name: RRC.BaumFultonMacPherson_unconditional
statement:
theorem BaumFultonMacPherson_unconditional :
    ∃ τ : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)]
        [IsNoetherian X], G0 X →+ TotalChow X,
      
      (∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)]
        [IsNoetherian X] [Y.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian Y]
        [Fact (ProjK k X)] [Fact (ProjK k Y)], ProjK k X → ProjK k Y →
        ∀ (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsProper f] (φ : G0 X →+ G0 Y), INDB.Computes f φ →
          ∀ x : G0 X, τ Y (φ x) = totalPushOn (opsK k) f (τ X x)) ∧
      
      (∀ {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)]
        [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (ProjK k X)] [IsIntegral X], ProjK k X → RegStalks X →
        ∀ (N : ℕ) (i : X ⟶ space k N) [IsClosedImmersion i] [i.IsOver (Spk k)] (x : K0 X),
          haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X) :=
            ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_projK (Fact.out : ProjK k X)⟩
          τ X (k0ToG0 X x) =
            ((tdLine k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N 1))
              (hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1 (hcr k N 1))) ^ (N + 1))
              (tauX k (closedPosV4 k) (chExact_closedPosV4 k) i x)) ∧
      
      (∀ {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)]
        [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (ProjK k X)] [ConnectedSpace X], ProjK k X →
        ∀ (y : K0 X) (x : G0 X), τ X (y • x) = chK0T2 k y (τ X x)) ∧
      
      (∀ {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)]
        [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (ProjK k X)], ProjK k X →
        ∀ (F : X.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike X F) (d : ℕ),
          (∀ x ∈ moduleSheafSupport F, height x ≤ d) →
          (∀ m, d < m → DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) m
              (τ X (g0ClassOf X F hF)) = 0) ∧
          DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) d (τ X (g0ClassOf X F hF)) =
            (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (coherentCycle F hF d) : DimChow X d)) ∧
      
      (∀ {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)]
        [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (ProjK k X)], ProjK k X →
        ∀ (N : ℕ) (ι : X ⟶ space k N) [IsClosedImmersion ι] [ι.IsOver (Spk k)]
          (x : G0 X) (y : K0 (space k N)), k0ToG0 (space k N) y = finitePushforward ι x →
          haveI : Fact (ProjK k (space k N)) := ⟨projK_space N rfl⟩
          totalPushOn (opsK k) ι (τ X x) = tdPn k N (chPn k N y (fundPn k N))) ∧
      
      (∀ e : ℤ, τ (space k 1) (k0ToG0 (space k 1) (projectiveTwistingK0Class k 1 e)) =
        fundPn k 1 + ((e : ℚ) + 1) • Hn k 1 (fundPn k 1))
proof:
:=
  BaumFultonMacPherson k (AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AssemblyFinal.regSpecAll_holds k)

name: RRC.SingularToddTransformation_nodalCubic_unconditional
statement:
theorem SingularToddTransformation_nodalCubic_unconditional :
    ProjK k (Xc k) ∧ IsIntegral (Xc k) ∧ ¬ RegStalks (Xc k) ∧
      Order.height (genericPoint (Xc k)) = 1 ∧
      degPn k 2 (totalPushOn (opsK k) (iotaP k)
        ((AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.targetThree k).tau (Xc k) (k0ToG0 (Xc k) 1))) = 0 ∧
      degPn k 2 (totalPushOn (opsK k) (iotaP k)
        ((AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.targetThree k).tau (Xc k) (k0ToG0 (Xc k)
          (pullbackK0RingHom (iotaP k) (projectiveTwistingK0Class k 2 1))))) = 3 ∧
      (∀ e : ℤ, degPn k 2 (totalPushOn (opsK k) (iotaP k)
        ((AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.targetThree k).tau (Xc k) (k0ToG0 (Xc k)
          (pullbackK0RingHom (iotaP k) (projectiveTwistingK0Class k 2 e))))) = 3 * (e : ℚ)) ∧
      (∀ m, 1 < m → DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow (Xc k) n) m
        ((AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.targetThree k).tau (Xc k) (k0ToG0 (Xc k) 1)) = 0) ∧
      DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow (Xc k) n) 1
          ((AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.targetThree k).tau (Xc k) (k0ToG0 (Xc k) 1)) =
        (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk
          (dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint (Xc k)) 1 (height_genericPoint_xc_nat k)) :
            DimChow (Xc k) 1)
proof:
:=
  SingularToddTransformation_nodalCubic k (AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.targetThree k)

name: FractionalIdeal.divisor_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem divisor_apply (I : (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ) (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) :
    divisor I v = count K v I
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [divisor]

name: FractionalIdeal.count_ofDivisor
statement:
@[simp]
theorem count_ofDivisor (D : Divisor R) (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) :
    count K v (ofDivisor K D : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) = D v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simpa [ofDivisor] using count_finsuppProd K v D

name: FractionalIdeal.eq_of_count_eq
statement:
private theorem eq_of_count_eq {I J : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K} (hI : I ≠ 0) (hJ : J ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ v, count K v I = count K v J) : I = J
proof:
:= by
  rw [← finprod_heightOneSpectrum_factorization' K hI,
    ← finprod_heightOneSpectrum_factorization' K hJ]
  exact finprod_congr fun v ↦ congr_arg ((v.asIdeal : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) ^ ·) (h v)

name: FractionalIdeal.principalFractionalIdeal_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem principalFractionalIdeal_apply_coe (x : Kˣ) :
    (principalFractionalIdeal (R := R) (K := K) x : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) =
      spanSingleton R⁰ (x : K)
proof: := rfl

name: FractionalIdeal.principalDivisor_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem principalDivisor_apply (x : Additive Kˣ) (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) :
    principalDivisor (R := R) (K := K) x v =
      count K v (spanSingleton R⁰ (x.toMul : K))
proof:
:= by
  change divisor (principalFractionalIdeal x.toMul) v = _
  rw [divisor_apply, principalFractionalIdeal_apply_coe]

name: FractionalIdeal.weightedDegree_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem weightedDegree_apply (w : Ideal R → ℕ) (D : Divisor R) :
    weightedDegree (R := R) w D =
      D.sum fun v n => n * (w v.asIdeal : ℤ)
proof: := rfl

name: FractionalIdeal.divisor_ideal_sum_eq_normalizedFactors_sum
statement:
theorem divisor_ideal_sum_eq_normalizedFactors_sum (J : Ideal R) (hJ : J ≠ ⊥)
    (w : Ideal R → ℕ) :
    let JU : (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ
proof:
:=
      Units.mk0 (J : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) (coeIdeal_ne_zero.mpr hJ)
    (divisor JU).sum (fun v n => n * (w v.asIdeal : ℤ)) =
      (((UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors J).map w).sum : ℤ) := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  rw [Finsupp.sum]
  let s := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors J
  have hcoeff (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) :
      divisor (Units.mk0 (J : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) (coeIdeal_ne_zero.mpr hJ)) v =
        (s.count v.asIdeal : ℤ) := by
    rw [divisor_apply, Units.val_mk0, count_coe K v hJ,
      Ideal.count_associates_factors_eq hJ v.isPrime v.ne_bot]
  have hsum :
      ∑ v ∈ (divisor
          (Units.mk0 (J : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) (coeIdeal_ne_zero.mpr hJ))).support,
          divisor (Units.mk0 (J : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) (coeIdeal_ne_zero.mpr hJ)) v *
            (w v.asIdeal : ℤ) =
        ∑ P ∈ s.toFinset, (s.count P : ℤ) * (w P : ℤ) := by
    apply Finset.sum_bij (fun v _ => v.asIdeal)
    · intro v hv
      rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset, ← Multiset.count_ne_zero]
      intro hz
      have : divisor
          (Units.mk0 (J : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) (coeIdeal_ne_zero.mpr hJ)) v = 0 := by
        rw [hcoeff, hz, Nat.cast_zero]
      exact (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hv) this
    · intro v₁ _ v₂ _ hv
      exact HeightOneSpectrum.ext hv
    · intro P hP
      rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset] at hP
      have hprime : Prime P :=
        UniqueFactorizationMonoid.prime_of_normalized_factor P hP
      let v : HeightOneSpectrum R :=
        ⟨P, Ideal.isPrime_of_prime hprime, hprime.ne_zero⟩
      refine ⟨v, ?_, rfl⟩
      rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, hcoeff]
      exact_mod_cast (Multiset.count_pos.mpr hP).ne'
    · intro v _
      rw [hcoeff]
  rw [hsum, Finset.sum_multiset_map_count]
  simp only [s, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_sum, Nat.cast_mul]
  push_cast
  rfl

name: FractionalIdeal.weightedDegree_divisor_ideal
statement:
theorem weightedDegree_divisor_ideal (J : Ideal R) (hJ : J ≠ ⊥)
    (w : Ideal R → ℕ) :
    weightedDegree (R := R) w
        (divisor (Units.mk0 (J : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) (coeIdeal_ne_zero.mpr hJ))) =
      (((UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors J).map w).sum : ℤ)
proof:
:=
  divisor_ideal_sum_eq_normalizedFactors_sum J hJ w

name: FractionalIdeal.weightedDegree_principal_mk'
statement:
theorem weightedDegree_principal_mk' (w : Ideal R → ℕ) (x : Kˣ) (n : R)
    (d : nonZeroDivisors R) (hnd : IsLocalization.mk' K n d = (x : K)) :
    weightedDegree (R := R) w (principalDivisor (Additive.ofMul x)) =
      (((UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors (Ideal.span {n})).map w).sum : ℤ) -
        (((UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors
          (Ideal.span {(d : R)})).map w).sum : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hn : n ≠ 0 := by
    intro hn
    exact x.ne_zero (by simpa [hn] using hnd.symm)
  have hd : (d : R) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero] using d.property
  have hspan : spanSingleton R⁰ (x : K) =
      spanSingleton R⁰ ((algebraMap R K) (d : R))⁻¹ *
        (Ideal.span {n} : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) := by
    rw [← hnd, IsFractionRing.mk'_eq_div, coeIdeal_span_singleton,
      spanSingleton_mul_spanSingleton]
    congr 1
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
    ac_rfl
  have hdiv : principalDivisor (R := R) (K := K) (Additive.ofMul x) =
      divisor (Units.mk0 (Ideal.span {n} : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)
          (coeIdeal_ne_zero.mpr (Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot.not.mpr hn))) -
        divisor (Units.mk0 (Ideal.span {(d : R)} : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)
          (coeIdeal_ne_zero.mpr (Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot.not.mpr hd))) := by
    ext v
    rw [principalDivisor_apply, Finsupp.sub_apply, divisor_apply, divisor_apply]
    change count K v (spanSingleton R⁰ (x : K)) =
      count K v (Ideal.span {n} : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) -
        count K v (Ideal.span {(d : R)} : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)
    rw [count_well_defined K v (spanSingleton_ne_zero_iff.mpr x.ne_zero) hspan,
      count_coe K v (Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot.not.mpr hn),
      count_coe K v (Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot.not.mpr hd)]
  rw [hdiv, map_sub,
    weightedDegree_divisor_ideal (K := K) (Ideal.span {n})
      (Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot.not.mpr hn) w,
    weightedDegree_divisor_ideal (K := K) (Ideal.span {(d : R)})
      (Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot.not.mpr hd) w]

name: RRC.isProper_structure_of_projectiveIntegralK
statement:
theorem isProper_structure_of_projectiveIntegralK
    {k : Type u} [CommRing k] {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X]
    (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) : IsProper (X ↘ Spk k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, N, j, hj, hjk⟩ := hX
  haveI := hj
  rw [← hjk]
  infer_instance

name: RRC.isProper_of_projectiveIntegralK
statement:
theorem isProper_of_projectiveIntegralK
    {k : Type u} [CommRing k] {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spk k)] [Y.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] : IsProper f
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsProper (X ↘ Spk k) := isProper_structure_of_projectiveIntegralK hX
  haveI : IsProper (Y ↘ Spk k) := isProper_structure_of_projectiveIntegralK hY
  haveI : IsProper (f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k)) := by
    rw [CategoryTheory.comp_over (f := f) (S := Spk k)]
    infer_instance
  exact IsProper.of_comp f (Y ↘ Spk k)

name: RRC.GrothendieckRiemannRoch
statement:
theorem GrothendieckRiemannRoch
    (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hXreg : RegStalks X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] (x : K0 X) :
    ch k hY (fShriek k hX hY hYreg f x) (fundamentalClass k hY) =
      pushforward k hX hY f
        (toddOfDual k hX (virtualCotangent k dX dY f)
          (ch k hX x (fundamentalClass k hX)))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsProper f := isProper_of_projectiveIntegralK hX hY f
  exact TF7.grr_chow_intrinsic_exists k dX dY hX hXreg hY hYreg f
    (CategoryTheory.comp_over (f := f) (S := Spk k)) x

name: RRC.adamsRiemannRoch
statement:
theorem adamsRiemannRoch
    (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hXreg : RegStalks X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] {n : ℕ} (i : X ⟶ PY k Y n) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hi : i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) = f) {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) (x : K0 X) :
    haveI : IsIntegral X
proof:
:= hX.1
    FIN.ARRwK hY hYreg n i hXreg j x (fShriek k hX hY hYreg f x) :=
  FIN.adamsRiemannRoch_kahler hX hXreg hY hYreg f
    (CategoryTheory.comp_over (f := f) (S := Spk k)) i hi hj x

name: RRC.fShriek_eq_alternatingSum_directImages
statement:
theorem fShriek_eq_alternatingSum_directImages
    (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] (E : X.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) :
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (hc : ∀ q, IsCoherentLike Y
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f E q)),
      (∀ q, N < q → CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f E q)) ∧
      k0ToG0 Y (fShriek k hX hY hYreg f (k0ClassOf X E hE)) =
        GrothendieckRiemannRoch.alternatingSum N (fun q ↦ g0ClassOf Y
          (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f E q) (hc q))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, i, hic, hi⟩ := RT.exists_factorisation hX hY f
    (CategoryTheory.comp_over (f := f) (S := Spk k))
  haveI := hic
  have h1 := CAN.k0ToG0_fShriekCan k hX hY hYreg f
    (CategoryTheory.comp_over (f := f) (S := Spk k)) i hi (k0ClassOf X E hE)
  have h2 := INDB.fShriekG0All_computes (k := k) (Y ↘ Spk k) n i
  rw [hi] at h2
  obtain ⟨N, hc, hz, he⟩ := h2 E hE.isFinitePresentation
  refine ⟨N, hc, hz, ?_⟩
  rw [fShriek, h1, k0ToG0_classOf]
  exact he

name: RRC.virtualCotangent_id
statement:
theorem virtualCotangent_id (dX : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension dX (X ↘ Spk k)] :
    virtualCotangent k dX dX (𝟙 X) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold virtualCotangent TF7.kahlerVirtual
  rw [pullbackK0RingHom_id]
  exact sub_self _

name: FunctionField.Chart.exp_neg_mul_lt_one_iff_le
statement:
lemma exp_neg_mul_lt_one_iff_le (x : ℤᵐ⁰) (n : ℤ) :
    WithZero.exp (-n) * x < 1 ↔ x ≤ WithZero.exp (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · simp [hx]
  rw [← WithZero.log_lt_log (mul_ne_zero WithZero.exp_ne_zero hx) one_ne_zero]
  rw [WithZero.log_mul WithZero.exp_ne_zero hx, WithZero.log_exp, WithZero.log_one]
  rw [← WithZero.log_le_iff_le_exp hx]
  omega

name: FunctionField.Chart.nonempty_placeA
statement: theorem nonempty_placeA : Nonempty (PlaceA k K)
proof:
:= by
  let P : Ideal k[X] := Ideal.span {Polynomial.X}
  letI : P.IsMaximal :=
    PrincipalIdealRing.isMaximal_of_irreducible Polynomial.irreducible_X
  obtain ⟨Q, hQprime, hQunder⟩ :=
    P.exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral_of_isDomain
      (S := ringOfIntegers k K) (by simp)
  have hQ0 : Q ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro hQ
    have hP : P = ⊥ := by simpa [hQ] using hQunder.symm
    have hX : Polynomial.X ∈ P := Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton _)
    rw [hP, Ideal.mem_bot] at hX
    exact Polynomial.X_ne_zero hX
  exact ⟨Sum.inl ⟨Q, hQprime, hQ0⟩⟩

name: FunctionField.Chart.memRRspace.zero_mem
statement: theorem zero_mem (D : DivisorA k K) : memRRspace k K D 0
proof:
:= fun v => by
  rw [map_zero]
  exact zero_le

name: FunctionField.Chart.memRRspace.add_mem
statement:
theorem add_mem {f g : K} (hf : memRRspace k K D f) (hg : memRRspace k K D g) :
    memRRspace k K D (f + g)
proof:
:= fun v =>
  le_trans (Valuation.map_add _ f g) (max_le (hf v) (hg v))

name: FunctionField.Chart.memRRspace.smul_mem
statement:
theorem smul_mem (c : k) {f : K} (hf : memRRspace k K D f) :
    memRRspace k K D (c • f)
proof:
:= fun v => by
  rw [Algebra.smul_def, map_mul]
  calc placeValuation k K v (algebraMap k K c) * placeValuation k K v f
      ≤ 1 * WithZero.exp (D v) :=
        mul_le_mul' (placeValuation_algebraMap_le_one k K v c) (hf v)
    _ = WithZero.exp (D v) := one_mul _

name: FunctionField.Chart.memRRspace.one_mem
statement: theorem one_mem : memRRspace k K 0 1
proof:
:= fun v => by
  rw [Valuation.map_one (placeValuation k K v)]
  show (1 : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) ≤ WithZero.exp ((0 : DivisorA k K) v)
  rw [Finsupp.zero_apply, ← WithZero.exp_zero]

name: FunctionField.Chart.memRRspace.mul_mem
statement:
theorem mul_mem {D E : DivisorA k K} {f g : K} (hf : memRRspace k K D f)
    (hg : memRRspace k K E g) :
    memRRspace k K (D + E) (f * g)
proof:
:= fun v => by
  rw [Valuation.map_mul (placeValuation k K v), Finsupp.add_apply]
  calc placeValuation k K v f * placeValuation k K v g
        ≤ WithZero.exp (D v) * WithZero.exp (E v) := mul_le_mul' (hf v) (hg v)
    _ = WithZero.exp (D v + E v) := by rw [← WithZero.exp_add]

name: FunctionField.Chart.memRRspace.memRRspace_mono
statement:
theorem memRRspace_mono {D E : DivisorA k K} (h : D ≤ E) {f : K} (hf : memRRspace k K D f) :
    memRRspace k K E f
proof:
:= fun v =>
  (hf v).trans (WithZero.exp_le_exp.mpr (h v))

name: FunctionField.Chart.memRRspace.pow_mem
statement:
theorem pow_mem {D : DivisorA k K} {f : K} (hf : memRRspace k K D f) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, memRRspace k K (n • D) (f ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simpa using one_mem (k := k) (K := K)
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [succ_nsmul, pow_succ]
      exact mul_mem (k := k) (K := K) ih hf

name: FunctionField.Chart.mem_RRspace_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_RRspace_iff (D : DivisorA k K) (f : K) :
    f ∈ RRspace k K D ↔ memRRspace k K D f
proof:
:= by
  simp [RRspace]

name: FunctionField.Chart.RRspace_mono
statement:
theorem RRspace_mono {D D' : DivisorA k K} (h : D ≤ D') :
    RRspace k K D ≤ RRspace k K D'
proof:
:= by
  intro f hf
  rw [mem_RRspace_iff] at hf ⊢
  exact fun v => (hf v).trans (WithZero.exp_le_exp.mpr (h v))

name: FunctionField.Chart.ell_add_principal
statement:
theorem ell_add_principal (D : DivisorA k K) (x : Kˣ) :
    ell k K (D + principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul x)) = ell k K D
proof:
:= by
  exact (RRspaceAddPrincipalEquiv k K D x).finrank_eq

name: FunctionField.Chart.finiteLocalResidueMap_ker
statement:
theorem finiteLocalResidueMap_ker (D : DivisorA k K)
    (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (ringOfIntegers k K)) :
    (finiteLocalResidueMap k K D v).ker =
      Submodule.comap (RRspace k K (D + Finsupp.single (Sum.inl v) 1)).subtype
        (RRspace k K D)
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.coe_subtype,
    mem_RRspace_iff]
  change IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.residueHom (K := K) v
      ⟨(Classical.choose (v.valuation_exists_uniformizer K)) ^
          (D (Sum.inl v) + 1) * (f : K), _⟩ = 0 ↔
    ∀ w, placeValuation k K w (f : K) ≤ WithZero.exp (D w)
  rw [IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.residueHom_eq_zero_iff]
  have hπ := Classical.choose_spec (v.valuation_exists_uniformizer K)
  rw [map_mul, map_zpow₀, hπ]
  rw [← WithZero.exp_zsmul]
  have hnsmul : (D (Sum.inl v) + 1) • (-1 : ℤ) = -(D (Sum.inl v) + 1) := by
    simp
  rw [hnsmul]
  have hlocal : WithZero.exp (-(D (Sum.inl v) + 1)) * v.valuation K (f : K) < 1 ↔
      v.valuation K (f : K) ≤ WithZero.exp (D (Sum.inl v)) := by
    simpa using exp_neg_mul_lt_one_iff_le
      (v.valuation K (f : K)) (D (Sum.inl v) + 1)
  rw [hlocal]
  constructor
  · intro hv w
    by_cases hw : w = Sum.inl v
    · subst w
      exact hv
    · have hf := f.property w
      simpa [placeValuation, hw] using hf
  · intro hf
    simpa [placeValuation] using hf (Sum.inl v)

name: FunctionField.Chart.finrankRRspaceDiff_single_finite_le
statement:
theorem finrankRRspaceDiff_single_finite_le (D : DivisorA k K)
    (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (ringOfIntegers k K)) :
    finrankRRspaceDiff k K D (D + Finsupp.single (Sum.inl v) 1) ≤
      placeDegree k K (Sum.inl v)
proof:
:= by
  let f := finiteLocalResidueMap k K D v
  let e : (ringOfIntegers k K ⧸ v.asIdeal) ≃ₗ[k] v.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
    LinearEquiv.ofBijective
      ((Algebra.linearMap (ringOfIntegers k K ⧸ v.asIdeal)
        v.asIdeal.ResidueField).restrictScalars k)
      (Ideal.bijective_algebraMap_quotient_residueField v.asIdeal)
  letI : FiniteDimensional k v.asIdeal.ResidueField := e.finiteDimensional
  have hker := finiteLocalResidueMap_ker k K D v
  rw [finrankRRspaceDiff, ← hker, f.quotKerEquivRange.finrank_eq]
  calc
    Module.finrank k f.range ≤ Module.finrank k v.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
      f.range.finrank_le
    _ = Module.finrank k (ringOfIntegers k K ⧸ v.asIdeal) := by
      exact e.finrank_eq.symm
    _ = placeDegree k K (Sum.inl v) := rfl

name: FunctionField.Chart.infiniteLocalResidueMap_ker
statement:
theorem infiniteLocalResidueMap_ker (D : DivisorA k K)
    (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (infiniteIntegers k K)) :
    (infiniteLocalResidueMap k K D v).ker =
      Submodule.comap (RRspace k K (D + Finsupp.single (Sum.inr v) 1)).subtype
        (RRspace k K D)
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.coe_subtype,
    mem_RRspace_iff]
  change IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.residueHom (K := K) v
      ⟨(Classical.choose (v.valuation_exists_uniformizer K)) ^
          (D (Sum.inr v) + 1) * (f : K), _⟩ = 0 ↔
    ∀ w, placeValuation k K w (f : K) ≤ WithZero.exp (D w)
  rw [IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.residueHom_eq_zero_iff]
  have hπ := Classical.choose_spec (v.valuation_exists_uniformizer K)
  rw [map_mul, map_zpow₀, hπ]
  rw [← WithZero.exp_zsmul]
  have hnsmul : (D (Sum.inr v) + 1) • (-1 : ℤ) = -(D (Sum.inr v) + 1) := by
    simp
  rw [hnsmul]
  have hlocal : WithZero.exp (-(D (Sum.inr v) + 1)) * v.valuation K (f : K) < 1 ↔
      v.valuation K (f : K) ≤ WithZero.exp (D (Sum.inr v)) := by
    simpa using exp_neg_mul_lt_one_iff_le
      (v.valuation K (f : K)) (D (Sum.inr v) + 1)
  rw [hlocal]
  constructor
  · intro hv w
    by_cases hw : w = Sum.inr v
    · subst w
      exact hv

name: FunctionField.Chart.finrankRRspaceDiff_single_infinite_le
statement:
theorem finrankRRspaceDiff_single_infinite_le (D : DivisorA k K)
    (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (infiniteIntegers k K)) :
    finrankRRspaceDiff k K D (D + Finsupp.single (Sum.inr v) 1) ≤
      placeDegree k K (Sum.inr v)
proof:
:= by
  let f := infiniteLocalResidueMap k K D v
  let e : (infiniteIntegers k K ⧸ v.asIdeal) ≃ₗ[k] v.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
    LinearEquiv.ofBijective
      ((Algebra.linearMap (infiniteIntegers k K ⧸ v.asIdeal)
        v.asIdeal.ResidueField).restrictScalars k)
      (Ideal.bijective_algebraMap_quotient_residueField v.asIdeal)
  letI : FiniteDimensional k v.asIdeal.ResidueField := e.finiteDimensional
  have hker := infiniteLocalResidueMap_ker k K D v
  rw [finrankRRspaceDiff, ← hker, f.quotKerEquivRange.finrank_eq]
  calc
    Module.finrank k f.range ≤ Module.finrank k v.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
      f.range.finrank_le
    _ = Module.finrank k (infiniteIntegers k K ⧸ v.asIdeal) := by
      exact e.finrank_eq.symm
    _ = placeDegree k K (Sum.inr v) := rfl

name: FunctionField.Chart.finiteDimensional_add_single_one
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_add_single_one (D : DivisorA k K) (v : PlaceA k K)
    [FiniteDimensional k (RRspace k K D)] :
    FiniteDimensional k (RRspace k K (D + Finsupp.single v 1))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hle : RRspace k K D ≤ RRspace k K (D + Finsupp.single v 1) := by
    apply RRspace_mono k K
    intro w
    simp only [Finsupp.add_apply]
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (by
      simp only [Finsupp.single_apply]
      split <;> omega)
  let p := Submodule.comap (RRspace k K (D + Finsupp.single v 1)).subtype
    (RRspace k K D)
  letI : Module.Finite k p :=
    Module.Finite.equiv (Submodule.comapSubtypeEquivOfLe hle).symm
  rcases v with v | v
  · let f := finiteLocalResidueMap k K D v
    let e : (ringOfIntegers k K ⧸ v.asIdeal) ≃ₗ[k] v.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
      LinearEquiv.ofBijective
        ((Algebra.linearMap (ringOfIntegers k K ⧸ v.asIdeal)
          v.asIdeal.ResidueField).restrictScalars k)
        (Ideal.bijective_algebraMap_quotient_residueField v.asIdeal)
    letI : FiniteDimensional k v.asIdeal.ResidueField := e.finiteDimensional
    letI : Module.Finite k f.range := inferInstance
    haveI hqker : Module.Finite k
        (RRspace k K (D + Finsupp.single (Sum.inl v) 1) ⧸ f.ker) :=
      Module.Finite.equiv f.quotKerEquivRange.symm
    haveI hqp : Module.Finite k
        (RRspace k K (D + Finsupp.single (Sum.inl v) 1) ⧸ p) := by
      exact Module.Finite.equiv (Submodule.quotEquivOfEq f.ker p
        (finiteLocalResidueMap_ker k K D v))
    exact Module.Finite.of_submodule_quotient p
  · let f := infiniteLocalResidueMap k K D v
    let e : (infiniteIntegers k K ⧸ v.asIdeal) ≃ₗ[k] v.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
      LinearEquiv.ofBijective
        ((Algebra.linearMap (infiniteIntegers k K ⧸ v.asIdeal)
          v.asIdeal.ResidueField).restrictScalars k)
        (Ideal.bijective_algebraMap_quotient_residueField v.asIdeal)
    letI : FiniteDimensional k v.asIdeal.ResidueField := e.finiteDimensional
    letI : Module.Finite k f.range := inferInstance
    haveI hqker : Module.Finite k
        (RRspace k K (D + Finsupp.single (Sum.inr v) 1) ⧸ f.ker) :=
      Module.Finite.equiv f.quotKerEquivRange.symm
    haveI hqp : Module.Finite k
        (RRspace k K (D + Finsupp.single (Sum.inr v) 1) ⧸ p) := by
      exact Module.Finite.equiv (Submodule.quotEquivOfEq f.ker p
        (infiniteLocalResidueMap_ker k K D v))
    exact Module.Finite.of_submodule_quotient p

name: FunctionField.Chart.finiteDimensional_add_single_nat
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_add_single_nat (D : DivisorA k K) (v : PlaceA k K)
    (n : ℕ) [FiniteDimensional k (RRspace k K D)] :
    FiniteDimensional k (RRspace k K (D + Finsupp.single v (n : ℤ)))
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      have heq : D + Finsupp.single v ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) = D := by simp
      rw [heq]
      infer_instance
  | succ n ih =>
      letI : FiniteDimensional k
          (RRspace k K (D + Finsupp.single v (n : ℤ))) := ih
      have hfin := finiteDimensional_add_single_one k K
        (D + Finsupp.single v (n : ℤ)) v
      have heq : D + Finsupp.single v ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) =
          (D + Finsupp.single v (n : ℤ)) + Finsupp.single v 1 := by
        classical
        ext w
        simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
        split <;> omega
      rw [heq]
      exact hfin

name: FunctionField.Chart.finrankRRspaceDiff_add_finrank_of_finite
statement:
theorem finrankRRspaceDiff_add_finrank_of_finite {D D' : DivisorA k K}
    (h : D ≤ D') [FiniteDimensional k (RRspace k K D')] :
    finrankRRspaceDiff k K D D' + Module.finrank k (RRspace k K D) =
      Module.finrank k (RRspace k K D')
proof:
:= by
  letI : AddCommGroup (RRspace k K D') := Submodule.addCommGroup _
  letI : Module k (RRspace k K D') := Submodule.module _
  rw [finrankRRspaceDiff,
    ← (Submodule.comapSubtypeEquivOfLe (RRspace_mono k K h)).finrank_eq]
  exact Submodule.finrank_quotient_add_finrank _

name: FunctionField.Chart.finrankRRspaceDiff_single_one_le
statement:
theorem finrankRRspaceDiff_single_one_le (D : DivisorA k K) (v : PlaceA k K) :
    finrankRRspaceDiff k K D (D + Finsupp.single v 1) ≤ placeDegree k K v
proof:
:= by
  rcases v with v | v
  · exact finrankRRspaceDiff_single_finite_le k K D v
  · exact finrankRRspaceDiff_single_infinite_le k K D v

name: FunctionField.Chart.finrankRRspaceDiff_single_nat_le
statement:
theorem finrankRRspaceDiff_single_nat_le (D : DivisorA k K) (v : PlaceA k K)
    (n : ℕ) [FiniteDimensional k (RRspace k K D)] :
    finrankRRspaceDiff k K D (D + Finsupp.single v (n : ℤ)) ≤
      n * placeDegree k K v
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, Finsupp.single_zero, add_zero, zero_mul]
      rw [finrankRRspaceDiff]
      have hp : Submodule.comap (RRspace k K D).subtype (RRspace k K D) = ⊤ := by
        ext f
        simp
      rw [hp]
      have h := Submodule.finrank_quotient_add_finrank
        (⊤ : Submodule k (RRspace k K D))
      simp only [finrank_top] at h
      omega
  | succ n ih =>
      let M := D + Finsupp.single v (n : ℤ)
      let N := M + Finsupp.single v 1
      letI : FiniteDimensional k (RRspace k K M) :=
        finiteDimensional_add_single_nat k K D v n
      letI : FiniteDimensional k (RRspace k K N) :=
        finiteDimensional_add_single_one k K M v
      have hDM : D ≤ M := by
        intro w
        dsimp only [M]
        simp only [Finsupp.add_apply]
        exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (by
          classical
          simp only [Finsupp.single_apply]
          split <;> omega)
      have hMN : M ≤ N := by
        intro w
        dsimp only [N]
        simp only [Finsupp.add_apply]
        exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (by
          classical
          simp only [Finsupp.single_apply]
          split <;> omega)
      have hDN : D ≤ N := hDM.trans hMN
      have hsumDM := finrankRRspaceDiff_add_finrank_of_finite k K hDM
      have hsumMN := finrankRRspaceDiff_add_finrank_of_finite k K hMN
      have hsumDN := finrankRRspaceDiff_add_finrank_of_finite k K hDN
      have hstep := finrankRRspaceDiff_single_one_le k K M v
      change finrankRRspaceDiff k K D M ≤ n * placeDegree k K v at ih
      change finrankRRspaceDiff k K M N ≤ placeDegree k K v at hstep
      have htotal : finrankRRspaceDiff k K D N ≤
          n * placeDegree k K v + placeDegree k K v := by omega
      have heq : D + Finsupp.single v ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = N := by
        classical
        ext w
        simp only [N, M, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
        split <;> omega
      rw [heq]
      simpa [Nat.succ_mul] using htotal

name: FunctionField.Chart.finiteDimensional_add_effective
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_add_effective (D E : DivisorA k K)
    (hE : IsEffective k K E) [FiniteDimensional k (RRspace k K D)] :
    FiniteDimensional k (RRspace k K (D + E))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction E using Finsupp.induction generalizing D with
  | zero =>
      rw [add_zero]
      infer_instance
  | single_add a b f ha hb ih =>
      have hfa : f a = 0 := Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp ha
      have hff : IsEffective k K f := by
        intro w
        by_cases hw : w = a
        · subst w
          rw [hfa]
        · have hwE := hE w
          simpa [Finsupp.single_apply, hw] using hwE
      have hb0 : 0 ≤ b := by
        have haE := hE a
        simpa [Finsupp.single_apply, hfa] using haE
      letI : FiniteDimensional k (RRspace k K (D + f)) := ih D hff
      have hsingle := finiteDimensional_add_single_nat k K (D + f) a b.toNat
      have hbcast : (b.toNat : ℤ) = b := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hb0
      have heq : D + (Finsupp.single a b + f) =
          (D + f) + Finsupp.single a (b.toNat : ℤ) := by
        rw [hbcast]
        abel
      rw [heq]
      exact hsingle

name: FunctionField.Chart.finrankRRspaceDiff_add_effective_le
statement:
theorem finrankRRspaceDiff_add_effective_le (D E : DivisorA k K)
    (hE : IsEffective k K E) [FiniteDimensional k (RRspace k K D)] :
    finrankRRspaceDiff k K D (D + E) ≤ (deg k K E).toNat
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction E using Finsupp.induction generalizing D with
  | zero =>
      rw [add_zero, finrankRRspaceDiff]
      have hp : Submodule.comap (RRspace k K D).subtype (RRspace k K D) = ⊤ := by
        ext f
        simp
      rw [hp, deg_zero]
      have h := Submodule.finrank_quotient_add_finrank
        (⊤ : Submodule k (RRspace k K D))
      simp only [finrank_top] at h
      omega
  | single_add a b f ha hb ih =>
      have hfa : f a = 0 := Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp ha
      have hff : IsEffective k K f := by
        intro w
        by_cases hw : w = a
        · subst w
          rw [hfa]
        · have hwE := hE w
          simpa [Finsupp.single_apply, hw] using hwE
      have hb0 : 0 ≤ b := by
        have haE := hE a
        simpa [Finsupp.single_apply, hfa] using haE
      let M := D + f
      let N := M + Finsupp.single a (b.toNat : ℤ)
      letI : FiniteDimensional k (RRspace k K M) :=
        finiteDimensional_add_effective k K D f hff
      letI : FiniteDimensional k (RRspace k K N) :=
        finiteDimensional_add_single_nat k K M a b.toNat
      have hDM : D ≤ M := by
        intro w
        dsimp only [M]
        simp only [Finsupp.add_apply]
        exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (hff w)
      have hMN : M ≤ N := by
        intro w
        dsimp only [N]
        simp only [Finsupp.add_apply]
        exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (by
          simp only [Finsupp.single_apply]
          split <;> omega)
      have hDN : D ≤ N := hDM.trans hMN
      have hsumDM := finrankRRspaceDiff_add_finrank_of_finite k K hDM
      have hsumMN := finrankRRspaceDiff_add_finrank_of_finite k K hMN
      have hsumDN := finrankRRspaceDiff_add_finrank_of_finite k K hDN
      have hfirst := ih D hff
      change finrankRRspaceDiff k K D M ≤ (deg k K f).toNat at hfirst
      have hsecond := finrankRRspaceDiff_single_nat_le k K M a b.toNat
      change finrankRRspaceDiff k K M N ≤ b.toNat * placeDegree k K a at hsecond
      have hbcast : (b.toNat : ℤ) = b := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hb0
      have hdegf : 0 ≤ deg k K f := deg_nonneg k K hff
      have hdegE : deg k K (Finsupp.single a b + f) =
          b * (placeDegree k K a : ℤ) + deg k K f := by
        rw [deg_add]
        simp [deg]
      have hdegE0 : 0 ≤ deg k K (Finsupp.single a b + f) := deg_nonneg k K hE
      have hdegNat : (deg k K (Finsupp.single a b + f)).toNat =
          b.toNat * placeDegree k K a + (deg k K f).toNat := by
        have hfcast : ((deg k K f).toNat : ℤ) = deg k K f :=
          Int.toNat_of_nonneg hdegf
        have hEcast : ((deg k K (Finsupp.single a b + f)).toNat : ℤ) =
            deg k K (Finsupp.single a b + f) := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hdegE0
        apply Int.ofNat_injective
        change ((deg k K (Finsupp.single a b + f)).toNat : ℤ) =
          ((b.toNat * placeDegree k K a + (deg k K f).toNat : ℕ) : ℤ)
        rw [hEcast, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, hbcast, hfcast]
        exact hdegE
      have htotal : finrankRRspaceDiff k K D N ≤
          (deg k K (Finsupp.single a b + f)).toNat := by omega
      have heq : D + (Finsupp.single a b + f) = N := by
        dsimp only [N, M]
        rw [hbcast]
        abel
      rw [heq]
      exact htotal

name: FunctionField.Chart.deg_principalDivisor_eq_zero
statement:
theorem deg_principalDivisor_eq_zero (x : Kˣ) :
    deg k K (principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul x)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact deg_principalDivisorA_eq_zero k K x

name: FunctionField.Chart.RRspace_neg_deg
statement:
theorem RRspace_neg_deg {D : DivisorA k K} (h : deg k K D < 0) :
    RRspace k K D = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro f hf
    rw [Submodule.mem_bot]
    by_contra hf0
    let x : Kˣ := Units.mk0 f hf0
    have hdiv : -D ≤ principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul x) := by
      intro v
      have hv := hf v
      have hxval := placeValuation_eq_exp_neg_principalDivisor k K (Additive.ofMul x) v
      change placeValuation k K v f ≤ WithZero.exp (D v) at hv
      change placeValuation k K v f =
        WithZero.exp (-(principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul x) v)) at hxval
      rw [hxval] at hv
      have hexp := WithZero.exp_le_exp.mp hv
      simp only [Finsupp.neg_apply]
      omega
    have hdeg := deg_mono k K hdiv
    rw [deg_neg, deg_principalDivisor_eq_zero k K x] at hdeg
    omega
  · exact bot_le

name: FunctionField.Chart.RRspace_neg_deg_ell
statement: theorem RRspace_neg_deg_ell {D : DivisorA k K} (h : deg k K D < 0) : ell k K D = 0
proof:
:= by
  show Module.finrank k (RRspace k K D) = 0
  rw [RRspace_neg_deg k K h]
  exact finrank_bot k K

name: FunctionField.Chart.finiteDimensional_RRspace_aux
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_RRspace_aux (D : DivisorA k K) :
    FiniteDimensional k (RRspace k K D)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let v : PlaceA k K := Classical.choice (nonempty_placeA k K)
  let n : ℕ := (deg k K D).toNat + 1
  let D₀ : DivisorA k K := D - Finsupp.single v (n : ℤ)
  have hdegSingle : deg k K (Finsupp.single v (n : ℤ)) =
      (n : ℤ) * placeDegree k K v := by
    simp [deg]
  have hnpos : 0 < (n : ℤ) := by
    dsimp only [n]
    omega
  have hvpos : 0 < (placeDegree k K v : ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast placeDegree_pos k K v
  have hdegDle : deg k K D < (n : ℤ) * placeDegree k K v := by
    by_cases hdeg0 : 0 ≤ deg k K D
    · have hcast : ((deg k K D).toNat : ℤ) = deg k K D :=
        Int.toNat_of_nonneg hdeg0
      have hdlt : deg k K D < (n : ℤ) := by
        dsimp only [n]
        push_cast
        omega
      have hnle : (n : ℤ) ≤ (n : ℤ) * placeDegree k K v := by
        have hvone : (1 : ℤ) ≤ placeDegree k K v := by omega
        simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hvone hnpos.le
      exact hdlt.trans_le hnle
    · have hprod : 0 < (n : ℤ) * placeDegree k K v :=
        mul_pos hnpos hvpos
      omega
  have hD₀neg : deg k K D₀ < 0 := by
    dsimp only [D₀]
    rw [deg_sub, hdegSingle]
    omega
  have hbot := RRspace_neg_deg k K hD₀neg
  letI : FiniteDimensional k (RRspace k K D₀) := by
    rw [hbot]
    infer_instance
  have hfin := finiteDimensional_add_single_nat k K D₀ v n
  have heq : D₀ + Finsupp.single v (n : ℤ) = D := by
    dsimp only [D₀]
    abel
  rw [heq] at hfin
  exact hfin

name: FunctionField.Chart.finrank_RRspace_quotient_le
statement:
theorem finrank_RRspace_quotient_le {D D' : DivisorA k K} (h : D ≤ D') :
    finrankRRspaceDiff k K D D' ≤ (deg k K (D' - D)).toNat
proof:
:= by
  letI : FiniteDimensional k (RRspace k K D) := finiteDimensional_RRspace_aux k K D
  have hE : IsEffective k K (D' - D) := (le_iff_sub_effective k K).mp h
  have hrank := finrankRRspaceDiff_add_effective_le k K D (D' - D) hE
  have heq : D + (D' - D) = D' := by abel
  rw [heq] at hrank
  exact hrank

name: FunctionField.Chart.isAlgebraic_of_placeValuation_le_one
statement:
theorem isAlgebraic_of_placeValuation_le_one (f : K)
    (hf : ∀ v : PlaceA k K, placeValuation k K v f ≤ 1) : IsAlgebraic k f
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf0 : f = 0
  · subst f
    exact isAlgebraic_zero
  have hfin := IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.mem_integers_of_valuation_le_one
    (R := ringOfIntegers k K) K f (fun v => hf (Sum.inl v))
  have hinf := IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.mem_integers_of_valuation_le_one
    (R := infiniteIntegers k K) K f (fun v => hf (Sum.inr v))
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hfin
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hinf
  let p : k[X][X] := minpoly k[X] a
  let q : (inftyValuationSubring k)[X] := minpoly (inftyValuationSubring k) b
  have hpmap : minpoly k⟮X⟯ f = p.map (algebraMap k[X] k⟮X⟯) := by
    rw [← ha]
    exact minpoly.isIntegrallyClosed_eq_field_fractions k⟮X⟯ K
      (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral a)
  have hqmap : minpoly k⟮X⟯ f =
      q.map (algebraMap (inftyValuationSubring k) k⟮X⟯) := by
    rw [← hb]
    exact minpoly.isIntegrallyClosed_eq_field_fractions k⟮X⟯ K
      (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral b)
  have hpcoeff : ∀ i, p.coeff i ∈ Set.range (Polynomial.C : k →+* k[X]) := by
    intro i
    let c := p.coeff i
    have hcval : RatFunc.inftyValuation k (algebraMap k[X] k⟮X⟯ c) ≤ 1 := by
      have hc : algebraMap k[X] k⟮X⟯ c =
          algebraMap (inftyValuationSubring k) k⟮X⟯ (q.coeff i) := by
        have hc' := congrArg (fun r : k⟮X⟯[X] => r.coeff i) (hpmap.symm.trans hqmap)
        simpa [p, q, c] using hc'
      rw [hc]
      exact (q.coeff i).property
    by_cases hc0 : c = 0
    · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      change Polynomial.C 0 = c
      simp [hc0]
    have hdeg : c.natDegree = 0 := by
      rw [RatFunc.inftyValuation_apply, RatFunc.inftyValuation.polynomial (F := k) hc0,
        ← WithZero.exp_zero, WithZero.exp_le_exp] at hcval
      omega
    exact ⟨c.coeff 0, (Polynomial.eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero hdeg).symm⟩
  have hprange : p ∈ (Polynomial.mapRingHom (Polynomial.C : k →+* k[X])).range := by
    rw [Polynomial.mem_map_range]
    exact hpcoeff
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := hprange
  have hP0 : P ≠ 0 := by
    intro hP0
    rw [hP0, map_zero] at hP
    have hpmonic : p.Monic := minpoly.monic (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral a)
    exact hpmonic.ne_zero hP.symm
  refine ⟨P, hP0, ?_⟩
  have hroot : Polynomial.aeval a p = 0 := minpoly.aeval _ _
  rw [← hP] at hroot
  change Polynomial.aeval a (P.map (Polynomial.C : k →+* k[X])) = 0 at hroot
  calc
    Polynomial.aeval f P = Polynomial.aeval f
        (P.map (Polynomial.C : k →+* k[X])) := by
      symm
      exact Polynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap k[X] f P
    _ = algebraMap (ringOfIntegers k K) K
        (Polynomial.aeval a (P.map (Polynomial.C : k →+* k[X]))) := by
      rw [← ha]
      symm
      simp
    _ = 0 := by rw [hroot, map_zero]

name: FunctionField.Chart.ell_zero
statement: theorem ell_zero [IsFullConstantField k K] : ell k K (0 : DivisorA k K) = 1
proof:
:= by
  let φ : k →ₗ[k] RRspace k K (0 : DivisorA k K) :=
    { toFun := fun c => ⟨algebraMap k K c, by
        intro v
        simpa using placeValuation_algebraMap_le_one k K v c⟩
      map_add' := fun x y => Subtype.ext (map_add (algebraMap k K) x y)
      map_smul' := fun c x => Subtype.ext (by simp [Algebra.smul_def]) }
  have hφ : Function.Bijective φ := by
    constructor
    · intro c d hcd
      apply (algebraMap k K).injective
      exact congrArg Subtype.val hcd
    · intro f
      have hfalg : IsAlgebraic k (f : K) := by
        apply isAlgebraic_of_placeValuation_le_one k K f
        intro v
        simpa [memRRspace] using f.property v
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := IsFullConstantField.algebraic_mem
        (k := k) (K := K) (f : K) hfalg
      refine ⟨c, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
      exact hc.symm
  let e : k ≃ₗ[k] RRspace k K (0 : DivisorA k K) := LinearEquiv.ofBijective φ hφ
  change Module.finrank k (RRspace k K (0 : DivisorA k K)) = 1
  rw [← e.finrank_eq]
  exact Module.finrank_self k

name: FunctionField.Chart.finrankRRspaceDiff_add_ell
statement:
theorem finrankRRspaceDiff_add_ell {D D' : DivisorA k K} (h : D ≤ D') :
    finrankRRspaceDiff k K D D' + ell k K D = ell k K D'
proof:
:= by
  letI : AddCommGroup (RRspace k K D') := Submodule.addCommGroup _
  letI : Module k (RRspace k K D') := Submodule.module _
  rw [finrankRRspaceDiff, ell, ell,
    ← (Submodule.comapSubtypeEquivOfLe (RRspace_mono k K h)).finrank_eq]
  exact Submodule.finrank_quotient_add_finrank _

name: FunctionField.Chart.ell_le
statement:
theorem ell_le [IsFullConstantField k K] (D : DivisorA k K) :
    (ell k K D : ℤ) ≤ deg k K (D ⊔ 0) + 1
proof:
:= by
  let E := D ⊔ 0
  have h0E : (0 : DivisorA k K) ≤ E := le_sup_right
  have hDE : D ≤ E := le_sup_left
  have hdegE : 0 ≤ deg k K E := deg_nonneg k K h0E
  have hq := finrank_RRspace_quotient_le k K h0E
  have hsum := finrankRRspaceDiff_add_ell k K h0E
  have hmono : ell k K D ≤ ell k K E := by
    exact Submodule.finrank_mono (RRspace_mono k K hDE)
  rw [ell_zero k K] at hsum
  have htoNat : ((deg k K E).toNat : ℤ) = deg k K E := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hdegE
  have hqZ : (finrankRRspaceDiff k K 0 E : ℤ) ≤
      ((deg k K (E - 0)).toNat : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hq
  simp only [sub_zero] at hqZ
  rw [htoNat] at hqZ
  change (ell k K D : ℤ) ≤ deg k K E + 1
  omega

name: FunctionField.Chart.ell_le_nonneg
statement:
theorem ell_le_nonneg [IsFullConstantField k K] {D : DivisorA k K} (hD : 0 ≤ D) :
    (ell k K D : ℤ) ≤ deg k K D + 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa [sup_eq_left.mpr hD] using ell_le k K D

name: FunctionField.Chart.defect_mono
statement:
theorem defect_mono {D D' : DivisorA k K} (h : D ≤ D') :
    deg k K D - ell k K D ≤ deg k K D' - ell k K D'
proof:
:= by
  have hdeg : 0 ≤ deg k K (D' - D) :=
    deg_nonneg k K ((le_iff_sub_effective k K).mp h)
  have hq := finrank_RRspace_quotient_le k K h
  have hsum := finrankRRspaceDiff_add_ell k K h
  have htoNat : ((deg k K (D' - D)).toNat : ℤ) = deg k K (D' - D) :=
    Int.toNat_of_nonneg hdeg
  have hqZ : (finrankRRspaceDiff k K D D' : ℤ) ≤
      ((deg k K (D' - D)).toNat : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hq
  rw [deg_sub] at htoNat
  rw [deg_sub] at hqZ
  rw [htoNat] at hqZ
  omega

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.stalk_isIntegrallyClosed
statement:
theorem stalk_isIntegrallyClosed (x : space k n) :
    IsIntegrallyClosed ((space k n).presheaf.stalk x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, x ∈ coordinateOpen k n i := by
    have : x ∈ (⨆ i : Fin (n + 1), coordinateOpen k n i) := by
      rw [coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top]; trivial
    simpa [TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup] using this
  have hU := coordinateOpen_isAffine k n i
  let U := coordinateOpen k n i
  letI : Algebra Γ(space k n, U) ((space k n).presheaf.stalk x) :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.algebra_section_stalk (space k n).presheaf ⟨x, hi⟩
  haveI := hU.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hi⟩
  let e := coordinateOpenSectionsEquiv k n i
  letI : Algebra (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) k) ((space k n).presheaf.stalk x) :=
    ((algebraMap Γ(space k n, U) ((space k n).presheaf.stalk x)).comp e.symm.toRingHom).toAlgebra
  haveI := IsLocalization.isLocalization_of_base_ringEquiv
    (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hi⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl ((space k n).presheaf.stalk x) e
  refine isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization (R := MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) k)
    ((space k n).presheaf.stalk x) ((hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hi⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl.map e) ?_
  rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  haveI : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨x, hi⟩⟩
  refine mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero ?_
  intro h0
  apply hy
  have : y = 0 := e.injective (by simpa using h0)
  simp [this]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.stalk_isNoetherianRing
statement:
theorem stalk_isNoetherianRing (x : space k n) :
    IsNoetherianRing ((space k n).presheaf.stalk x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, x ∈ coordinateOpen k n i := by
    have : x ∈ (⨆ i : Fin (n + 1), coordinateOpen k n i) := by
      rw [coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top]; trivial
    simpa [TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup] using this
  have hU := coordinateOpen_isAffine k n i
  let U := coordinateOpen k n i
  letI : Algebra Γ(space k n, U) ((space k n).presheaf.stalk x) :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.algebra_section_stalk (space k n).presheaf ⟨x, hi⟩
  haveI := hU.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hi⟩
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(space k n, U) :=
    isNoetherianRing_of_ringEquiv _ (coordinateOpenSectionsEquiv k n i).symm
  exact IsLocalization.isNoetherianRing (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hi⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl _
    inferInstance

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.isZero_of_forall_not_mem_support
statement:
theorem isZero_of_forall_not_mem_support (E : X.Modules)
    (h : ∀ x : X, x ∉ moduleSheafSupport E) : IsZero E
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero]
  ext U s
  let T : TopCat.Sheaf Ab X := ⟨E.presheaf, E.isSheaf⟩
  refine TopCat.Presheaf.section_ext T U _ _ fun x hx ↦ ?_
  haveI : Subsingleton (E.presheaf.stalk x) := not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton.mp (h x)
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.germ_smul_eq_zero_of_killed
statement:
theorem germ_smul_eq_zero_of_killed {E : X.Modules} (hE : (sigmaT Λ s).app E = 0)
    {W : X.Opens} {x : X} (hx : x ∈ W) (l : Λ.val.obj (op W))
    (e : (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj E) : germVal s hx l • e = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hk := (sigmaT_app_eq_zero_iff s E).mp hE
  obtain ⟨V, hxV, m, rfl⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.exists_germ_eq E.val.presheaf e
  let W' : X.Opens := W ⊓ V
  have hxW' : x ∈ W' := ⟨hx, hxV⟩
  let iW : W' ⟶ W := homOfLE inf_le_left
  let iV : W' ⟶ V := homOfLE inf_le_right
  let l' : Λ.val.obj (op W') := Λ.val.map iW.op l
  let m' : E.val.obj (op W') := E.val.map iV.op m
  have h0 := hk W' l' m'
  have hs : (s.val.app (op W')).hom l' = X.presheaf.map iW.op ((s.val.app (op W)).hom l) :=
    PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply s.val iW.op l
  have hg := congrArg (TopCat.Presheaf.germ E.val.presheaf W' x hxW') h0
  have hsm := PresheafOfModules.germ_smul (R := X.presheaf) E.val x W' hxW'
    ((s.val.app (op W')).hom l') m'
  have key := hsm.symm.trans (hg.trans (map_zero _))
  have h1 : X.presheaf.germ W' x hxW' ((s.val.app (op W')).hom l') = germVal s hx l := by
    rw [hs]
    exact X.presheaf.germ_res_apply iW x hxW' _
  have h2 : TopCat.Presheaf.germ E.val.presheaf W' x hxW' m' =
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ E.val.presheaf V x hxV m :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply E.val.presheaf iV x hxW' m
  rw [h1] at key
  exact (congrArg (fun t : (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj E ↦ germVal s hx l • t)
    h2).symm.trans key

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.stalk_injective_of_mono
statement:
theorem stalk_injective_of_mono {A B : X.Modules} (f : A ⟶ B) [Mono f] (x : X) :
    Function.Injective ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map f).hom
proof:
:= by
  haveI := moduleStalkFunctorLinear_preservesFiniteLimitsT0D X x
  have : Mono ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map f) := inferInstance
  exact (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp this

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.mono_sigmaT_of_isSMulRegular
statement:
theorem mono_sigmaT_of_isSMulRegular (hΛ : LocallyTrivial Λ) (hΛf : IsFiniteLocallyFree X Λ)
    (F : X.Modules)
    (hreg : ∀ x : X, ∃ (W : X.Opens) (hx : x ∈ W) (l : Λ.val.obj (op W)),
      IsSMulRegular ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj ((tensorSheafLeftFunctor X Λ).obj F))
        (germVal s hx l)) :
    Mono ((sigmaT Λ s).app F)
proof:
:= by
  let T := tensorSheafLeftFunctor X Λ
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits X Λ hΛf
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits X Λ hΛf
  have hc : Central T (sigmaT Λ s) := sigmaT_central hΛ s
  have hK : (sigmaT Λ s).app (kernel ((sigmaT Λ s).app F)) = 0 := app_kernel_eq_zero hc F
  have hz : IsZero (kernel ((sigmaT Λ s).app F)) := by
    apply isZero_of_forall_not_mem_support
    intro x hx
    rw [mem_moduleSheafSupport_iff] at hx
    obtain ⟨W, hxW, l, hl⟩ := hreg x
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ :=
      exists_ne (0 : (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj (kernel ((sigmaT Λ s).app F)))
    apply he
    have h1 := germ_smul_eq_zero_of_killed s hK hxW l e
    let ι := ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map (kernel.ι ((sigmaT Λ s).app F))).hom
    have h2 : germVal s hxW l • ι e = germVal s hxW l • 0 := by
      rw [smul_zero, ← ι.map_smul, h1, map_zero]
    exact stalk_injective_of_mono _ x ((hl h2).trans (map_zero ι).symm)
  exact Preadditive.mono_of_isZero_kernel _ hz

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.isUnit_of_isSMulRegular_of_maximal
statement:
theorem isUnit_of_isSMulRegular_of_maximal [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (F : X.Modules)
    [F.IsFinitePresentation] {x : X} (hx : Maximal (· ∈ moduleSheafSupport F) x)
    {r : X.presheaf.stalk x} (hr : IsSMulRegular ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj F) r) :
    IsUnit r
proof:
:= by
  let M := (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj F
  have hfl : IsFiniteLength (X.presheaf.stalk x) M := isFiniteLength_stalk_of_maximal F hx
  haveI : Nontrivial M := hx.1
  obtain ⟨hN, hA⟩ := isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp hfl
  by_contra hu
  have hrm : r ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal r).mpr hu
  let φ : M →ₗ[X.presheaf.stalk x] M := DistribSMul.toLinearMap _ M r
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective φ :=
    IsArtinian.surjective_of_injective_endomorphism φ hr
  have hle : (⊤ : Submodule (X.presheaf.stalk x) M) ≤
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x) • ⊤ := by
    intro m _
    obtain ⟨m', rfl⟩ := hsurj m
    exact Submodule.smul_mem_smul hrm Submodule.mem_top
  have hbot := Submodule.eq_bot_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) ⊤ (Module.Finite.fg_top) hle
    (by rw [IsLocalRing.jacobson_eq_maximalIdeal ⊥ bot_ne_top])
  exact top_ne_bot hbot

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.stalk_surjective_of_epi
statement:
theorem stalk_surjective_of_epi {A B : X.Modules} (g : A ⟶ B) [Epi g] (x : X) :
    Function.Surjective ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map g).hom
proof:
:= by
  have : Epi ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map g) := inferInstance
  exact (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mp this

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.mem_support_of_epi
statement:
theorem mem_support_of_epi {A B : X.Modules} (g : A ⟶ B) [Epi g] {x : X}
    (hx : x ∈ moduleSheafSupport B) : x ∈ moduleSheafSupport A
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_moduleSheafSupport_iff] at hx ⊢
  exact (stalk_surjective_of_epi g x).nontrivial

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.not_mem_support_cokernel
statement:
theorem not_mem_support_cokernel (hΛf : IsFiniteLocallyFree X Λ) (F : X.Modules)
    {W : X.Opens} {x : X} (hx : x ∈ W) (l : Λ.val.obj (op W)) (hu : IsUnit (germVal s hx l)) :
    x ∉ moduleSheafSupport (cokernel ((sigmaT Λ s).app F))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits X Λ hΛf
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits X Λ hΛf
  have hQ : (sigmaT Λ s).app (cokernel ((sigmaT Λ s).app F)) = 0 :=
    app_cokernel_eq_zero (T := tensorSheafLeftFunctor X Λ) F
  rw [mem_moduleSheafSupport_iff, not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton]
  refine ⟨fun e e' ↦ ?_⟩
  have h1 := germ_smul_eq_zero_of_killed s hQ hx l e
  have h2 := germ_smul_eq_zero_of_killed s hQ hx l e'
  rw [hu.smul_eq_zero] at h1 h2
  rw [h1, h2]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.isCoherentLike_twist
statement:
theorem isCoherentLike_twist (hΛf : IsFiniteLocallyFree X Λ) (F : X.Modules)
    (hF : IsCoherentLike X F) : IsCoherentLike X ((tensorSheafLeftFunctor X Λ).obj F)
proof:
:=
  tensorSheaf_isCoherentLike X Λ F hΛf hF

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.isCoherentLike_cokernel
statement:
theorem isCoherentLike_cokernel [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (hΛf : IsFiniteLocallyFree X Λ)
    (F : X.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike X F) :
    IsCoherentLike X (cokernel ((sigmaT Λ s).app F))
proof:
:=
  (KSpecialization.kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike (Y := X)).cokernel _ (isCoherentLike_twist hΛf F hF) hF

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.g0ClassOf_eq_smul_add_cokernel
statement:
theorem g0ClassOf_eq_smul_add_cokernel [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (hΛf : IsFiniteLocallyFree X Λ)
    (F : X.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike X F) (hm : Mono ((sigmaT Λ s).app F)) :
    g0ClassOf X F hF = k0ClassOf X Λ hΛf • g0ClassOf X F hF +
      g0ClassOf X (cokernel ((sigmaT Λ s).app F)) (isCoherentLike_cokernel s hΛf F hF)
proof:
:= by
  let f := (sigmaT Λ s).app F
  have hS : (ShortComplex.mk f (cokernel.π f) (cokernel.condition f)).ShortExact :=
    { exact := ShortComplex.exact_of_g_is_cokernel _ (cokernelIsCokernel f)
      mono_f := hm
      epi_g := inferInstanceAs (Epi (cokernel.π f)) }
  have h := ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_middle X.Modules (IsCoherentLike X)
    (isCoherentLike_twist hΛf F hF) hF (isCoherentLike_cokernel s hΛf F hF)
    (cokernel.condition f) hS
  rw [k0ClassOf_smul_g0ClassOf]
  exact h

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.isSMulRegular_stalk_spec
statement:
theorem isSMulRegular_stalk_spec {R : CommRingCat.{u}} (M : (Spec R).Modules)
    [M.IsQuasicoherent] {a : R} (ha : IsSMulRegular (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj M) a)
    (y : Spec R) :
    IsSMulRegular ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear (Spec R) y).obj M)
      ((Spec R).presheaf.germ ⊤ y trivial ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv a))
proof:
:= by
  let N : ModuleCat.{u} R := (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj M).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤)
  haveI : IsIso M.fromTildeΓ := Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent M
  let e : tilde N ≅ M := asIso M.fromTildeΓ
  letI : Algebra R ((Spec R).presheaf.stalk y) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Algebra R ((Spec.structureSheaf R).presheaf.stalk y))
  haveI : IsLocalization.AtPrime ((Spec R).presheaf.stalk y) y.asIdeal :=
    inferInstanceAs
      (IsLocalization.AtPrime ((Spec.structureSheaf R).presheaf.stalk y) y.asIdeal)
  letI : Module R ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear (Spec R) y).obj (tilde N)) :=
    inferInstanceAs
      (Module R ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (moduleStructurePresheaf R N).presheaf y))
  haveI : IsScalarTower R ((Spec R).presheaf.stalk y)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear (Spec R) y).obj (tilde N)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsScalarTower R ((structurePresheafInCommRingCat R).stalk y)
      ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (moduleStructurePresheaf R N).presheaf y))
  let g : N →ₗ[R] ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear (Spec R) y).obj (tilde N)) :=
    StructureSheaf.toStalkₗ R N y
  haveI : IsLocalizedModule y.asIdeal.primeCompl g :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsLocalizedModule y.asIdeal.primeCompl (StructureSheaf.toStalkₗ R N y))
  have haN : IsSMulRegular N a := ha
  have h1 : IsSMulRegular ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear (Spec R) y).obj (tilde N))
      (algebraMap R ((Spec R).presheaf.stalk y) a) :=
    IsSMulRegular.of_isLocalizedModule ((Spec R).presheaf.stalk y) y.asIdeal.primeCompl g haN
  have hga : algebraMap R ((Spec R).presheaf.stalk y) a =
      (Spec R).presheaf.germ ⊤ y trivial ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv a) := rfl
  let φ := ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear (Spec R) y).mapIso e).toLinearEquiv
  intro m₁ m₂ h
  apply φ.symm.injective
  apply h1
  change algebraMap R ((Spec R).presheaf.stalk y) a • φ.symm m₁ =
    algebraMap R ((Spec R).presheaf.stalk y) a • φ.symm m₂
  rw [hga, ← φ.symm.map_smul, ← φ.symm.map_smul]
  exact congrArg φ.symm h

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.chartModule_finite
statement:
theorem chartModule_finite {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (F : X.Modules)
    [F.IsFinitePresentation] : Module.Finite Γ(X, U) (chartModule hU F)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor hU.fromSpec).obj F).IsFinitePresentation :=
    isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor hU.fromSpec F
  haveI := moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor hU.fromSpec).obj F)
  infer_instance

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.isSMulRegular_stalk_of_isAffineOpen
statement:
theorem isSMulRegular_stalk_of_isAffineOpen {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] {v : Γ(X, U)}
    (hv : IsSMulRegular (chartModule hU F) v) {x : X} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    IsSMulRegular ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj F) (X.presheaf.germ U x hx v)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ : ∃ y, hU.fromSpec y = x :=
    ⟨hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩, hU.fromSpec_primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩⟩
  let f := hU.fromSpec
  let M := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj F
  haveI : M.IsFinitePresentation := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor f F
  have hM := isSMulRegular_stalk_spec M hv y
  have key : f.stalkMap y (X.presheaf.germ U (f y) hx v) =
      (Spec Γ(X, U)).presheaf.germ ⊤ y trivial ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv v) := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply, hU.fromSpec_app_self_apply]
    exact (Spec Γ(X, U)).presheaf.germ_res_apply _ y _ _
  intro m₁ m₂ h
  letI := Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkModule f y F
  let e := Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkLinearEquiv f y F
  apply e.symm.injective
  apply hM
  dsimp only at h ⊢
  have h1 := e.symm.map_smul (X.presheaf.germ U (f y) hx v) m₁
  have h2 := e.symm.map_smul (X.presheaf.germ U (f y) hx v) m₂
  have h3 : e.symm (X.presheaf.germ U (f y) hx v • m₁) =
      e.symm (X.presheaf.germ U (f y) hx v • m₂) := congrArg e.symm h
  rw [← key]
  exact h1.symm.trans (h3.trans h2)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistIntegerH_free
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistIntegerH_free (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (q : ℕ) :
    Module.Free ℤ (Scheme.Modules.H (projectiveTwistingSheaf ℤ n d) q)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      cases q with
      | zero => exact projectiveZero_integer_H_zero_free d
      | succ p =>
          haveI := projectiveTwistingSheaf_integer_H_vanishes 0 d (p + 1) (by omega)
          infer_instance
  | succ n =>
      cases q with
      | zero =>
          by_cases hd : 0 ≤ d
          · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le hd
            exact projectiveTwistingSheaf_integer_H_zero_free (n + 1) m
          · haveI := projectiveTwistingSheaf_H_zero_subsingleton_of_neg ℤ (n + 1)
              (by omega) d (by omega)
            infer_instance
      | succ p =>
          by_cases hp : p < n
          · haveI := projectiveSpace_integer_H_below_top_vanishes n d p hp
            infer_instance
          · by_cases he : p = n
            · subst p
              exact projectiveSpace_integer_H_top_free n d
            · haveI := projectiveTwistingSheaf_integer_H_vanishes (n + 1) d (p + 1)
                (by omega)
              infer_instance

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.affineIntegerG0Rank_projectiveTwistHigher
statement:
theorem affineIntegerG0Rank_projectiveTwistHigher (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (q : ℕ)
    (hE : IsCoherentLike (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ))
      (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
        (toSpec ℤ n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf ℤ n d) q)) :
    affineIntegerG0Rank (g0ClassOf _ _ hE) =
      (Module.finrank ℤ (Scheme.Modules.H (projectiveTwistingSheaf ℤ n d) q) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := projectiveTwistIntegerH_free n d q
  rw [affineIntegerG0Rank_classOf,
    integerModuleRank_congr
      (N := ModuleCat.of ℤ (Scheme.Modules.H (projectiveTwistingSheaf ℤ n d) q))
      (projectiveTwistIntegerHigherDirectImageSectionsEquiv n d q),
    integerModuleRank_eq_finrank]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveDerivedPushforward_integerTwist_rank
statement:
theorem projectiveDerivedPushforward_integerTwist_rank (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (d : ℤ) :
    affineIntegerG0Rank (projectiveDerivedPushforward ℤ n hn
      (g0ClassOf (space ℤ n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf ℤ n d)
        (projectiveIntegerTwist_coherent n d))) =
      projectiveTwistIntegerEuler n d
proof:
:= by
  rw [projectiveDerivedPushforward_classOf,
    GrothendieckRiemannRoch.map_alternatingSum, projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_eq_sum]
  unfold GrothendieckRiemannRoch.alternatingSum
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro q _
  dsimp only [projectiveHigherDirectImage]
  rw [affineIntegerG0Rank_projectiveTwistHigher, zsmul_eq_mul]
  simp only [Int.cast_id]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveIntegerG0Pushforward_zero
statement:
theorem projectiveIntegerG0Pushforward_zero :
    projectiveIntegerG0Pushforward 0 = finitePushforward (toSpec ℤ 0)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveIntegerG0Pushforward_succ
statement:
theorem projectiveIntegerG0Pushforward_succ (n : ℕ) :

proof: := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveIntegerG0Pushforward_twist_rank
statement:
theorem projectiveIntegerG0Pushforward_twist_rank (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) :
    affineIntegerG0Rank (projectiveIntegerG0Pushforward n
      (g0ClassOf (space ℤ n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf ℤ n d)
        (projectiveIntegerTwist_coherent n d))) =
      projectiveTwistIntegerEuler n d
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      rw [projectiveIntegerG0Pushforward_zero, finitePushforward_classOf,
        affineIntegerG0Rank_classOf]
      haveI := projectiveTwistIntegerH_free 0 d 0
      rw [integerModuleRank_congr
        (N := ModuleCat.of ℤ (Scheme.Modules.H (projectiveTwistingSheaf ℤ 0 d) 0))
        (projectiveTwistIntegerOrdinaryPushforwardSectionsEquiv 0 d),
        integerModuleRank_eq_finrank, finrank_projectiveZero_integer_H_zero,
        projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_zero_all]
      rfl
  | succ n =>
      rw [projectiveIntegerG0Pushforward_succ]
      exact projectiveDerivedPushforward_integerTwist_rank (n + 1) (Nat.zero_lt_succ n) d

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveIntegerG0Pushforward_twist_rank_all
proof:
:= by
  rw [projectiveIntegerG0Pushforward_twist_rank, projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_all]

name: SchemeQuadraticInteger.integerClass_congr
statement:
theorem integerClass_congr {M N : ModuleCat.{0} ℤ}
    (hM : ModuleResolution.IsFG ℤ M) (hN : ModuleResolution.IsFG ℤ N)
    (e : M ≃ₗ[ℤ] N) :
    ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf _ (ModuleResolution.IsFG ℤ) M hM =
      ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf _ (ModuleResolution.IsFG ℤ) N hN
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso _ (ModuleResolution.IsFG ℤ) hM hN
    (show Module.Finite ℤ (ModuleCat.of ℤ PUnit) from inferInstance)
    (ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _) e.toModuleIso

name: SchemeQuadraticInteger.integerPairClass
statement:
theorem integerPairClass :
    ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ) (ModuleResolution.IsFG ℤ)
      (ModuleCat.of ℤ (ℤ × ℤ)) (show Module.Finite ℤ (ℤ × ℤ) from inferInstance) =
      2 • ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ) (ModuleResolution.IsFG ℤ)
        (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ) (show Module.Finite ℤ ℤ from inferInstance)
proof:
:= by
  let S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{0} ℤ) := ShortComplex.mk
    (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.inl ℤ ℤ ℤ))
    (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.snd ℤ ℤ ℤ)) (by ext; rfl)
  have hS : S.ShortExact := ModuleCat.shortComplex_shortExact S
    (by
      intro y
      constructor
      · intro hy
        exact ⟨y.1, Prod.ext rfl hy.symm⟩
      · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
        rfl)
    (by intro a b h; exact congrArg Prod.fst h)
    (by intro b; exact ⟨(0, b), rfl⟩)
  have h := ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_middle
    (C := ModuleCat.{0} ℤ) (ModuleResolution.IsFG ℤ)
    (show Module.Finite ℤ S.X₁ from inferInstance)
    (show Module.Finite ℤ S.X₂ from inferInstance)
    (show Module.Finite ℤ S.X₃ from inferInstance) S.zero hS
  simpa only [two_nsmul] using h

name: SchemeQuadraticInteger.gammaG_classOf
statement:
theorem gammaG_classOf (E : (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ)).Modules)
    (hE : IsCoherentLike _ E) :
    GLocalisationSpec.gammaG ℤ (g0ClassOf _ E hE) =
      ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf _ (ModuleResolution.IsFG ℤ)
        ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of ℤ)).obj E)
        (GLocalisationSpec.finite_moduleSpecΓ_of_isCoherentLike ℤ E hE)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [GLocalisationSpec.gammaG, g0ClassOf, ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf,
    ExactGrothendieck.map_classOf]

name: SchemeQuadraticInteger.unitPushforwardClass
statement:
theorem unitPushforwardClass :
    finitePushforward toSpec (g0ClassOf _ unitSheaf unitCoherent) = 2 • baseUnitClass
proof:
:= by
  apply (GLocalisationSpec.specG0Equiv ℤ).symm.injective
  change GLocalisationSpec.gammaG ℤ
    (finitePushforward toSpec (g0ClassOf _ unitSheaf unitCoherent)) =
      GLocalisationSpec.gammaG ℤ (2 • baseUnitClass)
  rw [finitePushforward_classOf, map_nsmul, gammaG_classOf]
  unfold baseUnitClass
  rw [gammaG_classOf,
    integerClass_congr (N := ModuleCat.of ℤ (ℤ × ℤ)) _ (show Module.Finite ℤ (ℤ × ℤ) from inferInstance)
      unitPushforwardSectionsEquiv,
    integerClass_congr (N := ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ) _ (show Module.Finite ℤ ℤ from inferInstance)
      (unitModuleSpecΓLinearEquiv (CommRingCat.of ℤ)), integerPairClass]

name: SchemeQuadraticInteger.unitPushforwardClass_zsmul
statement:
theorem unitPushforwardClass_zsmul (m : ℤ) :
    finitePushforward toSpec (m • g0ClassOf _ unitSheaf unitCoherent) =
      (2 * m) • baseUnitClass
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_zsmul, unitPushforwardClass]
  simp only [two_nsmul, zsmul_add, two_mul, add_zsmul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.not_specializes_of_isClosed_g2tdg23
statement:
theorem not_specializes_of_isClosed_g2tdg23 {p q : X} (hp : IsClosed ({p} : Set X))
    (hpq : p ≠ q) : ¬ Specializes p q
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact hpq (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp (hp.closure_eq ▸ specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp h)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct_stalk_isIso_of_mem_closed
statement:
theorem toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct_stalk_isIso_of_mem_closed
    (F : X.Modules) (S : Finset X)
    (hSc : ∀ p : S, IsClosed ({p.1} : Set X)) (q : X) (hq : q ∈ S) :
    IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.stalkFunctor X q).map
      (toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct F S))
proof:
:= by
  let K : S → X.Modules := fun p =>
    (commLocalModuleSkyscraperFunctor p.1).obj
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X p.1).obj F)
  let T := Scheme.Modules.stalkFunctor X q
  let g : ∀ p : S, T.obj F ⟶ T.obj (K p) := fun p =>
    T.map (toCommLocalModuleSkyscraper p.1 F)
  let p : S := ⟨q, hq⟩
  letI : IsIso (g p) := by
    change IsIso (toCommLocalModuleSkyscraperStalk q F)
    simpa only [toCommLocalModuleSkyscraperStalkIso_hom] using
      (toCommLocalModuleSkyscraperStalkIso q F).isIso_hom
  have hK : ∀ i : S, i ≠ p → IsZero (T.obj (K i)) := by
    intro i hip
    have hiq : i.1 ≠ q := by
      intro hiq
      exact hip (Subtype.ext hiq)
    change IsZero (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk
      ((Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology i.1).skyscraperPresheaf
        (AddCommGrpCat.of ↑((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X i.1).obj F))) q)
    exact pointSkyscraper_stalk_isZero_of_not_specializes i.1 q _
      (not_specializes_of_isClosed_g2tdg23 (hSc i) hiq)
  let e := liftIsoOfUniqueNonzero (T.obj F) (fun i : S => T.obj (K i)) g p hK
  letI : IsIso (Pi.lift g) := e.isIso_hom
  letI : PreservesLimit (Discrete.functor K) T := by
    dsimp [T]
    infer_instance
  letI : IsIso (piComparison T K) :=
    (PreservesProduct.iso T K).isIso_hom
  have hcomp : T.map (toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct F S) ≫
      piComparison T K = Pi.lift g := by
    simpa only [K, g, ordinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct,
      toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct] using
      map_lift_piComparison T K F
        (fun i : S => toCommLocalModuleSkyscraper i.1 F)
  haveI : IsIso (T.map (toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct F S) ≫
      piComparison T K) := by
    rw [hcomp]
    infer_instance
  let hπ : IsIso (piComparison T K) :=
    (PreservesProduct.iso T K).isIso_hom
  let hc : IsIso (T.map (toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct F S) ≫
      piComparison T K) := inferInstance
  exact @IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right _ _ _ _ _
    (T.map (toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct F S)) (piComparison T K) hπ hc

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct_stalk_isIso_of_not_mem_closed
statement:
theorem toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct_stalk_isIso_of_not_mem_closed
    (F : X.Modules) (S : Finset X)
    (hSc : ∀ p : S, IsClosed ({p.1} : Set X))
    (hsupp : moduleSheafSupport F ⊆ (S : Set X))
    (q : X) (hq : q ∉ S) :
    IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.stalkFunctor X q).map
      (toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct F S))
proof:
:= by
  let T := Scheme.Modules.stalkFunctor X q
  have hqSupp : q ∉ moduleSheafSupport F := by
    intro hqSupp
    exact hq (hsupp hqSupp)
  have hsource : IsZero (T.obj F) := by
    change IsZero (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf q)
    rw [AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton]
    exact not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton.mp hqSupp
  have hspecializes : ∀ p : S, ¬ Specializes p.1 q := by
    intro p
    apply not_specializes_of_isClosed_g2tdg23 (hSc p)
    intro hpq
    exact hq (hpq ▸ p.2)
  have htarget : IsZero (T.obj (ordinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct F S)) :=
    ordinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct_stalk_isZero F S q hspecializes
  exact hsource.isIso htarget _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct_stalk_isIso_closed
statement:
theorem toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct_stalk_isIso_closed
    (F : X.Modules) (S : Finset X)
    (hSc : ∀ p : S, IsClosed ({p.1} : Set X))
    (hsupp : moduleSheafSupport F ⊆ (S : Set X)) (q : X) :
    IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.stalkFunctor X q).map
      (toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct F S))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hq : q ∈ S
  · exact toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct_stalk_isIso_of_mem_closed F S hSc q hq
  · exact toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct_stalk_isIso_of_not_mem_closed F S hSc hsupp q hq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct_isIso_closed
statement:
theorem toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct_isIso_closed
    (F : X.Modules) (S : Finset X)
    (hSc : ∀ p : S, IsClosed ({p.1} : Set X))
    (hsupp : moduleSheafSupport F ⊆ (S : Set X)) :
    IsIso (toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct F S)
proof:
:= by
  let f := toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct F S
  let T := Scheme.Modules.toAddCommGrpSheaf X
  letI (q : X) : IsIso
      ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor Ab.{u} q).map ((T.map f).hom)) := by
    change IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.stalkFunctor X q).map
      (toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct F S))
    exact toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct_stalk_isIso_closed F S hSc hsupp q
  haveI : IsIso (T.map f) :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.isIso_of_stalkFunctor_map_iso (T.map f)
  exact isIso_of_reflects_iso f T

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.exists_pointSkyscraperDevissage_closed
statement:
theorem exists_pointSkyscraperDevissage_closed
    (F : X.Modules) (S : Finset X)
    (hSc : ∀ p : S, IsClosed ({p.1} : Set X))
    (hsupp : moduleSheafSupport F ⊆ (S : Set X))
    (hfinite : ∀ p : S, IsFiniteLength (X.presheaf.stalk p.1)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X p.1).obj F)) (w : X → ℕ) :
    ∃ ps : List X, (∀ p, p ∈ ps → p ∈ S) ∧
      Nonempty (PointSkyscraperDevissage F ps) ∧
      (ps.map w).sum = ∑ p : S,
        (Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk p.1)
          ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X p.1).obj F)).toNat * w p.1
proof:
:= by
  let A : S → X.Modules := fun p ↦
    (commLocalModuleSkyscraperFunctor p.1).obj
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X p.1).obj F)
  let points : S → List X := fun p ↦
    finiteLengthPointSkyscraperPoints p.1 (hfinite p)
  let d : ∀ p : S, PointSkyscraperDevissage (A p) (points p) := fun p ↦
    finiteLengthPointSkyscraperDevissage p.1 (hfinite p)
  have hpoints : ∀ i p, p ∈ points i → p ∈ S := by
    intro i p hp
    have hpEq : p = i.1 :=
      mem_finiteLengthPointSkyscraperPoints_eq i.1 (hfinite i) hp
    simpa only [hpEq] using i.2
  obtain ⟨ps, hps, ⟨dps⟩, hsum⟩ :=
    exists_pointSkyscraperDevissage_product_with_property_and_weight
      A points d (fun p ↦ p ∈ S) hpoints w
  have hlocal : ∀ p : S, ((points p).map w).sum =
      (Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk p.1)
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X p.1).obj F)).toNat * w p.1 := by
    intro p
    have hrep : points p = List.replicate (points p).length p.1 :=
      List.eq_replicate_length.mpr (fun q hq ↦
        mem_finiteLengthPointSkyscraperPoints_eq p.1 (hfinite p) hq)
    rw [hrep, List.map_replicate, List.sum_const_nat,
      length_finiteLengthPointSkyscraperPoints]
  letI : IsIso (toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct F S) :=
    toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct_isIso_closed F S hSc hsupp
  refine ⟨ps, hps, ⟨PointSkyscraperDevissage.iso
    (asIso (toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct F S)) dps⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [hsum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p _ ↦ hlocal p)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.eulerChar_eq_sum_stalk_length_mul_finrank_closed
statement:
theorem eulerChar_eq_sum_stalk_length_mul_finrank_closed
    (F : X.Modules) (S : Finset X)
    (hSc : ∀ p : S, IsClosed ({p.1} : Set X))
    (hsupp : moduleSheafSupport F ⊆ (S : Set X))
    (hfinite : ∀ p : S, IsFiniteLength (X.presheaf.stalk p.1)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X p.1).obj F))
    (hκ : ∀ p : S, Module.Finite k ↑(X.residueField p.1)) :
    F.eulerChar k = (∑ p : S,
      (Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk p.1)
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X p.1).obj F)).toNat *
        Module.finrank k ↑(X.residueField p.1) : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ps, hps, ⟨dps⟩, hsum⟩ :=
    exists_pointSkyscraperDevissage_closed
      F S hSc hsupp hfinite (fun p ↦ Module.finrank k ↑(X.residueField p))
  calc
    F.eulerChar k =
        (((ps.map fun p ↦ Module.finrank k ↑(X.residueField p)).sum : ℕ) : ℤ) :=
      dps.eulerChar_eq_sum k (fun p hp ↦ hκ ⟨p, hps p hp⟩)
    _ = (∑ p : S,
        (Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk p.1)
          ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X p.1).obj F)).toNat *
          Module.finrank k ↑(X.residueField p.1) : ℕ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hsum

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.finrank_projectiveSpace_integer_H_top_negative
statement:
theorem finrank_projectiveSpace_integer_H_top_negative (n m : ℕ) :
    Module.finrank ℤ
      (Scheme.Modules.H (projectiveTwistingSheaf ℤ (n + 1) (-((m + n + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ))) (n + 1)) =
        (m + n + 1).choose (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite
    (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeDegreeExponent (n + 1) (-((m + n + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)))
  rw [LinearEquiv.finrank_eq
    (projectiveSpaceIntegerHTopNegativeExponentEquiv n (-((m + n + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ))),
    Module.finrank_pi, ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  rw [show m + n + 2 = m + (n + 1) + 1 by omega,
    Nat.card_congr (negativeLaurentExponentMonomialEquiv (n + 1) m)]
  change Nat.card {a : Fin ((n + 1) + 1) →₀ ℕ | a.degree = m} = _
  simpa only [Nat.add_assoc] using card_degree_eq_choose (n + 1) m

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.finrank_projectiveSpace_integer_H_top
statement:
theorem finrank_projectiveSpace_integer_H_top (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) :
    Module.finrank ℤ (Scheme.Modules.H (projectiveTwistingSheaf ℤ (n + 1) d) (n + 1)) =
      (-d - 1).toNat.choose (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hd : -((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ d
  · haveI : Subsingleton (Scheme.Modules.H (projectiveTwistingSheaf ℤ (n + 1) d) (n + 1)) :=
      AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf_H_isZero ℤ (n + 1) d hd n)
    rw [Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton]
    exact (Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt (by omega)).symm
  · let m := (-d - ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1).toNat
    have he : d = -((m + n + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by dsimp [m]; omega
    rw [he, finrank_projectiveSpace_integer_H_top_negative]
    congr 1
    omega

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_negative_all
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_negative_all (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (hd : d < 0) :
    projectiveTwistIntegerEuler (n + 1) d =
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ (n + 1) * ((-d - 1).toNat.choose (n + 1) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold projectiveTwistIntegerEuler
  rw [finsum_eq_single _ (n + 1)]
  · rw [finrank_projectiveSpace_integer_H_top]
  · intro q hq
    cases q with
    | zero =>
        haveI := projectiveTwistingSheaf_H_zero_subsingleton_of_neg ℤ (n + 1) (by omega) d hd
        rw [Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero]
    | succ p =>
        by_cases hp : p < n
        · haveI := projectiveSpace_integer_H_below_top_vanishes n d p hp
          rw [Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero]
        · haveI := projectiveTwistingSheaf_integer_H_vanishes (n + 1) d (p + 1) (by omega)
          rw [Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_zero_all
statement: theorem projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_zero_all (d : ℤ) : projectiveTwistIntegerEuler 0 d = 1

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_deep_negative
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_deep_negative (n m : ℕ) :
    projectiveTwistIntegerEuler (n + 1) (-((m + n + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)) =
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ (n + 1) * ((m + n + 1).choose (n + 1) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hm : (-(-((m + n + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)) - 1).toNat = m + n + 1 := by omega

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_all
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      rw [projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_zero_all]
      split_ifs <;> simp only [Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.cast_one, pow_zero, one_mul]
  | succ n =>
      by_cases hd : 0 ≤ d
      · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le hd
        rw [if_pos (by omega), Int.toNat_natCast, projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_nat]
      · rw [if_neg hd, projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_negative_all n d (by omega)]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_plane_all
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_plane_all (d : ℤ) :
    2 * projectiveTwistIntegerEuler 2 d = (d + 1) * (d + 2)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hd : -2 ≤ d
  · exact projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_plane d hd
  · let m := (-d - 3).toNat
    have he : d = -((m + 3 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by dsimp [m]; omega
    have hp : projectiveTwistIntegerEuler 2 (-((m + 3 : ℕ) : ℤ)) =
        projectiveTwistIntegerEuler 2 (m : ℤ) := by
      rw [projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_deep_negative 1 m, projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_nat]
      norm_num
    rw [he, hp, projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_plane (m : ℤ) (by omega)]
    push_cast
    ring

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.degPn_cycPn_zero
statement:
