    degPn k n (cycPn k n F hF 0) =
      ((∑ᶠ x : space k n, coherentCoeff F 0 x * (Module.finrank k ((space k n).residueField x) : ℤ)
        : ℤ) : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cycPn, degPn_lof_zero, F20.degQ_tmul, one_mul, F20.degChow_mk, AlgebraicCycle.degree]
  congr 2
  funext x
  rw [coherentCycle_apply]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.g2_base
statement:
theorem g2_base (hn : 0 < n) (F : (space k n).Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike (space k n) F)
    (hdim : ∀ x ∈ moduleSheafSupport F, height x ≤ (0 : ℕ)) (y : K0 (space k n))
    (hy : k0ToG0 (space k n) y = g0ClassOf (space k n) F hF) :
    ((eulerP k n hn (k0ToG0 (space k n) (uPn k n ^ 0 * y)) : ℤ) : ℚ) =
      degPn k n (((Hn k n) ^ 0) (cycPn k n F hF 0))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherian (space k n) := SchemeProjectiveSpace.isNoetherian k n
  haveI : F.IsFinitePresentation := hF
  rw [pow_zero, one_mul, pow_zero, Module.End.one_apply, hy, eulerP_g0ClassOf,
    degPn_cycPn_zero]
  have hfinS := finite_maximal_moduleSheafSupport F
  set S : Finset (space k n) := hfinS.toFinset with hSdef
  have hmemS : ∀ x, x ∈ S ↔ Maximal (· ∈ moduleSheafSupport F) x := fun x ↦ by
    rw [hSdef, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]; rfl
  have hht : ∀ x ∈ moduleSheafSupport F, height x = 0 := fun x hx ↦ by
    have h0 : height x ≤ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hdim x hx
    exact nonpos_iff_eq_zero.mp h0
  have hSc : ∀ p : S, IsClosed ({p.1} : Set (space k n)) := fun p ↦
    isClosed_singleton_of_height_eq_zero (hht p.1 ((hmemS p.1).mp p.2).1)
  have hsupp : moduleSheafSupport F ⊆ (S : Set (space k n)) := fun x hx ↦
    (hmemS x).mpr (maximal_of_height_eq_of_top F hdim (by rw [hht x hx]; rfl) hx)
  have hfinite : ∀ p : S, IsFiniteLength ((space k n).presheaf.stalk p.1)
      ((SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear (space k n) p.1).obj F) := fun p ↦
    isFiniteLength_stalk_of_maximal F ((hmemS p.1).mp p.2)
  have hκ : ∀ p : S, Module.Finite k ↑((space k n).residueField p.1) := fun p ↦
    AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.finite_residueField_of_isClosed k (hSc p)
  rw [SingularCurve.eulerChar_eq_sum_stalk_length_mul_finrank_closed k F S hSc hsupp hfinite hκ]
  rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ (s := S) (fun x hx ↦ by
    by_contra hxS
    apply hx
    have h0 : coherentCoeff F 0 x = 0 := if_neg (fun h ↦ hxS ((hmemS x).mpr h.2))
    exact (congrArg (· * _) h0).trans (zero_mul _))]
  rw [← Finset.sum_coe_sort S]
  have hc : ∀ p : S, coherentCoeff F 0 p.1 = ((stalkLength F p.1).toNat : ℤ) := fun p ↦ by
    have hp := (hmemS p.1).mp p.2
    exact if_pos ⟨by rw [hht p.1 hp.1]; rfl, hp⟩
  simp only [hc]
  push_cast
  rfl

statement:

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.cap_dimPrimeCycleT
statement:
theorem cap_dimPrimeCycleT :
    (opsV4 k).cap (Lpn k n) (hLpn k n) e
        ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v (e + 1) hv) :
          DimChow (space k n) (e + 1))) =
      (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (capCycleT v τ hτ e hv) : DimChow (space k n) e)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(opsV4 k).cap_mk (Lpn k n) (hLpn k n) e v hv
    (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one _ (hLpn k n) v) (frameB v)
    (D5.primeCycleOfFrame (k := k) (Lpn k n) (hLpn k n) e v hv (frameB v)) rfl]
  have hG : (QuotientAddGroup.mk (relGenT v τ hτ e hv).cycle : DimChow (space k n) e) = 0 :=
    (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff _).mpr (AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨_, rfl⟩)
  rw [capCycleT, QuotientAddGroup.mk_add, hG, add_zero]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.capCycleT_val
statement:
theorem capCycleT_val : (capCycleT v τ hτ e hv).1 =
    properPushforward (pointClosureι v) (weilB v) +
      properPushforward (pointClosureι v) (AlgebraicGeometry.div (coordT v τ))
proof: := rfl

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.capCycleT_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range
statement:
theorem capCycleT_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range (y : space k n)
    (hy : y ∉ Set.range (pointClosureι v)) : (capCycleT v τ hτ e hv).1 y = 0
proof:
:= by
  have e1 := AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range (pointClosureι v)
    (weilB v) (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) y hy
  have e2 := AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range (pointClosureι v)
    (AlgebraicGeometry.div (coordT v τ)) (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) y hy
  rw [capCycleT_val]
  exact (congrArg₂ (· + ·) e1 e2).trans (add_zero 0)

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.capCycleT_apply_image
statement:
theorem capCycleT_apply_image (z : pointClosureScheme v) :
    (capCycleT v τ hτ e hv).1 (pointClosureι v z) =
      Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame
        (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure (Lpn k n) (hLpn k n) v)
        (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one (Lpn k n) (hLpn k n) v) (frameB v) z +
      (pointClosureScheme v).ord (coordT v τ) z
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_closedImmersion (pointClosureι v)
    (weilB v) (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) z
  have h2 := AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_closedImmersion (pointClosureι v)
    (AlgebraicGeometry.div (coordT v τ)) (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) z
  rw [capCycleT_val]
  exact congrArg₂ (· + ·) h1 h2

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.capCycleT_apply_of_coheight_ne_one
statement:
theorem capCycleT_apply_of_coheight_ne_one (z : pointClosureScheme v) (hz : coheight z ≠ 1) :
    (capCycleT v τ hτ e hv).1 (pointClosureι v z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [capCycleT_apply_image, Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hz, add_zero]
  exact Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hz _

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.capCycleT_apply_of_coheight_one
statement:
theorem capCycleT_apply_of_coheight_one (z : pointClosureScheme v) (hz : coheight z = 1)
    {w : pointClosureScheme v}
    (d : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme v)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj (Lpn k n)) w) (hzd : z ∈ d.U) :
    (capCycleT v τ hτ e hv).1 (pointClosureι v z) =
      (pointClosureScheme v).ord (algebraMap ((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalk z)
        (pointClosureScheme v).functionField
        ((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.germ d.U z hzd (sectionCoordSec d (secT v τ)))) z
proof:
:= by
  rw [capCycleT_apply_image, Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame_eq_on_localData _ _
    (frameB v) d z hzd, ← sectionCoord_eq_algebraMap_germ d _ hzd,
    sectionCoord_compat (frameB v) d,
    show sectionCoord (frameB v) (secT v τ) = coordT v τ from rfl,
    (pointClosureScheme v).ord_mul hz hτ ((frameB v).regularTransitionFunction_ne_zero d)]
  rw [add_comm]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.capCycleT_tau_apply
statement:
theorem capCycleT_tau_apply (c : Fin (n + 1) → k) (hτ : coordT v (tau k n c) ≠ 0)
    (z : pointClosureScheme v) (hz : coheight z = 1) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (hzi : pointClosureι v z ∈ chartOpen k n i)
    (ht : (space k n).presheaf.germ (chartOpen k n i) (pointClosureι v z) hzi (chartVal k n c i) ∉
      Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι v z)) :
    (capCycleT v (tau k n c) hτ e hv).1 (pointClosureι v z) =
      ((CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity
        ((space k n).presheaf.germ (chartOpen k n i) (pointClosureι v z) hzi (chartVal k n c i))
        (C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι v z)).toNat : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  let ι := pointClosureι v
  let d0 := frame1 (ι z)
  let d : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme v)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj (Lpn k n)) z := jFrame ι z
  rw [capCycleT_apply_of_coheight_one v (tau k n c) hτ e hv z hz d d.mem]
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hut⟩ := germ_coord_tau k n c i hzi d0
  set t := (space k n).presheaf.germ (chartOpen k n i) (ι z) hzi (chartVal k n c i) with htdef
  have hg : (pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.germ d.U z d.mem (sectionCoordSec d (secT v (tau k n c))) =
      (ι.stalkMap z).hom u * (ι.stalkMap z).hom t := by
    have h1 : sectionCoordSec d (secT v (tau k n c)) = ι.app d0.U (sectionCoordSec d0 (tau k n c)) :=
      sectionCoordSec_pullbackFrame ι d0 (tau k n c) z d0.mem
    rw [h1, ← map_mul, ← hut]
    exact (Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply ι d0.U z d0.mem _).symm
  have hne : (ι.stalkMap z).hom t ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [Ne, ← RingHom.mem_ker, C1Cap.ker_stalkMap_pointClosureι]
  have hu' : IsUnit ((ι.stalkMap z).hom u) := hu.map _
  rw [hg, map_mul, (pointClosureScheme v).ord_mul hz
      ((map_ne_zero_iff _ (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective _ _)).mpr hu'.ne_zero)
      ((map_ne_zero_iff _ (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective _ _)).mpr hne),
    Scheme.ord_algebraMap_eq_zero_of_isUnit hz hu', zero_add]
  exact (C1Cap.localMultiplicity_toNat_eq_ord v z hz t ht).symm

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.pointClosureι_lt
statement:
theorem pointClosureι_lt {v : space k n} {a b : pointClosureScheme v} (hab : a < b) :
    pointClosureι v a < pointClosureι v b
proof:
:= by
  have hle : pointClosureι v a ≤ pointClosureι v b :=
    Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr
      ((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hab.le).map (pointClosureι v).continuous)
  refine lt_of_le_not_ge hle fun hge ↦ hab.ne ?_
  exact (pointClosureι v).isEmbedding.injective
    ((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hle).antisymm (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hge)).eq.symm

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.coheight_eq_one_of_height
statement:
theorem coheight_eq_one_of_height {v : space k n} {d : ℕ} (hv : height v = (d : ℕ∞) + 1)
    (z : pointClosureScheme v) (hz : height (pointClosureι v z) = d) : coheight z = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hle_top : ∀ w : pointClosureScheme v, pointClosureι v w ≤ v := fun w ↦ by
    have h := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr
      (((pointClosureGenericPoint_isGeneric v).specializes (Set.mem_univ w)).map
        (pointClosureι v).continuous)
    rwa [pointClosureι_genericPoint] at h
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [show (1 : ℕ∞) = ((1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) from rfl, Order.coheight_le_coe_iff]
    intro w hzw
    rw [Nat.cast_one, Order.lt_one_iff, Order.coheight_eq_zero]
    intro w' hww'
    by_contra hne
    have hlt : w < w' := lt_of_le_not_ge hww' hne
    have h1 := Order.height_add_one_le (pointClosureι_lt hzw)
    have h2 := Order.height_add_one_le (pointClosureι_lt hlt)
    have h3 := Order.height_mono (hle_top w')
    rw [hz] at h1
    rw [hv] at h3
    have : (d : ℕ∞) + 1 + 1 ≤ (d : ℕ∞) + 1 :=
      calc (d : ℕ∞) + 1 + 1 ≤ height (pointClosureι v w) + 1 := by gcongr
        _ ≤ height (pointClosureι v w') := h2
        _ ≤ (d : ℕ∞) + 1 := h3
    simp only [ENat.add_le_add_iff_right ENat.one_ne_top] at this
    have h5 : d + 1 ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast this
    omega
  · rw [Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero, Ne, Order.coheight_eq_zero]
    intro hmax
    have hzη : z = pointClosureGenericPoint v :=
      ((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp (hmax (pointClosure_le_genericPoint z))).antisymm
        (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp (pointClosure_le_genericPoint z))).eq
    rw [hzη, pointClosureι_genericPoint, hv] at hz
    have : ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) = (d : ℕ∞) := by push_cast; exact hz
    exact absurd (by exact_mod_cast this) (by omega : d + 1 ≠ d)

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.isUnit_germ_chartVal
statement:
theorem isUnit_germ_chartVal (F : (space k n).Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation]
    (c : Fin (n + 1) → k) (hc : Good k n F c) {V : space k n}
    (hV : Maximal (· ∈ moduleSheafSupport F) V) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (hVi : V ∈ chartOpen k n i) :
    IsUnit ((space k n).presheaf.germ (chartOpen k n i) V hVi (chartVal k n c i))
proof:
:=
  isUnit_of_isSMulRegular_of_maximal F hV
    (isSMulRegular_stalk_of_isAffineOpen (chartOpen_isAffine k n i) F (hc i true) hVi)

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.coordT_tau_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  let ι := pointClosureι V
  let η := pointClosureGenericPoint V
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_mem_chartOpen k n (ι η)
  let d0 := frame1 (ι η)
  have hV' : Maximal (· ∈ moduleSheafSupport F) (ι η) := by
    rw [show ι η = V from pointClosureι_genericPoint V]; exact hV
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hut⟩ := germ_coord_tau k n c i hi d0
  have ht := isUnit_germ_chartVal k n F c hc hV' i hi
  have hg : (pointClosureScheme V).presheaf.germ (frameB V).U η (frameB V).mem
      (sectionCoordSec (frameB V) (secT V (tau k n c))) =
      (ι.stalkMap η).hom ((space k n).presheaf.germ d0.U (ι η) d0.mem
        (sectionCoordSec d0 (tau k n c))) := by
    have h1 : sectionCoordSec (frameB V) (secT V (tau k n c)) =
        ι.app d0.U (sectionCoordSec d0 (tau k n c)) :=
      sectionCoordSec_pullbackFrame ι d0 (tau k n c) η d0.mem
    rw [h1]
    exact (Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply ι d0.U η d0.mem _).symm
  have hunit : IsUnit ((pointClosureScheme V).presheaf.germ (frameB V).U η (frameB V).mem
      (sectionCoordSec (frameB V) (secT V (tau k n c)))) := by
    rw [hg, hut]
    exact (hu.mul ht).map _
  rw [coordT, sectionCoord_eq_algebraMap_germ (frameB V) _ (frameB V).mem]
  exact (map_ne_zero_iff _ (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective _ _)).mpr hunit.ne_zero

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.capCycleT_tau_apply'
statement:
theorem capCycleT_tau_apply' (c : Fin (n + 1) → k) {v : space k n} (hτ : coordT v (tau k n c) ≠ 0)
    {e : ℕ} (hv : height v = e + 1) {y : space k n} (h : v ⤳ y) (hy : height y = e)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (hyi : y ∈ chartOpen k n i)
    (ht : (space k n).presheaf.germ (chartOpen k n i) y hyi (chartVal k n c i) ∉
      Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h) :
    (capCycleT v (tau k n c) hτ e hv).1 y =
      ((CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity
        ((space k n).presheaf.germ (chartOpen k n i) y hyi (chartVal k n c i)) h).toNat : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := C1Cap.exists_pointClosureι_eq h
  exact capCycleT_tau_apply v e hv c hτ z (coheight_eq_one_of_height hv z hy) i hyi ht

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.capCycleT_apply_of_height_ne
statement:
theorem capCycleT_apply_of_height_ne {v : space k n} (τ : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n (0 + 1), ⊤))
    (hτ : coordT v τ ≠ 0) {e : ℕ} (hv : height v = e + 1) {y : space k n} (hy : height y ≠ e) :
    (capCycleT v τ hτ e hv).1 y = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hyr : y ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι v)
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hyr
    refine capCycleT_apply_of_coheight_ne_one v τ hτ e hv z fun hz ↦ hy ?_
    exact D5.height_pointClosure_of_coheight_one (k := k) e v hv z hz
  · exact capCycleT_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range v τ hτ e hv y hyr

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.capCycleT_apply_of_not_specializes
proof:
:= by
  refine capCycleT_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range v τ hτ e hv y fun hyr ↦ hy ?_
  rw [range_pointClosureι] at hyr
  exact specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr hyr

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.mem_topSet_iff
statement:
theorem mem_topSet_iff (F : (space k n).Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] (d : ℕ)
    (V : space k n) :
    V ∈ topSet k n F d ↔ Maximal (· ∈ moduleSheafSupport F) V ∧ height V = (d : ℕ∞) + 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold topSet
  rw [Finset.mem_filter, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
  rfl

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.stalkLength_cokernel_eq_sum
statement:
theorem stalkLength_cokernel_eq_sum (F : (space k n).Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] (d : ℕ)
    (hdim : ∀ x ∈ moduleSheafSupport F, height x ≤ (d : ℕ∞) + 1)
    (c : Fin (n + 1) → k) (hc : Good k n F c) (hm : Mono (sigmaF k n c F))
    {y : space k n} (hy : height y = d) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (hyi : y ∈ chartOpen k n i) :
    stalkLength (cokernel (sigmaF k n c F)) y =
      ∑ V ∈ (topSet k n F d).attach, if h : V.1 ⤳ y then
        stalkLength F V.1 * CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity
          ((space k n).presheaf.germ (chartOpen k n i) y hyi (chartVal k n c i)) h else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [stalkLength_cokernel_linSec k n c F hm i hyi]
  set t := (space k n).presheaf.germ (chartOpen k n i) y hyi (chartVal k n c i) with htdef
  let B := (space k n).presheaf.stalk y
  let M := (moduleStalkFunctorLinear (space k n) y).obj F
  haveI : Module.Finite B M := SingularCurve.moduleStalk_finite_of_isFiniteType (space k n) y F
  let g : (topSet k n F d) → PrimeSpectrum B := fun V ↦
    if h : V.1 ⤳ y then ⟨Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h, inferInstance⟩
    else ⟨IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B, inferInstance⟩
  let SVa := (topSet k n F d).attach.filter (fun V ↦ V.1 ⤳ y)
  let T := SVa.image g
  have hg : ∀ V ∈ SVa, ∃ h : V.1 ⤳ y, g V = ⟨Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h, inferInstance⟩ :=
    fun V hV ↦ ⟨(Finset.mem_filter.mp hV).2, dif_pos _⟩
  
  have htop : ∀ V ∈ SVa, ∀ h : V.1 ⤳ y, t ∉ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h := by
    intro V _ h ht
    have hVi : V.1 ∈ chartOpen k n i := h.mem_open (chartOpen k n i).isOpen hyi
    have hVmax := ((mem_topSet_iff k n F d V.1).mp V.2).1
    have hu := isUnit_germ_chartVal k n F c hc hVmax i hVi
    have hmem := (mem_primeCompl_iff h t).mpr (by
      rw [htdef, (space k n).presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes_apply hyi h]
      exact hu)
    exact hmem ht
  
  have hS : ∀ p ∈ Module.support B M, p ∈ T ∨ p.asIdeal.IsMaximal := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨x', hx'y, hpx⟩ := Scheme.exists_specializes_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_eq y p.asIdeal
    have hpx' : p = ⟨Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hx'y, inferInstance⟩ := PrimeSpectrum.ext hpx.symm
    have hx'F : x' ∈ moduleSheafSupport F := by
      rw [← mem_support_stalk_iff F hx'y, ← hpx']
      exact hp
    by_cases hxy : x' = y
    · right
      subst hxy
      rw [← hpx, SchemeLocalOrdSymmetry.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_self]
      exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal _
    · left
      have hlt : y < x' := lt_of_le_not_ge (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr hx'y)
        fun hge ↦ hxy (hx'y.antisymm (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hge)).eq
      have h1 := Order.height_add_one_le hlt
      rw [hy] at h1
      have hx'h : height x' = (d : ℕ∞) + 1 := le_antisymm (hdim x' hx'F) h1
      have hx'top : x' ∈ topSet k n F d := (mem_topSet_iff k n F d x').mpr
        ⟨maximal_of_height_eq_of_top F hdim (by rw [hx'h]; rfl) hx'F, hx'h⟩
      refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨⟨x', hx'top⟩, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_attach _ _, hx'y⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [hpx']
      exact dif_pos hx'y
  have hTmin : ∀ q ∈ T, ∀ p ∈ Module.support B M, p.asIdeal ≤ q.asIdeal → p = q := by
    intro q hq p hp hle
    obtain ⟨V, hV, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hq
    obtain ⟨h, hgV⟩ := hg V hV
    obtain ⟨x', hx'y, hpx⟩ := Scheme.exists_specializes_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_eq y p.asIdeal
    have hpx' : p = ⟨Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hx'y, inferInstance⟩ :=
      PrimeSpectrum.ext hpx.symm
    have hx'F : x' ∈ moduleSheafSupport F := by
      rw [← mem_support_stalk_iff F hx'y, ← hpx']
      exact hp
    rw [hgV] at hle ⊢
    have hsp : p ⤳ (⟨Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h, inferInstance⟩ : PrimeSpectrum B) :=
      (PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes _ _).mp hle
    have hsp' := hsp.map ((space k n).fromSpecStalk y).continuous
    rw [hpx', Scheme.fromSpecStalk_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes,
      Scheme.fromSpecStalk_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes] at hsp'
    have hVmax := ((mem_topSet_iff k n F d V.1).mp V.2).1
    have hVx : V.1 ⤳ x' :=
      Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp (hVmax.2 hx'F (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr hsp'))
    have heq : x' = V.1 := (hsp'.antisymm hVx).eq
    rw [hpx']
    subst heq
    rfl
  have hfin : ∀ p ∈ Module.support B M, t ∈ p.asIdeal → p.asIdeal.IsMaximal := by
    intro p hp htp
    rcases hS p hp with hpT | hmax
    · obtain ⟨V, hV, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hpT
      obtain ⟨h, hgV⟩ := hg V hV
      rw [hgV] at htp
      exact absurd htp (htop V hV h)
    · exact hmax
  have hbT : ∀ q ∈ T, t ∉ q.asIdeal := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨V, hV, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hq
    obtain ⟨h, hgV⟩ := hg V hV
    rw [hgV]
    exact htop V hV h
  have hreg : IsSMulRegular M t :=
    isSMulRegular_stalk_of_isAffineOpen (chartOpen_isAffine k n i) F (hc i true) hyi
  have hb : chiKer t M = 0 := by
    rw [chiKer, Module.length_eq_zero_iff]
    refine ⟨fun a b ↦ Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    have ha : t • (a : M) = t • 0 := by rw [smul_zero]; exact a.2
    have hb' : t • (b : M) = t • 0 := by rw [smul_zero]; exact b.2
    exact (hreg ha).trans (hreg hb').symm
  rw [chiCoker_eq_sum_ord t (Module.support B M) T hS hTmin hfin hbT M subset_rfl hb]
  have hinj : Set.InjOn g SVa := by
    intro V hV W hW hVW
    obtain ⟨h, hgV⟩ := hg V hV
    obtain ⟨h', hgW⟩ := hg W hW
    rw [hgV, hgW] at hVW
    exact Subtype.ext (Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_injective h h'
      (congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal hVW))
  rw [Finset.sum_image hinj, Finset.sum_filter]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun V _ ↦ ?_
  by_cases h : V.1 ⤳ y
  · rw [if_pos h, dif_pos h]
    have hgV : g V = ⟨Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h, inferInstance⟩ := dif_pos h
    rw [hgV]
    change lengthAt (Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h) M * _ = _
    rw [lengthAt_stalk F h]
    rfl
  · rw [if_neg h, dif_neg h]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.mem_topSet_maximal
statement:
theorem mem_topSet_maximal {F : (space k n).Modules} [F.IsFinitePresentation] {d : ℕ}
    (V : topSet k n F d) : Maximal (· ∈ moduleSheafSupport F) V.1
proof:
:=
  ((mem_topSet_iff k n F d V.1).mp V.2).1

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.mem_topSet_height
statement:
theorem mem_topSet_height {F : (space k n).Modules} [F.IsFinitePresentation] {d : ℕ}
    (V : topSet k n F d) : height V.1 = (d : ℕ∞) + 1
proof:
:=
  ((mem_topSet_iff k n F d V.1).mp V.2).2

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.capSum_eq
statement:
theorem capSum_eq (F : (space k n).Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] (d : ℕ)
    (hdim : ∀ x ∈ moduleSheafSupport F, height x ≤ (d : ℕ∞) + 1)
    (c : Fin (n + 1) → k) (hc : Good k n F c) (hm : Mono (sigmaF k n c F))
    (hQ : IsCoherentLike (space k n) (cokernel (sigmaF k n c F)))
    (hdimQ : ∀ x ∈ moduleSheafSupport (cokernel (sigmaF k n c F)), height x ≤ d) :
    capSum k n F d c hc = coherentCycle (cokernel (sigmaF k n c F)) hQ d
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherian (space k n) := SchemeProjectiveSpace.isNoetherian k n
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext y
  rw [coherentCycle_apply]
  unfold capSum
  rw [AddSubgroup.val_finsetSum]
  simp only [AddSubgroup.coe_zsmul, Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply,
    Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_zsmul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  by_cases hy : height y = d
  · obtain ⟨i, hyi⟩ := exists_mem_chartOpen k n y
    have hQy : coherentCoeff (cokernel (sigmaF k n c F)) d y =
        ((stalkLength (cokernel (sigmaF k n c F)) y).toNat : ℤ) := by
      rw [← coherentCycle_apply (hF := hQ)]
      exact coherentCycle_apply_of_top _ hQ hdimQ hy
    rw [hQy, stalkLength_cokernel_eq_sum k n F d hdim c hc hm hy i hyi]
    have hfinQ : stalkLength (cokernel (sigmaF k n c F)) y ≠ ⊤ := by
      by_cases hmem : y ∈ moduleSheafSupport (cokernel (sigmaF k n c F))
      · haveI : (cokernel (sigmaF k n c F)).IsFinitePresentation := hQ
        exact Module.length_ne_top_iff.mpr (isFiniteLength_stalk_of_maximal _
          (maximal_of_height_eq_of_top _ hdimQ hy hmem))
      · rw [stalkLength_eq_zero_of_not_mem _ hmem]
        exact ENat.zero_ne_top
    rw [stalkLength_cokernel_eq_sum k n F d hdim c hc hm hy i hyi] at hfinQ
    rw [ENat.toNat_sum fun V hV ↦ (ENat.sum_ne_top.mp hfinQ) V hV, Nat.cast_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun V _ ↦ ?_
    by_cases h : V.1 ⤳ y
    · rw [dif_pos h, ENat.toNat_mul, Nat.cast_mul]
      congr 1
      have hVi : V.1 ∈ chartOpen k n i := h.mem_open (chartOpen k n i).isOpen hyi
      have hu := isUnit_germ_chartVal k n F c hc (mem_topSet_maximal k n V) i hVi
      have ht := (mem_primeCompl_iff h
        ((space k n).presheaf.germ (chartOpen k n i) y hyi (chartVal k n c i))).mpr (by
          rw [(space k n).presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes_apply hyi h]
          exact hu)
      exact capCycleT_tau_apply' c _ (mem_topSet_height k n V) h hy i hyi ht
    · rw [dif_neg h, capCycleT_apply_of_not_specializes _ _ _ h, mul_zero]
      rfl
  · rw [show coherentCoeff (cokernel (sigmaF k n c F)) d y = 0 from by
      rw [← coherentCycle_apply (hF := hQ)]
      exact coherentCycle_apply_of_height_ne _ hQ hy]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun V _ ↦ ?_
    rw [capCycleT_apply_of_height_ne _ _ _ hy, mul_zero]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.coherentCycle_succ_eq_sum
statement:
theorem coherentCycle_succ_eq_sum (F : (space k n).Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike (space k n) F)
    [F.IsFinitePresentation] (d : ℕ) :
    coherentCycle F hF (d + 1) = ∑ V ∈ (topSet k n F d).attach,
      ((stalkLength F V.1).toNat : ℤ) • dimPrimeCycle V.1 (d + 1) (mem_topSet_height k n V)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherian (space k n) := SchemeProjectiveSpace.isNoetherian k n
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext y
  rw [coherentCycle_apply, AddSubgroup.val_finsetSum]
  simp only [AddSubgroup.coe_zsmul, Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply,
    Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_zsmul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  by_cases hyT : y ∈ topSet k n F d
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ⟨y, hyT⟩]
    · have hyy := (mem_topSet_iff k n F d y).mp hyT
      change coherentCoeff F (d + 1) y = _ * (Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single y (1 : ℤ)) y
      rw [Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single_apply, if_pos rfl, mul_one, coherentCoeff,
        if_pos ⟨by rw [hyy.2]; push_cast; rfl, hyy.1⟩]
    · intro V _ hV
      change _ * (Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single V.1 (1 : ℤ)) y = 0
      rw [Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single_apply,
        if_neg (fun h ↦ hV (Subtype.ext h.symm)), mul_zero]
    · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_attach _ _) h
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero fun V _ ↦ ?_]
    · rw [coherentCoeff, if_neg]
      rintro ⟨hh, hmax⟩
      exact hyT ((mem_topSet_iff k n F d y).mpr ⟨hmax, by rw [hh]; push_cast; rfl⟩)
    · change _ * (Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single V.1 (1 : ℤ)) y = 0
      rw [Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single_apply,
        if_neg (fun h ↦ hyT (by rw [h]; exact V.2)), mul_zero]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.cap_coherentCycle
statement:
theorem cap_coherentCycle (F : (space k n).Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike (space k n) F)
    [F.IsFinitePresentation] (d : ℕ) (c : Fin (n + 1) → k) (hc : Good k n F c) :
    (opsV4 k).cap (Lpn k n) (hLpn k n) d
        ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (coherentCycle F hF (d + 1)) :
          DimChow (space k n) (d + 1))) =
      (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (capSum k n F d c hc) : DimChow (space k n) d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coherentCycle_succ_eq_sum k n F hF d, capSum]
  simp only [QuotientAddGroup.mk_sum, QuotientAddGroup.mk_zsmul, TensorProduct.tmul_sum,
    map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun V _ ↦ ?_
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_smul, map_zsmul, TensorProduct.tmul_smul]
  congr 1
  exact cap_dimPrimeCycleT V.1 (tau k n c) _ d (mem_topSet_height k n V)

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.g2_all
statement:
theorem g2_all (hn : 0 < n) (d : ℕ) :
    ∀ (F : (space k n).Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike (space k n) F), d ≤ n →
      (∀ x ∈ moduleSheafSupport F, height x ≤ d) → ∀ y : K0 (space k n),
        k0ToG0 (space k n) y = g0ClassOf (space k n) F hF →
          ((eulerP k n hn (k0ToG0 (space k n) (uPn k n ^ d * y)) : ℤ) : ℚ) =
            degPn k n (((Hn k n) ^ d) (cycPn k n F hF d))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherian (space k n) := SchemeProjectiveSpace.isNoetherian k n
  induction d with
  | zero =>
    intro F hF _ hdim y hy
    exact g2_base k n hn F hF hdim y hy
  | succ d ih =>
    intro F hF hdn hdim y hy
    haveI : F.IsFinitePresentation := hF
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_good k n F
    let s := linSec k n c
    have hΛf := twistM1_isFiniteLocallyFree k n
    have hm : Mono (sigmaF k n c F) := by
      refine mono_sigmaT_of_isSMulRegular s (twistM1_locallyTrivial k n) hΛf F fun x ↦ ?_
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_mem_chartOpen k n x
      haveI := avoidSheaf_isFinitePresentation k n F false
      exact ⟨chartOpen k n i, hi, frame k n i,
        isSMulRegular_stalk_of_isAffineOpen (chartOpen_isAffine k n i) (avoidSheaf k n F false)
          (hc i false) hi⟩
    have hrel := g0ClassOf_eq_smul_add_cokernel s hΛf F hF hm
    have hQ : IsCoherentLike (space k n) (cokernel (sigmaF k n c F)) :=
      isCoherentLike_cokernel s hΛf F hF
    have hdim' : ∀ x ∈ moduleSheafSupport F, height x ≤ (d : ℕ∞) + 1 := fun x hx ↦ by
      have := hdim x hx
      push_cast at this
      exact this
    have hQsupp : ∀ x ∈ moduleSheafSupport (cokernel (sigmaF k n c F)), height x ≤ d := by
      intro x hxQ
      have hxF : x ∈ moduleSheafSupport F := mem_support_of_epi (cokernel.π _) hxQ
      rcases (hdim' x hxF).lt_or_eq with hlt | heq
      · exact Order.le_of_lt_add_one hlt
      · exfalso
        have hmax := maximal_of_height_eq_of_top F hdim (by rw [heq]; push_cast; rfl) hxF
        obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_mem_chartOpen k n x
        have hu := isUnit_germ_chartVal k n F c hc hmax i hi
        exact not_mem_support_cokernel s hΛf F hi (frame k n i) hu hxQ
    have hyQ : k0ToG0 (space k n) (uu k n * y) =
        g0ClassOf (space k n) (cokernel (sigmaF k n c F)) hQ := by
      rw [k0ToG0_mul, hy]
      have hcl : k0ClassOf (space k n) (twistM1 k n) hΛf = projectiveTwistingK0Class k n (-1) :=
        rfl
      rw [hcl] at hrel
      rw [add_smul, one_smul, neg_smul]
      rw [eq_sub_of_add_eq' hrel.symm, sub_eq_add_neg]
    have h := ih (cokernel (sigmaF k n c F)) hQ (by omega) hQsupp (uu k n * y) hyQ
    rw [pow_succ, mul_assoc]
    refine h.trans ?_
    rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, cycPn, cycPn, Hn_lof_succ,
      cap_coherentCycle k n F hF d c hc, capSum_eq k n F d hdim' c hc hm hQ hQsupp]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.leadingCycleGateG2
statement: theorem leadingCycleGateG2 (hn : 0 < n) : LeadingCycleGateG2 k n hn
proof:
:=
  fun F hF d hdn hdim y hy ↦ g2_all k n hn d F hF hdn hdim y hy

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.leadingCycleGate
statement: theorem leadingCycleGate (hn : 0 < n) : RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.LeadingCycleGate k n hn
proof:
:=
  leadingCycleGate_of_g2 k n hn (leadingCycleGateG2 k n hn)

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.unitT_comp_sigmaT
statement:
theorem unitT_comp_sigmaT :
    unitT (Λ := Λ) F ≫ (underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map ((sigmaT Λ s).app F) =
      evalPre s F
proof:
:= by
  have h : (sigmaT Λ s).app F =
      (moduleSheafification X).map (evalPre s F) ≫ (moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).counit.app F :=
    theta_koszul s F
  let adj := moduleSheafificationAdjunction X
  have e2 : (moduleSheafification X).map (evalPre s F) ≫ adj.counit.app F =
      (adj.homEquiv (presTensor (Λ := Λ) F) F).symm (evalPre s F) :=
    (adj.homEquiv_counit (presTensor (Λ := Λ) F) F (evalPre s F)).symm
  rw [h]
  exact (adj.homEquiv_unit _ _ _).symm.trans
    ((congrArg (adj.homEquiv (presTensor (Λ := Λ) F) F) e2).trans (Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _))

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.evalPre_app_tmul
statement:
theorem evalPre_app_tmul (W : X.Opens) (l : Λ.val.obj (op W)) (m : F.val.obj (op W)) :
    ((evalPre s F).app (op W)).hom (l ⊗ₜ m) = (s.val.app (op W)).hom l • m
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.unitT_locallySurjective
statement:
theorem unitT_locallySurjective :
    Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map (unitT (Λ := Λ) F))
proof:
:= by
  have h : (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map (unitT (Λ := Λ) F) =
      CategoryTheory.toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (presTensor (Λ := Λ) F).presheaf :=
    rfl
  rw [h]
  exact Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_toSheafify' (J := Opens.grothendieckTopology X) _

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.stalk_map_germ
statement:
theorem stalk_map_germ {A B : X.Modules} (f : A ⟶ B) {W : X.Opens} {x : X} (hx : x ∈ W)
    (a : A.val.obj (op W)) :
    ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map f).hom (TopCat.Presheaf.germ A.val.presheaf W x hx a) =
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ B.val.presheaf W x hx ((f.val.app (op W)).hom a)
proof:
:=
  TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply W x hx ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map f.val) a

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.sigmaT_stalk_mem
statement:
theorem sigmaT_stalk_mem {x : X} {W0 : X.Opens} (hx0 : x ∈ W0) (l0 : Λ.val.obj (op W0))
    (hgen : ∀ (W : X.Opens) (hW : W ≤ W0) (l : Λ.val.obj (op W)),
      ∃ a : Γ(X, W), l = a • resL hW l0)
    (e : (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj ((tensorSheafLeftFunctor X Λ).obj F)) :
    ∃ m : (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj F,
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map ((sigmaT Λ s).app F)).hom e = germVal s hx0 l0 • m
proof:
:= by
  let E := (tensorSheafLeftFunctor X Λ).obj F
  obtain ⟨V, hxV, n, rfl⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.exists_germ_eq E.val.presheaf e
  haveI := unitT_locallySurjective (Λ := Λ) F
  have hsieve := Presheaf.imageSieve_mem (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
    ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map (unitT (Λ := Λ) F)) (U := op V) n
  obtain ⟨W', f, ⟨p, hp⟩, hxW'⟩ := (Opens.mem_grothendieckTopology X).mp hsieve x hxV
  let W : X.Opens := W' ⊓ W0
  have hxW : x ∈ W := ⟨hxW', hx0⟩
  let iW : W ⟶ W' := homOfLE inf_le_left
  let P := presTensor (Λ := Λ) F
  let σ := (sigmaT Λ s).app F
  let φ : P.obj (op W) →+ (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj F :=
    (TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf W x hxW).hom.comp
      ((evalPre s F).app (op W)).hom.toAddMonoidHom
  have keyφ : ∀ q : P.obj (op W), ∃ m : (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj F,
      φ q = germVal s hx0 l0 • m := by
    intro q
    induction q using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => exact ⟨0, (map_zero φ).trans (smul_zero _).symm⟩
    | tmul l m =>
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hgen W inf_le_right l
      let gm : (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj F := TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf W x hxW m
      refine ⟨X.presheaf.germ W x hxW a • gm, ?_⟩
      have hs : (s.val.app (op W)).hom l = a * X.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_right).op
          ((s.val.app (op W0)).hom l0) := by
        have hn := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply s.val (homOfLE (inf_le_right : W ≤ W0)).op l0
        exact (congrArg (s.val.app (op W)).hom ha).trans
          (((s.val.app (op W)).hom.map_smul a _).trans (congrArg (a • ·) hn))
      have hg : X.presheaf.germ W x hxW ((s.val.app (op W)).hom l) =
          X.presheaf.germ W x hxW a * germVal s hx0 l0 := by
        rw [hs]
        exact (map_mul (X.presheaf.germ W x hxW).hom a _).trans
          (congrArg (_ * ·) (X.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE inf_le_right) x hxW _))
      have e1 : φ (l ⊗ₜ m) = X.presheaf.germ W x hxW ((s.val.app (op W)).hom l) • gm :=
        PresheafOfModules.germ_smul (R := X.presheaf) F.val x W hxW _ m
      rw [e1, hg, mul_comm, mul_smul]
    | add q₁ q₂ h₁ h₂ =>
      obtain ⟨m₁, hm₁⟩ := h₁
      obtain ⟨m₂, hm₂⟩ := h₂
      exact ⟨m₁ + m₂, (map_add φ q₁ q₂).trans
        ((congrArg₂ (· + ·) hm₁ hm₂).trans (smul_add _ _ _).symm)⟩
  have key : ∀ q : P.obj (op W), ∃ m : (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj F,
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf W x hxW
        ((σ.val.app (op W)).hom (((unitT (Λ := Λ) F).app (op W)).hom q)) =
        germVal s hx0 l0 • m := by
    intro q
    have hq : (σ.val.app (op W)).hom (((unitT (Λ := Λ) F).app (op W)).hom q) =
        ((evalPre s F).app (op W)).hom q :=
      congrArg (fun g ↦ (g.app (op W)).hom q) (unitT_comp_sigmaT s F)
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := keyφ q
    exact ⟨m, (congrArg _ hq).trans hm⟩
  let iWV : W ⟶ V := iW ≫ f
  let q : P.obj (op W) := P.map iW.op p
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := key q
  refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
  have h1 := stalk_map_germ σ hxV n
  have h2 : ((unitT (Λ := Λ) F).app (op W)).hom q = E.val.map iWV.op n := by
    have hn := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply (unitT (Λ := Λ) F) iW.op p
    refine hn.trans ?_
    have hp' : ((unitT (Λ := Λ) F).app (op W')).hom p = E.val.map f.op n := hp
    rw [hp']
    exact (PresheafOfModules.map_comp_apply E.val f.op iW.op n).symm
  have h3 : (σ.val.app (op W)).hom (((unitT (Λ := Λ) F).app (op W)).hom q) =
      F.val.map iWV.op ((σ.val.app (op V)).hom n) := by
    rw [h2]
    exact PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply σ.val iWV.op n
  have h4 : TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf V x hxV ((σ.val.app (op V)).hom n) =
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf W x hxW (F.val.map iWV.op ((σ.val.app (op V)).hom n)) :=
    (TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply F.val.presheaf iWV x hxW _).symm
  exact h1.trans (h4.trans ((congrArg _ h3.symm).trans hm))

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.stalkLength_cokernel_sigmaT
statement:
theorem stalkLength_cokernel_sigmaT (hΛf : IsFiniteLocallyFree X Λ)
    (hm : Mono ((sigmaT Λ s).app F)) {x : X} {W0 : X.Opens} (hx0 : x ∈ W0)
    (l0 : Λ.val.obj (op W0))
    (hgen : ∀ (W : X.Opens) (hW : W ≤ W0) (l : Λ.val.obj (op W)),
      ∃ a : Γ(X, W), l = a • resL hW l0) :
    stalkLength (cokernel ((sigmaT Λ s).app F)) x =
      AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.LocalOrdSymmetry.chiCoker (germVal s hx0 l0)
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj F)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits X Λ hΛf
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits X Λ hΛf
  let σ := (sigmaT Λ s).app F
  let S := ShortComplex.mk σ (cokernel.π σ) (cokernel.condition σ)
  have hS : S.ShortExact :=
    { exact := ShortComplex.exact_of_g_is_cokernel _ (cokernelIsCokernel σ)
      mono_f := hm
      epi_g := inferInstanceAs (Epi (cokernel.π σ)) }
  have hSx := RRC.SingularTodd.shortExact_map_moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x hS
  let t := germVal s hx0 l0
  let M := (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj F
  let fσ := ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map σ).hom
  let gπ := ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map (cokernel.π σ)).hom
  have hrk : LinearMap.range fσ = LinearMap.ker gπ := hSx.exact.moduleCat_range_eq_ker
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective gπ :=
    (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mp hSx.epi_g
  
  have hQ : (sigmaT Λ s).app (cokernel σ) = 0 :=
    app_cokernel_eq_zero (T := tensorSheafLeftFunctor X Λ) F
  have hrange : LinearMap.range fσ = LinearMap.range (LinearMap.lsmul _ M t) := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · rintro _ ⟨e, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := sigmaT_stalk_mem s F hx0 l0 hgen e
      exact ⟨m, hm.symm⟩
    · rintro _ ⟨m, rfl⟩
      rw [hrk, LinearMap.mem_ker]
      change gπ (t • m) = 0
      exact (gπ.map_smul t m).trans (germ_smul_eq_zero_of_killed s hQ hx0 l0 (gπ m))
  have e1 : (M ⧸ LinearMap.ker gπ) ≃ₗ[X.presheaf.stalk x]
      (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj (cokernel σ) := gπ.quotKerEquivOfSurjective hsurj
  rw [stalkLength, ← e1.length_eq, ← hrk, hrange]
  rfl

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.S_mono
statement: theorem S_mono {j n : ℕ} (hjn : j ≤ n) : S M j ≤ S M n
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_
  rintro w ⟨i, hi, y, rfl⟩
  exact lof_mem_S (by omega) y

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.lowersDeg_mem_S_pred
statement:
theorem lowersDeg_mem_S_pred {u : GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Op M} (hu : LowersDeg u) {n : ℕ}
    {w : DirectSum ℕ M} (hw : w ∈ S M n) : u w ∈ S M (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction hw using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem w hw =>
    obtain ⟨j, hj, y, rfl⟩ := hw
    cases j with
    | zero => rw [hu.zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    | succ j =>
      obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := hu.succ j y
      rw [hy']
      exact lof_mem_S (by omega) y'
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hx

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.lowersDeg_pow_mem_S_sub
statement:
theorem lowersDeg_pow_mem_S_sub {u : GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Op M} (hu : LowersDeg u) {n : ℕ}
    {w : DirectSum ℕ M} (hw : w ∈ S M n) (i : ℕ) : (u ^ i) w ∈ S M (n - i)
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => simpa using hw
  | succ i ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]
    have := lowersDeg_mem_S_pred hu ih
    rwa [Nat.sub_sub] at this

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.lowersDeg_pow_succ_apply_eq_zero
statement:
theorem lowersDeg_pow_succ_apply_eq_zero {u : GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Op M} (hu : LowersDeg u)
    {n : ℕ} {w : DirectSum ℕ M} (hw : w ∈ S M n) : (u ^ (n + 1)) w = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hw using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem w hw =>
    obtain ⟨j, hj, y, rfl⟩ := hw
    exact hu.pow_apply_lof_zero j y (n + 1) (by omega)
  | zero => rw [map_zero]
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [map_smul, hx, smul_zero]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.component_eq_zero_of_mem_S
statement:
theorem component_eq_zero_of_mem_S {d m : ℕ} (hdm : d < m) {w : DirectSum ℕ M}
    (hw : w ∈ S M d) : DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ M m w = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hw using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem w hw =>
    obtain ⟨j, hj, y, rfl⟩ := hw
    rw [DirectSum.component.of, dif_neg (show j ≠ m by omega)]
  | zero => rw [map_zero]
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [map_smul, hx, smul_zero]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.evTrunc_add
statement:
theorem evTrunc_add {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℚ M] (n : ℕ) (H : Module.End ℚ M)
    (f g : ℚ⟦X⟧) : evTrunc n H (f + g) = evTrunc n H f + evTrunc n H g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [evTrunc_eq_sum, map_add, add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.evTrunc_neg
statement:
theorem evTrunc_neg {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℚ M] (n : ℕ) (H : Module.End ℚ M)
    (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) : evTrunc n H (-f) = -evTrunc n H f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [evTrunc_eq_sum, map_neg, neg_smul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.evTrunc_zero
statement:
theorem evTrunc_zero {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℚ M] (n : ℕ) (H : Module.End ℚ M) :
    evTrunc n H 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [evTrunc_eq_sum, map_zero, zero_smul, Finset.sum_const_zero]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.evTrunc_sub
statement:
theorem evTrunc_sub {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℚ M] (n : ℕ) (H : Module.End ℚ M)
    (f g : ℚ⟦X⟧) : evTrunc n H (f - g) = evTrunc n H f - evTrunc n H g
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, evTrunc_add, evTrunc_neg, ← sub_eq_add_neg]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.coeff_mul_eq_zero_of_low
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_eq_zero_of_low {g f : ℚ⟦X⟧} {N : ℕ} (hf : ∀ j < N, coeff j f = 0) :
    ∀ j < N, coeff j (g * f) = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  rw [coeff_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun p hp ↦ ?_
  have := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp
  rw [hf p.2 (by omega), mul_zero]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.coeff_mul_eq_of_low
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_eq_of_low {g f : ℚ⟦X⟧} {N : ℕ} (hf : ∀ j < N, coeff j f = 0)
    (hg : constantCoeff g = 1) : coeff N (g * f) = coeff N f
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_mul, Finset.sum_eq_single (0, N)]
  · rw [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, hg, one_mul]
  · intro p hp hne
    have h := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp
    have hp2 : p.2 < N := by
      rcases p with ⟨a, b⟩
      simp only at h ⊢
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos a with ha | ha
      · exact absurd (Prod.ext ha (by omega)) hne
      · omega
    rw [hf p.2 hp2, mul_zero]
  · intro h
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mpr (by simp)) h

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.constantCoeff_eSer_pow
statement: theorem constantCoeff_eSer_pow (j : ℕ) : constantCoeff (eSer ^ j) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_pow, constantCoeff_eSer, one_pow]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.constantCoeff_tdSer_pow
statement: theorem constantCoeff_tdSer_pow (j : ℕ) : constantCoeff (tdSer ^ j) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_pow, constantCoeff_tdSer, one_pow]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.low_of_X_pow_eSer_pow
statement:
theorem low_of_X_pow_eSer_pow (a n : ℕ) (f : ℚ⟦X⟧)
    (h : ∀ i ≤ n, coeff i (X ^ a * eSer ^ a * f) = 0) : ∀ j, j + a ≤ n → coeff j f = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∀ j, j + a ≤ n → coeff j (eSer ^ a * f) = 0 := by
    intro j hj
    have := h (j + a) hj
    rwa [mul_assoc, coeff_X_pow_mul', if_pos (by omega), Nat.add_sub_cancel] at this
  have hf : f = tdSer ^ a * (eSer ^ a * f) := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_pow, mul_comm tdSer eSer, eSer_mul_tdSer, one_pow, one_mul]
  intro j hj
  rw [hf]
  exact coeff_mul_eq_zero_of_low (N := j + 1) (fun i hi ↦ h1 i (by omega)) j (by omega)

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.chPn_zero
statement: theorem chPn_zero : chPn k n 0 = 0
proof: := map_zero _

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.chPn_add
statement: theorem chPn_add (a b : K0 (space k n)) : chPn k n (a + b) = chPn k n a + chPn k n b
proof:
:=
  map_add _ _ _

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.chFund_apply
statement: theorem chFund_apply (y : K0 (space k n)) : chFund k n y = chPn k n y (fundPn k n)
proof: := rfl

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.degT_spk_eq
statement: theorem degT_spk_eq (x : TotalChow (Spk k)) : degT k (Spk k) x = degTotalSpk k x
proof:
:= by
  rw [totalChow_spk_eq_lof k x, degT_lof_zero, degTotalSpk_lof_zero]
  generalize x 0 = z
  have hz : z = evalQ k z • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] ptClass k) :=
    evalQ_injective k (by rw [map_smul, evalQ_ptClass, smul_eq_mul, mul_one])
  conv_lhs => rw [hz]
  rw [map_smul, degQ_pt, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.fundPn_mem_S
statement: theorem fundPn_mem_S : fundPn k n ∈ S (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k n) m) n
proof:
:= by
  rw [fundPn, fundClass_space_eq]
  exact spaceFundClass_mem_S k n

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.lowersDeg_Hn
statement: theorem lowersDeg_Hn : LowersDeg (M := fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k n) m) (Hn k n)
proof:
:=
  lowersDeg_totalCapOn k _ (hcr k n 1)

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.Hn_pow_succ_fundPn
statement: theorem Hn_pow_succ_fundPn : ((Hn k n) ^ (n + 1)) (fundPn k n) = 0
proof:
:=
  lowersDeg_pow_succ_apply_eq_zero (lowersDeg_Hn k n) (fundPn_mem_S k n)

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.degPn_eq_push
statement:
theorem degPn_eq_push (w : TotalChow (space k n)) :
    degPn k n w = degTotalSpk k (totalPushOn (opsK k) (caseICover k n).toBase
      (totalPushOn (opsK k) (φK k n).hom w))
proof:
:= by
  exact congrArg (degTotalSpk k) (LinearMap.congr_fun (push_toSpec_eq k n) w)

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.degPn_pow
statement:
theorem degPn_pow (p : ℕ) :
    degPn k n (((Hn k n) ^ p) (fundPn k n)) = if p = n then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt p n with hp | hp
  · have hf : fundPn k n = spaceFundClass k n := fundClass_space_eq k n
    have h2 : ((caseIH k n) ^ p) (totalPushOn (opsK k) (φK k n).hom (spaceFundClass k n)) =
        totalPushOn (opsK k) (φK k n).hom (((spaceH k n) ^ p) (spaceFundClass k n)) :=
      LinearMap.congr_fun (pow_comp_eq_of_comp_eq (caseIH k n) (spaceH k n)
        (totalPushOn (opsK k) (φK k n).hom) (push_spaceH k n (caseITwistGate k n)) p)
        (spaceFundClass k n)
    have h3 : totalPushOn (opsK k) (φK k n).hom (((spaceH k n) ^ p) (spaceFundClass k n)) =
        ((caseIH k n) ^ p) (caseIFundClass k n) :=
      h2.symm.trans (congrArg ((caseIH k n) ^ p) (push_spaceFundClass k n))
    have h4 : degPn k n (((Hn k n) ^ p) (fundPn k n)) =
        degPn k n (((spaceH k n) ^ p) (spaceFundClass k n)) :=
      congrArg (fun z ↦ degPn k n (((spaceH k n) ^ p) z)) hf
    rw [h4, degPn_eq_push, h3]
    exact caseI_deg_pow k n p hp
  · rw [if_neg (by omega)]
    rw [pow_apply_eq_zero_of_le (Hn k n) (fundPn k n) n (Hn_pow_succ_fundPn k n) p (by omega),
      map_zero]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.degPn_pow_evTrunc
statement:
theorem degPn_pow_evTrunc (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ n) :
    degPn k n (((Hn k n) ^ m) (evTrunc n (Hn k n) f (fundPn k n))) = coeff (n - m) f
proof:
:= by
  rw [evTrunc_eq_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply, map_sum, map_sum]
  have : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      degPn k n (((Hn k n) ^ m) ((coeff i f • (Hn k n) ^ i) (fundPn k n))) =
        if i = n - m then coeff (n - m) f else 0 := by
    intro i _
    rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul, map_smul, ← Module.End.mul_apply, ← pow_add,
      degPn_pow, smul_eq_mul]
    by_cases h : i = n - m
    · subst h; rw [if_pos (by omega), if_pos rfl, mul_one]
    · rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg h, mul_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl this, Finset.sum_ite_eq' (Finset.range (n + 1)) (n - m)]
  rw [if_pos (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.coeff_eq_zero_of_evTrunc_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coeff_eq_zero_of_evTrunc_eq_zero (f : ℚ⟦X⟧)
    (hf : evTrunc n (Hn k n) f (fundPn k n) = 0) : ∀ i ≤ n, coeff i f = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  have := degPn_pow_evTrunc k n f (n - i) (by omega)
  rw [hf, map_zero, map_zero, Nat.sub_sub_self hi] at this
  exact this.symm

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.evTrunc_fundPn_mem_S
statement:
theorem evTrunc_fundPn_mem_S (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) :
    evTrunc n (Hn k n) f (fundPn k n) ∈ S (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k n) m) n
proof:
:=
  (lowersDeg_Hn k n).evTrunc_mem_S (fundPn_mem_S k n) f

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.evTrunc_fundPn_mem_S_of_low
statement:
theorem evTrunc_fundPn_mem_S_of_low (d : ℕ) (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) (hf : ∀ j, j + d < n → coeff j f = 0) :
    evTrunc n (Hn k n) f (fundPn k n) ∈ S (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k n) m) d
proof:
:= by
  rw [evTrunc_eq_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i hi ↦ ?_
  rw [LinearMap.smul_apply]
  by_cases hid : i + d < n
  · rw [hf i hid, zero_smul]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  · exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (S_mono (j := n - i) (by omega)
      (lowersDeg_pow_mem_S_sub (lowersDeg_Hn k n) (fundPn_mem_S k n) i))

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.lowersDeg_pow_lof
statement:
theorem lowersDeg_pow_lof {M : ℕ → Type*} [∀ n, AddCommGroup (M n)] [∀ n, Module ℚ (M n)]
    {u : GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Op M} (hu : LowersDeg u) (i : ℕ) :
    ∀ (j : ℕ) (a : M j), i ≤ j → ∃ a' : M (j - i),
      (u ^ i) (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M j a) = DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M (j - i) a'
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => intro j a _; exact ⟨a, by simp⟩
  | succ i ih =>
    intro j a hij
    obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := ih j a (by omega)
    obtain ⟨j', hj'⟩ : ∃ j', j - i = j' + 1 := ⟨j - i - 1, by omega⟩
    have key : ∀ (t : ℕ) (b : M t) (ht : t = j' + 1), ∃ c : M (j - (i + 1)),
        u (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M t b) = DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M (j - (i + 1)) c := by
      intro t b ht
      subst ht
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hu.succ j' b
      have hji : j - (i + 1) = j' := by omega
      rw [hji]
      exact ⟨c, hc⟩
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := key (j - i) a' hj'
    exact ⟨c, by rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ha', hc]⟩

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.fundPn_eq_lof
statement:
theorem fundPn_eq_lof : ∃ a : RationalDimChow (space k n) n,
    fundPn k n = DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k n) m) n a
proof:
:= by
  have hd : height (genericPoint (space k n)) = (n : ℕ∞) := height_genericPoint_space k n
  exact ⟨_, fundClass_eq k n hd⟩

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.component_Hn_pow_fundPn_eq_zero
statement:
theorem component_Hn_pow_fundPn_eq_zero (i m : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ n) (hm : m ≠ n - i) :
    DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k n) m) m
      (((Hn k n) ^ i) (fundPn k n)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := fundPn_eq_lof k n
  obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := lowersDeg_pow_lof (lowersDeg_Hn k n) i n a hi
  rw [ha, ha']
  rw [DirectSum.component.of, dif_neg (Ne.symm hm)]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.component_evTrunc_fundPn
statement:
theorem component_evTrunc_fundPn (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ n) :
    DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k n) m) m
        (evTrunc n (Hn k n) f (fundPn k n)) =
      coeff (n - m) f • DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k n) m) m
        (((Hn k n) ^ (n - m)) (fundPn k n))
proof:
:= by
  rw [evTrunc_eq_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply, map_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (n - m)]
  · rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul]
  · intro i hi hne
    have hi' : i ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
    rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul,
      component_Hn_pow_fundPn_eq_zero k n i m hi' (by omega), smul_zero]
  · intro h
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)) h

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.isRep_twist
statement:
theorem isRep_twist (d : ℤ) :
    IsRep k n (projectiveTwistingK0Class k n d) (rescale (d : ℚ) (exp ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  have hv := spaceFundClass_mem_S k n
  unfold IsRep
  rw [chFund_apply]
  unfold chPn fundPn
  rw [projectiveTwistingK0Class, chK0_classOf, fundClass_space_eq,
    chBundle_line k _ _ (hcr k n d) hv, totalCapOn_twist, evTrunc_smul_op]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.exists_isRep
statement: theorem exists_isRep (y : K0 (space k n)) : ∃ f, IsRep k n y f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := projectiveSpace_k0_span k n y
  choose N hN using fun i ↦ spk_exists_intCast k (g i)
  let F : K0 (space k n) →+ TotalChow (space k n) := chFund k n
  have hterm : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
      F (EulerIndependence.pb k n (g i) * projectiveTwistingK0Class k n (-1) ^ (i : ℕ)) =
        ((N i : ℤ) : ℚ) • evTrunc n (Hn k n)
          (rescale (((-((i : ℕ) : ℤ)) : ℤ) : ℚ) (exp ℚ)) (fundPn k n) := by
    intro i
    rw [hN i, map_intCast, projectiveTwistingK0Class_neg_one_pow, map_intCast_mul F]
    have h := isRep_twist k n (-((i : ℕ) : ℤ))
    unfold IsRep at h
    change N i • chFund k n _ = _
    rw [h, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]
  refine ⟨∑ i, ((N i : ℤ) : ℚ) • rescale (((-((i : ℕ) : ℤ)) : ℤ) : ℚ) (exp ℚ), ?_⟩
  unfold IsRep
  change F y = _
  rw [hg, map_sum, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ hterm i, evTrunc_sum_smul,
    LinearMap.sum_apply]
  rfl

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.isRep_twist_mul
statement:
theorem isRep_twist_mul {y : K0 (space k n)} {f : ℚ⟦X⟧} (d : ℤ) (h : IsRep k n y f) :
    IsRep k n (projectiveTwistingK0Class k n d * y) (rescale (d : ℚ) (exp ℚ) * f)
proof:
:= by
  have hmul : chPn k n (projectiveTwistingK0Class k n d * y) =
      chBundle k (closedPosV4 k) (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) * chPn k n y :=
    CIIKD.chK0_lineMul (chExact_closedPosV4 k) (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) (hcr k n d) y
  unfold IsRep at h ⊢
  rw [chFund_apply] at h ⊢
  rw [hmul, Module.End.mul_apply, h,
    chBundle_line k _ _ (hcr k n d) (evTrunc_fundPn_mem_S k n f), totalCapOn_twist,
    evTrunc_smul_op, ← evTrunc_mul_apply n _ _ (Hn_pow_succ_fundPn k n)]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.isRep_u_mul
statement:
theorem isRep_u_mul {y : K0 (space k n)} {f : ℚ⟦X⟧} (h : IsRep k n y f) :
    IsRep k n (uPn k n * y) (X * eSer * f)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := isRep_twist_mul k n (-1) h
  have hc : ((-1 : ℤ) : ℚ) = -1 := by norm_num
  rw [hc] at h1
  unfold IsRep at h h1 ⊢
  have e : uPn k n * y = y + -(projectiveTwistingK0Class k n (-1) * y) := by
    rw [uPn, add_mul, one_mul, neg_mul]
  rw [e, map_add, map_neg, h, h1, ← sub_eq_add_neg, ← LinearMap.sub_apply, ← evTrunc_sub,
    X_mul_eSer, sub_mul, one_mul]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.isRep_u_pow_mul
statement:
theorem isRep_u_pow_mul {y : K0 (space k n)} {f : ℚ⟦X⟧} (h : IsRep k n y f) (j : ℕ) :
    IsRep k n (uPn k n ^ j * y) (X ^ j * eSer ^ j * f)
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simpa using h
  | succ j ih =>
    have := isRep_u_mul k n ih
    have e1 : uPn k n ^ (j + 1) * y = uPn k n * (uPn k n ^ j * y) := by
      rw [pow_succ', mul_assoc]
    have e2 : (X : ℚ⟦X⟧) ^ (j + 1) * eSer ^ (j + 1) * f = X * eSer * (X ^ j * eSer ^ j * f) := by
      ring
    rw [e1, e2]
    exact this

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.low_coeff_of_u_pow
statement:
theorem low_coeff_of_u_pow (d : ℕ) {y : K0 (space k n)} (hy : uPn k n ^ (d + 1) * y = 0)
    {f : ℚ⟦X⟧} (h : IsRep k n y f) : ∀ j, j + d < n → coeff j f = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := isRep_u_pow_mul k n h (d + 1)
  unfold IsRep at h1
  rw [hy, map_zero] at h1
  have h2 := coeff_eq_zero_of_evTrunc_eq_zero k n _ h1.symm
  intro j hj
  exact low_of_X_pow_eSer_pow (d + 1) n f h2 j (by omega)

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.tdPn_evTrunc
statement:
theorem tdPn_evTrunc (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) :
    tdPn k n (evTrunc n (Hn k n) f (fundPn k n)) =
      evTrunc n (Hn k n) (tdSer ^ (n + 1) * f) (fundPn k n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tdPn, tdLine_pow_apply k _ (hcr k n 1) (evTrunc_fundPn_mem_S k n f) (n + 1)]
  change ((evTrunc n (Hn k n) tdSer) ^ (n + 1)) (evTrunc n (Hn k n) f (fundPn k n)) = _
  rw [evTrunc_pow_apply n _ _
      (lowersDeg_pow_succ_apply_eq_zero (lowersDeg_Hn k n) (evTrunc_fundPn_mem_S k n f)),
    ← evTrunc_mul_apply n _ _ (Hn_pow_succ_fundPn k n)]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.chPn_mem_S
statement:
theorem chPn_mem_S (d : ℕ) {y : K0 (space k n)} (hy : uPn k n ^ (d + 1) * y = 0) :
    chPn k n y (fundPn k n) ∈ S (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k n) m) d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := exists_isRep k n y
  rw [← chFund_apply, hf]
  exact evTrunc_fundPn_mem_S_of_low k n d f (low_coeff_of_u_pow d hy hf)

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.chPn_component_eq_zero
statement:
theorem chPn_component_eq_zero (d m : ℕ) (hdm : d < m) {y : K0 (space k n)}
    (hy : uPn k n ^ (d + 1) * y = 0) :
    DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k n) m) m
      (chPn k n y (fundPn k n)) = 0
proof:
:=
  component_eq_zero_of_mem_S hdm (chPn_mem_S d hy)

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.tdChPn_mem_S
statement:
theorem tdChPn_mem_S (d : ℕ) {y : K0 (space k n)} (hy : uPn k n ^ (d + 1) * y = 0) :
    tdPn k n (chPn k n y (fundPn k n)) ∈ S (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k n) m) d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := exists_isRep k n y
  rw [← chFund_apply, hf, tdPn_evTrunc]
  exact evTrunc_fundPn_mem_S_of_low k n d _
    (fun j hj ↦ coeff_mul_eq_zero_of_low (N := j + 1)
      (fun i hi ↦ low_coeff_of_u_pow d hy hf i (by omega)) j (by omega))

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.tdChPn_component_eq_zero
statement:
theorem tdChPn_component_eq_zero (d m : ℕ) (hdm : d < m) {y : K0 (space k n)}
    (hy : uPn k n ^ (d + 1) * y = 0) :
    DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k n) m) m
      (tdPn k n (chPn k n y (fundPn k n))) = 0
proof:
:=
  component_eq_zero_of_mem_S hdm (tdChPn_mem_S d hy)

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.component_tdChPn_eq
statement:
theorem component_tdChPn_eq (d : ℕ) (hdn : d ≤ n) {y : K0 (space k n)}
    (hy : uPn k n ^ (d + 1) * y = 0) :
    DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k n) m) d
        (tdPn k n (chPn k n y (fundPn k n))) =
      DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k n) m) d
        (chPn k n y (fundPn k n))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := exists_isRep k n y
  have hlow : ∀ j < n - d, coeff j f = 0 := fun j hj ↦ low_coeff_of_u_pow d hy hf j (by omega)
  rw [← chFund_apply, hf, tdPn_evTrunc, component_evTrunc_fundPn k n _ d hdn, component_evTrunc_fundPn k n _ d hdn,
    coeff_mul_eq_of_low hlow (constantCoeff_tdSer_pow (n + 1))]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.degPn_evTrunc
statement:
theorem degPn_evTrunc (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) :
    degPn k n (evTrunc n (Hn k n) f (fundPn k n)) = coeff n f
proof:
:= by
  have := degPn_pow_evTrunc k n f 0 (Nat.zero_le n)
  rwa [pow_zero, Module.End.one_apply, Nat.sub_zero] at this

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.euler_eq_degPn
statement:
theorem euler_eq_degPn (hn : 0 < n) (x : K0 (space k n)) :
    ((eulerP k n hn (k0ToG0 (space k n) x) : ℤ) : ℚ) =
      degPn k n (tdPn k n (chPn k n x (fundPn k n)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [hrr_projectiveSpace_final k n hn, degT_spk_eq]
  rfl

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.euler_u_pow_eq_coeff
proof:
:= by
  have hlow : ∀ j < n - d, coeff j f = 0 := fun j hj ↦ low_coeff_of_u_pow d hy hf j (by omega)
  have h1 := isRep_u_pow_mul k n hf d
  unfold IsRep at h1
  rw [euler_eq_degPn k n hn, ← chFund_apply, h1, tdPn_evTrunc, degPn_evTrunc k n]
  have e : tdSer ^ (n + 1) * (X ^ d * eSer ^ d * f) = X ^ d * (tdSer ^ (n + 1) * eSer ^ d * f) := by
    ring
  rw [e, coeff_X_pow_mul', if_pos hdn]
  refine coeff_mul_eq_of_low hlow ?_
  rw [map_mul, constantCoeff_tdSer_pow, constantCoeff_eSer_pow, one_mul]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.degPn_H_pow_chPn
statement:
theorem degPn_H_pow_chPn (hn : 0 < n) (d : ℕ) (hdn : d ≤ n) {y : K0 (space k n)}
    (hy : uPn k n ^ (d + 1) * y = 0) :
    degPn k n (((Hn k n) ^ d) (chPn k n y (fundPn k n))) =
      ((eulerP k n hn (k0ToG0 (space k n) (uPn k n ^ d * y)) : ℤ) : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := exists_isRep k n y
  rw [euler_u_pow_eq_coeff hn d hdn hy hf]
  unfold IsRep at hf
  rw [← chFund_apply, hf, degPn_pow_evTrunc k n f d hdn]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.degPn_H_pow_tdChPn
statement:
theorem degPn_H_pow_tdChPn (hn : 0 < n) (d : ℕ) (hdn : d ≤ n) {y : K0 (space k n)}
    (hy : uPn k n ^ (d + 1) * y = 0) :
    degPn k n (((Hn k n) ^ d) (tdPn k n (chPn k n y (fundPn k n)))) =
      ((eulerP k n hn (k0ToG0 (space k n) (uPn k n ^ d * y)) : ℤ) : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := exists_isRep k n y
  have hlow : ∀ j < n - d, coeff j f = 0 := fun j hj ↦ low_coeff_of_u_pow d hy hf j (by omega)
  rw [euler_u_pow_eq_coeff hn d hdn hy hf]
  unfold IsRep at hf
  rw [← chFund_apply, hf, tdPn_evTrunc, degPn_pow_evTrunc k n _ d hdn,
    coeff_mul_eq_of_low hlow (constantCoeff_tdSer_pow (n + 1))]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.coeff_rescale_exp_mul
statement:
theorem coeff_rescale_exp_mul (d : ℕ) (hdn : d ≤ n) (A : ℚ⟦X⟧) (hA : ∀ j, j + d < n → coeff j A = 0)
    (m : ℚ) :
    coeff n (rescale m (exp ℚ) * A) =
      ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), coeff (n - b) A / (b.factorial : ℚ) * m ^ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_mul, Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ (fun i j ↦
    coeff i (rescale m (exp ℚ)) * coeff j A)]
  have hsub : Finset.range (d + 1) ⊆ Finset.range (n + 1) :=
    Finset.range_subset_range.mpr (by omega)
  have hz : ∀ b ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), b ∉ Finset.range (d + 1) →
      coeff b (rescale m (exp ℚ)) * coeff (n - b) A = 0 := by
    intro b hb hb'
    simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hb hb'
    rw [hA (n - b) (by omega), mul_zero]
  rw [← Finset.sum_subset hsub hz]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ ↦ ?_
  rw [coeff_rescale, coeff_exp]
  simp only [Algebra.algebraMap_self, RingHom.id_apply]
  ring

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.hilbertPoly_exists
statement:
theorem hilbertPoly_exists (hn : 0 < n) (d : ℕ) (hdn : d ≤ n) {y : K0 (space k n)}
    (hy : uPn k n ^ (d + 1) * y = 0) :
    ∃ p : Polynomial ℚ, p.natDegree ≤ d ∧
      (d.factorial : ℚ) * p.coeff d =
        ((eulerP k n hn (k0ToG0 (space k n) (uPn k n ^ d * y)) : ℤ) : ℚ) ∧
      ∀ m : ℤ, ((eulerP k n hn (k0ToG0 (space k n) (projectiveTwistingK0Class k n m * y)) : ℤ) :
        ℚ) = p.eval (m : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := exists_isRep k n y
  have hlow : ∀ j, j + d < n → coeff j f = 0 := low_coeff_of_u_pow d hy hf
  set A : ℚ⟦X⟧ := tdSer ^ (n + 1) * f with hAdef
  have hA : ∀ j, j + d < n → coeff j A = 0 := fun j hj ↦
    coeff_mul_eq_zero_of_low (N := j + 1) (fun i hi ↦ hlow i (by omega)) j (by omega)
  let p : Polynomial ℚ := ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (d + 1),
    Polynomial.C (coeff (n - b) A / (b.factorial : ℚ)) * Polynomial.X ^ b
  have hcoeff : ∀ i, p.coeff i = if i < d + 1 then coeff (n - i) A / (i.factorial : ℚ) else 0 := by
    intro i
    simp only [p, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X_pow]
    by_cases hi : i < d + 1
    · rw [if_pos hi, Finset.sum_eq_single i]
      · rw [if_pos rfl]
      · intro b _ hb; rw [if_neg (Ne.symm hb)]
      · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_range.mpr hi) h
    · rw [if_neg hi]
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun b hb ↦ ?_
      have : i ≠ b := fun h ↦ hi (h ▸ Finset.mem_range.mp hb)
      rw [if_neg this]
  refine ⟨p, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Polynomial.natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero]
    intro i hi
    rw [hcoeff, if_neg (by
      have : d < i := by exact_mod_cast hi
      omega)]
  · rw [hcoeff, if_pos (by omega), euler_u_pow_eq_coeff hn d hdn hy hf, hAdef,
      coeff_mul_eq_of_low (fun j hj ↦ hlow j (by omega)) (constantCoeff_tdSer_pow (n + 1))]
    have : (d.factorial : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.factorial_pos d).ne'
    field_simp
  · intro m
    have h1 := isRep_twist_mul k n m hf
    rw [euler_eq_degPn k n hn]
    unfold IsRep at h1
    rw [← chFund_apply, h1, tdPn_evTrunc, degPn_evTrunc k n]
    have e : tdSer ^ (n + 1) * (rescale (m : ℚ) (exp ℚ) * f) = rescale (m : ℚ) (exp ℚ) * A := by
      rw [hAdef]; ring
    rw [e, coeff_rescale_exp_mul d hdn A hA (m : ℚ)]
    simp only [p, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
      Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.Hn_pow_eq_lof_component
statement:
theorem Hn_pow_eq_lof_component (d : ℕ) {w : TotalChow (space k n)}
    (hw : w ∈ S (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k n) m) d) :
    ((Hn k n) ^ d) w = ((Hn k n) ^ d) (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k n) m) d
      (DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k n) m) d w))
proof:
:= by
  induction hw using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem w hw =>
    obtain ⟨j, hj, a, rfl⟩ := hw
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j d with hjd | hjd
    · rw [DirectSum.component.of, dif_neg (by omega), map_zero, map_zero,
        (lowersDeg_Hn k n).pow_apply_lof_zero j a d (by omega)]
    · obtain rfl : j = d := by omega
      rw [DirectSum.component.lof_self]
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy, map_add, map_add, map_add]
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [map_smul, hx, map_smul, map_smul, map_smul]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.cycPn_pushUnit_integral
statement:
theorem cycPn_pushUnit_integral {V : Scheme.{u}} (ι : V ⟶ space k n) [IsClosedImmersion ι]
    [IsIntegral V] [IsNoetherian V] (hF : IsCoherentLike (space k n) (pushUnit ι)) (d : ℕ)
    (hd : height (ι (genericPoint V)) = d) :
    cycPn k n (pushUnit ι) hF d =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k n) m) d
        ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (M7.dimPrimeCycle (ι (genericPoint V)) d hd) :
          DimChow (space k n) d))
proof:
:= by
  rw [cycPn, coherentCycle_pushUnit_integral ι hF d hd]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.chPn_leading_of_gate
statement:
theorem chPn_leading_of_gate (hn : 0 < n) (hG : LeadingCycleGate k n hn)
    (F : (space k n).Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike (space k n) F) (d : ℕ) (hdn : d ≤ n)
    (hdim : ∀ x ∈ moduleSheafSupport F, height x ≤ d) (y : K0 (space k n))
    (hy : k0ToG0 (space k n) y = g0ClassOf (space k n) F hF) :
    chFund k n y ∈ S (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k n) m) d ∧
      tdPn k n (chFund k n y) ∈ S (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k n) m) d ∧
      DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k n) m) d
          (tdPn k n (chFund k n y)) =
        DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k n) m) d (chFund k n y) ∧
      degPn k n (((Hn k n) ^ d) (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k n) m) d
          (DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k n) m) d (chFund k n y)))) =
        degPn k n (((Hn k n) ^ d) (cycPn k n F hF d))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hu, hχ⟩ := hG F hF d hdn hdim y hy
  refine ⟨chPn_mem_S d hu, tdChPn_mem_S d hu, component_tdChPn_eq d hdn hu, ?_⟩
  rw [chFund_apply, ← Hn_pow_eq_lof_component k n d (chPn_mem_S d hu), ← hχ]
  exact degPn_H_pow_chPn hn d hdn hu

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.finrank_projectiveLine_integer_H_one
statement:
theorem finrank_projectiveLine_integer_H_one (d : ℤ) :
    Module.finrank ℤ (Scheme.Modules.H (projectiveTwistingSheaf ℤ 1 d) 1) =
      (-d - 1).toNat
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hd : -1 ≤ d
  · haveI : Subsingleton (Scheme.Modules.H (projectiveTwistingSheaf ℤ 1 d) 1) :=
      AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf_H_isZero ℤ 1 d hd 0)
    rw [Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton]
    omega
  · let m := (-d - 2).toNat
    have he : d = -(m : ℤ) - 2 := by dsimp [m]; omega
    rw [he, finrank_projectiveLine_integer_H_one_negative]
    omega

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_line_negative
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_line_negative (m : ℕ) :
    projectiveTwistIntegerEuler 1 (-(m : ℤ) - 2) = -(m : ℤ) - 1
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Subsingleton
      (Scheme.Modules.H (projectiveTwistingSheaf ℤ 1 (-(m : ℤ) - 2)) 0) :=
    projectiveTwistingSheaf_H_zero_subsingleton_of_neg ℤ 1 (by omega) _ (by omega)
  have hz : Module.finrank ℤ
      (Scheme.Modules.H (projectiveTwistingSheaf ℤ 1 (-(m : ℤ) - 2)) 0) = 0 :=
    Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton
  rw [projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_eq_sum]
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, pow_zero, pow_one,
    one_mul, zero_add]
  rw [hz, finrank_projectiveLine_integer_H_one_negative]
  push_cast
  ring

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_line_all
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_line_all (d : ℤ) :
    projectiveTwistIntegerEuler 1 d = d + 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hd : -1 ≤ d
  · exact projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_line d hd
  · let m := (-d - 2).toNat
    have he : d = -(m : ℤ) - 2 := by dsimp [m]; omega
    rw [he, projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_line_negative]
    ring

  Scheme.Opens.ι_image_top _

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.chartOpen_isAffine
statement: theorem chartOpen_isAffine (i : Fin (n + 1)) : IsAffineOpen (chartOpen k n i)
proof:
:= by

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.exists_mem_chartOpen
statement: theorem exists_mem_chartOpen (x : space k n) : ∃ i, x ∈ chartOpen k n i
proof:

  rw [← coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top k n, TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup] at hx
