name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.chartVal_eq
statement:
theorem chartVal_eq (c : Fin (n + 1) → k) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    chartVal k n c i = ∑ j, (space k n).presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op (constSec k n (c j)) *
      coordVal k n j i
proof:
:= by
  have h := map_sum (evalAt (N := tensorUnitSheaf (space k n)) (chartOpen k n i) (frame k n i))
    (fun j ↦ coordSec k n j ≫ Koszul.mulHom (constSec k n (c j))) Finset.univ
  refine h.trans (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_)
  change (Koszul.mulHom (constSec k n (c j))).app _ ((coordSec k n j).app _ (frame k n i)) = _
  exact Koszul.mulHom_app_apply _ _ _

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.isUnit_app_one_of_isIso
statement:
theorem isUnit_app_one_of_isIso {Y : Scheme.{u}} (Φ : unitModules Y ⟶ unitModules Y) [IsIso Φ] :
    IsUnit (show Γ(Y, ⊤) from Φ.app ⊤ (oneSec Y ⊤))
proof:
:= by
  let a : Γ(Y, ⊤) := Φ.app ⊤ (oneSec Y ⊤)
  let b : Γ(Y, ⊤) := (inv Φ).app ⊤ (oneSec Y ⊤)
  have h1 : (show Γ(Y, ⊤) from Φ.app ⊤ b) = 1 := by
    change ((inv Φ) ≫ Φ).app ⊤ (oneSec Y ⊤) = oneSec Y ⊤
    rw [IsIso.inv_hom_id]
    rfl
  have h2 : (show Γ(Y, ⊤) from Φ.app ⊤ b) = b * a := by
    have hb : (show Γ(unitModules Y, ⊤) from b) = b • oneSec Y ⊤ := (mul_one b).symm
    exact (congrArg (Φ.app ⊤) hb).trans (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul Φ b (oneSec Y ⊤))
  exact IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one b (by rw [mul_comm]; exact h2.symm.trans h1)

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.isUnit_coordVal_self
statement: theorem isUnit_coordVal_self (i : Fin (n + 1)) : IsUnit (coordVal k n i i)
proof:
:= by
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen k n i).ι
  let Φ : unitModules (coordinateOpen k n i).toScheme ⟶ unitModules (coordinateOpen k n i).toScheme :=
    (projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateIso k n (-1) i).hom ≫ G.map (Koszul.X k n i (-1)) ≫
      G.map (projectiveTwistingZeroIso k n).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso (coordinateOpen k n i).ι).hom
  haveI := Koszul.X_restrict_isIso k n i (-1)
  haveI : IsIso Φ := by dsimp only [Φ]; infer_instance
  have h := isUnit_app_one_of_isIso Φ
  have hΦ : (show Γ((coordinateOpen k n i).toScheme, ⊤) from
      Φ.app ⊤ (oneSec _ ⊤)) = ((coordinateOpen k n i).ι.appIso ⊤).hom (coordVal k n i i) := rfl
  rw [hΦ] at h
  exact (MulEquiv.isUnit_map ((coordinateOpen k n i).ι.appIso ⊤).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.toMulEquiv).mp h

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.LengthFormula.length_ne_top_of_support_maximal
statement:
theorem length_ne_top_of_support_maximal (N : Type v) [AddCommGroup N] [Module B N]
    [hN : Module.Finite B N] (h : ∀ p ∈ Module.support B N, p.asIdeal.IsMaximal) :
    Module.length B N ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  revert h
  induction hN using IsNoetherianRing.induction_on_isQuotientEquivQuotientPrime B with
  | subsingleton N =>
    intro _
    rw [Module.length_eq_zero]
    exact ENat.zero_ne_top
  | quotient N p e =>
    intro h
    have hp : p ∈ Module.support B N := by
      rw [e.support_eq, Module.mem_support_iff_of_finite, Ideal.annihilator_quotient]
    haveI := h p hp
    haveI : IsSimpleModule B (B ⧸ p.asIdeal) :=
      isSimpleModule_iff_isCoatom.mpr (Ideal.isMaximal_def.mp inferInstance)
    rw [e.length_eq, Module.length_eq_one_iff.mpr inferInstance]
    exact ENat.one_ne_top
  | exact N₁ N₂ N₃ f g hf hg hfg h₁ h₃ =>
    intro h
    rw [Module.length_eq_add_of_exact f g hf hg hfg]
    exact WithTop.add_ne_top.mpr
      ⟨h₁ fun p hp ↦ h p (Module.support_subset_of_injective f hf hp),
        h₃ fun p hp ↦ h p (Module.support_subset_of_surjective g hg hp)⟩

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.LengthFormula.mem_of_mem_support_of_smul_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hbp
  exact (Module.notMem_support_iff'.mpr fun m ↦ ⟨b, hbp, hb m⟩) hp

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.LengthFormula.chi_ne_top
statement:
theorem chi_ne_top (N : Type v) [AddCommGroup N] [Module B N] [Module.Finite B N]
    (hfin : ∀ p ∈ Module.support B N, b ∈ p.asIdeal → p.asIdeal.IsMaximal) :
    chiKer b N ≠ ⊤ ∧ chiCoker b N ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · refine length_ne_top_of_support_maximal _ fun p hp ↦ ?_
    have hp' : p ∈ Module.support B N :=
      Module.support_subset_of_injective _ (Submodule.subtype_injective _) hp
    refine hfin p hp' (mem_of_mem_support_of_smul_eq_zero (fun m ↦ ?_) hp)
    exact Subtype.ext (LinearMap.mem_ker.mp m.2)
  · refine length_ne_top_of_support_maximal _ fun p hp ↦ ?_
    have hp' : p ∈ Module.support B N :=
      Module.support_subset_of_surjective _ (Submodule.mkQ_surjective _) hp
    refine hfin p hp' (mem_of_mem_support_of_smul_eq_zero (fun m ↦ ?_) hp)
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mkQ_surjective _ m
    rw [← map_smul, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    exact ⟨x, rfl⟩

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.LengthFormula.devissage_module
statement:
theorem devissage_module (S : Set (PrimeSpectrum B)) (T : Finset (PrimeSpectrum B))
    (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p ∈ T ∨ p.asIdeal.IsMaximal)
    (hTmin : ∀ q ∈ T, ∀ p ∈ S, p.asIdeal ≤ q.asIdeal → p = q)
    (hfin : ∀ p ∈ S, b ∈ p.asIdeal → p.asIdeal.IsMaximal)
    (N : Type v) [AddCommGroup N] [Module B N] [hN : Module.Finite B N]
    (hNS : Module.support B N ⊆ S) :
    chiCoker b N + ∑ q ∈ T, lengthAt q.asIdeal N * chiKer b (B ⧸ q.asIdeal) =
      chiKer b N + ∑ q ∈ T, lengthAt q.asIdeal N * chiCoker b (B ⧸ q.asIdeal)
proof:
:= by
  revert hNS
  induction hN using IsNoetherianRing.induction_on_isQuotientEquivQuotientPrime B with
  | subsingleton N =>
    intro _
    rw [chiCoker_eq_zero, chiKer_eq_zero]
    simp only [lengthAt_eq_zero_of_subsingleton, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  | quotient N p e =>
    intro hNS
    have hpS : p ∈ S := hNS (by
      rw [e.support_eq, Module.mem_support_iff_of_finite, Ideal.annihilator_quotient])
    rw [chiCoker_congr b e, chiKer_congr b e]
    have hlen : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B, lengthAt q.asIdeal N = lengthAt q.asIdeal (B ⧸ p.asIdeal) :=
      fun q ↦ lengthAt_congr q.asIdeal e
    simp only [hlen]
    have hzero : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B, ¬ (p.asIdeal ≤ q.asIdeal) →
        lengthAt q.asIdeal (B ⧸ p.asIdeal) = 0 := by
      intro q hq
      obtain ⟨t, htp, htq⟩ := SetLike.not_le_iff_exists.1 hq
      exact lengthAt_eq_zero _ htq fun m ↦ smul_quotient_eq_zero htp m
    by_cases hpT : p ∈ T
    · have hsum : ∀ g : PrimeSpectrum B → ℕ∞,
          ∑ q ∈ T, lengthAt q.asIdeal (B ⧸ p.asIdeal) * g q = g p := by
        intro g
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single p]
        · rw [lengthAt_quotient_self, one_mul]
        · intro q hqT hqne
          refine (congrArg (· * g q) (hzero q fun hle ↦ hqne ?_)).trans (zero_mul _)
          exact (hTmin q hqT p hpS hle).symm
        · intro h; exact absurd hpT h
      rw [hsum, hsum, add_comm]
    · have hmax : p.asIdeal.IsMaximal := (hS p hpS).resolve_left hpT
      have hsum : ∀ g : PrimeSpectrum B → ℕ∞,
          ∑ q ∈ T, lengthAt q.asIdeal (B ⧸ p.asIdeal) * g q = 0 := by
        intro g
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun q hqT ↦ ?_
        refine (congrArg (· * g q) (hzero q fun hle ↦ ?_)).trans (zero_mul _)
        exact hpT (hTmin q hqT p hpS hle ▸ hqT)
      rw [hsum, hsum, add_zero, add_zero]
      exact chi_eq_of_isMaximal b p.asIdeal
  | exact N₁ N₂ N₃ f g hf hg hfg h₁ h₃ =>
    intro hNS
    have hS₁ : Module.support B N₁ ⊆ S := (Module.support_subset_of_injective f hf).trans hNS
    have hS₃ : Module.support B N₃ ⊆ S := (Module.support_subset_of_surjective g hg).trans hNS
    have E₁ := h₁ hS₁
    have E₃ := h₃ hS₃
    
    let P : Submodule B N₂ := LinearMap.range f
    let e₁ : N₁ ≃ₗ[B] P := LinearEquiv.ofInjective f hf
    have hker : LinearMap.ker g = P := hfg.linearMap_ker_eq
    let e₃ : (N₂ ⧸ P) ≃ₗ[B] N₃ :=
      (Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ hker.symm).trans (g.quotKerEquivOfSurjective hg)
    have hSES := chi_add_submodule b P
    rw [← chiKer_congr b e₁, ← chiCoker_congr b e₁, chiKer_congr b e₃, chiCoker_congr b e₃]
      at hSES
    have hlen : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B,
        lengthAt q.asIdeal N₂ = lengthAt q.asIdeal N₁ + lengthAt q.asIdeal N₃ := by
      intro q
      rw [lengthAt_add q.asIdeal P, lengthAt_congr q.asIdeal e₁.symm,
        lengthAt_congr q.asIdeal e₃]
    have hfin₁ := (chi_ne_top b N₁ fun p hp hb ↦ hfin p (hS₁ hp) hb).1
    have hfin₃ := (chi_ne_top b N₃ fun p hp hb ↦ hfin p (hS₃ hp) hb).1
    simp only [hlen, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine enat_add_right_cancel (z := chiKer b N₁ + chiKer b N₃)
      (WithTop.add_ne_top.mpr ⟨hfin₁, hfin₃⟩) ?_
    set K₁ := ∑ q ∈ T, lengthAt q.asIdeal N₁ * chiKer b (B ⧸ q.asIdeal)
    set K₃ := ∑ q ∈ T, lengthAt q.asIdeal N₃ * chiKer b (B ⧸ q.asIdeal)
    set C₁ := ∑ q ∈ T, lengthAt q.asIdeal N₁ * chiCoker b (B ⧸ q.asIdeal)
    set C₃ := ∑ q ∈ T, lengthAt q.asIdeal N₃ * chiCoker b (B ⧸ q.asIdeal)
    calc chiCoker b N₂ + (K₁ + K₃) + (chiKer b N₁ + chiKer b N₃)
        = (chiCoker b N₂ + chiKer b N₁ + chiKer b N₃) + K₁ + K₃ := by ring
      _ = (chiKer b N₂ + chiCoker b N₁ + chiCoker b N₃) + K₁ + K₃ := by rw [hSES]
      _ = chiKer b N₂ + (chiCoker b N₁ + K₁) + (chiCoker b N₃ + K₃) := by ring
      _ = chiKer b N₂ + (chiKer b N₁ + C₁) + (chiKer b N₃ + C₃) := by rw [E₁, E₃]
      _ = chiKer b N₂ + (C₁ + C₃) + (chiKer b N₁ + chiKer b N₃) := by ring

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.LengthFormula.chiCoker_eq_sum
statement:
theorem chiCoker_eq_sum (S : Set (PrimeSpectrum B)) (T : Finset (PrimeSpectrum B))
    (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p ∈ T ∨ p.asIdeal.IsMaximal)
    (hTmin : ∀ q ∈ T, ∀ p ∈ S, p.asIdeal ≤ q.asIdeal → p = q)
    (hfin : ∀ p ∈ S, b ∈ p.asIdeal → p.asIdeal.IsMaximal)
    (hbT : ∀ q ∈ T, b ∉ q.asIdeal)
    (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [Module.Finite B M]
    (hMS : Module.support B M ⊆ S) (hb : chiKer b M = 0) :
    chiCoker b M = ∑ q ∈ T, lengthAt q.asIdeal M * chiCoker b (B ⧸ q.asIdeal)
proof:
:= by
  have h := devissage_module b S T hS hTmin hfin M hMS
  have hq : ∀ q ∈ T, chiKer b (B ⧸ q.asIdeal) = 0 := fun q hqT ↦
    chiKer_quotient_prime_eq_zero q.asIdeal (hbT q hqT)
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q hqT ↦ by rw [hq q hqT, mul_zero], Finset.sum_const_zero,
    add_zero, hb, zero_add] at h
  exact h

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.LengthFormula.chiCoker_eq_sum_ord
statement:
theorem chiCoker_eq_sum_ord (S : Set (PrimeSpectrum B)) (T : Finset (PrimeSpectrum B))
    (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p ∈ T ∨ p.asIdeal.IsMaximal)
    (hTmin : ∀ q ∈ T, ∀ p ∈ S, p.asIdeal ≤ q.asIdeal → p = q)
    (hfin : ∀ p ∈ S, b ∈ p.asIdeal → p.asIdeal.IsMaximal)
    (hbT : ∀ q ∈ T, b ∉ q.asIdeal)
    (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [Module.Finite B M]
    (hMS : Module.support B M ⊆ S) (hb : chiKer b M = 0) :
    chiCoker b M = ∑ q ∈ T, lengthAt q.asIdeal M *
      Ring.ord (B ⧸ q.asIdeal) (Ideal.Quotient.mk q.asIdeal b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chiCoker_eq_sum b S T hS hTmin hfin hbT M hMS hb]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ ↦ by rw [chiCoker_quotient_ord]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.finrank_integer_degreePiece_eq_choose
statement:
theorem finrank_integer_degreePiece_eq_choose (n d : ℕ) :
    Module.finrank ℤ (degreePiece ℤ n d) = (d + n).choose n
proof:
:= by
  change Module.finrank ℤ (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) ℤ d) = _
  rw [LinearEquiv.finrank_eq
    (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmoduleEquivFinsupp (Fin (n + 1)) ℤ d)]
  haveI : Finite {m : Fin (n + 1) →₀ ℕ | m.degree = d} :=
    Finsupp.finite_setOf_degree_eq (Fin (n + 1)) d
  haveI : Fintype {m : Fin (n + 1) →₀ ℕ | m.degree = d} := Fintype.ofFinite _
  rw [Module.finrank_finsupp_self, ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  exact card_degree_eq_choose n d

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingSheaf_integer_H_zero_free
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingSheaf_integer_H_zero_free (n d : ℕ) :
    Module.Free ℤ (Scheme.Modules.H (projectiveTwistingSheaf ℤ n (d : ℤ)) 0)
proof:
:= by
  exact Module.Free.of_equiv
    (projectiveTwistingSheafIntegerHZeroLinearEquivDegreePiece n d).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingSheaf_integer_H_zero_finite
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingSheaf_integer_H_zero_finite (n d : ℕ) :
    Module.Finite ℤ (Scheme.Modules.H (projectiveTwistingSheaf ℤ n (d : ℤ)) 0)
proof:
:= by
  exact Module.Finite.equiv
    (projectiveTwistingSheafIntegerHZeroLinearEquivDegreePiece n d).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.finrank_projectiveTwistingSheaf_integer_H_zero
statement:
theorem finrank_projectiveTwistingSheaf_integer_H_zero (n d : ℕ) :
    Module.finrank ℤ (Scheme.Modules.H (projectiveTwistingSheaf ℤ n (d : ℤ)) 0) =
      (d + n).choose n
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearEquiv.finrank_eq (projectiveTwistingSheafIntegerHZeroLinearEquivDegreePiece n d),
    finrank_integer_degreePiece_eq_choose]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_nat
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_nat (n d : ℕ) :
    projectiveTwistIntegerEuler n (d : ℤ) = ((d + n).choose n : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold projectiveTwistIntegerEuler
  rw [finsum_eq_single _ 0]
  · simp only [pow_zero, one_mul]
    rw [finrank_projectiveTwistingSheaf_integer_H_zero]
  · intro q hq
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hq
    haveI : Subsingleton (Scheme.Modules.H (projectiveTwistingSheaf ℤ n (d : ℤ)) (p + 1)) :=
      AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf_H_isZero ℤ n (d : ℤ) (by omega) p)
    simp [Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_of_neg
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_of_neg (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (d : ℤ)
    (hd : -(n : ℤ) ≤ d) (hd0 : d < 0) :
    projectiveTwistIntegerEuler n d = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold projectiveTwistIntegerEuler
  refine finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero fun q ↦ ?_
  cases q with
  | zero =>
      haveI := projectiveTwistingSheaf_H_zero_subsingleton_of_neg ℤ n hn d hd0
      simp [Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton]
  | succ p =>
      haveI : Subsingleton (Scheme.Modules.H (projectiveTwistingSheaf ℤ n d) (p + 1)) :=
        AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf_H_isZero ℤ n d hd p)
      simp [Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingSheaf_integer_H_vanishes
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingSheaf_integer_H_vanishes (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (q : ℕ)
    (hq : n < q) :
    Subsingleton (Scheme.Modules.H (projectiveTwistingSheaf ℤ n d) q)
proof:
:= by
  letI := projectiveTwistingSheaf_isQuasicoherent ℤ n d
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : q ≠ 0)
  exact AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero
    (quasicoherent_sheafH_isZero_of_dimension ℤ n
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf ℤ n d) p (by omega))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_eq_sum
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_eq_sum (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) :
    projectiveTwistIntegerEuler n d =
      ∑ q ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ q *
        (Module.finrank ℤ (Scheme.Modules.H (projectiveTwistingSheaf ℤ n d) q) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold projectiveTwistIntegerEuler
  apply finsum_eq_finsetSum_of_support_subset
  intro q hq
  simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_range]
  by_contra h
  haveI := projectiveTwistingSheaf_integer_H_vanishes n d q (by omega)
  apply hq
  simp [Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_line
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_line (d : ℤ) (hd : -1 ≤ d) :
    projectiveTwistIntegerEuler 1 d = d + 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hd0 : 0 ≤ d
  · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le hd0
    rw [projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_nat]
    simp
  · have heq : d = -1 := by omega
    subst d
    rw [projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_of_neg 1 (by omega) (-1) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
    norm_num

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_plane
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_plane (d : ℤ) (hd : -2 ≤ d) :
    2 * projectiveTwistIntegerEuler 2 d = (d + 1) * (d + 2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl | rfl⟩ := Int.eq_nat_or_neg d
  · rw [projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_nat 2 m, Nat.choose_two_right]
    have h2 : 2 ∣ (m + 2) * (m + 2 - 1) := by
      rw [show m + 2 - 1 = m + 1 by omega]
      exact (Nat.even_mul_succ_self (m + 1)).two_dvd |>.trans (by
        rw [show m + 1 + 1 = m + 2 by omega, mul_comm])
    have : ((((m + 2) * (m + 2 - 1) / 2 : ℕ)) : ℤ) * 2 =
        ((m + 2) * (m + 2 - 1) : ℕ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.div_mul_cancel h2
    rw [mul_comm, this, show m + 2 - 1 = m + 1 by omega]
    push_cast
    ring
  · have hm : m = 0 ∨ m = 1 ∨ m = 2 := by omega
    rcases hm with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · have h0 := projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_nat 2 0
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero] at h0 ⊢
      rw [h0]
      decide
    · rw [projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_of_neg 2 (by norm_num) _ (by norm_num)
        (by norm_num)]
      norm_num
    · rw [projectiveTwistIntegerEuler_of_neg 2 (by norm_num) _ (by norm_num)
        (by norm_num)]
      norm_num

name: SchemeHirzebruchRiemannRoch.rationalEuler_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rationalEuler_classOf
    (hfinite : ∀ (E : X.Modules), SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X E →
      E.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (E : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X M}) :
    rationalEuler k hfinite
        (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ (ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules
          (SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X)) E) = E.1.eulerChar k
proof:
:= by
  simp [rationalEuler, SchemeKTheory.k0Euler]

name: SchemeHirzebruchRiemannRoch.rationalEuler_eq_rationalG0Euler_comp_k0ToG0
statement:
theorem rationalEuler_eq_rationalG0Euler_comp_k0ToG0
    (hfinite : ∀ (E : X.Modules), E.IsFinitePresentation →
      E.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k) :
    rationalEuler k (fun E hE ↦ hfinite E hE.isFinitePresentation) =
      (Int.castAddHom ℚ).comp
        ((SchemeKTheory.g0Euler k hfinite).comp (SchemeKTheory.k0ToG0 X))
proof:
:= by
  rw [SchemeKTheory.g0Euler_comp_k0ToG0]
  rfl

name: SchemeHirzebruchRiemannRoch.characteristicNumber_comp_k0ToG0
statement:
theorem characteristicNumber_comp_k0ToG0
    (chernG : SchemeKTheory.G0 X →+ A) (toddClass : A) (integral : A →+ ℚ) :
    HirzebruchRiemannRoch.characteristicNumber
        (chernG.comp (SchemeKTheory.k0ToG0 X)) toddClass integral =
      (HirzebruchRiemannRoch.characteristicNumber chernG toddClass integral).comp
        (SchemeKTheory.k0ToG0 X)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SchemeHirzebruchRiemannRoch.hom_eq_of_g0_formula
statement:
theorem hom_eq_of_g0_formula
    (hfinite : ∀ (E : X.Modules), E.IsFinitePresentation →
      E.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (chernG : SchemeKTheory.G0 X →+ A) (toddClass : A) (integral : A →+ ℚ)
    (hG0 : (Int.castAddHom ℚ).comp (SchemeKTheory.g0Euler k hfinite) =
      HirzebruchRiemannRoch.characteristicNumber chernG toddClass integral) :
    rationalEuler k (fun E hE ↦ hfinite E hE.isFinitePresentation) =
      HirzebruchRiemannRoch.characteristicNumber
        (chernG.comp (SchemeKTheory.k0ToG0 X)) toddClass integral
proof:
:= by
  rw [rationalEuler_eq_rationalG0Euler_comp_k0ToG0,
    characteristicNumber_comp_k0ToG0]
  ext z
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hG0
    (SchemeKTheory.k0ToG0 X (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ z))

name: SchemeHirzebruchRiemannRoch.hom_eq_of_vectorBundle_classes
statement:
theorem hom_eq_of_vectorBundle_classes
    (hfinite : ∀ (E : X.Modules), SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X E →
      E.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (chernCharacter : SchemeKTheory.K0 X →+ A)
    (toddClass : A) (integral : A →+ ℚ)
    (hbundle : ∀ E : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X M},
      (E.1.eulerChar k : ℚ) =
        integral (chernCharacter
          (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ (ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules
            (SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X)) E) * toddClass)) :
    rationalEuler k hfinite =
      HirzebruchRiemannRoch.characteristicNumber chernCharacter toddClass integral
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _
  intro E
  rw [rationalEuler_classOf]
  exact hbundle E

name: SchemeHirzebruchRiemannRoch.formula_of_vectorBundle_classes
statement:
theorem formula_of_vectorBundle_classes
    (hfinite : ∀ (E : X.Modules), SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X E →
      E.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (chernCharacter : SchemeKTheory.K0 X →+ A)
    (toddClass : A) (integral : A →+ ℚ)
    (hbundle : ∀ E : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X M},
      (E.1.eulerChar k : ℚ) =
        integral (chernCharacter
          (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ (ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules
            (SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X)) E) * toddClass))
    (z : SchemeKTheory.K0 X) :
    (SchemeKTheory.k0Euler k hfinite z : ℚ) =
      integral (chernCharacter z * toddClass)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun f : SchemeKTheory.K0 X →+ ℚ => f z)
    (hom_eq_of_vectorBundle_classes k hfinite chernCharacter toddClass integral hbundle)
  exact h

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.spec_stalk_surj
statement:
theorem spec_stalk_surj (m : (moduleStalkFunctorLinear (Spec R) y).obj M) :
    ∃ (n : Γ(M, ⊤)) (s : R), s ∉ y.asIdeal ∧
      (Spec R).presheaf.germ ⊤ y trivial ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv s) • m =
        TopCat.Presheaf.germ M.val.presheaf ⊤ y trivial n
proof:
:= by
  let N : ModuleCat.{u} R := (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj M).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤)
  haveI : IsIso M.fromTildeΓ := Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent M
  let e : tilde N ≅ M := asIso M.fromTildeΓ
  letI : Algebra R ((Spec R).presheaf.stalk y) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Algebra R ((Spec.structureSheaf R).presheaf.stalk y))
  letI : Module R ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear (Spec R) y).obj (tilde N)) :=
    inferInstanceAs
      (Module R ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (moduleStructurePresheaf R N).presheaf y))
  haveI : IsScalarTower R ((Spec R).presheaf.stalk y)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear (Spec R) y).obj (tilde N)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsScalarTower R ((structurePresheafInCommRingCat R).stalk y)
      ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (moduleStructurePresheaf R N).presheaf y))
  let g : N →ₗ[R] ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear (Spec R) y).obj (tilde N)) :=
    StructureSheaf.toStalkₗ R N y
  haveI : IsLocalizedModule y.asIdeal.primeCompl g :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsLocalizedModule y.asIdeal.primeCompl (StructureSheaf.toStalkₗ R N y))
  let φ := ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear (Spec R) y).mapIso e).toLinearEquiv
  obtain ⟨⟨n, s⟩, hs⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.surj y.asIdeal.primeCompl g (φ.symm m)
  have hga : algebraMap R ((Spec R).presheaf.stalk y) s =
      (Spec R).presheaf.germ ⊤ y trivial ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv s) := rfl
  refine ⟨e.hom.app ⊤ (tilde.toOpen N ⊤ n), s, s.2, ?_⟩
  have h1 : φ (g n) = TopCat.Presheaf.germ M.val.presheaf ⊤ y trivial
      (e.hom.app ⊤ (tilde.toOpen N ⊤ n)) :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply ⊤ y trivial
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map e.hom.val) (tilde.toOpen N ⊤ n)
  have h2 : φ ((s : R) • φ.symm m) =
      (Spec R).presheaf.germ ⊤ y trivial ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv s) • m := by
    rw [← algebraMap_smul ((Spec R).presheaf.stalk y) (s : R) (φ.symm m), φ.map_smul,
      φ.apply_symm_apply, hga]
  exact h2.symm.trans ((congrArg φ hs).trans h1)

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.fromTildeΓ_toOpen_top
statement:
theorem fromTildeΓ_toOpen_top (n : Γ(M, ⊤)) :
    M.fromTildeΓ.app ⊤ (tilde.toOpen ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj M).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤)) ⊤ n) =
      n
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ.hom n) (Scheme.Modules.toOpen_fromTildeΓ_app M ⊤)
  refine h.trans ?_
  change (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj M).1.map (𝟙 _) n = n
  rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
  rfl

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.spec_stalk_ker
statement:
theorem spec_stalk_ker (n : Γ(M, ⊤)) (h : TopCat.Presheaf.germ M.val.presheaf ⊤ y trivial n = 0) :
    ∃ s : R, s ∉ y.asIdeal ∧ s • n = 0
proof:
:= by
  let N : ModuleCat.{u} R := (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj M).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤)
  haveI : IsIso M.fromTildeΓ := Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent M
  let e : tilde N ≅ M := asIso M.fromTildeΓ
  letI : Algebra R ((Spec R).presheaf.stalk y) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Algebra R ((Spec.structureSheaf R).presheaf.stalk y))
  letI : Module R ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear (Spec R) y).obj (tilde N)) :=
    inferInstanceAs
      (Module R ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (moduleStructurePresheaf R N).presheaf y))
  let g : N →ₗ[R] ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear (Spec R) y).obj (tilde N)) :=
    StructureSheaf.toStalkₗ R N y
  haveI : IsLocalizedModule y.asIdeal.primeCompl g :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsLocalizedModule y.asIdeal.primeCompl (StructureSheaf.toStalkₗ R N y))
  let φ := ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear (Spec R) y).mapIso e).toLinearEquiv
  have h1 : φ (g n) = TopCat.Presheaf.germ M.val.presheaf ⊤ y trivial n := by
    have := TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply ⊤ y trivial
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map e.hom.val) (tilde.toOpen N ⊤ n)
    exact this.trans (congrArg _ (fromTildeΓ_toOpen_top M n))
  have hg : g n = g 0 := by
    rw [map_zero]
    apply φ.injective
    exact (h1.trans h).trans (map_zero φ).symm
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.exists_of_eq (S := y.asIdeal.primeCompl) hg
  refine ⟨c, c.2, ?_⟩
  rw [smul_zero] at hc
  exact hc

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.isUnit_germ_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem isUnit_germ_of_not_mem {y : Spec Γ(X, U)} (hx : hU.fromSpec y ∈ U) {s : Γ(X, U)}
    (hs : s ∉ y.asIdeal) : IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ U (hU.fromSpec y) hx s)
proof:
:= by
  have key : hU.fromSpec.stalkMap y (X.presheaf.germ U (hU.fromSpec y) hx s) =
      (Spec Γ(X, U)).presheaf.germ ⊤ y trivial ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv s) := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply, hU.fromSpec_app_self_apply]
    exact (Spec Γ(X, U)).presheaf.germ_res_apply _ y _ _
  have hu : IsUnit ((Spec Γ(X, U)).presheaf.germ ⊤ y trivial ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv s)) :=
    IsLocalization.map_units (M := y.asIdeal.primeCompl)
      ((Spec.structureSheaf Γ(X, U)).presheaf.stalk y) ⟨s, hs⟩
  rw [← key] at hu
  exact (isUnit_map_iff (asIso (hU.fromSpec.stalkMap y)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv _).mp hu

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.stalk_surj_affine
statement:
theorem stalk_surj_affine {x : X} (hx : x ∈ U) (e : (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj F) :
    ∃ (n : Γ(F, U)) (s : Γ(X, U)), IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ U x hx s) ∧
      X.presheaf.germ U x hx s • e = F.presheaf.germ U x hx n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ : ∃ y, hU.fromSpec y = x :=
    ⟨hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩, hU.fromSpec_primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩⟩
  let f := hU.fromSpec
  let M := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj F
  letI := Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkModule f y F
  let E := Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkLinearEquiv f y F
  obtain ⟨n, s, hs, hsm⟩ := spec_stalk_surj M y (E.symm e)
  have hU' : f ''ᵁ ⊤ = U := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange, hU.opensRange_fromSpec]
  have hxU' : f y ∈ f ''ᵁ ⊤ := by simp
  have key : f.stalkMap y (X.presheaf.germ U (f y) hx s) =
      (Spec Γ(X, U)).presheaf.germ ⊤ y trivial ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv s) := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply, hU.fromSpec_app_self_apply]
    exact (Spec Γ(X, U)).presheaf.germ_res_apply _ y _ _
  refine ⟨F.presheaf.map (eqToHom hU'.symm).op n, s, isUnit_germ_of_not_mem hU hx hs, ?_⟩
  have h1 : E (TopCat.Presheaf.germ M.val.presheaf ⊤ y trivial n) =
      F.presheaf.germ (f ''ᵁ ⊤) (f y) hxU' n :=
    Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkLinearEquiv_germ f y F ⊤ trivial n
  have h2 : F.presheaf.germ U (f y) hx (F.presheaf.map (eqToHom hU'.symm).op n) =
      F.presheaf.germ (f ''ᵁ ⊤) (f y) hxU' n :=
    F.presheaf.germ_res_apply (eqToHom hU'.symm) (f y) hx n
  have h3 : X.presheaf.germ U (f y) hx s • e = E ((Spec Γ(X, U)).presheaf.germ ⊤ y trivial
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv s) • E.symm e) := by
    rw [← key]
    change _ = E (X.presheaf.germ U (f y) hx s • E.symm e)
    rw [E.map_smul, E.apply_symm_apply]
    rfl
  exact h3.trans ((congrArg E hsm).trans (h1.trans h2.symm))

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.stalk_ker_affine
statement:
theorem stalk_ker_affine {x : X} (hx : x ∈ U) (n : Γ(F, U))
    (h : F.presheaf.germ U x hx n = 0) :
    ∃ s : Γ(X, U), IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ U x hx s) ∧
      ∀ (z : X) (hz : z ∈ U), X.presheaf.germ U z hz s • mgerm F U z hz n = 0
proof:
:= by
  let f := hU.fromSpec
  let M := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj F
  have hU' : f ''ᵁ ⊤ = U := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange, hU.opensRange_fromSpec]
  let n' : Γ(M, ⊤) := F.presheaf.map (eqToHom hU').op n
  
  have hgerm : ∀ (z' : Spec Γ(X, U)) (hz : f z' ∈ U),
      (letI := Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkModule f z' F
       Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkLinearEquiv f z' F
        (TopCat.Presheaf.germ M.val.presheaf ⊤ z' trivial n')) =
        F.presheaf.germ U (f z') hz n := by
    intro z' hz
    letI := Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkModule f z' F
    have hxU' : f z' ∈ f ''ᵁ ⊤ := by simp
    refine (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkLinearEquiv_germ f z' F ⊤ trivial n').trans ?_
    exact F.presheaf.germ_res_apply (eqToHom hU').op.unop (f z') hxU' n
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ : ∃ y, f y = x := ⟨hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩, hU.fromSpec_primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩⟩
  have hy0 : TopCat.Presheaf.germ M.val.presheaf ⊤ y trivial n' = 0 := by
    letI := Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkModule f y F
    apply (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkLinearEquiv f y F).injective
    exact (hgerm y hx).trans (h.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsn⟩ := spec_stalk_ker M y n' hy0
  refine ⟨s, isUnit_germ_of_not_mem hU hx hs, fun z hz ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨z', rfl⟩ : ∃ z', f z' = z := ⟨hU.primeIdealOf ⟨z, hz⟩, hU.fromSpec_primeIdealOf ⟨z, hz⟩⟩
  letI := Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkModule f z' F
  let E := Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkLinearEquiv f z' F
  have key : f.stalkMap z' (X.presheaf.germ U (f z') hz s) =
      (Spec Γ(X, U)).presheaf.germ ⊤ z' trivial ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv s) := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply, hU.fromSpec_app_self_apply]
    exact (Spec Γ(X, U)).presheaf.germ_res_apply _ z' _ _
  have hsm : mgerm M ⊤ z' trivial (s • n') =
      (Spec Γ(X, U)).presheaf.germ ⊤ z' trivial ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv s) •
        mgerm M ⊤ z' trivial n' := by
    rw [Scheme.Modules.smul_Spec_def]
    exact (PresheafOfModules.germ_smul (R := (Spec Γ(X, U)).presheaf) M.val z' ⊤ trivial _ n').trans
      (congrArg (· • mgerm M ⊤ z' trivial n')
        ((Spec Γ(X, U)).presheaf.germ_res_apply _ z' _ _))
  have hw : mgerm M ⊤ z' trivial n' = E.symm (mgerm F U (f z') hz n) :=
    (E.symm_apply_apply _).symm.trans (congrArg E.symm (hgerm z' hz))
  have h4 : X.presheaf.germ U (f z') hz s • E.symm (mgerm F U (f z') hz n) =
      (Spec Γ(X, U)).presheaf.germ ⊤ z' trivial ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv s) •
        mgerm M ⊤ z' trivial n' := by
    rw [hw, ← key]
    rfl
  have h5 : X.presheaf.germ U (f z') hz s • mgerm F U (f z') hz n =
      E (X.presheaf.germ U (f z') hz s • E.symm (mgerm F U (f z') hz n)) := by
    rw [E.map_smul, E.apply_symm_apply]
    rfl
  rw [h5, h4, ← hsm, hsn]
  exact (congrArg E (map_zero (TopCat.Presheaf.germ M.val.presheaf ⊤ z' trivial).hom)).trans
    (map_zero E)

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.mspec_germ
statement:
theorem mspec_germ {U : X.Opens} (hy : y ∈ U) (n : Γ(F, U)) :
    mspec F h (mgerm F U y hy n) = mgerm F U x (h.mem_open U.isOpen hy) n
proof:
:=
  TopCat.Presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes_apply F.presheaf hy h n

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.mspec_smul
statement:
theorem mspec_smul (b : X.presheaf.stalk y) (m : (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X y).obj F) :
    mspec F h (b • m) = (X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom b • mspec F h m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hyV, n, rfl⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.exists_germ_eq F.val.presheaf m
  obtain ⟨W, hyW, r, rfl⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.exists_germ_eq X.presheaf b
  let T : X.Opens := V ⊓ W
  have hyT : y ∈ T := ⟨hyV, hyW⟩
  have hxT : x ∈ T := h.mem_open T.isOpen hyT
  have e1 : TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf V y hyV n = mgerm F T y hyT
      (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left : T ⟶ V).op n) :=
    (F.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE inf_le_left) y hyT n).symm
  have e2 : X.presheaf.germ W y hyW r =
      X.presheaf.germ T y hyT (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_right : T ⟶ W).op r) :=
    (X.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE inf_le_right) y hyT r).symm
  rw [e1, e2]
  set n' := F.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left : T ⟶ V).op n
  set r' := X.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_right : T ⟶ W).op r
  have g1 : X.presheaf.germ T y hyT r' • mgerm F T y hyT n' = mgerm F T y hyT (r' • n') :=
    (PresheafOfModules.germ_smul (R := X.presheaf) F.val y T hyT r' n').symm
  have g2 : X.presheaf.germ T x hxT r' • mgerm F T x hxT n' = mgerm F T x hxT (r' • n') :=
    (PresheafOfModules.germ_smul (R := X.presheaf) F.val x T hxT r' n').symm
  rw [g1, mspec_germ, mspec_germ, X.presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes_apply hyT h r']
  exact g2.symm

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.mem_primeCompl_iff
statement:
theorem mem_primeCompl_iff (b : X.presheaf.stalk y) :
    b ∈ (Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h).primeCompl ↔
      IsUnit ((X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom b)
proof:
:= by
  change b ∉ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h ↔ _
  rw [Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes, Ideal.mem_comap, IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.mspec_isLocalizedModule
statement:
theorem mspec_isLocalizedModule [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    letI
proof:
:= specModule F h
    IsLocalizedModule (Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h).primeCompl (mspecLinear F h) := by
  letI := specModule F h
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨U, hU, rfl⟩, hyU, -⟩ :=
    X.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open (Set.mem_univ y) isOpen_univ
  have hxU : x ∈ U := h.mem_open U.isOpen hyU
  have hspec : ∀ r : Γ(X, U), (X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom (X.presheaf.germ U y hyU r) =
      X.presheaf.germ U x hxU r := fun r ↦ X.presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes_apply hyU h r
  refine ⟨fun c ↦ ?_, fun e ↦ ?_, fun {a b} hab ↦ ?_⟩
  · 
    have hu := (mem_primeCompl_iff h c).mp c.2
    rw [Module.End.isUnit_iff]
    refine ⟨fun m₁ m₂ hm ↦ hu.smul_left_cancel.mp hm, fun m ↦
      ⟨((hu.unit⁻¹ : (X.presheaf.stalk x)ˣ) : X.presheaf.stalk x) • m, ?_⟩⟩
    change (X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom c •
      (((hu.unit⁻¹ : (X.presheaf.stalk x)ˣ) : X.presheaf.stalk x) • m) = m
    rw [smul_smul, IsUnit.mul_val_inv, one_smul]
  · 
    obtain ⟨n, r, hr, hrn⟩ := stalk_surj_affine F hU hxU e
    refine ⟨⟨mgerm F U y hyU n, ⟨X.presheaf.germ U y hyU r, ?_⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [mem_primeCompl_iff, hspec]
      exact hr
    · change (X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom (X.presheaf.germ U y hyU r) • e =
        mspec F h (mgerm F U y hyU n)
      rw [hspec, mspec_germ]
      exact hrn
  · 
    have hd : mspec F h (a - b) = 0 := by
      change mspecLinear F h (a - b) = 0
      rw [map_sub, sub_eq_zero]
      exact hab
    obtain ⟨n, u, hu, hun⟩ := stalk_surj_affine F hU hyU (a - b)
    have hn0 : F.presheaf.germ U x hxU n = 0 := by
      have := congrArg (mspec F h) hun
      rw [mspec_smul, hd, smul_zero, mspec_germ] at this
      exact this.symm
    obtain ⟨t, ht, htn⟩ := stalk_ker_affine F hU hxU n hn0
    refine ⟨⟨X.presheaf.germ U y hyU t * X.presheaf.germ U y hyU u, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [mem_primeCompl_iff, map_mul, hspec]
      exact ht.mul (hu.map _)
    · have key : (X.presheaf.germ U y hyU t * X.presheaf.germ U y hyU u) • (a - b) = 0 := by
        rw [mul_smul, hun]
        exact htn y hyU
      have key' : (X.presheaf.germ U y hyU t * X.presheaf.germ U y hyU u) • a =
          (X.presheaf.germ U y hyU t * X.presheaf.germ U y hyU u) • b := by
        rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← smul_sub]
        exact key
      exact key'

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.lengthAt_stalk
statement:
theorem lengthAt_stalk [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    lengthAt (Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h) ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X y).obj F) =
      stalkLength F x
proof:
:= by
  letI := specModule F h
  haveI := mspec_isLocalizedModule F h
  letI := Scheme.stalkSpecializesAlgebra h
  let q := Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h
  let σ : Localization.AtPrime q ≃ₐ[X.presheaf.stalk y] X.presheaf.stalk x :=
    Scheme.stalkSpecializesAlgEquiv h
  letI modL : Module (Localization.AtPrime q) ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj F) :=
    Module.compHom _ (σ : Localization.AtPrime q →+* X.presheaf.stalk x)
  haveI : IsScalarTower (X.presheaf.stalk y) (Localization.AtPrime q)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj F) := by
    refine ⟨fun b l m ↦ ?_⟩
    change (σ (b • l)) • m = (X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom b • (σ l • m)
    rw [Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, AlgEquiv.commutes, mul_smul]
    rfl
  let e₁ := IsLocalizedModule.linearEquiv q.primeCompl
    (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap q.primeCompl ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X y).obj F))
    (mspecLinear F h)
  let e₂ := e₁.extendScalarsOfIsLocalization q.primeCompl (Localization.AtPrime q)
  rw [lengthAt, LinearEquiv.length_eq e₂, stalkLength]
  haveI : RingHomSurjective (σ : Localization.AtPrime q →+* X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    ⟨σ.surjective⟩
  exact length_eq_of_bijective (σ : Localization.AtPrime q →+* X.presheaf.stalk x)
    { toFun := id, map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl, map_smul' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl } Function.bijective_id

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.mem_support_stalk_iff
statement:
theorem mem_support_stalk_iff [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    (⟨Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h, inferInstance⟩ : PrimeSpectrum (X.presheaf.stalk y)) ∈
      Module.support (X.presheaf.stalk y) ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X y).obj F) ↔
      x ∈ moduleSheafSupport F
proof:
:= by
  letI := specModule F h
  haveI := mspec_isLocalizedModule F h
  let q := Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h
  let e₁ := IsLocalizedModule.linearEquiv q.primeCompl
    (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap q.primeCompl ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X y).obj F))
    (mspecLinear F h)
  rw [Module.mem_support_iff]
  exact e₁.toEquiv.nontrivial_congr

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.t1Space_of_forall_mem_coordinateOpen
statement:
theorem t1Space_of_forall_mem_coordinateOpen {Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Z]
    (j : Z ⟶ space k n) [IsClosedImmersion j] (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (h : ∀ p, j p ∈ coordinateOpen k n i) : T1Space Z
proof:
:= by
  have hU : j ⁻¹ᵁ coordinateOpen k n i = ⊤ := top_unique fun p _ ↦ h p
  have haff : IsAffineOpen (j ⁻¹ᵁ coordinateOpen k n i) :=
    (coordinateOpen_isAffine k n i).preimage j
  rw [hU] at haff
  haveI : IsAffine (⊤ : Z.Opens).toScheme := haff
  haveI : IsAffine Z := IsAffine.of_isIso Z.topIso.inv
  haveI : IsFinite (j ≫ toSpec k n) :=
    IsFinite.iff_isProper_and_isAffineHom.mpr ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩
  have hfin := (j ≫ toSpec k n).finite_appTop
  letI : Algebra Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of k), ⊤) Γ(Z, ⊤) := (j ≫ toSpec k n).appTop.hom.toAlgebra
  haveI : Module.Finite Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of k), ⊤) Γ(Z, ⊤) := hfin
  haveI : Algebra.IsIntegral Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of k), ⊤) Γ(Z, ⊤) := inferInstance
  have hk : IsField Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of k), ⊤) :=
    MulEquiv.isField (Field.toIsField k)
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.toMulEquiv
  have hZ : IsField Γ(Z, ⊤) := isField_of_isIntegral_of_isField' hk
  haveI : T1Space (PrimeSpectrum Γ(Z, ⊤)) := PrimeSpectrum.t1Space_iff_isField.mpr hZ
  haveI : T1Space (Spec Γ(Z, ⊤)) := inferInstanceAs (T1Space (PrimeSpectrum Γ(Z, ⊤)))
  exact Z.isoSpec.hom.isEmbedding.t1Space

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.isClosed_singleton_of_height_eq_zero
statement:
theorem isClosed_singleton_of_height_eq_zero {X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] {p : X}
    (hp : height p = 0) : IsClosed ({p} : Set X)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqc⟩ := isClosed_closure.exists_closed_singleton
    (Set.singleton_nonempty p).closure
  have hpq : p ⤳ q := specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr hq
  have hle : q ≤ p := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr hpq
  have hqp : q ⤳ p := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp (Order.height_eq_zero.mp hp hle)
  rw [(hpq.antisymm hqp).eq]
  exact hqc

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.degPn_lof_zero
statement:
theorem degPn_lof_zero (z : RationalDimChow (space k n) 0) :
    degPn k n (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k n) m) 0 z) =
      F20.degQ k (space k n) z
proof:
:= by
  rw [degPn, LinearMap.comp_apply, totalPushOn, DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    degTotalSpk_lof_zero]
  exact evalQ_ops_push k (opsV4 k) z

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.degPn_primeClass_zero_pos
statement:
theorem degPn_primeClass_zero_pos (p : space k n) (hp : height p = 0) :
    0 < degPn k n (primeClass k n 0 p hp)
proof:
:= by
  rw [primeClass, degPn_lof_zero, F20.degQ_tmul, one_mul, F20.degChow_dimPrimeCycle]
  exact_mod_cast F20.finrank_pos_of_isClosed (k := k) (isClosed_singleton_of_height_eq_zero hp)

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.Hn_lof_succ
statement:
theorem Hn_lof_succ (e : ℕ) (z : RationalDimChow (space k n) (e + 1)) :
    Hn k n (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k n) m) (e + 1) z) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k n) m) e
        ((opsV4 k).cap (Lpn k n) (hLpn k n) e z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Hn, spaceH, totalCapOn, DirectSum.toModule_lof]
  rfl

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.sectionCoord_eq_algebraMap_germ
statement:
theorem sectionCoord_eq_algebraMap_germ {S : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral S] {M : S.Modules} {x : S}
    (d : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData S M x) (s : Γ(M, ⊤)) {z : S} (hz : z ∈ d.U) :
    sectionCoord d s = algebraMap (S.presheaf.stalk z) S.functionField
      (S.presheaf.germ d.U z hz (sectionCoordSec d s))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty d.U := ⟨⟨z, hz⟩⟩
  rw [Scheme.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField]
  rfl

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.germ_sectionCoordSec_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  apply hs
  rw [sectionCoord_eq_algebraMap_germ d s hz, h0, map_zero]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.coordC_ne_zero
statement: theorem coordC_ne_zero : coordC v ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hu := jFrame_unit (pointClosureι v) (pointClosureGenericPoint v)
  rw [coordC, sectionCoord_eq_algebraMap_germ (frameB v) (secS v) (frameB v).mem]
  intro h0
  rw [map_eq_zero_iff _ (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective _ _)] at h0
  exact hu.ne_zero h0

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.sectionCoord_secS_ne_zero
statement:
theorem sectionCoord_secS_ne_zero {w : pointClosureScheme v}
    (d : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme v)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj (Lpn k n)) w) :
    sectionCoord d (secS v) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [sectionCoord_compat (frameB v) d]
  exact mul_ne_zero (coordC_ne_zero v) ((frameB v).regularTransitionFunction_ne_zero d)

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.cap_dimPrimeCycle
statement:
theorem cap_dimPrimeCycle :
    (opsV4 k).cap (Lpn k n) (hLpn k n) e
        ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v (e + 1) hv) :
          DimChow (space k n) (e + 1))) =
      (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (capCycle v e hv) : DimChow (space k n) e)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(opsV4 k).cap_mk (Lpn k n) (hLpn k n) e v hv
    (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one _ (hLpn k n) v) (frameB v)
    (D5.primeCycleOfFrame (k := k) (Lpn k n) (hLpn k n) e v hv (frameB v)) rfl]
  have hG : (QuotientAddGroup.mk (relGen v e hv).cycle : DimChow (space k n) e) = 0 :=
    (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff _).mpr (AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨_, rfl⟩)
  rw [capCycle, QuotientAddGroup.mk_add, hG, add_zero]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.capCycle_val
statement:
theorem capCycle_val : (capCycle v e hv).1 =
    properPushforward (pointClosureι v) (weilB v) +
      properPushforward (pointClosureι v) (AlgebraicGeometry.div (coordC v))
proof: := rfl

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.capCycle_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range
statement:
theorem capCycle_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range (y : space k n)
    (hy : y ∉ Set.range (pointClosureι v)) : (capCycle v e hv).1 y = 0
proof:
:= by
  have e1 := AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range (pointClosureι v)
    (weilB v) (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) y hy
  have e2 := AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range (pointClosureι v)
    (AlgebraicGeometry.div (coordC v)) (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) y hy
  rw [capCycle_val]
  exact (congrArg₂ (· + ·) e1 e2).trans (add_zero 0)

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.capCycle_apply_image
statement:
theorem capCycle_apply_image (z : pointClosureScheme v) :
    (capCycle v e hv).1 (pointClosureι v z) =
      Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame
        (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure (Lpn k n) (hLpn k n) v)
        (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one (Lpn k n) (hLpn k n) v) (frameB v) z +
      (pointClosureScheme v).ord (coordC v) z
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_closedImmersion (pointClosureι v)
    (weilB v) (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) z
  have h2 := AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_closedImmersion (pointClosureι v)
    (AlgebraicGeometry.div (coordC v)) (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) z
  rw [capCycle_val]
  exact congrArg₂ (· + ·) h1 h2

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.capCycle_apply_of_coheight_ne_one
statement:
theorem capCycle_apply_of_coheight_ne_one (z : pointClosureScheme v) (hz : coheight z ≠ 1) :
    (capCycle v e hv).1 (pointClosureι v z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [capCycle_apply_image, Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hz, add_zero]
  exact Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hz _

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.capCycle_apply_of_coheight_one
statement:
theorem capCycle_apply_of_coheight_one (z : pointClosureScheme v) (hz : coheight z = 1)
    {w : pointClosureScheme v}
    (d : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme v)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj (Lpn k n)) w) (hzd : z ∈ d.U) :
    (capCycle v e hv).1 (pointClosureι v z) =
      (pointClosureScheme v).ord (sectionCoord d (secS v)) z
proof:
:= by
  rw [capCycle_apply_image, Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame_eq_on_localData _ _
    (frameB v) d z hzd, sectionCoord_compat (frameB v) d,
    show sectionCoord (frameB v) (secS v) = coordC v from rfl,
    (pointClosureScheme v).ord_mul hz (coordC_ne_zero v)
      ((frameB v).regularTransitionFunction_ne_zero d)]
  rw [add_comm]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.capCycle_apply_of_coheight_one'
statement:
theorem capCycle_apply_of_coheight_one' (z : pointClosureScheme v) (hz : coheight z = 1)
    {w : pointClosureScheme v}
    (d : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme v)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj (Lpn k n)) w) (hzd : z ∈ d.U) :
    (capCycle v e hv).1 (pointClosureι v z) =
      (pointClosureScheme v).ord (algebraMap ((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalk z)
        (pointClosureScheme v).functionField
        ((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.germ d.U z hzd (sectionCoordSec d (secS v)))) z
proof:
:= by
  rw [capCycle_apply_of_coheight_one v e hv z hz d hzd, sectionCoord_eq_algebraMap_germ d _ hzd]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.ord_algebraMap_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.ord_algebraMap_eq_length_toNat hz a ha]
  exact Int.natCast_nonneg _

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.capCycle_nonneg
statement: theorem capCycle_nonneg (y : space k n) : 0 ≤ (capCycle v e hv).1 y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hy : y ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι v)
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hy
    by_cases hz : coheight z = 1
    · have d : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme v)
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj (Lpn k n)) z :=
        jFrame (pointClosureι v) z
      rw [capCycle_apply_of_coheight_one' v e hv z hz d d.mem]
      exact ord_algebraMap_nonneg hz _
        (germ_sectionCoordSec_ne_zero d _ d.mem (sectionCoord_secS_ne_zero v d))
    · rw [capCycle_apply_of_coheight_ne_one v e hv z hz]
  · rw [capCycle_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range v e hv y hy]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.exists_not_mem_chart
statement:
theorem exists_not_mem_chart (hv0 : height v ≠ 0) :
    ∃ p : pointClosureScheme v, pointClosureι v p ∉ coordinateOpen k n (chartIdx v)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  simp only [not_exists, not_not] at h
  haveI := t1Space_of_forall_mem_coordinateOpen (pointClosureι v) (chartIdx v) h
  have hnm : ¬ IsMin v := fun hm ↦ hv0 (Order.height_eq_zero.mpr hm)
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := not_isMin_iff.mp hnm
  have hvw : v ⤳ w := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hw.le
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := C1Cap.exists_pointClosureι_eq hvw
  have hgz : pointClosureGenericPoint v ⤳ z :=
    (pointClosureGenericPoint_isGeneric v).specializes trivial
  rw [← hgz.eq, pointClosureι_genericPoint] at hz
  exact hw.ne hz.symm

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.not_isUnit_germ_of_not_mem_chart
statement:
theorem not_isUnit_germ_of_not_mem_chart (p : pointClosureScheme v)
    (hp : pointClosureι v p ∉ coordinateOpen k n (chartIdx v)) :
    ¬ IsUnit ((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.germ (frameAt v p).U p (frameAt v p).mem
      (sectionCoordSec (frameAt v p) (secS v)))
proof:
:= by
  intro hu
  have hψ := ψ_ne_zero_of_isUnit p _ _ _ hu
  have hev : evalAt (jRho (pointClosureι v)) (jFrame (pointClosureι v)) (jSec (pointClosureι v)) p
      (MvPolynomial.X (chartIdx v)) ≠ 0 := by
    unfold evalAt
    rw [MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X']
    exact hψ
  rw [evalAt_jFrame, RingHom.comp_apply] at hev
  have hev2 : evalP k n (pointClosureι v p) (frame1 (pointClosureι v p))
      (MvPolynomial.X (chartIdx v)) ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ hev (by rw [h0, map_zero])
  rw [Ne, evalP_eq_zero_iff k n (chartOf (pointClosureι v p)) (pointClosureι v p)
    (mem_chartOf _) (frame1 _) 1 (MvPolynomial.X (chartIdx v))
    (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n (chartIdx v))] at hev2
  exact hp ((Proj.mem_basicOpen _ _ _).mpr hev2)

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.exists_coheight_one_not_isUnit
statement:
theorem exists_coheight_one_not_isUnit {S : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral S] [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
    {p : S} (a : S.presheaf.stalk p) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hna : ¬ IsUnit a) :
    ∃ (w : S) (h : w ⤳ p), coheight w = 1 ∧ ¬ IsUnit ((S.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom a)
proof:
:= by
  have hle : Ideal.span {a} ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (S.presheaf.stalk p) := by
    rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    exact hna
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, -⟩ := Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_le hle
  haveI : Q.IsPrime := hQ.1.1
  obtain ⟨w, h, hw⟩ := Scheme.exists_specializes_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_eq p Q
  refine ⟨w, h, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← Scheme.height_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h, hw]
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact Ideal.height_le_one_of_isPrincipal_of_mem_minimalPrimes _ Q hQ
    · exact (Ideal.one_le_height_span_singleton_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors
        (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero ha)).trans (Ideal.height_mono hQ.1.2)
  · have haQ : a ∈ Q := hQ.1.2 (Ideal.subset_span rfl)
    rw [← hw] at haQ
    exact haQ

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.germ_eq_stalkSpecializes
statement:
theorem germ_eq_stalkSpecializes {S : Scheme.{u}} {U : S.Opens} {p w : S} (hp : p ∈ U)
    (h : w ⤳ p) (hw : w ∈ U) (x : Γ(S, U)) :
    S.presheaf.germ U w hw x = (S.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom (S.presheaf.germ U p hp x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.exists_capCycle_pos
statement: theorem exists_capCycle_pos : ∃ y, 0 < (capCycle v e hv).1 y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := exists_not_mem_chart v (by rw [hv]; exact (by simp))
  have ha := germ_sectionCoordSec_ne_zero (frameAt v p) (secS v) (frameAt v p).mem
    (sectionCoord_secS_ne_zero v (frameAt v p))
  obtain ⟨w, h, hw1, hwu⟩ := exists_coheight_one_not_isUnit _ ha
    (not_isUnit_germ_of_not_mem_chart v p hp)
  have hwd : w ∈ (frameAt v p).U := h.mem_open (frameAt v p).U.isOpen (frameAt v p).mem
  refine ⟨pointClosureι v w, ?_⟩
  rw [capCycle_apply_of_coheight_one' v e hv w hw1 (frameAt v p) hwd,
    germ_eq_stalkSpecializes (frameAt v p).mem h hwd]
  have hne : (((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom
      ((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.germ (frameAt v p).U p (frameAt v p).mem
        (sectionCoordSec (frameAt v p) (secS v)))) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← germ_eq_stalkSpecializes (frameAt v p).mem h hwd]
    exact germ_sectionCoordSec_ne_zero (frameAt v p) (secS v) hwd
      (sectionCoord_secS_ne_zero v (frameAt v p))
  have := Scheme.one_le_ord_algebraMap_of_not_isUnit hw1 hne hwu
  omega

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.degCyc_apply
statement:
theorem degCyc_apply (e : ℕ) (D : dimensionCycles (space k n) e) :
    degCyc k n e D = degPn k n (((Hn k n) ^ e)
      (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k n) m) e
        ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow (space k n) e))))
proof: := rfl

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.degCyc_pos_of_effective
statement:
theorem degCyc_pos_of_effective (e : ℕ)
    (hprime : ∀ (v : space k n) (hv : height v = e), 0 < degCyc k n e (dimPrimeCycle v e hv))
    (D : dimensionCycles (space k n) e) (hD : ∀ y, 0 ≤ D.1 y) (hpos : ∃ y, 0 < D.1 y) :
    0 < degCyc k n e D
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hsum⟩ := F8.eq_sum_single D.1
  have hmem : ∀ x ∈ S, height x = e := fun x hx ↦
    D.2 (Function.mem_support.mpr ((hS x).mpr hx))
  have hDsum : D = ∑ x ∈ S.attach, D.1 x.1 • dimPrimeCycle x.1 e (hmem x.1 x.2) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [AddSubgroup.val_finsetSum]
    simp only [AddSubgroup.coe_zsmul]
    exact hsum.trans (Finset.sum_attach S (fun x ↦ D.1 x •
      (Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single x (1 : ℤ) : AlgebraicCycle (space k n) ℤ))).symm
  rw [hDsum, map_sum]
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hpos
  have hyS : y ∈ S := (hS y).mp hy.ne'
  refine Finset.sum_pos' (fun x _ ↦ ?_) ⟨⟨y, hyS⟩, Finset.mem_attach _ _, ?_⟩
  · rw [map_zsmul, zsmul_eq_mul]
    exact mul_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hD x.1) (hprime x.1 (hmem x.1 x.2)).le
  · rw [map_zsmul, zsmul_eq_mul]
    exact mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast hy) (hprime y (hmem y hyS))

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.degCyc_dimPrimeCycle_pos
statement:
theorem degCyc_dimPrimeCycle_pos :
    ∀ (e : ℕ) (v : space k n) (hv : height v = e), 0 < degCyc k n e (dimPrimeCycle v e hv)
  | 0, v, hv => by
    rw [degCyc_apply, pow_zero, Module.End.one_apply]
    exact degPn_primeClass_zero_pos k n v hv
  | e + 1, v, hv => by
    have hv' : height v = (e : ℕ∞) + 1
proof:
:= by rw [hv]; push_cast; rfl
    rw [degCyc_apply, pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, Hn_lof_succ,
      cap_dimPrimeCycle v e hv', ← degCyc_apply]
    exact degCyc_pos_of_effective k n e (degCyc_dimPrimeCycle_pos e) _
      (capCycle_nonneg v e hv') (exists_capCycle_pos v e hv')

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.degPn_Hn_pow_primeClass_pos
statement:
theorem degPn_Hn_pow_primeClass_pos (e : ℕ) (v : space k n) (hv : height v = e) :
    0 < degPn k n (((Hn k n) ^ e) (primeClass k n e v hv))
proof:
:=
  degCyc_dimPrimeCycle_pos k n e v hv

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.degPn_Hn_pow_cycPn_pushUnit_pos
statement:
theorem degPn_Hn_pow_cycPn_pushUnit_pos {V : Scheme.{u}} (ι : V ⟶ space k n)
    [IsClosedImmersion ι] [IsIntegral V] [IsNoetherian V]
    (hF : IsCoherentLike (space k n) (pushUnit ι)) (d : ℕ)
    (hd : height (ι (genericPoint V)) = d) :
    0 < degPn k n (((Hn k n) ^ d) (cycPn k n (pushUnit ι) hF d))
proof:
:= by
  rw [cycPn_pushUnit_integral k n ι hF d hd]
  exact degPn_Hn_pow_primeClass_pos k n d _ hd

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.eq_one_of_mul_degPn_cycPn_pushUnit
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_mul_degPn_cycPn_pushUnit {V : Scheme.{u}} (ι : V ⟶ space k n)
    [IsClosedImmersion ι] [IsIntegral V] [IsNoetherian V]
    (hF : IsCoherentLike (space k n) (pushUnit ι)) (d : ℕ)
    (hd : height (ι (genericPoint V)) = d) (c : ℚ)
    (hc : c * degPn k n (((Hn k n) ^ d) (cycPn k n (pushUnit ι) hF d)) =
      degPn k n (((Hn k n) ^ d) (cycPn k n (pushUnit ι) hF d))) : c = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := degPn_Hn_pow_cycPn_pushUnit_pos k n ι hF d hd
  have h2 : (c - 1) * degPn k n (((Hn k n) ^ d) (cycPn k n (pushUnit ι) hF d)) = 0 := by
    rw [sub_mul, hc, one_mul, sub_self]
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h2 with h | h
  · exact sub_eq_zero.mp h
  · exact absurd h hpos.ne'

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.frame_generates
statement:
theorem frame_generates (i : Fin (n + 1)) (W : (space k n).Opens) (hW : W ≤ chartOpen k n i)
    (l : (twistM1 k n).val.obj (op W)) :
    ∃ a : Γ(space k n, W), l = a • resL hW (frame k n i)
proof:
:= by
  let U := coordinateOpen k n i
  have hW' : U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W) = W := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι,
      inf_eq_right.mpr (hW.trans (chartOpen_eq k n i).le)]
  obtain ⟨V, rfl⟩ : ∃ V : U.toScheme.Opens, U.ι ''ᵁ V = W := ⟨_, hW'⟩
  let e := projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateIso k n (-1) i
  let a' : Γ(U.toScheme, V) := e.inv.app V l
  refine ⟨(U.ι.appIso V).inv a', ?_⟩
  have h1 : l = e.hom.app V a' := (Chow.C1Cap.iso_hom_inv_app e V l).symm
  have h2 : e.hom.app V a' = a' • e.hom.app V (1 : Γ(U.toScheme, V)) := by
    have := Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul e.hom a' (1 : Γ(U.toScheme, V))
    rw [← this]
    congr 1
    exact (mul_one a').symm
  have h3 : e.hom.app V (1 : Γ(U.toScheme, V)) = resL hW (frame k n i) := by
    have h := Chow.C1Cap.app_presheaf_map e.hom (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤))
      (1 : Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤))
    rw [Chow.C1Cap.unit_presheaf_map_one] at h
    exact h
  rw [h1, h2, h3]
  rfl

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.X_frame
statement:
theorem X_frame (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (Koszul.X k n j (-1)).app (chartOpen k n i) (frame k n i) =
      coordVal k n j i • resU k n i (e0 k n)
proof:
:= by
  let z := (projectiveTwistingZeroIso k n)
  have h1 : coordVal k n j i =
      z.hom.app (chartOpen k n i) ((Koszul.X k n j (-1)).app (chartOpen k n i) (frame k n i)) :=
    rfl
  have h2 : (Koszul.X k n j (-1)).app (chartOpen k n i) (frame k n i) =
      z.inv.app (chartOpen k n i) (coordVal k n j i) := by
    rw [h1]
    exact (Chow.C1Cap.iso_inv_hom_app z (chartOpen k n i) _).symm
  have h3 : z.inv.app (chartOpen k n i) (1 : Γ(space k n, chartOpen k n i)) =
      resU k n i (e0 k n) := by
    have h := Chow.C1Cap.app_presheaf_map z.inv (homOfLE (le_top : chartOpen k n i ≤ ⊤))
      (1 : Γ(space k n, ⊤))
    exact (congrArg _ (Chow.C1Cap.unit_presheaf_map_one _).symm).trans h
  rw [h2, ← h3, ← Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul]
  congr 1
  exact (mul_one (coordVal k n j i)).symm.trans (smul_eq_mul _ _).symm

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.resU_tsec
statement:
theorem resU_tsec (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    resU k n i (tsec k n j) = (Koszul.X k n j 0).app (chartOpen k n i) (resU k n i (e0 k n))
proof:
:=
  (Chow.C1Cap.app_presheaf_map (Koszul.X k n j 0) (homOfLE (le_top : chartOpen k n i ≤ ⊤))
    (e0 k n)).symm

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.coordVal_smul_tsec
statement:
theorem coordVal_smul_tsec (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordVal k n i i • resU k n i (tsec k n j) = coordVal k n j i • resU k n i (tsec k n i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [resU_tsec, resU_tsec, ← Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul, ← Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul,
    ← X_frame, ← X_frame]
  have h := congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ.app (chartOpen k n i) (frame k n i)) (Koszul.X_comm k n i j (-1))
  exact h

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.coordVal_smul_tau
statement:
theorem coordVal_smul_tau (c : Fin (n + 1) → k) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordVal k n i i • resU k n i (tau k n c) = chartVal k n c i • resU k n i (tsec k n i)
proof:
:= by
  have hres : resU k n i (tau k n c) = ∑ j, (space k n).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (le_top : chartOpen k n i ≤ ⊤)).op (constSec k n (c j)) • resU k n i (tsec k n j) := by
    unfold tau resU
    rw [map_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ Scheme.Modules.map_smul _ _ _ _
  rw [hres, Finset.smul_sum, chartVal_eq, Finset.sum_smul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
  rw [smul_comm, coordVal_smul_tsec, smul_smul]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.germ_coord_tau
statement:
theorem germ_coord_tau (c : Fin (n + 1) → k) (i : Fin (n + 1)) {x : space k n}
    (hx : x ∈ chartOpen k n i)
    (d' : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData (space k n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n (0 + 1)) x) :
    ∃ u : (space k n).presheaf.stalk x, IsUnit u ∧
      (space k n).presheaf.germ d'.U x d'.mem (sectionCoordSec d' (tau k n c)) =
        u * (space k n).presheaf.germ (chartOpen k n i) x hx (chartVal k n c i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨a, b, hab, hba⟩, ha⟩ := isUnit_coordVal_self k n i
  change a = coordVal k n i i at ha
  have hτ : resU k n i (tau k n c) = (b * chartVal k n c i) • resU k n i (tsec k n i) := by
    have h := congrArg (b • ·) (coordVal_smul_tau k n c i)
    simp only [smul_smul] at h
    rw [← ha, hba, one_smul] at h
    rw [h, mul_comm]
  let U := chartOpen k n i
  let W : (space k n).Opens := d'.U ⊓ U
  have hxW : x ∈ W := ⟨d'.mem, hx⟩
  let jWU : W ⟶ U := homOfLE inf_le_right
  let r : Γ(space k n, W) := (space k n).presheaf.map jWU.op (b * chartVal k n c i)
  have hmap : ∀ m : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n (0 + 1), ⊤),
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n (0 + 1)).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op m =
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n (0 + 1)).presheaf.map jWU.op (resU k n i m) := by
    intro m
    unfold resU
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
    rfl
  have hrel : (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n (0 + 1)).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op
      (tau k n c) = r • (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n (0 + 1)).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op (tsec k n i) := by
    rw [hmap, hmap, hτ, Scheme.Modules.map_smul]
  have hc := coord_rel d' (tau k n c) (tsec k n i) W inf_le_left r hrel
  have hg := congrArg ((space k n).presheaf.germ W x hxW) hc
  rw [map_mul, (space k n).presheaf.germ_res_apply, (space k n).presheaf.germ_res_apply,
    (space k n).presheaf.germ_res_apply, map_mul] at hg
  have hbu : IsUnit ((space k n).presheaf.germ U x hx b) :=
    (show IsUnit b from ⟨⟨b, a, hba, hab⟩, rfl⟩).map _
  refine ⟨(space k n).presheaf.germ U x hx b *
    (space k n).presheaf.germ d'.U x d'.mem (sectionCoordSec d' (tsec k n i)),
    hbu.mul (tsec_unit k n i x ((chartOpen_eq k n i) ▸ hx) d'), ?_⟩
  rw [hg]
  ring

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.stalkLength_cokernel_linSec
statement:
theorem stalkLength_cokernel_linSec (c : Fin (n + 1) → k) (F : (space k n).Modules)
    (hm : Mono ((sigmaT (twistM1 k n) (linSec k n c)).app F)) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    {x : space k n} (hx : x ∈ chartOpen k n i) :
    stalkLength (cokernel ((sigmaT (twistM1 k n) (linSec k n c)).app F)) x =
      AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.LocalOrdSymmetry.chiCoker
        ((space k n).presheaf.germ (chartOpen k n i) x hx (chartVal k n c i))
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear (space k n) x).obj F)
proof:
:=
  stalkLength_cokernel_sigmaT (linSec k n c) F (twistM1_isFiniteLocallyFree k n) hm hx
    (frame k n i) (frame_generates k n i)

name: HirzebruchRiemannRoch.eulerHom_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eulerHom_classOf (euler : Object → ℤ)
    (hadd : ∀ A B C, Exact A B C → euler B = euler A + euler C) (E : Object) :
    eulerHom euler hadd (ExactGrothendieck.classOf Object Exact E) = euler E
proof:
:= by
  simp [eulerHom, ExactGrothendieck.lift_classOf]

name: HirzebruchRiemannRoch.characteristicNumber_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem characteristicNumber_classOf
    (chernCharacter : ExactGrothendieck.Group Object Exact →+ A)
    (toddClass : A) (integral : A →+ ℚ) (E : Object) :
    characteristicNumber chernCharacter toddClass integral
        (ExactGrothendieck.classOf Object Exact E) =
      integral (chernCharacter (ExactGrothendieck.classOf Object Exact E) * toddClass)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: HirzebruchRiemannRoch.hom_eq_of_object_classes
statement:
theorem hom_eq_of_object_classes
    (euler : Object → ℤ)
    (euler_additive : ∀ A B C, Exact A B C → euler B = euler A + euler C)
    (chernCharacter : ExactGrothendieck.Group Object Exact →+ A)
    (toddClass : A) (integral : A →+ ℚ)
    (hobject : ∀ E : Object,
      (euler E : ℚ) =
        integral (chernCharacter (ExactGrothendieck.classOf Object Exact E) * toddClass)) :
    eulerHom euler euler_additive =
      characteristicNumber chernCharacter toddClass integral
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext Object Exact
  intro E
  rw [eulerHom_classOf, characteristicNumber_classOf]
  exact hobject E

name: HirzebruchRiemannRoch.formula_of_object_classes
statement:
theorem formula_of_object_classes
    (euler : Object → ℤ)
    (euler_additive : ∀ A B C, Exact A B C → euler B = euler A + euler C)
    (chernCharacter : ExactGrothendieck.Group Object Exact →+ A)
    (toddClass : A) (integral : A →+ ℚ)
    (hobject : ∀ E : Object,
      (euler E : ℚ) =
        integral (chernCharacter (ExactGrothendieck.classOf Object Exact E) * toddClass))
    (x : ExactGrothendieck.Group Object Exact) :
    eulerHom euler euler_additive x =
      integral (chernCharacter x * toddClass)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun f : ExactGrothendieck.Group Object Exact →+ ℚ => f x)
    (hom_eq_of_object_classes euler euler_additive chernCharacter toddClass integral hobject)
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.ProjectiveLine.chartPolynomialEquiv_symm_C
statement:
theorem chartPolynomialEquiv_symm_C (c : k) :
    (chartPolynomialEquiv k).symm (Polynomial.C c) =
      structureRingHom (X := space k 1) (R := CommRingCat.of k) (coordinateOpen k 1 0) c
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun f ↦ f.hom c)
    (projectiveCoordinateChartScalarRingHom_awayToSection k 1 0)
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply] at h
  refine Eq.trans ?_ h
  have hC : (MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv k (AffineChartIndex 1 0)).symm (Polynomial.C c) = MvPolynomial.C c := by
    rw [AlgEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
    simp
  change (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (grading k 1) (coordinate k 1 0)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k 1 0) Nat.zero_lt_one).hom.hom
      ((awayCoordinateEquiv k 1 0).symm
        ((MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv k (AffineChartIndex 1 0)).symm (Polynomial.C c))) = _
  rw [hC]
  change (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (grading k 1) (coordinate k 1 0)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k 1 0) Nat.zero_lt_one).hom.hom
      (awayCoordinateHom k 1 0 (MvPolynomial.C c)) = _
  rw [awayCoordinateHom, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.ProjectiveLine.isScalarTower_constants
statement:
theorem isScalarTower_constants :
    IsScalarTower k k[X] (space k 1).functionField
proof:

  change ((space k 1).germToFunctionField ⊤).hom
      (structureRingHom (X := space k 1) (R := CommRingCat.of k) ⊤ c) =
    ((space k 1).germToFunctionField (coordinateOpen k 1 0)).hom
      ((chartPolynomialEquiv k).symm (Polynomial.C c))
  rw [chartPolynomialEquiv_symm_C, ← structureRingHom_naturality (coordinateOpen k 1 0).leTop]
  simp only [Scheme.germToFunctionField]
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.ProjectiveLine.isFullConstantField
statement:

  algebraic_mem x hx

      (k := k) (K := k⟮X⟯) _ (hx.algHom (toRatFuncConstants k))
    refine ⟨c, (ratFuncAlgEquiv k).symm.injective ?_⟩
    change toRatFuncConstants k x = toRatFuncConstants k (algebraMap k _ c)
    rw [AlgHom.commutes]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.ProjectiveLine.hirzebruchRiemannRoch
statement:
theorem hirzebruchRiemannRoch (z : SchemeKTheory.K0 (space k 1)) :
    (SchemeKTheory.k0Euler k
        (fun E hE ↦
          (geometricFreeCartierPresentationOfFiniteLocallyFree
            (X := space k 1) k ⟨E, hE⟩).targetFinite) z : ℚ) =
      integral
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.rationalGradedDegreeOfStructureSheafFinite k
          (SchemeBridge.structureSheaf_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k))
        (geometricAdditiveChernCharacter (space k 1) z *
          toddClass (canonicalTangentFirstChern (X := space k 1) k))
proof:
:=
  curve_hirzebruchRiemannRoch_characteristicNumber (X := space k 1) k z

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.ProjectiveLine.card_degree_eq
statement:
theorem card_degree_eq (d : ℕ) :
    Nat.card {m : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ | m.degree = d} = d + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hdeg : ∀ m : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, m.degree = m 0 + m 1 := fun m ↦ by
    rw [Finsupp.degree_eq_sum, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  let e : {m : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ | m.degree = d} ≃ Fin (d + 1) :=
    { toFun := fun m ↦ ⟨m.1 0, by
        have h1 := hdeg m.1
        have h2 : m.1.degree = d := m.2
        omega⟩
      invFun := fun a ↦ ⟨Finsupp.single 0 a.1 + Finsupp.single 1 (d - a.1), by
        simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
        rw [hdeg]; simp; omega⟩
      left_inv := fun m ↦ by
        apply Subtype.ext
        ext i
        have h1 := hdeg m.1
        have h2 : m.1.degree = d := m.2
        fin_cases i
        · simp
        · simp; omega
      right_inv := fun a ↦ by ext; simp }
  rw [Nat.card_congr e, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fin]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.ProjectiveLine.finrank_degreePiece
statement: theorem finrank_degreePiece (d : ℕ) : Module.finrank k (degreePiece k 1 d) = d + 1
proof:
:= by
  change Module.finrank k (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d) = d + 1
  rw [LinearEquiv.finrank_eq (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmoduleEquivFinsupp (Fin 2) k d)]
  haveI : Finite {m : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ | m.degree = d} := Finsupp.finite_setOf_degree_eq (Fin 2) d
  haveI : Fintype {m : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ | m.degree = d} := Fintype.ofFinite _
  rw [Module.finrank_finsupp_self, ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  exact card_degree_eq d

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.ProjectiveLine.eulerChar_projectiveTwistingSheaf
statement:
theorem eulerChar_projectiveTwistingSheaf (d : ℕ) :
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf k 1 (d : ℤ)).eulerChar k = d + 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold Scheme.Modules.eulerChar
  rw [finsum_eq_single _ 0]
  · simp only [pow_zero, one_mul, Scheme.Modules.h]
    rw [LinearEquiv.finrank_eq (projectiveTwistingSheafHZeroLinearEquivDegreePiece k 1 d),
      finrank_degreePiece]
    push_cast; ring
  · intro q hq
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hq
    haveI : Subsingleton (Scheme.Modules.H (projectiveTwistingSheaf k 1 (d : ℤ)) (p + 1)) :=
      AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf_H_isZero k 1 (d : ℤ) (by omega) p)
    simp [Scheme.Modules.h, Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.ProjectiveLine.integral_chern_todd_projectiveTwist
statement:
theorem integral_chern_todd_projectiveTwist (d : ℕ) :
    integral
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.rationalGradedDegreeOfStructureSheafFinite k
          (SchemeBridge.structureSheaf_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k))
        (geometricAdditiveChernCharacter (space k 1) (projectiveTwistingK0Class k 1 (d : ℤ)) *
          toddClass (canonicalTangentFirstChern (X := space k 1) k)) = (d : ℚ) + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hirzebruchRiemannRoch]
  unfold projectiveTwistingK0Class
  haveI := projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree k 1 (d : ℤ)
  rw [show SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf (ProjectiveTwistSpace k 1) (projectiveTwistingSheaf k 1 (d : ℤ))
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree k 1 (d : ℤ)) =
      SchemeKTheory.k0Class (space k 1) (projectiveTwistingSheaf k 1 (d : ℤ)) from rfl,
    SchemeKTheory.k0Euler_classOf, eulerChar_projectiveTwistingSheaf]
  push_cast; ring

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.ProjectiveLine.eulerChar_projectiveTwistingSheaf_neg_one
statement:
theorem eulerChar_projectiveTwistingSheaf_neg_one :
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf k 1 (-1 : ℤ)).eulerChar k = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold Scheme.Modules.eulerChar
  refine finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero fun q ↦ ?_
  cases q with
  | zero =>
      haveI := projectiveTwistingSheaf_H_zero_subsingleton_of_neg k 1 Nat.one_pos (-1)
        (by norm_num)
      simp [Scheme.Modules.h, Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton]
  | succ p =>
      haveI : Subsingleton (Scheme.Modules.H (projectiveTwistingSheaf k 1 (-1 : ℤ)) (p + 1)) :=
        AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf_H_isZero k 1 (-1 : ℤ) (by norm_num) p)
      simp [Scheme.Modules.h, Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.ProjectiveLine.eulerChar_projectiveTwistingSheaf_int
statement:
theorem eulerChar_projectiveTwistingSheaf_int (d : ℤ) (hd : -1 ≤ d) :
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf k 1 d).eulerChar k = d + 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl | rfl⟩ := Int.eq_nat_or_neg d
  · exact eulerChar_projectiveTwistingSheaf k m
  · have hm : m = 0 ∨ m = 1 := by omega
    rcases hm with rfl | rfl
    · simpa using eulerChar_projectiveTwistingSheaf k 0
    · simpa using eulerChar_projectiveTwistingSheaf_neg_one k

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.ProjectiveLine.integral_chern_todd_projectiveTwist_int
statement:
theorem integral_chern_todd_projectiveTwist_int (d : ℤ) (hd : -1 ≤ d) :
    integral
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.rationalGradedDegreeOfStructureSheafFinite k
          (SchemeBridge.structureSheaf_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k))
        (geometricAdditiveChernCharacter (space k 1) (projectiveTwistingK0Class k 1 d) *
          toddClass (canonicalTangentFirstChern (X := space k 1) k)) = (d : ℚ) + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hirzebruchRiemannRoch]
  unfold projectiveTwistingK0Class
  haveI := projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree k 1 d
  rw [show SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf (ProjectiveTwistSpace k 1) (projectiveTwistingSheaf k 1 d)
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree k 1 d) =
      SchemeKTheory.k0Class (space k 1) (projectiveTwistingSheaf k 1 d) from rfl,
    SchemeKTheory.k0Euler_classOf, eulerChar_projectiveTwistingSheaf_int k d hd]
  push_cast; ring
