name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.chartVal_add
statement:
theorem chartVal_add (c c' : Fin (n + 1) → k) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    chartVal k n (c + c') i = chartVal k n c i + chartVal k n c' i
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartVal_eq, chartVal_eq, chartVal_eq, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
  rw [Pi.add_apply, map_add, map_add, add_mul]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.chartVal_smul
statement:
theorem chartVal_smul (t : k) (c : Fin (n + 1) → k) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    chartVal k n (t • c) i =
      (space k n).presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op (constSec k n t) * chartVal k n c i
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartVal_eq, chartVal_eq, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
  rw [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_mul, map_mul, mul_assoc]

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.chartVal_single
statement:
theorem chartVal_single (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    chartVal k n (Pi.single i 1) i = coordVal k n i i
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartVal_eq, Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · rw [Pi.single_eq_same, map_one, map_one, one_mul]
  · intro j _ hji
    rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hji, map_zero, map_zero, zero_mul]
  · intro h
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ i) h

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.badSub_ne_top
statement:
theorem badSub_ne_top (i : Fin (n + 1)) (P : Ideal Γ(space k n, chartOpen k n i))
    (hP : P ≠ ⊤) : badSub k n i P ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hmem : (Pi.single i 1 : Fin (n + 1) → k) ∈ badSub k n i P := h ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  change chartVal k n (Pi.single i 1) i ∈ P at hmem
  rw [chartVal_single] at hmem
  exact hP (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem P hmem (isUnit_coordVal_self k n i))

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.avoidSheaf_isFinitePresentation
statement:
theorem avoidSheaf_isFinitePresentation (F : (space k n).Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation]
    (b : Bool) : (avoidSheaf k n F b).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  cases b
  · exact isCoherentLike_twist (twistM1_isFiniteLocallyFree k n) F
      (show IsCoherentLike (space k n) F from inferInstanceAs F.IsFinitePresentation)
  · exact inferInstanceAs F.IsFinitePresentation

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.isSMulRegular_of_forall_not_mem
statement:
theorem isSMulRegular_of_forall_not_mem {A M : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] {r : A} (h : ∀ p ∈ associatedPrimes A M, r ∉ p) :
    IsSMulRegular M r
proof:
:= by
  rw [isSMulRegular_iff_right_eq_zero_of_smul]
  intro x hx
  by_contra hne
  have hmem : r ∈ ⋃ p ∈ associatedPrimes A M, (p : Set A) := by
    rw [biUnion_associatedPrimes_eq_zero_divisors]
    exact ⟨x, hne, hx⟩
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hrp⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hmem
  exact h p hp hrp

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.associatedPrimes_chart_finite
statement:
theorem associatedPrimes_chart_finite (F : (space k n).Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation]
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (b : Bool) : (associatedPrimes Γ(space k n, chartOpen k n i)
      (chartModule (chartOpen_isAffine k n i) (avoidSheaf k n F b))).Finite
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherian (space k n) := SchemeProjectiveSpace.isNoetherian k n
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(space k n, chartOpen k n i) :=
    IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨chartOpen k n i, chartOpen_isAffine k n i⟩
  haveI := avoidSheaf_isFinitePresentation k n F b
  haveI := chartModule_finite (chartOpen_isAffine k n i) (avoidSheaf k n F b)
  exact associatedPrimes.finite _ _

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.exists_avoid
statement:
theorem exists_avoid [Infinite k] (F : (space k n).Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ c : Fin (n + 1) → k, ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)) (b : Bool)
      (P : Ideal Γ(space k n, chartOpen k n i)),
      P ∈ associatedPrimes Γ(space k n, chartOpen k n i)
        (chartModule (chartOpen_isAffine k n i) (avoidSheaf k n F b)) → c ∉ badSub k n i P
proof:
:= by
  let ι := Σ (i : Fin (n + 1)) (b : Bool), ↥(associatedPrimes Γ(space k n, chartOpen k n i)
      (chartModule (chartOpen_isAffine k n i) (avoidSheaf k n F b)))
  haveI : ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)) (b : Bool), Finite ↥(associatedPrimes Γ(space k n, chartOpen k n i)
      (chartModule (chartOpen_isAffine k n i) (avoidSheaf k n F b))) :=
    fun i b ↦ (associatedPrimes_chart_finite k n F i b).to_subtype
  haveI : Finite ι := inferInstance
  letI : Fintype ι := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  let p : ι → Submodule k (Fin (n + 1) → k) := fun q ↦ badSub k n q.1 q.2.2.1
  have h₁ : ∀ q, p q ≠ ⊤ := fun q ↦ badSub_ne_top k n q.1 q.2.2.1 q.2.2.2.isPrime.ne_top
  have h₂ : (Finset.univ : Finset ι).card < ENat.card k := by
    rw [ENat.card_eq_top_of_infinite]
    exact ENat.coe_lt_top _
  obtain ⟨c, -, hc⟩ := Set.exists_of_ssubset
    (Submodule.iUnion_ssubset_of_forall_ne_top_of_card_lt Finset.univ p h₁ h₂)
  refine ⟨c, fun i b P hP hcP ↦ hc ?_⟩
  exact Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨⟨i, b, ⟨P, hP⟩⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, hcP⟩

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.exists_good
statement:
theorem exists_good [Infinite k] (F : (space k n).Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ c, Good k n F c
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherian (space k n) := SchemeProjectiveSpace.isNoetherian k n
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_avoid k n F
  refine ⟨c, fun i b ↦ ?_⟩
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(space k n, chartOpen k n i) :=
    IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨chartOpen k n i, chartOpen_isAffine k n i⟩
  exact isSMulRegular_of_forall_not_mem fun P hP hcP ↦ hc i b P hP hcP

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.isZero_g0ClassOf
statement:
theorem isZero_g0ClassOf {X : Scheme.{u}} (F : X.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike X F)
    (hz : IsZero F) : g0ClassOf X F hF = 0
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_isZero X.Modules (IsCoherentLike X) hF hz

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.uu_pow_mul_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem uu_pow_mul_eq_zero_of_lt [Infinite k] (hn : 0 < n) (d : ℕ) :
    ∀ (F : (space k n).Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike (space k n) F),
      (∀ x ∈ moduleSheafSupport F, height x < (d : ℕ∞)) →
      ∀ y : K0 (space k n), k0ToG0 (space k n) y = g0ClassOf (space k n) F hF →
        uu k n ^ d * y = 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherian (space k n) := SchemeProjectiveSpace.isNoetherian k n
  induction d with
  | zero =>
    intro F hF hsupp y hy
    have hz : IsZero F := isZero_of_forall_not_mem_support F fun x hx ↦ by
      have := hsupp x hx
      simp at this
    rw [isZero_g0ClassOf F hF hz] at hy
    have hy0 : y = 0 := (k0ToG0_bijective_field k n hn).1 (hy.trans (map_zero _).symm)
    rw [hy0, mul_zero]
  | succ d ih =>
    intro F hF hsupp y hy
    haveI : F.IsFinitePresentation := hF
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_good k n F
    let s := linSec k n c
    have hΛf := twistM1_isFiniteLocallyFree k n
    have hm : Mono ((KSpecialization.AR7R.sigmaT (twistM1 k n) s).app F) := by
      refine mono_sigmaT_of_isSMulRegular s (twistM1_locallyTrivial k n) hΛf F fun x ↦ ?_
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_mem_chartOpen k n x
      haveI := avoidSheaf_isFinitePresentation k n F false
      exact ⟨chartOpen k n i, hi, frame k n i,
        isSMulRegular_stalk_of_isAffineOpen (chartOpen_isAffine k n i) (avoidSheaf k n F false)
          (hc i false) hi⟩
    have hrel := g0ClassOf_eq_smul_add_cokernel s hΛf F hF hm
    set Q := cokernel ((KSpecialization.AR7R.sigmaT (twistM1 k n) s).app F) with hQdef
    have hQ := isCoherentLike_cokernel s hΛf F hF
    have hdim : ∀ x ∈ moduleSheafSupport F, height x ≤ (d : ℕ∞) := fun x hx ↦ by
      have := hsupp x hx
      rw [Nat.cast_succ] at this
      exact Order.le_of_lt_add_one this
    have hQsupp : ∀ x ∈ moduleSheafSupport Q, height x < (d : ℕ∞) := by
      intro x hxQ
      have hxF : x ∈ moduleSheafSupport F := mem_support_of_epi (cokernel.π _) hxQ
      rcases (hdim x hxF).lt_or_eq with hlt | heq
      · exact hlt
      · exfalso
        have hmax := maximal_of_height_eq_of_top F hdim heq hxF
        obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_mem_chartOpen k n x
        have hreg := isSMulRegular_stalk_of_isAffineOpen (chartOpen_isAffine k n i) F
          (hc i true) hi
        have hu := isUnit_of_isSMulRegular_of_maximal F hmax hreg
        exact not_mem_support_cokernel s hΛf F hi (frame k n i) hu hxQ
    have hyQ : k0ToG0 (space k n) (uu k n * y) = g0ClassOf (space k n) Q hQ := by
      rw [k0ToG0_mul, hy]
      have hcl : k0ClassOf (space k n) (twistM1 k n) hΛf = projectiveTwistingK0Class k n (-1) :=
        rfl
      rw [hcl] at hrel
      rw [add_smul, one_smul, neg_smul]
      rw [eq_sub_of_add_eq' hrel.symm, sub_eq_add_neg]
    have h := ih Q hQ hQsupp (uu k n * y) hyQ
    rw [pow_succ, mul_assoc]
    exact h

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.uPn_pow_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem uPn_pow_mul_eq_zero [Infinite k] (hn : 0 < n) (F : (space k n).Modules)
    (hF : IsCoherentLike (space k n) F) (d : ℕ)
    (hdim : ∀ x ∈ moduleSheafSupport F, height x ≤ d) (y : K0 (space k n))
    (hy : k0ToG0 (space k n) y = g0ClassOf (space k n) F hF) :
    RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingCycle.uPn k n ^ (d + 1) * y = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine uu_pow_mul_eq_zero_of_lt k n hn (d + 1) F hF (fun x hx ↦ ?_) y hy
  rw [Nat.cast_succ]
  exact Order.lt_add_one_iff_of_not_isMax (by simp) |>.mpr (hdim x hx)

name: RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.leadingCycleGate_of_g2
statement:
theorem leadingCycleGate_of_g2 [Infinite k] (hn : 0 < n) (hG2 : LeadingCycleGateG2 k n hn) :
    LeadingCycleGate k n hn
proof:
:=
  fun F hF d hdn hdim y hy ↦
    ⟨uPn_pow_mul_eq_zero k n hn F hF d hdim y hy, hG2 F hF d hdn hdim y hy⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.card_degree_eq_choose
statement:
theorem card_degree_eq_choose (n d : ℕ) :
    Nat.card {m : Fin (n + 1) →₀ ℕ | m.degree = d} = (d + n).choose n
proof:
:= by
  let e : {m : Fin (n + 1) →₀ ℕ | m.degree = d} ≃ Sym (Fin (n + 1)) d :=
    Equiv.subtypeEquiv Multiset.toFinsupp.symm.toEquiv fun m ↦ by
      change m.degree = d ↔ Multiset.card (Finsupp.toMultiset m) = d
      rw [Finsupp.card_toMultiset]
      rfl
  rw [Nat.card_congr e, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Sym.card_sym_eq_choose, Fintype.card_fin,
    show n + 1 + d - 1 = d + n by omega, Nat.choose_symm_add]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.finrank_degreePiece_eq_choose
statement:
theorem finrank_degreePiece_eq_choose (n d : ℕ) :
    Module.finrank k (degreePiece k n d) = (d + n).choose n
proof:
:= by
  change Module.finrank k (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) k d) = _
  rw [LinearEquiv.finrank_eq (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmoduleEquivFinsupp (Fin (n + 1)) k d)]
  haveI : Finite {m : Fin (n + 1) →₀ ℕ | m.degree = d} :=
    Finsupp.finite_setOf_degree_eq (Fin (n + 1)) d
  haveI : Fintype {m : Fin (n + 1) →₀ ℕ | m.degree = d} := Fintype.ofFinite _
  rw [Module.finrank_finsupp_self, ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  exact card_degree_eq_choose n d

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.eulerChar_projectiveTwistingSheaf_nat
statement:
theorem eulerChar_projectiveTwistingSheaf_nat (n d : ℕ) :
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n (d : ℤ)).eulerChar k = ((d + n).choose n : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Scheme.Modules.eulerChar
  rw [finsum_eq_single _ 0]
  · simp only [pow_zero, one_mul, Scheme.Modules.h]
    rw [LinearEquiv.finrank_eq (projectiveTwistingSheafHZeroLinearEquivDegreePiece k n d),
      finrank_degreePiece_eq_choose]
  · intro q hq
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hq
    haveI : Subsingleton (Scheme.Modules.H (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n (d : ℤ)) (p + 1)) :=
      AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf_H_isZero k n (d : ℤ) (by omega) p)
    simp [Scheme.Modules.h, Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.eulerChar_projectiveTwistingSheaf_of_neg
statement:
theorem eulerChar_projectiveTwistingSheaf_of_neg (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (d : ℤ)
    (hd : -(n : ℤ) ≤ d) (hd0 : d < 0) :
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).eulerChar k = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold Scheme.Modules.eulerChar
  refine finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero fun q ↦ ?_
  cases q with
  | zero =>
      haveI := projectiveTwistingSheaf_H_zero_subsingleton_of_neg k n hn d hd0
      simp [Scheme.Modules.h, Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton]
  | succ p =>
      haveI : Subsingleton (Scheme.Modules.H (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) (p + 1)) :=
        AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf_H_isZero k n d hd p)
      simp [Scheme.Modules.h, Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.eulerChar_projectivePlane_twist
statement:
theorem eulerChar_projectivePlane_twist (d : ℤ) (hd : -2 ≤ d) :
    2 * (projectiveTwistingSheaf k 2 d).eulerChar k = (d + 1) * (d + 2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl | rfl⟩ := Int.eq_nat_or_neg d
  · rw [eulerChar_projectiveTwistingSheaf_nat k 2 m, Nat.choose_two_right]
    have h2 : 2 ∣ (m + 2) * (m + 2 - 1) := by
      rw [show m + 2 - 1 = m + 1 by omega]
      exact (Nat.even_mul_succ_self (m + 1)).two_dvd |>.trans (by
        rw [show m + 1 + 1 = m + 2 by omega, mul_comm])
    have : ((((m + 2) * (m + 2 - 1) / 2 : ℕ)) : ℤ) * 2 = ((m + 2) * (m + 2 - 1) : ℕ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.div_mul_cancel h2
    rw [mul_comm, this, show m + 2 - 1 = m + 1 by omega]
    push_cast; ring
  · have hm : m = 0 ∨ m = 1 ∨ m = 2 := by omega
    rcases hm with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · have h0 := eulerChar_projectiveTwistingSheaf_nat k 2 0
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero] at h0 ⊢
      rw [h0]; decide
    · rw [eulerChar_projectiveTwistingSheaf_of_neg k 2 (by norm_num) _ (by norm_num)
        (by norm_num)]; norm_num
    · rw [eulerChar_projectiveTwistingSheaf_of_neg k 2 (by norm_num) _ (by norm_num)
        (by norm_num)]; norm_num

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.algebraMap_polynomial_injective'
statement:
theorem algebraMap_polynomial_injective' :
    Function.Injective (algebraMap k[X] W.CoordinateRing)
proof:

  exact AdjoinRoot.of.injective_of_degree_ne_zero
    (by rw [degree_polynomial]; exact (by decide : (2 : WithBot ℕ) ≠ 0))

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.derivative_polynomial
statement:

    derivative W.polynomial = W.polynomialY
proof:
:= by
  rw [polynomial, polynomialY]
  simp only [derivative_sub, derivative_add, derivative_pow, derivative_X, derivative_C,
    derivative_C_mul, mul_one, map_ofNat, map_natCast]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.polynomialY_ne_zero
statement: theorem polynomialY_ne_zero [W.IsElliptic] : W.polynomialY ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rw [polynomialY] at h
  have h1 : (C (2 : k) : k[X]) = 0 := by
    simpa using congr_arg (fun p => Polynomial.coeff p 1) h
  have h0 : (C W.a₁ * X + C W.a₃ : k[X]) = 0 := by
    simpa using congr_arg (fun p => Polynomial.coeff p 0) h
  have h2 : (2 : k) = 0 := Polynomial.C_eq_zero.mp h1
  have ha₁ : W.a₁ = 0 := by
    simpa using congr_arg (fun p => Polynomial.coeff p 1) h0
  have ha₃ : W.a₃ = 0 := by
    simpa using congr_arg (fun p => Polynomial.coeff p 0) h0
  have hΔ : W.Δ = 0 := by
    simp only [WeierstrassCurve.Δ, WeierstrassCurve.b₂, WeierstrassCurve.b₄,
      WeierstrassCurve.b₆, WeierstrassCurve.b₈, ha₁, ha₃]
    linear_combination (-32 * W.a₂ ^ 3 * W.a₆ + 8 * W.a₂ ^ 2 * W.a₄ ^ 2 - 32 * W.a₄ ^ 3
      - 216 * W.a₆ ^ 2 + 144 * W.a₂ * W.a₄ * W.a₆) * h2
  exact not_isUnit_zero (hΔ ▸ W.isUnit_Δ)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.aeval_yCoord
statement:
theorem aeval_yCoord :
    Polynomial.aeval (W.yCoord K) (W.polynomial.map (algebraMap k[X] k⟮X⟯)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : eval₂ (algebraMap k[X] K) (W.yCoord K) W.polynomial = 0 := by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k[X] W.CoordinateRing K, yCoord]
    show eval₂ ((algebraMap W.CoordinateRing K).comp (AdjoinRoot.of W.polynomial))
      ((algebraMap W.CoordinateRing K) (AdjoinRoot.root W.polynomial)) W.polynomial = 0
    rw [← Polynomial.hom_eval₂, AdjoinRoot.eval₂_root, map_zero]
  rw [Polynomial.aeval_def, Polynomial.eval₂_map, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k[X] k⟮X⟯ K]
  exact h1

:=
  ⟨W.polynomial.map (algebraMap k[X] k⟮X⟯), monic_polynomial.map _, by
