name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.negRoot_eq
statement:
lemma negRoot_eq : negRoot W =
    -AdjoinRoot.root W.polynomial -
      AdjoinRoot.of W.polynomial (C W.a₁ * X + C W.a₃)
proof:
:= by
  rw [negRoot, negPolynomial, map_sub, map_neg, AdjoinRoot.mk_X,
    AdjoinRoot.mk_C]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eval₂_negRoot
statement:
lemma eval₂_negRoot :
    W.polynomial.eval₂ (AdjoinRoot.of W.polynomial) (negRoot W) = 0
proof:
:= by
  calc
    W.polynomial.eval₂ (AdjoinRoot.of W.polynomial) (negRoot W) =
        W.polynomial.eval₂ (AdjoinRoot.of W.polynomial)
          (AdjoinRoot.root W.polynomial) := by
      rw [negRoot_eq, polynomial]
      simp only [eval₂_sub, eval₂_add, eval₂_mul, eval₂_pow, eval₂_X, eval₂_C]
      ring
    _ = 0 := AdjoinRoot.eval₂_root W.polynomial

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.coordinateNegRingHom_of
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coordinateNegRingHom_of (p : k[X]) :
    coordinateNegRingHom W (AdjoinRoot.of W.polynomial p) =
      AdjoinRoot.of W.polynomial p
proof:
:=
  AdjoinRoot.lift_of _

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.coordinateNegRingHom_root
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coordinateNegRingHom_root :
    coordinateNegRingHom W (AdjoinRoot.root W.polynomial) = negRoot W
proof:
:=
  AdjoinRoot.lift_root _

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.coordinateNegRingHom_negRoot
statement:
lemma coordinateNegRingHom_negRoot : coordinateNegRingHom W (negRoot W) =
    AdjoinRoot.root W.polynomial
proof:
:= by
  rw [negRoot_eq, map_sub, map_neg, coordinateNegRingHom_root,
    coordinateNegRingHom_of, negRoot_eq]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.coordinateNegRingHom_involutive
statement:
lemma coordinateNegRingHom_involutive :
    Function.Involutive (coordinateNegRingHom W)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  have hcomp : (coordinateNegRingHom W).comp (coordinateNegRingHom W) =
      RingHom.id _ := by
    apply AdjoinRoot.ringHom_ext
    · ext p
      all_goals simp [RingHom.comp_apply]
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, coordinateNegRingHom_root,
        coordinateNegRingHom_negRoot, RingHom.id_apply]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hcomp z

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.coordinateNegEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coordinateNegEquiv_apply (z : W.CoordinateRing) :
    coordinateNegEquiv W z = coordinateNegRingHom W z
proof: := rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.coordinateNegEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
lemma coordinateNegEquiv_symm_apply (z : W.CoordinateRing) :
    (coordinateNegEquiv W).symm z = coordinateNegEquiv W z
proof:
:= by
  apply (coordinateNegEquiv W).injective
  rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact (coordinateNegRingHom_involutive W z).symm

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.coordinateNegEquiv_XClass
statement:
lemma coordinateNegEquiv_XClass (x : k) :
    coordinateNegEquiv W (CoordinateRing.XClass W x) =
      CoordinateRing.XClass W x
proof:
:= by
  rw [CoordinateRing.XClass]
  change coordinateNegRingHom W
      (AdjoinRoot.of W.polynomial (X - C x)) = _
  simp

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.coordinateNegEquiv_YClass_neg
statement:
lemma coordinateNegEquiv_YClass_neg (x y : k) :
    coordinateNegEquiv W
        (CoordinateRing.YClass W (C (W.negY x y))) =
      -(CoordinateRing.YClass W (C y)) -
        algebraMap k[X] W.CoordinateRing (C W.a₁) *
          CoordinateRing.XClass W x
proof:
:= by
  rw [CoordinateRing.YClass]
  change coordinateNegRingHom W
      (AdjoinRoot.root W.polynomial -
        AdjoinRoot.of W.polynomial (C (W.negY x y))) = _
  rw [map_sub, coordinateNegRingHom_root, coordinateNegRingHom_of,
    negRoot_eq, CoordinateRing.YClass, CoordinateRing.XClass]
  change
    (-AdjoinRoot.root W.polynomial -
          AdjoinRoot.of W.polynomial (C W.a₁ * X + C W.a₃)) -
        AdjoinRoot.of W.polynomial (C (W.negY x y)) = _
  rw [negY]
  simp only [map_add, map_sub, map_mul, map_neg,
    AdjoinRoot.mk_X, AdjoinRoot.mk_C]
  rw [show algebraMap k[X] W.CoordinateRing (C W.a₁) =
    AdjoinRoot.of W.polynomial (C W.a₁) by rfl]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.coordinateNeg_equiv_heightOne
statement:
lemma coordinateNeg_equiv_heightOne [W.IsElliptic]
    {x y : k} (hP : W.Nonsingular x y) :
    IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.equivOfRingEquiv
        (coordinateNegEquiv W).toRingEquiv
        (Chart.affineHeightOne W hP) =
      Chart.affineHeightOne W ((W.nonsingular_neg x y).mpr hP)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.ext
  symm
  apply (Chart.XYIdeal_isMaximal W ((W.nonsingular_neg x y).mpr hP)).eq_of_le
    (Ideal.IsMaximal.ne_top inferInstance)
  rw [CoordinateRing.XYIdeal, Ideal.span_le]
  rintro z (rfl | hz)
  · change (coordinateNegEquiv W).symm (CoordinateRing.XClass W x) ∈
      CoordinateRing.XYIdeal W x (C y)
    rw [coordinateNegEquiv_symm_apply, coordinateNegEquiv_XClass]
    exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_insert _ _)
  · have hz' : z = CoordinateRing.YClass W (C (W.negY x y)) := by
      simpa using hz
    subst z
    change (coordinateNegEquiv W).symm
        (CoordinateRing.YClass W (C (W.negY x y))) ∈
      CoordinateRing.XYIdeal W x (C y)
    rw [coordinateNegEquiv_symm_apply, coordinateNegEquiv_YClass_neg]
    apply Ideal.sub_mem
    · exact (CoordinateRing.XYIdeal W x (C y)).neg_mem
        (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_singleton _)))
    · apply Ideal.mul_mem_left
      exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_insert _ _)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.valuationSubringAtPrime_equiv
statement:
private theorem valuationSubringAtPrime_equiv
    {R L : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDedekindDomain R]
    [Field L] [Algebra R L] [IsFractionRing R L]
    (h : R ≃+* R) (e : L ≃+* L)
    (he : ∀ r : R, e (algebraMap R L r) = algebraMap R L (h r))
    (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum R) :
    IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime L
        (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.equivOfRingEquiv h v) =
      (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime L v).comap
        e.symm.toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, s, hs, rfl⟩
    change e.symm
        (algebraMap R L a * (algebraMap R L s)⁻¹) ∈
      IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime L v
    refine ⟨h.symm a, h.symm s, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change h.symm s ∉ v.asIdeal
      change s ∉ v.asIdeal.comap h.symm
      exact hs
    · simp only [map_mul, map_inv₀]
      rw [show e.symm (algebraMap R L a) = algebraMap R L (h.symm a) by
        apply e.injective
        rw [e.apply_symm_apply, he, h.apply_symm_apply]]
      rw [show e.symm (algebraMap R L s) = algebraMap R L (h.symm s) by
        apply e.injective
        rw [e.apply_symm_apply, he, h.apply_symm_apply]]
  · intro hx
    change e.symm x ∈
      IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime L v at hx
    rcases hx with ⟨a, s, hs, hxs⟩
    refine ⟨h a, h s, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change h s ∉ v.asIdeal.comap h.symm
      simpa using hs
    · calc
        x = e (e.symm x) := (e.apply_symm_apply x).symm
        _ = e (algebraMap R L a * (algebraMap R L s)⁻¹) := by rw [hxs]
        _ = algebraMap R L (h a) * (algebraMap R L (h s))⁻¹ := by
          rw [map_mul, map_inv₀, he, he]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.functionFieldNegEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem functionFieldNegEquiv_algebraMap (z : W.CoordinateRing) :
    functionFieldNegEquiv W K (algebraMap W.CoordinateRing K z) =
      algebraMap W.CoordinateRing K (coordinateNegEquiv W z)
proof:
:=
  IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv_algebraMap (coordinateNegEquiv W) z

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.functionFieldNegEquiv_XK
statement:
@[simp]
theorem functionFieldNegEquiv_XK :
    functionFieldNegEquiv W K (XK k K) = XK k K
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Chart.xCoord_eq_XK W K, functionFieldNegEquiv_algebraMap]
  congr 1
  change coordinateNegRingHom W
      (AdjoinRoot.of W.polynomial X) = AdjoinRoot.of W.polynomial X
  simp

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.functionFieldNegEquiv_symm_XK
statement:
@[simp]
theorem functionFieldNegEquiv_symm_XK :
    (functionFieldNegEquiv W K).symm (XK k K) = XK k K
proof:
:= by
  apply (functionFieldNegEquiv W K).injective
  rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply, functionFieldNegEquiv_XK]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.functionFieldNegEquiv_finiteNegEquiv
statement:
theorem functionFieldNegEquiv_finiteNegEquiv (r : ringOfIntegers k K) :
    functionFieldNegEquiv W K (algebraMap (ringOfIntegers k K) K r) =
      algebraMap (ringOfIntegers k K) K (finiteNegEquiv W K r)
proof:
:= by
  let c := Chart.coordinateRingEquivIntegers W K
  let z : W.CoordinateRing := c.symm r
  have hz : c z = r := c.apply_symm_apply r
  have hc (q : W.CoordinateRing) :
      algebraMap (ringOfIntegers k K) K (c q) =
        algebraMap W.CoordinateRing K q :=
    IsIntegralClosure.algebraMap_equiv k[X] W.CoordinateRing K
      (ringOfIntegers k K) q
  calc
    functionFieldNegEquiv W K (algebraMap (ringOfIntegers k K) K r) =
        functionFieldNegEquiv W K (algebraMap W.CoordinateRing K z) := by
          rw [← hc z, hz]
    _ = algebraMap W.CoordinateRing K (coordinateNegEquiv W z) := by simp
    _ = algebraMap (ringOfIntegers k K) K
        (c (coordinateNegEquiv W z)) := (hc _).symm
    _ = algebraMap (ringOfIntegers k K) K (finiteNegEquiv W K r) := by
      rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finiteNegEquiv_heightOne
statement:
lemma finiteNegEquiv_heightOne {x y : k} (hP : W.Nonsingular x y) :
    IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.equivOfRingEquiv
        (finiteNegEquiv W K)
        (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.equivOfRingEquiv
          (Chart.coordinateRingEquivIntegers W K).toRingEquiv
          (Chart.affineHeightOne W hP)) =
      IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.equivOfRingEquiv
        (Chart.coordinateRingEquivIntegers W K).toRingEquiv
        (Chart.affineHeightOne W ((W.nonsingular_neg x y).mpr hP))
proof:
:= by
  let c := (Chart.coordinateRingEquivIntegers W K).toRingEquiv
  apply (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.equivOfRingEquiv c).symm.injective
  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hconj :
      (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.equivOfRingEquiv c).symm
          (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.equivOfRingEquiv
            (finiteNegEquiv W K)
            (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.equivOfRingEquiv c
              (Chart.affineHeightOne W hP))) =
        IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.equivOfRingEquiv
          (coordinateNegEquiv W).toRingEquiv
          (Chart.affineHeightOne W hP) := by
    apply IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.ext
    ext z
    simp [c, finiteNegEquiv,
      IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.equivOfRingEquiv,
      IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.comap]
  rw [hconj, coordinateNeg_equiv_heightOne]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.place_map_functionFieldNegEquiv_some
statement:
theorem place_map_functionFieldNegEquiv_some {x y : k}
    (hP : W.Nonsingular x y) :
    Place.map (functionFieldNegEquiv W K)
        (placeOfPoint W K (Point.some x y hP)) =
      placeOfPoint W K
        (Point.some x (W.negY x y) ((W.nonsingular_neg x y).mpr hP))
proof:
:= by
  let c := (Chart.coordinateRingEquivIntegers W K).toRingEquiv
  let v := IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.equivOfRingEquiv c
    (Chart.affineHeightOne W hP)
  let vneg := IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.equivOfRingEquiv c
    (Chart.affineHeightOne W ((W.nonsingular_neg x y).mpr hP))
  change Place.map (functionFieldNegEquiv W K)
      (Place.ofChart k K (Sum.inl v)) =
    Place.ofChart k K (Sum.inl vneg)
  apply Place.ext
  rw [Place.map_toValuationSubring, Place.ofChart_toValuationSubring]
  rw [Place.ofChart_valuation_eq]
  change
    ((v.valuation K).comap
        (functionFieldNegEquiv W K).symm.toRingEquiv.toRingHom).valuationSubring =
      (vneg.valuation K).valuationSubring
  change
    (v.valuation K).valuationSubring.comap
        (functionFieldNegEquiv W K).symm.toRingEquiv.toRingHom =
      (vneg.valuation K).valuationSubring
  rw [← IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime_eq_valuationSubring,
    ← IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime_eq_valuationSubring]
  have hvneg :
      IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.equivOfRingEquiv
          (finiteNegEquiv W K) v = vneg := by
    simpa [v, vneg, c] using finiteNegEquiv_heightOne W K hP
  rw [← hvneg]
  symm
  exact valuationSubringAtPrime_equiv (finiteNegEquiv W K)
    (functionFieldNegEquiv W K).toRingEquiv
    (functionFieldNegEquiv_finiteNegEquiv W K) v

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.place_map_functionFieldNegEquiv_zero
statement:
theorem place_map_functionFieldNegEquiv_zero :
    Place.map (functionFieldNegEquiv W K) (placeOfPoint W K 0) =
      placeOfPoint W K 0
proof:
:= by
  let vmap := Place.map (functionFieldNegEquiv W K) (placeOfPoint W K 0)
  have hdeg : vmap.degree = 1 := by
    rw [Place.degree_map]
    exact placeOfPoint_deg_one W K 0
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := exists_point_of_place_degree_one W K vmap hdeg
  cases P with
  | zero => exact hP
  | some x y hxy =>
      have hgt : 1 < vmap.valuation (XK k K) := by
        dsimp only [vmap]
        rw [Place.map_valuation_eq]
        change 1 < (placeOfPoint W K 0).valuation
          ((functionFieldNegEquiv W K).symm (XK k K))
        rw [functionFieldNegEquiv_symm_XK]
        change 1 < (Place.ofChart k K (Chart.infinityPlace K)).valuation (XK k K)
        rw [Place.ofChart_valuation_eq]
        exact _root_.FunctionField.Place.infinite_X_gt_one k K
          (Chart.infinityHeightOne (k := k) K)
      let c := (Chart.coordinateRingEquivIntegers W K).toRingEquiv
      let vf := IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.equivOfRingEquiv c
        (Chart.affineHeightOne W hxy)
      have hle : (placeOfPoint W K (Point.some x y hxy)).valuation (XK k K) ≤ 1 := by
        change (Place.ofChart k K (Sum.inl vf)).valuation (XK k K) ≤ 1
        rw [Place.ofChart_valuation_eq]
        exact Place.finite_X_le_one k K vf
      rw [hP] at hgt
      exact (not_le_of_gt hgt hle).elim

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.pointMap_functionFieldNegEquiv
statement:
theorem pointMap_functionFieldNegEquiv (P : W.Point) :
    pointMap W K (functionFieldNegEquiv W K) P = -P
proof:
:= by
  apply placeOfPoint_injective W K
  rw [placeOfPoint_pointMap]
  cases P with
  | zero =>
      change Place.map (functionFieldNegEquiv W K) (placeOfPoint W K (0 : W.Point)) =
        placeOfPoint W K (-(0 : W.Point))
      rw [Point.neg_zero]
      exact place_map_functionFieldNegEquiv_zero W K
  | some x y hxy =>
      simpa only [Point.neg_some] using
        place_map_functionFieldNegEquiv_some W K hxy

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.picZeroAction_functionFieldNegEquiv
statement:
theorem picZeroAction_functionFieldNegEquiv :
    picZeroAction (functionFieldNegEquiv W K) = AddEquiv.neg _
proof:
:= by
  apply picZeroAction_eq_neg_of_pointAbelJacobi_add_pointMap_const W K
  intro P
  rw [pointMap_functionFieldNegEquiv, pointMap_functionFieldNegEquiv]
  simp

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.placeOfPoint_injective
statement: theorem placeOfPoint_injective : Function.Injective (placeOfPoint W K)
proof:
:= by
  intro P Q hPQ
  have hchart : Chart.placeOfPoint W K P = Chart.placeOfPoint W K Q := by
    apply (chartToPlace k K).injective
    simpa only [placeOfPoint] using hPQ
  have hsub :
      (⟨Chart.placeOfPoint W K P, Chart.placeOfPoint_deg_one W K P⟩ :
        {v : PlaceA k K // placeDegree k K v = 1}) =
      ⟨Chart.placeOfPoint W K Q, Chart.placeOfPoint_deg_one W K Q⟩ :=
    Subtype.ext hchart
  have hclass := congrArg (Chart.Internal.degreeOneClass W K) hsub
  rw [Chart.Internal.degreeOneClass_placeOfPoint,
    Chart.Internal.degreeOneClass_placeOfPoint] at hclass
  apply Point.toClass_injective
  exact Additive.toMul.injective hclass

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.placeOfPoint_pointMap
statement:
theorem placeOfPoint_pointMap (e : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (P : W.Point) :
    placeOfPoint W K (pointMap W K e P) = Place.map e (placeOfPoint W K P)
proof:
:= by
  change ((pointEquivDegreeOnePlace W K)
    ((pointEquivDegreeOnePlace W K).symm
      (degreeOnePlaceMap (k := k) K e (pointEquivDegreeOnePlace W K P)))).1 = _
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.pointMap_refl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pointMap_refl (P : W.Point) :
    pointMap W K (AlgEquiv.refl : K ≃ₐ[k] K) P = P
proof:
:= by
  apply placeOfPoint_injective W K
  rw [placeOfPoint_pointMap]
  simp

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.pointMap_trans
statement:
theorem pointMap_trans (e f : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (P : W.Point) :
    pointMap W K f (pointMap W K e P) = pointMap W K (e.trans f) P
proof:
:= by
  apply placeOfPoint_injective W K
  rw [placeOfPoint_pointMap, placeOfPoint_pointMap,
    placeOfPoint_pointMap, Place.map_trans]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.pointMap_involutive
statement:
theorem pointMap_involutive (e : K ≃ₐ[k] K)
    (he : e.trans e = AlgEquiv.refl) : Function.Involutive (pointMap W K e)
proof:
:= by
  intro P
  rw [pointMap_trans, he]
  exact pointMap_refl W K P

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.intrinsicFiniteClass_single_placeOfPoint
statement:
theorem intrinsicFiniteClass_single_placeOfPoint (P : W.Point) :
    intrinsicFiniteClass W K (Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K P) 1) =
      Point.toClass P
proof:
:= by
  have hsingle :
      (divisorEquivChart k K).symm (Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K P) 1) =
        Finsupp.single (Chart.placeOfPoint W K P) 1 := by
    apply (divisorEquivChart k K).injective
    rw [AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    simp [divisorEquivChart, placeOfPoint]
  apply Additive.toMul.injective
  simpa [intrinsicFiniteClass, Chart.Internal.degreeOneClass, hsingle] using
    Chart.Internal.degreeOneClass_placeOfPoint W K P

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.intrinsicFiniteClass_principal
statement:
theorem intrinsicFiniteClass_principal (x : Kˣ) :
    intrinsicFiniteClass W K (principalDivisor k K (Additive.ofMul x)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [intrinsicFiniteClass, principalDivisor,
    Chart.Internal.finiteDivisorClass_principal]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisorClassPointClass_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem divisorClassPointClass_mk (D : Divisor k K) :
    divisorClassPointClass W K
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DivisorClassGroup (k := k) (K := K)) =
      intrinsicFiniteClass W K D
proof: := rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.picZeroPointClass_pointAbelJacobi
statement:
@[simp]
theorem picZeroPointClass_pointAbelJacobi (P : W.Point) :
    picZeroPointClass W K (pointAbelJacobi W K P) = Point.toClass P
proof:
:= by
  simp [picZeroPointClass, pointAbelJacobi,
    intrinsicFiniteClass_single_placeOfPoint]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.pointAbelJacobi_surjective
statement:
theorem pointAbelJacobi_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (pointAbelJacobi W K)
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective
    (PrincipalDivisors (k := k) (K := K)) q.1
  let Dchart : DivisorA k K := (divisorEquivChart k K).symm D
  have hdegD : Chart.deg k K Dchart = 0 := by
    have hq := q.2
    change divisorClassDegree q.1 = 0 at hq
    rw [← hD] at hq
    change divisorClassDegree
      (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DivisorClassGroup (k := k) (K := K)) = 0 at hq
    rw [divisorClassDegree_mk] at hq
    calc
      Chart.deg k K Dchart = Divisor.deg k K (divisorEquivChart k K Dchart) :=
        (Divisor.deg_equivChart k K Dchart).symm
      _ = Divisor.deg k K D := by
        rw [show divisorEquivChart k K Dchart = D by
          exact (divisorEquivChart k K).apply_symm_apply D]
      _ = 0 := hq
  let E : DivisorA k K := Dchart +
    Finsupp.single (Chart.placeOfPoint W K 0) 1
  have hdegE : Chart.deg k K E = 1 := by
    simp only [E, Chart.deg_add, hdegD, Chart.deg_single,
      Chart.placeOfPoint_deg_one, zero_add]
    norm_num
  have hellE : Chart.ell k K E = 1 :=
    Chart.ell_eq_one_of_deg_one (k := k) (K := K)
      (Chart.divOmega_invariant_differential W K) E
      (Chart.genus_eq_one W K) hdegE
  obtain ⟨f, heff⟩ := Chart.exists_effective_add_principal_of_ell_pos
    (k := k) (K := K) E (by omega)
  let Deff : DivisorA k K :=
    E + Chart.principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul f)
  have hdegEff : Chart.deg k K Deff = 1 := by
    simp only [Deff, Chart.deg_add, hdegE,
      Chart.deg_principalDivisorA_eq_zero, add_zero]
  obtain ⟨v, hvdeg, hv⟩ :=
    Chart.Internal.eq_single_of_effective_deg_one (k := k) K heff hdegEff
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := Chart.exists_point_of_place_degree_one W K v hvdeg
  refine ⟨P, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [← hD]
  apply QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem.mpr
  refine ⟨Additive.ofMul f, ?_⟩
  change
    principalDivisor k K (Additive.ofMul f) =
      Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K P) 1 -
        Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K 0) 1 - D
  have hv' :
      E + Chart.principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul f) =
        Finsupp.single (Chart.placeOfPoint W K P) 1 := by
    rw [hv, hP]
  dsimp only [E, Dchart] at hv'
  have hvIntrinsic :
      D + Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K 0) 1 +
          principalDivisor k K (Additive.ofMul f) =
        Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K P) 1 := by
    have h := congrArg (divisorEquivChart k K) hv'
    simp only [map_add, AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
    simpa [principalDivisor, placeOfPoint, divisorEquivChart] using h
  rw [← hvIntrinsic]
  abel

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.picZeroPointClass_injective
statement:
theorem picZeroPointClass_injective :
    Function.Injective (picZeroPointClass W K)
proof:
:= by
  intro q r hqr
  obtain ⟨P, rfl⟩ := pointAbelJacobi_surjective W K q
  obtain ⟨Q, rfl⟩ := pointAbelJacobi_surjective W K r
  apply congrArg (pointAbelJacobi W K)
  apply Point.toClass_injective
  simpa using hqr

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.pointAbelJacobi_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pointAbelJacobi_zero :
    pointAbelJacobi W K 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply picZeroPointClass_injective W K
  rw [map_zero, picZeroPointClass_pointAbelJacobi]
  exact map_zero Point.toClass

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.pointAbelJacobi_add
statement:
theorem pointAbelJacobi_add (P Q : W.Point) :
    pointAbelJacobi W K (P + Q) =
      pointAbelJacobi W K P + pointAbelJacobi W K Q
proof:
:= by
  apply picZeroPointClass_injective W K
  rw [map_add, picZeroPointClass_pointAbelJacobi,
    picZeroPointClass_pointAbelJacobi, picZeroPointClass_pointAbelJacobi]
  exact map_add Point.toClass P Q

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.pointAbelJacobi_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pointAbelJacobi_neg (P : W.Point) :
    pointAbelJacobi W K (-P) = -pointAbelJacobi W K P
proof:
:= by
  apply picZeroPointClass_injective W K
  rw [map_neg, picZeroPointClass_pointAbelJacobi,
    picZeroPointClass_pointAbelJacobi]
  exact map_neg Point.toClass P

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.pointAbelJacobi_add_eq_of_principalDivisor
statement:
theorem pointAbelJacobi_add_eq_of_principalDivisor
    (P Q R S : W.Point) (u : Kˣ)
    (hdiv : principalDivisor k K (Additive.ofMul u) =
      Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K P) 1 +
        Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K Q) 1 -
          Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K R) 1 -
            Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K S) 1) :
    pointAbelJacobi W K P + pointAbelJacobi W K Q =
      pointAbelJacobi W K R + pointAbelJacobi W K S
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change
    (QuotientAddGroup.mk
      (Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K P) 1 -
        Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K 0) 1) :
        DivisorClassGroup (k := k) (K := K)) +
      QuotientAddGroup.mk
        (Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K Q) 1 -
          Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K 0) 1) =
    (QuotientAddGroup.mk
      (Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K R) 1 -
        Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K 0) 1) :
        DivisorClassGroup (k := k) (K := K)) +
      QuotientAddGroup.mk
        (Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K S) 1 -
          Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K 0) 1)
  rw [← QuotientAddGroup.mk_add, ← QuotientAddGroup.mk_add,
    QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem]
  change
    ((Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K P) 1 -
        Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K 0) 1) +
      (Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K Q) 1 -
        Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K 0) 1)) -
      ((Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K R) 1 -
          Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K 0) 1) +
        (Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K S) 1 -
          Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K 0) 1)) ∈
      AddMonoidHom.range (principalDivisor k K)
  refine ⟨Additive.ofMul u, ?_⟩
  rw [hdiv]
  abel

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.pointAbelJacobi_add_const_of_fiber_principal
statement:
theorem pointAbelJacobi_add_const_of_fiber_principal
    (σ : W.Point → W.Point)
    (hfiber : ∀ P : W.Point, ∃ u : Kˣ,
      principalDivisor k K (Additive.ofMul u) =
        Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K P) 1 +
          Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K (σ P)) 1 -
            Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K 0) 1 -
              Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K (σ 0)) 1) :
    ∀ P : W.Point,
      pointAbelJacobi W K P + pointAbelJacobi W K (σ P) =
        pointAbelJacobi W K (σ 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro P
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hfiber P
  simpa using
    pointAbelJacobi_add_eq_of_principalDivisor W K P (σ P) 0 (σ 0) u hu

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.pointAbelJacobiEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pointAbelJacobiEquiv_apply (P : W.Point) :
    pointAbelJacobiEquiv W K P = pointAbelJacobi W K P
proof: := rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.pointMap_eq_sub_of_pointAbelJacobi_add_const
statement:
theorem pointMap_eq_sub_of_pointAbelJacobi_add_const
    (σ : W.Point → W.Point)
    (hconst : ∀ P : W.Point,
      pointAbelJacobi W K P + pointAbelJacobi W K (σ P) =
        pointAbelJacobi W K (σ 0)) (P : W.Point) :
    σ P = σ 0 - P
proof:
:= by
  apply (pointAbelJacobiEquiv W K).injective
  rw [map_sub]
  change pointAbelJacobi W K (σ P) =
    pointAbelJacobi W K (σ 0) - pointAbelJacobi W K P
  rw [eq_sub_iff_add_eq]
  simpa only [add_comm] using hconst P

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.pointMap_is_reflection_of_pointAbelJacobi_add_const
statement:
theorem pointMap_is_reflection_of_pointAbelJacobi_add_const
    (σ : W.Point → W.Point)
    (hconst : ∀ P : W.Point,
      pointAbelJacobi W K P + pointAbelJacobi W K (σ P) =
        pointAbelJacobi W K (σ 0)) :
    ∃ C : W.Point, ∀ P, σ P = C - P
proof:
:=
  ⟨σ 0, pointMap_eq_sub_of_pointAbelJacobi_add_const W K σ hconst⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.pointAbelJacobi_pointMap
statement:
theorem pointAbelJacobi_pointMap (e : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (P : W.Point) :
    picZeroAction e (pointAbelJacobi W K P) =
      pointAbelJacobi W K (pointMap W K e P) -
        pointAbelJacobi W K (pointMap W K e 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change divisorClassActionHom e
      (QuotientAddGroup.mk
        (Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K P) 1 -
          Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K 0) 1)) = _
  rw [divisorClassActionHom_mk]
  simp only [map_sub, Divisor.map_single]
  rw [← placeOfPoint_pointMap, ← placeOfPoint_pointMap]
  simp only [pointAbelJacobi]
  change
    (QuotientAddGroup.mk
      (Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K (pointMap W K e P)) 1 -
        Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K (pointMap W K e 0)) 1) :
      DivisorClassGroup (k := k) (K := K)) =
    (QuotientAddGroup.mk
      (Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K (pointMap W K e P)) 1 -
        Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K 0) 1) :
      DivisorClassGroup (k := k) (K := K)) -
    (QuotientAddGroup.mk
      (Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K (pointMap W K e 0)) 1 -
        Finsupp.single (placeOfPoint W K 0) 1) :
      DivisorClassGroup (k := k) (K := K))
  rw [← QuotientAddGroup.mk_sub]
  congr 1
  abel

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.picZeroAction_eq_neg_of_pointAbelJacobi_add_pointMap_const
statement:
theorem picZeroAction_eq_neg_of_pointAbelJacobi_add_pointMap_const
    (e : K ≃ₐ[k] K)
    (hconst : ∀ P : W.Point,
      pointAbelJacobi W K P + pointAbelJacobi W K (pointMap W K e P) =
        pointAbelJacobi W K (pointMap W K e 0)) :
    picZeroAction e = AddEquiv.neg _
proof:
:= by
  apply AddEquiv.ext
  intro q
  obtain ⟨P, rfl⟩ := pointAbelJacobi_surjective W K q
  change picZeroAction e (pointAbelJacobi W K P) =
    -pointAbelJacobi W K P
  rw [pointAbelJacobi_pointMap]
  have h := hconst P
  rw [← h, add_comm (pointAbelJacobi W K P),
    sub_add_eq_sub_sub, sub_self, zero_sub]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.pointMap_eq_sub_of_picZeroAction_eq_neg
statement:
theorem pointMap_eq_sub_of_picZeroAction_eq_neg (e : K ≃ₐ[k] K)
    (hneg : picZeroAction e = AddEquiv.neg _) (P : W.Point) :
    pointMap W K e P = pointMap W K e 0 - P
proof:
:= by
  apply Point.toClass_injective
  have h := pointAbelJacobi_pointMap W K e P
  rw [hneg] at h
  have hclass := congrArg (picZeroPointClass W K) h
  simp only [AddEquiv.neg_apply, map_neg, map_sub,
    picZeroPointClass_pointAbelJacobi] at hclass
  rw [map_sub]
  simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using
    (sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hclass.symm)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.pointMap_is_reflection_of_picZeroAction_eq_neg
statement:
theorem pointMap_is_reflection_of_picZeroAction_eq_neg (e : K ≃ₐ[k] K)
    (hneg : picZeroAction e = AddEquiv.neg _) :
    ∃ C : W.Point, ∀ P, pointMap W K e P = C - P
proof:
:=
  ⟨pointMap W K e 0, pointMap_eq_sub_of_picZeroAction_eq_neg W K e hneg⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.xPolynomial_eq_neg_swap
statement:
lemma xPolynomial_eq_neg_swap (W : WeierstrassCurve.Affine k) :
    xPolynomial W = -Polynomial.Bivariate.swap W.polynomial
proof:
:= by
  rw [xPolynomial, polynomial, Cubic.toPoly]
  simp only [map_add, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow, map_one, one_mul,
    Polynomial.Bivariate.swap_Y, Polynomial.Bivariate.swap_C,
    Polynomial.map_C, Polynomial.map_X]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.xPolynomial_monic
statement: lemma xPolynomial_monic (W : WeierstrassCurve.Affine k) : (xPolynomial W).Monic
proof:
:= by
  rw [xPolynomial]
  exact Cubic.monic_of_a_eq_one'

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.xAdjoinRootEquiv_mk
statement:
lemma xAdjoinRootEquiv_mk (W : WeierstrassCurve.Affine k) (q : k[X][Y]) :
    xAdjoinRootEquiv W (AdjoinRoot.mk (xPolynomial W) q) =
      CoordinateRing.mk W (Polynomial.Bivariate.swap q)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.coordinate_mk_eq_eval₂
statement:
lemma coordinate_mk_eq_eval₂ (W : WeierstrassCurve.Affine k) (q : k[X][Y]) :
    CoordinateRing.mk W q =
      eval₂ (eval₂RingHom (algebraMap k W.CoordinateRing)
        (CoordinateRing.mk W (C X))) (CoordinateRing.mk W Y) q
proof:
:= by
  change (CoordinateRing.mk W) q =
    (eval₂RingHom (eval₂RingHom (algebraMap k W.CoordinateRing)
      (CoordinateRing.mk W (C X))) (CoordinateRing.mk W Y)) q
  apply congrArg (fun f : k[X][Y] →+* W.CoordinateRing => f q)
  apply Polynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro p
    rw [AdjoinRoot.mk_C]
    change (AdjoinRoot.of W.polynomial) p =
      eval₂ (eval₂RingHom (algebraMap k W.CoordinateRing)
        (CoordinateRing.mk W (C X))) (CoordinateRing.mk W Y) (C p)
    rw [eval₂_C]
    apply congrArg (fun f : k[X] →+* W.CoordinateRing => f p)
    apply Polynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro a
      simp [CoordinateRing.mk,
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k k[X] W.CoordinateRing]
    · simp [CoordinateRing.mk]
  · simp [CoordinateRing.mk]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.coordinate_polynomialX_eval
statement:
lemma coordinate_polynomialX_eval (W : WeierstrassCurve.Affine k) :
    (W⁄W.CoordinateRing).polynomialX.evalEval
      (CoordinateRing.mk W (C X)) (CoordinateRing.mk W Y) =
        CoordinateRing.mk W W.polynomialX
proof:
:= by
  change (W.map (algebraMap k W.CoordinateRing)).polynomialX.evalEval _ _ = _
  rw [map_polynomialX]
  rw [← Polynomial.eval₂_eval₂RingHom_apply]
  exact (coordinate_mk_eq_eval₂ W W.polynomialX).symm

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.coordinate_polynomialY_eval
statement:
lemma coordinate_polynomialY_eval (W : WeierstrassCurve.Affine k) :
    (W⁄W.CoordinateRing).polynomialY.evalEval
      (CoordinateRing.mk W (C X)) (CoordinateRing.mk W Y) =
        CoordinateRing.mk W W.polynomialY
proof:
:= by
  change (W.map (algebraMap k W.CoordinateRing)).polynomialY.evalEval _ _ = _
  rw [map_polynomialY]
  rw [← Polynomial.eval₂_eval₂RingHom_apply]
  exact (coordinate_mk_eq_eval₂ W W.polynomialY).symm

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.coordinate_equation
statement:
lemma coordinate_equation (W : WeierstrassCurve.Affine k) :
    (W⁄W.CoordinateRing).Equation
      (CoordinateRing.mk W (C X)) (CoordinateRing.mk W Y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [equation_iff]
  have h : CoordinateRing.mk W W.polynomial = 0 := AdjoinRoot.mk_self
  simp only [polynomial, map_add, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow] at h
  convert sub_eq_zero.mp h using 1 <;>
    simp [WeierstrassCurve.baseChange, WeierstrassCurve.map,
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k k[X] W.CoordinateRing] ; ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.derivative_polynomial_eq
statement:
lemma derivative_polynomial_eq (W : WeierstrassCurve.Affine k) :
    W.polynomial.derivative = W.polynomialY
proof:
:= by
  rw [polynomial, polynomialY]
  simp only [derivative_add, derivative_sub, derivative_pow, derivative_X,
    derivative_mul, derivative_C, zero_mul]
  norm_num
  have h2 : (2 : k[X]) = C (2 : k) := (map_ofNat C 2).symm
  exact h2

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.xPolynomial_derivative_eq
statement:
lemma xPolynomial_derivative_eq (W : WeierstrassCurve.Affine k) :
    (xPolynomial W).derivative = -Polynomial.Bivariate.swap W.polynomialX
proof:
:= by
  rw [xPolynomial, polynomialX, Cubic.toPoly]
  simp only [derivative_add, derivative_pow, derivative_X,
    derivative_mul, derivative_C, zero_mul, add_zero]
  simp only [map_ofNat, C_1, one_mul, map_add, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow,
    Polynomial.Bivariate.swap_C, Polynomial.Bivariate.swap_Y,
    Polynomial.map_C, Polynomial.map_X]
  norm_num
  have h2 : (2 : k[X][Y]) = C (2 : k[X]) := (map_ofNat C 2).symm
  have h3 : (3 : k[X][Y]) = C (3 : k[X]) := (map_ofNat C 3).symm
  rw [h2, h3]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.xAdjoinRootEquiv_neg_swap_polynomialX
statement:
lemma xAdjoinRootEquiv_neg_swap_polynomialX (W : WeierstrassCurve.Affine k) :
    xAdjoinRootEquiv W (AdjoinRoot.mk (xPolynomial W)
      (-Polynomial.Bivariate.swap W.polynomialX)) =
      -CoordinateRing.mk W W.polynomialX
proof:
:= by
  have hcore : xAdjoinRootEquiv W
      (AdjoinRoot.mk (xPolynomial W) (Polynomial.Bivariate.swap W.polynomialX)) =
        CoordinateRing.mk W W.polynomialX := by
    rw [xAdjoinRootEquiv_mk, Polynomial.Bivariate.swap_swap_apply]
  calc
    xAdjoinRootEquiv W
        (AdjoinRoot.mk (xPolynomial W) (-Polynomial.Bivariate.swap W.polynomialX)) =
      xAdjoinRootEquiv W
        (-(AdjoinRoot.mk (xPolynomial W) (Polynomial.Bivariate.swap W.polynomialX))) := by
          rw [map_neg]
    _ = -xAdjoinRootEquiv W
        (AdjoinRoot.mk (xPolynomial W) (Polynomial.Bivariate.swap W.polynomialX)) := map_neg _ _
    _ = -CoordinateRing.mk W W.polynomialX := congrArg Neg.neg hcore

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.coordinate_derivatives_not_both_mem
statement:
lemma coordinate_derivatives_not_both_mem (W : WeierstrassCurve.Affine k) [W.IsElliptic]
    (P : Ideal W.CoordinateRing) [P.IsPrime] :
    CoordinateRing.mk W W.polynomialX ∉ P ∨ CoordinateRing.mk W W.polynomialY ∉ P
proof:
:= by
  let L := P.ResidueField
  let f : W.CoordinateRing →+* L := algebraMap W.CoordinateRing L
  let x : L := algebraMap W.CoordinateRing L (CoordinateRing.mk W (C X))
  let y : L := algebraMap W.CoordinateRing L (CoordinateRing.mk W Y)
  letI : (W⁄W.CoordinateRing).IsElliptic := by
    change (W.map (algebraMap k W.CoordinateRing)).IsElliptic
    infer_instance
  letI : ((W⁄W.CoordinateRing).map f).IsElliptic := by infer_instance
  have hEq : ((W⁄W.CoordinateRing).map f).Equation x y := by
    simpa [x, y, f] using (coordinate_equation W).map f
  have hns : ((W⁄W.CoordinateRing).map f).Nonsingular x y :=
    (((W⁄W.CoordinateRing).map f).equation_iff_nonsingular).mp hEq
  rw [Nonsingular] at hns
  rcases hns.2 with hx | hy
  · left
    intro hmem
    apply hx
    rw [map_polynomialX, map_mapRingHom_evalEval, coordinate_polynomialX_eval]
    exact Ideal.algebraMap_residueField_eq_zero.mpr hmem
  · right
    intro hmem
    apply hy
    rw [map_polynomialY, map_mapRingHom_evalEval, coordinate_polynomialY_eval]
    exact Ideal.algebraMap_residueField_eq_zero.mpr hmem

name: AdjoinRoot.isUnramifiedAt_of_monic_derivative_not_mem
statement:
theorem isUnramifiedAt_of_monic_derivative_not_mem (f : R[X]) (hf : f.Monic)
    (P : Ideal (AdjoinRoot f)) [P.IsPrime]
    (hP : AdjoinRoot.mk f f.derivative ∉ P) :
    Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt R P
proof:
:= by
  let Q : StandardEtalePair R :=
    ⟨f, hf, f.derivative, 1, 0, 1, by simp⟩
  have hfu : Algebra.FormallyUnramified R
      (Localization.Away (AdjoinRoot.mk f f.derivative)) := by
    exact Algebra.FormallyUnramified.of_equiv Q.equivAwayAdjoinRoot
  have hopen := (Algebra.basicOpen_subset_unramifiedLocus_iff (R := R)
    (A := AdjoinRoot f) (f := AdjoinRoot.mk f f.derivative)).mpr hfu
  have hmem : (⟨P, inferInstance⟩ : PrimeSpectrum (AdjoinRoot f)) ∈
      PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (AdjoinRoot.mk f f.derivative) := by
    simpa using hP
  exact hopen hmem

name: AdjoinRoot.isDiscreteValuationRing_atPrime_of_derivative_not_mem
statement:
theorem isDiscreteValuationRing_atPrime_of_derivative_not_mem
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsPrincipalIdealRing R]
    (f : R[X]) (hf : f.Monic) [IsDomain (AdjoinRoot f)]
    (P : Ideal (AdjoinRoot f)) [P.IsPrime] (hP0 : P ≠ ⊥)
    (hP : AdjoinRoot.mk f f.derivative ∉ P) :
    IsDiscreteValuationRing (Localization.AtPrime P)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Finite R (AdjoinRoot f) := hf.finite_adjoinRoot
  letI : IsNoetherianRing (AdjoinRoot f) := IsNoetherianRing.of_finite R _
  letI : IsNoetherianRing (Localization.AtPrime P) :=
    IsLocalization.isNoetherianRing P.primeCompl _ inferInstance
  letI : Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt R P :=
    isUnramifiedAt_of_monic_derivative_not_mem f hf P hP
  let p := P.under R
  letI := Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver p P
  have hmap : p.map (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime P)) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P) :=
    ((Algebra.isUnramifiedAt_iff_map_eq R p P).mp inferInstance).2
  haveI : p.IsPrincipal := IsPrincipalIdealRing.principal p
  have hprincipal : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)).IsPrincipal := by
    rw [← hmap]
    infer_instance
  exact ((IsDiscreteValuationRing.TFAE (Localization.AtPrime P)
    (IsLocalization.AtPrime.not_isField (AdjoinRoot f) hP0
      (Localization.AtPrime P))).out 4 0).mp hprincipal

name: AdjoinRoot.isDiscreteValuationRing_atPrime_of_derivative_eq_not_mem
statement:
theorem isDiscreteValuationRing_atPrime_of_derivative_eq_not_mem
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsPrincipalIdealRing R]
    (f : R[X]) (hf : f.Monic) [IsDomain (AdjoinRoot f)]
    (q : R[X]) (hder : f.derivative = q)
    (P : Ideal (AdjoinRoot f)) [P.IsPrime] (hP0 : P ≠ ⊥)
    (hP : AdjoinRoot.mk f q ∉ P) :
    IsDiscreteValuationRing (Localization.AtPrime P)
proof:
:= by
  apply isDiscreteValuationRing_atPrime_of_derivative_not_mem f hf P hP0
  rwa [hder]

name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.of_ringEquiv_of_not_isField
statement:
theorem of_ringEquiv_of_not_isField {A B : Type*}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [IsDomain A] [IsDomain B]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing A] [IsLocalRing B]
    (e : A ≃+* B) (hB : ¬IsField B) : IsDiscreteValuationRing B
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsPrincipalIdealRing B :=
    { principal := fun I => by
        let J := I.comap e.toRingHom
        haveI : J.IsPrincipal := IsPrincipalIdealRing.principal J
        have hJI : J.map e.toRingHom = I :=
          Ideal.map_comap_eq_self_of_equiv e I
        rw [← hJI]
        infer_instance }
  exact { not_a_field' := IsLocalRing.isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq.not.mp hB }

name: IsDiscreteValuationRing.atPrime_of_comap_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem atPrime_of_comap_ringEquiv {A B : Type*}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [IsDomain A] [IsDomain B]
    (e : A ≃+* B) (P : Ideal B) [P.IsPrime] (hP0 : P ≠ ⊥)
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing (Localization.AtPrime (P.comap e.toRingHom))] :
    IsDiscreteValuationRing (Localization.AtPrime P)
proof:
:= by
  have hmon : Submonoid.map e.toMonoidHom (P.comap e.toRingHom).primeCompl =
      P.primeCompl := e.map_primeCompl_comap_eq P
  let eLoc : Localization.AtPrime (P.comap e.toRingHom) ≃+* Localization.AtPrime P :=
    IsLocalization.ringEquivOfRingEquiv
      (M := (P.comap e.toRingHom).primeCompl) (T := P.primeCompl)
      _ _ e hmon
  exact of_ringEquiv_of_not_isField eLoc
    (IsLocalization.AtPrime.not_isField B hP0 _)

name: not_mem_comap_of_image_eq
statement:
private theorem not_mem_comap_of_image_eq {A B : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (e : A ≃+* B) (P : Ideal B) (x : A) (y : B) (hxy : e x = y) (hy : y ∉ P) :
    x ∉ P.comap e.toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  intro hx
  exact hy (hxy ▸ hx)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.isDiscreteValuationRing_atPrime_of_polynomialY_not_mem
statement:
theorem isDiscreteValuationRing_atPrime_of_polynomialY_not_mem
    (P : Ideal W.CoordinateRing) [P.IsPrime] (hP0 : P ≠ ⊥)
    (hY : CoordinateRing.mk W W.polynomialY ∉ P) :
    IsDiscreteValuationRing (Localization.AtPrime P)
proof:
:= by
  apply AdjoinRoot.isDiscreteValuationRing_atPrime_of_derivative_not_mem
    W.polynomial W.monic_polynomial P hP0
  rwa [derivative_polynomial_eq]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.x_comap_ne_bot
statement:
theorem x_comap_ne_bot (P : Ideal W.CoordinateRing) (hP0 : P ≠ ⊥) :
    P.comap (xAdjoinRootEquiv W).toRingHom ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  intro hQ
  apply hP0
  have hmap : (P.comap (xAdjoinRootEquiv W).toRingHom).map
      (xAdjoinRootEquiv W).toRingHom = P :=
    Ideal.map_comap_eq_self_of_equiv (xAdjoinRootEquiv W).toRingEquiv P
  rw [← hmap, hQ, Ideal.map_bot]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.isDiscreteValuationRing_atPrime_x_comap
statement:
theorem isDiscreteValuationRing_atPrime_x_comap
    (P : Ideal W.CoordinateRing) [P.IsPrime] (hP0 : P ≠ ⊥)
    (hX : CoordinateRing.mk W W.polynomialX ∉ P) :
    IsDiscreteValuationRing
      (Localization.AtPrime (P.comap (xAdjoinRootEquiv W).toRingHom))
proof:
:= by
  letI : (P.comap (xAdjoinRootEquiv W).toRingHom).IsPrime :=
    Ideal.IsPrime.comap (xAdjoinRootEquiv W).toRingHom
  exact AdjoinRoot.isDiscreteValuationRing_atPrime_of_derivative_eq_not_mem
    (xPolynomial W) (xPolynomial_monic W)
    (-Polynomial.Bivariate.swap W.polynomialX) (xPolynomial_derivative_eq W)
    (P.comap (xAdjoinRootEquiv W).toRingHom) (x_comap_ne_bot W P hP0)
    (not_mem_comap_of_image_eq (xAdjoinRootEquiv W).toRingEquiv P _ _
      (xAdjoinRootEquiv_neg_swap_polynomialX W) (by simpa using hX))

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.isDiscreteValuationRing_atPrime_of_polynomialX_not_mem
statement:
theorem isDiscreteValuationRing_atPrime_of_polynomialX_not_mem
    (P : Ideal W.CoordinateRing) [P.IsPrime] (hP0 : P ≠ ⊥)
    (hX : CoordinateRing.mk W W.polynomialX ∉ P) :
    IsDiscreteValuationRing (Localization.AtPrime P)
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing
      (Localization.AtPrime (P.comap (xAdjoinRootEquiv W).toRingHom)) :=
    isDiscreteValuationRing_atPrime_x_comap W P hP0 hX
  exact IsDiscreteValuationRing.atPrime_of_comap_ringEquiv
    (xAdjoinRootEquiv W).toRingEquiv P hP0

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.isDedekindDomainDvr
statement: theorem isDedekindDomainDvr : IsDedekindDomainDvr W.CoordinateRing
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsNoetherianRing W.CoordinateRing := IsNoetherianRing.of_finite k[X] _
  refine { is_dvr_at_nonzero_prime := ?_ }
  intro P hP0 hPprime
  rcases coordinate_derivatives_not_both_mem W P with hX | hY
  · exact isDiscreteValuationRing_atPrime_of_polynomialX_not_mem W P hP0 hX
  · exact isDiscreteValuationRing_atPrime_of_polynomialY_not_mem W P hP0 hY

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.isDedekindDomain
statement: theorem isDedekindDomain : IsDedekindDomain W.CoordinateRing

:= by

  infer_instance

name: SchemeKTheory.eulerChar_eq_alternatingSum
statement:
theorem eulerChar_eq_alternatingSum (F : X.Modules) (n : ℕ)
    (hvanish : ∀ i, n < i → Scheme.Modules.h k F i = 0) :
    Scheme.Modules.eulerChar k F =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ i * (Scheme.Modules.h k F i : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Modules.eulerChar]
  refine finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ ?_
  intro i hi
  simp only [Function.mem_support, ne_eq, mul_eq_zero, not_or] at hi
  simp only [Finset.coe_range, Set.mem_Iio]
  by_contra hle
  exact hi.2 (by exact_mod_cast hvanish i (by omega))

name: SchemeKTheory.g0Euler_g0ClassOf
statement:
theorem g0Euler_g0ClassOf
    (hfinite : ∀ E : X.Modules, E.IsFinitePresentation → E.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (E : X.Modules) (hE : IsCoherentLike X E) :
    g0Euler k hfinite (g0ClassOf X E hE) = Scheme.Modules.eulerChar k E
proof:
:= by
  letI : E.IsFinitePresentation := hE
  exact g0Euler_classOf k hfinite E

name: SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.g0Euler_comp_derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages
statement:
theorem g0Euler_comp_derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages (n : ℕ)
    (higher : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M} → ℕ → Y.Modules)
    (hcoherent : ∀ E i, SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike Y (higher E i))
    (hlong : ∀ A B C,
      ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X) A B C →
        GrothendieckRiemannRoch.LongExactWitness n
          (higherDirectImageClass higher hcoherent A)
          (higherDirectImageClass higher hcoherent B)
          (higherDirectImageClass higher hcoherent C))
    (hfiniteX : ∀ E : X.Modules, E.IsFinitePresentation →
      E.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (hfiniteY : ∀ E : Y.Modules, E.IsFinitePresentation →
      E.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (hdeg : ∀ E i,
      Scheme.Modules.eulerChar k (higher E i) = (Scheme.Modules.h k E.1 i : ℤ))
    (hvanish : ∀ (E : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M}) i, n < i →
      Scheme.Modules.h k E.1 i = 0) :
    (SchemeKTheory.g0Euler k hfiniteY).comp
        (derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages n higher hcoherent hlong) =
      SchemeKTheory.g0Euler k hfiniteX
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _
  intro E
  show SchemeKTheory.g0Euler k hfiniteY
      (derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages n higher hcoherent hlong
        (SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf X E.1 E.2)) =
    SchemeKTheory.g0Euler k hfiniteX (SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf X E.1 E.2)
  rw [derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages_classOf, GrothendieckRiemannRoch.map_alternatingSum,
    SchemeKTheory.g0Euler_g0ClassOf k hfiniteX E.1 E.2,
    SchemeKTheory.eulerChar_eq_alternatingSum k E.1 n (hvanish E),
    GrothendieckRiemannRoch.alternatingSum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [show higherDirectImageClass higher hcoherent E i =
        SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf Y (higher E i) (hcoherent E i) from rfl,
    SchemeKTheory.g0Euler_g0ClassOf k hfiniteY, hdeg E i, zsmul_eq_mul, Int.cast_id]

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.imageShortComplex_shortExact
statement:
theorem imageShortComplex_shortExact (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ D)
    (zero : f ≫ g = 0) (exact : (ShortComplex.mk f g zero).Exact) :
    (imageShortComplex f g zero).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  let S : ShortComplex C := ShortComplex.mk f g zero
  let S' : ShortComplex C :=
    ShortComplex.mk (Abelian.image.ι f) g (Abelian.image_ι_comp_eq_zero zero)
  let T : ShortComplex C := imageShortComplex f g zero
  let φ : T ⟶ S' := ShortComplex.homMk (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) (Abelian.image.ι g)
    (by simp [T, S', imageShortComplex])
    (by simp [T, S', imageShortComplex])
  have hS' : S'.Exact := by
    exact (S.exact_iff_exact_image_ι).mp exact
  letI : Epi φ.τ₁ := by
    change Epi (𝟙 T.X₁)
    infer_instance
  letI : IsIso φ.τ₂ := by
    change IsIso (𝟙 T.X₂)
    infer_instance
  letI : Mono φ.τ₃ := by
    change Mono (Abelian.image.ι g)
    infer_instance
  have hT : T.Exact :=
    (ShortComplex.exact_iff_of_epi_of_isIso_of_mono φ).mpr hS'
  letI : Mono T.f := by
    dsimp [T, imageShortComplex]
    infer_instance
  letI : Epi T.g := by
    dsimp [T, imageShortComplex]
    infer_instance
  exact { exact := hT }

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.subcategoryClassOf_eq_image_add_image
statement:
theorem subcategoryClassOf_eq_image_add_image
    (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ D) (zero : f ≫ g = 0)
    (exact : (ShortComplex.mk f g zero).Exact)
    (hImageF : P (Abelian.image f)) (hB : P B) (hImageG : P (Abelian.image g)) :
    ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf C P B hB =
      ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf C P (Abelian.image f) hImageF +
        ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf C P (Abelian.image g) hImageG
proof:
:= by
  let T := imageShortComplex f g zero
  exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_middle C P hImageF hB hImageG T.zero
    (imageShortComplex_shortExact f g zero exact)

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.BoundedLongExactSystem.toDerivedPushforward_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toDerivedPushforward_classOf (s : BoundedLongExactSystem P Object Exact n)
    (X : Object) :
    s.toDerivedPushforward (ExactGrothendieck.classOf Object Exact X) =
      alternatingSum n (s.higherClass X)
proof:
:=
  derivedPushforward_classOf n s.higherClass s.longExactWitness X

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedIdentity_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivedIdentity_classOf (X : Object) :
    derivedIdentity (Object := Object) (Exact := Exact)
        (ExactGrothendieck.classOf Object Exact X) =
      ExactGrothendieck.classOf Object Exact X
proof:
:= by
  rw [derivedIdentity, derivedPushforward_classOf]
  simp [alternatingSum, identityHigherClass]

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedIdentity_eq_id
statement:
theorem derivedIdentity_eq_id :
    derivedIdentity (Object := Object) (Exact := Exact) =
      AddMonoidHom.id (ExactGrothendieck.Group Object Exact)
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext Object Exact
  intro X

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforward_comp_of_leray_euler
statement:
theorem derivedPushforward_comp_of_leray_euler
    (n₁ n₂ n : ℕ)
    (higher₁ : Object → ℕ → ExactGrothendieck.Group Object' Exact')
    (higher₂ : Object' → ℕ → B)
    (higherComposite : Object → ℕ → B)
    (hlong₁ : ∀ X Y Z, Exact X Y Z →
      LongExactWitness n₁ (higher₁ X) (higher₁ Y) (higher₁ Z))
    (hlong₂ : ∀ X Y Z, Exact' X Y Z →
      LongExactWitness n₂ (higher₂ X) (higher₂ Y) (higher₂ Z))
    (hlongComposite : ∀ X Y Z, Exact X Y Z →
      LongExactWitness n (higherComposite X) (higherComposite Y) (higherComposite Z))
    (hleray : ∀ X,
      derivedPushforward n₂ higher₂ hlong₂ (alternatingSum n₁ (higher₁ X)) =
        alternatingSum n (higherComposite X)) :
    (derivedPushforward n₂ higher₂ hlong₂).comp
        (derivedPushforward n₁ higher₁ hlong₁) =
      derivedPushforward n higherComposite hlongComposite
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext Object Exact
  intro X
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, derivedPushforward_classOf]
  exact hleray X

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforward_comp_apply_of_leray_euler
statement:
theorem derivedPushforward_comp_apply_of_leray_euler
    (n₁ n₂ n : ℕ)
    (higher₁ : Object → ℕ → ExactGrothendieck.Group Object' Exact')
    (higher₂ : Object' → ℕ → B)
    (higherComposite : Object → ℕ → B)
    (hlong₁ : ∀ X Y Z, Exact X Y Z →
      LongExactWitness n₁ (higher₁ X) (higher₁ Y) (higher₁ Z))
    (hlong₂ : ∀ X Y Z, Exact' X Y Z →
      LongExactWitness n₂ (higher₂ X) (higher₂ Y) (higher₂ Z))
    (hlongComposite : ∀ X Y Z, Exact X Y Z →
      LongExactWitness n (higherComposite X) (higherComposite Y) (higherComposite Z))
    (hleray : ∀ X,
      derivedPushforward n₂ higher₂ hlong₂ (alternatingSum n₁ (higher₁ X)) =
        alternatingSum n (higherComposite X))
    (z : ExactGrothendieck.Group Object Exact) :
    derivedPushforward n₂ higher₂ hlong₂
        (derivedPushforward n₁ higher₁ hlong₁ z) =
      derivedPushforward n higherComposite hlongComposite z
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg
    (fun f : ExactGrothendieck.Group Object Exact →+ B ↦ f z)
    (derivedPushforward_comp_of_leray_euler n₁ n₂ n higher₁ higher₂
      higherComposite hlong₁ hlong₂ hlongComposite hleray)
  exact h

name: SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.concentratedHigherDirectImage_coherent
statement:
theorem concentratedHigherDirectImage_coherent
    (push : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M} → Y.Modules)
    (hpush : ∀ E, SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike Y (push E))
    (E : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M}) (i : ℕ) :
    SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike Y (concentratedHigherDirectImage push E i)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i = 0
  · simpa [concentratedHigherDirectImage, hi] using hpush E
  · simp only [concentratedHigherDirectImage, hi, if_false]
    show (0 : Y.Modules).IsFinitePresentation
    infer_instance

name: SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.concentratedHigherDirectImageClass_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem concentratedHigherDirectImageClass_eq
    (push : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M} → Y.Modules)
    (hpush : ∀ E, SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike Y (push E))
    (E : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M}) (i : ℕ) :
    higherDirectImageClass (concentratedHigherDirectImage push)
        (concentratedHigherDirectImage_coherent push hpush) E i =
      GrothendieckRiemannRoch.concentratedHigherClass
        (Exact' := ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn Y.Modules (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike Y))
        (concentratedPushObject push hpush) E i
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i = 0
  · subst i
    rfl
  · simp [higherDirectImageClass, concentratedHigherDirectImage, hi,
      GrothendieckRiemannRoch.concentratedHigherClass]

name: SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfConcentratedHigherDirectImages_eq_map
statement:
theorem derivedPushforwardOfConcentratedHigherDirectImages_eq_map (n : ℕ)
    (push : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M} → Y.Modules)
    (hpush : ∀ E, SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike Y (push E))
    (hexact : ∀ A B C,
      ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X) A B C →
        ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn Y.Modules (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike Y)
          (concentratedPushObject push hpush A) (concentratedPushObject push hpush B)
          (concentratedPushObject push hpush C)) :
    derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages n (concentratedHigherDirectImage push)
        (concentratedHigherDirectImage_coherent push hpush)
        (concentratedHigherDirectImageLongExact n push hpush hexact) =
      ExactGrothendieck.map (concentratedPushObject push hpush) hexact
proof:
:= by
  change GrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforward n _ _ = _
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _
  intro E
  rw [GrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforward_classOf,
    funext (concentratedHigherDirectImageClass_eq push hpush E),
    GrothendieckRiemannRoch.alternatingSum_concentratedHigherClass,
    ExactGrothendieck.map_classOf]

name: SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages_comp_of_concentrated
statement:
theorem derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages_comp_of_concentrated
    {Z : Scheme.{u}} (nXY nYZ : ℕ)
    (push : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M} → Y.Modules)
    (hpush : ∀ E, SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike Y (push E))
    (hexact : ∀ A B C,
      ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X) A B C →
        ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn Y.Modules (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike Y)
          (concentratedPushObject push hpush A) (concentratedPushObject push hpush B)
          (concentratedPushObject push hpush C))
    (higherYZ : {M : Y.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike Y M} → ℕ → Z.Modules)
    (hcoherentYZ : ∀ E i, SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike Z (higherYZ E i))
    (hlongYZ : ∀ A B C,
      ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn Y.Modules (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike Y) A B C →
        GrothendieckRiemannRoch.LongExactWitness nYZ
          (higherDirectImageClass higherYZ hcoherentYZ A)
          (higherDirectImageClass higherYZ hcoherentYZ B)
          (higherDirectImageClass higherYZ hcoherentYZ C)) :
    (derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages nYZ higherYZ hcoherentYZ hlongYZ).comp
        (derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages nXY (concentratedHigherDirectImage push)
          (concentratedHigherDirectImage_coherent push hpush)
          (concentratedHigherDirectImageLongExact nXY push hpush hexact)) =
      (derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages nYZ higherYZ hcoherentYZ hlongYZ).comp
        (ExactGrothendieck.map (concentratedPushObject push hpush) hexact)
proof:
:= by
  rw [derivedPushforwardOfConcentratedHigherDirectImages_eq_map nXY push hpush hexact]

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.alternatingSum_concentratedHigherClass
statement:
theorem alternatingSum_concentratedHigherClass (push : Object → Object') (X : Object) (n₁ : ℕ) :
    alternatingSum n₁ (concentratedHigherClass (Exact' := Exact') push X) =
      ExactGrothendieck.classOf Object' Exact' (push X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [alternatingSum, Finset.sum_eq_single 0]
  · simp [concentratedHigherClass]
  · intro i _ hi
    simp [concentratedHigherClass, hi]
  · intro h
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_range.2 (Nat.succ_pos n₁)) h

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforward_concentrated_eq_map
statement:
theorem derivedPushforward_concentrated_eq_map (n₁ : ℕ) (push : Object → Object')
    (hpush : ∀ X Y Z, Exact X Y Z → Exact' (push X) (push Y) (push Z)) :
    derivedPushforward n₁ (concentratedHigherClass (Exact' := Exact') push)
        (concentratedLongExactWitness n₁ push hpush) =
      ExactGrothendieck.map push hpush
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext Object Exact
  intro X
  rw [derivedPushforward_classOf, alternatingSum_concentratedHigherClass,
    ExactGrothendieck.map_classOf]

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.hleray_of_concentrated
statement:
theorem hleray_of_concentrated (n₁ n₂ : ℕ) (push : Object → Object')
    (higher₂ : Object' → ℕ → B)
    (hlong₂ : ∀ X Y Z, Exact' X Y Z →
      LongExactWitness n₂ (higher₂ X) (higher₂ Y) (higher₂ Z))
    (X : Object) :
    derivedPushforward n₂ higher₂ hlong₂
        (alternatingSum n₁ (concentratedHigherClass (Exact' := Exact') push X)) =
      alternatingSum n₂ (fun i => higher₂ (push X) i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [alternatingSum_concentratedHigherClass, derivedPushforward_classOf]

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforward_comp_of_concentrated
statement:
theorem derivedPushforward_comp_of_concentrated (n₁ n₂ : ℕ) (push : Object → Object')
    (hpush : ∀ X Y Z, Exact X Y Z → Exact' (push X) (push Y) (push Z))
    (higher₂ : Object' → ℕ → B)
    (hlong₂ : ∀ X Y Z, Exact' X Y Z →
      LongExactWitness n₂ (higher₂ X) (higher₂ Y) (higher₂ Z)) :
    (derivedPushforward n₂ higher₂ hlong₂).comp
        (derivedPushforward n₁ (concentratedHigherClass (Exact' := Exact') push)
          (concentratedLongExactWitness n₁ push hpush)) =
      derivedPushforward n₂ (fun X i => higher₂ (push X) i)
        (fun X Y Z h => hlong₂ _ _ _ (hpush X Y Z h))
proof:
:=
  derivedPushforward_comp_of_leray_euler n₁ n₂ n₂
    (concentratedHigherClass (Exact' := Exact') push) higher₂
    (fun X i => higher₂ (push X) i)
    (concentratedLongExactWitness n₁ push hpush) hlong₂
    (fun X Y Z h => hlong₂ _ _ _ (hpush X Y Z h))
    (hleray_of_concentrated n₁ n₂ push higher₂ hlong₂)

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforward_comp_apply_of_concentrated
statement:
theorem derivedPushforward_comp_apply_of_concentrated (n₁ n₂ : ℕ) (push : Object → Object')
    (hpush : ∀ X Y Z, Exact X Y Z → Exact' (push X) (push Y) (push Z))
    (higher₂ : Object' → ℕ → B)
    (hlong₂ : ∀ X Y Z, Exact' X Y Z →
      LongExactWitness n₂ (higher₂ X) (higher₂ Y) (higher₂ Z))
    (z : ExactGrothendieck.Group Object Exact) :
    derivedPushforward n₂ higher₂ hlong₂
        (derivedPushforward n₁ (concentratedHigherClass (Exact' := Exact') push)
          (concentratedLongExactWitness n₁ push hpush) z) =
      derivedPushforward n₂ (fun X i => higher₂ (push X) i)
        (fun X Y Z h => hlong₂ _ _ _ (hpush X Y Z h)) z
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun f : ExactGrothendieck.Group Object Exact →+ B ↦ f z)
    (derivedPushforward_comp_of_concentrated n₁ n₂ push hpush higher₂ hlong₂)

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.map_alternatingSum
statement:
theorem map_alternatingSum {B : Type w} [AddCommGroup B] (f : A →+ B)
    (n : ℕ) (term : ℕ → A) :
    f (alternatingSum n term) = alternatingSum n (fun i => f (term i))
proof:
:= by
  simp [alternatingSum]

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.alternating_boundary_sum
statement:
theorem alternating_boundary_sum (w : ℕ → A) (hzero : w 0 = 0) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, ((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) • (w i + w (i + 1))) =
      -(((-1 : ℤ) ^ n) • w n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [hzero]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih]
      have hsign : ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (n + 1)) = -((-1 : ℤ) ^ n) := by
        rw [pow_succ]
        simp
      rw [hsign]
      simp only [smul_add, neg_smul]
      abel

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.LongExactWitness.euler_additive
proof:
:= by
  unfold alternatingSum
  have hb :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) • b i) =
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) • (W.u i + W.v i) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [W.middleDecomposition]
  have ha :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) • a i) =
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) • (W.w i + W.u i) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [W.leftDecomposition]
  have hc :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) • c i) =
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) • (W.v i + W.w (i + 1)) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [W.rightDecomposition]
  rw [hb, ha, hc]
  have hboundary :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        ((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) • (W.w i + W.w (i + 1))) = 0 := by
    rw [alternating_boundary_sum W.w W.leftBoundary]
    rw [W.rightBoundary]
    simp
  let su : A := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) • W.u i
  let sv : A := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) • W.v i
  let sw : A := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) • W.w i
  let sw' : A := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) • W.w (i + 1)
  have huv :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) • (W.u i + W.v i)) =
        su + sv := by
    simp only [smul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rfl
  have hwu :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) • (W.w i + W.u i)) =
        sw + su := by
    simp only [smul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rfl
  have hvw :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) • (W.v i + W.w (i + 1))) =
        sv + sw' := by
    simp only [smul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rfl
  rw [huv, hwu, hvw]
  have hbnd : sw + sw' = 0 := by
    dsimp only [sw, sw']
    simpa only [smul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib] using hboundary
  calc
    su + sv = su + sv + (sw + sw') := by rw [hbnd, add_zero]
    _ = (sw + su) + (sv + sw') := by abel

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforward_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivedPushforward_classOf (n : ℕ) (higherClass : Object → ℕ → A)
    (hlong : ∀ X Y Z, Exact X Y Z →
      LongExactWitness n (higherClass X) (higherClass Y) (higherClass Z))
    (X : Object) :
    derivedPushforward n higherClass hlong (ExactGrothendieck.classOf Object Exact X) =
      alternatingSum n (higherClass X)
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.lift_classOf _ _ _

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforward_baseChange_of_degreewise
statement:
theorem derivedPushforward_baseChange_of_degreewise
    {Object' : Type v} {Exact' : Object' → Object' → Object' → Prop}
    {B : Type w} [AddCommGroup B]
    (n : ℕ) (higherClass : Object → ℕ → A)
    (higherClass' : Object' → ℕ → B)
    (hlong : ∀ X Y Z, Exact X Y Z →
      LongExactWitness n (higherClass X) (higherClass Y) (higherClass Z))
    (hlong' : ∀ X Y Z, Exact' X Y Z →
      LongExactWitness n (higherClass' X) (higherClass' Y) (higherClass' Z))
    (pullObject : Object → Object')
    (hpull : ∀ X Y Z, Exact X Y Z →
      Exact' (pullObject X) (pullObject Y) (pullObject Z))
    (pullTarget : A →+ B)
    (hdegree : ∀ X i, pullTarget (higherClass X i) = higherClass' (pullObject X) i) :
    pullTarget.comp (derivedPushforward n higherClass hlong) =
      (derivedPushforward n higherClass' hlong').comp
        (ExactGrothendieck.map pullObject hpull)
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext Object Exact
  intro X
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, derivedPushforward_classOf,
    ExactGrothendieck.map_classOf]
  rw [map_alternatingSum]
  congr 1
  funext i
  exact hdegree X i

name: SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages_classOf (n : ℕ)
    (higherDirectImage :
      {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M} → ℕ → Y.Modules)
    (hcoherent : ∀ E i,
      SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike Y (higherDirectImage E i))
    (hlong : ∀ A B C,
      ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X) A B C →
        GrothendieckRiemannRoch.LongExactWitness n
          (higherDirectImageClass higherDirectImage hcoherent A)
          (higherDirectImageClass higherDirectImage hcoherent B)
          (higherDirectImageClass higherDirectImage hcoherent C))
    (E : X.Modules) (hE : SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X E) :
    derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages n higherDirectImage hcoherent hlong
        (SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf X E hE) =
      GrothendieckRiemannRoch.alternatingSum n
        (higherDirectImageClass higherDirectImage hcoherent ⟨E, hE⟩)
proof:
:=
  GrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforward_classOf _ _ _ _

name: SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfLongExactSystem_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivedPushforwardOfLongExactSystem_classOf
    {n : ℕ} (s : HigherDirectImageLongExactSystem X Y n)
    (E : X.Modules) (hE : SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X E) :
    derivedPushforwardOfLongExactSystem s (SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf X E hE) =
      GrothendieckRiemannRoch.alternatingSum n
        (fun i ↦ SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf Y (s.higher ⟨E, hE⟩ i)
          (s.higher_mem ⟨E, hE⟩ i))
proof:
:= by
  change s.toDerivedPushforward
      (ExactGrothendieck.classOf
        {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M}
        (ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X))
        ⟨E, hE⟩) =
    GrothendieckRiemannRoch.alternatingSum n (s.higherClass ⟨E, hE⟩)
  exact s.toDerivedPushforward_classOf ⟨E, hE⟩

name: SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfLongExactSystem_eq
statement:
theorem derivedPushforwardOfLongExactSystem_eq
    {n : ℕ} (s : HigherDirectImageLongExactSystem X Y n) :
    derivedPushforwardOfLongExactSystem s =
      derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages n s.higher s.higher_mem
        s.longExactWitness
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.identityHigherDirectImage_coherent
statement:
theorem identityHigherDirectImage_coherent
    (E : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M}) (i : ℕ) :
    SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X (identityHigherDirectImage E i)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i = 0
  · simpa [identityHigherDirectImage, hi] using E.2
  · simp only [identityHigherDirectImage, hi, if_false]
    show (0 : X.Modules).IsFinitePresentation
    infer_instance

name: SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.identityHigherDirectImageClass_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem identityHigherDirectImageClass_eq
    (E : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M}) (i : ℕ) :
    higherDirectImageClass identityHigherDirectImage identityHigherDirectImage_coherent E i =
      GrothendieckRiemannRoch.identityHigherClass E i
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i = 0
  · subst i
    rfl
  · simp [higherDirectImageClass, identityHigherDirectImage, hi,
      GrothendieckRiemannRoch.identityHigherClass]

name: SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfIdentityHigherDirectImages_eq_id
statement:
theorem derivedPushforwardOfIdentityHigherDirectImages_eq_id :
    derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages 0 identityHigherDirectImage
        identityHigherDirectImage_coherent identityHigherDirectImageLongExact =
      AddMonoidHom.id (SchemeKTheory.G0 X)
proof:
:= by
  change GrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforward 0 _ _ = _
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _
  intro E
  rw [GrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforward_classOf]
  simp [GrothendieckRiemannRoch.alternatingSum,
    GrothendieckRiemannRoch.identityHigherClass]

name: SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages_baseChange_of_degreewise
statement:
theorem derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages_baseChange_of_degreewise
    {X' Y' : Scheme.{u}} (n : ℕ)
    (higherDirectImage :
      {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M} → ℕ → Y.Modules)
    (hcoherent : ∀ E i,
      SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike Y (higherDirectImage E i))
    (hlong : ∀ A B C,
      ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X) A B C →
        GrothendieckRiemannRoch.LongExactWitness n
          (higherDirectImageClass higherDirectImage hcoherent A)
          (higherDirectImageClass higherDirectImage hcoherent B)
          (higherDirectImageClass higherDirectImage hcoherent C))
    (higherDirectImage' :
      {M : X'.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X' M} → ℕ → Y'.Modules)
    (hcoherent' : ∀ E i,
      SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike Y' (higherDirectImage' E i))
    (hlong' : ∀ A B C,
      ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X'.Modules (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X') A B C →
        GrothendieckRiemannRoch.LongExactWitness n
          (higherDirectImageClass higherDirectImage' hcoherent' A)
          (higherDirectImageClass higherDirectImage' hcoherent' B)
          (higherDirectImageClass higherDirectImage' hcoherent' C))
    (pullObject :
      {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M} →
        {M : X'.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X' M})
    (hpull : ∀ A B C,
      ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X) A B C →
        ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X'.Modules (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X')
          (pullObject A) (pullObject B) (pullObject C))
    (pullTarget : SchemeKTheory.G0 Y →+ SchemeKTheory.G0 Y')
    (hdegree : ∀ E i,
      pullTarget (higherDirectImageClass higherDirectImage hcoherent E i) =
        higherDirectImageClass higherDirectImage' hcoherent' (pullObject E) i) :
    pullTarget.comp
        (derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages n higherDirectImage hcoherent hlong) =
      (derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages n higherDirectImage' hcoherent' hlong').comp
        (ExactGrothendieck.map pullObject hpull)
proof:
:=
  GrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforward_baseChange_of_degreewise n
    (higherDirectImageClass higherDirectImage hcoherent)
    (higherDirectImageClass higherDirectImage' hcoherent') hlong hlong'
    pullObject hpull pullTarget hdegree

name: SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages_comp_of_leray_euler
statement:
theorem derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages_comp_of_leray_euler
    {Z : Scheme.{u}} (nXY nYZ nXZ : ℕ)
    (higherXY :
      {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M} → ℕ → Y.Modules)
    (hcoherentXY : ∀ E i,
      SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike Y (higherXY E i))
    (hlongXY : ∀ A B C,
      ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X) A B C →
        GrothendieckRiemannRoch.LongExactWitness nXY
          (higherDirectImageClass higherXY hcoherentXY A)
          (higherDirectImageClass higherXY hcoherentXY B)
          (higherDirectImageClass higherXY hcoherentXY C))
    (higherYZ :
      {M : Y.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike Y M} → ℕ → Z.Modules)
    (hcoherentYZ : ∀ E i,
      SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike Z (higherYZ E i))
    (hlongYZ : ∀ A B C,
      ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn Y.Modules (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike Y) A B C →
        GrothendieckRiemannRoch.LongExactWitness nYZ
          (higherDirectImageClass higherYZ hcoherentYZ A)
          (higherDirectImageClass higherYZ hcoherentYZ B)
          (higherDirectImageClass higherYZ hcoherentYZ C))
    (higherXZ :
      {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M} → ℕ → Z.Modules)
    (hcoherentXZ : ∀ E i,
      SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike Z (higherXZ E i))
    (hlongXZ : ∀ A B C,
      ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X) A B C →
        GrothendieckRiemannRoch.LongExactWitness nXZ
          (higherDirectImageClass higherXZ hcoherentXZ A)
          (higherDirectImageClass higherXZ hcoherentXZ B)
          (higherDirectImageClass higherXZ hcoherentXZ C))
    (hleray : ∀ E,
      derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages nYZ higherYZ hcoherentYZ hlongYZ
          (GrothendieckRiemannRoch.alternatingSum nXY
            (higherDirectImageClass higherXY hcoherentXY E)) =
        GrothendieckRiemannRoch.alternatingSum nXZ
          (higherDirectImageClass higherXZ hcoherentXZ E)) :
    (derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages nYZ higherYZ hcoherentYZ hlongYZ).comp
        (derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages nXY higherXY hcoherentXY hlongXY) =
      derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages nXZ higherXZ hcoherentXZ hlongXZ
proof:
:=
  GrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforward_comp_of_leray_euler
    nXY nYZ nXZ
    (higherDirectImageClass higherXY hcoherentXY)
    (higherDirectImageClass higherYZ hcoherentYZ)
    (higherDirectImageClass higherXZ hcoherentXZ)
    hlongXY hlongYZ hlongXZ hleray

name: SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.hom_eq_of_coherentSheaf_classes
statement:
theorem hom_eq_of_coherentSheaf_classes
    (pushforward : SchemeKTheory.G0 X →+ SchemeKTheory.G0 Y)
    (chernX : SchemeKTheory.G0 X →+ CX) (toddX : CX)
    (chernY : SchemeKTheory.G0 Y →+ CY) (toddY : CY)
    (cyclePushforward : CX →+ CY)
    (hsheaf : ∀ E : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M},
      chernY (pushforward
        (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ (ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules
          (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X)) E)) * toddY =
        cyclePushforward
          (chernX (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ (ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules
            (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X)) E) * toddX)) :
    leftHandSide pushforward chernY toddY =
      rightHandSide chernX toddX cyclePushforward
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _
  intro E
  simpa [leftHandSide, rightHandSide, GrothendieckRiemannRoch.characteristicClass] using hsheaf E

name: SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.formula_of_coherentSheaf_classes
statement:
theorem formula_of_coherentSheaf_classes
    (pushforward : SchemeKTheory.G0 X →+ SchemeKTheory.G0 Y)
    (chernX : SchemeKTheory.G0 X →+ CX) (toddX : CX)
    (chernY : SchemeKTheory.G0 Y →+ CY) (toddY : CY)
    (cyclePushforward : CX →+ CY)
    (hsheaf : ∀ E : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M},
      chernY (pushforward
        (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ (ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules
          (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X)) E)) * toddY =
        cyclePushforward
          (chernX (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ (ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules
            (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X)) E) * toddX))
    (z : SchemeKTheory.G0 X) :
    chernY (pushforward z) * toddY = cyclePushforward (chernX z * toddX)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun f : SchemeKTheory.G0 X →+ CY => f z)
    (hom_eq_of_coherentSheaf_classes pushforward chernX toddX chernY toddY
      cyclePushforward hsheaf)
  exact h

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.characteristicClass_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem characteristicClass_classOf {C : Type w} [CommRing C]
    (chernCharacter : ExactGrothendieck.Group ObjectX ExactX →+ C) (toddClass : C)
    (E : ObjectX) :
    characteristicClass chernCharacter toddClass
        (ExactGrothendieck.classOf ObjectX ExactX E) =
      chernCharacter (ExactGrothendieck.classOf ObjectX ExactX E) * toddClass
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.hom_eq_of_object_classes
statement:
theorem hom_eq_of_object_classes {CX : Type w} {CY : Type x} [CommRing CX] [CommRing CY]
    (F : ObjectX → ObjectY)
    (hF : ∀ A B C, ExactX A B C → ExactY (F A) (F B) (F C))
    (chernX : ExactGrothendieck.Group ObjectX ExactX →+ CX) (toddX : CX)
    (chernY : ExactGrothendieck.Group ObjectY ExactY →+ CY) (toddY : CY)
    (cyclePushforward : CX →+ CY)
    (hobject : ∀ E : ObjectX,
      chernY (ExactGrothendieck.classOf ObjectY ExactY (F E)) * toddY =
        cyclePushforward
          (chernX (ExactGrothendieck.classOf ObjectX ExactX E) * toddX)) :
    leftHandSide F hF chernY toddY =
      rightHandSide chernX toddX cyclePushforward
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext ObjectX ExactX
  intro E
  simpa [leftHandSide, rightHandSide] using hobject E

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.formula_of_object_classes
statement:
theorem formula_of_object_classes {CX : Type w} {CY : Type x} [CommRing CX] [CommRing CY]
    (F : ObjectX → ObjectY)
    (hF : ∀ A B C, ExactX A B C → ExactY (F A) (F B) (F C))
    (chernX : ExactGrothendieck.Group ObjectX ExactX →+ CX) (toddX : CX)
    (chernY : ExactGrothendieck.Group ObjectY ExactY →+ CY) (toddY : CY)
    (cyclePushforward : CX →+ CY)
    (hobject : ∀ E : ObjectX,
      chernY (ExactGrothendieck.classOf ObjectY ExactY (F E)) * toddY =
        cyclePushforward
          (chernX (ExactGrothendieck.classOf ObjectX ExactX E) * toddX))
    (z : ExactGrothendieck.Group ObjectX ExactX) :
    chernY (ExactGrothendieck.map F hF z) * toddY =
      cyclePushforward (chernX z * toddX)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun f : ExactGrothendieck.Group ObjectX ExactX →+ CY => f z)
    (hom_eq_of_object_classes F hF chernX toddX chernY toddY cyclePushforward hobject)
  exact h

name: FunctionField.Chart.riemann_roch
statement:
theorem riemann_roch {W : DivisorA k K} (hW : IsCanonical k K W) (D : DivisorA k K) :
    (ell k K D : ℤ) = deg k K D + 1 - (genus k K : ℤ) + ell k K (W - D)
proof:
:= by
  have hi := indexOfSpecialty_eq k K D
  have hdual := indexOfSpecialty_eq_ell_sub k K hW D
  omega

name: FunctionField.Chart.ell_canonical
statement: theorem ell_canonical : ell k K W = genus k K
proof:
:= by
  have hRR := riemann_roch k K hW (0 : DivisorA k K)
  rw [ell_zero k K, deg_zero, zero_add, sub_zero] at hRR
  omega

name: FunctionField.Chart.deg_canonical
statement: theorem deg_canonical : deg k K W = 2 * (genus k K : ℤ) - 2
proof:
:= by
  have hRR := riemann_roch k K hW W
  rw [sub_self, ell_zero k K, ell_canonical k K hW] at hRR
  omega

name: FunctionField.Chart.ell_eq_of_deg_ge
statement:
theorem ell_eq_of_deg_ge (D : DivisorA k K) (hdeg : deg k K D ≥ 2 * (genus k K : ℤ) - 1) :
    (ell k K D : ℤ) = deg k K D + 1 - (genus k K : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hcanonical := deg_canonical k K hW
  have hneg : deg k K (W - D) < 0 := by
    rw [deg_sub, hcanonical]
    omega
  have hell := RRspace_neg_deg_ell k K hneg
  rw [riemann_roch k K hW D, hell, Int.ofNat_zero, add_zero]

name: FunctionField.Chart.indexOfSpecialty_eq_ell
statement:
theorem indexOfSpecialty_eq_ell (D : DivisorA k K) :
    (indexOfSpecialty k K D : ℤ) = ell k K (W - D)
proof:
:= by
  exact indexOfSpecialty_eq_ell_sub k K hW D

name: FunctionField.Chart.indexOfSpecialty_eq_zero_of_large_deg
statement:
theorem indexOfSpecialty_eq_zero_of_large_deg (D : DivisorA k K)
    (hdeg : deg k K D ≥ 2 * (genus k K : ℤ) - 1) :
    indexOfSpecialty k K D = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ := exists_isCanonical k K
  have hell := ell_eq_of_deg_ge k K hW D hdeg
  have hi := indexOfSpecialty_eq k K D
  omega

name: FunctionField.Chart.indexOfSpecialty_eq_zero_of_le_deg
statement:
theorem indexOfSpecialty_eq_zero_of_le_deg :
    ∃ c : ℤ, ∀ D : DivisorA k K, c ≤ deg k K D → indexOfSpecialty k K D = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨2 * (genus k K : ℤ) - 1, fun D hD =>
    indexOfSpecialty_eq_zero_of_large_deg k K D hD⟩

name: FunctionField.Chart.exists_effective_add_principal_of_ell_pos
statement:
theorem exists_effective_add_principal_of_ell_pos (D : DivisorA k K)
    (hD : 0 < ell k K D) :
    ∃ x : Kˣ, IsEffective k K
      (D + principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul x))
proof:
:= by
