  letI : FiniteDimensional k (RRspace k K D) := finiteDimensional_RRspace_aux k K D
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := (Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero (R := k)
    (M := RRspace k K D)).mp hD
  have hfval : (f : K) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hf
    exact Subtype.ext h
  let x : Kˣ := Units.mk0 (f : K) hfval
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  have hle : (0 : DivisorA k K) ≤
      D + principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul x) :=
    le_add_principal_of_memRRspace (k := k) (K := K)
      (D₀ := (0 : DivisorA k K)) (D₁ := D) hfval
      (by simpa only [sub_zero] using
        ((mem_RRspace_iff k K D (f : K)).mp f.property))
  exact hle

name: FunctionField.Chart.RRspace_inf
statement:
theorem RRspace_inf (D E : DivisorA k K) :
    RRspace k K (D ⊓ E) = RRspace k K D ⊓ RRspace k K E
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  simp only [Submodule.mem_inf, mem_RRspace_iff]
  constructor
  · intro hf
    exact ⟨memRRspace.memRRspace_mono (k := k) (K := K) inf_le_left hf,
      memRRspace.memRRspace_mono (k := k) (K := K) inf_le_right hf⟩
  · rintro ⟨hD, hE⟩ v
    change placeValuation k K v f ≤ WithZero.exp ((D ⊓ E) v)
    rw [Finsupp.inf_apply]
    by_cases h : D v ≤ E v
    · rw [inf_eq_left.mpr h]
      exact hD v
    · rw [inf_eq_right.mpr (le_of_not_ge h)]
      exact hE v

name: FunctionField.Chart.RRspace_sup_le
statement:
theorem RRspace_sup_le (D E : DivisorA k K) :
    RRspace k K D ⊔ RRspace k K E ≤ RRspace k K (D ⊔ E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sup_le_iff]
  exact ⟨RRspace_mono k K le_sup_left, RRspace_mono k K le_sup_right⟩

name: FunctionField.Chart.ell_submodular
statement:
theorem ell_submodular (D E : DivisorA k K) :
    ell k K D + ell k K E ≤ ell k K (D ⊔ E) + ell k K (D ⊓ E)
proof:
:= by
  letI : FiniteDimensional k (RRspace k K D) := finiteDimensional_RRspace_aux k K D
  letI : FiniteDimensional k (RRspace k K E) := finiteDimensional_RRspace_aux k K E
  have hsup : Module.finrank k ↑(RRspace k K D ⊔ RRspace k K E) ≤
      Module.finrank k (RRspace k K (D ⊔ E)) :=
    Submodule.finrank_mono (RRspace_sup_le k K D E)
  have hdim := Submodule.finrank_sup_add_finrank_inf_eq
    (RRspace k K D) (RRspace k K E)
  rw [← RRspace_inf k K D E] at hdim
  dsimp only [ell]
  omega

name: FunctionField.Chart.exists_minimal_RRspace
statement:
theorem exists_minimal_RRspace (A : DivisorA k K) (hA : 0 < ell k K A) :
    ∃ D₀ : DivisorA k K, D₀ ≤ A ∧ RRspace k K D₀ = RRspace k K A ∧
      ∀ v : PlaceA k K, ell k K (D₀ - Finsupp.single v 1) < ell k K D₀
proof:
:= by
  let S : Set ℕ := {n | ∃ D : DivisorA k K,
    D ≤ A ∧ RRspace k K D = RRspace k K A ∧ deg k K D = (n : ℤ)}
  have hdegA : 0 ≤ deg k K A := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_effective_add_principal_of_ell_pos k K A hA
    have hdeg := deg_nonneg k K hx
    rw [deg_add, deg_principalDivisor_eq_zero k K x, add_zero] at hdeg
    exact hdeg
  have hS : S.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨(deg k K A).toNat, A, le_rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
    exact (Int.toNat_of_nonneg hdegA).symm
  obtain ⟨D₀, hD₀A, hspace, hdegD₀⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem hS
  refine ⟨D₀, hD₀A, hspace, fun v => ?_⟩
  have hle : D₀ - Finsupp.single v 1 ≤ D₀ := by
    intro w
    simp only [Finsupp.sub_apply]
    exact sub_le_self _ (Finsupp.single_nonneg.mpr (by omega) w)
  have hell_le : ell k K (D₀ - Finsupp.single v 1) ≤ ell k K D₀ :=
    Submodule.finrank_mono (RRspace_mono k K hle)
  rw [lt_iff_le_and_ne]
  refine ⟨hell_le, ?_⟩
  intro hell_eq
  haveI : FiniteDimensional k (RRspace k K D₀) := finiteDimensional_RRspace_aux k K D₀
  have hspace_sub : RRspace k K (D₀ - Finsupp.single v 1) = RRspace k K D₀ :=
    Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq (RRspace_mono k K hle) hell_eq
  have hdegsub_nonneg : 0 ≤ deg k K (D₀ - Finsupp.single v 1) := by
    have hpos : 0 < ell k K (D₀ - Finsupp.single v 1) := by
      rw [hell_eq]
      dsimp only [ell] at hA ⊢
      rw [hspace]
      exact hA
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_effective_add_principal_of_ell_pos k K _ hpos
    have hdeg := deg_nonneg k K hx
    rw [deg_add, deg_principalDivisor_eq_zero k K x, add_zero] at hdeg
    exact hdeg
  let m := (deg k K (D₀ - Finsupp.single v 1)).toNat
  have hmcast : (m : ℤ) = deg k K (D₀ - Finsupp.single v 1) :=
    Int.toNat_of_nonneg hdegsub_nonneg
  have hmS : m ∈ S := by
    refine ⟨D₀ - Finsupp.single v 1, hle.trans hD₀A, ?_, hmcast.symm⟩
    exact hspace_sub.trans hspace
  have hmin := Nat.sInf_le hmS
  have hdegdrop : deg k K (D₀ - Finsupp.single v 1) < deg k K D₀ := by
    rw [deg_sub, deg_single]
    have hv := placeDegree_pos k K v
    omega
  rw [hdegD₀, ← hmcast] at hdegdrop
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hmin) (by exact_mod_cast hdegdrop)

name: FunctionField.Chart.exists_RRspace_avoiding
statement:
theorem exists_RRspace_avoiding [Infinite k] (D₀ : DivisorA k K)
    (s : Finset (PlaceA k K))
    (hdrop : ∀ v ∈ s, ell k K (D₀ - Finsupp.single v 1) < ell k K D₀) :
    ∃ z : RRspace k K D₀, ∀ v ∈ s,
      (z : K) ∉ RRspace k K (D₀ - Finsupp.single v 1)
proof:
:= by
  let p : {v // v ∈ s} → Submodule k (RRspace k K D₀) := fun v =>
    Submodule.comap (RRspace k K D₀).subtype
      (RRspace k K (D₀ - Finsupp.single v.1 1))
  have hp : ∀ v, p v ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro v hv
    have hrev : RRspace k K D₀ ≤ RRspace k K (D₀ - Finsupp.single v.1 1) :=
      Submodule.comap_subtype_eq_top.mp hv
    have hle : D₀ - Finsupp.single v.1 1 ≤ D₀ := by
      intro w
      simp only [Finsupp.sub_apply]
      exact sub_le_self _ (Finsupp.single_nonneg.mpr (by omega) w)
    have heq : RRspace k K (D₀ - Finsupp.single v.1 1) = RRspace k K D₀ :=
      le_antisymm (RRspace_mono k K hle) hrev
    have hell : ell k K (D₀ - Finsupp.single v.1 1) = ell k K D₀ := by
      dsimp only [ell]
      rw [heq]
    exact (ne_of_lt (hdrop v.1 v.2)) hell
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Submodule.exists_forall_notMem_of_forall_ne_top p hp
  refine ⟨z, fun v hv hmem => ?_⟩
  exact hz ⟨v, hv⟩ (by
    simpa only [p, Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.coe_subtype] using hmem)

name: FunctionField.Chart.memRRspace_iff_neg_principalDivisor_le
statement:
theorem memRRspace_iff_neg_principalDivisor_le {D : DivisorA k K} {f : K}
    (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    memRRspace k K D f ↔ ∀ v, -(principalDivisorA k K
      (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 f hf)) v) ≤ D v
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h v
    have hv := h v
    have hval := placeValuation_eq_exp_neg_principalDivisor k K
      (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 f hf)) v
    change placeValuation k K v f ≤ WithZero.exp (D v) at hv
    change placeValuation k K v f = WithZero.exp
      (-(principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 f hf)) v)) at hval
    rw [hval] at hv
    exact WithZero.exp_le_exp.mp hv
  · intro h v
    have hval := placeValuation_eq_exp_neg_principalDivisor k K
      (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 f hf)) v
    change placeValuation k K v f ≤ WithZero.exp (D v)
    change placeValuation k K v f = WithZero.exp
      (-(principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 f hf)) v)) at hval
    rw [hval]
    exact WithZero.exp_le_exp.mpr (h v)

name: FunctionField.Chart.eq_algebraMap_of_mul_mem
statement:
theorem eq_algebraMap_of_mul_mem {D₀ B : DivisorA k K} (hB0 : B ≠ 0) {z x : K}
    (hz : memRRspace k K D₀ z)
    (havoid : ∀ v ∈ B.support, z ∉ RRspace k K (D₀ - Finsupp.single v 1))
    (hx : memRRspace k K B x) (hmul : memRRspace k K D₀ (x * z)) :
    ∃ c : k, x = algebraMap k K c
proof:
:= by
  have hsupp : B.support.Nonempty := Finsupp.support_nonempty_iff.mpr hB0
  obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀⟩ := hsupp
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz0
    subst z
    exact havoid v₀ hv₀ (memRRspace.zero_mem (k := k) (K := K) _)
  by_cases hx0 : x = 0
  · exact ⟨0, by simp [hx0]⟩
  have hxz0 : x * z ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hx0 hz0
  let ux : Kˣ := Units.mk0 x hx0
  let uz : Kˣ := Units.mk0 z hz0
  let uxz : Kˣ := Units.mk0 (x * z) hxz0
  have hxdiv := (memRRspace_iff_neg_principalDivisor_le k K hx0).mp hx
  have hzdiv := (memRRspace_iff_neg_principalDivisor_le k K hz0).mp hz
  have hmuldiv := (memRRspace_iff_neg_principalDivisor_le k K hxz0).mp hmul
  change ∀ v, -(principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul ux) v) ≤ B v at hxdiv
  change ∀ v, -(principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul uz) v) ≤ D₀ v at hzdiv
  change ∀ v, -(principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul uxz) v) ≤ D₀ v at hmuldiv
  have hvalx : ∀ v : PlaceA k K, placeValuation k K v x ≤ 1 := by
    intro v
    have hdivx : 0 ≤ principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul ux) v := by
      by_cases hv : v ∈ B.support
      · have hzexact : -(principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul uz) v) = D₀ v := by
          have hle := hzdiv v
          have hnle : ¬ -(principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul uz) v) ≤ D₀ v - 1 := by
            intro hsmall
            apply havoid v hv
            rw [mem_RRspace_iff]
            apply (memRRspace_iff_neg_principalDivisor_le k K hz0).mpr
            intro w
            by_cases hw : w = v
            · subst w
              simpa using hsmall
            · simpa [Finsupp.single_apply, hw] using hzdiv w
          omega
        have hdivmul : principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul uxz) v =
            principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul ux) v +
              principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul uz) v := by
          have hu : uxz = ux * uz := by
            apply Units.ext
            rfl
          rw [hu, ofMul_mul, (principalDivisorA k K).map_add, Finsupp.add_apply]
        have hp := hmuldiv v
        rw [hdivmul] at hp
        omega
      · have hBv : B v = 0 := Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hv
        have hp := hxdiv v
        rw [hBv] at hp
        omega
    have hval := placeValuation_eq_exp_neg_principalDivisor k K
      (Additive.ofMul ux) v
    change placeValuation k K v x = WithZero.exp
      (-(principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul ux) v)) at hval
    rw [hval, ← WithZero.exp_zero]
    exact WithZero.exp_le_exp.mpr (by omega)
  exact IsFullConstantField.algebraic_mem (k := k) (K := K) x
    (isAlgebraic_of_placeValuation_le_one k K x hvalx)

name: FunctionField.Chart.ell_add_ell_le_of_effective_minimal
statement:
theorem ell_add_ell_le_of_effective_minimal [Infinite k]
    (D₀ B : DivisorA k K) (hB : IsEffective k K B) (hB0 : B ≠ 0)
    (hdrop : ∀ v ∈ B.support,
      ell k K (D₀ - Finsupp.single v 1) < ell k K D₀) :
    ell k K D₀ + ell k K B ≤ 1 + ell k K (D₀ + B)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hzavoid⟩ := exists_RRspace_avoiding k K D₀ B.support hdrop
  let T := RRspace k K (D₀ + B)
  let P : Submodule k T := Submodule.comap T.subtype (RRspace k K D₀)
  let mulZ : RRspace k K B →ₗ[k] T := {
    toFun x := ⟨(x : K) * (z : K), by
      rw [mem_RRspace_iff]
      simpa only [add_comm] using memRRspace.mul_mem (k := k) (K := K)
        ((mem_RRspace_iff k K B (x : K)).mp x.property)
        ((mem_RRspace_iff k K D₀ (z : K)).mp z.property)⟩
    map_add' x y := Subtype.ext (add_mul (x : K) (y : K) (z : K))
    map_smul' c x := Subtype.ext (by
      simp only [Submodule.coe_smul_of_tower, RingHom.id_apply, Algebra.smul_def]
      ring) }
  let φ : RRspace k K B →ₗ[k] T ⧸ P := P.mkQ.comp mulZ
  have hone_mem : memRRspace k K B (1 : K) :=
    memRRspace.memRRspace_mono (k := k) (K := K) (show (0 : DivisorA k K) ≤ B from hB)
      (memRRspace.one_mem (k := k) (K := K))
  let oneB : RRspace k K B := ⟨1, hone_mem⟩
  have hker_le : φ.ker ≤ k ∙ oneB := by
    intro x hxker
    have hq : P.mkQ (mulZ x) = 0 := by
      exact hxker
    have hp : mulZ x ∈ P := Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero P |>.mp hq
    have hmul : memRRspace k K D₀ ((x : K) * (z : K)) := by
      exact hp
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := eq_algebraMap_of_mul_mem k K hB0
      ((mem_RRspace_iff k K D₀ (z : K)).mp z.property) hzavoid
      ((mem_RRspace_iff k K B (x : K)).mp x.property) hmul
    have hxeq : x = c • oneB := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp only [Submodule.coe_smul_of_tower, oneB, Algebra.smul_def]
      rw [hc, mul_one]
    rw [hxeq]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self oneB)
  have hker_ge : k ∙ oneB ≤ φ.ker := by
    rw [Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
    change P.mkQ (mulZ oneB) = 0
    apply (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero P).mpr
    change (1 : K) * (z : K) ∈ RRspace k K D₀
    simpa only [one_mul] using z.property
  have hker : φ.ker = k ∙ oneB := le_antisymm hker_le hker_ge
  have honeB : oneB ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hc := congr_arg (fun q : RRspace k K B => (q : K)) h
    change (1 : K) = 0 at hc
    exact one_ne_zero hc
  have hfinKer : Module.finrank k φ.ker = 1 := by
    rw [hker, finrank_span_singleton honeB]
  have hDle : RRspace k K D₀ ≤ T := by
    exact RRspace_mono k K (show D₀ ≤ D₀ + B by
      intro v
      simp only [Finsupp.add_apply]
      linarith [hB v])
  have hmapP : P.map T.subtype = RRspace k K D₀ := by
    dsimp only [P]
    rw [Submodule.map_comap_subtype, inf_eq_right.mpr hDle]
  have hfinP : Module.finrank k P = ell k K D₀ := by
    rw [← Submodule.finrank_map_subtype_eq T P, hmapP]
    rfl
  letI : FiniteDimensional k (RRspace k K B) := finiteDimensional_RRspace_aux k K B
  letI : FiniteDimensional k T := finiteDimensional_RRspace_aux k K (D₀ + B)
  have hranknull := φ.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  have hrange : Module.finrank k φ.range ≤ Module.finrank k (T ⧸ P) := by
    simpa only [finrank_top] using
      Submodule.finrank_mono (show φ.range ≤ (⊤ : Submodule k (T ⧸ P)) from le_top)
  have hquot := P.finrank_quotient_add_finrank
  dsimp only [ell] at hfinP
  rw [hfinKer] at hranknull
  rw [hfinP] at hquot
  dsimp only [ell] at ⊢
  change Module.finrank k (RRspace k K D₀) + Module.finrank k (RRspace k K B) ≤
    1 + Module.finrank k T
  omega

name: FunctionField.Chart.ell_add_ell_le_infinite
statement:
theorem ell_add_ell_le_infinite [Infinite k]
    (A B : DivisorA k K) (hA : 0 < ell k K A) (hB : 0 < ell k K B) :
    ell k K A + ell k K B ≤ 1 + ell k K (A + B)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hxeff⟩ := exists_effective_add_principal_of_ell_pos k K A hA
  obtain ⟨y, hyeff⟩ := exists_effective_add_principal_of_ell_pos k K B hB
  let A₀ := A + principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul x)
  let B₀ := B + principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul y)
  have hellA₀ : ell k K A₀ = ell k K A := ell_add_principal k K A x
  have hellB₀ : ell k K B₀ = ell k K B := ell_add_principal k K B y
  have hA₀pos : 0 < ell k K A₀ := hellA₀.symm ▸ hA
  obtain ⟨D₀, hD₀le, hspace, hdrop⟩ := exists_minimal_RRspace k K A₀ hA₀pos
  have hellD₀ : ell k K D₀ = ell k K A₀ := by
    dsimp only [ell]
    rw [hspace]
  have hle : D₀ + B₀ ≤ A₀ + B₀ := by
    intro v
    simp only [Finsupp.add_apply]
    linarith [hD₀le v]
  have hell_mono : ell k K (D₀ + B₀) ≤ ell k K (A₀ + B₀) :=
    Submodule.finrank_mono (RRspace_mono k K hle)
  have hsum : A₀ + B₀ = (A + B) +
      principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul (x * y)) := by
    dsimp only [A₀, B₀]
    rw [ofMul_mul, (principalDivisorA k K).map_add]
    abel
  have hellsum : ell k K (A₀ + B₀) = ell k K (A + B) := by
    rw [hsum, ell_add_principal]
  by_cases hB₀0 : B₀ = 0
  · have hellB₀one : ell k K B₀ = 1 := by
      rw [hB₀0, ell_zero k K]
    have hellsum0 : ell k K A₀ = ell k K (A + B) := by
      simpa only [hB₀0, add_zero] using hellsum
    rw [← hellA₀, ← hellB₀, hellB₀one, ← hellsum0]
    omega
  · have hkey := ell_add_ell_le_of_effective_minimal k K D₀ B₀ hyeff hB₀0
      (fun v _ => hdrop v)
    rw [← hellA₀, ← hellB₀, ← hellsum]
    omega

name: FunctionField.Chart.ell_add_ell_le
statement:
theorem ell_add_ell_le (A B : DivisorA k K) (hA : 0 < ell k K A)
    (hB : 0 < ell k K B) :
    ell k K A + ell k K B ≤ 1 + ell k K (A + B)
proof:
:= by
  letI : FiniteDimensional k (RRspace k K A) := finiteDimensional_RRspace_aux k K A
  letI : FiniteDimensional k (RRspace k K B) := finiteDimensional_RRspace_aux k K B
  have hAne : RRspace k K A ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro hzero
    dsimp only [ell] at hA
    rw [hzero, finrank_bot] at hA
    omega
  have hBne : RRspace k K B ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro hzero
    dsimp only [ell] at hB
    rw [hzero, finrank_bot] at hB
    omega
  have hAfg : (RRspace k K A).FG :=
    (Submodule.fg_top (RRspace k K A)).mp Module.Finite.fg_top
  have hBfg : (RRspace k K B).FG :=
    (Submodule.fg_top (RRspace k K B)).mp Module.Finite.fg_top
  letI : FiniteDimensional k (RRspace k K A * RRspace k K B) :=
    Module.Finite.of_fg (hAfg.mul hBfg)
  have hproduct := mul_finrank k K (RRspace k K A) (RRspace k K B) hAne hBne
  have hmul : RRspace k K A * RRspace k K B ≤ RRspace k K (A + B) := by
    apply Submodule.mul_le.mpr
    intro x hx y hy
    rw [mem_RRspace_iff] at hx hy ⊢
    exact memRRspace.mul_mem (k := k) (K := K) hx hy
  have hmono : Module.finrank k (RRspace k K A * RRspace k K B) ≤
      Module.finrank k (RRspace k K (A + B)) :=
    Submodule.finrank_mono hmul
  dsimp only [ell]
  omega

name: FunctionField.Chart.clifford_of_ell_pos
statement:
theorem clifford_of_ell_pos {W : DivisorA k K} (hW : IsCanonical k K W) (D : DivisorA k K)
    (hℓD : 0 < ell k K D) (hℓW : 0 < ell k K (W - D)) :
    2 * ((ell k K D : ℤ) - 1) ≤ deg k K D
proof:
:= by
  have hkey := ell_add_ell_le k K D (W - D) hℓD hℓW
  have hsum : D + (W - D) = W := by abel
  rw [hsum, ell_canonical k K hW] at hkey
  have hRR := riemann_roch k K hW D
  omega

name: FunctionField.Chart.clifford
statement:
theorem clifford {W : DivisorA k K} (hW : IsCanonical k K W) (D : DivisorA k K)
    (_hdeg₀ : 0 ≤ deg k K D) (_hdeg₁ : deg k K D ≤ 2 * (genus k K : ℤ) - 2)
    (hℓD : 0 < ell k K D) (hℓW : 0 < ell k K (W - D)) :
    2 * ((ell k K D : ℤ) - 1) ≤ deg k K D
proof:
:=
  clifford_of_ell_pos k K hW D hℓD hℓW

name: FunctionField.Chart.exists_nonspecial_divisor
statement:
theorem exists_nonspecial_divisor :
    ∃ D : DivisorA k K, indexOfSpecialty k K D = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := exists_defect_eq k K
  refine ⟨D, ?_⟩
  have hi := indexOfSpecialty_eq k K D
  simp only [defect] at hD
  omega

name: FunctionField.Chart.genus_ratFunc_via_corollaries
statement: theorem genus_ratFunc_via_corollaries : genus k (RatFunc k) = 0
proof:
:=
  genus_ratFunc k

name: FunctionField.Chart.deg_canonical_ratFunc
statement:
theorem deg_canonical_ratFunc {W : DivisorA k (RatFunc k)} (hW : IsCanonical k (RatFunc k) W) :
    deg k (RatFunc k) W = -2
proof:
:= by
  rw [deg_canonical k (RatFunc k) hW, genus_ratFunc]
  norm_num

name: FunctionField.Chart.ell_neg_deg_ratFunc
statement:
theorem ell_neg_deg_ratFunc (D : DivisorA k (RatFunc k)) (h : deg k (RatFunc k) D < 0) :
    ell k (RatFunc k) D = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact RRspace_neg_deg_ell k (RatFunc k) h

name: FunctionField.Chart.ell_large_deg_ratFunc
statement:
theorem ell_large_deg_ratFunc {W : DivisorA k (RatFunc k)} (hW : IsCanonical k (RatFunc k) W)
    (D : DivisorA k (RatFunc k)) (h : deg k (RatFunc k) D ≥ -1) :
    (ell k (RatFunc k) D : ℤ) = deg k (RatFunc k) D + 1
proof:
:= by
  have h' : deg k (RatFunc k) D ≥ 2 * (genus k (RatFunc k) : ℤ) - 1 := by
    rw [genus_ratFunc]
    norm_num
    exact h
  simpa [genus_ratFunc] using ell_eq_of_deg_ge k (RatFunc k) hW D h'

name: FunctionField.Chart.finrank_differentialSpace_generalConstants
statement:
theorem finrank_differentialSpace_generalConstants (D : DivisorA k K) :
    Module.finrank k (differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K) D) =
      indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants k K D
proof:
:= by
  let S := adeleFilt k K D + diagonalSubmodule k K
  have homega : differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K) D = S.dualAnnihilator := by
    exact differentialSpace_eq_dualAnnihilator D
  rw [homega, ← S.dualQuotEquivDualAnnihilator.finrank_eq, Subspace.dual_finrank_eq]
  exact finrank_adele_quotient_generalConstants k K D

name: FunctionField.Chart.exists_nontrivial_omega_generalConstants
statement:
theorem exists_nontrivial_omega_generalConstants :
    ∃ D : DivisorA k K, differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K) D ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsScalarTower k k⟮X⟯ K :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun c => by
      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k k[X] K,
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k[X] k⟮X⟯ K,
        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k k[X] k⟮X⟯]
  let x : K := algebraMap k⟮X⟯ K (RatFunc.X : k⟮X⟯)
  have hx : ¬IsAlgebraic k x := by
    exact (transcendental_algebraMap_iff (algebraMap k⟮X⟯ K).injective).2
      RatFunc.transcendental_X
  let E : DivisorA k K := polarDivisor k K x
  let c := ell k K (0 : DivisorA k K)
  let r := c + 1
  let D : DivisorA k K := -(r • E)
  have hE : 0 < deg k K E := polar_deg_pos k K hx
  have hD : deg k K D < 0 := by
    have hr : 0 < r := Nat.zero_lt_succ c
    simp only [D, deg_neg, deg_nsmul]
    exact neg_lt_zero.mpr (mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast hr) hE)
  have hell : ell k K D = 0 := RRspace_neg_deg_ell k K hD
  have hi := indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants_eq (k := k) (K := K) D
  have hindex : 0 < indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants k K D := by
    have hg : 0 ≤ (genusWithConstants k K : ℤ) := Int.natCast_nonneg _
    have hc : (ell k K (0 : DivisorA k K) : ℤ) = (c : ℤ) := rfl
    have hr : (r : ℤ) = (c : ℤ) + 1 := by simp [r]
    have hdegE : (1 : ℤ) ≤ deg k K E := hE
    have hprod : (c : ℤ) < (r : ℤ) * deg k K E := by
      rw [hr]
      nlinarith [Int.natCast_nonneg c]
    have hindexZ : (0 : ℤ) < (indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants k K D : ℤ) := by
      rw [hi, hell, hc]
      simp only [D, deg_neg, deg_nsmul]
      omega
    exact_mod_cast hindexZ
  refine ⟨D, fun hbot => ?_⟩
  have hfin : 0 < Module.finrank k (differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K) D) := by
    rw [finrank_differentialSpace_generalConstants]
    exact hindex
  rw [hbot, finrank_bot] at hfin
  omega

name: FunctionField.Chart.finrank_weilDifferential_eq_one_generalConstants
statement:
theorem finrank_weilDifferential_eq_one_generalConstants :
    Module.finrank K (WeilDifferential k K) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D₀', hD₀'⟩ := exists_nontrivial_omega_generalConstants (k := k) (K := K)
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hφ0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hD₀'
  set ω₀ : WeilDifferential k K := ⟨φ, ⟨D₀', hφ⟩⟩ with hω₀def
  have hω₀ne : ω₀ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hφ0
    have hval : ω₀.toFun = φ := rfl
    rw [← hval, h]
    rfl
  refine (finrank_eq_one_iff_of_nonzero' ω₀ hω₀ne).mpr ?_
  intro ω
  by_contra hspan
  push Not at hspan
  have hindep : ∀ f g : K, f • ω₀ + g • ω = 0 → f = 0 ∧ g = 0 := by
    intro f g hfg
    by_cases hg : g = 0
    · subst hg
      rw [zero_smul, add_zero] at hfg
      refine ⟨?_, rfl⟩
      by_contra hf
      exact hω₀ne ((smulWeil_eq_zero_iff f hf ω₀).mp hfg)
    · exfalso
      apply hspan (g⁻¹ * (-f))
      have hgω : g • ω = (-f) • ω₀ := by
        have hneg : g • ω = -(f • ω₀) := by
          rw [eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, add_comm]
          exact hfg
        rw [hneg, neg_smul]
      have hω : ω = (g⁻¹ * (-f)) • ω₀ := by
        rw [mul_smul, ← hgω, ← mul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hg, one_smul]
      exact hω.symm
  obtain ⟨D₁, hD₁⟩ := ω₀.vanishes_on
  obtain ⟨D₂, hD₂⟩ := ω.vanishes_on
  set D₀ : DivisorA k K := D₁ ⊓ D₂ with hD₀def
  have h₀ : D₀ ∈ vanishingDivisors ω₀ :=
    mem_vanishingDivisors_of_le inf_le_left hD₁
  have h₂ : D₀ ∈ vanishingDivisors ω :=
    mem_vanishingDivisors_of_le inf_le_right hD₂
  set B : DivisorA k K := polarDivisor k K (XK k K) with hBdef
  have hBpos : 0 < deg k K B := polar_deg_pos k K (not_algebraic_XK k K)
  have hb1 : 1 ≤ deg k K B := hBpos
  have hcount : ∀ n : ℕ,
      2 * (ell k K (n • B) : ℤ) ≤
        indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants k K (D₀ - n • B) := by
    intro n
    set E : DivisorA k K := n • B with hEdef
    have hinj : Function.Injective
        (LinearMap.coprod (smulIntoOmega ω₀ h₀ E) (smulIntoOmega ω h₂ E)) := by
      intro x y hxy
      have hd : (LinearMap.coprod (smulIntoOmega ω₀ h₀ E)
          (smulIntoOmega ω h₂ E)) (x - y) = 0 := by
        rw [map_sub, hxy, sub_self]
      rw [LinearMap.coprod_apply] at hd
      have hcoe : (smulWeil (((x - y).1 : RRspace k K E) : K) ω₀).toFun
          + (smulWeil (((x - y).2 : RRspace k K E) : K) ω).toFun = 0 := by
        have h1 := congrArg Subtype.val hd
        simpa only [Submodule.coe_add, smulIntoOmega_coe, Submodule.coe_zero] using h1
      have hsum : ((((x - y).1 : RRspace k K E) : K) • ω₀
          + (((x - y).2 : RRspace k K E) : K) • ω).toFun = 0 := by
        rw [add_toFun]
        exact hcoe
      have hzero : (((x - y).1 : RRspace k K E) : K) • ω₀
          + (((x - y).2 : RRspace k K E) : K) • ω = 0 := ext hsum
      obtain ⟨hf0, hg0⟩ := hindep _ _ hzero
      have hxy0 : x - y = 0 := Prod.ext (Subtype.ext hf0) (Subtype.ext hg0)
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp hxy0
    have hfrle : Module.finrank k (RRspace k K E × RRspace k K E) ≤
        Module.finrank k (differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K) (D₀ - E)) :=
      LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective hinj
    rw [Module.finrank_prod, finrank_differentialSpace_generalConstants] at hfrle
    have hLfr : Module.finrank k (RRspace k K E) = ell k K E := rfl
    rw [hLfr] at hfrle
    omega
  set c : ℤ := (ell k K (0 : DivisorA k K) : ℤ) with hcdef
  set M : ℤ := max (deg k K D₀)
    (3 * (genusWithConstants k K : ℤ) - 3 * c - deg k K D₀) with hMdef
  set n : ℕ := M.toNat + 1 with hndef
  have hn_ge : (n : ℤ) ≥ M + 1 := by
    have hself := Int.self_le_toNat M
    push_cast [hndef]
    omega
  have hn_d0 : (n : ℤ) > deg k K D₀ := by
    have hle : deg k K D₀ ≤ M := le_max_left _ _
    omega
  have hn_g : (n : ℤ) >
      3 * (genusWithConstants k K : ℤ) - 3 * c - deg k K D₀ := by
    have hle :
        3 * (genusWithConstants k K : ℤ) - 3 * c - deg k K D₀ ≤ M :=
      le_max_right _ _
    omega
  have hnb_ge : (n : ℤ) * deg k K B ≥ (n : ℤ) := by
    have hn0 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ (n : ℤ) := Int.natCast_nonneg n
    nlinarith [hb1, hn0]
  have hdegsub : deg k K (D₀ - n • B) =
      deg k K D₀ - (n : ℤ) * deg k K B := by
    rw [deg_sub, deg_nsmul]
  have hdeg_neg : deg k K (D₀ - n • B) < 0 := by
    rw [hdegsub]
    omega
  have hell0 : ell k K (D₀ - n • B) = 0 :=
    RRspace_neg_deg_ell k K hdeg_neg
  have hi := indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants_eq
    (k := k) (K := K) (D₀ - n • B)
  rw [hell0, hdegsub] at hi
  have hrr := riemann_ineq_withConstants (k := k) (K := K) (n • B)
  rw [deg_nsmul] at hrr
  have hc := hcount n
  rw [← hcdef] at hi hrr
  omega

name: FunctionField.Chart.WeilDifferential.deg_le_of_mem_vanishingDivisors_generalConstants
statement:
theorem deg_le_of_mem_vanishingDivisors_generalConstants
    {ω : WeilDifferential k K} (hω : ω.toFun ≠ 0)
    {D : DivisorA k K} (hD : D ∈ vanishingDivisors ω) :
    deg k K D ≤
      2 * (genusWithConstants k K : ℤ) - ell k K (0 : DivisorA k K)
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (smulIntoOmega ω hD D) :=
    smulIntoOmega_injective ω hD D hω
  have hle : Module.finrank k (RRspace k K D) ≤
      Module.finrank k (differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K) (D - D)) :=
    LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective hinj
  have hDD : D - D = (0 : DivisorA k K) := sub_self D
  have homega :
      Module.finrank k (differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K) (D - D)) =
        genusWithConstants k K := by
    rw [hDD, finrank_differentialSpace_generalConstants]
    have hidx := indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants_eq
      (k := k) (K := K) (0 : DivisorA k K)
    rw [deg_zero (k := k) (K := K)] at hidx
    omega
  have hellg : (ell k K D : ℤ) ≤ (genusWithConstants k K : ℤ) := by
    have hnat : ell k K D ≤ genusWithConstants k K := by
      rw [show ell k K D = Module.finrank k (RRspace k K D) from rfl, ← homega]
      exact hle
    exact_mod_cast hnat
  have hRR := riemann_ineq_withConstants (k := k) (K := K) D
  omega

name: FunctionField.Chart.WeilDifferential.exists_max_vanishingDivisor_generalConstants
statement:
theorem exists_max_vanishingDivisor_generalConstants
    {ω : WeilDifferential k K} (hω : IsNonzero ω) :
    ∃! W : DivisorA k K, W ∈ vanishingDivisors ω ∧
      ∀ D ∈ vanishingDivisors ω, D ≤ W
proof:
:= by
  have hω' : ω.toFun ≠ 0 := hω
  set P : ℤ → Prop := fun z => ∃ D ∈ vanishingDivisors ω, deg k K D = z with hP
  have hInh : ∃ z, P z := by
    obtain ⟨D₀, hD₀⟩ := ω.vanishes_on
    exact ⟨deg k K D₀, D₀, hD₀, rfl⟩
  have hBdd : ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ z, P z → z ≤ b := by
    refine ⟨2 * (genusWithConstants k K : ℤ) -
      ell k K (0 : DivisorA k K), ?_⟩
    rintro z ⟨D, hD, rfl⟩
    exact deg_le_of_mem_vanishingDivisors_generalConstants hω' hD
  obtain ⟨ub, ⟨W, hWmem, hWdeg⟩, hubmax⟩ :=
    Int.exists_greatest_of_bdd hBdd hInh
  have hmaxdiv : ∀ D ∈ vanishingDivisors ω, D ≤ W := by
    intro D hD
    have hsup : D ⊔ W ∈ vanishingDivisors ω :=
      sup_mem_vanishingDivisors hD hWmem
    have hdegle : deg k K (D ⊔ W) ≤ ub := hubmax _ ⟨D ⊔ W, hsup, rfl⟩
    have hWle : W ≤ D ⊔ W := le_sup_right
    have hdegW : deg k K (D ⊔ W) ≤ deg k K W := by
      rw [hWdeg]
      exact hdegle
    have heq : W = D ⊔ W := eq_of_le_of_deg_le k K hWle hdegW
    rw [heq]
    exact le_sup_left
  refine ⟨W, ⟨hWmem, hmaxdiv⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro W' ⟨hW'mem, hW'max⟩
  exact le_antisymm (hmaxdiv W' hW'mem) (hW'max W hWmem)

name: FunctionField.Chart.WeilDifferential.divOmegaGeneralConstants_smul
statement:
theorem divOmegaGeneralConstants_smul
    (x : Kˣ) (ω : WeilDifferential k K) (hω : IsNonzero ω)
    (hxω : IsNonzero ((x : K) • ω)) :
    divOmegaGeneralConstants ((x : K) • ω) hxω =
      divOmegaGeneralConstants ω hω +
        principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul x)
proof:
:= by
  let W := divOmegaGeneralConstants ω hω
  let P := principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul x)
  have hmax : W ∈ vanishingDivisors ω ∧
      ∀ D ∈ vanishingDivisors ω, D ≤ W := by
    simpa only [W, divOmegaGeneralConstants] using
      (Classical.choose_spec (exists_max_vanishingDivisor_generalConstants
        (k := k) (K := K) hω)).1
  have htarget : W + P ∈ vanishingDivisors ((x : K) • ω) ∧
      ∀ E ∈ vanishingDivisors ((x : K) • ω), E ≤ W + P := by
    constructor
    · exact (add_principal_mem_vanishingDivisors_smul_iff
        (k := k) (K := K) x ω W).2 hmax.1
    · intro E hE
      have htranslate : (E - P) + P = E := by abel
      have hE' : E - P ∈ vanishingDivisors ω := by
        apply (add_principal_mem_vanishingDivisors_smul_iff
          (k := k) (K := K) x ω (E - P)).1
        simpa only [P, htranslate] using hE
      have hle := hmax.2 (E - P) hE'
      intro v
      have hv := hle v
      simp only [Finsupp.sub_apply, Finsupp.add_apply] at hv ⊢
      omega
  let hex := exists_max_vanishingDivisor_generalConstants
    (k := k) (K := K) hxω
  have hchosen : divOmegaGeneralConstants ((x : K) • ω) hxω ∈
        vanishingDivisors ((x : K) • ω) ∧
      ∀ D ∈ vanishingDivisors ((x : K) • ω),
        D ≤ divOmegaGeneralConstants ((x : K) • ω) hxω := by
    simpa only [divOmegaGeneralConstants, hex] using
      (Classical.choose_spec hex).1
  exact hex.unique hchosen htarget

name: FunctionField.Chart.exists_isCanonical_generalConstants
statement:
theorem exists_isCanonical_generalConstants :
    ∃ W : DivisorA k K, IsCanonicalGeneralConstants k K W
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := exists_nontrivial_omega_generalConstants (k := k) (K := K)
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hφ0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hD
  let ω : WeilDifferential k K := ⟨φ, ⟨D, hφ⟩⟩
  have hω : WeilDifferential.IsNonzero ω := hφ0
  exact ⟨WeilDifferential.divOmegaGeneralConstants ω hω, ω, hω, rfl⟩

name: FunctionField.Chart.isCanonicalGeneralConstants_unique_up_to_principal
statement:
theorem isCanonicalGeneralConstants_unique_up_to_principal
    {W₁ W₂ : DivisorA k K}
    (h₁ : IsCanonicalGeneralConstants k K W₁)
    (h₂ : IsCanonicalGeneralConstants k K W₂) :
    ∃ f : Kˣ, W₁ - W₂ = principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul f)
proof:
:= by
  rcases h₁ with ⟨ω₁, hω₁, rfl⟩
  rcases h₂ with ⟨ω₂, hω₂, rfl⟩
  have hω₁0 : ω₁ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hω₁
    rw [h]
    rfl
  have hω₂0 : ω₂ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hω₂
    rw [h]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_smul_eq_of_finrank_eq_one (K := K)
    (finrank_weilDifferential_eq_one_generalConstants (k := k) (K := K)) hω₂0 ω₁
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    subst c
    apply hω₁0
    simpa only [zero_smul] using hc.symm
  let f : Kˣ := Units.mk0 c hc0
  have hcf : (f : K) • ω₂ = ω₁ := by
    simpa only [f, Units.val_mk0] using hc
  have hnontrivial : WeilDifferential.IsNonzero ((f : K) • ω₂) := hcf.symm ▸ hω₁
  refine ⟨f, ?_⟩
  have hdiv := WeilDifferential.divOmegaGeneralConstants_smul
    (k := k) (K := K) f ω₂ hω₂ hnontrivial
  calc
    WeilDifferential.divOmegaGeneralConstants ω₁ hω₁ -
        WeilDifferential.divOmegaGeneralConstants ω₂ hω₂ =
      WeilDifferential.divOmegaGeneralConstants ((f : K) • ω₂) hnontrivial -
        WeilDifferential.divOmegaGeneralConstants ω₂ hω₂ := by
          congr 2
          exact hcf.symm
    _ = principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul f) := by
      rw [hdiv]
      abel

name: FunctionField.Chart.duality_generalConstants
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ω₀, hω₀, hdivW⟩ := hW
  have hω₀' : ω₀.toFun ≠ 0 := hω₀
  have hω₀ne : ω₀ ≠ 0 := fun h => hω₀ (by rw [h]; rfl)
  have hWspec : W ∈ vanishingDivisors ω₀ ∧
      ∀ D' ∈ vanishingDivisors ω₀, D' ≤ W := by
    have h := (Classical.choose_spec
      (WeilDifferential.exists_max_vanishingDivisor_generalConstants
        (k := k) (K := K) hω₀)).1
    have he : Classical.choose
        (WeilDifferential.exists_max_vanishingDivisor_generalConstants
          (k := k) (K := K) hω₀) = W := hdivW
    rw [he] at h
    exact h
  obtain ⟨hWmem, hWmax⟩ := hWspec
  have hWD : W - (W - D) = D := sub_sub_cancel W D
  set mu := smulIntoOmega ω₀ hWmem (W - D) with hmudef
  have hmuinj : Function.Injective mu :=
    smulIntoOmega_injective ω₀ hWmem (W - D) hω₀'
  have hmusurj : Function.Surjective mu := by
    intro psi
    set phi : AdeleSpace k K →ₗ[k] k := (psi : AdeleSpace k K →ₗ[k] k) with hphidef
    by_cases hpsi0 : phi = 0
    · exact ⟨0, by rw [map_zero]; exact (Subtype.ext hpsi0).symm⟩
    · have hpsimem : ∀ α ∈ adeleFilt k K D + diagonalSubmodule k K, phi α = 0 := by
        have hp : ∀ α ∈ adeleFilt k K (W - (W - D)) + diagonalSubmodule k K,
            phi α = 0 := psi.property
        rw [hWD] at hp
        exact hp
      set eta : WeilDifferential k K := ⟨phi, ⟨D, hpsimem⟩⟩ with hetadef
      have hetant : eta.toFun ≠ 0 := hpsi0
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_smul_eq_of_finrank_eq_one (K := K)
        (finrank_weilDifferential_eq_one_generalConstants (k := k) (K := K))
        hω₀ne eta
      have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := by
        intro h
        subst h
        apply hetant
        have heta0 : eta = 0 := by rw [← hc, zero_smul]
        rw [heta0]
        rfl
      set cu : Kˣ := Units.mk0 c hc0 with hcudef
      set P : DivisorA k K := principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul cu) with hPdef
      have hDmem : D ∈ vanishingDivisors ((cu : K) • ω₀) := by
        have hcomega : (cu : K) • ω₀ = eta := by
          rw [Units.val_mk0]
          exact hc
        rw [hcomega]
        intro α hα
        exact hpsimem α hα
      have hDPmem : D - P ∈ vanishingDivisors ω₀ := by
        apply (add_principal_mem_vanishingDivisors_smul_iff
          (k := k) (K := K) cu ω₀ (D - P)).1
        have hsub : (D - P) + P = D := by rw [hPdef]; abel
        rw [hsub]
        exact hDmem
      have hDPle : D - P ≤ W := hWmax (D - P) hDPmem
      have hcmem : memRRspace k K (W - D) c := by
        intro v
        have hval := placeValuation_eq_exp_neg_principalDivisor
          k K (Additive.ofMul cu) v
        change placeValuation k K v c ≤ WithZero.exp ((W - D) v)
        have hcv : placeValuation k K v c = WithZero.exp (-(P v)) := by
          rw [hPdef]
          have hcuc : (cu : K) = c := by simp [hcudef]
          rw [← hcuc]
          exact hval
        rw [hcv]
        apply WithZero.exp_le_exp.mpr
        have hlev := hDPle v
        simp only [Finsupp.sub_apply] at hlev ⊢
        omega
      refine ⟨⟨c, (mem_RRspace_iff k K (W - D) c).mpr hcmem⟩, ?_⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [hmudef, smulIntoOmega_coe]
      change ((c : K) • ω₀).toFun = phi
      rw [hc]
  have hfr : Module.finrank k (RRspace k K (W - D)) =
      Module.finrank k (differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K) (W - (W - D))) :=
    (LinearEquiv.ofBijective mu ⟨hmuinj, hmusurj⟩).finrank_eq
  show Module.finrank k (RRspace k K (W - D)) =
    indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants k K D
  rw [hfr, hWD, finrank_differentialSpace_generalConstants]

name: FunctionField.Chart.nonempty_dualityLinearEquiv_generalConstants
statement:
theorem nonempty_dualityLinearEquiv_generalConstants
    {W : DivisorA k K} (hW : IsCanonicalGeneralConstants k K W)
    (D : DivisorA k K) :
    Nonempty (RRspace k K (W - D) ≃ₗ[k]
      differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K) D)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ω, hω, hdivW⟩ := hW
  have hWmem : W ∈ vanishingDivisors ω := by
    have h := (Classical.choose_spec
      (WeilDifferential.exists_max_vanishingDivisor_generalConstants
        (k := k) (K := K) hω)).1.1
    have he : Classical.choose
        (WeilDifferential.exists_max_vanishingDivisor_generalConstants
          (k := k) (K := K) hω) = W := hdivW
    rwa [he] at h
  let mu := smulIntoOmega ω hWmem (W - D)
  have hmuinj : Function.Injective mu :=
    smulIntoOmega_injective ω hWmem (W - D) hω
  have hWD : W - (W - D) = D := sub_sub_cancel W D
  let eD : differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K) (W - (W - D)) ≃ₗ[k]
      differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K) D :=
    LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ (congrArg (differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K)) hWD)
  let muD : RRspace k K (W - D) →ₗ[k]
      differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K) D := eD.toLinearMap.comp mu
  have hmuDinj : Function.Injective muD := eD.injective.comp hmuinj
  have hdim : Module.finrank k (RRspace k K (W - D)) =
      Module.finrank k (differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K) D) := by
    calc
      Module.finrank k (RRspace k K (W - D)) = ell k K (W - D) := rfl
      _ = indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants k K D :=
        duality_generalConstants k K ⟨ω, hω, hdivW⟩ D
      _ = Module.finrank k (differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K) D) :=
        (finrank_differentialSpace_generalConstants k K D).symm
  let e : RRspace k K (W - D) ≃ₗ[k]
      differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K) D :=
    LinearMap.linearEquivOfInjective (K := k)
      (V := RRspace k K (W - D))
      (V₂ := differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K) D)
      muD hmuDinj hdim
  exact ⟨e⟩

name: FunctionField.Chart.indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants_eq_ell_sub
statement:
theorem indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants_eq_ell_sub
    {W : DivisorA k K} (hW : IsCanonicalGeneralConstants k K W)
    (D : DivisorA k K) :
    (indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants k K D : ℤ) = ell k K (W - D)
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast (duality_generalConstants k K hW D).symm

name: FunctionField.Chart.riemann_roch_generalConstants
statement:
theorem riemann_roch_generalConstants
    {W : DivisorA k K} (hW : IsCanonicalGeneralConstants k K W)
    (D : DivisorA k K) :
    (ell k K D : ℤ) =
      deg k K D + ell k K (0 : DivisorA k K) -
        (genusWithConstants k K : ℤ) + ell k K (W - D)
proof:
:= by
  have hi := indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants_eq k K D
  have hdual := indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants_eq_ell_sub k K hW D
  omega

name: FunctionField.Chart.finite_adeleFilt_sub_quotient
statement:
theorem finite_adeleFilt_sub_quotient {D D' : DivisorA k K} (hle : D ≤ D') :
    Module.Finite k ((adeleFilt k K D') ⧸
      Submodule.comap (adeleFilt k K D').subtype
        (adeleFilt k K D + diagonalSubmodule k K))
proof:
:= by
  have hE : IsEffective k K (D' - D) := (le_iff_sub_effective k K).mp hle
  have hdiv : D + (D' - D) = D' := by abel
  haveI : Module.Finite k ((adeleFilt k K D') ⧸
      Submodule.comap (adeleFilt k K D').subtype (adeleFilt k K D)) :=
    finiteAdeleFiltDiff_quotient_add_eq k K (M := D) hdiv.symm hE
  exact Module.Finite.equiv (Submodule.quotientQuotientEquivQuotient
    (Submodule.comap (adeleFilt k K D').subtype (adeleFilt k K D))
    (Submodule.comap (adeleFilt k K D').subtype
      (adeleFilt k K D + diagonalSubmodule k K))
    (Submodule.comap_mono (by
      rw [Submodule.add_eq_sup]
      exact le_sup_left)))

name: FunctionField.Chart.eq_of_le_of_deg_le
statement:
theorem eq_of_le_of_deg_le {D D' : DivisorA k K} (h : D ≤ D')
    (hdeg : deg k K D' ≤ deg k K D) : D = D'
proof:
:= by
  have hE : IsEffective k K (D' - D) := (le_iff_sub_effective k K).mp h
  have hdeg0 : deg k K (D' - D) = 0 := by
    have hge : 0 ≤ deg k K (D' - D) := deg_nonneg k K hE
    rw [deg_sub] at hge ⊢
    omega
  have hzero : D' - D = 0 := eq_zero_of_effective_deg_zero k K hE hdeg0
  exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hzero).symm

name: FunctionField.Chart.WeilDifferential.finrank_differentialSpace
statement:
theorem finrank_differentialSpace (D : DivisorA k K) :
    Module.finrank k (differentialSpace D) = indexOfSpecialty k K D
proof:
:= by
  let S := adeleFilt k K D + diagonalSubmodule k K
  have homega : differentialSpace D = S.dualAnnihilator := by
    ext φ
    rw [Submodule.mem_dualAnnihilator]
    change (∀ a ∈ adeleFilt k K D + diagonalSubmodule k K, φ a = 0) ↔ _
    rfl
  rw [homega, ← S.dualQuotEquivDualAnnihilator.finrank_eq, Subspace.dual_finrank_eq]
  exact finrank_adele_quotient k K D

name: FunctionField.Chart.WeilDifferential.exists_nontrivial_omega
statement:
theorem exists_nontrivial_omega :
    ∃ D : DivisorA k K, differentialSpace D ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsScalarTower k k⟮X⟯ K :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun c => by
      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k k[X] K,
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k[X] k⟮X⟯ K,
        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k k[X] k⟮X⟯]
  let x : K := algebraMap k⟮X⟯ K (RatFunc.X : k⟮X⟯)
  have hx : ¬IsAlgebraic k x := by
    exact (transcendental_algebraMap_iff (algebraMap k⟮X⟯ K).injective).2
      RatFunc.transcendental_X
  let E : DivisorA k K := polarDivisor k K x
  let D : DivisorA k K := -(E + E)
  have hE : 0 < deg k K E := polar_deg_pos k K hx
  have hD : deg k K D < 0 := by
    simp only [D, deg_neg, deg_add]
    omega
  have hℓ : ell k K D = 0 := RRspace_neg_deg_ell k K hD
  have hi := indexOfSpecialty_eq k K D
  have hindex : 0 < indexOfSpecialty k K D := by
    have hg : 0 ≤ (genus k K : ℤ) := Int.natCast_nonneg _
    have hdegD : deg k K D = -(deg k K E + deg k K E) := by
      simp only [D, deg_neg, deg_add]
    rw [hℓ, hdegD] at hi
    exact_mod_cast (show (0 : ℤ) < (indexOfSpecialty k K D : ℤ) by omega)
  refine ⟨D, fun hbot => ?_⟩
  have hfin : 0 < Module.finrank k (differentialSpace D) := by
    rw [finrank_differentialSpace]
    exact hindex
  rw [hbot, finrank_bot] at hfin
  omega

name: FunctionField.Chart.WeilDifferential.mul_mem_adeleFilt_add_diagonal
statement:
theorem mul_mem_adeleFilt_add_diagonal (x : Kˣ) (D : DivisorA k K)
    {a : AdeleSpace k K}
    (ha : a ∈ adeleFilt k K (D + principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul x)) +
      diagonalSubmodule k K) :
    (x : K) • a ∈ adeleFilt k K D + diagonalSubmodule k K
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.add_eq_sup] at ha ⊢
  rcases Submodule.mem_sup.mp ha with ⟨a₁, ha₁, a₂, ha₂, rfl⟩
  refine Submodule.mem_sup.mpr ⟨(x : K) • a₁, ?_, (x : K) • a₂, ?_,
    (smul_add (x : K) a₁ a₂).symm⟩
  · intro v
    change placeValuation k K v ((x : K) * a₁.val v) ≤ WithZero.exp (D v)
    rw [map_mul]
    have hxval := placeValuation_eq_exp_neg_principalDivisor k K (Additive.ofMul x) v
    change placeValuation k K v (x : K) =
      WithZero.exp (-(principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul x) v)) at hxval
    rw [hxval]
    have hv := ha₁ v
    rw [Finsupp.add_apply, WithZero.exp_add] at hv
    calc
      WithZero.exp (-(principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul x) v)) *
          placeValuation k K v (a₁.val v) ≤
          WithZero.exp (-(principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul x) v)) *
            (WithZero.exp (D v) *
              WithZero.exp (principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul x) v)) :=
        mul_le_mul_right hv _
      _ = WithZero.exp (D v) := by
        rw [← WithZero.exp_add, ← WithZero.exp_add]
        congr 1
        ring
  · rcases ha₂ with ⟨f, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(x : K) * f, by ext v; rfl⟩

name: FunctionField.Chart.WeilDifferential.smulWeil_toFun_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smulWeil_toFun_apply (x : K) (ω : WeilDifferential k K) (a : AdeleSpace k K) :
    (smulWeil x ω).toFun a = ω.toFun (x • a)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · simp [smulWeil, hx]
  · simp only [smulWeil, hx, ↓reduceDIte, LinearMap.comp_apply]
    congr 1

name: FunctionField.Chart.WeilDifferential.ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {ω η : WeilDifferential k K} (h : ω.toFun = η.toFun) : ω = η
proof:
:= by
  cases ω
  cases η
  cases h
  rfl

name: FunctionField.Chart.WeilDifferential.smulWeil_algebraMap
statement:
theorem smulWeil_algebraMap (c : k) (ω : WeilDifferential k K) (a : AdeleSpace k K) :
    (smulWeil (algebraMap k K c) ω).toFun a = c • ω.toFun a
proof:
:= by
  rw [smulWeil_toFun_apply, algebraMap_smul, map_smul]

name: FunctionField.Chart.WeilDifferential.smulWeil_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem smulWeil_eq_zero_iff (x : K) (hx : x ≠ 0) (ω : WeilDifferential k K) :
    smulWeil x ω = 0 ↔ ω = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hxω
    calc ω = (1 : K) • ω := (one_smul K ω).symm
      _ = (x⁻¹ * x) • ω := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hx]
      _ = x⁻¹ • (x • ω) := mul_smul x⁻¹ x ω
      _ = x⁻¹ • (smulWeil x ω) := rfl
      _ = x⁻¹ • (0 : WeilDifferential k K) := by rw [hxω]
      _ = 0 := smul_zero x⁻¹
  · intro hω
    subst hω
    show x • (0 : WeilDifferential k K) = 0
    exact smul_zero x

name: FunctionField.Chart.WeilDifferential.differentialSpace_eq_dualAnnihilator
statement:
theorem differentialSpace_eq_dualAnnihilator (D : DivisorA k K) :
    differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K) D =
      (adeleFilt k K D + diagonalSubmodule k K).dualAnnihilator
proof:
:= by
  ext φ
  rw [Submodule.mem_dualAnnihilator]
  change (∀ a ∈ adeleFilt k K D + diagonalSubmodule k K, φ a = 0) ↔ _
  rfl

name: FunctionField.Chart.WeilDifferential.mem_vanishingDivisors_of_le
statement:
theorem mem_vanishingDivisors_of_le {ω : WeilDifferential k K} {D D' : DivisorA k K}
    (hle : D' ≤ D) (hD : D ∈ vanishingDivisors ω) : D' ∈ vanishingDivisors ω
proof:
:= by
  intro α hα
  apply hD
  have hsub : adeleFilt k K D' + diagonalSubmodule k K ≤
      adeleFilt k K D + diagonalSubmodule k K := by
    simpa only [Submodule.add_eq_sup] using
      sup_le_sup (adeleFilt_mono k K hle) (le_refl (diagonalSubmodule k K))
  exact hsub hα

name: FunctionField.Chart.WeilDifferential.add_toFun
statement:
theorem add_toFun (ω η : WeilDifferential k K) :
    (ω + η).toFun = ω.toFun + η.toFun
proof: := rfl

name: FunctionField.Chart.WeilDifferential.smulWeil_toFun_mem_differentialSpace
proof:
:= by
  have hvan : ∀ α ∈ adeleFilt k K D₀ + diagonalSubmodule k K, ω.toFun α = 0 := h
  show ∀ a ∈ adeleFilt k K (D₀ - E) + diagonalSubmodule k K,
    (smulWeil (f : K) ω).toFun a = 0
  intro a ha
  rw [smulWeil_toFun_apply]
  by_cases hf : (f : K) = 0
  · rw [hf, zero_smul, map_zero]
  · have hmemE : memRRspace k K (D₀ - (D₀ - E)) (f : K) := by
      rw [sub_sub_cancel]
      exact (mem_RRspace_iff k K E (f : K)).mp f.property
    have hdivle : D₀ - E ≤ D₀ +
        principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 (f : K) hf)) :=
      le_add_principal_of_memRRspace (k := k) (K := K) (D₀ := D₀ - E) (D₁ := D₀)
        hf hmemE
    have hle : adeleFilt k K (D₀ - E) + diagonalSubmodule k K ≤
        adeleFilt k K (D₀ + principalDivisorA k K
          (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 (f : K) hf))) + diagonalSubmodule k K := by
      simpa only [Submodule.add_eq_sup] using
        sup_le_sup (adeleFilt_mono k K hdivle) (le_refl (diagonalSubmodule k K))
    have hsm := mul_mem_adeleFilt_add_diagonal (k := k) (K := K)
      (Units.mk0 (f : K) hf) D₀ (hle ha)
    rw [Units.val_mk0] at hsm
    exact hvan _ hsm

name: FunctionField.Chart.WeilDifferential.smulIntoOmega_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smulIntoOmega_coe (ω : WeilDifferential k K) {D₀ : DivisorA k K}
    (h : D₀ ∈ vanishingDivisors ω) (E : DivisorA k K) (f : RRspace k K E) :
    (smulIntoOmega ω h E f : AdeleSpace k K →ₗ[k] k) = (smulWeil (f : K) ω).toFun
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: FunctionField.Chart.WeilDifferential.smulIntoOmega_injective
proof:
:= by
  intro f g hfg
  by_contra hne
  have hd0 : smulIntoOmega ω h E (f - g) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, hfg, sub_self]
  have hval : ((f - g : RRspace k K E) : K) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    exact hne (sub_eq_zero.mp (Subtype.ext h0))
  have htoFun : (smulWeil ((f - g : RRspace k K E) : K) ω).toFun = 0 :=
    congrArg Subtype.val hd0
  have hzero : smulWeil ((f - g : RRspace k K E) : K) ω = 0 := ext htoFun
  have hω0 : ω = 0 := (smulWeil_eq_zero_iff _ hval ω).mp hzero
  apply hω
  rw [hω0]
  rfl

name: FunctionField.Chart.WeilDifferential.finrank_weilDifferential_eq_one
statement:
theorem finrank_weilDifferential_eq_one :
    Module.finrank K (WeilDifferential k K) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D₀', hD₀'⟩ := exists_nontrivial_omega (k := k) (K := K)
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hφ0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hD₀'
  set ω₀ : WeilDifferential k K := ⟨φ, ⟨D₀', hφ⟩⟩ with hω₀def
  have hω₀ne : ω₀ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hφ0
    have hval : ω₀.toFun = φ := rfl
    rw [← hval, h]; rfl
  refine (finrank_eq_one_iff_of_nonzero' ω₀ hω₀ne).mpr ?_
  intro ω
  by_contra hspan
  push Not at hspan
  
  have hindep : ∀ f g : K, f • ω₀ + g • ω = 0 → f = 0 ∧ g = 0 := by
    intro f g hfg
    by_cases hg : g = 0
    · subst hg
      rw [zero_smul, add_zero] at hfg
      refine ⟨?_, rfl⟩
      by_contra hf
      exact hω₀ne ((smulWeil_eq_zero_iff f hf ω₀).mp hfg)
    · exfalso
      apply hspan (g⁻¹ * (-f))
      have hgω : g • ω = (-f) • ω₀ := by
        have hneg : g • ω = -(f • ω₀) := by
          rw [eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, add_comm]; exact hfg
        rw [hneg, neg_smul]
      have hω : ω = (g⁻¹ * (-f)) • ω₀ := by
        rw [mul_smul, ← hgω, ← mul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hg, one_smul]
      exact hω.symm
  
  obtain ⟨D₁, hD₁⟩ := ω₀.vanishes_on
  obtain ⟨D₂, hD₂⟩ := ω.vanishes_on
  set D₀ : DivisorA k K := D₁ ⊓ D₂ with hD₀def
  have h₀ : D₀ ∈ vanishingDivisors ω₀ :=
    mem_vanishingDivisors_of_le inf_le_left hD₁
  have h₂ : D₀ ∈ vanishingDivisors ω :=
    mem_vanishingDivisors_of_le inf_le_right hD₂
  
  set B : DivisorA k K := polarDivisor k K (XK k K) with hBdef
  have hBpos : 0 < deg k K B := polar_deg_pos k K (not_algebraic_XK k K)
  have hb1 : 1 ≤ deg k K B := hBpos
  
  have hcount : ∀ n : ℕ,
      2 * (ell k K (n • B) : ℤ) ≤ indexOfSpecialty k K (D₀ - n • B) := by
    intro n
    set E : DivisorA k K := n • B with hEdef
    have hinj : Function.Injective
        (LinearMap.coprod (smulIntoOmega ω₀ h₀ E) (smulIntoOmega ω h₂ E)) := by
      intro x y hxy
      have hd : (LinearMap.coprod (smulIntoOmega ω₀ h₀ E)
          (smulIntoOmega ω h₂ E)) (x - y) = 0 := by
        rw [map_sub, hxy, sub_self]
      rw [LinearMap.coprod_apply] at hd
      have hcoe : (smulWeil (((x - y).1 : RRspace k K E) : K) ω₀).toFun
          + (smulWeil (((x - y).2 : RRspace k K E) : K) ω).toFun = 0 := by
        have h1 := congrArg Subtype.val hd
        simpa only [Submodule.coe_add, smulIntoOmega_coe, Submodule.coe_zero] using h1
      have hsum : ((((x - y).1 : RRspace k K E) : K) • ω₀
          + (((x - y).2 : RRspace k K E) : K) • ω).toFun = 0 := by
        rw [add_toFun]; exact hcoe
      have hzero : (((x - y).1 : RRspace k K E) : K) • ω₀
          + (((x - y).2 : RRspace k K E) : K) • ω = 0 := ext hsum
      obtain ⟨hf0, hg0⟩ := hindep _ _ hzero
      have hxy0 : x - y = 0 := Prod.ext (Subtype.ext hf0) (Subtype.ext hg0)
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp hxy0
    have hfrle : Module.finrank k (RRspace k K E × RRspace k K E) ≤
        Module.finrank k (differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K) (D₀ - E)) :=
      LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective hinj
    rw [Module.finrank_prod, finrank_differentialSpace] at hfrle
    have hLfr : Module.finrank k (RRspace k K E) = ell k K E := rfl
    rw [hLfr] at hfrle
    omega
  
  set M : ℤ := max (deg k K D₀) (3 * (genus k K : ℤ) - 3 - deg k K D₀) with hMdef
  set n : ℕ := M.toNat + 1 with hndef
  have hn_ge : (n : ℤ) ≥ M + 1 := by
    have hself := Int.self_le_toNat M
    push_cast [hndef]
    omega
  have hn_d0 : (n : ℤ) > deg k K D₀ := by
    have hle : deg k K D₀ ≤ M := le_max_left _ _
    omega
  have hn_g : (n : ℤ) > 3 * (genus k K : ℤ) - 3 - deg k K D₀ := by
    have hle : 3 * (genus k K : ℤ) - 3 - deg k K D₀ ≤ M := le_max_right _ _
    omega
  have hnb_ge : (n : ℤ) * deg k K B ≥ (n : ℤ) := by
    have hn0 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ (n : ℤ) := Int.natCast_nonneg n
    nlinarith [hb1, hn0]
  have hdegsub : deg k K (D₀ - n • B) = deg k K D₀ - (n : ℤ) * deg k K B := by
    rw [deg_sub, deg_nsmul]
  have hdeg_neg : deg k K (D₀ - n • B) < 0 := by
    rw [hdegsub]; omega
  have hℓ0 : ell k K (D₀ - n • B) = 0 := RRspace_neg_deg_ell k K hdeg_neg
  have hi := indexOfSpecialty_eq (k := k) (K := K) (D₀ - n • B)
  rw [hℓ0, hdegsub] at hi
  have hrr := riemann_ineq (k := k) (K := K) (n • B)
  rw [deg_nsmul] at hrr
  have hc := hcount n
  omega

name: FunctionField.Chart.WeilDifferential.add_principal_mem_vanishingDivisors_smul_iff
statement:
theorem add_principal_mem_vanishingDivisors_smul_iff (x : Kˣ)
    (ω : WeilDifferential k K) (D : DivisorA k K) :
    D + principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul x) ∈
        vanishingDivisors ((x : K) • ω) ↔
      D ∈ vanishingDivisors ω
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h a ha
    let P := principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul x)
    have hsource :
        (D + P) + principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul (x⁻¹ : Kˣ)) = D := by
      have hinv : Additive.ofMul (x⁻¹ : Kˣ) = -(Additive.ofMul x) := rfl
      rw [hinv, map_neg]
      abel
    have haSource : a ∈ adeleFilt k K
          ((D + P) + principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul (x⁻¹ : Kˣ))) +
          diagonalSubmodule k K := by
      simpa only [hsource] using ha
    have ha' := mul_mem_adeleFilt_add_diagonal (k := k) (K := K)
      (x⁻¹ : Kˣ) (D + P) haSource
    have hz := h (((x⁻¹ : Kˣ) : K) • a) ha'
    change (smulWeil (x : K) ω).toFun (((x⁻¹ : Kˣ) : K) • a) = 0 at hz
    rw [smulWeil_toFun_apply] at hz
    simpa [mul_smul] using hz
  · intro h a ha
    change (smulWeil (x : K) ω).toFun a = 0
    rw [smulWeil_toFun_apply]
    exact h _ (mul_mem_adeleFilt_add_diagonal (k := k) (K := K) x D ha)

name: FunctionField.Chart.WeilDifferential.sup_mem_vanishingDivisors
proof:
:= by
  intro α hα
  rw [Submodule.add_eq_sup, adeleFilt_sup_eq_add, ← Submodule.add_eq_sup] at hα
  rw [Submodule.add_eq_sup] at hα
  rcases Submodule.mem_sup.mp hα with ⟨a, ha, d, hd, rfl⟩
  rw [Submodule.add_eq_sup] at ha
  rcases Submodule.mem_sup.mp ha with ⟨a₁, ha₁, a₂, ha₂, rfl⟩
  have hsplit : a₁ + a₂ + d = (a₁ + d) + a₂ := by abel
  rw [hsplit, map_add]
  have h1 : ω.toFun (a₁ + d) = 0 := by
    apply hD₁
    rw [Submodule.add_eq_sup]
    exact Submodule.add_mem_sup ha₁ hd
  have h2 : ω.toFun a₂ = 0 := by
    apply hD₂
    rw [Submodule.add_eq_sup]
    exact Submodule.mem_sup_left ha₂
  rw [h1, h2, add_zero]

name: FunctionField.Chart.WeilDifferential.deg_le_of_mem_vanishingDivisors
statement:
theorem deg_le_of_mem_vanishingDivisors {ω : WeilDifferential k K} (hω : ω.toFun ≠ 0)
    {D : DivisorA k K} (hD : D ∈ vanishingDivisors ω) :
    deg k K D ≤ 2 * (genus k K : ℤ) - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (smulIntoOmega ω hD D) :=
    smulIntoOmega_injective ω hD D hω
  have hle : Module.finrank k (RRspace k K D) ≤
      Module.finrank k (differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K) (D - D)) :=
    LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective hinj
  have hDD : D - D = (0 : DivisorA k K) := sub_self D
  have hΩ : Module.finrank k (differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K) (D - D)) = genus k K := by
    rw [hDD, finrank_differentialSpace]
    have hidx := indexOfSpecialty_eq (k := k) (K := K) (0 : DivisorA k K)
    rw [ell_zero (k := k) (K := K), deg_zero (k := k) (K := K)] at hidx
    omega
  have hℓg : (ell k K D : ℤ) ≤ (genus k K : ℤ) := by
    have hnat : ell k K D ≤ genus k K := by
      rw [show ell k K D = Module.finrank k (RRspace k K D) from rfl, ← hΩ]
      exact hle
    exact_mod_cast hnat
  have hRR := riemann_ineq (k := k) (K := K) D
  omega

name: FunctionField.Chart.WeilDifferential.exists_max_vanishingDivisor
statement:
theorem exists_max_vanishingDivisor {ω : WeilDifferential k K} (hω : IsNonzero ω) :
    ∃! W : DivisorA k K, W ∈ vanishingDivisors ω ∧
      ∀ D ∈ vanishingDivisors ω, D ≤ W
proof:
:= by
  have hω' : ω.toFun ≠ 0 := hω
  set P : ℤ → Prop := fun z => ∃ D ∈ vanishingDivisors ω, deg k K D = z with hP
  have hInh : ∃ z, P z := by
    obtain ⟨D₀, hD₀⟩ := ω.vanishes_on
    exact ⟨deg k K D₀, D₀, hD₀, rfl⟩
  have hBdd : ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ z, P z → z ≤ b := by
    refine ⟨2 * (genus k K : ℤ) - 1, ?_⟩
    rintro z ⟨D, hD, rfl⟩
    exact deg_le_of_mem_vanishingDivisors hω' hD
  obtain ⟨ub, ⟨W, hWmem, hWdeg⟩, hubmax⟩ := Int.exists_greatest_of_bdd hBdd hInh
  have hmaxdiv : ∀ D ∈ vanishingDivisors ω, D ≤ W := by
    intro D hD
    have hsup : D ⊔ W ∈ vanishingDivisors ω := sup_mem_vanishingDivisors hD hWmem
    have hdegle : deg k K (D ⊔ W) ≤ ub := hubmax _ ⟨D ⊔ W, hsup, rfl⟩
    have hWle : W ≤ D ⊔ W := le_sup_right
    have hdegW : deg k K (D ⊔ W) ≤ deg k K W := by rw [hWdeg]; exact hdegle
    have heq : W = D ⊔ W := eq_of_le_of_deg_le k K hWle hdegW
    rw [heq]; exact le_sup_left
  refine ⟨W, ⟨hWmem, hmaxdiv⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro W' ⟨hW'mem, hW'max⟩
  exact le_antisymm (hmaxdiv W' hW'mem) (hW'max W hWmem)

name: FunctionField.Chart.WeilDifferential.divOmega_smul
statement:
theorem divOmega_smul (x : Kˣ) (ω : WeilDifferential k K) (hω : IsNonzero ω)
    (hxω : IsNonzero ((x : K) • ω)) :
    WeilDifferential.divOmega ((x : K) • ω) hxω =
      WeilDifferential.divOmega ω hω + principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul x)
proof:
:= by
  let W := WeilDifferential.divOmega ω hω
  let P := principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul x)
  have hmax : W ∈ vanishingDivisors ω ∧
      ∀ D ∈ vanishingDivisors ω, D ≤ W := by
    simpa only [W, divOmega] using
      (Classical.choose_spec (exists_max_vanishingDivisor (k := k) (K := K) hω)).1
  have htarget : W + P ∈ vanishingDivisors ((x : K) • ω) ∧
      ∀ E ∈ vanishingDivisors ((x : K) • ω), E ≤ W + P := by
    constructor
    · exact (add_principal_mem_vanishingDivisors_smul_iff
        (k := k) (K := K) x ω W).2 hmax.1
    · intro E hE
      have htranslate : (E - P) + P = E := by abel
      have hE' : E - P ∈ vanishingDivisors ω := by
        apply (add_principal_mem_vanishingDivisors_smul_iff
          (k := k) (K := K) x ω (E - P)).1
        simpa only [P, htranslate] using hE
      have hle := hmax.2 (E - P) hE'
      intro v
      have hv := hle v
      simp only [Finsupp.sub_apply, Finsupp.add_apply] at hv ⊢
      omega
  let hex := exists_max_vanishingDivisor (k := k) (K := K) hxω
  have hchosen : WeilDifferential.divOmega ((x : K) • ω) hxω ∈
        vanishingDivisors ((x : K) • ω) ∧
      ∀ D ∈ vanishingDivisors ((x : K) • ω),
        D ≤ WeilDifferential.divOmega ((x : K) • ω) hxω := by
    simpa only [divOmega, hex] using (Classical.choose_spec hex).1
  exact hex.unique hchosen htarget

name: FunctionField.Chart.exists_isCanonical
statement: theorem exists_isCanonical : ∃ W : DivisorA k K, IsCanonical k K W
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := WeilDifferential.exists_nontrivial_omega (k := k) (K := K)
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hφ0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hD
  let ω : WeilDifferential k K := ⟨φ, ⟨D, hφ⟩⟩
  have hω : WeilDifferential.IsNonzero ω := hφ0
  exact ⟨WeilDifferential.divOmega ω hω, ω, hω, rfl⟩

name: FunctionField.Chart.isCanonical_unique_up_to_principal
proof:
:= by
  rcases h₁ with ⟨ω₁, hω₁, rfl⟩
  rcases h₂ with ⟨ω₂, hω₂, rfl⟩
  have hω₁0 : ω₁ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hω₁
    rw [h]
    rfl
  have hω₂0 : ω₂ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hω₂
    rw [h]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_smul_eq_of_finrank_eq_one (K := K)
    (WeilDifferential.finrank_weilDifferential_eq_one (k := k) (K := K)) hω₂0 ω₁
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    subst c
    apply hω₁0
    simpa only [zero_smul] using hc.symm
  let f : Kˣ := Units.mk0 c hc0
  have hcf : (f : K) • ω₂ = ω₁ := by
    simpa only [f, Units.val_mk0] using hc
  have hnontrivial : WeilDifferential.IsNonzero ((f : K) • ω₂) := by
    exact hcf.symm ▸ hω₁
  refine ⟨f, ?_⟩
  have hdiv := WeilDifferential.divOmega_smul (k := k) (K := K) f ω₂ hω₂ hnontrivial
  calc
    WeilDifferential.divOmega ω₁ hω₁ - WeilDifferential.divOmega ω₂ hω₂ =
        WeilDifferential.divOmega ((f : K) • ω₂) hnontrivial -
          WeilDifferential.divOmega ω₂ hω₂ := by
            congr 2
            exact hcf.symm
    _ = principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul f) := by rw [hdiv]; abel

name: FunctionField.Chart.duality
statement:
theorem duality {W : DivisorA k K} (hW : IsCanonical k K W) (D : DivisorA k K) :
    ell k K (W - D) = indexOfSpecialty k K D
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ω₀, hω₀, hdivW⟩ := hW
  have hω₀' : ω₀.toFun ≠ 0 := hω₀
  have hω₀ne : ω₀ ≠ 0 := fun h => hω₀ (by rw [h]; rfl)
  
  have hWspec : W ∈ vanishingDivisors ω₀ ∧
      ∀ D' ∈ vanishingDivisors ω₀, D' ≤ W := by
    have h := (Classical.choose_spec
      (WeilDifferential.exists_max_vanishingDivisor (k := k) (K := K) hω₀)).1
    have he : Classical.choose
        (WeilDifferential.exists_max_vanishingDivisor (k := k) (K := K) hω₀) = W := hdivW
    rw [he] at h
    exact h
  obtain ⟨hWmem, hWmax⟩ := hWspec
  have hWD : W - (W - D) = D := sub_sub_cancel W D
  
  set μ := smulIntoOmega ω₀ hWmem (W - D) with hμdef
  have hμinj : Function.Injective μ := smulIntoOmega_injective ω₀ hWmem (W - D) hω₀'
  have hμsurj : Function.Surjective μ := by
    intro ψ
    set φ : AdeleSpace k K →ₗ[k] k := (ψ : AdeleSpace k K →ₗ[k] k) with hφdef
    by_cases hψ0 : φ = 0
    · exact ⟨0, by rw [map_zero]; exact (Subtype.ext hψ0).symm⟩
    · 
      have hψmem : ∀ α ∈ adeleFilt k K D + diagonalSubmodule k K, φ α = 0 := by
        have hp : ∀ α ∈ adeleFilt k K (W - (W - D)) + diagonalSubmodule k K, φ α = 0 :=
          ψ.property
        rw [hWD] at hp
        exact hp
      set η : WeilDifferential k K := ⟨φ, ⟨D, hψmem⟩⟩ with hηdef
      have hηnt : η.toFun ≠ 0 := hψ0
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_smul_eq_of_finrank_eq_one (K := K)
        (WeilDifferential.finrank_weilDifferential_eq_one (k := k) (K := K)) hω₀ne η
      have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := by
        intro h
        subst h
        apply hηnt
        have hη0 : η = 0 := by rw [← hc, zero_smul]
        rw [hη0]; rfl
      set cu : Kˣ := Units.mk0 c hc0 with hcudef
      set P : DivisorA k K := principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul cu) with hPdef
      
      have hDmem : D ∈ vanishingDivisors ((cu : K) • ω₀) := by
        have hcω : (cu : K) • ω₀ = η := by
          rw [Units.val_mk0]; exact hc
        rw [hcω]
        intro α hα
        exact hψmem α hα
      have hDPmem : D - P ∈ vanishingDivisors ω₀ := by
        apply (add_principal_mem_vanishingDivisors_smul_iff (k := k) (K := K) cu ω₀ (D - P)).1
        have hsub : (D - P) + P = D := by rw [hPdef]; abel
        rw [hsub]; exact hDmem
      have hDPle : D - P ≤ W := hWmax (D - P) hDPmem
      
      have hcmem : memRRspace k K (W - D) c := by
        intro v
        have hval := placeValuation_eq_exp_neg_principalDivisor k K (Additive.ofMul cu) v
        change placeValuation k K v c ≤ WithZero.exp ((W - D) v)
        have hcv : placeValuation k K v c =
            WithZero.exp (-(P v)) := by
          rw [hPdef]
          have hcuc : (cu : K) = c := by simp [hcudef]
          rw [← hcuc]; exact hval
        rw [hcv]
        apply WithZero.exp_le_exp.mpr
        have hlev := hDPle v
        simp only [Finsupp.sub_apply] at hlev ⊢
        omega
      refine ⟨⟨c, (mem_RRspace_iff k K (W - D) c).mpr hcmem⟩, ?_⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [hμdef, smulIntoOmega_coe]
      change ((c : K) • ω₀).toFun = φ
      rw [hc]
  
  have hfr : Module.finrank k (RRspace k K (W - D)) =
      Module.finrank k (differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K) (W - (W - D))) :=
    (LinearEquiv.ofBijective μ ⟨hμinj, hμsurj⟩).finrank_eq
  show Module.finrank k (RRspace k K (W - D)) = indexOfSpecialty k K D
  rw [hfr, hWD, finrank_differentialSpace]

name: FunctionField.Chart.nonempty_dualityLinearEquiv
statement:
theorem nonempty_dualityLinearEquiv {W : DivisorA k K} (hW : IsCanonical k K W)
    (D : DivisorA k K) :
    Nonempty (RRspace k K (W - D) ≃ₗ[k]
      WeilDifferential.differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K) D)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ω, hω, hdivW⟩ := hW
  have hWmem : W ∈ WeilDifferential.vanishingDivisors ω := by
    have h := (Classical.choose_spec
      (WeilDifferential.exists_max_vanishingDivisor (k := k) (K := K) hω)).1.1
    have he : Classical.choose
        (WeilDifferential.exists_max_vanishingDivisor (k := k) (K := K) hω) = W := hdivW
    rwa [he] at h
  let μ := WeilDifferential.smulIntoOmega ω hWmem (W - D)
  have hμinj : Function.Injective μ :=
    WeilDifferential.smulIntoOmega_injective ω hWmem (W - D) hω
  have hWD : W - (W - D) = D := sub_sub_cancel W D
  let eD : WeilDifferential.differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K) (W - (W - D)) ≃ₗ[k]
      WeilDifferential.differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K) D :=
    LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ (congrArg (WeilDifferential.differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K)) hWD)
  let μD : RRspace k K (W - D) →ₗ[k]
      WeilDifferential.differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K) D :=
    eD.toLinearMap.comp μ
  have hμDinj : Function.Injective μD := eD.injective.comp hμinj
  have hdim : Module.finrank k (RRspace k K (W - D)) =
      Module.finrank k (WeilDifferential.differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K) D) := by
    calc
      Module.finrank k (RRspace k K (W - D)) = ell k K (W - D) := rfl
      _ = indexOfSpecialty k K D := duality k K ⟨ω, hω, hdivW⟩ D
      _ = Module.finrank k
          (WeilDifferential.differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K) D) :=
        (WeilDifferential.finrank_differentialSpace D).symm
  let e : RRspace k K (W - D) ≃ₗ[k]
      WeilDifferential.differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K) D :=
    LinearMap.linearEquivOfInjective (K := k)
      (V := RRspace k K (W - D))
      (V₂ := WeilDifferential.differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K) D)
      μD hμDinj hdim
  exact ⟨e⟩

name: FunctionField.Chart.indexOfSpecialty_eq_ell_sub
statement:
theorem indexOfSpecialty_eq_ell_sub {W : DivisorA k K} (hW : IsCanonical k K W) (D : DivisorA k K) :
    (indexOfSpecialty k K D : ℤ) = ell k K (W - D)
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast (duality k K hW D).symm

name: QCExtension.exists_fg_submodule_pow_smul_mem
statement:
theorem exists_fg_submodule_pow_smul_mem {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (a : ι → R)
    (L : ι → Type u) [∀ i, AddCommGroup (L i)] [∀ i, Module R (L i)]
    [∀ i, Module (Localization.Away (a i)) (L i)]
    [∀ i, IsScalarTower R (Localization.Away (a i)) (L i)]
    [∀ i, Module.Finite (Localization.Away (a i)) (L i)]
    (l : ∀ i, M →ₗ[R] L i) [∀ i, IsLocalizedModule.Away (a i) (l i)] :
    ∃ N : Submodule R M, N.FG ∧ ∀ i (m : M), ∃ k : ℕ, a i ^ k • m ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose T hT using fun i => (Module.Finite.fg_top (R := Localization.Away (a i)) (M := L i))
  choose n x hx using fun i (t : L i) => IsLocalizedModule.Away.surj (a i) (f := l i) t
  let S : Set M := ⋃ i, (fun t => x i t) '' (T i : Set (L i))
  have hSfin : S.Finite := Set.finite_iUnion fun i => (T i).finite_toSet.image _
  refine ⟨Submodule.span R S, Submodule.fg_def.mpr ⟨S, hSfin, rfl⟩, fun i m => ?_⟩
  have hTle : (T i : Set (L i)) ⊆
      Submodule.span (Localization.Away (a i)) ((l i) '' S) := by
    intro t ht
    have hmem : (l i) (x i t) ∈ Submodule.span (Localization.Away (a i)) ((l i) '' S) :=
      Submodule.subset_span ⟨x i t, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, t, ht, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [← hx i t, ← algebraMap_smul (Localization.Away (a i))] at hmem
    exact (Submodule.smul_mem_iff_of_isUnit _
      (IsLocalization.map_units (Localization.Away (a i))
        (⟨a i ^ n i t, ⟨n i t, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers (a i)))).mp hmem
  have hlm : (l i) m ∈ Submodule.span (Localization.Away (a i)) ((l i) '' S) := by
    have : (l i) m ∈ Submodule.span (Localization.Away (a i)) (T i : Set (L i)) := by
      rw [hT i]; trivial
    exact Submodule.span_le.mpr hTle this
  obtain ⟨⟨_, p, rfl⟩, hp⟩ := multiple_mem_span_of_mem_localization_span
    (Submonoid.powers (a i)) (Localization.Away (a i)) ((l i) '' S) ((l i) m) hlm
  rw [← Submodule.map_span, Submodule.mem_map] at hp
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyeq⟩ := hp
  have h0 : (l i) (a i ^ p • m - y) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, map_smul, hyeq]
    simp [Submonoid.smul_def]
  obtain ⟨⟨_, q, rfl⟩, hq⟩ := (IsLocalizedModule.eq_zero_iff (Submonoid.powers (a i)) (l i)).mp h0
  refine ⟨q + p, ?_⟩
  have : a i ^ q • (a i ^ p • m) = a i ^ q • y := by
    have := hq
    simp only [Submonoid.smul_def, smul_sub, sub_eq_zero] at this
    exact this
  rw [pow_add, mul_smul, this]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hy

name: QCExtension.bijective_of_isLocalizedModule_of_pow_smul_mem
statement:
theorem bijective_of_isLocalizedModule_of_pow_smul_mem {N P L₁ L₂ : Type u}
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [AddCommGroup P] [Module R P] [AddCommGroup L₁] [Module R L₁]
    [AddCommGroup L₂] [Module R L₂] (h : R)
    (ι : N →ₗ[R] P) (hι : Function.Injective ι) (hN : ∀ m : P, ∃ k : ℕ, h ^ k • m ∈ ι.range)
    (l₁ : N →ₗ[R] L₁) (l₂ : P →ₗ[R] L₂) [IsLocalizedModule.Away h l₁]
    [IsLocalizedModule.Away h l₂] (ψ : L₁ →ₗ[R] L₂) (hψ : ψ ∘ₗ l₁ = l₂ ∘ₗ ι) :
    Function.Bijective ψ
proof:
:= by
  have hu₁ := IsLocalizedModule.map_units l₁ (⟨h, 1, pow_one h⟩ : Submonoid.powers h)
  have hu₂ := IsLocalizedModule.map_units l₂ (⟨h, 1, pow_one h⟩ : Submonoid.powers h)
  have hb₁ (c : ℕ) : Function.Bijective (algebraMap R (Module.End R L₁) (h ^ c)) :=
    (Module.End.isUnit_iff _).mp (by rw [map_pow]; exact hu₁.pow c)
  have hb₂ (c : ℕ) : Function.Bijective (algebraMap R (Module.End R L₂) (h ^ c)) :=
    (Module.End.isUnit_iff _).mp (by rw [map_pow]; exact hu₂.pow c)
  have hsq (n : N) : ψ (l₁ n) = l₂ (ι n) := congr($hψ n)
  constructor
  · rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨k, n, hn⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.Away.surj h (f := l₁) z
    have : l₂ (ι n) = 0 := by
      rw [← hsq, ← hn, map_smul, hz, smul_zero]
    obtain ⟨⟨_, j, rfl⟩, hj⟩ := (IsLocalizedModule.eq_zero_iff (Submonoid.powers h) l₂).mp this
    have hj' : h ^ j • n = 0 := by
      apply hι
      rw [map_smul, map_zero]
      simpa [Submonoid.smul_def] using hj
    have hz0 : h ^ (j + k) • z = 0 := by
      rw [pow_add, mul_smul, hn, ← map_smul, hj', map_zero]
    apply (hb₁ (j + k)).1
    rw [Module.algebraMap_end_apply, Module.algebraMap_end_apply, smul_zero]
    exact hz0
  · intro y
    obtain ⟨k, m, hm⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.Away.surj h (f := l₂) y
    obtain ⟨j, n, hn⟩ := hN m
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (hb₁ (j + k)).2 (l₁ n)
    refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
    apply (hb₂ (j + k)).1
    simp only [Module.algebraMap_end_apply] at hz ⊢
    rw [← map_smul, hz, hsq, hn, map_smul, pow_add, mul_smul, hm]

name: QCExtension.bijective_of_isLocalizedModule_of_pow_smul_mem'
statement:
theorem bijective_of_isLocalizedModule_of_pow_smul_mem' {N P L₁ L₂ : ModuleCat.{u} R} (h : R)
    (ι : N ⟶ P) (hι : Function.Injective ι.hom)
    (hN : ∀ m : P, ∃ k : ℕ, h ^ k • m ∈ LinearMap.range ι.hom)
    (l₁ : N ⟶ L₁) (l₂ : P ⟶ L₂) (h₁ : IsLocalizedModule.Away h l₁.hom)
    (h₂ : IsLocalizedModule.Away h l₂.hom) (ψ : L₁ ⟶ L₂) (hψ : l₁ ≫ ψ = ι ≫ l₂) :
    Function.Bijective ψ.hom
proof:
:=
  haveI := h₁; haveI := h₂
  bijective_of_isLocalizedModule_of_pow_smul_mem h ι.hom hι hN l₁.hom l₂.hom ψ.hom
    (by rw [← ModuleCat.hom_comp, hψ, ModuleCat.hom_comp])

name: QCExtension.bijective_of_comm_sq
statement:
theorem bijective_of_comm_sq {N P L₁ L₂ : ModuleCat.{u} R} {ι : N ⟶ P} {l₁ : N ⟶ L₁}
    {l₂ : P ⟶ L₂} {ψ : L₁ ⟶ L₂} (hψ : l₁ ≫ ψ = ι ≫ l₂) (h : R)
    (hι : Function.Injective ι.hom)
    (hN : ∀ m : P, ∃ k : ℕ, h ^ k • m ∈ LinearMap.range ι.hom)
    (h₁ : IsLocalizedModule.Away h l₁.hom) (h₂ : IsLocalizedModule.Away h l₂.hom) :
    Function.Bijective ψ.hom
proof:
:=
  bijective_of_isLocalizedModule_of_pow_smul_mem' h ι hι hN l₁ l₂ h₁ h₂ ψ hψ

name: QCExtension.app_map
statement:
lemma app_map {X : Scheme.{u}} {A B : X.Modules} (φ : A ⟶ B) {U V : X.Opens} (i : V ⟶ U)
    (s : Γ(A, U)) : φ.app V (A.presheaf.map i.op s) = B.presheaf.map i.op (φ.app U s)
proof:
:= by
  have := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (φ.mapPresheaf.naturality i.op) s
  rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at this
  exact this

name: QCExtension.bijective_app_of_basicOpen
statement:
theorem bijective_app_of_basicOpen {A B : (Spec R).Modules} (φ : A ⟶ B) (P : R → Prop)
    (hP : ∀ h h', P h → P (h * h'))
    (hbij : ∀ h, P h → Function.Bijective (φ.app (basicOpen h)))
    (W : (Spec R).Opens) (hW : ∀ x ∈ W, ∃ h, P h ∧ x ∈ basicOpen h ∧ basicOpen h ≤ W) :
    Function.Bijective (φ.app W)
proof:
:= by
  let ι := {h : R // P h ∧ basicOpen h ≤ W}
  let U : ι → (Spec R).Opens := fun h => basicOpen h.1
  let iUW : ∀ i, U i ⟶ W := fun i => homOfLE i.2.2
  have hcov : W ≤ iSup U := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨h, hPh, hxh, hle⟩ := hW x hx
    exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨h, hPh, hle⟩, hxh⟩
  have hinj : Function.Injective (φ.app W) := by
    intro s t hst
    refine TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' ⟨_, A.isSheaf⟩ U W iUW hcov s t fun i => ?_
    apply (hbij i.1 i.2.1).1
    change φ.app (U i) (A.presheaf.map (iUW i).op s) = φ.app (U i) (A.presheaf.map (iUW i).op t)
    rw [app_map, app_map, hst]
  refine ⟨hinj, fun t => ?_⟩
  choose sf hsf using fun i : ι => (hbij i.1 i.2.1).2 (B.presheaf.map (iUW i).op t)
  obtain ⟨s, hs, -⟩ := TopCat.Sheaf.existsUnique_gluing' ⟨_, A.isSheaf⟩ U W iUW hcov sf (by
    intro i j
    have hij : basicOpen (i.1 * j.1) = U i ⊓ U j := basicOpen_mul _ _
    have : Function.Injective (A.presheaf.map (eqToHom hij).op) :=
      ConcreteCategory.injective_of_mono_of_preservesPullback _
    apply this
    dsimp [Opens.infLELeft, Opens.infLERight]
    simp_rw [← A.presheaf.map_comp_apply, ← op_comp, eqToHom_comp_homOfLE]
    apply (hbij _ (hP _ _ i.2.1)).1
    rw [app_map, app_map, hsf, hsf, ← B.presheaf.map_comp_apply, ← B.presheaf.map_comp_apply]
    rfl)
  refine ⟨s, TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' ⟨_, B.isSheaf⟩ U W iUW hcov _ _ fun i => ?_⟩
  change B.presheaf.map (iUW i).op (φ.app W s) = B.presheaf.map (iUW i).op t
  rw [← app_map]
  change φ.app (U i) (A.presheaf.map (iUW i).op s) = _
  rw [hs i, hsf]

name: QCExtension.app_bijective_iff
statement:
lemma app_bijective_iff {A B : (Spec R).Modules} (φ : A ⟶ B) (U : (Spec R).Opens) :
    Function.Bijective (φ.app U) ↔
      Function.Bijective ((modulesSpecToSheaf.map φ).1.app (op U)).hom
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: QCExtension.toOpen_comp_tildeMap_fromTildeΓ
statement:
lemma toOpen_comp_tildeMap_fromTildeΓ (G : (Spec R).Modules) (N : ModuleCat.{u} R)
    (f : N ⟶ (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj G).presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) (U : (Spec R).Opens) :
    tilde.toOpen N U ≫ (modulesSpecToSheaf.map (tilde.map f ≫ G.fromTildeΓ)).1.app (op U) =
      f ≫ (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj G).presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op
proof:
:= by
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  erw [NatTrans.comp_app]
  rw [tilde.toOpen_map_app_assoc, Scheme.Modules.toOpen_fromTildeΓ_app]

name: QCExtension.bijective_app_basicOpen_of_tilde
statement:
lemma bijective_app_basicOpen_of_tilde (G : (Spec R).Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent]
    (N' : ModuleCat.{u} R) (ι : N' ⟶ (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj G).presheaf.obj (op ⊤))
    (hι : Function.Injective ι.hom) (φ : tilde N' ⟶ G) (h : R)
    (key : tilde.toOpen N' (basicOpen h) ≫
      (modulesSpecToSheaf.map φ).1.app (op (basicOpen h)) =
      ι ≫ (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj G).presheaf.map (basicOpen h).leTop.op)
    (hN' : ∀ m, ∃ k : ℕ, h ^ k • m ∈ LinearMap.range ι.hom) :
    Function.Bijective (φ.app (basicOpen h))
proof:
:= by
  have h₂ := isLocalizedModule_moduleSpecΓ_basicOpenRestriction G h
  have h₁ : IsLocalizedModule.Away h (tilde.toOpen N' (basicOpen h)).hom :=
    .of_linearEquiv (.powers h) (StructureSheaf.toOpenₗ R N' (basicOpen h))
      ((tilde.modulesSpecToSheafIso N').app _).toLinearEquiv.symm
  exact (app_bijective_iff φ _).2 (bijective_of_comm_sq key h hι hN' h₁ h₂)

name: QCExtension.exists_extension_of_isCompact
statement:
theorem exists_extension_of_isCompact [IsNoetherianRing R] (V : (Spec R).Opens)
    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set (Spec R))) (F : (V : Scheme.{u}).Modules)
    [F.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ E : (Spec R).Modules, E.IsFinitePresentation ∧ Nonempty (E.restrict V.ι ≅ F)
proof:
:= by
  set G := (pushforward V.ι).obj F
  haveI : G.IsQuasicoherent := QCPushforward.isQuasicoherent_pushforward_ι V hV F
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ, a, ha⟩ := PrimeSpectrum.isBasis_basic_opens.exists_iSup_eq_of_isCompact V hV
  have hle (i : κ) : basicOpen (a i) ≤ V := by rw [ha]; exact le_iSup_of_le i le_rfl
  have hfin (i : κ) : Module.Finite (Localization.Away (a i))
      (BasicOpenLocalizedSections G (a i)) := by
    let t := (basicOpenIsoSpecAway (a i)).inv ≫ (Spec R).homOfLE (hle i)
    have hψ : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (a i)))) =
        t ≫ V.ι := by
      simp [t, basicOpenIsoSpecAway]
    let e : G.restrict (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (a i))))) ≅
        F.restrict t :=
      (restrictFunctorCongr hψ).app G ≪≫ (restrictFunctorComp t V.ι).app G ≪≫
        (restrictFunctor t).mapIso ((restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso V.ι).app F)
    haveI : (F.restrict t).IsFinitePresentation := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor t F
    haveI : (G.restrict (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (a i)))))).IsFinitePresentation :=
      (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation
        (Spec (CommRingCat.of (Localization.Away (a i)))).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
          e.symm inferInstance
    haveI := moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation (R := CommRingCat.of (Localization.Away (a i)))
      (G.restrict (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (a i))))))
    exact Module.Finite.equiv (basicOpenLocalizedSectionsEquivNative G (a i)).symm
  haveI : ∀ i, IsLocalizedModule.Away (a i) (moduleSpecΓBasicOpenLocalizationMap G (a i)) :=
    fun i => isLocalizedModule_moduleSpecΓBasicOpenLocalizationMap G (a i)
  obtain ⟨N, hNfg, hN⟩ := exists_fg_submodule_pow_smul_mem a
    (fun i => BasicOpenLocalizedSections G (a i))
    (fun i => moduleSpecΓBasicOpenLocalizationMap G (a i))
  let Nm : ModuleCat R := ModuleCat.of R N
  haveI : Module.Finite R N := Module.Finite.iff_fg.mpr hNfg
  haveI : Module.FinitePresentation R N := Module.finitePresentation_of_finite R N
  let ιN : Nm ⟶ (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj G).presheaf.obj (op ⊤) :=
    ConcreteCategory.ofHom (C := ModuleCat R) N.subtype
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ : ∃ φ : tilde Nm ⟶ G,
      φ = tilde.map ιN ≫ G.fromTildeΓ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have key (h : R) : tilde.toOpen Nm (basicOpen h) ≫
      (modulesSpecToSheaf.map φ).1.app (op (basicOpen h)) =
      ιN ≫ (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj G).presheaf.map (basicOpen h).leTop.op := by
    rw [hφ]
    exact toOpen_comp_tildeMap_fromTildeΓ G Nm _ _
  have hbij : ∀ W : (Spec R).Opens, W ≤ V → Function.Bijective (φ.app W) := by
    intro W hWV
    refine bijective_app_of_basicOpen φ (fun h => ∃ i, basicOpen h ≤ basicOpen (a i))
      (fun h h' ⟨i, hi⟩ => ⟨i, le_trans (basicOpen_mul_le_left h h') hi⟩) ?_ W ?_
    · rintro h ⟨i, hi⟩
      have hN' : ∀ m, ∃ k : ℕ, h ^ k • m ∈ LinearMap.range ιN.hom := by
        intro m
        obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (basicOpen_le_basicOpen_iff h (a i)).mp hi
        obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hn
        obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hN i m
        refine ⟨n * k, ?_⟩
        change _ ∈ LinearMap.range N.subtype
        rw [Submodule.range_subtype, pow_mul, ← hc, mul_pow, mul_smul]
        exact N.smul_mem _ hk
      exact bijective_app_basicOpen_of_tilde G Nm ιN N.injective_subtype φ h (key h) hN'
    · intro x hx
      have hxV : x ∈ V := hWV hx
      rw [ha] at hxV
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hxV
      obtain ⟨_, ⟨h, rfl⟩, hxh, hhle⟩ := Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp
        PrimeSpectrum.isBasis_basic_opens (show x ∈ W ⊓ basicOpen (a i) from ⟨hx, hi⟩)
      exact ⟨h, ⟨i, le_trans hhle inf_le_right⟩, hxh, le_trans hhle inf_le_left⟩
  haveI : IsIso ((restrictFunctor V.ι).map φ) := by
    rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.isIso_iff_isIso_app]
    intro W
    rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
    exact hbij (V.ι ''ᵁ W) (V.ι.image_le_opensRange W |>.trans (by simp))
  exact ⟨tilde Nm, tilde_isFinitePresentation Nm,
    ⟨asIso ((restrictFunctor V.ι).map φ) ≪≫ (restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso V.ι).app F⟩⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.G0PP.pushforward_shortExact_of_R1
statement:
