theorem pushforward_shortExact_of_R1 {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ Z) (S : ShortComplex Y.Modules)
    (hS : S.ShortExact) (h1 : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f S.X₁ 1)) :
    (S.map (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f)).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  let P := Scheme.Modules.pushforward f
  haveI : P.IsRightAdjoint := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).isRightAdjoint
  haveI : Mono S.f := hS.mono_f
  have hex : (S.map P).Exact := hS.exact.map_of_mono_of_preservesKernel P hS.mono_f inferInstance
  have hw := affineLocalLongExactSheafification₂_exact f S hS 0
  have hepi0 : Epi ((affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor f 0).map S.g) :=
    hw.epi_f (h1.eq_of_tgt _ _)
  have hepi : Epi (P.map S.g) :=
    (epi_affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor_zero_map_iff f S.g).1 hepi0
  exact { exact := hex, mono_f := P.map_mono S.f, epi_g := hepi }

name: SchemeKTheory.G0PP.isGG_of_isAffine
statement:
theorem isGG_of_isAffine (A : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine A] (M : A.Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation] :
    IsGG M
proof:
:= by
  let G := SchemeProjectiveSpace.affineFiniteGeneratingSectionsOfIsAffine A M
  haveI : Finite G.I := inferInstance
  exact @isGG_of_finite _ M _ G.I _ (Iso.refl _) G.π G.epi

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PP.standardChartEmb_range_le
statement:
theorem standardChartEmb_range_le (i : C.I) {n : ℕ} (e : C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1)) :
    Set.range (standardChartEmb C i e) ⊆ Set.range (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i).ι
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
  rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
  change C.toBase (standardChartEmb C i e w) ∈ ((C.U i : X.Opens) : Set X)
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, standardChartEmb_toBase, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply,
    ← (C.isAffine i).range_fromSpec]
  exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PP.chartLift_ι
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem chartLift_ι (i : C.I) {n : ℕ} (e : C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1)) :
    chartLift C i e ≫ (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i).ι = standardChartEmb C i e
proof:
:=
  IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PP.chartLift_q
statement:
theorem chartLift_q (i : C.I) {n : ℕ} (e : C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1)) :
    chartLift C i e ≫ (C.toBase ∣_ C.U i) =
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n ≫ (C.isAffine i).isoSpec.inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono (C.U i).ι, Category.assoc, morphismRestrict_ι, chartLift_ι_assoc,
    standardChartEmb_toBase, Category.assoc, IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_inv_ι]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PP.chartLift_opensRange
statement:
theorem chartLift_opensRange (i : C.I) {n : ℕ} (e : C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1))
    (g : Γ(X, C.U i)) :
    ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι ≫
        chartLift C i e).opensRange =
      (C.toBase ∣_ C.U i) ⁻¹ᵁ ((C.U i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ X.basicOpen g)
proof:
:= by
  have h := standardChartEmb_opensRange C i e g
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, rfl⟩
    have hw : (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i).ι
        (((SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι ≫
          chartLift C i e) w) ∈ C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ X.basicOpen g := by
      rw [← h, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, Category.assoc, chartLift_ι]
      exact ⟨w, rfl⟩
    change (C.U i).ι ((C.toBase ∣_ C.U i) _) ∈ X.basicOpen g
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, morphismRestrict_ι, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact hw
  · intro hx
    have hx' : (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i).ι x ∈ C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ X.basicOpen g := by
      change C.toBase ((C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i).ι x) ∈ X.basicOpen g
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← morphismRestrict_ι, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
      exact hx
    rw [← h] at hx'
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hx'
    refine ⟨w, (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i).ι.isOpenEmbedding.injective ?_⟩
    rw [← hw, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, Category.assoc, chartLift_ι]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PP.higher_q_isZero
statement:
theorem higher_q_isZero [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (i : C.I) {n : ℕ}
    (e : C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1)) (K : (C.U i).toScheme.Modules) [K.IsFinitePresentation]
    (k : ℕ) :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (C.toBase ∣_ C.U i)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (C.toBase ∣_ C.U i)).obj K) (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, C.U i) :=
    IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨C.U i, C.isAffine i⟩
  let B : Set (C.U i).toScheme.Opens :=
    {V | ∃ g : Γ(X, C.U i), (C.U i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ X.basicOpen g = V}
  have hB : TopologicalSpace.Opens.IsBasis B := by
    rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd]
    intro W x hx
    have hxU : (C.U i).ι x ∈ C.U i := by
      have : (C.U i).ι x ∈ Set.range (C.U i).ι := ⟨x, rfl⟩
      rwa [Scheme.Opens.range_ι] at this
    have hxW : (C.U i).ι x ∈ (C.U i).ι ''ᵁ W := by
      change (C.U i).ι x ∈ (((C.U i).ι ''ᵁ W : X.Opens) : Set X)
      rw [Scheme.Hom.coe_image]
      exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨g, hgW, hxg⟩ := (C.isAffine i).exists_basicOpen_le ⟨(C.U i).ι x, hxW⟩ hxU
    refine ⟨_, ⟨g, rfl⟩, hxg, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    have hy' : (C.U i).ι y ∈ (C.U i).ι ''ᵁ W := hgW hy
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.preimage_image_eq (C.U i).ι W]
    exact hy'
  refine affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_isZero_of_isBasis _ _ _ hB ?_
  rintro V ⟨g, rfl⟩
  let W := SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g
  let ψ := chartLift C i e
  let K' := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (C.isAffine i).isoSpec.inv).obj K
  haveI : K'.IsFinitePresentation := pullback_isFinitePresentation_global _ K
  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (C.toBase ∣_ C.U i)).obj K).IsFinitePresentation :=
    pullback_isFinitePresentation_global _ K
  let M := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ψ).obj
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (C.toBase ∣_ C.U i)).obj K)
  haveI : M.IsFinitePresentation := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor _ _
  haveI : M.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  have hM : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n) M (k + 1)) :=
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.Quillen.R_iso _ n
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.Quillen.twistZeroIso _ n _ ≪≫ (chartLiftPullbackIso C i e K).symm)
      (k + 1) (SchemeProjectiveSpace.G0PBChain.baseTwist_higher_isZero _ n K' k 0 (by omega))
  have h0 := SchemeProjectiveSpace.RegularityChart.basicOpenH_of_isZero Γ(X, C.U i) n M (k + 1)
    hM g
  refine BundleRegularity.H_transfer (C.toBase ∣_ C.U i) _ (W.ι ≫ ψ)
    (chartLift_opensRange C i e g) _ (k + 1) ?_
  let c : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (W.ι ≫ ψ)).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (C.toBase ∣_ C.U i)).obj K) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj M :=
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp W.ι ψ).app _
  let E' := (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.functorH _ (k + 1)).mapIso
    ((Modules.toSheafAb W.toScheme).mapIso c)
  exact @Equiv.subsingleton _ _ E'.addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv.toEquiv h0

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PP.Gp_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement: theorem Gp_isFiniteLocallyFree (i : C.I) : IsFiniteLocallyFree _ (Gp C i)

:=

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PP.pushGp_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem pushGp_isFiniteLocallyFree (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) (i : C.I) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree _ ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.toBase ∣_ C.U i)).obj (Gp C i))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PP.push_tensor_shortExact
statement:
theorem push_tensor_shortExact [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    (i : C.I) (S : ShortComplex (C.U i).toScheme.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    [S.X₁.IsFinitePresentation] [S.X₂.IsFinitePresentation] [S.X₃.IsFinitePresentation] :
    (((S.map (Scheme.Modules.pullback (C.toBase ∣_ C.U i))).map
      (ProjectionFormula.tensorRight _ (Gp C i))).map
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.toBase ∣_ C.U i))).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Flat C.toBase := C.toBase_flat hpos
  haveI : Flat (C.toBase ∣_ C.U i) := inferInstance
  have h1 : (S.map (Scheme.Modules.pullback (C.toBase ∣_ C.U i))).ShortExact :=
    pullback_map_shortExact_global _ S hS
  haveI := tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits _ (Gp C i) (Gp_isFiniteLocallyFree C i)
  haveI := tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits _ (Gp C i)
    (Gp_isFiniteLocallyFree C i)
  haveI := preservesFiniteLimits_of_natIso (ProjectionFormula.tensorRightIso _ (Gp C i))
  haveI := preservesFiniteColimits_of_natIso (ProjectionFormula.tensorRightIso _ (Gp C i))
  have h2 := h1.map_of_exact (ProjectionFormula.tensorRight _ (Gp C i))
  refine G0PP.pushforward_shortExact_of_R1 _ _ h2 ?_
  obtain ⟨n, ⟨e⟩⟩ := BundleRegularity.hrank C hpos i
  have h := higher_q_isZero C i e S.X₁ 0
  let c : tensorSheaf _ ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (C.toBase ∣_ C.U i)).obj S.X₁) (Gp C i) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (C.toBase ∣_ C.U i)).obj S.X₁ :=
    tensorSheafMapIso _ (Iso.refl _) (pullbackObjUnitIso _) ≪≫ tensorSheafRightUnitor _ _
  exact h.of_iso ((affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor _ 1).mapIso c)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PP.exists_free_ses
statement:
theorem exists_free_ses [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (i : C.I) (M : (C.U i).toScheme.Modules)
    [M.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ (K F : (C.U i).toScheme.Modules) (ι : K ⟶ F) (g : F ⟶ M) (w : ι ≫ g = 0),
      (ShortComplex.mk ι g w).ShortExact ∧ K.IsFinitePresentation ∧
        ∃ N : ℕ, Nonempty (F ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := (C.U i).toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
          (ULift.{u} (Fin N)))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsAffine (C.U i).toScheme := C.isAffine i
  obtain ⟨N, g, hg⟩ := TowerAR6.exists_free_epi (G0PP.isGG_of_isAffine _ M)
  haveI : (SheafOfModules.free (R := (C.U i).toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
      (ULift.{u} (Fin N))).IsFinitePresentation :=
    (free_isFiniteLocallyFree _ (ULift.{u} (Fin N))).isFinitePresentation
  have hS : (ShortComplex.mk (kernel.ι g) g (kernel.condition g)).ShortExact :=
    { exact := ShortComplex.exact_kernel g }
  exact ⟨kernel g, _, kernel.ι g, g, kernel.condition g, hS,
    KSpecialization.kernel_isFinitePresentation g, N, ⟨Iso.refl _⟩⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PP.projectionMap_q_epi
statement:
theorem projectionMap_q_epi [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    (i : C.I) (M : (C.U i).toScheme.Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation] :
    Epi (projectionMap (C.toBase ∣_ C.U i) M (Gp C i))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, F, ι, g, w, hS, hK, N, ⟨eF⟩⟩ := exists_free_ses C i M
  haveI : F.IsFinitePresentation := (isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso _ eF.symm
    (free_isFiniteLocallyFree _ (ULift.{u} (Fin N)))).isFinitePresentation
  have h3 := push_tensor_shortExact C hpos i _ hS
  haveI hαF : IsIso (projectionMap (C.toBase ∣_ C.U i) F (Gp C i)) :=
    projectionMap_isIso_of_iso_free _ _ (ULift.{u} (Fin N)) eF
  haveI hepi : Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.toBase ∣_ C.U i)).map
      (tensorSheafMap _ ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (C.toBase ∣_ C.U i)).map g) (𝟙 (Gp C i)))) := by
    exact h3.epi_g
  have hnat := projectionMap_naturality (C.toBase ∣_ C.U i) g (Gp C i)
  haveI : Epi (tensorSheafMap _ g (𝟙 _) ≫ projectionMap (C.toBase ∣_ C.U i) M (Gp C i)) := by
    rw [hnat]
    infer_instance
  exact epi_of_epi (tensorSheafMap _ g (𝟙 _)) _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PP.isIso_of_four
statement:
theorem isIso_of_four {𝒜 : Type*} [Category 𝒜] [Abelian 𝒜] (R₁ R₂ : ShortComplex 𝒜)
    (hR₂ : R₂.Exact) [Epi R₁.g] (τ₁ : R₁.X₁ ⟶ R₂.X₁) (τ₂ : R₁.X₂ ⟶ R₂.X₂) (τ₃ : R₁.X₃ ⟶ R₂.X₃)
    (c₁₂ : R₁.f ≫ τ₂ = τ₁ ≫ R₂.f) (c₂₃ : R₁.g ≫ τ₃ = τ₂ ≫ R₂.g) (h₀ : Epi τ₁)
    (h₁ : IsIso τ₂) (h₂ : Epi τ₃) :
    IsIso τ₃
proof:
:= by
  let φ : R₁ ⟶ R₂ := { τ₁ := τ₁, τ₂ := τ₂, τ₃ := τ₃, comm₁₂ := c₁₂.symm, comm₂₃ := c₂₃.symm }
  haveI : Mono φ.τ₃ :=
    ShortComplex.mono_of_epi_of_epi_of_mono φ hR₂ inferInstance (inferInstanceAs (Epi τ₁))
      (inferInstanceAs (Mono τ₂))
  exact isIso_of_mono_of_epi τ₃

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PP.projectionMap_q_isIso
statement:
theorem projectionMap_q_isIso [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    (i : C.I) (M : (C.U i).toScheme.Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation] :
    IsIso (projectionMap (C.toBase ∣_ C.U i) M (Gp C i))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, F, ι, g, w, hS, hK, N, ⟨eF⟩⟩ := exists_free_ses C i M
  haveI : F.IsFinitePresentation := (isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso _ eF.symm
    (free_isFiniteLocallyFree _ (ULift.{u} (Fin N)))).isFinitePresentation
  have h3 := push_tensor_shortExact C hpos i _ hS
  let P := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.toBase ∣_ C.U i)).obj (Gp C i)
  have hP : IsFiniteLocallyFree _ P := pushGp_isFiniteLocallyFree C hpos i
  let R₁ := (ShortComplex.mk ι g w).map (ProjectionFormula.tensorRight _ P)
  haveI : Epi g := hS.epi_g
  haveI hR₁ : Epi R₁.g := TowerAR6.epi_tensorSheafMap_id_right g P hP
  haveI h₀ : Epi (projectionMap (C.toBase ∣_ C.U i) K (Gp C i)) :=
    projectionMap_q_epi C hpos i K
  haveI h₁ : IsIso (projectionMap (C.toBase ∣_ C.U i) F (Gp C i)) :=
    projectionMap_isIso_of_iso_free _ _ (ULift.{u} (Fin N)) eF
  haveI h₂ : Epi (projectionMap (C.toBase ∣_ C.U i) M (Gp C i)) := projectionMap_q_epi C hpos i M
  refine isIso_of_four R₁ _ h3.exact (projectionMap (C.toBase ∣_ C.U i) K (Gp C i))
    (projectionMap (C.toBase ∣_ C.U i) F (Gp C i)) _ ?_ ?_ h₀ h₁ h₂
  · exact projectionMap_naturality _ ι (Gp C i)
  · exact projectionMap_naturality _ g (Gp C i)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PP.projectionMap_toBase_isIso
statement:
theorem projectionMap_toBase_isIso [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) (T : X.Modules) [T.IsFinitePresentation] :
    IsIso (projectionMap C.toBase T (tensorUnitSheaf C.scheme))
proof:
:= by
  have hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop C.U :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := X) C.U).2 C.covers
  refine projectionMap_isIso_of_cover C.toBase T _ C.U hU fun i ↦ ?_
  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (C.U i).ι).obj T).IsFinitePresentation :=
    pullback_isFinitePresentation_global _ T
  exact projectionMap_q_isIso C hpos i _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PP.hunit
statement:
theorem hunit [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) :
    ∀ T : X.Modules, IsCoherentLike X T →
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.toBase).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj T) ≅ T)
proof:
:= fun T hT ↦ by
  haveI : T.IsFinitePresentation := hT
  exact ⟨pushPullbackIsoOfCoherent C hpos T⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PP.derivedPush_pullbackG0_twist_coh
statement:
theorem derivedPush_pullbackG0_twist_coh [IsNoetherian X] {N : ℕ}
    (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N) {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) (k : ℕ) (hk : k < r)
    (y : G0 X) :
    projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-(k : ℤ)) •
        G0PB.pullbackG0 C (G0PB.hpos_of_rank C hrank) y) =
      if k = 0 then y else 0
proof:
:=
  G0PB.derivedPush_pullbackG0_twist C hrank hE (hunit C (G0PB.hpos_of_rank C hrank)) k hk y

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PP.derivedPush_pullbackG0_eq
statement:
theorem derivedPush_pullbackG0_eq [IsNoetherian X] {N : ℕ}
    (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N) {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (hE : HasConstantRank X E r)
    (y : G0 X) :
    projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank (G0PB.pullbackG0 C (G0PB.hpos_of_rank C hrank) y) =
      y
proof:
:= by
  have h := derivedPush_pullbackG0_twist_coh C hrank hE 0 hr y
  rwa [Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero, canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_zero, one_smul, if_pos rfl] at h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.abelianImage_isFinitePresentation_of_noetherian
statement:
theorem abelianImage_isFinitePresentation_of_noetherian
    {A B : (Spec R).Modules} [A.IsQuasicoherent] [B.IsFinitePresentation]
    (f : A ⟶ B) : (Abelian.image f).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  let GA :=
    (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj A).presheaf.obj (.op (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens))
  let GB :=
    (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj B).presheaf.obj (.op (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens))
  let l : GA ⟶ GB := (modulesSpecToSheaf.map f).1.app (.op ⊤)
  let I : ModuleCat R := Abelian.image l
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R
      ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R)).obj B) :=
    moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation B
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R GB :=
    (topSectionsLinearEquivModuleSpecΓ B).finitePresentation_iff.mpr
      inferInstance
  letI : Module.Finite R GB := inferInstance
  letI : Module.Finite R I :=
    Module.Finite.of_injective (Abelian.image.ι l : I ⟶ GB).hom
      ((ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp inferInstance)
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R I :=
    Module.finitePresentation_of_finite R _
  have htilde :
      ((tilde.functor R).obj I).IsFinitePresentation :=
    tilde_isFinitePresentation I
  letI : (tilde.functor R).PreservesHomology :=
    Functor.preservesHomology_of_map_exact _ fun T hT =>
      tilde_map_exact T hT
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits (tilde.functor R) :=
    Functor.preservesFiniteLimits_of_preservesHomology _
  letI : PreservesFiniteColimits (tilde.functor R) :=
    Functor.preservesFiniteColimits_of_preservesHomology _
  letI : IsIso A.fromTildeΓ :=
    Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent A
  letI : IsIso B.fromTildeΓ :=
    Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent B
  let eA0 := asIso A.fromTildeΓ
  let eB0 := asIso B.fromTildeΓ
  let eA : (tilde.functor R).obj GA ≅ A := eA0
  let eB : (tilde.functor R).obj GB ≅ B := eB0
  let arrowIso :
      Arrow.mk ((tilde.functor R).map l) ≅ Arrow.mk f :=
    Arrow.isoMk' _ _ eA eB (by
      dsimp only [eA, eB, eA0, eB0, GA, GB, l]
      exact ((tilde.adjunction (R := R)).counit.naturality f).symm)
  let e₁ : (tilde.functor R).obj I ≅ Abelian.image ((tilde.functor R).map l) :=
    Abelian.PreservesImage.iso (tilde.functor R) l
  let e₂' := Abelian.im.mapIso arrowIso
  let e₂ : Abelian.image ((tilde.functor R).map l) ≅ Abelian.image f := e₂'
  let e : (tilde.functor R).obj I ≅ Abelian.image f := e₁ ≪≫ e₂
  exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation (Spec R).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
    e htilde

name: AlgebraicGeometry.image_isFinitePresentation_of_noetherian
statement:
theorem image_isFinitePresentation_of_noetherian
    {A B : (Spec R).Modules} [A.IsQuasicoherent] [B.IsFinitePresentation]
    (f : A ⟶ B) : (image f).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:=
  (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation (Spec R).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
    (Abelian.imageIsoImage f)
    (abelianImage_isFinitePresentation_of_noetherian f)

name: ExactGrothendieck.classOf_sub_eq_kernel_sub_cokernel
statement:
theorem classOf_sub_eq_kernel_sub_cokernel {A B : C} (f : A ⟶ B)
    (hA : P A) (hB : P B) :
    subcategoryClassOf C P A hA - subcategoryClassOf C P B hB =
      subcategoryClassOf C P (kernel f) (hP.kernel f hA hB) -
        subcategoryClassOf C P (cokernel f) (hP.cokernel f hA hB)
proof:
:= by
  let g := cokernel.π f
  have hQ : P (cokernel f) := hP.cokernel f hA hB
  have hI : P (kernel g) := hP.kernel g hB hQ
  have r₁ := PrincipalGysin.classOf_eq_ker_add_ker hP
    (ShortComplex.mk f g (cokernel.condition f)) (ShortComplex.exact_cokernel f) hA hB hQ
  have r₂ := PrincipalGysin.classOf_eq_ker_add_of_epi hP g hB hQ
  dsimp only at r₁ r₂
  rw [r₁, r₂]
  abel

name: SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf_mem_supportedClasses
statement:
theorem g0ClassOf_mem_supportedClasses (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (E : X.Modules) (hE : IsCoherentLike X E)
    (hzero : IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).obj E)) :
    g0ClassOf X E hE ∈ supportedClasses j
proof:
:=
  AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨E, hE, hzero, rfl⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.supportedClasses_le_ker_flatPullbackG0
statement:
theorem supportedClasses_le_ker_flatPullbackG0 (j : U ⟶ X)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] :
    supportedClasses j ≤ (flatPullbackG0 j).ker
proof:
:= by
  apply (AddSubgroup.closure_le _).2
  rintro z ⟨E, hE, hzero, rfl⟩
  change flatPullbackG0 j (g0ClassOf X E hE) = 0
  rw [flatPullbackG0_classOf]
  have hzero' : IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj E) :=
    hzero.of_iso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback j).app E).symm
  exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_isZero U.Modules (IsCoherentLike U)
    _ hzero'

name: SchemeKTheory.class_sub_mem_supportedClasses_of_comparison
statement:
theorem class_sub_mem_supportedClasses_of_comparison (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    {A B : X.Modules} (f : A ⟶ B)
    (hA : IsCoherentLike X A) (hB : IsCoherentLike X B)
    (hP : ExactGrothendieck.PrincipalGysin.KerCokerClosed (IsCoherentLike X))
    (hker : IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).obj (kernel f)))
    (hcoker : IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).obj (cokernel f))) :
    g0ClassOf X A hA - g0ClassOf X B hB ∈ supportedClasses j
proof:
:= by
  change ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf X.Modules (IsCoherentLike X) A hA -
    ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf X.Modules (IsCoherentLike X) B hB ∈ _
  rw [ExactGrothendieck.classOf_sub_eq_kernel_sub_cokernel hP f hA hB]
  exact sub_mem (g0ClassOf_mem_supportedClasses j _ _ hker)
    (g0ClassOf_mem_supportedClasses j _ _ hcoker)

name: SchemeKTheory.isZero_restrict_kernel_of_isIso
statement:
theorem isZero_restrict_kernel_of_isIso (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    {A B : X.Modules} (f : A ⟶ B)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).map f)] :
    IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).obj (kernel f))
proof:
:= by
  let F := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j
  letI : F.Additive := by
    constructor
    intro M N a b
    rfl
  letI : F.PreservesZeroMorphisms := Functor.preservesZeroMorphisms_of_additive F
  letI : F.PreservesHomology :=
    Functor.preservesHomology_of_map_exact F fun T hT =>
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor_map_exact j T hT
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits F :=
    Functor.preservesFiniteLimits_of_preservesHomology F
  exact (isZero_kernel_of_mono (F.map f)).of_iso (PreservesKernel.iso F f)

name: SchemeKTheory.isZero_restrict_cokernel_of_isIso

    IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).obj (cokernel f))
proof:
:= by
  let F := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j
  letI : F.Additive := by
    constructor
    intro M N a b
    rfl
  letI : F.PreservesZeroMorphisms := Functor.preservesZeroMorphisms_of_additive F
  letI : F.PreservesHomology :=
    Functor.preservesHomology_of_map_exact F fun T hT =>
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor_map_exact j T hT
  letI : PreservesFiniteColimits F :=
    Functor.preservesFiniteColimits_of_preservesHomology F
  exact (isZero_cokernel_of_epi (F.map f)).of_iso (PreservesCokernel.iso F f)

name: SchemeKTheory.class_sub_mem_supportedClasses_of_restrict_isIso

name: SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverLeftUnitor_unit_naturality
statement:
theorem tensorSheafOverLeftUnitor_unit_naturality
    (U : TopologicalSpace.Opens X)
    (a b : SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over U) ≅
      SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)) :
    (tensorSheafOverLeftUnitor X U
      (SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over U))).symm ≪≫
        tensorSheafOverMapIso X U a b ≪≫
          tensorSheafOverLeftUnitor X U
            (SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)) =
      b ≪≫ a
proof:
:= by
  letI : MonoidalCategory
      (PresheafOfModules.{u} (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj) :=
    inferInstanceAs (MonoidalCategory (PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (((Over.forget U).op ⋙ X.presheaf) ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)))
  let S := SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)
  have hunit :
      (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor S.val).inv ≫
          (a.hom.val ⊗ₘ b.hom.val) ≫
            (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor S.val).hom =
        b.hom.val ≫ a.hom.val := by
    dsimp only [S, SheafOfModules.unit]
    let aa : (𝟙_ (PresheafOfModules.{u}
        (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)) ⟶
        (𝟙_ (PresheafOfModules.{u}
          (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)) := a.hom.val
    let bb : (𝟙_ (PresheafOfModules.{u}
        (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)) ⟶
        (𝟙_ (PresheafOfModules.{u}
          (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)) := b.hom.val
    change (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor
          (𝟙_ (PresheafOfModules.{u}
            (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj))).inv ≫
        (aa ⊗ₘ bb) ≫
          (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor
            (𝟙_ (PresheafOfModules.{u}
              (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj))).hom =
      bb ≫ aa
    simp only [← Category.assoc]
    rw [MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor_inv_comp_tensorHom]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    change bb ≫
        (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor
          (𝟙_ (PresheafOfModules.{u}
            (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj))).inv ≫
          aa ▷ (𝟙_ (PresheafOfModules.{u}
            (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)) ≫
            (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor
              (𝟙_ (PresheafOfModules.{u}
                (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj))).hom =
      bb ≫ aa
    rw [MonoidalCategory.unitors_inv_equal, MonoidalCategory.unitors_equal]
    rw [MonoidalCategory.rightUnitor_naturality]
    simp
  apply Iso.ext
  let A := SheafOfModules.identitySheafificationOver
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.ringCatSheaf U
  let adj := PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
    (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)
  let c := (asIso adj.counit).app S
  change c.inv ≫ A.map (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor S.val).inv ≫
      A.map (a.hom.val ⊗ₘ b.hom.val) ≫
        A.map (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor S.val).hom ≫ c.hom =
    b.hom ≫ a.hom
  have hba := adj.counit.naturality (b.hom ≫ a.hom)
  change A.map (b.hom.val ≫ a.hom.val) ≫ c.hom =
    c.hom ≫ (b.hom ≫ a.hom) at hba
  have hAunit := congrArg (fun q ↦ A.map q) hunit
  have hmap :
      A.map (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor S.val).inv ≫
          A.map (a.hom.val ⊗ₘ b.hom.val) ≫
            A.map (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor S.val).hom =
        A.map (b.hom.val ≫ a.hom.val) := by
    calc
      _ = A.map (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor S.val).inv ≫
          A.map ((a.hom.val ⊗ₘ b.hom.val) ≫
            (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor S.val).hom) :=
        congrArg
          (fun q ↦ A.map (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor S.val).inv ≫ q)
          (A.map_comp (a.hom.val ⊗ₘ b.hom.val)
            (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor S.val).hom).symm
      _ = A.map ((MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor S.val).inv ≫
          ((a.hom.val ⊗ₘ b.hom.val) ≫
            (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor S.val).hom)) :=
        (A.map_comp (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor S.val).inv
          ((a.hom.val ⊗ₘ b.hom.val) ≫
            (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor S.val).hom)).symm
      _ = _ := hAunit
  apply (cancel_epi c.hom).1
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  exact (Category.assoc
      (A.map (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor S.val).inv)
      (A.map (a.hom.val ⊗ₘ b.hom.val))
      (A.map (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor S.val).hom ≫ c.hom)).symm |>.trans
    ((Category.assoc
      (A.map (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor S.val).inv ≫
        A.map (a.hom.val ⊗ₘ b.hom.val))
      (A.map (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor S.val).hom) c.hom).symm.trans
    ((congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ c.hom) (Category.assoc
      (A.map (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor S.val).inv)
      (A.map (a.hom.val ⊗ₘ b.hom.val))
      (A.map (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor S.val).hom))).trans
    ((congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ c.hom) hmap).trans hba)))

name: SchemeKTheory.overTensorFreeYonedaIso_hom_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma overTensorFreeYonedaIso_hom_naturality
    {U V : TopologicalSpace.Opens X} (h : V ⟶ U)
    {M N : PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀OfCommRingCat (Over.forget V) X.presheaf).map
        (f ▷ (PresheafOfModules.free
          (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj (yoneda.obj U)) ≫
      (overTensorFreeYonedaIso X h N).hom =
    (overTensorFreeYonedaIso X h M).hom ≫
      (PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀OfCommRingCat (Over.forget V) X.presheaf).map f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [overTensorFreeYonedaIso, Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc]
  erw [← Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ_natural_left_assoc]
  simp only [tensorIso_hom, Iso.refl_hom, MonoidalCategory.id_tensorHom]
  erw [← MonoidalCategory.whisker_exchange_assoc]
  erw [MonoidalCategory.rightUnitor_naturality]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.equalizerSieve_mem_of_over
statement:
lemma equalizerSieve_mem_of_over
    {F G : (TopologicalSpace.Opens X)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Ab} (f : F ⟶ G)
    {V : (TopologicalSpace.Opens X)ᵒᵖ}
    [Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective
      ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over V.unop)
      (Functor.whiskerLeft (Over.forget V.unop).op f)]
    (x y : ToType (F.obj V)) (hxy : f.app V x = f.app V y) :
    Presheaf.equalizerSieve x y ∈
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) V.unop
proof:
:= by
  let T : Over V.unop := Over.mk (𝟙 V.unop)
  have hT := Presheaf.equalizerSieve_mem
    ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over V.unop)
    (Functor.whiskerLeft (Over.forget V.unop).op f)
    (X := Opposite.op T) x y (by
      change f.app V x = f.app V y
      exact hxy)
  rw [GrothendieckTopology.mem_over_iff] at hT
  change Sieve.overEquiv T
      (Presheaf.equalizerSieve
        (F := (Over.forget V.unop).op ⋙ F) x y) ∈
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) V.unop at hT
  have hs : Sieve.overEquiv T
      (Presheaf.equalizerSieve
        (F := (Over.forget V.unop).op ⋙ F) x y) =
      Presheaf.equalizerSieve (F := F) x y := by
    apply Sieve.ext
    intro W g
    rw [Sieve.overEquiv_iff]
    rfl
  rwa [hs] at hT

name: SchemeKTheory.imageSieve_mem_of_over
statement:
lemma imageSieve_mem_of_over
    {F G : (TopologicalSpace.Opens X)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Ab} (f : F ⟶ G)
    {V : TopologicalSpace.Opens X}
    [Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective
      ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over V)
      (Functor.whiskerLeft (Over.forget V).op f)]
    (x : ToType (G.obj (Opposite.op V))) :
    Presheaf.imageSieve f x ∈ (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) V
proof:
:= by
  let T : Over V := Over.mk (𝟙 V)
  have hT := Presheaf.imageSieve_mem
    ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over V)
    (Functor.whiskerLeft (Over.forget V).op f)
    (U := Opposite.op T) x
  rw [GrothendieckTopology.mem_over_iff] at hT
  change Sieve.overEquiv T
      (Presheaf.imageSieve
        (Functor.whiskerLeft (Over.forget V).op f) x) ∈
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) V at hT
  have hs : Sieve.overEquiv T
      (Presheaf.imageSieve
        (Functor.whiskerLeft (Over.forget V).op f) x) =
      Presheaf.imageSieve f x := by
    apply Sieve.ext
    intro W g
    rw [Sieve.overEquiv_iff]
    rfl
  rwa [hs] at hT

name: SchemeKTheory.tensorFreeYoneda_subsingleton_at_of_not_nonempty
statement:
lemma tensorFreeYoneda_subsingleton_at_of_not_nonempty
    {U V : TopologicalSpace.Opens X}
    (hVU : ¬ Nonempty (V ⟶ U))
    (M : PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)) :
    Subsingleton
      ((M ⊗ (PresheafOfModules.free
        (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj (yoneda.obj U)).obj
          (Opposite.op V))
proof:
:= by
  have hfree (q : ((PresheafOfModules.free
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj (yoneda.obj U)).obj
        (Opposite.op V)) : q = 0 := by
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro i
    exact (hVU ⟨i⟩).elim
  have hzero (z : ((M ⊗ (PresheafOfModules.free
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj (yoneda.obj U)).obj
        (Opposite.op V))) : z = 0 := by
    induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => rfl
    | tmul m q =>
        rw [hfree q, TensorProduct.tmul_zero]
        rfl
    | add x y hx hy =>
        rw [hx, hy]
        exact add_zero 0
  exact ⟨fun x y ↦ (hzero x).trans (hzero y).symm⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.moduleLocalEquivalence_pushforwardOver
statement:
lemma moduleLocalEquivalence_pushforwardOver
    {M N : PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)} (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hf : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).W
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
        (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map f))
    (V : TopologicalSpace.Opens X) :
    ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over V).W
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
        (((Over.forget V).op ⋙ X.presheaf) ⋙
          forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map
        ((PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀OfCommRingCat
          (Over.forget V) X.presheaf).map f))
proof:
:= by
  letI : Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
        (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map f) :=
    hf.isLocallyInjective
  letI : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
        (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map f) :=
    hf.isLocallySurjective
  letI : Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective
      ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over V)
      (Functor.whiskerLeft (Over.forget V).op
        ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
          (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map f)) :=
    Presheaf.isLocallyInjective_whisker
      ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over V)
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (Over.forget V) _
  letI : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective
      ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over V)
      (Functor.whiskerLeft (Over.forget V).op
        ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
          (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map f)) :=
    Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_whisker
      ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over V)
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (Over.forget V) _
  change ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over V).W
    (Functor.whiskerLeft (Over.forget V).op
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
        (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map f))
  exact ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over V).W_of_isLocallyBijective
    (Functor.whiskerLeft (Over.forget V).op
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
        (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map f))

name: SchemeKTheory.tensorFreeYoneda_pushforwardOver_W_of_le
statement:
lemma tensorFreeYoneda_pushforwardOver_W_of_le
    {M N : PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)} (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hf : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).W
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
        (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map f))
    {U V : TopologicalSpace.Opens X} (hVU : V ⟶ U) :
    ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over V).W
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
        (((Over.forget V).op ⋙ X.presheaf) ⋙
          forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map
        ((PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀OfCommRingCat
          (Over.forget V) X.presheaf).map
          (f ▷ (PresheafOfModules.free
            (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj
              (yoneda.obj U))))
proof:
:= by
  let W := ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over V).W.inverseImage
    (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
      (((Over.forget V).op ⋙ X.presheaf) ⋙
        forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))
  change W ((PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀OfCommRingCat
    (Over.forget V) X.presheaf).map
      (f ▷ (PresheafOfModules.free
        (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj
          (yoneda.obj U)))
  apply (W.arrow_mk_iso_iff
    (Arrow.isoMk (overTensorFreeYonedaIso X hVU M)
      (overTensorFreeYonedaIso X hVU N)
      (overTensorFreeYonedaIso_hom_naturality X hVU f).symm)).2
  exact moduleLocalEquivalence_pushforwardOver X f hf V

name: SchemeKTheory.moduleLocalEquivalences_whiskerRight_freeYoneda
statement:
theorem moduleLocalEquivalences_whiskerRight_freeYoneda
    {M N : PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)} (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hf : moduleLocalEquivalences X f)
    (U : TopologicalSpace.Opens X) :
    moduleLocalEquivalences X
      (f ▷ (PresheafOfModules.free
        (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj
          (yoneda.obj U))
proof:
:= by
  change (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).W
    ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map f) at hf
  let Q := (PresheafOfModules.free
    (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj (yoneda.obj U)
  let t := f ▷ Q
  let ft := (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
    (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map t
  change (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).W ft
  letI : Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) ft :=
    ⟨by
      intro V x y hxy
      by_cases hVU : Nonempty (V.unop ⟶ U)
      · obtain ⟨hVU⟩ := hVU
        have htV := tensorFreeYoneda_pushforwardOver_W_of_le X f hf hVU
        letI : Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective
            ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over V.unop)
            (Functor.whiskerLeft (Over.forget V.unop).op ft) := by
          change Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective
            ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over V.unop)
            ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
              (((Over.forget V.unop).op ⋙ X.presheaf) ⋙
                forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map
              ((PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀OfCommRingCat
                (Over.forget V.unop) X.presheaf).map
                (f ▷ (PresheafOfModules.free
                  (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj
                    (yoneda.obj U))))
          exact htV.isLocallyInjective
        exact equalizerSieve_mem_of_over X ft x y hxy
      · letI : Subsingleton
            (ToType (((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
              (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj
                (M ⊗ Q)).obj V)) := by
          change Subsingleton ((M ⊗ Q).obj V)
          dsimp [Q]
          exact tensorFreeYoneda_subsingleton_at_of_not_nonempty X hVU M
        have hxy' : x = y := Subsingleton.elim _ _
        subst y
        rw [Presheaf.equalizerSieve_self_eq_top]
        exact (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).top_mem _⟩
  letI : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) ft :=
    ⟨by
      intro V y
      by_cases hVU : Nonempty (V ⟶ U)
      · obtain ⟨hVU⟩ := hVU
        have htV := tensorFreeYoneda_pushforwardOver_W_of_le X f hf hVU
        letI : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective
            ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over V)
            (Functor.whiskerLeft (Over.forget V).op ft) := by
          change Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective
            ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over V)
            ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
              (((Over.forget V).op ⋙ X.presheaf) ⋙
                forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map
              ((PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀OfCommRingCat
                (Over.forget V) X.presheaf).map
                (f ▷ (PresheafOfModules.free
                  (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj
                    (yoneda.obj U))))
          exact htV.isLocallySurjective
        exact imageSieve_mem_of_over X ft y
      · letI : Subsingleton
            (ToType (((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
              (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj
                (N ⊗ Q)).obj (Opposite.op V))) := by
          change Subsingleton ((N ⊗ Q).obj (Opposite.op V))
          dsimp [Q]
          exact tensorFreeYoneda_subsingleton_at_of_not_nonempty X hVU N
        have hy : y = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
        subst y
        have hs : Presheaf.imageSieve ft
            (0 : ToType (((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
              (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj
                (N ⊗ Q)).obj (Opposite.op V))) = ⊤ := by
          rw [← show ft.app (Opposite.op V) 0 = 0 by
              exact (ft.app (Opposite.op V)).hom.map_zero,
            Presheaf.imageSieve_app]
        rw [hs]
        exact (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).top_mem _⟩
  exact (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).W_of_isLocallyBijective ft

name: SchemeKTheory.moduleLocalEquivalences_whiskerRight_unit
statement:
theorem moduleLocalEquivalences_whiskerRight_unit
    {M N : PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)} (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hf : moduleLocalEquivalences X f) :
    moduleLocalEquivalences X
      (f ▷ (𝟙_ (PresheafOfModules.{u}
        (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))))
proof:
:= by
  exact ((moduleLocalEquivalences X).arrow_mk_iso_iff
    (Arrow.isoMk (MonoidalCategory.rightUnitor M)
      (MonoidalCategory.rightUnitor N)
      (MonoidalCategory.rightUnitor_naturality f).symm)).2 hf

name: SchemeKTheory.moduleLocalEquivalences_whiskerLeft_unit
statement:
theorem moduleLocalEquivalences_whiskerLeft_unit
    {M N : PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)} (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hf : moduleLocalEquivalences X f) :
    moduleLocalEquivalences X
      ((𝟙_ (PresheafOfModules.{u}
        (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))) ◁ f)
proof:
:= by
  exact ((moduleLocalEquivalences X).arrow_mk_iso_iff
    (Arrow.isoMk (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor M)
      (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor N)
      (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor_naturality f).symm)).2 hf

name: SchemeKTheory.moduleLocalEquivalences_whiskerRight_coproduct
statement:
theorem moduleLocalEquivalences_whiskerRight_coproduct (I : Type u)
    (F : I → PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))
    {M N : PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)} (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hF : ∀ i, moduleLocalEquivalences X (f ▷ F i)) :
    moduleLocalEquivalences X (f ▷ ∐ F)
proof:
:= by
  let c : Cofan F := Cofan.mk (∐ F) (Limits.Sigma.ι F)
  have hc : IsColimit c := coproductIsCoproduct F
  let α : Discrete.functor F ⋙ tensorLeft M ⟶
      Discrete.functor F ⋙ tensorLeft N :=
    Discrete.natTrans (fun i ↦ f ▷ F i.as)
  apply (inferInstance :
      (moduleLocalEquivalences X).IsStableUnderColimitsOfShape (Discrete I)).condition
      (Discrete.functor F ⋙ tensorLeft M)
      (Discrete.functor F ⋙ tensorLeft N)
      ((tensorLeft M).mapCocone c) ((tensorLeft N).mapCocone c)
      (isColimitOfPreserves (tensorLeft M) hc)
      (isColimitOfPreserves (tensorLeft N) hc) α
  · intro i
    exact hF i.as
  · intro i
    dsimp [α, c]
    exact MonoidalCategory.whisker_exchange f (Limits.Sigma.ι F i.as)

name: SchemeKTheory.moduleLocalEquivalences_whiskerRight_free
statement:
theorem moduleLocalEquivalences_whiskerRight_free (I : Type u)
    {M N : PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)} (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hf : moduleLocalEquivalences X f) :
    moduleLocalEquivalences X (f ▷ modulePresheafFree X I)
proof:
:= by
  let U := fun (_ : I) ↦ 𝟙_ (PresheafOfModules.{u}
    (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))
  let c : Cofan U := Cofan.mk (∐ U) (Limits.Sigma.ι U)
  have hc : IsColimit c := coproductIsCoproduct U
  let α : Discrete.functor U ⋙ tensorLeft M ⟶
      Discrete.functor U ⋙ tensorLeft N :=
    Discrete.natTrans (fun i ↦ f ▷ U i.as)
  apply (inferInstance :
      (moduleLocalEquivalences X).IsStableUnderColimitsOfShape (Discrete I)).condition
      (Discrete.functor U ⋙ tensorLeft M)
      (Discrete.functor U ⋙ tensorLeft N)
      ((tensorLeft M).mapCocone c) ((tensorLeft N).mapCocone c)
      (isColimitOfPreserves (tensorLeft M) hc)
      (isColimitOfPreserves (tensorLeft N) hc) α
  · intro i
    exact moduleLocalEquivalences_whiskerRight_unit X f hf
  · intro i
    dsimp [α, c, U, modulePresheafFree]
    exact MonoidalCategory.whisker_exchange f
      (Limits.Sigma.ι (fun (_ : I) ↦ 𝟙_ (PresheafOfModules.{u}
        (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))) i.as)

name: SchemeKTheory.moduleLocalEquivalences_whiskerLeft_free
statement:
theorem moduleLocalEquivalences_whiskerLeft_free (I : Type u)
    {M N : PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)} (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hf : moduleLocalEquivalences X f) :
    moduleLocalEquivalences X (modulePresheafFree X I ◁ f)
proof:
:= by
  let U := fun (_ : I) ↦ 𝟙_ (PresheafOfModules.{u}
    (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))
  let c : Cofan U := Cofan.mk (∐ U) (Limits.Sigma.ι U)
  have hc : IsColimit c := coproductIsCoproduct U
  let α : Discrete.functor U ⋙ tensorRight M ⟶
      Discrete.functor U ⋙ tensorRight N :=
    Discrete.natTrans (fun i ↦ U i.as ◁ f)
  apply (inferInstance :
      (moduleLocalEquivalences X).IsStableUnderColimitsOfShape (Discrete I)).condition
      (Discrete.functor U ⋙ tensorRight M)
      (Discrete.functor U ⋙ tensorRight N)
      ((tensorRight M).mapCocone c) ((tensorRight N).mapCocone c)
      (isColimitOfPreserves (tensorRight M) hc)
      (isColimitOfPreserves (tensorRight N) hc) α
  · intro i
    exact moduleLocalEquivalences_whiskerLeft_unit X f hf
  · intro i
    dsimp [α, c, U, modulePresheafFree]
    exact (MonoidalCategory.whisker_exchange
      (Limits.Sigma.ι (fun (_ : I) ↦ 𝟙_ (PresheafOfModules.{u}
        (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))) i.as) f).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.moduleLocalEquivalences_whiskerRight_of_freeYoneda
statement:
theorem moduleLocalEquivalences_whiskerRight_of_freeYoneda
    {M N : PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)} (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hfree : ∀ U : TopologicalSpace.Opens X,
      moduleLocalEquivalences X
        (f ▷ (PresheafOfModules.free
          (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj (yoneda.obj U)))
    (P : PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)) :
    moduleLocalEquivalences X (f ▷ P)
proof:
:= by
  have hC (A : PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)) :
      moduleLocalEquivalences X (f ▷ A.freeYonedaCoproduct) := by
    apply moduleLocalEquivalences_whiskerRight_coproduct X A.Elements
      (PresheafOfModules.Elements.freeYoneda (M := A)) f
    intro m
    exact hfree m.1.unop
  let D := parallelPair P.toFreeYonedaCoproduct 0
  let c := P.freeYonedaCoproductsCokernelCofork
  have hc : IsColimit c := P.isColimitFreeYonedaCoproductsCokernelCofork
  let α : D ⋙ tensorLeft M ⟶ D ⋙ tensorLeft N :=
    Functor.whiskerLeft D ((tensoringLeft _).map f)
  apply (inferInstance :
      (moduleLocalEquivalences X).IsStableUnderColimitsOfShape WalkingParallelPair).condition
      (D ⋙ tensorLeft M) (D ⋙ tensorLeft N)
      ((tensorLeft M).mapCocone c) ((tensorLeft N).mapCocone c)
      (isColimitOfPreserves (tensorLeft M) hc)
      (isColimitOfPreserves (tensorLeft N) hc) α
  · intro j
    rcases j with (_ | _)
    · exact hC (kernel P.fromFreeYonedaCoproduct)
    · exact hC P
  · intro j
    dsimp [α]
    exact MonoidalCategory.whisker_exchange f (c.ι.app j)

name: SchemeKTheory.moduleLocalEquivalences_isMonoidal_of_whiskerRight_freeYoneda
statement:
theorem moduleLocalEquivalences_isMonoidal_of_whiskerRight_freeYoneda
    (h : ∀ {M N : PresheafOfModules.{u}
        (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)} (f : M ⟶ N),
      moduleLocalEquivalences X f →
      ∀ U : TopologicalSpace.Opens X,
        moduleLocalEquivalences X
          (f ▷ (PresheafOfModules.free
            (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj (yoneda.obj U))) :
    (moduleLocalEquivalences X).IsMonoidal
proof:
:=
  { toIsMultiplicative := inferInstance
    whiskerRight := fun {M N} f hf P ↦ by
      apply moduleLocalEquivalences_whiskerRight_of_freeYoneda X f (P := P)
      intro U
      exact h f hf U
    whiskerLeft := fun P {M N} f hf ↦ by
      apply ((moduleLocalEquivalences X).arrow_mk_iso_iff
        (Arrow.isoMk' (P ◁ f) (f ▷ P)
          (braiding P M) (braiding P N))).2
      apply moduleLocalEquivalences_whiskerRight_of_freeYoneda X f (P := P)
      intro U
      exact h f hf U }

name: SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf_isLocallyFree
statement:
theorem tensorSheaf_isLocallyFree
    (M N : X.Modules) [M.IsLocallyFree] [N.IsLocallyFree] :
    (tensorSheaf X M N).IsLocallyFree
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨qM, hqM⟩ := SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFree.exists_isLocallyFreeData (M := M)
  obtain ⟨qN, hqN⟩ := SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFree.exists_isLocallyFreeData (M := N)
  letI : qM.IsLocallyFreeData := hqM
  letI : qN.IsLocallyFreeData := hqN
  exact (tensorLocalGeneratorsData X qM qN).isLocallyFree

name: SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree

theorem tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (M N : X.Modules)
    (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree X M) (hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree X N) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree X (tensorSheaf X M N)
proof:
:= by

  obtain ⟨qN, hqN, hqNfin⟩ := hN.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  letI : qM.IsLocallyFreeData := hqM
  letI : qN.IsLocallyFreeData := hqN

name: SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf_tensorSheaf_assoc
statement:
theorem k0ClassOf_tensorSheaf_assoc
    [(moduleLocalEquivalences X).IsMonoidal] (M N P : X.Modules)
    (hL : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (tensorSheaf X (tensorSheaf X M N) P))

    k0ClassOf X (tensorSheaf X (tensorSheaf X M N) P) hL =
      k0ClassOf X (tensorSheaf X M (tensorSheaf X N P)) hR
proof:
:=
  k0ClassOf_iso X hL hR (tensorSheafAssociator X M N P)

name: ExactGrothendieck.classOf_middle
statement:
theorem classOf_middle (A B C : Object) (h : Exact A B C) :
    classOf Object Exact B = classOf Object Exact A + classOf Object Exact C
proof:
:= by
  change (QuotientAddGroup.mk' (relations Object Exact)) (Finsupp.single B 1) =
    (QuotientAddGroup.mk' (relations Object Exact)) (Finsupp.single A 1) +
      (QuotientAddGroup.mk' (relations Object Exact)) (Finsupp.single C 1)
  rw [← map_add]
  apply QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem.mpr
  apply AddSubgroup.subset_closure
  refine ⟨A, B, C, h, ?_⟩
  simp only [relation, sub_eq_add_neg]
  abel

name: ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
proof:
:= by
  apply QuotientAddGroup.addMonoidHom_ext (relations Object Exact)
  apply Finsupp.liftAddHom.symm.injective
  funext x
  apply AddMonoidHom.ext
  intro n
  change f ((QuotientAddGroup.mk' (relations Object Exact)) (Finsupp.single x n)) =
    g ((QuotientAddGroup.mk' (relations Object Exact)) (Finsupp.single x n))
  have hsingle : Finsupp.single x n = n • Finsupp.single x (1 : ℤ) :=
    (Finsupp.smul_single_one x n).symm
  simp only [hsingle, map_zsmul]
  exact congrArg (fun z => n • z) (h x)

name: ExactGrothendieck.freeLift_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem freeLift_single (f : Object → A) (x : Object) (n : ℤ) :
    freeLift f (Finsupp.single x n) = n • f x
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.liftAddHom_apply_single _ _ _

name: ExactGrothendieck.relations_le_ker
statement:
theorem relations_le_ker (f : Object → A)
    (hadd : ∀ A B C, Exact A B C → f B = f A + f C) :
    relations Object Exact ≤ (freeLift f).ker
proof:
:= by
  change AddSubgroup.closure (relationSet Object Exact) ≤ (freeLift f).ker
  rw [AddSubgroup.closure_le]
  rintro z ⟨A, B, C, h, rfl⟩
  change freeLift f (relation Object A B C) = 0
  simp only [relation, map_sub, freeLift_single, one_zsmul]
  rw [hadd A B C h]
  abel

name: ExactGrothendieck.lift_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_classOf (f : Object → A)
    (hadd : ∀ A B C, Exact A B C → f B = f A + f C) (x : Object) :
    lift f hadd (classOf Object Exact x) = f x
proof:
:= by
  change (QuotientAddGroup.lift (relations Object Exact) (freeLift f) _)
      ((QuotientAddGroup.mk' (relations Object Exact)) (Finsupp.single x 1)) = f x
  erw [QuotientAddGroup.lift_mk']
  rw [freeLift_single, one_zsmul]

name: ExactGrothendieck.map_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_classOf (F : Object → Object')
    (hF : ∀ A B C, Exact A B C → Exact' (F A) (F B) (F C)) (E : Object) :
    map F hF (classOf Object Exact E) = classOf Object' Exact' (F E)
proof:
:=
  lift_classOf _ _ _

name: ExactGrothendieck.map_id
statement:
theorem map_id :
    map (Object := Object) (Exact := Exact) (Object' := Object) (Exact' := Exact)
        (fun E => E) (fun _ _ _ h => h) =
      AddMonoidHom.id (Group Object Exact)
proof:
:= by
  apply hom_ext Object Exact
  intro E
  simp

name: ExactGrothendieck.map_comp
statement:
theorem map_comp (F : Object → Object')
    (hF : ∀ A B C, Exact A B C → Exact' (F A) (F B) (F C))
    (G : Object' → Object'')
    (hG : ∀ A B C, Exact' A B C → Exact'' (G A) (G B) (G C)) :
    (map G hG).comp (map F hF) =
      map (fun E => G (F E)) (fun A B C h => hG (F A) (F B) (F C) (hF A B C h))
proof:
:= by
  apply hom_ext Object Exact
  intro E
  simp

name: SchemeKTheory.k0Map_classOf
statement:

theorem k0Map_classOf (F : X.Modules ⥤ Y.Modules) [F.PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (hobj : ∀ E, IsFiniteLocallyFree X E → IsFiniteLocallyFree Y (F.obj E))
    (hF : ∀ (S : ShortComplex X.Modules), S.ShortExact → (S.map F).ShortExact)
    (E : X.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) :
    k0Map F hobj hF (k0ClassOf X E hE) = k0ClassOf Y (F.obj E) (hobj E hE)

:= by

name: SchemeKTheory.g0Map_classOf

theorem g0Map_classOf (F : X.Modules ⥤ Y.Modules) [F.PreservesZeroMorphisms]

    (E : X.Modules) (hE : IsCoherentLike X E) :
    g0Map F hobj hF (g0ClassOf X E hE) = g0ClassOf Y (F.obj E) (hobj E hE)

name: KSpecialization.Data.descend_restrict
statement:
@[simp]
theorem descend_restrict (m : GM) : D.descend (D.restrict m) = D.gysin0 m
proof:
:= by
  have h : (QuotientAddGroup.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective D.restrict D.restrict_surjective).symm
      (D.restrict m) = QuotientAddGroup.mk m := by
    rw [AddEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
    rfl

name: KSpecialization.Data.sigma_eq
statement:

proof:
:= by

name: KSpecialization.Hom.sigma_comm
statement:
theorem Hom.sigma_comm {GX GM GU G0 GX' GM' GU' G0' : Type*} [AddCommGroup GX] [AddCommGroup GM]
    [AddCommGroup GU] [AddCommGroup G0] [AddCommGroup GX'] [AddCommGroup GM']
    [AddCommGroup GU'] [AddCommGroup G0'] {D : Data GX GM GU G0} {D' : Data GX' GM' GU' G0'}
    (f : Hom D D') (x : GX) : D'.sigma (f.fX x) = f.f0 (D.sigma x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := D.restrict_surjective (D.pullGm x)
  rw [D.sigma_eq hm, D'.sigma_eq (m := f.fM m), f.gysin_comm]
  rw [f.restrict_comm, hm, f.pull_comm]

name: KSpecialization.fibre_restrictions_eq
statement:
theorem fibre_restrictions_eq {KZ KW : Type*} [CommRing KZ] [CommRing KW] (pr : KZ →+* KW)
    (h : KW) (hspan : ∀ w, ∃ a b, w = pr a + pr b * h) (r₀ r₁ : KW →+* KZ)
    (h₀ : ∀ a, r₀ (pr a) = a) (h₁ : ∀ a, r₁ (pr a) = a) (hh₀ : r₀ h = 1) (hh₁ : r₁ h = 1) :
    r₀ = r₁
proof:
:= by
  ext w
  obtain ⟨a, b, rfl⟩ := hspan w
  simp [h₀, h₁, hh₀, hh₁]

name: KSpecialization.adams_transport
statement:
theorem adams_transport
    {KM KX KP KU KW KZ : Type*} [AddCommGroup KM] [AddCommGroup KX] [AddCommGroup KP]
    [AddCommGroup KU] [CommRing KW] [CommRing KZ]
    (Fp : KW →+ KM) (ip : KZ →+ KX) (sp : KZ →+ KP) (πp : KP →+ KZ)
    (res : KM →+ KU) (j₀ : KM →+ KX) (jP : KM →+ KP) (r₀ r₁ : KW →+* KZ) (pr : KZ →+* KW)
    (ψM : KM →+ KM) (ψX : KX →+ KX) (ψP : KP →+ KP) (ψU : KU →+ KU)
    (ψW : KW →+ KW) (ψZ : KZ →+ KZ) (θW : KW) (θZ : KZ)
    (hsupp : ∀ m, res m = 0 → ∃ w, Fp w = m)
    (hresψ : ∀ m, res (ψM m) = ψU (res m)) (hresF : ∀ w, res (Fp w) = 0)
    (hbc₀ : ∀ w, j₀ (Fp w) = ip (r₀ w)) (hbcP : ∀ w, jP (Fp w) = sp (r₁ w))
    (hψ₀ : ∀ m, j₀ (ψM m) = ψX (j₀ m)) (hψP : ∀ m, jP (ψM m) = ψP (jP m))
    (hψr₀ : ∀ w, r₀ (ψW w) = ψZ (r₀ w)) (hψr₁ : ∀ w, r₁ (ψW w) = ψZ (r₁ w))
    (hθ₀ : r₀ θW = θZ) (hθ₁ : r₁ θW = θZ)
    (hpr₀ : ∀ a, r₀ (pr a) = a) (hpr₁ : ∀ a, r₁ (pr a) = a)
    (hkoszul : ∀ z, ψP (sp z) = sp (θZ * ψZ z))
    (hπs : ∀ z, πp (sp z) = z) (hrigid : r₀ = r₁) (x : KZ) :
    ψX (ip x) = ip (θZ * ψZ x)
proof:
:= by
  set y := pr x
  set e := ψM (Fp y) - Fp (θW * ψW y) with he
  have hres : res e = 0 := by
    rw [he, map_sub, hresψ, hresF, hresF, map_zero, sub_zero]
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hsupp e hres
  
  have hP : jP e = 0 := by
    rw [he, map_sub, hψP, hbcP, hbcP, hkoszul, map_mul r₁, hθ₁, hψr₁, hpr₁, sub_self]
  have hw₁ : r₁ w = 0 := by
    have : sp (r₁ w) = 0 := by rw [← hbcP, hw, hP]
    rw [← hπs (r₁ w), this, map_zero]
  
  have hX : j₀ e = ψX (ip x) - ip (θZ * ψZ x) := by
    rw [he, map_sub, hψ₀, hbc₀, hbc₀, map_mul r₀, hθ₀, hψr₀, hpr₀]
  have : j₀ e = 0 := by rw [← hw, hbc₀, hrigid, hw₁, map_zero]
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← hX, this]

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_localGeneratorsData
statement:
theorem pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_localGeneratorsData
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) {M N : Y.Modules}
    (qM : M.LocalGeneratorsData) (qN : N.LocalGeneratorsData)
    [qM.IsLocallyFreeData] [qN.IsLocallyFreeData] :
    IsIso (pullbackTensorSheafHom f M N)
proof:
:= by
  apply pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_localGenerators f qM qN
  intro p
  let W := qM.X p.1 ⊓ qN.X p.2
  let fM : W ⟶ qM.X p.1 := homOfLE inf_le_left
  let fN : W ⟶ qN.X p.2 := homOfLE inf_le_right
  let GM := overMapGeneratingSections Y fM (qM.generators p.1)
  let GN := overMapGeneratingSections Y fN (qN.generators p.2)
  letI : IsIso GM.π := by
    dsimp only [GM]
    infer_instance
  letI : IsIso GN.π := by
    dsimp only [GN]
    infer_instance
  let eM := pullbackIsoFreeOfGeneratingSections W GM
  let eN := pullbackIsoFreeOfGeneratingSections W GN
  haveI hlocal :
      IsIso
        (pullbackTensorSheafHom (f ∣_ W)
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Scheme.Opens.ι W)).obj M)
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Scheme.Opens.ι W)).obj N)) :=
    pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_iso_free
      (f ∣_ W) GM.I GN.I eM eN
  let U := f ⁻¹ᵁ W
  let c := pullbackTensorSheafHom f M N
  apply (over_isIso_iff_restrictFunctor_map_isIso U c).2
  apply (restrictFunctor_map_isIso_iff_pullback_map_isIso U.ι c).2
  let alpha := pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict f W
  haveI htensor :
      IsIso
        (tensorSheafMap U
          (alpha.hom.app M) (alpha.hom.app N)) := by
    change IsIso (tensorSheafMapIso U (alpha.app M) (alpha.app N)).hom
    infer_instance
  haveI hcomp :
      IsIso
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).map c ≫
          (openPullbackTensorIso U.ι
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M)
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj N)).hom) := by
    rw [← pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict_tensorSheaf f W M N]
    infer_instance
  exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).map c)
    (openPullbackTensorIso U.ι
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj N)).hom

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_isFiniteLocallyFree
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (M N : Y.Modules)
    (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y M) (hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y N) :
    IsIso (pullbackTensorSheafHom f M N)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨qM, hqM, _⟩ := hM.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  obtain ⟨qN, hqN, _⟩ := hN.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  letI : qM.IsLocallyFreeData := hqM
  letI : qN.IsLocallyFreeData := hqN
  exact pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_localGeneratorsData f qM qN

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineScalarExtension_isFinitePresentation
statement:
theorem affineScalarExtension_isFinitePresentation (phi : R →+* S)
    (E : (Spec (.of R)).Modules) [E.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ((affineScalarExtensionFunctor phi).obj E).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R)).obj E) :=
    moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation E
  letI := phi.toAlgebra
  have hcanonical : Module.FinitePresentation S
      (S ⊗[R] ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R)).obj E)) := by
    infer_instance
  let e : (S ⊗[R] ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R)).obj E)) ≃ₗ[S]
      ((ModuleCat.extendScalars phi).obj
        ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R)).obj E)) := LinearEquiv.refl S _
  change (((tilde.functor (.of S)).obj ((ModuleCat.extendScalars phi).obj
    ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R)).obj E))).IsFinitePresentation)
  exact @tilde_isFinitePresentation (.of S)
    ((ModuleCat.extendScalars phi).obj
      ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R)).obj E))
    (Module.FinitePresentation.of_equiv e)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.extendScalars_map_shortExact
statement:
theorem extendScalars_map_shortExact (phi : R →+* S) (hphi : phi.Flat)
    (T : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R)) (hT : T.ShortExact) :
    (T.map (ModuleCat.extendScalars phi)).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits (ModuleCat.extendScalars phi) :=
    ModuleCat.preservesFiniteLimits_extendScalars_of_flat hphi
  exact hT.map_of_exact (ModuleCat.extendScalars phi)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineScalarExtension_map_shortExact
statement:
theorem affineScalarExtension_map_shortExact (phi : R →+* S) (hphi : phi.Flat)
    (T : ShortComplex (Spec (.of R)).Modules)
    [T.X₁.IsQuasicoherent] [T.X₂.IsQuasicoherent] [T.X₃.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hT : T.ShortExact) :
    (T.map (affineScalarExtensionFunctor phi)).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  letI : (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R)).Additive :=
    affineGlobalSectionsFunctor_additive_pinned _
  letI : (tilde.functor (.of S)).Additive := tildeFunctor_additive_pinned _
  letI : (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R)).PreservesZeroMorphisms :=
    Functor.preservesZeroMorphisms_of_additive _
  have hGamma : (T.map (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R))).ShortExact :=
    (moduleSpecΓ_map_shortExact_iff T).mpr hT
  have hExtend := extendScalars_map_shortExact phi hphi
    (T.map (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R))) hGamma
  have hTilde := tilde_map_shortExact (R := .of S)
    ((T.map (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R))).map
      (ModuleCat.extendScalars phi)) hExtend
  simpa only [affineScalarExtensionFunctor, ShortComplex.map_comp] using hTilde

name: SchemeKTheory.affineScalarExtensionObject_exact
statement:
theorem affineScalarExtensionObject_exact (phi : R →+* S) (hphi : phi.Flat)
    (A B C : {E : (Spec (.of R)).Modules // IsCoherentLike (Spec (.of R)) E})
    (h : ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn (Spec (.of R)).Modules
      (IsCoherentLike (Spec (.of R))) A B C) :
    ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn (Spec (.of S)).Modules
      (IsCoherentLike (Spec (.of S))) (affineScalarExtensionObject phi A)
      (affineScalarExtensionObject phi B) (affineScalarExtensionObject phi C)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, zero, hshort⟩ := h
  let T : ShortComplex (Spec (.of R)).Modules := ShortComplex.mk a b zero
  let P := T.map (affineScalarExtensionFunctor phi)
  letI : A.1.IsFinitePresentation := A.2
  letI : B.1.IsFinitePresentation := B.2
  letI : C.1.IsFinitePresentation := C.2
  exact ⟨P.f, P.g, P.zero,
    affineScalarExtension_map_shortExact phi hphi T hshort⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.affineScalarExtensionG0_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem affineScalarExtensionG0_classOf (phi : R →+* S) (hphi : phi.Flat)
    (E : (Spec (.of R)).Modules) (hE : IsCoherentLike (Spec (.of R)) E) :
    affineScalarExtensionG0 phi hphi (g0ClassOf (Spec (.of R)) E hE) =
      g0ClassOf (Spec (.of S)) ((affineScalarExtensionFunctor phi).obj E)
        (by letI : E.IsFinitePresentation := hE
            exact affineScalarExtension_isFinitePresentation phi E)
proof:
:= by
  exact ExactGrothendieck.map_classOf (affineScalarExtensionObject phi)
    (affineScalarExtensionObject_exact phi hphi) ⟨E, hE⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.tensorRestrictBaseChangeLinearEquiv_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tensorRestrictBaseChangeLinearEquiv_tmul
    (phi : R →+* S) (psi : R →+* A)
    (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] (s : S) (m : M) :
    letI : Algebra R S
proof:
:= phi.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra R A := psi.toAlgebra
    letI : Module R M := Module.compHom M psi
    letI : Algebra A (S ⊗[R] A) := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
    tensorRestrictBaseChangeLinearEquiv phi psi M (s ⊗ₜ[R] m) =
      (s ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : A)) ⊗ₜ[A] m := by
  letI : Algebra R S := phi.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra R A := psi.toAlgebra
  letI : Module R M := Module.compHom M psi
  letI : IsScalarTower R A M := IsScalarTower.of_compHom R A M
  letI : Algebra A (S ⊗[R] A) := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let hsmul : IsTensorProduct (LinearMap.lsmul A M) :=
    IsTensorProduct.of_equiv (TensorProduct.lid A M) (by
      intro a m
      simp)
  let h₁ : ∀ (t : S) (x : S) (y : A),
      TensorProduct.mk R S A (t • x) y =
        t • TensorProduct.mk R S A x y := by
    intro t x y
    exact TensorProduct.smul_tmul' t x y
  let h₂ : ∀ (a : A) (x : S) (y : A),
      TensorProduct.mk R S A x (a • y) =
        a • TensorProduct.mk R S A x y := by
    intro a x y
    change x ⊗ₜ[R] (a * y) = (1 ⊗ₜ[R] a) * (x ⊗ₜ[R] y)
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul]
    simp
  change (IsTensorProduct.assocOfMapSMul
    (TensorProduct.mk R S A) (TensorProduct.isTensorProduct R S A)
    (LinearMap.lsmul A M) hsmul h₁ h₂).symm (s ⊗ₜ[R] m) = _
  simpa using (IsTensorProduct.assocOfMapSMul_symm_tmul
    (TensorProduct.mk R S A) (TensorProduct.isTensorProduct R S A)
    (LinearMap.lsmul A M) hsmul h₁ h₂ s (1 : A) m)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBaseChangeRightHom_flat
statement:
theorem affineBaseChangeRightHom_flat (phi : R →+* S) (psi : R →+* A)
    (hphi : phi.Flat) : (affineBaseChangeRightHom phi psi).Flat
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra R S := phi.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra R A := psi.toAlgebra
  let e : A ⊗[R] S ≃+* S ⊗[R] A :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm R A S).toRingEquiv
  have hbase : (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] S)).Flat :=
    RingHom.Flat.isStableUnderBaseChange.tensorProduct A hphi
  have he : e.toRingHom.Flat := RingHom.Flat.of_bijective e.bijective
  have hcomp : e.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] S)) =
      affineBaseChangeRightHom phi psi := by
    ext a
    simp [e, affineBaseChangeRightHom,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_def]
  rw [← hcomp]
  exact hbase.comp he

statement:
theorem affineBaseChangeLeftHom_finite (phi : R →+* S) (psi : R →+* A)
