proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra R S := phi.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra R A := psi.toAlgebra
  exact RingHom.finite_isStableUnderBaseChange.tensorProduct S hpsi

name: KSpecialization.MixedLCI.transport_of_vanishing
statement:
theorem transport_of_vanishing
    {KM KX KP KU KW KZ : Type*} [AddCommGroup KM] [AddCommGroup KX] [AddCommGroup KP]
    [AddCommGroup KU] [CommRing KW] [CommRing KZ]
    (Fp : KW →+ KM) (ip : KZ →+ KX) (sp : KZ →+ KP)
    (res : KM →+ KU) (j₀ : KM →+ KX) (jP : KM →+ KP) (r₀ r₁ : KW →+* KZ) (pr : KZ →+* KW)
    (ψM : KM →+ KM) (ψX : KX →+ KX) (ψP : KP →+ KP) (ψU : KU →+ KU)
    (ψW : KW →+ KW) (ψZ : KZ →+ KZ) (θZ : KZ)
    (hvan : ∀ m, res m = 0 → jP m = 0 → j₀ m = 0)
    (hresψ : ∀ m, res (ψM m) = ψU (res m)) (hresF : ∀ w, res (Fp w) = 0)
    (hbc₀ : ∀ w, j₀ (Fp w) = ip (r₀ w)) (hbcP : ∀ w, jP (Fp w) = sp (r₁ w))
    (hψ₀ : ∀ m, j₀ (ψM m) = ψX (j₀ m)) (hψP : ∀ m, jP (ψM m) = ψP (jP m))
    (hψr₀ : ∀ w, r₀ (ψW w) = ψZ (r₀ w)) (hψr₁ : ∀ w, r₁ (ψW w) = ψZ (r₁ w))
    (hpr₀ : ∀ a, r₀ (pr a) = a) (hpr₁ : ∀ a, r₁ (pr a) = a)
    (hkoszul : ∀ z, ψP (sp z) = sp (θZ * ψZ z)) (x : KZ) :
    ψX (ip x) = ip (θZ * ψZ x)
proof:
:= by
  set e := ψM (Fp (pr x)) - Fp (pr θZ * ψW (pr x)) with he
  have hres : res e = 0 := by
    rw [he, map_sub, hresψ, hresF, hresF, map_zero, sub_zero]
  have hP : jP e = 0 := by
    rw [he, map_sub, hψP, hbcP, hbcP, hkoszul, map_mul r₁, hψr₁]
    simp only [hpr₁, sub_self]
  have hX : j₀ e = ψX (ip x) - ip (θZ * ψZ x) := by
    rw [he, map_sub, hψ₀, hbc₀, hbc₀, map_mul r₀, hψr₀]
    simp only [hpr₀]
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← hX]
  exact hvan e hres hP

name: KSpecialization.MixedLCI.vanishing_of_mixed
statement:
theorem vanishing_of_mixed
    {KM KA KE KU : Type*} [AddCommGroup KM] [AddCommGroup KA] [AddCommGroup KE] [AddCommGroup KU]
    {GM GA GE GU GW GZ : Type*} [AddCommGroup GM] [AddCommGroup GA] [AddCommGroup GE]
    [AddCommGroup GU] [AddCommGroup GW] [AddCommGroup GZ]
    (res : KM →+ KU) (j₀ : KM →+ KA) (jP : KM →+ KE)
    (cM : KM →+ GM) (cA : KA →+ GA) (cE : KE →+ GE) (cU : KU →+ GU)
    (resG : GM →+ GU) (FG : GW →+ GM) (gys₀ : GM →+ GA) (gysP : GM →+ GE)
    (iG : GZ →+ GA) (sG : GZ →+ GE) (r₀G r₁G : GW →+ GZ)
    (hcres : ∀ m, resG (cM m) = cU (res m))
    (hsuppG : ∀ g, resG g = 0 → ∃ v, FG v = g)
    (hc₀ : ∀ m, gys₀ (cM m) = cA (j₀ m)) (hcP : ∀ m, gysP (cM m) = cE (jP m))
    (hbc₀G : ∀ v, gys₀ (FG v) = iG (r₀G v)) (hbcPG : ∀ v, gysP (FG v) = sG (r₁G v))
    (hsinj : Function.Injective sG) (hrigidG : ∀ v, r₀G v = r₁G v)
    (hcA : Function.Injective cA) :
    ∀ m, res m = 0 → jP m = 0 → j₀ m = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro m hres hP
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hsuppG (cM m) (by rw [hcres, hres, map_zero])
  have h₁ : r₁G v = 0 := hsinj (by rw [map_zero, ← hbcPG, hv, hcP, hP, map_zero])
  apply hcA
  rw [map_zero, ← hc₀, ← hv, hbc₀G, hrigidG, h₁, map_zero]

name: KSpecialization.MixedLCI.hbc₀_of_mixed
statement:
theorem hbc₀_of_mixed {KM KA KW KZ GA GZ : Type*} [AddCommGroup KA] [AddCommGroup GA]
    (Fp : KW → KM) (ip : KZ → KA) (j₀ : KM → KA) (r₀ : KW → KZ)
    (cA : KA →+ GA) (cZ : KZ → GZ) (iG : GZ → GA)
    (hmix : ∀ w, cA (j₀ (Fp w)) = iG (cZ (r₀ w))) (hcip : ∀ z, cA (ip z) = iG (cZ z))
    (hcA : Function.Injective cA) (w : KW) : j₀ (Fp w) = ip (r₀ w)
proof:
:=
  hcA (by rw [hmix, hcip])

name: KSpecialization.MixedLCI.adams_transport_mixed
statement:
theorem adams_transport_mixed
    {KM KX KP KU KW KZ : Type*} [AddCommGroup KM] [AddCommGroup KX] [AddCommGroup KP]
    [AddCommGroup KU] [CommRing KW] [CommRing KZ]
    {GM GX GP GU GW GZ : Type*} [AddCommGroup GM] [AddCommGroup GX] [AddCommGroup GP]
    [AddCommGroup GU] [AddCommGroup GW] [AddCommGroup GZ]
    (Fp : KW →+ KM) (ip : KZ →+ KX) (sp : KZ →+ KP)
    (res : KM →+ KU) (j₀ : KM →+ KX) (jP : KM →+ KP) (r₀ r₁ : KW →+* KZ) (pr : KZ →+* KW)
    (ψM : KM →+ KM) (ψX : KX →+ KX) (ψP : KP →+ KP) (ψU : KU →+ KU)
    (ψW : KW →+ KW) (ψZ : KZ →+ KZ) (θZ : KZ)
    (cM : KM →+ GM) (cX : KX →+ GX) (cP : KP →+ GP) (cU : KU →+ GU)
    (resG : GM →+ GU) (FG : GW →+ GM) (gys₀ : GM →+ GX) (gysP : GM →+ GP)
    (iG : GZ →+ GX) (sG : GZ →+ GP) (r₀G r₁G : GW →+ GZ)
    (hcres : ∀ m, resG (cM m) = cU (res m))
    (hsuppG : ∀ g, resG g = 0 → ∃ v, FG v = g)
    (hc₀ : ∀ m, gys₀ (cM m) = cX (j₀ m)) (hcP : ∀ m, gysP (cM m) = cP (jP m))
    (hbc₀G : ∀ v, gys₀ (FG v) = iG (r₀G v)) (hbcPG : ∀ v, gysP (FG v) = sG (r₁G v))
    (hsinj : Function.Injective sG) (hrigidG : ∀ v, r₀G v = r₁G v)
    (hcX : Function.Injective cX)
    (hresψ : ∀ m, res (ψM m) = ψU (res m)) (hresF : ∀ w, res (Fp w) = 0)
    (hbc₀ : ∀ w, j₀ (Fp w) = ip (r₀ w)) (hbcP : ∀ w, jP (Fp w) = sp (r₁ w))
    (hψ₀ : ∀ m, j₀ (ψM m) = ψX (j₀ m)) (hψP : ∀ m, jP (ψM m) = ψP (jP m))
    (hψr₀ : ∀ w, r₀ (ψW w) = ψZ (r₀ w)) (hψr₁ : ∀ w, r₁ (ψW w) = ψZ (r₁ w))
    (hpr₀ : ∀ a, r₀ (pr a) = a) (hpr₁ : ∀ a, r₁ (pr a) = a)
    (hkoszul : ∀ z, ψP (sp z) = sp (θZ * ψZ z)) (x : KZ) :
    ψX (ip x) = ip (θZ * ψZ x)
proof:
:=
  transport_of_vanishing Fp ip sp res j₀ jP r₀ r₁ pr ψM ψX ψP ψU ψW ψZ θZ
    (vanishing_of_mixed res j₀ jP cM cX cP cU resG FG gys₀ gysP iG sG r₀G r₁G hcres hsuppG hc₀ hcP
      hbc₀G hbcPG hsinj hrigidG hcX)
    hresψ hresF hbc₀ hbcP hψ₀ hψP hψr₀ hψr₁ hpr₀ hpr₁ hkoszul x

name: KSpecialization.MixedLCI.adams_transport_recovered
statement:
theorem adams_transport_recovered
    {KM KX KP KU KW KZ : Type*} [AddCommGroup KM] [AddCommGroup KX] [AddCommGroup KP]
    [AddCommGroup KU] [CommRing KW] [CommRing KZ]
    (Fp : KW →+ KM) (ip : KZ →+ KX) (sp : KZ →+ KP) (πp : KP →+ KZ)
    (res : KM →+ KU) (j₀ : KM →+ KX) (jP : KM →+ KP) (r₀ r₁ : KW →+* KZ) (pr : KZ →+* KW)
    (ψM : KM →+ KM) (ψX : KX →+ KX) (ψP : KP →+ KP) (ψU : KU →+ KU)
    (ψW : KW →+ KW) (ψZ : KZ →+ KZ) (θW : KW) (θZ : KZ)
    (hsupp : ∀ m, res m = 0 → ∃ w, Fp w = m)
    (hresψ : ∀ m, res (ψM m) = ψU (res m)) (hresF : ∀ w, res (Fp w) = 0)
    (hbc₀ : ∀ w, j₀ (Fp w) = ip (r₀ w)) (hbcP : ∀ w, jP (Fp w) = sp (r₁ w))
    (hψ₀ : ∀ m, j₀ (ψM m) = ψX (j₀ m)) (hψP : ∀ m, jP (ψM m) = ψP (jP m))
    (hψr₀ : ∀ w, r₀ (ψW w) = ψZ (r₀ w)) (hψr₁ : ∀ w, r₁ (ψW w) = ψZ (r₁ w))
    (_hθ₀ : r₀ θW = θZ) (_hθ₁ : r₁ θW = θZ)
    (hpr₀ : ∀ a, r₀ (pr a) = a) (hpr₁ : ∀ a, r₁ (pr a) = a)
    (hkoszul : ∀ z, ψP (sp z) = sp (θZ * ψZ z))
    (hπs : ∀ z, πp (sp z) = z) (hrigid : r₀ = r₁) (x : KZ) :
    ψX (ip x) = ip (θZ * ψZ x)
proof:
:=
  adams_transport_mixed Fp ip sp res j₀ jP r₀ r₁ pr ψM ψX ψP ψU ψW ψZ θZ
    (AddMonoidHom.id KM) (AddMonoidHom.id KX) (AddMonoidHom.id KP) (AddMonoidHom.id KU)
    res Fp j₀ jP ip sp r₀.toAddMonoidHom r₁.toAddMonoidHom
    (fun _ => rfl) hsupp (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) hbc₀ hbcP
    (Function.LeftInverse.injective hπs) (fun v => by rw [hrigid])
    Function.injective_id
    hresψ hresF hbc₀ hbcP hψ₀ hψP hψr₀ hψr₁ hpr₀ hpr₁ hkoszul x

name: KSpecialization.MixedLCI.exists_pow_mul_eq_zero_of_loc
statement:
theorem exists_pow_mul_eq_zero_of_loc {RM R : Type*} [CommRing RM] [CommRing R] (j : ℕ)
    (f : RM →+* R) (L : Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : RM) →+* Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : R))
    (hL : ∀ b, L (algebraMap _ _ b) = algebraMap _ _ (f b))
    {m : Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : RM)} {a s : RM}
    (hs : m * algebraMap _ _ s = algebraMap _ _ a) (hm : L m = 0) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, f (((j : ℕ) : RM) ^ k * a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : algebraMap R (Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : R)) (f a) = 0 := by
    rw [← hL, ← hs, map_mul, hm, zero_mul]
  obtain ⟨⟨_, k, rfl⟩, hk⟩ :=
    (IsLocalization.map_eq_zero_iff (Submonoid.powers ((j : ℕ) : R)) _ _).1 h0
  refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
  rw [map_mul, map_pow, map_natCast]
  exact hk

name: KSpecialization.MixedLCI.vanishing_loc
statement:
theorem vanishing_loc {RM RU RE RA : Type*} [CommRing RM] [CommRing RU] [CommRing RE] [CommRing RA]
    (j : ℕ) (res : RM →+* RU) (jP : RM →+* RE) (j₀ : RM →+* RA)
    (Lres : Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : RM) →+* Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : RU))
    (LjP : Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : RM) →+* Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : RE))
    (Lj₀ : Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : RM) →+* Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : RA))
    (hLres : ∀ a, Lres (algebraMap _ _ a) = algebraMap _ _ (res a))
    (hLjP : ∀ a, LjP (algebraMap _ _ a) = algebraMap _ _ (jP a))
    (hLj₀ : ∀ a, Lj₀ (algebraMap _ _ a) = algebraMap _ _ (j₀ a))
    (hvan : ∀ m, res m = 0 → jP m = 0 → j₀ m = 0)
    (m : Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : RM)) (h₁ : Lres m = 0) (h₂ : LjP m = 0) : Lj₀ m = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨a, s⟩, hs⟩ := IsLocalization.surj (Submonoid.powers ((j : ℕ) : RM)) m
  simp only at hs
  obtain ⟨k₁, hk₁⟩ := exists_pow_mul_eq_zero_of_loc j res Lres hLres hs h₁
  obtain ⟨k₂, hk₂⟩ := exists_pow_mul_eq_zero_of_loc j jP LjP hLjP hs h₂
  have hv : j₀ (((j : ℕ) : RM) ^ (k₁ + k₂) * a) = 0 := by
    apply hvan
    · rw [pow_add, mul_comm (((j : ℕ) : RM) ^ k₁), mul_assoc, map_mul, hk₁, mul_zero]
    · rw [pow_add, mul_assoc, map_mul, hk₂, mul_zero]
  have hA : Lj₀ (algebraMap _ _ a) = 0 := by
    rw [hLj₀]
    refine (IsLocalization.map_eq_zero_iff (Submonoid.powers ((j : ℕ) : RA)) _ _).2
      ⟨⟨_, k₁ + k₂, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [map_mul, map_pow, map_natCast] at hv
    exact hv
  have hu : IsUnit (Lj₀ (algebraMap _ _ (s : RM))) := by
    rw [hLj₀]
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := s.2
    rw [← hk, map_pow, map_natCast]
    exact IsLocalization.map_units (Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : RA))
      (⟨((j : ℕ) : RA) ^ k, k, rfl⟩ : Submonoid.powers ((j : ℕ) : RA))
  have hm : Lj₀ m * Lj₀ (algebraMap _ _ (s : RM)) = 0 := by
    rw [← map_mul, hs, hA]
  exact (hu.mul_left_eq_zero).1 hm

name: KSpecialization.MixedLCI.adams_transport_mixed_loc
statement:
theorem adams_transport_mixed_loc {M A E U W Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : ℕ)
    (FpK : K0 W →+ K0 M) (ipK : K0 Z →+ K0 A) (spK : K0 Z →+ K0 E)
    (resK : K0 M →+* K0 U) (j₀K : K0 M →+* K0 A) (jPK : K0 M →+* K0 E)
    (r₀K r₁K : K0 W →+* K0 Z) (prK : K0 Z →+* K0 W)
    (ψM : K0 M →+* K0 M) (ψA : K0 A →+* K0 A) (ψE : K0 E →+* K0 E) (ψU : K0 U →+* K0 U)
    (ψW : K0 W →+* K0 W) (ψZ : K0 Z →+* K0 Z) (θZ : KLoc j Z)
    (hvan : ∀ m : K0 M, resK m = 0 → jPK m = 0 → j₀K m = 0)
    (hresψ : resK.comp ψM = ψU.comp resK) (hresF : ∀ w, resK (FpK w) = 0)
    (hbc₀ : ∀ w, j₀K (FpK w) = ipK (r₀K w)) (hbcP : ∀ w, jPK (FpK w) = spK (r₁K w))
    (hψ₀ : j₀K.comp ψM = ψA.comp j₀K) (hψP : jPK.comp ψM = ψE.comp jPK)
    (hψr₀ : r₀K.comp ψW = ψZ.comp r₀K) (hψr₁ : r₁K.comp ψW = ψZ.comp r₁K)
    (hpr₀ : r₀K.comp prK = RingHom.id _) (hpr₁ : r₁K.comp prK = RingHom.id _)
    (hkoszul : ∀ z : K0 Z, algebraMap _ (KLoc j E) (ψE (spK z)) =
      locAddHom j spK (θZ * algebraMap _ (KLoc j Z) (ψZ z)))
    (x : KLoc j Z) :
    locMap (j := j) ψA (locAddHom j ipK x) = locAddHom j ipK (θZ * locMap (j := j) ψZ x)
proof:
:= by
  have hlocId : locMap (j := j) (RingHom.id (K0 Z)) = RingHom.id _ := by
    apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers ((j : ℕ) : K0 Z))
    ext b
    simp [locMap_algebraMap]
  have hpr : ∀ (rK : K0 W →+* K0 Z), rK.comp prK = RingHom.id _ →
      ∀ a : KLoc j Z, locMap (j := j) rK (locMap (j := j) prK a) = a := fun rK h a => by
    have := DFunLike.congr_fun (ARRASM.locMap_comp (j := j) prK rK) a
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply] at this
    rw [this, h, hlocId]; rfl
  have e1 : ∀ w : KLoc j W, locMap (j := j) resK (locAddHom j FpK w) = 0 := fun w =>
    ARRASM.ext_of_algebraMap (j := j)
      ((locMap (j := j) resK).toAddMonoidHom.comp (locAddHom j FpK)) 0
      (fun a => by simp [locAddHom_algebraMap, locMap_algebraMap, hresF]) w
  have e2 : ∀ w : KLoc j W, locMap (j := j) j₀K (locAddHom j FpK w) =
      locAddHom j ipK (locMap (j := j) r₀K w) := fun w =>
    ARRASM.ext_of_algebraMap (j := j)
      ((locMap (j := j) j₀K).toAddMonoidHom.comp (locAddHom j FpK))
      ((locAddHom j ipK).comp (locMap (j := j) r₀K).toAddMonoidHom)
      (fun a => by simp [locAddHom_algebraMap, locMap_algebraMap, hbc₀]) w
  have e3 : ∀ w : KLoc j W, locMap (j := j) jPK (locAddHom j FpK w) =
      locAddHom j spK (locMap (j := j) r₁K w) := fun w =>
    ARRASM.ext_of_algebraMap (j := j)
      ((locMap (j := j) jPK).toAddMonoidHom.comp (locAddHom j FpK))
      ((locAddHom j spK).comp (locMap (j := j) r₁K).toAddMonoidHom)
      (fun a => by simp [locAddHom_algebraMap, locMap_algebraMap, hbcP]) w
  have e4 : ∀ z : KLoc j Z, locMap (j := j) ψE (locAddHom j spK z) =
      locAddHom j spK (θZ * locMap (j := j) ψZ z) := fun z =>
    ARRASM.ext_of_algebraMap (j := j)
      ((locMap (j := j) ψE).toAddMonoidHom.comp (locAddHom j spK))
      ((locAddHom j spK).comp ((AddMonoidHom.mulLeft θZ).comp
        (locMap (j := j) ψZ).toAddMonoidHom))
      (fun a => by
        show locMap (j := j) ψE (locAddHom j spK (algebraMap _ _ a)) =
          locAddHom j spK (θZ * locMap (j := j) ψZ (algebraMap _ _ a))
        rw [locAddHom_algebraMap, locMap_algebraMap, locMap_algebraMap]
        exact hkoszul a) z
  have hvanL : ∀ m : KLoc j M, locMap (j := j) resK m = 0 → locMap (j := j) jPK m = 0 →
      locMap (j := j) j₀K m = 0 := fun m h₁ h₂ =>
    vanishing_loc j resK jPK j₀K (locMap (j := j) resK) (locMap (j := j) jPK)
      (locMap (j := j) j₀K) (fun a => locMap_algebraMap _ _) (fun a => locMap_algebraMap _ _)
      (fun a => locMap_algebraMap _ _) hvan m h₁ h₂
  exact transport_of_vanishing (KM := KLoc j M) (KX := KLoc j A) (KP := KLoc j E)
    (KU := KLoc j U) (KW := KLoc j W) (KZ := KLoc j Z)
    (locAddHom j FpK) (locAddHom j ipK) (locAddHom j spK)
    (locMap (j := j) resK).toAddMonoidHom (locMap (j := j) j₀K).toAddMonoidHom
    (locMap (j := j) jPK).toAddMonoidHom (locMap (j := j) r₀K) (locMap (j := j) r₁K)
    (locMap (j := j) prK)
    (locMap (j := j) ψM).toAddMonoidHom (locMap (j := j) ψA).toAddMonoidHom
    (locMap (j := j) ψE).toAddMonoidHom (locMap (j := j) ψU).toAddMonoidHom
    (locMap (j := j) ψW).toAddMonoidHom (locMap (j := j) ψZ).toAddMonoidHom θZ
    hvanL
    (fun m => ARRASM.locMap_comm (j := j) ψM resK resK ψU hresψ m) e1 e2 e3
    (fun m => ARRASM.locMap_comm (j := j) ψM j₀K j₀K ψA hψ₀ m)
    (fun m => ARRASM.locMap_comm (j := j) ψM jPK jPK ψE hψP m)
    (fun w => ARRASM.locMap_comm (j := j) ψW r₀K r₀K ψZ hψr₀ w)
    (fun w => ARRASM.locMap_comm (j := j) ψW r₁K r₁K ψZ hψr₁ w)
    (hpr r₀K hpr₀) (hpr r₁K hpr₁) e4 x

name: KSpecialization.MixedLCI.adams_transport_mixed_loc_of_G
statement:
theorem adams_transport_mixed_loc_of_G {M A E U W Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : ℕ)
    {GM GA GE GU GW GZ : Type*} [AddCommGroup GM] [AddCommGroup GA] [AddCommGroup GE]
    [AddCommGroup GU] [AddCommGroup GW] [AddCommGroup GZ]
    (FpK : K0 W →+ K0 M) (ipK : K0 Z →+ K0 A) (spK : K0 Z →+ K0 E)
    (resK : K0 M →+* K0 U) (j₀K : K0 M →+* K0 A) (jPK : K0 M →+* K0 E)
    (r₀K r₁K : K0 W →+* K0 Z) (prK : K0 Z →+* K0 W)
    (ψM : K0 M →+* K0 M) (ψA : K0 A →+* K0 A) (ψE : K0 E →+* K0 E) (ψU : K0 U →+* K0 U)
    (ψW : K0 W →+* K0 W) (ψZ : K0 Z →+* K0 Z) (θZ : KLoc j Z)
    (cM : K0 M →+ GM) (cA : K0 A →+ GA) (cE : K0 E →+ GE) (cU : K0 U →+ GU)
    (resG : GM →+ GU) (FG : GW →+ GM) (gys₀ : GM →+ GA) (gysP : GM →+ GE)
    (iG : GZ →+ GA) (sG : GZ →+ GE) (r₀G r₁G : GW →+ GZ)
    (hcres : ∀ m, resG (cM m) = cU (resK m))
    (hsuppG : ∀ g, resG g = 0 → ∃ v, FG v = g)
    (hc₀ : ∀ m, gys₀ (cM m) = cA (j₀K m)) (hcP : ∀ m, gysP (cM m) = cE (jPK m))
    (hbc₀G : ∀ v, gys₀ (FG v) = iG (r₀G v)) (hbcPG : ∀ v, gysP (FG v) = sG (r₁G v))
    (hsinj : Function.Injective sG) (hrigidG : ∀ v, r₀G v = r₁G v)
    (hcA : Function.Injective cA)
    (hresψ : resK.comp ψM = ψU.comp resK) (hresF : ∀ w, resK (FpK w) = 0)
    (hbc₀ : ∀ w, j₀K (FpK w) = ipK (r₀K w)) (hbcP : ∀ w, jPK (FpK w) = spK (r₁K w))
    (hψ₀ : j₀K.comp ψM = ψA.comp j₀K) (hψP : jPK.comp ψM = ψE.comp jPK)
    (hψr₀ : r₀K.comp ψW = ψZ.comp r₀K) (hψr₁ : r₁K.comp ψW = ψZ.comp r₁K)
    (hpr₀ : r₀K.comp prK = RingHom.id _) (hpr₁ : r₁K.comp prK = RingHom.id _)
    (hkoszul : ∀ z : K0 Z, algebraMap _ (KLoc j E) (ψE (spK z)) =
      locAddHom j spK (θZ * algebraMap _ (KLoc j Z) (ψZ z)))
    (x : KLoc j Z) :
    locMap (j := j) ψA (locAddHom j ipK x) = locAddHom j ipK (θZ * locMap (j := j) ψZ x)
proof:
:=
  adams_transport_mixed_loc j FpK ipK spK resK j₀K jPK r₀K r₁K prK ψM ψA ψE ψU ψW ψZ θZ
    (vanishing_of_mixed resK.toAddMonoidHom j₀K.toAddMonoidHom jPK.toAddMonoidHom cM cA cE cU
      resG FG gys₀ gysP iG sG r₀G r₁G hcres hsuppG hc₀ hcP hbc₀G hbcPG hsinj hrigidG hcA)
    hresψ hresF hbc₀ hbcP hψ₀ hψP hψr₀ hψr₁ hpr₀ hpr₁ hkoszul x

name: GLocalisation.gcl_mem_torsionClasses
statement:
theorem gcl_mem_torsionClasses (T : Type u) [AddCommGroup T] [Module R T] [Module.Finite R T]
    (h : ∀ x : T, ∃ t ∈ S, t • x = 0) : gcl R T ∈ torsionClasses S
proof:
:=
  AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨T, _, _, _, h, rfl⟩

name: GLocalisation.latticeClass_mono
statement:
theorem latticeClass_mono {L₁ L₂ : Submodule R N} (h : L₁ ≤ L₂) (h₁ : IsLattice S L₁)
    (h₂ : L₂.FG) : latticeClass S L₁ h₁.1 = latticeClass S L₂ h₂
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Module.Finite R L₁ := Module.Finite.iff_fg.mpr h₁.1
  haveI : Module.Finite R L₂ := Module.Finite.iff_fg.mpr h₂
  let P : Submodule R L₂ := L₁.comap L₂.subtype
  have hses := gcl_ses (Submodule.inclusion h) P.mkQ (Submodule.inclusion_injective h)
    (by
      rw [LinearMap.exact_iff, Submodule.ker_mkQ, Submodule.range_inclusion])
    (Submodule.mkQ_surjective P)
  have htor : gcl R (L₂ ⧸ P) ∈ torsionClasses S := by
    apply gcl_mem_torsionClasses
    intro y
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mkQ_surjective P y
    obtain ⟨t, ht, htx⟩ := h₁.2 (x : N)
    refine ⟨t, ht, ?_⟩
    rw [← map_smul, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    exact htx
  unfold latticeClass
  rw [hses, QuotientAddGroup.mk_add, (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff _).mpr htor]
  exact (add_zero (_ : G0 R ⧸ torsionClasses S)).symm

name: GLocalisation.latticeClass_eq
statement:
theorem latticeClass_eq {L₁ L₂ : Submodule R N} (h₁ : IsLattice S L₁) (h₂ : IsLattice S L₂) :
    latticeClass S L₁ h₁.1 = latticeClass S L₂ h₂.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [latticeClass_mono S le_sup_left h₁ (h₁.1.sup h₂.1),
    latticeClass_mono S le_sup_right h₂ (h₁.1.sup h₂.1)]

name: GLocalisation.isLattice_comap
statement:
theorem isLattice_comap [IsNoetherianRing R] {N₁ N₂ : Type u} [AddCommGroup N₁] [Module R N₁]
    [AddCommGroup N₂] [Module R N₂] (f : N₁ →ₗ[R] N₂) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    {L : Submodule R N₂} (hL : IsLattice S L) : IsLattice S (L.comap f)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · haveI : IsNoetherian R L := isNoetherian_of_fg_of_noetherian L hL.1
    apply Submodule.fg_of_fg_map_injective f hf
    exact Submodule.FG.of_le_of_isNoetherian (Submodule.map_comap_le f L)
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨t, ht, htx⟩ := hL.2 (f x)
    exact ⟨t, ht, by simpa [Submodule.mem_comap] using htx⟩

name: GLocalisation.isLattice_map
statement:
theorem isLattice_map {N₂ N₃ : Type u} [AddCommGroup N₂] [Module R N₂]
    [AddCommGroup N₃] [Module R N₃] (g : N₂ →ₗ[R] N₃) (hg : Function.Surjective g)
    {L : Submodule R N₂} (hL : IsLattice S L) : IsLattice S (L.map g)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hL.1.map g, ?_⟩
  intro y
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hg y
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htx⟩ := hL.2 x
  exact ⟨t, ht, by rw [← map_smul]; exact Submodule.mem_map_of_mem htx⟩

name: GLocalisation.latticeClass_ses
statement:
theorem latticeClass_ses [IsNoetherianRing R] {N₁ N₂ N₃ : Type u} [AddCommGroup N₁]
    [Module R N₁] [AddCommGroup N₂] [Module R N₂] [AddCommGroup N₃] [Module R N₃]
    (f : N₁ →ₗ[R] N₂) (g : N₂ →ₗ[R] N₃) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (hex : Function.Exact f g) (hg : Function.Surjective g)
    {L : Submodule R N₂} (hL : IsLattice S L) :
    latticeClass S L hL.1 = latticeClass S (L.comap f) (isLattice_comap S f hf hL).1 +
      latticeClass S (L.map g) (isLattice_map S g hg hL).1
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := isLattice_comap S f hf hL
  have h₃ := isLattice_map S g hg hL
  haveI : Module.Finite R L := Module.Finite.iff_fg.mpr hL.1
  haveI : Module.Finite R (L.comap f) := Module.Finite.iff_fg.mpr h₁.1
  haveI : Module.Finite R (L.map g) := Module.Finite.iff_fg.mpr h₃.1
  let a : L.comap f →ₗ[R] L := f.restrict (fun x hx => hx)
  let b : L →ₗ[R] L.map g := g.restrict (fun x hx => Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hx)
  have ha : Function.Injective a := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply hf
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hxy
  have hb : Function.Surjective b := by
    rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hy
    exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩
  have hab : Function.Exact a b := by
    intro x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      have hx' : g x = 0 := congrArg Subtype.val hx
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (hex x).mp hx'
      refine ⟨⟨z, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · change f z ∈ L
        rw [hz]; exact x.2
      · apply Subtype.ext; exact hz
    · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact hex.apply_apply_eq_zero (z : N₁)
  have hses := gcl_ses a b ha hab hb
  unfold latticeClass
  rw [hses, QuotientAddGroup.mk_add]

name: GLocalisation.exists_lattice
statement: theorem exists_lattice [Module.Finite Rs N] : ∃ L : Submodule R N, IsLattice S L
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := (Module.Finite.fg_top : (⊤ : Submodule Rs N).FG)
  let L : Submodule R N := Submodule.span R (T : Set N)
  let P : Submodule Rs N :=
    { carrier := {x | ∃ t ∈ S, t • x ∈ L}
      add_mem' := by
        rintro x y ⟨t₁, h₁, hx⟩ ⟨t₂, h₂, hy⟩
        refine ⟨t₁ * t₂, S.mul_mem h₁ h₂, ?_⟩
        rw [smul_add]
        apply L.add_mem
        · rw [mul_comm, mul_smul]; exact L.smul_mem _ hx
        · rw [mul_smul]; exact L.smul_mem _ hy
      zero_mem' := ⟨1, S.one_mem, by simp⟩
      smul_mem' := by
        rintro a x ⟨t, ht, hx⟩
        obtain ⟨⟨r, u⟩, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.mk'_surjective S a
        refine ⟨u * t, S.mul_mem u.2 ht, ?_⟩
        have hu : (u : R) • (IsLocalization.mk' Rs r u • x) = r • x := by
          rw [← smul_assoc, Algebra.smul_def, IsLocalization.mk'_spec', algebraMap_smul]
        rw [mul_comm, mul_smul, hu]
        rw [smul_comm]
        exact L.smul_mem _ hx }
  refine ⟨L, Submodule.fg_span T.finite_toSet, ?_⟩
  intro x
  have hx : x ∈ P := by
    have : (⊤ : Submodule Rs N) ≤ P := by
      rw [← hT, Submodule.span_le]
      intro y hy
      exact ⟨1, S.one_mem, by simpa using Submodule.subset_span hy⟩
    exact this Submodule.mem_top
  exact hx

name: GLocalisation.res_smul
statement:
theorem res_smul (E : ModuleCat.{u} (Localization S)) (r : R) (x : Res S E) :
    r • x = (algebraMap R (Localization S) r • (show E from x) : E)
proof: := rfl

name: GLocalisation.res_isScalarTower
statement:
theorem res_isScalarTower (E : ModuleCat.{u} (Localization S)) :
    letI
proof:
:= resOrig S E
    IsScalarTower R (Localization S) (Res S E) := by
  letI := resOrig S E
  exact @IsScalarTower.mk R (Localization S) (Res S E) _ (resOrig S E).toSMul _
    (fun r a x => by rw [Algebra.smul_def]; exact mul_smul _ _ _)

name: GLocalisation.exists_lattice_obj
statement:
theorem exists_lattice_obj (E : ModuleCat.{u} (Localization S))
    [Module.Finite (Localization S) E] : ∃ L : Submodule R (Res S E), IsLattice S L
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module (Localization S) (Res S E) := resOrig S E
  haveI := res_isScalarTower S E
  haveI : Module.Finite (Localization S) (Res S E) := ‹Module.Finite (Localization S) E›
  exact exists_lattice S (Localization S)

name: GLocalisation.psiObj_eq
statement:
theorem psiObj_eq (E : {E : ModuleCat.{u} (Localization S) // IsFG (Localization S) E})
    (L : Submodule R (Res S E.1)) (hL : IsLattice S L) : psiObj S E = latticeClass S L hL.1
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Module.Finite (Localization S) E.1 := E.2
  exact latticeClass_eq S (exists_lattice_obj S E.1).choose_spec hL

name: GLocalisation.psi_classOf
statement:
theorem psi_classOf (E : ModuleCat.{u} (Localization S)) (hE : IsFG (Localization S) E) :
    psi S (ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf _ _ E hE) = psiObj S ⟨E, hE⟩
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.lift_classOf _ _ _

name: GLocalisation.isFG_localizedModule
statement:
theorem isFG_localizedModule (E : ModuleCat.{u} R) (hE : IsFG R E) :
    IsFG (Localization S) ((ModuleCat.localizedModuleFunctor S).obj E)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Module.Finite R E := hE
  change Module.Finite (Localization S) (E.localizedModule S)
  exact Module.Finite.of_isLocalizedModule S (Rₚ := Localization S)
    (E.localizedModuleMkLinearMap S)

name: GLocalisation.locG0_classOf
statement:
theorem locG0_classOf (E : ModuleCat.{u} R) (hE : IsFG R E) :
    locG0 S (ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf _ _ E hE) =
      ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf _ _ ((ModuleCat.localizedModuleFunctor S).obj E)
        (isFG_localizedModule S E hE)
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.mapOfShortExactFunctorOn_classOf _ _ _ _ _ _ _

name: GLocalisation.psi_locG0_classOf
statement:
theorem psi_locG0_classOf (E : ModuleCat.{u} R) (hE : IsFG R E) :
    psi S (locG0 S (ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf _ _ E hE)) =
      QuotientAddGroup.mk (ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf _ _ E hE)
proof:
:= by
  rw [locG0_classOf, psi_classOf]
  haveI : Module.Finite R E := hE
  let f := E.localizedModuleMkLinearMap S
  let F := (ModuleCat.localizedModuleFunctor S).obj E
  let g : E →ₗ[R] Res S F :=
    { toFun := fun m => (f m : E.localizedModule S)
      map_add' := fun a b => f.map_add a b
      map_smul' := fun r m => by
        change f (r • m) = algebraMap R (Localization S) r • f m
        rw [map_smul, algebraMap_smul] }
  have hL : IsLattice S (LinearMap.range g) := by
    refine ⟨Module.Finite.iff_fg.mp inferInstance, ?_⟩
    intro x
    obtain ⟨⟨m, u⟩, hx⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.mk'_surjective S f (show E.localizedModule S from x)
    refine ⟨u, u.2, m, ?_⟩
    change f m = algebraMap R (Localization S) (u : R) • (show E.localizedModule S from x)
    rw [algebraMap_smul, ← hx]
    exact (IsLocalizedModule.mk'_cancel' f m u).symm
  rw [psiObj_eq S _ _ hL]
  unfold latticeClass
  have hex : Function.Exact (LinearMap.ker g).subtype g.rangeRestrict := by
    rw [LinearMap.exact_iff, LinearMap.ker_rangeRestrict, Submodule.range_subtype]
  have hses := gcl_ses (LinearMap.ker g).subtype g.rangeRestrict
    (Submodule.injective_subtype _) hex (LinearMap.surjective_rangeRestrict g)
  have htor : gcl R (LinearMap.ker g) ∈ torsionClasses S := by
    apply gcl_mem_torsionClasses
    rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    have hy' : f y = f 0 := by rw [map_zero]; exact hy
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.exists_of_eq (S := S) hy'
    refine ⟨c, c.2, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    simpa [Submonoid.smul_def] using hc
  change _ = QuotientAddGroup.mk (gcl R E)
  rw [hses, QuotientAddGroup.mk_add, (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff _).mpr htor]
  exact (zero_add (_ : G0 R ⧸ torsionClasses S)).symm

name: GLocalisation.psi_comp_locG0
statement:
theorem psi_comp_locG0 :
    (psi S).comp (locG0 S) = QuotientAddGroup.mk' (torsionClasses S)
proof:
:= by
  refine ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext {E : ModuleCat.{u} R // IsFG R E}
    (ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn _ (IsFG R)) (A := G0 R ⧸ torsionClasses S) ?_
  intro E
  exact psi_locG0_classOf S E.1 E.2

name: GLocalisation.torsionClasses_le_ker
statement: theorem torsionClasses_le_ker : torsionClasses S ≤ (locG0 S).ker
proof:
:= by
  rw [torsionClasses, AddSubgroup.closure_le]
  rintro _ ⟨T, _, _, _, hT, rfl⟩
  change locG0 S (ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf _ _ (ModuleCat.of R T) _) = 0
  rw [locG0_classOf]
  apply ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_isZero
  let f := (ModuleCat.of R T).localizedModuleMkLinearMap S
  haveI : IsLocalizedModule S f := ModuleCat.localizedModule_isLocalizedModule _ _
  haveI hsub : Subsingleton ((ModuleCat.of R T).localizedModule S) := by
    refine ⟨fun a b => ?_⟩
    have h0 : ∀ z : (ModuleCat.of R T).localizedModule S, z = 0 := by
      intro z
      obtain ⟨⟨m, u⟩, rfl⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.mk'_surjective S f z
      obtain ⟨t, ht, htm⟩ := hT m
      exact (IsLocalizedModule.mk'_eq_zero' f u).mpr ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, htm⟩
    rw [h0 a, h0 b]
  exact @ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _ _
    ((ModuleCat.localizedModuleFunctor S).obj (ModuleCat.of R T)) hsub

name: GLocalisation.ker_locG0
statement: theorem ker_locG0 : (locG0 S).ker = torsionClasses S
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun x hx => ?_) (torsionClasses_le_ker S)
  have h := congrArg (fun φ => φ x) (psi_comp_locG0 S)
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, QuotientAddGroup.mk'_apply] at h
  rw [(AddMonoidHom.mem_ker).mp hx, map_zero] at h
  exact (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff _).mp h.symm

name: GLocalisation.isLocalizedModule_lattice
statement:
theorem isLocalizedModule_lattice (E : ModuleCat.{u} (Localization S))
    (L : Submodule R (Res S E)) (hL : IsLattice S L) :
    letI
proof:
:= resOrig S E
    IsLocalizedModule S L.subtype := by
  letI := resOrig S E
  haveI := res_isScalarTower S E
  refine ⟨fun x => ?_, fun y => ?_, fun {a b} h => ?_⟩
  · have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap R (Localization S) x) :=
      IsLocalization.map_units (Localization S) x
    rw [Module.End.isUnit_iff]
    have hfun : ∀ y : Res S E, (algebraMap R (Module.End R (Res S E)) x) y =
        algebraMap R (Localization S) x • y := fun y => by
      rw [Module.algebraMap_end_apply, algebraMap_smul]
    constructor
    · intro a b h
      rw [hfun, hfun] at h
      exact hu.smul_left_cancel.mp h
    · intro b
      refine ⟨((hu.unit⁻¹ : (Localization S)ˣ) : Localization S) • b, ?_⟩
      rw [hfun, smul_smul, IsUnit.mul_val_inv, one_smul]
  · obtain ⟨t, ht, hty⟩ := hL.2 y
    exact ⟨(⟨t • y, hty⟩, ⟨t, ht⟩), rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨1, by simpa using Subtype.ext h⟩

name: GLocalisation.locG0_surjective
statement: theorem locG0_surjective : Function.Surjective (locG0 S)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ E : {E : ModuleCat.{u} (Localization S) // IsFG _ E},
      ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ E ∈ (locG0 S).range := by
    rintro ⟨E, hE⟩
    haveI : Module.Finite (Localization S) E := hE
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := exists_lattice_obj S E
    haveI : Module.Finite R L := Module.Finite.iff_fg.mpr hL.1
    letI : Module (Localization S) (Res S E) := resOrig S E
    haveI := res_isScalarTower S E
    haveI := isLocalizedModule_lattice S E L hL
    let M : ModuleCat.{u} R := ModuleCat.of R L
    have hM : IsFG R M := (inferInstance : Module.Finite R L)
    let fL := M.localizedModuleMkLinearMap S
    haveI : IsLocalizedModule S fL := ModuleCat.localizedModule_isLocalizedModule M S
    let e₀ := IsLocalizedModule.linearEquiv S fL L.subtype
    let e := e₀.extendScalarsOfIsLocalization S (Localization S)
    refine ⟨ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf _ _ M hM, ?_⟩
    rw [locG0_classOf]
    exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso _ _ _ _
      (Z := ModuleCat.of (Localization S) PUnit) (inferInstance : Module.Finite _ PUnit)
      (ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _)
      (e.toModuleIso : (ModuleCat.localizedModuleFunctor S).obj M ≅ E)
  intro y
  have h : QuotientAddGroup.mk' (locG0 S).range = 0 := by
    refine ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext {E : ModuleCat.{u} (Localization S) // IsFG _ E}
      (ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn _ (IsFG _)) (A := G0 (Localization S) ⧸ (locG0 S).range) ?_
    intro E
    rw [QuotientAddGroup.mk'_apply, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply]
    exact (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff _).mpr (key E)
  have hy := congrArg (fun φ => φ y) h
  simp only [QuotientAddGroup.mk'_apply, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply] at hy
  exact (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff y).mp hy

name: GLocalisation.isFG_restrictScalars_quotient
statement:
theorem isFG_restrictScalars_quotient (E : ModuleCat.{u} (R ⧸ I)) (hE : IsFG (R ⧸ I) E) :
    IsFG R ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).obj E)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Module.Finite (R ⧸ I) E := hE
  letI : Module R E := Module.compHom E (algebraMap R (R ⧸ I))
  haveI : IsScalarTower R (R ⧸ I) E := IsScalarTower.of_compHom R (R ⧸ I) E
  change Module.Finite R E
  exact Module.Finite.trans (R ⧸ I) E

name: GLocalisation.pushG0_classOf
statement:
theorem pushG0_classOf (E : ModuleCat.{u} (R ⧸ I)) (hE : IsFG (R ⧸ I) E) :
    pushG0 I (ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf _ _ E hE) =
      ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf _ _
        ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).obj E)
        (isFG_restrictScalars_quotient I E hE)
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.mapOfShortExactFunctorOn_classOf _ _ _ _ _ _ _

name: GLocalisation.gcl_mem_range_pushG0_of_smul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem gcl_mem_range_pushG0_of_smul_eq_zero (T : Type u) [AddCommGroup T] [Module R T]
    [Module (R ⧸ I) T] [IsScalarTower R (R ⧸ I) T] [Module.Finite R T] :
    gcl R T ∈ (pushG0 I).range
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Module.Finite (R ⧸ I) T := Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite R (R ⧸ I) T
  refine ⟨gcl (R ⧸ I) T, ?_⟩
  unfold gcl
  rw [pushG0_classOf]
  let e : ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).obj (ModuleCat.of (R ⧸ I) T)) ≃ₗ[R]
      T :=
    { toFun := fun x => x
      invFun := fun x => x
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun r x => by
        change (Ideal.Quotient.mk I r) • (show T from x) = r • (show T from x)
        rw [← Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq, algebraMap_smul]
      left_inv := fun _ => rfl
      right_inv := fun _ => rfl }
  exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso _ _ _ _
    (Z := ModuleCat.of R PUnit) (inferInstance : Module.Finite _ PUnit)
    (ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _)
    (e.toModuleIso : _ ≅ ModuleCat.of R T)

name: GLocalisation.gcl_eq_zero_of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem gcl_eq_zero_of_subsingleton (T : Type u) [AddCommGroup T] [Module R T]
    [Module.Finite R T] [Subsingleton T] : gcl R T = 0
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_isZero _ _ _ (ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _)

name: GLocalisation.gcl_mem_range_pushG0_of_pow
statement:
theorem gcl_mem_range_pushG0_of_pow [IsNoetherianRing R] (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ (T : Type u) [AddCommGroup T] [Module R T] [Module.Finite R T],
      (∀ a ∈ I ^ n, ∀ x : T, a • x = 0) → gcl R T ∈ (pushG0 I).range
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro T _ _ _ h
    haveI : Subsingleton T := ⟨fun x y => by
      rw [← one_smul R x, ← one_smul R y, h 1 (by simp) x, h 1 (by simp) y]⟩
    rw [gcl_eq_zero_of_subsingleton]
    exact zero_mem _
  | succ n ih =>
    intro T _ _ _ h
    let T' : Submodule R T := I • ⊤
    have h' : ∀ a ∈ I ^ n, ∀ x : T', a • x = 0 := by
      intro a ha x
      apply Subtype.ext
      change a • (x : T) = 0
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := x
      change x ∈ I • (⊤ : Submodule R T) at hx
      refine Submodule.smul_induction_on (p := fun x => a • x = 0) hx ?_ ?_
      · intro b hb y _
        change a • b • y = 0
        rw [smul_smul]
        exact h _ (by rw [pow_succ]; exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul ha hb) y
      · intro x y hx hy
        rw [smul_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
    have h1 := ih T' h'
    have h2 := gcl_mem_range_pushG0_of_smul_eq_zero I (T ⧸ T')
    have hses := gcl_ses T'.subtype T'.mkQ (Submodule.injective_subtype _)
      (by rw [LinearMap.exact_iff, Submodule.ker_mkQ, Submodule.range_subtype])
      (Submodule.mkQ_surjective _)
    rw [hses]
    exact add_mem h1 h2

name: GLocalisation.exists_pow_smul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_pow_smul_eq_zero (T : Type u) [AddCommGroup T] [Module R T] [Module.Finite R T]
    (h : ∀ x : T, ∃ t ∈ Submonoid.powers s, t • x = 0) : ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ x : T, s ^ n • x = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨T0, hT0⟩ := (Module.Finite.fg_top : (⊤ : Submodule R T).FG)
  have hk : ∀ g : T, ∃ k : ℕ, s ^ k • g = 0 := by
    intro g
    obtain ⟨t, ⟨k, rfl⟩, hg⟩ := h g
    exact ⟨k, hg⟩
  choose k hk using hk
  refine ⟨∑ g ∈ T0, k g, fun x => ?_⟩
  have hle : Submodule.span R (T0 : Set T) ≤
      LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.lsmul R T (s ^ ∑ g ∈ T0, k g)) := by
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    intro g hg
    change s ^ (∑ g ∈ T0, k g) • g = 0
    rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel (Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) hg), pow_add,
      mul_smul, hk g, smul_zero]
  have hx := hle (hT0 ▸ Submodule.mem_top : x ∈ Submodule.span R (T0 : Set T))
  exact hx

name: GLocalisation.torsionClasses_powers_eq
statement:
theorem torsionClasses_powers_eq [IsNoetherianRing R] :
    torsionClasses (Submonoid.powers s) = (pushG0 (Ideal.span {s})).range
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [torsionClasses, AddSubgroup.closure_le]
    rintro _ ⟨T, _, _, _, hT, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_pow_smul_eq_zero s T hT
    apply gcl_mem_range_pushG0_of_pow (Ideal.span {s}) n T
    intro a ha x
    rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at ha
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := ha
    rw [mul_smul, hn, smul_zero]
  · have h : (QuotientAddGroup.mk' (torsionClasses (Submonoid.powers s))).comp
        (pushG0 (Ideal.span {s})) = 0 := by
      refine ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext {E : ModuleCat.{u} (R ⧸ Ideal.span {s}) // IsFG _ E}
        (ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn _ (IsFG _))
        (A := G0 R ⧸ torsionClasses (Submonoid.powers s)) ?_
      rintro ⟨E, hE⟩
      rw [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply, QuotientAddGroup.mk'_apply,
        QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff]
      change pushG0 (Ideal.span {s}) (ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf _ _ E hE) ∈ _
      rw [pushG0_classOf]
      haveI : Module.Finite R ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk
        (Ideal.span {s}))).obj E) := isFG_restrictScalars_quotient _ E hE
      refine gcl_mem_torsionClasses (Submonoid.powers s)
        ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {s}))).obj E) ?_
      intro x
      refine ⟨s, Submonoid.mem_powers s, ?_⟩
      change (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {s}) s) • (show E from x) = 0
      rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self s), zero_smul]
    rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    have hy := congrArg (fun φ => φ y) h
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply, QuotientAddGroup.mk'_apply] at hy
    exact (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff _).mp hy

name: GLocalisation.ker_locG0_powers_eq_range_pushG0
statement:
theorem ker_locG0_powers_eq_range_pushG0 [IsNoetherianRing R] :
    (locG0 (Submonoid.powers s)).ker = (pushG0 (Ideal.span {s})).range
proof:
:= by
  rw [ker_locG0, torsionClasses_powers_eq]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineCartesianTensorIso_hom_left
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem affineCartesianTensorIso_hom_left
    (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    (h : IsPullback g' f' f g) :
    (affineCartesianTensorIso g' f' f g h).hom ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (affineBaseChangeLeftHom g.appTop.hom f.appTop.hom)) =
      f' ≫ S'.isoSpec.hom
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra Γ(S, ⊤) Γ(S', ⊤) := g.appTop.hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra Γ(S, ⊤) Γ(X, ⊤) := f.appTop.hom.toAlgebra
  let chartMap := pullback.map f g (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map g.appTop)
    X.isoSpec.hom S'.isoSpec.hom S.isoSpec.hom
      (X.isoSpec_hom_naturality f).symm
      (S'.isoSpec_hom_naturality g).symm
  letI : IsIso chartMap := inferInstance
  have hspec :
      (pullbackSpecIso Γ(S, ⊤) Γ(S', ⊤) Γ(X, ⊤)).hom ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (affineBaseChangeLeftHom g.appTop.hom f.appTop.hom)) =
        pullback.fst (Spec.map g.appTop) (Spec.map f.appTop) := by
    exact pullbackSpecIso_hom_fst _ _ _
  calc
    (affineCartesianTensorIso g' f' f g h).hom ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (affineBaseChangeLeftHom g.appTop.hom f.appTop.hom)) =
        h.isoPullback.hom ≫ chartMap ≫
          (pullbackSymmetry (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map g.appTop)).hom ≫
          (pullbackSpecIso Γ(S, ⊤) Γ(S', ⊤) Γ(X, ⊤)).hom ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (affineBaseChangeLeftHom g.appTop.hom f.appTop.hom)) := rfl
    _ = h.isoPullback.hom ≫ chartMap ≫
        (pullbackSymmetry (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map g.appTop)).hom ≫
        pullback.fst (Spec.map g.appTop) (Spec.map f.appTop) := by
          exact congrArg
            (fun k ↦ h.isoPullback.hom ≫ chartMap ≫
              (pullbackSymmetry (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map g.appTop)).hom ≫ k)
            hspec
    _ = h.isoPullback.hom ≫ chartMap ≫
        pullback.snd (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map g.appTop) := by
          simp only [pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_fst]
    _ = h.isoPullback.hom ≫ pullback.snd f g ≫ S'.isoSpec.hom := by
          simp only [chartMap, pullback.lift_snd]
    _ = f' ≫ S'.isoSpec.hom := by
          simp only [← Category.assoc, IsPullback.isoPullback_hom_snd]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.affineCartesianTensorIso_hom_right
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem affineCartesianTensorIso_hom_right
    (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    (h : IsPullback g' f' f g) :
    (affineCartesianTensorIso g' f' f g h).hom ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (affineBaseChangeRightHom g.appTop.hom f.appTop.hom)) =
      g' ≫ X.isoSpec.hom
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra Γ(S, ⊤) Γ(S', ⊤) := g.appTop.hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra Γ(S, ⊤) Γ(X, ⊤) := f.appTop.hom.toAlgebra
  let chartMap := pullback.map f g (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map g.appTop)
    X.isoSpec.hom S'.isoSpec.hom S.isoSpec.hom
      (X.isoSpec_hom_naturality f).symm
      (S'.isoSpec_hom_naturality g).symm
  letI : IsIso chartMap := inferInstance
  have hspec :
      (pullbackSpecIso Γ(S, ⊤) Γ(S', ⊤) Γ(X, ⊤)).hom ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (affineBaseChangeRightHom g.appTop.hom f.appTop.hom)) =
        pullback.snd (Spec.map g.appTop) (Spec.map f.appTop) := by
    exact pullbackSpecIso_hom_snd _ _ _
  calc
    (affineCartesianTensorIso g' f' f g h).hom ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (affineBaseChangeRightHom g.appTop.hom f.appTop.hom)) =
        h.isoPullback.hom ≫ chartMap ≫
          (pullbackSymmetry (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map g.appTop)).hom ≫
          (pullbackSpecIso Γ(S, ⊤) Γ(S', ⊤) Γ(X, ⊤)).hom ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (affineBaseChangeRightHom g.appTop.hom f.appTop.hom)) := rfl
    _ = h.isoPullback.hom ≫ chartMap ≫
        (pullbackSymmetry (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map g.appTop)).hom ≫
        pullback.snd (Spec.map g.appTop) (Spec.map f.appTop) := by
          exact congrArg
            (fun k ↦ h.isoPullback.hom ≫ chartMap ≫
              (pullbackSymmetry (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map g.appTop)).hom ≫ k)
            hspec
    _ = h.isoPullback.hom ≫ chartMap ≫
        pullback.fst (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map g.appTop) := by
          simp only [pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_snd]
    _ = h.isoPullback.hom ≫ pullback.fst f g ≫ X.isoSpec.hom := by
          simp only [chartMap, pullback.lift_fst]
    _ = g' ≫ X.isoSpec.hom := by
          simp only [← Category.assoc, IsPullback.isoPullback_hom_fst]

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectionFormula.adjUnit_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem adjUnit_naturality (f : Y ⟶ X) {V V' : X.Modules} (a : V ⟶ V') :
    a ≫ adjUnit f V' =
      adjUnit f V ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map a)
proof:
:=
  (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.naturality a

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectionFormula.adjUnit_restrict
statement:
theorem adjUnit_restrict (f : Y ⟶ X) (W : X.Opens) (V : X.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback W.ι).map (adjUnit f V) ≫
      (pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso f W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj V)).hom =
    adjUnit (f ∣_ W) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback W.ι).obj V) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ W)).map
        ((pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict f W).hom.app V)
proof:
:= by
  have h := unit_mateEquiv (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f)
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (f ∣_ W))
    (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict f W).hom) V
  have hm : pullbackBaseChangeMate f W = (pullbackRestrictPushforwardNatIso f W).hom :=
    pullbackBaseChangeMate_eq_pullbackRestrictPushforwardNatIso_hom f W
  change _ ≫ (pullbackBaseChangeMate f W).app _ = _ at h
  rw [hm] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeKTheory.projectionMap_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem projectionMap_naturality (f : Y ⟶ X) {V V' : X.Modules} (a : V ⟶ V')
    (G : Y.Modules) :
    tensorSheafMap X a (𝟙 _) ≫ projectionMap f V' G =
      projectionMap f V G ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
          (tensorSheafMap Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map a) (𝟙 G))
proof:
:= by
  unfold projectionMap
  rw [Category.assoc, ← pushforwardTensorSheafHom_naturality, tensorSheafMap_comp_assoc,
    tensorSheafMap_comp_assoc, adjUnit_naturality]
  simp only [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.comp_id]

name: SchemeKTheory.projectionMap_restrict
statement:
theorem projectionMap_restrict (f : Y ⟶ X) (W : X.Opens) (V : X.Modules)
    (G : Y.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback W.ι).map (projectionMap f V G) ≫
        (pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso f W
          (tensorSheaf Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj V) G)).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ W)).map
          (openPullbackTensorIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj V) G).hom =
      (openPullbackTensorIso W.ι V ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj G)).hom ≫
        tensorSheafMap W (𝟙 _) (pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso f W G).hom ≫
        projectionMap (f ∣_ W) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback W.ι).obj V)
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj G) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ W)).map
          (tensorSheafMap (f ⁻¹ᵁ W)
            ((pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict f W).hom.app V) (𝟙 _))
proof:
:= by
  have hrest := pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso_pushforwardTensorSheafHom f W
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj V) G
  unfold projectionMap
  rw [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc, ← hrest,
    openPullbackTensorIso_hom_naturality_assoc, tensorSheafMap_comp_assoc,
    adjUnit_restrict]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← pushforwardTensorSheafHom_naturality, tensorSheafMap_comp_assoc,
    tensorSheafMap_comp_assoc]
  simp only [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.projectionMap_over_isIso
statement:
theorem projectionMap_over_isIso (f : Y ⟶ X) (W : X.Opens) (V : X.Modules)
    (G : Y.Modules)
    (h : IsIso (projectionMap (f ∣_ W) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback W.ι).obj V)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj G))) :
    IsIso ((projectionMap f V G).over W)
proof:
:= by
  apply (over_isIso_iff_restrictFunctor_map_isIso W _).2
  apply (restrictFunctor_map_isIso_iff_pullback_map_isIso W.ι _).2
  have hsq := projectionMap_restrict f W V G
  have i1 : IsIso (tensorSheafMap W (𝟙 ((Scheme.Modules.pullback W.ι).obj V))
      (pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso f W G).hom) := by
    change IsIso (tensorSheafMapIso W (Iso.refl _) (pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso f W G)).hom
    infer_instance
  have i2 : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ W)).map
      (tensorSheafMap (f ⁻¹ᵁ W)
        ((pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict f W).hom.app V)
        (𝟙 ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj G)))) := by
    change IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ W)).mapIso
      (tensorSheafMapIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ W) ((pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict f W).app V)
        (Iso.refl _))).hom
    infer_instance
  have : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback W.ι).map (projectionMap f V G) ≫
      (pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso f W
        (tensorSheaf Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj V) G)).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ W)).map
        (openPullbackTensorIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj V) G).hom) := by
    rw [hsq]
    exact @IsIso.comp_isIso _ _ _ _ _ _ _ inferInstance
      (@IsIso.comp_isIso _ _ _ _ _ _ _ i1 (@IsIso.comp_isIso _ _ _ _ _ _ _ h i2))
  exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right ((Scheme.Modules.pullback W.ι).map (projectionMap f V G))
    ((pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso f W
        (tensorSheaf Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj V) G)).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ W)).map
        (openPullbackTensorIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj V) G).hom)

name: SchemeKTheory.projectionMap_isIso_of_cover
statement:
theorem projectionMap_isIso_of_cover (f : Y ⟶ X) (V : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules)
    {I : Type*} (U : I → X.Opens) (hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop U)
    (h : ∀ i, IsIso (projectionMap (f ∣_ U i) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (U i).ι).obj V)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ U i).ι).obj G))) :
    IsIso (projectionMap f V G)
proof:
:=
  moduleHom_isIso_of_over_cover _ U hU fun i ↦ projectionMap_over_isIso f (U i) V G (h i)

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectionFormula.rightFunctor_map
statement:
theorem rightFunctor_map (X : Scheme.{u}) (N : X.Modules) {V W : X.Modules} (a : V ⟶ W) :
    (tensorSheafRightFunctor X N).map a = tensorSheafMap X a (𝟙 N)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [tensorSheafRightFunctor, tensorSheafMap, Functor.comp_map]
  exact congrArg (fun q ↦ (moduleSheafification X).map q)
    (MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_id _ _).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectionFormula.unit_compat
statement:
theorem unit_compat {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) (G : Y.Modules) :
    tensorSheafMap X (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit f.toRingCatSheafHom)
          (𝟙 ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj G)) ≫
        pushforwardTensorSheafHom f (tensorUnitSheaf Y) G ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map (tensorSheafLeftUnitor Y G).hom =
      (tensorSheafLeftUnitor X ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj G)).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply (moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).homEquiv _ _ |>.injective
  conv_lhs =>
    erw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left]
    erw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
    dsimp only [pushforwardTensorSheafHom]
    erw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  conv_rhs =>
    erw [moduleSheafification_homEquiv_tensorSheafLeftUnitor]
  have hY := moduleSheafification_homEquiv_tensorSheafLeftUnitor Y G
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit] at hY
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro U
  simp only [PresheafOfModules.comp_app]
  let F := ModuleCat.restrictScalars (f.app U.unop).hom
  let j := (TopologicalSpace.Opens.map f.base).op.obj U
  let u := (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit f.toRingCatSheafHom).val.app U
  have hu : u = Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε F := by
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro r
    change (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit f.toRingCatSheafHom).val.app U r =
      Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε F r
    rw [SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit_val_app_apply, ModuleCat.restrictScalars_η]
    rfl
  have hYj := congrArg (fun q ↦ q.app j) hY
  simp only [PresheafOfModules.comp_app] at hYj
  change
    (u ⊗ₘ 𝟙 _) ≫
          Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ F ((tensorUnitSheaf Y).val.obj j) (G.val.obj j) ≫
        F.map
          (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).unit.app
                (underlyingCommPresheaf Y (tensorUnitSheaf Y) ⊗
                  underlyingCommPresheaf Y G)).app j ≫
            ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).map (tensorSheafLeftUnitor Y G).hom).app j) =
      (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor
          (underlyingCommPresheaf X ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj G))).hom.app U
  rw [congrArg (fun q ↦ F.map q) hYj]
  rw [hu]
  change
    (Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε F ⊗ₘ 𝟙 _) ≫
          Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ F (𝟙_ _) (G.val.obj j) ≫
        F.map (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor (G.val.obj j)).hom =
      (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor (F.obj (G.val.obj j))).hom
  rw [MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_id, ← Functor.LaxMonoidal.left_unitality]

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectionFormula.isIso_app_biproduct
statement:
theorem isIso_app_biproduct {𝒞 𝒟 : Type*} [Category 𝒞] [Category 𝒟] [Preadditive 𝒞]
    [Preadditive 𝒟] {F G : 𝒞 ⥤ 𝒟} [F.Additive] [G.Additive] (α : F ⟶ G) {J : Type*} [Finite J]
    (Z : J → 𝒞) [HasBiproduct Z] (h : ∀ j, IsIso (α.app (Z j))) : IsIso (α.app (⨁ Z))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : Fintype J := Fintype.ofFinite J
  have htot : ∑ j, biproduct.π Z j ≫ biproduct.ι Z j = 𝟙 (⨁ Z) := by
    apply biproduct.hom_ext'
    intro j
    apply biproduct.hom_ext
    intro j'
    simp [Preadditive.comp_sum, Preadditive.sum_comp, biproduct.ι_π, comp_dite]
  refine ⟨∑ j, G.map (biproduct.π Z j) ≫ inv (α.app (Z j)) ≫ F.map (biproduct.ι Z j), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Preadditive.comp_sum]
    have : ∀ j, α.app (⨁ Z) ≫ G.map (biproduct.π Z j) ≫ inv (α.app (Z j)) ≫
        F.map (biproduct.ι Z j) = F.map (biproduct.π Z j ≫ biproduct.ι Z j) := by
      intro j
      rw [← NatTrans.naturality_assoc, IsIso.hom_inv_id_assoc, F.map_comp]
    simp only [this]
    rw [← F.map_sum, htot, F.map_id]
  · rw [Preadditive.sum_comp]
    have : ∀ j, (G.map (biproduct.π Z j) ≫ inv (α.app (Z j)) ≫ F.map (biproduct.ι Z j)) ≫
        α.app (⨁ Z) = G.map (biproduct.π Z j ≫ biproduct.ι Z j) := by
      intro j
      rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, NatTrans.naturality, IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc,
        G.map_comp]
    simp only [this]
    rw [← G.map_sum, htot, G.map_id]

name: SchemeKTheory.ProjectionFormula.isIso_app_of_iso
statement:
theorem isIso_app_of_iso {𝒞 𝒟 : Type*} [Category 𝒞] [Category 𝒟] {F G : 𝒞 ⥤ 𝒟}
    (α : F ⟶ G) {V W : 𝒞} (e : V ≅ W) [IsIso (α.app W)] : IsIso (α.app V)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIso (α.app V ≫ G.map e.hom) := by
    rw [← NatTrans.naturality]; infer_instance
  exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right _ (G.map e.hom)

name: SchemeKTheory.projectionMap_isIso_unit
statement:
theorem projectionMap_isIso_unit (f : Y ⟶ X) (G : Y.Modules) :
    IsIso (projectionMap f (tensorUnitSheaf X) G)
proof:
:= by
  let g := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
    (tensorSheafMap Y (pullbackObjUnitIso f).hom (𝟙 G) ≫ (tensorSheafLeftUnitor Y G).hom)
  have hη : adjUnit f (tensorUnitSheaf X) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map (pullbackObjUnitIso f).hom =
      SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit f.toRingCatSheafHom := by
    have hp := SheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction_homEquiv_pullbackObjUnitToUnit
      f.toRingCatSheafHom
    rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit] at hp
    exact hp
  have key : projectionMap f (tensorUnitSheaf X) G ≫ g =
      (tensorSheafLeftUnitor X ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj G)).hom := by
    unfold projectionMap
    simp only [g]
    rw [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc, ← pushforwardTensorSheafHom_naturality_assoc,
      tensorSheafMap_comp_assoc, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.comp_id, hη]
    exact unit_compat f G
  haveI : IsIso g := by
    haveI : IsIso (tensorSheafMap Y (pullbackObjUnitIso f).hom (𝟙 G)) := by
      change IsIso (tensorSheafMapIso Y (pullbackObjUnitIso f) (Iso.refl G)).hom
      infer_instance
    infer_instance
  haveI : IsIso (projectionMap f (tensorUnitSheaf X) G ≫ g) := by
    rw [key]; infer_instance
  exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right _ g

name: SchemeKTheory.projectionMap_isIso_of_iso_free
statement:
theorem projectionMap_isIso_of_iso_free (f : Y ⟶ X) (G : Y.Modules)
    {V : X.Modules} (I : Type u) [Finite I]
    (e : V ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I) :
    IsIso (projectionMap f V G)
proof:
:= by
  let α := projectionNatTrans f G
  let Z : I → X.Modules := fun _ ↦ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf
  haveI : HasCoproduct Z := inferInstanceAs (HasCoproduct (fun _ : I ↦
    SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf))
  haveI : HasBiproduct Z := HasBiproduct.of_hasCoproduct Z
  have hZ : ∀ i, IsIso (α.app (Z i)) := fun _ ↦ projectionMap_isIso_unit f G
  haveI : IsIso (α.app (⨁ Z)) := isIso_app_biproduct α Z hZ
  have e' : V ≅ ⨁ Z := e ≪≫ (biproduct.isoCoproduct Z).symm
  exact isIso_app_of_iso α e'

name: SchemeKTheory.projectionFormula
statement:
theorem projectionFormula (f : Y ⟶ X) (V : X.Modules) (hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree X V)
    (G : Y.Modules) : IsIso (projectionMap f V G)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin⟩ := hV.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := hqfin
  refine projectionMap_isIso_of_cover f V G q.X q.coversTop fun i ↦ ?_
  letI : (q.generators i).IsFiniteType :=
    SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType i
  exact projectionMap_isIso_of_iso_free (f ∣_ q.X i) _ (q.generators i).I
    (pullbackIsoFreeOfGeneratingSections (q.X i) (q.generators i))

name: SchemeKTheory.projectionFormulaIso_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem projectionFormulaIso_hom (f : Y ⟶ X) (V : X.Modules) (hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree X V)
    (G : Y.Modules) : (projectionFormulaIso f V hV G).hom = projectionMap f V G
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: ExactGrothendieck.categoryClassOf_middle
proof:
:=
  classOf_middle C (shortExactObjects C) A B D ⟨f, g, zero, h⟩

name: ExactGrothendieck.categoryClassOf_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem categoryClassOf_zero : categoryClassOf Acat (0 : Acat) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let S : ShortComplex Acat :=
    ShortComplex.mk (0 : (0 : Acat) ⟶ 0) (0 : (0 : Acat) ⟶ 0) zero_comp
  have hS : S.ShortExact :=
    { exact := (ShortComplex.exact_iff_mono S rfl).2
        (inferInstance : Mono (0 : (0 : Acat) ⟶ 0)) }
  have h := categoryClassOf_middle (C := Acat) S.zero hS
  change categoryClassOf Acat (0 : Acat) =
    categoryClassOf Acat (0 : Acat) + categoryClassOf Acat (0 : Acat) at h
  have h' := congrArg (fun z => z - categoryClassOf Acat (0 : Acat)) h
  symm
  simpa only [sub_self, add_sub_cancel_right] using h'

name: ExactGrothendieck.categoryClassOf_iso
statement:
theorem categoryClassOf_iso {A B : Acat} (e : A ≅ B) :
    categoryClassOf Acat A = categoryClassOf Acat B
proof:
:= by
  let S := ShortComplex.mk e.hom (0 : B ⟶ (0 : Acat)) comp_zero
  haveI : IsIso e.hom := by infer_instance
  have hS : S.ShortExact :=
    { exact := (ShortComplex.exact_iff_epi S rfl).2
        (inferInstance : Epi e.hom) }
  have h := categoryClassOf_middle (C := Acat) S.zero hS
  change categoryClassOf Acat B =
    categoryClassOf Acat A + categoryClassOf Acat (0 : Acat) at h
  simpa using h.symm

name: ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_middle
statement:
theorem subcategoryClassOf_middle {A B D : C} (hA : P A) (hB : P B) (hD : P D)
    {f : A ⟶ B} {g : B ⟶ D} (zero : f ≫ g = 0)
    (h : (ShortComplex.mk f g zero).ShortExact) :
    subcategoryClassOf C P B hB =
      subcategoryClassOf C P A hA + subcategoryClassOf C P D hD
proof:
:=
  classOf_middle {E : C // P E} (shortExactIn C P) ⟨A, hA⟩ ⟨B, hB⟩ ⟨D, hD⟩
    ⟨f, g, zero, h⟩

name: ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_isZero
statement:
theorem subcategoryClassOf_isZero {Z : Acat} (hZ : Q Z) (zeroZ : IsZero Z) :
    subcategoryClassOf Acat Q Z hZ = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI : Mono (0 : Z ⟶ Z) := zeroZ.mono _
  letI : Epi (0 : Z ⟶ Z) := zeroZ.epi _
  let S : ShortComplex Acat := ShortComplex.mk (0 : Z ⟶ Z) (0 : Z ⟶ Z) zero_comp
  have hS : S.ShortExact :=
    { exact := (ShortComplex.exact_iff_mono S rfl).2 inferInstance }
  have h := subcategoryClassOf_middle (C := Acat) Q hZ hZ hZ S.zero hS
  change subcategoryClassOf Acat Q Z hZ =
    subcategoryClassOf Acat Q Z hZ + subcategoryClassOf Acat Q Z hZ at h
  have h' := congrArg (fun z => z - subcategoryClassOf Acat Q Z hZ) h
  symm
  simpa only [sub_self, add_sub_cancel_right] using h'

name: ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso
statement:
theorem subcategoryClassOf_iso {A B Z : Acat} (hA : Q A) (hB : Q B)
    (hZ : Q Z) (zeroZ : IsZero Z) (e : A ≅ B) :
    subcategoryClassOf Acat Q A hA = subcategoryClassOf Acat Q B hB
proof:
:= by
  letI : Epi (0 : B ⟶ Z) := zeroZ.epi _
  haveI : IsIso e.hom := by infer_instance
  let S : ShortComplex Acat := ShortComplex.mk e.hom (0 : B ⟶ Z) comp_zero
  have hS : S.ShortExact :=
    { exact := (ShortComplex.exact_iff_epi S rfl).2 (inferInstance : Epi e.hom) }
  have h := subcategoryClassOf_middle (C := Acat) Q hA hB hZ S.zero hS
  change subcategoryClassOf Acat Q B hB =
    subcategoryClassOf Acat Q A hA + subcategoryClassOf Acat Q Z hZ at h
  rw [subcategoryClassOf_isZero Acat Q hZ zeroZ, add_zero] at h
  exact h.symm

name: ExactGrothendieck.mapOfShortExactFunctor_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapOfShortExactFunctor_classOf (F : C ⥤ D) [F.PreservesZeroMorphisms]

    (hF : ∀ (S : ShortComplex C), S.ShortExact → (S.map F).ShortExact)

    (hΦ : ∀ S : ShortComplex C, S.ShortExact → P S.X₁ → P S.X₂ → P S.X₃ →
      (S.map Φ).ShortExact) (E : C) (hE : P E) :

name: ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR8.PushCompat.ap_eq

name: ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR8.PushCompat.killed
statement:
theorem PushCompat.killed (c : PushCompat TC σC TD σD Φ) (hobj : ∀ E, PC E → PD (Φ.obj E))
    (E : C) (hE : Killed TC σC PC E) : Killed TD σD PD (Φ.obj E)
proof:
:=
  ⟨hobj E hE.1, c.ap_eq_zero hE.2⟩

name: ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR8.cartierGysin_comp_map
statement:
theorem cartierGysin_comp_map (c : PushCompat TC σC TD σD Φ) (hobj : ∀ E, PC E → PD (Φ.obj E))
    (hΦ : ∀ S : ShortComplex C, S.ShortExact → PC S.X₁ → PC S.X₂ → PC S.X₃ →
      (S.map Φ).ShortExact)
    (hker : ∀ E, PC E → IsIso (kernelComparison (ap TC σC E) Φ))
    (hcok : ∀ E, PC E → IsIso (cokernelComparison (ap TC σC E) Φ)) :
    (cartierGysin hcD hPD hTD).comp
        (mapOn Φ hobj hΦ) =
      (killedMap c hobj hΦ).comp (cartierGysin hcC hPC hTC)
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext _ _ fun E => ?_
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := E
  have hQ := killedClosed (T := TD) (σ := σD) hPD
  haveI := hker E hE
  haveI := hcok E hE
  have hΦE : PD (Φ.obj E) := hobj E hE
  change cartierGysin hcD hPD hTD (mapOn Φ hobj hΦ
      (subcategoryClassOf C PC E hE)) =
    killedMap c hobj hΦ (cartierGysin hcC hPC hTC (subcategoryClassOf C PC E hE))
  rw [mapOn_classOf, cartierGysin_classOf, cartierGysin_classOf, map_sub]
  have hc' : Killed TC σC PC (cokernel (ap TC σC E)) := killed_cokernel hcC hPC hTC hE
  have hk' : Killed TC σC PC (kernel (ap TC σC E)) := killed_kernel hcC hPC hTC hE
  have m1 : killedMap c hobj hΦ (subcategoryClassOf C (Killed TC σC PC) _ hc') =
      subcategoryClassOf D (Killed TD σD PD) (Φ.obj (cokernel (ap TC σC E)))
        (c.killed hobj _ hc') := mapOn_classOf _ _ _ _ _
  have m2 : killedMap c hobj hΦ (subcategoryClassOf C (Killed TC σC PC) _ hk') =
      subcategoryClassOf D (Killed TD σD PD) (Φ.obj (kernel (ap TC σC E)))
        (c.killed hobj _ hk') := mapOn_classOf _ _ _ _ _
  rw [m1, m2]
  rw [classOf_eq_of_iso hQ (cokernelIso c E) (killed_cokernel hcD hPD hTD hΦE)
      (c.killed hobj _ hc'),
    classOf_eq_of_iso hQ (kernelIso c E) (killed_kernel hcD hPD hTD hΦE) (c.killed hobj _ hk')]

name: ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR8.isIso_map_cokernel_π_of_map_eq_zero
statement:
theorem isIso_map_cokernel_π_of_map_eq_zero (G : C ⥤ D) [PreservesColimitsOfSize.{0, 0} G]
    {X Y : C} (f : X ⟶ Y) (h : G.map f = 0) : IsIso (G.map (cokernel.π f))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIso (cokernel.π (G.map f)) := cokernel.π_of_zero h
  rw [← π_comp_cokernelComparison f G]
  infer_instance

name: ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR8.map_ap_eq_zero_of_adj
statement:
theorem map_ap_eq_zero_of_adj {G : C ⥤ D} {H : D ⥤ C} (adj : G ⊣ H) [G.PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (E : C) (hH : ap TC σC (H.obj (G.obj E)) = 0) : G.map (ap TC σC E) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (TC.map (adj.unit.app E)) ≫ ap TC σC (H.obj (G.obj E)) =
      ap TC σC E ≫ adj.unit.app E := naturality' TC σC _
  have hu := adj.unit.naturality (ap TC σC E)
  have h0 : adj.homEquiv _ _ (G.map (ap TC σC E)) = 0 := by
    rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
    refine hu.symm.trans ?_
    change ap TC σC E ≫ adj.unit.app E = 0
    rw [← hn, hH]
    exact comp_zero
  calc G.map (ap TC σC E)
      = (adj.homEquiv _ _).symm (adj.homEquiv _ _ (G.map (ap TC σC E))) := by simp
    _ = (adj.homEquiv _ _).symm 0 := by rw [h0]
    _ = 0 := by simp [Adjunction.homEquiv_counit]

name: ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR8.pull_cartierGysin_classOf_of_mono
statement:
theorem pull_cartierGysin_classOf_of_mono {G : C ⥤ D} {H : D ⥤ C} (adj : G ⊣ H)
    [G.PreservesZeroMorphisms] [PreservesColimitsOfSize.{0, 0} G] {Q : D → Prop}
    (hQ0 : Q 0) (pull : SubcategoryGroup C (Killed TC σC PC) →+ SubcategoryGroup D Q)
    (hpull : ∀ K (hK : Killed TC σC PC K), ∃ h : Q (G.obj K),
      pull (subcategoryClassOf C _ K hK) = subcategoryClassOf D Q (G.obj K) h)
    (E : C) (hE : PC E) [Mono (ap TC σC E)] (hH : ap TC σC (H.obj (G.obj E)) = 0)
    (hGE : Q (G.obj E)) :
    pull (cartierGysin hcC hPC hTC (subcategoryClassOf C PC E hE)) =
      subcategoryClassOf D Q (G.obj E) hGE
proof:
:= by
  rw [cartierGysin_classOf_of_mono]
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := hpull _ (killed_cokernel hcC hPC hTC hE)
  rw [hh]
  haveI := isIso_map_cokernel_π_of_map_eq_zero G _ (map_ap_eq_zero_of_adj adj E hH)
  exact subcategoryClassOf_iso D Q h hGE hQ0 (isZero_zero D)
    (asIso (G.map (cokernel.π (ap TC σC E)))).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor_map_exact
statement:
theorem Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor_map_exact {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion f] (T : ShortComplex Y.Modules) (hT : T.Exact) :
    (T.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f)).Exact
proof:
:= by
  apply Functor.reflects_exact_of_faithful
    (Scheme.Modules.toAddCommGrpSheaf X)
  rw [TopCat.Sheaf.exact_iff_stalkFunctor_map_exact]
  intro x
  change (T.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f ⋙
    Scheme.Modules.stalkFunctor X x)).Exact
  have hx : (T.map (Scheme.Modules.stalkFunctor Y (f x))).Exact :=
    hT.map (Scheme.Modules.stalkFunctor Y (f x))
  exact ShortComplex.exact_of_iso
    (T.mapNatIso (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso f x)).symm hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor_map_shortExact
statement:
theorem Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor_map_shortExact {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion f] (T : ShortComplex Y.Modules) (hT : T.ShortExact) :
    (T.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f)).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  letI : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).Additive := by
    constructor
    intro M N a b
    rfl
  exact (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).exact_tfae.out 1 0 rfl rfl).mp
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor_map_exact f)) T hT

name: AlgebraicGeometry.tilde.moduleGermLinear_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma tilde.moduleGermLinear_apply (M : ModuleCat.{u} R)
    (U : Opens (PrimeSpectrum.Top R)) (x : PrimeSpectrum.Top R) (hx : x ∈ U)
    (s : (ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory.obj
      (structureSheafInType R M)).obj (.op U)) :
    tilde.moduleGermLinear M U x hx s =
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ (moduleStructurePresheaf R M).presheaf U x hx s
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.tilde.modulePresheafStalkLinearEquiv_germ
statement:
lemma tilde.modulePresheafStalkLinearEquiv_germ (M : ModuleCat.{u} R)
    (U : Opens (PrimeSpectrum.Top R)) (x : PrimeSpectrum.Top R) (hx : x ∈ U)
    (s : (ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory.obj
      (structureSheafInType R M)).obj (.op U)) :
    tilde.modulePresheafStalkLinearEquiv M x
        (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (moduleStructurePresheaf R M).presheaf U x hx s) =
      (structurePresheafInModuleCat R M).germ U x hx s
proof:
:= by
  let α : TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (moduleStructurePresheaf R M).presheaf x ≅
      (forget₂ _ _).obj ((structurePresheafInModuleCat R M).stalk x) :=
    Limits.colimit.isoColimitCocone ⟨_,
      Limits.isColimitOfPreserves (forget₂ (ModuleCat R) Ab)
        (Limits.colimit.isColimit ((OpenNhds.inclusion x).op ⋙
          structurePresheafInModuleCat R M))⟩
  have hα : TopCat.Presheaf.germ (moduleStructurePresheaf R M).presheaf U x hx ≫ α.hom =
      (forget₂ _ _).map ((structurePresheafInModuleCat R M).germ U x hx) :=
    Limits.colimit.isoColimitCocone_ι_hom (C := Ab) ..
  exact congr($hα s)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.tilde.toOpen_top_germ
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma tilde.toOpen_top_germ (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (x : PrimeSpectrum.Top R) :
    tilde.toOpen M ⊤ ≫ (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj (tilde M)).presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial =
      tilde.toModulesSpecToSheafStalk M x
proof:
:= by
  rw [tilde.toModulesSpecToSheafStalk, tilde.toStructurePresheafStalk, tilde.toOpen,
    Category.assoc, Category.assoc]
  congr 1
  exact (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ ⊤ x trivial
    (tilde.modulesSpecToSheafIso M).inv).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.tildeStalkMap_eq_localizedMap
statement:
lemma tildeStalkMap_eq_localizedMap {M N : ModuleCat.{u} R} (f : M ⟶ N)
    (x : PrimeSpectrum.Top R) :
    ((TopCat.Sheaf.forget (ModuleCat.{u} R) (Spec R) ⋙
        TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) x).map
      (modulesSpecToSheaf.map (tilde.map f))).hom =
      IsLocalizedModule.map x.asIdeal.primeCompl
        (tilde.toModulesSpecToSheafStalk M x).hom
        (tilde.toModulesSpecToSheafStalk N x).hom f.hom
proof:
:= by
  have hmap :
      tilde.toModulesSpecToSheafStalk M x ≫
          (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) x).map
            (modulesSpecToSheaf.map (tilde.map f)).1 =
        f ≫ tilde.toModulesSpecToSheafStalk N x := by
    rw [← tilde.toOpen_top_germ, ← tilde.toOpen_top_germ]
    calc
      (tilde.toOpen M ⊤ ≫
            (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj (tilde M)).presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial) ≫
          (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) x).map
            (modulesSpecToSheaf.map (tilde.map f)).1 =
        tilde.toOpen M ⊤ ≫
          ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj (tilde M)).presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial ≫
            (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) x).map
              (modulesSpecToSheaf.map (tilde.map f)).1) := Category.assoc _ _ _
      _ = tilde.toOpen M ⊤ ≫
          ((modulesSpecToSheaf.map (tilde.map f)).1.app (.op ⊤) ≫
            (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj (tilde N)).presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial) := by
        exact congrArg (fun q ↦ tilde.toOpen M ⊤ ≫ q)
          (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ ⊤ x trivial
            (modulesSpecToSheaf.map (tilde.map f)).1)
      _ = (tilde.toOpen M ⊤ ≫
            (modulesSpecToSheaf.map (tilde.map f)).1.app (.op ⊤)) ≫
          (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj (tilde N)).presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial :=
        (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = (f ≫ tilde.toOpen N ⊤) ≫
          (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj (tilde N)).presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial := by
        rw [tilde.toOpen_map_app]
      _ = f ≫ (tilde.toOpen N ⊤ ≫
          (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj (tilde N)).presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial) :=
        Category.assoc _ _ _
  apply IsLocalizedModule.linearMap_ext x.asIdeal.primeCompl
    (tilde.toModulesSpecToSheafStalk M x).hom
    (tilde.toModulesSpecToSheafStalk N x).hom
  ext y
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, IsLocalizedModule.map_apply]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun (congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom hmap) y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.modulesSpecToSheaf_map_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma modulesSpecToSheaf_map_apply {M N : (Spec R).Modules} (f : M ⟶ N)
    (U : (Spec R).Opens)
    (s : (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj M).presheaf.obj (.op U)) :
    ((modulesSpecToSheaf.map f).1.app (.op U)).hom s = f.val.app (.op U) s
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.tildeAbStalkMap_eq_localizedMap
statement:
lemma tildeAbStalkMap_eq_localizedMap {M N : ModuleCat.{u} R} (f : M ⟶ N)
    (x : PrimeSpectrum.Top R) :
    tilde.abStalkMapLinear f x =
      IsLocalizedModule.map x.asIdeal.primeCompl
        (tilde.toStalk M x).hom (tilde.toStalk N x).hom f.hom
proof:
:= by
  apply IsLocalizedModule.linearMap_ext x.asIdeal.primeCompl
    (tilde.toStalk M x).hom (tilde.toStalk N x).hom
  ext y
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, IsLocalizedModule.map_apply]
  change (tilde.abStalkMapLinear f x) ((tilde.toStalk M x).hom y) =
    (tilde.toStalk N x).hom (f.hom y)
  change ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor Ab.{u} x).map
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf (Spec R).ringCatSheaf.obj).map (tilde.map f).val)).hom
        (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (moduleStructurePresheaf R M).presheaf ⊤ x trivial
          (StructureSheaf.toOpenₗ R M ⊤ y)) =
    TopCat.Presheaf.germ (moduleStructurePresheaf R N).presheaf ⊤ x trivial
      (StructureSheaf.toOpenₗ R N ⊤ (f.hom y))
  erw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply]
  have hopen :
      (((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf (Spec R).ringCatSheaf.obj).map
        (tilde.map f).val).app (.op ⊤)).hom (StructureSheaf.toOpenₗ R M ⊤ y) =
        StructureSheaf.toOpenₗ R N ⊤ (f.hom y) := by
    have h := congrArg (fun q ↦ q.hom y) (tilde.toOpen_map_app f ⊤)
    simp only [tilde.toOpen, tilde.modulesSpecToSheafIso,
      ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, modulesSpecToSheaf_map_apply] at h
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext z
    exact congrArg (fun q ↦ q.1 z) h
  exact congrArg (fun z ↦
    (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (moduleStructurePresheaf R N).presheaf ⊤ x trivial).hom z) hopen

name: AlgebraicGeometry.tilde_map_exact
statement:
theorem tilde_map_exact (T : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R)) (hT : T.Exact) :
    (T.map (tilde.functor R)).Exact
proof:
:= by
  apply Functor.reflects_exact_of_faithful
    (Scheme.Modules.toAddCommGrpSheaf (Spec R))
  rw [TopCat.Sheaf.exact_iff_stalkFunctor_map_exact]
  intro x
  rw [ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff_function_exact]
  change Function.Exact (tilde.abStalkMapLinear T.f x)
    (tilde.abStalkMapLinear T.g x)
  rw [tildeAbStalkMap_eq_localizedMap, tildeAbStalkMap_eq_localizedMap]
  apply IsLocalizedModule.map_exact
  exact (ShortComplex.ShortExact.moduleCat_exact_iff_function_exact T).mp hT
