name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduleSpecΓ_map_exact_iff
statement:
theorem moduleSpecΓ_map_exact_iff
    (T : ShortComplex (Spec R).Modules)
    [T.X₁.IsQuasicoherent] [T.X₂.IsQuasicoherent] [T.X₃.IsQuasicoherent] :
    (T.map (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor R)).Exact ↔ T.Exact
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ShortComplex.exact_of_iso (moduleSpecΓTildeIso T)
      (tilde_map_exact _ h)
  · intro h
    apply Functor.reflects_exact_of_faithful (tilde.functor R)
    exact ShortComplex.exact_of_iso (moduleSpecΓTildeIso T).symm h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduleSpecΓ_map_shortExact_iff
statement:
theorem moduleSpecΓ_map_shortExact_iff
    (T : ShortComplex (Spec R).Modules)
    [T.X₁.IsQuasicoherent] [T.X₂.IsQuasicoherent] [T.X₃.IsQuasicoherent] :
    (T.map (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor R)).ShortExact ↔ T.ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso (moduleSpecΓTildeIso T)
      (tilde_map_shortExact _ h)
  · intro h
    apply CategoryTheory.ShortExact.reflects_shortExact_of_faithful (tilde.functor R)
    exact ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso (moduleSpecΓTildeIso T).symm h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.pushforward_specMap_map_shortExact
statement:
theorem pushforward_specMap_map_shortExact (phi : R ⟶ S)
    (T : ShortComplex (Spec S).Modules)
    [T.X₁.IsQuasicoherent] [T.X₂.IsQuasicoherent] [T.X₃.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hT : T.ShortExact) :
    (T.map (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Spec.map phi))).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  let F := Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Spec.map phi)
  letI : (T.map F).X₁.IsQuasicoherent :=
    isQuasicoherent_pushforward_specMap phi T.X₁
  letI : (T.map F).X₂.IsQuasicoherent :=
    isQuasicoherent_pushforward_specMap phi T.X₂
  letI : (T.map F).X₃.IsQuasicoherent :=
    isQuasicoherent_pushforward_specMap phi T.X₃
  apply (moduleSpecΓ_map_shortExact_iff (T.map F)).mp
  have hΓ : (T.map (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor S)).ShortExact :=
    (moduleSpecΓ_map_shortExact_iff T).mpr hT
  have hres :
      ((T.map (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor S)).map
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars phi.hom)).ShortExact :=
    hΓ.map_of_exact (ModuleCat.restrictScalars phi.hom)
  have hcomp :
      (T.map (F ⋙ affineGlobalSectionsFunctor R)).ShortExact :=
    ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso
      (T.mapNatIso (moduleSpecΓPushforwardNatIso phi)).symm hres
  simpa only [F, ShortComplex.map_comp] using hcomp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.pushforward_map_shortExact_of_isAffine
statement:
theorem pushforward_map_shortExact_of_isAffine (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (T : ShortComplex X.Modules)
    [T.X₁.IsQuasicoherent] [T.X₂.IsQuasicoherent] [T.X₃.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hT : T.ShortExact) :
    (T.map (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f)).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  let RX := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor X.isoSpec.inv
  let P := Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Spec.map f.appTop)
  let RY := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor Y.isoSpec.hom
  have hRX : (T.map RX).ShortExact :=
    Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor_map_shortExact X.isoSpec.inv T hT
  letI : (T.map RX).X₁.IsQuasicoherent := by
    change ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor X.isoSpec.inv).obj T.X₁).IsQuasicoherent
    infer_instance
  letI : (T.map RX).X₂.IsQuasicoherent := by
    change ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor X.isoSpec.inv).obj T.X₂).IsQuasicoherent
    infer_instance
  letI : (T.map RX).X₃.IsQuasicoherent := by
    change ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor X.isoSpec.inv).obj T.X₃).IsQuasicoherent
    infer_instance
  have hP : ((T.map RX).map P).ShortExact :=
    pushforward_specMap_map_shortExact f.appTop (T.map RX) hRX
  have hRY : (((T.map RX).map P).map RY).ShortExact :=
    Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor_map_shortExact Y.isoSpec.hom
      ((T.map RX).map P) hP
  have hcomp : (T.map (RX ⋙ P ⋙ RY)).ShortExact := by
    simpa only [ShortComplex.map_comp] using hRY
  exact ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso
    (T.mapNatIso (affinePushforwardNatIso f)).symm hcomp

name: SchemeKTheory.openRestrictionSheafificationComparison_homEquiv
statement:
theorem openRestrictionSheafificationComparison_homEquiv
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} (q : S ⟶ T) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (P : PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (T.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)) :
    (moduleSheafificationAdjunction S).homEquiv _ _
        (openRestrictionSheafificationComparison q P) =
      (openRestrictionPresheaf q).map
        ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction T).unit.app P)
proof:
:= by
  let adjS := moduleSheafificationAdjunction S
  let adjT := moduleSheafificationAdjunction T
  dsimp [openRestrictionSheafificationComparison]
  erw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left]
  have hc :
      adjS.homEquiv
          ((openRestrictionPresheaf q).obj
            ((moduleSheafification T ⋙
              underlyingCommPresheafFunctor T).obj P))
          ((Functor.id (S.Modules)).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj
              ((moduleSheafification T).obj P)))
          (adjS.counit.app
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj
              ((moduleSheafification T).obj P))) =
        𝟙 _ := by
    rw [← adjS.homEquiv_symm_id]
    exact Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _
  change
    (openRestrictionPresheaf q).map (adjT.unit.app P) ≫
        adjS.homEquiv _ _
          (adjS.counit.app
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj
              ((moduleSheafification T).obj P))) =
      (openRestrictionPresheaf q).map (adjT.unit.app P)
  rw [hc, Category.comp_id]

name: SchemeKTheory.openRestrictionSheafificationIso_inv_unit
statement:
theorem openRestrictionSheafificationIso_inv_unit
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} (q : S ⟶ T) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (P : PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (T.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)) :
    (openRestrictionPresheaf q).map
          ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction T).unit.app P) ≫
        (underlyingCommPresheafFunctor S).map
          (openRestrictionSheafificationIso q P).inv =
      (moduleSheafificationAdjunction S).unit.app
        ((openRestrictionPresheaf q).obj P)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← openRestrictionSheafificationComparison_homEquiv q P]
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_apply]
  rw [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp]
  change
    (moduleSheafificationAdjunction S).unit.app
          ((openRestrictionPresheaf q).obj P) ≫
        (underlyingCommPresheafFunctor S).map
          ((openRestrictionSheafificationIso q P).hom ≫
            (openRestrictionSheafificationIso q P).inv) = _
  rw [Iso.hom_inv_id]
  rw [(underlyingCommPresheafFunctor S).map_id]
  change
    (moduleSheafificationAdjunction S).unit.app
          ((openRestrictionPresheaf q).obj P) ≫
        𝟙 ((moduleSheafification S ⋙
          underlyingCommPresheafFunctor S).obj
            ((openRestrictionPresheaf q).obj P)) = _
  exact Category.comp_id _

name: SchemeKTheory.openRestriction_tensorSheafification_unit
statement:
theorem openRestriction_tensorSheafification_unit
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} (q : S ⟶ T) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (M N : PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (T.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)) :
    (openRestrictionPresheaf q).map
          ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction T).unit.app (M ⊗ N)) ≫
        (underlyingCommPresheafFunctor S).map
          (openRestrictionSheafificationIso q (M ⊗ N)).inv ≫
        (underlyingCommPresheafFunctor S).map
          (((moduleSheafification S).mapIso
            (pushforwardTensorIso q.opensFunctor
              (openRestrictionRingHom q)
              (fun U ↦ openRestrictionRingHom_app_isIso q U)
              M N)).hom) =
      (pushforwardTensorIso q.opensFunctor
            (openRestrictionRingHom q)
            (fun U ↦ openRestrictionRingHom_app_isIso q U)
            M N).hom ≫
        (moduleSheafificationAdjunction S).unit.app
          ((openRestrictionPresheaf q).obj M ⊗
            (openRestrictionPresheaf q).obj N)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  rw [openRestrictionSheafificationIso_inv_unit]
  let e := pushforwardTensorIso q.opensFunctor
    (openRestrictionRingHom q)
    (fun U ↦ openRestrictionRingHom_app_isIso q U) M N
  unfold openRestrictionPresheaf
  simpa only [Functor.id_obj, Functor.id_map, Functor.comp_map,
    Functor.mapIso, e] using
    ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction S).unit.naturality e.hom).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.openRestriction_tensorSheafification_unit_app_tmul
statement:
theorem openRestriction_tensorSheafification_unit_app_tmul
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} (q : S ⟶ T) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (M N : PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (T.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))
    (U : S.Opensᵒᵖ)
    (a : ((openRestrictionPresheaf q).obj M).obj U)
    (b : ((openRestrictionPresheaf q).obj N).obj U) :
    let e
proof:
:= pushforwardTensorIso q.opensFunctor
      (openRestrictionRingHom q)
      (fun V ↦ openRestrictionRingHom_app_isIso q V) M N
    let cp := openRestrictionSheafificationIso q (M ⊗ N)
    let ep := (moduleSheafification S).mapIso e
    let eta := (moduleSheafificationAdjunction T).unit.app (M ⊗ N)
    let etaS := (moduleSheafificationAdjunction S).unit.app
      ((openRestrictionPresheaf q).obj M ⊗
        (openRestrictionPresheaf q).obj N)
    (etaS.app U).hom (a ⊗ₜ b) =
      (((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor S).map ep.hom).app U).hom
        ((((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor S).map cp.inv).app U).hom
          ((((openRestrictionPresheaf q).map eta).app U).hom
            ((e.inv.app U).hom (a ⊗ₜ b)))) := by
  dsimp only
  let e := pushforwardTensorIso q.opensFunctor
    (openRestrictionRingHom q)
    (fun V ↦ openRestrictionRingHom_app_isIso q V) M N
  have h := congrArg (fun k ↦ k.app U)
    (openRestriction_tensorSheafification_unit q M N)
  simp only [PresheafOfModules.comp_app] at h
  have hx := congrArg
    (fun k ↦ k.hom ((e.inv.app U).hom (a ⊗ₜ b))) h
  erw [ModuleCat.hom_comp] at hx
  erw [ModuleCat.hom_comp] at hx
  erw [ModuleCat.hom_comp] at hx
  erw [ModuleCat.hom_comp] at hx
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply] at hx
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply] at hx
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply] at hx
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply] at hx
  have he : e.inv.app U ≫ e.hom.app U = 𝟙 _ := by
    have h := congrArg (fun k ↦ k.app U) e.inv_hom_id
    simpa only [PresheafOfModules.comp_app,
      PresheafOfModules.id_app] using h
  have hex := congrArg (fun k ↦ k.hom (a ⊗ₜ b)) he
  erw [ModuleCat.hom_comp] at hex
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, ConcreteCategory.id_apply] at hex
  let etaS := (moduleSheafificationAdjunction S).unit.app
    ((openRestrictionPresheaf q).obj M ⊗
      (openRestrictionPresheaf q).obj N)
  exact (congrArg (fun z ↦ (etaS.app U).hom z) hex).symm.trans hx.symm

name: SchemeKTheory.ModuleCat.tensorHom_restrictScalars_mu_map_tmul
statement:
theorem ModuleCat.tensorHom_restrictScalars_mu_map_tmul
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (phi : R →+* S)
    {P Q : ModuleCat R} {M N K : ModuleCat S}
    (a : P ⟶ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars phi).obj M)
    (b : Q ⟶ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars phi).obj N)
    (c : M ⊗ N ⟶ K) (x : P) (y : Q) :
    (((a ⊗ₘ b) ≫
          Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars phi) M N ≫
          (ModuleCat.restrictScalars phi).map c).hom)
        (x ⊗ₜ y) =
      ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars phi).map c).hom
        (a.hom x ⊗ₜ b.hom y)
proof:
:= by
  erw [ModuleCat.hom_comp]
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  erw [ModuleCat.hom_comp]
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  erw [ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_tmul]
  exact congrArg
    (fun z ↦ ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars phi).map c).hom z)
    (ModuleCat.restrictScalars_μ_tmul phi M N (a.hom x) (b.hom y))

name: SchemeKTheory.pushforwardTensorSheafHom_homEquiv_app_tmul
statement:
theorem pushforwardTensorSheafHom_homEquiv_app_tmul
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} (g : S ⟶ T) (A B : S.Modules)
    (U : T.Opensᵒᵖ)
    (a : A.val.obj ((Opens.map g.base).op.obj U))
    (b : B.val.obj ((Opens.map g.base).op.obj U)) :
    ((((moduleSheafificationAdjunction T).homEquiv _ _
          (pushforwardTensorSheafHom g A B)).app U).hom)
        (a ⊗ₜ[↑(T.presheaf.obj U)] b) =
      ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (g.app U.unop).hom).map
          (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction S).unit.app
            (A.val ⊗ B.val)).app
          ((Opens.map g.base).op.obj U))).hom
        (a ⊗ₜ[↑(S.presheaf.obj
          ((Opens.map g.base).op.obj U))] b)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [pushforwardTensorSheafHom]
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  let F := ModuleCat.restrictScalars (g.app U.unop).hom
  let j := (Opens.map g.base).op.obj U
  change
    ((Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ F (A.val.obj j) (B.val.obj j) ≫
        F.map (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction S).unit.app
          (A.val ⊗ B.val)).app j)).hom)
      (a ⊗ₜ[↑(T.presheaf.obj U)] b) = _
  erw [ModuleCat.hom_comp]
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  exact congrArg
    (fun z ↦ (F.map (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction S).unit.app
      (A.val ⊗ B.val)).app j)).hom z)
    (ModuleCat.restrictScalars_μ_tmul
      (g.app U.unop).hom (A.val.obj j) (B.val.obj j) a b)

name: SchemeKTheory.restrictPushforwardIso_tensorUnit_heP
statement:
private theorem restrictPushforwardIso_tensorUnit_heP
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} (g : S ⟶ T) (W : T.Opens)
    (A B : S.Modules) (U : W.toScheme.Opensᵒᵖ)
    (a : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).obj A)).val.obj U)
    (b : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).obj B)).val.obj U) :
    let j
proof:
:= (Opens.map (g ∣_ W).base).op.obj U
    let aS : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (g ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj A).val.obj j :=
      ((restrictPushforwardIso g W A).hom.val.app U).hom a
    let bS : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (g ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj B).val.obj j :=
      ((restrictPushforwardIso g W B).hom.val.app U).hom b
    let aS0 : A.val.obj ((g ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι.opensFunctor.op.obj j) := aS
    let bS0 : B.val.obj ((g ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι.opensFunctor.op.obj j) := bS
    let eP := pushforwardTensorIso (g ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι.opensFunctor
      (openRestrictionRingHom (g ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι)
      (fun V ↦ openRestrictionRingHom_app_isIso (g ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι V)
      A.val B.val
    (eP.inv.app j).hom (aS ⊗ₜ bS) = aS0 ⊗ₜ bS0 := by
  intro j aS bS aS0 bS0 eP
  dsimp [eP, pushforwardTensorIso, restrictScalarsTensorIso,
    restrictScalarsTensorIsoInv, restrictScalarsTensorSectionMu,
    aS0, bS0]
  erw [ModuleCat.restrictScalars_μ_tmul]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.restrictPushforwardIso_tensorUnit_haS
statement:
private theorem restrictPushforwardIso_tensorUnit_haS
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} (g : S ⟶ T) (W : T.Opens)
    (A : S.Modules) (U : W.toScheme.Opensᵒᵖ)
    (a : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).obj A)).val.obj U) :
    let aT : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).obj A).val.obj
        (W.ι.opensFunctor.op.obj U)
proof:
:= a
    let j := (Opens.map (g ∣_ W).base).op.obj U
    let aS : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (g ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj A).val.obj j :=
      ((restrictPushforwardIso g W A).hom.val.app U).hom a
    let aS0 : A.val.obj ((g ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι.opensFunctor.op.obj j) := aS
    let d := (eqToHom
      (image_morphismRestrict_preimage g W U.unop)).op
    aS0 = (A.val.map d).hom aT := by
  intro aT j aS aS0 d
  dsimp [aS0, aS]
  change
    (ConcreteCategory.hom
      (((restrictPushforwardIso g W A).hom).app U.unop)) a = _
  rw [restrictPushforwardIso_hom_app]
  dsimp [Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso, aT, d]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.restrictPushforwardIso_tensorUnit_app_tmul
statement:
theorem restrictPushforwardIso_tensorUnit_app_tmul
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} (g : S ⟶ T) (W : T.Opens)
    (A B : S.Modules) (U : W.toScheme.Opensᵒᵖ)
    (a : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).obj A)).val.obj U)
    (b : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).obj B)).val.obj U) :
    let p
proof:
:= (g ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι
    let h := g ∣_ W
    let j := (Opens.map h.base).op.obj U
    let eta := (moduleSheafificationAdjunction S).unit.app
      (A.val ⊗ B.val)
    let V := W.ι.opensFunctor.op.obj U
    let eP := pushforwardTensorIso p.opensFunctor
      (openRestrictionRingHom p)
      (fun V ↦ openRestrictionRingHom_app_isIso p V)
      A.val B.val
    let aT : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).obj A).val.obj V := a
    let bT : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).obj B).val.obj V := b
    let aS : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor p).obj A).val.obj j :=
      ((restrictPushforwardIso g W A).hom.val.app U).hom a
    let bS : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor p).obj B).val.obj j :=
      ((restrictPushforwardIso g W B).hom.val.app U).hom b
    ((restrictPushforwardIso g W (tensorSheaf S A B)).hom.val.app U).hom
        (((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (g.app V.unop).hom).map
          (eta.app ((Opens.map g.base).op.obj V))).hom
            (aT ⊗ₜ[↑(S.presheaf.obj
              ((Opens.map g.base).op.obj V))] bT)) =
      ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (h.app U.unop).hom).map
          (((openRestrictionPresheaf p).map eta).app j)).hom
        ((eP.inv.app j).hom (aS ⊗ₜ bS)) := by
  dsimp only
  let aT :
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).obj A).val.obj
        (W.ι.opensFunctor.op.obj U) := a
  let bT :
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).obj B).val.obj
        (W.ι.opensFunctor.op.obj U) := b
  let j := (Opens.map (g ∣_ W).base).op.obj U
  let aS : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (g ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj A).val.obj j :=
    ((restrictPushforwardIso g W A).hom.val.app U).hom a
  let bS : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (g ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj B).val.obj j :=
    ((restrictPushforwardIso g W B).hom.val.app U).hom b
  let aS0 : A.val.obj ((g ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι.opensFunctor.op.obj j) := aS
  let bS0 : B.val.obj ((g ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι.opensFunctor.op.obj j) := bS
  let eP := pushforwardTensorIso (g ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι.opensFunctor
    (openRestrictionRingHom (g ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι)
    (fun V ↦ openRestrictionRingHom_app_isIso (g ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι V)
    A.val B.val
  have heP :
      (eP.inv.app j).hom (aS ⊗ₜ bS) = aS0 ⊗ₜ bS0 :=
    restrictPushforwardIso_tensorUnit_heP g W A B U a b
  rw [heP]
  let d := (eqToHom
    (image_morphismRestrict_preimage g W U.unop)).op
  have haS : aS0 = (A.val.map d).hom aT :=
    restrictPushforwardIso_tensorUnit_haS g W A U a
  have hbS : bS0 = (B.val.map d).hom bT :=
    restrictPushforwardIso_tensorUnit_haS g W B U b
  change
    (ConcreteCategory.hom
      (((restrictPushforwardIso g W (tensorSheaf S A B)).hom).app U.unop)) _ = _
  rw [restrictPushforwardIso_hom_app]
  dsimp [Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso]
  rw [haS, hbS]
  simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Iso.refl_inv]
  let eta := (moduleSheafificationAdjunction S).unit.app
    (A.val ⊗ B.val)
  have hnat := congrArg
    (fun q ↦ q.hom (aT ⊗ₜ bT)) (eta.naturality d)
  erw [ModuleCat.hom_comp] at hnat
  erw [ModuleCat.hom_comp] at hnat
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply] at hnat
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply] at hnat
  erw [PresheafOfModules.Monoidal.tensorObj_map_tmul] at hnat
  exact hnat.symm

name: SchemeKTheory.restrictPushforwardIso_pushforwardTensorSheafHom
statement:
theorem restrictPushforwardIso_pushforwardTensorSheafHom
    (A B : X.Modules) :
    (restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso W.ι
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj A)
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj B)).hom ≫
        tensorSheafMap W
          (restrictPushforwardIso f W A).hom
          (restrictPushforwardIso f W B).hom ≫
        pushforwardTensorSheafHom (f ∣_ W)
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj A)
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj B) =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).map
          (pushforwardTensorSheafHom f A B) ≫
        (restrictPushforwardIso f W (tensorSheaf X A B)).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ W)).map
          (restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι A B).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hpush :
      (moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).unit.app
            (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj A).val ⊗
              ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj B).val) ≫
          (underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).map
            (pushforwardTensorSheafHom f A B) =
        (moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).homEquiv _ _
          (pushforwardTensorSheafHom f A B) := by
    rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_apply]
    rfl
  have hpushMapped :
      (openRestrictionPresheaf W.ι).map
          ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).unit.app
              (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj A).val ⊗
                ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj B).val) ≫
            (underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).map
              (pushforwardTensorSheafHom f A B)) =
        (openRestrictionPresheaf W.ι).map
          ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).homEquiv _ _
            (pushforwardTensorSheafHom f A B)) :=
    congrArg (fun k ↦ (openRestrictionPresheaf W.ι).map k) hpush
  rw [← cancel_epi
    (openRestrictionSheafificationIso W.ι
      (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj A).val ⊗
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj B).val)).hom]
  simp only [restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso, Iso.trans_hom,
    Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  apply (moduleSheafificationAdjunction W).homEquiv _ _ |>.injective
  conv_lhs =>
    erw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left]
    erw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left]
    dsimp only [pushforwardTensorSheafHom]
    erw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  conv_rhs =>
    erw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
    erw [openRestrictionSheafificationComparison_homEquiv]
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  rw [← openRestrictionPresheaf_map_underlying W.ι
    (pushforwardTensorSheafHom f A B)]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc]
  rw [hpushMapped]
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro U
  let t := (moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).homEquiv _ _
    (pushforwardTensorSheafHom f A B)
  let cp := openRestrictionSheafificationIso
    (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι (A.val ⊗ B.val)
  let ep := (moduleSheafification (f ⁻¹ᵁ W)).mapIso
    (pushforwardTensorIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι.opensFunctor
      (openRestrictionRingHom (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι)
      (fun V ↦ openRestrictionRingHom_app_isIso
        (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι V) A.val B.val)
  let r :=
    ((openRestrictionPresheaf W.ι).map t).app U ≫
      ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor W).map
        (restrictPushforwardIso f W (tensorSheaf X A B)).hom).app U ≫
      ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor W).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ W)).map cp.inv)).app U ≫
      ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor W).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ W)).map ep.hom)).app U
  simp only [PresheafOfModules.comp_app, Functor.map_comp]
  let e := pushforwardTensorIso W.ι.opensFunctor
      (openRestrictionRingHom W.ι)
      (fun V ↦ openRestrictionRingHom_app_isIso W.ι V)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj A).val
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj B).val
  rw [← cancel_epi (e.inv.app U)]
  have he : e.inv.app U ≫ e.hom.app U = 𝟙 _ := by
    have h := congrArg (fun k ↦ k.app U) e.inv_hom_id
    simpa only [PresheafOfModules.comp_app,
      PresheafOfModules.id_app] using h
  rw [← Category.assoc, he, Category.id_comp]
  apply ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.tensor_ext
  intro a b
  dsimp only [id]
  erw [ModuleCat.tensorHom_restrictScalars_mu_map_tmul
    ((f ∣_ W).app U.unop).hom]
  let aY :
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj A).val.obj
        (W.ι.opensFunctor.op.obj U) := a
  let bY :
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj B).val.obj
        (W.ι.opensFunctor.op.obj U) := b
  have he_apply :
      (e.inv.app U).hom (a ⊗ₜ b) = aY ⊗ₜ bY := by
    dsimp [e, pushforwardTensorIso, restrictScalarsTensorIso,
      restrictScalarsTensorIsoInv, restrictScalarsTensorSectionMu,
      aY, bY]
    erw [ModuleCat.restrictScalars_μ_tmul]
    rfl
  change _ = (e.inv.app U ≫ r).hom (a ⊗ₜ b)
  erw [ModuleCat.hom_comp]
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (congrArg (fun z ↦ r.hom z) he_apply).symm
  dsimp only [r]
  erw [ModuleCat.hom_comp]
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  erw [ModuleCat.hom_comp]
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  erw [ModuleCat.hom_comp]
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  erw [ModuleCat.restrictScalars.map_apply]
  erw [pushforwardTensorSheafHom_homEquiv_app_tmul
    f A B (W.ι.opensFunctor.op.obj U) aY bY]
  erw [restrictPushforwardIso_tensorUnit_app_tmul
    f W A B U a b]
  exact openRestriction_tensorSheafification_unit_app_tmul
    (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι A.val B.val
      ((Opens.map (f ∣_ W).base).op.obj U)
      (((restrictPushforwardIso f W A).hom.val.app U).hom a)
      (((restrictPushforwardIso f W B).hom.val.app U).hom b)

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso_pushforwardTensorSheafHom
statement:
theorem pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso_pushforwardTensorSheafHom
    (A B : X.Modules) :
    (openPullbackTensorIso W.ι
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj A)
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj B)).hom ≫
        tensorSheafMap W
          (pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso f W A).hom
          (pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso f W B).hom ≫
        pushforwardTensorSheafHom (f ∣_ W)
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj A)
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj B) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback W.ι).map
          (pushforwardTensorSheafHom f A B) ≫
        (pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso f W (tensorSheaf X A B)).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ W)).map
          (openPullbackTensorIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι A B).hom
proof:
:= by
  let eQ := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback W.ι
  let eP := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι
  simp only [openPullbackTensorIso, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom,
    tensorSheafMapIso_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [tensorSheafMap_comp_assoc]
  have hcomp (C : X.Modules) :
      (eQ.app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj C)).hom ≫
          (pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso f W C).hom =
        (restrictPushforwardIso f W C).hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ W)).map (eP.app C).hom := by
    dsimp [pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso,
      pullbackRestrictPushforwardNatIso]
    simp only [Iso.trans_hom]
    change
      (eQ.app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj C)).hom ≫
        ((eQ.app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj C)).inv ≫
          (restrictPushforwardIso f W C).hom ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ W)).map (eP.app C).hom) = _
    simpa only [Category.assoc] using
      (eQ.app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj C)).hom_inv_id_assoc
        ((restrictPushforwardIso f W C).hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ W)).map (eP.app C).hom)
  rw [hcomp A, hcomp B]
  rw [← tensorSheafMap_comp_assoc]
  rw [pushforwardTensorSheafHom_naturality]
  have hrest := congrArg
    (fun k ↦ k ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ W)).map
      (tensorSheafMap (f ⁻¹ᵁ W) (eP.app A).hom (eP.app B).hom))
    (restrictPushforwardIso_pushforwardTensorSheafHom f W A B)
  simp only [Category.assoc] at hrest
  rw [hrest]
  have hinvcomp (C : X.Modules) :
      (pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso f W C).hom =
        (eQ.app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj C)).inv ≫
          (restrictPushforwardIso f W C).hom ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ W)).map (eP.app C).hom := by
    rw [← cancel_epi (eQ.app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj C)).hom]
    rw [hcomp]
    simpa only [Category.assoc] using
      ((eQ.app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj C)).hom_inv_id_assoc
        ((restrictPushforwardIso f W C).hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ W)).map (eP.app C).hom)).symm
  rw [hinvcomp (tensorSheaf X A B)]
  simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  have hnat :
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback W.ι).map
            (pushforwardTensorSheafHom f A B) ≫
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback W.ι).app
            ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj (tensorSheaf X A B))).inv =
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback W.ι).app
            (tensorSheaf Y
              ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj A)
              ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj B))).inv ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).map
            (pushforwardTensorSheafHom f A B) :=
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback W.ι).inv.naturality
      (pushforwardTensorSheafHom f A B)
  rw [← reassoc_of% hnat]
  dsimp only [eQ, eP]
  conv_rhs =>
    rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc]
    rw [(Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback
      (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).app (tensorSheaf X A B) |>.hom_inv_id]
    rw [(Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ W)).map_id,
      Category.id_comp]

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict_tensorSheaf
statement:
theorem pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict_tensorSheaf
    (M N : Y.Modules) :
    (pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict f W).inv.app
          (tensorSheaf Y M N) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (f ∣_ W)).map
          (openPullbackTensorIso W.ι M N).hom ≫
        pullbackTensorSheafHom (f ∣_ W)
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback W.ι).obj M)
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback W.ι).obj N) ≫
        tensorSheafMap (f ⁻¹ᵁ W)
          ((pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict f W).hom.app M)
          ((pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict f W).hom.app N) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).map
          (pullbackTensorSheafHom f M N) ≫
        (openPullbackTensorIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M)
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj N)).hom
proof:
:= by
  let alpha := pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict f W
  rw [← cancel_epi (alpha.hom.app (tensorSheaf Y M N))]
  have halpha :
      alpha.hom.app (tensorSheaf Y M N) ≫
          (pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict f W).inv.app
            (tensorSheaf Y M N) = 𝟙 _ := by
    change (alpha.app (tensorSheaf Y M N)).hom ≫
      (alpha.app (tensorSheaf Y M N)).inv = _
    exact (alpha.app (tensorSheaf Y M N)).hom_inv_id
  rw [reassoc_of% halpha]
  apply (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
    (f ∣_ W)).homEquiv _ _ |>.injective
  conv_lhs =>
    erw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left]
    erw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
    simp only [pullbackTensorSheafHom, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  conv_rhs =>
    rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_apply]
  slice_lhs 3 4 =>
    rw [← pushforwardTensorSheafHom_naturality]
  slice_lhs 2 3 =>
    rw [tensorSheafMap_comp]
  have hunit (A : Y.Modules) :
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
            (f ∣_ W)).unit.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback W.ι).obj A) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ W)).map
          ((pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict f W).hom.app A) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback W.ι).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app A) ≫
        (pullbackRestrictPushforwardNatIso f W).hom.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj A) := by
    have hu := unit_mateEquiv
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f)
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (f ∣_ W))
      (pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict f W).hom A
    have hm := congrArg
      (fun k ↦ k.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj A))
      (pullbackBaseChangeMate_eq_pullbackRestrictPushforwardNatIso_hom
        f W)
    change
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback W.ι).map
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app A) ≫
          (pullbackBaseChangeMate f W).app
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj A) =
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
              (f ∣_ W)).unit.app
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback W.ι).obj A) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ W)).map
            ((pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict f W).hom.app A) at hu
    rw [hm] at hu
    exact hu.symm
  rw [hunit M, hunit N]
  rw [← tensorSheafMap_comp_assoc]
  slice_lhs 1 2 =>
    rw [← openPullbackTensorIso_hom_naturality]
  slice_lhs 2 4 =>
    change
      (openPullbackTensorIso W.ι
            ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj
              ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M))
            ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj
              ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj N))).hom ≫
          tensorSheafMap W
            (pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso f W
              ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M)).hom
            (pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso f W
              ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj N)).hom ≫
          pushforwardTensorSheafHom (f ∣_ W)
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj
              ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M))
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj
              ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj N))
    rw [pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso_pushforwardTensorSheafHom]
  conv_rhs =>
    rw [Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_comp]
    rw [reassoc_of% hunit (tensorSheaf Y M N)]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc]
  have hpull :
      tensorSheafMap Y
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app M)
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app N) ≫
          pushforwardTensorSheafHom f
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M)
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj N) =
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).homEquiv _ _
          (pullbackTensorSheafHom f M N) := by
    dsimp only [pullbackTensorSheafHom]
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [hpull]
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_apply]
  rw [Functor.map_comp_assoc]
  rw [pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso_hom_naturality_assoc]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.pushforwardTensorSheafHom_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem pushforwardTensorSheafHom_naturality
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    {M M' N N' : X.Modules}
    (a : M ⟶ M') (b : N ⟶ N') :
    tensorSheafMap Y
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map a)
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map b) ≫
        pushforwardTensorSheafHom f M' N' =
      pushforwardTensorSheafHom f M N ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
          (tensorSheafMap X a b)
proof:
:= by
  apply (moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).homEquiv _ _ |>.injective
  conv_lhs =>
    erw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left]
    dsimp only [pushforwardTensorSheafHom]
    erw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  conv_rhs =>
    erw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
    dsimp only [pushforwardTensorSheafHom]
    erw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro U
  simp only [PresheafOfModules.comp_app]
  let F := ModuleCat.restrictScalars (f.app U.unop).hom
  let j := (Opens.map f.base).op.obj U
  let t :
      (underlyingCommPresheaf X M ⊗ underlyingCommPresheaf X N) ⟶
        (underlyingCommPresheaf X M' ⊗ underlyingCommPresheaf X N') :=
    a.val ⊗ₘ b.val
  let η := (moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit
  change
    (F.map (a.val.app j) ⊗ₘ F.map (b.val.app j)) ≫
          Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ F
            (M'.val.obj j) (N'.val.obj j) ≫
        F.map ((η.app
          (underlyingCommPresheaf X M' ⊗
            underlyingCommPresheaf X N')).app j) =
      Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ F
            (M.val.obj j) (N.val.obj j) ≫
        F.map ((η.app
          (underlyingCommPresheaf X M ⊗
            underlyingCommPresheaf X N)).app j) ≫
          F.map (((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map
            ((moduleSheafification X).map t)).app j)
  rw [Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ_natural_assoc]
  rw [← F.map_comp, ← F.map_comp]
  congr 1
  have h := congrArg (fun q ↦ q.app j) (η.naturality t)
  simp only [Functor.id_map, PresheafOfModules.comp_app,
    Functor.comp_map] at h
  exact congrArg (fun q ↦ F.map q) h

name: SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafification_homEquiv_tensorSheafLeftUnitor
statement:
theorem moduleSheafification_homEquiv_tensorSheafLeftUnitor
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (M : X.Modules) :
    (moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).homEquiv _ _
        (tensorSheafLeftUnitor X M).hom =
      (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor
        (underlyingCommPresheaf X M)).hom
proof:
:= by
  let adj := moduleSheafificationAdjunction X
  change adj.homEquiv _ _
      ((moduleSheafification X).map
          (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor
            (underlyingCommPresheaf X M)).hom ≫
        adj.counit.app M) =
    (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor
      (underlyingCommPresheaf X M)).hom
  erw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left]
  change
    (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor
        (underlyingCommPresheaf X M)).hom ≫
      adj.homEquiv ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).obj M) M
        (adj.counit.app M) =
    (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor
      (underlyingCommPresheaf X M)).hom
  have hc :
      adj.homEquiv ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).obj M) M
          (adj.counit.app M) =
        𝟙 ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).obj M) := by
    rw [← adj.homEquiv_symm_id M]
    exact Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _
  rw [hc]
  exact Category.comp_id _

name: SchemeKTheory.pushforwardTensorSheafHom_unit_compat
statement:
theorem pushforwardTensorSheafHom_unit_compat
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    tensorSheafMap Y
          (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
            f.toRingCatSheafHom)
          (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
            f.toRingCatSheafHom) ≫
        pushforwardTensorSheafHom f
          (tensorUnitSheaf X) (tensorUnitSheaf X) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
          (tensorSheafLeftUnitor X
            (tensorUnitSheaf X)).hom =
      (tensorSheafLeftUnitor Y
          (tensorUnitSheaf Y)).hom ≫
        SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
          f.toRingCatSheafHom
proof:
:= by
  apply (moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).homEquiv _ _ |>.injective
  conv_lhs =>
    erw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left]
    erw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
    dsimp only [pushforwardTensorSheafHom]
    erw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  conv_rhs =>
    erw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
    erw [moduleSheafification_homEquiv_tensorSheafLeftUnitor]
  have hX :=
    moduleSheafification_homEquiv_tensorSheafLeftUnitor
      X (tensorUnitSheaf X)
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit] at hX
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro U
  simp only [PresheafOfModules.comp_app]
  let F := ModuleCat.restrictScalars (f.app U.unop).hom
  let j := (Opens.map f.base).op.obj U
  let u :=
    (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
      f.toRingCatSheafHom).val.app U
  have hu :
      u = Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε F := by
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro r
    change
      (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
        f.toRingCatSheafHom).val.app U r =
        Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε F r
    rw [SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit_val_app_apply,
      ModuleCat.restrictScalars_η]
    rfl
  have hXj := congrArg (fun q ↦ q.app j) hX
  simp only [PresheafOfModules.comp_app] at hXj
  change
    (u ⊗ₘ u) ≫
          Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ F
            ((tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj j)
            ((tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj j) ≫
        F.map
          (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app
                (underlyingCommPresheaf X (tensorUnitSheaf X) ⊗
                  underlyingCommPresheaf X (tensorUnitSheaf X))).app j ≫
            ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map
              (tensorSheafLeftUnitor X
                (tensorUnitSheaf X)).hom).app j) =
      ((MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor
          (underlyingCommPresheaf Y
            (tensorUnitSheaf Y))).hom.app U) ≫
        u
  rw [congrArg (fun q ↦ F.map q) hXj]
  rw [hu]
  change
    (Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε F ⊗ₘ
        Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε F) ≫
          Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ F (𝟙_ _) (𝟙_ _) ≫
        F.map (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor (𝟙_ _)).hom =
      (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor (𝟙_ _)).hom ≫
        Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε F
  rw [← Functor.LaxMonoidal.tensorUnit_whiskerLeft_comp_leftUnitor_hom]
  exact MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor_naturality _

name: SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap_comp
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem tensorSheafMap_comp
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    {M M' M'' N N' N'' : X.Modules}
    (a : M ⟶ M') (a' : M' ⟶ M'')
    (b : N ⟶ N') (b' : N' ⟶ N'') :
    tensorSheafMap X a b ≫ tensorSheafMap X a' b' =
      tensorSheafMap X (a ≫ a') (b ≫ b')
proof:
:= by
  change
    (moduleSheafification X).map (a.val ⊗ₘ b.val) ≫
        (moduleSheafification X).map (a'.val ⊗ₘ b'.val) =
      (moduleSheafification X).map
        ((a.val ≫ a'.val) ⊗ₘ (b.val ≫ b'.val))
  rw [← (moduleSheafification X).map_comp]
  rw [MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_comp_tensorHom]

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackTensorSheafHom_unit_compat
statement:
theorem pullbackTensorSheafHom_unit_compat
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    pullbackTensorSheafHom f
          (tensorUnitSheaf Y) (tensorUnitSheaf Y) ≫
        tensorSheafMap X
          (SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit
            f.toRingCatSheafHom)
          (SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit
            f.toRingCatSheafHom) ≫
        (tensorSheafLeftUnitor X (tensorUnitSheaf X)).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map
          (tensorSheafLeftUnitor Y (tensorUnitSheaf Y)).hom ≫
        SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit
          f.toRingCatSheafHom
proof:
:= by
  apply
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).homEquiv _ _ |>.injective
  simp only [Category.assoc, Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right,
    pullbackTensorSheafHom, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
  conv_rhs =>
    rw [Category.assoc]
    rw [Adjunction.unit_naturality_assoc]
  rw [← Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
  erw [SheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction_homEquiv_pullbackObjUnitToUnit]
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  rw [← pushforwardTensorSheafHom_naturality_assoc]
  rw [tensorSheafMap_comp_assoc]
  have hp :=
    SheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction_homEquiv_pullbackObjUnitToUnit
      f.toRingCatSheafHom
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit] at hp
  erw [hp]
  exact pushforwardTensorSheafHom_unit_compat f

statement:
theorem tilde_isCoherentLike (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (hM : ModuleResolution.IsFG R M) :
    IsCoherentLike (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) ((tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of R)).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Module.Finite R M := hM
  haveI : ((tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of R)).obj M).IsQuasicoherent :=
    (inferInstance : (tilde (R := CommRingCat.of R) M).IsQuasicoherent)
  haveI : Module.FinitePresentation R ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj
      ((tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of R)).obj M)) := by
    haveI := Module.finitePresentation_of_finite R M
    exact Module.FinitePresentation.of_equiv (unitEquiv R M)
  exact isFinitePresentation_of_moduleSpecΓ _

name: GLocalisationSpec.tildeG_classOf
statement:
theorem tildeG_classOf (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (hM : ModuleResolution.IsFG R M) :
    tildeG R (ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf _ _ M hM) =
      g0ClassOf _ ((tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of R)).obj M) (tilde_isCoherentLike R M hM)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tildeG, ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf, ExactGrothendieck.map_classOf]
  rfl

name: GLocalisationSpec.gammaG_comp_tildeG
statement: theorem gammaG_comp_tildeG : (gammaG R).comp (tildeG R) = AddMonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
  rintro ⟨M, hM⟩
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, tildeG, gammaG, ExactGrothendieck.map_classOf,
    AddMonoidHom.id_apply]
  haveI : Module.Finite R M := hM
  exact (ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso (ModuleCat.{u} R) (ModuleResolution.IsFG R)
    _ hM (show Module.Finite R (ModuleCat.of R PUnit.{u + 1}) from inferInstance)
    (ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _) ((tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := CommRingCat.of R)).app M).symm)

name: GLocalisationSpec.tildeG_comp_gammaG
statement: theorem tildeG_comp_gammaG : (tildeG R).comp (gammaG R) = AddMonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
  rintro ⟨E, hE⟩
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, tildeG, gammaG, ExactGrothendieck.map_classOf,
    AddMonoidHom.id_apply]
  haveI : E.IsFinitePresentation := hE
  exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso _ (IsCoherentLike _) _ hE
    (show (0 : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Modules).IsFinitePresentation from inferInstance)
    (isZero_zero _) (by
      haveI : IsIso (Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓ (R := CommRingCat.of R) E) :=
    Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent (R := CommRingCat.of R) E
      let i := asIso (Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓ (R := CommRingCat.of R) E)
      exact i)

name: GLocalisationSpec.flat_algebraMap_localization
statement: theorem flat_algebraMap_localization : (algebraMap R (Localization S)).Flat
proof:
:=
  RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff.mpr (IsLocalization.flat _ S)

name: GLocalisationSpec.affineScalarExtensionG0_tildeG
statement:
theorem affineScalarExtensionG0_tildeG (x : ModuleResolution.G0 R) :
    affineScalarExtensionG0 (algebraMap R (Localization S)) (flat_algebraMap_localization S)
        (tildeG R x) = tildeG (Localization S) (GLocalisation.locG0 S x)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (affineScalarExtensionG0 (algebraMap R (Localization S))
      (flat_algebraMap_localization S)).comp (tildeG R) =
      (tildeG (Localization S)).comp (GLocalisation.locG0 S) := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    rintro ⟨M, hM⟩
    change affineScalarExtensionG0 _ (flat_algebraMap_localization S) (tildeG R (ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf _ _ M hM)) =
      tildeG (Localization S) (GLocalisation.locG0 S (ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf _ _ M hM))
    rw [GLocalisation.locG0_classOf, tildeG_classOf, tildeG_classOf,
      affineScalarExtensionG0_classOf]
    exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso _ (IsCoherentLike _) _ _
      (show (0 : (Spec (CommRingCat.of (Localization S))).Modules).IsFinitePresentation from
        inferInstance)
      (isZero_zero _) ((tilde.functor _).mapIso (extendScalarsGammaTildeIso S M))
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h x

name: GLocalisationSpec.finitePushforward_tildeG
statement:
theorem finitePushforward_tildeG (x : ModuleResolution.G0 (R ⧸ I)) :
    finitePushforward (quotientSpecMap I) (tildeG (R ⧸ I) x) =
      tildeG R (GLocalisation.pushG0 I x)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (finitePushforward (quotientSpecMap I)).comp (tildeG (R ⧸ I)) =
      (tildeG R).comp (GLocalisation.pushG0 I) := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    rintro ⟨E, hE⟩
    change finitePushforward (quotientSpecMap I)
        (tildeG (R ⧸ I) (ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf _ _ E hE)) =
      tildeG R (GLocalisation.pushG0 I (ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf _ _ E hE))
    rw [GLocalisation.pushG0_classOf, tildeG_classOf, tildeG_classOf, finitePushforward_classOf]
    exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso _ (IsCoherentLike _) _ _
      (show (0 : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Modules).IsFinitePresentation from inferInstance)
      (isZero_zero _) (pushforwardTildeIso I E)
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h x

name: GLocalisationSpec.flatPullbackG0_eq_affineScalarExtensionG0
statement:
theorem flatPullbackG0_eq_affineScalarExtensionG0 (S : Submonoid R) :
    flatPullbackG0 (localizationSpecMap S) =
      affineScalarExtensionG0 (algebraMap R (Localization S)) (flat_algebraMap_localization S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← affinePullbackG0_eq_affineScalarExtensionG0]
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
  intro E
  change flatPullbackG0 _ (g0ClassOf _ E.1 E.2) = affinePullbackG0 _ _ (g0ClassOf _ E.1 E.2)
  rw [flatPullbackG0_classOf, affinePullbackG0_classOf]

name: GLocalisationSpec.flatPullbackG0_tildeG
statement:
theorem flatPullbackG0_tildeG (S : Submonoid R) (x : ModuleResolution.G0 R) :
    flatPullbackG0 (localizationSpecMap S) (tildeG R x) =
      tildeG (Localization S) (GLocalisation.locG0 S x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [flatPullbackG0_eq_affineScalarExtensionG0, affineScalarExtensionG0_tildeG]

name: GLocalisationSpec.flatPullbackG0_localizationSpecMap_surjective
statement:
theorem flatPullbackG0_localizationSpecMap_surjective (S : Submonoid R) :
    Function.Surjective (flatPullbackG0 (localizationSpecMap S))
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (specG0Equiv (Localization S)).surjective y
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := GLocalisation.locG0_surjective S z
  exact ⟨tildeG R x, flatPullbackG0_tildeG S x⟩

name: GLocalisationSpec.ker_flatPullbackG0_away_eq_range_finitePushforward
statement:
theorem ker_flatPullbackG0_away_eq_range_finitePushforward (s : R) :
    (flatPullbackG0 (localizationSpecMap (Submonoid.powers s))).ker =
      (finitePushforward (quotientSpecMap (Ideal.span {s}))).range
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (specG0Equiv R).surjective y
  change tildeG R x ∈ _ ↔ tildeG R x ∈ _
  rw [AddMonoidHom.mem_ker, flatPullbackG0_tildeG]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hx : x ∈ (GLocalisation.locG0 (Submonoid.powers s)).ker := by
      rw [AddMonoidHom.mem_ker]
      apply (specG0Equiv (Localization (Submonoid.powers s))).injective
      simpa [specG0Equiv] using h
    rw [GLocalisation.ker_locG0_powers_eq_range_pushG0] at hx
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨tildeG _ w, finitePushforward_tildeG _ w⟩
  · rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
    obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := (specG0Equiv (R ⧸ Ideal.span {s})).surjective w
    change finitePushforward _ (tildeG _ v) = _ at hw
    rw [finitePushforward_tildeG] at hw
    have hinj := (specG0Equiv R).injective (a₁ := GLocalisation.pushG0 _ v) (a₂ := x) hw
    subst hinj
    have : GLocalisation.pushG0 (Ideal.span {s}) v ∈
        (GLocalisation.locG0 (Submonoid.powers s)).ker := by
      rw [GLocalisation.ker_locG0_powers_eq_range_pushG0]; exact ⟨v, rfl⟩
    rw [AddMonoidHom.mem_ker] at this
    rw [this, map_zero]

name: GLocalisationSpec.exists_localizedModule_iso
statement:
theorem exists_localizedModule_iso (S : Submonoid R) (E : ModuleCat.{u} (Localization S))
    [Module.Finite (Localization S) E] :
    ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u} R, Module.Finite R M ∧
      Nonempty ((ModuleCat.localizedModuleFunctor S).obj M ≅ E)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := GLocalisation.exists_lattice_obj S E
  haveI : Module.Finite R L := Module.Finite.iff_fg.mpr hL.1
  letI : Module (Localization S) (GLocalisation.Res S E) := GLocalisation.resOrig S E
  haveI := GLocalisation.res_isScalarTower S E
  haveI := GLocalisation.isLocalizedModule_lattice S E L hL
  let M : ModuleCat.{u} R := ModuleCat.of R L
  let fL := M.localizedModuleMkLinearMap S
  haveI : IsLocalizedModule S fL := ModuleCat.localizedModule_isLocalizedModule M S
  let e₀ := IsLocalizedModule.linearEquiv S fL L.subtype
  let e := e₀.extendScalarsOfIsLocalization S (Localization S)
  exact ⟨M, (inferInstance : Module.Finite R L),
    ⟨(e.toModuleIso : (ModuleCat.localizedModuleFunctor S).obj M ≅ E)⟩⟩

name: GLocalisationSpec.exists_coherent_extension
statement:
theorem exists_coherent_extension (S : Submonoid R)
    (F : (Spec (CommRingCat.of (Localization S))).Modules)
    (hF : IsCoherentLike _ F) :
    ∃ (E : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Modules) (_ : IsCoherentLike _ E),
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (localizationSpecMap S)).obj E ≅ F)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : F.IsFinitePresentation := hF
  haveI : Module.Finite (Localization S) ((moduleSpecΓFunctor
      (R := CommRingCat.of (Localization S))).obj F) :=
    finite_moduleSpecΓ_of_isCoherentLike _ F hF
  obtain ⟨M, hM, ⟨eM⟩⟩ := exists_localizedModule_iso S
    ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of (Localization S))).obj F)
  refine ⟨(tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of R)).obj M, tilde_isCoherentLike R M hM, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  haveI : ((tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of R)).obj M).IsQuasicoherent :=
    (inferInstance : (tilde (R := CommRingCat.of R) M).IsQuasicoherent)
  let QE : AffineQuasicoherent (.of R) := ⟨(tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of R)).obj M, inferInstance⟩
  exact (affineQCPullbackNatIso (algebraMap R (Localization S))).app QE ≪≫
    (tilde.functor _).mapIso (extendScalarsGammaTildeIso S M ≪≫ eM) ≪≫ (by
      haveI : IsIso (Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓ (R := CommRingCat.of (Localization S)) F) :=
        Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent (R := CommRingCat.of (Localization S)) F
      let i := asIso (Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓ (R := CommRingCat.of (Localization S)) F)
      exact i)

name: GLocalisationSpec.flatPullbackG0_congr
statement:
theorem flatPullbackG0_congr {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f g : X ⟶ Y} [Flat f] [Flat g] (h : f = g) :
    flatPullbackG0 f = flatPullbackG0 g
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rfl

name: GLocalisationSpec.flatPullbackG0_id
statement: theorem flatPullbackG0_id (X : Scheme.{u}) : flatPullbackG0 (𝟙 X) = AddMonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
  intro E
  change flatPullbackG0 _ (g0ClassOf _ E.1 E.2) = g0ClassOf _ E.1 E.2
  rw [flatPullbackG0_classOf]
  exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso _ (IsCoherentLike _) _ _
    (show (0 : X.Modules).IsFinitePresentation from inferInstance)
    (isZero_zero _) ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackId X).app E.1)

name: GLocalisationSpec.flatPullbackG0_comp
statement:
theorem flatPullbackG0_comp {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) [Flat f] [Flat g] :
    flatPullbackG0 (f ≫ g) = (flatPullbackG0 f).comp (flatPullbackG0 g)
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
  intro E
  change flatPullbackG0 _ (g0ClassOf _ E.1 E.2) =
    flatPullbackG0 f (flatPullbackG0 g (g0ClassOf _ E.1 E.2))
  rw [flatPullbackG0_classOf, flatPullbackG0_classOf, flatPullbackG0_classOf]
  exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso _ (IsCoherentLike _) _ _
    (show (0 : X.Modules).IsFinitePresentation from inferInstance)
    (isZero_zero _) ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f g).app E.1).symm

name: GLocalisationSpec.flatPullbackG0_bijective_of_iso
statement:
theorem flatPullbackG0_bijective_of_iso {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (e : X ≅ Y) :
    Function.Bijective (flatPullbackG0 e.hom)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (flatPullbackG0 e.inv).comp (flatPullbackG0 e.hom) = AddMonoidHom.id _ := by
    rw [← flatPullbackG0_comp, flatPullbackG0_congr e.inv_hom_id, flatPullbackG0_id]
  have h2 : (flatPullbackG0 e.hom).comp (flatPullbackG0 e.inv) = AddMonoidHom.id _ := by
    rw [← flatPullbackG0_comp, flatPullbackG0_congr e.hom_inv_id, flatPullbackG0_id]
  exact ⟨Function.LeftInverse.injective (g := flatPullbackG0 e.inv) (DFunLike.congr_fun h1),
    Function.RightInverse.surjective (g := flatPullbackG0 e.inv) (DFunLike.congr_fun h2)⟩

name: GLocalisationSpec.flatPullbackG0_basicOpen_eq
statement:
theorem flatPullbackG0_basicOpen_eq :
    flatPullbackG0 (Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen s)) =
      (flatPullbackG0 (basicOpenIsoSpecAway (R := CommRingCat.of R) s).hom).comp
        (flatPullbackG0 (localizationSpecMap (Submonoid.powers s)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← flatPullbackG0_comp]
  exact flatPullbackG0_congr (basicOpenIsoSpecAway_hom_SpecMap (R := CommRingCat.of R) s).symm

name: GLocalisationSpec.flatPullbackG0_basicOpen_surjective
statement:
theorem flatPullbackG0_basicOpen_surjective :
    Function.Surjective
      (flatPullbackG0 (Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen s)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [flatPullbackG0_basicOpen_eq]
  exact (flatPullbackG0_bijective_of_iso _).2.comp
    (flatPullbackG0_localizationSpecMap_surjective _)

name: GLocalisationSpec.ker_flatPullbackG0_basicOpen_eq_range_finitePushforward
statement:
theorem ker_flatPullbackG0_basicOpen_eq_range_finitePushforward :
    (flatPullbackG0 (Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
        (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen s))).ker =
      (finitePushforward (quotientSpecMap (Ideal.span {s}))).range
proof:
:= by
  rw [flatPullbackG0_basicOpen_eq, ← ker_flatPullbackG0_away_eq_range_finitePushforward]
  ext y
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.mem_ker, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
  exact ⟨fun h => (flatPullbackG0_bijective_of_iso _).1 (h.trans (map_zero _).symm),
    fun h => by rw [h, map_zero]⟩

name: ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR1.naturality'
statement: theorem naturality' {A B : C} (f : A ⟶ B) : T.map f ≫ ap T σ B = ap T σ A ≫ f
proof:
:= by
  simpa [ap] using σ.naturality f

name: ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR1.app_eq_zero_of_mono
statement:
theorem app_eq_zero_of_mono {A B : C} (f : A ⟶ B) [Mono f] (hB : ap T σ B = 0) :
    ap T σ A = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono f, ← naturality' T σ f, hB, comp_zero, zero_comp]

name: ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR1.app_eq_zero_of_epi
statement:
theorem app_eq_zero_of_epi {A B : C} (f : A ⟶ B) [Epi f] (hA : ap T σ A = 0) :
    ap T σ B = 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Epi (T.map f) := inferInstance
  rw [← cancel_epi (T.map f), naturality' T σ f, hA, zero_comp, comp_zero]

name: ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR1.killedClosed
statement:
theorem killedClosed (hP : KerCokerClosed P) : KerCokerClosed (Killed T σ P) where
  zero
proof:
:= ⟨hP.zero, (isZero_zero C).eq_of_tgt _ _⟩
  kernel f hA hB := ⟨hP.kernel f hA.1 hB.1, app_eq_zero_of_mono (kernel.ι f) hA.2⟩
  cokernel f hA hB := ⟨hP.cokernel f hA.1 hB.1, app_eq_zero_of_epi (cokernel.π f) hB.2⟩

name: ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR1.app_kernel_eq_zero
statement:
theorem app_kernel_eq_zero (hc : Central T σ) (E : C) :
    ap T σ (kernel (ap T σ E)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono (kernel.ι (ap T σ E)), ← naturality' T σ (kernel.ι (ap T σ E)), hc,
    ← Functor.map_comp, kernel.condition, Functor.map_zero, zero_comp]

name: ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR1.app_cokernel_eq_zero
statement: theorem app_cokernel_eq_zero (E : C) : ap T σ (cokernel (ap T σ E)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_epi (T.map (cokernel.π (ap T σ E))), naturality' T σ, cokernel.condition,
    comp_zero]

name: ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR1.killed_kernel
statement: theorem killed_kernel {E : C} (hE : P E) : Killed T σ P (kernel (ap T σ E))
proof:
:=
  ⟨hP.kernel _ (hT E hE) hE, app_kernel_eq_zero hc E⟩

name: ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR1.killed_cokernel
statement: theorem killed_cokernel {E : C} (hE : P E) : Killed T σ P (cokernel (ap T σ E))
proof:
:=
  ⟨hP.cokernel _ (hT E hE) hE, app_cokernel_eq_zero E⟩

name: ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR1.gysinObj_additive
statement:
theorem gysinObj_additive (A B D : {E : C // P E}) (h : shortExactIn C P A B D) :
    gysinObj hc hP hT B = gysinObj hc hP hT A + gysinObj hc hP hT D
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, g, zero, hS⟩ := h
  let S := ShortComplex.mk f g zero
  haveI := hS.mono_f
  haveI := hS.epi_g
  let I := snakeInput (T := T) (σ := σ) S hS
  have hQ := killedClosed (T := T) (σ := σ) hP
  haveI : Mono I.L₀.f := by
    have w : I.L₀.f ≫ kernel.ι (ap T σ S.X₂) = kernel.ι (ap T σ S.X₁) ≫ T.map S.f :=
      kernel.lift_ι _ _ _
    haveI hm : Mono (T.map S.f) := (hS.map T).mono_f
    haveI : Mono (I.L₀.f ≫ kernel.ι (ap T σ S.X₂)) := by
      rw [w]; exact @mono_comp _ _ _ _ _ (kernel.ι _) _ (T.map S.f) hm
    exact mono_of_mono _ (kernel.ι (ap T σ S.X₂))
  haveI : Epi I.L₃.g := by
    have w : cokernel.π (ap T σ S.X₂) ≫ I.L₃.g = S.g ≫ cokernel.π (ap T σ S.X₃) :=
      cokernel.π_desc _ _ _
    haveI : Epi (cokernel.π (ap T σ S.X₂) ≫ I.L₃.g) := by
      rw [w]; exact @epi_comp _ _ _ _ _ S.g hS.epi_g (cokernel.π _) _
    exact epi_of_epi (cokernel.π (ap T σ S.X₂)) _
  have key : subcategoryClassOf C (Killed T σ P) (kernel (ap T σ A.1))
        (killed_kernel hc hP hT A.2) -
      subcategoryClassOf C (Killed T σ P) (kernel (ap T σ B.1)) (killed_kernel hc hP hT B.2) +
      subcategoryClassOf C (Killed T σ P) (kernel (ap T σ D.1)) (killed_kernel hc hP hT D.2) -
      subcategoryClassOf C (Killed T σ P) (cokernel (ap T σ A.1)) (killed_cokernel hc hP hT A.2) +
      subcategoryClassOf C (Killed T σ P) (cokernel (ap T σ B.1)) (killed_cokernel hc hP hT B.2) -
      subcategoryClassOf C (Killed T σ P) (cokernel (ap T σ D.1))
        (killed_cokernel hc hP hT D.2) = 0 :=
    six_term hQ I.L₀.f I.L₀.g I.δ I.L₃.f I.L₃.g I.L₀.zero I.L₀_g_δ I.δ_L₃_f
    I.L₃.zero I.L₀_exact I.L₁'_exact I.L₂'_exact I.L₃_exact
    (killed_kernel hc hP hT A.2) (killed_kernel hc hP hT B.2) (killed_kernel hc hP hT D.2)
    (killed_cokernel hc hP hT A.2) (killed_cokernel hc hP hT B.2) (killed_cokernel hc hP hT D.2)
  simp only [gysinObj]
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← key]
  abel

name: ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR1.cartierGysin_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cartierGysin_classOf (E : C) (hE : P E) :
    cartierGysin hc hP hT (subcategoryClassOf C P E hE) =
      subcategoryClassOf C (Killed T σ P) (cokernel (ap T σ E)) (killed_cokernel hc hP hT hE) -
        subcategoryClassOf C (Killed T σ P) (kernel (ap T σ E)) (killed_kernel hc hP hT hE)
proof:
:=
  lift_classOf _ _ _

name: ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR1.cartierGysin_classOf_of_mono
statement:
theorem cartierGysin_classOf_of_mono (E : C) (hE : P E) [Mono (ap T σ E)] :
    cartierGysin hc hP hT (subcategoryClassOf C P E hE) =
      subcategoryClassOf C (Killed T σ P) (cokernel (ap T σ E)) (killed_cokernel hc hP hT hE)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cartierGysin_classOf, subcategoryClassOf_isZero C _ _ (isZero_kernel_of_mono _), sub_zero]

name: ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR1.pushDivisor_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pushDivisor_classOf (E : C) (hE : Killed T σ P E) :
    pushDivisor (T := T) (σ := σ) (subcategoryClassOf C (Killed T σ P) E hE) =
      subcategoryClassOf C P E hE.1
proof:
:= by
  simp [pushDivisor, subcategoryClassOf, map]

name: ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR1.cartierGysin_pushDivisor
statement:
theorem cartierGysin_pushDivisor (F : C) (hF : Killed T σ P F) :
    cartierGysin hc hP hT (pushDivisor (T := T) (σ := σ)
        (subcategoryClassOf C (Killed T σ P) F hF)) =
      subcategoryClassOf C (Killed T σ P) F hF -
        subcategoryClassOf C (Killed T σ P) (T.obj F)
          ⟨hT F hF.1, (hc F).trans (by rw [hF.2, T.map_zero])⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hQ := killedClosed (T := T) (σ := σ) hP
  have hTF : Killed T σ P (T.obj F) := ⟨hT F hF.1, (hc F).trans (by rw [hF.2, T.map_zero])⟩
  rw [pushDivisor_classOf, cartierGysin_classOf]
  have e₁ : cokernel (ap T σ F) ≅ F :=
    cokernelIsoOfEq hF.2 ≪≫ (asIso (cokernel.π (0 : T.obj F ⟶ F))).symm
  have e₂ : kernel (ap T σ F) ≅ T.obj F :=
    kernelIsoOfEq hF.2 ≪≫ asIso (kernel.ι (0 : T.obj F ⟶ F))
  rw [classOf_eq_of_iso hQ e₁ (killed_cokernel hc hP hT hF.1) hF,
    classOf_eq_of_iso hQ e₂ (killed_kernel hc hP hT hF.1) hTF]

name: ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR1.pushDivisor_cartierGysin
statement:
theorem pushDivisor_cartierGysin (E : C) (hE : P E) :
    pushDivisor (T := T) (σ := σ) (cartierGysin hc hP hT (subcategoryClassOf C P E hE)) =
      subcategoryClassOf C P E hE - subcategoryClassOf C P (T.obj E) (hT E hE)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cartierGysin_classOf, map_sub, pushDivisor_classOf, pushDivisor_classOf]
  have hQ : P (cokernel (ap T σ E)) := hP.cokernel _ (hT E hE) hE
  have r₁ := classOf_eq_ker_add_ker hP _ (ShortComplex.exact_cokernel (ap T σ E)) (hT E hE) hE hQ
  have r₂ := classOf_eq_ker_add_of_epi hP (cokernel.π (ap T σ E)) hE hQ
  dsimp only at r₁
  rw [r₁, r₂]
  abel

name: ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR1.koszulσ_central
statement:
theorem koszulσ_central (hβ : (β_ Λ Λ).hom = 𝟙 _) :
    Central (tensorLeft Λ) (koszulσ Λ s)
proof:
:= by
  intro E
  have h1 : (s ▷ Λ) ≫ (λ_ Λ).hom = (Λ ◁ s) ≫ (ρ_ Λ).hom := by
    have hn := BraidedCategory.braiding_naturality_left s Λ
    simp only [hβ, Category.id_comp] at hn
    have hn' : (s ▷ Λ) ≫ (λ_ Λ).hom ≫ (ρ_ Λ).inv = Λ ◁ s := by simpa using hn
    calc (s ▷ Λ) ≫ (λ_ Λ).hom = ((s ▷ Λ) ≫ (λ_ Λ).hom ≫ (ρ_ Λ).inv) ≫ (ρ_ Λ).hom := by simp
      _ = _ := by rw [hn']
  change (s ▷ (Λ ⊗ E)) ≫ (λ_ (Λ ⊗ E)).hom = Λ ◁ ((s ▷ E) ≫ (λ_ E).hom)
  have e : s ▷ (Λ ⊗ E) = (α_ Λ Λ E).inv ≫ (s ▷ Λ) ▷ E ≫ (α_ (𝟙_ C) Λ E).hom := by
    rw [Iso.eq_inv_comp]; exact (associator_naturality_left s Λ E).symm
  have lt : (λ_ (Λ ⊗ E)).hom = (α_ (𝟙_ C) Λ E).inv ≫ (λ_ Λ).hom ▷ E := by simp
  rw [e, lt]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  rw [← comp_whiskerRight, h1, comp_whiskerRight, ← triangle, ← Category.assoc ((Λ ◁ s) ▷ E),
    associator_naturality_middle, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, whiskerLeft_comp]

name: ExactGrothendieck.product_assoc_of_classOf
statement:
theorem product_assoc_of_classOf (tensor : Object → Object → Object)
    (exactLeft : ∀ A B C Y, Exact A B C →
      Exact (tensor A Y) (tensor B Y) (tensor C Y))
    (exactRight : ∀ X A B C, Exact A B C →
      Exact (tensor X A) (tensor X B) (tensor X C))
    (hassoc : ∀ X Y Z,
      classOf Object Exact (tensor (tensor X Y) Z) =
        classOf Object Exact (tensor X (tensor Y Z)))
    (x y z : Group Object Exact) :
    product tensor exactLeft exactRight
        (product tensor exactLeft exactRight x y) z =
      product tensor exactLeft exactRight x
        (product tensor exactLeft exactRight y z)
proof:
:= by
  have hObjects (X Y : Object) :
      leftObjectMul tensor exactRight (tensor X Y) =
        (leftObjectMul tensor exactRight X).comp
          (leftObjectMul tensor exactRight Y) := by
    apply hom_ext Object Exact
    intro Z
    simp only [leftObjectMul_classOf, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
    exact hassoc X Y Z
  have hOneObject (X : Object) :
      (rightMul tensor exactLeft exactRight z).comp
          (leftObjectMul tensor exactRight X) =
        (leftObjectMul tensor exactRight X).comp
          (rightMul tensor exactLeft exactRight z) := by
    apply hom_ext Object Exact
    intro Y
    have h := congrArg (fun f : Group Object Exact →+ Group Object Exact => f z)
      (hObjects X Y)
    simpa only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, leftObjectMul_classOf, rightMul_apply,
      product_classOf_left] using h
  have hAll :
      (rightMul tensor exactLeft exactRight z).comp
          (rightMul tensor exactLeft exactRight y) =
        rightMul tensor exactLeft exactRight
          (product tensor exactLeft exactRight y z) := by
    apply hom_ext Object Exact
    intro X
    have h := congrArg (fun f : Group Object Exact →+ Group Object Exact => f y)
      (hOneObject X)
    simpa only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, rightMul_apply, product_classOf_left] using h
  exact congrArg (fun f : Group Object Exact →+ Group Object Exact => f x) hAll

name: ExactGrothendieck.product_comm_of_classOf
statement:
theorem product_comm_of_classOf (tensor : Object → Object → Object)
    (exactLeft : ∀ A B C Y, Exact A B C →
      Exact (tensor A Y) (tensor B Y) (tensor C Y))
    (exactRight : ∀ X A B C, Exact A B C →
      Exact (tensor X A) (tensor X B) (tensor X C))
    (hcomm : ∀ X Y,
      classOf Object Exact (tensor X Y) = classOf Object Exact (tensor Y X))
    (x y : Group Object Exact) :
    product tensor exactLeft exactRight x y =
      product tensor exactLeft exactRight y x
proof:
:= by
  have h : productHom tensor exactLeft exactRight =
      flipProductHom tensor exactLeft exactRight := by
    apply hom_ext Object Exact
    intro X
    apply hom_ext Object Exact
    intro Y
    simp only [productHom, lift_classOf, leftObjectMul_classOf, flipProductHom_apply,
      product_classOf_classOf]
    exact hcomm X Y
  exact congrArg (fun f : Group Object Exact →+ (Group Object Exact →+ Group Object Exact) =>
    f x y) h

name: ExactGrothendieck.product_one_left_of_classOf
statement:
theorem product_one_left_of_classOf (tensor : Object → Object → Object)
    (exactLeft : ∀ A B C Y, Exact A B C →
      Exact (tensor A Y) (tensor B Y) (tensor C Y))
    (exactRight : ∀ X A B C, Exact A B C →
      Exact (tensor X A) (tensor X B) (tensor X C))
    (unit : Object)
    (hunit : ∀ X, classOf Object Exact (tensor unit X) = classOf Object Exact X)
    (x : Group Object Exact) :
    product tensor exactLeft exactRight (classOf Object Exact unit) x = x
proof:
:= by
  have h : leftObjectMul tensor exactRight unit =
      AddMonoidHom.id (Group Object Exact) := by
    apply hom_ext Object Exact
    intro X
    simpa only [leftObjectMul_classOf, AddMonoidHom.id_apply] using hunit X
  simpa only [product_classOf_left, AddMonoidHom.id_apply] using
    congrArg (fun f : Group Object Exact →+ Group Object Exact => f x) h

name: ExactGrothendieck.product_one_right_of_classOf
statement:
theorem product_one_right_of_classOf (tensor : Object → Object → Object)
    (exactLeft : ∀ A B C Y, Exact A B C →
      Exact (tensor A Y) (tensor B Y) (tensor C Y))
    (exactRight : ∀ X A B C, Exact A B C →
      Exact (tensor X A) (tensor X B) (tensor X C))
    (unit : Object)
    (hunit : ∀ X, classOf Object Exact (tensor X unit) = classOf Object Exact X)
    (x : Group Object Exact) :
    product tensor exactLeft exactRight x (classOf Object Exact unit) = x
proof:
:= by
  have h : rightMul tensor exactLeft exactRight (classOf Object Exact unit) =
      AddMonoidHom.id (Group Object Exact) := by
    apply hom_ext Object Exact
    intro X
    simpa only [rightMul_apply, product_classOf_classOf, AddMonoidHom.id_apply] using hunit X
  simpa only [rightMul_apply, AddMonoidHom.id_apply] using
    congrArg (fun f : Group Object Exact →+ Group Object Exact => f x) h

name: ExactGrothendieck.CommutativeTensorData.lift_product
statement:
theorem lift_product {A : Type v} [CommRing A] (c : Object → A)
    (hadd : ∀ X Y Z, Exact X Y Z → c Y = c X + c Z)
    (hmul : ∀ X Y, c (T.tensor X Y) = c X * c Y)
    (x y : Group Object Exact) :
    lift c hadd (T.mul x y) = lift c hadd x * lift c hadd y
proof:
:= by
  let L := lift c hadd
  let rObject (X : Object) : Group Object Exact →+ A := {
    toFun := fun z ↦ c X * L z
    map_zero' := by simp
    map_add' := by simp [mul_add] }
  have hObject (X : Object) :
      L.comp (leftObjectMul T.tensor T.exactRight X) = rObject X := by
    apply hom_ext Object Exact
    intro Y
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, leftObjectMul_classOf]
    change L (classOf Object Exact (T.tensor X Y)) =
      rObject X (classOf Object Exact Y)
    rw [show rObject X (classOf Object Exact Y) =
      c X * L (classOf Object Exact Y) from rfl]
    simp only [L, lift_classOf]
    exact hmul X Y
  let rAll : Group Object Exact →+ A := {
    toFun := fun z ↦ L z * L y
    map_zero' := by simp
    map_add' := by simp [add_mul] }
  have hAll :
      L.comp (rightMul T.tensor T.exactLeft T.exactRight y) = rAll := by
    apply hom_ext Object Exact
    intro X
    have h := congrArg (fun f : Group Object Exact →+ A ↦ f y) (hObject X)
    change L (T.mul (classOf Object Exact X) y) =
      L (classOf Object Exact X) * L y
    rw [CommutativeTensorData.mul, product_classOf_left]
    rw [show L (classOf Object Exact X) = c X by
      simp only [L, lift_classOf]]
    change L (leftObjectMul T.tensor T.exactRight X y) = rObject X y at h
    rw [show rObject X y = c X * L y from rfl] at h
    exact h
  exact congrArg (fun f : Group Object Exact →+ A ↦ f x) hAll

name: ExactGrothendieck.CommutativeTensorData.lift_one

theorem lift_one {A : Type v} [CommRing A] (c : Object → A)
    (hadd : ∀ X Y Z, Exact X Y Z → c Y = c X + c Z)
    (hone : c T.unit = 1) : lift c hadd T.one = 1
proof:
:= by
  change lift c hadd (classOf Object Exact T.unit) = 1
  rw [lift_classOf]
  exact hone

name: ExactGrothendieck.CommutativeTensorData.ringLift_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ringLift_classOf {A : Type v} [CommRing A] (c : Object → A)
    (hadd : ∀ X Y Z, Exact X Y Z → c Y = c X + c Z)
    (hmul : ∀ X Y, c (T.tensor X Y) = c X * c Y)
    (hone : c T.unit = 1) (X : Object) :
    letI
proof:
:= T.commRing
    ringLift T c hadd hmul hone (classOf Object Exact X) = c X := by
  letI := T.commRing
  exact lift_classOf c hadd X

name: ARRG45C.k0ToG0_pullbackK0

proof:
:= by

    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    intro E
    change k0ToG0 X (pullbackK0 f (k0ClassOf Y E.1 E.2)) =
      flatPullbackG0 f (k0ToG0 Y (k0ClassOf Y E.1 E.2))

name: ARRG45C.finitePushforward_comp
statement:
theorem finitePushforward_comp (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ W) [IsFinite f] [IsFinite g] :
    finitePushforward (f ≫ g) = (finitePushforward g).comp (finitePushforward f)
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
  intro x
  change finitePushforward (f ≫ g) (g0ClassOf X x.1 x.2) =
    finitePushforward g (finitePushforward f (g0ClassOf X x.1 x.2))
  rw [finitePushforward_classOf, finitePushforward_classOf, finitePushforward_classOf]
  exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso W.Modules (IsCoherentLike W) _ _
    (show IsCoherentLike W (0 : W.Modules) from
      inferInstanceAs (0 : W.Modules).IsFinitePresentation)

name: ARRG45C.flatPullbackG0_finitePushforward_opens
statement:
theorem flatPullbackG0_finitePushforward_opens (F : W ⟶ M) [IsFinite F] (U : M.Opens)
    [IsLocallyNoetherian U] (x : G0 W) :
    flatPullbackG0 U.ι (finitePushforward F x) =
      finitePushforward (F ∣_ U) (flatPullbackG0 (F ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι x)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (flatPullbackG0 U.ι).comp (finitePushforward F) =
      (finitePushforward (F ∣_ U)).comp (flatPullbackG0 (F ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι) := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    intro E
    change flatPullbackG0 U.ι (finitePushforward F (g0ClassOf W E.1 E.2)) =
      finitePushforward (F ∣_ U) (flatPullbackG0 (F ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι (g0ClassOf W E.1 E.2))
    rw [finitePushforward_classOf, flatPullbackG0_classOf, flatPullbackG0_classOf,
      finitePushforward_classOf]
    exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso _ (IsCoherentLike _) _ _
      (show IsCoherentLike U (0 : U.toScheme.Modules) from
        inferInstanceAs (0 : U.toScheme.Modules).IsFinitePresentation)
      (isZero_zero _) (pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso F U E.1)
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h x

name: ARRG45C.flatPullbackG0_finitePushforward_openSquare
statement:
theorem flatPullbackG0_finitePushforward_openSquare
    {L W W' : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian L] [IsLocallyNoetherian W']
    {j : L ⟶ M} [IsOpenImmersion j] {F : W ⟶ M} {j' : W' ⟶ W} [IsOpenImmersion j']
    {F' : W' ⟶ L} [IsFinite F] [IsFinite F'] (h : IsPullback j' F' F j) (x : G0 W) :
    flatPullbackG0 j (finitePushforward F x) = finitePushforward F' (flatPullbackG0 j' x)
proof:
:= by
  let U : M.Opens := j.opensRange
  let e : L ≅ U.toScheme := j.isoOpensRange
  have he : e.hom ≫ U.ι = j := j.isoOpensRange_hom_ι
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian U := inferInstance
  have hV : IsPullback (F ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι (F ∣_ U) F U.ι := (isPullback_morphismRestrict F U).flip
  have hV' : IsPullback (F ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι (F ∣_ U ≫ e.inv) F j := by
    refine hV.of_iso (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) e.symm (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · simp
    · simp
    · simp
    · simp [← he]
  let d : W' ≅ (F ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme := h.isoIsPullback _ _ hV'
  have hd1 : d.hom ≫ (F ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι = j' := h.isoIsPullback_hom_fst _ _ hV'
  have hd2 : d.hom ≫ (F ∣_ U ≫ e.inv) = F' := h.isoIsPullback_hom_snd _ _ hV'
  have hc : F ∣_ U ≫ e.inv = d.inv ≫ F' := by
    rw [← hd2, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  have hj : flatPullbackG0 j = (flatPullbackG0 e.hom).comp (flatPullbackG0 U.ι) := by
    rw [← GLocalisationSpec.flatPullbackG0_comp, GLocalisationSpec.flatPullbackG0_congr he]
  have hj' : flatPullbackG0 j' = (flatPullbackG0 d.hom).comp (flatPullbackG0 (F ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι) := by
    rw [← GLocalisationSpec.flatPullbackG0_comp, GLocalisationSpec.flatPullbackG0_congr hd1]
  rw [hj, hj', AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply,
    flatPullbackG0_finitePushforward_opens F U x,
    flatPullbackG0_iso_eq_finitePushforward_inv e,
    flatPullbackG0_iso_eq_finitePushforward_inv d]
  have A := DFunLike.congr_fun (finitePushforward_comp (F ∣_ U) e.inv)
    (flatPullbackG0 (F ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι x)
  have B := DFunLike.congr_fun (finitePushforward_comp d.inv F')
    (flatPullbackG0 (F ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι x)
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply] at A B
  rw [← A, ← B, finitePushforward_congr hc]

name: SchemeKTheory.hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf
statement: theorem hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf : HasConstantRank Y (tensorUnitSheaf Y) 1
proof:
:= by
  let q := (SheafOfModules.free.generatingSections
    (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) PUnit.{u + 1}).localGeneratorsData
  refine ⟨q.ofEpi (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)).hom, inferInstance,
    inferInstance, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  change Nat.card PUnit = 1
  exact Nat.card_unique

name: SchemeKTheory.hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf {M N : Y.Modules} {r s : ℕ} (hM : HasConstantRank Y M r)
    (hN : HasConstantRank Y N s) : HasConstantRank Y (tensorSheaf Y M N) (r * s)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨qM, hqM, hqMfin, hcM⟩ := hM
  obtain ⟨qN, hqN, hqNfin, hcN⟩ := hN
  letI : qM.IsLocallyFreeData := hqM
  letI : qN.IsLocallyFreeData := hqN
  letI : qM.IsFiniteType := hqMfin
  letI : qN.IsFiniteType := hqNfin
  refine ⟨tensorLocalGeneratorsData Y qM qN, inferInstance, inferInstance, fun p ↦ ?_⟩
  change Nat.card (Σ _ : (qM.generators p.1).I, (qN.generators p.2).I) = r * s
  rw [Nat.card_congr (Equiv.sigmaEquivProd _ _), Nat.card_prod, hcM, hcN]

name: ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.twistBy_eq
statement: theorem twistBy_eq (M W : Y.Modules) : twistBy M W = tensorSheaf Y W M

name: ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.hasConstantRank_twistBy
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_twistBy {W : Y.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hW : HasConstantRank Y W r) :
    HasConstantRank Y (twistBy M W) r
proof:
:= by
  have := hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hW hM
  rw [Nat.mul_one] at this

name: ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.k0ClassOf_twistBy

theorem k0ClassOf_twistBy {W : Y.Modules} (hW : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y W)

    k0ClassOf Y (twistBy M W) hWM =
      k0ClassOf Y W hW * k0ClassOf Y M hM.isFiniteLocallyFree
proof:
:= by

name: SchemeKTheory.hasConstantRank_tensor_line
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_tensor_line {L L' : W.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank W L 1)
    (hL' : HasConstantRank W L' 1) : HasConstantRank W (tensorSheaf W L' L) 1
proof:
:= by

  rwa [Nat.mul_one] at this

name: SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf_mul_line
statement:
theorem k0ClassOf_mul_line {L L' : W.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank W L 1)
    (hL' : HasConstantRank W L' 1) :
    k0ClassOf W L' hL'.isFiniteLocallyFree * k0ClassOf W L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree =
      k0ClassOf W (tensorSheaf W L' L) (hasConstantRank_tensor_line hL hL').isFiniteLocallyFree
proof:
:=
  (ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.k0ClassOf_twistBy L hL hL'.isFiniteLocallyFree
    (hasConstantRank_tensor_line hL hL').isFiniteLocallyFree).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackAffineRefinement_comm
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem pullbackAffineRefinement_comm (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (i : (pullbackAffineRefinement f).I₀) :
    (pullbackAffineRefinement f).f i ≫ f =
      pullbackAffineRefinementToTarget f i ≫
        Y.affineOpenCover.openCover.f
          ((pullbackOpenCover f).fromAffineRefinement.s₀ i)
proof:
:= by
  have hp :
      Y.affineOpenCover.openCover.pullbackHom f
            ((pullbackOpenCover f).fromAffineRefinement.s₀ i) ≫
          Y.affineOpenCover.openCover.f
            ((pullbackOpenCover f).fromAffineRefinement.s₀ i) =
        (pullbackOpenCover f).f
            ((pullbackOpenCover f).fromAffineRefinement.s₀ i) ≫ f := by
    exact Scheme.Cover.pullbackHom_map
      Y.affineOpenCover.openCover f
        ((pullbackOpenCover f).fromAffineRefinement.s₀ i)
  have hw :
      (pullbackOpenCover f).fromAffineRefinement.h₀ i ≫
          (pullbackOpenCover f).f
            ((pullbackOpenCover f).fromAffineRefinement.s₀ i) =
        (pullbackAffineRefinement f).f i := by
    exact (pullbackOpenCover f).fromAffineRefinement.w₀ i
  change (pullbackAffineRefinement f).f i ≫ f =
    ((pullbackOpenCover f).fromAffineRefinement.h₀ i ≫
      Y.affineOpenCover.openCover.pullbackHom f
        ((pullbackOpenCover f).fromAffineRefinement.s₀ i)) ≫
      Y.affineOpenCover.openCover.f
        ((pullbackOpenCover f).fromAffineRefinement.s₀ i)
  rw [← hw]
  simp only [Category.assoc, hp]
  exact Category.assoc _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isOpenImmersion_of_comp_eq

    [IsOpenImmersion h] [IsOpenImmersion k] (w : g ≫ h = k) : IsOpenImmersion g
