name: AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackAffineRefinementToTarget_flat_aux
statement:
theorem pullbackAffineRefinementToTarget_flat_aux
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [Flat f]
    (i : (pullbackAffineRefinement f).I₀) :
    Flat (pullbackAffineRefinementToTarget f i)
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsOpenImmersion
      ((pullbackOpenCover f).fromAffineRefinement.h₀ i) :=
    isOpenImmersion_of_comp_eq _ _ _ ((pullbackOpenCover f).fromAffineRefinement.w₀ i)
  change Flat
    ((pullbackOpenCover f).fromAffineRefinement.h₀ i ≫
      Y.affineOpenCover.openCover.pullbackHom f
        ((pullbackOpenCover f).fromAffineRefinement.s₀ i))
  apply MorphismProperty.comp_mem (@Flat)
  · infer_instance
  · exact MorphismProperty.pullback_snd _ _ inferInstance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.pullback_isFinitePresentation_global
statement:
theorem pullback_isFinitePresentation_global (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (M : Y.Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  let P := (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M
  let C := pullbackAffineRefinement f
  let U : C.I₀ → X.Opens := fun i ↦ (C.f i).opensRange
  have hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop U :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := X) U).2
      C.openCover.isOpenCover_opensRange
  letI : ∀ i, (P.over (U i)).IsFinitePresentation := fun i ↦ by
    let q := C.f i
    let j := (pullbackOpenCover f).fromAffineRefinement.s₀ i
    let v := Y.affineOpenCover.openCover.f j
    let g := pullbackAffineRefinementToTarget f i
    let MV := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).obj M
    letI : MV.IsFinitePresentation :=
      isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor v M
    let MG := (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj MV
    letI : MG.IsFinitePresentation :=
      pullback_isFinitePresentation_of_isAffine g MV
    let PQ := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj P
    let eQ : PQ ≅ MG :=
      (pullbackAffineRefinementNatIso f i).app M
    letI : PQ.IsFinitePresentation :=
      (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation
        (Spec (C.X i)).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso eQ.symm inferInstance
    let PE := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q.isoOpensRange.inv).obj PQ
    letI : PE.IsFinitePresentation :=
      isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor q.isoOpensRange.inv PQ
    let R := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι).obj P
    let eR : PE ≅ R :=
      (restrictToOpensRangeNatIso q).app P
    letI : R.IsFinitePresentation :=
      (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation
        (U i).toScheme.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso eR inferInstance
    let N := (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).inverse.obj R
    letI : N.IsFinitePresentation :=
      isFinitePresentation_overEquiv_inverse (U i) R
    let eN : P.over (U i) ≅ N :=
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).unitIso.app (P.over (U i)) ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).inverse.mapIso
          ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv (U i)).app P)
    exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation
      (X.ringCatSheaf.over (U i))).prop_of_iso eN.symm inferInstance
  exact SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation_of_over_cover P U hU

name: AlgebraicGeometry.pullback_map_shortExact_global
statement:
theorem pullback_map_shortExact_global (f : X ⟶ Y) [Flat f]
    (T : ShortComplex Y.Modules)
    [T.X₁.IsQuasicoherent] [T.X₂.IsQuasicoherent] [T.X₃.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hT : T.ShortExact) :
    (T.map (Scheme.Modules.pullback f)).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  let P := T.map (Scheme.Modules.pullback f)
  let C := pullbackAffineRefinement f
  let U : C.I₀ → X.Opens := fun i ↦ (C.f i).opensRange
  have hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop U :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := X) U).2
      C.openCover.isOpenCover_opensRange
  apply Scheme.Modules.shortExact_of_restrict_cover X P U hU
  intro i
  let q := C.f i
  let j := (pullbackOpenCover f).fromAffineRefinement.s₀ i
  let v := Y.affineOpenCover.openCover.f j
  let g := pullbackAffineRefinementToTarget f i
  let TV := T.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v)
  have hTV : TV.ShortExact :=
    Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor_map_shortExact v T hT
  letI : TV.X₁.IsQuasicoherent := by
    change ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).obj T.X₁).IsQuasicoherent
    infer_instance
  letI : TV.X₂.IsQuasicoherent := by
    change ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).obj T.X₂).IsQuasicoherent
    infer_instance
  letI : TV.X₃.IsQuasicoherent := by
    change ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).obj T.X₃).IsQuasicoherent
    infer_instance
  have hG : (TV.map (Scheme.Modules.pullback g)).ShortExact :=
    pullback_map_shortExact_of_isAffine g TV hTV
  have hright :
      (T.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v ⋙
        Scheme.Modules.pullback g)).ShortExact := by
    simpa only [TV, ShortComplex.map_comp] using hG
  have hleft :
      (T.map (Scheme.Modules.pullback f ⋙
        Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q)).ShortExact :=
    ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso
      (T.mapNatIso (pullbackAffineRefinementNatIso f i)).symm hright
  have hq : (P.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q)).ShortExact := by
    simpa only [P, ShortComplex.map_comp] using hleft
  have he :
      ((P.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q)).map
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q.isoOpensRange.inv)).ShortExact :=
    Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor_map_shortExact
      q.isoOpensRange.inv (P.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q)) hq
  have hcomp :
      (P.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q ⋙
        Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q.isoOpensRange.inv)).ShortExact := by
    simpa only [ShortComplex.map_comp] using he
  exact ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso
    (P.mapNatIso (restrictToOpensRangeNatIso q)) hcomp

name: SchemeKTheory.flatPullbackObject_exact
statement:
theorem flatPullbackObject_exact (f : X ⟶ Y) [Flat f]
    (A B C : {M : Y.Modules // IsCoherentLike Y M})
    (h : ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn Y.Modules
      (IsCoherentLike Y) A B C) :
    ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules
      (IsCoherentLike X) (flatPullbackObject f A)
      (flatPullbackObject f B) (flatPullbackObject f C)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, zero, hshort⟩ := h
  letI : A.1.IsFinitePresentation := A.2
  letI : B.1.IsFinitePresentation := B.2
  letI : C.1.IsFinitePresentation := C.2
  let T : ShortComplex Y.Modules := ShortComplex.mk a b zero
  let P := T.map (Scheme.Modules.pullback f)
  exact ⟨P.f, P.g, P.zero,
    pullback_map_shortExact_global f T hshort⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.flatPullbackG0_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem flatPullbackG0_classOf (f : X ⟶ Y) [Flat f]
    (E : Y.Modules) (hE : IsCoherentLike Y E) :
    flatPullbackG0 f (g0ClassOf Y E hE) =
      g0ClassOf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E)
        (by
          letI : E.IsFinitePresentation := hE
          exact pullback_isFinitePresentation_global f E)
proof:
:= by
  exact ExactGrothendieck.map_classOf (flatPullbackObject f)
    (flatPullbackObject_exact f) ⟨E, hE⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.hasConstantRank_pullback
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_pullback {Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ Z) (M : Z.Modules) (r : ℕ)
    (h : HasConstantRank Z M r) :
    HasConstantRank Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M) r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin, hcard⟩ := h
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := hqfin
  let C := pullbackLocalGeneratorsOpenCover f q
  let I : C.I₀ → Type u := fun i ↦ (q.generators i).I
  letI : ∀ i, Finite (I i) := fun i ↦ by
    letI : (q.generators i).IsFiniteType :=
      SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType i
    dsimp only [I]
    infer_instance
  refine ⟨freeTrivializedOpenCoverLocalGeneratorsData C ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M) I
      (pullbackLocalGeneratorsOpenCoverIso f q), inferInstance, inferInstance, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  exact hcard i

name: SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctor_iso_hom_faithful
statement:
theorem restrictFunctor_iso_hom_faithful
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (e : X ≅ Y) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor e.hom).Faithful
proof:
:= by
  exact Functor.Faithful.of_comp_iso
    (F := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor e.hom)
    (G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor e.inv)
    (H := 𝟭 Y.Modules)
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp e.inv e.hom).symm ≪≫
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr e.inv_hom_id ≪≫
        Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorId)

theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_of_openCover_unitTrivializations

name: SheafOfModules.pushforward_isRightAdjoint_of_equivalence
statement:
theorem SheafOfModules.pushforward_isRightAdjoint_of_equivalence (eqv : C ≌ D)
    [Functor.IsContinuous eqv.functor J K] [Functor.IsContinuous eqv.inverse K J]
    (φ : S ⟶ (eqv.functor.sheafPushforwardContinuous RingCat.{u} J K).obj R)
    (ψ : R ⟶ (eqv.inverse.sheafPushforwardContinuous RingCat.{u} K J).obj S)
    (H₁ : Functor.whiskerRight (NatTrans.op eqv.counit) R.obj =
      ψ.hom ≫ eqv.inverse.op.whiskerLeft φ.hom)
    (H₂ : φ.hom ≫ eqv.functor.op.whiskerLeft ψ.hom ≫
      Functor.whiskerRight (NatTrans.op eqv.unit) S.obj = 𝟙 S.obj) :
    (SheafOfModules.pushforward.{v} ψ).IsRightAdjoint
proof:
:=
  (SheafOfModules.pushforwardPushforwardEquivalence eqv φ ψ H₁ H₂).isRightAdjoint_inverse

name: QCExtension.extensionToPushforward_restrict_isIso
statement:
theorem extensionToPushforward_restrict_isIso (E : T.Modules) (F : S.Modules)
    (e : E.restrict q ≅ F) :
    IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map (extensionToPushforward q E F e))
proof:
:= by
  let adj := Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q
  have h : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
      (extensionToPushforward q E F e)) ≫ adj.counit.app F = e.hom := by
    change (adj.homEquiv E F).symm (adj.homEquiv E F e.hom) = e.hom
    exact (adj.homEquiv E F).symm_apply_apply e.hom
  haveI : IsIso (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
      (extensionToPushforward q E F e)) ≫ adj.counit.app F) := by
    rw [h]
    infer_instance
  exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map (extensionToPushforward q E F e))
    (adj.counit.app F)

name: QCExtension.chartToOpen_comp_ι
statement:
lemma chartToOpen_comp_ι (U W : X.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W) :

name: QCExtension.exists_extension_compatible_with_global_pushforward
statement:
theorem exists_extension_compatible_with_global_pushforward (U W : X.Opens)
    (hW : IsAffineOpen W) [IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, W)]
    (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X)) (F : (U : Scheme.{u}).Modules)
    [F.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ E : (W : Scheme.{u}).Modules, E.IsFinitePresentation ∧
      Nonempty (E.restrict (chartToOpen U W hW) ≅
        (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).obj F).restrict W.ι).restrict
          (chartToOpen U W hW))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E, hE, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_extension_on_affine_chart U W hW hU F
  exact ⟨E, hE, ⟨e ≪≫ (globalPushforward_chartRestrictionIso U W hW F).symm⟩⟩

name: QCExtension.exists_extension_on_affine_chart_with_map
statement:
theorem exists_extension_on_affine_chart_with_map (U W : X.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
    [IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, W)] (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X))
    (F : (U : Scheme.{u}).Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ E : (W : Scheme.{u}).Modules, E.IsFinitePresentation ∧
      ∃ φ : E ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (chartToOpen U W hW)).obj
          (F.restrict (chartToU U W hW)),
        IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (chartToOpen U W hW)).map φ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E, hE, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_extension_on_affine_chart U W hW hU F
  exact ⟨E, hE, extensionToPushforward (chartToOpen U W hW) E
    (F.restrict (chartToU U W hW)) e,
    extensionToPushforward_restrict_isIso (chartToOpen U W hW) E
      (F.restrict (chartToU U W hW)) e⟩

name: GLocalisationOpen.surjective_of_classOf_mem_range
statement:
theorem surjective_of_classOf_mem_range {Object : Type*}
    {Exact : Object → Object → Object → Prop} {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A]
    (φ : A →+ ExactGrothendieck.Group Object Exact)
    (h : ∀ x, ExactGrothendieck.classOf Object Exact x ∈ φ.range) :
    Function.Surjective φ
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  induction z using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with | H f => ?_
  suffices hf : (QuotientAddGroup.mk f : ExactGrothendieck.Group Object Exact) ∈ φ.range from hf
  induction f using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => exact zero_mem _
  | add f g hf hg =>
    rw [QuotientAddGroup.mk_add]
    exact add_mem hf hg
  | single x n =>
    have : (QuotientAddGroup.mk (Finsupp.single x n) : ExactGrothendieck.Group Object Exact) =
        n • ExactGrothendieck.classOf Object Exact x := by
      rw [ExactGrothendieck.classOf, QuotientAddGroup.mk'_apply, ← QuotientAddGroup.mk_zsmul,
        Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    rw [this]
    exact zsmul_mem (h x) n

name: GLocalisationOpen.flatPullbackG0_opens_ι_surjective
statement:
theorem flatPullbackG0_opens_ι_surjective {R : CommRingCat.{u}} [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (V : (Spec R).Opens) : Function.Surjective (flatPullbackG0 V.ι)
proof:
:= by
  apply surjective_of_classOf_mem_range
  rintro ⟨F, hF⟩
  haveI : F.IsFinitePresentation := hF
  have hV : IsCompact (V : Set (Spec R)) := TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace.isCompact _
  obtain ⟨E, hE, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_extension_of_isCompact V hV F
  refine ⟨g0ClassOf (Spec R) E hE, ?_⟩
  rw [flatPullbackG0_classOf]
  exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso _ (IsCoherentLike (V : Scheme.{u}))
    _ hF (show IsCoherentLike (V : Scheme.{u}) (0 : (V : Scheme.{u}).Modules) from
      inferInstanceAs (0 : (V : Scheme.{u}).Modules).IsFinitePresentation) (Limits.isZero_zero _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.pullback_isFinitePresentation_of_isAffine
statement:
theorem pullback_isFinitePresentation_of_isAffine (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : Y.Modules)
    [M.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  let MY := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor Y.isoSpec.inv).obj M
  letI : MY.IsFinitePresentation :=
    isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor Y.isoSpec.inv M
  let P := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map f.appTop)).obj MY
  letI : P.IsFinitePresentation :=
    pullback_specMap_isFinitePresentation f.appTop.hom MY
  let Q := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor X.isoSpec.hom).obj P
  letI : Q.IsFinitePresentation :=
    isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor X.isoSpec.hom P
  letI : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor Y.isoSpec.inv ⋙
      Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map f.appTop) ⋙
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor X.isoSpec.hom).obj M).IsFinitePresentation := by
    change Q.IsFinitePresentation
    infer_instance
  exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation X.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
    ((affineSchemePullbackNatIso f).app M).symm inferInstance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.pullback_map_shortExact_of_isAffine
statement:
theorem pullback_map_shortExact_of_isAffine (f : X ⟶ Y) [Flat f]
    (T : ShortComplex Y.Modules)
    [T.X₁.IsQuasicoherent] [T.X₂.IsQuasicoherent] [T.X₃.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hT : T.ShortExact) :
    (T.map (Scheme.Modules.pullback f)).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  let RY := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor Y.isoSpec.inv
  let P := Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map f.appTop)
  let RX := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor X.isoSpec.hom
  have hRY : (T.map RY).ShortExact :=
    Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor_map_shortExact Y.isoSpec.inv T hT
  letI : (T.map RY).X₁.IsQuasicoherent := by
    change ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor Y.isoSpec.inv).obj T.X₁).IsQuasicoherent
    infer_instance
  letI : (T.map RY).X₂.IsQuasicoherent := by
    change ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor Y.isoSpec.inv).obj T.X₂).IsQuasicoherent
    infer_instance
  letI : (T.map RY).X₃.IsQuasicoherent := by
    change ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor Y.isoSpec.inv).obj T.X₃).IsQuasicoherent
    infer_instance
  have hP : ((T.map RY).map P).ShortExact :=
    pullback_specMap_map_shortExact f.appTop.hom f.flat_appTop (T.map RY) hRY
  have hRX : (((T.map RY).map P).map RX).ShortExact :=
    Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor_map_shortExact X.isoSpec.hom
      ((T.map RY).map P) hP
  have hcomp : (T.map (RY ⋙ P ⋙ RX)).ShortExact := by
    simpa only [ShortComplex.map_comp] using hRX
  exact ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso
    (T.mapNatIso (affineSchemePullbackNatIso f)).symm hcomp

name: SchemeKTheory.affineSchemePullbackObject_exact
statement:
theorem affineSchemePullbackObject_exact (f : X ⟶ Y) [Flat f]
    (A B C : {E : Y.Modules // IsCoherentLike Y E})
    (h : ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn Y.Modules (IsCoherentLike Y) A B C) :
    ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules (IsCoherentLike X)
      (affineSchemePullbackObject f A) (affineSchemePullbackObject f B)
      (affineSchemePullbackObject f C)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, zero, hshort⟩ := h
  let T : ShortComplex Y.Modules := ShortComplex.mk a b zero
  let P := T.map (Scheme.Modules.pullback f)
  letI : A.1.IsFinitePresentation := A.2
  letI : B.1.IsFinitePresentation := B.2
  letI : C.1.IsFinitePresentation := C.2
  exact ⟨P.f, P.g, P.zero,
    pullback_map_shortExact_of_isAffine f T hshort⟩

theorem affineSchemePullbackG0_classOf (f : X ⟶ Y) [Flat f]

      g0ClassOf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E)
        (by letI : E.IsFinitePresentation := hE
            exact pullback_isFinitePresentation_of_isAffine f E)
proof:

    (affineSchemePullbackObject_exact f) ⟨E, hE⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.eulerChar_additive_of_finite
statement:
theorem eulerChar_additive_of_finite (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (h₁ : S.X₁.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (h₂ : S.X₂.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (h₃ : S.X₃.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k) :
    S.X₂.eulerChar k = S.X₁.eulerChar k + S.X₃.eulerChar k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := h₁.vanishing
  obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂⟩ := h₂.vanishing
  obtain ⟨N₃, hN₃⟩ := h₃.vanishing
  let N := max N₁ (max N₂ N₃)
  have hX₁ : ∀ n, N < n → Subsingleton (S.X₁.H n) := by
    intro n hn
    exact hN₁ n (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left N₁ (max N₂ N₃)) hn)
  have hX₂ : ∀ n, N < n → Subsingleton (S.X₂.H n) := by
    intro n hn
    exact hN₂ n (lt_of_le_of_lt
      ((le_max_left N₂ N₃).trans (le_max_right N₁ (max N₂ N₃))) hn)
  have hX₃ : ∀ n, N < n → Subsingleton (S.X₃.H n) := by
    intro n hn
    exact hN₃ n (lt_of_le_of_lt
      ((le_max_right N₂ N₃).trans (le_max_right N₁ (max N₂ N₃))) hn)
  exact eulerChar_additive k S hS h₁.finite h₂.finite h₃.finite hX₁ hX₂ hX₃

theorem k0Euler_classOf
    (hfinite : ∀ (E : X.Modules), IsFiniteLocallyFree X E →

name: SchemeKTheory.eulerChar_free_fin
statement:
theorem eulerChar_free_fin
    (hfinite : ∀ (E : X.Modules), IsFiniteLocallyFree X E →
      E.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (n : ℕ) :
    Scheme.Modules.eulerChar k
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin n))) =
      n • Scheme.Modules.eulerChar k (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsFiniteLocallyFree X
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin n))) :=
    free_isFiniteLocallyFree X (ULift.{u} (Fin n))
  letI : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) :=
    unit_isFiniteLocallyFree X
  have h := congrArg (k0Euler k hfinite) (k0Class_free_fin X n)
  simpa only [k0Euler_classOf, map_nsmul] using h

name: SchemeKTheory.g0Euler_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem g0Euler_classOf
    (hfinite : ∀ (E : X.Modules), E.IsFinitePresentation →
      E.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (E : X.Modules) [E.IsFinitePresentation] :

name: SchemeKTheory.g0Euler_comp_k0ToG0
statement:
theorem g0Euler_comp_k0ToG0
    (hfinite : ∀ (E : X.Modules), E.IsFinitePresentation →
      E.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k) :
    (g0Euler k hfinite).comp (k0ToG0 X) =
      k0Euler k (fun E hE ↦ hfinite E hE.isFinitePresentation)
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
  intro E
  change g0Euler k hfinite
      (k0ToG0 X (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ E)) =
    k0Euler k (fun E hE ↦ hfinite E hE.isFinitePresentation)
      (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ E)
  rw [show ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ E = k0ClassOf X E.1 E.2 from rfl]
  rw [k0ToG0_classOf]
  change (ExactGrothendieck.lift
      (fun E : {M : X.Modules // IsCoherentLike X M} ↦ E.1.eulerChar k) _)
        (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ ⟨E.1, E.2.isFinitePresentation⟩) =
    (ExactGrothendieck.lift
      (fun E : {M : X.Modules // IsFiniteLocallyFree X M} ↦ E.1.eulerChar k) _)
        (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ E)
  rw [ExactGrothendieck.lift_classOf, ExactGrothendieck.lift_classOf]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.shortExact_middle_isFinitePresentation
statement:
theorem shortExact_middle_isFinitePresentation
    (T : ShortComplex (Spec R).Modules)
    [T.X₁.IsQuasicoherent] [T.X₂.IsQuasicoherent] [T.X₃.IsQuasicoherent]
    [T.X₁.IsFinitePresentation] [T.X₃.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hT : T.ShortExact) :
    T.X₂.IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  let G := T.map (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor R)
  have hG : G.ShortExact :=
    (moduleSpecΓ_map_shortExact_iff T).mpr hT
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R G.X₁ := by
    change Module.FinitePresentation R (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj T.X₁)
    exact moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation T.X₁
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R G.X₃ := by
    change Module.FinitePresentation R (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj T.X₃)
    exact moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation T.X₃
  let e : G.X₁ ≃ₗ[R] LinearMap.ker G.g.hom :=
    (LinearEquiv.ofInjective G.f.hom hG.moduleCat_injective_f).trans
      (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ hG.exact.moduleCat_range_eq_ker)
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R (LinearMap.ker G.g.hom) :=
    Module.FinitePresentation.of_equiv e
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R G.X₂ :=
    Module.finitePresentation_of_ker G.g.hom hG.moduleCat_surjective_g
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj T.X₂) := by
    change Module.FinitePresentation R G.X₂
    infer_instance
  exact isFinitePresentation_of_moduleSpecΓ T.X₂

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exact_middle_isFinitePresentation_of_noetherian
statement:
theorem exact_middle_isFinitePresentation_of_noetherian
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (T : ShortComplex (Spec R).Modules)
    [T.X₁.IsQuasicoherent] [T.X₂.IsQuasicoherent] [T.X₃.IsQuasicoherent]
    [T.X₁.IsFinitePresentation] [T.X₃.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hT : T.Exact) :
    T.X₂.IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  let G := T.map (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor R)
  have hG : G.Exact :=
    (moduleSpecΓ_map_exact_iff T).mpr hT
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R G.X₁ := by
    change Module.FinitePresentation R (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj T.X₁)
    exact moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation T.X₁
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R G.X₃ := by
    change Module.FinitePresentation R (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj T.X₃)
    exact moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation T.X₃
  letI : Module.Finite R (LinearMap.range G.f.hom) :=
    Module.Finite.range G.f.hom
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R (LinearMap.range G.f.hom) :=
    Module.finitePresentation_of_finite R _
  let e : LinearMap.range G.f.hom ≃ₗ[R] LinearMap.ker G.g.hom :=
    LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ hG.moduleCat_range_eq_ker
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R (LinearMap.ker G.g.hom) :=
    Module.FinitePresentation.of_equiv e
  letI : Module.Finite R (LinearMap.range G.g.hom) :=
    Module.Finite.of_injective (LinearMap.range G.g.hom).subtype
      (Submodule.injective_subtype _)
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R (LinearMap.range G.g.hom) :=
    Module.finitePresentation_of_finite R _
  let l : G.X₂ →ₗ[R] LinearMap.range G.g.hom :=
    G.g.hom.rangeRestrict
  let eker : LinearMap.ker G.g.hom ≃ₗ[R] LinearMap.ker l :=
    LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ (LinearMap.ker_rangeRestrict _).symm
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R (LinearMap.ker l) :=
    Module.FinitePresentation.of_equiv eker
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R G.X₂ :=
    Module.finitePresentation_of_ker l G.g.hom.surjective_rangeRestrict
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj T.X₂) := by
    change Module.FinitePresentation R G.X₂
    infer_instance
  exact isFinitePresentation_of_moduleSpecΓ T.X₂

statement:

    [IsNoetherianRing R]

    [T.X₁.IsQuasicoherent] [T.X₂.IsQuasicoherent] [T.X₃.IsQuasicoherent]

proof:
:= by
  let G := T.map (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor R)

    (moduleSpecΓ_map_shortExact_iff T).mpr hT
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R G.X₂ := by

    exact moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation T.X₂
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R G.X₃ := by
    change Module.FinitePresentation R (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj T.X₃)
    exact moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation T.X₃
  have hker : (LinearMap.ker G.g.hom).FG :=
    Module.FinitePresentation.fg_ker G.g.hom hG.moduleCat_surjective_g
  letI : Module.Finite R (LinearMap.ker G.g.hom) :=
    Module.Finite.of_fg hker
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R (LinearMap.ker G.g.hom) :=

  let e : G.X₁ ≃ₗ[R] LinearMap.ker G.g.hom :=
    (LinearEquiv.ofInjective G.f.hom hG.moduleCat_injective_f).trans

  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R G.X₁ :=
    Module.FinitePresentation.of_equiv e.symm
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj T.X₁) := by

  exact isFinitePresentation_of_moduleSpecΓ T.X₁

    affineIntegerG0Rank (g0ClassOf (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ))
      (SheafOfModules.unit (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ)).ringCatSheaf)
      (SheafOfModules.unit_isFinitePresentation (R := (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ)).ringCatSheaf))) =
        1
proof:
:= by
  rw [affineIntegerG0Rank_classOf, integerModuleRank_congr (N := ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)
    (unitModuleSpecΓLinearEquiv (CommRingCat.of ℤ)), integerModuleRank_eq_finrank]
  simp

name: overPresheafPushforward_preservesFiniteLimits
statement:
theorem overPresheafPushforward_preservesFiniteLimits
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens) :
    PreservesFiniteLimits
      (PresheafOfModules.pushforward
        (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)) where
  preservesFiniteLimits J _ _
proof:
:=
    { preservesLimit := fun {K} ↦
        { preserves := fun hc ↦
            ⟨PresheafOfModules.evaluationJointlyReflectsLimits _ _
              (fun V ↦ by
                let φ : (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj ⟶
                    (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj := 𝟙 _
                apply isLimitOfReflects
                  (CategoryTheory.forget
                    (ModuleCat ((X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj.obj V)))
                exact isLimitOfPreserves
                  (PresheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf.obj
                      (Opposite.op ((Over.forget U).obj V.unop)) ⋙
                    CategoryTheory.forget _)
                  hc)⟩ } }

name: overFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits
statement:
theorem overFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens) :
    PreservesFiniteLimits.{u, u, u + 1, u + 1}
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U)
proof:
:= by
  letI hpush := overPresheafPushforward_preservesFiniteLimits X U
  let hcomp : PreservesFiniteLimits
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U ⋙
        SheafOfModules.forget (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)) := by
    change PreservesFiniteLimits
      (SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
        PresheafOfModules.pushforward
          (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj))
    exact comp_preservesFiniteLimits _ _
  let hreflect : ReflectsFiniteLimits
      (SheafOfModules.forget (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)) := by
    infer_instance
  exact @preservesFiniteLimits_of_reflects_of_preserves.{u, u, u, u + 1, u + 1, u + 1}
    _ _ _ _ _ _
    (SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U)
    (SheafOfModules.forget (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)) hcomp hreflect

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exact_of_over_cover
statement:
theorem exact_of_over_cover (X : Scheme.{u})
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) {I : Type u} (U : I → X.Opens)
    (hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop U)
    (hS : ∀ i, (S.map (overRestrictionFunctor X (U i))).Exact) :
    S.Exact
proof:
:= by
  apply Functor.reflects_exact_of_faithful (toAddCommGrpSheaf X)
  rw [TopCat.Sheaf.exact_iff_stalkFunctor_map_exact]
  intro x
  change (S.map (stalkFunctor X x)).Exact
  let hcover : IsOpenCover U :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff X U).mp hU
  have hxUnion : x ∈ ⋃ i, (U i : Set X) := by
    rw [hcover.iSup_set_eq_univ]
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hxUnion
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := hxUnion
  have hi :
      ((S.map (overRestrictionFunctor X (U i))).map
        (overStalkFunctor X (U i) x hxi)).Exact := by
    exact (hS i).map _
  exact ShortComplex.exact_of_iso
    (S.mapNatIso (overStalkNatIso X (U i) x hxi)) hi

name: SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafLeftFunctor_map_exact
statement:
theorem tensorSheafLeftFunctor_map_exact
    (M : X.Modules) (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree X M)
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.Exact) :
    (S.map (tensorSheafLeftFunctor X M)).Exact
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin⟩ := hM.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := hqfin
  apply AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exact_of_over_cover X _ q.X q.coversTop
  intro i
  let U := q.X i
  let F := overRestrictionFunctor X U
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits F := by
    dsimp only [F, overRestrictionFunctor]
    exact overFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits X U
  letI : PreservesFiniteColimits F := by
    dsimp only [F, overRestrictionFunctor]
    exact overFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits X U
  have hRestr : (S.map F).Exact := hS.map F
  let I := (q.generators i).I
  letI : (q.generators i).IsFiniteType :=
    SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType i
  letI : Finite I := by
    dsimp only [I]
    infer_instance
  let e : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) I ≅ M.over U :=
    asIso (q.generators i).π
  let eTensor := tensorSheafOverLeftFunctorMapIso X U e
  letI : (tensorSheafOverLeftFunctor X U (M.over U)).Additive :=
    Functor.additive_of_iso eTensor
  have hFree := tensorSheafOverFreeLeftFunctor_map_exact X U I (S.map F) hRestr
  have hLocal :
      ((S.map F).map (tensorSheafOverLeftFunctor X U (M.over U))).Exact :=
    ShortComplex.exact_of_iso ((S.map F).mapNatIso eTensor) hFree
  exact ShortComplex.exact_of_iso
    (S.mapNatIso (tensorSheafLeftFunctorOverNatIso X U M)) hLocal

name: SchemeKTheory.exists_shortExact_of_functor_obj_eq'
statement:
theorem exists_shortExact_of_functor_obj_eq' {𝒜 : Type*} [Category 𝒜] [Abelian 𝒜] (F : 𝒜 ⥤ 𝒜)
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F] {A B D : 𝒜}
    (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ D) (w : f ≫ g = 0) (hS : (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact)
    {A' B' D' : 𝒜} (hA : F.obj A = A') (hB : F.obj B = B') (hD : F.obj D = D') :
    ∃ (f' : A' ⟶ B') (g' : B' ⟶ D') (w' : f' ≫ g' = 0),
      (ShortComplex.mk f' g' w').ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  subst hA hB hD
  exact ⟨F.map f, F.map g, ((ShortComplex.mk f g w).map F).zero,
    ShortComplex.ShortExact.map_of_exact hS F⟩

    (A B C Y : {M : X.Modules // IsFiniteLocallyFree X M})

      (IsFiniteLocallyFree X) A B C) :
    ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules (IsFiniteLocallyFree X)
      (k0TensorObject X A Y) (k0TensorObject X B Y)
      (k0TensorObject X C Y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, g, zero, hS⟩ := h
  let F := tensorSheafRightFunctor X Y.1
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits F :=
    tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits X Y.1 Y.2
  letI : PreservesFiniteColimits F :=
    tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits X Y.1 Y.2
  exact exists_shortExact_of_functor_obj_eq' F f g zero hS rfl rfl rfl

theorem k0RingLift_classOf {A : Type v} [CommRing A]

      ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules (IsFiniteLocallyFree X) E F G →
        c F = c E + c G)

name: ModuleResolution.chi_zero
statement:
theorem chi_zero (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [Module.Projective R M] : chi R 0 (ModuleCat.of R M) = pcl R M
proof:
:= by
  rw [chi, dif_pos ⟨‹_›, ‹_›⟩]; rfl

name: ModuleResolution.chi_succ
statement:

name: ModuleResolution.add_zero_level
statement: theorem add_zero_level : Add R 0
proof:
:= by
  intro A B C _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ f g hf hex hg hA hB hC
  haveI := projective_of_hasPDLE_zero A hA
  haveI := projective_of_hasPDLE_zero B hB
  haveI := projective_of_hasPDLE_zero C hC
  rw [chi_zero, chi_zero, chi_zero]

name: ModuleResolution.chi_subsingleton
statement:
theorem chi_subsingleton {n : ℕ} (hAdd : Add R n) (Z : Type u) [AddCommGroup Z] [Module R Z]
    [Subsingleton Z] : chi R n (ModuleCat.of R Z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Module.Finite R Z := inferInstance
  haveI : HasProjectiveDimensionLT (ModuleCat.of R Z) 0 :=
    (ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _).hasProjectiveDimensionLT_zero
  have hZ : HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of R Z) n :=
    hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge _ 0 (n + 1) (by omega)
  have h := hAdd Z Z Z 0 0 (Function.injective_of_subsingleton _)
    (fun x => by simp [Subsingleton.elim x 0]) (Function.surjective_to_subsingleton _) hZ hZ hZ
  have h' := congrArg (fun z => z - chi R n (ModuleCat.of R Z)) h
  simpa using h'.symm

name: ModuleResolution.res_level
statement:
theorem res_level {n : ℕ} (hAdd : Add R n) (hProj : Proj R n)
    (E M : Type u) [AddCommGroup E] [Module R E] [Module.Finite R E] [Module.Projective R E]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M] (π : E →ₗ[R] M)
    (hπ : Function.Surjective π) (hM : HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of R M) (n + 1)) :
    chi R (n + 1) (ModuleCat.of R M) = pcl R E - chi R n (ModuleCat.of R (LinearMap.ker π))
proof:
:= by
  rw [chi_succ]
  set E₀ := Fin (cov (ModuleCat.of R M)) → R
  set π₀ : E₀ →ₗ[R] M := covMap (ModuleCat.of R M)
  have hπ₀ : Function.Surjective π₀ := covMap_surjective _
  let Φ : E × E₀ →ₗ[R] M := π.coprod π₀
  let L := LinearMap.ker Φ
  
  let i₁ : LinearMap.ker π →ₗ[R] L :=
    { toFun := fun k => ⟨(k.1, 0), LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
        (show π k.1 + π₀ 0 = 0 by rw [map_zero, add_zero]; exact k.2)⟩
      map_add' := fun a b => Subtype.ext (Prod.ext rfl (add_zero 0).symm)
      map_smul' := fun r a => Subtype.ext (Prod.ext rfl (smul_zero r).symm) }
  let p₁ : L →ₗ[R] E₀ := (LinearMap.snd R E E₀).comp L.subtype
  let i₂ : LinearMap.ker π₀ →ₗ[R] L :=
    { toFun := fun k => ⟨(0, k.1), LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
        (show π 0 + π₀ k.1 = 0 by rw [map_zero, zero_add]; exact k.2)⟩
      map_add' := fun a b => Subtype.ext (Prod.ext (add_zero 0).symm rfl)
      map_smul' := fun r a => Subtype.ext (Prod.ext (smul_zero r).symm rfl) }
  let p₂ : L →ₗ[R] E := (LinearMap.fst R E E₀).comp L.subtype
  have hmemL : ∀ ℓ : L, π ℓ.1.1 + π₀ ℓ.1.2 = 0 := fun ℓ => LinearMap.mem_ker.mp ℓ.2
  have hi₁ : Function.Injective i₁ := fun a b h => by
    have := congrArg (fun ℓ : L => ℓ.1.1) h; exact Subtype.ext this
  have hi₂ : Function.Injective i₂ := fun a b h => by
    have := congrArg (fun ℓ : L => ℓ.1.2) h; exact Subtype.ext this
  have hp₁ : Function.Surjective p₁ := fun e₀ => by
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hπ (π₀ e₀)
    exact ⟨⟨(-e, e₀), LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
      (show π (-e) + π₀ e₀ = 0 by rw [map_neg, he, neg_add_cancel])⟩, rfl⟩
  have hp₂ : Function.Surjective p₂ := fun e => by
    obtain ⟨e₀, he₀⟩ := hπ₀ (π e)
    exact ⟨⟨(e, -e₀), LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
      (show π e + π₀ (-e₀) = 0 by rw [map_neg, he₀, add_neg_cancel])⟩, rfl⟩
  have hex₁ : Function.Exact i₁ p₁ := by
    intro ℓ
    constructor
    · intro h
      refine ⟨⟨ℓ.1.1, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · have := hmemL ℓ
        change ℓ.1.2 = 0 at h
        simpa [h] using this
      · change ℓ.1.2 = 0 at h
        exact Subtype.ext (Prod.ext rfl h.symm)
    · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩; rfl
  have hex₂ : Function.Exact i₂ p₂ := by
    intro ℓ
    constructor
    · intro h
      refine ⟨⟨ℓ.1.2, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · have := hmemL ℓ
        change ℓ.1.1 = 0 at h
        simpa [h] using this
      · change ℓ.1.1 = 0 at h
        exact Subtype.ext (Prod.ext h.symm rfl)
    · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩; rfl
  have hK : HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of R (LinearMap.ker π)) n := hasPDLE_ker π hπ n hM
  have hK₀ : HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of R (LinearMap.ker π₀)) n :=
    hasPDLE_ker π₀ hπ₀ n hM
  have hL : HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of R L) n :=
    hasPDLE_mid i₁ p₁ hi₁ hex₁ hp₁ n hK (hasPDLE_of_projective E₀ n)
  have h₁ := hAdd _ _ _ i₁ p₁ hi₁ hex₁ hp₁ hK hL (hasPDLE_of_projective E₀ n)
  have h₂ := hAdd _ _ _ i₂ p₂ hi₂ hex₂ hp₂ hK₀ hL (hasPDLE_of_projective E n)
  rw [hProj E₀] at h₁
  rw [hProj E] at h₂
  have : chi R n (ModuleCat.of R (LinearMap.ker π)) + pcl R E₀ =
      chi R n (ModuleCat.of R (LinearMap.ker π₀)) + pcl R E := h₁.symm.trans h₂
  change pcl R E₀ - chi R n (ModuleCat.of R (LinearMap.ker π₀)) = _
  rw [sub_eq_sub_iff_add_eq_add, add_comm (pcl R E₀), this, add_comm]

name: ModuleResolution.proj_succ_level
statement: theorem proj_succ_level {n : ℕ} (hAdd : Add R n) (hProj : Proj R n) : Proj R (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro P _ _ _ _
  rw [res_level hAdd hProj P P LinearMap.id Function.surjective_id (hasPDLE_of_projective P _)]
  haveI : Subsingleton (LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.id : P →ₗ[R] P)) := by
    rw [LinearMap.ker_id]; infer_instance
  rw [chi_subsingleton hAdd, sub_zero]

name: ModuleResolution.add_succ_level
statement: theorem add_succ_level {n : ℕ} (hAdd : Add R n) (hProj : Proj R n) : Add R (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro A B C _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ f g hf hex hg hA hB hC
  obtain ⟨ka, πA, hπA⟩ := Module.Finite.exists_fin' R A
  obtain ⟨kc, πC, hπC⟩ := Module.Finite.exists_fin' R C
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := Module.projective_lifting_property g πC hg
  let Φ : (Fin ka → R) × (Fin kc → R) →ₗ[R] B := (f ∘ₗ πA).coprod σ
  have hΦ : Function.Surjective Φ := by
    intro b
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hπC (g b)
    have : g (b - σ c) = 0 := by
      rw [map_sub, ← LinearMap.comp_apply, hσ, hc, sub_self]
    obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := (hex (b - σ c)).mp this
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hπA a'
    refine ⟨(a, c), ?_⟩
    change f (πA a) + σ c = b
    rw [ha', sub_add_cancel]
  let KA := LinearMap.ker πA
  let KC := LinearMap.ker πC
  let KB := LinearMap.ker Φ
  have hmem : ∀ ℓ : KB, f (πA ℓ.1.1) + σ ℓ.1.2 = 0 := fun ℓ => LinearMap.mem_ker.mp ℓ.2
  let i : KA →ₗ[R] KB :=
    { toFun := fun a => ⟨(a.1, 0), LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
        (show f (πA a.1) + σ 0 = 0 by rw [map_zero, add_zero, LinearMap.mem_ker.mp a.2, map_zero])⟩
      map_add' := fun a b => Subtype.ext (Prod.ext rfl (add_zero 0).symm)
      map_smul' := fun r a => Subtype.ext (Prod.ext rfl (smul_zero r).symm) }
  have hpC : ∀ ℓ : KB, πC ℓ.1.2 = 0 := fun ℓ => by
    have := congrArg g (hmem ℓ)
    rw [map_add, map_zero, hex.apply_apply_eq_zero, zero_add, ← LinearMap.comp_apply, hσ] at this
    exact this
  let p : KB →ₗ[R] KC :=
    { toFun := fun ℓ => ⟨ℓ.1.2, LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr (hpC ℓ)⟩
      map_add' := fun a b => rfl
      map_smul' := fun r a => rfl }
  have hi : Function.Injective i := fun a b h => by
    have := congrArg (fun ℓ : KB => ℓ.1.1) h; exact Subtype.ext this
  have hp : Function.Surjective p := by
    intro c
    have : g (σ c.1) = 0 := by rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, hσ]; exact c.2
    obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := (hex (σ c.1)).mp this
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hπA a'
    refine ⟨⟨(-a, c.1), LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr ?_⟩, rfl⟩
    change f (πA (-a)) + σ c.1 = 0
    rw [map_neg, map_neg, ha', neg_add_cancel]
  have hip : Function.Exact i p := by
    intro ℓ
    constructor
    · intro h
      have h2 : ℓ.1.2 = 0 := congrArg Subtype.val h
      have h1 : πA ℓ.1.1 = 0 := by
        apply hf
        have := hmem ℓ
        rw [h2, map_zero, add_zero] at this
        rw [this, map_zero]
      exact ⟨⟨ℓ.1.1, h1⟩, Subtype.ext (Prod.ext rfl h2.symm)⟩
    · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩; rfl
  have hKA := hasPDLE_ker πA hπA n hA
  have hKC := hasPDLE_ker πC hπC n hC
  have hKB := hasPDLE_ker Φ hΦ n hB
  have hK := hAdd KA KB KC i p hi hip hp hKA hKB hKC
  rw [res_level hAdd hProj _ _ Φ hΦ hB, res_level hAdd hProj _ _ πA hπA hA,
    res_level hAdd hProj _ _ πC hπC hC, hK]
  have hsum : pcl R ((Fin ka → R) × (Fin kc → R)) = pcl R (Fin ka → R) + pcl R (Fin kc → R) :=
    pcl_ses (LinearMap.inl R _ _) (LinearMap.snd R _ _) LinearMap.inl_injective
      (Function.Exact.inl_snd) LinearMap.snd_surjective
  rw [hsum]
  abel

name: ModuleResolution.add_proj_all
statement:
theorem add_proj_all : ∀ n, Add R n ∧ Proj R n
  | 0 => ⟨add_zero_level, proj_zero_level⟩
  | n + 1 => by
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩
proof:
:= add_proj_all n
      exact ⟨add_succ_level h1 h2, proj_succ_level h1 h2⟩

name: ModuleResolution.k0ToG0_chi
statement:
theorem k0ToG0_chi : ∀ (n : ℕ) (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M],
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of R M) n →
      k0ToG0 R (chi R n (ModuleCat.of R M)) = gcl R M
  | 0, M, _, _, _, hM => by
      haveI
proof:
:= projective_of_hasPDLE_zero M hM
      rw [chi_zero, k0ToG0_pcl]
  | n + 1, M, _, _, _, hM => by
      rw [chi_succ, map_sub, k0ToG0_pcl]
      have hπ := covMap_surjective (ModuleCat.of R M)
      rw [k0ToG0_chi n _ (hasPDLE_ker _ hπ n hM)]
      rw [gcl_ses (LinearMap.ker (covMap (ModuleCat.of R M))).subtype (covMap (ModuleCat.of R M))
        (Submodule.injective_subtype _) (LinearMap.exact_subtype_ker_map _) hπ]
      change gcl R (LinearMap.ker (covMap (ModuleCat.of R M))) + gcl R M -
        gcl R (LinearMap.ker (covMap (ModuleCat.of R M))) = gcl R M
      abel

name: ModuleResolution.k0ToG0_bijective_of_hasProjectiveDimensionLE
statement:
theorem k0ToG0_bijective_of_hasProjectiveDimensionLE (d : ℕ)
    (hd : ∀ M : ModuleCat.{u} R, Module.Finite R M → HasProjectiveDimensionLE M d) :
    Function.Bijective (k0ToG0 R)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hAdd, hProj⟩ := add_proj_all (R := R) d
  let ψ : G0 R →+ K0 R := ExactGrothendieck.lift (fun M => chi R d M.1) (by
    rintro ⟨A, hA⟩ ⟨B, hB⟩ ⟨C, hC⟩ ⟨f, g, zero, hS⟩
    haveI : Module.Finite R A := hA
    haveI : Module.Finite R B := hB
    haveI : Module.Finite R C := hC
    exact hAdd A B C f.hom g.hom hS.moduleCat_injective_f
      ((ShortComplex.ShortExact.moduleCat_exact_iff_function_exact _).mp hS.exact)
      hS.moduleCat_surjective_g (hd _ hA) (hd _ hB) (hd _ hC))
  have h1 : ψ.comp (k0ToG0 R) = AddMonoidHom.id _ := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    rintro ⟨E, hE1, hE2⟩
    change ψ (k0ToG0 R (pcl R E)) = pcl R E
    rw [k0ToG0_pcl]
    exact (ExactGrothendieck.lift_classOf _ _ _).trans (hProj E)
  have h2 : (k0ToG0 R).comp ψ = AddMonoidHom.id _ := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    rintro ⟨M, hM⟩
    haveI : Module.Finite R M := hM
    change k0ToG0 R (ψ (gcl R M)) = gcl R M
    rw [show ψ (gcl R M) = chi R d (ModuleCat.of R M) from ExactGrothendieck.lift_classOf _ _ _]
    exact k0ToG0_chi d M (hd _ hM)
  refine ⟨fun x y hxy => ?_, fun y => ⟨ψ y, ?_⟩⟩
  · have := congrArg ψ hxy
    simpa [← AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, h1] using this
  · exact DFunLike.congr_fun h2 y

name: ModuleCat.restrictScalars_isIso_μ_of_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem ModuleCat.restrictScalars_isIso_μ_of_ringEquiv (M N : ModuleCat S) :
    IsIso (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars e.toRingHom) M N)
proof:
:= by
  haveI hu : IsIso (extendRestrictScalarsAdj e.toRingHom).unit :=
    Adjunction.instIsIsoFunctorUnitOfIsEquivalence (extendRestrictScalarsAdj e.toRingHom)
  haveI hc : IsIso (extendRestrictScalarsAdj e.toRingHom).counit := by infer_instance
  haveI hcM : IsIso ((extendRestrictScalarsAdj e.toRingHom).counit.app M) :=
    NatIso.isIso_app_of_isIso _ M
  haveI hcN : IsIso ((extendRestrictScalarsAdj e.toRingHom).counit.app N) :=
    NatIso.isIso_app_of_isIso _ N
  haveI hunit : IsIso ((extendRestrictScalarsAdj e.toRingHom).unit.app
      (MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorObj ((restrictScalars e.toRingHom).obj M)
        ((restrictScalars e.toRingHom).obj N) : ModuleCat R)) :=
    NatIso.isIso_app_of_isIso _ _
  haveI ht : IsIso (MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorHom
      ((extendRestrictScalarsAdj e.toRingHom).counit.app M)
      ((extendRestrictScalarsAdj e.toRingHom).counit.app N)) :=
    tensor_isIso ((extendRestrictScalarsAdj e.toRingHom).counit.app M)
      ((extendRestrictScalarsAdj e.toRingHom).counit.app N)
  haveI hd : IsIso (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (extendScalars e.toRingHom)
      ((restrictScalars e.toRingHom).obj M) ((restrictScalars e.toRingHom).obj N)) := by
    infer_instance
  haveI hdt : IsIso (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (extendScalars e.toRingHom)
      ((restrictScalars e.toRingHom).obj M) ((restrictScalars e.toRingHom).obj N) ≫
      MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorHom
        ((extendRestrictScalarsAdj e.toRingHom).counit.app M)
        ((extendRestrictScalarsAdj e.toRingHom).counit.app N)) :=
    IsIso.comp_isIso' hd ht
  haveI hmap : IsIso ((restrictScalars e.toRingHom).map
      (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (extendScalars e.toRingHom)
          ((restrictScalars e.toRingHom).obj M) ((restrictScalars e.toRingHom).obj N) ≫
        MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorHom
          ((extendRestrictScalarsAdj e.toRingHom).counit.app M)
          ((extendRestrictScalarsAdj e.toRingHom).counit.app N))) :=
    Functor.map_isIso (restrictScalars e.toRingHom) _
  simp only [Adjunction.rightAdjointLaxMonoidal_μ, Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
  exact IsIso.comp_isIso' hunit hmap

name: PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars_μ_isIso_of_isIso_app
statement:
theorem PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars_μ_isIso_of_isIso_app
    (M N : PresheafOfModules.{u} (Q ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)) (X : Cᵒᵖ)
    (hX : IsIso (α.app X)) :
    IsIso (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (R := P.obj X) (S := Q.obj X) (α.app X).hom)
      (M.obj X) (N.obj X))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIso (α.app X) := hX
  have he : ((asIso (α.app X)).ringCatIsoToRingEquiv.toRingHom : P.obj X →+* Q.obj X) =
      (α.app X).hom := by
    simp [Iso.ringCatIsoToRingEquiv_toRingHom]
  rw [← he]
  exact ModuleCat.restrictScalars_isIso_μ_of_ringEquiv
    (asIso (α.app X)).ringCatIsoToRingEquiv (M.obj X) (N.obj X)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.pullback_specMap_isFinitePresentation
statement:
theorem pullback_specMap_isFinitePresentation (phi : R →+* S)
    (E : (Spec (.of R)).Modules) [E.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom phi))).obj E).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  letI : E.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  let QE : AffineQuasicoherent (.of R) := ⟨E, inferInstance⟩
  let P := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom phi))).obj E
  let Q := (affineScalarExtensionFunctor phi).obj E
  let e : P ≅ Q := (affineQCPullbackNatIso phi).app QE
  letI : Q.IsFinitePresentation := affineScalarExtension_isFinitePresentation phi E
  exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation (Spec (.of S)).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
    e.symm inferInstance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.pullback_specMap_isQuasicoherent
statement:
theorem pullback_specMap_isQuasicoherent (phi : R →+* S)
    (E : (Spec (.of R)).Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent] :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom phi))).obj E).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  let QE : AffineQuasicoherent (.of R) := ⟨E, inferInstance⟩
  let P := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom phi))).obj E
  let Q := (affineScalarExtensionFunctor phi).obj E
  let e : P ≅ Q := (affineQCPullbackNatIso phi).app QE
  letI : Q.IsQuasicoherent := by
    change ((tilde.functor (.of S)).obj
      ((ModuleCat.extendScalars phi).obj
        ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R)).obj E))).IsQuasicoherent
    exact inferInstanceAs
      ((@tilde (.of S) ((ModuleCat.extendScalars phi).obj
        ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R)).obj E))).IsQuasicoherent)
  exact (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent (Spec (.of S)).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
    e.symm inferInstance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.pullback_specMap_map_shortExact
statement:
theorem pullback_specMap_map_shortExact (phi : R →+* S) (hphi : phi.Flat)
    (T : ShortComplex (Spec (.of R)).Modules)
    [T.X₁.IsQuasicoherent] [T.X₂.IsQuasicoherent] [T.X₃.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hT : T.ShortExact) :
    (T.map (Scheme.Modules.pullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom phi)))).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  let Q := AffineQuasicoherent (.of R)
  let A : Q := ⟨T.X₁, inferInstance⟩
  let B : Q := ⟨T.X₂, inferInstance⟩
  let C : Q := ⟨T.X₃, inferInstance⟩
  let TQ : ShortComplex Q := ShortComplex.mk
    (ObjectProperty.homMk (X := A) (Y := B) T.f)
    (ObjectProperty.homMk (X := B) (Y := C) T.g)
      (by
        apply ObjectProperty.hom_ext
        change T.f ≫ T.g = 0
        exact T.zero)
  have hScalar : (T.map (affineScalarExtensionFunctor phi)).ShortExact :=
    affineScalarExtension_map_shortExact phi hphi T hT
  letI : (affineQCScalarExtensionFunctor phi).PreservesZeroMorphisms := by
    constructor
    intro X Y
    change (affineScalarExtensionFunctor phi).map (0 : X.obj ⟶ Y.obj) = 0
    exact (affineScalarExtensionFunctor phi).map_zero X.obj Y.obj
  have hScalarQ :
      (TQ.map (affineQCScalarExtensionFunctor phi)).ShortExact := by
    change (T.map (affineScalarExtensionFunctor phi)).ShortExact
    exact hScalar
  letI : (affineQCPullbackFunctor phi).PreservesZeroMorphisms := by
    constructor
    intro X Y
    change (Scheme.Modules.pullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom phi))).map (0 : X.obj ⟶ Y.obj) = 0
    exact (Scheme.Modules.pullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom phi))).map_zero X.obj Y.obj
  have hPullQ : (TQ.map (affineQCPullbackFunctor phi)).ShortExact :=
    ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso
      (TQ.mapNatIso (affineQCPullbackNatIso phi)).symm hScalarQ
  change (T.map (Scheme.Modules.pullback
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom phi)))).ShortExact at hPullQ
  exact hPullQ

name: SchemeKTheory.affinePullbackObject_exact
statement:
theorem affinePullbackObject_exact (phi : R →+* S) (hphi : phi.Flat)
    (A B C : {E : (Spec (.of R)).Modules // IsCoherentLike (Spec (.of R)) E})
    (h : ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn (Spec (.of R)).Modules
      (IsCoherentLike (Spec (.of R))) A B C) :
    ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn (Spec (.of S)).Modules
      (IsCoherentLike (Spec (.of S))) (affinePullbackObject phi A)
      (affinePullbackObject phi B) (affinePullbackObject phi C)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, zero, hshort⟩ := h
  let T : ShortComplex (Spec (.of R)).Modules := ShortComplex.mk a b zero
  let P := T.map (Scheme.Modules.pullback
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom phi)))
  letI : A.1.IsFinitePresentation := A.2
  letI : B.1.IsFinitePresentation := B.2
  letI : C.1.IsFinitePresentation := C.2
  exact ⟨P.f, P.g, P.zero,
    pullback_specMap_map_shortExact phi hphi T hshort⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.affinePullbackG0_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem affinePullbackG0_classOf (phi : R →+* S) (hphi : phi.Flat)
    (E : (Spec (.of R)).Modules) (hE : IsCoherentLike (Spec (.of R)) E) :
    affinePullbackG0 phi hphi (g0ClassOf (Spec (.of R)) E hE) =
      g0ClassOf (Spec (.of S))
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom phi))).obj E)
        (by letI : E.IsFinitePresentation := hE
            exact pullback_specMap_isFinitePresentation phi E)
proof:
:= by
  exact ExactGrothendieck.map_classOf (affinePullbackObject phi)
    (affinePullbackObject_exact phi hphi) ⟨E, hE⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.affinePullbackG0_eq_affineScalarExtensionG0
statement:
theorem affinePullbackG0_eq_affineScalarExtensionG0
    (phi : R →+* S) (hphi : phi.Flat) :
    affinePullbackG0 phi hphi = affineScalarExtensionG0 phi hphi
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _
  intro E
  change affinePullbackG0 phi hphi
      (g0ClassOf (Spec (.of R)) E.1 E.2) =
    affineScalarExtensionG0 phi hphi
      (g0ClassOf (Spec (.of R)) E.1 E.2)
  rw [affinePullbackG0_classOf, affineScalarExtensionG0_classOf]
  letI : E.1.IsFinitePresentation := E.2
  let QE : AffineQuasicoherent (.of R) := ⟨E.1, inferInstance⟩
  exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso
    (Spec (.of S)).Modules (IsCoherentLike (Spec (.of S)))
    (affinePullbackObject phi E).2 (affineScalarExtensionObject phi E).2
    (show (0 : (Spec (.of S)).Modules).IsFinitePresentation from inferInstance)
    (isZero_zero _) ((affineQCPullbackNatIso phi).app QE)

name: SchemeKTheory.flatPullbackK0RingHom_toAddMonoidHom
statement:
theorem flatPullbackK0RingHom_toAddMonoidHom
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [Flat f] :
    (flatPullbackK0RingHom f).toAddMonoidHom = flatPullbackK0 f
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
  intro E
  change (flatPullbackK0RingHom f)
      (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ E) =
    (flatPullbackK0 f) (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ E)
  unfold flatPullbackK0RingHom flatPullbackK0
  rw [k0RingLift_classOf, ExactGrothendieck.map_classOf]

name: SchemeKTheory.flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [Flat f] (x : K0 Y) :
    flatPullbackK0RingHom f x = flatPullbackK0 f x
proof:
:= by
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun (flatPullbackK0RingHom_toAddMonoidHom f) x

name: SchemeKTheory.flatPullbackK0_mul
statement:
theorem flatPullbackK0_mul
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [Flat f] (x y : K0 Y) :
    flatPullbackK0 f (x * y) =
      flatPullbackK0 f x * flatPullbackK0 f y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply,
    ← flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply,
    ← flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply]
  exact map_mul (flatPullbackK0RingHom f) x y

name: PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.kerStep_zero
statement: theorem kerStep_zero : KerStep S 0
proof:
:= by
  intro K B E i g hs hE hK _ hB
  exact (pdLE_zero_iff S).2 (S.P_ker hs ((pdLE_zero_iff S).1 hB) hE hK)

name: PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.succStep_of_kerStep
statement: theorem succStep_of_kerStep {n : ℕ} (h3 : KerStep S n) : SuccStep S n
proof:
:= by
  intro K E M i g hs hE hK hM hpd Z hZ
  obtain ⟨K', E', i', g', hs', hE', hK', hZ'⟩ := hZ
  haveI := hs.epi
  haveI := hs'.epi
  have hQP : S.Q (pullback g' g) := S.Q_pullback g' g (S.P_Q hE') (S.P_Q hE) hM
  have ses1 := hs.pullbackR g'
  have ses2 := hs'.pullbackL g
  have hpdB : PdLE S n (pullback g' g) := pdLE_ext S ses1 hE' hK hQP hpd
  exact h3 ses2 hE hK' hQP hpdB Z hZ'

name: PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.kerStep_succ
statement: theorem kerStep_succ {n : ℕ} (h1 : SuccStep S n) : KerStep S (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro K B E i g hs hE hK hB hpd
  obtain ⟨G, c, hG, hc⟩ := S.cover hB
  haveI := hc
  have sc := SES.kernel_of_epi c
  have hQkc := S.Q_kernel c (S.P_Q hG) hB
  have hpdkc : PdLE S n (kernel c) := hpd.ker S sc hG hQkc
  have hQpb : S.Q (pullback i c) := S.Q_pullback i c hK (S.P_Q hG) hB
  have hPpb : S.P (pullback i c) := S.P_ker (hs.comp c) hG hE hQpb
  exact h1 (sc.pullbackR i) hPpb hQkc hK hpdkc

name: PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.kerStep_succStep
statement:
theorem kerStep_succStep : ∀ n, KerStep S n ∧ SuccStep S n
  | 0 => ⟨kerStep_zero S, succStep_of_kerStep S (kerStep_zero S)⟩
  | n + 1 => by
    have h3 : KerStep S (n + 1)
proof:
:= kerStep_succ S (kerStep_succStep n).2
    exact ⟨h3, succStep_of_kerStep S h3⟩

name: PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.pdLE_succ_of_ses
statement:
theorem pdLE_succ_of_ses {n : ℕ} {K E M : C} {i : K ⟶ E} {g : E ⟶ M} (hs : SES i g)
    (hE : S.P E) (hK : S.Q K) (hM : S.Q M) (hpd : PdLE S n K) : PdLE S (n + 1) M
proof:
:=
  (kerStep_succStep S n).2 hs hE hK hM hpd

name: PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.pdLE_ker_of_ses
statement:
theorem pdLE_ker_of_ses {n : ℕ} {K B E : C} {i : K ⟶ B} {g : B ⟶ E} (hs : SES i g)
    (hE : S.P E) (hK : S.Q K) (hB : S.Q B) (hpd : PdLE S n B) : PdLE S n K
proof:
:=
  (kerStep_succStep S n).1 hs hE hK hB hpd

name: PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.pdLE_of_rep
statement: theorem pdLE_of_rep : ∀ (n : ℕ) {M : C} {x : K0 S}, S.Q M → Rep S n M x → PdLE S n M
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rintro M x _ ⟨h, -⟩
    exact (pdLE_zero_iff S).2 h
  | succ n ih =>
    rintro M x hM ⟨K, E, i, g, y, hs, hE, hK, hy, -⟩
    exact pdLE_succ_of_ses S hs hE hK hM (ih hK hy)

name: PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.extStep_zero
statement: theorem extStep_zero : ExtStep S 0
proof:
:= by
  intro A B D i g hs _ hB _ hA hD
  exact (pdLE_zero_iff S).2 (S.P_ext hs ((pdLE_zero_iff S).1 hA) ((pdLE_zero_iff S).1 hD) hB)

name: PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.quotStep_of_extStep
statement: theorem quotStep_of_extStep {n : ℕ} (h2 : ExtStep S n) : QuotStep S n
proof:
:= by
  intro A B D i g hs hA hB hD hpA hpB
  obtain ⟨E, e, hE, he⟩ := S.cover hB
  haveI := he
  have se := SES.kernel_of_epi e
  have hQke := S.Q_kernel e (S.P_Q hE) hB
  have hpke : PdLE S n (kernel e) := hpB.ker S se hE hQke
  have hQpb : S.Q (pullback i e) := S.Q_pullback i e hA (S.P_Q hE) hB
  have hpb : PdLE S n (pullback i e) := h2 (se.pullbackR i) hQke hQpb hA hpke hpA
  exact pdLE_succ_of_ses S (hs.comp e) hE hQpb hD hpb

name: PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.extStep_succ
statement: theorem extStep_succ {n : ℕ} (h4 : QuotStep S n) : ExtStep S (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro A B D i g hs hA hB hD hpA hpD
  obtain ⟨G, c, hG, hc⟩ := S.cover hD
  haveI := hc
  have sc := SES.kernel_of_epi c
  have hQkc := S.Q_kernel c (S.P_Q hG) hD
  have hpkc : PdLE S n (kernel c) := hpD.ker S sc hG hQkc
  have hQpb : S.Q (pullback c g) := S.Q_pullback c g (S.P_Q hG) hB hD
  have hpb : PdLE S (n + 1) (pullback c g) := pdLE_ext S (hs.pullbackR c) hG hA hQpb hpA
  exact h4 (sc.pullbackL g) hQkc hQpb hB hpkc hpb

name: PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.extStep_quotStep
statement:
theorem extStep_quotStep : ∀ n, ExtStep S n ∧ QuotStep S n
  | 0 => ⟨extStep_zero S, quotStep_of_extStep S (extStep_zero S)⟩
  | n + 1 => by
    have h2 : ExtStep S (n + 1)
proof:
:= extStep_succ S (extStep_quotStep n).2
    exact ⟨h2, quotStep_of_extStep S h2⟩

name: PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.pdLE_ext_of_ses
statement:
theorem pdLE_ext_of_ses {n : ℕ} {A B D : C} {i : A ⟶ B} {g : B ⟶ D} (hs : SES i g)
    (hA : S.Q A) (hB : S.Q B) (hD : S.Q D) (hpA : PdLE S n A) (hpD : PdLE S n D) :
    PdLE S n B
proof:
:=
  (extStep_quotStep S n).1 hs hA hB hD hpA hpD

name: PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.pdLE_quot_of_ses
statement:
theorem pdLE_quot_of_ses {n : ℕ} {A B D : C} {i : A ⟶ B} {g : B ⟶ D} (hs : SES i g)
    (hA : S.Q A) (hB : S.Q B) (hD : S.Q D) (hpA : PdLE S n A) (hpB : PdLE S (n + 1) B) :
    PdLE S (n + 1) D
proof:
:=
  (extStep_quotStep S n).2 hs hA hB hD hpA hpB

name: PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.pdLE_functor
statement: theorem pdLE_functor : ∀ (n : ℕ) {M : C}, S.Q M → PdLE S n M → PdLE S' n (T.obj M)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro M _ h
    exact (pdLE_zero_iff S').2 (hP ((pdLE_zero_iff S).1 h))
  | succ n ih =>
    intro M hM h
    obtain ⟨E, g, hE, hg⟩ := S.cover hM
    haveI := hg
    have hs := SES.kernel_of_epi g
    have hQK := S.Q_kernel g (S.P_Q hE) hM
    exact pdLE_succ_of_ses S' (hses hs) (hP hE) (hQ hQK) (hQ hM) (ih hQK (h.ker S hs hE hQK))

name: PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.rep_functor
statement:
theorem rep_functor (φ : K0 S →+ K0 S')
    (hφ : ∀ (E : C) (h : S.P E), φ (cls S E h) = cls S' (T.obj E) (hP h)) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) {M : C} {x : K0 S}, Rep S n M x → Rep S' n (T.obj M) (φ x)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rintro M x ⟨h, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨hP h, hφ M h⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    rintro M x ⟨K, E, i, g, y, hs, hE, hK, hy, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨T.obj K, T.obj E, T.map i, T.map g, φ y, hses hs, hP hE, hQ hK, ih hy,
      by rw [map_sub, hφ]⟩

name: PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.ses_cokernel_step
statement:
theorem ses_cokernel_step {A B D : C} (a : A ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ D) (w : a ≫ b = 0)
    (hex : (ShortComplex.mk a b w).Exact) :
    SES (cokernel.desc a b w) (cokernel.π b)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨by rw [← cancel_epi (cokernel.π a)]; simp, ?_⟩
  refine { exact := ShortComplex.exact_of_g_is_cokernel _ ?_
           mono_f := hex.mono_cokernelDesc
           epi_g := inferInstance }
  exact isCokernelOfComp (f := cokernel.desc a b w) (cokernel.π a) b (cokernelIsCokernel b) _
    (cokernel.π_desc a b w)

name: PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.altSum_eq_sum
statement:
theorem altSum_eq_sum {A : Type*} [CommRing A] (f : ℕ → A) (m : ℕ) :
    altSum f m = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, (-1 : A) ^ i * f i
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing f with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [altSum, ih, Finset.sum_range_succ']
    simp only [pow_succ, pow_zero, one_mul, mul_neg_one, neg_mul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    ring

name: PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.altSum_inst_congr
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing f with
  | zero => exact h0 f
  | succ m ih =>
    exact (hsub _ _).trans (congrArg (fun x => @HSub.hSub A A A (@instHSub A (@SubNegMonoid.toSub A
      (@AddGroup.toSubNegMonoid A (@AddCommGroup.toAddGroup A G₂)))) (f 0) x) (ih _))

name: PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.rep_cokernel_of_exact
statement:
theorem rep_cokernel_of_exact (Cc : ℕ → C) (hP : ∀ k, S.P (Cc k)) (dd : ∀ k, Cc (k + 1) ⟶ Cc k)
    (w : ∀ k, dd (k + 1) ≫ dd k = 0)
    (hex : ∀ k, (ShortComplex.mk (dd (k + 1)) (dd k) (w k)).Exact)
    (hQ : ∀ k, S.Q (cokernel (dd k))) :
    ∀ (m k : ℕ), IsZero (Cc (k + m)) →
      Rep S m (cokernel (dd k)) (altSum (fun i => cls S (Cc (i + k)) (hP (i + k))) m)
proof:
:= by
  set f : ℕ → K0 S := fun a => cls S (Cc a) (hP a) with hf
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro k hk
    have hz : IsZero (cokernel (dd k)) := IsZero.of_epi (cokernel.π (dd k)) hk
    exact rep_zero S 0 _ hz
  | succ m ih =>
    intro k hk
    have hk' : IsZero (Cc (k + 1 + m)) := by
      rwa [show k + 1 + m = k + (m + 1) by omega]
    have hy := ih (k + 1) hk'
    refine ⟨_, Cc k, _, _, _, ses_cokernel_step (dd (k + 1)) (dd k) (w k) (hex k), hP k,
      hQ (k + 1), hy, ?_⟩
    have e : (fun i => f (i + 1 + k)) = fun i => f (i + (k + 1)) :=
      funext fun i => congrArg f (by omega)
    have e0 : f (0 + k) = f k := congrArg f (by omega)
    change altSum (fun i => f (i + k)) (m + 1) = f k - altSum (fun i => f (i + (k + 1))) m
    rw [altSum, ← e, ← e0]

name: PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.Sch.koszul_ring_aux
statement:
theorem koszul_ring_aux {A : Type*} [CommRing A] {a r l : A} (h : r = l * r + a) :
    a = (1 - l) * r
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination -h

name: PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.Sch.ses_tensor
statement:
theorem ses_tensor {L : X.Modules} (hL : IsFiniteLocallyFree X L) {A B D : X.Modules}
    {i : A ⟶ B} {g : B ⟶ D} (hs : AbelianResolutionF15.SES i g) :
    AbelianResolutionF15.SES ((tensorSheafLeftFunctor X L).map i)
      ((tensorSheafLeftFunctor X L).map g)
proof:
:= by
  letI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits X L hL
  letI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits X L hL
  exact ⟨by rw [← Functor.map_comp, hs.zero, Functor.map_zero],
    hs.exact.map_of_exact (tensorSheafLeftFunctor X L)⟩

name: PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.Sch.pdLE_tensor
statement:
theorem pdLE_tensor (h : HasBundleCovers X) {L : X.Modules} (hL : IsFiniteLocallyFree X L)
    {d : ℕ} {F : X.Modules} (hF : IsCoherentLike X F) (hd : PdLE h d F) :
    PdLE h d (tensorSheaf X L F)
proof:
:=
  pdLE_functor (setup X h) (setup X h) (tensorSheafLeftFunctor X L)
    (fun hE => tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree X L _ hL hE)
    (fun hM => tensorSheaf_isCoherentLike X L _ hL hM) (fun hs => ses_tensor hL hs) d hF hd

name: PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.Sch.repK0_tensor
statement:
theorem repK0_tensor (h : HasBundleCovers X) {L : X.Modules} (hL : IsFiniteLocallyFree X L)
    {d d' : ℕ} (F : X.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike X F) (hd : PdLE h d F)
    (hF' : IsCoherentLike X (tensorSheaf X L F)) (hd' : PdLE h d' (tensorSheaf X L F)) :
    repK0 h (tensorSheaf X L F) hF' hd' = k0ClassOf X L hL * repK0 h F hF hd
proof:
:= by
  refine repK0_eq_of_rep h hF' hd' (n := d)
    (rep_functor (setup X h) (setup X h) (tensorSheafLeftFunctor X L)
      (fun hE => tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree X L _ hL hE)
      (fun hM => tensorSheaf_isCoherentLike X L _ hL hM) (fun hs => ses_tensor hL hs)
      (AddMonoidHom.mulLeft (k0ClassOf X L hL)) ?_ d
      (PerfectRepG2.rep_repK0 (setup X h) F hF hd))
  intro E hE
  exact k0ClassOf_mul X ⟨L, hL⟩ ⟨E, hE⟩

name: PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.Sch.pdLE_koszulStep
statement:
theorem pdLE_koszulStep (h : HasBundleCovers X) {L : X.Modules} (hL : IsFiniteLocallyFree X L)
    {F F' : X.Modules} {f : tensorSheaf X L F ⟶ F} {g : F ⟶ F'} (zero : f ≫ g = 0)
    (hS : (ShortComplex.mk f g zero).ShortExact) (hF : IsCoherentLike X F)
    (hF' : IsCoherentLike X F') {n : ℕ} (hd : PdLE h n F) : PdLE h (n + 1) F'
proof:
:=
  pdLE_quot_of_ses (setup X h) ⟨zero, hS⟩ (tensorSheaf_isCoherentLike X L F hL hF) hF hF'
    (pdLE_tensor h hL hF hd) (PerfectRepG2.pdLE_succ (setup X h) n F hd)

name: PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.Sch.repK0_koszulStep
statement:
theorem repK0_koszulStep (h : HasBundleCovers X) {L : X.Modules} (hL : IsFiniteLocallyFree X L)
    {F F' : X.Modules} {f : tensorSheaf X L F ⟶ F} {g : F ⟶ F'} (zero : f ≫ g = 0)
    (hS : (ShortComplex.mk f g zero).ShortExact) (hF : IsCoherentLike X F)
    (hF' : IsCoherentLike X F') {n d' : ℕ} (hd : PdLE h n F) (hd' : PdLE h d' F') :
    repK0 h F' hF' hd' = (1 - k0ClassOf X L hL) * repK0 h F hF hd
proof:
:= by
  have hLF := tensorSheaf_isCoherentLike X L F hL hF
  have hadd := repK0_add h zero hS hLF hF hF' (pdLE_tensor h hL hF hd) hd hd'
  rw [repK0_tensor h hL F hF hd] at hadd
  have e : (1 - k0ClassOf X L hL : K0 X) =
      @HSub.hSub (K0 X) (K0 X) (K0 X) (@instHSub (K0 X) Ring.toSub) 1 (k0ClassOf X L hL) := by
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
    rfl
  rw [e]
  exact koszul_ring_aux hadd

name: PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.Sch.pdLE_koszulChain
statement:
theorem pdLE_koszulChain (h : HasBundleCovers X) (L : ℕ → X.Modules)
    (hL : ∀ k, IsFiniteLocallyFree X (L k)) (F : ℕ → X.Modules)
    (f : ∀ k, tensorSheaf X (L k) (F k) ⟶ F k) (g : ∀ k, F k ⟶ F (k + 1))
    (zero : ∀ k, f k ≫ g k = 0) (d : ℕ) (hF : ∀ k ≤ d, IsCoherentLike X (F k))
    (hS : ∀ k < d, (ShortComplex.mk (f k) (g k) (zero k)).ShortExact) {n : ℕ}
    (h0 : PdLE h n (F 0)) : ∀ k ≤ d, PdLE h (n + k) (F k)
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro _; exact h0
  | succ k ih =>
    intro hk
    exact pdLE_koszulStep h (hL k) (zero k) (hS k (by omega)) (hF k (by omega)) (hF (k + 1) hk)
      (ih (by omega))

name: PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.Sch.repK0_koszulChain
statement:
theorem repK0_koszulChain (h : HasBundleCovers X) (L : ℕ → X.Modules)
    (hL : ∀ k, IsFiniteLocallyFree X (L k)) (F : ℕ → X.Modules)
    (f : ∀ k, tensorSheaf X (L k) (F k) ⟶ F k) (g : ∀ k, F k ⟶ F (k + 1))
    (zero : ∀ k, f k ≫ g k = 0) (d : ℕ) (hF : ∀ k ≤ d, IsCoherentLike X (F k))
    (hS : ∀ k < d, (ShortComplex.mk (f k) (g k) (zero k)).ShortExact) {n d' : ℕ}
    (h0 : PdLE h n (F 0)) (hd : PdLE h d' (F d)) :
    repK0 h (F d) (hF d le_rfl) hd =
      (∏ k ∈ Finset.range d, (1 - k0ClassOf X (L k) (hL k))) *
        repK0 h (F 0) (hF 0 (Nat.zero_le d)) h0
proof:
:= by
  have hp := pdLE_koszulChain h L hL F f g zero d hF hS h0
  induction d generalizing d' with
  | zero =>
    rw [Finset.prod_range_zero, one_mul]
    exact repK0_congr h _ _ hd h0
  | succ d ih =>
    rw [repK0_koszulStep h (hL d) (zero d) (hS d (Nat.lt_succ_self d)) (hF d (Nat.le_succ d))
      (hF (d + 1) le_rfl) (hp d (Nat.le_succ d)) hd,
      ih (fun k hk => hF k (Nat.le_succ_of_le hk)) (fun k hk => hS k (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hk))
        (hp d (Nat.le_succ d)) (fun k hk => hp k (Nat.le_succ_of_le hk)),
      Finset.prod_range_succ, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm (1 - k0ClassOf X (L d) (hL d))]

name: PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.Sch.pushforward_unit_isCoherentLike_of_knf
statement:
theorem pushforward_unit_isCoherentLike_of_knf {d : ℕ} (hK : HasConstantRank P K d)
    (hnf : ZeroSectionKNF s σ) :
    IsCoherentLike P ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward s).obj (tensorUnitSheaf Z))
proof:
:=
  (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation P.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso (cokernelIsoOfKNF s σ hnf)
    (cokernel_isCoherentLike P hK.isFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation
      (tensorUnitSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree P).isFinitePresentation σ)

name: PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.Sch.rep_pushforward_unit_of_knf
statement:
theorem rep_pushforward_unit_of_knf (h : HasBundleCovers P) {d : ℕ} (hK : HasConstantRank P K d)
    (hnf : ZeroSectionKNF s σ) :
    AbelianResolutionF15.Rep (setup P h) (d + 1)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward s).obj (tensorUnitSheaf Z)) (lambdaMinusOne K hK)
proof:
:= by
  have hreg : IsLocallyKoszulRegular P K σ := fun V x hx => by
    obtain ⟨W, hWV, hxW, hac, -, -⟩ := hnf V x hx
    exact ⟨W, hWV, hxW, hac⟩
  have hΛ : ∀ k, IsFiniteLocallyFree P (exteriorPowerSheaf P K k) := fun k =>
    exteriorPowerSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree P K hK.isFiniteLocallyFree k
  have hz : IsZero (exteriorPowerSheaf P K (0 + (d + 1))) := by
    rw [zero_add]
    exact isZero_exteriorPowerSheaf_of_rank_lt P K d hK (d + 1) (Nat.lt_succ_self d)
  have hR := rep_cokernel_of_exact (setup P h) (fun k => exteriorPowerSheaf P K k) hΛ
    (koszulDiffSheaf P K σ) (koszulDiffSheaf_comp P K σ) (koszulDiffSheaf_exact P K σ hreg)
    (fun k => cokernel_isCoherentLike P (hΛ (k + 1)).isFinitePresentation
      (hΛ k).isFinitePresentation (koszulDiffSheaf P K σ k)) (d + 1) 0 hz
  have hR' := PerfectRepG2.rep_iso (setup P h) (d + 1)
    (koszulCokernelIso P K σ ≪≫ cokernelIsoOfKNF s σ hnf) hR
  convert hR' using 1
  rw [lambdaMinusOne_eq_sum, ← altSum_eq_sum]
  refine altSum_inst_congr ?_ ?_ _ (d + 1)
  · intro _
    rfl
  · intro a b
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
    rfl

name: PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.Sch.pdLE_pushforward_unit_of_knf
statement:
theorem pdLE_pushforward_unit_of_knf (h : HasBundleCovers P) {d : ℕ} (hK : HasConstantRank P K d)
    (hnf : ZeroSectionKNF s σ) :
    PdLE h (d + 1) ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward s).obj (tensorUnitSheaf Z))
proof:
:=
  pdLE_of_rep (setup P h) (d + 1) (pushforward_unit_isCoherentLike_of_knf s σ hK hnf)
    (rep_pushforward_unit_of_knf s σ h hK hnf)

theorem repK0_pushforward_unit_of_knf (h : HasBundleCovers P) {d d' : ℕ}
    (hK : HasConstantRank P K d) (hnf : ZeroSectionKNF s σ)
    (hF : IsCoherentLike P ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward s).obj (tensorUnitSheaf Z)))
    (hd : PdLE h d' ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward s).obj (tensorUnitSheaf Z))) :

proof:
:=
  repK0_eq_of_rep h hF hd (rep_pushforward_unit_of_knf s σ h hK hnf)

name: PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.Sch.repK0_zeroSection_of_knf
statement:
theorem repK0_zeroSection_of_knf (h : HasBundleCovers C.scheme) {r : ℕ}
    (hE : HasConstantRank X (N ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X) (r + 1)) (hnf : ZeroSectionKNFStatement C)
    (V : X.Modules) (hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree X V) {d' : ℕ}
    (hF : IsCoherentLike C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.zeroSection).obj V))
    (hd : PdLE h d' ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.zeroSection).obj V)) :
    repK0 h _ hF hd =
      k0ClassOf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj V)
          (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global C.toBase V hV) *
        lambdaMinusOne C.tautologicalKernel (C.hasConstantRank_tautologicalKernel hE)
proof:
:= by
  have hK := C.hasConstantRank_tautologicalKernel hE
  have hV' := pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global C.toBase V hV
  have hO := pushforward_unit_isCoherentLike_of_knf C.zeroSection (zeroCosection C) hK hnf
  have hpO := pdLE_pushforward_unit_of_knf C.zeroSection (zeroCosection C) h hK hnf
  rw [← repK0_pushforward_unit_of_knf C.zeroSection (zeroCosection C) h hK hnf hO hpO,
    ← repK0_tensor h hV' _ hO hpO (tensorSheaf_isCoherentLike _ _ _ hV' hO)
      (pdLE_tensor h hV' hO hpO)]
  exact (repK0_iso h (zeroSectionPushIso C V hV) _ _ _ _).symm

name: PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.Sch.pdLE_zeroSection_of_knf
statement:
theorem pdLE_zeroSection_of_knf (h : HasBundleCovers C.scheme) {r : ℕ}
    (hE : HasConstantRank X (N ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X) (r + 1)) (hnf : ZeroSectionKNFStatement C)
    (V : X.Modules) (hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree X V) :
    PdLE h (r + 1) ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.zeroSection).obj V)
proof:
:= by
  have hK := C.hasConstantRank_tautologicalKernel hE
  have hV' := pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global C.toBase V hV
  have hO := pushforward_unit_isCoherentLike_of_knf C.zeroSection (zeroCosection C) hK hnf
  exact pdLE_iso h (zeroSectionPushIso C V hV)
    (pdLE_tensor h hV' hO (pdLE_pushforward_unit_of_knf C.zeroSection (zeroCosection C) h hK hnf))

name: PerfectRepTensorKoszulG2.Sch.zeroSection_isCoherentLike_of_knf
statement:
theorem zeroSection_isCoherentLike_of_knf {r : ℕ}
    (hE : HasConstantRank X (N ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X) (r + 1)) (hnf : ZeroSectionKNFStatement C)
    (V : X.Modules) (hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree X V) :
    IsCoherentLike C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.zeroSection).obj V)
proof:
:=
  (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation C.scheme.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
    (zeroSectionPushIso C V hV)
    (tensorSheaf_isCoherentLike _ _ _ (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global C.toBase V hV)
      (pushforward_unit_isCoherentLike_of_knf C.zeroSection (zeroCosection C)
        (C.hasConstantRank_tautologicalKernel hE) hnf))

name: SchemeKTheory.G0PP.exists_free_ses_of_isAffine
statement:
theorem exists_free_ses_of_isAffine (A : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine A] [IsLocallyNoetherian A]
    (M : A.Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ (K F : A.Modules) (ι : K ⟶ F) (g : F ⟶ M) (w : ι ≫ g = 0),
      (ShortComplex.mk ι g w).ShortExact ∧ K.IsFinitePresentation ∧
        ∃ N : ℕ, Nonempty (F ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := A.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin N)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, g, hg⟩ := TowerAR6.exists_free_epi (G0PP.isGG_of_isAffine A M)
  haveI : (SheafOfModules.free (R := A.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin N))).IsFinitePresentation :=
    (free_isFiniteLocallyFree _ (ULift.{u} (Fin N))).isFinitePresentation
  have hS : (ShortComplex.mk (kernel.ι g) g (kernel.condition g)).ShortExact :=
    { exact := ShortComplex.exact_kernel g }
  exact ⟨kernel g, _, kernel.ι g, g, kernel.condition g, hS,
    KSpecialization.kernel_isFinitePresentation g, N, ⟨Iso.refl _⟩⟩

proof:

name: SchemeKTheory.G0PP.pullbackTensorSheafHom_epi_of_free
statement:
theorem pullbackTensorSheafHom_epi_of_free {Y A : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ A) [IsAffine A]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian A] {M : A.Modules} (I : Type u)
    (eM : M ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := A.ringCatSheaf) I) (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree A M)
    (N : A.Modules) [N.IsFinitePresentation] :
    Epi (pullbackTensorSheafHom f M N)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, F, ι, g, w, hS, hK, n, ⟨eF⟩⟩ := exists_free_ses_of_isAffine A N
  haveI : Epi g := hS.epi_g
  haveI : IsIso (pullbackTensorSheafHom f M F) :=
    pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_iso_free f I (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) eM eF
  have hfM := pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global f M hM
  haveI : Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map g) := pullback_map_epi_pp f g
  haveI : Epi (tensorSheafMap Y (𝟙 ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M))
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map g)) :=
    TowerAR6.epi_tensorSheafMap_id_left _ _ hfM
  have hnat := pullbackTensorSheafHom_naturality f (𝟙 M) g
  rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id] at hnat
  haveI : Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map (tensorSheafMap A (𝟙 M) g) ≫
      pullbackTensorSheafHom f M N) := by
    rw [hnat]
    infer_instance
  exact epi_of_epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map (tensorSheafMap A (𝟙 M) g)) _

name: SchemeKTheory.G0PP.pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_free
statement:
theorem pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_free {Y A : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ A) [IsAffine A]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian A] {M : A.Modules} (I : Type u)
    (eM : M ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := A.ringCatSheaf) I) (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree A M)
    (N : A.Modules) [N.IsFinitePresentation] :
    IsIso (pullbackTensorSheafHom f M N)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, F, ι, g, w, hS, hK, n, ⟨eF⟩⟩ := exists_free_ses_of_isAffine A N
  haveI : F.IsFinitePresentation := (isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso _ eF.symm
    (free_isFiniteLocallyFree _ (ULift.{u} (Fin n)))).isFinitePresentation
  haveI : Epi g := hS.epi_g
  have hfM := pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global f M hM
  haveI : (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).IsLeftAdjoint :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).isLeftAdjoint
  haveI := tensorLeftPP_preservesFiniteColimits A M hM
  haveI := tensorLeftPP_preservesFiniteColimits Y _ hfM
  let S := ShortComplex.mk ι g w
  let R₁ := S.map (tensorLeftPP A M ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback f)
  let Φ₂ := Scheme.Modules.pullback f ⋙ tensorLeftPP Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M)
  have hR₂ : (S.map Φ₂).Exact :=
    hS.exact.map_of_epi_of_preservesCokernel Φ₂ hS.epi_g inferInstance
  haveI hR₁ : Epi R₁.g := by
    change Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map (tensorSheafMap A (𝟙 M) g))
    haveI : Epi (tensorSheafMap A (𝟙 M) g) := TowerAR6.epi_tensorSheafMap_id_left g M hM
    exact pullback_map_epi_pp f _
  have c : ∀ {B D : A.Modules} (b : B ⟶ D),
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map (tensorSheafMap A (𝟙 M) b) ≫
          pullbackTensorSheafHom f M D =
        pullbackTensorSheafHom f M B ≫
          tensorSheafMap Y (𝟙 ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M))
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map b) := fun b ↦ by
    have h := pullbackTensorSheafHom_naturality f (𝟙 M) b
    rwa [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id] at h
  exact SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PP.isIso_of_four R₁ (S.map Φ₂) hR₂ (pullbackTensorSheafHom f M K)
    (pullbackTensorSheafHom f M F) (pullbackTensorSheafHom f M N) (c ι) (c g)
    (pullbackTensorSheafHom_epi_of_free f I eM hM K)
    (pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_iso_free f I (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) eM eF)
    (pullbackTensorSheafHom_epi_of_free f I eM hM N)

name: SchemeKTheory.G0PP.pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_left
statement:
theorem pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_left {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (f : Y ⟶ X) (V T : X.Modules) (hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree X V) [T.IsFinitePresentation] :
    IsIso (pullbackTensorSheafHom f V T)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin⟩ := hV.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  let J := Σ j : q.I, {W : X.Opens // IsAffineOpen W ∧ W ≤ q.X j}
  let Wf : J → X.Opens := fun a ↦ a.2.1
  have hW : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop Wf := by
    rw [Opens.coversTop_iff]
    refine eq_top_iff.2 fun x _ ↦ ?_
    have hq' : (⨆ j, q.X j : X.Opens) = ⊤ := (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := X) q.X).1 q.coversTop
    have hx : x ∈ (⨆ j, q.X j : X.Opens) := by
      rw [hq']
      trivial
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.1 hx
    obtain ⟨W, hW, hxW, hWle⟩ :=
      TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.1 X.isBasis_affineOpens hj
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨⟨j, ⟨W, hW, hWle⟩⟩, hxW⟩
  have hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y).CoversTop (fun a ↦ f ⁻¹ᵁ Wf a) := by
    rw [Opens.coversTop_iff] at hW ⊢
    exact f.iSup_preimage_eq_top hW
  refine moduleHom_isIso_of_over_cover _ _ hU fun a ↦ ?_
  let W := Wf a
  haveI : IsAffine W.toScheme := a.2.2.1
  let fM : W ⟶ q.X a.1 := homOfLE a.2.2.2
  let GM := overMapGeneratingSections X fM (q.generators a.1)
  letI : IsIso GM.π := by
    dsimp only [GM]
    infer_instance
  let eM := pullbackIsoFreeOfGeneratingSections W GM
  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback W.ι).obj T).IsFinitePresentation :=
    pullback_isFinitePresentation_global _ T
  haveI hlocal : IsIso (pullbackTensorSheafHom (f ∣_ W) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback W.ι).obj V)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback W.ι).obj T)) :=
    pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_free (f ∣_ W) GM.I eM
      (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global _ V hV) _
  let U := f ⁻¹ᵁ W
  let c := pullbackTensorSheafHom f V T
  apply (over_isIso_iff_restrictFunctor_map_isIso U c).2
  apply (restrictFunctor_map_isIso_iff_pullback_map_isIso U.ι c).2
  let alpha := pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict f W
  haveI htensor : IsIso (tensorSheafMap U (alpha.hom.app V) (alpha.hom.app T)) := by
    change IsIso (tensorSheafMapIso U (alpha.app V) (alpha.app T)).hom
    infer_instance
  haveI hcomp : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).map c ≫
      (openPullbackTensorIso U.ι ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj V)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj T)).hom) := by
    have i_a : IsIso ((pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict f W).inv.app
        (tensorSheaf X V T)) := inferInstance
    have i_b : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f ∣_ W)).map
        (openPullbackTensorIso W.ι V T).hom) := inferInstance
    rw [← pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict_tensorSheaf f W V T]
    exact @IsIso.comp_isIso _ _ _ _ _ _ _ i_a
      (@IsIso.comp_isIso _ _ _ _ _ _ _ i_b (@IsIso.comp_isIso _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hlocal htensor))
  exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right ((Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).map c)
    (openPullbackTensorIso U.ι ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj V)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj T)).hom

statement:
