name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PP.pullbackG0_smul_classOf
statement:
theorem pullbackG0_smul_classOf [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    (V : X.Modules) (hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree X V) (T : X.Modules) (hT : IsCoherentLike X T) :
    G0PB.pullbackG0 C hpos (k0ClassOf X V hV • g0ClassOf X T hT) =
      C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos (k0ClassOf X V hV) •
        G0PB.pullbackG0 C hpos (g0ClassOf X T hT)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : T.IsFinitePresentation := hT
  have hVT : IsCoherentLike X (tensorSheaf X V T) := tensorSheaf_isCoherentLike X V T hV hT
  have hP : IsCoherentLike C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj T) :=
    pullback_isFinitePresentation_global C.toBase T
  have hPVT : IsCoherentLike C.scheme
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj (tensorSheaf X V T)) := by
    haveI : (tensorSheaf X V T).IsFinitePresentation := hVT
    exact pullback_isFinitePresentation_global C.toBase _
  have hPV := pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global C.toBase V hV
  rw [k0ClassOf_smul_g0ClassOf, G0PB.pullbackG0_classOf C hpos _ hVT hPVT,
    G0PB.pullbackG0_classOf C hpos _ hT hP, projectiveBundlePullbackK0_k0ClassOf C hpos V hV,
    k0ClassOf_smul_g0ClassOf]
  haveI := G0PP.pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_left C.toBase V T hV
  exact g0ClassOf_iso C.scheme _ _ (asIso (pullbackTensorSheafHom C.toBase V T))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PP.pullbackG0_smul
statement:
theorem pullbackG0_smul [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    (a : K0 X) (y : G0 X) :
    G0PB.pullbackG0 C hpos (a • y) =
      C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos a • G0PB.pullbackG0 C hpos y
proof:
:= by
  have hy : ∀ (T : X.Modules) (hT : IsCoherentLike X T) (a : K0 X),
      G0PB.pullbackG0 C hpos (a • g0ClassOf X T hT) =
        C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos a • G0PB.pullbackG0 C hpos (g0ClassOf X T hT) := by
    intro T hT a
    let φ : K0 X →+ G0 C.scheme :=
      (G0PB.pullbackG0 C hpos).comp ((k0ActG0 X).flip (g0ClassOf X T hT))
    let ψ : K0 X →+ G0 C.scheme :=
      ((k0ActG0 C.scheme).flip (G0PB.pullbackG0 C hpos (g0ClassOf X T hT))).comp
        (C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos).toAddMonoidHom
    have hφψ : φ = ψ := by
      apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
      rintro ⟨V, hV⟩
      exact pullbackG0_smul_classOf C hpos V hV T hT
    exact congrArg (fun χ : K0 X →+ G0 C.scheme ↦ χ a) hφψ
  let φ : G0 X →+ G0 C.scheme :=
    (G0PB.pullbackG0 C hpos).comp (k0ActG0 X a) -
      (k0ActG0 C.scheme (C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos a)).comp (G0PB.pullbackG0 C hpos)
  have hmem : y ∈ φ.ker := by
    refine G0PB.g0_mem_of_classOf φ.ker (fun T hT ↦ ?_) y
    rw [AddMonoidHom.mem_ker]
    change G0PB.pullbackG0 C hpos (a • g0ClassOf X T hT) -
      C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos a • G0PB.pullbackG0 C hpos (g0ClassOf X T hT) = 0
    rw [hy T hT a, sub_self]
  rw [AddMonoidHom.mem_ker] at hmem
  exact sub_eq_zero.1 hmem

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PP.g0_projectiveBundle_span_coeffFree
statement:
theorem g0_projectiveBundle_span_coeffFree [IsNoetherian X] {N : ℕ}
    (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N) {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (hE : HasConstantRank X E r)
    (z : G0 C.scheme) :
    z ∈ G0PB.twistSpan C (G0PB.hpos_of_rank C hrank) r
proof:
:= by
  have hz := G0PB.g0_projectiveBundle_span C hrank hr hE z
  refine (AddSubgroup.closure_le _).2 ?_ hz
  rintro w ⟨a, y, k, hk, rfl⟩
  refine AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨a • y, k, hk, ?_⟩
  rw [pullbackG0_smul, mul_comm, mul_smul]

statement:
theorem product_derivedPush_pullbackG0_twist [IsNoetherian Y] {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : j < n + 1) (y : G0 Y) :
    projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward (T1N5.cover_rank g hn)
      ((T1N5.cover g n).canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-(j : ℤ)) •
        G0PB.pullbackG0 (T1N5.cover g n)
          (G0PB.hpos_of_rank (T1N5.cover g n) (T1N5.cover_rank g hn)) y) =
      if j = 0 then y else 0
proof:
:=
  derivedPush_pullbackG0_twist_coh (T1N5.cover g n) (T1N5.cover_rank g hn)
    (G0PB.cover_hasConstantRank_g0pb n) j hj y

name: ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR10.preservesColimit_cokernel_of_exactOn
statement:
theorem preservesColimit_cokernel_of_exactOn (Φ : C ⥤ D) [Φ.Additive] (hP : KerCokerClosed P)
    (hΦ : ∀ S : ShortComplex C, S.ShortExact → P S.X₁ → P S.X₂ → P S.X₃ →
      (S.map Φ).ShortExact)
    {A B : C} (f : A ⟶ B) (hA : P A) (hB : P B) :
    PreservesColimit (parallelPair f 0) Φ
proof:
:= by
  let π := cokernel.π f
  let p : A ⟶ kernel π := kernel.lift π f (cokernel.condition f)
  have hp : Epi p := by
    have : (ShortComplex.mk f π (cokernel.condition f)).Exact := ShortComplex.exact_cokernel f
    exact (ShortComplex.exact_iff_epi_kernel_lift _).1 this
  have hK : P (kernel π) := hP.kernel π hB (hP.cokernel f hA hB)
  have hKp : P (kernel p) := hP.kernel p hA hK
  let S1 : ShortComplex C := ShortComplex.mk (kernel.ι p) p (kernel.condition p)
  have hS1 : S1.ShortExact := ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk' (ShortComplex.exact_kernel p) inferInstance hp
  let S2 : ShortComplex C := ShortComplex.mk (kernel.ι π) π (kernel.condition π)
  have hS2 : S2.ShortExact := ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk' (ShortComplex.exact_kernel π) inferInstance inferInstance
  have e1 := hΦ S1 hS1 hKp hA hK
  have e2 := hΦ S2 hS2 hK hB (hP.cokernel f hA hB)
  have hepi : Epi (Φ.map p) := e1.epi_g
  let S3 : ShortComplex D := ShortComplex.mk (Φ.map f) (Φ.map π) (by
    rw [← Φ.map_comp, cokernel.condition, Functor.map_zero])
  let φ : S3 ⟶ S2.map Φ :=
    { τ₁ := Φ.map p
      τ₂ := 𝟙 _
      τ₃ := 𝟙 _
      comm₁₂ := by
        change Φ.map p ≫ Φ.map (kernel.ι π) = Φ.map f ≫ 𝟙 _
        rw [← Φ.map_comp, Category.comp_id]
        simp [p]
      comm₂₃ := by
        change 𝟙 _ ≫ Φ.map π = Φ.map π ≫ 𝟙 _
        simp }
  haveI : Epi φ.τ₁ := hepi
  haveI : IsIso φ.τ₂ := inferInstanceAs (IsIso (𝟙 _))
  haveI : Mono φ.τ₃ := inferInstanceAs (Mono (𝟙 _))
  have hex : S3.Exact := (ShortComplex.exact_iff_of_epi_of_isIso_of_mono φ).2 e2.exact
  haveI : Epi S3.g := e2.epi_g
  refine preservesColimit_of_preserves_colimit_cocone (cokernelIsCokernel f) ?_
  apply (CokernelCofork.isColimitMapCoconeEquiv _ Φ).2
  exact hex.gIsCokernel

name: ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR10.isIso_cokernelComparison_of_exactOn
statement:
theorem isIso_cokernelComparison_of_exactOn (Φ : C ⥤ D) [Φ.Additive] (hP : KerCokerClosed P)
    (hΦ : ∀ S : ShortComplex C, S.ShortExact → P S.X₁ → P S.X₂ → P S.X₃ →
      (S.map Φ).ShortExact)
    {A B : C} (f : A ⟶ B) (hA : P A) (hB : P B) :
    IsIso (cokernelComparison f Φ)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := preservesColimit_cokernel_of_exactOn Φ hP hΦ f hA hB
  infer_instance

name: PerfectRepG2.pdLE_succ
statement: theorem pdLE_succ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (M : C), PdLE S n M → PdLE S (n + 1) M
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro M h Z hZ
    obtain ⟨K, E, i, g, hs, hE, hK, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hZ
    exact S.P_iso e.symm (S.P_ker hs hE ((pdLE_zero_iff S).1 h) hK)
  | succ n ih =>
    intro M h Z hZ
    obtain ⟨K, E, i, g, hs, hE, hK, hZ'⟩ := hZ
    exact ih K (h.ker S hs hE hK) Z hZ'

name: PerfectRepG2.pdLE_mono
statement: theorem pdLE_mono {n m : ℕ} (hnm : n ≤ m) {M : C} (h : PdLE S n M) : PdLE S m M
proof:
:= by
  induction hnm with
  | refl => exact h
  | step _ ih => exact pdLE_succ S _ M ih

name: PerfectRepG2.rep_succ
statement: theorem rep_succ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (M : C) (x : K0 S), Rep S n M x → Rep S (n + 1) M x
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rintro M x ⟨h, rfl⟩
    exact rep_bundle S 1 M h
  | succ n ih =>
    rintro M x ⟨K, E, i, g, y, hs, hE, hK, hy, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨K, E, i, g, y, hs, hE, hK, ih K y hy, rfl⟩

name: PerfectRepG2.rep_mono
statement: theorem rep_mono {n m : ℕ} (hnm : n ≤ m) {M : C} {x : K0 S} (h : Rep S n M x) : Rep S m M x
proof:
:= by
  induction hnm with
  | refl => exact h
  | step _ ih => exact rep_succ S _ M x ih

name: PerfectRepG2.cls_iso
statement: theorem cls_iso {M M' : C} (e : M ≅ M') (h : S.P M) (h' : S.P M') : cls S M h = cls S M' h'
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso C S.P h h' (S.P_zero (isZero_zero C)) (isZero_zero C) e

name: PerfectRepG2.rep_iso
statement:
theorem rep_iso (n : ℕ) {M M' : C} (e : M ≅ M') {x : K0 S} (hx : Rep S n M x) :
    Rep S n M' x
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨S.P_iso e h, cls_iso S e h _⟩
  | succ n =>
    obtain ⟨K, E, i, g, y, hs, hE, hK, hy, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨K, E, i, g ≫ e.hom, y, hs.ofIsoRight e, hE, hK, hy, rfl⟩

name: PerfectRepG2.rep_repK0
statement:
theorem rep_repK0 {d : ℕ} (M : C) (hQ : S.Q M) (h : PdLE S d M) :
    Rep S d M (repK0 S M hQ h)
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (exists_rep S d M hQ h)

name: PerfectRepG2.repK0_eq_of_rep
statement:
theorem repK0_eq_of_rep {d n : ℕ} {M : C} (hQ : S.Q M) (h : PdLE S d M) {x : K0 S}
    (hx : Rep S n M x) : repK0 S M hQ h = x
proof:
:=
  (add_uniq_all S (max d n)).2 M hQ (pdLE_mono S (le_max_left _ _) h) _ _
    (rep_mono S (le_max_left _ _) (rep_repK0 S M hQ h)) (rep_mono S (le_max_right _ _) hx)

name: PerfectRepG2.repK0_congr
statement:
theorem repK0_congr {d d' : ℕ} {M : C} (hQ hQ' : S.Q M) (h : PdLE S d M) (h' : PdLE S d' M) :
    repK0 S M hQ h = repK0 S M hQ' h'
proof:
:=
  repK0_eq_of_rep S hQ h (rep_repK0 S M hQ' h')

name: PerfectRepG2.k0ToG0_repK0
statement:
theorem k0ToG0_repK0 {d : ℕ} (M : C) (hQ : S.Q M) (h : PdLE S d M) :
    k0ToG0 S (repK0 S M hQ h) = gcl S M hQ
proof:
:=
  rep_map S d M _ hQ (rep_repK0 S M hQ h)

name: PerfectRepG2.repK0_cls
statement:
theorem repK0_cls {d : ℕ} (E : C) (hE : S.P E) (hQ : S.Q E) (h : PdLE S d E) :
    repK0 S E hQ h = cls S E hE
proof:
:=
  repK0_eq_of_rep S hQ h (n := 0) ⟨hE, rfl⟩

name: PerfectRepG2.repK0_iso
statement:
theorem repK0_iso {d d' : ℕ} {M M' : C} (e : M ≅ M') (hQ : S.Q M) (hQ' : S.Q M')
    (h : PdLE S d M) (h' : PdLE S d' M') : repK0 S M hQ h = repK0 S M' hQ' h'
proof:
:=
  (repK0_eq_of_rep S hQ' h' (rep_iso S d e (rep_repK0 S M hQ h))).symm

name: PerfectRepG2.repK0_zero
statement:
theorem repK0_zero {d : ℕ} {Z : C} (hZ : IsZero Z) (hQ : S.Q Z) (h : PdLE S d Z) :
    repK0 S Z hQ h = 0
proof:
:=
  repK0_eq_of_rep S hQ h (rep_zero S 0 Z hZ)

name: PerfectRepG2.repK0_add
statement:
theorem repK0_add {A B D : C} {i : A ⟶ B} {g : B ⟶ D} (hs : SES i g) (hQA : S.Q A) (hQB : S.Q B)
    (hQD : S.Q D) {dA dB dD : ℕ} (hA : PdLE S dA A) (hB : PdLE S dB B) (hD : PdLE S dD D) :
    repK0 S B hQB hB = repK0 S A hQA hA + repK0 S D hQD hD
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : dA ≤ max dA (max dB dD) := le_max_left _ _
  have h2 : dB ≤ max dA (max dB dD) := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
  have h3 : dD ≤ max dA (max dB dD) := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
  exact (add_uniq_all S (max dA (max dB dD))).1 hs hQA hQB hQD (pdLE_mono S h1 hA)
    (pdLE_mono S h2 hB) (pdLE_mono S h3 hD) (rep_mono S h1 (rep_repK0 S A hQA hA))
    (rep_mono S h2 (rep_repK0 S B hQB hB)) (rep_mono S h3 (rep_repK0 S D hQD hD))

name: PerfectRepG2.repK0_add'
statement:
theorem repK0_add' {A B D : C} {i : A ⟶ B} {g : B ⟶ D} (zero : i ≫ g = 0)
    (hs : (ShortComplex.mk i g zero).ShortExact) (hQA : S.Q A) (hQB : S.Q B) (hQD : S.Q D)
    {dA dB dD : ℕ} (hA : PdLE S dA A) (hB : PdLE S dB B) (hD : PdLE S dD D) :
    repK0 S B hQB hB = repK0 S A hQA hA + repK0 S D hQD hD
proof:
:=
  repK0_add S ⟨zero, hs⟩ hQA hQB hQD hA hB hD

name: PerfectRepG2.eulerPd_classOf
statement:
theorem eulerPd_classOf (d : ℕ) (M : C) (h : S.Q M ∧ PdLE S d M) :
    eulerPd S d (ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf C _ M h) = repK0 S M h.1 h.2
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.lift_classOf _ _ _

name: PerfectRepG2.liftHom_classOf
statement:
theorem liftHom_classOf (F : C' ⥤ C) (d : ℕ)
    (hobj : ∀ E, P' E → S.Q (F.obj E) ∧ PdLE S d (F.obj E))
    (hses : ∀ {A B D : C'} {i : A ⟶ B} {g : B ⟶ D}, SES i g → P' A → P' B → P' D →
      SES (F.map i) (F.map g)) (E : C') (hE : P' E) :
    liftHom S P' F d hobj hses (ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf C' P' E hE) =
      repK0 S (F.obj E) (hobj E hE).1 (hobj E hE).2
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.lift_classOf _ _ _

name: PerfectRepG2.k0ToG0_liftHom_classOf
statement:
theorem k0ToG0_liftHom_classOf (F : C' ⥤ C) (d : ℕ)
    (hobj : ∀ E, P' E → S.Q (F.obj E) ∧ PdLE S d (F.obj E))
    (hses : ∀ {A B D : C'} {i : A ⟶ B} {g : B ⟶ D}, SES i g → P' A → P' B → P' D →
      SES (F.map i) (F.map g)) (E : C') (hE : P' E) :
    k0ToG0 S (liftHom S P' F d hobj hses (ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf C' P' E hE)) =
      gcl S (F.obj E) (hobj E hE).1
proof:
:= by
  rw [liftHom_classOf, k0ToG0_repK0]

name: PerfectRepG2.Sch.hasBundleCovers_of_closedImmersion

name: PerfectRepG2.Sch.repK0_congr
statement:
theorem repK0_congr (h : HasBundleCovers X) {d d' : ℕ} {F : X.Modules} (hF hF' : IsCoherentLike X F)
    (hd : PdLE h d F) (hd' : PdLE h d' F) : repK0 h F hF hd = repK0 h F hF' hd'

:=
  PerfectRepG2.repK0_congr (setup X h) hF hF' hd hd'

name: PerfectRepG2.Sch.repK0_eq_of_rep
statement:
theorem repK0_eq_of_rep (h : HasBundleCovers X) {d n : ℕ} {F : X.Modules} (hF : IsCoherentLike X F)
    (hd : PdLE h d F) {x : K0 X} (hx : AbelianResolutionF15.Rep (setup X h) n F x) :
    repK0 h F hF hd = x

:=
  PerfectRepG2.repK0_eq_of_rep (setup X h) hF hd hx

name: PerfectRepG2.Sch.k0ToG0_repK0
statement:
theorem k0ToG0_repK0 (h : HasBundleCovers X) {d : ℕ} (F : X.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike X F)
    (hd : PdLE h d F) : k0ToG0 X (repK0 h F hF hd) = g0ClassOf X F hF
proof:
:=
  PerfectRepG2.k0ToG0_repK0 (setup X h) F hF hd

name: PerfectRepG2.Sch.repK0_bundle
statement:
theorem repK0_bundle (h : HasBundleCovers X) {d : ℕ} (E : X.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E)
    (hF : IsCoherentLike X E) (hd : PdLE h d E) : repK0 h E hF hd = k0ClassOf X E hE
proof:
:=
  PerfectRepG2.repK0_cls (setup X h) E hE hF hd

name: PerfectRepG2.Sch.repK0_iso
statement:
theorem repK0_iso (h : HasBundleCovers X) {d d' : ℕ} {F F' : X.Modules} (e : F ≅ F')
    (hF : IsCoherentLike X F) (hF' : IsCoherentLike X F') (hd : PdLE h d F) (hd' : PdLE h d' F') :
    repK0 h F hF hd = repK0 h F' hF' hd'
proof:
:=
  PerfectRepG2.repK0_iso (setup X h) e hF hF' hd hd'

name: PerfectRepG2.Sch.repK0_zero
statement:
theorem repK0_zero (h : HasBundleCovers X) {d : ℕ} {Z : X.Modules} (hZ : IsZero Z)
    (hF : IsCoherentLike X Z) (hd : PdLE h d Z) : repK0 h Z hF hd = 0
proof:
:=
  PerfectRepG2.repK0_zero (setup X h) hZ hF hd

name: PerfectRepG2.Sch.repK0_add
statement:
theorem repK0_add (h : HasBundleCovers X) {A B D : X.Modules} {i : A ⟶ B} {g : B ⟶ D}
    (zero : i ≫ g = 0) (hs : (ShortComplex.mk i g zero).ShortExact) (hA : IsCoherentLike X A)
    (hB : IsCoherentLike X B) (hD : IsCoherentLike X D) {dA dB dD : ℕ} (pA : PdLE h dA A)
    (pB : PdLE h dB B) (pD : PdLE h dD D) :
    repK0 h B hB pB = repK0 h A hA pA + repK0 h D hD pD
proof:
:=
  PerfectRepG2.repK0_add' (setup X h) zero hs hA hB hD pA pB pD

name: PerfectRepG2.Sch.eulerPd_classOf
statement:
theorem eulerPd_classOf (h : HasBundleCovers X) (d : ℕ) (F : X.Modules)
    (hF : IsCoherentLike X F ∧ PdLE h d F) :
    eulerPd h d (ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf X.Modules _ F hF) = repK0 h F hF.1 hF.2
proof:
:=
  PerfectRepG2.eulerPd_classOf (setup X h) d F hF

name: PerfectRepG2.Sch.liftHom_k0ClassOf
statement:
theorem liftHom_k0ClassOf (h : HasBundleCovers X) {Z : Scheme.{u}} (Φ : Z.Modules ⥤ X.Modules)
    (d : ℕ)
    (hobj : ∀ E, IsFiniteLocallyFree Z E → IsCoherentLike X (Φ.obj E) ∧ PdLE h d (Φ.obj E))
    (hses : ∀ {A B D : Z.Modules} {i : A ⟶ B} {g : B ⟶ D} (zero : i ≫ g = 0),
      (ShortComplex.mk i g zero).ShortExact → IsFiniteLocallyFree Z A →
        IsFiniteLocallyFree Z B → IsFiniteLocallyFree Z D →
          ∃ zero' : Φ.map i ≫ Φ.map g = 0, (ShortComplex.mk (Φ.map i) (Φ.map g) zero').ShortExact)
    (E : Z.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree Z E) :
    liftHom h Φ d hobj hses (k0ClassOf Z E hE) = repK0 h (Φ.obj E) (hobj E hE).1 (hobj E hE).2
proof:
:=
  PerfectRepG2.liftHom_classOf (setup X h) (IsFiniteLocallyFree Z) Φ d hobj
    (fun hs hA hB hD => by
      obtain ⟨zero', hs'⟩ := hses hs.zero hs.exact hA hB hD
      exact ⟨zero', hs'⟩) E hE

name: PerfectRepG2.Sch.k0ToG0_liftHom_k0ClassOf
statement:
theorem k0ToG0_liftHom_k0ClassOf (h : HasBundleCovers X) {Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (Φ : Z.Modules ⥤ X.Modules) (d : ℕ)
    (hobj : ∀ E, IsFiniteLocallyFree Z E → IsCoherentLike X (Φ.obj E) ∧ PdLE h d (Φ.obj E))
    (hses : ∀ {A B D : Z.Modules} {i : A ⟶ B} {g : B ⟶ D} (zero : i ≫ g = 0),
      (ShortComplex.mk i g zero).ShortExact → IsFiniteLocallyFree Z A →
        IsFiniteLocallyFree Z B → IsFiniteLocallyFree Z D →
          ∃ zero' : Φ.map i ≫ Φ.map g = 0, (ShortComplex.mk (Φ.map i) (Φ.map g) zero').ShortExact)
    (E : Z.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree Z E) :
    k0ToG0 X (liftHom h Φ d hobj hses (k0ClassOf Z E hE)) =
      g0ClassOf X (Φ.obj E) (hobj E hE).1
proof:
:= by
  rw [liftHom_k0ClassOf, k0ToG0_repK0]

name: BundleCoversProjBundleG2.exists_closedImmersion_frameCover
statement:
theorem exists_closedImmersion_frameCover (n : ℕ) {X : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ space R n)
    [IsClosedImmersion j] {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r)
    (C : AffineFrameCover X E) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (ι : C.scheme ⟶ space R m), IsClosedImmersion ι ∧
      ι ≫ toSpec R m = C.toBase ≫ j ≫ toSpec R n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, Ct, m, ι, hι, hιf⟩ := D37.exists_closedImmersion_twist_into_product_pos n j E r hE
  have hL : HasConstantRank X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n (D : ℤ))) 1 :=
    hasConstantRank_pullback X j _ 1
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.hasConstantRank_twist (k := R) n (D : ℤ))
  obtain ⟨iso, hiso⟩ := AlgebraicGeometry.D38.twistInvariance _ E hL hE C Ct
  haveI := hι
  haveI := SegreD36.isClosedImmersion_segreHomStd (k := R) n m
  refine ⟨SegreD36.segreDim n m, iso.hom ≫ ι ≫ SegreD36.segreHomStd n m, inferInstance, ?_⟩
  rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, SegreD36.segreHomStd, SegreD36.segreHom_toSpec,
    ← Category.assoc ι, hιf, Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc iso.hom, hiso]

name: BundleCoversProjBundleG2.hasBundleCovers_frameCover
statement:
theorem hasBundleCovers_frameCover (n : ℕ) {X : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ space R n)
    [IsClosedImmersion j] {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r)
    (C : AffineFrameCover X E) : HasBundleCovers C.scheme
proof:

name: QCExtension.chartToOpen_inv
statement:
lemma chartToOpen_inv (U W : X.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W) :
    chartToOpen U W hW ≫ hW.isoSpec.hom = (chartOpen U W hW).ι
proof:
:= by
  simp [chartToOpen]

name: QCExtension.chartOpen_isCompact
statement:
lemma chartOpen_isCompact (U W : X.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
    (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X)) :
    IsCompact (chartOpen U W hW : Set (Spec Γ(X, W)))
proof:
:= by
  let φ := hW.fromSpec
  have hrange : Set.range φ = W := hW.range_fromSpec
  have hUW : IsCompact ((U : Set X) ∩ W) :=
    QuasiSeparatedSpace.inter_isCompact _ _ U.2 hU W.2 hW.isCompact
  have h1 := (φ.isOpenEmbedding.isInducing.isCompact_preimage_iff
    (K := (U : Set X) ∩ W) (by rw [hrange]; exact Set.inter_subset_right)).2 hUW
  have h2 : φ ⁻¹' ((U : Set X) ∩ W) =
      (chartOpen U W hW : Set (Spec Γ(X, W))) := by
    ext y
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_inter_iff, chartOpen, Scheme.Hom.coe_preimage,
      SetLike.mem_coe]
    constructor
    · exact fun h => h.1
    · intro h
      have hy : φ y ∈ Set.range φ := Set.mem_range_self y
      rw [hrange] at hy
      exact ⟨h, hy⟩
  rwa [h2] at h1

name: QCExtension.exists_extension_on_affine_chart
statement:
theorem exists_extension_on_affine_chart (U W : X.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
    [IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, W)] (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X))
    (F : (U : Scheme.{u}).Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ E : (W : Scheme.{u}).Modules, E.IsFinitePresentation ∧
      Nonempty (E.restrict (chartToOpen U W hW) ≅ F.restrict (chartToU U W hW))
proof:
:= by
  let V := chartOpen U W hW
  let k := chartToU U W hW
  haveI : (F.restrict k).IsFinitePresentation := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor k F
  obtain ⟨E', hE', ⟨e⟩⟩ :=
    exists_extension_of_isCompact V (chartOpen_isCompact U W hW hU) (F.restrict k)
  let E := E'.restrict hW.isoSpec.hom
  haveI : E.IsFinitePresentation := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor hW.isoSpec.hom E'
  refine ⟨E, inferInstance, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  exact ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp (chartToOpen U W hW) hW.isoSpec.hom).app E').symm ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr (chartToOpen_inv U W hW)).app E' ≪≫ e

name: QCExtension.g0Class_restrict_chart_mem_range
statement:
theorem g0Class_restrict_chart_mem_range (U W : X.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
    [IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, W)] (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X))
    (F : (U : Scheme.{u}).Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] :
    g0ClassOf (chartOpen U W hW : Scheme.{u})
      (F.restrict (chartToU U W hW))
      (isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor (chartToU U W hW) F) ∈
      (flatPullbackG0 (chartToOpen U W hW)).range
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E, hE, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_extension_on_affine_chart U W hW hU F
  refine ⟨g0ClassOf (W : Scheme.{u}) E hE, ?_⟩
  rw [flatPullbackG0_classOf]
  exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso _
    (IsCoherentLike (chartOpen U W hW : Scheme.{u})) _
    (isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor (chartToU U W hW) F)
    (show IsCoherentLike (chartOpen U W hW : Scheme.{u})
      (0 : (chartOpen U W hW : Scheme.{u}).Modules) from
      inferInstanceAs (0 : (chartOpen U W hW : Scheme.{u}).Modules).IsFinitePresentation)
    (Limits.isZero_zero _)
    (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (chartToOpen U W hW)).app E).symm ≪≫ e)

name: SchemeKTheory.k0Class_middle
statement:
theorem k0Class_middle {A B D : X.Modules}
    [IsFiniteLocallyFree X A]
    [IsFiniteLocallyFree X B]
    [IsFiniteLocallyFree X D]
    {f : A ⟶ B} {g : B ⟶ D} (zero : f ≫ g = 0)
    (h : (ShortComplex.mk f g zero).ShortExact) :
    k0Class X B = k0Class X A + k0Class X D
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_middle X.Modules (IsFiniteLocallyFree X)
    inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance zero h

name: SchemeKTheory.k0Class_free_sum
statement:
theorem k0Class_free_sum (I J : Type u) [Finite I] [Finite J] :
    k0Class X (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (I ⊕ J)) =
      k0Class X (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I) +
        k0Class X (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) J)
proof:
:= by
  let A : X.Modules := SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I
  let B : X.Modules := SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) J
  let M : X.Modules := A ⊞ B
  let T : X.Modules := SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (I ⊕ J)
  let e : M ≅ T := freeBinaryIso X I J
  letI : IsFiniteLocallyFree X A := free_isFiniteLocallyFree X I
  letI : IsFiniteLocallyFree X B := free_isFiniteLocallyFree X J
  letI : IsFiniteLocallyFree X T := free_isFiniteLocallyFree X (I ⊕ J)
  letI : IsFiniteLocallyFree X M :=
    isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso X e.symm (free_isFiniteLocallyFree X (I ⊕ J))
  let S : ShortComplex X.Modules :=
    ShortComplex.mk (biprod.inl : A ⟶ M) (biprod.snd : M ⟶ B) (by simp)
  have hS : S.ShortExact := by
    exact ⟨(ShortComplex.Splitting.ofHasBinaryBiproduct A B).exact⟩
  have hrel : k0Class X M = k0Class X A + k0Class X B :=
    k0Class_middle X S.zero hS
  have hiso : k0Class X M = k0Class X T :=
    k0ClassOf_iso X inferInstance inferInstance e
  exact hiso.symm.trans hrel

name: SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem k0ClassOf_zero :
    k0ClassOf X (0 : X.Modules) (zero_isFiniteLocallyFree X) = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_isZero X.Modules
    (IsFiniteLocallyFree X) (zero_isFiniteLocallyFree X) (isZero_zero _)

name: SchemeKTheory.k0Class_free_fin
statement:
theorem k0Class_free_fin (n : ℕ) :
    k0Class X (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin n))) =
      n • k0Class X (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) :=
    unit_isFiniteLocallyFree X
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      have hiso := k0ClassOf_iso X
        (free_isFiniteLocallyFree X (ULift.{u} (Fin 0)))
        (zero_isFiniteLocallyFree X) (freeFinZeroIsoZero X)
      rw [zero_nsmul]
      change k0ClassOf X
          (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin 0)))
          (free_isFiniteLocallyFree X (ULift.{u} (Fin 0))) = 0
      exact hiso.trans (k0ClassOf_zero X)
  | succ n ih =>
      let eSum :
          SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf)
              (ULift.{u} (Fin n) ⊕ ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) ≅
            SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1))) :=
        (SheafOfModules.freeFunctor (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).mapIso
          ((Equiv.sumCongr Equiv.ulift Equiv.ulift).trans
            (finSumFinEquiv.trans Equiv.ulift.symm)).toIso
      letI : IsFiniteLocallyFree X
          (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf)
            (ULift.{u} (Fin n) ⊕ ULift.{u} (Fin 1))) :=
        free_isFiniteLocallyFree X (ULift.{u} (Fin n) ⊕ ULift.{u} (Fin 1))
      letI : IsFiniteLocallyFree X
          (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)))) :=
        free_isFiniteLocallyFree X (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)))
      have hsum := k0Class_free_sum X (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) (ULift.{u} (Fin 1))
      have hsumFin :
          k0Class X (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf)
              (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)))) =
            k0Class X (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf)
              (ULift.{u} (Fin n))) +
              k0Class X (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf)
                (ULift.{u} (Fin 1))) := by
        have hiso := k0ClassOf_iso X
          (free_isFiniteLocallyFree X
            (ULift.{u} (Fin n) ⊕ ULift.{u} (Fin 1)))
          (free_isFiniteLocallyFree X (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)))) eSum
        exact hiso.symm.trans hsum
      have hone :
          k0Class X (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf)
              (ULift.{u} (Fin 1))) =
            k0Class X (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) :=
        k0ClassOf_iso X (free_isFiniteLocallyFree X (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)))
          (unit_isFiniteLocallyFree X) (freeFinOneIsoUnit X)
      rw [hsumFin, ih, hone, succ_nsmul]

name: SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem g0ClassOf_zero (hzero : IsCoherentLike X (0 : X.Modules)) :
    g0ClassOf X (0 : X.Modules) hzero = 0
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_isZero X.Modules (IsCoherentLike X)
    hzero (CategoryTheory.Limits.isZero_zero _)

name: SchemeKTheory.g0Class_middle
statement:
theorem g0Class_middle {A B D : X.Modules}
    [A.IsFinitePresentation] [B.IsFinitePresentation] [D.IsFinitePresentation]
    {f : A ⟶ B} {g : B ⟶ D} (zero : f ≫ g = 0)
    (h : (ShortComplex.mk f g zero).ShortExact) :
    g0Class X B = g0Class X A + g0Class X D
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_middle X.Modules (IsCoherentLike X)
    (show IsCoherentLike X A from inferInstanceAs A.IsFinitePresentation)
    (show IsCoherentLike X B from inferInstanceAs B.IsFinitePresentation)
    (show IsCoherentLike X D from inferInstanceAs D.IsFinitePresentation) zero h

name: SchemeKTheory.k0ToG0_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem k0ToG0_classOf (E : X.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) :
    k0ToG0 X (k0ClassOf X E hE) =
      g0ClassOf X E hE.isFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  exact ExactGrothendieck.map_classOf (k0ToG0Object X) (fun _ _ _ h ↦ h) ⟨E, hE⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.k0ToG0_k0Class
statement:
@[simp]
theorem k0ToG0_k0Class (E : X.Modules) [IsFiniteLocallyFree X E] :
    k0ToG0 X (k0Class X E) = g0Class X E
proof:
:=
  k0ToG0_classOf X E inferInstance

name: SchemeKTheory.k0CommRing_mul_classOf
statement:
theorem k0CommRing_mul_classOf (T : K0TensorData X)
    (E F : {M : X.Modules // IsFiniteLocallyFree X M}) :
    @Mul.mul (K0 X) (k0CommRing X T).toMul
      (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ E) (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ F) =
        ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ (T.tensor E F)
proof:
:= by
  change ExactGrothendieck.product T.tensor T.exactLeft T.exactRight
    (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ E) (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ F) = _
  exact ExactGrothendieck.product_classOf_classOf
    T.tensor T.exactLeft T.exactRight E F

name: SchemeKTheory.frameFinite_E13
statement:
theorem frameFinite_E13 {M : X.Modules} {U : X.Opens} {J : Type u} [Finite J]
    (e : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) J ≅ M.over U) :
    (SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.equivOfIso e
      (SheafOfModules.free.generatingSections J)).IsFiniteType
proof:
:= by
  haveI : (SheafOfModules.free.generatingSections (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) J).IsFiniteType :=
    SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.IsFiniteType.mk (show Finite J from inferInstance)
  exact SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.equivOfIso_isFiniteType _ e

name: SchemeKTheory.hasConstantRank_biprod_E13
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_biprod_E13 {M N : X.Modules} {r s : ℕ} (hM : HasConstantRank X M r)
    (hN : HasConstantRank X N s) : HasConstantRank X (M ⊞ N) (r + s)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨q₁, hq₁, hq₁fin, hc₁⟩ := hM
  obtain ⟨q₃, hq₃, hq₃fin, hc₃⟩ := hN
  letI : q₁.IsLocallyFreeData := hq₁
  letI : q₁.IsFiniteType := hq₁fin
  letI : q₃.IsLocallyFreeData := hq₃
  letI : q₃.IsFiniteType := hq₃fin
  have hcover₁ : IsOpenCover q₁.X := (Opens.coversTop_iff X q₁.X).mp q₁.coversTop
  have hcover₃ : IsOpenCover q₃.X := (Opens.coversTop_iff X q₃.X).mp q₃.coversTop
  have hi : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ q₁.X i := fun x ↦ by
    have : x ∈ ⋃ i, (q₁.X i : Set X) := by
      rw [hcover₁.iSup_set_eq_univ]; exact Set.mem_univ x
    simpa using this
  have hj : ∀ x : X, ∃ j, x ∈ q₃.X j := fun x ↦ by
    have : x ∈ ⋃ i, (q₃.X i : Set X) := by
      rw [hcover₃.iSup_set_eq_univ]; exact Set.mem_univ x
    simpa using this
  choose i hxi using hi
  choose j hxj using hj
  have hfin₁ : ∀ x, Finite (q₁.generators (i x)).I := fun x ↦ by
    letI : (q₁.generators (i x)).IsFiniteType :=
      SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType (i x)
    infer_instance
  have hfin₃ : ∀ x, Finite (q₃.generators (j x)).I := fun x ↦ by
    letI : (q₃.generators (j x)).IsFiniteType :=
      SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType (j x)
    infer_instance
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ : ∃ U : X → X.Opens,
      ∀ x, x ∈ U x ∧ U x ≤ q₁.X (i x) ∧ U x ≤ q₃.X (j x) :=
    ⟨fun x ↦ q₁.X (i x) ⊓ q₃.X (j x), fun x ↦ ⟨⟨hxi x, hxj x⟩, inf_le_left, inf_le_right⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨e⟩ : Nonempty (∀ x : X, SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over (U x))
      ((q₁.generators (i x)).I ⊕ (q₃.generators (j x)).I) ≅ (M ⊞ N).over (U x)) :=
    ⟨fun x ↦ biprodFrameIsoE9 (U x) _ _ (frameOverLEE9 q₁ (i x) (U x) (hU x).2.1)
      (frameOverLEE9 q₃ (j x) (U x) (hU x).2.2)⟩
  refine ⟨{ I := X, X := U, coversTop := ?_
            generators := fun x ↦ SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.equivOfIso (e x)
              (SheafOfModules.free.generatingSections _) }, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Opens.coversTop_iff]
    exact top_le_iff.mp fun y _ ↦ TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨y, (hU y).1⟩
  · constructor
    intro y
    infer_instance
  · constructor
    intro y
    haveI := hfin₁ y
    haveI := hfin₃ y
    exact frameFinite_E13 (e y)
  · intro y
    haveI := hfin₁ y
    haveI := hfin₃ y
    change Nat.card ((q₁.generators (i y)).I ⊕ (q₃.generators (j y)).I) = r + s
    rw [Nat.card_sum, hc₁, hc₃]

name: SchemeKTheory.hasConstantRank_biprod_lines_E13
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_biprod_lines_E13 {L M : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1) : HasConstantRank X (L ⊞ M) 2
proof:
:=
  hasConstantRank_biprod_E13 hL hM

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.shortExact_of_over_cover
statement:
theorem shortExact_of_over_cover (X : Scheme.{u})
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) {I : Type u} (U : I → X.Opens)
    (hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop U)
    (hS : ∀ i, (S.map (overRestrictionFunctor X (U i))).ShortExact) :
    S.ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  have hpoint : ∀ x : X, (S.map (stalkFunctor X x)).ShortExact := by
    intro x
    let hcover : IsOpenCover U :=
      (Opens.coversTop_iff X U).mp hU
    have hxUnion : x ∈ ⋃ i, (U i : Set X) := by
      rw [hcover.iSup_set_eq_univ]
      exact Set.mem_univ x
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hxUnion
    obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := hxUnion
    have hi :
        ((S.map (overRestrictionFunctor X (U i))).map
          (overStalkFunctor X (U i) x hxi)).ShortExact :=
      (hS i).map_of_exact _
    exact ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso
      (S.mapNatIso (overStalkNatIso X (U i) x hxi)) hi
  apply CategoryTheory.ShortExact.reflects_shortExact_of_faithful
    (toAddCommGrpSheaf X)
  refine ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk' ?_ ?_ ?_
  · exact (exact_of_over_cover X S U hU (fun i ↦ (hS i).exact)).map _
  · rw [TopCat.Presheaf.mono_iff_stalk_mono]
    intro x
    change Mono ((S.map (stalkFunctor X x)).f)
    exact (hpoint x).mono_f
  · rw [← TopCat.Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi,
      TopCat.Presheaf.locally_surjective_iff_surjective_on_stalks]
    intro x
    rw [← AddCommGrpCat.epi_iff_surjective]
    change Epi ((S.map (stalkFunctor X x)).g)
    exact (hpoint x).epi_g

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.shortExact_of_restrict_cover
statement:
theorem shortExact_of_restrict_cover (X : Scheme.{u})
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) {I : Type u} (U : I → X.Opens)
    (hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop U)
    (hS : ∀ i,
      (S.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι)).ShortExact) :
    S.ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  have hpoint : ∀ x : X, (S.map (stalkFunctor X x)).ShortExact := by
    intro x
    let hcover : IsOpenCover U :=
      (Opens.coversTop_iff X U).mp hU
    have hxUnion : x ∈ ⋃ i, (U i : Set X) := by
      rw [hcover.iSup_set_eq_univ]
      exact Set.mem_univ x
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hxUnion
    obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := hxUnion
    have hi :
        ((S.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι)).map
          (stalkFunctor (U i).toScheme ⟨x, hxi⟩)).ShortExact :=
      (hS i).map_of_exact _
    exact ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso
      (S.mapNatIso
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso (U i).ι ⟨x, hxi⟩)) hi
  apply CategoryTheory.ShortExact.reflects_shortExact_of_faithful
    (toAddCommGrpSheaf X)
  refine ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk' ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [TopCat.Sheaf.exact_iff_stalkFunctor_map_exact]
    intro x
    change (S.map (stalkFunctor X x)).Exact
    exact (hpoint x).exact
  · rw [TopCat.Presheaf.mono_iff_stalk_mono]
    intro x
    change Mono ((S.map (stalkFunctor X x)).f)
    exact (hpoint x).mono_f
  · rw [← TopCat.Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi,
      TopCat.Presheaf.locally_surjective_iff_surjective_on_stalks]
    intro x
    rw [← AddCommGrpCat.epi_iff_surjective]
    change Epi ((S.map (stalkFunctor X x)).g)
    exact (hpoint x).epi_g

name: AlgebraicGeometry.finite_pushforward_map_shortExact
statement:
theorem finite_pushforward_map_shortExact
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f]
    (T : ShortComplex X.Modules)
    [T.X₁.IsQuasicoherent] [T.X₂.IsQuasicoherent]
    [T.X₃.IsQuasicoherent] (hT : T.ShortExact) :
    (T.map (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f)).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  let C := Y.affineOpenCover.openCover
  let U : C.I₀ → Y.Opens := fun i ↦ (C.f i).opensRange
  have hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y).CoversTop U :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := Y) U).2 C.isOpenCover_opensRange
  apply Scheme.Modules.shortExact_of_restrict_cover Y
    (T.map (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f)) U hU
  intro i
  have hAffine : IsAffineOpen (U i) := isAffineOpen_opensRange (C.f i)
  letI : IsAffine (U i).toScheme := hAffine
  letI : IsAffine (f ⁻¹ᵁ (U i)).toScheme := hAffine.preimage f
  let Ti := T.map
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ (U i)).ι)
  have hTi : Ti.ShortExact :=
    Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor_map_shortExact
      (f ⁻¹ᵁ (U i)).ι T hT
  letI : Ti.X₁.IsQuasicoherent := by
    change ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
      (f ⁻¹ᵁ (U i)).ι).obj T.X₁).IsQuasicoherent
    infer_instance
  letI : Ti.X₂.IsQuasicoherent := by
    change ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
      (f ⁻¹ᵁ (U i)).ι).obj T.X₂).IsQuasicoherent
    infer_instance
  letI : Ti.X₃.IsQuasicoherent := by
    change ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
      (f ⁻¹ᵁ (U i)).ι).obj T.X₃).IsQuasicoherent
    infer_instance
  have hlocal :
      (Ti.map (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ (U i)))).ShortExact :=
    pushforward_map_shortExact_of_isAffine (f ∣_ (U i)) Ti hTi
  have hcomp :
      (T.map
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ (U i)).ι ⋙
          Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ (U i)))).ShortExact := by
    simpa only [Ti, ShortComplex.map_comp] using hlocal
  exact ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso
    (T.mapNatIso (restrictPushforwardNatIso f (U i))).symm hcomp

name: SchemeKTheory.finitePushforwardExact
statement:
theorem finitePushforwardExact (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    (A B C : {M : X.Modules // IsCoherentLike X M})
    (h : ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules (IsCoherentLike X) A B C) :
    ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn Y.Modules (IsCoherentLike Y)
      (finitePushObject f A) (finitePushObject f B) (finitePushObject f C)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, zero, hshort⟩ := h
  letI : A.1.IsFinitePresentation := A.2
  letI : B.1.IsFinitePresentation := B.2
  letI : C.1.IsFinitePresentation := C.2
  let T : ShortComplex X.Modules := ShortComplex.mk a b zero
  let Q : ShortComplex Y.Modules := T.map (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f)
  change ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn Y.Modules (IsCoherentLike Y)
    ⟨Q.X₁, (finitePushObject f A).2⟩
    ⟨Q.X₂, (finitePushObject f B).2⟩
    ⟨Q.X₃, (finitePushObject f C).2⟩
  exact ⟨Q.f, Q.g, Q.zero,
    finite_pushforward_map_shortExact f T hshort⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.finitePushforward_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finitePushforward_classOf
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    (E : X.Modules) (hE : IsCoherentLike X E) :
    finitePushforward f (g0ClassOf X E hE) =
      g0ClassOf Y ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj E)
        (finitePushObject f ⟨E, hE⟩).2
proof:
:= by
  exact ExactGrothendieck.map_classOf
    (finitePushObject f) (finitePushforwardExact f) ⟨E, hE⟩

name: AbelianResolutionF15.SES.mono
statement: theorem mono (h : SES i g) : Mono i
proof: := h.exact.mono_f

name: AbelianResolutionF15.SES.epi
statement: theorem epi (h : SES i g) : Epi g
proof: := h.exact.epi_g

name: AbelianResolutionF15.SES.lift_exists
statement:
theorem lift_exists (h : SES i g) {T : C} (k : T ⟶ E) (hk : k ≫ g = 0) :
    ∃ u : T ⟶ K, u ≫ i = k
proof:
:= by
  haveI := h.mono
  have hK := h.exact.exact.fIsKernel
  exact ⟨hK.lift (KernelFork.ofι k hk), hK.fac (KernelFork.ofι k hk) .zero⟩

name: AbelianResolutionF15.SES.ofKernel
statement: theorem ofKernel (zero : i ≫ g = 0) [Epi g] (hK : IsLimit (KernelFork.ofι i zero)) : SES i g
proof:
:=
  ⟨zero, ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk' (ShortComplex.exact_of_f_is_kernel _ hK)
    (Limits.mono_of_isLimit_fork hK) inferInstance⟩

name: AbelianResolutionF15.SES.ofIsoRight
statement: theorem ofIsoRight (h : SES i g) {M' : C} (e : M ≅ M') : SES i (g ≫ e.hom)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨by rw [← Category.assoc, h.zero, zero_comp], ?_⟩
  have hiso : ShortComplex.mk i g h.zero ≅ ShortComplex.mk i (g ≫ e.hom)
      (by rw [← Category.assoc, h.zero, zero_comp]) :=
    ShortComplex.isoMk (Iso.refl K) (Iso.refl E) e (by simp) (by simp)
  exact ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso hiso h.exact

name: AbelianResolutionF15.SES.kernel_of_epi
statement: theorem kernel_of_epi (g : E ⟶ M) [Epi g] : SES (kernel.ι g) g
proof:
:=
  ⟨kernel.condition g, ⟨ShortComplex.exact_kernel g⟩⟩

name: AbelianResolutionF15.SES.pullbackR
statement:
theorem pullbackR (h : SES i g) {X : C} (f : X ⟶ M) :
    SES (pullback.lift (0 : K ⟶ X) i (by rw [zero_comp, h.zero])) (pullback.fst f g)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := h.mono
  haveI := h.epi
  haveI : Mono (pullback.lift (f := f) (g := g) (0 : K ⟶ X) i (by rw [zero_comp, h.zero])) :=
    mono_of_mono_fac (pullback.lift_snd (f := f) (g := g) _ _ _)
  have hz : pullback.lift (f := f) (g := g) (0 : K ⟶ X) i (by rw [zero_comp, h.zero]) ≫
      pullback.fst f g = 0 :=
    pullback.lift_fst _ _ _
  refine ofKernel hz (KernelFork.IsLimit.ofι' _ hz ?_)
  intro T k hk
  have hk' : (k ≫ pullback.snd f g) ≫ g = 0 := by
    rw [Category.assoc, ← pullback.condition, ← Category.assoc, hk, zero_comp]
  refine ⟨(h.liftSub _ hk').1, ?_⟩
  apply pullback.hom_ext
  · rw [Category.assoc, pullback.lift_fst, comp_zero, hk]
  · rw [Category.assoc, pullback.lift_snd]
    exact (h.liftSub _ hk').2

name: AbelianResolutionF15.SES.pullbackL
statement:
theorem pullbackL (h : SES i g) {X : C} (f : X ⟶ M) :
    SES (pullback.lift i (0 : K ⟶ X) (by rw [zero_comp, h.zero])) (pullback.snd g f)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := h.mono
  haveI := h.epi
  haveI : Mono (pullback.lift (f := g) (g := f) i (0 : K ⟶ X) (by rw [zero_comp, h.zero])) :=
    mono_of_mono_fac (pullback.lift_fst (f := g) (g := f) _ _ _)
  have hz : pullback.lift (f := g) (g := f) i (0 : K ⟶ X) (by rw [zero_comp, h.zero]) ≫
      pullback.snd g f = 0 :=
    pullback.lift_snd _ _ _
  refine ofKernel hz (KernelFork.IsLimit.ofι' _ hz ?_)
  intro T k hk
  have hk' : (k ≫ pullback.fst g f) ≫ g = 0 := by
    rw [Category.assoc, pullback.condition, ← Category.assoc, hk, zero_comp]
  refine ⟨(h.liftSub _ hk').1, ?_⟩
  apply pullback.hom_ext
  · rw [Category.assoc, pullback.lift_fst]
    exact (h.liftSub _ hk').2
  · rw [Category.assoc, pullback.lift_snd, comp_zero, hk]

name: AbelianResolutionF15.SES.comp
statement:
theorem comp (h : SES i g) {X : C} (a : X ⟶ E) [Epi a] :
    SES (pullback.snd i a) (a ≫ g)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := h.mono
  haveI := h.epi
  have hz : pullback.snd i a ≫ a ≫ g = 0 := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← pullback.condition, Category.assoc, h.zero, comp_zero]
  refine ofKernel hz (KernelFork.IsLimit.ofι' _ hz ?_)
  intro T k hk
  have hk' : (k ≫ a) ≫ g = 0 := by rw [Category.assoc, hk]
  exact ⟨pullback.lift (h.liftSub _ hk').1 k (h.liftSub _ hk').2, pullback.lift_snd _ _ _⟩

name: AbelianResolutionF15.SES.zeroId
statement: theorem zeroId {K : C} (hK : IsZero K) (E : C) : SES (0 : K ⟶ E) (𝟙 E)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Mono (0 : K ⟶ E) := hK.mono _
  refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
  exact ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk'
    ((ShortComplex.exact_iff_mono (ShortComplex.mk (0 : K ⟶ E) (𝟙 E) (by simp)) rfl).2
      (inferInstance : Mono (𝟙 E))) inferInstance inferInstance

name: AbelianResolutionF15.Syz.ofIsoRight
statement: theorem Syz.ofIsoRight {n : ℕ} {Z M M' : C} (h : Syz S n Z M) (e : M ≅ M') : Syz S n Z M'
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => obtain ⟨e1⟩ := h; exact ⟨e1 ≪≫ e⟩
  | succ n =>
    obtain ⟨K, E, i, g, hs, hE, hK, hZ⟩ := h
    exact ⟨K, E, i, g ≫ e.hom, hs.ofIsoRight e, hE, hK, hZ⟩

name: AbelianResolutionF15.PdLE.iso
statement: theorem PdLE.iso {n : ℕ} {M M' : C} (h : PdLE S n M) (e : M ≅ M') : PdLE S n M'
proof:
:=
  fun Z hZ => h Z (hZ.ofIsoRight S e.symm)

name: AbelianResolutionF15.pdLE_zero_iff
statement: theorem pdLE_zero_iff {M : C} : PdLE S 0 M ↔ S.P M
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h; exact h M ⟨Iso.refl M⟩
  · rintro h Z ⟨e⟩; exact S.P_iso e.symm h

name: AbelianResolutionF15.PdLE.ker
statement:
theorem PdLE.ker {n : ℕ} {M K E : C} {i : K ⟶ E} {g : E ⟶ M} (h : PdLE S (n + 1) M)
    (hs : SES i g) (hE : S.P E) (hK : S.Q K) : PdLE S n K
proof:
:=
  fun Z hZ => h Z ⟨K, E, i, g, hs, hE, hK, hZ⟩

name: AbelianResolutionF15.pdLE_of_P
statement: theorem pdLE_of_P : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : C), S.P E → PdLE S n E
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro E hE; exact (pdLE_zero_iff S).2 hE
  | succ n ih =>
    intro E hE Z hZ
    obtain ⟨K, E1, i, g, hs, hE1, hK, hZ⟩ := hZ
    exact ih K (S.P_ker hs hE1 hE hK) Z hZ

name: AbelianResolutionF15.pdLE_ext
statement:
theorem pdLE_ext {n : ℕ} {K P0 E : C} {i : K ⟶ P0} {g : P0 ⟶ E} (hs : SES i g) (hE : S.P E)
    (hK : S.Q K) (hP0 : S.Q P0) (hpd : PdLE S n K) : PdLE S n P0
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    rw [pdLE_zero_iff] at hpd ⊢
    exact S.P_ext hs hpd hE hP0
  | succ m =>
    intro Z hZ
    obtain ⟨K1, H, i1, a, hs1, hH, hK1, hZ1⟩ := hZ
    haveI := hs1.epi
    have hQH := S.P_Q hH
    have hQV : S.Q (pullback i a) := S.Q_pullback i a hK hQH hP0
    have sV1 := hs1.pullbackR i
    have sV2 := hs.comp a
    have hV : S.P (pullback i a) := S.P_ker sV2 hH hE hQV
    exact hpd Z ⟨K1, pullback i a, _, _, sV1, hV, hK1, hZ1⟩

name: AbelianResolutionF15.exists_rep
statement: theorem exists_rep : ∀ (n : ℕ) (M : C), S.Q M → PdLE S n M → ∃ x, Rep S n M x
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro M _ hpd
    have hP := (pdLE_zero_iff S).1 hpd
    exact ⟨cls S M hP, hP, rfl⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    intro M hQ hpd
    obtain ⟨E, g, hE, hepi⟩ := S.cover hQ
    haveI := hepi
    have hs := SES.kernel_of_epi g
    have hQK := S.Q_kernel g (S.P_Q hE) hQ
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := ih (kernel g) hQK (hpd.ker S hs hE hQK)
    exact ⟨cls S E hE - y, kernel g, E, kernel.ι g, g, y, hs, hE, hQK, hy, rfl⟩

name: AbelianResolutionF15.rep_zero
statement: theorem rep_zero : ∀ (n : ℕ) (Z : C), IsZero Z → Rep S n Z 0
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro Z hZ
    exact ⟨S.P_zero hZ, (ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_isZero C S.P (S.P_zero hZ) hZ).symm⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    intro Z hZ
    refine ⟨Z, Z, 0, 𝟙 Z, 0, SES.zeroId hZ Z, S.P_zero hZ, S.P_Q (S.P_zero hZ), ih Z hZ, ?_⟩
    rw [sub_zero]
    exact (ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_isZero C S.P (S.P_zero hZ) hZ).symm

name: AbelianResolutionF15.rep_bundle
statement: theorem rep_bundle : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : C) (hE : S.P E), Rep S n E (cls S E hE)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro E hE; exact ⟨hE, rfl⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    intro E hE
    have h0 : IsZero (0 : C) := isZero_zero C
    exact ⟨0, E, 0, 𝟙 E, 0, SES.zeroId h0 E, hE, S.P_Q (S.P_zero h0), rep_zero S n 0 h0,
      (sub_zero _).symm⟩

name: AbelianResolutionF15.uniq_zero
statement: theorem uniq_zero : Uniq S 0
proof:
:= by
  rintro M _ _ x y ⟨h1, rfl⟩ ⟨h2, rfl⟩
  rfl

name: AbelianResolutionF15.add_zero_level
statement: theorem add_zero_level : Add S 0
proof:
:= by
  rintro A B D i g hs _ _ _ _ _ _ x y z ⟨hA, rfl⟩ ⟨hB, rfl⟩ ⟨hD, rfl⟩
  exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_middle C S.P hA hB hD hs.zero hs.exact

name: AbelianResolutionF15.uniq_succ
statement: theorem uniq_succ {n : ℕ} (hA : Add S n) : Uniq S (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rintro M hQM hM x x' ⟨K, E, i, g, y, hs, hE, hK, hy, rfl⟩ ⟨K', E', i', g', y', hs', hE', hK', hy', rfl⟩
  haveI := hs.epi
  haveI := hs'.epi
  have hQE := S.P_Q hE
  have hQE' := S.P_Q hE'
  have hQP : S.Q (pullback g' g) := S.Q_pullback g' g hQE' hQE hQM
  have ses1 := hs.pullbackR g'
  have ses2 := hs'.pullbackL g
  have hpdP : PdLE S n (pullback g' g) := pdLE_ext S ses1 hE' hK hQP (hM.ker S hs hE hK)
  obtain ⟨yP, hyP⟩ := exists_rep S n _ hQP hpdP
  have h1 := hA ses1 hK hQP hQE' (hM.ker S hs hE hK) hpdP (pdLE_of_P S n _ hE') hy hyP
    (rep_bundle S n E' hE')
  have h2 := hA ses2 hK' hQP hQE (hM.ker S hs' hE' hK') hpdP (pdLE_of_P S n _ hE) hy' hyP
    (rep_bundle S n E hE)
  have h3 : y + cls S E' hE' = y' + cls S E hE := h1.symm.trans h2
  calc cls S E hE - y = (y' + cls S E hE) - (y' + y) := by abel
    _ = (y + cls S E' hE') - (y' + y) := by rw [h3]
    _ = cls S E' hE' - y' := by abel

name: AbelianResolutionF15.add_succ
statement: theorem add_succ {n : ℕ} (hA : Add S n) (hU : Uniq S (n + 1)) : Add S (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro A B D i g hs hQA hQB hQD hpA hpB hpD xA xB xD hxA hxB hxD
  
  obtain ⟨EC, ρ, hEC, hρ⟩ := S.cover hQD
  haveI := hρ
  have sC := SES.kernel_of_epi ρ
  have hQKC := S.Q_kernel ρ (S.P_Q hEC) hQD
  
  have s1 := hs.pullbackR ρ
  have s2 := sC.pullbackL g
  have hQB' : S.Q (pullback ρ g) := S.Q_pullback ρ g (S.P_Q hEC) hQB hQD
  obtain ⟨H, a, hH, ha⟩ := S.cover hQB'
  haveI := ha
  have sa := SES.kernel_of_epi a
  have hQK' := S.Q_kernel a (S.P_Q hH) hQB'
  
  have sV1 := sa.pullbackR (pullback.lift (0 : A ⟶ EC) i (by rw [zero_comp, hs.zero]))
  have sV2 := s1.comp a
  have hV : S.P (pullback (pullback.lift (0 : A ⟶ EC) i (by rw [zero_comp, hs.zero])) a) :=
    S.P_ker sV2 hH hEC (S.Q_pullback _ a hQA (S.P_Q hH) hQB')
  
  have sW1 := sa.pullbackR (pullback.lift (kernel.ι ρ) (0 : kernel ρ ⟶ B) (by
    rw [zero_comp, sC.zero]))
  have sW2 := s2.comp a
  have hQW : S.Q (pullback (pullback.lift (kernel.ι ρ) (0 : kernel ρ ⟶ B) (by
      rw [zero_comp, sC.zero])) a) :=
    S.Q_pullback _ a hQKC (S.P_Q hH) hQB'
  
  have hpK' : PdLE S n (kernel a) := by
    intro Z hZ
    exact hpA Z ⟨kernel a, _, _, _, sV1, hV, hQK', hZ⟩
  have hpW := hpB.ker S sW2 hH hQW
  have hpKC := hpD.ker S sC hEC hQKC
  obtain ⟨yK, hyK⟩ := exists_rep S n _ hQK' hpK'
  obtain ⟨yW, hyW⟩ := exists_rep S n _ hQW hpW
  obtain ⟨yC, hyC⟩ := exists_rep S n _ hQKC hpKC
  have hadd := hA sW1 hQK' hQW hQKC hpK' hpW hpKC hyK hyW hyC
  have RA : Rep S (n + 1) A (cls S _ hV - yK) := ⟨kernel a, _, _, _, yK, sV1, hV, hQK', hyK, rfl⟩
  have RB : Rep S (n + 1) B (cls S H hH - yW) := ⟨_, H, _, _, yW, sW2, hH, hQW, hyW, rfl⟩
  have RC : Rep S (n + 1) D (cls S EC hEC - yC) := ⟨_, EC, _, ρ, yC, sC, hEC, hQKC, hyC, rfl⟩
  have eA := hU A hQA hpA _ _ hxA RA
  have eB := hU B hQB hpB _ _ hxB RB
  have eD := hU D hQD hpD _ _ hxD RC
  have hrel := ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_middle C S.P hV hH hEC sV2.zero sV2.exact
  change cls S H hH = cls S _ hV + cls S EC hEC at hrel
  rw [eA, eB, eD, hadd, hrel]
  abel

name: AbelianResolutionF15.add_uniq_all
statement:
theorem add_uniq_all : ∀ n, Add S n ∧ Uniq S n
  | 0 => ⟨add_zero_level S, uniq_zero S⟩
  | n + 1 => by
      obtain ⟨h1, -⟩
proof:
:= add_uniq_all n
      have hU := uniq_succ S h1
      exact ⟨add_succ S h1 hU, hU⟩

name: AbelianResolutionF15.k0ToG0_cls
statement: theorem k0ToG0_cls (E : C) (h : S.P E) : k0ToG0 S (cls S E h) = gcl S E (S.P_Q h)
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.map_classOf (toQ S) (fun _ _ _ h => h) ⟨E, h⟩

name: AbelianResolutionF15.rep_map
statement:
theorem rep_map : ∀ (n : ℕ) (M : C) (x : K0 S) (hQ : S.Q M), Rep S n M x →
    k0ToG0 S x = gcl S M hQ
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rintro M x hQ ⟨h, rfl⟩
    exact k0ToG0_cls S M h
  | succ n ih =>
    rintro M x hQ ⟨K, E, i, g, y, hs, hE, hK, hy, rfl⟩
    have hrel := ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_middle C S.Q hK (S.P_Q hE) hQ hs.zero
      hs.exact
    change gcl S E (S.P_Q hE) = gcl S K hK + gcl S M hQ at hrel
    rw [map_sub, k0ToG0_cls, ih K y hK hy, hrel]
    abel

name: AbelianResolutionF15.k0ToG0_bijective
statement:
theorem k0ToG0_bijective (d : ℕ) (hd : ∀ M : C, S.Q M → PdLE S d M) :
    Function.Bijective (k0ToG0 S)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hAdd, hUniq⟩ := add_uniq_all S d
  let f : {M : C // S.Q M} → K0 S := fun M =>
    Classical.choose (exists_rep S d M.1 M.2 (hd M.1 M.2))
  have hf : ∀ M : {M : C // S.Q M}, Rep S d M.1 (f M) := fun M =>
    Classical.choose_spec (exists_rep S d M.1 M.2 (hd M.1 M.2))
  let ψ : G0 S →+ K0 S := ExactGrothendieck.lift f (by
    rintro A B D ⟨i, g, zero, hS⟩
    exact hAdd ⟨zero, hS⟩ A.2 B.2 D.2 (hd _ A.2) (hd _ B.2) (hd _ D.2) (hf A) (hf B) (hf D))
  have h1 : ψ.comp (k0ToG0 S) = AddMonoidHom.id _ := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    rintro ⟨E, hE⟩
    change ψ (k0ToG0 S (cls S E hE)) = cls S E hE
    rw [k0ToG0_cls]
    exact (ExactGrothendieck.lift_classOf _ _ _).trans
      (hUniq E (S.P_Q hE) (pdLE_of_P S d E hE) _ _ (hf ⟨E, S.P_Q hE⟩) (rep_bundle S d E hE))
  have h2 : (k0ToG0 S).comp ψ = AddMonoidHom.id _ := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    rintro ⟨M, hM⟩
    change k0ToG0 S (ψ (gcl S M hM)) = gcl S M hM
    rw [show ψ (gcl S M hM) = f ⟨M, hM⟩ from ExactGrothendieck.lift_classOf _ _ _]
    exact rep_map S d M _ hM (hf ⟨M, hM⟩)
  refine ⟨fun x y hxy => ?_, fun y => ⟨ψ y, ?_⟩⟩
  · have := congrArg ψ hxy
    simpa [← AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, h1] using this
  · exact DFunLike.congr_fun h2 y

name: SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf_eq_add_of_shortExact
statement:
theorem k0ClassOf_eq_add_of_shortExact {A B D : Y.Modules} (hA : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y A)
    (hB : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y B) (hD : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y D)
    {f : A ⟶ B} {g : B ⟶ D} (zero : f ≫ g = 0)
    (h : (ShortComplex.mk f g zero).ShortExact) :
    k0ClassOf Y B hB = k0ClassOf Y A hA + k0ClassOf Y D hD
proof:
:=
  @k0Class_middle Y A B D hA hB hD f g zero h

name: SchemeKTheory.ExactComplex.telescope
statement:
theorem ExactComplex.telescope {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (m z : ℕ → R) (n : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ i, i < n → m i = z (i + 1) + z i) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (-1 : R) ^ i * m i + (-1 : R) ^ n * z n = z 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [← ih fun i hi ↦ h i (by omega), Finset.sum_range_succ, h n (by omega), pow_succ]
    ring

name: SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf_alternating_sum_of_shortExact
statement:
theorem k0ClassOf_alternating_sum_of_shortExact (M Z : ℕ → Y.Modules)
    (hM : ∀ i, IsFiniteLocallyFree Y (M i)) (hZ : ∀ i, IsFiniteLocallyFree Y (Z i)) (n : ℕ)
    (hS : ∀ i, i < n → ∃ (f : Z (i + 1) ⟶ M i) (g : M i ⟶ Z i) (w : f ≫ g = 0),
      (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (-1 : K0 Y) ^ i * k0ClassOf Y (M i) (hM i) +
      (-1 : K0 Y) ^ n * k0ClassOf Y (Z n) (hZ n) = k0ClassOf Y (Z 0) (hZ 0)
proof:
:= by
  have key := ExactComplex.telescope (R := K0 Y) (fun i ↦ k0ClassOf Y (M i) (hM i))
    (fun i ↦ k0ClassOf Y (Z i) (hZ i)) n fun i hi ↦ by
      obtain ⟨f, g, w, h⟩ := hS i hi
      exact k0ClassOf_eq_add_of_shortExact Y (hZ (i + 1)) (hM i) (hZ i) w h
  exact key

name: SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf_eq_alternating_sum
statement:
theorem k0ClassOf_eq_alternating_sum (M Z : ℕ → Y.Modules)
    (hM : ∀ i, IsFiniteLocallyFree Y (M i)) (hZ : ∀ i, IsFiniteLocallyFree Y (Z i)) (n : ℕ)
    (hS : ∀ i, i < n → ∃ (f : Z (i + 1) ⟶ M i) (g : M i ⟶ Z i) (w : f ≫ g = 0),
      (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact)
    (hZn : IsZero (Z n)) :
    k0ClassOf Y (Z 0) (hZ 0) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (-1 : K0 Y) ^ i * k0ClassOf Y (M i) (hM i)
proof:
:= by
  have h := k0ClassOf_alternating_sum_of_shortExact Y M Z hM hZ n hS
  rw [k0ClassOf_iso Y (hZ n) (zero_isFiniteLocallyFree Y) hZn.isoZero, k0ClassOf_zero,
    mul_zero, add_zero] at h
  exact h.symm

name: SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf_alternating_sum_eq_zero
statement:
theorem k0ClassOf_alternating_sum_eq_zero (M Z : ℕ → Y.Modules)
    (hM : ∀ i, IsFiniteLocallyFree Y (M i)) (hZ : ∀ i, IsFiniteLocallyFree Y (Z i)) (n : ℕ)
    (hS : ∀ i, i < n → ∃ (f : Z (i + 1) ⟶ M i) (g : M i ⟶ Z i) (w : f ≫ g = 0),
      (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact)
    (hZ0 : IsZero (Z 0)) (hZn : IsZero (Z n)) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (-1 : K0 Y) ^ i * k0ClassOf Y (M i) (hM i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← k0ClassOf_eq_alternating_sum Y M Z hM hZ n hS hZn,
    k0ClassOf_iso Y (hZ 0) (zero_isFiniteLocallyFree Y) hZ0.isoZero, k0ClassOf_zero]

name: TopologicalSpace.Opens.sheafOfModulesEquivOver_H₁
statement:
theorem sheafOfModulesEquivOver_H₁ :
    Functor.whiskerRight (NatTrans.op U.overEquivalence.symm.counit) (Sheaf.over R U).obj =
      (U.sheafRestrictSheafEquivOver.app R).inv.hom ≫
        U.overEquivalence.symm.inverse.op.whiskerLeft (U.overPullbackSheafEquivOver.app R).inv.hom
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TopologicalSpace.Opens.sheafOfModulesEquivOver_H₂
statement:
theorem sheafOfModulesEquivOver_H₂ :
    (U.overPullbackSheafEquivOver.app R).inv.hom ≫
      U.overEquivalence.symm.functor.op.whiskerLeft (U.sheafRestrictSheafEquivOver.app R).inv.hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerRight (NatTrans.op U.overEquivalence.symm.unit) (U.sheafRestrict.obj R).obj =
      𝟙 (U.sheafRestrict.obj R).obj
proof:
:= by
  ext : 2
  simp [overPullbackSheafEquivOver, sheafRestrictSheafEquivOver, eqToHom_map, overEquivalence,
    IsOpenMap.functor]

name: CoherentExtensionAR5.isIso_restrict_map_of_forall
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.isIso_iff_isIso_app]
  intro O
  exact h O

name: CoherentExtensionAR5.isFinitePresentation_of_opens_cover
statement:
theorem isFinitePresentation_of_opens_cover (M : S.Modules) {ι : Type u} (A : ι → S.Opens)
    (hA : ⨆ i, A i = ⊤)
    (h : ∀ i, ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (A i).ι).obj M).IsFinitePresentation) :
    M.IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  letI : ∀ i, (M.over (A i)).IsFinitePresentation := fun i => by
    haveI := h i
    have h1 := isFinitePresentation_overEquiv_inverse (X := S) (A i)
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (A i).ι).obj M)
    exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation (S.ringCatSheaf.over (A i))).prop_of_iso (overIsoRestrict M (A i)).symm h1
  exact SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation_of_over_cover M A
    ((Opens.coversTop_iff (T := S) A).2 hA)

name: CoherentExtensionAR5.isFinitePresentation_restrict_of_range_subset
statement:
theorem isFinitePresentation_restrict_of_range_subset {T : Scheme.{u}} (q : T ⟶ X)
    [IsOpenImmersion q] (U : X.Opens) (hq : Set.range q ⊆ (U : Set X))
    (H : X.Modules) [((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj H).IsFinitePresentation] :
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj H).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  let θ : T ⟶ (U : Scheme.{u}) := IsOpenImmersion.lift U.ι q (by rwa [Scheme.Opens.range_ι])
  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (θ ≫ U.ι) := by
    simp only [θ, IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac]; infer_instance
  haveI : IsOpenImmersion θ := IsOpenImmersion.of_comp θ U.ι
  have h1 := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor θ ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj H)
  have e : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor θ).obj ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj H) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj H :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp θ U.ι).app H).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr (IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac U.ι q _)).app H
  exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation T.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso e h1

name: CoherentExtensionAR5.isFinitePresentation_restrict_sup
statement:
theorem isFinitePresentation_restrict_sup (H : X.Modules) (U W : X.Opens)
    [((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj H).IsFinitePresentation]
    [((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj H).IsFinitePresentation] :
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U ⊔ W).ι).obj H).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  let V := U ⊔ W
  let A : ULift.{u} Bool → V.toScheme.Opens := fun b => cond b.down (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U) (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)
  refine isFinitePresentation_of_opens_cover _ A ?_ ?_
  · rw [eq_top_iff]
    rintro ⟨x, hx⟩ -
    rcases (Opens.mem_sup.1 hx) with h | h
    · exact Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨⟨true⟩, h⟩
    · exact Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨⟨false⟩, h⟩
  · intro b
    have key : ∀ (B : X.Opens) [((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor B.ι).obj H).IsFinitePresentation],
        (B ≤ V) → ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ B).ι).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj H)).IsFinitePresentation := by
      intro B _ hB
      have h2 : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ((V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ B).ι ≫ V.ι)).obj H).IsFinitePresentation := by
        refine isFinitePresentation_restrict_of_range_subset _ B ?_ H
        rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
        exact y.2
      have e := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ B).ι V.ι).app H
      exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ B).toScheme.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso e h2
    obtain ⟨b⟩ := b
    cases b
    · exact key W le_sup_right
    · exact key U le_sup_left

name: CoherentExtensionAR5.isIso_map_homOfLE
statement:
theorem isIso_map_homOfLE {P : TopCat.Presheaf Ab X} {V V' : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ V') (h' : V' ≤ V) :
    IsIso (P.map (homOfLE h).op)
proof:
:= by
  have : homOfLE h = eqToHom (le_antisymm h h') := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [this]
  infer_instance

name: CoherentExtensionAR5.isIso_unit_restrict_pushforward
statement:
theorem isIso_unit_restrict_pushforward (U W : X.Opens) {T : Scheme.{u}} (c : T ⟶ (W : Scheme.{u}))
    [IsOpenImmersion c] (hc : W.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U ≤ c.opensRange) (F : (U : Scheme.{u}).Modules) :
    IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction c).unit.app
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).obj F)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.isIso_iff_isIso_app]
  intro O
  rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app]
  have hO : c ''ᵁ c ⁻¹ᵁ O = c.opensRange ⊓ O := Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf c O
  show IsIso (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE _).op)
  refine isIso_map_homOfLE _ ?_
  intro x hx
  have hx' : U.ι x ∈ ((W.ι ''ᵁ O : X.Opens) : Set X) := hx
  obtain ⟨w, hwO, hw⟩ := hx'
  have hwU : w ∈ W.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U := by
    have : W.ι w = U.ι x := hw
    show W.ι w ∈ U
    rw [this]
    exact x.2
  have hwc : w ∈ c.opensRange ⊓ O := ⟨hc hwU, hwO⟩
  rw [← hO] at hwc
  show U.ι x ∈ ((W.ι ''ᵁ (c ''ᵁ c ⁻¹ᵁ O) : X.Opens) : Set X)
  exact ⟨w, hwc, hw⟩

name: CoherentExtensionAR5.le_opensRange_chartToOpen
statement:
theorem le_opensRange_chartToOpen (U W : X.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W) :
    W.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U ≤ (QCExtension.chartToOpen U W hW).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  intro w hw
  let z : (Spec Γ(X, W) : Scheme.{u}) := hW.isoSpec.hom w
  have hfs : hW.fromSpec z = W.ι w := by
    have h1 : hW.isoSpec.inv ≫ W.ι = hW.fromSpec := IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_inv_ι hW
    have h2 : hW.isoSpec.inv z = w := by simp [z]
    rw [← h1, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, h2]
  have hz : z ∈ QCExtension.chartOpen U W hW := by
    show hW.fromSpec z ∈ U
    rw [hfs]
    exact hw
  refine ⟨⟨z, hz⟩, ?_⟩
  show hW.isoSpec.inv z = w
  simp [z]

name: CoherentExtensionAR5.isIso_app_of_isIso_restrict
statement:
theorem isIso_app_of_isIso_restrict {S W : Scheme.{u}} (c : S ⟶ W) [IsOpenImmersion c]
    {M N : W.Modules} (φ : M ⟶ N) [IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor c).map φ)]
    (O : W.Opens) (hO : O ≤ c.opensRange) : IsIso (φ.app O)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : IsIso (φ.app (c ''ᵁ c ⁻¹ᵁ O)) :=
    (inferInstance : IsIso (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor c).map φ).app (c ⁻¹ᵁ O)))
  have h2 : c ''ᵁ c ⁻¹ᵁ O = O := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf]
    exact inf_eq_right.2 hO
  rwa [h2] at h1

name: CoherentExtensionAR5.restrictFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits
statement:
theorem restrictFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion f] : PreservesFiniteLimits (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f)
proof:
:=
  (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).exact_tfae.out 1 3 rfl rfl).mp
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor_map_exact f)).1

name: CoherentExtensionAR5.isIso_restrict_unit
statement:
theorem isIso_restrict_unit {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion f] (M : Y.Modules) :
    IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction f).unit.app M))
proof:
:= by
  have h := (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction f).left_triangle_components M
  have h1 : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction f).counit) := inferInstance
  have h2 := NatIso.isIso_app_of_isIso (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction f).counit
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj M)
  exact @IsIso.of_isIso_fac_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ h2 (IsIso.id _) h

name: CoherentExtensionAR5.exists_glue_extension
statement:
theorem exists_glue_extension [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] (U W : X.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
    [IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, W)] (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X))
    (F : (U : Scheme.{u}).Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ G : ((U ⊔ W : X.Opens) : Scheme.{u}).Modules, G.IsFinitePresentation ∧
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (X.homOfLE (le_sup_left : U ≤ U ⊔ W))).obj G ≅ F)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E, hE, ⟨e⟩⟩ := QCExtension.exists_extension_compatible_with_global_pushforward U W hW hU F
  haveI := hE
  let c := QCExtension.chartToOpen U W hW
  let Q : X.Modules := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).obj F
  let B : (W : Scheme.{u}).Modules := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj Q
  haveI hη : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction c).unit.app B) :=
    isIso_unit_restrict_pushforward U W c (le_opensRange_chartToOpen U W hW) F
  let φ'' : E ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward c).obj ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor c).obj B) :=
    QCExtension.extensionToPushforward c E _ e
  haveI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor c).map φ'') :=
    QCExtension.extensionToPushforward_restrict_isIso c E _ e
  let φ' : E ⟶ B := φ'' ≫ inv ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction c).unit.app B)
  haveI hφ' : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor c).map φ') := by
    simp only [φ', Functor.map_comp]
    infer_instance
  have hφ'app : ∀ O : (W : Scheme.{u}).Opens, O ≤ W.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U → IsIso (φ'.app O) := fun O hO =>
    isIso_app_of_isIso_restrict c φ' O (hO.trans (le_opensRange_chartToOpen U W hW))
  let a : Q ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward W.ι).obj B :=
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction W.ι).unit.app Q
  let b : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward W.ι).obj E ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward W.ι).obj B :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward W.ι).map φ'
  let H : X.Modules := pullback a b
  have hP : IsPullback (pullback.fst a b) (pullback.snd a b) a b := IsPullback.of_hasPullback a b
  
  haveI : PreservesLimit (cospan a b) (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι) :=
    ((restrictFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits W.ι).preservesFiniteLimits WalkingCospan).preservesLimit
  haveI : PreservesLimit (cospan a b) (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι) :=
    ((restrictFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits U.ι).preservesFiniteLimits WalkingCospan).preservesLimit
  have hPW := hP.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι)
  haveI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).map a) := isIso_restrict_unit W.ι Q
  haveI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).map (pullback.snd a b)) :=
    hPW.isIso_snd_of_isIso
  let eW : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj H ≅ E :=
    asIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).map (pullback.snd a b)) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso W.ι).app E
  
  have hPU := hP.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι)
  haveI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map b) := by
    apply isIso_restrict_map_of_forall
    intro O'
    rw [Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app]
    refine hφ'app _ ?_
    intro w hw
    have hw' : W.ι w ∈ ((U.ι ''ᵁ O' : X.Opens) : Set X) := hw
    obtain ⟨y, -, hy⟩ := hw'
    have hy' : U.ι y = W.ι w := hy
    show W.ι w ∈ U
    rw [← hy']
    exact y.2
  haveI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map (pullback.fst a b)) :=
    hPU.isIso_fst_of_isIso
  let eU : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj H ≅ F :=
    asIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map (pullback.fst a b)) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso U.ι).app F
  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj H).IsFinitePresentation :=
    (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation W.toScheme.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso eW.symm inferInstance
  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj H).IsFinitePresentation :=
    (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso eU.symm inferInstance
  refine ⟨(Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U ⊔ W).ι).obj H, isFinitePresentation_restrict_sup H U W, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  exact ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp (X.homOfLE (le_sup_left : U ≤ U ⊔ W)) (U ⊔ W).ι).app H).symm ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr (X.homOfLE_ι (le_sup_left : U ≤ U ⊔ W))).app H ≪≫ eU

name: CoherentExtensionAR5.exists_extension_of_top
statement:
theorem exists_extension_of_top {X : Scheme.{u}} (F : ((⊤ : X.Opens) : Scheme.{u}).Modules)
    [F.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ G : X.Modules, G.IsFinitePresentation ∧
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (⊤ : X.Opens).ι).obj G ≅ F)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIso (⊤ : X.Opens).ι :=
    isIso_of_isOpenImmersion_of_opensRange_eq_top _ (Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι ⊤)
  let r : X ⟶ ((⊤ : X.Opens) : Scheme.{u}) := inv (⊤ : X.Opens).ι
  have hr : (⊤ : X.Opens).ι ≫ r = 𝟙 _ := IsIso.hom_inv_id (⊤ : X.Opens).ι
  refine ⟨(Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor r).obj F, isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor r F, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  exact ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp (⊤ : X.Opens).ι r).app F).symm ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr hr).app F ≪≫ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorId.app F

name: CoherentExtensionAR5.exists_extension_of_finset
statement:
theorem exists_extension_of_finset [IsNoetherian X] (t : Finset X.Opens)
    (ht : ∀ W ∈ t, IsAffineOpen W) :
    ∀ (U : X.Opens), (⊤ ≤ U ⊔ t.sup id) → ∀ (F : (U : Scheme.{u}).Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation],
    ∃ G : X.Modules, G.IsFinitePresentation ∧
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj G ≅ F)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction t using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    intro U hU F _
    have : U = ⊤ := by simpa using hU
    subst this
    exact exists_extension_of_top F
  | insert W t hWt ih =>
    intro U hU F _
    haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, W) :=
      IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨W, ht W (Finset.mem_insert_self W t)⟩
    obtain ⟨G', hG', ⟨e'⟩⟩ := exists_glue_extension U W (ht W (Finset.mem_insert_self W t))
      (NoetherianSpace.isCompact _) F
    haveI := hG'
    have hU' : ⊤ ≤ (U ⊔ W) ⊔ t.sup id := by
      refine hU.trans ?_
      rw [Finset.sup_insert]
      simp only [id, sup_assoc]
      exact le_rfl
    obtain ⟨G, hG, ⟨e⟩⟩ := ih (fun W' hW' => ht W' (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hW')) (U ⊔ W) hU' G'
    refine ⟨G, hG, ⟨?_⟩⟩
    exact (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr (X.homOfLE_ι (le_sup_left : U ≤ U ⊔ W))).symm.app G ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp (X.homOfLE (le_sup_left : U ≤ U ⊔ W)) (U ⊔ W).ι).app G ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (X.homOfLE (le_sup_left : U ≤ U ⊔ W))).mapIso e ≪≫ e'

name: CoherentExtensionAR5.exists_extension_of_opens
statement:
theorem exists_extension_of_opens [IsNoetherian X] (U : X.Opens)
    (F : (U : Scheme.{u}).Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ G : X.Modules, G.IsFinitePresentation ∧
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj G ≅ F)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hc : IsCompact ((⊤ : X.Opens) : Set X) := NoetherianSpace.isCompact _
  obtain ⟨t, htle⟩ := (CompleteLattice.isCompactElement_iff_exists_le_iSup_of_le_iSup _).1
    ((TopologicalSpace.Opens.isCompactElement_iff _).2 hc) X.affineOpens
    (fun W : X.affineOpens => (W : X.Opens)) (by rw [iSup_affineOpens_eq_top])
  refine exists_extension_of_finset (t.image (fun W : X.affineOpens => (W : X.Opens))) ?_ U ?_ F
  · intro W hW
    obtain ⟨W', -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hW
    exact W'.2
  · rw [Finset.sup_image]
    exact htle.trans le_sup_right

name: CoherentExtensionAR5.exists_extension_of_isOpenImmersion
statement:
theorem exists_extension_of_isOpenImmersion [IsNoetherian X] {Y : Scheme.{u}} (ι : Y ⟶ X)
    [IsOpenImmersion ι] (F : Y.Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ G : X.Modules, G.IsFinitePresentation ∧
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ι).obj G ≅ F)
proof:
:= by
  let U := ι.opensRange
  let θ : Y ≅ (U : Scheme.{u}) := ι.isoOpensRange
  haveI : IsOpenImmersion θ.inv := inferInstance
  haveI : IsOpenImmersion θ.hom := inferInstance
  let F' : (U : Scheme.{u}).Modules := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor θ.inv).obj F
  haveI : F'.IsFinitePresentation := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor θ.inv F
  obtain ⟨G, hG, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_extension_of_opens U F'
  refine ⟨G, hG, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  have h1 : θ.hom ≫ U.ι = ι := ι.isoOpensRange_hom_ι
  exact (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr h1).symm.app G ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp θ.hom U.ι).app G ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor θ.hom).mapIso e ≪≫
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp θ.hom θ.inv).app F).symm ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr θ.hom_inv_id).app F ≪≫
    Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorId.app F

name: SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation_pushforward
statement:
theorem isFinitePresentation_pushforward
    {N : SheafOfModules.{u} R} [N.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ((SheafOfModules.pushforward phi).obj N).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := IsFinitePresentation.exists_quasicoherentData N
  letI : Q.IsFinitePresentation := hQ
  let D := Q.pushforward G phi unitIso h
  letI : D.IsFinitePresentation := inferInstance
  exact ⟨D.shrink, inferInstance⟩

name: SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_isLeftAdjoint
statement:
theorem isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_isLeftAdjoint
    (unitIso : (SheafOfModules.pushforward phi).obj (unit R) ≅ unit S)
    [G.IsLeftAdjoint] [IsIso phi]
    [∀ X, Functor.IsContinuous (Over.post (X := X) G) (J'.over _) (J.over _)]
    [HasPullbacks C] [HasPullbacks C']
    {N : SheafOfModules.{u} R} [N.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ((SheafOfModules.pushforward phi).obj N).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  apply isFinitePresentation_pushforward G phi unitIso
  intro X Y f
  let G' := Over.post (X := X) G ⋙ Over.map f
  have : G'.IsContinuous (J'.over X) (J.over Y) :=
    Functor.isContinuous_comp _ _ _ (J.over _) _
  have : G'.IsCocontinuous (J'.over X) (J.over Y) :=
    isCocontinuous_comp _ _ _ (J.over _)
  let a : S.over X ⟶
      (G'.sheafPushforwardContinuous RingCat.{u} (J'.over X) (J.over Y)).obj (R.over Y) :=
    ((Over.forget X).sheafPushforwardContinuous RingCat.{u} (J'.over X) J').map phi
  have : (SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} a).IsLeftAdjoint :=
    SheafOfModules.isLeftAdjoint_pushforward_of_isIso a
  infer_instance

statement:
theorem isFiniteType_of_epi
    {M N : SheafOfModules.{u} R} (f : M ⟶ N) [Epi f] [M.IsFiniteType] :

proof:

statement:

    [HasPullbacks C] (M : SheafOfModules.{u} R) (X : C) [M.IsFinitePresentation] :
    (M.over X).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:=
  isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_isLeftAdjoint
    (C := C) (C' := Over X) (J := J) (J' := J.over X)
    (R := R) (S := R.over X) (G := Over.forget X) (phi := 𝟙 _) (Iso.refl _)

name: SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation_of_over_cover
statement:
theorem isFinitePresentation_of_over_cover
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} R) {I : Type u} (X : I → C) (hX : J.CoversTop X)
    [∀ i, (M.over (X i)).IsFinitePresentation] : M.IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  let D := fun i ↦
    (IsFinitePresentation.exists_quasicoherentData (M.over (X i))).choose
  letI : ∀ i, (D i).IsFinitePresentation := fun i ↦
    (IsFinitePresentation.exists_quasicoherentData (M.over (X i))).choose_spec
  let B := QuasicoherentData.bind M X hX D
  letI : B.IsFinitePresentation := inferInstance
  exact ⟨B.shrink, inferInstance⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.finitePresentation_of_localizationSpan_linearEquiv
statement:
theorem finitePresentation_of_localizationSpan_linearEquiv
    {M₀ : Type u} [AddCommGroup M₀] [Module R M₀]
    (s : Set R) (hs : Ideal.span s = ⊤)
    {N : ∀ (_ : s), Type u} [∀ g, AddCommGroup (N g)] [∀ g, Module R (N g)]
    {P : ∀ (_ : s), Type u} [∀ g, AddCommGroup (P g)] [∀ g, Module R (P g)]
    {Rₚ : ∀ (_ : s), Type u} [∀ g, CommRing (Rₚ g)] [∀ g, Algebra R (Rₚ g)]
    [∀ g, IsLocalization.Away g.val (Rₚ g)]
    [∀ g, Module (Rₚ g) (P g)] [∀ g, IsScalarTower R (Rₚ g) (P g)]
    (phi : ∀ g, M₀ →ₗ[R] N g)
    [∀ g, IsLocalizedModule.Away g.val (phi g)]
    (e : ∀ g, P g ≃ₗ[R] N g)
    (hP : ∀ g, Module.FinitePresentation (Rₚ g) (P g)) :
    Module.FinitePresentation R M₀
proof:
:= by
  let psi := fun g ↦ (e g).symm.toLinearMap.comp (phi g)
  letI : ∀ g, IsLocalizedModule.Away g.val (psi g) := fun g ↦ by
    dsimp [psi]
    infer_instance
  exact Module.FinitePresentation.of_localizationSpan' s hs psi hP

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isQuasicoherent_pushforward_specMap
statement:
theorem isQuasicoherent_pushforward_specMap
    (phi : R ⟶ S) (M : (Spec S).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Spec.map phi)).obj M).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.tilde_isFinitePresentation
statement:
theorem tilde_isFinitePresentation (M : ModuleCat.{u} R)
    [Module.FinitePresentation R M] : (tilde M).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hker⟩ :=
    (inferInstance : Module.FinitePresentation R M).out
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hker
  let P := presentationTilde M (s : Set M) hs (t : Set (s →₀ R)) ht
  haveI : P.IsFinite := by
    constructor
    · constructor
      change Finite s
      infer_instance
    · constructor
      change Finite t
      infer_instance
  exact P.isFinitePresentation

name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduleSpecΓ_isFinite_of_generatingSections
statement:
theorem moduleSpecΓ_isFinite_of_generatingSections
    (M : (Spec R).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (G : M.GeneratingSections) [G.IsFiniteType] :
    Module.Finite R (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj M)
proof:
:= by
  let Q := SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent (Spec R).ringCatSheaf
  let A : Q.FullSubcategory :=
    ⟨SheafOfModules.free G.I (R := (Spec R).ringCatSheaf), inferInstance⟩
  let B : Q.FullSubcategory := ⟨M, inferInstance⟩
  let p : A ⟶ B := ObjectProperty.homMk G.π
  letI : Epi p := by
    constructor
    intro Z f g h
    apply ObjectProperty.hom_ext
    apply (cancel_epi G.π).1
    simpa [p] using congrArg (fun q ↦ q.hom) h
  let q := (tildeEquiv (R := R)).inverse.map p
  letI : Epi q := inferInstance
  let e := finsuppIsoModuleSpecΓFree (R := R) G.I
  let l : (G.I →₀ R) →ₗ[R] moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj M :=
    (e.hom ≫ q).hom
  apply Module.Finite.of_surjective l
  exact ((ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective q).mp inferInstance).comp
    ((ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective e.hom).mp inferInstance)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation_of_generatingSections
statement:
theorem moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation_of_generatingSections
    (M : (Spec R).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (G : M.GeneratingSections) [G.IsFiniteType] :
    Module.FinitePresentation R (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj M)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Finite R (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj M) :=
