name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exists_isOpenCover_finitePresentation
statement:
lemma Scheme.Modules.exists_isOpenCover_finitePresentation
    (M : X.Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ (ι : Type u) (U : ι → X.Opens)
      (pres : ∀ i, (M.restrict (U i).ι).Presentation),
      IsOpenCover U ∧ (∀ i, IsAffineOpen (U i)) ∧ ∀ i, (pres i).IsFinite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := SheafOfModules.IsFinitePresentation.exists_quasicoherentData M
  letI : q.IsFinitePresentation := hq
  choose κ hsub heq using fun i ↦ Opens.isBasis_iff_cover.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens (q.X i)
  let P := fun i : Σ (j : q.I), κ j ↦ by
    let u := X.homOfLE (U := i.2) (V := q.X i.1) (by simp [heq, le_sSup])
    have : PreservesColimitsOfSize.{u, u} (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor u) :=
      inferInstance
    let F := (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (q.X i.1)).functor ⋙
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor u
    let iso : SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf _ ⋙ F ≅
        Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Scheme.Opens.ι i.2.1) :=
      (Functor.associator _ _ _).symm ≪≫
        Functor.isoWhiskerRight (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv _) _ ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp _ _).symm ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr (by simp [u]))
    exact SheafOfModules.Presentation.ofIsIso (iso.app M).hom <|
      (q.presentation i.1).map F (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso _).symm
  refine ⟨Σ (i : q.I), κ i, fun j ↦ j.2, P, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have cov := q.coversTop
    rw [Opens.coversTop_iff, IsOpenCover] at cov
    rw [IsOpenCover, iSup_sigma, ← cov]
    refine iSup_congr fun i ↦ ?_
    rw [heq i, sSup_eq_iSup']
  · intro j
    exact hsub _ j.2.2
  · intro i
    dsimp [P]
    infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exists_affineOpenCover_finitePresentation
statement:
lemma Scheme.Modules.exists_affineOpenCover_finitePresentation
    (M : X.Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ (𝒰 : Scheme.AffineOpenCover.{u} X), ∀ i,
      ∃ P : (M.restrict (𝒰.f i)).Presentation, P.IsFinite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ι, U, pres, hU, hU', hpres⟩ := M.exists_isOpenCover_finitePresentation
  let 𝒰 := Scheme.AffineOpenCover.ofIsOpenCover U hU hU'
  refine ⟨𝒰, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  letI : (pres i).IsFinite := hpres i
  let P := SheafOfModules.Presentation.ofIsIso
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp _ _).app M).inv <|
      Scheme.Modules.presentationRestrict (hU' i).isoSpec.inv (pres i)
  exact ⟨P, by dsimp [P]; infer_instance⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exists_basicOpenCover_finitePresentation
statement:
lemma Scheme.Modules.exists_basicOpenCover_finitePresentation
    (M : (Spec R).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ (ι : Type u) (f : ι → R),
      (⨆ i, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (f i)) = ⊤ ∧
        ∀ i, ∃ P :
          (M.restrict (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom <|
            algebraMap R (Localization.Away (f i))))).Presentation,
          P.IsFinite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ι, U, pres, hU, hU', hpres⟩ := M.exists_isOpenCover_finitePresentation
  choose κ hκ a ha using fun i : ι ↦
    PrimeSpectrum.isBasis_basic_opens.exists_iSup_eq_of_isCompact (U i) (hU' i).isCompact
  refine ⟨Σ i, κ i, fun i ↦ a i.1 i.2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [IsOpenCover] at hU
    rw [iSup_sigma, ← hU]
    exact iSup_congr fun i ↦ (ha i).symm
  · intro i
    let t := (Spec R).homOfLE
      (U := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (a i.1 i.2)) (V := U i.1)
      (by rw [ha i.1]; exact le_iSup_of_le i.2 le_rfl)
    let e : Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i.1).ι ⋙
        Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
          ((basicOpenIsoSpecAway _).inv ≫ t) ≅
        Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom <| algebraMap R
            (Localization.Away (a i.1 i.2)))) :=
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp _ _).symm ≪≫
        Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr
          (by simp [t, basicOpenIsoSpecAway])
    letI : (pres i.1).IsFinite := hpres i.1
    let Q := Scheme.Modules.presentationRestrict
      ((basicOpenIsoSpecAway _).inv ≫ t) (pres i.1)
    letI : Q.IsFinite := inferInstance
    let P := SheafOfModules.Presentation.ofIsIso (e.app M).hom Q
    exact ⟨P, by dsimp [P]; infer_instance⟩

statement:
lemma Scheme.Modules.exists_spanningBasicOpens_finitePresentation
    (M : (Spec R).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation] :

  refine ⟨Set.range f, PrimeSpectrum.iSup_basicOpen_eq_top_iff.mp hcover, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨_, i, rfl⟩
  exact hlocal i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor

theorem isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    (M : Y.Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj M).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  let alpha : X.presheaf ⟶ f.opensFunctor.op ⋙ Y.presheaf :=
    { app U := (f.appIso U.unop).inv }
  have hAlpha : IsIso alpha := NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app _
  let phi : X.ringCatSheaf ⟶
      (f.opensFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous _ _ _).obj Y.ringCatSheaf :=
    ⟨Functor.whiskerRight alpha (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)⟩
  have : IsIso phi := by
    rw [← isIso_iff_of_reflects_iso _ (ObjectProperty.ι _)]
    dsimp [phi]
    infer_instance

    f.opensFunctor phi (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isFinitePresentation_overEquiv_functor
statement:
theorem isFinitePresentation_overEquiv_functor (U : X.Opens)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (X.ringCatSheaf.over U))
    [M.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.obj M).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  letI := U.instIsDenseSubsiteSubtypeMemOverGrothendieckTopologyOverInverseOverEquivalence
  let F := U.overEquivalence.symm.functor
  letI : F.IsDenseSubsite (Opens.grothendieckTopology U.carrier)
      ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U) := by
    change U.overEquivalence.inverse.IsDenseSubsite
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology U.carrier) ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U)
    infer_instance
  letI : ∀ V, (Over.post F).IsContinuous
      ((Opens.grothendieckTopology U.carrier).over V)
      (((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U).over (F.obj V)) :=
    fun V ↦ Functor.isContinuous_of_coverPreserving
      (compatiblePreservingOfFlat _ _)
      (CoverPreserving.overPost V (Functor.IsDenseSubsite.coverPreserving _ _ F))
  change ((SheafOfModules.pushforward
    (U.overPullbackSheafEquivOver.app X.ringCatSheaf).inv).obj M).IsFinitePresentation
  exact SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_isLeftAdjoint
    U.overEquivalence.symm.functor
    (U.overPullbackSheafEquivOver.app X.ringCatSheaf).inv
    (TopologicalSpace.Opens.sheafOfModulesEquivOverUnit U X.ringCatSheaf)

    change U.overEquivalence.functor.IsDenseSubsite
      ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U) (Opens.grothendieckTopology U.carrier)
    infer_instance
  letI : ∀ V, (Over.post F).IsContinuous
      (((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U).over V)
      ((Opens.grothendieckTopology U.carrier).over (F.obj V)) :=
    fun V ↦ Functor.isContinuous_of_coverPreserving
      (compatiblePreservingOfFlat _ _)
      (CoverPreserving.overPost V (Functor.IsDenseSubsite.coverPreserving _ _ F))
  let M' : SheafOfModules.{u} (U.sheafRestrict.obj X.ringCatSheaf) := M

    dsimp [M']
    infer_instance
  change ((SheafOfModules.pushforward
    (U.sheafRestrictSheafEquivOver.app X.ringCatSheaf).inv).obj M').IsFinitePresentation
  exact SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_isLeftAdjoint

    (TopologicalSpace.Opens.sheafOfModulesEquivOverInverseUnit U X.ringCatSheaf)

statement:
private lemma openBaseChange_openMap_eq (f : X ⟶ Y) (U : Y.Opens)
    {V W : U.toScheme.Opens} (g : Opposite.op V ⟶ .op W) :
    (.op <| homOfLE <| Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono f <|
        Scheme.Hom.image_mono U.ι <| leOfHom g.unop) ≫
        (eqToHom (image_morphismRestrict_preimage f U W)).op =
      (eqToHom (image_morphismRestrict_preimage f U V)).op ≫
        (.op <| homOfLE <| Scheme.Hom.image_mono (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι <|
          Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono (f ∣_ U) <| leOfHom g.unop)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subsingleton.elim

name: AlgebraicGeometry.restrictUnitSectionIso_naturality

@[reassoc]
private lemma restrictUnitSectionIso_naturality (f : X ⟶ Y)

    ((unitModules Y).restrict f).presheaf.map g ≫
        (restrictUnitSectionIso f W).hom =
      (restrictUnitSectionIso f V).hom ≫
        (unitModules X).presheaf.map g
proof:
:= by
  ext x

    (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso f).hom.val g x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.morphismRestrict_app_apply
statement:
private lemma morphismRestrict_app_apply (f : X ⟶ Y) (U : Y.Opens)
    (V : U.toScheme.Opens) (r : Γ(U.toScheme, V)) :
    (f ∣_ U).app V r =
      X.presheaf.map
          (eqToHom (image_morphismRestrict_preimage f U V)).op
        (f.app (U.ι ''ᵁ V) ((U.ι.appIso V).inv r))
proof:
:= by
  rw [morphismRestrict_app]
  calc
    _ = X.presheaf.map
          (eqToHom (image_morphismRestrict_preimage f U V)).op
        (f.app (U.ι ''ᵁ V) r) :=
      congrFun (ConcreteCategory.coe_comp _ _) r
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso]
      rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.openBaseChange_middle_smul
statement:
private lemma openBaseChange_middle_smul (f : X ⟶ Y) (U : Y.Opens)
    (V : U.toScheme.Opens)
    (s : Γ(X, f ⁻¹ᵁ (U.ι ''ᵁ V))) :
    (unitModules X).smul s ≫
        (unitModules X).presheaf.map
          (eqToHom (image_morphismRestrict_preimage f U V)).op ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι
          (unitModules X) ((f ∣_ U) ⁻¹ᵁ V)).inv ≫
        (restrictUnitSectionIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι
          ((f ∣_ U) ⁻¹ᵁ V)).hom =
      (unitModules X).presheaf.map
          (eqToHom (image_morphismRestrict_preimage f U V)).op ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι
          (unitModules X) ((f ∣_ U) ⁻¹ᵁ V)).inv ≫
        (restrictUnitSectionIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι
          ((f ∣_ U) ⁻¹ᵁ V)).hom ≫
        (unitModules (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme).smul
          (X.presheaf.map
            (eqToHom (image_morphismRestrict_preimage f U V)).op s)
proof:
:= by
  have hi :
      ((f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι.appIso ((f ∣_ U) ⁻¹ᵁ V)).hom
          (X.presheaf.map
            (eqToHom (image_morphismRestrict_preimage f U V)).op s) =
        X.presheaf.map
          (eqToHom (image_morphismRestrict_preimage f U V)).op s := by
    rw [Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso]
    exact congrFun (ConcreteCategory.coe_id) _
  rw [Scheme.Modules.map_comp_smul_assoc]
  rw [Scheme.Modules.smul_restrictAppIso_inv_assoc]
  rw [hi]
  simp only [restrictUnitSectionIso]
  rw [smul_comp_app]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.openBaseChangeSectionIso_naturality
statement:
private lemma openBaseChangeSectionIso_naturality (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (U : Y.Opens) {V W : U.toScheme.Opens}
    (g : Opposite.op V ⟶ .op W) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj (unitModules X))).presheaf.map g ≫
        (openBaseChangeSectionIso f U W).hom =
      (openBaseChangeSectionIso f U V).hom ≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ U)).obj
          (unitModules (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme)).presheaf.map g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [openBaseChangeSectionIso, Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [Scheme.Modules.map_restrictAppIso_hom_assoc]
  rw [cancel_epi (Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso U.ι
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj (unitModules X)) V).hom]
  change
    (unitModules X).presheaf.map
          (.op <| homOfLE <| Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono f <|
            Scheme.Hom.image_mono U.ι <| leOfHom g.unop) ≫
        (unitModules X).presheaf.map
          (eqToHom (image_morphismRestrict_preimage f U W)).op ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι
          (unitModules X) ((f ∣_ U) ⁻¹ᵁ W)).inv ≫
        (restrictUnitSectionIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι
          ((f ∣_ U) ⁻¹ᵁ W)).hom =
      (unitModules X).presheaf.map
          (eqToHom (image_morphismRestrict_preimage f U V)).op ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι
          (unitModules X) ((f ∣_ U) ⁻¹ᵁ V)).inv ≫
        (restrictUnitSectionIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι
          ((f ∣_ U) ⁻¹ᵁ V)).hom ≫
        (unitModules (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme).presheaf.map
          ((TopologicalSpace.Opens.map (f ∣_ U).base).op.map g)
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc, openBaseChange_openMap_eq,
    Functor.map_comp_assoc]
  rw [← Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso_inv_map_assoc]
  rw [restrictUnitSectionIso_naturality]
  congr 1
  exact g

name: AlgebraicGeometry.openBaseChangeModuleSectionIso_naturality

private lemma openBaseChangeModuleSectionIso_naturality (f : X ⟶ Y)

proof:
:= by
  simp only [openBaseChangeModuleSectionIso, Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc]

    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M) V).hom]

    M.presheaf.map
          (.op <| homOfLE <| Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono f <|
            Scheme.Hom.image_mono U.ι <| leOfHom g.unop) ≫
        M.presheaf.map
          (eqToHom (image_morphismRestrict_preimage f U W)).op ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι M

name: AlgebraicGeometry.restrictPushforwardIso_hom_app

name: AlgebraicGeometry.restrictPushforwardIso_hom_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem restrictPushforwardIso_hom_naturality
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (U : Y.Opens) {M N : X.Modules} (g : M ⟶ N) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map g) ≫
        (restrictPushforwardIso f U N).hom =
      (restrictPushforwardIso f U M).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ U)).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).map g)
proof:
:= by
  apply (SheafOfModules.forget U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf).map_injective
  change
    (SheafOfModules.forget U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map
            ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map g)) ≫
        (openBaseChangeModulePresheafIso f U N).hom =
      (openBaseChangeModulePresheafIso f U M).hom ≫
        (SheafOfModules.forget U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ U)).map
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).map g))
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro V
  simp only [PresheafOfModules.comp_app]
  change
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map g)).val.app V ≫
      (openBaseChangeModuleSectionModuleIso f U N V.unop).hom =
    (openBaseChangeModuleSectionModuleIso f U M V.unop).hom ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ U)).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).map g)).val.app V
  dsimp only [openBaseChangeModuleSectionModuleIso]
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  have hsection :
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map
            ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map g)).app V.unop ≫
          (openBaseChangeModuleSectionIso f U N V.unop).hom =
        (openBaseChangeModuleSectionIso f U M V.unop).hom ≫
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ U)).map
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
              (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).map g)).app V.unop := by
    change
      ((((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map
              ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map g)).app V.unop ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso U.ι
              ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj N) V.unop).hom) ≫
          N.presheaf.map
            (eqToHom
              (image_morphismRestrict_preimage f U V.unop)).op) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι N
          ((f ∣_ U) ⁻¹ᵁ V.unop)).inv =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso U.ι
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M) V.unop).hom ≫
        (M.presheaf.map
          (eqToHom
            (image_morphismRestrict_preimage f U V.unop)).op ≫
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι M
              ((f ∣_ U) ⁻¹ᵁ V.unop)).inv ≫
            ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ U)).map
              ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
                (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).map g)).app V.unop))
    rw [show
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map g)).app V.unop ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso U.ι
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj N) V.unop).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso U.ι
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M) V.unop).hom ≫
        g.app (f ⁻¹ᵁ (U.ι ''ᵁ V.unop)) from rfl]
    have hnat := g.mapPresheaf.naturality
      (eqToHom (image_morphismRestrict_preimage f U V.unop)).op
    simp only [Scheme.Modules.mapPresheaf_app] at hnat
    have hlast :
        g.app ((f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ ((f ∣_ U) ⁻¹ᵁ V.unop)) ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι N
              ((f ∣_ U) ⁻¹ᵁ V.unop)).inv =
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι M
              ((f ∣_ U) ⁻¹ᵁ V.unop)).inv ≫
            ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ U)).map
              ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
                (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).map g)).app V.unop := by
      rfl
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [← reassoc_of% hnat, hlast]
  exact CategoryTheory.congr_fun hsection x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_affine_open_restrictions
statement:
theorem isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_affine_open_restrictions
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules)
    (h : ∀ (U : Y.Opens), IsAffineOpen U →
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ U)).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).obj M)).IsFinitePresentation) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  let P := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M
  let C := Y.affineOpenCover.openCover
  let U : C.I₀ → Y.Opens := fun i ↦ (C.f i).opensRange
  have hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y).CoversTop U :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := Y) U).2 C.isOpenCover_opensRange
  letI : ∀ i, (P.over (U i)).IsFinitePresentation := fun i ↦ by
    have hAffine : IsAffineOpen (U i) := isAffineOpen_opensRange (C.f i)
    let Q := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ (U i))).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ (U i)).ι).obj M)
    letI : Q.IsFinitePresentation := h (U i) hAffine
    let R := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι).obj P
    letI : R.IsFinitePresentation :=
      (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation (U i).toScheme.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
        (restrictPushforwardIso f (U i) M).symm inferInstance
    let N := (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).inverse.obj R
    letI : N.IsFinitePresentation :=
      isFinitePresentation_overEquiv_inverse (U i) R
    let e : P.over (U i) ≅ N :=
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).unitIso.app (P.over (U i)) ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).inverse.mapIso
          ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv (U i)).app P)
    exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation
      (Y.ringCatSheaf.over (U i))).prop_of_iso e.symm inferInstance
  exact SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation_of_over_cover P U hU

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isAffine
statement:
theorem isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isAffine (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules)
    [M.IsQuasicoherent] : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  let N := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor X.isoSpec.inv).obj M
  letI : N.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  let P := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Spec.map f.appTop)).obj N
  letI : P.IsQuasicoherent := isQuasicoherent_pushforward_specMap f.appTop N
  let Q := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor Y.isoSpec.hom).obj P
  letI : Q.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  exact (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent Y.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
    (affinePushforwardIso f M).symm inferInstance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_isFinite_of_isAffine
statement:
theorem isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_isFinite_of_isAffine
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation]
    [IsFinite f] [IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y, ⊤)] :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  let N := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor X.isoSpec.inv).obj M
  letI : N.IsFinitePresentation :=
    isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor X.isoSpec.inv M
  have hFinite : f.appTop.hom.Finite :=
    IsFinite.finite_app f ⊤ (isAffineOpen_top Y)
  let Q := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Spec.map f.appTop)).obj N
  letI : Q.IsFinitePresentation :=
    isFinitePresentation_pushforward_specMap_of_finite_of_isFinitePresentation
      f.appTop N hFinite
  let T := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor Y.isoSpec.hom).obj Q
  letI : T.IsFinitePresentation := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor Y.isoSpec.hom Q
  exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation Y.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
    (affinePushforwardIso f M).symm inferInstance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_isFinite_of_isAffine_of_specPresentation
statement:
theorem isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_isFinite_of_isAffine_of_specPresentation
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules)
    (P : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor X.isoSpec.inv).obj M).Presentation) [P.IsFinite]
    [IsFinite f] [IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y, ⊤)] :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  let N := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor X.isoSpec.inv).obj M
  have hFinite : f.appTop.hom.Finite :=
    IsFinite.finite_app f ⊤ (isAffineOpen_top Y)
  let Q := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Spec.map f.appTop)).obj N
  letI : Q.IsFinitePresentation :=
    isFinitePresentation_pushforward_specMap_of_finite_of_presentation
      f.appTop N P hFinite
  let T := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor Y.isoSpec.hom).obj Q
  letI : T.IsFinitePresentation := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor Y.isoSpec.hom Q
  exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation Y.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_isFinite_of_isAffine_of_presentation
statement:
theorem isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_isFinite_of_isAffine_of_presentation
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) (P : M.Presentation) [P.IsFinite]
    [IsFinite f] [IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y, ⊤)] :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  let PN := Scheme.Modules.presentationRestrict X.isoSpec.inv P
  letI : PN.IsFinite := by
    dsimp [PN, Scheme.Modules.presentationRestrict]
    infer_instance
  exact isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_isFinite_of_isAffine_of_specPresentation
    f M PN

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isFinitePresentation_pushforward_unit_of_isFinite_of_isAffine
statement:
theorem isFinitePresentation_pushforward_unit_of_isFinite_of_isAffine
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f] [IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y, ⊤)] :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj
      (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  let N := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor X.isoSpec.inv).obj
    (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)
  let P := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Spec.map f.appTop)).obj N
  let Punit := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Spec.map f.appTop)).obj
    (SheafOfModules.unit (Spec Γ(X, ⊤)).ringCatSheaf)
  have hFinite : f.appTop.hom.Finite :=
    IsFinite.finite_app f ⊤ (isAffineOpen_top Y)
  letI : Punit.IsFinitePresentation :=
    isFinitePresentation_pushforward_unit_specMap_of_finite f.appTop hFinite
  let eP : P ≅ Punit :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Spec.map f.appTop)).mapIso
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso X.isoSpec.inv)
  letI : P.IsFinitePresentation :=
    (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation (Spec Γ(Y, ⊤)).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
      eP.symm inferInstance
  let Q := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor Y.isoSpec.hom).obj P
  letI : Q.IsFinitePresentation := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor Y.isoSpec.hom P
  exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation Y.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
    (affinePushforwardIso f (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).symm inferInstance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isFinitePresentation_pushforward_unit_of_isFinite
statement:
theorem isFinitePresentation_pushforward_unit_of_isFinite
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj
      (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  let M := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj
    (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)
  let C := Y.affineOpenCover.openCover
  let U : C.I₀ → Y.Opens := fun i ↦ (C.f i).opensRange
  have hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y).CoversTop U :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := Y) U).2 C.isOpenCover_opensRange
  letI : ∀ i, (M.over (U i)).IsFinitePresentation := fun i ↦ by
    have hAffine : IsAffineOpen (U i) := isAffineOpen_opensRange (C.f i)
    letI : IsAffine (U i).toScheme := hAffine
    letI : IsAffine (f ⁻¹ᵁ (U i)).toScheme := hAffine.preimage f
    letI : IsNoetherianRing Γ((U i).toScheme, ⊤) :=
      IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian
        (X := (U i).toScheme) ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩
    let P := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ (U i))).obj
      (SheafOfModules.unit (f ⁻¹ᵁ (U i)).toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
    letI : P.IsFinitePresentation :=
      isFinitePresentation_pushforward_unit_of_isFinite_of_isAffine (f ∣_ (U i))
    let R := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι).obj M
    letI : R.IsFinitePresentation :=
      (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation (U i).toScheme.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
        (restrictPushforwardUnitIso f (U i)).symm inferInstance
    let N := (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).inverse.obj R
    letI : N.IsFinitePresentation :=
      isFinitePresentation_overEquiv_inverse (U i) R
    let e : M.over (U i) ≅ N :=
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).unitIso.app (M.over (U i)) ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).inverse.mapIso
          ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv (U i)).app M)
    exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation (Y.ringCatSheaf.over (U i))).prop_of_iso
      e.symm inferInstance
  exact SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation_of_over_cover M U hU

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.isZero_of_hasConstantRank_zero
statement:
theorem isZero_of_hasConstantRank_zero (M : W.Modules) (hr : HasConstantRank W M 0) :
    IsZero M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin, hcard⟩ := hr
  apply SchemeKTheory.isZero_of_isZero_over W _ q.X q.coversTop
  intro i
  let σ := q.generators i
  haveI : σ.IsFiniteType := hqfin.isFiniteType i
  haveI : Finite σ.I := SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.IsFiniteType.finite
  haveI : IsEmpty σ.I := by
    rcases Nat.card_eq_zero.mp (hcard i) with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact (not_finite σ.I).elim
  haveI : IsIso σ.π := hq.isIso i
  exact IsZero.of_iso ((isColimitEquivIsInitialOfIsEmpty _ (SheafOfModules.freeCofan σ.I))
    (SheafOfModules.isColimitFreeCofan σ.I)).isZero (asIso σ.π).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.openRestrictionSheafificationComparison_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem openRestrictionSheafificationComparison_naturality
    {P Q : PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (Y.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)} (a : P ⟶ Q) :
    (moduleSheafification X).map ((openRestrictionPresheaf q).map a) ≫
        openRestrictionSheafificationComparison q Q =
      openRestrictionSheafificationComparison q P ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
          ((moduleSheafification Y).map a)
proof:
:= by
  let adjY := PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
    (structurePresheafId Y)
  dsimp [openRestrictionSheafificationComparison]
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← (moduleSheafification X).map_comp]
  rw [← (openRestrictionPresheaf q).map_comp]
  have hη := adjY.unit.naturality a
  simp only [Functor.id_map] at hη
  rw [hη]
  rw [(openRestrictionPresheaf q).map_comp,
    (moduleSheafification X).map_comp, Category.assoc]
  rw [Category.assoc]
  congr 1
  change (moduleSheafification X).map
      ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
          ((moduleSheafification Y).map a))) ≫
        (moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).counit.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj ((moduleSheafification Y).obj Q)) =
    (moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).counit.app
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj ((moduleSheafification Y).obj P)) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map ((moduleSheafification Y).map a)
  simpa only [Functor.comp_map, Functor.id_map] using
    (moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).counit.naturality
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
        ((moduleSheafification Y).map a))

name: SchemeKTheory.openRestrictionPushforwardTensorIso_inv_naturality
statement:
theorem openRestrictionPushforwardTensorIso_inv_naturality
    {M M' N N' : PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (Y.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)}
    (a : M ⟶ M') (b : N ⟶ N') :
    (pushforwardTensorIso q.opensFunctor (openRestrictionRingHom q)
        (fun U ↦ openRestrictionRingHom_app_isIso q U) M N).inv ≫
      (openRestrictionPresheaf q).map (a ⊗ₘ b) =
    (((openRestrictionPresheaf q).map a) ⊗ₘ
        ((openRestrictionPresheaf q).map b)) ≫
      (pushforwardTensorIso q.opensFunctor (openRestrictionRingHom q)
        (fun U ↦ openRestrictionRingHom_app_isIso q U) M' N').inv
proof:
:= by
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro U
  simp only [PresheafOfModules.comp_app]
  let F := ModuleCat.restrictScalars ((openRestrictionRingHom q).app U).hom
  change Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ F (M.obj (q.opensFunctor.op.obj U))
        (N.obj (q.opensFunctor.op.obj U)) ≫
      F.map ((a ⊗ₘ b).app (q.opensFunctor.op.obj U)) =
    (F.map (a.app (q.opensFunctor.op.obj U)) ⊗ₘ
        F.map (b.app (q.opensFunctor.op.obj U))) ≫
      Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ F (M'.obj (q.opensFunctor.op.obj U))
        (N'.obj (q.opensFunctor.op.obj U))
  change Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ F (M.obj (q.opensFunctor.op.obj U))
        (N.obj (q.opensFunctor.op.obj U)) ≫
      F.map (a.app (q.opensFunctor.op.obj U) ⊗ₘ
        b.app (q.opensFunctor.op.obj U)) =
    (F.map (a.app (q.opensFunctor.op.obj U)) ⊗ₘ
        F.map (b.app (q.opensFunctor.op.obj U))) ≫
      Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ F (M'.obj (q.opensFunctor.op.obj U))
        (N'.obj (q.opensFunctor.op.obj U))
  exact (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ_natural F
    (a.app (q.opensFunctor.op.obj U))
    (b.app (q.opensFunctor.op.obj U))).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.openRestrictionPushforwardTensorIso_hom_naturality
statement:
theorem openRestrictionPushforwardTensorIso_hom_naturality
    {M M' N N' : PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (Y.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)}
    (a : M ⟶ M') (b : N ⟶ N') :
    (openRestrictionPresheaf q).map (a ⊗ₘ b) ≫
      (pushforwardTensorIso q.opensFunctor (openRestrictionRingHom q)
        (fun U ↦ openRestrictionRingHom_app_isIso q U) M' N').hom =
    (pushforwardTensorIso q.opensFunctor (openRestrictionRingHom q)
        (fun U ↦ openRestrictionRingHom_app_isIso q U) M N).hom ≫
      (((openRestrictionPresheaf q).map a) ⊗ₘ
        ((openRestrictionPresheaf q).map b))
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono
    (pushforwardTensorIso q.opensFunctor (openRestrictionRingHom q)
      (fun U ↦ openRestrictionRingHom_app_isIso q U) M' N').inv).1
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
  have h := openRestrictionPushforwardTensorIso_inv_naturality q a b
  have h' := congrArg
    (fun k ↦ (pushforwardTensorIso q.opensFunctor (openRestrictionRingHom q)
      (fun U ↦ openRestrictionRingHom_app_isIso q U) M N).hom ≫ k) h
  simpa only [Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc] using h'

name: SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso_hom_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso_hom_naturality
    {M M' N N' : Y.Modules} (a : M ⟶ M') (b : N ⟶ N') :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map (tensorSheafMap Y a b) ≫
        (restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q M' N').hom =
      (restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q M N).hom ≫
        tensorSheafMap X
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map a)
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map b)
proof:
:= by
  let G := openRestrictionPresheaf q
  let LX := moduleSheafification X
  let LY := moduleSheafification Y
  let c := openRestrictionSheafificationNatIso q
  let e := fun (A B : PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (Y.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)) ↦
    pushforwardTensorIso q.opensFunctor (openRestrictionRingHom q)
      (fun U ↦ openRestrictionRingHom_app_isIso q U) A B
  change
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
          (LY.map (a.val ⊗ₘ b.val)) ≫
        c.inv.app (M'.val ⊗ N'.val) ≫
          LX.map (e M'.val N'.val).hom =
      c.inv.app (M.val ⊗ N.val) ≫
        LX.map (e M.val N.val).hom ≫
          LX.map ((G.map a.val) ⊗ₘ (G.map b.val))
  have hc := c.inv.naturality (a.val ⊗ₘ b.val)
  simp only [Functor.comp_map] at hc
  rw [← Category.assoc, hc]
  rw [Category.assoc]
  congr 1
  rw [← LX.map_comp]
  rw [openRestrictionPushforwardTensorIso_hom_naturality q a.val b.val]
  rw [LX.map_comp]

name: SchemeKTheory.openPullbackTensorIso_hom_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem openPullbackTensorIso_hom_naturality
    {M M' N N' : Y.Modules} (a : M ⟶ M') (b : N ⟶ N') :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map (tensorSheafMap Y a b) ≫
        (openPullbackTensorIso q M' N').hom =
      (openPullbackTensorIso q M N).hom ≫
        tensorSheafMap X
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map a)
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map b)
proof:
:= by
  let e := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q
  simp only [openPullbackTensorIso, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom,
    tensorSheafMapIso_hom, Category.assoc]
  change
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map (tensorSheafMap Y a b) ≫
        (e.app (tensorSheaf Y M' N')).inv ≫
          (restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q M' N').hom ≫
            tensorSheafMap X (e.app M').hom (e.app N').hom =
      (e.app (tensorSheaf Y M N)).inv ≫
        (restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q M N).hom ≫
          tensorSheafMap X (e.app M).hom (e.app N).hom ≫
            tensorSheafMap X
              ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map a)
              ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map b)
  slice_lhs 1 2 =>
    exact e.inv.naturality (tensorSheafMap Y a b)
  change
    e.inv.app (tensorSheaf Y M N) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map (tensorSheafMap Y a b) ≫
          (restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q M' N').hom ≫
            tensorSheafMap X (e.app M').hom (e.app N').hom =
      e.inv.app (tensorSheaf Y M N) ≫
        (restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q M N).hom ≫
          tensorSheafMap X (e.app M).hom (e.app N).hom ≫
            tensorSheafMap X
              ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map a)
              ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map b)
  rw [cancel_epi (e.inv.app (tensorSheaf Y M N))]
  rw [restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso_hom_naturality_assoc q a b]
  rw [cancel_epi (restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q M N).hom]
  rw [tensorSheafMap_comp, tensorSheafMap_comp]
  have ha :
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map a ≫ (e.app M').hom =
        (e.app M).hom ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map a :=
    e.hom.naturality a
  have hb :
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map b ≫ (e.app N').hom =
        (e.app N).hom ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map b :=
    e.hom.naturality b
  rw [ha, hb]

name: SchemeKTheory.restrictPushforwardIso_restrictAdjunction_app
statement:
theorem restrictPushforwardIso_restrictAdjunction_app
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : S ⟶ T) (W : T.Opens)
    (M : S.Modules) (U : T.Opens) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction W.ι).unit.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M)).app U ≫
        ((restrictPushforwardIso f W M).hom).app (W.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U) =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).unit.app M)).app U ≫
        ((pushforwardBaseChangeIso f W).hom.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj M)).app U
proof:
:= by
  rw [restrictPushforwardIso_hom_app]
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app,
    Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app]
  dsimp [pushforwardBaseChangeIso]
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, NatTrans.comp_app,
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app,
    Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp_hom_app_app,
    Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp_inv_app_app,
    Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr_hom_app_app]
  dsimp [Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso]
  erw [Category.id_comp]
  erw [Category.id_comp]
  erw [Category.comp_id]
  erw [Category.comp_id]
  rw [Scheme.Modules.restrict_map]
  erw [← Functor.map_comp]
  erw [← Functor.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: SchemeKTheory.restrictAdjunction_homEquiv_restrictPushforwardIso_hom
statement:
theorem restrictAdjunction_homEquiv_restrictPushforwardIso_hom
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : S ⟶ T) (W : T.Opens) (M : S.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction W.ι).homEquiv _ _
        (restrictPushforwardIso f W M).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).unit.app M) ≫
        (pushforwardBaseChangeIso f W).hom.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_apply]
  ext U x
  exact CategoryTheory.congr_fun
    (restrictPushforwardIso_restrictAdjunction_app f W M U) x

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso_hom_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso_hom_naturality
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : S ⟶ T) (W : T.Opens)
    {M N : S.Modules} (a : M ⟶ N) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback W.ι).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map a) ≫
        (pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso f W N).hom =
      (pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso f W M).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ W)).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).map a)
proof:
:=
  (pullbackRestrictPushforwardNatIso f W).hom.naturality a

name: SchemeKTheory.conjugateEquiv_pullbackComp_hom
statement:
theorem conjugateEquiv_pullbackComp_hom
    {S T U : Scheme.{u}} (f : S ⟶ T) (g : T ⟶ U) :
    conjugateEquiv
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (f ≫ g))
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).comp
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f))
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f g).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f g).inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_epi (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f g).hom]
  rw [← Scheme.Modules.conjugateEquiv_pullbackComp_inv f g]
  rw [conjugateEquiv_comp]
  rw [Scheme.Modules.conjugateEquiv_pullbackComp_inv]
  simp

name: SchemeKTheory.conjugateEquiv_pullbackCongr_hom
statement:
theorem conjugateEquiv_pullbackCongr_hom
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} {f g : S ⟶ T} (h : f = g) :
    conjugateEquiv
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g)
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f)
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr h).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr h.symm).hom
proof:
:= by
  subst g
  simp [Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr]
  ext M U x
  rw [Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr_hom_app_app]

name: SchemeKTheory.conjugateEquiv_pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict_hom
statement:
theorem conjugateEquiv_pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict_hom
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : S ⟶ T) (W : T.Opens) :
    conjugateEquiv
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).comp
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι))
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction W.ι).comp
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (f ∣_ W)))
        (pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict f W).hom =

proof:

  rw [← conjugateEquiv_comp]
  rw [← conjugateEquiv_comp]
  rw [conjugateEquiv_pullbackComp_hom]
  rw [conjugateEquiv_pullbackCongr_hom]
  rw [Scheme.Modules.conjugateEquiv_pullbackComp_inv]

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackUnit_restrictFunctorIsoPullback_inv
statement:
theorem pullbackUnit_restrictFunctorIsoPullback_inv
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} (q : S ⟶ T) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (M : T.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q).unit.app M ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).inv.app M) =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).unit.app M
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q)
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q) M]
  unfold Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback
  slice_lhs 2 3 =>
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, Iso.hom_inv_id_app]
    exact (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map_id _

name: SchemeKTheory.restrictUnit_restrictFunctorIsoPullback_hom
statement:
theorem restrictUnit_restrictFunctorIsoPullback_hom
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} (q : S ⟶ T) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (M : T.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).unit.app M ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).hom.app M) =

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackRestrictPushforwardNatIso_hom_eq_mateViaPushforward
statement:
theorem pullbackRestrictPushforwardNatIso_hom_eq_mateViaPushforward
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : S ⟶ T) (W : T.Opens) :
    (pullbackRestrictPushforwardNatIso f W).hom =
      pullbackBaseChangeMateViaPushforward f W
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext M
  apply ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction W.ι).homEquiv _ _).injective
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_apply, Adjunction.homEquiv_apply]
  simp only [pullbackRestrictPushforwardNatIso, Iso.trans_hom,
    Functor.isoWhiskerLeft_hom, Functor.isoWhiskerRight_hom,
    NatTrans.comp_app, Functor.whiskerLeft_app, Functor.whiskerRight_app]
  have hmate := unit_mateEquiv_symm
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι)
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction W.ι)
    (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (pushforwardBaseChangeIso f W).hom) M
  have hmate' :
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
            (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).unit.app M) ≫
        (pushforwardBaseChangeIso f W).hom.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj M) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction W.ι).unit.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward W.ι).map
          ((pullbackBaseChangeMateViaPushforward f W).app M) := by
    change
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
            (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).unit.app M) ≫
        (pushforwardBaseChangeIso f W).hom.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj M) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction W.ι).unit.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj ((𝟭 S.Modules).obj M)) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward W.ι).map
          ((pullbackBaseChangeMateViaPushforward f W).app
            ((𝟭 S.Modules).obj M)) at hmate
    simpa only [Functor.id_obj] using hmate
  rw [← hmate']
  rw [Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_comp]
  slice_lhs 1 2 =>
    exact pullbackUnit_restrictFunctorIsoPullback_inv W.ι
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M)
  have hr := restrictAdjunction_homEquiv_restrictPushforwardIso_hom
    f W M
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_apply] at hr
  change
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction W.ι).unit.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward W.ι).map
          ((restrictPushforwardNatIso f W).hom.app M) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).unit.app M) ≫
        (pushforwardBaseChangeIso f W).hom.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj M) at hr
  rw [hr]
  rw [Category.assoc]
  have hnat :
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).map
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback
              (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).hom.app M)) ≫
        (pushforwardBaseChangeIso f W).hom.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj M) =
      (pushforwardBaseChangeIso f W).hom.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj M) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward W.ι).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ∣_ W)).map
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback
              (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).hom.app M)) :=
    (pushforwardBaseChangeIso f W).hom.naturality
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback
        (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).hom.app M)
  rw [← hnat]
  change
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).unit.app M) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).map
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback
              (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).hom.app M)) ≫
          (pushforwardBaseChangeIso f W).hom.app
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj M) = _
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc]
  rw [restrictUnit_restrictFunctorIsoPullback_hom]

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackBaseChangeMate_eq_mateViaPushforward
statement:
theorem pullbackBaseChangeMate_eq_mateViaPushforward
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : S ⟶ T) (W : T.Opens) :
    pullbackBaseChangeMate f W =
      pullbackBaseChangeMateViaPushforward f W
proof:
:= by
  apply ((mateEquiv
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι)
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction W.ι))).injective
  change
    ((mateEquiv
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι)
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction W.ι))
      ((mateEquiv
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f)
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (f ∣_ W)))
        (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _
          (pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict f W).hom))).natTrans =
      ((mateEquiv
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι)
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction W.ι))
        ((mateEquiv
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι)
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction W.ι)).symm
          (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _
            (pushforwardBaseChangeIso f W).hom))).natTrans
  rw [iterated_mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv]
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact conjugateEquiv_pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict_hom f W

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackBaseChangeMate_eq_pullbackRestrictPushforwardNatIso_hom
statement:
theorem pullbackBaseChangeMate_eq_pullbackRestrictPushforwardNatIso_hom
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : S ⟶ T) (W : T.Opens) :
    pullbackBaseChangeMate f W =
      (pullbackRestrictPushforwardNatIso f W).hom
proof:
:=
  (pullbackBaseChangeMate_eq_mateViaPushforward f W).trans
    (pullbackRestrictPushforwardNatIso_hom_eq_mateViaPushforward f W).symm

name: ExactGrothendieck.PrincipalGysin.classOf_eq_ker_add_ker
statement:
theorem classOf_eq_ker_add_ker (T : ShortComplex C) (hT : T.Exact) (hA : P T.X₁)
    (hB : P T.X₂) (hD : P T.X₃) :
    subcategoryClassOf C P T.X₁ hA =
      subcategoryClassOf C P (kernel T.f) (hP.kernel T.f hA hB) +
        subcategoryClassOf C P (kernel T.g) (hP.kernel T.g hB hD)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Epi (kernel.lift T.g T.f T.zero) := hT.epi_kernelLift
  let S : ShortComplex C :=
    ShortComplex.mk (kernel.ι T.f) (kernel.lift T.g T.f T.zero)
      (by ext; simp)
  have hS : S.ShortExact :=
    { exact := ShortComplex.exact_of_f_is_kernel _
        (isKernelOfComp (kernel.ι T.g) T.f (kernelIsKernel T.f) S.zero (kernel.lift_ι _ _ _)) }
  exact subcategoryClassOf_middle C P _ _ _ S.zero hS

name: ExactGrothendieck.PrincipalGysin.classOf_eq_ker_add_of_epi
statement:
theorem classOf_eq_ker_add_of_epi {B D : C} (g : B ⟶ D) [Epi g] (hB : P B) (hD : P D) :
    subcategoryClassOf C P B hB =
      subcategoryClassOf C P (kernel g) (hP.kernel g hB hD) +
        subcategoryClassOf C P D hD

name: ExactGrothendieck.PrincipalGysin.classOf_eq_of_iso
statement:
theorem classOf_eq_of_iso {A B : C} (e : A ≅ B) (hA : P A) (hB : P B) :
    subcategoryClassOf C P A hA = subcategoryClassOf C P B hB
proof:
:=
  subcategoryClassOf_iso C P hA hB hP.zero (isZero_zero C) e

name: ExactGrothendieck.PrincipalGysin.six_term
statement:
theorem six_term {X₀ X₁ X₂ X₃ X₄ X₅ : C} (f₀ : X₀ ⟶ X₁) (f₁ : X₁ ⟶ X₂) (f₂ : X₂ ⟶ X₃)
    (f₃ : X₃ ⟶ X₄) (f₄ : X₄ ⟶ X₅) [Mono f₀] [Epi f₄]
    (w₁ : f₀ ≫ f₁ = 0) (w₂ : f₁ ≫ f₂ = 0) (w₃ : f₂ ≫ f₃ = 0) (w₄ : f₃ ≫ f₄ = 0)
    (e₁ : (ShortComplex.mk f₀ f₁ w₁).Exact) (e₂ : (ShortComplex.mk f₁ f₂ w₂).Exact)
    (e₃ : (ShortComplex.mk f₂ f₃ w₃).Exact) (e₄ : (ShortComplex.mk f₃ f₄ w₄).Exact)
    (h₀ : P X₀) (h₁ : P X₁) (h₂ : P X₂) (h₃ : P X₃) (h₄ : P X₄) (h₅ : P X₅) :
    subcategoryClassOf C P X₀ h₀ - subcategoryClassOf C P X₁ h₁ +
      subcategoryClassOf C P X₂ h₂ - subcategoryClassOf C P X₃ h₃ +
      subcategoryClassOf C P X₄ h₄ - subcategoryClassOf C P X₅ h₅ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have r₁ := classOf_eq_ker_add_ker hP _ e₁ h₀ h₁ h₂
  have r₂ := classOf_eq_ker_add_ker hP _ e₂ h₁ h₂ h₃
  have r₃ := classOf_eq_ker_add_ker hP _ e₃ h₂ h₃ h₄
  have r₄ := classOf_eq_ker_add_ker hP _ e₄ h₃ h₄ h₅
  have r₅ := classOf_eq_ker_add_of_epi hP f₄ h₄ h₅
  have z : subcategoryClassOf C P (kernel f₀) (hP.kernel f₀ h₀ h₁) = 0 :=
    subcategoryClassOf_isZero C P _ (isZero_kernel_of_mono f₀)
  dsimp only at r₁ r₂ r₃ r₄
  rw [r₁, r₂, r₃, r₄, r₅, z]
  abel

name: ExactGrothendieck.PrincipalGysin.naturality'
statement: theorem naturality' {A B : C} (f : A ⟶ B) : ap τ A ≫ f = f ≫ ap τ B
proof:
:= by
  simpa [ap] using (τ.naturality f).symm

name: ExactGrothendieck.PrincipalGysin.app_eq_zero_of_mono
statement:
theorem app_eq_zero_of_mono {A B : C} (f : A ⟶ B) [Mono f] (hB : ap τ B = 0) :
    ap τ A = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono f, naturality' τ f, hB, comp_zero, zero_comp]

name: ExactGrothendieck.PrincipalGysin.app_eq_zero_of_epi
statement:
theorem app_eq_zero_of_epi {A B : C} (f : A ⟶ B) [Epi f] (hA : ap τ A = 0) :
    ap τ B = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_epi f, ← naturality' τ f, hA, comp_zero, zero_comp]

name: ExactGrothendieck.PrincipalGysin.KerCokerClosed.killed
statement:
theorem KerCokerClosed.killed (hP : KerCokerClosed P) : KerCokerClosed (Killed P τ) where
  zero
proof:
:= ⟨hP.zero, (isZero_zero C).eq_of_src _ _⟩
  kernel f hA hB := ⟨hP.kernel f hA.1 hB.1, app_eq_zero_of_mono τ (kernel.ι f) hA.2⟩
  cokernel f hA hB := ⟨hP.cokernel f hA.1 hB.1, app_eq_zero_of_epi τ (cokernel.π f) hB.2⟩

name: ExactGrothendieck.PrincipalGysin.app_kernel_eq_zero
statement: theorem app_kernel_eq_zero (E : C) : ap τ (kernel (ap τ E)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono (kernel.ι (ap τ E)), naturality' τ, kernel.condition, zero_comp]

name: ExactGrothendieck.PrincipalGysin.app_cokernel_eq_zero
statement: theorem app_cokernel_eq_zero (E : C) : ap τ (cokernel (ap τ E)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_epi (cokernel.π (ap τ E)), ← naturality' τ, cokernel.condition, comp_zero]

name: ExactGrothendieck.PrincipalGysin.killed_kernel
statement: theorem killed_kernel {E : C} (hE : P E) : Killed P τ (kernel (ap τ E))
proof:
:=
  ⟨hP.kernel _ hE hE, app_kernel_eq_zero τ E⟩

name: ExactGrothendieck.PrincipalGysin.killed_cokernel
statement: theorem killed_cokernel {E : C} (hE : P E) : Killed P τ (cokernel (ap τ E))
proof:
:=
  ⟨hP.cokernel _ hE hE, app_cokernel_eq_zero τ E⟩

name: ExactGrothendieck.PrincipalGysin.gysinObj_additive
statement:
theorem gysinObj_additive (A B D : {E : C // P E}) (h : shortExactIn C P A B D) :
    gysinObj τ hP B = gysinObj τ hP A + gysinObj τ hP D
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, g, zero, hS⟩ := h
  let S := ShortComplex.mk f g zero
  let I := snakeInput τ S hS
  have hQ := hP.killed τ
  haveI : Mono I.L₀.f := by
    have w : I.L₀.f ≫ kernel.ι (ap τ S.X₂) = kernel.ι (ap τ S.X₁) ≫ S.f := kernel.lift_ι _ _ _
    haveI : Mono (I.L₀.f ≫ kernel.ι (ap τ S.X₂)) := by
      rw [w]; exact @mono_comp _ _ _ _ _ (kernel.ι _) _ S.f hS.mono_f
    exact mono_of_mono _ (kernel.ι (ap τ S.X₂))
  haveI : Epi I.L₃.g := by
    have w : cokernel.π (ap τ S.X₂) ≫ I.L₃.g = S.g ≫ cokernel.π (ap τ S.X₃) :=
      cokernel.π_desc _ _ _
    haveI : Epi (cokernel.π (ap τ S.X₂) ≫ I.L₃.g) := by
      rw [w]; exact @epi_comp _ _ _ _ _ S.g hS.epi_g (cokernel.π _) _
    exact epi_of_epi (cokernel.π (ap τ S.X₂)) _
  have key : subcategoryClassOf C (Killed P τ) (kernel (ap τ A.1)) (killed_kernel τ hP A.2) -
      subcategoryClassOf C (Killed P τ) (kernel (ap τ B.1)) (killed_kernel τ hP B.2) +
      subcategoryClassOf C (Killed P τ) (kernel (ap τ D.1)) (killed_kernel τ hP D.2) -
      subcategoryClassOf C (Killed P τ) (cokernel (ap τ A.1)) (killed_cokernel τ hP A.2) +
      subcategoryClassOf C (Killed P τ) (cokernel (ap τ B.1)) (killed_cokernel τ hP B.2) -
      subcategoryClassOf C (Killed P τ) (cokernel (ap τ D.1)) (killed_cokernel τ hP D.2) = 0 :=
    six_term hQ I.L₀.f I.L₀.g I.δ I.L₃.f I.L₃.g I.L₀.zero I.L₀_g_δ I.δ_L₃_f
    I.L₃.zero I.L₀_exact I.L₁'_exact I.L₂'_exact I.L₃_exact
    (killed_kernel τ hP A.2) (killed_kernel τ hP B.2) (killed_kernel τ hP D.2)
    (killed_cokernel τ hP A.2) (killed_cokernel τ hP B.2) (killed_cokernel τ hP D.2)
  simp only [gysinObj]
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← key]
  abel

name: ExactGrothendieck.PrincipalGysin.gysin_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gysin_classOf (E : C) (hE : P E) :
    gysin τ hP (subcategoryClassOf C P E hE) =
      subcategoryClassOf C (Killed P τ) (cokernel (ap τ E)) (killed_cokernel τ hP hE) -
        subcategoryClassOf C (Killed P τ) (kernel (ap τ E)) (killed_kernel τ hP hE)
proof:
:=
  lift_classOf _ _ _

name: ExactGrothendieck.PrincipalGysin.gysin_classOf_of_mono
statement:
theorem gysin_classOf_of_mono (E : C) (hE : P E) [Mono (ap τ E)] :
    gysin τ hP (subcategoryClassOf C P E hE) =
      subcategoryClassOf C (Killed P τ) (cokernel (ap τ E)) (killed_cokernel τ hP hE)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gysin_classOf, subcategoryClassOf_isZero C _ _ (isZero_kernel_of_mono _), sub_zero]

name: ExactGrothendieck.PrincipalGysin.pushDivisor_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pushDivisor_classOf (E : C) (hE : Killed P τ E) :
    pushDivisor τ (subcategoryClassOf C (Killed P τ) E hE) = subcategoryClassOf C P E hE.1
proof:
:= by
  simp [pushDivisor, subcategoryClassOf, map]

name: ExactGrothendieck.PrincipalGysin.gysin_comp_pushDivisor
statement: theorem gysin_comp_pushDivisor : (gysin τ hP).comp (pushDivisor τ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext _ _ fun E => ?_
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := E
  change gysin τ hP (pushDivisor τ (subcategoryClassOf C (Killed P τ) E hE)) = 0
  rw [pushDivisor_classOf, gysin_classOf, sub_eq_zero]
  have hQ := hP.killed τ
  have e₁ : cokernel (ap τ E) ≅ E :=
    cokernelIsoOfEq hE.2 ≪≫ (asIso (cokernel.π (0 : E ⟶ E))).symm
  have e₂ : kernel (ap τ E) ≅ E := kernelIsoOfEq hE.2 ≪≫ asIso (kernel.ι (0 : E ⟶ E))
  rw [classOf_eq_of_iso hQ e₁ _ hE, classOf_eq_of_iso hQ e₂ _ hE]

name: ExactGrothendieck.PrincipalGysin.pushDivisor_comp_gysin
statement: theorem pushDivisor_comp_gysin : (pushDivisor τ).comp (gysin τ hP) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext _ _ fun E => ?_
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := E
  change pushDivisor τ (gysin τ hP (subcategoryClassOf C P E hE)) = 0
  rw [gysin_classOf, map_sub, pushDivisor_classOf, pushDivisor_classOf, sub_eq_zero]
  have hQ : P (cokernel (ap τ E)) := hP.cokernel _ hE hE
  have r₁ := classOf_eq_ker_add_ker hP _ (ShortComplex.exact_cokernel (ap τ E)) hE hE hQ
  have r₂ := classOf_eq_ker_add_of_epi hP (cokernel.π (ap τ E)) hE hQ
  dsimp only at r₁
  rw [r₁] at r₂
  exact add_left_cancel (r₂.symm.trans (add_comm _ _))

name: ExactGrothendieck.PrincipalGysin.mono_ap_smulNatTrans_iff
statement:
theorem mono_ap_smulNatTrans_iff (r : R) (M : ModuleCat.{v} R) :
    Mono (ap (smulNatTrans R r) M) ↔ IsSMulRegular M r
proof:
:= by
  rw [ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective]
  rfl

name: ExactGrothendieck.PrincipalGysin.mono_ap_smulNatTrans_of_flat
statement:
theorem mono_ap_smulNatTrans_of_flat (k : Type u) [Field k] (c : k)
    (M : ModuleCat.{v} (Polynomial k)) [Module.Flat (Polynomial k) M] :
    Mono (ap (smulNatTrans (Polynomial k) (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C c)) M)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mono_ap_smulNatTrans_iff]
  exact Module.Flat.isSMulRegular_of_nonZeroDivisors
    (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero (Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero c))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_isFinite
statement:
theorem isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_isFinite
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : X.Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation]
    [IsFinite f] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  apply isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_affine_open_restrictions f M
  intro U hU
  letI : IsAffine U.toScheme := hU
  letI : IsAffine (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme := hU.preimage f
  letI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤) :=
    IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian
      (X := U.toScheme) ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩
  let N := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).obj M
  letI : N.IsFinitePresentation :=
    isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι M
  exact isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_isFinite_of_isAffine
    (f ∣_ U) N

name: SchemeKTheory.isFiniteLocallyFree_of_openCover_freeTrivializations
statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_of_openCover_freeTrivializations
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (C : X.OpenCover.{u}) (M : X.Modules)
    (I : C.I₀ → Type u) [∀ i, Finite (I i)]
    (h : ∀ i, (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.f i)).obj M ≅
      SheafOfModules.free (R := (C.X i).ringCatSheaf) (I i)) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree X M
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨freeTrivializedOpenCoverLocalGeneratorsData C M I h,
    inferInstance, inferInstance⟩⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global
statement:
theorem pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : Y.Modules)
    (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y M) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin⟩ := hM.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := hqfin
  let C := pullbackLocalGeneratorsOpenCover f q
  let I : C.I₀ → Type u := fun i ↦ (q.generators i).I
  letI : ∀ i, Finite (I i) := fun i ↦ by
    letI : (q.generators i).IsFiniteType :=
      SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType i
    dsimp only [I]
    infer_instance
  exact isFiniteLocallyFree_of_openCover_freeTrivializations
    C ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M) I
      (pullbackLocalGeneratorsOpenCoverIso f q)

name: SchemeKTheory.flatPullbackK0Object_exact
statement:
theorem flatPullbackK0Object_exact
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [Flat f]
    (A B C : {M : Y.Modules // IsFiniteLocallyFree Y M})
    (h : ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn Y.Modules
      (IsFiniteLocallyFree Y) A B C) :
    ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules
      (IsFiniteLocallyFree X) (flatPullbackK0Object f A)
      (flatPullbackK0Object f B) (flatPullbackK0Object f C)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, zero, hshort⟩ := h
  letI : A.1.IsFinitePresentation := A.2.isFinitePresentation
  letI : B.1.IsFinitePresentation := B.2.isFinitePresentation
  letI : C.1.IsFinitePresentation := C.2.isFinitePresentation
  let T : ShortComplex Y.Modules := ShortComplex.mk a b zero
  let P := T.map (Scheme.Modules.pullback f)
  exact ⟨P.f, P.g, P.zero,
    pullback_map_shortExact_global f T hshort⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.flatPullbackK0_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem flatPullbackK0_classOf
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [Flat f]
    (E : Y.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y E) :
    flatPullbackK0 f (k0ClassOf Y E hE) =
      k0ClassOf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E)
        (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global f E hE)
proof:
:= by
  exact ExactGrothendieck.map_classOf (flatPullbackK0Object f)
    (flatPullbackK0Object_exact f) ⟨E, hE⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.flatPullbackK0_id
statement:
theorem flatPullbackK0_id (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    flatPullbackK0 (𝟙 X) = AddMonoidHom.id (K0 X)
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
  rintro ⟨E, hE⟩
  change flatPullbackK0 (𝟙 X) (k0ClassOf X E hE) =
    k0ClassOf X E hE
  rw [flatPullbackK0_classOf]
  exact k0ClassOf_iso X _ hE ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackId X).app E)

name: SchemeKTheory.flatPullbackK0_comp
statement:
theorem flatPullbackK0_comp
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    [Flat f] [Flat g] :
    (flatPullbackK0 f).comp (flatPullbackK0 g) =
      flatPullbackK0 (f ≫ g)
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
  rintro ⟨E, hE⟩
  change flatPullbackK0 f
      (flatPullbackK0 g (k0ClassOf Z E hE)) =
    flatPullbackK0 (f ≫ g) (k0ClassOf Z E hE)
  rw [flatPullbackK0_classOf,
    flatPullbackK0_classOf, flatPullbackK0_classOf]
  exact k0ClassOf_iso X _ _
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f g).app E)

name: SchemeKTheory.flatPullbackK0_one
statement:
theorem flatPullbackK0_one
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [Flat f] :
    flatPullbackK0 f 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  let hY := tensorUnitSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree Y
  let hX := tensorUnitSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree X
  change flatPullbackK0 f (k0ClassOf Y (tensorUnitSheaf Y) hY) =
    k0ClassOf X (tensorUnitSheaf X) hX
  rw [flatPullbackK0_classOf]
  let e :
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (tensorUnitSheaf Y) ≅
        tensorUnitSheaf X :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).mapIso
        (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
          (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)).symm ≪≫
      AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f PUnit ≪≫
      SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)
  exact k0ClassOf_iso X _ hX e

name: PerfectRepRestrictBG2.pdUp_of_pdKer
statement: theorem pdUp_of_pdKer {n : ℕ} (hk : PdKer S n) : PdUp S n
proof:
:= by
  intro K E M i g hs hE hK hM hpK Z hZ
  obtain ⟨K', E', i', g', hs', hE', hK', hZ'⟩ := hZ
  have hQV : S.Q (pullback g g') := S.Q_pullback g g' (S.P_Q hE) (S.P_Q hE') hM
  have s1 := hs.pullbackL g'
  have s2 := hs'.pullbackR g
  have hpV : PdLE S n (pullback g g') := pdLE_ext S s1 hE' hK hQV hpK
  exact hk s2 hE hK' hQV hpV Z hZ'

name: PerfectRepRestrictBG2.pdKer_zero
statement: theorem pdKer_zero : PdKer S 0
proof:
:= by
  intro A B D a b hs hD hA _ hB
  rw [pdLE_zero_iff] at hB ⊢
  exact S.P_ker hs hB hD hA

name: PerfectRepRestrictBG2.pdKer_succ
statement: theorem pdKer_succ {m : ℕ} (hu : PdUp S m) : PdKer S (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro A B D a b hab hD hQA hQB hpB
  obtain ⟨E2, q, hE2, hq⟩ := S.cover hQB
  haveI := hq
  have hs2 := SES.kernel_of_epi q
  have hQK2 : S.Q (kernel q) := S.Q_kernel q (S.P_Q hE2) hQB
  have hpK2 : PdLE S m (kernel q) := hpB.ker S hs2 hE2 hQK2
  have hsN := hs2.pullbackL a
  have hsC := hab.comp q
  have hPC : S.P (pullback a q) :=
    S.P_ker hsC hE2 hD (S.Q_pullback a q hQA (S.P_Q hE2) hQB)
  have hPN : S.P (pullback q a) := S.P_iso (pullbackSymmetry a q) hPC
  exact hu hsN hPN hQK2 hQA hpK2

name: PerfectRepRestrictBG2.pdKer_all
statement:
theorem pdKer_all : ∀ n, PdKer S n
  | 0 => pdKer_zero S
  | n + 1 => pdKer_succ S (pdUp_of_pdKer S (pdKer_all n))

name: PerfectRepRestrictBG2.pdLE_of_rep
statement:
theorem pdLE_of_rep : ∀ (n : ℕ) {M : C} {x : K0 S}, S.Q M → Rep S n M x → PdLE S n M
  | 0, M, _, _, ⟨h, _⟩ => pdLE_of_P S 0 M h
  | n + 1, _, _, hM, ⟨_, _, _, _, _, hs, hE, hK, hy, _⟩ =>
    pdUp_of_pdKer S (pdKer_all S n) hs hE hK hM (pdLE_of_rep n hK hy)

                                                                         

variable {C' : Type u'} [Category.{v'} C'] [Abelian C'] (S' : Setup C')

name: PerfectRepRestrictBG2.rep_map
statement:
theorem rep_map (Φ : C ⥤ C') (φ : K0 S →+ K0 S') (R : C → Prop)
    (hφ : ∀ E (hE : S.P E) (hE' : S'.P (Φ.obj E)), φ (cls S E hE) = cls S' (Φ.obj E) hE')
    (hP : ∀ E, S.P E → S'.P (Φ.obj E)) (hQ : ∀ M, S.Q M → S'.Q (Φ.obj M))
    (hRP : ∀ E, S.P E → R E)
    (hRsub : ∀ {A B D : C} {i : A ⟶ B} {g : B ⟶ D}, SES i g → R B → R A)
    (hses : ∀ {A B D : C} {i : A ⟶ B} {g : B ⟶ D}, SES i g → S.P B → S.Q A → S.Q D → R D →
      SES (Φ.map i) (Φ.map g)) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) {M : C} {x : K0 S}, S.Q M → R M → Rep S n M x → Rep S' n (Φ.obj M) (φ x)
  | 0, M, _, _, _, ⟨h, hx⟩ => ⟨hP M h, by rw [hx]; exact hφ M h _⟩
  | n + 1, M, _, hM, hR, ⟨K, E, i, g, y, hs, hE, hK, hy, hx⟩ =>
    ⟨Φ.obj K, Φ.obj E, Φ.map i, Φ.map g, φ y, hses hs hE hK hM hR, hP E hE, hQ K hK,
      rep_map Φ φ R hφ hP hQ hRP hRsub hses n hK (hRsub hs (hRP E hE)) hy,
      by rw [hx, map_sub, hφ E hE (hP E hE)]⟩

name: PerfectRepRestrictBG2.pdLE_map
statement:
theorem pdLE_map (Φ : C ⥤ C') (φ : K0 S →+ K0 S') (R : C → Prop)
    (hφ : ∀ E (hE : S.P E) (hE' : S'.P (Φ.obj E)), φ (cls S E hE) = cls S' (Φ.obj E) hE')
    (hP : ∀ E, S.P E → S'.P (Φ.obj E)) (hQ : ∀ M, S.Q M → S'.Q (Φ.obj M))
    (hRP : ∀ E, S.P E → R E)
    (hRsub : ∀ {A B D : C} {i : A ⟶ B} {g : B ⟶ D}, SES i g → R B → R A)
    (hses : ∀ {A B D : C} {i : A ⟶ B} {g : B ⟶ D}, SES i g → S.P B → S.Q A → S.Q D → R D →
      SES (Φ.map i) (Φ.map g))
    {d : ℕ} {M : C} (hQM : S.Q M) (hRM : R M) (h : PdLE S d M) : PdLE S' d (Φ.obj M)
proof:
:=
  pdLE_of_rep S' d (hQ M hQM)
    (rep_map S S' Φ φ R hφ hP hQ hRP hRsub hses d hQM hRM (PerfectRepG2.rep_repK0 S M hQM h))

name: PerfectRepRestrictBG2.repK0_map
statement:
theorem repK0_map (Φ : C ⥤ C') (φ : K0 S →+ K0 S') (R : C → Prop)
    (hφ : ∀ E (hE : S.P E) (hE' : S'.P (Φ.obj E)), φ (cls S E hE) = cls S' (Φ.obj E) hE')
    (hP : ∀ E, S.P E → S'.P (Φ.obj E)) (hQ : ∀ M, S.Q M → S'.Q (Φ.obj M))
    (hRP : ∀ E, S.P E → R E)
    (hRsub : ∀ {A B D : C} {i : A ⟶ B} {g : B ⟶ D}, SES i g → R B → R A)
    (hses : ∀ {A B D : C} {i : A ⟶ B} {g : B ⟶ D}, SES i g → S.P B → S.Q A → S.Q D → R D →
      SES (Φ.map i) (Φ.map g))
    {d d' : ℕ} {M : C} (hQM : S.Q M) (hRM : R M) (h : PdLE S d M)
    (hQ' : S'.Q (Φ.obj M)) (h' : PdLE S' d' (Φ.obj M)) :
    φ (PerfectRepG2.repK0 S M hQM h) = PerfectRepG2.repK0 S' (Φ.obj M) hQ' h'
proof:
:=
  (PerfectRepG2.repK0_eq_of_rep S' hQ' h'
    (rep_map S S' Φ φ R hφ hP hQ hRP hRsub hses d hQM hRM (PerfectRepG2.rep_repK0 S M hQM h))).symm

name: PerfectRepRestrictBG2.mono_cokernel_map
statement:
theorem mono_cokernel_map {K' E' M' K E M : C} (f' : K' ⟶ E') (g' : E' ⟶ M') (z' : f' ≫ g' = 0)
    (f : K ⟶ E) (g : E ⟶ M) (z : f ≫ g = 0) (a : K' ⟶ K) (b : E' ⟶ E) (c : M' ⟶ M)
    (w1 : a ≫ f = f' ≫ b) (w2 : b ≫ g = g' ≫ c)
    (hex : (ShortComplex.mk f' g' z').Exact) [Mono f] [Mono c] :
    Mono (cokernel.map a b f' f w1)
proof:
:= by
  apply Preadditive.mono_of_cancel_zero
  intro A y hy
  obtain ⟨A1, π1, hπ1, k, hk⟩ := surjective_up_to_refinements_of_epi (cokernel.π a) y
  have hkf : (k ≫ f) ≫ cokernel.π b = 0 := by
    have e1 : cokernel.π a ≫ cokernel.map a b f' f w1 = f ≫ cokernel.π b := by
      simp [cokernel.map]
    rw [Category.assoc, ← e1, ← Category.assoc, ← hk, Category.assoc, hy, comp_zero]
  obtain ⟨A2, π2, hπ2, e', he'⟩ :=
    (ShortComplex.exact_cokernel b).exact_up_to_refinements (k ≫ f) hkf
  have he'0 : e' ≫ g' = 0 := by
    rw [← cancel_mono c, Category.assoc, ← w2, ← Category.assoc]
    rw [← he', zero_comp, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, z, comp_zero, comp_zero]
  obtain ⟨A3, π3, hπ3, k', hk'⟩ := hex.exact_up_to_refinements e' he'0
  have hkk : π3 ≫ π2 ≫ k = k' ≫ a := by
    rw [← cancel_mono f]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [w1]
    have h1 : π2 ≫ k ≫ f = e' ≫ b := he'
    rw [h1, ← Category.assoc, hk', Category.assoc]
  haveI := hπ1; haveI := hπ2; haveI := hπ3
  rw [← cancel_epi (π3 ≫ π2 ≫ π1), comp_zero]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [hk, ← Category.assoc π2, ← Category.assoc π3, hkk, Category.assoc, cokernel.condition,
    comp_zero]

name: PerfectRepRestrictBG2.Sch.isCoherentLike_pullback
statement:
theorem isCoherentLike_pullback {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) {F : Y.Modules}
    (hF : IsCoherentLike Y F) : IsCoherentLike X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj F)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : F.IsFinitePresentation := hF
  exact pullback_isFinitePresentation_global f F

name: PerfectRepRestrictBG2.Sch.flat_ses
statement:
theorem flat_ses {A B D : Y.Modules} {i : A ⟶ B} {g : B ⟶ D}
    (hs : AbelianResolutionF15.SES i g) (hA : IsCoherentLike Y A) (hB : IsCoherentLike Y B)
    (hD : IsCoherentLike Y D) :
    AbelianResolutionF15.SES ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map i)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map g)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : A.IsFinitePresentation := hA
  haveI : B.IsFinitePresentation := hB
  haveI : D.IsFinitePresentation := hD
  let T : ShortComplex Y.Modules := ShortComplex.mk i g hs.zero
  haveI : T.X₁.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstanceAs A.IsQuasicoherent
  haveI : T.X₂.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstanceAs B.IsQuasicoherent
  haveI : T.X₃.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstanceAs D.IsQuasicoherent
  have h := pullback_map_shortExact_global f T hs.exact
  exact ⟨(T.map (Scheme.Modules.pullback f)).zero, h⟩

name: PerfectRepRestrictBG2.Sch.pdLE_pullback_of_flat
statement:
theorem pdLE_pullback_of_flat {d : ℕ} {F : Y.Modules} (hF : IsCoherentLike Y F)
    (hd : PdLE hY d F) : PdLE hX d ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj F)
proof:
:=
  PerfectRepRestrictBG2.pdLE_map (setup Y hY) (setup X hX) (Scheme.Modules.pullback f)
    (pullbackK0 f) (fun _ => True)
    (fun E hE _ => pullbackK0_classOf f E hE)
    (fun E hE => pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global f E hE)
    (fun _ hM => isCoherentLike_pullback f hM) (fun _ _ => trivial) (fun _ _ => trivial)
    (fun hs hB hA hD _ => flat_ses f hs hA (hB.isFinitePresentation) hD) hF trivial hd

name: PerfectRepRestrictBG2.Sch.pullbackK0_repK0_of_flat
statement:
theorem pullbackK0_repK0_of_flat {d d' : ℕ} (F : Y.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike Y F)
    (hd : PdLE hY d F) (hF' : IsCoherentLike X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj F))
    (hd' : PdLE hX d' ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj F)) :
    pullbackK0 f (repK0 hY F hF hd) = repK0 hX ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj F) hF' hd'
proof:
:=
  PerfectRepRestrictBG2.repK0_map (setup Y hY) (setup X hX) (Scheme.Modules.pullback f)
    (pullbackK0 f) (fun _ => True)
    (fun E hE _ => pullbackK0_classOf f E hE)
    (fun E hE => pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global f E hE)
    (fun _ hM => isCoherentLike_pullback f hM) (fun _ _ => trivial) (fun _ _ => trivial)
    (fun hs hB hA hD _ => flat_ses f hs hA (hB.isFinitePresentation) hD) hF trivial hd hF' hd'

name: PerfectRepRestrictBG2.Sch.pullbackK0_repK0_eq_zero_of_flat
statement:
theorem pullbackK0_repK0_eq_zero_of_flat {d : ℕ} (F : Y.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike Y F)
    (hd : PdLE hY d F) (hZ : IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj F)) :
    pullbackK0 f (repK0 hY F hF hd) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [pullbackK0_repK0_of_flat hX hY f F hF hd (isCoherentLike_pullback f hF)
    (pdLE_pullback_of_flat hX hY f hF hd)]
  exact repK0_zero hX hZ _ _

name: PerfectRepRestrictBG2.Sch.pullbackK0_repK0_of_isOpenImmersion
statement:
theorem pullbackK0_repK0_of_isOpenImmersion (j : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j] {d d' : ℕ}
    (F : Y.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike Y F) (hd : PdLE hY d F)
    (hF' : IsCoherentLike X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj F))
    (hd' : PdLE hX d' ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj F)) :
    pullbackK0 j (repK0 hY F hF hd) = repK0 hX ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj F) hF' hd'
proof:
:=
  pullbackK0_repK0_of_flat hX hY j F hF hd hF' hd'

name: PerfectRepRestrictBG2.Sch.pullback_shortExact_cartier
statement:
theorem pullback_shortExact_cartier (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1) (T : ShortComplex Y.Modules)
    (hT : T.ShortExact) (h1 : IsCoherentLike Y T.X₁) (h2 : IsCoherentLike Y T.X₂)
    (hm : Mono (ap TΣ sΣ T.X₃)) :
    (T.map (Scheme.Modules.pullback ιΣ)).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  have hline : IsLocalLineFrame L := isLocalLineFrame_of_hasConstantRank_one hL
  have hΛ1 : HasConstantRank Y (lineBundleDual Y L) 1 := lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank L hL
  have hΛ : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y (lineBundleDual Y L) := hΛ1.isFiniteLocallyFree
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits Y _ hΛ
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits Y _ hΛ
  have hI := locallyPrincipal_sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ hline
  have hB := ar7Bridge σ hline
  let adj := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction ιΣ
  haveI : PreservesColimitsOfSize.{0, 0} (Scheme.Modules.pullback ιΣ) :=
    adj.leftAdjoint_preservesColimits
  haveI := hT.mono_f
  haveI := hT.epi_g
  have ex : (T.map (Scheme.Modules.pullback ιΣ)).Exact :=
    hT.exact.map_of_epi_of_preservesCokernel _ inferInstance inferInstance
  
  have hπ : ∀ X : Y.Modules,
      IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ιΣ).map (cokernel.π (ap TΣ sΣ X))) := fun X =>
    ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR8.isIso_map_cokernel_π_of_map_eq_zero _ _
      (map_ap_eq_zero_of_adj adj X (hB.killed_of_idealKills _ (idealKills_pushforward _ _)))
  
  have hunit : ∀ X : Y.Modules, IsCoherentLike Y X →
      IsIso (ProjectionFormula.adjUnit ιΣ (cokernel (ap TΣ sΣ X))) := fun X hX => by
    have hc : IsCoherentLike Y (cokernel (ap TΣ sΣ X)) :=
      (kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike (Y := Y)).cokernel _
        (tensorSheaf_isCoherentLike Y _ _ hΛ hX) hX
    haveI : (cokernel (ap TΣ sΣ X)).IsFinitePresentation := hc
    exact isIso_adjUnit_of_killed hI _
      (hB.idealKills_of_killed _ hc (app_cokernel_eq_zero (T := TΣ) (σ := sΣ) X))
  
  have w1 : ap TΣ sΣ T.X₁ ≫ T.f = TΣ.map T.f ≫ ap TΣ sΣ T.X₂ := (naturality' TΣ sΣ T.f).symm
  have w2 : ap TΣ sΣ T.X₂ ≫ T.g = TΣ.map T.g ≫ ap TΣ sΣ T.X₃ := (naturality' TΣ sΣ T.g).symm
  have hTex : (T.map TΣ).ShortExact := hT.map_of_exact TΣ
  have hh : Mono (cokernel.map (ap TΣ sΣ T.X₁) (ap TΣ sΣ T.X₂) (TΣ.map T.f) T.f w1) :=
    mono_cokernel_map (TΣ.map T.f) (TΣ.map T.g) (T.map TΣ).zero T.f T.g T.zero _ _ _ w1 w2
      hTex.exact
  let h := cokernel.map (ap TΣ sΣ T.X₁) (ap TΣ sΣ T.X₂) (TΣ.map T.f) T.f w1
  haveI := hunit T.X₁ h1
  haveI := hunit T.X₂ h2
  have hn := ProjectionFormula.adjUnit_naturality ιΣ h
  have hm2 : Mono ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ιΣ).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ιΣ).map h)) := by
    have heq : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward ιΣ).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ιΣ).map h) =
        inv (ProjectionFormula.adjUnit ιΣ _) ≫ h ≫ ProjectionFormula.adjUnit ιΣ _ := by
      rw [hn, IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
    rw [heq]; infer_instance
  haveI : Mono ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ιΣ).map h) :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward ιΣ).mono_of_mono_map hm2
  have hsq : (Scheme.Modules.pullback ιΣ).map T.f ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback ιΣ).map (cokernel.π (ap TΣ sΣ T.X₂)) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback ιΣ).map (cokernel.π (ap TΣ sΣ T.X₁)) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback ιΣ).map h := by
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp]
    congr 1
    simp [h, cokernel.map]
  haveI := hπ T.X₁
  haveI := hπ T.X₂
  have hfm : Mono ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ιΣ).map T.f) := by
    have e : (Scheme.Modules.pullback ιΣ).map T.f =
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ιΣ).map (cokernel.π (ap TΣ sΣ T.X₁)) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback ιΣ).map h) ≫
          inv ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ιΣ).map (cokernel.π (ap TΣ sΣ T.X₂))) := by
      rw [← hsq, Category.assoc, IsIso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
    rw [e]; infer_instance
  exact { exact := ex, mono_f := hfm,
          epi_g := inferInstanceAs (Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ιΣ).map T.g)) }

name: PerfectRepRestrictBG2.Sch.mono_ap_of_mono
statement:
theorem mono_ap_of_mono (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1) {A B : Y.Modules} (i : A ⟶ B) [Mono i]
    (hB : Mono (ap TΣ sΣ B)) : Mono (ap TΣ sΣ A)
proof:
:= by
  have hΛ : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y (lineBundleDual Y L) :=
    (lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank L hL).isFiniteLocallyFree
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits Y _ hΛ
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits Y _ hΛ
  have w := naturality' TΣ sΣ i
  haveI : Mono (TΣ.map i ≫ ap TΣ sΣ B) := mono_comp _ _
  rw [w] at this
  exact mono_of_mono _ i

name: PerfectRepRestrictBG2.Sch.cartier_ses
statement:
theorem cartier_ses (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1) {A B D : Y.Modules} {i : A ⟶ B} {g : B ⟶ D}
    (hs : AbelianResolutionF15.SES i g) (hA : IsCoherentLike Y A) (hB : IsCoherentLike Y B)
    (hm : Mono (ap TΣ sΣ D)) :
    AbelianResolutionF15.SES ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ιΣ).map i)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ιΣ).map g)
proof:
:= by
  let T : ShortComplex Y.Modules := ShortComplex.mk i g hs.zero
  have h := pullback_shortExact_cartier σ hL T hs.exact hA hB hm
  exact ⟨(T.map (Scheme.Modules.pullback ιΣ)).zero, h⟩

name: PerfectRepRestrictBG2.Sch.pdLE_pullback_cartier
statement:
theorem pdLE_pullback_cartier (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1)
    (hbund : ∀ E, IsFiniteLocallyFree Y E → Mono (ap TΣ sΣ E))
    {d : ℕ} {F : Y.Modules} (hF : IsCoherentLike Y F) (hm : Mono (ap TΣ sΣ F))
    (hd : PdLE hY d F) : PdLE hD d ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ιΣ).obj F)
proof:
:=
  PerfectRepRestrictBG2.pdLE_map (setup Y hY) (setup _ hD) (Scheme.Modules.pullback ιΣ)
    (pullbackK0 ιΣ) (fun M => Mono (ap TΣ sΣ M))
    (fun E hE _ => pullbackK0_classOf ιΣ E hE)
    (fun E hE => pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global ιΣ E hE)
    (fun _ hM => isCoherentLike_pullback ιΣ hM) hbund
    (fun {_ _ _ i _} hs hR => by haveI := hs.mono; exact mono_ap_of_mono σ hL i hR)
    (fun hs hB hA _ hR => cartier_ses σ hL hs hA (hB.isFinitePresentation) hR) hF hm hd

name: PerfectRepRestrictBG2.Sch.pullbackK0_repK0_cartier
statement:
theorem pullbackK0_repK0_cartier (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1)
    (hbund : ∀ E, IsFiniteLocallyFree Y E → Mono (ap TΣ sΣ E))
    {d d' : ℕ} (F : Y.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike Y F) (hm : Mono (ap TΣ sΣ F))
    (hd : PdLE hY d F)
    (hF' : IsCoherentLike (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ιΣ).obj F))
    (hd' : PdLE hD d' ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ιΣ).obj F)) :
    pullbackK0 ιΣ (repK0 hY F hF hd) = repK0 hD ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ιΣ).obj F) hF' hd'
proof:
:=
  PerfectRepRestrictBG2.repK0_map (setup Y hY) (setup _ hD) (Scheme.Modules.pullback ιΣ)
    (pullbackK0 ιΣ) (fun M => Mono (ap TΣ sΣ M))
    (fun E hE _ => pullbackK0_classOf ιΣ E hE)
    (fun E hE => pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global ιΣ E hE)
    (fun _ hM => isCoherentLike_pullback ιΣ hM) hbund
    (fun {_ _ _ i _} hs hR => by haveI := hs.mono; exact mono_ap_of_mono σ hL i hR)
    (fun hs hB hA _ hR => cartier_ses σ hL hs hA (hB.isFinitePresentation) hR) hF hm hd hF' hd'

name: PerfectRepRestrictBG2.Sch.pullbackK0_repK0_cartier_of_regular
statement:
theorem pullbackK0_repK0_cartier_of_regular (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1)
    (hreg : SectionIsRegular σ)
    {d d' : ℕ} (F : Y.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike Y F) (hm : Mono (ap TΣ sΣ F))
    (hd : PdLE hY d F)
    (hF' : IsCoherentLike (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ιΣ).obj F))
    (hd' : PdLE hD d' ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ιΣ).obj F)) :
    pullbackK0 ιΣ (repK0 hY F hF hd) = repK0 hD ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ιΣ).obj F) hF' hd'
proof:
:=
  pullbackK0_repK0_cartier σ hY hD hL
    (fun E hE => CIIL3B.hmono_of_sectionIsRegular σ (isLocalLineFrame_of_hasConstantRank_one hL)
      hreg E hE) F hF hm hd hF' hd'

name: SchemeKTheory.resLE_comp_ι_square

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict_hom
statement:
