name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackBaseChangeSquare_unit_compat
statement:
theorem pullbackBaseChangeSquare_unit_compat (M : Y.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback W.ι).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app M) ≫
      (mateEquiv (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f)
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
            (f.resLE W (f ⁻¹ᵁ W) le_rfl))
          (pullbackBaseChangeSquare f W).hom).app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M) =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
          (f.resLE W (f ⁻¹ᵁ W) le_rfl)).unit.app
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback W.ι).obj M) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f.resLE W (f ⁻¹ᵁ W) le_rfl)).map
        ((pullbackBaseChangeSquare f W).hom.app M)
proof:
:=
  unit_mateEquiv (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f)
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (f.resLE W (f ⁻¹ᵁ W) le_rfl))
    (pullbackBaseChangeSquare f W).hom M

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackBaseChangeSquare_counit_compat
statement:
theorem pullbackBaseChangeSquare_counit_compat (d : X.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (f.resLE W (f ⁻¹ᵁ W) le_rfl)).map
        ((mateEquiv (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f)
            (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
              (f.resLE W (f ⁻¹ᵁ W) le_rfl))
            (pullbackBaseChangeSquare f W).hom).app d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
        (f.resLE W (f ⁻¹ᵁ W) le_rfl)).counit.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj d) =
    (pullbackBaseChangeSquare f W).hom.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj d) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).counit.app d)
proof:
:=
  mateEquiv_counit (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f)
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (f.resLE W (f ⁻¹ᵁ W) le_rfl))
    (pullbackBaseChangeSquare f W).hom d

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackBaseChangeSquare_tensoredUnit_compat
statement:
theorem pullbackBaseChangeSquare_tensoredUnit_compat (M N : Y.Modules) :
    tensorSheafMap W
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback W.ι).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app M))
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback W.ι).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app N)) ≫
      tensorSheafMap W
        ((mateEquiv (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f)
            (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
              (f.resLE W (f ⁻¹ᵁ W) le_rfl))
            (pullbackBaseChangeSquare f W).hom).app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M))
        ((mateEquiv (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f)
            (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
              (f.resLE W (f ⁻¹ᵁ W) le_rfl))
            (pullbackBaseChangeSquare f W).hom).app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj N)) =
    tensorSheafMap W
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
              (f.resLE W (f ⁻¹ᵁ W) le_rfl)).unit.app
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback W.ι).obj M))
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
              (f.resLE W (f ⁻¹ᵁ W) le_rfl)).unit.app
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback W.ι).obj N)) ≫
      tensorSheafMap W
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f.resLE W (f ⁻¹ᵁ W) le_rfl)).map
          ((pullbackBaseChangeSquare f W).hom.app M))
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (f.resLE W (f ⁻¹ᵁ W) le_rfl)).map
          ((pullbackBaseChangeSquare f W).hom.app N))
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorSheafMap_comp, tensorSheafMap_comp]
  rw [pullbackBaseChangeSquare_unit_compat f W M,
    pullbackBaseChangeSquare_unit_compat f W N]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctor_map_isIso_iff_pullback_map_isIso
statement:
theorem restrictFunctor_map_isIso_iff_pullback_map_isIso
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion q] {A B : Y.Modules} (φ : A ⟶ B) :
    IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map φ) ↔
      IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map φ)
proof:
:= by
  have hnat := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).hom.naturality φ
  constructor
  · intro h
    have heq : (Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map φ =
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).inv.app A ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map φ ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).hom.app B := by
      simp only [hnat, Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc]
    rw [heq]; infer_instance
  · intro h
    have heq : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map φ =
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).hom.app A ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map φ) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).inv.app B := by
      simp only [Category.assoc, ← hnat, Iso.hom_inv_id_app, Category.comp_id]
    rw [heq]; infer_instance

name: SchemeKTheory.over_isIso_iff_restrictFunctor_map_isIso
statement:
theorem over_isIso_iff_restrictFunctor_map_isIso
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.Opens) {A B : X.Modules} (φ : A ⟶ B) :
    IsIso (φ.over U) ↔ IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map φ)
proof:
:= by
  have hnat := (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.naturality φ
  letI : ((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor).IsEquivalence :=
    Equivalence.isEquivalence_functor (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U)
  have key : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U ⋙
        (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor).map φ =
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map (φ.over U) := rfl
  rw [key] at hnat
  constructor
  · intro h
    haveI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map (φ.over U)) :=
      Functor.map_isIso _ _
    have heq : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map φ =
        inv ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.app A) ≫
          ((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map (φ.over U) ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.app B) := by
      rw [hnat, IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
    rw [heq]
    infer_instance
  · intro h
    haveI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map (φ.over U)) := by
      have heq2 : (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map (φ.over U) =
          ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.app A ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map φ) ≫
            inv ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.app B) := by
        rw [← hnat]
        rw [Category.assoc, IsIso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
      rw [heq2]
      infer_instance
    exact CategoryTheory.isIso_of_reflects_iso (φ.over U) (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.G0PBChain.Γ_injective
statement:
theorem G0PBChain.Γ_injective (S : ShortComplex (space R n).Modules)
    (hF : S.X₃.IsFinitePresentation)
    (eP : S.X₂ ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj S.X₃))
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).map S.g)).hom) :
    Function.Injective ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).map S.g)).hom
proof:
:= by
  let G := S.X₃
  let V := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj G
  let P := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj V
  haveI : G.IsFinitePresentation := hF
  haveI : Module.Finite R Γ(G, ⊤) :=
    PushforwardFree.globalSections_finite R n G (pushforward_isFinitePresentation R n G)
  haveI : G.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  haveI := isQuasicoherent_pushforward_toSpec R n G
  let Qm : ModuleCat.{u} R := (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj V
  haveI : Module.Finite R Qm := Module.Finite.equiv (PushforwardFree.globalSectionsEquiv R n G)
  let c := (tilde.adjunction (R := CommRingCat.of R)).counit.app V
  have hc : IsIso c := Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent V
  let e1 : projectiveBaseModuleTilde R Qm ≅ V := @asIso _ _ _ _ c hc
  let e2 : P ≅ projectiveBaseModulePullback R n Qm :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).mapIso e1.symm
  let e3 : moduleTwist R n P ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≅
      projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n Qm ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) :=
    tensorSheafSymmetry (space R n) P _ ≪≫ tensorSheafMapIso (space R n) (Iso.refl _) e2
  let eBP : projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Qm) ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≅ S.X₂ :=
    e3.symm ≪≫ Quillen.twistCastZeroIso R n P ≪≫ eP.symm
  let A := (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj S.X₂)
  let eTot : (R × Qm) ≃ₗ[R] R × A :=
    Quillen.sqZeroSplitEquiv R Qm n ≪≫ₗ (LinearEquiv.refl R R).prodCongr
      (coordinateCechModuleSheafHZeroLinearEquiv R n _ ≪≫ₗ
        projectiveModuleHZeroLinearEquivSections R n _ ≪≫ₗ Quillen.secEquiv R n eBP ≪≫ₗ
        PushforwardFree.globalSectionsEquiv R n S.X₂)
  let f : A →ₗ[R] Qm := ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).map S.g)).hom
  let φ : (R × Qm) →ₗ[R] (R × Qm) := (LinearMap.prodMap LinearMap.id f) ∘ₗ eTot.toLinearMap
  have hφ : Function.Surjective φ := by
    rintro ⟨a, b⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hsurj b
    refine ⟨eTot.symm (a, x), ?_⟩
    simp [φ, f, hx]
  have hinj := OrzechProperty.injective_of_surjective_endomorphism φ hφ
  intro x y hxy
  have hxy' : f x = f y := hxy
  have h1 : eTot.symm (0, x) = eTot.symm (0, y) := hinj (by simp [φ, hxy'])
  exact congrArg Prod.snd (eTot.symm.injective h1)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.G0PBChain.R0_isZero
statement:
theorem G0PBChain.R0_isZero (S : ShortComplex (space R n).Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (hZ : S.X₁.IsFinitePresentation) (hF : S.X₃.IsFinitePresentation)
    (eP : S.X₂ ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj S.X₃))
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).map S.g)).hom) :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) S.X₁ 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hinj := G0PBChain.Γ_injective R n S hF eP hsurj
  haveI : S.X₁.IsFinitePresentation := hZ
  haveI : S.X₁.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  haveI := isQuasicoherent_pushforward_toSpec R n S.X₁
  haveI : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).IsRightAdjoint :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (toSpec R n)).isRightAdjoint
  haveI : (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).IsRightAdjoint :=
    (tilde.adjunction (R := CommRingCat.of R)).isRightAdjoint
  haveI : (tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of R)).IsLeftAdjoint :=
    (tilde.adjunction (R := CommRingCat.of R)).isLeftAdjoint
  haveI : Mono S.f := hS.mono_f
  let ι := (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).map S.f)
  have hι : Function.Injective ι.hom := (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective ι).1 inferInstance
  have hcomp : ι ≫ (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).map S.g) = 0 := by
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp, S.zero, Functor.map_zero, Functor.map_zero]
  have h0 : ∀ s, ι.hom s = 0 := fun s ↦ hinj (by
    have := congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ.hom s) hcomp
    simp only [ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply, ModuleCat.hom_zero,
      LinearMap.zero_apply] at this
    rw [this, map_zero])
  haveI : Subsingleton ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj S.X₁)) :=
    ⟨fun s t ↦ hι ((h0 s).trans (h0 t).symm)⟩
  have hΓ := ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj S.X₁))
  have hT := (tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of R)).map_isZero hΓ
  let c := (tilde.adjunction (R := CommRingCat.of R)).counit.app
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj S.X₁)
  have hc : IsIso c := Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj S.X₁)
  have hV : IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj S.X₁) :=
    hT.of_iso (@asIso _ _ _ _ c hc).symm
  exact hV.of_iso (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationZeroIso (toSpec R n) _)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.G0PBChain.kernel_vanishing
statement:
theorem G0PBChain.kernel_vanishing (S : ShortComplex (space R n).Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (hF : S.X₃.IsFinitePresentation) (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n S.X₃ 0)
    (eP : S.X₂ ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj S.X₃))
    (hR0 : Epi ((affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor (toSpec R n) 0).map S.g))
    (i : ℕ) :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n)
      (moduleTwist R n S.X₁ (-(i : ℤ))) (i + 1))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : S.X₃.IsFinitePresentation := hF
  rcases i with _ | k
  · have hw : (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor (toSpec R n) 0).map S.g ≫
        affineLocalConnectingSheafificationMap (toSpec R n) S hS 0 = 0 :=
      (affineLocalLongExactSheafification₂ (toSpec R n) S hS 0).zero
    have hδ : affineLocalConnectingSheafificationMap (toSpec R n) S hS 0 = 0 := by
      exact hR0.left_cancellation _ _ (hw.trans comp_zero.symm)
    have hP1 : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) S.X₂ (0 + 1)) :=
      Quillen.R_iso R n (Quillen.twistZeroIso R n _ ≪≫ eP.symm) (0 + 1)
        (CohQ.pullback_vanishing R n S.X₃ 0 0 (Or.inl (by omega)))
    have h1 : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) S.X₁ (0 + 1)) :=
      (affineLocalLongExactSheafification₃_exact (toSpec R n) S hS 0).isZero_of_both_zeros
        hδ (hP1.eq_of_tgt _ _)
    rw [Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero]
    exact Quillen.R_iso R n (Quillen.twistZeroIso R n _).symm _ h1
  · let N := projectiveTwistingSheaf R n (-((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))
    have hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) N := projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n _
    haveI := tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits (space R n) N hN
    haveI := tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits (space R n) N hN
    let S' := S.map (tensorSheafRightFunctor (space R n) N)
    have hS' : S'.ShortExact := hS.map_of_exact _
    have h1 := hreg (k + 1) (by omega)
    rw [zero_sub] at h1
    have h1' : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) S'.X₃ (k + 1)) :=
      h1
    have h3 : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) S'.X₂
        (k + 1 + 1)) :=
      Quillen.R_iso R n (tensorSheafMapIso (space R n) eP.symm (Iso.refl N)) (k + 1 + 1)
        (CohQ.pullback_vanishing R n S.X₃ (k + 1) (-((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (by omega))
    exact (affineLocalLongExactSheafification₃_exact (toSpec R n) S' hS'
      (k + 1)).isZero_of_both_zeros (h1'.eq_of_src _ _) (h3.eq_of_tgt _ _)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.G0PBChain.step
statement:
theorem G0PBChain.step (S : ShortComplex (space R n).Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (hF : S.X₃.IsFinitePresentation)
    (eP : S.X₂ ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj S.X₃))
    (q : ℕ) (hq : q + 1 ≤ n)
    (h : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n)
      (moduleTwist R n S.X₃ (-((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) q)) :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n)
      (moduleTwist R n S.X₁ (-((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) (q + 1))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : S.X₃.IsFinitePresentation := hF
  let N := projectiveTwistingSheaf R n (-((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))
  have hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) N := projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n _
  haveI := tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits (space R n) N hN
  haveI := tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits (space R n) N hN
  let S' := S.map (tensorSheafRightFunctor (space R n) N)
  have hS' : S'.ShortExact := hS.map_of_exact _
  have h1' : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) S'.X₃ q) := h
  have h3 : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) S'.X₂ (q + 1)) :=
    Quillen.R_iso R n (tensorSheafMapIso (space R n) eP.symm (Iso.refl N)) (q + 1)
      (CohQ.pullback_vanishing R n S.X₃ q (-((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (Or.inl (by omega)))
  exact (affineLocalLongExactSheafification₃_exact (toSpec R n) S' hS' q).isZero_of_both_zeros
    (h1'.eq_of_src _ _) (h3.eq_of_tgt _ _)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.G0PBChain.vanishing
statement:
theorem G0PBChain.vanishing (Sk : ℕ → ShortComplex (space R n).Modules)
    (hS : ∀ k, (Sk k).ShortExact) (h1 : ∀ k, (Sk k).X₁.IsFinitePresentation)
    (h3 : ∀ k, (Sk k).X₃.IsFinitePresentation)
    (eP : ∀ k, (Sk k).X₂ ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj (Sk k).X₃))
    (hsurj : ∀ k, Function.Surjective ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).map (Sk k).g)).hom)
    (link : ∀ k, (Sk (k + 1)).X₃ ≅ moduleTwist R n (Sk k).X₁ 1) (k : ℕ) :
    ∀ q, q ≤ k → IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n)
      (moduleTwist R n (Sk k).X₁ (-(q : ℤ))) q)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : ∀ j, IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n)
      (moduleTwist R n (Sk j).X₁ (-((0 : ℕ) : ℤ))) 0) := fun j ↦
    Quillen.R_iso R n (Quillen.twistNegZeroIso R n _).symm 0
      (G0PBChain.R0_isZero R n (Sk j) (hS j) (h1 j) (h3 j) (eP j) (hsurj j))
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro q hq
    obtain rfl : q = 0 := by omega
    exact h0 0
  | succ k ih =>
    intro q hq
    rcases q with _ | q
    · exact h0 (k + 1)
    · by_cases hqn : q + 1 ≤ n
      · refine G0PBChain.step R n (Sk (k + 1)) (hS _) (h3 _) (eP _) q hqn ?_
        have e := moduleTwistTwistIso R n (Sk k).X₁ 1 (-((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (-(q : ℤ))
          (by push_cast; ring)
        have e' : moduleTwist R n (Sk (k + 1)).X₃ (-((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ≅
            moduleTwist R n (Sk k).X₁ (-(q : ℤ)) :=
          tensorSheafMapIso (space R n) (link k) (Iso.refl _) ≪≫ e
        exact Quillen.R_iso R n e'.symm q (ih q (by omega))
      · haveI := h1 (k + 1)
        haveI := CohQ.moduleTwist_isFinitePresentation R n (Sk (k + 1)).X₁ (-((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))
        exact CohQ.dimension R n _ q (by omega)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.G0PBChain.isZero
statement:
theorem G0PBChain.isZero (Sk : ℕ → ShortComplex (space R n).Modules)
    (hS : ∀ k, (Sk k).ShortExact) (h1 : ∀ k, (Sk k).X₁.IsFinitePresentation)
    (h3 : ∀ k, (Sk k).X₃.IsFinitePresentation)
    (eP : ∀ k, (Sk k).X₂ ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj (Sk k).X₃))
    (hsurj : ∀ k, Function.Surjective ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).map (Sk k).g)).hom)
    (link : ∀ k, (Sk (k + 1)).X₃ ≅ moduleTwist R n (Sk k).X₁ 1) :
    IsZero (Sk n).X₁
proof:
:= by
  haveI := h1 n
  have hregZ : IsMumfordRegular R n (Sk n).X₁ 0 := by
    intro q hq
    rw [zero_sub]
    by_cases hqn : q ≤ n
    · exact G0PBChain.vanishing R n Sk hS h1 h3 eP hsurj link n q hqn
    · obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ : ∃ p, q = p + 1 := ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩
      haveI := CohQ.moduleTwist_isFinitePresentation R n (Sk n).X₁ (-((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))
      exact CohQ.dimension R n _ p (by omega)
  exact CohQ.isZero_of_regular R n _ hregZ
    (G0PBChain.R0_isZero R n (Sk n) (hS n) (h1 n) (h3 n) (eP n) (hsurj n))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.G0PBChain.isZero_of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem G0PBChain.isZero_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton R] (G : (space R n).Modules)
    [G.IsFinitePresentation] (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n G 0) : IsZero G
proof:
:= by
  refine CohQ.isZero_of_regular R n G hreg ?_
  haveI : G.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  haveI := isQuasicoherent_pushforward_toSpec R n G
  haveI : (tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of R)).IsLeftAdjoint :=
    (tilde.adjunction (R := CommRingCat.of R)).isLeftAdjoint
  haveI : Subsingleton ↑(CommRingCat.of R) := inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton R)
  haveI : Subsingleton ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj G)) :=
    Module.subsingleton (CommRingCat.of R) _
  have hΓ := ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj G))
  have hT := (tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of R)).map_isZero hΓ
  let c := (tilde.adjunction (R := CommRingCat.of R)).counit.app
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj G)
  have hc : IsIso c := Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj G)
  have hV : IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj G) :=
    hT.of_iso (@asIso _ _ _ _ c hc).symm
  exact hV.of_iso (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationZeroIso (toSpec R n) _)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.G0PBChain.baseTwist_higher_isZero
statement:
theorem G0PBChain.baseTwist_higher_isZero (W : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Modules)
    [W.IsFinitePresentation] (p : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (hd : -(n : ℤ) ≤ d) :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n)
      (moduleTwist R n ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj W) d) (p + 1))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Module.FinitePresentation R ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj W) :=
    moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation W
  exact Quillen.R_iso R n (G0PBChain.baseTwistIso R n W d).symm (p + 1)
    (Quillen.baseModule_vanishing R n _ p d hd)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.G0PBChain.baseTwist_push_isZero
statement:
theorem G0PBChain.baseTwist_push_isZero (W : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Modules)
    [W.IsFinitePresentation] (hn : 0 < n) (d : ℤ) (hd : d < 0) :
    IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj
      (moduleTwist R n ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj W) d))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Module.FinitePresentation R ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj W) :=
    moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation W
  have h := EulerIndependence.baseModule_higher_zero_isZero R
    ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj W) n hn d hd
  have h' : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n)
      (moduleTwist R n ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj W) d) 0) :=
    Quillen.R_iso R n (G0PBChain.baseTwistIso R n W d).symm 0 h
  exact h'.of_iso (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationZeroIso (toSpec R n) _).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.G0PBChain.push_isZero_of_subsingleton
statement:

      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj F)) :=

  exact K0Basis.pushforward_isZero_of_subsingleton_sections R n F

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PB.isZero_of_chart_coh
statement:
theorem isZero_of_chart_coh [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    (G : C.scheme.Modules) [G.IsFinitePresentation] (k : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ (i : C.I) (n : ℕ) (e : C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1)),
      IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n)
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e)).obj G) k)) :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification C.toBase G k)
proof:
:= by
  choose nr er using BundleRegularity.hrank C hpos
  let B : Set X.Opens := {V | ∃ i, ∃ g : Γ(X, C.U i), X.basicOpen g = V}
  have hB : TopologicalSpace.Opens.IsBasis B := by
    rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd]
    intro W x hx
    have hx' : x ∈ (⨆ i, C.U i : X.Opens) := by
      rw [C.covers]
      trivial
    obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.1 hx'
    obtain ⟨g, hgW, hxg⟩ := (C.isAffine i).exists_basicOpen_le ⟨x, hx⟩ hxi
    exact ⟨X.basicOpen g, ⟨i, g, rfl⟩, hxg, hgW⟩
  refine affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_isZero_of_isBasis _ _ _ hB ?_
  rintro V ⟨i, g, rfl⟩
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, C.U i) :=
    IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨C.U i, C.isAffine i⟩
  let e := (er i).some
  let ψ := standardChartEmb C i e
  let M := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ψ).obj G
  haveI : M.IsFinitePresentation := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor _ G
  haveI : M.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  have h0 := SchemeProjectiveSpace.RegularityChart.basicOpenH_of_isZero Γ(X, C.U i) (nr i) M k
    (h i (nr i) e) g
  let W := SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) (nr i) ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g
  refine BundleRegularity.H_transfer C.toBase (X.basicOpen g) (W.ι ≫ ψ)
    (standardChartEmb_opensRange C i e g) G k ?_
  let c : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (W.ι ≫ ψ)).obj G ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj M :=
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp W.ι ψ).app G
  let E' := (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.functorH _ k).mapIso
    ((Modules.toSheafAb W.toScheme).mapIso c)
  exact @Equiv.subsingleton _ _ E'.addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv.toEquiv h0

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PB.counit_epi
statement:
theorem counit_epi [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    (F : C.scheme.Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] (hF : ChartRegular C F) :
    Epi (quillenCounit C F)
proof:
:= by
  choose nr er using BundleRegularity.hrank C hpos
  refine BundleRegularity.epi_of_restrict _
    (fun i ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.space Γ(X, C.U i) (nr i))
    (fun i ↦ standardChartEmb C i (er i).some) ?_ (fun i ↦ ?_)
  · intro x
    have hx : C.toBase x ∈ (⨆ i, C.U i : X.Opens) := by
      rw [C.covers]
      trivial
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.1 hx
    have hx' : x ∈ ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) (nr i) ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤).ι ≫
        standardChartEmb C i (er i).some).opensRange := by
      rw [standardChartEmb_opensRange_top]
      exact hi
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hx'
    exact ⟨i, (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) (nr i) ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤).ι w,
      by rw [← hw, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]⟩
  · haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, C.U i) :=
      IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨C.U i, C.isAffine i⟩
    haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i (er i).some)).obj
      F).IsFinitePresentation := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor _ F
    exact BundleRegularity.epi_of_counit_fac
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction C.toBase)
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) (nr i)))
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.isAffine i).fromSpec)
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i (er i).some))
      (BundleRegularity.BC C i (er i).some) F
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohReg.epi_counit_of_isMumfordRegular Γ(X, C.U i) (nr i) _
        (hF i (nr i) (er i).some))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PB.chartRegular_kernel_twist
statement:
theorem chartRegular_kernel_twist [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    (F : C.scheme.Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] (hF : ChartRegular C F) :
    ChartRegular C (twist C (kernel (quillenCounit C F)) 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro i n e
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, C.U i) :=
    IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨C.U i, C.isAffine i⟩
  have hS := quillenCounitSeq_shortExact C hpos F hF
  let Si := (quillenCounitSeq C F).map (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e))
  have hSi : Si.ShortExact := hS.map_of_exact _
  have hR0 : Epi ((affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n) 0).map Si.g) :=
    (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.epi_affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor_zero_map_iff
      _ Si.g).2
      (BundleRegularity.pushforward_restrict_counit_epi
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction C.toBase)
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.isAffine i).fromSpec)
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e)) (BundleRegularity.BC C i e) F)
  have h3 : Si.X₃.IsFinitePresentation := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor _ F
  have hvan := SchemeProjectiveSpace.G0PBChain.kernel_vanishing Γ(X, C.U i) n Si hSi h3
    (hF i n e) (BundleRegularity.pullbackPushforwardChartIso C i e F) hR0
  have hreg : SchemeProjectiveSpace.IsMumfordRegular Γ(X, C.U i) n
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.moduleTwist Γ(X, C.U i) n Si.X₁ 1) 0 := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, q = j + 1 := ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩
    have e' := SchemeProjectiveSpace.moduleTwistTwistIso Γ(X, C.U i) n Si.X₁ 1
      (0 - ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (-(j : ℤ)) (by push_cast; ring)
    exact SchemeProjectiveSpace.Quillen.R_iso _ n e'.symm (j + 1) (hvan j)
  exact SchemeProjectiveSpace.RegularityChart.isRegular_iso _ n
    (BundleRegularity.twistIso C i e _ 1).symm 0 hreg

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PB.syzygy_spec
statement:
theorem syzygy_spec [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) {N : ℕ}
    (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N) (F : C.scheme.Modules) (hF : F.IsFinitePresentation)
    (hreg : ChartRegular C F) :
    ∀ k, (C.quillenSyzygy F k).IsFinitePresentation ∧ ChartRegular C (C.quillenSyzygy F k)
  | 0 => ⟨hF, hreg⟩
  | k + 1 => by
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩
proof:
:= syzygy_spec hpos hrank F hF hreg k
    haveI := h1
    haveI := kernel_isFinitePresentation C hrank (C.quillenSyzygy F k)
    exact ⟨ProjectiveBundleAR3.twist_isFinitePresentation C _ 1,
      chartRegular_kernel_twist C hpos _ h2⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PB.chart_kernel_isZero
statement:
theorem chart_kernel_isZero [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    {N : ℕ} (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N) (F : C.scheme.Modules) (hF : F.IsFinitePresentation)
    (hreg : ChartRegular C F) (i : C.I) {n : ℕ} (e : C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1)) :
    IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e)).obj
      (kernel (quillenCounit C (C.quillenSyzygy F n))))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, C.U i) :=
    IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨C.U i, C.isAffine i⟩
  have spec := syzygy_spec C hpos hrank F hF hreg
  have hsurj : ∀ k, Function.Surjective
      ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of Γ(X, C.U i))).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n)).map
          (((quillenCounitSeq C (C.quillenSyzygy F k)).map
            (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e))).g))).hom := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := BundleQuillen.exists_section
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction C.toBase)
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.isAffine i).fromSpec)
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e)) (BundleRegularity.BC C i e)
      (C.quillenSyzygy F k)
    exact SchemeProjectiveSpace.QuillenChain.Γ_surjective_of_section Γ(X, C.U i) _ s hs
  exact SchemeProjectiveSpace.G0PBChain.isZero Γ(X, C.U i) n
    (fun k ↦ (quillenCounitSeq C (C.quillenSyzygy F k)).map
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e)))
    (fun k ↦ by
      haveI := (spec k).1
      exact (quillenCounitSeq_shortExact C hpos _ (spec k).2).map_of_exact _)
    (fun k ↦ by
      haveI := (spec k).1
      haveI := kernel_isFinitePresentation C hrank (C.quillenSyzygy F k)
      exact isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor _ _)
    (fun k ↦ by
      haveI := (spec k).1
      exact isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor _ _)
    (fun k ↦ BundleRegularity.pullbackPushforwardChartIso C i e _)
    hsurj
    (fun k ↦ BundleRegularity.twistIso C i e _ 1)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PB.syzygy_isZero
statement:
theorem syzygy_isZero [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) {N : ℕ}
    (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N) {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r)
    (F : C.scheme.Modules) (hF : F.IsFinitePresentation) (hreg : ChartRegular C F) :
    IsZero (C.quillenSyzygy F r)
proof:
:= by
  choose nr er using BundleRegularity.hrank C hpos
  refine BundleQuillen.isZero_of_restrict _
    (fun i ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.space Γ(X, C.U i) (nr i))
    (fun i ↦ standardChartEmb C i (er i).some) ?_ (fun i ↦ ?_)
  · intro x
    have hx : C.toBase x ∈ (⨆ i, C.U i : X.Opens) := by
      rw [C.covers]
      trivial
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.1 hx
    have hx' : x ∈ ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) (nr i) ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤).ι ≫
        standardChartEmb C i (er i).some).opensRange := by
      rw [standardChartEmb_opensRange_top]
      exact hi
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hx'
    exact ⟨i, (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) (nr i) ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤).ι w,
      by rw [← hw, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]⟩
  · haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, C.U i) :=
      IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨C.U i, C.isAffine i⟩
    obtain ⟨hG, hGreg⟩ := syzygy_spec C hpos hrank F hF hreg r
    haveI := hG
    rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial Γ(X, C.U i) with hsub | hnt
    · haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i (er i).some)).obj
        (C.quillenSyzygy F r)).IsFinitePresentation := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor _ _
      exact SchemeProjectiveSpace.G0PBChain.isZero_of_subsingleton Γ(X, C.U i) (nr i) _
        (hGreg i (nr i) (er i).some)
    · obtain ⟨y⟩ : Nonempty (Spec Γ(X, C.U i)) := PrimeSpectrum.nonempty_iff_nontrivial.2 hnt
      have hx : (C.isAffine i).fromSpec y ∈ C.U i := by
        change (C.isAffine i).fromSpec y ∈ ((C.U i : X.Opens) : Set X)
        rw [← (C.isAffine i).range_fromSpec]
        exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
      have hcard := BundleQuillen.card_eq C hE i _ hx
      have hr : r = nr i + 1 := by
        rw [← hcard, Nat.card_congr (er i).some, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fin]
      rw [hr]
      have hZ := chart_kernel_isZero C hpos hrank F hF hreg i (er i).some
      have h1 := (tensorSheafRightFunctor _
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingSheaf Γ(X, C.U i) (nr i) 1)).map_isZero hZ
      exact h1.of_iso (BundleRegularity.twistIso C i (er i).some _ 1)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PB.resolution_step
statement:
theorem resolution_step [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) {N : ℕ}
    (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N) (F : C.scheme.Modules) (hF : F.IsFinitePresentation)
    (hreg : ChartRegular C F) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ (f : twist C (C.quillenSyzygy F (k + 1)) (-((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ⟶
        twist C ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.toBase).obj (C.quillenSyzygy F k))) (-(k : ℤ)))
      (g : twist C ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.toBase).obj (C.quillenSyzygy F k))) (-(k : ℤ)) ⟶
        twist C (C.quillenSyzygy F k) (-(k : ℤ)))
      (w : f ≫ g = 0), (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hG, hGreg⟩ := syzygy_spec C hpos hrank F hF hreg k
  haveI := hG
  have hS := quillenCounitSeq_shortExact C hpos _ hGreg
  let L := C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (-(k : ℤ))
  have hL : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme L := C.canonicalTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree _
  haveI := tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits C.scheme L hL
  haveI := tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits C.scheme L hL
  let S' := (quillenCounitSeq C (C.quillenSyzygy F k)).map (tensorSheafRightFunctor C.scheme L)
  have hS' : S'.ShortExact := hS.map_of_exact _
  let e : twist C (C.quillenSyzygy F (k + 1)) (-((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ≅ S'.X₁ :=
    twistTwistIso C hpos (kernel (quillenCounit C (C.quillenSyzygy F k))) 1
      (-((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (-(k : ℤ)) (by push_cast; ring)
  exact BundleQuillen.transport e S'.f S'.g S'.zero hS'

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PB.g0_mem_of_classOf
statement:
theorem g0_mem_of_classOf {Y : Scheme.{u}} (S : AddSubgroup (G0 Y))
    (h : ∀ (F : Y.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike Y F), g0ClassOf Y F hF ∈ S) (x : G0 Y) :
    x ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective _ x
  induction y using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => exact S.zero_mem
  | add a b ha hb =>
    rw [map_add]
    exact S.add_mem ha hb
  | single F n =>
    rw [← Finsupp.smul_single_one, map_zsmul]
    exact S.zsmul_mem (h F.1 F.2) n

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PB.pullbackG0_classOf
statement:
theorem pullbackG0_classOf (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) (T : X.Modules)
    (hT : IsCoherentLike X T)
    (h : IsCoherentLike C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj T)) :
    pullbackG0 C hpos (g0ClassOf X T hT) =
      g0ClassOf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj T) h
proof:
:= by
  letI : Flat C.toBase := C.toBase_flat hpos
  exact flatPullbackG0_classOf C.toBase T hT

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PB.g0ClassOf_twist
statement:
theorem g0ClassOf_twist (G : C.scheme.Modules) (hG : IsCoherentLike C.scheme G) (d : ℤ)
    (h : IsCoherentLike C.scheme (twist C G d)) :
    g0ClassOf C.scheme (twist C G d) h =
      C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class d • g0ClassOf C.scheme G hG
proof:
:= by
  rw [canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class, k0ClassOf_smul_g0ClassOf]
  exact g0ClassOf_iso C.scheme _ _ (tensorSheafSymmetry C.scheme _ _)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PB.classOf_mem_twistSpan_of_chartRegular
statement:
theorem classOf_mem_twistSpan_of_chartRegular [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) {N : ℕ} (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N) {r : ℕ}
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) (F : C.scheme.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike C.scheme F)
    (hreg : ChartRegular C F) :
    g0ClassOf C.scheme F hF ∈ twistSpan C hpos r
proof:
:= by
  have spec := syzygy_spec C hpos hrank F hF hreg
  have hZq : ∀ k : ℕ, IsCoherentLike C.scheme (twist C (C.quillenSyzygy F k) (-(k : ℤ))) :=
    fun k ↦ by
      haveI := (spec k).1
      exact ProjectiveBundleAR3.twist_isFinitePresentation C _ _
  have hM : ∀ k : ℕ, IsCoherentLike C.scheme (twist C ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.toBase).obj (C.quillenSyzygy F k))) (-(k : ℤ))) :=
    fun k ↦ by
      haveI := (spec k).1
      haveI := pullPush_isFinitePresentation C hrank (C.quillenSyzygy F k)
      exact ProjectiveBundleAR3.twist_isFinitePresentation C _ _
  have hMmem : ∀ k : ℕ, k < r → g0ClassOf C.scheme _ (hM k) ∈ twistSpan C hpos r := by
    intro k hk
    haveI := (spec k).1
    have hT := push_isFinitePresentation C hrank (C.quillenSyzygy F k)
    have hP := pullPush_isFinitePresentation C hrank (C.quillenSyzygy F k)
    refine AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨g0ClassOf X _ hT, k, hk, ?_⟩
    rw [g0ClassOf_twist C _ hP, pullbackG0_classOf C hpos _ hT hP]
  have hZr : g0ClassOf C.scheme _ (hZq r) = 0 :=
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohQ.cls_zero _ ((tensorSheafRightFunctor C.scheme _).map_isZero
      (syzygy_isZero C hpos hrank hE F hF hreg))
  have key : ∀ j i : ℕ, i + j = r → g0ClassOf C.scheme _ (hZq i) ∈ twistSpan C hpos r := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      intro i hi
      obtain rfl : i = r := by omega
      rw [hZr]
      exact zero_mem _
    | succ j ih =>
      intro i hi
      have h1 := ih (i + 1) (by omega)
      obtain ⟨f, g, w, hex⟩ := resolution_step C hpos hrank F hF hreg i
      have hrel := SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohQ.cls_middle (hZq (i + 1)) (hM i) (hZq i) w hex
      have hMS := hMmem i (by omega)
      rw [hrel] at hMS
      exact (AddSubgroup.add_mem_cancel_left _ h1).1 hMS
  have h0 := key r 0 (by omega)
  have hcls : g0ClassOf C.scheme _ (hZq 0) = g0ClassOf C.scheme F hF := by
    rw [g0ClassOf_twist C (C.quillenSyzygy F 0) hF]
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero, canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_zero, one_smul]
    rfl
  rw [← hcls]
  exact h0

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PB.hpos_of_rank
statement:
theorem hpos_of_rank {N : ℕ} (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N) :
    ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)
proof:
:= fun i ↦ by
  obtain ⟨n, -, -, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hrank i
  exact ⟨e.symm 0⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PB.smul_twist_mem_allTwistSpan
statement:
theorem smul_twist_mem_allTwistSpan (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) {r : ℕ} (m : ℤ)
    (x : G0 C.scheme) (hx : x ∈ twistSpan C hpos r) :
    C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class m • x ∈ allTwistSpan C hpos
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem w hw =>
    obtain ⟨y, k, -, rfl⟩ := hw
    apply AddSubgroup.subset_closure
    refine ⟨y, m + -(k : ℤ), ?_⟩
    rw [← mul_smul, C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_mul hpos]
  | zero => rw [smul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [smul_add]; exact add_mem ha hb
  | neg a _ ha => rw [smul_neg]; exact neg_mem ha

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PB.g0_projectiveBundle_span_twists
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := hpos_of_rank C hrank
  refine g0_mem_of_classOf _ (fun F hF ↦ ?_) z
  haveI : F.IsFinitePresentation := hF
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_isMumfordRegular_of_isFinitePresentation C hpos F
  haveI hFm : (twist C F m).IsFinitePresentation :=
    ProjectiveBundleAR3.twist_isFinitePresentation C F m
  have hreg := chartRegular_of_isMumfordRegular C (twist C F m)
    ((isMumfordRegular_twist_iff C hpos F m).1 hm)
  have hmem := classOf_mem_twistSpan_of_chartRegular C hpos hrank hE (twist C F m) hFm hreg
  have h2 := smul_twist_mem_allTwistSpan C hpos (-m) _ hmem
  have hcls : C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-m) • g0ClassOf C.scheme (twist C F m) hFm =
      g0ClassOf C.scheme F hF := by
    rw [g0ClassOf_twist C F hF, ← mul_smul, C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_mul hpos,
      neg_add_cancel, canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_zero, one_smul]
  rw [hcls] at h2
  exact h2

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PB.twist_mem_span_neg
proof:
:= C.projectiveBundleK0Algebra hpos
    C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class d ∈ Submodule.span (K0 X)
      (Set.range fun i : Fin r ↦ C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-(i : ℤ))) := by
  letI := C.projectiveBundleK0Algebra hpos
  have hspan : ((C.tautologicalK0Unit hpos ^ (d + ((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) : (K0 C.scheme)ˣ) :
      K0 C.scheme) ∈ Submodule.span (K0 X)
        (Set.range fun i : Fin r ↦ (C.tautologicalK0Unit hpos : K0 C.scheme) ^ (i : ℕ)) := by
    refine zpow_mem_span_of_relation r hr _ (C.tautologicalK0Unit hpos)
      (C.k0_relation hpos hr hE) ?_ _
    have hu := isUnit_lambdaClass_top X E r hE
    have hrev : ((Fin.rev (⟨0, hr⟩ : Fin r)) : ℕ) + 1 = r := by
      simp only [Fin.val_rev]
      omega
    change IsUnit ((-1 : K0 X) ^ (((Fin.rev (⟨0, hr⟩ : Fin r)) : ℕ) + 1) *
      lambdaClass X E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree (((Fin.rev (⟨0, hr⟩ : Fin r)) : ℕ) + 1))
    rw [hrev]
    exact (isUnit_one.neg.pow r).mul hu
  have hpow : ∀ j : ℤ, ((C.tautologicalK0Unit hpos ^ j : (K0 C.scheme)ˣ) : K0 C.scheme) =
      C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class j := fun j ↦
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_eq_zpow hpos j).symm
  let μ : K0 C.scheme →ₗ[K0 X] K0 C.scheme :=
    LinearMap.mulLeft (K0 X) (C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)))
  have hle : Submodule.span (K0 X)
        (Set.range fun i : Fin r ↦ (C.tautologicalK0Unit hpos : K0 C.scheme) ^ (i : ℕ)) ≤
      (Submodule.span (K0 X)
        (Set.range fun i : Fin r ↦ C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-(i : ℤ)))).comap μ := by
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_comap]
    refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨Fin.rev i, ?_⟩
    have hz : (C.tautologicalK0Unit hpos : K0 C.scheme) ^ (i : ℕ) =
        C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (i : ℤ) := by
      rw [← hpow, zpow_natCast, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val]
    show C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-((Fin.rev i : ℕ) : ℤ)) =
      C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) *
        (C.tautologicalK0Unit hpos : K0 C.scheme) ^ (i : ℕ)
    rw [hz, C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_mul hpos]
    have hi : -((Fin.rev i : ℕ) : ℤ) = -((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + (i : ℤ) := by
      rw [Fin.val_rev]
      have := i.isLt
      omega
    rw [hi]
  have h := hle hspan
  rw [Submodule.mem_comap] at h
  have heq : μ ((C.tautologicalK0Unit hpos ^ (d + ((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) : (K0 C.scheme)ˣ) :
      K0 C.scheme) = C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class d := by
    show C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) * _ = _
    rw [hpow, C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_mul hpos,
      show -((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + (d + ((r - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = d by ring]
  rw [← heq]
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PB.twist_smul_mem_coeffTwistSpan
statement:
theorem twist_smul_mem_coeffTwistSpan [IsNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) (y : G0 X) (d : ℤ) :
    C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class d • pullbackG0 C hpos y ∈ coeffTwistSpan C hpos r
proof:
:= by
  letI := C.projectiveBundleK0Algebra hpos
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun (K0 X)).1
    (twist_mem_span_neg C hpos hr hE d)
  rw [← hc, Finset.sum_smul]
  refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ ?_
  have hci : (c i • C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-((i : ℕ) : ℤ))) =
      C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos (c i) * C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-((i : ℕ) : ℤ)) :=
    Algebra.smul_def _ _
  rw [hci, coeffTwistSpan]
  exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨c i, y, i, i.isLt, rfl⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PB.g0_projectiveBundle_span
statement:
theorem g0_projectiveBundle_span [IsNoetherian X] {N : ℕ} (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N)
    {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) (z : G0 C.scheme) :
    z ∈ coeffTwistSpan C (hpos_of_rank C hrank) r
proof:
:= by
  have hz := g0_projectiveBundle_span_twists C hrank hE z
  induction hz using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem w hw =>
    obtain ⟨y, d, rfl⟩ := hw
    exact twist_smul_mem_coeffTwistSpan C _ hr hE y d
  | zero => exact zero_mem _
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => exact add_mem ha hb
  | neg a _ ha => exact neg_mem ha

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PB.pullback_twist_acyclic_coh
statement:
theorem pullback_twist_acyclic_coh [IsNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) (T : X.Modules) [T.IsFinitePresentation]
    (t : ℤ) (ht : 1 - (r : ℤ) ≤ t) (q : ℕ) :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification C.toBase
      (twist C ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj T) t) (q + 1))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj T).IsFinitePresentation :=
    pullback_isFinitePresentation_global C.toBase T
  haveI := ProjectiveBundleAR3.twist_isFinitePresentation C
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj T) t
  refine isZero_of_chart_coh C hpos _ (q + 1) fun i n e ↦ ?_
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, C.U i) :=
    IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨C.U i, C.isAffine i⟩
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial Γ(X, C.U i) with hsub | hnt
  · refine affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_isZero_of_isBasis _ _ _
      (B := (∅ : Set (Spec Γ(X, C.U i)).Opens)) ?_ (by simp)
    rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd]
    intro U x _
    exfalso
    have hx : (x : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, C.U i)).asIdeal = ⊤ :=
      (Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).2 (by rw [Subsingleton.elim (1 : Γ(X, C.U i)) 0]; exact zero_mem _)
    exact (x : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, C.U i)).isPrime.ne_top hx
  · obtain ⟨y⟩ : Nonempty (Spec Γ(X, C.U i)) := PrimeSpectrum.nonempty_iff_nontrivial.2 hnt
    have hx : (C.isAffine i).fromSpec y ∈ C.U i := by
      change (C.isAffine i).fromSpec y ∈ ((C.U i : X.Opens) : Set X)
      rw [← (C.isAffine i).range_fromSpec]
      exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
    have hcard := BundleQuillen.card_eq C hE i _ hx
    have hrn : r = n + 1 := by
      rw [← hcard, Nat.card_congr e, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fin]
    haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.isAffine i).fromSpec).obj
      T).IsFinitePresentation := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor _ T
    have h := SchemeProjectiveSpace.G0PBChain.baseTwist_higher_isZero Γ(X, C.U i) n
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.isAffine i).fromSpec).obj T) q t (by omega)
    exact SchemeProjectiveSpace.Quillen.R_iso _ n
      (BundleRegularity.twistIso C i e _ t ≪≫
        tensorSheafMapIso _ (K0Basis.chartPullbackIso C i e T) (Iso.refl _)).symm (q + 1) h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PB.push_pullback_twist_isZero
statement:
theorem push_pullback_twist_isZero [IsNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) (T : X.Modules) [T.IsFinitePresentation]
    (t : ℤ) (ht₀ : -(r : ℤ) < t) (ht : t < 0) :
    IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.toBase).obj
      (twist C ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj T) t))
proof:
:= by
  refine BundleQuillen.isZero_of_restrict _ (fun i : C.I ↦ Spec Γ(X, C.U i))
    (fun i ↦ (C.isAffine i).fromSpec) ?_ ?_
  · intro y
    have hy : y ∈ (⨆ i, C.U i : X.Opens) := by
      rw [C.covers]
      trivial
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.1 hy
    have hy' : y ∈ Set.range (C.isAffine i).fromSpec := by
      rw [(C.isAffine i).range_fromSpec]
      exact hi
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hy'
    exact ⟨i, z, hz⟩
  · intro i
    obtain ⟨n, ⟨e⟩⟩ := BundleRegularity.hrank C hpos i
    haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.isAffine i).fromSpec).obj
      T).IsFinitePresentation := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor _ T
    refine IsZero.of_iso ?_ (pushforwardRestrictIso C i e _ ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward _).mapIso (BundleRegularity.twistIso C i e _ t ≪≫
        tensorSheafMapIso _ (K0Basis.chartPullbackIso C i e T) (Iso.refl _)))
    rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial Γ(X, C.U i) with hsub | hnt
    · haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n)).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.isAffine i).fromSpec).obj T)).IsFinitePresentation :=
        pullback_isFinitePresentation_global _ _
      haveI : (tensorSheaf (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space Γ(X, C.U i) n)
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n)).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.isAffine i).fromSpec).obj T))
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingSheaf Γ(X, C.U i) n t)).IsFinitePresentation :=
        SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohQ.moduleTwist_isFinitePresentation Γ(X, C.U i) n _ t
      exact SchemeProjectiveSpace.G0PBChain.push_isZero_of_subsingleton _ n _
    · haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, C.U i) :=
        IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨C.U i, C.isAffine i⟩
      obtain ⟨y⟩ : Nonempty (Spec Γ(X, C.U i)) := PrimeSpectrum.nonempty_iff_nontrivial.2 hnt
      have hx : (C.isAffine i).fromSpec y ∈ C.U i := by
        change (C.isAffine i).fromSpec y ∈ ((C.U i : X.Opens) : Set X)
        rw [← (C.isAffine i).range_fromSpec]
        exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
      have hcard := BundleQuillen.card_eq C hE i _ hx
      have hr : r = n + 1 := by
        rw [← hcard, Nat.card_congr e, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fin]
      exact SchemeProjectiveSpace.G0PBChain.baseTwist_push_isZero _ n _ (by omega) t ht

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PB.alternatingSum_of_concentrated'
statement:
theorem alternatingSum_of_concentrated' {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] (n : ℕ) (t : ℕ → A)
    (h : ∀ i, 0 < i → t i = 0) : GrothendieckRiemannRoch.alternatingSum n t = t 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold GrothendieckRiemannRoch.alternatingSum
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 0]
  · simp
  · intro b _ hb
    rw [h b (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hb), smul_zero]
  · intro h0
    simp at h0

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PB.derivedPush_eq_zero_of_isZero
statement:
theorem derivedPush_eq_zero_of_isZero [IsLocallyNoetherian X] {N : ℕ}
    (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N) (G : C.scheme.Modules) (hG : IsCoherentLike C.scheme G)
    (h : ∀ q, IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification C.toBase G q)) :
    projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank (g0ClassOf C.scheme G hG) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward_classOf]
  unfold GrothendieckRiemannRoch.alternatingSum
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun q _ ↦ ?_
  have hz : g0ClassOf X _
      ((projectiveBundleHigherDirectImageLongExactSystem hrank).higher_mem ⟨G, hG⟩ q) = 0 :=
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohQ.cls_zero _ (h q)
  show (-1 : ℤ) ^ q • g0ClassOf X _
    ((projectiveBundleHigherDirectImageLongExactSystem hrank).higher_mem ⟨G, hG⟩ q) = 0
  rw [hz, smul_zero]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PB.derivedPush_pullbackG0_twist_neg
statement:
theorem derivedPush_pullbackG0_twist_neg [IsNoetherian X] {N : ℕ}
    (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N) {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) (k : ℕ)
    (hk0 : 0 < k) (hk : k < r) (y : G0 X) :
    projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-(k : ℤ)) • pullbackG0 C (hpos_of_rank C hrank) y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let φ : G0 X →+ G0 X := (projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank).comp
    ((k0ActG0 C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-(k : ℤ)))).comp
      (pullbackG0 C (hpos_of_rank C hrank)))
  have hmem : y ∈ φ.ker := by
    refine g0_mem_of_classOf φ.ker (fun T hT ↦ ?_) y
    rw [AddMonoidHom.mem_ker]
    haveI : T.IsFinitePresentation := hT
    have hP : IsCoherentLike C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj T) :=
      pullback_isFinitePresentation_global C.toBase T
    have hPt : IsCoherentLike C.scheme
        (twist C ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj T) (-(k : ℤ))) := by
      haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj T).IsFinitePresentation := hP
      exact ProjectiveBundleAR3.twist_isFinitePresentation C _ _
    change projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-(k : ℤ)) •
        pullbackG0 C (hpos_of_rank C hrank) (g0ClassOf X T hT)) = 0
    rw [pullbackG0_classOf C _ T hT hP, ← g0ClassOf_twist C _ hP _ hPt]
    refine derivedPush_eq_zero_of_isZero C hrank _ hPt fun q ↦ ?_
    rcases q with _ | q
    · exact (push_pullback_twist_isZero C (hpos_of_rank C hrank) hE T (-(k : ℤ))
        (by omega) (by omega)).of_iso
        (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationZeroIso C.toBase _)
    · exact pullback_twist_acyclic_coh C (hpos_of_rank C hrank) hE T (-(k : ℤ)) (by omega) q
  exact hmem

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PB.derivedPush_pullbackG0_classOf_of_iso
statement:
theorem derivedPush_pullbackG0_classOf_of_iso [IsNoetherian X] {N : ℕ}
    (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N) {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (hE : HasConstantRank X E r)
    (T : X.Modules)
    (hT : IsCoherentLike X T)
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.toBase).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj T) ≅
      T) :
    projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank
      (pullbackG0 C (hpos_of_rank C hrank) (g0ClassOf X T hT)) = g0ClassOf X T hT
proof:
:= by
  haveI : T.IsFinitePresentation := hT
  have hP : IsCoherentLike C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj T) :=
    pullback_isFinitePresentation_global C.toBase T
  rw [pullbackG0_classOf C _ T hT hP, projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward_classOf,
    alternatingSum_of_concentrated']
  · exact g0ClassOf_iso X _ _
      (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationZeroIso C.toBase _ ≪≫ e)
  · intro q hq
    obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ : ∃ q', q = q' + 1 := ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩
    have h := pullback_twist_acyclic_coh C (hpos_of_rank C hrank) hE T 0
      (by omega) q
    exact SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohQ.cls_zero _
      (K0Basis.higher_isZero_of_iso C (ProjectiveBundleAR3.twistZeroIso C _) (q + 1) h)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PB.derivedPush_pullbackG0_k0ToG0
statement:
theorem derivedPush_pullbackG0_k0ToG0 [IsNoetherian X] {N : ℕ}
    (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N) {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (hE : HasConstantRank X E r)
    (b : K0 X) :
    projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank
      (pullbackG0 C (hpos_of_rank C hrank) (k0ToG0 X b)) = k0ToG0 X b
proof:
:= by
  let φ : K0 X →+ G0 X := ((projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank).comp
    (pullbackG0 C (hpos_of_rank C hrank))).comp (k0ToG0 X)
  have hφ : φ = k0ToG0 X := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    rintro ⟨V, hV⟩
    change projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank
      (pullbackG0 C (hpos_of_rank C hrank) (k0ToG0 X (k0ClassOf X V hV))) =
        k0ToG0 X (k0ClassOf X V hV)
    rw [k0ToG0_classOf]
    exact derivedPush_pullbackG0_classOf_of_iso C hrank hr hE V _
      (pushPullbackIsoOfFiniteLocallyFree C (hpos_of_rank C hrank) V hV)
  exact congrArg (fun f : K0 X →+ G0 X ↦ f b) hφ

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.G0PB.derivedPush_pullbackG0_twist
statement:
theorem derivedPush_pullbackG0_twist [IsNoetherian X] {N : ℕ}
    (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N) {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r)
    (hunit : ∀ T : X.Modules, IsCoherentLike X T →
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.toBase).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj T) ≅ T))
    (k : ℕ) (hk : k < r) (y : G0 X) :
    projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-(k : ℤ)) • pullbackG0 C (hpos_of_rank C hrank) y) =
      if k = 0 then y else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with hk0
  · subst hk0
    rw [Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero, canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_zero, one_smul]
    let φ : G0 X →+ G0 X := ((projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank).comp
      (pullbackG0 C (hpos_of_rank C hrank))) - AddMonoidHom.id (G0 X)
    have hmem : y ∈ φ.ker := by
      refine g0_mem_of_classOf φ.ker (fun T hT ↦ ?_) y
      rw [AddMonoidHom.mem_ker]
      obtain ⟨e⟩ := hunit T hT
      change projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank
        (pullbackG0 C (hpos_of_rank C hrank) (g0ClassOf X T hT)) - g0ClassOf X T hT = 0
      rw [derivedPush_pullbackG0_classOf_of_iso C hrank hk hE T hT e, sub_self]
    rw [AddMonoidHom.mem_ker] at hmem
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 hmem
  · exact derivedPush_pullbackG0_twist_neg C hrank hE k (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk0) hk y

name: SchemeKTheory.freeSheafificationIso_ι
statement:
theorem freeSheafificationIso_ι
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {I : Type u} (i : I) :
    let P
proof:
:= PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
    let U : I → P := fun _ ↦ 𝟙_ P
    SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i ≫
        (freeSheafificationIso X I).hom =
      (moduleTensorUnitIso X).inv ≫
        (moduleSheafification X).map (Limits.Sigma.ι U i) := by
  letI : (moduleSheafification X).IsLeftAdjoint :=
    (moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).isLeftAdjoint
  let P := PresheafOfModules.{u}
    (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
  let U : I → P := fun _ ↦ 𝟙_ P
  have h :=
    IsColimit.comp_coconePointsIsoOfNatIso_inv
      (isColimitOfPreserves (moduleSheafification X)
        (coproductIsCoproduct U))
      (SheafOfModules.isColimitFreeCofan I)
      (Discrete.natIso fun _ ↦ moduleTensorUnitIso X)
      (Discrete.mk i)
  simpa [freeSheafificationIso, U, P, modulePresheafFree,
    SheafOfModules.ιFree, SheafOfModules.freeCofan] using h

name: SchemeKTheory.tensorCoproductIso_inv_ι
proof:
:= PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
    let UI : I → P := fun _ ↦ 𝟙_ P
    let d : (∐ UI) ⊗ N ≅ ∐ fun _ : I ↦ 𝟙_ P ⊗ N :=
      (isColimitOfPreserves (tensorRight N)
        (coproductIsCoproduct UI)).coconePointsIsoOfNatIso
          (coproductIsCoproduct (fun _ : I ↦ 𝟙_ P ⊗ N))
          (Discrete.natIso fun _ ↦ Iso.refl _)
    Limits.Sigma.ι (fun _ : I ↦ 𝟙_ P ⊗ N) i ≫ d.inv =
      (Limits.Sigma.ι UI i) ▷ N := by
  let P := PresheafOfModules.{u}
    (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
  let UI : I → P := fun _ ↦ 𝟙_ P
  have h :=
    IsColimit.comp_coconePointsIsoOfNatIso_inv
      (isColimitOfPreserves (tensorRight N)
        (coproductIsCoproduct UI))
      (coproductIsCoproduct (fun _ : I ↦ 𝟙_ P ⊗ N))
      (Discrete.natIso fun _ ↦ Iso.refl _)
      (Discrete.mk i)
  simpa [P, UI] using h

name: SchemeKTheory.modulePresheafFreeTensorIso_inv_ι
statement:
theorem modulePresheafFreeTensorIso_inv_ι
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {I J : Type u} (i : I) (j : J) :
    let P
proof:
:= PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
    let UI : I → P := fun _ ↦ 𝟙_ P
    let UJ : J → P := fun _ ↦ 𝟙_ P
    Limits.Sigma.ι (fun _ : Σ _ : I, J ↦ 𝟙_ P) ⟨i, j⟩ ≫
        (modulePresheafFreeTensorIso X I J).inv =
      (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor (𝟙_ P)).inv ≫
        (Limits.Sigma.ι UI i ⊗ₘ Limits.Sigma.ι UJ j) := by
  let P := PresheafOfModules.{u}
    (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
  let UI : I → P := fun _ ↦ 𝟙_ P
  let UJ : J → P := fun _ ↦ 𝟙_ P
  simp [modulePresheafFreeTensorIso, modulePresheafFree]
  slice_lhs 3 4 =>
    erw [tensorCoproductIso_inv_ι]
  exact
    (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor_inv_comp_tensorHom
      (Limits.Sigma.ι UI i) (Limits.Sigma.ι UJ j)).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.freeSheafificationIso_inv_comp_counitIso_inv
statement:
theorem freeSheafificationIso_inv_comp_counitIso_inv
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (I : Type u) :
    (freeSheafificationIso X I).inv ≫
        ((asIso (PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
          (structurePresheafId X)).counit).app
          (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I)).inv =
      (moduleSheafification X).map
        (freePresheafToUnderlyingFreeHom X I)
proof:
:= by
  let adj := moduleSheafificationAdjunction X
  let c :=
    (asIso (PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
      (structurePresheafId X)).counit).app
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I)
  have hq :
      (moduleSheafification X).map
          (freePresheafToUnderlyingFreeHom X I) ≫
        c.hom =
      (freeSheafificationIso X I).inv := by
    change
      (moduleSheafification X).map
            (freePresheafToUnderlyingFreeHom X I) ≫
          adj.counit.app
            (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I) =
        (freeSheafificationIso X I).inv
    erw [← Adjunction.homEquiv_counit]
    exact
      (adj.homEquiv _ _).symm_apply_apply
        (freeSheafificationIso X I).inv
  calc
    (freeSheafificationIso X I).inv ≫ c.inv =
        ((moduleSheafification X).map
            (freePresheafToUnderlyingFreeHom X I) ≫ c.hom) ≫
          c.inv := by rw [hq]
    _ = (moduleSheafification X).map
          (freePresheafToUnderlyingFreeHom X I) := by simp

name: SchemeKTheory.ιFree_comp_counitIso_inv
statement:
theorem ιFree_comp_counitIso_inv
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {I : Type u} (i : I) :
    SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i ≫
        ((asIso (PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
          (structurePresheafId X)).counit).app
            (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I)).inv =
      (moduleTensorUnitIso X).inv ≫
        (moduleSheafification X).map
          (SheafOfModules.ιFree
            (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i).val
proof:
:= by
  let adj := moduleSheafificationAdjunction X
  let c :=
    (asIso (PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
      (structurePresheafId X)).counit).app
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I)
  have h :=
    adj.counit.naturality
      (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i)
  simp only [Functor.comp_map, Functor.id_map] at h
  have e1 : adj.counit.app (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I) = c.hom := rfl
  have e2 : adj.counit.app (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) =
      (moduleTensorUnitIso X).hom := rfl
  have e3 : (underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map
      (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i) =
        (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i).val := rfl
  rw [e1, e2, e3] at h
  change
    SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i ≫ c.inv =
      (moduleTensorUnitIso X).inv ≫
        (moduleSheafification X).map
          (SheafOfModules.ιFree
            (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i).val
  symm
  calc
    (moduleTensorUnitIso X).inv ≫
          (moduleSheafification X).map
            (SheafOfModules.ιFree
              (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i).val =
        ((moduleTensorUnitIso X).inv ≫
            (moduleSheafification X).map
              (SheafOfModules.ιFree
                (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i).val ≫ c.hom) ≫
          c.inv := by simp
    _ = ((moduleTensorUnitIso X).inv ≫
            (moduleTensorUnitIso X).hom ≫
              SheafOfModules.ιFree
                (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i) ≫ c.inv := by rw [h]
    _ = SheafOfModules.ιFree
          (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i ≫ c.inv := by simp

name: SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafification_map_freeGenerator_whiskered
statement:
theorem moduleSheafification_map_freeGenerator_whiskered
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {I : Type u} (i : I) :
    let P
proof:
:= PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
    let UI : I → P := fun _ ↦ 𝟙_ P
    (moduleTensorUnitIso X).inv ≫
          (moduleSheafification X).map (Limits.Sigma.ι UI i) ≫
        (moduleSheafification X).map
          (freePresheafToUnderlyingFreeHom X I) =
      (moduleTensorUnitIso X).inv ≫
        (moduleSheafification X).map
          (SheafOfModules.ιFree
            (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i).val := by
  let P := PresheafOfModules.{u}
    (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
  let UI : I → P := fun _ ↦ 𝟙_ P
  calc
    (moduleTensorUnitIso X).inv ≫
          (moduleSheafification X).map (Limits.Sigma.ι UI i) ≫
        (moduleSheafification X).map
          (freePresheafToUnderlyingFreeHom X I) =
      (SheafOfModules.ιFree
          (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i ≫
        (freeSheafificationIso X I).hom) ≫
          (moduleSheafification X).map
            (freePresheafToUnderlyingFreeHom X I) := by
        rw [freeSheafificationIso_ι]
        rfl
    _ = (SheafOfModules.ιFree
          (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i ≫
        (freeSheafificationIso X I).hom) ≫
          ((freeSheafificationIso X I).inv ≫
            ((asIso (PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
              (structurePresheafId X)).counit).app
                (SheafOfModules.free
                  (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I)).inv) := by
        rw [freeSheafificationIso_inv_comp_counitIso_inv]
    _ = SheafOfModules.ιFree
          (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i ≫
        ((asIso (PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
          (structurePresheafId X)).counit).app
            (SheafOfModules.free
              (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I)).inv := by simp
    _ = (moduleTensorUnitIso X).inv ≫
        (moduleSheafification X).map
          (SheafOfModules.ιFree
            (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i).val :=
      ιFree_comp_counitIso_inv X i

name: SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafification_map_freeGenerator
statement:
theorem moduleSheafification_map_freeGenerator
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {I : Type u} (i : I) :
    let P
proof:
:= PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
    let UI : I → P := fun _ ↦ 𝟙_ P
    (moduleSheafification X).map
        (Limits.Sigma.ι UI i ≫
          freePresheafToUnderlyingFreeHom X I) =
      (moduleSheafification X).map
        (SheafOfModules.ιFree
          (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i).val := by
  let P := PresheafOfModules.{u}
    (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
  let UI : I → P := fun _ ↦ 𝟙_ P
  apply (cancel_epi (moduleTensorUnitIso X).inv).1
  rw [(moduleSheafification X).map_comp]
  exact moduleSheafification_map_freeGenerator_whiskered X i

name: SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafification_map_tensor_freeGenerators
statement:
theorem moduleSheafification_map_tensor_freeGenerators
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {I J : Type u} (i : I) (j : J) :
    let P
proof:
:= PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
    let UI : I → P := fun _ ↦ 𝟙_ P
    let UJ : J → P := fun _ ↦ 𝟙_ P
    (moduleSheafification X).map
        ((Limits.Sigma.ι UI i ≫
            freePresheafToUnderlyingFreeHom X I) ⊗ₘ
          (Limits.Sigma.ι UJ j ≫
            freePresheafToUnderlyingFreeHom X J)) =
      (moduleSheafification X).map
        ((SheafOfModules.ιFree
            (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i).val ⊗ₘ
          (SheafOfModules.ιFree
            (R := X.ringCatSheaf) j).val) := by
  let P := PresheafOfModules.{u}
    (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
  let UI : I → P := fun _ ↦ 𝟙_ P
  let UJ : J → P := fun _ ↦ 𝟙_ P
  letI : MonoidalCategory
      (SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringCatSheaf) :=
    localizedMonoidalCategory X
  letI : MonoidalCategory X.Modules :=
    localizedMonoidalCategory X
  letI : (moduleSheafification X).Monoidal := by
    change
      (CategoryTheory.Localization.Monoidal.toMonoidalCategory
        (moduleSheafification X) (moduleLocalEquivalences X)
        (moduleTensorUnitIso X)).Monoidal
    infer_instance
  apply
    (cancel_epi
      (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (moduleSheafification X)
        (𝟙_ P) (𝟙_ P))).1
  rw [← Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ_natural]
  rw [moduleSheafification_map_freeGenerator,
    moduleSheafification_map_freeGenerator]
  exact
    Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ_natural (moduleSheafification X)
      (SheafOfModules.ιFree
        (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i).val
      (SheafOfModules.ιFree
        (R := X.ringCatSheaf) j).val

name: SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafFreeIso_inv_ι
statement:
theorem tensorSheafFreeIso_inv_ι
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {I J : Type u} (i : I) (j : J) :
    SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) ⟨i, j⟩ ≫
        (tensorSheafFreeIso X I J).inv =
      (tensorSheafLeftUnitor X (tensorUnitSheaf X)).inv ≫
        tensorSheafMap X
          (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i)
          (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) j)
proof:
:= by
  letI : MonoidalCategory
      (SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringCatSheaf) :=
    localizedMonoidalCategory X
  letI : MonoidalCategory X.Modules :=
    localizedMonoidalCategory X
  letI : (moduleSheafification X).Monoidal := by
    change
      (CategoryTheory.Localization.Monoidal.toMonoidalCategory
        (moduleSheafification X) (moduleLocalEquivalences X)
        (moduleTensorUnitIso X)).Monoidal
    infer_instance
  simp only [tensorSheafFreeIso, Iso.trans_inv, Iso.symm_inv,
    Category.assoc]
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  erw [freeSheafificationIso_ι]
  slice_lhs 2 3 =>
    change (moduleSheafification X).map _ ≫
      (moduleSheafification X).map _
    rw [← (moduleSheafification X).map_comp]
    erw [modulePresheafFreeTensorIso_inv_ι]
    rw [(moduleSheafification X).map_comp]
  simp only [tensorSheafIsoLocalizedTensor, Iso.trans_inv,
    Iso.symm_inv, Category.assoc]
  slice_lhs 5 6 =>
    change (_ ⊗ₘ _) ≫ (_ ⊗ₘ _)
    rw [MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_comp_tensorHom]
    erw [freeSheafificationIso_inv_comp_counitIso_inv,
      freeSheafificationIso_inv_comp_counitIso_inv]
  slice_lhs 4 6 =>
    change
      Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (moduleSheafification X) _ _ ≫
        ((moduleSheafification X).map _ ⊗ₘ
          (moduleSheafification X).map _) ≫
        Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (moduleSheafification X) _ _
    rw [Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ_natural_assoc]
    simp
  slice_lhs 3 4 =>
    change (moduleSheafification X).map _ ≫
      (moduleSheafification X).map _
    rw [← (moduleSheafification X).map_comp]
    rw [MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_comp_tensorHom]
    erw [moduleSheafification_map_tensor_freeGenerators]
  simp only [tensorSheafLeftUnitor, tensorSheafMap,
    Iso.trans_inv, Category.assoc]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackTensorSheafHom_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem pullbackTensorSheafHom_naturality
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    {M M' N N' : Y.Modules}
    (a : M ⟶ M') (b : N ⟶ N') :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map
          (tensorSheafMap Y a b) ≫
        pullbackTensorSheafHom f M' N' =
      pullbackTensorSheafHom f M N ≫
        tensorSheafMap X
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map a)
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map b)
proof:
:= by
  apply
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).homEquiv _ _ |>.injective
  simp only [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right, pullbackTensorSheafHom,
    Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Category.assoc]
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
  rw [Category.assoc]
  rw [Adjunction.unit_naturality_assoc]
  rw [← Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [tensorSheafMap_comp_assoc]
  have ha :
      a ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app M' =
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app M ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map a) := by
    simpa only [Functor.id_map, Functor.comp_map] using
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.naturality a
  have hb :
      b ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app N' =
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app N ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map b) := by
    simpa only [Functor.id_map, Functor.comp_map] using
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.naturality b
  rw [ha, hb]
  rw [← tensorSheafMap_comp_assoc]
  slice_lhs 2 3 =>
    rw [pushforwardTensorSheafHom_naturality]

name: SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMapIso_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tensorSheafMapIso_hom
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {M M' N N' : X.Modules}

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitToUnit_isIso
statement:
theorem pullbackObjUnitToUnit_isIso
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    IsIso
      (SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit
        f.toRingCatSheafHom)
proof:
:= by
  letI : PreservesLimit
      (Functor.empty.{0} Y.Opens) (Opens.map f.base) :=
    preservesTerminal_of_iso (Opens.map f.base)
      ((Opens.map f.base).mapIso
          (terminalIsTerminal.uniqueUpToIso
            (isTerminalTop : IsTerminal (⊤ : Y.Opens))) ≪≫
        eqToIso (Opens.map_top f.base) ≪≫
        (isTerminalTop : IsTerminal (⊤ : X.Opens)).uniqueUpToIso
          terminalIsTerminal)
  letI : (Opens.map f.base).Final := inferInstance
  infer_instance

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pullbackObjUnitIso_hom
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso_inv_hom
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem pullbackObjUnitIso_inv_hom

name: SchemeKTheory.pullback_map_ιFree_comp_pullbackFreeIso_hom
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem pullback_map_ιFree_comp_pullbackFreeIso_hom
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    {I : Type u} (i : I) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map
          (SheafOfModules.ιFree
            (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) i) ≫
        (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f I).hom =
      SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit
          f.toRingCatSheafHom ≫
      SheafOfModules.ιFree
          (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i
proof:
:= by
  letI : PreservesLimit
      (Functor.empty.{0} Y.Opens) (Opens.map f.base) :=
    preservesTerminal_of_iso (Opens.map f.base)
      ((Opens.map f.base).mapIso
          (terminalIsTerminal.uniqueUpToIso
            (isTerminalTop : IsTerminal (⊤ : Y.Opens))) ≪≫
        eqToIso (Opens.map_top f.base) ≪≫
        (isTerminalTop : IsTerminal (⊤ : X.Opens)).uniqueUpToIso
          terminalIsTerminal)
  letI : (Opens.map f.base).Final := inferInstance
  unfold AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso
  exact
    SheafOfModules.pullback_map_ιFree_comp_pullbackObjFreeIso_hom
      f.toRingCatSheafHom i

name: SchemeKTheory.ιFree_comp_pullbackObjFreeIso_inv
statement:
theorem ιFree_comp_pullbackObjFreeIso_inv
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    {I : Type u} (i : I) :
    SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i ≫
        (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f I).inv =
      (pullbackObjUnitIso f).inv ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map
          (SheafOfModules.ιFree
            (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) i)
proof:
:= by
  apply
    (cancel_mono
      (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f I).hom).1
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  rw [pullback_map_ιFree_comp_pullbackFreeIso_hom]
  simp only [← Category.assoc, pullbackObjUnitIso_inv_hom]
  exact (Category.id_comp _).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackTensorSheafHom_unit_compat_inv
statement:
theorem pullbackTensorSheafHom_unit_compat_inv
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (pullbackObjUnitIso f).inv ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map
          (tensorSheafLeftUnitor Y (tensorUnitSheaf Y)).inv ≫
        pullbackTensorSheafHom f
          (tensorUnitSheaf Y) (tensorUnitSheaf Y) ≫
        tensorSheafMap X
          (pullbackObjUnitIso f).hom
          (pullbackObjUnitIso f).hom =
      (tensorSheafLeftUnitor X (tensorUnitSheaf X)).inv
proof:
:= by
  apply
    (cancel_mono
      (tensorSheafLeftUnitor X (tensorUnitSheaf X)).hom).1
  simp only [pullbackObjUnitIso_hom]
  slice_lhs 3 5 =>
    rw [pullbackTensorSheafHom_unit_compat]
  slice_lhs 2 3 =>
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id]
    exact (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map_id _
  slice_lhs 2 3 =>
    rw [Category.id_comp]
  rw [pullbackObjUnitIso_inv_hom]
  exact (tensorSheafLeftUnitor X (tensorUnitSheaf X)).inv_hom_id.symm

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackTensorSheafHom_unit_compat_inv_raw
statement:
theorem pullbackTensorSheafHom_unit_compat_inv_raw
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (pullbackObjUnitIso f).inv ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map
          (tensorSheafLeftUnitor Y (tensorUnitSheaf Y)).inv ≫
        pullbackTensorSheafHom f
          (tensorUnitSheaf Y) (tensorUnitSheaf Y) ≫
        tensorSheafMap X
          (SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit
            f.toRingCatSheafHom)
          (SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit
            f.toRingCatSheafHom) =
      (tensorSheafLeftUnitor X (tensorUnitSheaf X)).inv
proof:
:= by
  exact pullbackTensorSheafHom_unit_compat_inv f

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackTensorSheafHom_free_conjugate
statement:
theorem pullbackTensorSheafHom_free_conjugate
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (I J : Type u) :
    (pullbackTensorFreeSourceIso f I J).inv ≫
        pullbackTensorSheafHom f
          (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I)
          (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J) ≫
        (pullbackTensorFreeTargetIso f I J).hom =
      𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply Cofan.IsColimit.hom_ext
    (SheafOfModules.isColimitFreeCofan
      (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (Σ _ : I, J))
  intro ij
  rcases ij with ⟨i, j⟩
  change
    SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) ⟨i, j⟩ ≫
          (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso
            f (Σ _ : I, J)).inv ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map
            (tensorSheafFreeIso Y I J).inv ≫
          pullbackTensorSheafHom f
            (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I)
            (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J) ≫
          tensorSheafMap X
              (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f I).hom
              (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f J).hom ≫
            (tensorSheafFreeIso X I J).hom =
      SheafOfModules.ιFree
        (R := X.ringCatSheaf) ⟨i, j⟩
  slice_lhs 1 2 =>
    rw [ιFree_comp_pullbackObjFreeIso_inv]
  slice_lhs 2 3 =>
    rw [← (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map_comp]
    rw [tensorSheafFreeIso_inv_ι]
    rw [(Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map_comp]
  slice_lhs 3 4 =>
    rw [pullbackTensorSheafHom_naturality]
  slice_lhs 4 5 =>
    rw [tensorSheafMap_comp]
  rw [pullback_map_ιFree_comp_pullbackFreeIso_hom,
    pullback_map_ιFree_comp_pullbackFreeIso_hom]
  slice_lhs 4 4 =>
    rw [← tensorSheafMap_comp X
      (SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit
        f.toRingCatSheafHom)
      (SheafOfModules.ιFree
        (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i)
      (SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit
        f.toRingCatSheafHom)
      (SheafOfModules.ιFree
        (R := X.ringCatSheaf) j)]
  slice_lhs 1 4 =>
    rw [pullbackTensorSheafHom_unit_compat_inv_raw]
  slice_lhs 1 2 =>
    rw [← tensorSheafFreeIso_inv_ι]
  slice_lhs 2 3 =>
    rw [Iso.inv_hom_id]
  rw [Category.comp_id]

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackTensorSheafHom_free_isIso
statement:
theorem pullbackTensorSheafHom_free_isIso
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (I J : Type u) :
    IsIso
      (pullbackTensorSheafHom f
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I)
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J))
proof:
:= by
  let c :=
    pullbackTensorSheafHom f
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I)
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J)
  let eS := pullbackTensorFreeSourceIso f I J
  let eT := pullbackTensorFreeTargetIso f I J
  haveI : IsIso ((eS.inv ≫ c) ≫ eT.hom) := by
    rw [Category.assoc]
    change IsIso
      ((pullbackTensorFreeSourceIso f I J).inv ≫
        pullbackTensorSheafHom f
          (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I)
          (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J) ≫
        (pullbackTensorFreeTargetIso f I J).hom)
    rw [pullbackTensorSheafHom_free_conjugate]
    infer_instance
