  haveI : IsIso (eS.inv ≫ c) :=
    IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right (eS.inv ≫ c) eT.hom
  exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_left eS.inv c

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_iso_free
statement:
theorem pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_iso_free
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    {M N : Y.Modules} (I J : Type u)
    (eM : M ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I)
    (eN : N ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J) :
    IsIso (pullbackTensorSheafHom f M N)
proof:
:= by
  let F := Scheme.Modules.pullback f
  let a :=
    tensorSheafMap Y eM.hom eN.hom
  let b :=
    tensorSheafMap X
      (F.map eM.hom) (F.map eN.hom)
  haveI : IsIso a := by
    change IsIso (tensorSheafMapIso Y eM eN).hom
    infer_instance
  haveI : IsIso (F.map a) :=
    Functor.map_isIso F a
  haveI : IsIso b := by
    change IsIso
      (tensorSheafMapIso X
        (F.mapIso eM) (F.mapIso eN)).hom
    infer_instance
  haveI :
      IsIso
        (pullbackTensorSheafHom f
          (SheafOfModules.free
            (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I)
          (SheafOfModules.free
            (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J)) :=
    pullbackTensorSheafHom_free_isIso f I J
  haveI :
      IsIso
        (pullbackTensorSheafHom f M N ≫ b) := by
    rw [← pullbackTensorSheafHom_naturality]
    infer_instance
  exact
    IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right
      (pullbackTensorSheafHom f M N) b

name: SchemeKTheory.moduleHom_isIso_of_over_cover
statement:
theorem moduleHom_isIso_of_over_cover
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {M N : X.Modules} (a : M ⟶ N)
    {I : Type v} (U : I → X.Opens)
    (hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop U)
    (h : ∀ i, IsIso (a.over (U i))) :
    IsIso a
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsIso
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).map a) := by
    apply Sheaf.isIso_of_coversTop hU
    intro i
    letI : IsIso (a.over (U i)) := h i
    exact Functor.map_isIso
      (SheafOfModules.toSheaf
        (X.ringCatSheaf.over (U i)))
      (a.over (U i))
  let F := SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf
  let hF : F.ReflectsIsomorphisms := by
    have : (F ⋙
        sheafToPresheaf
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
          AddCommGrpCat).ReflectsIsomorphisms :=
      inferInstanceAs
        ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
          PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
            X.ringCatSheaf.obj).ReflectsIsomorphisms)
    exact reflectsIsomorphisms_of_comp F
      (sheafToPresheaf
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
        AddCommGrpCat)
  exact hF.reflects a

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_localGenerators
statement:
theorem pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_localGenerators
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    {M N : Y.Modules}
    (qM : M.LocalGeneratorsData)
    (qN : N.LocalGeneratorsData)
    [qM.IsLocallyFreeData] [qN.IsLocallyFreeData]
    (h : ∀ p : qM.I × qN.I,
      IsIso
        ((pullbackTensorSheafHom f M N).over
          (f ⁻¹ᵁ (qM.X p.1 ⊓ qN.X p.2)))) :
    IsIso (pullbackTensorSheafHom f M N)
proof:
:= by
  let W : qM.I × qN.I → Y.Opens :=
    fun p ↦ qM.X p.1 ⊓ qN.X p.2
  let U : qM.I × qN.I → X.Opens :=
    fun p ↦ f ⁻¹ᵁ W p
  have hW :
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y).CoversTop W :=
    coversTop_inf Y qM.coversTop qN.coversTop
  have hU :
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop U := by
    rw [Opens.coversTop_iff] at hW ⊢
    exact f.iSup_preimage_eq_top hW
  apply moduleHom_isIso_of_over_cover
    (pullbackTensorSheafHom f M N) U hU
  intro p
  exact h p

name: QCPushforward.Aux.of_le
statement:
lemma Aux.of_le {M : (Spec R).Modules} {V : (Spec R).Opens} (g : R) (hg : basicOpen g ≤ V)
    (hV : Aux M V) :
    Aux M (basicOpen g) where
  existence f hfg s
proof:
:= by
    obtain ⟨n, t, ht⟩ := hV.existence f (le_trans hfg hg) s
    use n, M.presheaf.map (homOfLE hg).op t
    simp [← M.presheaf.map_comp_apply, ← op_comp, homOfLE_comp, ht]
  uniqueness f hfg t ht := by
    obtain ⟨n, t', ht'⟩ := hV.existence g hg t
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hV.uniqueness _ (le_trans hfg hg) t' <| by
      rw [← homOfLE_comp hfg hg, op_comp, M.presheaf.map_comp_apply, ht', M.map_smul_Spec, ht]
      simp
    refine ⟨m, ((M.isSMulRegular_of_le_basicOpen le_rfl).pow n).right_eq_zero_of_smul ?_⟩
    simp [smul_comm, ← ht', ← M.map_smul_Spec, hm]

name: QCPushforward.gaux_of_eq_iSup_basicOpen
statement:
lemma gaux_of_eq_iSup_basicOpen {M : (Spec R).Modules} (V : (Spec R).Opens)
    {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (g : ι → R) (hg : V = ⨆ i, basicOpen (g i))
    (h₁ : ∀ (i : ι), Aux M (basicOpen (g i))) :
    GAux M V
proof:
:= by
  have h₂ (i j : ι) : Aux M (basicOpen (g i * g j)) :=
    .of_le _ (basicOpen_mul_le_left _ _) (h₁ i)
  have hgle (i : ι) : basicOpen (g i) ≤ V := by rw [hg]; exact le_iSup_of_le _ le_rfl
  have hug (i : ι) (m : ℕ) :
      IsUnit (algebraMap R (Module.End R Γ(M, basicOpen (g i))) (g i ^ m)) := by
    rw [map_pow]
    exact (Scheme.Modules.isUnit_algebraMap_end_of_le_basicOpen (g i) le_rfl).pow m
  refine ⟨fun f s ↦ ?_, fun f t hs ↦ ?_⟩
  · have hfgi (i : ι) : basicOpen (f * g i) ≤ basicOpen (g i) := basicOpen_mul_le_right f (g i)
    have hfgV (i : ι) : basicOpen (f * g i) ≤ V ⊓ basicOpen f :=
      le_inf (le_trans (hfgi i) (hgle i)) (basicOpen_mul_le_left f (g i))
    let s' (i : ι) : Γ(M, basicOpen (f * g i)) :=
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE <| hfgV i).op s
    obtain ⟨N, t, ht⟩ : ∃ (N : ℕ) (t : ∀ i, Γ(M, basicOpen (g i))),
        ∀ i, f ^ N • s' i = M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (basicOpen_mul_le_right f (g i))).op (t i) := by
      have (i : ι) : ∃ (n : ℕ) (t : Γ(M, basicOpen (g i))),
          f ^ n • s' i = M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hfgi i)).op t := by
        obtain ⟨n, t', ht'⟩ := (h₁ i).existence (f * g i) (hfgi i) (s' i)
        rw [mul_pow, mul_smul, smul_comm] at ht'
        obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := IsUnit.exists_right_inv (hug i n)
        use n, ψ t'
        apply (M.isSMulRegular_of_le_basicOpen (basicOpen_mul_le_right f (g i))).pow n
        dsimp
        rw [← ht', ← Scheme.Modules.map_smul_Spec]
        congr 1
        exact congr($hψ t').symm
      choose n t' ht' using this
      have (i : ι) : n i ≤ ⨆ i, n i := le_ciSup (Finite.bddAbove_range _) _
      have hN (i : ι) : ⨆ i, n i = ((⨆ i, n i) - n i) + n i := by grind
      refine ⟨⨆ i, n i, fun i ↦ f ^ ((⨆ i, n i) - n i) • t' i, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
      conv_lhs => rw [hN i]
      rw [pow_add, mul_smul, ht', M.map_smul_Spec]
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ (K : ℕ), ∀ (i j : ι),
        M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (basicOpen_mul_le_left (g i) (g j))).op (f ^ K • t i) =
          M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (basicOpen_mul_le_right (g i) (g j))).op (f ^ K • t j) := by
      have (i j : ι) : ∃ (m : ℕ),
          M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (basicOpen_mul_le_left (g i) (g j))).op (f ^ m • t i) =
            M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (basicOpen_mul_le_right (g i) (g j))).op (f ^ m • t j) := by
        have := (h₂ i j).uniqueness (f * (g i * g j)) (basicOpen_mul_le_right _ _)
          (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (basicOpen_mul_le_left (g i) (g j))).op (t i) -
            M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (basicOpen_mul_le_right (g i) (g j))).op (t j)) ?_
        · obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := this
          use m
          apply (M.isSMulRegular_of_le_basicOpen le_rfl).pow m
          simpa [M.map_smul_Spec _ (f ^ m), ← mul_smul, ← mul_smul, ← mul_pow, ← mul_comm f,
            smul_sub, sub_eq_zero] using hm
        · have hfgigi : basicOpen (f * (g i * g j)) ≤ basicOpen (f * g i) := by
            rw [← mul_assoc]
            exact basicOpen_mul_le_left _ _
          have hfgigj : basicOpen (f * (g i * g j)) ≤ basicOpen (f * g j) := by
            rw [mul_comm (g i) (g j), ← mul_assoc]
            exact basicOpen_mul_le_left _ _
          rw [map_sub, ← M.presheaf.map_comp_apply, ← op_comp, ← M.presheaf.map_comp_apply,
            ← op_comp, homOfLE_comp, homOfLE_comp, ← homOfLE_comp hfgigi (hfgi i),
            ← homOfLE_comp hfgigj (hfgi j), op_comp, M.presheaf.map_comp_apply, ← ht i,
            M.map_smul_Spec, ← M.presheaf.map_comp_apply, ← op_comp, homOfLE_comp, op_comp,
            M.presheaf.map_comp_apply, ← ht j, M.map_smul_Spec, ← M.presheaf.map_comp_apply,
            ← op_comp, homOfLE_comp]
          simp
      choose m hm using this
      let K := ⨆ i, ⨆ j, m i j
      refine ⟨K, fun i j ↦ ?_⟩
      have : m i j ≤ K :=
        le_ciSup_of_le (Finite.bddAbove_range _) i (le_ciSup (Finite.bddAbove_range _) _)
      have : K = (K - m i j) + m i j := by lia
      rw [this, pow_add, mul_smul, mul_smul, M.map_smul_Spec, M.map_smul_Spec _ (f ^ (K - m i j)),
        hm i j]
    refine ⟨N + K, ?_⟩
    have := TopCat.Sheaf.existsUnique_gluing' ⟨_, M.isSheaf⟩ (fun i ↦ basicOpen (g i)) V
      (fun i ↦ homOfLE (by rw [hg]; exact le_iSup_of_le _ le_rfl)) (by simp [hg])
      (fun i ↦ f ^ K • t i) ?_
    · obtain ⟨a, ha, -⟩ := this
      use a
      refine TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' ⟨_, M.isSheaf⟩ (fun i ↦ basicOpen (f * g i)) _
          (fun i ↦ homOfLE (hfgV i)) ?_ _ _ ?_
      · rw [hg, iSup_inf_eq]
        refine iSup_mono fun i => ?_
        rw [basicOpen_mul, inf_comm]
      · intro i
        rw [← M.presheaf.map_comp_apply, ← op_comp, homOfLE_comp,
          ← homOfLE_comp (basicOpen_mul_le_right _ _) (hgle i), op_comp, M.presheaf.map_comp_apply,
          M.map_smul_Spec, ha, M.map_smul_Spec, pow_add, mul_smul, smul_comm, ht i]
    · intro i j
      have : Function.Injective (M.presheaf.map (eqToHom <| (basicOpen_mul (g i) (g j))).op) :=
        ConcreteCategory.injective_of_mono_of_preservesPullback _
      apply this
      dsimp [Opens.infLELeft, Opens.infLERight]
      simp_rw [← M.presheaf.map_comp_apply, ← op_comp, eqToHom_comp_homOfLE]
      exact hK i j
  · have (i : ι) : ∃ (n : ℕ), M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hgle i)).op (f ^ n • t) = 0 := by
      have := (h₁ i).uniqueness (f * g i) (basicOpen_mul_le_right f (g i))
        (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hgle i)).op t) ?_
      · obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := this
        use n
        rw [mul_pow, mul_comm, mul_smul, ← Scheme.Modules.map_smul_Spec] at hn
        exact ((M.isSMulRegular_of_le_basicOpen le_rfl).pow n).right_eq_zero_of_smul hn
      · have hfgV : basicOpen (f * g i) ≤ V ⊓ basicOpen f :=
          le_inf (le_trans (basicOpen_mul_le_right f (g i)) (hgle i)) (basicOpen_mul_le_left f (g i))
        rw [← M.presheaf.map_comp_apply, ← op_comp, homOfLE_comp,
          ← homOfLE_comp hfgV inf_le_left, op_comp, M.presheaf.map_comp_apply]
        simp [hs]
    choose n hn using this
    use ⨆ i, n i
    apply TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' ⟨_, M.isSheaf⟩ (fun i ↦ basicOpen (g i)) _
      (fun i ↦ homOfLE (by rw [hg]; exact le_iSup_of_le _ le_rfl))
    · simp [hg]
    · intro i
      have : n i ≤ ⨆ i, n i := le_ciSup (Finite.bddAbove_range _) _
      have : ⨆ i, n i = ((⨆ i, n i) - n i) + n i := by lia
      rw [this, pow_add, mul_smul, Scheme.Modules.map_smul_Spec, hn i]
      simp

name: QCPushforward.isLocalizing_of_gaux
statement:
theorem isLocalizing_of_gaux (M : (Spec R).Modules) (V : (Spec R).Opens) (h : GAux M V)
    (hV : ∀ (W W' : (Spec R).Opens) (hW : W' ≤ W), V ⊓ W ≤ W' →
      Function.Bijective (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op)) :
    IsLocalizing (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj M)
proof:
:= by
  intro f
  refine IsLocalizedModule.Away.mk_of_addCommGroup
    (Scheme.Modules.isUnit_algebraMap_end_of_le_basicOpen f le_rfl) ?_ ?_
  · intro (x : Γ(M, basicOpen f))
    obtain ⟨n, t, ht⟩ := h.existence f
      (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : V ⊓ basicOpen f ≤ basicOpen f)).op x)
    obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := (hV ⊤ V le_top inf_le_left).2 t
    refine ⟨n, T, ?_⟩
    apply (hV (basicOpen f) (V ⊓ basicOpen f) inf_le_right le_rfl).1
    show M.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_right).op (f ^ n • x) =
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_right).op (M.presheaf.map (basicOpen f).leTop.op T)
    rw [M.map_smul_Spec, ← ht, ← hT, ← M.presheaf.map_comp_apply, ← M.presheaf.map_comp_apply]
    rfl
  · intro (x : Γ(M, ⊤)) hx
    have hx' : M.presheaf.map (basicOpen f).leTop.op x = 0 := hx
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h.uniqueness f (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op x) (by
      have : M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V ⊓ basicOpen f ≤ V)).op
          (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op x) =
          M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : V ⊓ basicOpen f ≤ basicOpen f)).op
            (M.presheaf.map (basicOpen f).leTop.op x) := by
        rw [← M.presheaf.map_comp_apply, ← M.presheaf.map_comp_apply]
        rfl
      rw [this, hx', map_zero])
    refine ⟨n, (hV ⊤ V le_top inf_le_left).1 ?_⟩
    rw [M.map_smul_Spec, hn, map_zero]

name: QCPushforward.aux_top_of_isLocalizing
statement:
lemma aux_top_of_isLocalizing (M : (Spec R).Modules)
    (h : IsLocalizing (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj M)) : Aux M ⊤
proof:
:= by
  let φ (f : R) := ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj M).obj.map (basicOpen f).leTop.op).hom
  have hf (f : R) : IsLocalizedModule.Away f (φ f) := h f
  refine ⟨fun f hle s ↦ ?_, fun f hle s hs ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨n, y, hy⟩ := (hf f).surj _ _ s
    use n, y, hy.symm
  · obtain ⟨⟨_, n, rfl⟩, hn⟩ := (IsLocalizedModule.eq_zero_iff (.powers f) (φ f)).mp hs
    use n, hn

name: QCPushforward.aux_basicOpen_of_aux_restrict
statement:
lemma aux_basicOpen_of_aux_restrict (M : (Spec R).Modules) (g : R)
    (h : Aux (M.restrict <|
        Spec.map <| CommRingCat.ofHom <| algebraMap R <| Localization.Away g) ⊤) :
      Aux M (basicOpen g)
proof:
:= by
  let a : R ⟶ CommRingCat.of (Localization.Away g) :=
    CommRingCat.ofHom <| algebraMap R _
  set ψ : Spec (.of <| Localization.Away g) ⟶ Spec (.of R) := Spec.map a
  set M' : (Spec (.of <| Localization.Away g)).Modules := M.restrict ψ
  have heq (f : R) (hf : basicOpen f ≤ basicOpen g) :
      basicOpen f = ψ ''ᵁ basicOpen (a f) := by
    rw [← SpecMap_preimage_basicOpen, Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf]
    simp [a, ψ, hf]
  let iso : Γ(M.restrict ψ, ⊤) ≅ Γ(M, basicOpen g) :=
    M.restrictAppIso _ _ ≪≫ M.presheaf.mapIso (eqToIso <| by simp [ψ, a]).op
  let e (f : R) (hf : basicOpen f ≤ basicOpen g) : Γ(M', basicOpen (a f)) ≅ Γ(M, basicOpen f) :=
    M.restrictAppIso ψ (basicOpen (a f)) ≪≫ M.presheaf.mapIso (eqToIso <| heq f hf).op
  refine ⟨fun f hf s ↦ ?_, fun f hf t ht ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨n, t, ht⟩ := h.existence (a f) le_top ((e _ hf).inv s)
    use n, iso.hom t
    have := congr((e _ hf).hom $ht)
    dsimp [M'] at this
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at this
    simp only [homOfLE_leOfHom, Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.op_hom, eqToIso.hom,
      eqToHom_op, Iso.trans_inv, Functor.mapIso_inv, Iso.op_inv, eqToIso.inv, e, iso] at this ⊢
    simp only [homOfLE_leOfHom, Scheme.Modules.map_restrictAppIso_hom_assoc, AddCommGrpCat.hom_comp,
      AddMonoidHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, ← map_pow, ψ] at this
    rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso_smul_Spec] at this
    simpa [← Functor.map_comp_apply, eqToHom_comp_homOfLE_op, homOfLE_op_comp_eqToHom] using this
  · obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h.uniqueness (a f) le_top (iso.inv t) <| by
      simpa [M', iso, ← M.presheaf.map_comp_apply, homOfLE_op_comp_eqToHom, e] using
        congr((e _ hf).inv $ht)
    use n
    have := congr(iso.hom $hn)
    dsimp [iso, ψ] at this
    rw [eqToHom_op, map_zero, ← map_pow, Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso_smul_Spec,
      M.map_smul_Spec, Iso.inv_hom_id_apply] at this
    simpa using this

name: QCPushforward.aux_basicOpen_of_isQuasicoherent_restrict
statement:
lemma aux_basicOpen_of_isQuasicoherent_restrict (M : (Spec R).Modules) (g : R)
    [(M.restrict <| Spec.map <| CommRingCat.ofHom <| algebraMap R <|
      Localization.Away g).IsQuasicoherent] :
    Aux M (basicOpen g)
proof:
:=
  aux_basicOpen_of_aux_restrict M g (aux_top_of_isLocalizing _
    ((isIso_fromTildeΓ_iff_isLocalizing _).1
      (Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent
        (R := CommRingCat.of (Localization.Away g)) _)))

name: QCPushforward.isQuasicoherent_of_restrict
statement:
theorem isQuasicoherent_of_restrict (M : (Spec R).Modules) (V : (Spec R).Opens)
    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set (Spec R))) [(M.restrict V.ι).IsQuasicoherent]
    (hlive : ∀ (W W' : (Spec R).Opens) (hW : W' ≤ W), V ⊓ W ≤ W' →
      Function.Bijective (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op)) :
    M.IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  rw [isQuasicoherent_iff_isIso_fromTildeΓ, isIso_fromTildeΓ_iff_isLocalizing]
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ, a, ha⟩ := PrimeSpectrum.isBasis_basic_opens.exists_iSup_eq_of_isCompact V hV
  refine isLocalizing_of_gaux M V (gaux_of_eq_iSup_basicOpen V a ha fun i => ?_) hlive
  have hle : basicOpen (a i) ≤ V := by rw [ha]; exact le_iSup_of_le i le_rfl
  let t := (basicOpenIsoSpecAway (a i)).inv ≫ (Spec R).homOfLE hle
  have hψ : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (a i)))) = t ≫ V.ι := by
    simp [t, basicOpenIsoSpecAway]
  let e : M.restrict (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (a i))))) ≅
      (M.restrict V.ι).restrict t :=
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr hψ).app M ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp t V.ι).app M
  haveI : (M.restrict (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (a i)))))).IsQuasicoherent :=
    (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent
      (Spec (CommRingCat.of (Localization.Away (a i)))).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
        e.symm inferInstance
  exact aux_basicOpen_of_isQuasicoherent_restrict M (a i)

name: QCPushforward.isQuasicoherent_pushforward_ι
statement:
theorem isQuasicoherent_pushforward_ι (V : (Spec R).Opens) (hV : IsCompact (V : Set (Spec R)))
    (F : (V : Scheme.{u}).Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward V.ι).obj F).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  set N := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward V.ι).obj F
  haveI : (N.restrict V.ι).IsQuasicoherent :=
    (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent (V : Scheme.{u}).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso V.ι).app F).symm
        (inferInstanceAs F.IsQuasicoherent)
  refine isQuasicoherent_of_restrict N V hV ?_
  intro W W' hW hVW
  have heq : V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W' = V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W := by
    refine le_antisymm (fun x hx => hW hx) (fun x hx => ?_)
    exact hVW ⟨x.2, hx⟩
  show Function.Bijective (F.presheaf.map ((Opens.map V.ι.base).map (homOfLE hW)).op)
  have : (Opens.map V.ι.base).map (homOfLE hW) = eqToHom heq := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [this]
  exact ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _

name: QCPushforward.isQuasicoherent_of_affine_cover
statement:
theorem isQuasicoherent_of_affine_cover {X : Scheme.{u}} (M : X.Modules)
    (h : ∀ x : X, ∃ (W : X.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W), x ∈ W ∧
      (M.restrict hW.fromSpec).IsQuasicoherent) :
    M.IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  choose W hW hxW hq using h
  let q : SheafOfModules.QuasicoherentData (R := X.ringCatSheaf) M :=
    { I := X
      X := W
      coversTop := by
        rw [Opens.coversTop_iff]
        exact eq_top_iff.mpr fun x _ => Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨x, hxW x⟩
      presentation := fun x => presentationOver M (W x) (presentationRestrictι M (hW x)
        (haveI := hq x; presentationOfIsQuasicoherentSpec _)) }
  exact q.isQuasicoherent

name: QCPushforward.isQuasicoherent_pushforward_opens_ι
statement:
theorem isQuasicoherent_pushforward_opens_ι {X : Scheme.{u}} [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X)) (F : (U : Scheme.{u}).Modules)
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).obj F).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  set M := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).obj F
  apply isQuasicoherent_of_affine_cover
  intro x
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hxW, -⟩ :=
    Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens (Opens.mem_top x)
  refine ⟨W, hW, hxW, ?_⟩
  let φ := hW.fromSpec
  let V : (Spec Γ(X, W)).Opens := φ ⁻¹ᵁ U
  have hrange : Set.range φ = W := hW.range_fromSpec
  have hVc : IsCompact (V : Set (Spec Γ(X, W))) := by
    have hUW : IsCompact ((U : Set X) ∩ W) :=
      QuasiSeparatedSpace.inter_isCompact _ _ U.2 hU W.2 hW.isCompact
    have h1 := (φ.isOpenEmbedding.isInducing.isCompact_preimage_iff
      (K := (U : Set X) ∩ W) (by rw [hrange]; exact Set.inter_subset_right)).2 hUW
    have h2 : φ ⁻¹' ((U : Set X) ∩ W) = (V : Set (Spec Γ(X, W))) := by
      ext y
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_inter_iff, V, Scheme.Hom.coe_preimage,
        SetLike.mem_coe]
      constructor
      · exact fun h => h.1
      · intro h
        have hy : φ y ∈ Set.range φ := Set.mem_range_self y
        rw [hrange] at hy
        exact ⟨h, hy⟩
    rwa [h2] at h1
  have hsub : Set.range (V.ι ≫ φ) ⊆ Set.range U.ι := by
    rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
    rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact y.2
  let k := IsOpenImmersion.lift U.ι (V.ι ≫ φ) hsub
  haveI : IsOpenImmersion k := by
    haveI : IsOpenImmersion (k ≫ U.ι) := by
      rw [IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac]; infer_instance
    exact IsOpenImmersion.of_comp k U.ι
  let e : (M.restrict φ).restrict V.ι ≅ F.restrict k :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp V.ι φ).app M).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr (IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac U.ι (V.ι ≫ φ) hsub).symm).app
        M ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp k U.ι).app M ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor k).mapIso
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso U.ι).app F)
  haveI : ((M.restrict φ).restrict V.ι).IsQuasicoherent :=
    (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent (V : Scheme.{u}).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso e.symm
      inferInstance
  refine isQuasicoherent_of_restrict (M.restrict φ) V hVc ?_
  intro W₁ W₁' hW hVW
  have heq : U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (φ ''ᵁ W₁') = U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (φ ''ᵁ W₁) := by
    refine le_antisymm (fun z hz => ?_) (fun z hz => ?_)
    · obtain ⟨y, hy, hyz⟩ := hz
      exact ⟨y, hW hy, hyz⟩
    · obtain ⟨y, hy, hyz⟩ := hz
      have hyV : y ∈ V := by
        have h' : U.ι.base z ∈ (U : Set X) := by
          rw [← Scheme.Opens.range_ι]; exact Set.mem_range_self z
        have hyz' : φ.base y = U.ι.base z := hyz
        show φ.base y ∈ (U : Set X)
        rw [hyz']
        exact h'
      exact ⟨y, hVW ⟨hyV, hy⟩, hyz⟩
  show Function.Bijective (F.presheaf.map
    ((Opens.map U.ι.base).map (φ.opensFunctor.map (homOfLE hW))).op)
  have : (Opens.map U.ι.base).map (φ.opensFunctor.map (homOfLE hW)) = eqToHom heq :=
    Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [this]
  exact ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.algebraMap_ne_zero_of_irreducible
statement:
theorem algebraMap_ne_zero_of_irreducible {ϖ : R} (hϖ : Irreducible ϖ) :
    algebraMap R K ϖ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ne, map_eq_zero_iff _ (IsFractionRing.injective R K)]
  exact hϖ.ne_zero

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.smul_zpow_inj
statement:
theorem smul_zpow_inj {ϖ : R} (hϖ : Irreducible ϖ) {n m : ℤ} {u v : Rˣ}
    (h : u • algebraMap R K ϖ ^ n = v • algebraMap R K ϖ ^ m) : n = m ∧ u = v
proof:
:= by
  have hπ := algebraMap_ne_zero_of_irreducible (K := K) hϖ
  set N : ℕ := (-n).toNat + (-m).toNat with hN
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : ℕ, (a : ℤ) = n + N := ⟨(n + N).toNat, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)⟩
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b : ℕ, (b : ℤ) = m + N := ⟨(m + N).toNat, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)⟩
  have e : ∀ (w : Rˣ) (k : ℤ) (c : ℕ), (c : ℤ) = k + N →
      algebraMap R K ((w : R) * ϖ ^ c) =
        (w • algebraMap R K ϖ ^ k) * algebraMap R K ϖ ^ (N : ℤ) := by
    intro w k c hc
    rw [Units.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def, mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ hπ, ← hc, map_mul, map_pow,
      zpow_natCast]
  have h' : algebraMap R K ((u : R) * ϖ ^ a) = algebraMap R K ((v : R) * ϖ ^ b) := by
    rw [e u n a ha, e v m b hb, h]
  have h'' := IsFractionRing.injective R K h'
  have hab := unit_mul_pow_congr_pow hϖ hϖ u v a b h''
  subst hab
  exact ⟨by omega, unit_mul_pow_congr_unit hϖ u v a a h''⟩

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.irreducible_unif
statement: theorem irreducible_unif : Irreducible (unif R)
proof: := (exists_irreducible R).choose_spec

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.exists_smul_zpow_unif
statement:
theorem exists_smul_zpow_unif (x : Kˣ) :
    ∃ (n : ℤ) (u : Rˣ), (x : K) = u • algebraMap R K (unif R) ^ n
proof:
:=
  exists_units_eq_smul_zpow_of_irreducible (irreducible_unif R) x.ne_zero

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.coe_eq_unitPart_smul
statement:
theorem coe_eq_unitPart_smul (x : Kˣ) :
    (x : K) = unitPart R x • algebraMap R K (unif R) ^ ord R x
proof:
:=
  (exists_smul_zpow_unif (R := R) x).choose_spec.choose_spec

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.ord_unitPart_eq
statement:
theorem ord_unitPart_eq {x : Kˣ} {n : ℤ} {u : Rˣ}
    (h : (x : K) = u • algebraMap R K (unif R) ^ n) : ord R x = n ∧ unitPart R x = u
proof:
:=
  smul_zpow_inj (irreducible_unif R) ((coe_eq_unitPart_smul R x).symm.trans h)

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.algebraMap_units_zpow
statement:
theorem algebraMap_units_zpow (v : Rˣ) (k : ℤ) :
    algebraMap R K ((v ^ k : Rˣ) : R) = algebraMap R K (v : R) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg Units.val (map_zpow (Units.map (algebraMap R K : R →* K)) v k)
  rw [Units.val_zpow_eq_zpow_val, Units.coe_map, Units.coe_map] at this
  exact this

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.ord_eq_of_eq_smul_zpow
statement:
theorem ord_eq_of_eq_smul_zpow {ϖ : R} (hϖ : Irreducible ϖ) {x : Kˣ} {n : ℤ} {u : Rˣ}
    (h : (x : K) = u • algebraMap R K ϖ ^ n) : ord R x = n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := associated_of_irreducible R hϖ (irreducible_unif R)
  
  have hπ0 := algebraMap_ne_zero_of_irreducible (K := K) (irreducible_unif R)
  have hϖ' : algebraMap R K ϖ = algebraMap R K ((w⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) * algebraMap R K (unif R) := by
    rw [← hw, ← map_mul, mul_left_comm, Units.inv_mul, mul_one]
  refine (ord_unitPart_eq (u := u * (w⁻¹) ^ n) ?_).1
  rw [h, hϖ', mul_zpow, ← algebraMap_units_zpow, Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def,
    Units.val_mul, map_mul, mul_assoc]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.smul_zpow_mul_smul_zpow
statement:
theorem smul_zpow_mul_smul_zpow (π : K) (hπ : π ≠ 0) (u v : Rˣ) (n m : ℤ) :
    (u • π ^ n) * (v • π ^ m) = (u * v) • π ^ (n + m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def,
    Algebra.smul_def, zpow_add₀ hπ, Units.val_mul, map_mul]
  ring

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.ord_unitPart_mul
statement:
theorem ord_unitPart_mul (x y : Kˣ) :
    ord R (x * y) = ord R x + ord R y ∧ unitPart R (x * y) = unitPart R x * unitPart R y
proof:
:= by
  apply ord_unitPart_eq
  rw [Units.val_mul, coe_eq_unitPart_smul R x, coe_eq_unitPart_smul R y,
    smul_zpow_mul_smul_zpow _ (algebraMap_ne_zero_of_irreducible (irreducible_unif R))]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.ord_mul
statement: theorem ord_mul (x y : Kˣ) : ord R (x * y) = ord R x + ord R y
proof: := (ord_unitPart_mul x y).1

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.unitPart_mul
statement: theorem unitPart_mul (x y : Kˣ) : unitPart R (x * y) = unitPart R x * unitPart R y
proof:
:=
  (ord_unitPart_mul x y).2

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.ord_unitPart_one
statement: theorem ord_unitPart_one : ord R (1 : Kˣ) = 0 ∧ unitPart R (1 : Kˣ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply ord_unitPart_eq
  simp

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.ord_one
statement: theorem ord_one : ord R (1 : Kˣ) = 0
proof: := (ord_unitPart_one (K := K)).1

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.unitPart_one
statement: theorem unitPart_one : unitPart R (1 : Kˣ) = 1
proof: := (ord_unitPart_one (K := K)).2

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.ord_inv
statement: theorem ord_inv (x : Kˣ) : ord R x⁻¹ = - ord R x
proof:
:= by
  have := ord_mul (R := R) x x⁻¹
  rw [mul_inv_cancel, ord_one] at this
  omega

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.unitPart_inv
statement: theorem unitPart_inv (x : Kˣ) : unitPart R x⁻¹ = (unitPart R x)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have := unitPart_mul (R := R) x x⁻¹
  rw [mul_inv_cancel, unitPart_one] at this
  exact (eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right this.symm)

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.ord_zpow
statement: theorem ord_zpow (x : Kˣ) (k : ℤ) : ord R (x ^ k) = k * ord R x
proof:
:= by
  let f : Kˣ →* Multiplicative ℤ :=
    { toFun := fun y => Multiplicative.ofAdd (ord R y)
      map_one' := by simp [ord_one]
      map_mul' := fun y z => by simp [ord_mul] }
  have := map_zpow f x k
  simpa [f, mul_comm] using congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd this

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.unitPart_zpow
statement: theorem unitPart_zpow (x : Kˣ) (k : ℤ) : unitPart R (x ^ k) = unitPart R x ^ k

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.addVal_eq_ord
statement:
theorem addVal_eq_ord {r : R} (hr : r ≠ 0) (x : Kˣ) (hx : (x : K) = algebraMap R K r) :
    0 ≤ ord R x ∧ addVal R r = ((ord R x).toNat : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, u, hk⟩ := eq_unit_mul_pow_irreducible hr (irreducible_unif R)
  have hord : ord R x = k := by
    apply (ord_unitPart_eq (u := u) _).1
    rw [hx, hk, zpow_natCast, Units.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, map_pow]
  refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
  rw [hord, Int.toNat_natCast, addVal_def r u (irreducible_unif R) k hk]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.length_quotient_span_eq_ord
statement:
theorem length_quotient_span_eq_ord {r : R} (hr : r ≠ 0) (x : Kˣ)
    (hx : (x : K) = algebraMap R K r) :
    Module.length R (R ⧸ Ideal.span {r}) = ((ord R x).toNat : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, u, hk⟩ := eq_unit_mul_pow_irreducible hr (irreducible_unif R)
  have hord : ord R x = k := by
    apply (ord_unitPart_eq (u := u) _).1
    rw [hx, hk, zpow_natCast, Units.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, map_pow]
  have hspan : Ideal.span {r} = maximalIdeal R ^ k := by
    rw [hk, Ideal.span_singleton_mul_left_unit u.isUnit, (irreducible_unif R).maximalIdeal_eq,
      Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
  rw [hspan, length_quotient_pow_maximalIdeal, hord, Int.toNat_natCast]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.algebraMap_tameUnit
statement:
theorem algebraMap_tameUnit (a b : Kˣ) :
    algebraMap R K (tameUnit R a b : R) =
      (-1) ^ (ord R a * ord R b) * (a : K) ^ ord R b / (b : K) ^ ord R a
proof:
:= by
  have hπ := algebraMap_ne_zero_of_irreducible (K := K) (irreducible_unif R)
  have hub : algebraMap R K (unitPart R b : R) ≠ 0 :=
    ((unitPart R b).isUnit.map (algebraMap R K)).ne_zero
  have ha := coe_eq_unitPart_smul R a
  have hb := coe_eq_unitPart_smul R b
  rw [Units.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def] at ha hb
  rw [ha, hb, tameUnit, Units.val_mul, Units.val_mul, map_mul, map_mul, map_units_inv,
    algebraMap_units_zpow, algebraMap_units_zpow, algebraMap_units_zpow,
    Units.val_neg, Units.val_one, map_neg, map_one]
  generalize ord R a = n at *
  generalize ord R b = m at *
  generalize algebraMap R K (unif R) = π at *
  generalize algebraMap R K (unitPart R a : R) = ua at *
  generalize algebraMap R K (unitPart R b : R) = ub at *
  have hp : π ^ (n * m) ≠ 0 := zpow_ne_zero _ hπ
  rw [mul_zpow, mul_zpow, ← zpow_mul, ← zpow_mul, mul_comm m n, mul_div_assoc,
    mul_div_mul_right _ _ hp, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.tame_eq_residue_tameUnit
statement:
theorem tame_eq_residue_tameUnit (a b : Kˣ) :
    (tame R a b : ResidueField R) = residue R (tameUnit R a b : R)
proof: := rfl

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.tame_eq_residue
statement:
theorem tame_eq_residue (a b : Kˣ) (c : R)
    (hc : algebraMap R K c = (-1) ^ (ord R a * ord R b) * (a : K) ^ ord R b / (b : K) ^ ord R a) :
    (tame R a b : ResidueField R) = residue R c
proof:
:= by
  rw [tame_eq_residue_tameUnit]
  congr 1
  apply IsFractionRing.injective R K
  rw [hc, algebraMap_tameUnit]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.tameUnit_mul_left
statement:
theorem tameUnit_mul_left (a a' b : Kˣ) :
    tameUnit R (a * a') b = tameUnit R a b * tameUnit R a' b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tameUnit, ord_mul, unitPart_mul, add_mul, zpow_add, mul_zpow, mul_inv]
  simp only [mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.tameUnit_mul_tameUnit_swap
statement: theorem tameUnit_mul_tameUnit_swap (a b : Kˣ) : tameUnit R a b * tameUnit R b a = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tameUnit]
  rw [mul_comm (ord R b) (ord R a)]
  have h1 : ((-1 : Rˣ) ^ (ord R a * ord R b)) * (-1) ^ (ord R a * ord R b) = 1 := by
    rw [← zpow_add]
    exact Even.neg_one_zpow ⟨_, rfl⟩
  calc _ = ((-1 : Rˣ) ^ (ord R a * ord R b) * (-1) ^ (ord R a * ord R b)) *
        (unitPart R a ^ ord R b * (unitPart R a ^ ord R b)⁻¹) *
        (unitPart R b ^ ord R a * (unitPart R b ^ ord R a)⁻¹) := by
          simp only [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
    _ = 1 := by rw [h1, mul_inv_cancel, mul_inv_cancel, one_mul, one_mul]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.tameUnit_swap
statement: theorem tameUnit_swap (a b : Kˣ) : tameUnit R b a = (tameUnit R a b)⁻¹
proof:
:=
  eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right (tameUnit_mul_tameUnit_swap a b)

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.tameUnit_mul_right
statement:
theorem tameUnit_mul_right (a b b' : Kˣ) :
    tameUnit R a (b * b') = tameUnit R a b * tameUnit R a b'
proof:
:= by
  rw [tameUnit_swap, tameUnit_mul_left, mul_inv, ← tameUnit_swap, ← tameUnit_swap]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.neg_one_zpow_mul_self
statement:
theorem neg_one_zpow_mul_self {G : Type*} [Monoid G] [HasDistribNeg G] (u : Gˣ) (n : ℤ)
    (hu : u = -1) : u ^ (n * n) = u ^ n
proof:
:= by
  subst hu
  rcases Int.even_or_odd n with h | h
  · rw [Even.neg_one_zpow h, Even.neg_one_zpow (h.mul_right n)]
  · rw [Odd.neg_one_zpow h, Odd.neg_one_zpow (h.mul h)]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.tameUnit_self
statement: theorem tameUnit_self (a : Kˣ) : tameUnit R a a = (-1) ^ ord R a
proof:
:= by
  rw [tameUnit, mul_inv_cancel_right, neg_one_zpow_mul_self _ _ rfl]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.tameUnit_of_ord_eq_zero
statement:
theorem tameUnit_of_ord_eq_zero (a b : Kˣ) (ha : ord R a = 0) :
    tameUnit R a b = unitPart R a ^ ord R b
proof:
:= by
  rw [tameUnit, ha, zero_mul, zpow_zero, zpow_zero, inv_one, one_mul, mul_one]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.algebraMap_unitPart_of_ord_eq_zero
statement:
theorem algebraMap_unitPart_of_ord_eq_zero (a : Kˣ) (ha : ord R a = 0) :
    algebraMap R K (unitPart R a : R) = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_eq_unitPart_smul R a, ha, zpow_zero, Units.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def, mul_one]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.tame_mul_left
statement: theorem tame_mul_left (a a' b : Kˣ) : tame R (a * a') b = tame R a b * tame R a' b
proof:
:= by
  rw [tame, tameUnit_mul_left, map_mul]; rfl

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.tame_mul_right
statement: theorem tame_mul_right (a b b' : Kˣ) : tame R a (b * b') = tame R a b * tame R a b'
proof:
:= by
  rw [tame, tameUnit_mul_right, map_mul]; rfl

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.tame_mul_tame_swap
statement: theorem tame_mul_tame_swap (a b : Kˣ) : tame R a b * tame R b a = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [tame, tame, ← map_mul, tameUnit_mul_tameUnit_swap, map_one]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.tame_swap
statement: theorem tame_swap (a b : Kˣ) : tame R b a = (tame R a b)⁻¹
proof:
:=
  eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right (tame_mul_tame_swap a b)

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.tame_self
statement: theorem tame_self (a : Kˣ) : tame R a a = (-1) ^ ord R a
proof:
:= by
  rw [tame, tameUnit_self, map_zpow]
  congr 1

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.tame_of_ord_eq_zero
statement:
theorem tame_of_ord_eq_zero (a b : Kˣ) (ha : ord R a = 0) :
    tame R a b = Units.map (residue R : R →* ResidueField R) (unitPart R a) ^ ord R b
proof:
:= by
  rw [tame, tameUnit_of_ord_eq_zero a b ha, map_zpow]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.tame_of_ord_eq_zero_of_ord_eq_zero
statement:
theorem tame_of_ord_eq_zero_of_ord_eq_zero (a b : Kˣ) (ha : ord R a = 0) (hb : ord R b = 0) :
    tame R a b = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [tame_of_ord_eq_zero a b ha, hb, zpow_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLBC.pencil_gysinCycles_comm
statement:
theorem pencil_gysinCycles_comm (n : ℕ) (α : dimensionCycles X (n + 1 + 1)) :
    gysinCycles (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj (pc'.L g'))
        (hasConstantRank_restrict (pc'.L g') (pc'.hL g') ι) (wPullbackSection ι (pc'.s g')) j n
        (lbRep (k := k) ι (pc.W g) (pc.hW g ι hι) (pc.t g) (n + 1) α) =
      gysinCycles (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι').obj (pc.L g))
        (hasConstantRank_restrict (pc.L g) (pc.hL g) ι') (wPullbackSection ι' (pc.s g)) j' n
        (lbRep (k := k) ι' (pc'.W g') (pc'.hW g' ι' hι') (pc'.t g') (n + 1) α)
proof:
:=
  gysinCycles_comm_of_charts (k := k) (pc.hW g ι hι) (pc'.hW g' ι' hι') (pc.isSupport g ι hι)
    (pc'.isSupport g' ι' hι') (pc.principalOn g) (pc'.principalOn g') (pc.e g) (pc.he g)
    (pc'.e g') (pc'.he g') j j' hJ hJcov n α

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLBC.pencil_gysinDescends
statement: theorem pencil_gysinDescends (n : ℕ) : GysinDescends (k := k) (pc.L g) (pc.hL g) (pc.s g) ι n
proof:
:=
  gysinDescends_of_chart (k := k) (pc.hW g ι hι) (pc.isSupport g ι hι) (pc.principalOn g)
    (pc.e g) (pc.he g) n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLBC.pencil_gysinDescends_restrict
statement:
theorem pencil_gysinDescends_restrict (hj : ∀ z, z ∈ Set.range j ↔ ι z ∈ Set.range ι')
    (n : ℕ) :
    GysinDescends (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj (pc'.L g'))
      (hasConstantRank_restrict (pc'.L g') (pc'.hL g') ι) (wPullbackSection ι (pc'.s g')) j n
proof:
:=
  gysinDescends_restrict_of_chart (k := k) j
    (range_comp_subset_preimage j j' hJ (pc'.hW g' ι' hι'))
    (isSupport_restrict (pc'.isSupport g' ι' hι') j hj) (pc'.principalOn g') (pc'.e g')
    (pc'.he g') n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLBC.pencil_gysinChow_comm
statement:
theorem pencil_gysinChow_comm (n : ℕ)
    (hd : GysinDescends (k := k) (pc.L g) (pc.hL g) (pc.s g) ι (n + 1))
    (hd' : GysinDescends (k := k) (pc'.L g') (pc'.hL g') (pc'.s g') ι' (n + 1))
    (hdZ : GysinDescends (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj (pc'.L g'))
      (hasConstantRank_restrict (pc'.L g') (pc'.hL g') ι) (wPullbackSection ι (pc'.s g')) j n)
    (hdZ' : GysinDescends (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι').obj (pc.L g))
      (hasConstantRank_restrict (pc.L g) (pc.hL g) ι') (wPullbackSection ι' (pc.s g)) j' n)
    (ξ : DimChow X (n + 1 + 1)) :
    gysinChow hdZ (gysinChow hd ξ) = gysinChow hdZ' (gysinChow hd' ξ)
proof:
:=
  gysinChow_comm_of_charts (k := k) (pc.hW g ι hι) (pc'.hW g' ι' hι') (pc.isSupport g ι hι)
    (pc'.isSupport g' ι' hι') (pc.principalOn g) (pc'.principalOn g') (pc.e g) (pc.he g)
    (pc'.e g') (pc'.he g') j j' hJ hJcov n hd hd' hdZ hdZ' ξ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLBC.p1_gysinCycles_comm
statement:
theorem p1_gysinCycles_comm (n : ℕ) (α : dimensionCycles X (n + 1 + 1)) :
    gysinCycles (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj (lineAt g' c'))
        (hasConstantRank_restrict _ ((pencilP1 k c').hL g') ι)
        (wPullbackSection ι ((pencilP1 k c').s g')) j n
        (lbRep (k := k) ι ((pencilP1 k c).W g) ((pencilP1 k c).hW g ι (rangeAt g c ι hι))
          ((pencilP1 k c).t g) (n + 1) α) =
      gysinCycles (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι').obj (lineAt g c))
        (hasConstantRank_restrict _ ((pencilP1 k c).hL g) ι')
        (wPullbackSection ι' ((pencilP1 k c).s g)) j' n
        (lbRep (k := k) ι' ((pencilP1 k c').W g') ((pencilP1 k c').hW g' ι' (rangeAt g' c' ι' hι'))
          ((pencilP1 k c').t g') (n + 1) α)
proof:
:=
  pencil_gysinCycles_comm (k := k) (pencilP1 k c) (pencilP1 k c') g g' ι (rangeAt g c ι hι) ι'
    (rangeAt g' c' ι' hι') j j' hJ hJcov n α

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.restrictFn_eq_germEqs
statement:
theorem restrictFn_eq_germEqs (t : Γ(X, ⊤)) (w : X) (z : pointClosureScheme w) :
    restrictFn t w = algebraMap ((pointClosureScheme w).presheaf.stalk z)
      (pointClosureScheme w).functionField (germEqs ((pointClosureι w).appTop t) z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← algebraMap_stalkMap_germEqs t w z, germEqs_appTop]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.ffHom_restrictFn
statement:
theorem ffHom_restrictFn (f : X ⟶ Y) (t : Γ(Y, ⊤)) (v : X)
    (g : pointClosureScheme v ⟶ pointClosureScheme (f v))
    (hg : g ≫ pointClosureι (f v) = pointClosureι v ≫ f) [IsDominant g] :
    (ffHom g).hom (restrictFn t (f v)) = restrictFn (f.appTop t) v
proof:
:= by
  set η := genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v)
  rw [restrictFn_eq_germEqs t (f v) (g η), ffHom_algebraMap_stalk g η,
    restrictFn_eq_germEqs (f.appTop t) v η]
  congr 1
  have h1 := congrFun (germEqs_appTop g ((pointClosureι (f v)).appTop t)) η
  rw [← show (germEqs ((pointClosureι (f v)).appTop t)).pullback g η =
      (g.stalkMap η).hom (germEqs ((pointClosureι (f v)).appTop t) (g η)) from rfl, ← h1]
  congr 1
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, hg, Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop,
    CommRingCat.comp_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.height_map_eq
statement:
theorem height_map_eq (n : ℕ) {v : X} (hv : height v = n + 1) (hdeg : f.degree v ≠ 0) :
    height (f v) = n + 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := heightCompatible_of_finiteType k f
  exact (h v hdeg).trans hv

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.isUnit_appTop_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem isUnit_appTop_of_isUnit {v : X} (hu : IsUnit (germEqs t (f v))) :
    IsUnit (germEqs (f.appTop t) v)
proof:
:=
  (isUnit_germEqs_appTop_iff f t v).mpr hu

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.pf_transGen_aux
statement:
theorem pf_transGen_aux (v : X) :
    ∃ g : pointClosureScheme v ⟶ pointClosureScheme (f v),
      g ≫ pointClosureι (f v) = pointClosureι v ≫ f ∧ IsProper g ∧ IsDominant g ∧
        g.degree (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v)) = f.degree v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := D16.exists_factor f v
  haveI : IsProper (g ≫ pointClosureι (f v)) := by rw [hg]; infer_instance
  haveI : IsProper g := IsProper.of_comp g (pointClosureι (f v))
  have hηv : pointClosureι v (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v)) = v := by
    rw [← C1Cap.pointClosureGenericPoint_eq_genericPoint, pointClosureι_genericPoint]
  have hηw : pointClosureι (f v) (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme (f v))) = f v := by
    rw [← C1Cap.pointClosureGenericPoint_eq_genericPoint, pointClosureι_genericPoint]
  have hgen : g (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v)) =
      genericPoint (pointClosureScheme (f v)) := by
    apply (pointClosureι (f v)).isClosedEmbedding.injective
    rw [hηw, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hg, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hηv]
  haveI : IsDominant g := isDominant_of_map_genericPoint g hgen
  refine ⟨g, hg, inferInstance, inferInstance, ?_⟩
  have h1 := hom_degree_comp (pointClosureι v) f (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v))
  have h2 := hom_degree_comp g (pointClosureι (f v)) (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v))
  rw [hg] at h2
  rw [hηv, Scheme.Hom.degree_eq_one_of_isClosedImmersion (pointClosureι v), one_mul] at h1
  rw [Scheme.Hom.degree_eq_one_of_isClosedImmersion (pointClosureι (f v)), mul_one] at h2
  exact h2.symm.trans h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.pf_transGen_cycle_eq
statement:
theorem pf_transGen_cycle_eq (n : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = n + 1)
    (hu : IsUnit (germEqs (f.appTop t) v))
    (g : pointClosureScheme v ⟶ pointClosureScheme (f v))
    (hg : g ≫ pointClosureι (f v) = pointClosureι v ≫ f) [IsDominant g] [QuasiCompact g] :
    properPushforward f (transGen (k := k) (f.appTop t) n v hv hu).cycle.1 =
      properPushforward (pointClosureι (f v))
        (properPushforward g (div ((ffHom g).hom (restrictFn t (f v)))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [ffHom_restrictFn f t v g hg]
  change properPushforward f (properPushforward (pointClosureι v) _) = _
  rw [← properPushforward_comp, properPushforward_congr hg.symm, properPushforward_comp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.pf_transGen_cycle_ne
statement:
theorem pf_transGen_cycle_ne (n : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = n + 1)
    (hu : IsUnit (germEqs t (f v))) (hdeg : f.degree v ≠ 0) :
    properPushforward f (transGen (k := k) (f.appTop t) n v hv
        (isUnit_appTop_of_isUnit f t hu)).cycle.1 =
      (f.degree v : ℤ) • (transGen (k := k) t n (f v)
        (height_map_eq (k := k) f n hv hdeg) hu).cycle.1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hP, hD, hgdeg⟩ := pf_transGen_aux f v
  letI : (pointClosureScheme v).Over (Spk k) := ⟨pointClosureι v ≫ X ↘ Spk k⟩
  letI : (pointClosureScheme (f v)).Over (Spk k) := ⟨pointClosureι (f v) ≫ Y ↘ Spk k⟩
  haveI : g.IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨by
    change g ≫ pointClosureι (f v) ≫ Y ↘ Spk k = pointClosureι v ≫ X ↘ Spk k
    rw [← Category.assoc, hg, Category.assoc, CategoryTheory.comp_over (f := f) (S := Spk k)]⟩
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType ((pointClosureScheme v) ↘ Spk k) := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (pointClosureι v ≫ X ↘ Spk k)
    infer_instance
  rw [pf_transGen_cycle_eq (k := k) f t n v hv _ g hg,
    D16.pf_div_ffHom_ne k g (by rw [hgdeg]; exact hdeg) _ (restrictFn_ne_zero t (f v) hu), hgdeg]
  exact map_zsmul (properPushforwardHom (pointClosureι (f v))) _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.pf_transGen_cycle_zero
statement:
theorem pf_transGen_cycle_zero (n : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = n + 1)
    (hu : IsUnit (germEqs t (f v))) (hdeg : f.degree v = 0) :
    properPushforward f (transGen (k := k) (f.appTop t) n v hv
        (isUnit_appTop_of_isUnit f t hu)).cycle.1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hP, hD, hgdeg⟩ := pf_transGen_aux f v
  letI : (pointClosureScheme v).Over (Spk k) := ⟨pointClosureι v ≫ X ↘ Spk k⟩
  letI : (pointClosureScheme (f v)).Over (Spk k) := ⟨pointClosureι (f v) ≫ Y ↘ Spk k⟩
  haveI : g.IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨by
    change g ≫ pointClosureι (f v) ≫ Y ↘ Spk k = pointClosureι v ≫ X ↘ Spk k
    rw [← Category.assoc, hg, Category.assoc, CategoryTheory.comp_over (f := f) (S := Spk k)]⟩
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType ((pointClosureScheme v) ↘ Spk k) := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (pointClosureι v ≫ X ↘ Spk k)
    infer_instance
  rw [pf_transGen_cycle_eq (k := k) f t n v hv _ g hg,
    D16.pf_div_ffHom_zero k g (by rw [hgdeg]; exact hdeg) _ (restrictFn_ne_zero t (f v) hu),
    properPushforward_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.divCycPrime_id_eq
statement:
theorem divCycPrime_id_eq (n : ℕ) (w : X) (hw : height w = n + 1) (s : Γ(X, ⊤))
    (hu : IsUnit (germEqs s w)) :
    (divCycPrime (k := k) s (𝟙 X) n w).1 = (transGen (k := k) s n w hw hu).cycle.1
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  rw [divCycPrime_apply (k := k) s (𝟙 X) n w hw z, transGen_cycle_apply]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.divCycPrime_eq_zero
statement:
theorem divCycPrime_eq_zero (n : ℕ) (w : X) (s : Γ(X, ⊤)) (hu : ¬ IsUnit (germEqs s w))
    {Z : Scheme.{u}} [Z.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Z ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian Z]
    (ι : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι] [ι.IsOver (Spk k)] :
    divCycPrime (k := k) s ι n w = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold divCycPrime
  rw [dif_neg (fun h ↦ hu h.2)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.pf_divCyc_prime
statement:
theorem pf_divCyc_prime (n : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = n + 1) :
    properPushforward f (divCyc (k := k) (f.appTop t) (𝟙 X) n (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv)).1 =
      (divCyc (k := k) t (𝟙 Y) n (D13.pfHom (k := k) f (n + 1) (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv))).1
proof:
:= by
  rw [divCyc_dimPrimeCycle]
  by_cases hdeg : f.degree v = 0
  · 
    have hz : D13.pfHom (k := k) f (n + 1) (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv) = 0 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      ext y
      change properPushforward f (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv).1 y = 0
      rw [D16.pf_prime_apply]
      simp [hdeg]
    rw [hz, map_zero]
    by_cases hu : IsUnit (germEqs t (f v))
    · rw [divCycPrime_id_eq (k := k) n v hv _ (isUnit_appTop_of_isUnit f t hu),
        pf_transGen_cycle_zero (k := k) f t n v hv hu hdeg]
      rfl
    · rw [divCycPrime_eq_zero (k := k) n v _ (fun h ↦ hu ((isUnit_germEqs_appTop_iff f t v).mp h)),
        ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, properPushforward_zero]
      rfl
  · have hw : height (f v) = n + 1 := height_map_eq (k := k) f n hv hdeg
    have hpf : D13.pfHom (k := k) f (n + 1) (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv) =
        (f.degree v : ℤ) • dimPrimeCycle (f v) (n + 1) hw := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      ext y
      change properPushforward f (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv).1 y =
        (f.degree v : ℤ) * (dimPrimeCycle (f v) (n + 1) hw).1 y
      rw [D16.pf_prime_apply, m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply]
      by_cases hy : f v = y
      · subst hy; simp
      · rw [if_neg hy, if_neg (Ne.symm hy)]; simp
    rw [hpf, map_zsmul, divCyc_dimPrimeCycle]
    by_cases hu : IsUnit (germEqs t (f v))
    · rw [divCycPrime_id_eq (k := k) n v hv _ (isUnit_appTop_of_isUnit f t hu),
        pf_transGen_cycle_ne (k := k) f t n v hv hu hdeg]
      change _ = (f.degree v : ℤ) • (divCycPrime (k := k) t (𝟙 Y) n (f v)).1
      rw [divCycPrime_id_eq (k := k) n (f v) hw t hu]
    · rw [divCycPrime_eq_zero (k := k) n v _ (fun h ↦ hu ((isUnit_germEqs_appTop_iff f t v).mp h)),
        divCycPrime_eq_zero (k := k) n (f v) t hu, smul_zero, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero,
        properPushforward_zero]
      rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.pf_divCyc
statement:
theorem pf_divCyc (n : ℕ) (β : dimensionCycles X (n + 1)) :
    D13.pfHom (k := k) f n (divCyc (k := k) (f.appTop t) (𝟙 X) n β) =
      divCyc (k := k) t (𝟙 Y) n (D13.pfHom (k := k) f (n + 1) β)
proof:
:= by
  have key : β ∈ AddMonoidHom.eqLocus
      ((D13.pfHom (k := k) f n).comp (divCyc (k := k) (f.appTop t) (𝟙 X) n))
      ((divCyc (k := k) t (𝟙 Y) n).comp (D13.pfHom (k := k) f (n + 1))) := by
    refine D13.dimCycle_mem_of_prime _ (fun v hv ↦ ?_) β
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact pf_divCyc_prime (k := k) f t n v hv
  exact key

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLB.presheaf_map_map_g2xlb
statement:
theorem presheaf_map_map_g2xlb (N : S.Modules) {U V T : S.Opens} (h1 : V ≤ U) (h2 : T ≤ V)
    (x : Γ(N, U)) :
    N.presheaf.map (homOfLE h2).op (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE h1).op x) =
      N.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h2.trans h1)).op x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLB.wFrameSec_restrict_wCoord
statement:
theorem wFrameSec_restrict_wCoord {x : S} (d : WFrame M x) (e : Γ(M, ⊤)) (V : S.Opens)
    (hV : V ≤ d.U) :
    wFrameSec d V hV (S.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op (wCoord d e)) =
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op e
proof:
:= by
  rw [D39.wFrameSec_restrict d d.U V le_rfl hV (wCoord d e), wCoord_spec, presheaf_map_map_g2xlb]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLB.germ_wCoord_change
statement:
theorem germ_wCoord_change {x : S} (d d' : WFrame M x) (e : Γ(M, ⊤)) :
    ∃ a : S.presheaf.stalk x, IsUnit a ∧
      S.presheaf.germ d'.U x d'.mem (wCoord d' e) =
        S.presheaf.germ d.U x d.mem (wCoord d e) * a
proof:
:= by
  have hV : d.U ⊓ d'.U ≤ d.U := inf_le_left
  have hV' : d.U ⊓ d'.U ≤ d'.U := inf_le_right
  have hx : x ∈ d.U ⊓ d'.U := ⟨d.mem, d'.mem⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := d'.exists_coord _ hV' (wFrameSec d _ hV 1)
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := d.exists_coord _ hV (wFrameSec d' _ hV' 1)
  have hab : a * b = 1 := by
    apply D39.wFrameSec_injective d _ hV
    rw [wFrameSec_smul d _ hV (a * b), mul_smul, ← wFrameSec_smul d _ hV b, hb,
      ← wFrameSec_smul d' _ hV' a, ha]
  have hc : S.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV').op (wCoord d' e) =
      S.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op (wCoord d e) * a := by
    apply D39.wFrameSec_injective d' _ hV'
    rw [wFrameSec_restrict_wCoord, wFrameSec_smul d' _ hV' (_ * a), mul_smul,
      ← wFrameSec_smul d' _ hV' a, ha, ← wFrameSec_smul d _ hV, wFrameSec_restrict_wCoord]
  refine ⟨S.presheaf.germ _ x hx a, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one (S.presheaf.germ _ x hx b) ?_
    rw [← map_mul, hab, map_one]
  · have h := congrArg (S.presheaf.germ _ x hx) hc
    rw [map_mul, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply] at h
    exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLB.wCoord_pullbackWFrame
statement:
theorem wCoord_pullbackWFrame {Y : Scheme.{u}} (j : Y ⟶ S) {x : S} (d : WFrame M x)
    (e : Γ(M, ⊤)) (p : Y) (hp : j p ∈ d.U) :
    wCoord (WFrame.ofData (pullbackWFrame j d p hp)) (wPullbackSection j e) =
      j.app d.U (wCoord d e)
proof:
:= by
  apply D39.wFrameSec_injective (WFrame.ofData (pullbackWFrame j d p hp)) _ le_rfl
  rw [wCoord_spec]
  exact (wFrameSec_pullbackWFrame j d e (wCoord d e) (wCoord_spec d e) p hp).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLB.isUnit_eqOfSection_pullback
statement:
theorem isUnit_eqOfSection_pullback {Y : Scheme.{u}} (j : Y ⟶ S) (hM : HasConstantRank S M 1)
    (hMY : HasConstantRank Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj M) 1) (e : Γ(M, ⊤)) (p : Y)
    (hu : IsUnit (eqOfSection M hM e (j p))) :
    IsUnit (eqOfSection _ hMY (wPullbackSection j e) p)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, h⟩ := germ_wCoord_change
    (WFrame.ofData (pullbackWFrame j (wFrameAt M hM (j p)) p (wFrameAt M hM (j p)).mem))
    (wFrameAt _ hMY p) (wPullbackSection j e)
  unfold eqOfSection
  rw [h]
  refine IsUnit.mul ?_ ha
  rw [wCoord_pullbackWFrame]
  have h2 := Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply j (wFrameAt M hM (j p)).U p
    (wFrameAt M hM (j p)).mem (wCoord (wFrameAt M hM (j p)) e)
  refine (congrArg IsUnit h2).mp ?_
  exact hu.map _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLB.primeCapOrZero_eq_zero_of_units
statement:
theorem primeCapOrZero_eq_zero_of_units (M : Y.Modules) (hM : HasConstantRank Y M 1)
    (e : Γ(M, ⊤)) (he : ∀ y, IsUnit (eqOfSection M hM e y)) (n : ℕ) (v : Y) :
    D5.primeCapOrZero (k := k) M hM n v = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hv : height v = n + 1
  · obtain ⟨C, hC, hCv⟩ := D39.repW_of_isUnit (k := k) hM e n v hv (he v)
    have h0 : C = 0 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      ext y
      rw [hCv y, c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_isUnit _ v y (he y)]
      rfl
    rw [hC, h0, QuotientAddGroup.mk_zero]
  · rw [D5.primeCapOrZero, dif_neg hv]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLB.principalOn_of_sections
statement:
theorem principalOn_of_sections (e : Γ(L, ⊤)) (W : X.Opens) (t : Γ(X, W))
    (he : ∀ y ∈ W, IsUnit (eqOfSection L hL e y))
    (hst : L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op s =
      t • L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op e) :
    PrincipalOn L hL s W t
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  have hV : (wFrameAt L hL y).U ⊓ W ≤ (wFrameAt L hL y).U := inf_le_left
  have hVW : (wFrameAt L hL y).U ⊓ W ≤ W := inf_le_right
  have hyV : y ∈ (wFrameAt L hL y).U ⊓ W := ⟨(wFrameAt L hL y).mem, hy⟩
  have hc : X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op (wCoord (wFrameAt L hL y) s) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVW).op t *
        X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op (wCoord (wFrameAt L hL y) e) := by
    apply D39.wFrameSec_injective (wFrameAt L hL y) _ hV
    rw [wFrameSec_restrict_wCoord, wFrameSec_smul (wFrameAt L hL y) _ hV (_ * _), mul_smul,
      ← wFrameSec_smul (wFrameAt L hL y) _ hV, wFrameSec_restrict_wCoord]
    have h := congrArg (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVW).op) hst
    rw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul, presheaf_map_map_g2xlb, presheaf_map_map_g2xlb] at h
    exact h
  refine ⟨eqOfSection L hL e y, he y hy, ?_⟩
  have h := congrArg (X.presheaf.germ _ y hyV) hc
  rw [map_mul, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply,
    TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply] at h
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLB.c1CapPrimeCoeff_congr_unit
statement:
theorem c1CapPrimeCoeff_congr_unit (a b : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (v y : X)
    (u : X.presheaf.stalk y) (hu : IsUnit u) (h : a y = b y * u) :
    C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a v y = C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff b v y
proof:
:= by
  unfold C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff
  split_ifs with h1
  · rw [h, mul_comm, CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity_unit_mul hu]
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLB.eqs_eq_chartEqs
statement:
theorem eqs_eq_chartEqs (W : X.Opens) (t : Γ(X, W)) (hP : PrincipalOn L hL s W t) (y : X)
    (hy : y ∈ W) : ∃ a : X.presheaf.stalk y, IsUnit a ∧
      eqOfSection L hL s y = chartEqs W t y * a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, h⟩ := hP y hy
  exact ⟨a, ha, by rw [chartEqs_of_mem W t hy]; exact h⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLB.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eqs_chart
statement:
theorem c1CapPrimeCoeff_eqs_chart (W : X.Opens) (t : Γ(X, W)) (hP : PrincipalOn L hL s W t)
    (x z : W.toScheme) :
    C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (eqOfSection L hL s) (W.ι x) (W.ι z) =
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs (W.topIso.inv t)) x z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, h⟩ := eqs_eq_chartEqs W t hP (W.ι z) z.2
  rw [c1CapPrimeCoeff_congr_unit _ (chartEqs W t) _ _ a ha h,
    c1CapPrimeCoeff_openImm W.ι (chartEqs W t) x z, germEqs_topIso_inv]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLB.isUnit_eqs_iff_chart
statement:
theorem isUnit_eqs_iff_chart (W : X.Opens) (t : Γ(X, W)) (hP : PrincipalOn L hL s W t)
    (x : W.toScheme) :
    IsUnit (eqOfSection L hL s (W.ι x)) ↔ IsUnit (germEqs (W.topIso.inv t) x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, h⟩ := eqs_eq_chartEqs W t hP (W.ι x) x.2
  rw [isUnit_germEqs_topIso_inv_iff W t x, h]
  exact ha.mul_right_iff

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLB.liftW_fac
statement: theorem liftW_fac : liftW ι W hW ≫ W.ι = ι
proof: := IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLB.liftW_apply
statement: theorem liftW_apply (z : Z) : W.ι (liftW ι W hW z) = ι z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, liftW_fac]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLB.resW_apply
statement:
theorem resW_apply (n : ℕ) (D : dimensionCycles X n) (x : W.toScheme) :
    (resW (k := k) W n D).1 x = D.1 (W.ι x)
proof:
:= by
  change flatPullback W.ι D.1 x = D.1 (W.ι x)
  rw [flatPullback_apply, flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion, Nat.cast_one, mul_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLB.resW_mem_dimRationalEquivalence
statement:
theorem resW_mem_dimRationalEquivalence (n : ℕ) (D : dimensionCycles X n)
    (hD : D ∈ dimRationalEquivalence X n) :
    resW (k := k) W n D ∈ dimRationalEquivalence W.toScheme n
proof:
:=
  flatPullback_mem_dimRationalEquivalence W.ι (dimensionCatenary_of_finiteType k)
    (pureRelDim_openImmersion k W.ι) D hD

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLB.isZeroLocus_liftW
statement:
theorem isZeroLocus_liftW (hZ : IsSupport L hL s ι) (hP : PrincipalOn L hL s W t) :
    IsZeroLocus (W.topIso.inv t) (liftW ι W hW)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  rw [← isUnit_eqs_iff_chart W t hP x, ← hZ (W.ι x)]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨z, (liftW_apply ι W hW z).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
    refine ⟨z, W.ι.isOpenEmbedding.injective ?_⟩
    rw [liftW_apply, hz]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLB.excess_eq_zero
statement:
theorem excess_eq_zero (e : Γ(L, ⊤)) (he : ∀ z, IsUnit (eqOfSection L hL e (ι z))) (n : ℕ)
    (z₀ : Z) :
    D5.primeCapOrZero (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj L)
      (hasConstantRank_restrict L hL ι) n z₀ = 0
proof:
:=
  primeCapOrZero_eq_zero_of_units (k := k) _ _ (wPullbackSection ι e)
    (fun z ↦ isUnit_eqOfSection_pullback ι hL _ e z (he z)) n z₀

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLB.gysinPrime_eq_mk
statement:
theorem gysinPrime_eq_mk (hexc : ∀ n z₀, D5.primeCapOrZero (k := k)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj L) (hasConstantRank_restrict L hL ι) n z₀ = 0)
    (n : ℕ) (w : X) (hw : height w = n + 1) :
    ∃ R : dimensionCycles X n, gysinPrime (k := k) L hL s ι n w =
        QuotientAddGroup.mk (restrictHom ι n R) ∧
      ∀ y, R.1 y = if IsUnit (eqOfSection L hL s w) then
        C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (eqOfSection L hL s) w y else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hu : IsUnit (eqOfSection L hL s w)
  · refine ⟨transverseCycle (k := k) L hL s n w hw hu, ?_, fun y ↦ ?_⟩
    · rw [gysinPrime, dif_pos hw, dif_pos hu]
    · rw [if_pos hu]
      exact transverseCycle_apply (k := k) L hL s n w hw hu y
  · refine ⟨0, ?_, fun y ↦ ?_⟩
    · rw [gysinPrime, dif_pos hw, dif_neg hu, map_zero, QuotientAddGroup.mk_zero]
      split_ifs with hz
      · exact hexc n _
      · rfl
    · rw [if_neg hu]
      rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLB.gysinCycles_eq_divIntCycles_resW
statement:
theorem gysinCycles_eq_divIntCycles_resW (hP : PrincipalOn L hL s W t)
    (hexc : ∀ n z₀, D5.primeCapOrZero (k := k)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj L) (hasConstantRank_restrict L hL ι) n z₀ = 0)
    (n : ℕ) (D : dimensionCycles X (n + 1)) :
    gysinCycles (k := k) L hL s ι n D =
      divIntCycles (k := k) (W.topIso.inv t) (liftW ι W hW) n (resW (k := k) W (n + 1) D)
proof:
:= by
  set fs := compactCycleFinsupp D.1 with hfs
  have hsupp : ∀ v, v ∈ fs.support ↔ D.1 v ≠ 0 := fun v ↦ by
    rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, hfs, compactCycleFinsupp_apply]
  have hcod : ∀ v, D.1 v ≠ 0 → height v = n + 1 := fun v hv ↦ D.2 hv
  
  let R' : X → dimensionCycles X n := fun w ↦
    if h : height w = n + 1 then
      (gysinPrime_eq_mk (k := k) (L := L) (hL := hL) (s := s) ι hexc n w h).choose
    else 0
  have hRep : ∀ w ∈ fs.support, gysinPrime (k := k) L hL s ι n w =
      (QuotientAddGroup.mk (restrictHom ι n (R' w)) : DimChow Z n) := by
    intro w hw
    have hc := hcod w ((hsupp w).mp hw)
    simp only [R', dif_pos hc]
    exact (gysinPrime_eq_mk (k := k) (L := L) (hL := hL) (s := s) ι hexc n w hc).choose_spec.1
  have hRepv : ∀ w ∈ fs.support, ∀ y, (R' w).1 y = if IsUnit (eqOfSection L hL s w) then
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (eqOfSection L hL s) w y else 0 := by
    intro w hw y
    have hc := hcod w ((hsupp w).mp hw)
    simp only [R', dif_pos hc]
    exact (gysinPrime_eq_mk (k := k) (L := L) (hL := hL) (s := s) ι hexc n w hc).choose_spec.2 y
  have hL1 : gysinCycles (k := k) L hL s ι n D =
      QuotientAddGroup.mk (restrictHom ι n (fs.sum fun w m ↦ m • R' w)) := by
    change fs.sum (fun v m ↦ m • gysinPrime (k := k) L hL s ι n v) = _
    rw [Finsupp.sum_congr (g2 := fun v m ↦
      m • (QuotientAddGroup.mk (restrictHom ι n (R' v)) : DimChow Z n)) fun v hv ↦ by
        rw [hRep v hv]]
    have := map_finsuppSum ((QuotientAddGroup.mk' (dimRationalEquivalence Z n)).comp
      (restrictHom ι n)) fs (fun v m ↦ m • R' v)
    simp only [map_zsmul, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, QuotientAddGroup.mk'_apply] at this
    exact this.symm
  rw [hL1, divIntCycles_eq_mk_divCyc]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext z
  
  let F : X → ℤ := fun w ↦ D.1 w * if IsUnit (eqOfSection L hL s w) then
    C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (eqOfSection L hL s) w (ι z) else 0
  have hFsupp : Function.support F ⊆ ↑fs.support := by
    intro v hv
    rw [Finset.mem_coe, hsupp]
    exact left_ne_zero_of_mul hv
  have hFW : Function.support F ⊆ Set.range W.ι := by
    intro v hv
    rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
    have h2 := right_ne_zero_of_mul hv
    split_ifs at h2 with hu
    · by_contra hvW
      apply h2
      apply C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_not_specializes
      intro hsp
      exact hvW (hsp.mem_open W.isOpen (hW ⟨z, rfl⟩))
    · exact absurd rfl h2
  
  have hLHS : (restrictHom ι n (fs.sum fun w m ↦ m • R' w)).1 z = ∑ᶠ w, F w := by
    rw [restrictHom_apply]
    change D6.evalHomD X n (ι z) (fs.sum fun w m ↦ m • R' w) = _
    rw [map_finsuppSum]
    simp only [map_zsmul, smul_eq_mul]
    change ∑ w ∈ fs.support, fs w * (R' w).1 (ι z) = _
    rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ hFsupp]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun w hw ↦ ?_
    rw [hRepv w hw (ι z), hfs, compactCycleFinsupp_apply]
  
  have hRHS : (divCyc (k := k) (W.topIso.inv t) (liftW ι W hW) n
      (resW (k := k) W (n + 1) D)).1 z = ∑ᶠ x : W.toScheme, F (W.ι x) := by
    rw [divCyc_apply]
    unfold C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff
    refine finsum_congr fun x ↦ ?_
    rw [resW_apply]
    simp only [F]
    congr 1
    split_ifs with hu
    · rw [← liftW_apply ι W hW z, c1CapPrimeCoeff_eqs_chart W t hP]
    · exact c1CapPrimeCoeff_germEqs_of_not_isUnit _
        (fun h ↦ hu ((isUnit_eqs_iff_chart W t hP x).mpr h)) _
  rw [hLHS, hRHS, ← finsum_mem_range W.ι.isOpenEmbedding.injective, ← finsum_mem_univ F]
  refine (finsum_mem_inter_support_eq F _ _ ?_).symm
  ext v
  simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_univ, true_and, and_iff_right_iff_imp]
  exact fun hv ↦ hFW hv

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLB.gysinDescends_of_principalDescends
statement:
theorem gysinDescends_of_principalDescends (hP : PrincipalOn L hL s W t)
    (hexc : ∀ n z₀, D5.primeCapOrZero (k := k)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj L) (hasConstantRank_restrict L hL ι) n z₀ = 0)
    (n : ℕ) (h : DivIntDescends (k := k) (W.topIso.inv t) (liftW ι W hW) n) :
    GysinDescends (k := k) L hL s ι n
proof:
:= by
  intro g
  rw [gysinCycles_eq_divIntCycles_resW (k := k) ι W hW hP hexc n g.cycle,
    ← divIntChow_mk h]
  have hr := resW_mem_dimRationalEquivalence (k := k) W (n + 1) g.cycle
    (AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨g, rfl⟩)
  rw [(QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff _).mpr hr, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLB.gysinDescends_of_principalGate
statement:
theorem gysinDescends_of_principalGate (hZ : IsSupport L hL s ι)
    (hP : PrincipalOn L hL s W t)
    (hexc : ∀ n z₀, D5.primeCapOrZero (k := k)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj L) (hasConstantRank_restrict L hL ι) n z₀ = 0)
    (n : ℕ) (himp : DivImproperGate (k := k) (W.topIso.inv t) (liftW ι W hW) n) :
    GysinDescends (k := k) L hL s ι n
proof:
:=
  gysinDescends_of_principalDescends hW hP hexc n
    (divIntDescends_of_improperGate (isZeroLocus_liftW ι W hW hZ hP) n himp)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLB.improperGate_of_principalGate
statement:
theorem improperGate_of_principalGate (hZ : IsSupport L hL s ι)
    (hP : PrincipalOn L hL s W t)
    (hexc : ∀ n z₀, D5.primeCapOrZero (k := k)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj L) (hasConstantRank_restrict L hL ι) n z₀ = 0)
    (n : ℕ) (himp : DivImproperGate (k := k) (W.topIso.inv t) (liftW ι W hW) n) :
    ImproperGate (k := k) L hL s ι n
proof:
:=
  fun g _ _ ↦ gysinDescends_of_principalGate hW hZ hP hexc n himp g

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLB.gysinDescends_of_affineChart
statement:
theorem gysinDescends_of_affineChart [IsAffine W.toScheme] (hZ : IsSupport L hL s ι)
    (hP : PrincipalOn L hL s W t)
    (hexc : ∀ n z₀, D5.primeCapOrZero (k := k)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj L) (hasConstantRank_restrict L hL ι) n z₀ = 0)
    (n : ℕ) : GysinDescends (k := k) L hL s ι n
proof:
:=
  gysinDescends_of_principalDescends hW hP hexc n
    (G2XDESC.divIntDescends_of_isAffine (k := k) (W.topIso.inv t) (liftW ι W hW)
      (isZeroLocus_liftW ι W hW hZ hP) n)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLB.excess_eq_zero_of_sections
statement:
theorem excess_eq_zero_of_sections (n : ℕ) (z₀ : Z) :
    D5.primeCapOrZero (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj L)
      (hasConstantRank_restrict L hL ι) n z₀ = 0
proof:
:=
  excess_eq_zero (k := k) ι L hL e (fun z ↦ he _ (hW ⟨z, rfl⟩)) n z₀

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLB.gysinDescends_of_sections
statement:
theorem gysinDescends_of_sections (hZ : IsSupport L hL s ι) (n : ℕ)
    (himp : DivImproperGate (k := k) (W.topIso.inv t) (liftW ι W hW) n) :
    GysinDescends (k := k) L hL s ι n
proof:
:=
  gysinDescends_of_principalGate hW hZ (principalOn_of_sections L hL s e W t he hst)
    (excess_eq_zero_of_sections (k := k) hW e he) n himp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLB.improperGate_of_sections
statement:
theorem improperGate_of_sections (hZ : IsSupport L hL s ι) (n : ℕ)
    (himp : DivImproperGate (k := k) (W.topIso.inv t) (liftW ι W hW) n) :
    ImproperGate (k := k) L hL s ι n
proof:
:=
  fun g _ _ ↦ gysinDescends_of_sections hW e he hst hZ n himp g

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLB.gysinDescends_of_sections_affine
statement:
theorem gysinDescends_of_sections_affine [IsAffine W.toScheme] (hZ : IsSupport L hL s ι)
    (n : ℕ) : GysinDescends (k := k) L hL s ι n
proof:
:=
  gysinDescends_of_affineChart hW hZ (principalOn_of_sections L hL s e W t he hst)
    (excess_eq_zero_of_sections (k := k) hW e he) n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLB.fibreInt_tmul
statement:
theorem fibreInt_tmul (hZ : IsSupport L hL s ι) (n : ℕ)
    (himp : DivImproperGate (k := k) (W.topIso.inv t) (liftW ι W hW) n) (q : ℚ)
    (D : dimensionCycles X (n + 1)) :
    fibreInt hW e he hst hZ n himp (q ⊗ₜ QuotientAddGroup.mk D) =
      q ⊗ₜ gysinCycles (k := k) L hL s ι n D
proof:
:=
  rationalGysin_tmul _ q D

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLB.push_fibreInt
statement:
theorem push_fibreInt (hZ : IsSupport L hL s ι) (n : ℕ)
    (himp : DivImproperGate (k := k) (W.topIso.inv t) (liftW ι W hW) n)
    (hX : D5.CapDescends (k := k) L hL n) (ξ : RationalDimChow X (n + 1)) :
    D9.properPushforwardRationalDimChowD9 (k := k) ι n (fibreInt hW e he hst hZ n himp ξ) =
      D5.rationalCap (k := k) L hL n hX ξ
proof:
:=
  push_rationalGysin hZ _ hX ξ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLB.improperGate_of_principalGateHolds
statement:
theorem improperGate_of_principalGateHolds (H : PrincipalGateHolds k)
    (hZ : IsSupport L hL s ι) (hP : PrincipalOn L hL s W t)
    (hexc : ∀ n z₀, D5.primeCapOrZero (k := k)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj L) (hasConstantRank_restrict L hL ι) n z₀ = 0)
    (n : ℕ) : ImproperGate (k := k) L hL s ι n
proof:
:=
  improperGate_of_principalGate hW hZ hP hexc n
    (H W.toScheme Z (W.topIso.inv t) (liftW ι W hW) (isZeroLocus_liftW ι W hW hZ hP) n)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLB.gysinDescends_of_principalGateHolds
statement:
theorem gysinDescends_of_principalGateHolds (H : PrincipalGateHolds k)
    (hZ : IsSupport L hL s ι) (hP : PrincipalOn L hL s W t)
    (hexc : ∀ n z₀, D5.primeCapOrZero (k := k)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj L) (hasConstantRank_restrict L hL ι) n z₀ = 0)
    (n : ℕ) : GysinDescends (k := k) L hL s ι n
proof:
:=
  gysinDescends_of_principalGate hW hZ hP hexc n
    (H W.toScheme Z (W.topIso.inv t) (liftW ι W hW) (isZeroLocus_liftW ι W hW hZ hP) n)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLB.gysinDescends_of_sections_of_principalGateHolds
statement:
theorem gysinDescends_of_sections_of_principalGateHolds (H : PrincipalGateHolds k)
    (e : Γ(L, ⊤)) (he : ∀ y ∈ W, IsUnit (eqOfSection L hL e y))
    (hst : L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op s =
      t • L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op e)
    (hZ : IsSupport L hL s ι) (n : ℕ) : GysinDescends (k := k) L hL s ι n
proof:
:=
  gysinDescends_of_sections hW e he hst hZ n
    (H W.toScheme Z (W.topIso.inv t) (liftW ι W hW)
      (isZeroLocus_liftW ι W hW hZ (principalOn_of_sections L hL s e W t he hst)) n)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XS.pointAt_mem_chartOne
statement:
theorem pointAt_mem_chartOne (c : k) (y : Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :
    pointAt k c y ∈ (chartOpen k 1).1
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartOpen_val]
  exact ⟨_, (Scheme.Hom.comp_apply _ _ y).symm⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XS.disjoint_pointAt_pointInf
statement:
theorem disjoint_pointAt_pointInf (c : k) :
    Disjoint (Set.range (pointAt k c)) (Set.range (pointInf k))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩ ⟨y', hy'⟩
  exact pointInf_not_mem k y' (hy' ▸ pointAt_mem_chartOne k c y)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XS.exists_pencilP1
statement:
theorem exists_pencilP1 (c : k) : ∃ pc : Pencil (P1 k),
    pc.S = Set.range (pointAt k c) ∧ pc.S' = Set.range (pointInf k)
proof:
:= by
  have hd := A5CD.exists_cartierData_P1_two_points k c
  obtain ⟨𝓛, h𝓛, σc, σi, -, -, hc, hi⟩ := hd
  exact ⟨⟨𝓛, h𝓛, E26.sectionOfHom σc, E26.sectionOfHom σi, Set.range (pointAt k c),
    Set.range (pointInf k), isZeroSet_of_ker h𝓛 σc _ hc, isZeroSet_of_ker h𝓛 σi _ hi,
    (pointAt k c).isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range,
    (pointInf k).isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range, disjoint_pointAt_pointInf k c⟩, rfl, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XS.pencilP1_S
statement: theorem pencilP1_S (c : k) : (pencilP1 k c).S = Set.range (pointAt k c)
proof:
:=
  (exists_pencilP1 k c).choose_spec.1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XS.pencilP1_S'
statement: theorem pencilP1_S' (c : k) : (pencilP1 k c).S' = Set.range (pointInf k)
proof:
:=
  (exists_pencilP1 k c).choose_spec.2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XS.range_fibreι
statement: theorem range_fibreι : Set.range (fibreι g p) = g ⁻¹' Set.range p
proof:
:=
  Scheme.Pullback.range_fst g p

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XS.rangeAt
statement: theorem rangeAt : Set.range ι = g ⁻¹' (pencilP1 k c).S
proof: := by rw [pencilP1_S, hι]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XS.rangeInf
statement: theorem rangeInf : Set.range ι' = g ⁻¹' (pencilP1 k c).swap.S
proof:
:= by
  change _ = g ⁻¹' (pencilP1 k c).S'
  rw [pencilP1_S', hι']

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XS.fibreIntAt_tmul
statement:
theorem fibreIntAt_tmul (n : ℕ) (q : ℚ) (D : dimensionCycles X (n + 1)) :
    fibreIntAt g c ι hι n (q ⊗ₜ QuotientAddGroup.mk D) =
      q ⊗ₜ gysinCycles (k := k) (lineAt g c) ((pencilP1 k c).hL g) ((pencilP1 k c).s g) ι n D
proof:
:=
  (pencilP1 k c).fibreInt_tmul g ι _ n q D

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XS.push_fibreIntAt_tmul
statement:
theorem push_fibreIntAt_tmul (n : ℕ) (q : ℚ) (D : dimensionCycles X (n + 1)) :
    D9.properPushforwardRationalDimChowD9 (k := k) ι n
        (fibreIntAt g c ι hι n (q ⊗ₜ QuotientAddGroup.mk D)) =
      q ⊗ₜ D5.capCycles (k := k) (lineAt g c) ((pencilP1 k c).hL g) n D
proof:
:=
  (pencilP1 k c).push_fibreInt_tmul g ι _ n q D

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XS.push_fibreIntAt
statement:
theorem push_fibreIntAt (n : ℕ) (hX : D5.CapDescends (k := k) (lineAt g c) ((pencilP1 k c).hL g) n)
    (ξ : RationalDimChow X (n + 1)) :
    D9.properPushforwardRationalDimChowD9 (k := k) ι n (fibreIntAt g c ι hι n ξ) =
      D5.rationalCap (k := k) (lineAt g c) ((pencilP1 k c).hL g) n hX ξ
proof:
:=
  (pencilP1 k c).push_fibreInt g ι _ n hX ξ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XS.push_fibreIntAt_eq_push_fibreIntInf
statement:
theorem push_fibreIntAt_eq_push_fibreIntInf (n : ℕ) (ξ : RationalDimChow X (n + 1)) :
    D9.properPushforwardRationalDimChowD9 (k := k) ι n (fibreIntAt g c ι hι n ξ) =
      D9.properPushforwardRationalDimChowD9 (k := k) ι' n (fibreIntInf g c ι' hι' n ξ)
proof:
:=
  (pencilP1 k c).push_fibreInt_swap g ι _ ι' _ n ξ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XS.push_fibreIntAt_tmul_eq_push_fibreIntInf
statement:
theorem push_fibreIntAt_tmul_eq_push_fibreIntInf (n : ℕ) (q : ℚ)
    (D : dimensionCycles X (n + 1)) :
    D9.properPushforwardRationalDimChowD9 (k := k) ι n
        (fibreIntAt g c ι hι n (q ⊗ₜ QuotientAddGroup.mk D)) =
      D9.properPushforwardRationalDimChowD9 (k := k) ι' n
        (fibreIntInf g c ι' hι' n (q ⊗ₜ QuotientAddGroup.mk D))
proof:
:=
  push_fibreIntAt_eq_push_fibreIntInf g c ι hι ι' hι' n _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XS.push_fibre_zero_eq_inf_fund
statement:
theorem push_fibre_zero_eq_inf_fund [IsIntegral X] (n : ℕ)
    (hX : height (genericPoint X) = n + 1)
    (ι₀ : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι₀] [ι₀.IsOver (Spk k)]
    (hι₀ : Set.range ι₀ = g ⁻¹' Set.range (pointAt k 0)) :
    D9.properPushforwardRationalDimChowD9 (k := k) ι₀ n
        (fibreIntAt g 0 ι₀ hι₀ n (1 ⊗ₜ QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint X) (n + 1)
          (by exact_mod_cast hX)))) =
      D9.properPushforwardRationalDimChowD9 (k := k) ι' n
        (fibreIntInf g 0 ι' hι' n (1 ⊗ₜ QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint X) (n + 1)
          (by exact_mod_cast hX))))
proof:
:=
  push_fibreIntAt_eq_push_fibreIntInf g 0 ι₀ hι₀ ι' hι' n _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XS.push_fibreIntP1_eq
statement:
theorem push_fibreIntP1_eq (n : ℕ) (ξ : RationalDimChow X (n + 1)) :
    D9.properPushforwardRationalDimChowD9 (k := k) (fibreι g (pointAt k c)) n
        (fibreIntP1 g c n ξ) =
      D9.properPushforwardRationalDimChowD9 (k := k) (fibreι g (pointInf k)) n
        (fibreIntP1Inf g c n ξ)
proof:
:=
  push_fibreIntAt_eq_push_fibreIntInf g c _ _ _ _ n ξ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.homogeneousMonomial_mem_grade
statement:
theorem homogeneousMonomial_mem_grade (n : ℕ) (c : A) :
    homogeneousMonomial I n c ∈ grade I (n • 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hn : n • (1 : ℕ) = n := by simp
  rw [hn]
  unfold homogeneousMonomial
  split_ifs with hc
  · change monomial n c = monomial n ((monomial n c).coeff n)
    simp
  · exact (grade I n).zero_mem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.elt_val
statement:
theorem elt_val (n : ℕ) (c : A) :
    (elt I r n c).val = Localization.mk (homogeneousMonomial I n c)
      (⟨generator I r ^ n, n, rfl⟩ : Submonoid.powers (generator I r))
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.homogeneousMonomial_add
statement:
theorem homogeneousMonomial_add (n : ℕ) {c d : A} (hc : c ∈ I ^ n) (hd : d ∈ I ^ n) :
    homogeneousMonomial I n (c + d) = homogeneousMonomial I n c + homogeneousMonomial I n d
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [Subalgebra.coe_add, homogeneousMonomial_coe I n _ (add_mem hc hd),
    homogeneousMonomial_coe I n _ hc, homogeneousMonomial_coe I n _ hd, map_add]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.homogeneousMonomial_mul
statement:
theorem homogeneousMonomial_mul (m n : ℕ) {c d : A} (hc : c ∈ I ^ m) (hd : d ∈ I ^ n) :
    homogeneousMonomial I (m + n) (c * d) =
      homogeneousMonomial I m c * homogeneousMonomial I n d
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [Subalgebra.coe_mul, homogeneousMonomial_coe I (m + n) _ (by
      rw [pow_add]; exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hc hd),
    homogeneousMonomial_coe I m _ hc, homogeneousMonomial_coe I n _ hd, monomial_mul_monomial]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.elt_add
statement:
theorem elt_add (n : ℕ) {c d : A} (hc : c ∈ I ^ n) (hd : d ∈ I ^ n) :
    elt I r n (c + d) = elt I r n c + elt I r n d
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_add, elt_val, elt_val, elt_val, Localization.add_mk_self,
    homogeneousMonomial_add I n hc hd]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.elt_mul
statement:
theorem elt_mul (m n : ℕ) {c d : A} (hc : c ∈ I ^ m) (hd : d ∈ I ^ n) :
    elt I r (m + n) (c * d) = elt I r m c * elt I r n d
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul, elt_val, elt_val, elt_val, Localization.mk_mul,
    homogeneousMonomial_mul I m n hc hd]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [pow_add]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.elt_zero
statement: theorem elt_zero (c : A) : elt I r 0 c = baseElement I r c
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  rw [elt_val, baseElement, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [homogeneousMonomial_coe I 0 c (by simp)]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.elt_one_self
statement: theorem elt_one_self : elt I r 1 r.1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  have h : homogeneousMonomial I 1 r.1 = generator I r := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [homogeneousMonomial_coe I 1 r.1 (by rw [pow_one]; exact r.2)]
    rfl
  rw [elt_val, HomogeneousLocalization.val_one, h, Localization.mk_eq_mk',
    IsLocalization.mk'_eq_iff_eq_mul]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.elt_one_ratio
statement: theorem elt_one_ratio : elt I r 1 s.1 = ratioElement I r s
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  rw [elt_val, ratioElement, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [homogeneousMonomial_coe I 1 s.1 (by rw [pow_one]; exact s.2)]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.isPolyRatio_add
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hy
  exact ⟨p + q, (eval₂_add _ _).symm⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.isPolyRatio_mul
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hy
  exact ⟨p * q, (eval₂_mul _ _).symm⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.isPolyRatio_base
statement: theorem isPolyRatio_base (c : A) : IsPolyRatio (s := s) (baseRingHom I r c)
proof:
:=
  ⟨C c, (eval₂_C _ _).symm⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.isPolyRatio_ratio
statement: theorem isPolyRatio_ratio : IsPolyRatio (s := s) (ratioElement I r s)
proof:
:=
  ⟨X, (eval₂_X _ _).symm⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.isPolyRatio_elt_one
statement:
theorem isPolyRatio_elt_one (hI : I = Ideal.span {r.1, s.1}) {y : A} (hy : y ∈ I) :
    IsPolyRatio (s := s) (elt I r 1 y)
proof:
:= by
  have hy' : y ∈ Ideal.span {r.1, s.1} := hI ▸ hy
  obtain ⟨α, β, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_pair.mp hy'
  have hr1 : r.1 ∈ I ^ 1 := by rw [pow_one]; exact r.2
  have hs1 : s.1 ∈ I ^ 1 := by rw [pow_one]; exact s.2
  have h0 : ∀ c : A, c ∈ I ^ 0 := fun c ↦ by simp
  rw [elt_add I r 1 (by simpa using I.mul_mem_left α r.2) (by simpa using I.mul_mem_left β s.2)]
  have e1 : elt I r 1 (α * r.1) = elt I r 0 α * elt I r 1 r.1 := by
    have := elt_mul I r 0 1 (h0 α) hr1
    simpa using this
  have e2 : elt I r 1 (β * s.1) = elt I r 0 β * elt I r 1 s.1 := by
    have := elt_mul I r 0 1 (h0 β) hs1
    simpa using this
  rw [e1, e2, elt_zero, elt_zero, elt_one_self, elt_one_ratio, ← baseRingHom_apply,
