    ← baseRingHom_apply, mul_one]
  exact isPolyRatio_add (isPolyRatio_base α)
    (isPolyRatio_mul (isPolyRatio_base β) isPolyRatio_ratio)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.isPolyRatio_elt
statement:
theorem isPolyRatio_elt (hI : I = Ideal.span {r.1, s.1}) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (c : A), c ∈ I ^ n → IsPolyRatio (s := s) (elt I r n c)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro c _
    rw [elt_zero, ← baseRingHom_apply]
    exact isPolyRatio_base c
  | succ n ih =>
    intro c hc
    rw [pow_succ] at hc
    have key : c ∈ I ^ n * I ∧ IsPolyRatio (s := s) (elt I r (n + 1) c) := by
      refine Submodule.mul_induction_on hc (C := fun c ↦
        c ∈ I ^ n * I ∧ IsPolyRatio (s := s) (elt I r (n + 1) c)) ?_ ?_
      · intro x hx y hy
        refine ⟨Ideal.mul_mem_mul hx hy, ?_⟩
        rw [elt_mul I r n 1 hx (by simpa using hy)]
        exact isPolyRatio_mul (ih x hx) (isPolyRatio_elt_one r s hI hy)
      · rintro x y ⟨hx, px⟩ ⟨hy, py⟩
        refine ⟨add_mem hx hy, ?_⟩
        rw [elt_add I r (n + 1) (by rw [pow_succ]; exact hx) (by rw [pow_succ]; exact hy)]
        exact isPolyRatio_add px py
    exact key.2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.exists_eval₂_ratio
statement:
theorem exists_eval₂_ratio (hI : I = Ideal.span {r.1, s.1})
    (x : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grade I) (generator I r)) :
    ∃ p : A[X], x = p.eval₂ (baseRingHom I r) (ratioElement I r s)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, y, hy, rfl⟩ :=
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_surjective (grade I) (generator_mem_grade_one I r) x
  have hn : n • (1 : ℕ) = n := by simp
  have hy' : (y : A[X]) = monomial n ((y : A[X]).coeff n) := by
    have h := hy
    rw [hn] at h
    exact h
  have hc : (y : A[X]).coeff n ∈ I ^ n := (mem_reesAlgebra_iff I (y : A[X])).mp y.2 n
  have hyeq : y = homogeneousMonomial I n ((y : A[X]).coeff n) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [homogeneousMonomial_coe I n _ hc]
    exact hy'
  have : HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grade I) (generator_mem_grade_one I r) n y hy =
      elt I r n ((y : A[X]).coeff n) := by
    apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
    rw [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, elt_val]
    congr 1
  rw [this]
  exact isPolyRatio_elt r s hI n _ hc

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.baseRingHom_quotient_surjective
statement:
theorem baseRingHom_quotient_surjective (hI : I = Ideal.span {r.1, s.1}) :
    Function.Surjective
      ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {ratioElement I r s})).comp (baseRingHom I r))
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := exists_eval₂_ratio r s hI x
  refine ⟨p.coeff 0, ?_⟩
  rw [RingHom.comp_apply, Ideal.Quotient.eq]
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := X_dvd_sub_C (p := p)
  have h : p.eval₂ (baseRingHom I r) (ratioElement I r s) - baseRingHom I r (p.coeff 0) =
      ratioElement I r s * q.eval₂ (baseRingHom I r) (ratioElement I r s) := by
    rw [← eval₂_C (baseRingHom I r) (ratioElement I r s), ← eval₂_sub, hq, eval₂_mul, eval₂_X]
  rw [← neg_sub, h]
  exact neg_mem (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span rfl))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.map_baseRingHom_eq_span
statement:
theorem map_baseRingHom_eq_span (hI : I = Ideal.span {r.1, s.1}) :
    I.map (baseRingHom I r) = Ideal.span {baseRingHom I r r.1}
proof:
:= by
  have hs : baseRingHom I r s.1 = baseRingHom I r r.1 * ratioElement I r s := by
    rw [baseRingHom_apply, baseRingHom_apply, baseElement_mul_ratioElement]
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro y hy
    rw [hI] at hy
    obtain ⟨α, β, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_pair.mp hy
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, map_add, map_mul, map_mul, hs]
    refine add_mem (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.subset_span rfl)) ?_
    rw [mul_comm (baseRingHom I r r.1), ← mul_assoc]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.subset_span rfl)
  · rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ r.2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.pair_decomp
statement:
theorem pair_decomp :
    ∃ e a' b' : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grade I) (generator I r),
      e = baseRingHom I r r.1 ∧ baseRingHom I r r.1 = e * a' ∧ baseRingHom I r s.1 = e * b' ∧
        IsCoprime a' b'
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨baseRingHom I r r.1, 1, ratioElement I r s, rfl, (mul_one _).symm, ?_,
    isCoprime_one_left⟩
  rw [baseRingHom_apply, baseRingHom_apply, baseElement_mul_ratioElement]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.eps_local_lt
statement:
theorem eps_local_lt {ι : Type*} (S : Finset ι) (hS : S.Nonempty) (d e x y : ι → ℕ)
    (hd : ∀ i ∈ S, 1 ≤ d i) (he : ∀ i ∈ S, 1 ≤ e i) :
    ∑ i ∈ S, e i * x i < (∑ i ∈ S, d i * (e i + x i)) * (∑ i ∈ S, d i * (e i + y i))
proof:
:= by
  set P := ∑ i ∈ S, d i * (e i + x i)
  set Q := ∑ i ∈ S, d i * (e i + y i)
  have heQ : ∀ i ∈ S, e i ≤ Q := by
    intro i hi
    calc e i ≤ d i * (e i + y i) := by
          calc e i ≤ e i + y i := Nat.le_add_right _ _
            _ = 1 * (e i + y i) := (one_mul _).symm
            _ ≤ d i * (e i + y i) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (hd i hi)
      _ ≤ Q := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j ↦ d j * (e j + y j))
          (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) hi
  have hQ : 1 ≤ Q := by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hS
    exact (he i hi).trans (heQ i hi)
  have hxP : ∑ i ∈ S, x i < P := by
    have h1 : ∑ i ∈ S, x i < ∑ i ∈ S, (e i + x i) :=
      Finset.sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty hS fun i hi ↦ by have := he i hi; omega
    refine h1.trans_le (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi ↦ ?_)
    calc e i + x i = 1 * (e i + x i) := (one_mul _).symm
      _ ≤ d i * (e i + x i) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (hd i hi)
  calc ∑ i ∈ S, e i * x i ≤ ∑ i ∈ S, Q * x i :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi ↦ Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (heQ i hi)
    _ = Q * ∑ i ∈ S, x i := (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
    _ < Q * P := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hxP hQ
    _ = P * Q := Nat.mul_comm _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.eps_lt
statement:
theorem eps_lt {κ ι : Type*} (T : Finset κ) (hT : T.Nonempty) (S : κ → Finset ι)
    (hS : ∀ w ∈ T, (S w).Nonempty) (d e x y : κ → ι → ℕ)
    (hd : ∀ w ∈ T, ∀ i ∈ S w, 1 ≤ d w i) (he : ∀ w ∈ T, ∀ i ∈ S w, 1 ≤ e w i) :
    ∑ w ∈ T, ∑ i ∈ S w, e w i * x w i <
      ∑ w ∈ T, (∑ i ∈ S w, d w i * (e w i + x w i)) * (∑ i ∈ S w, d w i * (e w i + y w i))
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty hT fun w hw ↦
    eps_local_lt (S w) (hS w hw) (d w) (e w) (x w) (y w) (hd w hw) (he w hw)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.eps_lt'
statement:
theorem eps_lt' {κ ι : Type*} (T : Finset κ) (hT : T.Nonempty) (S : κ → Finset ι)
    (hS : ∀ w ∈ T, (S w).Nonempty) (d e x y : κ → ι → ℕ)
    (hd : ∀ w ∈ T, ∀ i ∈ S w, 1 ≤ d w i) (he : ∀ w ∈ T, ∀ i ∈ S w, 1 ≤ e w i) :
    ∑ w ∈ T, ∑ i ∈ S w, e w i * y w i <
      ∑ w ∈ T, (∑ i ∈ S w, d w i * (e w i + x w i)) * (∑ i ∈ S w, d w i * (e w i + y w i))
proof:
:= by
  have h := eps_lt T hT S hS d e y x hd he
  refine h.trans_eq (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun w _ ↦ Nat.mul_comm _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.stalkMap_surjective_openImm
statement: theorem stalkMap_surjective_openImm (z : V) : Function.Surjective (j.stalkMap z).hom
proof:
:=
  (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (j.stalkMap z)).2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.stalkPrime_openImm_eq_comap
statement:
theorem stalkPrime_openImm_eq_comap {x z : V} (h : x ⤳ z) :
    Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (h.map j.continuous) =
      (Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h).comap (j.stalkMap z).hom
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  simp only [Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes, Ideal.mem_comap, IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal,
    mem_nonunits_iff]
  have hsq := j.stalkSpecializes_stalkMap_apply x z h a
  rw [← hsq]
  constructor
  · intro ha hu
    exact ha (IsLocalHom.map_nonunit _ hu)
  · intro ha hu
    exact ha (hu.map _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.localMultiplicity_openImm
statement:
theorem localMultiplicity_openImm {x z : V} (h : x ⤳ z) (a : X.presheaf.stalk (j z)) :
    CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity a (h.map j.continuous) =
      CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity ((j.stalkMap z).hom a) h
proof:
:= by
  unfold CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity
  have : quotientStalkEquivOpen j h (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ ((j.stalkMap z).hom a) := rfl
  rw [← this, LocalOrdSymmetry.ord_ringEquiv]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.specializes_openImm_iff
statement: theorem specializes_openImm_iff {x z : V} : j x ⤳ j z ↔ x ⤳ z
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ (j.isOpenEmbedding.isInducing.specializes_iff).mp h, fun h ↦ h.map j.continuous⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.c1CapPrimeCoeff_openImm
statement:
theorem c1CapPrimeCoeff_openImm (a : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (x z : V) :
    C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a (j x) (j z) = C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (a.pullback j) x z
proof:
:= by
  unfold C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff
  by_cases h : x ⤳ z
  · rw [dif_pos (h.map j.continuous), dif_pos h]
    rw [ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (quotientStalkEquivOpen j h)]
    split_ifs with hd
    · rw [localMultiplicity_openImm j h]
      rfl
    · rfl
  · rw [dif_neg (fun h' ↦ h ((specializes_openImm_iff j).mp h')), dif_neg h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.chartEqs_of_mem
statement:
theorem chartEqs_of_mem (U : Γs.Opens) (ρ : Γ(Γs, U)) {y : Γs} (hy : y ∈ U) :
    chartEqs U ρ y = Γs.presheaf.germ U y hy ρ
proof:
:= by
  unfold chartEqs
  rw [dif_pos hy]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.germEqs_eq_germ
statement:
theorem germEqs_eq_germ (t : Γ(Γs, ⊤)) (U : Γs.Opens) {y : Γs} (hy : y ∈ U) :
    germEqs t y = Γs.presheaf.germ U y hy (t |_ U)
proof:
:= by
  unfold germEqs
  exact (TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply Γs.presheaf (homOfLE le_top) y hy t).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.c1CapPrimeCoeff_chart
statement:
theorem c1CapPrimeCoeff_chart (t u : Γ(Γs, ⊤)) (U U' : Γs.Opens) (ρ : Γ(Γs, U))
    (ρ' : Γ(Γs, U')) (hcov : ∀ y, y ∈ U ∨ y ∈ U')
    (hU : u |_ U = ρ * t |_ U) (hU' : t |_ U' = ρ' * u |_ U')
    (v w : Γs) (ht : IsUnit (germEqs t w)) :
    C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs u) v w = C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (chartEqs U ρ) v w
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hs : v ⤳ w
  swap
  · rw [C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_not_specializes _ hs,
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_not_specializes _ hs]
  
  have hunit : ∀ a : C1Cap.LocalEquations Γs, IsUnit (a w) →
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a v w = 0 := fun a ha ↦ by
    unfold C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff
    rw [dif_pos hs]
    split_ifs
    · rw [CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity_of_isUnit ha]
      rfl
    · rfl
  by_cases hw : w ∈ U
  · 
    have hgerm : germEqs u w = chartEqs U ρ w * germEqs t w := by
      rw [germEqs_eq_germ u U hw, germEqs_eq_germ t U hw, chartEqs_of_mem U ρ hw, hU, map_mul]
    unfold C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff
    rw [dif_pos hs, dif_pos hs, hgerm, mul_comm,
      CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity_unit_mul ht]
  · have hw' : w ∈ U' := (hcov w).resolve_left hw
    
    have hgerm : germEqs t w = Γs.presheaf.germ U' w hw' ρ' * germEqs u w := by
      rw [germEqs_eq_germ u U' hw', germEqs_eq_germ t U' hw', hU', map_mul]
    have hu : IsUnit (germEqs u w) := by
      rw [hgerm] at ht
      exact isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_right ht
    rw [hunit _ hu, hunit _ (by unfold chartEqs; rw [dif_neg hw]; exact isUnit_one)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.iterCoeff_chart
statement:
theorem iterCoeff_chart (t u : Γ(Γs, ⊤)) (U U' : Γs.Opens) (ρ : Γ(Γs, U))
    (ρ' : Γ(Γs, U')) (hcov : ∀ y, y ∈ U ∨ y ∈ U')
    (hU : u |_ U = ρ * t |_ U) (hU' : t |_ U' = ρ' * u |_ U') (α : Γs → ℤ) (y : Γs) :
    C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (germEqs t) (C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (germEqs u) α) y =
      C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (germEqs t) (C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (chartEqs U ρ) α) y
proof:
:= by
  unfold C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff
  congr 1
  funext w
  by_cases ht : IsUnit (germEqs t w)
  · congr 1
    congr 1
    funext v
    rw [c1CapPrimeCoeff_chart t u U U' ρ ρ' hcov hU hU' v w ht]
  · rw [c1CapPrimeCoeff_germEqs_of_not_isUnit t ht, mul_zero, mul_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.fullIter_apply_chart
statement:
theorem fullIter_apply_chart (t u : Γ(Γs, ⊤)) (U U' : Γs.Opens) (ρ : Γ(Γs, U))
    (ρ' : Γ(Γs, U')) (hcov : ∀ y, y ∈ U ∨ y ∈ U')
    (hU : u |_ U = ρ * t |_ U) (hU' : t |_ U' = ρ' * u |_ U') (n : ℕ)
    (α : dimensionCycles Γs (n + 1 + 1)) (y : Γs) :
    (fullIter (k := k) t u n α).1 y =
      C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (germEqs t) (C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (chartEqs U ρ) α.1) y
proof:
:= by
  rw [fullIter_apply, iterCoeff_chart t u U U' ρ ρ' hcov hU hU']

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.isUnit_left_g2xf
statement: theorem isUnit_left_g2xf {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {a b : R} (h : a * b = 1) : IsUnit a
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨a, b, h, by rw [mul_comm]; exact h⟩, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.isUnit_right_g2xf
statement: theorem isUnit_right_g2xf {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {a b : R} (h : a * b = 1) : IsUnit b
proof:
:=
  isUnit_left_g2xf (b := a) (by rw [mul_comm]; exact h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.c1_zero_of_isUnit_g2xf
statement:
theorem c1_zero_of_isUnit_g2xf {X : Scheme.{u}} (a : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (w y : X)
    (hy : IsUnit (a y)) : C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a w y = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff
  split_ifs with h1 h2
  · rw [CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity_of_isUnit hy]
    rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.chartFn_eq
statement:
theorem chartFn_eq (U : Γs.Opens) (ρ : Γ(Γs, U)) (w : Γs) (hw : w ∈ U)
    (z : pointClosureScheme w) (hz : pointClosureι w z ∈ U) :
    algebraMap ((pointClosureScheme w).presheaf.stalk z) (pointClosureScheme w).functionField
      (((pointClosureι w).stalkMap z).hom (Γs.presheaf.germ U (pointClosureι w z) hz ρ)) =
      chartFn U ρ w hw
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty ((pointClosureι w) ⁻¹ᵁ U) := ⟨⟨z, hz⟩⟩
  unfold chartFn
  erw [Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply]
  rw [Scheme.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.germ_mul_germ_eq_one
statement:
theorem germ_mul_germ_eq_one (U U' : Γs.Opens) (ρ : Γ(Γs, U)) (ρ' : Γ(Γs, U'))
    (hinv : ρ |_ (U ⊓ U') * ρ' |_ (U ⊓ U') = 1) {y : Γs} (hy : y ∈ U) (hy' : y ∈ U') :
    Γs.presheaf.germ U y hy ρ * Γs.presheaf.germ U' y hy' ρ' = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Γs.presheaf.germ U y hy ρ = Γs.presheaf.germ (U ⊓ U') y ⟨hy, hy'⟩ (ρ |_ (U ⊓ U')) :=
    (TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply Γs.presheaf (homOfLE inf_le_left) y ⟨hy, hy'⟩ ρ).symm
  have h2 : Γs.presheaf.germ U' y hy' ρ' =
      Γs.presheaf.germ (U ⊓ U') y ⟨hy, hy'⟩ (ρ' |_ (U ⊓ U')) :=
    (TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply Γs.presheaf (homOfLE inf_le_right) y ⟨hy, hy'⟩ ρ').symm
  rw [h1, h2, ← map_mul, hinv, map_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.germ_notMem_stalkPrime
statement:
theorem germ_notMem_stalkPrime (U : Γs.Opens) (ρ : Γ(Γs, U)) {w y : Γs} (h : w ⤳ y)
    (hy : y ∈ U) (hw : IsUnit (Γs.presheaf.germ U w (h.mem_open U.isOpen hy) ρ)) :
    Γs.presheaf.germ U y hy ρ ∉ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  unfold Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes at hmem
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff] at hmem
  apply hmem
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes]
  exact hw

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.two_chart_div
statement:
theorem two_chart_div (U U' : Γs.Opens) (ρ : Γ(Γs, U)) (ρ' : Γ(Γs, U'))
    (hcov : ∀ y, y ∈ U ∨ y ∈ U') (hinv : ρ |_ (U ⊓ U') * ρ' |_ (U ⊓ U') = 1)
    (w : Γs) (hw : w ∈ U) (hw' : w ∈ U') (z : pointClosureScheme w) (hz : coheight z = 1) :
    C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (chartEqs U ρ) w (pointClosureι w z) -
        C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (chartEqs U' ρ') w (pointClosureι w z) =
      (pointClosureScheme w).ord (chartFn U ρ w hw) z
proof:
:= by
  set y := pointClosureι w z with hydef
  have hs : w ⤳ y := C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι w z
  have hunitw : IsUnit (Γs.presheaf.germ U w hw ρ) :=
    isUnit_left_g2xf (germ_mul_germ_eq_one U U' ρ ρ' hinv hw hw')
  have hunitw' : IsUnit (Γs.presheaf.germ U' w hw' ρ') :=
    isUnit_right_g2xf (germ_mul_germ_eq_one U U' ρ ρ' hinv hw hw')
  
  set z0 := pointClosureGenericPoint w
  have hz0 : pointClosureι w z0 = w := pointClosureι_genericPoint w
  have hz0U : pointClosureι w z0 ∈ U := by rw [hz0]; exact hw
  have hz0U' : pointClosureι w z0 ∈ U' := by rw [hz0]; exact hw'
  have hprod : chartFn U ρ w hw * chartFn U' ρ' w hw' = 1 := by
    rw [← chartFn_eq U ρ w hw z0 hz0U, ← chartFn_eq U' ρ' w hw' z0 hz0U', ← map_mul, ← map_mul,
      germ_mul_germ_eq_one U U' ρ ρ' hinv hz0U hz0U', map_one, map_one]
  have hne : chartFn U ρ w hw ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one hprod
  have hne' : chartFn U' ρ' w hw' ≠ 0 := right_ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one hprod
  have hord : (pointClosureScheme w).ord (chartFn U ρ w hw) z +
      (pointClosureScheme w).ord (chartFn U' ρ' w hw') z = 0 := by
    rw [← Scheme.ord_mul hz hne hne', hprod]
    have h11 := Scheme.ord_mul hz (one_ne_zero (α := (pointClosureScheme w).functionField))
      (one_ne_zero (α := (pointClosureScheme w).functionField))
    rw [mul_one] at h11
    omega
  
  have hcoef : ∀ (V : Γs.Opens) (σ : Γ(Γs, V)) (hwV : w ∈ V)
      (hσ : IsUnit (Γs.presheaf.germ V w hwV σ)) (hyV : y ∈ V),
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (chartEqs V σ) w y = (pointClosureScheme w).ord (chartFn V σ w hwV) z := by
    intro V σ hwV hσ hyV
    rw [hydef, C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_ord _ w z hz (by
      rw [chartEqs_of_mem V σ hyV]
      exact germ_notMem_stalkPrime V σ hs hyV hσ)]
    rw [chartEqs_of_mem V σ hyV, chartFn_eq V σ w hwV z hyV]
  have hone : ∀ (V : Γs.Opens) (σ : Γ(Γs, V)), y ∉ V →
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (chartEqs V σ) w y = 0 := by
    intro V σ hyV
    apply c1_zero_of_isUnit_g2xf
    unfold chartEqs
    rw [dif_neg hyV]
    exact isUnit_one
  by_cases hyU : y ∈ U
  · rw [hcoef U ρ hw hunitw hyU]
    by_cases hyU' : y ∈ U'
    · rw [c1_zero_of_isUnit_g2xf _ w y (by
        rw [chartEqs_of_mem U' ρ' hyU']
        exact isUnit_right_g2xf (germ_mul_germ_eq_one U U' ρ ρ' hinv hyU hyU')),
        sub_zero]
    · rw [hone U' ρ' hyU', sub_zero]
  · have hyU' : y ∈ U' := (hcov y).resolve_left hyU
    rw [hone U ρ hyU, hcoef U' ρ' hw' hunitw' hyU']
    omega

name: RRC.SingularTodd.rationalDimChow_mem_of_prime
statement:
theorem rationalDimChow_mem_of_prime (n : ℕ) (M : Submodule ℚ (RationalDimChow X n))
    (h : ∀ (v : X) (hv : height v = n),
      (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v n hv) : DimChow X n) ∈ M)
    (x : RationalDimChow X n) : x ∈ M
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => exact M.zero_mem
  | tmul q c =>
    obtain ⟨D, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective c
    have h1 := m7s_mem_of_prime M Set.univ (fun v hv _ ↦ h v hv) D (Set.subset_univ _)
    have h2 : q ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X n) =
        q • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X n)) := by
      rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    rw [h2]
    exact M.smul_mem q h1
  | add x y hx hy => exact M.add_mem hx hy

name: RRC.SingularTodd.totalChow_ext
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.linearMap_ext ℚ fun n ↦ ?_
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  have hx := rationalDimChow_mem_of_prime n
    (LinearMap.eqLocus (φ ∘ₗ DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) n)
      (ψ ∘ₗ DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) n))
    (fun v hv ↦ LinearMap.mem_eqLocus.mpr (h v n hv)) x
  exact LinearMap.mem_eqLocus.mp hx

name: RRC.SingularTodd.totalChow_span_primeClass
statement:
theorem totalChow_span_primeClass :
    Submodule.span ℚ {x : TotalChow X | ∃ (v : X) (n : ℕ) (hv : height v = n),
      x = primeClassT2 v n hv} = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  set S := Submodule.span ℚ {x : TotalChow X | ∃ (v : X) (n : ℕ) (hv : height v = n),
      x = primeClassT2 v n hv}
  have h : S.mkQ = 0 := totalChow_ext fun v n hv ↦ by
    rw [LinearMap.zero_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨v, n, hv, rfl⟩
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro x _
  have := LinearMap.congr_fun h x
  rwa [LinearMap.zero_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at this

name: RRC.SingularTodd.dimPrimeCycle_eq_properPushforward
statement:
theorem dimPrimeCycle_eq_properPushforward (ι : V ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι] [IsIntegral V]
    (v : X) (hιv : ι (genericPoint V) = v) (n : ℕ) (hv : height v = n)
    (hη : height (genericPoint V) = n) :
    (dimPrimeCycle v n hv).1 = properPushforward ι (dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint V) n hη).1
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [properPushforward_eq_pushforward_closedImmersion ι _ (fun _ : V ↦ ()) (fun _ : X ↦ ())
    (fun _ _ ↦ rfl)]
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.range ι
  · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [pushforward_apply_closedImmersion ι _ (fun _ : V ↦ ()) (fun _ : X ↦ ()) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) y,
      m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply, m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply]
    have hiff : ι y = v ↔ y = genericPoint V := by
      rw [← hιv]
      exact ι.isClosedEmbedding.injective.eq_iff
    by_cases hy : y = genericPoint V
    · rw [if_pos (hiff.mpr hy), if_pos hy]
    · rw [if_neg (fun h ↦ hy (hiff.mp h)), if_neg hy]
  · rw [pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range ι _ (fun _ : V ↦ ()) (fun _ : X ↦ ()) x hx,
      m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply, if_neg]
    rintro rfl
    exact hx ⟨_, hιv⟩

name: RRC.SingularTodd.primeClass_eq_push
statement:
theorem primeClass_eq_push (ι : V ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι] [ι.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsIntegral V]
    (v : X) (hιv : ι (genericPoint V) = v) (n : ℕ) (hv : height v = n)
    (hη : height (genericPoint V) = n) :
    primeClassT2 v n hv = totalPushOn (opsK k) ι (primeClassT2 (genericPoint V) n hη)
proof:
:= by
  unfold primeClassT2 totalPushOn
  rw [DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  congr 1
  exact ((opsK k).push_mk ι n _ _ (dimPrimeCycle_eq_properPushforward ι v hιv n hv hη)).symm

name: RRC.SingularTodd.whitneyK
statement: theorem whitneyK : WhitneyConstRankOn (opsK k) (cpK k) closedPosK
proof:
:= by
  intro X _ _ _ _ _ A B D a b w hs r s hA hD n
  have hB := hasConstantRank_middle hs hA hD
  rw [constRankChernAssignOn'_eq _ _ _ B (r + s) hB]
  simp only [constRankChernAssignOn'_eq _ _ _ A r hA, constRankChernAssignOn'_eq _ _ _ D s hD]
  apply totalChow_ext
  intro v m hv
  
  letI : (pointClosureScheme v).Over (Spk k) := ⟨pointClosureι v ≫ X ↘ Spk k⟩
  haveI : (pointClosureι v).IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨rfl⟩
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType ((pointClosureScheme v) ↘ Spk k) := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (pointClosureι v ≫ X ↘ Spk k)
    infer_instance
  haveI : CompactSpace (pointClosureScheme v) :=
    (pointClosureι v).isClosedEmbedding.compactSpace
  haveI : IsNoetherian (pointClosureScheme v) := { }
  have hVK : ProjK k (pointClosureScheme v) :=
    projK_closed (Fact.out : ProjK k X) (pointClosureι v) rfl
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (pointClosureScheme v)) := ⟨hVK⟩
  haveI : Fact (D28.ProjectiveIntegral k (pointClosureScheme v)) :=
    ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_projK hVK⟩
  have hιv : pointClosureι v (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v)) = v := by
    rw [← C1Cap.pointClosureGenericPoint_eq_genericPoint, pointClosureι_genericPoint]
  have hη : height (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v)) = m := by
    rw [← height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion (pointClosureι v), hιv, hv]
  rw [primeClass_eq_push (k := k) (pointClosureι v) v hιv m hv hη]
  set ι := pointClosureι v with hι
  set y := primeClassT2 (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v)) m hη with hy
  
  have pf : ∀ (E : X.Modules) (e : ℕ) (hE : HasConstantRank X E e) (i : ℕ)
      (z : TotalChow (pointClosureScheme v)),
      chernOpOn' (opsK k) (cpK k) closedPosK E e hE i (totalPushOn (opsK k) ι z) =
        totalPushOn (opsK k) ι (chernOpOn' (opsK k) (cpK k) closedPosK
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj E) e (hasConstantRank_pullback _ ι E e hE) i z) :=
    fun E e hE i z ↦ (LinearMap.congr_fun
      (CIIL1D.chernOpOn'_push ι (opsK k) (cpK k) closedPosK E e hE i) z).symm
  
  have hsV : (ShortComplex.mk ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).map a)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).map b)
      (by rw [← Functor.map_comp, w, Functor.map_zero])).ShortExact :=
    pullback_map_shortExact_of_finiteLocallyFree_right ι (ShortComplex.mk a b w) hs
      hD.isFiniteLocallyFree
  have hAV := hasConstantRank_pullback _ ι A r hA
  have hDV := hasConstantRank_pullback _ ι D s hD
  have hBV := hasConstantRank_pullback _ ι B (r + s) hB
  have hWV := GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.whitney_projectiveIntegral (k := k)
    (W3.projBundleClosedPos_projectiveIntegral_unconditional k) _ _ _ hsV hAV hDV n
  rw [← constRankChernAssignOn'_opsK_eq, ← constRankChernAssignOn'_opsK_eq] at hWV
  simp only [← constRankChernAssignOn'_opsK_eq] at hWV
  rw [constRankChernAssignOn'_eq _ _ _ _ (r + s) hBV] at hWV
  simp only [constRankChernAssignOn'_eq _ _ _ _ r hAV,
    constRankChernAssignOn'_eq _ _ _ _ s hDV] at hWV
  
  rw [pf B (r + s) hB n y, hWV, LinearMap.sum_apply, map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ ↦ ?_
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, pf D s hD p.2 y, pf A r hA p.1]

name: RRC.SingularTodd.whitneyConvOn_projK
statement:
theorem whitneyConvOn_projK [Nonempty X] {A B D : X.Modules} (a : A ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ D)
    (w : a ≫ b = 0) (h : (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact) {r s : ℕ}
    (hA : HasConstantRank X A r) (hD : HasConstantRank X D s) :
    WhitneyConvOn (constRankChernAssignOn' (opsK k) (cpK k) closedPosK) A B D
proof:
:=
  whitneyK a b w h hA hD

name: RRC.SingularTodd.chernT2_comm
statement:
theorem chernT2_comm [Nonempty X] {E F : X.Modules} {r s : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r)
    (hF : HasConstantRank X F s) (i j : ℕ) :
    chernT2 k E i * chernT2 k F j = chernT2 k F j * chernT2 k E i
proof:
:=
  cOp_comm (whitneyK (k := k)) hE hF i j

name: RRC.SingularTodd.rkT2_eq
statement:

proof:
:= by
  have h : ∃ r, Nonempty (HasConstantRank X E r) := ⟨r, ⟨hE⟩⟩
  unfold rkT2
  rw [dif_pos h]
  exact hasConstantRank_unique h.choose_spec.some hE

name: RRC.SingularTodd.exists_rank_T2
statement:
theorem exists_rank_T2 [ConnectedSpace X] {E : X.Modules} (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) :

:=

name: RRC.SingularTodd.chExactT2
statement:
theorem chExactT2 [ConnectedSpace X] {A B D : X.Modules} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ D)
    (w : f ≫ g = 0) (hs : (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact) (hA : IsFiniteLocallyFree X A)
    (_hB : IsFiniteLocallyFree X B) (hD : IsFiniteLocallyFree X D) :
    chBundleT2 k B = chBundleT2 k A + chBundleT2 k D
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hAr⟩ := exists_rank_T2 (k := k) hA
  obtain ⟨s, hDs⟩ := exists_rank_T2 (k := k) hD
  have hBr := hasConstantRank_middle hs hAr hDs
  unfold chBundleT2
  rw [rkT2_eq hBr, rkT2_eq hAr, rkT2_eq hDs]
  exact GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.chFromChern_conv
    (convData (whitneyK (k := k)) f g w hs hAr hDs) r s

name: RRC.SingularTodd.chK0T2_classOf
statement:
theorem chK0T2_classOf [ConnectedSpace X] (E : X.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) :
    chK0T2 k (k0ClassOf X E hE) = chBundleT2 k E
proof:
:= by
  unfold chK0T2 k0ClassOf ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf
  exact ExactGrothendieck.lift_classOf
    (Object := {E : X.Modules // IsFiniteLocallyFree X E})
    (Exact := ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules (IsFiniteLocallyFree X)) _ _ ⟨E, hE⟩

name: RRC.SingularTodd.chBundleT2_eq_chBundle
statement:
theorem chBundleT2_eq_chBundle [Fact (D28.ProjectiveIntegral k X)]
    (hP : D30.ProjBundleClosedPos (D28.ProjectiveIntegral k)) (E : X.Modules) :
    chBundleT2 k E = GRRBlueprintV4.chBundle k hP E
proof:
:= by
  unfold chBundleT2 GRRBlueprintV4.chBundle
  rw [GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.chernSeq_eq, chernT2, constRankChernAssignOn'_opsK_eq hP E]
  rfl

name: RRC.SingularTodd.chK0T2_eq_chK0
statement:
theorem chK0T2_eq_chK0 [ConnectedSpace X] [Fact (D28.ProjectiveIntegral k X)]
    (hP : D30.ProjBundleClosedPos (D28.ProjectiveIntegral k)) (h : GRRBlueprintV4.ChExact k hP) :
    chK0T2 k (X := X) = GRRBlueprintV4.chK0 k hP h
proof:
:= by
  refine ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext (Object := {E : X.Modules // IsFiniteLocallyFree X E})
    (Exact := ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules (IsFiniteLocallyFree X)) fun E ↦ ?_
  change chK0T2 k (k0ClassOf X E.1 E.2) = GRRBlueprintV4.chK0 k hP h (k0ClassOf X E.1 E.2)
  rw [chK0T2_classOf, GRRBlueprintV4.chK0_classOf, chBundleT2_eq_chBundle k hP]

name: RRC.SingularTodd.tdDualUnitT2_commute
statement:
theorem tdDualUnitT2_commute [ConnectedSpace X] (E F : {E : X.Modules // IsFiniteLocallyFree X E}) :
    tdDualUnitT2 k X E.1 E.2 * tdDualUnitT2 k X F.1 F.2 =
      tdDualUnitT2 k X F.1 F.2 * tdDualUnitT2 k X E.1 E.2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_rank_T2 (k := k) E.2
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_rank_T2 (k := k) F.2
  refine Units.ext ?_
  rw [Units.val_mul, Units.val_mul]
  exact GRRBlueprintV4.TOD.tdDualTot_commute (hP := closedPosK) (whitneyK (k := k)) hr hs

name: RRC.SingularTodd.tdDualUnitT2_comm_gen
statement:
theorem tdDualUnitT2_comm_gen [ConnectedSpace X] :
    ∀ x ∈ Set.range (fun E : {E : X.Modules // IsFiniteLocallyFree X E} ↦
        tdDualUnitT2 k X E.1 E.2),
      ∀ y ∈ Set.range (fun E : {E : X.Modules // IsFiniteLocallyFree X E} ↦
        tdDualUnitT2 k X E.1 E.2), x * y = y * x
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨E, rfl⟩ y ⟨F, rfl⟩
  exact tdDualUnitT2_commute k X E F

name: RRC.SingularTodd.tdK0T2_classOf
statement:
theorem tdK0T2_classOf [ConnectedSpace X] (E : X.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) :
    tdK0T2 k X (k0ClassOf X E hE) =
      Additive.ofMul ⟨tdDualUnitT2 k X E hE, tdDualUnitT2_mem k X E hE⟩
proof:
:= by
  unfold tdK0T2 k0ClassOf ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf

    (Object := {E : X.Modules // IsFiniteLocallyFree X E})
    (Exact := ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules (IsFiniteLocallyFree X)) _ _ ⟨E, hE⟩

name: RRC.SingularTodd.tdTanT2_classOf
statement:
theorem tdTanT2_classOf [ConnectedSpace X] (E : X.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) :
    tdTanT2 k X (k0ClassOf X E hE) = GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tdDualTot (opsK k) (cpK k) closedPosK E
proof:
:= by

  rfl

name: RRC.SingularTodd.tdTanT2_eq_tdTan
statement:
theorem tdTanT2_eq_tdTan [ConnectedSpace X] [Fact (D28.ProjectiveIntegral k X)] (v : K0 X) :
    tdTanT2 k X v = GRRBlueprintV4.TOD.tdTan k X v
proof:
:= by
  let g1 : K0 X →+ Additive (Module.End ℚ (TotalChow X))ˣ :=
    (MonoidHom.toAdditive (tdGroupT2 k X).subtype).comp (tdK0T2 k X)
  let g2 : K0 X →+ Additive (Module.End ℚ (TotalChow X))ˣ :=
    (MonoidHom.toAdditive (GRRBlueprintV4.TOD.tdGroup k X).subtype).comp
      (GRRBlueprintV4.TOD.tdK0 k X)
  have hgen : ∀ E : {E : X.Modules // IsFiniteLocallyFree X E},
      g1 (k0ClassOf X E.1 E.2) = g2 (k0ClassOf X E.1 E.2) := by
    intro E
    simp only [g1, g2, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
    rw [tdK0T2_classOf, GRRBlueprintV4.TOD.tdK0_classOf]
    change Additive.ofMul (tdDualUnitT2 k X E.1 E.2) =
      Additive.ofMul (GRRBlueprintV4.TOD.tdDualUnit k X E.1 E.2)
    congr 1
  have h : ∀ w : K0 X, g1 w = g2 w := by
    intro w
    obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective w
    induction f using Finsupp.induction_linear with
    | zero => rw [QuotientAddGroup.mk_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
    | add f g hf hg => rw [QuotientAddGroup.mk_add, map_add, map_add, hf, hg]
    | single E n =>
      have hs : (QuotientAddGroup.mk (Finsupp.single E n) : K0 X) =
          n • k0ClassOf X E.1 E.2 := by
        rw [← Finsupp.smul_single_one E n, QuotientAddGroup.mk_zsmul]
        rfl
      rw [hs, map_zsmul, map_zsmul, hgen E]
  exact congrArg (fun z ↦ ((Additive.toMul z : (Module.End ℚ (TotalChow X))ˣ) :
    Module.End ℚ (TotalChow X))) (h v)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.epsPrime_comm
statement:
theorem epsPrime_comm (a b : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (v : X) :
    epsPrime a b v = epsPrime b a v

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.c1CapPrimeCoeff_nonneg_g2xfr4
statement:
theorem c1CapPrimeCoeff_nonneg_g2xfr4 (a : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (v w : X) :
    0 ≤ C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a v w
proof:
:= by
  unfold C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.c1CapPrimeCoeff_toNat_cast
statement:
theorem c1CapPrimeCoeff_toNat_cast (a : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (v w : X) :
    ((C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a v w).toNat : ℤ) = C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a v w
proof:
:=
  Int.toNat_of_nonneg (c1CapPrimeCoeff_nonneg_g2xfr4 a v w)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.exists_of_c1CapPrimeCoeff_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_of_c1CapPrimeCoeff_ne_zero (a : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) {v w : X}
    (hne : C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a v w ≠ 0) :
    ∃ h : v ⤳ w, ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk w ⧸ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h) = 1 ∧
      ¬ IsUnit (a w)
proof:
:= by
  unfold C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff at hne
  split_ifs at hne with h hd
  · refine ⟨h, hd, fun hu ↦ hne ?_⟩
    rw [CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity_of_isUnit hu]
    rfl
  · exact absurd rfl hne
  · exact absurd rfl hne

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.germEqs_notMem_stalkPrime
statement:
theorem germEqs_notMem_stalkPrime (t : Γ(X, ⊤)) {v y : X} (h : v ⤳ y)
    (hv : IsUnit (germEqs t v)) : germEqs t y ∉ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h
proof:
:= by
  unfold Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, stalkSpecializes_germEqs t h, IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal,
    mem_nonunits_iff, not_not]
  exact hv

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.localMultiplicity_ne_top_g2xfr4
statement:
theorem localMultiplicity_ne_top_g2xfr4 [IsLocallyNoetherian X] {v y : X} (h : v ⤳ y)
    (hd : ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk y ⧸ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h) = 1)
    (a : X.presheaf.stalk y) (ha : a ∉ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h) :
    CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity a h ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  unfold CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity
  haveI : Ring.KrullDimLE 1 (X.presheaf.stalk y ⧸ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h) :=
    Ring.krullDimLE_iff.mpr hd.le
  apply Ring.ord_ne_top
  apply mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero
  rwa [Ne, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.coeff_chart_add
statement:
theorem coeff_chart_add (t u : Γ(Γs, ⊤)) (U : Γs.Opens) (ρ : Γ(Γs, U))
    (hU : u |_ U = ρ * t |_ U) (γ : Γs) (ht : IsUnit (germEqs t γ)) (hu : IsUnit (germEqs u γ))
    (x : Γs) (hx : x ∈ U) :
    C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs u) γ x =
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) γ x + C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (chartEqs U ρ) γ x
proof:
:= by
  unfold C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff
  by_cases h : γ ⤳ x
  · rw [dif_pos h, dif_pos h, dif_pos h]
    by_cases hd : ringKrullDim (Γs.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h) = 1
    · rw [if_pos hd, if_pos hd, if_pos hd]
      have hgerm : germEqs u x = chartEqs U ρ x * germEqs t x := by
        rw [germEqs_eq_germ u U hx, germEqs_eq_germ t U hx, chartEqs_of_mem U ρ hx, hU, map_mul]
      have hmul := CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity_mul (a := chartEqs U ρ x) h
        (germEqs_notMem_stalkPrime t h ht)
      have hfin := localMultiplicity_ne_top_g2xfr4 h hd _ (germEqs_notMem_stalkPrime u h hu)
      rw [hgerm] at hfin ⊢
      rw [hmul] at hfin ⊢
      have h1 : CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity (chartEqs U ρ x) h ≠ ⊤ := fun h1 ↦
        hfin (by rw [h1, top_add])
      have h2 : CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity (germEqs t x) h ≠ ⊤ := fun h2 ↦
        hfin (by rw [h2, add_top])
      rw [ENat.toNat_add h1 h2]
      push_cast
      ring
    · rw [if_neg hd, if_neg hd, if_neg hd, add_zero]
  · rw [dif_neg h, dif_neg h, dif_neg h, add_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.divCyc_prime_apply_g2xfr4
statement:
theorem divCyc_prime_apply_g2xfr4 (t : Γ(X, ⊤)) (n : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = n + 1)
    (w : X) :
    (divCyc (k := k) t (𝟙 X) n (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv)).1 w =
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) v w
proof:
:= by
  rw [divCyc_apply, c1CapCyclesCoeff_dimPrimeCycle]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.coeff_support_finite
statement:
theorem coeff_support_finite (t : Γ(X, ⊤)) (n : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = n + 1) :
    (Function.support fun w ↦ C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) v w).Finite
proof:
:= by
  have hfin : ((divCyc (k := k) t (𝟙 X) n (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv)).1.support).Finite := by
    simpa using (divCyc (k := k) t (𝟙 X) n
      (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv)).1.locallyFiniteSupport.finite_inter_support_of_isCompact
        (isCompact_univ (X := X))
  refine hfin.subset fun w hw ↦ ?_
  rw [Function.mem_support] at hw ⊢
  rwa [divCyc_prime_apply_g2xfr4 (k := k)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.coeff_eq_sum_fibre
statement:
theorem coeff_eq_sum_fibre (t : Γ(Y, ⊤)) (n : ℕ) (γ : X) (hγ : height γ = n + 1 + 1)
    (hdeg : f.degree γ = 1) (w : Y) (Q : Finset X)
    (hQ : ∀ x, f x = w → C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs (f.appTop t)) γ x ≠ 0 → x ∈ Q) :
    C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) (f γ) w =
      ∑ x ∈ Q with f x = w,
        C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs (f.appTop t)) γ x * (f.degree x : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hv : height (f γ) = n + 1 + 1 :=
    height_map_eq (k := k) f (n + 1) hγ (by rw [hdeg]; exact one_ne_zero)
  have h := pf_divCyc_prime (k := k) f t (n + 1) γ hγ
  rw [pfHom_dimPrimeCycle_of_degree_one (k := k) f (n + 1 + 1) γ hγ hdeg hv] at h
  have hw := congrArg (fun D : AlgebraicCycle Y ℤ ↦ D w) h
  simp only at hw
  rw [divCyc_prime_apply_g2xfr4 (k := k), properPushforward_apply_eq_sum_of_subset f _ w Q
    (fun x hx hx0 ↦ hQ x hx (by rwa [divCyc_prime_apply_g2xfr4 (k := k)] at hx0))] at hw
  rw [← hw]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ ↦ ?_
  rw [divCyc_prime_apply_g2xfr4 (k := k)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.epsPrime_eq_zero_of_not_isUnit_left
statement:
theorem epsPrime_eq_zero_of_not_isUnit_left {Z : Scheme.{u}} (t : Γ(Z, ⊤))
    (b : C1Cap.LocalEquations Z) {v : Z} (ht : ¬ IsUnit (germEqs t v)) :
    epsPrime (germEqs t) b v = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold epsPrime
  simp [c1CapPrimeCoeff_germEqs_of_not_isUnit t ht]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.epsPrime_eq_zero_of_not_isUnit_right
statement:
theorem epsPrime_eq_zero_of_not_isUnit_right {Z : Scheme.{u}} (a : C1Cap.LocalEquations Z)
    (u : Γ(Z, ⊤)) {v : Z} (hu : ¬ IsUnit (germEqs u v)) :
    epsPrime a (germEqs u) v = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [epsPrime_comm]
  exact epsPrime_eq_zero_of_not_isUnit_left u a hu

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.epsPrime_chart_lt
statement:
theorem epsPrime_chart_lt (t u : Γ(Y, ⊤)) (n : ℕ) (γ : X) (hγ : height γ = n + 1 + 1)
    (hdeg : f.degree γ = 1) (U : X.Opens) (ρ : Γ(X, U))
    (hU : f.appTop u |_ U = ρ * f.appTop t |_ U)
    (hρdeg : ∀ x, γ ⤳ x → ¬ IsUnit (chartEqs U ρ x) → f.degree x ≠ 0)
    (hpos : 0 < epsPrime (germEqs t) (germEqs u) (f γ)) :
    epsPrime (germEqs (f.appTop t)) (chartEqs U ρ) γ <
      epsPrime (germEqs t) (germEqs u) (f γ)
proof:
:= by
  have hv : height (f γ) = n + 1 + 1 :=
    height_map_eq (k := k) f (n + 1) hγ (by rw [hdeg]; exact one_ne_zero)
  have ht : IsUnit (germEqs t (f γ)) := by
    by_contra ht
    rw [epsPrime_eq_zero_of_not_isUnit_left t _ ht] at hpos
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos
  have hu : IsUnit (germEqs u (f γ)) := by
    by_contra hu
    rw [epsPrime_eq_zero_of_not_isUnit_right _ u hu] at hpos
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos
  have ht' : IsUnit (germEqs (f.appTop t) γ) := isUnit_appTop_of_isUnit f t ht
  have hu' : IsUnit (germEqs (f.appTop u) γ) := isUnit_appTop_of_isUnit f u hu
  
  set Sa := (coeff_support_finite (k := k) (f.appTop t) (n + 1) γ hγ).toFinset with hSa
  set Sb := (coeff_support_finite (k := k) (f.appTop u) (n + 1) γ hγ).toFinset with hSb
  set SA := (coeff_support_finite (k := k) t (n + 1) (f γ) hv).toFinset with hSA
  have hmemSa : ∀ x, x ∈ Sa ↔ C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs (f.appTop t)) γ x ≠ 0 := fun x ↦ by
    rw [hSa, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Function.mem_support]
  have hmemSb : ∀ x, x ∈ Sb ↔ C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs (f.appTop u)) γ x ≠ 0 := fun x ↦ by
    rw [hSb, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Function.mem_support]
  have hmemSA : ∀ w, w ∈ SA ↔ C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) (f γ) w ≠ 0 := fun w ↦ by
    rw [hSA, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Function.mem_support]
  set P := {x ∈ Sa | C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (chartEqs U ρ) γ x ≠ 0} with hP
  set T := P.image f with hT
  
  have hK1 : ∀ x ∈ P, 1 ≤ f.degree x ∧
      1 ≤ (C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs (f.appTop t)) γ x).toNat ∧
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs (f.appTop u)) γ x =
        C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs (f.appTop t)) γ x +
          C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (chartEqs U ρ) γ x := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hP, Finset.mem_filter, hmemSa] at hx
    obtain ⟨h, _, hnu⟩ := exists_of_c1CapPrimeCoeff_ne_zero _ hx.2
    have hxU : x ∈ U := by
      by_contra hxU
      apply hnu
      unfold chartEqs
      rw [dif_neg hxU]
      exact isUnit_one
    refine ⟨Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (hρdeg x h hnu), ?_,
      coeff_chart_add _ _ U ρ hU γ ht' hu' x hxU⟩
    have h0 := c1CapPrimeCoeff_nonneg_g2xfr4 (germEqs (f.appTop t)) γ x
    have h1 := hx.1
    omega
  
  have hA : ∀ w, C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) (f γ) w =
      ∑ x ∈ Sa with f x = w,
        C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs (f.appTop t)) γ x * (f.degree x : ℤ) := fun w ↦
    coeff_eq_sum_fibre (k := k) f t n γ hγ hdeg w Sa (fun x _ hx ↦ (hmemSa x).mpr hx)
  have hB : ∀ w, C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs u) (f γ) w =
      ∑ x ∈ Sb with f x = w,
        C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs (f.appTop u)) γ x * (f.degree x : ℤ) := fun w ↦
    coeff_eq_sum_fibre (k := k) f u n γ hγ hdeg w Sb (fun x _ hx ↦ (hmemSb x).mpr hx)
  
  have hK3a : ∀ w, (∑ i ∈ P with f i = w, f.degree i *
      (C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs (f.appTop t)) γ i).toNat) ≤
        (C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) (f γ) w).toNat := by
    intro w
    have hle : ((∑ i ∈ P with f i = w, f.degree i *
        (C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs (f.appTop t)) γ i).toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤
          ((C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) (f γ) w).toNat : ℤ) := by
      rw [c1CapPrimeCoeff_toNat_cast, hA w]
      push_cast
      simp_rw [c1CapPrimeCoeff_toNat_cast]
      refine (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ ?_).trans_eq
        (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ mul_comm _ _)
      · intro i hi
        rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hi ⊢
        exact ⟨(Finset.mem_filter.mp hi.1).1, hi.2⟩
      · intro i _ _
        exact mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (c1CapPrimeCoeff_nonneg_g2xfr4 _ _ _)
    exact_mod_cast hle
  have hK3b : ∀ w, (∑ i ∈ P with f i = w, f.degree i *
      ((C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs (f.appTop t)) γ i).toNat +
        (C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (chartEqs U ρ) γ i).toNat)) ≤
        (C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs u) (f γ) w).toNat := by
    intro w
    have hle : ((∑ i ∈ P with f i = w, f.degree i *
        ((C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs (f.appTop t)) γ i).toNat +
          (C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (chartEqs U ρ) γ i).toNat) : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤
          ((C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs u) (f γ) w).toNat : ℤ) := by
      rw [c1CapPrimeCoeff_toNat_cast, hB w]
      push_cast
      simp_rw [c1CapPrimeCoeff_toNat_cast]
      have hcongr : ∀ i ∈ {x ∈ P | f x = w}, (f.degree i : ℤ) *
          (C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs (f.appTop t)) γ i +
            C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (chartEqs U ρ) γ i) =
          C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs (f.appTop u)) γ i * (f.degree i : ℤ) := by
        intro i hi
        rw [(hK1 i (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).1).2.2, mul_comm]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hcongr]
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ ?_
      · intro i hi
        rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hi ⊢
        refine ⟨(hmemSb i).mpr ?_, hi.2⟩
        have hiP := hi.1
        obtain ⟨_, he, hadd⟩ := hK1 i hiP
        have h0 := c1CapPrimeCoeff_nonneg_g2xfr4 (chartEqs U ρ) γ i
        rw [hadd]
        omega
      · intro i _ _
        exact mul_nonneg (c1CapPrimeCoeff_nonneg_g2xfr4 _ _ _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    exact_mod_cast hle
  
  have hK4 : epsPrime (germEqs (f.appTop t)) (chartEqs U ρ) γ =
      ∑ w ∈ T, ∑ i ∈ P with f i = w,
        (C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs (f.appTop t)) γ i).toNat *
          (C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (chartEqs U ρ) γ i).toNat := by
    unfold epsPrime
    rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ (s := P) ?_]
    · exact (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun x hx ↦ Finset.mem_image_of_mem f hx) _).symm
    · intro x hx
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hx
      rw [Finset.mem_coe, hP, Finset.mem_filter, hmemSa]
      constructor
      · intro h0
        rw [h0] at hx
        simp at hx
      · intro h0
        rw [h0] at hx
        simp at hx
  
  have hK5 : ∑ w ∈ T, (C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) (f γ) w).toNat *
      (C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs u) (f γ) w).toNat ≤
        epsPrime (germEqs t) (germEqs u) (f γ) := by
    unfold epsPrime
    rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ (s := SA ∪ T) ?_]
    · exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset Finset.subset_union_right
    · intro w hw
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hw
      rw [Finset.coe_union, Set.mem_union, Finset.mem_coe, hmemSA]
      left
      intro h0
      rw [h0] at hw
      simp at hw
  rcases Finset.eq_empty_or_nonempty T with hT0 | hTne
  · rw [hK4, hT0, Finset.sum_empty]
    exact hpos
  · have hS : ∀ w ∈ T, ({x ∈ P | f x = w}).Nonempty := by
      intro w hw
      obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hw
      exact ⟨x, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hx, rfl⟩⟩
    have hlt := eps_lt T hTne (fun w ↦ {x ∈ P | f x = w}) hS (fun _ i ↦ f.degree i)
      (fun _ i ↦ (C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs (f.appTop t)) γ i).toNat)
      (fun _ i ↦ (C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (chartEqs U ρ) γ i).toNat) (fun _ _ ↦ 0)
      (fun w _ i hi ↦ (hK1 i (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).1).1)
      (fun w _ i hi ↦ (hK1 i (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).1).2.1)
    rw [hK4]
    refine hlt.trans_le (le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun w _ ↦ ?_) hK5)
    simp only [add_zero]
    rw [Nat.mul_comm (C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) (f γ) w).toNat]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul (hK3b w) (hK3a w)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.epsPrime_chart_lt'
statement:
theorem epsPrime_chart_lt' (t u : Γ(Y, ⊤)) (n : ℕ) (γ : X) (hγ : height γ = n + 1 + 1)
    (hdeg : f.degree γ = 1) (U' : X.Opens) (ρ' : Γ(X, U'))
    (hU' : f.appTop t |_ U' = ρ' * f.appTop u |_ U')
    (hρdeg : ∀ x, γ ⤳ x → ¬ IsUnit (chartEqs U' ρ' x) → f.degree x ≠ 0)
    (hpos : 0 < epsPrime (germEqs t) (germEqs u) (f γ)) :
    epsPrime (germEqs (f.appTop u)) (chartEqs U' ρ') γ <
      epsPrime (germEqs t) (germEqs u) (f γ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [epsPrime_comm (germEqs t)] at hpos ⊢
  exact epsPrime_chart_lt (k := k) f u t n γ hγ hdeg U' ρ' hU' hρdeg hpos

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.one_le_ord_toNat_g2xfr4
statement:
theorem one_le_ord_toNat_g2xfr4 {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [Ring.KrullDimLE 1 R] {a : R} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hnu : ¬ IsUnit a) :
    1 ≤ (Ring.ord R a).toNat
proof:
:= by
  have hfin : Ring.ord R a ≠ ⊤ := Ring.ord_ne_top (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero ha)
  have hne : Ideal.span {a} ≠ ⊤ := by
    rw [Ne, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top]
    exact hnu
  haveI : Nontrivial (R ⧸ Ideal.span {a}) := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hne
  have hpos : 0 < Ring.ord R a := Module.length_pos
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hfin
  rw [← hm] at hpos ⊢
  rw [ENat.toNat_coe]
  exact_mod_cast hpos

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.commAdmissible_of_epsPrime_eq_zero
statement:
theorem commAdmissible_of_epsPrime_eq_zero (t u : Γ(X, ⊤)) (n : ℕ) (v : X)
    (hv : height v = n + 1) (h0 : epsPrime (germEqs t) (germEqs u) v = 0) :
    CommAdmissible t u v
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : IsUnit (germEqs t v)
  swap
  · exact Or.inl ht
  by_cases hu : IsUnit (germEqs u v)
  swap
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hu)
  refine Or.inr (Or.inr ?_)
  intro z hz q hq htq huq
  by_contra hqm
  obtain ⟨x, h, hxq⟩ := Scheme.exists_specializes_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_eq z q
  have hxz : x ≠ z := by
    rintro rfl
    apply hqm
    rw [← hxq]
    unfold Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes
    rw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkSpecializes_refl]
    rfl
  have hct := pullback_germEqs_ne_zero t v ht z
  have hx1 : coheight x = 1 :=
    C1Cap.coheight_eq_one_of_mem_stalkPrime h hxz hz hct (by rw [hxq]; exact htq)
  
  have hnu : ∀ s : Γ(X, ⊤), (germEqs s).pullback (pointClosureι v) z ∈ q →
      ¬ IsUnit ((germEqs s).pullback (pointClosureι v) x) := by
    intro s hs
    rw [← hxq] at hs
    unfold Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes at hs
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff] at hs
    rwa [← germEqs_appTop, ← stalkSpecializes_germEqs _ h, germEqs_appTop]
  
  have hcoeff : ∀ s : Γ(X, ⊤), IsUnit (germEqs s v) →
      (germEqs s).pullback (pointClosureι v) z ∈ q →
      1 ≤ (C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs s) v (pointClosureι v x)).toNat := by
    intro s hs hsq
    rw [C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_pointClosureι, if_pos hx1, Int.toNat_natCast,
      C1Cap.localMultiplicity_eq_ord_stalkMap]
    haveI : Ring.KrullDimLE 1 ((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalk x) :=
      krullDimLE_of_coheight hx1
    exact one_le_ord_toNat_g2xfr4 (pullback_germEqs_ne_zero s v hs x) (hnu s hsq)
  have hpos : 1 ≤ (C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) v (pointClosureι v x)).toNat *
      (C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs u) v (pointClosureι v x)).toNat :=
    Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.mul_ne_zero (by have := hcoeff t ht htq; omega)
      (by have := hcoeff u hu huq; omega))
  
  have hfin := coeff_support_finite (k := k) t n v hv
  have hle : (C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) v (pointClosureι v x)).toNat *
      (C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs u) v (pointClosureι v x)).toNat ≤
        epsPrime (germEqs t) (germEqs u) v := by
    unfold epsPrime
    rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ (s := hfin.toFinset) ?_]
    · refine Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i ↦ (C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) v i).toNat *
        (C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs u) v i).toNat) (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) ?_
      rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Function.mem_support]
      have := hcoeff t ht htq
      omega
    · intro w hw
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hw
      rw [Set.Finite.coe_toFinset, Function.mem_support]
      intro h0
      rw [h0] at hw
      simp at hw
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.fullIter_comm_of_epsPrime_eq_zero
statement:
theorem fullIter_comm_of_epsPrime_eq_zero (t u : Γ(X, ⊤)) (n : ℕ)
    (α : dimensionCycles X (n + 1 + 1))
    (hα : ∀ v, α.1 v ≠ 0 → epsPrime (germEqs t) (germEqs u) v = 0) :
    fullIter (k := k) t u n α = fullIter (k := k) u t n α
proof:
:=
  fullIter_comm (k := k) t u n α fun v hv ↦
    commAdmissible_of_epsPrime_eq_zero (k := k) t u (n + 1) v (α.2 hv) (hα v hv)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.epsPrime_openImm_le
statement:
theorem epsPrime_openImm_le (j : V ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (a b : C1Cap.LocalEquations X)
    (x : V) (hfin : (Function.support fun w ↦ C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a (j x) w).Finite) :
    epsPrime (a.pullback j) (b.pullback j) x ≤ epsPrime a b (j x)
proof:
:= by
  set g : X → ℕ := fun w ↦
    (C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a (j x) w).toNat * (C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff b (j x) w).toNat with hg
  have hinj : Function.Injective j := j.isOpenEmbedding.injective
  have hsupp : ∀ w, g w ≠ 0 → w ∈ hfin.toFinset := by
    intro w hw
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Function.mem_support]
    intro h0
    rw [hg] at hw
    simp only [h0] at hw
    simp at hw
  have hL : epsPrime (a.pullback j) (b.pullback j) x = ∑ᶠ z, g (j z) := by
    unfold epsPrime
    congr 1
    funext z
    rw [hg, ← c1CapPrimeCoeff_openImm, ← c1CapPrimeCoeff_openImm]
  have hR : epsPrime a b (j x) = ∑ w ∈ hfin.toFinset, g w := by
    unfold epsPrime
    exact finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ fun w hw ↦ hsupp w hw
  rw [hL, hR, finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset (s := hfin.toFinset.preimage j hinj.injOn)
    _ (fun z hz ↦ by rw [Finset.coe_preimage]; exact hsupp _ hz),
    Finset.sum_preimage' j _ hinj.injOn g]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.germEqs_topIso_inv
statement:
theorem germEqs_topIso_inv (U : X.Opens) (ρ : Γ(X, U)) :
    germEqs (U.topIso.inv ρ) = (chartEqs U ρ).pullback U.ι
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  have hxU : U.ι x ∈ U := x.2
  have hxV : x ∈ U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U := hxU
  unfold C1Cap.LocalEquations.pullback germEqs
  rw [chartEqs_of_mem U ρ hxU, Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply,
    ← TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply U.toScheme.presheaf
      (homOfLE (le_top : U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U ≤ ⊤)) x hxV (U.topIso.inv ρ)]
  congr 1
  simp only [Scheme.Opens.toScheme_presheaf_map, Scheme.Opens.ι_app, Scheme.Opens.topIso_inv]
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply]
  erw [← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.epsPrime_toScheme_le
statement:
theorem epsPrime_toScheme_le (t : Γ(X, ⊤)) (U : X.Opens) (ρ : Γ(X, U)) (x : U)
    (hfin : (Function.support fun w ↦
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) (U.ι x) w).Finite) :
    epsPrime (germEqs (U.ι.appTop t)) (germEqs (U.topIso.inv ρ)) x ≤
      epsPrime (germEqs t) (chartEqs U ρ) (U.ι x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [germEqs_appTop, germEqs_topIso_inv]
  exact epsPrime_openImm_le U.ι _ _ x hfin

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.epsPrime_toScheme_chart_lt
statement:
theorem epsPrime_toScheme_chart_lt (t u : Γ(Y, ⊤)) (n : ℕ) (U : X.Opens) (ρ : Γ(X, U))
    (x : U) (hγ : height (U.ι x) = n + 1 + 1) (hdeg : f.degree (U.ι x) = 1)
    (hU : f.appTop u |_ U = ρ * f.appTop t |_ U)
    (hρdeg : ∀ y, U.ι x ⤳ y → ¬ IsUnit (chartEqs U ρ y) → f.degree y ≠ 0)
    (hpos : 0 < epsPrime (germEqs t) (germEqs u) (f (U.ι x))) :
    epsPrime (germEqs (U.ι.appTop (f.appTop t))) (germEqs (U.topIso.inv ρ)) x <
      epsPrime (germEqs t) (germEqs u) (f (U.ι x))
proof:
:=
  (epsPrime_toScheme_le (f.appTop t) U ρ x
    (coeff_support_finite (k := k) (f.appTop t) (n + 1) (U.ι x) hγ)).trans_lt
    (epsPrime_chart_lt (k := k) f t u n (U.ι x) hγ hdeg U ρ hU hρdeg hpos)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.epsCyc_single

  · intro w hw

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.eps_strong_induction
statement:
theorem eps_strong_induction {D : Sort*} (ε : D → ℕ) (P : D → Prop)
    (step : ∀ d, (∀ d', ε d' < ε d → P d') → P d) (d : D) : P d
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ∀ m, ∀ d, ε d = m → P d from h _ d rfl
  intro m
  induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ m ih =>
    intro d hd
    exact step d fun d' hlt ↦ ih (ε d') (hd ▸ hlt) d' rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.not_isUnit_chartEqs_imp_notMem
statement:
theorem not_isUnit_chartEqs_imp_notMem (U U' : Γs.Opens) (ρ : Γ(Γs, U)) (ρ' : Γ(Γs, U'))
    (hinv : ρ |_ (U ⊓ U') * ρ' |_ (U ⊓ U') = 1) {y : Γs} (hnu : ¬ IsUnit (chartEqs U ρ y)) :
    y ∉ U'
proof:
:= by
  intro hy'
  by_cases hy : y ∈ U
  · rw [chartEqs_of_mem U ρ hy] at hnu
    exact hnu (isUnit_left_g2xf (germ_mul_germ_eq_one U U' ρ ρ' hinv hy hy'))
  · apply hnu
    unfold chartEqs
    rw [dif_neg hy]
    exact isUnit_one

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.chartDeg_of_compl
statement:
theorem chartDeg_of_compl {d : Γs → ℕ} (γ : Γs) (U U' : Γs.Opens) (ρ : Γ(Γs, U))
    (ρ' : Γ(Γs, U')) (hinv : ρ |_ (U ⊓ U') * ρ' |_ (U ⊓ U') = 1)
    (hdegc : ∀ y, γ ⤳ y → y ∉ U' → d y ≠ 0) :
    ∀ y, γ ⤳ y → ¬ IsUnit (chartEqs U ρ y) → d y ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun y h hnu ↦
  hdegc y h (not_isUnit_chartEqs_imp_notMem U U' ρ ρ' hinv hnu)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T0C.length_self_eq_length_quot_ker
statement:
theorem length_self_eq_length_quot_ker (ψ : A →+* C) (hψ : Function.Surjective ψ) :
    Module.length C C = Module.length A (A ⧸ RingHom.ker ψ)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra A C := ψ.toAlgebra
  rw [← Module.length_eq_of_surjective (S := A) (R := C) (M := C) hψ]
  exact ((Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective (f := Algebra.ofId A C)
    hψ).toLinearEquiv.length_eq).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T0C.ker_comp_equiv_span
statement:
theorem ker_comp_equiv_span (φ : A ≃+* B) (g : A) :
    RingHom.ker ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {φ g})).comp φ.toRingHom) = Ideal.span {g}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker, RingHom.comp_apply, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem,
    Ideal.mem_span_singleton, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  exact map_dvd_iff φ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T0C.length_quot_span_equiv
statement:
theorem length_quot_span_equiv (φ : A ≃+* B) (ψ : A →+* C) (hψ : Function.Surjective ψ) (g : A)
    (hker : RingHom.ker ψ = Ideal.span {g}) :
    Module.length B (B ⧸ Ideal.span {φ g}) = Module.length C C
proof:
:= by
  rw [Module.length_eq_of_surjective (S := B) (R := B ⧸ Ideal.span {φ g})
      (M := B ⧸ Ideal.span {φ g}) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective,
    length_self_eq_length_quot_ker ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {φ g})).comp φ.toRingHom)
      (fun b => by
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective b
      exact ⟨φ.symm c, congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) (φ.apply_symm_apply c)⟩),
    length_self_eq_length_quot_ker ψ hψ, ker_comp_equiv_span, hker]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T0C.ringKrullDim_le_one_of_ker_span
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_le_one_of_ker_span [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [Nontrivial C]
    (ψ : A →+* C) (hψ : Function.Surjective ψ) (g : A) (hker : RingHom.ker ψ = Ideal.span {g})
    (hC : ringKrullDim C = 0) : ringKrullDim A ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hg : g ∈ Ring.jacobson A := by
    rw [IsLocalRing.ringJacobson_eq_maximalIdeal]
    apply IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal (RingHom.ker_ne_top ψ)
    rw [hker]
    exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
  have h := ringKrullDim_le_ringKrullDim_quotient_add_card ({g} : Finset A) (by simpa using hg)
  rw [Finset.coe_singleton, ← hker,
    ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective hψ), hC] at h
  simpa using h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T0C.coheight_ne_zero_of_ne_generic
statement: theorem coheight_ne_zero_of_ne_generic {x : X} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X) : coheight x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hmax : IsMax x := Order.coheight_eq_zero.mp h
  have h1 : x ≤ genericPoint X := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr (genericPoint_specializes x)
  exact hx ((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp (hmax h1)).antisymm
    (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp h1)).eq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T0C.coheight_le_one_of_mem_genericPoints
statement:
theorem coheight_le_one_of_mem_genericPoints [IsNoetherian Z] {L : X.Modules}
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (ι : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι]
    (hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = ι.ker) {p : Z} (hp : p ∈ genericPoints Z) :
    coheight (ι p) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  haveI : L.IsLocallyFree := hL.isFiniteLocallyFree.isLocallyFree
  haveI : L.IsFinitePresentation :=
    IsFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation X hL.isFiniteLocallyFree
  have hker := E27.ker_stalkMap_eq_span_germ_wCoord σ ι hid p (wFrameAt L hL (ι p))
  have hc0 : coheight p = 0 := coheight_eq_zero_of_mem_genericPoints hp
  have hC : ringKrullDim (Z.presheaf.stalk p) = 0 := by
    rw [ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight, hc0]
    rfl
  have h := ringKrullDim_le_one_of_ker_span (ι.stalkMap p).hom (ι.stalkMap_surjective p) _
    hker hC
  rw [ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight] at h
  exact_mod_cast h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T0C.coheight_eq_one_of_mem_genericPoints
statement:
theorem coheight_eq_one_of_mem_genericPoints {L : X.Modules}
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (ι : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι]
    (hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = ι.ker) (hgen : genericPoint X ∉ Set.range ι)
    {p : Z} (hp : p ∈ genericPoints Z) : coheight (ι p) = 1
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (coheight_le_one_of_mem_genericPoints hL σ ι hid hp)
    (Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr
      (coheight_ne_zero_of_ne_generic (fun h => hgen ⟨p, h⟩)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T0C.mem_genericPoints_of_coheight_eq_one
statement:
theorem mem_genericPoints_of_coheight_eq_one (ι : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι]
    (hgen : genericPoint X ∉ Set.range ι) {p : Z} (hp : coheight (ι p) = 1) :
    p ∈ genericPoints Z
proof:
:= by
  apply mem_genericPoints_of_isMax
  intro p' hpp'
  have hle : ι p ≤ ι p' := by
    rw [Scheme.le_iff_specializes] at hpp' ⊢
    exact hpp'.map ι.continuous
  by_cases heq : ι p = ι p'
  · rw [ι.isEmbedding.injective heq]
  · exfalso
    have hlt : ι p < ι p' := lt_of_le_not_ge hle (fun h => heq
      ((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp h).antisymm (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hle)).eq)
    have h1 := Order.coheight_add_one_le hlt
    have h0 : coheight (ι p') ≠ 0 := coheight_ne_zero_of_ne_generic (fun h => hgen ⟨p', h⟩)
    rw [hp] at h1
    have h2 : (1 : ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ 1 :=
      le_trans (by gcongr; exact Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr h0) h1
    exact absurd h2 (by decide)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T0C.height_of_mem_genericPoints
statement:
theorem height_of_mem_genericPoints [IsNoetherian Z] {L : X.Modules}
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (ι : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι]
    (hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = ι.ker) (hgen : genericPoint X ∉ Set.range ι)
    {n : ℕ} (hX : height (genericPoint X) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
    {p : Z} (hp : p ∈ genericPoints Z) : height (ι p) = n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := pointClosureι_generic_surjective (X := X) (ι p)
  have hcz : coheight z = 1 := by
    rw [← coheight_pointClosureι_generic, hz]
    exact coheight_eq_one_of_mem_genericPoints hL σ ι hid hgen hp
  rw [← hz]
  exact D5.height_pointClosure_of_coheight_one (k := k) n (genericPoint X)
    (by rw [hX]; push_cast; rfl) z hcz

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T0C.pushFund_mem_dimensionCycles
statement:
theorem pushFund_mem_dimensionCycles {L : X.Modules}
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (ι : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι]
    (hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = ι.ker) (hgen : genericPoint X ∉ Set.range ι)
    {n : ℕ} (hX : height (genericPoint X) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)) :
    properPushforward ι (fundamentalCycle Z) ∈ dimensionCycles X n
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  change properPushforward ι (fundamentalCycle Z) y ≠ 0 at hy
  by_cases hr : y ∈ Set.range ι
  · obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hr
    rw [E21.pp_apply_image] at hy
    have hp : p ∈ genericPoints Z := by
      by_contra h
      exact hy (fundamentalCycle_apply_of_not_mem_genericPoints h)
    exact height_of_mem_genericPoints (k := k) hL σ ι hid hgen hX hp
  · exact absurd (E21.pp_apply_notRange ι _ y hr) hy

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T0C.fundCycleT2_coe
statement:
theorem fundCycleT2_coe {L : X.Modules}
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (ι : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι]

    (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (ι : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι]
    (hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = ι.ker) (hgen : genericPoint X ∉ Set.range ι)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T0C.fundamentalCycle_mem_dimensionCycles
statement:
theorem fundamentalCycle_mem_dimensionCycles [IsNoetherian Z] {L : X.Modules}
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (ι : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι]
    (hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = ι.ker) (hgen : genericPoint X ∉ Set.range ι)
    {n : ℕ} (hX : height (genericPoint X) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)) :
    fundamentalCycle Z ∈ dimensionCycles Z n
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  rw [fundamentalCycle_support] at hp
  change height p = n
  rw [← height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion ι p]
  exact height_of_mem_genericPoints (k := k) hL σ ι hid hgen hX hp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T0C.weil_eq_pushFund
statement:
theorem weil_eq_pushFund {L : X.Modules}
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (ι : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι]
    (hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = ι.ker) (hgen : genericPoint X ∉ Set.range ι) :
    ∃ (bf : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme (genericPoint X))
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι (genericPoint X))).obj L)
        (pointClosureGenericPoint (genericPoint X))),
      properPushforward (pointClosureι (genericPoint X))
        (Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame
          (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL (genericPoint X))
          (m7s_genericRank_pointClosure L hL (genericPoint X)) bf).1 =
        properPushforward ι (fundamentalCycle Z)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : L.IsLocallyFree := hL.isFiniteLocallyFree.isLocallyFree
  haveI : L.IsFinitePresentation :=
    IsFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation X hL.isFiniteLocallyFree
  haveI := isIso_pointClosureι_generic (X := X)
  set w : X := genericPoint X with hw
  let z₀ : pointClosureScheme w := pointClosureGenericPoint w
  have hsupp : pointClosureι w z₀ ∉ (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).support := by
    rw [hid, pointClosureι_genericPoint]
    exact E26.notMem_support_ker ι _ hgen
  have hu := E26.wCoord_isUnit_of_notMem_support σ (pointClosureι w z₀) hsupp
    (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z₀))
  have hM := isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL w
  have hrank := m7s_genericRank_pointClosure L hL w
  obtain ⟨bf, hb⟩ := E26.exists_refFrame (hL := hL) w (E26.sectionOfHom σ) z₀ hu
  refine ⟨bf, ?_⟩
  ext y
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := pointClosureι_generic_surjective (X := X) y
  rw [E21.pp_apply_image, Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame_apply]
  by_cases hr : pointClosureι w z ∈ Set.range ι
  · obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hr
    rw [← hp, E21.pp_apply_image]
    have hcz : coheight z = coheight (ι p) := by
      rw [hp, coheight_pointClosureι_generic]
    by_cases hpg : p ∈ genericPoints Z
    · have hc1 : coheight z = 1 :=
        hcz.trans (coheight_eq_one_of_mem_genericPoints hL σ ι hid hgen hpg)
      rw [E25.coeff_eq_ord_sectionCoord hM hrank bf _ hb (closureFrame (hL := hL) _ z) z
          (closureFrame (hL := hL) _ z).mem,
        E25.sectionCoord_eq_algebraMap_germ _ _ z (closureFrame (hL := hL) _ z).mem,
        E27.germ_sectionCoordSec_closureFrame hL w _ z,
        fundamentalCycle_apply_of_mem_genericPoints hpg]
      have haux : ∀ (y : X) (hy : ι p = y) (d : WFrame L y),
          ∃ ψ : X.presheaf.stalk y →+* Z.presheaf.stalk p, Function.Surjective ψ ∧
            RingHom.ker ψ =
              Ideal.span {X.presheaf.germ d.U y d.mem (wCoord d (E26.sectionOfHom σ))} := by
        intro y hy d
        subst hy
        exact ⟨(ι.stalkMap p).hom, ι.stalkMap_surjective p,
          E27.ker_stalkMap_eq_span_germ_wCoord σ ι hid p d⟩
      obtain ⟨ψ, hψs, hψk⟩ := haux (pointClosureι w z) hp (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z))
      set g := X.presheaf.germ (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z)).U (pointClosureι w z)
        (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z)).mem
        (wCoord (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z)) (E26.sectionOfHom σ)) with hgdef
      let φ : X.presheaf.stalk (pointClosureι w z) ≃+* (pointClosureScheme w).presheaf.stalk z :=
        (asIso ((pointClosureι w).stalkMap z)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
      have hφ : φ g = ((pointClosureι w).stalkMap z).hom g := rfl
      have hcX : coheight (pointClosureι w z) = 1 := by
        rw [coheight_pointClosureι_generic, hc1]
      have hg0 : ((pointClosureι w).stalkMap z).hom g ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        have hg : g = 0 := φ.injective (by rw [hφ, h0, map_zero])
        have hinj : Function.Injective ψ := by
          rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
          intro a ha
          have ha' : a ∈ RingHom.ker ψ := ha
          rwa [hψk, hg, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot.mpr rfl, Ideal.mem_bot] at ha'
        have e := ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (RingEquiv.ofBijective ψ ⟨hinj, hψs⟩)
        rw [ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight, ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight,
          coheight_eq_zero_of_mem_genericPoints hpg, hcX] at e
        exact absurd e (by decide)
      rw [Scheme.ord_algebraMap_eq_length_toNat hc1 _ hg0, ← hφ,
        length_quot_span_equiv φ ψ hψs g hψk]
      rfl
    · have hc : coheight z ≠ 1 := fun h =>
        hpg (mem_genericPoints_of_coheight_eq_one ι hgen (hcz ▸ h))
      rw [E25.coeff_eq_zero_of_coheight_ne hM hrank bf z hc,
        fundamentalCycle_apply_of_not_mem_genericPoints hpg]
  · rw [E21.pp_apply_notRange ι _ _ hr]
    exact E28.coeff_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range hL w hM hrank σ ι hid bf hb z hr

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T0C.cap_eq_fundCycleT2
statement:
theorem cap_eq_fundCycleT2 {L : X.Modules}
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (ι : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι]
    (hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = ι.ker) (hgen : genericPoint X ∉ Set.range ι)
    {n : ℕ} (hX : height (genericPoint X) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)) :
    ops.cap L hL n ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint X) (n + 1) hX) : DimChow X (n + 1))) =
      (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk (fundCycleT2 (k := k) hL σ ι hid hgen hX) : DimChow X n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨bf, hbf⟩ := weil_eq_pushFund (k := k) hL σ ι hid hgen
  exact ops.cap_mk L hL n (genericPoint X) hX (m7s_genericRank_pointClosure L hL _) bf _
    hbf.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T0C.cap_eq_push_fundamental
statement:
theorem cap_eq_push_fundamental [Z.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Z ↘ Spk k)] [Fact (P Z)]
    {L : X.Modules}
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (ι : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι]
    [ι.IsOver (Spk k)]
    (hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = ι.ker) (hgen : genericPoint X ∉ Set.range ι)
    {n : ℕ} (hX : height (genericPoint X) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)) :
    ops.cap L hL n ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint X) (n + 1) hX) : DimChow X (n + 1))) =
      ops.push ι n ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk (⟨fundamentalCycle Z,
          fundamentalCycle_mem_dimensionCycles (k := k) hL σ ι hid hgen hX⟩ :
            dimensionCycles Z n) : DimChow Z n))
proof:
:= by
  rw [cap_eq_fundCycleT2 ops hL σ ι hid hgen hX]
  exact (ops.push_mk ι n _ _ rfl).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XDESC.extOpen_chartDiv_apply
statement:
theorem extOpen_chartDiv_apply (m : ℕ) (x : U.toScheme) (hx : height x = m + 1) (y : Γs) :
    (extOpen (k := k) U m (divCyc (k := k) (U.topIso.inv φ) (𝟙 U.toScheme) m
      (dimPrimeCycle x (m + 1) hx))).1 y = C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (chartEqs U φ) (U.ι x) y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hy : y ∈ U
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ : y ∈ Set.range U.ι := by rwa [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
    rw [extOpen_apply_ι, divCyc_prime_apply_g2xfr4 (k := k), germEqs_topIso_inv,
      ← c1CapPrimeCoeff_openImm]
  · rw [extOpen_apply_notMem (k := k) U m _ hy]
    symm
    apply c1_zero_of_isUnit_g2xf
    unfold chartEqs
    rw [dif_neg hy]
    exact isUnit_one

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XDESC.divCyc_extOpen_chartDiv_apply
statement:
theorem divCyc_extOpen_chartDiv_apply (t : Γ(Γs, ⊤)) (n : ℕ) (x : U.toScheme)
    (hx : height x = n + 1 + 1) (y : Γs) :
    (divCyc (k := k) t (𝟙 Γs) n (extOpen (k := k) U (n + 1)
      (divCyc (k := k) (U.topIso.inv φ) (𝟙 U.toScheme) (n + 1)
        (dimPrimeCycle x (n + 1 + 1) hx)))).1 y =
      ∑ᶠ w : Γs, C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (chartEqs U φ) (U.ι x) w *
        C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) w y
proof:
:= by
  rw [divCyc_apply]
  unfold C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff
  exact finsum_congr fun w ↦ by rw [extOpen_chartDiv_apply (k := k) U φ (n + 1) x hx w]; rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XDESC.extOpen_fullIter_chart_desc
statement:
theorem extOpen_fullIter_chart_desc (t : Γ(Γs, ⊤)) (hcov : ∀ y, y ∈ U ∨ y ∈ U')
    (hinvG : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U) (hy' : y ∈ U'),
      Γs.presheaf.germ U y hy φ * Γs.presheaf.germ U' y hy' ψ = 1) (n : ℕ) (x : U.toScheme)
    (hx : height x = n + 1 + 1) :
    extOpen (k := k) U n
        (fullIter (k := k) (U.ι.appTop t) (U.topIso.inv φ) n (dimPrimeCycle x (n + 1 + 1) hx)) =
      divCyc (k := k) t (𝟙 Γs) n (extOpen (k := k) U (n + 1)
        (divCyc (k := k) (U.topIso.inv φ) (𝟙 U.toScheme) (n + 1)
          (dimPrimeCycle x (n + 1 + 1) hx)))
proof:
:= by
  refine extOpen_eq_of_coeff (k := k) U n _ _ (fun z ↦ ?_) (fun y hy ↦ ?_)
  · rw [divCyc_extOpen_chartDiv_apply (k := k) U φ t n x hx, fullIter_apply]
    change ∑ᶠ w, C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (germEqs (U.topIso.inv φ))
      (dimPrimeCycle x (n + 1 + 1) hx).1 w * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs (U.ι.appTop t)) w z = _
    rw [D18.finsum_reindex_range U.ι U.ι.isOpenEmbedding.injective
      (fun w ↦ C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (chartEqs U φ) (U.ι x) w *
        C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) w (U.ι z)) (fun w hw ↦ by
          rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
          exact mem_of_c1_chartEqs_ne_zero U φ (left_ne_zero_of_mul hw))]
    exact finsum_congr fun w ↦ by
      rw [c1CapCyclesCoeff_dimPrimeCycle, germEqs_appTop, germEqs_topIso_inv,
        ← c1CapPrimeCoeff_openImm, ← c1CapPrimeCoeff_openImm]
  · rw [divCyc_extOpen_chartDiv_apply (k := k) U φ t n x hx]
    apply finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero
    intro w
    by_contra hne
    have h1 := left_ne_zero_of_mul hne
    have h2 := right_ne_zero_of_mul hne
    obtain ⟨_, _, hnu⟩ := exists_of_c1CapPrimeCoeff_ne_zero _ h1
    have hw' := notMem_of_not_isUnit_chartEqs U U' φ ψ hinvG hnu
    have hs := specializes_of_c1_ne_zero _ h2
    exact hw' (hs.mem_open U'.isOpen ((hcov y).resolve_left hy))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XDESC.remainder_term_desc
statement:
theorem remainder_term_desc (hcov : ∀ y, y ∈ U ∨ y ∈ U')
    (hunit : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U), IsUnit (Γs.presheaf.germ U y hy φ) → y ∈ U')
    (hunit' : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U'), IsUnit (Γs.presheaf.germ U' y hy ψ) → y ∈ U)
    (n : ℕ) (γ : Γs) (hγ : height γ = n + 1 + 1) (w y : Γs) :
    C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) γ w * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (chartEqs U φ) w y -
        C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) γ w * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (chartEqs U' ψ) w y =
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) γ w * (remCyc (k := k) U U' φ ψ hinv n w).1 y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hw : w ∈ U
  · by_cases hw' : w ∈ U'
    · by_cases hh : height w = n + 1
      · unfold remCyc
        rw [dif_pos ⟨hw, hw', hh⟩, remGen_cycle_apply (k := k) U U' φ ψ hinv hcov n w hw hw' hh]
        ring
      · have h0 : C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) γ w = 0 := by
          by_contra hne
          exact hh (height_of_c1_ne_zero (k := k) t n γ hγ hne)
        rw [h0]
        ring
    · have hnu : ¬ IsUnit (chartEqs U φ w) := by
        rw [chartEqs_of_mem U φ hw]
        exact fun h ↦ hw' (hunit w hw h)
      have hrem : remCyc (k := k) U U' φ ψ hinv n w = 0 := by
        unfold remCyc
        rw [dif_neg (fun h ↦ hw' h.2.1)]
      rw [c1_chartEqs_of_not_isUnit U φ hnu, c1_chartEqs_of_notMem U' ψ hw', hrem]
      simp
  · have hw' : w ∈ U' := (hcov w).resolve_left hw
    have hnu : ¬ IsUnit (chartEqs U' ψ w) := by
      rw [chartEqs_of_mem U' ψ hw']
      exact fun h ↦ hw (hunit' w hw' h)
    have hrem : remCyc (k := k) U U' φ ψ hinv n w = 0 := by
      unfold remCyc
      rw [dif_neg (fun h ↦ hw h.1)]
    rw [c1_chartEqs_of_not_isUnit U' ψ hnu, c1_chartEqs_of_notMem U φ hw, hrem]
    simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XDESC.remainder_desc_mem_relOn
statement:
theorem remainder_desc_mem_relOn (hcov : ∀ y, y ∈ U ∨ y ∈ U')
    (hunit : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U), IsUnit (Γs.presheaf.germ U y hy φ) → y ∈ U')
    (hunit' : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U'), IsUnit (Γs.presheaf.germ U' y hy ψ) → y ∈ U)
    (n : ℕ) (x : U.toScheme) (hx : height x = n + 1 + 1) (x' : U'.toScheme)
    (hx' : height x' = n + 1 + 1) (hxx : U'.ι x' = U.ι x) (hγ : height (U.ι x) = n + 1 + 1) :
    extOpen (k := k) U n (fullIter (k := k) (U.topIso.inv φ) (U.ι.appTop t) n
        (dimPrimeCycle x (n + 1 + 1) hx)) -
      extOpen (k := k) U' n (fullIter (k := k) (U'.topIso.inv ψ) (U'.ι.appTop t) n
        (dimPrimeCycle x' (n + 1 + 1) hx')) ∈ relOn n (bothZero t t)
proof:
:= by
  set γ := U.ι x with hγdef
  have hft := coeff_support_finite (k := k) t (n + 1) γ hγ
  set S := hft.toFinset with hS
  have key : extOpen (k := k) U n (fullIter (k := k) (U.topIso.inv φ) (U.ι.appTop t) n
        (dimPrimeCycle x (n + 1 + 1) hx)) -
      extOpen (k := k) U' n (fullIter (k := k) (U'.topIso.inv ψ) (U'.ι.appTop t) n
        (dimPrimeCycle x' (n + 1 + 1) hx')) =
      ∑ w ∈ S, C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) γ w • remCyc (k := k) U U' φ ψ hinv n w := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    ext y
    have hev := map_sum (D6.evalHomD Γs n y)
      (fun w ↦ C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) γ w • remCyc (k := k) U U' φ ψ hinv n w) S
    change (extOpen (k := k) U n _).1 y - (extOpen (k := k) U' n _).1 y =
      D6.evalHomD Γs n y (∑ w ∈ S, _)
    rw [hev, extOpen_fullIter_chart_rev_apply (k := k), extOpen_fullIter_chart_rev_apply (k := k),
      hxx]
    simp only [map_zsmul, smul_eq_mul]
    change _ = ∑ w ∈ S, C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) γ w *
      (remCyc (k := k) U U' φ ψ hinv n w).1 y
    rw [← finsum_sub_distrib (hft.subset fun w hw ↦ left_ne_zero_of_mul hw)
      (hft.subset fun w hw ↦ left_ne_zero_of_mul hw)]
    rw [finsum_congr (remainder_term_desc (k := k) U U' φ ψ hinv t hcov hunit hunit' n γ hγ · y)]
    refine finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ fun w hw ↦ ?_
    rw [Finset.mem_coe, hS, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
    exact left_ne_zero_of_mul hw
  rw [key]
  refine sum_mem fun w hw ↦ zsmul_mem ?_ _
  rw [hS, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Function.mem_support] at hw
  obtain ⟨_, _, hnt⟩ := exists_of_c1CapPrimeCoeff_ne_zero _ hw
  exact remCyc_mem_relOn (k := k) U U' φ ψ hinv t t n w hnt hnt

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XDESC.extOpen_chart_relOn_desc
statement:
theorem extOpen_chart_relOn_desc (t : Γ(Γs, ⊤)) (hcov : ∀ y, y ∈ U ∨ y ∈ U')
    (hinvG : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U) (hy' : y ∈ U'),
      Γs.presheaf.germ U y hy φ * Γs.presheaf.germ U' y hy' ψ = 1) (n : ℕ)
    (D : dimensionCycles U.toScheme n)
    (hD : D ∈ relOn n (bothZero (U.ι.appTop t) (U.topIso.inv φ))) :
    extOpen (k := k) U n D ∈ relOn n (bothZero t t)
proof:
:= by
  have hnuφ : ∀ z ∈ bothZero (U.ι.appTop t) (U.topIso.inv φ),
      ¬ IsUnit (chartEqs U φ (U.ι z)) :=
    fun z hz h ↦ hz.2 ((isUnit_germEqs_topIso_inv_iff U φ z).mpr h)
  refine extOpen_relOn (k := k) U n _ ((U' : Set Γs)ᶜ) (bothZero t t) U'.isOpen.isClosed_compl
    (fun y hy ↦ (hcov y).resolve_right hy)
    (fun z hz ↦ notMem_of_not_isUnit_chartEqs U U' φ ψ hinvG (hnuφ z hz)) (fun z hz ↦ ?_) D hD
  have hnt : ¬ IsUnit (germEqs t (U.ι z)) :=
    fun h ↦ hz.1 ((isUnit_germEqs_appTop_iff U.ι t z).mpr h)
  exact ⟨hnt, hnt⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XDESC.ι_ptOpens
statement: theorem ι_ptOpens (V : Γs.Opens) (γ : Γs) (hγV : γ ∈ V) : V.ι (ptOpens V γ hγV) = γ
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XDESC.height_ptOpens
statement:
theorem height_ptOpens (V : Γs.Opens) {γ : Γs} (hγV : γ ∈ V) {m : ℕ∞}
    (hγ : height γ = m) : height (ptOpens V γ hγV) = m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← height_opensι_g2xfr25 (k := k), ι_ptOpens]
  exact hγ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XDESC.divCyc_twoChart_mem_relOn
statement:
theorem divCyc_twoChart_mem_relOn (t : Γ(Γs, ⊤)) (hcov : ∀ y, y ∈ U ∨ y ∈ U')
    (hinv : φ |_ (U ⊓ U') * ψ |_ (U ⊓ U') = 1)
    (hunit : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U), IsUnit (Γs.presheaf.germ U y hy φ) → y ∈ U')
    (hunit' : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U'), IsUnit (Γs.presheaf.germ U' y hy ψ) → y ∈ U)
    (n : ℕ) (γ : Γs) (hγU : γ ∈ U) (hγU' : γ ∈ U') (hγ : height γ = n + 1 + 1) :
    divCyc (k := k) t (𝟙 Γs) n (twoChartCyc (k := k) U U' φ ψ n γ hγU hγU' hγ) ∈
      relOn n (bothZero t t)
proof:
:= by
  have hinvG : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U) (hy' : y ∈ U'),
      Γs.presheaf.germ U y hy φ * Γs.presheaf.germ U' y hy' ψ = 1 :=
    fun y hy hy' ↦ germ_mul_germ_eq_one U U' φ ψ hinv hy hy'
  have hinvG' : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U') (hy' : y ∈ U),
      Γs.presheaf.germ U' y hy ψ * Γs.presheaf.germ U y hy' φ = 1 :=
    fun y hy hy' ↦ by rw [mul_comm]; exact hinvG y hy' hy
  have hcov' : ∀ y, y ∈ U' ∨ y ∈ U := fun y ↦ (hcov y).symm
  set x : U.toScheme := ptOpens U γ hγU with hxdef
  set x' : U'.toScheme := ptOpens U' γ hγU' with hx'def
  have hx : height x = n + 1 + 1 := height_ptOpens (k := k) U hγU hγ
  have hx' : height x' = n + 1 + 1 := height_ptOpens (k := k) U' hγU' hγ
  unfold twoChartCyc
  rw [map_sub, ← extOpen_fullIter_chart_desc (k := k) U U' φ ψ t hcov hinvG n x hx,
    ← extOpen_fullIter_chart_desc (k := k) U' U ψ φ t hcov' hinvG' n x' hx']
  set A := fullIter (k := k) (U.ι.appTop t) (U.topIso.inv φ) n (dimPrimeCycle x (n + 1 + 1) hx)
  set B := fullIter (k := k) (U.topIso.inv φ) (U.ι.appTop t) n (dimPrimeCycle x (n + 1 + 1) hx)
  set A' := fullIter (k := k) (U'.ι.appTop t) (U'.topIso.inv ψ) n
    (dimPrimeCycle x' (n + 1 + 1) hx')
  set B' := fullIter (k := k) (U'.topIso.inv ψ) (U'.ι.appTop t) n
    (dimPrimeCycle x' (n + 1 + 1) hx')
  have hsplit : extOpen (k := k) U n A - extOpen (k := k) U' n A' =
      (extOpen (k := k) U n (A - B) - extOpen (k := k) U' n (A' - B')) +
        (extOpen (k := k) U n B - extOpen (k := k) U' n B') := by
    rw [map_sub, map_sub]
    abel
  rw [hsplit]
  have hF : A - B ∈ relOn n (bothZero (U.ι.appTop t) (U.topIso.inv φ)) :=
    fultonComm_route_F (k := k) (U.ι.appTop t) (U.topIso.inv φ) n x hx
