    rwa [sup_bot_eq, sup_bot_eq, hTmap] at this
  have hwφ : Adm (Iφ.map g) (LinearMap.range φ') (w.map φ') := bd_adm_w g hφ h' hQψ hw
  have hxg : Adm ⊥ (Iφ.map g) ((x₀.map φ).map g) := bd_adm_g g hx
  have hws : (w.map s₁).map g = w.map φ' := by
    rw [List.map_map]; exact List.map_congr_left fun x _ => hs₁ x
  have hwsT : Adm Iφ Tφ (w.map s₁) := by
    refine adm_of_map g ⊥ (fun v hv => ?_) hcondT hIT ?_
    · obtain ⟨x, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hv
      show g (s₁ x) ∈ LinearMap.range φ'
      rw [hs₁]; exact LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _
    · rw [sup_bot_eq, sup_bot_eq, hTmap, hws]; exact hwφ
  have e1 := ratio_map g ⊥ hcondT hwsT hz''T
  rw [sup_bot_eq, sup_bot_eq, hTmap, hws] at e1
  have e2 := ratio_map ψ ⊥ (inf_le_right.trans hkψ.le) hwsT hz''T
  rw [hIψ, hTψ, bot_sup_eq, sup_bot_eq, hz''] at e2
  rw [ratio_append_left hxg (adm_append hwφ hY) (adm_append hz''g hY),
    ratio_append_right hY hwφ hz''g, ← e1, e2]

name: FinLenDet.perDet_eq_of_boundary
statement:
theorem perDet_eq_of_boundary (g : M →ₗ[A] M') (hφ : g ∘ₗ φ = φ' ∘ₗ g)
    (hψ : g ∘ₗ ψ = ψ' ∘ₗ g)
    (h : PerExact (⊥ : Submodule A M) ⊤ φ ψ) (h' : PerExact (⊥ : Submodule A M') ⊤ φ' ψ')
    (hKφ : LinearMap.ker g ≤ LinearMap.ker φ) (hKψ : LinearMap.ker g ≤ LinearMap.ker ψ)
    (hQφ : LinearMap.range φ' ≤ LinearMap.range g) (hQψ : LinearMap.range ψ' ≤ LinearMap.range g)
    (hbd : ∀ (m' : M') (m₁ m₂ : M), g m₁ = φ' m' → g m₂ = ψ' m' → ψ m₁ = φ m₂) :
    perDet ⊥ ⊤ φ' ψ' = perDet ⊥ ⊤ φ ψ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hkφ, hkψ⟩ := perExact_bot_top_iff.1 h
  have hKIφ : LinearMap.ker g ≤ LinearMap.range φ := hKψ.trans hkψ.le
  have hKIψ : LinearMap.ker g ≤ LinearMap.range ψ := hKφ.trans hkφ.le
  
  obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀⟩ := exists_adm (bot_le : (⊥ : Submodule A M) ≤ LinearMap.ker g)
  obtain ⟨z', hz', -⟩ := exists_lift φ ⊤ z₀ fun v hv => by
    rw [← LinearMap.range_eq_map]; exact hKIφ (hz₀.mem v hv)
  obtain ⟨z'', hz'', -⟩ := exists_lift ψ ⊤ z₀ fun v hv => by
    rw [← LinearMap.range_eq_map]; exact hKIψ (hz₀.mem v hv)
  obtain ⟨lx, hlx, hlxS⟩ := exists_adm_sub ((⊤ : Submodule A M).map φ) (LinearMap.range φ)
    (LinearMap.ker g) hKIφ (by rw [LinearMap.range_eq_map]; exact le_sup_left)
  obtain ⟨x₀, rfl, -⟩ := exists_lift φ ⊤ lx hlxS
  obtain ⟨ly, hly, hlyS⟩ := exists_adm_sub ((⊤ : Submodule A M).map ψ) (LinearMap.range ψ)
    (LinearMap.ker g) hKIψ (by rw [LinearMap.range_eq_map]; exact le_sup_left)
  obtain ⟨y₀, rfl, -⟩ := exists_lift ψ ⊤ ly hlyS
  
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_adm (le_top : LinearMap.range g ≤ ⊤)
  choose s₁ hs₁ using fun x => hQφ (LinearMap.mem_range_self φ' x)
  choose s₂ hs₂ using fun x => hQψ (LinearMap.mem_range_self ψ' x)
  
  have C : IsChoice ⊥ ⊤ φ ψ (z' ++ x₀) (z'' ++ y₀) := by
    refine ⟨by simp, by simp, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [top_map_sup_bot, List.map_append, hz']; exact adm_append hz₀ hlx
    · rw [top_map_sup_bot, List.map_append, hz'']; exact adm_append hz₀ hly
  have gφ : (x₀.map g).map φ' = (x₀.map φ).map g := by
    simp only [List.map_map]; congr 1; funext v; exact (LinearMap.congr_fun hφ v).symm
  have gψ : (y₀.map g).map ψ' = (y₀.map ψ).map g := by
    simp only [List.map_map]; congr 1; funext v; exact (LinearMap.congr_fun hψ v).symm
  have C' : IsChoice ⊥ ⊤ φ' ψ' (x₀.map g ++ w) (y₀.map g ++ w) := by
    refine ⟨by simp, by simp, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [top_map_sup_bot, List.map_append, gφ]
      exact adm_append (bd_adm_g g hlx) (bd_adm_w g hφ h' hQψ hw)
    · rw [top_map_sup_bot, List.map_append, gψ]
      exact adm_append (bd_adm_g g hly) (bd_adm_w g hψ h'.symm hQφ hw)
  
  have hA : Adm (⊥ : Submodule A _) ⊤ (z₀ ++ (x₀.map φ ++ (z'' ++ y₀))) := by
    have := C.adm₁ h; rwa [List.map_append, hz', List.append_assoc] at this
  have hB : Adm (⊥ : Submodule A _) ⊤ (z₀ ++ (y₀.map ψ ++ (z' ++ x₀))) := by
    have := C.adm₂ h; rwa [List.map_append, hz'', List.append_assoc] at this
  have tA : Adm (LinearMap.ker g) ⊤ (x₀.map φ ++ (z'' ++ y₀)) := by
    have := adm_append_right hA; rwa [hz₀.sup_lspan] at this
  have tB : Adm (LinearMap.ker g) ⊤ (y₀.map ψ ++ (z' ++ x₀)) := by
    have := adm_append_right hB; rwa [hz₀.sup_lspan] at this
  have hA₀ := bd_adm_g g tA
  have hB₀ := bd_adm_g g tB
  rw [← LinearMap.range_eq_map] at hA₀ hB₀
  have eM : ratio (⊥ : Submodule A _) ⊤ ((z' ++ x₀).map φ ++ (z'' ++ y₀)) ((z'' ++ y₀).map ψ ++ (z' ++ x₀)) =
      ratio (⊥ : Submodule A _) ⊤ ((x₀.map φ ++ (z'' ++ y₀)).map g ++ w) ((y₀.map ψ ++ (z' ++ x₀)).map g ++ w) := by
    rw [List.map_append, List.map_append, hz', hz'', List.append_assoc, List.append_assoc,
      ratio_append_left hz₀ tA tB, ratio_append_right hw hA₀ hB₀]
    have e := ratio_map g ⊥ (inf_le_right : (⊤ : Submodule A M) ⊓ (⊥ : Submodule A M').comap g ≤
      LinearMap.ker g) tA tB
    rwa [top_map_sup_bot, sup_bot_eq, eq_bot_iff.2 (map_comap_le g ⊥)] at e
  
  have hY : Adm (LinearMap.range φ') ⊤ (y₀.map g ++ w) := by
    have := C'.adm_tail h'; rwa [top_map_sup_bot] at this
  have hX : Adm (LinearMap.range ψ') ⊤ (x₀.map g ++ w) := by
    have := C'.symm.adm_tail h'.symm; rwa [top_map_sup_bot] at this
  have l₀ := boundary_ratio g hφ hψ h h' hKφ hKψ hQφ hQψ hz₀ hz'' hlx hw hY s₁ hs₁
  have l₁ := boundary_ratio g hψ hφ h.symm h'.symm hKψ hKφ hQψ hQφ hz₀ hz' hly hw hX s₂ hs₂
  have hlist : (w.map s₁).map ψ = (w.map s₂).map φ := by
    simp only [List.map_map]
    exact List.map_congr_left fun x _ => hbd x (s₁ x) (s₂ x) (hs₁ x) (hs₂ x)
  rw [hlist, ← l₁] at l₀
  
  set A₁ := (x₀.map φ).map g ++ (w.map φ' ++ (y₀.map g ++ w))
  set A₀ := (x₀.map φ).map g ++ (z''.map g ++ (y₀.map g ++ w))
  set B₁ := (y₀.map ψ).map g ++ (w.map ψ' ++ (x₀.map g ++ w))
  set B₀ := (y₀.map ψ).map g ++ (z'.map g ++ (x₀.map g ++ w))
  have hA₁ : Adm (⊥ : Submodule A _) ⊤ A₁ := by
    have := C'.adm₁ h'; rwa [List.map_append, gφ, List.append_assoc] at this
  have hB₁ : Adm (⊥ : Submodule A _) ⊤ B₁ := by
    have := C'.adm₂ h'; rwa [List.map_append, gψ, List.append_assoc] at this
  have eA₀ : (x₀.map φ ++ (z'' ++ y₀)).map g ++ w = A₀ := by simp [A₀]
  have eB₀ : (y₀.map ψ ++ (z' ++ x₀)).map g ++ w = B₀ := by simp [B₀]
  rw [eA₀, eB₀] at eM
  have hA₀' : Adm (⊥ : Submodule A _) ⊤ A₀ := by rw [← eA₀]; exact adm_append hA₀ hw
  have hB₀' : Adm (⊥ : Submodule A _) ⊤ B₀ := by rw [← eB₀]; exact adm_append hB₀ hw
  have hlen : w.length = z₀.length := by
    have := Adm.length_eq hA₁ hA₀'
    simp only [A₁, A₀, List.length_append, List.length_map] at this
    rw [← hz'', List.length_map]; omega
  rw [perDet_eq h' C', perDet_eq h C, eM]
  have e3 : ratio (⊥ : Submodule A _) ⊤ ((x₀.map g ++ w).map φ' ++ (y₀.map g ++ w))
      ((y₀.map g ++ w).map ψ' ++ (x₀.map g ++ w)) =
      ratio (⊥ : Submodule A _) ⊤ A₁ A₀ * (ratio (⊥ : Submodule A _) ⊤ A₀ B₀ * ratio (⊥ : Submodule A _) ⊤ B₀ B₁) := by
    rw [ratio_mul_ratio hB₀', ratio_mul_ratio hA₀']
    congr 1 <;> simp [A₁, B₁, gφ, gψ]
  rw [e3, l₀]
  have e4 := ratio_mul_ratio_symm hB₁ hB₀'
  have hz'len : z'.length = z₀.length := by rw [← hz', List.length_map]
  have hz''len : z''.length = z₀.length := by rw [← hz'', List.length_map]
  simp only [List.length_append, List.length_map, hlen, hz'len, hz''len]
  calc _ = (-1) ^ ((x₀.length + z₀.length) * (y₀.length + z₀.length)) * ratio (⊥ : Submodule A _) ⊤ A₀ B₀ *
        (ratio (⊥ : Submodule A _) ⊤ B₁ B₀ * ratio (⊥ : Submodule A _) ⊤ B₀ B₁) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [e4]; ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.generator_mem_relOn
statement:
theorem generator_mem_relOn {n : ℕ} {S : Set X} (G : DimRelationGenerator X n)
    (hG : ∀ y, G.i y ∈ S) : G.cycle ∈ relOn n S
proof:
:=
  AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨G, hG, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.relOn_mono
statement: theorem relOn_mono {n : ℕ} {S T : Set X} (h : S ⊆ T) : relOn n S ≤ relOn n T
proof:
:=
  AddSubgroup.closure_mono fun _ ⟨G, hG, hc⟩ ↦ ⟨G, fun y ↦ h (hG y), hc⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.relOn_le_dimRationalEquivalence
statement:
theorem relOn_le_dimRationalEquivalence (n : ℕ) (S : Set X) :
    relOn n S ≤ dimRationalEquivalence X n
proof:
:=
  (AddSubgroup.closure_le _).mpr fun _ ⟨G, _, hc⟩ ↦ hc ▸ AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨G, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.isUnit_germEqs_iff_mem_basicOpen
statement:
theorem isUnit_germEqs_iff_mem_basicOpen (t : Γ(X, ⊤)) (x : X) :
    IsUnit (germEqs t x) ↔ x ∈ X.basicOpen t
proof:
:=
  (X.mem_basicOpen t x trivial).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.isClosed_bothZero
statement: theorem isClosed_bothZero (t u : Γ(X, ⊤)) : IsClosed (bothZero t u)
proof:
:= by
  have h : bothZero t u = ((X.basicOpen t : Set X)ᶜ) ∩ ((X.basicOpen u : Set X)ᶜ) := by
    ext x
    simp only [bothZero, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_compl_iff, SetLike.mem_coe,
      isUnit_germEqs_iff_mem_basicOpen]
  rw [h]
  exact (X.basicOpen t).isOpen.isClosed_compl.inter (X.basicOpen u).isOpen.isClosed_compl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.bothZero_of_specializes
statement:
theorem bothZero_of_specializes {t u : Γ(X, ⊤)} {x y : X} (h : x ⤳ y) (hx : x ∈ bothZero t u) :
    y ∈ bothZero t u
proof:
:=
  ⟨not_isUnit_germEqs_of_specializes t h hx.1, not_isUnit_germEqs_of_specializes u h hx.2⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.pp_apply_notMem_g2xfr25
statement:
theorem pp_apply_notMem_g2xfr25 (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] (D : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) {y : Y}
    (hy : y ∉ Set.range f) : properPushforward f D y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [properPushforward_apply_eq_sum_of_subset f D y ∅ (fun x hx _ ↦ (hy ⟨x, hx⟩).elim)]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.pp_apply_inj_g2xfr25
statement:
theorem pp_apply_inj_g2xfr25 (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (D : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) (z : X) : properPushforward f D (f z) = D z * (f.degree z : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [properPushforward_apply_eq_sum_of_subset f D (f z) {z}
    (fun x hx _ ↦ by rw [Finset.mem_singleton]; exact hf hx)]
  rw [Finset.filter_singleton, if_pos rfl, Finset.sum_singleton]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.degree_eq_one_of_isIso_stalkMap_g2xfr25
statement:
theorem degree_eq_one_of_isIso_stalkMap_g2xfr25 (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : X)
    [IsIso (f.stalkMap x)] : f.degree x = 1
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↑(Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)))
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↑(X.presheaf.stalk x)) :=
    RingHom.toAlgebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (f.stalkMap x).hom)
  apply Algebra.finrank_eq_one_iff_bijective_algebraMap.mpr
  let e : Y.presheaf.stalk (f x) ≃+* X.presheaf.stalk x :=
    (asIso (f.stalkMap x)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  have he : (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (f.stalkMap x).hom) =
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.mapEquiv e : _ →+* _) := rfl
  change Function.Bijective (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (f.stalkMap x).hom)
  rw [he]
  exact (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.mapEquiv e).bijective

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.degree_openImm_g2xfr25
statement: theorem degree_openImm_g2xfr25 (j : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j] (x : X) : j.degree x = 1
proof:
:=
  degree_eq_one_of_isIso_stalkMap_g2xfr25 j x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.opensι_isOver_g2xfr25
statement: theorem opensι_isOver_g2xfr25 [X.Over (Spk k)] (U : X.Opens) : U.ι.IsOver (Spk k)
proof: := ⟨rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.opens_loft_g2xfr25
statement:
theorem opens_loft_g2xfr25 [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] (U : X.Opens) :
    LocallyOfFiniteType (U.toScheme ↘ Spk k)
proof:
:= by
  change LocallyOfFiniteType (U.ι ≫ X ↘ Spk k)
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.opens_noetherian_g2xfr25
statement: theorem opens_noetherian_g2xfr25 [IsNoetherian X] (U : X.Opens) : IsNoetherian U.toScheme
proof:
:= by
  haveI : CompactSpace U.toScheme :=
    isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp (TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace.isCompact (U : Set X))
  exact { }

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.height_opensι_g2xfr25
statement: theorem height_opensι_g2xfr25 (U : X.Opens) (x : U.toScheme) : height (U.ι x) = height x
proof:
:=
  heightCompatible_of_finiteType k U.ι x (by rw [degree_openImm_g2xfr25]; exact one_ne_zero)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.extOpen_apply_ι
statement:
theorem extOpen_apply_ι (U : X.Opens) (n : ℕ) (D : dimensionCycles U.toScheme n)
    (z : U.toScheme) : (extOpen (k := k) U n D).1 (U.ι z) = D.1 z
proof:
:= by
  change properPushforward U.ι D.1 (U.ι z) = D.1 z
  rw [pp_apply_inj_g2xfr25 U.ι U.ι.isOpenEmbedding.injective, degree_openImm_g2xfr25]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.extOpen_apply_notMem
statement:
theorem extOpen_apply_notMem (U : X.Opens) (n : ℕ) (D : dimensionCycles U.toScheme n) {y : X}
    (hy : y ∉ U) : (extOpen (k := k) U n D).1 y = 0
proof:
:= by
  change properPushforward U.ι D.1 y = 0
  apply pp_apply_notMem_g2xfr25
  rwa [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.extOpen_eq_of_coeff
statement:
theorem extOpen_eq_of_coeff (U : X.Opens) (n : ℕ) (D : dimensionCycles U.toScheme n)
    (E : dimensionCycles X n) (hD : ∀ z, D.1 z = E.1 (U.ι z)) (hE : ∀ y, y ∉ U → E.1 y = 0) :
    extOpen (k := k) U n D = E
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext y
  by_cases hy : y ∈ U
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ : y ∈ Set.range U.ι := by rwa [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
    rw [extOpen_apply_ι, hD]
  · rw [extOpen_apply_notMem (k := k) U n D hy, hE y hy]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.isClosed_image_opensι
statement:
theorem isClosed_image_opensι (U : X.Opens) {A : Set U.toScheme} (hA : IsClosed A) {C : Set X}
    (hC : IsClosed C) (hCU : C ⊆ U) (hAC : ∀ z ∈ A, U.ι z ∈ C) : IsClosed (U.ι '' A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← closure_subset_iff_isClosed]
  intro y hy
  have hyC : y ∈ C := closure_minimal (by rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩; exact hAC z hz) hC hy
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ : y ∈ Set.range U.ι := by rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]; exact hCU hyC
  refine ⟨z, ?_, rfl⟩
  have hcl := U.ι.isOpenEmbedding.isInducing.closure_eq_preimage_closure_image A
  rw [hA.closure_eq] at hcl
  rw [hcl]
  exact hy

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.extOpen_relOn
statement:
theorem extOpen_relOn (U : X.Opens) (n : ℕ) (S : Set U.toScheme) (C T : Set X) (hC : IsClosed C)
    (hCU : C ⊆ U) (hSC : ∀ z ∈ S, U.ι z ∈ C) (hST : ∀ z ∈ S, U.ι z ∈ T)
    (D : dimensionCycles U.toScheme n) (hD : D ∈ relOn n S) :
    extOpen (k := k) U n D ∈ relOn n T
proof:
:= by
  induction hD using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem D hD =>
    obtain ⟨G, hG, rfl⟩ := hD
    have hcl : IsClosed (Set.range (G.i ≫ U.ι)) := by
      rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_base, TopCat.coe_comp, Set.range_comp]
      exact isClosed_image_opensι U G.i.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range hC hCU
        (by rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩; exact hSC _ (hG y))
    haveI : IsClosedImmersion (G.i ≫ U.ι) := .of_isPreimmersion _ hcl
    let G' : DimRelationGenerator X n :=
      { Y := G.Y
        i := G.i ≫ U.ι
        f := G.f
        hf := G.hf
        dimension := fun y hy ↦ by
          rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, height_opensι_g2xfr25 (k := k)]
          exact G.dimension y hy }
    have hG' : extOpen (k := k) U n G.cycle = G'.cycle := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change properPushforward U.ι (properPushforward G.i (div G.f)) =
        properPushforward (G.i ≫ U.ι) (div G.f)
      rw [properPushforward_comp]
    rw [hG']
    exact generator_mem_relOn G' fun y ↦ by
      rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
      exact hST _ (hG y)
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add D E _ _ hD hE => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hD hE
  | neg D _ hD => rw [map_neg]; exact neg_mem hD

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.pushClosed_relOn
statement:
theorem pushClosed_relOn {T : Scheme.{u}} (ι : T ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι] (n : ℕ)
    (D : dimensionCycles T n) (hD : D ∈ dimRationalEquivalence T n) (S : Set X)
    (hS : Set.range ι ⊆ S) :
    (⟨properPushforward ι D.1,
        properPushforward_mem_dimensionCycles ι (heightCompatible_of_isClosedImmersion ι) D.2⟩ :
      dimensionCycles X n) ∈ relOn n S
proof:
:= by
  induction hD using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem D hD =>
    obtain ⟨G, rfl⟩ := hD
    let G' : DimRelationGenerator X n :=
      { Y := G.Y
        i := G.i ≫ ι
        f := G.f
        hf := G.hf
        dimension := fun y hy ↦ by
          rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion]
          exact G.dimension y hy }
    have hG' : (⟨properPushforward ι G.cycle.1,
        properPushforward_mem_dimensionCycles ι (heightCompatible_of_isClosedImmersion ι)
          G.cycle.2⟩ : dimensionCycles X n) = G'.cycle := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change properPushforward ι (properPushforward G.i (div G.f)) =
        properPushforward (G.i ≫ ι) (div G.f)
      rw [properPushforward_comp]
    rw [hG']
    exact generator_mem_relOn G' fun y ↦ hS ⟨_, rfl⟩
  | zero =>
    have : (⟨properPushforward ι (0 : dimensionCycles T n).1,
        properPushforward_mem_dimensionCycles ι (heightCompatible_of_isClosedImmersion ι)
          (0 : dimensionCycles T n).2⟩ : dimensionCycles X n) = 0 :=
      Subtype.ext (properPushforward_zero ι)
    rw [this]
    exact zero_mem _
  | add D E _ _ hD hE =>
    have : (⟨properPushforward ι (D + E).1,
        properPushforward_mem_dimensionCycles ι (heightCompatible_of_isClosedImmersion ι)
          (D + E).2⟩ : dimensionCycles X n) =
        ⟨properPushforward ι D.1, properPushforward_mem_dimensionCycles ι
          (heightCompatible_of_isClosedImmersion ι) D.2⟩ +
        ⟨properPushforward ι E.1, properPushforward_mem_dimensionCycles ι
          (heightCompatible_of_isClosedImmersion ι) E.2⟩ :=
      Subtype.ext (properPushforward_add ι D.1 E.1)
    rw [this]
    exact add_mem hD hE
  | neg D _ hD =>
    have : (⟨properPushforward ι (-D).1,
        properPushforward_mem_dimensionCycles ι (heightCompatible_of_isClosedImmersion ι)
          (-D).2⟩ : dimensionCycles X n) =
        -⟨properPushforward ι D.1, properPushforward_mem_dimensionCycles ι
          (heightCompatible_of_isClosedImmersion ι) D.2⟩ :=
      Subtype.ext ((properPushforwardHom ι).map_neg D.1)
    rw [this]
    exact neg_mem hD

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.pfHom_generator_relOn
statement:
theorem pfHom_generator_relOn (n : ℕ) (S : Set Y) (T : Set X) (hT : IsClosed T)
    (hST : ∀ y ∈ S, f y ∈ T) (G : DimRelationGenerator Y n) (hG : ∀ y, G.i y ∈ S) :
    D13.pfHom (k := k) f n G.cycle ∈ relOn n T
proof:
:= by
  set e : G.Y ⟶ X := G.i ≫ f with he
  letI : G.Y.Over (Spk k) := ⟨G.i ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k)⟩
  haveI : G.i.IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨rfl⟩
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (G.Y ↘ Spk k) := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (G.i ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k))
    infer_instance
  letI : e.image.Over (Spk k) := ⟨e.imageι ≫ (X ↘ Spk k)⟩
  haveI : e.imageι.IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨rfl⟩
  haveI : e.toImage.IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨by
    change e.toImage ≫ (e.imageι ≫ (X ↘ Spk k)) = G.i ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k)
    rw [← Category.assoc, Scheme.Hom.toImage_imageι, he, Category.assoc]
    rw [CategoryTheory.comp_over (f := f) (S := Spk k)]⟩
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (e.image ↘ Spk k) := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (e.imageι ≫ (X ↘ Spk k))
    infer_instance
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian e.image := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (e.image ↘ Spk k)
  haveI : IsProper e := by rw [he]; infer_instance
  haveI : IsProper (e.toImage ≫ e.imageι) := by rw [Scheme.Hom.toImage_imageι]; infer_instance
  haveI : IsProper e.toImage := IsProper.of_comp e.toImage e.imageι
  let g0 : DimRelationGenerator G.Y n :=
    { Y := G.Y
      i := 𝟙 G.Y
      f := G.f
      hf := G.hf
      dimension := fun y hy ↦ by
        rw [← height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion G.i]
        exact G.dimension y hy }
  have hrel := properPushforward_generator_mem_of_S2 k (D7.genericFibreVanishing k) e.toImage
    (heightCompatible_of_finiteType k e.toImage) (dimensionCatenary_of_finiteType k) g0
  have hrange : Set.range e.imageι ⊆ T := by
    rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.range_subschemeι, Scheme.Hom.support_ker]
    refine closure_minimal ?_ hT
    rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    rw [he, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact hST _ (hG y)
  have hpush := pushClosed_relOn e.imageι n _ hrel T hrange
  convert hpush using 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  change properPushforward f (properPushforward G.i (div G.f)) =
    properPushforward e.imageι (properPushforward e.toImage (properPushforward (𝟙 G.Y) (div G.f)))
  rw [properPushforward_id, ← properPushforward_comp, ← properPushforward_comp]
  exact properPushforward_congr (by rw [Scheme.Hom.toImage_imageι]) _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.pfHom_relOn
statement:
theorem pfHom_relOn (n : ℕ) (S : Set Y) (T : Set X) (hT : IsClosed T) (hST : ∀ y ∈ S, f y ∈ T)
    (D : dimensionCycles Y n) (hD : D ∈ relOn n S) : D13.pfHom (k := k) f n D ∈ relOn n T
proof:
:= by
  induction hD using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem D hD =>
    obtain ⟨G, hG, rfl⟩ := hD
    exact pfHom_generator_relOn (k := k) f n S T hT hST G hG
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add D E _ _ hD hE => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hD hE
  | neg D _ hD => rw [map_neg]; exact neg_mem hD

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XS.isUnit_eqOfSection_pullback_iff
statement:
theorem isUnit_eqOfSection_pullback_iff (e : Γ(M, ⊤)) (x : X) :
    IsUnit (eqOfSection _ hMX (wPullbackSection f e) x) ↔
      IsUnit (eqOfSection M hM e (f x))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hu ↦ ?_, isUnit_eqOfSection_pullback f hM hMX e x⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha, h⟩ := germ_wCoord_change
    (WFrame.ofData (pullbackWFrame f (wFrameAt M hM (f x)) x (wFrameAt M hM (f x)).mem))
    (wFrameAt _ hMX x) (wPullbackSection f e)
  have h2 := Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply f (wFrameAt M hM (f x)).U x
    (wFrameAt M hM (f x)).mem (wCoord (wFrameAt M hM (f x)) e)
  have hu' := hu
  unfold eqOfSection at hu'
  rw [h, wCoord_pullbackWFrame] at hu'
  have h3 : IsUnit ((f.stalkMap x).hom (eqOfSection M hM e (f x))) := by
    have h4 := isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left hu'
    unfold eqOfSection
    exact (congrArg IsUnit h2).mpr h4
  exact (isUnit_map_iff (f.stalkMap x).hom _).mp h3

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XS.isUnit_eqOfSection_iff_of_ker
statement:
theorem isUnit_eqOfSection_iff_of_ker {Q : Scheme.{u}} (σ : tensorUnitSheaf P ⟶ M)
    (p : Q ⟶ P) [IsClosedImmersion p] (hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = p.ker) (y : P) :
    IsUnit (eqOfSection M hM (E26.sectionOfHom σ) y) ↔ y ∉ Set.range p
proof:
:= by
  haveI : M.IsLocallyFree := hM.isFiniteLocallyFree.isLocallyFree
  haveI : M.IsFinitePresentation :=
    IsFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation P hM.isFiniteLocallyFree
  constructor
  · rintro hu ⟨q, rfl⟩
    have hker := E27.ker_stalkMap_eq_span_germ_wCoord σ p hid q (wFrameAt M hM (p q))
    have h1 : RingHom.ker (p.stalkMap q).hom = ⊤ := by
      rw [hker]
      exact Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top.mpr hu
    have h2 : (1 : P.presheaf.stalk (p q)) ∈ RingHom.ker (p.stalkMap q).hom := by
      rw [h1]
      exact Submodule.mem_top
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker, map_one] at h2
    exact one_ne_zero h2
  · intro hy
    refine E26.wCoord_isUnit_of_notMem_support σ y ?_ (wFrameAt M hM y)
    have hs : ((p.ker).support : Set P) = Set.range p := by
      rw [Scheme.Hom.support_ker, p.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range.closure_eq]
    rw [hid]
    intro hmem
    exact hy (by rw [← hs]; exact hmem)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XS.res_eq_smul_res_of_le
statement:
theorem res_eq_smul_res_of_le (e s : Γ(L, ⊤)) {V V' : X.Opens} (h : V' ≤ V) (r : Γ(X, V))
    (hr : L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op s =
      r • L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op e) :
    L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V' ≤ ⊤)).op s =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op r • L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V' ≤ ⊤)).op e
proof:
:= by
  have h' := congrArg (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op) hr
  rw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul, presheaf_map_map_g2xlb, presheaf_map_map_g2xlb] at h'
  exact h'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XS.smul_res_cancel
statement:
theorem smul_res_cancel (e : Γ(L, ⊤)) (V : X.Opens)
    (hV : ∀ y ∈ V, IsUnit (eqOfSection L hL e y)) (a b : Γ(X, V))
    (h : a • L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op e =
      b • L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op e) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  refine TopCat.Presheaf.section_ext X.sheaf V a b fun y hy ↦ ?_
  change X.presheaf.germ V y hy a = X.presheaf.germ V y hy b
  have hV' : V ⊓ (wFrameAt L hL y).U ≤ (wFrameAt L hL y).U := inf_le_right
  have hVV : V ⊓ (wFrameAt L hL y).U ≤ V := inf_le_left
  have hyV : y ∈ V ⊓ (wFrameAt L hL y).U := ⟨hy, (wFrameAt L hL y).mem⟩
  have hc : X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVV).op a *
        X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV').op (wCoord (wFrameAt L hL y) e) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVV).op b *
        X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV').op (wCoord (wFrameAt L hL y) e) := by
    apply D39.wFrameSec_injective (wFrameAt L hL y) _ hV'
    rw [wFrameSec_smul (wFrameAt L hL y) _ hV' (_ * _), mul_smul,
      ← wFrameSec_smul (wFrameAt L hL y) _ hV', wFrameSec_restrict_wCoord,
      wFrameSec_smul (wFrameAt L hL y) _ hV' (_ * _), mul_smul,
      ← wFrameSec_smul (wFrameAt L hL y) _ hV', wFrameSec_restrict_wCoord]
    have h' := congrArg (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVV).op) h
    rw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul, Scheme.Modules.map_smul, presheaf_map_map_g2xlb] at h'
    exact h'
  have h2 := congrArg (X.presheaf.germ _ y hyV) hc
  rw [map_mul, map_mul, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply,
    TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply] at h2
  exact (hV y hy).mul_right_cancel h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XS.isUnit_ratioCoord
statement:
theorem isUnit_ratioCoord (e : Γ(L, ⊤)) (W : X.Opens) (y : X) :
    IsUnit (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (ratioOpen_le_frame hL e W y)).op
      (wCoord (wFrameAt L hL y) e))
proof:
:= by
  refine X.toRingedSpace.isUnit_of_isUnit_germ _ _ fun z hz ↦ ?_
  have hz' : z ∈ X.basicOpen (wCoord (wFrameAt L hL y) e) := hz.1
  have hz2 := (Scheme.mem_basicOpen X _ z (X.basicOpen_le _ hz')).mp hz'
  change IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ _ z hz _)
  rw [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]
  exact hz2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XS.localRatio_spec
statement:
theorem localRatio_spec (e s : Γ(L, ⊤)) (W : X.Opens) (y : X) :
    L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : ratioOpen hL e W y ≤ ⊤)).op s =
      localRatio hL e s W y •
        L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : ratioOpen hL e W y ≤ ⊤)).op e
proof:
:= by
  have hVd := ratioOpen_le_frame hL e W y
  rw [← wFrameSec_restrict_wCoord (wFrameAt L hL y) s _ hVd,
    ← wFrameSec_restrict_wCoord (wFrameAt L hL y) e _ hVd,
    wFrameSec_smul (wFrameAt L hL y) _ hVd
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVd).op (wCoord (wFrameAt L hL y) e)),
    smul_smul, ← wFrameSec_smul (wFrameAt L hL y) _ hVd]
  congr 1
  rw [localRatio, mul_assoc, IsUnit.val_inv_mul, mul_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XS.exists_ratio
statement:
theorem exists_ratio (e s : Γ(L, ⊤)) (W : X.Opens)
    (he : ∀ y ∈ W, IsUnit (eqOfSection L hL e y)) :
    ∃ t : Γ(X, W), L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op s =
      t • L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op e
proof:
:= by
  let U : W → X.Opens := fun y ↦ ratioOpen hL e W y.1
  let sf : ∀ y : W, Γ(X, U y) := fun y ↦ localRatio hL e s W y.1
  have hUW : ∀ y : W, U y ≤ W := fun y ↦ ratioOpen_le hL e W y.1
  have hcover : W ≤ iSup U := by
    intro y hy
    rw [Opens.mem_iSup]
    refine ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, ?_, hy⟩
    exact (Scheme.mem_basicOpen X _ y (wFrameAt L hL y).mem).mpr (he y hy)
  have hcompat : TopCat.Presheaf.IsCompatible X.sheaf.1 U sf := by
    intro i j
    apply smul_res_cancel hL e (U i ⊓ U j)
      (fun z hz ↦ he z (hUW i hz.1))
    change X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : ratioOpen hL e W i.1 ⊓ ratioOpen hL e W j.1 ≤
        ratioOpen hL e W i.1)).op (localRatio hL e s W i.1) •
        L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : ratioOpen hL e W i.1 ⊓ ratioOpen hL e W j.1 ≤ ⊤)).op e =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : ratioOpen hL e W i.1 ⊓ ratioOpen hL e W j.1 ≤
        ratioOpen hL e W j.1)).op (localRatio hL e s W j.1) •
        L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : ratioOpen hL e W i.1 ⊓ ratioOpen hL e W j.1 ≤ ⊤)).op e
    rw [← res_eq_smul_res_of_le e s inf_le_left _ (localRatio_spec hL e s W i.1),
      ← res_eq_smul_res_of_le e s inf_le_right _ (localRatio_spec hL e s W j.1)]
  obtain ⟨t₀, ht, -⟩ := TopCat.Sheaf.existsUnique_gluing' X.sheaf U W
    (fun i ↦ homOfLE (hUW i)) hcover sf hcompat
  let t : Γ(X, W) := t₀
  refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
  let F : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} X := ⟨L.presheaf, L.isSheaf⟩
  refine TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' F U W (fun i ↦ homOfLE (hUW i)) hcover _ _ fun i ↦ ?_
  change L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hUW i)).op (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op s) =
    L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hUW i)).op (t • L.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op e)
  rw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul, presheaf_map_map_g2xlb, presheaf_map_map_g2xlb]
  have hti : X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hUW i)).op t = localRatio hL e s W i.1 := ht i
  rw [hti]
  exact localRatio_spec hL e s W i.1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XS.ratio_spec
statement:
theorem ratio_spec (e s : Γ(L, ⊤)) (W : X.Opens) (he : ∀ y ∈ W, IsUnit (eqOfSection L hL e y)) :
    L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op s =
      ratio hL e s W he • L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op e
proof:
:=
  (exists_ratio hL e s W he).choose_spec

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XS.isZeroSet_of_ker

    (hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = p.ker) :
    IsZeroSet hM (E26.sectionOfHom σ) (Set.range p)
proof:
:=
  isUnit_eqOfSection_iff_of_ker hM σ p hid

theorem push_fibreInt_tmul_swap (n : ℕ) (q : ℚ) (D : dimensionCycles X (n + 1)) :

        (pc.fibreInt (k := k) g ι hι n (q ⊗ₜ QuotientAddGroup.mk D)) =
      D9.properPushforwardRationalDimChowD9 (k := k) ι' n
        (pc.swap.fibreInt (k := k) g ι' hι' n (q ⊗ₜ QuotientAddGroup.mk D))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XS.Pencil.push_fibreInt_swap
statement:
theorem push_fibreInt_swap (n : ℕ) (ξ : RationalDimChow X (n + 1)) :
    D9.properPushforwardRationalDimChowD9 (k := k) ι n (pc.fibreInt (k := k) g ι hι n ξ) =
      D9.properPushforwardRationalDimChowD9 (k := k) ι' n
        (pc.swap.fibreInt (k := k) g ι' hι' n ξ)
proof:
:= by
  induction ξ using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul q x =>
    induction x using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H D => exact push_fibreInt_tmul_swap pc g ι hι ι' hι' n q D
  | add ξ η hξ hη => rw [map_add, map_add, hξ, hη, map_add, map_add]

name: RiemannRoch.NormLengthT2.length_quot_toNat_eq
statement:
theorem length_quot_toNat_eq (x : B) :
    (Module.length A (B ⧸ Ideal.span {x})).toNat =
      (Ring.ord B x).toNat * resDeg A B
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsLocalRing.length_restrictScalars A B (B ⧸ Ideal.span {x}), ENat.toNat_mul]
  rfl

name: RiemannRoch.NormLengthT2.ordFrac_algebraMap_eq
statement:
theorem ordFrac_algebraMap_eq {x : B} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    Ring.ordFrac B (algebraMap B L x) =
      ((Multiplicative.ofAdd ((Ring.ord B x).toNat : ℤ) : Multiplicative ℤ) : ℤᵐ⁰)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ring.ordFrac_eq_ord B hx]
  exact Ring.ordMonoidWithZeroHom_eq_coe B (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hx)
    (ENat.coe_toNat (Ring.ord_ne_top (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hx))).symm

name: RiemannRoch.NormLengthT2.toNat_sum_of_ne_top
statement:
theorem toNat_sum_of_ne_top {T : Type*} (s : Finset T) (f : T → ℕ∞)
    (h : ∑ t ∈ s, f t ≠ ⊤) : (∑ t ∈ s, f t).toNat = ∑ t ∈ s, (f t).toNat
proof:
:= by
  have hf : ∀ t ∈ s, f t ≠ ⊤ := fun t ht ↦
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top h (Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ ↦ zero_le) ht)
  have heq : ∑ t ∈ s, f t = ((∑ t ∈ s, (f t).toNat : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
    push_cast
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun t ht ↦ (ENat.coe_toNat (hf t ht)).symm)
  rw [heq, ENat.toNat_coe]

name: RiemannRoch.NormLengthT2.prod_coe_ofAdd_pow
statement:
theorem prod_coe_ofAdd_pow {T : Type*} [Fintype T] (n d : T → ℕ) :
    ∏ t, ((Multiplicative.ofAdd (n t : ℤ) : Multiplicative ℤ) : ℤᵐ⁰) ^ d t =
      ((Multiplicative.ofAdd ((∑ t, n t * d t : ℕ) : ℤ) : Multiplicative ℤ) : ℤᵐ⁰)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.cast_sum, ofAdd_sum, ← WithZero.coeMonoidHom_apply, map_prod]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun t _ ↦ ?_)
  rw [WithZero.coeMonoidHom_apply, ← WithZero.coe_pow, ← ofAdd_nsmul]
  congr 2
  push_cast
  rw [nsmul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

name: RiemannRoch.NormLengthT2.algebraMap_ne_zero_of_atPrime
statement:
theorem algebraMap_ne_zero_of_atPrime {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [IsDomain S] (P : Ideal S)
    [P.IsPrime] (D : Type*) [CommRing D] [Algebra S D] [IsLocalization.AtPrime D P]
    {b : S} (hb : b ≠ 0) : algebraMap S D b ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  exact hb (IsLocalization.injective D P.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors
    (h0.trans (map_zero _).symm))

name: RiemannRoch.NormLengthT2.isLocalHom_algebraMap
statement:
theorem isLocalHom_algebraMap [∀ t, IsLocalRing (D t)]
    (hDtower : ∀ t r, algebraMap A (D t) (algebraMap R A r) =
      algebraMap S (D t) (algebraMap R S r))
    (hQover : ∀ t, (Q t).comap (algebraMap R S) = p) (t : T) :
    IsLocalHom (algebraMap A (D t))
proof:
:= by
  refine ((IsLocalRing.local_hom_TFAE (algebraMap A (D t))).out 2 0).mp ?_
  rw [← IsLocalization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal p A, Ideal.map_map]
  have hcomp : (algebraMap A (D t)).comp (algebraMap R A) =
      (algebraMap S (D t)).comp (algebraMap R S) := RingHom.ext (hDtower t)
  rw [hcomp, ← Ideal.map_map, ← IsLocalization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal (Q t) (D t)]
  apply Ideal.map_mono
  rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, hQover t]

name: RiemannRoch.NormLengthT2.ordFrac_norm_eq_ofAdd_sum
statement:
theorem ordFrac_norm_eq_ofAdd_sum
    (hDtower : ∀ t r, algebraMap A (D t) (algebraMap R A r) =
      algebraMap S (D t) (algebraMap R S r))
    (hQover : ∀ t, (Q t).comap (algebraMap R S) = p)
    (hQinj : Function.Injective Q)
    (hQsurj : ∀ Q' : Ideal S, Q'.IsPrime → Q'.comap (algebraMap R S) = p → ∃ t, Q t = Q')
    (b : S) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    Ring.ordFrac A (Algebra.norm K (algebraMap S L b)) =
      ((Multiplicative.ofAdd ((∑ t, (Ring.ord (D t) (algebraMap S (D t) b)).toNat *
        resDeg A (D t) : ℕ) : ℤ) : Multiplicative ℤ) : ℤᵐ⁰)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hfin, hnorm⟩ := RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.local_formula (K := K) (L := L)
    p (A := A) Q D hDtower hQover hQinj hQsurj b hb
  rw [hnorm, toNat_sum_of_ne_top _ _ hfin]
  congr 3
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun t _ ↦ ?_)
  exact length_quot_toNat_eq A (D t) _

name: RiemannRoch.NormLengthT2.ordFrac_norm_eq_prod_of_mem
statement:
theorem ordFrac_norm_eq_prod_of_mem
    (hDtower : ∀ t r, algebraMap A (D t) (algebraMap R A r) =
      algebraMap S (D t) (algebraMap R S r))
    (hQover : ∀ t, (Q t).comap (algebraMap R S) = p)
    (hQinj : Function.Injective Q)
    (hQsurj : ∀ Q' : Ideal S, Q'.IsPrime → Q'.comap (algebraMap R S) = p → ∃ t, Q t = Q')
    (b : S) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    Ring.ordFrac A (Algebra.norm K (algebraMap S L b)) =
      ∏ t, Ring.ordFrac (D t) (algebraMap S L b) ^ resDeg A (D t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ordFrac_norm_eq_ofAdd_sum p Q D hDtower hQover hQinj hQsurj b hb, ← prod_coe_ofAdd_pow]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun t _ ↦ ?_)
  rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply S (D t) L,
    ordFrac_algebraMap_eq (algebraMap_ne_zero_of_atPrime (Q t) (D t) hb)]

name: RiemannRoch.NormLengthT2.ordFrac_norm_eq_prod
statement:
theorem ordFrac_norm_eq_prod
    (hDtower : ∀ t r, algebraMap A (D t) (algebraMap R A r) =
      algebraMap S (D t) (algebraMap R S r))
    (hQover : ∀ t, (Q t).comap (algebraMap R S) = p)
    (hQinj : Function.Injective Q)
    (hQsurj : ∀ Q' : Ideal S, Q'.IsPrime → Q'.comap (algebraMap R S) = p → ∃ t, Q t = Q')
    (b : L) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    Ring.ordFrac A (Algebra.norm K b) =
      ∏ t, Ring.ordFrac (D t) b ^ resDeg A (D t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, y, hy, rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective (A := S) b
  have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hy
  have hyL : algebraMap S L y ≠ 0 := (map_ne_zero_iff _ (IsFractionRing.injective S L)).mpr hy0
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hb (by rw [map_zero, zero_div])
  set c := algebraMap S L x / algebraMap S L y with hc
  have hcy : c * algebraMap S L y = algebraMap S L x := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hyL
  have hX := ordFrac_norm_eq_prod_of_mem (K := K) (L := L) p Q D hDtower hQover hQinj hQsurj x hx0
  have hY := ordFrac_norm_eq_prod_of_mem (K := K) (L := L) p Q D hDtower hQover hQinj hQsurj y hy0
  have hNy : Ring.ordFrac A (Algebra.norm K (algebraMap S L y)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [map_ne_zero]
    exact Algebra.norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hyL
  rw [← hcy, map_mul, map_mul] at hX
  have hP : ∏ t, Ring.ordFrac (D t) (c * algebraMap S L y) ^ resDeg A (D t) =
      (∏ t, Ring.ordFrac (D t) c ^ resDeg A (D t)) *
        Ring.ordFrac A (Algebra.norm K (algebraMap S L y)) := by
    rw [hY, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
    refine Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun t _ ↦ ?_)
    rw [map_mul, mul_pow]
  rw [hP] at hX
  exact mul_right_cancel₀ hNy hX

name: RiemannRoch.NormLengthT2.isLocalization_atPrime_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem isLocalization_atPrime_maximalIdeal (A : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] :
    IsLocalization.AtPrime A (maximalIdeal A)
proof:
:=
  IsLocalization.self (fun _ hx ↦ (IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal.mp hx))

name: RiemannRoch.NormLengthT2.comap_eq_maximalIdeal
statement: theorem comap_eq_maximalIdeal (t : T) : (Q t).comap (algebraMap A B) = maximalIdeal A
proof:
:= by
  haveI : (Ideal.under A (Q t)).IsMaximal := Ideal.IsMaximal.under A (Q t)
  exact IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal this

name: RiemannRoch.NormLengthT2.ordFrac_norm_eq_prod_local
statement:
theorem ordFrac_norm_eq_prod_local
    (hQinj : Function.Injective Q)
    (hQsurj : ∀ Q' : Ideal B, Q'.IsMaximal → ∃ t, Q t = Q')
    (b : L) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    Ring.ordFrac A (Algebra.norm K b) =
      ∏ t, Ring.ordFrac (D t) b ^ resDeg A (D t)
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsLocalization.AtPrime A (maximalIdeal A) := isLocalization_atPrime_maximalIdeal A
  haveI : ∀ t, (Q t).IsPrime := fun t ↦ (hQ t).isPrime
  refine ordFrac_norm_eq_prod (R := A) (S := B) (K := K) (L := L) (maximalIdeal A) (A := A) Q D
    (fun t r ↦ ?_) (comap_eq_maximalIdeal Q) hQinj (fun Q' hQ' hover ↦ ?_) b hb
  · rw [Algebra.algebraMap_self, RingHom.id_apply, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B (D t)]
  · haveI := hQ'
    have hmax : Q'.IsMaximal := Ideal.isMaximal_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal_comap Q'
      (by rw [hover]; exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal A)
    exact hQsurj Q' hmax

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XDESC.divCyc_eq_restrictHom
statement:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XDESC.divCycPrime_id_mem_relOn
statement:
theorem divCycPrime_id_mem_relOn (a : Γ(X, ⊤)) (n : ℕ) (S : Set X) (hS : IsClosed S) (w : X)
    (hw : w ∈ S) : divCycPrime (k := k) a (𝟙 X) n w ∈ relOn n S
proof:
:= by
  unfold divCycPrime
  split_ifs with h
  · have e : restrictHom (𝟙 X) n (transGen (k := k) a n w h.1 h.2).cycle =
        (transGen (k := k) a n w h.1 h.2).cycle := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      ext z
      rfl
    rw [e]
    exact generator_mem_relOn _ fun y ↦ (C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι w y).mem_closed hS hw
  · exact zero_mem _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XDESC.divCyc_id_mem_relOn
statement:
theorem divCyc_id_mem_relOn (a : Γ(X, ⊤)) (n : ℕ) (S : Set X) (hS : IsClosed S)
    (D : dimensionCycles X (n + 1)) (hD : ∀ w, D.1 w ≠ 0 → w ∈ S) :
    divCyc (k := k) a (𝟙 X) n D ∈ relOn n S
proof:
:= by
  change (compactCycleFinsupp D.1).sum (fun v m ↦ m • divCycPrime (k := k) a (𝟙 X) n v) ∈ _
  rw [Finsupp.sum]
  refine sum_mem fun w hw ↦ zsmul_mem (divCycPrime_id_mem_relOn a n S hS w (hD w ?_)) _
  rwa [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, compactCycleFinsupp_apply] at hw

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XDESC.restrictFn_eq_ffHom
statement:
theorem restrictFn_eq_ffHom (a : Γ(Y, ⊤)) :
    restrictFn a (genericPoint Y) =
      (RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.ffHom (pointClosureι (genericPoint Y))).hom
        (Y.germToFunctionField ⊤ a)
proof:
:= by
  set j := pointClosureι (genericPoint Y)
  set ηP := genericPoint (pointClosureScheme (genericPoint Y))
  rw [restrictFn_eq_germEqs a (genericPoint Y) ηP, germEqs_appTop]
  have hpb : (germEqs a).pullback j ηP = (j.stalkMap ηP).hom (germEqs a (j ηP)) := rfl
  rw [hpb]
  rw [← RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.ffHom_algebraMap_stalk j ηP]
  congr 1
  exact Scheme.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField (U := ⊤) trivial a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XDESC.c1CapPrimeCoeff_genericPoint
statement:
theorem c1CapPrimeCoeff_genericPoint (n : ℕ) (hη : height (genericPoint Y) = n + 1)
    (a : Γ(Y, ⊤)) (ha : Y.germToFunctionField ⊤ a ≠ 0) (y : Y) :
    C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs a) (genericPoint Y) y =
      Scheme.ord (Y.germToFunctionField ⊤ a) y
proof:
:= by
  have hu : IsUnit (germEqs a (genericPoint Y)) := by
    change IsUnit (Y.germToFunctionField ⊤ a)
    exact isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr ha
  rw [← transGen_cycle_apply (k := k) a n (genericPoint Y) hη hu y]
  change properPushforward (pointClosureι (genericPoint Y))
    (div (restrictFn a (genericPoint Y))) y = _
  letI : (pointClosureScheme (genericPoint Y)).Over (Spk k) :=
    ⟨pointClosureι (genericPoint Y) ≫ Y ↘ Spk k⟩
  haveI : (pointClosureι (genericPoint Y)).IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨rfl⟩
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType ((pointClosureScheme (genericPoint Y)) ↘ Spk k) := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (pointClosureι (genericPoint Y) ≫ Y ↘ Spk k)
    infer_instance
  have hdeg : (pointClosureι (genericPoint Y)).degree
      (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme (genericPoint Y))) = 1 :=
    Scheme.Hom.degree_eq_one_of_isClosedImmersion _ _
  rw [restrictFn_eq_ffHom a, D16.pf_div_ffHom_ne k (pointClosureι (genericPoint Y))
    (by rw [hdeg]; exact one_ne_zero) _ ha, hdeg, Nat.cast_one, one_smul, div_eq_ord]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XDESC.div_eq_sub_of_ratio
statement:
theorem div_eq_sub_of_ratio (n : ℕ) (hη : height (genericPoint Y) = n + 1 + 1)
    (f : Y.functionField) (a b : Γ(Y, ⊤)) (ha : Y.germToFunctionField ⊤ a ≠ 0)
    (hb : Y.germToFunctionField ⊤ b ≠ 0)
    (hab : f * Y.germToFunctionField ⊤ b = Y.germToFunctionField ⊤ a)
    (y : Y) :
    div f y = (divCyc (k := k) a (𝟙 Y) (n + 1)
        (dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint Y) (n + 1 + 1) hη)).1 y -
      (divCyc (k := k) b (𝟙 Y) (n + 1) (dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint Y) (n + 1 + 1) hη)).1 y
proof:
:= by
  have hf : f ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [zero_mul] at hab
    exact ha hab.symm
  rw [divCyc_prime_apply_g2xfr4 (k := k), divCyc_prime_apply_g2xfr4 (k := k),
    c1CapPrimeCoeff_genericPoint (k := k) (n + 1) hη a ha,
    c1CapPrimeCoeff_genericPoint (k := k) (n + 1) hη b hb, ← hab, ← div_eq_ord, ← div_eq_ord,
    div_mul f hf _ hb]
  change div f y = (div f y + div (Y.germToFunctionField ⊤ b) y) - div (Y.germToFunctionField ⊤ b) y
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XDESC.divCyc_div_mem_relOn_of_ratio
statement:
theorem divCyc_div_mem_relOn_of_ratio (n : ℕ) (hη : height (genericPoint Y) = n + 1 + 1)
    (t : Γ(Y, ⊤)) (D : dimensionCycles Y (n + 1)) (f : Y.functionField) (hD : D.1 = div f)
    (a b : Γ(Y, ⊤)) (ha : Y.germToFunctionField ⊤ a ≠ 0) (hb : Y.germToFunctionField ⊤ b ≠ 0)
    (hab : f * Y.germToFunctionField ⊤ b = Y.germToFunctionField ⊤ a) :
    divCyc (k := k) t (𝟙 Y) n D ∈ relOn n (bothZero t t)
proof:
:= by
  set P := dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint Y) (n + 1 + 1) hη with hP
  have hDeq : D = divCyc (k := k) a (𝟙 Y) (n + 1) P - divCyc (k := k) b (𝟙 Y) (n + 1) P := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    ext y
    change D6.evalHomD Y (n + 1) y D = D6.evalHomD Y (n + 1) y (_ - _)
    rw [map_sub]
    change D.1 y = (divCyc (k := k) a (𝟙 Y) (n + 1) P).1 y - (divCyc (k := k) b (𝟙 Y) (n + 1) P).1 y
    rw [hD]
    exact div_eq_sub_of_ratio (k := k) n hη f a b ha hb hab y
  rw [hDeq, map_sub]
  have key : ∀ c : Γ(Y, ⊤),
      divCyc (k := k) t (𝟙 Y) n (divCyc (k := k) c (𝟙 Y) (n + 1) P) ∈ relOn n (bothZero t t) := by
    intro c
    have hF : fullIter (k := k) t c n P - fullIter (k := k) c t n P ∈ relOn n (bothZero t c) :=
      fultonComm_route_F (k := k) t c n (genericPoint Y) hη
    have hsub : bothZero t c ⊆ bothZero t t := fun x hx ↦ ⟨hx.1, hx.1⟩
    have h1 : fullIter (k := k) t c n P - fullIter (k := k) c t n P ∈ relOn n (bothZero t t) :=
      relOn_mono hsub hF
    have h2 : fullIter (k := k) c t n P ∈ relOn n (bothZero t t) := by
      refine divCyc_id_mem_relOn c n _ (isClosed_bothZero t t) _ fun w hw ↦ ?_
      rw [hP, divCyc_prime_apply_g2xfr4 (k := k)] at hw
      obtain ⟨_, _, hnu⟩ := exists_of_c1CapPrimeCoeff_ne_zero _ hw
      exact ⟨hnu, hnu⟩
    have h3 := add_mem h1 h2
    rw [sub_add_cancel] at h3
    exact h3
  exact sub_mem (key a) (key b)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XDESC.genDesc_of_ratio
statement:
theorem genDesc_of_ratio (t : Γ(X, ⊤)) (n : ℕ) (g : DimRelationGenerator X (n + 1))
    (a b : Γ(g.Y, ⊤)) (ha : g.Y.germToFunctionField ⊤ a ≠ 0)
    (hb : g.Y.germToFunctionField ⊤ b ≠ 0)
    (hab : g.f * g.Y.germToFunctionField ⊤ b = g.Y.germToFunctionField ⊤ a) :
    GenDesc (k := k) t n g
proof:
:= by
  letI : g.Y.Over (Spk k) := ⟨g.i ≫ X ↘ Spk k⟩
  haveI : g.i.IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨rfl⟩
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (g.Y ↘ Spk k) := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (g.i ≫ X ↘ Spk k)
    infer_instance
  haveI : CompactSpace g.Y := g.i.isClosedEmbedding.compactSpace
  haveI : IsNoetherian g.Y := { }
  have hDmem : div g.f ∈ dimensionCycles g.Y (n + 1) := by
    intro y hy
    have hy' : div g.f y ≠ 0 := hy
    have hc : coheight y = 1 := by
      by_contra hc
      rw [div_eq_ord, Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hc] at hy'
      exact hy' rfl
    change height y = _
    rw [← height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion g.i]
    exact g.dimension y hc
  let D : dimensionCycles g.Y (n + 1) := ⟨div g.f, hDmem⟩
  have hcyc : g.cycle = D13.pfHom (k := k) g.i (n + 1) D := Subtype.ext rfl
  unfold GenDesc
  rw [hcyc, ← pf_divCyc (k := k) g.i t n D]
  refine pfHom_relOn (k := k) g.i n (bothZero (g.i.appTop t) (g.i.appTop t)) (bothZero t t)
    (isClosed_bothZero t t) (fun y hy ↦ ⟨fun h ↦ hy.1 ((isUnit_germEqs_appTop_iff g.i t y).mpr h),
      fun h ↦ hy.2 ((isUnit_germEqs_appTop_iff g.i t y).mpr h)⟩) _ ?_
  by_cases hex : ∃ y : g.Y, coheight y = 1
  · obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hex
    have hη : height (genericPoint g.Y) = n + 1 + 1 := by
      have h := dimensionCatenary_of_finiteType k (X := X) g.Y g.i y hy
      rw [g.dimension y hy, height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion g.i] at h
      rw [← h]
      push_cast
      rfl
    exact divCyc_div_mem_relOn_of_ratio (k := k) n hη _ D g.f rfl a b ha hb hab
  · have hD0 : D = 0 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      ext y
      change Scheme.ord g.f y = 0
      exact Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one (fun h ↦ hex ⟨y, h⟩) _
    rw [hD0, map_zero]
    exact zero_mem _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XDESC.genDesc_of_isAffine
statement:
theorem genDesc_of_isAffine (t : Γ(X, ⊤)) (n : ℕ) (g : DimRelationGenerator X (n + 1))
    [IsAffine g.Y] : GenDesc (k := k) t n g
proof:
:= by
  haveI := functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen g.Y ⊤ (isAffineOpen_top g.Y)
  obtain ⟨a, b, hb, hab⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective (A := Γ(g.Y, ⊤)) g.f
  have hbK : g.Y.germToFunctionField ⊤ b ≠ 0 :=
    IsFractionRing.to_map_ne_zero_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors hb
  have haK : g.Y.germToFunctionField ⊤ a ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply g.hf
    rw [← hab]
    change g.Y.germToFunctionField ⊤ a / g.Y.germToFunctionField ⊤ b = 0
    rw [h0, zero_div]
  refine genDesc_of_ratio (k := k) t n g a b haK hbK ?_
  rw [← hab]
  exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ hbK

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.graphZeroDegree
statement: theorem graphZeroDegree : GraphZeroDegree k
proof:
:= by
  intro V _ _ _ _ t u ht hu
  have hab1 : ∀ U : V.affineOpens,
      (graphIdeal t u).ideal U = Ideal.span {resTop U t, resTop U u} := ideal_graphIdeal t u
  have hab2 : ∀ U : V.affineOpens,
      (graphIdeal t u).ideal U = Ideal.span {resTop U u, resTop U t} := fun U ↦ by
    rw [ideal_graphIdeal, Set.pair_comm]
  have key : ∀ (a b : Γ(V, ⊤))
      (hab : ∀ U : V.affineOpens, (graphIdeal t u).ideal U = Ideal.span {resTop U a, resTop U b})
      (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (y : graphClosure t u), y ∉ pairM t u a b →
        (graphπ t u).degree y ≠ 0 := by
    intro a b hab ha hb y hy
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (mem_range_pairZeroι hab ht ha hb y).mpr hy
    haveI := isClosedImmersion_pairZeroι (t := t) (u := u) (a := a) (b := b) hab ht ha hb
    haveI := isClosedImmersion_pairZeroToBase (t := t) (u := u) (a := a) (b := b) hab ht ha hb
    have h := Scheme.Hom.degree_eq_one_of_isClosedImmersion (pairZeroToBase t u a b) z
    rw [pairZeroToBase, hom_degree_comp,
      Scheme.Hom.degree_eq_one_of_isClosedImmersion (pairZeroι t u a b), one_mul] at h
    rw [h]
    exact one_ne_zero
  exact ⟨key t u hab1 ht hu, key u t hab2 hu ht⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.fultonComm_route_F
statement:
theorem fultonComm_route_F (n : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = n + 1 + 1) :
    FultonComm k t u n v hv
proof:
:=
  fultonComm_of_graphZeroDegree (k := k) t u graphZeroDegree n v hv

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.divCommImproperGate_route_F
statement:
theorem divCommImproperGate_route_F (hW : jt ≫ ιt = ju ≫ ιu)
    (hZt : ∀ x, ¬ IsUnit (germEqs t x) → x ∈ Set.range ιt)
    (hZu : ∀ x, ¬ IsUnit (germEqs u x) → x ∈ Set.range ιu)
    (hWcov : ∀ x, ¬ IsUnit (germEqs t x) → ¬ IsUnit (germEqs u x) → x ∈ Set.range (ju ≫ ιu))
    (n : ℕ) : DivCommImproperGate (k := k) t u ιt ιu jt ju n
proof:
:=
  divCommImproperGate_of_graphZeroDegree (k := k) t u ιt ιu jt ju graphZeroDegree hW hZt hZu
    hWcov n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.divIntCycles_comm_route_F
statement:
theorem divIntCycles_comm_route_F (hW : jt ≫ ιt = ju ≫ ιu)
    (hZt : ∀ x, ¬ IsUnit (germEqs t x) → x ∈ Set.range ιt)
    (hZu : ∀ x, ¬ IsUnit (germEqs u x) → x ∈ Set.range ιu)
    (hWcov : ∀ x, ¬ IsUnit (germEqs t x) → ¬ IsUnit (germEqs u x) → x ∈ Set.range (ju ≫ ιu))
    (n : ℕ) (α : dimensionCycles X (n + 1 + 1)) :
    divIntCycles (k := k) (ιu.appTop t) ju n (divCyc (k := k) u ιu (n + 1) α) =
      divIntCycles (k := k) (ιt.appTop u) jt n (divCyc (k := k) t ιt (n + 1) α)
proof:
:=
  divIntCycles_comm_of_gate (k := k) t u ιt ιu jt ju hW hZt hZu n
    (divCommImproperGate_route_F (k := k) t u ιt ιu jt ju hW hZt hZu hWcov n) α

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.germEqs_ne_zero_of_isUnit_g2xfr25
statement:
theorem germEqs_ne_zero_of_isUnit_g2xfr25 {X : Scheme.{u}} {t : Γ(X, ⊤)} {x : X}
    (h : IsUnit (germEqs t x)) : t ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rintro rfl
  have h0 : germEqs (0 : Γ(X, ⊤)) x = 0 := map_zero _
  rw [h0] at h
  exact not_isUnit_zero h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.pointClosureι_genericPoint_g2xfr25

theorem pointClosureι_genericPoint_g2xfr25 {X : Scheme.{u}} (v : X) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.comp_appTop_apply_g2xfr25
statement:
theorem comp_appTop_apply_g2xfr25 {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (s : Γ(Z, ⊤)) :
    (f ≫ g).appTop s = f.appTop (g.appTop s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, CommRingCat.comp_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.fultonComm_of_epsPrime_eq_zero
statement:
theorem fultonComm_of_epsPrime_eq_zero (t u : Γ(X, ⊤)) (n : ℕ) (v : X)
    (hv : height v = n + 1 + 1) (h0 : epsPrime (germEqs t) (germEqs u) v = 0) :
    FultonComm k t u n v hv
proof:
:= by
  unfold FultonComm
  rw [fullIter_comm_of_epsPrime_eq_zero (k := k) t u n _ (fun w hw ↦ by
    have hwv : w = v := by
      by_contra h
      apply hw
      rw [m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply, if_neg h]
    rw [hwv]
    exact h0), sub_self]
  exact zero_mem _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.fultonComm_cover_Γ
statement:
theorem fultonComm_cover_Γ (hcov : ∀ y, y ∈ U ∨ y ∈ U') (hU : u |_ U = ρ * t |_ U)
    (hU' : t |_ U' = ρ' * u |_ U') (hinv : ρ |_ (U ⊓ U') * ρ' |_ (U ⊓ U') = 1)
    (hunit : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U), IsUnit (Γs.presheaf.germ U y hy ρ) → y ∈ U')
    (hunit' : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U'), IsUnit (Γs.presheaf.germ U' y hy ρ') → y ∈ U)
    (n : ℕ) (γ : Γs) (hγ : height γ = n + 1 + 1) (ht : IsUnit (germEqs t γ))
    (hu : IsUnit (germEqs u γ)) (x : U.toScheme) (hxγ : U.ι x = γ) (hx : height x = n + 1 + 1)
    (x' : U'.toScheme) (hxγ' : U'.ι x' = γ) (hx' : height x' = n + 1 + 1) (m : ℕ)
    (IH : FultonIH k m)
    (hlt : epsPrime (germEqs (U.ι.appTop t)) (germEqs (U.topIso.inv ρ)) x < m)
    (hlt' : epsPrime (germEqs (U'.ι.appTop u)) (germEqs (U'.topIso.inv ρ')) x' < m) :
    FultonComm k t u n γ hγ
proof:
:=
  chart_step (k := k) t u U U' ρ ρ' hcov hU hU' hinv hunit hunit' n γ hγ ht hu x hxγ hx x' hxγ'
    hx' (IH U.toScheme _ _ n x hx hlt) (IH U'.toScheme _ _ n x' hx' hlt')

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.fultonComm_push
statement:
theorem fultonComm_push (n : ℕ) (γ : Γs) (hγ : height γ = n + 1 + 1) (hdeg : f.degree γ = 1)
    (v : X) (hfγ : f γ = v) (hv : height v = n + 1 + 1)
    (hΓ : FultonComm k (f.appTop t) (f.appTop u) n γ hγ) : FultonComm k t u n v hv
proof:
:= by
  have hpush := pfHom_relOn (k := k) f n (bothZero (f.appTop t) (f.appTop u)) (bothZero t u)
    (isClosed_bothZero t u) (fun y hy ↦ ⟨fun h ↦ hy.1 ((isUnit_germEqs_appTop_iff f t y).mpr h),
      fun h ↦ hy.2 ((isUnit_germEqs_appTop_iff f u y).mpr h)⟩) _ hΓ
  have hv' : height (f γ) = n + 1 + 1 := by rw [hfγ]; exact hv
  have hγv : D13.pfHom (k := k) f (n + 1 + 1) (dimPrimeCycle γ (n + 1 + 1) hγ) =
      dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1 + 1) hv :=
    (pfHom_dimPrimeCycle_of_degree_one (k := k) f (n + 1 + 1) γ hγ hdeg hv').trans
      (dimPrimeCycle_congr hfγ hv' hv)
  unfold FultonComm
  rw [← hγv, ← pf_fullIter (k := k) f t u, ← pf_fullIter (k := k) f u t, ← map_sub]
  exact hpush

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.fultonComm_cover
statement:
theorem fultonComm_cover (U U' : Γs.Opens) (ρ : Γ(Γs, U)) (ρ' : Γ(Γs, U'))
    (hcov : ∀ y, y ∈ U ∨ y ∈ U') (hU : f.appTop u |_ U = ρ * f.appTop t |_ U)
    (hU' : f.appTop t |_ U' = ρ' * f.appTop u |_ U') (hinv : ρ |_ (U ⊓ U') * ρ' |_ (U ⊓ U') = 1)
    (hunit : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U), IsUnit (Γs.presheaf.germ U y hy ρ) → y ∈ U')
    (hunit' : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U'), IsUnit (Γs.presheaf.germ U' y hy ρ') → y ∈ U)
    (hdegU : ∀ y, y ∉ U' → f.degree y ≠ 0) (hdegU' : ∀ y, y ∉ U → f.degree y ≠ 0)
    (n : ℕ) (γ : Γs) (hγ : height γ = n + 1 + 1) (hdeg : f.degree γ = 1)
    (v : X) (hfγ : f γ = v) (hv : height v = n + 1 + 1) (ht : IsUnit (germEqs t v))
    (hu : IsUnit (germEqs u v)) (m : ℕ) (hm : epsPrime (germEqs t) (germEqs u) v = m)
    (hpos : 0 < m) (IH : FultonIH k m) : FultonComm k t u n v hv
proof:
:= by
  have ht' : IsUnit (germEqs (f.appTop t) γ) :=
    isUnit_appTop_of_isUnit f t (by rw [hfγ]; exact ht)
  have hu' : IsUnit (germEqs (f.appTop u) γ) :=
    isUnit_appTop_of_isUnit f u (by rw [hfγ]; exact hu)
  have hγU : γ ∈ U := by
    rcases hcov γ with h | h
    · exact h
    · apply hunit' γ h
      have e := germEqs_mul_chart (u := f.appTop t) (t := f.appTop u) U' ρ' hU' h
      rw [e, chartEqs_of_mem U' ρ' h] at ht'
      exact isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left ht'
  have hγU' : γ ∈ U' := by
    rcases hcov γ with h | h
    · apply hunit γ h
      have e := germEqs_mul_chart (u := f.appTop u) (t := f.appTop t) U ρ hU h
      rw [e, chartEqs_of_mem U ρ h] at hu'
      exact isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left hu'
    · exact h
  have hinvG : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U) (hy' : y ∈ U'),
      Γs.presheaf.germ U y hy ρ * Γs.presheaf.germ U' y hy' ρ' = 1 :=
    fun y hy hy' ↦ germ_mul_germ_eq_one U U' ρ ρ' hinv hy hy'
  have hinvG' : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U') (hy' : y ∈ U),
      Γs.presheaf.germ U' y hy ρ' * Γs.presheaf.germ U y hy' ρ = 1 :=
    fun y hy hy' ↦ by rw [mul_comm]; exact hinvG y hy' hy
  let x : U.toScheme := ⟨γ, hγU⟩
  let x' : U'.toScheme := ⟨γ, hγU'⟩
  have hxγ : U.ι x = γ := rfl
  have hxγ' : U'.ι x' = γ := rfl
  have hx : height x = n + 1 + 1 := by
    rw [← height_opensι_g2xfr25 (k := k), hxγ]
    exact hγ
  have hx' : height x' = n + 1 + 1 := by
    rw [← height_opensι_g2xfr25 (k := k), hxγ']
    exact hγ
  have hlt := epsPrime_toScheme_chart_lt (k := k) f t u n U ρ x hγ hdeg hU
    (fun y _ hnu ↦ hdegU y (notMem_of_not_isUnit_chartEqs U U' ρ ρ' hinvG hnu))
    (by rw [hxγ, hfγ, hm]; exact hpos)
  have hlt' := epsPrime_toScheme_chart_lt (k := k) f u t n U' ρ' x' hγ hdeg hU'
    (fun y _ hnu ↦ hdegU' y (notMem_of_not_isUnit_chartEqs U' U ρ' ρ hinvG' hnu))
    (by rw [hxγ', hfγ, epsPrime_comm, hm]; exact hpos)
  have e1 : epsPrime (germEqs t) (germEqs u) (f (U.ι x)) = m := by
    rw [← hm]; exact congrArg _ hfγ
  have e2 : epsPrime (germEqs u) (germEqs t) (f (U'.ι x')) = m := by
    rw [← hm, epsPrime_comm]; exact congrArg _ hfγ
  exact fultonComm_push (k := k) f t u n γ hγ hdeg v hfγ hv
    (fultonComm_cover_Γ (k := k) (f.appTop t) (f.appTop u) U U' ρ ρ' hcov hU hU' hinv hunit
      hunit' n γ hγ ht' hu' x hxγ hx x' hxγ' hx' m IH (hlt.trans_eq e1) (hlt'.trans_eq e2))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.fultonComm_of_model
statement:
theorem fultonComm_of_model (M : GraphModel k V (ιV.appTop t) (ιV.appTop u)) (n : ℕ) (v : X)
    (hgen : ιV (genericPoint V) = v) (hv : height v = n + 1 + 1) (ht : IsUnit (germEqs t v))
    (hu : IsUnit (germEqs u v)) (m : ℕ) (hm : epsPrime (germEqs t) (germEqs u) v = m)
    (hpos : 0 < m) (IH : FultonIH k m) : FultonComm k t u n v hv
proof:
:= by
  have happ : ∀ s : Γ(X, ⊤), (M.π ≫ ιV).appTop s = M.π.appTop (ιV.appTop s) :=
    fun s ↦ comp_appTop_apply_g2xfr25 _ _ s
  have hfγ : (M.π ≫ ιV) M.γ = v := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, M.hγ, hgen]
  have hdeg : (M.π ≫ ιV).degree M.γ = 1 := by
    rw [hom_degree_comp, M.hdeg, Scheme.Hom.degree_eq_one_of_isClosedImmersion (f := ιV), mul_one]
  have hdegf : ∀ y, M.π.degree y ≠ 0 → (M.π ≫ ιV).degree y ≠ 0 := fun y hy ↦ by
    rw [hom_degree_comp, Scheme.Hom.degree_eq_one_of_isClosedImmersion (f := ιV), mul_one]
    exact hy
  have hγh : height M.γ = n + 1 + 1 := by
    rw [← heightCompatible_of_finiteType k (M.π ≫ ιV) M.γ (by rw [hdeg]; exact one_ne_zero), hfγ]
    exact hv
  have hU : (M.π ≫ ιV).appTop u |_ M.U = M.ρ * (M.π ≫ ιV).appTop t |_ M.U := by
    rw [happ, happ]; exact M.hU
  have hU' : (M.π ≫ ιV).appTop t |_ M.U' = M.ρ' * (M.π ≫ ιV).appTop u |_ M.U' := by
    rw [happ, happ]; exact M.hU'
  exact fultonComm_cover (k := k) (M.π ≫ ιV) t u M.U M.U' M.ρ M.ρ' M.hcov hU hU' M.hinv M.hunit
    M.hunit' (fun y hy ↦ hdegf y (M.hdegU y hy)) (fun y hy ↦ hdegf y (M.hdegU' y hy)) n M.γ hγh
    hdeg v hfγ hv ht hu m hm hpos IH

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.fultonComm_of_graphModels
statement:
theorem fultonComm_of_graphModels (hG : HasGraphModels k) (m : ℕ) :
    ∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X]
      (t u : Γ(X, ⊤)) (n : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = n + 1 + 1),
      epsPrime (germEqs t) (germEqs u) v = m → FultonComm k t u n v hv
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ m ih =>
  intro X _ _ _ t u n v hv hm
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with h0 | hpos
  · exact fultonComm_of_epsPrime_eq_zero (k := k) t u n v hv (hm.trans h0)
  have IH : FultonIH k m := fun Y _ _ _ a b n' y hy hlt ↦ ih _ hlt Y a b n' y hy rfl
  have hpos' : 0 < epsPrime (germEqs t) (germEqs u) v := by rw [hm]; exact hpos
  have ht : IsUnit (germEqs t v) := by
    by_contra ht
    rw [epsPrime_eq_zero_of_not_isUnit_left t _ ht] at hpos'
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos'
  have hu : IsUnit (germEqs u v) := by
    by_contra hu
    rw [epsPrime_eq_zero_of_not_isUnit_right _ u hu] at hpos'
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos'
  letI : (pointClosureScheme v).Over (Spk k) := ⟨pointClosureι v ≫ X ↘ Spk k⟩
  haveI : (pointClosureι v).IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨rfl⟩
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType ((pointClosureScheme v) ↘ Spk k) := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (pointClosureι v ≫ X ↘ Spk k)
    infer_instance
  haveI : CompactSpace (pointClosureScheme v) := (pointClosureι v).isClosedEmbedding.compactSpace
  haveI : IsNoetherian (pointClosureScheme v) := { }
  have hgen := pointClosureι_genericPoint_g2xfr25 v
  have hunitV : ∀ s : Γ(X, ⊤), IsUnit (germEqs s v) →
      IsUnit (germEqs ((pointClosureι v).appTop s) (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v))) :=
    fun s hs ↦ (isUnit_germEqs_appTop_iff (pointClosureι v) s _).mpr (by rw [hgen]; exact hs)
  obtain ⟨M⟩ := hG (pointClosureScheme v) ((pointClosureι v).appTop t)
    ((pointClosureι v).appTop u) (germEqs_ne_zero_of_isUnit_g2xfr25 (hunitV t ht))
    (germEqs_ne_zero_of_isUnit_g2xfr25 (hunitV u hu))
  exact fultonComm_of_model (k := k) (pointClosureι v) t u M n v hgen hv ht hu m hm hpos IH

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.restrictHom_relOn_eq_zero
statement:
theorem restrictHom_relOn_eq_zero (ι : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι] (n : ℕ) (S : Set X)
    (hS : S ⊆ Set.range ι) (D : dimensionCycles X n) (hD : D ∈ relOn n S) :
    (QuotientAddGroup.mk (restrictHom ι n D) : DimChow Z n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hD using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem D hD =>
    obtain ⟨G, hG, rfl⟩ := hD
    exact restrictHom_relation_of_range ι G fun y ↦ hS (hG y)
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; rfl
  | add D E _ _ hD hE => rw [map_add, QuotientAddGroup.mk_add, hD, hE, add_zero]
  | neg D _ hD => rw [map_neg, QuotientAddGroup.mk_neg, hD, neg_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.divIntCycles_prime_comm_of_graphModels
statement:
theorem divIntCycles_prime_comm_of_graphModels (hG : HasGraphModels k)
    (hW : jt ≫ ιt = ju ≫ ιu)
    (hZt : ∀ x, ¬ IsUnit (germEqs t x) → x ∈ Set.range ιt)
    (hZu : ∀ x, ¬ IsUnit (germEqs u x) → x ∈ Set.range ιu)
    (hWcov : ∀ x, ¬ IsUnit (germEqs t x) → ¬ IsUnit (germEqs u x) → x ∈ Set.range (ju ≫ ιu))
    (n : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = n + 1 + 1) :
    divIntCycles (k := k) (ιu.appTop t) ju n
        (divCyc (k := k) u ιu (n + 1) (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1 + 1) hv)) =
      divIntCycles (k := k) (ιt.appTop u) jt n
        (divCyc (k := k) t ιt (n + 1) (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1 + 1) hv))
proof:
:= by
  have hF := fultonComm_of_graphModels (k := k) hG _ X t u n v hv rfl
  rw [divIntCycles_eq_mk_divCyc, divIntCycles_eq_mk_divCyc,
    restrict_fullIter (k := k) t u ιu ju hZu, restrict_fullIter (k := k) u t ιt jt hZt,
    restrictHom_congr_g2xf hW]
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← QuotientAddGroup.mk_sub, ← map_sub]
  exact restrictHom_relOn_eq_zero (ju ≫ ιu) n (bothZero t u) (fun x hx ↦ hWcov x hx.1 hx.2) _ hF

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.divCommImproperGate_of_graphModels
statement:
theorem divCommImproperGate_of_graphModels (hG : HasGraphModels k)
    (hW : jt ≫ ιt = ju ≫ ιu)
    (hZt : ∀ x, ¬ IsUnit (germEqs t x) → x ∈ Set.range ιt)
    (hZu : ∀ x, ¬ IsUnit (germEqs u x) → x ∈ Set.range ιu)
    (hWcov : ∀ x, ¬ IsUnit (germEqs t x) → ¬ IsUnit (germEqs u x) → x ∈ Set.range (ju ≫ ιu))
    (n : ℕ) : DivCommImproperGate (k := k) t u ιt ιu jt ju n
proof:
:=
  fun v hv _ ↦ divIntCycles_prime_comm_of_graphModels (k := k) t u ιt ιu jt ju hG hW hZt hZu
    hWcov n v hv

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.divIntCycles_comm_of_graphModels
statement:
theorem divIntCycles_comm_of_graphModels (hG : HasGraphModels k)
    (hW : jt ≫ ιt = ju ≫ ιu)
    (hZt : ∀ x, ¬ IsUnit (germEqs t x) → x ∈ Set.range ιt)
    (hZu : ∀ x, ¬ IsUnit (germEqs u x) → x ∈ Set.range ιu)
    (hWcov : ∀ x, ¬ IsUnit (germEqs t x) → ¬ IsUnit (germEqs u x) → x ∈ Set.range (ju ≫ ιu))
    (n : ℕ) (α : dimensionCycles X (n + 1 + 1)) :
    divIntCycles (k := k) (ιu.appTop t) ju n (divCyc (k := k) u ιu (n + 1) α) =
      divIntCycles (k := k) (ιt.appTop u) jt n (divCyc (k := k) t ιt (n + 1) α)
proof:
:=
  divIntCycles_comm_of_gate (k := k) t u ιt ιu jt ju hW hZt hZu n
    (divCommImproperGate_of_graphModels (k := k) t u ιt ιu jt ju hG hW hZt hZu hWcov n) α

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLBC.c1_eq_zero_of_isUnit_g2xlbc
statement:
theorem c1_eq_zero_of_isUnit_g2xlbc (a : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (w y : X) (hy : IsUnit (a y)) :
    C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a w y = 0
proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLBC.finsum_eq_finsum_comp_g2xlbc
statement:
theorem finsum_eq_finsum_comp_g2xlbc {Y : Type*} (g : Y → X) (hg : Function.Injective g)
    (f : X → ℤ) (h : Function.support f ⊆ Set.range g) : ∑ᶠ v, f v = ∑ᶠ y, f (g y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← finsum_mem_range hg, ← finsum_mem_univ f]
  refine finsum_mem_inter_support_eq f _ _ ?_
  ext v
  simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_univ, true_and]
  exact ⟨fun hv ↦ ⟨h hv, hv⟩, fun hv ↦ hv.2⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLBC.c1CapCyclesCoeff_chart
statement:
theorem c1CapCyclesCoeff_chart {a : C1Cap.LocalEquations X} {O : X.Opens}
    {τ : Γ(O.toScheme, ⊤)} (h : ChartAgree a O τ) (F : X → ℤ) (z : O.toScheme) :
    C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff a F (O.ι z) =
      C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (germEqs τ) (fun x ↦ F (O.ι x)) z
proof:
:= by
  unfold C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff
  have hsub : Function.support (fun v ↦ F v * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a v (O.ι z)) ⊆
      Set.range O.ι := by
    intro v hv
    rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
    by_contra hvO
    apply hv
    show F v * _ = 0
    rw [C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_not_specializes a
      (fun hsp ↦ hvO (hsp.mem_open O.isOpen (mem_of_mem_opens_g2xlbc O z))), mul_zero]
  rw [finsum_eq_finsum_comp_g2xlbc O.ι O.ι.isOpenEmbedding.injective _ hsub]
  exact finsum_congr fun x ↦ by rw [h x z]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLBC.iter_chart
statement:
theorem iter_chart {a b : C1Cap.LocalEquations X} {O : X.Opens} {τa τb : Γ(O.toScheme, ⊤)}
    (ha : ChartAgree a O τa) (hb : ChartAgree b O τb) (F : X → ℤ) (z : O.toScheme) :
    C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff a (C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff b F) (O.ι z) =
      C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (germEqs τa)
        (C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (germEqs τb) (fun x ↦ F (O.ι x))) z
proof:
:= by
  rw [c1CapCyclesCoeff_chart ha]
  congr 1
  funext x
  exact c1CapCyclesCoeff_chart hb F x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLBC.c1CapCyclesCoeff_eq_zero_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem c1CapCyclesCoeff_eq_zero_of_isUnit (a : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (F : X → ℤ) (y : X)
    (hy : IsUnit (a y)) : C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff a F y = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff
  rw [finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero fun v ↦ by
    rw [c1_eq_zero_of_isUnit_g2xlbc a v y hy, mul_zero]]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLBC.iter_eq_zero_of_notMem
statement:
theorem iter_eq_zero_of_notMem (a b : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (A B : Set X) (hB : IsClosed B)
    (ha : ∀ x, ¬ IsUnit (a x) → x ∈ A) (hb : ∀ x, ¬ IsUnit (b x) → x ∈ B) (F : X → ℤ)
    (y : X) (hy : y ∉ A ∩ B) :
    C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff a (C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff b F) y = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hay : IsUnit (a y)
  · exact c1CapCyclesCoeff_eq_zero_of_isUnit a _ y hay
  have hyA : y ∈ A := ha y hay
  have hyB : y ∉ B := fun h ↦ hy ⟨hyA, h⟩
  unfold C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff
  refine finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero fun w ↦ ?_
  by_cases hwy : w ⤳ y
  · have hbw : IsUnit (b w) := by
      by_contra hbw
      exact hyB (hwy.mem_closed hB (hb w hbw))
    have h0 := c1CapCyclesCoeff_eq_zero_of_isUnit b F w hbw
    unfold C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff at h0
    rw [h0, zero_mul]
  · rw [C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_not_specializes a hwy, mul_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLBC.c1CapCyclesCoeff_closed
statement:
theorem c1CapCyclesCoeff_closed {Z : Scheme.{u}} (ι : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι]
    (a : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (aZ : C1Cap.LocalEquations Z)
    (hag : ∀ x z, C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff aZ x z = C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a (ι x) (ι z))
    (F : X → ℤ) (hF : Function.support F ⊆ Set.range ι) (z : Z) :
    C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff aZ (fun x ↦ F (ι x)) z = C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff a F (ι z)
proof:
:= by
  unfold C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff
  have hsub : Function.support (fun v ↦ F v * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a v (ι z)) ⊆
      Set.range ι := fun v hv ↦ hF (left_ne_zero_of_mul hv)
  rw [finsum_eq_finsum_comp_g2xlbc ι ι.isEmbedding.injective _ hsub]
  exact finsum_congr fun x ↦ by rw [hag x z]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLBC.support_c1CapCyclesCoeff_subset
statement:
theorem support_c1CapCyclesCoeff_subset (a : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (F : X → ℤ) (A : Set X)
    (ha : ∀ x, ¬ IsUnit (a x) → x ∈ A) :
    Function.support (C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff a F) ⊆ A
proof:
:= by
  intro w hw
  by_contra hwA
  exact hw (c1CapCyclesCoeff_eq_zero_of_isUnit a F w (by_contra fun h ↦ hwA (ha w h)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLBC.lbIter_comm_relOn
statement:
theorem lbIter_comm_relOn (hW : Set.range ι ⊆ W) (hW' : Set.range ι' ⊆ W')
    (hZ : IsSupport L hL s ι) (hZ' : IsSupport L' hL' s' ι')
    (hP : PrincipalOn L hL s W t) (hP' : PrincipalOn L' hL' s' W' t') (n : ℕ)
    (α : dimensionCycles X (n + 1 + 1)) :
    ∃ R ∈ relOn n (Set.range ι ∩ Set.range ι'), ∀ y,
      R.1 y = C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (eqOfSection L hL s)
          (C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (eqOfSection L' hL' s') α.1) y -
        C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (eqOfSection L' hL' s')
          (C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (eqOfSection L hL s) α.1) y
proof:
:= by
  set O : X.Opens := W ⊓ W' with hO
  have hOW : O ≤ W := inf_le_left
  have hOW' : O ≤ W' := inf_le_right
  have hPO := principalOn_mono hOW hP
  have hPO' := principalOn_mono hOW' hP'
  set τ := O.topIso.inv (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hOW).op t) with hτ
  set τ' := O.topIso.inv (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hOW').op t') with hτ'
  have hA : ChartAgree (eqOfSection L hL s) O τ := chartAgree_of_principalOn hPO
  have hA' : ChartAgree (eqOfSection L' hL' s') O τ' := chartAgree_of_principalOn hPO'
  set β := resW (k := k) O (n + 1 + 1) α with hβ
  let H : dimensionCycles O.toScheme (n + 1 + 1) →+ dimensionCycles O.toScheme n :=
    (divCyc (k := k) τ (𝟙 _) n).comp (divCyc (k := k) τ' (𝟙 _) (n + 1)) -
      (divCyc (k := k) τ' (𝟙 _) n).comp (divCyc (k := k) τ (𝟙 _) (n + 1))
  have hHmem : H β ∈ relOn n (bothZero τ τ') := by
    have := dimCycle_mem_of_prime_on ((relOn n (bothZero τ τ')).comap H) (fun _ ↦ True)
      (fun v hv _ ↦ AddSubgroup.mem_comap.mpr (fultonComm_route_F (k := k) τ τ' n v hv)) β
      (fun _ _ ↦ trivial)
    exact AddSubgroup.mem_comap.mp this
  have hCO : Set.range ι ∩ Set.range ι' ⊆ (O : Set X) := fun x hx ↦ ⟨hW hx.1, hW' hx.2⟩
  refine ⟨extOpen (k := k) O n (H β), ?_, fun y ↦ ?_⟩
  · refine extOpen_relOn (k := k) O n (bothZero τ τ') _ _ isClosed_range_inter hCO ?_ ?_ _ hHmem
    · intro z hz
      refine ⟨(hZ _).mpr fun hu ↦ hz.1 ((isUnit_eqs_iff_chart O _ hPO z).mp hu),
        (hZ' _).mpr fun hu ↦ hz.2 ((isUnit_eqs_iff_chart O _ hPO' z).mp hu)⟩
    · intro z hz
      exact ⟨(hZ _).mpr fun hu ↦ hz.1 ((isUnit_eqs_iff_chart O _ hPO z).mp hu),
        (hZ' _).mpr fun hu ↦ hz.2 ((isUnit_eqs_iff_chart O _ hPO' z).mp hu)⟩
  · by_cases hy : y ∈ (O : Set X)
    · have hyr : y ∈ Set.range O.ι := by rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]; exact hy
      obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hyr
      rw [extOpen_apply_ι, iter_chart hA hA', iter_chart hA' hA]
      have hβz : (fun x ↦ α.1 (O.ι x)) = β.1 := funext fun x ↦ (resW_apply (k := k) O _ α x).symm
      rw [hβz]
      change (fullIter (k := k) τ τ' n β).1 z - (fullIter (k := k) τ' τ n β).1 z = _
      rw [fullIter_apply, fullIter_apply]
    · rw [extOpen_apply_notMem (k := k) O n _ hy]
      have hyJ : y ∉ Set.range ι ∩ Set.range ι' := fun h ↦ hy (hCO h)
      have hyJ' : y ∉ Set.range ι' ∩ Set.range ι := fun h ↦ hyJ ⟨h.2, h.1⟩
      rw [iter_eq_zero_of_notMem _ _ _ _ ι'.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range
          (fun x hx ↦ (hZ x).mpr hx) (fun x hx ↦ (hZ' x).mpr hx) _ y hyJ,
        iter_eq_zero_of_notMem _ _ _ _ ι.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range
          (fun x hx ↦ (hZ' x).mpr hx) (fun x hx ↦ (hZ x).mpr hx) _ y hyJ', sub_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLBC.eqOfSection_pullback_eq
statement:
theorem eqOfSection_pullback_eq {M : S.Modules} (j : Y ⟶ S) (hM : HasConstantRank S M 1)
    (hMY : HasConstantRank Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj M) 1) (e : Γ(M, ⊤)) (p : Y) :
    ∃ a : Y.presheaf.stalk p, IsUnit a ∧
      eqOfSection _ hMY (wPullbackSection j e) p =
        (j.stalkMap p).hom (eqOfSection M hM e (j p)) * a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, h⟩ := germ_wCoord_change
    (WFrame.ofData (pullbackWFrame j (wFrameAt M hM (j p)) p (wFrameAt M hM (j p)).mem))
    (wFrameAt _ hMY p) (wPullbackSection j e)
  refine ⟨a, ha, ?_⟩
  unfold eqOfSection
  rw [h, wCoord_pullbackWFrame]
  congr 1
  exact (Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply j (wFrameAt M hM (j p)).U p
    (wFrameAt M hM (j p)).mem (wCoord (wFrameAt M hM (j p)) e)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLBC.principalOn_pullback
statement:
theorem principalOn_pullback {L : S.Modules} {hL : HasConstantRank S L 1} {s : Γ(L, ⊤)}
    {W : S.Opens} {t : Γ(S, W)} (hP : PrincipalOn L hL s W t) (j : Y ⟶ S)
    (hLY : HasConstantRank Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj L) 1) :
    PrincipalOn _ hLY (wPullbackSection j s) (j ⁻¹ᵁ W) (j.app W t)
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨a, ha, h⟩ := eqOfSection_pullback_eq j hL hLY s p
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hb'⟩ := hP (j p) hp
  refine ⟨(j.stalkMap p).hom b * a, (hb.map _).mul ha, ?_⟩
  rw [h, hb', map_mul, Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply, mul_assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLBC.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eqs_pullback
statement:
theorem c1CapPrimeCoeff_eqs_pullback {L : S.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank S L 1) (s : Γ(L, ⊤))
    (j : Y ⟶ S) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    (hLY : HasConstantRank Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj L) 1) (x z : Y) :
    C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (eqOfSection _ hLY (wPullbackSection j s)) x z =
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (eqOfSection L hL s) (j x) (j z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, h⟩ := eqOfSection_pullback_eq j hL hLY s z
  rw [c1CapPrimeCoeff_congr_unit _ ((eqOfSection L hL s).pullback j) x z a ha h,
    D18.c1CapPrimeCoeff_image j]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLBC.isUnit_eqs_pullback_iff
statement:
theorem isUnit_eqs_pullback_iff {L : S.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank S L 1) (s : Γ(L, ⊤))
    (j : Y ⟶ S) (hLY : HasConstantRank Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj L) 1) (p : Y) :
    IsUnit (eqOfSection _ hLY (wPullbackSection j s) p) ↔ IsUnit (eqOfSection L hL s (j p))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, h⟩ := eqOfSection_pullback_eq j hL hLY s p
  rw [h, ha.mul_right_iff]
  exact isUnit_map_iff (j.stalkMap p).hom _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLBC.lbRep_apply
statement:
theorem lbRep_apply (hP : PrincipalOn L hL s W t) (n : ℕ) (D : dimensionCycles X (n + 1))
    (z : Z) :
    (lbRep (k := k) ι W hW t n D).1 z =
      C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (eqOfSection L hL s) D.1 (ι z)
proof:
:= by
  change (divCyc (k := k) (W.topIso.inv t) (liftW ι W hW) n
    (resW (k := k) W (n + 1) D)).1 z = _
  rw [divCyc_apply, ← liftW_apply ι W hW z,
    c1CapCyclesCoeff_chart (chartAgree_of_principalOn hP)]
  congr 1
  funext x
  exact resW_apply (k := k) W _ D x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLBC.gysinCycles_eq_mk_lbRep
statement:
theorem gysinCycles_eq_mk_lbRep (hP : PrincipalOn L hL s W t)
    (hexc : ∀ n z₀, D5.primeCapOrZero (k := k)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj L) (hasConstantRank_restrict L hL ι) n z₀ = 0)
    (n : ℕ) (D : dimensionCycles X (n + 1)) :
    gysinCycles (k := k) L hL s ι n D = QuotientAddGroup.mk (lbRep (k := k) ι W hW t n D)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gysinCycles_eq_divIntCycles_resW (k := k) ι W hW hP hexc, divIntCycles_eq_mk_divCyc]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLBC.range_comp_subset_preimage
statement:
theorem range_comp_subset_preimage (j : J ⟶ Z) (j' : J ⟶ Z') (hJ : j ≫ ι = j' ≫ ι')
    (hW' : Set.range ι' ⊆ W') : Set.range j ⊆ (ι ⁻¹ᵁ W' : Z.Opens)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
  show ι (j y) ∈ W'
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hJ, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  exact hW' ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLBC.lbRep_lbRep_apply
statement:
theorem lbRep_lbRep_apply (hW : Set.range ι ⊆ W) (hZ : IsSupport L hL s ι)
    (hP : PrincipalOn L hL s W t) (hP' : PrincipalOn L' hL' s' W' t')
    (j : J ⟶ Z) [IsClosedImmersion j] [j.IsOver (Spk k)]
    (hWj : Set.range j ⊆ (ι ⁻¹ᵁ W' : Z.Opens)) (n : ℕ) (α : dimensionCycles X (n + 1 + 1))
    (y : J) :
    (lbRep (k := k) j (ι ⁻¹ᵁ W') hWj (ι.app W' t') n (lbRep (k := k) ι W hW t (n + 1) α)).1 y =
      C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (eqOfSection L' hL' s')
        (C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (eqOfSection L hL s) α.1) (ι (j y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [lbRep_apply (k := k) j (ι ⁻¹ᵁ W') hWj (ι.app W' t')
    (principalOn_pullback hP' ι (hasConstantRank_restrict L' hL' ι))]
  have hE : (lbRep (k := k) ι W hW t (n + 1) α).1 =
      fun z ↦ C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (eqOfSection L hL s) α.1 (ι z) :=
    funext fun z ↦ lbRep_apply (k := k) ι W hW t hP (n + 1) α z
  rw [hE]
  exact c1CapCyclesCoeff_closed ι (eqOfSection L' hL' s') _
    (c1CapPrimeCoeff_eqs_pullback hL' s' ι (hasConstantRank_restrict L' hL' ι)) _
    (support_c1CapCyclesCoeff_subset _ _ _ fun x hx ↦ (hZ x).mpr hx) (j y)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLBC.excess_restrict_eq_zero
statement:
theorem excess_restrict_eq_zero (j : J ⟶ Z) [IsClosedImmersion j] [j.IsOver (Spk k)]
    (hWj : Set.range j ⊆ (ι ⁻¹ᵁ W' : Z.Opens))
    (e' : Γ(L', ⊤)) (he' : ∀ y ∈ W', IsUnit (eqOfSection L' hL' e' y)) (n : ℕ) (z₀ : J) :
    D5.primeCapOrZero (k := k)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj L'))
      (hasConstantRank_restrict _ (hasConstantRank_restrict L' hL' ι) j) n z₀ = 0
proof:
:=
  excess_eq_zero (k := k) j _ (hasConstantRank_restrict L' hL' ι) (wPullbackSection ι e')
    (fun z ↦ isUnit_eqOfSection_pullback ι hL' _ e' (j z) (he' _ (hWj ⟨z, rfl⟩))) n z₀

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLBC.gysinCycles_comm_of_charts
statement:
theorem gysinCycles_comm_of_charts (hW : Set.range ι ⊆ W) (hW' : Set.range ι' ⊆ W')
    (hZ : IsSupport L hL s ι) (hZ' : IsSupport L' hL' s' ι')
    (hP : PrincipalOn L hL s W t) (hP' : PrincipalOn L' hL' s' W' t')
    (e : Γ(L, ⊤)) (he : ∀ y ∈ W, IsUnit (eqOfSection L hL e y))
    (e' : Γ(L', ⊤)) (he' : ∀ y ∈ W', IsUnit (eqOfSection L' hL' e' y))
    (j : J ⟶ Z) [IsClosedImmersion j] [j.IsOver (Spk k)]
    (j' : J ⟶ Z') [IsClosedImmersion j'] [j'.IsOver (Spk k)]
    (hJ : j ≫ ι = j' ≫ ι') (hJcov : Set.range ι ∩ Set.range ι' ⊆ Set.range (j ≫ ι))
    (n : ℕ) (α : dimensionCycles X (n + 1 + 1)) :
    gysinCycles (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj L') (hasConstantRank_restrict L' hL' ι)
        (wPullbackSection ι s') j n (lbRep (k := k) ι W hW t (n + 1) α) =
      gysinCycles (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι').obj L) (hasConstantRank_restrict L hL ι')
        (wPullbackSection ι' s) j' n (lbRep (k := k) ι' W' hW' t' (n + 1) α)
proof:
:= by
  have hWj := range_comp_subset_preimage j j' hJ hW'
  have hWj' := range_comp_subset_preimage j' j hJ.symm hW
  rw [gysinCycles_eq_mk_lbRep (k := k) j (ι ⁻¹ᵁ W') hWj (ι.app W' t')
      (principalOn_pullback hP' ι (hasConstantRank_restrict L' hL' ι))
      (excess_restrict_eq_zero (k := k) j hWj e' he'),
    gysinCycles_eq_mk_lbRep (k := k) j' (ι' ⁻¹ᵁ W) hWj' (ι'.app W t)
      (principalOn_pullback hP ι' (hasConstantRank_restrict L hL ι'))
      (excess_restrict_eq_zero (k := k) j' hWj' e he)]
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hRv⟩ := lbIter_comm_relOn (k := k) hW hW' hZ hZ' hP hP' n α
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← QuotientAddGroup.mk_sub]
  have key : lbRep (k := k) j (ι ⁻¹ᵁ W') hWj (ι.app W' t') n (lbRep (k := k) ι W hW t (n + 1) α) -
      lbRep (k := k) j' (ι' ⁻¹ᵁ W) hWj' (ι'.app W t) n (lbRep (k := k) ι' W' hW' t' (n + 1) α) =
      restrictHom (j ≫ ι) n (-R) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    ext y
    have hy : ι' (j' y) = ι (j y) := by
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← hJ, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    change (lbRep (k := k) j (ι ⁻¹ᵁ W') hWj (ι.app W' t') n
        (lbRep (k := k) ι W hW t (n + 1) α)).1 y -
      (lbRep (k := k) j' (ι' ⁻¹ᵁ W) hWj' (ι'.app W t) n
        (lbRep (k := k) ι' W' hW' t' (n + 1) α)).1 y = -(R.1 ((j ≫ ι) y))
    rw [lbRep_lbRep_apply (k := k) hW hZ hP hP' j hWj,
      lbRep_lbRep_apply (k := k) hW' hZ' hP' hP j' hWj', hy, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hRv]
    ring
  rw [key]
  exact restrictHom_relOn_eq_zero (j ≫ ι) n _ hJcov (-R) (neg_mem hR)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLBC.principalGateHolds_g2xlbc
