name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLBC.excess_of_unit
statement:
theorem excess_of_unit (hW : Set.range ι ⊆ W) (e : Γ(L, ⊤))
    (he : ∀ y ∈ W, IsUnit (eqOfSection L hL e y)) (n : ℕ) (z₀ : Z) :
    D5.primeCapOrZero (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj L)
      (hasConstantRank_restrict L hL ι) n z₀ = 0
proof:
:=
  excess_eq_zero (k := k) ι L hL e (fun z ↦ he _ (hW ⟨z, rfl⟩)) n z₀

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLBC.gysinDescends_of_chart
statement:
theorem gysinDescends_of_chart (hW : Set.range ι ⊆ W) (hZ : IsSupport L hL s ι)
    (hP : PrincipalOn L hL s W t) (e : Γ(L, ⊤)) (he : ∀ y ∈ W, IsUnit (eqOfSection L hL e y))
    (n : ℕ) : GysinDescends (k := k) L hL s ι n
proof:
:=
  gysinDescends_of_principalGateHolds hW (principalGateHolds_g2xlbc k) hZ hP
    (excess_of_unit (k := k) hW e he) n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLBC.isSupport_restrict
statement:
theorem isSupport_restrict (hZ' : IsSupport L' hL' s' ι') (j : J ⟶ Z) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    (hj : ∀ z, z ∈ Set.range j ↔ ι z ∈ Set.range ι') :
    IsSupport ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj L') (hasConstantRank_restrict L' hL' ι)
      (wPullbackSection ι s') j
proof:
:= fun z ↦ by
  rw [hj, hZ' (ι z)]
  exact (isUnit_eqs_pullback_iff hL' s' ι _ z).not.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLBC.gysinDescends_restrict_of_chart
statement:
theorem gysinDescends_restrict_of_chart (j : J ⟶ Z) [IsClosedImmersion j] [j.IsOver (Spk k)]
    (hWj : Set.range j ⊆ (ι ⁻¹ᵁ W' : Z.Opens))
    (hJZ : IsSupport ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj L') (hasConstantRank_restrict L' hL' ι)
      (wPullbackSection ι s') j)
    (hP' : PrincipalOn L' hL' s' W' t') (e' : Γ(L', ⊤))
    (he' : ∀ y ∈ W', IsUnit (eqOfSection L' hL' e' y)) (n : ℕ) :
    GysinDescends (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj L')
      (hasConstantRank_restrict L' hL' ι) (wPullbackSection ι s') j n
proof:
:=
  gysinDescends_of_principalGateHolds hWj (principalGateHolds_g2xlbc k) hJZ
    (principalOn_pullback hP' ι (hasConstantRank_restrict L' hL' ι))
    (excess_restrict_eq_zero (k := k) j hWj e' he') n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XLBC.gysinChow_comm_of_charts
statement:
theorem gysinChow_comm_of_charts (hW : Set.range ι ⊆ W) (hW' : Set.range ι' ⊆ W')
    (hZ : IsSupport L hL s ι) (hZ' : IsSupport L' hL' s' ι')
    (hP : PrincipalOn L hL s W t) (hP' : PrincipalOn L' hL' s' W' t')
    (e : Γ(L, ⊤)) (he : ∀ y ∈ W, IsUnit (eqOfSection L hL e y))
    (e' : Γ(L', ⊤)) (he' : ∀ y ∈ W', IsUnit (eqOfSection L' hL' e' y))
    (j : J ⟶ Z) [IsClosedImmersion j] [j.IsOver (Spk k)]
    (j' : J ⟶ Z') [IsClosedImmersion j'] [j'.IsOver (Spk k)]
    (hJ : j ≫ ι = j' ≫ ι') (hJcov : Set.range ι ∩ Set.range ι' ⊆ Set.range (j ≫ ι)) (n : ℕ)
    (hd : GysinDescends (k := k) L hL s ι (n + 1))
    (hd' : GysinDescends (k := k) L' hL' s' ι' (n + 1))
    (hdZ : GysinDescends (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj L')
      (hasConstantRank_restrict L' hL' ι) (wPullbackSection ι s') j n)
    (hdZ' : GysinDescends (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι').obj L)
      (hasConstantRank_restrict L hL ι') (wPullbackSection ι' s) j' n)
    (ξ : DimChow X (n + 1 + 1)) :
    gysinChow hdZ (gysinChow hd ξ) = gysinChow hdZ' (gysinChow hd' ξ)
proof:
:= by
  induction ξ using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
  | H α =>
    rw [gysinChow_mk, gysinCycles_eq_mk_lbRep (k := k) ι W hW t hP
        (excess_of_unit (k := k) hW e he) (n + 1) α, gysinChow_mk,
      gysinChow_mk, gysinCycles_eq_mk_lbRep (k := k) ι' W' hW' t' hP'
        (excess_of_unit (k := k) hW' e' he') (n + 1) α, gysinChow_mk]
    exact gysinCycles_comm_of_charts (k := k) hW hW' hZ hZ' hP hP' e he e' he' j j' hJ hJcov n α

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.c1_eq_zero_of_mem_stalkPrime_g2xfr25
proof:
:= by
  unfold C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff
  rw [dif_pos h]
  split_ifs with hd
  · unfold CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hmem, Ring.ord_zero,
      length_self_eq_top_of_ringKrullDim_eq_one hd]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.c1_chartEqs_of_not_isUnit
statement:
theorem c1_chartEqs_of_not_isUnit (U : Γs.Opens) (ρ : Γ(Γs, U)) {w : Γs}
    (hw : ¬ IsUnit (chartEqs U ρ w)) (y : Γs) : C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (chartEqs U ρ) w y = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : w ⤳ y
  swap
  · exact C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_not_specializes _ h
  by_cases hy : y ∈ U
  swap
  · apply c1_zero_of_isUnit_g2xf
    unfold chartEqs
    rw [dif_neg hy]
    exact isUnit_one
  have hwU : w ∈ U := h.mem_open U.isOpen hy
  apply c1_eq_zero_of_mem_stalkPrime_g2xfr25 _ h
  unfold Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, chartEqs_of_mem U ρ hy, ← CommRingCat.comp_apply,
    TopCat.Presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes, IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff]
  rwa [chartEqs_of_mem U ρ hwU] at hw

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.notMem_of_not_isUnit_chartEqs
statement:
theorem notMem_of_not_isUnit_chartEqs (U U' : Γs.Opens) (ρ : Γ(Γs, U)) (ρ' : Γ(Γs, U'))
    (hinvG : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U) (hy' : y ∈ U'),
      Γs.presheaf.germ U y hy ρ * Γs.presheaf.germ U' y hy' ρ' = 1)
    {y : Γs} (hnu : ¬ IsUnit (chartEqs U ρ y)) : y ∉ U'
proof:
:= by
  intro hy'
  by_cases hy : y ∈ U
  · rw [chartEqs_of_mem U ρ hy] at hnu
    exact hnu (isUnit_left_g2xf (hinvG y hy hy'))
  · apply hnu
    unfold chartEqs
    rw [dif_neg hy]
    exact isUnit_one

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.mem_of_c1_chartEqs_ne_zero
statement:
theorem mem_of_c1_chartEqs_ne_zero (U : Γs.Opens) (ρ : Γ(Γs, U)) {w y : Γs}
    (hne : C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (chartEqs U ρ) w y ≠ 0) : y ∈ U
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hy
  apply hne
  apply c1_zero_of_isUnit_g2xf
  unfold chartEqs
  rw [dif_neg hy]
  exact isUnit_one

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.specializes_of_c1_ne_zero
statement:
theorem specializes_of_c1_ne_zero (a : C1Cap.LocalEquations Γs) {w y : Γs}
    (hne : C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a w y ≠ 0) : w ⤳ y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.isUnit_germEqs_topIso_inv_iff
statement:
theorem isUnit_germEqs_topIso_inv_iff (U : Γs.Opens) (ρ : Γ(Γs, U)) (z : U.toScheme) :
    IsUnit (germEqs (U.topIso.inv ρ) z) ↔ IsUnit (chartEqs U ρ (U.ι z))
proof:
:= by

  exact isUnit_map_iff (U.ι.stalkMap z).hom _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.germEqs_mul_chart
statement:
theorem germEqs_mul_chart (hU : u |_ U = ρ * t |_ U) {y : Γs} (hy : y ∈ U) :
    germEqs u y = chartEqs U ρ y * germEqs t y
proof:
:= by
  rw [germEqs_eq_germ u U hy, germEqs_eq_germ t U hy, chartEqs_of_mem U ρ hy, hU, map_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.fullIter_prime_apply_chart
statement:
theorem fullIter_prime_apply_chart (hcov : ∀ y, y ∈ U ∨ y ∈ U')
    (hU : u |_ U = ρ * t |_ U) (hU' : t |_ U' = ρ' * u |_ U') (n : ℕ) (γ : Γs)
    (hγ : height γ = n + 1 + 1) (y : Γs) :
    (fullIter (k := k) t u n (dimPrimeCycle γ (n + 1 + 1) hγ)).1 y =
      ∑ᶠ w : Γs, C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (chartEqs U ρ) γ w *
        C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) w y
proof:
:= by
  rw [fullIter_apply_chart (k := k) t u U U' ρ ρ' hcov hU hU']
  change ∑ᶠ w, C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (chartEqs U ρ) (dimPrimeCycle γ (n + 1 + 1) hγ).1 w *
    C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) w y = _
  exact finsum_congr fun w ↦ by rw [c1CapCyclesCoeff_dimPrimeCycle]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.fullIter_prime_eq_zero_off_chart
statement:
theorem fullIter_prime_eq_zero_off_chart (hcov : ∀ y, y ∈ U ∨ y ∈ U')
    (hU : u |_ U = ρ * t |_ U) (hU' : t |_ U' = ρ' * u |_ U')
    (hinvG : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U) (hy' : y ∈ U'),
      Γs.presheaf.germ U y hy ρ * Γs.presheaf.germ U' y hy' ρ' = 1) (n : ℕ) (γ : Γs)
    (hγ : height γ = n + 1 + 1) (y : Γs) (hy : y ∉ U) :
    (fullIter (k := k) t u n (dimPrimeCycle γ (n + 1 + 1) hγ)).1 y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [fullIter_prime_apply_chart (k := k) t u U U' ρ ρ' hcov hU hU']
  apply finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero
  intro w
  by_contra hne
  have h1 := left_ne_zero_of_mul hne
  have h2 := right_ne_zero_of_mul hne
  obtain ⟨_, _, hnu⟩ := exists_of_c1CapPrimeCoeff_ne_zero _ h1
  have hw' := notMem_of_not_isUnit_chartEqs U U' ρ ρ' hinvG hnu
  have hs := specializes_of_c1_ne_zero _ h2
  exact hw' (hs.mem_open U'.isOpen ((hcov y).resolve_left hy))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.fullIter_toScheme_apply
statement:
theorem fullIter_toScheme_apply (hcov : ∀ y, y ∈ U ∨ y ∈ U')
    (hU : u |_ U = ρ * t |_ U) (hU' : t |_ U' = ρ' * u |_ U') (n : ℕ) (x : U.toScheme)
    (hx : height x = n + 1 + 1) (hγ : height (U.ι x) = n + 1 + 1) (z : U.toScheme) :
    (fullIter (k := k) (U.ι.appTop t) (U.topIso.inv ρ) n (dimPrimeCycle x (n + 1 + 1) hx)).1 z =
      (fullIter (k := k) t u n (dimPrimeCycle (U.ι x) (n + 1 + 1) hγ)).1 (U.ι z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fullIter_prime_apply_chart (k := k) t u U U' ρ ρ' hcov hU hU', fullIter_apply]
  change ∑ᶠ w, C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (germEqs (U.topIso.inv ρ))
    (dimPrimeCycle x (n + 1 + 1) hx).1 w * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs (U.ι.appTop t)) w z = _
  rw [D18.finsum_reindex_range U.ι U.ι.isOpenEmbedding.injective
    (fun w ↦ C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (chartEqs U ρ) (U.ι x) w *
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) w (U.ι z)) (fun w hw ↦ by
        rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
        exact mem_of_c1_chartEqs_ne_zero U ρ (left_ne_zero_of_mul hw))]
  exact finsum_congr fun w ↦ by
    rw [c1CapCyclesCoeff_dimPrimeCycle, germEqs_appTop, germEqs_topIso_inv,
      ← c1CapPrimeCoeff_openImm, ← c1CapPrimeCoeff_openImm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.extOpen_fullIter_chart
statement:
theorem extOpen_fullIter_chart (hcov : ∀ y, y ∈ U ∨ y ∈ U')
    (hU : u |_ U = ρ * t |_ U) (hU' : t |_ U' = ρ' * u |_ U')
    (hinvG : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U) (hy' : y ∈ U'),
      Γs.presheaf.germ U y hy ρ * Γs.presheaf.germ U' y hy' ρ' = 1) (n : ℕ) (x : U.toScheme)
    (hx : height x = n + 1 + 1) (hγ : height (U.ι x) = n + 1 + 1) :
    extOpen (k := k) U n
        (fullIter (k := k) (U.ι.appTop t) (U.topIso.inv ρ) n (dimPrimeCycle x (n + 1 + 1) hx)) =
      fullIter (k := k) t u n (dimPrimeCycle (U.ι x) (n + 1 + 1) hγ)
proof:
:=
  extOpen_eq_of_coeff (k := k) U n _ _
    (fullIter_toScheme_apply (k := k) t u U U' ρ ρ' hcov hU hU' n x hx hγ)
    (fullIter_prime_eq_zero_off_chart (k := k) t u U U' ρ ρ' hcov hU hU' hinvG n (U.ι x) hγ)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.extOpen_fullIter_chart_rev_apply
statement:
theorem extOpen_fullIter_chart_rev_apply (n : ℕ) (x : U.toScheme) (hx : height x = n + 1 + 1)
    (y : Γs) :
    (extOpen (k := k) U n (fullIter (k := k) (U.topIso.inv ρ) (U.ι.appTop t) n
        (dimPrimeCycle x (n + 1 + 1) hx))).1 y =
      ∑ᶠ w : Γs, C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) (U.ι x) w *
        C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (chartEqs U ρ) w y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hy : y ∈ U
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ : y ∈ Set.range U.ι := by rwa [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
    rw [extOpen_apply_ι, fullIter_apply]
    change ∑ᶠ w, C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (germEqs (U.ι.appTop t))
      (dimPrimeCycle x (n + 1 + 1) hx).1 w *
        C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs (U.topIso.inv ρ)) w z = _
    rw [D18.finsum_reindex_range U.ι U.ι.isOpenEmbedding.injective
      (fun w ↦ C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) (U.ι x) w *
        C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (chartEqs U ρ) w (U.ι z)) (fun w hw ↦ by
          rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
          exact (specializes_of_c1_ne_zero _ (right_ne_zero_of_mul hw)).mem_open U.isOpen z.2)]
    exact finsum_congr fun w ↦ by
      rw [c1CapCyclesCoeff_dimPrimeCycle, germEqs_appTop, germEqs_topIso_inv,
        ← c1CapPrimeCoeff_openImm, ← c1CapPrimeCoeff_openImm]
  · rw [extOpen_apply_notMem (k := k) U n _ hy]
    symm
    apply finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero
    intro w
    rw [c1_zero_of_isUnit_g2xf (chartEqs U ρ) w y (by
      unfold chartEqs
      rw [dif_neg hy]
      exact isUnit_one), mul_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.c1_chartEqs_of_notMem
statement:
theorem c1_chartEqs_of_notMem (U : Γs.Opens) (ρ : Γ(Γs, U)) {w : Γs} (hw : w ∉ U) (y : Γs) :
    C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (chartEqs U ρ) w y = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  exact hw ((specializes_of_c1_ne_zero _ hne).mem_open U.isOpen
    (mem_of_c1_chartEqs_ne_zero U ρ hne))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.chartFn_mul_chartFn
statement:
theorem chartFn_mul_chartFn (U U' : Γs.Opens) (ρ : Γ(Γs, U)) (ρ' : Γ(Γs, U'))
    (hinv : ρ |_ (U ⊓ U') * ρ' |_ (U ⊓ U') = 1) (w : Γs) (hw : w ∈ U) (hw' : w ∈ U') :
    chartFn U ρ w hw * chartFn U' ρ' w hw' = 1
proof:
:= by
  set z0 := pointClosureGenericPoint w
  have hz0 : pointClosureι w z0 = w := pointClosureι_genericPoint w
  have hz0U : pointClosureι w z0 ∈ U := by rw [hz0]; exact hw
  have hz0U' : pointClosureι w z0 ∈ U' := by rw [hz0]; exact hw'
  rw [← chartFn_eq U ρ w hw z0 hz0U, ← chartFn_eq U' ρ' w hw' z0 hz0U', ← map_mul, ← map_mul,
    germ_mul_germ_eq_one U U' ρ ρ' hinv hz0U hz0U', map_one, map_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.specializes_iff_mem_range_pointClosureι
statement:
theorem specializes_iff_mem_range_pointClosureι (w y : Γs) :
    w ⤳ y ↔ y ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [range_pointClosureι, specializes_iff_mem_closure]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.pointClosure_cycle_apply_g2xfr25
statement:
theorem pointClosure_cycle_apply_g2xfr25 (w : Γs) (f : (pointClosureScheme w).functionField)
    (y : Γs) (hy : y ∉ Set.range (pointClosureι w)) :
    properPushforward (pointClosureι w) (div f) y = 0
proof:
:=
  pp_apply_notMem_g2xfr25 _ _ hy

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.remGen_cycle_apply
statement:
theorem remGen_cycle_apply (hcov : ∀ y, y ∈ U ∨ y ∈ U') (n : ℕ) (w : Γs) (hw : w ∈ U)
    (hw' : w ∈ U') (hh : height w = n + 1) (y : Γs) :
    (remGen (k := k) U U' ρ ρ' hinv n w hw hw' hh).cycle.1 y =
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (chartEqs U ρ) w y - C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (chartEqs U' ρ') w y
proof:
:= by
  change properPushforward (pointClosureι w) (div (chartFn U ρ w hw)) y = _
  by_cases hy : y ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι w)
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [properPushforward_apply_self]
    change (pointClosureScheme w).ord (chartFn U ρ w hw) z = _
    by_cases hz : coheight z = 1
    · exact (two_chart_div U U' ρ ρ' hcov hinv w hw hw' z hz).symm
    · rw [Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hz, C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_pointClosureι,
        C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_pointClosureι, if_neg hz, if_neg hz, sub_zero]
  · rw [pointClosure_cycle_apply_g2xfr25 w _ y hy]
    have hs : ¬ w ⤳ y := fun h ↦ hy ((specializes_iff_mem_range_pointClosureι w y).mp h)
    rw [C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_not_specializes _ hs,
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_not_specializes _ hs, sub_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.remCyc_mem_relOn
statement:
theorem remCyc_mem_relOn (t u : Γ(Γs, ⊤)) (n : ℕ) (w : Γs) (ht : ¬ IsUnit (germEqs t w))
    (hu : ¬ IsUnit (germEqs u w)) :
    remCyc (k := k) U U' ρ ρ' hinv n w ∈ relOn n (bothZero t u)
proof:
:= by
  unfold remCyc
  split_ifs with h
  · refine generator_mem_relOn _ fun y ↦ ?_
    exact bothZero_of_specializes (C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι w y) ⟨ht, hu⟩
  · exact zero_mem _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.height_of_c1_ne_zero
statement:
theorem height_of_c1_ne_zero (n : ℕ) (γ : Γs) (hγ : height γ = n + 1 + 1) {w : Γs}
    (hne : C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) γ w ≠ 0) : height w = n + 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := (divCyc (k := k) t (𝟙 Γs) (n + 1) (dimPrimeCycle γ (n + 1 + 1) hγ)).2
  apply h
  change (divCyc (k := k) t (𝟙 Γs) (n + 1) (dimPrimeCycle γ (n + 1 + 1) hγ)).1 w ≠ 0
  rwa [divCyc_prime_apply_g2xfr4 (k := k)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.remainder_term
statement:
theorem remainder_term (hcov : ∀ y, y ∈ U ∨ y ∈ U') (hU : u |_ U = ρ * t |_ U)
    (hunit : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U), IsUnit (Γs.presheaf.germ U y hy ρ) → y ∈ U')
    (hunit' : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U'), IsUnit (Γs.presheaf.germ U' y hy ρ') → y ∈ U)
    (n : ℕ) (γ : Γs) (hγ : height γ = n + 1 + 1) (ht : IsUnit (germEqs t γ))
    (hu : IsUnit (germEqs u γ)) (w y : Γs) :
    C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) γ w * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (chartEqs U ρ) w y -
        C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs u) γ w * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (chartEqs U' ρ') w y =
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) γ w * (remCyc (k := k) U U' ρ ρ' hinv n w).1 y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hw : w ∈ U
  · by_cases hw' : w ∈ U'
    · have hργ : C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (chartEqs U ρ) γ w = 0 :=
        c1_zero_of_isUnit_g2xf _ γ w (by
          rw [chartEqs_of_mem U ρ hw]
          exact isUnit_left_g2xf (germ_mul_germ_eq_one U U' ρ ρ' hinv hw hw'))
      have hug : C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs u) γ w =
          C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) γ w := by
        rw [coeff_chart_add t u U ρ hU γ ht hu w hw, hργ, add_zero]
      rw [hug]
      by_cases hh : height w = n + 1
      · unfold remCyc
        rw [dif_pos ⟨hw, hw', hh⟩, remGen_cycle_apply (k := k) U U' ρ ρ' hinv hcov n w hw hw' hh]
        ring
      · have h0 : C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) γ w = 0 := by
          by_contra hne
          exact hh (height_of_c1_ne_zero (k := k) t n γ hγ hne)
        rw [h0]
        ring
    · have hnu : ¬ IsUnit (chartEqs U ρ w) := by
        rw [chartEqs_of_mem U ρ hw]
        exact fun h ↦ hw' (hunit w hw h)
      have hrem : remCyc (k := k) U U' ρ ρ' hinv n w = 0 := by
        unfold remCyc
        rw [dif_neg (fun h ↦ hw' h.2.1)]
      rw [c1_chartEqs_of_not_isUnit U ρ hnu, c1_chartEqs_of_notMem U' ρ' hw', hrem]
      simp
  · have hw' : w ∈ U' := (hcov w).resolve_left hw
    have hnu : ¬ IsUnit (chartEqs U' ρ' w) := by
      rw [chartEqs_of_mem U' ρ' hw']
      exact fun h ↦ hw (hunit' w hw' h)
    have hrem : remCyc (k := k) U U' ρ ρ' hinv n w = 0 := by
      unfold remCyc
      rw [dif_neg (fun h ↦ hw h.1)]
    rw [c1_chartEqs_of_not_isUnit U' ρ' hnu, c1_chartEqs_of_notMem U ρ hw, hrem]
    simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.remainder_mem_relOn
statement:
theorem remainder_mem_relOn (hcov : ∀ y, y ∈ U ∨ y ∈ U') (hU : u |_ U = ρ * t |_ U)
    (hunit : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U), IsUnit (Γs.presheaf.germ U y hy ρ) → y ∈ U')
    (hunit' : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U'), IsUnit (Γs.presheaf.germ U' y hy ρ') → y ∈ U)
    (n : ℕ) (x : U.toScheme) (hx : height x = n + 1 + 1) (x' : U'.toScheme)
    (hx' : height x' = n + 1 + 1) (hxx : U'.ι x' = U.ι x) (hγ : height (U.ι x) = n + 1 + 1)
    (ht : IsUnit (germEqs t (U.ι x))) (hu : IsUnit (germEqs u (U.ι x))) :
    extOpen (k := k) U n (fullIter (k := k) (U.topIso.inv ρ) (U.ι.appTop t) n
        (dimPrimeCycle x (n + 1 + 1) hx)) -
      extOpen (k := k) U' n (fullIter (k := k) (U'.topIso.inv ρ') (U'.ι.appTop u) n
        (dimPrimeCycle x' (n + 1 + 1) hx')) ∈ relOn n (bothZero t u)
proof:
:= by
  set γ := U.ι x with hγdef
  have hft := coeff_support_finite (k := k) t (n + 1) γ hγ
  have hfu := coeff_support_finite (k := k) u (n + 1) γ hγ
  set S := hft.toFinset with hS
  have key : extOpen (k := k) U n (fullIter (k := k) (U.topIso.inv ρ) (U.ι.appTop t) n
        (dimPrimeCycle x (n + 1 + 1) hx)) -
      extOpen (k := k) U' n (fullIter (k := k) (U'.topIso.inv ρ') (U'.ι.appTop u) n
        (dimPrimeCycle x' (n + 1 + 1) hx')) =
      ∑ w ∈ S, C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) γ w • remCyc (k := k) U U' ρ ρ' hinv n w := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    ext y
    have hev := map_sum (D6.evalHomD Γs n y)
      (fun w ↦ C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) γ w • remCyc (k := k) U U' ρ ρ' hinv n w) S
    change (extOpen (k := k) U n _).1 y - (extOpen (k := k) U' n _).1 y =
      D6.evalHomD Γs n y (∑ w ∈ S, _)
    rw [hev, extOpen_fullIter_chart_rev_apply (k := k), extOpen_fullIter_chart_rev_apply (k := k),
      hxx]
    simp only [map_zsmul, smul_eq_mul]
    change _ = ∑ w ∈ S, C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) γ w *
      (remCyc (k := k) U U' ρ ρ' hinv n w).1 y
    rw [← finsum_sub_distrib (hft.subset fun w hw ↦ left_ne_zero_of_mul hw)
      (hfu.subset fun w hw ↦ left_ne_zero_of_mul hw)]
    rw [finsum_congr (remainder_term (k := k) U U' ρ ρ' hinv t u hcov hU hunit hunit' n γ hγ ht hu
      · y)]
    refine finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ fun w hw ↦ ?_
    rw [Finset.mem_coe, hS, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
    exact left_ne_zero_of_mul hw
  rw [key]
  refine sum_mem fun w hw ↦ zsmul_mem ?_ _
  rw [hS, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Function.mem_support] at hw
  obtain ⟨_, _, hnt⟩ := exists_of_c1CapPrimeCoeff_ne_zero _ hw
  by_cases hwU : w ∈ U
  · have hnu : ¬ IsUnit (germEqs u w) := by
      intro hu'
      apply hnt
      rw [germEqs_mul_chart t u U ρ hU hwU] at hu'
      exact isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_right hu'
    exact remCyc_mem_relOn (k := k) U U' ρ ρ' hinv t u n w hnt hnu
  · have hrem : remCyc (k := k) U U' ρ ρ' hinv n w = 0 := by
      unfold remCyc
      rw [dif_neg (fun h ↦ hwU h.1)]
    rw [hrem]
    exact zero_mem _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.mem_opens_ι_g2xfr25
statement: theorem mem_opens_ι_g2xfr25 (V : Γs.Opens) (z : V.toScheme) : V.ι z ∈ V
proof:
:=
  (Scheme.Opens.range_ι V).subset ⟨z, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.extOpen_chart_relOn
statement:
theorem extOpen_chart_relOn (hcov : ∀ y, y ∈ U ∨ y ∈ U') (hU : u |_ U = ρ * t |_ U)
    (hinvG : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U) (hy' : y ∈ U'),
      Γs.presheaf.germ U y hy ρ * Γs.presheaf.germ U' y hy' ρ' = 1) (n : ℕ)
    (D : dimensionCycles U.toScheme n)
    (hD : D ∈ relOn n (bothZero (U.ι.appTop t) (U.topIso.inv ρ))) :
    extOpen (k := k) U n D ∈ relOn n (bothZero t u)
proof:
:= by
  have hnuρ : ∀ z ∈ bothZero (U.ι.appTop t) (U.topIso.inv ρ), ¬ IsUnit (chartEqs U ρ (U.ι z)) :=
    fun z hz h ↦ hz.2 ((isUnit_germEqs_topIso_inv_iff U ρ z).mpr h)
  refine extOpen_relOn (k := k) U n _ ((U' : Set Γs)ᶜ) (bothZero t u) U'.isOpen.isClosed_compl
    (fun y hy ↦ (hcov y).resolve_right hy)
    (fun z hz ↦ notMem_of_not_isUnit_chartEqs U U' ρ ρ' hinvG (hnuρ z hz)) (fun z hz ↦ ?_) D hD
  have hnt : ¬ IsUnit (germEqs t (U.ι z)) :=
    fun h ↦ hz.1 ((isUnit_germEqs_appTop_iff U.ι t z).mpr h)
  refine ⟨hnt, fun h ↦ hnuρ z hz ?_⟩
  rw [germEqs_mul_chart t u U ρ hU (mem_opens_ι_g2xfr25 U z)] at h
  exact isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2XF.chart_step
statement:
theorem chart_step (hcov : ∀ y, y ∈ U ∨ y ∈ U') (hU : u |_ U = ρ * t |_ U)
    (hU' : t |_ U' = ρ' * u |_ U') (hinv : ρ |_ (U ⊓ U') * ρ' |_ (U ⊓ U') = 1)
    (hunit : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U), IsUnit (Γs.presheaf.germ U y hy ρ) → y ∈ U')
    (hunit' : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U'), IsUnit (Γs.presheaf.germ U' y hy ρ') → y ∈ U)
    (n : ℕ) (γ : Γs) (hγ : height γ = n + 1 + 1) (ht : IsUnit (germEqs t γ))
    (hu : IsUnit (germEqs u γ)) (x : U.toScheme) (hxγ : U.ι x = γ) (hx : height x = n + 1 + 1)
    (x' : U'.toScheme) (hxγ' : U'.ι x' = γ) (hx' : height x' = n + 1 + 1)
    (hIH : fullIter (k := k) (U.ι.appTop t) (U.topIso.inv ρ) n (dimPrimeCycle x (n + 1 + 1) hx) -
        fullIter (k := k) (U.topIso.inv ρ) (U.ι.appTop t) n (dimPrimeCycle x (n + 1 + 1) hx) ∈
      relOn n (bothZero (U.ι.appTop t) (U.topIso.inv ρ)))
    (hIH' : fullIter (k := k) (U'.ι.appTop u) (U'.topIso.inv ρ') n
          (dimPrimeCycle x' (n + 1 + 1) hx') -
        fullIter (k := k) (U'.topIso.inv ρ') (U'.ι.appTop u) n (dimPrimeCycle x' (n + 1 + 1) hx') ∈
      relOn n (bothZero (U'.ι.appTop u) (U'.topIso.inv ρ'))) :
    fullIter (k := k) t u n (dimPrimeCycle γ (n + 1 + 1) hγ) -
        fullIter (k := k) u t n (dimPrimeCycle γ (n + 1 + 1) hγ) ∈ relOn n (bothZero t u)
proof:
:= by
  have hinvG : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U) (hy' : y ∈ U'),
      Γs.presheaf.germ U y hy ρ * Γs.presheaf.germ U' y hy' ρ' = 1 :=
    fun y hy hy' ↦ germ_mul_germ_eq_one U U' ρ ρ' hinv hy hy'
  have hinvG' : ∀ y (hy : y ∈ U') (hy' : y ∈ U),
      Γs.presheaf.germ U' y hy ρ' * Γs.presheaf.germ U y hy' ρ = 1 :=
    fun y hy hy' ↦ by rw [mul_comm]; exact hinvG y hy' hy
  have hcov' : ∀ y, y ∈ U' ∨ y ∈ U := fun y ↦ (hcov y).symm
  have hγx : height (U.ι x) = n + 1 + 1 := hxγ ▸ hγ
  have hγx' : height (U'.ι x') = n + 1 + 1 := hxγ' ▸ hγ
  have e1 := extOpen_fullIter_chart (k := k) t u U U' ρ ρ' hcov hU hU' hinvG n x hx hγx
  have e2 := extOpen_fullIter_chart (k := k) u t U' U ρ' ρ hcov' hU' hU hinvG' n x' hx' hγx'
  rw [dimPrimeCycle_congr hxγ hγx hγ] at e1
  rw [dimPrimeCycle_congr hxγ' hγx' hγ] at e2
  rw [← e1, ← e2]
  set A := fullIter (k := k) (U.ι.appTop t) (U.topIso.inv ρ) n (dimPrimeCycle x (n + 1 + 1) hx)
  set B := fullIter (k := k) (U.topIso.inv ρ) (U.ι.appTop t) n (dimPrimeCycle x (n + 1 + 1) hx)
  set A' := fullIter (k := k) (U'.ι.appTop u) (U'.topIso.inv ρ') n
    (dimPrimeCycle x' (n + 1 + 1) hx')
  set B' := fullIter (k := k) (U'.topIso.inv ρ') (U'.ι.appTop u) n
    (dimPrimeCycle x' (n + 1 + 1) hx')
  have hsplit : extOpen (k := k) U n A - extOpen (k := k) U' n A' =
      (extOpen (k := k) U n (A - B) - extOpen (k := k) U' n (A' - B')) +
        (extOpen (k := k) U n B - extOpen (k := k) U' n B') := by
    rw [map_sub, map_sub]
    abel
  rw [hsplit]
  have hbz : bothZero u t = bothZero t u := by
    ext y
    exact and_comm
  refine add_mem (sub_mem ?_ ?_) ?_
  · exact extOpen_chart_relOn (k := k) t u U U' ρ ρ' hcov hU hinvG n _ hIH
  · rw [← hbz]
    exact extOpen_chart_relOn (k := k) u t U' U ρ' ρ hcov' hU' hinvG' n _ hIH'
  · have hxx : U'.ι x' = U.ι x := hxγ'.trans hxγ.symm
    rw [← hxγ] at ht hu
    exact remainder_mem_relOn (k := k) U U' ρ ρ' hinv t u hcov hU hunit hunit' n x hx x' hx' hxx
      hγx ht hu

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.mem_range_zeroToL
statement:
theorem mem_range_zeroToL (w : L.toScheme) :
    w ∈ Set.range (zeroToL L σ) ↔ w ∉ L.toScheme.basicOpen σ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.range_subschemeι, zeroIdeal,
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.coe_support_ofIdealTop]
  simp [Scheme.zeroLocus_span, Scheme.mem_zeroLocus_iff]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.zeroToL_app_res
statement:
theorem zeroToL_app_res (W : L.toScheme.affineOpens) :
    (zeroToL L σ).app W.1 (L.toScheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op σ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : L.toScheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op σ ∈ (zeroIdeal L σ).ideal W := by
    rw [zeroIdeal, Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop_ideal]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (Ideal.subset_span rfl)
  rw [← Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_subschemeι (zeroIdeal L σ), Scheme.Hom.ker_apply] at h1
  exact h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.appTop_eq_appLE_res
statement:
theorem appTop_eq_appLE_res {P Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : P ⟶ Y) (W : Y.Opens) (hW : ⊤ ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ W)
    (s : Γ(Y, ⊤)) : g.appTop s = g.appLE W ⊤ hW (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.map_appLE]
  simp [Scheme.Hom.appLE]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.zeroPiece_fst_appTop
statement:
theorem zeroPiece_fst_appTop {R : CommRingCat.{u}} (j : Spec R ⟶ L.toScheme) [IsOpenImmersion j] :
    (pullback.fst j (zeroToL L σ)).appTop (j.appTop σ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let W : L.toScheme.affineOpens := ⟨j ''ᵁ ⊤, (isAffineOpen_top _).image_of_isOpenImmersion j⟩
  have hW : ⊤ ≤ (pullback.fst j (zeroToL L σ) ≫ j) ⁻¹ᵁ W.1 := by
    intro p _
    exact ⟨_, trivial, rfl⟩
  have e1 : (pullback.fst j (zeroToL L σ)).appTop (j.appTop σ) =
      (pullback.fst j (zeroToL L σ) ≫ j).appTop σ := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, CommRingCat.comp_apply]
  rw [e1, appTop_eq_appLE_res _ W.1 hW]
  have e2 : (pullback.fst j (zeroToL L σ) ≫ j).appLE W.1 ⊤ hW =
      (pullback.snd j (zeroToL L σ) ≫ zeroToL L σ).appLE W.1 ⊤
        (by rw [← pullback.condition]; exact hW) := by
    congr 1
    exact pullback.condition
  rw [e2, Scheme.Hom.comp_appLE, CommRingCat.comp_apply, zeroToL_app_res L σ W, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.isClosedImmersion_zeroPiece
statement:
theorem isClosedImmersion_zeroPiece (j : Spec (CommRingCat.of C) ⟶ L.toScheme) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (hsurj : ∀ c : C, ∃ a, c - φ a ∈ Ideal.span {ρc})
    (hσ : j.appTop σ = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of C)).inv ρc) :
    IsClosedImmersion (pullback.fst j (zeroToL L σ) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsAffine (zeroPiece L σ j) := isAffine_of_isAffineHom (pullback.fst j (zeroToL L σ))
  apply IsClosedImmersion.of_surjective_of_isAffine
  have hf : Function.Surjective (pullback.fst j (zeroToL L σ)).appTop :=
    (IsClosedImmersion.isAffine_surjective_of_isAffine (pullback.fst j (zeroToL L σ))).2
  have h0 := zeroPiece_fst_appTop L σ j
  rw [hσ] at h0
  have hS : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)).appTop =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(V, U)).hom ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom φ ≫
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of C)).inv := by
    rw [← Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
  intro x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hf x
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hsurj ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of C)).hom y)
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp ha
  refine ⟨(Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(V, U)).inv a, ?_⟩
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, CommRingCat.comp_apply, hS]
  simp only [CommRingCat.comp_apply, Iso.inv_hom_id_apply]
  have hy : y = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of C)).inv (φ a) +
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of C)).inv c * (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of C)).inv ρc := by
    rw [← map_mul, ← map_add, hc, add_sub_cancel, Iso.hom_inv_id_apply]
  rw [hy, map_add, map_mul, h0, mul_zero, add_zero]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.mem_basicOpen_topIso_inv_iff
statement:
theorem mem_basicOpen_topIso_inv_iff {X : Scheme.{u}} (L : X.Opens) (ρ : Γ(X, L)) (w : L.toScheme) :
    w ∈ L.toScheme.basicOpen (L.topIso.inv ρ) ↔ IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ L w.1 w.2 ρ)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : w ∈ L.toScheme.basicOpen (L.topIso.inv ρ) ↔
      L.ι w ∈ L.ι ''ᵁ L.toScheme.basicOpen (L.topIso.inv ρ) :=
    (L.ι.apply_mem_image_iff).symm
  rw [Scheme.Opens.ι_image_basicOpen_topIso_inv] at h1
  exact h1.trans (X.mem_basicOpen ρ w.1 w.2)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.topIso_inv_res
statement:
theorem topIso_inv_res {X : Scheme.{u}} (L : X.Opens) (x : Γ(X, ⊤)) :
    L.topIso.inv (x |_ L) = L.ι.appTop x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Opens.ι_appTop, Scheme.Opens.topIso_inv]
  change (X.presheaf.map _ ≫ X.presheaf.map _) x = _
  rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.ΓSpec_mul_right_cancel
statement:
theorem ΓSpec_mul_right_cancel {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsDomain C]
    {x y z : Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of C), ⊤)} (hz : z ≠ 0) (h : x * z = y * z) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of C)).hom).1
  have hz' : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of C)).hom z ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply hz
    rw [← Iso.hom_inv_id_apply (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of C)) z, h0, map_zero]
  have h' := congrArg (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of C)).hom h
  rw [map_mul, map_mul] at h'
  exact mul_right_cancel₀ (M₀ := C) hz' h'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.stalkMap_surjective_of_comp_openImm
statement:
theorem stalkMap_surjective_of_comp_openImm {P Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (s : P ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion s]
    (g : Z ⟶ Y) (p : P) (h : Function.Surjective ((s ≫ g).stalkMap p)) :
    Function.Surjective (g.stalkMap (s p))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp] at h
  intro x
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h ((s.stalkMap p) x)
  refine ⟨y, (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (s.stalkMap p)).1 ?_⟩
  rw [← hy]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.ΓSpecIso_inv_mul_of_eq
statement:
theorem ΓSpecIso_inv_mul_of_eq {C : Type u} [CommRing C] {x y z : C} (h : x = y * z) :
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of C)).inv x =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of C)).inv y * (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of C)).inv z
proof:
:= by
  rw [h, map_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.ΓSpecIso_inv_ne_zero
statement:
theorem ΓSpecIso_inv_ne_zero {C : Type u} [CommRing C] {x : C} (h : x ≠ 0) :
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of C)).inv x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  apply h
  rw [← Iso.inv_hom_id_apply (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of C)) x, h0, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.ΓSpec_eq_of_mul_eq
statement:
theorem ΓSpec_eq_of_mul_eq {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsDomain C] (σ' : Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of C), ⊤))
    (x y z : C) (key : y = x * z) (hx : x ≠ 0)
    (h1 : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of C)).inv y =
      σ' * (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of C)).inv x) :
    σ' = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of C)).inv z
proof:
:= by
  rw [key, map_mul, mul_comm] at h1
  exact (ΓSpec_mul_right_cancel (ΓSpecIso_inv_ne_zero hx) h1).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.ΓSpec_eq_of_mul_eq'
statement:
theorem ΓSpec_eq_of_mul_eq' {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsDomain C]
    (σ' Ab Aa : Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of C), ⊤)) (x y z : C) (key : y = x * z) (hx : x ≠ 0)
    (hb : Ab = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of C)).inv y)
    (ha : Aa = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of C)).inv x) (h1 : Ab = σ' * Aa) :
    σ' = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of C)).inv z
proof:
:= by
  subst hb ha
  exact ΓSpec_eq_of_mul_eq σ' x y z key hx h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.appTop_appTop
statement:
theorem appTop_appTop {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (x : Γ(Z, ⊤)) :
    f.appTop (g.appTop x) = (f ≫ g).appTop x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, CommRingCat.comp_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.sub_mem_of_quotient_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [RingHom.comp_apply, Ideal.Quotient.eq] at h
  have h' := (Ideal.span {ρc}).neg_mem h
  rwa [neg_sub] at h'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.degree_eq_one_of_comp_closedImmersion
statement:
theorem degree_eq_one_of_comp_closedImmersion {Z Y X : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) (f : Y ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsClosedImmersion (i ≫ f)] (z : Z) : f.degree (i z) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (i ≫ f).residueFieldMap_bijective_of_isClosedImmersion z
  have h2 := i.residueFieldMap_bijective_of_isClosedImmersion z
  rw [Scheme.residueFieldMap_comp] at h1
  have h3 : Function.Bijective (f.residueFieldMap (i z)).hom :=
    (Function.Bijective.of_comp_iff' h2 _).mp h1
  letI : Algebra
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (f (i z))))
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↑(Y.presheaf.stalk (i z))) :=
    RingHom.toAlgebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (f.stalkMap (i z)).hom)
  apply Algebra.finrank_eq_one_iff_bijective_algebraMap.mpr
  exact h3

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.mem_basicOpen_pairσ_iff
statement:
theorem mem_basicOpen_pairσ_iff (w : (pairL t u a b).toScheme) :
    w ∈ (pairL t u a b).toScheme.basicOpen (pairσ t u a b) ↔
      IsUnit ((graphClosure t u).presheaf.germ (pairL t u a b) w.1 w.2
        (ratio ((graphπ t u).appTop a) ((graphπ t u).appTop b)))
proof:
:=
  mem_basicOpen_topIso_inv_iff _ _ w

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.pair_memA
statement: theorem pair_memA (U : V.affineOpens) : resTop U a ∈ (graphIdeal t u).ideal U
proof:
:= by
  rw [hab U]
  exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_insert _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.pair_memB
statement: theorem pair_memB (U : V.affineOpens) : resTop U b ∈ (graphIdeal t u).ideal U
proof:
:= by
  rw [hab U]
  exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.pairChart_mem
statement: theorem pairChart_mem (U : V.affineOpens) (q) : pairChart hab U q ∈ pairL t u a b
proof:
:=
  le_regLocus (chart_dividesOn t u U a b _ ⟨resTop U b, pair_memB hab U⟩ rfl rfl) ⟨q, trivial, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.pairChartL_ι
statement: theorem pairChartL_ι (U : V.affineOpens) : pairChartL hab U ≫ (pairL t u a b).ι = pairChart hab U
proof:
:=
  IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.pairChartL_ι'
statement:
theorem pairChartL_ι' (U : V.affineOpens) :
    pairChartL hab U ≫ (pairL t u a b).ι = chartι t u U ⟨resTop U a, pair_memA hab U⟩
proof:
:=
  IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.exists_pairChart
statement:
theorem exists_pairChart (U : V.affineOpens) (y : graphClosure t u) (hy : y ∉ pairM t u a b)
    (hyU : graphπ t u y ∈ U.1) : ∃ q, pairChart hab U q = y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (CIIB1.mem_range_affineι_iff (graphIdeal t u) U y).mpr hyU
  have hI : (graphIdeal t u).ideal U = Ideal.span (Set.range ![resTop U a, resTop U b]) := by
    rw [hab U, Matrix.range_cons, Matrix.range_cons, Matrix.range_empty,
      Set.union_empty, Set.singleton_union]
  let cov := affineOpenCoverOfSpan ((graphIdeal t u).ideal U) ![resTop U a, resTop U b] hI
  obtain ⟨i, w, hw⟩ : ∃ i : Fin 2, z ∈ Set.range (cov.f i) := ⟨cov.idx z, cov.covers z⟩
  fin_cases i
  · refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
    rw [← hw]
    rfl
  · exfalso
    apply hy
    refine le_regLocus (chart_dividesOn t u U b a ⟨resTop U b, pair_memB hab U⟩
      ⟨resTop U a, pair_memA hab U⟩ rfl rfl) ⟨w, trivial, ?_⟩
    rw [← hw]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.pair_cover
statement: theorem pair_cover (y : graphClosure t u) : y ∈ pairL t u a b ∨ y ∈ pairM t u a b
proof:
:= by
  have hy : y ∈ ⨆ U : V.affineOpens, (GlobalBlowup.affineι V (graphIdeal t u) U).opensRange := by
    rw [GlobalBlowup.iSup_opensRange_affineι]
    trivial
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hy
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hU
  have hI : (graphIdeal t u).ideal U = Ideal.span (Set.range ![resTop U a, resTop U b]) := by
    rw [hab U, Matrix.range_cons, Matrix.range_cons, Matrix.range_empty,
      Set.union_empty, Set.singleton_union]
  let cov := affineOpenCoverOfSpan ((graphIdeal t u).ideal U) ![resTop U a, resTop U b] hI
  obtain ⟨i, w, hw⟩ : ∃ i : Fin 2, z ∈ Set.range (cov.f i) := ⟨cov.idx z, cov.covers z⟩
  fin_cases i
  · left
    refine le_regLocus (chart_dividesOn t u U a b ⟨resTop U a, pair_memA hab U⟩
      ⟨resTop U b, pair_memB hab U⟩ rfl rfl) ⟨w, trivial, ?_⟩
    rw [← hw]
    rfl
  · right
    refine le_regLocus (chart_dividesOn t u U b a ⟨resTop U b, pair_memB hab U⟩
      ⟨resTop U a, pair_memA hab U⟩ rfl rfl) ⟨w, trivial, ?_⟩
    rw [← hw]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.mem_range_pairZeroι
statement:
theorem mem_range_pairZeroι (y : graphClosure t u) :
    y ∈ Set.range (pairZeroι t u a b) ↔ y ∉ pairM t u a b
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isIntegral_graphClosure t u ht
  have hA := appTop_graphπ_ne_zero t u ht ha
  have hB := appTop_graphπ_ne_zero t u ht hb
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
    have hz : zeroToL (pairL t u a b) (pairσ t u a b) z ∈
        Set.range (zeroToL (pairL t u a b) (pairσ t u a b)) := ⟨z, rfl⟩
    rw [mem_range_zeroToL, mem_basicOpen_pairσ_iff] at hz
    exact fun h ↦ hz ((isUnit_germ_ratio_iff hA hB _).mpr h)
  · intro hy
    have hyL : y ∈ pairL t u a b := (pair_cover hab y).resolve_right hy
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (mem_range_zeroToL (pairL t u a b) (pairσ t u a b) ⟨y, hyL⟩).mpr (by
      rw [mem_basicOpen_pairσ_iff]
      exact fun h ↦ hy ((isUnit_germ_ratio_iff hA hB hyL).mp h))
    exact ⟨z, by rw [pairZeroι, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hz]; rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.range_pairZeroι
statement:
theorem range_pairZeroι :
    Set.range (pairZeroι t u a b) = ((pairM t u a b : Set (graphClosure t u)))ᶜ
proof:
:=
  Set.ext fun y ↦ mem_range_pairZeroι hab ht ha hb y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.isClosedImmersion_pairZeroι
statement: theorem isClosedImmersion_pairZeroι : IsClosedImmersion (pairZeroι t u a b)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : SurjectiveOnStalks (pairZeroι t u a b) := by
    unfold pairZeroι
    infer_instance
  refine { isClosedEmbedding := ?_ }
  rw [Topology.isClosedEmbedding_iff]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · change Topology.IsEmbedding ((pairL t u a b).ι ∘ zeroToL (pairL t u a b) (pairσ t u a b))
    exact (pairL t u a b).ι.isOpenEmbedding.isEmbedding.comp
      (zeroToL (pairL t u a b) (pairσ t u a b)).isClosedEmbedding.isEmbedding
  · rw [range_pairZeroι hab ht ha hb]
    exact (pairM t u a b).isOpen.isClosed_compl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.pairChartL_appTop_σ
statement:
theorem pairChartL_appTop_σ (U : V.affineOpens) (hUne : (U.1 : Set V).Nonempty) :
    (pairChartL hab U).appTop (pairσ t u a b) =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (chartRing t u U ⟨resTop U a, pair_memA hab U⟩))).inv
        (ratioElement _ ⟨resTop U a, pair_memA hab U⟩ ⟨resTop U b, pair_memB hab U⟩)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isIntegral_graphClosure t u ht
  haveI : Nonempty U.1 := hUne.to_subtype
  have hra : resTop U a ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply ha
    apply map_injective_of_isIntegral V (homOfLE (le_top : U.1 ≤ ⊤))
    rw [map_zero]
    exact h0
  haveI : IsDomain (chartRing t u U ⟨resTop U a, pair_memA hab U⟩) :=
    CIIB2.isDomain_away _ ⟨resTop U a, pair_memA hab U⟩ hra
  have hA := appTop_graphπ_ne_zero t u ht ha
  have hrel : (pairL t u a b).ι.appTop ((graphπ t u).appTop b) =
      pairσ t u a b * (pairL t u a b).ι.appTop ((graphπ t u).appTop a) := by
    rw [← topIso_inv_res, ← topIso_inv_res, res_eq_ratio_mul hA, map_mul]
    rfl
  have hpull : ∀ x : Γ(V, ⊤), (pairChartL hab U).appTop
      ((pairL t u a b).ι.appTop ((graphπ t u).appTop x)) =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (chartRing t u U ⟨resTop U a, pair_memA hab U⟩))).inv
        (baseRingHom _ ⟨resTop U a, pair_memA hab U⟩ (resTop U x)) := by
    intro x
    have e : (pairChartL hab U ≫ (pairL t u a b).ι) ≫ graphπ t u =
        chartι t u U ⟨resTop U a, pair_memA hab U⟩ ≫ graphπ t u := by
      rw [pairChartL_ι']
    exact ((appTop_appTop _ _ _).trans (appTop_appTop _ _ _)).trans
      ((congrArg (fun g ↦ g.appTop x) e).trans (chartι_graphπ_appTop t u U _ x))
  have h1 := congrArg (pairChartL hab U).appTop hrel
  rw [map_mul] at h1
  have key : baseRingHom _ ⟨resTop U a, pair_memA hab U⟩ (resTop U b) =
      baseRingHom _ ⟨resTop U a, pair_memA hab U⟩ (resTop U a) *
        ratioElement _ ⟨resTop U a, pair_memA hab U⟩ ⟨resTop U b, pair_memB hab U⟩ := by
    rw [baseRingHom_apply, baseRingHom_apply]
    exact (baseElement_mul_ratioElement ((graphIdeal t u).ideal U) ⟨resTop U a, pair_memA hab U⟩
      ⟨resTop U b, pair_memB hab U⟩).symm
  exact ΓSpec_eq_of_mul_eq' (C := chartRing t u U ⟨resTop U a, pair_memA hab U⟩) _ _ _ _ _ _ key (fun h0 ↦ hra
    (CIIB2.baseRingHom_injective _ ⟨resTop U a, pair_memA hab U⟩ hra
      (h0.trans (map_zero _).symm))) (hpull b) (hpull a) h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.isClosedImmersion_pairPiece
statement:
theorem isClosedImmersion_pairPiece (U : V.affineOpens) (hUne : (U.1 : Set V).Nonempty) :
    IsClosedImmersion (pullback.fst (pairChartL hab U) (zeroToL _ (pairσ t u a b)) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (baseRingHom _ ⟨resTop U a, pair_memA hab U⟩)))
proof:
:=
  isClosedImmersion_zeroPiece (pairL t u a b) (pairσ t u a b)
    (baseRingHom _ ⟨resTop U a, pair_memA hab U⟩)
    (ratioElement _ ⟨resTop U a, pair_memA hab U⟩ ⟨resTop U b, pair_memB hab U⟩)
    (pairChartL hab U)
    (fun c ↦ by
      obtain ⟨a0, h⟩ := G2XF.baseRingHom_quotient_surjective ⟨resTop U a, pair_memA hab U⟩
        ⟨resTop U b, pair_memB hab U⟩ (hab U) (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ c)
      exact ⟨a0, sub_mem_of_quotient_eq _ _ c a0 h⟩)
    (pairChartL_appTop_σ hab ht ha U hUne)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.pairPiece_square
statement:
theorem pairPiece_square (U : V.affineOpens) :
    pullback.snd (pairChartL hab U) (zeroToL _ (pairσ t u a b)) ≫ pairZeroToBase t u a b =
      pullback.fst (pairChartL hab U) (zeroToL _ (pairσ t u a b)) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (baseRingHom _ ⟨resTop U a, pair_memA hab U⟩)) ≫
          U.2.fromSpec
proof:
:= by
  rw [← chartι_graphπ, ← pairChartL_ι' hab U, pairZeroToBase, pairZeroι]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [pullback.condition_assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.exists_pairPiece
statement:
theorem exists_pairPiece (z : pairZero t u a b) (U : V.affineOpens)
    (hzU : pairZeroToBase t u a b z ∈ U.1) :
    ∃ p : zeroPiece (pairL t u a b) (pairσ t u a b) (pairChartL hab U),
      pullback.snd (pairChartL hab U) (zeroToL _ (pairσ t u a b)) p = z
proof:
:= by
  have hyM : pairZeroι t u a b z ∉ pairM t u a b :=
    (mem_range_pairZeroι hab ht ha hb _).mp ⟨z, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := exists_pairChart hab U _ hyM hzU
  have hq' : pairChartL hab U q = zeroToL _ (pairσ t u a b) z := by
    apply (pairL t u a b).ι.isOpenEmbedding.injective
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, pairChartL_ι, hq]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨p, -, hp⟩ := Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback q z hq'
  exact ⟨p, hp⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.isClosedImmersion_pairZeroToBase
statement:
theorem isClosedImmersion_pairZeroToBase [IsLocallyNoetherian V] :
    IsClosedImmersion (pairZeroToBase t u a b)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isClosedImmersion_pairZeroι hab ht ha hb
  have hsq : ∀ (U : V.affineOpens) (hUne : (U.1 : Set V).Nonempty),
      SurjectiveOnStalks (pullback.snd (pairChartL hab U) (zeroToL _ (pairσ t u a b)) ≫
        pairZeroToBase t u a b) := by
    intro U hUne
    haveI := isClosedImmersion_pairPiece hab ht ha U hUne
    rw [pairPiece_square hab U, ← Category.assoc]
    infer_instance
  have hinj : Function.Injective (pairZeroToBase t u a b) := by
    intro z₁ z₂ h
    obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := exists_affineOpens_mem (pairZeroToBase t u a b z₁)
    obtain ⟨p₁, rfl⟩ := exists_pairPiece hab ht ha hb z₁ U hU
    obtain ⟨p₂, rfl⟩ := exists_pairPiece hab ht ha hb z₂ U (h ▸ hU)
    haveI := isClosedImmersion_pairPiece hab ht ha U ⟨_, hU⟩
    congr 1
    have h' : (pullback.snd (pairChartL hab U) (zeroToL _ (pairσ t u a b)) ≫
        pairZeroToBase t u a b) p₁ = (pullback.snd (pairChartL hab U)
          (zeroToL _ (pairσ t u a b)) ≫ pairZeroToBase t u a b) p₂ := h
    rw [pairPiece_square hab U, ← Category.assoc] at h'
    exact (Scheme.Hom.isClosedEmbedding _).injective
      (U.2.fromSpec.isOpenEmbedding.injective h')
  have hclosed : IsClosedMap (pairZeroToBase t u a b) := by
    change IsClosedMap (graphπ t u ∘ pairZeroι t u a b)
    exact (graphπ t u).isClosedMap.comp (pairZeroι t u a b).isClosedEmbedding.isClosedMap
  refine { stalkMap_surjective := ?_, isClosedEmbedding := ?_ }
  · intro z
    obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := exists_affineOpens_mem (pairZeroToBase t u a b z)
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := exists_pairPiece hab ht ha hb z U hU
    exact stalkMap_surjective_of_comp_openImm _ _ p
      ((hsq U ⟨_, hU⟩).stalkMap_surjective p)
  · exact .of_continuous_injective_isClosedMap (pairZeroToBase t u a b).continuous hinj hclosed

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.zeroLamToBase_eq
statement: theorem zeroLamToBase_eq : zeroLamToBase t u = zeroLamι t u ≫ graphπ t u
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.zeroMuToBase_eq
statement: theorem zeroMuToBase_eq : zeroMuToBase t u = zeroMuι t u ≫ graphπ t u
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.hab_lam
statement:
theorem hab_lam : ∀ U : V.affineOpens,
    (graphIdeal t u).ideal U = Ideal.span {resTop U t, resTop U u}
proof:
:=
  ideal_graphIdeal t u

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.hab_mu
statement:
theorem hab_mu : ∀ U : V.affineOpens,
    (graphIdeal t u).ideal U = Ideal.span {resTop U u, resTop U t}
proof:
:= by
  intro U
  rw [ideal_graphIdeal, Set.pair_comm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.range_zeroLamι
statement:
theorem range_zeroLamι :
    Set.range (zeroLamι t u) = ((chartMu t u : Set (graphClosure t u)))ᶜ
proof:
:=
  range_pairZeroι (hab_lam t u) ht ht hu

statement:
theorem range_zeroMuι :
    Set.range (zeroMuι t u) = ((chartLam t u : Set (graphClosure t u)))ᶜ
proof:
:=
  range_pairZeroι (hab_mu t u) ht hu ht

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.isClosedImmersion_zeroLamι
statement: theorem isClosedImmersion_zeroLamι : IsClosedImmersion (zeroLamι t u)
proof:
:=
  isClosedImmersion_pairZeroι (hab_lam t u) ht ht hu

statement: theorem isClosedImmersion_zeroMuι : IsClosedImmersion (zeroMuι t u)

:=

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.isClosedImmersion_zeroLamToBase

    IsClosedImmersion (zeroLamToBase t u)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.isClosedImmersion_zeroMuToBase

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.degree_graphπ_of_not_mem_chartMu
statement:
theorem degree_graphπ_of_not_mem_chartMu [IsLocallyNoetherian V] (y : graphClosure t u)
    (hy : y ∉ chartMu t u) : (graphπ t u).degree y = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hy' : y ∈ Set.range (zeroLamι t u) := by
    rw [range_zeroLamι ht hu]
    exact hy
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hy'
  haveI := isClosedImmersion_zeroLamι ht hu
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion (zeroLamι t u ≫ graphπ t u) := isClosedImmersion_zeroLamToBase ht hu
  exact degree_eq_one_of_comp_closedImmersion _ _ z

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.degree_graphπ_of_not_mem_chartLam
statement:
theorem degree_graphπ_of_not_mem_chartLam [IsLocallyNoetherian V] (y : graphClosure t u)
    (hy : y ∉ chartLam t u) : (graphπ t u).degree y = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hy' : y ∈ Set.range (zeroMuι t u) := by
    rw [range_zeroMuι ht hu]
    exact hy
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hy'
  haveI := isClosedImmersion_zeroMuι ht hu
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion (zeroMuι t u ≫ graphπ t u) := isClosedImmersion_zeroMuToBase ht hu
  exact degree_eq_one_of_comp_closedImmersion _ _ z

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.graphZeroDegree_core
statement:
theorem graphZeroDegree_core {V : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral V] [IsLocallyNoetherian V]
    (t u : Γ(V, ⊤)) (ht : t ≠ 0) (hu : u ≠ 0) :
    (∀ y : graphClosure t u, y ∉ chartMu t u → (graphπ t u).degree y ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ y : graphClosure t u, y ∉ chartLam t u → (graphπ t u).degree y ≠ 0)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun y hy ↦ by rw [degree_graphπ_of_not_mem_chartMu ht hu y hy]; exact one_ne_zero,
    fun y hy ↦ by rw [degree_graphπ_of_not_mem_chartLam ht hu y hy]; exact one_ne_zero⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.le_regLocus
statement:
theorem le_regLocus {a b : Γ(X, ⊤)} {W : X.Opens} (h : DividesOn a b W) :
    W ≤ regLocus a b
proof:
:=
  le_sSup h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.map_res_top
statement:
theorem map_res_top (x : Γ(X, ⊤)) {W W' : X.Opens} (i : W' ⟶ W) :
    X.presheaf.map i.op (x |_ W) = x |_ W'
proof:
:= by
  change X.presheaf.map i.op (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE _).op x) =
    X.presheaf.map (homOfLE _).op x
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.dividesOn_mono
statement:
theorem dividesOn_mono {a b : Γ(X, ⊤)} {W W' : X.Opens} (h : W' ≤ W) (hW : DividesOn a b W) :
    DividesOn a b W'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hW
  refine ⟨X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op c, ?_⟩
  have := congrArg (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom hc
  rw [map_mul] at this
  change X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (b |_ W) =
    X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op c * X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (a |_ W) at this
  rwa [map_res_top, map_res_top] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.res_top_ne_zero
statement:
theorem res_top_ne_zero {a : Γ(X, ⊤)} (ha : a ≠ 0) (W : X.Opens) [Nonempty W] :
    a |_ W ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  apply ha
  apply map_injective_of_isIntegral X (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤))
  rw [map_zero]
  exact h0

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.mul_res_cancel
statement:
theorem mul_res_cancel {a : Γ(X, ⊤)} (ha : a ≠ 0) (W : X.Opens) {c c' : Γ(X, W)}
    (h : c * a |_ W = c' * a |_ W) : c = c'
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hW : (W : Set X).Nonempty
  · haveI : Nonempty W := hW.to_subtype
    exact mul_right_cancel₀ (res_top_ne_zero ha W) h
  · have hb : W = ⊥ := (Opens.not_nonempty_iff_eq_bot W).mp hW
    subst hb
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.ratioSpec_holds
statement: theorem ratioSpec_holds {a : Γ(X, ⊤)} (ha : a ≠ 0) (b : Γ(X, ⊤)) : ratioSpec a b
proof:
:= by
  let ι := {W : X.Opens // DividesOn a b W}
  let U : ι → X.Opens := fun i ↦ i.1
  let sf : ∀ i : ι, Γ(X, U i) := fun i ↦ i.2.choose
  have hsf : ∀ i : ι, b |_ (U i) = sf i * a |_ (U i) := fun i ↦ i.2.choose_spec
  have hcover : regLocus a b ≤ iSup U := sSup_le fun W hW ↦ le_iSup U ⟨W, hW⟩
  let iUV : ∀ i : ι, U i ⟶ regLocus a b := fun i ↦ homOfLE (le_regLocus i.2)
  have hrestr : ∀ (i : ι) {W : X.Opens} (e : W ⟶ U i),
      b |_ W = X.presheaf.map e.op (sf i) * a |_ W := by
    intro i W e
    have h1 := congrArg (X.presheaf.map e.op).hom (hsf i)
    rw [map_mul] at h1
    change X.presheaf.map e.op (b |_ U i) =
      X.presheaf.map e.op (sf i) * X.presheaf.map e.op (a |_ U i) at h1
    rwa [map_res_top, map_res_top] at h1
  have hcompat : TopCat.Presheaf.IsCompatible X.sheaf.1 U sf := by
    intro i j
    apply mul_res_cancel ha (U i ⊓ U j)
    exact (hrestr i (Opens.infLELeft (U i) (U j))).symm.trans
      (hrestr j (Opens.infLERight (U i) (U j)))
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, -⟩ := X.sheaf.existsUnique_gluing' U (regLocus a b) iUV hcover sf hcompat
  refine ⟨ρ, X.sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' U (regLocus a b) iUV hcover _ _ fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  change X.presheaf.map (iUV i).op (b |_ regLocus a b) =
    X.presheaf.map (iUV i).op ((show Γ(X, regLocus a b) from ρ) * a |_ regLocus a b)
  rw [map_mul, map_res_top, map_res_top]
  have hρi : X.presheaf.map (iUV i).op (show Γ(X, regLocus a b) from ρ) = sf i := hρ i
  rw [hρi]
  exact hsf i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.res_eq_ratio_mul
statement:
theorem res_eq_ratio_mul {a : Γ(X, ⊤)} (ha : a ≠ 0) (b : Γ(X, ⊤)) :
    b |_ regLocus a b = ratio a b * a |_ regLocus a b
proof:
:= by
  have h := ratioSpec_holds ha b
  unfold ratio
  rw [dif_pos h]
  exact h.choose_spec

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.eq_ratio_res
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_res_cancel ha W
  rw [← hc]
  have h1 := congrArg (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op).hom (res_eq_ratio_mul ha b)
  rw [map_mul] at h1
  change X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op (b |_ regLocus a b) =
    X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op (ratio a b) *
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op (a |_ regLocus a b) at h1
  rwa [map_res_top, map_res_top] at h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.ratio_mul_ratio
statement:
theorem ratio_mul_ratio {a b : Γ(X, ⊤)} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    ratio a b |_ (regLocus a b ⊓ regLocus b a) * ratio b a |_ (regLocus a b ⊓ regLocus b a) =
      1
proof:
:= by
  set W := regLocus a b ⊓ regLocus b a
  have h1 : b |_ W = ratio a b |_ W * a |_ W := by
    have := congrArg (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : W ≤ regLocus a b)).op).hom
      (res_eq_ratio_mul ha b)
    rw [map_mul] at this
    change X.presheaf.map (homOfLE _).op (b |_ regLocus a b) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE _).op (ratio a b) *
        X.presheaf.map (homOfLE _).op (a |_ regLocus a b) at this
    rwa [map_res_top, map_res_top] at this
  have h2 : a |_ W = ratio b a |_ W * b |_ W := by
    have := congrArg (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : W ≤ regLocus b a)).op).hom
      (res_eq_ratio_mul hb a)
    rw [map_mul] at this
    change X.presheaf.map (homOfLE _).op (a |_ regLocus b a) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE _).op (ratio b a) *
        X.presheaf.map (homOfLE _).op (b |_ regLocus b a) at this
    rwa [map_res_top, map_res_top] at this
  apply mul_res_cancel hb W
  rw [one_mul]
  calc ratio a b |_ W * ratio b a |_ W * b |_ W
      = ratio a b |_ W * (ratio b a |_ W * b |_ W) := mul_assoc _ _ _
    _ = b |_ W := by rw [← h2, ← h1]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.mem_regLocus_of_isUnit_germ
proof:
:= by
  set U := regLocus a b
  set W := X.basicOpen (ratio a b)
  have hyW : y ∈ W := (X.mem_basicOpen (ratio a b) y hy).mpr hu
  have hWU : W ≤ U := X.basicOpen_le _
  have hunit : IsUnit (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWU).op (ratio a b)) :=
    RingedSpace.isUnit_res_basicOpen X.toRingedSpace (ratio a b)
  refine le_regLocus (W := W) ⟨hunit.unit⁻¹.1, ?_⟩ hyW
  have h1 := congrArg (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWU).op).hom (res_eq_ratio_mul ha b)
  rw [map_mul] at h1
  change X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWU).op (b |_ U) =
    X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWU).op (ratio a b) * X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWU).op (a |_ U) at h1
  rw [map_res_top, map_res_top] at h1
  rw [h1, ← mul_assoc]
  change a |_ W = (hunit.unit⁻¹ : (Γ(X, W))ˣ).1 * hunit.unit.1 * a |_ W
  rw [Units.inv_mul, one_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.isUnit_germ_ratio_iff
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨mem_regLocus_of_isUnit_germ ha b hy, fun hy' ↦ ?_⟩
  have hyW : y ∈ regLocus a b ⊓ regLocus b a := ⟨hy, hy'⟩
  have h := congrArg (X.presheaf.germ _ y hyW).hom (ratio_mul_ratio ha hb)
  rw [map_mul, map_one] at h
  have e : X.presheaf.germ _ y hyW (ratio a b |_ (regLocus a b ⊓ regLocus b a)) =
      X.presheaf.germ _ y hy (ratio a b) :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply X.presheaf (homOfLE inf_le_left) y hyW (ratio a b)
  rw [e] at h
  exact isUnit_iff_exists_inv.mpr ⟨_, h⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.zeroLocus_ratio_eq_compl
statement:
theorem zeroLocus_ratio_eq_compl {a b : Γ(X, ⊤)} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (hcov : ∀ y, y ∈ regLocus a b ∨ y ∈ regLocus b a) (y : X) :
    (∃ hy : y ∈ regLocus a b, ¬ IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ _ y hy (ratio a b))) ↔
      y ∉ regLocus b a
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hy, hn⟩
    exact fun h ↦ hn ((isUnit_germ_ratio_iff ha hb hy).mpr h)
  · intro h
    have hy := (hcov y).resolve_right h
    exact ⟨hy, fun hu ↦ h ((isUnit_germ_ratio_iff ha hb hy).mp hu)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.dividesOn_opensRange
statement:
theorem dividesOn_opensRange (j : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (a b : Γ(X, ⊤)) (c : Γ(Y, ⊤))
    (h : j.appTop b = j.appTop a * c) : DividesOn a b (j ''ᵁ ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(j.appIso ⊤).inv c, ?_⟩
  apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (j.appIso ⊤).hom).1
  have key : ∀ x : Γ(X, ⊤), (j.appIso ⊤).hom (x |_ (j ''ᵁ ⊤)) = j.appTop x := by
    intro x
    rw [Scheme.Hom.appIso_hom']
    change (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE _).op ≫ j.appLE (j ''ᵁ ⊤) ⊤ _) x = j.appTop x
    rw [Scheme.Hom.map_appLE]
    simp [Scheme.Hom.appLE]
  rw [map_mul, key, key, h, mul_comm]
  congr 1
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Iso.inv_hom_id, CommRingCat.id_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.appTop_specMap_comp_fromSpec
statement:
theorem appTop_specMap_comp_fromSpec {X : Scheme.{u}} {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] (φ : Γ(X, U) →+* B) (x : Γ(X, ⊤)) :
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ≫ hU.fromSpec).appTop x =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of B)).inv (φ (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op x))
proof:
:= by
  have hf : hU.fromSpec.appTop =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv :=
    (hU.fromSpec_app_of_le ⊤ le_top).trans (by congr 1)
  have hS : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)).appTop =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).hom ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom φ ≫
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of B)).inv := by
    rw [← Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, hf, hS, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.appTop_mul_of_eq
statement:
theorem appTop_mul_of_eq {X : Scheme.{u}} {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    {B : Type u} [CommRing B] (φ : Γ(X, U) →+* B) (x y : Γ(X, ⊤)) (ρ : B)
    (h : φ (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op x) =
      φ (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op y) * ρ) :
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ≫ hU.fromSpec).appTop x =
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ≫ hU.fromSpec).appTop y *
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of B)).inv ρ
proof:
:= by
  rw [appTop_specMap_comp_fromSpec, appTop_specMap_comp_fromSpec, h, map_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.dividesOn_of_comp
statement:
theorem dividesOn_of_comp {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (π : X ⟶ Z)
    (g : Y ⟶ Z) (hg : j ≫ π = g)
    (a b : Γ(Z, ⊤)) (c : Γ(Y, ⊤)) (h : g.appTop b = g.appTop a * c) :
    DividesOn (π.appTop a) (π.appTop b) (j ''ᵁ ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  subst hg
  apply dividesOn_opensRange j _ _ c
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop]
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.chartι_graphπ
statement:
theorem chartι_graphπ (U : V.affineOpens) (r : (graphIdeal t u).ideal U) :
    chartι t u U r ≫ graphπ t u =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (baseRingHom ((graphIdeal t u).ideal U) r)) ≫ U.2.fromSpec
proof:
:= by
  have h : chartι t u U r ≫ graphπ t u =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (baseRingHom ((graphIdeal t u).ideal U) r)) ≫
        U.2.isoSpec.inv ≫ U.1.ι :=
    GlobalBlowup.chartHom_comp_toBase V (graphIdeal t u) ⟨U, r⟩
  rw [h, IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_inv_ι]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.chartι_graphπ_appTop
statement:
theorem chartι_graphπ_appTop (U : V.affineOpens) (r : (graphIdeal t u).ideal U)
    (x : Γ(V, ⊤)) :
    (chartι t u U r ≫ graphπ t u).appTop x =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (chartRing t u U r))).inv
        (baseRingHom _ r (resTop U x))
proof:
:=
  (congrArg (fun g : chart ((graphIdeal t u).ideal U) r ⟶ V ↦ g.appTop x)
    (chartι_graphπ t u U r)).trans
    (appTop_specMap_comp_fromSpec U.2 (baseRingHom ((graphIdeal t u).ideal U) r) x)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.chart_dividesOn
statement:
theorem chart_dividesOn (U : V.affineOpens) (a b : Γ(V, ⊤)) (r s : (graphIdeal t u).ideal U)
    (hr : r.1 = resTop U a) (hs : s.1 = resTop U b) :
    DividesOn ((graphπ t u).appTop a) ((graphπ t u).appTop b) (chartι t u U r ''ᵁ ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  have key : baseRingHom ((graphIdeal t u).ideal U) r (resTop U b) =
      baseRingHom ((graphIdeal t u).ideal U) r (resTop U a) * ratioElement _ r s := by
    rw [← hr, ← hs, baseRingHom_apply, baseRingHom_apply, baseElement_mul_ratioElement]
  exact dividesOn_of_comp _ _ _ (chartι_graphπ t u U r) a b _
    (appTop_mul_of_eq U.2 (baseRingHom ((graphIdeal t u).ideal U) r) b a _ key)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.ideal_graphIdeal_range
statement:
theorem ideal_graphIdeal_range (U : V.affineOpens) :
    (graphIdeal t u).ideal U = Ideal.span (Set.range ![resTop U t, resTop U u])
proof:
:= by
  rw [ideal_graphIdeal, Matrix.range_cons, Matrix.range_cons, Matrix.range_empty,
    Set.union_empty, Set.singleton_union]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.graph_cover
statement:
theorem graph_cover (y : graphClosure t u) :
    y ∈ regLocus (tΓ t u) (uΓ t u) ∨ y ∈ regLocus (uΓ t u) (tΓ t u)
proof:
:= by
  have hy : y ∈ ⨆ U : V.affineOpens, (GlobalBlowup.affineι V (graphIdeal t u) U).opensRange := by
    rw [GlobalBlowup.iSup_opensRange_affineι]
    trivial
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hy
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hU
  have hI := ideal_graphIdeal_range t u U
  let cov := affineOpenCoverOfSpan ((graphIdeal t u).ideal U) ![resTop U t, resTop U u] hI
  obtain ⟨i, w, hw⟩ : ∃ i : Fin 2, z ∈ Set.range (cov.f i) := ⟨cov.idx z, cov.covers z⟩
  fin_cases i
  · left
    refine le_regLocus (chart_dividesOn t u U t u ⟨resTop U t, resTop_left_mem t u U⟩
      ⟨resTop U u, resTop_right_mem t u U⟩ rfl rfl) ⟨w, trivial, ?_⟩
    rw [← hw]
    rfl
  · right
    refine le_regLocus (chart_dividesOn t u U u t ⟨resTop U u, resTop_right_mem t u U⟩
      ⟨resTop U t, resTop_left_mem t u U⟩ rfl rfl) ⟨w, trivial, ?_⟩
    rw [← hw]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.graph_hcov
statement: theorem graph_hcov (y : graphClosure t u) : y ∈ chartLam t u ∨ y ∈ chartMu t u

statement:
theorem graph_zeroLocus_rhoLam (ht : t ≠ 0) (hu : u ≠ 0) (y : graphClosure t u) :
    (∃ hy : y ∈ chartLam t u,
        ¬ IsUnit ((graphClosure t u).presheaf.germ _ y hy (rhoLam t u))) ↔ y ∉ chartMu t u
proof:
:= by

name: RRC.SingularTodd.isFiniteLength_of_isLocalizedModule_of_minimal
statement:
theorem isFiniteLength_of_isLocalizedModule_of_minimal (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime]
    (hmin : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum R, q ∈ Module.support R N → q.asIdeal ≤ p → q.asIdeal = p)
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [IsLocalization.AtPrime A p]
    {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module A M] [IsScalarTower R A M]
    (g : N →ₗ[R] M) [IsLocalizedModule p.primeCompl g] :
    IsFiniteLength A M
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : IsLocalRing A := IsLocalization.AtPrime.isLocalRing A p
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing A := IsLocalization.isNoetherianRing p.primeCompl A inferInstance
  haveI : Module.Finite A M := Module.Finite.of_isLocalizedModule p.primeCompl g
  let I : Ideal R := Module.annihilator R N
  let J : Ideal A := I.map (algebraMap R A)
  have hJ : J ≤ Module.annihilator A M := by
    rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro r hr
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, Module.mem_annihilator]
    intro m
    rw [algebraMap_smul]
    obtain ⟨⟨n, s⟩, hs⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.surj p.primeCompl g m
    have h1 : (algebraMap R (Module.End R M) (s : R)) (r • m) =
        (algebraMap R (Module.End R M) (s : R)) 0 := by
      rw [map_zero, Module.algebraMap_end_apply, smul_comm]
      change r • (s • m) = 0
      rw [hs, ← map_smul, Module.mem_annihilator.mp hr n, map_zero]
    exact ((Module.End.isUnit_iff _).mp (IsLocalizedModule.map_units g s)).injective h1
  have hkill : Module.IsTorsionBySet A M (J : Set A) := by
    intro m a
    exact Module.mem_annihilator.mp (hJ a.2) m
  haveI : Ring.KrullDimLE 0 (A ⧸ J) := Ring.KrullDimLE.mk₀ fun Q hQ => by
    let P : Ideal A := Q.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk J)
    haveI : P.IsPrime := Ideal.comap_isPrime _ _
    have hJP : J ≤ P := by
      intro a ha
      change Ideal.Quotient.mk J a ∈ Q
      rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr ha]
      exact Q.zero_mem
    let q : PrimeSpectrum R := ⟨P.comap (algebraMap R A), Ideal.comap_isPrime _ _⟩
    have hqp : q.asIdeal ≤ p := by
      intro r hr
      by_contra hrp
      have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap R A r) :=
        IsLocalization.map_units A (⟨r, hrp⟩ : p.primeCompl)
      exact (inferInstance : P.IsPrime).ne_top (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem P hr hu)
    have hIq : I ≤ q.asIdeal := Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mp hJP
    have hsupp : q ∈ Module.support R N := by
      rw [Module.support_eq_zeroLocus]
      exact hIq
    have hq := hmin q hsupp hqp
    have hPmax : P = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A := by
      apply le_antisymm (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal (inferInstance : P.IsPrime).ne_top)
      rw [← IsLocalization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal p A, ← hq]
      exact Ideal.map_comap_le
    haveI : P.IsMaximal := hPmax ▸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal A
    have hQ' : P.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) = Q :=
      Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective Q
    rw [← hQ']
    refine (Ideal.map_eq_top_or_isMaximal_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
      (inferInstance : P.IsMaximal)).resolve_left ?_
    rw [hQ']
    exact hQ.ne_top
  haveI : IsArtinianRing (A ⧸ J) := IsNoetherianRing.isArtinianRing_of_krullDimLE_zero
  letI : Module (A ⧸ J) M := hkill.module
  haveI : Module.Finite (A ⧸ J) M := Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite A (A ⧸ J) M
  have hArtM : IsArtinian A M :=
    (hkill.semilinearMap.isArtinian_iff_of_bijective Function.bijective_id).mpr inferInstance
  exact isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mpr ⟨inferInstance, hArtM⟩

name: RRC.SingularTodd.isFiniteLength_compHom_of_surjective
statement:
theorem isFiniteLength_compHom_of_surjective {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (φ : A →+* B) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) {P : Type u} [AddCommGroup P] [Module B P]
    (h : IsFiniteLength B P) :
    letI : Module A P
proof:
:= Module.compHom P φ
    IsFiniteLength A P := by
  letI : Module A P := Module.compHom P φ
  haveI : RingHomSurjective φ := ⟨hφ⟩
  let l : P →ₛₗ[φ] P := { toFun := id, map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl, map_smul' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl }
  obtain ⟨hN, hA⟩ := isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp h
  exact isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mpr
    ⟨(l.isNoetherian_iff_of_bijective Function.bijective_id).mpr hN,
      (l.isArtinian_iff_of_bijective Function.bijective_id).mpr hA⟩

name: RRC.SingularTodd.isFiniteLength_stalk_spec_of_maximal
statement:
theorem isFiniteLength_stalk_spec_of_maximal {R : CommRingCat.{u}} [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (M : (Spec R).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation] {y : Spec R}
    (hy : ∀ q : Spec R, q ∈ moduleSheafSupport M → q ⤳ y → q = y) :
    IsFiniteLength ((Spec R).presheaf.stalk y) ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear (Spec R) y).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  let N : ModuleCat.{u} R := (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj M).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤)
  haveI : Module.FinitePresentation R N := moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation M
  haveI : IsIso M.fromTildeΓ := Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent M
  let e : tilde N ≅ M := asIso M.fromTildeΓ
  letI : Algebra R ((Spec R).presheaf.stalk y) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Algebra R ((Spec.structureSheaf R).presheaf.stalk y))
  haveI : IsLocalization.AtPrime ((Spec R).presheaf.stalk y) y.asIdeal :=
    inferInstanceAs
      (IsLocalization.AtPrime ((Spec.structureSheaf R).presheaf.stalk y) y.asIdeal)
  letI : Module R ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear (Spec R) y).obj (tilde N)) :=
    inferInstanceAs
      (Module R ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (moduleStructurePresheaf R N).presheaf y))
  haveI : IsScalarTower R ((Spec R).presheaf.stalk y)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear (Spec R) y).obj (tilde N)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsScalarTower R ((structurePresheafInCommRingCat R).stalk y)
      ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (moduleStructurePresheaf R N).presheaf y))
  let g : N →ₗ[R] ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear (Spec R) y).obj (tilde N)) :=
    StructureSheaf.toStalkₗ R N y
  haveI : IsLocalizedModule y.asIdeal.primeCompl g :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsLocalizedModule y.asIdeal.primeCompl (StructureSheaf.toStalkₗ R N y))
  have hmin : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum R, q ∈ Module.support R N → q.asIdeal ≤ y.asIdeal →
      q.asIdeal = y.asIdeal := by
    intro q hq hqy
    have hqM : q ∈ moduleSheafSupport M := by
      rw [← moduleSheafSupport_eq_of_iso e, moduleSheafSupport_tilde_eq]
      exact hq
    have hspec : (q : Spec R) ⤳ y := (PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes q y).mp hqy
    exact congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal (hy q hqM hspec)
  have hT : IsFiniteLength ((Spec R).presheaf.stalk y)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear (Spec R) y).obj (tilde N)) :=
    isFiniteLength_of_isLocalizedModule_of_minimal y.asIdeal hmin _ g
  exact ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear (Spec R) y).mapIso e).toLinearEquiv.isFiniteLength hT

name: RRC.SingularTodd.isFiniteLength_stalk_of_maximal
statement:
theorem isFiniteLength_stalk_of_maximal [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (F : X.Modules)
    [F.IsFinitePresentation] {x : X} (hx : Maximal (· ∈ moduleSheafSupport F) x) :
    IsFiniteLength (X.presheaf.stalk x) ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj F)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨U, hU, rfl⟩, hxU, -⟩ :=
    X.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open (Set.mem_univ x) isOpen_univ
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, U) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨U, hU⟩
  let f : Spec Γ(X, U) ⟶ X := hU.fromSpec
  obtain ⟨y, hfy⟩ : ∃ y : Spec Γ(X, U), f y = x := ⟨_, hU.fromSpec_primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxU⟩⟩
  let M := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj F
  haveI : M.IsFinitePresentation := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor f F
  have hy : ∀ q : Spec Γ(X, U), q ∈ moduleSheafSupport M → q ⤳ y → q = y := by
    intro q hq hqy
    rw [moduleSheafSupport_restrictFunctor f F] at hq
    have h1 : f q ⤳ x := hfy ▸ hqy.map f.continuous
    have h2 : f q ≤ x := hx.2 hq ((Scheme.le_iff_specializes).mpr h1)
    have h3 : x ⤳ f q := (Scheme.le_iff_specializes).mp h2
    exact f.isOpenEmbedding.injective (hfy ▸ (h1.antisymm h3).eq)
  have hM := isFiniteLength_stalk_spec_of_maximal M hy
  subst hfy
  letI : Module (X.presheaf.stalk (f y)) ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear (Spec Γ(X, U)) y).obj M) :=
    Module.compHom _ (f.stalkMap y).hom
  have hcomp : IsFiniteLength (X.presheaf.stalk (f y))
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear (Spec Γ(X, U)) y).obj M) :=
    isFiniteLength_compHom_of_surjective (f.stalkMap y).hom
      (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (f.stalkMap y)).2 hM
  let eStalk :
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear (Spec Γ(X, U)) y).obj M) ≃ₗ[X.presheaf.stalk (f y)]
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X (f y)).obj F) := by
    letI := Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkModule f y F
    exact Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkLinearEquiv f y F
  exact eStalk.isFiniteLength hcomp

name: RRC.SingularTodd.moduleStalkFunctorLinear_preservesFiniteLimitsT0D
statement:
theorem moduleStalkFunctorLinear_preservesFiniteLimitsT0D :
    PreservesFiniteLimits (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x)
proof:
:= by
  let hcomp : PreservesFiniteLimits
      (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x ⋙
        forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.stalk x)) Ab.{u}) := by
    change PreservesFiniteLimits (Scheme.Modules.stalkFunctor X x)
    infer_instance
  let hreflect : ReflectsFiniteLimits
      (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.stalk x)) Ab.{u}) := by
    infer_instance
  exact preservesFiniteLimits_of_reflects_of_preserves
    (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x)
    (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.stalk x)) Ab.{u})

name: RRC.SingularTodd.shortExact_map_moduleStalkFunctorLinear
statement:
theorem shortExact_map_moduleStalkFunctorLinear {S : ShortComplex X.Modules}
    (hS : S.ShortExact) : (S.map (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x)).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  letI := moduleStalkFunctorLinear_preservesFiniteLimitsT0D X x
  exact hS.map_of_exact (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x)

name: RRC.SingularTodd.finite_maximal_moduleSheafSupport
statement:
theorem finite_maximal_moduleSheafSupport [IsNoetherian X] (F : X.Modules)
    [F.IsFinitePresentation] : {x : X | Maximal (· ∈ moduleSheafSupport F) x}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hSfin, hScl, hSirr, hZ⟩ :=
    NoetherianSpace.exists_finite_set_isClosed_irreducible (isClosed_moduleSheafSupport F)
  refine (hSfin.biUnion (t := fun t ↦ {y : X | IsGenericPoint y t}) fun t _ ↦ ?_).subset ?_
  · exact (show ({y : X | IsGenericPoint y t}).Subsingleton from
      fun a ha b hb ↦ IsGenericPoint.eq ha hb).finite
  · intro x hx
    have hxZ : x ∈ ⋃₀ S := hZ ▸ hx.1
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hxt⟩ := Set.mem_sUnion.mp hxZ
    let η := (hSirr t ht).genericPoint
    have hη : IsGenericPoint η t := (hSirr t ht).isGenericPoint_genericPoint (hScl t ht)
    have hηZ : η ∈ moduleSheafSupport F := hZ ▸ Set.mem_sUnion.mpr ⟨t, ht, hη.mem⟩
    have hηx : η ⤳ x := hη.specializes hxt
    have hxη : x ⤳ η :=
      (Scheme.le_iff_specializes).mp (hx.2 hηZ ((Scheme.le_iff_specializes).mpr hηx))
    have hEq : η = x := (hηx.antisymm hxη).eq
    exact Set.mem_biUnion ht (show IsGenericPoint x t from hEq ▸ hη)

name: RRC.SingularTodd.coherentCycleRaw_apply
statement:
theorem coherentCycleRaw_apply [IsNoetherian X] (F : X.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike X F)
    (n : ℕ) (x : X) : coherentCycleRaw F hF n x = coherentCoeff F n x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : F.IsFinitePresentation := hF
  by_cases hx : Maximal (· ∈ moduleSheafSupport F) x
  · have hmem : x ∈ (finite_maximal_moduleSheafSupport F).toFinset := by simpa using hx
    simp [coherentCycleRaw, hmem]
  · have hmem : x ∉ (finite_maximal_moduleSheafSupport F).toFinset := by simpa using hx
    have h0 : coherentCoeff F n x = 0 := by simp [coherentCoeff, hx]
    simp [coherentCycleRaw, hmem, h0]

name: RRC.SingularTodd.coherentCycleRaw_mem
statement:
theorem coherentCycleRaw_mem [IsNoetherian X] (F : X.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike X F)
    (n : ℕ) : coherentCycleRaw F hF n ∈ dimensionCycles X n
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  change coherentCycleRaw F hF n x ≠ 0 at hx
  rw [coherentCycleRaw_apply] at hx
  by_contra hne
  rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hne
  exact hx (by simp [coherentCoeff, hne])

name: RRC.SingularTodd.coherentCycle_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coherentCycle_apply [IsNoetherian X] (F : X.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike X F)
    (n : ℕ) (x : X) :
    (coherentCycle F hF n : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) x = coherentCoeff F n x
proof:
:=
  coherentCycleRaw_apply F hF n x

name: RRC.SingularTodd.maximal_of_height_eq_of_top
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hmem, fun y hy hxy ↦ ?_⟩
  by_contra hyx
  have hlt : x < y := lt_of_le_not_ge hxy hyx
  have htop : height x < ⊤ := by rw [hx]; exact ENat.coe_lt_top n
  have h := height_strictMono hlt htop
  rw [hx] at h
  exact absurd (hdim y hy) (not_le.mpr h)

name: RRC.SingularTodd.coherentCoeff_of_top
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hmem : x ∈ moduleSheafSupport F
  · simp [coherentCoeff, hx, maximal_of_height_eq_of_top F hdim hx hmem]
  · simp [coherentCoeff, stalkLength_eq_zero_of_not_mem F hmem]

name: RRC.SingularTodd.coherentCycle_apply_of_top
statement:
theorem coherentCycle_apply_of_top [IsNoetherian X] (F : X.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike X F)
    {n : ℕ} (hdim : ∀ y ∈ moduleSheafSupport F, height y ≤ n) {x : X} (hx : height x = n) :
    (coherentCycle F hF n : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) x = ((stalkLength F x).toNat : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coherentCycle_apply, coherentCoeff_of_top F hdim hx]

name: RRC.SingularTodd.coherentCycle_apply_of_height_ne
statement:
theorem coherentCycle_apply_of_height_ne [IsNoetherian X] (F : X.Modules)
    (hF : IsCoherentLike X F) {n : ℕ} {x : X} (hx : height x ≠ n) :
    (coherentCycle F hF n : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [coherentCycle_apply, coherentCoeff, hx]

name: RRC.SingularTodd.coherentCycle_additive
statement:
theorem coherentCycle_additive [IsNoetherian X] {A B D : X.Modules}
    (hA : IsCoherentLike X A) (hB : IsCoherentLike X B) (hD : IsCoherentLike X D)
    {f : A ⟶ B} {g : B ⟶ D} (zero : f ≫ g = 0)
    (hS : (ShortComplex.mk f g zero).ShortExact) (n : ℕ)
    (hdim : ∀ x ∈ moduleSheafSupport B, height x ≤ n) :
    coherentCycle B hB n = coherentCycle A hA n + coherentCycle D hD n
proof:
:= by
  haveI : B.IsFinitePresentation := hB
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext x
  change (coherentCycle B hB n : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) x =
    (coherentCycle A hA n : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) x + (coherentCycle D hD n : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) x
  by_cases hx : height x = n
  swap
  · rw [coherentCycle_apply_of_height_ne B hB hx, coherentCycle_apply_of_height_ne A hA hx,
      coherentCycle_apply_of_height_ne D hD hx, add_zero]
  have hT := shortExact_map_moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x hS
  have hinj := hT.moduleCat_injective_f
  have hsurj := hT.moduleCat_surjective_g
  have hex := (ShortComplex.ShortExact.moduleCat_exact_iff_function_exact _).mp hT.exact
  have hlen : stalkLength B x = stalkLength A x + stalkLength D x :=
    Module.length_eq_add_of_exact _ _ hinj hsurj hex
  have hAB : ∀ y ∈ moduleSheafSupport A, y ∈ moduleSheafSupport B := by
    intro y hy
    haveI : Nontrivial ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X y).obj A) := hy
    have hTy := shortExact_map_moduleStalkFunctorLinear X y hS
    exact @Function.Injective.nontrivial _ _ hy _ hTy.moduleCat_injective_f
  have hDB : ∀ y ∈ moduleSheafSupport D, y ∈ moduleSheafSupport B := by
    intro y hy
    haveI : Nontrivial ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X y).obj D) := hy
    have hTy := shortExact_map_moduleStalkFunctorLinear X y hS
    exact @Function.Surjective.nontrivial _ _ hy _ hTy.moduleCat_surjective_g
  have hdimA : ∀ y ∈ moduleSheafSupport A, height y ≤ n := fun y hy ↦ hdim y (hAB y hy)
  have hdimD : ∀ y ∈ moduleSheafSupport D, height y ≤ n := fun y hy ↦ hdim y (hDB y hy)
  rw [coherentCycle_apply_of_top B hB hdim hx, coherentCycle_apply_of_top A hA hdimA hx,
    coherentCycle_apply_of_top D hD hdimD hx]
  have hfin : stalkLength B x ≠ ⊤ := by
    by_cases hmem : x ∈ moduleSheafSupport B
    · exact Module.length_ne_top_iff.mpr
        (isFiniteLength_stalk_of_maximal B (maximal_of_height_eq_of_top B hdim hx hmem))
    · rw [stalkLength_eq_zero_of_not_mem B hmem]
      exact ENat.zero_ne_top
  rw [hlen] at hfin ⊢
  obtain ⟨hAfin, hDfin⟩ := WithTop.add_ne_top.mp hfin
  rw [ENat.toNat_add hAfin hDfin]
  push_cast
  rfl

name: RRC.SingularTodd.G0Le.toG0_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem G0Le.toG0_classOf (n : ℕ) (F : X.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentDimLE X n F) :
    G0Le.toG0 X n (ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf X.Modules (IsCoherentDimLE X n) F hF) =
      g0ClassOf X F hF.1
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.map_classOf _ _ _

name: RRC.SingularTodd.topCycleG0_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem topCycleG0_classOf [IsNoetherian X] (n : ℕ) (F : X.Modules)
    (hF : IsCoherentDimLE X n F) :
    topCycleG0 X n (ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf X.Modules (IsCoherentDimLE X n) F hF) =
      coherentCycle F hF.1 n
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.lift_classOf _ _ _

name: RRC.SingularTodd.topChowG0_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem topChowG0_classOf [IsNoetherian X] (n : ℕ) (F : X.Modules)
    (hF : IsCoherentDimLE X n F) :
    topChowG0 X n (ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf X.Modules (IsCoherentDimLE X n) F hF) =
      QuotientAddGroup.mk (coherentCycle F hF.1 n)
proof:
:= by
  simp [topChowG0]

name: RRC.SingularTodd.subsingleton_stalk_pushUnit_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem subsingleton_stalk_pushUnit_of_not_mem {y : X} (hy : y ∉ Set.range ι) :
