    Subsingleton ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X y).obj (pushUnit ι))
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ∀ c : ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X y).obj (pushUnit ι)), c = 0 from
    ⟨fun a b ↦ by rw [h a, h b]⟩
  intro c
  obtain ⟨U, hyU, s, rfl⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.exists_germ_eq (pushUnit ι).val.presheaf c
  let O : X.Opens := ⟨(Set.range ι)ᶜ, ι.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range.isOpen_compl⟩
  let W : X.Opens := U ⊓ O
  have hyW : y ∈ W := ⟨hyU, hy⟩
  have hW : ι ⁻¹ᵁ W = ⊥ := by
    ext v
    simp [W, O]
  have hsub : Subsingleton Γ(V, ι ⁻¹ᵁ W) := hW ▸ inferInstance
  rw [← TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ (homOfLE inf_le_left : W ⟶ U) y hyW s]
  have h0 : (pushUnit ι).val.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left : W ⟶ U).op s = 0 :=
    @Subsingleton.elim _ hsub _ _
  rw [h0, map_zero]
  rfl

name: RRC.SingularTodd.pushUnitStalkHom_bijective
statement: theorem pushUnitStalkHom_bijective (v : V) : Function.Bijective (pushUnitStalkHom ι v)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := TopCat.Presheaf.stalkPushforward.stalkPushforward_iso_of_isInducing Ab
    ι.isClosedEmbedding.isInducing (SheafOfModules.unit V.ringCatSheaf).val.presheaf v
  exact ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _

name: RRC.SingularTodd.pushUnitStalkHom_smul
statement:
theorem pushUnitStalkHom_smul (v : V) (a : X.presheaf.stalk (ι v))
    (m : (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X (ι v)).obj (pushUnit ι)) :
    pushUnitStalkHom ι v (a • m) = ι.stalkMap v a • pushUnitStalkHom ι v m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, r, rfl⟩ := X.presheaf.exists_germ_eq a
  obtain ⟨W, hW, s, rfl⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.exists_germ_eq (pushUnit ι).val.presheaf m
  let T : X.Opens := U ⊓ W
  have hT : ι v ∈ T := ⟨hU, hW⟩
  rw [← X.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE inf_le_left : T ⟶ U) (ι v) hT r,
    ← TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ (homOfLE inf_le_right : T ⟶ W) (ι v) hT s]
  set r' := X.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left : T ⟶ U).op r
  set s' := (pushUnit ι).val.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_right : T ⟶ W).op s
  have h1 := PresheafOfModules.germ_smul (R := X.presheaf) (M := (pushUnit ι).val) (ι v) T hT r' s'
  erw [← h1]
  simp only [pushUnitStalkHom]
  erw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkPushforward_germ_apply, TopCat.Presheaf.stalkPushforward_germ_apply]
  rw [Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply]
  have h2 := PresheafOfModules.germ_smul (R := V.presheaf)
    (M := (SheafOfModules.unit V.ringCatSheaf).val) v (ι ⁻¹ᵁ T) hT (ι.app T r') s'
  erw [← h2]
  rfl

name: RRC.SingularTodd.isCoherentLike_pushUnit
statement: theorem isCoherentLike_pushUnit [IsLocallyNoetherian X] : IsCoherentLike X (pushUnit ι)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : (SheafOfModules.unit V.ringCatSheaf).IsFinitePresentation :=
    SheafOfModules.unit_isFinitePresentation (R := V.ringCatSheaf)
  exact isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_isFinite ι _

name: RRC.SingularTodd.mem_moduleSheafSupport_pushUnit_image
statement:
theorem mem_moduleSheafSupport_pushUnit_image (v : V) :
    ι v ∈ moduleSheafSupport (pushUnit ι)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module (X.presheaf.stalk (ι v)) (V.presheaf.stalk v) :=
    Module.compHom _ (ι.stalkMap v).hom
  change Nontrivial ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X (ι v)).obj (pushUnit ι))
  exact (pushUnitStalkLinearEquiv ι v).toEquiv.nontrivial

name: RRC.SingularTodd.moduleSheafSupport_pushUnit
statement: theorem moduleSheafSupport_pushUnit : moduleSheafSupport (pushUnit ι) = Set.range ι
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · intro hy
    by_contra hny
    haveI := subsingleton_stalk_pushUnit_of_not_mem ι hny
    exact (not_nontrivial ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X y).obj (pushUnit ι))) hy
  · rintro ⟨v, rfl⟩
    exact mem_moduleSheafSupport_pushUnit_image ι v

name: RRC.SingularTodd.stalkLength_pushUnit
statement:
theorem stalkLength_pushUnit (v : V) :
    stalkLength (pushUnit ι) (ι v) =
      Module.length (V.presheaf.stalk v) (V.presheaf.stalk v)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra (X.presheaf.stalk (ι v)) (V.presheaf.stalk v) := (ι.stalkMap v).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Module (X.presheaf.stalk (ι v)) (V.presheaf.stalk v) :=
    Module.compHom _ (ι.stalkMap v).hom
  haveI : IsScalarTower (X.presheaf.stalk (ι v)) (V.presheaf.stalk v) (V.presheaf.stalk v) := by
    constructor
    intro r s n
    change ((ι.stalkMap v).hom r * s) * n = (ι.stalkMap v).hom r * (s * n)
    exact mul_assoc _ _ _
  rw [stalkLength, (pushUnitStalkLinearEquiv ι v).length_eq]
  exact Module.length_eq_of_surjective (ι.stalkMap_surjective v)

name: RRC.SingularTodd.maximal_range_iff
statement: theorem maximal_range_iff (v : V) : Maximal (· ∈ Set.range ι) (ι v) ↔ IsMax v
proof:
:= by
  have hle : ∀ a b : V, ι a ≤ ι b ↔ a ≤ b := by
    intro a b
    rw [Scheme.le_iff_specializes, Scheme.le_iff_specializes]
    exact ι.isClosedEmbedding.isInducing.specializes_iff
  constructor
  · intro h w hvw
    exact (hle w v).mp (h.2 ⟨w, rfl⟩ ((hle v w).mpr hvw))
  · intro h
    refine ⟨⟨v, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩ hvw
    exact (hle w v).mpr (h ((hle v w).mp hvw))

name: RRC.SingularTodd.coherentCycle_pushUnit_apply_image
statement:
theorem coherentCycle_pushUnit_apply_image [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian V]
    (hF : IsCoherentLike X (pushUnit ι)) (n : ℕ) (v : V) :
    (coherentCycle (pushUnit ι) hF n : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) (ι v) =
      if height (ι v) = n then fundamentalCycle V v else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [coherentCycle_apply, coherentCoeff, moduleSheafSupport_pushUnit]
  simp only [maximal_range_iff]
  by_cases hn : height (ι v) = n
  · by_cases hv : IsMax v
    · have hg : v ∈ genericPoints V := mem_genericPoints_of_isMax hv
      rw [if_pos ⟨hn, hv⟩, if_pos hn, fundamentalCycle_apply_of_mem_genericPoints hg,
        stalkLength_pushUnit]
      rfl
    · have hg : v ∉ genericPoints V := fun hg ↦ hv (isMax_of_mem_genericPoints hg)
      rw [if_neg (fun h ↦ hv h.2), if_pos hn, fundamentalCycle_apply_of_not_mem_genericPoints hg]
  · rw [if_neg (fun h ↦ hn h.1), if_neg hn]

name: RRC.SingularTodd.coherentCycle_pushUnit_apply_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem coherentCycle_pushUnit_apply_of_not_mem [IsNoetherian X]
    (hF : IsCoherentLike X (pushUnit ι)) (n : ℕ) {y : X} (hy : y ∉ Set.range ι) :
    (coherentCycle (pushUnit ι) hF n : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) y = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [coherentCycle_apply, coherentCoeff, moduleSheafSupport_pushUnit, if_neg]
  exact fun h ↦ hy h.2.1

name: RRC.SingularTodd.coherentCycle_pushUnit_integral
statement:
theorem coherentCycle_pushUnit_integral [IsNoetherian X] [IsIntegral V] [IsNoetherian V]
    (hF : IsCoherentLike X (pushUnit ι)) (n : ℕ) (hn : height (ι (genericPoint V)) = n) :
    coherentCycle (pushUnit ι) hF n = M7.dimPrimeCycle (ι (genericPoint V)) n hn
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext y
  change (coherentCycle (pushUnit ι) hF n : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) y =
    Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single (ι (genericPoint V)) (1 : ℤ) y
  rw [Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single_apply]
  by_cases hy : y ∈ Set.range ι
  · obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [coherentCycle_pushUnit_apply_image ι hF n v]
    have hle : ∀ w : V, w ≤ genericPoint V := fun w ↦
      (Scheme.le_iff_specializes).mpr ((genericPoint_spec V).specializes (Set.mem_univ w))
    by_cases hv : v = genericPoint V
    · subst hv
      have hg : genericPoint V ∈ genericPoints V :=
        mem_genericPoints_of_isMax (fun w _ ↦ hle w)
      have h1 : selfLocalLength (genericPoint V) = 1 := by
        letI : Field (V.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint V)) := inferInstanceAs (Field V.functionField)
        exact Module.length_eq_one _ _
      rw [if_pos hn, if_pos rfl, fundamentalCycle_apply_of_mem_genericPoints hg]
      simp [genericMultiplicity, h1]
    · have hg : v ∉ genericPoints V := fun hg ↦
        hv (((Scheme.le_iff_specializes).mp (isMax_of_mem_genericPoints hg (hle v))).antisymm
          ((Scheme.le_iff_specializes).mp (hle v))).eq
      have hne : ι v ≠ ι (genericPoint V) := fun h ↦ hv (ι.isClosedEmbedding.injective h)
      rw [if_neg hne, fundamentalCycle_apply_of_not_mem_genericPoints hg, ite_self]
  · rw [coherentCycle_pushUnit_apply_of_not_mem ι hF n hy, if_neg]
    rintro rfl
    exact hy ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: RRC.SingularTodd.coherentCycle_pushUnit_eq_pushforward_fundamentalCycle
statement:
theorem coherentCycle_pushUnit_eq_pushforward_fundamentalCycle [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian V]
    (hF : IsCoherentLike X (pushUnit ι)) (n : ℕ)
    (hpure : ∀ v ∈ genericPoints V, height (ι v) = n) :
    (coherentCycle (pushUnit ι) hF n : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) =
      properPushforward ι (fundamentalCycle V)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext y
  by_cases hy : y ∈ Set.range ι
  · obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [coherentCycle_pushUnit_apply_image ι hF n v, properPushforward,
      AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_closedImmersion ι _ (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ())
        (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) v]
    by_cases hn : height (ι v) = n
    · rw [if_pos hn]
    · have hg : v ∉ genericPoints V := fun hg ↦ hn (hpure v hg)
      rw [if_neg hn, fundamentalCycle_apply_of_not_mem_genericPoints hg]
  · rw [coherentCycle_pushUnit_apply_of_not_mem ι hF n hy, properPushforward,
      AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range ι _ (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ())
        y hy]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T2C.exists_factor_of_range_t2c
statement:
theorem exists_factor_of_range_t2c {W : Scheme.{u}} [IsReduced W] (F : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion F] (g : W ⟶ X) (h : ∀ x, g x ∈ Set.range F) :
    ∃ f : W ⟶ Z, f ≫ F = g
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Surjective (pullback.snd F g) := by
    rw [surjective_iff, ← Set.range_eq_univ, Scheme.Pullback.range_snd]
    exact Set.eq_univ_of_forall h
  haveI : IsIso (pullback.snd F g) := isIso_of_isClosedImmersion_of_surjective _
  refine ⟨inv (pullback.snd F g) ≫ pullback.fst F g, ?_⟩
  rw [Category.assoc, pullback.condition, IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T2C.dimPrimeCycle_congr
statement:
theorem dimPrimeCycle_congr {a b : X} (h : a = b) {m : ℕ} (ha : height a = m)
    (hb : height b = m) : dimPrimeCycle a m ha = dimPrimeCycle b m hb
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T2C.properPushforward_apply_self
statement:
theorem properPushforward_apply_self (E : AlgebraicCycle Z ℤ) (z : Z) :
    properPushforward ι E (ι z) = E z
proof:
:= by
  rw [properPushforward_eq_pushforward_closedImmersion ι E (fun _ : Z ↦ ()) (fun _ : X ↦ ())
    (fun _ _ ↦ rfl)]
  exact pushforward_apply_closedImmersion ι E (fun _ : Z ↦ ()) (fun _ : X ↦ ()) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) z

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T2C.properPushforward_of_fac
statement:
theorem properPushforward_of_fac {W : Scheme.{u}} (h : W ⟶ Z) (i : W ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [IsClosedImmersion h] (hfac : h ≫ ι = i) (E : AlgebraicCycle W ℤ) :
    properPushforward i E = properPushforward ι (properPushforward h E)
proof:
:= by
  subst hfac
  exact properPushforward_comp h ι E

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T2C.restrictCycle_properPushforward
statement:
theorem restrictCycle_properPushforward (E : AlgebraicCycle Z ℤ) :
    F13.restrictCycle ι ι.isEmbedding.injective (properPushforward ι E) = E
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  rw [F13.restrictCycle_apply, properPushforward_apply_self]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T2C.restrictHom_apply
statement:
theorem restrictHom_apply (n : ℕ) (E : dimensionCycles X n) (z : Z) :
    (restrictHom ι n E).1 z = E.1 (ι z)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T2C.properPushforward_dimPrimeCycle
statement:
theorem properPushforward_dimPrimeCycle (m : ℕ) (z : Z) (hz : height z = m) :
    properPushforward ι (dimPrimeCycle z m hz).1 =
      (dimPrimeCycle (ι z) m ((height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion ι z).trans hz)).1
proof:
:= by
  have hres : F13.restrictCycle ι ι.isEmbedding.injective
      (dimPrimeCycle (ι z) m ((height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion ι z).trans hz)).1 =
      (dimPrimeCycle z m hz).1 := by
    ext z'
    rw [F13.restrictCycle_apply, m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply, m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply]
    by_cases h : z' = z
    · subst h; simp
    · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun h' ↦ h (ι.isEmbedding.injective h'))]
  rw [← hres]
  refine F13.properPushforward_restrictCycle ι _ fun x hx ↦ ?_
  rw [m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply, if_neg]
  rintro rfl
  exact hx ⟨z, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T2C.restrictHom_relation_of_range
statement:
theorem restrictHom_relation_of_range {m : ℕ} (G : DimRelationGenerator X m)
    (hG : ∀ y, G.i y ∈ Set.range ι) :
    (QuotientAddGroup.mk (restrictHom ι m G.cycle) : DimChow Z m) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, hfac⟩ := exists_factor_of_range_t2c ι G.i hG
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion (h ≫ ι) := by rw [hfac]; infer_instance
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion h := IsClosedImmersion.of_comp_isClosedImmersion h ι
  let G' : DimRelationGenerator Z m :=
    ⟨G.Y, h, G.f, G.hf, fun y hy ↦ by
      rw [← height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion ι, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hfac]
      exact G.dimension y hy⟩
  have hcyc : restrictHom ι m G.cycle = G'.cycle := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change F13.restrictCycle ι ι.isEmbedding.injective (properPushforward G.i (div G.f)) =
      properPushforward h (div G.f)
    rw [properPushforward_of_fac ι h G.i hfac, restrictCycle_properPushforward]
  rw [hcyc, QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff]
  exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨G', rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T2C.hasConstantRank_restrict
statement: theorem hasConstantRank_restrict : HasConstantRank Z ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj L) 1
proof:
:=
  hasConstantRank_pullback Z ι L 1 hL

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T2C.transverseCycle_class
statement:
theorem transverseCycle_class (n : ℕ) (w : X) (hw : height w = n + 1)
    (hu : IsUnit (eqs L hL s w)) :
    D5.primeCapOrZero (k := k) L hL n w =
      (QuotientAddGroup.mk (transverseCycle (k := k) L hL s n w hw hu) : DimChow X n)
proof:
:=
  (D39.repW_of_isUnit (k := k) hL s n w hw hu).choose_spec.1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T2C.transverseCycle_apply
statement:
theorem transverseCycle_apply (n : ℕ) (w : X) (hw : height w = n + 1)
    (hu : IsUnit (eqs L hL s w)) (y : X) :
    (transverseCycle (k := k) L hL s n w hw hu).1 y = C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (eqs L hL s) w y
proof:
:=
  (D39.repW_of_isUnit (k := k) hL s n w hw hu).choose_spec.2 y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T2C.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_isUnit (a : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (w y : X)
    (hy : IsUnit (a y)) : C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a w y = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff
  split_ifs with h1 h2
  · rw [CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity_of_isUnit hy]
    rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T2C.gysinCycles_dimPrimeCycle
statement:
theorem gysinCycles_dimPrimeCycle (n : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = n + 1) :
    gysinCycles (k := k) L hL s ι n (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv) =
      gysinPrime (k := k) L hL s ι n v
proof:
:= by
  have hsingle : compactCycleFinsupp (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv).1 = Finsupp.single v 1 := by
    ext x
    rw [compactCycleFinsupp_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply]
    by_cases hx : x = v
    · simp [hx]
    · rw [if_neg hx, if_neg (Ne.symm hx)]
  show (compactCycleFinsupp (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv).1).sum
    (fun w m ↦ m • gysinPrime (k := k) L hL s ι n w) = _
  rw [hsingle, Finsupp.sum_single_index (zero_zsmul _), one_zsmul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T2C.push_gysinPrime
statement:
theorem push_gysinPrime (hZ : IsSupport L hL s ι) (n : ℕ) (w : X) (hw : height w = n + 1) :
    D9.properPushforwardDimChowD9 (k := k) ι n (gysinPrime (k := k) L hL s ι n w) =
      D5.primeCap (k := k) L hL n w hw
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hu : IsUnit (eqs L hL s w)
  · rw [gysinPrime, dif_pos hw, dif_pos hu, D9.properPushforwardDimChowD9_mk]
    have hpush : properPushforward ι
        (restrictHom ι n (transverseCycle (k := k) L hL s n w hw hu)).1 =
        (transverseCycle (k := k) L hL s n w hw hu).1 := by
      refine F13.properPushforward_restrictCycle ι _ fun x hx ↦ ?_
      rw [transverseCycle_apply]
      refine c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_isUnit _ w x ?_
      by_contra h
      exact hx ((hZ x).mpr h)
    have := transverseCycle_class (k := k) L hL s n w hw hu
    rw [D5.primeCapOrZero, dif_pos hw] at this
    rw [this]
    congr 1
    exact Subtype.ext hpush
  · have hz : ∃ z, ι z = w := (hZ w).mpr hu
    rw [gysinPrime, dif_pos hw, dif_neg hu, dif_pos hz]
    have hzw : ι hz.choose = w := hz.choose_spec
    have hzh : height hz.choose = n + 1 := by
      rw [← height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion ι, hzw, hw]
    rw [D5.primeCapOrZero, dif_pos hzh]
    have hD' : (dimPrimeCycle w (n + 1) hw).1 =
        properPushforward ι (dimPrimeCycle hz.choose (n + 1) hzh).1 := by
      rw [properPushforward_dimPrimeCycle]
      exact congrArg Subtype.val (dimPrimeCycle_congr hzw.symm _ _)
    rw [D16.capPushGate (k := k) ι L hL n hz.choose hzh (dimPrimeCycle w (n + 1) hw) hD',
      D5.capCycles_dimPrimeCycle]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T2C.push_gysinCycles
statement:
theorem push_gysinCycles (hZ : IsSupport L hL s ι) (n : ℕ) (D : dimensionCycles X (n + 1)) :
    D9.properPushforwardDimChowD9 (k := k) ι n (gysinCycles (k := k) L hL s ι n D) =
      D5.capCycles (k := k) L hL n D
proof:
:= by
  have key : D ∈ AddMonoidHom.eqLocus
      ((D9.properPushforwardDimChowD9 (k := k) ι n).comp (gysinCycles (k := k) L hL s ι n))
      (D5.capCycles (k := k) L hL n) := by
    refine D13.dimCycle_mem_of_prime _ (fun v hv ↦ ?_) D
    change D9.properPushforwardDimChowD9 (k := k) ι n
        (gysinCycles (k := k) L hL s ι n (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv)) =
      D5.capCycles (k := k) L hL n (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv)
    rw [gysinCycles_dimPrimeCycle, D5.capCycles_dimPrimeCycle, push_gysinPrime hZ]
  exact key

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T2C.gysinCycles_push
statement:
theorem gysinCycles_push (hZ : IsSupport L hL s ι) (n : ℕ) (β : dimensionCycles Z (n + 1)) :
    gysinCycles (k := k) L hL s ι n (D13.pfHom (k := k) ι (n + 1) β) =
      D5.capCycles (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_restrict L hL ι) n β
proof:
:= by
  have key : β ∈ AddMonoidHom.eqLocus
      ((gysinCycles (k := k) L hL s ι n).comp (D13.pfHom (k := k) ι (n + 1)))
      (D5.capCycles (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_restrict L hL ι) n) := by
    refine D13.dimCycle_mem_of_prime _ (fun z hz ↦ ?_) β
    change gysinCycles (k := k) L hL s ι n
        (D13.pfHom (k := k) ι (n + 1) (dimPrimeCycle z (n + 1) hz)) =
      D5.capCycles (k := k) _ _ n (dimPrimeCycle z (n + 1) hz)
    have hzh : height (ι z) = n + 1 := (height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion ι z).trans hz
    have hpf : D13.pfHom (k := k) ι (n + 1) (dimPrimeCycle z (n + 1) hz) =
        dimPrimeCycle (ι z) (n + 1) hzh :=
      Subtype.ext (properPushforward_dimPrimeCycle ι (n + 1) z hz)
    have hex : ∃ z', ι z' = ι z := ⟨z, rfl⟩
    have hnu : ¬ IsUnit (eqs L hL s (ι z)) := (hZ (ι z)).mp ⟨z, rfl⟩
    rw [hpf, gysinCycles_dimPrimeCycle, gysinPrime, dif_pos hzh, dif_neg hnu, dif_pos hex,
      D5.capCycles_dimPrimeCycle]
    have hch : hex.choose = z := ι.isEmbedding.injective hex.choose_spec
    have : ∀ z' (h' : z' = z), D5.primeCapOrZero (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_restrict L hL ι) n z' =
        D5.primeCap (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj L)
          (hasConstantRank_restrict L hL ι) n z hz := by
      rintro z' rfl
      unfold D5.primeCapOrZero
      exact dif_pos hz
    exact this _ hch
  exact key

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T2C.gysinCycles_relation_of_range
statement:
theorem gysinCycles_relation_of_range (hZ : IsSupport L hL s ι) (n : ℕ)
    (hcap : D5.CapDescends (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj L)
      (hasConstantRank_restrict L hL ι) n)
    (g : DimRelationGenerator X (n + 1)) (hg : ∀ y, g.i y ∈ Set.range ι) :
    gysinCycles (k := k) L hL s ι n g.cycle = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, hfac⟩ := exists_factor_of_range_t2c ι g.i hg
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion (h ≫ ι) := by rw [hfac]; infer_instance
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion h := IsClosedImmersion.of_comp_isClosedImmersion h ι
  let g' : DimRelationGenerator Z (n + 1) :=
    ⟨g.Y, h, g.f, g.hf, fun y hy ↦ by
      rw [← height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion ι, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hfac]
      exact g.dimension y hy⟩
  have hcyc : g.cycle = D13.pfHom (k := k) ι (n + 1) g'.cycle := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change properPushforward g.i (div g.f) = properPushforward ι (properPushforward h (div g.f))
    exact properPushforward_of_fac ι h g.i hfac _
  rw [hcyc, gysinCycles_push hZ]
  exact hcap g'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T2C.gysinCycles_eq_mk_of_units
statement:
theorem gysinCycles_eq_mk_of_units (n : ℕ) (D : dimensionCycles X (n + 1))
    (hD : ∀ v, D.1 v ≠ 0 → IsUnit (eqs L hL s v)) :
    ∃ C : dimensionCycles X n,
      gysinCycles (k := k) L hL s ι n D = QuotientAddGroup.mk (restrictHom ι n C) ∧
      ∀ y, C.1 y = C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (eqs L hL s) D.1 y
proof:
:= by
  set fs := compactCycleFinsupp D.1 with hfs
  have hcod : ∀ v, D.1 v ≠ 0 → height v = n + 1 := fun v hv ↦ D.2 hv
  have hsupp : ∀ v, v ∈ fs.support ↔ D.1 v ≠ 0 := fun v ↦ by
    rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, hfs, compactCycleFinsupp_apply]
  let R' : X → dimensionCycles X n := fun w ↦
    if h : height w = n + 1 ∧ IsUnit (eqs L hL s w) then
      transverseCycle (k := k) L hL s n w h.1 h.2 else 0
  have hRep : ∀ w ∈ fs.support, gysinPrime (k := k) L hL s ι n w =
      (QuotientAddGroup.mk (restrictHom ι n (R' w)) : DimChow Z n) := by
    intro w hw
    have hw' := (hsupp w).mp hw
    have hc := hcod w hw'
    have hu := hD w hw'
    simp only [R', dif_pos (And.intro hc hu)]
    rw [gysinPrime, dif_pos hc, dif_pos hu]
  have hRepv : ∀ w ∈ fs.support, ∀ y,
      (R' w).1 y = C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (eqs L hL s) w y := by
    intro w hw y
    have hw' := (hsupp w).mp hw
    simp only [R', dif_pos (And.intro (hcod w hw') (hD w hw'))]
    exact transverseCycle_apply (k := k) L hL s n w _ _ y
  refine ⟨fs.sum fun w m ↦ m • R' w, ?_, fun y ↦ ?_⟩
  · change fs.sum (fun v m ↦ m • gysinPrime (k := k) L hL s ι n v) = _
    rw [Finsupp.sum_congr (g2 := fun v m ↦
      m • (QuotientAddGroup.mk (restrictHom ι n (R' v)) : DimChow Z n)) fun v hv ↦ by
        rw [hRep v hv]]
    have := map_finsuppSum ((QuotientAddGroup.mk' (dimRationalEquivalence Z n)).comp
      (restrictHom ι n)) fs (fun v m ↦ m • R' v)
    simp only [map_zsmul, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, QuotientAddGroup.mk'_apply] at this
    exact this.symm
  · change D6.evalHomD X n y (fs.sum fun w m ↦ m • R' w) = _
    rw [map_finsuppSum]
    simp only [map_zsmul, smul_eq_mul]
    change ∑ w ∈ fs.support, fs w * (R' w).1 y = _
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun w hw ↦ by rw [hRepv w hw y]]
    unfold C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff
    have hsub : Function.support (fun v ↦ D.1 v * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (eqs L hL s) v y) ⊆
        ↑fs.support := by
      intro v hv
      rw [Finset.mem_coe, hsupp]
      exact left_ne_zero_of_mul hv
    rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ hsub]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun v _ ↦ ?_
    rw [hfs, compactCycleFinsupp_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T2C.gysinCycles_relation_of_proper
statement:
theorem gysinCycles_relation_of_proper (hZ : IsSupport L hL s ι) (n : ℕ)
    (g : DimRelationGenerator X (n + 1)) (ha : D6.IsProperForD g (eqs L hL s)) :
    gysinCycles (k := k) L hL s ι n g.cycle = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hunits : ∀ v, g.cycle.1 v ≠ 0 → IsUnit (eqs L hL s v) := by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨y, rfl, hy⟩ := D12.exists_div_ne_zero_of_cycle_ne_zero g hv
    exact (D14.pullback_isUnit_iff g y).mp (D12.unit_of_proper g _ ha hy)
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hCv⟩ := gysinCycles_eq_mk_of_units (k := k) (ι := ι) n g.cycle hunits
  have hCeq : C = D6.relCycleD (k := k) g (eqs L hL s) ha := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    ext x
    rw [hCv, D6.c1CapCyclesCoeff_relationD (k := k) g _ ha x]
  rw [hC, hCeq, D6.relCycleD, map_sum, QuotientAddGroup.mk_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun w _ ↦ ?_
  rw [map_zsmul, QuotientAddGroup.mk_zsmul]
  have hw := (ha.finite.mem_toFinset.mp w.2)
  have hnu : ¬ IsUnit (eqs L hL s (g.i w.1)) := by
    intro hu
    exact (IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal.mpr ((D14.pullback_isUnit_iff g w.1).mpr hu)) hw.2
  have hmem : g.i w.1 ∈ Set.range ι := (hZ _).mpr hnu
  
  have hrange : ∀ y, (D6.relGenD (k := k) g w.1 hw.1).i y ∈ Set.range ι := by
    intro y
    have hsp : g.i w.1 ⤳ (D6.relGenD (k := k) g w.1 hw.1).i y := by
      change g.i w.1 ⤳ g.i (pointClosureι w.1 y)
      exact (C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι w.1 y).map g.i.continuous
    exact hsp.mem_closed ι.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range hmem
  rw [restrictHom_relation_of_range ι _ hrange, zsmul_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T2C.gysinDescends_of_improperGate
statement:
theorem gysinDescends_of_improperGate (hZ : IsSupport L hL s ι) (n : ℕ)
    (hcap : D5.CapDescends (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj L)
      (hasConstantRank_restrict L hL ι) n)
    (himp : ImproperGate (k := k) L hL s ι n) :
    GysinDescends (k := k) L hL s ι n
proof:
:= by
  intro g
  by_cases hη : IsUnit (eqs L hL s (g.i (genericPoint g.Y)))
  · by_cases hp : D6.IsProperForD g (eqs L hL s)
    · exact gysinCycles_relation_of_proper hZ n g hp
    · exact himp g hη hp
  · refine gysinCycles_relation_of_range hZ n hcap g fun y ↦ ?_
    have hmem : g.i (genericPoint g.Y) ∈ Set.range ι := (hZ _).mpr hη
    have hsp : g.i (genericPoint g.Y) ⤳ g.i y :=
      ((genericPoint_spec g.Y).specializes (Set.mem_univ y)).map g.i.continuous
    exact hsp.mem_closed ι.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range hmem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T2C.gysinChow_mk
statement:
theorem gysinChow_mk {n : ℕ} (h : GysinDescends (k := k) L hL s ι n)
    (D : dimensionCycles X (n + 1)) :
    gysinChow h (QuotientAddGroup.mk D) = gysinCycles (k := k) L hL s ι n D
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T2C.rationalGysin_tmul
statement:
theorem rationalGysin_tmul {n : ℕ} (h : GysinDescends (k := k) L hL s ι n) (q : ℚ)
    (D : dimensionCycles X (n + 1)) :
    rationalGysin h (q ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X (n + 1))) =
      q ⊗ₜ[ℤ] gysinCycles (k := k) L hL s ι n D
proof:
:= by
  rw [rationalGysin, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T2C.push_gysinChow
statement:
theorem push_gysinChow (hZ : IsSupport L hL s ι) {n : ℕ} (h : GysinDescends (k := k) L hL s ι n)
    (hX : D5.CapDescends (k := k) L hL n) (x : DimChow X (n + 1)) :
    D9.properPushforwardDimChowD9 (k := k) ι n (gysinChow h x) = D5.capChow (k := k) L hL n hX x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
  | H D =>
    rw [gysinChow_mk, D5.capChow_mk]
    exact push_gysinCycles hZ n D

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2T2C.push_rationalGysin
statement:
theorem push_rationalGysin (hZ : IsSupport L hL s ι) {n : ℕ}
    (h : GysinDescends (k := k) L hL s ι n) (hX : D5.CapDescends (k := k) L hL n)
    (ξ : RationalDimChow X (n + 1)) :
    D9.properPushforwardRationalDimChowD9 (k := k) ι n (rationalGysin h ξ) =
      D5.rationalCap (k := k) L hL n hX ξ
proof:
:= by
  induction ξ using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul q x =>
    rw [rationalGysin, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, D9.properPushforwardRationalDimChowD9_tmul,
      D5.rationalCap, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul]
    congr 1
    exact push_gysinChow hZ h hX x
  | add ξ η hξ hη => rw [map_add, map_add, hξ, hη, map_add]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CDI.algebraMap_stalkMap_germEqs
statement:
theorem algebraMap_stalkMap_germEqs (t : Γ(X, ⊤)) (w : X) (z : pointClosureScheme w) :
    algebraMap ((pointClosureScheme w).presheaf.stalk z) (pointClosureScheme w).functionField
      (((pointClosureι w).stalkMap z).hom (germEqs t (pointClosureι w z))) = restrictFn t w
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty ((pointClosureι w) ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : X.Opens)) :=
    ⟨⟨pointClosureGenericPoint w, trivial⟩⟩
  unfold germEqs restrictFn
  erw [Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply]
  rw [Scheme.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CDI.restrictFn_ne_zero
statement:
theorem restrictFn_ne_zero (t : Γ(X, ⊤)) (w : X) (hu : IsUnit (germEqs t w)) :
    restrictFn t w ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hu' : IsUnit (germEqs t (pointClosureι w (pointClosureGenericPoint w))) := by
    rw [pointClosureι_genericPoint]
    exact hu
  rw [← algebraMap_stalkMap_germEqs t w (pointClosureGenericPoint w)]
  exact ((hu'.map ((pointClosureι w).stalkMap _).hom).map
    (algebraMap ((pointClosureScheme w).presheaf.stalk _)
      (pointClosureScheme w).functionField)).ne_zero

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CDI.germEqs_notMem_stalkPrime
statement:
theorem germEqs_notMem_stalkPrime (t : Γ(X, ⊤)) (w : X) (hu : IsUnit (germEqs t w))
    (z : pointClosureScheme w) :
    germEqs t (pointClosureι w z) ∉
      Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι w z)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rw [← C1Cap.ker_stalkMap_pointClosureι, RingHom.mem_ker] at h
  apply restrictFn_ne_zero t w hu
  rw [← algebraMap_stalkMap_germEqs t w z, h, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CDI.transGen_cycle_apply
statement:
theorem transGen_cycle_apply (n : ℕ) (w : X) (hw : height w = n + 1)
    (hu : IsUnit (germEqs t w)) (y : X) :
    (transGen (k := k) t n w hw hu).cycle.1 y = C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) w y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hy : y ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι w)
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hy
    change properPushforward (pointClosureι w) (div (restrictFn t w)) (pointClosureι w z) = _
    rw [properPushforward_apply_self, AlgebraicGeometry.div_eq_ord]
    by_cases hz : coheight z = 1
    · rw [C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_ord _ w z hz (germEqs_notMem_stalkPrime t w hu z),
        algebraMap_stalkMap_germEqs]
    · rw [Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hz, C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_pointClosureι,
        if_neg hz]
  · change properPushforward (pointClosureι w) (div (restrictFn t w)) y = _
    rw [properPushforward_eq_pushforward_closedImmersion (pointClosureι w) _
      (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ : X ↦ ()) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl),
      pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range _ _ _ _ _ hy,
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_not_specializes]
    intro h
    apply hy
    rw [range_pointClosureι]
    exact specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CDI.divIntCycles_dimPrimeCycle
statement:
theorem divIntCycles_dimPrimeCycle (n : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = n + 1) :
    divIntCycles (k := k) t ι n (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv) = divIntPrime (k := k) t ι n v
proof:
:= by
  have hsingle : compactCycleFinsupp (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv).1 = Finsupp.single v 1 := by
    ext x
    rw [compactCycleFinsupp_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply]
    by_cases hx : x = v
    · simp [hx]
    · rw [if_neg hx, if_neg (Ne.symm hx)]
  show (compactCycleFinsupp (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv).1).sum
    (fun w m ↦ m • divIntPrime (k := k) t ι n w) = _
  rw [hsingle, Finsupp.sum_single_index (zero_zsmul _), one_zsmul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CDI.divInt_prime_not_le
statement:
theorem divInt_prime_not_le (n : ℕ) (w : X) (hw : height w = n + 1)
    (hu : IsUnit (germEqs t w)) :
    divIntCycles (k := k) t ι n (dimPrimeCycle w (n + 1) hw) =
      QuotientAddGroup.mk (restrictHom ι n (transGen (k := k) t n w hw hu).cycle)
proof:
:= by
  rw [divIntCycles_dimPrimeCycle, divIntPrime, dif_pos ⟨hw, hu⟩]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CDI.divInt_prime_le
statement:
theorem divInt_prime_le (n : ℕ) (w : X) (hw : height w = n + 1)
    (hnu : ¬ IsUnit (germEqs t w)) :
    divIntCycles (k := k) t ι n (dimPrimeCycle w (n + 1) hw) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [divIntCycles_dimPrimeCycle, divIntPrime, dif_neg (fun h ↦ hnu h.2)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CDI.isZeroLocus_iff
statement: theorem isZeroLocus_iff : IsZeroLocus t ι ↔ Set.range ι = X.zeroLocus {t}
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ x, x ∉ (X.basicOpen t : Set X) ↔ ¬ IsUnit (germEqs t x) := fun x ↦ by
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Scheme.mem_basicOpen X t x (Set.mem_univ x)]
    rfl
  rw [Scheme.zeroLocus_singleton]
  constructor
  · intro h
    ext x
    rw [Set.mem_compl_iff, key]
    exact h x
  · intro h x
    rw [h, Set.mem_compl_iff, key]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CDI.push_divIntCycles
statement:
theorem push_divIntCycles (hZ : IsZeroLocus t ι) (n : ℕ) (D : dimensionCycles X (n + 1)) :
    D9.properPushforwardDimChowD9 (k := k) ι n (divIntCycles (k := k) t ι n D) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have key : D ∈ ((D9.properPushforwardDimChowD9 (k := k) ι n).comp
      (divIntCycles (k := k) t ι n)).ker := by
    refine D13.dimCycle_mem_of_prime _ (fun v hv ↦ ?_) D
    rw [AddMonoidHom.mem_ker, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, divIntCycles_dimPrimeCycle, divIntPrime]
    split_ifs with h
    · rw [D9.properPushforwardDimChowD9_mk]
      have hpush : properPushforward ι
          (restrictHom ι n (transGen (k := k) t n v h.1 h.2).cycle).1 =
          (transGen (k := k) t n v h.1 h.2).cycle.1 := by
        refine F13.properPushforward_restrictCycle ι _ fun x hx ↦ ?_
        rw [transGen_cycle_apply]
        refine c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_isUnit _ v x ?_
        by_contra hn
        exact hx ((hZ x).mpr hn)
      rw [QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff]
      have : (⟨properPushforward ι
          (restrictHom ι n (transGen (k := k) t n v h.1 h.2).cycle).1,
          properPushforward_mem_dimensionCycles ι (heightCompatible_of_finiteType k ι)
            (restrictHom ι n (transGen (k := k) t n v h.1 h.2).cycle).2⟩ :
            dimensionCycles X n) = (transGen (k := k) t n v h.1 h.2).cycle :=
        Subtype.ext hpush
      rw [this]
      exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨_, rfl⟩
    · exact map_zero _
  exact key

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CDI.divIntCycles_push
statement:
theorem divIntCycles_push (hZ : IsZeroLocus t ι) (n : ℕ) (β : dimensionCycles Z (n + 1)) :
    divIntCycles (k := k) t ι n (D13.pfHom (k := k) ι (n + 1) β) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have key : β ∈ ((divIntCycles (k := k) t ι n).comp (D13.pfHom (k := k) ι (n + 1))).ker := by
    refine D13.dimCycle_mem_of_prime _ (fun z hz ↦ ?_) β
    have hzh : height (ι z) = n + 1 := (height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion ι z).trans hz
    have hpf : D13.pfHom (k := k) ι (n + 1) (dimPrimeCycle z (n + 1) hz) =
        dimPrimeCycle (ι z) (n + 1) hzh :=
      Subtype.ext (properPushforward_dimPrimeCycle ι (n + 1) z hz)
    rw [AddMonoidHom.mem_ker, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, hpf]
    exact divInt_prime_le (k := k) t ι n (ι z) hzh ((hZ (ι z)).mp ⟨z, rfl⟩)
  exact key

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CDI.divIntCycles_relation_of_range
statement:
theorem divIntCycles_relation_of_range (hZ : IsZeroLocus t ι) (n : ℕ)
    (g : DimRelationGenerator X (n + 1)) (hg : ∀ y, g.i y ∈ Set.range ι) :
    divIntCycles (k := k) t ι n g.cycle = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, hfac⟩ := exists_factor_of_range_t2c ι g.i hg
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion (h ≫ ι) := by rw [hfac]; infer_instance
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion h := IsClosedImmersion.of_comp_isClosedImmersion h ι
  let g' : DimRelationGenerator Z (n + 1) :=
    ⟨g.Y, h, g.f, g.hf, fun y hy ↦ by
      rw [← height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion ι, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hfac]
      exact g.dimension y hy⟩
  have hcyc : g.cycle = D13.pfHom (k := k) ι (n + 1) g'.cycle := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change properPushforward g.i (div g.f) = properPushforward ι (properPushforward h (div g.f))
    exact properPushforward_of_fac ι h g.i hfac _
  rw [hcyc]
  exact divIntCycles_push hZ n g'.cycle

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CDI.divIntCycles_eq_mk_of_units
statement:
theorem divIntCycles_eq_mk_of_units (n : ℕ) (D : dimensionCycles X (n + 1))
    (hD : ∀ v, D.1 v ≠ 0 → IsUnit (germEqs t v)) :
    ∃ C : dimensionCycles X n,
      divIntCycles (k := k) t ι n D = QuotientAddGroup.mk (restrictHom ι n C) ∧
      ∀ y, C.1 y = C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (germEqs t) D.1 y
proof:
:= by
  set fs := compactCycleFinsupp D.1 with hfs
  have hcod : ∀ v, D.1 v ≠ 0 → height v = n + 1 := fun v hv ↦ D.2 hv
  have hsupp : ∀ v, v ∈ fs.support ↔ D.1 v ≠ 0 := fun v ↦ by
    rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, hfs, compactCycleFinsupp_apply]
  let R' : X → dimensionCycles X n := fun w ↦
    if h : height w = n + 1 ∧ IsUnit (germEqs t w) then
      (transGen (k := k) t n w h.1 h.2).cycle else 0
  have hRep : ∀ w ∈ fs.support, divIntPrime (k := k) t ι n w =
      (QuotientAddGroup.mk (restrictHom ι n (R' w)) : DimChow Z n) := by
    intro w hw
    have hw' := (hsupp w).mp hw
    have hh : height w = n + 1 ∧ IsUnit (germEqs t w) := ⟨hcod w hw', hD w hw'⟩
    simp only [R', dif_pos hh]
    rw [divIntPrime, dif_pos hh]
  have hRepv : ∀ w ∈ fs.support, ∀ y,
      (R' w).1 y = C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) w y := by
    intro w hw y
    have hw' := (hsupp w).mp hw
    simp only [R', dif_pos (And.intro (hcod w hw') (hD w hw'))]
    exact transGen_cycle_apply (k := k) t n w _ _ y
  refine ⟨fs.sum fun w m ↦ m • R' w, ?_, fun y ↦ ?_⟩
  · change fs.sum (fun v m ↦ m • divIntPrime (k := k) t ι n v) = _
    rw [Finsupp.sum_congr (g2 := fun v m ↦
      m • (QuotientAddGroup.mk (restrictHom ι n (R' v)) : DimChow Z n)) fun v hv ↦ by
        rw [hRep v hv]]
    have := map_finsuppSum ((QuotientAddGroup.mk' (dimRationalEquivalence Z n)).comp
      (restrictHom ι n)) fs (fun v m ↦ m • R' v)
    simp only [map_zsmul, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, QuotientAddGroup.mk'_apply] at this
    exact this.symm
  · change D6.evalHomD X n y (fs.sum fun w m ↦ m • R' w) = _
    rw [map_finsuppSum]
    simp only [map_zsmul, smul_eq_mul]
    change ∑ w ∈ fs.support, fs w * (R' w).1 y = _
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun w hw ↦ by rw [hRepv w hw y]]
    unfold C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff
    have hsub : Function.support (fun v ↦ D.1 v * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) v y) ⊆
        ↑fs.support := by
      intro v hv
      rw [Finset.mem_coe, hsupp]
      exact left_ne_zero_of_mul hv
    rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ hsub]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun v _ ↦ ?_
    rw [hfs, compactCycleFinsupp_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CDI.divIntCycles_relation_of_proper
statement:
theorem divIntCycles_relation_of_proper (hZ : IsZeroLocus t ι) (n : ℕ)
    (g : DimRelationGenerator X (n + 1)) (ha : D6.IsProperForD g (germEqs t)) :
    divIntCycles (k := k) t ι n g.cycle = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hunits : ∀ v, g.cycle.1 v ≠ 0 → IsUnit (germEqs t v) := by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨y, rfl, hy⟩ := D12.exists_div_ne_zero_of_cycle_ne_zero g hv
    exact (D14.pullback_isUnit_iff g y).mp (D12.unit_of_proper g _ ha hy)
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hCv⟩ := divIntCycles_eq_mk_of_units (k := k) (ι := ι) n g.cycle hunits
  have hCeq : C = D6.relCycleD (k := k) g (germEqs t) ha := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    ext x
    rw [hCv, D6.c1CapCyclesCoeff_relationD (k := k) g _ ha x]
  rw [hC, hCeq, D6.relCycleD, map_sum, QuotientAddGroup.mk_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun w _ ↦ ?_
  rw [map_zsmul, QuotientAddGroup.mk_zsmul]
  have hw := (ha.finite.mem_toFinset.mp w.2)
  have hnu : ¬ IsUnit (germEqs t (g.i w.1)) := by
    intro hu
    exact (IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal.mpr ((D14.pullback_isUnit_iff g w.1).mpr hu)) hw.2
  have hmem : g.i w.1 ∈ Set.range ι := (hZ _).mpr hnu
  have hrange : ∀ y, (D6.relGenD (k := k) g w.1 hw.1).i y ∈ Set.range ι := by
    intro y
    have hsp : g.i w.1 ⤳ (D6.relGenD (k := k) g w.1 hw.1).i y := by
      change g.i w.1 ⤳ g.i (pointClosureι w.1 y)
      exact (C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι w.1 y).map g.i.continuous
    exact hsp.mem_closed ι.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range hmem
  rw [restrictHom_relation_of_range ι _ hrange, zsmul_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CDI.divIntDescends_of_improperGate
statement:
theorem divIntDescends_of_improperGate (hZ : IsZeroLocus t ι) (n : ℕ)
    (himp : DivImproperGate (k := k) t ι n) : DivIntDescends (k := k) t ι n
proof:
:= by
  intro g
  by_cases hη : IsUnit (germEqs t (g.i (genericPoint g.Y)))
  · by_cases hp : D6.IsProperForD g (germEqs t)
    · exact divIntCycles_relation_of_proper hZ n g hp
    · exact himp g hη hp
  · refine divIntCycles_relation_of_range hZ n g fun y ↦ ?_
    have hmem : g.i (genericPoint g.Y) ∈ Set.range ι := (hZ _).mpr hη
    have hsp : g.i (genericPoint g.Y) ⤳ g.i y :=
      ((genericPoint_spec g.Y).specializes (Set.mem_univ y)).map g.i.continuous
    exact hsp.mem_closed ι.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range hmem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CDI.divIntChow_mk
statement:
theorem divIntChow_mk {n : ℕ} (h : DivIntDescends (k := k) t ι n)
    (D : dimensionCycles X (n + 1)) :
    divIntChow h (QuotientAddGroup.mk D) = divIntCycles (k := k) t ι n D
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CDI.divInt_tmul
statement:
theorem divInt_tmul {n : ℕ} (h : DivIntDescends (k := k) t ι n) (q : ℚ)
    (D : dimensionCycles X (n + 1)) :
    divInt h (q ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X (n + 1))) =
      q ⊗ₜ[ℤ] divIntCycles (k := k) t ι n D
proof:
:= by
  rw [divInt, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CDI.divInt_push
statement:
theorem divInt_push (hZ : IsZeroLocus t ι) {n : ℕ} (h : DivIntDescends (k := k) t ι n)
    (ξ : RationalDimChow X (n + 1)) :
    D9.properPushforwardRationalDimChowD9 (k := k) ι n (divInt h ξ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction ξ using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul q x =>
    induction x using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H D =>
      rw [divInt_tmul, D9.properPushforwardRationalDimChowD9_tmul, push_divIntCycles hZ n D,
        TensorProduct.tmul_zero]
  | add ξ η hξ hη => rw [map_add, map_add, hξ, hη, add_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CDI.divInt_comp_push
statement:
theorem divInt_comp_push (hZ : IsZeroLocus t ι) {n : ℕ} (h : DivIntDescends (k := k) t ι n)
    (β : dimensionCycles Z (n + 1)) :
    divIntChow h (D9.properPushforwardDimChowD9 (k := k) ι (n + 1) (QuotientAddGroup.mk β)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [D9.properPushforwardDimChowD9_mk]
  exact divIntCycles_push hZ n β

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.mulQ_mk
statement:
theorem mulQ_mk (z x r : B) :
    mulQ z x (Submodule.Quotient.mk r) = (Submodule.Quotient.mk (x * r) : Qt z)
proof:
:= by
  show x • (Submodule.Quotient.mk r : Qt z) = _
  rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, smul_eq_mul]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.mk_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem mk_eq_zero_iff (z r : B) : (Submodule.Quotient.mk r : Qt z) = 0 ↔ z ∣ r
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.mk_mem_ker_mulQ
statement:
theorem mk_mem_ker_mulQ (z x r : B) :
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk r : Qt z) ∈ LinearMap.ker (mulQ z x) ↔ z ∣ x * r
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, mulQ_mk, mk_eq_zero_iff]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.mk_mem_range_mulQ
statement:
theorem mk_mem_range_mulQ {z y : B} (hy : y ∣ z) (r : B) :
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk r : Qt z) ∈ LinearMap.range (mulQ z y) ↔ y ∣ r
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨m, hm⟩
    obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ m
    rw [mulQ_mk, Submodule.Quotient.eq, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hm
    have h2 := dvd_sub (dvd_mul_right y s) (hy.trans hm)
    rwa [sub_sub_cancel] at h2
  · rintro ⟨s, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk s, mulQ_mk _ _ _⟩

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.mulQ_mul
statement: theorem mulQ_mul (z x y : B) : mulQ z (x * y) = mulQ z x ∘ₗ mulQ z y
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun m => by simp [mulQ, mul_smul]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.mulQ_comm
statement: theorem mulQ_comm (z x y : B) : mulQ z x ∘ₗ mulQ z y = mulQ z y ∘ₗ mulQ z x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mulQ_mul, ← mulQ_mul, mul_comm]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.comp_mulQ
statement: theorem comp_mulQ {z w : B} (g : Qt z →ₗ[B] Qt w) (x : B) : g ∘ₗ mulQ z x = mulQ w x ∘ₗ g
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun m => by simp [mulQ]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.mulMap_mk
statement:
theorem mulMap_mk (z c w : B) (h : w ∣ c * z) (r : B) :
    mulMap z c w h (Submodule.Quotient.mk r) = (Submodule.Quotient.mk (c * r) : Qt w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mulMap, Submodule.mapQ_apply]; rfl

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.projMap_mk
statement:
theorem projMap_mk (z w : B) (h : w ∣ z) (r : B) :
    projMap z w h (Submodule.Quotient.mk r) = (Submodule.Quotient.mk r : Qt w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [projMap, Submodule.mapQ_apply]; rfl

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.map_top_mulMap
statement:
theorem map_top_mulMap (z c w : B) (h : w ∣ c * z) :
    (⊤ : Submodule B (Qt z)).map (mulMap z c w h) = LinearMap.range (mulQ w c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.map_top]
  ext m
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ n
    exact ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk s, by rw [mulQ_mk, mulMap_mk]⟩
  · rintro ⟨n, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ n
    exact ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk s, by rw [mulQ_mk, mulMap_mk]⟩

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.ker_mulQ_eq_range
statement:
theorem ker_mulQ_eq_range {x y z : B} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hz : z = x * y) :
    LinearMap.ker (mulQ z x) = LinearMap.range (mulQ z y)
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ m
  have hy : y ∣ z := by rw [hz]; exact dvd_mul_left y x
  rw [mk_mem_ker_mulQ, mk_mem_range_mulQ hy, hz, mul_dvd_mul_iff_left hx]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.ker_mulMap
statement:
theorem ker_mulMap {z c w : B} (hc : c ≠ 0) (hw : w = c * z) :
    (⊤ : Submodule B (Qt z)) ⊓
        (⊥ : Submodule B (Qt w)).comap (mulMap z c w (by rw [hw])) ≤ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  intro m hm
  obtain ⟨-, hm⟩ := Submodule.mem_inf.1 hm
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ m
  rw [Submodule.mem_comap, mulMap_mk, Submodule.mem_bot, mk_eq_zero_iff, hw,
    mul_dvd_mul_iff_left hc] at hm
  rw [Submodule.mem_bot, mk_eq_zero_iff]
  exact hm

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.finLen
statement: theorem finLen {z : B} (hz : z ≠ 0) : IsArtinian B (Qt z) ∧ IsNoetherian B (Qt z)
proof:
:= by
  have := isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.1
    (isFiniteLength_quotient_span_singleton B (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hz))
  exact ⟨this.2, this.1⟩

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.symb_eq
statement:
theorem symb_eq {a b z : B} (hz : z = a * b) (h0 : z ≠ 0) [IsArtinian B (Qt z)]
    [IsNoetherian B (Qt z)] :
    symb a b = perDet (M := Qt z) ⊥ ⊤ (mulQ z a) (mulQ z b)
proof:
:= by
  subst hz
  rw [symb, dif_neg h0]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.symb_of_mul_eq_zero
statement: theorem symb_of_mul_eq_zero {a b : B} (h : a * b = 0) : symb a b = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [symb, dif_pos h]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.perExact_symb
statement:
theorem perExact_symb {a b z : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hz : z = a * b) :
    PerExact (⊥ : Submodule B (Qt z)) ⊤ (mulQ z a) (mulQ z b)
proof:
:=
  perExact_bot_top_iff.2
    ⟨ker_mulQ_eq_range ha hz, ker_mulQ_eq_range hb (hz.trans (mul_comm a b))⟩

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.symb_ne_zero
statement: theorem symb_ne_zero (a b : B) : symb a b ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : a * b = 0
  · rw [symb_of_mul_eq_zero h]; exact one_ne_zero
  · haveI := (finLen h).1
    haveI := (finLen h).2
    rw [symb_eq rfl h]
    exact perDet_ne_zero (perExact_symb (left_ne_zero_of_mul h) (right_ne_zero_of_mul h) rfl)

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.symb_mul_symb_swap
statement: theorem symb_mul_symb_swap {a b : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) : symb a b * symb b a = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hz : a * b ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero ha hb
  haveI := (finLen hz).1
  haveI := (finLen hz).2
  rw [symb_eq rfl hz, symb_eq (mul_comm a b) hz]
  exact perDet_mul_perDet_symm (perExact_symb ha hb rfl)

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.symb_mul_right
statement:
theorem symb_mul_right (a : B) {b c : B} (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    symb a (b * c) = symb a b * symb a c
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : a = 0
  · subst ha; simp [symb_of_mul_eq_zero]
  have hz : a * (b * c) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero ha (mul_ne_zero hb hc)
  have hab : a * b ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero ha hb
  have hac : a * c ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero ha hc
  haveI := (finLen hz).1
  haveI := (finLen hz).2
  haveI := (finLen hab).1
  haveI := (finLen hab).2
  haveI := (finLen hac).1
  haveI := (finLen hac).2
  set z := a * (b * c) with hzdef
  have h1 : LinearMap.range (mulQ z a) = LinearMap.ker (mulQ z b ∘ₗ mulQ z c) := by
    rw [← mulQ_mul]; exact (ker_mulQ_eq_range (mul_ne_zero hb hc) (by rw [hzdef]; ring)).symm
  have h2 : LinearMap.ker (mulQ z a) = LinearMap.range (mulQ z b ∘ₗ mulQ z c) := by
    rw [← mulQ_mul]; exact ker_mulQ_eq_range ha rfl
  have h4 : LinearMap.ker (mulQ z b) = LinearMap.range (mulQ z a ∘ₗ mulQ z c) := by
    rw [← mulQ_mul]; exact ker_mulQ_eq_range hb (by rw [hzdef]; ring)
  have h5 : LinearMap.range (mulQ z c) = LinearMap.ker (mulQ z a ∘ₗ mulQ z b) := by
    rw [← mulQ_mul]; exact (ker_mulQ_eq_range hab (by rw [hzdef]; ring)).symm
  rw [symb_eq rfl hz, mulQ_mul,
    perDet_comp (mulQ_comm _ _ _) (mulQ_comm _ _ _) (mulQ_comm _ _ _) h1 h2 h4 h5]
  congr 1
  · 
    have hdvd : z ∣ c * (a * b) := ⟨1, by rw [hzdef]; ring⟩
    have key := perDet_map (mulMap (a * b) c z hdvd) (comp_mulQ _ a) (comp_mulQ _ b)
      (perExact_symb ha hb rfl) (ker_mulMap hc (by rw [hzdef]; ring))
    rw [Submodule.map_bot, map_top_mulMap] at key
    rw [key, symb_eq rfl hab]
  · 
    have hdvd : a * c ∣ z := ⟨b, by rw [hzdef]; ring⟩
    have memK : ∀ r : B, (Submodule.Quotient.mk r : Qt z) ∈ LinearMap.ker (mulQ z b) ↔
        a * c ∣ r := fun r => by
      rw [mk_mem_ker_mulQ, show z = b * (a * c) by rw [hzdef]; ring, mul_dvd_mul_iff_left hb]
    have hleγ : LinearMap.ker (mulQ z b) ≤ LinearMap.range (mulQ z c) := by
      intro m hm
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ m
      rw [memK] at hm
      rw [mk_mem_range_mulQ ⟨a * b, by rw [hzdef]; ring⟩]
      exact (dvd_mul_left c a).trans hm
    have hleα : LinearMap.ker (mulQ z b) ≤ LinearMap.range (mulQ z a) := by
      intro m hm
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ m
      rw [memK] at hm
      rw [mk_mem_range_mulQ ⟨b * c, rfl⟩]
      exact (dvd_mul_right a c).trans hm
    have hPE : PerExact (LinearMap.ker (mulQ z b)) ⊤ (mulQ z a) (mulQ z c) := by
      refine ⟨le_top, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [top_inf_eq, Submodule.map_top, sup_eq_left.2 hleγ]
        ext m
        obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ m
        rw [Submodule.mem_comap, mulQ_mk, memK, mk_mem_range_mulQ ⟨a * b, by rw [hzdef]; ring⟩,
          mul_dvd_mul_iff_left ha]
      · rw [top_inf_eq, Submodule.map_top, sup_eq_left.2 hleα]
        ext m
        obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ m
        rw [Submodule.mem_comap, mulQ_mk, memK, mk_mem_range_mulQ ⟨b * c, rfl⟩, mul_comm a c,
          mul_dvd_mul_iff_left hc]
    have hg : (⊤ : Submodule B (Qt z)) ⊓ (⊥ : Submodule B (Qt (a * c))).comap
        (projMap z (a * c) hdvd) ≤ LinearMap.ker (mulQ z b) := by
      intro m hm
      obtain ⟨-, hm⟩ := Submodule.mem_inf.1 hm
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ m
      rw [Submodule.mem_comap, projMap_mk, Submodule.mem_bot, mk_eq_zero_iff] at hm
      rw [memK]; exact hm
    have hP : (LinearMap.ker (mulQ z b)).map (projMap z (a * c) hdvd) = ⊥ := by
      rw [eq_bot_iff]
      rintro m ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ n
      rw [SetLike.mem_coe, memK] at hn
      rw [projMap_mk, Submodule.mem_bot, mk_eq_zero_iff]
      exact hn
    have hT : (⊤ : Submodule B (Qt z)).map (projMap z (a * c) hdvd) = ⊤ := by
      rw [eq_top_iff]
      intro m _
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ m
      exact ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk r, trivial, projMap_mk _ _ _ _⟩
    have key := perDet_map (projMap z (a * c) hdvd) (comp_mulQ _ a) (comp_mulQ _ c) hPE hg
    rw [hP, hT] at key
    rw [← key, symb_eq rfl hac]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.symb_swap
statement: theorem symb_swap {a b : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) : symb b a = (symb a b)⁻¹
proof:
:=
  eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right (symb_mul_symb_swap ha hb)

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.symb_mul_left
statement:
theorem symb_mul_left {a a' : B} (b : B) (ha : a ≠ 0) (ha' : a' ≠ 0) :
    symb (a * a') b = symb a b * symb a' b
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hb : b = 0
  · subst hb; simp [symb_of_mul_eq_zero]
  rw [symb_swap hb (mul_ne_zero ha ha'), symb_mul_right b ha ha', mul_inv, ← symb_swap hb ha,
    ← symb_swap hb ha']

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.symb_self
statement:
theorem symb_self {a : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (hn : Ring.ord B a = n) :
    symb a a = (-1) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have hz : a * a ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero ha ha
  haveI := (finLen hz).1
  haveI := (finLen hz).2
  haveI := (finLen ha).1
  haveI := (finLen ha).2
  rw [symb_eq rfl hz]
  obtain ⟨X, hXT, hX⟩ := exists_image_adm (mulQ (a * a) a) ⊤ ⊥
  rw [perDet_self (perExact_symb ha ha rfl) hX hXT]
  obtain ⟨Z, hZ⟩ := exists_adm (M := Qt a) (bot_le : (⊥ : Submodule B (Qt a)) ≤ ⊤)
  have hlen := hZ.moduleLength_eq
  have hZ' := adm_map (mulMap a a (a * a) ⟨1, by ring⟩) ⊥ (ker_mulMap ha rfl) hZ
  rw [Submodule.map_bot, sup_bot_eq, sup_bot_eq, map_top_mulMap] at hZ'
  rw [sup_bot_eq, Submodule.map_top] at hX
  have hl := hX.length_eq hZ'
  rw [List.length_map, List.length_map] at hl
  have : Z.length = n := by
    have h2 : (Z.length : ℕ∞) = n := by rw [← hlen, ← hn]; rfl
    exact_mod_cast h2
  rw [hl, this]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.symb_unit
statement:
theorem symb_unit {u b : B} (hu : IsUnit u) (hb : b ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (hn : Ring.ord B b = n) :
    symb u b = residue B u ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have hz : u * b ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hu.ne_zero hb
  haveI := (finLen hz).1
  haveI := (finLen hz).2
  rw [symb_eq rfl hz]
  have h0 : mulQ (u * b) b = 0 := LinearMap.ext fun m => by
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ m
    rw [mulQ_mk, LinearMap.zero_apply, mk_eq_zero_iff, mul_comm u b]
    exact mul_dvd_mul_left b hu.dvd
  rw [h0]
  obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ := exists_adm (M := Qt (u * b)) (bot_le : (⊥ : Submodule B (Qt (u * b))) ≤ ⊤)
  rw [perDet_unit_zero hu hX]
  have hlen := hX.moduleLength_eq
  have : X.length = n := by
    have h2 : (X.length : ℕ∞) = n := by
      rw [← hlen, ← hn, ← Ring.ord_mul_of_isUnit_left hu b]; rfl
    exact_mod_cast h2
  rw [this]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.coe_dB
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_dB (a b : B) : (dB a b : ResidueField B) = symb a b
proof: := rfl

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dB_mul_right
statement:
theorem dB_mul_right (a : B) {b c : B} (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    dB a (b * c) = dB a b * dB a c
proof:
:=
  Units.ext (by simp [symb_mul_right a hb hc])

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dB_mul_left
statement:
theorem dB_mul_left {a a' : B} (b : B) (ha : a ≠ 0) (ha' : a' ≠ 0) :
    dB (a * a') b = dB a b * dB a' b
proof:
:=
  Units.ext (by simp [symb_mul_left b ha ha'])

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dB_mul_dB_swap
statement: theorem dB_mul_dB_swap {a b : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) : dB a b * dB b a = 1
proof:
:=
  Units.ext (by simp [symb_mul_symb_swap ha hb])

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dB_swap
statement: theorem dB_swap {a b : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) : dB b a = (dB a b)⁻¹
proof:
:=
  eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right (dB_mul_dB_swap ha hb)

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dB_self
statement: theorem dB_self {a : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (hn : Ring.ord B a = n) : dB a a = (-1) ^ n
proof:
:=
  Units.ext (by simp [symb_self ha hn])

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dB_unit
statement:
theorem dB_unit (u : Bˣ) {b : B} (hb : b ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (hn : Ring.ord B b = n) :
    dB (u : B) b = Units.map (residue B : B →* ResidueField B) u ^ n
proof:
:=
  Units.ext (by simp [symb_unit u.isUnit hb hn])

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dB_pow_right
statement: theorem dB_pow_right (a : B) {b : B} (hb : b ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) : dB a (b ^ n) = dB a b ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rw [pow_zero, pow_zero]
    have h := dB_mul_right a (one_ne_zero (α := B)) (one_ne_zero (α := B))
    rw [one_mul] at h
    exact left_eq_mul.1 h |>.symm ▸ rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ, dB_mul_right a (pow_ne_zero n hb) hb, ih, pow_succ]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dB_pow_left
statement: theorem dB_pow_left {a : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) (b : B) (n : ℕ) : dB (a ^ n) b = dB a b ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rw [pow_zero, pow_zero]
    have h := dB_mul_left b (one_ne_zero (α := B)) (one_ne_zero (α := B))
    rw [one_mul] at h
    exact left_eq_mul.1 h |>.symm ▸ rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ, dB_mul_left b (pow_ne_zero n ha) ha, ih, pow_succ]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.coe_unitOf
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_unitOf (a : B) (ha : a ≠ 0) : (unitOf K a ha : K) = algebraMap B K a
proof: := rfl

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.unitOf_mul
statement:
theorem unitOf_mul {a b : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    unitOf K (a * b) (mul_ne_zero ha hb) = unitOf K a ha * unitOf K b hb
proof:
:=
  Units.ext (by simp)

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.unitOf_inj
statement:
theorem unitOf_inj {a b : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (h : unitOf K a ha = unitOf K b hb) :
    a = b
proof:
:=
  IsFractionRing.injective B K (congrArg Units.val h)

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.exists_eq_div
statement:
theorem exists_eq_div (x : Kˣ) :
    ∃ (a c : B) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0), x = unitOf K a ha * (unitOf K c hc)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, c, hc, hx⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective (A := B) (x : K)
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hc
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [map_zero, zero_div] at hx
    exact x.ne_zero hx.symm
  refine ⟨a, c, ha0, hc0, Units.ext ?_⟩
  rw [Units.val_mul, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val, coe_unitOf, coe_unitOf, ← div_eq_mul_inv, hx]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.extK_aux
statement:
theorem extK_aux {f : B → G} (hf : ∀ x y : B, x ≠ 0 → y ≠ 0 → f (x * y) = f x * f y)
    {x : Kˣ} {a0 c0 a c : B} (ha0 : a0 ≠ 0) (hc0 : c0 ≠ 0) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h0 : x = unitOf K a0 ha0 * (unitOf K c0 hc0)⁻¹) (h : x = unitOf K a ha * (unitOf K c hc)⁻¹) :
    f a0 / f c0 = f a / f c
proof:
:= by
  have e : unitOf K a0 ha0 * unitOf K c hc = unitOf K a ha * unitOf K c0 hc0 := by
    have := h0.symm.trans h
    rwa [← div_eq_mul_inv, ← div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_div_iff_mul_eq_mul] at this
  rw [← unitOf_mul, ← unitOf_mul] at e
  have e' := unitOf_inj _ _ e
  rw [div_eq_div_iff_mul_eq_mul, ← hf _ _ ha0 hc, ← hf _ _ ha hc0, e']

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.extK_eq
statement:
theorem extK_eq {f : B → G} (hf : ∀ x y : B, x ≠ 0 → y ≠ 0 → f (x * y) = f x * f y)
    {x : Kˣ} {a c : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) (h : x = unitOf K a ha * (unitOf K c hc)⁻¹) :
    extK K f x = f a / f c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ha0, hc0, h0⟩ := (exists_eq_div (B := B) (K := K) x).choose_spec.choose_spec
  exact extK_aux hf ha0 hc0 ha hc h0 h

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.map_one_of_mul
statement:
theorem map_one_of_mul {f : B → G} (hf : ∀ x y : B, x ≠ 0 → y ≠ 0 → f (x * y) = f x * f y) :
    f 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := hf 1 1 one_ne_zero one_ne_zero
  rw [one_mul] at h
  exact (left_eq_mul.1 h)

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.extKHom_eq
statement:
theorem extKHom_eq {f : B → G} (hf : ∀ x y : B, x ≠ 0 → y ≠ 0 → f (x * y) = f x * f y)
    {x : Kˣ} {a c : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) (h : x = unitOf K a ha * (unitOf K c hc)⁻¹) :
    extKHom K f hf x = f a / f c
proof:
:=
  extK_eq hf ha hc h

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.extKHom_unitOf
statement:
theorem extKHom_unitOf {f : B → G} (hf : ∀ x y : B, x ≠ 0 → y ≠ 0 → f (x * y) = f x * f y)
    {a : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) : extKHom K f hf (unitOf K a ha) = f a
proof:
:= by
  have h : unitOf K a ha = unitOf K a ha * (unitOf K (1 : B) one_ne_zero)⁻¹ := by
    rw [show unitOf K (1 : B) one_ne_zero = 1 from Units.ext (by simp), inv_one, mul_one]
  rw [extKHom_eq hf ha one_ne_zero h, map_one_of_mul hf, div_one]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.pairing_ext
proof:
:= by
  ext x y
  obtain ⟨a, c, ha, hc, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_div (B := B) (K := K) x
  obtain ⟨b, d, hb, hd, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_div (B := B) (K := K) y
  simp only [map_mul, map_inv, MonoidHom.mul_apply, MonoidHom.inv_apply]
  rw [h a b ha hb, h a d ha hd, h c b hc hb, h c d hc hd]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dBHom_mul
statement:
theorem dBHom_mul {a a' : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) (ha' : a' ≠ 0) :
    (dBHom (K := K) (a * a')) = dBHom a * dBHom a'
proof:
:= by
  ext1 y
  obtain ⟨b, d, hb, hd, hy⟩ := exists_eq_div (B := B) (K := K) y
  simp only [dBHom, MonoidHom.mul_apply]
  rw [extKHom_eq _ hb hd hy, extKHom_eq _ hb hd hy, extKHom_eq _ hb hd hy,
    dB_mul_left b ha ha', dB_mul_left d ha ha', mul_div_mul_comm]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dK_unitOf
statement:
theorem dK_unitOf {a b : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    dK B K (unitOf K a ha) (unitOf K b hb) = dB a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [dK, extKHom_unitOf, dBHom, extKHom_unitOf]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dK_mul_dK_swap
statement: theorem dK_mul_dK_swap (x y : Kˣ) : dK B K x y * dK B K y x = 1
proof:
:= by
  have : dK B K * (dK B K).flip = (1 : Kˣ →* Kˣ →* (ResidueField B)ˣ) := by
    refine pairing_ext B fun a b ha hb => ?_
    rw [MonoidHom.mul_apply, MonoidHom.mul_apply, MonoidHom.flip_apply, dK_unitOf, dK_unitOf,
      MonoidHom.one_apply, MonoidHom.one_apply, dB_mul_dB_swap ha hb]
  have := congrArg (fun F => F x y) this
  simpa using this

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dK_swap
statement: theorem dK_swap (x y : Kˣ) : dK B K y x = (dK B K x y)⁻¹
proof:
:=
  eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right (dK_mul_dK_swap x y)

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.ordZ_unitOf
statement:
theorem ordZ_unitOf {a : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    ordZ B K (unitOf K a ha) = Multiplicative.ofAdd ((Ring.ord B a).toNat : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ordZ, extKHom_unitOf]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dB_self'
statement: theorem dB_self' {a : B} (ha : a ≠ 0) : dB a a = (-1) ^ (Ring.ord B a).toNat
proof:
:=
  dB_self ha (ENat.coe_toNat (Ring.ord_ne_top (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero ha))).symm

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dK_self_mul
statement: theorem dK_self_mul (x y : Kˣ) : dK B K (x * y) (x * y) = dK B K x x * dK B K y y
proof:
:= by
  have h := dK_mul_dK_swap (B := B) x y
  simp only [map_mul, MonoidHom.mul_apply]
  rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc (dK B K y x), mul_comm (dK B K y x), h, one_mul]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dK_self_inv
statement: theorem dK_self_inv (x : Kˣ) : dK B K x⁻¹ x⁻¹ = dK B K x x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [map_inv, MonoidHom.inv_apply, inv_inv]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.neg_one_pow_inv
statement:
theorem neg_one_pow_inv {G : Type*} [Group G] [HasDistribNeg G] (k : ℕ) :
    ((-1 : G) ^ k)⁻¹ = (-1) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [← inv_pow, inv_neg_one]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dK_self
statement: theorem dK_self (x : Kˣ) : dK B K x x = (-1) ^ (Multiplicative.toAdd (ordZ B K x))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, c, ha, hc, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_div (B := B) (K := K) x
  rw [dK_self_mul, dK_self_inv, dK_unitOf, dK_unitOf, map_mul, map_inv, ordZ_unitOf, ordZ_unitOf,
    toAdd_mul, toAdd_inv, toAdd_ofAdd, toAdd_ofAdd, zpow_add, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast,
    zpow_natCast, dB_self' ha, dB_self' hc, neg_one_pow_inv]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.units_map_residue_neg_one
statement:
theorem units_map_residue_neg_one :
    Units.map (residue R : R →* ResidueField R) (-1) = -1
proof:
:=
  Units.ext (by simp)

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.unitOf_eq_smul
statement:
theorem unitOf_eq_smul (u : Rˣ) (k : ℕ) :
    (unitOf K ((u : R) * unif R ^ k) (mul_ne_zero u.ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _
      (irreducible_unif R).ne_zero)) : K) = u • algebraMap R K (unif R) ^ (k : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_unitOf, Units.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def, zpow_natCast, map_mul, map_pow]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dB_eq_tame
statement:
theorem dB_eq_tame {a b : R} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    dB a b = tame R (unitOf K a ha) (unitOf K b hb)
proof:
:= by
  have hϖ := irreducible_unif R
  have hϖ0 : unif R ≠ 0 := hϖ.ne_zero
  have hϖ1 : Ring.ord R (unif R) = ((1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [Ring.ord_of_irreducible hϖ]; rfl
  obtain ⟨k, u, hk⟩ := eq_unit_mul_pow_irreducible ha hϖ
  obtain ⟨l, v, hl⟩ := eq_unit_mul_pow_irreducible hb hϖ
  subst hk hl
  have hv0 : Ring.ord R (v : R) = ((0 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [Ring.ord_of_isUnit v.isUnit]; rfl
  obtain ⟨hka, hua⟩ := ord_unitPart_eq (unitOf_eq_smul (K := K) u k)
  obtain ⟨hkb, hub⟩ := ord_unitPart_eq (unitOf_eq_smul (K := K) v l)
  rw [tame, tameUnit, hka, hkb, hua, hub, map_mul, map_mul, map_inv, map_zpow, map_zpow, map_zpow,
    units_map_residue_neg_one, ← Nat.cast_mul, zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast,
    dB_mul_left _ u.ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hϖ0), dB_mul_right _ v.ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hϖ0),
    dB_mul_right _ v.ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hϖ0), dB_pow_right _ hϖ0, dB_pow_right _ hϖ0,
    dB_pow_left hϖ0, dB_pow_left hϖ0, dB_unit u v.ne_zero hv0, dB_unit u hϖ0 hϖ1,
    dB_swap v.ne_zero hϖ0, dB_unit v hϖ0 hϖ1, dB_self hϖ0 hϖ1]
  simp only [pow_zero, pow_one, one_mul, inv_pow, ← pow_mul]
  rw [mul_assoc ((-1) ^ (k * l)), mul_comm ((-1 : (ResidueField R)ˣ) ^ (k * l)), mul_assoc]

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dK_eq_tameHom
statement: theorem dK_eq_tameHom : dK R K = tameHom R K
proof:
:=
  pairing_ext R (K := K) fun a b ha hb => by rw [dK_unitOf, dB_eq_tame (K := K) ha hb]; rfl

name: RiemannRoch.SingularTodd.TameSymbolT2.dK_eq_tame
statement: theorem dK_eq_tame (x y : Kˣ) : dK R K x y = tame R x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [dK_eq_tameHom]; rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.ideal_graphIdeal
statement:
theorem ideal_graphIdeal (t u : Γ(V, ⊤)) (U : V.affineOpens) :
    (graphIdeal t u).ideal U = Ideal.span {resTop U t, resTop U u}
proof:
:= by
  rw [graphIdeal, Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop_ideal, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_pair]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.resTop_left_mem
statement:
theorem resTop_left_mem (t u : Γ(V, ⊤)) (U : V.affineOpens) :
    resTop U t ∈ (graphIdeal t u).ideal U
proof:
:= by
  rw [ideal_graphIdeal]
  exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_insert _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.resTop_right_mem
statement:
theorem resTop_right_mem (t u : Γ(V, ⊤)) (U : V.affineOpens) :
    resTop U u ∈ (graphIdeal t u).ideal U
proof:
:= by
  rw [ideal_graphIdeal]
  exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.coe_support_graphIdeal
statement:
theorem coe_support_graphIdeal (t u : Γ(V, ⊤)) :
    ((graphIdeal t u).support : Set V) = V.zeroLocus (U := ⊤) (Ideal.span {t, u} : Set Γ(V, ⊤))
proof:
:=
  Scheme.IdealSheafData.coe_support_ofIdealTop _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.exists_affineOpens_mem
statement: theorem exists_affineOpens_mem (x : V) : ∃ U : V.affineOpens, x ∈ U.1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hx, -⟩ := exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (U := ⊤) (x := x) trivial
  exact ⟨⟨W, hW⟩, hx⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.graphIdeal_ne_bot
statement:
theorem graphIdeal_ne_bot [IsIntegral V] (t u : Γ(V, ⊤)) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    graphIdeal t u ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨U, hx⟩ := exists_affineOpens_mem (Classical.arbitrary V)
  haveI : Nonempty U.1 := ⟨⟨_, hx⟩⟩
  have hmem := resTop_left_mem t u U
  rw [h] at hmem
  change resTop U t ∈ (⊥ : Ideal Γ(V, U.1)) at hmem
  rw [Ideal.mem_bot] at hmem
  apply ht
  apply map_injective_of_isIntegral V (homOfLE (le_top : U.1 ≤ ⊤))
  rw [hmem, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.isIntegral_graphClosure
statement:
theorem isIntegral_graphClosure [IsIntegral V] (t u : Γ(V, ⊤)) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    IsIntegral (graphClosure t u)
proof:
:=
  GlobalBlowup.isIntegral_blowup V _ (graphIdeal_ne_bot t u ht)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.graphClosure_over_hom
statement:
theorem graphClosure_over_hom [V.Over (Spk k)] (t u : Γ(V, ⊤)) :
    graphClosure t u ↘ Spk k = graphπ t u ≫ V ↘ Spk k
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.projectiveIntegralK_graphClosure
statement:
theorem projectiveIntegralK_graphClosure [IsNoetherianRing k] [V.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (V ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian V] (hV : ProjectiveIntegralK k V)
    (t u : Γ(V, ⊤)) (ht : t ≠ 0) : ProjectiveIntegralK k (graphClosure t u)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIntegral V := hV.1
  exact CIIB5.projectiveIntegralK_blowup hV (graphIdeal t u) (graphIdeal_ne_bot t u ht)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.isIso_graphπ_restrict
statement:
theorem isIso_graphπ_restrict :
    IsIso (graphπ t u ∣_ GlobalBlowup.centreComplement V (graphIdeal t u))
proof:
:=
  GlobalBlowup.toBase_restrict_isIso V _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.isIso_stalkMap_of_isIso_restrict
statement:
theorem isIso_stalkMap_of_isIso_restrict {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (O : Y.Opens)
    (hO : IsIso (f ∣_ O)) (x : X) (hx : f x ∈ O) : IsIso (f.stalkMap x)
proof:
:= by
  have e := morphismRestrictStalkMap f O ⟨x, hx⟩
  have h1 : MorphismProperty.isomorphisms CommRingCat ((f ∣_ O).stalkMap ⟨x, hx⟩) :=
    (MorphismProperty.isomorphisms.iff _).mpr inferInstance
  exact (MorphismProperty.arrow_mk_iso_iff (MorphismProperty.isomorphisms CommRingCat) e).mp h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.degree_eq_one_of_isIso_stalkMap
statement:
theorem degree_eq_one_of_isIso_stalkMap {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : X)
    [IsIso (f.stalkMap x)] : f.degree x = 1
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↑(Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)))
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↑(X.presheaf.stalk x)) :=
    RingHom.toAlgebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (f.stalkMap x).hom)
  apply Algebra.finrank_eq_one_iff_bijective_algebraMap.mpr
  let e : Y.presheaf.stalk (f x) ≃+* X.presheaf.stalk x :=
    (asIso (f.stalkMap x)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  have he : (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (f.stalkMap x).hom) =
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.mapEquiv e : _ →+* _) := rfl
  change Function.Bijective (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (f.stalkMap x).hom)
  rw [he]
  exact (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.mapEquiv e).bijective

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.genericPoint_mem_centreComplement
statement:
theorem genericPoint_mem_centreComplement (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    genericPoint V ∈ GlobalBlowup.centreComplement V (graphIdeal t u)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := GlobalBlowup.centreComplement_nonempty V _ (graphIdeal_ne_bot t u ht)
  exact ((genericPoint_specializes x).mem_open
    (GlobalBlowup.centreComplement V (graphIdeal t u)).isOpen hx)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.graphπ_genericPoint
statement:
theorem graphπ_genericPoint (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    haveI
proof:
:= isIntegral_graphClosure t u ht
    graphπ t u (genericPoint (graphClosure t u)) = genericPoint V := by
  haveI := isIntegral_graphClosure t u ht
  set O := GlobalBlowup.centreComplement V (graphIdeal t u)
  haveI := isIso_graphπ_restrict t u
  
  let y : (graphπ t u ⁻¹ᵁ O).toScheme :=
    inv (graphπ t u ∣_ O) ⟨genericPoint V, genericPoint_mem_centreComplement t u ht⟩
  have hy : graphπ t u y.1 = genericPoint V := by
    have h1 : (graphπ t u ∣_ O) y = ⟨genericPoint V, genericPoint_mem_centreComplement t u ht⟩ := by
      change (inv (graphπ t u ∣_ O) ≫ (graphπ t u ∣_ O)) _ = _
      rw [IsIso.inv_hom_id]
      rfl
    exact (morphismRestrict_base_coe (graphπ t u) O y).symm.trans (congrArg Subtype.val h1)
  have hs : graphπ t u (genericPoint (graphClosure t u)) ⤳ genericPoint V := by
    rw [← hy]
    exact (genericPoint_specializes y.1).map (graphπ t u).continuous
  exact (hs.antisymm (genericPoint_specializes _)).eq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.degree_graphπ_genericPoint
statement:
theorem degree_graphπ_genericPoint (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    haveI
proof:
:= isIntegral_graphClosure t u ht
    (graphπ t u).degree (genericPoint (graphClosure t u)) = 1 := by
  haveI := isIntegral_graphClosure t u ht
  have hx : graphπ t u (genericPoint (graphClosure t u)) ∈
      GlobalBlowup.centreComplement V (graphIdeal t u) := by
    rw [graphπ_genericPoint t u ht]
    exact genericPoint_mem_centreComplement t u ht
  haveI := isIso_stalkMap_of_isIso_restrict (graphπ t u) _ (isIso_graphπ_restrict t u) _ hx
  exact degree_eq_one_of_isIso_stalkMap _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.appTop_graphπ_ne_zero
statement:
theorem appTop_graphπ_ne_zero (ht : t ≠ 0) {s : Γ(V, ⊤)} (hs : s ≠ 0) :
    (graphπ t u).appTop s ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isIntegral_graphClosure t u ht
  have hx : graphπ t u (genericPoint (graphClosure t u)) ∈
      GlobalBlowup.centreComplement V (graphIdeal t u) := by
    rw [graphπ_genericPoint t u ht]
    exact genericPoint_mem_centreComplement t u ht
  haveI := isIso_stalkMap_of_isIso_restrict (graphπ t u) _ (isIso_graphπ_restrict t u) _ hx
  intro h0
  apply hs
  have h1 := (graphπ t u).germ_stalkMap_apply ⊤ (genericPoint (graphClosure t u)) trivial s
  have h1' : (graphπ t u).stalkMap (genericPoint (graphClosure t u))
      (V.presheaf.germ ⊤ _ trivial s) = 0 := by
    rw [h1]
    change (graphClosure t u).presheaf.germ _ _ _ ((graphπ t u).appTop s) = 0
    rw [h0, map_zero]
  have h2 : V.presheaf.germ ⊤ (graphπ t u (genericPoint (graphClosure t u))) trivial s = 0 :=
    (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).mp
      (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
        ((graphπ t u).stalkMap (genericPoint (graphClosure t u)))).1 _ h1'
  exact (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).mp (germ_injective_of_isIntegral V (U := ⊤) _ trivial) _ h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.GraphClosure.res_appTop_graphπ_ne_zero
statement:
theorem res_appTop_graphπ_ne_zero (ht : t ≠ 0) {s : Γ(V, ⊤)} (hs : s ≠ 0)
    (W : (graphClosure t u).Opens) [Nonempty W] :
    (graphClosure t u).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op ((graphπ t u).appTop s) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isIntegral_graphClosure t u ht
  intro h0
  apply appTop_graphπ_ne_zero t u ht hs
  apply map_injective_of_isIntegral (graphClosure t u) (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤))
  rw [h0, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2TEXC.length_self_eq_top_of_ringKrullDim_eq_one
statement:
theorem length_self_eq_top_of_ringKrullDim_eq_one {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (h : ringKrullDim R = 1) : Module.length R R = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  have hfl := Module.length_ne_top_iff.mp hne
  haveI : IsArtinianRing R := (isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp hfl).2
  have h0 : ringKrullDim R ≤ 0 := Ring.krullDimLE_iff.mp inferInstance
  rw [h] at h0
  exact absurd h0 (by decide)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2TEXC.stalkSpecializes_germEqs
statement:
theorem stalkSpecializes_germEqs (t : Γ(X, ⊤)) {x y : X} (h : x ⤳ y) :
    (X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom (germEqs t y) = germEqs t x
proof:
:= by
  unfold germEqs
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2TEXC.not_isUnit_germEqs_of_specializes
statement:
theorem not_isUnit_germEqs_of_specializes (t : Γ(X, ⊤)) {x y : X} (h : x ⤳ y)
    (hx : ¬ IsUnit (germEqs t x)) : ¬ IsUnit (germEqs t y)
proof:
:= by
  intro hy
  apply hx
  rw [← stalkSpecializes_germEqs t h]
  exact hy.map _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2TEXC.c1CapPrimeCoeff_germEqs_of_not_isUnit
proof:
:= by
  unfold C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff
  split_ifs with h hd
  · have hmem : germEqs t y ∈ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h := by
      unfold Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes
      rw [Ideal.mem_comap, stalkSpecializes_germEqs t h, IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal,
        mem_nonunits_iff]
      exact hv
    unfold CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hmem, Ring.ord_zero,
      length_self_eq_top_of_ringKrullDim_eq_one hd]
    rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2TEXC.germEqs_appTop
statement:
theorem germEqs_appTop {Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : Z ⟶ X) (t : Γ(X, ⊤)) :
    germEqs (j.appTop t) = (germEqs t).pullback j
proof:
:= by
  funext z
  unfold germEqs C1Cap.LocalEquations.pullback
  rw [Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2TEXC.isUnit_germEqs_appTop_iff
statement:
theorem isUnit_germEqs_appTop_iff {Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : Z ⟶ X) (t : Γ(X, ⊤)) (z : Z) :
    IsUnit (germEqs (j.appTop t) z) ↔ IsUnit (germEqs t (j z))
proof:
:= by
  rw [germEqs_appTop]
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ (isUnit_map_iff (j.stalkMap z).hom _).mp h, fun h ↦ h.map _⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2TEXC.c1CapPrimeCoeff_appTop
statement:
theorem c1CapPrimeCoeff_appTop {Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    (t : Γ(X, ⊤)) (x z : Z) :
    C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs (j.appTop t)) x z =
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) (j x) (j z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [germEqs_appTop, D18.c1CapPrimeCoeff_image]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2TEXC.c1CapCyclesCoeff_dimPrimeCycle
statement:
theorem c1CapCyclesCoeff_dimPrimeCycle (a : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) {m : ℕ} (v : X)
    (hv : height v = m) (y : X) :
    C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff a (dimPrimeCycle v m hv).1 y = C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a v y
proof:
:= by
  unfold C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff
  rw [finsum_eq_single _ v]
  · rw [m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply, if_pos rfl, one_mul]
  · intro w hw
    rw [m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply, if_neg hw, zero_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2TEXC.pullback_germEqs_ne_zero
statement:
theorem pullback_germEqs_ne_zero (t : Γ(X, ⊤)) (v : X) (hu : IsUnit (germEqs t v))
    (z : pointClosureScheme v) : (germEqs t).pullback (pointClosureι v) z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  apply restrictFn_ne_zero t v hu
  rw [← algebraMap_stalkMap_germEqs t v z]
  change algebraMap _ _ ((germEqs t).pullback (pointClosureι v) z) = 0
  rw [h0, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2TEXC.pullback_germEqs_assoc
statement:
theorem pullback_germEqs_assoc (t : Γ(X, ⊤)) (v : X) {x y : pointClosureScheme v}
    (h : x ⤳ y) :
    Associated (((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom
      ((germEqs t).pullback (pointClosureι v) y)) ((germEqs t).pullback (pointClosureι v) x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← germEqs_appTop, stalkSpecializes_germEqs]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2TEXC.meetsProperly_of_jointProper
statement:
theorem meetsProperly_of_jointProper (t u : Γ(X, ⊤)) (v : X) (ht : IsUnit (germEqs t v))
    (hu : IsUnit (germEqs u v)) (hj : JointProper v t u) :
    D18.MeetsProperly v (germEqs t) (germEqs u) where
  ne_a
proof:
:= pullback_germEqs_ne_zero t v ht
  ne_b := pullback_germEqs_ne_zero u v hu
  assoc_a := fun _ _ h ↦ pullback_germEqs_assoc t v h
  assoc_b := fun _ _ h ↦ pullback_germEqs_assoc u v h
  joint := hj

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2TEXC.divCycPrime_apply
statement:
theorem divCycPrime_apply (n : ℕ) (w : X) (hw : height w = n + 1) (z : Z) :
    (divCycPrime (k := k) t ι n w).1 z = C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) w (ι z)
proof:
:= by
  unfold divCycPrime
  by_cases hu : IsUnit (germEqs t w)
  · rw [dif_pos ⟨hw, hu⟩, restrictHom_apply, transGen_cycle_apply]
  · rw [dif_neg (fun h ↦ hu h.2), c1CapPrimeCoeff_germEqs_of_not_isUnit t hu]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2TEXC.divCyc_dimPrimeCycle
statement:
theorem divCyc_dimPrimeCycle (n : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = n + 1) :
    divCyc (k := k) t ι n (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv) = divCycPrime (k := k) t ι n v
proof:
:= by
  have hsingle : compactCycleFinsupp (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv).1 = Finsupp.single v 1 := by
    ext x
    rw [compactCycleFinsupp_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply]
    by_cases hx : x = v
    · simp [hx]
    · rw [if_neg hx, if_neg (Ne.symm hx)]
  show (compactCycleFinsupp (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv).1).sum
    (fun w m ↦ m • divCycPrime (k := k) t ι n w) = _
  rw [hsingle, Finsupp.sum_single_index (zero_zsmul _), one_zsmul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2TEXC.mk_divCycPrime
statement:
theorem mk_divCycPrime (n : ℕ) (w : X) :
    (QuotientAddGroup.mk (divCycPrime (k := k) t ι n w) : DimChow Z n) =
      divIntPrime (k := k) t ι n w
proof:
:= by
  unfold divCycPrime divIntPrime
  split_ifs
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2TEXC.divIntCycles_eq_mk_divCyc
statement:
theorem divIntCycles_eq_mk_divCyc (n : ℕ) (D : dimensionCycles X (n + 1)) :
