    divIntCycles (k := k) t ι n D = QuotientAddGroup.mk (divCyc (k := k) t ι n D)
proof:
:= by
  change (compactCycleFinsupp D.1).sum (fun v m ↦ m • divIntPrime (k := k) t ι n v) =
    QuotientAddGroup.mk ((compactCycleFinsupp D.1).sum fun v m ↦ m • divCycPrime (k := k) t ι n v)
  have := map_finsuppSum (QuotientAddGroup.mk' (dimRationalEquivalence Z n))
    (compactCycleFinsupp D.1) (fun v m ↦ m • divCycPrime (k := k) t ι n v)
  simp only [map_zsmul, QuotientAddGroup.mk'_apply] at this
  rw [this]
  exact Finsupp.sum_congr fun v _ ↦ by rw [← mk_divCycPrime]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2TEXC.divCyc_apply
statement:
theorem divCyc_apply (n : ℕ) (D : dimensionCycles X (n + 1)) (z : Z) :
    (divCyc (k := k) t ι n D).1 z = C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (germEqs t) D.1 (ι z)
proof:
:= by
  set fs := compactCycleFinsupp D.1 with hfs
  have hsupp : ∀ v, v ∈ fs.support ↔ D.1 v ≠ 0 := fun v ↦ by
    rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, hfs, compactCycleFinsupp_apply]
  change D6.evalHomD Z n z (fs.sum fun w m ↦ m • divCycPrime (k := k) t ι n w) = _
  rw [map_finsuppSum]
  simp only [map_zsmul, smul_eq_mul]
  change ∑ w ∈ fs.support, fs w * (divCycPrime (k := k) t ι n w).1 z = _
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun w hw ↦ by
    rw [divCycPrime_apply (k := k) t ι n w (D.2 ((hsupp w).mp hw)) z]]
  unfold C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff
  have hsub : Function.support
      (fun v ↦ D.1 v * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) v (ι z)) ⊆ ↑fs.support := by
    intro v hv
    rw [Finset.mem_coe, hsupp]
    exact left_ne_zero_of_mul hv
  rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ hsub]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun v _ ↦ ?_
  rw [hfs, compactCycleFinsupp_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2TEXC.divCyc_divCyc_apply
statement:
theorem divCyc_divCyc_apply (hZu : ∀ x, ¬ IsUnit (germEqs u x) → x ∈ Set.range ιu) (n : ℕ)
    (α : dimensionCycles X (n + 1 + 1)) (y : W) :
    (divCyc (k := k) (ιu.appTop t) ju n (divCyc (k := k) u ιu (n + 1) α)).1 y =
      C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (germEqs t) (C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (germEqs u) α.1) (ιu (ju y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [divCyc_apply]
  unfold C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff
  simp_rw [divCyc_apply, c1CapPrimeCoeff_appTop]
  unfold C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff
  refine (D18.finsum_reindex_range ιu ιu.isEmbedding.injective
    (fun x ↦ (∑ᶠ v, α.1 v * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs u) v x) *
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) x (ιu (ju y))) ?_).symm
  intro x hx
  apply hZu x
  intro hux
  apply hx
  have h0 : ∀ v, α.1 v * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs u) v x = 0 := fun v ↦ by
    rw [c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_isUnit _ v x hux, mul_zero]
  simp only [h0, finsum_zero, zero_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2TEXC.coeff_comm_prime
statement:
theorem coeff_comm_prime (n : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = n + 1 + 1)
    (hadm : CommAdmissible t u v) (y : X) :
    ∑ᶠ w : X, C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs u) v w * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) w y =
      ∑ᶠ w : X, C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs t) v w * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs u) w y
proof:
:= by
  
  have hex : ∀ a b : Γ(X, ⊤), ¬ IsUnit (germEqs a v) → ∀ w,
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs a) v w * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs b) w y = 0 ∧
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs b) v w * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs a) w y = 0 := by
    intro a b ha w
    refine ⟨by rw [c1CapPrimeCoeff_germEqs_of_not_isUnit a ha, zero_mul], ?_⟩
    by_cases hs : v ⤳ w
    · rw [c1CapPrimeCoeff_germEqs_of_not_isUnit a (not_isUnit_germEqs_of_specializes a hs ha),
        mul_zero]
    · rw [C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_not_specializes _ hs, zero_mul]
  rcases hadm with ht | hu | hj
  · simp only [fun w ↦ (hex t u ht w).1, fun w ↦ (hex t u ht w).2, finsum_zero]
  · simp only [fun w ↦ (hex u t hu w).1, fun w ↦ (hex u t hu w).2, finsum_zero]
  · by_cases ht : IsUnit (germEqs t v)
    · by_cases hu : IsUnit (germEqs u v)
      · exact D18.coeff_symm_X (k := k) n v hv (germEqs t) (germEqs u)
          (meetsProperly_of_jointProper t u v ht hu hj) y
      · simp only [fun w ↦ (hex u t hu w).1, fun w ↦ (hex u t hu w).2, finsum_zero]
    · simp only [fun w ↦ (hex t u ht w).1, fun w ↦ (hex t u ht w).2, finsum_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2TEXC.dimCycle_mem_of_prime_on
statement:
theorem dimCycle_mem_of_prime_on {V : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace V] {m : ℕ}
    (S : AddSubgroup (dimensionCycles V m)) (P : V → Prop)
    (hprime : ∀ (v : V) (hv : height v = m), P v → dimPrimeCycle v m hv ∈ S)
    (D : dimensionCycles V m) (hD : ∀ v, D.1 v ≠ 0 → P v) : D ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  have hfin : (D.1.support).Finite := by
    simpa using D.1.locallyFiniteSupport.finite_inter_support_of_isCompact
      (isCompact_univ (X := V))
  suffices h : ∀ s : Finset V, ∀ D : dimensionCycles V m, (∀ v, D.1 v ≠ 0 → P v) →
      D.1.support ⊆ s → D ∈ S from h hfin.toFinset D hD (by simp)
  intro s
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    intro D _ hDs
    have hD0 : D = 0 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      ext y
      by_contra hy
      exact absurd (hDs hy) (by simp)
    rw [hD0]
    exact S.zero_mem
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    intro D hP hDs
    by_cases hDa : D.1 a = 0
    · refine ih D hP ?_
      intro y hy
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp (hDs hy) with rfl | h
      · exact absurd hDa hy
      · exact h
    · have hah : height a = m := D.2 hDa
      set Q := dimPrimeCycle a m hah with hQ
      set R : dimensionCycles V m := D - D.1 a • Q with hR
      have hRval : ∀ y, R.1 y = D.1 y - D.1 a * (if y = a then 1 else 0) := by
        intro y
        change D.1 y - D.1 a * Q.1 y = _
        rw [hQ, m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply]
      have hDR : D = R + D.1 a • Q := by rw [hR]; abel
      rw [hDR]
      refine S.add_mem ?_ (S.zsmul_mem (hprime a hah (hP a hDa)) _)
      refine ih R ?_ ?_
      · intro y hy
        rw [hRval] at hy
        by_cases hya : y = a
        · subst hya
          simp at hy
        · rw [if_neg hya, mul_zero, sub_zero] at hy
          exact hP y hy
      · intro y hy
        rw [Function.mem_support, hRval] at hy
        by_cases hya : y = a
        · subst hya
          simp at hy
        · rw [if_neg hya, mul_zero, sub_zero] at hy
          rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp (hDs hy) with h | h
          · exact absurd h hya
          · exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2TEXC.divCyc_comm
statement:
theorem divCyc_comm (hW : jt ≫ ιt = ju ≫ ιu)
    (hZt : ∀ x, ¬ IsUnit (germEqs t x) → x ∈ Set.range ιt)
    (hZu : ∀ x, ¬ IsUnit (germEqs u x) → x ∈ Set.range ιu) (n : ℕ)
    (α : dimensionCycles X (n + 1 + 1)) (hα : ∀ v, α.1 v ≠ 0 → CommAdmissible t u v) :
    divCyc (k := k) (ιu.appTop t) ju n (divCyc (k := k) u ιu (n + 1) α) =
      divCyc (k := k) (ιt.appTop u) jt n (divCyc (k := k) t ιt (n + 1) α)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext y
  have hy : ιt (jt y) = ιu (ju y) := by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hW, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  change (divCyc (k := k) (ιu.appTop t) ju n (divCyc (k := k) u ιu (n + 1) α)).1 y =
    (divCyc (k := k) (ιt.appTop u) jt n (divCyc (k := k) t ιt (n + 1) α)).1 y
  rw [divCyc_divCyc_apply (k := k) t u ιu ju hZu, divCyc_divCyc_apply (k := k) u t ιt jt hZt, hy]
  
  let F : dimensionCycles X (n + 1 + 1) →+ ℤ :=
    (D6.evalHomD W n y).comp ((divCyc (k := k) (ιu.appTop t) ju n).comp
      (divCyc (k := k) u ιu (n + 1)))
  let G : dimensionCycles X (n + 1 + 1) →+ ℤ :=
    (D6.evalHomD W n y).comp ((divCyc (k := k) (ιt.appTop u) jt n).comp
      (divCyc (k := k) t ιt (n + 1)))
  have hF : ∀ β : dimensionCycles X (n + 1 + 1), F β = C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (germEqs t)
      (C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (germEqs u) β.1) (ιu (ju y)) := fun β ↦
    divCyc_divCyc_apply (k := k) t u ιu ju hZu n β y
  have hG : ∀ β : dimensionCycles X (n + 1 + 1), G β = C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (germEqs u)
      (C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (germEqs t) β.1) (ιu (ju y)) := fun β ↦ by
    rw [← hy]
    exact divCyc_divCyc_apply (k := k) u t ιt jt hZt n β y
  have key : α ∈ AddMonoidHom.eqLocus F G := by
    refine dimCycle_mem_of_prime_on _ (CommAdmissible t u) (fun v hv hadm ↦ ?_) α hα
    change F (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1 + 1) hv) = G (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1 + 1) hv)
    rw [hF, hG, funext (c1CapCyclesCoeff_dimPrimeCycle (germEqs u) v hv),
      funext (c1CapCyclesCoeff_dimPrimeCycle (germEqs t) v hv)]
    exact coeff_comm_prime (k := k) t u n v hv hadm _
  rw [← hF, ← hG]
  exact key

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2TEXC.divIntCycles_comm
statement:
theorem divIntCycles_comm (hW : jt ≫ ιt = ju ≫ ιu)
    (hZt : ∀ x, ¬ IsUnit (germEqs t x) → x ∈ Set.range ιt)
    (hZu : ∀ x, ¬ IsUnit (germEqs u x) → x ∈ Set.range ιu) (n : ℕ)
    (α : dimensionCycles X (n + 1 + 1)) (hα : ∀ v, α.1 v ≠ 0 → CommAdmissible t u v) :
    divIntCycles (k := k) (ιu.appTop t) ju n (divCyc (k := k) u ιu (n + 1) α) =
      divIntCycles (k := k) (ιt.appTop u) jt n (divCyc (k := k) t ιt (n + 1) α)
proof:
:= by
  rw [divIntCycles_eq_mk_divCyc, divIntCycles_eq_mk_divCyc,
    divCyc_comm (k := k) t u ιt ιu jt ju hW hZt hZu n α hα]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2TEXC.divCyc_comm_of_isZeroLocus
statement:
theorem divCyc_comm_of_isZeroLocus (hW : jt ≫ ιt = ju ≫ ιu) (hZt : IsZeroLocus t ιt)
    (hZu : IsZeroLocus u ιu) (n : ℕ) (α : dimensionCycles X (n + 1 + 1))
    (hα : ∀ v, α.1 v ≠ 0 → CommAdmissible t u v) :
    divCyc (k := k) (ιu.appTop t) ju n (divCyc (k := k) u ιu (n + 1) α) =
      divCyc (k := k) (ιt.appTop u) jt n (divCyc (k := k) t ιt (n + 1) α)
proof:
:=
  divCyc_comm (k := k) t u ιt ιu jt ju hW (fun x hx ↦ (hZt x).mpr hx)
    (fun x hx ↦ (hZu x).mpr hx) n α hα

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2TEXC.divIntCycles_comm_of_gate
statement:
theorem divIntCycles_comm_of_gate (hW : jt ≫ ιt = ju ≫ ιu)
    (hZt : ∀ x, ¬ IsUnit (germEqs t x) → x ∈ Set.range ιt)
    (hZu : ∀ x, ¬ IsUnit (germEqs u x) → x ∈ Set.range ιu) (n : ℕ)
    (hgate : DivCommImproperGate (k := k) t u ιt ιu jt ju n)
    (α : dimensionCycles X (n + 1 + 1)) :
    divIntCycles (k := k) (ιu.appTop t) ju n (divCyc (k := k) u ιu (n + 1) α) =
      divIntCycles (k := k) (ιt.appTop u) jt n (divCyc (k := k) t ιt (n + 1) α)
proof:
:= by
  have key : α ∈ AddMonoidHom.eqLocus
      ((divIntCycles (k := k) (ιu.appTop t) ju n).comp (divCyc (k := k) u ιu (n + 1)))
      ((divIntCycles (k := k) (ιt.appTop u) jt n).comp (divCyc (k := k) t ιt (n + 1))) := by
    refine D13.dimCycle_mem_of_prime _ (fun v hv ↦ ?_) α
    change divIntCycles (k := k) (ιu.appTop t) ju n
        (divCyc (k := k) u ιu (n + 1) (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1 + 1) hv)) =
      divIntCycles (k := k) (ιt.appTop u) jt n
        (divCyc (k := k) t ιt (n + 1) (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1 + 1) hv))
    by_cases hadm : CommAdmissible t u v
    · refine divIntCycles_comm (k := k) t u ιt ιu jt ju hW hZt hZu n _ fun w hw ↦ ?_
      have hwv : w = v := by
        by_contra h
        apply hw
        rw [m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply, if_neg h]
      rw [hwv]
      exact hadm
    · exact hgate v hv hadm
  exact key

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.G2TEXC.divIntChow_comm
statement:
theorem divIntChow_comm (hW : jt ≫ ιt = ju ≫ ιu)
    (hZt : ∀ x, ¬ IsUnit (germEqs t x) → x ∈ Set.range ιt)
    (hZu : ∀ x, ¬ IsUnit (germEqs u x) → x ∈ Set.range ιu) (n : ℕ)
    (hgate : DivCommImproperGate (k := k) t u ιt ιu jt ju n)
    (ht : DivIntDescends (k := k) t ιt (n + 1)) (hu : DivIntDescends (k := k) u ιu (n + 1))
    (ht' : DivIntDescends (k := k) (ιu.appTop t) ju n)
    (hu' : DivIntDescends (k := k) (ιt.appTop u) jt n) (ξ : DimChow X (n + 1 + 1)) :
    divIntChow ht' (divIntChow hu ξ) = divIntChow hu' (divIntChow ht ξ)
proof:
:= by
  induction ξ using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
  | H α =>
    rw [divIntChow_mk, divIntChow_mk, divIntCycles_eq_mk_divCyc, divIntCycles_eq_mk_divCyc,
      divIntChow_mk, divIntChow_mk]
    exact divIntCycles_comm_of_gate (k := k) t u ιt ιu jt ju hW hZt hZu n hgate α

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.ratFn_ne_zero

  ratBlowup_cover f hf y

    ratφ f |_ (ratU f ⊓ ratU' f) * ratψ f |_ (ratU f ⊓ ratU' f) = 1

    (h : IsUnit ((ratBlowup f).presheaf.germ (ratU f) y hy (ratφ f))) : y ∈ ratU' f

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.genericPoint_mem_ratU

proof:
:=
  genericPoint_mem_ratLocus _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.genericPoint_mem_ratU'

proof:
:=
  genericPoint_mem_ratLocus _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.chartFn_ratφ
statement:
theorem chartFn_ratφ :
    chartFn (ratU f) (ratφ f) (genericPoint (ratBlowup f)) genericPoint_mem_ratU =
      (ffHom (pointClosureι (genericPoint (ratBlowup f)))).hom (ratFn f)
proof:
:= by
  set γ := genericPoint (ratBlowup f)
  haveI : Nonempty (ratU f) := ⟨⟨γ, genericPoint_mem_ratU⟩⟩
  haveI : Nonempty ((pointClosureι γ) ⁻¹ᵁ ratU f) :=
    ⟨⟨pointClosureGenericPoint γ, by
      show pointClosureι γ (pointClosureGenericPoint γ) ∈ ratU f
      rw [pointClosureι_genericPoint]
      exact genericPoint_mem_ratU⟩⟩
  have h1 : (ratBlowup f).germToFunctionField (ratU f) (ratφ f) = ratFn f :=
    germ_ratSec _ genericPoint_mem_ratU
  rw [← h1, ffHom_germ (pointClosureι γ) (ratU f) ((pointClosureι γ) ⁻¹ᵁ ratU f) le_rfl,
    Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.twoChartCyc_rat_eq
statement:
theorem twoChartCyc_rat_eq (hf : f ≠ 0) (n : ℕ)
    (hγ : height (genericPoint (ratBlowup f)) = n + 1 + 1) :
    (twoChartCyc (k := k) (ratU f) (ratU' f) (ratφ f) (ratψ f) n (genericPoint (ratBlowup f))
      genericPoint_mem_ratU genericPoint_mem_ratU' hγ).1 = div (ratFn f)
proof:
:= by
  set γ := genericPoint (ratBlowup f)
  ext y
  change D6.evalHomD (ratBlowup f) (n + 1) y (_ - _) = div (ratFn f) y
  rw [map_sub]
  change (extOpen (k := k) (ratU f) (n + 1) _).1 y - (extOpen (k := k) (ratU' f) (n + 1) _).1 y =
    div (ratFn f) y
  rw [extOpen_chartDiv_apply (k := k) (ratU f) (ratφ f) (n + 1) _ _ y,
    extOpen_chartDiv_apply (k := k) (ratU' f) (ratψ f) (n + 1) _ _ y, ι_ptOpens, ι_ptOpens,
    ← remGen_cycle_apply (k := k) (ratU f) (ratU' f) (ratφ f) (ratψ f) (rat_hinv hf)
      (rat_hcov hf) (n + 1) γ genericPoint_mem_ratU genericPoint_mem_ratU' hγ y]
  change properPushforward (pointClosureι γ)
    (div (chartFn (ratU f) (ratφ f) γ genericPoint_mem_ratU)) y = _
  letI : (pointClosureScheme γ).Over (Spk k) := ⟨pointClosureι γ ≫ ratBlowup f ↘ Spk k⟩
  haveI : (pointClosureι γ).IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨rfl⟩
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType ((pointClosureScheme γ) ↘ Spk k) := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (pointClosureι γ ≫ ratBlowup f ↘ Spk k)
    infer_instance
  have hdeg : (pointClosureι γ).degree (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme γ)) = 1 :=
    Scheme.Hom.degree_eq_one_of_isClosedImmersion _ _
  rw [chartFn_ratφ, D16.pf_div_ffHom_ne k (pointClosureι γ) (by rw [hdeg]; exact one_ne_zero) _
    (ratFn_ne_zero hf), hdeg, Nat.cast_one, one_smul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.pp_ratπ_div
statement: theorem pp_ratπ_div (hf : f ≠ 0) : properPushforward (ratπ f) (div (ratFn f)) = div f
proof:
:= by
  rw [D16.pf_div_ffHom_ne k (ratπ f) (by rw [degree_ratπ_genericPoint]; exact one_ne_zero) f hf,
    degree_ratπ_genericPoint, Nat.cast_one, one_smul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.height_genericPoint_ratBlowup
statement:
theorem height_genericPoint_ratBlowup :
    height (genericPoint (ratBlowup f)) = height (genericPoint Y)
proof:
:= by
  have h := heightCompatible_of_finiteType k (ratπ f) (genericPoint (ratBlowup f))
    (by rw [degree_ratπ_genericPoint]; exact one_ne_zero)
  rw [ratπ_genericPoint] at h
  exact h.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.ratGraphModel_of_height
statement:
theorem ratGraphModel_of_height (n : ℕ) (g : DimRelationGenerator X (n + 1))
    (hη : height (genericPoint g.Y) = n + 1 + 1) : Nonempty (RatGraphModel k n g)
proof:
:= by
  letI : g.Y.Over (Spk k) := ⟨g.i ≫ X ↘ Spk k⟩
  haveI : g.i.IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨rfl⟩
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (g.Y ↘ Spk k) := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (g.i ≫ X ↘ Spk k)
    infer_instance
  haveI : CompactSpace g.Y := g.i.isClosedEmbedding.compactSpace
  haveI : IsNoetherian g.Y := { }
  have hγ : height (genericPoint (ratBlowup g.f)) = n + 1 + 1 :=
    (height_genericPoint_ratBlowup (k := k)).trans hη
  have hpush : D13.pfHom (k := k) (ratπ g.f ≫ g.i) (n + 1)
      (twoChartCyc (k := k) (ratU g.f) (ratU' g.f) (ratφ g.f) (ratψ g.f) n
        (genericPoint (ratBlowup g.f)) genericPoint_mem_ratU genericPoint_mem_ratU' hγ) =
      g.cycle := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change properPushforward (ratπ g.f ≫ g.i) (twoChartCyc (k := k) (ratU g.f) (ratU' g.f)
      (ratφ g.f) (ratψ g.f) n (genericPoint (ratBlowup g.f)) genericPoint_mem_ratU
        genericPoint_mem_ratU' hγ).1 = properPushforward g.i (div g.f)
    rw [twoChartCyc_rat_eq (k := k) g.hf n hγ, properPushforward_comp,
      pp_ratπ_div (k := k) g.hf]
  exact ⟨{ Γs := ratBlowup g.f
           π := ratπ g.f ≫ g.i
           U := ratU g.f
           U' := ratU' g.f
           φ := ratφ g.f
           ψ := ratψ g.f
           hcov := rat_hcov g.hf
           hinv := rat_hinv g.hf
           hunit := rat_hunit
           hunit' := rat_hunit'
           γ := genericPoint (ratBlowup g.f)
           hγU := genericPoint_mem_ratU
           hγU' := genericPoint_mem_ratU'
           hγ := hγ
           hpush := hpush }⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.genDesc_proved
statement:
theorem genDesc_proved (t : Γ(X, ⊤)) (n : ℕ) (g : DimRelationGenerator X (n + 1)) :
    GenDesc (k := k) t n g
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hex : ∃ y : g.Y, coheight y = 1
  · obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hex
    have hη : height (genericPoint g.Y) = n + 1 + 1 := by
      have h := dimensionCatenary_of_finiteType k (X := X) g.Y g.i y hy
      rw [g.dimension y hy, height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion g.i] at h
      rw [← h]
      push_cast
      rfl
    obtain ⟨M⟩ := ratGraphModel_of_height (k := k) n g hη
    exact genDesc_of_ratGraphModel t M
  · have h0 : g.cycle = 0 := by
      have hd : div g.f = 0 := by
        ext z
        change Scheme.ord g.f z = 0
        exact Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one (fun h ↦ hex ⟨z, h⟩) _
      apply Subtype.ext
      change properPushforward g.i (div g.f) = 0
      rw [hd, properPushforward_zero]
    unfold GenDesc
    rw [h0, map_zero]
    exact zero_mem _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.blowIdeal_ideal
statement:
theorem blowIdeal_ideal (f : Y.functionField) (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    (blowIdeal f).ideal U = denIdeal f U.1 ⊔ denIdeal f⁻¹ U.1
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.blowIdeal_ne_bot
statement: theorem blowIdeal_ne_bot (f : Y.functionField) : blowIdeal f ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨U, hx⟩ := GraphClosure.exists_affineOpens_mem (genericPoint Y)
  haveI : Nonempty U.1 := ⟨⟨_, hx⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hb0⟩ := exists_mem_denIdeal_ne_zero f U
  have hmem : b ∈ (blowIdeal f).ideal U := by
    rw [blowIdeal_ideal]
    exact Ideal.mem_sup_left hb
  rw [h] at hmem
  change b ∈ (⊥ : Ideal Γ(Y, U.1)) at hmem
  exact hb0 (Ideal.mem_bot.mp hmem)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.genericPoint_mem_centreComplement_g2xrat
statement:
theorem genericPoint_mem_centreComplement_g2xrat (f : Y.functionField) :
    genericPoint Y ∈ GlobalBlowup.centreComplement Y (blowIdeal f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := GlobalBlowup.centreComplement_nonempty Y _ (blowIdeal_ne_bot f)
  exact (genericPoint_specializes x).mem_open
    (GlobalBlowup.centreComplement Y (blowIdeal f)).isOpen hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.ratπ_genericPoint
statement:
theorem ratπ_genericPoint (f : Y.functionField) :
    ratπ f (genericPoint (ratBlowup f)) = genericPoint Y
proof:
:= by
  set O := GlobalBlowup.centreComplement Y (blowIdeal f)
  haveI := GlobalBlowup.toBase_restrict_isIso Y (blowIdeal f)
  let y : (ratπ f ⁻¹ᵁ O).toScheme :=
    inv (ratπ f ∣_ O) ⟨genericPoint Y, genericPoint_mem_centreComplement_g2xrat f⟩
  have hy : ratπ f y.1 = genericPoint Y := by
    have h1 : (ratπ f ∣_ O) y = ⟨genericPoint Y, genericPoint_mem_centreComplement_g2xrat f⟩ := by
      change (inv (ratπ f ∣_ O) ≫ (ratπ f ∣_ O)) _ = _
      rw [IsIso.inv_hom_id]
      rfl
    exact (morphismRestrict_base_coe (ratπ f) O y).symm.trans (congrArg Subtype.val h1)
  have hs : ratπ f (genericPoint (ratBlowup f)) ⤳ genericPoint Y := by
    rw [← hy]
    exact (genericPoint_specializes y.1).map (ratπ f).continuous
  exact (hs.antisymm (genericPoint_specializes _)).eq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.degree_ratπ_genericPoint
statement:
theorem degree_ratπ_genericPoint (f : Y.functionField) :
    (ratπ f).degree (genericPoint (ratBlowup f)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hx : ratπ f (genericPoint (ratBlowup f)) ∈
      GlobalBlowup.centreComplement Y (blowIdeal f) := by
    rw [ratπ_genericPoint f]
    exact genericPoint_mem_centreComplement_g2xrat f
  haveI := GraphClosure.isIso_stalkMap_of_isIso_restrict (ratπ f) _
    (GlobalBlowup.toBase_restrict_isIso Y _) _ hx
  exact GraphClosure.degree_eq_one_of_isIso_stalkMap _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.appLE_specMap_comp_fromSpec
statement:
theorem appLE_specMap_comp_fromSpec {Y : Scheme.{u}} {V : Y.Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    {B : CommRingCat.{u}} (φ : Γ(Y, V) ⟶ B)
    (e : (⊤ : (Spec B).Opens) ≤ (Spec.map φ ≫ hV.fromSpec) ⁻¹ᵁ V) :
    (Spec.map φ ≫ hV.fromSpec).appLE V ⊤ e = φ ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso B).inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_appLE, hV.fromSpec_app_self, Category.assoc, Scheme.Hom.map_appLE,
    Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.stalkMap_germ_specMap_fromSpec
statement:
theorem stalkMap_germ_specMap_fromSpec {Y : Scheme.{u}} {V : Y.Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    {B : CommRingCat.{u}} (φ : Γ(Y, V) ⟶ B) (h : Spec B ⟶ Y)
    (hh : h = Spec.map φ ≫ hV.fromSpec) (z : Spec B) (hz : h z ∈ V) (x : Γ(Y, V)) :
    h.stalkMap z (Y.presheaf.germ V (h z) hz x) =
      (Spec B).presheaf.germ ⊤ z trivial ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso B).inv (φ x))
proof:
:= by
  have hle : (⊤ : (Spec B).Opens) ≤ h ⁻¹ᵁ V := by
    intro p _
    change h p ∈ V
    rw [hh, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact hV.range_fromSpec.le ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have happ : h.appLE V ⊤ hle x = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso B).inv (φ x) := by
    subst hh
    rw [appLE_specMap_comp_fromSpec hV φ hle]
    rfl
  rw [Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply, ← happ, Scheme.Hom.appLE, CommRingCat.comp_apply,
    TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.stalkMap_germ_mul_of_eq
statement:
theorem stalkMap_germ_mul_of_eq {Y : Scheme.{u}} {V : Y.Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    {B : CommRingCat.{u}} (φ : Γ(Y, V) ⟶ B) (h : Spec B ⟶ Y)
    (hh : h = Spec.map φ ≫ hV.fromSpec) (z : Spec B) (hz : h z ∈ V) (x x' : Γ(Y, V)) (q : B)
    (hq : φ x = φ x' * q) :
    h.stalkMap z (Y.presheaf.germ V (h z) hz x) =
      h.stalkMap z (Y.presheaf.germ V (h z) hz x') *
        (Spec B).presheaf.germ ⊤ z trivial ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso B).inv q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [stalkMap_germ_specMap_fromSpec hV φ h hh z hz, stalkMap_germ_specMap_fromSpec hV φ h hh z hz,
    hq, map_mul, map_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.baseRingHom_eq_mul_ratio
statement:
theorem baseRingHom_eq_mul_ratio {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (J : Ideal A) (r s : J) :
    ReesBlowup.baseRingHom J r s.1 =
      ReesBlowup.baseRingHom J r r.1 * ReesBlowup.ratioElement J r s
proof:
:= by
  rw [ReesBlowup.baseRingHom_apply, ReesBlowup.baseRingHom_apply,
    ReesBlowup.baseElement_mul_ratioElement]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.mem_ratLocus_of_chart
statement:
theorem mem_ratLocus_of_chart {Γs Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Γs] [IsIntegral Y] (π : Γs ⟶ Y)
    [IsDominant π] {V : Y.Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) {B : CommRingCat.{u}} (φ : Γ(Y, V) ⟶ B)
    (j : Spec B ⟶ Γs) [IsOpenImmersion j] (hj : j ≫ π = Spec.map φ ≫ hV.fromSpec)
    (g : Y.functionField) (r s : Γ(Y, V)) (q : B) (hq : φ s = φ r * q)
    (hηV : genericPoint Y ∈ V) (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (hrs : Y.presheaf.germ V (genericPoint Y) hηV s =
      Y.presheaf.germ V (genericPoint Y) hηV r * g) (w : Spec B) :
    j w ∈ ratLocus ((ffHom π).hom g)
proof:
:= by
  have hyU : (j ≫ π) w ∈ V := by
    rw [hj, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact hV.range_fromSpec.le ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hc := stalkMap_germ_mul_of_eq hV φ (j ≫ π) hj w hyU s r q hq
  rw [Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp] at hc
  have hbij := ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (j.stalkMap w)
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hbij.2 ((Spec B).presheaf.germ ⊤ w trivial ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso B).inv q))
  have hyU' : π (j w) ∈ V := hyU
  have hst : π.stalkMap (j w) (Y.presheaf.germ V _ hyU' s) =
      π.stalkMap (j w) (Y.presheaf.germ V _ hyU' r) * a := by
    apply hbij.1
    rw [map_mul, ha]
    exact hc
  refine mem_ratLocus_of_algebraMap a ?_
  haveI : Nonempty V := ⟨⟨_, hηV⟩⟩
  have e1 := ffHom_algebraMap_stalk π (j w) (Y.presheaf.germ V _ hyU' s)
  have e2 := ffHom_algebraMap_stalk π (j w) (Y.presheaf.germ V _ hyU' r)
  rw [Scheme.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField] at e1 e2
  rw [hst, map_mul, ← e2] at e1
  have hrs' : Y.germToFunctionField V s = Y.germToFunctionField V r * g := hrs
  rw [hrs', map_mul] at e1
  have hne : (ffHom π).hom (Y.germToFunctionField V r) ≠ 0 :=
    (map_ne_zero _).mpr ((map_ne_zero_iff _ (Y.germToFunctionField_injective V)).mpr hr)
  exact (mul_left_cancel₀ hne e1).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.chart_mem_ratLocus_of
statement:
theorem chart_mem_ratLocus_of (I : Y.IdealSheafData) [IsIntegral (GlobalBlowup.blowup Y I)]
    [IsDominant (GlobalBlowup.toBase Y I)] (g : Y.functionField) (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (r s : I.ideal U) (hηU : genericPoint Y ∈ U.1) (hr : r.1 ≠ 0)
    (hrs : Y.presheaf.germ U.1 (genericPoint Y) hηU s.1 =
      Y.presheaf.germ U.1 (genericPoint Y) hηU r.1 * g)
    (w : ReesBlowup.chart (I.ideal U) r) :
    GlobalBlowup.chartHom Y I ⟨U, r⟩ w ∈
      ratLocus ((ffHom (GlobalBlowup.toBase Y I)).hom g)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : GlobalBlowup.chartHom Y I ⟨U, r⟩ ≫ GlobalBlowup.toBase Y I =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (ReesBlowup.baseRingHom (I.ideal U) r)) ≫ U.2.fromSpec := by
    have h : GlobalBlowup.chartHom Y I ⟨U, r⟩ ≫ GlobalBlowup.toBase Y I =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (ReesBlowup.baseRingHom (I.ideal U) r)) ≫
          U.2.isoSpec.inv ≫ U.1.ι :=
      GlobalBlowup.chartHom_comp_toBase Y I ⟨U, r⟩
    exact h.trans (by rw [U.2.isoSpec_inv_ι])
  exact mem_ratLocus_of_chart (GlobalBlowup.toBase Y I) U.2 _ _ hcomp g r.1 s.1 _
    (baseRingHom_eq_mul_ratio (I.ideal U) r s) hηU hr hrs w

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.chart_mem_ratLocus
statement:
theorem chart_mem_ratLocus (f g : Y.functionField) (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (r s : (blowIdeal f).ideal U) (hηU : genericPoint Y ∈ U.1) (hr : r.1 ≠ 0)
    (hrs : Y.presheaf.germ U.1 (genericPoint Y) hηU s.1 =
      Y.presheaf.germ U.1 (genericPoint Y) hηU r.1 * g)
    (w : ReesBlowup.chart ((blowIdeal f).ideal U) r) :
    GlobalBlowup.chartHom Y (blowIdeal f) ⟨U, r⟩ w ∈ ratLocus ((ffHom (ratπ f)).hom g)
proof:
:=
  chart_mem_ratLocus_of (blowIdeal f) g U r s hηU hr hrs w

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.genericPoint_mem_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem genericPoint_mem_of_ne_zero {U : Y.Opens} {a : Γ(Y, U)} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    genericPoint Y ∈ U
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hη
  haveI := subsingleton_sec hη
  exact ha (Subsingleton.elim _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.ratBlowup_cover
statement:
theorem ratBlowup_cover (f : Y.functionField) (hf : f ≠ 0) (y : ratBlowup f) :
    y ∈ ratLocus ((ffHom (ratπ f)).hom f) ∨ y ∈ ratLocus ((ffHom (ratπ f)).hom f)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hy : y ∈ ⨆ U : Y.affineOpens, (GlobalBlowup.affineι Y (blowIdeal f) U).opensRange := by
    rw [GlobalBlowup.iSup_opensRange_affineι]
    trivial
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hy
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hU
  let S₁ := {a : Γ(Y, U.1) // a ∈ denIdeal f U.1 ∧ a ≠ 0}
  let S₂ := {a : Γ(Y, U.1) // a ∈ denIdeal f⁻¹ U.1 ∧ a ≠ 0}
  let s : S₁ ⊕ S₂ → Γ(Y, U.1) := Sum.elim Subtype.val Subtype.val
  have hI : (blowIdeal f).ideal U = Ideal.span (Set.range s) := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · rw [blowIdeal_ideal]
      refine sup_le (fun a ha ↦ ?_) (fun a ha ↦ ?_)
      · by_cases h0 : a = 0
        · rw [h0]
          exact zero_mem _
        · exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨Sum.inl ⟨a, ha, h0⟩, rfl⟩
      · by_cases h0 : a = 0
        · rw [h0]
          exact zero_mem _
        · exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨Sum.inr ⟨a, ha, h0⟩, rfl⟩
    · rw [Ideal.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨i | i, rfl⟩
      · exact Ideal.mem_sup_left i.2.1
      · exact Ideal.mem_sup_right i.2.1
  let cov := ReesBlowup.affineOpenCoverOfSpan ((blowIdeal f).ideal U) s hI
  obtain ⟨i, w, hw⟩ : ∃ i, z ∈ Set.range (cov.f i) := ⟨cov.idx z, cov.covers z⟩
  rcases i with ⟨a, ha, ha0⟩ | ⟨a, ha, ha0⟩
  · left
    have hηU : genericPoint Y ∈ U.1 := genericPoint_mem_of_ne_zero ha0
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := ha hηU
    have hbI : b ∈ (blowIdeal f).ideal U :=
      Ideal.mem_sup_right (mem_denIdeal_inv hf (a := a) fun _ ↦ hb)
    have h := chart_mem_ratLocus f f U ⟨a, Ideal.mem_sup_left ha⟩ ⟨b, hbI⟩ hηU ha0 hb w
    rw [← hw]
    exact h
  · right
    have hηU : genericPoint Y ∈ U.1 := genericPoint_mem_of_ne_zero ha0
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := ha hηU
    have hbI : b ∈ (blowIdeal f).ideal U := by
      have := mem_denIdeal_inv (inv_ne_zero hf) (a := a) fun _ ↦ hb
      rw [inv_inv] at this
      exact Ideal.mem_sup_left this
    have h := chart_mem_ratLocus f f⁻¹ U ⟨a, Ideal.mem_sup_right ha⟩ ⟨b, hbI⟩ hηU ha0 hb w
    rw [map_inv₀] at h
    rw [← hw]
    exact h

name: RRC.SingularTodd.closedPosK
statement: theorem closedPosK : D30.ProjBundleClosedPos (ProjK k)
proof:
:= by
  intro X _ _ _ hX E C e hC
  obtain ⟨N, j, hj, hjk⟩ := hX.out
  haveI := hj
  have hE : HasConstantRank X E (e + 1) := D37.hasConstantRank_of_frameCover C hC
  obtain ⟨D, C', n, ι, hι, hιf⟩ :=
    D37.exists_closedImmersion_twist_into_product_pos N j E (e + 1) hE
  have hL : HasConstantRank X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (D : ℤ))) 1 :=
    hasConstantRank_pullback X j _ 1
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.hasConstantRank_twist (k := k) N (D : ℤ))
  obtain ⟨iso, hiso⟩ := AlgebraicGeometry.D38.twistInvariance _ E hL hE C C'
  haveI := hι
  haveI := SegreD36.isClosedImmersion_segreHomStd (k := k) N n
  refine ⟨SegreD36.segreDim N n, iso.hom ≫ ι ≫ SegreD36.segreHomStd N n, inferInstance, ?_⟩
  change _ = C.toBase ≫ X ↘ Spk k
  rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, SegreD36.segreHomStd, SegreD36.segreHom_toSpec,
    ← Category.assoc ι, hιf, Category.assoc, hjk, ← Category.assoc iso.hom, hiso]

name: RRC.SingularTodd.opsK_pull_eq
statement:
theorem opsK_pull_eq [Fact (ProjK k X)] [Fact (ProjK k Y)] [Fact (D28.ProjectiveIntegral k X)]
    [Fact (D28.ProjectiveIntegral k Y)] (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat f] (d : ℕ)
    (hd : PureRelDim f d) (n : ℕ) :
    (opsK k).pull f d hd n = (D28.chowOpsOn_projectiveIntegral k).pull f d hd n
