name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.le_ratLocus
statement:
theorem le_ratLocus [IrreducibleSpace X] {g : X.functionField} {W : X.Opens} (h : RegOn g W) :
    W ≤ ratLocus g
proof:
:=
  le_sSup h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.genericPoint_mem_of_mem
statement: theorem genericPoint_mem_of_mem {W : X.Opens} {x : X} (hx : x ∈ W) : genericPoint X ∈ W
proof:
:=
  (genericPoint_specializes x).mem_open W.isOpen hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.eq_bot_of_genericPoint_notMem
statement: theorem eq_bot_of_genericPoint_notMem {W : X.Opens} (hη : genericPoint X ∉ W) : W = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Opens.not_nonempty_iff_eq_bot]
  rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
  exact hη (genericPoint_mem_of_mem hx)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.subsingleton_sec
statement: theorem subsingleton_sec {W : X.Opens} (hη : genericPoint X ∉ W) : Subsingleton Γ(X, W)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl := eq_bot_of_genericPoint_notMem hη
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.sec_ext
statement:
theorem sec_ext {W : X.Opens} {c c' : Γ(X, W)}
    (h : ∀ hη : genericPoint X ∈ W,
      X.presheaf.germ W (genericPoint X) hη c = X.presheaf.germ W (genericPoint X) hη c') :
    c = c'
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hη : genericPoint X ∈ W
  · exact germ_injective_of_isIntegral X _ hη (h hη)
  · haveI := subsingleton_sec hη
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.regOn_ratLocus
statement: theorem regOn_ratLocus (g : X.functionField) : RegOn g (ratLocus g)
proof:
:= by
  let ι := {W : X.Opens // RegOn g W}
  let U : ι → X.Opens := fun i ↦ i.1
  let sf : ∀ i : ι, Γ(X, U i) := fun i ↦ i.2.choose
  have hsf : ∀ (i : ι) (hη : genericPoint X ∈ U i),
      X.presheaf.germ (U i) (genericPoint X) hη (sf i) = g := fun i ↦ i.2.choose_spec
  have hcover : ratLocus g ≤ iSup U := sSup_le fun W hW ↦ le_iSup U ⟨W, hW⟩
  let iUV : ∀ i : ι, U i ⟶ ratLocus g := fun i ↦ homOfLE (le_ratLocus i.2)
  have hcompat : TopCat.Presheaf.IsCompatible X.sheaf.1 U sf := by
    intro i j
    apply sec_ext
    intro hη
    change X.presheaf.germ _ _ hη (X.presheaf.map (Opens.infLELeft (U i) (U j)).op (sf i)) =
      X.presheaf.germ _ _ hη (X.presheaf.map (Opens.infLERight (U i) (U j)).op (sf j))
    rw [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply, hsf, hsf]
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, -⟩ := X.sheaf.existsUnique_gluing' U (ratLocus g) iUV hcover sf hcompat
  refine ⟨ρ, fun hη ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp (hcover hη)
  have hρi : X.presheaf.map (iUV i).op (show Γ(X, ratLocus g) from ρ) = sf i := hρ i
  calc X.presheaf.germ (ratLocus g) (genericPoint X) hη ρ
      = X.presheaf.germ (U i) (genericPoint X) hi
          (X.presheaf.map (iUV i).op (show Γ(X, ratLocus g) from ρ)) :=
        (TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply X.presheaf (iUV i) (genericPoint X) hi ρ).symm
    _ = g := by rw [hρi]; exact hsf i hi

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.germ_ratSec
statement:
theorem germ_ratSec (g : X.functionField) (hη : genericPoint X ∈ ratLocus g) :
    X.presheaf.germ (ratLocus g) (genericPoint X) hη (ratSec g) = g
proof:
:=
  (regOn_ratLocus g).choose_spec hη

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.mem_ratLocus_of_algebraMap
statement:
theorem mem_ratLocus_of_algebraMap {g : X.functionField} {y : X} (a : X.presheaf.stalk y)
    (ha : algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk y) X.functionField a = g) : y ∈ ratLocus g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hyW, c, rfl⟩ := X.presheaf.exists_germ_eq a
  refine le_ratLocus (W := W) ⟨c, fun hη ↦ ?_⟩ hyW
  haveI : Nonempty W := ⟨⟨y, hyW⟩⟩
  rw [← ha, Scheme.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.algebraMap_germ_ratSec
statement:
theorem algebraMap_germ_ratSec (g : X.functionField) {y : X} (hy : y ∈ ratLocus g) :
    algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk y) X.functionField
      (X.presheaf.germ (ratLocus g) y hy (ratSec g)) = g
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty (ratLocus g) := ⟨⟨y, hy⟩⟩
  rw [Scheme.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField]
  exact germ_ratSec g _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.mem_ratLocus_iff
statement:
theorem mem_ratLocus_iff {g : X.functionField} {y : X} :
    y ∈ ratLocus g ↔ ∃ a : X.presheaf.stalk y,
      algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk y) X.functionField a = g
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hy ↦ ⟨_, algebraMap_germ_ratSec g hy⟩, fun ⟨a, ha⟩ ↦ mem_ratLocus_of_algebraMap a ha⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.genericPoint_mem_ratLocus
statement: theorem genericPoint_mem_ratLocus (g : X.functionField) : genericPoint X ∈ ratLocus g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hηW, c, hc⟩ := X.presheaf.exists_germ_eq (x := genericPoint X) g
  exact le_ratLocus ⟨c, fun _ ↦ hc⟩ hηW

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.mem_ratLocus_inv_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem mem_ratLocus_inv_of_isUnit {g : X.functionField} {y : X} (hy : y ∈ ratLocus g)
    (hu : IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ (ratLocus g) y hy (ratSec g))) : y ∈ ratLocus g⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hu.exists_right_inv
  refine mem_ratLocus_of_algebraMap v ?_
  have h1 := congrArg (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk y) X.functionField) hv
  rw [map_mul, map_one, algebraMap_germ_ratSec] at h1
  exact eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.ratSec_mul_ratSec_inv
statement:
theorem ratSec_mul_ratSec_inv {g : X.functionField} (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    ratSec g |_ (ratLocus g ⊓ ratLocus g⁻¹) * ratSec g⁻¹ |_ (ratLocus g ⊓ ratLocus g⁻¹) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply sec_ext
  intro hη
  have h1 : X.presheaf.germ (ratLocus g ⊓ ratLocus g⁻¹) (genericPoint X) hη
      (ratSec g |_ (ratLocus g ⊓ ratLocus g⁻¹)) =
        X.presheaf.germ (ratLocus g) (genericPoint X) hη.1 (ratSec g) :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ _ _ _ _
  have h2 : X.presheaf.germ (ratLocus g ⊓ ratLocus g⁻¹) (genericPoint X) hη
      (ratSec g⁻¹ |_ (ratLocus g ⊓ ratLocus g⁻¹)) =
        X.presheaf.germ (ratLocus g⁻¹) (genericPoint X) hη.2 (ratSec g⁻¹) :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ _ _ _ _
  rw [map_mul, h1, h2, germ_ratSec, germ_ratSec, map_one, mul_inv_cancel₀ hg]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.mem_denIdeal
statement:
theorem mem_denIdeal {g : X.functionField} {U : X.Opens} {a : Γ(X, U)} :
    a ∈ denIdeal g U ↔ ∀ hη : genericPoint X ∈ U, ∃ b : Γ(X, U),
      X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) hη b = X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) hη a * g
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.denIdeal_map_basicOpen
statement:
theorem denIdeal_map_basicOpen (g : X.functionField) (U : X.affineOpens) (s : Γ(X, U.1)) :
    (denIdeal g U.1).map (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le s)).op).hom =
      denIdeal g (X.basicOpen s)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := U.2.isLocalization_basicOpen s
  change Ideal.map (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen s)) _ = _
  by_cases hη : genericPoint X ∈ X.basicOpen s
  swap
  · haveI := subsingleton_sec hη
    ext x
    rw [Subsingleton.elim x 0]
    simp only [Submodule.zero_mem]
  have hηU : genericPoint X ∈ U.1 := X.basicOpen_le s hη
  have hres : ∀ a : Γ(X, U.1), X.presheaf.germ (X.basicOpen s) (genericPoint X) hη
      (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen s) a) = X.presheaf.germ U.1 (genericPoint X) hηU a :=
    fun a ↦ TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ _ _ _ _
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro a ha _
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := ha hηU
    exact ⟨algebraMap _ _ b, by rw [hres, hres, hb]⟩
  · intro x hx
    rw [IsLocalization.mem_map_algebraMap_iff (Submonoid.powers s)]
    obtain ⟨⟨a, m⟩, ham⟩ := IsLocalization.surj (Submonoid.powers s) x
    obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := hx hη
    obtain ⟨⟨c, m'⟩, hcm⟩ := IsLocalization.surj (Submonoid.powers s) b'
    dsimp only at ham hcm
    have e1 := congrArg (X.presheaf.germ (X.basicOpen s) (genericPoint X) hη) ham
    have e2 := congrArg (X.presheaf.germ (X.basicOpen s) (genericPoint X) hη) hcm
    rw [map_mul, hres, hres] at e1 e2
    refine ⟨⟨⟨a * m', fun _ ↦ ⟨c * m, ?_⟩⟩, m * m'⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [map_mul, map_mul, ← e1, ← e2, hb']
      ring
    · simp only [Submonoid.coe_mul, map_mul]
      rw [← ham]
      ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.denIdealSheaf_ideal
statement:
theorem denIdealSheaf_ideal (g : X.functionField) (U : X.affineOpens) :
    (denIdealSheaf g).ideal U = denIdeal g U.1
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.exists_mem_denIdeal_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_mem_denIdeal_ne_zero (g : X.functionField) (U : X.affineOpens)
    [Nonempty U.1] : ∃ b ∈ denIdeal g U.1, b ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI := functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen X U.1 U.2
  obtain ⟨a, b, hb, hab⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective (A := Γ(X, U.1)) g
  have hbK : algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) X.functionField b ≠ 0 :=
    IsFractionRing.to_map_ne_zero_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors hb
  refine ⟨b, fun hη ↦ ⟨a, ?_⟩, nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hb⟩
  change X.germToFunctionField U.1 a = X.germToFunctionField U.1 b * g
  change algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) X.functionField a = algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) X.functionField b * g
  rw [← hab]
  field_simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.RatGraph.mem_denIdeal_inv
statement:
theorem mem_denIdeal_inv {g : X.functionField} (hg : g ≠ 0) {U : X.Opens} {a b : Γ(X, U)}
    (hab : ∀ hη : genericPoint X ∈ U,
      X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) hη b = X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) hη a * g) :
    b ∈ denIdeal g⁻¹ U
proof: := fun hη ↦ ⟨a, by rw [hab hη, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hg, mul_one]⟩

name: FunctionField.Chart.exceptionalFinite
statement:
theorem exceptionalFinite (α : AdeleSpace k K) :
    {v : PlaceA k K | ¬placeValuation k K v (α.val v) ≤ 1}.Finite
proof:
:=
  (Filter.eventually_cofinite.mp α.property).subset (by
    intro v hv
    change α.val v ∉ placeValuationSubring k K v
    simpa [placeValuationSubring, Valuation.mem_valuationSubring_iff] using hv)

name: FunctionField.Chart.mem_adeleFilt_divisorOfAdele
statement:
theorem mem_adeleFilt_divisorOfAdele (α : AdeleSpace k K) :
    α ∈ adeleFilt k K (divisorOfAdele k K α)
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  show placeValuation k K v (α.val v) ≤ WithZero.exp ((divisorOfAdele k K α) v)
  dsimp [divisorOfAdele, exceptionalPlaces, Finsupp.onFinset_apply]
  by_cases hv : placeValuation k K v (α.val v) ≤ 1
  · have hnotlt : ¬1 < placeValuation k K v (α.val v) := not_lt.mpr hv
    have hnotmem : v ∉ exceptionalPlaces k K α := by
      intro hmem
      have hgt := (exceptionalFinite k K α).mem_toFinset.mp (by
        dsimp [exceptionalPlaces] at hmem ⊢
        exact hmem)
      have hnotle : ¬placeValuation k K v (α.val v) ≤ 1 := by simpa using hgt
      exact absurd hv hnotle
    split_ifs with hlt
    · exfalso
      exact hnotlt hlt
    · simpa [WithZero.exp_zero] using hv
  · have hlt : 1 < placeValuation k K v (α.val v) := not_le.mp hv
    have hmem : v ∈ exceptionalPlaces k K α := by
      dsimp [exceptionalPlaces]
      exact (exceptionalFinite k K α).mem_toFinset.mpr (not_le.mpr hlt)
    have hval : placeValuation k K v (α.val v) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (zero_lt_one.trans hlt)
    split_ifs with hlt'
    · simp [WithZero.exp_log hval]
    · exfalso
      exact hlt' hlt

name: FunctionField.Chart.exists_adeleFilt_mem
statement:
theorem exists_adeleFilt_mem (α : AdeleSpace k K) :
    ∃ D : DivisorA k K, α ∈ adeleFilt k K D
proof:
:=
  ⟨divisorOfAdele k K α, mem_adeleFilt_divisorOfAdele k K α⟩

name: FunctionField.Chart.defect_eq_genus_of_ge
statement:
theorem defect_eq_genus_of_ge {D D' : DivisorA k K} (hle : D ≤ D')
    (hD : defect k K D = genus k K) : defect k K D' = genus k K
proof:
:= by
  have hle' : defect k K D ≤ defect k K D' := defect_mono' (k := k) (K := K) hle
  have hgen : defect k K D' ≤ genus k K := defect_le k K D'
  omega

name: FunctionField.Chart.sandwichRank_eq_zero_of_defect_eq
statement:
theorem sandwichRank_eq_zero_of_defect_eq {D D' : DivisorA k K} (hle : D ≤ D')
    (hD : defect k K D = genus k K) :
    sandwichRank k K D D' hle = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hD' : defect k K D' = genus k K := defect_eq_genus_of_ge (k := k) (K := K) hle hD
  have hs := sandwich (k := k) (K := K) hle
  dsimp only [defect] at hD hD' ⊢
  rw [hs]
  omega

name: FunctionField.Chart.adeleFilt_add_diagonal_eq_of_sandwich_zero
statement:
theorem adeleFilt_add_diagonal_eq_of_sandwich_zero {D D' : DivisorA k K} (hle : D ≤ D')
    (h0 : sandwichRank k K D D' hle = 0) :
    adeleFilt k K D' + diagonalSubmodule k K = adeleFilt k K D + diagonalSubmodule k K
proof:
:=
  sandwichDiagonalSubmodule_eq_of_rank_zero (k := k) (K := K) hle h0

name: FunctionField.Chart.adeleSubmodule_top_eq_adeleFilt_add_diagonal
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro α _
    obtain ⟨Dα, hDα⟩ := exists_adeleFilt_mem (k := k) (K := K) α
    let D' := D ⊔ Dα
    have hD' : defect k K D' = genus k K :=
      defect_eq_genus_of_ge (k := k) (K := K) (le_sup_left (a := D) (b := Dα)) hD
    have h0 := sandwichRank_eq_zero_of_defect_eq (k := k) (K := K) (D := D) (D' := D')
      (le_sup_left (a := D) (b := Dα)) hD
    have heq := adeleFilt_add_diagonal_eq_of_sandwich_zero (k := k) (K := K) (D := D) (D' := D')
      (le_sup_left (a := D) (b := Dα)) h0
    have hmem : α ∈ adeleFilt k K D' + diagonalSubmodule k K :=
      Submodule.mem_sup_left (adeleFilt_mono (k := k) (K := K) le_sup_right hDα)
    rw [heq] at hmem
    exact hmem
  · exact le_top

name: FunctionField.Chart.finrankAdeleQuotient_eq_sandwichRank
statement:
theorem finrankAdeleQuotient_eq_sandwichRank {D D' : DivisorA k K} (hle : D ≤ D')
    (hfull : topAdeleSubmodule k K = adeleFilt k K D' + diagonalSubmodule k K) :
    finrankAdeleQuotient k K D = (sandwichRank k K D D' hle).toNat
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let ssum := adeleFilt k K D + diagonalSubmodule k K
  let topMod := topAdeleSubmodule k K
  letI : AddCommGroup ↥topMod := Submodule.addCommGroup _
  letI : Module k ↥topMod := Submodule.module _
  let p := Submodule.comap topMod.subtype ssum
  let e : ↥topMod ≃ₗ[k] AdeleSpace k K :=
    Submodule.topEquiv (R := k) (M := AdeleSpace k K)
  have hmap := Submodule.map_comap_subtype (p := topMod) (p' := ssum)
  have heq_lm : (e : ↥topMod →ₗ[k] AdeleSpace k K) = topMod.subtype := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    rintro ⟨f, _⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext v
    rfl
  have hf : p.map (e : ↥topMod →ₗ[k] AdeleSpace k K) = ssum := by
    rw [show p.map (e : ↥topMod →ₗ[k] AdeleSpace k K) = p.map topMod.subtype from by
      rw [heq_lm], hmap, inf_eq_right]
    exact le_top
  dsimp only [finrankAdeleQuotient, sandwichRank, ssum]
  rw [← (Submodule.Quotient.equiv p ssum e hf).finrank_eq, hfull.symm]
  simp only [topMod, topAdeleSubmodule, ssum, p]
  simp

name: FunctionField.Chart.finrank_adele_quotient
statement:
theorem finrank_adele_quotient (D : DivisorA k K) :
    finrankAdeleQuotient k K D = indexOfSpecialty k K D
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D₁, hD₁⟩ := exists_defect_eq (k := k) (K := K)
  let D' := D ⊔ D₁
  have hle : D ≤ D' := le_sup_left (a := D) (b := D₁)
  have hD' : defect k K D' = genus k K :=
    defect_eq_genus_of_ge (k := k) (K := K) (le_sup_right (a := D) (b := D₁)) hD₁
  have hfull := adeleSubmodule_top_eq_adeleFilt_add_diagonal (k := k) (K := K) hD'
  have hsand := sandwich (k := k) (K := K) hle
  have hfin := finrankAdeleQuotient_eq_sandwichRank (k := k) (K := K) hle hfull
  have hdef : sandwichRank k K D D' hle = defect k K D' - defect k K D := by
    dsimp only [defect]
    rw [hsand]
    omega
  have hidx : (indexOfSpecialty k K D : ℤ) = genus k K - defect k K D := by
    have := indexOfSpecialty_eq (k := k) (K := K) D
    dsimp only [defect] at this ⊢
    omega
  have hD'gen : defect k K D' = genus k K := hD'
  calc finrankAdeleQuotient k K D
      _ = (sandwichRank k K D D' hle).toNat := hfin
      _ = (genus k K - defect k K D).toNat := by rw [hdef, hD'gen]
      _ = indexOfSpecialty k K D := by
        rw [← hidx]
        simp only [Int.toNat_natCast]

name: FunctionField.Chart.linearIndependent_fin_pow_of_transcendental
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_fin_pow_of_transcendental {x : L} (hx : Transcendental k x) (r : ℕ) :
    LinearIndependent k fun j : Fin (r + 1) => x ^ (j : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
  intro g hg j
  let p : k[X] := ∑ i : Fin (r + 1), C (g i) * X ^ (i : ℕ)
  have hzero : aeval x p = 0 := by
    have hsum : aeval x p = ∑ i : Fin (r + 1), g i • x ^ (i : ℕ) := by
      simp only [p, map_sum, map_mul, aeval_C]
      congr 1
      ext i
      rw [aeval_X_pow, Algebra.smul_def, mul_comm]
    rw [hsum, hg]
  have hp0 : p = 0 := (transcendental_iff.mp hx) p hzero
  have hcoeffj : g j = 0 := by
    have hpgj : g j = p.coeff (j : ℕ) := by
      classical
      dsimp only [p]
      rw [finsetSum_coeff, Finset.sum_eq_single j]
      · rw [coeff_C_mul_X_pow, if_pos rfl]
      · intro b _ ne
        rw [coeff_C_mul_X_pow]
        split_ifs with h
        · exact absurd h (Fin.val_ne_of_ne ne.symm)
        · rfl
      · simp
    rw [hpgj, hp0, coeff_zero]
  exact hcoeffj

name: FunctionField.Chart.polarDivisor_zero
statement: theorem polarDivisor_zero : polarDivisor k K (0 : K) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [polarDivisor]

name: FunctionField.Chart.polarDivisor_nonneg
statement: theorem polarDivisor_nonneg (x : K) : 0 ≤ polarDivisor k K x
proof:
:= by
  unfold polarDivisor
  split_ifs with hx
  · simp
  · exact le_sup_right

name: FunctionField.Chart.polarDivisor_eq_zero_of_algebraic
statement:
theorem polarDivisor_eq_zero_of_algebraic {x : K} (hx : IsAlgebraic k x) :
    polarDivisor k K x = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx0 : x = 0
  · simp [polarDivisor, hx0]
  · obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := IsFullConstantField.algebraic_mem (k := k) (K := K) x hx
    have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := fun hc0 => hx0 (hc.trans (by rw [hc0, map_zero]))
    have hdiv :
        principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 x hx0)) = 0 := by
      have hmap : Units.mk0 x hx0 = Units.map (algebraMap k K) (Units.mk0 c hc0) := by
        ext
        exact hc
      rw [hmap, principalDivisorA_algebraMap k K (Units.mk0 c hc0)]
    ext v
    unfold polarDivisor
    simp only [dif_neg hx0, hdiv, neg_zero, Finsupp.sup_apply, max_self]

name: FunctionField.Chart.exists_placeValuation_gt_one_of_not_algebraic
statement:
theorem exists_placeValuation_gt_one_of_not_algebraic {x : K} (_hx : x ≠ 0)
    (hnt : ¬IsAlgebraic k x) :
    ∃ v : PlaceA k K, 1 < placeValuation k K v x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : ∃ v : PlaceA k K, 1 < placeValuation k K v x
  · exact h
  · push Not at h
    exact absurd (isAlgebraic_of_placeValuation_le_one k K x h) hnt

name: FunctionField.Chart.polarDivisor_pos
statement:
theorem polarDivisor_pos {x : K} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hnt : ¬IsAlgebraic k x) :
    0 < deg k K (polarDivisor k K x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hvgt⟩ := exists_placeValuation_gt_one_of_not_algebraic k K hx hnt
  have hvpos : 0 < placeDegree k K v := placeDegree_pos k K v
  have hord : 0 < (polarDivisor k K x) v := by
    unfold polarDivisor
    split_ifs with hx0
    · exact absurd hx0 hx
    · have hvval := placeValuation_eq_exp_neg_principalDivisor k K
        (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 x hx)) v
      change 1 < placeValuation k K v x at hvgt
      change placeValuation k K v x =
        WithZero.exp (-(principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 x hx)) v)) at hvval
      rw [hvval] at hvgt
      let t := -(principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 x hx)) v)
      have hexp1 : 1 < WithZero.exp t := hvgt
      have ht : 0 < t := by
        have hexpne : WithZero.exp t ≠ 0 := WithZero.exp_pos.ne'
        have hlog : WithZero.log 1 < WithZero.log (WithZero.exp t) :=
          (WithZero.log_lt_log one_ne_zero hexpne).2 hexp1
        rw [WithZero.log_one, WithZero.log_exp] at hlog
        exact hlog
      rw [Finsupp.sup_apply]
      exact lt_sup_iff.2 (Or.inl ht)
  have hsingle : Finsupp.single v (polarDivisor k K x v) ≤ polarDivisor k K x := by
    intro w
    by_cases hw : w = v
    · subst hw
      simp only [Finsupp.single_apply, if_pos]
      exact le_rfl
    · rw [Finsupp.single_apply, if_neg (Ne.symm hw)]
      exact polarDivisor_nonneg k K x w
  have hle : (placeDegree k K v : ℤ) * (polarDivisor k K x v) ≤
      deg k K (polarDivisor k K x) := by
    rw [← mul_comm (polarDivisor k K x v : ℤ), ← deg_single k K v (polarDivisor k K x v)]
    exact deg_mono k K hsingle
  have hdeg : 0 < (placeDegree k K v : ℤ) * (polarDivisor k K x v) := by
    exact mul_pos (mod_cast hvpos) (mod_cast hord)
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le hdeg hle

name: FunctionField.Chart.not_isAlgebraic_iff_transcendental
statement:
theorem not_isAlgebraic_iff_transcendental (x : K) :
    ¬IsAlgebraic k x ↔ Transcendental k x
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: FunctionField.Chart.le_of_forall_nat_mul_le
statement:
theorem le_of_forall_nat_mul_le {n d c : ℕ} (_hd : 0 < d)
    (h : ∀ r : ℕ, n * (r + 1) ≤ d * r + c) : n ≤ d
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hn
  have hn' : d < n := lt_of_not_ge hn
  have hnd : 0 < n - d := tsub_pos_of_lt hn'
  have step : ∀ r : ℕ, (n - d) * r + n ≤ c := by
    intro r
    have hr := h r
    have hsuc : n * (r + 1) = n * r + n := Nat.mul_succ n r
    have hn_eq : d + (n - d) = n := by rw [Nat.add_comm, Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_of_lt hn')]
    have hsplit : n * r = d * r + (n - d) * r := by
      conv_lhs => arg 1; rw [← hn_eq]
      exact add_mul d (n - d) r
    rw [hsuc, hsplit] at hr
    have hr' : (n - d) * r + n ≤ c := by omega
    exact hr'
  have _hnc : n ≤ c := by simpa [Nat.mul_zero, Nat.zero_add] using step 0
  have bound : ∀ r : ℕ, (n - d) * r ≤ c - n := by
    intro r
    have := step r
    omega
  set q := (c - n) / (n - d)
  have hq_lt : c - n < (q + 1) * (n - d) := by
    have hmod := Nat.mod_lt (c - n) hnd
    calc c - n
        = (n - d) * q + (c - n) % (n - d) := (Nat.div_add_mod (c - n) (n - d)).symm
      _ = q * (n - d) + (c - n) % (n - d) := by rw [Nat.mul_comm]
      _ < q * (n - d) + (n - d) := by gcongr
      _ = (q + 1) * (n - d) := by ring_nf
  have hcontra := bound (q + 1)
  rw [Nat.mul_comm] at hcontra
  exact lt_irrefl _ (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hcontra hq_lt)

name: FunctionField.Chart.memRRspace_polarDivisor_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem memRRspace_polarDivisor_of_ne_zero {x : K} (hxne : x ≠ 0) :
    memRRspace k K (polarDivisor k K x) x
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  unfold polarDivisor
  split_ifs with hx0
  · exact absurd hx0 hxne
  · have hvval := placeValuation_eq_exp_neg_principalDivisor k K
      (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 x hx0)) v
    change placeValuation k K v x =
      WithZero.exp (-(principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 x hx0)) v)) at hvval
    rw [hvval, Finsupp.sup_apply]
    exact WithZero.exp_le_exp.mpr (le_max_left _ 0)

name: FunctionField.Chart.memRRspace_smul_polar
statement:
theorem memRRspace_smul_polar {x : K} (hxne : x ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    memRRspace k K (n • polarDivisor k K x) (x ^ n)
proof:
:=
  memRRspace.pow_mem (k := k) (K := K) (D := polarDivisor k K x) (f := x)
    (memRRspace_polarDivisor_of_ne_zero k K hxne) n

name: FunctionField.Chart.nsmul_le_nsmul_polar
statement:
theorem nsmul_le_nsmul_polar {D : DivisorA k K} (hD : 0 ≤ D) {j r : ℕ} (hjr : j ≤ r) :
    j • D ≤ r • D
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  show (j : ℤ) * D v ≤ (r : ℤ) * D v
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Nat.cast_le.mpr hjr) (hD v)

name: FunctionField.Chart.polarDivisor_le_basisPoleBound
statement:
theorem polarDivisor_le_basisPoleBound {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (f : ι → K) (i : ι) :
    polarDivisor k K (f i) ≤ basisPoleBound k K f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [basisPoleBound]
  rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => polarDivisor_nonneg k K (f j))

name: FunctionField.Chart.basisPoleBound_nonneg
statement:
theorem basisPoleBound_nonneg {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (f : ι → K) :
    0 ≤ basisPoleBound k K f
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  change 0 ≤ (basisPoleBound k K f) v
  simp [basisPoleBound, Finset.sum_apply]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => polarDivisor_nonneg k K (f i) v

name: FunctionField.Chart.memRRspace_basisPoleBound
statement:
theorem memRRspace_basisPoleBound {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (f : ι → K) (i : ι) :
    memRRspace k K (basisPoleBound k K f) (f i)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : f i = 0
  · rw [hi]
    exact memRRspace.zero_mem (k := k) (K := K) (basisPoleBound k K f)
  · exact (memRRspace.memRRspace_mono (k := k) (K := K) (polarDivisor_le_basisPoleBound k K f i))
      (memRRspace_polarDivisor_of_ne_zero k K hi)

name: FunctionField.Chart.memRRspace_basis_smul_x_pow
statement:
theorem memRRspace_basis_smul_x_pow {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (f : ι → K) (x : K)
    (hxne : x ≠ 0) (r : ℕ) (i : ι) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ r) :
    memRRspace k K (basisPoleBound k K f + r • polarDivisor k K x) (f i * x ^ j)
proof:
:=
  memRRspace.mul_mem (k := k) (K := K)
    (memRRspace_basisPoleBound k K f i)
    ((memRRspace.memRRspace_mono (k := k) (K := K)
        (nsmul_le_nsmul_polar (D := polarDivisor k K x) (hD := polarDivisor_nonneg k K x)
          (hjr := hj)))
      (memRRspace_smul_polar k K hxne j))

name: FunctionField.Chart.transcendental_XK
statement: theorem transcendental_XK : Transcendental k (XK k K)
proof:
:=
  (transcendental_algebraMap_iff (algebraMap k⟮X⟯ K).injective).2 RatFunc.transcendental_X

name: FunctionField.Chart.not_algebraic_XK
statement: theorem not_algebraic_XK : ¬IsAlgebraic k (XK k K)
proof:
:=
  transcendental_XK k K

name: FunctionField.Chart.XK_ne_zero
statement: theorem XK_ne_zero : XK k K ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun hx0 =>
  (not_algebraic_XK k K) (hx0 ▸ isAlgebraic_zero)

name: FunctionField.Chart.linearIndependent_fin_pow_XK
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_fin_pow_XK (r : ℕ) :
    LinearIndependent k fun j : Fin (r + 1) => (XK k K) ^ (j : ℕ)
proof:
:=
  linearIndependent_fin_pow_of_transcendental (k := k) (L := K) (transcendental_XK k K) r

name: FunctionField.Chart.linearIndependent_basis_smul_XK_pow
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_basis_smul_XK_pow {n r : ℕ}
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin n) k⟮X⟯ K) :
    LinearIndependent k fun p : Fin n × Fin (r + 1) =>
      (b p.1 : K) * (XK k K) ^ (p.2 : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
  intro g hg
  let s : Fin n → k⟮X⟯ := fun i =>
    ∑ j : Fin (r + 1), g (i, j) • RatFunc.X ^ (j : ℕ)
  have hsingle : ∀ i, algebraMap k⟮X⟯ K (s i) * (b i : K) =
      ∑ j : Fin (r + 1), g (i, j) • ((b i : K) * (XK k K) ^ (j : ℕ)) := by
    intro i
    dsimp only [s, XK]
    rw [map_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
    intro j _
    simp only [Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, map_pow, mul_assoc, mul_comm (b i : K),
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k k⟮X⟯ K (g (i, j))]
  have hcombo : ∑ i : Fin n, algebraMap k⟮X⟯ K (s i) * (b i : K) = 0 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hsingle i, ← Finset.sum_product']
    exact hg
  have hcombo' : ∑ i : Fin n, s i • (b i : K) = 0 := by
    simpa only [Algebra.smul_def] using hcombo
  have hs : ∀ i, s i = 0 :=
    (Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp b.linearIndependent) s hcombo'
  intro p
  have hs' := hs p.1
  have hlin := linearIndependent_fin_pow_of_transcendental (k := k) (L := k⟮X⟯)
    RatFunc.transcendental_X r
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff] at hlin
  exact hlin (fun j => g (p.1, j)) (by dsimp only [s] at hs'; exact hs') p.2

name: FunctionField.Chart.ell_family_ge
statement:
theorem ell_family_ge {n r : ℕ} (b : Module.Basis (Fin n) k⟮X⟯ K) :
    n * (r + 1) ≤ ell k K (basisPoleBound k K b + r • polarDivisor k K (XK k K))
proof:
:= by
  let C := basisPoleBound k K b
  let B := polarDivisor k K (XK k K)
  let x := XK k K
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := XK_ne_zero k K
  have hDnn : 0 ≤ C + r • B := add_nonneg (basisPoleBound_nonneg k K b) fun v =>
    mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg r) (polarDivisor_nonneg k K x v)
  let v : Fin n × Fin (r + 1) → K := fun p => (b p.1 : K) * x ^ (p.2 : ℕ)
  have hmem : ∀ p, v p ∈ RRspace k K (C + r • B) := by
    intro p
    rw [mem_RRspace_iff]
    exact memRRspace_basis_smul_x_pow (k := k) (K := K) (f := b) x hx0 r p.1 (p.2 : ℕ)
      (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Fin.is_lt p.2))
  have hlin : LinearIndependent k v :=
    linearIndependent_basis_smul_XK_pow (k := k) (K := K) b
  have hsubset : span k (Set.range v) ≤ RRspace k K (C + r • B) := by
    refine span_le.mpr ?_
    rintro _ ⟨p, rfl⟩
    exact hmem p
  have hcard : n * (r + 1) ≤ Module.finrank k (span k (Set.range v)) := by
    have heq_card := finrank_span_eq_card (R := k) (M := K) hlin
    simp [heq_card, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin]
  have hle : Module.finrank k (span k (Set.range v)) ≤ ell k K (C + r • B) :=
    Submodule.finrank_mono hsubset
  exact Nat.le_trans hcard hle

name: FunctionField.Chart.finrank_le_deg_polarX
statement:
theorem finrank_le_deg_polarX :
    Module.finrank k⟮X⟯ K ≤ deg k K (polarDivisor k K (XK k K))
proof:
:= by
  let n := Module.finrank k⟮X⟯ K
  let b := Module.finBasis k⟮X⟯ K
  let C := basisPoleBound k K b
  let B := polarDivisor k K (XK k K)
  have hx : ¬IsAlgebraic k (XK k K) := not_algebraic_XK k K
  have hx0 : XK k K ≠ 0 := XK_ne_zero k K
  have hBpos : 0 < deg k K B := polarDivisor_pos k K hx0 hx
  have hBnn : 0 ≤ B := polarDivisor_nonneg k K (XK k K)
  have hBeff : IsEffective k K B := hBnn
  have hdegB0 := deg_nonneg k K hBeff
  have hdpos : 0 < (deg k K B).toNat := by
    rw [← Int.toNat_of_nonneg hdegB0] at hBpos
    exact Int.ofNat_lt.mp hBpos
  have hmain : n ≤ (deg k K B).toNat :=
    le_of_forall_nat_mul_le (d := (deg k K B).toNat) (c := (deg k K C).toNat + 1) hdpos fun r => by
      let D := C + r • B
      have hDnn : 0 ≤ D := add_nonneg (basisPoleBound_nonneg k K b) fun v =>
        mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg r) (hBnn v)
      have hDeff : IsEffective k K D := hDnn
      have hCeff : IsEffective k K C := basisPoleBound_nonneg k K b
      have hell : (ell k K D : ℤ) ≤ deg k K D + 1 :=
        ell_le_nonneg (k := k) (K := K) hDnn
      have hdeg : deg k K D = deg k K C + (r : ℤ) * deg k K B := by
        rw [add_comm, ← nsmul_eq_mul, deg_add, deg_nsmul, nsmul_eq_mul, add_comm]
      have hell_nat : n * (r + 1) ≤ ell k K D :=
        ell_family_ge (k := k) (K := K) (n := n) (r := r) b
      have hbound : (n * (r + 1) : ℤ) ≤ deg k K D + 1 :=
        (Nat.cast_le.mpr hell_nat).trans hell
      have hC0 := deg_nonneg k K hCeff
      have htoC : ((deg k K C).toNat : ℤ) = deg k K C := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hC0
      have htoB : ((deg k K B).toNat : ℤ) = deg k K B := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hdegB0
      have hsum :
          deg k K D + 1 = (deg k K B).toNat * r + ((deg k K C).toNat + 1) := by
        rw [hdeg, htoC, htoB]
        ring
      have hnat_z :
          (n * (r + 1) : ℤ) ≤ (deg k K B).toNat * r + ((deg k K C).toNat + 1) := by
        rw [← hsum]
        exact hbound
      exact_mod_cast hnat_z
  have hdegB := deg_nonneg k K hBeff
  rw [← Int.toNat_of_nonneg hdegB]
  exact_mod_cast hmain

name: FunctionField.Chart.linearIndependent_basis_smul_x_pow
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_basis_smul_x_pow {n r : ℕ} {x : K} (hx : Transcendental k x)
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin n) (rationalSubfield k K x) K) :
    LinearIndependent k fun p : Fin n × Fin (r + 1) =>
      (b p.1 : K) * x ^ (p.2 : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
  intro g hg
  let F := rationalSubfield k K x
  have hxF : x ∈ F := IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_of_mem k (Set.mem_singleton x)
  let s : Fin n → F := fun i =>
    ∑ j : Fin (r + 1), g (i, j) • ⟨x ^ (j : ℕ), by
      convert F.pow_mem hxF (Int.ofNat j) using 1
      exact (zpow_natCast x j).symm⟩
  have hsingle : ∀ i, s i • (b i : K) =
      ∑ j : Fin (r + 1), g (i, j) • ((b i : K) * x ^ (j : ℕ)) := by
    intro i
    simp only [s, Algebra.smul_def, map_sum]
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    congr 1
    ext j
    simp [mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]
  have hcombo : ∑ i : Fin n, s i • (b i : K) = 0 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hsingle i, ← Finset.sum_product']
    exact hg
  have hs : ∀ i, s i = 0 := (Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp b.linearIndependent) s hcombo
  intro p
  have hs' := hs p.1
  have hz : ∑ j : Fin (r + 1), g (p.1, j) • x ^ (j : ℕ) = 0 := by
    simpa [s] using congrArg Subtype.val hs'
  have hlin := linearIndependent_fin_pow_of_transcendental (k := k) (L := K) hx r
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff] at hlin
  exact hlin (fun j => g (p.1, j)) hz p.2

name: FunctionField.Chart.algebraMap_polynomial_eq_aeval_XK
statement:
theorem algebraMap_polynomial_eq_aeval_XK (p : k[X]) :
    algebraMap k[X] K p = aeval (XK k K) p
proof:
:= by
  have h : IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k k[X] K = aeval (XK k K) := by
    refine Polynomial.algHom_ext ?_
    rw [IsScalarTower.toAlgHom_apply, aeval_X,
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k[X] k⟮X⟯ K, RatFunc.algebraMap_X]
    rfl
  calc algebraMap k[X] K p = IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k k[X] K p := rfl
    _ = aeval (XK k K) p := by rw [h]

name: FunctionField.Chart.algebraMap_ratFunc_eq_div
statement:
theorem algebraMap_ratFunc_eq_div (c : k⟮X⟯) :
    algebraMap k⟮X⟯ K c = aeval (XK k K) c.num / aeval (XK k K) c.denom
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← RatFunc.num_div_denom c]
  rw [map_div₀, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k[X] k⟮X⟯ K,
    ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k[X] k⟮X⟯ K,
    algebraMap_polynomial_eq_aeval_XK, algebraMap_polynomial_eq_aeval_XK]

name: FunctionField.Chart.coe_aeval_adjoinSimple_gen_XK
statement:
theorem coe_aeval_adjoinSimple_gen_XK (p : k[X]) :
    ((aeval (AdjoinSimple.gen k (XK k K)) p : IntermediateField.adjoin k {XK k K}) : K)
      = aeval (XK k K) p
proof:
:= by
  have hgen : (IntermediateField.adjoin k {XK k K}).val (AdjoinSimple.gen k (XK k K)) = XK k K :=
    IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.algebraMap_gen k (XK k K)
  calc ((aeval (AdjoinSimple.gen k (XK k K)) p : IntermediateField.adjoin k {XK k K}) : K)
      = (IntermediateField.adjoin k {XK k K}).val
          (aeval (AdjoinSimple.gen k (XK k K)) p) := rfl
    _ = aeval ((IntermediateField.adjoin k {XK k K}).val (AdjoinSimple.gen k (XK k K))) p :=
        (Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply _ _ _).symm
    _ = aeval (XK k K) p := by rw [hgen]

name: FunctionField.Chart.coe_ratFuncAlgEquiv_XK
statement:
theorem coe_ratFuncAlgEquiv_XK (c : k⟮X⟯) :
    ((RatFunc.algEquivOfTranscendental (XK k K) (transcendental_XK k K) c :
        IntermediateField.adjoin k {XK k K}) : K)
      = algebraMap k⟮X⟯ K c
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← RatFunc.num_div_denom c]
  rw [map_div₀, RatFunc.algEquivOfTranscendental_algebraMap,
    RatFunc.algEquivOfTranscendental_algebraMap, IntermediateField.coe_div,
    coe_aeval_adjoinSimple_gen_XK, coe_aeval_adjoinSimple_gen_XK,
    algebraMap_ratFunc_eq_div]

name: FunctionField.Chart.finrank_eq_finrank_rationalSubfield_XK
statement:
theorem finrank_eq_finrank_rationalSubfield_XK :
    Module.finrank k⟮X⟯ K =
      Module.finrank (rationalSubfield k K (algebraMap k⟮X⟯ K (RatFunc.X : k⟮X⟯))) K
proof:
:= by
  refine Algebra.finrank_eq_of_equiv_equiv
    (RatFunc.algEquivOfTranscendental (XK k K) (transcendental_XK k K)).toRingEquiv
    (RingEquiv.refl K) ?_
  ext c
  show algebraMap (IntermediateField.adjoin k {XK k K}) K
      (RatFunc.algEquivOfTranscendental (XK k K) (transcendental_XK k K) c)
    = algebraMap k⟮X⟯ K c
  rw [IntermediateField.algebraMap_apply]
  exact coe_ratFuncAlgEquiv_XK k K c

name: FunctionField.Chart.isAlgebraic_adjoin_XK
statement:
theorem isAlgebraic_adjoin_XK (z : K) :
    IsAlgebraic (Algebra.adjoin k {XK k K}) z
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : IsAlgebraic k⟮X⟯ z := Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic z
  have h2 : IsAlgebraic k[X] z := (IsFractionRing.isAlgebraic_iff k[X] k⟮X⟯ K).mpr h1
  obtain ⟨p, hp0, hpz⟩ := h2
  set e := Polynomial.algEquivOfTranscendental k (XK k K) (transcendental_XK k K) with he
  have hcomp : ((Algebra.adjoin k {XK k K}).val.comp e.toAlgHom : k[X] →ₐ[k] K)
      = IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k k[X] K := by
    refine Polynomial.algHom_ext ?_
    rw [AlgHom.comp_apply]
    have hex : e.toAlgHom X = e X := rfl
    rw [hex, he, Polynomial.algEquivOfTranscendental_apply_X,
      IsScalarTower.toAlgHom_apply, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k[X] k⟮X⟯ K,
      RatFunc.algebraMap_X]
    rfl
  refine ⟨p.map (e : k[X] →+* Algebra.adjoin k {XK k K}), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (Polynomial.map_ne_zero_iff e.injective).mpr hp0
  · rw [aeval_def, Polynomial.eval₂_map]
    have hring : ((algebraMap (Algebra.adjoin k {XK k K}) K).comp
        (e : k[X] →+* Algebra.adjoin k {XK k K})) = algebraMap k[X] K := by
      have := congrArg AlgHom.toRingHom hcomp
      exact this
    rw [hring, ← aeval_def]
    exact hpz

name: FunctionField.Chart.isAlgebraic_adjoin_x_XK
statement:
theorem isAlgebraic_adjoin_x_XK {x : K} (hx : Transcendental k x) :
    IsAlgebraic (Algebra.adjoin k {x}) (XK k K)
proof:
:= by
  have h := IsAlgebraic.adjoin_singleton (R := k) (A := K) (B := K)
    (transcendental_XK k K) hx (isAlgebraic_adjoin_XK k K x)
  simpa using h

name: FunctionField.Chart.isAlgebraic_rationalSubfield_XK
statement:
theorem isAlgebraic_rationalSubfield_XK {x : K} (hx : Transcendental k x) :
    IsAlgebraic (rationalSubfield k K x) (XK k K)
proof:
:= by
  have hle : Algebra.adjoin k {x} ≤ (rationalSubfield k K x).toSubalgebra := by
    refine Algebra.adjoin_le ?_
    intro y hy
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
    subst hy
    exact IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k {y} rfl
  exact (isAlgebraic_adjoin_x_XK k K hx).tower_top_of_subalgebra_le hle

name: FunctionField.Chart.finiteDimensional_rationalSubfield
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_rationalSubfield {x : K} (hx : Transcendental k x) :
    FiniteDimensional (rationalSubfield k K x) K
proof:
:= by
  set F := rationalSubfield k K x with hF
  set t := XK k K with ht
  have htF : IsIntegral F t := (isAlgebraic_rationalSubfield_XK k K hx).isIntegral
  haveI hFN : FiniteDimensional F (IntermediateField.adjoin F {t}) :=
    IntermediateField.adjoin.finiteDimensional htF
  set N := IntermediateField.adjoin F {t} with hN
  
  have haev : ∀ p : k[X], aeval t p ∈ N := by
    intro p
    have h1 : aeval t (p.map (algebraMap k F)) = aeval t p :=
      Polynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap F t p
    rw [← h1]
    have h2 : aeval t (p.map (algebraMap k F)) ∈ Algebra.adjoin F ({t} : Set K) := by
      rw [Algebra.adjoin_singleton_eq_range_aeval]
      exact ⟨p.map (algebraMap k F), rfl⟩
    exact IntermediateField.algebra_adjoin_le_adjoin F {t} h2
  
  have hE : ∀ c : k⟮X⟯, algebraMap k⟮X⟯ K c ∈ N := by
    intro c
    rw [algebraMap_ratFunc_eq_div]
    exact div_mem (haev c.num) (haev c.denom)
  
  have hsub : ∀ z : K, z ∈ Algebra.adjoin k ({t} : Set K) → z ∈ N := by
    intro z hz
    rw [Algebra.adjoin_singleton_eq_range_aeval] at hz
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hz
    exact haev p
  
  let χ : Algebra.adjoin k ({t} : Set K) →+* N :=
    { toFun := fun a => ⟨a.1, hsub a.1 a.2⟩
      map_one' := rfl
      map_mul' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_zero' := rfl
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl }
  have hχinj : Function.Injective χ := by
    intro a b hab
    have h : (a : K) = (b : K) := congrArg (fun z : N => (z : K)) hab
    exact Subtype.ext h
  
  set b := Module.finBasis k⟮X⟯ K with hb
  
  have hbN : ∀ i, IsIntegral N (b i) := by
    intro i
    refine IsAlgebraic.isIntegral ?_
    obtain ⟨p, hp0, hpz⟩ := isAlgebraic_adjoin_XK k K (b i)
    refine ⟨p.map χ, (Polynomial.map_ne_zero_iff hχinj).mpr hp0, ?_⟩
    rw [aeval_def, Polynomial.eval₂_map]
    have hring : (algebraMap N K).comp χ
        = algebraMap (Algebra.adjoin k ({t} : Set K)) K := RingHom.ext fun a => rfl
    rw [hring, ← aeval_def]
    exact hpz
  
  have htop : IntermediateField.adjoin N (Set.range ⇑b) = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    rintro z -
    have hz := b.sum_repr z
    rw [← hz]
    refine sum_mem fun i _ => ?_
    rw [Algebra.smul_def]
    refine mul_mem ?_ (IntermediateField.subset_adjoin N _ ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    have hmem := hE (b.repr z i)
    have := IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem (IntermediateField.adjoin N (Set.range ⇑b))
      (⟨algebraMap k⟮X⟯ K (b.repr z i), hmem⟩ : N)
    rwa [IntermediateField.algebraMap_apply] at this
  haveI hfin : Finite (Set.range ⇑b) := (Set.finite_range ⇑b).to_subtype
  haveI hNtop : FiniteDimensional N (IntermediateField.adjoin N (Set.range ⇑b)) :=
    IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_adjoin fun z hz => by
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hz
      exact hbN i
  haveI hNK : FiniteDimensional N K := by
    rw [htop] at hNtop
    exact (IntermediateField.topEquiv (F := N) (E := K)).toLinearEquiv.finiteDimensional
  exact Module.Finite.trans N K

name: FunctionField.Chart.finrankAdjoin_le_deg_polar
statement:
theorem finrankAdjoin_le_deg_polar {x : K} (hx : ¬IsAlgebraic k x) :
    Module.finrank (rationalSubfield k K x) K ≤ deg k K (polarDivisor k K x)
proof:
:= by
  have hxT : Transcendental k x := hx
  by_cases hx0 : x = 0
  · subst hx0
    exact absurd isAlgebraic_zero hx
  haveI := finiteDimensional_rationalSubfield (k := k) (K := K) hxT
  let F := rationalSubfield k K x
  let n := Module.finrank F K
  let b := Module.finBasis F K
  let C := basisPoleBound k K b
  let B := polarDivisor k K x
  have hBpos : 0 < deg k K B := polarDivisor_pos k K hx0 hx
  have hBnn : 0 ≤ B := polarDivisor_nonneg k K x
  have hBeff : IsEffective k K B := polarDivisor_nonneg k K x
  have hdegB0 := deg_nonneg k K hBeff
  have hdpos : 0 < (deg k K B).toNat := by
    rw [← Int.toNat_of_nonneg hdegB0] at hBpos
    exact Int.ofNat_lt.mp hBpos
  have hmain : n ≤ (deg k K B).toNat :=
    le_of_forall_nat_mul_le (d := (deg k K B).toNat) (c := (deg k K C).toNat + 1) hdpos fun r => by
      let D := C + r • B
      have hDnn : 0 ≤ D := add_nonneg (basisPoleBound_nonneg k K b) fun v =>
        mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg r) (hBnn v)
      have hDeff : IsEffective k K D := hDnn
      have hCeff : IsEffective k K C := basisPoleBound_nonneg k K b
      let v : Fin n × Fin (r + 1) → K := fun p => (b p.1 : K) * x ^ (p.2 : ℕ)
      have hmem : ∀ p, v p ∈ RRspace k K D := by
        intro p
        rw [mem_RRspace_iff]
        exact memRRspace_basis_smul_x_pow (k := k) (K := K) (f := b) x hx0 r p.1 (p.2 : ℕ)
          (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Fin.is_lt p.2))
      have hlin : LinearIndependent k v :=
        linearIndependent_basis_smul_x_pow (k := k) (K := K) hxT b
      have hsubset : span k (Set.range v) ≤ RRspace k K D := by
        refine span_le.mpr ?_
        rintro _ ⟨p, rfl⟩
        exact hmem p
      have hcard :
          n * (r + 1) ≤ Module.finrank k (span k (Set.range v)) := by
        have heq_card := finrank_span_eq_card (R := k) (M := K) hlin
        simp [heq_card, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin]
      have hle : Module.finrank k (span k (Set.range v)) ≤ ell k K D :=
        Submodule.finrank_mono hsubset
      have hell : (ell k K D : ℤ) ≤ deg k K D + 1 :=
        ell_le_nonneg (k := k) (K := K) hDnn
      have hdeg : deg k K D = deg k K C + (r : ℤ) * deg k K B := by
        rw [add_comm, ← nsmul_eq_mul, deg_add, deg_nsmul, nsmul_eq_mul, add_comm]
      have hell_nat : n * (r + 1) ≤ ell k K D := Nat.le_trans hcard hle
      have hbound : (n * (r + 1) : ℤ) ≤ deg k K D + 1 :=
        (Nat.cast_le.mpr hell_nat).trans hell
      have hC0 := deg_nonneg k K hCeff
      have htoC : ((deg k K C).toNat : ℤ) = deg k K C := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hC0
      have htoB : ((deg k K B).toNat : ℤ) = deg k K B := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hdegB0
      have hsum :
          deg k K D + 1 = (deg k K B).toNat * r + ((deg k K C).toNat + 1) := by
        rw [hdeg, htoC, htoB]
        ring
      have hnat_z :
          (n * (r + 1) : ℤ) ≤ (deg k K B).toNat * r + ((deg k K C).toNat + 1) := by
        rw [← hsum]
        exact hbound
      exact_mod_cast hnat_z
  have hdegB := deg_nonneg k K hBeff
  rw [← Int.toNat_of_nonneg hdegB]
  exact_mod_cast hmain

name: FunctionField.Chart.deg_polar_le_finrank
statement:
theorem deg_polar_le_finrank {x : K} (hx : ¬IsAlgebraic k x)
    (hxgen : x = algebraMap k⟮X⟯ K (RatFunc.X : k⟮X⟯)) :
    Module.finrank k⟮X⟯ K ≤ deg k K (polarDivisor k K x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hxgen] at hx ⊢
  have h := finrankAdjoin_le_deg_polar (k := k) (K := K) hx
  have hfin :
      Module.finrank k⟮X⟯ K =
        Module.finrank (rationalSubfield k K (algebraMap k⟮X⟯ K (RatFunc.X : k⟮X⟯))) K :=
    finrank_eq_finrank_rationalSubfield_XK k K
  exact hfin ▸ h

name: FunctionField.Chart.ell_zero_pos
statement: theorem ell_zero_pos : 0 < ell k K (0 : DivisorA k K)
proof:
:= by
  letI : FiniteDimensional k (RRspace k K (0 : DivisorA k K)) :=
    finiteDimensional_RRspace_aux k K 0
  rw [ell, Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero]
  refine ⟨⟨1, memRRspace.one_mem (k := k) (K := K)⟩, ?_⟩
  intro h
  exact one_ne_zero (congrArg Subtype.val h)

name: FunctionField.Chart.ell_le_generalConstants
statement:
theorem ell_le_generalConstants (D : DivisorA k K) :
    (ell k K D : ℤ) ≤ deg k K (D ⊔ 0) + ell k K (0 : DivisorA k K)
proof:
:= by
  let E := D ⊔ 0
  have h0E : (0 : DivisorA k K) ≤ E := le_sup_right
  have hDE : D ≤ E := le_sup_left
  have hdegE : 0 ≤ deg k K E := deg_nonneg k K h0E
  have hq := finrank_RRspace_quotient_le k K h0E
  have hsum := finrankRRspaceDiff_add_ell k K h0E
  have hmono : ell k K D ≤ ell k K E :=
    Submodule.finrank_mono (RRspace_mono k K hDE)
  have htoNat : ((deg k K E).toNat : ℤ) = deg k K E :=
    Int.toNat_of_nonneg hdegE
  have hqZ : (finrankRRspaceDiff k K 0 E : ℤ) ≤
      ((deg k K (E - 0)).toNat : ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hq
  simp only [sub_zero] at hqZ
  rw [htoNat] at hqZ
  have hsumZ :
      (finrankRRspaceDiff k K 0 E : ℤ) + ell k K (0 : DivisorA k K) =
        ell k K E := by
    exact_mod_cast hsum
  change (ell k K D : ℤ) ≤ deg k K E + ell k K (0 : DivisorA k K)
  omega

name: FunctionField.Chart.ell_le_nonneg_generalConstants
statement:
theorem ell_le_nonneg_generalConstants {D : DivisorA k K} (hD : 0 ≤ D) :
    (ell k K D : ℤ) ≤ deg k K D + ell k K (0 : DivisorA k K)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [sup_eq_left.mpr hD] using ell_le_generalConstants k K D

name: FunctionField.Chart.finrank_le_deg_polarX_generalConstants
statement:
theorem finrank_le_deg_polarX_generalConstants :
    Module.finrank k⟮X⟯ K ≤ deg k K (polarDivisor k K (XK k K))
proof:
:= by
  let n := Module.finrank k⟮X⟯ K
  let b := Module.finBasis k⟮X⟯ K
  let C := basisPoleBound k K b
  let B := polarDivisor k K (XK k K)
  have hx : ¬IsAlgebraic k (XK k K) := not_algebraic_XK k K
  have hx0 : XK k K ≠ 0 := XK_ne_zero k K
  have hBpos : 0 < deg k K B := polarDivisor_pos k K hx0 hx
  have hBnn : 0 ≤ B := polarDivisor_nonneg k K (XK k K)
  have hBeff : IsEffective k K B := hBnn
  have hdegB0 := deg_nonneg k K hBeff
  have hdpos : 0 < (deg k K B).toNat := by
    rw [← Int.toNat_of_nonneg hdegB0] at hBpos
    exact Int.ofNat_lt.mp hBpos
  have hmain : n ≤ (deg k K B).toNat :=
    le_of_forall_nat_mul_le
      (d := (deg k K B).toNat)
      (c := (deg k K C).toNat + ell k K (0 : DivisorA k K)) hdpos fun r ↦ by
        let D := C + r • B
        have hDnn : 0 ≤ D := add_nonneg (basisPoleBound_nonneg k K b) fun v ↦
          mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg r) (hBnn v)
        have hCeff : IsEffective k K C := basisPoleBound_nonneg k K b
        have hell : (ell k K D : ℤ) ≤
            deg k K D + ell k K (0 : DivisorA k K) :=
          ell_le_nonneg_generalConstants (k := k) (K := K) hDnn
        have hdeg : deg k K D = deg k K C + (r : ℤ) * deg k K B := by
          rw [add_comm, ← nsmul_eq_mul, deg_add, deg_nsmul, nsmul_eq_mul, add_comm]
        have hellNat : n * (r + 1) ≤ ell k K D :=
          ell_family_ge (k := k) (K := K) (n := n) (r := r) b
        have hbound : (n * (r + 1) : ℤ) ≤
            deg k K D + ell k K (0 : DivisorA k K) :=
          (Nat.cast_le.mpr hellNat).trans hell
        have hC0 := deg_nonneg k K hCeff
        have htoC : ((deg k K C).toNat : ℤ) = deg k K C :=
          Int.toNat_of_nonneg hC0
        have htoB : ((deg k K B).toNat : ℤ) = deg k K B :=
          Int.toNat_of_nonneg hdegB0
        have hsum :
            deg k K D + ell k K (0 : DivisorA k K) =
              (deg k K B).toNat * r +
                ((deg k K C).toNat + ell k K (0 : DivisorA k K)) := by
          rw [hdeg, htoC, htoB]
          ring
        have hnatZ :
            (n * (r + 1) : ℤ) ≤
              (deg k K B).toNat * r +
                ((deg k K C).toNat + ell k K (0 : DivisorA k K)) := by
          rw [← hsum]
          exact hbound
        exact_mod_cast hnatZ
  rw [← Int.toNat_of_nonneg hdegB0]
  exact_mod_cast hmain

name: FunctionField.Chart.deg_polarX_eq_finrank_generalConstants
statement:
theorem deg_polarX_eq_finrank_generalConstants :
    deg k K (polarDivisor k K (XK k K)) = Module.finrank k⟮X⟯ K
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (deg_polarX_le_finrank (k := k) (K := K))
    (finrank_le_deg_polarX_generalConstants (k := k) (K := K))

name: FunctionField.Chart.defectWithConstants_mono
statement:
theorem defectWithConstants_mono {D D' : DivisorA k K} (h : D ≤ D') :
    defectWithConstants k K D ≤ defectWithConstants k K D'
proof:
:= by
  have hmono := defect_mono (k := k) (K := K) h
  dsimp only [defectWithConstants]
  omega

name: FunctionField.Chart.defectWithConstants_add_principal
statement:
theorem defectWithConstants_add_principal (D : DivisorA k K) (x : Kˣ) :
    defectWithConstants k K (D + principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul x)) =
      defectWithConstants k K D
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [defectWithConstants]
  rw [deg_add, deg_principalDivisor_eq_zero (k := k) (K := K) x,
    ell_add_principal, add_zero]

name: FunctionField.Chart.defectWithConstants_le_of_family
statement:
theorem defectWithConstants_le_of_family (B C : DivisorA k K) (c0 : ℤ)
    (hmono : ∀ r : ℕ, defectWithConstants k K (C + r • B) ≤ c0)
    (hgrow : ∀ m : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, m ≤ ell k K (C + r • B)) :
    ∀ D : DivisorA k K, defectWithConstants k K D ≤ c0
proof:
:= by
  intro D
  let Dpos := D ⊔ (0 : DivisorA k K)
  have hDle : D ≤ Dpos := le_sup_left
  have hDposEff : IsEffective k K Dpos := fun v ↦ le_max_right (D v) 0
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hgrow (deg k K Dpos + ell k K (0 : DivisorA k K))
  let Dr := C + r • B
  have hsub := ell_sub_effective_sub_ge (k := k) (K := K)
    (D := Dr - Dpos) (E := Dpos) hDposEff
  rw [sub_add_cancel] at hsub
  have hellPos : 0 < ell k K (Dr - Dpos) := by
    have hellZero : 0 < ell k K (0 : DivisorA k K) := ell_zero_pos k K
    linarith
  obtain ⟨f, hfne⟩ := (Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero (R := k)).1 hellPos
  let fK : K := f.val
  have hfKne : fK ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hfne (Subtype.ext h)
  have hmem : memRRspace k K (Dr - Dpos) fK := f.property
  have hDposLe :
      Dpos ≤ Dr + principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 fK hfKne)) :=
    le_add_principal_of_memRRspace (k := k) (K := K) hfKne hmem
  have hDle' :
      D ≤ Dr + principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 fK hfKne)) :=
    hDle.trans hDposLe
  calc
    defectWithConstants k K D ≤
        defectWithConstants k K
          (Dr + principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 fK hfKne))) :=
      defectWithConstants_mono (k := k) (K := K) hDle'
    _ = defectWithConstants k K Dr :=
      defectWithConstants_add_principal (k := k) (K := K) Dr _
    _ ≤ c0 := hmono r

name: FunctionField.Chart.defectWithConstants_le_chart_family
statement:
theorem defectWithConstants_le_chart_family (D : DivisorA k K) :
    defectWithConstants k K D ≤
      deg k K (basisPoleBound k K (Module.finBasis k⟮X⟯ K)) +
        ell k K (0 : DivisorA k K) - Module.finrank k⟮X⟯ K
proof:
:= by
  let b := Module.finBasis k⟮X⟯ K
  let n := Module.finrank k⟮X⟯ K
  let C := basisPoleBound k K b
  let B := polarDivisor k K (XK k K)
  let c0 := deg k K C + ell k K (0 : DivisorA k K) - n
  have hmono : ∀ r : ℕ, defectWithConstants k K (C + r • B) ≤ c0 := by
    intro r
    have hdeg : deg k K (C + r • B) = deg k K C + (r : ℤ) * deg k K B := by
      rw [add_comm, ← nsmul_eq_mul, deg_add, deg_nsmul, nsmul_eq_mul, add_comm]
    have hell := ell_family_ge (k := k) (K := K) (n := n) (r := r) b
    have hBdeg : deg k K B = (n : ℤ) :=
      deg_polarX_eq_finrank_generalConstants (k := k) (K := K)
    have hcast : (n * (r + 1) : ℤ) ≤ ell k K (C + r • B) :=
      Nat.cast_le.mpr hell
    dsimp only [defectWithConstants]
    rw [hdeg, hBdeg]
    linarith
  have hn : 0 < n := Module.finrank_pos
  have hgrow : ∀ m : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, m ≤ ell k K (C + r • B) := by
    intro m
    by_cases hm : m ≤ 0
    · refine ⟨0, hm.trans ?_⟩
      positivity
    · have hmpos : 0 < m := by omega
      let mnat := Int.toNat m
      have hmNat : (mnat : ℤ) = m := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hmpos)
      refine ⟨mnat, ?_⟩
      have hge := ell_family_ge (k := k) (K := K) (n := n) (r := mnat) b
      have hcast : (n * (mnat + 1) : ℤ) ≤ ell k K (C + mnat • B) :=
        Nat.cast_le.mpr hge
      have hbound : m ≤ (n * (mnat + 1) : ℤ) := by
        rw [← hmNat]
        have hn1 : (1 : ℤ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
        nlinarith [show (0 : ℤ) < m from hmpos]
      exact hbound.trans hcast
  exact defectWithConstants_le_of_family (k := k) (K := K) B C c0 hmono hgrow D

name: FunctionField.Chart.exists_max_defectWithConstants
statement:
theorem exists_max_defectWithConstants :
    ∃ g : ℕ,
      (∀ D : DivisorA k K, defectWithConstants k K D ≤ (g : ℤ)) ∧
        ∃ D : DivisorA k K, defectWithConstants k K D = (g : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  let b := Module.finBasis k⟮X⟯ K
  let n := Module.finrank k⟮X⟯ K
  let C := basisPoleBound k K b
  let c0 := deg k K C + ell k K (0 : DivisorA k K) - n
  have hbound : ∀ D : DivisorA k K, defectWithConstants k K D ≤ c0 :=
    fun D ↦ defectWithConstants_le_chart_family (k := k) (K := K) D
  have hzero : defectWithConstants k K (0 : DivisorA k K) = 0 := by
    dsimp only [defectWithConstants]
    rw [deg_zero (k := k) (K := K)]
    omega
  have hInh : ∃ z : ℤ, ∃ D : DivisorA k K, defectWithConstants k K D = z :=
    ⟨0, 0, hzero⟩
  have hBdd :
      ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ z : ℤ, (∃ D : DivisorA k K, defectWithConstants k K D = z) → z ≤ b := by
    refine ⟨c0, ?_⟩
    intro z ⟨D, hD⟩
    simpa [hD] using hbound D
  obtain ⟨g', hg', hgmax⟩ := Int.exists_greatest_of_bdd hBdd hInh
  have hgNonneg : 0 ≤ g' := hgmax 0 ⟨0, hzero⟩
  refine ⟨g'.toNat, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro D
    calc
      defectWithConstants k K D ≤ g' := hgmax _ ⟨D, rfl⟩
      _ = (g'.toNat : ℤ) := (Int.toNat_of_nonneg hgNonneg).symm
  · obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := hg'
    refine ⟨D, ?_⟩
    rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg hgNonneg]
    exact hD

name: FunctionField.Chart.riemann_ineq_withConstants
statement:
theorem riemann_ineq_withConstants (D : DivisorA k K) :
    (ell k K D : ℤ) ≥
      deg k K D + ell k K (0 : DivisorA k K) - genusWithConstants k K
proof:
:= by
  have h := (Classical.choose_spec (exists_max_defectWithConstants k K)).1 D
  simp only [defectWithConstants, genusWithConstants] at h ⊢
  omega

name: FunctionField.Chart.defectWithConstants_le
statement:
theorem defectWithConstants_le (D : DivisorA k K) :
    defectWithConstants k K D ≤ genusWithConstants k K
proof:
:= by
  have h := riemann_ineq_withConstants k K D
  simp only [defectWithConstants]
  omega

name: FunctionField.Chart.exists_defectWithConstants_eq
statement:
theorem exists_defectWithConstants_eq :
    ∃ D : DivisorA k K, defectWithConstants k K D = genusWithConstants k K
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [genusWithConstants] using
    (Classical.choose_spec (exists_max_defectWithConstants k K)).2

name: FunctionField.Chart.indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants_eq
statement:
theorem indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants_eq (D : DivisorA k K) :
    (indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants k K D : ℤ) =
      ell k K D -
        (deg k K D + ell k K (0 : DivisorA k K) - genusWithConstants k K)
proof:
:= by
  have h := riemann_ineq_withConstants k K D
  rw [indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants, Int.toNat_of_nonneg]
  omega

name: FunctionField.Chart.defectWithConstants_eq_defect
statement:
theorem defectWithConstants_eq_defect [IsFullConstantField k K] (D : DivisorA k K) :
    defectWithConstants k K D = defect k K D
proof:
:= by
  simp only [defectWithConstants, defect, ell_zero (k := k) (K := K)]
  norm_num

name: FunctionField.Chart.genusWithConstants_eq_genus
statement:
theorem genusWithConstants_eq_genus [IsFullConstantField k K] :
    genusWithConstants k K = genus k K
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Dg, hDg⟩ := exists_defectWithConstants_eq (k := k) (K := K)
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := exists_defect_eq (k := k) (K := K)
  have hle : (genusWithConstants k K : ℤ) ≤ genus k K := by
    rw [← hDg, defectWithConstants_eq_defect]
    exact defect_le (k := k) (K := K) Dg
  have hge : (genus k K : ℤ) ≤ genusWithConstants k K := by
    rw [← hD, ← defectWithConstants_eq_defect]
    exact defectWithConstants_le (k := k) (K := K) D
  exact_mod_cast le_antisymm hle hge

name: FunctionField.Chart.indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants_eq_indexOfSpecialty
statement:
theorem indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants_eq_indexOfSpecialty [IsFullConstantField k K]
    (D : DivisorA k K) :
    indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants k K D = indexOfSpecialty k K D
proof:
:= by
  simp only [indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants, indexOfSpecialty, ell_zero (k := k) (K := K),
    genusWithConstants_eq_genus (k := k) (K := K)]
  norm_num

name: FunctionField.Chart.deg_polarX_eq_finrank
statement:
theorem deg_polarX_eq_finrank :
    deg k K (polarDivisor k K (XK k K)) = Module.finrank k⟮X⟯ K
proof:
:= by
  exact le_antisymm (deg_polarX_le_finrank (k := k) (K := K))
    (finrank_le_deg_polarX (k := k) (K := K))

name: FunctionField.Chart.defect_mono'
statement:
theorem defect_mono' {D D' : DivisorA k K} (h : D ≤ D') :
    defect k K D ≤ defect k K D'
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [defect]
  have := defect_mono (k := k) (K := K) h
  omega

name: FunctionField.Chart.defect_add_principal
statement:
theorem defect_add_principal (D : DivisorA k K) (x : Kˣ) :
    defect k K (D + principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul x)) = defect k K D
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [defect]
  rw [deg_add, deg_principalDivisor_eq_zero (k := k) (K := K) x, ell_add_principal, add_zero]

name: FunctionField.Chart.le_add_principal_of_memRRspace
statement:
theorem le_add_principal_of_memRRspace {D₀ D₁ : DivisorA k K} {f : K} (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (hmem : memRRspace k K (D₁ - D₀) f) :
    D₀ ≤ D₁ + principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 f hf))
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_iff_sub_effective]
  intro v
  dsimp only [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.sub_apply]
  have hv := hmem v
  have hxval := placeValuation_eq_exp_neg_principalDivisor k K (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 f hf)) v
  change placeValuation k K v f ≤ WithZero.exp ((D₁ - D₀) v) at hv
  change placeValuation k K v f =
    WithZero.exp (-(principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 f hf)) v)) at hxval
  rw [hxval] at hv
  have hexp := WithZero.exp_le_exp.mp hv
  have hsubv : (D₁ - D₀) v = D₁ v - D₀ v := rfl
  have hexp' :
      -(principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 f hf)) v) ≤ D₁ v - D₀ v := by
    simpa [hsubv] using hexp
  linarith

name: FunctionField.Chart.ell_sub_effective_sub_ge
statement:
theorem ell_sub_effective_sub_ge {D E : DivisorA k K} (hE : IsEffective k K E) :
    (ell k K (D + E) : ℤ) - deg k K E ≤ ell k K D
proof:
:= by
  have hle : D ≤ D + E := by
    intro v
    simp only [Finsupp.add_apply]
    linarith [hE v]
  have hsum := finrankRRspaceDiff_add_ell (k := k) (K := K) hle
  have hq := finrankRRspaceDiff_add_effective_le (k := k) (K := K) D E hE
  have hdeg : 0 ≤ deg k K E := deg_nonneg (k := k) (K := K) hE
  have htoNat : ((deg k K E).toNat : ℤ) = deg k K E := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hdeg
  have hqZ : (finrankRRspaceDiff k K D (D + E) : ℤ) ≤ deg k K E := by
    rw [← htoNat]
    exact_mod_cast hq
  have hsum' : (finrankRRspaceDiff k K D (D + E) : ℤ) + ell k K D = ell k K (D + E) := by
    exact_mod_cast hsum
  omega

name: FunctionField.Chart.defect_le_of_family
statement:
theorem defect_le_of_family (B C : DivisorA k K) (c₀ : ℤ)
    (hmono : ∀ r : ℕ, defect k K (C + r • B) ≤ c₀)
    (hgrow : ∀ m : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, m ≤ ell k K (C + r • B)) :
    ∀ D : DivisorA k K, defect k K D ≤ c₀
proof:
:= by
  intro D
  let Dpos := D ⊔ (0 : DivisorA k K)
  have hDle : D ≤ Dpos := le_sup_left (a := D) (b := 0)
  have hDposeff : IsEffective k K Dpos := fun v => le_max_right (D v) 0
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hgrow (deg k K Dpos + 1)
  let Dr := C + r • B
  have hsub := ell_sub_effective_sub_ge (k := k) (K := K) (D := Dr - Dpos) (E := Dpos) hDposeff
  rw [sub_add_cancel] at hsub
  have hellpos : 0 < ell k K (Dr - Dpos) := by
    linarith
  obtain ⟨f, hfne⟩ := (Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero (R := k)).1 hellpos
  let fK : K := f.val
  have hfKne : fK ≠ 0 := fun h => hfne (Subtype.ext h)
  have hmem : memRRspace k K (Dr - Dpos) fK := f.property
  have hDposle : Dpos ≤ Dr + principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 fK hfKne)) :=
    le_add_principal_of_memRRspace (k := k) (K := K) hfKne hmem
  have hDle' : D ≤ Dr + principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 fK hfKne)) :=
    le_trans hDle hDposle
  calc
    defect k K D ≤
        defect k K (Dr + principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 fK hfKne))) :=
      defect_mono' (k := k) (K := K) hDle'
    _ = defect k K Dr := defect_add_principal (k := k) (K := K) Dr _
    _ ≤ c₀ := hmono r

name: FunctionField.Chart.defect_le_chart_family
statement:
theorem defect_le_chart_family (D : DivisorA k K) :
    defect k K D ≤
      deg k K (basisPoleBound k K (Module.finBasis k⟮X⟯ K)) + 1 -
        Module.finrank k⟮X⟯ K
proof:
:= by
  let b := Module.finBasis k⟮X⟯ K
  let n := Module.finrank k⟮X⟯ K
  let C := basisPoleBound k K b
  let B := polarDivisor k K (XK k K)
  let c₀ := deg k K C + 1 - n
  have hmono : ∀ r : ℕ, defect k K (C + r • B) ≤ c₀ := by
    intro r
    have hdeg : deg k K (C + r • B) = deg k K C + (r : ℤ) * deg k K B := by
      rw [add_comm, ← nsmul_eq_mul, deg_add, deg_nsmul, nsmul_eq_mul, add_comm]
    have hell := ell_family_ge (k := k) (K := K) (n := n) (r := r) b
    have hBdeg : deg k K B = (n : ℤ) := deg_polarX_eq_finrank (k := k) (K := K)
    have hcast : (n * (r + 1) : ℤ) ≤ ell k K (C + r • B) := Nat.cast_le.mpr hell
    dsimp only [defect]
    rw [hdeg, hBdeg]
    linarith
  have hn : 0 < n := Module.finrank_pos
  have hgrow : ∀ m : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, m ≤ ell k K (C + r • B) := by
    intro m
    by_cases hm : m ≤ 0
    · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      have h0le : (0 : DivisorA k K) ≤ C + 0 • B := fun v =>
        show 0 ≤ (C + 0 • B) v by
          simpa [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.nsmul_apply] using
            basisPoleBound_nonneg (k := k) (K := K) b v
      have hmono0 : (ell k K (0 : DivisorA k K) : ℤ) ≤ ell k K (C + 0 • B) := by
        exact_mod_cast Submodule.finrank_mono (RRspace_mono (k := k) (K := K) h0le)
      rw [ell_zero (k := k) (K := K)] at hmono0
      linarith
    · have hmpos : 0 < m := by omega
      let mnat := Int.toNat m
      have hmNat : (mnat : ℤ) = m := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hmpos)
      refine ⟨mnat, ?_⟩
      have hge := ell_family_ge (k := k) (K := K) (n := n) (r := mnat) b
      have hcast : (n * (mnat + 1) : ℤ) ≤ ell k K (C + mnat • B) := Nat.cast_le.mpr hge
      have hbound : m ≤ (n * (mnat + 1) : ℤ) := by
        rw [← hmNat]
        have hn1 : (1 : ℤ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
        nlinarith [show (0 : ℤ) < m from hmpos]
      linarith
  exact defect_le_of_family (k := k) (K := K) B C c₀ hmono hgrow D

name: FunctionField.Chart.exists_max_defect
statement:
theorem exists_max_defect :
    ∃ g : ℕ, (∀ D : DivisorA k K, defect k K D ≤ (g : ℤ)) ∧
      ∃ D : DivisorA k K, defect k K D = (g : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  let b := Module.finBasis k⟮X⟯ K
  let n := Module.finrank k⟮X⟯ K
  let C := basisPoleBound k K b
  let c₀ := deg k K C + 1 - n
  have hbound : ∀ D : DivisorA k K, defect k K D ≤ c₀ :=
    fun D => defect_le_chart_family (k := k) (K := K) D
  have hzero : defect k K (0 : DivisorA k K) = 0 := by
    dsimp only [defect]
    rw [deg_zero (k := k) (K := K), ell_zero (k := k) (K := K)]
    omega
  have hInh : ∃ z : ℤ, ∃ D : DivisorA k K, defect k K D = z := ⟨0, 0, hzero⟩
  have hBdd : ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ z : ℤ, (∃ D : DivisorA k K, defect k K D = z) → z ≤ b := by
    refine ⟨c₀, ?_⟩
    intro z ⟨D, hD⟩
    simpa [hD] using hbound D
  obtain ⟨g', hg', hgmax⟩ := Int.exists_greatest_of_bdd hBdd hInh
  have hg'nn : 0 ≤ g' := hgmax 0 ⟨0, hzero⟩
  refine ⟨g'.toNat, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro D
    have hle := hgmax (defect k K D) ⟨D, rfl⟩
    calc defect k K D ≤ g' := hle
      _ = (g'.toNat : ℤ) := (Int.toNat_of_nonneg hg'nn).symm
  · obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := hg'
    refine ⟨D, ?_⟩
    rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg hg'nn]
    exact hD

name: FunctionField.Chart.riemann_ineq
statement:
theorem riemann_ineq (D : DivisorA k K) :
    (ell k K D : ℤ) ≥ deg k K D + 1 - (genus k K : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (Classical.choose_spec (exists_max_defect k K)).1 D
  simp only [defect, genus] at h ⊢
  omega

name: FunctionField.Chart.defect_le
statement: theorem defect_le (D : DivisorA k K) : defect k K D ≤ genus k K
proof:
:= by
  have h := riemann_ineq k K D
  simp only [defect]
  omega

name: FunctionField.Chart.exists_defect_eq
statement: theorem exists_defect_eq : ∃ D : DivisorA k K, defect k K D = genus k K
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [genus] using (Classical.choose_spec (exists_max_defect k K)).2

name: FunctionField.Chart.genus_le_of_family
statement:
theorem genus_le_of_family (B C : DivisorA k K) (c₀ : ℤ)
    (hmono : ∀ r : ℕ, defect k K (C + r • B) ≤ c₀)
    (hgrow : ∀ m : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, m ≤ ell k K (C + r • B)) :
    (genus k K : ℤ) ≤ c₀
proof:
:= by
  have hbound := defect_le_of_family (k := k) (K := K) B C c₀ hmono hgrow
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := exists_defect_eq (k := k) (K := K)
  simpa [hD] using hbound D

name: FunctionField.Chart.indexOfSpecialty_eq
statement:
theorem indexOfSpecialty_eq (D : DivisorA k K) :
    (indexOfSpecialty k K D : ℤ) = ell k K D - (deg k K D + 1 - (genus k K : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  have h := riemann_ineq k K D
  rw [indexOfSpecialty, Int.toNat_of_nonneg]
  omega

name: FunctionField.Chart.polar_deg_pos
statement:
theorem polar_deg_pos {x : K} (hx : ¬IsAlgebraic k x) :
    0 < deg k K (polarDivisor k K x)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx0 : x = 0
  · subst hx0
    exact absurd isAlgebraic_zero hx
  · exact polarDivisor_pos k K hx0 hx

name: FunctionField.Chart.genus_ratFunc
statement: theorem genus_ratFunc : genus k (RatFunc k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let K := k⟮X⟯
  have hn : Module.finrank k⟮X⟯ K = 1 := Module.finrank_self k⟮X⟯
  let hb : Module.Basis (Fin 1) k⟮X⟯ K := Module.Basis.singleton (Fin 1) k⟮X⟯
  let B := polarDivisor k K (XK k K)
  let C := (0 : DivisorA k K)
  have hCeq : basisPoleBound k K hb = C := by
    have hpol : polarDivisor k K (1 : K) = 0 :=
      polarDivisor_eq_zero_of_algebraic (k := k) (K := K) isAlgebraic_one
    ext v
    simp only [basisPoleBound, C, Finsupp.zero_apply]
    rw [Finset.sum_fin_eq_sum_range, Finset.sum_range_one]
    dsimp [hb]
    simp only [Module.Basis.singleton_apply, hpol]
    rfl
  have hmono : ∀ r : ℕ, defect k K (C + r • B) ≤ 0 := by
    intro r
    dsimp only [defect]
    have hdeg : deg k K (C + r • B) = (r : ℤ) * deg k K B := by
      rw [zero_add, deg_nsmul]
    have hell := ell_family_ge (k := k) (K := K) (n := 1) (r := r) hb
    have hell' : ((r + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ (ell k K (C + r • B) : ℤ) := by
      have hellNat : r + 1 ≤ ell k K (C + r • B) := by
        simpa [hCeq, one_mul, B] using hell
      exact_mod_cast hellNat
    norm_num [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at hell'
    have hBdeg : deg k K B = 1 := by
      rw [deg_polarX_eq_finrank (k := k) (K := K)]
      exact_mod_cast hn
    rw [hdeg, hBdeg]
    linarith
  have hgrow : ∀ m : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, m ≤ ell k K (C + r • B) := by
    intro m
    by_cases hm : m ≤ 0
    · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      have h0le : (0 : DivisorA k K) ≤ C + 0 • B := fun v => by simp [C]
      have hmono0 : (ell k K (0 : DivisorA k K) : ℤ) ≤ ell k K (C + 0 • B) := by
        exact_mod_cast Submodule.finrank_mono (RRspace_mono (k := k) (K := K) h0le)
      rw [ell_zero (k := k) (K := K)] at hmono0
      linarith
    · have hmpos : 0 < m := by omega
      let mnat := Int.toNat m
      have hmNat : (mnat : ℤ) = m := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hmpos)
      refine ⟨mnat, ?_⟩
      have hge := ell_family_ge (k := k) (K := K) (n := 1) (r := mnat) hb
      have hcast : ((mnat + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ (ell k K (C + mnat • B) : ℤ) := by
        have hgeNat : mnat + 1 ≤ ell k K (C + mnat • B) := by
          simpa [hCeq, one_mul, B] using hge
        exact_mod_cast hgeNat
      norm_num [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at hcast
      linarith
  have hle : (genus k K : ℤ) ≤ 0 :=
    genus_le_of_family (k := k) (K := K) B C 0 hmono hgrow
  have hge : 0 ≤ (genus k K : ℤ) := by
    have := defect_le (k := k) (K := K) (0 : DivisorA k K)
    dsimp [defect] at this
    rw [deg_zero (k := k) (K := K), ell_zero (k := k) (K := K)] at this
    exact this
  linarith

name: FunctionField.Chart.defectWithConstants_eq_genus_of_ge
statement:
theorem defectWithConstants_eq_genus_of_ge {D D' : DivisorA k K} (hle : D ≤ D')
    (hD : defectWithConstants k K D = genusWithConstants k K) :
    defectWithConstants k K D' = genusWithConstants k K
proof:
:= by
  have hle' : defectWithConstants k K D ≤ defectWithConstants k K D' :=
    defectWithConstants_mono (k := k) (K := K) hle
  have hgen : defectWithConstants k K D' ≤ genusWithConstants k K :=
    defectWithConstants_le k K D'
  omega

name: FunctionField.Chart.sandwichRank_eq_zero_of_defectWithConstants_eq
statement:
theorem sandwichRank_eq_zero_of_defectWithConstants_eq
    {D D' : DivisorA k K} (hle : D ≤ D')
    (hD : defectWithConstants k K D = genusWithConstants k K) :
    sandwichRank k K D D' hle = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hD' : defectWithConstants k K D' = genusWithConstants k K :=
    defectWithConstants_eq_genus_of_ge (k := k) (K := K) hle hD
  have hs := sandwich (k := k) (K := K) hle
  dsimp only [defectWithConstants] at hD hD' ⊢
  rw [hs]
  omega

name: FunctionField.Chart.adeleSubmodule_top_eq_adeleFilt_add_diagonal_generalConstants
statement:
theorem adeleSubmodule_top_eq_adeleFilt_add_diagonal_generalConstants
    {D : DivisorA k K}
    (hD : defectWithConstants k K D = genusWithConstants k K) :
    topAdeleSubmodule k K = adeleFilt k K D + diagonalSubmodule k K
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro α _
    obtain ⟨Dα, hDα⟩ := exists_adeleFilt_mem (k := k) (K := K) α
    let D' := D ⊔ Dα
    have h0 := sandwichRank_eq_zero_of_defectWithConstants_eq
      (k := k) (K := K) (D := D) (D' := D')
      (le_sup_left (a := D) (b := Dα)) hD
    have heq := adeleFilt_add_diagonal_eq_of_sandwich_zero
      (k := k) (K := K) (D := D) (D' := D')
      (le_sup_left (a := D) (b := Dα)) h0
    have hmem : α ∈ adeleFilt k K D' + diagonalSubmodule k K :=
      Submodule.mem_sup_left (adeleFilt_mono (k := k) (K := K) le_sup_right hDα)
    rw [heq] at hmem
    exact hmem
  · exact le_top

name: FunctionField.Chart.finrank_adele_quotient_generalConstants
statement:
theorem finrank_adele_quotient_generalConstants (D : DivisorA k K) :
    finrankAdeleQuotient k K D = indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants k K D
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D₁, hD₁⟩ := exists_defectWithConstants_eq (k := k) (K := K)
  let D' := D ⊔ D₁
  have hle : D ≤ D' := le_sup_left (a := D) (b := D₁)
  have hD' : defectWithConstants k K D' = genusWithConstants k K :=
    defectWithConstants_eq_genus_of_ge (k := k) (K := K)
      (le_sup_right (a := D) (b := D₁)) hD₁
  have hfull := adeleSubmodule_top_eq_adeleFilt_add_diagonal_generalConstants
    (k := k) (K := K) hD'
  have hsand := sandwich (k := k) (K := K) hle
  have hfin := finrankAdeleQuotient_eq_sandwichRank
    (k := k) (K := K) hle hfull
  have hdef : sandwichRank k K D D' hle =
      defectWithConstants k K D' - defectWithConstants k K D := by
    dsimp only [defectWithConstants]
    rw [hsand]
    omega
  have hidx : (indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants k K D : ℤ) =
      genusWithConstants k K - defectWithConstants k K D := by
    have h := indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants_eq (k := k) (K := K) D
    dsimp only [defectWithConstants] at h ⊢
    omega
  calc
    finrankAdeleQuotient k K D =
        (sandwichRank k K D D' hle).toNat := hfin
    _ = (genusWithConstants k K - defectWithConstants k K D).toNat := by
      rw [hdef, hD']
    _ = indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants k K D := by
      rw [← hidx]
      simp only [Int.toNat_natCast]

name: FunctionField.Chart.maximalIdeal_infty_eq_span_t
proof:
:= by
  let v := RatFunc.inftyValuation k

  have hgen : (↑(Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.generator v) : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) =
      WithZero.exp (-1 : ℤ) := by
    have h := Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.generator_eq_exp_neg_one_of_mem_range
      (v := v) (show WithZero.exp (-1 : ℤ) ∈ Set.range v from ⟨tRatFunc k, hπval⟩)
    exact congrArg Units.val h
  have hπ : v.IsUniformizer (tA k : k⟮X⟯) := by
    rw [Valuation.IsUniformizer.iff, tRatFunc_coe k, hgen]
    exact hπval
  exact Valuation.IsUniformizer.is_generator hπ

statement:
theorem XK_mem_ringOfIntegers :

proof:
