name: FunctionField.Chart.ringOfIntegers_coe_ne_zero
statement: theorem ringOfIntegers_coe_ne_zero {a : ringOfIntegers k K} (ha : a ≠ 0) : (a : K) ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  fun h => ha ((Subtype.ext_iff).mpr h)

name: FunctionField.Chart.principalDivisorA_nonneg_at_finite_of_mem_ringOfIntegers
statement:
theorem principalDivisorA_nonneg_at_finite_of_mem_ringOfIntegers {a : ringOfIntegers k K}
    (ha : a ≠ 0) (w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (ringOfIntegers k K)) :
    0 ≤ principalDivisorA k K
      (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 (a : K) (ringOfIntegers_coe_ne_zero k K ha))) (Sum.inl w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [principalDivisorA_apply_finite, FractionalIdeal.principalDivisor_apply]
  have hle := w.valuation_le_one (K := K) a
  have hval := FractionalIdeal.valuation_eq_exp_neg_count (R := ringOfIntegers k K) (K := K) w
    (Units.mk0 (a : K) (ringOfIntegers_coe_ne_zero k K ha))
  have hcount :
      FractionalIdeal.principalDivisor (R := ringOfIntegers k K) (K := K)
        (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 (a : K) (ringOfIntegers_coe_ne_zero k K ha))) w =
      FractionalIdeal.count K w
        (FractionalIdeal.spanSingleton (ringOfIntegers k K)⁰
          (Units.mk0 (a : K) (ringOfIntegers_coe_ne_zero k K ha))) := by
    rfl
  have hnonneg :
      0 ≤ FractionalIdeal.count K w
        (FractionalIdeal.spanSingleton (ringOfIntegers k K)⁰
          (Units.mk0 (a : K) (ringOfIntegers_coe_ne_zero k K ha))) := by
    let count :=
      FractionalIdeal.count K w
        (FractionalIdeal.spanSingleton (ringOfIntegers k K)⁰
          (Units.mk0 (a : K) (ringOfIntegers_coe_ne_zero k K ha)))
    have hle' : -count ≤ 0 :=
      WithZero.exp_le_exp.mp (by rw [← hval, WithZero.exp_zero]; exact hle)
    exact neg_nonpos.mp hle'
  simpa [hcount] using hnonneg

name: FunctionField.Chart.polarDivisor_XK_zero_at_finite
statement:
theorem polarDivisor_XK_zero_at_finite
    (w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (ringOfIntegers k K)) :
    polarDivisor k K (XK k K) (Sum.inl w) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : XK k K ≠ 0 := XK_ne_zero k K
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := XK_mem_ringOfIntegers k K
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := fun ha0 => hx0 (by simpa [ha] using congrArg Subtype.val ha0)
  have hprincipal :
      0 ≤ principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 (XK k K) hx0)) (Sum.inl w) := by
    simpa [ha] using
      principalDivisorA_nonneg_at_finite_of_mem_ringOfIntegers (k := k) (K := K) ha0 w
  unfold polarDivisor
  simp only [dif_neg hx0, Finsupp.sup_apply]
  exact max_eq_right (neg_nonpos.mpr hprincipal)

name: FunctionField.Chart.tK_ne_zero
statement: theorem tK_ne_zero : tK k K ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [tK, tRatFunc]
  intro h
  rw [← map_zero (algebraMap k⟮X⟯ K)] at h
  exact one_div_ne_zero RatFunc.X_ne_zero <|
    (RingHom.injective (algebraMap k⟮X⟯ K)).eq_iff.mp h

name: FunctionField.Chart.principalDivisorA_tK_at_infinite
statement:
theorem principalDivisorA_tK_at_infinite
    (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (infiniteIntegers k K)) :
    principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 (tK k K) (tK_ne_zero k K))) (Sum.inr v) =
      (ramIdxInfty k K v.asIdeal : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [principalDivisorA_apply_infinite]
  let A := inftyValuationSubring k
  let S := infiniteIntegers k K
  let tS : S := algebraMap A S (tA k)
  have htK : tK k K = algebraMap A K (tA k) := by
    dsimp [tK, tA, tRatFunc]
    rfl
  have hspan :
      FractionalIdeal.spanSingleton S⁰ (tK k K) =
        (Ideal.span {tS} : FractionalIdeal S⁰ K) := by
    rw [htK, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A S K, ← FractionalIdeal.coeIdeal_span_singleton]
  have htS : tS ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hz : tK k K = 0 := by
      dsimp [tS] at h
      rw [htK, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A S K, h, map_zero]
    exact tK_ne_zero k K hz
  let p := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A
  have hinj := ValuationSubring.integralClosure_algebraMap_injective
    (v := RatFunc.inftyValuation k) (L := K)
  have hpne : p ≠ ⊥ :=
    Ring.ne_bot_of_isMaximal_of_not_isField (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal A)
      (IsDiscreteValuationRing.not_isField A)
  have hmap : Ideal.map (algebraMap A S) p ≠ ⊥ := by
    rintro hbot
    exact hpne ((Ideal.map_eq_bot_iff_of_injective hinj).mp hbot)
  have hcount :
      FractionalIdeal.principalDivisor (R := S) (K := K)
          (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 (tK k K) (tK_ne_zero k K))) v =
        (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors (Ideal.map (algebraMap A S) p)).count
          v.asIdeal := by
    rw [FractionalIdeal.principalDivisor_apply, toMul_ofMul, Units.val_mk0, hspan,
      FractionalIdeal.count_coe (K := K) v (Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot.not.mpr htS),
      ← map_maximalIdeal_infty k]
    rw [Ideal.count_associates_factors_eq hmap v.isPrime v.ne_bot]
  rw [hcount, ← IsDedekindDomain.ramificationIdx'_eq_normalizedFactors_count hmap v.isPrime
      v.ne_bot, ramIdxInfty]

name: FunctionField.Chart.principalDivisorA_XK_at_infinite
statement:
theorem principalDivisorA_XK_at_infinite
    (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (infiniteIntegers k K)) :
    principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 (XK k K) (XK_ne_zero k K))) (Sum.inr v) =
      -(ramIdxInfty k K v.asIdeal : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : XK k K ≠ 0 := XK_ne_zero k K
  have ht0 : tK k K ≠ 0 := tK_ne_zero k K
  let hunit : Kˣ := Units.mk0 (XK k K * tK k K) (by rw [XK_mul_tK k K]; exact one_ne_zero)
  have hmul : hunit = Units.mk0 (XK k K) hx0 * Units.mk0 (tK k K) ht0 := by
    apply Units.ext
    simp [hunit, Units.val_mul, Units.val_mk0, XK_mul_tK k K]
  have hprod :
      principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul hunit) =
        principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 (XK k K) hx0)) +
          principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 (tK k K) ht0)) := by
    rw [show Additive.ofMul hunit =
        Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 (XK k K) hx0 * Units.mk0 (tK k K) ht0) from congr_arg _ hmul,
      ofMul_mul, (principalDivisorA k K).map_add]
  have hone : principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul hunit) = 0 := by
    ext w
    simp only [Finsupp.zero_apply]
    have hv := placeValuation_eq_exp_neg_principalDivisor k K (Additive.ofMul hunit) w
    have hval' : placeValuation k K w ↑(Additive.toMul (Additive.ofMul hunit)) = 1 := by
      rw [toMul_ofMul, show (↑hunit : K) = 1 by simp [hunit, XK_mul_tK k K]]
      rcases w with w | w <;> simp [placeValuation]
    have hexp :
        WithZero.exp (-((principalDivisorA k K) (Additive.ofMul hunit)) w) = WithZero.exp 0 :=
      (hv.symm.trans hval').trans WithZero.exp_zero.symm
    exact neg_eq_zero.mp (WithZero.exp_injective hexp)
  have hzero :
      principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 (XK k K) hx0)) (Sum.inr v) +
          principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 (tK k K) ht0)) (Sum.inr v) = 0 := by
    have := congrArg (fun D => D (Sum.inr v)) hone
    rwa [hprod] at this
  rw [principalDivisorA_tK_at_infinite k K v] at hzero
  linarith

name: FunctionField.Chart.ramificationIdx_pos_over_infty
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx_pos_over_infty
    (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (infiniteIntegers k K)) :
    0 < ramIdxInfty k K v.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  let A := inftyValuationSubring k
  let p := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A
  have hpne : p ≠ ⊥ :=
    Ring.ne_bot_of_isMaximal_of_not_isField (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal A)
      (IsDiscreteValuationRing.not_isField A)
  have hPp : v.asIdeal.LiesOver p := ⟨(IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal inferInstance).symm⟩
  exact Nat.cast_pos.mpr <|
    Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr <|
      IsDedekindDomain.ramificationIdx'_ne_zero_of_liesOver (S := infiniteIntegers k K)
        v.asIdeal hpne

name: FunctionField.Chart.polarDivisor_XK_at_infinite
statement:
theorem polarDivisor_XK_at_infinite
    (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (infiniteIntegers k K)) :
    polarDivisor k K (XK k K) (Sum.inr v) = ramIdxInfty k K v.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : XK k K ≠ 0 := XK_ne_zero k K
  have hprincipal := principalDivisorA_XK_at_infinite (k := k) (K := K) v
  have hpos : 0 < (ramIdxInfty k K v.asIdeal : ℤ) :=
    Nat.cast_pos.mpr (ramificationIdx_pos_over_infty (k := k) (K := K) v)
  have hneg :
      (-principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul (Units.mk0 (XK k K) hx0))) (Sum.inr v) =
        (ramIdxInfty k K v.asIdeal : ℤ) := by
    simpa using congrArg Neg.neg hprincipal
  unfold polarDivisor
  simp only [dif_neg hx0, Finsupp.sup_apply, hneg]
  exact max_eq_left (le_of_lt hpos)

name: FunctionField.Chart.deg_polarDivisor_XK_eq_primesOverFinset_sum
statement:
theorem deg_polarDivisor_XK_eq_primesOverFinset_sum :
    deg k K (polarDivisor k K (XK k K)) =
      ∑ P ∈ IsDedekindDomain.primesOverFinset
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (inftyValuationSubring k)) (infiniteIntegers k K),
        (ramIdxInfty k K P : ℤ) *
          ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (inftyValuationSubring k)).inertiaDeg P : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [deg, Finsupp.sum]
  let A := inftyValuationSubring k
  let S := infiniteIntegers k K
  let p := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A
  let D := polarDivisor k K (XK k K)
  have hp : p ≠ ⊥ :=
    Ring.ne_bot_of_isMaximal_of_not_isField (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal A)
      (IsDiscreteValuationRing.not_isField A)
  let pred : PlaceA k K → Prop := fun v => match v with | Sum.inr _ => true | _ => false
  let g : PlaceA k K → ℤ := fun v => (D v : ℤ) * (placeDegree k K v : ℤ)
  have hsum_filter :
      D.support.sum g =
        (D.support.filter pred).sum g :=
    Eq.symm <|
      Finset.sum_subset (Finset.filter_subset pred D.support) fun v hv hv' => by
        rcases v with v | v
        · rw [polarDivisor_XK_zero_at_finite, zero_mul]
        · exfalso
          simp only [Finset.mem_filter, pred] at hv'
          exact hv' ⟨hv, by simp⟩
  rw [hsum_filter]
  apply Finset.sum_bij (fun v _ => inftyIdealOfPlace (k := k) (K := K) v)
  · intro v hv
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, pred] at hv
    obtain ⟨_, hright⟩ := hv
    rcases v with v | w
    · cases hright
    · rw [IsDedekindDomain.mem_primesOverFinset_iff hp]
      have hpw : p = w.asIdeal.under A :=
        (IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal (Ideal.IsMaximal.under A w.asIdeal)).symm
      exact ⟨w.isPrime, ⟨hpw⟩⟩
  · intro v₁ hv₁ v₂ hv₂ h
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, pred] at hv₁ hv₂ ⊢
    match v₁ with
    | Sum.inl _ => simp at hv₁
    | Sum.inr w₁ =>
      match v₂ with
      | Sum.inl _ => simp at hv₂
      | Sum.inr w₂ =>
        simp only [inftyIdealOfPlace] at h
        exact congrArg Sum.inr (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.ext h)
  · intro P hP
    have hmem := (IsDedekindDomain.mem_primesOverFinset_iff hp (P := P)).mp hP
    have hprime : P.IsPrime := hmem.1
    have hbot : P ≠ ⊥ := Ideal.ne_bot_of_mem_primesOver hp hmem
    let w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum S := ⟨P, hprime, hbot⟩
    refine ⟨Sum.inr w, ?_, rfl⟩
    · simp only [Finset.mem_filter, pred, Finsupp.mem_support_iff]
      refine And.intro ?_ (by simp)
      rw [polarDivisor_XK_at_infinite]
      norm_cast
      exact (ramificationIdx_pos_over_infty k K w).ne'
  · intro v hv
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, pred, inftyIdealOfPlace] at hv ⊢
    rcases v with v | v
    · simp at hv
    · have hpw : v.asIdeal.under A = p :=
        IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal (Ideal.IsMaximal.under A v.asIdeal)
      rw [polarDivisor_XK_at_infinite k K v, ramIdxInfty, placeDegree_infinite_eq_inertiaDeg, hpw]

name: FunctionField.Chart.deg_polarX_le_finrank
statement:
theorem deg_polarX_le_finrank :
    deg k K (polarDivisor k K (XK k K)) ≤ Module.finrank k⟮X⟯ K
proof:
:= by
  rw [deg_polarDivisor_XK_eq_primesOverFinset_sum k K]
  let A := inftyValuationSubring k
  let S := infiniteIntegers k K
  let p := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A
  have hp : p ≠ ⊥ :=
    Ring.ne_bot_of_isMaximal_of_not_isField (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal A)
      (IsDiscreteValuationRing.not_isField A)
  letI : p.IsMaximal := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal A
  have hsum := Ideal.sum_ramification_inertia (R := A) (S := S) (K := k⟮X⟯) (L := K) hp
  have heq :
      (∑ P ∈ IsDedekindDomain.primesOverFinset p S,
          (ramIdxInfty k K P : ℤ) * (p.inertiaDeg P : ℤ)) =
        Module.finrank k⟮X⟯ K := by
    dsimp [ramIdxInfty]
    norm_cast
  exact le_of_eq heq

    ch k (projectiveIntegralK k)

          (SmoothRegularStalks.regStalks_of_smoothOver k (space k 1) 1) (𝟙 (space k 1)) x)

        (toddOfDual k (projectiveIntegralK k) (virtualCotangent k 1 1 (𝟙 (space k 1)))

name: RRC.SmoothWitnessP1.adamsRiemannRoch_P1
statement:
theorem adamsRiemannRoch_P1 :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (i : space k 1 ⟶ PY k (space k 1) n) (_ : IsClosedImmersion i),
      i ≫ pullback.fst (space k 1 ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) = 𝟙 (space k 1) ∧
      ∀ {j : ℕ}, 2 ≤ j → ∀ x : K0 (space k 1),
        haveI : IsIntegral (space k 1)
proof:
:= (projectiveIntegralK k).1
        FIN.ARRwK (projectiveIntegralK k)
          (SmoothRegularStalks.regStalks_of_smoothOver k (space k 1) 1) n i
          (SmoothRegularStalks.regStalks_of_smoothOver k (space k 1) 1) j x
          (fShriek k (projectiveIntegralK k) (projectiveIntegralK k)
            (SmoothRegularStalks.regStalks_of_smoothOver k (space k 1) 1) (𝟙 (space k 1)) x) := by
  obtain ⟨n, i, hi, hif⟩ := RT.exists_factorisation (projectiveIntegralK k) (projectiveIntegralK k)
    (𝟙 (space k 1)) (Category.id_comp _)
  exact ⟨n, i, hi, hif, fun hj x =>
    adamsRiemannRoch_smooth (dX := 1) (dY := 1) (projectiveIntegralK k) (projectiveIntegralK k)
      (𝟙 (space k 1)) i hif hj x⟩

name: RRC.SmoothRegularStalks.ncard_range_le_card
statement:
theorem ncard_range_le_card {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] (f : α → β) :
    (Set.range f).ncard ≤ Fintype.card α
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Set.image_univ]
  exact (Set.ncard_image_le Set.finite_univ).trans (by simp [Set.ncard_univ])

name: RRC.SmoothRegularStalks.isRegularLocalRing_quotient_of_linearIndependent
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_quotient_of_linearIndependent {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ]
    (f : σ → maximalIdeal R)
    (hf : LinearIndependent (ResidueField R) fun i => (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent (f i)) :
    IsRegularLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (f i : R)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set I : Ideal R := Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => (f i : R)) with hI
  have hIm : I ≤ maximalIdeal R := by
    rw [hI, Ideal.span_le]; rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact (f i).2
  have hItop : I ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top hIm
  haveI : Nontrivial (R ⧸ I) := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hItop
  haveI : IsLocalRing (R ⧸ I) :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  
  let v : σ → CotangentSpace R := fun i => (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent (f i)
  set W : Submodule (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) :=
    Submodule.span (ResidueField R) (Set.range v) with hW
  obtain ⟨C, hWC⟩ := Submodule.exists_isCompl W
  let bC := Module.finBasis (ResidueField R) C
  have hgex : ∀ j, ∃ g : maximalIdeal R, (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent g = (bC j : _) :=
    fun j => (maximalIdeal R).toCotangent_surjective _
  choose g hg using hgex
  
  have hspan : Submodule.span R (Set.range f ∪ Set.range g) = ⊤ := by
    rw [← CotangentSpace.span_image_eq_top_iff, eq_top_iff, ← hWC.sup_eq_top]
    refine sup_le ?_ ?_
    · rw [hW, Submodule.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨f i, Or.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    · intro c hc
      have hc' : (⟨c, hc⟩ : C) ∈ Submodule.span (ResidueField R) (Set.range bC) := by
        rw [bC.span_eq]; trivial
      have := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (f := C.subtype) hc'
      rw [Submodule.map_span] at this
      refine Submodule.span_mono ?_ this
      rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨j, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨g j, Or.inr ⟨j, rfl⟩, hg j⟩
  have hm : maximalIdeal R =
      Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i => (f i : R)) ∪ Set.range (fun j => (g j : R))) := by
    have := congrArg (Submodule.map (maximalIdeal R).subtype) hspan
    rw [Submodule.map_span, Submodule.map_top, Submodule.range_subtype, Set.image_union,
      ← Set.range_comp, ← Set.range_comp] at this
    exact this.symm
  
  have hmT : maximalIdeal (R ⧸ I) = Ideal.span (Set.range fun j => Ideal.Quotient.mk I (g j)) := by
    have hmax : ((maximalIdeal R).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).IsMaximal := by
      refine (Ideal.map_eq_top_or_isMaximal_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
        (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R)).resolve_left fun h => (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top ?_
      have := congrArg (Ideal.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) h
      rwa [Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective,
        ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, Ideal.mk_ker, sup_eq_left.mpr hIm, Ideal.comap_top] at this
    rw [← IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hmax, congrArg (Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) hm,
      Ideal.map_span, Set.image_union,
      Ideal.span_union, ← Set.range_comp, ← Set.range_comp]
    have h0 : Ideal.span (Set.range (Ideal.Quotient.mk I ∘ fun i => (f i : R))) = ⊥ := by
      rw [Ideal.span_eq_bot]
      rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    rw [h0, bot_sup_eq]
    rfl
  
  have hT : (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ I)).spanFinrank ≤ Module.finrank (ResidueField R) C := by
    rw [hmT]
    refine le_trans (Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_ncard_of_finite (Set.finite_range _)) ?_
    exact le_trans (ncard_range_le_card _) (by simp)
  have hWr : Module.finrank (ResidueField R) W = Fintype.card σ := finrank_span_eq_card hf
  have hVr : Module.finrank (ResidueField R) W + Module.finrank (ResidueField R) C =
      (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank := by
    rw [Submodule.finrank_add_eq_of_isCompl hWC, spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_eq_finrank_cotangentSpace]
  have hIr : I.spanFinrank ≤ Fintype.card σ := by
    refine le_trans (Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_ncard_of_finite (Set.finite_range _)) ?_
    exact ncard_range_le_card _
  have hKrull := ringKrullDim_le_ringKrullDim_quotient_add_spanFinrank I
    (le_trans hIm (by rw [IsLocalRing.ringJacobson_eq_maximalIdeal]))
  have hreg := IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R := R)
  have hle := ringKrullDim_le_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R ⧸ I)
  have hne : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ I) ≠ ⊥ := fun h => by
    have := ringKrullDim_nonneg_of_nontrivial (R := R ⧸ I)
    rw [h] at this
    exact absurd this (by simp)
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, ringKrullDim (R ⧸ I) = n := by
    rcases h : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ I) with _ | n
    · exact absurd h hne
    · rcases n with _ | n
      · have h' : ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤
            (((maximalIdeal (R ⧸ I)).spanFinrank : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
          rw [h] at hle; exact hle
        rw [WithBot.coe_le_coe, top_le_iff] at h'
        exact absurd h' (ENat.coe_ne_top _)
      · exact ⟨n, rfl⟩
  apply IsRegularLocalRing.of_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_le
  rw [hn] at hKrull ⊢
  rw [← hreg] at hKrull
  have : (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank ≤ n + I.spanFinrank := by exact_mod_cast hKrull
  exact_mod_cast (show (maximalIdeal (R ⧸ I)).spanFinrank ≤ n by omega)

name: RRC.SmoothRegularStalks.residue_pderiv_eq_zero_of_mem_sq
statement:
theorem residue_pderiv_eq_zero_of_mem_sq (Q : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι R0)) [Q.IsPrime] (a : ι)
    {z : MvPolynomial ι R0} (hz : z ∈ Q ^ 2) :
    algebraMap _ Q.ResidueField (pderiv a z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_two] at hz
  refine Submodule.mul_induction_on hz (fun x hx y hy => ?_) (fun x y hx hy => ?_)
  · rw [(pderiv a).leibniz x y, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, map_add, map_mul, map_mul,
      Ideal.algebraMap_residueField_eq_zero.mpr hx, Ideal.algebraMap_residueField_eq_zero.mpr hy]
    simp
  · rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]

name: RRC.SmoothRegularStalks.linearIndependent_locRel
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_locRel (Q : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι R0)) [Q.IsPrime] {σ : Type*}
    [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] (f : σ → MvPolynomial ι R0) (hfQ : ∀ i, f i ∈ Q) (a : σ → ι)
    (hdet : (Matrix.of fun i j => pderiv (a i) (f j)).det ∉ Q) :
    LinearIndependent (ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime Q))
      fun i => (maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime Q)).toCotangent (locRel Q f hfQ i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set L := Localization.AtPrime Q
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
  intro c hc
  choose a' ha' using fun i => IsLocalRing.residue_surjective (c i)
  obtain ⟨⟨b, hb⟩, hbint⟩ := IsLocalization.exist_integer_multiples Q.primeCompl Finset.univ a'
  choose p hp using fun i => hbint i (Finset.mem_univ i)
  
  have key : (maximalIdeal L).toCotangent (∑ i, a' i • locRel Q f hfQ i) = 0 := by
    rw [← hc, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [map_smul, ← ha', ← IsLocalRing.ResidueField.algebraMap_eq, algebraMap_smul]
  have hsum : (∑ i, a' i * algebraMap _ L (f i)) ∈ maximalIdeal L ^ 2 := by
    have := (Ideal.toCotangent_eq_zero _ _).mp key
    simpa [locRel, smul_eq_mul] using this
  
  have hp' : ∀ i, algebraMap _ L (p i) = algebraMap _ L b * a' i := fun i => by
    rw [hp i]; exact Algebra.smul_def _ _
  set X : MvPolynomial ι R0 := ∑ i, p i * f i with hX
  have hXQ : X ∈ Q := Ideal.sum_mem _ fun i _ => Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (hfQ i)
  have hXL : algebraMap _ L X = algebraMap _ L b * ∑ i, a' i * algebraMap _ L (f i) := by
    simp only [hX, map_sum, map_mul, hp', Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]
  have hXmem : algebraMap _ L X ∈ (Q ^ 2).map (algebraMap _ L) := by
    rw [Ideal.map_pow, IsLocalization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal, hXL]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hsum
  obtain ⟨⟨y, s⟩, hys⟩ := (IsLocalization.mem_map_algebraMap_iff Q.primeCompl L).mp hXmem
  rw [← map_mul] at hys
  obtain ⟨c', hc'⟩ := (IsLocalization.eq_iff_exists Q.primeCompl L).mp hys
  have ht : (c' : MvPolynomial ι R0) * s ∉ Q := (Q.primeCompl.mul_mem c'.2 s.2 :)
  have htX : ((c' : MvPolynomial ι R0) * s) * X ∈ Q ^ 2 := by
    rw [show ((c' : MvPolynomial ι R0) * s) * X = c' * (X * s) by ring, hc']
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ y.2
  generalize (c' : MvPolynomial ι R0) * s = t at ht htX
  
  have hfQ' : ∀ i, algebraMap _ Q.ResidueField (f i) = 0 := fun i =>
    Ideal.algebraMap_residueField_eq_zero.mpr (hfQ i)
  have hrow : ∀ j, ∑ i, algebraMap _ Q.ResidueField (pderiv (a j) (f i)) *
      algebraMap _ Q.ResidueField (p i) = 0 := by
    intro j
    have h0 := residue_pderiv_eq_zero_of_mem_sq Q (a j) htX
    rw [(pderiv (a j)).leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, map_add, map_mul _ t, map_mul _ X,
      Ideal.algebraMap_residueField_eq_zero.mpr hXQ, zero_mul, add_zero] at h0
    have ht' : algebraMap _ Q.ResidueField t ≠ 0 :=
      mt Ideal.algebraMap_residueField_eq_zero.mp ht
    have h1 := (mul_eq_zero.mp h0).resolve_left ht'
    rw [hX, map_sum, map_sum] at h1
    rw [← h1]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [(pderiv _).leibniz, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, map_add, map_mul, map_mul, hfQ' i]
    ring
  set N := (Matrix.of fun i j => pderiv (a i) (f j)).map (algebraMap _ Q.ResidueField) with hN
  have hNdet : N.det ≠ 0 := by
    have : N.det = algebraMap _ Q.ResidueField (Matrix.of fun i j => pderiv (a i) (f j)).det := by
      rw [RingHom.map_det]; rfl
    rw [this]
    exact mt Ideal.algebraMap_residueField_eq_zero.mp hdet
  have hv : N.mulVec (fun i => algebraMap _ Q.ResidueField (p i)) = 0 := by
    ext j
    simpa [N, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct] using hrow j
  have hpv := Matrix.eq_zero_of_mulVec_eq_zero hNdet hv
  intro i
  have hpi : p i ∈ Q := Ideal.algebraMap_residueField_eq_zero.mp (congrFun hpv i)
  have hbu : IsUnit (algebraMap _ L b) := IsLocalization.map_units L (⟨b, hb⟩ : Q.primeCompl)
  have : residue L (algebraMap _ L b) * c i = 0 := by
    rw [← ha', ← map_mul, ← hp', IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff]
    exact (IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff L Q (p i)).mpr hpi
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left ((residue_ne_zero_iff_isUnit _).mpr hbu)

name: RRC.SmoothRegularStalks.isRegularRing_mvPolynomial_fin
statement:
theorem isRegularRing_mvPolynomial_fin (R0 : Type*) [CommRing R0] [IsRegularRing R0] (n : ℕ) :
    IsRegularRing (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R0)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    exact IsRegularRing.of_ringEquiv (MvPolynomial.isEmptyRingEquiv R0 (Fin 0)).symm
  | succ n ih =>
    haveI := ih
    exact IsRegularRing.of_ringEquiv (MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv R0 n).toRingEquiv.symm

name: RRC.SmoothRegularStalks.isRegularRing_mvPolynomial
statement:
theorem isRegularRing_mvPolynomial (R0 : Type*) [CommRing R0] [IsRegularRing R0] (ι : Type*)
    [Finite ι] : IsRegularRing (MvPolynomial ι R0)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isRegularRing_mvPolynomial_fin R0 (Nat.card ι)
  exact IsRegularRing.of_ringEquiv
    (MvPolynomial.renameEquiv R0 (Finite.equivFin ι).symm).toRingEquiv

name: RRC.SmoothRegularStalks.isRegularLocalRing_localization_of_submersivePresentation
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_localization_of_submersivePresentation {R S : Type*} [CommRing R]
    [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [IsRegularRing R] {ι σ : Type*} [Finite ι] [Finite σ]
    (P : Algebra.SubmersivePresentation R S ι σ) (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime] :
    IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime q)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI := Fintype.ofFinite σ
  haveI : IsRegularRing P.Ring := isRegularRing_mvPolynomial R ι
  set g : P.Ring →+* S := algebraMap P.Ring S with hgdef
  have hg : Function.Surjective g := P.algebraMap_surjective
  set Q : Ideal P.Ring := q.comap g with hQ
  have hrel : ∀ i, P.relation i ∈ Q := fun i => by
    rw [hQ, Ideal.mem_comap]
    have : g (P.relation i) = 0 := by
      rw [← RingHom.mem_ker]
      exact P.relation_mem_ker i
    rw [this]; exact q.zero_mem
  have hjac : P.jacobiMatrix = Matrix.of fun i j => MvPolynomial.pderiv (P.map i) (P.relation j) := by
    exact Matrix.ext fun i j => P.jacobiMatrix_apply i j
  have hdet : (Matrix.of fun i j => MvPolynomial.pderiv (P.map i) (P.relation j)).det ∉ Q := by
    intro h
    rw [hQ, Ideal.mem_comap, ← hjac] at h
    have hu := P.jacobian_isUnit
    rw [Algebra.PreSubmersivePresentation.jacobian_eq_jacobiMatrix_det] at hu
    exact (inferInstance : q.IsPrime).ne_top (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ h hu)
  have hT := isRegularLocalRing_quotient_of_linearIndependent (locRel Q P.relation hrel)
    (linearIndependent_locRel Q P.relation hrel P.map hdet)
  
  have hM : Q.primeCompl.map g = q.primeCompl := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩; exact hy
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hg x
      exact ⟨y, hx, rfl⟩
  haveI : IsLocalization (Q.primeCompl.map g) (Localization.AtPrime q) := by
    rw [hM]; infer_instance
  have hsurj := IsLocalization.map_surjective_of_surjective (M := Q.primeCompl)
    (S := Localization.AtPrime Q) (g := g) (Q := Localization.AtPrime q) hg
  have hker := IsLocalization.ker_map (S := Localization.AtPrime Q) (M := Q.primeCompl)
    (Localization.AtPrime q) g hM
  have hkerg : RingHom.ker g = Ideal.span (Set.range P.relation) := by
    rw [P.span_range_relation_eq_ker]; rfl
  have hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => ((locRel Q P.relation hrel i : _) :
      Localization.AtPrime Q)) = RingHom.ker (IsLocalization.map (Localization.AtPrime q) g
        Q.primeCompl.le_comap_map : Localization.AtPrime Q →+* Localization.AtPrime q) := by
    refine Eq.trans ?_ hker.symm
    rw [hkerg, Ideal.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
    rfl
  let e : (Localization.AtPrime Q ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range fun i =>
      ((locRel Q P.relation hrel i : _) : Localization.AtPrime Q))) ≃+* Localization.AtPrime q :=
    (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hspan).trans (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective hsurj)
  exact @IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv _ _ hT _ _ e

name: RRC.SmoothRegularStalks.isRegularRing_of_isStandardSmooth
statement:
theorem isRegularRing_of_isStandardSmooth (R S : Type*) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [IsRegularRing R] [Algebra.IsStandardSmooth R S] : IsRegularRing S
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing S := Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing R S
  refine ⟨fun q _ => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨ι, σ, _, _, ⟨P⟩⟩ := ‹Algebra.IsStandardSmooth R S›.out
  exact isRegularLocalRing_localization_of_submersivePresentation P q

name: RRC.SmoothRegularStalks.regStalks_of_smoothOver
statement:
theorem regStalks_of_smoothOver (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spk k)] (d : ℕ)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d (X ↘ Spk k)] : RegStalks X
proof:
:=
  regStalks_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension_field k (X ↘ Spk k) d

name: RRC.SmoothRegularStalks.smoothRegular
statement:
theorem smoothRegular (k : Type u) [Field k] :
    AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.SmoothComparison.SmoothRegular k
proof:
:=
  fun X _ _ _ _ d _ => regStalks_of_smoothOver k X d

name: RRC.SmoothRegularStalks.smoothComparison_targetThree
statement:
theorem smoothComparison_targetThree (k : Type u) [Field k] [Infinite k] :
    AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.Statement.SmoothComparison k
      (AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.targetThree k)
proof:
:=
  AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.SmoothComparison.smoothComparison_targetThree (smoothRegular k)

name: RRC.BaumFultonMacPherson_smooth_of_smooth
statement:
theorem BaumFultonMacPherson_smooth_of_smooth (k : Type u) [Field k] [Infinite k]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (ProjK k X)] [IsIntegral X]
    (d : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d (X ↘ Spk k)] (x : K0 X) :
    haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X)
proof:
:=
      ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_projK (Fact.out : ProjK k X)⟩
    (AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.targetThree k).tau X (k0ToG0 X x) =
      TOD.tdTan k X
        (k0ClassOf X (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (X ↘ Spk k))
          (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_hasConstantRank (X ↘ Spk k) d).isFiniteLocallyFree)
        (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chExact_closedPosV4 k) x (fundClass k (W := X))) :=
  BaumFultonMacPherson_smooth k d (SmoothRegularStalks.regStalks_of_smoothOver k X d) x

name: RRC.GrothendieckRiemannRoch_smooth
statement:
theorem GrothendieckRiemannRoch_smooth
    (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] (x : K0 X) :
    ch k hY (fShriek k hX hY (SmoothRegularStalks.regStalks_of_smoothOver k Y dY) f x)
        (fundamentalClass k hY) =
      pushforward k hX hY f
        (toddOfDual k hX (virtualCotangent k dX dY f)
          (ch k hX x (fundamentalClass k hX)))
proof:
:=
  GrothendieckRiemannRoch hX (SmoothRegularStalks.regStalks_of_smoothOver k X dX) hY
    (SmoothRegularStalks.regStalks_of_smoothOver k Y dY) f x

name: RRC.adamsRiemannRoch_smooth
statement:
theorem adamsRiemannRoch_smooth {dX dY : ℕ} [SmoothOfRelativeDimension dX (X ↘ Spk k)]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension dY (Y ↘ Spk k)]
    (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] {n : ℕ} (i : X ⟶ PY k Y n) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hi : i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) = f) {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) (x : K0 X) :
    haveI : IsIntegral X
proof:
:= hX.1
    FIN.ARRwK hY (SmoothRegularStalks.regStalks_of_smoothOver k Y dY) n i
      (SmoothRegularStalks.regStalks_of_smoothOver k X dX) j x
      (fShriek k hX hY (SmoothRegularStalks.regStalks_of_smoothOver k Y dY) f x) :=
  adamsRiemannRoch hX _ hY _ f i hi hj x

name: RRC.fShriek_eq_alternatingSum_directImages_smooth
statement:
theorem fShriek_eq_alternatingSum_directImages_smooth {dY : ℕ}
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension dY (Y ↘ Spk k)] [Infinite k]
    (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] (E : X.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) :
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (hc : ∀ q, IsCoherentLike Y
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f E q)),
      (∀ q, N < q → CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero
        (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f E q)) ∧
      k0ToG0 Y (fShriek k hX hY (SmoothRegularStalks.regStalks_of_smoothOver k Y dY) f
          (k0ClassOf X E hE)) =
        GrothendieckRiemannRoch.alternatingSum N (fun q ↦ g0ClassOf Y
          (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f E q) (hc q))
proof:
:=
  fShriek_eq_alternatingSum_directImages hX hY _ f E hE

name: RRC.SmoothRegularStalks.regStalks_of_smooth
statement:
theorem regStalks_of_smooth {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [Smooth f] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    (hY : RegStalks Y) : RegStalks X
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨U, hU, V, hV, hxV, e, hs⟩ := Smooth.exists_isStandardSmooth f x
  haveI := isRegularRing_sections Y hY ⟨U, hU⟩
  letI := (f.appLE U V e).hom.toAlgebra
  haveI : Algebra.IsStandardSmooth Γ(Y, U) Γ(X, V) := hs
  haveI := isRegularRing_of_isStandardSmooth Γ(Y, U) Γ(X, V)
  letI : Algebra Γ(X, V) (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.algebra_section_stalk X.presheaf ⟨x, hxV⟩
  haveI := hV.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hxV⟩
  exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv
    (IsLocalization.algEquiv (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxV⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl
      (Localization.AtPrime (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxV⟩).asIdeal)
      (X.presheaf.stalk x)).toRingEquiv

name: RRC.SmoothRegularStalks.regStalks_of_smooth_field
statement:
theorem regStalks_of_smooth_field (k : Type u) [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}}

name: RRC.SmoothRegularStalks.regStalks_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension_field

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AssemblyWitnessCubic.coeff_two_mul_g2twit
statement:
theorem coeff_two_mul_g2twit (f g : ℚ⟦X⟧) :
    coeff 2 (f * g) = coeff 0 f * coeff 2 g + coeff 1 f * coeff 1 g + coeff 2 f * coeff 0 g
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_mul, Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk]
  simp [Finset.sum_range_succ]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AssemblyWitnessCubic.coeff_two_tdSer
statement: theorem coeff_two_tdSer : coeff 2 tdSer = 1 / 12
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (coeff 2) eSer_mul_tdSer
  have h0 : coeff 0 eSer = 1 := by
    rw [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, constantCoeff_eSer]
  have h1 : coeff 1 eSer = -1 / 2 := by
    simp [eSer, Nat.factorial]
    norm_num
  have h2 : coeff 2 eSer = 1 / 6 := by
    simp [eSer, Nat.factorial]
    norm_num
  rw [coeff_two_mul_g2twit, coeff_one, if_neg (by norm_num), h0, h1, h2,
    AssemblyWitness.coeff_zero_tdSer_g2tasm, AssemblyWitness.coeff_one_tdSer] at h
  linarith

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AssemblyWitnessCubic.coeff_tdSer_cube
statement:
theorem coeff_tdSer_cube :
    coeff 0 (tdSer ^ 3) = 1 ∧ coeff 1 (tdSer ^ 3) = 3 / 2 ∧ coeff 2 (tdSer ^ 3) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have a0 := AssemblyWitness.coeff_zero_tdSer_g2tasm
  have a1 := AssemblyWitness.coeff_one_tdSer
  have a2 := coeff_two_tdSer
  have b0 : coeff 0 (tdSer * tdSer) = 1 := by
    rw [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, map_mul, constantCoeff_tdSer, one_mul]
  have b1 : coeff 1 (tdSer * tdSer) = 1 := by
    rw [AssemblyWitness.coeff_one_mul_g2tasm, a0, a1]; norm_num
  have b2 : coeff 2 (tdSer * tdSer) = 5 / 12 := by
    rw [coeff_two_mul_g2twit, a0, a1, a2]; norm_num
  have e3 : tdSer ^ 3 = tdSer * tdSer * tdSer := by ring
  rw [e3]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, map_mul, ← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, b0,
      ← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, a0, one_mul]
  · rw [AssemblyWitness.coeff_one_mul_g2tasm, b0, b1, a0, a1]; norm_num
  · rw [coeff_two_mul_g2twit, b0, b1, b2, a0, a1, a2]; norm_num

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AssemblyWitnessCubic.coeff_two_td_cube_twist
statement:
theorem coeff_two_td_cube_twist (e : ℤ) :
    coeff 2 (tdSer ^ (2 + 1) *
      (rescale (e : ℚ) (exp ℚ) - rescale (((e - 3 : ℤ)) : ℚ) (exp ℚ))) = 3 * (e : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c0, c1, c2⟩ := coeff_tdSer_cube
  rw [show (2 + 1 : ℕ) = 3 from rfl, coeff_two_mul_g2twit, c0, c1, c2]
  simp only [map_sub, coeff_rescale, coeff_exp, Nat.factorial, Int.cast_sub]
  push_cast
  simp only [Algebra.algebraMap_self, RingHom.id_apply]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AssemblyWitnessCubic.iotaP_toSpec
statement: theorem iotaP_toSpec : iotaP k ≫ toSpec k 2 = Xc k ↘ Spk k
proof:
:= by
  change iota k ≫ pullback.snd (Yk k ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 2) ≫ toSpec k 2 =
    iC k ≫ ((PC k) ↘ Spk k)
  rw [← pullback.condition, ← Category.assoc]
  have h : iota k ≫ pullback.fst (Yk k ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 2) = fC k := by
    unfold fC iC
    rw [Category.assoc, AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1PF.coverIso_inv_toBase]
  rw [h]
  exact hfC k

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AssemblyWitnessCubic.projK_xc
statement: theorem projK_xc : ProjK k (Xc k)
proof: := ⟨2, iotaP k, inferInstance, iotaP_toSpec k⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AssemblyWitnessCubic.push_psi
statement:
theorem push_psi (z : K0 (space k 2)) :
    finitePushforward (psi k) (k0ToG0 (Amb k) (pullbackK0RingHom (psi k) z)) =
      k0ToG0 (space k 2) z
proof:
:= by
  have h := KSpecialization.ARRHBCP.k0ToG0_pullbackK0_iso' (asIso (psi k)) z
  rw [pullbackK0RingHom_apply]
  change k0ToG0 (Amb k) (pullbackK0 (asIso (psi k)).hom z) = _ at h
  rw [show pullbackK0 (psi k) z = pullbackK0 (asIso (psi k)).hom z from rfl, h,
    ← AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, ← ARRG45C.finitePushforward_comp,
    KSpecialization.ARRHBCP.finitePushforward_congr (f := (asIso (psi k)).inv ≫ psi k)
      (asIso (psi k)).inv_hom_id,
    KSpecialization.ARRHBCP.finitePushforward_id']
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AssemblyWitnessCubic.push_one
statement:
theorem push_one :
    finitePushforward (iotaP k) (k0ToG0 (Xc k) 1) =
      k0ToG0 (space k 2) (1 - projectiveTwistingK0Class k 2 (-3))
proof:
:= by
  have hkos : finitePushforward (iota k) (k0ToG0 (Xc k) 1) =
      k0ToG0 (Amb k) (1 - classE k) := by
    rw [CIK1A.finitePushforward_one_eq_cosection (Eb k) (sigma k) (iota k) (eb_hasConstantRank k)
      (sigma_frames k) (ker_iota k), CIK1A.lambdaMinusOne_rankOne]
  unfold iotaP
  rw [ARRG45C.finitePushforward_comp, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, hkos, classE_eq, ← map_one
    (pullbackK0RingHom (psi k)), ← map_sub, push_psi]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AssemblyWitnessCubic.push_twist
statement:
theorem push_twist (e : ℤ) :
    finitePushforward (iotaP k)
        (k0ToG0 (Xc k) (pullbackK0RingHom (iotaP k) (projectiveTwistingK0Class k 2 e))) =
      k0ToG0 (space k 2)
        (projectiveTwistingK0Class k 2 e - projectiveTwistingK0Class k 2 (e - 3))
proof:
:= by
  have hm : projectiveTwistingK0Class k 2 e * (1 - projectiveTwistingK0Class k 2 (-3)) =
      projectiveTwistingK0Class k 2 e - projectiveTwistingK0Class k 2 (e - 3) := by
    simp only [sub_eq_add_neg, mul_add, mul_one, mul_neg, projectiveTwistingK0Class_mul]
  rw [← one_mul (pullbackK0RingHom (iotaP k) _), finitePushforward_k0ToG0_mul_pullback, push_one,
    ← k0ToG0_mul]
  exact congrArg (k0ToG0 (space k 2)) hm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AssemblyWitnessCubic.isRep_twist_sub
statement:
theorem isRep_twist_sub (e : ℤ) :
    IsRep k 2 (projectiveTwistingK0Class k 2 e - projectiveTwistingK0Class k 2 (e - 3))
      (rescale (e : ℚ) (exp ℚ) - rescale (((e - 3 : ℤ)) : ℚ) (exp ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := isRep_twist k 2 e
  have h2 := isRep_twist k 2 (e - 3)
  unfold IsRep at h1 h2 ⊢
  rw [map_sub, h1, h2, evTrunc_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AssemblyWitnessCubic.degPn_td_ch_twist
statement:
theorem degPn_td_ch_twist (e : ℤ) :
    degPn k 2 (tdPn k 2 (chPn k 2
      (projectiveTwistingK0Class k 2 e - projectiveTwistingK0Class k 2 (e - 3)) (fundPn k 2))) =
      3 * (e : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  have hrep := isRep_twist_sub k e
  unfold IsRep at hrep
  rw [← chFund_apply, hrep, tdPn_evTrunc, degPn_evTrunc, coeff_two_td_cube_twist]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AssemblyWitnessCubic.euler_push_twist
statement:
theorem euler_push_twist (e : ℤ) :
    eulerP k 2 (by norm_num) (finitePushforward (iotaP k)
        (k0ToG0 (Xc k) (pullbackK0RingHom (iotaP k) (projectiveTwistingK0Class k 2 e)))) =
      3 * e
proof:
:= by
  have h := euler_eq_degPn k 2 (by norm_num)
    (projectiveTwistingK0Class k 2 e - projectiveTwistingK0Class k 2 (e - 3))
  rw [degPn_td_ch_twist, ← push_twist] at h
  exact_mod_cast h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AssemblyWitnessCubic.euler_push_one
statement:
theorem euler_push_one :
    eulerP k 2 (by norm_num) (finitePushforward (iotaP k) (k0ToG0 (Xc k) 1)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := euler_push_twist k 0
  rwa [projectiveTwistingK0Class_zero, map_one, mul_zero] at h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AssemblyWitnessCubic.degPn_push_tau_twist
statement:
theorem degPn_push_tau_twist (e : ℤ) :
    degPn k 2 (totalPushOn (opsK k) (iotaP k)
        (T.tau (Xc k) (k0ToG0 (Xc k)
          (pullbackK0RingHom (iotaP k) (projectiveTwistingK0Class k 2 e))))) = 3 * (e : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [T.ambient (projK_xc k) 2 (iotaP k) _ _ (push_twist k e).symm, degPn_td_ch_twist]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AssemblyWitnessCubic.degPn_push_tau_one
statement:
theorem degPn_push_tau_one :
    degPn k 2 (totalPushOn (opsK k) (iotaP k) (T.tau (Xc k) (k0ToG0 (Xc k) 1))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := degPn_push_tau_twist T 0
  rwa [projectiveTwistingK0Class_zero, map_one, Int.cast_zero, mul_zero] at h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AssemblyWitnessCubic.degPn_push_tau_O1
statement:
theorem degPn_push_tau_O1 :
    degPn k 2 (totalPushOn (opsK k) (iotaP k)
        (T.tau (Xc k) (k0ToG0 (Xc k)
          (pullbackK0RingHom (iotaP k) (projectiveTwistingK0Class k 2 1))))) = 3
proof:
:= by
  have h := degPn_push_tau_twist T 1
  rwa [Int.cast_one, mul_one] at h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AssemblyWitnessCubic.iotaP_generic_ne
statement: theorem iotaP_generic_ne : iotaP k (genericPoint (Xc k)) ≠ genericPoint (space k 2)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (iotaP k) := by
    intro y
    have hcl : IsClosed (Set.range (iotaP k)) := (iotaP k).isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range
    have hy : y ∈ closure ({genericPoint (space k 2)} : Set (space k 2)) :=
      specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp (genericPoint_specializes y)
    have hsub : closure ({genericPoint (space k 2)} : Set (space k 2)) ⊆ Set.range (iotaP k) :=
      hcl.closure_subset_iff.mpr (by
        rintro _ rfl
        exact ⟨_, h⟩)
    exact hsub hy
  haveI : Surjective (iotaP k) := ⟨hsurj⟩
  haveI : IsIso (iotaP k) := isIso_of_isClosedImmersion_of_surjective (iotaP k)
  exact not_regStalks_X k (regStalks_of_openImmersion (iotaP k) (projectiveSpace_regStalks k 2))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AssemblyWitnessCubic.height_genericPoint_xc
statement: theorem height_genericPoint_xc : height (genericPoint (Xc k)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hι := height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion (iotaP k) (genericPoint (Xc k))
  have h2 := CASE1B.height_genericPoint_space k 2
  have hle : iotaP k (genericPoint (Xc k)) ≤ genericPoint (space k 2) :=
    Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr (genericPoint_specializes _)
  have hlt : iotaP k (genericPoint (Xc k)) < genericPoint (space k 2) :=
    lt_of_le_not_ge hle (fun h ↦ iotaP_generic_ne k (by
      have e := (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp h).antisymm (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hle)
      exact e.eq))
  have hfin : height (iotaP k (genericPoint (Xc k))) < ⊤ :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (Order.height_mono hle) (by rw [h2]; exact ENat.coe_lt_top 2)
  have hs := Order.height_strictMono hlt hfin
  rw [h2, hι] at hs
  have hle1 : height (genericPoint (Xc k)) ≤ 1 := by simpa using hs
  refine le_antisymm hle1 (Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr fun h0 ↦ ?_)
  
  have hmin : IsMin (genericPoint (Xc k)) := Order.height_eq_zero.mp h0
  apply not_regStalks_X k
  intro x
  have hx : x = genericPoint (Xc k) := by
    have h1 : x ≤ genericPoint (Xc k) := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr (genericPoint_specializes x)
    exact ((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp h1).antisymm
      (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp (hmin h1))).eq.symm
  subst hx
  change IsRegularLocalRing (Xc k).functionField
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AssemblyWitnessCubic.height_genericPoint_xc_nat
statement: theorem height_genericPoint_xc_nat : height (genericPoint (Xc k)) = ((1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  rw [height_genericPoint_xc]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AssemblyWitnessCubic.height_le_one
statement: theorem height_le_one (x : Xc k) : height x ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  (Order.height_mono (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr (genericPoint_specializes x))).trans
    (height_genericPoint_xc k).le

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AssemblyWitnessCubic.isCoherentLike_tensorUnit_g2twit

:=
  (tensorUnitSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (Xc k)).isFinitePresentation

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AssemblyWitnessCubic.isCoherentLike_pushUnit_id
statement: theorem isCoherentLike_pushUnit_id : IsCoherentLike (Xc k) (pushUnit (𝟙 (Xc k)))
proof:
:=
  (finitePushObject (𝟙 (Xc k)) ⟨tensorUnitSheaf (Xc k), isCoherentLike_tensorUnit_g2twit k⟩).2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AssemblyWitnessCubic.g0ClassOf_pushUnit_id
statement:
theorem g0ClassOf_pushUnit_id :
    g0ClassOf (Xc k) (pushUnit (𝟙 (Xc k))) (isCoherentLike_pushUnit_id k) = k0ToG0 (Xc k) 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := finitePushforward_classOf (𝟙 (Xc k)) (tensorUnitSheaf (Xc k))
    (isCoherentLike_tensorUnit_g2twit k)
  rw [KSpecialization.ARRHBCP.finitePushforward_id', AddMonoidHom.id_apply] at h
  rw [k0ToG0_one]
  exact h.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AssemblyWitnessCubic.tau_one_leading
statement:
theorem tau_one_leading :
    (∀ m, 1 < m → DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow (Xc k) n) m
        (T.tau (Xc k) (k0ToG0 (Xc k) 1)) = 0) ∧
      DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow (Xc k) n) 1
          (T.tau (Xc k) (k0ToG0 (Xc k) 1)) =
        (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk
          (dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint (Xc k)) 1 (height_genericPoint_xc_nat k)) : DimChow (Xc k) 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hL := T.leading (projK_xc k) (pushUnit (𝟙 (Xc k))) (isCoherentLike_pushUnit_id k) 1
    (fun x _ ↦ by exact_mod_cast height_le_one k x)
  rw [g0ClassOf_pushUnit_id] at hL
  refine ⟨hL.1, ?_⟩
  rw [hL.2, coherentCycle_pushUnit_integral (𝟙 (Xc k)) (isCoherentLike_pushUnit_id k) 1
    (height_genericPoint_xc_nat k)]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AssemblyWitnessCubic.tau_one_eq
statement:
theorem tau_one_eq :
    T.tau (Xc k) (k0ToG0 (Xc k) 1) =
      DirectSum.of (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow (Xc k) n) 1
          ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk
            (dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint (Xc k)) 1 (height_genericPoint_xc_nat k)) : DimChow (Xc k) 1)) +
        DirectSum.of (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow (Xc k) n) 0
          (DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow (Xc k) n) 0
            (T.tau (Xc k) (k0ToG0 (Xc k) 1)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := tau_one_leading T
  refine DirectSum.ext_component ℚ fun m ↦ ?_
  simp only [map_add, ← DirectSum.lof_eq_of ℚ, DirectSum.component.of]
  rcases m with _ | _ | m
  · simp
  · simpa using h2
  · rw [h1 (m + 2) (by omega)]
    simp

name: RRC.SingularToddTransformation_nodalCubic
statement:
theorem SingularToddTransformation_nodalCubic (k : Type u) [Field k] [Infinite k]
    (T : TargetThree k) :
    ProjK k (Xc k) ∧ IsIntegral (Xc k) ∧ ¬ RegStalks (Xc k) ∧
      Order.height (genericPoint (Xc k)) = 1 ∧
      degPn k 2 (totalPushOn (opsK k) (iotaP k) (T.tau (Xc k) (k0ToG0 (Xc k) 1))) = 0 ∧
      degPn k 2 (totalPushOn (opsK k) (iotaP k) (T.tau (Xc k) (k0ToG0 (Xc k)
        (pullbackK0RingHom (iotaP k) (projectiveTwistingK0Class k 2 1))))) = 3 ∧
      (∀ e : ℤ, degPn k 2 (totalPushOn (opsK k) (iotaP k) (T.tau (Xc k) (k0ToG0 (Xc k)
        (pullbackK0RingHom (iotaP k) (projectiveTwistingK0Class k 2 e))))) = 3 * (e : ℚ)) ∧
      (∀ m, 1 < m → DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow (Xc k) n) m
        (T.tau (Xc k) (k0ToG0 (Xc k) 1)) = 0) ∧
      DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow (Xc k) n) 1
          (T.tau (Xc k) (k0ToG0 (Xc k) 1)) =
        (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk
          (dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint (Xc k)) 1 (height_genericPoint_xc_nat k)) : DimChow (Xc k) 1)
proof:
:=
  ⟨projK_xc k, inferInstance, not_regStalks_X k, height_genericPoint_xc k,
    degPn_push_tau_one T, degPn_push_tau_O1 T, degPn_push_tau_twist T,
    (tau_one_leading T).1, (tau_one_leading T).2⟩

name: RRC.SingularToddTransformation_nodalCubic_conditional
statement:
theorem SingularToddTransformation_nodalCubic_conditional (k : Type u) [Field k] [Infinite k]
    (hR : Assembly.RegSpecAll k) :
    ∃ T : TargetThree k,
      ¬ RegStalks (Xc k) ∧
      degPn k 2 (totalPushOn (opsK k) (iotaP k) (T.tau (Xc k) (k0ToG0 (Xc k) 1))) = 0 ∧
      degPn k 2 (totalPushOn (opsK k) (iotaP k) (T.tau (Xc k) (k0ToG0 (Xc k)
        (pullbackK0RingHom (iotaP k) (projectiveTwistingK0Class k 2 1))))) = 3
proof:
:=
  ⟨Assembly.targetThree_conditional k hR, not_regStalks_X k,
    degPn_push_tau_one _, degPn_push_tau_O1 _⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.rank_add_rank_of_exact_kim2
statement:
theorem rank_add_rank_of_exact_kim2 {K : Type*} [Field K] {p n m : Type*} [Fintype p] [Fintype n]
    [Fintype m] (D₁ : Matrix n p K) (D₀ : Matrix m n K)
    (h : Function.Exact D₁.mulVecLin D₀.mulVecLin) :
    D₁.rank + D₀.rank = Fintype.card n
proof:
:= by
  have hrn := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker D₀.mulVecLin
  rw [Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card] at hrn
  rw [h.linearMap_ker_eq] at hrn
  rw [Matrix.rank, Matrix.rank]
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.rank_map_fractionRing_kim2
statement:
theorem rank_map_fractionRing_kim2 {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {m n : Type*}
    [Fintype m] [Fintype n] (D : Matrix m n R) (c : ℕ) (htop : GraphBundles.minorsIdeal c D = ⊤)
    (hbot : GraphBundles.minorsIdeal (c + 1) D = ⊥) :
    (D.map (algebraMap R (FractionRing R))).rank = c
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : c ≤ (D.map (algebraMap R (FractionRing R))).rank := by
    rw [← minorsIdeal_ne_bot_iff_le_rank, minorsIdeal_map_eq_top _ _ _ htop]
    exact top_ne_bot
  have h2 : (D.map (algebraMap R (FractionRing R))).rank < c + 1 := by
    rw [← minorsIdeal_eq_bot_iff_rank_lt]
    exact minorsIdeal_map_eq_bot _ _ _ hbot
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.add_eq_card_of_exact_kim2
statement:
theorem add_eq_card_of_exact_kim2 {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {p n m : Type*}
    [Fintype p] [Fintype n] [Fintype m] (D₁ : Matrix n p R) (D₀ : Matrix m n R)
    (h : Function.Exact D₁.mulVecLin D₀.mulVecLin) (a b : ℕ) (ha : GraphBundles.minorsIdeal a D₁ = ⊤)
    (ha' : GraphBundles.minorsIdeal (a + 1) D₁ = ⊥) (hb : GraphBundles.minorsIdeal b D₀ = ⊤)
    (hb' : GraphBundles.minorsIdeal (b + 1) D₀ = ⊥) : a + b = Fintype.card n
proof:
:= by
  have hK := exact_map_of_exact (A := FractionRing R) (nonZeroDivisors R) D₁ D₀ h
  have := rank_add_rank_of_exact_kim2 _ _ hK
  rwa [rank_map_fractionRing_kim2 D₁ a ha ha', rank_map_fractionRing_kim2 D₀ b hb hb'] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.ideal_map_germ_congr_kim2
statement:
theorem ideal_map_germ_congr_kim2 (I : X.IdealSheafData) {A B : X.affineOpens} (hAB : A = B)
    {x : X} (hA : x ∈ A.1) (hB : x ∈ B.1) :
    (I.ideal A).map (X.presheaf.germ A.1 x hA).hom = (I.ideal B).map (X.presheaf.germ B.1 x hB).hom
proof:
:= by
  subst hAB
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.ideal_map_germ_eq_kim2
statement:
theorem ideal_map_germ_eq_kim2 (I : X.IdealSheafData) (V V' : X.affineOpens) {x : X}
    (hx : x ∈ V.1) (hx' : x ∈ V'.1) :
    (I.ideal V).map (X.presheaf.germ V.1 x hx).hom =
      (I.ideal V').map (X.presheaf.germ V'.1 x hx').hom
proof:
:= by
  have e : ∀ (W : X.affineOpens) (hW : x ∈ W.1),
      (X.presheaf.germ W.1 x hW).hom = stalkHomXiR (𝟙 X) W.1 (w := x) hW := fun W hW => rfl
  rw [e V hx, e V' hx']
  exact ideal_map_stalkHom_eq_kim (𝟙 X) I V V' hx hx'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.splitData_numerics
statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.splitData_numerics (C : RankedBundleComplex M) {U : M.Opens}
    (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) (V' : M.affineOpens) (hV'U : V'.1 ≤ U) {x : M} (hx : x ∈ V'.1)
    (cf : ℕ → ℕ) (hcf : IsSplitData C.toDetIdealComplex V' cf) :
    cf 0 = 0 ∧ ∀ j ≤ C.K.len, (if j + 1 ≤ C.K.len then cf (j + 1) else 0) + cf j = C.rank j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : Nonempty M := ⟨x⟩
  obtain ⟨V, hxV, hVV', ⟨fr⟩⟩ := C.exists_sectionFrames (U := V'.1) hx
  obtain ⟨hsurj, hex⟩ := hC V (hVV'.trans hV'U)
  have hexR : ∀ j, Function.Exact (frameMat C V fr (j + 1)).mulVecLin
      (frameMat C V fr j).mulVecLin := by
    intro j
    rw [frameMat_mulVecLin, frameMat_mulVecLin]
    exact exact_conj _ _ (fr j) (fr (j + 1)) (fr (j + 2)) (hex j)
  have hsurjR : Function.Surjective (frameMat C V fr 0).mulVecLin := by
    rw [frameMat_mulVecLin]
    simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
    exact (fr 0).symm.surjective.comp (hsurj.comp (fr 1).surjective)
  
  let A := M.presheaf.stalk x
  letI : Algebra Γ(M, V.1) A := TopCat.Presheaf.algebra_section_stalk M.presheaf ⟨x, hxV⟩
  haveI := V.2.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hxV⟩
  let S := (V.2.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxV⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl
  let N : ∀ j, Matrix _ _ A := fun j => (frameMat C V fr j).map (algebraMap Γ(M, V.1) A)
  have hexA : ∀ j, Function.Exact (N (j + 1)).mulVecLin (N j).mulVecLin := fun j =>
    exact_map_of_exact S _ _ (hexR j)
  have hsurjA : Function.Surjective (N 0).mulVecLin :=
    surjective_map_of_surjective S _ hsurjR
  
  have hminA : ∀ j r, GraphBundles.minorsIdeal r (N j) =
      ((C.toDetIdealComplex.detIdeal (j + 1) r).ideal V').map (M.presheaf.germ V'.1 x hx).hom := by
    intro j r
    rw [← ideal_map_germ_eq_kim2 _ V V' hxV hx, RankedBundleComplex.toDetIdealComplex_detIdeal,
      (frameDataOfFrames C V fr).detIdeal_ideal_eq (j + 1) r, ← minorsIdeal_map]
    rfl
  
  let a : ℕ → ℕ := fun j => if j + 1 ≤ C.K.len then cf (j + 1) else 0
  have hsplitA : ∀ j, GraphBundles.minorsIdeal (a j) (N j) = ⊤ ∧ GraphBundles.minorsIdeal (a j + 1) (N j) = ⊥ := by
    intro j
    by_cases hj : j + 1 ≤ C.K.len
    · have ha : a j = cf (j + 1) := if_pos hj
      obtain ⟨hle, htop, hbot⟩ := hcf (j + 1) hj
      rw [ha]
      refine ⟨by rw [hminA, htop _ le_rfl, Ideal.map_top], ?_⟩
      by_cases hr : cf (j + 1) + 1 ≤ C.rank (j + 1)
      · rw [hminA, hbot _ (Nat.lt_succ_self _) hr, Ideal.map_bot]
      · apply minorsIdeal_eq_bot_of_card_lt
        rw [Fintype.card_ulift, Fintype.card_fin, C.frRank_eq_rank]
        change ¬ (cf (j + 1) + 1 ≤ C.toDetIdealComplex.rank (j + 1)) at hr
        rw [RankedBundleComplex.toDetIdealComplex_rank] at hr
        omega
    · have ha : a j = 0 := if_neg hj
      rw [ha]
      refine ⟨minorsIdeal_zero _, minorsIdeal_eq_bot_of_card_lt _ ?_⟩
      rw [Fintype.card_ulift, Fintype.card_fin]
      unfold RankedBundleComplex.frRank
      rw [if_neg hj]
      omega
  have hcard : ∀ j, j ≤ C.K.len →
      Fintype.card (ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j))) = C.rank j := fun j _ => by
    rw [Fintype.card_ulift, Fintype.card_fin, C.frRank_eq_rank]
  
  have hcf0 : cf 0 = 0 := by
    obtain ⟨-, htop, -⟩ := hcf 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
    by_contra hne
    have h1 := htop 1 (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hne)
    rw [RankedBundleComplex.toDetIdealComplex_detIdeal, RankedBundleComplex.detIdeal_zero_left,
      if_neg one_ne_zero, Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_bot] at h1
    haveI := nontrivial_sections_xiR hx
    exact bot_ne_top h1
  refine ⟨hcf0, fun j hj => ?_⟩
  rcases j with _ | i
  · have hex0 : Function.Exact (N 0).mulVecLin (0 : Matrix (Fin 0) _ A).mulVecLin :=
      fun y => ⟨fun _ => hsurjA y, fun _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
    have h := add_eq_card_of_exact_kim2 _ _ hex0 (a 0) 0 (hsplitA 0).1 (hsplitA 0).2
      (by rw [minorsIdeal_of_isEmpty_rows, if_pos rfl])
      (by rw [minorsIdeal_of_isEmpty_rows, if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero 0)])
    rw [hcard 0 hj, add_zero] at h
    rw [hcf0, add_zero]
    exact h
  · have h := add_eq_card_of_exact_kim2 _ _ (hexA i) (a (i + 1)) (a i) (hsplitA (i + 1)).1
      (hsplitA (i + 1)).2 (hsplitA i).1 (hsplitA i).2
    rw [hcard (i + 1) hj] at h
    have hai : a i = cf (i + 1) := if_pos hj
    rw [hai] at h
    exact h

name: SingTau.ResolutionData.ι_p
statement: theorem ι_p (j : ℕ) : R.ι j ≫ R.p j = 0
proof: := (R.ses j).zero

name: SingTau.ResolutionData.d_ε
statement: theorem d_ε : K.d 0 ≫ R.ε = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ε, R.fac 0, Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc (R.ι 0), R.ι_p, zero_comp, comp_zero]

name: SingTau.ResolutionData.isZero_Z
statement: theorem isZero_Z (j : ℕ) (hj : K.len < j) : IsZero (R.Z j)
proof:
:=
  IsZero.of_epi (R.p j) (K.isZero_E j hj)

name: SingTau.ResolutionData.exact_succ
statement: theorem exact_succ (j : ℕ) : (ShortComplex.mk (K.d (j + 1)) (K.d j) (K.dd j)).Exact
proof:
:= by
  have h3 : (ShortComplex.mk (R.ι (j + 1)) (R.p (j + 1)) (R.ι_p _)).Exact := (R.ses (j + 1)).exact.exact
  have hz : R.ι (j + 1) ≫ R.p (j + 1) ≫ R.ι j = 0 := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, R.ι_p, zero_comp]
  let φ : ShortComplex.mk (R.ι (j + 1)) (R.p (j + 1)) (R.ι_p _) ⟶
      ShortComplex.mk (R.ι (j + 1)) (R.p (j + 1) ≫ R.ι j) hz :=
    { τ₁ := 𝟙 _, τ₂ := 𝟙 _, τ₃ := R.ι j }
  have h2 : (ShortComplex.mk (R.ι (j + 1)) (R.p (j + 1) ≫ R.ι j) hz).Exact :=
    (ShortComplex.exact_iff_of_epi_of_isIso_of_mono φ).1 h3
  let ψ : ShortComplex.mk (K.d (j + 1)) (K.d j) (K.dd j) ⟶
      ShortComplex.mk (R.ι (j + 1)) (R.p (j + 1) ≫ R.ι j) hz :=
    { τ₁ := R.p (j + 2), τ₂ := 𝟙 _, τ₃ := 𝟙 _
      comm₁₂ := by simp [R.fac (j + 1)]
      comm₂₃ := by simp [R.fac j] }
  exact (ShortComplex.exact_iff_of_epi_of_isIso_of_mono ψ).2 h2

name: SingTau.ResolutionData.exact_zero
statement: theorem exact_zero : (ShortComplex.mk (K.d 0) R.ε R.d_ε).Exact
proof:
:= by
  have h3 : (ShortComplex.mk (R.ι 0) (R.p 0) (R.ι_p _)).Exact := (R.ses 0).exact.exact
  have hz : R.ι 0 ≫ R.p 0 ≫ R.e.hom = 0 := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, R.ι_p, zero_comp]
  let φ : ShortComplex.mk (R.ι 0) (R.p 0) (R.ι_p _) ⟶
      ShortComplex.mk (R.ι 0) (R.p 0 ≫ R.e.hom) hz :=
    { τ₁ := 𝟙 _, τ₂ := 𝟙 _, τ₃ := R.e.hom }
  have h2 : (ShortComplex.mk (R.ι 0) (R.p 0 ≫ R.e.hom) hz).Exact :=
    (ShortComplex.exact_iff_of_epi_of_isIso_of_mono φ).1 h3
  let ψ : ShortComplex.mk (K.d 0) R.ε R.d_ε ⟶ ShortComplex.mk (R.ι 0) (R.p 0 ≫ R.e.hom) hz :=
    { τ₁ := R.p 1, τ₂ := 𝟙 _, τ₃ := 𝟙 _
      comm₁₂ := by simp [R.fac 0]
      comm₂₃ := by simp [ε] }
  exact (ShortComplex.exact_iff_of_epi_of_isIso_of_mono ψ).2 h2

name: SingTau.ResolutionData.alt_partial
statement:
theorem alt_partial (Q' : C → Prop) (hE' : ∀ j, Q' (K.E j)) (hZ' : ∀ j, Q' (R.Z j)) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, (-1 : ℤ) ^ j • ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf C Q' (K.E j) (hE' j) =
      ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf C Q' (R.Z 0) (hZ' 0) -
        (-1 : ℤ) ^ n • ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf C Q' (R.Z n) (hZ' n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih,
      ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_middle C Q' (hZ' (n + 1)) (hE' n) (hZ' n)
        (R.ses n).zero (R.ses n).exact, pow_succ, mul_neg_one]
    generalize (-1 : ℤ) ^ n = c
    generalize ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf C Q' (R.Z 0) (hZ' 0) = x
    generalize ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf C Q' (R.Z n) (hZ' n) = y
    generalize ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf C Q' (R.Z (n + 1)) (hZ' (n + 1)) = z
    rw [zsmul_add, neg_zsmul]
    abel

name: SingTau.ResolutionData.alt_eq
statement:
theorem alt_eq (Q' : C → Prop) (hE' : ∀ j, Q' (K.E j)) (hZ' : ∀ j, Q' (R.Z j)) (hG' : Q' G) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (K.len + 1),
        (-1 : ℤ) ^ j • ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf C Q' (K.E j) (hE' j) =
      ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf C Q' G hG'
proof:
:= by
  rw [R.alt_partial Q' hE' hZ',
    ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_isZero C Q' (hZ' _) (R.isZero_Z _ (Nat.lt_succ_self _)),
    smul_zero, sub_zero]
  exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso C Q' (hZ' 0) hG' (hZ' (K.len + 1))
    (R.isZero_Z _ (Nat.lt_succ_self _)) R.e

name: SingTau.ResolutionData.gAlt_eq
statement:
theorem gAlt_eq (hPQ : ∀ {A : C}, P A → Q A) (hG : Q G) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (K.len + 1),
        (-1 : ℤ) ^ j • ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf C Q (K.E j) (hPQ (K.hE j)) =
      ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf C Q G hG
proof:
:=
  R.alt_eq Q (fun j => hPQ (K.hE j)) R.hZ hG

name: SingTau.ResolutionData.map_altSum
statement:
theorem map_altSum (hPQ : ∀ {A : C}, P A → Q A)
    (f : ExactGrothendieck.SubcategoryGroup C P →+ ExactGrothendieck.SubcategoryGroup C Q)
    (hf : ∀ (A : C) (h : P A), f (ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf C P A h) =
      ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf C Q A (hPQ h)) (hG : Q G) :
    f K.altSum = ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf C Q G hG
proof:
:= by
  unfold PComplex.altSum
  rw [map_sum]
  simp only [map_zsmul, hf]
  exact R.gAlt_eq hPQ hG

name: SingTau.alt_shift
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ', pow_zero, one_smul, Nat.add_zero, sub_eq_add_neg,
    ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib, add_comm]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [show k + (i + 1) = k + 1 + i by omega, pow_succ, mul_neg_one, neg_smul]

name: SingTau.tailSum_succ
statement:
private theorem tailSum_succ (K : PComplex S.P) (k n : ℕ) :
    tailSum S K k (n + 1) = cls S (K.E k) (K.hE k) - tailSum S K (k + 1) n
proof:
:=
  alt_shift (termCls S K) k n

name: SingTau.rep_tail
statement: theorem rep_tail : ∀ (n k : ℕ), K.len + 1 ≤ k + n → Rep S n (R.Z k) (tailSum S K k n)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro k hk
    have hz : IsZero (R.Z k) := R.isZero_Z k (by omega)
    refine ⟨S.P_zero hz, ?_⟩
    simp only [tailSum, Finset.range_zero, Finset.sum_empty]
    exact (ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_isZero C S.P (S.P_zero hz) hz).symm
  | succ n ih =>
    intro k hk
    exact ⟨R.Z (k + 1), K.E k, R.ι k, R.p k, tailSum S K (k + 1) n, R.ses k, K.hE k, R.hZ (k + 1),
      ih (k + 1) (by omega), tailSum_succ S K k n⟩

name: SingTau.rep_altSum
statement: theorem rep_altSum : Rep S (K.len + 1) G K.altSum
proof:
:= by
  have h := rep_tail S R (K.len + 1) 0 (by omega)
  have ht : tailSum S K 0 (K.len + 1) = K.altSum := by
    unfold tailSum PComplex.altSum termCls
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [Nat.zero_add]
    rfl
  rw [ht] at h
  exact PerfectRepG2.rep_iso S _ R.e h

name: SingTau.repK0_eq_altSum
statement:
theorem repK0_eq_altSum {d : ℕ} (hQ : S.Q G) (hd : PdLE S d G) :
    PerfectRepG2.repK0 S G hQ hd = K.altSum
proof:
:=
  PerfectRepG2.repK0_eq_of_rep S hQ hd (rep_altSum S R)

name: SingTau.comp4_eq_zero
statement:
theorem comp4_eq_zero {W X Y Z V : C} (a : W ⟶ X) (b : X ⟶ Y) (c : Y ⟶ Z) (e : Z ⟶ V)
    (h : b ≫ c = 0) : (a ≫ b) ≫ (c ≫ e) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc b, h, zero_comp, comp_zero]

name: SingTau.exists_cover_iso
statement:
theorem exists_cover_iso {M : C} (hM : S.Q M) :
    ∃ (E : C) (g : E ⟶ M), S.P E ∧ Epi g ∧ (S.P M → IsIso g)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : S.P M
  · exact ⟨M, 𝟙 M, h, inferInstance, fun _ => inferInstance⟩
  · obtain ⟨E, g, hE, hg⟩ := S.cover hM
    exact ⟨E, g, hE, hg, fun h' => (h h').elim⟩

name: SingTau.QObj.coverObj_P
statement: theorem QObj.coverObj_P (M : QObj S) : S.P M.coverObj
proof:
:=
  (exists_cover_iso S M.hQ).choose_spec.choose_spec.1

name: SingTau.QObj.isIso_coverMap
statement: theorem QObj.isIso_coverMap (M : QObj S) (h : S.P M.obj) : IsIso M.coverMap
proof:
:=
  (exists_cover_iso S M.hQ).choose_spec.choose_spec.2.2 h

name: SingTau.syz_chain
statement:
theorem syz_chain {Z E : ℕ → C} (ι : ∀ j, Z (j + 1) ⟶ E j) (p : ∀ j, E j ⟶ Z j)
    (hs : ∀ j, SES (ι j) (p j)) (hE : ∀ j, S.P (E j)) (hZ : ∀ j, S.Q (Z j)) :
    ∀ n k, Syz S n (Z (k + n)) (Z k)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro k; exact ⟨Iso.refl _⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    intro k
    have h := ih (k + 1)
    rw [show k + 1 + n = k + (n + 1) by omega] at h
    exact ⟨Z (k + 1), E k, ι k, p k, hs k, hE k, hZ (k + 1), h⟩

name: SingTau.QObj.isZero_next
statement: theorem QObj.isZero_next (M : QObj S) (h : S.P M.obj) : IsZero M.next.obj
proof:
:= by
  haveI := M.isIso_coverMap h
  change IsZero (kernel M.coverMap)
  exact IsZero.of_mono_eq_zero (kernel.ι M.coverMap) (by
    rw [← cancel_mono M.coverMap, kernel.condition, zero_comp])

name: SingTau.syzStage_P
statement:
theorem syzStage_P (G : QObj S) {d : ℕ} (hd : PdLE S d G.obj) :
    ∀ j, d ≤ j → S.P (syzStage G j).obj
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    have hd0 : d = 0 := by omega
    subst hd0
    exact (pdLE_zero_iff S).1 hd
  | succ j ih =>
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j d with h | h
    · have hdj : d = j + 1 := by omega
      subst hdj
      have hsyz := syz_chain (S := S) (Z := fun j => (syzStage G j).obj)
        (E := fun j => (syzStage G j).coverObj) (fun j => kernel.ι (syzStage G j).coverMap)
        (fun j => (syzStage G j).coverMap) (fun j => SES.kernel_of_epi (syzStage G j).coverMap)
        (fun j => (syzStage G j).coverObj_P) (fun j => (syzStage G j).hQ) (j + 1) 0
      rw [Nat.zero_add] at hsyz
      exact hd _ hsyz
    · exact S.P_zero ((syzStage G j).isZero_next (ih h))

name: SingTau.exists_resolution
statement:
theorem exists_resolution {d : ℕ} {G : C} (hQ : S.Q G) (hd : PdLE S d G) :
    ∃ K : PComplex S.P, K.len = d ∧ PResolves S.Q K G
proof:
:=
  ⟨syzComplex ⟨G, hQ⟩ d hd, rfl, ⟨syzData ⟨G, hQ⟩ d hd⟩⟩

name: SingTau.DomStage.hQP1

proof: := S.Q_pullback _ _ (S.P_Q (K₂.hE j)) s.hQ (R₂.hZ j)

name: SingTau.DomStage.hQT

name: SingTau.DomStage.hE3

proof: := s.TQ.coverObj_P

name: SingTau.DomStage.ses1

proof: := (R₁.ses j).pullbackL s.α

name: SingTau.DomStage.ses2
statement: theorem ses2 : SES s.ℓ2 s.q2
proof: := (R₂.ses j).pullbackL s.β

name: SingTau.DomStage.ses3

proof: := s.ses1.comp s.af

name: SingTau.DomStage.β'_aux
statement: theorem β'_aux : (s.ι3 ≫ s.a ≫ pullback.snd s.q1 s.q2) ≫ s.q2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← pullback.condition, ← Category.assoc s.a, ← Category.assoc s.ι3,
    ← pullback.condition, Category.assoc, s.ses1.zero, comp_zero]

name: SingTau.DomStage.β'_ℓ2
statement: theorem β'_ℓ2 : s.β' ≫ s.ℓ2 = s.ι3 ≫ s.a ≫ pullback.snd s.q1 s.q2
proof:
:=
  (s.ses2.liftSub (s.ι3 ≫ s.a ≫ pullback.snd s.q1 s.q2) s.β'_aux).2

name: SingTau.DomStage.epi_β'
statement: theorem epi_β' : Epi s.β'
proof:
:= by
  have hw : (0 : pullback s.ℓ2T s.a ⟶ R₁.Z (j + 1)) ≫ s.ℓ1 = pullback.snd s.ℓ2T s.a ≫ s.af := by
    rw [zero_comp, ← Category.assoc, ← pullback.condition, Category.assoc, pullback.lift_fst,
      comp_zero]
  let κ : pullback s.ℓ2T s.a ⟶ s.Z' := pullback.lift 0 (pullback.snd s.ℓ2T s.a) hw
  haveI : Mono s.ℓ2 := s.ses2.mono
  have hfac : κ ≫ s.β' = pullback.fst s.ℓ2T s.a := by
    rw [← cancel_mono s.ℓ2, Category.assoc, s.β'_ℓ2, ← Category.assoc κ, pullback.lift_snd,
      ← Category.assoc, ← pullback.condition, Category.assoc, pullback.lift_snd]
  exact epi_of_epi_fac hfac

name: SingTau.DomStage.hQZ'
statement: theorem hQZ' : S.Q s.Z'
proof: := S.Q_pullback _ _ (R₁.hZ (j + 1)) (S.P_Q s.hE3) s.hQP1

name: SingTau.DomStage.φ1_p
statement: theorem φ1_p : s.φ1 ≫ R₁.p j = s.p3 ≫ s.α
proof:
:= by
  rw [Category.assoc, pullback.condition, ← Category.assoc]

name: SingTau.DomStage.φ2_p
statement: theorem φ2_p : s.φ2 ≫ R₂.p j = s.p3 ≫ s.β
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : pullback.fst (R₂.p j) s.β ≫ R₂.p j = s.q2 ≫ s.β := pullback.condition
  have h2 : pullback.snd s.q1 s.q2 ≫ s.q2 = pullback.fst s.q1 s.q2 ≫ s.q1 :=
    pullback.condition.symm
  calc s.φ2 ≫ R₂.p j = s.a ≫ pullback.snd s.q1 s.q2 ≫ (pullback.fst (R₂.p j) s.β ≫ R₂.p j) := by
        simp only [φ2, Category.assoc]
    _ = s.a ≫ (pullback.snd s.q1 s.q2 ≫ s.q2) ≫ s.β := by rw [h1, Category.assoc]
    _ = s.a ≫ (pullback.fst s.q1 s.q2 ≫ s.q1) ≫ s.β := by rw [h2]
    _ = s.p3 ≫ s.β := by simp only [p3, af, Category.assoc]

name: SingTau.DomStage.ι3_φ1
statement: theorem ι3_φ1 : s.ι3 ≫ s.φ1 = s.α' ≫ R₁.ι j
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← pullback.condition, Category.assoc, pullback.lift_fst]

name: SingTau.DomStage.ι3_φ2
statement: theorem ι3_φ2 : s.ι3 ≫ s.φ2 = s.β' ≫ R₂.ι j
proof:
:= by
  have h : s.β' ≫ s.ℓ2 ≫ pullback.fst (R₂.p j) s.β = s.β' ≫ R₂.ι j := by
    rw [pullback.lift_fst]
  rw [← h, ← Category.assoc s.β', s.β'_ℓ2]
  simp only [φ2, Category.assoc]

name: SingTau.DomStage.isIso_p3
statement: theorem isIso_p3 (hP : S.P s.Z) [IsIso (R₁.p j)] [IsIso (R₂.p j)] : IsIso s.p3
proof:
:= by
  have hPT : S.P s.T := S.P_iso (asIso (pullback.fst s.q1 s.q2 ≫ s.q1)).symm hP
  haveI : IsIso s.a := s.TQ.isIso_coverMap hPT
  unfold p3 af
  infer_instance

name: SingTau.DomStage.isZero_Z'
statement: theorem isZero_Z' (hP : S.P s.Z) [IsIso (R₁.p j)] [IsIso (R₂.p j)] : IsZero s.next.Z
proof:
:= by
  haveI := s.isIso_p3 hP
  haveI : Mono s.ι3 := s.ses3.mono
  have h0 : s.ι3 = 0 := by
    rw [← cancel_mono s.p3, s.ses3.zero, zero_comp]
  have : IsZero s.Z' := IsZero.of_mono_eq_zero _ h0
  exact this

name: SingTau.DomStage.chain1
statement: theorem chain1 : (s.next.p3 ≫ s.ι3) ≫ s.φ1 = s.next.φ1 ≫ K₁.d j
proof:
:=
  calc (s.next.p3 ≫ s.ι3) ≫ s.φ1 = s.next.p3 ≫ (s.ι3 ≫ s.φ1) := Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = s.next.p3 ≫ (s.α' ≫ R₁.ι j) := congrArg (fun t => s.next.p3 ≫ t) s.ι3_φ1
    _ = (s.next.p3 ≫ s.next.α) ≫ R₁.ι j := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = (s.next.φ1 ≫ R₁.p (j + 1)) ≫ R₁.ι j := by rw [s.next.φ1_p]
    _ = s.next.φ1 ≫ K₁.d j := by rw [R₁.fac j, Category.assoc]

name: SingTau.DomStage.chain2
statement: theorem chain2 : (s.next.p3 ≫ s.ι3) ≫ s.φ2 = s.next.φ2 ≫ K₂.d j
proof:
:=
  calc (s.next.p3 ≫ s.ι3) ≫ s.φ2 = s.next.p3 ≫ (s.ι3 ≫ s.φ2) := Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = s.next.p3 ≫ (s.β' ≫ R₂.ι j) := congrArg (fun t => s.next.p3 ≫ t) s.ι3_φ2
    _ = (s.next.p3 ≫ s.next.β) ≫ R₂.ι j := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = (s.next.φ2 ≫ R₂.p (j + 1)) ≫ R₂.ι j := by rw [s.next.φ2_p]
    _ = s.next.φ2 ≫ K₂.d j := by rw [R₂.fac j, Category.assoc]

name: SingTau.isIso_p_of_le
statement:
theorem isIso_p_of_le {P Q : C → Prop} {K : PComplex P} {G : C} (R : ResolutionData Q K G)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : K.len ≤ j) : IsIso (R.p j)
proof:
:= by
  have hz : IsZero (R.Z (j + 1)) := R.isZero_Z (j + 1) (by omega)
  have h0 : R.ι j = 0 := hz.eq_of_src _ _
  haveI : Mono (R.p j) :=
    (ShortComplex.exact_iff_mono (ShortComplex.mk (R.ι j) (R.p j) (R.ι_p j)) h0).1
      (R.ses j).exact.exact
  exact isIso_of_mono_of_epi _

name: SingTau.domStage_P
statement:
theorem domStage_P {d : ℕ} (hd : PdLE S d G) (L : ℕ) (hL : d ≤ L) (h1 : K₁.len ≤ L)
    (h2 : K₂.len ≤ L) : ∀ j, L ≤ j → S.P (domStage R₁ R₂ j).Z
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    have hL0 : L = 0 := by omega
    subst hL0
    have hd0 : d = 0 := by omega
    subst hd0
    exact (pdLE_zero_iff S).1 ((hd.iso S R₁.e.symm))
  | succ j ih =>
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j L with h | h
    · have hLj : L = j + 1 := by omega
      subst hLj
      have hsyz := syz_chain (S := S) (Z := fun j => (domStage R₁ R₂ j).Z)
        (E := fun j => (domStage R₁ R₂ j).E3) (fun j => (domStage R₁ R₂ j).ι3)
        (fun j => (domStage R₁ R₂ j).p3) (fun j => (domStage R₁ R₂ j).ses3)
        (fun j => (domStage R₁ R₂ j).hE3) (fun j => (domStage R₁ R₂ j).hQ) (j + 1) 0
      rw [Nat.zero_add] at hsyz
      exact (PerfectRepG2.pdLE_mono S hL (hd.iso S R₁.e.symm)) _ hsyz
    · haveI := isIso_p_of_le R₁ j (by omega)
      haveI := isIso_p_of_le R₂ j (by omega)
      haveI := (domStage R₁ R₂ j).isIso_p3 (ih h)
      exact S.P_zero ((domStage R₁ R₂ j).isZero_Z' (ih h))

name: SingTau.dominate
statement:
theorem dominate {d : ℕ} (hd : PdLE S d G) (R₁ : ResolutionData S.Q K₁ G)
    (R₂ : ResolutionData S.Q K₂ G) :
    ∃ (K₃ : PComplex S.P) (R₃ : ResolutionData S.Q K₃ G) (φ₁ : ∀ j, K₃.E j ⟶ K₁.E j)
      (φ₂ : ∀ j, K₃.E j ⟶ K₂.E j),
      K₃.len = max d (max K₁.len K₂.len) ∧
      (∀ j, Epi (φ₁ j)) ∧ (∀ j, Epi (φ₂ j)) ∧
      (∀ j, K₃.d j ≫ φ₁ j = φ₁ (j + 1) ≫ K₁.d j) ∧
      (∀ j, K₃.d j ≫ φ₂ j = φ₂ (j + 1) ≫ K₂.d j) ∧
      φ₁ 0 ≫ R₁.ε = R₃.ε ∧ φ₂ 0 ≫ R₂.ε = R₃.ε
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨domComplex R₁ R₂ hd, domData R₁ R₂ hd, fun j => (domStage R₁ R₂ j).φ1,
    fun j => (domStage R₁ R₂ j).φ2, rfl, fun j => (domStage R₁ R₂ j).epi_φ1,
    fun j => (domStage R₁ R₂ j).epi_φ2, fun j => (domStage R₁ R₂ j).chain1,
    fun j => (domStage R₁ R₂ j).chain2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (domStage R₁ R₂ 0).φ1 ≫ R₁.p 0 ≫ R₁.e.hom = (domStage R₁ R₂ 0).p3 ≫ R₁.e.hom
    rw [← Category.assoc, (domStage R₁ R₂ 0).φ1_p]
    change ((domStage R₁ R₂ 0).p3 ≫ 𝟙 _) ≫ R₁.e.hom = _
    rw [Category.comp_id]
  · change (domStage R₁ R₂ 0).φ2 ≫ R₂.p 0 ≫ R₂.e.hom = (domStage R₁ R₂ 0).p3 ≫ R₁.e.hom
    rw [← Category.assoc, (domStage R₁ R₂ 0).φ2_p]
    change ((domStage R₁ R₂ 0).p3 ≫ (R₁.e.hom ≫ R₂.e.inv)) ≫ R₂.e.hom = _
    simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]

name: SingTau.P_kernel_of_epi
statement:
theorem P_kernel_of_epi {A B : C} (f : A ⟶ B) [Epi f] (hA : S.P A) (hB : S.P B) :
    S.P (kernel f)
proof:
:=
  S.P_ker (SES.kernel_of_epi f) hA hB (S.Q_kernel f (S.P_Q hA) (S.P_Q hB))

name: SingTau.SesQ.next_shortExact
statement: theorem next_shortExact : s.snake.L₀.ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Mono s.snake.L₁.f := s.ses13.mono
  haveI : Epi s.snake.v₁₂.τ₁ := s.epi_v_τ₁
  have h0 : s.snake.v₂₃.τ₁ = 0 := by
    rw [← cancel_epi s.snake.v₁₂.τ₁, s.snake.w₁₃_τ₁, comp_zero]

  exact ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk' s.snake.L₀_exact inferInstance
    ((ShortComplex.exact_iff_epi s.snake.L₁' hδ).1 s.snake.L₁'_exact)
