name: SingTau.SesQ.chain_i
statement:
theorem chain_i : ((s.next hQ).v.τ₁ ≫ s.snake.v₀₁.τ₁) ≫ s.i =
    (s.next hQ).i ≫ ((s.next hQ).v.τ₂ ≫ s.snake.v₀₁.τ₂)
proof:
:=
  calc ((s.next hQ).v.τ₁ ≫ s.snake.v₀₁.τ₁) ≫ s.i
      = (s.next hQ).v.τ₁ ≫ (s.snake.v₀₁.τ₁ ≫ s.snake.L₁.f) := Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = (s.next hQ).v.τ₁ ≫ (s.snake.L₀.f ≫ s.snake.v₀₁.τ₂) :=
        congrArg (fun t => (s.next hQ).v.τ₁ ≫ t) s.snake.v₀₁.comm₁₂
    _ = ((s.next hQ).v.τ₁ ≫ (s.next hQ).L.f) ≫ s.snake.v₀₁.τ₂ := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = ((s.next hQ).row.f ≫ (s.next hQ).v.τ₂) ≫ s.snake.v₀₁.τ₂ := by
        rw [(s.next hQ).v.comm₁₂]
    _ = (s.next hQ).i ≫ ((s.next hQ).v.τ₂ ≫ s.snake.v₀₁.τ₂) := Category.assoc _ _ _

name: SingTau.SesQ.chain_q
statement:
theorem chain_q : ((s.next hQ).v.τ₂ ≫ s.snake.v₀₁.τ₂) ≫ s.q =
    (s.next hQ).q ≫ ((s.next hQ).v.τ₃ ≫ s.snake.v₀₁.τ₃)
proof:
:=
  calc ((s.next hQ).v.τ₂ ≫ s.snake.v₀₁.τ₂) ≫ s.q
      = (s.next hQ).v.τ₂ ≫ (s.snake.v₀₁.τ₂ ≫ s.snake.L₁.g) := Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = (s.next hQ).v.τ₂ ≫ (s.snake.L₀.g ≫ s.snake.v₀₁.τ₃) :=
        congrArg (fun t => (s.next hQ).v.τ₂ ≫ t) s.snake.v₀₁.comm₂₃
    _ = ((s.next hQ).v.τ₂ ≫ (s.next hQ).L.g) ≫ s.snake.v₀₁.τ₃ := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = ((s.next hQ).row.g ≫ (s.next hQ).v.τ₃) ≫ s.snake.v₀₁.τ₃ := by
        rw [(s.next hQ).v.comm₂₃]
    _ = (s.next hQ).q ≫ ((s.next hQ).v.τ₃ ≫ s.snake.v₀₁.τ₃) := Category.assoc _ _ _

name: SingTau.SesQ.isIso_v
statement:
theorem isIso_v (hP₂ : S.P s.L.X₂) (hP₃ : S.P s.L.X₃) :
    IsIso s.v.τ₁ ∧ IsIso s.v.τ₂ ∧ IsIso s.v.τ₃
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIso s.c3 := s.C3.isIso_coverMap hP₃
  have hPb : S.P s.Pb := S.P_iso (asIso (pullback.fst s.L.g s.c3)).symm hP₂
  haveI : IsIso s.c2 := s.C2.isIso_coverMap hPb
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [v_τ₁]; infer_instance
  · rw [v_τ₂]; infer_instance
  · rw [v_τ₃]; infer_instance

name: SingTau.SesQ.isZero_next
statement:
theorem isZero_next (hP₂ : S.P s.L.X₂) (hP₃ : S.P s.L.X₃) :
    IsZero (s.next hQ).L.X₁ ∧ IsZero (s.next hQ).L.X₂ ∧ IsZero (s.next hQ).L.X₃
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := s.isIso_v hP₂ hP₃
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · haveI : IsIso s.snake.v₁₂.τ₁ := h1
    have h0 : s.snake.v₀₁.τ₁ = 0 := by
      rw [← cancel_mono s.snake.v₁₂.τ₁, s.snake.w₀₂_τ₁, zero_comp]
    have : IsZero s.snake.L₀.X₁ :=
      @IsZero.of_mono_eq_zero _ _ _ _ _ _ s.snake.mono_v₀₁_τ₁ h0
    exact this
  · haveI : IsIso s.snake.v₁₂.τ₂ := h2
    have h0 : s.snake.v₀₁.τ₂ = 0 := by
      rw [← cancel_mono s.snake.v₁₂.τ₂, s.snake.w₀₂_τ₂, zero_comp]
    have : IsZero s.snake.L₀.X₂ :=
      @IsZero.of_mono_eq_zero _ _ _ _ _ _ s.snake.mono_v₀₁_τ₂ h0
    exact this
  · haveI : IsIso s.snake.v₁₂.τ₃ := h3
    have h0 : s.snake.v₀₁.τ₃ = 0 := by
      rw [← cancel_mono s.snake.v₁₂.τ₃, s.snake.w₀₂_τ₃, zero_comp]
    have : IsZero s.snake.L₀.X₃ :=
      @IsZero.of_mono_eq_zero _ _ _ _ _ _ s.snake.mono_v₀₁_τ₃ h0
    exact this

name: SingTau.hsStage_P
statement:
theorem hsStage_P (s₀ : SesQ S) {d₁ d₂ d₃ : ℕ} (hd₁ : PdLE S d₁ s₀.L.X₁)
    (hd₂ : PdLE S d₂ s₀.L.X₂) (hd₃ : PdLE S d₃ s₀.L.X₃) (N : ℕ) (h₁ : d₁ ≤ N) (h₂ : d₂ ≤ N)
    (h₃ : d₃ ≤ N) : ∀ j, N ≤ j → S.P (hsStage hQ s₀ j).L.X₁ ∧ S.P (hsStage hQ s₀ j).L.X₂ ∧
      S.P (hsStage hQ s₀ j).L.X₃
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    have hN : N = 0 := by omega
    subst hN
    exact ⟨(pdLE_zero_iff S).1 (by have : d₁ = 0 := by omega
                                   subst this; exact hd₁),
      (pdLE_zero_iff S).1 (by have : d₂ = 0 := by omega
                              subst this; exact hd₂),
      (pdLE_zero_iff S).1 (by have : d₃ = 0 := by omega
                              subst this; exact hd₃)⟩
  | succ j ih =>
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j N with h | h
    · have hNj : N = j + 1 := by omega
      subst hNj
      have c1 := syz_chain (S := S) (Z := fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).L.X₁)
        (E := fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).E1) (fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).snake.v₀₁.τ₁)
        (fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).v.τ₁) (fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).colSES₁)
        (fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).hE1) (fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).h₁) (j + 1) 0
      have c2 := syz_chain (S := S) (Z := fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).L.X₂)
        (E := fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).E2) (fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).snake.v₀₁.τ₂)
        (fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).v.τ₂) (fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).colSES₂)
        (fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).hE2) (fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).h₂) (j + 1) 0
      have c3 := syz_chain (S := S) (Z := fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).L.X₃)
        (E := fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).E3) (fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).snake.v₀₁.τ₃)
        (fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).v.τ₃) (fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).colSES₃)
        (fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).hE3) (fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).h₃) (j + 1) 0
      rw [Nat.zero_add] at c1 c2 c3
      exact ⟨PerfectRepG2.pdLE_mono S h₁ hd₁ _ c1, PerfectRepG2.pdLE_mono S h₂ hd₂ _ c2,
        PerfectRepG2.pdLE_mono S h₃ hd₃ _ c3⟩
    · obtain ⟨-, hP₂, hP₃⟩ := ih h
      obtain ⟨z1, z2, z3⟩ := (hsStage hQ s₀ j).isZero_next hQ hP₂ hP₃
      exact ⟨S.P_zero z1, S.P_zero z2, S.P_zero z3⟩

name: SingTau.hsStage_isZero
statement:
theorem hsStage_isZero (s₀ : SesQ S) {d₁ d₂ d₃ : ℕ} (hd₁ : PdLE S d₁ s₀.L.X₁)
    (hd₂ : PdLE S d₂ s₀.L.X₂) (hd₃ : PdLE S d₃ s₀.L.X₃) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : max d₁ (max d₂ d₃) < j) : IsZero (hsStage hQ s₀ j).E1 ∧
      IsZero (hsStage hQ s₀ j).E2 ∧ IsZero (hsStage hQ s₀ j).E3
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, j = i + 1 := ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩
  have hP := hsStage_P hQ s₀ hd₁ hd₂ hd₃ (max d₁ (max d₂ d₃)) (le_max_left _ _)
    (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))
  obtain ⟨-, hP₂, hP₃⟩ := hP j (by omega)
  obtain ⟨z1, z2, z3⟩ := (hsStage hQ s₀ j).isZero_next hQ hP₂ hP₃
  obtain ⟨-, hQ₂, hQ₃⟩ := hP (j + 1) (by omega)
  obtain ⟨i1, i2, i3⟩ := (hsStage hQ s₀ (j + 1)).isIso_v hQ₂ hQ₃
  haveI := i1
  haveI := i2
  haveI := i3
  exact ⟨IsZero.of_iso z1 (@asIso _ _ _ _ (hsStage hQ s₀ (j + 1)).v.τ₁ i1),
    IsZero.of_iso z2 (@asIso _ _ _ _ (hsStage hQ s₀ (j + 1)).v.τ₂ i2),
    IsZero.of_iso z3 (@asIso _ _ _ _ (hsStage hQ s₀ (j + 1)).v.τ₃ i3)⟩

name: SingTau.horseshoe
statement:
theorem horseshoe {L : ShortComplex C} (hL : L.ShortExact) (h₁ : S.Q L.X₁) (h₂ : S.Q L.X₂)
    (h₃ : S.Q L.X₃) {d₁ d₂ d₃ : ℕ} (hd₁ : PdLE S d₁ L.X₁) (hd₂ : PdLE S d₂ L.X₂)
    (hd₃ : PdLE S d₃ L.X₃) :
    ∃ (K₁ K₂ K₃ : PComplex S.P) (R₁ : ResolutionData S.Q K₁ L.X₁)
      (R₂ : ResolutionData S.Q K₂ L.X₂) (R₃ : ResolutionData S.Q K₃ L.X₃)
      (i : ∀ j, K₁.E j ⟶ K₂.E j) (q : ∀ j, K₂.E j ⟶ K₃.E j),
      K₁.len = max d₁ (max d₂ d₃) ∧ K₂.len = max d₁ (max d₂ d₃) ∧
      K₃.len = max d₁ (max d₂ d₃) ∧
      (∀ j, SES (i j) (q j)) ∧
      (∀ j, K₁.d j ≫ i j = i (j + 1) ≫ K₂.d j) ∧
      (∀ j, K₂.d j ≫ q j = q (j + 1) ≫ K₃.d j) ∧
      R₁.ε ≫ L.f = i 0 ≫ R₂.ε ∧ R₂.ε ≫ L.g = q 0 ≫ R₃.ε
proof:
:= by
  let s₀ : SesQ S := ⟨L, hL, h₁, h₂, h₃⟩
  let R₁ : ResolutionData S.Q (hsComplex₁ hQ s₀ hd₁ hd₂ hd₃) L.X₁ :=
    { Z := fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).L.X₁
      ι := fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).snake.v₀₁.τ₁
      p := fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).v.τ₁
      ses := fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).colSES₁
      fac := fun _ => rfl
      hZ := fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).h₁
      e := Iso.refl _ }
  let R₂ : ResolutionData S.Q (hsComplex₂ hQ s₀ hd₁ hd₂ hd₃) L.X₂ :=
    { Z := fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).L.X₂
      ι := fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).snake.v₀₁.τ₂
      p := fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).v.τ₂
      ses := fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).colSES₂
      fac := fun _ => rfl
      hZ := fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).h₂
      e := Iso.refl _ }
  let R₃ : ResolutionData S.Q (hsComplex₃ hQ s₀ hd₁ hd₂ hd₃) L.X₃ :=
    { Z := fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).L.X₃
      ι := fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).snake.v₀₁.τ₃
      p := fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).v.τ₃
      ses := fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).colSES₃
      fac := fun _ => rfl
      hZ := fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).h₃
      e := Iso.refl _ }
  refine ⟨_, _, _, R₁, R₂, R₃, fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).i, fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).q,
    rfl, rfl, rfl, fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).ses13, fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).chain_i hQ,
    fun j => (hsStage hQ s₀ j).chain_q hQ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (s₀.v.τ₁ ≫ 𝟙 _) ≫ L.f = s₀.i ≫ s₀.v.τ₂ ≫ 𝟙 _
    rw [Category.comp_id, Category.comp_id]
    exact s₀.v.comm₁₂
  · change (s₀.v.τ₂ ≫ 𝟙 _) ≫ L.g = s₀.q ≫ s₀.v.τ₃ ≫ 𝟙 _
    rw [Category.comp_id, Category.comp_id]
    exact s₀.v.comm₂₃

name: SingTau.ResolutionData.P_Z_of_isZero
statement:
theorem ResolutionData.P_Z_of_isZero (S : Setup C) {K : PComplex S.P}
    (R : ResolutionData S.Q K G) (hG : IsZero G) : ∀ j, S.P (R.Z j)
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero => exact S.P_zero (hG.of_iso R.e)
  | succ j ih => exact S.P_ker (R.ses j) (K.hE j) ih (R.hZ (j + 1))

name: SingTau.ResolutionData.altSum_eq_zero_of_isZero
statement:
theorem ResolutionData.altSum_eq_zero_of_isZero (S : Setup C) {K : PComplex S.P}
    (R : ResolutionData S.Q K G) (hG : IsZero G) : K.altSum = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := R.alt_eq S.P K.hE (R.P_Z_of_isZero S hG) (S.P_zero hG)
  rw [ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_isZero C S.P (S.P_zero hG) hG] at h
  exact h

name: SingTau.exact_local_split
statement:
theorem exact_local_split (R : ResolutionData Q K G) (hG : IsZero G)
    (hproj : ∀ j, Projective (K.E j)) :
    ∀ j, Projective (R.Z j) ∧
      Nonempty (ShortComplex.mk (R.ι j) (R.p j) (R.ses j).zero).Splitting
proof:
:= by
  have hZ : ∀ j, Projective (R.Z j) := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      have hz : IsZero (R.Z 0) := hG.of_iso R.e
      exact ⟨fun f e _ => ⟨0, hz.eq_of_src _ _⟩⟩
    | succ j ih =>
      haveI := ih
      haveI := hproj j
      let s := (R.ses j).exact.splittingOfProjective
      refine ⟨fun f e _ => ⟨R.ι j ≫ Projective.factorThru (s.r ≫ f) e, ?_⟩⟩
      rw [Category.assoc, Projective.factorThru_comp, ← Category.assoc]
      erw [s.f_r]
      rw [Category.id_comp]
  intro j
  haveI := hZ j
  exact ⟨hZ j, ⟨(R.ses j).exact.splittingOfProjective⟩⟩

name: SingTau.pdLE_of_regular
statement:
theorem pdLE_of_regular (K : Type u) [CommRing K] [IsNoetherianRing K]
    [M1.FiniteDimBase K] (n : ℕ) (i : M ⟶ space K n)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsLocallyNoetherian M]
    (hreg : ∀ x : M, IsRegularLocalRing (M.presheaf.stalk x)) (G : M.Modules)
    (hG : IsCoherentLike M G) :
    PerfectRepG2.Sch.PdLE (PerfectRepG2.Sch.hasBundleCovers_of_closedImmersion K n i)
      (n + M1.FiniteDimBase.d K) G
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherian (space K n) := SchemeProjectiveSpace.isNoetherian K n
  obtain ⟨Cv, R, hR, e, hdim⟩ := ClosedImmersionCoverF11.exists_regular_cover K n i hreg
  haveI : ∀ j, IsRegularRing (R j) := hR
  haveI : G.IsFinitePresentation := hG
  exact ResolutionRegularClosedF15.pdLE_of_kernelForm Cv (fun j => R j) e
    (PerfectRepG2.Sch.hasBundleCovers_of_closedImmersion K n i) _ G hG
    fun Z hZ => SheafSyzygyF10.isFiniteLocallyFree_of_isSheafSyzygy Cv _ (fun j => R j) e hdim hZ

statement:

    (G : M.Modules) (hG : IsCoherentLike M G) :

      C.len = n + M1.FiniteDimBase.d K ∧ Resolves C G
proof:

name: SingTau.exists_resolves

    (hM : Chow.M7.CIICLASS.ProjectiveIntegralK k M)
    (hreg : ∀ x : M, IsRegularLocalRing (M.presheaf.stalk x)) (G : M.Modules)
    (hG : IsCoherentLike M G) : ∃ C : BundleComplex M, Resolves C G
proof:

  haveI := hj

name: SingTau.dominate_of_regular
statement:
theorem dominate_of_regular (K : Type u) [CommRing K] [IsNoetherianRing K]
    [M1.FiniteDimBase K] (n : ℕ) (i : M ⟶ space K n)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (hreg : ∀ x : M, IsRegularLocalRing (M.presheaf.stalk x))
    {G : M.Modules} (hG : IsCoherentLike M G) {K₁ K₂ : BundleComplex M}
    (R₁ : ResolutionData (IsCoherentLike M) K₁ G) (R₂ : ResolutionData (IsCoherentLike M) K₂ G) :
    ∃ (K₃ : BundleComplex M) (R₃ : ResolutionData (IsCoherentLike M) K₃ G)
      (φ₁ : ∀ j, K₃.E j ⟶ K₁.E j) (φ₂ : ∀ j, K₃.E j ⟶ K₂.E j),
      K₃.len = max (n + M1.FiniteDimBase.d K) (max K₁.len K₂.len) ∧
      (∀ j, Epi (φ₁ j)) ∧ (∀ j, Epi (φ₂ j)) ∧
      (∀ j, K₃.d j ≫ φ₁ j = φ₁ (j + 1) ≫ K₁.d j) ∧
      (∀ j, K₃.d j ≫ φ₂ j = φ₂ (j + 1) ≫ K₂.d j) ∧
      φ₁ 0 ≫ R₁.ε = R₃.ε ∧ φ₂ 0 ≫ R₂.ε = R₃.ε
proof:
:= by
  haveI := PerfectRepG2.Sch.isLocallyNoetherian_of_closedImmersion K n i
  exact dominate (PerfectRepG2.Sch.setup M (PerfectRepG2.Sch.hasBundleCovers_of_closedImmersion K n i))
    (pdLE_of_regular K n i hreg G hG) R₁ R₂

name: SingTau.horseshoe_of_regular
statement:
theorem horseshoe_of_regular (K : Type u) [CommRing K] [IsNoetherianRing K]
    [M1.FiniteDimBase K] (n : ℕ) (emb : M ⟶ space K n)
    [IsClosedImmersion emb] (hreg : ∀ x : M, IsRegularLocalRing (M.presheaf.stalk x))
    {L : ShortComplex M.Modules} (hL : L.ShortExact) (h₁ : IsCoherentLike M L.X₁)
    (h₂ : IsCoherentLike M L.X₂) (h₃ : IsCoherentLike M L.X₃) :
    ∃ (K₁ K₂ K₃ : BundleComplex M) (R₁ : ResolutionData (IsCoherentLike M) K₁ L.X₁)
      (R₂ : ResolutionData (IsCoherentLike M) K₂ L.X₂)
      (R₃ : ResolutionData (IsCoherentLike M) K₃ L.X₃)
      (i : ∀ j, K₁.E j ⟶ K₂.E j) (q : ∀ j, K₂.E j ⟶ K₃.E j),
      (∀ j, SES (i j) (q j)) ∧
      (∀ j, K₁.d j ≫ i j = i (j + 1) ≫ K₂.d j) ∧
      (∀ j, K₂.d j ≫ q j = q (j + 1) ≫ K₃.d j) ∧
      R₁.ε ≫ L.f = i 0 ≫ R₂.ε ∧ R₂.ε ≫ L.g = q 0 ≫ R₃.ε
proof:
:= by
  haveI := PerfectRepG2.Sch.isLocallyNoetherian_of_closedImmersion K n emb
  obtain ⟨K₁, K₂, K₃, R₁, R₂, R₃, i, q, -, -, -, h⟩ :=
    horseshoe (PerfectRepG2.Sch.setup M (PerfectRepG2.Sch.hasBundleCovers_of_closedImmersion K n emb))
      (fun e h => isCoherentLike_of_iso e h) hL h₁ h₂ h₃
      (pdLE_of_regular K n emb hreg _ h₁) (pdLE_of_regular K n emb hreg _ h₂)
      (pdLE_of_regular K n emb hreg _ h₃)
  exact ⟨K₁, K₂, K₃, R₁, R₂, R₃, i, q, h⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ProjectionCovariance.push_injective_of_iso_g2tpcov
statement:
theorem push_injective_of_iso_g2tpcov :
    haveI : IsProper j
proof:
:= isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) j
    Function.Injective (totalPushOn (opsK k) j) := by
  haveI : IsProper j := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) j
  haveI : (inv j).IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨by rw [← comp_over j (Spk k), IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc]⟩
  haveI : IsProper (inv j) := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) (inv j)
  haveI : IsProper (j ≫ inv j) := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
  intro v w h
  have h' := congrArg (totalPushOn (opsK k) (inv j)) h
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← totalPushOn_comp,
    totalPushOn_congr (opsK k) (IsIso.hom_inv_id j), totalPushOn_id] at h'
  exact h'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ProjectionCovariance.tauAdditivity_of_iso
statement:
theorem tauAdditivity_of_iso {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n)
    (hadd : TauAdditivity hMK ιZ hM) : TauAdditivity hMK ιX hM
proof:
:= by
  intro C₁ C₂ C₃ i q hses hi hq U h₁ h₂ h₃ hX
  have hXZ : ∀ x : M, x ∉ U → x ∈ Set.range ιZ := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hX x hx
    exact ⟨j y, by rw [← hj]; rfl⟩
  apply push_injective_of_iso_g2tpcov (k := k) j
  rw [map_add, push_tauStd_closed hMK ιZ ιX j hj C₂ U h₂ hX hM,
    push_tauStd_closed hMK ιZ ιX j hj C₁ U h₁ hX hM, push_tauStd_closed hMK ιZ ιX j hj C₃ U h₃ hX hM]
  exact hadd C₁ C₂ C₃ i q hses hi hq U h₁ h₂ h₃ hXZ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ProjectionCovariance.isPullback_ιS

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ProjectionCovariance.gen_fst
statement:
theorem gen_fst (hIII : FlatBaseChangeFst k a b) [Nonempty X] (ι : X ⟶ space k a)
    [IsClosedImmersion ι] [ι.IsOver (Spk k)] (haddι : TauAdditivityPn a ι)
    (haddC : TauAdditivity (pp_member k a b) (ιF (b := b) ι) (pp_height k a b)) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : j < b + 1) (y : G0 X) :
    totalPushOn (opsK k) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).toBase
        (tauPP (ιF (b := b) ι) haddC ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-(j : ℤ)) •
          G0PB.pullbackG0 (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b) (coverHpos k _ b) y)) =
      if j = 0 then tauPn a ι haddι y else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hA : HasConstantRank (PP k a b)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pr₂PP k a b)).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k b (-(j : ℤ)))) 1 :=
    hasConstantRank_pullback _ _ _ 1 (hcr k b _)
  rw [← k0_pullTwist_neg b (ιF (b := b) ι) (pr₂PP k a b) (ιF_snd ι) j]
  unfold tauPP
  rw [tauTwo_apply, tauG0_smul_line (pp_member k a b) (ιF (b := b) ι) (pp_height k a b)
    (pp_regStalks k a b) _ hA haddC, hIII ι haddι haddC y]
  unfold tdTwo
  rw [Module.End.mul_apply,
    tdLineK_iso_g2tproj _ (hasConstantRank_pullback _ (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).toBase _ 1
      (hasConstantRank_pullback X ι _ 1 (hcr k a 1)))
      (baseTwistIso (ιF (b := b) ι) (pr₁PP k a b) _ ι (ιF_fst ι)),
    GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Interw.pow (interw_tdLineK (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).toBase _
      (hasConstantRank_pullback X ι _ 1 (hcr k a 1))) (a + 1),
    tdLineK_pullTwist_one b (ιF (b := b) ι) (pr₂PP k a b) (ιF_snd ι),
    chK_eq_chBundleT2 _ (hasConstantRank_pullTwist b (ιF (b := b) ι) (pr₂PP k a b) (-(j : ℤ))),
    eval_twistK k b (-(j : ℤ)) _ _
      (cap_pullTwist b (ιF (b := b) ι) (pr₂PP k a b) (ιF_snd ι) (-(j : ℤ))),
    GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4.choose_twist (-(j : ℤ)) (by omega) (by omega)]
  by_cases h0 : j = 0
  · subst h0
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero, if_true, one_smul]
    rfl
  · have h0' : -(j : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by omega
    simp only [h0, h0', if_false, zero_smul, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ProjectionCovariance.gen_snd
statement:
theorem gen_snd (hIII : FlatBaseChangeSnd k a b) [Nonempty X] (ι : X ⟶ space k b)
    [IsClosedImmersion ι] [ι.IsOver (Spk k)] (haddι : TauAdditivityPn b ι)
    (haddC : TauAdditivity (pp_member k a b) (ιS (a := a) ι) (pp_height k a b)) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : j < a + 1) (y : G0 X) :
    totalPushOn (opsK k) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) a).toBase
        (tauPP (ιS (a := a) ι) haddC ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) a).canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-(j : ℤ)) •
          G0PB.pullbackG0 (cover (X ↘ Spk k) a) (coverHpos k _ a) y)) =
      if j = 0 then tauPn b ι haddι y else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hA : HasConstantRank (PP k a b)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pr₁PP k a b)).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k a (-(j : ℤ)))) 1 :=
    hasConstantRank_pullback _ _ _ 1 (hcr k a _)
  rw [← k0_pullTwist_neg a (ιS (a := a) ι) (pr₁PP k a b) (ιS_fst ι) j]
  unfold tauPP
  rw [tauTwo_apply, tauG0_smul_line (pp_member k a b) (ιS (a := a) ι) (pp_height k a b)
    (pp_regStalks k a b) _ hA haddC, hIII ι haddι haddC y]
  unfold tdTwo
  rw [((tdLineK_commute _ _ _ _).pow_pow (a + 1) (b + 1)).eq, Module.End.mul_apply,
    tdLineK_iso_g2tproj _ (hasConstantRank_pullback _ (cover (X ↘ Spk k) a).toBase _ 1
      (hasConstantRank_pullback X ι _ 1 (hcr k b 1)))
      (baseTwistIso (ιS (a := a) ι) (pr₂PP k a b) _ ι (ιS_snd ι)),
    GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Interw.pow (interw_tdLineK (cover (X ↘ Spk k) a).toBase _
      (hasConstantRank_pullback X ι _ 1 (hcr k b 1))) (b + 1),
    tdLineK_pullTwist_one a (ιS (a := a) ι) (pr₁PP k a b) (ιS_fst ι),
    chK_eq_chBundleT2 _ (hasConstantRank_pullTwist a (ιS (a := a) ι) (pr₁PP k a b) (-(j : ℤ))),
    eval_twistK k a (-(j : ℤ)) _ _
      (cap_pullTwist a (ιS (a := a) ι) (pr₁PP k a b) (ιS_fst ι) (-(j : ℤ))),
    GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4.choose_twist (-(j : ℤ)) (by omega) (by omega)]
  by_cases h0 : j = 0
  · subst h0
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero, if_true, one_smul]
    rfl
  · have h0' : -(j : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by omega
    simp only [h0, h0', if_false, zero_smul, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegDeform.subsingleton_stalk_pushforward_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem subsingleton_stalk_pushforward_of_not_mem {V Y : Scheme.{u}} (ι : V ⟶ Y)
    [IsClosedImmersion ι] (F : V.Modules) {y : Y} (hy : y ∉ Set.range ι) :
    Subsingleton (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj F).presheaf.stalk y)
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ∀ c : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj F).presheaf.stalk y, c = 0 from
    ⟨fun a b ↦ by rw [h a, h b]⟩
  intro c
  obtain ⟨U, hyU, s, rfl⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.exists_germ_eq _ c
  let O : Y.Opens := ⟨(Set.range ι)ᶜ, ι.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range.isOpen_compl⟩
  let W : Y.Opens := U ⊓ O
  have hyW : y ∈ W := ⟨hyU, hy⟩
  have hW : ι ⁻¹ᵁ W = ⊥ := by
    ext v
    simp [W, O]
  haveI hsubR : Subsingleton Γ(V, ι ⁻¹ᵁ W) := hW ▸ inferInstance
  haveI hsub : Subsingleton (F.val.obj (op (ι ⁻¹ᵁ W))) := Module.subsingleton Γ(V, ι ⁻¹ᵁ W) _
  rw [← TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ (homOfLE inf_le_left : W ⟶ U) y hyW s]
  have h0 : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj F).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE inf_le_left : W ⟶ U).op s = 0 :=
    @Subsingleton.elim (F.val.obj (op (ι ⁻¹ᵁ W))) hsub _ _
  rw [h0, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.minorsIdeal_eq_of_mul_kim2
statement:
theorem minorsIdeal_eq_of_mul_kim2 {κ ν μ : Type*} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] [Fintype ν]
    [DecidableEq ν] (B : Matrix κ ν A) (L : Matrix ν κ A) (M : Matrix ν μ A) (X : Matrix κ μ A)
    (hBM : B * M = X) (hLB : L * B = 1) (r : ℕ) :
    GraphBundles.minorsIdeal r M = GraphBundles.minorsIdeal r X
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · have : M = L * X := by rw [← hBM, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hLB, Matrix.one_mul]
    rw [this]
    exact GraphBundles.minorsIdeal_mul_left_le L X r
  · rw [← hBM]
    exact GraphBundles.minorsIdeal_mul_left_le B M r

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.minorsIdeal_fromRows_zero_kim2
statement:
theorem minorsIdeal_fromRows_zero_kim2 {n m₀ μ : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Fintype m₀]
    [DecidableEq m₀] (d : Matrix n μ A) (r : ℕ) :
    GraphBundles.minorsIdeal r (Matrix.fromRows d (0 : Matrix m₀ μ A)) =
      GraphBundles.minorsIdeal r d
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · have : Matrix.fromRows d (0 : Matrix m₀ μ A) =
        Matrix.fromRows (1 : Matrix n n A) (0 : Matrix m₀ n A) * d := by
      rw [Matrix.fromRows_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.zero_mul]
    rw [this]
    exact GraphBundles.minorsIdeal_mul_left_le _ d r
  · have : d = Matrix.fromCols (1 : Matrix n n A) (0 : Matrix n m₀ A) *
        Matrix.fromRows d (0 : Matrix m₀ μ A) := by
      rw [Matrix.fromCols_mul_fromRows, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero]
    conv_lhs => rw [this]
    exact GraphBundles.minorsIdeal_mul_left_le _ _ r

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.mulVec_eq_of_frames_kim2
statement:
theorem mulVec_eq_of_frames_kim2 {L G : Y.Modules} (ιL : L ⟶ G) (T : Y.Opens) {n₀ κ : Type u}
    [Fintype n₀] [Fintype κ] (sec₀ : n₀ → Γ(L, T)) (A : κ → Γ(G, T)) (hA : IsSecFrame G T A)
    (B₀ : Matrix κ n₀ Γ(Y, T))
    (hB₀ : ∀ l, ιL.app T (sec₀ l) = Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, T) A (fun a => B₀ a l))
    (a : n₀ → Γ(Y, T)) (x : κ → Γ(Y, T))
    (hx : ιL.app T (Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, T) sec₀ a) =
      Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, T) A x) :
    B₀ *ᵥ a = x
proof:
:= by
  apply hA.bijective_self.1
  rw [← hx]
  have e1 := app_linearCombination_xiR ιL sec₀ (le_refl T) a
  have e2 := linearCombination_comb_xiR G A B₀ (le_refl T) a
  simp only [secResXiR_self] at e1 e2
  have e3 : (fun l => ιL.app T (sec₀ l)) =
      (fun l => Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, T) A (fun a => B₀ a l)) := funext hB₀
  have e4 : B₀.map (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_refl T)).op).hom = B₀ := by
    ext i l
    exact rXiR_self _ _
  rw [e1, e3]
  erw [e2]
  rw [e4]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.gamma_minors_of_chart
statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.gamma_minors_of_chart (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ C.K.len)
    (V' : M.affineOpens)
    (hV'mem : xiProj (k := k) C (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU
      (genericPoint (C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU))) ∈ V'.1)
    (cf : ℕ → ℕ) (hcf : IsSplitData C.toDetIdealComplex V' cf)
    (z : C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU)
    (c : XiChart ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).map (C.dj j)) (xiOpen C)
      (xiCoord C) (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU z))
    (hcard : Fintype.card c.n = C.rank j) (V : M.affineOpens)
    (hTV : c.T ≤ xiProj (k := k) C ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)
    (hD : ∀ r : ℕ, GraphBundles.minorsIdeal r c.D =
      ((C.toDetIdealComplex.detIdeal j r).ideal V).map ((xiProj (k := k) C).appLE V.1 c.T hTV).hom) :
    GraphBundles.minorsIdeal (C.rank j - cf j)
        (xiTop (c.B.map (stalkHomXiR (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU) c.T c.mem))) = ⊤ ∧
      GraphBundles.minorsIdeal (C.rank j - cf j + 1)
        (xiTop (c.B.map (stalkHomXiR (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU) c.T c.mem))) = ⊥ ∧
      GraphBundles.minorsIdeal (cf j)
        (xiBot (c.B.map (stalkHomXiR (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU) c.T c.mem))) = ⊤ ∧
      GraphBundles.minorsIdeal (cf j + 1)
        (xiBot (c.B.map (stalkHomXiR (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU) c.T c.mem))) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hγ : C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU (genericPoint (C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU)) =
      C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU := C.gammaTildeι_genericPoint U hC hU
  have hrk : C.toDetIdealComplex.rank j = C.rank j := rfl
  have hcfle : cf j ≤ C.rank j := hrk ▸ (hcf j hj).1
  
  have hηT : C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU (genericPoint (C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU)) ∈
      c.T := by
    have hsp := (genericPoint_specializes z).map (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU).continuous
    exact hsp.mem_open c.T.isOpen c.mem
  haveI : Nonempty (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU ⁻¹ᵁ c.T :
      (C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU).Opens) := ⟨⟨z, c.mem⟩⟩
  
  let g := ((C.graphModel (k := k)).presheaf.germ c.T _ hηT).hom
  let f := ((C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU).stalkMap
    (genericPoint (C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU))).hom
  have hf : ∀ x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((C.graphModel (k := k)).presheaf.stalk
      (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU (genericPoint (C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU)))),
      f x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    by_contra hne
    exact (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal x).mp hx (isUnit_of_map_unit f x (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hne))
  have hμ : g c.μ ≠ 0 := fun h0 =>
    c.hμ (germ_injective_of_isIntegral _ _ hηT (h0.trans (map_zero g).symm))
  have hpole : ∀ x, x * g c.μ ≠ g c.l := C.chart_pole (k := k) U hC hU j c hγ hηT
  obtain ⟨hs1, hs2⟩ := C.chart_split (k := k) j hj c hcard V hTV hD hηT V' hV'mem cf hcf
  have hac : C.rank j - cf j + cf j = Fintype.card c.n := by omega
  obtain ⟨hg1, hg2⟩ := (c.hB.map g).generic_bounds f hf hμ hpole hac hs1 hs2
  
  let φ := stalkHomXiR (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU) c.T c.mem
  let ψ := algebraMap ((C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU).presheaf.stalk z)
    (C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU).functionField
  have hψ : Function.Injective ψ := IsFractionRing.injective _ _
  have hcomp : ∀ a : Γ(C.graphModel (k := k), c.T), ψ (φ a) = f (g a) := by
    intro a
    have e1 : ψ (φ a) = (C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU).germToFunctionField
        (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU ⁻¹ᵁ c.T)
        (((C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU).app c.T).hom a) :=
      Scheme.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField
        (show z ∈ C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU ⁻¹ᵁ c.T from c.mem) _
    rw [e1]
    exact (Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply _ c.T _ hηT a).symm
  have hBmap : ∀ {p q : Type u} (P : Matrix p q Γ(C.graphModel (k := k), c.T)),
      (P.map φ).map ψ = (P.map g).map f := by
    intro p q P
    ext a b
    exact hcomp (P a b)
  have h₁ : GraphBundles.minorsIdeal (C.rank j - cf j + 1) ((xiTop (c.B.map φ)).map ψ) = ⊥ := by
    have e : (xiTop (c.B.map φ)).map ψ = (xiTop (c.B.map g)).map f := hBmap (xiTop c.B)
    rw [e]; exact hg1
  have h₂ : GraphBundles.minorsIdeal (cf j + 1) ((xiBot (c.B.map φ)).map ψ) = ⊥ := by
    have e : (xiBot (c.B.map φ)).map ψ = (xiBot (c.B.map g)).map f := hBmap (xiBot c.B)
    rw [e]; exact hg2
  obtain ⟨ht1, ht2⟩ := (c.hB.map φ).const_rank_of_generic ψ hψ hac h₁ h₂
  exact ⟨ht1, minorsIdeal_eq_bot_of_injective ψ hψ _ _ h₁, ht2,
    minorsIdeal_eq_bot_of_injective ψ hψ _ _ h₂⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.le_rank_of_minor_ne_zero
statement:
theorem le_rank_of_minor_ne_zero (M : Matrix m n F) {r : ℕ} (S : Fin r → m) (T : Fin r → n)
    (h : (M.submatrix S T).det ≠ 0) : r ≤ M.rank
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (M.submatrix S T).rank = r := by
    rw [rank_of_isUnit _ ((isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr h)),
      Fintype.card_fin]
  exact h1 ▸ rank_submatrix_le M S T

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.le_rank_of_minorsIdeal_ne_bot
statement:
theorem le_rank_of_minorsIdeal_ne_bot (M : Matrix m n F) {r : ℕ} (h : minorsIdeal r M ≠ ⊥) :
    r ≤ M.rank
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hlt
  apply h
  rw [minorsIdeal, Ideal.span_eq_bot]
  rintro _ ⟨⟨S, T⟩, rfl⟩
  by_contra hne
  exact hlt (le_rank_of_minor_ne_zero M S T hne)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.exists_rows_linearIndependent
statement:
theorem exists_rows_linearIndependent [Finite m] (M : Matrix m n F) :
    ∃ S : Fin M.rank → m, LinearIndependent F (M.submatrix S id).row
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨κ, a, ha, hsp, hli⟩ := exists_linearIndependent' F M.row
  haveI : Finite κ := Finite.of_injective a ha
  haveI : Fintype κ := Fintype.ofFinite κ
  have hcard : Fintype.card κ = M.rank := by
    rw [rank_eq_finrank_span_row, ← hsp]
    exact (linearIndependent_iff_card_eq_finrank_span.mp hli)
  let e : Fin M.rank ≃ κ := (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq hcard).symm
  refine ⟨a ∘ e, ?_⟩
  have : (M.submatrix (a ∘ e) id).row = (M.row ∘ a) ∘ e := by
    funext i j; rfl
  rw [this]
  exact hli.comp e e.injective

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.exists_minor_ne_zero_rank
statement:
theorem exists_minor_ne_zero_rank (M : Matrix m n F) :
    ∃ (S : Fin M.rank → m) (T : Fin M.rank → n), (M.submatrix S T).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := exists_rows_linearIndependent M
  set N : Matrix (Fin M.rank) n F := M.submatrix S id with hN
  have hNr : N.rank = M.rank := by
    rw [hS.rank_matrix, Fintype.card_fin]
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := exists_rows_linearIndependent Nᵀ
  have hNt : Nᵀ.rank = M.rank := by rw [rank_transpose, hNr]
  let e : Fin Nᵀ.rank ≃ Fin M.rank := finCongr hNt
  have hT' : LinearIndependent F (Nᵀ.submatrix (T ∘ e.symm) id).row := by
    have : (Nᵀ.submatrix (T ∘ e.symm) id).row = (Nᵀ.submatrix T id).row ∘ e.symm := by
      funext i j; rfl
    rw [this]
    exact hT.comp e.symm e.symm.injective
  have hunit : IsUnit (Nᵀ.submatrix (T ∘ e.symm) id) :=
    linearIndependent_rows_iff_isUnit.mp hT'
  refine ⟨S, T ∘ e.symm, ?_⟩
  have h1 : (M.submatrix S (T ∘ e.symm)) = (Nᵀ.submatrix (T ∘ e.symm) id)ᵀ := by
    ext i j; rfl
  rw [h1, det_transpose]
  exact ((isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hunit).ne_zero

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.minorsIdeal_ne_bot_of_le_rank
statement:
theorem minorsIdeal_ne_bot_of_le_rank (M : Matrix m n F) {r : ℕ} (h : r ≤ M.rank) :
    minorsIdeal r M ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, T, hST⟩ := exists_minor_ne_zero_rank M
  intro hbot
  have hle : minorsIdeal M.rank M ≤ minorsIdeal r M := minorsIdeal_antitone M h
  rw [hbot, le_bot_iff] at hle
  apply hST
  have hmem := minor_mem_minorsIdeal M S T
  rw [hle] at hmem
  exact (Submodule.mem_bot F).mp hmem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.minorsIdeal_eq_bot_iff_rank_lt
statement:
theorem minorsIdeal_eq_bot_iff_rank_lt (M : Matrix m n F) (r : ℕ) :
    minorsIdeal r M = ⊥ ↔ M.rank < r
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hle
    exact minorsIdeal_ne_bot_of_le_rank M (not_lt.mp hle) h
  · intro h
    by_contra hne
    exact absurd (le_rank_of_minorsIdeal_ne_bot M hne) (not_le.mpr h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.minorsIdeal_ne_bot_iff_le_rank
statement:
theorem minorsIdeal_ne_bot_iff_le_rank (M : Matrix m n F) (r : ℕ) :
    minorsIdeal r M ≠ ⊥ ↔ r ≤ M.rank
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ne, minorsIdeal_eq_bot_iff_rank_lt, not_lt]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.card_le_rank_add_rank_of_injective
statement:
theorem card_le_rank_add_rank_of_injective {m₁ m₂ : Type*} [Fintype m₁] [Fintype m₂]
    (B : Matrix (m₁ ⊕ m₂) n F) (hB : Function.Injective B.mulVec) :
    Fintype.card n ≤ (B.submatrix Sum.inl id).rank + (B.submatrix Sum.inr id).rank
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set B₁ := B.submatrix Sum.inl id
  set B₂ := B.submatrix Sum.inr id
  have hk : LinearMap.ker B₁.mulVecLin ⊓ LinearMap.ker B₂.mulVecLin = ⊥ := by
    rw [eq_bot_iff]
    intro v hv
    rw [Submodule.mem_inf, LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.mem_ker] at hv
    rw [Submodule.mem_bot]
    apply hB
    rw [mulVec_zero]
    funext i
    rcases i with i | i
    · exact congrFun hv.1 i
    · exact congrFun hv.2 i
  have h1 := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker B₁.mulVecLin
  have h2 := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker B₂.mulVecLin
  have h3 := Submodule.finrank_sup_add_finrank_inf_eq (LinearMap.ker B₁.mulVecLin)
    (LinearMap.ker B₂.mulVecLin)
  rw [hk, finrank_bot] at h3
  have h4 := Submodule.finrank_le (LinearMap.ker B₁.mulVecLin ⊔ LinearMap.ker B₂.mulVecLin)
  rw [Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card] at h1 h2 h4
  change B₁.rank + _ = _ at h1
  change B₂.rank + _ = _ at h2
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.minorsIdeal_eq_top_of_residue
statement:
theorem minorsIdeal_eq_top_of_residue [IsLocalRing R] (M : Matrix m n R) (r : ℕ)
    (h : minorsIdeal r (M.map (IsLocalRing.residue R)) ≠ ⊥) : minorsIdeal r M = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  apply h
  rw [← minorsIdeal_map, Ideal.map_eq_bot_iff_le_ker, IsLocalRing.ker_residue]
  exact IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal hne

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.minorsIdeal_eq_bot_of_injective
statement:
theorem minorsIdeal_eq_bot_of_injective {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (M : Matrix m n R) (r : ℕ)
    (h : minorsIdeal r (M.map f) = ⊥) : minorsIdeal r M = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [← minorsIdeal_map] at h
  exact (Ideal.map_eq_bot_iff_of_injective hf).mp h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.minorsIdeal_map_eq_bot
statement:
theorem minorsIdeal_map_eq_bot {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S) (M : Matrix m n R) (r : ℕ)
    (h : minorsIdeal r M = ⊥) : minorsIdeal r (M.map f) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [← minorsIdeal_map, h, Ideal.map_bot]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.minorsIdeal_map_eq_top
statement:
theorem minorsIdeal_map_eq_top {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S) (M : Matrix m n R) (r : ℕ)
    (h : minorsIdeal r M = ⊤) : minorsIdeal r (M.map f) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [← minorsIdeal_map, h, Ideal.map_top]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.rank_residue_le_map
statement:
theorem rank_residue_le_map [IsLocalRing R] {K : Type*} [Field K] (f : R →+* K)
    (M : Matrix m n R) :
    (M.map (IsLocalRing.residue R)).rank ≤ (M.map f).rank
proof:
:= by
  set r := (M.map (IsLocalRing.residue R)).rank
  have h1 : minorsIdeal r (M.map (IsLocalRing.residue R)) ≠ ⊥ :=
    minorsIdeal_ne_bot_of_le_rank _ le_rfl
  have h2 : minorsIdeal r M = ⊤ := minorsIdeal_eq_top_of_residue M r h1
  have h3 : minorsIdeal r (M.map f) = ⊤ := minorsIdeal_map_eq_top f M r h2
  exact le_rank_of_minorsIdeal_ne_bot _ (by rw [h3]; exact top_ne_bot)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.isSplit_of_stacked
statement:
theorem isSplit_of_stacked [IsLocalRing R] {m₁ m₂ : Type*} [Fintype m₁] [Fintype m₂]
    [DecidableEq n] (B : Matrix (m₁ ⊕ m₂) n R) (L : Matrix n (m₁ ⊕ m₂) R) (hL : L * B = 1)
    {a b : ℕ} (hab : a + b = Fintype.card n)
    (h₁ : minorsIdeal (a + 1) (B.submatrix Sum.inl id) = ⊥)
    (h₂ : minorsIdeal (b + 1) (B.submatrix Sum.inr id) = ⊥) :
    minorsIdeal a (B.submatrix Sum.inl id) = ⊤ ∧ minorsIdeal b (B.submatrix Sum.inr id) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set κ := IsLocalRing.residue R
  set Bk := B.map κ
  have hLk : L.map κ * Bk = 1 := by
    rw [← Matrix.map_mul, hL, Matrix.map_one _ (map_zero κ) (map_one κ)]
  have hinj : Function.Injective Bk.mulVec := by
    intro v w hvw
    have := congrArg (L.map κ).mulVec hvw
    simpa [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hLk] using this
  have hsum := card_le_rank_add_rank_of_injective Bk hinj
  have e₁ : Bk.submatrix Sum.inl id = (B.submatrix Sum.inl id).map κ := rfl
  have e₂ : Bk.submatrix Sum.inr id = (B.submatrix Sum.inr id).map κ := rfl
  have r₁ : (Bk.submatrix Sum.inl id).rank < a + 1 := by
    rw [← minorsIdeal_eq_bot_iff_rank_lt, e₁]
    exact minorsIdeal_map_eq_bot κ _ _ h₁
  have r₂ : (Bk.submatrix Sum.inr id).rank < b + 1 := by
    rw [← minorsIdeal_eq_bot_iff_rank_lt, e₂]
    exact minorsIdeal_map_eq_bot κ _ _ h₂
  refine ⟨minorsIdeal_eq_top_of_residue _ _ ?_, minorsIdeal_eq_top_of_residue _ _ ?_⟩
  · rw [← e₁, minorsIdeal_ne_bot_iff_le_rank]; omega
  · rw [← e₂, minorsIdeal_ne_bot_iff_le_rank]; omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ProjectionCovariance.capPull_add
statement:
theorem capPull_add (a c : ℤ) :
    capPull (k := k) D g (a + c) = capPull (k := k) D g a + capPull (k := k) D g c
proof:
:= by
  have hA := hasConstantRank_pullback W g _ 1 (D.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf a)
  have hC := hasConstantRank_pullback W g _ 1 (D.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf c)
  have hT : HasConstantRank W (tensorSheaf W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj
      (D.canonicalTwistingSheaf a)) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj
        (D.canonicalTwistingSheaf c))) 1 := by
    have h := hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hA hC
    rwa [Nat.one_mul] at h
  haveI : (D.canonicalTwistingSheaf c).IsFinitePresentation :=
    (D.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf c).isFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation
  haveI := G0PP.pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_left g (D.canonicalTwistingSheaf a)
    (D.canonicalTwistingSheaf c) (D.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf a).isFiniteLocallyFree
  let e : (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj (D.canonicalTwistingSheaf (a + c)) ≅
      tensorSheaf W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj (D.canonicalTwistingSheaf a))
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj (D.canonicalTwistingSheaf c)) :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).mapIso
        (AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.twistingTensorIso D hpos a c).symm ≪≫
      asIso (pullbackTensorSheafHom g _ _)
  unfold capPull
  rw [cap_isoOn (opsK k) _ hT ⟨e⟩]
  exact totalCapOn_tensor (ops := opsK k) _ _ hA hC hT

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ProjectionCovariance.int_linear_g2tpcov
statement:
theorem int_linear_g2tpcov {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] [Module ℚ A] (f : ℤ → A)
    (hf : ∀ a c, f (a + c) = f a + f c) (d : ℤ) : f d = (d : ℚ) • f 1
proof:
:= by
  let F : ℤ →+ A := AddMonoidHom.mk' f hf
  have h : F (d • 1) = d • F 1 := map_zsmul F d 1
  rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at h
  rw [Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ProjectionCovariance.capPull_int
statement:
theorem capPull_int (d : ℤ) :
    capPull (k := k) D g d = (d : ℚ) • capPull (k := k) D g 1
proof:
:=
  int_linear_g2tpcov (fun e => capPull (k := k) D g e) (capPull_add (k := k) D hpos g) d

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ProjectionCovariance.q0_twist_one_iso
statement:
theorem q0_twist_one_iso :
    Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (q0 g n)).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n 1) ≅
      (cover g n).canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e1⟩ := AffineFrameCover.transportTwistGlobalCompat (freeEq g n) (Dc g n)
  refine ⟨((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (i1 g n).hom
      (ppm g n ≫ D35.rho0 (k := k) (J := J.{u} n) Equiv.ulift)).app _).symm ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (i1 g n).hom).mapIso
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (ppm g n)
        (D35.rho0 (k := k) (J := J.{u} n) Equiv.ulift)).app _).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (ppm g n)).mapIso (rho0TwistIso k n 1) ≪≫
      ((Cs (k := k) n).pullbackCanonicalTwistingSheafOneIso g).symm) ≪≫ e1⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ProjectionCovariance.hasConstantRank_pullTwist
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_pullTwist (d : ℤ) :
    HasConstantRank (cover (X ↘ Spk k) n).scheme
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ιC).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).obj
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d))) 1
proof:
:=
  hasConstantRank_pullback _ ιC _ 1 (hasConstantRank_pullback T π _ 1 (hcr k n d))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ProjectionCovariance.cap_pullTwist
statement:
theorem cap_pullTwist (d : ℤ) :
    totalCapOn (opsK k) _ (hasConstantRank_pullTwist n ιC π d) =
      (d : ℚ) • xiCapOn (opsK k) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) n)
proof:
:= by
  let G := q0 (X ↘ Spk k) n ≫ (CASE1.caseISpaceIso k n).hom
  have hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty ((CASE1.caseICover k n).basisIndex i) := fun _ => ⟨ULift.up 0⟩
  have hG : ∀ e : ℤ, totalCapOn (opsK k) _ (hasConstantRank_pullTwist n ιC π e) =
      capPull (k := k) (CASE1.caseICover k n) G e := by
    intro e
    unfold capPull
    refine cap_isoOn (opsK k) _ _ ⟨pullTwistIso n ιC π hπ e ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (q0 (X ↘ Spk k) n)).mapIso (CASE1B.caseITwistIso k n e).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp _ _).app _⟩
  obtain ⟨e1⟩ := q0_twist_one_iso k (X ↘ Spk k) n
  have h1 : totalCapOn (opsK k) _ (hasConstantRank_pullTwist n ιC π 1) =
      xiCapOn (opsK k) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) n) :=
    cap_isoOn (opsK k) _ _ ⟨pullTwistIso n ιC π hπ 1 ≪≫ e1⟩
  rw [hG, capPull_int (CASE1.caseICover k n) hpos G d, ← hG, h1]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ProjectionCovariance.tdLineK_pullTwist_one
statement:
theorem tdLineK_pullTwist_one :
    tdLineK k _ (hasConstantRank_pullTwist n ιC π 1) =
      tdLineK k ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) n).canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
        ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) n).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e1⟩ := q0_twist_one_iso k (X ↘ Spk k) n
  exact AmbientIndependence.tdLineK_iso_g2tproj _ _ (pullTwistIso n ιC π hπ 1 ≪≫ e1)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ProjectionCovariance.projectiveTwistingK0Class_neg_pow
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingK0Class_neg_pow (j : ℕ) :
    projectiveTwistingK0Class k n (-1) ^ j = projectiveTwistingK0Class k n (-(j : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    rw [pow_zero, Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero, projectiveTwistingK0Class_zero]
  | succ j ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, ih, projectiveTwistingK0Class_mul]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ProjectionCovariance.k0_pullTwist_neg
statement:
theorem k0_pullTwist_neg (j : ℕ) :
    k0ClassOf _ _ (hasConstantRank_pullTwist n ιC π (-(j : ℤ))).isFiniteLocallyFree =
      (cover (X ↘ Spk k) n).canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-(j : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) n).basisIndex i) := fun _ => ⟨ULift.up 0⟩
  rw [← pullbackK0RingHom_classOf ιC _
      (hasConstantRank_pullback T π _ 1 (hcr k n (-(j : ℤ)))).isFiniteLocallyFree,
    ← pullbackK0RingHom_classOf π _ (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree k n _),
    ← RingHom.comp_apply,
    pullbackK0RingHom_comp, hπ]
  change pullbackK0RingHom (q0 (X ↘ Spk k) n) (projectiveTwistingK0Class k n (-(j : ℤ))) = _
  rw [← projectiveTwistingK0Class_neg_pow, map_pow, twist_comparison]
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    rw [pow_zero]
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero]
    exact (AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_zero _).symm
  | succ j ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, ih, AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_mul _ hpos]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ProjectionCovariance.tdLineK_commute
statement:
theorem tdLineK_commute (L L' : W.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank W L 1)
    (hL' : HasConstantRank W L' 1) : Commute (tdLineK k L hL) (tdLineK k L' hL')
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Commute (totalCapOn (opsK k) L hL) (totalCapOn (opsK k) L' hL') :=
    (cpK k).cap_comm L L' hL hL'
  refine LinearMap.ext fun w => ?_
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4.exists_mem_S w
  have h1 : tdLineK k L' hL' w ∈ GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.S (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow W m) n := by
    rw [tdLineK_apply k L' hL' hn]
    exact (lowersDeg_totalCapOnK k L' hL').evTrunc_mem_S hn _
  have h2 : tdLineK k L hL w ∈ GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.S (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow W m) n := by
    rw [tdLineK_apply k L hL hn]
    exact (lowersDeg_totalCapOnK k L hL).evTrunc_mem_S hn _
  rw [Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, tdLineK_apply k L hL h1, tdLineK_apply k L' hL' hn,
    tdLineK_apply k L' hL' h2, tdLineK_apply k L hL hn, ← Module.End.mul_apply,
    ← Module.End.mul_apply]
  unfold evTrunc
  exact congrFun (congrArg DFunLike.coe (commute_aeval_g2tpcov hc _ _).eq) w

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.linMinorsIdeal_sectionMap_eq_of_overIso
statement:
theorem linMinorsIdeal_sectionMap_eq_of_overIso {E F E' F' : X.Modules} (d : E ⟶ F)
    (d' : E' ⟶ F') (U : X.Opens)
    (eE : (overRestrictionFunctor X U).obj E' ≅ (overRestrictionFunctor X U).obj E)
    (eF : (overRestrictionFunctor X U).obj F' ≅ (overRestrictionFunctor X U).obj F)
    (h : (overRestrictionFunctor X U).map d' ≫ eF.hom = eE.hom ≫ (overRestrictionFunctor X U).map d)
    (r : ℕ) : linMinorsIdeal (sectionMap d' U) r = linMinorsIdeal (sectionMap d U) r
proof:
:= by
  let W₀ : (Over U)ᵒᵖ := op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))
  let lE : E'.val.obj (op U) ≃ₗ[Γ(X, U)] E.val.obj (op U) :=
    ((SheafOfModules.forget _ ⋙ PresheafOfModules.evaluation _ W₀).mapIso eE).toLinearEquiv
  let lF : F'.val.obj (op U) ≃ₗ[Γ(X, U)] F.val.obj (op U) :=
    ((SheafOfModules.forget _ ⋙ PresheafOfModules.evaluation _ W₀).mapIso eF).toLinearEquiv
  have hd : sectionMap d' U = lF.symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ sectionMap d U ∘ₗ lE.toLinearMap := by
    ext x
    have hx := congrArg (fun φ ↦ (φ.val.app W₀).hom x) h
    apply lF.injective
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact hx
  rw [hd, linMinorsIdeal_equiv]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.minorsTwistInvariant_of_line
statement:
theorem minorsTwistInvariant_of_line {A : M.Modules} (hA : HasConstantRank M A 1) :
    MinorsTwistInvariant M A
proof:
:= by
  intro E F hE hF d r
  haveI := hE.isFinitePresentation
  haveI := hF.isFinitePresentation
  haveI := (tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree M E A hE hA.isFiniteLocallyFree).isFinitePresentation
  haveI := (tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree M F A hF hA.isFiniteLocallyFree).isFinitePresentation
  have key : ∀ x : M, ∃ V : M.affineOpens, x ∈ V.1 ∧
      (sheafMinorsIdeal (tensorSheafMap M d (𝟙 A)) r).ideal V = (sheafMinorsIdeal d r).ideal V := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨V, hxV, -, ι, _, s, hcard, hs⟩ :=
      exists_isSecFrame hA (O := ⊤) (x := x) (Set.mem_univ x)
    haveI : Unique ι := (Fintype.card_eq_one_iff_nonempty_unique.1 hcard).some
    refine ⟨V, hxV, ?_⟩
    rw [minorsCompatible_of_isFinitePresentation (tensorSheafMap M d (𝟙 A)) r V,
      minorsCompatible_of_isFinitePresentation d r V]
    let Φ := twistOverNatIsoTtw2 A hs
    exact linMinorsIdeal_sectionMap_eq_of_overIso d (tensorSheafMap M d (𝟙 A)) V.1 (Φ.app E)
      (Φ.app F) (Φ.hom.naturality d) r
  choose V hxV hV using key
  exact Scheme.IdealSheafData.ext_of_iSup_eq_top V
    (eq_top_iff.2 fun x _ ↦ TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨x, hxV x⟩) hV

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.WDiv.length_self_eq_length_quot_span
statement:
theorem length_self_eq_length_quot_span (ψ : A →+* C) (hψ : Function.Surjective ψ) (g : A)
    (hker : RingHom.ker ψ = Ideal.span {g}) :
    Module.length C C = Module.length A (A ⧸ Ideal.span {g})
proof:

  rw [← Module.length_eq_of_surjective (S := A) (R := C) (M := C) hψ, ← hker]
  exact ((Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective (f := Algebra.ofId A C)
    hψ).toLinearEquiv.length_eq).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.WDiv.mem_genericPoints_of_ker_span
statement:
theorem mem_genericPoints_of_ker_span (z : Z) (hz : coheight (ι z) = 1)
    (a : X.presheaf.stalk (ι z)) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hker : RingHom.ker (ι.stalkMap z).hom = Ideal.span {a}) : z ∈ genericPoints Z
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_genericPoints_iff_coheight_eq_zero]
  have h1 : ringKrullDim (Z.presheaf.stalk z) + 1 ≤ ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk (ι z)) := by
    rw [← ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv
      (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective (ι.stalkMap_surjective z)), hker]
    exact ringKrullDim_quotient_succ_le_of_nonZeroDivisor (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero ha)
  rw [ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight, ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight, hz] at h1
  have h2 : coheight z + 1 ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast h1
  by_contra hne
  have h3 : (1 : ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ 1 := le_trans (by gcongr; exact Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hne) h2
  exact absurd h3 (by decide)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.WDiv.pushFund_apply_eq_div

theorem pushFund_apply_eq_div (z : Z) (hz : coheight (ι z) = 1)

    (hker : RingHom.ker (ι.stalkMap z).hom = Ideal.span {a}) :
    properPushforward ι (fundamentalCycle Z) (ι z) =
      div (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (ι z)) X.functionField a) (ι z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pushFund_apply_image, fundamentalCycle_apply_of_mem_genericPoints
    (mem_genericPoints_of_ker_span ι z hz a ha hker), div_eq_ord,
    Scheme.ord_algebraMap_eq_length_toNat hz a ha, genericMultiplicity, selfLocalLength,
    length_self_eq_length_quot_span (ι.stalkMap z).hom (ι.stalkMap_surjective z) a hker]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.WDiv.pushFund_apply_eq_zero_of_coheight_ne
statement:
theorem pushFund_apply_eq_zero_of_coheight_ne
    (hloc : ∀ z : Z, ∃ a : X.presheaf.stalk (ι z), a ≠ 0 ∧
      RingHom.ker (ι.stalkMap z).hom = Ideal.span {a})
    (x : X) (hx : coheight x ≠ 1) : properPushforward ι (fundamentalCycle Z) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hr : x ∈ Set.range ι
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hr
    rw [pushFund_apply_image]
    apply fundamentalCycle_apply_of_not_mem_genericPoints
    intro hg
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hker⟩ := hloc z
    exact hx (coheight_eq_one_of_principal_stalk_kernel_at_generic ι z hg a ha hker)
  · exact pushFund_apply_notRange ι x hr

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.WDiv.pushFund_ker_eq
statement:
theorem pushFund_ker_eq {X Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Z] (j : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion j] (I : X.IdealSheafData) (hI : I = j.ker) :
    haveI
proof:
:= GraphModel.isNoetherian_subscheme I
    properPushforward I.subschemeι (fundamentalCycle I.subscheme) =
      properPushforward j (fundamentalCycle Z) := by
  subst hI
  haveI := GraphModel.isNoetherian_subscheme j.ker
  have hj : ∀ z : Z, j z = j.imageι (j.toImage z) := fun z => by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, j.toImage_imageι]
  ext x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.range j
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hx
    change properPushforward j.imageι (fundamentalCycle j.image) (j z) = _
    rw [pushFund_apply_image j z, hj z, pushFund_apply_image j.imageι]
    exact (fundamentalCycle_apply_iso (asIso j.toImage) z).symm
  · change properPushforward j.imageι (fundamentalCycle j.image) x = _
    rw [pushFund_apply_notRange j x hx, pushFund_apply_notRange]
    rintro ⟨w, rfl⟩
    apply hx
    refine ⟨inv j.toImage w, ?_⟩
    have e : inv j.toImage ≫ j = j.imageι := by
      rw [IsIso.inv_comp_eq]
      exact j.toImage_imageι.symm
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, e]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.WDiv.fundamentalCycle_apply_genericPoint
statement:
theorem fundamentalCycle_apply_genericPoint (Z : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral Z] [IsNoetherian Z] :
    fundamentalCycle Z (genericPoint Z) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hg : genericPoint Z ∈ genericPoints Z := by
    rw [mem_genericPoints_iff_coheight_eq_zero, Order.coheight_eq_zero]
    intro y _
    exact Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr (genericPoint_specializes y)
  rw [fundamentalCycle_apply_of_mem_genericPoints hg, genericMultiplicity, selfLocalLength]
  have : Module.length Z.functionField Z.functionField = 1 := Module.length_eq_one _ _
  change ((Module.length Z.functionField Z.functionField).toNat : ℤ) = 1
  rw [this]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.WDiv.fundamentalCycle_apply_ne_genericPoint
statement:
theorem fundamentalCycle_apply_ne_genericPoint (Z : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral Z] [IsNoetherian Z]
    (z : Z) (hz : z ≠ genericPoint Z) : fundamentalCycle Z z = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply fundamentalCycle_apply_of_not_mem_genericPoints
  intro h
  have hmax : IsMax z := isMax_of_mem_genericPoints h
  have h1 : z ≤ genericPoint Z := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr (genericPoint_specializes z)
  exact hz ((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp (hmax h1)).antisymm
    (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp h1)).eq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.exists_mem_overlap
statement:
theorem exists_mem_overlap [Nonempty M] :
    ∃ w : graphModel (k := k) C, w ∈ graphToP1 (k := k) C ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 0).1 ∧
      w ∈ graphToP1 (k := k) C ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 1).1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a⟩ : Nonempty M := inferInstance
  let y : Spec (CommRingCat.of (Polynomial k)) :=
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (1 : k))) (default : Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
  obtain ⟨b, -, hb⟩ := Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback (f := M ↘ Spk k)
    (g := SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k 1) a (chart k 1 y) (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  have hbr : b ∈ (jChart (k := k) (A := M) 1).opensRange := by
    rw [opensRange_jChart]
    exact ⟨y, hb.symm⟩
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hbr
  have e : graphToP1 (k := k) C (graphChart (k := k) C l) = chart k 1 y := by
    rw [graphToP1, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, graphChart_toBase_assoc, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hl, hb]
  refine ⟨graphChart (k := k) C l, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show graphToP1 (k := k) C (graphChart (k := k) C l) ∈ (chartOpen k 0).1
    rw [e, mem_chartOpen_iff]
    have hy : y ∈ chart k 1 ⁻¹ᵁ (chart k 0).opensRange := by
      rw [chart_one_preimage]
      change (Polynomial.X : Polynomial k) ∉ Ideal.comap _ _
      simp
    exact hy
  · show graphToP1 (k := k) C (graphChart (k := k) C l) ∈ (chartOpen k 1).1
    rw [e, mem_chartOpen_iff]
    exact ⟨y, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.nonempty_chartOne
statement:
theorem nonempty_chartOne [Nonempty M] :
    Nonempty (graphToP1 (k := k) C ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 1).1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, -, hw⟩ := exists_mem_overlap (k := k) C
  exact ⟨⟨w, hw⟩⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.nonempty_chartZero
statement:
theorem nonempty_chartZero [Nonempty M] :
    Nonempty (graphToP1 (k := k) C ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 0).1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw, -⟩ := exists_mem_overlap (k := k) C
  exact ⟨⟨w, hw⟩⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.algebraMap_tStalk
statement:
theorem algebraMap_tStalk [Nonempty M] [IsIntegral (graphModel (k := k) C)]
    (w : graphModel (k := k) C) (hw : w ∈ graphToP1 (k := k) C ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 1).1) :
    algebraMap _ (graphModel (k := k) C).functionField (tStalk (k := k) C w hw) = ratFn (k := k) C
proof:
:= by
  haveI := nonempty_chartOne (k := k) C
  exact Scheme.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField hw (tW (k := k) C)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.sStalk_mul_tStalk
statement:
theorem sStalk_mul_tStalk (w : graphModel (k := k) C)
    (h0 : w ∈ graphToP1 (k := k) C ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 0).1)
    (h1 : w ∈ graphToP1 (k := k) C ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 1).1) :
    sStalk (k := k) C w h0 * tStalk (k := k) C w h1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hO : w ∈ graphToP1 (k := k) C ⁻¹ᵁ overlapOpen k := ⟨h0, h1⟩
  have key : ∀ (j : Fin 2) (c : Γ(P1 k, (chartOpen k j).1))
      (hle : overlapOpen k ≤ (chartOpen k j).1)
      (hj : w ∈ graphToP1 (k := k) C ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k j).1),
      (graphModel (k := k) C).presheaf.germ _ w hj ((graphToP1 (k := k) C).app _ c) =
        (graphModel (k := k) C).presheaf.germ _ w hO ((graphToP1 (k := k) C).app _
          ((P1 k).presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op c)) := by
    intro j c hle hj
    have h := congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom c) ((graphToP1 (k := k) C).naturality (homOfLE hle).op)
    simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply] at h
    rw [h, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply']
  rw [sStalk, tStalk, sW, tW, key 0 _ inf_le_left h0, key 1 _ inf_le_right h1, ← map_mul,
    ← map_mul, sP1_mul_tP1, map_one, map_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.algebraMap_sStalk_mul_ratFn
statement:
theorem algebraMap_sStalk_mul_ratFn [Nonempty M] [IsIntegral (graphModel (k := k) C)]
    (w : graphModel (k := k) C) (hw : w ∈ graphToP1 (k := k) C ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 0).1) :
    algebraMap _ (graphModel (k := k) C).functionField (sStalk (k := k) C w hw) * ratFn (k := k) C = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w', h0, h1⟩ := exists_mem_overlap (k := k) C
  haveI := nonempty_chartZero (k := k) C
  have e0 : algebraMap _ (graphModel (k := k) C).functionField (sStalk (k := k) C w hw) =
      algebraMap _ (graphModel (k := k) C).functionField (sStalk (k := k) C w' h0) := by
    rw [Scheme.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField, Scheme.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField]
  rw [e0, ← algebraMap_tStalk (k := k) C w' h1, ← map_mul, sStalk_mul_tStalk, map_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.ratFn_ne_zero
statement: theorem ratFn_ne_zero [Nonempty M] [IsIntegral (graphModel (k := k) C)] : ratFn (k := k) C ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, h0, -⟩ := exists_mem_overlap (k := k) C
  exact right_ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one (algebraMap_sStalk_mul_ratFn (k := k) C w h0)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.ratFn_eq_inv
statement:
theorem ratFn_eq_inv [Nonempty M] [IsIntegral (graphModel (k := k) C)]
    (w : graphModel (k := k) C) (hw : w ∈ graphToP1 (k := k) C ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 0).1) :
    ratFn (k := k) C = (algebraMap _ (graphModel (k := k) C).functionField (sStalk (k := k) C w hw))⁻¹
proof:
:=
  eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right (algebraMap_sStalk_mul_ratFn (k := k) C w hw)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.tStalk_ne_zero
statement:
theorem tStalk_ne_zero [Nonempty M] [IsIntegral (graphModel (k := k) C)]
    (w : graphModel (k := k) C) (hw : w ∈ graphToP1 (k := k) C ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 1).1) :
    tStalk (k := k) C w hw ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply ratFn_ne_zero (k := k) C
  rw [← algebraMap_tStalk (k := k) C w hw, h, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.sStalk_ne_zero
statement:
theorem sStalk_ne_zero [Nonempty M] [IsIntegral (graphModel (k := k) C)]
    (w : graphModel (k := k) C) (hw : w ∈ graphToP1 (k := k) C ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 0).1) :
    sStalk (k := k) C w hw ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := algebraMap_sStalk_mul_ratFn (k := k) C w hw
  rw [h, map_zero, zero_mul] at this
  exact zero_ne_one this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.zeroCycle_eq
statement:
theorem zeroCycle_eq [IsNoetherian (graphModel (k := k) C)] :
    haveI
proof:
:= isNoetherian_subscheme (zeroDivisor (k := k) C)
    zeroCycle (k := k) C = properPushforward (zeroDivisor (k := k) C).subschemeι
      (fundamentalCycle (zeroDivisor (k := k) C).subscheme) := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.infCycle_eq
statement:
theorem infCycle_eq [IsNoetherian (graphModel (k := k) C)] :
    haveI
proof:
:= isNoetherian_subscheme (infDivisor (k := k) C)
    infCycle (k := k) C = properPushforward (infDivisor (k := k) C).subschemeι
      (fundamentalCycle (infDivisor (k := k) C).subscheme) := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.zeroCycle_apply_of_coheight_ne
statement:
theorem zeroCycle_apply_of_coheight_ne [Nonempty M] [IsIntegral (graphModel (k := k) C)]
    [IsNoetherian (graphModel (k := k) C)] (x : graphModel (k := k) C) (hx : coheight x ≠ 1) :
    zeroCycle (k := k) C x = 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isNoetherian_subscheme (zeroDivisor (k := k) C)
  rw [zeroCycle_eq]
  refine WDiv.pushFund_apply_eq_zero_of_coheight_ne _ (fun z => ?_) x hx
  exact ⟨_, tStalk_ne_zero (k := k) C _ (mem_chartOne_of_mem_zeroDivisor C z),
    ker_zeroDivisor_stalkMap C z (mem_chartOne_of_mem_zeroDivisor C z)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.infCycle_apply_of_coheight_ne
statement:
theorem infCycle_apply_of_coheight_ne [Nonempty M] [IsIntegral (graphModel (k := k) C)]
    [IsNoetherian (graphModel (k := k) C)] (x : graphModel (k := k) C) (hx : coheight x ≠ 1) :
    infCycle (k := k) C x = 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isNoetherian_subscheme (infDivisor (k := k) C)
  rw [infCycle_eq]
  refine WDiv.pushFund_apply_eq_zero_of_coheight_ne _ (fun z => ?_) x hx
  exact ⟨_, sStalk_ne_zero (k := k) C _ (mem_chartZero_of_mem_infDivisor C z),
    ker_infDivisor_stalkMap C z (mem_chartZero_of_mem_infDivisor C z)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.zeroCycle_apply_of_not_mem_graphAway
statement:
theorem zeroCycle_apply_of_not_mem_graphAway [IsNoetherian (graphModel (k := k) C)]
    (x : graphModel (k := k) C) (hx : x ∉ graphAway (k := k) C) : zeroCycle (k := k) C x = 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isNoetherian_subscheme (zeroDivisor (k := k) C)
  rw [zeroCycle_eq]
  refine WDiv.pushFund_apply_notRange _ x ?_
  rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
  apply hx
  rw [mem_graphAway_iff, ← mem_chartOpen_iff]
  exact mem_chartOne_of_mem_zeroDivisor C z

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.div_ratFn
statement:
theorem div_ratFn [Nonempty M] [IsIntegral (graphModel (k := k) C)]
    [IsNoetherian (graphModel (k := k) C)] :
    div (ratFn (k := k) C) = zeroCycle (k := k) C - infCycle (k := k) C
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change div (ratFn (k := k) C) x = zeroCycle (k := k) C x - infCycle (k := k) C x
  by_cases hx : coheight x = 1
  · by_cases hxa : x ∈ graphAway (k := k) C
    · rw [infCycle_apply_of_mem_graphAway C hxa, sub_zero]
      have hw : x ∈ graphToP1 (k := k) C ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 1).1 := by
        show graphToP1 (k := k) C x ∈ (chartOpen k 1).1
        rw [mem_chartOpen_iff, ← mem_graphAway_iff]
        exact hxa
      rw [← algebraMap_tStalk (k := k) C x hw]
      haveI := isNoetherian_subscheme (zeroDivisor (k := k) C)
      by_cases h0 : x ∈ Set.range (zeroDivisor (k := k) C).subschemeι
      · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := h0
        rw [zeroCycle_eq, WDiv.pushFund_apply_eq_div _ z hx _ (tStalk_ne_zero (k := k) C _ hw)
          (ker_zeroDivisor_stalkMap C z hw)]
      · rw [zeroCycle_eq, WDiv.pushFund_apply_notRange _ x h0]
        refine WDiv.div_algebraMap_isUnit hx _ (isUnit_tStalk C hw ?_)
        intro hs
        apply h0
        rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.range_subschemeι]
        exact hs
    · rw [zeroCycle_apply_of_not_mem_graphAway C x hxa, zero_sub]
      have hsupp : x ∈ ((infDivisor (k := k) C).support : Set (graphModel (k := k) C)) :=
        (mem_infDivisor_support_iff C x).mpr hxa
      rw [← Scheme.IdealSheafData.range_subschemeι] at hsupp
      obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hsupp
      have hw := mem_chartZero_of_mem_infDivisor C z
      haveI := isNoetherian_subscheme (infDivisor (k := k) C)
      rw [ratFn_eq_inv (k := k) C _ hw, div_inv _ ((map_ne_zero_iff _
          (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective _ _)).mpr (sStalk_ne_zero (k := k) C _ hw)),
        infCycle_eq, WDiv.pushFund_apply_eq_div _ z hx _ (sStalk_ne_zero (k := k) C _ hw)
          (ker_infDivisor_stalkMap C z hw)]
      rfl
  · rw [zeroCycle_apply_of_coheight_ne C x hx, infCycle_apply_of_coheight_ne C x hx, sub_zero,
      div_eq_ord, Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hx]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.height_of_coheight_eq_one
proof:
:= by
  have h := dimensionCatenary_of_finiteType k (X := graphModel (k := k) C)
    (graphModel (k := k) C) (𝟙 _) x hx
  change height x + 1 = height (genericPoint (graphModel (k := k) C)) at h
  rw [hW] at h
  exact ENat_add_one_cancel (by simpa using h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.zeroCycle_mem_dimensionCycles
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have h1 : coheight x = 1 := by
    by_contra h
    exact hx (zeroCycle_apply_of_coheight_ne C x h)
  exact height_of_coheight_eq_one C hW x h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.infCycle_mem_dimensionCycles
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have h1 : coheight x = 1 := by
    by_contra h
    exact hx (infCycle_apply_of_coheight_ne C x h)
  exact height_of_coheight_eq_one C hW x h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.ratFnRelation_cycle
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change properPushforward (𝟙 _) (div (ratFn (k := k) C)) = zeroCycle (k := k) C - infCycle (k := k) C
  rw [properPushforward_id, div_ratFn]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.mk_zeroDimCycle_eq_mk_infDimCycle
statement:
theorem mk_zeroDimCycle_eq_mk_infDimCycle {n : ℕ}
    (hW : height (genericPoint (graphModel (k := k) C)) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)) :
    (QuotientAddGroup.mk (zeroDimCycle C hW) : DimChow (graphModel (k := k) C) n) =
      QuotientAddGroup.mk (infDimCycle C hW)
proof:
:= by
  rw [QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem, ← ratFnRelation_cycle C hW]
  exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.evalZero_comp_C
statement:
theorem evalZero_comp_C :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : k))) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.C : k →+* Polynomial k)) = 𝟙 (Spk k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  have : (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : k)).comp Polynomial.C = RingHom.id k := by
    ext a
    simp
  rw [this]
  exact Spec.map_id _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.isPullback_lineZero
statement:
theorem isPullback_lineZero :
    IsPullback (lineZero (k := k) (M := M)) (M ↘ Spk k)
      (DeformationSpace.toLineOver M ⊥ k (phiK (k := k) (A := M)))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : k))))
proof:
:= by
  have s : IsPullback (𝟙 M) (M ↘ Spk k) (M ↘ Spk k)
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : k))) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.C : k →+* Polynomial k))) := by
    rw [evalZero_comp_C]
    exact IsPullback.id_horiz _
  exact IsPullback.of_right' s (isPullback_line (k := k) (A := M))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.lineZero_toBase
statement: theorem lineZero_toBase : lineZero (k := k) (M := M) ≫ DeformationSpace.toBase M ⊥ = 𝟙 M
proof:
:=
  (isPullback_line (k := k) (A := M)).lift_fst _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.opensRange_graphChart
statement: theorem opensRange_graphChart : (graphChart (k := k) C).opensRange = graphAway (k := k) C
proof:
:= by
  ext w
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨l, rfl⟩
    have := range_graphChart_subset (k := k) C ⟨l, rfl⟩
    rwa [Scheme.Opens.range_ι] at this
  · intro hw
    refine ⟨(graphAwayIso (k := k) C).inv ⟨w, hw⟩, ?_⟩
    have e : (graphAwayIso (k := k) C).inv ≫ graphChart (k := k) C = (graphAway (k := k) C).ι := by
      rw [← graphAwayIso_hom_ι, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, e]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.isPullback_graphChart
statement:
theorem isPullback_graphChart :
    IsPullback (graphChart (k := k) C) (DeformationSpace.toLineOver M ⊥ k (phiK (k := k) (A := M)))
      (graphToP1 (k := k) C) (chart k 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine (IsOpenImmersion.isPullback _ _ _ _ ?_ ?_).flip
  · rw [graphToP1, graphChart_toBase_assoc, jChart_snd]
  · rw [opensRange_graphChart]
    ext w
    change graphToP1 (k := k) C w ∈ Set.range (chart k 1) ↔ w ∈ graphAway (k := k) C
    rw [mem_graphAway_iff]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.zeroSection_toBase_fst
statement:
theorem zeroSection_toBase_fst :
    zeroSection (k := k) C ≫ graphToBase (k := k) C ≫ pullback.fst _ _ = 𝟙 M
proof:
:= by
  rw [zeroSection, Category.assoc, graphChart_toBase_fst, lineZero_toBase (k := k)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.isPullback_zeroSection
statement:
theorem isPullback_zeroSection :
    IsPullback (zeroSection (k := k) C) (M ↘ Spk k) (graphToP1 (k := k) C)
      (DeformationSpace.pointAt k 0)
proof:
:=
  (isPullback_lineZero (k := k) (M := M)).paste_horiz (isPullback_graphChart (k := k) C)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.isClosedImmersion_zeroSection
statement: theorem isClosedImmersion_zeroSection : IsClosedImmersion (zeroSection (k := k) C)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (isPullback_zeroSection (k := k) C).isoPullback_hom_fst]
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.zeroDivisor_eq_ker
statement: theorem zeroDivisor_eq_ker : zeroDivisor (k := k) C = (zeroSection (k := k) C).ker
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (isPullback_zeroSection (k := k) C).isoPullback_hom_fst, Scheme.Hom.ker_comp_of_isIso,
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_fst_of_isClosedImmersion]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.zeroCycle_eq_pushforward
statement:
theorem zeroCycle_eq_pushforward [IsNoetherian M] [IsNoetherian (graphModel (k := k) C)] :
    haveI
proof:
:= isClosedImmersion_zeroSection (k := k) C
    zeroCycle (k := k) C = properPushforward (zeroSection (k := k) C) (fundamentalCycle M) := by
  haveI := isClosedImmersion_zeroSection (k := k) C
  rw [zeroCycle_eq]
  exact WDiv.pushFund_ker_eq _ _ (zeroDivisor_eq_ker (k := k) C)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.zeroCycle_apply_zeroSection_generic
statement:
theorem zeroCycle_apply_zeroSection_generic [IsIntegral M] [IsNoetherian M]
    [IsNoetherian (graphModel (k := k) C)] :
    zeroCycle (k := k) C (zeroSection (k := k) C (genericPoint M)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isClosedImmersion_zeroSection (k := k) C
  rw [zeroCycle_eq_pushforward, WDiv.pushFund_apply_image,
    WDiv.fundamentalCycle_apply_genericPoint]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.zeroCycle_apply_eq_zero
statement:
theorem zeroCycle_apply_eq_zero [IsIntegral M] [IsNoetherian M]
    [IsNoetherian (graphModel (k := k) C)] (x : graphModel (k := k) C)
    (hx : x ≠ zeroSection (k := k) C (genericPoint M)) : zeroCycle (k := k) C x = 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isClosedImmersion_zeroSection (k := k) C
  rw [zeroCycle_eq_pushforward]
  by_cases hr : x ∈ Set.range (zeroSection (k := k) C)
  · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hr
    rw [WDiv.pushFund_apply_image]
    exact WDiv.fundamentalCycle_apply_ne_genericPoint M m (fun h => hx (by rw [h]))
  · exact WDiv.pushFund_apply_notRange _ x hr

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.pushforward_zeroCycle
statement:
theorem pushforward_zeroCycle [IsNoetherian M] [IsNoetherian (graphModel (k := k) C)]
    [QuasiCompact (graphToBase (k := k) C ≫ pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k 1))] :
    properPushforward (graphToBase (k := k) C ≫ pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k)
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k 1)) (zeroCycle (k := k) C) = fundamentalCycle M
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isClosedImmersion_zeroSection (k := k) C
  have key : ∀ (f : M ⟶ M) [QuasiCompact f], f = 𝟙 M →
      properPushforward f (fundamentalCycle M) = fundamentalCycle M := by
    intro f _ hf
    subst hf
    exact properPushforward_id _
  rw [zeroCycle_eq_pushforward, ← properPushforward_comp]
  exact key _ (zeroSection_toBase_fst (k := k) C)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.height_genericPoint_graphModel
statement:
theorem height_genericPoint_graphModel {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    height (genericPoint (graphModel (k := k) C)) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isClosedImmersion_zeroSection (k := k) C
  have hc : coheight (zeroSection (k := k) C (genericPoint M)) = 1 := by
    by_contra h
    have h0 := zeroCycle_apply_of_coheight_ne C _ h
    rw [zeroCycle_apply_zeroSection_generic] at h0
    exact one_ne_zero h0
  have h := dimensionCatenary_of_finiteType k (X := graphModel (k := k) C)
    (graphModel (k := k) C) (𝟙 _) _ hc
  change height (zeroSection (k := k) C (genericPoint M)) + 1 =
    height (genericPoint (graphModel (k := k) C)) at h
  rw [← h, height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion, hM]
  push_cast
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.mk_zeroDimCycle_eq_mk_infDimCycle_of_height
statement:
theorem mk_zeroDimCycle_eq_mk_infDimCycle_of_height {n : ℕ}
    (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    (QuotientAddGroup.mk (zeroDimCycle C (height_genericPoint_graphModel C hM)) :
        DimChow (graphModel (k := k) C) n) =
      QuotientAddGroup.mk (infDimCycle C (height_genericPoint_graphModel C hM))
proof:
:=
  mk_zeroDimCycle_eq_mk_infDimCycle C _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegularComparison.Generic.mono_of_ses
statement:
theorem mono_of_ses [T.PreservesZeroMorphisms] (S : ShortComplex C) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    [Epi (T.map S.g)]
    (a₁ : T.obj S.X₁ ⟶ S.X₁) (a₂ : T.obj S.X₂ ⟶ S.X₂) (a₃ : T.obj S.X₃ ⟶ S.X₃)
    (h₁ : T.map S.f ≫ a₂ = a₁ ≫ S.f) (h₂ : T.map S.g ≫ a₃ = a₂ ≫ S.g) [Mono a₂]
    (hφ : Mono (cokernel.map a₁ a₂ (T.map S.f) S.f h₁.symm)) : Mono a₃
proof:
:= by
  rw [Preadditive.mono_iff_cancel_zero]
  intro A x hx
  obtain ⟨A₁, π₁, hπ₁, y, hy⟩ := surjective_up_to_refinements_of_epi (T.map S.g) x
  have hy0 : (y ≫ a₂) ≫ S.g = 0 := by
    rw [Category.assoc, ← h₂, ← Category.assoc, ← hy, Category.assoc, hx, comp_zero]
  obtain ⟨A₂, π₂, hπ₂, z, hz⟩ := hS.exact.exact_up_to_refinements _ hy0
  have hz0 : z ≫ cokernel.π a₁ = 0 := by
    rw [← cancel_mono (cokernel.map a₁ a₂ (T.map S.f) S.f h₁.symm), Category.assoc,
      cokernel.π_desc, zero_comp, ← Category.assoc, ← hz, Category.assoc, Category.assoc,
      cokernel.condition, comp_zero, comp_zero]
  obtain ⟨A₃, π₃, hπ₃, w, hw⟩ :=
    (ShortComplex.exact_cokernel a₁).exact_up_to_refinements z hz0
  have hw' : w ≫ T.map S.f = π₃ ≫ π₂ ≫ y := by
    rw [← cancel_mono a₂, Category.assoc, h₁, ← Category.assoc]
    rw [← hw, Category.assoc, ← hz, Category.assoc, Category.assoc]
  have hfin : π₃ ≫ π₂ ≫ π₁ ≫ x = 0 := by
    calc π₃ ≫ π₂ ≫ π₁ ≫ x = (π₃ ≫ π₂ ≫ y) ≫ T.map S.g := by
          rw [hy]; simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = 0 := by rw [← hw', Category.assoc, ← T.map_comp, S.zero, T.map_zero, comp_zero]
  rw [← cancel_epi π₁, ← cancel_epi π₂, ← cancel_epi π₃, hfin, comp_zero, comp_zero, comp_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegularComparison.Generic.mono_pullback_eta_pr
statement:
theorem mono_pullback_eta_pr [IsIso (ηΣ ≫ pr)] {K E : Z.Modules} (k : K ⟶ E) [Mono k] :
    Mono ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ηΣ).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).map k))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (inv (ηΣ ≫ pr))).IsRightAdjoint :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (inv (ηΣ ≫ pr))).isRightAdjoint
  haveI h1 : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (ηΣ ≫ pr)).PreservesMonomorphisms :=
    Functor.preservesMonomorphisms.of_iso
      (ARRG45C.pullbackHomIsoPushforwardInv (asIso (ηΣ ≫ pr))).symm
  haveI : (Scheme.Modules.pullback pr ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback ηΣ).PreservesMonomorphisms :=
    Functor.preservesMonomorphisms.of_iso (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp ηΣ pr).symm
  exact (Scheme.Modules.pullback pr ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback ηΣ).map_mono k

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegularComparison.Generic.mono_cokernel_map_pr
statement:
theorem mono_cokernel_map_pr (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1) [IsIso (ηΣ ≫ pr)]
    {K E : Z.Modules} (k : K ⟶ E) [Mono k] (hK : IsCoherentLike Z K) :
    Mono (cokernel.map (ap TW sW ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj K))
      (ap TW sW ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E)) ((TW).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).map k))
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).map k) (ap_naturality_g2treg3 σ F _).symm)
proof:
:= by
  letI : K.IsFinitePresentation := hK
  have hV : IsCoherentLike W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj K) :=
    pullback_isFinitePresentation_global pr K
  set φ := cokernel.map (ap TW sW ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj K))
      (ap TW sW ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E)) ((TW).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).map k))
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).map k) (ap_naturality_g2treg3 σ F _).symm with hφdef
  let adj := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction ηΣ
  haveI hu : IsIso (adj.unit.app (cokernel (ap TW sW ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj K)))) :=
    KSpecialization.ARRHU.hunit_ARRHU σ hL F _ hV
  haveI hK' := CIIL3B.isIso_pullback_fst_cokernel_π σ F hL ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj K)
  haveI hE' := CIIL3B.isIso_pullback_fst_cokernel_π σ F hL ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E)
  haveI hm := mono_pullback_eta_pr σ F pr k
  have hsq : (Scheme.Modules.pullback ηΣ).map
        (cokernel.π (ap TW sW ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj K))) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback ηΣ).map φ =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback ηΣ).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).map k) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback ηΣ).map
          (cokernel.π (ap TW sW ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E))) := by
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp, hφdef, cokernel.π_desc]
  haveI hpm : Mono ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ηΣ).map φ) := by
    have : (Scheme.Modules.pullback ηΣ).map φ =
        inv ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ηΣ).map
          (cokernel.π (ap TW sW ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj K)))) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback ηΣ).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).map k) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback ηΣ).map
            (cokernel.π (ap TW sW ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E))) := by
      rw [IsIso.eq_inv_comp, hsq]
    rw [this]
    infer_instance
  haveI : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward ηΣ).IsRightAdjoint := adj.isRightAdjoint
  have hnat : φ ≫ adj.unit.app (cokernel (ap TW sW ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E))) =
      adj.unit.app (cokernel (ap TW sW ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj K))) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward ηΣ).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ηΣ).map φ) :=
    adj.unit.naturality φ
  have hpush : Mono ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ηΣ).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ηΣ).map φ)) :=
    Functor.map_mono _ _
  have h2 : Mono (φ ≫ adj.unit.app (cokernel (ap TW sW ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E)))) := by
    rw [hnat]
    exact @mono_comp _ _ _ _ _ _ (@IsIso.mono_of_iso _ _ _ _ _ hu) _ hpush
  exact @mono_of_mono _ _ _ _ _ _ _ h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegularComparison.Generic.mono_ap_pullback_coherent
statement:
theorem mono_ap_pullback_coherent (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1)
    [Mono (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))] [IsIso (ηΣ ≫ pr)]
    (hcov : PerfectRepG2.Sch.HasBundleCovers Z) (F0 : Z.Modules) (hF0 : IsCoherentLike Z F0) :
    Mono (ap TW sW ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj F0))
proof:
:= by
  have hΛ1 : HasConstantRank Y (lineBundleDual Y L) 1 := lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank L hL
  have hΛW1 := SchemeKTheory.hasConstantRank_pullback W F _ 1 hΛ1
  have hΛW : IsFiniteLocallyFree W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)) :=
    hΛW1.isFiniteLocallyFree
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits W _ hΛW
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits W _ hΛW
  obtain ⟨E, hE, g, hg⟩ := hcov F0 hF0
  have hEc : IsCoherentLike Z E := hE.isFinitePresentation
  have hKc : IsCoherentLike Z (kernel g) :=
    (KSpecialization.kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike).kernel g hEc hF0
  letI : F0.IsFinitePresentation := hF0
  letI : E.IsFinitePresentation := hEc
  letI : (kernel g).IsFinitePresentation := hKc
  let S : ShortComplex Z.Modules := ShortComplex.mk (kernel.ι g) g (kernel.condition g)
  have hS : S.ShortExact := { exact := ShortComplex.exact_kernel g }
  have hS' := pullback_map_shortExact_global pr S hS
  haveI : Epi ((TW).map (S.map (Scheme.Modules.pullback pr)).g) := by
    haveI : Epi (S.map (Scheme.Modules.pullback pr)).g := hS'.epi_g
    infer_instance
  haveI : Mono (ap TW sW (S.map (Scheme.Modules.pullback pr)).X₂) :=
    CIIL3B.hMono_of_mono_pullbackSection σ F pr E hE
  exact mono_of_ses (TW) (S.map (Scheme.Modules.pullback pr)) hS' _ _ _
    (ap_naturality_g2treg3 σ F _) (ap_naturality_g2treg3 σ F _)
    (mono_cokernel_map_pr σ F pr hL (kernel.ι g) hKc)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegularComparison.Generic.mono_ap_pushforward_coherent
statement:
theorem mono_ap_pushforward_coherent (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1)
    [Mono (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))] [IsIso (ηΣ ≫ pr)]
    (hcov : PerfectRepG2.Sch.HasBundleCovers Z) (F0 : Z.Modules) (hF0 : IsCoherentLike Z F0) :
    Mono (ap TΣ sΣ ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj F0)))
proof:
:= by
  have hΛ1 : HasConstantRank Y (lineBundleDual Y L) 1 := lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank L hL
  have hΛ : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y (lineBundleDual Y L) := hΛ1.isFiniteLocallyFree
  have hΛW1 := SchemeKTheory.hasConstantRank_pullback W F _ 1 hΛ1
  have hΛW : IsFiniteLocallyFree W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)) :=
    hΛW1.isFiniteLocallyFree
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits Y _ hΛ
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits Y _ hΛ
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits W _ hΛW
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits W _ hΛW
  haveI := mono_ap_pullback_coherent σ F pr hL hcov F0 hF0
  haveI : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).IsRightAdjoint :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction F).isRightAdjoint
  rw [(pushCompat F (dualEval σ) hΛ).ap_eq]
  infer_instance
