statement:
theorem g0Class_liftSheaf (F : X.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike X F) (x : K0 X)
    (hx : k0ToG0 X x = g0ClassOf X F hF) :
    g0ClassOf (M k N i) (liftSheaf k N i F) (isCoherentLike_liftSheaf k N i F hF) =
      finitePushforward (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k N) i.ker)
        (flatPullbackG0 (totalToClosedBase (space k N) i.ker)
          (k0ToG0 i.ker.subscheme (pullbackK0 (phiXA i).inv x)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [ARRG45C.k0ToG0_pullbackK0, hx]
  rw [show flatPullbackG0 (totalToClosedBase (space k N) i.ker)
        (flatPullbackG0 (phiXA i).inv (g0ClassOf X F hF)) =
      flatPullbackG0 (totalToClosedBase (space k N) i.ker ≫ (phiXA i).inv)
        (g0ClassOf X F hF) by rw [GLocalisationSpec.flatPullbackG0_comp]; rfl]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegularComparison.k0ToG0_altSum_pullback_e
statement:
theorem k0ToG0_altSum_pullback_e (F : X.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike X F)
    (C : RankedBundleComplex (pencil N i hX).M)
    (R : _root_.SingTau.ResolutionData (IsCoherentLike (pencil N i hX).M) C.K (liftSheaf k N i F))
    (x : K0 X) (hx : k0ToG0 X x = g0ClassOf X F hF) :
    k0ToG0 (pencil N i hX).E (C.pullback (pencil N i hX).e).K.altSum =
      finitePushforward (pencil N i hX).s (k0ToG0 X x)
proof:
:= by
  have hA := FRI.space_member k N
  have hAreg := CIICLASS.T1N23.projectiveSpace_regStalks k N
  have hZ := regularZA i hX
  haveI : IsIntegral i.ker.subscheme := integralZA i
  haveI : IsNoetherian (totalGlobal (space k N) i.ker) := total_isNoetherian (k := k) i.ker hA
  set x' := pullbackK0 (phiXA i).inv x with hx'
  have h1 : k0ToG0 (M k N i) C.K.altSum =
      g0ClassOf (M k N i) (liftSheaf k N i F) (isCoherentLike_liftSheaf k N i F hF) :=
    _root_.SingTau.k0ToG0_altSum R _
  have h2 : C.K.altSum = liftK' i.ker hA hAreg hZ x' := by
    apply (bijective_total i.ker hA hAreg hZ).1
    rw [liftK'_spec, ← g0Class_liftSheaf N i F hF x hx]
    exact h1
  rw [altSum_pullback, h2]
  have h3 := hbcE_concrete' (k := k) i.ker hA hAreg hZ canonφA x'
  rw [k0ToG0_phiXA] at h3
  change k0ToG0 (component (space k N) i.ker)
      (pullbackK0 (componentToTotal (space k N) i.ker) (liftK' i.ker hA hAreg hZ x')) =
    finitePushforward ((phiXA i).hom ≫ zeroE i.ker canonφA) (k0ToG0 X x)
  rw [h3, ARRG45C.finitePushforward_comp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.ideal_sheafMinorsIdeal_eq_of_frames
statement:
theorem ideal_sheafMinorsIdeal_eq_of_frames {E F : X.Modules} [E.IsQuasicoherent]
    [F.IsFinitePresentation] (d : E ⟶ F) (r : ℕ) (V : X.affineOpens) {ι κ : Type u} [Fintype ι]
    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] {s : ι → Γ(E, V.1)} {t : κ → Γ(F, V.1)}
    (hs : IsSecFrame E V.1 s) (ht : IsSecFrame F V.1 t) (D : Matrix κ ι Γ(X, V.1))
    (hD : ∀ i, d.app V.1 (s i) = Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, V.1) t (fun k => D k i)) :
    (sheafMinorsIdeal d r).ideal V = GraphBundles.minorsIdeal r D
proof:
:= by
  refine ideal_sheafMinorsIdeal_eq_minorsIdeal d r V
    (minorsCompatible_of_isFinitePresentation d r V) (hs.equiv V.1 le_rfl)
    (ht.equiv V.1 le_rfl).symm D ?_
  refine LinearMap.ext fun c => ?_
  change (ht.equiv V.1 le_rfl).symm (d.app V.1 (hs.equiv V.1 le_rfl c)) = D.mulVec c
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
  change d.app V.1 (Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, V.1) (secResXiR E le_rfl s) c) =
    Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, V.1) (secResXiR F le_rfl t) (D.mulVec c)
  rw [app_linearCombination_xiR, show (fun i => d.app V.1 (s i)) =
      fun i => Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, V.1) t (fun k => D k i) from funext hD,
    linearCombination_comb_xiR]
  congr 2
  ext a b
  exact presheaf_map_homOfLE_self V.1 (D a b)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.sheafMinorsIdeal_pullback
statement:
theorem sheafMinorsIdeal_pullback {E F : M.Modules} {a b : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank M E a)
    (hF : HasConstantRank M F b) (d : E ⟶ F) (r : ℕ) :
    sheafMinorsIdeal ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map d) r = (sheafMinorsIdeal d r).comap g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI := hE.isFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation
  haveI := hF.isFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation
  haveI := (hasConstantRank_pullback N g E a hE).isFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation
  haveI := (hasConstantRank_pullback N g F b hF).isFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation
  have key : ∀ y : N, ∃ W : N.affineOpens, y ∈ W.1 ∧
      (sheafMinorsIdeal ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map d) r).ideal W =
        ((sheafMinorsIdeal d r).comap g).ideal W := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨V₁, hy₁, -, ι, _, s₁, -, hs₁⟩ := exists_isSecFrame hE (O := ⊤) (x := g y) trivial
    obtain ⟨V, hyV, hVV₁, κ, _, t, -, ht⟩ := exists_isSecFrame hF (O := V₁.1) (x := g y) hy₁
    let s : ι → Γ(E, V.1) := secResXiR E hVV₁ s₁
    have hs : IsSecFrame E V.1 s := hs₁.mono hVV₁
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨W₀, hW₀, rfl⟩, hyW, hWle⟩ :=
      N.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open (show y ∈ ((g ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 : N.Opens) : Set N)
        from hyV) (g ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).isOpen
    let W : N.affineOpens := ⟨W₀, hW₀⟩
    have hWV : W.1 ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 := hWle
    
    let D : Matrix κ ι Γ(M, V.1) := fun k i => (ht.equiv V.1 le_rfl).symm (d.app V.1 (s i)) k
    have hD : ∀ i, d.app V.1 (s i) =
        Fintype.linearCombination Γ(M, V.1) t (fun k => D k i) := by
      intro i
      have h := (ht.equiv V.1 le_rfl).apply_symm_apply (d.app V.1 (s i))
      rw [IsSecFrame.equiv_apply] at h
      rw [Fintype.linearCombination_apply]
      conv_lhs => rw [← h]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
      rw [show secResXiR F le_rfl t = t from secResXiR_self F t]
    
    let sW := secResXiR _ hWV (pullSecXiR g E V.1 s)
    let tW := secResXiR _ hWV (pullSecXiR g F V.1 t)
    have hsW : IsSecFrame _ W.1 sW := (isSecFrame_pullback g E V.1 hs).mono hWV
    have htW : IsSecFrame _ W.1 tW := (isSecFrame_pullback g F V.1 ht).mono hWV
    let φ := (g.appLE V.1 W.1 hWV).hom
    have hDW : ∀ i, ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map d).app W.1 (sW i) =
        Fintype.linearCombination Γ(N, W.1) tW (fun k => (D.map φ) k i) := by
      intro i
      have h1 := pullback_app_pullSecXiR g E V.1 d s t D hD i
      change ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map d).app W.1
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op
          (pullSecXiR g E V.1 s i)) = _
      rw [app_res_xiR, h1]
      have h2 := linearCombination_res_xiR ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj F)
        (pullSecXiR g F V.1 t) hWV (le_refl _) (fun k => g.app V.1 (D k i))
      rw [secResXiR_self] at h2
      rw [h2]
      rfl
    refine ⟨W, hyW, ?_⟩
    rw [ideal_sheafMinorsIdeal_eq_of_frames _ r W hsW htW (D.map φ) hDW,
      Chow.M7.KDGb.comap_ideal_eq_map g _ V W hWV,
      ideal_sheafMinorsIdeal_eq_of_frames d r V hs ht D hD, minorsIdeal_map]
  choose W hyW hW using key
  refine Scheme.IdealSheafData.ext_of_iSup_eq_top W ?_ hW
  exact top_le_iff.mp fun y _ => TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨y, hyW y⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.gamma_k0_altSum_eq_zero
statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.gamma_k0_altSum_eq_zero :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (C.K.len + 1), (-1 : K0 (C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU)) ^ i *
      k0ClassOf (C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU) (C.xiGamma (k := k) U hC hU i)
        (C.hasConstantRank_xiGamma U hC hU i).isFiniteLocallyFree = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hπγ : xiProj (k := k) C (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU
      (genericPoint (C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU))) ∈ U := by
    rw [C.gammaTildeι_genericPoint U hC hU]
    exact C.xiProj_gammaPt_mem (k := k) U hC hU
  obtain ⟨V', hV'mem, hV'U, cf, hcf⟩ := C.isSplitOn_of_sectionExactOn U hC _ hπγ
  obtain ⟨hcf0, hnum⟩ := C.splitData_numerics hC V' hV'U hV'mem cf hcf
  let c : ℕ → ℕ := fun i => if i ≤ C.K.len then cf i else 0
  have hci : ∀ i, i ≤ C.K.len → c i = cf i := fun i hi => if_pos hi
  refine altSum_eq_zero_of_locallySplit C.K.len C.rank c (C.hasConstantRank_xiGamma U hC hU)
    (C.xiShiftGamma_comp U hC hU) (fun i hi => ?_) (fun i hi => ?_) ?_ ?_
  · rw [hci (i + 1) hi]
    exact C.isLocallySplitOfRank_xiShiftGamma U hC hU i hi V' hV'mem cf hcf
  · rw [hci i hi]
    have h := hnum i hi
    by_cases hi' : i + 1 ≤ C.K.len
    · rw [if_pos hi'] at h
      rw [hci (i + 1) hi']
      exact h
    · rw [if_neg hi'] at h
      have : c (i + 1) = 0 := if_neg hi'
      rw [this]
      exact h
  · rw [hci 0 (Nat.zero_le _)]
    exact hcf0
  · exact if_neg (Nat.lt_irrefl _ ∘ Nat.lt_of_succ_le)

statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.isFiniteLocallyFree_xiRestrict {V : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : V ⟶ C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU) (i : ℕ) :

      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (g ≫ C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU)).obj (C.xi (k := k) i))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.gamma_k0_altSum_pullback_eq_zero
statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.gamma_k0_altSum_pullback_eq_zero {V : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : V ⟶ C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (C.K.len + 1), (-1 : K0 V) ^ i *
      k0ClassOf V ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (g ≫ C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU)).obj
        (C.xi (k := k) i)) (C.isFiniteLocallyFree_xiRestrict U hC hU g i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (pullbackK0RingHom g) (C.gamma_k0_altSum_eq_zero U hC hU)
  rw [map_sum, map_zero] at h
  rw [← h]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, map_one, pullbackK0RingHom_classOf]
  congr 1
  exact k0ClassOf_iso V _ _
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU)).app (C.xi (k := k) i)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.gamma_altSum_map_eq_zero
statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.gamma_altSum_map_eq_zero {V : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : V ⟶ C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU) {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] (φ : K0 V →+ G) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (C.K.len + 1), φ ((-1 : K0 V) ^ i *
      k0ClassOf V ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (g ≫ C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU)).obj
        (C.xi (k := k) i)) (C.isFiniteLocallyFree_xiRestrict U hC hU g i)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_sum, C.gamma_k0_altSum_pullback_eq_zero U hC hU g, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AmbientIndependence.tauSheaf_twist
statement:
theorem tauSheaf_twist (hadd : TauAdditivity hMK ι hM) (F : X.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike X F)
    (hAF : IsCoherentLike X (tensorSheaf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj A) F)) :
    tauSheaf hMK ι hM hreg (pushCoh ι ⟨_, hAF⟩).1 (pushCoh ι ⟨_, hAF⟩).2 =
      chK k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj A)
        (tauSheaf hMK ι hM hreg (pushCoh ι ⟨F, hF⟩).1 (pushCoh ι ⟨F, hF⟩).2)
proof:
:= by
  set G := (pushCoh ι ⟨F, hF⟩).1
  have hG : IsCoherentLike M G := (pushCoh ι ⟨F, hF⟩).2
  let C := chosenRes hMK hreg G hG
  let R := chosenResData hMK hreg G hG
  have hC : C.SectionExactOn (exactLocus G hG) := sectionExactOn_of_resolutionData C R hG
  have hX := mem_range_of_not_mem_exactLocus ι hG (pushCoh_support ι ⟨F, hF⟩)
  let R' : _root_.SingTau.ResolutionData (IsCoherentLike M) (C.twistTtw A hA).K
      (pushCoh ι ⟨_, hAF⟩).1 :=
    resolutionDataIso_g2tproj (resolutionDataTwist A hA.isFiniteLocallyFree R)
      (twistPushIso_g2tproj ι A hA F)
  rw [tauSheaf_eq hMK ι hM hreg hadd _ (pushCoh ι ⟨_, hAF⟩).2 (pushCoh_support ι ⟨_, hAF⟩)
    (C.twistTtw A hA) R' (exactLocus G hG) (sectionExactOn_twistTtw C A hA hC) hX,
    tauStd_twistTtw_line (k := k) hMK C A hA ι (exactLocus G hG) hC hM]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AmbientIndependence.tauG0_smul_line
statement:
theorem tauG0_smul_line (hadd : TauAdditivity hMK ι hM) (z : G0 X) :
    tauG0 hMK ι hM hreg hadd
        (k0ClassOf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj A)
          (hasConstantRank_pullback X ι A 1 hA).isFiniteLocallyFree • z) =
      chK k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj A) (tauG0 hMK ι hM hreg hadd z)
proof:
:= by
  let f : G0 X →+ TotalChow X := (tauG0 hMK ι hM hreg hadd).comp
    (DistribSMul.toAddMonoidHom (G0 X)
      (k0ClassOf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj A)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X ι A 1 hA).isFiniteLocallyFree))
  let g : G0 X →+ TotalChow X :=
    (chK k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj A)).toAddMonoidHom.comp (tauG0 hMK ι hM hreg hadd)
  have hfg : f = g := by
    refine ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _ fun F => ?_
    change tauG0 hMK ι hM hreg hadd (k0ClassOf X _ _ • g0ClassOf X F.1 F.2) =
      chK k _ (tauG0 hMK ι hM hreg hadd (g0ClassOf X F.1 F.2))
    rw [k0ClassOf_smul_g0ClassOf, tauG0_classOf, tauG0_classOf]
    exact tauSheaf_twist hMK ι hM hreg A hA hadd F.1 F.2 _
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hfg z

statement: theorem sesKer_shortExact {A B : X.Modules} (f : A ⟶ B) : (sesKer f).ShortExact

  haveI : Epi (kernel.lift (cokernel.π f) f (cokernel.condition f)) := hT.epi_kernelLift

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.kerCokerClosed_dimLE
statement:
theorem kerCokerClosed_dimLE (d : ℕ) :
    ExactGrothendieck.PrincipalGysin.KerCokerClosed (IsCoherentDimLE X d) where
  zero
proof:
:= ⟨KSpecialization.kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike.zero,
    fun x hx ↦ absurd hx (not_mem_support_of_isZero (isZero_zero _) x)⟩
  kernel f hA hB := ⟨KSpecialization.kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike.kernel f hA.1 hB.1,
    fun x hx ↦ hA.2 x (support_subset_of_mono (kernel.ι f) hx)⟩
  cokernel f hA hB := ⟨KSpecialization.kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike.cokernel f hA.1 hB.1,
    fun x hx ↦ hB.2 x (support_subset_of_epi (cokernel.π f) hx)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.cls_four
statement:
theorem cls_four {d : ℕ} {A B : X.Modules} (f : A ⟶ B) (hA : IsCoherentDimLE X d A)
    (hB : IsCoherentDimLE X d B) :
    cls X d A hA + cls X d (cokernel f) ((kerCokerClosed_dimLE d).cokernel f hA hB) =
      cls X d B hB + cls X d (kernel f) ((kerCokerClosed_dimLE d).kernel f hA hB)
proof:
:= by
  have hK := kerCokerClosed_dimLE (X := X) d
  have hC := hK.cokernel f hA hB
  have r1 := ExactGrothendieck.PrincipalGysin.classOf_eq_ker_add_ker hK
    (ShortComplex.mk f (cokernel.π f) (cokernel.condition f))
    (ShortComplex.exact_of_g_is_cokernel _ (cokernelIsCokernel f)) hA hB hC
  have r2 := ExactGrothendieck.PrincipalGysin.classOf_eq_ker_add_of_epi hK (cokernel.π f) hB hC
  dsimp only at r1
  unfold cls
  rw [r1, r2]
  abel

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.stalkLength_add_of_shortExact
statement:
theorem stalkLength_add_of_shortExact {S : ShortComplex X.Modules} (hS : S.ShortExact) (y : X) :
    stalkLength S.X₂ y = stalkLength S.X₁ y + stalkLength S.X₃ y
proof:
:= by
  have hT := shortExact_map_moduleStalkFunctorLinear X y hS
  exact Module.length_eq_add_of_exact _ _ hT.moduleCat_injective_f hT.moduleCat_surjective_g
    ((ShortComplex.ShortExact.moduleCat_exact_iff_function_exact _).mp hT.exact)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.mu_add_of_shortExact
statement:
theorem mu_add_of_shortExact {S : ShortComplex X.Modules} (hS : S.ShortExact) (T : Finset X) :
    mu T S.X₂ = mu T S.X₁ + mu T S.X₃
proof:
:= by
  unfold mu
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun y _ ↦ stalkLength_add_of_shortExact hS y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.mu_eq_of_iso
statement: theorem mu_eq_of_iso {A B : X.Modules} (e : A ≅ B) (T : Finset X) : mu T A = mu T B
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_congr rfl fun y _ ↦ stalkLength_eq_of_iso e y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.stalkLength_le_mu
statement:
theorem stalkLength_le_mu {T : Finset X} {x : X} (hx : x ∈ T) (F : X.Modules) :
    stalkLength F x ≤ mu T F
proof:
:=
  Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun y ↦ stalkLength F y) (fun _ _ ↦ zero_le) hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.mu_pos
statement:
theorem mu_pos {T : Finset X} {x : X} (hx : x ∈ T) {F : X.Modules}
    (hF : x ∈ moduleSheafSupport F) : 0 < mu T F
proof:
:=
  (stalkLength_pos_of_mem F hF).trans_le (stalkLength_le_mu hx F)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.mu_lt_top
proof:
:= by
  haveI : F.IsFinitePresentation := hF.1
  unfold mu
  rw [ENat.sum_lt_top]
  intro y hy
  by_cases hmem : y ∈ moduleSheafSupport F
  · exact Ne.lt_top (Module.length_ne_top_iff.mpr
      (isFiniteLength_stalk_of_maximal F (maximal_of_height_eq_of_top F hF.2 (hT y hy) hmem)))
  · rw [stalkLength_eq_zero_of_not_mem F hmem]
    simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.enat_lt_of_add
statement: theorem enat_lt_of_add {a b c : ℕ∞} (h : b = a + c) (hb : b < ⊤) (hc : 0 < c) : a < b
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  have ha : a ≠ ⊤ := fun h ↦ by simp [h] at hb
  have hc' : c ≠ ⊤ := fun h ↦ by simp [h] at hb
  lift a to ℕ using ha
  lift c to ℕ using hc'
  exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right (by exact_mod_cast hc)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.mu_ker_lt
statement:
theorem mu_ker_lt [IsLocallyNoetherian X] {d : ℕ} {T : Finset X} (hT : ∀ y ∈ T, height y = d)
    {A B : X.Modules} (f : A ⟶ B) (hA : IsCoherentDimLE X d A) {x : X} (hxT : x ∈ T)
    (hx : x ∈ moduleSheafSupport (img f)) : mu T (kernel f) < mu T A
proof:
:=
  enat_lt_of_add (mu_add_of_shortExact (sesKer_shortExact f) T) (mu_lt_top hT hA)
    (mu_pos hxT hx)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.mu_coker_lt
statement:
theorem mu_coker_lt [IsLocallyNoetherian X] {d : ℕ} {T : Finset X} (hT : ∀ y ∈ T, height y = d)
    {A B : X.Modules} (f : A ⟶ B) (hB : IsCoherentDimLE X d B) {x : X} (hxT : x ∈ T)
    (hx : x ∈ moduleSheafSupport (img f)) : mu T (cokernel f) < mu T B
proof:
:= by
  have h := mu_add_of_shortExact (sesCoker_shortExact f) T
  rw [add_comm] at h
  exact enat_lt_of_add h (mu_lt_top hT hB) (mu_pos hxT hx)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.mem_support_img
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  have h1 := stalkLength_add_of_shortExact (sesKer_shortExact f) x
  have h2 := stalkLength_pos_of_mem A hxA
  change stalkLength A x = stalkLength (kernel f) x + stalkLength (img f) x at h1
  rw [stalkLength_eq_zero_of_not_mem _ hker, stalkLength_eq_zero_of_not_mem _ h, add_zero] at h1
  rw [h1] at h2
  exact lt_irrefl _ h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.not_mem_support_coker_of_length_one
proof:
:= by
  intro hc
  have h1 := stalkLength_add_of_shortExact (sesCoker_shortExact f) x
  change stalkLength B x = stalkLength (img f) x + stalkLength (cokernel f) x at h1
  have h2 := stalkLength_pos_of_mem _ hx
  have h3 := stalkLength_pos_of_mem _ hc
  rw [hB] at h1
  have h4 : (1 : ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ stalkLength (img f) x + stalkLength (cokernel f) x :=
    add_le_add (Order.one_le_iff_pos.mpr h2) (Order.one_le_iff_pos.mpr h3)
  rw [← h1] at h4
  exact absurd h4 (by decide)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.selMat_mul
statement:
theorem selMat_mul (S₀ : n → n ⊕ m) (B : Matrix (n ⊕ m) n A) :
    (selMat S₀ : Matrix n (n ⊕ m) A) * B = B.submatrix S₀ id
proof:
:= by
  ext j k
  simp [selMat, Matrix.mul_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.IsGraphSat.smul_bot_eq
statement:
theorem IsGraphSat.smul_bot_eq (h : IsGraphSat μ l d S₀ B) :
    μ • xiBot B = l • (d * xiTop B)
proof:
:= by
  ext i k
  have h1 := congrFun (congrFun h.psi i) k
  have h2 : (graphPsi μ l d * B) i k = (graphPsi μ l d *ᵥ fun x => B x k) i := rfl
  rw [h2, graphPsi_mulVec] at h1
  have h3 : (d * xiTop B) i k = (d *ᵥ ((fun x => B x k) ∘ Sum.inl)) i := rfl
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Function.comp_apply, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.zero_apply,
    sub_eq_zero] at h1
  simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, submatrix_apply, id_eq, h3]
  exact h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.IsGraphSat.selMat_mul_eq_one
statement:
theorem IsGraphSat.selMat_mul_eq_one (h : IsGraphSat μ l d S₀ B) :
    (selMat S₀ : Matrix n (n ⊕ m) A) * B = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [selMat_mul, h.rows_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.IsGraphSat.entry_bot
statement:
theorem IsGraphSat.entry_bot (h : IsGraphSat μ l d S₀ B) (i : m) (k : n) :
    μ * B (Sum.inr i) k = l * (d * xiTop B) i k
proof:
:= by
  have := congrFun (congrFun h.smul_bot_eq i) k
  simpa using this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.IsGraphSat.minorsIdeal_bot_eq_bot
statement:
theorem IsGraphSat.minorsIdeal_bot_eq_bot [IsDomain A] (h : IsGraphSat μ l d S₀ B) (hμ : μ ≠ 0)
    {c : ℕ} (hd : GraphBundles.minorsIdeal (c + 1) d = ⊥) :
    GraphBundles.minorsIdeal (c + 1) (xiBot B) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [GraphBundles.minorsIdeal, Ideal.span_eq_bot]
  rintro _ ⟨⟨S, T⟩, rfl⟩
  have hmem : ((μ • xiBot B).submatrix S T).det ∈ GraphBundles.minorsIdeal (c + 1) d := by
    rw [h.smul_bot_eq]
    have e : l • (d * xiTop B) = (Matrix.diagonal fun _ => l) * d * xiTop B := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.smul_eq_diagonal_mul]
    rw [e]
    exact (GraphBundles.minorsIdeal_mul_right_le _ _ _).trans
      (GraphBundles.minorsIdeal_mul_left_le _ _ _) (GraphBundles.minor_mem_minorsIdeal _ S T)
  have e2 : (μ • xiBot B).submatrix S T = μ • ((xiBot B).submatrix S T) := by
    ext i j; simp
  rw [hd, Ideal.mem_bot, e2, det_smul, Fintype.card_fin] at hmem
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hmem).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero _ hμ)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.IsGraphSat.mul_top_mem_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem IsGraphSat.mul_top_mem_maximalIdeal [IsLocalRing A] (h : IsGraphSat μ l d S₀ B)
    (ht : ∀ x : A, x * μ ≠ l) (i : m) (k : n) :
    (d * xiTop B) i k ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hu
  have hu' : IsUnit ((d * xiTop B) i k) := by
    rwa [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff, not_not] at hu
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hu'
  apply ht (B (Sum.inr i) k * ↑u⁻¹)
  have e := h.entry_bot i k
  rw [← hu] at e
  calc B (Sum.inr i) k * ↑u⁻¹ * μ = (μ * B (Sum.inr i) k) * ↑u⁻¹ := by ring
    _ = l * ↑u * ↑u⁻¹ := by rw [e]
    _ = l := by rw [mul_assoc, Units.mul_inv, mul_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.IsGraphSat.rank_top_add_le
statement:
theorem IsGraphSat.rank_top_add_le [IsLocalRing A] {K : Type*} [Field K] (f : A →+* K)
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A, f x = 0) (h : IsGraphSat μ l d S₀ B)
    (ht : ∀ x : A, x * μ ≠ l) {c : ℕ} (hd : GraphBundles.minorsIdeal c d = ⊤) :
    ((xiTop B).map f).rank + c ≤ Fintype.card n
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : d.map f * (xiTop B).map f = 0 := by
    rw [← Matrix.map_mul]
    ext i k
    simp only [Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.zero_apply]
    exact hf _ (h.mul_top_mem_maximalIdeal ht i k)
  have h1 := rank_add_rank_le_card_of_mul_eq_zero h0
  have h2 : c ≤ (d.map f).rank := by
    refine le_rank_of_minorsIdeal_ne_bot _ ?_
    rw [minorsIdeal_map_eq_top f d c hd]
    exact top_ne_bot
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.IsGraphSat.generic_bounds
statement:
theorem IsGraphSat.generic_bounds [IsLocalRing A] [IsDomain A] {K : Type*} [Field K]
    (f : A →+* K) (hf : ∀ x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A, f x = 0) (h : IsGraphSat μ l d S₀ B)
    (hμ : μ ≠ 0) (ht : ∀ x : A, x * μ ≠ l) {a c : ℕ} (hac : a + c = Fintype.card n)
    (hc : GraphBundles.minorsIdeal c d = ⊤) (hc1 : GraphBundles.minorsIdeal (c + 1) d = ⊥) :
    GraphBundles.minorsIdeal (a + 1) ((xiTop B).map f) = ⊥ ∧
      GraphBundles.minorsIdeal (c + 1) ((xiBot B).map f) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, minorsIdeal_map_eq_bot _ _ _ (h.minorsIdeal_bot_eq_bot hμ hc1)⟩
  rw [minorsIdeal_eq_bot_iff_rank_lt]
  have := h.rank_top_add_le f hf ht hc
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.IsGraphSat.const_rank_of_generic
statement:
theorem IsGraphSat.const_rank_of_generic [IsLocalRing A] {K : Type*} [Field K] (f : A →+* K)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (h : IsGraphSat μ l d S₀ B) {a c : ℕ}
    (hac : a + c = Fintype.card n)
    (h₁ : GraphBundles.minorsIdeal (a + 1) ((xiTop B).map f) = ⊥)
    (h₂ : GraphBundles.minorsIdeal (c + 1) ((xiBot B).map f) = ⊥) :
    GraphBundles.minorsIdeal a (xiTop B) = ⊤ ∧ GraphBundles.minorsIdeal c (xiBot B) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact isSplit_of_stacked B (selMat S₀) h.selMat_mul_eq_one hac
    (minorsIdeal_eq_bot_of_injective f hf _ _ h₁) (minorsIdeal_eq_bot_of_injective f hf _ _ h₂)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.freeGenXiR_eq_freeSection
statement:
theorem freeGenXiR_eq_freeSection (i : ι) (O : Z.Opens) :
    freeGenXiR ι i O = (SheafOfModules.freeSection (R := Z.ringCatSheaf) i).val (op O)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.underlyingFree_hom_freeGenXiR
statement:
theorem underlyingFree_hom_freeGenXiR (i : ι) (O : Z.Opens) :
    ((SchemeKTheory.underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree Z ι).hom.app (op O)).hom (freeGenXiR ι i O) =
      Finsupp.single i 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [freeGenXiR_eq_freeSection]
  exact SchemeKTheory.underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree_hom_freeSection_eval Z ι i (op O)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.secResXiR_freeGen
statement:
theorem secResXiR_freeGen (i : ι) {O O' : Z.Opens} (h : O' ≤ O) :
    secResXiR (SheafOfModules.free (R := Z.ringCatSheaf) ι) h (fun i => freeGenXiR ι i O) i =
      freeGenXiR ι i O'
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := Z.ringCatSheaf) i).val
    (homOfLE h).op (1 : Z.presheaf.obj (op O))
  simp only [secResXiR, freeGenXiR]
  erw [← h1]
  congr 1
  exact map_one (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.bijective_lc_of_equiv_single
statement:
theorem bijective_lc_of_equiv_single {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [Fintype ι] (e : M ≃ₗ[R] (ι →₀ R)) (v : ι → M) (hv : ∀ i, e (v i) = Finsupp.single i 1) :
    Function.Bijective (Fintype.linearCombination R v)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : v = ⇑((Finsupp.basisSingleOne (R := R) (ι := ι)).map e.symm) := by
    funext i
    rw [Module.Basis.map_apply, Finsupp.coe_basisSingleOne]
    exact (e.symm_apply_eq.2 (hv i).symm).symm
  rw [this]
  exact bijective_linearCombination_basisXiR _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.isSecFrame_freeGen
statement:
theorem isSecFrame_freeGen (O : Z.Opens) :
    IsSecFrame (SheafOfModules.free (R := Z.ringCatSheaf) ι) O (fun i => freeGenXiR ι i O)
proof:
:= by
  intro V h
  let e := ((PresheafOfModules.evaluation _ (op V)).mapIso
    (SchemeKTheory.underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree Z ι)).toLinearEquiv
  refine bijective_lc_of_equiv_single ι e _ fun i => ?_
  rw [secResXiR_freeGen]
  exact underlyingFree_hom_freeGenXiR ι i V

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.IsSecFrame.map_iso
proof:
:= by
  intro V h
  have : (Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Z, V) (secResXiR B h (fun i => Φ.hom.app U (t i))) :
      (ι → Γ(Z, V)) → Γ(B, V)) =
      (Φ.hom.app V) ∘ Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Z, V) (secResXiR A h t) := by
    funext c
    exact (app_linearCombination_xiR Φ.hom t h c).symm
  rw [this]
  exact ((ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective _).1 inferInstance).comp (ht V h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.lc_restrict_xiR
statement:
theorem lc_restrict_xiR {O O' : Z.Opens} (t : ι → Γ(L, f ''ᵁ O)) (h : O' ≤ O)
    (c : ι → Γ(Z, O')) :
    Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Z, O') (secResXiR (L.restrict f) h t) c =
      Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, f ''ᵁ O') (secResXiR L (f.image_mono h) t)
        (fun i => (f.appIso O').inv (c i))
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.isSecFrame_restrict_iff
statement:
theorem isSecFrame_restrict_iff (O : Z.Opens) (t : ι → Γ(L, f ''ᵁ O)) :
    IsSecFrame (L.restrict f) O t ↔ IsSecFrame L (f ''ᵁ O) t
proof:
:= by
  let eqv : ∀ O' : Z.Opens, (ι → Γ(Z, O')) ≃ (ι → Γ(X, f ''ᵁ O')) := fun O' =>
    Equiv.arrowCongr (Equiv.refl ι) (f.appIso O').commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.symm.toEquiv
  constructor
  · intro ht V hV
    have hVr : V ≤ f.opensRange := hV.trans (f.image_le_opensRange O)
    obtain ⟨O', rfl⟩ : ∃ O', f ''ᵁ O' = V :=
      ⟨f ⁻¹ᵁ V, by rw [f.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, inf_eq_right.2 hVr]⟩
    have h' : O' ≤ O := (f.image_le_image_iff O' O).1 hV
    have hb := ht O' h'
    have : (Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, f ''ᵁ O') (secResXiR L hV t) :
        (ι → Γ(X, f ''ᵁ O')) → Γ(L, f ''ᵁ O')) =
        Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Z, O') (secResXiR (L.restrict f) h' t) ∘ (eqv O').symm := by
      funext c
      rw [Function.comp_apply, lc_restrict_xiR]
      congr 1
      funext i
      exact ((f.appIso O').commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.symm_apply_apply (c i)).symm
    rw [this]
    exact hb.comp (eqv O').symm.bijective
  · intro ht O' h'
    have hb := ht (f ''ᵁ O') (f.image_mono h')
    have : (Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Z, O') (secResXiR (L.restrict f) h' t) :
        (ι → Γ(Z, O')) → Γ(L, f ''ᵁ O')) =
        Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, f ''ᵁ O') (secResXiR L (f.image_mono h') t) ∘ eqv O' := by
      funext c
      exact lc_restrict_xiR f L t h' c
    rw [this]
    exact hb.comp (eqv O').bijective

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.globalFrameHom_app
statement:
theorem globalFrameHom_app (t : ι → Γ(L, U)) (O : Z.Opens) (x) :
    (globalFrameHom L hU t).app O x =
      Finsupp.linearCombination Γ(Z, O) (secResXiR L (le_top.trans hU) t)
        (((SchemeKTheory.underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree Z ι).hom.app (op O)).hom x)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.globalFrameHom_freeGen
statement:
theorem globalFrameHom_freeGen (t : ι → Γ(L, U)) (i : ι) :
    (globalFrameHom L hU t).app U (freeGenXiR ι i U) = t i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [globalFrameHom_app, underlyingFree_hom_freeGenXiR]
  erw [Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul]
  exact congrFun (secResXiR_self L t) i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.globalFrameHom_bijective
statement:
theorem globalFrameHom_bijective {t : ι → Γ(L, U)} (ht : IsSecFrame L U t) (O : Z.Opens) :
    Function.Bijective ((globalFrameHom L hU t).app O)
proof:
:= by
  have he : Function.Bijective
      (((SchemeKTheory.underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree Z ι).hom.app (op O)).hom) :=
    ((PresheafOfModules.evaluation _ (op O)).mapIso
      (SchemeKTheory.underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree Z ι)).toLinearEquiv.bijective
  have hl : Function.Bijective (Finsupp.linearCombination Γ(Z, O)
      (secResXiR L (le_top.trans hU : O ≤ U) t)) := by
    have h2 := ht O (le_top.trans hU : O ≤ U)
    have : (Finsupp.linearCombination Γ(Z, O) (secResXiR L (le_top.trans hU : O ≤ U) t) :
        (ι →₀ Γ(Z, O)) → Γ(L, O)) =
        Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Z, O) (secResXiR L (le_top.trans hU : O ≤ U) t) ∘
          (Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite Γ(Z, O) Γ(Z, O) ι) := by
      funext c
      rw [Function.comp_apply, ← Finsupp.linearCombination_eq_fintype_linearCombination_apply,
        LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    rw [this]
    exact h2.comp (Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite _ _ ι).bijective
  exact hl.comp he

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.IsSecFrame.of_eq
statement:
theorem IsSecFrame.of_eq {L : Y.Modules} {U U' : Y.Opens} (h : U' ≤ U) (heq : U' = U)
    {s : ι → Γ(L, U)} (hs : IsSecFrame L U' (secResXiR L h s)) : IsSecFrame L U s
proof:
:= by
  intro W hW
  have hW' : W ≤ U' := heq ▸ hW
  have := hs W hW'
  rwa [secResXiR_res] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.isSecFrame_pullback
statement:
theorem isSecFrame_pullback {s : ι → Γ(E, V)} (hs : IsSecFrame E V s) :
    IsSecFrame ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E) (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (pullSecXiR f E V s)
proof:
:= by
  
  let s' : ι → Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj E, V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V) := fun i =>
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction V.ι).unit.app E).app V (s i)
  have hs' : IsSecFrame ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj E) (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V) s' := by
    rw [isSecFrame_restrict_iff]
    exact hs.mono (V.ι.image_preimage_le V)
  have hTop : (⊤ : V.toScheme.Opens) ≤ V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V := fun x _ => x.2
  haveI : Fact (IsSecFrame _ _ s') := ⟨hs'⟩
  let Φ := asIso (globalFrameHom ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj E) hTop s')
  let g := f ∣_ V
  let Ψ := (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso g ι).symm ≪≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).mapIso Φ ≪≫
    restrictPullbackIso f V E
  let O₁ : (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.Opens := g ⁻¹ᵁ (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V)
  have h1 := (isSecFrame_freeGen (Z := (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme) ι O₁).map_iso Ψ
  have hu : ∀ i, Ψ.hom.app O₁ (freeGenXiR ι i O₁) = (restrictPullbackIso f V E).hom.app O₁
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app _).app (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V) (s' i)) := by
    intro i
    change (restrictPullbackIso f V E).hom.app O₁ (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map Φ.hom).app O₁
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso g ι).inv.app O₁ (freeGenXiR ι i O₁))) = _
    congr 1
    have hP : (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso g ι).inv.app O₁ (freeGenXiR ι i O₁) =
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.free (R := V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) ι)).app (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V)
          (freeGenXiR ι i (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V)) := by
      have := SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.adjUnit_pullbackFreeIso_apply g ι i
        (op (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V))
      refine Eq.trans ?_ (iso_inv_hom_app (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso g ι) O₁ _)
      congr 1
      exact this.symm
    rw [hP, pullback_map_unit]
    congr 1
    exact globalFrameHom_freeGen (hU := hTop) s' i
  let F' := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E)
  have h1' : IsSecFrame F' O₁ (fun i => (restrictPullbackIso f V E).hom.app O₁
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app _).app (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V) (s' i))) := by
    have : (fun i => Ψ.hom.app O₁ (freeGenXiR ι i O₁)) = fun i => (restrictPullbackIso f V E).hom.app O₁
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app _).app (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V) (s' i)) :=
      funext hu
    rw [← this]
    exact h1
  have heq : (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) = O₁ := preimage_morphismRestrict_eq f V V
  have h2 := h1'.mono (le_of_eq heq)
  have hw : secResXiR F' (le_of_eq heq) (fun i => (restrictPullbackIso f V E).hom.app O₁
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app _).app (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V) (s' i))) =
      fun i => ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).unit.app
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E)).app (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (pullSecXiR f E V s i) := by
    funext i
    have := restrictPullbackIso_hom_unit f V E V (s i)
    simp only [secResXiR]
    rw [show (homOfLE (le_of_eq heq)) = eqToHom heq from Subsingleton.elim _ _]
    exact this
  rw [hw] at h2
  rw [isSecFrame_restrict_iff] at h2
  exact IsSecFrame.of_eq ((f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι.image_preimage_le (f ⁻¹ᵁ V))
    (by rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι, inf_idem]) h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.pullSecXiR_smul
statement:
theorem pullSecXiR_smul (a : Γ(X, V)) (x : Γ(E, V)) :
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app E).app V (a • x) :
      Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E, f ⁻¹ᵁ V)) =
      f.app V a • (show Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E, f ⁻¹ᵁ V) from
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app E).app V x)
proof:
:=
  Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul _ a x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.pullback_app_pullSecXiR
statement:
theorem pullback_app_pullSecXiR {F : X.Modules} (d : E ⟶ F) {κ : Type u} [Fintype κ]
    (s : ι → Γ(E, V)) (s' : κ → Γ(F, V)) (D : Matrix κ ι Γ(X, V))
    (hD : ∀ i, d.app V (s i) = Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, V) s' (fun k => D k i)) (i : ι) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map d).app (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (pullSecXiR f E V s i) =
      Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (pullSecXiR f F V s')
        (fun k => f.app V (D k i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [pullSecXiR, pullback_map_unit, hD i, Fintype.linearCombination_apply,
    Fintype.linearCombination_apply]
  erw [map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  exact pullSecXiR_smul f F V (D k i) (s' k)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AmbientIndependence.pfHom_eq_self_of_eq_id_g2tproj
statement:
theorem pfHom_eq_self_of_eq_id_g2tproj {W : Scheme.{u}} [W.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (W ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian W] (f : W ⟶ W) [f.IsOver (Spk k)]
    [IsProper f] (hf : f = 𝟙 W) (n : ℕ) (D : dimensionCycles W n) :
    D13.pfHom (k := k) f n D = D
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change properPushforward f D.1 = D.1
  subst hf
  exact properPushforward_id D.1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AmbientIndependence.tdLineK_iso_g2tproj
statement:
theorem tdLineK_iso_g2tproj {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (ProjK k X)] {L L' : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hL' : HasConstantRank X L' 1) (e : L ≅ L') :
    CaseIProjSingular.tdLineK k L hL = CaseIProjSingular.tdLineK k L' hL'
proof:
:= by
  have h : K7.chernLineValOn (opsK k) X L hL = K7.chernLineValOn (opsK k) X L' hL' := by
    funext i
    change (if i = 0 then 1 else if i = 1 then totalCapOn (opsK k) L hL else 0) =
      (if i = 0 then 1 else if i = 1 then totalCapOn (opsK k) L' hL' else 0)
    rw [K3.cap_isoOn (opsK k) hL hL' ⟨e⟩]
  exact congrArg GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.tdFromChern h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AmbientIndependence.push_tauRaw_closed
statement:
theorem push_tauRaw_closed (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U)
    (hX : ∀ x : M, x ∉ U → x ∈ Set.range ιX) {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    haveI : IsProper j
proof:
:= isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) j
    totalPushOn (opsK k) j (tauRaw (k := k) C ιX U hC hM) = tauRaw (k := k) C ιZ U hC hM := by
  haveI : IsProper j := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) j
  have hgX : j ≫ ιZ = ιX ≫ 𝟙 M := by rw [hj, Category.comp_id]
  have key := ModelInd.push_tauRaw_modelInd' C ιZ C ιX (𝟙 M)
    (ModelInd.graphIdeal_comap_id_g2tmi (k := k) C) j hgX
    (ModelInd.xiPullbackCompat_id_g2tmi (k := k) C) U hC hX hM
  rw [key]
  haveI := ModelInd.cmpMap_isOver C C (𝟙 M) (ModelInd.graphIdeal_comap_id_g2tmi (k := k) C)
  haveI : IsProper (ModelInd.cmpMap C C (𝟙 M) (ModelInd.graphIdeal_comap_id_g2tmi (k := k) C)) :=
    isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
  rw [pfHom_eq_self_of_eq_id_g2tproj _ (ModelInd.cmpMap_id_g2tmi (k := k) C)]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AmbientIndependence.push_tauStd_closed
statement:
theorem push_tauStd_closed (C : RankedBundleComplex M) (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U)
    (hX : ∀ x : M, x ∉ U → x ∈ Set.range ιX) {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    haveI : IsProper j
proof:
:= isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) j
    totalPushOn (opsK k) j (tauStd hMK C ιX U hC hM) = tauStd hMK C ιZ U hC hM := by
  letI := prodP1Over (k := k) (A := M)
  letI := blowupOver (k := k) (graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := prodP1_lft (k := k) (A := M)
  haveI := prodP1_isNoetherian (k := k) (A := M)
  haveI := blowup_locallyOfFiniteType
    (CIICLASS.projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod hMK 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
    (graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) (graphIdeal_ne_bot C.toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := blowup_isNoetherian
    (CIICLASS.projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod hMK 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
    (graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) (graphIdeal_ne_bot C.toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := C.isIntegral_graphModel (k := k) hMK
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (C.graphModel (k := k))) :=
    ⟨projK_of_projectiveIntegralK (projectiveIntegralK_graphModel hMK C.toDetIdealComplex)⟩
  haveI : (xiProj (k := k) C).IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨Category.assoc _ _ _⟩
  exact push_tauRaw_closed (k := k) C ιZ ιX j hj U hC hX hM

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AmbientIndependence.tauSheaf_iso_g2tproj
statement:
theorem tauSheaf_iso_g2tproj (hadd : TauAdditivity hMK ιZ hM) {G G' : M.Modules}
    (hG : IsCoherentLike M G) (hG' : IsCoherentLike M G')
    (hsupp : moduleSheafSupport G ⊆ Set.range ιZ) (hsupp' : moduleSheafSupport G' ⊆ Set.range ιZ)
    (e : G ≅ G') :
    tauSheaf hMK ιZ hM hreg G' hG' = tauSheaf hMK ιZ hM hreg G hG
proof:
:= by
  rw [tauSheaf_eq hMK ιZ hM hreg hadd G' hG' hsupp' (chosenRes hMK hreg G hG)
    (resolutionDataIso_g2tproj (chosenResData hMK hreg G hG) e) (exactLocus G hG)
    (sectionExactOn_of_resolutionData _ (chosenResData hMK hreg G hG) hG)
    (mem_range_of_not_mem_exactLocus ιZ hG hsupp)]
  rfl

statement:
theorem push_tauSheaf_closed (G : M.Modules) (hG : IsCoherentLike M G)

    haveI : IsProper j
proof:
:= isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) j
    totalPushOn (opsK k) j (tauSheaf hMK ιX hM hreg G hG) = tauSheaf hMK ιZ hM hreg G hG :=

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AmbientIndependence.tauG0_finitePushforward
statement:
theorem tauG0_finitePushforward [IsClosedImmersion j] (haddZ : TauAdditivity hMK ιZ hM)
    (haddX : TauAdditivity hMK ιX hM) (x : G0 X) :
    haveI : IsProper j
proof:
:= isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) j
    tauG0 hMK ιZ hM hreg haddZ (finitePushforward j x) =
      totalPushOn (opsK k) j (tauG0 hMK ιX hM hreg haddX x) := by
  haveI : IsProper j := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) j
  let f : G0 X →+ TotalChow Z := (tauG0 hMK ιZ hM hreg haddZ).comp (finitePushforward j)
  let g : G0 X →+ TotalChow Z :=
    (totalPushOn (opsK k) j).toAddMonoidHom.comp (tauG0 hMK ιX hM hreg haddX)
  have hfg : f = g := by
    refine ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _ fun F => ?_
    change tauG0 hMK ιZ hM hreg haddZ (finitePushforward j (g0ClassOf X F.1 F.2)) =
      totalPushOn (opsK k) j (tauG0 hMK ιX hM hreg haddX (g0ClassOf X F.1 F.2))
    rw [finitePushforward_classOf, tauG0_classOf, tauG0_classOf,
      push_tauSheaf_closed hMK ιZ ιX j hj hM hreg _ _ (pushCoh_support ιX F)]
    exact tauSheaf_iso_g2tproj hMK ιZ hM hreg haddZ _ _
      ((pushCoh_support ιX F).trans fun y ⟨x, hx⟩ => ⟨j x, by rw [← hx, ← hj]; rfl⟩)
      (FamilySpecializationG0.moduleSheafSupport_pushforward_subset ιZ _)
      (pushIso_g2tproj ιZ ιX j hj F.1)
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hfg x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AmbientIndependence.tauPn_finitePushforward
statement:
theorem tauPn_finitePushforward (haddZ : TauAdditivityPn N ιZ) (haddX : TauAdditivityPn N ιX)
    (x : G0 X) :
    haveI : IsProper j
proof:
:= isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) j
    tauPn N ιZ haddZ (finitePushforward j x) = totalPushOn (opsK k) j (tauPn N ιX haddX x) := by
  haveI : IsProper j := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) j
  have hL : HasConstantRank Z ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ιZ).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N 1)) 1 :=
    hasConstantRank_pullback Z ιZ _ 1 (hcr k N 1)
  have htd : tdLineK k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ιX).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N 1))
      (hasConstantRank_pullback X ιX _ 1 (hcr k N 1)) =
      tdLineK k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ιZ).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N 1)))
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X j _ 1 hL) :=
    tdLineK_iso_g2tproj _ _ ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr hj.symm).app _ ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp j ιZ).app _).symm)
  simp only [tauPn, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe]
  rw [tauG0_finitePushforward (FRI.space_member k N) ιZ ιX j hj
    (CASE1B.height_genericPoint_space k N) (CIICLASS.T1N23.projectiveSpace_regStalks k N)
    haddZ haddX x, htd,
    (GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Interw.pow (interw_tdLineK j _ hL) (N + 1))]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.sections_SES_of_affine
statement:
theorem sections_SES_of_affine {A B C : X.Modules} {i : A ⟶ B} {g : B ⟶ C}
    (h : AbelianResolutionF15.SES i g) [A.IsQuasicoherent] [B.IsQuasicoherent]
    [C.IsQuasicoherent] (V : X.affineOpens) :
    Function.Injective (sectionMap i V.1) ∧ Function.Exact (sectionMap i V.1) (sectionMap g V.1) ∧
      Function.Surjective (sectionMap g V.1)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsAffine V.1.toScheme := V.2
  let e := V.1.toScheme.isoSpec
  let T : ShortComplex X.Modules := ShortComplex.mk i g h.zero
  let T1 := T.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.1.ι)
  let T2 := T1.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor e.inv)
  have hT2 : T2.ShortExact :=
    Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor_map_shortExact e.inv T1
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor_map_shortExact V.1.ι T h.exact)
  letI : T2.X₁.IsQuasicoherent := by
    change ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor e.inv).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.1.ι).obj A)).IsQuasicoherent
    infer_instance
  letI : T2.X₂.IsQuasicoherent := by
    change ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor e.inv).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.1.ι).obj B)).IsQuasicoherent
    infer_instance
  letI : T2.X₃.IsQuasicoherent := by
    change ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor e.inv).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.1.ι).obj C)).IsQuasicoherent
    infer_instance
  have hΓ := (moduleSpecΓ_map_shortExact_iff T2).mpr hT2
  have hW : V.1.ι ''ᵁ (e.inv ''ᵁ ⊤) = V.1 := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange, Scheme.Hom.opensRange_of_isIso,
      Scheme.Opens.ι_image_top]
  have h1 : Function.Injective (sectionMap i (V.1.ι ''ᵁ (e.inv ''ᵁ ⊤))) :=
    hΓ.moduleCat_injective_f
  have h2 : Function.Exact (sectionMap i (V.1.ι ''ᵁ (e.inv ''ᵁ ⊤)))
      (sectionMap g (V.1.ι ''ᵁ (e.inv ''ᵁ ⊤))) :=
    (ShortComplex.ShortExact.moduleCat_exact_iff_function_exact _).mp hΓ.exact
  have h3 : Function.Surjective (sectionMap g (V.1.ι ''ᵁ (e.inv ''ᵁ ⊤))) :=
    hΓ.moduleCat_surjective_g
  rw [hW] at h1 h2 h3
  exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.subsingleton_sections_of_le_exactLocus
statement:
theorem subsingleton_sections_of_le_exactLocus (G : X.Modules) (hG : IsCoherentLike X G)
    {W : X.Opens} (hW : W ≤ exactLocus G hG) : Subsingleton (G.val.obj (op W))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun a b => ?_⟩
  let T : TopCat.Sheaf Ab X := ⟨G.presheaf, G.isSheaf⟩
  refine TopCat.Presheaf.section_ext T W a b fun x hx => ?_
  haveI : Subsingleton (G.presheaf.stalk x) := (mem_exactLocus_iff G hG x).1 (hW hx)
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.exactLocus_eq_top_of_isZero
statement:

    exactLocus G hG = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.2 fun x _ => (mem_exactLocus_iff G hG x).2 ?_
  have h1 : IsZero G.presheaf := Functor.map_isZero (Scheme.Modules.toPresheaf X) h
  have hz : IsZero (G.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    Functor.map_isZero (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor Ab.{u} x) h1
  exact (AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton).1 hz

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.sectionExactOn_of_resolutionData
proof:
:= by
  intro V hV
  have qE : ∀ j, (C.K.E j).IsQuasicoherent := fun j => by
    haveI : (C.K.E j).IsFinitePresentation := (C.K.hE j).isFinitePresentation
    infer_instance
  have qZ : ∀ j, (R.Z j).IsQuasicoherent := fun j => by
    haveI : (R.Z j).IsFinitePresentation := R.hZ j
    infer_instance
  have hs : ∀ j, Function.Injective (sectionMap (R.ι j) V.1) ∧
      Function.Exact (sectionMap (R.ι j) V.1) (sectionMap (R.p j) V.1) ∧
      Function.Surjective (sectionMap (R.p j) V.1) := fun j => by
    haveI := qE j
    haveI := qZ j
    haveI := qZ (j + 1)
    exact sections_SES_of_affine (R.ses j) V
  have hd : ∀ j (y : (C.K.E (j + 1)).val.obj (op V.1)),
      sectionMap (C.K.d j) V.1 y = sectionMap (R.ι j) V.1 (sectionMap (R.p (j + 1)) V.1 y) :=
    fun j y => by rw [R.fac j, sectionMap_comp_apply]
  
  have hZ0 : Subsingleton ((R.Z 0).val.obj (op V.1)) := by
    haveI := subsingleton_sections_of_le_exactLocus G hG hV
    exact (sectionMap_injective_of_iso R.e V.1).subsingleton
  refine ⟨fun y => ?_, fun j y => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := ((hs 0).2.1 y).1 (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (hs 1).2.2 z
    exact ⟨x, by rw [hd, hz]⟩
  · rw [hd]
    constructor
    · intro h0
      have h1 : sectionMap (R.p (j + 1)) V.1 y = 0 :=
        (hs j).1 (by rw [h0, map_zero])
      obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := ((hs (j + 1)).2.1 y).1 h1
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (hs (j + 2)).2.2 z
      exact ⟨x, hd (j + 1) x⟩
    · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
      rw [hd (j + 1) x, ((hs (j + 1)).2.1 _).2 ⟨_, rfl⟩, map_zero]
