name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.exists_rankedResolution
statement:
theorem exists_rankedResolution {k : Type u} [Field k] {M : Scheme.{u}} [M.Over (Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian M] [LocallyOfFiniteType (M ↘ Spk k)]
    (hM : CIICLASS.ProjectiveIntegralK k M)
    (hreg : ∀ x : M, IsRegularLocalRing (M.presheaf.stalk x)) (G : M.Modules)
    (hG : IsCoherentLike M G) :
    ∃ C : RankedBundleComplex M,
      Nonempty (_root_.SingTau.ResolutionData (IsCoherentLike M) C.K G)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := _root_.SingTau.exists_resolves hM hreg G hG
  haveI : IsIntegral M := hM.1
  exact ⟨RankedBundleComplex.ofConnected K, hK⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.exact_of_rank_cokernel_image
statement:
theorem exact_of_rank_cokernel_image {A B D : Y.Modules} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ D)
    (w : f ≫ g = 0) {r : ℕ} (h₁ : HasConstantRank Y (cokernel f) r)
    (h₂ : HasConstantRank Y (Abelian.image g) r) : (ShortComplex.mk f g w).Exact
proof:
:= by
  let gb : cokernel f ⟶ D := cokernel.desc f g w
  have hgb : gb ≫ cokernel.π g = 0 := by
    rw [← cancel_epi (cokernel.π f), ← Category.assoc, cokernel.π_desc, cokernel.condition,
      comp_zero]
  let h : cokernel f ⟶ Abelian.image g := kernel.lift (cokernel.π g) gb hgb
  have hfac : cokernel.π f ≫ h = Abelian.factorThruImage g := by
    rw [← cancel_mono (Abelian.image.ι g), Abelian.image.fac, Category.assoc]
    change cokernel.π f ≫ h ≫ kernel.ι (cokernel.π g) = g
    rw [kernel.lift_ι, cokernel.π_desc]
  haveI : Epi (cokernel.π f ≫ h) := by rw [hfac]; infer_instance
  haveI : Epi h := epi_of_epi (cokernel.π f) h
  have hk : HasConstantRank Y (kernel h) (r - r) := hasConstantRank_kernel Y h₁ h₂ h
  rw [Nat.sub_self] at hk
  haveI : Mono h := Preadditive.mono_of_isZero_kernel h
    (Chow.M7.isZero_of_hasConstantRank_zero _ hk)
  haveI : Mono gb := by
    have : gb = h ≫ kernel.ι (cokernel.π g) := (kernel.lift_ι _ _ _).symm
    rw [this]; infer_instance
  exact (ShortComplex.exact_iff_mono_cokernel_desc _).2 this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.teleZ_zero
statement: theorem teleZ_zero : teleZ X ε 0 = 0
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.teleZClass_eq
statement:
theorem teleZClass_eq (i : ℕ) (h : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y (teleZ X ε i)) :
    teleZClass X ε i = k0ClassOf Y (teleZ X ε i) h
proof:
:= by
  rw [teleZClass, dif_pos h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.teleZClass_of_isZero
statement: theorem teleZClass_of_isZero (i : ℕ) (h : IsZero (teleZ X ε i)) : teleZClass X ε i = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hf : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y (teleZ X ε i) :=
    isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso Y h.isoZero.symm (zero_isFiniteLocallyFree Y)
  rw [teleZClass_eq X ε i hf, k0ClassOf_iso Y hf (zero_isFiniteLocallyFree Y) h.isoZero,
    k0ClassOf_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.tele_rank_kernel
statement:
theorem tele_rank_kernel (i : ℕ) (hi : i + 1 ≤ n) :
    HasConstantRank Y (kernel (ε i)) (c (i + 2))
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hasConstantRank_ker_im_coker (hX (i + 1)) (hX i) (ε i) (hsplit i hi)
    (by have := hnum i (by omega); omega)).1
  have h2 : c (i + 2) + c (i + 1) = e (i + 1) := hnum (i + 1) hi
  rwa [show e (i + 1) - c (i + 1) = c (i + 2) by omega] at h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.tele_rank_image
statement:
theorem tele_rank_image (i : ℕ) (hi : i + 1 ≤ n) :
    HasConstantRank Y (Abelian.image (ε i)) (c (i + 1))
proof:
:=
  (hasConstantRank_ker_im_coker (hX (i + 1)) (hX i) (ε i) (hsplit i hi)
    (by have := hnum i (by omega); omega)).2.1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.tele_rank_cokernel
statement:
theorem tele_rank_cokernel (i : ℕ) (hi : i + 1 ≤ n) :
    HasConstantRank Y (cokernel (ε i)) (c i)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hasConstantRank_ker_im_coker (hX (i + 1)) (hX i) (ε i) (hsplit i hi)
    (by have := hnum i (by omega); omega)).2.2
  have := hnum i (by omega)
  rwa [show e i - c (i + 1) = c i by omega] at h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.tele_rank_Z
statement:
theorem tele_rank_Z (i : ℕ) (hi0 : 1 ≤ i) (hi : i ≤ n + 1) :
    HasConstantRank Y (teleZ X ε i) (c i)
proof:
:= by
  match i, hi0, hi with
  | 1, _, _ =>
    have h := hnum 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
    rw [hc0, add_zero] at h
    exact h ▸ hX 0
  | i + 2, _, hi => exact tele_rank_kernel n e c hX hsplit hnum i (by omega)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.tele_isFLF_Z
statement: theorem tele_isFLF_Z (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ n + 1) : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y (teleZ X ε i)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos i with rfl | hpos
  · rw [teleZ_zero]; exact zero_isFiniteLocallyFree Y
  · exact (tele_rank_Z n e c hX hsplit hnum hc0 i hpos hi).isFiniteLocallyFree

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.tele_shortExact
statement:
theorem tele_shortExact (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ n) :
    ∃ (f : teleZ X ε (i + 1) ⟶ X i) (g : X i ⟶ teleZ X ε i) (w : f ≫ g = 0),
      (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  match i, hi with
  | 0, _ =>
    refine ⟨𝟙 (X 0), 0, comp_zero, ?_⟩
    refine ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk' ?_ (show Mono (𝟙 (X 0)) by infer_instance)
      (IsZero.epi (isZero_zero Y.Modules) _)
    exact (ShortComplex.exact_iff_epi _ rfl).2 (show Epi (𝟙 (X 0)) by infer_instance)
  | 1, hi =>
    have hcok : HasConstantRank Y (cokernel (ε 0)) (c 0) :=
      tele_rank_cokernel n e c hX hsplit hnum 0 hi
    rw [hc0] at hcok
    haveI : Epi (ε 0) := Preadditive.epi_of_isZero_cokernel _
      (Chow.M7.isZero_of_hasConstantRank_zero _ hcok)
    refine ⟨kernel.ι (ε 0), ε 0, kernel.condition _, ?_⟩
    exact ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk'
      (ShortComplex.exact_of_f_is_kernel _ (kernelIsKernel (ε 0)))
      (show Mono (kernel.ι (ε 0)) by infer_instance) (show Epi (ε 0) by infer_instance)
  | k + 2, hi =>
    let ℓ : X (k + 2) ⟶ kernel (ε k) := kernel.lift (ε k) (ε (k + 1)) (hεε k)
    have hex : (ShortComplex.mk (ε (k + 1)) (ε k) (hεε k)).Exact :=
      exact_of_rank_cokernel_image _ _ _
        (tele_rank_cokernel n e c hX hsplit hnum (k + 1) hi)
        (tele_rank_image n e c hX hsplit hnum k (by omega))
    haveI : Epi ℓ := (ShortComplex.exact_iff_epi_kernel_lift _).1 hex
    have hw : kernel.ι (ε (k + 1)) ≫ ℓ = 0 := by
      rw [← cancel_mono (kernel.ι (ε k)), Category.assoc, kernel.lift_ι, kernel.condition,
        zero_comp]
    refine ⟨kernel.ι (ε (k + 1)), ℓ, hw, ?_⟩
    refine ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk' ?_ (show Mono (kernel.ι (ε (k + 1))) by infer_instance)
      (show Epi ℓ by infer_instance)
    exact ShortComplex.exact_of_f_is_kernel _
      (isKernelOfComp (kernel.ι (ε k)) (ε (k + 1)) (kernelIsKernel (ε (k + 1))) hw
        (kernel.lift_ι _ _ _))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.altSum_eq_zero_of_locallySplit
statement:
theorem altSum_eq_zero_of_locallySplit :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (-1 : K0 Y) ^ i *
      k0ClassOf Y (X i) (hX i).isFiniteLocallyFree = 0
proof:
:= by
  have key := SchemeKTheory.ExactComplex.telescope (R := K0 Y)
    (fun i => k0ClassOf Y (X i) (hX i).isFiniteLocallyFree) (teleZClass X ε) (n + 1)
    fun i hi => by
      obtain ⟨f, g, w, hS⟩ := tele_shortExact n e c hX hεε hsplit hnum hc0 i (by omega)
      have h1 := tele_isFLF_Z n e c hX hsplit hnum hc0 (i + 1) (by omega)
      have h2 := tele_isFLF_Z n e c hX hsplit hnum hc0 i (by omega)
      rw [teleZClass_eq X ε _ h1, teleZClass_eq X ε _ h2]
      exact k0ClassOf_eq_add_of_shortExact Y h1 _ h2 w hS
  have hz0 : teleZClass X ε 0 = 0 :=
    teleZClass_of_isZero X ε 0 (by rw [teleZ_zero]; exact isZero_zero _)
  have hzn : teleZClass X ε (n + 1) = 0 := by
    apply teleZClass_of_isZero
    have h := tele_rank_Z n e c hX hsplit hnum hc0 (n + 1) (by omega) le_rfl
    rw [hcn] at h
    exact Chow.M7.isZero_of_hasConstantRank_zero _ h
  rw [hz0, hzn, mul_zero, add_zero] at key
  exact key

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.secResXiR_res
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simp only [secResXiR]
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.secResXiR_self
statement:
theorem secResXiR_self (L : X.Modules) {U : X.Opens} {ι : Type*} (s : ι → Γ(L, U)) :
    secResXiR L (le_refl U) s = s
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simp only [secResXiR]
  rw [show (homOfLE (le_refl U) : U ⟶ U) = 𝟙 U from Subsingleton.elim _ _, op_id,
    CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.res_res_xiR
statement:
theorem res_res_xiR (L : X.Modules) {U₁ U₂ U₃ : X.Opens} (h₁ : U₂ ≤ U₁) (h₂ : U₃ ≤ U₂)
    (x : Γ(L, U₁)) :
    L.presheaf.map (homOfLE h₂).op (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE h₁).op x) =
      L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h₂.trans h₁)).op x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.linearCombination_res_xiR
statement:
theorem linearCombination_res_xiR (L : X.Modules) {U : X.Opens} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (s : ι → Γ(L, U)) {V V' : X.Opens} (h : V' ≤ V) (hV : V ≤ U) (c : ι → Γ(X, V)) :
    L.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, V) (secResXiR L hV s) c) =
      Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, V') (secResXiR L (h.trans hV) s)
        (fun k => X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (c k))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.linearCombination_apply, Fintype.linearCombination_apply, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  rw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul]
  congr 1
  exact res_res_xiR L hV h (s k)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.IsSecFrame.mono
statement:
theorem IsSecFrame.mono (hs : IsSecFrame L U s) {U' : X.Opens} (h : U' ≤ U) :
    IsSecFrame L U' (secResXiR L h s)
proof:
:= by
  intro V hV
  rw [secResXiR_res]
  exact hs V (hV.trans h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.IsSecFrame.bijective_self
statement:
theorem IsSecFrame.bijective_self (hs : IsSecFrame L U s) :
    Function.Bijective (Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, U) s)
proof:
:= by
  have := hs U le_rfl
  rwa [secResXiR_self] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.IsSecFrame.equiv_apply
statement:
theorem IsSecFrame.equiv_apply (hs : IsSecFrame L U s) (V : X.Opens) (h : V ≤ U)
    (c : ι → Γ(X, V)) : hs.equiv V h c = ∑ i, c i • secResXiR L h s i
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.bijective_linearCombination_basisXiR
statement:
theorem bijective_linearCombination_basisXiR {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module R M] {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] (b : Module.Basis κ R M) :
    Function.Bijective (Fintype.linearCombination R b)
proof:
:= by
  have : (Fintype.linearCombination R b : (κ → R) → M) = b.equivFun.symm := by
    funext c
    rw [Module.Basis.equivFun_symm_apply, Fintype.linearCombination_apply]
  rw [this]
  exact b.equivFun.symm.bijective

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.linearCombination_finsuppMap_xiR
statement:
theorem linearCombination_finsuppMap_xiR (s : ι → Γ(L, U)) {V V' : X.Opens} (h : V' ≤ V) (hV : V ≤ U)
    (c : ι →₀ Γ(X, V)) :
    Finsupp.linearCombination Γ(X, V') (secResXiR L (h.trans hV) s)
        ((SchemeKTheory.finsuppFreePresheaf X ι).map (homOfLE h).op c) =
      L.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (Finsupp.linearCombination Γ(X, V) (secResXiR L hV s) c)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change Finsupp.linearCombination Γ(X, V') (secResXiR L (h.trans hV) s)
        ((SchemeKTheory.finsuppFreePresheaf X ι).restrictₛₗ (homOfLE h).op c) =
      (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
        (Finsupp.linearCombination Γ(X, V) (secResXiR L hV s) c)
  induction c using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => erw [map_zero, map_zero]
  | add a b ha hb => erw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, map_add]
  | single i a =>
    have hs : (Finsupp.single i a : ι →₀ Γ(X, V)) = a • ModuleCat.freeMk i := by
      exact (Finsupp.smul_single_one i a).symm
    rw [hs]
    erw [map_smulₛₗ, SchemeKTheory.finsuppFreePresheaf_restrictₛₗ_freeMk]
    erw [Finsupp.smul_single_one, Finsupp.smul_single_one, Finsupp.linearCombination_single,
      Finsupp.linearCombination_single]
    erw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul]
    congr 1
    simp only [secResXiR]
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.secFrameHom_app
statement:
theorem secFrameHom_app (s : ι → Γ(L, U)) (W : (Over U)ᵒᵖ) (x) :
    (secFrameHom L s).val.app W x =
      Finsupp.linearCombination Γ(X, W.unop.left) (secResXiR L (leOfHom W.unop.hom) s)
        (((SchemeKTheory.underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree X ι).hom.app (op W.unop.left)).hom x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.secFrameHom_bijective
statement:
theorem secFrameHom_bijective (hs : IsSecFrame L U s) (W : (Over U)ᵒᵖ) :
    Function.Bijective ((secFrameHom L s).val.app W)
proof:
:= by
  have he : Function.Bijective
      (((SchemeKTheory.underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree X ι).hom.app (op W.unop.left)).hom) :=
    ((PresheafOfModules.evaluation _ (op W.unop.left)).mapIso
      (SchemeKTheory.underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree X ι)).toLinearEquiv.bijective
  have hl : Function.Bijective (Finsupp.linearCombination Γ(X, W.unop.left)
      (secResXiR L (leOfHom W.unop.hom) s)) := by
    have h2 := hs W.unop.left (leOfHom W.unop.hom)
    have : (Finsupp.linearCombination Γ(X, W.unop.left) (secResXiR L (leOfHom W.unop.hom) s) :
        (ι →₀ Γ(X, W.unop.left)) → Γ(L, W.unop.left)) =
        Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, W.unop.left) (secResXiR L (leOfHom W.unop.hom) s) ∘
          (Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite Γ(X, W.unop.left) Γ(X, W.unop.left) ι) := by
      funext c
      rw [Function.comp_apply, ← Finsupp.linearCombination_eq_fintype_linearCombination_apply,
        LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    rw [this]
    exact h2.comp (Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite _ _ ι).bijective
  exact hl.comp he

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.hasConstantRank_of_isSecFrame
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_of_isSecFrame {L : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (U : X → X.Opens)
    (hU : ∀ x, x ∈ U x) (ι : X → Type u) [∀ x, Fintype (ι x)]
    (hcard : ∀ x, Fintype.card (ι x) = r) (s : ∀ x, ι x → Γ(L, U x))
    (hs : ∀ x, IsSecFrame L (U x) (s x)) : SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank X L r
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨{ I := X, X := U, coversTop := ?_
            generators := fun x ↦ SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.equivOfIso (secFrameIso (hs x))
              (SheafOfModules.free.generatingSections (ι x)) }, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Opens.coversTop_iff]
    change iSup U = ⊤
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro x _
    exact Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨x, hU x⟩
  · constructor
    intro i
    infer_instance
  · constructor
    intro i
    change ((SheafOfModules.free.generatingSections (ι i)).ofEpi
      (secFrameIso (hs i)).hom).IsFiniteType
    haveI : (SheafOfModules.free.generatingSections (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over (U i))
        (ι i)).IsFiniteType :=
      SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.IsFiniteType.mk (show Finite (ι i) from inferInstance)
    infer_instance
  · intro i
    change Nat.card (ι i) = r
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hcard]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.exists_isSecFrame
statement:
theorem exists_isSecFrame {L : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hL : SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank X L r)
    {O : X.Opens} {x : X} (hx : x ∈ O) :
    ∃ (V : X.affineOpens) (_ : x ∈ V.1) (_ : V.1 ≤ O) (ι : Type u) (_ : Fintype ι)
      (s : ι → Γ(L, V.1)), Fintype.card ι = r ∧ IsSecFrame L V.1 s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := exists_affineFrameCover_card hL
  have hxU : x ∈ ⨆ i, C.U i := by
    rw [C.covers.iSup_eq_top]
    trivial
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.1 hxU
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨V₀, hV₀, rfl⟩, hxV, hVle⟩ :=
    X.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open (show x ∈ ((C.U i ⊓ O : X.Opens) : Set X)
      from ⟨hi, hx⟩) (C.U i ⊓ O).isOpen
  let V : X.affineOpens := ⟨V₀, hV₀⟩
  replace hVle : V.1 ≤ C.U i ⊓ O := hVle
  have hVU : V.1 ≤ C.U i := hVle.trans inf_le_left
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  letI : Fintype (C.basisIndex i) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  refine ⟨V, hxV, hVle.trans inf_le_right, C.basisIndex i, inferInstance,
    fun k => C.restrictedSectionBasis i V.1 hVU k, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hC i]
  · intro V' hV'
    have : secResXiR L hV' (fun k => C.restrictedSectionBasis i V.1 hVU k) =
        ⇑(C.restrictedSectionBasis i V' (hV'.trans hVU)) := by
      funext k
      simp only [secResXiR]
      rw [← C.restrictedSectionBasis_eq_restrict i V.1 hVU k,
        ← C.restrictedSectionBasis_eq_restrict i V' (hV'.trans hVU) k]
      exact res_res_xiR L hVU hV' (C.sectionBasis i k)
    rw [this]
    exact bijective_linearCombination_basisXiR _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.res_injective_of_isSecFrame
statement:
theorem res_injective_of_isSecFrame [IsIntegral X] {L : X.Modules}
    (hfr : ∀ x : X, ∃ (V : X.Opens) (_ : x ∈ V) (ι : Type u) (_ : Fintype ι)
      (s : ι → Γ(L, V)), IsSecFrame L V s)
    {V V' : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ V') (hV : (V : Set X).Nonempty) :
    Function.Injective (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro x hx
  choose O hxO ι hι s hs using hfr
  let F : TopCat.Sheaf Ab X := ⟨L.presheaf, L.isSheaf⟩
  let A : V' → X.Opens := fun y => V' ⊓ O y.1
  refine F.eq_of_locally_eq' A V' (fun y => homOfLE inf_le_left) ?_ x 0 ?_
  · intro y hy
    exact Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hy, hxO y⟩
  · intro y
    change L.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op x = L.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op 0
    rw [map_zero]
    have hA : ((A y : X.Opens) : Set X).Nonempty := ⟨y.1, y.2, hxO y.1⟩
    have hAV : ((A y ⊓ V : X.Opens) : Set X).Nonempty :=
      nonempty_preirreducible_inter (A y).isOpen V.isOpen hA hV
    haveI : Nonempty (A y ⊓ V : X.Opens) := hAV.to_subtype
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (hs y.1 (A y) inf_le_right).2 (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op x)
    
    have hres : Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, A y ⊓ V)
        (secResXiR L (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right : A y ⊓ V ≤ O y.1) (s y.1))
        (fun k => X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : A y ⊓ V ≤ A y)).op (c k)) = 0 := by
      rw [← linearCombination_res_xiR L (s y.1) (inf_le_left : A y ⊓ V ≤ A y)
        (inf_le_right : A y ≤ O y.1), hc, res_res_xiR,
        show (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left : A y ⊓ V ≤ V') = (inf_le_right : A y ⊓ V ≤ V).trans h
          from rfl, ← res_res_xiR L h (inf_le_right : A y ⊓ V ≤ V), hx, map_zero]
    have hc0 : (fun k => X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : A y ⊓ V ≤ A y)).op (c k)) = 0 :=
      (hs y.1 (A y ⊓ V) (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right)).1 (by rw [hres, map_zero])
    have hc' : c = 0 := by
      funext k
      apply map_injective_of_isIntegral X (homOfLE (inf_le_left : A y ⊓ V ≤ A y))
      exact (congrFun hc0 k).trans (map_zero _).symm
    rw [← hc, hc', map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.res_injective_of_hasConstantRank
statement:
theorem res_injective_of_hasConstantRank [IsIntegral X] {L : X.Modules} {r : ℕ}
    (hL : SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank X L r) {V V' : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ V')
    (hV : (V : Set X).Nonempty) :
    Function.Injective (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op)
proof:
:= by
  refine res_injective_of_isSecFrame (fun x => ?_) h hV
  obtain ⟨V, hx, -, ι, hι, s, -, hs⟩ := exists_isSecFrame hL (O := ⊤) (x := x) trivial
  exact ⟨V.1, hx, ι, hι, s, hs⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.app_res_xiR
statement:
theorem app_res_xiR {P Q : X.Modules} (φ : P ⟶ Q) {U V : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) (x : Γ(P, U)) :
    φ.app V (P.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x) = Q.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (φ.app U x)
proof:
:= by
  have := φ.mapPresheaf.naturality (homOfLE h).op
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.mapPresheaf_app] at this
  exact congrArg (fun f => f x) this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.app_linearCombination_xiR
statement:
theorem app_linearCombination_xiR {P Q : X.Modules} (φ : P ⟶ Q) {U V : X.Opens} {ι : Type*}
    [Fintype ι] (s : ι → Γ(P, U)) (h : V ≤ U) (c : ι → Γ(X, V)) :
    φ.app V (Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, V) (secResXiR P h s) c) =
      Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, V) (secResXiR Q h (fun i => φ.app U (s i))) c
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.linearCombination_apply, Fintype.linearCombination_apply, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul]
  congr 1
  exact app_res_xiR φ h (s i)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.linearCombination_comb_xiR
statement:
theorem linearCombination_comb_xiR (L : X.Modules) {U V : X.Opens} {κ ι : Type*} [Fintype κ]
    [Fintype ι] (s : κ → Γ(L, U)) (B : Matrix κ ι Γ(X, U)) (h : V ≤ U) (c : ι → Γ(X, V)) :
    Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, V)
        (secResXiR L h (fun k => Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, U) s (fun a => B a k))) c =
      Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, V) (secResXiR L h s)
        ((B.map (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom) *ᵥ c)
proof:
:= by
  have hk : ∀ k, secResXiR L h (fun k => Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, U) s (fun a => B a k)) k =
      Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, V) (secResXiR L h s)
        (fun a => (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom (B a k)) := by
    intro k
    have := linearCombination_res_xiR L s h (le_refl U) (fun a => B a k)
    rw [secResXiR_self] at this
    simpa only [secResXiR] using this
  rw [Fintype.linearCombination_apply, Fintype.linearCombination_apply]
  simp_rw [hk, Fintype.linearCombination_apply, Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
  rw [← Finset.sum_smul]
  congr 1
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.map_apply]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => mul_comm _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.isSplitData_of_split
statement:
theorem isSplitData_of_split {M : Scheme.{u}} (C : DetIdealComplex M) (V : M.affineOpens)
    (c : ℕ → ℕ) {m n m₁ n₁ : ℕ → Type u} [∀ j, Fintype (m j)] [∀ j, Fintype (n j)]
    [∀ j, DecidableEq (m j)] [∀ j, DecidableEq (n j)]
    (D : ∀ j, Matrix (m j) (n j) Γ(M, V.1))
    (hD : ∀ j ≤ C.len, ∀ r ≤ C.rank j, (C.detIdeal j r).ideal V = GraphBundles.minorsIdeal r (D j))
    (hc : ∀ j ≤ C.len, c j ≤ C.rank j)
    (eR : ∀ j, m j ≃ Fin (c j) ⊕ m₁ j) (eC : ∀ j, n j ≃ Fin (c j) ⊕ n₁ j)
    (P P' : ∀ j, Matrix (m j) (m j) Γ(M, V.1)) (Q Q' : ∀ j, Matrix (n j) (n j) Γ(M, V.1))
    (hP : ∀ j, P' j * P j = 1) (hQ : ∀ j, Q j * Q' j = 1)
    (hsplit : ∀ j ≤ C.len,
      D j = P j * (GraphBundles.splitNormal (c j) (m₁ j) (n₁ j)).submatrix (eR j) (eC j) * Q j) :
    IsSplitData C V c
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  obtain ⟨htop, hbot⟩ := GraphBundles.minorsIdeal_of_split (eR j) (eC j) (P j) (P' j) (Q j)
    (Q' j) (hP j) (hQ j) (D j) (hsplit j hj)
  refine ⟨hc j hj, fun r hr => ?_, fun r hr hre => ?_⟩
  · rw [hD j hj r (hr.trans (hc j hj))]
    exact GraphBundles.minorsIdeal_eq_top_of_le htop hr
  · rw [hD j hj r hre]
    exact GraphBundles.minorsIdeal_eq_bot_of_lt hbot hr

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.isRegular_chartZero_coord
statement:
theorem isRegular_chartZero_coord (U' : (B0 (k := k) M).affineOpens)
    (hW : (U' : (B0 (k := k) M).Opens) ≤
      pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ ((chartOpen k 0 : (P1 k).affineOpens) : (P1 k).Opens)) :
    IsRegular (((pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE _ U' hW).hom
      (secEquiv k 0 Polynomial.X))
proof:
:= by
  set f := ((pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE _ U' hW).hom with hf
  have hflat : f.Flat := (pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).flat_appLE (chartOpen k 0).2 U'.2 hW
  letI := f.toAlgebra
  haveI : Module.Flat Γ(P1 k, (chartOpen k 0).1) Γ(B0 (k := k) M, U'.1) := hflat
  have hX : IsSMulRegular Γ(P1 k, (chartOpen k 0).1) (secEquiv k 0 Polynomial.X) := by
    intro a b hab
    apply (secEquiv k 0).symm.injective
    have h := congrArg (secEquiv k 0).symm hab
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, map_mul, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at h
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ Polynomial.X_ne_zero h
  have h2 := hX.of_flat (S := Γ(B0 (k := k) M, U'.1))
  apply (Commute.isRegular_iff (Commute.all _)).mpr
  intro a b hab
  exact h2 (by simpa [smul_eq_mul, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra] using hab)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.graphIdeal_ideal_eq_top_of_chartOne
statement:
theorem graphIdeal_ideal_eq_top_of_chartOne (C : DetIdealComplex M)
    (U' : (B0 (k := k) M).affineOpens) (V : M.affineOpens)
    (hV : (U' : (B0 (k := k) M).Opens) ≤ pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (V : M.Opens))
    (hW : (U' : (B0 (k := k) M).Opens) ≤
      pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ ((chartOpen k 1 : (P1 k).affineOpens) : (P1 k).Opens)) :
    (graphIdeal (k := k) C).ideal U' = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [graphIdeal_ideal_eq C U' V _ hV hW, ← Ideal.one_eq_top]
  refine Finset.prod_eq_one fun j _ => ?_
  rw [Ideal.one_eq_top, eq_top_iff]
  refine le_iSup_of_le (⟨0, Nat.succ_pos _⟩ : Fin (C.rank j + 1)) ?_
  have hinf : (infIdeal k).ideal (chartOpen k 1) = ⊤ := ker_pointInf_U1 k
  simp only [pow_zero, C.detIdeal_zero, Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_top,
    Pi.top_apply, Ideal.map_top, hinf, Ideal.top_pow, Ideal.one_eq_top, Ideal.top_mul, le_refl]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.graphIdeal_ideal_eq_span_of_chartZero
statement:
theorem graphIdeal_ideal_eq_span_of_chartZero (C : DetIdealComplex M)
    (U' : (B0 (k := k) M).affineOpens) (V : M.affineOpens)
    (hV : (U' : (B0 (k := k) M).Opens) ≤ pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (V : M.Opens))
    (hW : (U' : (B0 (k := k) M).Opens) ≤
      pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ ((chartOpen k 0 : (P1 k).affineOpens) : (P1 k).Opens))
    (c : ℕ → ℕ) (hc : IsSplitData C V c) :
    (graphIdeal (k := k) C).ideal U' = Ideal.span {(((pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE
      _ U' hW).hom (secEquiv k 0 Polynomial.X)) ^
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (C.len + 1), (C.rank j - c j)}
proof:
:= by
  set s := ((pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE _ U' hW).hom (secEquiv k 0 Polynomial.X)
  rw [graphIdeal_ideal_eq C U' V _ hV hW, ← Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, ← Ideal.prod_span_singleton]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
  have hj' : j ≤ C.len := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (Finset.mem_range.1 hj)
  obtain ⟨hcj, htop, hbot⟩ := hc j hj'
  have hterm : ∀ r : ℕ,
      ((zeroIdeal k).ideal (chartOpen k 0) ^ r * (infIdeal k).ideal (chartOpen k 0) ^ (C.rank j - r)).map
        ((pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE _ U' hW).hom = Ideal.span {s ^ (C.rank j - r)} := by
    intro r
    rw [Ideal.map_mul, Ideal.map_pow, Ideal.map_pow, zeroIdeal_map_chartZero U' hW,
      infIdeal_map_chartZero U' hW, Ideal.span_singleton_one, Ideal.top_pow, Ideal.top_mul,
      Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine iSup_le fun r => ?_
    rw [hterm r]
    by_cases hr : (r : ℕ) ≤ c j
    · rw [htop r hr, Ideal.map_top, Ideal.top_mul]
      exact Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton.mpr (pow_dvd_pow s (by omega))
    · rw [hbot r (by omega) (Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 r.2), Ideal.map_bot, Ideal.bot_mul]
      exact bot_le
  · refine le_iSup_of_le (⟨c j, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hcj⟩ : Fin (C.rank j + 1)) ?_
    rw [hterm, htop (c j) le_rfl, Ideal.map_top, Ideal.top_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.graphIdeal_locallyPrincipal
statement:
theorem graphIdeal_locallyPrincipal (C : DetIdealComplex M) (U : M.Opens) (hC : IsSplitOn C U) :
    ∀ y ∈ pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ U, ∃ U' : (B0 (k := k) M).affineOpens,
      y ∈ U'.1 ∧ U'.1 ≤ pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ U ∧
      ∃ g : Γ(B0 (k := k) M, U'.1), (graphIdeal (k := k) C).ideal U' = Ideal.span {g} ∧
        IsRegular g
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨V, hxV, hVU, c, hc⟩ := hC _ hy
  have hp : pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) y ∈ (chartOpen k 0).1 ⊔ (chartOpen k 1).1 := by
    rw [chartOpen_sup_eq_top]; trivial
  rcases (TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_sup.mp hp) with hp0 | hp1
  · obtain ⟨_, ⟨U', hU', rfl⟩, hyU', hU'le⟩ :=
      (B0 (k := k) M).isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open
        (show y ∈ pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 0).1 from ⟨hxV, hp0⟩)
        (pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 0).1).2
    have hV' : (⟨U', hU'⟩ : (B0 (k := k) M).affineOpens).1 ≤
        pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 := fun z hz => (hU'le hz).1
    have hW' : (⟨U', hU'⟩ : (B0 (k := k) M).affineOpens).1 ≤
        pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 0).1 := fun z hz => (hU'le hz).2
    refine ⟨⟨U', hU'⟩, hyU', fun z hz => hVU (hV' hz), _,
      graphIdeal_ideal_eq_span_of_chartZero C ⟨U', hU'⟩ V hV' hW' c hc, ?_⟩
    exact (isRegular_chartZero_coord ⟨U', hU'⟩ hW').pow _
  · obtain ⟨_, ⟨U', hU', rfl⟩, hyU', hU'le⟩ :=
      (B0 (k := k) M).isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open
        (show y ∈ pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 1).1 from ⟨hxV, hp1⟩)
        (pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 1).1).2
    have hV' : (⟨U', hU'⟩ : (B0 (k := k) M).affineOpens).1 ≤
        pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 := fun z hz => (hU'le hz).1
    have hW' : (⟨U', hU'⟩ : (B0 (k := k) M).affineOpens).1 ≤
        pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 1).1 := fun z hz => (hU'le hz).2
    refine ⟨⟨U', hU'⟩, hyU', fun z hz => hVU (hV' hz), 1, ?_, isRegular_one⟩
    rw [graphIdeal_ideal_eq_top_of_chartOne C ⟨U', hU'⟩ V hV' hW', Ideal.span_singleton_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.isIso_graphToBase_restrict
statement:
theorem isIso_graphToBase_restrict (C : DetIdealComplex M) (U : M.Opens) (hC : IsSplitOn C U) :
    IsIso (graphToBase (k := k) C ∣_ (pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ U))
proof:
:=
  isIso_toBase_restrict_of_locallyPrincipal _ _ _ (graphIdeal_locallyPrincipal C U hC)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.awayIso_hom_fst
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem awayIso_hom_fst (C : DetIdealComplex M) (U : M.Opens) (hC : IsSplitOn C U) :
    (awayIso (k := k) C U hC).hom ≫ pullback.fst _ _ ≫ U.ι =
      (awayOpen (k := k) C U).ι ≫ graphToBase (k := k) C ≫
        pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [awayIso, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, asIso_hom, Category.assoc]
  simp
  rw [← pullback.condition, pullbackRestrictIsoRestrict_inv_fst_assoc, morphismRestrict_ι_assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.awayIso_hom_snd
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem awayIso_hom_snd (C : DetIdealComplex M) (U : M.Opens) (hC : IsSplitOn C U) :
    (awayIso (k := k) C U hC).hom ≫ pullback.snd _ _ =
      (awayOpen (k := k) C U).ι ≫ graphToBase (k := k) C ≫
        pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [awayIso]
  rw [pullbackRestrictIsoRestrict_inv_fst_assoc, morphismRestrict_ι_assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AmbientIndependence.finitePushforward_id_g2tproj
statement:
theorem finitePushforward_id_g2tproj [IsLocallyNoetherian X] :
    finitePushforward (𝟙 X) = AddMonoidHom.id (G0 X)
proof:
:= by
  refine ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _ fun F => ?_
  change finitePushforward (𝟙 X) (g0ClassOf X F.1 F.2) = g0ClassOf X F.1 F.2
  rw [finitePushforward_classOf]
  exact g0ClassOf_iso X _ _ ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardId X).app F.1)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AmbientIndependence.computes_id_g2tproj
statement:
theorem computes_id_g2tproj [IsLocallyNoetherian X] :
    INDB.Computes (𝟙 X) (AddMonoidHom.id (G0 X))
proof:
:= by
  have h := INDB.computes_finitePushforward (𝟙 X)
  rwa [finitePushforward_id_g2tproj] at h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AmbientIndependence.computes_section
statement:
theorem computes_section [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X'] (q : X' ⟶ X)
    {φ : G0 X' →+ G0 X} (hφ : INDB.Computes q φ) (γ : X ⟶ X') [IsClosedImmersion γ]
    (hγ : γ ≫ q = 𝟙 X) (x : G0 X) : φ (finitePushforward γ x) = x
proof:
:= by
  have h := INDB.computes_comp_finite γ q hφ
  rw [hγ] at h
  have := INDB.computes_unique h computes_id_g2tproj
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun this x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AmbientIndependence.tauTwo_apply
statement:
theorem tauTwo_apply {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (ProjK k X)] (ι : X ⟶ M) [IsClosedImmersion ι] [ι.IsOver (Spk k)]
    (hadd : TauAdditivity hMK ι hM) (x : G0 X) :
    tauTwo hMK hM hreg L₁ L₂ hL₁ hL₂ e₁ e₂ ι hadd x =
      tdTwo (k := k) L₁ L₂ hL₁ hL₂ e₁ e₂ ι (tauG0 hMK ι hM hreg hadd x)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AmbientIndependence.interw_tdLineK_comp
statement:
theorem interw_tdLineK_comp (L : M.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank M L 1) [IsProper j] :
    GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Interw (totalPushOn (opsK k) j)
      (tdLineK k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ιX).obj L) (hasConstantRank_pullback X ιX L 1 hL))
      (tdLineK k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ιZ).obj L) (hasConstantRank_pullback Z ιZ L 1 hL))
proof:
:= by
  have hLZ := hasConstantRank_pullback Z ιZ L 1 hL
  rw [tdLineK_iso_g2tproj _ (hasConstantRank_pullback X j _ 1 hLZ)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr hj.symm).app L ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp j ιZ).app L).symm)]
  exact interw_tdLineK j _ hLZ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AmbientIndependence.interw_tdTwo
statement:
theorem interw_tdTwo [IsProper j] :
    GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Interw (totalPushOn (opsK k) j) (tdTwo (k := k) L₁ L₂ hL₁ hL₂ e₁ e₂ ιX)
      (tdTwo (k := k) L₁ L₂ hL₁ hL₂ e₁ e₂ ιZ)
proof:
:=
  ((interw_tdLineK_comp ιZ ιX j hj L₁ hL₁).pow e₁).mul
    ((interw_tdLineK_comp ιZ ιX j hj L₂ hL₂).pow e₂)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AmbientIndependence.tauTwo_finitePushforward
statement:
theorem tauTwo_finitePushforward [IsClosedImmersion j] (haddZ : TauAdditivity hMK ιZ hM)
    (haddX : TauAdditivity hMK ιX hM) (x : G0 X) :
    haveI : IsProper j
proof:
:= isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) j
    tauTwo hMK hM hreg L₁ L₂ hL₁ hL₂ e₁ e₂ ιZ haddZ (finitePushforward j x) =
      totalPushOn (opsK k) j (tauTwo hMK hM hreg L₁ L₂ hL₁ hL₂ e₁ e₂ ιX haddX x) := by
  haveI : IsProper j := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) j
  rw [tauTwo_apply, tauTwo_apply, tauG0_finitePushforward hMK ιZ ιX j hj hM hreg haddZ haddX x,
    interw_tdTwo L₁ L₂ hL₁ hL₂ e₁ e₂ ιZ ιX j hj]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AmbientIndependence.tauTwo_eq_of_section
statement:
theorem tauTwo_eq_of_section (hadd' : TauAdditivity hMK ι' hM)
    (hadd₁₂ : TauAdditivity hMK ι₁₂ hM) {φ : G0 X' →+ G0 X} (hφ : INDB.Computes q φ)
    (τ : G0 X →+ TotalChow X)
    (hIV : ∀ z : G0 X', haveI : IsProper q := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) q
      totalPushOn (opsK k) q (tauTwo hMK hM hreg L₁ L₂ hL₁ hL₂ e₁ e₂ ι' hadd' z) = τ (φ z))
    (x : G0 X) : tauTwo hMK hM hreg L₁ L₂ hL₁ hL₂ e₁ e₂ ι₁₂ hadd₁₂ x = τ x
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsProper q := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) q
  haveI : IsProper γ := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) γ
  haveI : IsProper (γ ≫ q) := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
  have hpush : ∀ v : TotalChow X,
      totalPushOn (opsK k) q (totalPushOn (opsK k) γ v) = v := by
    intro v
    rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← totalPushOn_comp, totalPushOn_congr (opsK k) hγ,
      totalPushOn_id, LinearMap.id_apply]
  rw [← hpush (tauTwo hMK hM hreg L₁ L₂ hL₁ hL₂ e₁ e₂ ι₁₂ hadd₁₂ x),
    ← tauTwo_finitePushforward hMK hM hreg L₁ L₂ hL₁ hL₂ e₁ e₂ ι' ι₁₂ γ hι hadd' hadd₁₂ x,
    hIV, computes_section q hφ γ hγ x]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AmbientIndependence.tauX_eq_tauPn
statement:
theorem tauX_eq_tauPn (hIV : ProjCovAll k) (hadd : TauAdditivityAmb k) (N : ℕ)
    (ι : X ⟶ space k N) [IsClosedImmersion ι] [ι.IsOver (Spk k)] :
    tauX X hadd = tauPn N ι (hadd.2 N ι)
proof:
:=
  tauPn_indep (chosenEmb (k := k) X) ι (hIV _ N).1 (hIV _ N).2 (hadd.1 _ N) _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AmbientIndependence.push_tauX
statement:
theorem push_tauX (hIV : ProjCovAll k) (hadd : TauAdditivityAmb k) (N : ℕ)
    (ι : X ⟶ space k N) [IsClosedImmersion ι] [ι.IsOver (Spk k)] (x : G0 X)
    (y : K0 (space k N)) (hy : k0ToG0 (space k N) y = finitePushforward ι x) :
    totalPushOn (opsK k) ι (tauX X hadd x) = tdPn k N (chPn k N y (fundPn k N))
proof:
:= by
  rw [tauX_eq_tauPn hIV hadd N ι]
  exact push_tauPn N ι _ x y hy

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AmbientIndependence.tauX_finitePushforward
statement:
theorem tauX_finitePushforward (hIV : ProjCovAll k) (hadd : TauAdditivityAmb k)
    {Z : Scheme.{u}} [Z.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Z ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian Z]
    [Fact (ProjK k Z)] (j : X ⟶ Z) [IsClosedImmersion j] [j.IsOver (Spk k)] (x : G0 X) :
    haveI : IsProper j
proof:
:= LocalizedLift.isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) j
    tauX Z hadd (finitePushforward j x) = totalPushOn (opsK k) j (tauX X hadd x) := by
  rw [tauX_eq_tauPn hIV hadd _ (j ≫ chosenEmb (k := k) Z)]
  exact tauPn_finitePushforward _ (chosenEmb (k := k) Z) (j ≫ chosenEmb (k := k) Z) j rfl _ _ x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.AmbientIndependence.tauX_covariant
statement:
theorem tauX_covariant (hIV : ProjCovAll k) (hadd : TauAdditivityAmb k)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} [Y.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian Y]
    [Fact (ProjK k Y)] (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsProper f] (φ : G0 X →+ G0 Y)
    (hφ : INDB.Computes f φ) (x : G0 X) :
    tauX Y hadd (φ x) = totalPushOn (opsK k) f (tauX X hadd x)
proof:
:= by
  set a := chosenDim (k := k) Y
  set n := chosenDim (k := k) X
  set ιY := chosenEmb (k := k) Y
  set jX := chosenEmb (k := k) X
  haveI := sec_lft (pr₁PP k a n) ιY
  haveI := sec_isNoetherian (pr₁PP k a n) ιY
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (pullback ιY (pr₁PP k a n))) := ⟨sec_projK (pr₁PP k a n) ιY⟩
  let κ : X ⟶ PP k a n := graphPP (f ≫ ιY) jX
  haveI hκ : IsClosedImmersion κ := graphPP_isClosedImmersion_snd (f ≫ ιY) jX
  let i : X ⟶ pullback ιY (pr₁PP k a n) := pullback.lift f κ (graphPP_fst (f ≫ ιY) jX).symm
  have hi₁ : i ≫ pullback.fst ιY (pr₁PP k a n) = f := pullback.lift_fst _ _ _
  have hi₂ : i ≫ pullback.snd ιY (pr₁PP k a n) = κ := pullback.lift_snd _ _ _
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion i := by
    haveI : IsClosedImmersion (i ≫ pullback.snd ιY (pr₁PP k a n)) := by rw [hi₂]; exact hκ
    exact IsClosedImmersion.of_comp i (pullback.snd ιY (pr₁PP k a n))
  haveI : i.IsOver (Spk k) :=
    ⟨by
      change i ≫ pullback.fst ιY (pr₁PP k a n) ≫ Y ↘ Spk k = X ↘ Spk k
      rw [← Category.assoc, hi₁, comp_over]⟩
  haveI : IsProper i := LocalizedLift.isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) i
  haveI : IsProper (pullback.fst ιY (pr₁PP k a n)) :=
    LocalizedLift.isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
  haveI : IsProper (i ≫ pullback.fst ιY (pr₁PP k a n)) :=
    LocalizedLift.isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
  obtain ⟨φq, hφq, hIVq⟩ := (hIV a n).1 ιY (pullback.snd ιY (pr₁PP k a n))
    (pullback.fst ιY (pr₁PP k a n)) (IsPullback.of_hasPullback _ _) (hadd.2 a ιY) (hadd.1 a n _)
  have hcomp : φq.comp (finitePushforward i) = φ := by
    have h := INDB.computes_comp_finite i _ hφq
    rw [hi₁] at h
    exact INDB.computes_unique h hφ
  have key := hIVq (finitePushforward i x)
  rw [tauPP, tauTwo_finitePushforward (pp_member k a n) (pp_height k a n) (pp_regStalks k a n)
    (ppL₁ k a n) (ppL₂ k a n) (hppL₁ k a n) (hppL₂ k a n) (a + 1) (n + 1) (pullback.snd ιY (pr₁PP k a n)) κ i hi₂
    (hadd.1 a n _) (hadd.1 a n κ) x, ← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← totalPushOn_comp,
    totalPushOn_congr (opsK k) hi₁] at key
  rw [← DFunLike.congr_fun hcomp x, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
  change tauPn a ιY (hadd.2 a ιY) _ = _
  rw [← key]
  have hX : tauPP κ (hadd.1 a n κ) x = tauPn n jX (hadd.2 n jX) x :=
    tauPn_eq_tauPP_snd' (f ≫ ιY) jX (hIV a n).2 (hadd.1 a n) (hadd.2 n jX) x
  change _ = totalPushOn (opsK k) f (tauPn n jX (hadd.2 n jX) x)
  rw [← hX]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.graphPsi_mulVec
statement:
theorem graphPsi_mulVec (μ l : A) (d : Matrix m n A) (v : n ⊕ m → A) :
    graphPsi μ l d *ᵥ v = μ • (v ∘ Sum.inr) - l • (d *ᵥ (v ∘ Sum.inl))
proof:
:= by
  rw [graphPsi, fromCols_mulVec, neg_mulVec, smul_mulVec, smul_mulVec, one_mulVec]
  abel

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.graphMat_mulVec_xiR
statement:
theorem graphMat_mulVec_xiR (μ l : A) (d : Matrix m n A) (a : n → A) :
    GraphBundles.graphMat μ l d *ᵥ a = Sum.elim (μ • a) (l • (d *ᵥ a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [GraphBundles.graphMat, fromRows_mulVec, smul_mulVec, smul_mulVec, one_mulVec]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.graphPsi_mul_graphMat
statement:
theorem graphPsi_mul_graphMat (μ l : A) (d : Matrix m n A) :
    graphPsi μ l d * GraphBundles.graphMat μ l d = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [graphPsi, GraphBundles.graphMat, fromCols_mul_fromRows]
  simp only [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul]
  rw [smul_neg, smul_smul, smul_smul, mul_comm μ l, neg_add_cancel]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.graphPsi_map
statement:
theorem graphPsi_map {A' : Type*} [CommRing A'] (f : A →+* A') (μ l : A) (d : Matrix m n A) :
    (graphPsi μ l d).map f = graphPsi (f μ) (f l) (d.map f)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rcases j with j | j <;>
    simp [graphPsi, Matrix.fromCols, Matrix.one_apply, apply_ite f]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.submatrix_mulVec_xiR
statement:
theorem submatrix_mulVec_xiR {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] (B : Matrix (n ⊕ m) κ A) (S₀ : n → n ⊕ m)
    (c : κ → A) : (B *ᵥ c) ∘ S₀ = B.submatrix S₀ id *ᵥ c
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.IsGraphSat.map
statement:
theorem map {A' : Type*} [CommRing A'] (h : IsGraphSat μ l d S₀ B) (f : A →+* A') :
    IsGraphSat (f μ) (f l) (d.map f) S₀ (B.map f) where
  rows_one
proof:
:= by
    rw [Matrix.submatrix_map, h.rows_one, Matrix.map_one f f.map_zero f.map_one]
  factor := by
    rw [← GraphBundles.graphMat_map, Matrix.submatrix_map, ← Matrix.map_mul, ← h.factor]
  psi := by
    rw [← graphPsi_map, ← Matrix.map_mul, h.psi, Matrix.map_zero _ f.map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.IsGraphSat.mulVec_injective
statement: theorem mulVec_injective (h : IsGraphSat μ l d S₀ B) : Function.Injective (B *ᵥ ·)
proof:
:= by
  intro c c' hc
  have h1 := congrArg (· ∘ S₀) hc
  simp only [submatrix_mulVec_xiR, h.rows_one, one_mulVec] at h1
  exact h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.IsGraphSat.psi_mulVec
statement: theorem psi_mulVec (h : IsGraphSat μ l d S₀ B) (c : n → A) : graphPsi μ l d *ᵥ (B *ᵥ c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mulVec_mulVec, h.psi, zero_mulVec]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.IsGraphSat.eq_of_psi
statement:
theorem eq_of_psi [IsDomain A] (h : IsGraphSat μ l d S₀ B) (hμ : μ ≠ 0) (v : n ⊕ m → A)
    (hv : graphPsi μ l d *ᵥ v = 0) : v = B *ᵥ (v ∘ S₀)
proof:
:= by
  rw [graphPsi_mulVec, sub_eq_zero] at hv
  have h1 : μ • v = GraphBundles.graphMat μ l d *ᵥ (v ∘ Sum.inl) := by
    rw [graphMat_mulVec_xiR]
    funext x
    rcases x with i | k
    · rfl
    · exact congrFun hv k
  have h2 : μ • v = B *ᵥ ((GraphBundles.graphMat μ l d).submatrix S₀ id *ᵥ (v ∘ Sum.inl)) := by
    rw [h1, mulVec_mulVec, ← h.factor]
  have h3 : (μ • v) ∘ S₀ = (GraphBundles.graphMat μ l d).submatrix S₀ id *ᵥ (v ∘ Sum.inl) := by
    rw [h2, submatrix_mulVec_xiR, h.rows_one, one_mulVec]
  have h4 : μ • v = μ • (B *ᵥ (v ∘ S₀)) := by
    calc μ • v = B *ᵥ ((GraphBundles.graphMat μ l d).submatrix S₀ id *ᵥ (v ∘ Sum.inl)) := h2
      _ = B *ᵥ ((μ • v) ∘ S₀) := by rw [h3]
      _ = μ • (B *ᵥ (v ∘ S₀)) := by rw [← mulVec_smul]; rfl
  funext x
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ hμ (congrFun h4 x)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.IsGraphSat.of_isSatSummand
statement:
theorem of_isSatSummand {Δ : A} (hΔ : IsSMulRegular A Δ)
    (hS : MinorsSat.IsSatSummand (GraphBundles.graphMat μ l d) S₀ Δ B) : IsGraphSat μ l d S₀ B where
  rows_one
proof:
:= hS.rows_one
  factor := hS.factor
  psi := by
    have hc : ∀ c : n → A, (graphPsi μ l d * B) *ᵥ c = 0 := by
      intro c
      rw [← mulVec_mulVec]
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hS.smul_mem (B *ᵥ c) ⟨c, rfl⟩
      simp only [mulVecLin_apply] at hw
      have hv : Δ • (graphPsi μ l d *ᵥ (B *ᵥ c)) = 0 := by
        rw [← mulVec_smul, ← hw, mulVec_mulVec, graphPsi_mul_graphMat, zero_mulVec]
      funext k
      apply hΔ
      change Δ • (graphPsi μ l d *ᵥ (B *ᵥ c)) k = Δ • (0 : A)
      rw [smul_zero]
      exact congrFun hv k
    ext i j
    have := congrFun (hc (Pi.single j 1)) i
    rw [mulVec_single_one] at this
    exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.comp_app_xiR
statement:
theorem comp_app_xiR {A B C : Y.Modules} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C) (U : Y.Opens) (x : Γ(A, U)) :
    (f ≫ g).app U x = g.app U (f.app U x)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.BiprodXiR.pr₁_in₁
statement:
theorem BiprodXiR.pr₁_in₁ (hb : BiprodXiR pr₁ pr₂ in₁ in₂) (U : Y.Opens) (x : Γ(P, U)) :
    pr₁.app U (in₁.app U x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← comp_app_xiR, hb.h11]; rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.BiprodXiR.pr₂_in₂
statement:
theorem BiprodXiR.pr₂_in₂ (hb : BiprodXiR pr₁ pr₂ in₁ in₂) (U : Y.Opens) (x : Γ(Q, U)) :
    pr₂.app U (in₂.app U x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← comp_app_xiR, hb.h22]; rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.BiprodXiR.pr₂_in₁
statement:
theorem BiprodXiR.pr₂_in₁ (hb : BiprodXiR pr₁ pr₂ in₁ in₂) (U : Y.Opens) (x : Γ(P, U)) :
    pr₂.app U (in₁.app U x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← comp_app_xiR, hb.h12]; rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.BiprodXiR.pr₁_in₂
statement:
theorem BiprodXiR.pr₁_in₂ (hb : BiprodXiR pr₁ pr₂ in₁ in₂) (U : Y.Opens) (x : Γ(Q, U)) :
    pr₁.app U (in₂.app U x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← comp_app_xiR, hb.h21]; rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.BiprodXiR.split
statement:
theorem BiprodXiR.split (hb : BiprodXiR pr₁ pr₂ in₁ in₂) (U : Y.Opens) (x : Γ(G, U)) :
    in₁.app U (pr₁.app U x) + in₂.app U (pr₂.app U x) = x
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (fun f : G ⟶ G => f.app U x) hb.hid
  exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.linearCombination_sum_xiR
statement:
theorem linearCombination_sum_xiR {M : Y.Modules} {V : Y.Opens} (f : n ⊕ m → Γ(M, V))
    (v : n ⊕ m → Γ(Y, V)) :
    Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, V) f v =
      Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, V) (f ∘ Sum.inl) (v ∘ Sum.inl) +
        Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, V) (f ∘ Sum.inr) (v ∘ Sum.inr)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Fintype.linearCombination_apply, Fintype.sum_sum_type, Function.comp_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.sumFrameXiR_lc
statement:
theorem sumFrameXiR_lc (sP : n → Γ(P, T)) (sQ : m → Γ(Q, T)) {V : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ T)
    (v : n ⊕ m → Γ(Y, V)) :
    Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, V) (secResXiR G h (sumFrameXiR in₁ in₂ sP sQ)) v =
      in₁.app V (Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, V) (secResXiR P h sP) (v ∘ Sum.inl)) +
        in₂.app V (Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, V) (secResXiR Q h sQ) (v ∘ Sum.inr))
proof:
:= by
  rw [app_linearCombination_xiR, app_linearCombination_xiR, linearCombination_sum_xiR]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.BiprodXiR.pr₁_lc
statement:
theorem BiprodXiR.pr₁_lc (hb : BiprodXiR pr₁ pr₂ in₁ in₂) (sP : n → Γ(P, T)) (sQ : m → Γ(Q, T))
    {V : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ T) (v : n ⊕ m → Γ(Y, V)) :
    pr₁.app V (Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, V) (secResXiR G h (sumFrameXiR in₁ in₂ sP sQ)) v) =
      Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, V) (secResXiR P h sP) (v ∘ Sum.inl)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sumFrameXiR_lc, map_add, hb.pr₁_in₁, hb.pr₁_in₂, add_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.BiprodXiR.pr₂_lc
statement:
theorem BiprodXiR.pr₂_lc (hb : BiprodXiR pr₁ pr₂ in₁ in₂) (sP : n → Γ(P, T)) (sQ : m → Γ(Q, T))
    {V : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ T) (v : n ⊕ m → Γ(Y, V)) :
    pr₂.app V (Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, V) (secResXiR G h (sumFrameXiR in₁ in₂ sP sQ)) v) =
      Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, V) (secResXiR Q h sQ) (v ∘ Sum.inr)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sumFrameXiR_lc, map_add, hb.pr₂_in₁, hb.pr₂_in₂, zero_add]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.BiprodXiR.isSecFrame_sumFrame
proof:
:= by
  intro V h
  constructor
  · intro v v' hv
    have h1 := congrArg (pr₁.app V) hv
    have h2 := congrArg (pr₂.app V) hv
    rw [hb.pr₁_lc, hb.pr₁_lc] at h1
    rw [hb.pr₂_lc, hb.pr₂_lc] at h2
    have e1 := (hP V h).1 h1
    have e2 := (hQ V h).1 h2
    funext x
    rcases x with i | k
    · exact congrFun e1 i
    · exact congrFun e2 k
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (hP V h).2 (pr₁.app V x)
    obtain ⟨b, hb'⟩ := (hQ V h).2 (pr₂.app V x)
    refine ⟨Sum.elim a b, ?_⟩
    rw [sumFrameXiR_lc]
    change in₁.app V (Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, V) (secResXiR P h sP) a) +
      in₂.app V (Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, V) (secResXiR Q h sQ) b) = x
    rw [ha, hb', hb.split]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.rXiR_rXiR
statement:
theorem rXiR_rXiR {U₁ U₂ U₃ : Y.Opens} (h₁ : U₂ ≤ U₁) (h₂ : U₃ ≤ U₂) (x : Γ(Y, U₁)) :
    rXiR h₂ (rXiR h₁ x) = rXiR (h₂.trans h₁) x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rXiR]
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.rXiR_self
statement: theorem rXiR_self {U : Y.Opens} (h : U ≤ U) (x : Γ(Y, U)) : rXiR h x = x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rXiR]
  rw [show (homOfLE h : U ⟶ U) = 𝟙 U from Subsingleton.elim _ _, op_id,
    CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.rXiR_comp_fun
statement:
theorem rXiR_comp_fun {U₁ U₂ U₃ : Y.Opens} (h₁ : U₂ ≤ U₁) (h₂ : U₃ ≤ U₂) {κ : Type*}
    (w : κ → Γ(Y, U₁)) : rXiR h₂ ∘ (rXiR h₁ ∘ w) = rXiR (h₂.trans h₁) ∘ w
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  exact rXiR_rXiR h₁ h₂ (w k)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.rXiR_mulVec
statement:
theorem rXiR_mulVec {U₁ U₂ U₃ : Y.Opens} (h₁ : U₂ ≤ U₁) (h₂ : U₃ ≤ U₂) (D : Matrix m n Γ(Y, U₁))
    (w : n → Γ(Y, U₂)) (k : m) :
    rXiR h₂ ((D.map (rXiR h₁) *ᵥ w) k) = (D.map (rXiR (h₂.trans h₁)) *ᵥ (rXiR h₂ ∘ w)) k
proof:
:= by
  rw [RingHom.map_mulVec, Matrix.map_map]
  congr 2
  funext a
  exact rXiR_rXiR h₁ h₂ a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.delta_lc_xiR
statement:
theorem delta_lc_xiR (δ : P ⟶ Q) (sP : n → Γ(P, T)) (sQ : m → Γ(Q, T)) (D : Matrix m n Γ(Y, T))
    (hD : ∀ i, δ.app T (sP i) = Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, T) sQ (fun k => D k i))
    {V : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ T) (a : n → Γ(Y, V)) :
    δ.app V (Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, V) (secResXiR P h sP) a) =
      Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, V) (secResXiR Q h sQ) (D.map (rXiR h) *ᵥ a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [app_linearCombination_xiR]
  have : (fun i => δ.app T (sP i)) =
      fun i => Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, T) sQ (fun k => D k i) := funext hD
  rw [this]
  exact linearCombination_comb_xiR Q sQ D h a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.BiprodXiR.graphDefect_lc
statement:
theorem BiprodXiR.graphDefect_lc (hb : BiprodXiR pr₁ pr₂ in₁ in₂) (sP : n → Γ(P, T))
    (sQ : m → Γ(Q, T)) (D : Matrix m n Γ(Y, T))
    (hD : ∀ i, δ.app T (sP i) = Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, T) sQ (fun k => D k i))
    {V : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ T) (v : n ⊕ m → Γ(Y, V)) :
    graphDefect pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V
        (Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, V) (secResXiR G h (sumFrameXiR in₁ in₂ sP sQ)) v) =
      Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, V ⊓ W₁)
        (secResXiR Q ((inf_le_left : V ⊓ W₁ ≤ V).trans h) sQ)
        (rXiR (inf_le_left : V ⊓ W₁ ≤ V) ∘ (v ∘ Sum.inr) -
          rXiR (inf_le_right : V ⊓ W₁ ≤ W₁) t •
            (D.map (rXiR ((inf_le_left : V ⊓ W₁ ≤ V).trans h)) *ᵥ
              (rXiR (inf_le_left : V ⊓ W₁ ≤ V) ∘ (v ∘ Sum.inl))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [graphDefect, hb.pr₂_lc, hb.pr₁_lc, linearCombination_res_xiR, linearCombination_res_xiR,
    delta_lc_xiR δ sP sQ D hD, map_sub, map_smul]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.BiprodXiR.genGraph_lc_iff
statement:
theorem BiprodXiR.genGraph_lc_iff (hb : BiprodXiR pr₁ pr₂ in₁ in₂)
    (hW₁ : (W₁ : Set Y).Nonempty) (sP : n → Γ(P, T)) (sQ : m → Γ(Q, T))
    (hQ : IsSecFrame Q T sQ) (D : Matrix m n Γ(Y, T))
    (hD : ∀ i, δ.app T (sP i) = Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, T) sQ (fun k => D k i))
    (μ l : Γ(Y, T)) (hμ : μ ≠ 0)
    (ht : rXiR (inf_le_right : T ⊓ W₁ ≤ W₁) t * rXiR (inf_le_left : T ⊓ W₁ ≤ T) μ =
      rXiR (inf_le_left : T ⊓ W₁ ≤ T) l)
    {V : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ T) (hV : (V : Set Y).Nonempty) (v : n ⊕ m → Γ(Y, V)) :
    GenGraph pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V
        (Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, V) (secResXiR G h (sumFrameXiR in₁ in₂ sP sQ)) v) ↔
      graphPsi (rXiR h μ) (rXiR h l) (D.map (rXiR h)) *ᵥ v = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [graphPsi_mulVec]
  constructor
  · intro hg
    obtain ⟨V'', hV'', hne, h0⟩ := hg hV
    rw [hb.graphDefect_lc δ W₁ t sP sQ D hD h v, linearCombination_res_xiR] at h0
    have hw := (hQ V'' (hV''.trans (inf_le_left.trans h))).1 (h0.trans (map_zero _).symm)
    haveI : Nonempty V'' := hne.to_subtype
    have hTW : V'' ≤ T ⊓ W₁ := hV''.trans (inf_le_inf_right W₁ h)
    funext k
    apply map_injective_of_isIntegral Y (homOfLE (hV''.trans inf_le_left : V'' ≤ V))
    have hwk := congrFun hw k
    have htk := congrArg (rXiR hTW) ht
    change rXiR (hV''.trans inf_le_left) _ = rXiR (hV''.trans inf_le_left) 0
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Function.comp_apply, map_sub, map_mul,
      rXiR_rXiR, rXiR_mulVec, rXiR_comp_fun, Pi.zero_apply, map_zero] at hwk htk ⊢
    linear_combination rXiR (hV''.trans (inf_le_left.trans h)) μ * hwk +
      (D.map (rXiR (hV''.trans (inf_le_left.trans h))) *ᵥ
        (rXiR (hV''.trans inf_le_left) ∘ (v ∘ Sum.inl))) k * htk
  · intro hpsi _
    have hne : ((V ⊓ W₁ : Y.Opens) : Set Y).Nonempty := nonempty_inter_xiS hV hW₁
    refine ⟨V ⊓ W₁, le_rfl, hne, ?_⟩
    rw [res_self_xiS, hb.graphDefect_lc δ W₁ t sP sQ D hD h v]
    haveI : Nonempty (V ⊓ W₁ : Y.Opens) := hne.to_subtype
    have hTW : V ⊓ W₁ ≤ T ⊓ W₁ := inf_le_inf_right W₁ h
    have hμ' : rXiR (inf_le_left.trans h : V ⊓ W₁ ≤ T) μ ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hμ
      apply map_injective_of_isIntegral Y (homOfLE (inf_le_left.trans h : V ⊓ W₁ ≤ T))
      exact h0.trans (map_zero _).symm
    have hw : (rXiR (inf_le_left : V ⊓ W₁ ≤ V) ∘ (v ∘ Sum.inr) -
          rXiR (inf_le_right : V ⊓ W₁ ≤ W₁) t •
            (D.map (rXiR ((inf_le_left : V ⊓ W₁ ≤ V).trans h)) *ᵥ
              (rXiR (inf_le_left : V ⊓ W₁ ≤ V) ∘ (v ∘ Sum.inl)))) = 0 := by
      funext k
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ hμ'
      have hk := congrArg (rXiR (inf_le_left : V ⊓ W₁ ≤ V)) (congrFun hpsi k)
      have htk := congrArg (rXiR hTW) ht
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Function.comp_apply, map_sub, map_mul,
        rXiR_rXiR, rXiR_mulVec, Pi.zero_apply, map_zero] at hk htk ⊢
      linear_combination hk -
        (D.map (rXiR (inf_le_left.trans h : V ⊓ W₁ ≤ T)) *ᵥ
          (rXiR (inf_le_left : V ⊓ W₁ ≤ V) ∘ (v ∘ Sum.inl))) k * htk
    rw [hw, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.XiChart.amb_eq
statement:
theorem XiChart.amb_eq {w : Y} (c : XiChart δ W₁ t w) (k : c.n) :
    c.amb in₁ in₂ k = Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, c.T)
      (secResXiR G (le_refl c.T) (sumFrameXiR in₁ in₂ c.sP c.sQ))
      (c.B.map (rXiR (le_refl c.T)) *ᵥ Pi.single k 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [secResXiR_self, mulVec_single_one]
  unfold XiChart.amb
  congr 1
  funext a
  exact (rXiR_self _ _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.XiChart.amb_genGraph
statement:
theorem XiChart.amb_genGraph (hb : BiprodXiR pr₁ pr₂ in₁ in₂) (hW₁ : (W₁ : Set Y).Nonempty)
    {w : Y} (c : XiChart δ W₁ t w) (k : c.n) :
    GenGraph pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t c.T (c.amb in₁ in₂ k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [c.amb_eq]
  have hT : (c.T : Set Y).Nonempty := ⟨w, c.mem⟩
  rw [hb.genGraph_lc_iff δ W₁ t hW₁ c.sP c.sQ c.hQ c.D c.hD c.μ c.l c.hμ c.ht le_rfl hT]
  exact (c.hB.map (rXiR (le_refl c.T))).psi_mulVec _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.genericGraphι_app_injective_xiR
statement:
theorem genericGraphι_app_injective_xiR (hW₁ : (W₁ : Set Y).Nonempty) (V : Y.Opens) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.subsingleton_sections_bot_xiR
statement:
theorem subsingleton_sections_bot_xiR (V : Y.Opens) (hV : ¬ (V : Set Y).Nonempty) :
    Subsingleton Γ(Y, V)
proof:
:= by
  have : V = ⊥ := by
    ext x
    simp only [Opens.coe_bot, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.XiChart.isSecFrame
statement:
theorem XiChart.isSecFrame (hb : BiprodXiR pr₁ pr₂ in₁ in₂) (hW₁ : (W₁ : Set Y).Nonempty)
    {w : Y} (c : XiChart δ W₁ t w) :
    IsSecFrame (genericGraphSheaf pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁) c.T (c.sec hb hW₁)
proof:
:= by
  intro V h
  have hfr := hb.isSecFrame_sumFrame c.hP c.hQ V h
  have key : ∀ a : c.n → Γ(Y, V), (genericGraphι pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁).app V
      (Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, V)
        (secResXiR (genericGraphSheaf pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁) h (c.sec hb hW₁)) a) =
      Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, V) (secResXiR G h (sumFrameXiR in₁ in₂ c.sP c.sQ))
        (c.B.map (rXiR h) *ᵥ a) := by
    intro a
    rw [app_linearCombination_xiR]
    exact linearCombination_comb_xiR G _ c.B h a
  constructor
  · intro a a' haa'
    have h1 := congrArg ((genericGraphι pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁).app V) haa'
    rw [key, key] at h1
    exact (c.hB.map (rXiR h)).mulVec_injective (hfr.1 h1)
  · intro x
    by_cases hV : (V : Set Y).Nonempty
    · obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hfr.2 ((genericGraphι pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁).app V x)
      have hg := genericGraphι_app_mem pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁ V x
      rw [← hv, hb.genGraph_lc_iff δ W₁ t hW₁ c.sP c.sQ c.hQ c.D c.hD c.μ c.l c.hμ c.ht h hV]
        at hg
      haveI : Nonempty V := hV.to_subtype
      have hμV : rXiR h c.μ ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        apply c.hμ
        apply map_injective_of_isIntegral Y (homOfLE h)
        exact h0.trans (map_zero _).symm
      have hv' := (c.hB.map (rXiR h)).eq_of_psi hμV v hg
      refine ⟨v ∘ c.S₀, genericGraphι_app_injective_xiR hW₁ V ?_⟩
      rw [key, ← hv', hv]
    · haveI := subsingleton_sections_bot_xiR V hV
      haveI : Subsingleton Γ(G, V) := hfr.2.subsingleton
      refine ⟨0, genericGraphι_app_injective_xiR hW₁ V (Subsingleton.elim _ _)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.hasConstantRank_genericGraphSheaf
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_genericGraphSheaf (hb : BiprodXiR pr₁ pr₂ in₁ in₂)
    (hW₁ : (W₁ : Set Y).Nonempty) {r : ℕ}
    (hc : ∀ w : Y, ∃ c : XiChart δ W₁ t w, Fintype.card c.n = r) :
    SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank Y (genericGraphSheaf pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁) r
proof:
:= by
  choose c hc using hc
  exact hasConstantRank_of_isSecFrame (fun w => (c w).T) (fun w => (c w).mem) (fun w => (c w).n)
    hc (fun w => (c w).sec hb hW₁) (fun w => (c w).isSecFrame hb hW₁)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.germXiR_rXiR
statement:
theorem germXiR_rXiR {T T' : Y.Opens} (h : T' ≤ T) {w : Y} (hw : w ∈ T') (a : Γ(Y, T)) :
    germXiR hw (rXiR h a) = germXiR (h hw) a
proof:
:=
  Y.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE h) w hw a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.exists_open_res_eq_zero_xiR
statement:
theorem exists_open_res_eq_zero_xiR {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {T : Y.Opens} {w : Y} (hw : w ∈ T)
    (e : ι → Γ(Y, T)) (he : ∀ i, germXiR hw (e i) = 0) :
    ∃ (T' : Y.Opens) (h : T' ≤ T), w ∈ T' ∧ ∀ i, rXiR h (e i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hU : ∀ i, ∃ (U : Y.Opens) (_ : w ∈ U) (hUT : U ≤ T), rXiR hUT (e i) = 0 := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨W, hwW, iU, iV, h⟩ := Y.presheaf.germ_eq w hw hw (e i) 0 (by rw [he i, map_zero])
    refine ⟨W, hwW, iU.le, ?_⟩
    change (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE iU.le).op).hom (e i) = 0
    rw [show homOfLE iU.le = iU from rfl]
    exact h.trans (map_zero _)
  choose U hwU hUT hU0 using hU
  classical
  let T' : Y.Opens := T ⊓ Finset.univ.inf U
  have hT' : T' ≤ T := inf_le_left
  have hTi : ∀ i, T' ≤ U i := fun i => inf_le_right.trans (Finset.inf_le (Finset.mem_univ i))
  refine ⟨T', hT', ⟨hw, ?_⟩, fun i => ?_⟩
  · exact Finset.inf_induction (p := fun W : Y.Opens => w ∈ W) trivial
      (fun a ha b hb => ⟨ha, hb⟩) fun i _ => hwU i
  · rw [show (hT' : T' ≤ T) = (hTi i).trans (hUT i) from rfl, ← rXiR_rXiR (hUT i) (hTi i), hU0 i,
      map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.exists_open_lift_xiR
statement:
theorem exists_open_lift_xiR {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {T : Y.Opens} {w : Y} (hw : w ∈ T)
    (g : ι → Y.presheaf.stalk w) :
    ∃ (T' : Y.Opens) (_ : T' ≤ T) (hw' : w ∈ T') (b : ι → Γ(Y, T')),
      ∀ i, germXiR hw' (b i) = g i
proof:
:= by
  have hU : ∀ i, ∃ (U : Y.Opens) (hwU : w ∈ U) (s : Γ(Y, U)), germXiR hwU s = g i := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨U, m, s, hs⟩ := Y.presheaf.exists_germ_eq (g i)
    exact ⟨U, m, s, hs⟩
  choose U hwU s hs using hU
  classical
  let T' : Y.Opens := T ⊓ Finset.univ.inf U
  have hTi : ∀ i, T' ≤ U i := fun i => inf_le_right.trans (Finset.inf_le (Finset.mem_univ i))
  have hw' : w ∈ T' := ⟨hw, Finset.inf_induction (p := fun W : Y.Opens => w ∈ W) trivial
      (fun a ha b hb => ⟨ha, hb⟩) fun i _ => hwU i⟩
  refine ⟨T', inf_le_left, hw', fun i => rXiR (hTi i) (s i), fun i => ?_⟩
  rw [germXiR_rXiR, hs i]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.matrix_eq_zero_of_entries_xiR
statement:
theorem matrix_eq_zero_of_entries_xiR {A : Type*} [Zero A] {κ ν : Type*} (M : Matrix κ ν A)
    (h : ∀ i j, M i j = 0) : M = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  exact h i j

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.exists_isGraphSat_of_stalk
statement:
theorem exists_isGraphSat_of_stalk {T : Y.Opens} {w : Y} (hw : w ∈ T) (μ l : Γ(Y, T))
    (D : Matrix m n Γ(Y, T)) (S₀ : n → n ⊕ m) (Bw : Matrix (n ⊕ m) n (Y.presheaf.stalk w))
    (h : IsGraphSat (germXiR hw μ) (germXiR hw l) (D.map (germXiR hw)) S₀ Bw) :
    ∃ (T' : Y.Opens) (hT' : T' ≤ T) (_ : w ∈ T') (B : Matrix (n ⊕ m) n Γ(Y, T')),
      IsGraphSat (rXiR hT' μ) (rXiR hT' l) (D.map (rXiR hT')) S₀ B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T₁, h₁, hw₁, b, hb⟩ := exists_open_lift_xiR hw (fun p : (n ⊕ m) × n => Bw p.1 p.2)
  let B₁ : Matrix (n ⊕ m) n Γ(Y, T₁) := Matrix.of fun a k => b (a, k)
  have hB₁ : B₁.map (germXiR hw₁) = Bw := by
    ext a k
    exact hb (a, k)
  
  let μ₁ := rXiR h₁ μ
  let l₁ := rXiR h₁ l
  let D₁ := D.map (rXiR h₁)
  have hg : ∀ x : Γ(Y, T), germXiR hw₁ (rXiR h₁ x) = germXiR hw x := fun x => germXiR_rXiR h₁ hw₁ x
  have hD₁ : D₁.map (germXiR hw₁) = D.map (germXiR hw) := by
    ext i j
    exact hg (D i j)
  have h' : IsGraphSat (germXiR hw₁ μ₁) (germXiR hw₁ l₁) (D₁.map (germXiR hw₁)) S₀
      (B₁.map (germXiR hw₁)) := by
    rw [hB₁, hD₁, hg, hg]
    exact h
  
  let E₁ : Matrix n n Γ(Y, T₁) := B₁.submatrix S₀ id - 1
  let E₂ : Matrix (n ⊕ m) n Γ(Y, T₁) := GraphBundles.graphMat μ₁ l₁ D₁ -
    B₁ * (GraphBundles.graphMat μ₁ l₁ D₁).submatrix S₀ id
  let E₃ : Matrix m n Γ(Y, T₁) := graphPsi μ₁ l₁ D₁ * B₁
  have hE₁ : E₁.map (germXiR hw₁) = 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.map_sub _ (map_sub _), Matrix.map_one _ (map_zero _) (map_one _),
      ← Matrix.submatrix_map, h'.rows_one, sub_self]
  have hE₂ : E₂.map (germXiR hw₁) = 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.map_sub _ (map_sub _), Matrix.map_mul, ← Matrix.submatrix_map,
      GraphBundles.graphMat_map, sub_eq_zero]
    exact h'.factor
  have hE₃ : E₃.map (germXiR hw₁) = 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.map_mul, graphPsi_map, h'.psi]
  obtain ⟨T₂, h₂, hw₂, hz⟩ := exists_open_res_eq_zero_xiR hw₁
    (fun p : (n × n) ⊕ ((n ⊕ m) × n) ⊕ (m × n) =>
      Sum.elim (fun q => E₁ q.1 q.2) (Sum.elim (fun q => E₂ q.1 q.2) (fun q => E₃ q.1 q.2)) p)
    (by
      rintro (q | q | q)
      · exact congrFun (congrFun hE₁ q.1) q.2
      · exact congrFun (congrFun hE₂ q.1) q.2
      · exact congrFun (congrFun hE₃ q.1) q.2)
  have hz₁ : E₁.map (rXiR h₂) = 0 := by ext i j; exact hz (Sum.inl (i, j))
  have hz₂ : E₂.map (rXiR h₂) = 0 := by ext i j; exact hz (Sum.inr (Sum.inl (i, j)))
  have hz₃ : E₃.map (rXiR h₂) = 0 := by ext i j; exact hz (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (i, j)))
  have hDD : D.map (rXiR (h₂.trans h₁)) = D₁.map (rXiR h₂) := by
    ext i j
    exact (rXiR_rXiR h₁ h₂ (D i j)).symm
  refine ⟨T₂, h₂.trans h₁, hw₂, B₁.map (rXiR h₂), ?_⟩
  rw [hDD, ← rXiR_rXiR h₁ h₂ μ, ← rXiR_rXiR h₁ h₂ l]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Matrix.map_sub _ (map_sub _), Matrix.map_one _ (map_zero _) (map_one _),
      ← Matrix.submatrix_map, sub_eq_zero] at hz₁
    exact hz₁
  · rw [Matrix.map_sub _ (map_sub _), Matrix.map_mul, ← Matrix.submatrix_map,
      GraphBundles.graphMat_map, sub_eq_zero] at hz₂
    exact hz₂
  · rw [Matrix.map_mul, graphPsi_map] at hz₃
    exact hz₃

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.biprodXiR_pullback
statement:
theorem biprodXiR_pullback {M W : Scheme.{u}} (π : W ⟶ M) (E F : M.Modules) :
    BiprodXiR ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map (biprod.fst : E ⊞ F ⟶ E))
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map (biprod.snd : E ⊞ F ⟶ F))
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map (biprod.inl : E ⟶ E ⊞ F))
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map (biprod.inr : F ⟶ E ⊞ F)) where
  h11
proof:
:= by rw [← Functor.map_comp, biprod.inl_fst, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
  h22 := by rw [← Functor.map_comp, biprod.inr_snd, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
  h12 := by rw [← Functor.map_comp, biprod.inl_snd, Functor.map_zero]
  h21 := by rw [← Functor.map_comp, biprod.inr_fst, Functor.map_zero]
  hid := by
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_add, biprod.total, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.hasConstantRank_xi_of_charts
statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.hasConstantRank_xi_of_charts (C : RankedBundleComplex M)
    [IsIntegral (C.graphModel (k := k))] (j : ℕ)
    (hc : ∀ w : C.graphModel (k := k),
      ∃ c : XiChart ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).map (C.dj j)) (xiOpen C)
        (xiCoord C) w, Fintype.card c.n = C.rank j) :
    SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank (C.graphModel (k := k)) (C.xi j) (C.rank j)
proof:
:=
  hasConstantRank_genericGraphSheaf (biprodXiR_pullback _ _ _) (xiOpen_nonempty C) hc

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegularComparison.Fibre.sectionExactOn_pullback_other
statement:
theorem sectionExactOn_pullback_other (F : X.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike X F)
    (C : RankedBundleComplex (RegDeform.M k n i))
    (R : _root_.SingTau.ResolutionData (IsCoherentLike (RegDeform.M k n i)) C.K
      (liftSheaf k n i F)) :
    (C.pullback (otherToTotal (space k n) i.ker)).SectionExactOn ⊤
proof:

theorem mem_range_zeroE_of_mem_W (y : component A J)
    (hy : componentToTotal A J y ∈ Set.range (subschemeTotalGlobalι A J)) :

proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hy
  set y' := inv (RG7.psiSigma J φk) y with hy'def
  have hpy : RG7.psiSigma J φk y' = y := by
    rw [hy'def, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, IsIso.inv_hom_id, id_apply_g2treg2]
  have hy' : RG7.iotaSigma J φk y' = componentToTotal A J y := by
    rw [← RG7.psiSigma_fac J φk, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hpy]
  obtain ⟨p, -, hp2⟩ := Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback w y' (hw.trans hy'.symm)
  refine ⟨(pullback.fst _ _ ≫ totalToClosedBase A J) p, ?_⟩
  have hz : RG7.zeroSigma J φk ((pullback.fst _ _ ≫ totalToClosedBase A J) p) = y' := by
    rw [RG7.zeroSigma, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply (pullback.fst _ _ ≫ _) (inv _),
      IsIso.hom_inv_id, id_apply_g2treg2, hp2]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegularComparison.Fibre.resolutionData_pullback_cartier
statement:
theorem resolutionData_pullback_cartier (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1)
    (hbund : ∀ E, IsFiniteLocallyFree Y E →
      Mono (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor Y (lineBundleDual Y L))
        (sigmaT (lineBundleDual Y L) (dualEval σ)) E))
    (C : RankedBundleComplex Y) {G : Y.Modules}
    (R : _root_.SingTau.ResolutionData (IsCoherentLike Y) C.K G)
    (hm : Mono (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor Y (lineBundleDual Y L))
        (sigmaT (lineBundleDual Y L) (dualEval σ)) G)) :
    Nonempty (_root_.SingTau.ResolutionData
      (IsCoherentLike (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme)
      (C.pullback (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι).K
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι).obj G))
proof:
:= by
  have hmZ : ∀ j, Mono (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor Y (lineBundleDual Y L))
      (sigmaT (lineBundleDual Y L) (dualEval σ)) (R.Z j)) := by
    intro j
    cases j with
    | zero => exact mono_ap_of_mono σ hL R.e.hom hm
    | succ j =>
      haveI := (R.ses j).mono
      exact mono_ap_of_mono σ hL (R.ι j) (hbund _ (C.K.hE j))
  refine ⟨{ Z := fun j => (Scheme.Modules.pullback (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι).obj
              (R.Z j)
            ι := fun j => (Scheme.Modules.pullback (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι).map
              (R.ι j)
            p := fun j => (Scheme.Modules.pullback (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι).map
              (R.p j)
            ses := fun j => cartier_ses σ hL (R.ses j) (R.hZ (j + 1))
              (C.K.hE j).isFinitePresentation (hmZ j)
            fac := fun j => by
              change (Scheme.Modules.pullback _).map (C.K.d j) = _
              rw [R.fac j, Functor.map_comp]
              rfl
            hZ := fun j => isCoherentLike_pullback _ (R.hZ j)
            e := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι).mapIso R.e }⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.exists_step_g2treg2
statement:
theorem exists_step_g2treg2 {j : ℕ} (hex : Function.Exact (d (j + 1)) (d j))
    (t : HStepG2treg2 P d j) :
    ∃ s' : P (j + 1) →ₗ[R] P (j + 1 + 1), ∀ y, d (j + 1) (s' y) = y - t.s (d j y)
proof:
:= by
  let φ : P (j + 1) →ₗ[R] P (j + 1) := LinearMap.id - t.s ∘ₗ d j
  have hφ : ∀ y, φ y ∈ LinearMap.range (d (j + 1)) := by
    intro y
    apply (hex (φ y)).1
    simp only [φ, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, map_sub, t.hs,
      sub_self]
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := Module.projective_lifting_property (d (j + 1)).rangeRestrict
    (LinearMap.codRestrict _ φ hφ) (LinearMap.surjective_rangeRestrict _)
  refine ⟨l, fun y => ?_⟩
  have := congrArg Subtype.val (LinearMap.congr_fun hl y)
  simpa [φ] using this
