name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.exists_matHomotopy_g2treg2
statement:
theorem exists_matHomotopy_g2treg2 (D : ∀ j, Matrix (n j) (n (j + 1)) R)
    (h0 : Function.Surjective (D 0).mulVecLin)
    (hex : ∀ j, Function.Exact (D (j + 1)).mulVecLin (D j).mulVecLin) :
    ∃ S : ∀ j, Matrix (n (j + 1)) (n j) R,
      D 0 * S 0 = 1 ∧ ∀ j, D (j + 1) * S (j + 1) + S j * D j = 1
proof:
:= by
  let d : ∀ j, (n (j + 1) → R) →ₗ[R] (n j → R) := fun j => (D j).mulVecLin
  let h := hseqG2treg2 (P := fun j => n j → R) (d := d) h0 hex
  refine ⟨fun j => LinearMap.toMatrix' (h j).s, ?_, fun j => ?_⟩
  · apply Matrix.toLin'.injective
    rw [Matrix.toLin'_mul, Matrix.toLin'_toMatrix', Matrix.toLin'_one, Matrix.toLin'_apply']
    exact LinearMap.ext fun x => hseqG2treg2_zero (P := fun j => n j → R) (d := d) h0 hex x
  · apply Matrix.toLin'.injective
    rw [map_add, Matrix.toLin'_mul, Matrix.toLin'_mul, Matrix.toLin'_toMatrix',
      Matrix.toLin'_toMatrix', Matrix.toLin'_one, Matrix.toLin'_apply', Matrix.toLin'_apply']
    refine LinearMap.ext fun y => ?_
    have := hseqG2treg2_succ (P := fun j => n j → R) (d := d) h0 hex j y
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply]
    change d (j + 1) ((h (j + 1)).s y) + (h j).s (d j y) = y
    rw [this, sub_add_cancel]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.mul_eq_zero_of_exact_g2treg2
statement:
theorem mul_eq_zero_of_exact_g2treg2 {a b c : Type u} [Fintype a] [Fintype b] [Fintype c]
    [DecidableEq a] [DecidableEq b] [DecidableEq c]
    (D₁ : Matrix b c R) (D₀ : Matrix a b R) (h : Function.Exact D₁.mulVecLin D₀.mulVecLin) :
    D₀ * D₁ = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.toLin'.injective
  rw [Matrix.toLin'_mul, map_zero, Matrix.toLin'_apply', Matrix.toLin'_apply']
  exact LinearMap.ext fun x => h.apply_apply_eq_zero x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.exact_of_matHomotopy_g2treg2
statement:
theorem exact_of_matHomotopy_g2treg2 {R' : Type*} [CommRing R']
    (D : ∀ j, Matrix (n j) (n (j + 1)) R') (S : ∀ j, Matrix (n (j + 1)) (n j) R')
    (hDD : ∀ j, D j * D (j + 1) = 0) (h0 : D 0 * S 0 = 1)
    (h : ∀ j, D (j + 1) * S (j + 1) + S j * D j = 1) :
    Function.Surjective (D 0).mulVecLin ∧
      ∀ j, Function.Exact (D (j + 1)).mulVecLin (D j).mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun v => ⟨S 0 *ᵥ v, ?_⟩, fun j y => ⟨fun hy => ⟨S (j + 1) *ᵥ y, ?_⟩, ?_⟩⟩
  · simp only [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, h0, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  · have hy' : D j *ᵥ y = 0 := hy
    have e := congrArg (fun M => M *ᵥ y) (h j)
    simp only [Matrix.add_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hy',
      Matrix.mulVec_zero, add_zero] at e
    simpa only [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply] using e
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
    simp only [Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hDD, Matrix.zero_mulVec]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.exact_map_of_exact_g2treg2
statement:
theorem exact_map_of_exact_g2treg2 {R' : Type*} [CommRing R'] (φ : R →+* R')
    (D : ∀ j, Matrix (n j) (n (j + 1)) R) (h0 : Function.Surjective (D 0).mulVecLin)
    (hex : ∀ j, Function.Exact (D (j + 1)).mulVecLin (D j).mulVecLin) :
    Function.Surjective ((D 0).map φ).mulVecLin ∧
      ∀ j, Function.Exact ((D (j + 1)).map φ).mulVecLin ((D j).map φ).mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS0, hS⟩ := exists_matHomotopy_g2treg2 n D h0 hex
  refine exact_of_matHomotopy_g2treg2 n (fun j => (D j).map φ) (fun j => (S j).map φ)
    (fun j => ?_) ?_ (fun j => ?_)
  · rw [← Matrix.map_mul, mul_eq_zero_of_exact_g2treg2 (D (j + 1)) (D j) (hex j), Matrix.map_zero _
      (map_zero φ)]
  · rw [← Matrix.map_mul, hS0, Matrix.map_one _ (map_zero φ) (map_one φ)]
  · rw [← Matrix.map_mul, ← Matrix.map_mul, ← Matrix.map_add _ (map_add φ), hS j,
      Matrix.map_one _ (map_zero φ) (map_one φ)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.lc_mulVec_g2treg2
statement:
theorem lc_mulVec_g2treg2 {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] (g : A →ₗ[R] B) (s : ι → A)
    (s' : κ → B) (D : Matrix κ ι R)
    (hD : ∀ i, g (s i) = Fintype.linearCombination R s' (fun k => D k i)) (c : ι → R) :
    g (Fintype.linearCombination R s c) = Fintype.linearCombination R s' (D *ᵥ c)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Fintype.linearCombination_apply, map_sum, map_smul, hD, Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul,
    Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Finset.sum_smul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [mul_comm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.exact_of_conj_g2treg2
statement:
theorem exact_of_conj_g2treg2 {P₀ P₁ P₂ Q₀ Q₁ Q₂ : Type*} [AddCommGroup P₀] [Module R P₀]
    [AddCommGroup P₁] [Module R P₁] [AddCommGroup P₂] [Module R P₂] [AddCommGroup Q₀]
    [Module R Q₀] [AddCommGroup Q₁] [Module R Q₁] [AddCommGroup Q₂] [Module R Q₂]
    (f : P₂ →ₗ[R] P₁) (g : P₁ →ₗ[R] P₀) (e₀ : Q₀ ≃ₗ[R] P₀) (e₁ : Q₁ ≃ₗ[R] P₁)
    (e₂ : Q₂ ≃ₗ[R] P₂)
    (h : Function.Exact (e₁.symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ f ∘ₗ e₂.toLinearMap)
      (e₀.symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ g ∘ₗ e₁.toLinearMap)) :
    Function.Exact f g
proof:
:= by
  have := exact_conj _ _ e₀.symm e₁.symm e₂.symm h
  have hf : e₁.symm.symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (e₁.symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ f ∘ₗ e₂.toLinearMap) ∘ₗ
      e₂.symm.toLinearMap = f := by
    ext x; simp
  have hg : e₀.symm.symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (e₀.symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ g ∘ₗ e₁.toLinearMap) ∘ₗ
      e₁.symm.toLinearMap = g := by
    ext x; simp
  rwa [hf, hg] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.surjective_of_conj_g2treg2
statement:
theorem surjective_of_conj_g2treg2 {P₀ P₁ Q₀ Q₁ : Type*} [AddCommGroup P₀] [Module R P₀]
    [AddCommGroup P₁] [Module R P₁] [AddCommGroup Q₀] [Module R Q₀] [AddCommGroup Q₁]
    [Module R Q₁] (f : P₁ →ₗ[R] P₀) (e₀ : Q₀ ≃ₗ[R] P₀) (e₁ : Q₁ ≃ₗ[R] P₁)
    (h : Function.Surjective (e₀.symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ f ∘ₗ e₁.toLinearMap)) :
    Function.Surjective f
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h (e₀.symm y)
  refine ⟨e₁ x, ?_⟩
  have := congrArg e₀ hx
  simpa using this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.equiv_self_apply_g2treg2
statement:
theorem equiv_self_apply_g2treg2 {L : X.Modules} {W : X.Opens} {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι]
    {s : ι → Γ(L, W)} (hs : IsSecFrame L W s) (c : ι → Γ(X, W)) :
    hs.equiv W le_rfl c = Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, W) s c
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsSecFrame.equiv_apply, secResXiR_self, Fintype.linearCombination_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.conj_eq_mulVecLin_g2treg2
statement:
theorem conj_eq_mulVecLin_g2treg2 {A B : X.Modules} (d : A ⟶ B) {W : X.Opens} {ι κ : Type u}
    [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] {s : ι → Γ(A, W)} {s' : κ → Γ(B, W)} (hs : IsSecFrame A W s)
    (hs' : IsSecFrame B W s') (D : Matrix κ ι Γ(X, W))
    (hD : ∀ i, sectionMap d W (s i) = Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, W) s' (fun k => D k i)) :
    (hs'.equiv W le_rfl).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ sectionMap d W ∘ₗ (hs.equiv W le_rfl).toLinearMap =
      D.mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun c => ?_
  have e1 : (hs.equiv W le_rfl) c = Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, W) s c :=
    equiv_self_apply_g2treg2 hs c
  have e2 := lc_mulVec_g2treg2 (sectionMap d W) s s' D hD c
  have e3 : (hs'.equiv W le_rfl) (D *ᵥ c) = Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, W) s' (D *ᵥ c) :=
    equiv_self_apply_g2treg2 hs' (D *ᵥ c)
  apply (hs'.equiv W le_rfl).injective
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
    Matrix.mulVecLin_apply]
  exact (congrArg (sectionMap d W) e1).trans (e2.trans e3.symm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.coordMat_spec_g2treg2
statement:
theorem coordMat_spec_g2treg2 {A B : X.Modules} (d : A ⟶ B) {W : X.Opens} {ι κ : Type u}
    [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] (s : ι → Γ(A, W)) {s' : κ → Γ(B, W)} (hs' : IsSecFrame B W s')
    (i : ι) :
    sectionMap d W (s i) = Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, W) s'
      (fun k => coordMat_g2treg2 d s hs' k i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← equiv_self_apply_g2treg2 hs']
  exact ((hs'.equiv W le_rfl).apply_symm_apply _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.pull_coord_g2treg2
statement:
theorem pull_coord_g2treg2 {E F : M.Modules} (d : E ⟶ F) {V : M.Opens} {W : N.Opens}
    (hW : W ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V) {ι κ : Type u} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] (s : ι → Γ(E, V))
    (s' : κ → Γ(F, V)) (D : Matrix κ ι Γ(M, V))
    (hD : ∀ i, sectionMap d V (s i) = Fintype.linearCombination Γ(M, V) s' (fun k => D k i))
    (i : ι) :
    sectionMap ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map d) W
        (secResXiR _ hW (pullSecXiR f E V s) i) =
      Fintype.linearCombination Γ(N, W) (secResXiR _ hW (pullSecXiR f F V s'))
        (fun k => pullRingHom_g2treg2 f hW (D k i))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := pullback_app_pullSecXiR f E V d s s' D hD i
  have h2 := linearCombination_res_xiR ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj F)
    (pullSecXiR f F V s') hW (le_refl _) (fun k => f.app V (D k i))
  rw [secResXiR_self] at h2
  have h3 := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map d).val
    (homOfLE hW).op (pullSecXiR f E V s i)
  refine h3.trans ?_
  refine (congrArg (fun z => ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj F).presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op z)
    h1).trans ?_
  exact h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.pullback_exact_on_g2treg2
statement:
theorem pullback_exact_on_g2treg2 (C : RankedBundleComplex M) (V : M.affineOpens)
    (s : ∀ j, ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j)) → Γ(C.K.E j, V.1))
    (hs : ∀ j, IsSecFrame (C.K.E j) V.1 (s j))
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (sectionMap (C.K.d 0) V.1))
    (hexV : ∀ j, Function.Exact (sectionMap (C.K.d (j + 1)) V.1) (sectionMap (C.K.d j) V.1))
    {W : N.Opens} (hW : W ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) :
    Function.Surjective (sectionMap ((C.pullback f).K.d 0) W) ∧
      ∀ j, Function.Exact (sectionMap ((C.pullback f).K.d (j + 1)) W)
        (sectionMap ((C.pullback f).K.d j) W)
proof:
:= by
  let n : ℕ → Type u := fun j => ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j))
  let D : ∀ j, Matrix (n j) (n (j + 1)) Γ(M, V.1) := fun j =>
    coordMat_g2treg2 (C.K.d j) (s (j + 1)) (hs j)
  have hD : ∀ j, ∀ i, sectionMap (C.K.d j) V.1 (s (j + 1) i) =
      Fintype.linearCombination Γ(M, V.1) (s j) (fun k => D j k i) := fun j i =>
    coordMat_spec_g2treg2 (C.K.d j) (s (j + 1)) (hs j) i
  have hconj : ∀ j, ((hs j).equiv V.1 le_rfl).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ sectionMap (C.K.d j) V.1 ∘ₗ
      ((hs (j + 1)).equiv V.1 le_rfl).toLinearMap = (D j).mulVecLin := fun j =>
    conj_eq_mulVecLin_g2treg2 (C.K.d j) (hs (j + 1)) (hs j) (D j) (hD j)
  have h0 : Function.Surjective (D 0).mulVecLin := by
    rw [← hconj 0]
    exact surjective_conj_ttw2 _ _ _ hsurj
  have hex : ∀ j, Function.Exact (D (j + 1)).mulVecLin (D j).mulVecLin := by
    intro j
    rw [← hconj j, ← hconj (j + 1)]
    exact exact_conj _ _ _ _ _ (hexV j)
  obtain ⟨h0', hex'⟩ := exact_map_of_exact_g2treg2 n (pullRingHom_g2treg2 f hW) D h0 hex
  
  let t : ∀ j, n j → Γ((C.pullback f).K.E j, W) := fun j =>
    secResXiR _ hW (pullSecXiR f (C.K.E j) V.1 (s j))
  have ht : ∀ j, IsSecFrame ((C.pullback f).K.E j) W (t j) := fun j =>
    (isSecFrame_pullback f (C.K.E j) V.1 (hs j)).mono hW
  have hconjW : ∀ j, ((ht j).equiv W le_rfl).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
      sectionMap ((C.pullback f).K.d j) W ∘ₗ ((ht (j + 1)).equiv W le_rfl).toLinearMap =
      ((D j).map (pullRingHom_g2treg2 f hW)).mulVecLin := fun j =>
    conj_eq_mulVecLin_g2treg2 ((C.pullback f).K.d j) (ht (j + 1)) (ht j) _
      (fun i => pull_coord_g2treg2 f (C.K.d j) hW (s (j + 1)) (s j) (D j) (hD j) i)
  refine ⟨surjective_of_conj_g2treg2 _ ((ht 0).equiv W le_rfl) ((ht (0 + 1)).equiv W le_rfl) ?_,
    fun j => exact_of_conj_g2treg2 _ _ ((ht j).equiv W le_rfl) ((ht (j + 1)).equiv W le_rfl)
      ((ht (j + 1 + 1)).equiv W le_rfl) ?_⟩
  · convert h0' using 2
    exact hconjW 0
  · convert hex' j using 2
    · exact hconjW (j + 1)
    · exact hconjW j
    · rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.sectionExactOn_pullback
statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.sectionExactOn_pullback (C : RankedBundleComplex M) {U : M.Opens}
    (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) : (C.pullback f).SectionExactOn (f ⁻¹ᵁ U)
proof:
:= by
  intro V' hV'
  have hloc : ∀ y : V'.1, ∃ r : Γ(N, V'.1), y.1 ∈ N.basicOpen r ∧ ∃ (V : M.affineOpens)
      (_ : V.1 ≤ U) (s : ∀ j, ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j)) → Γ(C.K.E j, V.1)),
      (∀ j, IsSecFrame (C.K.E j) V.1 (s j)) ∧ N.basicOpen r ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨V, hfyV, hVU, s, hs⟩ := C.exists_secFramesXiR (O := U) (x := f y.1) (hV' y.2)
    obtain ⟨r, hrO, hyr⟩ := V'.2.exists_basicOpen_le (V := f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) ⟨y.1, hfyV⟩ y.2
    exact ⟨r, hyr, V, hVU, s, hs, hrO⟩
  choose r hyr V hVU s hs hrV using hloc
  have hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range r) = ⊤ := by
    rw [← V'.2.self_le_iSup_basicOpen_iff]
    intro x hx
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨⟨r ⟨x, hx⟩, ⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩, hyr ⟨x, hx⟩⟩
  have key : ∀ y : V'.1,
      Function.Surjective (sectionMap ((C.pullback f).K.d 0) (N.basicOpen (r y))) ∧
      ∀ j, Function.Exact (sectionMap ((C.pullback f).K.d (j + 1)) (N.basicOpen (r y)))
        (sectionMap ((C.pullback f).K.d j) (N.basicOpen (r y))) := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨hs0, hex⟩ := hC (V y) (hVU y)
    exact pullback_exact_on_g2treg2 f C (V y) (s y) (hs y) hs0 hex (hrV y)
  haveI : ∀ j, ((C.pullback f).K.E j).IsFinitePresentation := fun j ↦
    ((C.pullback f).K.hE j).isFinitePresentation
  refine ⟨surjective_sectionMap_of_basicOpen V'.2 _ (Set.range r) hspan ?_, fun j ↦
    exact_sectionMap_of_basicOpen V'.2 _ _ (Set.range r) hspan ?_⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact (key y).1
  · rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact (key y).2 j

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.sectionExactOn_pullback_top_of_range
statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.sectionExactOn_pullback_top_of_range (C : RankedBundleComplex M)
    {U : M.Opens} (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) (hf : Set.range f ⊆ (U : Set M)) :
    (C.pullback f).SectionExactOn ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have h := C.sectionExactOn_pullback f hC
  have htop : f ⁻¹ᵁ U = ⊤ := by
    ext y
    simp only [TopologicalSpace.Opens.map_coe, Set.mem_preimage, SetLike.mem_coe,
      TopologicalSpace.Opens.coe_top, Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
    exact hf ⟨y, rfl⟩
  rwa [htop] at h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegularComparison.Generic.tauRaw_fibre_eq_two_retract
statement:
theorem tauRaw_fibre_eq_two_retract :
    tauRaw (k := k) (C.pullback g₀) ι₀ U₀ hC₀ hN₀ = tauRaw (k := k) (C.pullback g₁) ι₁ U₁ hC₁ hN₁
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsProper gX₀ := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) gX₀
  haveI : IsProper gX₁ := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) gX₁
  haveI : IsProper gX₂ := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) gX₂
  haveI : IsProper r := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) r
  have h := push_tauRaw_fibre_eq_two_canon C ι U hC hU hX p c hM g₀ ι₀ gX₀ hgX₀ U₀ hC₀ hX₀ hUU₀ s₀
    hfib₀ hN₀ g₁ ι₁ gX₁ hgX₁ U₁ hC₁ hX₁ hUU₁ s₁ hs₁ hN₁ g₂ ι₂ gX₂ hgX₂ U₂ hC₂ hX₂ hUU₂ s₂ hs₂ hN₂
    hker hgen₁ hgen₂
  rw [tauRaw_eq_zero_of_eq_top' (k := k) (C.pullback g₂) ι₂ U₂ hU₂ hC₂ hN₂, map_zero,
    add_zero] at h
  have h' := congrArg (totalPushOn (opsK k) r) h
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← totalPushOn_comp, ← totalPushOn_comp,
    totalPushOn_congr (opsK k) hr₀, totalPushOn_congr (opsK k) hr₁, totalPushOn_id] at h'
  exact h'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegularComparison.Generic.tauStd_fibre_eq_two_retract
statement:
theorem tauStd_fibre_eq_two_retract :
    tauStd h0K (C.pullback g₀) ι₀ U₀ hC₀ hN₀ = tauStd h1K (C.pullback g₁) ι₁ U₁ hC₁ hN₁
proof:
:= by
  letI := prodP1Over (k := k) (A := M)
  letI := blowupOver (k := k) (graphIdeal (k := k) (C).toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := prodP1_lft (k := k) (A := M)
  haveI := prodP1_isNoetherian (k := k) (A := M)
  haveI := blowup_locallyOfFiniteType
    (CIICLASS.projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod hMK 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
    (graphIdeal (k := k) (C).toDetIdealComplex) (graphIdeal_ne_bot (C).toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := blowup_isNoetherian
    (CIICLASS.projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod hMK 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
    (graphIdeal (k := k) (C).toDetIdealComplex) (graphIdeal_ne_bot (C).toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := (C).isIntegral_graphModel (k := k) hMK
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k ((C).graphModel (k := k))) :=
    ⟨projK_of_projectiveIntegralK (projectiveIntegralK_graphModel hMK (C).toDetIdealComplex)⟩
  haveI : (xiProj (k := k) (C)).IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨Category.assoc _ _ _⟩
  letI := prodP1Over (k := k) (A := N₀)
  letI := blowupOver (k := k) (graphIdeal (k := k) (C.pullback g₀).toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := prodP1_lft (k := k) (A := N₀)
  haveI := prodP1_isNoetherian (k := k) (A := N₀)
  haveI := blowup_locallyOfFiniteType
    (CIICLASS.projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod h0K 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
    (graphIdeal (k := k) (C.pullback g₀).toDetIdealComplex) (graphIdeal_ne_bot (C.pullback g₀).toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := blowup_isNoetherian
    (CIICLASS.projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod h0K 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
    (graphIdeal (k := k) (C.pullback g₀).toDetIdealComplex) (graphIdeal_ne_bot (C.pullback g₀).toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := (C.pullback g₀).isIntegral_graphModel (k := k) h0K
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k ((C.pullback g₀).graphModel (k := k))) :=
    ⟨projK_of_projectiveIntegralK (projectiveIntegralK_graphModel h0K (C.pullback g₀).toDetIdealComplex)⟩
  haveI : (xiProj (k := k) (C.pullback g₀)).IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨Category.assoc _ _ _⟩
  letI := prodP1Over (k := k) (A := N₁)
  letI := blowupOver (k := k) (graphIdeal (k := k) (C.pullback g₁).toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := prodP1_lft (k := k) (A := N₁)
  haveI := prodP1_isNoetherian (k := k) (A := N₁)
  haveI := blowup_locallyOfFiniteType
    (CIICLASS.projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod h1K 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
    (graphIdeal (k := k) (C.pullback g₁).toDetIdealComplex) (graphIdeal_ne_bot (C.pullback g₁).toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := blowup_isNoetherian
    (CIICLASS.projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod h1K 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
    (graphIdeal (k := k) (C.pullback g₁).toDetIdealComplex) (graphIdeal_ne_bot (C.pullback g₁).toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := (C.pullback g₁).isIntegral_graphModel (k := k) h1K
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k ((C.pullback g₁).graphModel (k := k))) :=
    ⟨projK_of_projectiveIntegralK (projectiveIntegralK_graphModel h1K (C.pullback g₁).toDetIdealComplex)⟩
  haveI : (xiProj (k := k) (C.pullback g₁)).IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨Category.assoc _ _ _⟩
  letI := prodP1Over (k := k) (A := N₂)
  letI := blowupOver (k := k) (graphIdeal (k := k) (C.pullback g₂).toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := prodP1_lft (k := k) (A := N₂)
  haveI := prodP1_isNoetherian (k := k) (A := N₂)
  haveI := blowup_locallyOfFiniteType
    (CIICLASS.projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod h2K 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
    (graphIdeal (k := k) (C.pullback g₂).toDetIdealComplex) (graphIdeal_ne_bot (C.pullback g₂).toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := blowup_isNoetherian
    (CIICLASS.projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod h2K 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
    (graphIdeal (k := k) (C.pullback g₂).toDetIdealComplex) (graphIdeal_ne_bot (C.pullback g₂).toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := (C.pullback g₂).isIntegral_graphModel (k := k) h2K
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k ((C.pullback g₂).graphModel (k := k))) :=
    ⟨projK_of_projectiveIntegralK (projectiveIntegralK_graphModel h2K (C.pullback g₂).toDetIdealComplex)⟩
  haveI : (xiProj (k := k) (C.pullback g₂)).IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨Category.assoc _ _ _⟩
  exact tauRaw_fibre_eq_two_retract C ι U hC hU hX p c hM g₀ ι₀ gX₀ hgX₀ U₀ hC₀ hX₀ hUU₀ s₀
    hfib₀ hN₀ g₁ ι₁ gX₁ hgX₁ U₁ hC₁ hX₁ hUU₁ s₁ hs₁ hN₁ g₂ ι₂ gX₂ hgX₂ U₂ hC₂ hX₂ hUU₂ s₂ hs₂
    hN₂ hU₂ r hr₀ hr₁ hker hgen₁ hgen₂

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegularComparison.Generic.exists_fibre_section
statement:
theorem exists_fibre_section {N' M' P Q : Scheme.{u}} (p : M' ⟶ P) (q : Q ⟶ P) [IsClosedImmersion q]
    (g : N' ⟶ M') (h : q.ker.comap p ≤ g.ker) : ∃ s : N' ⟶ Q, g ≫ p = s ≫ q
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion (pullback.fst p q) :=
    MorphismProperty.pullback_fst (P := @IsClosedImmersion) _ _ inferInstance
  have h' : (pullback.fst p q).ker ≤ g.ker := by
    rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_fst_of_isClosedImmersion]; exact h
  refine ⟨IsClosedImmersion.lift (pullback.fst p q) g h' ≫ pullback.snd p q, ?_⟩
  rw [Category.assoc, ← pullback.condition, ← Category.assoc, IsClosedImmersion.lift_fac]

proof:
:= by

  have h1 : (pencil N i hX).π ≫ (X ↘ Spk k) = ((pencil N i hX).E ↘ Spk k) :=
    CategoryTheory.comp_over (f := (pencil N i hX).π) (S := Spk k)
  rw [← h1, ← Category.assoc, (pencil N i hX).sπ, Category.id_comp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegularComparison.zsGate
statement:
theorem zsGate (h0 : (coheight (i (genericPoint X))).toNat ≠ 0) (x : K0 X)
    (ε : K0 (pencil N i hX).E)
    (hε : k0ToG0 (pencil N i hX).E ε = finitePushforward (pencil N i hX).s (k0ToG0 X x)) :
    totalPushOn (opsV4 k) (pencil N i hX).π
        (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) ε (fundClass k (W := (pencil N i hX).E))) =
      tauX k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) i x
proof:
:= by
  have hA := FRI.space_member k N
  have hAreg := CIICLASS.T1N23.projectiveSpace_regStalks k N
  have hZ := regularZA i hX
  haveI : IsIntegral i.ker.subscheme := integralZA i
  haveI : IsNoetherian (totalGlobal (space k N) i.ker) := total_isNoetherian (k := k) i.ker hA
  haveI : IsNoetherian (subschemeTotalGlobal (space k N) i.ker) := KG2B.isNoetherian_W i.ker hA
  let D := ARRKG2A.inputsOfKG2B i.ker hA hAreg hZ
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e, ARRKG2A.codim i.ker = e + 1 :=
    ⟨ARRKG2A.codim i.ker - 1, by have := codim_eq_coheightA i; omega⟩
  have hNr : HasConstantRank (ARRKG2A.Zs (space k N) i.ker) (ARRKG2A.Nsh i.ker) (e + 1) := by
    have := ARRKG2A.hNrank D
    rw [he] at this
    exact this
  obtain ⟨CNZ, hCNZ⟩ := exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hNr
  let M := zsModelXA i hA hAreg hX canonφA D e he CNZ hCNZ
  have hfact : ProjectiveIntegral k M.CX.scheme := by
    obtain ⟨hI, N', j, hj⟩ := (inferInstance : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k
      (concreteGeomXA i hA hAreg hX canonφA).E)).out
    haveI := hI
    haveI := hj
    exact ⟨CIICLASS.isIntegral_of_iso M.φ.symm, N', M.φ.inv ≫ j, inferInstance⟩
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k M.CX.scheme) := ⟨hfact⟩
  have hbridge := CIIMB.lambdaMinusOne_taut_eq_kosClassX M.CX
    (M.CX.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card M.hC (Nat.succ_pos _)) M.CX M.hN M.hE
    (M.CX.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card M.hC (Nat.succ_pos _))
  have hchow : ZSChowGates M (chEx k) :=
    CIIFZ.zsChowGates_of_chMul M (chEx k) (fun a b => CIIMB.chK_mul' (chEx k) a b)
  exact zeroSection_of_gates M (chEx k) hchow hbridge (injE_componentA i hA hAreg hX) x ε hε

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegularComparison.tauStd_zeroSection
statement:
theorem tauStd_zeroSection (h0 : (coheight (i (genericPoint X))).toNat ≠ 0)
    (C : RankedBundleComplex (pencil N i hX).E) (U : (pencil N i hX).E.Opens)
    (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) (hXU : ∀ y, y ∉ U → y ∈ Set.range (pencil N i hX).s) {n : ℕ}
    (hE : height (genericPoint (pencil N i hX).E) = n) (x : K0 X)
    (hx : k0ToG0 (pencil N i hX).E C.K.altSum =
      finitePushforward (pencil N i hX).s (k0ToG0 X x)) :
    haveI : Fact (ProjK k (pencil N i hX).E)
proof:
:= ⟨pencil_E_projK N i hX⟩
    haveI : Fact (ProjK k (pencil N i hX).Z) := (inferInstance : Fact (ProjK k X))
    haveI := pencil_s_isOver N i hX
    tauStd (pencil_E_member N i hX) C (pencil N i hX).s U hC hE =
      tauX k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) i x := by
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (pencil N i hX).E) := ⟨pencil_E_projK N i hX⟩
  haveI := pencil_s_isOver N i hX
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (pencil N i hX).Z) := (inferInstance : Fact (ProjK k X))
  haveI : ConnectedSpace (pencil N i hX).E := connectedSpace_of_isIntegral
  have hf : primeClassT2 (genericPoint (pencil N i hX).E) n hE =
      fundClass k (W := (pencil N i hX).E) := by rw [fundClass_eq k n hE]; rfl
  have hsπ : ∀ v, totalPushOn (opsK k) (pencil N i hX).π
      (totalPushOn (opsK k) (pencil N i hX).s v) = v := fun v => by
    rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← totalPushOn_comp (opsK k) (pencil N i hX).s (pencil N i hX).π,
      totalPushOn_congr (opsK k) (pencil N i hX).sπ, totalPushOn_id]
    rfl
  rw [← hsπ (tauStd _ C _ U hC hE), push_tauStd _ C _ U hC hXU hE,
    chK0T2_eq_chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k), hf]
  exact zsGate N i hX h0 x C.K.altSum hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegularComparison.push_tauG0_eq_push_tauX
statement:
theorem push_tauG0_eq_push_tauX (hadd : TauAdditivityPn N i) (x : K0 X) :
    totalPushOn (opsK k) i (tauG0 (FRI.space_member k N) i (CASE1B.height_genericPoint_space k N)
        (CIICLASS.T1N23.projectiveSpace_regStalks k N) hadd (k0ToG0 X x)) =
      totalPushOn (opsK k) i (tauX k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) i x)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : ConnectedSpace (space k N) := connectedSpace_of_isIntegral
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k (space k N)) := ⟨space_projectiveIntegral N⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (CIICLASS.T1N23.k0ToG0_bijective_of_projectiveIntegralK
    (FRI.space_member k N) (CIICLASS.T1N23.projectiveSpace_regStalks k N)).2
    (finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X x))
  have hf : primeClassT2 (genericPoint (space k N)) N (CASE1B.height_genericPoint_space k N) =
      fundClass k (W := space k N) := by
    rw [fundClass_eq k N (CASE1B.height_genericPoint_space k N)]; rfl
  rw [push_tauG0 _ i _ _ hadd _ y hy, chK0T2_eq_chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k), hf]
  exact caseII_ambient i (FRI.space_member k N) (CIICLASS.T1N23.projectiveSpace_regStalks k N)
    hX x y hy

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegularComparison.tauG0_k0ToG0_of_isIso
statement:
theorem tauG0_k0ToG0_of_isIso [IsIso i] (hadd : TauAdditivityPn N i) (x : K0 X) :
    tauG0 (FRI.space_member k N) i (CASE1B.height_genericPoint_space k N)
        (CIICLASS.T1N23.projectiveSpace_regStalks k N) hadd (k0ToG0 X x) =
      tauX k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) i x
proof:
:= by
  haveI := inv_isOver_g2treg N i
  have hinv : ∀ v, totalPushOn (opsK k) (inv i) (totalPushOn (opsK k) i v) = v := fun v => by
    rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← totalPushOn_comp (opsK k) i (inv i),
      totalPushOn_congr (opsK k) (IsIso.hom_inv_id i), totalPushOn_id]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LciComparisonBridge.kahler_iS
statement:
theorem kahler_iS :
    pullbackK0RingHom (iS i') (k0ClassOf _ (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (toSpec k (n + 1)))
        (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (toSpec k (n + 1)) (n + 1))) =
      pullbackK0RingHom i'
        (k0ClassOf _ (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (cover (Spk k ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase)
          (OMGC.cover_kahler_isFiniteLocallyFree (Spk k ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)
            (OMGB.coverKahlerBaseChange (Spk k ↘ Spk k) (n + 1))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [FIN.cover_kahlerClass, OMG.cotangent_classOf, ← pullbackK0RingHom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply]
  congr 1
  simp only [map_sub, map_nsmul, map_one, OMGC.twist_comparison_explicit]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LciComparisonBridge.conormal_class_iS
statement:
theorem conormal_class_iS (hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (conormalSheaf i'))
    (hN' : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (conormalSheaf (iS i'))) :
    k0ClassOf X (conormalSheaf (iS i')) hN' = k0ClassOf X (conormalSheaf i') hN
proof:
:= by
  have h : i' ≫ (cover (Spk k ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase = iS i' ≫ toSpec k (n + 1) :=
    (iS_toSpec i').symm
  have hv := G2C6.virtual_eq_of_smooth (cover (Spk k ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase (toSpec k (n + 1))
    (n + 1) (n + 1) i' (iS i') h hN hN'
    (OMGC.cover_kahler_isFiniteLocallyFree (Spk k ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)
      (OMGB.coverKahlerBaseChange (Spk k ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)))
    (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (toSpec k (n + 1)) (n + 1))
  rw [kahler_iS] at hv
  exact (sub_right_inj.mp hv).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LciComparisonBridge.tdLine_iso_g2pol4b
statement:
theorem tdLine_iso_g2pol4b [Infinite k] {W : Scheme.{u}} [W.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (W ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian W] [Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k W)]
    {L L' : W.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank W L 1) (hL' : HasConstantRank W L' 1) (e : L ≅ L') :
    tdLine k L hL = tdLine k L' hL'
proof:
:= by
  have h : K7.chernLineValOn (opsV4 k) W L hL = K7.chernLineValOn (opsV4 k) W L' hL' := by
    funext j
    change (if j = 0 then 1 else if j = 1 then totalCapOn (opsV4 k) L hL else 0) =
      (if j = 0 then 1 else if j = 1 then totalCapOn (opsV4 k) L' hL' else 0)
    rw [K3.cap_isoOn (opsV4 k) hL hL' ⟨e⟩]
  exact congrArg GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.tdFromChern h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LciComparisonBridge.tdLine_iS
statement:
theorem tdLine_iS :
    tdLine k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (iS i')).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k (n + 1) 1))
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X (iS i') _ 1 (CASE1C.hcr k (n + 1) 1)) =
      tdLine k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i').obj
          ((cover (Spk k ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X i' _ 1
          ((cover (Spk k ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e1⟩ := ProjectionCovariance.q0_twist_one_iso k (Spk k ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)
  exact tdLine_iso_g2pol4b _ _
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp i' (qS k (n + 1))).app _).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback i').mapIso e1)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LciComparisonBridge.tdInvN_iS
statement:
theorem tdInvN_iS {r : ℕ} (C : G2C.RegularCover i'.ker r)
    [Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k (cover (Spk k ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme)] :
    tdInvN k (closedPosV4 k) (iS i') = tdInvN k (closedPosV4 k) i'
proof:
:= by
  have hr := G2C.conormal_hasConstantRank_of_cover i' C
  have hr' := G2C.conormal_hasConstantRank_of_cover (iS i') (coverS i' C)
  rw [TOT.tdInvN_eq_tdInvDualTot (closedPosV4 k) (iS i') hr',
    TOT.tdInvN_eq_tdInvDualTot (closedPosV4 k) i' hr,
    ← TOD.tdTanInv_classOf _ hr'.isFiniteLocallyFree, ← TOD.tdTanInv_classOf _ hr.isFiniteLocallyFree,
    conormal_class_iS i' hr.isFiniteLocallyFree hr'.isFiniteLocallyFree]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LciComparisonBridge.tau_lci_tdTan
statement:
theorem tau_lci_tdTan [Infinite k] {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (ProjK k X)] [IsIntegral X] {n : ℕ}
    (i' : X ⟶ (cover (Spk k ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme) [IsClosedImmersion i'] [i'.IsOver (Spk k)]
    {r : ℕ} (C : G2C.RegularCover i'.ker r) (x : K0 X) :
    haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X)
proof:
:=
      ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_projK (Fact.out : ProjK k X)⟩
    (targetThree k).tau X (k0ToG0 X x) =
      TOD.tdTan k X (TOD.relCotangentVirtual k i' (G2C.conormal_isFiniteLocallyFree_of_cover i' C))
        (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) x (fundClass k (W := X))) := by
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X) := ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_projK (Fact.out : ProjK k X)⟩
  have hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X := ⟨inferInstance, (Fact.out : ProjK k X)⟩
  have hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k (Spk k) := ExamplesLCIProjective.yk_projectiveIntegralK k
  haveI := factCover (n := n + 1) k hY
  rw [LciComparison.tau_lci k (n + 1) (iS i') (coverS i' C) x,
    G2C.tdTan_relCotangentVirtual_lci k hX hY i' (G2C.conormal_hasConstantRank_of_cover i' C),
    tdLine_iS i', Module.End.mul_apply]
  congr 1
  unfold tauX
  rw [tdInvN_iS i' C]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LciComparisonBridge.tau_lci_tdTan_space
statement:
theorem tau_lci_tdTan_space [Infinite k] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X]
    [Fact (ProjK k X)] [IsIntegral X] [i.IsOver (Spk k)] {r : ℕ}
    (Cv : G2C.RegularCover i.ker r) (x : K0 X) :

proof:

    (targetThree k).tau X (k0ToG0 X x) =
      TOD.tdTan k X (TOD.relCotangentVirtual k (iC' i)
          (G2C.conormal_isFiniteLocallyFree_of_cover (iC' i) (coverC' i Cv)))
        (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) x (fundClass k (W := X))) :=
  tau_lci_tdTan k (iC' i) (coverC' i Cv) x

name: RRC.BaumFultonMacPherson_lci
statement:
theorem BaumFultonMacPherson_lci (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) {n : ℕ}
    (i : X ⟶ (cover (Spk k ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme) [IsClosedImmersion i] [i.IsOver (Spk k)]
    {r : ℕ} (C : G2C.RegularCover i.ker r) (x : K0 X) :
    (SingTau.targetThree k).tau X (k0ToG0 X x) =
      toddOfDual k hX (lciVirtualCotangent k i C) (ch k hX x (fundamentalClass k hX))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Fact (SingularTodd.ProjK k X) := ⟨SingularTodd.projK_of_projectiveIntegralK hX⟩
  haveI : IsIntegral X := hX.1

name: RRC.GrothendieckRiemannRochLci_point_eq_tau
statement:
theorem GrothendieckRiemannRochLci_point_eq_tau (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) {n : ℕ}
    (f : X ⟶ Spk k) [f.IsOver (Spk k)]
    (i : X ⟶ (cover (Spk k ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hi : i ≫ (cover (Spk k ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase = f)
    {r : ℕ} (C : G2C.RegularCover i.ker r) (x : K0 X) :
    ch k (ExamplesLCIProjective.yk_projectiveIntegralK k)
        (fShriek k hX (ExamplesLCIProjective.yk_projectiveIntegralK k)
          (ExamplesLCIProjective.yk_regStalks k) f x)
        (fundamentalClass k (ExamplesLCIProjective.yk_projectiveIntegralK k)) =
      pushforward k hX (ExamplesLCIProjective.yk_projectiveIntegralK k) f
        ((SingTau.targetThree k).tau X (k0ToG0 X x))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : i.IsOver (Spk k) := isOver_of_factorisation f i hi
  rw [BaumFultonMacPherson_lci hX i C x]
  exact GrothendieckRiemannRochLci hX (ExamplesLCIProjective.yk_projectiveIntegralK k)
    (ExamplesLCIProjective.yk_regStalks k) f i hi C x

name: RRC.BaumFultonMacPherson_lci_nodalCubic
statement:
theorem BaumFultonMacPherson_lci_nodalCubic (k : Type u) [Field k] [Infinite k] :
    ¬ RegStalks (Xc k) ∧ ∀ x : K0 (Xc k),
      (SingTau.targetThree k).tau (Xc k) (k0ToG0 (Xc k) x) =

proof:

  ⟨not_regStalks_X k, fun x =>
    BaumFultonMacPherson_lci (xc_projectiveIntegralK k) (iC k) (coverC k) x⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegularComparison.Generic.tauStd_generic_eq_tauStd_E
statement:
theorem tauStd_generic_eq_tauStd_E (h0 : (coheight (i (genericPoint X))).toNat ≠ 0)
    (F : X.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike X F) (C : RankedBundleComplex (pencil N i hX).M)
    (R : _root_.SingTau.ResolutionData (IsCoherentLike (pencil N i hX).M) C.K (liftSheaf k N i F))
    (hE : height (genericPoint (pencil N i hX).E) = N) :
    haveI : Fact (ProjK k (pencil N i hX).E)
proof:
:= ⟨pencil_E_projK N i hX⟩
    haveI : Fact (ProjK k (pencil N i hX).Z) := (inferInstance : Fact (ProjK k X))
    haveI := pencil_s_isOver N i hX
    tauStd (FRI.space_member k N) (C.pullback (pencil N i hX).j) i (openJ N i hX F hF)
        (sectionExactOn_openJ N i hX F hF C R) (CASE1B.height_genericPoint_space k N) =
      tauStd (pencil_E_member N i hX) (C.pullback (pencil N i hX).e) (pencil N i hX).s
        (openE N i hX F hF) (sectionExactOn_openE N i hX F hF C R) hE := by
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (pencil N i hX).E) := ⟨pencil_E_projK N i hX⟩
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (pencil N i hX).Z) := (inferInstance : Fact (ProjK k X))
  haveI := pencil_s_isOver N i hX
  have hJ := ker_ne_bot_of_rank N i h0
  haveI : IsIntegral (GlobalBlowup.blowup (space k N) i.ker) :=
    GlobalBlowup.isIntegral_blowup (space k N) i.ker hJ
  haveI hoc : IsClosedImmersion (otherToTotal (space k N) i.ker) :=
    InfinityOtherClosedImmersion.otherToTotal_isClosedImmersion _ _
  haveI : @IsClosedImmersion _ (pencil N i hX).M (otherToTotal (space k N) i.ker) := hoc
  haveI : @IsClosedImmersion _ (pencil N i hX).M (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k N) i.ker) :=
    (inferInstance : IsClosedImmersion (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k N) i.ker))
  haveI : @Scheme.Hom.IsOver (subschemeTotalGlobal (space k N) i.ker) (pencil N i hX).M
      (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k N) i.ker) (Spk k) _ _ := ⟨rfl⟩
  haveI : @Scheme.Hom.IsOver (space k N) (pencil N i hX).M (pencil N i hX).j (Spk k) _ _ :=
    PencilGeom.j_over _
  haveI : (pencil N i hX).e.IsOver (Spk k) := PencilGeom.e_over _
  haveI : @Scheme.Hom.IsOver (GlobalBlowup.blowup (space k N) i.ker) (pencil N i hX).M
      (otherToTotal (space k N) i.ker) (Spk k) _ _ := ⟨rfl⟩
  haveI : @IsClosedImmersion X (pencil N i hX).E (pencil N i hX).s := PencilGeom.s_ci _
  haveI : @Scheme.Hom.IsOver X (pencil N i hX).E (pencil N i hX).s (Spk k) _ _ :=
    pencil_s_isOver N i hX
  haveI := component_integral' k N i hX
  haveI : IsIntegral (pencil N i hX).M := (inferInstance : IsIntegral (M k N i))
  have hMK : ProjectiveIntegralK k (pencil N i hX).M := projectiveIntegralK_M k N i
  haveI hMf : Fact (ProjK k (pencil N i hX).M) := ⟨projK_of_projectiveIntegralK hMK⟩
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (subschemeTotalGlobal (space k N) i.ker)) :=
    ⟨projK_closed (projK_of_projectiveIntegralK hMK : ProjK k (totalGlobal (space k N) i.ker))
      (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k N) i.ker) rfl⟩
  have h2K : ProjectiveIntegralK k (GlobalBlowup.blowup (space k N) i.ker) :=
    projectiveIntegralK_of_closedImmersion hMK (otherToTotal (space k N) i.ker) rfl inferInstance
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (GlobalBlowup.blowup (space k N) i.ker)) :=
    ⟨projK_of_projectiveIntegralK h2K⟩
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (WP N i.ker)) :=
    ⟨projK_closed (Fact.out : ProjK k (GlobalBlowup.blowup (space k N) i.ker))
      (pullback.snd (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k N) i.ker) (otherToTotal (space k N) i.ker)) rfl⟩
  have hG := isCoherentLike_liftSheaf k N i F hF
  have hEP := height_E_P k N i hX (canonφA (k := k)) hJ
  obtain ⟨s₁, hs₁⟩ := exists_fibre_section (toP1Global (space k N) i.ker k (canonφA (k := k)))
    (pointInf k) (componentToTotal (space k N) i.ker)
    (by rw [comap_pointInf_ker]; exact inf_le_left)
  obtain ⟨s₂, hs₂⟩ := exists_fibre_section (toP1Global (space k N) i.ker k (canonφA (k := k)))
    (pointInf k) (otherToTotal (space k N) i.ker)
    (by rw [comap_pointInf_ker]; exact inf_le_right)
  have hU : ((exactLocus (liftSheaf k N i F) hG : (M k N i).Opens) : Set (M k N i)).Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨b⟩ : Nonempty (GlobalBlowup.blowup (space k N) i.ker) := inferInstance
    exact ⟨_, range_other_subset_exactLocus k N i F hF ⟨b, rfl⟩⟩
  exact tauStd_fibre_eq_two_retract C hMK (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k N) i.ker)
    (exactLocus (liftSheaf k N i F) hG) (sectionExactOn_of_resolutionData C R hG) hU
    (mem_range_of_not_mem_exactLocus _ hG (moduleSheafSupport_pushforward_subset _ _))
    (toP1Global (space k N) i.ker k (canonφA (k := k))) 1 (height_M k N i (canonφA (k := k)))
    (FRI.space_member k N) (pencil N i hX).j i (gX0 N i) (gX0_W N i) (openJ N i hX F hF)
    (sectionExactOn_openJ N i hX F hF C R) (mem_range_i_of_not_mem_openJ N i hX F hF)
    (fun _ hx => hx) _
    (fibre_isPullback_P1Global (space k N) i.ker k (canonφA (k := k)) 1).flip
    (CASE1B.height_genericPoint_space k N)
    (pencil_E_member N i hX) (pencil N i hX).e (pencil N i hX).s (gX1 N i) (gX1_W N i)
    (openE N i hX F hF) (sectionExactOn_openE N i hX F hF C R)
    (mem_range_s_of_not_mem_openE N i hX F hF) (fun _ hx => hx) s₁ hs₁ hE
    h2K (otherToTotal (space k N) i.ker)
    (pullback.snd (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k N) i.ker) (otherToTotal (space k N) i.ker))
    (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k N) i.ker) (otherToTotal (space k N) i.ker))
    pullback.condition ⊤ (sectionExactOn_pullback_other k N i F hF C R)
    (fun x hx => absurd trivial hx) (fun x _ => range_other_subset_exactLocus k N i F hF ⟨x, rfl⟩)
    s₂ hs₂ hEP.2 rfl (rW N i) (gX0_r N i) (gX1_r N i)
    (comap_pointInf_ker k (space k N) i.ker (canonφA (k := k)))
    (component_generic_not_mem_other (space k N) i.ker)
    (other_generic_not_mem_component (space k N) i.ker hJ)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegularComparison.Generic.regSpecialization
statement: theorem regSpecialization (hadd : TauAdditivityPn N i) : RegSpecialization N i hX hadd
proof:
:= by
  refine regSpecialization_of_tauEq N i hX hadd ?_
  intro h0 F hF C R
  have hJ := ker_ne_bot_of_rank N i h0
  have hE : height (genericPoint (pencil N i hX).E) = N := by
    haveI := component_integral' k N i hX
    exact (height_E_P k N i hX (canonφA (k := k)) hJ).1
  exact ⟨N, hE, (tauG0_eq_tauStd_generic N i hX hadd F hF C R).trans
    (tauStd_generic_eq_tauStd_E N i hX h0 F hF C R hE)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegularComparison.Generic.regular_tauPn_of_tauAdditivity
statement:
theorem regular_tauPn_of_tauAdditivity {k : Type u} [Field k] [Infinite k] (N : ℕ)
    [Fact (ProjK k (space k N))] {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (ProjK k X)] [IsIntegral X]
    (hreg : CIICLASS.T1N23.RegStalks X) (i : X ⟶ space k N) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [i.IsOver (Spk k)] (hadd : TauAdditivityPn N i) (x : K0 X) :
    haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X)
proof:
:=
      ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_projK (Fact.out : ProjK k X)⟩
    tauPn N i hadd (k0ToG0 X x) =
      ((tdLine k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N 1))
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1 (hcr k N 1))) ^ (N + 1))
        (tauX k (closedPosV4 k) (chExact_closedPosV4 k) i x) := by
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X) := ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_projK (Fact.out : ProjK k X)⟩
  exact regular_tauPn N hreg i hadd (regSpecialization N i hreg hadd) x

statement:
theorem tauPn_eq_tauPP_fst (hIV : ProjCovFst k a b) (hadd : TauAdditivityPP k a b)
    (haddι : TauAdditivityPn a ι) (x : G0 X) :
    tauPP (graphPP ι ι') (hadd (graphPP ι ι')) x = tauPn a ι haddι x
proof:
:= by
  haveI := sec_lft (pr₁PP k a b) ι
  haveI := sec_isNoetherian (pr₁PP k a b) ι
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (pullback ι (pr₁PP k a b))) := ⟨sec_projK (pr₁PP k a b) ι⟩
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hφIV⟩ := hIV ι (pullback.snd ι (pr₁PP k a b)) (pullback.fst ι (pr₁PP k a b))
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback _ _) haddι (hadd _)
  exact tauTwo_eq_of_section (pp_member k a b) (pp_height k a b) (pp_regStalks k a b)
    (ppL₁ k a b) (ppL₂ k a b) (hppL₁ k a b) (hppL₂ k a b) (a + 1) (b + 1)
    (pullback.snd ι (pr₁PP k a b)) (pullback.fst ι (pr₁PP k a b))
    (secPP (pr₁PP k a b) ι (graphPP ι ι') (graphPP_fst ι ι'))
    (secPP_fst _ _ _ _) (graphPP ι ι') (secPP_snd _ _ _ _) (hadd _) (hadd _) hφ _ hφIV x

    tauPP (graphPP ι ι') (hadd (graphPP ι ι')) x = tauPn b ι' haddι' x
proof:

  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (pullback ι' (pr₂PP k a b))) := ⟨sec_projK (pr₂PP k a b) ι'⟩
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hφIV⟩ := hIV ι' (pullback.snd ι' (pr₂PP k a b)) (pullback.fst ι' (pr₂PP k a b))
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback _ _) haddι' (hadd _)
  exact tauTwo_eq_of_section (pp_member k a b) (pp_height k a b) (pp_regStalks k a b)
    (ppL₁ k a b) (ppL₂ k a b) (hppL₁ k a b) (hppL₂ k a b) (a + 1) (b + 1)
    (pullback.snd ι' (pr₂PP k a b)) (pullback.fst ι' (pr₂PP k a b))
    (secPP (pr₂PP k a b) ι' (graphPP ι ι') (graphPP_snd ι ι'))
    (secPP_fst _ _ _ _) (graphPP ι ι') (secPP_snd _ _ _ _) (hadd _) (hadd _) hφ _ hφIV x

statement:
theorem tauPn_eq_tauPP_snd' (hIV : ProjCovSnd k a b) (hadd : TauAdditivityPP k a b)
    (haddι' : TauAdditivityPn b ι') (x : G0 X) :
    haveI
proof:
:= graphPP_isClosedImmersion_snd ι ι'
    tauPP (graphPP ι ι') (hadd (graphPP ι ι')) x = tauPn b ι' haddι' x := by
  haveI := graphPP_isClosedImmersion_snd ι ι'
  haveI := sec_lft (pr₂PP k a b) ι'
  haveI := sec_isNoetherian (pr₂PP k a b) ι'
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (pullback ι' (pr₂PP k a b))) := ⟨sec_projK (pr₂PP k a b) ι'⟩
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hφIV⟩ := hIV ι' (pullback.snd ι' (pr₂PP k a b)) (pullback.fst ι' (pr₂PP k a b))
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback _ _) haddι' (hadd _)
  exact tauTwo_eq_of_section (pp_member k a b) (pp_height k a b) (pp_regStalks k a b)
    (ppL₁ k a b) (ppL₂ k a b) (hppL₁ k a b) (hppL₂ k a b) (a + 1) (b + 1)
    (pullback.snd ι' (pr₂PP k a b)) (pullback.fst ι' (pr₂PP k a b))
    (secPP (pr₂PP k a b) ι' (graphPP ι ι') (graphPP_snd ι ι'))
    (secPP_fst _ _ _ _) (graphPP ι ι') (secPP_snd _ _ _ _) (hadd _) (hadd _) hφ _ hφIV x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.genericMultiplicity_openImmersion_genericPoint_kim
statement:
theorem genericMultiplicity_openImmersion_genericPoint_kim {Z Z' : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z]
    (j : Z' ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion j] [IsIntegral Z'] :
    genericMultiplicity (j (genericPoint Z')) = 1
proof:
:= by
  let e : Z.presheaf.stalk (j (genericPoint Z')) ≃+* Z'.functionField :=
    (asIso (j.stalkMap (genericPoint Z'))).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  have hs : IsSimpleModule (Z.presheaf.stalk (j (genericPoint Z')))
      (Z.presheaf.stalk (j (genericPoint Z'))) := by
    rw [isSimpleModule_self_iff_isUnit]
    refine ⟨e.symm.injective.nontrivial, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    have hex : e x ≠ 0 := fun h => hx (by simpa using congrArg e.symm h)
    exact (isUnit_map_iff e x).mp hex.isUnit
  unfold genericMultiplicity selfLocalLength
  rw [Module.length_eq_one_iff.mpr hs]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.isIso_infFibreAwayToU
statement:
theorem isIso_infFibreAwayToU (hC : IsSplitOn C U) :
    IsIso (infFibreAwayToU (k := k) C U hC)
proof:
:= by
  have s1 := isPullback_comap_subschemeι_kim (infIdeal k) (graphToP1 (k := k) C)
  have s0 := isPullback_morphismRestrict (infFibreι (k := k) C) (awayOpen (k := k) C U)
  have s01 := s0.paste_vert s1
  have hg : (awayOpen (k := k) C U).ι ≫ graphToP1 (k := k) C =
      (awayIso (k := k) C U hC).hom ≫ pullback.snd _ _ :=
    (awayIso_hom_snd (k := k) C U hC).symm
  have s2 := s01.of_iso (Iso.refl _) (awayIso (k := k) C U hC) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _)
    (fst' := (infFibreι (k := k) C ∣_ awayOpen (k := k) C U) ≫ (awayIso (k := k) C U hC).hom)
    (snd' := ((infFibreι (k := k) C) ⁻¹ᵁ (awayOpen (k := k) C U)).ι ≫
      Scheme.IdealSheafData.subschemeMap ((infIdeal k).comap (graphToP1 (k := k) C)) (infIdeal k)
        (graphToP1 (k := k) C) (Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_map_comap _ _))
    (f' := pullback.snd _ _) (g' := (infIdeal k).subschemeι)
    (by simp) (by simp) (by simpa using hg) (by simp)
  have s3 := s2.paste_horiz
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback (U.ι ≫ (M ↘ Spk k)) (toSpec k 1))
  haveI := isIso_infSubschemeι_toSpec_kim k
  have h := s3.isIso_fst_of_isIso

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.gammaPt_specializes

proof:

    genericPoint_specializes _

    (infFibreι (k := k) C).continuous

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.eq_gammaFibrePt_of_mem_genericPoints
statement:
theorem eq_gammaFibrePt_of_mem_genericPoints [IsNoetherian (graphModel (k := k) C)]
    (hC : IsSplitOn C U) (hU : (U : Set M).Nonempty) {z : infFibre (k := k) C}
    (hz : z ∈ genericPoints (infFibre (k := k) C)) (hzU : z ∈ infFibreAway (k := k) C U) :
    haveI
proof:
:= isIntegral_infFibreAway (k := k) C U hC hU
    z = (infFibreAway (k := k) C U).ι (genericPoint (infFibreAway (k := k) C U)) := by
  haveI := isIntegral_infFibreAway (k := k) C U hC hU
  haveI := isNoetherian_subscheme (infDivisor (k := k) C)
  have hmax := isMax_of_mem_genericPoints hz
  have h : genericPoint (infFibreAway (k := k) C U) ⤳ (⟨z, hzU⟩ : infFibreAway (k := k) C U) :=
    genericPoint_specializes _
  have h' : (infFibreAway (k := k) C U).ι (genericPoint (infFibreAway (k := k) C U)) ⤳ z := by
    simpa using h.map (infFibreAway (k := k) C U).ι.continuous
  have h2 : z ≤ (infFibreAway (k := k) C U).ι (genericPoint (infFibreAway (k := k) C U)) :=
    Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr h'
  have h3 := hmax h2
  rw [Scheme.le_iff_specializes] at h3
  exact (h3.antisymm h').eq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.infCycle_gammaPt

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.eq_gammaPt_of_infCycle_ne_zero
statement:
theorem eq_gammaPt_of_infCycle_ne_zero [IsNoetherian (graphModel (k := k) C)]
    (hC : IsSplitOn C U) (hU : (U : Set M).Nonempty) {w : graphModel (k := k) C}
    (hw : infCycle (k := k) C w ≠ 0) (hwU : w ∈ awayOpen (k := k) C U) :
    w = gammaPt (k := k) C U hC hU
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isNoetherian_subscheme (infDivisor (k := k) C)
  rw [infCycle_eq] at hw
  by_cases hr : w ∈ Set.range (infFibreι (k := k) C)
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hr
    rw [WDiv.pushFund_apply_image] at hw
    have hz : z ∈ genericPoints (infFibre (k := k) C) := by
      by_contra h
      exact hw (fundamentalCycle_apply_of_not_mem_genericPoints h)
    rw [eq_gammaFibrePt_of_mem_genericPoints (k := k) C U hC hU hz hwU]
    rfl
  · exact absurd (WDiv.pushFund_apply_notRange _ w hr) hw

statement:
theorem fst_toBase_not_mem_of_infCycle_ne_zero [IsNoetherian (graphModel (k := k) C)]
    (hC : IsSplitOn C U) (w : graphModel (k := k) C) (hw : infCycle (k := k) C w ≠ 0)
    (hne : ∀ hU : (U : Set M).Nonempty, w ≠ gammaPt (k := k) C U hC hU) :
    (graphToBase (k := k) C ≫ pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)) w ∉ U
proof:
:= by
  intro hwU
  have hU : (U : Set M).Nonempty := ⟨_, hwU⟩
  exact hne hU (eq_gammaPt_of_infCycle_ne_zero (k := k) C U hC hU hw hwU)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.infCycle_decomposition
statement:
theorem infCycle_decomposition [IsNoetherian (graphModel (k := k) C)] (hC : IsSplitOn C U)
    (hU : (U : Set M).Nonempty) :
    ∃ R : AlgebraicCycle (graphModel (k := k) C) ℤ,
      infCycle (k := k) C =
        Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single (gammaPt (k := k) C U hC hU) 1 + R ∧
      ∀ w, R w ≠ 0 →
        (graphToBase (k := k) C ≫ pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)) w ∉ U
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨infCycle (k := k) C -
    Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single (gammaPt (k := k) C U hC hU) 1, by abel, ?_⟩
  intro w hw hwU
  apply hw
  change infCycle (k := k) C w -
    Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single (gammaPt (k := k) C U hC hU) (1 : ℤ) w = 0
  rw [Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single_apply]
  by_cases h : w = gammaPt (k := k) C U hC hU
  · subst h
    rw [if_pos rfl, infCycle_gammaPt]
    rfl
  · rw [if_neg h, infCycle_eq_zero_of_mem_awayOpen_of_ne (k := k) C U hC hU w hwU h]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.SmoothComparison.pullbackTwistTensorIso_space
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistTensorIso_space :
    Nonempty (tensorSheaf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N 1))
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (-1))) ≅
        tensorUnitSheaf X)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_isFiniteLocallyFree i
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N 1) (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (-1))
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree k N 1)
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree k N (-1))
  have e0 : projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (1 + -1) = projectiveTwistingSheaf k N 0 :=
    congrArg (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N) (by norm_num)
  exact ⟨(asIso (pullbackTensorSheafHom i (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N 1)
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (-1)))).symm ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback i).mapIso
      (projectiveTwistingTensorIso k N 1 (-1) ≪≫ eqToIso e0 ≪≫ projectiveTwistingZeroIso k N) ≪≫
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso i⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.SmoothComparison.cap_pullback_twist_add_space
statement:
theorem cap_pullback_twist_add_space :
    totalCapOn (opsV4 k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N 1))
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1 (hcr k N 1)) +
      totalCapOn (opsV4 k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (-1)))
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1 (hcr k N (-1))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1 (hcr k N 1)
  have h2 := hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1 (hcr k N (-1))
  have hT : HasConstantRank X (tensorSheaf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N 1)) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (-1)))) 1 := by
    simpa using hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf h1 h2
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := pullbackTwistTensorIso_space N i
  rw [← totalCapOn_tensor (ops := opsV4 k) _ _ h1 h2 hT,
    cap_isoOn (ops := opsV4 k) hT hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf ⟨e⟩,
    totalCapOn_tensorUnit (opsV4 k)]

statement:
theorem tdTan_pullback_twist_space :
    tdTan k X (k0ClassOf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (-1)))
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1 (hcr k N (-1))).isFiniteLocallyFree) =
      tdLine k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N 1))
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1 (hcr k N 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [tdTan_classOf]
  exact tdDualTot_line k _ _ _ _ (cap_pullback_twist_add_space k N i)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.SmoothComparison.tdTan_pullback_kahler_space
statement:
theorem tdTan_pullback_kahler_space :
    tdTan k X (pullbackK0RingHom i (k0ClassOf (space k N)
        (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (toSpec k N))
        (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (toSpec k N) N))) =
      (tdLine k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N 1))
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1 (hcr k N 1))) ^ (N + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [OMG.cotangent_classOf, map_sub, map_nsmul, map_one, tdTan_sub, tdTan_nsmul, tdTanInv_one,
    mul_one, projectiveTwistingK0Class, pullbackK0RingHom_classOf, tdTan_pullback_twist_space]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.SmoothComparison.tdTan_kahler_eq
statement:
theorem tdTan_kahler_eq (hXreg : RegStalks X) (d : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d (X ↘ Spk k)]
    (N : ℕ) (i : X ⟶ space k N) [IsClosedImmersion i] [i.IsOver (Spk k)] :
    tdTan k X (kahlerClass k d) =
      (tdLine k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N 1))
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1 (hcr k N 1))) ^ (N + 1) *
        tdInvN k (closedPosV4 k) i
proof:
:= by
  have e : i ≫ (space k N ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k := comp_over i (Spk k)
  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension N (space k N ↘ Spk k) :=
    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension N (toSpec k N))
  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension d (i ≫ (space k N ↘ Spk k)) := by rw [e]; infer_instance
  have hP : RegStalks (space k N) := projectiveSpace_regStalks k N
  have h1 := SchemeKTheory.TF7.kahlerClass_conormal k i hP hXreg N d
  have h3 := SchemeKTheory.TF7.k0ClassOf_relativeSheaf_congr e
    (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_hasConstantRank (i ≫ (space k N ↘ Spk k)) d).isFiniteLocallyFree
    (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_hasConstantRank (X ↘ Spk k) d).isFiniteLocallyFree
  have hr : HasConstantRank X (conormalSheaf i) (N - d) :=
    SchemeKTheory.TF6.hasConstantRank_libConormalAmb_sub k i hP hXreg (m := N) (d := d)
  have hΩ : kahlerClass k d =
      pullbackK0RingHom i (k0ClassOf (space k N) (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (toSpec k N))
        (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (toSpec k N) N)) -
        k0ClassOf X (conormalSheaf i) hr.isFiniteLocallyFree := by
    unfold kahlerClass
    rw [← h3]
    exact eq_sub_of_add_eq' h1.symm
  rw [hΩ, tdTan_sub, tdTan_pullback_kahler_space, tdTanInv_classOf,
    tdInvN_eq_tdInvDualTot (closedPosV4 k) i hr]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.SmoothComparison.tau_eq_tdTan_kahler
statement:
theorem tau_eq_tdTan_kahler {C : SchemeClass k} (T : ToddTransformation k C) {X : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (ProjK k X)]
    [IsIntegral X] (d : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d (X ↘ Spk k)] (hC : C X)
    (hreg : RegStalks X) (x : K0 X) :
    haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X)
proof:
:=
      ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_projK (Fact.out : ProjK k X)⟩
    T.tau X (k0ToG0 X x) =
      GRRBlueprintV4.TOD.tdTan k X
        (k0ClassOf X (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (X ↘ Spk k))
          (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_hasConstantRank (X ↘ Spk k) d).isFiniteLocallyFree)
        (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chExact_closedPosV4 k) x (fundClass k (W := X))) := by
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X) :=
    ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_projK (Fact.out : ProjK k X)⟩
  obtain ⟨N, j, hj, hjo⟩ := (Fact.out : ProjK k X)
  haveI := hj
  haveI : j.IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨hjo⟩
  rw [T.regular hC hreg N j x]
  have h := tdTan_kahler_eq k hreg d N j
  unfold kahlerClass at h
  rw [h, Module.End.mul_apply]
  rfl

name: RRC.BaumFultonMacPherson_smooth
statement:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModulePropertyDisconnected.chK0T2_push
statement:
theorem chK0T2_push {U V : Scheme.{u}} [U.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (U ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian U] [Fact (ProjK k U)] [ConnectedSpace U] [V.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (V ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian V] [Fact (ProjK k V)] [ConnectedSpace V]
    (κ : V ⟶ U) [IsClosedImmersion κ] [κ.IsOver (Spk k)] (z : K0 U) (t : TotalChow V) :
    totalPushOn (opsK k) κ (chK0T2 k (pullbackK0 κ z) t) =
      chK0T2 k z (totalPushOn (opsK k) κ t)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty V := inferInstance
  haveI : Nonempty U := ⟨κ (Classical.arbitrary V)⟩
  let L : K0 U →+ (TotalChow V →ₗ[ℚ] TotalChow U) :=
    { toFun := fun z ↦ totalPushOn (opsK k) κ ∘ₗ chK0T2 k (pullbackK0 κ z)
      map_zero' := by rw [map_zero, map_zero, LinearMap.comp_zero]
      map_add' := fun a b ↦ by rw [map_add, map_add, LinearMap.comp_add] }
  let R : K0 U →+ (TotalChow V →ₗ[ℚ] TotalChow U) :=
    { toFun := fun z ↦ chK0T2 k z ∘ₗ totalPushOn (opsK k) κ
      map_zero' := by rw [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_comp]
      map_add' := fun a b ↦ by rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_comp] }
  have hLR : L = R := by
    refine ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext (Object := {E : U.Modules // IsFiniteLocallyFree U E})
      (Exact := ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn U.Modules (IsFiniteLocallyFree U))
      (A := TotalChow V →ₗ[ℚ] TotalChow U) (f := L) (g := R) fun E ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_rank_T2 (k := k) E.2
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro w
    change totalPushOn (opsK k) κ (chK0T2 k (pullbackK0 κ (k0ClassOf U E.1 E.2)) w) =
      chK0T2 k (k0ClassOf U E.1 E.2) (totalPushOn (opsK k) κ w)
    have hr' := hasConstantRank_pullback V κ E.1 r hr
    rw [pullbackK0_classOf]
    rw [show k0ClassOf V ((Scheme.Modules.pullback κ).obj E.1)
        (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global κ E.1 E.2) =
        k0ClassOf V ((Scheme.Modules.pullback κ).obj E.1) hr'.isFiniteLocallyFree from rfl,
      chK0T2_classOf_eq_chK _ hr', show k0ClassOf U E.1 E.2 = k0ClassOf U E.1 hr.isFiniteLocallyFree
        from rfl, chK0T2_classOf_eq_chK _ hr]
    exact chK_push κ E.1 hr w
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun (DFunLike.congr_fun hLR z) t

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModulePropertyDisconnected.chAll_apply
statement:
theorem chAll_apply (y : K0 X) (t : TotalChow X) :
    chAll k y t = ∑ c : ConnectedComponents X,
      pushC k c (chK0T2 k (pullbackK0 (compOpen c).ι y) (rho k c t))
proof:
:= by
  unfold chAll
  rw [AddMonoidHom.finsetSum_apply, LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModulePropertyDisconnected.chAll_push
statement:
theorem chAll_push {V : Scheme.{u}} [V.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (V ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian V] [Fact (ProjK k V)] [ConnectedSpace V]
    (κ : V ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion κ] [κ.IsOver (Spk k)] (y : K0 X) (t : TotalChow V) :
    chAll k y (totalPushOn (opsK k) κ t) =
      totalPushOn (opsK k) κ (chK0T2 k (pullbackK0 κ y) t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v0⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty V)
  set c0 : ConnectedComponents X := (κ v0 : ConnectedComponents X) with hc0
  have hrange : Set.range κ ⊆ Set.range (compOpen c0).ι := by
    rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
    exact subset_compOpen_of_isPreconnected (isPreconnected_range κ.continuous) ⟨v0, rfl⟩
  let κ' : V ⟶ (compOpen c0).toScheme := IsOpenImmersion.lift (compOpen c0).ι κ hrange
  have hfac : κ' ≫ (compOpen c0).ι = κ := IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion (κ' ≫ (compOpen c0).ι) := by rw [hfac]; infer_instance
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion κ' := IsClosedImmersion.of_comp_isClosedImmersion κ' (compOpen c0).ι
  haveI : κ'.IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨by
    change κ' ≫ (compOpen c0).ι ≫ X ↘ Spk k = V ↘ Spk k
    rw [← Category.assoc, hfac, comp_over]⟩
  haveI : (κ' ≫ (compOpen c0).ι).IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨by rw [hfac, comp_over]⟩
  have hpush : totalPushOn (opsK k) κ =
      pushC k c0 ∘ₗ totalPushOn (opsK k) κ' := by
    rw [← totalPushOn_congr (opsK k) hfac, pushC, (cpK k).push_comp]
  have hpull : pullbackK0 κ y = pullbackK0 κ' (pullbackK0 (compOpen c0).ι y) := by
    rw [pullbackK0_comp_apply, hfac]
  rw [hpush, LinearMap.comp_apply, chAll_apply,
    Finset.sum_eq_single c0 (fun c _ hc ↦ by
      rw [show rho k c (pushC k c0 (totalPushOn (opsK k) κ' t)) =
        (rho k c ∘ₗ pushC k c0) (totalPushOn (opsK k) κ' t) from rfl, rho_pushC_ne hc,
        LinearMap.zero_apply, map_zero, map_zero])
      (fun h ↦ absurd (Finset.mem_univ c0) h),
    show rho k c0 (pushC k c0 (totalPushOn (opsK k) κ' t)) =
      (rho k c0 ∘ₗ pushC k c0) (totalPushOn (opsK k) κ' t) from rfl, rho_pushC_self,
    LinearMap.id_apply, ← chK0T2_push κ', hpull, LinearMap.comp_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModulePropertyDisconnected.chAll_eq_of_push
statement:
theorem chAll_eq_of_push (y : K0 X) (φ : Module.End ℚ (TotalChow X))
    (hφ : ∀ (V : Scheme.{u}) [V.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (V ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian V]
      [Fact (ProjK k V)] [IsIntegral V] (κ : V ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion κ] [κ.IsOver (Spk k)]
      (t : TotalChow V),
      φ (totalPushOn (opsK k) κ t) = totalPushOn (opsK k) κ (chK0T2 k (pullbackK0 κ y) t)) :
    chAll k y = φ
proof:
:= by
  apply totalChow_ext
  intro v m hv
  letI : (pointClosureScheme v).Over (Spk k) := ⟨pointClosureι v ≫ X ↘ Spk k⟩
  haveI : (pointClosureι v).IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨rfl⟩
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType ((pointClosureScheme v) ↘ Spk k) := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (pointClosureι v ≫ X ↘ Spk k)
    infer_instance
  haveI : CompactSpace (pointClosureScheme v) :=
    (pointClosureι v).isClosedEmbedding.compactSpace
  haveI : IsNoetherian (pointClosureScheme v) := { }
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (pointClosureScheme v)) :=
    ⟨projK_closed (Fact.out : ProjK k X) (pointClosureι v) rfl⟩
  have hιv : pointClosureι v (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v)) = v := by
    rw [← C1Cap.pointClosureGenericPoint_eq_genericPoint, pointClosureι_genericPoint]
  have hη : height (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v)) = m := by
    rw [← height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion (pointClosureι v), hιv, hv]
  rw [primeClass_eq_push (k := k) (pointClosureι v) v hιv m hv hη, chAll_push,
    hφ (pointClosureScheme v) (pointClosureι v)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModulePropertyDisconnected.chAll_eq_chK0T2
statement: theorem chAll_eq_chK0T2 [ConnectedSpace X] (y : K0 X) : chAll k y = chK0T2 k y
proof:
:=
  chAll_eq_of_push y _ fun _ _ _ _ _ _ κ _ _ t ↦ (chK0T2_push κ y t).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModulePropertyDisconnected.chAll_classOf_eq_chK
statement:
theorem chAll_classOf_eq_chK (E : X.Modules) {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    chAll k (k0ClassOf X E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree) = chK k E
proof:
:= by
  refine chAll_eq_of_push _ _ fun V _ _ _ _ _ κ _ _ t ↦ ?_
  have hr' := hasConstantRank_pullback V κ E r hE
  rw [pullbackK0_classOf, show k0ClassOf V ((Scheme.Modules.pullback κ).obj E)
      (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global κ E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree) =
      k0ClassOf V ((Scheme.Modules.pullback κ).obj E) hr'.isFiniteLocallyFree from rfl,
    chK0T2_classOf_eq_chK _ hr']
  exact (chK_push κ E hE t).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModulePropertyDisconnected.exists_dimLE_g2pol3
statement:
theorem exists_dimLE_g2pol3 (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (ProjK k X)] :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ x : X, height x ≤ N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, j, hj, -⟩ := (Fact.out : ProjK k X)
  haveI := hj
  refine ⟨N, fun x ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [← height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion j x]
  exact Statement.LFA.height_le_space (k := k) N (j x)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModulePropertyDisconnected.tauX_module_all
statement:
theorem tauX_module_all (hIV : ProjCovAll k) (hadd : TauAdditivityAmb k)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X]
    [Fact (ProjK k X)] (y : K0 X) (x : G0 X) :
    tauX X hadd (y • x) = chAll k y (tauX X hadd x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_dimLE_g2pol3 (k := k) X
  let F : G0 X →+ TotalChow X := (tauX X hadd).comp ((smulAddHom (K0 X) (G0 X)) y)
  let G : G0 X →+ TotalChow X := (chAll k y).toAddMonoidHom.comp (tauX X hadd)
  
  have hgen : ∀ w ∈ G0Dev.genSet X N, (F - G).comp (G0Le.toG0 X N) w = 0 := by
    rintro w ⟨V, hVi, hVn, κ, hκ, h, rfl⟩
    letI : V.Over (Spk k) := ⟨κ ≫ X ↘ Spk k⟩
    haveI : κ.IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨rfl⟩
    haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (V ↘ Spk k) :=
      inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType (κ ≫ X ↘ Spk k))
    haveI : Fact (ProjK k V) := ⟨projK_closed (Fact.out : ProjK k X) κ rfl⟩
    have hU : IsCoherentLike V (SheafOfModules.unit V.ringCatSheaf) :=
      SheafOfModules.unit_isFinitePresentation (R := V.ringCatSheaf)
    set o : G0 V := g0ClassOf V _ hU
    have hw : G0Le.toG0 X N (ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf X.Modules
        (IsCoherentDimLE X N) (pushUnit κ) h) = finitePushforward κ o := by
      rw [G0Le.toG0_classOf, finitePushforward_classOf]
    haveI : IsProper κ := LocalizedLift.isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) κ
    have hcov := fun z ↦ tauX_finitePushforward hIV hadd κ z
    rw [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, hw, AddMonoidHom.sub_apply, sub_eq_zero]
    change tauX X hadd (y • finitePushforward κ o) = chAll k y (tauX X hadd (finitePushforward κ o))
    rw [← closedImmersion_projectionFormula κ o y, hcov, hcov,
      GlobGenMorphismB.tauX_module_g2tggmb hIV hadd, chAll_push]
  have hle : AddSubgroup.closure (G0Dev.genSet X N) ≤ ((F - G).comp (G0Le.toG0 X N)).ker :=
    (AddSubgroup.closure_le _).mpr hgen
  have hFG : F = G := by
    refine sub_eq_zero.mp (ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
      (Object := {E : X.Modules // IsCoherentLike X E})
      (Exact := ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules (IsCoherentLike X)) fun E ↦ ?_)
    have hE : IsCoherentDimLE X N E.1 := ⟨E.2, fun x _ ↦ hN x⟩
    have hz := hle (G0Dev.g0Devissage (k := k) X N
      (ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf X.Modules (IsCoherentDimLE X N) E.1 hE))
    rw [AddMonoidHom.mem_ker, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, G0Le.toG0_classOf] at hz
    rw [AddMonoidHom.zero_apply]
    exact hz
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hFG x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModulePropertyDisconnected.tauX_module_all_connected
statement:
theorem tauX_module_all_connected (hIV : ProjCovAll k) (hadd : TauAdditivityAmb k)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X]
    [Fact (ProjK k X)] [ConnectedSpace X] (y : K0 X) (x : G0 X) :
    tauX X hadd (y • x) = chK0T2 k y (tauX X hadd x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tauX_module_all hIV hadd, chAll_eq_chK0T2]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModulePropertyDisconnected.targetThree_module_all
statement:
theorem targetThree_module_all {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (ProjK k X)] (y : K0 X) (x : G0 X) :
    (targetThree k).tau X (y • x) = chAll k y ((targetThree k).tau X x)
proof:
:= by

name: RRC.SingularToddTransformation_module_all
statement:
theorem SingularToddTransformation_module_all (k : Type v) [Field k] [Infinite k] :
    ∃ T : Statement.TargetThree k,
      (∀ {X : Scheme.{v}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X]
        [Fact (ProjK k X)] (y : K0 X) (x : G0 X), T.tau X (y • x) = chAll k y (T.tau X x)) ∧
      (∀ {X : Scheme.{v}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X]
        [Fact (ProjK k X)] [ConnectedSpace X] (y : K0 X), chAll k y = chK0T2 k y)
proof:
:=
  ⟨targetThree k, fun y x ↦ targetThree_module_all k y x, fun y ↦ chAll_eq_chK0T2 y⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LciComparison.zsGateL
statement:
theorem zsGateL (h0 : r ≠ 0) (x : K0 X) :
    totalPushOn (opsV4 k) (pencilL N i Cv).π
        (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k)
          (pullbackK0 (pencilL N i Cv).e (G2CC2.liftLci i (FRI.space_member k N) Cv x))
          (fundClass k (W := (pencilL N i Cv).E))) =
      tauX k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) i x
proof:
:= by
  have hA := FRI.space_member k N
  have hAreg := CIICLASS.T1N23.projectiveSpace_regStalks k N
  haveI : IsIntegral i.ker.subscheme := integralZA i
  haveI : IsNoetherian (totalGlobal (space k N) i.ker) := total_isNoetherian (k := k) i.ker hA
  haveI : IsNoetherian (subschemeTotalGlobal (space k N) i.ker) := KG2B.isNoetherian_W i.ker hA
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k (space k N)) := ⟨space_projectiveIntegral N⟩
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e, r = e + 1 := ⟨r - 1, by omega⟩
  have hNr : HasConstantRank (ARRKG2A.Zs (space k N) i.ker) (ARRKG2A.Nsh i.ker) (e + 1) := by
    have := G2C1.hNrankC Cv.toQuasiregular
    rw [he] at this
    exact this
  obtain ⟨CNZ, hCNZ⟩ := exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hNr
  let M := G2CC3.zsModel_lci i hA Cv canonφA e he CNZ hCNZ
  have hfact : ProjectiveIntegral k M.CX.scheme := by
    obtain ⟨hI, N', j, hj⟩ := (inferInstance : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k
      (G2CC2.concreteGeomXA_lci i hA Cv canonφA).E)).out
    haveI := hI
    haveI := hj
    exact ⟨CIICLASS.isIntegral_of_iso M.φ.symm, N', M.φ.inv ≫ j, inferInstance⟩
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k M.CX.scheme) := ⟨hfact⟩
  have hbridge := CIIMB.lambdaMinusOne_taut_eq_kosClassX M.CX
    (M.CX.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card M.hC (Nat.succ_pos _)) M.CX M.hN M.hE
    (M.CX.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card M.hC (Nat.succ_pos _))
  have hchow : ZSChowGates M (chEx k) :=
    CIIFZ.zsChowGates_of_chMul M (chEx k) (fun a b => CIIMB.chK_mul' (chEx k) a b)
  exact G2CC3.zeroSection_lci i hA Cv canonφA hAreg M (chEx k) hchow hbridge x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LciComparison.tauStd_zeroSectionL
statement:
theorem tauStd_zeroSectionL (h0 : r ≠ 0) (C : RankedBundleComplex (pencilL N i Cv).E)
    (U : (pencilL N i Cv).E.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U)
    (hXU : ∀ y, y ∉ U → y ∈ Set.range (pencilL N i Cv).s) {n : ℕ}
    (hE : height (genericPoint (pencilL N i Cv).E) = n) (x : K0 X)
    (hx : C.K.altSum =
      pullbackK0 (pencilL N i Cv).e (G2CC2.liftLci i (FRI.space_member k N) Cv x)) :
    haveI : Fact (ProjK k (pencilL N i Cv).E)
proof:
:= ⟨pencilL_E_projK N i Cv⟩
    haveI : Fact (ProjK k (pencilL N i Cv).Z) := (inferInstance : Fact (ProjK k X))
    haveI := pencilL_s_isOver N i Cv
    tauStd (pencilL_E_member N i Cv) C (pencilL N i Cv).s U hC hE =
      tauX k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) i x := by
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (pencilL N i Cv).E) := ⟨pencilL_E_projK N i Cv⟩
  haveI := pencilL_s_isOver N i Cv
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (pencilL N i Cv).Z) := (inferInstance : Fact (ProjK k X))
  haveI : ConnectedSpace (pencilL N i Cv).E := connectedSpace_of_isIntegral
  have hf : primeClassT2 (genericPoint (pencilL N i Cv).E) n hE =
      fundClass k (W := (pencilL N i Cv).E) := by rw [fundClass_eq k n hE]; rfl
  have hsπ : ∀ v, totalPushOn (opsK k) (pencilL N i Cv).π
      (totalPushOn (opsK k) (pencilL N i Cv).s v) = v := fun v => by
    rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply,
      ← totalPushOn_comp (opsK k) (pencilL N i Cv).s (pencilL N i Cv).π,
      totalPushOn_congr (opsK k) (pencilL N i Cv).sπ, totalPushOn_id]
    rfl
  rw [← hsπ (tauStd _ C _ U hC hE), push_tauStd _ C _ U hC hXU hE,
    chK0T2_eq_chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k), hf, hx]
  exact zsGateL N i Cv h0 x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LciComparison.exists_rankedResolution_bundleL
statement:
theorem exists_rankedResolution_bundleL (V : X.Modules) (hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree X V) :
    ∃ (C : RankedBundleComplex (pencilL N i Cv).M)
      (_ : _root_.SingTau.ResolutionData (IsCoherentLike (pencilL N i Cv).M) C.K
        (liftSheaf k N i V)),
      C.K.altSum = G2CC2.liftLci i (FRI.space_member k N) Cv (k0ClassOf X V hV)
proof:
:= by
  have hA := FRI.space_member k N
  haveI := BundleCoversProjBundleG2.isLocallyNoetherian_total i.ker hA
  have hV' := pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global (phiXA i).inv V hV
  have hV'' := pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global (totalToClosedBase (space k N) i.ker) _ hV'
  have hG' := (finitePushObject (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k N) i.ker)
    ⟨_, hV''.isFinitePresentation⟩).2
  have hd := DeformationRegularWSheafLCI.pdLE_pushforward_of_regularCover
    (BundleCoversProjBundleG2.hasBundleCovers_total i.ker hA) Cv _ hV''
  obtain ⟨K, -, ⟨R'⟩⟩ := _root_.SingTau.exists_resolves_of_pdLE
    (BundleCoversProjBundleG2.hasBundleCovers_total i.ker hA) hG' hd
  haveI : IsIntegral (pencilL N i Cv).M := (inferInstance : IsIntegral (M k N i))
  haveI : ConnectedSpace (pencilL N i Cv).M := connectedSpace_of_isIntegral
  refine ⟨RankedBundleComplex.ofConnected K, ResolutionDataIso R' (liftIsoL N i V), ?_⟩
  rw [RankedBundleComplex.ofConnected_K, G2CC2.liftLci_apply, pullbackK0_classOf,
    G2CC2.liftZ_k0ClassOf]
  exact (_root_.SingTau.repK0_eq_altSum _ R' hG' hd).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LciComparison.tauG0_classOf_bundleL
statement:
theorem tauG0_classOf_bundleL (hadd : TauAdditivityPn N i)
    (h0 : (coheight (i (genericPoint X))).toNat ≠ 0) (V : X.Modules)
    (hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree X V) :
    tauG0 (FRI.space_member k N) i (CASE1B.height_genericPoint_space k N)
        (CIICLASS.T1N23.projectiveSpace_regStalks k N) hadd
        (g0ClassOf X V hV.isFinitePresentation) =
      tauX k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) i (k0ClassOf X V hV)
proof:
:= by
  have hr : r ≠ 0 := by rw [G2C.rank_eq_codim_of_cover i Cv]; exact h0
  obtain ⟨C, R, halt⟩ := exists_rankedResolution_bundleL N i Cv V hV
  rw [tauG0_eq_tauStd_EL N i Cv hadd h0 V hV.isFinitePresentation C R (height_EL N i Cv h0)]
  exact tauStd_zeroSectionL N i Cv hr _ _ (sectionExactOn_openEL N i Cv V _ C R)
    (mem_range_s_of_not_mem_openEL N i Cv V _) _ (k0ClassOf X V hV)
    (by rw [altSum_pullback, halt])

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LciComparison.tauG0_k0ToG0_eq_lci
statement:
theorem tauG0_k0ToG0_eq_lci (hadd : TauAdditivityPn N i) (x : K0 X) :
    tauG0 (FRI.space_member k N) i (CASE1B.height_genericPoint_space k N)
        (CIICLASS.T1N23.projectiveSpace_regStalks k N) hadd (k0ToG0 X x) =
      tauX k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) i x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0 : (coheight (i (genericPoint X))).toNat = 0
  · have hr : r = 0 := by rw [G2C.rank_eq_codim_of_cover i Cv]; exact h0
    haveI : IsIso i := G2CC3.isIso_of_cover_zero i Cv hr
    have hX : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme X :=
      BlowupRegularAR12E.isRegularScheme_of_iso (asIso i)
        (CIICLASS.T1N23.projectiveSpace_regStalks k N)
    exact tauG0_k0ToG0_of_isIso N i hX hadd x
  · refine G2CC2.ext_k0
      ((tauG0 (FRI.space_member k N) i (CASE1B.height_genericPoint_space k N)
        (CIICLASS.T1N23.projectiveSpace_regStalks k N) hadd).comp (k0ToG0 X))
      (tauXHom N i) (fun V hV => ?_) x
    change tauG0 _ i _ _ hadd (k0ToG0 X (k0ClassOf X V hV)) =
      tauX k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) i (k0ClassOf X V hV)
    rw [k0ToG0_classOf]
    exact tauG0_classOf_bundleL N i Cv hadd h0 V hV

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LciComparison.tauPn_lci
statement:
theorem tauPn_lci (hadd : TauAdditivityPn N i) (x : K0 X) :
    tauPn N i hadd (k0ToG0 X x) =
      ((tdLine k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N 1))
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1 (hcr k N 1))) ^ (N + 1))
        (tauX k (closedPosV4 k) (chExact_closedPosV4 k) i x)
proof:
:= by
  change ((tdLineK k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N 1))
      (hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1 (hcr k N 1))) ^ (N + 1))
      (tauG0 (FRI.space_member k N) i (CASE1B.height_genericPoint_space k N)
        (CIICLASS.T1N23.projectiveSpace_regStalks k N) hadd (k0ToG0 X x)) = _
  rw [tauG0_k0ToG0_eq_lci N i Cv hadd x]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LciComparison.tau_lci
statement:
theorem tau_lci (k : Type u) [Field k] [Infinite k] {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (ProjK k X)] [IsIntegral X]
    (N : ℕ) (i : X ⟶ space k N) [IsClosedImmersion i] [i.IsOver (Spk k)] {r : ℕ}
    (Cv : G2C.RegularCover i.ker r) (x : K0 X) :
    haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X)
proof:
:=
      ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_projK (Fact.out : ProjK k X)⟩
    (targetThree k).tau X (k0ToG0 X x) =
      ((tdLine k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N 1))
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1 (hcr k N 1))) ^ (N + 1))
        (tauX k (closedPosV4 k) (chExact_closedPosV4 k) i x) := by
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X) := ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_projK (Fact.out : ProjK k X)⟩
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (space k N)) := ⟨projK_space N rfl⟩
  rw [AssemblyFinal.targetThree_tau_eq,
    AmbientIndependence.tauX_eq_tauPn (FlatBC.projCovAll_g2tcibca k) _ N i]
  exact tauPn_lci N i Cv _ x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.app_res_xiS
statement:
theorem app_res_xiS {M N : Y.Modules} (φ : M ⟶ N) {U V : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) (x : Γ(M, U)) :
    φ.app V (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x) = N.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (φ.app U x)
proof:
:= by
  have := φ.mapPresheaf.naturality (homOfLE h).op
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.mapPresheaf_app] at this
  exact congrArg (fun f => f x) this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.graphDefect_smul

      (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V ⊓ W₁ ≤ V)).op).hom a •

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.genGraph_zero
statement:

proof:
:= fun hV =>
  ⟨V ⊓ W₁, le_rfl, nonempty_inter_xiS hV hW₁, by rw [graphDefect_zero, map_zero]⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.genGraph_add
statement:
theorem genGraph_add (V : Y.Opens) {s₁ s₂ : Γ(G, V)} (h₁ : GenGraph pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V s₁)
    (h₂ : GenGraph pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V s₂) : GenGraph pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V (s₁ + s₂)
proof:
:= by
  intro hV
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hAne, hA0⟩ := h₁ hV
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hBne, hB0⟩ := h₂ hV
  refine ⟨A ⊓ B, inf_le_left.trans hA, nonempty_inter_xiS hAne hBne, ?_⟩
  rw [graphDefect_add, map_add, ← res_res_xiS Q hA (inf_le_left : A ⊓ B ≤ A),
    ← res_res_xiS Q hB (inf_le_right : A ⊓ B ≤ B), hA0, hB0, map_zero, map_zero, add_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.genGraph_smul
statement:
theorem genGraph_smul (V : Y.Opens) (a : Γ(Y, V)) {s : Γ(G, V)}
    (hs : GenGraph pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V s) : GenGraph pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V (a • s)
proof:
:= by
  intro hV
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hAne, hA0⟩ := hs hV
  refine ⟨A, hA, hAne, ?_⟩
  rw [graphDefect_smul, Scheme.Modules.map_smul, hA0, smul_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.genGraph_res
proof:
:= by
  intro hV'
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hAne, hA0⟩ := hs (hV'.mono h)
  have hne : ((A ⊓ (V' ⊓ W₁) : Y.Opens) : Set Y).Nonempty :=
    nonempty_inter_xiS hAne (nonempty_inter_xiS hV' hW₁)
  refine ⟨A ⊓ (V' ⊓ W₁), inf_le_right, hne, ?_⟩
  rw [graphDefect_res, res_res_xiS, ← res_res_xiS Q hA (inf_le_left : A ⊓ (V' ⊓ W₁) ≤ A), hA0,
    map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.mem_genericGraphSubmodule
statement:
theorem mem_genericGraphSubmodule (hW₁ : (W₁ : Set Y).Nonempty) (V : Y.Opens) (s : Γ(G, V)) :

:=

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.genericGraphSubmodule_isSheaf
statement:
theorem genericGraphSubmodule_isSheaf (hW₁ : (W₁ : Set Y).Nonempty) :
    TopCat.Presheaf.IsSheaf
      ((genericGraphSubmodule pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁).toPresheafOfModules.presheaf)
proof:
:= by
  rw [TopCat.Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheafUniqueGluing]
  intro ι U sf hsf
  have hamb : TopCat.Presheaf.IsSheaf G.val.presheaf := G.isSheaf
  rw [TopCat.Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheafUniqueGluing] at hamb
  obtain ⟨s, hs, huniq⟩ := hamb U (fun i => (sf i).1)
    (fun i j => congrArg Subtype.val (hsf i j))
  have hmem : GenGraph pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t (iSup U) s := by
    intro hne
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hne
    obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hx
    obtain ⟨A, hA, hAne, hA0⟩ := (sf i).2 ⟨x, hxi⟩
    have hsi : G.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_iSup U i)).op s = (sf i).1 := hs i
    refine ⟨A, hA.trans (inf_le_inf_right W₁ (le_iSup U i)), hAne, ?_⟩
    have h0 : Q.presheaf.map (homOfLE hA).op
        (graphDefect pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t (U i) (G.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_iSup U i)).op s)) = 0 := by
      rw [hsi]; exact hA0
    rw [graphDefect_res, res_res_xiS] at h0
    exact h0
  refine ⟨⟨s, hmem⟩, fun i => Subtype.ext (hs i), fun t' ht => Subtype.ext ?_⟩
  exact huniq t'.1 fun i => congrArg Subtype.val (ht i)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.genericGraphι_app_mem
