name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.xiOpen_nonempty
statement:
theorem xiOpen_nonempty [Nonempty M] (C : RankedBundleComplex M) :
    ((xiOpen (k := k) C : (C.graphModel (k := k)).Opens) : Set (C.graphModel (k := k))).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_mem_chart_one (k := k) (M := M)
  have hb' : b ∈ (jChart (k := k) (A := M) 1).opensRange := by
    rw [opensRange_jChart]; exact hb
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hb'
  refine ⟨graphChart (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex x, ?_⟩
  change pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) (graphToBase (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex
    (graphChart (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex x)) ∈ ((chartOpen k 1).1 : Set (P1 k))
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply (graphChart (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex)
    (graphToBase (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) x, graphChart_toBase]
  change _ ∈ ((chart k 1 ''ᵁ ⊤ : (P1 k).Opens) : Set (P1 k))
  rw [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange]
  exact hb

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.sectionMap_eq_conj_ttw2
statement:
theorem sectionMap_eq_conj_ttw2 {E F E' F' : X.Modules} (d : E ⟶ F) (d' : E' ⟶ F')
    (eE : (overRestrictionFunctor X U).obj E' ≅ (overRestrictionFunctor X U).obj E)
    (eF : (overRestrictionFunctor X U).obj F' ≅ (overRestrictionFunctor X U).obj F)
    (h : (overRestrictionFunctor X U).map d' ≫ eF.hom = eE.hom ≫ (overRestrictionFunctor X U).map d)
    {V : X.Opens} (hV : V ≤ U) :
    sectionMap d' V = (overLinEquivTtw2 eF hV).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ sectionMap d V ∘ₗ
      (overLinEquivTtw2 eE hV).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  have hx := congrArg (fun φ ↦ (φ.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV)))).hom x) h
  apply (overLinEquivTtw2 eF hV).injective
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.isLocalizedModule_resLin_ttw2
statement:
theorem isLocalizedModule_resLin_ttw2 {V : X.Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (G : X.Modules)
    [G.IsQuasicoherent] (r : Γ(X, V)) :
    IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers r) (resLinXiS G (X.basicOpen_le r))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hV.isLocalization_basicOpen r
  exact isLocalizedModule_of_pow (R' := Γ(X, X.basicOpen r)) r (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) _
    (fun y ↦ exists_pow_smul_eq_res hV G r y) (fun x hx ↦ exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_res hV G r x hx)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.map_resLin_eq_ttw2
proof:
:= isLocalizedModule_resLin_ttw2 hV P₁ r
    haveI := isLocalizedModule_resLin_ttw2 hV P₂ r
    IsLocalizedModule.map (Submonoid.powers r) (resLinXiS P₁ (X.basicOpen_le r))
      (resLinXiS P₂ (X.basicOpen_le r)) (sectionMap a V) = secMapResTtw2 a r := by
  haveI := isLocalizedModule_resLin_ttw2 hV P₁ r
  haveI := isLocalizedModule_resLin_ttw2 hV P₂ r
  apply IsLocalizedModule.linearMap_ext (Submonoid.powers r) (resLinXiS P₁ (X.basicOpen_le r))
    (resLinXiS P₂ (X.basicOpen_le r))
  rw [IsLocalizedModule.map_comp]
  ext x
  exact (PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply a.val (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le r)).op x).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.exact_sectionMap_of_basicOpen
statement:
theorem exact_sectionMap_of_basicOpen {V : X.Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) {P₁ P₂ P₃ : X.Modules}
    [P₁.IsQuasicoherent] [P₂.IsQuasicoherent] [P₃.IsQuasicoherent] (a : P₁ ⟶ P₂) (b : P₂ ⟶ P₃)
    (s : Set Γ(X, V)) (hs : Ideal.span s = ⊤)
    (H : ∀ r ∈ s, Function.Exact (sectionMap a (X.basicOpen r)) (sectionMap b (X.basicOpen r))) :
    Function.Exact (sectionMap a V) (sectionMap b V)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : ∀ r : s, IsLocalizedModule.Away r.1 (resLinXiS P₁ (X.basicOpen_le r.1)) := fun r ↦
    isLocalizedModule_resLin_ttw2 hV P₁ r.1
  haveI : ∀ r : s, IsLocalizedModule.Away r.1 (resLinXiS P₂ (X.basicOpen_le r.1)) := fun r ↦
    isLocalizedModule_resLin_ttw2 hV P₂ r.1
  haveI : ∀ r : s, IsLocalizedModule.Away r.1 (resLinXiS P₃ (X.basicOpen_le r.1)) := fun r ↦
    isLocalizedModule_resLin_ttw2 hV P₃ r.1
  refine exact_of_isLocalized_span s hs (fun r ↦ P₁.val.obj (op (X.basicOpen r.1)))
    (fun r ↦ resLinXiS P₁ (X.basicOpen_le r.1)) (fun r ↦ P₂.val.obj (op (X.basicOpen r.1)))
    (fun r ↦ resLinXiS P₂ (X.basicOpen_le r.1)) (fun r ↦ P₃.val.obj (op (X.basicOpen r.1)))
    (fun r ↦ resLinXiS P₃ (X.basicOpen_le r.1)) (sectionMap a V) (sectionMap b V) (fun r ↦ ?_)
  rw [map_resLin_eq_ttw2 hV a r.1, map_resLin_eq_ttw2 hV b r.1]
  exact H r.1 r.2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.surjective_sectionMap_of_basicOpen
statement:
theorem surjective_sectionMap_of_basicOpen {V : X.Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) {P₁ P₂ : X.Modules}
    [P₁.IsQuasicoherent] [P₂.IsQuasicoherent] (a : P₁ ⟶ P₂)
    (s : Set Γ(X, V)) (hs : Ideal.span s = ⊤)
    (H : ∀ r ∈ s, Function.Surjective (sectionMap a (X.basicOpen r))) :
    Function.Surjective (sectionMap a V)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : ∀ r : s, IsLocalizedModule.Away r.1 (resLinXiS P₁ (X.basicOpen_le r.1)) := fun r ↦
    isLocalizedModule_resLin_ttw2 hV P₁ r.1
  haveI : ∀ r : s, IsLocalizedModule.Away r.1 (resLinXiS P₂ (X.basicOpen_le r.1)) := fun r ↦
    isLocalizedModule_resLin_ttw2 hV P₂ r.1
  refine surjective_of_isLocalized_span s hs (fun r ↦ P₁.val.obj (op (X.basicOpen r.1)))
    (fun r ↦ resLinXiS P₁ (X.basicOpen_le r.1)) (fun r ↦ P₂.val.obj (op (X.basicOpen r.1)))
    (fun r ↦ resLinXiS P₂ (X.basicOpen_le r.1)) (sectionMap a V) (fun r ↦ ?_)
  rw [map_resLin_eq_ttw2 hV a r.1]
  exact H r.1 r.2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.surjective_conj_ttw2
statement:
theorem surjective_conj_ttw2 {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {P Q P' Q' : Type*} [AddCommGroup P]
    [Module R P] [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q] [AddCommGroup P'] [Module R P'] [AddCommGroup Q']
    [Module R Q'] (f : P →ₗ[R] Q) (e₁ : P' ≃ₗ[R] P) (e₂ : Q' ≃ₗ[R] Q)
    (h : Function.Surjective f) :
    Function.Surjective (e₂.symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ f ∘ₗ e₁.toLinearMap)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := h (e₂ z)
  exact ⟨e₁.symm w, by simp [hw]⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.sectionExactOn_twistTtw
statement:
theorem sectionExactOn_twistTtw (C : RankedBundleComplex M) (A : M.Modules)
    (hA : HasConstantRank M A 1) {U : M.Opens} (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) :
    (C.twistTtw A hA).SectionExactOn U
proof:
:= by
  intro V hVU
  have hloc : ∀ x : V.1, ∃ r : Γ(M, V.1), x.1 ∈ M.basicOpen r ∧ ∃ (O : M.Opens) (ι : Type u)
      (_ : Fintype ι) (s : ι → Γ(A, O)), Fintype.card ι = 1 ∧ IsSecFrame A O s ∧
        M.basicOpen r ≤ O := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨O, hxO, -, ι, hι, s, hcard, hs⟩ :=
      exists_isSecFrame hA (O := ⊤) (x := x.1) (Set.mem_univ _)
    obtain ⟨r, hrO, hxr⟩ := V.2.exists_basicOpen_le (V := O.1) ⟨x.1, hxO⟩ x.2
    exact ⟨r, hxr, O.1, ι, hι, s, hcard, hs, hrO⟩
  choose r hxr O ι hι s hcard hs hrO using hloc
  have hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range r) = ⊤ := by
    rw [← V.2.self_le_iSup_basicOpen_iff]
    intro x hx
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨⟨r ⟨x, hx⟩, ⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩, hxr ⟨x, hx⟩⟩
  have key : ∀ y : V.1,
      Function.Surjective (sectionMap ((C.twistTtw A hA).K.d 0) (M.basicOpen (r y))) ∧
      ∀ j, Function.Exact (sectionMap ((C.twistTtw A hA).K.d (j + 1)) (M.basicOpen (r y)))
        (sectionMap ((C.twistTtw A hA).K.d j) (M.basicOpen (r y))) := by
    intro y
    haveI : Unique (ι y) := (Fintype.card_eq_one_iff_nonempty_unique.1 (hcard y)).some
    have hconj : ∀ j, sectionMap ((C.twistTtw A hA).K.d j) (M.basicOpen (r y)) =
        (overLinEquivTtw2 ((twistOverNatIsoTtw2 A (hs y)).app (C.K.E j)) (hrO y)).symm.toLinearMap
          ∘ₗ sectionMap (C.K.d j) (M.basicOpen (r y)) ∘ₗ
          (overLinEquivTtw2 ((twistOverNatIsoTtw2 A (hs y)).app (C.K.E (j + 1))) (hrO y)).toLinearMap :=
      fun j ↦ sectionMap_eq_conj_ttw2 (C.K.d j) ((C.twistTtw A hA).K.d j)
        ((twistOverNatIsoTtw2 A (hs y)).app _) ((twistOverNatIsoTtw2 A (hs y)).app _)
        ((twistOverNatIsoTtw2 A (hs y)).hom.naturality (C.K.d j)) (hrO y)
    obtain ⟨hs0, hex⟩ := hC (M.affineBasicOpen (r y)) ((M.basicOpen_le _).trans hVU)
    refine ⟨?_, fun j ↦ ?_⟩
    · rw [hconj]
      exact surjective_conj_ttw2 _ _ _ hs0
    · rw [hconj, hconj]
      exact exact_conj _ _ _ _ _ (hex j)
  haveI : ∀ j, ((C.twistTtw A hA).K.E j).IsFinitePresentation := fun j ↦
    ((C.twistTtw A hA).K.hE j).isFinitePresentation
  refine ⟨surjective_sectionMap_of_basicOpen V.2 _ (Set.range r) hspan ?_, fun j ↦
    exact_sectionMap_of_basicOpen V.2 _ _ (Set.range r) hspan ?_⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact (key y).1
  · rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact (key y).2 j

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.exists_xiChart_of_data_kim
statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.exists_xiChart_of_data_kim (C : RankedBundleComplex M)
    [IsIntegral (C.graphModel (k := k))] (j : ℕ) (w : C.graphModel (k := k))
    (U' : (B0 (k := k) M).affineOpens) (hwU' : graphToBase (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex w ∈ U'.1)
    (V : M.affineOpens) (hV : U'.1 ≤ pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)
    (s : ∀ j, ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j)) → Γ(C.K.E j, V.1))
    (hs : ∀ j, IsSecFrame (C.K.E j) V.1 (s j))
    (Wp : (P1 k).affineOpens) (hW : U'.1 ≤ pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ Wp.1)
    (μB lB : Γ(B0 (k := k) M, U'.1))
    (hl : ((zeroIdeal k).ideal Wp).map
      ((pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE Wp.1 U'.1 hW).hom = Ideal.span {lB})
    (hμ : ((infIdeal k).ideal Wp).map
      ((pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE Wp.1 U'.1 hW).hom = Ideal.span {μB})
    (g : (C.graphModel (k := k)).presheaf.stalk w) (hg : g ≠ 0)
    (hgJ : ((graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex).ideal U').map
      (stalkHomXiR (graphToBase (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) U'.1 hwU') = Ideal.span {g})
    (μT lT : Γ(C.graphModel (k := k), graphToBase (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1))
    (hμT : μT ≠ 0)
    (ht : rXiR (inf_le_right : graphToBase (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 ⊓ xiOpen C ≤
        xiOpen C) (xiCoord C) * rXiR inf_le_left μT = rXiR inf_le_left lT)
    (hcμ : germXiR (show w ∈ graphToBase (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 from hwU') μT =
      stalkHomXiR (graphToBase (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) U'.1 hwU' μB)
    (hcl : germXiR (show w ∈ graphToBase (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 from hwU') lT =
      stalkHomXiR (graphToBase (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) U'.1 hwU' lB) :
    ∃ c : XiChart ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).map (C.dj j)) (xiOpen C)
      (xiCoord C) w, Fintype.card c.n = C.rank j ∧
        ∃ hTV : c.T ≤ xiProj (k := k) C ⁻¹ᵁ V.1, ∀ r : ℕ, GraphBundles.minorsIdeal r c.D =
          ((C.toDetIdealComplex.detIdeal j r).ideal V).map
            ((xiProj (k := k) C).appLE V.1 c.T hTV).hom
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b := graphToBase (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex
  let π := xiProj (k := k) C
  let T₀ : (C.graphModel (k := k)).Opens := b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1
  have hw₀ : w ∈ T₀ := hwU'
  have hT₀ : T₀ ≤ π ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 := fun z hz => hV hz
  let F := frameDataOfFrames C V (frXiR C V s hs)
  let ψ := ((pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE V.1 U'.1 hV).hom
  let f := stalkHomXiR b U'.1 hwU'
  obtain ⟨sQ, hsQ, hrel⟩ := exists_tgtFrame_xiR C V s hs j
  let DT : Matrix (mRowXSP C.frRank j) (ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j))) Γ(C.graphModel (k := k), T₀) :=
    (F.D j).map (π.appLE V.1 T₀ hT₀).hom
  have hDT : DT.map (germXiR hw₀) = ((F.D j).map ψ).map f := by
    ext a c
    exact xiProj_appLE_germ C U' V hV hwU' hT₀ (F.D j a c)
  have hstalk : ∃ (S₀ : ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j)) → ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j)) ⊕ mRowXSP C.frRank j)
      (Bw : Matrix (ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j)) ⊕ mRowXSP C.frRank j) (ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j)))
        ((C.graphModel (k := k)).presheaf.stalk w)),
      IsGraphSat (germXiR hw₀ μT) (germXiR hw₀ lT) (DT.map (germXiR hw₀)) S₀ Bw := by
    have e1 : germXiR hw₀ μT = f μB := hcμ
    have e2 : germXiR hw₀ lT = f lB := hcl
    rw [hDT, e1, e2]
    by_cases hj : j ≤ C.K.len
    · have hJ' : (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (C.K.len + 1),
          GraphBundles.graphFormula μB lB ((F.D i).map ψ)).map f = Ideal.span {g} := by
        rw [← C.graphIdeal_eq_frames U' V Wp hV hW μB lB hl hμ s hs]
        exact hgJ
      obtain ⟨S₀, Bw, hΔ, hS⟩ := GraphBundles.exists_satSummand_graphMat_of_map f
        (Finset.range (C.K.len + 1)) μB lB (fun i => (F.D i).map ψ) hJ'
        (IsSMulRegular.of_ne_zero hg) (Finset.mem_range.2 (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hj))
      rw [GraphBundles.graphMat_map] at hS hΔ
      exact ⟨S₀, Bw, IsGraphSat.of_isSatSummand hΔ hS⟩
    · haveI : IsEmpty (ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j))) :=
        ⟨fun a => by
          have h := a.down.2
          change a.down.1 < (if j ≤ C.K.len then C.rank j else 0) at h
          rw [if_neg hj] at h
          exact Nat.not_lt_zero _ h⟩
      refine ⟨fun a => isEmptyElim a, 0, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩ <;> ext a b <;> exact isEmptyElim b
  obtain ⟨S₀, Bw, hBw⟩ := hstalk
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hwT, B, hB⟩ := exists_isGraphSat_of_stalk hw₀ μT lT DT S₀ Bw hBw
  have hT0' : T ≤ π ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 := hT.trans hT₀
  refine ⟨{
      T := T
      mem := hwT
      n := ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j))
      m := mRowXSP C.frRank j
      sP := secResXiR _ hT0' (pullSecXiR π (C.K.E j) V.1 (s j))
      hP := (isSecFrame_pullback π (C.K.E j) V.1 (hs j)).mono hT0'
      sQ := secResXiR _ hT0' (pullSecXiR π (C.tgt j) V.1 sQ)
      hQ := (isSecFrame_pullback π (C.tgt j) V.1 hsQ).mono hT0'
      D := DT.map (rXiR hT)
      hD := ?_
      μ := rXiR hT μT
      l := rXiR hT lT
      hμ := ?_
      ht := ?_
      S₀ := S₀
      B := B
      hB := hB }, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    simp only [secResXiR]
    rw [app_res_xiR, pullback_app_pullSecXiR π (C.K.E j) V.1 (C.dj j) (s j) sQ (F.D j) (hrel) i,
      Fintype.linearCombination_apply, Fintype.linearCombination_apply, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    rw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul]
    congr 1
    change rXiR hT0' ((π.app V.1).hom (F.D j k i)) = rXiR hT (rXiR hT₀ ((π.app V.1).hom (F.D j k i)))
    rw [rXiR_rXiR]
  · intro h0
    apply hμT
    haveI : Nonempty T := ⟨⟨w, hwT⟩⟩
    apply map_injective_of_isIntegral _ (homOfLE hT)
    exact h0.trans (map_zero _).symm
  · have := congrArg (rXiR (inf_le_inf_right (xiOpen C) hT : T ⊓ xiOpen C ≤ T₀ ⊓ xiOpen C)) ht
    simp only [map_mul, rXiR_rXiR] at this
    simp only [rXiR_rXiR]
    exact this
  · refine ⟨?_, hT0', fun r => ?_⟩
    · change Fintype.card (ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j))) = C.rank j
      rw [Fintype.card_ulift, Fintype.card_fin, C.frRank_eq_rank]
    · have hD : DT.map (rXiR hT) = (F.D j).map (π.appLE V.1 T hT0').hom := by
        ext a c
        change rXiR hT ((π.appLE V.1 T₀ hT₀).hom (F.D j a c)) =
          (π.appLE V.1 T hT0').hom (F.D j a c)
        simp only [rXiR]
        have e := congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom (F.D j a c))
          (Scheme.Hom.appLE_map π hT₀ (homOfLE hT).op)
        simpa only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] using e
      have h3 : GraphBundles.minorsIdeal r (DT.map (rXiR hT)) =
          (GraphBundles.minorsIdeal r (F.D j)).map (π.appLE V.1 T hT0').hom := by
        rw [hD]
        exact (GraphBundles.minorsIdeal_map _ r _).symm
      rw [← F.detIdeal_ideal_eq j r] at h3
      exact h3

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.exists_xiChart_kim
statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.exists_xiChart_kim (C : RankedBundleComplex M)
    [IsIntegral (C.graphModel (k := k))] (j : ℕ) (w : C.graphModel (k := k)) :
    ∃ (c : XiChart ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).map (C.dj j)) (xiOpen C)
      (xiCoord C) w) (V : M.affineOpens), Fintype.card c.n = C.rank j ∧
        ∃ hTV : c.T ≤ xiProj (k := k) C ⁻¹ᵁ V.1, ∀ r : ℕ, GraphBundles.minorsIdeal r c.D =
          ((C.toDetIdealComplex.detIdeal j r).ideal V).map
            ((xiProj (k := k) C).appLE V.1 c.T hTV).hom
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b := graphToBase (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex
  obtain ⟨U₀, hwU₀, g, hg0, hgJ⟩ :=
    exists_stalk_principal_blowup (graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) w
  obtain ⟨V, hxV, -, s, hs⟩ := C.exists_secFramesXiR (O := ⊤)
    (x := pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) (b w)) trivial
  have hp : pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) (b w) ∈ (chartOpen k 0).1 ⊔ (chartOpen k 1).1 := by
    rw [chartOpen_sup_eq_top]; trivial
  
  have hbasic : ∀ (c : Fin 2), pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) (b w) ∈ (chartOpen k c).1 →
      ∃ h : Γ(B0 (k := k) M, U₀.1), (B0 (k := k) M).basicOpen h ≤
        pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k c).1 ∧
        b w ∈ (B0 (k := k) M).basicOpen h := by
    intro c hc
    exact U₀.2.exists_basicOpen_le (V := pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 ⊓
      pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k c).1) ⟨b w, ⟨hxV, hc⟩⟩ hwU₀
  rcases TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_sup.mp hp with hp0 | hp1
  · obtain ⟨h, hhO, hwh⟩ := hbasic 0 hp0
    let U' := (B0 (k := k) M).affineBasicOpen h
    have hV : U'.1 ≤ pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 := fun z hz => (hhO hz).1
    have hW : U'.1 ≤ pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 0).1 :=
      fun z hz => (hhO hz).2
    have hwU' : b w ∈ U'.1 := hwh
    have hgJ' : ((graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex).ideal U').map
        (stalkHomXiR b U'.1 hwU') = Ideal.span {g} :=
      (ideal_map_stalk_basicOpen b _ U₀ h hwh).trans hgJ
    let gP := b ≫ pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)
    have hT₀ : b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 ≤ gP ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 0).1 := fun z hz => hW hz
    let sT := (gP.appLE (chartOpen k 0).1 _ hT₀).hom (secEquiv k 0 Polynomial.X)
    have hov : b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 ⊓ xiOpen C ≤ gP ⁻¹ᵁ overlapOpen k := fun z hz => ⟨hT₀ hz.1, hz.2⟩
    have ht : rXiR (inf_le_right : b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 ⊓ xiOpen C ≤ xiOpen C) (xiCoord C) *
        rXiR (inf_le_left : b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 ⊓ xiOpen C ≤ b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1) sT =
        rXiR (inf_le_left : b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 ⊓ xiOpen C ≤ b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1) 1 := by
      have key := congrArg (gP.appLE (overlapOpen k) _ hov).hom (sP1_mul_tP1 k)
      rw [map_mul, map_one] at key
      rw [map_one, ← key, mul_comm]
      congr 1
      · have e := congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom (sP1 k))
          (Scheme.Hom.map_appLE gP hov (homOfLE (inf_le_left : overlapOpen k ≤ (chartOpen k 0).1)).op)
        simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at e
        rw [e]
        have e2 := congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom (sP1 k))
          (Scheme.Hom.appLE_map gP hT₀ (homOfLE (inf_le_left : b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 ⊓ xiOpen C ≤ b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1)).op)
        simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at e2
        exact e2
      · have e := congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom (tP1 k))
          (Scheme.Hom.map_appLE gP hov (homOfLE (inf_le_right : overlapOpen k ≤ (chartOpen k 1).1)).op)
        simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at e
        rw [e]
        have e2 := congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom (tP1 k))
          (Scheme.Hom.appLE_map gP (le_refl (gP ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 1).1))
            (homOfLE (inf_le_right : b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 ⊓ xiOpen C ≤ xiOpen C)).op)
        simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at e2
        rw [← e2, ← Scheme.Hom.app_eq_appLE]
        rfl
    have hne : ((b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 ⊓ xiOpen C : (C.graphModel (k := k)).Opens) :
        Set (C.graphModel (k := k))).Nonempty :=
      nonempty_preirreducible_inter (b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1).isOpen (xiOpen C).isOpen ⟨w, hwU'⟩
        (xiOpen_nonempty C)
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hne
    haveI := nontrivial_sections_xiR hz
    have hμT : sT ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have := ht
      rw [h0, map_zero, mul_zero, map_one] at this
      exact zero_ne_one this
    refine Exists.elim (C.exists_xiChart_of_data_kim j w U' hwU' V hV s hs (chartOpen k 0) hW
      (((pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE _ U'.1 hW).hom (secEquiv k 0 Polynomial.X)) 1
      (zeroIdeal_map_chartZero U' hW) (infIdeal_map_chartZero U' hW) g hg0 hgJ' sT 1 hμT ht ?_ ?_)
      fun c hc => ⟨c, V, hc⟩
    · exact comp_appLE_germ_xiR b (pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)) U'.1 (chartOpen k 0).1 hW
        hwU' hT₀ _
    · rw [map_one, map_one]
  · obtain ⟨h, hhO, hwh⟩ := hbasic 1 hp1
    let U' := (B0 (k := k) M).affineBasicOpen h
    have hV : U'.1 ≤ pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 := fun z hz => (hhO hz).1
    have hW : U'.1 ≤ pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 1).1 :=
      fun z hz => (hhO hz).2
    have hwU' : b w ∈ U'.1 := hwh
    have hgJ' : ((graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex).ideal U').map
        (stalkHomXiR b U'.1 hwU') = Ideal.span {g} :=
      (ideal_map_stalk_basicOpen b _ U₀ h hwh).trans hgJ
    have hT₀ : b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 ≤ xiOpen C := fun z hz => hW hz
    haveI := nontrivial_sections_xiR (show w ∈ b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 from hwU')
    refine Exists.elim (C.exists_xiChart_of_data_kim j w U' hwU' V hV s hs (chartOpen k 1) hW 1
      (((pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE _ U'.1 hW).hom (secEquiv k 1 Polynomial.X))
      (zeroIdeal_map_chartOne U' hW) (infIdeal_map_chartOne U' hW) g hg0 hgJ' 1
      (rXiR hT₀ (xiCoord C)) one_ne_zero ?_ ?_ ?_) fun c hc => ⟨c, V, hc⟩
    · rw [map_one, mul_one, rXiR_rXiR]
    · rw [map_one, map_one]
    · exact comp_appLE_germ_xiR b (pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)) U'.1 (chartOpen k 1).1 hW
        hwU' hT₀ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.minorsIdeal_eq_bot_of_card_lt
statement:
theorem minorsIdeal_eq_bot_of_card_lt (d : Matrix m n A) {r : ℕ} (h : Fintype.card n < r) :
    GraphBundles.minorsIdeal r d = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [GraphBundles.minorsIdeal, Ideal.span_eq_bot]
  rintro _ ⟨⟨S, T⟩, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨a, b, hne, heq⟩ := Fintype.exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt T (by simpa using h)
  exact Matrix.det_zero_of_column_eq hne (fun i => by simp [heq])

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.le_card_of_minorsIdeal_eq_top
statement:
theorem le_card_of_minorsIdeal_eq_top [Nontrivial A] (d : Matrix m n A) {c : ℕ}
    (h : GraphBundles.minorsIdeal c d = ⊤) : c ≤ Fintype.card n
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hlt
  rw [minorsIdeal_eq_bot_of_card_lt d (not_le.1 hlt)] at h
  exact bot_ne_top h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.exact_conj
statement:
theorem exact_conj (f : P₂ →ₗ[R] P₁) (g : P₁ →ₗ[R] P₀) (e₀ : Q₀ ≃ₗ[R] P₀) (e₁ : Q₁ ≃ₗ[R] P₁)
    (e₂ : Q₂ ≃ₗ[R] P₂) (h : Function.Exact f g) :
    Function.Exact (e₁.symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ f ∘ₗ e₂.toLinearMap)
      (e₀.symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ g ∘ₗ e₁.toLinearMap)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, Function.comp_apply, Set.mem_range]
  constructor
  · intro hy
    have hy' : g (e₁ y) = 0 := by simpa using hy
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (h (e₁ y)).1 hy'
    exact ⟨e₂.symm z, by simp [hz]⟩
  · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
    simp [h.apply_apply_eq_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.piAlg_apply
statement: theorem piAlg_apply (n : Type*) (v : n → R) : piAlg (A := A) n v = algebraMap R A ∘ v
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.map_piAlg_mulVecLin
statement:
theorem map_piAlg_mulVecLin (D : Matrix m n R) :
    IsLocalizedModule.map S (piAlg (A := A) n) (piAlg (A := A) m) D.mulVecLin =
      ((D.map (algebraMap R A)).mulVecLin).restrictScalars R
proof:
:= by
  apply IsLocalizedModule.linearMap_ext S (piAlg (A := A) n) (piAlg (A := A) m)
  rw [IsLocalizedModule.map_comp]
  refine LinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
  funext i
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, LinearMap.coe_restrictScalars,
    Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, piAlg_apply]
  exact RingHom.map_mulVec (algebraMap R A) D v i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.exact_map_of_exact
statement:
theorem exact_map_of_exact (D₁ : Matrix n p R) (D₀ : Matrix m n R)
    (h : Function.Exact D₁.mulVecLin D₀.mulVecLin) :
    Function.Exact (D₁.map (algebraMap R A)).mulVecLin (D₀.map (algebraMap R A)).mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  have := IsLocalizedModule.map_exact S (piAlg (A := A) p) (piAlg (A := A) n)
    (piAlg (A := A) m) _ _ h
  rw [map_piAlg_mulVecLin, map_piAlg_mulVecLin] at this
  exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.surjective_map_of_surjective
statement:
theorem surjective_map_of_surjective (D : Matrix n p R) (h : Function.Surjective D.mulVecLin) :
    Function.Surjective (D.map (algebraMap R A)).mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  have hex : Function.Exact D.mulVecLin (0 : Matrix (Fin 0) n R).mulVecLin :=
    fun y => ⟨fun _ => h y, fun _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
  have := exact_map_of_exact (A := A) S D _ hex
  exact fun y => (this y).1 (Subsingleton.elim _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.exists_affineFrameCover_card
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin, hcard⟩ := hE
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := hqfin
  choose κ hsub heq using
    fun i ↦ Opens.isBasis_iff_cover.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens (q.X i)
  let U : (Σ i : q.I, κ i) → X.Opens := fun j ↦ j.2
  refine ⟨
    { I := Σ i : q.I, κ i
      U := U
      covers := ?_
      isAffine := fun j ↦ hsub j.1 j.2.2
      basisIndex := fun j ↦ (q.generators j.1).I
      basisIndex_finite := fun j ↦ by
        letI : (q.generators j.1).IsFiniteType :=
          SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType j.1
        infer_instance
      frame := fun j ↦ ?_ }, fun j => hcard j.1⟩
  · have hcover : IsOpenCover q.X :=
      (Opens.coversTop_iff X q.X).mp q.coversTop
    rw [IsOpenCover, iSup_sigma, ← hcover]
    refine iSup_congr fun i ↦ ?_
    rw [heq i, sSup_eq_iSup']
  · let F := SheafOfModules.overMap X.ringCatSheaf
      (homOfLE (show U j ≤ q.X j.1 by
        dsimp only [U]
        simp [heq, le_sSup]))
    exact
      Scheme.Modules.freeOverMapIso X (q.X j.1) (U j)
          (show U j ≤ q.X j.1 by
            dsimp only [U]
            simp [heq, le_sSup])
          (q.generators j.1).I ≪≫
        F.mapIso (asIso (q.generators j.1).π) ≪≫
          (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf
            (homOfLE (show U j ≤ q.X j.1 by
              dsimp only [U]
              simp [heq, le_sSup]))).app E

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.subsingleton_sections_of_isZero
statement:
theorem subsingleton_sections_of_isZero {E : X.Modules} (h : IsZero E) (V : X.Opens) :
    Subsingleton (E.val.obj (op V))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun a b => ?_⟩
  have key : ∀ s : E.val.obj (op V), s = 0 := fun s => by
    have h2 : s = ((0 : E ⟶ E).val.app (op V)).hom s :=
      congrArg (fun f : E ⟶ E => (f.val.app (op V)).hom s) (h.eq_of_src (𝟙 E) 0)
    rw [h2]
    rfl
  rw [key a, key b]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.exists_sectionFrames
statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.exists_sectionFrames (C : RankedBundleComplex X) {U : X.Opens}
    {x : X} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    ∃ (V : X.affineOpens) (_ : x ∈ V.1), V.1 ≤ U ∧
      Nonempty (∀ j, (ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j)) → Γ(X, V.1)) ≃ₗ[Γ(X, V.1)]
        (C.K.E j).val.obj (op V.1))
proof:
:= by
  choose CF hCF using fun j => exists_affineFrameCover_card (C.hrank j)
  have hmem : ∀ j, ∃ i, x ∈ (CF j).U i := by
    intro j
    have : x ∈ (⨆ i, (CF j).U i : X.Opens) := by rw [(CF j).covers]; trivial
    exact Opens.mem_iSup.1 this
  choose ι hι using hmem
  let O : X.Opens := U ⊓ (Finset.range (C.K.len + 1)).inf fun j => (CF j).U (ι j)
  have hxO : x ∈ O := by
    refine ⟨hx, ?_⟩
    refine Finset.inf_induction (p := fun W : X.Opens => x ∈ W) trivial
      (fun a ha b hb => ⟨ha, hb⟩) fun j _ => hι j
  obtain ⟨V', hV', hxV', hV'O⟩ := (Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.1 X.isBasis_affineOpens) hxO
  let V : X.affineOpens := ⟨V', hV'⟩
  have hVU : V.1 ≤ U := hV'O.trans inf_le_left
  have hVj : ∀ j, j ≤ C.K.len → V.1 ≤ (CF j).U (ι j) := fun j hj =>
    hV'O.trans (inf_le_right.trans (Finset.inf_le (Finset.mem_range.2 (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hj))))
  refine ⟨V, hxV', hVU, ⟨fun j => ?_⟩⟩
  by_cases hj : j ≤ C.K.len
  · letI : Finite ((CF j).basisIndex (ι j)) := (CF j).basisIndex_finite (ι j)
    have hc : Nat.card ((CF j).basisIndex (ι j)) = C.frRank j := by
      rw [hCF j]
      show C.rank j = if j ≤ C.K.len then C.rank j else 0
      rw [if_pos hj]
    let e : (CF j).basisIndex (ι j) ≃ ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j)) :=
      (Finite.equivFinOfCardEq hc).trans Equiv.ulift.symm
    exact (((CF j).restrictedSectionBasis (ι j) V.1 (hVj j hj)).reindex e).equivFun.symm
  · haveI := subsingleton_sections_of_isZero (C.K.isZero_E j (not_le.1 hj)) V.1
    haveI : IsEmpty (ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j))) :=
      ⟨fun a => by
        have h := a.down.2
        change a.down.1 < (if j ≤ C.K.len then C.rank j else 0) at h
        rw [if_neg hj] at h
        exact Nat.not_lt_zero _ h⟩
    exact LinearEquiv.ofSubsingleton _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.stalkSplit_of_sectionExactOn
statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.stalkSplit_of_sectionExactOn (C : RankedBundleComplex X)
    {U : X.Opens} (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) {x : X} (hx : x ∈ U) : C.StalkSplit x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hxV, hVU, ⟨fr⟩⟩ := C.exists_sectionFrames hx
  obtain ⟨hsurj, hex⟩ := hC V hVU
  
  have hexR : ∀ j, Function.Exact (frameMat C V fr (j + 1)).mulVecLin
      (frameMat C V fr j).mulVecLin := by
    intro j
    rw [frameMat_mulVecLin, frameMat_mulVecLin]
    exact exact_conj _ _ (fr j) (fr (j + 1)) (fr (j + 2)) (hex j)
  have hsurjR : Function.Surjective (frameMat C V fr 0).mulVecLin := by
    rw [frameMat_mulVecLin]
    simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
    exact (fr 0).symm.surjective.comp (hsurj.comp (fr 1).surjective)
  
  let A := X.presheaf.stalk x
  letI : Algebra Γ(X, V.1) A := TopCat.Presheaf.algebra_section_stalk X.presheaf ⟨x, hxV⟩
  haveI := V.2.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hxV⟩
  let dA : ∀ j, (ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank (j + 1))) → A) →ₗ[A] (ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j)) → A) :=
    fun j => ((frameMat C V fr j).map (algebraMap Γ(X, V.1) A)).mulVecLin
  have hexA : ∀ j, Function.Exact (dA (j + 1)) (dA j) := fun j =>
    exact_map_of_exact (V.2.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxV⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl _ _ (hexR j)
  have hsurjA : Function.Surjective (dA 0) :=
    surjective_map_of_surjective (V.2.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxV⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl _ hsurjR
  choose cs hcs using exists_linMinorsIdeal_split_of_exact
    (F := fun j => ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j)) → A) dA hsurjA hexA
  let c : ℕ → ℕ := fun j => match j with
    | 0 => 0
    | j + 1 => cs j
  refine ⟨V, hxV, frameDataOfFrames C V fr, c, fun j hj => ?_, fun j hj => ?_⟩
  · rcases j with _ | j
    · exact Nat.zero_le _
    · have h1 := (hcs j).1
      change linMinorsIdeal (((frameMat C V fr j).map (algebraMap Γ(X, V.1) A)).mulVecLin)
        (cs j) = ⊤ at h1
      rw [linMinorsIdeal_mulVecLin] at h1
      have := le_card_of_minorsIdeal_eq_top _ h1
      rw [Fintype.card_ulift, Fintype.card_fin] at this
      change cs j ≤ (if j + 1 ≤ C.K.len then C.rank (j + 1) else 0) at this
      rw [if_pos hj] at this
      exact this
  · rcases j with _ | j
    · refine ⟨minorsIdeal_zero _, ?_⟩
      rw [minorsIdeal_of_isEmpty_rows]
      simp
    · have h1 := hcs j
      change linMinorsIdeal (((frameMat C V fr j).map (algebraMap Γ(X, V.1) A)).mulVecLin)
        (cs j) = ⊤ ∧ linMinorsIdeal (((frameMat C V fr j).map (algebraMap Γ(X, V.1) A)).mulVecLin)
        (cs j + 1) = ⊥ at h1
      rw [linMinorsIdeal_mulVecLin, linMinorsIdeal_mulVecLin] at h1
      exact h1

statement: theorem pureRelDim_iso_g2tflat {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (φ : X ≅ Y) : PureRelDim φ.hom 0
proof:
:= by
  intro x _
  let o : X ≃o Y :=
    { toEquiv := (Scheme.homeoOfIso φ).toEquiv
      map_rel_iff' := by
        intro a b
        change (Scheme.homeoOfIso φ) b ⤳ (Scheme.homeoOfIso φ) a ↔ b ⤳ a
        exact (Scheme.homeoOfIso φ).isInducing.specializes_iff }
  have := Order.height_orderIso o x

  rw [this]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FlatBC.isPullback_prodMap_g2tflat
statement:
theorem isPullback_prodMap_g2tflat {Z V : Scheme.{u}} [Z.Over (Spk k)] [V.Over (Spk k)] (b : ℕ)
    (F : Z ⟶ V) [F.IsOver (Spk k)] :
    IsPullback (pullback.map (Z ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k b) (V ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k b) F (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _)
        (by rw [Category.comp_id, comp_over]) (by rw [Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]))
      (pullback.fst (Z ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k b)) (pullback.fst (V ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k b)) F
proof:
:= by
  have t := (IsPullback.of_hasPullback (V ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k b)).flip
  have s : IsPullback (pullback.map (Z ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k b) (V ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k b) F (𝟙 _)
        (𝟙 _) (by rw [Category.comp_id, comp_over]) (by rw [Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]) ≫
          pullback.snd (V ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k b))
      (pullback.fst (Z ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k b)) (toSpec k b) (F ≫ (V ↘ Spk k)) := by
    rw [pullback.lift_snd, Category.comp_id, comp_over]
    exact (IsPullback.of_hasPullback (Z ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k b)).flip
  exact IsPullback.of_right s (pullback.lift_fst _ _ _) t

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FlatBC.pureRelDim_of_isPullback_prodFst_g2tflat
statement:
theorem pureRelDim_of_isPullback_prodFst_g2tflat {Z Z' V : Scheme.{u}} [Z.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Z ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian Z] [V.Over (Spk k)] (b : ℕ) (F : Z ⟶ V)
    [F.IsOver (Spk k)] (q : Z' ⟶ pullback (V ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k b)) (p : Z' ⟶ Z)
    (h : IsPullback q p (pullback.fst (V ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k b)) F) : PureRelDim p b
proof:
:= by
  have hm := isPullback_prodMap_g2tflat k b F
  have hp : p = (h.isoIsPullback _ _ hm).hom ≫ pullback.fst (Z ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k b) :=
    (h.isoIsPullback_hom_snd _ _ hm).symm
  rw [hp]
  exact PureRelDim.comp (pureRelDim_iso_g2tflat (h.isoIsPullback _ _ hm))
    (pureRelDim_prodFst_g2tflat k Z b)

    (ηX (k := k) (C.pullback g) ι' ≫ ι' ≫ q) _ h1

theorem tauRaw_flatPullback_prod [Flat gX] (hgXd : PureRelDim gX b) (U : M.Opens)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FlatBC.tauStd_flatPullback_prod
statement:
theorem tauStd_flatPullback_prod {k : Type u} [Field k] [Infinite k] {M : Scheme.{u}}
    [M.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (M ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian M] [IsIntegral M]
    [Fact (ProjK k M)] (hMK : CIICLASS.ProjectiveIntegralK k M) (C : RankedBundleComplex M)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X]
    [Fact (ProjK k X)] (ι : X ⟶ M) [IsClosedImmersion ι] [ι.IsOver (Spk k)]
    {N : Scheme.{u}} [N.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (N ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian N]
    [IsIntegral N] [Fact (ProjK k N)] (hNK : CIICLASS.ProjectiveIntegralK k N) (g : N ⟶ M)
    [g.IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat g]
    {X' : Scheme.{u}} [X'.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X' ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X']
    [Fact (ProjK k X')] (ι' : X' ⟶ N) [IsClosedImmersion ι'] [ι'.IsOver (Spk k)]
    (gX : X' ⟶ X) [gX.IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat gX] (hsq : IsPullback gX ι' ι g)
    {V : Scheme.{u}} [V.Over (Spk k)] (b : ℕ) (f : M ⟶ V) [f.IsOver (Spk k)]
    (q : N ⟶ pullback (V ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k b))
    (hpr : IsPullback q g (pullback.fst (V ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k b)) f)
    (hgXd : PureRelDim gX b) (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U)
    (hX : ∀ x : M, x ∉ U → x ∈ Set.range ι)
    (hC' : (C.pullback g).SectionExactOn (g ⁻¹ᵁ U)) {n n' : ℕ} (hnd : n + b = n')
    (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) (hN : height (genericPoint N) = n') :
    totalPullOn (opsK k) gX b hgXd (tauStd hMK C ι U hC hM) =
      tauStd hNK (C.pullback g) ι' (g ⁻¹ᵁ U) hC' hN
proof:
:= by
  letI := prodP1Over (k := k) (A := M)
  letI := blowupOver (k := k) (graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := prodP1_lft (k := k) (A := M)
  haveI := prodP1_isNoetherian (k := k) (A := M)
  haveI := blowup_locallyOfFiniteType
    (CIICLASS.projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod hMK 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
    (graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) (graphIdeal_ne_bot C.toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := blowup_isNoetherian
    (CIICLASS.projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod hMK 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
    (graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) (graphIdeal_ne_bot C.toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := C.isIntegral_graphModel (k := k) hMK
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (C.graphModel (k := k))) :=
    ⟨projK_of_projectiveIntegralK (projectiveIntegralK_graphModel hMK C.toDetIdealComplex)⟩
  haveI : (xiProj (k := k) C).IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨Category.assoc _ _ _⟩
  letI := prodP1Over (k := k) (A := N)
  letI := blowupOver (k := k) (graphIdeal (k := k) (C.pullback g).toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := prodP1_lft (k := k) (A := N)
  haveI := prodP1_isNoetherian (k := k) (A := N)
  haveI := blowup_locallyOfFiniteType
    (CIICLASS.projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod hNK 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
    (graphIdeal (k := k) (C.pullback g).toDetIdealComplex)
    (graphIdeal_ne_bot (C.pullback g).toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := blowup_isNoetherian
    (CIICLASS.projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod hNK 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
    (graphIdeal (k := k) (C.pullback g).toDetIdealComplex)
    (graphIdeal_ne_bot (C.pullback g).toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := (C.pullback g).isIntegral_graphModel (k := k) hNK
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k ((C.pullback g).graphModel (k := k))) :=
    ⟨projK_of_projectiveIntegralK
      (projectiveIntegralK_graphModel hNK (C.pullback g).toDetIdealComplex)⟩
  haveI : (xiProj (k := k) (C.pullback g)).IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨Category.assoc _ _ _⟩
  exact tauRaw_flatPullback_prod C ι g ι' gX hsq b f q hpr hgXd U hC hX hC' hnd hM hN

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.reesSpecialization_ext_of_fibre
statement:
theorem reesSpecialization_ext_of_fibre (hg₁ : g₁ ≫ p = 𝟙 M) (hg₀ : g₀ ≫ p = 𝟙 M)
    (θ₁ : Φ ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback g₁ ≅ Scheme.Modules.pullback g₁)
    (hθ₁ : ∀ E, (Scheme.Modules.pullback g₁).map (σ.app E) = θ₁.hom.app E)
    (θ₀ : Φ ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback g₀ ≅ Scheme.Modules.pullback g₀)
    (hσ₀ : ∀ E, (Scheme.Modules.pullback g₀).map (σ.app E) = 0)
    (U U₀ : M.Opens) (hC : (extComplex C₁ C₂ c).SectionExactOn U)
    (hC₀ : (sumComplex C₁ C₂).SectionExactOn U₀) {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n)
    (hF : tauRaw (k := k) ((reesComplex p Φ hΦ σ c).pullback g₁) ι U
        (sectionExactOn_isoData (reesFibreUnit p g₁ hg₁ Φ hΦ σ c θ₁ hθ₁).symm hC) hM =
      tauRaw (k := k) ((reesComplex p Φ hΦ σ c).pullback g₀) ι U₀
        (sectionExactOn_isoData (reesFibreZero p g₀ hg₀ Φ hΦ σ c θ₀ hσ₀).symm hC₀) hM) :
    ReesSpecialization (k := k) (extComplex C₁ C₂ c) (sumComplex C₁ C₂) ι U U₀ hC hC₀ hM
proof:
:=
  reesSpecialization_of_fibre (k := k) hMK (extComplex C₁ C₂ c) (sumComplex C₁ C₂)
    ((reesComplex p Φ hΦ σ c).pullback g₁) ((reesComplex p Φ hΦ σ c).pullback g₀) ι
    (reesFibreUnit p g₁ hg₁ Φ hΦ σ c θ₁ hθ₁) (reesFibreZero p g₀ hg₀ Φ hΦ σ c θ₀ hσ₀) U U₀ hC hC₀
    _ _ hM hF

proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.graphChart_modelMap
statement:
theorem graphChart_modelMap :
    graphChart (k := k) D' ≫ modelMap g D D' hJ = lineMap (k := k) g ≫ graphChart (k := k) D
proof:
:= by
  set φ := IsOpenImmersion.lift (graphChart (k := k) D) (graphChart (k := k) D' ≫ modelMap g D D' hJ)
    (range_graphChart_modelMap_subset g D D' hJ) with hφdef
  have hφ : φ ≫ graphChart (k := k) D = graphChart (k := k) D' ≫ modelMap g D D' hJ :=
    IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _
  suffices h : φ = lineMap (k := k) g by rw [← hφ, h]
  apply (isPullback_line (k := k) (A := M)).hom_ext
  · rw [lineMap_toBase, ← graphChart_toBase_fst (k := k) D, ← Category.assoc, hφ, Category.assoc,
      modelMap_toBase_fst, reassoc_of% graphChart_toBase_fst (k := k) D']
  · rw [lineMap_toLineOver, ← cancel_mono (ProjectiveLine.chart k 1), Category.assoc,
      ← (isPullback_graphChart (k := k) D).w, ← Category.assoc, hφ, Category.assoc, modelMap_toP1,
      (isPullback_graphChart (k := k) D').w]

    (hne : z ≠ fibrePt g D p q sN hfib gt hgt ιZ sZ hZ) : fundamentalCycle Z z = 0
proof:
:= by

  intro hg
  obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := hz
  have h1 := fibrePt_specializes g D p q sN hfib gt hgt ιZ sZ hZ l
  have h2 : fibreChart g D p q sN hfib gt hgt ιZ sZ hZ l ⤳ fibrePt g D p q sN hfib gt hgt ιZ sZ hZ := by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.eqs_pencil_comp
statement:
theorem eqs_pencil_comp (y : V) :
    ∃ a : V.presheaf.stalk y, IsUnit a ∧
      eqOfSection (pc'.L (f ≫ gl₁)) (pc'.hL (f ≫ gl₁)) (pc'.s (f ≫ gl₁)) y =
        (f.stalkMap y).hom (eqOfSection (pc'.L gl₁) (pc'.hL gl₁) (pc'.s gl₁) (f y)) * a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a₁, ha₁, h1⟩ := eqOfSection_pullback_eq (f ≫ gl₁) pc'.hM (pc'.hL (f ≫ gl₁)) pc'.σ y
  obtain ⟨a₂, ha₂, h2⟩ := eqOfSection_pullback_eq gl₁ pc'.hM (pc'.hL gl₁) pc'.σ (f y)
  have h2' : (gl₁.stalkMap (f y)).hom (eqOfSection pc'.M pc'.hM pc'.σ (gl₁ (f y))) =
      eqOfSection (pc'.L gl₁) (pc'.hL gl₁) (pc'.s gl₁) (f y) * ↑ha₂.unit⁻¹ := by
    rw [h2, mul_assoc, IsUnit.mul_val_inv, mul_one]
  refine ⟨(f.stalkMap y).hom ↑ha₂.unit⁻¹ * a₁, ((Units.isUnit _).map _).mul ha₁, ?_⟩
  change eqOfSection (pc'.L (f ≫ gl₁)) (pc'.hL (f ≫ gl₁))
    (wPullbackSection (f ≫ gl₁) pc'.σ) y = _
  rw [h1, Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp]
  change (f.stalkMap y).hom ((gl₁.stalkMap (f y)).hom _) * a₁ = _
  erw [h2']
  rw [map_mul, mul_assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.pfHom_pencil_c1
statement:
theorem pfHom_pencil_c1 {k : Type u} [Field k] [V.Over (Spk k)] [V₁.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (V ↘ Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (V₁ ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian V]
    [IsNoetherian V₁] [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsProper f] {n : ℕ} (v : V) (hv : height v = n + 1)
    (D : dimensionCycles V n)
    (hD : ∀ y, D.1 y = C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff
      (eqOfSection (pc'.L (f ≫ gl₁)) (pc'.hL (f ≫ gl₁)) (pc'.s (f ≫ gl₁))) v y) (x : V₁) :
    (D13.pfHom (k := k) f n D).1 x = (f.degree v : ℤ) *
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (eqOfSection (pc'.L gl₁) (pc'.hL gl₁) (pc'.s gl₁)) (f v) x
proof:
:= by
  set O : V₁.Opens := pc'.W gl₁ with hOdef
  have hs1 : ∀ y, D.1 y ≠ 0 → f y ∈ O := fun y hy ↦ by
    rw [hD] at hy
    exact mem_W_of_c1_ne_zero pc' (f ≫ gl₁) hy
  by_cases hvO : f v ∈ O
  swap
  · have hD0 : D = 0 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]
      ext y
      by_contra hy
      rw [hD] at hy
      exact hvO (mem_W_of_c1_ne_zero' pc' (f ≫ gl₁) hy)
    have hR : C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (eqOfSection (pc'.L gl₁) (pc'.hL gl₁) (pc'.s gl₁)) (f v) x = 0 := by
      by_contra h
      exact hvO (mem_W_of_c1_ne_zero' pc' gl₁ h)
    rw [hD0, map_zero, hR, mul_zero]
    rfl
  by_cases hxO : x ∈ O
  swap
  · have hR : C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (eqOfSection (pc'.L gl₁) (pc'.hL gl₁) (pc'.s gl₁)) (f v) x = 0 := by
      by_contra h
      exact hxO (mem_W_of_c1_ne_zero pc' gl₁ h)
    rw [hR, mul_zero]
    change properPushforward f D.1 x = 0
    rw [properPushforward_apply_eq_sum_of_subset f D.1 x ∅ (fun y hy hne ↦
      absurd (hy ▸ hs1 y hne) hxO)]
    simp
  set O' : V.Opens := f ⁻¹ᵁ O with hO'def
  set fO : O'.toScheme ⟶ O.toScheme := f ∣_ O with hfOdef
  have hfO : fO ≫ O.ι = O'.ι ≫ f := morphismRestrict_ι f O
  haveI : fO.IsOver (Spk k) := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.isOver_iff]
    change fO ≫ (O.ι ≫ V₁ ↘ Spk k) = O'.ι ≫ V ↘ Spk k
    rw [← Category.assoc, hfO, Category.assoc, CategoryTheory.comp_over (f := f) (S := Spk k)]
  set x' : O.toScheme := ⟨x, hxO⟩
  have hx' : O.ι x' = x := rfl
  set v' : O'.toScheme := ⟨v, hvO⟩
  have hv' : O'.ι v' = v := rfl
  set D' := resW (k := k) O' n D with hD'def
  have hDext : extOpen (k := k) O' n D' = D :=
    extOpen_eq_of_coeff (k := k) O' n D' D (fun z ↦ resW_apply (k := k) O' n D z)
      (fun y hy ↦ by
        by_contra h
        exact hy (hs1 y h))
  
  have step1 : (D13.pfHom (k := k) f n D).1 x = properPushforward fO D'.1 x' := by
    rw [← hDext]
    change properPushforward f (properPushforward O'.ι D'.1) x = _
    rw [← properPushforward_comp, properPushforward_congr hfO.symm, properPushforward_comp, ← hx',
      pp_apply_inj_g2xfr25 O.ι O.ι.isOpenEmbedding.injective, degree_openImm_g2xfr25]
    simp
  set tO : Γ(O.toScheme, ⊤) := O.topIso.inv (pc'.t gl₁)
  have hv'h : height v' = n + 1 := by
    rw [← height_opensι_g2xfr25 (k := k) O' v']
    exact hv
  
  have hchart : ∀ z : O'.toScheme,
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (eqOfSection (pc'.L (f ≫ gl₁)) (pc'.hL (f ≫ gl₁)) (pc'.s (f ≫ gl₁)))
        (O'.ι v') (O'.ι z) = C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (germEqs (fO.appTop tO)) v' z := by
    intro z
    rw [germEqs_appTop, germEqs_topIso_inv, ← localEquations_pullback_comp_g2tbivf, hfO,
      localEquations_pullback_comp_g2tbivf, ← c1CapPrimeCoeff_openImm]
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hu'⟩ := eqs_pencil_comp pc' f gl₁ (O'.ι z)
    have hzO : f (O'.ι z) ∈ O := z.2
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hb'⟩ := eqs_eq_chartEqs O (pc'.t gl₁) (pc'.principalOn gl₁) (f (O'.ι z)) hzO
    refine c1CapPrimeCoeff_congr_unit _ _ _ _ ((f.stalkMap (O'.ι z)).hom b * u)
      ((hb.map _).mul hu) ?_
    rw [hu', hb', map_mul, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  have hD'eq : D' = divCyc (k := k) (fO.appTop tO) (𝟙 _) n (dimPrimeCycle v' (n + 1) hv'h) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    ext z
    rw [divCyc_apply, c1CapCyclesCoeff_dimPrimeCycle]
    change D'.1 z = _
    rw [hD'def, resW_apply, hD]
    exact hchart z
  rw [step1, hD'eq]
  change (D13.pfHom (k := k) fO n (divCyc (k := k) (fO.appTop tO) (𝟙 _) n
    (dimPrimeCycle v' (n + 1) hv'h))).1 x' = _
  rw [pf_divCyc (k := k) fO tO n (dimPrimeCycle v' (n + 1) hv'h), divCyc_apply]
  have hpf : ∀ w, (D13.pfHom (k := k) fO (n + 1) (dimPrimeCycle v' (n + 1) hv'h)).1 w =
      if fO v' = w then (fO.degree v' : ℤ) else 0 := fun w ↦
    D16.pf_prime_apply fO (n + 1) v' hv'h w
  unfold C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff
  rw [finsum_eq_single _ (fO v') (fun w hw ↦ by rw [hpf w, if_neg (Ne.symm hw), zero_mul]),
    hpf, if_pos rfl]
  have hdeg : fO.degree v' = f.degree v := by
    have h1 := Chow.hom_degree_comp fO O.ι v'
    have h2 := Chow.hom_degree_comp O'.ι f v'
    rw [hfO, h2, degree_openImm_g2xfr25 O'.ι v', degree_openImm_g2xfr25 O.ι (fO v'), one_mul] at h1
    rw [mul_one] at h1
    exact h1.symm
  have hfv : O.ι (fO v') = f v := by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hfO, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    rfl
  rw [hdeg, ← c1CapPrimeCoeff_eqs_chart O (pc'.t gl₁) (pc'.principalOn gl₁), hfv]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.infDimCycle_apply_c1
statement:
theorem infDimCycle_apply_c1 (c₀ : k) {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n)
    (x : C.graphModel (k := k)) :
    (infDimCycle (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex (hW_tlmap (k := k) C hM)).1 x =
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (eqOfSection ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.L
          (graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex))
        ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.hL (graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex))
        ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.s (graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex)))
        (genericPoint (C.graphModel (k := k))) x
proof:
:= by
  set pc' := (RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap
  set gl := graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex
  haveI := GraphModel.isNoetherian_subscheme (infDivisor (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex)
  have hs : pc'.s gl = E26.sectionOfHom (KDGb.pullbackSec gl (RegDeform.p1σi k c₀)) :=
    (KDGb.pullbackSec_app_one gl (RegDeform.p1σi k c₀) ⊤).symm
  have hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf (KDGb.pullbackSec gl (RegDeform.p1σi k c₀)) =
      (infDivisor (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex).subschemeι.ker := by
    rw [KDGb.sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_pullbackSec (RegDeform.p1Line_rank k c₀),
      RegDeform.p1σi_ker, Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_subschemeι]
    rfl
  have hgen : genericPoint (C.graphModel (k := k)) ∉
      Set.range (infDivisor (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex).subschemeι := by
    rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.range_subschemeι]
    exact genericPoint_not_mem_infSupport (k := k) C
  rw [hs]
  exact (c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_pushFund (pc'.hL gl) _ _ hid hgen x).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.dom_isOver_g2tbivf
statement: theorem dom_isOver_g2tbivf : β.IsOver (Spk k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.isOver_iff]
  rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_over (f := xiProj (k := k) C₁) (S := Spk k),
    ← CategoryTheory.comp_over (f := xiProj (k := k) C) (S := Spk k), ← Category.assoc]
  congr 1
  unfold xiProj
  rw [← Category.assoc, hβ]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.dom_toP1_g2tbivf
statement:
theorem dom_toP1_g2tbivf :
    β ≫ graphToP1 (k := k) C₁.toDetIdealComplex = graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex
proof:
:= by
  unfold graphToP1
  rw [← Category.assoc, hβ]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.graphChart_dom
statement:
theorem graphChart_dom :
    graphChart (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex ≫ β = graphChart (k := k) C₁.toDetIdealComplex
proof:
:= by
  have hr : Set.range (graphChart (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex ≫ β) ⊆
      Set.range (graphChart (k := k) C₁.toDetIdealComplex) := by
    rintro _ ⟨l, rfl⟩
    have h : (graphChart (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex ≫ β) l ∈
        graphAway (k := k) C₁.toDetIdealComplex := by
      change graphToBase (k := k) C₁.toDetIdealComplex ((graphChart (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex ≫ β) l) ∈
        (jChart (k := k) (A := M) 1).opensRange
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, Category.assoc, hβ, graphChart_toBase]
      exact ⟨l, rfl⟩
    rw [← opensRange_graphChart] at h
    obtain ⟨l', hl'⟩ := h
    exact ⟨l', hl'⟩
  set φ := IsOpenImmersion.lift (graphChart (k := k) C₁.toDetIdealComplex)
    (graphChart (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex ≫ β) hr
  have hφ : φ ≫ graphChart (k := k) C₁.toDetIdealComplex =
      graphChart (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex ≫ β := IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _
  have h1 : φ = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [← cancel_mono (jChart (k := k) (A := M) 1), Category.id_comp,
      ← graphChart_toBase (k := k) C₁.toDetIdealComplex, ← Category.assoc, hφ, Category.assoc, hβ,
      graphChart_toBase]
    exact (graphChart_toBase (k := k) C₁.toDetIdealComplex).symm
  rw [← hφ, h1, Category.id_comp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.dom_genericPoint
statement:
theorem dom_genericPoint :
    β (genericPoint (C.graphModel (k := k))) = genericPoint (C₁.graphModel (k := k))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isIntegral_line_g2tbivf (N := M)
  rw [← genericPoint_eq_of_isOpenImmersion (graphChart (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex),
    ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, graphChart_dom C C₁ β hβ, genericPoint_eq_of_isOpenImmersion]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.dom_degree_genericPoint
statement: theorem dom_degree_genericPoint : β.degree (genericPoint (C.graphModel (k := k))) = 1
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isIntegral_line_g2tbivf (N := M)
  have h := Chow.hom_degree_comp (graphChart (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) β
    (genericPoint (DeformationSpace.line M))
  rw [graphChart_dom C C₁ β hβ, m7g_degree_openImmersion, m7g_degree_openImmersion, one_mul,
    genericPoint_eq_of_isOpenImmersion] at h
  exact h.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.pfHom_infDimCycle_dom
statement:
theorem pfHom_infDimCycle_dom {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    haveI
proof:
:= dom_isOver_g2tbivf C C₁ β hβ
    haveI : IsProper β := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) β
    D13.pfHom (k := k) β n (infDimCycle (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex (hW_tlmap (k := k) C hM)) =
      infDimCycle (k := k) C₁.toDetIdealComplex (hW_tlmap (k := k) C₁ hM) := by
  haveI := dom_isOver_g2tbivf C C₁ β hβ
  haveI : IsProper β := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) β
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext x
  have hv : height (genericPoint (C.graphModel (k := k))) = n + 1 := by
    rw [hW_tlmap (k := k) C hM]
    push_cast
    rfl
  have hD : ∀ y, (infDimCycle (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex (hW_tlmap (k := k) C hM)).1 y =
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (eqOfSection ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k 0).swap.L
          (β ≫ graphToP1 (k := k) C₁.toDetIdealComplex))
        ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k 0).swap.hL (β ≫ graphToP1 (k := k) C₁.toDetIdealComplex))
        ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k 0).swap.s (β ≫ graphToP1 (k := k) C₁.toDetIdealComplex)))
        (genericPoint (C.graphModel (k := k))) y := by
    intro y
    rw [dom_toP1_g2tbivf C C₁ β hβ]
    exact infDimCycle_apply_c1 C 0 hM y
  change (D13.pfHom (k := k) β n _).1 x = _
  rw [pfHom_pencil_c1 (RegDeform.p1Pencil k 0).swap β _ _ hv _ hD x,
    dom_degree_genericPoint C C₁ β hβ, dom_genericPoint C C₁ β hβ, Nat.cast_one, one_mul,
    infDimCycle_apply_c1 C₁ 0 hM x]

name: SingTau.ses_inl_snd_ss
statement: theorem ses_inl_snd_ss (A B : C) : SES (biprod.inl : A ⟶ A ⊞ B) biprod.snd
proof:
:=
  ⟨biprod.inl_snd, (ShortComplex.Splitting.ofHasBinaryBiproduct A B).shortExact⟩

name: SingTau.Q_biprod_ss
statement:
theorem Q_biprod_ss (hQ : ∀ {A B : C}, (A ≅ B) → S.Q A → S.Q B) {A B : C} (hA : S.Q A)
    (hB : S.Q B) : S.Q (A ⊞ B)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : S.Q (0 : C) := S.P_Q (S.P_zero (isZero_zero C))
  exact hQ (pullbackZeroZeroIso A B ≪≫ (biprod.isoProd A B).symm)
    (S.Q_pullback (0 : A ⟶ 0) (0 : B ⟶ 0) hA hB h0)

name: SingTau.P_biprod_ss
statement:
theorem P_biprod_ss (hQ : ∀ {A B : C}, (A ≅ B) → S.Q A → S.Q B) {A B : C} (hA : S.P A)
    (hB : S.P B) : S.P (A ⊞ B)
proof:
:=
  S.P_ext (ses_inl_snd_ss A B) hA hB (Q_biprod_ss hQ (S.P_Q hA) (S.P_Q hB))

name: SingTau.SplitHS.hE1

name: SingTau.SplitHS.hE3

name: SingTau.SplitHS.rowSES
statement: theorem rowSES : SES (biprod.inl : E1 s ⟶ E2 s) biprod.snd
proof: := ses_inl_snd_ss _ _

name: SingTau.SplitHS.v_τ₁
statement: theorem v_τ₁ : (v s).τ₁ = c1 s
proof: := rfl

name: SingTau.SplitHS.v_τ₂
statement: theorem v_τ₂ : (v s).τ₂ = biprod.desc (c1 s ≫ s.L.f) (c2 s)

statement: theorem v_τ₃ : (v s).τ₃ = c2 s ≫ s.L.g

name: SingTau.SplitHS.next_shortExact
statement: theorem next_shortExact : (snake s).L₀.ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Mono (snake s).L₁.f := (rowSES s).mono
  haveI : Epi (snake s).v₁₂.τ₁ := epi_v_τ₁ s
  have h0 : (snake s).v₂₃.τ₁ = 0 := by
    rw [← cancel_epi (snake s).v₁₂.τ₁, (snake s).w₁₃_τ₁, comp_zero]
  have hz : IsZero (snake s).L₃.X₁ := IsZero.of_epi_eq_zero _ h0
  have hδ : (snake s).L₁'.g = 0 := hz.eq_of_tgt _ _
  exact ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk' (snake s).L₀_exact inferInstance
    ((ShortComplex.exact_iff_epi (snake s).L₁' hδ).1 (snake s).L₁'_exact)

name: SingTau.SplitHS.hE2
statement: theorem hE2 : S.P (E2 s)
proof: := P_biprod_ss hQ (hE1 s) (hE3 s)

name: SingTau.SplitHS.next_h₁
statement: theorem next_h₁ : S.Q (snake s).L₀.X₁
proof:
:=
  hQ (IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso (kernelIsKernel (snake s).v₁₂.τ₁) (snake s).h₀τ₁)
    (S.Q_kernel _ (S.P_Q (hE1 s)) s.h₁)

statement: theorem next_h₂ : S.Q (snake s).L₀.X₂
proof:
:=
  hQ (IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso (kernelIsKernel (snake s).v₁₂.τ₂) (snake s).h₀τ₂)
    (S.Q_kernel _ (S.P_Q (hE2 s hQ)) s.h₂)

name: SingTau.SplitHS.next_h₃
statement: theorem next_h₃ : S.Q (snake s).L₀.X₃
proof:
:=
  hQ (IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso (kernelIsKernel (snake s).v₁₂.τ₃) (snake s).h₀τ₃)
    (S.Q_kernel _ (S.P_Q (hE3 s)) s.h₃)

name: SingTau.SplitHS.colSES₁
statement: theorem colSES₁ : SES (snake s).v₀₁.τ₁ (v s).τ₁
proof:
:=
  ⟨(snake s).w₀₂_τ₁, ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk' (snake s).exact_C₁_up
    (snake s).mono_v₀₁_τ₁ (epi_v_τ₁ s)⟩

name: SingTau.SplitHS.colSES₂

:=

    (snake s).mono_v₀₁_τ₂ (epi_v_τ₂ s)⟩

name: SingTau.SplitHS.colSES₃
statement: theorem colSES₃ : SES (snake s).v₀₁.τ₃ (v s).τ₃
proof:
