name: SingTau.SplitHS.chain_inl
statement:
theorem chain_inl : ((v (next s hQ)).τ₁ ≫ (snake s).v₀₁.τ₁) ≫ biprod.inl =
    biprod.inl ≫ ((v (next s hQ)).τ₂ ≫ (snake s).v₀₁.τ₂)
proof:
:=
  calc ((v (next s hQ)).τ₁ ≫ (snake s).v₀₁.τ₁) ≫ biprod.inl
      = (v (next s hQ)).τ₁ ≫ ((snake s).v₀₁.τ₁ ≫ (snake s).L₁.f) := Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = (v (next s hQ)).τ₁ ≫ ((snake s).L₀.f ≫ (snake s).v₀₁.τ₂) :=
        congrArg (fun t => (v (next s hQ)).τ₁ ≫ t) (snake s).v₀₁.comm₁₂
    _ = ((v (next s hQ)).τ₁ ≫ (next s hQ).L.f) ≫ (snake s).v₀₁.τ₂ := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = ((row (next s hQ)).f ≫ (v (next s hQ)).τ₂) ≫ (snake s).v₀₁.τ₂ := by
        rw [(v (next s hQ)).comm₁₂]
    _ = biprod.inl ≫ ((v (next s hQ)).τ₂ ≫ (snake s).v₀₁.τ₂) := Category.assoc _ _ _

name: SingTau.SplitHS.chain_snd
statement:
theorem chain_snd : ((v (next s hQ)).τ₂ ≫ (snake s).v₀₁.τ₂) ≫ biprod.snd =
    biprod.snd ≫ ((v (next s hQ)).τ₃ ≫ (snake s).v₀₁.τ₃)
proof:
:=
  calc ((v (next s hQ)).τ₂ ≫ (snake s).v₀₁.τ₂) ≫ biprod.snd
      = (v (next s hQ)).τ₂ ≫ ((snake s).v₀₁.τ₂ ≫ (snake s).L₁.g) := Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = (v (next s hQ)).τ₂ ≫ ((snake s).L₀.g ≫ (snake s).v₀₁.τ₃) :=
        congrArg (fun t => (v (next s hQ)).τ₂ ≫ t) (snake s).v₀₁.comm₂₃
    _ = ((v (next s hQ)).τ₂ ≫ (next s hQ).L.g) ≫ (snake s).v₀₁.τ₃ := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = ((row (next s hQ)).g ≫ (v (next s hQ)).τ₃) ≫ (snake s).v₀₁.τ₃ := by
        rw [(v (next s hQ)).comm₂₃]
    _ = biprod.snd ≫ ((v (next s hQ)).τ₃ ≫ (snake s).v₀₁.τ₃) := Category.assoc _ _ _

name: SingTau.SplitHS.isIso_v
statement:
theorem isIso_v (hz : IsZero s.L.X₁) (hP₂ : S.P s.L.X₂) :
    IsIso (v s).τ₁ ∧ IsIso (v s).τ₂ ∧ IsIso (v s).τ₃
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIso (c1 s) := (C1 s).isIso_coverMap (S.P_zero hz)
  haveI : IsIso (c2 s) := (C2 s).isIso_coverMap hP₂
  have hE1z : IsZero (E1 s) := hz.of_iso (asIso (c1 s))
  haveI : IsIso s.L.g := (s.hL.isIso_g_iff).2 hz
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [v_τ₁]; infer_instance
  · rw [v_τ₂]
    refine ⟨⟨inv (c2 s) ≫ biprod.inr, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · apply biprod.hom_ext'
      · exact hE1z.eq_of_src _ _
      · rw [biprod.inr_desc_assoc, IsIso.hom_inv_id_assoc, Category.comp_id]
    · rw [Category.assoc, biprod.inr_desc, IsIso.inv_hom_id]
  · rw [v_τ₃]; infer_instance

name: SingTau.SplitHS.isZero_of_iso_v₁
statement: theorem isZero_of_iso_v₁ (h : IsIso (v s).τ₁) : IsZero (snake s).L₀.X₁
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIso (snake s).v₁₂.τ₁ := h
  have h0 : (snake s).v₀₁.τ₁ = 0 := by
    rw [← cancel_mono (snake s).v₁₂.τ₁, (snake s).w₀₂_τ₁, zero_comp]
  exact @IsZero.of_mono_eq_zero _ _ _ _ _ _ (snake s).mono_v₀₁_τ₁ h0

name: SingTau.SplitHS.isZero_of_iso_v₂
statement: theorem isZero_of_iso_v₂ (h : IsIso (v s).τ₂) : IsZero (snake s).L₀.X₂
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIso (snake s).v₁₂.τ₂ := h
  have h0 : (snake s).v₀₁.τ₂ = 0 := by
    rw [← cancel_mono (snake s).v₁₂.τ₂, (snake s).w₀₂_τ₂, zero_comp]
  exact @IsZero.of_mono_eq_zero _ _ _ _ _ _ (snake s).mono_v₀₁_τ₂ h0

name: SingTau.SplitHS.isZero_of_iso_v₃
statement: theorem isZero_of_iso_v₃ (h : IsIso (v s).τ₃) : IsZero (snake s).L₀.X₃
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIso (snake s).v₁₂.τ₃ := h
  have h0 : (snake s).v₀₁.τ₃ = 0 := by
    rw [← cancel_mono (snake s).v₁₂.τ₃, (snake s).w₀₂_τ₃, zero_comp]
  exact @IsZero.of_mono_eq_zero _ _ _ _ _ _ (snake s).mono_v₀₁_τ₃ h0

name: SingTau.SplitHS.isZero_next
statement:
theorem isZero_next (hz : IsZero s.L.X₁) (hP₂ : S.P s.L.X₂) :
    IsZero (next s hQ).L.X₁ ∧ IsZero (next s hQ).L.X₂ ∧ IsZero (next s hQ).L.X₃
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := isIso_v s hz hP₂
  exact ⟨isZero_of_iso_v₁ s h1, isZero_of_iso_v₂ s h2, isZero_of_iso_v₃ s h3⟩

name: SingTau.SplitHS.P_next
statement:
theorem P_next (hP₁ : S.P s.L.X₁) (hP₂ : S.P s.L.X₂) (hP₃ : S.P s.L.X₃) :
    IsZero (next s hQ).L.X₁ ∧ S.P (next s hQ).L.X₂ ∧ S.P (next s hQ).L.X₃
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIso (c1 s) := (C1 s).isIso_coverMap hP₁
  refine ⟨isZero_of_iso_v₁ s (by rw [v_τ₁]; infer_instance), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact S.P_ker (colSES₂ s) (hE2 s hQ) hP₂ (next_h₂ s hQ)
  · exact S.P_ker (colSES₃ s) (hE3 s) hP₃ (next_h₃ s hQ)

name: SingTau.SplitHS.isZero_E
statement:
theorem isZero_E (hz₁ : IsZero s.L.X₁) (hz₂ : IsZero s.L.X₂) :
    IsZero (E1 s) ∧ IsZero (E2 s) ∧ IsZero (E3 s)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIso (c1 s) := (C1 s).isIso_coverMap (S.P_zero hz₁)
  haveI : IsIso (c2 s) := (C2 s).isIso_coverMap (S.P_zero hz₂)
  have h1 : IsZero (E1 s) := hz₁.of_iso (asIso (c1 s))
  have h3 : IsZero (E3 s) := hz₂.of_iso (asIso (c2 s))
  exact ⟨h1, (biprod_isZero_iff _ _).2 ⟨h1, h3⟩, h3⟩

name: SingTau.ssStage_P
statement:
theorem ssStage_P (s₀ : SesQ S) {d₁ d₂ d₃ : ℕ} (hd₁ : PdLE S d₁ s₀.L.X₁)
    (hd₂ : PdLE S d₂ s₀.L.X₂) (hd₃ : PdLE S d₃ s₀.L.X₃) (N : ℕ) (h₁ : d₁ ≤ N) (h₂ : d₂ ≤ N)
    (h₃ : d₃ ≤ N) : ∀ j, N ≤ j → S.P (ssStage hQ s₀ j).L.X₁ ∧ S.P (ssStage hQ s₀ j).L.X₂ ∧
      S.P (ssStage hQ s₀ j).L.X₃
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    have hN : N = 0 := by omega
    subst hN
    exact ⟨(pdLE_zero_iff S).1 (by have : d₁ = 0 := by omega
                                   subst this; exact hd₁),
      (pdLE_zero_iff S).1 (by have : d₂ = 0 := by omega
                              subst this; exact hd₂),
      (pdLE_zero_iff S).1 (by have : d₃ = 0 := by omega
                              subst this; exact hd₃)⟩
  | succ j ih =>
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j N with h | h
    · have hNj : N = j + 1 := by omega
      subst hNj
      have c1 := syz_chain (S := S) (Z := fun j => (ssStage hQ s₀ j).L.X₁)
        (E := fun j => E1 (ssStage hQ s₀ j)) (fun j => (snake (ssStage hQ s₀ j)).v₀₁.τ₁)
        (fun j => (v (ssStage hQ s₀ j)).τ₁) (fun j => colSES₁ (ssStage hQ s₀ j))
        (fun j => hE1 (ssStage hQ s₀ j)) (fun j => (ssStage hQ s₀ j).h₁) (j + 1) 0
      have c2 := syz_chain (S := S) (Z := fun j => (ssStage hQ s₀ j).L.X₂)
        (E := fun j => E2 (ssStage hQ s₀ j)) (fun j => (snake (ssStage hQ s₀ j)).v₀₁.τ₂)
        (fun j => (v (ssStage hQ s₀ j)).τ₂) (fun j => colSES₂ (ssStage hQ s₀ j))
        (fun j => hE2 (ssStage hQ s₀ j) hQ) (fun j => (ssStage hQ s₀ j).h₂) (j + 1) 0
      have c3 := syz_chain (S := S) (Z := fun j => (ssStage hQ s₀ j).L.X₃)
        (E := fun j => E3 (ssStage hQ s₀ j)) (fun j => (snake (ssStage hQ s₀ j)).v₀₁.τ₃)
        (fun j => (v (ssStage hQ s₀ j)).τ₃) (fun j => colSES₃ (ssStage hQ s₀ j))
        (fun j => hE3 (ssStage hQ s₀ j)) (fun j => (ssStage hQ s₀ j).h₃) (j + 1) 0
      rw [Nat.zero_add] at c1 c2 c3
      exact ⟨PerfectRepG2.pdLE_mono S h₁ hd₁ _ c1, PerfectRepG2.pdLE_mono S h₂ hd₂ _ c2,
        PerfectRepG2.pdLE_mono S h₃ hd₃ _ c3⟩
    · obtain ⟨hP₁, hP₂, hP₃⟩ := ih h
      obtain ⟨z1, p2, p3⟩ := P_next (ssStage hQ s₀ j) hQ hP₁ hP₂ hP₃
      exact ⟨S.P_zero z1, p2, p3⟩

name: SingTau.ssStage_isZero
statement:
theorem ssStage_isZero (s₀ : SesQ S) {d₁ d₂ d₃ : ℕ} (hd₁ : PdLE S d₁ s₀.L.X₁)
    (hd₂ : PdLE S d₂ s₀.L.X₂) (hd₃ : PdLE S d₃ s₀.L.X₃) :
    ∀ m, IsZero (ssStage hQ s₀ (max d₁ (max d₂ d₃) + 2 + m)).L.X₁ ∧
      IsZero (ssStage hQ s₀ (max d₁ (max d₂ d₃) + 2 + m)).L.X₂ ∧
      IsZero (ssStage hQ s₀ (max d₁ (max d₂ d₃) + 2 + m)).L.X₃
proof:
:= by
  set N := max d₁ (max d₂ d₃)
  have hP := ssStage_P hQ s₀ hd₁ hd₂ hd₃ N (le_max_left _ _)
    (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    obtain ⟨hP₁, hP₂, hP₃⟩ := hP N le_rfl
    obtain ⟨z1, p2, -⟩ := P_next (ssStage hQ s₀ N) hQ hP₁ hP₂ hP₃
    exact isZero_next (ssStage hQ s₀ (N + 1)) hQ z1 p2
  | succ m ih =>
    obtain ⟨z1, z2, -⟩ := ih
    exact isZero_next (ssStage hQ s₀ (N + 2 + m)) hQ z1 (S.P_zero z2)

name: SingTau.ssStage_isZero_E
statement:
theorem ssStage_isZero_E (s₀ : SesQ S) {d₁ d₂ d₃ : ℕ} (hd₁ : PdLE S d₁ s₀.L.X₁)
    (hd₂ : PdLE S d₂ s₀.L.X₂) (hd₃ : PdLE S d₃ s₀.L.X₃) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : max d₁ (max d₂ d₃) + 1 < j) :
    IsZero (E1 (ssStage hQ s₀ j)) ∧ IsZero (E2 (ssStage hQ s₀ j)) ∧
      IsZero (E3 (ssStage hQ s₀ j))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, j = max d₁ (max d₂ d₃) + 2 + m :=
    ⟨j - (max d₁ (max d₂ d₃) + 2), by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨z1, z2, -⟩ := ssStage_isZero hQ s₀ hd₁ hd₂ hd₃ m
  exact isZero_E _ z1 z2

name: SingTau.ssD₁_dd
statement: theorem ssD₁_dd (j : ℕ) : ssD₁ hQ s₀ (j + 1) ≫ ssD₁ hQ s₀ j = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold ssD₁
  exact comp4_eq_zero _ _ _ _ (snake (ssStage hQ s₀ (j + 1))).w₀₂_τ₁

name: SingTau.ssD₂_dd
statement: theorem ssD₂_dd (j : ℕ) : ssD₂ hQ s₀ (j + 1) ≫ ssD₂ hQ s₀ j = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold ssD₂
  exact comp4_eq_zero _ _ _ _ (snake (ssStage hQ s₀ (j + 1))).w₀₂_τ₂

name: SingTau.ssD₃_dd
statement: theorem ssD₃_dd (j : ℕ) : ssD₃ hQ s₀ (j + 1) ≫ ssD₃ hQ s₀ j = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold ssD₃
  exact comp4_eq_zero _ _ _ _ (snake (ssStage hQ s₀ (j + 1))).w₀₂_τ₃

name: SingTau.inl_ssD₂
statement: theorem inl_ssD₂ (j : ℕ) : biprod.inl ≫ ssD₂ hQ s₀ j = ssD₁ hQ s₀ j ≫ biprod.inl
proof:
:=
  (chain_inl (ssStage hQ s₀ j) hQ).symm

name: SingTau.ssD₂_snd
statement: theorem ssD₂_snd (j : ℕ) : ssD₂ hQ s₀ j ≫ biprod.snd = biprod.snd ≫ ssD₃ hQ s₀ j
proof:
:=
  chain_snd (ssStage hQ s₀ j) hQ

name: SingTau.ssD₂_eq
statement:
theorem ssD₂_eq (j : ℕ) :
    ssD₂ hQ s₀ j = biprod.map (ssD₁ hQ s₀ j) (ssD₃ hQ s₀ j) +
      biprod.snd ≫ ssH hQ s₀ j ≫ biprod.inl
proof:
:= by
  have hl := inl_ssD₂ hQ s₀ j
  have hs := ssD₂_snd hQ s₀ j
  apply biprod.hom_ext'
  · rw [hl, Preadditive.comp_add, biprod.inl_map, biprod.inl_snd_assoc, zero_comp, add_zero]
  · apply biprod.hom_ext
    · simp only [ssH, Category.assoc, Preadditive.comp_add, Preadditive.add_comp,
        biprod.inr_map_assoc, biprod.inr_fst, comp_zero, biprod.inr_snd_assoc, biprod.inl_fst,
        Category.comp_id, zero_add]
    · simp only [Category.assoc, Preadditive.comp_add, Preadditive.add_comp, hs,
        biprod.inr_map_assoc, biprod.inr_snd, biprod.inr_snd_assoc, biprod.inl_snd, comp_zero,
        add_zero, Category.comp_id]

name: SingTau.ssD₂_fst
statement:
theorem ssD₂_fst (j : ℕ) :
    ssD₂ hQ s₀ j ≫ biprod.fst = biprod.fst ≫ ssD₁ hQ s₀ j + biprod.snd ≫ ssH hQ s₀ j
proof:
:= by
  rw [ssD₂_eq hQ s₀ j, Preadditive.add_comp, biprod.map_fst, Category.assoc, Category.assoc,
    biprod.inl_fst, Category.comp_id]

name: SingTau.ssH_hdd
statement:
theorem ssH_hdd (j : ℕ) :
    ssH hQ s₀ (j + 1) ≫ ssD₁ hQ s₀ j + ssD₃ hQ s₀ (j + 1) ≫ ssH hQ s₀ j = 0
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : biprod.inr ≫ ssD₂ hQ s₀ (j + 1) ≫ biprod.snd = ssD₃ hQ s₀ (j + 1) := by
    rw [ssD₂_snd, biprod.inr_snd_assoc]
  calc ssH hQ s₀ (j + 1) ≫ ssD₁ hQ s₀ j + ssD₃ hQ s₀ (j + 1) ≫ ssH hQ s₀ j
      = biprod.inr ≫ ssD₂ hQ s₀ (j + 1) ≫
          (biprod.fst ≫ ssD₁ hQ s₀ j + biprod.snd ≫ ssH hQ s₀ j) := by
        rw [Preadditive.comp_add, Preadditive.comp_add, ← e1]
        simp only [ssH, Category.assoc]
    _ = biprod.inr ≫ (ssD₂ hQ s₀ (j + 1) ≫ ssD₂ hQ s₀ j) ≫ biprod.fst := by
        rw [← ssD₂_fst]
        simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = 0 := by rw [ssD₂_dd, zero_comp, comp_zero]

name: SingTau.ssData_ε₁₂
statement:
theorem ssData_ε₁₂ : (ssData₁ hQ s₀ hd₁ hd₂ hd₃).ε ≫ s₀.L.f =
    (biprod.inl : E1 s₀ ⟶ E2 s₀) ≫ (ssData₂ hQ s₀ hd₁ hd₂ hd₃).ε
proof:
:= by
  change ((v s₀).τ₁ ≫ 𝟙 _) ≫ s₀.L.f = biprod.inl ≫ (v s₀).τ₂ ≫ 𝟙 _
  rw [Category.comp_id, Category.comp_id]
  exact (v s₀).comm₁₂

name: SingTau.ssData_ε₂₃
statement:
theorem ssData_ε₂₃ : (ssData₂ hQ s₀ hd₁ hd₂ hd₃).ε ≫ s₀.L.g =
    (biprod.snd : E2 s₀ ⟶ E3 s₀) ≫ (ssData₃ hQ s₀ hd₁ hd₂ hd₃).ε
proof:
:= by
  change ((v s₀).τ₂ ≫ 𝟙 _) ≫ s₀.L.g = biprod.snd ≫ (v s₀).τ₃ ≫ 𝟙 _
  rw [Category.comp_id, Category.comp_id]
  exact (v s₀).comm₂₃

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.CIBCA.tMul_zero_g2tcibca
statement: theorem tMul_zero_g2tcibca (E : Y.Modules) : tMul (0 : Γ(Y, ⊤)) E = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro U
  ext m
  change tRes (0 : Γ(Y, ⊤)) U • m = 0
  have h : tRes (0 : Γ(Y, ⊤)) U = 0 := map_zero (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op).hom
  rw [h, zero_smul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.CIBCA.tMul_add_g2tcibca
statement:
theorem tMul_add_g2tcibca (s t : Γ(Y, ⊤)) (E : Y.Modules) :
    tMul (s + t) E = tMul s E + tMul t E
proof:
:= by
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro U
  ext m
  change tRes (s + t) U • m = tRes s U • m + tRes t U • m
  have h : tRes (s + t) U = tRes s U + tRes t U :=
    map_add (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op).hom s t
  rw [h, add_smul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.CIBCA.tMul_pullback_eq_zero_g2tcibca
statement:
theorem tMul_pullback_eq_zero_g2tcibca {A : Scheme.{u}} (f : A ⟶ Y) (s : Γ(Y, ⊤))
    (E : Y.Modules) (h : tMul s E = 0) :
    tMul (f.appTop s) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let adj := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f
  apply (adj.homEquiv _ _).injective
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, ← tMul_pushforward, Functor.map_zero]
  have hn : adj.unit.app E ≫ tMul s ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E)) = tMul s E ≫ adj.unit.app E :=
    tMul_naturality s (adj.unit.app E)
  have h2 : tMul s E ≫ adj.unit.app E = 0 := by rw [h, zero_comp]
  exact (hn.trans h2).trans comp_zero.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.CIBCA.localGen_eq_topIso_g2tcibca
statement:
theorem localGen_eq_topIso_g2tcibca (W : Y.Opens) (a : Γ(Y, W)) :
    localGen W a = W.topIso.inv a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [localGen, Scheme.Opens.topIso, Functor.mapIso_inv, Iso.op_inv, eqToIso.inv]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.CIBCA.resLE_appTop_localGen_g2tcibca
statement:
theorem resLE_appTop_localGen_g2tcibca {A : Scheme.{u}} (f : A ⟶ Y) (V : Y.Opens) (W : A.Opens)
    (h : W ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (a : Γ(Y, V)) :
    (f.resLE V W h).appTop (localGen V a) = localGen W (f.appLE V W h a)
proof:
:= by
  have e : V.topIso.hom.hom (V.topIso.inv.hom a) = a := Iso.inv_hom_id_apply V.topIso a
  rw [localGen_eq_topIso_g2tcibca, localGen_eq_topIso_g2tcibca, Scheme.Hom.appTop,
    Scheme.Hom.resLE_app_top]
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply]
  rw [e]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.CIBCA.localGen_zero_g2tcibca
statement: theorem localGen_zero_g2tcibca (W : Y.Opens) : localGen W (0 : Γ(Y, W)) = 0
proof:
:=
  map_zero (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_of_eq (Scheme.Opens.ι_image_top W))).op).hom

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.CIBCA.localGen_add_g2tcibca
statement:
theorem localGen_add_g2tcibca (W : Y.Opens) (a b : Γ(Y, W)) :
    localGen W (a + b) = localGen W a + localGen W b
proof:
:=
  map_add (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_of_eq (Scheme.Opens.ι_image_top W))).op).hom a b

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.CIBCA.isQuasicoherent_of_restrict_g2tcibca
statement:
theorem isQuasicoherent_of_restrict_g2tcibca {X : Scheme.{u}} (P : X.Modules)
    (h : ∀ x : X, ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj P).IsQuasicoherent) :
    P.IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  choose U hxU hU using h
  have hcov : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop U := by
    rw [Opens.coversTop_iff]
    exact eq_top_iff.mpr fun x _ => Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨x, hxU x⟩
  letI : ∀ i, (P.over (U i)).IsQuasicoherent := fun i ↦ by
    let R := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι).obj P
    letI : R.IsQuasicoherent := hU i
    let N := (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).inverse.obj R
    letI : N.IsQuasicoherent := isQuasicoherent_overEquiv_inverse (U i) R
    let e : P.over (U i) ≅ N :=
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).unitIso.app (P.over (U i)) ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).inverse.mapIso
          ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv (U i)).app P)
    exact (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent (X.ringCatSheaf.over (U i))).prop_of_iso
      e.symm inferInstance
  exact SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent.of_coversTop P U hcov

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.CIBCA.exists_pair_g2tcibca
statement:
theorem exists_pair_g2tcibca {M N : Scheme.{u}} (g : N ⟶ M) (x : N) :
    ∃ c : PairIdx_g2tcibca g, x ∈ (c.1.1 : N.Opens)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hgx, -⟩ :=
    Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp M.isBasis_affineOpens (Opens.mem_top (g x))
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hx, hWV⟩ :=
    Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp N.isBasis_affineOpens (show x ∈ g ⁻¹ᵁ V from hgx)
  exact ⟨⟨(⟨W, hW⟩, ⟨V, hV⟩), hWV⟩, hx⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.CIBCA.iSup_pair_g2tcibca
statement:
theorem iSup_pair_g2tcibca {M N : Scheme.{u}} (g : N ⟶ M) :
    (⨆ c : PairIdx_g2tcibca g, (c.1.1 : N.Opens)) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  eq_top_iff.mpr fun x _ => by
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_pair_g2tcibca g x
    exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨c, hc⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.CIBCA.killedOn_pushforward_g2tcibca
statement:
theorem killedOn_pushforward_g2tcibca (F : X.Modules) (V : M.affineOpens) :
    KilledOn ι.ker V ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj F)
proof:
:= fun a ha =>
  tMul_eq_zero_of_iso _
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (V : M.Opens).ι).mapIso
      (pushforwardImageIso_g2tcibca ι F).symm)
    (killedOn_pushforward ι.ker ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι.toImage).obj F) V a ha)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.CIBCA.killedOn_g2tcibca
statement:
theorem killedOn_g2tcibca (F : X.Modules) (c : PairIdx_g2tcibca g) :
    KilledOn ((ι.ker).comap g) c.1.1
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj F))
proof:
:= by
  intro r hr
  let W : N.affineOpens := c.1.1
  let V : M.affineOpens := c.1.2
  let E := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj F
  let G := (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E
  have hspan := comap_ideal_le_span g ι.ker V W c.2 hr
  refine Submodule.span_induction
    (p := fun r _ => tMul (localGen (W : N.Opens) r)
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (W : N.Opens).ι).obj G) = 0) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hspan
  · rintro _ ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    have h1 := killedOn_pushforward_g2tcibca ι F V a ha
    have h2 := tMul_pullback_eq_zero_g2tcibca (g.resLE V W c.2) _ _ h1
    rw [resLE_appTop_localGen_g2tcibca] at h2
    exact tMul_eq_zero_of_iso _ (restrictPullbackIso_g2tcibca g V W c.2 E) h2
  · rw [localGen_zero_g2tcibca]
    exact tMul_zero_g2tcibca _
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy
    rw [localGen_add_g2tcibca, tMul_add_g2tcibca, hx, hy, add_zero]
  · intro a x _ hx
    rw [smul_eq_mul, localGen_mul, tMul_mul, hx, comp_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.CIBCA.isQuasicoherent_g2tcibca
statement:
theorem isQuasicoherent_g2tcibca (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj F)).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  apply isQuasicoherent_of_restrict_g2tcibca
  intro x
  obtain ⟨c, hx⟩ := exists_pair_g2tcibca g x
  refine ⟨c.1.1, hx, ?_⟩
  let W : N.affineOpens := c.1.1
  let V : M.affineOpens := c.1.2
  haveI : IsAffine (W : N.Opens) := W.2
  haveI : IsAffine (V : M.Opens) := V.2
  let E := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj F
  haveI : E.IsQuasicoherent := isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isAffineHom ι F
  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (V : M.Opens).ι).obj E).IsQuasicoherent :=
    inferInstance
  haveI := pullback_isQuasicoherent_of_isAffine (g.resLE V W c.2)
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (V : M.Opens).ι).obj E)
  exact (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent (W : N.Opens).toScheme.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
    (restrictPullbackIso_g2tcibca g V W c.2 E).symm inferInstance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.CIBCA.subschemeIso_hom_comp_g2tcibca
statement:
theorem subschemeIso_hom_comp_g2tcibca :
    (subschemeIso_g2tcibca ι ι' g gX hsq).hom ≫ ι' = ((ι.ker).comap g).subschemeι
proof:
:= by
  have hmap : inv (pullback.map ι g ι.ker.subschemeι g ι.toImage (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _)
      (by rw [Category.comp_id]; exact ι.toImage_imageι.symm) (by simp)) ≫ pullback.snd ι g =
      pullback.snd _ _ := by
    rw [IsIso.inv_comp_eq, pullback.lift_snd, Category.comp_id]
  simp only [subschemeIso_g2tcibca, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, asIso_inv, Category.assoc,
    IsPullback.isoPullback_inv_snd, hmap, pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_snd]
  exact Scheme.IdealSheafData.comapIso_hom_fst _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.CIBCA.closedImmersionBaseChange_iso_g2tcibca
statement:
theorem closedImmersionBaseChange_iso_g2tcibca (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj F) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι').obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback gX).obj F))
proof:
:= by
  let J := (ι.ker).comap g
  let E := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj F
  let G := (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E
  haveI : G.IsQuasicoherent := isQuasicoherent_g2tcibca ι g F
  haveI hu : IsIso (ProjectionFormula.adjUnit J.subschemeι G) :=
    isIso_adjUnit_of_killedOn J G (fun c : PairIdx_g2tcibca g => c.1.1) (iSup_pair_g2tcibca g)
      (killedOn_g2tcibca ι g F)
  let e := subschemeIso_g2tcibca ι ι' g gX hsq
  have he : e.hom ≫ ι' = J.subschemeι := subschemeIso_hom_comp_g2tcibca ι ι' g gX hsq
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion ι' := by
    have : ι' = e.inv ≫ J.subschemeι := by rw [← he, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
    rw [this]
    infer_instance
  let K := (Scheme.Modules.pullback J.subschemeι).obj G
  let H := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward e.hom).obj K
  let e1 : G ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι').obj H :=
    asIso (ProjectionFormula.adjUnit J.subschemeι G) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr he.symm).app K ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp e.hom ι').app K).symm
  let adj' := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction ι'
  let adj := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction ι
  haveI : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).Full := (KSpecialization.pushforwardFullyFaithful ι).full
  haveI : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).Faithful :=
    (KSpecialization.pushforwardFullyFaithful ι).faithful
  haveI : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι').Full :=
    (KSpecialization.pushforwardFullyFaithful ι').full
  haveI : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι').Faithful :=
    (KSpecialization.pushforwardFullyFaithful ι').faithful
  haveI : IsIso adj.counit := inferInstance
  haveI : IsIso adj'.counit := inferInstance
  let cF : (Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj E ≅ F :=
    @asIso _ _ _ _ (adj.counit.app F) (NatIso.isIso_app_of_isIso adj.counit F)
  let e2 : H ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback gX).obj F :=
    (asIso (adj'.counit.app H)).symm ≪≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback ι').mapIso e1.symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp ι' g).app E ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr hsq.w.symm).app E ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp gX ι).app E).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback gX).mapIso cF
  exact ⟨e1 ≪≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι').mapIso e2⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.exists_pairIdx
statement:
theorem exists_pairIdx (y : Y) (U₀ : X.Opens) (W₀ : Y.Opens) (hy : y ∈ W₀) (hfy : f y ∈ U₀) :
    ∃ p : PairIdx f, y ∈ p.W.1 ∧ p.U.1 ≤ U₀ ∧ p.W.1 ≤ W₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hfyU, hUU₀⟩ :=
    TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens hfy
  have hyW : y ∈ W₀ ⊓ f ⁻¹ᵁ U := ⟨hy, hfyU⟩
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hyW', hWle⟩ :=
    TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp Y.isBasis_affineOpens hyW
  exact ⟨⟨⟨U, hU⟩, ⟨W, hW⟩, hWle.trans inf_le_right⟩, hyW', hUU₀, hWle.trans inf_le_left⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.range_affineι
statement:
theorem range_affineι (W : Y.affineOpens) :
    Set.range (affineι Y J W) = toBase Y J ⁻¹' (W.1 : Set Y)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (gluingData Y J).preimage_toBase_eq_range_ι W
  have h' : Set.range (Y.directedAffineCover.f W) = (W.1 : Set Y) := Scheme.Opens.range_ι W.1
  rw [h'] at h
  exact h.symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.mem_range_affineι_iff
statement:
theorem mem_range_affineι_iff (W : Y.affineOpens) (z : blowup Y J) :
    z ∈ Set.range (affineι Y J W) ↔ toBase Y J z ∈ W.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [range_affineι]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.pairCover_f
statement: theorem pairCover_f (p : PairIdx f) : (pairCover f J).f p = affineι Y J p.W
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.map_appLE_eq
statement:
theorem map_appLE_eq {J : Y.IdealSheafData} (hJ : I.comap f = J) (p : PairIdx f) :
    (I.ideal p.U).map (f.appLE p.U.1 p.W.1 p.le).hom = J.ideal p.W
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hJ]
  exact (Chow.M7.KDGb.comap_ideal_eq_map f I p.U p.W p.le).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.res_comp_appLE
statement:
theorem res_comp_appLE {p q : PairIdx f} (h₁ : p.U ≤ q.U) (h₂ : p.W ≤ q.W) :
    (res Y h₂).comp (f.appLE q.U.1 q.W.1 q.le).hom =
      (f.appLE p.U.1 p.W.1 p.le).hom.comp (res X h₁)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← CommRingCat.hom_comp, ← CommRingCat.hom_comp]
  congr 1
  rw [Scheme.Hom.appLE_map, Scheme.Hom.map_appLE]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.pairPieceMap_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem pairPieceMap_naturality {J : Y.IdealSheafData} (hJ : I.comap f = J) {p q : PairIdx f}
    (h₁ : p.U ≤ q.U) (h₂ : p.W ≤ q.W) :
    (gluingFunctor Y J).map (homOfLE h₂) ≫ pairPieceMap f I hJ q =
      pairPieceMap f I hJ p ≫ (gluingFunctor X I).map (homOfLE h₁)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gluingFunctor_map, gluingFunctor_map]
  unfold pairPieceMap
  refine (schemeMapOfEq_comp _ _ _ _ _ _ _).trans
    (Eq.trans ?_ (schemeMapOfEq_comp _ _ _ _ _ _ _).symm)
  exact schemeMapOfEq_congr _ (res_comp_appLE f h₁ h₂) _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.pairPieceMap_compat
statement:
theorem pairPieceMap_compat {J : Y.IdealSheafData} (hJ : I.comap f = J) {p q : PairIdx f}
    (h : p ≤ q) :
    (gluingFunctor Y J).map (homOfLE h.2) ≫ pairPieceMap f I hJ q ≫ affineι X I q.U =
      pairPieceMap f I hJ p ≫ affineι X I p.U
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairPieceMap_naturality_assoc f I hJ h.1 h.2]
  exact congrArg (_ ≫ ·) (colimit.w (gluingData X I).functor (homOfLE h.1))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.pairGlue_compat
statement:
theorem pairGlue_compat {J : Y.IdealSheafData} (hJ : I.comap f = J)
    {i j : (pairCover f J).I₀} (hij : i ⟶ j) :
    (pairCover f J).trans hij ≫ pairGlue f I hJ j = pairGlue f I hJ i
proof:
:=
  pairPieceMap_compat f I hJ (leOfHom hij)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.affineι_pullbackMap
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem affineι_pullbackMap {J : Y.IdealSheafData} (hJ : I.comap f = J) (p : PairIdx f) :
    affineι Y J p.W ≫ pullbackMap f I hJ = pairPieceMap f I hJ p ≫ affineι X I p.U
proof:
:=
  (pairCover f J).map_glueMorphismsOfLocallyDirected _ _ p

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.pullbackMap_toBase
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem pullbackMap_toBase {J : Y.IdealSheafData} (hJ : I.comap f = J) :
    pullbackMap f I hJ ≫ toBase X I = toBase Y J ≫ f
proof:
:= by
  refine (pairCover f J).hom_ext _ _ fun p => ?_
  change affineι Y J p.W ≫ _ = affineι Y J p.W ≫ _
  rw [affineι_pullbackMap_assoc, ← (isPullback_affine X I p.U).w,
    ← (isPullback_affine Y J p.W).w_assoc]
  simp only [Category.assoc, IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_inv_ι]
  unfold pairPieceMap
  rw [← Category.assoc, schemeMapOfEq_comp_projection, Category.assoc]
  congr 1
  exact IsAffineOpen.SpecMap_appLE_fromSpec f (isAffineOpen X p.U) (isAffineOpen Y p.W) p.le

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.isProper_pullbackMap
statement:
theorem isProper_pullbackMap [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] [IsProper f]
    {J : Y.IdealSheafData} (hJ : I.comap f = J) : IsProper (pullbackMap f I hJ)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := toBase_isProper X I
  haveI := toBase_isProper Y J
  have h : IsProper (pullbackMap f I hJ ≫ toBase X I) := by
    rw [pullbackMap_toBase]
    infer_instance
  exact MorphismProperty.of_postcomp (W := @IsProper) (W' := @IsSeparated) _ (toBase X I)
    inferInstance h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.range_pullbackMap_eq_closure
statement:
theorem range_pullbackMap_eq_closure [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] [IsProper f]
    {J : Y.IdealSheafData} (hJ : I.comap f = J) {D : Set (blowup Y J)} (hD : Dense D) :
    Set.range (pullbackMap f I hJ) = closure (pullbackMap f I hJ '' D)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isProper_pullbackMap f I hJ
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [← Set.image_univ, ← hD.closure_eq]
    exact image_closure_subset_closure_image (pullbackMap f I hJ).continuous
  · exact ((pullbackMap f I hJ).isClosedMap.isClosed_range).closure_subset_iff.mpr
      (Set.image_subset_range _ _)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.hom_ext_of_affineι
proof:
:= by
  let 𝒰 : (blowup Y J).OpenCover :=
    { I₀ := S
      X W := scheme (J.ideal W.1)
      f W := affineι Y J W.1
      mem₀ := by
        rw [Scheme.presieve₀_mem_precoverage_iff]
        refine ⟨fun z ↦ ?_, fun W ↦ affineι_isOpenImmersion Y J W.1⟩
        obtain ⟨W, hW, hz⟩ := hS (toBase Y J z)
        exact ⟨⟨W, hW⟩, (mem_range_affineι_iff J W z).mpr hz⟩ }
  exact 𝒰.hom_ext _ _ fun W => h W.1 W.2

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.pullbackMap_id
statement: theorem pullbackMap_id : pullbackMap (𝟙 X) I (Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_id I) = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  refine (pairCover (𝟙 X) I).hom_ext _ _ fun p => ?_
  change affineι X I p.W ≫ _ = affineι X I p.W ≫ _
  rw [affineι_pullbackMap, Category.comp_id]
  have hle : p.W ≤ p.U := p.le
  have e : pairPieceMap (𝟙 X) I (Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_id I) p =
      (gluingFunctor X I).map (homOfLE hle) := by
    rw [gluingFunctor_map]
    unfold pairPieceMap
    refine schemeMapOfEq_congr _ ?_ _ _
    change ((𝟙 X : X ⟶ X).app p.U.1 ≫ X.presheaf.map (homOfLE p.le).op).hom = _
    exact congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom (Category.id_comp _)
  rw [e]
  exact colimit.w (gluingData X I).functor (homOfLE hle)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.pullbackMap_comp
statement:
theorem pullbackMap_comp {Z : Scheme.{u}} (g : Z ⟶ Y) {J : Y.IdealSheafData}
    {K : Z.IdealSheafData} (hJ : I.comap f = J) (hK : J.comap g = K) :
    pullbackMap (g ≫ f) I (show I.comap (g ≫ f) = K by
        rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp, hJ, hK]) =
      pullbackMap g J hK ≫ pullbackMap f I hJ
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : I.comap (g ≫ f) = K := by rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp, hJ, hK]
  refine hom_ext_of_affineι K
    {W | ∃ (U : X.affineOpens) (V : Y.affineOpens), V.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 ∧ W.1 ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V.1}
    (fun z => ?_) (fun W hW => ?_)
  · obtain ⟨q, hq, -, -⟩ := exists_pairIdx f (g z) ⊤ ⊤ trivial trivial
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpU, -⟩ := exists_pairIdx g z q.W.1 ⊤ trivial hq
    exact ⟨p.W, ⟨q.U, q.W, q.le, fun x hx => hpU (p.le hx)⟩, hp⟩
  · obtain ⟨U, V, hVU, hWV⟩ := hW
    let pV : PairIdx f := ⟨U, V, hVU⟩
    let pW : PairIdx g := ⟨V, W, hWV⟩
    let pc : PairIdx (g ≫ f) := ⟨U, W, fun x hx => hVU (hWV hx)⟩
    have h1 := affineι_pullbackMap (g ≫ f) I hcomp pc
    have h2 := affineι_pullbackMap g J hK pW
    have h3 := affineι_pullbackMap f I hJ pV
    change affineι Z K pc.W ≫ _ = affineι Z K pW.W ≫ _
    rw [h1, reassoc_of% h2]
    change _ = pairPieceMap g J hK pW ≫ affineι Y J pV.W ≫ pullbackMap f I hJ
    rw [h3, ← Category.assoc]
    congr 1
    unfold pairPieceMap
    rw [schemeMapOfEq_comp]
    refine schemeMapOfEq_congr _ ?_ _ _
    rw [← CommRingCat.hom_comp, Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE]

name: GraphBundles.minor_mem_minorsIdeal
statement:
theorem minor_mem_minorsIdeal {r : ℕ} (d : Matrix m n A) (S : Fin r → m) (T : Fin r → n) :
    (d.submatrix S T).det ∈ minorsIdeal r d
proof:
:=
  Ideal.subset_span ⟨(S, T), rfl⟩

name: GraphBundles.minorsIdeal_zero
statement: theorem minorsIdeal_zero (d : Matrix m n A) : minorsIdeal 0 d = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.eq_top_iff_one]
  have h := minor_mem_minorsIdeal d (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → m) (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → n)
  rwa [det_isEmpty] at h

name: GraphBundles.det_mem_minorsIdeal
statement:
theorem det_mem_minorsIdeal {b : Type*} [Fintype b] [DecidableEq b] (d : Matrix m n A)
    (β : b → m) (γ : b → n) : (d.submatrix β γ).det ∈ minorsIdeal (Fintype.card b) d
proof:
:= by
  let g : Fin (Fintype.card b) ≃ b := (Fintype.equivFin b).symm
  have h := minor_mem_minorsIdeal d (β ∘ g) (γ ∘ g)
  have e : d.submatrix (β ∘ g) (γ ∘ g) = (d.submatrix β γ).submatrix g g := rfl
  rwa [e, det_submatrix_equiv_self] at h

name: GraphBundles.minorsIdeal_map
statement:
theorem minorsIdeal_map {A' : Type*} [CommRing A'] (f : A →+* A') (r : ℕ) (d : Matrix m n A) :
    (minorsIdeal r d).map f = minorsIdeal r (d.map f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [minorsIdeal, minorsIdeal, Ideal.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
  have : (⇑f ∘ fun ST : (Fin r → m) × (Fin r → n) => (d.submatrix ST.1 ST.2).det) =
      fun ST => ((d.map f).submatrix ST.1 ST.2).det := by
    funext ST
    rw [Function.comp_apply, RingHom.map_det]
    rfl
  rw [this]

name: GraphBundles.minorsIdeal_succ_le
statement:
theorem minorsIdeal_succ_le (r : ℕ) (d : Matrix m n A) :
    minorsIdeal (r + 1) d ≤ minorsIdeal r d
proof:
:= by
  refine Ideal.span_le.2 ?_
  rintro _ ⟨⟨S, T⟩, rfl⟩
  change (d.submatrix S T).det ∈ minorsIdeal r d
  rw [det_succ_row_zero]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j _ => Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ ?_
  exact minor_mem_minorsIdeal d (S ∘ Fin.succ) (T ∘ j.succAbove)

name: GraphBundles.minorsIdeal_antitone
statement: theorem minorsIdeal_antitone (d : Matrix m n A) : Antitone fun r : ℕ => minorsIdeal r d
proof:
:=
  antitone_nat_of_succ_le fun r => minorsIdeal_succ_le r d

name: GraphBundles.det_submatrix_equivs
statement:
theorem det_submatrix_equivs (M : Matrix k k A) (f e : n ≃ k) :
    (M.submatrix f e).det = ((Equiv.Perm.sign (e.trans f.symm) : ℤ) : A) * M.det
proof:
:= by
  have h : M.submatrix f e = (M.submatrix f f).submatrix id (e.trans f.symm) := by
    ext i j; simp
  rw [h, det_permute', det_submatrix_equiv_self]

name: GraphBundles.sign_mul_self
statement:
theorem sign_mul_self (σ : Equiv.Perm n) :
    ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : A) * ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : A) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Int.cast_mul, ← Units.val_mul, Int.units_mul_self]; simp

name: GraphBundles.mem_of_sign_mul_mem
statement:
theorem mem_of_sign_mul_mem {I : Ideal A} {x : A} (σ : Equiv.Perm n)
    (h : ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : A) * x ∈ I) : x ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  have := I.mul_mem_left ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : A) h
  rwa [← mul_assoc, sign_mul_self, one_mul] at this

name: GraphBundles.span_pow_mul_span_pow
statement:
theorem span_pow_mul_span_pow (μ l : A) (a b : ℕ) :
    Ideal.span {l} ^ a * Ideal.span {μ} ^ b = Ideal.span {l ^ a * μ ^ b}
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.span_singleton_pow, Ideal.span_singleton_mul_span_singleton]

name: GraphBundles.det_graphMat_block
statement:
theorem det_graphMat_block {a b : Type*} [Fintype a] [Fintype b] [DecidableEq a] [DecidableEq b]
    (μ l : A) (d : Matrix m n A) (e : n ≃ a ⊕ b) (β : b → m) :
    ((graphMat μ l d).submatrix
        (Sum.elim (fun x => Sum.inl (e.symm (Sum.inl x))) (fun y => Sum.inr (β y))) e.symm).det =
      μ ^ Fintype.card a * l ^ Fintype.card b * (d.submatrix β (e.symm ∘ Sum.inr)).det
proof:
:= by
  have h : (graphMat μ l d).submatrix
      (Sum.elim (fun x => Sum.inl (e.symm (Sum.inl x))) (fun y => Sum.inr (β y))) e.symm =
      fromBlocks (μ • (1 : Matrix a a A)) 0 (l • d.submatrix β (e.symm ∘ Sum.inl))
        (l • d.submatrix β (e.symm ∘ Sum.inr)) := by
    ext (x | x) (y | y) <;>
      simp [graphMat, Matrix.fromRows, Matrix.one_apply]
  rw [h, det_fromBlocks_zero₁₂, det_smul, det_smul, det_one]
  ring

name: GraphBundles.det_submatrix_comp_equiv
statement:
theorem det_submatrix_comp_equiv {a b : Type*} [Fintype a] [Fintype b] [DecidableEq a]
    [DecidableEq b] (M : Matrix (n ⊕ m) n A) (R : a ⊕ b → n ⊕ m) (e : n ≃ a ⊕ b) :
    (M.submatrix (R ∘ e) id).det = (M.submatrix R e.symm).det
proof:
:= by
  have h : M.submatrix (R ∘ e) id = (M.submatrix R e.symm).submatrix e e := by
    ext i j; simp
  rw [h, det_submatrix_equiv_self]

name: GraphBundles.graphFormula_le_maxMinors
statement:
theorem graphFormula_le_maxMinors (μ l : A) (d : Matrix m n A) :
    graphFormula μ l d ≤ maxMinors (graphMat μ l d)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine iSup_le fun r => ?_
  rw [span_pow_mul_span_pow, minorsIdeal, Ideal.span_mul_span', Ideal.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨⟨S, T⟩, rfl⟩, _, rfl, rfl⟩
  change (d.submatrix S T).det * (l ^ (r : ℕ) * μ ^ (Fintype.card n - r)) ∈ _
  by_cases hT : Function.Injective T
  · 
    let e : n ≃ {c : n // c ∉ Set.range T} ⊕ Fin r :=
      (Equiv.sumCompl fun c : n => c ∈ Set.range T).symm.trans
        ((Equiv.sumComm _ _).trans (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl _) (Equiv.ofInjective T hT).symm))
    have he : ∀ i : Fin r, e.symm (Sum.inr i) = T i := by
      intro i
      simp [e, Equiv.sumCongr, Equiv.ofInjective]
    have hcard : Fintype.card {c : n // c ∉ Set.range T} = Fintype.card n - r := by
      rw [Fintype.card_subtype_compl, Set.card_range_of_injective hT, Fintype.card_fin]
    let R : {c : n // c ∉ Set.range T} ⊕ Fin r → n ⊕ m :=
      Sum.elim (fun x => Sum.inl (e.symm (Sum.inl x))) (fun y => Sum.inr (S y))
    have hdet := det_graphMat_block μ l d e S
    have hT' : (e.symm ∘ Sum.inr : Fin r → n) = T := funext he
    rw [hT', hcard, Fintype.card_fin] at hdet
    have hmem := minor_mem_maxMinors (graphMat μ l d) (R ∘ e)
    rw [det_submatrix_comp_equiv, hdet] at hmem
    rw [show (d.submatrix S T).det * (l ^ (r : ℕ) * μ ^ (Fintype.card n - r)) =
      μ ^ (Fintype.card n - r) * l ^ (r : ℕ) * (d.submatrix S T).det by ring]
    exact hmem
  · obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hne⟩ := Function.not_injective_iff.1 hT
    rw [det_zero_of_column_eq hne (fun k => by simp [hij]), zero_mul]
    exact Ideal.zero_mem _

name: GraphBundles.maxMinors_le_graphFormula
statement:
theorem maxMinors_le_graphFormula (μ l : A) (d : Matrix m n A) :
    maxMinors (graphMat μ l d) ≤ graphFormula μ l d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Ideal.span_le.2 ?_
  rintro _ ⟨S, rfl⟩
  change ((graphMat μ l d).submatrix S id).det ∈ graphFormula μ l d
  by_cases hS : Function.Injective S
  · let P := {i : n // (S i).isLeft = true}
    let Q := {i : n // ¬ (S i).isLeft = true}
    let α : P → n := fun i => (S i.1).getLeft i.2
    let β : Q → m := fun i => (S i.1).getRight (by simpa using i.2)
    have hα : Function.Injective α := by
      intro i j hij
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply hS
      rw [← Sum.inl_getLeft (S i.1) i.2, ← Sum.inl_getLeft (S j.1) j.2]
      exact congrArg Sum.inl hij
    have hcard : Fintype.card {c : n // c ∉ Set.range α} = Fintype.card Q := by
      rw [Fintype.card_subtype_compl, Set.card_range_of_injective hα]
      have := Fintype.card_subtype_compl (fun i : n => (S i).isLeft = true)
      simp only [P, Q] at this ⊢
      omega
    let e : n ≃ P ⊕ Q :=
      (Equiv.sumCompl fun c : n => c ∈ Set.range α).symm.trans
        (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.ofInjective α hα).symm (Fintype.equivOfCardEq hcard))
    have he : ∀ x : P, e.symm (Sum.inl x) = α x := by
      intro x
      simp [e, Equiv.sumCongr]
    let f : n ≃ P ⊕ Q := (Equiv.sumCompl fun i : n => (S i).isLeft = true).symm
    let R : P ⊕ Q → n ⊕ m :=
      Sum.elim (fun x => Sum.inl (e.symm (Sum.inl x))) (fun y => Sum.inr (β y))
    have hSR : S = R ∘ f := by
      funext i
      by_cases hi : (S i).isLeft = true
      · have hf : f i = Sum.inl ⟨i, hi⟩ := by simp [f, Equiv.sumCompl, hi]
        simp only [Function.comp_apply, hf, R, Sum.elim_inl, he]
        exact (Sum.inl_getLeft (S i) hi).symm
      · have hf : f i = Sum.inr ⟨i, hi⟩ := by simp [f, Equiv.sumCompl, hi]
        simp only [Function.comp_apply, hf, R, Sum.elim_inr, β]
        exact (Sum.inr_getRight (S i) (by simpa using hi)).symm
    have hdet := det_graphMat_block μ l d e β
    
    have h1 : (graphMat μ l d).submatrix S id =
        ((graphMat μ l d).submatrix R e.symm).submatrix f e := by
      rw [hSR]; ext i j; simp
    rw [h1, det_submatrix_equivs, hdet]
    refine (mem_of_sign_mul_mem (A := A) (n := n) (e.trans f.symm) ?_)
    rw [← mul_assoc, sign_mul_self, one_mul]
    have hPQ : Fintype.card P + Fintype.card Q = Fintype.card n := by
      have := Fintype.card_subtype_compl (fun i : n => (S i).isLeft = true)
      have h2 := Fintype.card_subtype_le (fun i : n => (S i).isLeft = true)
      simp only [P, Q] at this ⊢
      omega
    let r : Fin (Fintype.card n + 1) := ⟨Fintype.card Q, by omega⟩
    refine le_iSup (fun r : Fin (Fintype.card n + 1) =>
      minorsIdeal r d * (Ideal.span {l} ^ (r : ℕ) * Ideal.span {μ} ^ (Fintype.card n - r))) r ?_
    rw [span_pow_mul_span_pow]
    have hr : (r : ℕ) = Fintype.card Q := rfl
    have hnr : Fintype.card n - r = Fintype.card P := by rw [hr]; omega
    rw [hnr, hr]
    have := Ideal.mul_mem_mul (det_mem_minorsIdeal d β (e.symm ∘ Sum.inr))
      (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self (l ^ Fintype.card Q * μ ^ Fintype.card P))
    rw [show μ ^ Fintype.card P * l ^ Fintype.card Q * (d.submatrix β (e.symm ∘ Sum.inr)).det =
      (d.submatrix β (e.symm ∘ Sum.inr)).det * (l ^ Fintype.card Q * μ ^ Fintype.card P) by ring]
    exact this
  · obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hne⟩ := Function.not_injective_iff.1 hS
    rw [det_zero_of_row_eq hne (by ext k; simp [hij])]
    exact Ideal.zero_mem _

name: GraphBundles.maxMinors_graphMat
statement:
theorem maxMinors_graphMat (μ l : A) (d : Matrix m n A) :
    maxMinors (graphMat μ l d) = graphFormula μ l d
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (maxMinors_le_graphFormula μ l d) (graphFormula_le_maxMinors μ l d)

name: GraphBundles.graphMat_map
statement:
theorem graphMat_map {A' : Type*} [CommRing A'] (f : A →+* A') (μ l : A) (d : Matrix m n A) :
    (graphMat μ l d).map f = graphMat (f μ) (f l) (d.map f)
proof:
:= by
  ext (i | i) j <;> simp [graphMat, Matrix.fromRows, Matrix.one_apply, apply_ite f]

name: GraphBundles.graphFormula_map
statement:
theorem graphFormula_map {A' : Type*} [CommRing A'] (f : A →+* A') (μ l : A) (d : Matrix m n A) :
    (graphFormula μ l d).map f = graphFormula (f μ) (f l) (d.map f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← maxMinors_graphMat, ← maxMinors_graphMat, maxMinors_map, graphMat_map]

name: GraphBundles.graphFormula_map_prod
statement:
theorem graphFormula_map_prod {ι : Type*} {m n : ι → Type*} [∀ j, Fintype (n j)]
    [∀ j, DecidableEq (m j)] [∀ j, DecidableEq (n j)] {A' : Type*} [CommRing A'] (f : A →+* A') (s : Finset ι) (μ l : A)
    (d : ∀ j, Matrix (m j) (n j) A) :
    ∏ j ∈ s, graphFormula (f μ) (f l) ((d j).map f) =
      (∏ j ∈ s, graphFormula μ l (d j)).map f
proof:
:= by
  have h := map_prod (Ideal.mapHom f) (fun j => graphFormula μ l (d j)) s
  simp only [Ideal.mapHom_apply] at h
  rw [h]
  exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j _ => (graphFormula_map f μ l (d j)).symm

name: GraphBundles.exists_span_eq_of_mul_eq_span
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, u, hu, hab⟩ :
      ∃ a ∈ I, ∃ b ∈ J, ∃ u : A, IsUnit u ∧ a * b = g * u := by
    by_contra hne
    push Not at hne
    have hle : I * J ≤ Ideal.span {g} * IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A := by
      refine Ideal.mul_le.2 fun a ha b hb => ?_
      have hm : a * b ∈ Ideal.span {g} := h ▸ Ideal.mul_mem_mul ha hb
      obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.1 hm
      have hu' : u ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A :=
        (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).2 fun hu1 => hne a ha b hb u hu1 (by rw [← hu, mul_comm])
      exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_mul.2 ⟨u, hu', by rw [← hu, mul_comm]⟩
    have hg' : g ∈ Ideal.span {g} * IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A :=
      hle (h ▸ Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self g)
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hgz⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton_mul.1 hg'
    have h1 : g • (1 - z) = g • (0 : A) := by
      simp only [smul_eq_mul, mul_sub, mul_one, hgz, sub_self, mul_zero]
    have h2 : 1 = z := sub_eq_zero.1 (hg h1)
    exact (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).1 hz (h2 ▸ isUnit_one)
  
  have hbreg : IsSMulRegular A b := by
    intro y y' hyy
    simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hyy
    apply (hu.isSMulRegular A)
    apply hg
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    calc g * (u * y) = (a * b) * y := by rw [hab]; ring
      _ = a * (b * y) := by ring
      _ = a * (b * y') := by rw [hyy]
      _ = g * (u * y') := by rw [← mul_assoc, hab]; ring
  have hareg : IsSMulRegular A a := by
    intro y y' hyy
    simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hyy
    apply (hu.isSMulRegular A)
    apply hg
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    calc g * (u * y) = (a * b) * y := by rw [hab]; ring
      _ = b * (a * y) := by ring
      _ = b * (a * y') := by rw [hyy]
      _ = g * (u * y') := by rw [← mul_assoc, mul_comm b a, hab]; ring
  refine ⟨a, le_antisymm (fun x hx => ?_) ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).2 ha), hareg⟩
  have hxb : x * b ∈ Ideal.span {g} := h ▸ Ideal.mul_mem_mul hx hb
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.1 hxb
  have hxu : x * u = a * c := by
    apply hbreg
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    calc b * (x * u) = (x * b) * u := by ring
      _ = c * (a * b) := by rw [← hc, hab]; ring
      _ = b * (a * c) := by ring
  have hx' : x = a * (c * ↑hu.unit⁻¹) := by
    calc x = x * u * ↑hu.unit⁻¹ := by rw [mul_assoc, IsUnit.mul_val_inv, mul_one]
      _ = a * (c * ↑hu.unit⁻¹) := by rw [hxu, mul_assoc]
  rw [hx']
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self a)

name: GraphBundles.exists_span_eq_of_prod_eq_span
statement:
theorem exists_span_eq_of_prod_eq_span [IsLocalRing A] {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι)
    (I : ι → Ideal A) {g : A} (h : ∏ j ∈ s, I j = Ideal.span {g}) (hg : IsSMulRegular A g)
    {j : ι} (hj : j ∈ s) : ∃ a : A, I j = Ideal.span {a} ∧ IsSMulRegular A a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase s I hj] at h
  exact exists_span_eq_of_mul_eq_span h hg

name: GraphBundles.exists_satSummand_graphMat_of_prod
statement:
theorem exists_satSummand_graphMat_of_prod [IsLocalRing A] (s : Finset ι) (μ l : A)
    (d : ∀ j, Matrix (m j) (n j) A) {g : A}
    (hJ : ∏ j ∈ s, graphFormula μ l (d j) = Ideal.span {g}) (hg : IsSMulRegular A g)
    {j : ι} (hj : j ∈ s) :
    ∃ (S₀ : n j → n j ⊕ m j) (B : Matrix (n j ⊕ m j) (n j) A),
      maxMinors (graphMat μ l (d j)) =
          Ideal.span {((graphMat μ l (d j)).submatrix S₀ id).det} ∧
        IsSMulRegular A ((graphMat μ l (d j)).submatrix S₀ id).det ∧
        IsSatSummand (graphMat μ l (d j)) S₀ ((graphMat μ l (d j)).submatrix S₀ id).det B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hareg⟩ :=
    exists_span_eq_of_prod_eq_span s (fun j => graphFormula μ l (d j)) hJ hg hj
  rw [← maxMinors_graphMat] at ha
  obtain ⟨S₀, hS₀, hΔ⟩ := exists_minor_generator_of_isLocalRing _ a ha hareg
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := exists_summand_maxMinors _ S₀ hΔ hS₀.le
  exact ⟨S₀, B, hS₀, hΔ, hB⟩

name: GraphBundles.exists_satSummand_graphMat_of_map
statement:
theorem exists_satSummand_graphMat_of_map {A' : Type*} [CommRing A'] [IsLocalRing A']
    (f : A →+* A') (s : Finset ι) (μ l : A) (d : ∀ j, Matrix (m j) (n j) A) {g : A'}
    (hJ : (∏ j ∈ s, graphFormula μ l (d j)).map f = Ideal.span {g}) (hg : IsSMulRegular A' g)
    {j : ι} (hj : j ∈ s) :
    ∃ (S₀ : n j → n j ⊕ m j) (B : Matrix (n j ⊕ m j) (n j) A'),
      IsSMulRegular A' (((graphMat μ l (d j)).map f).submatrix S₀ id).det ∧
        IsSatSummand ((graphMat μ l (d j)).map f) S₀
          (((graphMat μ l (d j)).map f).submatrix S₀ id).det B
proof:
:= by
  have hmap : (∏ j ∈ s, graphFormula μ l (d j)).map f =
      ∏ j ∈ s, graphFormula (f μ) (f l) ((d j).map f) := by
    rw [← graphFormula_map_prod]
  rw [hmap] at hJ
  obtain ⟨S₀, B, -, hΔ, hB⟩ := exists_satSummand_graphMat_of_prod s (f μ) (f l)
    (fun j => (d j).map f) hJ hg hj
  rw [graphMat_map]
  exact ⟨S₀, B, hΔ, hB⟩

name: GraphBundles.minorsIdeal_eq_top_of_le
statement:
theorem minorsIdeal_eq_top_of_le {d : Matrix m n A} {c r : ℕ} (hc : minorsIdeal c d = ⊤)
    (hr : r ≤ c) : minorsIdeal r d = ⊤
proof:
:=
  top_le_iff.1 (hc ▸ minorsIdeal_antitone d hr)

name: GraphBundles.minorsIdeal_eq_bot_of_lt
statement:
theorem minorsIdeal_eq_bot_of_lt {d : Matrix m n A} {c r : ℕ} (hc : minorsIdeal (c + 1) d = ⊥)
    (hr : c < r) : minorsIdeal r d = ⊥
proof:
:=
  le_bot_iff.1 (hc ▸ minorsIdeal_antitone d hr)

name: GraphBundles.graphFormula_eq_span_of_rank
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine iSup_le fun r => ?_
    rw [span_pow_mul_span_pow]
    by_cases hr : (r : ℕ) ≤ c
    · refine Ideal.mul_le_left.trans ?_
      rw [Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton]
      refine dvd_mul_of_dvd_right (pow_dvd_pow μ ?_) _
      omega
    · rw [minorsIdeal_eq_bot_of_lt hbot (by omega), Ideal.bot_mul]
      exact bot_le
  · let r : Fin (Fintype.card n + 1) := ⟨c, by omega⟩
    refine le_trans ?_ (le_iSup (fun r : Fin (Fintype.card n + 1) =>
      minorsIdeal r d * (Ideal.span {l} ^ (r : ℕ) * Ideal.span {μ} ^ (Fintype.card n - r))) r)
    show Ideal.span {μ ^ (Fintype.card n - c)} ≤
      minorsIdeal c d * (Ideal.span {l} ^ c * Ideal.span {μ} ^ (Fintype.card n - c))
    rw [span_pow_mul_span_pow, htop, Ideal.top_mul, Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton]
    exact (hl.pow c).mul_left_dvd.2 dvd_rfl

name: GraphBundles.graphFormula_eq_top_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem graphFormula_eq_top_of_isUnit (μ l : A) (d : Matrix m n A) (hμ : IsUnit μ) :
    graphFormula μ l d = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine top_le_iff.1 (le_trans ?_ (le_iSup (fun r : Fin (Fintype.card n + 1) =>
      minorsIdeal r d * (Ideal.span {l} ^ (r : ℕ) * Ideal.span {μ} ^ (Fintype.card n - r))) 0))
  show ⊤ ≤ minorsIdeal 0 d * (Ideal.span {l} ^ 0 * Ideal.span {μ} ^ (Fintype.card n - 0))
  rw [minorsIdeal_zero, Ideal.top_mul, span_pow_mul_span_pow, pow_zero, one_mul,
    Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top.2 (hμ.pow _)]

name: GraphBundles.prod_graphFormula_eq_span_of_rank
statement:
theorem prod_graphFormula_eq_span_of_rank {ι : Type*} {m n : ι → Type*} [∀ j, Fintype (n j)]
    [∀ j, DecidableEq (n j)] (s : Finset ι) (μ l : A) (d : ∀ j, Matrix (m j) (n j) A)
    (c : ι → ℕ) (hcn : ∀ j ∈ s, c j ≤ Fintype.card (n j))
    (htop : ∀ j ∈ s, minorsIdeal (c j) (d j) = ⊤)
    (hbot : ∀ j ∈ s, minorsIdeal (c j + 1) (d j) = ⊥) (hl : IsUnit l) :
    ∏ j ∈ s, graphFormula μ l (d j) =
      Ideal.span {μ ^ ∑ j ∈ s, (Fintype.card (n j) - c j)}
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j hj =>
    graphFormula_eq_span_of_rank μ l (d j) (c j) (hcn j hj) (htop j hj) (hbot j hj) hl,
    Ideal.prod_span_singleton, Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum]

name: GraphBundles.det_mul_mem
statement:
theorem det_mul_mem {r : ℕ} {k : Type*} [Fintype k] [DecidableEq k] (X : Matrix (Fin r) k A)
    (Y : Matrix k (Fin r) A) (I : Ideal A) (hY : ∀ f : Fin r → k, (Y.submatrix f id).det ∈ I) :
    (X * Y).det ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  have e : X * Y = Matrix.of fun i => ∑ κ, X i κ • Y κ := by
    ext i j
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Finset.sum_apply]
  have h1 : (X * Y).det = (detRowAlternating : (Fin r → A) [⋀^Fin r]→ₗ[A] A).toMultilinearMap
      (fun i => ∑ κ, X i κ • Y κ) := by
    rw [e]; rfl
  rw [h1, MultilinearMap.map_sum]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun f _ => ?_
  rw [MultilinearMap.map_smul_univ, smul_eq_mul]
  exact I.mul_mem_left _ (hY f)

name: GraphBundles.minorsIdeal_mul_left_le
statement:
theorem minorsIdeal_mul_left_le {m' : Type*} [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] (P : Matrix m' m A)
    (d : Matrix m n A) (r : ℕ) : minorsIdeal r (P * d) ≤ minorsIdeal r d
proof:
:= by
  refine Ideal.span_le.2 ?_
  rintro _ ⟨⟨S, T⟩, rfl⟩
  have e : (P * d).submatrix S T = P.submatrix S id * d.submatrix id T := by
    ext i j; simp [Matrix.mul_apply]
  change ((P * d).submatrix S T).det ∈ minorsIdeal r d
  rw [e]
  exact det_mul_mem _ _ _ fun f => minor_mem_minorsIdeal d f T

name: GraphBundles.minorsIdeal_transpose_le
statement:
theorem minorsIdeal_transpose_le (d : Matrix m n A) (r : ℕ) :
    minorsIdeal r dᵀ ≤ minorsIdeal r d
proof:
:= by
  refine Ideal.span_le.2 ?_
  rintro _ ⟨⟨S, T⟩, rfl⟩
  have e : dᵀ.submatrix S T = (d.submatrix T S)ᵀ := rfl
  change (dᵀ.submatrix S T).det ∈ minorsIdeal r d
  rw [e, det_transpose]
  exact minor_mem_minorsIdeal d T S

name: GraphBundles.minorsIdeal_transpose
statement:
theorem minorsIdeal_transpose (d : Matrix m n A) (r : ℕ) :
    minorsIdeal r dᵀ = minorsIdeal r d
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (minorsIdeal_transpose_le d r) (by
    simpa only [transpose_transpose] using minorsIdeal_transpose_le dᵀ r)

name: GraphBundles.minorsIdeal_mul_right_le
statement:
theorem minorsIdeal_mul_right_le {n' : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (d : Matrix m n A)
    (Q : Matrix n n' A) (r : ℕ) : minorsIdeal r (d * Q) ≤ minorsIdeal r d
proof:
:= by
  rw [← minorsIdeal_transpose (d * Q), transpose_mul, ← minorsIdeal_transpose d]
  exact minorsIdeal_mul_left_le _ _ r

name: GraphBundles.minorsIdeal_mul_eq
statement:
theorem minorsIdeal_mul_eq [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (P P' : Matrix m m A) (Q Q' : Matrix n n A) (hP : P' * P = 1) (hQ : Q * Q' = 1)
    (d : Matrix m n A) (r : ℕ) : minorsIdeal r (P * d * Q) = minorsIdeal r d
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ((minorsIdeal_mul_right_le _ _ r).trans (minorsIdeal_mul_left_le _ _ r)) ?_
  have e : d = P' * (P * d * Q) * Q' := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_assoc, hQ, Matrix.mul_one, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hP,
      Matrix.one_mul]
  conv_lhs => rw [e]
  exact (minorsIdeal_mul_right_le _ _ r).trans (minorsIdeal_mul_left_le _ _ r)

name: GraphBundles.minorsIdeal_submatrix_equiv
statement:
theorem minorsIdeal_submatrix_equiv {m' n' : Type*} (d : Matrix m n A) (e₁ : m' ≃ m)
    (e₂ : n' ≃ n) (r : ℕ) : minorsIdeal r (d.submatrix e₁ e₂) = minorsIdeal r d
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine Ideal.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨⟨S, T⟩, rfl⟩
    exact minor_mem_minorsIdeal d (e₁ ∘ S) (e₂ ∘ T)
  · refine Ideal.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨⟨S, T⟩, rfl⟩
    have h := minor_mem_minorsIdeal (d.submatrix e₁ e₂) (e₁.symm ∘ S) (e₂.symm ∘ T)
    simpa [submatrix_submatrix, Function.comp_def] using h

name: GraphBundles.minorsIdeal_splitNormal_top
statement:
theorem minorsIdeal_splitNormal_top (c : ℕ) (m₁ n₁ : Type*) :
    minorsIdeal c (splitNormal (A := A) c m₁ n₁) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.eq_top_iff_one]
  have h := minor_mem_minorsIdeal (splitNormal (A := A) c m₁ n₁) Sum.inl Sum.inl
  have e : (splitNormal (A := A) c m₁ n₁).submatrix Sum.inl Sum.inl = 1 := by
    ext i j; simp [splitNormal]
  rwa [e, det_one] at h

name: GraphBundles.minorsIdeal_splitNormal_succ
statement:
theorem minorsIdeal_splitNormal_succ (c : ℕ) (m₁ n₁ : Type*) :
    minorsIdeal (c + 1) (splitNormal (A := A) c m₁ n₁) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine le_bot_iff.1 (Ideal.span_le.2 ?_)
  rintro _ ⟨⟨S, T⟩, rfl⟩
  change ((splitNormal (A := A) c m₁ n₁).submatrix S T).det ∈ (⊥ : Ideal A)
  rw [Ideal.mem_bot]
  by_cases hS : Function.Injective S
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, (S i).isLeft = false := by
      by_contra h
      have hl : ∀ i, (S i).isLeft = true := fun i => by
        by_contra h'
        exact h ⟨i, by simpa using h'⟩
      have hinj : Function.Injective fun i => (S i).getLeft (hl i) := by
        intro i j hij
        apply hS
        rw [← Sum.inl_getLeft (S i) (hl i), ← Sum.inl_getLeft (S j) (hl j)]
        exact congrArg Sum.inl hij
      have := Fintype.card_le_of_injective _ hinj
      simp at this
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y, S i = Sum.inr y := by
      rcases h : S i with y | y
      · rw [h] at hi; simp at hi
      · exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
    refine det_eq_zero_of_row_eq_zero i fun j => ?_
    show splitNormal (A := A) c m₁ n₁ (S i) (T j) = 0
    rw [hy]
    rcases T j with z | z <;> simp [splitNormal]
  · obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hne⟩ := Function.not_injective_iff.1 hS
    exact det_zero_of_row_eq hne (by ext k; simp [hij])

name: GraphBundles.minorsIdeal_of_split
statement:
theorem minorsIdeal_of_split [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {c : ℕ} {m₁ n₁ : Type*} (eR : m ≃ Fin c ⊕ m₁) (eC : n ≃ Fin c ⊕ n₁)
    (P P' : Matrix m m A) (Q Q' : Matrix n n A) (hP : P' * P = 1) (hQ : Q * Q' = 1)
    (d : Matrix m n A) (hd : d = P * (splitNormal c m₁ n₁).submatrix eR eC * Q) :
    minorsIdeal c d = ⊤ ∧ minorsIdeal (c + 1) d = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [hd, minorsIdeal_mul_eq P P' Q Q' hP hQ, minorsIdeal_mul_eq P P' Q Q' hP hQ,
    minorsIdeal_submatrix_equiv, minorsIdeal_submatrix_equiv]
  exact ⟨minorsIdeal_splitNormal_top c m₁ n₁, minorsIdeal_splitNormal_succ c m₁ n₁⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FlatBC.altCh_pull_g2tflat
statement:
theorem altCh_pull_g2tflat {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [Y.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X]
    [IsNoetherian Y] [Fact (ProjK k X)] [Fact (ProjK k Y)] (f : Y ⟶ X) [f.IsOver (Spk k)]
    [Flat f] (d : ℕ) (hd : PureRelDim f d) (E : ℕ → X.Modules) (r : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hE : ∀ j, HasConstantRank X (E j) (r j)) (len : ℕ) (v : TotalChow X) :
    totalPullOn (opsK k) f d hd (altCh k E len v) =
      altCh k (fun j ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (E j)) len
        (totalPullOn (opsK k) f d hd v)
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty Y with hY | hY
  · exact (totalChow_eq_zero_of_isEmpty _).trans (totalChow_eq_zero_of_isEmpty _).symm
  · haveI : Nonempty X := ⟨f (Classical.arbitrary Y)⟩
    unfold altCh
    rw [LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
    rw [zsmul_end_apply_tlmap, zsmul_end_apply_tlmap, map_zsmul]
    congr 1
    exact GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4A.chTot_pull (whitneyK (k := k)) f d hd (hE j) v

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FlatBC.mem_range_of_isPullback_g2tflat
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨z, -, hz2⟩ := Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback (f := ι) (g := g) y x hy
  refine ⟨hsq.isoPullback.inv z, ?_⟩
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hsq.isoPullback_inv_snd, hz2]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FlatBC.isPullback_jX_g2tflat
statement:
theorem isPullback_jX_g2tflat :
    IsPullback (jX (k := k) C ι) (ηX (k := k) C ι) (xiProj (k := k) C) ι
proof:
:=
  IsPullback.of_hasPullback _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FlatBC.isPullback_cmpX_ηX_g2tflat
statement:
theorem isPullback_cmpX_ηX_g2tflat :
    IsPullback (cmpX C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX) (ηX (k := k) C' ι') (ηX (k := k) C ι) gX
proof:
:= by
  have s0 := (isPullback_jX_g2tflat (k := k) C' ι').flip.paste_vert
    (isPullback_cmpMap_of_flat C C' g hJ).flip
  have s : IsPullback (ηX (k := k) C' ι') (cmpX C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX ≫ jX (k := k) C ι)
      (gX ≫ ι) (xiProj (k := k) C) := by
    rw [cmpX_jX, hgX]
    exact s0
  exact (IsPullback.of_bot s (cmpX_ηX C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX).symm
    (isPullback_jX_g2tflat (k := k) C ι).flip).flip

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FlatBC.isPullback_cmpX_jX_g2tflat
statement:
theorem isPullback_cmpX_jX_g2tflat :

      (cmpMap C C' g hJ)
proof:
:= by
  have s0 := (isPullback_jX_g2tflat (k := k) C' ι').flip.paste_horiz hsq
  have s : IsPullback (cmpX C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX ≫ ηX (k := k) C ι) (jX (k := k) C' ι') ι
      (cmpMap C C' g hJ ≫ xiProj (k := k) C) := by
    rw [cmpX_ηX, cmpMap_xiProj]
    exact s0
  exact IsPullback.of_right s (cmpX_jX C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX) (isPullback_jX_g2tflat (k := k) C ι).flip

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FlatBC.rCycle_support_jX_g2tflat
statement:
theorem rCycle_support_jX_g2tflat (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U)
    (hX : ∀ x : M, x ∉ U → x ∈ Set.range ι) {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    ∀ w, w ∉ Set.range (jX (k := k) C ι) → (rCycle (k := k) C U hC hM).1 w = 0

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FlatBC.flatPullback_rhoX_g2tflat
statement:
theorem flatPullback_rhoX_g2tflat (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U)
    (hX : ∀ x : M, x ∉ U → x ∈ Set.range ι) (U' : N.Opens) (hU' : U' = g ⁻¹ᵁ U)
    (hC' : C'.SectionExactOn U') {n n' : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n)
    (hN : height (genericPoint N) = n') :
    haveI
proof:
:= flat_cmpX_g2tflat C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX hsq
    flatPullback (cmpX C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX) (rhoX (k := k) C ι U hC hM).1 =
      (rhoX (k := k) C' ι' U' hC' hN).1 := by
  haveI := flat_cmpX_g2tflat C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX hsq
  have hX' : ∀ x : N, x ∉ U' → x ∈ Set.range ι' := by
    subst hU'
    intro x hx
    exact mem_range_of_isPullback_g2tflat hsq x (hX _ hx)
  have key : properPushforward (jX (k := k) C' ι')
      (flatPullback (cmpX C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX) (rhoX (k := k) C ι U hC hM).1) =
      properPushforward (jX (k := k) C' ι') (rhoX (k := k) C' ι' U' hC' hN).1 := by
    rw [← flatPullback_properPushforward (jX (k := k) C ι) (cmpMap C C' g hJ) (jX (k := k) C' ι')
      (cmpX C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX) (isPullback_cmpX_jX_g2tflat C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX hsq)]
    change flatPullback (cmpMap C C' g hJ) (properPushforward (jX (k := k) C ι)
        (F13.restrictCycle (jX (k := k) C ι) (jX (k := k) C ι).isEmbedding.injective
          (rCycle (k := k) C U hC hM).1)) =
      properPushforward (jX (k := k) C' ι')
        (F13.restrictCycle (jX (k := k) C' ι') (jX (k := k) C' ι').isEmbedding.injective
          (rCycle (k := k) C' U' hC' hN).1)
    rw [F13.properPushforward_restrictCycle _ _ (rCycle_support_jX_g2tflat C ι U hC hX hM),
      F13.properPushforward_restrictCycle _ _ (rCycle_support_jX_g2tflat C' ι' U' hC' hX' hN),
      flatPullback_rCycle_g2tflat C C' g hJ U hC U' hU' hC' hM hN]
  have := congrArg (F13.restrictCycle (jX (k := k) C' ι') (jX (k := k) C' ι').isEmbedding.injective)
    key
  rwa [G2T2C.restrictCycle_properPushforward, G2T2C.restrictCycle_properPushforward] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FlatBC.pull_tauRaw_eq_tauPulled_g2tflat
statement:
theorem pull_tauRaw_eq_tauPulled_g2tflat [Flat gX] (d : ℕ) (hgXd : PureRelDim gX d)
    (hβXd : PureRelDim (cmpX C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX) d) (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U)
    (hX : ∀ x : M, x ∉ U → x ∈ Set.range ι) (U' : N.Opens) (hU' : U' = g ⁻¹ᵁ U)
    (hC' : C'.SectionExactOn U') {n n' : ℕ} (hnd : n + d = n')
    (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) (hN : height (genericPoint N) = n') :
    totalPullOn (opsK k) gX d hgXd (tauRaw (k := k) C ι U hC hM) =
      tauPulled C C' ι' g hJ U' hC' hN
proof:
:= by
  subst hnd
  haveI := flat_cmpX_g2tflat C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX hsq
  haveI := cmpX_isOver C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX
  have hop : opWXPulled C C' ι' g hJ =
      altCh k (fun j ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (cmpX C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX)).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (jX (k := k) C ι)).obj (C.xi (k := k) j))) C.K.len := by
    unfold opWXPulled altCh
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
    congr 1
    exact chK_iso_g2tmi (pullSquareIso C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX (C.xi (k := k) j))
  rw [tauPulled, hop, tauRaw, ← LinearMap.comp_apply (totalPullOn (opsK k) gX d hgXd),
    (cpK k).base_change (ηX (k := k) C ι) gX (ηX (k := k) C' ι') (cmpX C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX) d
      hgXd hβXd (isPullback_cmpX_ηX_g2tflat C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX), LinearMap.comp_apply]
  congr 1
  rw [opWX, altCh_pull_g2tflat (cmpX C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX) d hβXd
    (fun j ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (jX (k := k) C ι)).obj (C.xi (k := k) j)) C.rank
    (fun j ↦ hasConstantRank_pullback _ (jX (k := k) C ι) _ _ (C.hasConstantRank_xi (k := k) j)),
    M7ASM.totalPullOn_lof]
  congr 2
  refine (opsK k).pull_mk (cmpX C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX) d hβXd n (rhoX (k := k) C ι U hC hM)
    (rhoX (k := k) C' ι' U' hC' hN) fun x ↦ ?_
  rw [← flatPullback_rhoX_g2tflat C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX hsq U hC hX U' hU' hC' hM hN]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FlatBC.tauRaw_flatPullback
statement:
theorem tauRaw_flatPullback [Flat gX] (d : ℕ) (hgXd : PureRelDim gX d)
    (hβXd : PureRelDim (betaX (k := k) C ι g ι' gX hgX) d) (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U)
    (hX : ∀ x : M, x ∉ U → x ∈ Set.range ι) (U' : N.Opens) (hU' : U' = g ⁻¹ᵁ U)
    (hC' : (C.pullback g).SectionExactOn U') {n n' : ℕ} (hnd : n + d = n')
    (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) (hN : height (genericPoint N) = n') :
    totalPullOn (opsK k) gX d hgXd (tauRaw (k := k) C ι U hC hM) =
      tauRaw (k := k) (C.pullback g) ι' U' hC' hN
proof:
:= by
  rw [tauRaw_eq_tauPulled C (C.pullback g) ι' g (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)
    (xiPullbackCompat_g2txipb g C) U' hC' hN]
  exact pull_tauRaw_eq_tauPulled_g2tflat C ι (C.pullback g) ι' g
    (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g) gX hgX hsq d hgXd hβXd U hC hX U' hU' hC' hnd hM hN

proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FlatBC.flatBaseChangeFst_of_g2tflat
statement:
theorem flatBaseChangeFst_of_g2tflat (hbc : ClosedImmersionBaseChange.{u}) :
    FlatBaseChangeFst k a b
proof:
:= by
  intro X _ _ _ _ _ ι _ _ haddι haddC y
  haveI : Flat (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).toBase := instFlatCoverToBaseG2TC1V k b
  haveI : Flat (pr₁PP k a b) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Flat (pullback.fst (space k a ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k b)))
  have hpr := isPullback_pr₁PP_g2tflat k a b
  have hg : PureRelDim (pr₁PP k a b) b :=
    pureRelDim_of_isPullback_prodFst_g2tflat k b (𝟙 (space k a)) (𝟙 (PP k a b)) (pr₁PP k a b) hpr
  have hnd : a + b = ppDim k a b :=
    nat_eq_of_height_g2tflat (pr₁PP k a b) hg (CASE1B.height_genericPoint_space k a)
      (pp_height k a b)
  exact tauG0_flatPullback_prod (FRI.space_member k a) ι (pp_member k a b) (pr₁PP k a b)
    (ιF (b := b) ι) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).toBase (isPullback_ιF ι) b (𝟙 (space k a))
    (𝟙 (PP k a b)) hpr (cover_pureRelDim k b) hnd (CASE1B.height_genericPoint_space k a)
    (pp_height k a b) (CIICLASS.T1N23.projectiveSpace_regStalks k a) (pp_regStalks k a b)
    (fun F hF ↦ hbc ι (ιF (b := b) ι) (pr₁PP k a b) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).toBase
      (isPullback_ιF ι) F hF) haddι haddC y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FlatBC.flatBaseChangeSnd_of_g2tflat

theorem flatBaseChangeSnd_of_g2tflat (hbc : ClosedImmersionBaseChange.{u}) :

proof:
:= by
  intro X _ _ _ _ _ ι _ _ haddι haddC y
  haveI : Flat (cover (X ↘ Spk k) a).toBase := instFlatCoverToBaseG2TC1V k a
  haveI : Flat (space k a ↘ Spk k) := (inferInstance : Flat (toSpec k a))
  haveI : Flat (pr₂PP k a b) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Flat (pullback.snd (space k a ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k b)))
  have hpr := isPullback_pr₂PP_g2tflat k a b
  have hg : PureRelDim (pr₂PP k a b) a :=
    pureRelDim_of_isPullback_prodFst_g2tflat k a (𝟙 (space k b)) (swapPP_g2tflat k a b)
      (pr₂PP k a b) hpr
  have hnd : b + a = ppDim k a b :=
    nat_eq_of_height_g2tflat (pr₂PP k a b) hg (CASE1B.height_genericPoint_space k b)
      (pp_height k a b)
  exact tauG0_flatPullback_prod (FRI.space_member k b) ι (pp_member k a b) (pr₂PP k a b)
    (ιS (a := a) ι) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) a).toBase (isPullback_ιS ι) a (𝟙 (space k b))
    (swapPP_g2tflat k a b) hpr (cover_pureRelDim k a) hnd (CASE1B.height_genericPoint_space k b)
    (pp_height k a b) (CIICLASS.T1N23.projectiveSpace_regStalks k b) (pp_regStalks k a b)
    (fun F hF ↦ hbc ι (ιS (a := a) ι) (pr₂PP k a b) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) a).toBase
      (isPullback_ιS ι) F hF) haddι haddC y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModuleProperty.exists_epi_free_twist
statement:
theorem exists_epi_free_twist (N : ℕ) {X : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ space k N) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) :
    ∃ (D : ℕ) (I : Type u) (_ : Fintype I)
      (π : FreeM X I ⟶ tensorSheaf X L ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (D : ℤ)))), Epi π
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI hLfp : L.IsFinitePresentation :=
    IsFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation X hL.isFiniteLocallyFree
  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj L).IsFinitePresentation :=
    isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_isFinite j L
  obtain ⟨D, G, hG⟩ := serre_generation k N ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj L)
  letI := hG
  let V := projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (D : ℤ)
  let L' : X.Modules := tensorSheaf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj V) L
  let e : tensorSheaf (space k N) V ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj L) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj L' :=
    projectionFormulaIso j V (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree k N _) L
  haveI : Finite G.I := hG.finite
  letI : Fintype G.I := Fintype.ofFinite G.I
  let e1 : FreeM (space k N) G.I ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj L' := G.π ≫ e.hom
  haveI : Epi e1 := epi_comp' G.epi inferInstance
  haveI hP : Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).map e1) := inferInstance
  haveI hC := ClosedImmersionCoverF11.counit_epi j L'
  let φ : FreeM X G.I ⟶ L' :=
    (pullbackFreeIso j G.I).inv ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback j).map e1 ≫ ClosedImmersionCoverF11.counitHom j L'
  haveI : Epi φ :=
    epi_comp' (inferInstance : Epi (pullbackFreeIso j G.I).inv) (epi_comp' hP hC)
  refine ⟨D, G.I, inferInstance, φ ≫ (tensorSheafSymmetry X _ _).hom, ?_⟩
  exact epi_comp' inferInstance inferInstance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModuleProperty.lineDiffPullback_of_globGenMorphism
statement: theorem lineDiffPullback_of_globGenMorphism (h : GlobGenMorphism k) : LineDiffPullback k
proof:
:= by
  intro X _ _ _ hX L hL
  obtain ⟨N, j, hj, hjk⟩ := hX.out
  haveI := hj
  haveI : j.IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨hjk⟩
  obtain ⟨D, I, hI, π, hπ⟩ := exists_epi_free_twist (k := k) N j L hL
  have hB : HasConstantRank X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (D : ℤ))) 1 :=
    hasConstantRank_pullback X j _ 1 (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.hasConstantRank_twist (k := k) N (D : ℤ))
  have hLB : HasConstantRank X (tensorSheaf X L ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (D : ℤ)))) 1 := by
    have := hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hL hB
    rwa [Nat.one_mul] at this
  obtain ⟨n, φ, hφ, ⟨e⟩⟩ := h _ hLB I π hπ
  exact ⟨n, N, φ, j, hφ, inferInstance, 1, (D : ℤ), ⟨e.symm⟩⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.sheafMinorsIdeal_iso_g2trees
statement:
theorem sheafMinorsIdeal_iso_g2trees {E F E' F' : M.Modules} (eE : E ≅ E') (eF : F ≅ F')
    (d : E ⟶ F) (d' : E' ⟶ F') (h : d ≫ eF.hom = eE.hom ≫ d') (r : ℕ) :
    sheafMinorsIdeal d' r = sheafMinorsIdeal d r
proof:
:= by
  unfold sheafMinorsIdeal
  congr 1
  funext U
  have e : sectionMap d' U.1 = (sectionEquiv_g2trees eF U.1).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
      sectionMap d U.1 ∘ₗ (sectionEquiv_g2trees eE.symm U.1).toLinearMap := by
    refine LinearMap.ext fun x ↦ ?_
    change sectionMap d' U.1 x = sectionMap (eE.inv ≫ d ≫ eF.hom) U.1 x
    rw [h, ← Category.assoc, eE.inv_hom_id, Category.id_comp]
  rw [e, linMinorsIdeal_equiv]

theorem tauGenStd_congr_iso_g2trees (D : DetIdealComplex M)
    {F G : ℕ → (graphModel (k := k) D).Modules} (e : ∀ j, F j ≅ G j) (len : ℕ) (U : M.Opens)
    (hS : IsSplitOn D U) {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    tauGenStd (k := k) hMK ι D F len U hS hM = tauGenStd (k := k) hMK ι D G len U hS hM
proof:
:= by
  letI := prodP1Over (k := k) (A := M)
  letI := blowupOver (k := k) (graphIdeal (k := k) D)
  haveI := prodP1_lft (k := k) (A := M)
  haveI := prodP1_isNoetherian (k := k) (A := M)
  haveI := blowup_locallyOfFiniteType
    (CIICLASS.projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod hMK 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
    (graphIdeal (k := k) D) (graphIdeal_ne_bot D)
  haveI := blowup_isNoetherian
    (CIICLASS.projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod hMK 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
    (graphIdeal (k := k) D) (graphIdeal_ne_bot D)
  haveI := GraphModel.isIntegral_graphModel hMK D
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (graphModel (k := k) D)) :=
    ⟨projK_of_projectiveIntegralK (projectiveIntegralK_graphModel hMK D)⟩
  haveI : (projD (k := k) D).IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨Category.assoc _ _ _⟩
  exact tauGen_congr_iso (k := k) D ι e len U hS hM

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.tauStd_isoData
statement:
theorem tauStd_isoData {C C' : RankedBundleComplex M} (I : ComplexIsoData C C') (U : M.Opens)
    (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) (hC' : C'.SectionExactOn U) {n : ℕ}
    (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    tauStd hMK C' ι U hC' hM = tauStd hMK C ι U hC hM
proof:
:= by
  rw [tauStd_eq_tauGenStd, tauStd_eq_tauGenStd,
    tauGenStd_xiStd_congr (k := k) hMK ι (toDetIdealComplex_isoData I) C'.dj
      (xiOpen_nonempty C') (xiOpen_nonempty C) C'.K.len U
      (C'.isSplitOn_of_sectionExactOn U hC') (C.isSplitOn_of_sectionExactOn U hC) hM,
    I.len_eq]
  haveI := GraphModel.isIntegral_graphModel hMK C.toDetIdealComplex
  exact tauGenStd_congr_iso_g2trees (k := k) hMK ι C.toDetIdealComplex
    (fun j ↦ (xiD_isoData (k := k) I C.toDetIdealComplex (xiOpen_nonempty C) j).symm) _ U _ hM

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.tauRaw_eq_tauStd_g2trees
statement:
theorem tauRaw_eq_tauStd_g2trees (C : RankedBundleComplex M)
    [inst : (C.graphModel (k := k)).Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType ((C.graphModel (k := k)) ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian (C.graphModel (k := k))] [IsIntegral (C.graphModel (k := k))]
    [Fact (ProjK k (C.graphModel (k := k)))] [hπ : (xiProj (k := k) C).IsOver (Spk k)]
    (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    tauRaw (k := k) C ι U hC hM = tauStd hMK C ι U hC hM
proof:
:= by
  have key : inst = (letI := prodP1Over (k := k) (A := M)
      blowupOver (k := k) (graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex)) := by
    have h0 := hπ.comp_over
    revert h0
    cases inst with
    | ofHom o =>
      intro h0
      change ⟨o⟩ = (⟨graphToBase (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex ≫
        (pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k 1) ≫ M ↘ Spk k)⟩ :
          (C.graphModel (k := k)).Over (Spk k))
      congr 1
      rw [← Category.assoc]
      exact h0.symm
  subst key
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.tauRaw_isoData
statement:
theorem tauRaw_isoData (C C' : RankedBundleComplex M)
    [(C.graphModel (k := k)).Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType ((C.graphModel (k := k)) ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian (C.graphModel (k := k))] [IsIntegral (C.graphModel (k := k))]
    [Fact (ProjK k (C.graphModel (k := k)))] [(xiProj (k := k) C).IsOver (Spk k)]
    [(C'.graphModel (k := k)).Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType ((C'.graphModel (k := k)) ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian (C'.graphModel (k := k))] [IsIntegral (C'.graphModel (k := k))]
    [Fact (ProjK k (C'.graphModel (k := k)))] [(xiProj (k := k) C').IsOver (Spk k)]
    (I : ComplexIsoData C C') (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U)
    (hC' : C'.SectionExactOn U) {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    tauRaw (k := k) C' ι U hC' hM = tauRaw (k := k) C ι U hC hM
proof:
:= by
  rw [tauRaw_eq_tauStd_g2trees (k := k) hMK ι C' U hC' hM,
    tauRaw_eq_tauStd_g2trees (k := k) hMK ι C U hC hM]
  exact tauStd_isoData (k := k) hMK ι I U hC hC' hM

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.sectionExactOn_isoData
statement:
theorem sectionExactOn_isoData (I : ComplexIsoData C C') {U : M.Opens}
    (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) : C'.SectionExactOn U
proof:
:= by
  intro V hV
  obtain ⟨hs, hex⟩ := hC V hV
  
  have hd : ∀ j (x : (C'.K.E (j + 1)).val.obj (op V.1)),
      sectionMap (C'.K.d j) V.1 x =
        sectionMap (I.e j).hom V.1 (sectionMap (C.K.d j) V.1 (sectionMap (I.e (j + 1)).inv V.1 x)) := by
    intro j x
    change sectionMap (C'.K.d j) V.1 x = sectionMap ((I.e (j + 1)).inv ≫ C.K.d j ≫ (I.e j).hom) V.1 x
    rw [I.comm j, ← Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.id_comp]
  refine ⟨fun y ↦ ?_, fun j ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hs (sectionMap (I.e 0).inv V.1 y)
    refine ⟨sectionMap (I.e 1).hom V.1 a, ?_⟩
    rw [hd]
    change sectionMap (I.e 0).hom V.1 (sectionMap (C.K.d 0) V.1
      (sectionMap ((I.e 1).hom ≫ (I.e 1).inv) V.1 a)) = y
    rw [Iso.hom_inv_id]
    change sectionMap (I.e 0).hom V.1 (sectionMap (C.K.d 0) V.1 a) = y
    rw [ha]
    change sectionMap ((I.e 0).inv ≫ (I.e 0).hom) V.1 y = y
    rw [Iso.inv_hom_id]; rfl
  · intro y
    rw [hd]
    constructor
    · intro hy
      have hy' : sectionMap (C.K.d j) V.1 (sectionMap (I.e (j + 1)).inv V.1 y) = 0 := by
        have := congrArg (sectionMap (I.e j).inv V.1) hy
        rw [map_zero] at this
        rw [← this]
        change _ = sectionMap ((I.e j).hom ≫ (I.e j).inv) V.1 _
        rw [Iso.hom_inv_id]; rfl
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := ((hex j) _).1 hy'
      refine ⟨sectionMap (I.e (j + 2)).hom V.1 a, ?_⟩
      rw [hd]
      change sectionMap (I.e (j + 1)).hom V.1 (sectionMap (C.K.d (j + 1)) V.1
        (sectionMap ((I.e (j + 2)).hom ≫ (I.e (j + 2)).inv) V.1 a)) = y
      rw [Iso.hom_inv_id]
      change sectionMap (I.e (j + 1)).hom V.1 (sectionMap (C.K.d (j + 1)) V.1 a) = y
      rw [ha]
      change sectionMap ((I.e (j + 1)).inv ≫ (I.e (j + 1)).hom) V.1 y = y
      rw [Iso.inv_hom_id]; rfl
    · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
      rw [hd]
      change sectionMap (I.e j).hom V.1 (sectionMap (C.K.d j) V.1
        (sectionMap ((I.e (j + 1)).hom ≫ (I.e (j + 1)).inv) V.1
          (sectionMap (C.K.d (j + 1)) V.1 (sectionMap (I.e (j + 2)).inv V.1 x)))) = 0
      rw [Iso.hom_inv_id]
      change sectionMap (I.e j).hom V.1 (sectionMap (C.K.d (j + 1) ≫ C.K.d j) V.1
        (sectionMap (I.e (j + 2)).inv V.1 x)) = 0
      rw [C.K.dd j]
      change sectionMap (I.e j).hom V.1 0 = 0
      exact map_zero _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.genGraph_of_res_xipb
statement:
theorem genGraph_of_res_xipb {V V' : Y.Opens} (h : V' ≤ V) (hV' : (V' : Set Y).Nonempty)
    {s : Γ(G, V)} (hs : GenGraph pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V' (G.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op s)) :
    GenGraph pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V s
proof:
:= by
  intro _
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hAne, hA0⟩ := hs hV'
  refine ⟨A, hA.trans (inf_le_inf_right W₁ h), hAne, ?_⟩
  rw [graphDefect_res, res_res_xiS] at hA0
  exact hA0

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.genGraph_lc_xipb
statement:
theorem genGraph_lc_xipb (hW₁ : (W₁ : Set Y).Nonempty) {V : Y.Opens} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (s : ι → Γ(G, V)) (hs : ∀ i, GenGraph pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V (s i)) (c : ι → Γ(Y, V)) :
    GenGraph pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V (Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, V) s c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.linearCombination_apply]
  exact Finset.sum_induction _ (GenGraph pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V)
    (fun a b ha hb => genGraph_add pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V ha hb) (genGraph_zero pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁ V)
    (fun i _ => genGraph_smul pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V (c i) (hs i))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.genGraph_app_of_frames_xipb
statement:
theorem genGraph_app_of_frames_xipb (hW₁ : (W₁ : Set Y).Nonempty) {A : Y.Modules} (f : A ⟶ G)
    (hfr : ∀ w : Y, ∃ (O : Y.Opens) (_ : w ∈ O) (ι : Type u) (_ : Fintype ι) (p : ι → Γ(A, O)),
      IsSecFrame A O p ∧ ∀ i, GenGraph pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t O (f.app O (p i)))
    (V : Y.Opens) (x : Γ(A, V)) : GenGraph pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V (f.app V x)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hV : (V : Set Y).Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hV
    obtain ⟨O, hwO, ι, hι, p, hp, hgp⟩ := hfr w
    have hne : ((V ⊓ O : Y.Opens) : Set Y).Nonempty := ⟨w, hw, hwO⟩
    refine genGraph_of_res_xipb pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t (inf_le_left : V ⊓ O ≤ V) hne ?_
    rw [← app_res_xiR]
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (hp (V ⊓ O) inf_le_right).2 (A.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op x)
    rw [← hc, app_linearCombination_xiR]
    exact genGraph_lc_xipb pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁ _
      (fun i => genGraph_res pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁ inf_le_right (hgp i)) c
  · intro h
    exact absurd h hV

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.res_graphDefect_xipb
statement:
theorem res_graphDefect_xipb {V V'' : Y.Opens} (h : V'' ≤ V ⊓ W₁) (s : Γ(G, V)) :
    Q.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (graphDefect pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V s) =
      pr₂.app V'' (G.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h.trans inf_le_left)).op s) -
        (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h.trans inf_le_right)).op).hom t •
          δ.app V'' (pr₁.app V'' (G.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h.trans inf_le_left)).op s))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [graphDefect, map_sub, Scheme.Modules.map_smul, res_res_xiS, ringRes_res_xiS,
    app_res_xiS]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.graphDefect_eq_xipb
statement:
theorem graphDefect_eq_xipb (V : Y.Opens) (s : Γ(G, V)) :
    graphDefect pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V s =
      pr₂.app (V ⊓ W₁) (G.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V ⊓ W₁ ≤ V)).op s) -
        (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : V ⊓ W₁ ≤ W₁)).op).hom t •
          δ.app (V ⊓ W₁) (pr₁.app (V ⊓ W₁)
            (G.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V ⊓ W₁ ≤ V)).op s))
proof:
:= by
  have := res_graphDefect_xipb pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t (le_refl (V ⊓ W₁)) s
  rw [res_self_xiS] at this
  exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.app_lc_xipb
statement:
theorem app_lc_xipb {A B : Y.Modules} (φ : A ⟶ B) {U : Y.Opens} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (s : ι → Γ(A, U)) (c : ι → Γ(Y, U)) :
    φ.app U (Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, U) s c) =
      Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, U) (fun i => φ.app U (s i)) c
proof:
:= by
  have := app_linearCombination_xiR φ s (le_refl U) c
  rw [secResXiR_self, secResXiR_self] at this
