name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.bijective_of_frames_xipb
statement:
theorem bijective_of_frames_xipb {A B G : Y.Modules} (ψ : A ⟶ B) (ι : B ⟶ G) {O : Y.Opens}
    {n n' κ : Type u} [Fintype n] [Fintype n'] [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq n]
    (hcard : Fintype.card n = Fintype.card n')
    {p : n → Γ(A, O)} (hp : IsSecFrame A O p) {O' : Y.Opens} {s : n' → Γ(B, O')}
    (hs : IsSecFrame B O' s)
    {f : κ → Γ(G, O)} (hf : IsSecFrame G O f) (S₀ : n → κ) (Bm : Matrix κ n Γ(Y, O))
    (hrows : Bm.submatrix S₀ id = 1)
    (hφ : ∀ k, ι.app O (ψ.app O (p k)) = Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, O) f (fun a => Bm a k))
    {V : Y.Opens} (hV : V ≤ O) (hV' : V ≤ O') : Function.Bijective (ψ.app V)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let R := Γ(Y, V)
  let Pe := hp.equiv V hV
  let Se := hs.equiv V hV'
  let Fe := hf.equiv V hV
  let X : (n → R) →ₗ[R] (n' → R) := Se.symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ appLinXiG ψ V ∘ₗ Pe.toLinearMap
  let L : (n' → R) →ₗ[R] (n → R) :=
    LinearMap.funLeft R R S₀ ∘ₗ Fe.symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ appLinXiG ι V ∘ₗ Se.toLinearMap
  have hLX : L ∘ₗ X = LinearMap.id := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro c
    change (Fe.symm (ι.app V (Se (Se.symm (ψ.app V (Pe c)))))) ∘ S₀ = c
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    have h1 : ι.app V (ψ.app V (Pe c)) =
        Fe ((Bm.map (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op).hom) *ᵥ c) := by
      change ι.app V (ψ.app V (Fintype.linearCombination R (secResXiR A hV p) c)) =
        Fintype.linearCombination R (secResXiR G hV f) _
      rw [app_linearCombination_xiR, app_linearCombination_xiR]
      have : (fun i => ι.app O (ψ.app O (p i))) =
          fun k => Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, O) f (fun a => Bm a k) := funext hφ
      rw [this]
      exact linearCombination_comb_xiR G f Bm hV c
    rw [h1, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    change (Bm.map (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op).hom).submatrix S₀ id *ᵥ c = c
    rw [Matrix.submatrix_map, hrows, Matrix.map_one _ (map_zero _) (map_one _), Matrix.one_mulVec]
  
  let e : (n' → R) ≃ₗ[R] (n → R) :=
    LinearEquiv.funCongrLeft R R (Fintype.equivOfCardEq hcard)
  have hcomm : (e.toLinearMap ∘ₗ X) ∘ₗ (L ∘ₗ e.symm.toLinearMap) = LinearMap.id := by
    rw [LinearMap.comp_eq_id_comm]
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro c
    change L (e.symm (e (X c))) = c
    rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    exact congrArg (fun φ : (n → R) →ₗ[R] (n → R) => φ c) hLX
  have hXinj : Function.Injective X := by
    intro a b hab
    have := congrArg L hab
    exact (congrArg (fun φ : (n → R) →ₗ[R] (n → R) => φ a) hLX).symm.trans
      (this.trans (congrArg (fun φ : (n → R) →ₗ[R] (n → R) => φ b) hLX))
  have hXsurj : Function.Surjective X := by
    intro y
    refine ⟨L (e.symm (e y)), ?_⟩
    have := congrArg (fun φ : (n → R) →ₗ[R] (n → R) => φ (e y)) hcomm
    exact e.injective this
  have hψ : (ψ.app V : Γ(A, V) → Γ(B, V)) = Se ∘ X ∘ Pe.symm := by
    funext x
    change ψ.app V x = Se (Se.symm (ψ.app V (Pe (Pe.symm x))))
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [hψ]
  exact Se.bijective.comp (⟨hXinj, hXsurj⟩ : Function.Bijective X) |>.comp Pe.symm.bijective

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.isIso_of_local_bijective_xipb
statement:
theorem isIso_of_local_bijective_xipb {A B : Y.Modules} (ψ : A ⟶ B)
    (h : ∀ w : Y, ∃ O : Y.Opens, w ∈ O ∧ ∀ V : Y.Opens, V ≤ O → Function.Bijective (ψ.app V)) :
    IsIso ψ
proof:
:= by
  choose O hwO hO using h
  let FA : TopCat.Sheaf Ab Y := ⟨A.presheaf, A.isSheaf⟩
  let FB : TopCat.Sheaf Ab Y := ⟨B.presheaf, B.isSheaf⟩
  have hinj : ∀ W : Y.Opens, Function.Injective (ψ.app W) := by
    intro W
    rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro x hx
    let U : W → Y.Opens := fun y => W ⊓ O y.1
    refine FA.eq_of_locally_eq' U W (fun y => homOfLE inf_le_left) ?_ x 0 ?_
    · intro y hy
      exact Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hy, hwO y⟩
    · intro y
      change A.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op x = A.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op 0
      rw [map_zero]
      apply (hO y.1 (U y) inf_le_right).1
      rw [app_res_xiR, hx, map_zero, map_zero]
  apply isIso_of_app_bijective_xiG
  intro W
  refine ⟨hinj W, ?_⟩
  intro z
  let U : W → Y.Opens := fun y => W ⊓ O y.1
  have hloc : ∀ y : W, ∃ x : Γ(A, U y),
      ψ.app (U y) x = B.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U y ≤ W)).op z :=
    fun y => (hO y.1 (U y) inf_le_right).2 _
  choose xs hxs using hloc
  have hcomp : TopCat.Presheaf.IsCompatible FA.1 U xs := by
    intro y y'
    apply hinj
    change ψ.app _ (A.presheaf.map (homOfLE _).op (xs y)) =
      ψ.app _ (A.presheaf.map (homOfLE _).op (xs y'))
    rw [app_res_xiR, app_res_xiR, hxs, hxs, res_res_xiR, res_res_xiR]
  obtain ⟨x, hx, -⟩ := FA.existsUnique_gluing' U W (fun y => homOfLE inf_le_left)
    (fun y hy => Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hy, hwO y⟩) xs hcomp
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  change ψ.app W x = z
  refine FB.eq_of_locally_eq' U W (fun y => homOfLE inf_le_left)
    (fun y hy => Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hy, hwO y⟩) _ _ ?_
  intro y
  change B.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op (ψ.app W x) =
    B.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op z
  rw [← app_res_xiR, ← hxs y]
  congr 1
  exact hx y

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.generator_mem_span_generator_of_eq_span
proof:
:= by
  have hs : s.1 ∈ Ideal.span {g} := hI ▸ s.2
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hs
  rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
  refine ⟨algebraMap A (reesAlgebra I) a, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (algebraMap A A[X] a) * monomial 1 g = monomial 1 s.1
  rw [Polynomial.algebraMap_apply, Algebra.algebraMap_self, RingHom.id_apply, C_mul_monomial, ha]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.basicOpen_generator_eq_top
statement:
theorem basicOpen_generator_eq_top (I : Ideal A) (g : A) (hI : I = Ideal.span {g}) :
    Proj.basicOpen (grade I) (generator I ⟨g, hI ▸ Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self g⟩) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have h := Proj.iSup_basicOpen_eq_top (grade I)
    (fun _ : Unit => generator I ⟨g, hI ▸ Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self g⟩) (by
      refine (irrelevant_le_span_generators I).trans ?_
      rw [Ideal.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨s, rfl⟩
      rw [Set.range_const]
      exact generator_mem_span_generator_of_eq_span I g hI s)
  simpa using h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.baseRingHom_bijective_of_eq_span
statement:
theorem baseRingHom_bijective_of_eq_span (I : Ideal A) (g : A) (hI : I = Ideal.span {g})
    (hg : IsRegular g) :
    Function.Bijective (baseRingHom I ⟨g, hI ▸ Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self g⟩)
proof:
:= by
  set r : I := ⟨g, hI ▸ Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self g⟩ with hr
  have hL : Function.Injective (chartLocalizationMap I (RingHom.id A) r) :=
    chartLocalizationMap_injective I (RingHom.id A) r (fun _ _ h => h) hg
  have hmap : I.map (RingHom.id A) = Ideal.span {(RingHom.id A) r.1} := by
    rw [Ideal.map_id]; exact hI
  have hloc : Function.Injective (algebraMap A (Localization.Away g)) :=
    IsLocalization.injective (Localization.Away g)
      (powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_isRegular g hg)
  constructor
  · intro a b hab
    apply hloc
    have := congrArg (chartLocalizationMap I (RingHom.id A) r) hab
    rwa [chartLocalizationMap_id_baseRingHom, chartLocalizationMap_id_baseRingHom] at this
  · intro z
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := chartLocalizationMap_mem_range I (RingHom.id A) r hmap z
    refine ⟨a, hL ?_⟩
    rw [chartLocalizationMap_id_baseRingHom]
    exact ha

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.isIso_projection_of_eq_span
statement:
theorem isIso_projection_of_eq_span (I : Ideal A) (g : A) (hI : I = Ideal.span {g})
    (hg : IsRegular g) : IsIso (projection I)
proof:
:= by
  set r : I := ⟨g, hI ▸ Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self g⟩ with hr
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (chartMap I r) := by
    intro x
    have hx : x ∈ (chartMap I r).opensRange := by
      rw [chartMap_opensRange, basicOpen_generator_eq_top I g hI]; trivial
    exact hx
  have : IsIso (chartMap I r) := by
    rw [isIso_iff_isOpenImmersion_and_surjective]
    exact ⟨inferInstance, ⟨hsurj⟩⟩
  let e := RingEquiv.ofBijective (baseRingHom I r) (baseRingHom_bijective_of_eq_span I g hI hg)
  have : IsIso (CommRingCat.ofHom (baseRingHom I r)) :=
    (e.toCommRingCatIso.isIso_hom :)
  have : IsIso (chartMap I r ≫ projection I) := by
    rw [chartMap_projection]; infer_instance
  exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_left (chartMap I r) (projection I)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.isIso_toBase_restrict_affine_of_eq_span
statement:
theorem isIso_toBase_restrict_affine_of_eq_span (U : X.affineOpens) (g : Γ(X, U.1))
    (hI : I.ideal U = Ideal.span {g}) (hg : IsRegular g) : IsIso (toBase X I ∣_ U.1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MorphismProperty.isomorphisms.iff,
    property_restrict_iff' X I (MorphismProperty.isomorphisms Scheme) U,
    MorphismProperty.isomorphisms.iff]
  have := isIso_projection_of_eq_span (I.ideal U) g hI hg
  infer_instance

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.isIso_toBase_restrict_of_locallyPrincipal
statement:
theorem isIso_toBase_restrict_of_locallyPrincipal (O : X.Opens)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ O, ∃ V : X.affineOpens, x ∈ V.1 ∧ V.1 ≤ O ∧
      ∃ g : Γ(X, V.1), I.ideal V = Ideal.span {g} ∧ IsRegular g) :
    IsIso (toBase X I ∣_ O)
proof:
:= by
  let S := {V : X.affineOpens // V.1 ≤ O ∧
    ∃ g : Γ(X, V.1), I.ideal V = Ideal.span {g} ∧ IsRegular g}
  let W : S → O.toScheme.Opens := fun V => O.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V.1.1
  have hcover : ⨆ V : S, W V = ⊤ := by
    refine top_le_iff.mp fun x _ => ?_
    obtain ⟨V, hxV, hVO, hV⟩ := h (O.ι x) (by simp)
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨V, hVO, hV⟩, hxV⟩
  rw [← MorphismProperty.isomorphisms.iff]
  apply IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.of_iSup_eq_top W hcover
  intro V
  obtain ⟨V, hVO, g, hg, hreg⟩ := V
  have himage : O.ι ''ᵁ W ⟨V, hVO, g, hg, hreg⟩ = V.1 := by
    change O.ι ''ᵁ (O.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) = V.1
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
    exact inf_eq_right.mpr hVO
  have hV := isIso_toBase_restrict_affine_of_eq_span X I V g hg hreg
  exact (MorphismProperty.arrow_mk_iso_iff (MorphismProperty.isomorphisms Scheme)
    (morphismRestrictRestrict (toBase X I) O _ ≪≫ morphismRestrictEq (toBase X I) himage)).mpr hV

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.isIso_toBase_of_locallyPrincipal
statement:
theorem isIso_toBase_of_locallyPrincipal
    (h : ∀ x : X, ∃ V : X.affineOpens, x ∈ V.1 ∧
      ∃ g : Γ(X, V.1), I.ideal V = Ideal.span {g} ∧ IsRegular g) :
    IsIso (toBase X I)
proof:
:= by
  let S := {V : X.affineOpens // ∃ g : Γ(X, V.1), I.ideal V = Ideal.span {g} ∧ IsRegular g}
  have hcover : ⨆ V : S, V.1.1 = ⊤ := by
    refine top_le_iff.mp fun x _ => ?_
    obtain ⟨V, hxV, hV⟩ := h x
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨V, hV⟩, hxV⟩
  rw [← MorphismProperty.isomorphisms.iff]
  apply IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.of_iSup_eq_top (fun V : S => V.1.1) hcover
  rintro ⟨V, g, hg, hreg⟩
  exact isIso_toBase_restrict_affine_of_eq_span X I V g hg hreg

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.lineMap_comp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.fundamentalCycle_fibreChartOf_generic
statement:
theorem fundamentalCycle_fibreChartOf_generic [IsNoetherian Z] [IsIntegral T'] :
    fundamentalCycle Z (fibreChartOf gt q J τ hJ L sT hT ιZ sZ hZ (genericPoint T')) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hmax : IsMax (fibreChartOf gt q J τ hJ L sT hT ιZ sZ hZ (genericPoint T')) := by
    intro y hy
    rw [Scheme.le_iff_specializes] at hy ⊢
    have hO : IsOpen (Set.range (fibreChartOf gt q J τ hJ L sT hT ιZ sZ hZ)) :=
      (fibreChartOf gt q J τ hJ L sT hT ιZ sZ hZ).isOpenEmbedding.isOpen_range
    obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ : y ∈ Set.range (fibreChartOf gt q J τ hJ L sT hT ιZ sZ hZ) :=
      hy.mem_open hO ⟨_, rfl⟩
    exact (genericPoint_specializes l).map (fibreChartOf gt q J τ hJ L sT hT ιZ sZ hZ).continuous
  rw [fundamentalCycle_apply_of_mem_genericPoints (mem_genericPoints_of_isMax hmax),
    genericMultiplicity_openImmersion_genericPoint_kim]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.mem_compOpen_iff

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.mem_range_of_fibre
statement:
theorem mem_range_of_fibre (m : M) (hm : p m ∈ Set.range q) :
    m ∈ Set.range g₁ ∨ m ∈ Set.range g₂
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  set O : M.Opens := ⟨(Set.range g₁ ∪ Set.range g₂)ᶜ,
    (g₁.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range.union g₂.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range).isOpen_compl⟩
  have hmO : m ∈ O := fun h' ↦ h'.elim h.1 h.2
  have htop : q.ker.comap (O.ι ≫ p) = ⊤ := by
    rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp, hker,
      InfinitySchemeAffineUnion.comap_inf_of_openImmersion,
      MultiplicityGlobalARRM4.ker_comap_eq_top_of_disjoint g₁ O.ι,
      MultiplicityGlobalARRM4.ker_comap_eq_top_of_disjoint g₂ O.ι, inf_top_eq]
    · rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι, Set.disjoint_left]
      intro x hx hxO
      exact hxO (Or.inr hx)
    · rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι, Set.disjoint_left]
      intro x hx hxO
      exact hxO (Or.inl hx)
  have hsupp := Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_comap q.ker (O.ι ≫ p)
  rw [htop, Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_top] at hsupp
  have hmem : (⟨m, hmO⟩ : O.toScheme) ∈ ((q.ker.support.preimage (O.ι ≫ p).continuous :
      TopologicalSpace.Closeds O.toScheme) : Set O.toScheme) := by
    change (O.ι ≫ p) ⟨m, hmO⟩ ∈ (q.ker.support : Set P)
    rw [Scheme.Hom.support_ker]
    exact subset_closure hm
  rw [← hsupp] at hmem
  exact hmem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.comp_isOver_g2tbivf
statement:
theorem comp_isOver_g2tbivf :
    (g₁ ∣_ compOpen g₂).IsOver (Spk k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.isOver_iff]
  change g₁ ∣_ compOpen g₂ ≫ ((compOpen g₂).ι ≫ M ↘ Spk k) = (g₁ ⁻¹ᵁ compOpen g₂).ι ≫ N₁ ↘ Spk k
  rw [← Category.assoc, morphismRestrict_ι, Category.assoc,
    CategoryTheory.comp_over (f := g₁) (S := Spk k)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.isPullback_comp
statement:
theorem isPullback_comp :
    IsPullback (g₁ ∣_ compOpen g₂) ((g₁ ⁻¹ᵁ compOpen g₂).ι ≫ s₁) ((compOpen g₂).ι ≫ p) q
proof:
:= by
  refine isPullback_of_isClosedImmersion _ _ _ _ ?_ ?_
  · rw [← Category.assoc, morphismRestrict_ι, Category.assoc, hs₁, Category.assoc]
  · rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp, hker,
      InfinitySchemeAffineUnion.comap_inf_of_openImmersion,
      MultiplicityGlobalARRM4.ker_comap_eq_top_of_disjoint g₂ (compOpen g₂).ι, inf_top_eq,
      InfinityOtherStrictTransform.closedImmersion_ker_of_isPullback
        (isPullback_morphismRestrict g₁ (compOpen g₂))]
    rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι, Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hx hxO
    exact hxO hx

:= comp_isOver_g2tbivf (k := k) g₁ g₂
    IsPullback (lineMap (k := k) (g₁ ∣_ compOpen g₂))
      (DeformationSpace.toBase (g₁ ⁻¹ᵁ compOpen g₂).toScheme ⊥ ≫ ((g₁ ⁻¹ᵁ compOpen g₂).ι ≫ s₁))
      (DeformationSpace.toBase (compOpen g₂).toScheme ⊥ ≫ ((compOpen g₂).ι ≫ p)) q :=
  haveI := comp_isOver_g2tbivf (k := k) g₁ g₂
  (isPullback_lineMap (k := k) (g₁ ∣_ compOpen g₂)).paste_vert (isPullback_comp p q g₁ g₂ s₁ hs₁ hker)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.compPt_eq_graphChart
statement:
theorem compPt_eq_graphChart :
    haveI
proof:
:= isIntegral_line_g2tbivf (N := N₁)
    ιZ (compPt p q g₁ g₂ s₁ hs₁ hker D gt hgt ιZ sZ hZ hgen₁) =
      graphChart (k := k) D (lineMap (k := k) g₁ (genericPoint (DeformationSpace.line N₁))) := by
  haveI := compOpen_integral g₁ g₂ hgen₁
  haveI := isIntegral_line_g2tbivf (N := (g₁ ⁻¹ᵁ compOpen g₂).toScheme)
  haveI := isIntegral_line_g2tbivf (N := N₁)
  haveI := comp_isOver_g2tbivf (k := k) g₁ g₂
  unfold compPt
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, compChart_ι, ← Category.assoc, ← lineMap_comp,
    lineMap_congr (morphismRestrict_ι g₁ (compOpen g₂)), lineMap_comp, Category.assoc,
    Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, genericPoint_eq_of_isOpenImmersion]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.compPt_eq
statement:
theorem compPt_eq (D₁ : DetIdealComplex N₁)
    (hJ₁ : (graphIdeal (k := k) D).comap (prodMap (k := k) g₁) = graphIdeal (k := k) D₁)
    [IsIntegral (graphModel (k := k) D₁)] :
    ιZ (compPt p q g₁ g₂ s₁ hs₁ hker D gt hgt ιZ sZ hZ hgen₁) =
      modelMap g₁ D D₁ hJ₁ (genericPoint (graphModel (k := k) D₁))
proof:
:= by

    ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply (graphChart (k := k) D₁), graphChart_modelMap, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.genericPoint_eq_of_surjective_g2tbivf
statement:
theorem genericPoint_eq_of_surjective_g2tbivf {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IrreducibleSpace X]
    [IrreducibleSpace Y] (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    f (genericPoint X) = genericPoint Y
proof:
:= by
  apply ((genericPoint_spec Y).eq _).symm
  have h := (genericPoint_spec X).image f.continuous
  rw [Set.image_univ, hf.range_eq, closure_univ] at h
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.toBase_genericPoint_g2tbivf
statement:
theorem toBase_genericPoint_g2tbivf (k : Type u) [Field k] [N.Over (Spk k)] [IsIntegral N] :
    haveI
proof:
:= isIntegral_line_g2tbivf (N := N)
    DeformationSpace.toBase N ⊥ (genericPoint (DeformationSpace.line N)) = genericPoint N := by
  haveI := isIntegral_line_g2tbivf (N := N)
  refine genericPoint_eq_of_surjective_g2tbivf _ fun x ↦ ⟨lineZero (k := k) x, ?_⟩
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, lineZero_toBase]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.lineMap_generic_specializes
statement:
theorem lineMap_generic_specializes (g : N ⟶ M) [g.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsIntegral N]
    (l : DeformationSpace.line M) (hl : DeformationSpace.toBase M ⊥ l ∈ Set.range g) :
    haveI
proof:
:= isIntegral_line_g2tbivf (N := N)
    lineMap (k := k) g (genericPoint (DeformationSpace.line N)) ⤳ l := by
  haveI := isIntegral_line_g2tbivf (N := N)
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hl
  have h := isPullback_lineMap (k := k) g
  obtain ⟨z, hz, -⟩ := Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback (f := DeformationSpace.toBase M ⊥)
    (g := g) l x hx.symm
  have hl : lineMap (k := k) g (h.isoPullback.inv z) = l := by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, h.isoPullback_inv_fst, hz]
  rw [← hl]
  exact (genericPoint_specializes _).map (lineMap (k := k) g).continuous

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.fibre_mem_specializes
statement:
theorem fibre_mem_specializes (z : Z) (hz : ιZ z ∈ graphAway (k := k) D) :
    ιZ (compPt p q g₁ g₂ s₁ hs₁ hker D gt hgt ιZ sZ hZ hgen₁) ⤳ ιZ z ∨
      ιZ (compPt p q g₂ g₁ s₂ hs₂ (hker.trans (inf_comm _ _)) D gt hgt ιZ sZ hZ hgen₂) ⤳ ιZ z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← opensRange_graphChart] at hz
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hz
  have hq : p (DeformationSpace.toBase M ⊥ l) ∈ Set.range q := by
    refine ⟨sZ z, ?_⟩
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← hZ.w, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← hl, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply,
      hgt, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  rcases mem_range_of_fibre p q g₁ g₂ hker _ hq with h1 | h2
  · left
    rw [compPt_eq_graphChart, ← hl]
    exact (lineMap_generic_specializes g₁ l h1).map (graphChart (k := k) D).continuous
  · right
    rw [compPt_eq_graphChart, ← hl]
    exact (lineMap_generic_specializes g₂ l h2).map (graphChart (k := k) D).continuous

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.compPt_ne
statement:
theorem compPt_ne :
    ιZ (compPt p q g₁ g₂ s₁ hs₁ hker D gt hgt ιZ sZ hZ hgen₁) ≠
      ιZ (compPt p q g₂ g₁ s₂ hs₂ (hker.trans (inf_comm _ _)) D gt hgt ιZ sZ hZ hgen₂)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isIntegral_line_g2tbivf (N := N₁)
  haveI := isIntegral_line_g2tbivf (N := N₂)
  rw [compPt_eq_graphChart, compPt_eq_graphChart]
  intro h
  have h' := congrArg (DeformationSpace.toBase M ⊥)
    ((graphChart (k := k) D).isOpenEmbedding.injective h)
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, lineMap_toBase, lineMap_toBase,
    Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, toBase_genericPoint_g2tbivf k,
    toBase_genericPoint_g2tbivf k] at h'
  exact hgen₁ ⟨_, h'.symm⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.pushFund_two_support
statement:
theorem pushFund_two_support [IsNoetherian Z] (w : graphModel (k := k) D)
    (h₁ : w ≠ ιZ (compPt p q g₁ g₂ s₁ hs₁ hker D gt hgt ιZ sZ hZ hgen₁))
    (h₂ : w ≠ ιZ (compPt p q g₂ g₁ s₂ hs₂ (hker.trans (inf_comm _ _)) D gt hgt ιZ sZ hZ hgen₂))
    (hF : properPushforward ιZ (fundamentalCycle Z) w ≠ 0) : w ∉ graphAway (k := k) D
proof:
:= by
  intro hw
  by_cases hr : w ∈ Set.range ιZ
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hr
    rw [WDiv.pushFund_apply_image] at hF
    have hgz : z ∈ genericPoints Z := by
      by_contra hn
      exact hF (fundamentalCycle_apply_of_not_mem_genericPoints hn)
    have hmax := isMax_of_mem_genericPoints hgz
    have key : ∀ c : Z, ιZ c ⤳ ιZ z → ιZ z = ιZ c := fun c hc ↦ by
      have hc' : c ⤳ z := ιZ.isClosedEmbedding.isInducing.specializes_iff.mp hc
      have h3 := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp (hmax (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr hc'))
      rw [(h3.antisymm hc').eq]
    rcases fibre_mem_specializes p q g₁ g₂ s₁ hs₁ s₂ hs₂ hker D gt hgt ιZ sZ hZ hgen₁ hgen₂ z hw
      with hs | hs
    · exact h₁ (key _ hs)
    · exact h₂ (key _ hs)
  · exact hF (WDiv.pushFund_apply_notRange ιZ w hr)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.lCyc_pfHom_infDim_eq
statement:
theorem lCyc_pfHom_infDim_eq :
    haveI
proof:
:= cmpMap_isOver C (C.pullback g) g (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)
    haveI : IsProper (cmpMap C (C.pullback g) g (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)) :=
      isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
    haveI : IsProper gX := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) gX
    lCyc (k := k) C ι (C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU) n
        (D13.pfHom (k := k) (cmpMap C (C.pullback g) g (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)) n
          (infDimCycle (k := k) (C.pullback g).toDetIdealComplex
            (hW_tlmap (k := k) (C.pullback g) hN))) =
      totalPushOn (opsK k) gX (tauRaw (k := k) (C.pullback g) ι' U' hC' hN) := by
  haveI := cmpMap_isOver C (C.pullback g) g (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)
  haveI : IsProper (cmpMap C (C.pullback g) g (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)) :=
    isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
  haveI : IsProper gX := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) gX
  rw [lCyc_eq_outX (k := k) C ι U hC hU,
    push_tauRaw_modelInd_pullback' C ι g ι' gX hgX U' hC' hX' hN]
  change _ = outX (k := k) C ι n (G2T2C.restrictHom (jX (k := k) C ι) n
    (D13.pfHom (k := k) (cmpMap C (C.pullback g) g (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)) n
      (infDimCycle (k := k) (C.pullback g).toDetIdealComplex (hW_tlmap (k := k) (C.pullback g) hN) -
        gammaCycle (k := k) (C.pullback g) U' hC' hN)))
  rw [map_sub, map_sub, map_sub,
    outX_restrict_eq_zero (k := k) C ι U hC hU _
      (pfHom_gammaCycle_mem_closure C U hC hU g U' hC' hUU' hN), sub_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.c1_lambda_cmpMap_eq_pfHom'
statement:
theorem c1_lambda_cmpMap_eq_pfHom' [IsClosedImmersion g] (c₀ : k) (x : C.graphModel (k := k)) :
    haveI
proof:
:= cmpMap_isOver C (C.pullback g) g (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)
    haveI : IsProper (cmpMap C (C.pullback g) g (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)) :=
      isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
    C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (eqOfSection ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.L
          (graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex))
          ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.hL (graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex))
          ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.s (graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex)))
        (cmpMap C (C.pullback g) g (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)
          (genericPoint ((C.pullback g).graphModel (k := k)))) x =
      (D13.pfHom (k := k) (cmpMap C (C.pullback g) g (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)) n
        (infDimCycle (k := k) (C.pullback g).toDetIdealComplex
          (hW_tlmap (k := k) (C.pullback g) hN))).1 x := by
  haveI := cmpMap_isOver C (C.pullback g) g (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)
  haveI : IsProper (cmpMap C (C.pullback g) g (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)) :=
    isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
  set β := cmpMap C (C.pullback g) g (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)
  have hv : height (genericPoint ((C.pullback g).graphModel (k := k))) = n + 1 := by
    rw [hW_tlmap (k := k) (C.pullback g) hN]
    push_cast
    rfl
  have hD : ∀ y, (infDimCycle (k := k) (C.pullback g).toDetIdealComplex
      (hW_tlmap (k := k) (C.pullback g) hN)).1 y =
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (eqOfSection ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.L
          (β ≫ graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex))
        ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.hL (β ≫ graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex))
        ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.s (β ≫ graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex)))
        (genericPoint ((C.pullback g).graphModel (k := k))) y := by
    intro y
    rw [modelMap_toP1]
    exact infDimCycle_apply_c1 (C.pullback g) c₀ hN y
  rw [pfHom_pencil_c1 (RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap β _ _ hv _ hD x,
    degree_modelMap_genericPoint, Nat.cast_one, one_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.c1CapCyclesCoeff_eq_of_two
statement:
theorem c1CapCyclesCoeff_eq_of_two {V : Scheme.{u}} (a : C1Cap.LocalEquations V) (F : V → ℤ)
    (w₁ w₂ : V) (hne : w₁ ≠ w₂) (h₁ : F w₁ = 1) (h₂ : F w₂ = 1)
    (hF : ∀ w, w ≠ w₁ → w ≠ w₂ → F w ≠ 0 → ∀ x, C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a w x = 0) (x : V) :
    C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff a F x = C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a w₁ x + C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a w₂ x
proof:
:= by
  unfold C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff
  rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ (s := {w₁, w₂}) (fun w hw ↦ by
    by_contra hn
    simp only [Finset.coe_insert, Finset.coe_singleton, Set.mem_insert_iff,
      Set.mem_singleton_iff, not_or] at hn
    apply hw
    show F w * _ = 0
    by_cases hFw : F w = 0
    · rw [hFw, zero_mul]
    · rw [hF w hn.1 hn.2 hFw x, mul_zero]), Finset.sum_pair hne, h₁, h₂, one_mul, one_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.genericPoint_not_mem_fibre_two
statement:
theorem genericPoint_not_mem_fibre_two :
    genericPoint (C.graphModel (k := k)) ∉ Set.range ιZ
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
  have hη : ιZ z ∈ graphAway (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex := by
    rw [hz]
    exact genericPoint_mem_graphAway C.toDetIdealComplex
  have hheight : ∀ (N' : Scheme.{u}) [N'.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (N' ↘ Spk k)]
      [IsNoetherian N'] [IsIntegral N'] [Fact (ProjK k N')] (g' : N' ⟶ M) [g'.IsOver (Spk k)]
      [IsClosedImmersion g'] [((C.pullback g').graphModel (k := k)).Over (Spk k)]
      [LocallyOfFiniteType (((C.pullback g').graphModel (k := k)) ↘ Spk k)]
      [IsNoetherian ((C.pullback g').graphModel (k := k))]
      [IsIntegral ((C.pullback g').graphModel (k := k))]
      [Fact (ProjK k ((C.pullback g').graphModel (k := k)))]
      [(xiProj (k := k) (C.pullback g')).IsOver (Spk k)],
      height (genericPoint N') = n → ∀ w : C.graphModel (k := k),
      w = cmpMap C (C.pullback g') g' (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g')
        (genericPoint ((C.pullback g').graphModel (k := k))) →
      w ⤳ genericPoint (C.graphModel (k := k)) → False := by
    intro N' _ _ _ _ _ g' _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hN' w hw hsp
    have hle := Order.height_mono (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr hsp)
    rw [hw, hW_tlmap (k := k) C hM, height_cmpMap_genericPoint C (C.pullback g') g'
      (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g') hN'] at hle
    norm_cast at hle
    omega
  rcases fibre_mem_specializes p q g₁ g₂ s₁ hs₁ s₂ hs₂ hker C.toDetIdealComplex
      (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p) (hgt_xiProj C p) ιZ sZ hZ hgen₁ hgen₂ z hη with hs | hs
  · rw [hz] at hs
    exact hheight N₁ g₁ hN₁ _ (compPt_eq p q g₁ g₂ s₁ hs₁ hker C.toDetIdealComplex _
      (hgt_xiProj C p) ιZ sZ hZ hgen₁ (C.pullback g₁).toDetIdealComplex
      (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g₁)) hs
  · rw [hz] at hs
    exact hheight N₂ g₂ hN₂ _ (compPt_eq p q g₂ g₁ s₂ hs₂ (hker.trans (inf_comm _ _))
      C.toDetIdealComplex _ (hgt_xiProj C p) ιZ sZ hZ hgen₂ (C.pullback g₂).toDetIdealComplex
      (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g₂)) hs

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.c1t_fundW_eq_pushFund_two
statement:
theorem c1t_fundW_eq_pushFund_two (w : C.graphModel (k := k)) :
    C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (eqOfSection (pc.L (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p))
        (pc.hL (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p)) (pc.s (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p))) (fundW (k := k) C hM).1 w =
      properPushforward ιZ (fundamentalCycle Z) w
proof:
:= by
  set gt := xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p
  rw [fundW, G2TEXC.c1CapCyclesCoeff_dimPrimeCycle]
  have hs : pc.s gt = E26.sectionOfHom (KDGb.pullbackSec gt σq) := by
    change wPullbackSection gt pc.σ = _
    rw [hσq]
    exact (KDGb.pullbackSec_app_one gt σq ⊤).symm
  have hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf (KDGb.pullbackSec gt σq) = ιZ.ker := by
    rw [KDGb.sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_pullbackSec pc.hM, hqker]
    exact (InfinityOtherStrictTransform.closedImmersion_ker_of_isPullback hZ).symm
  rw [hs]
  exact c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_pushFund (pc.hL gt) _ ιZ hid
    (genericPoint_not_mem_fibre_two C p q ιZ sZ hZ hM g₁ s₁ hs₁ hN₁ g₂ s₂ hs₂ hN₂ hker hgen₁
      hgen₂) w

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.pfClosed_fibreRep_eq_two
statement:
theorem pfClosed_fibreRep_eq_two :
    haveI
proof:
:= cmpMap_isOver C (C.pullback g₁) g₁ (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g₁)
    haveI : IsProper (cmpMap C (C.pullback g₁) g₁ (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g₁)) :=
      isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
    haveI := cmpMap_isOver C (C.pullback g₂) g₂ (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g₂)
    haveI : IsProper (cmpMap C (C.pullback g₂) g₂ (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g₂)) :=
      isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
    pfClosed (interSnd ιZ ιY ≫ ιY) n
        (fibreRep (k := k) pc (RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p)
          (graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) ιZ (hιZ_of_isPullback C p q pc hSq ιZ sZ hZ)
          ιY hιY n (fundW (k := k) C hM)) =
      D13.pfHom (k := k) (cmpMap C (C.pullback g₁) g₁ (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g₁)) n
          (infDimCycle (k := k) (C.pullback g₁).toDetIdealComplex
            (hW_tlmap (k := k) (C.pullback g₁) hN₁)) +
        D13.pfHom (k := k) (cmpMap C (C.pullback g₂) g₂ (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g₂)) n
          (infDimCycle (k := k) (C.pullback g₂).toDetIdealComplex
            (hW_tlmap (k := k) (C.pullback g₂) hN₂)) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext x
  rw [pfClosed_fibreRep]
  have hF : C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (eqOfSection (pc.L (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p))
      (pc.hL (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p)) (pc.s (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p))) (fundW (k := k) C hM).1 =
      fun w ↦ properPushforward ιZ (fundamentalCycle Z) w :=
    funext (c1t_fundW_eq_pushFund_two C p q pc σq hσq hqker ιZ sZ hZ hM g₁ s₁ hs₁ hN₁ g₂ s₂ hs₂
      hN₂ hker hgen₁ hgen₂)
  set c₁ := compPt p q g₁ g₂ s₁ hs₁ hker C.toDetIdealComplex (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p)
    (hgt_xiProj C p) ιZ sZ hZ hgen₁
  set c₂ := compPt p q g₂ g₁ s₂ hs₂ (hker.trans (inf_comm _ _)) C.toDetIdealComplex
    (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p) (hgt_xiProj C p) ιZ sZ hZ hgen₂
  have h₁ : properPushforward ιZ (fundamentalCycle Z) (ιZ c₁) = 1 := by
    rw [WDiv.pushFund_apply_image, fundamentalCycle_compPt]
  have h₂ : properPushforward ιZ (fundamentalCycle Z) (ιZ c₂) = 1 := by
    rw [WDiv.pushFund_apply_image, fundamentalCycle_compPt]
  have hsupp : ∀ w, w ≠ ιZ c₁ → w ≠ ιZ c₂ → properPushforward ιZ (fundamentalCycle Z) w ≠ 0 →
      ∀ x, C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (eqOfSection ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.L
        (graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex))
        ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.hL (graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex))
        ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.s (graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex))) w x = 0 := by
    intro w hw₁ hw₂ hFw x
    apply c1_pencil_eq_zero_of_not_isUnit
    intro hu
    exact pushFund_two_support p q g₁ g₂ s₁ hs₁ s₂ hs₂ hker C.toDetIdealComplex _
      (hgt_xiProj C p) ιZ sZ hZ hgen₁ hgen₂ w hw₁ hw₂ hFw
      (mem_graphAway_of_isUnit_lambda C.toDetIdealComplex c₀ w hu)
  rw [hF, c1CapCyclesCoeff_eq_of_two _ _ _ _ (compPt_ne p q g₁ g₂ s₁ hs₁ s₂ hs₂ hker
      C.toDetIdealComplex _ (hgt_xiProj C p) ιZ sZ hZ hgen₁ hgen₂) h₁ h₂ hsupp x,
    compPt_eq p q g₁ g₂ s₁ hs₁ hker C.toDetIdealComplex _ (hgt_xiProj C p) ιZ sZ hZ hgen₁
      (C.pullback g₁).toDetIdealComplex (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g₁),
    compPt_eq p q g₂ g₁ s₂ hs₂ _ C.toDetIdealComplex _ (hgt_xiProj C p) ιZ sZ hZ hgen₂
      (C.pullback g₂).toDetIdealComplex (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g₂),
    c1_lambda_cmpMap_eq_pfHom' C g₁ hN₁ c₀ x, c1_lambda_cmpMap_eq_pfHom' C g₂ hN₂ c₀ x]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.fibre_identification_two
statement:
theorem fibre_identification_two :
    haveI
proof:
:= isProper_interSnd_g2tbiv (k := k) ιZ ιY
    haveI : IsProper gX₁ := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) gX₁
    haveI : IsProper gX₂ := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) gX₂
    lChow (k := k) C ι U hC hU (interSnd ιZ ιY ≫ ιY)
        (dichotomy_J (k := k) C ι U hC hU hX ιZ ιY (infSupport_of_lambda (k := k) C c₀ ιY hιY)) n
      (G2T2C.gysinCycles (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ιZ).obj
          ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.L (graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex)))
        (G2T2C.hasConstantRank_restrict _ ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.hL _) ιZ)
        (wPullbackSection ιZ ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.s
          (graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex)))
        (interFst ιZ ιY) n
        (G2XLBC.lbRep (k := k) ιZ (pc.W (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p))
          (pc.hW (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p) ιZ (hιZ_of_isPullback C p q pc hSq ιZ sZ hZ))
          (pc.t (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p)) (n + 1) (fundW (k := k) C hM))) =
      totalPushOn (opsK k) gX₁ (tauRaw (k := k) (C.pullback g₁) ι₁ U₁ hC₁ hN₁) +
        totalPushOn (opsK k) gX₂ (tauRaw (k := k) (C.pullback g₂) ι₂ U₂ hC₂ hN₂) := by
  haveI := isProper_interSnd_g2tbiv (k := k) ιZ ιY
  haveI : IsProper gX₁ := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) gX₁
  haveI : IsProper gX₂ := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) gX₂
  rw [gysinCycles_eq_mk_fibreRep (k := k) pc (RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap
      (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p) (graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) ιZ
      (hιZ_of_isPullback C p q pc hSq ιZ sZ hZ) ιY hιY n (fundW (k := k) C hM),
    lChow_mk, pfClosed_fibreRep_eq_two C p q pc σq hσq hqker hSq ιZ sZ hZ c₀ ιY hιY hM g₁ s₁ hs₁
      hN₁ g₂ s₂ hs₂ hN₂ hker hgen₁ hgen₂, map_add,
    lCyc_pfHom_infDim_eq C ι U hC hU g₁ ι₁ gX₁ hgX₁ U₁ hC₁ hX₁ hUU₁ hN₁,
    lCyc_pfHom_infDim_eq C ι U hC hU g₂ ι₂ gX₂ hgX₂ U₂ hC₂ hX₂ hUU₂ hN₂]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.push_tauRaw_fibre_eq_two
statement:
theorem push_tauRaw_fibre_eq_two :
    haveI : IsProper gX₀
proof:
:= isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) gX₀
    haveI : IsProper gX₁ := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) gX₁
    haveI : IsProper gX₂ := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) gX₂
    totalPushOn (opsK k) gX₀ (tauRaw (k := k) (C.pullback g₀) ι₀ U₀ hC₀ hN₀) =
      totalPushOn (opsK k) gX₁ (tauRaw (k := k) (C.pullback g₁) ι₁ U₁ hC₁ hN₁) +
        totalPushOn (opsK k) gX₂ (tauRaw (k := k) (C.pullback g₂) ι₂ U₂ hC₂ hN₂) := by
  haveI : IsProper gX₀ := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) gX₀
  haveI : IsProper gX₁ := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) gX₁
  haveI : IsProper gX₂ := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) gX₂
  rw [← fibre_identification C ι U hC hU hX g₀ ι₀ gX₀ hgX₀ U₀ hC₀ hX₀ hUU₀ p
      (DeformationSpace.pointAt k c) s₀ hfib₀ (RegDeform.p1Pencil k c) (RegDeform.p1σc k c) rfl
      (RegDeform.p1σc_ker k c) rfl ιZ₀ sZ₀ hZ₀ c₀ ιY hιY hM hN₀,
    ← fibre_identification_two C ι U hC hU hX p (pointInf k) (RegDeform.p1Pencil k c).swap
      (RegDeform.p1σi k c) rfl (RegDeform.p1σi_ker k c) rfl ιZ₁ sZ₁ hZ₁ c₀ ιY hιY hM g₁ ι₁ gX₁ hgX₁
      U₁ hC₁ hX₁ hUU₁ s₁ hs₁ hN₁ g₂ ι₂ gX₂ hgX₂ U₂ hC₂ hX₂ hUU₂ s₂ hs₂ hN₂ hker hgen₁ hgen₂,
    specialization_core_p1 C ι U hC hU hX (RegDeform.p1Pencil k c) (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p) c₀ ιZ₀
      (hιZ_of_isPullback C p (DeformationSpace.pointAt k c) (RegDeform.p1Pencil k c) rfl ιZ₀ sZ₀ hZ₀)
      ιY hιY hM,
    specialization_core_p1 C ι U hC hU hX (RegDeform.p1Pencil k c).swap (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p) c₀
      ιZ₁ (hιZ_of_isPullback C p (pointInf k) (RegDeform.p1Pencil k c).swap rfl ιZ₁ sZ₁ hZ₁)
      ιY hιY hM]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.Statement.ToddTransformation.covariant_fShriekG0All
statement:
theorem covariant_fShriekG0All {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X] [Y.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian Y] [Fact (ProjK k X)] [Fact (ProjK k Y)]
    (hX : C X) (hY : C Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsProper f] (n : ℕ)
    (i : X ⟶ pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n)) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hi : i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) = f) (x : G0 X) :
    T.tau Y (fShriekG0All (Y ↘ Spk k) n i x) = totalPushOn (opsK k) f (T.tau X x)
proof:
:= by
  have hc := INDB.fShriekG0All_computes (Y ↘ Spk k) n i
  rw [hi] at hc
  exact T.covariant hX hY f _ hc x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.Statement.ToddTransformation.tau_k0ToG0_eq_of_regular
statement:
theorem tau_k0ToG0_eq_of_regular (T' : ToddTransformation k C) {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (ProjK k X)] [IsIntegral X]
    (hX : C X) (hreg : RegStalks X) (x : K0 X) :
    T.tau X (k0ToG0 X x) = T'.tau X (k0ToG0 X x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, j, hj, hjo⟩ := (Fact.out : ProjK k X)
  haveI := hj
  haveI : j.IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨hjo⟩
  rw [T.regular hX hreg N j x, T'.regular hX hreg N j x]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.Statement.ToddTransformation.push_eq_of_ambient
statement:
theorem push_eq_of_ambient (T' : ToddTransformation k C) {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (ProjK k X)] (hX : C X) (N : ℕ)
    (ι : X ⟶ space k N) [IsClosedImmersion ι] [ι.IsOver (Spk k)] (x : G0 X) (y : K0 (space k N))
    (hy : k0ToG0 (space k N) y = finitePushforward ι x) :
    haveI : Fact (ProjK k (space k N))
proof:
:= ⟨projK_space N rfl⟩
    totalPushOn (opsK k) ι (T.tau X x) = totalPushOn (opsK k) ι (T'.tau X x) := by
  rw [T.ambient hX N ι x y hy, T'.ambient hX N ι x y hy]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.Statement.ToddTransformation.component_eq_of_leading
statement:
theorem component_eq_of_leading (T' : ToddTransformation k C) {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (ProjK k X)] (hX : C X)
    (F : X.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike X F) (d : ℕ)
    (hd : ∀ x ∈ moduleSheafSupport F, height x ≤ d) (m : ℕ) (hm : d ≤ m) :
    DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) m (T.tau X (g0ClassOf X F hF)) =
      DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) m (T'.tau X (g0ClassOf X F hF))
proof:
:= by
  rcases hm.eq_or_lt with rfl | hlt
  · rw [(T.leading hX F hF d hd).2, (T'.leading hX F hF d hd).2]
  · rw [(T.leading hX F hF d hd).1 m hlt, (T'.leading hX F hF d hd).1 m hlt]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.Statement.ToddTransformation.leading_pushUnit
statement:
theorem leading_pushUnit {X V : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (ProjK k X)] (hX : C X) (ι : V ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι]
    [IsIntegral V] [IsNoetherian V] (hF : IsCoherentLike X (pushUnit ι)) (d : ℕ)
    (hη : height (ι (genericPoint V)) = d)
    (hd : ∀ x ∈ moduleSheafSupport (pushUnit ι), height x ≤ d) :
    DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) d
        (T.tau X (g0ClassOf X (pushUnit ι) hF)) =
      (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (ι (genericPoint V)) d hη) :
        DimChow X d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(T.leading hX _ hF d hd).2, coherentCycle_pushUnit_integral ι hF d hη]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.Statement.ToddTransformation.tau_ne_zero_of_cycle_ne_zero
statement:
theorem tau_ne_zero_of_cycle_ne_zero {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (ProjK k X)] (hX : C X)
    (F : X.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike X F) (d : ℕ)
    (hd : ∀ x ∈ moduleSheafSupport F, height x ≤ d)
    (hne : (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (coherentCycle F hF d) : DimChow X d) ≠ 0) :
    T.tau X (g0ClassOf X F hF) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  apply hne
  rw [← (T.leading hX F hF d hd).2, h0, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.c1_pencil_eq_zero_of_not_isUnit
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  have hx := mem_W_of_c1_ne_zero pc' gl h
  have hwW := mem_W_of_c1_ne_zero' pc' gl h
  apply h
  have e := c1CapPrimeCoeff_eqs_chart (pc'.W gl) (pc'.t gl) (pc'.principalOn gl)
    (⟨w, hwW⟩ : (pc'.W gl).toScheme) ⟨x, hx⟩
  change C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff _ ((pc'.W gl).ι ⟨w, hwW⟩) ((pc'.W gl).ι ⟨x, hx⟩) = 0
  rw [e]
  refine G2TEXC.c1CapPrimeCoeff_germEqs_of_not_isUnit _ ?_ _
  rw [← isUnit_eqs_iff_chart (pc'.W gl) (pc'.t gl) (pc'.principalOn gl)]
  exact hw

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.c1CapCyclesCoeff_eq_of_single
statement:
theorem c1CapCyclesCoeff_eq_of_single (a : C1Cap.LocalEquations V) (F : V → ℤ) (w₀ : V)
    (h₀ : F w₀ = 1) (hF : ∀ w, w ≠ w₀ → F w ≠ 0 → ∀ x, C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a w x = 0) (x : V) :
    C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff a F x = C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a w₀ x
proof:
:= by
  unfold C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff
  rw [finsum_eq_single _ w₀ (fun w hw ↦ by
    by_cases hFw : F w = 0
    · rw [hFw, zero_mul]
    · rw [hF w hw hFw x, mul_zero]), h₀, one_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.hWj_g2tbivf
statement: theorem hWj_g2tbivf : Set.range (interFst ιZ ιY) ⊆ (ιZ ⁻¹ᵁ pc'.W gl : Z.Opens)
proof:
:=
  range_comp_subset_preimage (interFst ιZ ιY) (interSnd ιZ ιY) (inter_condition ιZ ιY)
    (pc'.hW gl ιY hιY)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.gysinCycles_eq_mk_fibreRep
statement:
theorem gysinCycles_eq_mk_fibreRep (n : ℕ) (α : dimensionCycles V (n + 1 + 1)) :
    gysinCycles (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ιZ).obj (pc'.L gl))
        (hasConstantRank_restrict (pc'.L gl) (pc'.hL gl) ιZ) (wPullbackSection ιZ (pc'.s gl))
        (interFst ιZ ιY) n (lbRep (k := k) ιZ (pc.W gt) (pc.hW gt ιZ hιZ) (pc.t gt) (n + 1) α) =
      QuotientAddGroup.mk (fibreRep (k := k) pc pc' gt gl ιZ hιZ ιY hιY n α)
proof:
:=
  gysinCycles_eq_mk_lbRep (k := k) (interFst ιZ ιY) (ιZ ⁻¹ᵁ pc'.W gl)
    (hWj_g2tbivf pc' gl ιZ ιY hιY) (ιZ.app (pc'.W gl) (pc'.t gl))
    (principalOn_pullback (pc'.principalOn gl) ιZ (hasConstantRank_restrict _ (pc'.hL gl) ιZ))
    (excess_restrict_eq_zero (k := k) (interFst ιZ ιY) (hWj_g2tbivf pc' gl ιZ ιY hιY) (pc'.e gl)
      (pc'.he gl)) n _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.pfClosed_fibreRep
statement:
theorem pfClosed_fibreRep (n : ℕ) (α : dimensionCycles V (n + 1 + 1)) (x : V) :
    (pfClosed (interSnd ιZ ιY ≫ ιY) n (fibreRep (k := k) pc pc' gt gl ιZ hιZ ιY hιY n α)).1 x =
      C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (eqOfSection (pc'.L gl) (pc'.hL gl) (pc'.s gl))
        (C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (eqOfSection (pc.L gt) (pc.hL gt) (pc.s gt)) α.1) x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.range (interSnd ιZ ιY ≫ ιY)
  · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [pfClosed_apply_self]
    unfold fibreRep
    rw [lbRep_lbRep_apply (k := k) (pc.hW gt ιZ hιZ) (pc.isSupport gt ιZ hιZ) (pc.principalOn gt)
      (pc'.principalOn gl) (interFst ιZ ιY) (hWj_g2tbivf pc' gl ιZ ιY hιY) n α y,
      ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, inter_condition]
  · rw [pfClosed_apply_of_not_mem _ _ _ x hx]
    symm
    refine iter_eq_zero_of_notMem _ _ (Set.range ιY) (Set.range ιZ)
      ιZ.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range (fun x hx ↦ ((pc'.isSupport gl ιY hιY) x).mpr hx)
      (fun x hx ↦ ((pc.isSupport gt ιZ hιZ) x).mpr hx) _ x ?_
    rintro ⟨hxY, hxZ⟩
    apply hx
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hxZ
    have hz : z ∈ Set.range (interFst ιZ ιY) := by
      rw [range_interFst]
      exact hxY
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hz
    exact ⟨w, by rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← inter_condition, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.range_fst_of_isPullback_g2tbivf
statement:
theorem range_fst_of_isPullback_g2tbivf {P X Y S : Scheme.{u}} {a : P ⟶ X} {b : P ⟶ Y}
    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : Y ⟶ S} (h : IsPullback a b f g) : Set.range a = f ⁻¹' Set.range g
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Scheme.Pullback.range_fst, ← h.isoPullback_hom_fst]
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, (Scheme.Hom.comp_apply _ _ w).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨w, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨h.isoPullback.inv w, ?_⟩
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.isClosedImmersion_of_isPullback_g2tbivf
statement:
theorem isClosedImmersion_of_isPullback_g2tbivf {P X Y S : Scheme.{u}} {a : P ⟶ X} {b : P ⟶ Y}
    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : Y ⟶ S} (h : IsPullback a b f g) [IsClosedImmersion g] : IsClosedImmersion a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h.isoPullback_hom_fst]
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion (pullback.fst f g) :=
    MorphismProperty.pullback_fst (P := @IsClosedImmersion) _ _ ‹_›
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.mem_graphAway_of_isUnit_lambda
statement:
theorem mem_graphAway_of_isUnit_lambda (w : graphModel (k := k) D)
    (hw : IsUnit (eqOfSection ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.L (graphToP1 (k := k) D))
      ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.hL (graphToP1 (k := k) D))
      ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.s (graphToP1 (k := k) D)) w)) :
    w ∈ graphAway (k := k) D
proof:
:= by
  rw [G2XS.Pencil.isUnit_s_iff, RegDeform.p1Pencil_swap_S] at hw
  rw [mem_graphAway_iff_toP1]
  by_contra h
  exact hw (mem_range_infPoint_of_not_mem_chart_one h)

    graphChart (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex ≫ (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p) =

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.genericPoint_not_mem_fibre
statement:
theorem genericPoint_not_mem_fibre :
    genericPoint (C.graphModel (k := k)) ∉ Set.range ιZ
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isClosedImmersion_fibre_g2tbivf g p q sN hfib
  rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
  have hη : genericPoint (C.graphModel (k := k)) ∈ graphAway (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex :=
    genericPoint_mem_graphAway C.toDetIdealComplex
  have hzr : z ∈ Set.range (fibreChart g C.toDetIdealComplex p q sN hfib (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p)
      (hgt_xiProj C p) ιZ sZ hZ) := by
    rw [range_fibreChart]
    show ιZ z ∈ Set.range (graphChart (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex)
    rw [hz, ← opensRange_graphChart] at *
    exact hη
  obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := hzr
  have hsp := (fibrePt_specializes g C.toDetIdealComplex p q sN hfib (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p)
    (hgt_xiProj C p) ιZ sZ hZ l).map ιZ.continuous
  rw [hz, fibrePt_eq g C.toDetIdealComplex p q sN hfib (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p) (hgt_xiProj C p) ιZ
    sZ hZ (C.pullback g).toDetIdealComplex (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)] at hsp
  have hle := Order.height_mono (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr hsp)
  rw [hW_tlmap (k := k) C hM, height_cmpMap_genericPoint C (C.pullback g) g
    (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g) hN] at hle
  norm_cast at hle
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.c1t_fundW_eq_pushFund
statement:
theorem c1t_fundW_eq_pushFund (w : C.graphModel (k := k)) :
    C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (eqOfSection (pc.L (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p))
        (pc.hL (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p)) (pc.s (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p))) (fundW (k := k) C hM).1 w =
      properPushforward ιZ (fundamentalCycle Z) w
proof:
:= by
  set gt := xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p
  rw [fundW, G2TEXC.c1CapCyclesCoeff_dimPrimeCycle]
  have hs : pc.s gt = E26.sectionOfHom (KDGb.pullbackSec gt σq) := by
    change wPullbackSection gt pc.σ = _
    rw [hσq]
    exact (KDGb.pullbackSec_app_one gt σq ⊤).symm
  have hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf (KDGb.pullbackSec gt σq) = ιZ.ker := by
    rw [KDGb.sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_pullbackSec pc.hM, hqker]
    exact (ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityOtherStrictTransform.closedImmersion_ker_of_isPullback hZ).symm
  rw [hs]
  exact c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_pushFund (pc.hL gt) _ ιZ hid
    (genericPoint_not_mem_fibre C g p q sN hfib ιZ sZ hZ hM hN) w

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.pushFund_fibre_support
statement:
theorem pushFund_fibre_support :
    properPushforward ιZ (fundamentalCycle Z)
        (ιZ (fibrePt g C.toDetIdealComplex p q sN hfib (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p) (hgt_xiProj C p)
          ιZ sZ hZ)) = 1 ∧
      ∀ w, w ≠ ιZ (fibrePt g C.toDetIdealComplex p q sN hfib (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p)
          (hgt_xiProj C p) ιZ sZ hZ) → properPushforward ιZ (fundamentalCycle Z) w ≠ 0 →
        ∀ x, C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (eqOfSection ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.L
          (graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex))
          ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.hL (graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex))
          ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.s (graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex))) w x = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨by rw [WDiv.pushFund_apply_image, fundamentalCycle_fibrePt], fun w hw hF x ↦ ?_⟩
  apply c1_pencil_eq_zero_of_not_isUnit
  intro hu
  have hwA := mem_graphAway_of_isUnit_lambda C.toDetIdealComplex c₀ w hu
  by_cases hwr : w ∈ Set.range ιZ
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hwr
    rw [WDiv.pushFund_apply_image] at hF
    apply hF
    refine fundamentalCycle_eq_zero_of_mem_range g C.toDetIdealComplex p q sN hfib _
      (hgt_xiProj C p) ιZ sZ hZ z ?_ (fun h ↦ hw (by rw [h]))
    rw [range_fibreChart]
    show ιZ z ∈ Set.range (graphChart (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex)
    rw [← opensRange_graphChart] at hwA
    exact hwA
  · exact hF (WDiv.pushFund_apply_notRange ιZ w hwr)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.c1_lambda_cmpMap_eq_pfHom
statement:
theorem c1_lambda_cmpMap_eq_pfHom (x : C.graphModel (k := k)) :
    haveI
proof:
:= cmpMap_isOver C (C.pullback g) g (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)
    haveI : IsProper (cmpMap C (C.pullback g) g (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)) :=
      isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
    C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (eqOfSection ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.L
          (graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex))
          ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.hL (graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex))
          ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.s (graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex)))
        (cmpMap C (C.pullback g) g (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)
          (genericPoint ((C.pullback g).graphModel (k := k)))) x =
      (D13.pfHom (k := k) (cmpMap C (C.pullback g) g (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)) n
        (infDimCycle (k := k) (C.pullback g).toDetIdealComplex
          (hW_tlmap (k := k) (C.pullback g) hN))).1 x := by
  haveI := cmpMap_isOver C (C.pullback g) g (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)
  haveI : IsProper (cmpMap C (C.pullback g) g (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)) :=
    isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
  haveI := isClosedImmersion_fibre_g2tbivf g p q sN hfib
  set β := cmpMap C (C.pullback g) g (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)
  have hv : height (genericPoint ((C.pullback g).graphModel (k := k))) = n + 1 := by
    rw [hW_tlmap (k := k) (C.pullback g) hN]
    push_cast
    rfl
  have hD : ∀ y, (infDimCycle (k := k) (C.pullback g).toDetIdealComplex
      (hW_tlmap (k := k) (C.pullback g) hN)).1 y =
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (eqOfSection ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.L
          (β ≫ graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex))
        ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.hL (β ≫ graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex))
        ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.s (β ≫ graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex)))
        (genericPoint ((C.pullback g).graphModel (k := k))) y := by
    intro y
    rw [modelMap_toP1]
    exact infDimCycle_apply_c1 (C.pullback g) c₀ hN y
  rw [pfHom_pencil_c1 (RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap β _ _ hv _ hD x,
    degree_modelMap_genericPoint, Nat.cast_one, one_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.pfClosed_fibreRep_eq
statement:
theorem pfClosed_fibreRep_eq :
    haveI
proof:
:= cmpMap_isOver C (C.pullback g) g (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)
    haveI : IsProper (cmpMap C (C.pullback g) g (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)) :=
      isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
    pfClosed (interSnd ιZ ιY ≫ ιY) n
        (fibreRep (k := k) pc (RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p)
          (graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) ιZ (hιZ_of_isPullback C p q pc hSq ιZ sZ hZ)
          ιY hιY n (fundW (k := k) C hM)) =
      D13.pfHom (k := k) (cmpMap C (C.pullback g) g (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)) n
        (infDimCycle (k := k) (C.pullback g).toDetIdealComplex
          (hW_tlmap (k := k) (C.pullback g) hN)) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext x
  rw [pfClosed_fibreRep]
  have hF : C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff (eqOfSection (pc.L (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p))
      (pc.hL (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p)) (pc.s (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p))) (fundW (k := k) C hM).1 =
      fun w ↦ properPushforward ιZ (fundamentalCycle Z) w :=
    funext (c1t_fundW_eq_pushFund C g p q sN hfib pc σq hσq hqker ιZ sZ hZ hM hN)
  obtain ⟨h₀, hsupp⟩ := pushFund_fibre_support C g p q sN hfib ιZ sZ hZ c₀
  rw [hF, c1CapCyclesCoeff_eq_of_single _ _ _ h₀ hsupp x,
    fibrePt_eq g C.toDetIdealComplex p q sN hfib (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p) (hgt_xiProj C p) ιZ
      sZ hZ (C.pullback g).toDetIdealComplex (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)]
  exact c1_lambda_cmpMap_eq_pfHom C g p q sN hfib c₀ hN x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.pfHom_gammaCycle_mem_closure
statement:
theorem pfHom_gammaCycle_mem_closure (x : C.graphModel (k := k))
    (hx : (haveI := cmpMap_isOver C (C.pullback g) g (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)
      haveI : IsProper (cmpMap C (C.pullback g) g (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)) :=
        isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
      D13.pfHom (k := k) (cmpMap C (C.pullback g) g (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)) n
        (gammaCycle (k := k) (C.pullback g) U' hC' hN)).1 x ≠ 0) :
    x ∈ closure {C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU}
proof:
:= by
  haveI := cmpMap_isOver C (C.pullback g) g (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)
  haveI : IsProper (cmpMap C (C.pullback g) g (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)) :=
    isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
  set β := cmpMap C (C.pullback g) g (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)
  unfold gammaCycle at hx
  split_ifs at hx with hU'
  · change properPushforward β (dimPrimeCycle _ n _).1 x ≠ 0 at hx
    rw [D16.pf_prime_apply] at hx
    split_ifs at hx with hβx
    swap
    · exact absurd rfl hx
    subst hβx
    apply specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp
    refine RankedBundleComplex.gammaPt_specializes C U hC hU ?_ ?_
    · have h := GraphModel.gammaPt_mem_support (k := k) (C.pullback g).toDetIdealComplex U'
        ((C.pullback g).isSplitOn_of_sectionExactOn U' hC') hU'
      rw [← comap_infDivisor_modelMap g C.toDetIdealComplex (C.pullback g).toDetIdealComplex
        (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g), Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_comap] at h
      exact h
    · have h := RankedBundleComplex.xiProj_gammaPt_mem (k := k) (C.pullback g) U' hC' hU'
      have e : C.graphProj (k := k) (β ((C.pullback g).gammaPt (k := k) U' hC' hU')) =
          g ((C.pullback g).graphProj (k := k) ((C.pullback g).gammaPt (k := k) U' hC' hU')) := by
        change (β ≫ graphToBase (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex ≫ pullback.fst _ _) _ =
          (graphToBase (k := k) (C.pullback g).toDetIdealComplex ≫ pullback.fst _ _ ≫ g) _
        rw [modelMap_toBase_fst]
      rw [e]
      exact hUU' _ h
  · exact absurd (by rw [map_zero]; rfl) hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.fibre_identification
statement:
theorem fibre_identification :
    haveI
proof:
:= isProper_interSnd_g2tbiv (k := k) ιZ ιY
    haveI : IsProper gX := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) gX
    lChow (k := k) C ι U hC hU (interSnd ιZ ιY ≫ ιY)
        (dichotomy_J (k := k) C ι U hC hU hX ιZ ιY (infSupport_of_lambda (k := k) C c₀ ιY hιY)) n
      (G2T2C.gysinCycles (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ιZ).obj
          ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.L (graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex)))
        (G2T2C.hasConstantRank_restrict _ ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.hL _) ιZ)
        (wPullbackSection ιZ ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.s
          (graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex)))
        (interFst ιZ ιY) n
        (G2XLBC.lbRep (k := k) ιZ (pc.W (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p))
          (pc.hW (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p) ιZ (hιZ_of_isPullback C p q pc hSq ιZ sZ hZ))
          (pc.t (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p)) (n + 1) (fundW (k := k) C hM))) =
      totalPushOn (opsK k) gX (tauRaw (k := k) (C.pullback g) ι' U' hC' hN) := by
  haveI := isProper_interSnd_g2tbiv (k := k) ιZ ιY
  haveI : IsProper gX := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) gX
  haveI := cmpMap_isOver C (C.pullback g) g (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)
  haveI : IsProper (cmpMap C (C.pullback g) g (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)) :=
    isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
  rw [gysinCycles_eq_mk_fibreRep (k := k) pc (RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap
      (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p) (graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) ιZ
      (hιZ_of_isPullback C p q pc hSq ιZ sZ hZ) ιY hιY n (fundW (k := k) C hM),
    lChow_mk, pfClosed_fibreRep_eq C g p q sN hfib pc σq hσq hqker hSq ιZ sZ hZ c₀ ιY hιY hM hN,
    lCyc_eq_outX (k := k) C ι U hC hU,
    push_tauRaw_modelInd_pullback' C ι g ι' gX hgX U' hC' hX' hN]
  change _ = outX (k := k) C ι n (G2T2C.restrictHom (jX (k := k) C ι) n
    (D13.pfHom (k := k) (cmpMap C (C.pullback g) g (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)) n
      (infDimCycle (k := k) (C.pullback g).toDetIdealComplex (hW_tlmap (k := k) (C.pullback g) hN) -
        gammaCycle (k := k) (C.pullback g) U' hC' hN)))
  rw [map_sub, map_sub, map_sub,
    outX_restrict_eq_zero (k := k) C ι U hC hU _
      (pfHom_gammaCycle_mem_closure C U hC hU g U' hC' hUU' hN), sub_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.push_tauRaw_fibre_eq
statement:
theorem push_tauRaw_fibre_eq :
    haveI : IsProper gX₁
proof:
:= isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) gX₁
    haveI : IsProper gX₂ := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) gX₂
    totalPushOn (opsK k) gX₁ (tauRaw (k := k) (C.pullback g₁) ι₁ U₁ hC₁ hN₁) =
      totalPushOn (opsK k) gX₂ (tauRaw (k := k) (C.pullback g₂) ι₂ U₂ hC₂ hN₂) := by
  haveI : IsProper gX₁ := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) gX₁
  haveI : IsProper gX₂ := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) gX₂
  rw [← fibre_identification C ι U hC hU hX g₁ ι₁ gX₁ hgX₁ U₁ hC₁ hX₁ hUU₁ p
      (DeformationSpace.pointAt k c) s₁ hfib₁ (RegDeform.p1Pencil k c) (RegDeform.p1σc k c) rfl
      (RegDeform.p1σc_ker k c) rfl ιZ₁ sZ₁ hZ₁ c₀ ιY hιY hM hN₁,
    ← fibre_identification C ι U hC hU hX g₂ ι₂ gX₂ hgX₂ U₂ hC₂ hX₂ hUU₂ p
      (pointInf k) s₂ hfib₂ (RegDeform.p1Pencil k c).swap (RegDeform.p1σi k c) rfl
      (RegDeform.p1σi_ker k c) rfl ιZ₂ sZ₂ hZ₂ c₀ ιY hιY hM hN₂,
    specialization_core_p1 C ι U hC hU hX (RegDeform.p1Pencil k c) (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p) c₀ ιZ₁
      (hιZ_of_isPullback C p (DeformationSpace.pointAt k c) (RegDeform.p1Pencil k c) rfl ιZ₁ sZ₁ hZ₁)
      ιY hιY hM,
    specialization_core_p1 C ι U hC hU hX (RegDeform.p1Pencil k c).swap (xiProj (k := k) C ≫ p) c₀
      ιZ₂ (hιZ_of_isPullback C p (pointInf k) (RegDeform.p1Pencil k c).swap rfl ιZ₂ sZ₂ hZ₂)
      ιY hιY hM]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.tauRaw_fibre_eq
statement:
theorem tauRaw_fibre_eq :
    tauRaw (k := k) (C.pullback g₁) ι' U₁ hC₁ hN = tauRaw (k := k) (C.pullback g₂) ι' U₂ hC₂ hN
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsProper gX₁ := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) gX₁
  haveI : IsProper gX₂ := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) gX₂
  haveI : IsProper r := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) r
  have h := congrArg (totalPushOn (opsK k) r)
    (push_tauRaw_fibre_eq C ι U hC hU hX p c c₀ ιY hιY hM g₁ ι' gX₁ hgX₁ U₁ hC₁ hX₁ hUU₁ s₁ hfib₁
      ιZ₁ sZ₁ hZ₁ hN g₂ ι' gX₂ hgX₂ U₂ hC₂ hX₂ hUU₂ s₂ hfib₂ ιZ₂ sZ₂ hZ₂ hN)
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← totalPushOn_comp, ← totalPushOn_comp,
    totalPushOn_congr (opsK k) hr₁, totalPushOn_congr (opsK k) hr₂, totalPushOn_id] at h
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.linMinorsIdeal_map_le
statement:
theorem linMinorsIdeal_map_le (lP : P →ₗ[R] P') (lQ : Q →ₗ[R] Q') [IsLocalizedModule S lQ]
    (φ : P →ₗ[R] Q) (φ' : P' →ₗ[R'] Q') (h : ∀ p, φ' (lP p) = lQ (φ p)) (r : ℕ) :
    (linMinorsIdeal φ r).map (algebraMap R R') ≤ linMinorsIdeal φ' r
proof:
:= by
  rw [linMinorsIdeal, Ideal.map_span, Ideal.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨⟨p, ψ⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  let ext : Module.Dual R Q → Module.Dual R' Q' := fun χ =>
    IsLocalizedModule.mapExtendScalars S lQ (Algebra.linearMap R R') R' χ
  have hext : ∀ χ q, ext χ (lQ q) = algebraMap R R' (χ q) := by
    intro χ q
    simp [ext, IsLocalizedModule.mapExtendScalars_apply_apply, IsLocalizedModule.map_apply]
  have hmem := det_mem_linMinorsIdeal φ' (fun b => lP (p b)) (fun a => ext (ψ a))
  have e : (algebraMap R R') (Matrix.of fun a b => ψ a (φ (p b))).det =
      (Matrix.of fun a b => ext (ψ a) (φ' (lP (p b)))).det := by
    rw [RingHom.map_det]
    congr 1
    ext a b
    simp [h, hext]
  show _ ∈ (linMinorsIdeal φ' r : Set R')
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, e]
  exact hmem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.linMinorsIdeal_le_map
statement:
theorem linMinorsIdeal_le_map (lP : P →ₗ[R] P') (lQ : Q →ₗ[R] Q')
    (hsurj : ∀ y : P', ∃ (p : P) (s : S), algebraMap R R' s • y = lP p)
    [Module.FinitePresentation R Q]
    (φ : P →ₗ[R] Q) (φ' : P' →ₗ[R'] Q') (h : ∀ p, φ' (lP p) = lQ (φ p)) (r : ℕ) :
    linMinorsIdeal φ' r ≤ (linMinorsIdeal φ r).map (algebraMap R R')
proof:
:= by
  refine Ideal.span_le.2 ?_
  rintro _ ⟨⟨p', ψ'⟩, rfl⟩
  choose p s hps using fun b => hsurj (p' b)
  
  have hlift : ∀ a, ∃ (χ : Module.Dual R Q) (t : S),
      ∀ q, algebraMap R R' (χ q) = algebraMap R R' t * ψ' a (lQ q) := by
    intro a
    let g : Q →ₗ[R] R' := ((ψ' a).restrictScalars R).comp lQ
    obtain ⟨χ, t, hχ⟩ := Module.FinitePresentation.exists_lift_of_isLocalizedModule S
      (Algebra.linearMap R R') g
    refine ⟨χ, t, fun q => ?_⟩
    have := LinearMap.congr_fun hχ q
    simpa [g, Submonoid.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def] using this
  choose χ t hχ using hlift
  set D' : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) R' := Matrix.of fun a b => ψ' a (φ' (p' b)) with hD'
  have hkey : (Matrix.of fun a b => (algebraMap R R' (t a)) *
      ((algebraMap R R' (s b)) * D' a b)) =
      (Matrix.of fun a b => χ a (φ (p b))).map (algebraMap R R') := by
    ext a b
    simp only [Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.map_apply, hD', hχ, ← h, ← hps]
    rw [map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  have hdet : (algebraMap R R') (Matrix.of fun a b => χ a (φ (p b))).det =
      (∏ a, algebraMap R R' (t a)) * ((∏ b, algebraMap R R' (s b)) * D'.det) := by
    rw [RingHom.map_det, RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, ← hkey, ← Matrix.det_mul_row,
      ← Matrix.det_mul_column]
    rfl
  have hdet' : (∏ a, algebraMap R R' (t a)) * ((∏ b, algebraMap R R' (s b)) * D'.det) ∈
      (linMinorsIdeal φ r).map (algebraMap R R') := by
    rw [← hdet]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (det_mem_linMinorsIdeal φ p χ)
  have hu : IsUnit ((∏ a, algebraMap R R' (t a)) * ∏ b, algebraMap R R' (s b)) := by
    refine IsUnit.mul (IsUnit.prod_univ_iff.2 ?_) (IsUnit.prod_univ_iff.2 ?_) <;>
      intro i <;> exact IsLocalization.map_units R' _
  rw [← mul_assoc] at hdet'
  exact (Ideal.unit_mul_mem_iff_mem _ hu).1 hdet'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.fromSpec_appIso_inv_res
statement:
theorem fromSpec_appIso_inv_res (V : (Spec Γ(X, U)).Opens) (r : Γ(X, U)) :
    (hU.fromSpec.appIso V).inv.hom (((Spec Γ(X, U)).presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op).hom
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv.hom r)) =
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (image_fromSpec_le hU V)).op).hom r

:= by

      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv.hom r) = (hU.fromSpec.appLE U V hV).hom r := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.appLE, CommRingCat.comp_apply, IsAffineOpen.fromSpec_app_self_apply,
      ← CommRingCat.comp_apply ((Spec Γ(X, U)).presheaf.map _)

    (y : Γ(N, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.spec_exists_pow_smul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem spec_exists_pow_smul_eq_zero (N : (Spec R).Modules) [N.IsQuasicoherent] (f : R)
    (x : Γ(N, ⊤))
    (hx : N.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ ⊤)).op x = 0) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, f ^ n • x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hloc := specResXiS_isLocalized N f
  obtain ⟨⟨_, n, rfl⟩, hc⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.exists_of_eq (S := Submonoid.powers f)
    (f := specResXiS N f) (x₁ := x) (x₂ := 0) (by rw [map_zero]; exact hx)
  rw [smul_zero] at hc
  exact ⟨n, hc⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.exists_pow_smul_eq_res
statement:
theorem exists_pow_smul_eq_res [G.IsQuasicoherent] (f : Γ(X, U)) (y : Γ(G, X.basicOpen f)) :
    ∃ (x : Γ(G, U)) (n : ℕ), (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op).hom f ^ n • y =
      G.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op x
proof:
:= by
  have e2 : hU.fromSpec ''ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f = X.basicOpen f :=
    hU.fromSpec_image_basicOpen f
  have e1 := image_top_fromSpec hU
  obtain ⟨xN, n, hx⟩ := spec_exists_pow_smul_eq_res (G.restrict hU.fromSpec) f
    (G.presheaf.map (homOfLE e2.le).op y)
  refine ⟨G.presheaf.map (homOfLE e1.ge).op xN, n, ?_⟩
  apply res_injective_of_eq_xiS G e2
  have hx' : (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (image_fromSpec_le hU _)).op).hom (f ^ n) •
      G.presheaf.map (homOfLE e2.le).op y =
      G.presheaf.map (homOfLE (Scheme.Hom.image_mono _ le_top)).op xN :=
    (fromSpec_smul_eq hU G _ (f ^ n) _).symm.trans hx
  rw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul, ← map_pow, ringRes_res_xiS, res_res_xiS, hx', res_res_xiS]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_res
statement:
theorem exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_res [G.IsQuasicoherent] (f : Γ(X, U)) (x : Γ(G, U))
    (hx : G.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op x = 0) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, f ^ n • x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have e2 : hU.fromSpec ''ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f = X.basicOpen f :=
    hU.fromSpec_image_basicOpen f
  have e1 := image_top_fromSpec hU
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := spec_exists_pow_smul_eq_zero (G.restrict hU.fromSpec) f
    (G.presheaf.map (homOfLE e1.le).op x) (by
      change G.presheaf.map (homOfLE (Scheme.Hom.image_mono _ le_top)).op
        (G.presheaf.map (homOfLE e1.le).op x) = 0
      rw [res_res_xiS, ← res_res_xiS G (X.basicOpen_le f) e2.le, hx, map_zero])
  refine ⟨n, res_injective_of_eq_xiS G e1 ?_⟩
  have hn' : (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (image_fromSpec_le hU _)).op).hom (f ^ n) •
      G.presheaf.map (homOfLE e1.le).op x = 0 :=
    (fromSpec_smul_eq hU G _ (f ^ n) _).symm.trans hn
  rw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul, map_zero]
  exact hn'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.finitePresentation_sections_of_isAffineOpen
statement:
theorem finitePresentation_sections_of_isAffineOpen [G.IsFinitePresentation] :
    Module.FinitePresentation Γ(X, U) Γ(G, U)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : (G.restrict hU.fromSpec).IsFinitePresentation :=
    isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor hU.fromSpec G
  haveI := moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation (G.restrict hU.fromSpec)
  exact Module.FinitePresentation.of_equiv
    ((topSectionsLinearEquivModuleSpecΓ (G.restrict hU.fromSpec)).symm.trans
      (topSectionsEquivXiS hU G))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.isLocalizedModule_of_pow
statement:
theorem isLocalizedModule_of_pow {R R' : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing R'] [Algebra R R'] (f : R)
    [IsLocalization.Away f R'] {Q Q' : Type*} [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q] [AddCommGroup Q']
    [Module R' Q'] [Module R Q'] (hQ' : ∀ (a : R) (y : Q'), a • y = algebraMap R R' a • y)
    (l : Q →ₗ[R] Q')
    (hsurj : ∀ y : Q', ∃ (x : Q) (n : ℕ), algebraMap R R' f ^ n • y = l x)
    (hker : ∀ x : Q, l x = 0 → ∃ n : ℕ, f ^ n • x = 0) :
    IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f) l where
  map_units x
proof:
:= by
    rw [Module.End.isUnit_iff]
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := IsLocalization.map_units R' x
    have hact : ∀ y : Q', (algebraMap R (Module.End R Q') x) y = (u : R') • y := by
      intro y
      rw [Module.algebraMap_end_apply, hQ', hu]
    refine ⟨fun a b hab => ?_, fun b => ⟨(↑u⁻¹ : R') • b, ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [hact, hact] at hab
      have := congrArg (fun y => (↑u⁻¹ : R') • y) hab
      simp only [smul_smul, Units.inv_mul, one_smul] at this
      exact this
    · rw [hact, smul_smul, Units.mul_inv, one_smul]
  surj y := by
    obtain ⟨x, n, hx⟩ := hsurj y
    refine ⟨⟨x, ⟨f ^ n, n, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    change (f ^ n) • y = l x
    rw [hQ', map_pow, hx]
  exists_of_eq {x₁ x₂} h := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hker (x₁ - x₂) (by rw [map_sub, h, sub_self])
    refine ⟨⟨f ^ n, n, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    change f ^ n • x₁ = f ^ n • x₂
    rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← smul_sub, hn]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.linMinorsIdeal_basicOpen
statement:
theorem linMinorsIdeal_basicOpen {E F : X.Modules} [E.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFinitePresentation]
    (d : E ⟶ F) (r : ℕ) (U : X.affineOpens) (f : Γ(X, U)) :
    (linMinorsIdeal (sectionMap d U.1) r).map
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op).hom =
      linMinorsIdeal (sectionMap d (X.affineBasicOpen f).1) r
proof:
:= by
  have hU := U.2
  haveI := hU.isLocalization_basicOpen f
  letI : Module Γ(X, U) (E.val.obj (op (X.basicOpen f))) :=
    Module.compHom _ (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op).hom
  letI : Module Γ(X, U) (F.val.obj (op (X.basicOpen f))) :=
    Module.compHom _ (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op).hom
  haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(X, U) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) (E.val.obj (op (X.basicOpen f))) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul fun _ _ => rfl
  haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(X, U) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) (F.val.obj (op (X.basicOpen f))) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul fun _ _ => rfl
  let lP := resLinXiS E (X.basicOpen_le f)
  let lQ := resLinXiS F (X.basicOpen_le f)
  haveI : Module.FinitePresentation Γ(X, U) (F.val.obj (op U.1)) :=
    finitePresentation_sections_of_isAffineOpen hU F
  haveI : IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f) lQ :=
    isLocalizedModule_of_pow (R' := Γ(X, X.basicOpen f)) f (fun _ _ => rfl) lQ
      (fun y => exists_pow_smul_eq_res hU F f y)
      (fun x hx => exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_res hU F f x hx)
  have hnat : ∀ p, sectionMap d (X.basicOpen f) (lP p) = lQ (sectionMap d U.1 p) :=
    fun p => PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply d.val (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op p
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact linMinorsIdeal_map_le (Submonoid.powers f) lP lQ _ _ hnat r
  · refine linMinorsIdeal_le_map (Submonoid.powers f) lP lQ ?_ _ _ hnat r
    intro y
    obtain ⟨x, n, hx⟩ := exists_pow_smul_eq_res hU E f y
    exact ⟨x, ⟨f ^ n, n, rfl⟩, by rw [map_pow]; exact hx⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.sheafMinorsIdeal_eq_minorsIdealSheafData
statement:
theorem sheafMinorsIdeal_eq_minorsIdealSheafData {E F : X.Modules} [E.IsQuasicoherent]

    sheafMinorsIdeal d r = minorsIdealSheafData d r

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.minorsCompatible_of_isFinitePresentation
statement:
theorem minorsCompatible_of_isFinitePresentation {E F : X.Modules} [E.IsQuasicoherent]
    [F.IsFinitePresentation] (d : E ⟶ F) (r : ℕ) (U : X.affineOpens) : MinorsCompatible d r U

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.minorsIdeal_of_isEmpty_rows
statement:
theorem minorsIdeal_of_isEmpty_rows {A : Type*} [CommRing A] {m n : Type*} [IsEmpty m]
    (d : Matrix m n A) (r : ℕ) : GraphBundles.minorsIdeal r d = if r = 0 then ⊤ else ⊥
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with hr
  · subst hr; exact minorsIdeal_zero d
  · obtain ⟨r', rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hr
    rw [GraphBundles.minorsIdeal, Ideal.span_eq_bot]
    rintro _ ⟨⟨S, T⟩, rfl⟩
    exact isEmptyElim (S 0)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.minorsCompatible
statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.minorsCompatible (C : RankedBundleComplex X) (j r : ℕ)
    (U : X.affineOpens) : MinorsCompatible (C.K.d j) r U
proof:
:= by
  haveI := (C.K.hE (j + 1)).isFinitePresentation
  haveI := (C.K.hE j).isFinitePresentation
  exact minorsCompatible_of_isFinitePresentation _ r U

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.detIdeal_ideal_eq_of_frames
statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.detIdeal_ideal_eq_of_frames (C : RankedBundleComplex X)
    (V : X.affineOpens) {m n : ℕ → Type u} [∀ j, Fintype (m j)] [∀ j, Fintype (n j)]
    [∀ j, DecidableEq (m j)] [∀ j, DecidableEq (n j)] [IsEmpty (m 0)]
    (D : ∀ j, Matrix (m j) (n j) Γ(X, V.1))
    (eE : ∀ j, (n (j + 1) → Γ(X, V.1)) ≃ₗ[Γ(X, V.1)] (C.K.E (j + 1)).val.obj (op V.1))
    (eF : ∀ j, (C.K.E j).val.obj (op V.1) ≃ₗ[Γ(X, V.1)] (m (j + 1) → Γ(X, V.1)))
    (hD : ∀ j, (eF j).toLinearMap ∘ₗ sectionMap (C.K.d j) V.1 ∘ₗ (eE j).toLinearMap =
      (D (j + 1)).mulVecLin) (j r : ℕ) :
    (C.detIdeal j r).ideal V = GraphBundles.minorsIdeal r (D j)
proof:
:= by
  cases j with
  | zero =>
    rw [RankedBundleComplex.detIdeal_zero_left, minorsIdeal_of_isEmpty_rows]
    split_ifs <;> rfl
  | succ j =>
    rw [RankedBundleComplex.detIdeal_succ]
    exact ideal_sheafMinorsIdeal_eq_minorsIdeal _ r V (C.minorsCompatible j r V) (eE j) (eF j)
      (D (j + 1)) (hD j)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.detIdeal_ideal_map_eq_of_frames
statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.detIdeal_ideal_map_eq_of_frames (C : RankedBundleComplex X)
    (V : X.affineOpens) {m n : ℕ → Type u} [∀ j, Fintype (m j)] [∀ j, Fintype (n j)]
    [∀ j, DecidableEq (m j)] [∀ j, DecidableEq (n j)] [IsEmpty (m 0)]
    (D : ∀ j, Matrix (m j) (n j) Γ(X, V.1))
    (eE : ∀ j, (n (j + 1) → Γ(X, V.1)) ≃ₗ[Γ(X, V.1)] (C.K.E (j + 1)).val.obj (op V.1))
    (eF : ∀ j, (C.K.E j).val.obj (op V.1) ≃ₗ[Γ(X, V.1)] (m (j + 1) → Γ(X, V.1)))
    (hD : ∀ j, (eF j).toLinearMap ∘ₗ sectionMap (C.K.d j) V.1 ∘ₗ (eE j).toLinearMap =
      (D (j + 1)).mulVecLin) {B : Type*} [CommRing B] (φ : Γ(X, V.1) →+* B) (j r : ℕ) :
    ((C.toDetIdealComplex.detIdeal j r).ideal V).map φ =
      GraphBundles.minorsIdeal r ((D j).map φ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [RankedBundleComplex.toDetIdealComplex_detIdeal,
    C.detIdeal_ideal_eq_of_frames V D eE eF hD j r, minorsIdeal_map]

name: MinorsSat.minor_mem_maxMinors
statement:
theorem minor_mem_maxMinors (φ : Matrix m n A) (S : n → m) :
    (φ.submatrix S id).det ∈ maxMinors φ
