:=
  Ideal.subset_span ⟨S, rfl⟩

name: MinorsSat.cancel_mul
statement: theorem cancel_mul {Δ x y : A} (hΔ : IsSMulRegular A Δ) (h : Δ * x = Δ * y) : x = y
proof:
:=
  hΔ (by simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using h)

name: MinorsSat.cancel_smul_vec
statement:
theorem cancel_smul_vec {κ : Type*} {Δ : A} (hΔ : IsSMulRegular A Δ) {v w : κ → A}
    (h : Δ • v = Δ • w) : v = w
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  exact cancel_mul hΔ (by simpa using congrFun h k)

name: MinorsSat.cancel_smul_mat
statement:
theorem cancel_smul_mat {κ κ' : Type*} {Δ : A} (hΔ : IsSMulRegular A Δ) {X Y : Matrix κ κ' A}
    (h : Δ • X = Δ • Y) : X = Y
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  exact cancel_mul hΔ (by simpa using congrFun₂ h i j)

name: MinorsSat.mul_adjugate_apply
statement:
theorem mul_adjugate_apply (i : m) (s : ι) :
    (φ.submatrix id T₀ * adjugate (φ.submatrix S₀ T₀)) i s =
      (φ.submatrix (Function.update S₀ s i) T₀).det
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (φ.submatrix id T₀ * adjugate (φ.submatrix S₀ T₀)) i s =
      cramer (φ.submatrix S₀ T₀)ᵀ (fun t => φ i (T₀ t)) s := by
    rw [cramer_eq_adjugate_mulVec, ← adjugate_transpose, mulVec_transpose]
    simp [vecMul, dotProduct, Matrix.mul_apply]
  rw [h1, cramer_transpose_apply]
  congr 1
  ext a b
  by_cases h : a = s
  · subst h; simp
  · simp [h]

name: MinorsSat.smul_eq_mul_adjugate_mul
statement:
theorem smul_eq_mul_adjugate_mul (hΔ : IsSMulRegular A (φ.submatrix S₀ T₀).det)
    (hrank : ∀ (S : ι ⊕ Unit → m) (T : ι ⊕ Unit → n), (φ.submatrix S T).det = 0) :
    (φ.submatrix S₀ T₀).det • φ =
      (φ.submatrix id T₀ * adjugate (φ.submatrix S₀ T₀)) * φ.submatrix S₀ id
proof:
:= by
  set M := φ.submatrix S₀ T₀ with hM
  set Δ := M.det with hΔdef
  ext i c
  
  let y : Matrix ι Unit A := Matrix.of fun t _ => φ (S₀ t) c
  let x : Matrix Unit ι A := Matrix.of fun _ t => φ i (T₀ t)
  let d : Matrix Unit Unit A := Matrix.of fun _ _ => φ i c
  let N : Matrix (ι ⊕ Unit) (ι ⊕ Unit) A := fromBlocks M y x d
  have hN : N = φ.submatrix (Sum.elim S₀ fun _ => i) (Sum.elim T₀ fun _ => c) := by
    ext (a | a) (b | b) <;> rfl
  have hNdet : N.det = 0 := by rw [hN]; exact hrank _ _
  let K : Matrix (ι ⊕ Unit) (ι ⊕ Unit) A :=
    fromBlocks (adjugate M) (-(adjugate M * y)) 0 (Δ • (1 : Matrix Unit Unit A))
  let E : Matrix Unit Unit A := x * -(adjugate M * y) + d * (Δ • (1 : Matrix Unit Unit A))
  have hNK : N * K = fromBlocks (Δ • (1 : Matrix ι ι A)) 0 (x * adjugate M) E := by
    simp only [N, K, E, fromBlocks_multiply, mul_adjugate, Matrix.mul_zero, add_zero,
      Matrix.mul_neg, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_one, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← hΔdef]
    congr 1
    rw [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.one_mul, neg_add_cancel]
  have hdet := congrArg Matrix.det hNK
  rw [det_mul, hNdet, zero_mul, det_fromBlocks_zero₁₂, det_smul, det_one, mul_one,
    det_unique] at hdet
  
  have hE : E () () = 0 := by
    have hreg : IsSMulRegular A (Δ ^ Fintype.card ι) := hΔ.pow _
    exact cancel_mul hreg (by rw [← hdet, mul_zero])
  have hE' : E () () = Δ * φ i c -
      (φ.submatrix id T₀ * (adjugate M * φ.submatrix S₀ id)) i c := by
    simp only [E, x, y, d, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.neg_apply,
      Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, Finset.univ_unique, Finset.sum_singleton,
      submatrix_apply, id, smul_eq_mul, if_true, mul_one]
    simp only [mul_neg, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    ring
  rw [hE', ← Matrix.mul_assoc] at hE
  simpa [smul_eq_mul] using sub_eq_zero.1 hE

name: MinorsSat.mul_adjugate_mem
statement:
theorem mul_adjugate_mem (hgen : ∀ S : ι → m,
      (φ.submatrix S T₀).det ∈ Ideal.span {(φ.submatrix S₀ T₀).det}) (i : m) (s : ι) :
    ∃ b : A, b * (φ.submatrix S₀ T₀).det =
      (φ.submatrix id T₀ * adjugate (φ.submatrix S₀ T₀)) i s
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_adjugate_apply]
  exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.1 (hgen _)

name: MinorsSat.smul_satMat
statement:
theorem smul_satMat (hgen : ∀ S : ι → m,
      (φ.submatrix S T₀).det ∈ Ideal.span {(φ.submatrix S₀ T₀).det}) :
    (φ.submatrix S₀ T₀).det • satMat hgen =
      φ.submatrix id T₀ * adjugate (φ.submatrix S₀ T₀)
proof:
:= by
  ext i s
  rw [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  exact Classical.choose_spec (mul_adjugate_mem hgen i s)

name: MinorsSat.satMat_rows_one
statement:
theorem satMat_rows_one (hΔ : IsSMulRegular A (φ.submatrix S₀ T₀).det)
    (hgen : ∀ S : ι → m,
      (φ.submatrix S T₀).det ∈ Ideal.span {(φ.submatrix S₀ T₀).det}) :
    (satMat hgen).submatrix S₀ id = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply cancel_smul_mat hΔ
  have hs : (φ.submatrix S₀ T₀).det • (satMat hgen).submatrix S₀ id =
      ((φ.submatrix S₀ T₀).det • satMat hgen).submatrix S₀ id := rfl
  rw [hs, smul_satMat]
  have : (φ.submatrix id T₀ * adjugate (φ.submatrix S₀ T₀)).submatrix S₀ id =
      φ.submatrix S₀ T₀ * adjugate (φ.submatrix S₀ T₀) := by
    ext a b; simp [Matrix.mul_apply]
  rw [this, mul_adjugate]

name: MinorsSat.satMat_factor
statement:
theorem satMat_factor (hΔ : IsSMulRegular A (φ.submatrix S₀ T₀).det)
    (hgen : ∀ S : ι → m,
      (φ.submatrix S T₀).det ∈ Ideal.span {(φ.submatrix S₀ T₀).det})
    (hrank : ∀ (S : ι ⊕ Unit → m) (T : ι ⊕ Unit → n), (φ.submatrix S T).det = 0) :
    φ = satMat hgen * φ.submatrix S₀ id
proof:
:= by
  apply cancel_smul_mat hΔ
  rw [smul_eq_mul_adjugate_mul hΔ hrank, ← Matrix.smul_mul, smul_satMat]

name: MinorsSat.isSatSummand_of
statement:
theorem isSatSummand_of {Δ : A} (hΔ : IsSMulRegular A Δ) {B : Matrix m ι A}
    (h1 : B.submatrix S₀ id = 1) (hfac : φ = B * φ.submatrix S₀ id)
    (hsmul : ∀ u : ι → A, ∃ w : n → A, Δ • (B *ᵥ u) = φ *ᵥ w) :
    IsSatSummand φ S₀ Δ B
proof:
:= by
  have hrestr : ∀ u : ι → A, (fun s => (B *ᵥ u) (S₀ s)) = u := by
    intro u
    have : (fun s => (B *ᵥ u) (S₀ s)) = (B.submatrix S₀ id) *ᵥ u := rfl
    rw [this, h1, one_mulVec]
  have hrange_le : LinearMap.range φ.mulVecLin ≤ LinearMap.range B.mulVecLin := by
    rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨φ.submatrix S₀ id *ᵥ w, ?_⟩
    simp only [mulVecLin_apply]
    rw [mulVec_mulVec, ← hfac]
  have hsat : ∀ s : A, IsSMulRegular A s → ∀ v : m → A,
      s • v ∈ LinearMap.range B.mulVecLin → v ∈ LinearMap.range B.mulVecLin := by
    rintro s hs v ⟨u, hu⟩
    simp only [mulVecLin_apply] at hu
    refine ⟨fun t => v (S₀ t), ?_⟩
    simp only [mulVecLin_apply]
    apply cancel_smul_vec hs
    have hu' : u = s • fun t => v (S₀ t) := by
      rw [← hrestr u, hu]; rfl
    rw [← mulVec_smul, ← hu', hu]
  refine
    { rows_one := h1
      factor := hfac
      range_le := hrange_le
      smul_mem := ?_
      injective := ?_
      isCompl := ?_
      saturated := hsat
      mem_iff := ?_ }
  · rintro _ ⟨u, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hsmul u
    exact ⟨w, by simp [hw]⟩
  · intro u u' h
    rw [← hrestr u, ← hrestr u']
    simp only [mulVecLin_apply] at h
    rw [h]
  · constructor
    · rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
      rintro v ⟨u, rfl⟩ hv
      simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, mulVecLin_apply] at hv ⊢
      have : (fun s => (B *ᵥ u) (S₀ s)) = 0 := hv
      rw [hrestr] at this
      rw [this, mulVec_zero]
    · rw [codisjoint_iff, eq_top_iff]
      intro v _
      refine Submodule.mem_sup.2 ⟨B *ᵥ fun t => v (S₀ t), ⟨_, rfl⟩,
        v - B *ᵥ fun t => v (S₀ t), ?_, by abel⟩
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
      funext s
      have := congrFun (hrestr fun t => v (S₀ t)) s
      show v (S₀ s) - (B *ᵥ fun t => v (S₀ t)) (S₀ s) = 0
      rw [show (B *ᵥ fun t => v (S₀ t)) (S₀ s) = v (S₀ s) from this, sub_self]
  · intro v
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨u, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hsmul u
      exact ⟨w, by simp [hw]⟩
    · intro h
      exact hsat Δ hΔ v (hrange_le h)

name: MinorsSat.isSatSummand_satMat
statement:
theorem isSatSummand_satMat (hΔ : IsSMulRegular A (φ.submatrix S₀ T₀).det)
    (hgen : ∀ S : ι → m,
      (φ.submatrix S T₀).det ∈ Ideal.span {(φ.submatrix S₀ T₀).det})
    (hrank : ∀ (S : ι ⊕ Unit → m) (T : ι ⊕ Unit → n), (φ.submatrix S T).det = 0) :
    IsSatSummand φ S₀ (φ.submatrix S₀ T₀).det (satMat hgen)
proof:
:= by
  refine isSatSummand_of hΔ (satMat_rows_one hΔ hgen) (satMat_factor hΔ hgen hrank) ?_
  intro u
  refine ⟨(1 : Matrix n n A).submatrix id T₀ *ᵥ (adjugate (φ.submatrix S₀ T₀) *ᵥ u), ?_⟩
  have hP : φ * (1 : Matrix n n A).submatrix id T₀ = φ.submatrix id T₀ := by
    ext a b; simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
  rw [← smul_mulVec, smul_satMat, mulVec_mulVec, mulVec_mulVec, hP]

name: MinorsSat.exists_summand
statement:
theorem exists_summand (hΔ : IsSMulRegular A (φ.submatrix S₀ T₀).det)
    (hgen : ∀ S : ι → m,
      (φ.submatrix S T₀).det ∈ Ideal.span {(φ.submatrix S₀ T₀).det})
    (hrank : ∀ (S : ι ⊕ Unit → m) (T : ι ⊕ Unit → n), (φ.submatrix S T).det = 0) :
    ∃ B : Matrix m ι A, IsSatSummand φ S₀ (φ.submatrix S₀ T₀).det B
proof:
:=
  ⟨_, isSatSummand_satMat hΔ hgen hrank⟩

name: MinorsSat.det_submatrix_sum_unit_eq_zero
statement:
theorem det_submatrix_sum_unit_eq_zero (φ : Matrix m n A) (S : n ⊕ Unit → m)
    (T : n ⊕ Unit → n) : (φ.submatrix S T).det = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, h⟩ := Fintype.exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt T (by simp)
  exact det_zero_of_column_eq hab fun k => by simp [h]

name: MinorsSat.exists_summand_maxMinors
statement:
theorem exists_summand_maxMinors (φ : Matrix m n A) (S₀ : n → m)
    (hΔ : IsSMulRegular A (φ.submatrix S₀ id).det)
    (hgen : maxMinors φ ≤ Ideal.span {(φ.submatrix S₀ id).det}) :
    ∃ B : Matrix m n A, IsSatSummand φ S₀ (φ.submatrix S₀ id).det B
proof:
:=
  exists_summand hΔ (fun S => hgen (minor_mem_maxMinors φ S))
    (det_submatrix_sum_unit_eq_zero φ)

name: MinorsSat.maxMinors_eq_span_of_le
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm hgen ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).2 (minor_mem_maxMinors φ S₀))

name: MinorsSat.maxMinors_fromBlocks
statement:
theorem maxMinors_fromBlocks (φ₁ : Matrix m₁ n₁ A) (φ₂ : Matrix m₂ n₂ A) :
    maxMinors (fromBlocks φ₁ 0 0 φ₂) = maxMinors φ₁ * maxMinors φ₂
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : ∀ (S₁ : n₁ → m₁) (S₂ : n₂ → m₂),
      (fromBlocks φ₁ 0 0 φ₂).submatrix (Sum.map S₁ S₂) id =
        fromBlocks (φ₁.submatrix S₁ id) 0 0 (φ₂.submatrix S₂ id) := by
    intro S₁ S₂
    ext (a | a) (b | b) <;> rfl
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine Ideal.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨S, rfl⟩
    set Φ := fromBlocks φ₁ 0 0 φ₂
    by_cases h : ∃ (σ : Equiv.Perm (n₁ ⊕ n₂)) (S₁ : n₁ → m₁) (S₂ : n₂ → m₂),
        S ∘ σ = Sum.map S₁ S₂
    · obtain ⟨σ, S₁, S₂, hσ⟩ := h
      have hp := det_permute σ (Φ.submatrix S id)
      rw [submatrix_submatrix, Function.id_comp, hσ, hsub, det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁] at hp
      have hmem : (φ₁.submatrix S₁ id).det * (φ₂.submatrix S₂ id).det ∈
          maxMinors φ₁ * maxMinors φ₂ :=
        Ideal.mul_mem_mul (minor_mem_maxMinors φ₁ S₁) (minor_mem_maxMinors φ₂ S₂)
      rw [hp] at hmem
      have hsq : ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : A) * ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : A) = 1 := by
        rw [← Int.cast_mul, ← Units.val_mul, Int.units_mul_self]; simp
      have := Ideal.mul_mem_left _ ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : A) hmem
      rwa [← mul_assoc, hsq, one_mul] at this
    · have : (Φ.submatrix S id).det = 0 := by
        rw [det_apply]
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun σ _ => ?_
        by_contra hne
        have hprod : ∏ c, (Φ.submatrix S id) (σ c) c ≠ 0 := by
          intro h0; apply hne; rw [h0, smul_zero]
        have hall : ∀ c, Φ (S (σ c)) c ≠ 0 := fun c h0 =>
          hprod (Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ c) (by simpa using h0))
        have h1 : ∀ a : n₁, ∃ b, S (σ (Sum.inl a)) = Sum.inl b := by
          intro a
          rcases hS : S (σ (Sum.inl a)) with b | b
          · exact ⟨b, rfl⟩
          · exact absurd (by simp [Φ, hS]) (hall (Sum.inl a))
        have h2 : ∀ a : n₂, ∃ b, S (σ (Sum.inr a)) = Sum.inr b := by
          intro a
          rcases hS : S (σ (Sum.inr a)) with b | b
          · exact absurd (by simp [Φ, hS]) (hall (Sum.inr a))
          · exact ⟨b, rfl⟩
        choose S₁ hS₁ using h1
        choose S₂ hS₂ using h2
        exact h ⟨σ, S₁, S₂, funext fun c => by rcases c with a | a <;> simp [hS₁, hS₂]⟩
      show (Φ.submatrix S id).det ∈ maxMinors φ₁ * maxMinors φ₂
      rw [this]; exact Ideal.zero_mem _
  · rw [maxMinors, maxMinors, Ideal.span_mul_span', Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨S₁, rfl⟩, _, ⟨S₂, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    have := minor_mem_maxMinors (fromBlocks φ₁ 0 0 φ₂) (Sum.map S₁ S₂)
    rwa [hsub, det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁] at this

name: MinorsSat.maxMinors_map
statement:
theorem maxMinors_map {A' : Type*} [CommRing A'] (f : A →+* A') (φ : Matrix m n A) :
    (maxMinors φ).map f = maxMinors (φ.map f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [maxMinors, maxMinors, Ideal.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
  have : (⇑f ∘ fun S : n → m => (φ.submatrix S id).det) =
      fun S => ((φ.map f).submatrix S id).det := by
    funext S
    rw [Function.comp_apply, RingHom.map_det]
    rfl
  rw [this]

name: MinorsSat.exists_summand_of_map
statement:
theorem exists_summand_of_map {A' : Type*} [CommRing A'] (f : A →+* A') (φ : Matrix m n A)
    (S₀ : n → m) (hΔ : IsSMulRegular A' (f (φ.submatrix S₀ id).det))
    (hgen : (maxMinors φ).map f = Ideal.span {f (φ.submatrix S₀ id).det}) :
    ∃ B : Matrix m n A', IsSatSummand (φ.map f) S₀ (f (φ.submatrix S₀ id).det) B
proof:
:= by
  have hdet : f (φ.submatrix S₀ id).det = ((φ.map f).submatrix S₀ id).det := by
    rw [RingHom.map_det]; rfl
  rw [hdet] at hΔ hgen ⊢
  rw [maxMinors_map] at hgen
  exact exists_summand_maxMinors (φ.map f) S₀ hΔ hgen.le

name: MinorsSat.exists_minor_generator_of_isLocalRing
statement:
theorem exists_minor_generator_of_isLocalRing [IsLocalRing A] (φ : Matrix m n A) (g : A)
    (hg : maxMinors φ = Ideal.span {g}) (hreg : IsSMulRegular A g) :
    ∃ S₀ : n → m, maxMinors φ = Ideal.span {(φ.submatrix S₀ id).det} ∧
      IsSMulRegular A (φ.submatrix S₀ id).det
proof:
:= by
  have hgmem : g ∈ maxMinors φ := hg ▸ Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self g
  rw [maxMinors] at hgmem
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun A).1 hgmem
  have hd : ∀ S : n → m, ∃ d : A, d * g = (φ.submatrix S id).det := fun S =>
    Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.1 (hg ▸ minor_mem_maxMinors φ S)
  choose d hd using hd
  have hsum : ∑ S, c S * d S = 1 := by
    apply cancel_mul hreg
    rw [mul_one]
    conv_rhs => rw [← hc]
    simp only [Finset.mul_sum, smul_eq_mul, ← hd]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun S _ => by ring
  obtain ⟨S₀, hS₀⟩ : ∃ S₀, IsUnit (c S₀ * d S₀) := by
    by_contra hne
    push Not at hne
    have : ∑ S, c S * d S ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A :=
      sum_mem fun S _ => (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).2 (hne S)
    rw [hsum] at this
    exact (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).1 this isUnit_one
  have hu : IsUnit (d S₀) := isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_right hS₀
  refine ⟨S₀, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hg, ← hd S₀, Ideal.span_singleton_mul_left_unit hu]
  · rw [← hd S₀]
    exact (hu.isSMulRegular A).mul hreg

name: MinorsSat.exists_summand_of_isLocalRing
statement:
theorem exists_summand_of_isLocalRing [IsLocalRing A] (φ : Matrix m n A) (g : A)
    (hg : maxMinors φ = Ideal.span {g}) (hreg : IsSMulRegular A g) :
    ∃ (S₀ : n → m) (B : Matrix m n A), IsSatSummand φ S₀ (φ.submatrix S₀ id).det B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S₀, hS₀, hΔ⟩ := exists_minor_generator_of_isLocalRing φ g hg hreg
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := exists_summand_maxMinors φ S₀ hΔ hS₀.le
  exact ⟨S₀, B, hB⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LciComparison.tau_lci_nodalCubic
statement:
theorem tau_lci_nodalCubic (k : Type u) [Field k] [Infinite k] :
    ¬ RegStalks (Xc k) ∧ ∀ x : K0 (Xc k),
      haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k (Xc k))
proof:
:=
        ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_projK (Fact.out : ProjK k (Xc k))⟩
      (targetThree k).tau (Xc k) (k0ToG0 (Xc k) x) =
        ((tdLine k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (iotaP k)).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k 2 1))
          (hasConstantRank_pullback (Xc k) (iotaP k) _ 1 (hcr k 2 1))) ^ (2 + 1))
          (tauX k (closedPosV4 k) (chExact_closedPosV4 k) (iotaP k) x) :=
  ⟨not_regStalks_X k, fun x => tau_lci k 2 (iotaP k) (coverP k) x⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegDeform.not_mem_support_of_ideal_eq_top
statement:
theorem not_mem_support_of_ideal_eq_top (I : X.IdealSheafData) (U : X.affineOpens) (w : X)
    (hw : w ∈ U.1) (h : I.ideal U = ⊤) : w ∉ I.support
proof:
:= by
  intro hs
  have hz := (Scheme.IdealSheafData.mem_supportSet_iff_of_mem (U := U) hw).mp hs
  rw [h, Scheme.mem_zeroLocus_iff] at hz
  exact hz 1 (by simp) (by rw [Scheme.basicOpen_one]; exact hw)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegDeform.exists_affine_avoid
statement:
theorem exists_affine_avoid (ι₂ : Z₂ ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι₂] (V : X.Opens) (w : X)
    (hwV : w ∈ V) (hw : w ∉ Set.range ι₂) :
    ∃ U : X.affineOpens, w ∈ U.1 ∧ U.1 ≤ V ∧ ∀ z ∈ U.1, z ∉ ι₂.ker.support
proof:
:= by
  let O : X.Opens := V ⊓ ⟨(Set.range ι₂)ᶜ, ι₂.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range.isOpen_compl⟩
  have hwO : w ∈ O := ⟨hwV, hw⟩
  obtain ⟨U', hU', hwU, hUO⟩ := (Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens) hwO
  refine ⟨⟨U', hU'⟩, hwU, fun z hz ↦ (hUO hz).1, fun z hz ↦ ?_⟩
  exact E26.notMem_support_ker ι₂ z (hUO hz).2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegDeform.inf_ideal_eq_left
statement:
theorem inf_ideal_eq_left (ι₁ : Z₁ ⟶ X) (ι₂ : Z₂ ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι₂] (U : X.affineOpens)
    (hU : ∀ z ∈ U.1, z ∉ ι₂.ker.support) : (ι₁.ker ⊓ ι₂.ker).ideal U = ι₁.ker.ideal U
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_inf, Pi.inf_apply,
    SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.ideal_eq_top_of_disjoint_support ι₂.ker U hU, inf_top_eq]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegDeform.ker_stalkMap_eq_span_germ_wCoord_inf
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_eq_span_germ_wCoord_inf [L.IsQuasicoherent] [L.IsFinitePresentation]
    (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (ι₁ : Z₁ ⟶ X) (ι₂ : Z₂ ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι₁]
    [IsClosedImmersion ι₂] (hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = ι₁.ker ⊓ ι₂.ker) (q : Z₁)
    (hq : ι₁ q ∉ Set.range ι₂) (d : WFrame L (ι₁ q)) :
    RingHom.ker (ι₁.stalkMap q).hom =
      Ideal.span {X.presheaf.germ d.U (ι₁ q) d.mem (wCoord d (E26.sectionOfHom σ))}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U', hqU, hUd, hU⟩ := exists_affine_avoid ι₂ d.U (ι₁ q) d.mem hq
  rw [E27.ker_stalkMap_eq_map_germ_ker ι₁ U' q hqU, ← inf_ideal_eq_left ι₁ ι₂ U' hU, ← hid,
    E27.sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_ideal_eq_span σ d U' hUd, Ideal.map_span,
    Set.image_singleton]
  congr 2
  exact X.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE hUd) (ι₁ q) hqU _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegDeform.not_mem_support_inf
statement:
theorem not_mem_support_inf (ι₁ : Z₁ ⟶ X) (ι₂ : Z₂ ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι₁]
    [IsClosedImmersion ι₂] (w : X) (h₁ : w ∉ Set.range ι₁) (h₂ : w ∉ Set.range ι₂) :
    w ∉ (ι₁.ker ⊓ ι₂.ker).support
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hwU, -, hU⟩ := exists_affine_avoid ι₂ ⊤ w trivial h₂
  obtain ⟨U₁, hwU₁, hU₁U, hU₁⟩ := exists_affine_avoid ι₁ U.1 w hwU h₁
  refine not_mem_support_of_ideal_eq_top _ U₁ w hwU₁ ?_
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_inf, Pi.inf_apply,
    SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.ideal_eq_top_of_disjoint_support ι₁.ker U₁ hU₁,
    SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.ideal_eq_top_of_disjoint_support ι₂.ker U₁ (fun z hz ↦ hU z (hU₁U hz)), inf_top_eq]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegDeform.ord_eq_one_at_lift_of_key
statement:
theorem ord_eq_one_at_lift_of_key {Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Z] {L : X.Modules}
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (ι : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι]
    (hkey : ∀ d : WFrame L (ι (genericPoint Z)), RingHom.ker (ι.stalkMap (genericPoint Z)).hom =
      Ideal.span {X.presheaf.germ d.U (ι (genericPoint Z)) d.mem (wCoord d (E26.sectionOfHom σ))})
    (w : X) (hne : w ≠ ι (genericPoint Z))
    (z : pointClosureScheme w)
    (hz : pointClosureι w z = ι (genericPoint Z))
    (hcoh : coheight z = 1) :
    (pointClosureScheme w).ord
      (D10.sectionCoord (closureFrame (hL := hL) w z)
        (wPullbackSection (pointClosureι w) (E26.sectionOfHom σ))) z = 1
proof:
:= by
  haveI : L.IsLocallyFree := hL.isFiniteLocallyFree.isLocallyFree
  haveI : L.IsFinitePresentation :=
    IsFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation X hL.isFiniteLocallyFree
  have haux : ∀ (y : X) (hy : ι (genericPoint Z) = y) (d : WFrame L y),
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk y) =
        Ideal.span {X.presheaf.germ d.U y d.mem (wCoord d (E26.sectionOfHom σ))} := by
    intro y hy d
    subst hy
    exact (A5FR.maximalIdeal_eq_ker_stalkMap_generic ι).trans (hkey d)
  have hm := haux (pointClosureι w z) hz.symm (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z))
  have hmax := A5FR.closure_max_span w z _ hm
  have hne0 := A5FR.closure_image_ne_zero_of_max w z _ (by rw [hz]; exact hne) hmax
  rw [E25.sectionCoord_eq_algebraMap_germ _ _ z (closureFrame (hL := hL) w z).mem,
    E27.germ_sectionCoordSec_closureFrame hL w _ z]
  exact Scheme.ord_algebraMap_eq_one_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal hcoh hne0 hmax.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegDeform.height_generic_eq_succ_of_key
statement:
theorem height_generic_eq_succ_of_key {Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Z] {L : X.Modules}
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (ι : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι]
    (hkey : ∀ d : WFrame L (ι (genericPoint Z)), RingHom.ker (ι.stalkMap (genericPoint Z)).hom =
      Ideal.span {X.presheaf.germ d.U (ι (genericPoint Z)) d.mem (wCoord d (E26.sectionOfHom σ))})
    (hne : ι (genericPoint Z) ≠ genericPoint X) :
    height (genericPoint X) = height (genericPoint Z) + 1
proof:
:= by
  set q : X := ι (genericPoint Z) with hq
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : X.presheaf.stalk q,
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk q) = Ideal.span {g} :=
    ⟨_, (A5FR.maximalIdeal_eq_ker_stalkMap_generic ι).trans (hkey (wFrameAt L hL q))⟩
  have hg0 : g ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot.mpr rfl] at hg
    have hfield : IsField (X.presheaf.stalk q) :=
      IsLocalRing.isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq.mpr hg
    have h1 := ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight q
    rw [ringKrullDim_eq_zero_of_isField hfield] at h1
    have h2 : coheight q = 0 := by exact_mod_cast h1.symm
    have hmax : IsMax q := coheight_eq_zero.mp h2
    have hle : q ≤ genericPoint X := (genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial
    have hge : genericPoint X ≤ q := hmax hle
    exact hne (((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hge).antisymm
      (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hle)).eq)
  have hcoh : coheight q = 1 :=
    E27.coheight_eq_one_of_maximalIdeal_span q g hg0 hg
  have hcat := dimensionCatenary_of_finiteType k (X := X) X (𝟙 X) q hcoh
  change height q + 1 = height (genericPoint X) at hcat
  rw [← hcat, hq, height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion ι]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegDeform.TwoComponents.symm
statement:
theorem TwoComponents.symm {L : X.Modules} {σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L} {ι₁ : Z₁ ⟶ X}
    {ι₂ : Z₂ ⟶ X} (h : TwoComponents σ ι₁ ι₂) : TwoComponents σ ι₂ ι₁
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.hid.trans (inf_comm _ _), h.gen₂, h.gen₁⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegDeform.TwoComponents.key₁
statement:
theorem TwoComponents.key₁ {L : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    {σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L} {ι₁ : Z₁ ⟶ X} {ι₂ : Z₂ ⟶ X} [IsClosedImmersion ι₁]
    [IsClosedImmersion ι₂] (h : TwoComponents σ ι₁ ι₂) (d : WFrame L (ι₁ (genericPoint Z₁))) :
    RingHom.ker (ι₁.stalkMap (genericPoint Z₁)).hom =
      Ideal.span {X.presheaf.germ d.U (ι₁ (genericPoint Z₁)) d.mem
        (wCoord d (E26.sectionOfHom σ))}
proof:
:= by
  haveI : L.IsLocallyFree := hL.isFiniteLocallyFree.isLocallyFree
  haveI : L.IsFinitePresentation :=
    IsFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation X hL.isFiniteLocallyFree
  exact ker_stalkMap_eq_span_germ_wCoord_inf σ ι₁ ι₂ h.hid _ h.gen₁ d

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegDeform.TwoComponents.height₁
statement:
theorem TwoComponents.height₁ {L : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    {σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L} {ι₁ : Z₁ ⟶ X} {ι₂ : Z₂ ⟶ X} [IsClosedImmersion ι₁]
    [IsClosedImmersion ι₂] (h : TwoComponents σ ι₁ ι₂)
    (hne : ι₁ (genericPoint Z₁) ≠ genericPoint X) {n : ℕ}
    (hX : height (genericPoint X) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)) :
    height (genericPoint Z₁) = (n : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  have h' := height_generic_eq_succ_of_key (k := k) hL σ ι₁ (h.key₁ hL) hne
  rw [hX] at h'
  have h'' : height (genericPoint Z₁) + 1 = (n : ℕ∞) + 1 := by
    rw [← h']; push_cast; rfl
  exact ENat_add_one_cancel h''

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegDeform.weil_coeff_two
statement:
theorem weil_coeff_two {L : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (ι₁ : Z₁ ⟶ X) (ι₂ : Z₂ ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι₁]
    [IsClosedImmersion ι₂] (h : TwoComponents σ ι₁ ι₂) {n : ℕ}
    (hX : height (genericPoint X) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
    (hZ₁ : height (genericPoint Z₁) = (n : ℕ∞)) (hZ₂ : height (genericPoint Z₂) = (n : ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ (bf : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme (genericPoint X))
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι (genericPoint X))).obj L)
        (pointClosureGenericPoint (genericPoint X))),
      ∀ z : pointClosureScheme (genericPoint X),
        Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame
          (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL (genericPoint X))
          (m7s_genericRank_pointClosure L hL (genericPoint X)) bf z =
        (if pointClosureι (genericPoint X) z = ι₁ (genericPoint Z₁) then 1 else 0) +
          (if pointClosureι (genericPoint X) z = ι₂ (genericPoint Z₂) then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : L.IsLocallyFree := hL.isFiniteLocallyFree.isLocallyFree
  haveI : L.IsFinitePresentation :=
    IsFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation X hL.isFiniteLocallyFree
  have hnot₁ := A5FR.generic_not_mem_range ι₁ hX hZ₁
  have hnot₂ := A5FR.generic_not_mem_range ι₂ hX hZ₂
  have hιq₁ : height (ι₁ (genericPoint Z₁)) = (n : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion ι₁, hZ₁]
  have hιq₂ : height (ι₂ (genericPoint Z₂)) = (n : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion ι₂, hZ₂]
  have hne₁ : genericPoint X ≠ ι₁ (genericPoint Z₁) := fun e ↦ hnot₁ ⟨_, e.symm⟩
  have hne₂ : genericPoint X ≠ ι₂ (genericPoint Z₂) := fun e ↦ hnot₂ ⟨_, e.symm⟩
  have h12 : ι₁ (genericPoint Z₁) ≠ ι₂ (genericPoint Z₂) := fun e ↦ h.gen₁ ⟨_, e.symm⟩
  let z₀ : pointClosureScheme (genericPoint X) := pointClosureGenericPoint (genericPoint X)
  have hsupp : pointClosureι (genericPoint X) z₀ ∉ (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).support := by
    rw [h.hid, pointClosureι_genericPoint]
    exact not_mem_support_inf ι₁ ι₂ _ hnot₁ hnot₂
  have hu := E26.wCoord_isUnit_of_notMem_support σ (pointClosureι (genericPoint X) z₀) hsupp
    (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι (genericPoint X) z₀))
  have hM := isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL (genericPoint X)
  have hrank := m7s_genericRank_pointClosure L hL (genericPoint X)
  obtain ⟨bf, hb⟩ := E26.exists_refFrame (hL := hL) (genericPoint X) (E26.sectionOfHom σ) z₀ hu
  have hlift : ∀ q : X, q ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι (genericPoint X)) := fun q ↦ by
    rw [range_pointClosureι]
    exact specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp (genericPoint_specializes _)
  
  
  have hcomp : ∀ (q : X), height q = (n : ℕ∞) → ∀ (S : Set X), (∀ s ∈ S, q ⤳ s) →
      ∀ z : pointClosureScheme (genericPoint X), coheight z = 1 →
        pointClosureι (genericPoint X) z ∈ S → pointClosureι (genericPoint X) z = q := by
    intro q hιq S hS z hc hr
    obtain ⟨zq, hzq⟩ := hlift q
    have hcohq : coheight zq = 1 :=
      E28.coheight_eq_one_of_height (genericPoint X) (n := n) hX q hιq zq hzq
    by_contra hz
    have hle : pointClosureι (genericPoint X) z ≤ q := by
      rw [Scheme.le_iff_specializes]; exact hS _ hr
    have hlt : pointClosureι (genericPoint X) z < q :=
      lt_of_le_not_ge hle (fun h' ↦ hz (by
        have h1 := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hle
        have h2 := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp h'
        exact (h2.antisymm h1).eq))
    rw [← hzq] at hlt
    have hzz : z < zq := (E28.pointClosureι_lt_iff (genericPoint X) z zq).mp hlt
    have := Order.coheight_add_one_le hzz
    rw [hcohq, hc] at this
    norm_num at this
  have hS₁ : ∀ s ∈ Set.range ι₁, ι₁ (genericPoint Z₁) ⤳ s := by
    rintro _ ⟨p, rfl⟩; exact (genericPoint_specializes p).map ι₁.continuous
  have hS₂ : ∀ s ∈ Set.range ι₂, ι₂ (genericPoint Z₂) ⤳ s := by
    rintro _ ⟨p, rfl⟩; exact (genericPoint_specializes p).map ι₂.continuous
  refine ⟨bf, fun z => ?_⟩
  by_cases hz₁ : pointClosureι (genericPoint X) z = ι₁ (genericPoint Z₁)
  · have hz₂ : pointClosureι (genericPoint X) z ≠ ι₂ (genericPoint Z₂) := by rw [hz₁]; exact h12
    rw [if_pos hz₁, if_neg hz₂, add_zero]
    have hc : coheight z = 1 :=
      E28.coheight_eq_one_of_height (genericPoint X) (n := n) hX _ hιq₁ z hz₁
    rw [E25.coeff_eq_ord_sectionCoord hM hrank bf _ hb (closureFrame (hL := hL) _ z) z
      (closureFrame (hL := hL) _ z).mem]
    exact ord_eq_one_at_lift_of_key hL σ ι₁ (h.key₁ hL) (genericPoint X) hne₁ z hz₁ hc
  · by_cases hz₂ : pointClosureι (genericPoint X) z = ι₂ (genericPoint Z₂)
    · rw [if_neg hz₁, if_pos hz₂, zero_add]
      have hc : coheight z = 1 :=
        E28.coheight_eq_one_of_height (genericPoint X) (n := n) hX _ hιq₂ z hz₂
      rw [E25.coeff_eq_ord_sectionCoord hM hrank bf _ hb (closureFrame (hL := hL) _ z) z
        (closureFrame (hL := hL) _ z).mem]
      exact ord_eq_one_at_lift_of_key hL σ ι₂ (h.symm.key₁ hL) (genericPoint X) hne₂ z hz₂ hc
    · rw [if_neg hz₁, if_neg hz₂, add_zero]
      by_cases hc : coheight z = 1
      · have hr₁ : pointClosureι (genericPoint X) z ∉ Set.range ι₁ :=
          fun hr ↦ hz₁ (hcomp _ hιq₁ _ hS₁ z hc hr)
        have hr₂ : pointClosureι (genericPoint X) z ∉ Set.range ι₂ :=
          fun hr ↦ hz₂ (hcomp _ hιq₂ _ hS₂ z hc hr)
        have hs : pointClosureι (genericPoint X) z ∉ (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).support := by
          rw [h.hid]; exact not_mem_support_inf ι₁ ι₂ _ hr₁ hr₂
        exact E25.coeff_eq_zero_of_isUnit hM hrank bf _ hb (closureFrame (hL := hL) _ z) z
          (closureFrame (hL := hL) _ z).mem hc
          (E28.closure_coord_isUnit _ _ z
            (E26.wCoord_isUnit_of_notMem_support σ _ hs (wFrameAt L hL _)))
      · exact E25.coeff_eq_zero_of_coheight_ne hM hrank bf z hc

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegDeform.twoCycle_apply
statement:
theorem twoCycle_apply (ι₁ : Z₁ ⟶ X) (ι₂ : Z₂ ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι₁] [IsClosedImmersion ι₂]
    [ι₁.IsOver (Spk k)] [ι₂.IsOver (Spk k)] {n : ℕ}
    (hZ₁ : height (genericPoint Z₁) = (n : ℕ∞)) (hZ₂ : height (genericPoint Z₂) = (n : ℕ∞))
    (y : X) :
    (twoCycle (k := k) ι₁ ι₂ hZ₁ hZ₂).1 y =
      (if y = ι₁ (genericPoint Z₁) then 1 else 0) + (if y = ι₂ (genericPoint Z₂) then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [twoCycle, pushPrime, AddSubgroup.coe_add, Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_add,
    Pi.add_apply]
  rw [E21.pp_prime_apply, E21.pp_prime_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegDeform.twoCycle_eq_pushWeil
statement:
theorem twoCycle_eq_pushWeil {L : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (ι₁ : Z₁ ⟶ X) (ι₂ : Z₂ ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι₁]
    [IsClosedImmersion ι₂] [ι₁.IsOver (Spk k)] [ι₂.IsOver (Spk k)]
    (h : TwoComponents σ ι₁ ι₂) {n : ℕ}
    (hX : height (genericPoint X) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
    (hZ₁ : height (genericPoint Z₁) = (n : ℕ∞)) (hZ₂ : height (genericPoint Z₂) = (n : ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ (bf : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme (genericPoint X))
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι (genericPoint X))).obj L)
        (pointClosureGenericPoint (genericPoint X))),
      (twoCycle (k := k) ι₁ ι₂ hZ₁ hZ₂).1 = properPushforward (pointClosureι (genericPoint X))
        (Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame
          (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL (genericPoint X))
          (m7s_genericRank_pointClosure L hL (genericPoint X)) bf).1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨bf, hcoef⟩ := weil_coeff_two hL σ ι₁ ι₂ h hX hZ₁ hZ₂
  refine ⟨bf, ?_⟩
  have hlift : ∀ q : X, q ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι (genericPoint X)) := fun q ↦ by
    rw [range_pointClosureι]
    exact specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp (genericPoint_specializes _)
  ext y
  rw [twoCycle_apply]
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hlift y
  rw [E21.pp_apply_image]
  exact (hcoef z).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegDeform.capCycles_two
statement:
theorem capCycles_two {L : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (ι₁ : Z₁ ⟶ X) (ι₂ : Z₂ ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι₁]
    [IsClosedImmersion ι₂] [ι₁.IsOver (Spk k)] [ι₂.IsOver (Spk k)]
    (h : TwoComponents σ ι₁ ι₂) {n : ℕ}
    (hX : height (genericPoint X) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
    (hZ₁ : height (genericPoint Z₁) = (n : ℕ∞)) (hZ₂ : height (genericPoint Z₂) = (n : ℕ∞)) :
    D5.capCycles (k := k) L hL n (dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint X) (n + 1) hX) =
      (QuotientAddGroup.mk (twoCycle (k := k) ι₁ ι₂ hZ₁ hZ₂) : DimChow X n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨bf, hbf⟩ := twoCycle_eq_pushWeil (k := k) hL σ ι₁ ι₂ h hX hZ₁ hZ₂
  exact D5.capCycles_prime_eq_mk (k := k) L hL n (genericPoint X) hX bf _ hbf

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegDeform.cap_generic_eq_push_two
statement:
theorem cap_generic_eq_push_two {L : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (ι₁ : Z₁ ⟶ X) (ι₂ : Z₂ ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι₁]
    [IsClosedImmersion ι₂] [ι₁.IsOver (Spk k)] [ι₂.IsOver (Spk k)]
    (h : TwoComponents σ ι₁ ι₂) {n : ℕ}
    (hX : height (genericPoint X) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
    (hZ₁ : height (genericPoint Z₁) = (n : ℕ∞)) (hZ₂ : height (genericPoint Z₂) = (n : ℕ∞)) :
    ops.cap L hL n ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint X) (n + 1) hX) : DimChow X (n + 1))) =
      ops.push ι₁ n ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
          (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint Z₁) n hZ₁) : DimChow Z₁ n)) +
        ops.push ι₂ n ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
          (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint Z₂) n hZ₂) : DimChow Z₂ n))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨bf, hbf⟩ := twoCycle_eq_pushWeil (k := k) hL σ ι₁ ι₂ h hX hZ₁ hZ₂
  have h₁ := ops.push_mk ι₁ n (dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint Z₁) n hZ₁)
    (pushPrime (k := k) ι₁ hZ₁) rfl
  have h₂ := ops.push_mk ι₂ n (dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint Z₂) n hZ₂)
    (pushPrime (k := k) ι₂ hZ₂) rfl
  rw [ops.cap_mk L hL n (genericPoint X) hX (m7s_genericRank_pointClosure L hL _) bf _ hbf,
    h₁, h₂, ← TensorProduct.tmul_add, twoCycle, QuotientAddGroup.mk_add]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.exists_xiChartDataKim2
statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.exists_xiChartDataKim2 (C : RankedBundleComplex M)
    [IsIntegral (C.graphModel (k := k))] (w : C.graphModel (k := k)) :
    Nonempty (C.XiChartDataKim2 (k := k) w)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b := graphToBase (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex
  obtain ⟨U₀, hwU₀, g, hg0, hgJ⟩ :=
    exists_stalk_principal_blowup (graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) w
  obtain ⟨V, hxV, -, s, hs⟩ := C.exists_secFramesXiR (O := ⊤)
    (x := pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) (b w)) trivial
  have hp : pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) (b w) ∈ (chartOpen k 0).1 ⊔ (chartOpen k 1).1 := by
    rw [chartOpen_sup_eq_top]; trivial
  
  have hbasic : ∀ (c : Fin 2), pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) (b w) ∈ (chartOpen k c).1 →
      ∃ h : Γ(B0 (k := k) M, U₀.1), (B0 (k := k) M).basicOpen h ≤
        pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k c).1 ∧
        b w ∈ (B0 (k := k) M).basicOpen h := by
    intro c hc
    exact U₀.2.exists_basicOpen_le (V := pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 ⊓
      pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k c).1) ⟨b w, ⟨hxV, hc⟩⟩ hwU₀
  rcases TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_sup.mp hp with hp0 | hp1
  · obtain ⟨h, hhO, hwh⟩ := hbasic 0 hp0
    let U' := (B0 (k := k) M).affineBasicOpen h
    have hV : U'.1 ≤ pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 := fun z hz => (hhO hz).1
    have hW : U'.1 ≤ pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 0).1 :=
      fun z hz => (hhO hz).2
    have hwU' : b w ∈ U'.1 := hwh
    have hgJ' : ((graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex).ideal U').map
        (stalkHomXiR b U'.1 hwU') = Ideal.span {g} :=
      (ideal_map_stalk_basicOpen b _ U₀ h hwh).trans hgJ
    let gP := b ≫ pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)
    have hT₀ : b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 ≤ gP ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 0).1 := fun z hz => hW hz
    let sT := (gP.appLE (chartOpen k 0).1 _ hT₀).hom (secEquiv k 0 Polynomial.X)
    have hov : b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 ⊓ xiOpen C ≤ gP ⁻¹ᵁ overlapOpen k := fun z hz => ⟨hT₀ hz.1, hz.2⟩
    have ht : rXiR (inf_le_right : b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 ⊓ xiOpen C ≤ xiOpen C) (xiCoord C) *
        rXiR (inf_le_left : b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 ⊓ xiOpen C ≤ b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1) sT =
        rXiR (inf_le_left : b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 ⊓ xiOpen C ≤ b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1) 1 := by
      have key := congrArg (gP.appLE (overlapOpen k) _ hov).hom (sP1_mul_tP1 k)
      rw [map_mul, map_one] at key
      rw [map_one, ← key, mul_comm]
      congr 1
      · have e := congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom (sP1 k))
          (Scheme.Hom.map_appLE gP hov (homOfLE (inf_le_left : overlapOpen k ≤ (chartOpen k 0).1)).op)
        simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at e
        rw [e]
        have e2 := congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom (sP1 k))
          (Scheme.Hom.appLE_map gP hT₀ (homOfLE (inf_le_left : b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 ⊓ xiOpen C ≤ b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1)).op)
        simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at e2
        exact e2
      · have e := congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom (tP1 k))
          (Scheme.Hom.map_appLE gP hov (homOfLE (inf_le_right : overlapOpen k ≤ (chartOpen k 1).1)).op)
        simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at e
        rw [e]
        have e2 := congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom (tP1 k))
          (Scheme.Hom.appLE_map gP (le_refl (gP ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 1).1))
            (homOfLE (inf_le_right : b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 ⊓ xiOpen C ≤ xiOpen C)).op)
        simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at e2
        rw [← e2, ← Scheme.Hom.app_eq_appLE]
        rfl
    have hne : ((b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 ⊓ xiOpen C : (C.graphModel (k := k)).Opens) :
        Set (C.graphModel (k := k))).Nonempty :=
      nonempty_preirreducible_inter (b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1).isOpen (xiOpen C).isOpen ⟨w, hwU'⟩
        (xiOpen_nonempty C)
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hne
    haveI := nontrivial_sections_xiR hz
    have hμT : sT ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have := ht
      rw [h0, map_zero, mul_zero, map_one] at this
      exact zero_ne_one this
    refine ⟨RankedBundleComplex.XiChartDataKim2.mk U' hwU' V hV s hs (chartOpen k 0) hW
      (((pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE _ U'.1 hW).hom (secEquiv k 0 Polynomial.X)) 1
      (zeroIdeal_map_chartZero U' hW) (infIdeal_map_chartZero U' hW) g hg0 hgJ' sT 1 hμT ht ?_ ?_⟩
    · exact comp_appLE_germ_xiR b (pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)) U'.1 (chartOpen k 0).1 hW
        hwU' hT₀ _
    · rw [map_one, map_one]
  · obtain ⟨h, hhO, hwh⟩ := hbasic 1 hp1
    let U' := (B0 (k := k) M).affineBasicOpen h
    have hV : U'.1 ≤ pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 := fun z hz => (hhO hz).1
    have hW : U'.1 ≤ pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 1).1 :=
      fun z hz => (hhO hz).2
    have hwU' : b w ∈ U'.1 := hwh
    have hgJ' : ((graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex).ideal U').map
        (stalkHomXiR b U'.1 hwU') = Ideal.span {g} :=
      (ideal_map_stalk_basicOpen b _ U₀ h hwh).trans hgJ
    have hT₀ : b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 ≤ xiOpen C := fun z hz => hW hz
    haveI := nontrivial_sections_xiR (show w ∈ b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 from hwU')
    refine ⟨RankedBundleComplex.XiChartDataKim2.mk U' hwU' V hV s hs (chartOpen k 1) hW 1
      (((pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE _ U'.1 hW).hom (secEquiv k 1 Polynomial.X))
      (zeroIdeal_map_chartOne U' hW) (infIdeal_map_chartOne U' hW) g hg0 hgJ' 1
      (rXiR hT₀ (xiCoord C)) one_ne_zero ?_ ?_ ?_⟩
    · rw [map_one, mul_one, rXiR_rXiR]
    · rw [map_one, map_one]
    · exact comp_appLE_germ_xiR b (pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)) U'.1 (chartOpen k 1).1 hW
        hwU' hT₀ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.XiChartDataKim2.mem_T₀
statement: theorem mem_T₀ : w ∈ d.T₀
proof: := d.hwU'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.XiChartDataKim2.T₀_le
statement: theorem T₀_le : d.T₀ ≤ xiProj (k := k) C ⁻¹ᵁ d.V.1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.XiChartDataKim2.exists_sat
statement:
theorem exists_sat [IsIntegral (C.graphModel (k := k))] (j : ℕ) :
    ∃ (T : (C.graphModel (k := k)).Opens) (hT : T ≤ d.T₀) (_ : w ∈ T)
      (S₀ : ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j)) → ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j)) ⊕ mRowXSP C.frRank j)
      (B : Matrix (ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j)) ⊕ mRowXSP C.frRank j) (ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j)))
        Γ(C.graphModel (k := k), T)),
      IsGraphSat (rXiR hT d.μT) (rXiR hT d.lT) ((d.DT j).map (rXiR hT)) S₀ B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b := graphToBase (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex
  let ψ := ((pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE d.V.1 d.U'.1 d.hV).hom
  let f := stalkHomXiR b d.U'.1 d.hwU'
  have hDT : (d.DT j).map (germXiR d.mem_T₀) = ((d.frData.D j).map ψ).map f := by
    ext a c
    exact xiProj_appLE_germ C d.U' d.V d.hV d.hwU' d.T₀_le (d.frData.D j a c)
  have hstalk : ∃ (S₀ : ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j)) → ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j)) ⊕
        mRowXSP C.frRank j)
      (Bw : Matrix (ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j)) ⊕ mRowXSP C.frRank j) (ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j)))
        ((C.graphModel (k := k)).presheaf.stalk w)),
      IsGraphSat (germXiR d.mem_T₀ d.μT) (germXiR d.mem_T₀ d.lT) ((d.DT j).map (germXiR d.mem_T₀))
        S₀ Bw := by
    have e1 : germXiR d.mem_T₀ d.μT = f d.μB := d.hcμ
    have e2 : germXiR d.mem_T₀ d.lT = f d.lB := d.hcl
    rw [hDT, e1, e2]
    by_cases hj : j ≤ C.K.len
    · have hJ' : (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (C.K.len + 1),
          GraphBundles.graphFormula d.μB d.lB ((d.frData.D i).map ψ)).map f = Ideal.span {d.g} := by
        rw [← C.graphIdeal_eq_frames d.U' d.V d.Wp d.hV d.hW d.μB d.lB d.hl d.hμ d.s d.hs]
        exact d.hgJ
      obtain ⟨S₀, Bw, hΔ, hS⟩ := GraphBundles.exists_satSummand_graphMat_of_map f
        (Finset.range (C.K.len + 1)) d.μB d.lB (fun i => (d.frData.D i).map ψ) hJ'
        (IsSMulRegular.of_ne_zero d.hg) (Finset.mem_range.2 (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hj))
      rw [GraphBundles.graphMat_map] at hS hΔ
      exact ⟨S₀, Bw, IsGraphSat.of_isSatSummand hΔ hS⟩
    · haveI : IsEmpty (ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j))) :=
        ⟨fun a => by
          have h := a.down.2
          change a.down.1 < (if j ≤ C.K.len then C.rank j else 0) at h
          rw [if_neg hj] at h
          exact Nat.not_lt_zero _ h⟩
      refine ⟨fun a => isEmptyElim a, 0, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩ <;> ext a b <;> exact isEmptyElim b
  obtain ⟨S₀, Bw, hBw⟩ := hstalk
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hwT, B, hB⟩ := exists_isGraphSat_of_stalk d.mem_T₀ d.μT d.lT (d.DT j) S₀ Bw hBw
  exact ⟨T, hT, hwT, S₀, B, hB⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.XiChartDataKim2.chart_minors
statement:
theorem chart_minors (j : ℕ) (sQ) (hsQ) (hrel) (T) (hT) (hwT) (S₀) (B) (hB) (r : ℕ) :
    GraphBundles.minorsIdeal r (d.chart j sQ hsQ hrel T hT hwT S₀ B hB).D =
      ((C.toDetIdealComplex.detIdeal j r).ideal d.V).map
        ((xiProj (k := k) C).appLE d.V.1 T (hT.trans d.T₀_le)).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hD : (d.DT j).map (rXiR hT) =
      (d.frData.D j).map ((xiProj (k := k) C).appLE d.V.1 T (hT.trans d.T₀_le)).hom := by
    ext a c
    change rXiR hT (((xiProj (k := k) C).appLE d.V.1 d.T₀ d.T₀_le).hom (d.frData.D j a c)) =
      ((xiProj (k := k) C).appLE d.V.1 T (hT.trans d.T₀_le)).hom (d.frData.D j a c)
    simp only [rXiR]
    have e := congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom (d.frData.D j a c))
      (Scheme.Hom.appLE_map (xiProj (k := k) C) d.T₀_le (homOfLE hT).op)
    simpa only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] using e
  change GraphBundles.minorsIdeal r ((d.DT j).map (rXiR hT)) = _
  have h3 : GraphBundles.minorsIdeal r ((d.DT j).map (rXiR hT)) =
      (GraphBundles.minorsIdeal r (d.frData.D j)).map
        ((xiProj (k := k) C).appLE d.V.1 T (hT.trans d.T₀_le)).hom := by
    rw [hD]
    exact (GraphBundles.minorsIdeal_map _ r _).symm
  rw [← d.frData.detIdeal_ideal_eq j r] at h3
  exact h3

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModelInd.cmpX_push_lof
statement:
theorem cmpX_push_lof {n : ℕ} (D : dimensionCycles (WX (k := k) C' ι') n) :
    haveI
proof:
:= cmpX_isOver C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX
    haveI : IsProper (cmpX C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX) := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
    totalPushOn (opsK k) (cmpX C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX)
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow (WX (k := k) C' ι') n) n
          ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow (WX (k := k) C' ι') n))) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow (WX (k := k) C ι) n) n
        ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (D13.pfHom (k := k) (cmpX C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX) n D) :
          DimChow (WX (k := k) C ι) n)) := by
  haveI := cmpX_isOver C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX
  haveI : IsProper (cmpX C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX) := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
  unfold totalPushOn
  rw [DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  congr 1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModelInd.push_tauPulled
proof:
:= cmpX_isOver C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX
    haveI : IsProper (cmpX C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX) := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
    haveI : IsProper gX := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) gX
    totalPushOn (opsK k) gX (tauPulled C C' ι' g hJ U' hC' hN) =
      totalPushOn (opsK k) (ηX (k := k) C ι) (opWX (k := k) C ι
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow (WX (k := k) C ι) n) n
          ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk
            (D13.pfHom (k := k) (cmpX C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX) n (rhoX (k := k) C' ι' U' hC' hN)) :
              DimChow (WX (k := k) C ι) n)))) := by
  haveI := cmpX_isOver C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX
  haveI : IsProper (cmpX C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX) := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
  haveI : IsProper gX := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) gX
  have hop : opWXPulled C C' ι' g hJ =
      altCh k (fun j ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (cmpX C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX)).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (jX (k := k) C ι)).obj (C.xi (k := k) j))) C.K.len := by
    unfold opWXPulled altCh
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
    congr 1
    exact chK_iso_g2tmi (pullSquareIso C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX (C.xi (k := k) j))
  rw [tauPulled, hop, ← cmpX_push_lof C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX,
    ← altCh_push (cmpX C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX)
      (fun j ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (jX (k := k) C ι)).obj (C.xi (k := k) j)) C.rank
      (fun j ↦ hasConstantRank_pullback _ (jX (k := k) C ι) _ _ (C.hasConstantRank_xi (k := k) j)),
    ← LinearMap.comp_apply (totalPushOn (opsK k) gX), ← totalPushOn_comp,
    ← LinearMap.comp_apply (totalPushOn (opsK k) (ηX (k := k) C ι)), ← totalPushOn_comp,
    totalPushOn_congr (opsK k) (cmpX_ηX C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModelInd.push_tauRaw_modelInd
statement:
theorem push_tauRaw_modelInd (h : XiPullbackCompat C C' g hJ) (U' : N.Opens)
    (hC' : C'.SectionExactOn U') {n : ℕ} (hN : height (genericPoint N) = n) :
    haveI
proof:
:= cmpX_isOver C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX
    haveI : IsProper (cmpX C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX) := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _

    totalPushOn (opsK k) gX (tauRaw (k := k) C' ι' U' hC' hN) =
      totalPushOn (opsK k) (ηX (k := k) C ι) (opWX (k := k) C ι
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow (WX (k := k) C ι) n) n
          ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk
            (D13.pfHom (k := k) (cmpX C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX) n (rhoX (k := k) C' ι' U' hC' hN)) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModelInd.cmpX_rho_eq
statement:
theorem cmpX_rho_eq (U' : N.Opens) (hC' : C'.SectionExactOn U')
    (hX' : ∀ x : N, x ∉ U' → x ∈ Set.range ι') {n : ℕ} (hN : height (genericPoint N) = n) :
    haveI
proof:
:= cmpX_isOver C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX
    haveI : IsProper (cmpX C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX) := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
    haveI := cmpMap_isOver C C' g hJ
    haveI : IsProper (cmpMap C C' g hJ) := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
    D13.pfHom (k := k) (cmpX C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX) n (rhoX (k := k) C' ι' U' hC' hN) =
      G2T2C.restrictHom (jX (k := k) C ι) n
        (D13.pfHom (k := k) (cmpMap C C' g hJ) n (rCycle (k := k) C' U' hC' hN)) := by
  haveI := cmpX_isOver C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX
  haveI : IsProper (cmpX C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX) := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
  haveI := cmpMap_isOver C C' g hJ
  haveI : IsProper (cmpMap C C' g hJ) := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
  apply Subtype.ext
  change properPushforward (cmpX C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX)
      (F13.restrictCycle (jX (k := k) C' ι') (jX (k := k) C' ι').isEmbedding.injective
        (rCycle (k := k) C' U' hC' hN).1) =
    F13.restrictCycle (jX (k := k) C ι) (jX (k := k) C ι).isEmbedding.injective
      (properPushforward (cmpMap C C' g hJ) (rCycle (k := k) C' U' hC' hN).1)
  have hsupp : ∀ w, w ∉ Set.range (jX (k := k) C' ι') → (rCycle (k := k) C' U' hC' hN).1 w = 0 := by
    intro w hw
    by_contra hne
    apply hw
    rw [range_jX]
    exact hX' _ (rCycle_support (k := k) C' U' hC' hN w hne)
  rw [← G2T2C.restrictCycle_properPushforward (jX (k := k) C ι)
      (properPushforward (cmpX C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX) _),
    ← properPushforward_comp, properPushforward_congr (cmpX_jX C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX),
    properPushforward_comp, F13.properPushforward_restrictCycle _ _ hsupp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModelInd.push_tauRaw_modelInd'
statement:
theorem push_tauRaw_modelInd' (h : XiPullbackCompat C C' g hJ) (U' : N.Opens)
    (hC' : C'.SectionExactOn U') (hX' : ∀ x : N, x ∉ U' → x ∈ Set.range ι') {n : ℕ}
    (hN : height (genericPoint N) = n) :

proof:

    totalPushOn (opsK k) gX (tauRaw (k := k) C' ι' U' hC' hN) =
      totalPushOn (opsK k) (ηX (k := k) C ι) (opWX (k := k) C ι
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow (WX (k := k) C ι) n) n
          ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (G2T2C.restrictHom (jX (k := k) C ι) n
            (D13.pfHom (k := k) (cmpMap C C' g hJ) n (rCycle (k := k) C' U' hC' hN))) :
              DimChow (WX (k := k) C ι) n)))) := by
  rw [push_tauRaw_modelInd C ι C' ι' g hJ gX hgX h U' hC' hN,

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModelInd.pfHom_fundamentalCycle_cmpMap
proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegularComparison.tauG0_classOf_eq
statement:
theorem tauG0_classOf_eq (hadd : TauAdditivityPn N i) (hS : RegSpecialization N i hX hadd)
    (h0 : (coheight (i (genericPoint X))).toNat ≠ 0) (F : X.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike X F)
    (x : K0 X) (hx : k0ToG0 X x = g0ClassOf X F hF) :
    tauG0 (FRI.space_member k N) i (CASE1B.height_genericPoint_space k N)
        (CIICLASS.T1N23.projectiveSpace_regStalks k N) hadd (g0ClassOf X F hF) =
      tauX k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) i x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, ⟨R⟩⟩ := exists_rankedResolution_liftSheaf k N i hX F hF
  obtain ⟨U, hC, hXU, n, hE, heq⟩ := hS h0 F hF C R
  rw [heq]
  exact tauStd_zeroSection N i hX h0 (C.pullback (pencil N i hX).e) U hC hXU hE x
    (k0ToG0_altSum_pullback_e N i hX F hF C R x hx)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegularComparison.tauG0_k0ToG0_eq
statement:
theorem tauG0_k0ToG0_eq (hadd : TauAdditivityPn N i) (hS : RegSpecialization N i hX hadd)
    (x : K0 X) :
    tauG0 (FRI.space_member k N) i (CASE1B.height_genericPoint_space k N)
        (CIICLASS.T1N23.projectiveSpace_regStalks k N) hadd (k0ToG0 X x) =
      tauX k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) i x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0 : (coheight (i (genericPoint X))).toNat = 0
  · haveI := isIso_of_rank_zero_g2treg N i hX h0
    exact tauG0_k0ToG0_of_isIso N i hX hadd x
  · have hb : Function.Bijective (k0ToG0 X) :=
      CIICLASS.T1N23.k0ToG0_bijective_of_projectiveIntegralK
        (projectiveIntegralK_of_projK (Fact.out : ProjK k X)) hX
    let e := AddEquiv.ofBijective (k0ToG0 X) hb
    have hfg : tauG0 (FRI.space_member k N) i (CASE1B.height_genericPoint_space k N)
        (CIICLASS.T1N23.projectiveSpace_regStalks k N) hadd =
        (tauXHom (k := k) N i).comp e.symm.toAddMonoidHom := by
      refine ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _ fun F => ?_
      change tauG0 _ i _ _ hadd (g0ClassOf X F.1 F.2) =
        tauX k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) i (e.symm (g0ClassOf X F.1 F.2))
      exact tauG0_classOf_eq N i hX hadd hS h0 F.1 F.2 _ (e.apply_symm_apply _)
    rw [hfg, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
    change tauX k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) i (e.symm (e x)) = _
    rw [AddEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegularComparison.regular_tauPn
statement:
theorem regular_tauPn {k : Type u} [Field k] [Infinite k] (N : ℕ) [Fact (ProjK k (space k N))]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X]
    [Fact (ProjK k X)] [IsIntegral X] (hreg : CIICLASS.T1N23.RegStalks X)
    (i : X ⟶ space k N) [IsClosedImmersion i] [i.IsOver (Spk k)] (hadd : TauAdditivityPn N i)
    (hS : haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X) :=
        ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_projK (Fact.out : ProjK k X)⟩
      RegSpecialization N i hreg hadd) (x : K0 X) :
    haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X)
proof:
:=
      ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_projK (Fact.out : ProjK k X)⟩
    tauPn N i hadd (k0ToG0 X x) =
      ((tdLine k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N 1))
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1 (hcr k N 1))) ^ (N + 1))
        (tauX k (closedPosV4 k) (chExact_closedPosV4 k) i x) := by
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X) := ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_projK (Fact.out : ProjK k X)⟩
  change ((tdLineK k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N 1))
      (hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1 (hcr k N 1))) ^ (N + 1))
      (tauG0 (FRI.space_member k N) i (CASE1B.height_genericPoint_space k N)
        (CIICLASS.T1N23.projectiveSpace_regStalks k N) hadd (k0ToG0 X x)) = _
  rw [tauG0_k0ToG0_eq N i hreg hadd hS x]
  rfl

theorem exists_section_g2tggmb (M : X.Modules) (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1)
    (C : AffineFrameCover X (tensorSheaf X M (tensorUnitSheaf X))) :
    ∃ s : X ⟶ C.scheme, s ≫ C.toBase = 𝟙 X
proof:
:= by
  have hO : HasConstantRank X (tensorUnitSheaf X) 1 := hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf
  obtain ⟨C0⟩ := exists_affineFrameCover X (tensorUnitSheaf X) hO.isFiniteLocallyFree
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := AlgebraicGeometry.D38.twistInvariance M (tensorUnitSheaf X) hM hO C0 C
  refine ⟨C0.quotientSection (𝟙 _)
      (surjective_app_of_split (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) (Category.id_comp _)) ≫ e.hom, ?_⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GlobGenMorphismB.exists_morphism_of_epi_g2tggmb
statement:
theorem exists_morphism_of_epi_g2tggmb {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X]
    (M : X.Modules) (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1) (n : ℕ)
    (b : FreeM X (T1N5.J.{u} n) ⟶ tensorSheaf X M (tensorUnitSheaf X)) [Epi b] :
    ∃ φ : X ⟶ space k n, φ ≫ toSpec k n = X ↘ Spk k ∧
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback φ).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n 1) ≅ M)
proof:
:= by
  let g : X ⟶ D35.Yk k := X ↘ Spk k
  have hO : HasConstantRank X (tensorUnitSheaf X) 1 := hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf
  have hD : HasConstantRank X (tensorSheaf X M (tensorUnitSheaf X)) 1 := by
    have h := hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hM hO
    rwa [Nat.one_mul] at h
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := E14.exists_pairCover b (isFiniteLocallyFree_freeM_g2tggmb _)
    hD.isFiniteLocallyFree
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_section_g2tggmb M hM P.toD
  let ι := P.toB.isoOfCovers (T1N5.cover g n)
  have hι : ι.hom ≫ (T1N5.cover g n).toBase = P.toB.toBase :=
    AffineFrameCover.isoOfCovers_toBase _ _
  obtain ⟨e1⟩ := ProjectionCovariance.q0_twist_one_iso k g n
  obtain ⟨e2⟩ := P.toB.isoOfCovers_twist_unconditional (T1N5.cover g n)
  obtain ⟨e3⟩ := E29.twistIso_of_E24 P
  haveI := isIso_tautologicalQuotient_g2tggmb hD P.toD
  let a : X ⟶ (T1N5.cover g n).scheme := s ≫ P.jHom ≫ ι.hom
  refine ⟨a ≫ T1KG3.OMGC.q0 g n, ?_, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  · have hq := (T1KG3.OMGC.isPullback_q0 g n).w
    simp only [a, Category.assoc, hq, reassoc_of% hι, reassoc_of% P.jHom_toBase,
      reassoc_of% hs]
    rfl
  · exact ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp a (T1KG3.OMGC.q0 g n)).app _).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback a).mapIso e1 ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp s (P.jHom ≫ ι.hom)).app _).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback s).mapIso
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp P.jHom ι.hom).app _).symm ≪≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback P.jHom).mapIso e2 ≪≫ e3 ≪≫
          (asIso P.toD.tautologicalQuotient).symm) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp s P.toD.toBase).app _ ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr hs).app _ ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackId X).app _ ≪≫
      tensorSheafRightUnitor X M

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GlobGenMorphismB.globGenMorphism_g2tggmb
statement: theorem globGenMorphism_g2tggmb : GlobGenMorphism k
proof:
:= by
  intro X _ _ _ _ M hM I _ π hπ
  classical
  let n := Fintype.card I
  let e : T1N5.J.{u} n ≃ Option I :=
    Equiv.ulift.trans (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq (Fintype.card_option (α := I))).symm
  let w : FreeM X (T1N5.J.{u} n) ≅ FreeM X (Option I) :=
    Sigma.whiskerEquiv (f := fun _ : T1N5.J.{u} n => UnitM X)
      (g := fun _ : Option I => UnitM X) e (fun _ => Iso.refl _)
  let b := w.hom ≫ D37.padCollapse X I ≫ π ≫ (tensorSheafRightUnitor X M).inv
  haveI : Epi b := by
    haveI := hπ
    exact epi_comp' inferInstance (epi_comp' inferInstance (epi_comp' hπ inferInstance))
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, he⟩ := exists_morphism_of_epi_g2tggmb (k := k) M hM n b
  exact ⟨n, φ, ⟨hφ⟩, he⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.exists_mul_eq_of_cols_p1x
statement:
theorem exists_mul_eq_of_cols_p1x {m k l : Type*} [Fintype k] (A : Matrix m k R)
    (B : Matrix m l R) (h : ∀ i, ∃ w : k → R, A *ᵥ w = fun a => B a i) :
    ∃ H : Matrix k l R, A * H = B
proof:
:= by
  choose w hw using h
  refine ⟨Matrix.of fun b i => w i b, ?_⟩
  ext a i
  have := congrFun (hw i) a
  simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct] using this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.mul_eq_zero_of_exact_p1x
statement: theorem mul_eq_zero_of_exact_p1x (j : ℕ) : D j * D (j + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.toLin'.injective
  rw [Matrix.toLin'_mul, map_zero]
  refine LinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, Matrix.toLin'_apply, Matrix.toLin'_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  exact (hex j _).2 ⟨v, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.exists_H0_p1x
statement: theorem exists_H0_p1x : ∃ H : Matrix (ι 1) (ι 0) R, D 0 * H = 1
proof:
:=
  exists_mul_eq_of_cols_p1x (D 0) 1 fun _ => hsurj _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.exists_Hsucc_p1x
statement:
theorem exists_Hsucc_p1x (j : ℕ) (H : Matrix (ι (j + 1)) (ι j) R) (hH : D j * H * D j = D j) :
    ∃ H' : Matrix (ι (j + 2)) (ι (j + 1)) R, D (j + 1) * H' = 1 - H * D j
proof:
:= by
  refine exists_mul_eq_of_cols_p1x _ _ fun i => ?_
  have h0 : D j * (1 - H * D j) = 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_one, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hH, sub_self]
  have h1 : (D j).mulVecLin (fun a => (1 - H * D j : Matrix (ι (j + 1)) (ι (j + 1)) R) a i) = 0 := by
    funext a
    have := congrFun (congrFun h0 a) i
    simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct] using this
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := (hex j _).1 h1
  exact ⟨w, hw⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.contractionP1x_zero
statement: theorem contractionP1x_zero : D 0 * (contractionP1x D hsurj hex 0).1 = 1
proof:
:=
  (exists_H0_p1x D hsurj).choose_spec

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.contractionP1x_succ
statement:
theorem contractionP1x_succ (j : ℕ) :
    D (j + 1) * (contractionP1x D hsurj hex (j + 1)).1 + (contractionP1x D hsurj hex j).1 * D j =
      1
proof:
:= by
  have h := (exists_Hsucc_p1x D hex j (contractionP1x D hsurj hex j).1
    (contractionP1x D hsurj hex j).2).choose_spec
  change D (j + 1) * (exists_Hsucc_p1x D hex j (contractionP1x D hsurj hex j).1
    (contractionP1x D hsurj hex j).2).choose + _ = 1
  rw [h, sub_add_cancel]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.exact_map_of_exact_p1x
statement:
theorem exact_map_of_exact_p1x {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S) :
    Function.Surjective ((D 0).map φ).mulVecLin ∧
      ∀ j, Function.Exact ((D (j + 1)).map φ).mulVecLin ((D j).map φ).mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  let H : ∀ j, Matrix (ι (j + 1)) (ι j) S := fun j => (contractionP1x D hsurj hex j).1.map φ
  refine ⟨fun y => ⟨H 0 *ᵥ y, ?_⟩, fun j x => ⟨fun hx => ⟨H (j + 1) *ᵥ x, ?_⟩, ?_⟩⟩
  · change (D 0).map φ *ᵥ (H 0 *ᵥ y) = y
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.map_mul, contractionP1x_zero,
      Matrix.map_one _ φ.map_zero φ.map_one, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  · change (D (j + 1)).map φ *ᵥ (H (j + 1) *ᵥ x) = x
    change (D j).map φ *ᵥ x = 0 at hx
    have key : (D (j + 1)).map φ * H (j + 1) = 1 - H j * (D j).map φ := by
      have h := congrArg (fun A => A.map φ) (contractionP1x_succ D hsurj hex j)
      simp only [Matrix.map_add _ (map_add φ), Matrix.map_mul,
        Matrix.map_one _ φ.map_zero φ.map_one] at h
      exact eq_sub_of_add_eq h
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, key, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
      hx, Matrix.mulVec_zero, sub_zero]
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    change (D j).map φ *ᵥ ((D (j + 1)).map φ *ᵥ y) = 0
    rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.map_mul, mul_eq_zero_of_exact_p1x D hex j,
      Matrix.map_zero _ φ.map_zero, Matrix.zero_mulVec]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.sectionMap_eq_frames_p1x
statement:
theorem sectionMap_eq_frames_p1x {E F : X.Modules} (d : E ⟶ F) {V : X.Opens} {ι κ : Type u}
    [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] {s : ι → Γ(E, V)} {t : κ → Γ(F, V)} (hs : IsSecFrame E V s)
    (ht : IsSecFrame F V t) (D : Matrix κ ι Γ(X, V))
    (hD : ∀ i, d.app V (s i) = Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, V) t (fun k => D k i)) :
    sectionMap d V = (ht.equiv V le_rfl).toLinearMap ∘ₗ D.mulVecLin ∘ₗ
      (hs.equiv V le_rfl).symm.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := (hs.equiv V le_rfl).surjective x
  have hc : (hs.equiv V le_rfl).symm (hs.equiv V le_rfl c) = c := LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply _ _
  change d.app V (Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, V) (secResXiR E le_rfl s) c) =
    Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, V) (secResXiR F le_rfl t)
      (D.mulVec ((hs.equiv V le_rfl).symm (hs.equiv V le_rfl c)))
  rw [hc, app_linearCombination_xiR, show (fun i => d.app V (s i)) =
      fun i => Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, V) t (fun k => D k i) from funext hD,
    linearCombination_comb_xiR]
  congr 2
  ext a b
  exact presheaf_map_homOfLE_self V (D a b)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.frameMatP1x_spec
statement:
theorem frameMatP1x_spec {E F : X.Modules} (d : E ⟶ F) {V : X.Opens} {ι κ : Type u} [Fintype ι]
    [Fintype κ] (s : ι → Γ(E, V)) {t : κ → Γ(F, V)} (ht : IsSecFrame F V t) (i : ι) :
    d.app V (s i) =
      Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, V) t (fun k => frameMatP1x d s ht k i)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (ht.equiv V le_rfl).apply_symm_apply (d.app V (s i))
  rw [IsSecFrame.equiv_apply] at h
  rw [Fintype.linearCombination_apply]
  conv_lhs => rw [← h]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  rw [show secResXiR F le_rfl t = t from secResXiR_self F t]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.exact_frames_iff_p1x
statement:
theorem exact_frames_iff_p1x {E₀ E₁ E₂ : X.Modules} (d₁ : E₂ ⟶ E₁) (d₀ : E₁ ⟶ E₀) {V : X.Opens}
    {ι₀ ι₁ ι₂ : Type u} [Fintype ι₀] [Fintype ι₁] [Fintype ι₂] {s₀ : ι₀ → Γ(E₀, V)}
    {s₁ : ι₁ → Γ(E₁, V)} {s₂ : ι₂ → Γ(E₂, V)} (h₀ : IsSecFrame E₀ V s₀)
    (h₁ : IsSecFrame E₁ V s₁) (h₂ : IsSecFrame E₂ V s₂) (D₁ : Matrix ι₁ ι₂ Γ(X, V))
    (D₀ : Matrix ι₀ ι₁ Γ(X, V))
    (hD₁ : ∀ i, d₁.app V (s₂ i) = Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, V) s₁ (fun k => D₁ k i))
    (hD₀ : ∀ i, d₀.app V (s₁ i) = Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, V) s₀ (fun k => D₀ k i)) :
    Function.Exact (sectionMap d₁ V) (sectionMap d₀ V) ↔
      Function.Exact D₁.mulVecLin D₀.mulVecLin
proof:
:= by
  rw [sectionMap_eq_frames_p1x d₁ h₂ h₁ D₁ hD₁, sectionMap_eq_frames_p1x d₀ h₁ h₀ D₀ hD₀]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have := exact_conj _ _ (h₀.equiv V le_rfl) (h₁.equiv V le_rfl) (h₂.equiv V le_rfl) h
    have k₁ : (h₁.equiv V le_rfl).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ ((h₁.equiv V le_rfl).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        D₁.mulVecLin ∘ₗ (h₂.equiv V le_rfl).symm.toLinearMap) ∘ₗ (h₂.equiv V le_rfl).toLinearMap =
        D₁.mulVecLin := LinearMap.ext fun x => by simp
    have k₀ : (h₀.equiv V le_rfl).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ ((h₀.equiv V le_rfl).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        D₀.mulVecLin ∘ₗ (h₁.equiv V le_rfl).symm.toLinearMap) ∘ₗ (h₁.equiv V le_rfl).toLinearMap =
        D₀.mulVecLin := LinearMap.ext fun x => by simp
    rwa [k₁, k₀] at this
  · intro h
    have := exact_conj _ _ (h₀.equiv V le_rfl).symm (h₁.equiv V le_rfl).symm
      (h₂.equiv V le_rfl).symm h
    simp only [LinearEquiv.symm_symm] at this
    exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.surjective_frames_iff_p1x
proof:
:= by
  rw [sectionMap_eq_frames_p1x d₀ h₁ h₀ D₀ hD₀]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have := surjective_conj_ttw2 _ (h₁.equiv V le_rfl) (h₀.equiv V le_rfl) h
    have k₀ : (h₀.equiv V le_rfl).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ ((h₀.equiv V le_rfl).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        D₀.mulVecLin ∘ₗ (h₁.equiv V le_rfl).symm.toLinearMap) ∘ₗ (h₁.equiv V le_rfl).toLinearMap =
        D₀.mulVecLin := LinearMap.ext fun x => by simp
    rwa [k₀] at this
  · intro h
    have := surjective_conj_ttw2 _ (h₁.equiv V le_rfl).symm (h₀.equiv V le_rfl).symm h
    simp only [LinearEquiv.symm_symm] at this
    exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.pullback_app_frames_p1x
statement:
theorem pullback_app_frames_p1x {E F : M.Modules} (d : E ⟶ F) {V : M.Opens} {W : T.Opens}
    (hWV : W ≤ p ⁻¹ᵁ V) {ι κ : Type u} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] (s : ι → Γ(E, V))
    (t : κ → Γ(F, V)) (D : Matrix κ ι Γ(M, V))
    (hD : ∀ i, d.app V (s i) = Fintype.linearCombination Γ(M, V) t (fun k => D k i)) (i : ι) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p).map d).app W (secResXiR _ hWV (pullSecXiR p E V s) i) =
      Fintype.linearCombination Γ(T, W) (secResXiR _ hWV (pullSecXiR p F V t))
        (fun k => (D.map (p.appLE V W hWV).hom) k i)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := pullback_app_pullSecXiR p E V d s t D hD i
  change ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p).map d).app W
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullback p).obj E).presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op
      (pullSecXiR p E V s i)) = _
  rw [app_res_xiR, h1]
  have h2 := linearCombination_res_xiR ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p).obj F)
    (pullSecXiR p F V t) hWV (le_refl _) (fun k => p.app V (D k i))
  rw [secResXiR_self] at h2
  rw [h2]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.pullback_exact_of_frames_p1x
statement:
theorem pullback_exact_of_frames_p1x (C : RankedBundleComplex M) {O : M.Opens}
    (s : ∀ j, ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j)) → Γ(C.K.E j, O))
    (hs : ∀ j, IsSecFrame (C.K.E j) O (s j))
    (hO : Function.Surjective (sectionMap (C.K.d 0) O) ∧
      ∀ j, Function.Exact (sectionMap (C.K.d (j + 1)) O) (sectionMap (C.K.d j) O))
    {W : T.Opens} (hWO : W ≤ p ⁻¹ᵁ O) :
    Function.Surjective (sectionMap ((C.pullback p).K.d 0) W) ∧
      ∀ j, Function.Exact (sectionMap ((C.pullback p).K.d (j + 1)) W)
        (sectionMap ((C.pullback p).K.d j) W)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let D : ∀ j, Matrix (ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j))) (ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank (j + 1)))) Γ(M, O) :=
    fun j => frameMatP1x (C.K.d j) (s (j + 1)) (hs j)
  have hD : ∀ j i, (C.K.d j).app O (s (j + 1) i) =
      Fintype.linearCombination Γ(M, O) (s j) (fun k => D j k i) :=
    fun j i => frameMatP1x_spec (C.K.d j) (s (j + 1)) (hs j) i
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (D 0).mulVecLin :=
    (surjective_frames_iff_p1x (C.K.d 0) (hs 0) (hs 1) (D 0) (hD 0)).1 hO.1
  have hex : ∀ j, Function.Exact (D (j + 1)).mulVecLin (D j).mulVecLin := fun j =>
    (exact_frames_iff_p1x (C.K.d (j + 1)) (C.K.d j) (hs j) (hs (j + 1)) (hs (j + 2)) (D (j + 1))
      (D j) (hD (j + 1)) (hD j)).1 (hO.2 j)
  obtain ⟨hsurj', hex'⟩ := exact_map_of_exact_p1x D hsurj hex (p.appLE O W hWO).hom
  let t : ∀ j, ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j)) → Γ((C.pullback p).K.E j, W) :=
    fun j => secResXiR _ hWO (pullSecXiR p (C.K.E j) O (s j))
  have ht : ∀ j, IsSecFrame ((C.pullback p).K.E j) W (t j) := fun j =>
    (isSecFrame_pullback p (C.K.E j) O (hs j)).mono hWO
  have hD' : ∀ j i, ((C.pullback p).K.d j).app W (t (j + 1) i) =
      Fintype.linearCombination Γ(T, W) (t j) (fun k => ((D j).map (p.appLE O W hWO).hom) k i) :=
    fun j i => pullback_app_frames_p1x p (C.K.d j) hWO (s (j + 1)) (s j) (D j) (hD j) i
  refine ⟨(surjective_frames_iff_p1x _ (ht 0) (ht 1) _ (hD' 0)).2 hsurj', fun j => ?_⟩
  exact (exact_frames_iff_p1x _ _ (ht j) (ht (j + 1)) (ht (j + 2)) _ _ (hD' (j + 1))
    (hD' j)).2 (hex' j)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.sectionExactOn_pullback
statement:
theorem sectionExactOn_pullback (C : RankedBundleComplex M) {U : M.Opens}
    (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) : (C.pullback p).SectionExactOn (p ⁻¹ᵁ U)
proof:
:= by
  intro V hVU
  have key : ∀ y : V.1, ∃ r : Γ(T, V.1), y.1 ∈ T.basicOpen r ∧
      (Function.Surjective (sectionMap ((C.pullback p).K.d 0) (T.basicOpen r)) ∧
        ∀ j, Function.Exact (sectionMap ((C.pullback p).K.d (j + 1)) (T.basicOpen r))
          (sectionMap ((C.pullback p).K.d j) (T.basicOpen r))) := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨O, hyO, hOU, s, hs⟩ := C.exists_secFramesXiR (O := U) (x := p y.1) (hVU y.2)
    obtain ⟨r, hrO, hyr⟩ := V.2.exists_basicOpen_le (V := p ⁻¹ᵁ O.1) ⟨y.1, hyO⟩ y.2
    exact ⟨r, hyr, pullback_exact_of_frames_p1x p C s hs (hC O hOU) hrO⟩
  choose r hyr hr using key
  have hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range r) = ⊤ := by
    rw [← V.2.self_le_iSup_basicOpen_iff]
    intro x hx
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨⟨r ⟨x, hx⟩, ⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩, hyr ⟨x, hx⟩⟩
  haveI : ∀ j, ((C.pullback p).K.E j).IsFinitePresentation := fun j =>
    ((C.pullback p).K.hE j).isFinitePresentation
  refine ⟨surjective_sectionMap_of_basicOpen V.2 _ (Set.range r) hspan ?_, fun j =>
    exact_sectionMap_of_basicOpen V.2 _ _ (Set.range r) hspan ?_⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact (hr y).1
  · rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact (hr y).2 j

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ReesAddP1.modules_eq_of_locally_g2taddp1
statement:
theorem modules_eq_of_locally_g2taddp1 (N : W.Modules) {O : W.Opens} (s t : Γ(N, O))
    (h : ∀ x : O, ∃ (V : W.Opens) (hV : V ≤ O), (x : W) ∈ V ∧
      N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op s = N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op t) : s = t
proof:
:= by
  choose V hV hxV hst using h
  let T : TopCat.Sheaf Ab W := ⟨N.presheaf, N.isSheaf⟩
  refine T.eq_of_locally_eq' V O (fun x ↦ homOfLE (hV x)) ?_ s t hst
  intro y hy
  exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hxV ⟨y, hy⟩⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ReesAddP1.presheaf_map_map_g2taddp1
statement:

    (k' : P ⟶ R) (x : Γ(N, R)) :
    N.presheaf.map i.op (N.presheaf.map j.op x) = N.presheaf.map k'.op x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp]
  congr 2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ReesAddP1.eq_zero_of_wFrames
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_wFrames
    (h : ∀ w : W, ∃ (e : WFrame N w) (V : W.Opens) (hV : V ≤ e.U), w ∈ V ∧
      ∀ (V' : W.Opens) (hV' : V' ≤ V) (c : Γ(W, V')),
        φ.app V' (wFrameSec e V' (hV'.trans hV) c) = 0) : φ = 0
proof:
:= by
  choose e V hV hwV hφ using h
  ext O s
  apply modules_eq_of_locally_g2taddp1 (tensorUnitSheaf W)
  intro x
  refine ⟨V x ⊓ O, inf_le_right, ⟨hwV x, x.2⟩, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (e x).exists_coord (V x ⊓ O) (inf_le_left.trans (hV x))
    (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_right).op s)
  rw [← app_presheaf_map, ← hc, hφ x _ inf_le_left c, Hom.zero_app]
  change (0 : Γ(tensorUnitSheaf W, V x ⊓ O)) = (tensorUnitSheaf W).presheaf.map _ 0
  rw [map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ReesAddP1.isIso_of_wFrames
statement:
theorem isIso_of_wFrames
    (h : ∀ w : W, ∃ (e : WFrame N w) (V : W.Opens) (hV : V ≤ e.U) (u : Γ(W, V)), w ∈ V ∧
      IsUnit u ∧ ∀ (V' : W.Opens) (hV' : V' ≤ V) (c : Γ(W, V')),
        φ.app V' (wFrameSec e V' (hV'.trans hV) c) = c * W.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV').op u) :
    IsIso φ
proof:
:= by
  choose e V hV u hwV hu hφ using h
  have hinj : ∀ (O : W.Opens) (s : Γ(N, O)), φ.app O s = 0 → s = 0 := by
    intro O s hs
    apply modules_eq_of_locally_g2taddp1 N
    intro x
    refine ⟨V x ⊓ O, inf_le_right, ⟨hwV x, x.2⟩, ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (e x).exists_coord (V x ⊓ O) (inf_le_left.trans (hV x))
      (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_right).op s)
    have h1 : φ.app (V x ⊓ O) (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_right).op s) = 0 := by
      rw [app_presheaf_map, hs]
      exact map_zero _
    rw [← hc, hφ x _ inf_le_left c] at h1
    have hu' : IsUnit (W.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V x ⊓ O ≤ V x)).op (u x)) :=
      (hu x).map _
    have hc0 : c = 0 := hu'.mul_left_eq_zero.mp h1
    rw [← hc, hc0, wFrameSec_smul, zero_smul]
    exact (map_zero _).symm
  have hsurj : ∀ (O : W.Opens) (t : Γ(W, O)), ∃ s : Γ(N, O), φ.app O s = t := by
    intro O t
    have hu' : ∀ x : O, IsUnit (W.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V x ⊓ O ≤ V x)).op (u x)) :=
      fun x ↦ (hu x).map _
    let sf : ∀ x : O, Γ(N, V x ⊓ O) := fun x ↦
      wFrameSec (e x) (V x ⊓ O) (inf_le_left.trans (hV x))
        (W.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : V x ⊓ O ≤ O)).op t * ↑(hu' x).unit⁻¹)
    have hsf : ∀ x : O, φ.app (V x ⊓ O) (sf x) =
        W.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : V x ⊓ O ≤ O)).op t := by
      intro x
      change φ.app (V x ⊓ O) (wFrameSec (e x) (V x ⊓ O) (inf_le_left.trans (hV x)) _) = _
      rw [hφ x _ inf_le_left, mul_assoc]
      have : (↑(hu' x).unit⁻¹ : Γ(W, V x ⊓ O)) *
          W.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V x ⊓ O ≤ V x)).op (u x) = 1 :=
        (hu' x).val_inv_mul
      rw [this, mul_one]
    have hres : ∀ (x : O) {P : W.Opens} (i : P ⟶ V x ⊓ O) (hPO : P ≤ O),
        φ.app P (N.presheaf.map i.op (sf x)) = W.presheaf.map (homOfLE hPO).op t := by
      intro x P i hPO
      rw [app_presheaf_map, hsf x]
      exact presheaf_map_map_g2taddp1 (tensorUnitSheaf W) i _ _ t
    let T : TopCat.Sheaf Ab W := ⟨N.presheaf, N.isSheaf⟩
    have hcompat : TopCat.Presheaf.IsCompatible T.1 (fun x : O ↦ V x ⊓ O) sf := by
      intro x y
      apply sub_eq_zero.mp
      apply hinj
      change φ.app _ (N.presheaf.map _ (sf x) - N.presheaf.map _ (sf y)) = 0
      rw [map_sub, hres x _ ((inf_le_left : (V x ⊓ O) ⊓ (V y ⊓ O) ≤ V x ⊓ O).trans inf_le_right),
        hres y _ ((inf_le_left : (V x ⊓ O) ⊓ (V y ⊓ O) ≤ V x ⊓ O).trans inf_le_right), sub_self]
    have hcover : O ≤ ⨆ x : O, V x ⊓ O := by
      intro y hy
      exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr
        ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, show y ∈ V y ⊓ O from ⟨hwV y, hy⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨s, hs, -⟩ := T.existsUnique_gluing' (fun x : O ↦ V x ⊓ O) O
      (fun x ↦ homOfLE inf_le_right) hcover sf hcompat
    refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
    apply modules_eq_of_locally_g2taddp1 (tensorUnitSheaf W)
    intro x
    refine ⟨V x ⊓ O, inf_le_right, ⟨hwV x, x.2⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [← app_presheaf_map]
    change φ.app _ (T.1.map (homOfLE inf_le_right).op s) = _
    rw [hs x, hsf x]
    rfl
  rw [Hom.isIso_iff_isIso_app]
  intro O
  rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
  refine ⟨fun a b hab ↦ sub_eq_zero.mp (hinj O _ ?_), fun t ↦ hsurj O t⟩
  rw [map_sub, hab, sub_self]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ReesAddP1.structure_map_map_g2taddp1
statement:
theorem structure_map_map_g2taddp1 {P Q R : W.Opens} (i : P ⟶ Q) (j : Q ⟶ R) (k' : P ⟶ R)
    (x : Γ(W, R)) : W.presheaf.map i.op (W.presheaf.map j.op x) = W.presheaf.map k'.op x
proof:

  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ReesAddP1.pullbackSection_dualEval_eq_zero
statement:
theorem pullbackSection_dualEval_eq_zero (hF : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ ≤ F.ker) :
    KSpecialization.AR7R.pullbackSection F (dualEval σ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hq, hf⟩ := KDGb.qc_fp_of_hasConstantRank hL
  haveI := hq
  haveI := hf
  have hΛ : HasConstantRank Y (lineBundleDual Y L) 1 := lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank L hL
  apply eq_zero_of_wFrames
  intro w
  let d : WFrame (lineBundleDual Y L) (F w) := (exists_wFrame hΛ (F w)).some
  obtain ⟨V0, hV0, hxV0, hV0d⟩ := (Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp Y.isBasis_affineOpens) d.mem
  have hle : F ⁻¹ᵁ V0 ≤ F ⁻¹ᵁ d.U := fun x hx ↦ hV0d hx
  refine ⟨WFrame.ofData (pullbackWFrame F d w d.mem), F ⁻¹ᵁ V0, hle, hxV0, ?_⟩
  intro V' hV' c
  rw [ARRHS.pullbackSection_wFrameSec σ F d w d.mem V' (hV'.trans hle) c]
  have ha : Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV0d).op ((dualEval σ).app d.U (wFrameGen d)) ∈
      (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).ideal ⟨V0, hV0⟩ := by
    rw [sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_affine σ ⟨V0, hV0⟩]
    have e1 : Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV0d).op ((dualEval σ).app d.U (wFrameGen d)) =
        (dualEval σ).app V0 ((lineBundleDual Y L).presheaf.map (homOfLE hV0d).op
          (wFrameGen d)) := (app_presheaf_map (dualEval σ) (homOfLE hV0d) (wFrameGen d)).symm
    rw [e1]
    exact dualEvalVal_mem_affineIdeal σ ⟨V0, hV0⟩ _
  have h0 : F.app V0 (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV0d).op ((dualEval σ).app d.U (wFrameGen d))) =
      0 := F.ideal_ker_le ⟨V0, hV0⟩ (Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_def.mp hF ⟨V0, hV0⟩ ha)
  have hnat := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (F.naturality (homOfLE hV0d).op)
    ((dualEval σ).app d.U (wFrameGen d))
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hnat
  rw [hnat] at h0
  have h2 : W.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hV'.trans hle)).op
      (F.app d.U ((dualEval σ).app d.U (wFrameGen d))) =
      W.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV').op (W.presheaf.map
        ((Opens.map F.base).map (homOfLE hV0d).op.unop).op
          (F.app d.U ((dualEval σ).app d.U (wFrameGen d)))) :=
    (structure_map_map_g2taddp1 _ _ _ _).symm
  have h3 : W.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hV'.trans hle)).op
      (F.app d.U ((dualEval σ).app d.U (wFrameGen d))) = 0 := by
    rw [h2, h0, map_zero]
  exact mul_eq_zero_of_right c h3

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ReesAddP1.isIso_pullbackSection_dualEval
statement:
theorem isIso_pullbackSection_dualEval (hreg : SectionIsRegular σ)
    (hF : ∀ w : W, F w ∉ Set.range (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι) :
    IsIso (KSpecialization.AR7R.pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hq, hf⟩ := KDGb.qc_fp_of_hasConstantRank hL
  haveI := hq
  haveI := hf
  have hline : IsLocalLineFrame L := KSpecialization.AR7R.isLocalLineFrame_of_hasConstantRank_one hL
  have hΛ : HasConstantRank Y (lineBundleDual Y L) 1 := lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank L hL
  apply isIso_of_wFrames
  intro w
  let d : WFrame (lineBundleDual Y L) (F w) := (exists_wFrame hΛ (F w)).some
  let b : Γ(W, F ⁻¹ᵁ d.U) := F.app d.U ((dualEval σ).app d.U (wFrameGen d))
  have hunit : IsUnit (W.presheaf.germ (F ⁻¹ᵁ d.U) w d.mem b) := by
    have hu := ARRHS.isUnit_germ_dualEval_wFrameGen σ hline hreg d d.mem (hF w)
    have := hu.map (F.stalkMap w).hom
    rw [Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply] at this
    exact this
  refine ⟨WFrame.ofData (pullbackWFrame F d w d.mem), W.basicOpen b, W.basicOpen_le b,
    W.presheaf.map (homOfLE (W.basicOpen_le b)).op b, (W.mem_basicOpen b w d.mem).mpr hunit,
    W.toRingedSpace.isUnit_res_basicOpen b, ?_⟩
  intro V' hV' c
  rw [ARRHS.pullbackSection_wFrameSec σ F d w d.mem V' (hV'.trans (W.basicOpen_le b)) c]
  congr 1
  exact (structure_map_map_g2taddp1 (homOfLE hV') (homOfLE (W.basicOpen_le b)) _ b).symm

    norm_num

proof:
