name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.not_mem_support_kernel_sigmaT
statement:
theorem not_mem_support_kernel_sigmaT (hΛ : LocallyTrivial Λ) (hΛf : IsFiniteLocallyFree X Λ)
    (F : X.Modules) {W : X.Opens} {x : X} (hx : x ∈ W) (l : Λ.val.obj (op W))
    (hu : IsUnit (germVal s hx l)) :
    x ∉ moduleSheafSupport (kernel ((sigmaT Λ s).app F))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits X Λ hΛf
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits X Λ hΛf
  have hc : Central (tensorSheafLeftFunctor X Λ) (sigmaT Λ s) := sigmaT_central hΛ s
  have hK : (sigmaT Λ s).app (kernel ((sigmaT Λ s).app F)) = 0 := app_kernel_eq_zero hc F
  rw [mem_moduleSheafSupport_iff, not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton]
  refine ⟨fun e e' ↦ ?_⟩
  have h1 := germ_smul_eq_zero_of_killed s hK hx l e
  have h2 := germ_smul_eq_zero_of_killed s hK hx l e'
  rw [hu.smul_eq_zero] at h1 h2
  rw [h1, h2]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.exists_cosection_unit
statement:
theorem exists_cosection_unit {L : X.Modules} (hG : WGenerated L) (y : X) :
    ∃ (s : lineBundleDual X L ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) (W : X.Opens) (hy : y ∈ W)
      (l : (lineBundleDual X L).val.obj (op W)), IsUnit (germVal s hy l)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, d, c, hc, hu⟩ := hG y
  let σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L := Chow.M7.A5CD.secHomG t
  let e : L.over d.U ≅ (LineBundleDual.unitMod X).over d.U :=
    d.frame.symm ≪≫ LineBundleDual.freePUnitIsoUnitOver d.U
  refine ⟨Chow.M7.dualEval σ, d.U, d.mem, e.hom, ?_⟩
  have h1 : germVal (Chow.M7.dualEval σ) d.mem e.hom = X.presheaf.germ d.U y d.mem
      (LineBundleDual.evalAt L d.U (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : d.U ≤ ⊤)).op t) e.hom) := by
    change X.presheaf.germ d.U y d.mem (LineBundleDual.evalAt L d.U
      (((Chow.M7.A5CD.secHomG t).val.app (op d.U)).hom (1 : Γ(X, d.U))) e.hom) = _
    rw [Chow.M7.A5CD.secHomG_app_one]
  have h2 : (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : d.U ≤ ⊤)).op t : Γ(L, d.U)) =
      c • wFrameSec d d.U le_rfl 1 := by
    rw [← hc, wFrameSec_smul]
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := d.exists_coord d.U le_rfl (LineBundleDual.localGen e)
  have k1 := LineBundleDual.evalAt_smul_left L d.U (wFrameSec d d.U le_rfl 1) r e.hom
  have k2 := LineBundleDual.evalAt_smul_left L d.U (wFrameSec d d.U le_rfl 1) c e.hom
  have hs1 := wFrameSec_smul d d.U le_rfl r
  have ha : r * LineBundleDual.evalAt L d.U (wFrameSec d d.U le_rfl 1) e.hom = 1 := by
    rw [← k1]
    erw [← hs1, hr]
    exact LineBundleDual.evalAt_localGen e
  have hua : IsUnit (LineBundleDual.evalAt L d.U (wFrameSec d d.U le_rfl 1) e.hom) :=
    isUnit_iff_exists_inv.mpr ⟨r, by rw [mul_comm]; exact ha⟩
  rw [h1]
  erw [h2, k2, map_mul]
  exact hu.mul (hua.map _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.nonempty_dualTwistIso
statement:
theorem nonempty_dualTwistIso (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (F : X.Modules) :
    Nonempty ((tensorSheafLeftFunctor X (lineBundleDual X L)).obj (tensorSheaf X L F) ≅ F)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, -, hcard⟩ := id hL
  letI := hq
  let e := fun i ↦ (LineBundleDual.exists_triv L q hcard i).some
  let T := tensorLineBundleDualIso L q.X q.coversTop e
  let e0 : (tensorSheafLeftFunctor X (lineBundleDual X L)).obj (tensorSheaf X L F) ≅
      tensorSheaf X (lineBundleDual X L) (tensorSheaf X L F) := Iso.refl _
  exact ⟨e0 ≪≫ (tensorSheafAssociator X _ _ _).symm ≪≫
    tensorSheafMapIso X (tensorSheafSymmetry X _ _) (Iso.refl F) ≪≫
    tensorSheafMapIso X T (Iso.refl F) ≪≫ tensorSheafLeftUnitor X F⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.exists_twist_generated
statement:
theorem exists_twist_generated (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ (D : ℕ) (I : Type u) (_ : Fintype I)
      (g : FreeM X I ⟶ tensorSheaf X (twistPullbackNatW (k := k) N j D) F), Epi g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj F).IsFinitePresentation :=
    isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_isFinite j F
  obtain ⟨D, G, hG⟩ := serre_generation k N ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj F)
  letI := hG
  let V := projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (D : ℤ)
  let L' : X.Modules := tensorSheaf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj V) F
  let e : tensorSheaf (space k N) V ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj F) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj L' :=
    projectionFormulaIso j V (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree k N _) F
  haveI : Finite G.I := hG.finite
  letI : Fintype G.I := Fintype.ofFinite G.I
  let e1 : FreeM (space k N) G.I ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj L' := G.π ≫ e.hom
  haveI : Epi e1 := epi_comp' G.epi inferInstance
  haveI hP : Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).map e1) := inferInstance
  haveI hC := ClosedImmersionCoverF11.counit_epi j L'
  let φ : FreeM X G.I ⟶ L' :=
    (pullbackFreeIso j G.I).inv ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback j).map e1 ≫ ClosedImmersionCoverF11.counitHom j L'
  haveI : Epi φ := epi_comp' (inferInstance : Epi (pullbackFreeIso j G.I).inv) (epi_comp' hP hC)
  exact ⟨D, G.I, inferInstance, φ, inferInstance⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.twist_step
statement:
theorem twist_step (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] (x : X) :
    ∃ (G : X.Modules) (_ : G.IsFinitePresentation) (I : Type u) (_ : Fintype I)
      (g : FreeM X I ⟶ G) (_ : Epi g) (A : X.Modules) (_ : A ≅ F) (f : A ⟶ G),
      (∀ y, stalkLength G y = stalkLength F y) ∧ x ∉ moduleSheafSupport (kernel f) ∧
        x ∉ moduleSheafSupport (cokernel f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, I, hI, g, hg⟩ := exists_twist_generated N j F
  let L := twistPullbackNatW (k := k) N j D
  have hL : HasConstantRank X L 1 := hasConstantRank_twistPullbackNatW N j D
  have hLg : WGenerated L := twistPullbackNatW_generated N j D
  let G := tensorSheaf X L F
  have hGc : IsCoherentLike X G :=
    tensorSheaf_isCoherentLike X L F hL.isFiniteLocallyFree (inferInstanceAs F.IsFinitePresentation)
  let Λ := lineBundleDual X L
  have hΛ1 : HasConstantRank X Λ 1 := lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank L hL
  have hΛf : IsFiniteLocallyFree X Λ := hΛ1.isFiniteLocallyFree
  have hΛt : LocallyTrivial Λ := locallyTrivial_of_hasConstantRank_one hΛ1
  obtain ⟨eA⟩ := nonempty_dualTwistIso L hL F
  let A := (tensorSheafLeftFunctor X Λ).obj G
  have hloc : ∀ y : X, ∃ s : Λ ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X,
      y ∉ moduleSheafSupport (kernel ((sigmaT Λ s).app G)) ∧
        y ∉ moduleSheafSupport (cokernel ((sigmaT Λ s).app G)) := fun y ↦ by
    obtain ⟨s, W, hy, l, hu⟩ := exists_cosection_unit hLg y
    exact ⟨s, not_mem_support_kernel_sigmaT s hΛt hΛf G hy l hu,
      not_mem_support_cokernel s hΛf G hy l hu⟩
  have hlen : ∀ y, stalkLength G y = stalkLength F y := fun y ↦ by
    obtain ⟨s, hk, hc⟩ := hloc y
    rw [← stalkLength_eq_of_iso eA y]
    exact (stalkLength_eq_of_not_mem_ker_coker _ hk hc).symm
  obtain ⟨s, hk, hc⟩ := hloc x
  exact ⟨G, hGc, I, hI, g, hg, A, eA, (sigmaT Λ s).app G, hlen, hk, hc⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.sectionMap_add_g2tbiva
statement:
theorem sectionMap_add_g2tbiva {E F : M.Modules} (f g : E ⟶ F) (V : M.Opens)
    (x : E.val.obj (op V)) : sectionMap (f + g) V x = sectionMap f V x + sectionMap g V x
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.sectionMap_comp_g2tbiva
statement:
theorem sectionMap_comp_g2tbiva {A B D : M.Modules} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ D) (V : M.Opens)
    (x : A.val.obj (op V)) : sectionMap (f ≫ g) V x = sectionMap g V (sectionMap f V x)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.sectionMap_id_g2tbiva
statement:
theorem sectionMap_id_g2tbiva (E : M.Modules) (V : M.Opens) (x : E.val.obj (op V)) :
    sectionMap (𝟙 E) V x = x
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.sectionMap_zero_g2tbiva
statement:
theorem sectionMap_zero_g2tbiva {E F : M.Modules} (V : M.Opens) (x : E.val.obj (op V)) :
    sectionMap (0 : E ⟶ F) V x = 0
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.sectionMap_biprod_total
statement:
theorem sectionMap_biprod_total {A B : M.Modules} (V : M.Opens) (y : (A ⊞ B).val.obj (op V)) :
    y = sectionMap biprod.inl V (sectionMap biprod.fst V y) +
      sectionMap biprod.inr V (sectionMap biprod.snd V y)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun φ : A ⊞ B ⟶ A ⊞ B ↦ sectionMap φ V y) (biprod.total (X := A) (Y := B))
  simp only [sectionMap_add_g2tbiva, sectionMap_comp_g2tbiva, sectionMap_id_g2tbiva] at h
  exact h.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.sectionMap_biprodMap_inl
statement:
theorem sectionMap_biprodMap_inl (a : A.val.obj (op V)) :
    sectionMap (biprod.map f g) V (sectionMap biprod.inl V a) =
      sectionMap biprod.inl V (sectionMap f V a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sectionMap_comp_g2tbiva, ← sectionMap_comp_g2tbiva, biprod.inl_map]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.sectionMap_biprodMap_inr
statement:
theorem sectionMap_biprodMap_inr (b : B.val.obj (op V)) :
    sectionMap (biprod.map f g) V (sectionMap biprod.inr V b) =
      sectionMap biprod.inr V (sectionMap g V b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sectionMap_comp_g2tbiva, ← sectionMap_comp_g2tbiva, biprod.inr_map]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.sectionMap_fst_biprodMap
statement:
theorem sectionMap_fst_biprodMap (y : (A ⊞ B).val.obj (op V)) :
    sectionMap biprod.fst V (sectionMap (biprod.map f g) V y) =
      sectionMap f V (sectionMap biprod.fst V y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sectionMap_comp_g2tbiva, ← sectionMap_comp_g2tbiva, biprod.map_fst]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.sectionMap_snd_biprodMap
statement:
theorem sectionMap_snd_biprodMap (y : (A ⊞ B).val.obj (op V)) :
    sectionMap biprod.snd V (sectionMap (biprod.map f g) V y) =
      sectionMap g V (sectionMap biprod.snd V y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sectionMap_comp_g2tbiva, ← sectionMap_comp_g2tbiva, biprod.map_snd]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.sectionMap_biprodMap_add
statement:
theorem sectionMap_biprodMap_add (a : A.val.obj (op V)) (b : B.val.obj (op V)) :
    sectionMap (biprod.map f g) V (sectionMap biprod.inl V a + sectionMap biprod.inr V b) =
      sectionMap biprod.inl V (sectionMap f V a) + sectionMap biprod.inr V (sectionMap g V b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_add, sectionMap_biprodMap_inl, sectionMap_biprodMap_inr]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.bundleBiprod_len

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.bundleBiprod_E

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.altSum_eq_sum_of_le
statement:
theorem altSum_eq_sum_of_le (K : _root_.SingTau.BundleComplex M) {N : ℕ} (hN : K.len ≤ N) :
    K.altSum = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1),
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ j • ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf M.Modules (IsFiniteLocallyFree M)
        (K.E j) (K.hE j)
proof:
:= by
  unfold _root_.SingTau.PComplex.altSum
  rw [← Finset.sum_range_add_sum_Ico _ (Nat.succ_le_succ hN),
    Finset.sum_eq_zero (s := Finset.Ico (K.len + 1) (N + 1)) (fun j hj ↦ by
      rw [ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_isZero M.Modules (IsFiniteLocallyFree M) (K.hE j)
        (K.isZero_E j (by rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hj; omega)), zsmul_zero]), add_zero]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.classOf_biprod_g2tbiva
statement:
theorem classOf_biprod_g2tbiva {A B : M.Modules} (hA : IsFiniteLocallyFree M A)
    (hB : IsFiniteLocallyFree M B) (hAB : IsFiniteLocallyFree M (A ⊞ B)) :
    ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf M.Modules (IsFiniteLocallyFree M) (A ⊞ B) hAB =
      ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf M.Modules (IsFiniteLocallyFree M) A hA +
        ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf M.Modules (IsFiniteLocallyFree M) B hB
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_middle M.Modules (IsFiniteLocallyFree M) hA hAB hB
    (biprod.inl_snd) (ShortComplex.Splitting.ofHasBinaryBiproduct A B).shortExact

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.altSum_bundleBiprod
statement:
theorem altSum_bundleBiprod (K₁ K₂ : _root_.SingTau.BundleComplex M) :
    (bundleBiprod K₁ K₂).altSum = K₁.altSum + K₂.altSum
proof:
:= by
  rw [altSum_eq_sum_of_le (bundleBiprod K₁ K₂) le_rfl,
    altSum_eq_sum_of_le K₁ (le_max_left K₁.len K₂.len),
    altSum_eq_sum_of_le K₂ (le_max_right K₁.len K₂.len), ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
  exact (congrArg (fun z ↦ (-1 : ℤ) ^ j • z)
    (classOf_biprod_g2tbiva (K₁.hE j) (K₂.hE j) ((bundleBiprod K₁ K₂).hE j))).trans
    (zsmul_add _ _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.sectionExactOn_sumComplex
statement:
theorem sectionExactOn_sumComplex (C₁ C₂ : RankedBundleComplex M) (U : M.Opens)
    (h₁ : C₁.SectionExactOn U) (h₂ : C₂.SectionExactOn U) :
    (sumComplex C₁ C₂).SectionExactOn U
proof:
:= by
  intro V hV
  obtain ⟨s₁, e₁⟩ := h₁ V hV
  obtain ⟨s₂, e₂⟩ := h₂ V hV
  refine ⟨fun y ↦ ?_, fun j ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := s₁ (sectionMap biprod.fst V.1 y)
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := s₂ (sectionMap biprod.snd V.1 y)
    refine ⟨sectionMap biprod.inl V.1 a + sectionMap biprod.inr V.1 b,
      (sectionMap_biprodMap_add (C₁.K.d 0) (C₂.K.d 0) V.1 a b).trans ?_⟩
    rw [ha, hb]
    exact (sectionMap_biprod_total V.1 y).symm
  · intro y
    change sectionMap (biprod.map (C₁.K.d j) (C₂.K.d j)) V.1 y = 0 ↔
      y ∈ Set.range (sectionMap (biprod.map (C₁.K.d (j + 1)) (C₂.K.d (j + 1))) V.1)
    constructor
    · intro hy
      have hf : sectionMap (C₁.K.d j) V.1 (sectionMap biprod.fst V.1 y) = 0 := by
        rw [← sectionMap_fst_biprodMap, hy, map_zero]
      have hs : sectionMap (C₂.K.d j) V.1 (sectionMap biprod.snd V.1 y) = 0 := by
        rw [← sectionMap_snd_biprodMap, hy, map_zero]
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := ((e₁ j) _).1 hf
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := ((e₂ j) _).1 hs
      refine ⟨sectionMap biprod.inl V.1 a + sectionMap biprod.inr V.1 b,
        (sectionMap_biprodMap_add (C₁.K.d (j + 1)) (C₂.K.d (j + 1)) V.1 a b).trans ?_⟩
      rw [ha, hb]
      exact (sectionMap_biprod_total V.1 y).symm
    · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
      have hdd := congrArg (fun φ ↦ sectionMap φ V.1 x) ((bundleBiprod C₁.K C₂.K).dd j)
      exact hdd.trans (sectionMap_zero_g2tbiva _ _)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.pairOpenCover_f

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.isPullback_pairPiece
statement:
theorem isPullback_pairPiece [Flat f] {J : Y.IdealSheafData} (hJ : I.comap f = J)
    (p : PairIdx f) :
    IsPullback (gluingApp Y J p.W) (pairPieceMap f I hJ p ≫ affineι X I p.U) (p.W.1.ι ≫ f)
      (toBase X I)
proof:
:= by
  let _ := (f.appLE p.U.1 p.W.1 p.le).hom.toAlgebra
  have hflat : (f.appLE p.U.1 p.W.1 p.le).hom.Flat :=
    HasRingHomProperty.appLE @Flat f inferInstance p.U p.W p.le
  have : Module.Flat Γ(X, p.U.1) Γ(Y, p.W.1) := hflat
  have hA := isPullback_schemeMapOfEq (I.ideal p.U) (J.ideal p.W) (map_appLE_eq f I hJ p)
  have hA' : IsPullback (gluingApp Y J p.W) (pairPieceMap f I hJ p)
      ((isAffineOpen Y p.W).isoSpec.hom ≫
        Spec.map (f.appLE p.U.1 p.W.1 p.le) ≫ (isAffineOpen X p.U).isoSpec.inv)
      (gluingApp X I p.U) := by
    refine IsPullback.of_iso hA.flip (Iso.refl _) (isAffineOpen Y p.W).isoSpec.symm
      (Iso.refl _) (isAffineOpen X p.U).isoSpec.symm ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · exact (Category.id_comp _).symm
    · exact (Category.id_comp _).symm
    · simp only [Iso.symm_hom, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
      rfl
    · exact (Category.id_comp _).symm
  have hB := isPullback_affine' X I p.U
  have hP := hA'.paste_vert hB
  convert hP using 1
  rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_inv_ι,
    IsAffineOpen.SpecMap_appLE_fromSpec f (isAffineOpen X p.U) (isAffineOpen Y p.W) p.le,
    ← IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_inv_ι]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  exact (Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc _ _).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.isPullback_pullbackMap_of_flat
statement:
theorem isPullback_pullbackMap_of_flat [Flat f] {J : Y.IdealSheafData} (hJ : I.comap f = J) :
    IsPullback (toBase Y J) (pullbackMap f I hJ) f (toBase X I)
proof:
:= by
  refine Scheme.isPullback_of_openCover _ _ _ _ (pairOpenCover f) fun p => ?_
  have hV := (isPullback_affine' Y J p.W).flip
  refine IsPullback.of_iso (isPullback_pairPiece f I hJ p) hV.isoPullback (Iso.refl _)
    (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom]
    exact hV.isoPullback_hom_snd.symm
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom]
    refine (affineι_pullbackMap f I hJ p).symm.trans ?_
    exact congrArg (· ≫ pullbackMap f I hJ) hV.isoPullback_hom_fst.symm
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
    rfl
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.flat_pullbackMap_of_flat
statement:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModelInd.isPullback_cmpMap_of_flat
statement:
theorem isPullback_cmpMap_of_flat [Flat g] :
    IsPullback (modelMap g C.toDetIdealComplex C'.toDetIdealComplex hJ) (xiProj (k := k) C')
      (xiProj (k := k) C) g
proof:

  haveI := flat_prodMap_g2tflat (k := k) g
  have h1 := (GlobalBlowup.isPullback_pullbackMap_of_flat (prodMap (k := k) g)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.pullS_res_xipb
statement:
theorem pullS_res_xipb (E : X.Modules) {U V : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) (s : Γ(E, U)) :

      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (f.preimage_mono h)).op (pullS_xipb f E U s)
proof:
:=

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.pullS_map_xipb
statement:
theorem pullS_map_xipb {E F : X.Modules} (d : E ⟶ F) (U : X.Opens) (s : Γ(E, U)) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map d).app (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) (pullS_xipb f E U s) =
      pullS_xipb f F U (d.app U s)
proof:
:=

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.pullS_lc_xipb
statement:
theorem pullS_lc_xipb (E : X.Modules) (U : X.Opens) {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (s : ι → Γ(E, U))
    (c : ι → Γ(X, U)) :
    pullS_xipb f E U (Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, U) s c) =
      Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, f ⁻¹ᵁ U) (fun i => pullS_xipb f E U (s i))
        (fun i => f.app U (c i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.linearCombination_apply, Fintype.linearCombination_apply]
  change ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app E).app U _ = _
  erw [map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  exact pullS_smul_xipb f E U (c i) (s i)

proof:
:= by

    (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.preimage_xiOpen_xipb
statement:
theorem preimage_xiOpen_xipb :
    pullbackModelMap (k := k) g C ⁻¹ᵁ xiOpen (k := k) C = xiOpen (k := k) (C.pullback g)
proof:
:= by
  unfold xiOpen
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage]
  exact congrArg (fun f => f ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 1).1)
    (modelMap_toP1 (k := k) g C.toDetIdealComplex (C.pullback g).toDetIdealComplex
      (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.xiCoord_pull_xipb
statement:
theorem xiCoord_pull_xipb {U : (C.graphModel (k := k)).Opens}
    {V : ((C.pullback g).graphModel (k := k)).Opens} (hU : U ≤ xiOpen (k := k) C)
    (hV : V ≤ xiOpen (k := k) (C.pullback g)) (h₁ : V ≤ pullbackModelMap (k := k) g C ⁻¹ᵁ U) :
    (((C.pullback g).graphModel (k := k)).presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op).hom
        (xiCoord (k := k) (C.pullback g)) =
      ((pullbackModelMap (k := k) g C).appLE U V h₁).hom
        (((C.graphModel (k := k)).presheaf.map (homOfLE hU).op).hom (xiCoord (k := k) C))
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (f : (C.pullback g).graphModel (k := k) ⟶ P1 k)
      (_ : f = graphToP1 (k := k) (C.pullback g).toDetIdealComplex)
      (e : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 1).1),
      f.appLE (chartOpen k 1).1 V e =
        (graphToP1 (k := k) (C.pullback g).toDetIdealComplex).appLE (chartOpen k 1).1 V hV := by
    intro f hf e
    subst hf
    rfl
  change ((graphToP1 (k := k) (C.pullback g).toDetIdealComplex).appLE (chartOpen k 1).1 V hV).hom
      (secEquiv k 1 Polynomial.X) =
    ((pullbackModelMap (k := k) g C).appLE U V h₁).hom
      (((graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex).appLE (chartOpen k 1).1 U hU).hom
        (secEquiv k 1 Polynomial.X))
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE,
    key (pullbackModelMap (k := k) g C ≫ graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) (modelMap_toP1 (k := k) g C.toDetIdealComplex (C.pullback g).toDetIdealComplex
      (C.graphIdeal_pullback (k := k) g))]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.etaApp_nat_xipb
statement:
theorem etaApp_nat_xipb {X X' : M.Modules} (f : X ⟶ X') :

        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).map f) ≫ (etaApp_xipb g C X').hom =
      (etaApp_xipb g C X).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) (C.pullback g))).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map f)
proof:
:=
  (etaIso_xipb g C).hom.naturality f

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.tgtIso_dj_xipb
statement:
theorem tgtIso_dj_xipb : ∀ j : ℕ,
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map (C.dj j) ≫ (tgtIso_xipb g C j).hom = (C.pullback g).dj j
  | 0 => IsZero.eq_of_tgt (isZero_zero _) _ _
  | _ + 1 => Category.comp_id _

                                            
def biprodIso_xipb (j : ℕ) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj (C.K.E j ⊞ C.tgt j) ≅
      (C.pullback g).K.E j ⊞ (C.pullback g).tgt j
proof:
:=
  (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).mapBiprod (C.K.E j) (C.tgt j) ≪≫
    biprod.mapIso (Iso.refl _) (tgtIso_xipb g C j)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.genGraph_phi_xipb
statement:
theorem genGraph_phi_xipb (j : ℕ) (T : (C.graphModel (k := k)).Opens)
    (y : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).obj (C.K.E j ⊞ C.tgt j), T))
    (hy : GenGraph ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).map biprod.fst)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).map biprod.snd)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).map (C.dj j)) (xiOpen (k := k) C)
      (xiCoord (k := k) C) T y) :
    GenGraph ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) (C.pullback g))).map biprod.fst)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) (C.pullback g))).map biprod.snd)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) (C.pullback g))).map ((C.pullback g).dj j))
      (xiOpen (k := k) (C.pullback g)) (xiCoord (k := k) (C.pullback g))
      (pullbackModelMap (k := k) g C ⁻¹ᵁ T)
      ((phiIso_xipb g C j).hom.app _ (pullS_xipb (pullbackModelMap (k := k) g C) _ T y))
proof:
:= by
  intro hne
  have hT : (T : Set (C.graphModel (k := k))).Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hne
    exact ⟨_, hx⟩
  have hQ : ResInjXiG ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).obj (C.tgt j)) :=
    resInjXiG_of_hasConstantRank (hasConstantRank_pullback _ _ _ _ (C.hasConstantRank_tgt j))
  have h0 := (genGraph_iff_graphDefect_eq_zero_xiG _ _ _ hQ (xiOpen_nonempty (k := k) C) hT y).1 hy
  have hle : pullbackModelMap (k := k) g C ⁻¹ᵁ (T ⊓ xiOpen (k := k) C) ≤
      pullbackModelMap (k := k) g C ⁻¹ᵁ T ⊓ xiOpen (k := k) (C.pullback g) :=
    le_inf (Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono _ inf_le_left)
      ((Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono _ inf_le_right).trans (preimage_xiOpen_xipb g C).le)
  have hne' : ((pullbackModelMap (k := k) g C ⁻¹ᵁ (T ⊓ xiOpen (k := k) C) : Opens _) :
      Set ((C.pullback g).graphModel (k := k))).Nonempty := by
    have := nonempty_inter_xiS hne (xiOpen_nonempty (k := k) (C.pullback g))
    rw [← preimage_xiOpen_xipb g C] at this
    exact this
  refine ⟨_, hle, hne', ?_⟩
  rw [res_graphDefect_xipb, ← app_res_xiR,
    ← pullS_res_xipb (pullbackModelMap (k := k) g C) _ (inf_le_left : T ⊓ xiOpen (k := k) C ≤ T)]
  have e2 : ∀ w, ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) (C.pullback g))).map biprod.snd).app
      (pullbackModelMap (k := k) g C ⁻¹ᵁ (T ⊓ xiOpen (k := k) C))
      ((phiIso_xipb g C j).hom.app (pullbackModelMap (k := k) g C ⁻¹ᵁ (T ⊓ xiOpen (k := k) C)) w) =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) (C.pullback g))).map (tgtIso_xipb g C j).hom).app _
        ((etaApp_xipb g C (C.tgt j)).hom.app _
          (((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullbackModelMap (k := k) g C)).map
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).map biprod.snd)).app _ w)) :=
    fun w => congrArg (fun f => Scheme.Modules.Hom.app f
      (pullbackModelMap (k := k) g C ⁻¹ᵁ (T ⊓ xiOpen (k := k) C)) w) (phiIso_snd_xipb g C j)
  have e1 : ∀ w, ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) (C.pullback g))).map biprod.fst).app
      (pullbackModelMap (k := k) g C ⁻¹ᵁ (T ⊓ xiOpen (k := k) C))
      ((phiIso_xipb g C j).hom.app (pullbackModelMap (k := k) g C ⁻¹ᵁ (T ⊓ xiOpen (k := k) C)) w) =
      (etaApp_xipb g C (C.K.E j)).hom.app _
          (((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullbackModelMap (k := k) g C)).map
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).map biprod.fst)).app _ w) :=
    fun w => congrArg (fun f => Scheme.Modules.Hom.app f
      (pullbackModelMap (k := k) g C ⁻¹ᵁ (T ⊓ xiOpen (k := k) C)) w) (phiIso_fst_xipb g C j)
  have ed : ∀ w, ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) (C.pullback g))).map
      (tgtIso_xipb g C j).hom).app (pullbackModelMap (k := k) g C ⁻¹ᵁ (T ⊓ xiOpen (k := k) C))
        ((etaApp_xipb g C (C.tgt j)).hom.app _
          (((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullbackModelMap (k := k) g C)).map
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).map (C.dj j))).app _ w)) =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) (C.pullback g))).map ((C.pullback g).dj j)).app _
        ((etaApp_xipb g C (C.K.E j)).hom.app _ w) :=
    fun w => congrArg (fun f => Scheme.Modules.Hom.app f
      (pullbackModelMap (k := k) g C ⁻¹ᵁ (T ⊓ xiOpen (k := k) C)) w) (eta_delta_xipb g C j)
  rw [e1, e2]
  rw [← ed, pullS_map_xipb, pullS_map_xipb, pullS_map_xipb,
    xiCoord_pull_xipb g C (U := T ⊓ xiOpen (k := k) C) inf_le_right _ le_rfl,
    Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app]
  rw [← Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul, ← map_sub, ← Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul, ← map_sub,
    ← pullS_smul_xipb, ← pullS_sub_xipb, ← graphDefect_eq_xipb, h0, pullS_zero_xipb, map_zero,
    map_zero]

statement: theorem isIso_xiPullbackLift (j : ℕ) : IsIso (xiPullbackLift (k := k) g C j)
proof:
:= by

  apply isIso_of_local_bijective_xipb
  intro w
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := C.exists_xiChart (k := k) j (pullbackModelMap (k := k) g C w)
  obtain ⟨V', hwV', -, ι', hι', s', hcard', hs'⟩ :=
    exists_isSecFrame ((C.pullback g).hasConstantRank_xi (k := k) j) (O := ⊤) (x := w) trivial
  have hb := biprodXiR_pullback (xiProj (k := k) C) (C.K.E j) (C.tgt j)
  refine ⟨pullbackModelMap (k := k) g C ⁻¹ᵁ c.T ⊓ V'.1, ⟨c.mem, hwV'⟩, fun V hV => ?_⟩
  refine bijective_of_frames_xipb (xiPullbackLift g C j) ((C.pullback g).xiι (k := k) j)
    (hc.trans hcard'.symm)
    (isSecFrame_pullback (pullbackModelMap (k := k) g C) _ _
      (c.isSecFrame hb (xiOpen_nonempty (k := k) C))) hs'
    ((isSecFrame_pullback (pullbackModelMap (k := k) g C) _ _
      (hb.isSecFrame_sumFrame c.hP c.hQ)).map_iso (phiIso_xipb g C j))
    c.S₀ (c.B.map ((pullbackModelMap (k := k) g C).app c.T).hom) ?_ ?_
    (hV.trans inf_le_left) (hV.trans inf_le_right)
  · rw [Matrix.submatrix_map, c.hB.rows_one, Matrix.map_one _ (map_zero _) (map_one _)]
  · intro i
    rw [← comp_app_xiR, xiPullbackLift_ι]
    change (phiIso_xipb g C j).hom.app _
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullbackModelMap (k := k) g C)).map (C.xiι (k := k) j)).app _
        (pullS_xipb (pullbackModelMap (k := k) g C) _ c.T
          (c.sec hb (xiOpen_nonempty (k := k) C) i))) = _

    change (phiIso_xipb g C j).hom.app _ (pullS_xipb (pullbackModelMap (k := k) g C) _ c.T
      (Fintype.linearCombination _ (sumFrameXiR _ _ c.sP c.sQ) (fun a => c.B a i))) = _
    rw [pullS_lc_xipb, app_lc_xipb]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.CaseIProjSingular.chernFreeK
statement:
theorem chernFreeK :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (J : Type u) [Finite J], Nat.card J = n →
      ∀ (hr : HasConstantRank Y (FreeM Y J) n) (a : ℕ),
        chernOpOn' (opsK k) (cpK k) closedPosK (FreeM Y J) n hr a =
          if a = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro J _ _ hr a; rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    intro J _ hJ hr a
    have hpos : 0 < Nat.card J := by omega
    obtain ⟨j0⟩ : Nonempty J := (Nat.card_pos_iff.mp hpos).1
    let J' := {j : J // j ≠ j0}
    let σ : Option J' ≃ J := Equiv.optionSubtypeNe j0
    haveI : Finite J' := inferInstance
    have hJ' : Nat.card J' = n := by
      have h1 : Nat.card (Option J') = Nat.card J' + 1 := by
        haveI := Fintype.ofFinite J'
        simp [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
      have h2 : Nat.card (Option J') = Nat.card J := Nat.card_congr σ
      omega
    have hrJ' : HasConstantRank Y (FreeM Y J') n := by
      have h := hasConstantRank_free_type Y J'
      rw [hJ'] at h
      exact h
    have hB : HasConstantRank Y (FreeM Y J' ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf Y) (n + 1) :=
      hasConstantRank_biprod_E13 hrJ' hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf
    let e : FreeM Y J ≅ FreeM Y J' ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf Y :=
      T1N4C.reindexIso σ.symm ≪≫ T1N4C.optionIso J'
    have h1 := congrFun (chernOpOn'_bundleIso (opsK k) (cpK k) closedPosK e (n + 1) hr hB) a
    rw [h1]
    rw [CIIL1B.chernOpOn'_unit_summand (opsK k) (cpK k) closedPosK hrJ'
      (whitneyUnitSummandK k hrJ') a hB]
    exact ih J' hJ' hrJ' a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.CaseIProjSingular.sandwichOn_free_eq_zeroK
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hfin, hcard⟩ := T1N4C.finite_of_frameCover C hC
  have hE : HasConstantRank Y (FreeM Y J) (e + 1) :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D37.hasConstantRank_of_frameCover C hC
  have hcher : ∀ a, chernOfCoverOn (opsK k) C (cpK k) hC a = if a = 0 then 1 else 0 := by
    intro a
    rw [← chernOpOn'_eq_chernOfCoverOn (opsK k) (cpK k) closedPosK C hE hC]
    exact chernFreeK k (e + 1) J hcard hE a
  have hs : segreOn (opsK k) C (cpK k) hC (j - e) = 0 := by
    have hm := CIIL1B.chernOfCoverOn_mul_segreOn (opsK k) (cpK k) C hC (j - e)
    have hne : j - e ≠ 0 := by omega
    rw [if_neg hne, Finset.sum_eq_single 0] at hm
    · simpa [hcher] using hm
    · intro a _ ha
      simp [hcher, ha]
    · intro h
      exact absurd (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)) h
  rw [CIIL1B.sandwichOn_eq_phi (opsK k) (cpK k) C hC j, if_pos hj.le]
  exact hs

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.CaseIProjSingular.lowersDeg_totalCapOnK
statement:
theorem lowersDeg_totalCapOnK (L : W.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank W L 1) :
    LowersDeg (M := fun m ↦ RationalDimChow W m) (totalCapOn (opsK k) L hL) where
  zero
proof:
:= fun y ↦ by simp [totalCapOn, capComponentOn]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.CaseIProjSingular.segre_pushK
statement:
theorem segre_pushK (β : TotalChow X) (p : ℕ) :
    totalPushOn (opsK k) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).toBase
        ((xiCapOn (opsK k) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b) ^ p) (pullK k b β)) =
      if p = b then β else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ∀ j, sandwichOn (opsK k) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b) (cpK k) (cover_card k) j β =
      totalPushOn (opsK k) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).toBase
        ((xiCapOn (opsK k) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b) ^ j) (pullK k b β)) :=
    fun j ↦ rfl
  rcases lt_trichotomy p b with h | h | h
  · rw [← hs, sandwichOn_eq_zero_of_lt (opsK k) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b) (cpK k) (cover_card k) h,
      if_neg (Nat.ne_of_lt h)]
    rfl
  · subst h
    rw [if_pos rfl, ← hs]
    have := congrArg (fun f ↦ f β)
      (segreOn_zero (opsK k) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) p) (cpK k) (cover_card k))
    simpa [segreOn] using this
  · rw [← hs, sandwichOn_free_eq_zeroK k (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b) (cover_card k) h,
      if_neg (Nat.ne_of_gt h)]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.CaseIProjSingular.pullK_mem_S
proof:
:= by
  induction h using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem w hw =>
    obtain ⟨j, hj, y, rfl⟩ := hw
    have : pullK k b (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow X m) j y) =
        DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).scheme m) (j + b)
          ((opsK k).pull (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).toBase b (cover_pureRelDim k b) j y) := by
      unfold pullK totalPullOn
      rw [DirectSum.toModule_lof]
      rfl
    rw [this]
    exact lof_mem_S (by omega) _
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.CaseIProjSingular.xi_pow_vanishK
proof:
:= by
  induction hv using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem w hw =>
    obtain ⟨j, hj, y, rfl⟩ := hw
    exact (lowersDeg_totalCapOnK k ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
      ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)).pow_apply_lof_zero
        j y (D + 1) (by omega)
  | zero => rw [map_zero]
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [map_smul, hx, smul_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.CaseIProjSingular.capTwist_addK
statement:
theorem capTwist_addK (a c d : ℤ) (h : a + c = d) :
    totalCapOn (opsK k) ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).canonicalTwistingSheaf d)
        ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf d) =
      totalCapOn (opsK k) ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).canonicalTwistingSheaf a)
          ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf a) +
        totalCapOn (opsK k) ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).canonicalTwistingSheaf c)
          ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf c)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  have hT : HasConstantRank (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).scheme
      (tensorSheaf (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).scheme ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).canonicalTwistingSheaf a)
      ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).canonicalTwistingSheaf c)) 1 := by
    have h := hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf
      ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf a)
      ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf c)
    rwa [Nat.one_mul] at h
  rw [← cap_isoOn (opsK k) hT
    ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf (a + c))
    ⟨AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.twistingTensorIso (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b)
      (hposOf _ (cover_card k)) a c⟩]
  exact totalCapOn_tensor (ops := opsK k) _ _ _ _ hT

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.CaseIProjSingular.capTwistK
statement:
theorem capTwistK (m : ℤ) :
    totalCapOn (opsK k) ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).canonicalTwistingSheaf m)
        ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf m) =
      (m : ℚ) • xiCapOn (opsK k) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b)
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Int.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    rw [cap_isoOn (opsK k) ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 0)
      hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf ⟨(cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).canonicalTwistingSheafZeroIso⟩,
      totalCapOn_tensorUnit]
    simp
  | succ i ih =>
    rw [capTwist_addK k b (i : ℤ) 1 ((i : ℤ) + 1) rfl, ih]
    push_cast
    rw [add_smul, one_smul]
    rfl
  | pred i ih =>
    have h := capTwist_addK k (X := X) b (-(i : ℤ) - 1) 1 (-(i : ℤ)) (by ring)
    rw [ih] at h
    have key : ∀ {A : Type _} [AddCommGroup A] (a c H : A), a = c + H → c = a - H :=
      fun a c H h ↦ by rw [h]; abel
    push_cast at h ⊢
    refine (key _ _ _ h).trans ?_
    refine LinearMap.ext fun v ↦ ?_
    simp [sub_smul, xiCapOn]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.CaseIProjSingular.eval_twistK
statement:
theorem eval_twistK (m : ℤ) (L : (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).scheme.Modules)
    (hL : HasConstantRank (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).scheme L 1)
    (hcap : totalCapOn (opsK k) L hL = (m : ℚ) • xiCapOn (opsK k) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b))
    (β : TotalChow X) :
    totalPushOn (opsK k) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).toBase
        (((tdLineK k ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
            ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)) ^ (b + 1))
          (chBundleT2 k L (pullK k b β))) =
      Ring.choose ((m : ℚ) + b) b • β
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := exists_mem_S β
  have hv := pullK_mem_S k b hd
  have hH : xiCapOn (opsK k) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b) =
      totalCapOn (opsK k) ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
        ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) := rfl
  have h1 : chBundleT2 k L (pullK k b β) =
      evTrunc (d + b) (xiCapOn (opsK k) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b)) (rescale (m : ℚ) (exp ℚ))
        (pullK k b β) := by
    rw [chBundleT2_line k (W := (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).scheme) L hL hv, hcap, evTrunc_smul_op]
  have hmem : evTrunc (d + b) (xiCapOn (opsK k) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b))
      (rescale (m : ℚ) (exp ℚ)) (pullK k b β) ∈
      S (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).scheme m) (d + b) :=
    (lowersDeg_totalCapOnK k ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
      ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)).evTrunc_mem_S hv _
  rw [h1, tdLineK_pow_apply k _ ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    hmem (b + 1), ← hH]
  have hc : Commute ((evTrunc (d + b) (xiCapOn (opsK k) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b)) tdSer) ^ (b + 1))
      (evTrunc (d + b) (xiCapOn (opsK k) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b)) (rescale (m : ℚ) (exp ℚ))) :=
    Commute.pow_left (evTrunc_comm (d + b) _ _ _) (b + 1)
  rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, hc.eq, Module.End.mul_apply]
  exact chiOp_int' (d + b) b (by omega) (xiCapOn (opsK k) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b)) (pullK k b β)
    (xi_pow_vanishK k b hv) (totalPushOn (opsK k) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).toBase) β
    (fun p _ ↦ segre_pushK k b β p) m

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.CaseIProjSingular.push_tdLineK_chT2_twist_pullK
statement:
theorem push_tdLineK_chT2_twist_pullK (t : ℤ) (β : TotalChow X) :
    totalPushOn (opsK k) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).toBase
      (((tdLineK k ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
          ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)) ^ (b + 1))
        (chBundleT2 k ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).canonicalTwistingSheaf t)
          (totalPullOn (opsK k) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).toBase b (cover_pureRelDim k b) β))) =
      Ring.choose ((t : ℚ) + b) b • β
proof:
:=
  eval_twistK k b t _ ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf t)
    (capTwistK k b t) β

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.CaseIProjSingular.push_tdLineK_chT2_twist_pullK_of_le
statement:
theorem push_tdLineK_chT2_twist_pullK_of_le (t : ℤ) (ht0 : -(b : ℤ) ≤ t) (ht : t ≤ 0)
    (β : TotalChow X) :
    totalPushOn (opsK k) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).toBase
      (((tdLineK k ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
          ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)) ^ (b + 1))
        (chBundleT2 k ((cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).canonicalTwistingSheaf t)
          (totalPullOn (opsK k) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).toBase b (cover_pureRelDim k b) β))) =
      if t = 0 then β else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [push_tdLineK_chT2_twist_pullK k b t β, choose_twist t ht0 ht]
  by_cases h0 : t = 0 <;> simp [h0]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.tauRaw_sumComplex_g2tsum
statement:
theorem tauRaw_sumComplex_g2tsum (hlen : C₁.K.len = C₂.K.len) (U : M.Opens)
    (hC₁ : C₁.SectionExactOn U) (hC₂ : C₂.SectionExactOn U) (hU : (U : Set M).Nonempty)
    (hX : ∀ x : M, x ∉ U → x ∈ Set.range ι) {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    tauRaw (k := k) (sumComplex C₁ C₂) ι U (sectionExactOn_sumComplex C₁ C₂ U hC₁ hC₂) hM =
      tauRaw (k := k) C₁ ι U hC₁ hM + tauRaw (k := k) C₂ ι U hC₂ hM
proof:
:=
  tauRaw_sum (k := k) (sumComplex C₁ C₂) C₁ C₂ ι (sumDom₁_g2tsum (k := k) C₁ C₂ hlen)
    (sumDom₁_toBase_g2tsum (k := k) C₁ C₂ hlen) (sumDom₂_g2tsum (k := k) C₁ C₂ hlen)
    (sumDom₂_toBase_g2tsum (k := k) C₁ C₂ hlen) U _ hC₁ hC₂ hU hX hM
    (xiSumSplit_sumComplex_g2tsum (k := k) C₁ C₂ hlen)
    (pfHom_infDimCycle_dom (k := k) (sumComplex C₁ C₂) C₁ (sumDom₁_g2tsum (k := k) C₁ C₂ hlen)
      (sumDom₁_toBase_g2tsum (k := k) C₁ C₂ hlen) hM)
    (pfHom_infDimCycle_dom (k := k) (sumComplex C₁ C₂) C₂ (sumDom₂_g2tsum (k := k) C₁ C₂ hlen)
      (sumDom₂_toBase_g2tsum (k := k) C₁ C₂ hlen) hM)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.tauRaw_additive_sumComplex_g2tsum
statement:
theorem tauRaw_additive_sumComplex_g2tsum (C : RankedBundleComplex M)
    [(C.graphModel (k := k)).Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType ((C.graphModel (k := k)) ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian (C.graphModel (k := k))] [IsIntegral (C.graphModel (k := k))]
    [Fact (ProjK k (C.graphModel (k := k)))] [(xiProj (k := k) C).IsOver (Spk k)]
    (hlen : C₁.K.len = C₂.K.len) (U U₀ : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U)
    (hC₁ : C₁.SectionExactOn U₀) (hC₂ : C₂.SectionExactOn U₀) (hU₀ : (U₀ : Set M).Nonempty)
    (hX₀ : ∀ x : M, x ∉ U₀ → x ∈ Set.range ι) {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n)
    (hspec : ReesSpecialization (k := k) C (sumComplex C₁ C₂) ι U U₀ hC
      (sectionExactOn_sumComplex C₁ C₂ U₀ hC₁ hC₂) hM) :
    tauRaw (k := k) C ι U hC hM =
      tauRaw (k := k) C₁ ι U₀ hC₁ hM + tauRaw (k := k) C₂ ι U₀ hC₂ hM
proof:
:= by
  rw [hspec]
  exact tauRaw_sumComplex_g2tsum (k := k) C₁ C₂ ι hlen U₀ hC₁ hC₂ hU₀ hX₀ hM

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.Statement.exists_computes
statement:
theorem exists_computes (k : Type u) [Field k] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)]
    [Y.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y] (hX : ProjK k X) (hY : ProjK k Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [f.IsOver (Spk k)] :
    ∃ φ : G0 X →+ G0 Y, INDB.Computes f φ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, j, hj, hjk⟩ := hX
  obtain ⟨M, j', hj', hjk'⟩ := hY
  haveI := hj; haveI := hj'
  haveI : IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spk k) := by rw [← hjk']; infer_instance
  have hw : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = j ≫ toSpec k N := by
    rw [hjk]; exact CategoryTheory.comp_over (f := f) (S := Spk k)
  let i : X ⟶ pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k N) := pullback.lift f j hw
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion i := by
    have h2 : IsClosedImmersion (i ≫ pullback.snd (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k N)) := by
      simp only [i, pullback.lift_snd]; exact hj
    exact IsClosedImmersion.of_comp _ (pullback.snd (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k N))
  have hc := INDB.fShriekG0All_computes (Y ↘ Spk k) N i
  rw [show i ≫ pullback.fst (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k N) = f from pullback.lift_fst _ _ _] at hc
  exact ⟨_, hc⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LeadingTerm.leading_of_generators
statement:
theorem leading_of_generators {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian X] (t : G0 X →+ TotalChow X) (d : ℕ) (hdev : G0Devissage X d)
    (hgen : ∀ (V : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral V] [IsNoetherian V] (ι : V ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι]
      (hF : IsCoherentLike X (pushUnit ι)) (e : ℕ) (he : height (ι (genericPoint V)) = e),
      (∀ m, e < m → DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) m
          (t (g0ClassOf X (pushUnit ι) hF)) = 0) ∧
        DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) e
            (t (g0ClassOf X (pushUnit ι) hF)) =
          (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (ι (genericPoint V)) e he) :
            DimChow X e))
    (F : X.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike X F) (hd : ∀ x ∈ moduleSheafSupport F, height x ≤ d) :
    (∀ m, d < m → DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) m
        (t (g0ClassOf X F hF)) = 0) ∧
      DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) d (t (g0ClassOf X F hF)) =
        (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (coherentCycle F hF d) : DimChow X d)
proof:
:= by
  let T : G0Le X d →+ TotalChow X := t.comp (G0Le.toG0 X d)
  let A : ∀ m : ℕ, G0Le X d →+ RationalDimChow X m := fun m ↦
    (DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) m).toAddMonoidHom.comp T
  let B : G0Le X d →+ RationalDimChow X d :=
    A d - (TensorProduct.mk ℤ ℚ (DimChow X d) 1).toAddMonoidHom.comp (topChowG0 X d)
  have hgen' : ∀ w ∈ {w | ∃ (V : Scheme.{u}) (_ : IsIntegral V) (_ : IsNoetherian V) (ι : V ⟶ X)
      (_ : IsClosedImmersion ι) (h : IsCoherentDimLE X d (pushUnit ι)),
      w = ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf X.Modules (IsCoherentDimLE X d) (pushUnit ι) h},
      (∀ m, d < m → A m w = 0) ∧ B w = 0 := by
    rintro w ⟨V, hVi, hVn, ι, hι, h, rfl⟩
    have hmemη : ι (genericPoint V) ∈ moduleSheafSupport (pushUnit ι) := by
      rw [moduleSheafSupport_pushUnit]; exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hle := h.2 _ hmemη
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e : ℕ, height (ι (genericPoint V)) = e :=
      ⟨(height (ι (genericPoint V))).toNat,
        (ENat.coe_toNat (ne_top_of_le_ne_top (ENat.coe_ne_top d) hle)).symm⟩
    have hed : e ≤ d := by rw [he] at hle; exact_mod_cast hle
    obtain ⟨htop, hlead⟩ := hgen V ι h.1 e he
    have hT : T (ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf X.Modules (IsCoherentDimLE X d)
        (pushUnit ι) h) = t (g0ClassOf X (pushUnit ι) h.1) := by
      simp only [T, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, G0Le.toG0_classOf]
    refine ⟨fun m hm ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [A, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, hT]
      exact htop m (lt_of_le_of_lt hed hm)
    · simp only [B, A, AddMonoidHom.sub_apply, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, hT, topChowG0_classOf,
        LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe, TensorProduct.mk_apply]
      rcases hed.eq_or_lt with rfl | hlt
      · rw [hlead, coherentCycle_pushUnit_integral ι h.1 e he, sub_self]
      · have hz : coherentCycle (pushUnit ι) h.1 d = 0 := by
          apply Subtype.ext
          ext x
          rw [coherentCycle_apply, coherentCoeff, if_neg]
          · rfl
          rintro ⟨hx, hmax⟩
          have hxs := hmax.prop
          rw [moduleSheafSupport_pushUnit] at hxs
          obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hxs
          have h1 := LFA.height_le_genericPoint_lfa v
          rw [← height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion ι v, ← height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion ι,
            hx, he] at h1
          have : d ≤ e := by exact_mod_cast h1
          omega
        rw [htop d hlt, hz, QuotientAddGroup.mk_zero, TensorProduct.tmul_zero, sub_zero]
  have hcl : ∀ z, z ∈ AddSubgroup.closure {w | ∃ (V : Scheme.{u}) (_ : IsIntegral V)
      (_ : IsNoetherian V) (ι : V ⟶ X) (_ : IsClosedImmersion ι)
      (h : IsCoherentDimLE X d (pushUnit ι)),
      w = ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf X.Modules (IsCoherentDimLE X d) (pushUnit ι) h} →
      (∀ m, d < m → A m z = 0) ∧ B z = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    refine ⟨fun m hm ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hle : AddSubgroup.closure _ ≤ (A m).ker :=
        (AddSubgroup.closure_le _).mpr fun w hw ↦ (hgen' w hw).1 m hm
      exact hle hz
    · have hle : AddSubgroup.closure _ ≤ B.ker :=
        (AddSubgroup.closure_le _).mpr fun w hw ↦ (hgen' w hw).2
      exact hle hz
  have hFd : IsCoherentDimLE X d F := ⟨hF, hd⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hzdef⟩ : ∃ z, z = ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf X.Modules
      (IsCoherentDimLE X d) F hFd := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := hcl z (hdev z)
  have hT : T z = t (g0ClassOf X F hF) := by
    rw [hzdef]
    simp only [T, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, G0Le.toG0_classOf]
  refine ⟨fun m hm ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hT]
    exact hA m hm
  · have hB' : DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) d (T z) -
        (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] topChowG0 X d z = 0 := hB
    rw [hT, hzdef, topChowG0_classOf] at hB'
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hB'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LeadingTerm.top_tauPn_unit
statement:
theorem top_tauPn_unit {V : Scheme.{u}} [V.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (V ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian V] [Fact (ProjK k V)] [IsIntegral V] (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    [Fact (ProjK k (space k N))] (J : V ⟶ space k N) [IsClosedImmersion J] [J.IsOver (Spk k)]
    (hadd : TauAdditivityPn N J) (hU : IsCoherentLike V (SheafOfModules.unit V.ringCatSheaf))
    (e : ℕ) (hη : height (genericPoint V) = e) :
    (∀ m, e < m → DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow V n) m
        (tauPn N J hadd (g0ClassOf V _ hU)) = 0) ∧
      DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow V n) e
        (tauPn N J hadd (g0ClassOf V _ hU)) = LFA.fundGen e hη
proof:
:= by
  set x0 : G0 V := g0ClassOf V _ hU with hx0
  set t : TotalChow V := tauPn N J hadd x0 with ht
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := LFA.exists_eq_smul_fundGen hη
    (DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow V n) e t)
  have hup : ∀ m, e < m → DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow V n) m t = 0 :=
    fun m hm ↦ LFA.rationalDimChow_eq_zero_of_lt hη hm _
  have hJη : height (J (genericPoint V)) = e := by
    rw [height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion, hη]
  have heN : e ≤ N := by
    have h := LFA.height_le_space (k := k) N (J (genericPoint V))
    rw [hJη] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  have hFJ : IsCoherentLike (space k N) (pushUnit J) := isCoherentLike_pushUnit J
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := k0ToG0_surjective_of_base k N (k0ToG0_bijective_spec_field k).2
    (finitePushforward J x0)
  have hy' : k0ToG0 (space k N) y = g0ClassOf (space k N) (pushUnit J) hFJ := by
    rw [hy, hx0, finitePushforward_classOf]
  have hdimJ : ∀ x ∈ moduleSheafSupport (pushUnit J), height x ≤ e := by
    rw [moduleSheafSupport_pushUnit]
    rintro _ ⟨v, rfl⟩
    rw [height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion, ← hη]
    exact LFA.height_le_genericPoint_lfa v
  obtain ⟨-, -, htd, hdeg⟩ := chPn_leading_of_gate k N hN
    (RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.leadingCycleGate k N hN) (pushUnit J) hFJ e heN hdimJ y hy'
  have hA := push_tauPn N J hadd x0 y hy
  have hcomp : DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k N) m) e (chFund k N y) =
      c • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (J (genericPoint V)) e hJη) :
        DimChow (space k N) e)) := by
    rw [← htd, chFund_apply, ← hA, LFA.component_totalPushOn, ← ht, hc, map_smul,
      push_fundGen J e hJη hη]
  have hlof : DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k N) m) e
      (DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k N) m) e (chFund k N y)) =
      c • cycPn k N (pushUnit J) hFJ e := by
    rw [hcomp, map_smul, cycPn_pushUnit_integral k N J hFJ e hJη]
  rw [hlof, map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at hdeg
  have hc1 : c = 1 :=
    RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.eq_one_of_mul_degPn_cycPn_pushUnit k N J hFJ e hJη c hdeg
  exact ⟨hup, by rw [hc, hc1, one_smul]⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LeadingTerm.leading_tauPn
statement:
theorem leading_tauPn {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (ProjK k X)] (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) [Fact (ProjK k (space k N))]
    (ι : X ⟶ space k N) [IsClosedImmersion ι] [ι.IsOver (Spk k)]
    (hadd : ∀ {V : Scheme.{u}} [V.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (V ↘ Spk k)]
      [IsNoetherian V] [Fact (ProjK k V)] (J : V ⟶ space k N) [IsClosedImmersion J]
      [J.IsOver (Spk k)], TauAdditivityPn N J)
    (F : X.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike X F) (d : ℕ)
    (hd : ∀ x ∈ moduleSheafSupport F, height x ≤ d) :
    (∀ m, d < m → DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) m
        (tauPn N ι (hadd ι) (g0ClassOf X F hF)) = 0) ∧
      DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) d
          (tauPn N ι (hadd ι) (g0ClassOf X F hF)) =
        (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (coherentCycle F hF d) : DimChow X d)
proof:
:= by
  refine leading_of_generators (k := k) _ d (G0Dev.g0Devissage (k := k) X d)
    (fun V _ _ j _ hFj e he ↦ ?_) F hF hd
  letI : V.Over (Spk k) := ⟨j ≫ X ↘ Spk k⟩
  haveI : j.IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨rfl⟩
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (V ↘ Spk k) :=
    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType (j ≫ X ↘ Spk k))
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k V) :=
    ⟨projK_closed (Fact.out : ProjK k X) j (CategoryTheory.comp_over (f := j) (S := Spk k))⟩
  haveI : IsProper j := LocalizedLift.isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) j
  have hη : height (genericPoint V) = e := by
    rw [← he, height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion]
  have hU : IsCoherentLike V (SheafOfModules.unit V.ringCatSheaf) :=
    SheafOfModules.unit_isFinitePresentation (R := V.ringCatSheaf)
  obtain ⟨htop, hlead⟩ := top_tauPn_unit N hN (j ≫ ι) (hadd (j ≫ ι)) hU e hη
  have hX' : tauPn N ι (hadd ι) (g0ClassOf X (pushUnit j) hFj) =
      totalPushOn (opsK k) j (tauPn N (j ≫ ι) (hadd (j ≫ ι)) (g0ClassOf V _ hU)) := by
    rw [← finitePushforward_classOf]
    exact tauPn_finitePushforward N ι (j ≫ ι) j rfl (hadd ι) (hadd (j ≫ ι)) _
  refine ⟨fun m hm ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hX', LFA.component_totalPushOn, htop m hm, map_zero]
  · rw [hX', LFA.component_totalPushOn, hlead, push_fundGen j e he hη]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LeadingTerm.leading_tauX_of_pos
statement:
theorem leading_tauX_of_pos (hadd : TauAdditivityAmb k) {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (ProjK k X)]
    (hpos : 0 < chosenDim (k := k) X)
    (F : X.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike X F) (d : ℕ)

        (tauX X hadd (g0ClassOf X F hF)) = 0) ∧
      DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) d (tauX X hadd (g0ClassOf X F hF)) =
        (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (coherentCycle F hF d) : DimChow X d)
proof:

  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (space k (chosenDim (k := k) X))) := ⟨projK_space _ rfl⟩
  exact leading_tauPn (chosenDim (k := k) X) hpos (chosenEmb (k := k) X)
    (fun J _ _ ↦ hadd.2 _ J) F hF d hd

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModuleProperty.tdLineK_eq_tdTot_g2tmod

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModuleProperty.commute_tdLineK_chK
statement:
theorem commute_tdLineK_chK (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (E : X.Modules)
    {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) : Commute (tdLineK k L hL) (chK k E)
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty X with hX | hX
  · exact commute_of_isEmpty_g2tmod _ _
  · have hc : ∀ j, Commute (constRankChernAssignOn' (opsK k) (cpK k) closedPosK X L 1)
        (chOpOn (opsK k) (cpK k) closedPosK X E j) := fun j ↦
      chOpOn_comm_cOp (whitneyK (k := k)) hE hL j 1
    have hc' : ∀ j, Commute (totalCapOn (opsK k) L hL)
        (chOpOn (opsK k) (cpK k) closedPosK X E j) := fun j ↦ by
      have h := hc j
      rwa [cOp_line (opsK k) (cpK k) closedPosK L hL 1] at h
    have hterm : ∀ i j, Commute (tdOpOn (opsK k) (cpK k) closedPosK X L i)
        (chOpOn (opsK k) (cpK k) closedPosK X E j) := fun i j ↦ by
      rw [tdOpOn_line L hL i]
      exact ((hc' j).pow_left i).smul_left _
    have hch : chK k E = GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tot (M := fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n)
        (PowerSeries.mk (chOpOn (opsK k) (cpK k) closedPosK X E)) :=
      GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.chTot_eq_tot (opsK k) (cpK k) closedPosK E
    have htd : GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tdTot (opsK k) (cpK k) closedPosK L =
        GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tot (M := fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n)
          (tdSeriesOn (opsK k) (cpK k) closedPosK X L) :=
      GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tdTot_eq_tot (opsK k) (cpK k) closedPosK L
    rw [tdLineK_eq_tdTot_g2tmod, Commute, SemiconjBy, htd, hch,
      ← GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tot_mul (GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.gser_td (whitneyK (k := k)) hL)
        (GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.gser_ch (whitneyK (k := k)) hE),
      ← GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tot_mul (GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.gser_ch (whitneyK (k := k)) hE)
        (GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.gser_td (whitneyK (k := k)) hL)]
    congr 1
    refine PowerSeries.ext fun n ↦ ?_
    rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
    simp only [tdSeriesOn, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
    calc ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, tdOpOn (opsK k) (cpK k) closedPosK X L p.1 *
          chOpOn (opsK k) (cpK k) closedPosK X E p.2
        = ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, chOpOn (opsK k) (cpK k) closedPosK X E p.2 *
          tdOpOn (opsK k) (cpK k) closedPosK X L p.1 :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ ↦ (hterm p.1 p.2).eq
      _ = ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, chOpOn (opsK k) (cpK k) closedPosK X E p.1 *
          tdOpOn (opsK k) (cpK k) closedPosK X L p.2 :=
          Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_swap
            (f := fun p : ℕ × ℕ ↦ chOpOn (opsK k) (cpK k) closedPosK X E p.1 *
              tdOpOn (opsK k) (cpK k) closedPosK X L p.2)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModuleProperty.chK_line_injective_g2tmod
statement:
theorem chK_line_injective_g2tmod {M : X.Modules} (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1)
    {v w : TotalChow X} (h : chK k M v = chK k M w) : v = w
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty X with hX | hX
  · rw [totalChow_eq_zero_of_isEmpty v, totalChow_eq_zero_of_isEmpty w]
  · set c := totalCapOn (opsK k) M hM
    have hc : c ∈ GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.lowSub (fun i ↦ RationalDimChow X i) 1 :=
      GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.lowSub_of_loweringSub (totalCapOn_mem_lowering (opsK k) M hM)
    have hinv : GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.gexp ((-1 : ℚ) • c) * GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.gexp c = 1 := by
      rw [← GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.gexp_add (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hc) hc
        ((Commute.refl c).smul_left (-1 : ℚ)), neg_one_smul, neg_add_cancel,
        GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.gexp_zero]
    have hch : chK k M = GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.gexp c := GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.chTot_line M hM
    rw [hch] at h
    have := congrArg (GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.gexp ((-1 : ℚ) • c)) h
    rwa [← Module.End.mul_apply, ← Module.End.mul_apply, hinv, Module.End.one_apply,
      Module.End.one_apply] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModuleProperty.tauPn_smul_line
statement:
theorem tauPn_smul_line (N : ℕ) [Fact (ProjK k (space k N))] (ι : X ⟶ space k N)
    [IsClosedImmersion ι] [ι.IsOver (Spk k)] (hadd : TauAdditivityPn N ι)
    (A : (space k N).Modules) (hA : HasConstantRank (space k N) A 1) (z : G0 X) :
    tauPn N ι hadd (k0ClassOf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj A)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X ι A 1 hA).isFiniteLocallyFree • z) =
      chK k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj A) (tauPn N ι hadd z)
proof:
:= by
  have hap : ∀ w, tauPn N ι hadd w =
      (tdLineK k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N 1))
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X ι _ 1 (GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.hcr k N 1)) ^ (N + 1))
        (tauG0 (FRI.space_member k N) ι (CASE1B.height_genericPoint_space k N)
          (CIICLASS.T1N23.projectiveSpace_regStalks k N) hadd w) := fun _ ↦ rfl
  rw [hap, hap, tauG0_smul_line (FRI.space_member k N) ι (CASE1B.height_genericPoint_space k N)
      (CIICLASS.T1N23.projectiveSpace_regStalks k N) A hA hadd z]
  have hc := ((commute_tdLineK_chK (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N 1)) (hasConstantRank_pullback X ι _ 1 (GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.hcr k N 1))
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj A) (hasConstantRank_pullback X ι A 1 hA)).pow_left (N + 1))
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun hc.eq _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModuleProperty.tauPP_smul_line
statement:
theorem tauPP_smul_line {a b : ℕ} (j : X ⟶ PP k a b) [IsClosedImmersion j] [j.IsOver (Spk k)]
    (hadd : TauAdditivity (pp_member k a b) j (pp_height k a b))
    (A : (PP k a b).Modules) (hA : HasConstantRank (PP k a b) A 1) (z : G0 X) :
    tauPP j hadd (k0ClassOf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj A)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X j A 1 hA).isFiniteLocallyFree • z) =
      chK k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj A) (tauPP j hadd z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tauPP, tauTwo_apply, tauTwo_apply,
    tauG0_smul_line (pp_member k a b) j (pp_height k a b) (pp_regStalks k a b) A hA hadd z]
  have hA' := hasConstantRank_pullback X j A 1 hA
  have h₁ := (commute_tdLineK_chK (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj (ppL₁ k a b))
    (hasConstantRank_pullback X j _ 1 (hppL₁ k a b)) _ hA').pow_left (a + 1)
  have h₂ := (commute_tdLineK_chK (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj (ppL₂ k a b))
    (hasConstantRank_pullback X j _ 1 (hppL₂ k a b)) _ hA').pow_left (b + 1)
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun (h₁.mul_left h₂).eq _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModuleProperty.k0ClassOf_tensor_line_g2tmod
statement:

    k0ClassOf X (tensorSheaf X L M) hLM = k0ClassOf X L hL * k0ClassOf X M hM.isFiniteLocallyFree
proof:
:=
  ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.k0ClassOf_twistBy M hM hL hLM

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModuleProperty.bundleMod_iso
statement:
theorem bundleMod_iso {E E' : X.Modules} (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E)
    (hE' : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E') (e : E ≅ E') (h : BundleMod hadd X E hE) :
    BundleMod hadd X E' hE'
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  rw [← k0ClassOf_iso X hE hE' e, ← chK_iso_g2tmod e]
  exact h z

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModuleProperty.bundleMod_tensor
statement:
theorem bundleMod_tensor {L M : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1) (h₁ : BundleMod hadd X L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree)
    (h₂ : BundleMod hadd X M hM.isFiniteLocallyFree)
    (hLM : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (tensorSheaf X L M)) :
    BundleMod hadd X (tensorSheaf X L M) hLM
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  rw [k0ClassOf_tensor_line_g2tmod hL.isFiniteLocallyFree hM hLM, mul_smul,
    h₁, h₂, chK_tensor_lines_g2tmod hL hM, Module.End.mul_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModuleProperty.bundleMod_cancel
statement:
theorem bundleMod_cancel {L M : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1) (hLM : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (tensorSheaf X L M))
    (h₁ : BundleMod hadd X (tensorSheaf X L M) hLM)
    (h₂ : BundleMod hadd X M hM.isFiniteLocallyFree) :
    BundleMod hadd X L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  apply chK_line_injective_g2tmod (k := k) hM
  have e := h₁ z
  rw [k0ClassOf_tensor_line_g2tmod hL.isFiniteLocallyFree hM hLM, mul_comm,
    mul_smul, h₂, chK_tensor_lines_g2tmod hL hM, Module.End.mul_apply] at e
  exact e

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModuleProperty.bundleMod_graph
statement:
theorem bundleMod_graph {a : ℕ} (φ : X ⟶ space k a) [φ.IsOver (Spk k)]
    (A : (PP k a (chosenDim (k := k) X)).Modules)
    (hA : HasConstantRank (PP k a (chosenDim (k := k) X)) A 1) :
    BundleMod hadd X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (graphPP φ (chosenEmb (k := k) X))).obj A)
      (hasConstantRank_pullback X _ A 1 hA).isFiniteLocallyFree
proof:
:= by
  haveI := graphPP_isClosedImmersion_snd φ (chosenEmb (k := k) X)
  intro z
  have h := fun w ↦ tauPn_eq_tauPP_snd' φ (chosenEmb (k := k) X) (hIV a _).2 (hadd.1 a _)
    (hadd.2 _ (chosenEmb (k := k) X)) w
  change tauPn _ _ _ _ = chK k _ (tauPn _ _ _ _)
  rw [← h, ← h]
  exact tauPP_smul_line _ _ A hA z

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModuleProperty.bundleMod_pullbackTwist
statement:
theorem bundleMod_pullbackTwist {a : ℕ} (φ : X ⟶ space k a) [φ.IsOver (Spk k)] (t : ℤ) :
    BundleMod hadd X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback φ).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k a t))
      (hasConstantRank_pullback X φ _ 1 (GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.hcr k a t)).isFiniteLocallyFree
proof:
:= by
  set κ := graphPP φ (chosenEmb (k := k) X)
  let A : (PP k a (chosenDim (k := k) X)).Modules :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pr₁PP k a (chosenDim (k := k) X))).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k a t)
  have hA : HasConstantRank _ A 1 := hasConstantRank_pullback _ _ _ 1 (GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.hcr k a t)
  have e : (Scheme.Modules.pullback κ).obj A ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback φ).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k a t) :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp κ (pr₁PP k a (chosenDim (k := k) X))).app _ ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (graphPP_fst φ (chosenEmb (k := k) X))).app _
  exact bundleMod_iso hadd _ _ e (bundleMod_graph hIV hadd φ A hA)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModuleProperty.lineModAll_of_lineDiffPullback
statement: theorem lineModAll_of_lineDiffPullback (hgeo : LineDiffPullback k) : LineModAll k hadd
proof:
:= by
  intro X _ _ _ _ L hL
  obtain ⟨a, b, φ₁, φ₂, h₁, h₂, t₁, t₂, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hgeo L hL
  have hM := hasConstantRank_pullback X φ₂ _ 1 (GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.hcr k b t₂)
  have hLM : HasConstantRank X (tensorSheaf X L
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback φ₂).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k b t₂))) 1 := by
    have := hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hL hM
    rwa [Nat.one_mul] at this
  refine bundleMod_cancel hadd hL hM hLM.isFiniteLocallyFree ?_
    (bundleMod_pullbackTwist hIV hadd φ₂ t₂)
  exact bundleMod_iso hadd _ _ e.symm (bundleMod_pullbackTwist hIV hadd φ₁ t₁)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.isIso_tensorSheafMap_p1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.pullback_tensorSheafMap_p1
statement:
theorem pullback_tensorSheafMap_p1 (lam : A ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf T)
    (E : T.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree T E) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map (tensorSheafMap T (𝟙 E) lam) =
      pullbackTensorSheafHom g E A ≫
        tensorSheafMap M (𝟙 _) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map lam) ≫
          @inv _ _ _ _ (pullbackTensorSheafHom g E (tensorUnitSheaf T))
            (pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_isFiniteLocallyFree g E _ hE
              hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf.isFiniteLocallyFree)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_isFiniteLocallyFree g E (tensorUnitSheaf T) hE
    hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf.isFiniteLocallyFree
  have h := pullbackTensorSheafHom_naturality g (𝟙 E) lam
  rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id] at h
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← h, Category.assoc, IsIso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.isIso_pullback_twistSigma
statement:
theorem isIso_pullback_twistSigma (hA : IsFiniteLocallyFree T A) (lam : A ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf T)
    (hlam : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map lam)) (E : T.Modules)
    (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree T E) :
    IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map ((twistSigma A lam).app E))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_isFiniteLocallyFree g E A hE hA
  haveI := pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_isFiniteLocallyFree g E (tensorUnitSheaf T) hE
    hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf.isFiniteLocallyFree
  haveI h1 : IsIso (tensorSheafMap M (𝟙 ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E))
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map lam)) := isIso_tensorSheafMap_p1 _ _
  haveI h2 : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map (tensorSheafRightUnitor T E).hom) :=
    inferInstance
  have hc : (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map ((twistSigma A lam).app E) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map (tensorSheafMap T (𝟙 E) lam) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map (tensorSheafRightUnitor T E).hom :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map_comp _ _
  rw [hc, pullback_tensorSheafMap_p1 A g lam E hE]
  exact IsIso.comp_isIso' (IsIso.comp_isIso'
    (pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_isFiniteLocallyFree g E A hE hA)
    (IsIso.comp_isIso' h1 inferInstance)) h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.pullback_twistSigma_eq_zero
statement:
theorem pullback_twistSigma_eq_zero (lam : A ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf T)
    (hlam : (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map lam = 0) (E : T.Modules)
    (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree T E) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map ((twistSigma A lam).app E) = 0

      (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map (tensorSheafMap T (𝟙 E) lam) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map (tensorSheafRightUnitor T E).hom :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map_comp _ _
  rw [hc, pullback_tensorSheafMap_p1 A g lam E hE, hlam,
    tensorSheafMap_id_zero_p1, zero_comp, comp_zero, zero_comp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.reesSpecialization_twist_of_fibre
statement:
theorem reesSpecialization_twist_of_fibre (hg₁ : g₁ ≫ p = 𝟙 M) (hg₀ : g₀ ≫ p = 𝟙 M)
    (hlam₁ : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g₁).map lam)) (mu : A ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf T)
    (hlam₀ : (Scheme.Modules.pullback g₀).map lam = 0)
    (hmu₀ : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g₀).map mu))
    (U U₀ : M.Opens) (hC : (extComplex C₁ C₂ c).SectionExactOn U)
    (hC₀ : (sumComplex C₁ C₂).SectionExactOn U₀) {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n)
    (hF : tauRaw (k := k) ((reesComplex p (ProjectionFormula.tensorRight T A)
          (hasConstantRank_tensorRight_p1 A hA) (twistSigma A lam) c).pullback g₁) ι U
        (sectionExactOn_isoData (reesFibreUnitTwist p g₁ hg₁ A hA c lam hlam₁).symm hC) hM =
      tauRaw (k := k) ((reesComplex p (ProjectionFormula.tensorRight T A)
          (hasConstantRank_tensorRight_p1 A hA) (twistSigma A lam) c).pullback g₀) ι U₀
        (sectionExactOn_isoData (reesFibreZeroTwist p g₀ hg₀ A hA c lam mu hlam₀ hmu₀).symm hC₀)
          hM) :
    ReesSpecialization (k := k) (extComplex C₁ C₂ c) (sumComplex C₁ C₂) ι U U₀ hC hC₀ hM
proof:
:=
  reesSpecialization_of_fibre (k := k) hMK (extComplex C₁ C₂ c) (sumComplex C₁ C₂)
    _ _ ι (reesFibreUnitTwist p g₁ hg₁ A hA c lam hlam₁)
    (reesFibreZeroTwist p g₀ hg₀ A hA c lam mu hlam₀ hmu₀) U U₀ hC hC₀ _ _ hM hF

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.sections_ses_g2tfadd
statement:
theorem sections_ses_g2tfadd {A B D : M.Modules} (hA : IsFiniteLocallyFree M A)
    (hB : IsFiniteLocallyFree M B) (hD : IsFiniteLocallyFree M D) {f : A ⟶ B} {g : B ⟶ D}
    (h : AbelianResolutionF15.SES f g) (V : M.affineOpens) :
    Function.Injective (sectionMap f V.1) ∧ Function.Exact (sectionMap f V.1) (sectionMap g V.1) ∧
      Function.Surjective (sectionMap g V.1)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isQuasicoherent_of_bundle_g2tbivr hA
  haveI := isQuasicoherent_of_bundle_g2tbivr hB
  haveI := isQuasicoherent_of_bundle_g2tbivr hD
  exact sections_SES_of_affine h V

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.coneProj_g2tfadd_apply
statement:
theorem coneProj_g2tfadd_apply (j : ℕ) (V : M.Opens)
    (x : (C₂.K.E j ⊞ (splitShift C₁ hz).K.E j).val.obj (op V)) :
    sectionMap (coneProj_g2tfadd hz i q hi j) V x = sectionMap (q j) V (sectionMap biprod.fst V x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.coneProj_g2tfadd_chain
statement:
theorem coneProj_g2tfadd_chain (hiq : ∀ j, i j ≫ q j = 0) (j : ℕ) :
    (splitCone hz i hi).K.d j ≫ coneProj_g2tfadd hz i q hi j =
      coneProj_g2tfadd hz i q hi (j + 1) ≫ C₃.K.d j
proof:
:= by
  change extD C₂ (splitShift C₁ hz) (splitConeCocycle hz i hi) j ≫ biprod.fst ≫ q j =
    (biprod.fst ≫ q (j + 1)) ≫ C₃.K.d j
  have h0 : (splitConeCocycle hz i hi).h j ≫ q j = 0 := hiq j
  rw [extD_fst_assoc, Preadditive.add_comp, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, hq j, h0, comp_zero,
    add_zero, Category.assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.coneProj_lift_g2tfadd
statement:
theorem coneProj_lift_g2tfadd (hses : ∀ j, AbelianResolutionF15.SES (i j) (q j))
    (V : M.affineOpens) (j : ℕ) (c : (C₃.K.E (j + 1)).val.obj (op V.1))
    (b : (C₂.K.E j).val.obj (op V.1))
    (h : sectionMap (C₃.K.d j) V.1 c + sectionMap (q j) V.1 b = 0) :
    ∃ (β : (C₂.K.E (j + 1)).val.obj (op V.1)) (α : (C₁.K.E j).val.obj (op V.1)),
      sectionMap (q (j + 1)) V.1 β = c ∧
        sectionMap (i j) V.1 α = sectionMap (C₂.K.d j) V.1 β + b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, -, hs⟩ :=
    sections_ses_g2tfadd (C₁.K.hE (j + 1)) (C₂.K.hE (j + 1)) (C₃.K.hE (j + 1)) (hses (j + 1)) V
  obtain ⟨-, he, -⟩ := sections_ses_g2tfadd (C₁.K.hE j) (C₂.K.hE j) (C₃.K.hE j) (hses j) V
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := hs c
  have hk : sectionMap (q j) V.1 (sectionMap (C₂.K.d j) V.1 β + b) = 0 := by
    rw [map_add, ← sectionMap_comp_g2tbiva, hq j, sectionMap_comp_g2tbiva, hβ]
    exact h
  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := (he _).1 hk
  exact ⟨β, α, hβ, hα⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.coneProj_cone_sectionExactOn_top
statement:
theorem coneProj_cone_sectionExactOn_top (hses : ∀ j, AbelianResolutionF15.SES (i j) (q j)) :
    (splitCone hz (coneProj_g2tfadd hz i q hi)
      (coneProj_g2tfadd_chain hz i q hi hq fun j => (hses j).zero)).SectionExactOn ⊤
proof:
:= by
  intro V _
  refine splitCone_sectionExact_of hz _ _ V.1 (fun c => ?_) (fun c x h => ?_)
    (fun j c x h hD => ?_)
  · 
    obtain ⟨-, -, hs⟩ := sections_ses_g2tfadd (C₁.K.hE 0) (C₂.K.hE 0) (C₃.K.hE 0) (hses 0) V
    obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := hs c
    refine ⟨0, sectionMap (biprod.inl : C₂.K.E 0 ⟶ C₂.K.E 0 ⊞ (splitShift C₁ hz).K.E 0) V.1 β, ?_⟩
    rw [map_zero, zero_add, coneProj_g2tfadd_apply, sec_fst_inl_g2trees]
    exact hβ
  · 
    obtain ⟨β, α, hβ, hα⟩ := coneProj_lift_g2tfadd i q hq hses V 0 c
      (sectionMap biprod.fst V.1 x) h
    refine ⟨0, sectionMap (biprod.inl : C₂.K.E 1 ⟶ C₂.K.E 1 ⊞ (splitShift C₁ hz).K.E 1) V.1 β +
      sectionMap (biprod.inr : (splitShift C₁ hz).K.E 1 ⟶ C₂.K.E 1 ⊞ (splitShift C₁ hz).K.E 1)
        V.1 (-α), ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [map_zero, zero_add, coneProj_g2tfadd_apply]
      erw [sec_fst_add_g2trees]
      exact hβ
    · refine sec_biprod_ext_g2trees V.1 _ _ ?_ (sec_splitShift_zero C₁ hz V.1 _ _)
      erw [LinearMap.map_neg]
      erw [sec_extD_fst, sec_fst_add_g2trees, sec_snd_add_g2trees]
      change -(sectionMap (C₂.K.d 0) V.1 β + sectionMap (i 0) V.1 (-α)) = _
      rw [map_neg, hα]
      abel
  · 
    obtain ⟨β, α, hβ, hα⟩ := coneProj_lift_g2tfadd i q hq hses V (j + 1) c
      (sectionMap biprod.fst V.1 x) h
    refine ⟨0, sectionMap (biprod.inl : C₂.K.E (j + 2) ⟶ C₂.K.E (j + 2) ⊞
      (splitShift C₁ hz).K.E (j + 2)) V.1 β +
      sectionMap (biprod.inr : (splitShift C₁ hz).K.E (j + 2) ⟶ C₂.K.E (j + 2) ⊞
        (splitShift C₁ hz).K.E (j + 2)) V.1 (-α), ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [map_zero, zero_add, coneProj_g2tfadd_apply]
      erw [sec_fst_add_g2trees]
      exact hβ
    · 
      have hD1 : sectionMap (C₂.K.d j) V.1 (sectionMap biprod.fst V.1 x) +
          sectionMap (i j) V.1 (sectionMap biprod.snd V.1 x) = 0 := by
        have h1 := congrArg (sectionMap biprod.fst V.1) hD
        erw [sec_extD_fst, map_zero] at h1
        exact h1
      obtain ⟨hinj, -, -⟩ := sections_ses_g2tfadd (C₁.K.hE j) (C₂.K.hE j) (C₃.K.hE j) (hses j) V
      
      have hdα : sectionMap (C₁.K.d j) V.1 α = -sectionMap biprod.snd V.1 x := by
        apply hinj
        rw [← sectionMap_comp_g2tbiva, hi j, sectionMap_comp_g2tbiva, hα, map_add,
          ← sectionMap_comp_g2tbiva, C₂.K.dd j, sectionMap_zero_g2tbiva, zero_add]
        erw [LinearMap.map_neg]
        exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hD1
      refine sec_biprod_ext_g2trees V.1 _ _ ?_ ?_
      · erw [LinearMap.map_neg]
        erw [sec_extD_fst, sec_fst_add_g2trees, sec_snd_add_g2trees]
        change -(sectionMap (C₂.K.d (j + 1)) V.1 β + sectionMap (i (j + 1)) V.1 (-α)) = _
        rw [map_neg, hα]
        abel
      · erw [LinearMap.map_neg]
        erw [sec_extD_snd, sec_snd_add_g2trees, sec_splitShift_d_succ]
        change -(-sectionMap (C₁.K.d j) V.1 (-α)) = _
        rw [map_neg, hdα, neg_neg]
        exact neg_neg _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.tauAdditivity_of_split
statement:
theorem tauAdditivity_of_split (hsplit : TauAdditivitySplit hMK ι hM) :
    TauAdditivity hMK ι hM
proof:
:= by
  intro C₁ C₂ C₃ i q hses hi hq U h₁ h₂ h₃ hX
  obtain ⟨r₀, hz⟩ := exists_hasConstantRank_zero_g2tr1b hMK
  have hs₁ := sectionExactOn_splitShift C₁ hz h₁
  have hci : (splitCone hz i hi).SectionExactOn U :=
    sectionExactOn_extComplex (splitConeCocycle hz i hi) h₂ hs₁
  
  have e1 : tauStd hMK (splitCone hz i hi) ι U hci hM =
      tauStd hMK C₂ ι U h₂ hM + -tauStd hMK C₁ ι U h₁ hM := by
    rw [← tauStd_splitShift hMK ι hM hsplit hz C₁ U h₁ hX]
    exact hsplit C₂ (splitShift C₁ hz) (splitConeCocycle hz i hi) U h₂ hs₁ hX
  
  have e2 := tauStd_add_shift_of_cone hMK ι hM hsplit hz (splitCone hz i hi) C₃
    (coneProj_g2tfadd hz i q hi) (coneProj_g2tfadd_chain hz i q hi hq fun j => (hses j).zero)
    (coneProj_cone_sectionExactOn_top hz i q hi hq hses) U hci h₃ hX
  rw [tauStd_splitShift hMK ι hM hsplit hz (splitCone hz i hi) U hci hX] at e2
  have e3 : tauStd hMK C₃ ι U h₃ hM = tauStd hMK (splitCone hz i hi) ι U hci hM :=
    add_neg_eq_zero.mp e2
  rw [e3, e1]
  abel

theorem covariant_tauFam (hadd : TauAdditivityAmb k) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.Assembly.regular_tauFam
statement:
theorem regular_tauFam (hadd : TauAdditivityAmb k) (hR : RegSpecAll k) {X : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (ProjK k X)]
    [IsIntegral X] (hreg : RegStalks X) (N : ℕ) (i : X ⟶ space k N) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [i.IsOver (Spk k)] (x : K0 X) :
    haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X)
proof:
:=
      ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_projK (Fact.out : ProjK k X)⟩
    tauFam hadd X (k0ToG0 X x) =
      ((tdLine k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N 1))
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1 (hcr k N 1))) ^ (N + 1))
        (tauX k (closedPosV4 k) (chExact_closedPosV4 k) i x) := by
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (space k N)) := ⟨projK_space N rfl⟩
  rw [tauFam_eq hadd X, AmbientIndependence.tauX_eq_tauPn (FlatBC.projCovAll_g2tcibca k) hadd N i]
  exact regular_tauPn N hreg i (hadd.2 N i) (hR N hreg i (hadd.2 N i)) x

statement:
theorem push_tauPn (hadd : TauAdditivityPn N ι) (x : G0 X) (y : K0 (space k N))

    (GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Interw.pow
      (interw_tdLineK ι (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N 1) (hcr k N 1)) (N + 1)),

    chK0T2_eq_chK0 k (GRRBlueprintV4.closedPosV4 k) (GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.chExact_closedPosV4 k),
    fundPn, GRRBlueprintV4.fundClass_eq k N (CASE1B.height_genericPoint_space k N)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.genGraph_iff_graphDefect_eq_zero_xiG
statement:
theorem genGraph_iff_graphDefect_eq_zero_xiG (hQ : ResInjXiG Q) (hW₁ : (W₁ : Set Y).Nonempty)
    {V : Y.Opens} (hV : (V : Set Y).Nonempty) (s : Γ(G, V)) :
    GenGraph pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V s ↔ graphDefect pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V s = 0

:= by
  constructor
  · intro hg
    obtain ⟨V'', h, hne, h0⟩ := hg hV
    exact hQ h hne (h0.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  · intro h0 _
    refine ⟨V ⊓ W₁, le_rfl, nonempty_inter_xiS hV hW₁, ?_⟩
    rw [h0, map_zero]

      Q.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V ⊓ W₁ ≤ V)).op

  · intro h0
    rw [h0, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.bijective_pr₁_xiG
statement:
theorem bijective_pr₁_xiG (hb : BiprodXiR pr₁ pr₂ in₁ in₂) (hQ : ResInjXiG Q)
    (hW₁ : (W₁ : Set Y).Nonempty) {V : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ W₁) :
    Function.Bijective ((genericGraphι pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁ ≫ pr₁).app V)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hV : (V : Set Y).Nonempty
  · constructor
    · intro x y hxy
      apply Subtype.ext
      change pr₁.app V x.1 = pr₁.app V y.1 at hxy
      have hx := (genGraph_iff_of_le_xiG δ W₁ t hQ hW₁ h hV x.1).1 x.2
      have hy := (genGraph_iff_of_le_xiG δ W₁ t hQ hW₁ h hV y.1).1 y.2
      rw [← hb.split V x.1, ← hb.split V y.1, hx, hy, hxy]
    · intro e
      have hg : GenGraph pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V (graphSecXiG (in₁ := in₁) (in₂ := in₂) δ W₁ t h e) := by
        rw [genGraph_iff_of_le_xiG δ W₁ t hQ hW₁ h hV, pr₂_graphSecXiG δ W₁ t hb,
          pr₁_graphSecXiG δ W₁ t hb]
      exact ⟨⟨_, hg⟩, pr₁_graphSecXiG δ W₁ t hb h e⟩
  · haveI := subsingleton_modSections_xiG (L := genericGraphSheaf pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁) V hV
    haveI := subsingleton_modSections_xiG (L := P) V hV
    exact ⟨fun a b _ => Subsingleton.elim a b, fun e => ⟨0, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.isIso_of_app_bijective_xiG
statement:
theorem isIso_of_app_bijective_xiG {X : Scheme.{u}} {M N : X.Modules} (f : M ⟶ N)
    (h : ∀ W : X.Opens, Function.Bijective (f.val.app (op W))) : IsIso f
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : IsIso ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).map f).hom := by
    have : ∀ W, IsIso (((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).map f).hom.app W) := fun W ↦
      (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective _).2 (h W.unop)
    exact NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app _
  have h2 : IsIso ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).map f) := by
    have : IsIso ((sheafToPresheaf _ _).map ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).map f)) := h1
    exact isIso_of_reflects_iso _ (sheafToPresheaf _ _)
  let F := SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf
  have hF : F.ReflectsIsomorphisms := by
    have : (F ⋙ sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat).ReflectsIsomorphisms :=
      inferInstanceAs
        ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
          PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf X.ringCatSheaf.obj).ReflectsIsomorphisms)
    exact reflectsIsomorphisms_of_comp F (sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat)
  exact hF.reflects f

statement:
theorem isIso_restrict_pr₁_xiG (hb : BiprodXiR pr₁ pr₂ in₁ in₂) (hQ : ResInjXiG Q)
