name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.genGraph_iff_of_le_chartZero_xiG
statement:
theorem genGraph_iff_of_le_chartZero_xiG (hQ : ResInjXiG Q) (hW₁ : (W₁ : Set Y).Nonempty)
    (W₀ : Y.Opens) (σ : Γ(Y, W₀))
    (hst : ∀ {V : Y.Opens} (h0 : V ≤ W₀) (h1 : V ≤ W₁), rXiR h0 σ * rXiR h1 t = 1)
    {V : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ W₀) (hV : (V : Set Y).Nonempty) (s : Γ(G, V)) :
    GenGraph pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V s ↔ rXiR h σ • pr₂.app V s = δ.app V (pr₁.app V s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [genGraph_iff_graphDefect_eq_zero_xiG δ W₁ t hQ hW₁ hV]
  have h1 : (V ⊓ W₁ : Y.Opens) ≤ W₀ := inf_le_left.trans h
  have hst' := hst h1 (inf_le_right : V ⊓ W₁ ≤ W₁)
  have key : Q.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V ⊓ W₁ ≤ V)).op
      (rXiR h σ • pr₂.app V s - δ.app V (pr₁.app V s)) =
        rXiR h1 σ • graphDefect pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V s := by
    simp only [graphDefect, map_sub, Scheme.Modules.map_smul, smul_sub, smul_smul, app_res_xiS,
      ringRes_res_xiS]
    rw [hst', one_smul]
  constructor
  · intro h0
    rw [h0, smul_zero] at key
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 (hQ inf_le_left (nonempty_inter_xiS hV hW₁) (key.trans (map_zero _).symm))
  · intro h0
    rw [h0, sub_self, map_zero] at key
    calc graphDefect pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V s
        = (rXiR h1 σ * rXiR (inf_le_right : V ⊓ W₁ ≤ W₁) t) • graphDefect pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V s := by
          rw [hst', one_smul]
      _ = rXiR (inf_le_right : V ⊓ W₁ ≤ W₁) t • (rXiR h1 σ • graphDefect pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V s) := by
          rw [mul_comm, mul_smul]
      _ = 0 := by rw [← key, smul_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.lc_zeroFrameAlgXiG
statement:
theorem lc_zeroFrameAlgXiG (c : nA ⊕ nB → R) :
    Fintype.linearCombination R (zeroFrameAlgXiG i₁ i₂ σ sA sB qB) c =
      i₁ (Fintype.linearCombination R (Sum.elim sA sB)
          (Sum.elim (c ∘ Sum.inl) (σ • (c ∘ Sum.inr)))) +
        i₂ (Fintype.linearCombination R (Sum.elim qB qC) (Sum.elim (c ∘ Sum.inr) 0))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Fintype.linearCombination_apply, Fintype.sum_sum_type, zeroFrameAlgXiG, Sum.elim_inl,
    Sum.elim_inr, Function.comp_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.zero_apply, zero_smul,
    Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero, map_add, map_sum, map_smul, smul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    smul_eq_mul, mul_smul]
  simp only [smul_comm σ (c _)]
  abel

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.delta_lc_zeroFrameAlgXiG
statement:
theorem delta_lc_zeroFrameAlgXiG (d : PP →ₗ[R] QQ) (hA : ∀ i, d (sA i) = 0)
    (hB : ∀ k, d (sB k) = qB k) (α : nA ⊕ nB → R) :
    d (Fintype.linearCombination R (Sum.elim sA sB) α) =
      Fintype.linearCombination R (Sum.elim qB qC) (Sum.elim (α ∘ Sum.inr) 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Fintype.linearCombination_apply, Fintype.sum_sum_type, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr,
    Function.comp_apply, Pi.zero_apply, zero_smul, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero, map_add,
    map_sum, map_smul, hA, hB, smul_zero, zero_add]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.zeroFrameAlgXiG_spec
statement:
theorem zeroFrameAlgXiG_spec [IsDomain R] (p₁ : GG →ₗ[R] PP) (p₂ : GG →ₗ[R] QQ)
    (d : PP →ₗ[R] QQ) (hσ : σ ≠ 0)
    (hb1 : ∀ x, p₁ (i₁ x) = x) (hb2 : ∀ y, p₂ (i₂ y) = y) (hb12 : ∀ x, p₂ (i₁ x) = 0)
    (hb21 : ∀ y, p₁ (i₂ y) = 0) (hsplit : ∀ g, i₁ (p₁ g) + i₂ (p₂ g) = g)
    (hP : Function.Bijective (Fintype.linearCombination R (Sum.elim sA sB)))
    (hQ : Function.Bijective (Fintype.linearCombination R (Sum.elim qB qC)))
    (hA : ∀ i, d (sA i) = 0) (hB : ∀ k, d (sB k) = qB k) :
    Function.Injective (Fintype.linearCombination R (zeroFrameAlgXiG i₁ i₂ σ sA sB qB)) ∧
      ∀ g, σ • p₂ g = d (p₁ g) →
        ∃ c, Fintype.linearCombination R (zeroFrameAlgXiG i₁ i₂ σ sA sB qB) c = g
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro c hc
    rw [lc_zeroFrameAlgXiG i₁ i₂ σ sA sB qB qC] at hc
    have h2 := congrArg p₂ hc
    rw [map_add, hb12, hb2, zero_add, map_zero] at h2
    have h2' := hQ.1 (h2.trans (map_zero _).symm)
    have h1 := congrArg p₁ hc
    rw [map_add, hb1, hb21, add_zero, map_zero] at h1
    have h1' := hP.1 (h1.trans (map_zero _).symm)
    funext x
    cases x with
    | inl i => exact congrFun h1' (Sum.inl i)
    | inr k => exact congrFun h2' (Sum.inl k)
  · intro g hg
    obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := hP.2 (p₁ g)
    obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := hQ.2 (p₂ g)
    have heq : Fintype.linearCombination R (Sum.elim qB qC) (σ • γ) =
        Fintype.linearCombination R (Sum.elim qB qC) (Sum.elim (α ∘ Sum.inr) 0) := by
      rw [map_smul, hγ, hg, ← hα, delta_lc_zeroFrameAlgXiG sA sB qB qC d hA hB]
    have heq' := hQ.1 heq
    have hγC : ∀ l, γ (Sum.inr l) = 0 := fun l => by
      have := congrFun heq' (Sum.inr l)
      simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Sum.elim_inr, Pi.zero_apply] at this
      exact (mul_eq_zero.1 this).resolve_left hσ
    have hαB : ∀ k, α (Sum.inr k) = σ * γ (Sum.inl k) := fun k => by
      have := congrFun heq' (Sum.inl k)
      simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Sum.elim_inl, Function.comp_apply] at this
      exact this.symm
    refine ⟨Sum.elim (α ∘ Sum.inl) (γ ∘ Sum.inl), ?_⟩
    rw [lc_zeroFrameAlgXiG i₁ i₂ σ sA sB qB qC]
    have e1 : Sum.elim (Sum.elim (α ∘ Sum.inl) (γ ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl)
        (σ • (Sum.elim (α ∘ Sum.inl) (γ ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr)) = α := by
      funext x
      cases x with
      | inl i => rfl
      | inr k => exact (hαB k).symm
    have e2 : Sum.elim (Sum.elim (α ∘ Sum.inl) (γ ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr) 0 = γ := by
      funext x
      cases x with
      | inl k => rfl
      | inr l => exact (hγC l).symm
    rw [e1, e2, hα, hγ, hsplit]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.secRes_zeroFrameAmbXiG
statement:
theorem secRes_zeroFrameAmbXiG {T V : Y.Opens} (hT : T ≤ W₀) (h : V ≤ T) (sA : nA → Γ(P, T))
    (sB : nB → Γ(P, T)) (qB : nB → Γ(Q, T)) :
    secResXiR G h (zeroFrameAmbXiG (in₁ := in₁) (in₂ := in₂) W₀ σ hT sA sB qB) =
      zeroFrameAmbXiG (in₁ := in₁) (in₂ := in₂) W₀ σ (h.trans hT) (secResXiR P h sA)
        (secResXiR P h sB) (secResXiR Q h qB)
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  cases x with
  | inl i => exact app_res_xiR in₁ h (sA i) |>.symm
  | inr k =>
    simp only [secResXiR, zeroFrameAmbXiG, zeroFrameAlgXiG, Sum.elim_inr, appLinXiG,
      LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, map_add, Scheme.Modules.map_smul, app_res_xiR,
      ringRes_res_xiS]

proof:
:= by
  funext x
  cases x <;> rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.genGraph_zeroFrameAmbXiG
statement:
theorem genGraph_zeroFrameAmbXiG (hb : BiprodXiR pr₁ pr₂ in₁ in₂) (hQ : ResInjXiG Q)
    (hW₁ : (W₁ : Set Y).Nonempty)
    (hst : ∀ {V : Y.Opens} (h0 : V ≤ W₀) (h1 : V ≤ W₁), rXiR h0 σ * rXiR h1 t = 1)
    {T : Y.Opens} (hT : T ≤ W₀) (sA : nA → Γ(P, T)) (sB : nB → Γ(P, T)) (qB : nB → Γ(Q, T))
    (hA : ∀ i, δ.app T (sA i) = 0) (hB : ∀ k, δ.app T (sB k) = qB k) (c : nA ⊕ nB) :
    GenGraph pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t T (zeroFrameAmbXiG (in₁ := in₁) (in₂ := in₂) W₀ σ hT sA sB qB c)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hTn : (T : Set Y).Nonempty
  · rw [genGraph_iff_of_le_chartZero_xiG δ W₁ t hQ hW₁ W₀ σ hst hT hTn]
    cases c with
    | inl i =>
      simp only [zeroFrameAmbXiG, zeroFrameAlgXiG, Sum.elim_inl, appLinXiG, LinearMap.coe_mk,
        AddHom.coe_mk]
      rw [hb.pr₂_in₁, hb.pr₁_in₁, hA, smul_zero]
    | inr k =>
      simp only [zeroFrameAmbXiG, zeroFrameAlgXiG, Sum.elim_inr, appLinXiG, LinearMap.coe_mk,
        AddHom.coe_mk]
      rw [map_add, map_add, Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul, Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul, hb.pr₂_in₁,
        hb.pr₂_in₂, hb.pr₁_in₁, hb.pr₁_in₂, smul_zero, zero_add, add_zero,
        Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul, hB]
  · intro hTn'
    exact absurd hTn' hTn

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.genericGraphι_zeroFrameXiG
statement:
theorem genericGraphι_zeroFrameXiG (hb : BiprodXiR pr₁ pr₂ in₁ in₂) (hQ : ResInjXiG Q)
    (hW₁ : (W₁ : Set Y).Nonempty)
    (hst : ∀ {V : Y.Opens} (h0 : V ≤ W₀) (h1 : V ≤ W₁), rXiR h0 σ * rXiR h1 t = 1)

    (genericGraphι pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁).app T
        (zeroFrameXiG δ W₁ t W₀ σ hb hQ hW₁ hst hT sA sB qB hA hB c) =

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.isSecFrame_zeroFrameXiG
statement:
theorem isSecFrame_zeroFrameXiG [IsIntegral Y] (hb : BiprodXiR pr₁ pr₂ in₁ in₂)
    (hQ : ResInjXiG Q) (hW₁ : (W₁ : Set Y).Nonempty)
    (hst : ∀ {V : Y.Opens} (h0 : V ≤ W₀) (h1 : V ≤ W₁), rXiR h0 σ * rXiR h1 t = 1)
    {T : Y.Opens} (hT : T ≤ W₀) (sA : nA → Γ(P, T)) (sB : nB → Γ(P, T)) (qB : nB → Γ(Q, T))
    (qC : nC → Γ(Q, T)) (hPf : IsSecFrame P T (Sum.elim sA sB))
    (hQf : IsSecFrame Q T (Sum.elim qB qC))
    (hA : ∀ i, δ.app T (sA i) = 0) (hB : ∀ k, δ.app T (sB k) = qB k) :
    IsSecFrame (genericGraphSheaf pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁) T
      (zeroFrameXiG δ W₁ t W₀ σ hb hQ hW₁ hst hT sA sB qB hA hB)
proof:
:= by
  intro V h
  
  have hι : ∀ c, (genericGraphι pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁).app V (Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, V)
      (secResXiR _ h (zeroFrameXiG δ W₁ t W₀ σ hb hQ hW₁ hst hT sA sB qB hA hB)) c) =
      Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, V) (zeroFrameAlgXiG (appLinXiG in₁ V) (appLinXiG in₂ V)
        (rXiR (h.trans hT) σ) (secResXiR P h sA) (secResXiR P h sB) (secResXiR Q h qB)) c := by
    intro c
    rw [app_linearCombination_xiR]
    have e := secRes_zeroFrameAmbXiG (in₁ := in₁) (in₂ := in₂) W₀ σ hT h sA sB qB
    exact congrArg (fun f => Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, V) f c) e
  by_cases hV : (V : Set Y).Nonempty
  · haveI : Nonempty V := hV.to_subtype
    have hσ : rXiR (h.trans hT) σ ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have hne : ((V ⊓ W₁ : Y.Opens) : Set Y).Nonempty := nonempty_inter_xiS hV hW₁
      haveI : Nonempty (V ⊓ W₁ : Y.Opens) := hne.to_subtype
      have h1 := hst (inf_le_left.trans (h.trans hT) : V ⊓ W₁ ≤ W₀) (inf_le_right : V ⊓ W₁ ≤ W₁)
      rw [← rXiR_rXiR (h.trans hT) (inf_le_left : V ⊓ W₁ ≤ V) σ, h0, map_zero, zero_mul] at h1
      exact zero_ne_one h1
    have hA' : ∀ i, appLinXiG δ V (secResXiR P h sA i) = 0 := fun i => by
      change δ.app V (P.presheaf.map _ (sA i)) = 0
      rw [app_res_xiR, hA, map_zero]
    have hB' : ∀ k, appLinXiG δ V (secResXiR P h sB k) = secResXiR Q h qB k := fun k => by
      change δ.app V (P.presheaf.map _ (sB k)) = _
      rw [app_res_xiR, hB]
      rfl
    have hP' := hPf V h
    have hQ' := hQf V h
    rw [secRes_sumElim_xiG] at hP' hQ'
    obtain ⟨hinj, hsurj⟩ := zeroFrameAlgXiG_spec (appLinXiG in₁ V) (appLinXiG in₂ V)
      (rXiR (h.trans hT) σ) (secResXiR P h sA) (secResXiR P h sB) (secResXiR Q h qB)
      (secResXiR Q h qC) (appLinXiG pr₁ V) (appLinXiG pr₂ V) (appLinXiG δ V) hσ
      (hb.pr₁_in₁ V) (hb.pr₂_in₂ V) (hb.pr₂_in₁ V) (hb.pr₁_in₂ V) (hb.split V) hP' hQ' hA' hB'
    constructor
    · intro c c' hcc
      apply hinj
      rw [← hι, ← hι, hcc]
    · intro x
      have hx := (genGraph_iff_of_le_chartZero_xiG δ W₁ t hQ hW₁ W₀ σ hst (h.trans hT) hV x.1).1
        x.2
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hsurj x.1 hx
      refine ⟨c, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
      exact (hι c).trans hc
  · haveI := subsingleton_modSections_xiG (L := genericGraphSheaf pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁) V hV
    haveI : Subsingleton Γ(Y, V) := by
      have : V = ⊥ := by
        ext x
        simp only [Opens.coe_bot, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
        exact fun hx => hV ⟨x, hx⟩
      subst this
      infer_instance
    exact ⟨fun a b _ => Subsingleton.elim a b, fun e => ⟨0, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩⟩

theorem isIso_pullback_map_comp_xiG {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (a : X ⟶ Y) (ι : Y ⟶ Z)

statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.xi_sections_chartOne_iff (j : ℕ) {V : (C.graphModel (k := k)).Opens}
    (h : V ≤ xiOpen (k := k) C) (hV : (V : Set (C.graphModel (k := k))).Nonempty)
    (s : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).obj (C.K.E j ⊞ C.tgt j), V)) :
    (∃ x : Γ(C.xi j, V), (C.xiι j).app V x = s) ↔
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).map biprod.snd).app V s =
        rXiR h (xiCoord C) • ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).map (C.dj j)).app V
          (((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).map biprod.fst).app V s)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.sW_mul_xiCoord
statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.sW_mul_xiCoord {V : (C.graphModel (k := k)).Opens}
    (h0 : V ≤ graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 0).1)
    (h1 : V ≤ xiOpen (k := k) C) :
    rXiR h0 (sW (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) * rXiR h1 (xiCoord C) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hO : V ≤ graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex ⁻¹ᵁ overlapOpen k := le_inf h0 h1
  have key : ∀ (j : Fin 2) (c : Γ(P1 k, (chartOpen k j).1)) (hle : overlapOpen k ≤ (chartOpen k j).1)
      (hj : V ≤ graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k j).1),
      rXiR hj ((graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex).app _ c) =
        rXiR hO ((graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex).app _
          ((P1 k).presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op c)) := by
    intro j c hle hj
    change ((graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex).app _ ≫
        (C.graphModel (k := k)).presheaf.map (homOfLE hj).op) c =
      ((P1 k).presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op ≫ (graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex).app _ ≫
        (C.graphModel (k := k)).presheaf.map (homOfLE hO).op) c
    rw [← Category.assoc, Scheme.Hom.naturality, Category.assoc,
      ← (C.graphModel (k := k)).presheaf.map_comp]
    rfl
  calc rXiR h0 (sW (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) * rXiR h1 (xiCoord C)
      = rXiR hO ((graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex).app _
            ((P1 k).presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : overlapOpen k ≤ (chartOpen k 0).1)).op
              (sP1 k))) *
          rXiR hO ((graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex).app _
            ((P1 k).presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : overlapOpen k ≤ (chartOpen k 1).1)).op
              (tP1 k))) :=
        congrArg₂ (· * ·) (key 0 (sP1 k) inf_le_left h0) (key 1 (tP1 k) inf_le_right h1)
    _ = 1 := by rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, sP1_mul_tP1, map_one, map_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.xi_sections_chartZero_iff
statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.xi_sections_chartZero_iff (j : ℕ) {V : (C.graphModel (k := k)).Opens}
    (h : V ≤ graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 0).1)
    (hV : (V : Set (C.graphModel (k := k))).Nonempty)
    (s : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).obj (C.K.E j ⊞ C.tgt j), V)) :
    (∃ x : Γ(C.xi j, V), (C.xiι j).app V x = s) ↔
      rXiR h (sW (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) •
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).map biprod.snd).app V s =
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).map (C.dj j)).app V
          (((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).map biprod.fst).app V s)
proof:

  rw [← genGraph_iff_of_le_chartZero_xiG _ _ _ (C.resInj_tgt j) (xiOpen_nonempty C) _ _
    (fun h0 h1 => C.sW_mul_xiCoord h0 h1) h hV]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.dj_zeroFrameData_eq_zero
statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.dj_zeroFrameData_eq_zero (j : ℕ) {V : M.Opens} {nA : Type u}

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.xiι_xiZeroFrame
statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.xiι_xiZeroFrame (j : ℕ) {V : M.Opens} {nA nB : Type u}

        (sW (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex)
        (inf_le_right : xiProj (k := k) C ⁻¹ᵁ V ⊓ xiOpenZero (k := k) C ≤ xiOpenZero (k := k) C)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.isSecFrame_xi_zeroFrame
statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.isSecFrame_xi_zeroFrame (j : ℕ) {V : M.Opens}
    {nA nB nC : Type u} [Fintype nA] [Fintype nB] [Fintype nC]
    (sA : nA → Γ(C.K.E j, V)) (sB : nB → Γ(C.K.E j, V)) (qB : nB → Γ(C.tgt j, V))
    (qC : nC → Γ(C.tgt j, V)) (hPf : IsSecFrame (C.K.E j) V (Sum.elim sA sB))
    (hQf : IsSecFrame (C.tgt j) V (Sum.elim qB qC))
    (hA : ∀ i, (C.dj j).app V (sA i) = 0) (hB : ∀ m, (C.dj j).app V (sB m) = qB m) :
    IsSecFrame (C.xi j) (xiProj (k := k) C ⁻¹ᵁ V ⊓ xiOpenZero (k := k) C)
      (C.xiZeroFrame j sA sB qB hA hB)
proof:
:= by
  have hA' := C.dj_zeroFrameData_eq_zero (k := k) j sA hA
  have hB' := C.dj_zeroFrameData_eq (k := k) j sB qB hB
  have hP' : IsSecFrame ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).obj (C.K.E j))
      (xiProj (k := k) C ⁻¹ᵁ V ⊓ xiOpenZero (k := k) C) (Sum.elim (C.zeroFrameData (k := k) j V sA) (C.zeroFrameData (k := k) j V sB)) := by
    have := (isSecFrame_pullback (xiProj (k := k) C) (C.K.E j) V hPf).mono
      (inf_le_left : xiProj (k := k) C ⁻¹ᵁ V ⊓ xiOpenZero (k := k) C ≤ _)
    rwa [pullSecXiR_sumElim, secRes_sumElim_xiG] at this
  have hQ' : IsSecFrame ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).obj (C.tgt j))
      (xiProj (k := k) C ⁻¹ᵁ V ⊓ xiOpenZero (k := k) C) (Sum.elim (C.zeroFrameTgt (k := k) j V qB) (C.zeroFrameTgt (k := k) j V qC)) := by
    have := (isSecFrame_pullback (xiProj (k := k) C) (C.tgt j) V hQf).mono
      (inf_le_left : xiProj (k := k) C ⁻¹ᵁ V ⊓ xiOpenZero (k := k) C ≤ _)
    rwa [pullSecXiR_sumElim, secRes_sumElim_xiG] at this
  exact isSecFrame_zeroFrameXiG _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hP' hQ' hA' hB'

theorem sec_extD_fst (j : ℕ) (V : M.Opens) (y : (C₁.K.E (j + 1) ⊞ C₂.K.E (j + 1)).val.obj (op V)) :
    sectionMap biprod.fst V (sectionMap (extD C₁ C₂ c j) V y) =

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.sec_hdd
statement:
theorem sec_hdd (j : ℕ) (V : M.Opens) (b : (C₂.K.E (j + 2)).val.obj (op V)) :
    sectionMap (C₁.K.d j) V (sectionMap (c.h (j + 1)) V b) =
      -sectionMap (c.h j) V (sectionMap (C₂.K.d (j + 1)) V b)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun φ ↦ sectionMap φ V b) (c.hdd j)
  change sectionMap (C₁.K.d j) V (sectionMap (c.h (j + 1)) V b) +
    sectionMap (c.h j) V (sectionMap (C₂.K.d (j + 1)) V b) = 0 at h
  exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.sectionExactOn_extComplex
statement:
theorem sectionExactOn_extComplex {U : M.Opens} (h₁ : C₁.SectionExactOn U)
    (h₂ : C₂.SectionExactOn U) : (extComplex C₁ C₂ c).SectionExactOn U
proof:
:= by
  intro V hV
  obtain ⟨s₁, e₁⟩ := h₁ V hV
  obtain ⟨s₂, e₂⟩ := h₂ V hV
  refine ⟨fun y ↦ ?_, fun j ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := s₂ (sectionMap biprod.snd V.1 y)
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := s₁ (sectionMap biprod.fst V.1 y - sectionMap (c.h 0) V.1 b)
    refine ⟨sectionMap biprod.inl V.1 a + sectionMap biprod.inr V.1 b, ?_⟩
    change sectionMap (extD C₁ C₂ c 0) V.1 _ = y
    refine sec_biprod_ext_g2trees V.1 _ _ ?_ ?_
    · rw [sec_extD_fst]
      erw [sec_fst_add_g2trees, sec_snd_add_g2trees]
      rw [ha, sub_add_cancel]
    · rw [sec_extD_snd]
      erw [sec_snd_add_g2trees]
      rw [hb]
  · intro y
    change sectionMap (extD C₁ C₂ c j) V.1 y = 0 ↔
      y ∈ Set.range (sectionMap (extD C₁ C₂ c (j + 1)) V.1)
    constructor
    · intro hy
      have hs : sectionMap (C₂.K.d j) V.1 (sectionMap biprod.snd V.1 y) = 0 := by
        rw [← sec_extD_snd, hy, map_zero]
      have hf : sectionMap (C₁.K.d j) V.1 (sectionMap biprod.fst V.1 y) +
          sectionMap (c.h j) V.1 (sectionMap biprod.snd V.1 y) = 0 := by
        rw [← sec_extD_fst, hy, map_zero]
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := ((e₂ j) _).1 hs
      have hf' : sectionMap (C₁.K.d j) V.1
          (sectionMap biprod.fst V.1 y - sectionMap (c.h (j + 1)) V.1 b) = 0 := by
        rw [map_sub, sec_hdd, hb, sub_neg_eq_add, hf]
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := ((e₁ j) _).1 hf'
      refine ⟨sectionMap biprod.inl V.1 a + sectionMap biprod.inr V.1 b, ?_⟩
      refine sec_biprod_ext_g2trees V.1 _ _ ?_ ?_
      · rw [sec_extD_fst]
        erw [sec_fst_add_g2trees, sec_snd_add_g2trees]
        rw [ha, sub_add_cancel]
      · rw [sec_extD_snd]
        erw [sec_snd_add_g2trees]
        rw [hb]
    · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
      have hdd := congrArg (fun φ ↦ sectionMap φ V.1 x) (extD_dd C₁ C₂ c j)
      exact hdd.trans (sectionMap_zero_g2tbiva _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegularComparison.Generic.lineSc_toBase
statement: theorem lineSc_toBase (c : k) : lineSc Y k φk c ≫ DeformationSpace.toBase Y ⊥ = 𝟙 Y
proof:
:= by
  have h2 := RelativeSpec.Hom.map_toBase (RelativeSpec.quotientHom
    (DeformationSpace.algebraData Y ⊥) _ (DeformationSpace.lineHom_bot_compat Y k φk c))
  unfold lineSc
  rw [Category.assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegularComparison.Generic.ker_fibreιGlobal_ne_bot
statement:
theorem ker_fibreιGlobal_ne_bot [Nonempty J.subscheme] (c : k) :
    (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk c).ker ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk c) :=
    MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (fibre_isPullback_P1Global Y J k φk c) inferInstance
  intro hb
  haveI : IsIso (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk c) := IsClosedImmersion.isIso_iff_ker_eq_bot.mpr hb
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_W_not_mem_lineT Y J
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk c).surjective (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J w)
  exact hw (range_fibreιGlobal_subset Y J k φk c ⟨y, hy⟩)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegularComparison.Generic.generic_W_not_mem_fibre

theorem generic_W_not_mem_fibre [IsIntegral J.subscheme] (c : k) :
    haveI
proof:
:= IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_subschemeTotalGlobal Y J
    subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J (genericPoint (subschemeTotalGlobal Y J)) ∉
      Set.range (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk c) := by
  haveI := IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_subschemeTotalGlobal Y J
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk c) :=
    MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (fibre_isPullback_P1Global Y J k φk c) inferInstance
  intro h
  have hsub := RegDeform.range_subset_of_generic (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) _
    (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk c).isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range h
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_W_not_mem_lineT Y J
  exact hw (range_fibreιGlobal_subset Y J k φk c (hsub ⟨w, rfl⟩))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegularComparison.Generic.fst_pr_comp_fibreCLift
statement:
theorem fst_pr_comp_fibreCLift (c : k) :
    (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk c) ≫
      totalToClosedBase Y J) ≫ fibreCLift Y J k φk c = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  have hS : lineSc Y k φk c ≫ DeformationSpace.toBase Y ⊥ = 𝟙 Y := lineSc_toBase Y k φk c
  apply pullback.hom_ext
  · have hsq := isPullback_lineTι_subschemeTotal Y J
    let P := pullback (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk c)
    let h' : P ⟶ subschemeUGlobal Y J := hsq.lift
      (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk c))
      (pullback.snd (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk c) ≫ lineSc Y k φk c) (by
        rw [pullback.condition, Category.assoc, ← fibreιGlobal_eq])
    have h1 : h' ≫ subschemeTιGlobal Y J =
        pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk c) :=
      hsq.lift_fst _ _ _
    have h2 : h' ≫ subschemeToLineGlobal Y J =
        pullback.snd (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk c) ≫ lineSc Y k φk c :=
      hsq.lift_snd _ _ _
    have hsl := isPullback_subschemeLine Y J
    have key : h' ≫ polynomialToClosedBase Y J ≫ subSc Y J k φk c = h' := by
      apply hsl.hom_ext
      · simp only [Category.assoc, subSc_subschemeToLine]
        rw [← reassoc_of% hsl.w, reassoc_of% h2, reassoc_of% hS, h2]
      · simp only [Category.assoc, subSc_polynomialToClosedBase, Category.comp_id]
    simp only [Category.assoc, fibreCLift, pullback.lift_fst, Category.id_comp]
    rw [← h1]
    simp only [secC, Category.assoc, subschemeTι_totalToClosedBase_assoc]
    rw [← Category.assoc (polynomialToClosedBase Y J), ← Category.assoc h', ← Category.assoc h',
      Category.assoc h', key]
  · simp only [Category.assoc, fibreCLift, pullback.lift_snd, Category.id_comp]
    rw [totalToClosedBase_subschemeι, pullback.condition_assoc, fibreιGlobal_toBase,
      Category.comp_id]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegularComparison.Generic.mono_ap_of_iso
statement:
theorem mono_ap_of_iso {Y : Scheme.{u}} (T : Y.Modules ⥤ Y.Modules) (s : T ⟶ 𝟭 Y.Modules)
    {A B : Y.Modules} (e : A ≅ B) [Mono (ap T s B)] : Mono (ap T s A)
proof:
:= by
  have hn : T.map e.hom ≫ ap T s B = ap T s A ≫ e.hom := s.naturality e.hom
  have : ap T s A = T.map e.hom ≫ ap T s B ≫ e.inv := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, hn, Category.assoc, e.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegularComparison.Generic.restrictSection_eq

        (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf (sigma1 (k := k) N i)).subschemeι ≫
        totalToClosedBase (space k N) i.ker) ≫

      i.ker.subschemeι ≫ kappa N i

  let ℓ : i.ker.subscheme ⟶ pullback (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k N) i.ker)
      (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf (sigma1 (k := k) N i)).subschemeι :=
    pullback.lift (secC (space k N) i.ker k (canonφA (k := k)) 1) (i.ker.subschemeι ≫ kappa N i)
      (by rw [secC_F, Category.assoc, kappa_fac])
  have hℓ : ℓ ≫ (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k N) i.ker)
      (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf (sigma1 (k := k) N i)).subschemeι ≫
        totalToClosedBase (space k N) i.ker) = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, pullback.lift_fst, secC_pr]
  rw [IsIso.inv_eq_of_inv_hom_id hℓ, pullback.lift_snd]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.c1CapPrimeCoeff_genericPoint_eq_ord
statement:
theorem c1CapPrimeCoeff_genericPoint_eq_ord (a : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (x : X)
    (hx : coheight x = 1) (ha : a x ≠ 0) :
    C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a (genericPoint X) x =
      X.ord (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField (a x)) x
proof:
:= by
  have h : genericPoint X ⤳ x := genericPoint_specializes x
  have hP := stalkPrime_genericPoint_eq_bot x h
  let e : (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h) ≃+* X.presheaf.stalk x :=
    (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hP).trans (RingEquiv.quotientBot _)
  have hdim : ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h) = 1 := by
    rw [ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv e, ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight, hx]
    rfl
  unfold C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff
  rw [dif_pos h, if_pos hdim, ← CartierIntersection.ord_stalk_toNat_eq_ord hx _ ha]
  unfold CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity
  rw [← LocalOrdSymmetry.ord_ringEquiv e]
  rfl

  have hdim : ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h) ≠ 1 := by
    rw [ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv e, ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.ker_stalkMap_eq_span_eqOfSection
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_eq_span_eqOfSection (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (ι : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι]
    (hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = ι.ker) (z : Z) :
    RingHom.ker (ι.stalkMap z).hom =
      Ideal.span {eqOfSection L hL (E26.sectionOfHom σ) (ι z)}
proof:
:= by
  haveI : L.IsLocallyFree := hL.isFiniteLocallyFree.isLocallyFree
  haveI : L.IsFinitePresentation := IsFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation X hL.isFiniteLocallyFree
  set d := wFrameAt L hL (ι z)
  obtain ⟨U', hzU, hUd⟩ := GraphModel.exists_affine_le d.U d.mem
  rw [E27.ker_stalkMap_eq_map_germ_ker ι U' z hzU, ← hid,
    E27.sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_ideal_eq_span σ d U' hUd, Ideal.map_span,
    Set.image_singleton]
  congr 2
  exact X.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE hUd) (ι z) hzU _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.eqOfSection_ne_zero
statement:
theorem eqOfSection_ne_zero (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L)
    (ι : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι] (hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = ι.ker)
    (hgen : genericPoint X ∉ Set.range ι) (x : X) :
    eqOfSection L hL (E26.sectionOfHom σ) x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI : L.IsLocallyFree := hL.isFiniteLocallyFree.isLocallyFree
  haveI : L.IsFinitePresentation := IsFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation X hL.isFiniteLocallyFree
  set d := wFrameAt L hL x
  have hη : genericPoint X ∈ d.U :=
    (genericPoint_specializes x).mem_open d.U.isOpen d.mem
  let dη : WFrame L (genericPoint X) := ⟨d.U, hη, d.frame⟩
  have hsupp : genericPoint X ∉ (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).support := by
    rw [hid]
    exact E26.notMem_support_ker ι _ hgen
  have hu := E26.wCoord_isUnit_of_notMem_support σ (genericPoint X) hsupp dη
  intro h0
  haveI : Nonempty d.U := ⟨⟨x, d.mem⟩⟩
  have h1 : algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField
      (X.presheaf.germ d.U x d.mem (wCoord d (E26.sectionOfHom σ))) = 0 := by
    change algebraMap _ _ (eqOfSection L hL (E26.sectionOfHom σ) x) = 0
    rw [h0, map_zero]
  rw [Scheme.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField] at h1
  apply hu.ne_zero
  exact h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_pushFund
statement:
theorem c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_pushFund [IsNoetherian X] (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (ι : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι]
    (hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = ι.ker) (hgen : genericPoint X ∉ Set.range ι) (x : X) :
    C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (eqOfSection L hL (E26.sectionOfHom σ)) (genericPoint X) x =
      properPushforward ι (fundamentalCycle Z) x
proof:
:= by
  have hloc : ∀ z : Z, ∃ a : X.presheaf.stalk (ι z), a ≠ 0 ∧
      RingHom.ker (ι.stalkMap z).hom = Ideal.span {a} := fun z ↦
    ⟨_, eqOfSection_ne_zero hL σ ι hid hgen (ι z), ker_stalkMap_eq_span_eqOfSection hL σ ι hid z⟩
  by_cases hx1 : coheight x = 1
  · by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.range ι
    · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hx
      rw [c1CapPrimeCoeff_genericPoint_eq_ord _ _ hx1 (eqOfSection_ne_zero hL σ ι hid hgen _),
        WDiv.pushFund_apply_eq_div ι z hx1 _ (eqOfSection_ne_zero hL σ ι hid hgen _)
          (ker_stalkMap_eq_span_eqOfSection hL σ ι hid z), div_eq_ord]
    · haveI : L.IsLocallyFree := hL.isFiniteLocallyFree.isLocallyFree
      haveI : L.IsFinitePresentation :=
        IsFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation X hL.isFiniteLocallyFree
      have hsupp : x ∉ (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).support := by
        rw [hid]
        exact E26.notMem_support_ker ι _ hx
      rw [G2T2C.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_isUnit _ _ _
        (E26.wCoord_isUnit_of_notMem_support σ x hsupp _)]
      exact (WDiv.pushFund_apply_notRange ι x hx).symm
  · rw [c1CapPrimeCoeff_genericPoint_eq_zero _ _ hx1,
      WDiv.pushFund_apply_eq_zero_of_coheight_ne ι hloc x hx1]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.genericPoint_not_mem_infSupport
statement:

  rw [infDivisor, Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_comap]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.lambdaCycleEq_p1
statement:
theorem lambdaCycleEq_p1 (c₀ : k)
    (hιY : Set.range ιY = graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex ⁻¹'
      (RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.S)
    {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)) :
    LambdaCycleEq (k := k) C (RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap
      (graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) ιY hιY hM
proof:
:= by
  set pc' := (RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap
  set gl := graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex
  haveI := GraphModel.isNoetherian_subscheme (infDivisor (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex)
  
  have hcoef : ∀ x, (pfClosed ιY (n + 1) (G2XLBC.lbRep (k := k) ιY (pc'.W gl) (pc'.hW gl ιY hιY)
      (pc'.t gl) (n + 1) (fundW (k := k) C hM))).1 x =
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (eqOfSection (pc'.L gl) (pc'.hL gl) (pc'.s gl))
        (genericPoint (C.graphModel (k := k))) x := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.range ιY
    · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
      rw [pfClosed_apply_self, G2XLBC.lbRep_apply (k := k) ιY (pc'.W gl) (pc'.hW gl ιY hιY)
        (pc'.t gl) (pc'.principalOn gl)]
      exact G2TEXC.c1CapCyclesCoeff_dimPrimeCycle _ _ _ _
    · rw [pfClosed_apply_of_not_mem _ _ _ x hx, G2T2C.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_isUnit]
      by_contra hu
      exact hx (((pc'.isSupport gl ιY hιY) x).mpr hu)
  
  have hs : pc'.s gl = E26.sectionOfHom (KDGb.pullbackSec gl (RegDeform.p1σi k c₀)) :=
    (KDGb.pullbackSec_app_one gl (RegDeform.p1σi k c₀) ⊤).symm
  have hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf (KDGb.pullbackSec gl (RegDeform.p1σi k c₀)) =
      (infDivisor (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex).subschemeι.ker := by
    rw [KDGb.sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_pullbackSec (RegDeform.p1Line_rank k c₀),
      RegDeform.p1σi_ker, Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_subschemeι]
    rfl
  have hgen : genericPoint (C.graphModel (k := k)) ∉
      Set.range (infDivisor (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex).subschemeι := by
    rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.range_subschemeι]
    exact genericPoint_not_mem_infSupport (k := k) C
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext x
  rw [hcoef, hs]
  exact c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_pushFund (pc'.hL gl) _ _ hid hgen x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.specialization_core_p1
statement:
theorem specialization_core_p1 :
    haveI
proof:
:= isProper_interSnd_g2tbiv (k := k) ιZ ιY
    lChow (k := k) C ι U hC hU (interSnd ιZ ιY ≫ ιY)
        (dichotomy_J (k := k) C ι U hC hU hX ιZ ιY (infSupport_of_lambda (k := k) C c₀ ιY hιY)) n
      (G2T2C.gysinCycles (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ιZ).obj
          ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.L (graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex)))
        (G2T2C.hasConstantRank_restrict _ ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.hL _) ιZ)
        (wPullbackSection ιZ ((RegDeform.p1Pencil k c₀).swap.s
          (graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.exists_lift_aux
statement:
theorem exists_lift_aux (dA : A₁ →ₗ[R] A₀) (dA' : A₂ →ₗ[R] A₁) (dB : B₁ →ₗ[R] B₀)
    (dB' : B₂ →ₗ[R] B₁) (φ₀ : A₀ →ₗ[R] B₀) (φ₁ : A₁ →ₗ[R] B₁) (φ₂ : A₂ →ₗ[R] B₂)
    (hφ₂ : Function.Surjective φ₂) (κ : K₁ →ₗ[R] A₁) (hκ : Function.Exact κ φ₁)
    (h₀ : ∀ a, φ₀ (dA a) = dB (φ₁ a)) (h₁ : ∀ a, φ₁ (dA' a) = dB' (φ₂ a))
    (hB : Function.Exact dB' dB) (hAA : ∀ a, dA (dA' a) = 0) (a : A₀) (ha0 : φ₀ a = 0)
    (y : A₁) (hy : dA y = a) : ∃ k, dA (κ k) = a
proof:
:= by
  have hdy : dB (φ₁ y) = 0 := by rw [← h₀, hy, ha0]
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (hB _).1 hdy
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hφ₂ z
  have hker : φ₁ (y - dA' w) = 0 := by rw [map_sub, h₁, hz, sub_self]
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (hκ _).1 hker
  exact ⟨k, by rw [hk, map_sub, hAA, sub_zero, hy]⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.resolution_sections_exact
statement:
theorem resolution_sections_exact {K : _root_.SingTau.BundleComplex M} {G : M.Modules}
    (R : _root_.SingTau.ResolutionData (IsCoherentLike M) K G) (V : M.affineOpens) :
    (∀ a, sectionMap R.ε V.1 a = 0 → ∃ y, sectionMap (K.d 0) V.1 y = a) ∧
      ∀ j, Function.Exact (sectionMap (K.d (j + 1)) V.1) (sectionMap (K.d j) V.1)
proof:
:= by
  have qE : ∀ j, (K.E j).IsQuasicoherent := fun j => isQuasicoherent_of_bundle_g2tbivr (K.hE j)
  have qZ : ∀ j, (R.Z j).IsQuasicoherent := fun j => by
    haveI : (R.Z j).IsFinitePresentation := R.hZ j
    infer_instance
  have hs : ∀ j, Function.Injective (sectionMap (R.ι j) V.1) ∧
      Function.Exact (sectionMap (R.ι j) V.1) (sectionMap (R.p j) V.1) ∧
      Function.Surjective (sectionMap (R.p j) V.1) := fun j => by
    haveI := qE j
    haveI := qZ j
    haveI := qZ (j + 1)
    exact sections_SES_of_affine (R.ses j) V
  have hd : ∀ j (y : (K.E (j + 1)).val.obj (op V.1)),
      sectionMap (K.d j) V.1 y = sectionMap (R.ι j) V.1 (sectionMap (R.p (j + 1)) V.1 y) :=
    fun j y => by rw [R.fac j, sectionMap_comp_apply]
  refine ⟨fun a ha => ?_, fun j y => ?_⟩
  · have ha' : sectionMap R.e.hom V.1 (sectionMap (R.p 0) V.1 a) = 0 := ha
    have hp : sectionMap (R.p 0) V.1 a = 0 :=
      sectionMap_injective_of_iso R.e V.1 (by rw [ha', map_zero])
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := ((hs 0).2.1 a).1 hp
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (hs 1).2.2 z
    exact ⟨x, by rw [hd, hz]⟩
  · rw [hd]
    constructor
    · intro h0
      have h1 : sectionMap (R.p (j + 1)) V.1 y = 0 :=
        (hs j).1 (by rw [h0, map_zero])
      obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := ((hs (j + 1)).2.1 y).1 h1
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (hs (j + 2)).2.2 z
      exact ⟨x, hd (j + 1) x⟩
    · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
      rw [hd (j + 1) x, ((hs (j + 1)).2.1 _).2 ⟨_, rfl⟩, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.kerComplex_sectionExactOn_top
statement:
theorem kerComplex_sectionExactOn_top [IsLocallyNoetherian M] [ConnectedSpace M]
    (hcov : PerfectRepG2.Sch.HasBundleCovers M) (hepi : ∀ j, Epi (φ j)) {G : M.Modules}
    (R₃ : _root_.SingTau.ResolutionData (IsCoherentLike M) K₃ G)
    (R₁ : _root_.SingTau.ResolutionData (IsCoherentLike M) K₁ G) (hε : φ 0 ≫ R₁.ε = R₃.ε) :
    (RankedBundleComplex.ofConnected (kerComplex φ hφ hcov hepi)).SectionExactOn ⊤
proof:
:= by
  intro V _
  have hsK : ∀ j, Function.Injective (sectionMap (kernel.ι (φ j)) V.1) ∧
      Function.Exact (sectionMap (kernel.ι (φ j)) V.1) (sectionMap (φ j) V.1) ∧
      Function.Surjective (sectionMap (φ j) V.1) := fun j => by
    haveI : (kernel (φ j)).IsQuasicoherent :=
      isQuasicoherent_of_bundle_g2tbivr ((kerComplex φ hφ hcov hepi).hE j)
    haveI := isQuasicoherent_of_bundle_g2tbivr (K₃.hE j)
    haveI := isQuasicoherent_of_bundle_g2tbivr (K₁.hE j)
    exact sections_SES_of_affine (kerComplex_ses φ hepi j) V
  have h3 := resolution_sections_exact R₃ V
  have h1 := resolution_sections_exact R₁ V
  have hcomm : ∀ j y, sectionMap (φ j) V.1 (sectionMap (K₃.d j) V.1 y) =
      sectionMap (K₁.d j) V.1 (sectionMap (φ (j + 1)) V.1 y) := fun j y => by
    rw [← sectionMap_comp_apply, hφ, sectionMap_comp_apply]
  have hιd : ∀ j x, sectionMap (kernel.ι (φ j)) V.1 (sectionMap (kerD φ hφ j) V.1 x) =
      sectionMap (K₃.d j) V.1 (sectionMap (kernel.ι (φ (j + 1))) V.1 x) := fun j x => by
    rw [← sectionMap_comp_apply, kerD_ι, sectionMap_comp_apply]
  have hdd3 : ∀ j y, sectionMap (K₃.d j) V.1 (sectionMap (K₃.d (j + 1)) V.1 y) = 0 :=
    fun j y => (congrArg (fun f => sectionMap f V.1 y) (K₃.dd j)).trans
      (sectionMap_zero_apply_g2tbivr _ _ _ _)
  have hφι : ∀ j x, sectionMap (φ j) V.1 (sectionMap (kernel.ι (φ j)) V.1 x) = 0 :=
    fun j x => (congrArg (fun f => sectionMap f V.1 x) (kernel.condition (φ j))).trans
      (sectionMap_zero_apply_g2tbivr _ _ _ _)
  refine ⟨fun x => ?_, fun j x => ?_⟩
  · have hεa : sectionMap R₃.ε V.1 (sectionMap (kernel.ι (φ 0)) V.1 x) = 0 := by
      rw [← hε, sectionMap_comp_apply, hφι 0 x, map_zero]
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h3.1 _ hεa
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_lift_aux (sectionMap (K₃.d 0) V.1) (sectionMap (K₃.d 1) V.1)
      (sectionMap (K₁.d 0) V.1) (sectionMap (K₁.d 1) V.1) (sectionMap (φ 0) V.1)
      (sectionMap (φ 1) V.1) (sectionMap (φ 2) V.1) (hsK 2).2.2
      (sectionMap (kernel.ι (φ 1)) V.1) (hsK 1).2.1 (hcomm 0) (hcomm 1) (h1.2 0) (hdd3 0) _
      (hφι 0 x) y hy
    refine ⟨k, (hsK 0).1 ?_⟩
    change sectionMap (kernel.ι (φ 0)) V.1 (sectionMap (kerD φ hφ 0) V.1 k) = _
    rw [hιd, hk]
  · constructor
    · intro hx
      have hx' : sectionMap (kerD φ hφ j) V.1 x = 0 := hx
      have hda : sectionMap (K₃.d j) V.1 (sectionMap (kernel.ι (φ (j + 1))) V.1 x) = 0 := by
        rw [← hιd, hx', map_zero]
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := ((h3.2 j) _).1 hda
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_lift_aux (sectionMap (K₃.d (j + 1)) V.1)
        (sectionMap (K₃.d (j + 2)) V.1) (sectionMap (K₁.d (j + 1)) V.1)
        (sectionMap (K₁.d (j + 2)) V.1) (sectionMap (φ (j + 1)) V.1)
        (sectionMap (φ (j + 2)) V.1) (sectionMap (φ (j + 3)) V.1) (hsK (j + 3)).2.2
        (sectionMap (kernel.ι (φ (j + 2))) V.1) (hsK (j + 2)).2.1 (hcomm (j + 1)) (hcomm (j + 2))
        (h1.2 (j + 1)) (hdd3 (j + 1)) _ (hφι (j + 1) x) y hy
      refine ⟨k, (hsK (j + 1)).1 ?_⟩
      change sectionMap (kernel.ι (φ (j + 1))) V.1 (sectionMap (kerD φ hφ (j + 1)) V.1 k) = _
      rw [hιd, hk]
    · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
      exact (congrArg (fun f => sectionMap f V.1 k) (kerD_comp φ hφ j)).trans
        (sectionMap_zero_apply_g2tbivr _ _ _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.ratFn_ne_algebraMap_gammaPt
statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.ratFn_ne_algebraMap_gammaPt [IsIntegral (C.graphModel (k := k))]
    [IsNoetherian (C.graphModel (k := k))] {y : C.graphModel (k := k)}
    (hy : y = C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU) (x : (C.graphModel (k := k)).presheaf.stalk y) :
    algebraMap _ (C.graphModel (k := k)).functionField x ≠ ratFn (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex
proof:
:= by
  subst hy
  intro hx
  have hsupp := gammaPt_mem_support (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex U
    (C.isSplitOn_of_sectionExactOn U hC) hU
  have hz : zeroCycle (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex (C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU) = 0 :=
    zeroCycle_apply_of_not_mem_graphAway _ _
      ((mem_infDivisor_support_iff (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex _).mp hsupp)
  have hi := C.infCycle_gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU
  have hcoh := coheight_gammaPt (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex U
    (C.isSplitOn_of_sectionExactOn U hC) hU
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [map_zero] at hx
    exact ratFn_ne_zero (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex hx.symm
  have hdiv : div (ratFn (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) (C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU) =
      zeroCycle (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex (C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU) -
        infCycle (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex (C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU) := by
    rw [div_ratFn]
    rfl
  rw [hz, hi, ← hx, div_eq_ord, Scheme.ord_algebraMap_eq_length_toNat hcoh x hx0] at hdiv
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.chart_pole
statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.chart_pole (j : ℕ) {w : C.graphModel (k := k)}
    (c : XiChart ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).map (C.dj j)) (xiOpen C)
      (xiCoord C) w) {y : C.graphModel (k := k)} (hy : y = C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU)
    (hyT : y ∈ c.T) (x : (C.graphModel (k := k)).presheaf.stalk y) :
    x * (C.graphModel (k := k)).presheaf.germ c.T y hyT c.μ ≠
      (C.graphModel (k := k)).presheaf.germ c.T y hyT c.l
proof:
:= by
  intro hx
  haveI : Nonempty c.T := ⟨⟨y, hyT⟩⟩
  have hne : ((c.T ⊓ xiOpen (k := k) C : (C.graphModel (k := k)).Opens) : Set (C.graphModel (k := k))).Nonempty :=
    nonempty_preirreducible_inter c.T.isOpen (xiOpen (k := k) C).isOpen ⟨y, hyT⟩
      (xiOpen_nonempty C)
  haveI : Nonempty (c.T ⊓ xiOpen (k := k) C : (C.graphModel (k := k)).Opens) := hne.to_subtype
  haveI : Nonempty (xiOpen (k := k) C : (C.graphModel (k := k)).Opens) := (xiOpen_nonempty C).to_subtype
  
  have hrel := congrArg ((C.graphModel (k := k)).germToFunctionField (c.T ⊓ xiOpen (k := k) C)) c.ht
  rw [map_mul] at hrel
  have e1 : (C.graphModel (k := k)).germToFunctionField (c.T ⊓ xiOpen (k := k) C)
      (rXiR (inf_le_right : c.T ⊓ xiOpen (k := k) C ≤ xiOpen C) (xiCoord C)) =
      ratFn (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex := by
    simp only [rXiR, Scheme.germToFunctionField, ← CommRingCat.comp_apply, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res]
    unfold ratFn
    rfl
  have e2 : ∀ f : Γ(C.graphModel (k := k), c.T), (C.graphModel (k := k)).germToFunctionField (c.T ⊓ xiOpen (k := k) C)
      (rXiR (inf_le_left : c.T ⊓ xiOpen (k := k) C ≤ c.T) f) = (C.graphModel (k := k)).germToFunctionField c.T f := by
    intro f
    simp only [rXiR, Scheme.germToFunctionField, ← CommRingCat.comp_apply, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res]
  rw [e1, e2, e2] at hrel
  have hx' := congrArg (algebraMap ((C.graphModel (k := k)).presheaf.stalk y) (C.graphModel (k := k)).functionField) hx
  rw [map_mul, Scheme.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField,
    Scheme.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField] at hx'
  have hμ : (C.graphModel (k := k)).germToFunctionField c.T c.μ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply c.hμ
    exact (C.graphModel (k := k)).germToFunctionField_injective c.T (h0.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  have := mul_right_cancel₀ hμ (hx'.trans hrel.symm)
  exact C.ratFn_ne_algebraMap_gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU hy x this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.chart_split
statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.chart_split (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ C.K.len) {w : C.graphModel (k := k)}
    (c : XiChart ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).map (C.dj j)) (xiOpen C)
      (xiCoord C) w) (hcard : Fintype.card c.n = C.rank j) (V : M.affineOpens)
    (hTV : c.T ≤ xiProj (k := k) C ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)
    (hD : ∀ r : ℕ, GraphBundles.minorsIdeal r c.D =
      ((C.toDetIdealComplex.detIdeal j r).ideal V).map ((xiProj (k := k) C).appLE V.1 c.T hTV).hom)
    {y : C.graphModel (k := k)} (hyT : y ∈ c.T) (V' : M.affineOpens)
    (hyV' : xiProj (k := k) C y ∈ V'.1) (cf : ℕ → ℕ) (hcf : IsSplitData C.toDetIdealComplex V' cf) :
    GraphBundles.minorsIdeal (cf j) (c.D.map ((C.graphModel (k := k)).presheaf.germ c.T y hyT).hom)
        = ⊤ ∧
      GraphBundles.minorsIdeal (cf j + 1)
        (c.D.map ((C.graphModel (k := k)).presheaf.germ c.T y hyT).hom) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have hyV : xiProj (k := k) C y ∈ V.1 := hTV hyT
  have key : ∀ r : ℕ, GraphBundles.minorsIdeal r (c.D.map ((C.graphModel (k := k)).presheaf.germ c.T y hyT).hom) =
      ((C.toDetIdealComplex.detIdeal j r).ideal V').map (stalkHomXiR (xiProj (k := k) C) V'.1 hyV') := by
    intro r
    rw [← GraphBundles.minorsIdeal_map, hD r, Ideal.map_map,
      ← ideal_map_stalkHom_eq_kim (xiProj (k := k) C) _ V V' hyV hyV']
    congr 1
    ext a
    change ((C.graphModel (k := k)).presheaf.germ c.T y hyT).hom
        (((xiProj (k := k) C).appLE V.1 c.T hTV).hom a) =
      ((C.graphModel (k := k)).presheaf.germ _ y hyV).hom (((xiProj (k := k) C).app V.1).hom a)
    rw [Scheme.Hom.appLE, CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply]
    exact (C.graphModel (k := k)).presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE hTV) y hyT _
  obtain ⟨hle, htop, hbot⟩ := hcf j hj
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [key, htop (cf j) le_rfl, Ideal.map_top]
  · by_cases hr : cf j + 1 ≤ C.rank j
    · rw [key, hbot (cf j + 1) (Nat.lt_succ_self _) hr, Ideal.map_bot]
    · exact minorsIdeal_eq_bot_of_card_lt _ (by omega)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.gamma_constRank
statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.gamma_constRank (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ C.K.len) :
    ∃ cj : ℕ, cj ≤ C.rank j ∧ ∀ z : C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU,
      ∃ c : XiChart ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).map (C.dj j)) (xiOpen C)
          (xiCoord C) (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU z),
        Fintype.card c.n = C.rank j ∧
        GraphBundles.minorsIdeal (C.rank j - cj)
          (xiTop (c.B.map (stalkHomXiR (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU) c.T c.mem))) = ⊤ ∧
        GraphBundles.minorsIdeal (C.rank j - cj + 1)
          (xiTop (c.B.map (stalkHomXiR (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU) c.T c.mem))) = ⊥ ∧
        GraphBundles.minorsIdeal cj
          (xiBot (c.B.map (stalkHomXiR (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU) c.T c.mem))) = ⊤ ∧
        GraphBundles.minorsIdeal (cj + 1)
          (xiBot (c.B.map (stalkHomXiR (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU) c.T c.mem))) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hγ : C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU (genericPoint (C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU)) =
      C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU := C.gammaTildeι_genericPoint U hC hU
  
  have hπγ : xiProj (k := k) C (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU
      (genericPoint (C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU))) ∈ U := by
    rw [hγ]; exact C.xiProj_gammaPt_mem (k := k) U hC hU
  obtain ⟨V', hV'mem, -, cf, hcf⟩ := C.isSplitOn_of_sectionExactOn U hC _ hπγ
  have hrk : C.toDetIdealComplex.rank j = C.rank j := rfl
  have hcfle : cf j ≤ C.rank j := hrk ▸ (hcf j hj).1
  refine ⟨cf j, hcfle, fun z => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨c, V, hcard, hTV, hD⟩ := C.exists_xiChart_kim (k := k) j
    (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU z)
  refine ⟨c, hcard, ?_⟩
  
  have hηT : C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU (genericPoint (C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU)) ∈
      c.T := by
    have hsp := (genericPoint_specializes z).map (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU).continuous
    exact hsp.mem_open c.T.isOpen c.mem
  haveI : Nonempty (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU ⁻¹ᵁ c.T :
      (C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU).Opens) := ⟨⟨z, c.mem⟩⟩
  
  let g := ((C.graphModel (k := k)).presheaf.germ c.T _ hηT).hom
  let f := ((C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU).stalkMap
    (genericPoint (C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU))).hom
  have hf : ∀ x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((C.graphModel (k := k)).presheaf.stalk
      (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU (genericPoint (C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU)))),
      f x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    by_contra hne
    exact (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal x).mp hx (isUnit_of_map_unit f x (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hne))
  have hμ : g c.μ ≠ 0 := fun h0 =>
    c.hμ (germ_injective_of_isIntegral _ _ hηT (h0.trans (map_zero g).symm))
  have hpole : ∀ x, x * g c.μ ≠ g c.l := C.chart_pole (k := k) U hC hU j c hγ hηT
  obtain ⟨hs1, hs2⟩ := C.chart_split (k := k) j hj c hcard V hTV hD hηT V' hV'mem cf hcf
  have hac : C.rank j - cf j + cf j = Fintype.card c.n := by omega
  obtain ⟨hg1, hg2⟩ := (c.hB.map g).generic_bounds f hf hμ hpole hac hs1 hs2
  
  let φ := stalkHomXiR (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU) c.T c.mem
  let ψ := algebraMap ((C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU).presheaf.stalk z)
    (C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU).functionField
  have hψ : Function.Injective ψ := IsFractionRing.injective _ _
  have hcomp : ∀ a : Γ(C.graphModel (k := k), c.T), ψ (φ a) = f (g a) := by
    intro a
    have e1 : ψ (φ a) = (C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU).germToFunctionField
        (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU ⁻¹ᵁ c.T)
        (((C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU).app c.T).hom a) :=
      Scheme.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField
        (show z ∈ C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU ⁻¹ᵁ c.T from c.mem) _
    rw [e1]
    exact (Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply _ c.T _ hηT a).symm
  have hBmap : ∀ {p q : Type u} (P : Matrix p q Γ(C.graphModel (k := k), c.T)),
      (P.map φ).map ψ = (P.map g).map f := by
    intro p q P
    ext a b
    exact hcomp (P a b)
  have h₁ : GraphBundles.minorsIdeal (C.rank j - cf j + 1) ((xiTop (c.B.map φ)).map ψ) = ⊥ := by
    have e : (xiTop (c.B.map φ)).map ψ = (xiTop (c.B.map g)).map f := hBmap (xiTop c.B)
    rw [e]; exact hg1
  have h₂ : GraphBundles.minorsIdeal (cf j + 1) ((xiBot (c.B.map φ)).map ψ) = ⊥ := by
    have e : (xiBot (c.B.map φ)).map ψ = (xiBot (c.B.map g)).map f := hBmap (xiBot c.B)
    rw [e]; exact hg2
  obtain ⟨ht1, ht2⟩ := (c.hB.map φ).const_rank_of_generic ψ hψ hac h₁ h₂
  exact ⟨ht1, minorsIdeal_eq_bot_of_injective ψ hψ _ _ h₁, ht2,
    minorsIdeal_eq_bot_of_injective ψ hψ _ _ h₂⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ReesAddP1.tauStd_extComplex_eq_sumComplex
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Fact (CIICLASS.ProjectiveIntegralK k M) := ⟨hMK⟩
  have hext := sectionExactOn_extComplex c h₁ h₃
  have hsum := sectionExactOn_sumComplex C₁ C₃ U h₁ h₃
  have hET : (reesComplex (famP1 k M) (ProjectionFormula.tensorRight _ TD.A)
      (hasConstantRank_tensorRight_p1 TD.A TD.hA) (twistSigma TD.A TD.lam) c).SectionExactOn
        ((famP1 k M) ⁻¹ᵁ U) :=
    sectionExactOn_reesComplex_pullback (famP1 k M) TD.A TD.hA _ _ c h₁ h₃
  have hMT := height_famT k (M := M) hM
  have hcanon := tauRaw_fibre_eq_canon (k := k)
    (reesComplex (famP1 k M) (ProjectionFormula.tensorRight _ TD.A)
      (hasConstantRank_tensorRight_p1 TD.A TD.hA) (twistSigma TD.A TD.lam) c)
    (famι k ι) ((famP1 k M) ⁻¹ᵁ U) hET (famP1_preimage_nonempty k U hU) (famX_cover k ι U hX)
    (famP2 k M) 0 hMT hM ι (famR k ι)
    (famSecAt k M 0) (famGX k ι _ _) (famGX_ι k ι _ _) (famGX_r k ι _ _) U
    (sectionExactOn_isoData (reesFibreZeroTwist (famP1 k M) (famSecAt k M 0)
      (famSec_p1 k _ _) TD.A TD.hA c TD.lam TD.mu TD.hlam0 TD.hmu0).symm hsum) hX
    (famSec_mem_preimage k _ _ U) (M ↘ Spk k) (famSec_isPullback k _ _)
    (famSecInf k M) (famGX k ι _ _) (famGX_ι k ι _ _) (famGX_r k ι _ _) U
    (sectionExactOn_isoData (reesFibreUnitTwist (famP1 k M) (famSecInf k M)
      (famSec_p1 k _ _) TD.A TD.hA c TD.lam TD.hlamInf).symm hext) hX
    (famSec_mem_preimage k _ _ U) (M ↘ Spk k) (famSec_isPullback k _ _)
  have hspec := reesSpecialization_twist_of_fibre (k := k) hMK (famP1 k M) TD.A TD.hA TD.lam c
    (famSecInf k M) (famSecAt k M 0) ι (famSec_p1 k _ _) (famSec_p1 k _ _) TD.hlamInf TD.mu
    TD.hlam0 TD.hmu0 U U hext hsum hM hcanon.symm
  unfold ReesSpecialization at hspec
  rw [tauRaw_eq_tauStd_g2trees (k := k) hMK ι, tauRaw_eq_tauStd_g2trees (k := k) hMK ι] at hspec
  exact hspec

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ReesAddP1.totalPushOn_injective_of_surjective
statement:
theorem totalPushOn_injective_of_surjective (hsurj : Function.Surjective ι) :
    Function.Injective (totalPushOn (opsK k) ι)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Surjective ι := ⟨hsurj⟩
  haveI : IsIso ι := isIso_of_isClosedImmersion_of_surjective ι
  haveI : (inv ι).IsOver (Spk k) :=
    ⟨by rw [IsIso.inv_comp_eq, CategoryTheory.comp_over (f := ι) (S := Spk k)]⟩
  haveI : IsProper ι := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) ι
  haveI : IsProper (inv ι) := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) (inv ι)
  haveI : (ι ≫ inv ι).IsOver (Spk k) := inferInstance
  haveI : IsProper (ι ≫ inv ι) := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) (ι ≫ inv ι)
  intro a b hab
  have h := congrArg (totalPushOn (opsK k) (inv ι)) hab
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← totalPushOn_comp,
    K5.totalPushOn_congr (opsK k) (IsIso.hom_inv_id ι), K5.totalPushOn_id] at h
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ReesAddP1.tauStd_extComplex_add_of_empty
statement:
theorem tauStd_extComplex_add_of_empty {C₁ C₃ : RankedBundleComplex M} (c : ExtCocycle C₁ C₃)
    (U : M.Opens) (h₁ : C₁.SectionExactOn U) (h₃ : C₃.SectionExactOn U)
    (hU : ¬ (U : Set M).Nonempty) (hX : ∀ x : M, x ∉ U → x ∈ Set.range ι) {n : ℕ}
    (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    tauStd hMK (extComplex C₁ C₃ c) ι U (sectionExactOn_extComplex c h₁ h₃) hM =
      tauStd hMK C₁ ι U h₁ hM + tauStd hMK C₃ ι U h₃ hM
proof:
:= by
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective ι := fun x ↦ hX x fun hx ↦ hU ⟨x, hx⟩
  apply totalPushOn_injective_of_surjective (k := k) ι hsurj
  rw [map_add, push_tauStd hMK _ ι U _ hX hM, push_tauStd hMK _ ι U _ hX hM,
    push_tauStd hMK _ ι U _ hX hM, altSum_extComplex, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModulePropertyDisconnected.isOpen_connectedComponent_g2pol3
statement: theorem isOpen_connectedComponent_g2pol3 (x : α) : IsOpen (connectedComponent x)
proof:
:= by
  have hfin := NoetherianSpace.finite_irreducibleComponents (α := α)
  have hcompl : (connectedComponent x)ᶜ =
      ⋃ Z ∈ {Z ∈ irreducibleComponents α | Disjoint Z (connectedComponent x)}, Z := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · intro hy
      refine Set.mem_biUnion (x := irreducibleComponent y)
        ⟨irreducibleComponent_mem_irreducibleComponents y, ?_⟩ (mem_irreducibleComponent)
      have hsub : irreducibleComponent y ⊆ connectedComponent y :=
        (IsPreirreducible.isPreconnected isIrreducible_irreducibleComponent.2).subset_connectedComponent
          mem_irreducibleComponent
      have hne : connectedComponent y ≠ connectedComponent x := by
        intro h
        apply hy
        rw [← h]
        exact mem_connectedComponent
      exact (connectedComponent_disjoint hne).mono_left hsub
    · intro hy hyC
      obtain ⟨Z, ⟨-, hd⟩, hyZ⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hy
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hd hyZ hyC
  rw [← isClosed_compl_iff, hcompl]
  exact (hfin.subset fun Z hZ ↦ hZ.1).isClosed_biUnion fun Z hZ ↦
    isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents Z hZ.1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModulePropertyDisconnected.isEmpty_pullback_compOpen
statement:
theorem isEmpty_pullback_compOpen {c d : ConnectedComponents X} (h : c ≠ d) :
    IsEmpty (pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) (compOpen d).ι (compOpen c).ι)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun p ↦ ?_⟩
  have h1 : (compOpen d).ι (pullback.fst (compOpen d).ι (compOpen c).ι p) =
      (compOpen c).ι (pullback.snd (compOpen d).ι (compOpen c).ι p) := by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, pullback.condition]
  have hd : (compOpen d).ι (pullback.fst (compOpen d).ι (compOpen c).ι p) ∈ compOpen d :=
    (pullback.fst (compOpen d).ι (compOpen c).ι p).2
  have hc : (compOpen c).ι (pullback.snd (compOpen d).ι (compOpen c).ι p) ∈ compOpen c :=
    (pullback.snd (compOpen d).ι (compOpen c).ι p).2
  rw [h1] at hd
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (disjoint_compOpen h) hc hd

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModulePropertyDisconnected.rho_pushC_ne
statement:
theorem rho_pushC_ne {c d : ConnectedComponents X} (h : c ≠ d) :
    rho k c ∘ₗ pushC k d = 0
proof:
:= by
  set P := pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) (compOpen d).ι (compOpen c).ι
  haveI : IsEmpty P := isEmpty_pullback_compOpen h
  letI : P.Over (Spk k) := ⟨pullback.snd (compOpen d).ι (compOpen c).ι ≫
    (compOpen c).toScheme ↘ Spk k⟩
  haveI : (pullback.snd (compOpen d).ι (compOpen c).ι).IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨rfl⟩
  haveI : (pullback.fst (compOpen d).ι (compOpen c).ι).IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨by
    change pullback.fst (compOpen d).ι (compOpen c).ι ≫ (compOpen d).ι ≫ X ↘ Spk k =
      pullback.snd (compOpen d).ι (compOpen c).ι ≫ (compOpen c).ι ≫ X ↘ Spk k
    rw [← Category.assoc, pullback.condition, Category.assoc]⟩
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (P ↘ Spk k) :=
    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType (pullback.snd (compOpen d).ι (compOpen c).ι ≫
      (compOpen c).toScheme ↘ Spk k))
  haveI : CompactSpace P := (pullback.snd (compOpen d).ι (compOpen c).ι).isClosedEmbedding.compactSpace
  haveI : IsNoetherian P := { }
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k P) :=
    ⟨projK_closed (Fact.out : ProjK k (compOpen c).toScheme)
      (pullback.snd (compOpen d).ι (compOpen c).ι) rfl⟩
  unfold rho pushC
  rw [(cpK k).base_change (compOpen d).ι (compOpen c).ι (pullback.snd _ _) (pullback.fst _ _) 0
      (pureRelDim_openImmersion k _) (pureRelDim_openImmersion k _)
      (IsPullback.of_hasPullback (compOpen d).ι (compOpen c).ι)]
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, totalChow_eq_zero_of_isEmpty
    (totalPullOn (opsK k) (pullback.fst (compOpen d).ι (compOpen c).ι) 0 _ z), map_zero,
    LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: RRC.SingularTodd.stalkLength_ne_top_of_maximal
statement:
theorem stalkLength_ne_top_of_maximal [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (F : X.Modules)
    [F.IsFinitePresentation] {x : X} (hx : Maximal (· ∈ moduleSheafSupport F) x) :
    stalkLength F x ≠ ⊤
proof:
:=
  Module.length_ne_top_iff.mpr (isFiniteLength_stalk_of_maximal F hx)

name: RRC.SingularTodd.stalkLength_ne_top_of_top
statement:
theorem stalkLength_ne_top_of_top [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (F : X.Modules)
    [F.IsFinitePresentation] {d : ℕ} (hdim : ∀ y ∈ moduleSheafSupport F, height y ≤ d)
    {x : X} (hx : height x = d) : stalkLength F x ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hmem : x ∈ moduleSheafSupport F
  · exact stalkLength_ne_top_of_maximal F (maximal_of_height_eq_of_top F hdim hx hmem)
  · rw [stalkLength_eq_zero_of_not_mem F hmem]
    exact ENat.zero_ne_top

name: RRC.SingularTodd.coe_toNat_stalkLength_of_maximal
statement:
theorem coe_toNat_stalkLength_of_maximal [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (F : X.Modules)
    [F.IsFinitePresentation] {x : X} (hx : Maximal (· ∈ moduleSheafSupport F) x) :
    ((stalkLength F x).toNat : ℕ∞) = stalkLength F x
proof:
:=
  ENat.coe_toNat (stalkLength_ne_top_of_maximal F hx)

name: RRC.SingularTodd.coherentCycle_coeff_eq_length
statement:
theorem coherentCycle_coeff_eq_length [IsNoetherian X] (F : X.Modules)
    (hF : IsCoherentLike X F) {d : ℕ} {x : X} (hx : height x = d)
    (hmax : Maximal (· ∈ moduleSheafSupport F) x) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, stalkLength F x = (n : ℕ∞) ∧
      (coherentCycle F hF d : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) x = (n : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : F.IsFinitePresentation := hF
  refine ⟨(stalkLength F x).toNat, (coe_toNat_stalkLength_of_maximal F hmax).symm, ?_⟩
  simp [coherentCycle_apply, coherentCoeff, hx, hmax]

name: RRC.SingularTodd.coherentCycle_coeff_eq_length_of_top
statement:
theorem coherentCycle_coeff_eq_length_of_top [IsNoetherian X] (F : X.Modules)
    (hF : IsCoherentLike X F) {d : ℕ} (hdim : ∀ y ∈ moduleSheafSupport F, height y ≤ d)
    {x : X} (hx : height x = d) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, stalkLength F x = (n : ℕ∞) ∧
      (coherentCycle F hF d : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) x = (n : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : F.IsFinitePresentation := hF
  exact ⟨(stalkLength F x).toNat, (ENat.coe_toNat (stalkLength_ne_top_of_top F hdim hx)).symm,
    coherentCycle_apply_of_top F hF hdim hx⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.det_bordered_eq_zero
statement:
theorem det_bordered_eq_zero (D : Matrix κ ι R) (h : minorsIdeal (Fintype.card γ + 1) D = ⊥)
    (S : γ → κ) (T : γ → ι) (k : κ) (i : ι) :
    (D.submatrix (Sum.elim S fun _ : Unit => k) (Sum.elim T fun _ : Unit => i)).det = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hmem := det_mem_minorsIdeal D (Sum.elim S fun _ : Unit => k)
    (Sum.elim T fun _ : Unit => i)
  rw [Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_unit, h] at hmem
  exact (Submodule.mem_bot R).1 hmem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.eq_mul_nonsing_inv_mul
statement:
theorem eq_mul_nonsing_inv_mul (D : Matrix κ ι R) (S : γ → κ) (T : γ → ι)
    (hA : IsUnit (D.submatrix S T).det) (h : minorsIdeal (Fintype.card γ + 1) D = ⊥) :
    D = D.submatrix id T * (D.submatrix S T)⁻¹ * D.submatrix S id
proof:
:= by
  letI : Invertible (D.submatrix S T) := invertibleOfIsUnitDet _ hA
  ext k i
  have h0 := det_bordered_eq_zero D h S T k i
  have hblk : D.submatrix (Sum.elim S fun _ : Unit => k) (Sum.elim T fun _ : Unit => i) =
      fromBlocks (D.submatrix S T) (of fun a (_ : Unit) => D (S a) i)
        (of fun (_ : Unit) b => D k (T b)) (of fun _ _ => D k i) := by
    ext (a | a) (b | b) <;> rfl
  have hu : ∀ M : Matrix Unit Unit R, M.det = M () () := fun M => det_unique M
  rw [hblk, det_fromBlocks₁₁, hu] at h0
  have h1 := (hA.mul_right_eq_zero).1 h0
  rw [Matrix.sub_apply, sub_eq_zero, invOf_eq_nonsing_inv] at h1
  simp only [of_apply] at h1
  rw [h1]
  simp only [mul_apply, of_apply, submatrix_apply, id]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.mul_colSel
statement:
theorem mul_colSel {μ : Type*} (M : Matrix μ ι R) (T : γ → ι) :
    M * colSel T = M.submatrix id T
proof:
:= by
  ext k b
  simp [colSel, mul_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.rowSel_mul
statement:
theorem rowSel_mul {μ : Type*} (S : γ → κ) (M : Matrix κ μ R) :
    rowSel S * M = M.submatrix S id
proof:
:= by
  ext a j
  simp [rowSel, mul_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.app_top_lc_cfrs
statement:
theorem app_top_lc_cfrs {P Q : Z.Modules} (g : P ⟶ Q) {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (t : ι → Γ(P, ⊤)) (c : ι → Γ(Z, ⊤)) :
    g.app ⊤ (Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Z, ⊤) t c) =
      Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Z, ⊤) (fun i => g.app ⊤ (t i)) c
proof:
:= by
  have := app_linearCombination_xiR g t (le_refl ⊤) c
  rwa [secResXiR_self, secResXiR_self] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.free_hom_ext_cfrs
statement:
theorem free_hom_ext_cfrs {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] {N : Z.Modules} (f g : freeZ Z ι ⟶ N)
    (h : ∀ i, f.app ⊤ (genZ ι i) = g.app ⊤ (genZ ι i)) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  ext O x
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := (isSecFrame_freeGen (Z := Z) ι ⊤ O le_top).2 x
  change f.app O _ = g.app O _
  rw [app_linearCombination_xiR, app_linearCombination_xiR,
    show (fun i => f.app ⊤ (freeGenXiR ι i ⊤)) = fun i => g.app ⊤ (freeGenXiR ι i ⊤) from
      funext h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.matHom_app_gen
statement:
theorem matHom_app_gen {κ ι : Type u} [Fintype κ] [Fintype ι] (M : Matrix κ ι Γ(Z, ⊤)) (i : ι) :
    (matHom M).app ⊤ (genZ ι i) = Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Z, ⊤) (genZ κ) (fun k => M k i)
proof:
:=
  globalFrameHom_freeGen _ i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.matHom_comp
statement:
theorem matHom_comp {μ κ ι : Type u} [Fintype μ] [Fintype κ] [Fintype ι]
    (M₂ : Matrix κ ι Γ(Z, ⊤)) (M₁ : Matrix μ κ Γ(Z, ⊤)) :
    matHom M₂ ≫ matHom M₁ = matHom (M₁ * M₂)
proof:
:= by
  apply free_hom_ext_cfrs
  intro i
  rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, CategoryTheory.comp_apply, matHom_app_gen, app_top_lc_cfrs,
    matHom_app_gen]
  simp only [matHom_app_gen, Fintype.linearCombination_apply, Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul,
    mul_apply, Finset.sum_smul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  rw [mul_comm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.matHom_one
statement:
theorem matHom_one {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] :
    matHom (1 : Matrix ι ι Γ(Z, ⊤)) = 𝟙 (freeZ Z ι)
proof:
:= by
  apply free_hom_ext_cfrs
  intro i
  rw [matHom_app_gen, Scheme.Modules.Hom.id_app, CategoryTheory.id_apply,
    Fintype.linearCombination_apply]
  simp [one_apply, ite_smul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.exists_split_of_globalFrames
statement:
theorem exists_split_of_globalFrames {P Q : Z.Modules} (ψ : P ⟶ Q) {ι κ γ : Type u} [Fintype ι]
    [Fintype κ] [Fintype γ] [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] [DecidableEq γ]
    (tP : ι → Γ(P, ⊤)) (htP : IsSecFrame P ⊤ tP) (tQ : κ → Γ(Q, ⊤)) (htQ : IsSecFrame Q ⊤ tQ)
    (D : Matrix κ ι Γ(Z, ⊤))
    (hD : ∀ i, ψ.app ⊤ (tP i) = Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Z, ⊤) tQ (fun k => D k i))
    (S : γ → κ) (T : γ → ι) (hA : IsUnit (D.submatrix S T).det)
    (hfac : D = D.submatrix id T * (D.submatrix S T)⁻¹ * D.submatrix S id) :
    ∃ (π : P ⟶ freeZ Z γ) (i : freeZ Z γ ⟶ Q) (ρ : Q ⟶ freeZ Z γ),
      Epi π ∧ i ≫ ρ = 𝟙 _ ∧ π ≫ i = ψ
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Fact (IsSecFrame P ⊤ tP) := ⟨htP⟩
  haveI : Fact (IsSecFrame Q ⊤ tQ) := ⟨htQ⟩
  let ΦP := globalFrameHom P (le_refl (⊤ : Z.Opens)) tP
  let ΦQ := globalFrameHom Q (le_refl (⊤ : Z.Opens)) tQ
  let A := D.submatrix S T
  have hAA : A * A⁻¹ = 1 := mul_nonsing_inv A hA
  let π : P ⟶ freeZ Z γ := inv ΦP ≫ matHom (D.submatrix S id)
  let σ : freeZ Z γ ⟶ P := matHom (colSel T * A⁻¹) ≫ ΦP
  let i : freeZ Z γ ⟶ Q := matHom (D.submatrix id T * A⁻¹) ≫ ΦQ
  let ρ : Q ⟶ freeZ Z γ := inv ΦQ ≫ matHom (rowSel S)
  have hσπ : σ ≫ π = 𝟙 _ := by
    simp only [σ, π, Category.assoc, IsIso.hom_inv_id_assoc, matHom_comp]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, mul_colSel]
    exact (congrArg matHom hAA).trans matHom_one
  have hiρ : i ≫ ρ = 𝟙 _ := by
    simp only [i, ρ, Category.assoc, IsIso.hom_inv_id_assoc, matHom_comp]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, rowSel_mul]
    exact (congrArg matHom hAA).trans matHom_one
  refine ⟨π, i, ρ, epi_of_epi_fac hσπ, hiρ, ?_⟩
  rw [← cancel_epi ΦP]
  simp only [π, i, Category.assoc]
  rw [IsIso.hom_inv_id_assoc, ← Category.assoc, matHom_comp, ← hfac]
  apply free_hom_ext_cfrs
  intro j
  rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, CategoryTheory.comp_apply, Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app,
    CategoryTheory.comp_apply, matHom_app_gen, app_top_lc_cfrs, globalFrameHom_freeGen, hD]
  congr 2
  funext k
  exact globalFrameHom_freeGen tQ k

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.exists_open_res_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_open_res_eq_zero {U : X.Opens} {x : X} (hx : x ∈ U) {α : Type*} [Finite α]
    (g : α → Γ(X, U)) (h : ∀ a, X.presheaf.germ U x hx (g a) = 0) :
    ∃ (W : X.Opens) (hW : W ≤ U), x ∈ W ∧ ∀ a, X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op (g a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have H : ∀ a, ∃ (W : X.Opens) (_ : x ∈ W) (iU : W ⟶ U), X.presheaf.map iU.op (g a) = 0 :=
    fun a => by
      obtain ⟨W, hxW, iU, iV, e⟩ := X.presheaf.germ_eq x hx hx (g a) 0 (by rw [h a, map_zero])
      exact ⟨W, hxW, iU, by rw [e, map_zero]⟩
  choose W hxW iU hW using H
  let W₀ : X.Opens := ⟨⋂ a, (W a : Set X), isOpen_iInter_of_finite fun a => (W a).isOpen⟩
  refine ⟨W₀ ⊓ U, inf_le_right, ⟨Set.mem_iInter.2 hxW, hx⟩, fun a => ?_⟩
  have hle : W₀ ⊓ U ≤ W a := fun y hy => Set.mem_iInter.1 hy.1 a
  rw [show (homOfLE (inf_le_right : W₀ ⊓ U ≤ U)) = homOfLE hle ≫ iU a from
    Subsingleton.elim _ _, op_comp, Functor.map_comp, CategoryTheory.comp_apply, hW a, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.isUnit_res_of_le_basicOpen
statement:
theorem isUnit_res_of_le_basicOpen {U W : X.Opens} (f : Γ(X, U)) (hW : W ≤ X.basicOpen f)
    (hWU : W ≤ U) : IsUnit (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWU).op f)
proof:
:= by
  apply X.toRingedSpace.isUnit_of_isUnit_germ
  intro y hy
  erw [X.presheaf.germ_res_apply]
  exact (X.mem_basicOpen f y (hWU hy)).1 (hW hy)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.hasConstantRank_freeZ
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_freeZ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (c : ℕ) :
    HasConstantRank Z (freeZ Z (ULift.{u} (Fin c))) c
proof:
:=
  ⟨(SheafOfModules.free.generatingSections (R := Z.ringCatSheaf)
      (ULift.{u} (Fin c))).localGeneratorsData,
    inferInstance, inferInstance, fun _ ↦ show Nat.card (ULift.{u} (Fin c)) = c by simp⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.isLocallySplitOfRank_of_frames
statement:
theorem isLocallySplitOfRank_of_frames {E F : X.Modules} (φ : E ⟶ F) (c : ℕ)
    (H : ∀ x : X, ∃ (U : X.Opens) (hx : x ∈ U) (ι κ : Type u) (_ : Fintype ι) (_ : Fintype κ)
      (s : ι → Γ(E, U)) (s' : κ → Γ(F, U)) (D : Matrix κ ι Γ(X, U)),
      IsSecFrame E U s ∧ IsSecFrame F U s' ∧
      (∀ i, φ.app U (s i) = Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, U) s' (fun k => D k i)) ∧
      minorsIdeal c (D.map (X.presheaf.germ U x hx).hom) = ⊤ ∧
      minorsIdeal (c + 1) (D.map (X.presheaf.germ U x hx).hom) = ⊥) :
    IsLocallySplitOfRank φ c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x
  obtain ⟨U, hx, ι, κ, _, _, s, s', D, hs, hs', hD, htop, hbot⟩ := H x
  let gx := (X.presheaf.germ U x hx).hom
  have hdet : ∀ {r : ℕ} (S : Fin r → κ) (T : Fin r → ι),
      ((D.map gx).submatrix S T).det = gx (D.submatrix S T).det := fun S T => by
    rw [RingHom.map_det]; rfl
  
  obtain ⟨S, T, hST⟩ : ∃ (S : Fin c → κ) (T : Fin c → ι), IsUnit (gx (D.submatrix S T).det) := by
    by_contra hne
    apply (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal (X.presheaf.stalk x)).ne_top
    rw [eq_top_iff, ← htop]
    refine Ideal.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨⟨S, T⟩, rfl⟩
    change ((D.map gx).submatrix S T).det ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)
    rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff, hdet]
    exact fun h => hne ⟨S, T, h⟩
  
  have hz : ∀ ST : (Fin (c + 1) → κ) × (Fin (c + 1) → ι),
      X.presheaf.germ U x hx (D.submatrix ST.1 ST.2).det = 0 := fun ST => by
    have hm := minor_mem_minorsIdeal (D.map gx) ST.1 ST.2
    rw [hbot, hdet] at hm
    exact (Submodule.mem_bot _).1 hm
  obtain ⟨W₀, hW₀U, hxW₀, hW₀⟩ :=
    exists_open_res_eq_zero hx
      (fun ST : (Fin (c + 1) → κ) × (Fin (c + 1) → ι) => (D.submatrix ST.1 ST.2).det) hz
  let W : X.Opens := W₀ ⊓ X.basicOpen (D.submatrix S T).det
  have hxW : x ∈ W := ⟨hxW₀, (X.mem_basicOpen _ x hx).2 hST⟩
  have hWU : W ≤ U := inf_le_left.trans hW₀U
  let U' : X.Opens := W.ι ''ᵁ ⊤
  have hU'W : U' ≤ W := (W.ι.image_le_opensRange ⊤).trans (by rw [Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι])
  have h : U' ≤ U := hU'W.trans hWU
  
  let g : Γ(X, U) →+* Γ(W, ⊤) :=
    (W.ι.appIso ⊤).hom.hom.comp (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
  let Dz : Matrix κ ι Γ(W, ⊤) := D.map g
  let γ := ULift.{u} (Fin c)
  let S' : γ → κ := S ∘ ULift.down
  let T' : γ → ι := T ∘ ULift.down
  have hres : ∀ a : Γ(X, U), g a = (W.ι.appIso ⊤).hom
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hU'W).op (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWU).op a)) := fun a => by
    simp only [g, RingHom.comp_apply]
    congr 1
    rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
    rfl
  have hA' : IsUnit (Dz.submatrix S' T').det := by
    have e1 : Dz.submatrix S' T' = (Dz.submatrix S T).submatrix Equiv.ulift Equiv.ulift := rfl
    rw [e1, det_submatrix_equiv_self, show (Dz.submatrix S T).det = g (D.submatrix S T).det from
      (RingHom.map_det g _).symm, hres]
    exact ((isUnit_res_of_le_basicOpen _ inf_le_right hWU).map _).map _
  have hbotz : minorsIdeal (Fintype.card γ + 1) Dz = ⊥ := by
    rw [show Fintype.card γ = c by simp [γ]]
    refine Ideal.span_eq_bot.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨⟨S₁, T₁⟩, rfl⟩
    change (Dz.submatrix S₁ T₁).det = 0
    rw [show (Dz.submatrix S₁ T₁).det = g (D.submatrix S₁ T₁).det from
      (RingHom.map_det g _).symm, hres]
    have hW₀W : W ≤ W₀ := inf_le_left
    rw [show (homOfLE hWU) = homOfLE hW₀W ≫ homOfLE hW₀U from Subsingleton.elim _ _, op_comp,
      Functor.map_comp, CategoryTheory.comp_apply]
    erw [hW₀ (S₁, T₁)]
    simp
  have hfacz := eq_mul_nonsing_inv_mul Dz S' T' hA' hbotz
  
  let tE : ι → Γ(E.restrict W.ι, ⊤) := secResXiR E h s
  let tF : κ → Γ(F.restrict W.ι, ⊤) := secResXiR F h s'
  have htE : IsSecFrame (E.restrict W.ι) ⊤ tE :=
    (isSecFrame_restrict_iff W.ι E ⊤ tE).2 (hs.mono h)
  have htF : IsSecFrame (F.restrict W.ι) ⊤ tF :=
    (isSecFrame_restrict_iff W.ι F ⊤ tF).2 (hs'.mono h)
  have hDz : ∀ i, ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).map φ).app ⊤ (tE i) =
      Fintype.linearCombination Γ(W, ⊤) tF (fun k => Dz k i) := fun i => by
    change φ.app U' (E.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (s i)) = _
    rw [app_res_xiR, hD i]
    conv_lhs => rw [← secResXiR_self F s', linearCombination_res_xiR F s' h le_rfl]
    rw [show tF = secResXiR (F.restrict W.ι) (le_refl ⊤) tF from (secResXiR_self _ _).symm,
      lc_restrict_xiR]
    rw [secResXiR_res]
    congr 1
    funext k
    simp only [Dz, Matrix.map_apply, g, RingHom.comp_apply]
    exact (Iso.hom_inv_id_apply (W.ι.appIso ⊤) _).symm
  obtain ⟨π, i, ρ, hπ, hiρ, hfac⟩ :=
    exists_split_of_globalFrames ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).map φ) tE htE tF htF Dz hDz
      S' T' hA' hfacz
  exact ⟨W, hxW, freeZ W γ, π, i, ρ, hasConstantRank_freeZ W c, hπ, hiρ, hfac⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.hasConstantRank_ker_im_coker_of_frames
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_ker_im_coker_of_frames {E F : X.Modules} {e f c : ℕ}
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E e) (hF : HasConstantRank X F f) (φ : E ⟶ F)
    (H : ∀ x : X, ∃ (U : X.Opens) (hx : x ∈ U) (ι κ : Type u) (_ : Fintype ι) (_ : Fintype κ)
      (s : ι → Γ(E, U)) (s' : κ → Γ(F, U)) (D : Matrix κ ι Γ(X, U)),
      IsSecFrame E U s ∧ IsSecFrame F U s' ∧
      (∀ i, φ.app U (s i) = Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, U) s' (fun k => D k i)) ∧
      minorsIdeal c (D.map (X.presheaf.germ U x hx).hom) = ⊤ ∧
      minorsIdeal (c + 1) (D.map (X.presheaf.germ U x hx).hom) = ⊥)
    (hcf : c ≤ f) :
    HasConstantRank X (kernel φ) (e - c) ∧ HasConstantRank X (Abelian.image φ) c ∧
      HasConstantRank X (cokernel φ) (f - c)
proof:
:=
  hasConstantRank_ker_im_coker hE hF φ (isLocallySplitOfRank_of_frames φ c H) hcf

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.Statement.LFA.component_totalPushOn
statement:
theorem component_totalPushOn (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsProper f] (m : ℕ)
    (x : TotalChow X) :
    DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow Y n) m (totalPushOn ops f x) =
      ops.push f m (DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) m x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of i z =>
    rw [← DirectSum.lof_eq_of ℚ, totalPushOn, DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply]
    by_cases h : i = m
    · subst h
      rw [DirectSum.component.lof_self, DirectSum.component.lof_self]
    · rw [DirectSum.component.of, DirectSum.component.of, dif_neg h, dif_neg h, map_zero]
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.Statement.LFA.le_genericPoint_lfa
statement: theorem le_genericPoint_lfa (x : V) : x ≤ genericPoint V
proof:
:=
  Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr (genericPoint_specializes x)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.Statement.LFA.height_le_genericPoint_lfa
statement: theorem height_le_genericPoint_lfa (x : V) : height x ≤ height (genericPoint V)
proof:
:=
  height_mono (le_genericPoint_lfa x)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.Statement.LFA.eq_genericPoint_of_height
statement:
theorem eq_genericPoint_of_height {e : ℕ} (hη : height (genericPoint V) = e) {x : V}
    (hx : height x = e) : x = genericPoint V
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  have hlt : x < genericPoint V := lt_of_le_not_ge (le_genericPoint_lfa x) (fun hge ↦
    hne ((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hge).antisymm
      (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp (le_genericPoint_lfa x))).eq)
  have h := height_strictMono hlt (by rw [hx]; exact ENat.coe_lt_top e)
  rw [hx, hη] at h
  exact lt_irrefl _ h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.Statement.LFA.rationalDimChow_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem rationalDimChow_eq_zero_of_lt {e m : ℕ} (hη : height (genericPoint V) = e) (hm : e < m)
    (z : RationalDimChow V m) : z = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := rationalDimChow_mem_of_prime (X := V) m ⊥ (fun v hv ↦ by
    exfalso
    have h1 := height_le_genericPoint_lfa v
    rw [hv, hη] at h1
    have h2 : m ≤ e := by exact_mod_cast h1
    omega) z
  simpa using h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.Statement.LFA.exists_eq_smul_fundGen
statement:
theorem exists_eq_smul_fundGen {e : ℕ} (hη : height (genericPoint V) = e)
    (z : RationalDimChow V e) : ∃ c : ℚ, z = c • fundGen e hη
proof:
:= by
  have h := rationalDimChow_mem_of_prime (X := V) e (Submodule.span ℚ {fundGen e hη})
    (fun v hv ↦ by
      obtain rfl := eq_genericPoint_of_height hη hv
      exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _) z
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp h
  exact ⟨c, hc.symm⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.Statement.LFA.exists_pos_embedding
statement:
theorem exists_pos_embedding {V : Scheme.{u}} [V.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (V ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian V] (hV : ProjK k V) :
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (_ : 0 < N) (J : V ⟶ space k N),
      IsClosedImmersion J ∧ J ≫ toSpec k N = V ↘ Spk k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, j, hj, hjo⟩ := hV
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos N with rfl | hN
  · refine ⟨1, one_pos,
      j ≫ toSpec k 0 ≫ SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationSpace.pointAt k 0, ?_, ?_⟩
    · haveI := hj
      infer_instance
    · rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc,
        SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.pointAt_toSpec, Category.comp_id, hjo]
  · exact ⟨N, hN, j, hj, hjo⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.Statement.LFA.height_le_space
statement: theorem height_le_space (N : ℕ) (x : space k N) : height x ≤ N
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := Order.height_le_krullDim x
  have h2 : krullDim (space k N) ≤ N := by
    rw [← Order.krullDimLE_iff]
    infer_instance
  exact_mod_cast h1.trans h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.Statement.closedCovariant_of_covariant

theorem closedCovariant_of_covariant {C : SchemeClass k} {τ : TauFamily k}
    (hcov : ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)]
      [IsNoetherian X] [Y.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian Y]
      [Fact (ProjK k X)] [Fact (ProjK k Y)], C X → C Y →
      ∀ (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsProper f] (φ : G0 X →+ G0 Y), INDB.Computes f φ →
        ∀ x : G0 X, τ Y (φ x) = totalPushOn (opsK k) f (τ X x)) :
    ClosedCovariant C τ
proof:
:=
  fun hX hV ι _ _ x ↦ hcov hV hX ι _ (INDB.computes_finitePushforward ι) x
