name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.Statement.push_fundGen
statement:
theorem push_fundGen {X V : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian X] [V.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (V ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian V]
    [Fact (ProjK k X)] [Fact (ProjK k V)] [IsIntegral V]
    (ι : V ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι] [ι.IsOver (Spk k)] (e : ℕ)
    (hv : height (ι (genericPoint V)) = e) (hη : height (genericPoint V) = e) :
    (opsK k).push ι e (LFA.fundGen e hη) =
      (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (ι (genericPoint V)) e hv) :
        DimChow X e)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) e)
    (primeClass_eq_push (k := k) ι (ι (genericPoint V)) rfl e hv hη)
  rw [LFA.component_totalPushOn] at h
  simp only [primeClassT2, DirectSum.component.lof_self] at h
  exact h.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.Statement.top_pushUnit_of_ambient
statement:
theorem top_pushUnit_of_ambient {C : SchemeClass k} {τ : TauFamily k}
    (hC : ClosedUnderIntegral C) (hcov : ClosedCovariant C τ) (hamb : AmbientIdentity C τ)
    {X V : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X]
    [Fact (ProjK k X)] [V.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (V ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian V]
    [IsIntegral V] (hX : C X) (ι : V ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι] [ι.IsOver (Spk k)]
    (hF : IsCoherentLike X (pushUnit ι)) (e : ℕ) (he : height (ι (genericPoint V)) = e) :
    (∀ m, e < m → DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) m
        (τ X (g0ClassOf X (pushUnit ι) hF)) = 0) ∧
      DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) e
          (τ X (g0ClassOf X (pushUnit ι) hF)) =
        (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (ι (genericPoint V)) e he) :
          DimChow X e)
proof:
:= by
  have hιo : ι ≫ X ↘ Spk k = V ↘ Spk k := CategoryTheory.comp_over (f := ι) (S := Spk k)
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k V) := ⟨projK_closed (Fact.out : ProjK k X) ι hιo⟩
  have hV : C V := hC ι hX
  have hη : height (genericPoint V) = e := by
    rw [← he, height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion]
  
  have hU : IsCoherentLike V (SheafOfModules.unit V.ringCatSheaf) :=
    SheafOfModules.unit_isFinitePresentation (R := V.ringCatSheaf)
  set x0 : G0 V := g0ClassOf V _ hU with hx0
  have hpush : ∀ {Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian Z] (j : V ⟶ Z) [IsClosedImmersion j]
      (hFj : IsCoherentLike Z (pushUnit j)), finitePushforward j x0 = g0ClassOf Z (pushUnit j) hFj :=
    fun j _ _ ↦ by rw [hx0, finitePushforward_classOf]
  set t : TotalChow V := τ V x0 with ht
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := LFA.exists_eq_smul_fundGen hη
    (DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow V n) e t)
  have hup : ∀ m, e < m → DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow V n) m t = 0 :=
    fun m hm ↦ LFA.rationalDimChow_eq_zero_of_lt hη hm _
  
  obtain ⟨N, hN, J, hJ, hJo⟩ := LFA.exists_pos_embedding (Fact.out : ProjK k V)
  haveI := hJ
  haveI : J.IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨hJo⟩
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (space k N)) := ⟨projK_space N rfl⟩
  have hJη : height (J (genericPoint V)) = e := by
    rw [height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion, hη]
  have heN : e ≤ N := by
    have h := LFA.height_le_space (k := k) N (J (genericPoint V))
    rw [hJη] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  have hFJ : IsCoherentLike (space k N) (pushUnit J) := isCoherentLike_pushUnit J
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := k0ToG0_surjective_of_base k N (k0ToG0_bijective_spec_field k).2
    (finitePushforward J x0)
  have hy' : k0ToG0 (space k N) y = g0ClassOf (space k N) (pushUnit J) hFJ := hy.trans (hpush J hFJ)
  have hdimJ : ∀ x ∈ moduleSheafSupport (pushUnit J), height x ≤ e := by
    rw [moduleSheafSupport_pushUnit]
    rintro _ ⟨v, rfl⟩
    rw [height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion, ← hη]
    exact LFA.height_le_genericPoint_lfa v
  obtain ⟨-, -, htd, hdeg⟩ := chPn_leading_of_gate k N hN
    (RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.leadingCycleGate k N hN) (pushUnit J) hFJ e heN hdimJ y hy'
  have hA := hamb hV N J x0 y hy
  
  have hcomp : DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k N) m) e (chFund k N y) =
      c • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (J (genericPoint V)) e hJη) :
        DimChow (space k N) e)) := by
    rw [← htd, chFund_apply, ← hA, LFA.component_totalPushOn, hc, map_smul,
      push_fundGen J e hJη hη]
  have hlof : DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k N) m) e
      (DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k N) m) e (chFund k N y)) =
      c • cycPn k N (pushUnit J) hFJ e := by
    rw [hcomp, map_smul, cycPn_pushUnit_integral k N J hFJ e hJη]
  rw [hlof, map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at hdeg
  have hc1 : c = 1 :=
    RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.eq_one_of_mul_degPn_cycPn_pushUnit k N J hFJ e hJη c hdeg
  
  have hX' : τ X (g0ClassOf X (pushUnit ι) hF) = totalPushOn (opsK k) ι t := by
    rw [← hpush ι hF, ht]
    exact hcov hX hV ι x0
  refine ⟨fun m hm ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hX', LFA.component_totalPushOn, hup m hm, map_zero]
  · rw [hX', LFA.component_totalPushOn, hc, hc1, one_smul, push_fundGen ι e he hη]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.Statement.leading_of_ambient
statement:
theorem leading_of_ambient {C : SchemeClass k} {τ : TauFamily k}
    (hC : ClosedUnderIntegral C) (hcov : ClosedCovariant C τ) (hamb : AmbientIdentity C τ)
    (hdev : ∀ {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)]
      [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (ProjK k X)], C X → ∀ d : ℕ, G0Devissage X d) :
    LeadingClause C τ
proof:
:= by
  intro X _ _ _ _ hX F hF d hd
  let T : G0Le X d →+ TotalChow X := (τ X).comp (G0Le.toG0 X d)
  let A : ∀ m : ℕ, G0Le X d →+ RationalDimChow X m := fun m ↦
    (DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) m).toAddMonoidHom.comp T
  let B : G0Le X d →+ RationalDimChow X d :=
    A d - (TensorProduct.mk ℤ ℚ (DimChow X d) 1).toAddMonoidHom.comp (topChowG0 X d)
  
  have hgen : ∀ w ∈ {w | ∃ (V : Scheme.{u}) (_ : IsIntegral V) (_ : IsNoetherian V) (ι : V ⟶ X)
      (_ : IsClosedImmersion ι) (h : IsCoherentDimLE X d (pushUnit ι)),
      w = ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf X.Modules (IsCoherentDimLE X d) (pushUnit ι) h},
      (∀ m, d < m → A m w = 0) ∧ B w = 0 := by
    rintro w ⟨V, hVi, hVn, ι, hι, h, rfl⟩
    letI : V.Over (Spk k) := ⟨ι ≫ X ↘ Spk k⟩
    haveI : ι.IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨rfl⟩
    haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (V ↘ Spk k) :=
      inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType (ι ≫ X ↘ Spk k))
    have hmemη : ι (genericPoint V) ∈ moduleSheafSupport (pushUnit ι) := by
      rw [moduleSheafSupport_pushUnit]; exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hle := h.2 _ hmemη
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e : ℕ, height (ι (genericPoint V)) = e :=
      ⟨(height (ι (genericPoint V))).toNat,
        (ENat.coe_toNat (ne_top_of_le_ne_top (ENat.coe_ne_top d) hle)).symm⟩
    have hed : e ≤ d := by rw [he] at hle; exact_mod_cast hle
    obtain ⟨htop, hlead⟩ := top_pushUnit_of_ambient hC hcov hamb hX ι h.1 e he
    have hT : T (ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf X.Modules (IsCoherentDimLE X d)
        (pushUnit ι) h) = τ X (g0ClassOf X (pushUnit ι) h.1) := by
      simp only [T, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, G0Le.toG0_classOf]
    refine ⟨fun m hm ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [A, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, hT]
      exact htop m (lt_of_le_of_lt hed hm)
    · simp only [B, A, AddMonoidHom.sub_apply, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, hT, topChowG0_classOf,
        LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe, TensorProduct.mk_apply]
      rcases hed.eq_or_lt with rfl | hlt
      · rw [hlead, coherentCycle_pushUnit_integral ι h.1 e he, sub_self]
      · have hz : coherentCycle (pushUnit ι) h.1 d = 0 := by
          apply Subtype.ext
          ext x
          rw [coherentCycle_apply, coherentCoeff, if_neg]
          · rfl
          rintro ⟨hx, hmax⟩
          have hxs := hmax.prop
          rw [moduleSheafSupport_pushUnit] at hxs
          obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hxs
          have h1 := LFA.height_le_genericPoint_lfa v
          rw [← height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion ι v, ← height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion ι,
            hx, he] at h1
          have : d ≤ e := by exact_mod_cast h1
          omega
        rw [htop d hlt, hz, QuotientAddGroup.mk_zero, TensorProduct.tmul_zero, sub_zero]
  have hcl : ∀ z, z ∈ AddSubgroup.closure {w | ∃ (V : Scheme.{u}) (_ : IsIntegral V)
      (_ : IsNoetherian V) (ι : V ⟶ X) (_ : IsClosedImmersion ι)
      (h : IsCoherentDimLE X d (pushUnit ι)),
      w = ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf X.Modules (IsCoherentDimLE X d) (pushUnit ι) h} →
      (∀ m, d < m → A m z = 0) ∧ B z = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    refine ⟨fun m hm ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hle : AddSubgroup.closure _ ≤ (A m).ker :=
        (AddSubgroup.closure_le _).mpr fun w hw ↦ (hgen w hw).1 m hm
      exact hle hz
    · have hle : AddSubgroup.closure _ ≤ B.ker :=
        (AddSubgroup.closure_le _).mpr fun w hw ↦ (hgen w hw).2
      exact hle hz
  have hFd : IsCoherentDimLE X d F := ⟨hF, hd⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hzdef⟩ : ∃ z, z = ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf X.Modules
      (IsCoherentDimLE X d) F hFd := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := hcl z (hdev hX d z)
  have hT : T z = τ X (g0ClassOf X F hF) := by
    rw [hzdef]
    simp only [T, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, G0Le.toG0_classOf]
  refine ⟨fun m hm ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hT]
    exact hA m hm
  · have hB' : DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) d (T z) -
        (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] topChowG0 X d z = 0 := hB
    rw [hT, hzdef, topChowG0_classOf] at hB'
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hB'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.CaseIProjSingular.push_tdLine_ch_twist_pull
statement:
theorem push_tdLine_ch_twist_pull (t : ℤ) (β : TotalChow V) :
    haveI
proof:
:= factY k hV
    haveI := factCover (n := b) k hV
    totalPushOn (opsV4 k) (cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).toBase
      (((tdLine k ((cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
          ((cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)) ^ (b + 1))
        (chBundle k (closedPosV4 k) ((cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).canonicalTwistingSheaf t)
          (pullZ k (cover (V ↘ Spk k) b) (cover_card k) β))) =
      Ring.choose ((t : ℚ) + b) b • β := by
  haveI := factY k hV
  haveI := factCover (n := b) k hV
  exact eval_twist k (cover (V ↘ Spk k) b) (cover_card k) t _
    ((cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf t)
    (capTwist k (cover (V ↘ Spk k) b) (hposOf _ (cover_card k)) t) β

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.CaseIProjSingular.push_tdLine_ch_twist_pull_of_le
statement:
theorem push_tdLine_ch_twist_pull_of_le (t : ℤ) (ht0 : -(b : ℤ) ≤ t) (ht : t ≤ 0)
    (β : TotalChow V) :
    haveI
proof:
:= factY k hV
    haveI := factCover (n := b) k hV
    totalPushOn (opsV4 k) (cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).toBase
      (((tdLine k ((cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
          ((cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)) ^ (b + 1))
        (chBundle k (closedPosV4 k) ((cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).canonicalTwistingSheaf t)
          (pullZ k (cover (V ↘ Spk k) b) (cover_card k) β))) =
      if t = 0 then β else 0 := by
  rw [push_tdLine_ch_twist_pull k hV b t β, choose_twist t ht0 ht]
  by_cases h0 : t = 0 <;> simp [h0]

statement:
theorem push_tdLineK_chT2_twist_pull (t : ℤ) (β : TotalChow V) :
    totalPushOn (opsK k) (cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).toBase
      (((tdLineK k ((cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
          ((cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)) ^ (b + 1))
        (chBundleT2 k ((cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).canonicalTwistingSheaf t)
          (totalPullOn (opsK k) (cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).toBase b (cover_pureRelDim k b) β))) =
      Ring.choose ((t : ℚ) + b) b • β
proof:
:= by
  have hV := projectiveIntegralK_base k (V := V)
  haveI := factY k hV

  exact push_tdLine_ch_twist_pull k hV b t β

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.CaseIProjSingular.fundClass_cover_eq_pull
statement:
theorem fundClass_cover_eq_pull :
    haveI
proof:
:= factY k (projectiveIntegralK_base k (V := V))
    haveI := factCover (n := b) k (projectiveIntegralK_base k (V := V))
    fundClass k (W := (cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).scheme) =
      totalPullOn (opsK k) (cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).toBase b (cover_pureRelDim k b)
        (fundClass k (W := V)) := by
  haveI := factY k (projectiveIntegralK_base k (V := V))
  haveI := factCover (n := b) k (projectiveIntegralK_base k (V := V))
  exact fundClass_scheme_eq_pull k (cover (V ↘ Spk k) b) (cover_card k)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.CaseIProjSingular.push_tdLineK_chT2_twist_fund
statement:
theorem push_tdLineK_chT2_twist_fund (t : ℤ) :
    haveI
proof:
:= factY k (projectiveIntegralK_base k (V := V))

    totalPushOn (opsK k) (cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).toBase
      (((tdLineK k ((cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
          ((cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)) ^ (b + 1))
        (chBundleT2 k ((cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).canonicalTwistingSheaf t)
          (fundClass k (W := (cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).scheme)))) =
      Ring.choose ((t : ℚ) + b) b • fundClass k (W := V) := by
  haveI := factY k (projectiveIntegralK_base k (V := V))
  haveI := factCover (n := b) k (projectiveIntegralK_base k (V := V))
  rw [fundClass_cover_eq_pull k b]
  exact push_tdLineK_chT2_twist_pull k b t _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.CaseIProjSingular.push_tdLineK_chT2_twist_fund_of_le
statement:
theorem push_tdLineK_chT2_twist_fund_of_le (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ b) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.CaseIProjSingular.push_tdLineK_chK0T2_gen
statement:
theorem push_tdLineK_chK0T2_gen (e : K0 V) (t : ℤ) (ht0 : -(b : ℤ) ≤ t) (ht : t ≤ 0) :
    haveI
proof:
:= factY k (projectiveIntegralK_base k (V := V))
    haveI := factCover (n := b) k (projectiveIntegralK_base k (V := V))
    haveI : ConnectedSpace (cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).scheme :=
      haveI := isIntegral_cover k (V := V) b
      connectedSpace_of_isIntegral
    haveI : ConnectedSpace V := connectedSpace_of_isIntegral
    totalPushOn (opsK k) (cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).toBase
      (((tdLineK k ((cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
          ((cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)) ^ (b + 1))
        (chK0T2 k ((cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).projectiveBundlePullbackK0 (hposOf _ (cover_card k)) e *
            (cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class t)
          (fundClass k (W := (cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).scheme)))) =
      if t = 0 then chK0T2 k e (fundClass k (W := V)) else 0 := by
  haveI := factY k (projectiveIntegralK_base k (V := V))
  haveI := factCover (n := b) k (projectiveIntegralK_base k (V := V))
  haveI : ConnectedSpace (cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).scheme :=
    haveI := isIntegral_cover k (V := V) b
    connectedSpace_of_isIntegral
  haveI : ConnectedSpace V := connectedSpace_of_isIntegral
  rw [chK0T2_eq_chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chExact_closedPosV4 k),
    chK0T2_eq_chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chExact_closedPosV4 k), tdLineK_eq_tdLine]
  exact rhs_gen k (cover (V ↘ Spk k) b) (cover_card k) (chExact_closedPosV4 k) e t ht0 ht

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.CaseIProjSingular.caseI_cover_coeff
statement:
theorem caseI_cover_coeff (hb : 0 < b) (c : Fin (b + 1) → K0 V) :
    haveI
proof:
:= factY k (projectiveIntegralK_base k (V := V))
    haveI := factCover (n := b) k (projectiveIntegralK_base k (V := V))
    haveI : ConnectedSpace (cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).scheme :=
      haveI := isIntegral_cover k (V := V) b
      connectedSpace_of_isIntegral
    haveI : ConnectedSpace V := connectedSpace_of_isIntegral
    projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward (cover_rank (V ↘ Spk k) hb)
        (k0ToG0 _ (∑ i : Fin (b + 1),
          (cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).projectiveBundlePullbackK0 (hposOf _ (cover_card k)) (c i) *
            (cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-(b : ℤ) + ((i : ℕ) : ℤ)))) =
        k0ToG0 V (c (Fin.last b)) ∧
      totalPushOn (opsK k) (cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).toBase
        (((tdLineK k ((cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
            ((cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)) ^ (b + 1))
          (chK0T2 k (∑ i : Fin (b + 1),
            (cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).projectiveBundlePullbackK0 (hposOf _ (cover_card k)) (c i) *
              (cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-(b : ℤ) + ((i : ℕ) : ℤ)))
            (fundClass k (W := (cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).scheme)))) =
        chK0T2 k (c (Fin.last b)) (fundClass k (W := V)) := by
  haveI := factY k (projectiveIntegralK_base k (V := V))
  haveI := factCover (n := b) k (projectiveIntegralK_base k (V := V))
  haveI : ConnectedSpace (cover (V ↘ Spk k) b).scheme :=
    haveI := isIntegral_cover k (V := V) b
    connectedSpace_of_isIntegral
  haveI : ConnectedSpace V := connectedSpace_of_isIntegral
  have hb' : ∀ i : Fin (b + 1), -(b : ℤ) ≤ -(b : ℤ) + ((i : ℕ) : ℤ) ∧
      -(b : ℤ) + ((i : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ 0 := fun i ↦ by
    have := i.isLt
    omega
  have hiff : ∀ i : Fin (b + 1), (-(b : ℤ) + ((i : ℕ) : ℤ) = 0 ↔ i = Fin.last b) := fun i ↦ by
    rw [Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_last]
    omega
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [map_sum, map_sum]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ piShriek_gen (cover (V ↘ Spk k) b)
      (hposOf _ (cover_card k)) (cover_hasConstantRank (Y := V) b) (cover_rank (V ↘ Spk k) hb)
      (c i) _ (hb' i).1 (hb' i).2]
    rw [← map_sum]
    congr 1
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (Fin.last b)]
    · rw [if_pos ((hiff _).2 rfl)]
    · intro i _ hi
      rw [if_neg (fun h ↦ hi ((hiff i).1 h))]
    · intro h
      exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h
  · rw [map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply, map_sum, map_sum]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ push_tdLineK_chK0T2_gen k b (c i) _ (hb' i).1 (hb' i).2]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (Fin.last b)]
    · rw [if_pos ((hiff _).2 rfl)]
    · intro i _ hi
      rw [if_neg (fun h ↦ hi ((hiff i).1 h))]
    · intro h
      exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.domX_push_classTot
statement:
theorem domX_push_classTot {m : ℕ} (D : dimensionCycles (WX (k := k) C ι) m) :
    haveI
proof:
:= domX_isOver C C₁ ι β hβ
    haveI : IsProper (domX C C₁ ι β hβ) := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
    totalPushOn (opsK k) (domX C C₁ ι β hβ) (classTot (WX (k := k) C ι) m D) =
      classTot (WX (k := k) C₁ ι) m (D13.pfHom (k := k) (domX C C₁ ι β hβ) m D) := by
  haveI := domX_isOver C C₁ ι β hβ
  haveI : IsProper (domX C C₁ ι β hβ) := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
  change totalPushOn (opsK k) (domX C C₁ ι β hβ)
      (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow (WX (k := k) C ι) n) m
        ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow (WX (k := k) C ι) m))) =
    DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow (WX (k := k) C₁ ι) n) m
      ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (D13.pfHom (k := k) (domX C C₁ ι β hβ) m D) :
        DimChow (WX (k := k) C₁ ι) m))
  unfold totalPushOn
  rw [DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  congr 1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.push_outX_dom
statement:
theorem push_outX_dom {m : ℕ} (D : dimensionCycles (WX (k := k) C ι) m) :
    haveI
proof:
:= domX_isOver C C₁ ι β hβ
    haveI : IsProper (domX C C₁ ι β hβ) := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
    totalPushOn (opsK k) (ηX (k := k) C ι)
        (altCh k (fun j ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (jX (k := k) C ι)).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback β).obj (C₁.xi (k := k) j))) C₁.K.len
          (classTot (WX (k := k) C ι) m D)) =
      outX (k := k) C₁ ι m (D13.pfHom (k := k) (domX C C₁ ι β hβ) m D) := by
  haveI := domX_isOver C C₁ ι β hβ
  haveI : IsProper (domX C C₁ ι β hβ) := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
  have hop : altCh k (fun j ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (jX (k := k) C ι)).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback β).obj (C₁.xi (k := k) j))) C₁.K.len =
      altCh k (fun j ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (domX C C₁ ι β hβ)).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (jX (k := k) C₁ ι)).obj (C₁.xi (k := k) j))) C₁.K.len := by
    unfold altCh
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
    congr 1
    exact chK_iso_g2tmi (domSquareIso C C₁ ι β hβ (C₁.xi (k := k) j))
  rw [hop, ← totalPushOn_congr (opsK k) (domX_ηX C C₁ ι β hβ), totalPushOn_comp,
    LinearMap.comp_apply,
    altCh_push (domX C C₁ ι β hβ)
      (fun j ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (jX (k := k) C₁ ι)).obj (C₁.xi (k := k) j)) C₁.rank
      (fun j ↦ hasConstantRank_pullback _ (jX (k := k) C₁ ι) _ _
        (C₁.hasConstantRank_xi (k := k) j)),
    domX_push_classTot]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.domX_restrict_eq
statement:
theorem domX_restrict_eq {m : ℕ} (D : dimensionCycles (C.graphModel (k := k)) m)
    (hD : ∀ w, D.1 w ≠ 0 → w ∈ Set.range (jX (k := k) C ι)) :
    haveI
proof:
:= domX_isOver C C₁ ι β hβ
    haveI : IsProper (domX C C₁ ι β hβ) := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
    haveI := dom_isOver C C₁ β hβ
    haveI : IsProper β := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
    D13.pfHom (k := k) (domX C C₁ ι β hβ) m (G2T2C.restrictHom (jX (k := k) C ι) m D) =
      G2T2C.restrictHom (jX (k := k) C₁ ι) m (D13.pfHom (k := k) β m D) := by
  haveI := domX_isOver C C₁ ι β hβ
  haveI : IsProper (domX C C₁ ι β hβ) := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
  haveI := dom_isOver C C₁ β hβ
  haveI : IsProper β := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
  apply Subtype.ext
  change properPushforward (domX C C₁ ι β hβ)
      (F13.restrictCycle (jX (k := k) C ι) (jX (k := k) C ι).isEmbedding.injective D.1) =
    F13.restrictCycle (jX (k := k) C₁ ι) (jX (k := k) C₁ ι).isEmbedding.injective
      (properPushforward β D.1)
  have hsupp : ∀ w, w ∉ Set.range (jX (k := k) C ι) → D.1 w = 0 := by
    intro w hw
    by_contra hne
    exact hw (hD w hne)
  rw [← G2T2C.restrictCycle_properPushforward (jX (k := k) C₁ ι)
      (properPushforward (domX C C₁ ι β hβ) _),
    ← properPushforward_comp, properPushforward_congr (domX_jX C C₁ ι β hβ),
    properPushforward_comp, F13.properPushforward_restrictCycle _ _ hsupp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.gammaPt_specializes_dom
statement:
theorem gammaPt_specializes_dom (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U)
    (hC₁ : C₁.SectionExactOn U) (hU : (U : Set M).Nonempty) :
    C₁.gammaPt (k := k) U hC₁ hU ⤳ β (C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU)
proof:
:= by
  refine C₁.gammaPt_specializes (k := k) U hC₁ hU ?_ ?_
  · have h := gammaPt_mem_support (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex U
      (C.isSplitOn_of_sectionExactOn U hC) hU
    rw [infDivisor, Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_comap] at h ⊢
    show graphToP1 (k := k) C₁.toDetIdealComplex (β (C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU)) ∈
      (CIIB6.infIdeal k).support
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, dom_toP1 C C₁ β hβ]
    exact h
  · change (β ≫ C₁.graphProj (k := k)) (C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU) ∈ U
    have h : β ≫ C₁.graphProj (k := k) = C.graphProj (k := k) := by
      simp only [RankedBundleComplex.graphProj]
      rw [← Category.assoc, hβ]
    rw [h]
    exact C.xiProj_gammaPt_mem (k := k) U hC hU

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.pfHom_gammaCycle_support
statement:
theorem pfHom_gammaCycle_support (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U)
    (hC₁ : C₁.SectionExactOn U) (hU : (U : Set M).Nonempty) {n : ℕ}
    (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    haveI
proof:
:= dom_isOver C C₁ β hβ
    haveI : IsProper β := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
    ∀ x, (D13.pfHom (k := k) β n (gammaCycle (k := k) C U hC hM)).1 x ≠ 0 →
      x ∈ closure {C₁.gammaPt (k := k) U hC₁ hU} := by
  haveI := dom_isOver C C₁ β hβ
  haveI : IsProper β := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
  intro x hx
  have hg : gammaCycle (k := k) C U hC hM = dimPrimeCycle (C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU) n
      (height_gammaPt (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex U (C.isSplitOn_of_sectionExactOn U hC) hU hM) :=
    dif_pos hU
  rw [hg] at hx
  change properPushforward β (dimPrimeCycle _ n _).1 x ≠ 0 at hx
  rw [D16.pf_prime_apply] at hx
  by_cases hbx : β (C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU) = x
  · rw [← hbx]
    exact specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp (gammaPt_specializes_dom (k := k) C C₁ β hβ U hC hC₁ hU)
  · rw [if_neg hbx] at hx
    exact absurd rfl hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.outX_push_rCycle
statement:
theorem outX_push_rCycle (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) (hC₁ : C₁.SectionExactOn U)
    (hU : (U : Set M).Nonempty) {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n)
    (hinf : haveI := dom_isOver C C₁ β hβ
      haveI : IsProper β := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
      D13.pfHom (k := k) β n (infDimCycle (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex (hW_tlmap (k := k) C hM)) =
        infDimCycle (k := k) C₁.toDetIdealComplex (hW_tlmap (k := k) C₁ hM)) :
    haveI
proof:
:= dom_isOver C C₁ β hβ
    haveI : IsProper β := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
    outX (k := k) C₁ ι n (G2T2C.restrictHom (jX (k := k) C₁ ι) n
        (D13.pfHom (k := k) β n (rCycle (k := k) C U hC hM))) =
      tauRaw (k := k) C₁ ι U hC₁ hM := by
  haveI := dom_isOver C C₁ β hβ
  haveI : IsProper β := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
  rw [← lCyc_eq_outX (k := k) C₁ ι U hC₁ hU, rCycle, map_sub, map_sub, hinf,
    ← tauRaw_eq_lCyc (k := k) C₁ ι U hC₁ hU hM,
    lCyc_eq_zero_of_support (k := k) C₁ ι _ _
      (pfHom_gammaCycle_support (k := k) C C₁ β hβ U hC hC₁ hU hM), sub_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.opWX_eq_add
statement:
theorem opWX_eq_add (h : XiSumSplit C C₁ C₂ β₁ β₂) :
    opWX (k := k) C ι =
      altCh k (fun j ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (jX (k := k) C ι)).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback β₁).obj (C₁.xi (k := k) j))) C₁.K.len +
        altCh k (fun j ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (jX (k := k) C ι)).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback β₂).obj (C₂.xi (k := k) j))) C₂.K.len
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂, hξ⟩ := h
  rw [h₁, h₂]
  unfold opWX altCh
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
  have hj : chK k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (jX (k := k) C ι)).obj (C.xi (k := k) j)) =
      chK k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (jX (k := k) C ι)).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback β₁).obj (C₁.xi (k := k) j))) +
        chK k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (jX (k := k) C ι)).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback β₂).obj (C₂.xi (k := k) j))) := by
    rw [chK_iso_g2tmi ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (jX (k := k) C ι)).mapIso (hξ j).some ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (jX (k := k) C ι)).mapBiprod _ _)]
    exact chK_biprod_g2tbiva
      (hasConstantRank_pullback _ (jX (k := k) C ι) _ _
        (hasConstantRank_pullback _ β₁ _ _ (C₁.hasConstantRank_xi (k := k) j)))
      (hasConstantRank_pullback _ (jX (k := k) C ι) _ _
        (hasConstantRank_pullback _ β₂ _ _ (C₂.hasConstantRank_xi (k := k) j)))
  beta_reduce
  rw [hj]
  exact smul_add _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.tauRaw_sum
statement:
theorem tauRaw_sum (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) (hC₁ : C₁.SectionExactOn U)
    (hC₂ : C₂.SectionExactOn U) (hU : (U : Set M).Nonempty)
    (hX : ∀ x : M, x ∉ U → x ∈ Set.range ι) {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n)
    (hξ : XiSumSplit C C₁ C₂ β₁ β₂)
    (hinf₁ : haveI := dom_isOver C C₁ β₁ hβ₁
      haveI : IsProper β₁ := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
      D13.pfHom (k := k) β₁ n (infDimCycle (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex (hW_tlmap (k := k) C hM)) =
        infDimCycle (k := k) C₁.toDetIdealComplex (hW_tlmap (k := k) C₁ hM))
    (hinf₂ : haveI := dom_isOver C C₂ β₂ hβ₂
      haveI : IsProper β₂ := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
      D13.pfHom (k := k) β₂ n (infDimCycle (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex (hW_tlmap (k := k) C hM)) =
        infDimCycle (k := k) C₂.toDetIdealComplex (hW_tlmap (k := k) C₂ hM)) :
    tauRaw (k := k) C ι U hC hM = tauRaw (k := k) C₁ ι U hC₁ hM + tauRaw (k := k) C₂ ι U hC₂ hM
proof:
:= by
  have hsupp : ∀ w, (rCycle (k := k) C U hC hM).1 w ≠ 0 → w ∈ Set.range (jX (k := k) C ι) := by
    intro w hw
    rw [range_jX]
    exact hX _ (rCycle_support (k := k) C U hC hM w hw)
  have hτ : tauRaw (k := k) C ι U hC hM = totalPushOn (opsK k) (ηX (k := k) C ι)
      (opWX (k := k) C ι (classTot (WX (k := k) C ι) n (rhoX (k := k) C ι U hC hM))) := rfl
  rw [hτ, opWX_eq_add (k := k) C C₁ C₂ ι β₁ β₂ hξ, LinearMap.add_apply, map_add,
    push_outX_dom (k := k) C C₁ ι β₁ hβ₁, push_outX_dom (k := k) C C₂ ι β₂ hβ₂, rhoX,
    domX_restrict_eq (k := k) C C₁ ι β₁ hβ₁ _ hsupp,
    domX_restrict_eq (k := k) C C₂ ι β₂ hβ₂ _ hsupp,
    outX_push_rCycle (k := k) C C₁ ι β₁ hβ₁ U hC hC₁ hU hM hinf₁,
    outX_push_rCycle (k := k) C C₂ ι β₂ hβ₂ U hC hC₂ hU hM hinf₂]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.tauRaw_additive
statement:
theorem tauRaw_additive (U U₀ : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) (hC₀ : C₀.SectionExactOn U₀)
    (hC₁ : C₁.SectionExactOn U₀) (hC₂ : C₂.SectionExactOn U₀) (hU₀ : (U₀ : Set M).Nonempty)
    (hX₀ : ∀ x : M, x ∉ U₀ → x ∈ Set.range ι) {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n)
    (hspec : ReesSpecialization (k := k) C C₀ ι U U₀ hC hC₀ hM)
    (β₁ : C₀.graphModel (k := k) ⟶ C₁.graphModel (k := k))
    (hβ₁ : β₁ ≫ graphToBase (k := k) C₁.toDetIdealComplex =
      graphToBase (k := k) C₀.toDetIdealComplex)
    (β₂ : C₀.graphModel (k := k) ⟶ C₂.graphModel (k := k))
    (hβ₂ : β₂ ≫ graphToBase (k := k) C₂.toDetIdealComplex =
      graphToBase (k := k) C₀.toDetIdealComplex)
    (hξ : XiSumSplit C₀ C₁ C₂ β₁ β₂)
    (hinf₁ : haveI := dom_isOver C₀ C₁ β₁ hβ₁
      haveI : IsProper β₁ := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
      D13.pfHom (k := k) β₁ n (infDimCycle (k := k) C₀.toDetIdealComplex
        (hW_tlmap (k := k) C₀ hM)) =
        infDimCycle (k := k) C₁.toDetIdealComplex (hW_tlmap (k := k) C₁ hM))
    (hinf₂ : haveI := dom_isOver C₀ C₂ β₂ hβ₂
      haveI : IsProper β₂ := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
      D13.pfHom (k := k) β₂ n (infDimCycle (k := k) C₀.toDetIdealComplex
        (hW_tlmap (k := k) C₀ hM)) =
        infDimCycle (k := k) C₂.toDetIdealComplex (hW_tlmap (k := k) C₂ hM)) :
    tauRaw (k := k) C ι U hC hM =
      tauRaw (k := k) C₁ ι U₀ hC₁ hM + tauRaw (k := k) C₂ ι U₀ hC₂ hM
proof:
:= by
  rw [hspec]
  exact tauRaw_sum (k := k) C₀ C₁ C₂ ι β₁ hβ₁ β₂ hβ₂ U₀ hC₀ hC₁ hC₂ hU₀ hX₀ hM hξ hinf₁ hinf₂

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.splitShiftD_dd
statement:
theorem splitShiftD_dd (K : _root_.SingTau.BundleComplex M) :
    ∀ j, splitShiftD K (j + 1) ≫ splitShiftD K j = 0
  | 0 => comp_zero
  | j + 1 => by
    change (-K.d (j + 1)) ≫ (-K.d j) = 0
    rw [Preadditive.neg_comp_neg]
    exact K.dd j

                                             
def splitShiftK (K : _root_.SingTau.BundleComplex M) (hz : IsFiniteLocallyFree M 0) :
    _root_.SingTau.BundleComplex M where
  len
proof:
:= K.len + 1
  E := splitShiftE K
  d := splitShiftD K
  dd := splitShiftD_dd K
  hE j := match j with
    | 0 => hz
    | j + 1 => K.hE j
  isZero_E j hj := match j, hj with
    | 0, hj => absurd hj (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
    | j + 1, hj => K.isZero_E j (by omega)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.splitShift_E_succ
statement: theorem splitShift_E_succ (j : ℕ) : (splitShift C hz).K.E (j + 1) = C.K.E j
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.splitShift_d_succ
statement: theorem splitShift_d_succ (j : ℕ) : (splitShift C hz).K.d (j + 1) = -C.K.d j
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.sec_zero_subsingleton_g2tr1b
statement:
theorem sec_zero_subsingleton_g2tr1b (V : M.Opens) (s t : (0 : M.Modules).val.obj (op V)) :
    s = t
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ x : (0 : M.Modules).val.obj (op V), x = 0 := fun x => by
    have h1 : (𝟙 (0 : M.Modules)) = 0 := (isZero_zero _).eq_of_src _ _
    have h2 := congrArg (fun f => sectionMap f V x) h1
    exact h2
  rw [h s, h t]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.sec_neg_g2tr1b
statement:
theorem sec_neg_g2tr1b {A B : M.Modules} (f : A ⟶ B) (V : M.Opens) (x : A.val.obj (op V)) :
    sectionMap (-f) V x = -sectionMap f V x
proof:
:= by
  have h := sectionMap_add_g2tbiva f (-f) V x
  rw [add_neg_cancel, sectionMap_zero_g2tbiva] at h
  exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right h.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.sec_splitShift_d_succ
statement:
theorem sec_splitShift_d_succ (j : ℕ) (V : M.Opens) (x : (C.K.E (j + 1)).val.obj (op V)) :
    sectionMap ((splitShift C hz).K.d (j + 1)) V x = -sectionMap (C.K.d j) V x
proof:
:=
  sec_neg_g2tr1b (C.K.d j) V x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.sec_splitShift_zero
statement:
theorem sec_splitShift_zero (V : M.Opens) (s t : ((splitShift C hz).K.E 0).val.obj (op V)) :
    s = t
proof:
:=
  sec_zero_subsingleton_g2tr1b V s t

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.sectionExactOn_splitShift
statement:
theorem sectionExactOn_splitShift {U : M.Opens} (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) :
    (splitShift C hz).SectionExactOn U
proof:
:= by
  intro V hV
  obtain ⟨s, e⟩ := hC V hV
  refine ⟨fun y => ⟨0, sec_splitShift_zero C hz V.1 _ _⟩, fun j => ?_⟩
  cases j with
  | zero =>
    intro y
    refine ⟨fun _ => ?_, fun _ => sec_splitShift_zero C hz V.1 _ _⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := s y
    refine ⟨-x, ?_⟩
    rw [sec_splitShift_d_succ, map_neg, neg_neg]
    exact hx
  | succ j =>
    intro y
    have hy : sectionMap ((splitShift C hz).K.d (j + 1)) V.1 y = -sectionMap (C.K.d j) V.1 y :=
      sec_splitShift_d_succ C hz j V.1 y
    constructor
    · intro h0
      have h1 : sectionMap (C.K.d j) V.1 y = 0 := by
        rw [h0] at hy
        exact neg_eq_zero.mp hy.symm
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := ((e j) y).1 h1
      refine ⟨-x, ?_⟩
      rw [sec_splitShift_d_succ, map_neg, neg_neg]
      exact hx
    · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
      exact (congrArg (fun f => sectionMap f V.1 x) ((splitShift C hz).K.dd (j + 1))).trans
        (sectionMap_zero_g2tbiva _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.splitCone_sectionExact_of
statement:
theorem splitCone_sectionExact_of (V : M.Opens)
    (P0 : ∀ b : (C'.K.E 0).val.obj (op V), ∃ (b₁ : (C'.K.E 1).val.obj (op V))
      (a : (C.K.E 0).val.obj (op V)), sectionMap (C'.K.d 0) V b₁ + sectionMap (φ 0) V a = b)
    (Q0 : ∀ (b : (C'.K.E 1).val.obj (op V)) (a : (C.K.E 0).val.obj (op V)),
      sectionMap (C'.K.d 0) V b + sectionMap (φ 0) V a = 0 →
      ∃ (b' : (C'.K.E 2).val.obj (op V)) (a' : (C.K.E 1).val.obj (op V)),
        sectionMap (C'.K.d 1) V b' + sectionMap (φ 1) V a' = b ∧ -sectionMap (C.K.d 0) V a' = a)
    (Qs : ∀ (i : ℕ) (b : (C'.K.E (i + 2)).val.obj (op V)) (a : (C.K.E (i + 1)).val.obj (op V)),
      sectionMap (C'.K.d (i + 1)) V b + sectionMap (φ (i + 1)) V a = 0 →
      sectionMap (C.K.d i) V a = 0 →
      ∃ (b' : (C'.K.E (i + 3)).val.obj (op V)) (a' : (C.K.E (i + 2)).val.obj (op V)),
        sectionMap (C'.K.d (i + 2)) V b' + sectionMap (φ (i + 2)) V a' = b ∧
          -sectionMap (C.K.d (i + 1)) V a' = a) :
    Function.Surjective (sectionMap ((splitCone hz φ hφ).K.d 0) V) ∧
      ∀ j, Function.Exact (sectionMap ((splitCone hz φ hφ).K.d (j + 1)) V)
        (sectionMap ((splitCone hz φ hφ).K.d j) V)
proof:
:= by
  let c := splitConeCocycle hz φ hφ
  refine ⟨fun y => ?_, fun j y => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨b₁, a, h⟩ := P0 (sectionMap biprod.fst V y)
    refine ⟨sectionMap biprod.inl V b₁ +
      sectionMap (biprod.inr : (splitShift C hz).K.E 1 ⟶ _) V a, ?_⟩
    change sectionMap (extD C' (splitShift C hz) c 0) V _ = y
    refine sec_biprod_ext_g2trees V _ _ ?_ (sec_splitShift_zero C hz V _ _)
    rw [sec_extD_fst]
    erw [sec_fst_add_g2trees, sec_snd_add_g2trees]
    exact h
  · change sectionMap (extD C' (splitShift C hz) c j) V y = 0 ↔
      y ∈ Set.range (sectionMap (extD C' (splitShift C hz) c (j + 1)) V)
    constructor
    · intro hy
      have hf : sectionMap (C'.K.d j) V (sectionMap biprod.fst V y) +
          sectionMap (c.h j) V (sectionMap biprod.snd V y) = 0 := by
        rw [← sec_extD_fst, hy, map_zero]
      have hs : sectionMap ((splitShift C hz).K.d j) V (sectionMap biprod.snd V y) = 0 := by
        rw [← sec_extD_snd, hy, map_zero]
      have key : ∃ (b' : (C'.K.E (j + 2)).val.obj (op V)) (a' : (C.K.E (j + 1)).val.obj (op V)),
          sectionMap (C'.K.d (j + 1)) V b' + sectionMap (φ (j + 1)) V a' =
            sectionMap biprod.fst V y ∧
          -sectionMap (C.K.d j) V a' = sectionMap biprod.snd V y := by
        cases j with
        | zero => exact Q0 _ _ hf
        | succ i =>
          refine Qs i _ _ hf ?_
          have hs' := hs
          erw [sec_splitShift_d_succ] at hs'
          exact neg_eq_zero.mp hs'
      obtain ⟨b', a', h1, h2⟩ := key
      refine ⟨sectionMap biprod.inl V b' +
        sectionMap (biprod.inr : (splitShift C hz).K.E (j + 2) ⟶ _) V a', ?_⟩
      refine sec_biprod_ext_g2trees V _ _ ?_ ?_
      · rw [sec_extD_fst]
        erw [sec_fst_add_g2trees, sec_snd_add_g2trees]
        exact h1
      · rw [sec_extD_snd]
        erw [sec_snd_add_g2trees, sec_splitShift_d_succ]
        exact h2
    · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
      have hdd := congrArg (fun f ↦ sectionMap f V x) (extD_dd C' (splitShift C hz) c j)
      exact hdd.trans (sectionMap_zero_g2tbiva _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.splitCone_id_chain
statement: theorem splitCone_id_chain (j : ℕ) : C.K.d j ≫ 𝟙 (C.K.E j) = 𝟙 (C.K.E (j + 1)) ≫ C.K.d j
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.splitCone_id_sectionExactOn_top
statement:
theorem splitCone_id_sectionExactOn_top :
    (splitCone hz (fun j => 𝟙 (C.K.E j)) (splitCone_id_chain C)).SectionExactOn ⊤
proof:
:= by
  intro V _
  refine splitCone_sectionExact_of hz _ _ V.1 (fun b => ⟨0, b, ?_⟩) (fun b a h => ⟨0, b, ?_, ?_⟩)
    (fun i b a h _ => ⟨0, b, ?_, ?_⟩)
  · rw [map_zero, zero_add]; rfl
  · rw [map_zero, zero_add]; rfl
  · exact (eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right h).symm
  · rw [map_zero, zero_add]; rfl
  · exact (eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right h).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.resolution_eps_surjective_g2tr1b
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isQuasicoherent_of_bundle_g2tbivr (K.hE 0)
  haveI : (R.Z 0).IsFinitePresentation := R.hZ 0
  haveI : (R.Z 1).IsFinitePresentation := R.hZ 1
  have hp := (sections_SES_of_affine (R.ses 0) V).2.2
  intro g
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hp (sectionMap R.e.inv V.1 g)
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  change sectionMap (R.p 0 ≫ R.e.hom) V.1 x = g
  rw [sectionMap_comp_apply, hx, ← sectionMap_comp_apply, Iso.inv_hom_id, sectionMap_id_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.splitCone_res_sectionExactOn_top
statement:
theorem splitCone_res_sectionExactOn_top (hε : φ 0 ≫ R₁.ε = R₃.ε) :
    (splitCone hz φ hφ).SectionExactOn ⊤
proof:
:= by
  intro V _
  have h3 := resolution_sections_exact R₃ V
  have h1 := resolution_sections_exact R₁ V
  have hsurj := resolution_eps_surjective_g2tr1b R₃ V
  have hcomm : ∀ j y, sectionMap (φ j) V.1 (sectionMap (C₃.K.d j) V.1 y) =
      sectionMap (C₁.K.d j) V.1 (sectionMap (φ (j + 1)) V.1 y) := fun j y => by
    rw [← sectionMap_comp_apply, hφ, sectionMap_comp_apply]
  have hεφ : ∀ a, sectionMap R₁.ε V.1 (sectionMap (φ 0) V.1 a) = sectionMap R₃.ε V.1 a :=
    fun a => by rw [← sectionMap_comp_apply, hε]
  have hdε : ∀ b, sectionMap R₁.ε V.1 (sectionMap (C₁.K.d 0) V.1 b) = 0 := fun b => by
    rw [← sectionMap_comp_apply, R₁.d_ε]; rfl
  
  have lift : ∀ (i : ℕ) (b : (C₁.K.E (i + 1)).val.obj (op V.1))
      (a'' : (C₃.K.E (i + 1)).val.obj (op V.1)),
      sectionMap (C₁.K.d i) V.1 b + sectionMap (φ i) V.1 (sectionMap (C₃.K.d i) V.1 a'') = 0 →
      ∃ (b' : (C₁.K.E (i + 2)).val.obj (op V.1)) (a' : (C₃.K.E (i + 1)).val.obj (op V.1)),
        sectionMap (C₁.K.d (i + 1)) V.1 b' + sectionMap (φ (i + 1)) V.1 a' = b ∧
          -sectionMap (C₃.K.d i) V.1 a' = sectionMap (C₃.K.d i) V.1 a'' := by
    intro i b a'' h
    have hk : sectionMap (C₁.K.d i) V.1 (b + sectionMap (φ (i + 1)) V.1 a'') = 0 := by
      rw [map_add, ← hcomm, h]
    obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := ((h1.2 i) _).1 hk
    refine ⟨b', -a'', ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hb', map_neg, add_neg_cancel_right]
    · rw [map_neg, neg_neg]
  refine splitCone_sectionExact_of hz φ hφ V.1 (fun b => ?_) (fun b a h => ?_)
    (fun i b a h ha => ?_)
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hsurj (sectionMap R₁.ε V.1 b)
    have hk : sectionMap R₁.ε V.1 (b - sectionMap (φ 0) V.1 a) = 0 := by
      rw [map_sub, hεφ, ha, sub_self]
    obtain ⟨b₁, hb₁⟩ := h1.1 _ hk
    exact ⟨b₁, a, by rw [hb₁, sub_add_cancel]⟩
  · have hεa : sectionMap R₃.ε V.1 a = 0 := by
      rw [← hεφ, eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right h, map_neg, hdε, neg_zero]
    obtain ⟨a'', rfl⟩ := h3.1 a hεa
    exact lift 0 b a'' h
  · obtain ⟨a'', rfl⟩ := ((h3.2 i) a).1 ha
    exact lift (i + 1) b a'' h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.exists_hasConstantRank_zero_g2tr1b
statement: theorem exists_hasConstantRank_zero_g2tr1b : ∃ r₀ : ℕ, HasConstantRank M 0 r₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, N, e, he, -⟩ := id hMK
  haveI := he
  haveI : ConnectedSpace M := connectedSpace_of_isIntegral
  haveI := PerfectRepG2.Sch.isLocallyNoetherian_of_closedImmersion k N e
  have hz0 : IsFiniteLocallyFree M 0 :=
    (PerfectRepG2.Sch.setup M (PerfectRepG2.Sch.hasBundleCovers_of_closedImmersion k N e)).P_zero
      (isZero_zero _)
  exact hasConstantRank_exists_EXU hz0

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.tauStd_add_shift_of_cone
statement:
theorem tauStd_add_shift_of_cone (hsplit : TauAdditivitySplit hMK ι hM) {r₀ : ℕ}
    (hz : HasConstantRank M 0 r₀) (C C' : RankedBundleComplex M) (φ : ∀ j, C.K.E j ⟶ C'.K.E j)
    (hφ : ∀ j, C.K.d j ≫ φ j = φ (j + 1) ≫ C'.K.d j)
    (hcone : (splitCone hz φ hφ).SectionExactOn ⊤) (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U)
    (hC' : C'.SectionExactOn U) (hX : ∀ x : M, x ∉ U → x ∈ Set.range ι) :
    tauStd hMK C' ι U hC' hM +
      tauStd hMK (splitShift C hz) ι U (sectionExactOn_splitShift C hz hC) hM = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hsplit C' (splitShift C hz) (splitConeCocycle hz φ hφ) U hC'
    (sectionExactOn_splitShift C hz hC) hX]
  exact tauStd_eq_zero_of_top hMK ι _ hcone U _ hX hM

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.tauStd_splitShift
statement:
theorem tauStd_splitShift (hsplit : TauAdditivitySplit hMK ι hM) {r₀ : ℕ}
    (hz : HasConstantRank M 0 r₀) (C : RankedBundleComplex M) (U : M.Opens)
    (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) (hX : ∀ x : M, x ∉ U → x ∈ Set.range ι) :
    tauStd hMK (splitShift C hz) ι U (sectionExactOn_splitShift C hz hC) hM =
      -tauStd hMK C ι U hC hM
proof:
:=
  eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right (tauStd_add_shift_of_cone hMK ι hM hsplit hz C C _
    (splitCone_id_chain C) (splitCone_id_sectionExactOn_top hz C) U hC hC hX)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.tauStd_eq_of_chainMap_res
statement:
theorem tauStd_eq_of_chainMap_res (hsplit : TauAdditivitySplit hMK ι hM) {G : M.Modules}
    (hG : IsCoherentLike M G) (hsupp : moduleSheafSupport G ⊆ Set.range ι)
    (C₃ C₁ : RankedBundleComplex M) (R₃ : _root_.SingTau.ResolutionData (IsCoherentLike M) C₃.K G)
    (R₁ : _root_.SingTau.ResolutionData (IsCoherentLike M) C₁.K G)
    (φ : ∀ j, C₃.K.E j ⟶ C₁.K.E j) (hφ : ∀ j, C₃.K.d j ≫ φ j = φ (j + 1) ≫ C₁.K.d j)
    (hε : φ 0 ≫ R₁.ε = R₃.ε) :
    tauStd hMK C₃ ι (exactLocus G hG) (sectionExactOn_of_resolutionData C₃ R₃ hG) hM =
      tauStd hMK C₁ ι (exactLocus G hG) (sectionExactOn_of_resolutionData C₁ R₁ hG) hM
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r₀, hz⟩ := exists_hasConstantRank_zero_g2tr1b hMK
  have hX := mem_range_of_not_mem_exactLocus ι hG hsupp
  have hC₃ := sectionExactOn_of_resolutionData C₃ R₃ hG
  have hC₁ := sectionExactOn_of_resolutionData C₁ R₁ hG
  have h1 := tauStd_add_shift_of_cone hMK ι hM hsplit hz C₃ C₁ φ hφ
    (splitCone_res_sectionExactOn_top hz R₃ R₁ φ hφ hε) _ hC₃ hC₁ hX
  rw [tauStd_splitShift hMK ι hM hsplit hz C₃ _ hC₃ hX] at h1
  exact (eq_of_sub_eq_zero (by rw [sub_eq_add_neg]; exact h1)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.tauResIndep_of_split
statement:
theorem tauResIndep_of_split (hsplit : TauAdditivitySplit hMK ι hM) :
    TauResIndep hMK ι hM hreg
proof:
:= by
  intro G hG hsupp C R U hC hX
  rw [tauStd_indep hMK ι C U (exactLocus G hG) hC (sectionExactOn_of_resolutionData C R hG) hX
    (mem_range_of_not_mem_exactLocus ι hG hsupp) hM]
  obtain ⟨-, N, e, he, -⟩ := id hMK
  haveI := he
  haveI : ConnectedSpace M := connectedSpace_of_isIntegral
  obtain ⟨K₃, R₃, φ₁, φ₂, -, -, -, hc₁, hc₂, hε₁, hε₂⟩ :=
    _root_.SingTau.dominate_of_regular k N e hreg hG (chosenResData hMK hreg G hG) R
  let C₃ := RankedBundleComplex.ofConnected K₃
  exact (tauStd_eq_of_chainMap_res hMK ι hM hsplit hG hsupp C₃ _ R₃ _ φ₁ hc₁ hε₁).symm.trans
    (tauStd_eq_of_chainMap_res hMK ι hM hsplit hG hsupp C₃ C R₃ R φ₂ hc₂ hε₂)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.tauSheaf_add_split
statement:
theorem tauSheaf_add_split (hsplit : TauAdditivitySplit hMK ι hM) {L : ShortComplex M.Modules}
    (hL : L.ShortExact) (h₁ : IsCoherentLike M L.X₁) (h₂ : IsCoherentLike M L.X₂)
    (h₃ : IsCoherentLike M L.X₃) (hs₁ : moduleSheafSupport L.X₁ ⊆ Set.range ι)
    (hs₂ : moduleSheafSupport L.X₂ ⊆ Set.range ι) (hs₃ : moduleSheafSupport L.X₃ ⊆ Set.range ι) :
    tauSheaf hMK ι hM hreg L.X₂ h₂ =
      tauSheaf hMK ι hM hreg L.X₁ h₁ + tauSheaf hMK ι hM hreg L.X₃ h₃
proof:
:=
  tauSheaf_add_of_split hMK ι hM hreg (tauResIndep_of_split hMK ι hM hreg hsplit) hsplit hL
    h₁ h₂ h₃ hs₁ hs₂ hs₃

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.tauG0Split_classOf

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.tauG0Split_eq_tauG0

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.push_tauG0Split
statement:
theorem push_tauG0Split [ConnectedSpace M] (hsplit : TauAdditivitySplit hMK ι hM) (x : G0 X)
    (y : K0 M) (hy : k0ToG0 M y = finitePushforward ι x) :
    totalPushOn (opsK k) ι (tauG0Split hMK ι hM hreg hsplit x) =
      chK0T2 k y (primeClassT2 (genericPoint M) n hM)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, N, e, he, -⟩ := id hMK
  haveI := he
  have hb := ResolutionRegularClosedF15.k0ToG0_bijective_of_regular_closed k N e hreg
  let E := AddEquiv.ofBijective (k0ToG0 M) hb
  have key : ∀ x : G0 X, totalPushOn (opsK k) ι (tauG0Split hMK ι hM hreg hsplit x) =
      chK0T2 k (E.symm (finitePushforward ι x)) (primeClassT2 (genericPoint M) n hM) := by
    intro x
    let f : G0 X →+ TotalChow M :=
      (totalPushOn (opsK k) ι).toAddMonoidHom.comp (tauG0Split hMK ι hM hreg hsplit)
    let g : G0 X →+ TotalChow M :=
      AddMonoidHom.mk' (fun x => chK0T2 k (E.symm (finitePushforward ι x))
        (primeClassT2 (genericPoint M) n hM)) (fun a b => by
          simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply])
    have hfg : f = g := by
      refine ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _ fun F => ?_
      change totalPushOn (opsK k) ι (tauG0Split hMK ι hM hreg hsplit (g0ClassOf X F.1 F.2)) =
        chK0T2 k (E.symm (finitePushforward ι (g0ClassOf X F.1 F.2)))
          (primeClassT2 (genericPoint M) n hM)
      rw [tauG0Split_classOf, push_tauSheaf hMK ι hM hreg _ _ (pushCoh_support ι F),
        finitePushforward_classOf]
      congr 2
      apply E.injective
      rw [AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
      exact _root_.SingTau.k0ToG0_altSum (chosenResData hMK hreg _ _) _
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun hfg x
  rw [key x]
  congr 2
  apply E.injective
  rw [AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact hy.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.stalk_map_eq_zero_of_not_mem_img
statement:
theorem stalk_map_eq_zero_of_not_mem_img {A B : X.Modules} (f : A ⟶ B) {x : X}
    (hx : x ∉ moduleSheafSupport (img f)) : (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map f = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_moduleSheafSupport_iff, not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton] at hx
  have hfac : f = kernel.lift (cokernel.π f) f (cokernel.condition _) ≫
      kernel.ι (cokernel.π f) := (kernel.lift_ι _ _ _).symm
  ext m
  rw [hfac, Functor.map_comp, ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  have h3 : ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map (kernel.lift (cokernel.π f) f
      (cokernel.condition _))).hom m = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [h3, map_zero]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.exists_summand
statement:
theorem exists_summand {I : Type u} [Fintype I] {G : X.Modules} (g : FreeM X I ⟶ G) [Epi g]
    {x : X} (hx : x ∈ moduleSheafSupport G) :
    ∃ i : I, x ∈ moduleSheafSupport (img (inFree I i ≫ g))
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hno
  push Not at hno
  have hzero : (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map g = 0 := by
    have hsum : g = ∑ i, prFree (X := X) I i ≫ (inFree I i ≫ g) := by
      simp only [← Category.assoc, ← Preadditive.sum_comp, sum_prFree, Category.id_comp]
    rw [hsum, Functor.map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ ↦ ?_
    rw [Functor.map_comp, stalk_map_eq_zero_of_not_mem_img _ (hno i), comp_zero]
  have hs := RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.stalk_surjective_of_epi g x
  rw [hzero] at hs
  rw [mem_moduleSheafSupport_iff] at hx
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := hs a
  obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := hs b
  exact hab (ha'.symm.trans hb')

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.pushUnit_mem_genSub
statement:
theorem pushUnit_mem_genSub {d : ℕ} {x : X} (hx : height x ≤ d) :

proof:

    { toIsLocallyNoetherian := inferInstance,
      toCompactSpace := (Chow.pointClosureι x).isClosedEmbedding.compactSpace }
  exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨Chow.pointClosureScheme x, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    Chow.pointClosureι x, inferInstance, _, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.lt_of_mu_lt
proof:
:= by
  have hfin := mu_lt_top hT hA
  lift mu T A to ℕ using hfin.ne with a ha
  exact ⟨a, by exact_mod_cast hlt.trans_le hb, le_rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.step
statement:
theorem step (d : ℕ)
    (hlow : ∀ (G : X.Modules) (hG : IsCoherentDimLE X d G),
      (∀ y ∈ moduleSheafSupport G, height y < d) → cls X d G hG ∈ genSub X d) :
    ∀ (m : ℕ) (T : Finset X), (∀ y ∈ T, height y = d) → ∀ (F : X.Modules)
      (hF : IsCoherentDimLE X d F), (∀ y ∈ moduleSheafSupport F, height y = d → y ∈ T) →
        mu T F ≤ m → cls X d F hF ∈ genSub X d
proof:
:= by
  have hK := kerCokerClosed_dimLE (X := X) d
  intro m
  induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ m ih =>
  intro T hT F hF hTF hμ
  by_cases htop : ∃ x ∈ moduleSheafSupport F, height x = d
  swap
  · push Not at htop
    exact hlow F hF fun y hy ↦ lt_of_le_of_ne (hF.2 y hy) (htop y hy)
  obtain ⟨x, hxF, hxd⟩ := htop
  have hxT : x ∈ T := hTF x hxF hxd
  
  have IH : ∀ (F' : X.Modules) (hF' : IsCoherentDimLE X d F'),
      moduleSheafSupport F' ⊆ moduleSheafSupport F → mu T F' < mu T F →
        cls X d F' hF' ∈ genSub X d := by
    intro F' hF' hsub hlt
    obtain ⟨m', hm', hle⟩ := lt_of_mu_lt hT hF' hlt hμ
    exact ih m' hm' T hT F' hF' (fun y hy hyd ↦ hTF y (hsub hy) hyd) hle
  haveI : F.IsFinitePresentation := hF.1
  
  obtain ⟨G, hGfp, I, hI, g, hg, A, eA, f, hlen, hk, hc⟩ := twist_step N j F x
  have hsuppG : moduleSheafSupport G = moduleSheafSupport F := support_eq_of_stalkLength_eq hlen
  have hG : IsCoherentDimLE X d G := ⟨hGfp, fun y hy ↦ hF.2 y (hsuppG ▸ hy)⟩
  have hA : IsCoherentDimLE X d A := isCoherentDimLE_of_iso eA.symm hF
  have hsuppA : moduleSheafSupport A = moduleSheafSupport F := support_eq_of_iso eA
  have hmuG : mu T G = mu T F := mu_eq_of_stalkLength_eq hlen
  have hmuA : mu T A = mu T F := mu_eq_of_iso eA T
  have hxA : x ∈ moduleSheafSupport A := hsuppA ▸ hxF
  have hxG : x ∈ moduleSheafSupport G := hsuppG ▸ hxF
  have hximg : x ∈ moduleSheafSupport (img f) := mem_support_img f hxA hk
  have r1 := cls_four f hA hG
  have hclsA : cls X d A hA = cls X d F hF :=
    ExactGrothendieck.PrincipalGysin.classOf_eq_of_iso hK eA hA hF
  have hker : cls X d (kernel f) (hK.kernel f hA hG) ∈ genSub X d :=
    IH _ _ (fun y hy ↦ hsuppA ▸ support_subset_of_mono (kernel.ι f) hy)
      (hmuA ▸ mu_ker_lt hT f hA hxT hximg)
  have hcok : cls X d (cokernel f) (hK.cokernel f hA hG) ∈ genSub X d :=
    IH _ _ (fun y hy ↦ hsuppG ▸ support_subset_of_epi (cokernel.π f) hy)
      (hmuG ▸ mu_coker_lt hT f hG hxT hximg)
  suffices hGmem : cls X d G hG ∈ genSub X d by
    have e : cls X d F hF = cls X d G hG + cls X d (kernel f) (hK.kernel f hA hG) -
        cls X d (cokernel f) (hK.cokernel f hA hG) := by
      rw [← hclsA]
      exact eq_sub_of_add_eq r1
    rw [e]
    exact sub_mem (add_mem hGmem hker) hcok
  
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_summand g hxG
  let φ : UnitM X ⟶ G := inFree I i ≫ g
  have hUc : IsCoherentLike X (UnitM X) :=
    show (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).IsFinitePresentation from
      SheafOfModules.unit_isFinitePresentation (R := X.ringCatSheaf)
  have hcokφ : IsCoherentDimLE X d (cokernel φ) :=
    ⟨KSpecialization.kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike.cokernel φ hUc hG.1,
      fun y hy ↦ hG.2 y (support_subset_of_epi (cokernel.π φ) hy)⟩
  have hQ : IsCoherentDimLE X d (img φ) := hK.kernel (cokernel.π φ) hG hcokφ
  have r2 : cls X d G hG = cls X d (img φ) hQ + cls X d (cokernel φ) hcokφ :=
    ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_middle X.Modules (IsCoherentDimLE X d) hQ hG hcokφ
      (sesCoker φ).zero (sesCoker_shortExact φ)
  have hxQ : x ∈ moduleSheafSupport (img φ) := hi
  have hmu2 := mu_add_of_shortExact (sesCoker_shortExact φ) T
  change mu T G = mu T (img φ) + mu T (cokernel φ) at hmu2
  have hcokφmem : cls X d (cokernel φ) hcokφ ∈ genSub X d := by
    refine IH _ _ (fun y hy ↦ hsuppG ▸ support_subset_of_epi (cokernel.π φ) hy) ?_
    rw [← hmuG]
    exact enat_lt_of_add (hmu2.trans (add_comm _ _)) (mu_lt_top hT hG) (mu_pos hxT hxQ)
  have hmuQ : mu T (img φ) ≤ mu T F := by
    rw [← hmuG, hmu2]
    exact le_self_add
  have hsuppQ : moduleSheafSupport (img φ) ⊆ moduleSheafSupport F := fun y hy ↦
    hsuppG ▸ support_subset_of_mono (kernel.ι (cokernel.π φ)) hy
  
  let q : UnitM X ⟶ img φ := kernel.lift (cokernel.π φ) φ (cokernel.condition φ)
  haveI : Epi q := (sesKer_shortExact φ).epi_g
  haveI : (img φ).IsFinitePresentation := hQ.1
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := cyclic_step q hxQ
  have hP : IsCoherentDimLE X d (pushUnit (Chow.pointClosureι x)) :=
    isCoherentDimLE_pushUnit_pointClosure hxd.le
  have r3 := cls_four ψ hQ hP
  have hkerψ : cls X d (kernel ψ) (hK.kernel ψ hQ hP) ∈ genSub X d :=
    IH _ _ (fun y hy ↦ hsuppQ (support_subset_of_mono (kernel.ι ψ) hy))
      ((mu_ker_lt hT ψ hQ hxT hψ).trans_le hmuQ)
  have hxcok : x ∉ moduleSheafSupport (cokernel ψ) :=
    not_mem_support_coker_of_length_one ψ (stalkLength_pushUnit_pointClosure x) hψ
  have hcokψ : cls X d (cokernel ψ) (hK.cokernel ψ hQ hP) ∈ genSub X d := by
    refine hlow _ _ fun y hy ↦ ?_
    have hyP := support_subset_of_epi (cokernel.π ψ) hy
    rw [moduleSheafSupport_pushUnit, Chow.range_pointClosureι] at hyP
    have hle : y ≤ x := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr (specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr hyP)
    have hne : y ≠ x := fun h ↦ hxcok (h ▸ hy)
    have hlt := height_strictMono (lt_of_le_not_ge hle fun hge ↦ hne
      (Specializes.antisymm (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hge) (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hle)).eq)
      ((height_mono hle).trans_lt (by rw [hxd]; exact ENat.coe_lt_top d))
    rwa [hxd] at hlt
  have hPmem := pushUnit_mem_genSub (X := X) hxd.le
  have e2 : cls X d (img φ) hQ = cls X d (pushUnit (Chow.pointClosureι x)) hP +
      cls X d (kernel ψ) (hK.kernel ψ hQ hP) - cls X d (cokernel ψ) (hK.cokernel ψ hQ hP) :=
    eq_sub_of_add_eq r3
  rw [r2, e2]
  exact add_mem (sub_mem (add_mem hPmem hkerψ) hcokψ) hcokφmem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.of_hlow
statement:
theorem of_hlow (d : ℕ)
    (hlow : ∀ (G : X.Modules) (hG : IsCoherentDimLE X d G),
      (∀ y ∈ moduleSheafSupport G, height y < d) → cls X d G hG ∈ genSub X d)
    (F : X.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentDimLE X d F) : cls X d F hF ∈ genSub X d
proof:
:= by
  haveI : F.IsFinitePresentation := hF.1
  have hfin : {y | y ∈ moduleSheafSupport F ∧ height y = d}.Finite :=
    (finite_maximal_moduleSheafSupport F).subset
      fun y hy ↦ maximal_of_height_eq_of_top F hF.2 hy.2 hy.1
  have hT : ∀ y ∈ hfin.toFinset, height y = d := fun y hy ↦
    ((Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).mp hy).2
  have hTF : ∀ y ∈ moduleSheafSupport F, height y = d → y ∈ hfin.toFinset :=
    fun y hy hyd ↦ (Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).mpr ⟨hy, hyd⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp (mu_lt_top hT hF).ne
  exact step N j d hlow m hfin.toFinset hT F hF hTF hm.ge

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.cls_mem_genSub
statement:
theorem cls_mem_genSub (d : ℕ) :
    ∀ (F : X.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentDimLE X d F), cls X d F hF ∈ genSub X d
proof:
:= by
  induction d with
  | zero =>
    refine of_hlow N j 0 fun G hG hlt ↦ ?_
    have hz : IsZero G := RRC.ProjectiveSpaceSupportVanish.isZero_of_forall_not_mem_support G
      fun y hy ↦ by
        have := hlt y hy
        simp at this
    have h0 : cls X 0 G hG = 0 := ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_isZero _ _ hG hz
    rw [h0]
    exact zero_mem _
  | succ d ih =>
    refine of_hlow N j (d + 1) fun G hG hlt ↦ ?_
    have hG' : IsCoherentDimLE X d G := ⟨hG.1, fun y hy ↦ by
      have := hlt y hy
      rw [Nat.cast_succ] at this
      exact Order.le_of_lt_add_one this⟩
    have h := incl_mem_genSub X (Nat.le_succ d) (ih G hG')
    rw [G0Le.incl_classOf] at h
    exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.g0Devissage_of_closedImmersion
statement: theorem g0Devissage_of_closedImmersion (d : ℕ) : Statement.G0Devissage X d
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  let π : G0Le X d →+ G0Le X d ⧸ genSub X d := QuotientAddGroup.mk' (genSub X d)
  have hπ : π = 0 := by
    refine ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext {E : X.Modules // IsCoherentDimLE X d E}
      (ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules (IsCoherentDimLE X d))
      (A := G0Le X d ⧸ genSub X d) (f := π) (g := 0) fun E ↦ ?_
    change π (cls X d E.1 E.2) = 0
    rw [QuotientAddGroup.mk'_apply, QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff]
    exact cls_mem_genSub N j d E.1 E.2
  have h := congrArg (fun f : G0Le X d →+ G0Le X d ⧸ genSub X d ↦ f z) hπ
  change (QuotientAddGroup.mk z : G0Le X d ⧸ genSub X d) = 0 at h
  exact (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff z).mp h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.g0Devissage

    Statement.G0Devissage X d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, j, hj, -⟩ := (Fact.out : ProjK k X)

  exact g0Devissage_of_closedImmersion N j d

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ReesAddP1.rank_eq_zero_of_len_lt
statement:
theorem rank_eq_zero_of_len_lt [Nonempty M] (C : RankedBundleComplex M) {j : ℕ}
    (hj : C.K.len < j) : C.rank j = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x⟩ := ‹Nonempty M›
  have hz := C.K.isZero_E j hj
  have hfl := (C.hrank j).isFiniteLocallyFree
  have hS : (ShortComplex.mk (𝟙 (C.K.E j)) (0 : C.K.E j ⟶ C.K.E j)
      (by rw [Category.id_comp])).ShortExact :=
    { exact := ShortComplex.exact_of_isZero_X₂ _ hz
      mono_f := inferInstance
      epi_g := ⟨fun _ _ _ ↦ hz.eq_of_src _ _⟩ }
  have h := rankAt_add x (by rw [Category.id_comp]) hS hfl hfl
  rw [rankAt_of_hasConstantRank (C.hrank j)] at h
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ReesAddP1.minorsIdeal_eq_top_of_rank_zero
statement:
theorem minorsIdeal_eq_top_of_rank_zero (D : DetIdealComplex M) (j : ℕ) (h : D.rank j = 0) :
    minorsIdeal (k := k) D j = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine top_le_iff.mp ?_
  refine le_trans ?_ (le_iSup _ (⟨0, Nat.succ_pos _⟩ : Fin (D.rank j + 1)))
  simp only [D.detIdeal_zero, pow_zero, h, Nat.zero_sub,
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.one_eq_top, Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_top,
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.top_mul, le_refl]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ReesAddP1.graphIdeal_padComplex
statement:
theorem graphIdeal_padComplex [Nonempty M] (C : RankedBundleComplex M) (N : ℕ)
    (hN : C.K.len ≤ N) :
    graphIdeal (k := k) (padComplex C N hN).toDetIdealComplex =
      graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex
proof:
:= by
  unfold graphIdeal
  change ∏ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), minorsIdeal (k := k) (padComplex C N hN).toDetIdealComplex j =
    ∏ j ∈ Finset.range (C.K.len + 1), minorsIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex j
  rw [← Finset.prod_range_mul_prod_Ico _ (Nat.succ_le_succ hN),
    Finset.prod_eq_one (s := Finset.Ico (C.K.len + 1) (N + 1)) (fun j hj ↦ by
      rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hj
      exact (minorsIdeal_eq_top_of_rank_zero (k := k) _ j
        (rank_eq_zero_of_len_lt C (by omega))).trans Scheme.IdealSheafData.one_eq_top.symm),
    mul_one]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ReesAddP1.eqToHom_toBase_g2taddp1
statement:
theorem eqToHom_toBase_g2taddp1 {B : Scheme.{u}} {J J' : B.IdealSheafData} (h : J' = J) :
    eqToHom (congrArg (GlobalBlowup.blowup B) h) ≫ GlobalBlowup.toBase B J =
      GlobalBlowup.toBase B J'
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ReesAddP1.padMap_toBase
statement:
theorem padMap_toBase [Nonempty M] (C : RankedBundleComplex M) (N : ℕ) (hN : C.K.len ≤ N) :
    padMap (k := k) C N hN ≫ graphToBase (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex =
      graphToBase (k := k) (padComplex C N hN).toDetIdealComplex
proof:
:=
  eqToHom_toBase_g2taddp1 (graphIdeal_padComplex (k := k) C N hN)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ReesAddP1.pullbackGraphSheaf_eqToHom_g2taddp1
statement:
theorem pullbackGraphSheaf_eqToHom_g2taddp1 {E T : M.Modules} (d : E ⟶ T)
    {J J' : (CIIB6.B0 (k := k) M).IdealSheafData} (h : J' = J)
    [IrreducibleSpace (GlobalBlowup.blowup _ J)] [IrreducibleSpace (GlobalBlowup.blowup _ J')]
    (hne : (((GlobalBlowup.toBase _ J ≫ pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)) ⁻¹ᵁ
      (chartOpen k 1).1 : (GlobalBlowup.blowup _ J).Opens) : Set (GlobalBlowup.blowup _ J)).Nonempty)
    (hne' : (((GlobalBlowup.toBase _ J' ≫ pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)) ⁻¹ᵁ
      (chartOpen k 1).1 : (GlobalBlowup.blowup _ J').Opens) :
        Set (GlobalBlowup.blowup _ J')).Nonempty) :
    Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (eqToHom (congrArg (GlobalBlowup.blowup _) h))).obj
      (pullbackGraphSheaf (GlobalBlowup.toBase _ J ≫ pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)) d
        ((GlobalBlowup.toBase _ J ≫ pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)) ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 1).1)
        (((GlobalBlowup.toBase _ J ≫ pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).app
          (chartOpen k 1).1).hom (secEquiv k 1 Polynomial.X)) hne) ≅
      pullbackGraphSheaf (GlobalBlowup.toBase _ J' ≫ pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)) d
        ((GlobalBlowup.toBase _ J' ≫ pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)) ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 1).1)
        (((GlobalBlowup.toBase _ J' ≫ pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).app
          (chartOpen k 1).1).hom (secEquiv k 1 Polynomial.X)) hne')
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  exact ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (eqToHom_refl _ _)).app _ ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackId _).app _⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ReesAddP1.xi_padComplex
statement:
theorem xi_padComplex [Nonempty M] (C : RankedBundleComplex M) (N : ℕ) (hN : C.K.len ≤ N)
    [IrreducibleSpace (C.graphModel (k := k))]
    [IrreducibleSpace ((padComplex C N hN).graphModel (k := k))] (j : ℕ) :
    Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (padMap (k := k) C N hN)).obj (C.xi (k := k) j) ≅
      (padComplex C N hN).xi (k := k) j)
proof:
:=
  pullbackGraphSheaf_eqToHom_g2taddp1 (k := k) (C.dj j) (graphIdeal_padComplex (k := k) C N hN)
    (xiOpen_nonempty C) (xiOpen_nonempty (padComplex C N hN))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ReesAddP1.chK_eq_zero_of_rank_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hz := isZero_of_hasConstantRank_zero E hE
  have e : E ⊞ E ≅ E := ((biprod_isZero_iff _ _).2 ⟨hz, hz⟩).iso hz
  have h := chK_biprod_g2tbiva (k := k) hE hE
  rw [chK_iso_g2tmi e] at h
  refine LinearMap.ext fun v ↦ ?_
  have hv := LinearMap.congr_fun h v
  rw [LinearMap.add_apply] at hv
  rw [LinearMap.zero_apply]
  exact add_left_cancel (hv.symm.trans (add_zero _).symm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ReesAddP1.tauStd_padComplex
statement:
theorem tauStd_padComplex (C : RankedBundleComplex M) (N : ℕ) (hN : C.K.len ≤ N) (U : M.Opens)
    (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) (hU : (U : Set M).Nonempty)
    (hX : ∀ x : M, x ∉ U → x ∈ Set.range ι) {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    tauStd hMK (padComplex C N hN) ι U (sectionExactOn_padComplex hN hC) hM =
      tauStd hMK C ι U hC hM
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Fact (CIICLASS.ProjectiveIntegralK k M) := ⟨hMK⟩
  rw [← tauRaw_eq_tauStd_g2trees (k := k) hMK ι (padComplex C N hN),
    ← tauRaw_eq_tauStd_g2trees (k := k) hMK ι C]
  have hP := sectionExactOn_padComplex hN hC
  have hβ := padMap_toBase (k := k) C N hN
  have hsupp : ∀ w, (rCycle (k := k) (padComplex C N hN) U hP hM).1 w ≠ 0 →
      w ∈ Set.range (jX (k := k) (padComplex C N hN) ι) := by
    intro w hw
    rw [range_jX]
    exact hX _ (rCycle_support (k := k) (padComplex C N hN) U hP hM w hw)
  have hop : opWX (k := k) (padComplex C N hN) ι =
      altCh k (fun j ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (jX (k := k) (padComplex C N hN) ι)).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (padMap (k := k) C N hN)).obj (C.xi (k := k) j))) C.K.len := by
    unfold opWX altCh
    rw [padComplex_len, ← Finset.sum_range_add_sum_Ico _ (Nat.succ_le_succ hN),
      Finset.sum_eq_zero (s := Finset.Ico (C.K.len + 1) (N + 1)) (fun j hj ↦ by
        rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hj
        have h0 : (padComplex C N hN).rank j = 0 := rank_eq_zero_of_len_lt C (by omega)
        have hr := hasConstantRank_pullback _ (jX (k := k) (padComplex C N hN) ι) _ _
          ((padComplex C N hN).hasConstantRank_xi (k := k) j)
        rw [h0] at hr
        rw [chK_eq_zero_of_rank_zero hr]
        exact smul_zero ((-1 : ℤ) ^ j)), add_zero]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
    congr 1
    exact chK_iso_g2tmi ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (jX (k := k) (padComplex C N hN) ι)).mapIso
      (xi_padComplex (k := k) C N hN j).some.symm)
  have hτ : tauRaw (k := k) (padComplex C N hN) ι U hP hM =
      totalPushOn (opsK k) (ηX (k := k) (padComplex C N hN) ι)
        (opWX (k := k) (padComplex C N hN) ι
          (classTot (WX (k := k) (padComplex C N hN) ι) n
            (rhoX (k := k) (padComplex C N hN) ι U hP hM))) := rfl
  rw [hτ, hop, push_outX_dom (k := k) (padComplex C N hN) C ι (padMap (k := k) C N hN) hβ, rhoX,
    domX_restrict_eq (k := k) (padComplex C N hN) C ι (padMap (k := k) C N hN) hβ _ hsupp,
    outX_push_rCycle (k := k) (padComplex C N hN) C ι (padMap (k := k) C N hN) hβ U hP hC hU hM
      (pfHom_infDimCycle_dom (k := k) (padComplex C N hN) C (padMap (k := k) C N hN) hβ hM)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ReesAddP1.tauSumFormula_holds
statement: theorem tauSumFormula_holds : TauSumFormula hMK ι hM
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Fact (CIICLASS.ProjectiveIntegralK k M) := ⟨hMK⟩
  intro C₁ C₃ U h₁ h₃ hU hX
  have hN₁ : C₁.K.len ≤ max C₁.K.len C₃.K.len := le_max_left _ _
  have hN₃ : C₃.K.len ≤ max C₁.K.len C₃.K.len := le_max_right _ _
  have hP₁ := sectionExactOn_padComplex hN₁ h₁
  have hP₃ := sectionExactOn_padComplex hN₃ h₃
  rw [← tauStd_isoData (k := k) hMK ι (sumPadIsoData C₁ C₃) U
    (sectionExactOn_sumComplex C₁ C₃ U h₁ h₃)
    (sectionExactOn_sumComplex _ _ U hP₁ hP₃) hM]
  have hsum := tauRaw_sumComplex_g2tsum (k := k) (padComplex C₁ _ hN₁) (padComplex C₃ _ hN₃) ι
    rfl U hP₁ hP₃ hU hX hM
  rw [tauRaw_eq_tauStd_g2trees (k := k) hMK ι, tauRaw_eq_tauStd_g2trees (k := k) hMK ι,
    tauRaw_eq_tauStd_g2trees (k := k) hMK ι] at hsum
  rw [hsum, tauStd_padComplex (k := k) hMK ι C₁ _ hN₁ U h₁ hU hX hM,
    tauStd_padComplex (k := k) hMK ι C₃ _ hN₃ U h₃ hU hX hM]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ReesAddP1.tauAdditivitySplit_holds
statement: theorem tauAdditivitySplit_holds : TauAdditivitySplit hMK ι hM
proof:
:=
  tauAdditivitySplit_of_tauSumFormula hMK ι hM (tauSumFormula_holds hMK ι hM)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModuleProperty.rankBetween_of_card_g2tmod
statement:
theorem rankBetween_of_card_g2tmod {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E) {r : ℕ}
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = r + 1 + 1) : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd (r + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  haveI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  exact ⟨r + 1, Nat.succ_pos r, le_rfl, ⟨(Finite.equivFin _).trans (finCongr (hC i))⟩⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModuleProperty.bundleMod_of_projectiveBundle
statement:
theorem bundleMod_of_projectiveBundle {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ}
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E (r + 1 + 1)) (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = r + 1 + 1) [Fact (ProjK k C.scheme)]
    (hP : BundleMod hadd C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj E)
      (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global C.toBase E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree)) :
    BundleMod hadd X E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  have hrank := rankBetween_of_card_g2tmod C hC
  have hφ := INDB.computes_projectiveBundle C hrank
  have hid : ∀ y : G0 X, projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank
      (G0PB.pullbackG0 C (G0PB.hpos_of_rank C hrank) y) = y :=
    G0PP.derivedPush_pullbackG0_eq C hrank (Nat.succ_pos _) hE
  have hcov : ∀ w, tauX X hadd (projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank w) =
      totalPushOn (opsK k) C.toBase (tauX C.scheme hadd w) :=
    tauX_covariant hIV hadd C.toBase _ hφ
  have hpb : G0PB.pullbackG0 C (G0PB.hpos_of_rank C hrank)
      (k0ClassOf X E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree • x) =
      k0ClassOf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj E)
        (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global C.toBase E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree) •
        G0PB.pullbackG0 C (G0PB.hpos_of_rank C hrank) x := by
    rw [G0PP.pullbackG0_smul, G0PP.projectiveBundlePullbackK0_k0ClassOf]
  calc tauX X hadd (k0ClassOf X E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree • x)
      = tauX X hadd (projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank (G0PB.pullbackG0 C
          (G0PB.hpos_of_rank C hrank) (k0ClassOf X E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree • x))) := by
        rw [hid]
    _ = totalPushOn (opsK k) C.toBase (chK k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj E)
          (tauX C.scheme hadd (G0PB.pullbackG0 C (G0PB.hpos_of_rank C hrank) x))) := by
        rw [hcov, hpb, hP]
    _ = chK k E (totalPushOn (opsK k) C.toBase
          (tauX C.scheme hadd (G0PB.pullbackG0 C (G0PB.hpos_of_rank C hrank) x))) :=
        chK_push C.toBase E hE _
    _ = chK k E (tauX X hadd x) := by
        rw [← hcov, hid]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModuleProperty.bundleMod_pullback_of_taut
statement:
theorem bundleMod_pullback_of_taut {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ}
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E (r + 1 + 1)) (C : AffineFrameCover X E) [Fact (ProjK k C.scheme)]
    (hK : BundleMod hadd C.scheme C.tautologicalKernel
      (C.hasConstantRank_tautologicalKernel hE).isFiniteLocallyFree)
    (hO : BundleMod hadd C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
      (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).isFiniteLocallyFree) :
    BundleMod hadd C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj E)
      (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global C.toBase E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  have hKr := C.hasConstantRank_tautologicalKernel hE
  have hO1 := C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1
  rw [k0ClassOf_eq_add_of_shortExact C.scheme hKr.isFiniteLocallyFree
    (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global C.toBase E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree)
    hO1.isFiniteLocallyFree C.tautologicalKernelι_comp C.tautologicalKernel_shortExact,
    add_smul, map_add, hK, hO]
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty C.scheme with hX | hX
  · rw [totalChow_eq_zero_of_isEmpty (tauX C.scheme hadd z), map_zero, map_zero, map_zero,
      add_zero]
  · rw [show chK k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj E) =
        chK k C.tautologicalKernel + chK k (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) from
      GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.chTot_additive (whitneyK (k := k)) _ _ _
        C.tautologicalKernel_shortExact hKr hO1]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModuleProperty.bundleMod_of_lineModAll
statement:
theorem bundleMod_of_lineModAll (hLine : LineModAll k hadd) (r : ℕ) :
    ∀ {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X]
      [Fact (ProjK k X)] (E : X.Modules) (hE : HasConstantRank X E (r + 1)),
      BundleMod hadd X E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero =>
    intro X _ _ _ _ E hE
    exact hLine E hE
  | succ r ih =>
    intro X _ _ _ _ E hE
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hE
    haveI : Fact (ProjK k C.scheme) := ⟨closedPosK C hC⟩
    exact bundleMod_of_projectiveBundle hIV hadd hE C hC
      (bundleMod_pullback_of_taut hadd hE C
        (ih C.tautologicalKernel (C.hasConstantRank_tautologicalKernel hE))
        (hLine _ (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModuleProperty.tauX_module
statement:
theorem tauX_module (hLine : LineModAll k hadd) [ConnectedSpace X] (y : K0 X) (x : G0 X) :
    tauX X hadd (y • x) = chK0T2 k y (tauX X hadd x)
proof:
:= by
  let F : K0 X →+ TotalChow X := (tauX X hadd).comp ((smulAddHom (K0 X) (G0 X)).flip x)
  let G : K0 X →+ TotalChow X :=
    { toFun := fun y ↦ chK0T2 k y (tauX X hadd x)
      map_zero' := by rw [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
      map_add' := fun a b ↦ by rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply] }
  have hFG : F = G := by
    refine ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext (Object := {E : X.Modules // IsFiniteLocallyFree X E})
      (Exact := ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules (IsFiniteLocallyFree X)) fun E ↦ ?_
    change tauX X hadd (k0ClassOf X E.1 E.2 • x) = chK0T2 k (k0ClassOf X E.1 E.2) (tauX X hadd x)
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_rank_T2 (k := k) E.2
    rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty X with hX | hX
    · rw [totalChow_eq_zero_of_isEmpty (tauX X hadd _), totalChow_eq_zero_of_isEmpty (tauX X hadd x),
        map_zero]
    cases r with
    | zero =>
      have h0 : k0ClassOf X E.1 E.2 = 0 := by
        rw [k0ClassOf_iso X E.2 (zero_isFiniteLocallyFree X)
          (isZero_of_hasConstantRank_zero E.1 hr).isoZero, k0ClassOf_zero]
      have hz : (0 : K0 X) • x = 0 := ((smulAddHom (K0 X) (G0 X)).flip x).map_zero
      rw [h0, hz, map_zero, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
    | succ r =>
      rw [chK0T2_classOf_eq_chK E.1 hr]
      exact bundleMod_of_lineModAll hIV hadd hLine r E.1 hr x
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hFG y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ModuleProperty.tauX_module_of_lineDiffPullback
statement:
theorem tauX_module_of_lineDiffPullback (hgeo : LineDiffPullback k) [ConnectedSpace X]
    (y : K0 X) (x : G0 X) : tauX X hadd (y • x) = chK0T2 k y (tauX X hadd x)
proof:
:=
  tauX_module hIV hadd (lineModAll_of_lineDiffPullback hIV hadd hgeo) y x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.support_pow_le
statement:
theorem support_pow_le {X : Scheme.{u}} (I : X.IdealSheafData) (n : ℕ) :
    (I ^ n).support ≤ I.support
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    rw [pow_zero, Scheme.IdealSheafData.one_eq_top, Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_top]
    exact bot_le
  | succ n => rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_pow_succ]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.support_prod_le
statement:
theorem support_prod_le {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (F : ι → X.IdealSheafData)
    (Z : TopologicalSpace.Closeds X) (h : ∀ j ∈ s, (F j).support ≤ Z) :
    (∏ j ∈ s, F j).support ≤ Z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    rw [Finset.prod_empty, Scheme.IdealSheafData.one_eq_top, Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_top]
    exact bot_le
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_mul]
    exact sup_le (h a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s))
      (ih fun j hj ↦ h j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.infPow_comap_le_minorsIdeal
statement:
theorem infPow_comap_le_minorsIdeal (C : DetIdealComplex M) (j : ℕ) :
    (infIdeal k ^ C.rank j).comap (pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)) ≤
      minorsIdeal (k := k) C j
proof:
:= by
  refine le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) (le_iSup _ (0 : Fin (C.rank j + 1)))
  simp only [Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, Nat.sub_zero, C.detIdeal_zero,
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_top, Scheme.IdealSheafData.one_eq_top,
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.top_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.support_minorsIdeal_le
statement:
theorem support_minorsIdeal_le (C : DetIdealComplex M) (j : ℕ) :
    (minorsIdeal (k := k) C j).support ≤
      ((infIdeal k).comap (pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1))).support
proof:
:= by
  refine le_trans (Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_antitone (infPow_comap_le_minorsIdeal C j)) ?_
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_comap, Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_comap]
  intro x hx
  exact support_pow_le (infIdeal k) (C.rank j) hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.support_graphIdeal_le
statement:
theorem support_graphIdeal_le (C : DetIdealComplex M) :
    (graphIdeal (k := k) C).support ≤
      ((infIdeal k).comap (pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1))).support
proof:
:=

theorem exists_mem_chart_one [Nonempty M] :
    ∃ b : B0 (k := k) M, pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) b ∈ Set.range (chart k 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a⟩ : Nonempty M := inferInstance
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x : Spec (CommRingCat.of (Polynomial k)),
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.C : k →+* Polynomial k))) x = (M ↘ Spk k) a :=
    Polynomial.comap_C_surjective (R := k) ((M ↘ Spk k) a)
  obtain ⟨b, -, hb⟩ := Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback (f := M ↘ Spk k)
    (g := toSpec k 1) a (chart k 1 x) (by
      have e : toSpec k 1 (chart k 1 x) =
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.C : k →+* Polynomial k))) x := by
        rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, chart_toSpec]
      exact hx.symm.trans e.symm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.projectiveIntegralK_graphModel

theorem projectiveIntegralK_graphModel [Nonempty M] [LocallyOfFiniteType (M ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian M] (hM : ProjectiveIntegralK k M) (C : DetIdealComplex M) :
    letI
proof:
:= prodP1Over (k := k) (A := M)
    letI := blowupOver (k := k) (graphIdeal (k := k) C)
    haveI := prodP1_lft (k := k) (A := M)
    haveI := prodP1_isNoetherian (k := k) (A := M)
    haveI := blowup_locallyOfFiniteType
      (projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod hM 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
      (graphIdeal (k := k) C) (graphIdeal_ne_bot C)
    haveI := blowup_isNoetherian
      (projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod hM 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
      (graphIdeal (k := k) C) (graphIdeal_ne_bot C)
    ProjectiveIntegralK k (graphModel (k := k) C) :=
  letI := prodP1Over (k := k) (A := M)
  haveI := prodP1_lft (k := k) (A := M)
  haveI := prodP1_isNoetherian (k := k) (A := M)
  projectiveIntegralK_blowup_prod hM 1 (Y := B0 (k := k) M) (Iso.refl _)
    (Category.id_comp _) (graphIdeal (k := k) C) (graphIdeal_ne_bot C)

proof:
:=

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.isIso_graphChart'
statement: theorem isIso_graphChart' (C : DetIdealComplex M) : IsIso (graphChart' (k := k) C)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := toBase_restrict_isIso (B0 (k := k) M) (graphIdeal (k := k) C)
  haveI : IsIso (GlobalBlowup.toBase (B0 (k := k) M) (graphIdeal (k := k) C) ∣_
      (jChart (k := k) (A := M) 1).opensRange) :=
    isIso_morphismRestrict_of_le _ (opensRange_jChart_le_centreComplement_graph C) inferInstance
  have h : graphChart' (k := k) C ≫ (GlobalBlowup.toBase (B0 (k := k) M) (graphIdeal (k := k) C) ∣_
      (jChart (k := k) (A := M) 1).opensRange) =
        (jChart (k := k) (A := M) 1).isoOpensRange.hom := by

      morphismRestrict_ι, ← Category.assoc, graphChart'_ι, graphChart_toBase]

  have : IsIso (graphChart' (k := k) C ≫
      (GlobalBlowup.toBase (B0 (k := k) M) (graphIdeal (k := k) C) ∣_
        (jChart (k := k) (A := M) 1).opensRange)) := by
    rw [h]; infer_instance
  exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right (graphChart' (k := k) C)
    (GlobalBlowup.toBase (B0 (k := k) M) (graphIdeal (k := k) C) ∣_

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.mem_range_infPoint_of_not_mem_chart_one
statement:
theorem mem_range_infPoint_of_not_mem_chart_one {p : P1 k} (hp : p ∉ Set.range (chart k 1)) :
    p ∈ Set.range (infPoint k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ : p ∈ Set.range (chart k 0) := (chart_cover_P1 p).resolve_right hp
  have hX : (Polynomial.X : Polynomial k) ∈ x.asIdeal := by
    by_contra h
    apply hp
    have hx : x ∈ chart k 0 ⁻¹ᵁ (chart k 1).opensRange := by
      rw [chart_zero_preimage]; exact h
    exact hx
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : k)) :=
    fun a ↦ ⟨Polynomial.C a, by simp⟩
  have hx : x ∈ Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : k))) := by
    rw [range_comap_of_surjective _ _ hsurj]
    show (↑(RingHom.ker (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : k))) : Set (Polynomial k)) ⊆ x.asIdeal
    rw [Polynomial.ker_evalRingHom, map_zero, sub_zero]
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp ha
    exact x.asIdeal.mul_mem_left c hX
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hx
  refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
  rw [infPoint, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  congr 1

theorem mem_infIdeal_support_iff (p : P1 k) :
