proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h hp ↦ not_mem_infIdeal_support k hp h, fun hp ↦ ?_⟩
  have hs : ((infIdeal k).support : Set (P1 k)) = closure (Set.range (infPoint k)) :=
    Scheme.Hom.support_ker (infPoint k)
  change p ∈ ((infIdeal k).support : Set (P1 k))
  rw [hs]
  exact subset_closure (mem_range_infPoint_of_not_mem_chart_one hp)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.mem_infDivisor_support_iff
statement:
theorem mem_infDivisor_support_iff (C : DetIdealComplex M) (w : graphModel (k := k) C) :
    w ∈ (infDivisor (k := k) C).support ↔ w ∉ graphAway (k := k) C
proof:
:= by
  rw [infDivisor, Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_comap]
  change graphToP1 (k := k) C w ∈ (infIdeal k).support ↔ _
  rw [mem_infIdeal_support_iff]
  have e : w ∈ graphAway (k := k) C ↔
      graphToBase (k := k) C w ∈
        pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (chart k 1).opensRange := by
    rw [← opensRange_jChart]; rfl
  rw [e]
  rfl

theorem exists_blowup_not_mem_support [IsIntegral A] (hJ : J ≠ ⊥) :

proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := GlobalBlowup.centreComplement_nonempty A J hJ
  haveI := GlobalBlowup.toBase_restrict_isIso A J
  let f := GlobalBlowup.toBase A J ∣_ GlobalBlowup.centreComplement A J
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective f := f.homeomorph.surjective
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hsurj ⟨x, hx⟩
  refine ⟨(GlobalBlowup.toBase A J ⁻¹ᵁ GlobalBlowup.centreComplement A J).ι b, ?_⟩
  have h1 := congrArg (fun q ↦ (GlobalBlowup.centreComplement A J).ι q) hb
  simp only at h1
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, morphismRestrict_ι, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at h1
  rw [h1]
  exact hx

    D9.properPushforwardRationalDimChowD9 (k := k) ι' n
        ((p1Pencil k c).swap.fibreInt (k := k) (toP1Global A J k φk) ι' hι' n
          ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk
            (dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint (totalGlobal A J)) (n + 1) hM) :
              DimChow (totalGlobal A J) (n + 1)))) =
      (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (specialCycle k A J φk hJ hM) :
        DimChow (totalGlobal A J) n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [G2XS.Pencil.push_fibreInt_tmul]
  congr 1
  exact capCycles_inf k A J φk hJ c hM

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegDeform.pullbackSec_c_ker
statement:
theorem pullbackSec_c_ker (c : k) :
    sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf (KDGb.pullbackSec (toP1Global A J k φk) (p1σc k c)) =
      (fibreιGlobal A J k φk c).ker
proof:
:= by
  rw [KDGb.sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_pullbackSec (p1Line_rank k c), p1σc_ker]
  exact (InfinityOtherStrictTransform.closedImmersion_ker_of_isPullback
    (fibre_isPullback_P1Global A J k φk c).flip).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegDeform.capCycles_at
statement:
theorem capCycles_at [A.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (A ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian A]
    (c : k) [(fibreιGlobal A J k φk c).IsOver (Spk k)] {n : ℕ}
    (hM : height (genericPoint (totalGlobal A J)) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
    (hA : height (genericPoint A) = (n : ℕ∞)) :
    D5.capCycles (k := k) (lineInf k A J φk c) (lineInf_rank k A J φk c) n
        (dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint (totalGlobal A J)) (n + 1) hM) =
      (QuotientAddGroup.mk (pushPrime (k := k) (fibreιGlobal A J k φk c) hA) :
        DimChow (totalGlobal A J) n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨bf, hcoef⟩ := A5FR.weil_coeff_ite (lineInf_rank k A J φk c)
    (KDGb.pullbackSec (toP1Global A J k φk) (p1σc k c)) (fibreιGlobal A J k φk c)
    (pullbackSec_c_ker k A J φk c) hM hA
  refine D5.capCycles_prime_eq_mk (k := k) _ _ n _ hM bf _ ?_
  have hlift : ∀ q : totalGlobal A J, q ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι (genericPoint (totalGlobal A J))) :=
    fun q ↦ by
      rw [range_pointClosureι]
      exact specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp (genericPoint_specializes _)
  ext y
  change properPushforward (fibreιGlobal A J k φk c) (dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint A) n hA).1 y = _
  rw [E21.pp_prime_apply]
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hlift y
  rw [E21.pp_apply_image]
  exact (hcoef z).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.RegDeform.push_fibreIntAt_fund
statement:
theorem push_fibreIntAt_fund [A.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (A ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian A]
    (c : k) [(fibreιGlobal A J k φk c).IsOver (Spk k)] {n : ℕ}
    (hM : height (genericPoint (totalGlobal A J)) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
    (hA : height (genericPoint A) = (n : ℕ∞))
    {Z : Scheme.{u}} [Z.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Z ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian Z]
    (ι : Z ⟶ totalGlobal A J) [IsClosedImmersion ι] [ι.IsOver (Spk k)]
    (hι : Set.range ι = toP1Global A J k φk ⁻¹' (p1Pencil k c).S) :
    D9.properPushforwardRationalDimChowD9 (k := k) ι n
        ((p1Pencil k c).fibreInt (k := k) (toP1Global A J k φk) ι hι n
          ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk
            (dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint (totalGlobal A J)) (n + 1) hM) :
              DimChow (totalGlobal A J) (n + 1)))) =
      (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (pushPrime (k := k) (fibreιGlobal A J k φk c) hA) :
        DimChow (totalGlobal A J) n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [G2XS.Pencil.push_fibreInt_tmul]
  congr 1
  exact capCycles_at k A J φk c hM hA

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.lChow_comp
statement:
theorem lChow_comp {J : Scheme.{u}} [J.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (J ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian J] (j : J ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion j] [j.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsProper j]
    (hJ : ∀ y, (j ≫ jY) y ∈ closure {C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU} ∨
      (j ≫ jY) y ∈ Set.range (jX (k := k) C ι)) (m : ℕ) (x : DimChow J m) :
    lChow (k := k) C ι U hC hU (j ≫ jY) hJ m x =
      lChow (k := k) C ι U hC hU jY hY m (D9.properPushforwardDimChowD9 (k := k) j m x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
  | H D =>
    rw [lChow_mk, D9.properPushforwardDimChowD9_mk, pfClosed_comp]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.dichotomy_Y
statement:
theorem dichotomy_Y : ∀ y, ιY y ∈ closure {C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU} ∨
    ιY y ∈ Set.range (jX (k := k) C ι)

  mem_closure_or_range_of_mem_infSupport (k := k) C ι U hC hU hX (hYsupp y)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.dichotomy_J
statement:
theorem dichotomy_J : ∀ y, (interSnd ιZ ιY ≫ ιY) y ∈ closure {C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU} ∨
    (interSnd ιZ ιY ≫ ιY) y ∈ Set.range (jX (k := k) C ι)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.specialization_core
statement:
theorem specialization_core (hB1 : LambdaCycleEq (k := k) C pc' gl ιY hιY hM) :
    haveI
proof:
:= isProper_interSnd_g2tbiv (k := k) ιZ ιY
    lChow (k := k) C ι U hC hU (interSnd ιZ ιY ≫ ιY)
        (dichotomy_J (k := k) C ι U hC hU hX ιZ ιY hYsupp) n
      (gysinCycles (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ιZ).obj (pc'.L gl))
        (hasConstantRank_restrict (pc'.L gl) (pc'.hL gl) ιZ) (wPullbackSection ιZ (pc'.s gl))
        (interFst ιZ ιY) n
        (lbRep (k := k) ιZ (pc.W gt) (pc.hW gt ιZ hιZ) (pc.t gt) (n + 1) (fundW (k := k) C hM))) =
      tauCap (k := k) C ι U hC (pc.L gt) (pc.hL gt) hM := by
  haveI := isProper_interSnd_g2tbiv (k := k) ιZ ιY
  have hJcov : Set.range ιZ ∩ Set.range ιY ⊆ Set.range (interFst ιZ ιY ≫ ιZ) := by
    rintro x ⟨⟨z, rfl⟩, hzY⟩
    have hz : z ∈ Set.range (interFst ιZ ιY) := by
      rw [range_interFst]
      exact hzY
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hz
    exact ⟨w, rfl⟩
  rw [pencil_gysinCycles_comm (k := k) pc pc' gt gl ιZ hιZ ιY hιY (interFst ιZ ιY)
    (interSnd ιZ ιY) (inter_condition ιZ ιY) hJcov n (fundW (k := k) C hM),
    lChow_comp (k := k) C ι U hC hU ιY (dichotomy_Y (k := k) C ι U hC hU hX ιY hYsupp)]
  have hj : ∀ z, z ∈ Set.range (interSnd ιZ ιY) ↔ ιY z ∈ Set.range ιZ := by
    intro z
    change z ∈ Set.range (pullback.snd ιZ ιY) ↔ _
    rw [Scheme.Pullback.range_snd]
    rfl
  rw [push_gysinCycles (k := k) (isSupport_restrict (pc.isSupport gt ιZ hιZ) (interSnd ιZ ιY) hj)]
  rw [show hasConstantRank_restrict (pc.L gt) (pc.hL gt) ιY =
    hasConstantRank_pullback Y ιY (pc.L gt) 1 (pc.hL gt) from rfl]
  rw [lChow_capCycles (k := k) C ι U hC hU ιY (dichotomy_Y (k := k) C ι U hC hU hX ιY hYsupp)
    (pc.L gt) (pc.hL gt) n, hB1, partOn_infDimCycle (k := k) C U hC hU hM]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.specialization_core_swap
statement:
theorem specialization_core_swap (hB1 : LambdaCycleEq (k := k) C pc' gl ιY hιY hM)
    {Z₂ : Scheme.{u}} [Z₂.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Z₂ ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian Z₂]
    [Fact (ProjK k Z₂)] (ιZ₂ : Z₂ ⟶ C.graphModel (k := k)) [IsClosedImmersion ιZ₂]
    [ιZ₂.IsOver (Spk k)] (hιZ₂ : Set.range ιZ₂ = gt ⁻¹' pc.swap.S) :
    haveI
proof:
:= isProper_interSnd_g2tbiv (k := k) ιZ ιY
    haveI := isProper_interSnd_g2tbiv (k := k) ιZ₂ ιY
    lChow (k := k) C ι U hC hU (interSnd ιZ ιY ≫ ιY)
        (dichotomy_J (k := k) C ι U hC hU hX ιZ ιY hYsupp) n
      (gysinCycles (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ιZ).obj (pc'.L gl))
        (hasConstantRank_restrict (pc'.L gl) (pc'.hL gl) ιZ) (wPullbackSection ιZ (pc'.s gl))
        (interFst ιZ ιY) n
        (lbRep (k := k) ιZ (pc.W gt) (pc.hW gt ιZ hιZ) (pc.t gt) (n + 1) (fundW (k := k) C hM))) =
    lChow (k := k) C ι U hC hU (interSnd ιZ₂ ιY ≫ ιY)
        (dichotomy_J (k := k) C ι U hC hU hX ιZ₂ ιY hYsupp) n
      (gysinCycles (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ιZ₂).obj (pc'.L gl))
        (hasConstantRank_restrict (pc'.L gl) (pc'.hL gl) ιZ₂) (wPullbackSection ιZ₂ (pc'.s gl))
        (interFst ιZ₂ ιY) n
        (lbRep (k := k) ιZ₂ (pc.swap.W gt) (pc.swap.hW gt ιZ₂ hιZ₂) (pc.swap.t gt) (n + 1)
          (fundW (k := k) C hM))) := by
  rw [specialization_core (k := k) C ι U hC hU hX pc pc' gt gl ιZ hιZ ιY hιY hYsupp hM hB1,
    specialization_core (k := k) C ι U hC hU hX pc.swap pc' gt gl ιZ₂ hιZ₂ ιY hιY hYsupp hM hB1]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.maxMinors_submatrix_equiv_g2tsum
statement:
theorem maxMinors_submatrix_equiv_g2tsum {m m' n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (φ : Matrix m n A) (e : m' ≃ m) :
    MinorsSat.maxMinors (φ.submatrix e id) = MinorsSat.maxMinors φ
proof:
:= by
  unfold MinorsSat.maxMinors
  congr 1
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨S, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨e ∘ S, by dsimp only; rw [Matrix.submatrix_submatrix]; rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨S, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨e.symm ∘ S, ?_⟩
    dsimp only
    rw [Matrix.submatrix_submatrix]
    congr 2
    funext i
    simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.graphMat_fromBlocks_g2tsum

theorem graphMat_fromBlocks_g2tsum (μ l : A) (D₁ : Matrix m₁ n₁ A) (D₂ : Matrix m₂ n₂ A) :

      (Matrix.fromBlocks (GraphBundles.graphMat μ l D₁) 0 0

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.graphFormula_fromBlocks_g2tsum
statement:

      GraphBundles.graphFormula μ l D₁ * GraphBundles.graphFormula μ l D₂

    ← GraphBundles.maxMinors_graphMat, graphMat_fromBlocks_g2tsum, maxMinors_submatrix_equiv_g2tsum,
    MinorsSat.maxMinors_fromBlocks]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.graphIdeal_sum_ideal_chart_g2tsum
statement:
theorem graphIdeal_sum_ideal_chart_g2tsum (hlen : C₁.K.len = C₂.K.len)
    (U' : (B0 (k := k) M).affineOpens) (V : M.affineOpens) (Wp : (P1 k).affineOpens)
    (hV : (U' : (B0 (k := k) M).Opens) ≤ pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (V : M.Opens))
    (hW : (U' : (B0 (k := k) M).Opens) ≤
      pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (Wp : (P1 k).Opens))
    (μ l : Γ(B0 (k := k) M, U'))
    (hl : ((zeroIdeal k).ideal Wp).map
      ((pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE Wp U' hW).hom = Ideal.span {l})
    (hμ : ((infIdeal k).ideal Wp).map
      ((pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE Wp U' hW).hom = Ideal.span {μ})
    (F₁ : C₁.FrameData V) (F₂ : C₂.FrameData V) (hn₁ : ∀ j, Fintype.card (F₁.n j) = C₁.rank j)
    (hn₂ : ∀ j, Fintype.card (F₂.n j) = C₂.rank j) :
    (graphIdeal (k := k) (sumComplex C₁ C₂).toDetIdealComplex).ideal U' =
      (graphIdeal (k := k) C₁.toDetIdealComplex).ideal U' *
        (graphIdeal (k := k) C₂.toDetIdealComplex).ideal U'
proof:
:= by
  set φ := ((pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE V U' hV).hom with hφ
  rw [graphIdeal_ideal_eq_prod_graphFormula (sumComplex C₁ C₂).toDetIdealComplex U' V Wp hV hW
      μ l hl hμ (fun j => ((frameDataSum_g2tsum C₁ C₂ F₁ F₂).D j).map φ)
      (fun j => by
        rw [RankedBundleComplex.toDetIdealComplex_rank, sumComplex_rank, ← hn₁ j, ← hn₂ j]
        exact Fintype.card_sum)
      (fun j r _ => detIdeal_map_frames_g2tsum _ _ φ j r),
    graphIdeal_ideal_eq_prod_graphFormula C₁.toDetIdealComplex U' V Wp hV hW μ l hl hμ
      (fun j => (F₁.D j).map φ) (fun j => by rw [RankedBundleComplex.toDetIdealComplex_rank, hn₁])
      (fun j r _ => detIdeal_map_frames_g2tsum _ _ φ j r),
    graphIdeal_ideal_eq_prod_graphFormula C₂.toDetIdealComplex U' V Wp hV hW μ l hl hμ
      (fun j => (F₂.D j).map φ) (fun j => by rw [RankedBundleComplex.toDetIdealComplex_rank, hn₂])
      (fun j r _ => detIdeal_map_frames_g2tsum _ _ φ j r)]
  simp only [RankedBundleComplex.toDetIdealComplex_len, sumComplex_K, bundleBiprod_len, hlen,
    max_self]
  rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  have key : ∀ {B : Type u} [CommRing B] (f : Γ(M, V.1) →+* B) (μ' l' : B),
      GraphBundles.graphFormula μ' l' ((Matrix.fromBlocks (F₁.D j) 0 0 (F₂.D j)).map f) =
        GraphBundles.graphFormula μ' l' ((F₁.D j).map f) *
          GraphBundles.graphFormula μ' l' ((F₂.D j).map f) := by
    intro B _ f μ' l'
    rw [Matrix.fromBlocks_map, Matrix.map_zero _ (map_zero f), Matrix.map_zero _ (map_zero f),
      graphFormula_fromBlocks_g2tsum]
  exact key φ μ l

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.graphIdeal_sumComplex_g2tsum
statement:
theorem graphIdeal_sumComplex_g2tsum [Nonempty M] (hlen : C₁.K.len = C₂.K.len) :
    graphIdeal (k := k) (sumComplex C₁ C₂).toDetIdealComplex =
      graphIdeal (k := k) C₁.toDetIdealComplex * graphIdeal (k := k) C₂.toDetIdealComplex
proof:
:= by
  let P : (B0 (k := k) M).affineOpens → Prop := fun U' =>
    ∃ (V : M.affineOpens) (_ : (U' : (B0 (k := k) M).Opens) ≤
        pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (V : M.Opens))
      (F₁ : C₁.FrameData V) (F₂ : C₂.FrameData V)
      (_ : ∀ j, Fintype.card (F₁.n j) = C₁.rank j) (_ : ∀ j, Fintype.card (F₂.n j) = C₂.rank j),
      (U' : (B0 (k := k) M).Opens) ≤
          pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ ((chartOpen k 0 : (P1 k).affineOpens) :
            (P1 k).Opens) ∨
        (U' : (B0 (k := k) M).Opens) ≤
          pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ ((chartOpen k 1 : (P1 k).affineOpens) :
            (P1 k).Opens)
  refine Scheme.IdealSheafData.ext_of_iSup_eq_top (fun U' : {U' // P U'} => U'.1) ?_ ?_
  · refine top_le_iff.mp fun y _ => ?_
    set x := pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) y
    obtain ⟨V₁, hxV₁, -, s₁, hs₁⟩ := C₁.exists_secFramesXiR (O := ⊤) (x := x) trivial
    obtain ⟨V, hxV, hVV₁, s₂, hs₂⟩ := C₂.exists_secFramesXiR (O := V₁.1) (x := x) hxV₁
    let s₁' : ∀ j, ULift.{u} (Fin (C₁.frRank j)) → Γ(C₁.K.E j, V.1) :=
      fun j => secResXiR _ hVV₁ (s₁ j)
    have hs₁' : ∀ j, IsSecFrame (C₁.K.E j) V.1 (s₁' j) := fun j => (hs₁ j).mono hVV₁
    let F₁ := frameDataOfFrames C₁ V (frXiR C₁ V s₁' hs₁')
    let F₂ := frameDataOfFrames C₂ V (frXiR C₂ V s₂ hs₂)
    have hn₁ : ∀ j, Fintype.card (F₁.n j) = C₁.rank j := fun j => by
      change Fintype.card (ULift.{u} (Fin (C₁.frRank j))) = _
      rw [Fintype.card_ulift, Fintype.card_fin, C₁.frRank_eq_rank]
    have hn₂ : ∀ j, Fintype.card (F₂.n j) = C₂.rank j := fun j => by
      change Fintype.card (ULift.{u} (Fin (C₂.frRank j))) = _
      rw [Fintype.card_ulift, Fintype.card_fin, C₂.frRank_eq_rank]
    have hp : pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) y ∈ (chartOpen k 0).1 ⊔ (chartOpen k 1).1 := by
      rw [chartOpen_sup_eq_top]; trivial
    have key : ∀ c : Fin 2, pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) y ∈ (chartOpen k c).1 →
        ∃ U' : (B0 (k := k) M).affineOpens, y ∈ U'.1 ∧
          (U' : (B0 (k := k) M).Opens) ≤ pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (V : M.Opens) ∧
          (U' : (B0 (k := k) M).Opens) ≤
            pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ ((chartOpen k c : (P1 k).affineOpens) :
              (P1 k).Opens) := by
      intro c hc
      obtain ⟨U', hU', hyU', hU'le⟩ := (Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.1 (B0 (k := k) M).isBasis_affineOpens)
        (show y ∈ pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (V : M.Opens) ⊓
          pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ ((chartOpen k c : (P1 k).affineOpens) :
            (P1 k).Opens) from ⟨hxV, hc⟩)
      exact ⟨⟨U', hU'⟩, hyU', hU'le.trans inf_le_left, hU'le.trans inf_le_right⟩
    rcases Opens.mem_sup.mp hp with h0 | h1
    · obtain ⟨U', hyU', hV, hW⟩ := key 0 h0
      exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨U', V, hV, F₁, F₂, hn₁, hn₂, Or.inl hW⟩, hyU'⟩
    · obtain ⟨U', hyU', hV, hW⟩ := key 1 h1
      exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨U', V, hV, F₁, F₂, hn₁, hn₂, Or.inr hW⟩, hyU'⟩
  · rintro ⟨U', V, hV, F₁, F₂, hn₁, hn₂, hW | hW⟩
    · rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_mul, Pi.mul_apply]
      exact graphIdeal_sum_ideal_chart_g2tsum C₁ C₂ hlen U' V (chartOpen k 0) hV hW
        (((pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE _ U' hW).hom (secEquiv k 0 Polynomial.X)) 1
        (zeroIdeal_map_chartZero U' hW) (infIdeal_map_chartZero U' hW) F₁ F₂ hn₁ hn₂
    · rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_mul, Pi.mul_apply]
      exact graphIdeal_sum_ideal_chart_g2tsum C₁ C₂ hlen U' V (chartOpen k 1) hV hW 1
        (((pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE _ U' hW).hom (secEquiv k 1 Polynomial.X))
        (zeroIdeal_map_chartOne U' hW) (infIdeal_map_chartOne U' hW) F₁ F₂ hn₁ hn₂

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.inter_condition
statement: theorem inter_condition : interFst jY jT ≫ jY = interSnd jY jT ≫ jT
proof: := pullback.condition

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.range_interFst
statement: theorem range_interFst : Set.range (interFst jY jT) = jY ⁻¹' Set.range jT
proof:
:=
  Scheme.Pullback.range_fst _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.isProper_interFst_g2tbiv
statement: theorem isProper_interFst_g2tbiv : IsProper (interFst jY jT)
proof:
:=

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.isProper_interSnd_g2tbiv

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.totalPushOn_classTot
statement:
theorem totalPushOn_classTot {Z X : Scheme.{u}} [Z.Over (Spk k)] [X.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Z ↘ Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian Z]
    [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (ProjK k Z)] [Fact (ProjK k X)] (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [i.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsProper i] (m : ℕ) (D : dimensionCycles Z m) :
    totalPushOn (opsK k) i (classTot Z m D) = classTot X m (pfClosed i m D)
proof:
:= by
  change totalPushOn (opsK k) i (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow Z n) m
    ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow Z m))) =
    DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) m
      ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (pfClosed i m D) : DimChow X m))
  unfold totalPushOn
  rw [DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  congr 1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.totalCapOn_classTot
statement:
theorem totalCapOn_classTot {Z : Scheme.{u}} [Z.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Z ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian Z] [Fact (ProjK k Z)] (A : Z.Modules) (hA : HasConstantRank Z A 1) (m : ℕ)
    (D : dimensionCycles Z (m + 1)) :
    totalCapOn (opsK k) A hA (classTot Z (m + 1) D) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow Z n) m
        ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] D5.capCycles (k := k) A hA m D)
proof:
:= by
  change totalCapOn (opsK k) A hA (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow Z n) (m + 1)
    ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow Z (m + 1)))) = _
  rw [totalCapOn_lof_succ_of_eq (opsK k) A hA rfl _ _ HEq.rfl]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.lTot_classTot
statement:
theorem lTot_classTot (m : ℕ) (D : dimensionCycles Y m) :
    lTot (k := k) C ι U hC hU jY hY (classTot Y m D) =
      lCyc (k := k) C ι (C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU) m (pfClosed jY m D)
proof:
:= by
  change lTot (k := k) C ι U hC hU jY hY (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow Y n) m
    ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow Y m))) = _
  rw [lTot, DirectSum.toModule_lof, lChowQ, LinearMap.liftBaseChange_tmul, one_smul]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.lTot_lof_capCycles
statement:
theorem lTot_lof_capCycles (A : Y.Modules) (hA : HasConstantRank Y A 1) (m : ℕ)
    (D : dimensionCycles Y (m + 1)) :
    lTot (k := k) C ι U hC hU jY hY (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow Y n) m
      ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] D5.capCycles (k := k) A hA m D)) =
      lChow (k := k) C ι U hC hU jY hY m (D5.capCycles (k := k) A hA m D)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lTot, DirectSum.toModule_lof, lChowQ, LinearMap.liftBaseChange_tmul, one_smul]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.pfClosed_comp
statement:
theorem pfClosed_comp {A B Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ Z) [IsClosedImmersion f]
    [IsClosedImmersion g] [IsClosedImmersion (f ≫ g)] (m : ℕ) (D : dimensionCycles A m) :
    pfClosed (f ≫ g) m D = pfClosed g m (pfClosed f m D)
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (properPushforward_comp f g D.1)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.pfClosed_congr
statement:
theorem pfClosed_congr {A Z : Scheme.{u}} {f g : A ⟶ Z} [IsClosedImmersion f]
    [IsClosedImmersion g] (h : f = g) (m : ℕ) (D : dimensionCycles A m) :
    pfClosed f m D = pfClosed g m D
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.lTot_push_gamma
statement:
theorem lTot_push_gamma {T : Scheme.{u}} [T.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (T ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian T] [Fact (ProjK k T)] (jT : T ⟶ C.graphModel (k := k)) [IsClosedImmersion jT]
    [jT.IsOver (Spk k)] (hT : Set.range jT ⊆ closure {C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU}) :
    haveI
proof:
:= isProper_interFst_g2tbiv (k := k) jY jT
    lTot (k := k) C ι U hC hU jY hY ∘ₗ totalPushOn (opsK k) (interFst jY jT) = 0 := by
  haveI := isProper_interFst_g2tbiv (k := k) jY jT
  refine DirectSum.linearMap_ext ℚ fun m ↦ rationalDimChow_hom_ext fun D ↦ ?_
  change lTot (k := k) C ι U hC hU jY hY (totalPushOn (opsK k) (interFst jY jT)
    (classTot _ m D)) = 0
  rw [totalPushOn_classTot, lTot_classTot, ← pfClosed_comp]
  refine lCyc_eq_zero_of_support (k := k) C ι _ _ fun x hx ↦ ?_
  by_contra hxγ
  apply hx
  apply pfClosed_apply_of_not_mem
  rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
  apply hxγ
  rw [inter_condition]
  exact hT ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.lTot_push_over
statement:
theorem lTot_push_over :
    haveI
proof:
:= isProper_interFst_g2tbiv (k := k) jY (jX (k := k) C ι)
    haveI := isProper_interSnd_g2tbiv (k := k) jY (jX (k := k) C ι)
    lTot (k := k) C ι U hC hU jY hY ∘ₗ totalPushOn (opsK k) (interFst jY (jX (k := k) C ι)) =
      totalPushOn (opsK k) (ηX (k := k) C ι) ∘ₗ opWX (k := k) C ι ∘ₗ
        totalPushOn (opsK k) (interSnd jY (jX (k := k) C ι)) := by
  haveI := isProper_interFst_g2tbiv (k := k) jY (jX (k := k) C ι)
  haveI := isProper_interSnd_g2tbiv (k := k) jY (jX (k := k) C ι)
  refine DirectSum.linearMap_ext ℚ fun m ↦ rationalDimChow_hom_ext fun D ↦ ?_
  change lTot (k := k) C ι U hC hU jY hY (totalPushOn (opsK k) (interFst jY (jX (k := k) C ι))
    (classTot _ m D)) = totalPushOn (opsK k) (ηX (k := k) C ι) (opWX (k := k) C ι
      (totalPushOn (opsK k) (interSnd jY (jX (k := k) C ι)) (classTot _ m D)))
  rw [totalPushOn_classTot, totalPushOn_classTot, lTot_classTot, ← pfClosed_comp]
  have hfac : interFst jY (jX (k := k) C ι) ≫ jY = interSnd jY (jX (k := k) C ι) ≫ jX (k := k) C ι :=
    inter_condition _ _
  have h1 : pfClosed (interFst jY (jX (k := k) C ι) ≫ jY) m D =
      pfClosed (jX (k := k) C ι) m (pfClosed (interSnd jY (jX (k := k) C ι)) m D) := by
    rw [pfClosed_congr hfac, pfClosed_comp]
  rw [h1, lCyc_eq_outX (k := k) C ι U hC hU]
  have h2 : G2T2C.restrictHom (jX (k := k) C ι) m
      (pfClosed (jX (k := k) C ι) m (pfClosed (interSnd jY (jX (k := k) C ι)) m D)) =
      pfClosed (interSnd jY (jX (k := k) C ι)) m D :=
    Subtype.ext (G2T2C.restrictCycle_properPushforward (jX (k := k) C ι) _)
  rw [h2]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.pfClosed_partOn_inter
statement:
theorem pfClosed_partOn_inter (m : ℕ) (β : dimensionCycles Y m) :
    pfClosed jY m (partOn (interFst jY jT) m β) = partOn jT m (pfClosed jY m β)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.range jY
  · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [pfClosed_apply_self]
    by_cases hy : y ∈ Set.range (interFst jY jT)
    · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hy
      rw [partOn_apply_of_mem, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, inter_condition, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply,
        partOn_apply_of_mem, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← inter_condition, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply,
        pfClosed_apply_self]
    · rw [partOn_apply_of_not_mem _ m β y hy, partOn_apply_of_not_mem]
      intro hyT
      exact hy (by rw [range_interFst]; exact hyT)
  · rw [pfClosed_apply_of_not_mem _ m _ x hx]
    by_cases hxT : x ∈ Set.range jT
    · obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hxT
      rw [partOn_apply_of_mem, pfClosed_apply_of_not_mem _ m _ _ hx]
    · rw [partOn_apply_of_not_mem _ m _ x hxT]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.pfClosed_restrict_inter
statement:
theorem pfClosed_restrict_inter (m : ℕ) (E : dimensionCycles Y m) :
    pfClosed (interSnd jY jT) m (G2T2C.restrictHom (interFst jY jT) m E) =
      G2T2C.restrictHom jT m (pfClosed jY m E)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext t
  rw [G2T2C.restrictHom_apply]
  by_cases ht : jT t ∈ Set.range jY
  · have ht' : t ∈ Set.range (interSnd jY jT) := by
      change t ∈ Set.range (pullback.snd jY jT)
      rw [Scheme.Pullback.range_snd]
      exact ht
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := ht'
    rw [pfClosed_apply_self, G2T2C.restrictHom_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← inter_condition,
      Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, pfClosed_apply_self]
  · rw [pfClosed_apply_of_not_mem _ m _ _ ht, pfClosed_apply_of_not_mem]
    rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
    apply ht
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← inter_condition, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.totalCapOn_push_apply
statement:
theorem totalCapOn_push_apply {Z V : Scheme.{u}} [Z.Over (Spk k)] [V.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Z ↘ Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (V ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian Z]
    [IsNoetherian V] [Fact (ProjK k Z)] [Fact (ProjK k V)] (q : Z ⟶ V) [q.IsOver (Spk k)]
    [IsProper q] (L : V.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank V L 1) (c : TotalChow Z) :
    totalCapOn (opsK k) L hL (totalPushOn (opsK k) q c) =
      totalPushOn (opsK k) q (totalCapOn (opsK k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback Z q L 1 hL) c)
proof:
:=
  (LinearMap.congr_fun ((cpK k).cap_push q L hL) c).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.lChow_capCycles
statement:
theorem lChow_capCycles (A : (C.graphModel (k := k)).Modules)
    (hA : HasConstantRank (C.graphModel (k := k)) A 1) (m : ℕ) (β : dimensionCycles Y (m + 1)) :
    lChow (k := k) C ι U hC hU jY hY m (D5.capCycles (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback jY).obj A)
      (hasConstantRank_pullback Y jY A 1 hA) m β) =
    totalPushOn (opsK k) (ηX (k := k) C ι) (opWX (k := k) C ι
      (totalCapOn (opsK k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (jX (k := k) C ι)).obj A)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback _ (jX (k := k) C ι) A 1 hA)
        (classTot (WX (k := k) C ι) (m + 1) (G2T2C.restrictHom (jX (k := k) C ι) (m + 1)
          (pfClosed jY (m + 1) β - partOn (pointClosureι (C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU)) (m + 1)
            (pfClosed jY (m + 1) β))))))
proof:
:= by
  set γ := C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU
  
  letI : (pointClosureScheme γ).Over (Spk k) :=
    ⟨pointClosureι γ ≫ C.graphModel (k := k) ↘ Spk k⟩
  haveI : (pointClosureι γ).IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨rfl⟩
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType ((pointClosureScheme γ) ↘ Spk k) := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (pointClosureι γ ≫ C.graphModel (k := k) ↘ Spk k)
    infer_instance
  haveI : CompactSpace (pointClosureScheme γ) := (pointClosureι γ).isClosedEmbedding.compactSpace
  haveI : IsNoetherian (pointClosureScheme γ) := { }
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (pointClosureScheme γ)) :=
    ⟨projK_closed (Fact.out : ProjK k (C.graphModel (k := k))) (pointClosureι γ) rfl⟩
  haveI := isProper_interFst_g2tbiv (k := k) jY (pointClosureι γ)
  haveI := isProper_interFst_g2tbiv (k := k) jY (jX (k := k) C ι)
  haveI := isProper_interSnd_g2tbiv (k := k) jY (jX (k := k) C ι)
  set qG := interFst jY (pointClosureι γ)
  set qX := interFst jY (jX (k := k) C ι)
  set qX' := interSnd jY (jX (k := k) C ι)
  
  set βG := partOn qG (m + 1) β
  set βX := β - βG
  have hβX : partOn qX (m + 1) βX = βX := by
    refine partOn_eq_self qX (m + 1) βX fun y hy ↦ ?_
    rw [range_interFst]
    have hyG : y ∉ Set.range qG := by
      rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
      apply hy
      change β.1 (qG z) - (partOn qG (m + 1) β).1 (qG z) = 0
      rw [partOn_apply_of_mem, sub_self]
    rcases hY y with h | h
    · exact absurd (by rw [range_interFst, Set.mem_preimage, range_pointClosureι]; exact h) hyG
    · exact h
  have hsplit : β = βG + βX := (add_sub_cancel βG β).symm
  
  rw [← lTot_lof_capCycles (k := k) C ι U hC hU jY hY, ← totalCapOn_classTot,
    show classTot Y (m + 1) β = classTot Y (m + 1) βG + classTot Y (m + 1) βX by
      rw [← map_add, ← hsplit], map_add, map_add]
  
  have hG : lTot (k := k) C ι U hC hU jY hY (totalCapOn (opsK k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback jY).obj A)
      (hasConstantRank_pullback Y jY A 1 hA) (classTot Y (m + 1) βG)) = 0 := by
    rw [show βG = pfClosed qG (m + 1) (G2T2C.restrictHom qG (m + 1) β) from rfl,
      ← totalPushOn_classTot (k := k), totalCapOn_push_apply (k := k)]
    have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (lTot_push_gamma (k := k) C ι U hC hU jY hY (pointClosureι γ)
      (by rw [range_pointClosureι])) (totalCapOn (opsK k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback qG).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback jY).obj A)) (hasConstantRank_pullback _ qG _ 1
          (hasConstantRank_pullback Y jY A 1 hA)) (classTot _ (m + 1)
            (G2T2C.restrictHom qG (m + 1) β)))
    rwa [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply] at h
  rw [hG, zero_add]
  
  rw [← hβX, show partOn qX (m + 1) βX = pfClosed qX (m + 1) (G2T2C.restrictHom qX (m + 1) βX)
      from rfl, ← totalPushOn_classTot (k := k), totalCapOn_push_apply (k := k)]
  rw [show lTot (k := k) C ι U hC hU jY hY (totalPushOn (opsK k) qX _) = _ from
    LinearMap.congr_fun (lTot_push_over (k := k) C ι U hC hU jY hY) _]
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  congr 2
  rw [(cpK k).cap_iso _ (hasConstantRank_pullback _ qX' _ 1
      (hasConstantRank_pullback _ (jX (k := k) C ι) A 1 hA)) ⟨interPullbackIso jY (jX (k := k) C ι) A⟩,
    ← totalCapOn_push_apply (k := k), totalPushOn_classTot (k := k), pfClosed_restrict_inter]
  congr 3
  show pfClosed jY (m + 1) (β - partOn qG (m + 1) β) = _
  rw [map_sub, pfClosed_partOn_inter jY (pointClosureι γ)]
  exact hasConstantRank_pullback _ _ A 1 hA

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.det_mem_linMinorsIdeal
statement:
theorem det_mem_linMinorsIdeal (f : P →ₗ[R] Q) {r : ℕ} (p : Fin r → P)
    (ψ : Fin r → Module.Dual R Q) :
    (Matrix.of fun a b => ψ a (f (p b))).det ∈ linMinorsIdeal f r
proof:
:=
  Ideal.subset_span ⟨(p, ψ), rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.linMinorsIdeal_zero
statement: theorem linMinorsIdeal_zero (f : P →ₗ[R] Q) : linMinorsIdeal f 0 = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.eq_top_iff_one]
  have h := det_mem_linMinorsIdeal f (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → P) (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → Module.Dual R Q)
  rwa [Matrix.det_isEmpty] at h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.linMinorsIdeal_equiv
statement:
theorem linMinorsIdeal_equiv {P' Q' : Type*} [AddCommGroup P'] [Module R P'] [AddCommGroup Q']
    [Module R Q'] (f : P →ₗ[R] Q) (e₁ : P' ≃ₗ[R] P) (e₂ : Q ≃ₗ[R] Q') (r : ℕ) :
    linMinorsIdeal (e₂.toLinearMap ∘ₗ f ∘ₗ e₁.toLinearMap) r = linMinorsIdeal f r
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine Ideal.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨⟨p, ψ⟩, rfl⟩
    have h := det_mem_linMinorsIdeal f (fun b => e₁ (p b)) (fun a => ψ a ∘ₗ e₂.toLinearMap)
    simpa using h
  · refine Ideal.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨⟨p, ψ⟩, rfl⟩
    have h := det_mem_linMinorsIdeal (e₂.toLinearMap ∘ₗ f ∘ₗ e₁.toLinearMap)
      (fun b => e₁.symm (p b)) (fun a => ψ a ∘ₗ e₂.symm.toLinearMap)
    simpa using h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.linMinorsIdeal_mulVecLin
statement:
theorem linMinorsIdeal_mulVecLin (d : Matrix m n R) (r : ℕ) :
    linMinorsIdeal d.mulVecLin r = GraphBundles.minorsIdeal r d
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine Ideal.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨⟨p, ψ⟩, rfl⟩
    
    let Ψ : Matrix (Fin r) m R := Matrix.of fun a i => ψ a (Pi.single i 1)
    let Pm : Matrix n (Fin r) R := Matrix.of fun k b => p b k
    have e : (Matrix.of fun a b => ψ a (d.mulVecLin (p b))) = Ψ * d * Pm := by
      ext a b
      rw [Matrix.of_apply, LinearMap.pi_apply_eq_sum_univ (ψ a)]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, smul_eq_mul,
        Ψ, Pm, Matrix.of_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      have : (fun j : m => if i = j then (1 : R) else 0) = Pi.single i 1 := by
        funext j; by_cases h : i = j <;> simp [h, eq_comm]
      rw [this]
      ring
    change (Matrix.of fun a b => ψ a (d.mulVecLin (p b))).det ∈ GraphBundles.minorsIdeal r d
    rw [e]
    have h := minor_mem_minorsIdeal (Ψ * d * Pm) (id : Fin r → Fin r) (id : Fin r → Fin r)
    rw [Matrix.submatrix_id_id] at h
    exact (minorsIdeal_mul_right_le _ _ r).trans (minorsIdeal_mul_left_le _ _ r) h
  · refine Ideal.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨⟨S, T⟩, rfl⟩
    have h := det_mem_linMinorsIdeal d.mulVecLin (fun b => Pi.single (T b) (1 : R))
      (fun a => LinearMap.proj (S a))
    have e : (Matrix.of fun a b => (LinearMap.proj (R := R) (φ := fun _ : m => R) (S a))
        (d.mulVecLin (Pi.single (T b) (1 : R)))) = d.submatrix S T := by
      ext a b
      simp [Matrix.mulVec_single]
    rwa [e] at h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.exists_satSummand_reesChart
statement:
theorem exists_satSummand_reesChart (s : Finset ι) (μ l : A) (d : ∀ j, Matrix (m j) (n j) A)
    (I : Ideal A) (hI : ∏ j ∈ s, graphFormula μ l (d j) = I) (r : I)
    (p : Ideal (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grade I) (generator I r))) [p.IsPrime]
    {j : ι} (hj : j ∈ s) :
    ∃ (S₀ : n j → n j ⊕ m j) (B : Matrix (n j ⊕ m j) (n j) (Localization.AtPrime p)),
      IsSMulRegular (Localization.AtPrime p)
          (((graphMat μ l (d j)).map ((algebraMap _ (Localization.AtPrime p)).comp
            (baseRingHom I r))).submatrix S₀ id).det ∧
        MinorsSat.IsSatSummand ((graphMat μ l (d j)).map ((algebraMap _ (Localization.AtPrime p)).comp
            (baseRingHom I r))) S₀
          (((graphMat μ l (d j)).map ((algebraMap _ (Localization.AtPrime p)).comp
            (baseRingHom I r))).submatrix S₀ id).det B
proof:
:= by
  have hJ : (∏ j ∈ s, graphFormula μ l (d j)).map
      ((algebraMap _ (Localization.AtPrime p)).comp (baseRingHom I r)) =
      Ideal.span {algebraMap _ (Localization.AtPrime p) (baseElement I r r.1)} := by
    rw [hI, ← Ideal.map_map, map_baseRingHom_eq_span_baseElement, Ideal.map_span,
      Set.image_singleton]
  have hreg : IsSMulRegular (Localization.AtPrime p)
      (algebraMap _ (Localization.AtPrime p) (baseElement I r r.1)) := by
    have hb : IsSMulRegular _ (baseElement I r r.1) := fun x y hxy =>
      (baseElement_self_isRegular I r).left hxy
    exact hb.of_flat
  exact exists_satSummand_graphMat_of_map _ s μ l d hJ hreg hj

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.ideal_finsetProd
statement:
theorem ideal_finsetProd {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (F : ι → X.IdealSheafData)
    (U : X.affineOpens) : (∏ j ∈ s, F j).ideal U = ∏ j ∈ s, (F j).ideal U
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    rw [Finset.prod_empty, Finset.prod_empty, Scheme.IdealSheafData.one_eq_top,
      Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_top, Pi.top_apply, Ideal.one_eq_top]
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.prod_insert ha, Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_mul,
      Pi.mul_apply, ih]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.graphIdeal_ideal_eq
statement:
theorem graphIdeal_ideal_eq (C : DetIdealComplex M) (U : (B0 (k := k) M).affineOpens)
    (V : M.affineOpens) (W : (P1 k).affineOpens)
    (hV : (U : (B0 (k := k) M).Opens) ≤ pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (V : M.Opens))
    (hW : (U : (B0 (k := k) M).Opens) ≤
      pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (W : (P1 k).Opens)) :
    (graphIdeal (k := k) C).ideal U = ∏ j ∈ Finset.range (C.len + 1), ⨆ r : Fin (C.rank j + 1),
      ((C.detIdeal j r).ideal V).map ((pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE V U hV).hom *
        ((zeroIdeal k).ideal W ^ (r : ℕ) * (infIdeal k).ideal W ^ (C.rank j - r)).map
          ((pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE W U hW).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [graphIdeal, ideal_finsetProd]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  rw [minorsIdeal, Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_iSup, iSup_apply]
  refine iSup_congr fun r => ?_
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_mul, Pi.mul_apply, KDGb.comap_ideal_eq_map _ _ V U hV,
    KDGb.comap_ideal_eq_map _ _ W U hW, Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_mul, Pi.mul_apply,
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_pow, Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_pow, Pi.pow_apply, Pi.pow_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.graphIdeal_ideal_eq_prod_graphFormula
statement:
theorem graphIdeal_ideal_eq_prod_graphFormula (C : DetIdealComplex M)
    (U : (B0 (k := k) M).affineOpens) (V : M.affineOpens) (W : (P1 k).affineOpens)
    (hV : (U : (B0 (k := k) M).Opens) ≤ pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (V : M.Opens))
    (hW : (U : (B0 (k := k) M).Opens) ≤
      pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (W : (P1 k).Opens))
    (μ l : Γ(B0 (k := k) M, U))
    (hl : ((zeroIdeal k).ideal W).map
      ((pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE W U hW).hom = Ideal.span {l})
    (hμ : ((infIdeal k).ideal W).map
      ((pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE W U hW).hom = Ideal.span {μ})
    {m n : ℕ → Type u} [∀ j, Fintype (m j)] [∀ j, Fintype (n j)] [∀ j, DecidableEq (m j)]
    [∀ j, DecidableEq (n j)] (D : ∀ j, Matrix (m j) (n j) Γ(B0 (k := k) M, U))
    (hn : ∀ j, Fintype.card (n j) = C.rank j)
    (hD : ∀ j (r : ℕ), r ≤ C.rank j →
      ((C.detIdeal j r).ideal V).map ((pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE V U hV).hom =
        GraphBundles.minorsIdeal r (D j)) :
    (graphIdeal (k := k) C).ideal U =
      ∏ j ∈ Finset.range (C.len + 1), graphFormula μ l (D j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [graphIdeal_ideal_eq C U V W hV hW]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  have key : ∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ C.rank j →
      ((C.detIdeal j r).ideal V).map ((pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE V U hV).hom *
        ((zeroIdeal k).ideal W ^ r * (infIdeal k).ideal W ^ (C.rank j - r)).map
          ((pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE W U hW).hom =
      GraphBundles.minorsIdeal r (D j) *
        (Ideal.span {l} ^ r * Ideal.span {μ} ^ (Fintype.card (n j) - r)) := by
    intro r hr
    rw [Ideal.map_mul, Ideal.map_pow, Ideal.map_pow, hl, hμ, hD j r hr, hn j]
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine iSup_le fun r => ?_
    have hr : (r : ℕ) ≤ C.rank j := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 r.2
    rw [key r hr]
    exact le_iSup (fun r : Fin (Fintype.card (n j) + 1) => GraphBundles.minorsIdeal (r : ℕ) (D j) *
      (Ideal.span {l} ^ (r : ℕ) * Ideal.span {μ} ^ (Fintype.card (n j) - r)))
      ⟨r, by rw [hn j]; exact r.2⟩
  · refine iSup_le fun r => ?_
    have hr : (r : ℕ) ≤ C.rank j := by have h1 := r.2; have h2 := hn j; omega
    rw [← key r hr]
    exact le_iSup (fun r : Fin (C.rank j + 1) =>
      ((C.detIdeal j r).ideal V).map ((pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE V U hV).hom *
        ((zeroIdeal k).ideal W ^ (r : ℕ) * (infIdeal k).ideal W ^ (C.rank j - r)).map
          ((pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE W U hW).hom) ⟨r, by omega⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.exists_satSummand_graphModelChart
statement:
theorem exists_satSummand_graphModelChart (C : DetIdealComplex M)
    (U : (B0 (k := k) M).affineOpens) (V : M.affineOpens) (W : (P1 k).affineOpens)
    (hV : (U : (B0 (k := k) M).Opens) ≤ pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (V : M.Opens))
    (hW : (U : (B0 (k := k) M).Opens) ≤
      pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (W : (P1 k).Opens))
    (μ l : Γ(B0 (k := k) M, U))
    (hl : ((zeroIdeal k).ideal W).map
      ((pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE W U hW).hom = Ideal.span {l})
    (hμ : ((infIdeal k).ideal W).map
      ((pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE W U hW).hom = Ideal.span {μ})
    {m n : ℕ → Type u} [∀ j, Fintype (m j)] [∀ j, Fintype (n j)] [∀ j, DecidableEq (m j)]
    [∀ j, DecidableEq (n j)] (D : ∀ j, Matrix (m j) (n j) Γ(B0 (k := k) M, U))
    (hn : ∀ j, Fintype.card (n j) = C.rank j)
    (hD : ∀ j (r : ℕ), r ≤ C.rank j →
      ((C.detIdeal j r).ideal V).map ((pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE V U hV).hom =
        GraphBundles.minorsIdeal r (D j))
    (r : (graphIdeal (k := k) C).ideal U)
    (p : Ideal (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grade ((graphIdeal (k := k) C).ideal U))
      (generator ((graphIdeal (k := k) C).ideal U) r))) [p.IsPrime]
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ C.len) :
    ∃ (S₀ : n j → n j ⊕ m j) (B : Matrix (n j ⊕ m j) (n j) (Localization.AtPrime p)),
      IsSMulRegular (Localization.AtPrime p)
          (((graphMat μ l (D j)).map ((algebraMap _ (Localization.AtPrime p)).comp
            (baseRingHom _ r))).submatrix S₀ id).det ∧
        MinorsSat.IsSatSummand ((graphMat μ l (D j)).map ((algebraMap _ (Localization.AtPrime p)).comp
            (baseRingHom _ r))) S₀
          (((graphMat μ l (D j)).map ((algebraMap _ (Localization.AtPrime p)).comp
            (baseRingHom _ r))).submatrix S₀ id).det B
proof:
:=
  exists_satSummand_reesChart (Finset.range (C.len + 1)) μ l D _
    (graphIdeal_ideal_eq_prod_graphFormula C U V W hV hW μ l hl hμ D hn hD).symm r p
    (Finset.mem_range.2 (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hj))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.pointClosureIdeal_le_map_of_specializes

theorem pointClosureIdeal_le_map_of_specializes (ξ : X) (v : Y) (h : v ⤳ f ξ) :
    pointClosureIdeal v ≤ (pointClosureIdeal ξ).map f
proof:
:= by
  unfold pointClosureIdeal

  apply Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal_antimono

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.pfClosed_apply_of_not_mem

proof:

proof:
:= by

  ext x

    by_contra h
    exact hx (hD x (Ne.symm h))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.opWX_primeClassT2_eq_zero
statement:
theorem opWX_primeClassT2_eq_zero (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U)
    (hU : (U : Set M).Nonempty) {m : ℕ} (w : WX (k := k) C ι) (hw : height w = m)
    (hγ : C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU ⤳ jX (k := k) C ι w) :
    opWX (k := k) C ι (primeClassT2 w m hw) = 0
proof:
:= by
  set V := pointClosureScheme w
  letI : V.Over (Spk k) := ⟨pointClosureι w ≫ WX (k := k) C ι ↘ Spk k⟩
  haveI : (pointClosureι w).IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨rfl⟩
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (V ↘ Spk k) := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (pointClosureι w ≫ WX (k := k) C ι ↘ Spk k)
    infer_instance
  haveI : CompactSpace V := (pointClosureι w).isClosedEmbedding.compactSpace
  haveI : IsNoetherian V := { }
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k V) :=
    ⟨projK_closed (Fact.out : ProjK k (WX (k := k) C ι)) (pointClosureι w) rfl⟩
  haveI : ConnectedSpace V := connectedSpace_of_isIntegral
  haveI : IsProper (pointClosureι w) := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
  have hgen : pointClosureι w (genericPoint V) = w := f17_pc_generic w
  have hη : height (genericPoint V) = m := by
    rw [← height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion (pointClosureι w), hgen, hw]
  
  have hγ' : C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU ⤳ jX (k := k) C ι w := hγ
  let g : V ⟶ C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU :=
    closureMapSpec (jX (k := k) C ι) w (C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU) hγ'
  have hg : g ≫ C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU = pointClosureι w ≫ jX (k := k) C ι :=
    closureMapSpec_ι (jX (k := k) C ι) w (C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU) hγ'
  rw [primeClass_eq_push (k := k) (pointClosureι w) w hgen m hw hη, opWX,
    ← altCh_push (pointClosureι w) (fun j ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (jX (k := k) C ι)).obj
      (C.xi j)) C.rank (fun j ↦ hasConstantRank_pullback _ _ _ _ (C.hasConstantRank_xi (k := k) j))]
  have h0 : altCh k (fun j ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι w)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (jX (k := k) C ι)).obj (C.xi j))) C.K.len = 0 := by
    have hiso : ∀ j, (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι w)).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (jX (k := k) C ι)).obj (C.xi j)) ≅
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (g ≫ C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU)).obj (C.xi j) := fun j ↦
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (pointClosureι w) (jX (k := k) C ι)).app (C.xi j) ≪≫
        eqToIso (by rw [hg])
    have hF : ∀ j, HasConstantRank V ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
        (g ≫ C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU)).obj (C.xi j)) (C.rank j) := fun j ↦
      hasConstantRank_pullback _ _ _ _ (C.hasConstantRank_xi (k := k) j)
    have h1 : altCh k (fun j ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι w)).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (jX (k := k) C ι)).obj (C.xi j))) C.K.len =
        altCh k (fun j ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (g ≫ C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU)).obj
          (C.xi j)) C.K.len := by
      unfold altCh
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
      exact congrArg (fun T ↦ ((-1 : ℤ) ^ j) • T) (GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4A.chTot_iso (hiso j))
    rw [h1, ← chK0T2_altSum_eq (k := k) _ C.rank hF]
    have h2 := C.gamma_k0_altSum_pullback_eq_zero (k := k) U hC hU g
    have h3 : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (C.K.len + 1), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ j) •
        k0ClassOf V ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (g ≫ C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU)).obj
          (C.xi j)) (hF j).isFiniteLocallyFree = 0 := by
      rw [← h2]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
      rcases Nat.even_or_odd j with hj | hj
      · rw [hj.neg_one_pow, hj.neg_one_pow, one_smul, one_mul]
      · rw [hj.neg_one_pow, hj.neg_one_pow, neg_one_mul]
        exact neg_one_zsmul _
    rw [h3, map_zero]
  rw [h0, LinearMap.zero_apply, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.classTot_eq_zero_of_mk_eq_zero
statement:
theorem classTot_eq_zero_of_mk_eq_zero (Y : Scheme.{u}) (m : ℕ) (D : dimensionCycles Y m)
    (hD : (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow Y m) = 0) : classTot Y m D = 0
proof:
:= by
  change DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow Y n) m
    ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow Y m)) = 0
  rw [hD, TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.outX_dimPrimeCycle
statement:
theorem outX_dimPrimeCycle {m : ℕ} (w : WX (k := k) C ι) (hw : height w = m) :
    outX (k := k) C ι m (dimPrimeCycle w m hw) =
      totalPushOn (opsK k) (ηX (k := k) C ι) (opWX (k := k) C ι (primeClassT2 w m hw))
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.outX_restrict_eq_zero
statement:
theorem outX_restrict_eq_zero (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U)
    (hU : (U : Set M).Nonempty) {m : ℕ} (D : dimensionCycles (C.graphModel (k := k)) m)
    (hD : ∀ x, D.1 x ≠ 0 → x ∈ closure {C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU}) :
    outX (k := k) C ι m (G2T2C.restrictHom (jX (k := k) C ι) m D) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hmem := G2TEXC.dimCycle_mem_of_prime_on (outX (k := k) C ι m).ker
    (fun v ↦ C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU ⤳ jX (k := k) C ι v) (fun v hv hP ↦ ?_)
    (G2T2C.restrictHom (jX (k := k) C ι) m D) (fun v hv ↦ ?_)
  · exact hmem
  · rw [AddMonoidHom.mem_ker, outX_dimPrimeCycle,
      opWX_primeClassT2_eq_zero (k := k) C ι U hC hU v hv hP, map_zero]
  · rw [G2T2C.restrictHom_apply] at hv
    exact specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr (hD _ hv)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.lCyc_apply
statement:
theorem lCyc_apply (γ : C.graphModel (k := k)) (m : ℕ) (D : dimensionCycles (C.graphModel (k := k)) m) :
    lCyc (k := k) C ι γ m D = outX (k := k) C ι m (G2T2C.restrictHom (jX (k := k) C ι) m
      (D - partOn (pointClosureι γ) m D))
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.lCyc_eq_zero_of_support
proof:
:= by
  rw [lCyc_apply, partOn_eq_self (pointClosureι γ) m D (fun x hx ↦ by
    rw [range_pointClosureι]; exact hD x hx), sub_self, map_zero, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.lCyc_eq_outX
statement:
theorem lCyc_eq_outX (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) (hU : (U : Set M).Nonempty) {m : ℕ}
    (D : dimensionCycles (C.graphModel (k := k)) m) :
    lCyc (k := k) C ι (C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU) m D =
      outX (k := k) C ι m (G2T2C.restrictHom (jX (k := k) C ι) m D)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lCyc_apply, map_sub, map_sub, outX_restrict_eq_zero (k := k) C ι U hC hU
    (partOn (pointClosureι (C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU)) m D), sub_zero]
  intro x hx
  by_cases hxr : x ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι (C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU))
  · rwa [range_pointClosureι] at hxr
  · exact absurd (partOn_apply_of_not_mem _ m D x hxr) hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.lCyc_relation
statement:
theorem lCyc_relation (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) (hU : (U : Set M).Nonempty)
    {m : ℕ} (G : DimRelationGenerator (C.graphModel (k := k)) m)
    (hG : (∀ y, G.i y ∈ closure {C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU}) ∨
      (∀ y, G.i y ∈ Set.range (jX (k := k) C ι))) :
    lCyc (k := k) C ι (C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU) m G.cycle = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsupp : ∀ x, G.cycle.1 x ≠ 0 → x ∈ Set.range G.i := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : x ∈ (properPushforward G.i (div G.f)).support := hx
    rw [properPushforward, pushforward_support_closedImmersion G.i (div G.f) (fun _ ↦ ())
      (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl)] at hx'
    obtain ⟨y, _, rfl⟩ := hx'
    exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
  rcases hG with hG | hG
  · refine lCyc_eq_zero_of_support (k := k) C ι _ G.cycle fun x hx ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hsupp x hx
    exact hG y
  · rw [lCyc_eq_outX (k := k) C ι U hC hU]
    exact (congrArg (fun T ↦ ((totalPushOn (opsK k) (ηX (k := k) C ι)) ∘ₗ
      (opWX (k := k) C ι)) T) (classTot_eq_zero_of_mk_eq_zero _ m _
        (G2T2C.restrictHom_relation_of_range (jX (k := k) C ι) G hG))).trans (map_zero _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.relation_dichotomy
statement:
theorem relation_dichotomy (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) (hU : (U : Set M).Nonempty)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (jY : Y ⟶ C.graphModel (k := k)) [IsClosedImmersion jY]
    (hY : ∀ y, jY y ∈ closure {C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU} ∨ jY y ∈ Set.range (jX (k := k) C ι))
    {m : ℕ} (G : DimRelationGenerator Y m) :
    (∀ y, (G.i ≫ jY) y ∈ closure {C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU}) ∨
      (∀ y, (G.i ≫ jY) y ∈ Set.range (jX (k := k) C ι))
proof:
:= by
  have hspec : ∀ y : G.Y, (G.i ≫ jY) (genericPoint G.Y) ⤳ (G.i ≫ jY) y := fun y ↦
    (genericPoint_specializes y).map (G.i ≫ jY).continuous
  rcases hY (G.i (genericPoint G.Y)) with h | h
  · exact Or.inl fun y ↦ (hspec y).mem_closed isClosed_closure h
  · exact Or.inr fun y ↦ (hspec y).mem_closed
      (jX (k := k) C ι).isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.mem_closure_or_range_of_mem_infSupport
statement:
theorem mem_closure_or_range_of_mem_infSupport (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U)
    (hU : (U : Set M).Nonempty) (hX : ∀ x : M, x ∉ U → x ∈ Set.range ι)
    {x : C.graphModel (k := k)} (hx : x ∈ (infDivisor (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex).support) :
    x ∈ closure {C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU} ∨ x ∈ Set.range (jX (k := k) C ι)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hxU : C.graphProj (k := k) x ∈ U
  · exact Or.inl (specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp
      (C.gammaPt_specializes (k := k) U hC hU hx hxU))
  · right
    rw [range_jX]
    exact hX _ hxU

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.lChow_mk
statement:
theorem lChow_mk (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) (hU : (U : Set M).Nonempty)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (jY : Y ⟶ C.graphModel (k := k)) [IsClosedImmersion jY]
    (hY : ∀ y, jY y ∈ closure {C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU} ∨ jY y ∈ Set.range (jX (k := k) C ι))
    (m : ℕ) (D : dimensionCycles Y m) :
    lChow (k := k) C ι U hC hU jY hY m (QuotientAddGroup.mk D) =
      lCyc (k := k) C ι (C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU) m (pfClosed jY m D)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.eq_of_specializes_of_height_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_specializes_of_height_eq {Y : Scheme.{u}} {a b : Y} (h : a ⤳ b) {n : ℕ}
    (ha : height a = n) (hb : height b = n) : b = a
proof:
:= by
  have hle : b ≤ a := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr h
  by_cases hab : a ≤ b
  · exact ((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hab).antisymm h).eq
  · have := height_strictMono (lt_of_le_not_ge hle hab) (by rw [hb]; exact ENat.coe_lt_top n)
    rw [ha, hb] at this
    exact absurd this (lt_irrefl _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.partOn_infDimCycle
statement:
theorem partOn_infDimCycle (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) (hU : (U : Set M).Nonempty)
    {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    partOn (pointClosureι (C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU)) n
        (infDimCycle (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex (hW_tlmap (k := k) C hM)) =
      gammaCycle (k := k) C U hC hM
proof:
:= by
  have hγ := height_gammaPt (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex U (C.isSplitOn_of_sectionExactOn U hC)
    hU hM
  have hg : gammaCycle (k := k) C U hC hM = dimPrimeCycle (C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU) n hγ :=
    dif_pos hU
  rw [hg]
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext x
  rw [m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply]
  by_cases hxr : x ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι (C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU))
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hxr
    rw [partOn_apply_of_mem]
    have hspec : C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU ⤳ pointClosureι (C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU) z := by
      apply specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr
      rw [← range_pointClosureι]
      exact ⟨z, rfl⟩
    by_cases hz : pointClosureι (C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU) z = C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU
    · rw [if_pos hz, hz]
      exact C.infCycle_gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU
    · rw [if_neg hz]
      by_contra hne
      have hh := (infDimCycle (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex (hW_tlmap (k := k) C hM)).2 hne
      exact hz (eq_of_specializes_of_height_eq hspec hγ hh)
  · rw [partOn_apply_of_not_mem _ n _ x hxr, if_neg]
    rintro rfl
    exact hxr (mem_range_pointClosureι _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.tauRaw_eq_lCyc
statement:
theorem tauRaw_eq_lCyc (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) (hU : (U : Set M).Nonempty)
    {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    tauRaw (k := k) C ι U hC hM = lCyc (k := k) C ι (C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU) n
      (infDimCycle (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex (hW_tlmap (k := k) C hM))
proof:
:= by
  rw [lCyc_apply, partOn_infDimCycle (k := k) C U hC hU hM]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.gammaPt_eq
statement:
theorem gammaPt_eq (U U' : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) (hC' : C.SectionExactOn U')
    (hU : (U : Set M).Nonempty) (hU' : (U' : Set M).Nonempty) {n : ℕ}
    (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU = C.gammaPt (k := k) U' hC' hU'
proof:
:= by
  have hV : ((U ⊓ U' : M.Opens) : Set M).Nonempty :=
    nonempty_preirreducible_inter U.isOpen U'.isOpen hU hU'
  have hCV : C.SectionExactOn (U ⊓ U') := fun V hVle ↦ hC V (hVle.trans inf_le_left)
  have key : ∀ (U₀ : M.Opens) (hC₀ : C.SectionExactOn U₀) (hU₀ : (U₀ : Set M).Nonempty),
      U ⊓ U' ≤ U₀ → C.gammaPt (k := k) (U ⊓ U') hCV hV = C.gammaPt (k := k) U₀ hC₀ hU₀ := by
    intro U₀ hC₀ hU₀ hle
    have hs : C.gammaPt (k := k) U₀ hC₀ hU₀ ⤳ C.gammaPt (k := k) (U ⊓ U') hCV hV :=
      C.gammaPt_specializes (k := k) U₀ hC₀ hU₀
        (gammaPt_mem_support (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex _ _ hV)
        (hle (C.xiProj_gammaPt_mem (k := k) (U ⊓ U') hCV hV))
    exact eq_of_specializes_of_height_eq hs
      (height_gammaPt (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex U₀ (C.isSplitOn_of_sectionExactOn U₀ hC₀)
        hU₀ hM)
      (height_gammaPt (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex (U ⊓ U')
        (C.isSplitOn_of_sectionExactOn (U ⊓ U') hCV) hV hM)
  rw [← key U hC hU inf_le_left, ← key U' hC' hU' inf_le_right]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.tauRaw_indep
statement:
theorem tauRaw_indep (U U' : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) (hC' : C.SectionExactOn U')
    (hX : ∀ x : M, x ∉ U → x ∈ Set.range ι) (hX' : ∀ x : M, x ∉ U' → x ∈ Set.range ι) {n : ℕ}
    (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    tauRaw (k := k) C ι U hC hM = tauRaw (k := k) C ι U' hC' hM
proof:
:= by
  
  have hempty : ∀ (U₁ U₂ : M.Opens) (hC₁ : C.SectionExactOn U₁) (hC₂ : C.SectionExactOn U₂)
      (hU₁ : (U₁ : Set M).Nonempty), ¬ (U₂ : Set M).Nonempty →
      (∀ x : M, x ∉ U₂ → x ∈ Set.range ι) →
      tauRaw (k := k) C ι U₁ hC₁ hM = tauRaw (k := k) C ι U₂ hC₂ hM := by
    intro U₁ U₂ hC₁ hC₂ hU₁ hU₂ hX₂
    rw [tauRaw_eq_lCyc (k := k) C ι U₁ hC₁ hU₁ hM, lCyc_eq_outX (k := k) C ι U₁ hC₁ hU₁]
    have hr : rCycle (k := k) C U₂ hC₂ hM =
        infDimCycle (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex (hW_tlmap (k := k) C hM) := by
      rw [rCycle, gammaCycle, dif_neg hU₂, sub_zero]
    rw [tauRaw, rhoX, hr]
    rfl
  by_cases hU : (U : Set M).Nonempty
  · by_cases hU' : (U' : Set M).Nonempty
    · rw [tauRaw_eq_lCyc (k := k) C ι U hC hU hM, tauRaw_eq_lCyc (k := k) C ι U' hC' hU' hM,
        gammaPt_eq (k := k) C U U' hC hC' hU hU' hM]
    · exact hempty U U' hC hC' hU hU' hX'
  · by_cases hU' : (U' : Set M).Nonempty
    · exact (hempty U' U hC' hC hU' hU hX).symm
    · have h1 : rCycle (k := k) C U hC hM = rCycle (k := k) C U' hC' hM := by
        rw [rCycle, rCycle, gammaCycle, gammaCycle, dif_neg hU, dif_neg hU']
      rw [tauRaw, tauRaw, rhoX, rhoX, h1]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.preservesBinaryBiproducts_pullback_g2tsum
statement:
theorem preservesBinaryBiproducts_pullback_g2tsum {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    PreservesBinaryBiproducts (Scheme.Modules.pullback f)
proof:
:=
  preservesBinaryBiproducts_of_preservesBiproducts _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.graphDefect_transport_g2tsum
statement:
theorem graphDefect_transport_g2tsum (a : G ⟶ G₂) (b : P ⟶ P₂) (c : Q ⟶ Q₂)
    (h₁ : pr₁ ≫ b = a ≫ pr₁₂) (h₂ : pr₂ ≫ c = a ≫ pr₂₂) (hδ : δ ≫ c = b ≫ δ₂) (V : Y.Opens)
    (s : Γ(G, V)) :
    graphDefect pr₁₂ pr₂₂ δ₂ W₁ t V (a.app V s) =
      c.app (V ⊓ W₁) (graphDefect pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V s)
proof:
:= by
  have e₁ : pr₁₂.app V (a.app V s) = b.app V (pr₁.app V s) := by
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
      ← Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ← Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, h₁]
  have e₂ : pr₂₂.app V (a.app V s) = c.app V (pr₂.app V s) := by
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
      ← Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ← Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, h₂]
  have eδ : ∀ (V' : Y.Opens) (x : Γ(P, V')), δ₂.app V' (b.app V' x) = c.app V' (δ.app V' x) := by
    intro V' x
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
      ← Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ← Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, hδ]
  simp only [graphDefect, e₁, e₂, map_sub, Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul, app_res_xiS, eδ]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.genGraph_transport_g2tsum
statement:
theorem genGraph_transport_g2tsum (a : G ⟶ G₂) (b : P ⟶ P₂) (c : Q ⟶ Q₂)
    (h₁ : pr₁ ≫ b = a ≫ pr₁₂) (h₂ : pr₂ ≫ c = a ≫ pr₂₂) (hδ : δ ≫ c = b ≫ δ₂) (V : Y.Opens)
    {s : Γ(G, V)} (hs : GenGraph pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V s) :
    GenGraph pr₁₂ pr₂₂ δ₂ W₁ t V (a.app V s)
proof:
:= by
  intro hV
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hAne, hA0⟩ := hs hV
  refine ⟨A, hA, hAne, ?_⟩
  rw [graphDefect_transport_g2tsum W₁ t a b c h₁ h₂ hδ, ← app_res_xiS, hA0, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.etaGen_nat_g2tsum
statement:
theorem etaGen_nat_g2tsum {A A' : Z.Modules} (φ : A ⟶ A') :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map φ) ≫
        (etaGen_g2tsum f g π h A').hom =
      (etaGen_g2tsum f g π h A).hom ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map φ
proof:
:=
  (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f g ≪≫ Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr h).hom.naturality φ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.etaGen_nat_apply_g2tsum
statement:
theorem etaGen_nat_apply_g2tsum {A A' : Z.Modules} (φ : A ⟶ A') (V : X.Opens)
    (w : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj A), V)) :
    (etaGen_g2tsum f g π h A').hom.app V
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map φ)).app V w) =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map φ).app V ((etaGen_g2tsum f g π h A).hom.app V w)
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun ψ => Scheme.Modules.Hom.app ψ V w) (etaGen_nat_g2tsum f g π h φ)

theorem pullSecXiR_apply_g2tsum {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) (E : X.Modules) (V : X.Opens)
    {ι : Type u} (s : ι → Γ(E, V)) (i : ι) :
    pullSecXiR f E V s i = pullS_xipb f E V (s i)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.genGraph_pull_g2tsum
statement:
theorem genGraph_pull_g2tsum (hO : β ⁻¹ᵁ O' = O)
    (ht : ∀ (U : W'.Opens) (hU : U ≤ O') (hV : β ⁻¹ᵁ U ≤ O),
      (W.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op).hom t =
        (β.app U).hom ((W'.presheaf.map (homOfLE hU).op).hom t'))
    (hO'ne : (O' : Set W').Nonempty) (hOne : (O : Set W).Nonempty)
    (hQ : ResInjXiG ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π').obj F)) (T : W'.Opens)
    (y : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π').obj (E ⊞ F), T))
    (hy : GenGraph ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π').map biprod.fst)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π').map biprod.snd) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π').map d) O' t' T y) :
    GenGraph ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map biprod.fst)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map biprod.snd) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map d) O t
      (β ⁻¹ᵁ T) ((etaGen_g2tsum β π' π hπ (E ⊞ F)).hom.app _ (pullS_xipb β _ T y))
proof:
:= by
  intro hne
  have hT : (T : Set W').Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hne
    exact ⟨_, hx⟩
  have h0 := (genGraph_iff_graphDefect_eq_zero_xiG _ _ _ hQ hO'ne hT y).1 hy
  have hle : β ⁻¹ᵁ (T ⊓ O') ≤ β ⁻¹ᵁ T ⊓ O :=
    le_inf (Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono _ inf_le_left)
      ((Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono _ inf_le_right).trans hO.le)
  have hne' : ((β ⁻¹ᵁ (T ⊓ O') : Opens _) : Set W).Nonempty := by
    have := nonempty_inter_xiS hne hOne
    rw [← hO] at this
    exact this
  refine ⟨_, hle, hne', ?_⟩
  rw [res_graphDefect_xipb, ← app_res_xiR,
    ← pullS_res_xipb β _ (inf_le_left : T ⊓ O' ≤ T)]
  rw [← etaGen_nat_apply_g2tsum, ← etaGen_nat_apply_g2tsum,
    ← etaGen_nat_apply_g2tsum, pullS_map_xipb, pullS_map_xipb, pullS_map_xipb,
    ht (T ⊓ O') inf_le_right]
  rw [← Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul, ← map_sub, ← pullS_smul_xipb, ← pullS_sub_xipb,
    ← graphDefect_eq_xipb, h0, pullS_zero_xipb, map_zero]

theorem homGen_app_pullS_g2tsum (T : W'.Opens) (x : Γ(S, T)) :
    (homGen_g2tsum β π' π hπ incE incT ι').app _ (pullS_xipb β S T x) =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map (biprod.map incE incT)).app _
        ((etaGen_g2tsum β π' π hπ (E ⊞ F)).hom.app _ (pullS_xipb β _ T (ι'.app T x)))
proof:
:= by
  change ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map (biprod.map incE incT)).app _
      ((etaGen_g2tsum β π' π hπ (E ⊞ F)).hom.app _
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullback β).map ι').app _ (pullS_xipb β S T x))) = _
  rw [pullS_map_xipb]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.genGraph_homGen_g2tsum
statement:
theorem genGraph_homGen_g2tsum (hinc : d ≫ incT = incE ≫ d₀) (hO : β ⁻¹ᵁ O' = O)
    (ht : ∀ (U : W'.Opens) (hU : U ≤ O') (hV : β ⁻¹ᵁ U ≤ O),
      (W.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op).hom t =
        (β.app U).hom ((W'.presheaf.map (homOfLE hU).op).hom t'))
    (hO'ne : (O' : Set W').Nonempty) (hOne : (O : Set W).Nonempty)
    (hQ : ResInjXiG ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π').obj F))
    (hS : ∀ (T : W'.Opens) (x : Γ(S, T)), GenGraph ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π').map biprod.fst)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π').map biprod.snd) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π').map d) O' t' T
      (ι'.app T x))
    (T : W'.Opens) (x : Γ(S, T)) :
    GenGraph ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map biprod.fst)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map biprod.snd) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map d₀) O t
      (β ⁻¹ᵁ T) ((homGen_g2tsum β π' π hπ incE incT ι').app _ (pullS_xipb β S T x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [homGen_app_pullS_g2tsum]
  refine genGraph_transport_g2tsum O t
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map (biprod.map incE incT))
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map incE) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map incT) ?_ ?_ ?_ _
    (genGraph_pull_g2tsum β π' π hπ d O' t' O t hO ht hO'ne hOne hQ T _ (hS T x))
  · rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp, biprod.map_fst]
  · rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp, biprod.map_snd]
  · rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp, hinc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.xiCoord_dom_g2tsum
statement:
theorem xiCoord_dom_g2tsum {U : (C'.graphModel (k := k)).Opens}
    {V : (C.graphModel (k := k)).Opens} (hU : U ≤ xiOpen (k := k) C')
    (hV : V ≤ xiOpen (k := k) C) (h₁ : V ≤ β ⁻¹ᵁ U) :
    ((C.graphModel (k := k)).presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op).hom (xiCoord (k := k) C) =
      (β.appLE U V h₁).hom
        (((C'.graphModel (k := k)).presheaf.map (homOfLE hU).op).hom (xiCoord (k := k) C'))
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (f : C.graphModel (k := k) ⟶ P1 k)
      (_ : f = graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex)
      (e : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 1).1),
      f.appLE (chartOpen k 1).1 V e =
        (graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex).appLE (chartOpen k 1).1 V hV := by
    intro f hf e
    subst hf
    rfl
  change ((graphToP1 (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex).appLE (chartOpen k 1).1 V hV).hom
      (secEquiv k 1 Polynomial.X) =
    (β.appLE U V h₁).hom
      (((graphToP1 (k := k) C'.toDetIdealComplex).appLE (chartOpen k 1).1 U hU).hom
        (secEquiv k 1 Polynomial.X))
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE,
    key (β ≫ graphToP1 (k := k) C'.toDetIdealComplex) (toP1_dom_g2tsum C C' β hβ)]

    (y : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C')).obj (C'.K.E j ⊞ C'.tgt j), T))
    (hy : GenGraph ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C')).map biprod.fst)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C')).map biprod.snd)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C')).map (C'.dj j)) (xiOpen (k := k) C')
      (xiCoord (k := k) C') T y) :
    GenGraph ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).map biprod.fst)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).map biprod.snd)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).map (C'.dj j)) (xiOpen (k := k) C)
      (xiCoord (k := k) C) (β ⁻¹ᵁ T)
      ((etaDomApp_g2tsum C C' β hβ (C'.K.E j ⊞ C'.tgt j)).hom.app _ (pullS_xipb β _ T y))
proof:
:=
  genGraph_pull_g2tsum β (xiProj (k := k) C') (xiProj (k := k) C) (xiProj_dom_g2tsum C C' β hβ)
    (C'.dj j) (xiOpen (k := k) C') (xiCoord (k := k) C') (xiOpen (k := k) C) (xiCoord (k := k) C)
    (preimage_xiOpen_g2tsum C C' β hβ)
    (fun U hU hV => by
      rw [xiCoord_dom_g2tsum C C' β hβ hU hV le_rfl, Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app])
    (xiOpen_nonempty (k := k) C') (xiOpen_nonempty (k := k) C)
    (resInjXiG_of_hasConstantRank (hasConstantRank_pullback _ _ _ _ (C'.hasConstantRank_tgt j)))

theorem exists_frame_dom_g2tsum (w : C.graphModel (k := k)) :
    ∃ (O : (C.graphModel (k := k)).Opens) (_ : w ∈ O) (ι : Type u) (_ : Fintype ι)
      (p : ι → Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback β).obj (C'.xi (k := k) j), O)),
      IsSecFrame _ O p ∧ ∀ i,
        GenGraph ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).map biprod.fst)
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).map biprod.snd)
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).map (C.dj j)) (xiOpen (k := k) C)
          (xiCoord (k := k) C) O ((xiDomHom_g2tsum C C' β hβ j incE incT).app O (p i))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, -⟩ := C'.exists_xiChart (k := k) j (β w)
  have hb := biprodXiR_pullback (xiProj (k := k) C') (C'.K.E j) (C'.tgt j)

    pullSecXiR β (C'.xi (k := k) j) c.T (c.sec hb (xiOpen_nonempty (k := k) C')),
    isSecFrame_pullback _ _ _ (c.isSecFrame hb (xiOpen_nonempty (k := k) C')),
    fun i => by
      rw [pullSecXiR_apply_g2tsum]
      exact genGraph_xiDomHom_g2tsum C C' β hβ j incE incT hinc c.T _⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.bijective_sum_of_frames_g2tsum
statement:
theorem bijective_sum_of_frames_g2tsum {Y : Scheme.{u}} {A₁ A₂ B G G₁ G₂ : Y.Modules}
    (ψ₁ : A₁ ⟶ B) (ψ₂ : A₂ ⟶ B) (ι : B ⟶ G) (ι₁ : A₁ ⟶ G₁) (ι₂ : A₂ ⟶ G₂) (a₁ : G₁ ⟶ G)
    (a₂ : G₂ ⟶ G) [IsIso (biprod.desc a₁ a₂)] (h₁ : ψ₁ ≫ ι = ι₁ ≫ a₁) (h₂ : ψ₂ ≫ ι = ι₂ ≫ a₂)
    {O O' : Y.Opens} {n₁ n₂ κ₁ κ₂ n' : Type u} [Fintype n₁] [Fintype n₂] [Fintype κ₁]
    [Fintype κ₂] [Fintype n'] [DecidableEq n₁] [DecidableEq n₂]
    {p₁ : n₁ → Γ(A₁, O)} (hp₁ : IsSecFrame A₁ O p₁) {p₂ : n₂ → Γ(A₂, O)}
    (hp₂ : IsSecFrame A₂ O p₂) {f₁ : κ₁ → Γ(G₁, O)} (hf₁ : IsSecFrame G₁ O f₁)
    {f₂ : κ₂ → Γ(G₂, O)} (hf₂ : IsSecFrame G₂ O f₂) (S₁ : n₁ → κ₁) (S₂ : n₂ → κ₂)
    (B₁ : Matrix κ₁ n₁ Γ(Y, O)) (B₂ : Matrix κ₂ n₂ Γ(Y, O))
    (hr₁ : B₁.submatrix S₁ id = 1) (hr₂ : B₂.submatrix S₂ id = 1)
    (hφ₁ : ∀ k, ι₁.app O (p₁ k) = Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, O) f₁ (fun a => B₁ a k))
    (hφ₂ : ∀ k, ι₂.app O (p₂ k) = Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, O) f₂ (fun a => B₂ a k))
    {s : n' → Γ(B, O')} (hs : IsSecFrame B O' s)
    (hcard : Fintype.card n₁ + Fintype.card n₂ = Fintype.card n')
    {V : Y.Opens} (hV : V ≤ O) (hV' : V ≤ O') : Function.Bijective ((biprod.desc ψ₁ ψ₂).app V)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hb := biprodXiR_biprod_g2tsum A₁ A₂
  have hbG := biprodXiR_biprod_g2tsum G₁ G₂
  refine bijective_of_frames_xipb (biprod.desc ψ₁ ψ₂) ι (n := n₁ ⊕ n₂) (κ := κ₁ ⊕ κ₂)
    (by rw [Fintype.card_sum, hcard]) (hb.isSecFrame_sumFrame hp₁ hp₂) hs
    ((hbG.isSecFrame_sumFrame hf₁ hf₂).map_iso (asIso (biprod.desc a₁ a₂)))
    (Sum.map S₁ S₂) (Matrix.fromBlocks B₁ 0 0 B₂) ?_ ?_ hV hV'
  · have : (Matrix.fromBlocks B₁ 0 0 B₂).submatrix (Sum.map S₁ S₂) id =
        Matrix.fromBlocks (B₁.submatrix S₁ id) 0 0 (B₂.submatrix S₂ id) := by
      ext (i | i) (k | k) <;> rfl
    rw [this, hr₁, hr₂, Matrix.fromBlocks_one]
  · have hΘ₁ : ∀ x : Γ(G₁, O), (biprod.desc a₁ a₂).app O ((biprod.inl : G₁ ⟶ G₁ ⊞ G₂).app O x) =
        a₁.app O x := fun x =>
      congrArg (fun φ => Scheme.Modules.Hom.app φ O x) (biprod.inl_desc a₁ a₂)
    have hΘ₂ : ∀ x : Γ(G₂, O), (biprod.desc a₁ a₂).app O ((biprod.inr : G₂ ⟶ G₁ ⊞ G₂).app O x) =
        a₂.app O x := fun x =>
      congrArg (fun φ => Scheme.Modules.Hom.app φ O x) (biprod.inr_desc a₁ a₂)
    rintro (k | k)
    · have e : ι.app O ((biprod.desc ψ₁ ψ₂).app O ((biprod.inl : A₁ ⟶ A₁ ⊞ A₂).app O (p₁ k))) =
          a₁.app O (ι₁.app O (p₁ k)) := by
        have hm : (biprod.inl ≫ biprod.desc ψ₁ ψ₂) ≫ ι = ι₁ ≫ a₁ := by
          rw [biprod.inl_desc, h₁]
        exact congrArg (fun φ => Scheme.Modules.Hom.app φ O (p₁ k)) hm
      change ι.app O ((biprod.desc ψ₁ ψ₂).app O ((biprod.inl : A₁ ⟶ A₁ ⊞ A₂).app O (p₁ k))) = _
      rw [e, hφ₁, app_lc_xipb, Fintype.linearCombination_apply, Fintype.linearCombination_apply,
        Fintype.sum_sum_type]
      simp only [Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₁, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₁, Matrix.zero_apply, zero_smul,
        Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero, asIso_hom, sumFrameXiR, Sum.elim_inl, hΘ₁]
    · have e : ι.app O ((biprod.desc ψ₁ ψ₂).app O ((biprod.inr : A₂ ⟶ A₁ ⊞ A₂).app O (p₂ k))) =
          a₂.app O (ι₂.app O (p₂ k)) := by
        have hm : (biprod.inr ≫ biprod.desc ψ₁ ψ₂) ≫ ι = ι₂ ≫ a₂ := by
          rw [biprod.inr_desc, h₂]
        exact congrArg (fun φ => Scheme.Modules.Hom.app φ O (p₂ k)) hm
      change ι.app O ((biprod.desc ψ₁ ψ₂).app O ((biprod.inr : A₂ ⟶ A₁ ⊞ A₂).app O (p₂ k))) = _
      rw [e, hφ₂, app_lc_xipb, Fintype.linearCombination_apply, Fintype.linearCombination_apply,
        Fintype.sum_sum_type]
      simp only [Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₂, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₂, Matrix.zero_apply, zero_smul,
        Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add, asIso_hom, sumFrameXiR, Sum.elim_inr, hΘ₂]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.pull_relation_g2tsum
statement:
theorem pull_relation_g2tsum {W W' : Scheme.{u}} (β : W ⟶ W') {A G : W'.Modules} (ι : A ⟶ G)
    {T : W'.Opens} {n κ : Type u} [Fintype κ] (s : n → Γ(A, T)) (f : κ → Γ(G, T))
    (B : Matrix κ n Γ(W', T))
    (h : ∀ k, ι.app T (s k) = Fintype.linearCombination Γ(W', T) f (fun a => B a k))
    {O : W.Opens} (hO : O ≤ β ⁻¹ᵁ T) (k : n) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback β).map ι).app O (secResXiR _ hO (pullSecXiR β A T s) k) =
      Fintype.linearCombination Γ(W, O) (secResXiR _ hO (pullSecXiR β G T f))
        (fun a => ((B.map (β.app T).hom).map (W.presheaf.map (homOfLE hO).op).hom) a k)
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : secResXiR _ hO (pullSecXiR β A T s) k =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback β).obj A).presheaf.map (homOfLE hO).op (pullS_xipb β A T (s k)) :=
    rfl
  rw [e1, app_res_xiR, pullS_map_xipb, h, pullS_lc_xipb]
  have := linearCombination_res_xiR ((Scheme.Modules.pullback β).obj G)
    (fun i => pullS_xipb β G T (f i)) hO (le_refl _) (fun i => (β.app T).hom (B i k))
  rw [secResXiR_self] at this
  rw [this]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.isIso_desc_pullback_g2tsum
statement:
theorem isIso_desc_pullback_g2tsum {W B : Scheme.{u}} (π : W ⟶ B) {G₁ G₂ : W.Modules}
    {X₁ X₂ X : B.Modules} (e₁ : G₁ ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback π).obj X₁)
    (e₂ : G₂ ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback π).obj X₂) (r₁ : X₁ ⟶ X) (r₂ : X₂ ⟶ X)
    [IsIso (biprod.desc r₁ r₂)] :
    IsIso (biprod.desc (e₁.hom ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map r₁)
      (e₂.hom ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map r₂))
proof:
:= by
  have : biprod.desc (e₁.hom ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map r₁)
      (e₂.hom ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map r₂) =
      (biprod.mapIso e₁ e₂).hom ≫ ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).mapBiprod X₁ X₂).inv ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map (biprod.desc r₁ r₂) := by
    rw [biprod.mapBiprod_inv_map_desc]
    apply biprod.hom_ext' <;> simp
  rw [this]
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecialization.isIso_sumLift_g2tsum
statement: theorem isIso_sumLift_g2tsum (j : ℕ) : IsIso (sumLift_g2tsum C₁ C₂ β₁ hβ₁ β₂ hβ₂ j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [sumLift_eq_g2tsum]
  apply isIso_of_local_bijective_xipb
  intro w
  obtain ⟨c₁, hc₁⟩ := C₁.exists_xiChart (k := k) j (β₁ w)
  obtain ⟨c₂, hc₂⟩ := C₂.exists_xiChart (k := k) j (β₂ w)
  obtain ⟨V', hwV', -, ι', hι', s', hcard', hs'⟩ :=
    exists_isSecFrame ((sumComplex C₁ C₂).hasConstantRank_xi (k := k) j) (O := ⊤) (x := w) trivial
  have hb₁ := biprodXiR_pullback (xiProj (k := k) C₁) (C₁.K.E j) (C₁.tgt j)
  have hb₂ := biprodXiR_pullback (xiProj (k := k) C₂) (C₂.K.E j) (C₂.tgt j)
  have hO₁ : β₁ ⁻¹ᵁ c₁.T ⊓ β₂ ⁻¹ᵁ c₂.T ≤ β₁ ⁻¹ᵁ c₁.T := inf_le_left
  have hO₂ : β₁ ⁻¹ᵁ c₁.T ⊓ β₂ ⁻¹ᵁ c₂.T ≤ β₂ ⁻¹ᵁ c₂.T := inf_le_right
  haveI := isIso_ambSum_g2tsum C₁ C₂ β₁ hβ₁ β₂ hβ₂ j
  refine ⟨(β₁ ⁻¹ᵁ c₁.T ⊓ β₂ ⁻¹ᵁ c₂.T) ⊓ V'.1, ⟨⟨c₁.mem, c₂.mem⟩, hwV'⟩, fun V hV => ?_⟩
  exact bijective_sum_of_frames_g2tsum _ _ ((sumComplex C₁ C₂).xiι (k := k) j)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback β₁).map (C₁.xiι (k := k) j))
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback β₂).map (C₂.xiι (k := k) j)) _ _
    (domLift₁_ι_g2tsum C₁ C₂ β₁ hβ₁ j) (domLift₂_ι_g2tsum C₁ C₂ β₂ hβ₂ j)
    ((isSecFrame_pullback β₁ _ _ (c₁.isSecFrame hb₁ (xiOpen_nonempty (k := k) C₁))).mono hO₁)
    ((isSecFrame_pullback β₂ _ _ (c₂.isSecFrame hb₂ (xiOpen_nonempty (k := k) C₂))).mono hO₂)
    ((isSecFrame_pullback β₁ _ _ (hb₁.isSecFrame_sumFrame c₁.hP c₁.hQ)).mono hO₁)
    ((isSecFrame_pullback β₂ _ _ (hb₂.isSecFrame_sumFrame c₂.hP c₂.hQ)).mono hO₂)
    c₁.S₀ c₂.S₀ _ _ (rows_one_pull_g2tsum β₁ hO₁ c₁.S₀ c₁.B c₁.hB.rows_one)
    (rows_one_pull_g2tsum β₂ hO₂ c₂.S₀ c₂.B c₂.hB.rows_one)
    (pull_relation_g2tsum β₁ (C₁.xiι (k := k) j) _ _ c₁.B (fun i => rfl) hO₁)
    (pull_relation_g2tsum β₂ (C₂.xiι (k := k) j) _ _ c₂.B (fun i => rfl) hO₂) hs'
    (by rw [hc₁, hc₂, hcard']; rfl) (hV.trans inf_le_left) (hV.trans inf_le_right)
