statement:
theorem tauStd_generic_eq_tauStd_EL (h0 : (coheight (i (genericPoint X))).toNat ≠ 0)
    (F : X.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike X F) (C : RankedBundleComplex (pencilL N i Cv).M)
    (R : _root_.SingTau.ResolutionData (IsCoherentLike (pencilL N i Cv).M) C.K
      (liftSheaf k N i F))
    (hE : height (genericPoint (pencilL N i Cv).E) = N) :
    haveI : Fact (ProjK k (pencilL N i Cv).E)
proof:
:= ⟨pencilL_E_projK N i Cv⟩
    haveI : Fact (ProjK k (pencilL N i Cv).Z) := (inferInstance : Fact (ProjK k X))
    haveI := pencilL_s_isOver N i Cv
    tauStd (FRI.space_member k N) (C.pullback (pencilL N i Cv).j) i (openJL N i Cv F hF)
        (sectionExactOn_openJL N i Cv F hF C R) (CASE1B.height_genericPoint_space k N) =
      tauStd (pencilL_E_member N i Cv) (C.pullback (pencilL N i Cv).e) (pencilL N i Cv).s
        (openEL N i Cv F hF) (sectionExactOn_openEL N i Cv F hF C R) hE := by
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (pencilL N i Cv).E) := ⟨pencilL_E_projK N i Cv⟩
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (pencilL N i Cv).Z) := (inferInstance : Fact (ProjK k X))
  haveI := pencilL_s_isOver N i Cv
  have hJ := ker_ne_bot_of_rank N i h0
  haveI : IsIntegral (GlobalBlowup.blowup (space k N) i.ker) :=
    GlobalBlowup.isIntegral_blowup (space k N) i.ker hJ
  haveI hoc : IsClosedImmersion (otherToTotal (space k N) i.ker) :=
    InfinityOtherClosedImmersion.otherToTotal_isClosedImmersion _ _
  haveI : @IsClosedImmersion _ (pencilL N i Cv).M (otherToTotal (space k N) i.ker) := hoc
  haveI : @IsClosedImmersion _ (pencilL N i Cv).M (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k N) i.ker) :=
    (inferInstance : IsClosedImmersion (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k N) i.ker))
  haveI : @Scheme.Hom.IsOver (subschemeTotalGlobal (space k N) i.ker) (pencilL N i Cv).M
      (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k N) i.ker) (Spk k) _ _ := ⟨rfl⟩
  haveI : @Scheme.Hom.IsOver (space k N) (pencilL N i Cv).M (pencilL N i Cv).j (Spk k) _ _ :=
    PencilGeom.j_over _
  haveI : (pencilL N i Cv).e.IsOver (Spk k) := PencilGeom.e_over _
  haveI : @Scheme.Hom.IsOver (GlobalBlowup.blowup (space k N) i.ker) (pencilL N i Cv).M
      (otherToTotal (space k N) i.ker) (Spk k) _ _ := ⟨rfl⟩
  haveI : @IsClosedImmersion X (pencilL N i Cv).E (pencilL N i Cv).s := PencilGeom.s_ci _
  haveI : @Scheme.Hom.IsOver X (pencilL N i Cv).E (pencilL N i Cv).s (Spk k) _ _ :=
    pencilL_s_isOver N i Cv
  haveI := component_integralL k N i Cv
  haveI : IsIntegral (pencilL N i Cv).M := (inferInstance : IsIntegral (M k N i))
  have hMK : ProjectiveIntegralK k (pencilL N i Cv).M := projectiveIntegralK_M k N i
  haveI hMf : Fact (ProjK k (pencilL N i Cv).M) := ⟨projK_of_projectiveIntegralK hMK⟩
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (subschemeTotalGlobal (space k N) i.ker)) :=
    ⟨projK_closed (projK_of_projectiveIntegralK hMK : ProjK k (totalGlobal (space k N) i.ker))
      (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k N) i.ker) rfl⟩
  have h2K : ProjectiveIntegralK k (GlobalBlowup.blowup (space k N) i.ker) :=
    projectiveIntegralK_of_closedImmersion hMK (otherToTotal (space k N) i.ker) rfl inferInstance
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (GlobalBlowup.blowup (space k N) i.ker)) :=
    ⟨projK_of_projectiveIntegralK h2K⟩
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (WP N i.ker)) :=
    ⟨projK_closed (Fact.out : ProjK k (GlobalBlowup.blowup (space k N) i.ker))
      (pullback.snd (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k N) i.ker) (otherToTotal (space k N) i.ker)) rfl⟩
  have hG := isCoherentLike_liftSheaf k N i F hF
  have hEP := height_E_PL k N i Cv (canonφA (k := k)) hJ
  obtain ⟨s₁, hs₁⟩ := exists_fibre_section (toP1Global (space k N) i.ker k (canonφA (k := k)))
    (pointInf k) (componentToTotal (space k N) i.ker)
    (by rw [comap_pointInf_ker]; exact inf_le_left)
  obtain ⟨s₂, hs₂⟩ := exists_fibre_section (toP1Global (space k N) i.ker k (canonφA (k := k)))
    (pointInf k) (otherToTotal (space k N) i.ker)
    (by rw [comap_pointInf_ker]; exact inf_le_right)
  have hU : ((exactLocus (liftSheaf k N i F) hG : (M k N i).Opens) : Set (M k N i)).Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨b⟩ : Nonempty (GlobalBlowup.blowup (space k N) i.ker) := inferInstance
    exact ⟨_, range_other_subset_exactLocus k N i F hF ⟨b, rfl⟩⟩
  exact tauStd_fibre_eq_two_retract C hMK (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k N) i.ker)
    (exactLocus (liftSheaf k N i F) hG) (sectionExactOn_of_resolutionData C R hG) hU
    (mem_range_of_not_mem_exactLocus _ hG (moduleSheafSupport_pushforward_subset _ _))
    (toP1Global (space k N) i.ker k (canonφA (k := k))) 1 (height_M k N i (canonφA (k := k)))
    (FRI.space_member k N) (pencilL N i Cv).j i (gX0 N i) (gX0_W N i) (openJL N i Cv F hF)
    (sectionExactOn_openJL N i Cv F hF C R) (mem_range_i_of_not_mem_openJL N i Cv F hF)
    (fun _ hx => hx) _
    (fibre_isPullback_P1Global (space k N) i.ker k (canonφA (k := k)) 1).flip
    (CASE1B.height_genericPoint_space k N)
    (pencilL_E_member N i Cv) (pencilL N i Cv).e (pencilL N i Cv).s (gX1 N i) (gX1_W N i)
    (openEL N i Cv F hF) (sectionExactOn_openEL N i Cv F hF C R)
    (mem_range_s_of_not_mem_openEL N i Cv F hF) (fun _ hx => hx) s₁ hs₁ hE
    h2K (otherToTotal (space k N) i.ker)
    (pullback.snd (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k N) i.ker) (otherToTotal (space k N) i.ker))
    (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k N) i.ker) (otherToTotal (space k N) i.ker))
    pullback.condition ⊤ (sectionExactOn_pullback_other k N i F hF C R)
    (fun x hx => absurd trivial hx) (fun x _ => range_other_subset_exactLocus k N i F hF ⟨x, rfl⟩)
    s₂ hs₂ hEP.2 rfl (rW N i) (gX0_r N i) (gX1_r N i)
    (comap_pointInf_ker k (space k N) i.ker (canonφA (k := k)))
    (component_generic_not_mem_other (space k N) i.ker)
    (other_generic_not_mem_component (space k N) i.ker hJ)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LciComparison.tauG0_eq_tauStd_EL
statement:
theorem tauG0_eq_tauStd_EL (hadd : TauAdditivityPn N i)
    (h0 : (coheight (i (genericPoint X))).toNat ≠ 0)
    (F : X.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike X F) (C : RankedBundleComplex (pencilL N i Cv).M)
    (R : _root_.SingTau.ResolutionData (IsCoherentLike (pencilL N i Cv).M) C.K
      (liftSheaf k N i F))
    (hE : height (genericPoint (pencilL N i Cv).E) = N) :
    haveI : Fact (ProjK k (pencilL N i Cv).E)
proof:
:= ⟨pencilL_E_projK N i Cv⟩
    haveI : Fact (ProjK k (pencilL N i Cv).Z) := (inferInstance : Fact (ProjK k X))
    haveI := pencilL_s_isOver N i Cv
    tauG0 (FRI.space_member k N) i (CASE1B.height_genericPoint_space k N)
        (CIICLASS.T1N23.projectiveSpace_regStalks k N) hadd (g0ClassOf X F hF) =
      tauStd (pencilL_E_member N i Cv) (C.pullback (pencilL N i Cv).e) (pencilL N i Cv).s
        (openEL N i Cv F hF) (sectionExactOn_openEL N i Cv F hF C R) hE :=
  (tauG0_eq_tauStd_genericL N i Cv hadd F hF C R).trans
    (tauStd_generic_eq_tauStd_EL N i Cv h0 F hF C R hE)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.overAppTtw2_comp
statement:
theorem overAppTtw2_comp
    (e : (overRestrictionFunctor Y U).obj P ⟶ (overRestrictionFunctor Y U).obj P')
    (e' : (overRestrictionFunctor Y U).obj P' ⟶ (overRestrictionFunctor Y U).obj P'')
    {V : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) (x : Γ(P, V)) :
    overAppTtw2 (e ≫ e') h x = overAppTtw2 e' h (overAppTtw2 e h x)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.overAppTtw2_map
statement:
theorem overAppTtw2_map (f : P ⟶ P') {V : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) (x : Γ(P, V)) :
    overAppTtw2 ((overRestrictionFunctor Y U).map f) h x = f.app V x
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.overAppTtw2_id
statement:
theorem overAppTtw2_id {V : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) (x : Γ(P, V)) :
    overAppTtw2 (𝟙 ((overRestrictionFunctor Y U).obj P)) h x = x
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.overAppTtw2_inv_hom
statement:
theorem overAppTtw2_inv_hom
    (e : (overRestrictionFunctor Y U).obj P ≅ (overRestrictionFunctor Y U).obj P')
    {V : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) (x : Γ(P, V)) :
    overAppTtw2 e.inv h (overAppTtw2 e.hom h x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← overAppTtw2_comp, e.hom_inv_id, overAppTtw2_id]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.overAppTtw2_injective
statement:
theorem overAppTtw2_injective
    (e : (overRestrictionFunctor Y U).obj P ≅ (overRestrictionFunctor Y U).obj P')
    {V : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) : Function.Injective (overAppTtw2 e.hom h)
proof:
:=
  Function.LeftInverse.injective (overAppTtw2_inv_hom e h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.overAppTtw2_hom_inv
statement:
theorem overAppTtw2_hom_inv
    (e : (overRestrictionFunctor Y U).obj P ≅ (overRestrictionFunctor Y U).obj P')
    {V : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) (x : Γ(P', V)) :
    overAppTtw2 e.hom h (overAppTtw2 e.inv h x) = x
proof:
:=
  overAppTtw2_inv_hom e.symm h x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.overAppTtw2_add
statement:
theorem overAppTtw2_add {V : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) (x y : Γ(P, V)) :
    overAppTtw2 e h (x + y) = overAppTtw2 e h x + overAppTtw2 e h y
proof:
:=
  map_add _ x y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.overAppTtw2_sub
statement:
theorem overAppTtw2_sub {V : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) (x y : Γ(P, V)) :
    overAppTtw2 e h (x - y) = overAppTtw2 e h x - overAppTtw2 e h y
proof:
:=
  map_sub (e.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE h)))).hom x y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.overAppTtw2_zero
statement: theorem overAppTtw2_zero {V : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) : overAppTtw2 e h (0 : Γ(P, V)) = 0
proof:
:=
  map_zero (e.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE h)))).hom

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.overAppTtw2_smul
statement:
theorem overAppTtw2_smul {V : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) (r : Γ(Y, V)) (x : Γ(P, V)) :
    overAppTtw2 e h (r • x) = r • overAppTtw2 e h x
proof:
:=
  (e.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE h)))).hom.map_smul r x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.overAppTtw2_res
statement:
theorem overAppTtw2_res {V V' : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) (h' : V' ≤ V) (x : Γ(P, V)) :
    overAppTtw2 e (h'.trans h) (P.presheaf.map (homOfLE h').op x) =
      P'.presheaf.map (homOfLE h').op (overAppTtw2 e h x)
proof:
:= by
  have := e.val.naturality (Over.homMk (U := Over.mk (homOfLE (h'.trans h)))
    (V := Over.mk (homOfLE h)) (homOfLE h')).op
  exact congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ.hom x) this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.overAppTtw2_res'
statement:
theorem overAppTtw2_res' {V V' : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) (h' : V' ≤ V) (hV' : V' ≤ U)
    (x : Γ(P, V)) :
    overAppTtw2 e hV' (P.presheaf.map (homOfLE h').op x) =
      P'.presheaf.map (homOfLE h').op (overAppTtw2 e h x)
proof:
:=
  overAppTtw2_res e h h' x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.liftGenGraphTtw2_ι
statement:
theorem liftGenGraphTtw2_ι {Z : Y.Modules} (f : Z ⟶ G)
    (hf : ∀ (V : Y.Opens) (z : Γ(Z, V)), GenGraph pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V (f.app V z)) :
    liftGenGraphTtw2 pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁ f hf ≫ genericGraphι pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁ = f
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.genGraph_of_res
statement:
theorem genGraph_of_res {V V' : Y.Opens} (h : V' ≤ V) (hV' : (V' : Set Y).Nonempty)
    {s : Γ(G, V)} (hs : GenGraph pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V' (G.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op s)) :
    GenGraph pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V s
proof:
:= by
  intro _
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hAne, hA0⟩ := hs hV'
  refine ⟨A, hA.trans (inf_le_inf_right W₁ h), hAne, ?_⟩
  rw [graphDefect_res, res_res_xiS] at hA0
  exact hA0

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.graphDefect_transport
statement:
theorem graphDefect_transport (a : G ⟶ G₂) (b : P ⟶ P₂) (c : Q ⟶ Q₂)
    (h₁ : pr₁ ≫ b = a ≫ pr₁₂) (h₂ : pr₂ ≫ c = a ≫ pr₂₂) (hδ : δ ≫ c = b ≫ δ₂) (V : Y.Opens)
    (s : Γ(G, V)) :
    graphDefect pr₁₂ pr₂₂ δ₂ W₁ t V (a.app V s) = c.app (V ⊓ W₁) (graphDefect pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V s)
proof:
:= by
  have e₁ : pr₁₂.app V (a.app V s) = b.app V (pr₁.app V s) := by
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app,
      ← Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, h₁]
  have e₂ : pr₂₂.app V (a.app V s) = c.app V (pr₂.app V s) := by
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app,
      ← Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, h₂]
  have eδ : ∀ (V' : Y.Opens) (x : Γ(P, V')), δ₂.app V' (b.app V' x) = c.app V' (δ.app V' x) := by
    intro V' x
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app,
      ← Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, hδ]
  simp only [graphDefect, e₁, e₂, map_sub, Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul, app_res_xiS, eδ]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.genGraph_transport
statement:
theorem genGraph_transport (a : G ⟶ G₂) (b : P ⟶ P₂) (c : Q ⟶ Q₂)
    (h₁ : pr₁ ≫ b = a ≫ pr₁₂) (h₂ : pr₂ ≫ c = a ≫ pr₂₂) (hδ : δ ≫ c = b ≫ δ₂) (V : Y.Opens)
    {s : Γ(G, V)} (hs : GenGraph pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V s) :
    GenGraph pr₁₂ pr₂₂ δ₂ W₁ t V (a.app V s)
proof:
:= by
  intro hV
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hAne, hA0⟩ := hs hV
  refine ⟨A, hA, hAne, ?_⟩
  rw [graphDefect_transport W₁ t a b c h₁ h₂ hδ, ← app_res_xiS, hA0, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.twistOverNatIsoTtw2_naturality
statement:
theorem twistOverNatIsoTtw2_naturality {X X' : Y.Modules} (f : X ⟶ X') {V : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ O)
    (x : Γ(tensorSheaf Y X L, V)) :
    overAppTtw2 ((twistOverNatIsoTtw2 L hs).hom.app X') h
        ((ProjectionFormula.tensorRight Y L).map f |>.app V x) =
      f.app V (overAppTtw2 ((twistOverNatIsoTtw2 L hs).hom.app X) h x)
proof:
:= by
  have := (twistOverNatIsoTtw2 L hs).hom.naturality f
  exact congrArg (fun e ↦ overAppTtw2 e h x) this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.graphDefect_twistOver
statement:
theorem graphDefect_twistOver {V : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ O) (x : Γ(tensorSheaf Y G L, V)) :
    overAppTtw2 ((twistOverNatIsoTtw2 L hs).hom.app Q) (inf_le_left.trans h)
        (graphDefect ((ProjectionFormula.tensorRight Y L).map pr₁)
          ((ProjectionFormula.tensorRight Y L).map pr₂)
          ((ProjectionFormula.tensorRight Y L).map δ) W₁ t V x) =
      graphDefect pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V (overAppTtw2 ((twistOverNatIsoTtw2 L hs).hom.app G) h x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [graphDefect, overAppTtw2_sub, overAppTtw2_smul]
  rw [overAppTtw2_res' _ h, twistOverNatIsoTtw2_naturality, twistOverNatIsoTtw2_naturality,
    overAppTtw2_res' _ h, twistOverNatIsoTtw2_naturality]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.genGraph_twistOver_iff
statement:
theorem genGraph_twistOver_iff {V : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ O) (x : Γ(tensorSheaf Y G L, V)) :
    GenGraph ((ProjectionFormula.tensorRight Y L).map pr₁)
        ((ProjectionFormula.tensorRight Y L).map pr₂)
        ((ProjectionFormula.tensorRight Y L).map δ) W₁ t V x ↔
      GenGraph pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V (overAppTtw2 ((twistOverNatIsoTtw2 L hs).hom.app G) h x)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx hV
    obtain ⟨A, hA, hAne, hA0⟩ := hx hV
    refine ⟨A, hA, hAne, ?_⟩
    rw [← graphDefect_twistOver L hs pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t h x,
      ← overAppTtw2_res' _ (inf_le_left.trans h) hA ((hA.trans inf_le_left).trans h), hA0,
      overAppTtw2_zero]
  · intro hx hV
    obtain ⟨A, hA, hAne, hA0⟩ := hx hV
    refine ⟨A, hA, hAne, ?_⟩
    apply overAppTtw2_injective ((twistOverNatIsoTtw2 L hs).app Q)
      ((hA.trans inf_le_left).trans h)
    change overAppTtw2 ((twistOverNatIsoTtw2 L hs).hom.app Q) _ _ =
      overAppTtw2 ((twistOverNatIsoTtw2 L hs).hom.app Q) _ 0
    rw [overAppTtw2_res' _ (inf_le_left.trans h), graphDefect_twistOver L hs pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t h x,
      hA0, overAppTtw2_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.genericGraphι_app_eq_val
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.genGraph_twist_ι
statement:
theorem genGraph_twist_ι (V : Y.Opens)
    (z : Γ(tensorSheaf Y (genericGraphSheaf pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁) L, V)) :
    GenGraph ((ProjectionFormula.tensorRight Y L).map pr₁)
      ((ProjectionFormula.tensorRight Y L).map pr₂)
      ((ProjectionFormula.tensorRight Y L).map δ) W₁ t V
      (((ProjectionFormula.tensorRight Y L).map (genericGraphι pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁)).app V z)
proof:
:= by
  intro hV
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hV
  obtain ⟨O, hyO, -, ι, _, s, hcard, hs⟩ :=
    exists_isSecFrame hL (O := ⊤) (x := y) (Set.mem_univ y)
  haveI : Unique ι := (Fintype.card_eq_one_iff_nonempty_unique.1 hcard).some
  refine genGraph_of_res _ _ _ W₁ t (inf_le_left : V ⊓ O.1 ≤ V) ⟨y, hy, hyO⟩ ?_ ⟨y, hy⟩
  rw [← app_res_xiS, genGraph_twistOver_iff L hs pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t inf_le_right,
    twistOverNatIsoTtw2_naturality]
  exact genericGraphι_app_mem pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.twistGraphHomTtw2_bijective
statement:
theorem twistGraphHomTtw2_bijective {O : Y.Opens} {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] [Unique ι]
    {s : ι → Γ(L, O)} (hs : IsSecFrame L O s) {V : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ O) :
    Function.Bijective
      (overAppTtw2 ((overRestrictionFunctor Y O).map (twistGraphHomTtw2 hL pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁)) h)
proof:
:= by
  have hg : ∀ a, (((twistGraphHomTtw2 hL pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁).app V a).1 :
      Γ(tensorSheaf Y G L, V)) =
      ((ProjectionFormula.tensorRight Y L).map (genericGraphι pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁)).app V a :=
    fun _ ↦ rfl
  have key : ∀ a, overAppTtw2 ((twistOverNatIsoTtw2 L hs).hom.app G) h
      (((ProjectionFormula.tensorRight Y L).map (genericGraphι pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁)).app V a) =
      (overAppTtw2 ((twistOverNatIsoTtw2 L hs).hom.app
        (genericGraphSheaf pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁)) h a).1 := fun a ↦
    twistOverNatIsoTtw2_naturality L hs (genericGraphι pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁) h a
  constructor
  · intro a b hab
    have hab' : (((twistGraphHomTtw2 hL pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁).app V a).1 :
        Γ(tensorSheaf Y G L, V)) = ((twistGraphHomTtw2 hL pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁).app V b).1 :=
      congrArg Subtype.val hab
    rw [hg, hg] at hab'
    have h2 := congrArg (overAppTtw2 ((twistOverNatIsoTtw2 L hs).hom.app G) h) hab'
    rw [key, key] at h2
    exact overAppTtw2_injective ((twistOverNatIsoTtw2 L hs).app _) h (Subtype.ext h2)
  · intro b
    have hb : GenGraph pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V
        (overAppTtw2 ((twistOverNatIsoTtw2 L hs).hom.app G) h b.1) :=
      (genGraph_twistOver_iff L hs pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t h b.1).1 b.2
    let z : Γ(genericGraphSheaf pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁, V) :=
      ⟨overAppTtw2 ((twistOverNatIsoTtw2 L hs).hom.app G) h b.1, hb⟩
    refine ⟨overAppTtw2 ((twistOverNatIsoTtw2 L hs).inv.app _) h z, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    change (((twistGraphHomTtw2 hL pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁).app V
      (overAppTtw2 ((twistOverNatIsoTtw2 L hs).inv.app _) h z)).1 : Γ(tensorSheaf Y G L, V)) = b.1
    rw [hg]
    apply overAppTtw2_injective ((twistOverNatIsoTtw2 L hs).app G) h
    change overAppTtw2 ((twistOverNatIsoTtw2 L hs).hom.app G) h _ =
      overAppTtw2 ((twistOverNatIsoTtw2 L hs).hom.app G) h b.1
    rw [key]
    have := overAppTtw2_hom_inv ((twistOverNatIsoTtw2 L hs).app _) h z
    exact congrArg Subtype.val this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.twistGraphHomTtw2_isIso
statement: theorem twistGraphHomTtw2_isIso : IsIso (twistGraphHomTtw2 hL pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁)
proof:
:= by
  have hex : ∀ y : Y, ∃ (O : Y.affineOpens) (_ : y ∈ O.1) (ι : Type u) (_ : Fintype ι)
      (s : ι → Γ(L, O.1)), Fintype.card ι = 1 ∧ IsSecFrame L O.1 s := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨O, hyO, -, ι, hι, s, hcard, hs⟩ :=
      exists_isSecFrame hL (O := ⊤) (x := y) (Set.mem_univ y)
    exact ⟨O, hyO, ι, hι, s, hcard, hs⟩
  choose O hyO ι hι s hcard hs using hex
  refine moduleHom_isIso_of_over_cover _ (fun y ↦ (O y).1) ?_ (fun y ↦ ?_)
  · rw [Opens.coversTop_iff]
    change iSup (fun y ↦ (O y).1) = ⊤
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro y _
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨y, hyO y⟩
  · haveI : Unique (ι y) := (Fintype.card_eq_one_iff_nonempty_unique.1 (hcard y)).some
    refine LineBundleDual.isIso_of_bijective _ (fun W ↦ ?_)
    exact twistGraphHomTtw2_bijective hL pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t hW₁ (hs y) (leOfHom W.unop.hom)

statement:
theorem twistBiprodIsoTtw2_fst {E F E' F' : M.Modules} (eE : E' ≅ tensorSheaf M E A)
    (eF : F' ≅ tensorSheaf M F A) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.pullbackTwistIsoTtw2_comm
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistIsoTtw2_comm {W : Scheme.{u}} (π : W ⟶ M) (hA : IsFiniteLocallyFree M A)
    {X₁ X₂ X₁' X₂' : M.Modules} (h₁ : IsFiniteLocallyFree M X₁) (h₂ : IsFiniteLocallyFree M X₂)
    (e₁ : X₁' ≅ tensorSheaf M X₁ A) (e₂ : X₂' ≅ tensorSheaf M X₂ A) (f : X₁ ⟶ X₂)
    (f' : X₁' ⟶ X₂') (hf : f' ≫ e₂.hom = e₁.hom ≫ tensorSheafMap M f (𝟙 A)) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map f' ≫ (pullbackTwistIsoTtw2 π hA h₂ e₂).hom =
      (pullbackTwistIsoTtw2 π hA h₁ e₁).hom ≫
        tensorSheafMap W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map f) (𝟙 _)
proof:
:= by
  change (Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map f' ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map e₂.hom ≫ _ =
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map e₁.hom ≫ _) ≫ _
  rw [Category.assoc, ← pullbackTensorIsoTtw2_naturality π hA h₁ h₂, ← Category.assoc,
    ← Category.assoc, ← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, ← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, hf]

  have hA' := hA.isFiniteLocallyFree

    (pullbackTwistIsoTtw2 π hA' hE eE) (pullbackTwistIsoTtw2 π hA' hF eF)
    (pullbackTwistIsoTtw2_comm π hA' hEF hE _ _ _ _ (twistBiprodIsoTtw2_fst eE eF))

    (pullbackTwistIsoTtw2_comm π hA' hE hF _ _ _ _ hcomm) ≪≫
    twistGraphIsoTtw2 (hasConstantRank_pullback W π A 1 hA)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map biprod.fst) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map biprod.snd)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map d) W₁ t hW₁⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FlatBC.isZero_of_stalks_g2tflat
statement:
theorem isZero_of_stalks_g2tflat {Y : Scheme.{u}} (A : Y.Modules)
    (h : ∀ y, Subsingleton (A.presheaf.stalk y)) : IsZero A
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero]
  apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext
  intro U
  have hsub : Subsingleton (A.presheaf.obj (op U)) :=
    ⟨fun a b ↦ TopCat.Presheaf.section_ext ⟨A.presheaf, A.isSheaf⟩ U a b
      fun x _ ↦ Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
  ext a

proof:
:= by

  have hz : IsZero (A.presheaf.stalk y) :=

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FlatBC.preimage_exactLocus_le_g2tflat
statement:
theorem preimage_exactLocus_le_g2tflat {M N : Scheme.{u}} (g : N ⟶ M) (G : M.Modules)
    (hG : IsCoherentLike M G) (hG' : IsCoherentLike N ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj G)) :
    g ⁻¹ᵁ exactLocus G hG ≤ exactLocus ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj G) hG'
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  refine (mem_exactLocus_iff _ hG' y).2 ?_
  set W := exactLocus G hG
  have hW : IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj G) := by
    refine isZero_of_stalks_g2tflat _ fun z ↦ ?_
    have hz : z ∉ moduleSheafSupport ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj G) := by
      rw [moduleSheafSupport_restrictFunctor]
      exact z.2
    exact not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton.mp hz
  let j := (g ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι
  let e : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj G) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (g ∣_ W)).obj ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj G) :=
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback j).app _ ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp j g).app G ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (morphismRestrict_ι g W).symm).app G ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (g ∣_ W) W.ι).app G).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (g ∣_ W)).mapIso
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback W.ι).app G).symm
  have hZ : IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (g ∣_ W)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj G)) :=
    Functor.map_isZero _ hW
  let y₀ : (g ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme := ⟨y, hy⟩
  have h0 : y₀ ∉ moduleSheafSupport
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj G)) := by
    rw [moduleSheafSupport_eq_of_iso e]
    intro hnt
    haveI := subsingleton_stalk_of_isZero_g2tflat _ hZ y₀
    exact (not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton.mpr this) hnt
  rw [moduleSheafSupport_restrictFunctor] at h0
  exact not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton.mp h0

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FlatBC.tauSheaf_flatPullback_prod
statement:
theorem tauSheaf_flatPullback_prod (haddN : TauAdditivity hNK ι' hN) (G : M.Modules)
    (hG : IsCoherentLike M G) (hsupp : moduleSheafSupport G ⊆ Set.range ι) (G' : N.Modules)
    (hG' : IsCoherentLike N G') (hsupp' : moduleSheafSupport G' ⊆ Set.range ι')
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj G ≅ G') :
    totalPullOn (opsK k) gX b hgXd (tauSheaf hMK ι hM hregM G hG) =
      tauSheaf hNK ι' hN hregN G' hG'
proof:
:= by
  let C := chosenRes hMK hregM G hG
  let R := chosenResData hMK hregM G hG
  have hgG : IsCoherentLike N ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj G) := by
    haveI : G.IsFinitePresentation := hG
    exact pullback_isFinitePresentation_global g G
  let R' := resolutionDataPullback_g2tflat g C R
  have hC' : (C.pullback g).SectionExactOn (g ⁻¹ᵁ exactLocus G hG) :=
    sectionExactOn_mono (sectionExactOn_of_resolutionData (C.pullback g) R' hgG)
      (preimage_exactLocus_le_g2tflat g G hG hgG)
  have hX : ∀ x : M, x ∉ exactLocus G hG → x ∈ Set.range ι :=
    mem_range_of_not_mem_exactLocus ι hG hsupp
  have hX' : ∀ x : N, x ∉ g ⁻¹ᵁ exactLocus G hG → x ∈ Set.range ι' :=
    fun x hx ↦ mem_range_of_isPullback_g2tflat hsq x (hX _ hx)
  have h1 : tauSheaf hMK ι hM hregM G hG = tauStd hMK C ι (exactLocus G hG)
      (sectionExactOn_of_resolutionData C R hG) hM := rfl
  rw [h1, tauStd_flatPullback_prod hMK C ι hNK g ι' gX hsq b f q hpr hgXd (exactLocus G hG)
    (sectionExactOn_of_resolutionData C R hG) hX hC' hnd hM hN]
  exact (tauSheaf_eq hNK ι' hN hregN haddN G' hG' hsupp' (C.pullback g)
    (resolutionDataIso_g2tflat R' e) (g ⁻¹ᵁ exactLocus G hG) hC' hX').symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FlatBC.tauG0_flatPullback_prod
statement:
theorem tauG0_flatPullback_prod
    (hbc : ∀ F : X.Modules, IsCoherentLike X F →
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj F) ≅
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι').obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback gX).obj F)))
    (haddM : TauAdditivity hMK ι hM) (haddN : TauAdditivity hNK ι' hN) (y : G0 X) :
    tauG0 hNK ι' hN hregN haddN (flatPullbackG0 gX y) =
      totalPullOn (opsK k) gX b hgXd (tauG0 hMK ι hM hregM haddM y)
proof:
:= by
  have key : (tauG0 hNK ι' hN hregN haddN).comp (flatPullbackG0 gX) =
      (totalPullOn (opsK k) gX b hgXd).toAddMonoidHom.comp (tauG0 hMK ι hM hregM haddM) := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    intro E
    change tauG0 hNK ι' hN hregN haddN (flatPullbackG0 gX (g0ClassOf X E.1 E.2)) =
      totalPullOn (opsK k) gX b hgXd (tauG0 hMK ι hM hregM haddM (g0ClassOf X E.1 E.2))
    rw [flatPullbackG0_classOf, tauG0_classOf, tauG0_classOf]
    exact (tauSheaf_flatPullback_prod hMK ι hNK g ι' gX hsq b f q hpr hgXd hnd hM hN hregM hregN
      haddN _ (pushCoh ι E).2 (pushCoh_support ι E) _ (pushCoh ι' (flatPullbackObject gX E)).2
      (pushCoh_support ι' (flatPullbackObject gX E)) (hbc E.1 E.2).some).symm
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun key y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.genGraph_map_kim2
statement:
theorem genGraph_map_kim2 (pr₁' : G' ⟶ P') (pr₂' : G' ⟶ Q') (δ' : P' ⟶ Q') (pr₁ : G ⟶ P)
    (pr₂ : G ⟶ Q) (δ : P ⟶ Q) (W₁ : Y.Opens) (t : Γ(Y, W₁)) (σ : G' ⟶ G) (e : Q' ⟶ P)
    (h₁ : σ ≫ pr₁ = pr₂' ≫ e) (h₂ : σ ≫ pr₂ = 0) (hdd : δ' ≫ e ≫ δ = 0) (V : Y.Opens)
    (x : Γ(G', V)) (hx : GenGraph pr₁' pr₂' δ' W₁ t V x) :
    GenGraph pr₁ pr₂ δ W₁ t V (σ.app V x)
proof:
:= by
  intro hV
  obtain ⟨V'', hV'', hne, h0⟩ := hx hV
  refine ⟨V'', hV'', hne, ?_⟩
  have h1 := congrArg ((e ≫ δ).app V'') h0
  rw [app_res_xiR, map_zero, graphDefect, map_sub, Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul,
    ← comp_app_xiR δ' (e ≫ δ), hdd] at h1
  have hz : ∀ {A B : Y.Modules} (W : Y.Opens) (a : Γ(A, W)), (0 : A ⟶ B).app W a = 0 :=
    fun _ _ => rfl
  rw [hz, smul_zero, sub_zero] at h1
  rw [graphDefect, ← comp_app_xiR σ pr₂, h₂, hz, map_zero, zero_sub, ← comp_app_xiR σ pr₁, h₁,
    comp_app_xiR pr₂' e, ← app_res_xiR e, ← comp_app_xiR e δ, map_neg, Scheme.Modules.map_smul,
    h1, smul_zero, neg_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.shiftAmb_fst
statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.shiftAmb_fst (j : ℕ) :
    C.shiftAmb (k := k) j ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).map biprod.fst =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).map
        (biprod.snd : C.K.E (j + 1) ⊞ C.tgt (j + 1) ⟶ C.K.E j)

statement:
theorem resBOXiS_mul_left (g h : Γ(X, U)) (a : Γ(X, U)) :
    resBOXiS (g * h) a = (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show X.basicOpen (g * h) ≤ X.basicOpen g by
      rw [Scheme.basicOpen_mul]; exact inf_le_left)).op).hom (resBOXiS g a)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.SplitAtXiS.mul_right
statement:
theorem SplitAtXiS.mul_right {g : Γ(X, U)} {D : Matrix m n Γ(X, U)} {c : ℕ}
    (hs : SplitAtXiS g D c) (h : Γ(X, U)) : SplitAtXiS (g * h) D c
proof:
:= by
  have e : D.map (resBOXiS (g * h)) = (D.map (resBOXiS g)).map
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show X.basicOpen (g * h) ≤ X.basicOpen g by
        rw [Scheme.basicOpen_mul]; exact inf_le_left)).op).hom := by
    ext i j
    exact resBOXiS_mul_left g h _
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [e, ← minorsIdeal_map, hs.1, Ideal.map_top]
  · rw [e, ← minorsIdeal_map, hs.2, Ideal.map_bot]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.exists_isUnit_of_map_eq_top
statement:
theorem exists_isUnit_of_map_eq_top {A B : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B]
    (f : A →+* B) {I : Ideal A} (h : I.map f = ⊤) : ∃ a ∈ I, IsUnit (f a)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  push Not at hne
  have hle : I.map f ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B := by
    rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro a ha
    exact (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).2 (hne a ha)
  rw [h] at hle
  exact (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal B).ne_top (top_le_iff.1 hle)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.exists_basicOpen_res_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_basicOpen_res_eq_zero (hU : IsAffineOpen U) {x : X} (hx : x ∈ U) (a : Γ(X, U))
    (ha : X.presheaf.germ U x hx a = 0) :
    ∃ h : Γ(X, U), x ∈ X.basicOpen h ∧ resBOXiS h a = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hxW, iU, iV, e⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.germ_eq X.presheaf x hx hx a 0
    (by rw [ha, map_zero])
  rw [map_zero] at e
  obtain ⟨h, hle, hxh⟩ := hU.exists_basicOpen_le ⟨x, hxW⟩ hx
  refine ⟨h, hxh, ?_⟩
  have : resBOXiS h a = (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op).hom ((X.presheaf.map iU.op).hom a) := by
    rw [show iU = homOfLE iU.le from rfl, ringRes_res_xiS]
  rw [this]
  change (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op).hom ((X.presheaf.map iU.op) a) = 0
  rw [e, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.exists_splitAt_of_stalk
statement:
theorem exists_splitAt_of_stalk (hU : IsAffineOpen U) {x : X} (hx : x ∈ U) (D : Matrix m n Γ(X, U))
    (c : ℕ) (htop : GraphBundles.minorsIdeal c (D.map (X.presheaf.germ U x hx).hom) = ⊤)
    (hbot : GraphBundles.minorsIdeal (c + 1) (D.map (X.presheaf.germ U x hx).hom) = ⊥) :
    ∃ g : Γ(X, U), x ∈ X.basicOpen g ∧ SplitAtXiS g D c
proof:
:= by
  rw [← minorsIdeal_map] at htop
  obtain ⟨a, haI, hau⟩ := exists_isUnit_of_map_eq_top _ htop
  
  have hz : ∀ ST : (Fin (c + 1) → m) × (Fin (c + 1) → n),
      X.presheaf.germ U x hx (D.submatrix ST.1 ST.2).det = 0 := by
    intro ST
    have hmem := minor_mem_minorsIdeal (D.map (X.presheaf.germ U x hx).hom) ST.1 ST.2
    rw [hbot, Ideal.mem_bot, Matrix.submatrix_map] at hmem
    rw [RingHom.map_det, RingHom.mapMatrix_apply]
    exact hmem
  choose hST hxST hresST using fun ST => exists_basicOpen_res_eq_zero hU hx _ (hz ST)
  let P : Γ(X, U) := ∏ ST, hST ST
  refine ⟨a * P, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Scheme.mem_basicOpen _ _ x hx, map_mul, map_prod]
    refine hau.mul (Finset.prod_induction _ IsUnit (fun _ _ => IsUnit.mul) isUnit_one
      fun ST _ => ?_)
    exact (Scheme.mem_basicOpen _ _ x hx).1 (hxST ST)
  · 
    have hunit : IsUnit (resBOXiS (a * P) a) := by
      rw [resBOXiS_mul_left a P a]
      exact (X.toRingedSpace.isUnit_res_basicOpen a).map _
    have hmem : resBOXiS (a * P) a ∈ GraphBundles.minorsIdeal c (D.map (resBOXiS (a * P))) := by
      rw [← minorsIdeal_map]; exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ haI
    exact Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ hmem hunit
  · rw [GraphBundles.minorsIdeal, Ideal.span_eq_bot]
    rintro _ ⟨ST, rfl⟩
    show ((D.map (resBOXiS (a * P))).submatrix ST.1 ST.2).det = 0
    rw [Matrix.submatrix_map, ← RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, ← RingHom.map_det]
    have hle : X.basicOpen (a * P) ≤ X.basicOpen (hST ST) := by
      rw [Scheme.basicOpen_mul]
      refine inf_le_right.trans ?_
      change X.basicOpen (∏ ST, hST ST) ≤ _
      rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ hST (Finset.mem_univ ST), Scheme.basicOpen_mul]
      exact inf_le_left
    change resBOXiS (a * P) _ = 0
    rw [show resBOXiS (a * P) (D.submatrix ST.1 ST.2).det =
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op).hom (resBOXiS (hST ST) (D.submatrix ST.1 ST.2).det) from
        (ringRes_res_xiS _ _ _).symm, hresST ST, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.basicOpen_finsetProd_le
statement:
theorem basicOpen_finsetProd_le {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Γ(X, U))
    {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ s) : X.basicOpen (∏ j ∈ s, f j) ≤ X.basicOpen (f i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase s f hi, Scheme.basicOpen_mul]
  exact inf_le_left

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.mem_basicOpen_finsetProd
statement:
theorem mem_basicOpen_finsetProd {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Γ(X, U)) {x : X}
    (hx : x ∈ U) (h : ∀ i ∈ s, x ∈ X.basicOpen (f i)) : x ∈ X.basicOpen (∏ j ∈ s, f j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.mem_basicOpen _ _ x hx, map_prod]
  exact Finset.prod_induction _ IsUnit (fun _ _ => IsUnit.mul) isUnit_one
    fun i hi => (Scheme.mem_basicOpen _ _ x hx).1 (h i hi)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.isSplitOn_of_stalkSplit
statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.isSplitOn_of_stalkSplit (C : RankedBundleComplex X) (U : X.Opens)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ U, C.StalkSplit x) : IsSplitOn C.toDetIdealComplex U
proof:
:= by
  intro x hxU
  obtain ⟨V, hxV, F, c, hc, hs⟩ := h x hxU
  have hj : ∀ j, ∃ g : Γ(X, V.1), x ∈ X.basicOpen g ∧
      (j ≤ C.K.len → SplitAtXiS g (F.D j) (c j)) := by
    intro j
    by_cases hjl : j ≤ C.K.len
    · obtain ⟨g, hxg, hg⟩ := exists_splitAt_of_stalk V.2 hxV (F.D j) (c j) (hs j hjl).1
        (hs j hjl).2
      exact ⟨g, hxg, fun _ => hg⟩
    · refine ⟨1, ?_, fun h' => absurd h' hjl⟩
      rw [Scheme.basicOpen_one]; exact hxV
  choose G hxG hG using hj
  obtain ⟨g₀, hg₀U, hxg₀⟩ := V.2.exists_basicOpen_le ⟨x, hxU⟩ hxV
  let g : Γ(X, V.1) := g₀ * ∏ j ∈ Finset.range (C.K.len + 1), G j
  have hxg : x ∈ X.basicOpen g := by
    rw [Scheme.basicOpen_mul]
    exact ⟨hxg₀, mem_basicOpen_finsetProd _ _ hxV fun j _ => hxG j⟩
  refine ⟨X.affineBasicOpen g, hxg, ?_, c, ?_⟩
  · change X.basicOpen g ≤ U
    rw [Scheme.basicOpen_mul]
    exact inf_le_left.trans hg₀U
  · intro j hjl
    have hsplit : SplitAtXiS g (F.D j) (c j) := by
      have hmem : j ∈ Finset.range (C.K.len + 1) := Finset.mem_range.2 (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hjl)
      change SplitAtXiS (g₀ * ∏ j ∈ Finset.range (C.K.len + 1), G j) (F.D j) (c j)
      rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase _ G hmem]
      exact ((hG j hjl).mul_right _).mul_left g₀
    have hid : ∀ r, (C.toDetIdealComplex.detIdeal j r).ideal (X.affineBasicOpen g) =
        GraphBundles.minorsIdeal r ((F.D j).map (resBOXiS g)) := by
      intro r
      rw [← Scheme.IdealSheafData.map_ideal_basicOpen, RankedBundleComplex.toDetIdealComplex_detIdeal,
        F.detIdeal_ideal_eq, minorsIdeal_map]
    refine ⟨?_, fun r hr => ?_, fun r hr _ => ?_⟩
    · simpa using hc j hjl
    · rw [hid]; exact minorsIdeal_eq_top_of_le hsplit.1 hr
    · rw [hid]; exact minorsIdeal_eq_bot_of_lt hsplit.2 hr

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.linMinorsIdeal_of_factor
statement:
theorem linMinorsIdeal_of_factor (c : ℕ) (d : P →ₗ[A] Q) (π : P →ₗ[A] (Fin c → A))
    (σ : (Fin c → A) →ₗ[A] P) (i : (Fin c → A) →ₗ[A] Q) (ρ : Q →ₗ[A] (Fin c → A))
    (hd : d = i ∘ₗ π) (hπσ : π ∘ₗ σ = LinearMap.id) (hρi : ρ ∘ₗ i = LinearMap.id) :
    linMinorsIdeal d c = ⊤ ∧ linMinorsIdeal d (c + 1) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Ideal.eq_top_iff_one]
    have h := det_mem_linMinorsIdeal d (fun b => σ (Pi.single b 1))
      (fun a => (LinearMap.proj a : (Fin c → A) →ₗ[A] A) ∘ₗ ρ)
    have e : (Matrix.of fun a b => ((LinearMap.proj a : (Fin c → A) →ₗ[A] A) ∘ₗ ρ)
        (d (σ (Pi.single b 1)))) = 1 := by
      ext a b
      have h1 : ρ (d (σ (Pi.single b 1))) = Pi.single b 1 := by
        rw [hd, LinearMap.comp_apply, ← LinearMap.comp_apply ρ i, hρi, LinearMap.id_apply,
          ← LinearMap.comp_apply π σ, hπσ, LinearMap.id_apply]
      simp only [Matrix.of_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, h1, LinearMap.proj_apply,
        Pi.single_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
    rwa [e, Matrix.det_one] at h
  · rw [linMinorsIdeal, Ideal.span_eq_bot]
    rintro _ ⟨⟨p, ψ⟩, rfl⟩
    let Xm : Matrix (Fin (c + 1)) (Fin c) A := Matrix.of fun a k => ψ a (i (Pi.single k 1))
    let Ym : Matrix (Fin c) (Fin (c + 1)) A := Matrix.of fun k b => π (p b) k
    have e : (Matrix.of fun a b => ψ a (d (p b))) = Xm * Ym := by
      ext a b
      rw [Matrix.of_apply, hd, LinearMap.comp_apply,
        show ψ a (i (π (p b))) = ((ψ a) ∘ₗ i) (π (p b)) from rfl,
        LinearMap.pi_apply_eq_sum_univ ((ψ a) ∘ₗ i) (π (p b))]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Xm, Ym, Matrix.of_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
      rw [LinearMap.comp_apply]
      congr 3
      funext j
      by_cases hkj : k = j
      · subst hkj; simp
      · simp [hkj, Ne.symm hkj]
    change (Matrix.of fun a b => ψ a (d (p b))).det = 0
    rw [e, ← Ideal.mem_bot]
    refine det_mul_mem Xm Ym ⊥ fun f => ?_
    obtain ⟨a₁, a₂, hne, heq⟩ := Fintype.exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt f (by simp)
    rw [Ideal.mem_bot]
    exact Matrix.det_zero_of_row_eq hne (by ext b; simp [heq])

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.range_projective_split_of_exact
statement:
theorem range_projective_split_of_exact (h0 : Function.Surjective (d 0))
    (hex : ∀ j, Function.Exact (d (j + 1)) (d j)) (j : ℕ) :
    Module.Projective A (LinearMap.range (d j)) ∧
      ∃ r : F j →ₗ[A] LinearMap.range (d j), r ∘ₗ (LinearMap.range (d j)).subtype = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    have htop : LinearMap.range (d 0) = ⊤ := LinearMap.range_eq_top.2 h0
    let e : LinearMap.range (d 0) ≃ₗ[A] F 0 :=
      (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ htop).trans (LinearEquiv.ofTop ⊤ rfl)
    refine ⟨Module.Projective.of_equiv e.symm, e.symm.toLinearMap, ?_⟩
    ext x
    simp [e]
  | succ j ih =>
    obtain ⟨hP, -⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := (d j).rangeRestrict.exists_rightInverse_of_surjective
      (LinearMap.range_rangeRestrict _)
    have hk : LinearMap.range (d (j + 1)) = LinearMap.ker (d j) :=
      ((hex j).linearMap_ker_eq).symm
    have hdσ : ∀ x, d j (σ ((d j).rangeRestrict x)) = d j x := by
      intro x
      have := congrArg (fun y : LinearMap.range (d j) => (y : F j))
        (LinearMap.congr_fun hσ ((d j).rangeRestrict x))
      simpa using this
    let q : F (j + 1) →ₗ[A] LinearMap.ker (d j) :=
      (LinearMap.id - σ ∘ₗ (d j).rangeRestrict).codRestrict (LinearMap.ker (d j)) fun x => by
        simp [hdσ]
    let r : F (j + 1) →ₗ[A] LinearMap.range (d (j + 1)) :=
      (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ hk.symm).toLinearMap ∘ₗ q
    have hr : r ∘ₗ (LinearMap.range (d (j + 1))).subtype = LinearMap.id := by
      ext ⟨y, hy⟩
      have hy' : y ∈ LinearMap.ker (d j) := hk ▸ hy
      have h0' : (d j).rangeRestrict y = 0 := by
        ext; simpa using hy'
      simp [r, q, h0']
    exact ⟨Module.Projective.of_split _ r hr, r, hr⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.exists_linMinorsIdeal_split_of_exact
statement:
theorem exists_linMinorsIdeal_split_of_exact [IsLocalRing A] [∀ j, Module.Finite A (F j)]
    (h0 : Function.Surjective (d 0)) (hex : ∀ j, Function.Exact (d (j + 1)) (d j)) (j : ℕ) :
    ∃ c : ℕ, linMinorsIdeal (d j) c = ⊤ ∧ linMinorsIdeal (d j) (c + 1) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hP, r, hr⟩ := range_projective_split_of_exact d h0 hex j
  haveI := hP
  haveI : Module.Finite A (LinearMap.range (d j)) := Module.Finite.range (d j)
  haveI : Module.Free A (LinearMap.range (d j)) := Module.free_of_flat_of_isLocalRing
  let e := (Module.finBasis A (LinearMap.range (d j))).equivFun
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := (d j).rangeRestrict.exists_rightInverse_of_surjective
    (LinearMap.range_rangeRestrict _)
  refine ⟨_, linMinorsIdeal_of_factor _ (d j) (e.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (d j).rangeRestrict)
    (σ ∘ₗ e.symm.toLinearMap) ((LinearMap.range (d j)).subtype ∘ₗ e.symm.toLinearMap)
    (e.toLinearMap ∘ₗ r) ?_ ?_ ?_⟩
  · ext x; simp
  · refine LinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
    have := LinearMap.congr_fun hσ (e.symm v)
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe] at this ⊢
    rw [this, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  · refine LinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
    have := LinearMap.congr_fun hr (e.symm v)
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe] at this ⊢
    rw [this, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ProjectionCovariance.star_of_gen
proof:
:= by
  let D : G0 C.scheme →+ V := F - τ.comp φ
  have hle : G0PB.twistSpan C hpos r ≤ D.ker := by
    refine (AddSubgroup.closure_le _).2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨y, j, hj, rfl⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, AddMonoidHom.mem_ker, AddMonoidHom.sub_apply, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply,
      hgen j hj y, hφ j hj y]
    by_cases h0 : j = 0
    · simp [h0]
    · simp [h0]
  have h := hle hw
  rw [AddMonoidHom.mem_ker, AddMonoidHom.sub_apply, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, sub_eq_zero] at h
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ProjectionCovariance.isIso_toBase_zero
statement:
theorem isIso_toBase_zero {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X] :
    IsIso (cover (X ↘ Spk k) 0).toBase
proof:
:= by
  have h := CIICLASS.T1PF.coverIso_inv_toBase (X ↘ Spk k) 0
  have h' : (cover (X ↘ Spk k) 0).toBase =
      (coverIso (X ↘ Spk k) 0).hom ≫ pullback.fst (X ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 0) := by
    rw [← h, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  rw [h']
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ProjectionCovariance.exists_star_fst
statement:
theorem exists_star_fst (hIII : FlatBaseChangeFst k a b) {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (ProjK k X)] (ι : X ⟶ space k a)
    [IsClosedImmersion ι] [ι.IsOver (Spk k)] (haddι : TauAdditivityPn a ι)
    (haddC : TauAdditivity (pp_member k a b) (ιF (b := b) ι) (pp_height k a b)) :
    ∃ φC : G0 (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).scheme →+ G0 X,
      INDB.Computes (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).toBase φC ∧ ∀ w,
        totalPushOn (opsK k) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).toBase (tauPP (ιF (b := b) ι) haddC w) =
          tauPn a ι haddι (φC w)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos b with hb | hb
  · subst hb
    haveI := isIso_toBase_zero (k := k) (X := X)
    refine ⟨finitePushforward (cover (X ↘ Spk k) 0).toBase,
      INDB.computes_finitePushforward _, fun w => ?_⟩
    rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty X with hX | hX
    · exact (totalChow_eq_zero_of_isEmpty _).trans (totalChow_eq_zero_of_isEmpty _).symm
    have hpb : ∀ y, G0PB.pullbackG0 (cover (X ↘ Spk k) 0) (coverHpos k _ 0) y =
        finitePushforward (asIso (cover (X ↘ Spk k) 0).toBase).inv y := fun y =>
      DFunLike.congr_fun
        (ARRG45C.flatPullbackG0_iso_eq_finitePushforward_inv (asIso (cover (X ↘ Spk k) 0).toBase)) y
    refine star_of_gen (cover (X ↘ Spk k) 0) (coverHpos k _ 0) 1
      ((totalPushOn (opsK k) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) 0).toBase).toAddMonoidHom.comp
        (tauPP (ιF (b := 0) ι) haddC)) (tauPn a ι haddι) _
      (fun j hj y => gen_fst hIII ι haddι haddC j hj y) (fun j hj y => ?_) w ?_
    · obtain rfl : j = 0 := by omega
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero, canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_zero, one_smul, if_true]
      rw [hpb]
      exact DFunLike.congr_fun
        (GRRBlueprintV4.T1BR.finitePushforward_hom_inv (asIso (cover (X ↘ Spk k) 0).toBase)) y
    · refine AddSubgroup.subset_closure
        ⟨finitePushforward (cover (X ↘ Spk k) 0).toBase w, 0, Nat.zero_lt_one, ?_⟩
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero, canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_zero, one_smul]
      rw [hpb]
      exact (DFunLike.congr_fun
        (GRRBlueprintV4.T1BR.finitePushforward_inv_hom (asIso (cover (X ↘ Spk k) 0).toBase)) w).symm
  · refine ⟨projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward (cover_rank (X ↘ Spk k) hb),
      INDB.computes_projectiveBundle _ _, fun w => ?_⟩
    rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty X with hX | hX
    · exact (totalChow_eq_zero_of_isEmpty _).trans (totalChow_eq_zero_of_isEmpty _).symm
    exact star_of_gen (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b) (coverHpos k _ b) (b + 1)
      ((totalPushOn (opsK k) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).toBase).toAddMonoidHom.comp
        (tauPP (ιF (b := b) ι) haddC)) (tauPn a ι haddι) _
      (fun j hj y => gen_fst hIII ι haddι haddC j hj y)
      (fun j hj y => G0PP.product_derivedPush_pullbackG0_twist (X ↘ Spk k) hb j hj y) w
      (G0PP.g0_product_span_coeffFree (X ↘ Spk k) hb w)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ProjectionCovariance.exists_star_snd
statement:
theorem exists_star_snd (hIII : FlatBaseChangeSnd k a b) {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (ProjK k X)] (ι : X ⟶ space k b)
    [IsClosedImmersion ι] [ι.IsOver (Spk k)] (haddι : TauAdditivityPn b ι)
    (haddC : TauAdditivity (pp_member k a b) (ιS (a := a) ι) (pp_height k a b)) :
    ∃ φC : G0 (cover (X ↘ Spk k) a).scheme →+ G0 X,
      INDB.Computes (cover (X ↘ Spk k) a).toBase φC ∧ ∀ w,
        totalPushOn (opsK k) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) a).toBase (tauPP (ιS (a := a) ι) haddC w) =
          tauPn b ι haddι (φC w)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos a with ha | ha
  · subst ha
    haveI := isIso_toBase_zero (k := k) (X := X)
    refine ⟨finitePushforward (cover (X ↘ Spk k) 0).toBase,
      INDB.computes_finitePushforward _, fun w => ?_⟩

    have hpb : ∀ y, G0PB.pullbackG0 (cover (X ↘ Spk k) 0) (coverHpos k _ 0) y =
        finitePushforward (asIso (cover (X ↘ Spk k) 0).toBase).inv y := fun y =>
      DFunLike.congr_fun
        (ARRG45C.flatPullbackG0_iso_eq_finitePushforward_inv (asIso (cover (X ↘ Spk k) 0).toBase)) y
    refine star_of_gen (cover (X ↘ Spk k) 0) (coverHpos k _ 0) 1
      ((totalPushOn (opsK k) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) 0).toBase).toAddMonoidHom.comp
        (tauPP (ιS (a := 0) ι) haddC)) (tauPn b ι haddι) _
      (fun j hj y => gen_snd hIII ι haddι haddC j hj y) (fun j hj y => ?_) w ?_
    · obtain rfl : j = 0 := by omega
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero, canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_zero, one_smul, if_true]
      rw [hpb]
      exact DFunLike.congr_fun
        (GRRBlueprintV4.T1BR.finitePushforward_hom_inv (asIso (cover (X ↘ Spk k) 0).toBase)) y
    · refine AddSubgroup.subset_closure
        ⟨finitePushforward (cover (X ↘ Spk k) 0).toBase w, 0, Nat.zero_lt_one, ?_⟩
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero, canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_zero, one_smul]
      rw [hpb]
      exact (DFunLike.congr_fun
        (GRRBlueprintV4.T1BR.finitePushforward_inv_hom (asIso (cover (X ↘ Spk k) 0).toBase)) w).symm
  · refine ⟨projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward (cover_rank (X ↘ Spk k) ha),
      INDB.computes_projectiveBundle _ _, fun w => ?_⟩
    rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty X with hX | hX
    · exact (totalChow_eq_zero_of_isEmpty _).trans (totalChow_eq_zero_of_isEmpty _).symm
    exact star_of_gen (cover (X ↘ Spk k) a) (coverHpos k _ a) (a + 1)
      ((totalPushOn (opsK k) (cover (X ↘ Spk k) a).toBase).toAddMonoidHom.comp
        (tauPP (ιS (a := a) ι) haddC)) (tauPn b ι haddι) _
      (fun j hj y => gen_snd hIII ι haddι haddC j hj y)
      (fun j hj y => G0PP.product_derivedPush_pullbackG0_twist (X ↘ Spk k) ha j hj y) w
      (G0PP.g0_product_span_coeffFree (X ↘ Spk k) ha w)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ProjectionCovariance.projCovFst
statement: theorem projCovFst (hIII : FlatBaseChangeFst k a b) : ProjCovFst k a b
proof:
:= by
  intro X _ _ _ _ ι _ _ X' _ _ _ _ ι' _ _ q _ hsq haddι hadd'
  haveI : IsProper q := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) q
  let e : (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).scheme ≅ X' :=
    (isPullback_ιF (b := b) ι).isoIsPullback _ _ hsq
  have he1 : e.hom ≫ q = (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).toBase :=
    IsPullback.isoIsPullback_hom_fst _ _ _ _
  have he2 : e.hom ≫ ι' = ιF (b := b) ι := IsPullback.isoIsPullback_hom_snd _ _ _ _
  haveI : e.hom.IsOver (Spk k) :=
    ⟨by rw [← comp_over q (Spk k), ← Category.assoc, he1]; rfl⟩
  haveI : e.inv.IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨by rw [← comp_over e.hom (Spk k), Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]⟩
  haveI : IsProper e.hom := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
  haveI : IsProper (e.hom ≫ q) := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
  have haddC : TauAdditivity (pp_member k a b) (ιF (b := b) ι) (pp_height k a b) :=
    tauAdditivity_of_iso (pp_member k a b) ι' (ιF (b := b) ι) e.hom he2 (pp_height k a b) hadd'
  have hinv : e.inv ≫ (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).toBase = q := by rw [← he1, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  obtain ⟨φC, hcomp, hstar⟩ := exists_star_fst hIII ι haddι haddC
  refine ⟨φC.comp (finitePushforward e.inv), ?_, fun z => ?_⟩
  · have h := INDB.computes_comp_finite e.inv (cover (X ↘ Spk k) b).toBase hcomp
    rwa [hinv] at h
  · have hz : finitePushforward e.hom (finitePushforward e.inv z) = z :=
      DFunLike.congr_fun (GRRBlueprintV4.T1BR.finitePushforward_hom_inv e) z
    have hpush := tauTwo_finitePushforward (pp_member k a b) (pp_height k a b) (pp_regStalks k a b)
      (ppL₁ k a b) (ppL₂ k a b) (hppL₁ k a b) (hppL₂ k a b) (a + 1) (b + 1) ι' (ιF (b := b) ι)
      e.hom he2 hadd' haddC (finitePushforward e.inv z)
    rw [hz] at hpush
    change totalPushOn (opsK k) q (tauPP ι' hadd' z) = tauPn a ι haddι (φC (finitePushforward e.inv z))
    unfold tauPP
    rw [hpush, ← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← totalPushOn_comp, totalPushOn_congr (opsK k) he1]
    exact hstar _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.map_baseRingHom_eq_span_of_mul_g2tsum
statement:
theorem map_baseRingHom_eq_span_of_mul_g2tsum {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {I I₁ I₂ : Ideal A}
    (hI : I = I₁ * I₂) {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ I₁) (hb : b ∈ I₂) (r : I) (hr : r.1 = a * b) :
    I₁.map (baseRingHom I r) = Ideal.span {baseRingHom I r a} ∧
      IsRegular (baseRingHom I r a)
proof:
:= by
  have hreg : IsRegular (baseRingHom I r a * baseRingHom I r b) := by
    rw [← map_mul, ← hr, baseRingHom_apply]
    exact baseElement_self_isRegular I r
  obtain ⟨ha', hb'⟩ := isRegular_mul_iff.mp hreg
  refine ⟨le_antisymm ?_ ?_, ha'⟩
  · rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro x hx
    have hxb : x * b ∈ I := hI ▸ Ideal.mul_mem_mul hx hb
    have key := baseElement_mul_ratioElement I r ⟨x * b, hxb⟩
    rw [hr] at key
    simp only [← baseRingHom_apply, map_mul] at key
    change baseRingHom I r x ∈ Ideal.span {baseRingHom I r a}
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
    refine ⟨ratioElement I r ⟨x * b, hxb⟩, ?_⟩
    apply hb'.left
    change baseRingHom I r b * (ratioElement I r ⟨x * b, hxb⟩ * baseRingHom I r a) =
      baseRingHom I r b * baseRingHom I r x
    calc baseRingHom I r b * (ratioElement I r ⟨x * b, hxb⟩ * baseRingHom I r a)
        = baseRingHom I r a * baseRingHom I r b * ratioElement I r ⟨x * b, hxb⟩ := by ring
      _ = baseRingHom I r x * baseRingHom I r b := key
      _ = baseRingHom I r b * baseRingHom I r x := mul_comm _ _
  · rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ha

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.appLE_specMap_comp_fromSpec_g2tsum
statement:
theorem appLE_specMap_comp_fromSpec_g2tsum {Y : Scheme.{u}} {V : Y.Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    {B : CommRingCat.{u}} (φ : Γ(Y, V) ⟶ B)
    (e : (⊤ : (Spec B).Opens) ≤ (Spec.map φ ≫ hV.fromSpec) ⁻¹ᵁ V) :
    (Spec.map φ ≫ hV.fromSpec).appLE V ⊤ e = φ ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso B).inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_appLE, hV.fromSpec_app_self, Category.assoc, Scheme.Hom.map_appLE,
    Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality]
  rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.comap_span_singleton_equiv_g2tsum
statement:
theorem comap_span_singleton_equiv_g2tsum {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (f : R ≃+* S)
    (e : S) : Ideal.comap (f : R →+* S) (Ideal.span {e}) = Ideal.span {f.symm e}
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hx
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hx
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
    refine ⟨f.symm a, f.injective ?_⟩
    rw [map_mul, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact ha
  · rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff, SetLike.mem_coe, Ideal.mem_comap]
    change f (f.symm e) ∈ _
    rw [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact Ideal.subset_span rfl

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.exists_span_comap_chart_g2tsum
statement:
theorem exists_span_comap_chart_g2tsum {W X : Scheme.{u}} {R' : CommRingCat.{u}}
    (c : Spec R' ⟶ W) [IsOpenImmersion c] (b : W ⟶ X) (U : X.affineOpens)
    (φ : Γ(X, U.1) ⟶ R') (hcb : c ≫ b = Spec.map φ ≫ U.2.fromSpec) (J : X.IdealSheafData)
    (e : R') (hJ : (J.ideal U).map φ.hom = Ideal.span {e}) (he : IsRegular e) :
    ∃ g : Γ(W, c ''ᵁ ⊤),
      (J.comap b).ideal ⟨c ''ᵁ ⊤, (isAffineOpen_top _).image_of_isOpenImmersion c⟩ =
        Ideal.span {g} ∧ IsRegular g
proof:
:= by
  let V : W.affineOpens := ⟨c ''ᵁ ⊤, (isAffineOpen_top _).image_of_isOpenImmersion c⟩
  have hV : V.1 ≤ b ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 := by
    rintro _ ⟨q, -, rfl⟩
    change b (c q) ∈ U.1
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hcb, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact U.2.range_fromSpec.le ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [Chow.M7.KDGb.comap_ideal_eq_map b J U V hV]
  let θ : Γ(W, V.1) ⟶ R' := (c.appIso ⊤).hom ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R').hom
  have hle : (⊤ : (Spec R').Opens) ≤ (Spec.map φ ≫ U.2.fromSpec) ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 := by
    intro q _
    change (Spec.map φ ≫ U.2.fromSpec) q ∈ U.1
    rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact U.2.range_fromSpec.le ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have key : ∀ (f : Spec R' ⟶ X) (_ : f = Spec.map φ ≫ U.2.fromSpec)
      (e' : (⊤ : (Spec R').Opens) ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1),
      f.appLE U.1 ⊤ e' = (Spec.map φ ≫ U.2.fromSpec).appLE U.1 ⊤ hle := by
    intro f hf e'
    subst hf
    rfl
  have hθ : b.appLE U.1 V.1 hV ≫ θ = φ := by
    change b.appLE U.1 V.1 hV ≫ (c.appIso ⊤).hom ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R').hom = φ
    rw [Scheme.Hom.appIso_hom', ← Category.assoc, Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE,
      key (c ≫ b) hcb, appLE_specMap_comp_fromSpec_g2tsum, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id,
      Category.comp_id]
  let θe : Γ(W, V.1) ≃+* R' := (asIso θ).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  have hθe : ∀ x, θe x = θ.hom x := fun _ => rfl
  refine ⟨θe.symm e, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h1 : (J.ideal U).map (b.appLE U.1 V.1 hV).hom =
        Ideal.comap (θe : Γ(W, V.1) →+* R')
          (Ideal.map (θe : Γ(W, V.1) →+* R') ((J.ideal U).map (b.appLE U.1 V.1 hV).hom)) :=
      (Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective _ θe.bijective).symm
    rw [h1, Ideal.map_map]
    have h2 : (θe : Γ(W, V.1) →+* R').comp (b.appLE U.1 V.1 hV).hom = φ.hom := by
      ext x
      change θ.hom ((b.appLE U.1 V.1 hV).hom x) = φ.hom x
      rw [← hθ]
      rfl
    rw [h2, hJ]
    exact comap_span_singleton_equiv_g2tsum θe e
  · have hinj : ∀ x y : Γ(W, V.1), θe x = θe y → x = y := fun x y h => θe.injective h
    refine ⟨fun x y hxy => ?_, fun x y hxy => ?_⟩
    · apply hinj
      apply he.left
      have := congrArg θe hxy
      simpa only [map_mul, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using this
    · apply hinj
      apply he.right
      have := congrArg θe hxy
      simpa only [map_mul, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using this

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.ideal_eq_span_products_g2tsum
statement:
theorem ideal_eq_span_products_g2tsum (hJ : J = J₁ * J₂) (U : X.affineOpens) :
    J.ideal U = Ideal.span (Set.range fun p : J₁.ideal U × J₂.ideal U => p.1.1 * p.2.1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hJ, Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_mul, Pi.mul_apply]
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact Ideal.mul_le.2 fun a ha b hb => Ideal.subset_span ⟨(⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩), rfl⟩
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨⟨a, b⟩, rfl⟩
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul a.2 b.2

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.locallyPrincipal_comap_factor_g2tsum
statement:
theorem locallyPrincipal_comap_factor_g2tsum (hJ : J = J₁ * J₂) (z : blowup X J) :
    ∃ V : (blowup X J).affineOpens, z ∈ V.1 ∧ ∃ g : Γ(blowup X J, V.1),
      (J₁.comap (toBase X J)).ideal V = Ideal.span {g} ∧ IsRegular g
proof:
:= by
  have hz : z ∈ (⨆ U : X.affineOpens, (affineι X J U).opensRange) := by
    rw [iSup_opensRange_affineι]; trivial
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp hz
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hU
  let s : J₁.ideal U × J₂.ideal U → Γ(X, U.1) := fun q => q.1.1 * q.2.1
  have hspan := ideal_eq_span_products_g2tsum J J₁ J₂ hJ U
  let 𝒰 := affineOpenCoverOfSpan (J.ideal U) s hspan
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := 𝒰.covers p
  let i := 𝒰.idx p
  have hri : s i ∈ J.ideal U := by
    rw [hspan]
    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩
  let r : J.ideal U := ⟨s i, hri⟩
  have hf : 𝒰.f i = chartMap (J.ideal U) r := rfl
  have hzq : chartι X J U r q = affineι X J U p := by
    change (chartMap (J.ideal U) r ≫ affineι X J U) q = _
    rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← hf]
    exact congrArg (affineι X J U) hq
  have hI : J.ideal U = J₁.ideal U * J₂.ideal U := by
    rw [hJ, Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_mul, Pi.mul_apply]
  have hr : r.1 = (i.1 : Γ(X, U.1)) * (i.2 : Γ(X, U.1)) := rfl
  obtain ⟨hmap, hreg⟩ := map_baseRingHom_eq_span_of_mul_g2tsum hI i.1.2 i.2.2 r hr
  have hmap' : (J₁.ideal U).map (CommRingCat.ofHom (baseRingHom (J.ideal U) r)).hom =
      Ideal.span {baseRingHom (J.ideal U) r (i.1 : Γ(X, U.1))} := hmap
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgreg⟩ := exists_span_comap_chart_g2tsum (chartι X J U r) (toBase X J) U
    (CommRingCat.ofHom (baseRingHom (J.ideal U) r)) (chartι_toBase X J U r) J₁ _ hmap' hreg
  refine ⟨⟨(chartι X J U r) ''ᵁ ⊤, (isAffineOpen_top _).image_of_isOpenImmersion _⟩, ?_,
    g, hg, hgreg⟩
  change affineι X J U p ∈ (chartι X J U r) ''ᵁ ⊤
  rw [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange]
  exact ⟨q, hzq⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.isPullback_prodMap

    [IsNoetherian M] [LocallyOfFiniteType (N ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian N] [IsProper g]
    (hN : ProjectiveIntegralK k N) (C : DetIdealComplex M) :
    Set.range (graphModelMap (k := k) g C) =
      closure (graphModelMap (k := k) g C '' (graphAway (k := k) (C.comap g) : Set _))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isNoetherian_B0 (k := k) M
  haveI := isNoetherian_B0 (k := k) N
  haveI := isProper_prodMap (k := k) g
  haveI := isIntegral_graphModel hN (C.comap g)
  exact range_graphModelMap_eq_closure g C (graphAway_nonempty (C.comap g))

proof:
:= by
  rw [← opensRange_graphChart] at hw
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hw
  haveI := isIso_graphChart' (k := k) D
  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (graphChart (k := k) D) := by
    rw [← graphChart'_ι]; infer_instance
  have h := Chow.hom_degree_comp (graphChart (k := k) D) (graphToBase (k := k) D) y
  rw [graphChart_toBase, m7g_degree_openImmersion, m7g_degree_openImmersion, one_mul] at h

proof:
:= by
  haveI := isClosedImmersion_prodMap (k := k) g
  have h1 := Chow.hom_degree_comp (modelMap g C C' hJ) (graphToBase (k := k) C) w
  have h2 := Chow.hom_degree_comp (graphToBase (k := k) C') (prodMap (k := k) g) w
  rw [modelMap_toBase, h2, degree_graphToBase_of_mem C' hw,
    (prodMap (k := k) g).degree_eq_one_of_isClosedImmersion,
    degree_graphToBase_of_mem C (modelMap_mem_graphAway g C C' hJ hw)] at h1
  simpa using h1.symm

    by_contra h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.exists_shift_matrix_kim2
statement:
theorem exists_shift_matrix_kim2 {L₁ L₀ G₁ G₀ P₁ Q₁ P₀ Q₀ : Y.Modules} (ι₁ : L₁ ⟶ G₁)
    (ι₀ : L₀ ⟶ G₀) (ε : L₁ ⟶ L₀) (σ : G₁ ⟶ G₀) (hεσ : ε ≫ ι₀ = ι₁ ≫ σ) (in₁₁ : P₁ ⟶ G₁)
    (in₂₁ : Q₁ ⟶ G₁) (in₁₀ : P₀ ⟶ G₀) (in₂₀ : Q₀ ⟶ G₀) (e : Q₁ ⟶ P₀) (h1 : in₁₁ ≫ σ = 0)
    (h2 : in₂₁ ≫ σ = e ≫ in₁₀) (T : Y.Opens) {n₁ n₀ m₀ : Type u} [Fintype n₁] [Fintype n₀]
    [Fintype m₀] (sP₁ : n₁ → Γ(P₁, T)) (sQ₁ : n₀ → Γ(Q₁, T)) (sP₀ : n₀ → Γ(P₀, T))
    (sQ₀ : m₀ → Γ(Q₀, T)) (hframe : ∀ b, e.app T (sQ₁ b) = sP₀ b)
    (hA₀ : IsSecFrame G₀ T (sumFrameXiR in₁₀ in₂₀ sP₀ sQ₀))
    (B₁ : Matrix (n₁ ⊕ n₀) n₁ Γ(Y, T)) (B₀ : Matrix (n₀ ⊕ m₀) n₀ Γ(Y, T))
    (sec₁ : n₁ → Γ(L₁, T)) (sec₀ : n₀ → Γ(L₀, T))
    (hsec₁ : ∀ i, ι₁.app T (sec₁ i) =
      Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, T) (sumFrameXiR in₁₁ in₂₁ sP₁ sQ₁) (fun a => B₁ a i))
    (hsec₀ : ∀ l, ι₀.app T (sec₀ l) =
      Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, T) (sumFrameXiR in₁₀ in₂₀ sP₀ sQ₀) (fun a => B₀ a l))
    (hf₀ : IsSecFrame L₀ T sec₀) :
    ∃ Mm : Matrix n₀ n₁ Γ(Y, T),
      (∀ i, ε.app T (sec₁ i) = Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, T) sec₀ (fun l => Mm l i)) ∧
      B₀ * Mm = Matrix.fromRows (B₁.submatrix Sum.inr id) (0 : Matrix m₀ n₁ Γ(Y, T))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Mm : Matrix n₀ n₁ Γ(Y, T) := fun l i => (hf₀.equiv T le_rfl).symm (ε.app T (sec₁ i)) l
  have hM : ∀ i, ε.app T (sec₁ i) = Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, T) sec₀ (fun l => Mm l i) := by
    intro i
    have h := (hf₀.equiv T le_rfl).apply_symm_apply (ε.app T (sec₁ i))
    change Fintype.linearCombination _ (secResXiR _ le_rfl _) _ = _ at h
    rw [secResXiR_self] at h
    exact h.symm
  refine ⟨Mm, hM, ?_⟩
  
  have hσA : ∀ v : n₁ ⊕ n₀ → Γ(Y, T), σ.app T
      (Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, T) (sumFrameXiR in₁₁ in₂₁ sP₁ sQ₁) v) =
      Fintype.linearCombination Γ(Y, T) (sumFrameXiR in₁₀ in₂₀ sP₀ sQ₀)
        (Matrix.fromRows (Matrix.of fun b (_ : Unit) => v (Sum.inr b))
          (0 : Matrix m₀ Unit Γ(Y, T)) · ()) := by
    intro v
    have e1 := app_linearCombination_xiR σ (sumFrameXiR in₁₁ in₂₁ sP₁ sQ₁) (le_refl T) v
    rw [secResXiR_self] at e1
    simp only [secResXiR_self] at e1
    rw [e1, linearCombination_sum_xiR, linearCombination_sum_xiR]
    have hl : (fun a => σ.app T (sumFrameXiR in₁₁ in₂₁ sP₁ sQ₁ a)) ∘ Sum.inl = 0 := by
      funext a
      change σ.app T (in₁₁.app T (sP₁ a)) = 0
      rw [← comp_app_xiR, h1]
      rfl
    have hr : (fun a => σ.app T (sumFrameXiR in₁₁ in₂₁ sP₁ sQ₁ a)) ∘ Sum.inr =
        sumFrameXiR in₁₀ in₂₀ sP₀ sQ₀ ∘ Sum.inl := by
      funext b
      change σ.app T (in₂₁.app T (sQ₁ b)) = in₁₀.app T (sP₀ b)
      rw [← comp_app_xiR, h2, comp_app_xiR, hframe]
    rw [hl, hr]
    simp only [Fintype.linearCombination_apply, Pi.zero_apply, smul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero,
      zero_add, Function.comp_apply, Matrix.fromRows_apply_inl, Matrix.fromRows_apply_inr,
      Matrix.zero_apply, zero_smul, add_zero, Matrix.of_apply]
  ext l i
  have hcol := mulVec_eq_of_frames_kim2 ι₀ T sec₀ (sumFrameXiR in₁₀ in₂₀ sP₀ sQ₀) hA₀ B₀ hsec₀
    (fun l => Mm l i) (Matrix.fromRows (Matrix.of fun b (_ : Unit) => B₁ (Sum.inr b) i)
      (0 : Matrix m₀ Unit Γ(Y, T)) · ()) (by
        rw [← hM i, ← comp_app_xiR, hεσ, comp_app_xiR, hsec₁ i, hσA])
  have := congrFun hcol l
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
  change (B₀ *ᵥ fun l => Mm l i) l = _
  rw [this]
  rcases l with b | c <;> rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.isLocallySplitOfRank_xiShiftGamma
statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.isLocallySplitOfRank_xiShiftGamma (j : ℕ) (hj : j + 1 ≤ C.K.len)
    (V' : M.affineOpens)
    (hV'mem : xiProj (k := k) C (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU
      (genericPoint (C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU))) ∈ V'.1)
    (cf : ℕ → ℕ) (hcf : IsSplitData C.toDetIdealComplex V' cf) :
    IsLocallySplitOfRank (C.xiShiftGamma (k := k) U hC hU j) (cf (j + 1))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply isLocallySplitOfRank_of_frames
  intro z
  set ι := C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU with hι
  set π := xiProj (k := k) C with hπ
  obtain ⟨d⟩ := C.exists_xiChartDataKim2 (k := k) (ι z)
  obtain ⟨T₁, hT₁, hw₁, S₁, B₁, hB₁⟩ := d.exists_sat (j + 1)
  obtain ⟨T₀, hT₀, hw₀, S₀, B₀, hB₀⟩ := d.exists_sat j
  obtain ⟨sQ₀, hsQ₀, hrel₀⟩ := exists_tgtFrame_xiR C d.V d.s d.hs j
  have hw : ι z ∈ T₁ ⊓ T₀ := ⟨hw₁, hw₀⟩
  have hb₁ := biprodXiR_pullback π (C.K.E (j + 1)) (C.tgt (j + 1))
  have hb₀ := biprodXiR_pullback π (C.K.E j) (C.tgt j)
  have hf₁ := ((d.chartSucc j T₁ hT₁ hw₁ S₁ B₁ hB₁).restrictKim2 (T₁ ⊓ T₀) inf_le_left hw).isSecFrame
    hb₁ (xiOpen_nonempty C)
  have hf₀ := ((d.chart j sQ₀ hsQ₀ hrel₀ T₀ hT₀ hw₀ S₀ B₀ hB₀).restrictKim2 (T₁ ⊓ T₀) inf_le_right
    hw).isSecFrame hb₀ (xiOpen_nonempty C)
  set R₁ := (d.chartSucc j T₁ hT₁ hw₁ S₁ B₁ hB₁).restrictKim2 (T₁ ⊓ T₀) inf_le_left hw with hR₁
  set R₀ := (d.chart j sQ₀ hsQ₀ hrel₀ T₀ hT₀ hw₀ S₀ B₀ hB₀).restrictKim2 (T₁ ⊓ T₀) inf_le_right hw
    with hR₀
  have hframe : ∀ b, Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (𝟙 ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).obj (C.K.E j)))
      (T₁ ⊓ T₀) (R₁.sQ b) = R₀.sP b := by
    intro b
    change secResXiR _ inf_le_left (secResXiR _ (hT₁.trans d.T₀_le)
        (pullSecXiR π (C.tgt (j + 1)) d.V.1 (d.s j))) b =
      secResXiR _ inf_le_right (secResXiR _ (hT₀.trans d.T₀_le)
        (pullSecXiR π (C.K.E j) d.V.1 (d.s j))) b
    rw [secResXiR_res, secResXiR_res]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨Mm, hMm, hBM⟩ := exists_shift_matrix_kim2 (C.xiι (k := k) (j + 1)) (C.xiι (k := k) j)
    (C.xiShift (k := k) j) (C.shiftAmb (k := k) j) (C.xiShift_xiι j)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map biprod.inl) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map biprod.inr)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map biprod.inl) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).map biprod.inr)
    (𝟙 ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).obj (C.K.E j))) (C.inl_shiftAmb j)
    ((C.inr_shiftAmb j).trans (Category.id_comp _).symm) (T₁ ⊓ T₀)
    R₁.sP R₁.sQ R₀.sP R₀.sQ hframe (hb₀.isSecFrame_sumFrame R₀.hP R₀.hQ) R₁.B R₀.B
    (R₁.sec hb₁ (xiOpen_nonempty C)) (R₀.sec hb₀ (xiOpen_nonempty C)) (fun i => rfl) (fun l => rfl)
    hf₀
  have hφ : ∀ {p q : Type u} (P : Matrix p q Γ(C.graphModel (k := k), T₁ ⊓ T₀)),
      (P.map (ι.app (T₁ ⊓ T₀)).hom).map
        ((C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU).presheaf.germ (ι ⁻¹ᵁ (T₁ ⊓ T₀)) z hw).hom =
      P.map (stalkHomXiR ι (T₁ ⊓ T₀) hw) := by
    intro p q P
    rw [Matrix.map_map]
    rfl
  have hmin : ∀ r, GraphBundles.minorsIdeal r (Mm.map (stalkHomXiR ι (T₁ ⊓ T₀) hw)) =
      GraphBundles.minorsIdeal r
        (xiBot ((d.chartSucc j T₁ hT₁ hw₁ S₁ B₁ hB₁).B.map (stalkHomXiR ι T₁ hw₁))) := by
    intro r
    refine (minorsIdeal_eq_of_mul_kim2 (R₀.B.map (stalkHomXiR ι (T₁ ⊓ T₀) hw)) (selMat R₀.S₀)
      (Mm.map (stalkHomXiR ι (T₁ ⊓ T₀) hw))
      ((Matrix.fromRows (R₁.B.submatrix Sum.inr id) 0).map (stalkHomXiR ι (T₁ ⊓ T₀) hw))
      ((Matrix.map_mul (f := stalkHomXiR ι (T₁ ⊓ T₀) hw) (L := R₀.B) (M := Mm)).symm.trans
        (congrArg (fun P => P.map (stalkHomXiR ι (T₁ ⊓ T₀) hw)) hBM))
      ((R₀.hB.map _).selMat_mul_eq_one) r).trans ?_
    have e : (Matrix.fromRows (R₁.B.submatrix Sum.inr id)
        (0 : Matrix R₀.m R₁.n Γ(C.graphModel (k := k), T₁ ⊓ T₀))).map
          (stalkHomXiR ι (T₁ ⊓ T₀) hw) =
        Matrix.fromRows (xiBot ((d.chartSucc j T₁ hT₁ hw₁ S₁ B₁ hB₁).B.map (stalkHomXiR ι T₁ hw₁)))
          (0 : Matrix R₀.m R₁.n ((C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU).presheaf.stalk z)) := by
      ext b i
      rcases b with b | c
      · exact stalkHomXiR_res ι inf_le_left hw _
      · exact map_zero (stalkHomXiR ι (T₁ ⊓ T₀) hw)
    exact (congrArg (GraphBundles.minorsIdeal r) e).trans (minorsIdeal_fromRows_zero_kim2 _ r)
  have hg := C.gamma_minors_of_chart U hC hU (j + 1) hj V' hV'mem cf hcf z
    (d.chartSucc j T₁ hT₁ hw₁ S₁ B₁ hB₁)
    (d.chart_card (j + 1) _ _ _ T₁ hT₁ hw₁ S₁ B₁ hB₁) d.V (hT₁.trans d.T₀_le)
    (d.chart_minors (j + 1) _ _ _ T₁ hT₁ hw₁ S₁ B₁ hB₁)
  refine ⟨ι ⁻¹ᵁ (T₁ ⊓ T₀), hw, R₁.n, R₀.n, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    pullSecXiR ι (C.xi (k := k) (j + 1)) (T₁ ⊓ T₀) (R₁.sec hb₁ (xiOpen_nonempty C)),
    pullSecXiR ι (C.xi (k := k) j) (T₁ ⊓ T₀) (R₀.sec hb₀ (xiOpen_nonempty C)),
    Mm.map (ι.app (T₁ ⊓ T₀)).hom, isSecFrame_pullback ι _ _ hf₁, isSecFrame_pullback ι _ _ hf₀,
    fun i => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact pullback_app_pullSecXiR ι (C.xi (k := k) (j + 1)) (T₁ ⊓ T₀) (C.xiShift (k := k) j) _ _
      Mm hMm i
  · exact (congrArg (GraphBundles.minorsIdeal (cf (j + 1))) (hφ Mm)).trans
      ((hmin _).trans hg.2.2.1)
  · exact (congrArg (GraphBundles.minorsIdeal (cf (j + 1) + 1)) (hφ Mm)).trans
      ((hmin _).trans hg.2.2.2)

name: SingTau.splitHorseshoe_of_regular
statement:
theorem splitHorseshoe_of_regular {M : Scheme.{u}} (K : Type u) [CommRing K]
    [IsNoetherianRing K] [M1.FiniteDimBase K] (n : ℕ) (emb : M ⟶ space K n)
    [IsClosedImmersion emb] (hreg : ∀ x : M, IsRegularLocalRing (M.presheaf.stalk x))
    {L : ShortComplex M.Modules} (hL : L.ShortExact) (h₁ : IsCoherentLike M L.X₁)
    (h₂ : IsCoherentLike M L.X₂) (h₃ : IsCoherentLike M L.X₃) :
    ∃ (K₁ K₃ : BundleComplex M) (h : ∀ j, K₃.E (j + 1) ⟶ K₁.E j)
      (_ : ∀ j, h (j + 1) ≫ K₁.d j + K₃.d (j + 1) ≫ h j = 0) (K₂ : BundleComplex M)
      (_ : ∀ j, K₂.E j = (K₁.E j ⊞ K₃.E j))
      (R₁ : ResolutionData (IsCoherentLike M) K₁ L.X₁)
      (R₂ : ResolutionData (IsCoherentLike M) K₂ L.X₂)
      (R₃ : ResolutionData (IsCoherentLike M) K₃ L.X₃)
      (i : ∀ j, K₁.E j ⟶ K₂.E j) (q : ∀ j, K₂.E j ⟶ K₃.E j),
      (∀ j, SES (i j) (q j)) ∧
      (∀ j, K₁.d j ≫ i j = i (j + 1) ≫ K₂.d j) ∧
      (∀ j, K₂.d j ≫ q j = q (j + 1) ≫ K₃.d j) ∧
      R₁.ε ≫ L.f = i 0 ≫ R₂.ε ∧ R₂.ε ≫ L.g = q 0 ≫ R₃.ε
proof:
:= by
  haveI := PerfectRepG2.Sch.isLocallyNoetherian_of_closedImmersion K n emb
  let S := PerfectRepG2.Sch.setup M (PerfectRepG2.Sch.hasBundleCovers_of_closedImmersion K n emb)
  let hQ : ∀ {A B : M.Modules}, (A ≅ B) → S.Q A → S.Q B := fun e h => isCoherentLike_of_iso e h
  let s₀ : SesQ S := ⟨L, hL, h₁, h₂, h₃⟩
  have hd₁ := pdLE_of_regular K n emb hreg _ h₁
  have hd₂ := pdLE_of_regular K n emb hreg _ h₂
  have hd₃ := pdLE_of_regular K n emb hreg _ h₃
  refine ⟨ssComplex₁ hQ s₀ hd₁ hd₂ hd₃, ssComplex₃ hQ s₀ hd₁ hd₂ hd₃, ssH hQ s₀,
    ssH_hdd hQ s₀, ssComplex₂ hQ s₀ hd₁ hd₂ hd₃, fun _ => rfl, ssData₁ hQ s₀ hd₁ hd₂ hd₃,
    ssData₂ hQ s₀ hd₁ hd₂ hd₃, ssData₃ hQ s₀ hd₁ hd₂ hd₃, fun _ => biprod.inl,
    fun _ => biprod.snd, fun _ => ses_inl_snd_ss _ _, fun j => (inl_ssD₂ hQ s₀ j).symm,
    fun j => ssD₂_snd hQ s₀ j, ssData_ε₁₂ hQ s₀ hd₁ hd₂ hd₃, ssData_ε₂₃ hQ s₀ hd₁ hd₂ hd₃⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.rankedSplitHorseshoe
statement:
theorem rankedSplitHorseshoe (K : Type u) [CommRing K] [IsNoetherianRing K] [M1.FiniteDimBase K]
    (n : ℕ) (emb : M ⟶ space K n) [IsClosedImmersion emb]
    (hreg : ∀ x : M, IsRegularLocalRing (M.presheaf.stalk x))
    {L : ShortComplex M.Modules} (hL : L.ShortExact) (h₁ : IsCoherentLike M L.X₁)
    (h₂ : IsCoherentLike M L.X₂) (h₃ : IsCoherentLike M L.X₃) :
    ∃ (C₁ C₃ : RankedBundleComplex M) (c : ExtCocycle C₁ C₃)
      (R₁ : _root_.SingTau.ResolutionData (IsCoherentLike M) C₁.K L.X₁)
      (R₂ : _root_.SingTau.ResolutionData (IsCoherentLike M) (extComplex C₁ C₃ c).K L.X₂)
      (R₃ : _root_.SingTau.ResolutionData (IsCoherentLike M) C₃.K L.X₃),
      R₁.ε ≫ L.f = biprod.inl ≫ R₂.ε ∧ R₂.ε ≫ L.g = biprod.snd ≫ R₃.ε

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.tauAdditivitySplit_of_tauAdditivity
statement:
theorem tauAdditivitySplit_of_tauAdditivity (hadd : TauAdditivity hMK ι hM) :
    TauAdditivitySplit hMK ι hM
proof:
:= by
  intro C₁ C₃ c U h₁ h₃ hX
  exact hadd C₁ (extComplex C₁ C₃ c) C₃ (fun _ => biprod.inl) (fun _ => biprod.snd)
    (fun j => extComplex_ses C₁ C₃ j) (fun j => extComplex_inl_chain C₁ C₃ c j)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.tauSheaf_add_of_split
statement:
theorem tauSheaf_add_of_split (hind : TauResIndep hMK ι hM hreg)
    (hsplit : TauAdditivitySplit hMK ι hM) {L : ShortComplex M.Modules}
    (hL : L.ShortExact) (h₁ : IsCoherentLike M L.X₁) (h₂ : IsCoherentLike M L.X₂)
    (h₃ : IsCoherentLike M L.X₃) (hs₁ : moduleSheafSupport L.X₁ ⊆ Set.range ι)
    (hs₂ : moduleSheafSupport L.X₂ ⊆ Set.range ι) (hs₃ : moduleSheafSupport L.X₃ ⊆ Set.range ι) :
    tauSheaf hMK ι hM hreg L.X₂ h₂ =
      tauSheaf hMK ι hM hreg L.X₁ h₁ + tauSheaf hMK ι hM hreg L.X₃ h₃
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, N, e, he, -⟩ := id hMK
  haveI := he
  haveI : ConnectedSpace M := connectedSpace_of_isIntegral
  obtain ⟨C₁, C₃, c, R₁, R₂, R₃, -, -⟩ := rankedSplitHorseshoe k N e hreg hL h₁ h₂ h₃
  let U : M.Opens := exactLocus L.X₁ h₁ ⊓ exactLocus L.X₂ h₂ ⊓ exactLocus L.X₃ h₃
  have hU₁ : U ≤ exactLocus L.X₁ h₁ := inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left
  have hU₂ : U ≤ exactLocus L.X₂ h₂ := inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right
  have hU₃ : U ≤ exactLocus L.X₃ h₃ := inf_le_right
  have hX : ∀ x : M, x ∉ U → x ∈ Set.range ι := by
    intro x hx
    by_contra hn
    apply hx
    have m₁ : x ∈ exactLocus L.X₁ h₁ := fun h => hn (hs₁ h)
    have m₂ : x ∈ exactLocus L.X₂ h₂ := fun h => hn (hs₂ h)
    have m₃ : x ∈ exactLocus L.X₃ h₃ := fun h => hn (hs₃ h)
    exact ⟨⟨m₁, m₂⟩, m₃⟩
  have hC₁ : C₁.SectionExactOn U :=
    sectionExactOn_mono (sectionExactOn_of_resolutionData C₁ R₁ h₁) hU₁
  have hC₃ : C₃.SectionExactOn U :=
    sectionExactOn_mono (sectionExactOn_of_resolutionData C₃ R₃ h₃) hU₃
  rw [hind L.X₁ h₁ hs₁ C₁ R₁ U hC₁ hX, hind L.X₃ h₃ hs₃ C₃ R₃ U hC₃ hX,
    hind L.X₂ h₂ hs₂ (extComplex C₁ C₃ c) R₂ U (sectionExactOn_extComplex c hC₁ hC₃) hX]
  exact hsplit C₁ C₃ c U hC₁ hC₃ hX

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FlatBC.genericMultiplicity_flat_g2tflat
statement:
theorem genericMultiplicity_flat_g2tflat (x : Z') :
    genericMultiplicity x = genericMultiplicity (f x) * flatPullbackCoeff f x
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra (Z.presheaf.stalk (f x)) (Z'.presheaf.stalk x) := (f.stalkMap x).hom.toAlgebra
  haveI : Module.Flat (Z.presheaf.stalk (f x)) (Z'.presheaf.stalk x) := Flat.stalkMap f x
  haveI : IsLocalHom (algebraMap (Z.presheaf.stalk (f x)) (Z'.presheaf.stalk x)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsLocalHom (f.stalkMap x).hom)
  have h := IsLocalRing.length_baseChange (Z.presheaf.stalk (f x)) (Z'.presheaf.stalk x)
    (Z.presheaf.stalk (f x))
  rw [(TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.rid (Z.presheaf.stalk (f x)) (Z'.presheaf.stalk x)
    (Z'.presheaf.stalk x)).length_eq] at h
  unfold genericMultiplicity selfLocalLength flatPullbackCoeff
  rw [h, ENat.toNat_mul]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FlatBC.eq_of_specializes_of_mem_genericPoints_g2tflat
statement:
theorem eq_of_specializes_of_mem_genericPoints_g2tflat {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Y]
    {y y' : Y} (hy : y ∈ genericPoints Y) (h : y' ⤳ y) : y' = y
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : y ≤ y' := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr h
  have h2 := isMax_of_mem_genericPoints hy h1
  exact (h.antisymm (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp h2)).eq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FlatBC.flatPullback_fundamentalCycle_g2tflat
statement:
theorem flatPullback_fundamentalCycle_g2tflat :
    flatPullback f (fundamentalCycle Z) = fundamentalCycle Z'
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [flatPullback_apply]
  by_cases hz : f x ∈ genericPoints Z
  · rw [fundamentalCycle_apply_of_mem_genericPoints hz]
    by_cases hx : x ∈ genericPoints Z'
    · rw [fundamentalCycle_apply_of_mem_genericPoints hx, genericMultiplicity_flat_g2tflat f x]
      push_cast
      ring
    · rw [fundamentalCycle_apply_of_not_mem_genericPoints hx]
      have hc : flatPullbackCoeff f x = 0 := by
        have hnm : ¬ IsMax x := fun h ↦ hx (mem_genericPoints_of_isMax h)
        obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := not_isMax_iff.mp hnm
        have hyx : y ⤳ x := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hxy.le
        have hne : y ≠ x := fun h ↦ hxy.ne h.symm
        have hfy : f y = f x :=
          eq_of_specializes_of_mem_genericPoints_g2tflat hz (hyx.map f.continuous)
        exact m6pb_coeff_eq_zero_of_specializes f hyx hne hfy
      rw [hc]
      simp
  · rw [fundamentalCycle_apply_of_not_mem_genericPoints hz, zero_mul]
    have hx : x ∉ genericPoints Z' := by
      intro hx
      have hnm : ¬ IsMax (f x) := fun h ↦ hz (mem_genericPoints_of_isMax h)
      obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀⟩ := not_isMax_iff.mp hnm
      have h1 : z₀ ⤳ f x := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hz₀.le
      obtain ⟨y, hyx, hfy⟩ := f17_exists_generization f x h1
      have heq : y = x := eq_of_specializes_of_mem_genericPoints_g2tflat hx hyx
      exact hz₀.ne (by rw [← hfy, heq])
    rw [fundamentalCycle_apply_of_not_mem_genericPoints hx]
