name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FlatBC.flatPullback_rCycle_g2tflat
statement:
theorem flatPullback_rCycle_g2tflat (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) (U' : N.Opens)
    (hU' : U' = g ⁻¹ᵁ U) (hC' : C'.SectionExactOn U') {n n' : ℕ}
    (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) (hN : height (genericPoint N) = n') :
    flatPullback (cmpMap (k := k) C C' g hJ) (rCycle (k := k) C U hC hM).1 =
      (rCycle (k := k) C' U' hC' hN).1
proof:
:= by
  subst hU'
  ext w
  rw [flatPullback_apply]
  by_cases hw : xiProj (k := k) C' w ∈ g ⁻¹ᵁ U
  · have h1 : (rCycle (k := k) C U hC hM).1 (cmpMap (k := k) C C' g hJ w) = 0 := by
      by_contra h
      apply rCycle_support (k := k) C U hC hM _ h
      rw [cmpMap_xiProj_apply_g2tflat]
      exact hw
    have h2 : (rCycle (k := k) C' (g ⁻¹ᵁ U) hC' hN).1 w = 0 := by
      by_contra h
      exact rCycle_support (k := k) C' (g ⁻¹ᵁ U) hC' hN w h hw
    rw [h1, h2, zero_mul]
  · have hinf := congrArg (fun D : AlgebraicCycle _ ℤ ↦ D w)
      (flatPullback_infCycle_g2tflat C C' g hJ)
    simp only [flatPullback_apply] at hinf
    have hΓ : (gammaCycle (k := k) C U hC hM).1 (cmpMap (k := k) C C' g hJ w) = 0 := by
      refine gammaCycle_apply_eq_zero_g2tflat C U hC hM _ ?_
      rw [cmpMap_xiProj_apply_g2tflat]
      exact hw
    have hΓ' : (gammaCycle (k := k) C' (g ⁻¹ᵁ U) hC' hN).1 w = 0 :=
      gammaCycle_apply_eq_zero_g2tflat C' (g ⁻¹ᵁ U) hC' hN w hw
    rw [rCycle_val_g2tflat, rCycle_val_g2tflat]
    change ((infCycle (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) (cmpMap (k := k) C C' g hJ w) -
        (gammaCycle (k := k) C U hC hM).1 (cmpMap (k := k) C C' g hJ w)) * _ =
      (infCycle (k := k) C'.toDetIdealComplex) w - (gammaCycle (k := k) C' (g ⁻¹ᵁ U) hC' hN).1 w
    rw [hΓ, hΓ', sub_zero, sub_zero, hinf]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.kernel_ι_factorThruImage
statement: theorem kernel_ι_factorThruImage : kernel.ι φ ≫ Abelian.factorThruImage φ = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (Abelian.image.ι φ)).1
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.shortExact_kernel_image
statement: theorem shortExact_kernel_image : (kernelImageComplex φ).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  refine { exact := ?_, mono_f := ?_, epi_g := ?_ }
  · refine ShortComplex.exact_of_f_is_kernel _ ?_
    refine KernelFork.IsLimit.ofι _ _
      (fun {W'} k hk => kernel.lift φ k (by
        rw [← Abelian.image.fac φ, ← Category.assoc]
        change (k ≫ Abelian.factorThruImage φ) ≫ _ = 0
        rw [hk, zero_comp])) (fun k hk => kernel.lift_ι _ _ _) ?_
    intro W' k hk m hm
    apply (cancel_mono (kernel.ι φ)).1
    simpa using hm
  · change Mono (kernel.ι φ); infer_instance
  · change Epi (Abelian.factorThruImage φ); infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.shortExact_image_cokernel
statement: theorem shortExact_image_cokernel : (imageCokernelComplex φ).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  refine { exact := ?_, mono_f := ?_, epi_g := ?_ }
  · exact ShortComplex.exact_of_f_is_kernel _ (kernelIsKernel (cokernel.π φ))
  · change Mono (kernel.ι (cokernel.π φ)); infer_instance
  · change Epi (cokernel.π φ); infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.hasConstantRank_of_iso_cfrs
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_of_iso_cfrs {M N : X.Modules} (e : M ≅ N) {r : ℕ}
    (hM : HasConstantRank X M r) : HasConstantRank X N r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hfin, hcard⟩ := hM
  refine ⟨{ I := q.I, X := q.X, coversTop := q.coversTop
            generators := fun i ↦ SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.equivOfIso
              ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf (q.X i)).mapIso e) (q.generators i) },
    ?_, ?_, hcard⟩
  · constructor
    intro i
    haveI := hq.isIso i
    exact SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.equivOfIso_isIso _ _
  · constructor
    intro i
    haveI := hfin.isFiniteType i
    exact SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.equivOfIso_isFiniteType _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.hasConstantRank_restrict_cfrs
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_restrict_cfrs {Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    {M : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (h : HasConstantRank X M r) :
    HasConstantRank Z ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj M) r
proof:
:=
  hasConstantRank_of_iso_cfrs ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback f).app M).symm
    (hasConstantRank_pullback Z f M r h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.hasConstantRank_of_restrict_opens_cfrs
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_of_restrict_opens_cfrs (M : X.Modules) (r : ℕ)
    (H : ∀ x : X, ∃ V : X.Opens, x ∈ V ∧
      HasConstantRank V ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj M) r) :
    HasConstantRank X M r
proof:
:= by
  have H' : ∀ x : X, ∃ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (ι : Z ⟶ X) (_ : IsOpenImmersion ι),
      x ∈ ι.opensRange ∧
        Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ι).obj M ≅
          ⨁ fun _ : Fin ((fun _ : X ↦ r) x) => unitModule Z) := fun x ↦ by
    obtain ⟨V, hxV, q, hq, hqfin, hcard⟩ := H x
    letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
    letI : q.IsFiniteType := hqfin
    have hcover : IsOpenCover q.X :=
      (Opens.coversTop_iff (V : Scheme) q.X).mp q.coversTop
    have hxUnion : (⟨x, hxV⟩ : (V : Scheme)) ∈ ⋃ i, (q.X i : Set (V : Scheme)) := by
      rw [hcover.iSup_set_eq_univ]
      exact Set.mem_univ _
    obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hxUnion
    let C := localGeneratorsOpenCover q
    letI : (q.generators i).IsFiniteType :=
      SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType i
    letI : Finite (q.generators i).I := by infer_instance
    refine ⟨C.X i, C.f i ≫ V.ι, inferInstance, ?_, ⟨?_⟩⟩
    · have : (⟨x, hxV⟩ : (V : Scheme)) ∈ (C.f i).opensRange := ⟨⟨_, hxi⟩, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := this
      exact ⟨z, by simp [hz]⟩
    · exact (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp (C.f i) V.ι).app M ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.f i)).mapIso (Iso.refl _) ≪≫
          localGeneratorsOpenCoverIso q i ≪≫
            freeIsoBiprod (C.X i) (q.generators i).I (Finite.equivFinOfCardEq (hcard i))
  choose Z ι hι hx he using H'
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin, hcard⟩ := exists_localGeneratorsData_of_local M (fun _ ↦ r)
    (fun x ↦ ⟨Z x, ι x, hι x, hx x, he x⟩)
  exact ⟨q, hq, hqfin, fun i ↦ (hcard i).choose_spec⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.hasConstantRank_cokernel_of_locallySplit
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_cokernel_of_locallySplit (hF : HasConstantRank X F f) (φ : E ⟶ F)
    (hφ : IsLocallySplitOfRank φ c) : HasConstantRank X (cokernel φ) (f - c)
proof:
:= by
  refine hasConstantRank_of_restrict_opens_cfrs _ _ fun x ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨V, hxV, L, π, i, ρ, hL, hπ, hiρ, hfac⟩ := hφ x
  refine ⟨V, hxV, ?_⟩
  let R := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι
  have hFV : HasConstantRank V (R.obj F) f := hasConstantRank_restrict_cfrs V.ι hF
  haveI : Epi ρ := epi_of_epi_fac hiρ
  have hK : HasConstantRank V (kernel ρ) (f - c) := hasConstantRank_kernel V hFV hL ρ
  refine hasConstantRank_of_iso_cfrs ?_ hK
  exact (cokernelIsoKernelOfRetraction i ρ hiρ).symm ≪≫ (cokernelEpiComp π i).symm ≪≫
    cokernelIsoOfEq hfac ≪≫ (PreservesCokernel.iso R φ).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.hasConstantRank_image_of_locallySplit
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_image_of_locallySplit (hF : HasConstantRank X F f) (φ : E ⟶ F)
    (hφ : IsLocallySplitOfRank φ c) (hcf : c ≤ f) :
    HasConstantRank X (Abelian.image φ) c
proof:
:= by
  have h := hasConstantRank_kernel X hF (hasConstantRank_cokernel_of_locallySplit hF φ hφ)
    (cokernel.π φ)
  rwa [Nat.sub_sub_self hcf] at h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.hasConstantRank_kernel_of_locallySplit
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_kernel_of_locallySplit (hE : HasConstantRank X E e)
    (hF : HasConstantRank X F f) (φ : E ⟶ F) (hφ : IsLocallySplitOfRank φ c) (hcf : c ≤ f) :
    HasConstantRank X (kernel φ) (e - c)
proof:
:=
  hasConstantRank_of_iso_cfrs (kernelIsoKernelFactorThruImage φ).symm
    (hasConstantRank_kernel X hE (hasConstantRank_image_of_locallySplit hF φ hφ hcf)
      (Abelian.factorThruImage φ))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.hasConstantRank_ker_im_coker
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_ker_im_coker (hE : HasConstantRank X E e) (hF : HasConstantRank X F f)
    (φ : E ⟶ F) (hφ : IsLocallySplitOfRank φ c) (hcf : c ≤ f) :
    HasConstantRank X (kernel φ) (e - c) ∧ HasConstantRank X (Abelian.image φ) c ∧
      HasConstantRank X (cokernel φ) (f - c)
proof:
:=
  ⟨hasConstantRank_kernel_of_locallySplit hE hF φ hφ hcf,
    hasConstantRank_image_of_locallySplit hF φ hφ hcf,
    hasConstantRank_cokernel_of_locallySplit hF φ hφ⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.k0ClassOf_eq_kernel_add_image
statement:
theorem k0ClassOf_eq_kernel_add_image (hE : HasConstantRank X E e) (hF : HasConstantRank X F f)
    (φ : E ⟶ F) (hφ : IsLocallySplitOfRank φ c) (hcf : c ≤ f) :
    k0ClassOf X E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree =
      k0ClassOf X (kernel φ) (hasConstantRank_kernel_of_locallySplit hE hF φ hφ hcf).isFiniteLocallyFree +
        k0ClassOf X (Abelian.image φ)
          (hasConstantRank_image_of_locallySplit hF φ hφ hcf).isFiniteLocallyFree
proof:
:=
  k0ClassOf_eq_add_of_shortExact X _ _ _ (kernel_ι_factorThruImage φ)
    (shortExact_kernel_image φ)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ConstantFibreRank.k0ClassOf_eq_image_add_cokernel
statement:
theorem k0ClassOf_eq_image_add_cokernel (hF : HasConstantRank X F f)
    (φ : E ⟶ F) (hφ : IsLocallySplitOfRank φ c) (hcf : c ≤ f) :
    k0ClassOf X F hF.isFiniteLocallyFree =
      k0ClassOf X (Abelian.image φ)
          (hasConstantRank_image_of_locallySplit hF φ hφ hcf).isFiniteLocallyFree +
        k0ClassOf X (cokernel φ)
          (hasConstantRank_cokernel_of_locallySplit hF φ hφ).isFiniteLocallyFree
proof:
:=
  k0ClassOf_eq_add_of_shortExact X _ _ _ (kernel.condition _) (shortExact_image_cokernel φ)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.le_preimage_imageAffine

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.chartRing_bijective
statement:
theorem chartRing_bijective (W : V.toScheme.affineOpens) :
    Function.Bijective (chartRing X V W)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (V.ι.appIso W.1).hom = V.ι.appLE (V.ι ''ᵁ W.1) W.1 (V.ι.preimage_image_eq W.1).ge :=
    V.ι.appIso_hom' W.1
  change Function.Bijective (V.ι.appLE (V.ι ''ᵁ W.1) W.1 (V.ι.preimage_image_eq W.1).ge).hom
  rw [← h]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.map_chartRing
statement:
theorem map_chartRing (W : V.toScheme.affineOpens) :
    (I.ideal (imageAffine X V W)).map (chartRing X V W) = (restrictIdeal X I V).ideal W
proof:
:=
  (Chow.M7.KDGb.comap_ideal_eq_map V.ι I (imageAffine X V W) W
    (le_preimage_imageAffine X V W)).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.res_comp_chartRing
statement:
theorem res_comp_chartRing {W₁ W₂ : V.toScheme.affineOpens} (h : W₁ ≤ W₂) :
    (res V.toScheme h).comp (chartRing X V W₂) =
      (chartRing X V W₁).comp (res X (show imageAffine X V W₁ ≤ imageAffine X V W₂ from
        V.ι.image_mono h))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← CommRingCat.hom_comp, ← CommRingCat.hom_comp]
  congr 1
  rw [Scheme.Hom.appLE_map, Scheme.Hom.map_appLE]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.pieceMap_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem pieceMap_naturality {W₁ W₂ : V.toScheme.affineOpens} (h : W₁ ≤ W₂) :
    (gluingFunctor V.toScheme (restrictIdeal X I V)).map (homOfLE h) ≫ pieceMap X I V W₂ =
      pieceMap X I V W₁ ≫ (gluingFunctor X I).map
        (homOfLE (show imageAffine X V W₁ ≤ imageAffine X V W₂ from V.ι.image_mono h))
proof:
:= by
  rw [gluingFunctor_map, gluingFunctor_map]
  unfold pieceMap
  refine (schemeMapOfEq_comp _ _ _ _ _ _ _).trans
    (Eq.trans ?_ (schemeMapOfEq_comp _ _ _ _ _ _ _).symm)
  exact schemeMapOfEq_congr _ (res_comp_chartRing X V h) _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.pieceCocone_naturality
statement:
theorem pieceCocone_naturality {W₁ W₂ : V.toScheme.affineOpens} (h : W₁ ⟶ W₂) :
    (gluingFunctor V.toScheme (restrictIdeal X I V)).map h ≫
        pieceMap X I V W₂ ≫ affineι X I (imageAffine X V W₂) =
      (pieceMap X I V W₁ ≫ affineι X I (imageAffine X V W₁)) ≫ 𝟙 (blowup X I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Category.comp_id]
  exact (pieceMap_naturality_assoc X I V (leOfHom h) _).trans
    (congrArg (pieceMap X I V W₁ ≫ ·) (colimit.w (gluingData X I).functor _))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.affineι_restrictMap
statement:
theorem affineι_restrictMap (W : V.toScheme.affineOpens) :
    affineι V.toScheme (restrictIdeal X I V) W ≫ restrictMap X I V =
      pieceMap X I V W ≫ affineι X I (imageAffine X V W)
proof:
:=
  colimit.ι_desc _ _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.isPullback_piece
statement:
theorem isPullback_piece (W : V.toScheme.affineOpens) :
    IsPullback (gluingApp V.toScheme (restrictIdeal X I V) W)
      (pieceMap X I V W ≫ affineι X I (imageAffine X V W)) (W.1.ι ≫ V.ι)
      (toBase X I)
proof:
:= by
  let _ := (chartRing X V W).toAlgebra
  have : Module.Flat Γ(X, (imageAffine X V W).1) Γ(V, W.1) :=
    RingHom.Flat.of_bijective (chartRing_bijective X V W)
  have hA := isPullback_schemeMapOfEq (I.ideal (imageAffine X V W))
    ((restrictIdeal X I V).ideal W) (map_chartRing X I V W)
  
  have hA' : IsPullback (gluingApp V.toScheme (restrictIdeal X I V) W) (pieceMap X I V W)
      ((isAffineOpen V.toScheme W).isoSpec.hom ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (chartRing X V W)) ≫ (isAffineOpen X (imageAffine X V W)).isoSpec.inv)
      (gluingApp X I (imageAffine X V W)) := by
    refine IsPullback.of_iso hA.flip (Iso.refl _) (isAffineOpen V.toScheme W).isoSpec.symm
      (Iso.refl _) (isAffineOpen X (imageAffine X V W)).isoSpec.symm ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · exact (Category.id_comp _).symm
    · exact (Category.id_comp _).symm
    · simp only [Iso.symm_hom, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
      rfl
    · exact (Category.id_comp _).symm
  have hB := isPullback_affine' X I (imageAffine X V W)
  have hP := hA'.paste_vert hB
  convert hP using 1
  rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_inv_ι]
  change _ = _ ≫ Spec.map (V.ι.appLE (imageAffine X V W).1 W.1 _) ≫ _
  rw [IsAffineOpen.SpecMap_appLE_fromSpec V.ι (isAffineOpen X (imageAffine X V W))
    (isAffineOpen V.toScheme W), ← IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_inv_ι]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  exact (Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc _ _).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.isPullback_restrict_blowup
statement:
theorem isPullback_restrict_blowup :
    IsPullback (toBase V.toScheme (restrictIdeal X I V)) (restrictMap X I V) V.ι (toBase X I)
proof:
:= by
  refine Scheme.isPullback_of_openCover _ _ _ _ V.toScheme.directedAffineCover fun W => ?_
  have hV := (isPullback_affine' V.toScheme (restrictIdeal X I V) W).flip
  refine IsPullback.of_iso (isPullback_piece X I V W) hV.isoPullback (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _)
    (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom]
    exact hV.isoPullback_hom_snd.symm
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom]
    refine (affineι_restrictMap X I V W).symm.trans ?_
    exact congrArg (· ≫ restrictMap X I V) hV.isoPullback_hom_fst.symm
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
    rfl
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.restrictIso_hom_ι

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.restrictIso_hom_toBase

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.mstalk_map_germ
statement:
theorem mstalk_map_germ {A B : X.Modules} (φ : A ⟶ B) (U : X.Opens) (z : X) (hz : z ∈ U)
    (n : Γ(A, U)) :
    ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X z).map φ).hom (TopCat.Presheaf.germ A.val.presheaf U z hz n) =
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ B.val.presheaf U z hz (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app φ U n)
proof:
:= by
  change ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat z).map
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).map φ))).hom
      (TopCat.Presheaf.germ A.val.presheaf U z hz n) = _
  erw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.mem_support_of_specializes
statement:
theorem mem_support_of_specializes {F : X.Modules} [F.IsQuasicoherent] {x y : X} (h : x ⤳ y)
    (hx : x ∈ moduleSheafSupport F) : y ∈ moduleSheafSupport F
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (RRC.ProjectiveSpaceLeadingDegree.mem_support_stalk_iff F h).mpr hx
  rw [mem_moduleSheafSupport_iff]
  exact Module.nonempty_support_iff.mp ⟨_, h1⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.unitPush_app
statement:
theorem unitPush_app {V : Scheme.{u}} (ι : V ⟶ X) (U : X.Opens) (a : Γ(X, U)) :
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (unitPush ι) U a = ι.app U a
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.not_mem_support_of_kill
statement:
theorem not_mem_support_of_kill {Q : X.Modules} (q : Chow.M7.D22.UnitM X ⟶ Q)
    [Epi q] {U : X.Opens} (s : Γ(X, U)) (hs : Scheme.Modules.Hom.app q U s = 0) {y : X} (hy : y ∈ U)
    (hu : IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ U y hy s)) : y ∉ moduleSheafSupport Q
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_moduleSheafSupport_iff, not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton]
  
  have hlin : ∀ (W : X.Opens) (r : Γ(X, W)), Scheme.Modules.Hom.app q W r = r • Scheme.Modules.Hom.app q W (1 : Γ(X, W)) := fun W r ↦ by
    rw [← Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul]
    congr 1
    exact (mul_one r).symm
  suffices h : ∀ m : (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X y).obj Q, m = 0 from
    ⟨fun a b ↦ by rw [h a, h b]⟩
  intro m
  obtain ⟨W, hyW, n, rfl⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.exists_germ_eq Q.val.presheaf m
  obtain ⟨W', hW', hyW', t, ht⟩ := Chow.M7.D22.exists_local_preimage_of_epi q W n y hyW
  let W'' : X.Opens := W' ⊓ U
  have hy'' : y ∈ W'' := ⟨hyW', hy⟩
  let i1 : W'' ⟶ W' := homOfLE inf_le_left
  let i2 : W'' ⟶ U := homOfLE inf_le_right
  
  let g : (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X y).obj Q :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.germ Q.val.presheaf W'' y hy'' (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app q W'' (1 : Γ(X, W'')))
  have hg : g = 0 := by
    have h0 : Scheme.Modules.Hom.app q W'' (X.presheaf.map i2.op s) = 0 := by
      have h := Chow.C1Cap.app_presheaf_map q i2 s
      erw [hs, map_zero] at h
      exact h
    rw [hlin] at h0
    have h3 := congrArg (TopCat.Presheaf.germ Q.val.presheaf W'' y hy'') h0
    have h2 := PresheafOfModules.germ_smul (R := X.presheaf) Q.val y W'' hy''
      (X.presheaf.map i2.op s) (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app q W'' (1 : Γ(X, W'')))
    have h4 : X.presheaf.germ W'' y hy'' (X.presheaf.map i2.op s) = X.presheaf.germ U y hy s :=
      X.presheaf.germ_res_apply i2 y hy'' s
    have h1 : X.presheaf.germ U y hy s • g = 0 := by
      rw [← h4]
      exact h2.symm.trans (h3.trans (map_zero _))
    exact (hu.smul_eq_zero).mp h1
  have e1 : (TopCat.Presheaf.germ Q.val.presheaf W y hyW n : (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X y).obj Q) =
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ Q.val.presheaf W' y hyW' (Q.val.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW').op n) :=
    (TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply Q.val.presheaf (homOfLE hW') y hyW' n).symm
  have e2 : (TopCat.Presheaf.germ Q.val.presheaf W' y hyW' (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app q W' t) :
      (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X y).obj Q) = TopCat.Presheaf.germ Q.val.presheaf W'' y hy''
      (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app q W'' (X.presheaf.map i1.op t)) := by
    have h := Chow.C1Cap.app_presheaf_map q i1 t
    erw [h]
    exact (TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply Q.val.presheaf i1 y hy'' _).symm
  change (TopCat.Presheaf.germ Q.val.presheaf W y hyW n : (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X y).obj Q) = 0
  rw [e1]
  erw [← ht]
  rw [e2, hlin]
  have h2 := PresheafOfModules.germ_smul (R := X.presheaf) Q.val y W'' hy''
    (X.presheaf.map i1.op t) (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app q W'' (1 : Γ(X, W'')))
  have h5 : X.presheaf.germ W'' y hy'' (X.presheaf.map i1.op t) • g = 0 := by
    rw [hg, smul_zero]
  exact h2.trans h5

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.kernel_comp_unitPush_eq_zero
statement:
theorem kernel_comp_unitPush_eq_zero {Q : X.Modules} [Q.IsQuasicoherent]
    (q : Chow.M7.D22.UnitM X ⟶ Q) [Epi q] {x : X} (hx : x ∈ moduleSheafSupport Q) :
    kernel.ι q ≫ unitPush (Chow.pointClosureι x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext U t
  let s : Γ(X, U) := Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (kernel.ι q) U t
  have hs : Scheme.Modules.Hom.app q U s = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun φ ↦ Scheme.Modules.Hom.app φ U t) (kernel.condition q)
    simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, Scheme.Modules.Hom.zero_app] at h
    exact h
  rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, Scheme.Modules.Hom.zero_app]
  change Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (unitPush (Chow.pointClosureι x)) U s = 0
  rw [unitPush_app]
  change (Chow.pointClosureι x).app U s = (0 : Γ(Chow.pointClosureScheme x, Chow.pointClosureι x ⁻¹ᵁ U))
  rw [← AlgebraicGeometry.basicOpen_eq_bot_iff]
  refine eq_bot_iff.mpr fun v hv ↦ ?_
  exfalso
  rw [← Scheme.preimage_basicOpen] at hv
  obtain ⟨hvU, hu⟩ := (Scheme.mem_basicOpen'' (X := X) s (Chow.pointClosureι x v)).mp hv
  have hnot := not_mem_support_of_kill q s hs hvU hu
  have hcl : Chow.pointClosureι x v ∈ closure {x} := by
    rw [← Chow.range_pointClosureι]
    exact ⟨v, rfl⟩
  exact hnot (mem_support_of_specializes (specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr hcl) hx)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.comp_psi
statement:
theorem comp_psi {Q : X.Modules} [Q.IsQuasicoherent] (q : Chow.M7.D22.UnitM X ⟶ Q) [Epi q]
    {x : X} (hx : x ∈ moduleSheafSupport Q) : q ≫ psi q hx = unitPush _
proof:
:=
  Abelian.comp_epiDesc _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.germ_unitPush_ne_zero
statement:
theorem germ_unitPush_ne_zero (x : X) :
    (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (pushUnit (Chow.pointClosureι x)).val.presheaf ⊤ x trivial
      (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (unitPush (Chow.pointClosureι x)) ⊤ (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))) :
        (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj (pushUnit (Chow.pointClosureι x))) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h' := h.trans (map_zero (ConcreteCategory.hom (TopCat.Presheaf.germ
    (pushUnit (Chow.pointClosureι x)).val.presheaf ⊤ x trivial))).symm
  obtain ⟨W, hxW, iU, iV, hW⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.germ_eq (U := ⊤) (V := ⊤) _ x trivial trivial _ _ h'
  rw [map_zero, unitPush_app] at hW
  have h1 : (1 : Γ(Chow.pointClosureScheme x, Chow.pointClosureι x ⁻¹ᵁ W)) = 0 := by
    have h2 : (Chow.pointClosureScheme x).presheaf.map
        ((Opens.map (Chow.pointClosureι x).base).map iU).op
        ((Chow.pointClosureι x).app ⊤ (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))) = 0 := hW
    rw [map_one, map_one] at h2
    exact h2
  let v := Chow.pointClosureGenericPoint x
  have hv : v ∈ Chow.pointClosureι x ⁻¹ᵁ W := by
    show Chow.pointClosureι x v ∈ W
    rw [Chow.pointClosureι_genericPoint]
    exact hxW
  have h3 := congrArg ((Chow.pointClosureScheme x).presheaf.germ _ v hv) h1
  rw [map_one, map_zero] at h3
  exact one_ne_zero h3

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.mem_support_img_psi
statement:
theorem mem_support_img_psi {Q : X.Modules} [Q.IsQuasicoherent] (q : Chow.M7.D22.UnitM X ⟶ Q)
    [Epi q] {x : X} (hx : x ∈ moduleSheafSupport Q) :
    x ∈ moduleSheafSupport (img (psi q hx))
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hno
  rw [mem_moduleSheafSupport_iff, not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton] at hno
  let g0 : (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj Q := TopCat.Presheaf.germ Q.val.presheaf ⊤ x trivial
    (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app q ⊤ (1 : Γ(X, ⊤)))
  have h1 : ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map (psi q hx)).hom g0 =
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ (pushUnit (Chow.pointClosureι x)).val.presheaf ⊤ x trivial
      (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (unitPush (Chow.pointClosureι x)) ⊤ (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))) := by
    rw [mstalk_map_germ, ← comp_psi q hx]
    rfl
  have hfac : psi q hx = kernel.lift (cokernel.π (psi q hx)) (psi q hx) (cokernel.condition _) ≫
      kernel.ι (cokernel.π (psi q hx)) := (kernel.lift_ι _ _ _).symm
  have h2 : ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map (psi q hx)).hom g0 = 0 := by
    rw [hfac, Functor.map_comp, ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply]
    have h3 : ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map (kernel.lift (cokernel.π (psi q hx)) (psi q hx)
        (cokernel.condition _))).hom g0 = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [h3, map_zero]
  exact germ_unitPush_ne_zero x (h1.symm.trans h2)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.isCoherentDimLE_pushUnit_pointClosure
statement:
theorem isCoherentDimLE_pushUnit_pointClosure [IsLocallyNoetherian X] {d : ℕ} {x : X}
    (hx : height x ≤ d) : IsCoherentDimLE X d (pushUnit (Chow.pointClosureι x))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨isCoherentLike_pushUnit _, fun y hy ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [moduleSheafSupport_pushUnit, Chow.range_pointClosureι] at hy
  have hle : y ≤ x := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr (specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr hy)
  exact (height_mono hle).trans hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.length_self_of_isField
statement:
theorem length_self_of_isField {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (h : IsField R) :
    Module.length R R = 1
proof:
:= by
  letI := h.toField
  exact Module.length_eq_one R R

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.stalkLength_pushUnit_pointClosure
statement:
theorem stalkLength_pushUnit_pointClosure (x : X) :
    stalkLength (pushUnit (Chow.pointClosureι x)) x = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := stalkLength_pushUnit (Chow.pointClosureι x) (Chow.pointClosureGenericPoint x)
  rw [Chow.pointClosureι_genericPoint] at h
  rw [h]
  apply length_self_of_isField
  have hη : Chow.pointClosureGenericPoint x = genericPoint (Chow.pointClosureScheme x) :=
    (Chow.pointClosureGenericPoint_isGeneric x).eq (genericPoint_spec _)
  rw [hη]
  exact Field.toIsField (Chow.pointClosureScheme x).functionField

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.G0Dev.cyclic_step
statement:
theorem cyclic_step {Q : X.Modules} [Q.IsQuasicoherent] (q : Chow.M7.D22.UnitM X ⟶ Q) [Epi q]
    {x : X} (hx : x ∈ moduleSheafSupport Q) :
    ∃ ψ : Q ⟶ pushUnit (Chow.pointClosureι x), x ∈ moduleSheafSupport (img ψ)
proof:
:=
  ⟨psi q hx, mem_support_img_psi q hx⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.nontrivial_sections_xiR
statement: theorem nontrivial_sections_xiR {V : X.Opens} {x : X} (hx : x ∈ V) : Nontrivial Γ(X, V)
proof:
:=
  RingHom.domain_nontrivial (X.presheaf.germ V x hx).hom

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.rank_eq_zero_of_isZero_xiR
statement:
theorem rank_eq_zero_of_isZero_xiR [Nonempty X] {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ}
    (hE : SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank X E r) (hz : Limits.IsZero E) : r = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x⟩ := ‹Nonempty X›
  obtain ⟨V, hx, -, ι, hι, s, hcard, hs⟩ := exists_isSecFrame hE (O := ⊤) (x := x) trivial
  haveI : Subsingleton Γ(E, V.1) := subsingleton_sections_of_isZero hz V.1
  haveI := nontrivial_sections_xiR hx
  by_contra hr
  obtain ⟨i⟩ : Nonempty ι := Fintype.card_pos_iff.1 (by omega)
  classical
  have h := (hs V.1 le_rfl).1 (Subsingleton.elim
    (Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, V.1) (secResXiR E le_rfl s) (Pi.single i 1))
    (Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, V.1) (secResXiR E le_rfl s) 0))
  have := congrFun h i
  simp at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.IsSecFrame.reindex
statement:
theorem IsSecFrame.reindex {L : X.Modules} {U : X.Opens} {ι κ : Type u} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    {s : ι → Γ(L, U)} (hs : IsSecFrame L U s) (e : κ ≃ ι) : IsSecFrame L U (s ∘ e)
proof:
:= by
  intro V h
  have : (Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, V) (secResXiR L h (s ∘ e)) : (κ → Γ(X, V)) → Γ(L, V)) =
      Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, V) (secResXiR L h s) ∘ (fun c => c ∘ e.symm) := by
    funext c
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, Fintype.linearCombination_apply, secResXiR]
    exact Fintype.sum_equiv e _ _ (fun k => by rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply])
  rw [this]
  exact (hs V h).comp (e.arrowCongr (Equiv.refl Γ(X, V))).bijective

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.isSecFrame_of_isEmpty
statement:
theorem isSecFrame_of_isEmpty {L : X.Modules} {U : X.Opens} {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] [IsEmpty ι]
    (hL : ∀ V, Subsingleton Γ(L, V)) (s : ι → Γ(L, U)) : IsSecFrame L U s
proof:
:= by
  intro V h
  haveI := hL V
  constructor
  · intro a b _
    exact Subsingleton.elim a b
  · intro y
    exact ⟨0, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.exists_secFramesXiR
statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.exists_secFramesXiR (C : RankedBundleComplex X) {O : X.Opens}
    {x : X} (hx : x ∈ O) :
    ∃ (V : X.affineOpens) (_ : x ∈ V.1) (_ : V.1 ≤ O)
      (s : ∀ j, ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j)) → Γ(C.K.E j, V.1)),
      ∀ j, IsSecFrame (C.K.E j) V.1 (s j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfr : ∀ j, ∃ (V : X.Opens) (_ : x ∈ V) (s : ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j)) → Γ(C.K.E j, V)),
      IsSecFrame (C.K.E j) V s := by
    intro j
    by_cases hj : j ≤ C.K.len
    · obtain ⟨V, hxV, -, ι, hι, s, hcard, hs⟩ := exists_isSecFrame (C.hrank j) (O := ⊤)
        (x := x) trivial
      have hc : Fintype.card ι = Fintype.card (ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j))) := by
        rw [hcard, Fintype.card_ulift, Fintype.card_fin]
        show C.rank j = if j ≤ C.K.len then C.rank j else 0
        rw [if_pos hj]
      exact ⟨V.1, hxV, s ∘ (Fintype.equivOfCardEq hc).symm, hs.reindex _⟩
    · haveI : IsEmpty (ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j))) :=
        ⟨fun a => by
          have h := a.down.2
          change a.down.1 < (if j ≤ C.K.len then C.rank j else 0) at h
          rw [if_neg hj] at h
          exact Nat.not_lt_zero _ h⟩
      exact ⟨⊤, trivial, fun a => isEmptyElim a, isSecFrame_of_isEmpty
        (fun V => subsingleton_sections_of_isZero (C.K.isZero_E j (not_le.1 hj)) V) _⟩
  choose Vj hxj s hs using hfr
  let O' : X.Opens := O ⊓ (Finset.range (C.K.len + 1)).inf Vj
  have hxO : x ∈ O' := ⟨hx, Finset.inf_induction (p := fun W : X.Opens => x ∈ W) trivial
      (fun a ha b hb => ⟨ha, hb⟩) fun j _ => hxj j⟩
  obtain ⟨V', hV', hxV', hV'O⟩ := (Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.1 X.isBasis_affineOpens) hxO
  let V : X.affineOpens := ⟨V', hV'⟩
  refine ⟨V, hxV', hV'O.trans inf_le_left, fun j => ?_, fun j => ?_⟩
  · by_cases hj : j ≤ C.K.len
    · exact secResXiR _ (hV'O.trans (inf_le_right.trans
        (Finset.inf_le (Finset.mem_range.2 (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hj))))) (s j)
    · exact fun a => 0
  · by_cases hj : j ≤ C.K.len
    · simp only [hj, dite_true]
      exact (hs j).mono _
    · simp only [hj, dite_false]
      haveI : IsEmpty (ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j))) :=
        ⟨fun a => by
          have h := a.down.2
          change a.down.1 < (if j ≤ C.K.len then C.rank j else 0) at h
          rw [if_neg hj] at h
          exact Nat.not_lt_zero _ h⟩
      exact isSecFrame_of_isEmpty
        (fun V => subsingleton_sections_of_isZero (C.K.isZero_E j (not_le.1 hj)) V) _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.frRank_eq_rank
statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.frRank_eq_rank [Nonempty X] (C : RankedBundleComplex X) (j : ℕ) :
    C.frRank j = C.rank j
proof:
:= by
  unfold RankedBundleComplex.frRank
  split_ifs with hj
  · rfl
  · exact (rank_eq_zero_of_isZero_xiR (C.hrank j) (C.K.isZero_E j (not_le.1 hj))).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.stalkHomXiR_res
statement:
theorem stalkHomXiR_res (b : W ⟶ X) {U U' : X.Opens} (h : U' ≤ U) {w : W} (hw : b w ∈ U')
    (a : Γ(X, U)) : stalkHomXiR b U' hw (rXiR h a) = stalkHomXiR b U (h hw) a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [stalkHomXiR, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, rXiR]
  have e : (b.app U').hom ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom a) =
      (W.presheaf.map (homOfLE (b.preimage_mono h)).op).hom ((b.app U).hom a) := by
    have := congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom a) (b.naturality (homOfLE h).op)
    exact this
  rw [e]
  exact W.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE (b.preimage_mono h)) w hw _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.ideal_map_stalk_basicOpen
statement:
theorem ideal_map_stalk_basicOpen (b : W ⟶ X) (I : X.IdealSheafData) (U : X.affineOpens)
    (h : Γ(X, U.1)) {w : W} (hw : b w ∈ X.basicOpen h) :
    (I.ideal (X.affineBasicOpen h)).map (stalkHomXiR b (X.basicOpen h) hw) =
      (I.ideal U).map (stalkHomXiR b U.1 (X.basicOpen_le h hw))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← I.map_ideal_basicOpen U h]
  erw [Ideal.map_map]
  congr 1
  ext a
  exact stalkHomXiR_res b (X.basicOpen_le h) hw a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.germ_app_congr_xiR
statement:
theorem germ_app_congr_xiR {S : Scheme.{u}} {f g : S ⟶ X} (hfg : f = g) (U : X.Opens) (q : S)
    (hf : f q ∈ U) (hg : g q ∈ U) (a : Γ(X, U)) :
    S.presheaf.germ (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) q hf (f.app U a) = S.presheaf.germ (g ⁻¹ᵁ U) q hg (g.app U a)
proof:
:= by
  subst hfg
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.germ_spec_fromSpec_xiR
statement:
theorem germ_spec_fromSpec_xiR (U : X.affineOpens) {R' : CommRingCat.{u}} (φ : Γ(X, U.1) ⟶ R')
    (q : Spec R') (hq : (Spec.map φ ≫ U.2.fromSpec) q ∈ U.1) (a : Γ(X, U.1)) :
    (Spec R').presheaf.germ ((Spec.map φ ≫ U.2.fromSpec) ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) q hq
        ((Spec.map φ ≫ U.2.fromSpec).app U.1 a) =
      (Spec R').presheaf.germ ⊤ q trivial ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R').inv.hom (φ.hom a))
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : (Spec.map φ ≫ U.2.fromSpec).app U.1 a =
      (Spec.map φ).app (U.2.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) (U.2.fromSpec.app U.1 a) := rfl
  rw [e1, IsAffineOpen.fromSpec_app_self_apply]
  have e2 := congrArg (fun ψ => ψ.hom ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U.1)).inv.hom a))
    ((Spec.map φ).naturality (eqToHom U.2.fromSpec_preimage_self).op)
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at e2
  erw [e2, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]
  have e3 := congrArg (fun ψ => ψ.hom a) (Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality φ)
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at e3
  rw [e3]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.stalk_principal_of_chart
statement:
theorem stalk_principal_of_chart [IsIntegral W] {R' : CommRingCat.{u}} (c : Spec R' ⟶ W)
    [IsOpenImmersion c] (b : W ⟶ X) (U : X.affineOpens) (φ : Γ(X, U.1) ⟶ R')
    (hcb : c ≫ b = Spec.map φ ≫ U.2.fromSpec) (J : Ideal Γ(X, U.1)) (e : R')
    (hJ : J.map φ.hom = Ideal.span {e}) (he : IsRegular e) (q : Spec R') (hU : b (c q) ∈ U.1) :
    ∃ g : W.presheaf.stalk (c q), g ≠ 0 ∧ J.map (stalkHomXiR b U.1 hU) = Ideal.span {g}
proof:
:= by
  have hq' : (Spec.map φ ≫ U.2.fromSpec) q ∈ U.1 := by
    rw [← hcb]
    exact hU
  have key : ∀ a, (c.stalkMap q).hom (stalkHomXiR b U.1 hU a) =
      (Spec R').presheaf.germ ⊤ q trivial ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R').inv.hom (φ.hom a)) := by
    intro a
    simp only [stalkHomXiR, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply]
    rw [Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply]
    have h1 : (Spec R').presheaf.germ (c ⁻¹ᵁ (b ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)) q hU (c.app (b ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) (b.app U.1 a)) =
        (Spec R').presheaf.germ ((c ≫ b) ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) q hU ((c ≫ b).app U.1 a) := rfl
    rw [h1, germ_app_congr_xiR hcb U.1 q hU hq' a]
    exact germ_spec_fromSpec_xiR U φ q hq' a
  let θ : R' →+* (Spec R').presheaf.stalk q :=
    ((Spec R').presheaf.germ ⊤ q trivial).hom.comp (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R').inv.hom
  have hσ : (c.stalkMap q).hom.comp (stalkHomXiR b U.1 hU) = θ.comp φ.hom := RingHom.ext key
  have hinv : (inv (c.stalkMap q)).hom.comp (c.stalkMap q).hom = RingHom.id _ := by
    rw [← CommRingCat.hom_comp, IsIso.hom_inv_id]
    rfl
  have hmap : J.map (stalkHomXiR b U.1 hU) = (J.map (θ.comp φ.hom)).map (inv (c.stalkMap q)).hom := by
    rw [← hσ, Ideal.map_map, ← RingHom.comp_assoc, hinv, RingHom.id_comp]
  rw [hmap, ← Ideal.map_map, hJ, Ideal.map_span, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton,
    Set.image_singleton]
  refine ⟨(inv (c.stalkMap q)).hom (θ e), ?_, rfl⟩
  haveI : Nonempty (Spec R') := ⟨q⟩
  haveI : IsIntegral (Spec R') := isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion c
  haveI : Nontrivial R' := RingHom.domain_nontrivial θ
  have hθ : Function.Injective θ :=
    (germ_injective_of_isIntegral (Spec R') (U := ⊤) q trivial).comp
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R').commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.symm.injective
  have hinvinj : Function.Injective (inv (c.stalkMap q)).hom :=
    (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (inv (c.stalkMap q))).1
  intro h0
  apply he.ne_zero
  apply hθ
  apply hinvinj
  rw [h0, map_zero, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.exists_stalk_principal_blowup
statement:
theorem exists_stalk_principal_blowup (I : X.IdealSheafData) [IsIntegral (blowup X I)]
    (w : blowup X I) :
    ∃ (U : X.affineOpens) (hU : toBase X I w ∈ U.1) (g : (blowup X I).presheaf.stalk w),
      g ≠ 0 ∧ (I.ideal U).map (stalkHomXiR (toBase X I) U.1 hU) = Ideal.span {g}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, r, q, rfl⟩ := exists_mem_range_chartι X I w
  have hcb := chartι_toBase X I U r
  have hU : toBase X I (chartι X I U r q) ∈ U.1 := by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hcb, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    have : U.2.fromSpec (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (baseRingHom (I.ideal U) r)) q) ∈
      U.2.fromSpec.opensRange := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rwa [U.2.opensRange_fromSpec] at this
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgJ⟩ := stalk_principal_of_chart (chartι X I U r) (toBase X I) U _ hcb
    (I.ideal U) (equation X I U r) (map_baseRingHom_eq X I U r) (equation_isRegular X I U r) q hU
  exact ⟨U, hU, g, hg, hgJ⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.frXiR_single
statement:
theorem frXiR_single (j : ℕ) (c : ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j))) :
    frXiR C V s hs j (Pi.single c 1) = s j c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, V.1) (secResXiR _ le_rfl (s j)) (Pi.single c 1) = s j c
  rw [Fintype.linearCombination_apply_single, one_smul]
  exact congrFun (secResXiR_self _ (s j)) c

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.frameMat_relation_xiR
statement:
theorem frameMat_relation_xiR (j : ℕ) (c : ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank (j + 1)))) :
    (C.K.d j).app V.1 (s (j + 1) c) =
      Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, V.1) (s j) (fun k => frameMat C V (frXiR C V s hs) j k c)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h := congrArg (fun φ => φ (Pi.single c 1)) (frameMat_mulVecLin C V (frXiR C V s hs) j)
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, Matrix.mulVecLin_apply,
    Matrix.mulVec_single_one] at h
  rw [frXiR_single] at h
  have h2 := congrArg (frXiR C V s hs j) h
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h2
  calc (C.K.d j).app V.1 (s (j + 1) c) = sectionMap (C.K.d j) V.1 (s (j + 1) c) := rfl
    _ = frXiR C V s hs j ((frameMat C V (frXiR C V s hs) j).col c) := h2.symm
    _ = _ := by
      change Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, V.1) (secResXiR _ le_rfl (s j)) _ = _
      rw [secResXiR_self]
      rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.exists_tgtFrame_xiR
statement:
theorem exists_tgtFrame_xiR (j : ℕ) :
    ∃ sQ : mRowXSP C.frRank j → Γ(C.tgt j, V.1), IsSecFrame (C.tgt j) V.1 sQ ∧
      ∀ c, (C.dj j).app V.1 (s j c) = Fintype.linearCombination Γ(X, V.1) sQ
        (fun k => (frameDataOfFrames C V (frXiR C V s hs)).D j k c)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases j with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨fun k => (k : PEmpty).elim, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact isSecFrame_of_isEmpty
        (fun W => subsingleton_sections_of_isZero
          (show Limits.IsZero (C.tgt 0) from Limits.isZero_zero _) W) _
    · intro c
      exact Subsingleton.elim (h := subsingleton_sections_of_isZero
        (show Limits.IsZero (C.tgt 0) from Limits.isZero_zero _) V.1) _ _
  | succ i =>
    exact ⟨s i, hs i, fun c => frameMat_relation_xiR C V s hs i c⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.graphIdeal_eq_frames
statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.graphIdeal_eq_frames (C : RankedBundleComplex M)
    (U' : (B0 (k := k) M).affineOpens) (V : M.affineOpens) (Wp : (P1 k).affineOpens)
    (hV : U'.1 ≤ pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)
    (hW : U'.1 ≤ pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ Wp.1)
    (μ l : Γ(B0 (k := k) M, U'.1))
    (hl : ((zeroIdeal k).ideal Wp).map
      ((pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE Wp.1 U'.1 hW).hom = Ideal.span {l})
    (hμ : ((infIdeal k).ideal Wp).map
      ((pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE Wp.1 U'.1 hW).hom = Ideal.span {μ})
    (s : ∀ j, ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j)) → Γ(C.K.E j, V.1))
    (hs : ∀ j, IsSecFrame (C.K.E j) V.1 (s j)) :
    (graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex).ideal U' =
      ∏ j ∈ Finset.range (C.K.len + 1), GraphBundles.graphFormula μ l
        (((frameDataOfFrames C V (frXiR C V s hs)).D j).map
          ((pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE V.1 U'.1 hV).hom)
proof:
:= by
  refine graphIdeal_ideal_eq_prod_graphFormula C.toDetIdealComplex U' V Wp hV hW μ l hl hμ
    (m := mRowXSP C.frRank) (n := fun j => ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j))) _ ?_ ?_
  · intro j
    simp only [Fintype.card_ulift, Fintype.card_fin, RankedBundleComplex.toDetIdealComplex_rank]
    exact C.frRank_eq_rank j
  · intro j r _
    rw [RankedBundleComplex.toDetIdealComplex_detIdeal,
      (frameDataOfFrames C V (frXiR C V s hs)).detIdeal_ideal_eq, GraphBundles.minorsIdeal_map]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.comp_appLE_germ_xiR
statement:
theorem comp_appLE_germ_xiR {W B Z : Scheme.{u}} (b : W ⟶ B) (q : B ⟶ Z) (U' : B.Opens)
    (O : Z.Opens) (hO : U' ≤ q ⁻¹ᵁ O) {w : W} (hwU' : b w ∈ U') (e : b ⁻¹ᵁ U' ≤ (b ≫ q) ⁻¹ᵁ O)
    (a : Γ(Z, O)) :
    germXiR (show w ∈ b ⁻¹ᵁ U' from hwU') ((b ≫ q).appLE O _ e a) =
      stalkHomXiR b U' hwU' ((q.appLE O U' hO) a)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE b q O U' (b ⁻¹ᵁ U') hO le_rfl
  have h2 := congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom a) h
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at h2
  simp only [stalkHomXiR, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, germXiR]
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app, h2]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.xiProj_appLE_germ
statement:
theorem xiProj_appLE_germ (C : RankedBundleComplex M) (U' : (B0 (k := k) M).affineOpens)
    (V : M.affineOpens) (hV : U'.1 ≤ pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)
    {w : C.graphModel (k := k)} (hwU' : graphToBase (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex w ∈ U'.1)
    (hT₀ : graphToBase (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 ≤ xiProj (k := k) C ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)
    (a : Γ(M, V.1)) :
    germXiR (show w ∈ graphToBase (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 from hwU')
        ((xiProj (k := k) C).appLE V.1 _ hT₀ a) =
      stalkHomXiR (graphToBase (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) U'.1 hwU'
        (((pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE V.1 U'.1 hV) a)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE (graphToBase (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex)
    (pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)) V.1 U'.1
    (graphToBase (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1) hV le_rfl
  have h2 := congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom a) h
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at h2
  simp only [stalkHomXiR, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, germXiR]
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app]
  rw [h2]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.exists_xiChart_of_data
statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.exists_xiChart_of_data (C : RankedBundleComplex M)
    [IsIntegral (C.graphModel (k := k))] (j : ℕ) (w : C.graphModel (k := k))
    (U' : (B0 (k := k) M).affineOpens) (hwU' : graphToBase (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex w ∈ U'.1)
    (V : M.affineOpens) (hV : U'.1 ≤ pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)
    (s : ∀ j, ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j)) → Γ(C.K.E j, V.1))
    (hs : ∀ j, IsSecFrame (C.K.E j) V.1 (s j))
    (Wp : (P1 k).affineOpens) (hW : U'.1 ≤ pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ Wp.1)
    (μB lB : Γ(B0 (k := k) M, U'.1))
    (hl : ((zeroIdeal k).ideal Wp).map
      ((pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE Wp.1 U'.1 hW).hom = Ideal.span {lB})
    (hμ : ((infIdeal k).ideal Wp).map
      ((pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE Wp.1 U'.1 hW).hom = Ideal.span {μB})
    (g : (C.graphModel (k := k)).presheaf.stalk w) (hg : g ≠ 0)
    (hgJ : ((graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex).ideal U').map
      (stalkHomXiR (graphToBase (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) U'.1 hwU') = Ideal.span {g})
    (μT lT : Γ(C.graphModel (k := k), graphToBase (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1))
    (hμT : μT ≠ 0)
    (ht : rXiR (inf_le_right : graphToBase (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 ⊓ xiOpen C ≤
        xiOpen C) (xiCoord C) * rXiR inf_le_left μT = rXiR inf_le_left lT)
    (hcμ : germXiR (show w ∈ graphToBase (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 from hwU') μT =
      stalkHomXiR (graphToBase (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) U'.1 hwU' μB)
    (hcl : germXiR (show w ∈ graphToBase (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 from hwU') lT =
      stalkHomXiR (graphToBase (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) U'.1 hwU' lB) :
    ∃ c : XiChart ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).map (C.dj j)) (xiOpen C)
      (xiCoord C) w, Fintype.card c.n = C.rank j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b := graphToBase (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex
  let π := xiProj (k := k) C
  let T₀ : (C.graphModel (k := k)).Opens := b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1
  have hw₀ : w ∈ T₀ := hwU'
  have hT₀ : T₀ ≤ π ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 := fun z hz => hV hz
  let F := frameDataOfFrames C V (frXiR C V s hs)
  let ψ := ((pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE V.1 U'.1 hV).hom
  let f := stalkHomXiR b U'.1 hwU'
  obtain ⟨sQ, hsQ, hrel⟩ := exists_tgtFrame_xiR C V s hs j
  let DT : Matrix (mRowXSP C.frRank j) (ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j))) Γ(C.graphModel (k := k), T₀) :=
    (F.D j).map (π.appLE V.1 T₀ hT₀).hom
  have hDT : DT.map (germXiR hw₀) = ((F.D j).map ψ).map f := by
    ext a c
    exact xiProj_appLE_germ C U' V hV hwU' hT₀ (F.D j a c)
  have hstalk : ∃ (S₀ : ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j)) → ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j)) ⊕ mRowXSP C.frRank j)
      (Bw : Matrix (ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j)) ⊕ mRowXSP C.frRank j) (ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j)))
        ((C.graphModel (k := k)).presheaf.stalk w)),
      IsGraphSat (germXiR hw₀ μT) (germXiR hw₀ lT) (DT.map (germXiR hw₀)) S₀ Bw := by
    have e1 : germXiR hw₀ μT = f μB := hcμ
    have e2 : germXiR hw₀ lT = f lB := hcl
    rw [hDT, e1, e2]
    by_cases hj : j ≤ C.K.len
    · have hJ' : (∏ i ∈ Finset.range (C.K.len + 1),
          GraphBundles.graphFormula μB lB ((F.D i).map ψ)).map f = Ideal.span {g} := by
        rw [← C.graphIdeal_eq_frames U' V Wp hV hW μB lB hl hμ s hs]
        exact hgJ
      obtain ⟨S₀, Bw, hΔ, hS⟩ := GraphBundles.exists_satSummand_graphMat_of_map f
        (Finset.range (C.K.len + 1)) μB lB (fun i => (F.D i).map ψ) hJ'
        (IsSMulRegular.of_ne_zero hg) (Finset.mem_range.2 (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hj))
      rw [GraphBundles.graphMat_map] at hS hΔ
      exact ⟨S₀, Bw, IsGraphSat.of_isSatSummand hΔ hS⟩
    · haveI : IsEmpty (ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j))) :=
        ⟨fun a => by
          have h := a.down.2
          change a.down.1 < (if j ≤ C.K.len then C.rank j else 0) at h
          rw [if_neg hj] at h
          exact Nat.not_lt_zero _ h⟩
      refine ⟨fun a => isEmptyElim a, 0, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩ <;> ext a b <;> exact isEmptyElim b
  obtain ⟨S₀, Bw, hBw⟩ := hstalk
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hwT, B, hB⟩ := exists_isGraphSat_of_stalk hw₀ μT lT DT S₀ Bw hBw
  have hT0' : T ≤ π ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 := hT.trans hT₀
  refine ⟨{
      T := T
      mem := hwT
      n := ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j))
      m := mRowXSP C.frRank j
      sP := secResXiR _ hT0' (pullSecXiR π (C.K.E j) V.1 (s j))
      hP := (isSecFrame_pullback π (C.K.E j) V.1 (hs j)).mono hT0'
      sQ := secResXiR _ hT0' (pullSecXiR π (C.tgt j) V.1 sQ)
      hQ := (isSecFrame_pullback π (C.tgt j) V.1 hsQ).mono hT0'
      D := DT.map (rXiR hT)
      hD := ?_
      μ := rXiR hT μT
      l := rXiR hT lT
      hμ := ?_
      ht := ?_
      S₀ := S₀
      B := B
      hB := hB }, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    simp only [secResXiR]
    rw [app_res_xiR, pullback_app_pullSecXiR π (C.K.E j) V.1 (C.dj j) (s j) sQ (F.D j) (hrel) i,
      Fintype.linearCombination_apply, Fintype.linearCombination_apply, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    rw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul]
    congr 1
    change rXiR hT0' ((π.app V.1).hom (F.D j k i)) = rXiR hT (rXiR hT₀ ((π.app V.1).hom (F.D j k i)))
    rw [rXiR_rXiR]
  · intro h0
    apply hμT
    haveI : Nonempty T := ⟨⟨w, hwT⟩⟩
    apply map_injective_of_isIntegral _ (homOfLE hT)
    exact h0.trans (map_zero _).symm
  · have := congrArg (rXiR (inf_le_inf_right (xiOpen C) hT : T ⊓ xiOpen C ≤ T₀ ⊓ xiOpen C)) ht
    simp only [map_mul, rXiR_rXiR] at this
    simp only [rXiR_rXiR]
    exact this
  · change Fintype.card (ULift.{u} (Fin (C.frRank j))) = C.rank j
    rw [Fintype.card_ulift, Fintype.card_fin, C.frRank_eq_rank]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.GraphModel.RankedBundleComplex.exists_xiChart
statement:
theorem RankedBundleComplex.exists_xiChart (C : RankedBundleComplex M)
    [IsIntegral (C.graphModel (k := k))] (j : ℕ) (w : C.graphModel (k := k)) :
    ∃ c : XiChart ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).map (C.dj j)) (xiOpen C)
      (xiCoord C) w, Fintype.card c.n = C.rank j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b := graphToBase (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex
  obtain ⟨U₀, hwU₀, g, hg0, hgJ⟩ :=
    exists_stalk_principal_blowup (graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) w
  obtain ⟨V, hxV, -, s, hs⟩ := C.exists_secFramesXiR (O := ⊤)
    (x := pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) (b w)) trivial
  have hp : pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) (b w) ∈ (chartOpen k 0).1 ⊔ (chartOpen k 1).1 := by
    rw [chartOpen_sup_eq_top]; trivial
  
  have hbasic : ∀ (c : Fin 2), pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) (b w) ∈ (chartOpen k c).1 →
      ∃ h : Γ(B0 (k := k) M, U₀.1), (B0 (k := k) M).basicOpen h ≤
        pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 ⊓
          pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k c).1 ∧
        b w ∈ (B0 (k := k) M).basicOpen h := by
    intro c hc
    exact U₀.2.exists_basicOpen_le (V := pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 ⊓
      pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k c).1) ⟨b w, ⟨hxV, hc⟩⟩ hwU₀
  rcases TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_sup.mp hp with hp0 | hp1
  · obtain ⟨h, hhO, hwh⟩ := hbasic 0 hp0
    let U' := (B0 (k := k) M).affineBasicOpen h
    have hV : U'.1 ≤ pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 := fun z hz => (hhO hz).1
    have hW : U'.1 ≤ pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 0).1 :=
      fun z hz => (hhO hz).2
    have hwU' : b w ∈ U'.1 := hwh
    have hgJ' : ((graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex).ideal U').map
        (stalkHomXiR b U'.1 hwU') = Ideal.span {g} :=
      (ideal_map_stalk_basicOpen b _ U₀ h hwh).trans hgJ
    let gP := b ≫ pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)
    have hT₀ : b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 ≤ gP ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 0).1 := fun z hz => hW hz
    let sT := (gP.appLE (chartOpen k 0).1 _ hT₀).hom (secEquiv k 0 Polynomial.X)
    have hov : b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 ⊓ xiOpen C ≤ gP ⁻¹ᵁ overlapOpen k := fun z hz => ⟨hT₀ hz.1, hz.2⟩
    have ht : rXiR (inf_le_right : b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 ⊓ xiOpen C ≤ xiOpen C) (xiCoord C) *
        rXiR (inf_le_left : b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 ⊓ xiOpen C ≤ b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1) sT =
        rXiR (inf_le_left : b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 ⊓ xiOpen C ≤ b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1) 1 := by
      have key := congrArg (gP.appLE (overlapOpen k) _ hov).hom (sP1_mul_tP1 k)
      rw [map_mul, map_one] at key
      rw [map_one, ← key, mul_comm]
      congr 1
      · have e := congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom (sP1 k))
          (Scheme.Hom.map_appLE gP hov (homOfLE (inf_le_left : overlapOpen k ≤ (chartOpen k 0).1)).op)
        simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at e
        rw [e]
        have e2 := congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom (sP1 k))
          (Scheme.Hom.appLE_map gP hT₀ (homOfLE (inf_le_left : b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 ⊓ xiOpen C ≤ b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1)).op)
        simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at e2
        exact e2
      · have e := congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom (tP1 k))
          (Scheme.Hom.map_appLE gP hov (homOfLE (inf_le_right : overlapOpen k ≤ (chartOpen k 1).1)).op)
        simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at e
        rw [e]
        have e2 := congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom (tP1 k))
          (Scheme.Hom.appLE_map gP (le_refl (gP ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 1).1))
            (homOfLE (inf_le_right : b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 ⊓ xiOpen C ≤ xiOpen C)).op)
        simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at e2
        rw [← e2, ← Scheme.Hom.app_eq_appLE]
        rfl
    have hne : ((b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 ⊓ xiOpen C : (C.graphModel (k := k)).Opens) :
        Set (C.graphModel (k := k))).Nonempty :=
      nonempty_preirreducible_inter (b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1).isOpen (xiOpen C).isOpen ⟨w, hwU'⟩
        (xiOpen_nonempty C)
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hne
    haveI := nontrivial_sections_xiR hz
    have hμT : sT ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have := ht
      rw [h0, map_zero, mul_zero, map_one] at this
      exact zero_ne_one this
    refine C.exists_xiChart_of_data j w U' hwU' V hV s hs (chartOpen k 0) hW
      (((pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE _ U'.1 hW).hom (secEquiv k 0 Polynomial.X)) 1
      (zeroIdeal_map_chartZero U' hW) (infIdeal_map_chartZero U' hW) g hg0 hgJ' sT 1 hμT ht ?_ ?_
    · exact comp_appLE_germ_xiR b (pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)) U'.1 (chartOpen k 0).1 hW
        hwU' hT₀ _
    · rw [map_one, map_one]
  · obtain ⟨h, hhO, hwh⟩ := hbasic 1 hp1
    let U' := (B0 (k := k) M).affineBasicOpen h
    have hV : U'.1 ≤ pullback.fst (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 := fun z hz => (hhO hz).1
    have hW : U'.1 ≤ pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k 1).1 :=
      fun z hz => (hhO hz).2
    have hwU' : b w ∈ U'.1 := hwh
    have hgJ' : ((graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex).ideal U').map
        (stalkHomXiR b U'.1 hwU') = Ideal.span {g} :=
      (ideal_map_stalk_basicOpen b _ U₀ h hwh).trans hgJ
    have hT₀ : b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 ≤ xiOpen C := fun z hz => hW hz
    haveI := nontrivial_sections_xiR (show w ∈ b ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1 from hwU')
    refine C.exists_xiChart_of_data j w U' hwU' V hV s hs (chartOpen k 1) hW 1
      (((pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)).appLE _ U'.1 hW).hom (secEquiv k 1 Polynomial.X))
      (zeroIdeal_map_chartOne U' hW) (infIdeal_map_chartOne U' hW) g hg0 hgJ' 1
      (rXiR hT₀ (xiCoord C)) one_ne_zero ?_ ?_ ?_
    · rw [map_one, mul_one, rXiR_rXiR]
    · rw [map_one, map_one]
    · exact comp_appLE_germ_xiR b (pullback.snd (M ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)) U'.1 (chartOpen k 1).1 hW
        hwU' hT₀ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.tauStd_twistTtw_line_of
statement:
theorem tauStd_twistTtw_line_of (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U)
    (hC' : (C.twistTtw A hA).SectionExactOn U) {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    tauStd hMK (C.twistTtw A hA) ι U hC' hM =
      chK k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj A) (tauStd hMK C ι U hC hM)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : tauStd hMK (C.twistTtw A hA) ι U hC' hM =
      tauGenStd (k := k) hMK ι C.toDetIdealComplex
        (xiStd (k := k) hMK C.toDetIdealComplex (C.twistTtw A hA).dj (xiOpen_nonempty C))
        C.K.len U (C.isSplitOn_of_sectionExactOn U hC) hM :=
    (tauStd_eq_tauGenStd (k := k) hMK ι (C.twistTtw A hA) U hC' hM).trans
      (tauGenStd_xiStd_congr (k := k) hMK ι
        (toDetIdealComplex_twistTtw C A hA (minorsTwistInvariant_of_line hA)) _ _ _ _ U _ _ hM)
  rw [h1]
  letI := prodP1Over (k := k) (A := M)
  letI := blowupOver (k := k) (graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := prodP1_lft (k := k) (A := M)
  haveI := prodP1_isNoetherian (k := k) (A := M)
  haveI := blowup_locallyOfFiniteType
    (CIICLASS.projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod hMK 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
    (graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) (graphIdeal_ne_bot C.toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := blowup_isNoetherian
    (CIICLASS.projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod hMK 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
    (graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) (graphIdeal_ne_bot C.toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := C.isIntegral_graphModel (k := k) hMK
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (C.graphModel (k := k))) :=
    ⟨projK_of_projectiveIntegralK (projectiveIntegralK_graphModel hMK C.toDetIdealComplex)⟩
  haveI hπ : (xiProj (k := k) C).IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨Category.assoc _ _ _⟩
  haveI : (projD (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex).IsOver (Spk k) := hπ
  have h2 : tauGenStd (k := k) hMK ι C.toDetIdealComplex
        (xiStd (k := k) hMK C.toDetIdealComplex (C.twistTtw A hA).dj (xiOpen_nonempty C))
        C.K.len U (C.isSplitOn_of_sectionExactOn U hC) hM =
      tauGen (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex ι
        (xiD (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex (C.twistTtw A hA).dj (xiOpen_nonempty C))
        C.K.len U (C.isSplitOn_of_sectionExactOn U hC) hM :=
    rfl
  have h3 := tauGen_congr_iso (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex ι
    (fun j ↦ (xiTwistIsoLF (k := k) C A hA (graphSheafTwistLF_of_line hA) C.toDetIdealComplex
      (xiOpen_nonempty C) j).some)
    C.K.len U (C.isSplitOn_of_sectionExactOn U hC) hM
  have h4 := (tauRawTw_eq_tauGen (k := k) C ι A U hC hM).symm
  have h6 : tauStd hMK C ι U hC hM = tauRaw (k := k) C ι U hC hM := rfl
  rw [h2, h3]
  refine h4.trans ?_
  rw [tauRawTw_eq (k := k) C ι A hA U hC hM, h6]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.push_tauStd_twistTtw_line_of
statement:
theorem push_tauStd_twistTtw_line_of (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U)
    (hC' : (C.twistTtw A hA).SectionExactOn U) (hX : ∀ x : M, x ∉ U → x ∈ Set.range ι) {n : ℕ}
    (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    totalPushOn (opsK k) ι (tauStd hMK (C.twistTtw A hA) ι U hC' hM) =
      chK k A (chK0T2 k C.K.altSum (primeClassT2 (genericPoint M) n hM))
proof:
:= by
  rw [tauStd_twistTtw_line_of (k := k) hMK C A hA ι U hC hC' hM, chK_push ι A hA,
    push_tauStd (k := k) hMK C ι U hC hX hM]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwistSheaf.push_tauStd_twistTtw_line

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ReesAddP1.famSecAt_ne_famSecInf
statement: theorem famSecAt_ne_famSecInf (c : k) (x y : M) : famSecAt k M c x ≠ famSecInf k M y
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h1 : famP2 k M (famSecAt k M c x) ∈ Set.range (DeformationSpace.pointAt k c) := by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, famSec_p2, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have h2 : famP2 k M (famSecInf k M y) ∈ Set.range (ProjectiveLine.pointInf k) := by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, famSec_p2, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [h] at h1
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (G2XS.disjoint_pointAt_pointInf k c) h1 h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.ReesAddP1.height_famT
statement:
theorem height_famT [IsIntegral (famT k M)] {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    height (genericPoint (famT k M)) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  have hL := KDGb.hasConstantRank_pullback_one (RegDeform.p1Line_rank k 0) (famP2 k M)
  have hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf (KDGb.pullbackSec (famP2 k M) (RegDeform.p1σc k 0)) =
      (famSecAt k M 0).ker := by
    rw [KDGb.sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_pullbackSec (RegDeform.p1Line_rank k 0),
      RegDeform.p1σc_ker, famSec_ker_eq k _ _ inferInstance]
  have hne : famSecAt k M 0 (genericPoint M) ≠ genericPoint (famT k M) := by
    intro h
    have hsurj : Function.Surjective (famSecAt k M 0) := by
      intro x
      have hx : x ∈ closure ({genericPoint (famT k M)} : Set (famT k M)) := by
        rw [(genericPoint_spec (famT k M)).def]; trivial
      have hcl := (famSecAt k M 0).isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range
      exact closure_minimal (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr
        (show genericPoint (famT k M) ∈ Set.range (famSecAt k M 0) from ⟨_, h⟩)) hcl hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hsurj (famSecInf k M (genericPoint M))
    exact famSecAt_ne_famSecInf k 0 y (genericPoint M) hy
  have h := FRI.height_generic_eq_succ k hL _ (famSecAt k M 0) hid hne
  rw [h, hM]
  push_cast
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwist.tauGen_congr_iso
statement:
theorem tauGen_congr_iso {F G : ℕ → (graphModel (k := k) D).Modules} (e : ∀ j, F j ≅ G j)
    (len : ℕ) (U : M.Opens) (hS : IsSplitOn D U) {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    tauGen (k := k) D ι F len U hS hM = tauGen (k := k) D ι G len U hS hM
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty (WXD (k := k) D ι) with hE | hE
  · unfold tauGen
    rw [totalChow_eq_zero_of_isEmpty (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ _ n _), map_zero, map_zero, map_zero,
      map_zero]
  have h : altCh k (fun j ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (jXD (k := k) D ι)).obj (F j)) len =
      altCh k (fun j ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (jXD (k := k) D ι)).obj (G j)) len := by
    unfold altCh
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
    exact congrArg (fun T ↦ ((-1 : ℤ) ^ j) • T)
      (GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4A.chTot_iso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (jXD (k := k) D ι)).mapIso (e j)))
  unfold tauGen
  rw [h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwist.tauRaw_eq_tauGen

theorem tauRaw_eq_tauGen (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) {n : ℕ}

      haveI : (projD (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex).IsOver (Spk k)
proof:
:= hπ
      tauGen (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex ι (fun j ↦ C.xi (k := k) j) C.K.len U
        (C.isSplitOn_of_sectionExactOn U hC) hM :=
  rfl

      haveI : (projD (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex).IsOver (Spk k)
proof:

          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).obj A))
