name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwist.tauGenStd_xiStd_congr
statement:
theorem tauGenStd_xiStd_congr {D₁ D₂ : DetIdealComplex M} (h : D₁ = D₂) {E' T' : ℕ → M.Modules}
    (dj : ∀ j, E' j ⟶ T' j)
    (hne₁ : ((xiOpenD (k := k) D₁ : (graphModel (k := k) D₁).Opens) :
      Set (graphModel (k := k) D₁)).Nonempty)
    (hne₂ : ((xiOpenD (k := k) D₂ : (graphModel (k := k) D₂).Opens) :
      Set (graphModel (k := k) D₂)).Nonempty)
    (len : ℕ) (U : M.Opens) (hS₁ : IsSplitOn D₁ U) (hS₂ : IsSplitOn D₂ U) {n : ℕ}
    (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    tauGenStd (k := k) hMK ι D₁ (xiStd (k := k) hMK D₁ dj hne₁) len U hS₁ hM =
      tauGenStd (k := k) hMK ι D₂ (xiStd (k := k) hMK D₂ dj hne₂) len U hS₂ hM
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwist.dj_twistTtw_comm
statement:
theorem dj_twistTtw_comm (j : ℕ) :
    ∃ eF : (C.twistTtw A hA).tgt j ≅ tensorSheaf M (C.tgt j) A,
      (C.twistTtw A hA).dj j ≫ eF.hom = (Iso.refl _).hom ≫ tensorSheafMap M (C.dj j) (𝟙 A)
proof:
:= by
  cases j with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨zeroTwistIso A, ?_⟩
    exact ((ProjectionFormula.tensorRight M A).map_isZero (isZero_zero _)).eq_of_tgt _ _
  | succ j =>
    refine ⟨Iso.refl _, ?_⟩
    change tensorSheafMap M (C.K.d j) (𝟙 A) ≫ 𝟙 _ = 𝟙 _ ≫ tensorSheafMap M (C.K.d j) (𝟙 A)
    rw [Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwist.xiTwistIso
statement:
theorem xiTwistIso (hξ : GraphSheafTwist M A) (D : DetIdealComplex M)
    [IrreducibleSpace (graphModel (k := k) D)]
    (hne : ((xiOpenD (k := k) D : (graphModel (k := k) D).Opens) :
      Set (graphModel (k := k) D)).Nonempty) (j : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (xiD (k := k) D (C.twistTtw A hA).dj hne j ≅
      tensorSheaf _ (xiD (k := k) D C.dj hne j)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (projD (k := k) D)).obj A))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨eF, h⟩ := dj_twistTtw_comm C A hA j
  exact hξ (graphModel (k := k) D) (projD (k := k) D) (xiOpenD (k := k) D) (xiCoordD (k := k) D)
    hne (C.dj j) ((C.twistTtw A hA).dj j) (Iso.refl _) eF h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwist.tauStd_twistTtw
statement:
theorem tauStd_twistTtw (hmin : MinorsTwistInvariant M A) (hξ : GraphSheafTwist M A)
    (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) (hC' : (C.twistTtw A hA).SectionExactOn U) {n : ℕ}
    (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    tauStd hMK (C.twistTtw A hA) ι U hC' hM =
      chK k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj A) (tauStd hMK C ι U hC hM)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : tauStd hMK (C.twistTtw A hA) ι U hC' hM =
      tauGenStd (k := k) hMK ι C.toDetIdealComplex
        (xiStd (k := k) hMK C.toDetIdealComplex (C.twistTtw A hA).dj (xiOpen_nonempty C))
        C.K.len U (C.isSplitOn_of_sectionExactOn U hC) hM :=
    (tauStd_eq_tauGenStd (k := k) hMK ι (C.twistTtw A hA) U hC' hM).trans
      (tauGenStd_xiStd_congr (k := k) hMK ι (toDetIdealComplex_twistTtw C A hA hmin) _ _ _ _ U
        _ _ hM)
  rw [h1]
  letI := prodP1Over (k := k) (A := M)
  letI := blowupOver (k := k) (graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := prodP1_lft (k := k) (A := M)
  haveI := prodP1_isNoetherian (k := k) (A := M)
  haveI := blowup_locallyOfFiniteType
    (CIICLASS.projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod hMK 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
    (graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) (graphIdeal_ne_bot C.toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := blowup_isNoetherian
    (CIICLASS.projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod hMK 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
    (graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) (graphIdeal_ne_bot C.toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := C.isIntegral_graphModel (k := k) hMK
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (C.graphModel (k := k))) :=
    ⟨projK_of_projectiveIntegralK (projectiveIntegralK_graphModel hMK C.toDetIdealComplex)⟩
  haveI hπ : (xiProj (k := k) C).IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨Category.assoc _ _ _⟩
  haveI : (projD (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex).IsOver (Spk k) := hπ
  have h2 : tauGenStd (k := k) hMK ι C.toDetIdealComplex
        (xiStd (k := k) hMK C.toDetIdealComplex (C.twistTtw A hA).dj (xiOpen_nonempty C))
        C.K.len U (C.isSplitOn_of_sectionExactOn U hC) hM =
      tauGen (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex ι
        (xiD (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex (C.twistTtw A hA).dj (xiOpen_nonempty C))
        C.K.len U (C.isSplitOn_of_sectionExactOn U hC) hM :=
    rfl
  have h3 := tauGen_congr_iso (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex ι
    (fun j ↦ (xiTwistIso (k := k) C A hA hξ C.toDetIdealComplex (xiOpen_nonempty C) j).some)
    C.K.len U (C.isSplitOn_of_sectionExactOn U hC) hM
  have h4 := (tauRawTw_eq_tauGen (k := k) C ι A U hC hM).symm
  have h6 : tauStd hMK C ι U hC hM = tauRaw (k := k) C ι U hC hM := rfl
  rw [h2, h3]
  refine h4.trans ?_
  rw [tauRawTw_eq (k := k) C ι A hA U hC hM, h6]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLiftTwist.push_tauStd_twistTtw
statement:
theorem push_tauStd_twistTtw (hmin : MinorsTwistInvariant M A) (hξ : GraphSheafTwist M A)
    (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) (hC' : (C.twistTtw A hA).SectionExactOn U)
    (hX : ∀ x : M, x ∉ U → x ∈ Set.range ι) {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    totalPushOn (opsK k) ι (tauStd hMK (C.twistTtw A hA) ι U hC' hM) =
      chK k A (chK0T2 k C.K.altSum (primeClassT2 (genericPoint M) n hM))
proof:
:= by
  rw [tauStd_twistTtw (k := k) hMK C A hA ι hmin hξ U hC hC' hM, chK_push ι A hA,
    push_tauStd (k := k) hMK C ι U hC hX hM]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.totalChow_eq_zero_of_isEmpty
statement: theorem totalChow_eq_zero_of_isEmpty {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsEmpty X] (x : TotalChow X) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => rfl
  | of n y =>
    induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => exact map_zero _
    | tmul a z =>
      induction z using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
      | H D =>
        have hD : D = 0 := Subtype.ext (by ext x; exact isEmptyElim x)
        rw [hD, QuotientAddGroup.mk_zero, TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero]
    | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, ha, hb, add_zero]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [hx, hy, add_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.degPres_opsK
statement:
theorem degPres_opsK {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [Y.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X]
    [IsNoetherian Y] [Fact (ProjK k X)] [Fact (ProjK k Y)] (g : X ⟶ Y) [g.IsOver (Spk k)]
    [IsProper g] : GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.DegPres (totalPushOn (opsK k) g)
proof:
:= by
  intro n y
  exact ⟨(opsK k).push g n y, by simp [totalPushOn]⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.chK_push
statement:
theorem chK_push {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [Y.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X]
    [IsNoetherian Y] [Fact (ProjK k X)] [Fact (ProjK k Y)] (g : X ⟶ Y) [g.IsOver (Spk k)]
    [IsProper g] (E : Y.Modules) {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank Y E r) (v : TotalChow X) :
    totalPushOn (opsK k) g (chK k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E) v) =
      chK k E (totalPushOn (opsK k) g v)
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty X with hX | hX
  · rw [totalChow_eq_zero_of_isEmpty v, map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
  · haveI : Nonempty Y := ⟨g (Classical.arbitrary X)⟩
    have hr' := hasConstantRank_pullback X g E r hE
    have key : GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Interw (totalPushOn (opsK k) g)
        (chK k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)) (chK k E) := by
      unfold chK GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.chTot
      refine GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Interw.gsum (degPres_opsK g) (fun n ↦ ?_)
      rw [M7ASM.chOpOn_eq hr', M7ASM.chOpOn_eq hE,
        constRankChernAssignOn'_eq _ _ _ _ r hr', constRankChernAssignOn'_eq _ _ _ _ r hE]
      intro w
      exact CIIL1D.projFormulaPi_ch g (opsK k) (cpK k) closedPosK E r hE n w
    exact key v

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.zsmul_end_apply_tlmap
statement:
theorem zsmul_end_apply_tlmap {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℚ V] (n : ℤ)
    (T : Module.End ℚ V) (x : V) : (n • T) x = n • T x
proof:
:=
  map_zsmul (AddMonoidHom.mk' (fun T : Module.End ℚ V ↦ T x) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl)) n T

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.altCh_push
statement:
theorem altCh_push {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [Y.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X]
    [IsNoetherian Y] [Fact (ProjK k X)] [Fact (ProjK k Y)] (g : X ⟶ Y) [g.IsOver (Spk k)]
    [IsProper g] (E : ℕ → Y.Modules) (r : ℕ → ℕ) (hE : ∀ j, HasConstantRank Y (E j) (r j))
    (len : ℕ) (v : TotalChow X) :
    totalPushOn (opsK k) g (altCh k (fun j ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj (E j)) len v) =
      altCh k E len (totalPushOn (opsK k) g v)
proof:
:= by
  unfold altCh
  rw [LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
  rw [zsmul_end_apply_tlmap, zsmul_end_apply_tlmap, map_zsmul, chK_push g _ (hE j)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.chK0T2_classOf_eq_chK
statement:
theorem chK0T2_classOf_eq_chK {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (ProjK k X)] [ConnectedSpace X] [Nonempty X] (E : X.Modules) {r : ℕ}
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    chK0T2 k (k0ClassOf X E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree) = chK k E
proof:
:= by
  rw [chK0T2_classOf, chBundleT2, rkT2_eq hE]
  exact GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.chFromChern_eq_chTot (whitneyK (k := k)) hE

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.chK0T2_altSum_eq
statement:
theorem chK0T2_altSum_eq {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (ProjK k X)] [ConnectedSpace X] [Nonempty X] (F : ℕ → X.Modules)
    (r : ℕ → ℕ) (hF : ∀ j, HasConstantRank X (F j) (r j)) (len : ℕ) :
    chK0T2 k (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (len + 1),
        ((-1 : ℤ) ^ j) • k0ClassOf X (F j) (hF j).isFiniteLocallyFree) = altCh k F len
proof:
:= by
  simp only [map_sum, map_zsmul, chK0T2_classOf_eq_chK _ (hF _), altCh]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.isProper_of_projK_tlmap
statement:
theorem isProper_of_projK_tlmap {W : Scheme.{u}} [W.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (W ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian W] (h : ProjK k W) : IsProper (W ↘ Spk k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, j, hj, hjk⟩ := h
  rw [← hjk]
  haveI := hj
  haveI : IsProper (toSpec k N) := inferInstanceAs (IsProper (space k N ↘ Spk k))
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.isProper_of_isOver_tlmap
statement:
theorem isProper_of_isOver_tlmap {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [Y.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X]
    [IsNoetherian Y] [Fact (ProjK k X)] [Fact (ProjK k Y)] (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] :
    IsProper f
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isProper_of_projK_tlmap (Fact.out : ProjK k X)
  haveI := isProper_of_projK_tlmap (Fact.out : ProjK k Y)
  haveI : IsProper (f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k)) := by rw [comp_over]; infer_instance
  exact IsProper.of_comp f (Y ↘ Spk k)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.gammaK0Vanishing
statement:
theorem gammaK0Vanishing (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) (hU : (U : Set M).Nonempty) :
    GammaK0Vanishing (k := k) C U hC hU
proof:
:= by
  have h := C.gamma_k0_altSum_eq_zero (k := k) U hC hU
  rw [GammaK0Vanishing, ← h]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd j with hj | hj
  · rw [hj.neg_one_pow, hj.neg_one_pow, one_smul, one_mul]
  · rw [hj.neg_one_pow, hj.neg_one_pow, neg_one_mul]
    exact neg_one_zsmul _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.s0_xiProj
statement: theorem s0_xiProj : s0 (k := k) C ≫ xiProj (k := k) C = 𝟙 M
proof:
:=
  zeroSection_toBase_fst (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.hW_tlmap
statement:
theorem hW_tlmap {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    height (genericPoint (C.graphModel (k := k))) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
proof:
:=
  height_genericPoint_graphModel (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex hM

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.fundamentalCycle_eq_dimPrimeCycle
statement:
theorem fundamentalCycle_eq_dimPrimeCycle {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    fundamentalCycle M = (dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint M) n hM).1
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply]
  by_cases hx : x = genericPoint M
  · subst hx
    rw [if_pos rfl, WDiv.fundamentalCycle_apply_genericPoint]
  · rw [if_neg hx, WDiv.fundamentalCycle_apply_ne_genericPoint M x hx]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.zeroClass_eq_push
statement:
theorem zeroClass_eq_push {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow (C.graphModel (k := k)) n) n
      ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (zeroDimCycle (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex
        (hW_tlmap (k := k) C hM)) : DimChow (C.graphModel (k := k)) n)) =
      totalPushOn (opsK k) (s0 (k := k) C) (primeClassT2 (genericPoint M) n hM)
proof:
:= by
  unfold primeClassT2 totalPushOn
  rw [DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  congr 1
  refine ((opsK k).push_mk (s0 (k := k) C) n _ _ ?_).symm
  change zeroCycle (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex = _
  rw [zeroCycle_eq_pushforward (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex, fundamentalCycle_eq_dimPrimeCycle hM]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.altCh_s0
statement:
theorem altCh_s0 :
    altCh k (fun j ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (s0 (k := k) C)).obj (C.xi j)) C.K.len =
    chK0T2 k C.K.altSum
proof:
:= by
  haveI : ConnectedSpace M := connectedSpace_of_isIntegral
  rw [show C.K.altSum = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (C.K.len + 1),
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ j) • k0ClassOf M (C.K.E j) (C.hrank j).isFiniteLocallyFree from rfl,
    chK0T2_altSum_eq (k := k) (fun j ↦ C.K.E j) C.rank C.hrank]
  unfold altCh
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
  exact congrArg (fun T ↦ ((-1 : ℤ) ^ j) • T)
    (GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4A.chTot_iso (C.xiZeroIso (k := k) j))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.push_opW_zeroClass
statement:
theorem push_opW_zeroClass {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    totalPushOn (opsK k) (xiProj (k := k) C) (opW (k := k) C
      (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow (C.graphModel (k := k)) n) n
        ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (zeroDimCycle (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex
          (hW_tlmap (k := k) C hM)) : DimChow (C.graphModel (k := k)) n)))) =
      chK0T2 k C.K.altSum (primeClassT2 (genericPoint M) n hM)
proof:
:= by
  rw [zeroClass_eq_push (k := k) C hM, opW,
    ← altCh_push (s0 (k := k) C) (fun j ↦ C.xi j) C.rank (C.hasConstantRank_xi (k := k)),
    altCh_s0, ← LinearMap.comp_apply (totalPushOn (opsK k) (xiProj (k := k) C)),
    ← totalPushOn_comp, totalPushOn_congr (opsK k) (s0_xiProj (k := k) C), totalPushOn_id,
    LinearMap.id_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.opW_gamma_eq_zero
statement:
theorem opW_gamma_eq_zero (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) (hU : (U : Set M).Nonempty)
    (hK : GammaK0Vanishing (k := k) C U hC hU) {n : ℕ}
    (hγ : height (C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU) = n) :
    opW (k := k) C (primeClassT2 (C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU) n hγ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI : (C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU).Over (Spk k) :=
    ⟨C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU ≫ C.graphModel (k := k) ↘ Spk k⟩
  haveI : (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU).IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨rfl⟩
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType ((C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU) ↘ Spk k) := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU ≫ C.graphModel (k := k) ↘ Spk k)
    infer_instance
  haveI : CompactSpace (C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU) :=
    (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU).isClosedEmbedding.compactSpace
  haveI : IsNoetherian (C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU) := { }
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU)) :=
    ⟨projK_closed (Fact.out : ProjK k (C.graphModel (k := k))) (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU) rfl⟩
  haveI : ConnectedSpace (C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU) := connectedSpace_of_isIntegral
  haveI : IsProper (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU) := isProper_of_isOver_tlmap (k := k) _
  have hιv := C.gammaTildeι_genericPoint (k := k) U hC hU
  have hη : height (genericPoint (C.gammaTilde (k := k) U hC hU)) = n := by
    rw [← height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU), hιv, hγ]
  rw [primeClass_eq_push (k := k) (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU) _ hιv n hγ hη, opW,
    ← altCh_push (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU) (fun j ↦ C.xi j) C.rank
      (C.hasConstantRank_xi (k := k))]
  have h0 : altCh k (fun j ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (C.gammaTildeι (k := k) U hC hU)).obj
      (C.xi j)) C.K.len = 0 := by
    rw [← chK0T2_altSum_eq (k := k) (fun j ↦ C.xiGamma (k := k) U hC hU j) C.rank
      (fun j ↦ C.hasConstantRank_xiGamma (k := k) U hC hU j)]
    exact (congrArg (chK0T2 k) hK).trans (map_zero _)
  rw [h0, LinearMap.zero_apply, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.rCycle_support
proof:
:= by
  intro hwU
  have hU : (U : Set M).Nonempty := ⟨_, hwU⟩
  have hrw : (rCycle (k := k) C U hC hM).1 w = infCycle (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex w -
      (if w = C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU then 1 else 0) := by
    rw [← m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply (C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU) n
      (height_gammaPt (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex U (C.isSplitOn_of_sectionExactOn U hC) hU hM)]
    simp only [rCycle, gammaCycle, dif_pos hU]
    rfl
  by_cases hwg : w = C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU
  · rw [hrw, if_pos hwg, hwg, C.infCycle_gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU, sub_self] at hw
    exact hw rfl
  · rw [hrw, if_neg hwg, sub_zero] at hw
    exact hwg (C.eq_gammaPt_of_infCycle_ne_zero (k := k) U hC hU hw hwU)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.rCycle_eq_zero_of_eq_top
statement:
theorem rCycle_eq_zero_of_eq_top (hC : C.SectionExactOn ⊤) {n : ℕ}
    (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) : rCycle (k := k) C ⊤ hC hM = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext w
  by_contra hw
  exact rCycle_support (k := k) C ⊤ hC hM w hw trivial

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.infClass_eq
statement:
theorem infClass_eq {n : ℕ} (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U)
    (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow (C.graphModel (k := k)) n) n
      ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (infDimCycle (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex
        (hW_tlmap (k := k) C hM)) : DimChow (C.graphModel (k := k)) n)) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow (C.graphModel (k := k)) n) n
        ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (gammaCycle (k := k) C U hC hM) :
          DimChow (C.graphModel (k := k)) n)) +
      DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow (C.graphModel (k := k)) n) n
        ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (rCycle (k := k) C U hC hM) :
          DimChow (C.graphModel (k := k)) n))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_add, ← TensorProduct.tmul_add, ← QuotientAddGroup.mk_add, rCycle, add_sub_cancel]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.opW_infClass
statement:
theorem opW_infClass {n : ℕ} (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U)
    (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    opW (k := k) C (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow (C.graphModel (k := k)) n) n
      ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (infDimCycle (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex
        (hW_tlmap (k := k) C hM)) : DimChow (C.graphModel (k := k)) n))) =
      opW (k := k) C (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow (C.graphModel (k := k)) n) n
        ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (rCycle (k := k) C U hC hM) :
          DimChow (C.graphModel (k := k)) n)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [infClass_eq (k := k) C U hC hM, map_add]
  by_cases hU : (U : Set M).Nonempty
  · have hg : gammaCycle (k := k) C U hC hM = dimPrimeCycle (C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU) n
        (height_gammaPt (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex U (C.isSplitOn_of_sectionExactOn U hC) hU
          hM) :=
      dif_pos hU
    rw [hg]
    rw [show DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow (C.graphModel (k := k)) n) n
        ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU) n
          (height_gammaPt (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex U (C.isSplitOn_of_sectionExactOn U hC) hU
            hM)) : DimChow (C.graphModel (k := k)) n)) =
        primeClassT2 (C.gammaPt (k := k) U hC hU) n
          (height_gammaPt (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex U (C.isSplitOn_of_sectionExactOn U hC) hU
            hM) from rfl,
      opW_gamma_eq_zero (k := k) C U hC hU (gammaK0Vanishing (k := k) C U hC hU), zero_add]
  · have hg : gammaCycle (k := k) C U hC hM = 0 := dif_neg hU
    rw [hg, QuotientAddGroup.mk_zero, TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero, map_zero, zero_add]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.jX_xiProj
statement: theorem jX_xiProj : jX (k := k) C ι ≫ xiProj (k := k) C = ηX (k := k) C ι ≫ ι

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.range_jX

:=

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.rClass_eq_push
statement:
theorem rClass_eq_push (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U)
    (hX : ∀ x : M, x ∉ U → x ∈ Set.range ι) {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    totalPushOn (opsK k) (jX (k := k) C ι)
      (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow (WX (k := k) C ι) n) n
        ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (rhoX (k := k) C ι U hC hM) :
          DimChow (WX (k := k) C ι) n))) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow (C.graphModel (k := k)) n) n
        ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (rCycle (k := k) C U hC hM) :
          DimChow (C.graphModel (k := k)) n))
proof:
:= by
  unfold totalPushOn
  rw [DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  congr 1
  refine (opsK k).push_mk (jX (k := k) C ι) n _ _ ?_
  refine (F13.properPushforward_restrictCycle (jX (k := k) C ι) _ fun w hw ↦ ?_).symm
  by_contra hne
  apply hw
  rw [range_jX]
  exact hX _ (rCycle_support (k := k) C U hC hM w hne)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.push_tauRaw
statement:
theorem push_tauRaw (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U)
    (hX : ∀ x : M, x ∉ U → x ∈ Set.range ι) {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    totalPushOn (opsK k) ι (tauRaw (k := k) C ι U hC hM) =
      chK0T2 k C.K.altSum (primeClassT2 (genericPoint M) n hM)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← push_opW_zeroClass (k := k) C hM,
    mk_zeroDimCycle_eq_mk_infDimCycle (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex (hW_tlmap (k := k) C hM),
    opW_infClass (k := k) C U hC hM, ← rClass_eq_push (k := k) C ι U hC hX hM, opW,
    ← altCh_push (jX (k := k) C ι) (fun j ↦ C.xi j) C.rank (C.hasConstantRank_xi (k := k)),
    tauRaw, ← LinearMap.comp_apply (totalPushOn (opsK k) ι), ← totalPushOn_comp,
    ← LinearMap.comp_apply (totalPushOn (opsK k) (xiProj (k := k) C)), ← totalPushOn_comp,
    totalPushOn_congr (opsK k) (jX_xiProj (k := k) C ι)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.tauRaw_eq_zero_of_eq_top
statement:
theorem tauRaw_eq_zero_of_eq_top (hC : C.SectionExactOn ⊤) {n : ℕ}
    (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) : tauRaw (k := k) C ι ⊤ hC hM = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [tauRaw, rhoX, rCycle_eq_zero_of_eq_top (k := k) C hC hM, map_zero,
    QuotientAddGroup.mk_zero, TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.interw_lineChernK
statement:
theorem interw_lineChernK {X Z : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [Z.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Z ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X]
    [IsNoetherian Z] [Fact (ProjK k X)] [Fact (ProjK k Z)] (i : X ⟶ Z) [i.IsOver (Spk k)]
    [IsProper i] (L : Z.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank Z L 1) (j : ℕ) :
    GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Interw (totalPushOn (opsK k) i)
      (K7.chernLineValOn (opsK k) X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X i L 1 hL) j)
      (K7.chernLineValOn (opsK k) Z L hL j)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [K7.chernLineValOn]
  by_cases h0 : j = 0
  · rw [if_pos h0, if_pos h0]; exact GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Interw.one
  · by_cases h1 : j = 1
    · rw [if_neg h0, if_neg h0, if_pos h1, if_pos h1]
      intro v
      exact LinearMap.congr_fun ((cpK k).cap_push i L hL) v
    · rw [if_neg h0, if_neg h0, if_neg h1, if_neg h1]; exact GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Interw.zero

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.interw_tdLineK
statement:
theorem interw_tdLineK {X Z : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [Z.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Z ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X]
    [IsNoetherian Z] [Fact (ProjK k X)] [Fact (ProjK k Z)] (i : X ⟶ Z) [i.IsOver (Spk k)]
    [IsProper i] (L : Z.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank Z L 1) :
    GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Interw (totalPushOn (opsK k) i)
      (tdLineK k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj L) (hasConstantRank_pullback X i L 1 hL))
      (tdLineK k L hL)
proof:
:=
  GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Interw.tdFromChern (degPres_opsK i) (interw_lineChernK i L hL)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.push_tauLoc_space
statement:
theorem push_tauLoc_space (U : (space k N).Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U)
    (hX : ∀ x : space k N, x ∉ U → x ∈ Set.range ι) :
    totalPushOn (opsK k) ι (tauLoc (k := k) N C ι U hC) =
      tdPn k N (chPn k N C.K.altSum (fundPn k N))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : ConnectedSpace (space k N) := connectedSpace_of_isIntegral
  rw [tauLoc, (GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Interw.pow
      (interw_tdLineK ι (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N 1) (hcr k N 1)) (N + 1)),
    push_tauRaw (k := k) C ι U hC hX (CASE1B.height_genericPoint_space k N),
    chK0T2_eq_chK0 k (GRRBlueprintV4.closedPosV4 k) (GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.chExact_closedPosV4 k),
    fundPn,
    GRRBlueprintV4.fundClass_eq k N (CASE1B.height_genericPoint_space k N)]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.opWXTw_apply
statement:
theorem opWXTw_apply (A : M.Modules) (hA : HasConstantRank M A 1)
    (v : TotalChow (WX (k := k) C ι)) :
    opWXTw (k := k) C ι A v = chK k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (ηX (k := k) C ι)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj A)) (opWX (k := k) C ι v)
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty (WX (k := k) C ι) with hE | hE
  · rw [totalChow_eq_zero_of_isEmpty v, map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
  · have hAW := hasConstantRank_pullback _ (xiProj (k := k) C) A 1 hA
    have hAX := hasConstantRank_pullback _ (jX (k := k) C ι) _ 1 hAW
    simp only [opWXTw, opWX, altCh]
    rw [LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
    rw [zsmul_end_apply_tlmap, zsmul_end_apply_tlmap, map_zsmul]
    congr 1
    have hξ := hasConstantRank_pullback _ (jX (k := k) C ι) _ _ (C.hasConstantRank_xi (k := k) j)
    haveI : IsIso (pullbackTensorSheafHom (jX (k := k) C ι) (C.xi j)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).obj A)) :=
      pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_isFiniteLocallyFree _ _ _
        (C.hasConstantRank_xi (k := k) j).isFiniteLocallyFree hAW.isFiniteLocallyFree
    have h1 : chK k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (jX (k := k) C ι)).obj
        (tensorSheaf _ (C.xi j) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).obj A))) =
        chK k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (ηX (k := k) C ι)).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj A)) *
          chK k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (jX (k := k) C ι)).obj (C.xi j)) := by
      unfold chK
      rw [GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4A.chTot_iso (asIso (pullbackTensorSheafHom (jX (k := k) C ι) (C.xi j)
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (xiProj (k := k) C)).obj A))),
        GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4A.chTot_tensor_line (whitneyK (k := k)) hξ hAX,
        GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4A.chTot_iso (pullbackSquareIso (k := k) C ι A)]
    rw [h1]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.tauRawTw_eq
statement:
theorem tauRawTw_eq (A : M.Modules) (hA : HasConstantRank M A 1) (U : M.Opens)
    (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    tauRawTw (k := k) C ι A U hC hM =
      chK k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj A) (tauRaw (k := k) C ι U hC hM)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tauRawTw, opWXTw_apply (k := k) C ι A hA, tauRaw,
    chK_push (ηX (k := k) C ι) _ (hasConstantRank_pullback X ι A 1 hA)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.push_tauRawTw
statement:
theorem push_tauRawTw (A : M.Modules) (hA : HasConstantRank M A 1) (U : M.Opens)
    (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) (hX : ∀ x : M, x ∉ U → x ∈ Set.range ι) {n : ℕ}
    (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    totalPushOn (opsK k) ι (tauRawTw (k := k) C ι A U hC hM) =
      chK k A (chK0T2 k C.K.altSum (primeClassT2 (genericPoint M) n hM))
proof:
:= by
  rw [tauRawTw_eq (k := k) C ι A hA, chK_push ι A hA, push_tauRaw (k := k) C ι U hC hX hM]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.tauRaw_eq_zero_of_eq_top'
statement:
theorem tauRaw_eq_zero_of_eq_top' (U : M.Opens) (hU : U = ⊤) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) {n : ℕ}
    (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) : tauRaw (k := k) C ι U hC hM = 0

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.push_tauRes
statement:
theorem push_tauRes {G : M.Modules} (R : _root_.SingTau.ResolutionData (IsCoherentLike M) C.K G)
    (hG : IsCoherentLike M G) (hsupp : moduleSheafSupport G ⊆ Set.range ι) {n : ℕ}
    (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    totalPushOn (opsK k) ι (tauRes (k := k) C ι R hG hM) =
      chK0T2 k C.K.altSum (primeClassT2 (genericPoint M) n hM)
proof:
:=
  push_tauRaw (k := k) C ι _ _ (fun x hx ↦ hsupp (by
    by_contra h
    exact hx (show x ∈ ((moduleSheafSupport G)ᶜ : Set M) from h))) hM

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.tauRes_eq_zero_of_isZero
statement:
theorem tauRes_eq_zero_of_isZero {G : M.Modules}

    (h : IsZero G) {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    tauRes (k := k) C ι R hG hM = 0

  tauRaw_eq_zero_of_eq_top' (k := k) C ι _ (exactLocus_eq_top_of_isZero G hG h) _ hM

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.push_tauStd
statement:
theorem push_tauStd {k : Type u} [Field k] [Infinite k] {M : Scheme.{u}} [M.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (M ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian M] [IsIntegral M] [Fact (ProjK k M)]
    (hMK : CIICLASS.ProjectiveIntegralK k M) (C : RankedBundleComplex M)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X]
    [Fact (ProjK k X)] (ι : X ⟶ M) [IsClosedImmersion ι] [ι.IsOver (Spk k)]
    (U : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) (hX : ∀ x : M, x ∉ U → x ∈ Set.range ι) {n : ℕ}
    (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    totalPushOn (opsK k) ι (tauStd hMK C ι U hC hM) =
      chK0T2 k C.K.altSum (primeClassT2 (genericPoint M) n hM)
proof:
:= by
  letI := prodP1Over (k := k) (A := M)
  letI := blowupOver (k := k) (graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := prodP1_lft (k := k) (A := M)
  haveI := prodP1_isNoetherian (k := k) (A := M)
  haveI := blowup_locallyOfFiniteType
    (CIICLASS.projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod hMK 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
    (graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) (graphIdeal_ne_bot C.toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := blowup_isNoetherian
    (CIICLASS.projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod hMK 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
    (graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) (graphIdeal_ne_bot C.toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := C.isIntegral_graphModel (k := k) hMK
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (C.graphModel (k := k))) :=
    ⟨projK_of_projectiveIntegralK (projectiveIntegralK_graphModel hMK C.toDetIdealComplex)⟩
  haveI : (xiProj (k := k) C).IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨Category.assoc _ _ _⟩
  exact push_tauRaw (k := k) C ι U hC hX hM

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.LocalizedLift.tauStd_eq_zero_of_eq_top
statement:
theorem tauStd_eq_zero_of_eq_top {k : Type u} [Field k] [Infinite k] {M : Scheme.{u}}
    [M.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (M ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian M] [IsIntegral M]
    [Fact (ProjK k M)] (hMK : CIICLASS.ProjectiveIntegralK k M) (C : RankedBundleComplex M)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X]
    [Fact (ProjK k X)] (ι : X ⟶ M) [IsClosedImmersion ι] [ι.IsOver (Spk k)]
    (U : M.Opens) (hU : U = ⊤) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) {n : ℕ}
    (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) : tauStd hMK C ι U hC hM = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI := prodP1Over (k := k) (A := M)
  letI := blowupOver (k := k) (graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := prodP1_lft (k := k) (A := M)
  haveI := prodP1_isNoetherian (k := k) (A := M)
  haveI := blowup_locallyOfFiniteType
    (CIICLASS.projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod hMK 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
    (graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) (graphIdeal_ne_bot C.toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := blowup_isNoetherian
    (CIICLASS.projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod hMK 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
    (graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) (graphIdeal_ne_bot C.toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := C.isIntegral_graphModel (k := k) hMK
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (C.graphModel (k := k))) :=
    ⟨projK_of_projectiveIntegralK (projectiveIntegralK_graphModel hMK C.toDetIdealComplex)⟩
  haveI : (xiProj (k := k) C).IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨Category.assoc _ _ _⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.moduleSheafSupport_pushforward_subset
statement:
theorem moduleSheafSupport_pushforward_subset {X : Scheme.{u}} (ι : X ⟶ M) [IsClosedImmersion ι]
    (F : X.Modules) : moduleSheafSupport ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj F) ⊆ Set.range ι
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  by_contra hny
  have hsub : Subsingleton (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj F).presheaf.stalk y) := by
    suffices h : ∀ c : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj F).presheaf.stalk y, c = 0 from
      ⟨fun a b ↦ by rw [h a, h b]⟩
    intro c
    obtain ⟨U, hyU, s, rfl⟩ :=
      TopCat.Presheaf.exists_germ_eq ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj F).presheaf c
    let O : M.Opens := ⟨(Set.range ι)ᶜ, ι.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range.isOpen_compl⟩
    let W : M.Opens := U ⊓ O
    have hyW : y ∈ W := ⟨hyU, hny⟩
    have hW : Subsingleton (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj F).presheaf.obj (op W)) := by
      change Subsingleton (F.presheaf.obj (op (ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)))
      refine ⟨fun a b => TopCat.Presheaf.section_ext ⟨F.presheaf, F.isSheaf⟩ _ a b
        fun x hx => ?_⟩
      have hx' : ι x ∈ W := hx
      exact absurd ⟨x, rfl⟩ hx'.2
    rw [← TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ (homOfLE inf_le_left : W ⟶ U) y hyW s]
    have h0 : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι).obj F).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE inf_le_left : W ⟶ U).op s = 0 := @Subsingleton.elim _ hW _ _
    rw [h0, map_zero]
  exact (not_nontrivial _) hy

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.tauStd_indep
statement:
theorem tauStd_indep (C : RankedBundleComplex M) (U U' : M.Opens) (hC : C.SectionExactOn U)
    (hC' : C.SectionExactOn U') (hX : ∀ x : M, x ∉ U → x ∈ Set.range ι)
    (hX' : ∀ x : M, x ∉ U' → x ∈ Set.range ι) {n : ℕ} (hM : height (genericPoint M) = n) :
    tauStd hMK C ι U hC hM = tauStd hMK C ι U' hC' hM
proof:
:= by
  letI := prodP1Over (k := k) (A := M)
  letI := blowupOver (k := k) (graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := prodP1_lft (k := k) (A := M)
  haveI := prodP1_isNoetherian (k := k) (A := M)
  haveI := blowup_locallyOfFiniteType
    (CIICLASS.projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod hMK 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
    (graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) (graphIdeal_ne_bot C.toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := blowup_isNoetherian
    (CIICLASS.projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod hMK 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
    (graphIdeal (k := k) C.toDetIdealComplex) (graphIdeal_ne_bot C.toDetIdealComplex)
  haveI := C.isIntegral_graphModel (k := k) hMK
  haveI : Fact (ProjK k (C.graphModel (k := k))) :=
    ⟨projK_of_projectiveIntegralK (projectiveIntegralK_graphModel hMK C.toDetIdealComplex)⟩
  haveI : (xiProj (k := k) C).IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨Category.assoc _ _ _⟩
  exact FamilySpecialization.tauRaw_indep (k := k) C ι U U' hC hC' hX hX' hM

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.tauStd_eq_zero_of_top

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.tauStd_eq_of_dominate
statement:
theorem tauStd_eq_of_dominate (hadd : TauAdditivity hMK ι hM) {G : M.Modules}
    (hG : IsCoherentLike M G) (hsupp : moduleSheafSupport G ⊆ Set.range ι)
    (C₃ C₁ : RankedBundleComplex M) (R₃ : _root_.SingTau.ResolutionData (IsCoherentLike M) C₃.K G)
    (R₁ : _root_.SingTau.ResolutionData (IsCoherentLike M) C₁.K G)
    (φ : ∀ j, C₃.K.E j ⟶ C₁.K.E j) (hepi : ∀ j, Epi (φ j))
    (hφ : ∀ j, C₃.K.d j ≫ φ j = φ (j + 1) ≫ C₁.K.d j) (hε : φ 0 ≫ R₁.ε = R₃.ε) :
    tauStd hMK C₃ ι (exactLocus G hG) (sectionExactOn_of_resolutionData C₃ R₃ hG) hM =
      tauStd hMK C₁ ι (exactLocus G hG) (sectionExactOn_of_resolutionData C₁ R₁ hG) hM
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, N, e, he, -⟩ := id hMK
  haveI := he
  haveI : ConnectedSpace M := connectedSpace_of_isIntegral
  let hcov := PerfectRepG2.Sch.hasBundleCovers_of_closedImmersion k N e
  let Kc := RankedBundleComplex.ofConnected (kerComplex φ hφ hcov hepi)
  have hK : Kc.SectionExactOn ⊤ := kerComplex_sectionExactOn_top φ hφ hcov hepi R₃ R₁ hε
  have hX := mem_range_of_not_mem_exactLocus ι hG hsupp
  have hKU : Kc.SectionExactOn (exactLocus G hG) := sectionExactOn_mono hK le_top
  rw [hadd Kc C₃ C₁ (fun j => kernel.ι (φ j)) φ (kerComplex_ses φ hepi)
    (fun j => kerD_ι φ hφ j) hφ (exactLocus G hG) hKU _ _ hX,
    tauStd_eq_zero_of_top hMK ι Kc hK _ hKU hX hM, zero_add]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.tauStd_res_indep
statement:
theorem tauStd_res_indep (hadd : TauAdditivity hMK ι hM) {G : M.Modules}
    (hG : IsCoherentLike M G) (hsupp : moduleSheafSupport G ⊆ Set.range ι)
    (C₁ C₂ : RankedBundleComplex M) (R₁ : _root_.SingTau.ResolutionData (IsCoherentLike M) C₁.K G)
    (R₂ : _root_.SingTau.ResolutionData (IsCoherentLike M) C₂.K G) :
    tauStd hMK C₁ ι (exactLocus G hG) (sectionExactOn_of_resolutionData C₁ R₁ hG) hM =
      tauStd hMK C₂ ι (exactLocus G hG) (sectionExactOn_of_resolutionData C₂ R₂ hG) hM
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, N, e, he, -⟩ := id hMK
  haveI := he
  haveI : ConnectedSpace M := connectedSpace_of_isIntegral
  obtain ⟨K₃, R₃, φ₁, φ₂, -, he₁, he₂, hc₁, hc₂, hε₁, hε₂⟩ :=
    _root_.SingTau.dominate_of_regular k N e hreg hG R₁ R₂
  let C₃ := RankedBundleComplex.ofConnected K₃
  rw [← tauStd_eq_of_dominate hMK ι hM hadd hG hsupp C₃ C₁ R₃ R₁ φ₁ he₁ hc₁ hε₁,
    tauStd_eq_of_dominate hMK ι hM hadd hG hsupp C₃ C₂ R₃ R₂ φ₂ he₂ hc₂ hε₂]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.tauSheaf_eq
statement:
theorem tauSheaf_eq (hadd : TauAdditivity hMK ι hM) (G : M.Modules) (hG : IsCoherentLike M G)
    (hsupp : moduleSheafSupport G ⊆ Set.range ι) (C : RankedBundleComplex M)
    (R : _root_.SingTau.ResolutionData (IsCoherentLike M) C.K G) (U : M.Opens)
    (hC : C.SectionExactOn U) (hX : ∀ x : M, x ∉ U → x ∈ Set.range ι) :
    tauSheaf hMK ι hM hreg G hG = tauStd hMK C ι U hC hM
proof:
:= by
  rw [tauStd_indep hMK ι C U (exactLocus G hG) hC (sectionExactOn_of_resolutionData C R hG) hX
    (mem_range_of_not_mem_exactLocus ι hG hsupp) hM]
  exact tauStd_res_indep hMK ι hM hreg hadd hG hsupp _ C (chosenResData hMK hreg G hG) R

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.tauSheaf_add
statement:
theorem tauSheaf_add (hadd : TauAdditivity hMK ι hM) {L : ShortComplex M.Modules}
    (hL : L.ShortExact) (h₁ : IsCoherentLike M L.X₁) (h₂ : IsCoherentLike M L.X₂)
    (h₃ : IsCoherentLike M L.X₃) (hs₁ : moduleSheafSupport L.X₁ ⊆ Set.range ι)
    (hs₂ : moduleSheafSupport L.X₂ ⊆ Set.range ι) (hs₃ : moduleSheafSupport L.X₃ ⊆ Set.range ι) :
    tauSheaf hMK ι hM hreg L.X₂ h₂ =
      tauSheaf hMK ι hM hreg L.X₁ h₁ + tauSheaf hMK ι hM hreg L.X₃ h₃
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, N, e, he, -⟩ := id hMK
  haveI := he
  haveI : ConnectedSpace M := connectedSpace_of_isIntegral
  obtain ⟨K₁, K₂, K₃, R₁, R₂, R₃, i, q, hses, hi, hq, -, -⟩ :=
    _root_.SingTau.horseshoe_of_regular k N e hreg hL h₁ h₂ h₃
  let U : M.Opens := exactLocus L.X₁ h₁ ⊓ exactLocus L.X₂ h₂ ⊓ exactLocus L.X₃ h₃
  have hU₁ : U ≤ exactLocus L.X₁ h₁ := inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left
  have hU₂ : U ≤ exactLocus L.X₂ h₂ := inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right
  have hU₃ : U ≤ exactLocus L.X₃ h₃ := inf_le_right
  have hX : ∀ x : M, x ∉ U → x ∈ Set.range ι := by
    intro x hx
    by_contra hn
    apply hx
    have m₁ : x ∈ exactLocus L.X₁ h₁ := fun h => hn (hs₁ h)
    have m₂ : x ∈ exactLocus L.X₂ h₂ := fun h => hn (hs₂ h)
    have m₃ : x ∈ exactLocus L.X₃ h₃ := fun h => hn (hs₃ h)
    exact ⟨⟨m₁, m₂⟩, m₃⟩
  let C₁ := RankedBundleComplex.ofConnected K₁
  let C₂ := RankedBundleComplex.ofConnected K₂
  let C₃ := RankedBundleComplex.ofConnected K₃
  have hC₁ : C₁.SectionExactOn U :=
    sectionExactOn_mono (sectionExactOn_of_resolutionData C₁ R₁ h₁) hU₁
  have hC₂ : C₂.SectionExactOn U :=
    sectionExactOn_mono (sectionExactOn_of_resolutionData C₂ R₂ h₂) hU₂
  have hC₃ : C₃.SectionExactOn U :=
    sectionExactOn_mono (sectionExactOn_of_resolutionData C₃ R₃ h₃) hU₃
  rw [tauSheaf_eq hMK ι hM hreg hadd L.X₁ h₁ hs₁ C₁ R₁ U hC₁ hX,
    tauSheaf_eq hMK ι hM hreg hadd L.X₂ h₂ hs₂ C₂ R₂ U hC₂ hX,
    tauSheaf_eq hMK ι hM hreg hadd L.X₃ h₃ hs₃ C₃ R₃ U hC₃ hX]
  exact hadd C₁ C₂ C₃ i q hses hi hq U hC₁ hC₂ hC₃ hX

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.push_tauSheaf
statement:
theorem push_tauSheaf [ConnectedSpace M] (G : M.Modules) (hG : IsCoherentLike M G)
    (hsupp : moduleSheafSupport G ⊆ Set.range ι) :
    totalPushOn (opsK k) ι (tauSheaf hMK ι hM hreg G hG) =
      chK0T2 k (chosenRes hMK hreg G hG).K.altSum (primeClassT2 (genericPoint M) n hM)
proof:
:=
  push_tauStd hMK _ ι _ _ (mem_range_of_not_mem_exactLocus ι hG hsupp) hM

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.tauG0_classOf
statement:
theorem tauG0_classOf (hadd : TauAdditivity hMK ι hM) (F : X.Modules) (hF : IsCoherentLike X F) :
    tauG0 hMK ι hM hreg hadd (g0ClassOf X F hF) =
      tauSheaf hMK ι hM hreg (pushCoh ι ⟨F, hF⟩).1 (pushCoh ι ⟨F, hF⟩).2
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.lift_classOf _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingTau.FamilySpecializationG0.push_tauG0
statement:
theorem push_tauG0 [ConnectedSpace M] (hadd : TauAdditivity hMK ι hM) (x : G0 X) (y : K0 M)
    (hy : k0ToG0 M y = finitePushforward ι x) :
    totalPushOn (opsK k) ι (tauG0 hMK ι hM hreg hadd x) =
      chK0T2 k y (primeClassT2 (genericPoint M) n hM)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, N, e, he, -⟩ := id hMK
  haveI := he
  have hb := ResolutionRegularClosedF15.k0ToG0_bijective_of_regular_closed k N e hreg
  let E := AddEquiv.ofBijective (k0ToG0 M) hb
  have key : ∀ x : G0 X, totalPushOn (opsK k) ι (tauG0 hMK ι hM hreg hadd x) =
      chK0T2 k (E.symm (finitePushforward ι x)) (primeClassT2 (genericPoint M) n hM) := by
    intro x
    let f : G0 X →+ TotalChow M :=
      (totalPushOn (opsK k) ι).toAddMonoidHom.comp (tauG0 hMK ι hM hreg hadd)
    let g : G0 X →+ TotalChow M :=
      AddMonoidHom.mk' (fun x => chK0T2 k (E.symm (finitePushforward ι x))
        (primeClassT2 (genericPoint M) n hM)) (fun a b => by
          simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply])
    have hfg : f = g := by
      refine ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _ fun F => ?_
      change totalPushOn (opsK k) ι (tauG0 hMK ι hM hreg hadd (g0ClassOf X F.1 F.2)) =
        chK0T2 k (E.symm (finitePushforward ι (g0ClassOf X F.1 F.2)))
          (primeClassT2 (genericPoint M) n hM)
      rw [tauG0_classOf, push_tauSheaf hMK ι hM hreg _ _ (pushCoh_support ι F),
        finitePushforward_classOf]
      congr 2
      apply E.injective
      rw [AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
      exact _root_.SingTau.k0ToG0_altSum (chosenResData hMK hreg _ _) _
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun hfg x
  rw [key x]
  congr 2
  apply E.injective
  rw [AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact hy.symm

name: FunctionField.Chart.finiteAdeleLocalResidueMap_ker
statement:
theorem finiteAdeleLocalResidueMap_ker (D : DivisorA k K)
    (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (ringOfIntegers k K)) :
    (finiteAdeleLocalResidueMap k K D v).ker =
      Submodule.comap (adeleFilt k K (D + Finsupp.single (Sum.inl v) 1)).subtype
        (adeleFilt k K D)
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.coe_subtype,
    finiteAdeleLocalResidueMap, finiteAdeleLocalResidueToSubring]
  change IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.residueHom (K := K) v
      ⟨(Classical.choose (v.valuation_exists_uniformizer K)) ^
          (D (Sum.inl v) + 1) * ((a.val : AdeleSpace k K).val (Sum.inl v)), _⟩ = 0 ↔
    ∀ w, placeValuation k K w ((a.val : AdeleSpace k K).val w) ≤ WithZero.exp (D w)
  rw [IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.residueHom_eq_zero_iff]
  have hπ := Classical.choose_spec (v.valuation_exists_uniformizer K)
  rw [map_mul, map_zpow₀, hπ]
  rw [← WithZero.exp_zsmul]
  have hnsmul : (D (Sum.inl v) + 1) • (-1 : ℤ) = -(D (Sum.inl v) + 1) := by simp
  rw [hnsmul]
  have hlocal : WithZero.exp (-(D (Sum.inl v) + 1)) *
      v.valuation K ((a.val : AdeleSpace k K).val (Sum.inl v)) < 1 ↔
      v.valuation K ((a.val : AdeleSpace k K).val (Sum.inl v)) ≤
        WithZero.exp (D (Sum.inl v)) := by
    simpa using exp_neg_mul_lt_one_iff_le
      (v.valuation K ((a.val : AdeleSpace k K).val (Sum.inl v))) (D (Sum.inl v) + 1)
  rw [hlocal]
  constructor
  · intro hv w
    by_cases hw : w = Sum.inl v
    · subst hw
      exact hv
    · simpa [placeValuation, hw] using a.property w
  · intro hf
    simpa [placeValuation] using hf (Sum.inl v)

name: FunctionField.Chart.finiteAdeleLocalResidueMap_surjective
statement:
theorem finiteAdeleLocalResidueMap_surjective (D : DivisorA k K)
    (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (ringOfIntegers k K)) :
    Function.Surjective (finiteAdeleLocalResidueMap k K D v)
proof:
:= by
  let π : K := Classical.choose (v.valuation_exists_uniformizer K)
  let n : ℤ := D (Sum.inl v) + 1
  intro y
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective y
  let z : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime K v :=
    IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.localizationAlgEquiv (K := K) v x
  have hz : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.residueHom (K := K) v z = y := by
    rwa [IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.residueHom_apply_localizationAlgEquiv]
  let xK : K := π ^ (-n) * (z : K)
  let a₀ : AdeleSpace k K := adeleUpdate k K (zeroAdele k K) (Sum.inl v) xK
  have ha₀ : a₀ ∈ adeleFilt k K (D + Finsupp.single (Sum.inl v) 1) := by
    intro w
    by_cases hw : w = Sum.inl v
    · subst hw
      simp only [placeValuation, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
      have hπpow : v.valuation K (π ^ (-n)) = WithZero.exp (-1) ^ (-n) := by
        rw [map_zpow₀, Classical.choose_spec (v.valuation_exists_uniformizer K)]
      have hzle : v.valuation K (z : K) ≤ 1 := by
        simpa [IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime_eq_valuationSubring,
          Valuation.mem_valuationSubring_iff] using z.property
      have hval :
          (v.valuation K) (a₀.val (Sum.inl v)) ≤ WithZero.exp (D (Sum.inl v) + 1) := by
        have hmul' : (v.valuation K) (a₀.val (Sum.inl v)) =
            (v.valuation K) (π ^ (-n)) * (v.valuation K) (z : K) := by
          show (v.valuation K)
              (Function.update (0 : PlaceA k K → K) (Sum.inl v) xK (Sum.inl v)) = _
          simp only [Function.update_self, xK]
          exact Valuation.map_mul (v.valuation K) _ _
        have hbound :
            (v.valuation K) (π ^ (-n)) * (v.valuation K) (z : K) ≤ WithZero.exp n := by
          have hπpow : v.valuation K (π ^ (-n)) = WithZero.exp (-1) ^ (-n) := by
            rw [map_zpow₀, Classical.choose_spec (v.valuation_exists_uniformizer K)]
          rw [hπpow]
          have hzle0 : (v.valuation K) (z : K) ≤ WithZero.exp (0 : ℤ) := by
            simpa [WithZero.exp_zero] using hzle
          calc
            WithZero.exp (-1) ^ (-n) * (v.valuation K) (z : K)
                ≤ WithZero.exp (-1) ^ (-n) * WithZero.exp 0 := mul_le_mul_right hzle0 _
            _ = WithZero.exp n := by
              rw [← WithZero.exp_zsmul, ← WithZero.exp_add]
              simp
        simpa [n] using (le_of_eq hmul').trans hbound
      exact hval
    · simp only [placeValuation, zeroAdele, adeleUpdate, a₀,
        Function.update_of_ne hw, Pi.zero_apply, Valuation.map_zero,
        Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
      exact zero_le
  refine ⟨⟨a₀, ha₀⟩, ?_⟩
  have hmul : (finiteAdeleLocalResidueToSubring k K D v ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ : K) = (z : K) := by
    dsimp [finiteAdeleLocalResidueToSubring, a₀, adeleUpdate, xK, zeroAdele, n, π]
    simp only [Function.update_self]
    have hπne : π ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have huniform := Classical.choose_spec (v.valuation_exists_uniformizer K)
      have hπdef : v.valuation K π = WithZero.exp (-1) := by dsimp [π]; exact huniform
      rw [h0, Valuation.map_zero] at hπdef
      exact absurd hπdef.symm WithZero.exp_ne_zero
    have h1 : π ^ (D (Sum.inl v) + 1) * π ^ (-(D (Sum.inl v) + 1)) = (1 : K) := by
      rw [← zpow_add₀ hπne, add_neg_cancel, zpow_zero]
    calc
      π ^ (D (Sum.inl v) + 1) * (π ^ (-(D (Sum.inl v) + 1)) * (z : K))
          = (π ^ (D (Sum.inl v) + 1) * π ^ (-(D (Sum.inl v) + 1))) * (z : K) := by ring
      _ = (z : K) := by rw [h1, one_mul]
  simp only [finiteAdeleLocalResidueMap, finiteAdeleLocalResidueToSubring]
  exact congr_arg (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.residueHom (K := K) v)
    (Subtype.ext_iff.mpr hmul) ▸ hz

name: FunctionField.Chart.finrankAdeleFiltDiff_single_finite
statement:
theorem finrankAdeleFiltDiff_single_finite (D : DivisorA k K)
    (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (ringOfIntegers k K)) :
    finrankAdeleFiltDiff k K D (D + Finsupp.single (Sum.inl v) 1) =
      placeDegree k K (Sum.inl v)
proof:
:= by
  let f := finiteAdeleLocalResidueMap k K D v
  let e : (ringOfIntegers k K ⧸ v.asIdeal) ≃ₗ[k] v.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
    LinearEquiv.ofBijective
      ((Algebra.linearMap (ringOfIntegers k K ⧸ v.asIdeal)
        v.asIdeal.ResidueField).restrictScalars k)
      (Ideal.bijective_algebraMap_quotient_residueField v.asIdeal)
  letI : FiniteDimensional k v.asIdeal.ResidueField := e.finiteDimensional
  have hker := finiteAdeleLocalResidueMap_ker k K D v
  have hsurj := finiteAdeleLocalResidueMap_surjective k K D v
  rw [finrankAdeleFiltDiff, ← hker, f.quotKerEquivRange.finrank_eq]
  rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hsurj, finrank_top]
  calc
    Module.finrank k v.asIdeal.ResidueField = Module.finrank k (ringOfIntegers k K ⧸ v.asIdeal) :=
      e.finrank_eq.symm
    _ = placeDegree k K (Sum.inl v) := rfl

name: FunctionField.Chart.infiniteAdeleLocalResidueMap_ker
statement:
theorem infiniteAdeleLocalResidueMap_ker (D : DivisorA k K)
    (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (infiniteIntegers k K)) :
    (infiniteAdeleLocalResidueMap k K D v).ker =
      Submodule.comap (adeleFilt k K (D + Finsupp.single (Sum.inr v) 1)).subtype
        (adeleFilt k K D)
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.coe_subtype,
    infiniteAdeleLocalResidueMap, infiniteAdeleLocalResidueToSubring]
  change IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.residueHom (K := K) v
      ⟨(Classical.choose (v.valuation_exists_uniformizer K)) ^
          (D (Sum.inr v) + 1) * ((a.val : AdeleSpace k K).val (Sum.inr v)), _⟩ = 0 ↔
    ∀ w, placeValuation k K w ((a.val : AdeleSpace k K).val w) ≤ WithZero.exp (D w)
  rw [IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.residueHom_eq_zero_iff]
  have hπ := Classical.choose_spec (v.valuation_exists_uniformizer K)
  rw [map_mul, map_zpow₀, hπ]
  rw [← WithZero.exp_zsmul]
  have hnsmul : (D (Sum.inr v) + 1) • (-1 : ℤ) = -(D (Sum.inr v) + 1) := by simp
  rw [hnsmul]
  have hlocal : WithZero.exp (-(D (Sum.inr v) + 1)) *
      v.valuation K ((a.val : AdeleSpace k K).val (Sum.inr v)) < 1 ↔
      v.valuation K ((a.val : AdeleSpace k K).val (Sum.inr v)) ≤
        WithZero.exp (D (Sum.inr v)) := by
    simpa using exp_neg_mul_lt_one_iff_le
      (v.valuation K ((a.val : AdeleSpace k K).val (Sum.inr v))) (D (Sum.inr v) + 1)
  rw [hlocal]
  constructor
  · intro hv w
    by_cases hw : w = Sum.inr v
    · subst hw
      exact hv
    · simpa [placeValuation, hw] using a.property w
  · intro hf
    simpa [placeValuation] using hf (Sum.inr v)

name: FunctionField.Chart.infiniteAdeleLocalResidueMap_surjective

    (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (infiniteIntegers k K)) :
    Function.Surjective (infiniteAdeleLocalResidueMap k K D v)

:= by
  let π : K := Classical.choose (v.valuation_exists_uniformizer K)
  let n : ℤ := D (Sum.inr v) + 1
  intro y
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective y
  let z : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime K v :=
    IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.localizationAlgEquiv (K := K) v x
  have hz : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.residueHom (K := K) v z = y := by
    rwa [IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.residueHom_apply_localizationAlgEquiv]
  let xK : K := π ^ (-n) * (z : K)
  let a₀ : AdeleSpace k K := adeleUpdate k K (zeroAdele k K) (Sum.inr v) xK
  have ha₀ : a₀ ∈ adeleFilt k K (D + Finsupp.single (Sum.inr v) 1) := by
    intro w
    by_cases hw : w = Sum.inr v
    · subst hw
      simp only [placeValuation, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
      have hπpow : v.valuation K (π ^ (-n)) = WithZero.exp (-1) ^ (-n) := by
        rw [map_zpow₀, Classical.choose_spec (v.valuation_exists_uniformizer K)]
      have hzle : v.valuation K (z : K) ≤ 1 := by
        simpa [IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime_eq_valuationSubring,
          Valuation.mem_valuationSubring_iff] using z.property
      have hval :
          (v.valuation K) (a₀.val (Sum.inr v)) ≤ WithZero.exp (D (Sum.inr v) + 1) := by
        have hmul' : (v.valuation K) (a₀.val (Sum.inr v)) =
            (v.valuation K) (π ^ (-n)) * (v.valuation K) (z : K) := by
          show (v.valuation K)
              (Function.update (0 : PlaceA k K → K) (Sum.inr v) xK (Sum.inr v)) = _
          simp only [Function.update_self, xK]
          exact Valuation.map_mul (v.valuation K) _ _
        have hbound :
            (v.valuation K) (π ^ (-n)) * (v.valuation K) (z : K) ≤ WithZero.exp n := by
          have hπpow : v.valuation K (π ^ (-n)) = WithZero.exp (-1) ^ (-n) := by
            rw [map_zpow₀, Classical.choose_spec (v.valuation_exists_uniformizer K)]
          rw [hπpow]
          have hzle0 : (v.valuation K) (z : K) ≤ WithZero.exp (0 : ℤ) := by
            simpa [WithZero.exp_zero] using hzle
          calc
            WithZero.exp (-1) ^ (-n) * (v.valuation K) (z : K)
                ≤ WithZero.exp (-1) ^ (-n) * WithZero.exp 0 := mul_le_mul_right hzle0 _
            _ = WithZero.exp n := by
              rw [← WithZero.exp_zsmul, ← WithZero.exp_add]
              simp
        simpa [n] using (le_of_eq hmul').trans hbound
      exact hval
    · simp only [placeValuation, zeroAdele, adeleUpdate, a₀,
        Function.update_of_ne hw, Pi.zero_apply, Valuation.map_zero,
        Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
      exact zero_le
  refine ⟨⟨a₀, ha₀⟩, ?_⟩
  have hmul : (infiniteAdeleLocalResidueToSubring k K D v ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ : K) = (z : K) := by
    dsimp [infiniteAdeleLocalResidueToSubring, a₀, adeleUpdate, xK, zeroAdele, n, π]
    simp only [Function.update_self]
    have hπne : π ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have huniform := Classical.choose_spec (v.valuation_exists_uniformizer K)
      have hπdef : v.valuation K π = WithZero.exp (-1) := by dsimp [π]; exact huniform
      rw [h0, Valuation.map_zero] at hπdef
      exact absurd hπdef.symm WithZero.exp_ne_zero
    have h1 : π ^ (D (Sum.inr v) + 1) * π ^ (-(D (Sum.inr v) + 1)) = (1 : K) := by
      rw [← zpow_add₀ hπne, add_neg_cancel, zpow_zero]
    calc
      π ^ (D (Sum.inr v) + 1) * (π ^ (-(D (Sum.inr v) + 1)) * (z : K))
          = (π ^ (D (Sum.inr v) + 1) * π ^ (-(D (Sum.inr v) + 1))) * (z : K) := by ring
      _ = (z : K) := by rw [h1, one_mul]
  simp only [infiniteAdeleLocalResidueMap, infiniteAdeleLocalResidueToSubring]
  exact congr_arg (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.residueHom (K := K) v)
    (Subtype.ext_iff.mpr hmul) ▸ hz
