name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.mem_placeOfCodimOnePoint_iff
statement:
theorem mem_placeOfCodimOnePoint_iff (p : CodimOnePoint X) (z : X.functionField) :
    z ∈ placeOfCodimOnePoint k p ↔
      ∃ a : X.presheaf.stalk p.1,
        algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk p.1) X.functionField a = z
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk p.1) :=
    IsRegularInCodimensionOne.stalk_dvr p.1 p.2
  change z ∈
    ((IsDiscreteValuationRing.maximalIdeal
      (X.presheaf.stalk p.1)).valuation X.functionField).valuationSubring.toSubring ↔ _
  rw [← IsDiscreteValuationRing.map_algebraMap_eq_valuationSubring
    (A := X.presheaf.stalk p.1) (K := X.functionField)]
  simp [Subring.mem_map]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.normalization_placeOfCodimOnePoint
statement:
theorem normalization_placeOfCodimOnePoint (p : CodimOnePoint X) :
    (placeOfCodimOnePoint k p).normalization = pointNormalization (k := k) p
proof:
:= by
  exact FunctionField.orderMonoidIso_withZeroMulInt_unique _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.valuation_placeOfCodimOnePoint
statement:
theorem valuation_placeOfCodimOnePoint (p : CodimOnePoint X) :
    (placeOfCodimOnePoint k p).valuation = adicValuationAt p
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk p.1) :=
    IsRegularInCodimensionOne.stalk_dvr p.1 p.2
  let v :=
    (IsDiscreteValuationRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk p.1)).valuation X.functionField
  letI : v.IsRankOneDiscrete := by
    dsimp only [v]
    infer_instance
  ext z
  change (placeOfCodimOnePoint k p).normalization
      ((placeOfCodimOnePoint k p).toValuationSubring.valuation.restrict z) = v z
  rw [normalization_placeOfCodimOnePoint]
  rw [pointNormalization]
  let hEquiv : v.IsEquiv v.valuationSubring.valuation :=
    Valuation.isEquiv_valuation_valuationSubring v
  change (Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.valueGroup₀_equiv_withZeroMulInt v)
      (hEquiv.symm.orderMonoidIso (v.valuationSubring.valuation.restrict z)) = v z
  rw [hEquiv.symm.orderMonoidIso_spec]
  exact Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.valueGroup₀_equiv_withZeroMulInt_restrict_apply_of_surjective
    ((IsDiscreteValuationRing.maximalIdeal
      (X.presheaf.stalk p.1)).valuation_surjective X.functionField) z

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.valuation_eq_exp_neg_ord
statement:
theorem valuation_eq_exp_neg_ord (p : CodimOnePoint X) {f : X.functionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    (placeOfCodimOnePoint k p).valuation f = WithZero.exp (-X.ord f p.1)
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk p.1) :=
    IsRegularInCodimensionOne.stalk_dvr p.1 p.2
  rw [valuation_placeOfCodimOnePoint]
  calc
    adicValuationAt p f = (X.ordHom p.1 p.2 f)⁻¹ := by
      rw [← inv_inj]
      simpa only [adicValuationAt, Scheme.ordHom, inv_inv] using
        (Ring.ordFrac_eq_valuation_inv
          (R := X.presheaf.stalk p.1) f).symm
    _ = (WithZero.exp (X.ord f p.1))⁻¹ := by
      congr 1
      simpa only [WithZero.exp_eq_coe_ofAdd] using
        (X.ord_eq_iff p.2 hf).mp rfl
    _ = WithZero.exp (-X.ord f p.1) := by
      simp [WithZero.exp_eq_coe_ofAdd]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.centerOfPlace_ne_genericPoint
statement:
theorem centerOfPlace_ne_genericPoint (v : FunctionField.Place k X.functionField) :
    centerOfPlace k v ≠ genericPoint X
proof:
:= by
  intro hc
  let l : Spec (CommRingCat.of v.toValuationSubring) ⟶ X := by
    change Spec (CommRingCat.of (placeValuativeCommSq k v).R) ⟶ X
    exact (liftOfPlace k v).l
  have hc' : l (IsLocalRing.closedPoint v.toValuationSubring) = genericPoint X := by
    exact hc
  let e : Inseparable (l (IsLocalRing.closedPoint v.toValuationSubring)) (genericPoint X) :=
    Inseparable.of_eq hc'
  let α : X.functionField ⟶ CommRingCat.of v.toValuationSubring :=
    (X.presheaf.stalkCongr e).inv ≫ Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo l
  have hfactor : Spec.map α ≫ X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X) = l := by
    have hspec : Spec.map (X.presheaf.stalkCongr e).inv ≫
        X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X) =
      X.fromSpecStalk (l (IsLocalRing.closedPoint v.toValuationSubring)) := by
      change Spec.map (X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes e.le) ≫
          X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X) =
        X.fromSpecStalk (l (IsLocalRing.closedPoint v.toValuationSubring))
      exact Scheme.SpecMap_stalkSpecializes_fromSpecStalk e.le
    change Spec.map ((X.presheaf.stalkCongr e).inv ≫
        Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo l) ≫
      X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X) = l
    rw [Spec.map_comp, Category.assoc, hspec]
    exact Scheme.Spec_stalkClosedPointTo_fromSpecStalk (f := l)
  have hleft := (liftOfPlace k v).fac_left
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap v.toValuationSubring X.functionField)) ≫ l =
    X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X) at hleft
  have hscheme : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap v.toValuationSubring X.functionField)) ≫
      Spec.map α = 𝟙 (Spec X.functionField) := by
    rw [← cancel_mono (X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X))]
    calc
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap v.toValuationSubring X.functionField)) ≫ Spec.map α) ≫
          X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X) = X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X) := by
        rw [Category.assoc, hfactor]
        exact hleft
      _ = 𝟙 (Spec X.functionField) ≫ X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X) :=
        (Category.id_comp _).symm
  rw [← Spec.map_comp, Spec.map_eq_id] at hscheme
  apply v.ne_top
  apply ValuationSubring.ext v.toValuationSubring ⊤
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro
    exact ValuationSubring.mem_top x
  · intro
    let y : v.toValuationSubring := α.hom x
    have hy : (y : X.functionField) = x := by
      have hfun := DFunLike.congr_fun (CommRingCat.hom_ext_iff.mp hscheme) x
      dsimp only [y]
      exact hfun
    exact hy ▸ y.property

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.centerStalkToPlace_comp_inclusion
statement:
theorem centerStalkToPlace_comp_inclusion (v : FunctionField.Place k X.functionField) :
    centerStalkToPlace k v ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap v.toValuationSubring X.functionField) =
      CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (centerOfPlace k v)) X.functionField)
proof:
:= by
  let l : Spec (CommRingCat.of v.toValuationSubring) ⟶ X := by
    change Spec (CommRingCat.of (placeValuativeCommSq k v).R) ⟶ X
    exact (liftOfPlace k v).l
  have hfactor : Spec.map (centerStalkToPlace k v) ≫
      X.fromSpecStalk (centerOfPlace k v) = l := by
    change Spec.map (Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo l) ≫
        X.fromSpecStalk (l (IsLocalRing.closedPoint v.toValuationSubring)) = l
    exact Scheme.Spec_stalkClosedPointTo_fromSpecStalk (f := l)
  have hleft := (liftOfPlace k v).fac_left
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap v.toValuationSubring X.functionField)) ≫ l =
    X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X) at hleft
  have hgeneric : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (centerOfPlace k v)) X.functionField)) ≫
      X.fromSpecStalk (centerOfPlace k v) =
        X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X) := by
    change Spec.map (X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes
        ((genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial)) ≫
      X.fromSpecStalk (centerOfPlace k v) = X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X)
    exact Scheme.SpecMap_stalkSpecializes_fromSpecStalk
      ((genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial)
  apply Spec.map_injective
  rw [← cancel_mono (X.fromSpecStalk (centerOfPlace k v))]
  calc
    Spec.map (centerStalkToPlace k v ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap v.toValuationSubring X.functionField)) ≫
        X.fromSpecStalk (centerOfPlace k v) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap v.toValuationSubring X.functionField)) ≫ l := by
        rw [Spec.map_comp, Category.assoc, hfactor]
    _ = X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X) := hleft
    _ = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (centerOfPlace k v)) X.functionField)) ≫
        X.fromSpecStalk (centerOfPlace k v) := hgeneric.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.coe_centerPointPlaceToPlace
statement:
theorem coe_centerPointPlaceToPlace (v : FunctionField.Place k X.functionField)
    (z : (placeOfCodimOnePoint k
      (codimOneCenterOfPlace k v)).toValuationSubring) :
    ((centerPointPlaceToPlace k v).hom z : X.functionField) = z
proof:
:= by
  let p := codimOneCenterOfPlace k v
  let e := localRingEquivValuationSubring k p
  let a : X.presheaf.stalk p.1 := e.symm z
  calc
    ((centerPointPlaceToPlace k v).hom z : X.functionField) =
        algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk p.1) X.functionField a := by
      have hfun := DFunLike.congr_fun
        (CommRingCat.hom_ext_iff.mp (centerStalkToPlace_comp_inclusion k v)) a
      exact hfun
    _ = z := by
      have ha := congrArg Subtype.val (e.apply_symm_apply z)
      exact ha

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.centerPointPlace_le_place
statement:
theorem centerPointPlace_le_place (v : FunctionField.Place k X.functionField) :
    (placeOfCodimOnePoint k
        (codimOneCenterOfPlace k v)).toValuationSubring.toSubring ≤
      v.toValuationSubring.toSubring
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  let z : (placeOfCodimOnePoint k
      (codimOneCenterOfPlace k v)).toValuationSubring := ⟨x, hx⟩
  let y : v.toValuationSubring := (centerPointPlaceToPlace k v).hom z
  have hy : (y : X.functionField) = x := by
    simpa only [y, z] using coe_centerPointPlaceToPlace k v z
  exact hy ▸ y.property

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.centerPointPlace_toLocalSubring_le
statement:
theorem centerPointPlace_toLocalSubring_le (v : FunctionField.Place k X.functionField) :
    (placeOfCodimOnePoint k
        (codimOneCenterOfPlace k v)).toValuationSubring.toLocalSubring ≤
      v.toValuationSubring.toLocalSubring
proof:
:= by
  let hle := centerPointPlace_le_place k v
  refine ⟨hle, ?_⟩
  have hmap : Subring.inclusion hle = (centerPointPlaceToPlace k v).hom := by
    ext z
    exact (coe_centerPointPlaceToPlace k v z).symm
  have hlocal : IsLocalHom (centerPointPlaceToPlace k v).hom := by
    let e := localRingEquivValuationSubring k (codimOneCenterOfPlace k v)
    letI : IsLocalHom e.symm.toRingHom :=
      isLocalHom_of_leftInverse e.toRingHom e.apply_symm_apply
    change IsLocalHom ((centerStalkToPlace k v).hom.comp e.symm.toRingHom)
    exact @RingHom.isLocalHom_comp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
      (centerStalkToPlace_isLocalHom k v) (inferInstance : IsLocalHom e.symm.toRingHom)
  exact hmap.symm ▸ hlocal

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.placeOfCodimOnePoint_codimOneCenterOfPlace
statement:
theorem placeOfCodimOnePoint_codimOneCenterOfPlace
    (v : FunctionField.Place k X.functionField) :
    placeOfCodimOnePoint k (codimOneCenterOfPlace k v) = v
proof:
:= by
  apply FunctionField.Place.ext
  apply ValuationSubring.toLocalSubring_injective
  exact (placeOfCodimOnePoint k
    (codimOneCenterOfPlace k v)).toValuationSubring.isMax_toLocalSubring.eq_of_le
      (centerPointPlace_toLocalSubring_le k v)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.centerOfPlace_placeOfCodimOnePoint
statement:
theorem centerOfPlace_placeOfCodimOnePoint (p : CodimOnePoint X) :
    centerOfPlace k (placeOfCodimOnePoint k p) = p.1
proof:
:= by
  have hproper : IsProper (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := inferInstance
  rw [IsProper.eq_valuativeCriterion] at hproper
  letI : Unique
      ((placeValuativeCommSq k (placeOfCodimOnePoint k p)).commSq.LiftStruct) :=
    Classical.choice
      (hproper.1.1.1 (placeValuativeCommSq k (placeOfCodimOnePoint k p)))
  have hlift : liftOfPlace k (placeOfCodimOnePoint k p) =
      liftOfCodimOnePoint k p := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [centerOfPlace, hlift]
  let e := localRingEquivValuationSubring k p
  letI : IsLocalHom e.toRingHom :=
    isLocalHom_of_leftInverse e.symm.toRingHom e.symm_apply_apply
  change (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom e.toRingHom) ≫ X.fromSpecStalk p.1)
      (IsLocalRing.closedPoint
        (placeOfCodimOnePoint k p).toValuationSubring) = p.1
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, Spec_closedPoint,
    Scheme.fromSpecStalk_closedPoint]

statement: lemma pointOfPlace_injective : Function.Injective (pointOfPlace (X := X) k)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.eventually_mem_place_of_proper_curve
statement:
theorem eventually_mem_place_of_proper_curve (f : X.functionField) :
    ∀ᶠ v : FunctionField.Place k X.functionField in cofinite,
      f ∈ v.toValuationSubring
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : f = 0
  · subst f
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun v => v.toValuationSubring.zero_mem
  letI : CompactSpace X :=
    QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
  have hsupport : (AlgebraicGeometry.div f).support.Finite := by
    simpa using
      (AlgebraicGeometry.div f).locallyFiniteSupport.finite_inter_support_of_isCompact
        (isCompact_univ : IsCompact (Set.univ : Set X))
  apply Filter.eventually_cofinite.mpr
  refine (hsupport.preimage (pointOfPlace_injective (X := X) k).injOn).subset ?_
  intro v hv
  change f ∉ v.toValuationSubring at hv
  change pointOfPlace (X := X) k v ∈ (AlgebraicGeometry.div f).support
  by_contra hsupport'
  apply hv
  rw [← FunctionField.Place.valuationSubring_valuation,
    Valuation.mem_valuationSubring_iff]
  let p : CodimOnePoint X := (codimOnePointEquivPlace k).symm v
  have hp : p.1 = pointOfPlace (X := X) k v := rfl
  have hord : X.ord f p.1 = 0 := by
    simpa only [hp, Function.mem_support, AlgebraicGeometry.div_eq_ord, not_not] using hsupport'
  rw [← (codimOnePointEquivPlace k).apply_symm_apply v]
  change (placeOfCodimOnePoint k p).valuation f ≤ 1
  rw [valuation_eq_exp_neg_ord k p hf, hord]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.adelicPrincipalPartsPresheaf_isSheaf
statement:
lemma adelicPrincipalPartsPresheaf_isSheaf
    (D : FunctionField.Divisor k X.functionField) :
    TopCat.Presheaf.IsSheaf (adelicPrincipalPartsPresheaf k D)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [TopCat.Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheafUniqueGluing]
  intro ι U sf hsf
  let W : X.Opens := iSup U
  have hcover : (W : Set X) ⊆ ⋃ i, (U i : Set X) := by
    intro x hx
    simpa only [W, Opens.coe_iSup, Set.mem_iUnion] using hx
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := (NoetherianSpace.isCompact (W : Set X)).elim_finite_subcover
    (fun i => (U i : Set X)) (fun i => (U i).isOpen) hcover
  have hexists (v : FunctionField.Place k X.functionField)
      (hv : pointOfPlace k v ∈ W) :
      ∃ i, i ∈ t ∧ pointOfPlace k v ∈ U i := by
    have h := ht hv
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at h
    rcases h with ⟨i, hi, hvi⟩
    exact ⟨i, hi, hvi⟩
  let chosenIndex (v : FunctionField.Place k X.functionField)
      (hv : pointOfPlace k v ∈ W) : ι :=
    Classical.choose (hexists v hv)
  have chosenIndex_mem (v : FunctionField.Place k X.functionField)
      (hv : pointOfPlace k v ∈ W) : chosenIndex v hv ∈ t :=
    (Classical.choose_spec (hexists v hv)).1
  have chosenIndex_center_mem (v : FunctionField.Place k X.functionField)
      (hv : pointOfPlace k v ∈ W) : pointOfPlace k v ∈ U (chosenIndex v hv) :=
    (Classical.choose_spec (hexists v hv)).2
  let rep (i : ι) : FunctionField.AdeleSpace k X.functionField :=
    principalPartRepresentative k D (U i) (sf i)
  let gluedFun : FunctionField.Place k X.functionField → X.functionField := fun v =>
    if hv : pointOfPlace k v ∈ W then (rep (chosenIndex v hv)).1 v else 0
  have hbad (i : ι) :
      {v : FunctionField.Place k X.functionField |
        (rep i).1 v ∉ v.toValuationSubring}.Finite :=
    Filter.eventually_cofinite.mp (rep i).property
  have hbadUnion :
      (⋃ i ∈ (↑t : Set ι),
        {v : FunctionField.Place k X.functionField |
          (rep i).1 v ∉ v.toValuationSubring}).Finite :=
    Set.Finite.biUnion t.finite_toSet fun i _ => hbad i
  have gluedFun_eventually :
      ∀ᶠ v : FunctionField.Place k X.functionField in cofinite,
        gluedFun v ∈ v.toValuationSubring := by
    rw [Filter.eventually_cofinite]
    refine hbadUnion.subset ?_
    intro v hv
    by_cases hvW : pointOfPlace k v ∈ W
    · apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
      refine ⟨chosenIndex v hvW, ?_⟩
      apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
      refine ⟨chosenIndex_mem v hvW, ?_⟩
      simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, gluedFun, dif_pos hvW] using hv
    · simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, gluedFun, dif_neg hvW] at hv
      exact (hv v.toValuationSubring.zero_mem).elim
  let gluedAdele : FunctionField.AdeleSpace k X.functionField :=
    ⟨gluedFun, gluedFun_eventually⟩
  let sec : ↑((adelicPrincipalPartsPresheaf k D).obj (op W)) :=
    (adeleFiltOn k D W).mkQ gluedAdele
  have hsec (i : ι) :
      (adelicPrincipalPartsPresheaf k D).map (Opens.leSupr U i).op sec = sf i := by
    rw [show sf i = (adeleFiltOn k D (U i)).mkQ (rep i) by
      exact (mk_principalPartRepresentative k D (U i) (sf i)).symm]
    change (adeleFiltOn k D (U i)).mkQ gluedAdele =
      (adeleFiltOn k D (U i)).mkQ (rep i)
    apply (Submodule.Quotient.eq (adeleFiltOn k D (U i))).mpr
    intro v hvi
    have hvW : pointOfPlace k v ∈ W :=
      Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨i, hvi⟩
    let j : ι := chosenIndex v hvW
    have hvj : pointOfPlace k v ∈ U j := chosenIndex_center_mem v hvW
    have hcompat := hsf j i
    rw [show sf j = (adeleFiltOn k D (U j)).mkQ (rep j) by
      exact (mk_principalPartRepresentative k D (U j) (sf j)).symm,
      show sf i = (adeleFiltOn k D (U i)).mkQ (rep i) by
        exact (mk_principalPartRepresentative k D (U i) (sf i)).symm] at hcompat
    have hdiff := (Submodule.Quotient.eq
      (adeleFiltOn k D (U j ⊓ U i))).mp hcompat
    have hvdiff := hdiff v ⟨hvj, hvi⟩
    change v.valuation ((rep j - rep i).1 v) ≤ WithZero.exp (D v) at hvdiff
    change v.valuation ((gluedAdele - rep i).1 v) ≤ WithZero.exp (D v)
    change v.valuation (gluedFun v - (rep i).1 v) ≤ WithZero.exp (D v)
    have hglue : gluedFun v = (rep j).1 v := by
      simp only [gluedFun, dif_pos hvW, j]
    rw [hglue]
    exact hvdiff
  refine ⟨sec, hsec, ?_⟩
  intro sec' hsec'
  let sec'' : FunctionField.AdeleSpace k X.functionField ⧸ adeleFiltOn k D W := sec'
  change sec'' = sec
  rw [show sec'' = (adeleFiltOn k D W).mkQ
      (principalPartRepresentative k D W sec'') by
    exact (mk_principalPartRepresentative k D W sec'').symm]
  change (adeleFiltOn k D W).mkQ (principalPartRepresentative k D W sec'') =
    (adeleFiltOn k D W).mkQ gluedAdele
  apply (Submodule.Quotient.eq (adeleFiltOn k D W)).mpr
  intro v hvW
  obtain ⟨i, hvi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hvW
  have hi := hsec' i
  change (adelicPrincipalPartsPresheaf k D).map (Opens.leSupr U i).op sec'' = sf i at hi
  rw [show sec'' = (adeleFiltOn k D W).mkQ
      (principalPartRepresentative k D W sec'') by
        exact (mk_principalPartRepresentative k D W sec'').symm,
    ← hsec i] at hi
  change (adeleFiltOn k D (U i)).mkQ
      (principalPartRepresentative k D W sec'') =
    (adeleFiltOn k D (U i)).mkQ gluedAdele at hi
  have hdiff := (Submodule.Quotient.eq (adeleFiltOn k D (U i))).mp hi
  exact hdiff v hvi

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.rationalSectionValue_add
statement:
private lemma rationalSectionValue_add (U : X.Opens)
    (s t : ↑((functionFieldSheaf X).val.obj (op U))) :
    rationalSectionValue (X := X) U (s + t) =
      rationalSectionValue (X := X) U s + rationalSectionValue (X := X) U t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hU : Nonempty ↑U
  · simp only [rationalSectionValue, dif_pos hU, eval_add]
  · have hz : IsZero (((functionFieldSheaf X).val.presheaf).obj (op U)) :=
      skyscraperPresheaf_obj_isZero (genericPoint X) (AddCommGrpCat.of X.functionField)
        (fun h => hU ⟨⟨genericPoint X, h⟩⟩)
    letI : Subsingleton ↑((functionFieldSheaf X).val.obj (op U)) :=
      AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero hz
    have hs : s = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    have ht : t = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    subst s
    subst t
    simp only [rationalSectionValue, dif_neg hU, add_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.rationalSectionValue_map
statement:
private lemma rationalSectionValue_map {U V : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ U)
    (s : ↑((functionFieldSheaf X).val.obj (op U))) [hV : Nonempty ↑V] :
    rationalSectionValue (X := X) V
        ((functionFieldSheaf X).val.map (homOfLE h).op s) =
      rationalSectionValue (X := X) U s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let hU : Nonempty ↑U := hV.map fun x => ⟨x.1, h x.2⟩
  letI : Nonempty ↑U := hU
  simp only [rationalSectionValue, dif_pos hV, dif_pos hU]
  rw [eval_map]
  exact congrArg (fun x => eval x s) (Subsingleton.elim _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.rationalSectionValue_constSection
statement:
private lemma rationalSectionValue_constSection (U : X.Opens) [hU : Nonempty ↑U]
    (f : X.functionField) :
    rationalSectionValue (X := X) U (constSection (U := op U) f) = f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [rationalSectionValue, dif_pos hU, eval_constSection]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.germ_structureRingHom
statement:
private lemma germ_structureRingHom (U : X.Opens) (x : X) (hx : x ∈ U) (c : k) :
    X.presheaf.germ U x hx
        (structureRingHom (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) U c) =
      algebraMap k (X.presheaf.stalk x) c
proof:
:= by
  change X.presheaf.germ U x hx
      (X.presheaf.map U.leTop.op
        (globalSec (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) c)) =
    X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial
      (X.presheaf.map (⊤ : X.Opens).leTop.op
        (globalSec (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) c))
  rw [X.presheaf.germ_res_apply]
  have htop : (⊤ : X.Opens).leTop = 𝟙 (⊤ : X.Opens) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [htop]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.rationalSectionValue_smul
statement:
private lemma rationalSectionValue_smul (U : X.Opens) (c : k)
    (s : ↑((functionFieldSheaf X).val.obj (op U))) :
    rationalSectionValue (X := X) U
        ((structureRingHom (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) U c) • s) =
      c • rationalSectionValue (X := X) U s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hU : Nonempty ↑U
  · letI : Nonempty ↑U := hU
    simp only [rationalSectionValue, dif_pos hU]
    let x := genericFiberWitness (X := X) U
    let a := structureRingHom (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) U c
    calc
      eval x (a • s) =
          X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) x.down.down a * eval x s :=
        eval_smul x a s
      _ = algebraMap k X.functionField c * eval x s := by
        change algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X)) X.functionField
            (X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) x.down.down a) * eval x s = _
        rw [germ_structureRingHom]
        rw [Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply]
        apply congrArg (fun z : X.functionField => z * eval x s)
        rw [CompatibleAlgebra.algebraMap_eq (X := X) (k := k)]
        rfl
      _ = c • eval x s := (Algebra.smul_def c _).symm
  · simp only [rationalSectionValue, dif_neg hU, smul_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.constSection_rationalSectionValue
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hU : Nonempty ↑U
  · letI : Nonempty ↑U := hU
    refine pi_ext _ fun x => ?_
    change eval x (constSection (rationalSectionValue (X := X) U s)) = eval x s
    rw [eval_constSection]
    simp only [rationalSectionValue, dif_pos hU]
    change eval (genericFiberWitness (X := X) U) s = eval x s
    exact congrArg (fun y => eval y s) (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  · have hz : IsZero (((functionFieldSheaf X).val.presheaf).obj (op U)) :=
      skyscraperPresheaf_obj_isZero (genericPoint X) (AddCommGrpCat.of X.functionField)
        (fun h => hU ⟨⟨genericPoint X, h⟩⟩)
    letI : Subsingleton ↑((functionFieldSheaf X).val.obj (op U)) :=
      AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero hz
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.mem_carrier_iff_diagonal_mem_adeleFiltOn
statement:
lemma mem_carrier_iff_diagonal_mem_adeleFiltOn (f : X.functionField) (U : X.Opens)
    [Nonempty ↑U] :
    f ∈ AlgebraicCycle.Sheaf.carrier D.1 U ↔
      properCurveDiagonal k f ∈
        adeleFiltOn k (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D) U
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : f = 0
  · subst f
    simp only [AlgebraicCycle.Sheaf.zero_mem' D.1 U,
      map_zero, Submodule.zero_mem]
  constructor
  · intro h v hvU
    let p : CodimOnePoint X := (codimOnePointEquivPlace k).symm v
    have hpU : p.1 ∈ U := by
      simpa only [pointOfPlace, p] using hvU
    have hp := (AlgebraicCycle.Sheaf.mem_carrier_iff.mp h hf).2 p.1 hpU
    rw [← (codimOnePointEquivPlace k).apply_symm_apply v]
    rw [weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor_apply]
    change (placeOfCodimOnePoint k p).valuation f ≤ WithZero.exp (D.1 p.1)
    rw [valuation_eq_exp_neg_ord k p hf]
    exact WithZero.exp_le_exp.mpr (by omega)
  · intro h
    rw [AlgebraicCycle.Sheaf.mem_carrier_iff]
    intro _
    refine ⟨inferInstance, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    by_cases hz1 : coheight z = 1
    · let p : CodimOnePoint X := ⟨z, hz1⟩
      have hp := h (codimOnePointEquivPlace k p)
      have hcenter : pointOfPlace k (codimOnePointEquivPlace k p) = z := by
        simp only [pointOfPlace, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, p]
      specialize hp (hcenter.symm ▸ hz)
      rw [weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor_apply] at hp
      change (placeOfCodimOnePoint k p).valuation f ≤ WithZero.exp (D.1 p.1) at hp
      rw [valuation_eq_exp_neg_ord k p hf] at hp
      have hp' := WithZero.exp_le_exp.mp hp
      change 0 ≤ X.ord f p.1 + D.1 p.1
      omega
    · have hord : X.ord f z = 0 := Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hz1 f
      have hD : D.1 z = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hz1 (D.2 (show z ∈ D.1.support from hne))
      rw [hord, hD]
      omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.rationalSectionValue_mem_carrier_of_mk_eq_zero
statement:
private lemma rationalSectionValue_mem_carrier_of_mk_eq_zero (U : X.Opens)
    (s : ↑((functionFieldSheaf X).val.obj (op U)))
    (h : (adeleFiltOn k (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D) U).mkQ
      (properCurveDiagonal k
        (rationalSectionValue (X := X) U s)) = 0) :
    rationalSectionValue (X := X) U s ∈ AlgebraicCycle.Sheaf.carrier D.1 U
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hU : Nonempty ↑U
  · letI : Nonempty ↑U := hU
    rw [mem_carrier_iff_diagonal_mem_adeleFiltOn k D]
    exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mp h
  · have hs : rationalSectionValue (X := X) U s = 0 := by
      simp only [rationalSectionValue, dif_neg hU]
    rw [hs]
    exact AlgebraicCycle.Sheaf.zero_mem' D.1 U

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.rationalToAdelicPrincipalParts_smulEnd
statement:
private lemma rationalToAdelicPrincipalParts_smulEnd (c : k) :
    smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of k) (functionFieldSheaf X) c ≫
        rationalToAdelicPrincipalParts k D =
      rationalToAdelicPrincipalParts k D ≫
        adelicPrincipalPartsSmulEnd k
          (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D) c
proof:
:= by
  apply CategoryTheory.Sheaf.hom_ext
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext U
  apply AddCommGrpCat.hom_ext
  ext s
  let s' : ↑((functionFieldSheaf X).val.obj U) := s
  change (adeleFiltOn k (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D) (unop U)).mkQ
      (properCurveDiagonal k
        (rationalSectionValue (X := X) (unop U)
          ((structureRingHom (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) (unop U) c) • s'))) =
    c • (adeleFiltOn k (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D) (unop U)).mkQ
      (properCurveDiagonal k
        (rationalSectionValue (X := X) (unop U) s'))
  rw [rationalSectionValue_smul, map_smul, map_smul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.adele_bound_exceptional_finite
statement:
lemma adele_bound_exceptional_finite
    (E : FunctionField.Divisor k X.functionField)
    (a : FunctionField.AdeleSpace k X.functionField) :
    {v : FunctionField.Place k X.functionField |
      ¬v.valuation (a.1 v) ≤ WithZero.exp (E v)}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  have ha : {v : FunctionField.Place k X.functionField |
      ¬v.valuation (a.1 v) ≤ 1}.Finite :=
    (Filter.eventually_cofinite.mp a.property).subset (by
      intro v hv
      change a.1 v ∉ v.toValuationSubring
      intro haMem
      apply hv
      rw [← Valuation.mem_valuationSubring_iff,
        Place.valuationSubring_valuation]
      exact haMem)
  refine (ha.union E.support.finite_toSet).subset ?_
  intro v hv
  by_cases hav : ¬v.valuation (a.1 v) ≤ 1
  · exact Or.inl hav
  · apply Or.inr
    apply Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr
    intro hE
    apply hv
    simpa only [hE, WithZero.exp_zero] using not_not.mp hav

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.rationalToAdelicPrincipalParts_isLocallySurjective
statement:
lemma rationalToAdelicPrincipalParts_isLocallySurjective :
    CategoryTheory.Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective (rationalToAdelicPrincipalParts k D)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine (TopCat.Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff _).mpr ?_
  intro U q z hzU
  let E := weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D
  let a : FunctionField.AdeleSpace k X.functionField :=
    principalPartRepresentative k E U q
  by_cases hz1 : coheight z = 1
  · let p : CodimOnePoint X := ⟨z, hz1⟩
    let v : FunctionField.Place k X.functionField := codimOnePointEquivPlace k p
    let f : X.functionField := a.1 v
    let b : FunctionField.AdeleSpace k X.functionField :=
      properCurveDiagonal k f - a
    let bad : Set (FunctionField.Place k X.functionField) :=
      {w | ¬w.valuation (b.1 w) ≤ WithZero.exp (E w)}
    have hbad : bad.Finite := adele_bound_exceptional_finite k E b
    let badCenters : Set X := ⋃ w ∈ bad, ({pointOfPlace k w} : Set X)
    have hbadCenters : IsClosed badCenters := by
      exact hbad.isClosed_biUnion fun w _ =>
        isClosed_singleton_of_coheight_eq_one (X := X) (pointOfPlace_coheight k w)
    have hzbad : z ∉ badCenters := by
      intro hz
      simp only [badCenters, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
      obtain ⟨w, hwbad, hwz⟩ := hz
      have hwv : w = v := by
        apply (codimOnePointEquivPlace k).symm.injective
        apply Subtype.ext
        calc
          ((codimOnePointEquivPlace k).symm w).1 = pointOfPlace k w := rfl
          _ = z := hwz.symm
          _ = p.1 := rfl
          _ = ((codimOnePointEquivPlace k).symm v).1 :=
            congrArg Subtype.val ((codimOnePointEquivPlace k).symm_apply_apply p).symm
      subst w
      apply hwbad
      change v.valuation ((properCurveDiagonal k f - a).1 v) ≤
        WithZero.exp (E v)
      change v.valuation (f - a.1 v) ≤ WithZero.exp (E v)
      simp only [f, sub_self, map_zero]
      exact bot_le
    let V : X.Opens := U ⊓ ⟨badCentersᶜ, hbadCenters.isOpen_compl⟩
    have hzV : z ∈ V := ⟨hzU, hzbad⟩
    letI : Nonempty ↑V := ⟨⟨z, hzV⟩⟩
    let s := constSection (U := op V) f
    refine ⟨V, inf_le_left, ⟨s, ?_⟩, hzV⟩
    rw [← mk_principalPartRepresentative k E U q]
    change (adeleFiltOn k E V).mkQ
        (properCurveDiagonal k
          (rationalSectionValue (X := X) V s)) =
      (adeleFiltOn k E V).mkQ a
    rw [rationalSectionValue_constSection]
    apply (Submodule.Quotient.eq (adeleFiltOn k E V)).mpr
    intro w hwV
    have hwbad : w ∉ bad := by
      intro hw
      exact hwV.2 (by
        simp only [badCenters, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
        exact ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩)
    exact not_not.mp hwbad
  · let f : X.functionField := 0
    let b : FunctionField.AdeleSpace k X.functionField :=
      properCurveDiagonal k f - a
    let bad : Set (FunctionField.Place k X.functionField) :=
      {w | ¬w.valuation (b.1 w) ≤ WithZero.exp (E w)}
    have hbad : bad.Finite := adele_bound_exceptional_finite k E b
    let badCenters : Set X := ⋃ w ∈ bad, ({pointOfPlace k w} : Set X)
    have hbadCenters : IsClosed badCenters := by
      exact hbad.isClosed_biUnion fun w _ =>
        isClosed_singleton_of_coheight_eq_one (X := X) (pointOfPlace_coheight k w)
    have hzbad : z ∉ badCenters := by
      intro hz
      simp only [badCenters, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
      obtain ⟨w, _, hwz⟩ := hz
      exact hz1 (hwz ▸ pointOfPlace_coheight k w)
    let V : X.Opens := U ⊓ ⟨badCentersᶜ, hbadCenters.isOpen_compl⟩
    have hzV : z ∈ V := ⟨hzU, hzbad⟩
    letI : Nonempty ↑V := ⟨⟨z, hzV⟩⟩
    let s := constSection (U := op V) f
    refine ⟨V, inf_le_left, ⟨s, ?_⟩, hzV⟩
    rw [← mk_principalPartRepresentative k E U q]
    change (adeleFiltOn k E V).mkQ
        (properCurveDiagonal k
          (rationalSectionValue (X := X) V s)) =
      (adeleFiltOn k E V).mkQ a
    rw [rationalSectionValue_constSection]
    apply (Submodule.Quotient.eq (adeleFiltOn k E V)).mpr
    intro w hwV
    have hwbad : w ∉ bad := by
      intro hw
      exact hwV.2 (by
        simp only [badCenters, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
        exact ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩)
    exact not_not.mp hwbad

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.adelicResolution_exact
statement: lemma adelicResolution_exact : (adelicResolution k D).Exact
proof:
:= by
  apply ShortComplex.exact_of_f_is_kernel
  refine KernelFork.IsLimit.ofι' _ _ fun {A} l hl => ⟨⟨{
    app := fun U => AddCommGrpCat.ofHom <| AddMonoidHom.mk'
      (fun a => ⟨rationalSectionValue (X := X) (unop U) (l.hom.app U a), by
        apply rationalSectionValue_mem_carrier_of_mk_eq_zero k D
        have h0 := congrArg (fun (ψ : A ⟶
            adelicPrincipalPartsSheaf k (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D)) =>
          ψ.hom.app U a) hl
        change (adeleFiltOn k (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D) (unop U)).mkQ
            (properCurveDiagonal k
              (rationalSectionValue (X := X) (unop U) (l.hom.app U a))) = 0 at h0
        exact h0⟩)
      (fun a b => by
        apply Subtype.ext
        change rationalSectionValue (X := X) (unop U) (l.hom.app U (a + b)) =
          rationalSectionValue (X := X) (unop U) (l.hom.app U a) +
            rationalSectionValue (X := X) (unop U) (l.hom.app U b)
        rw [map_add]
        exact rationalSectionValue_add (X := X) (unop U) _ _)
    naturality := fun {U V} r => by
      apply AddCommGrpCat.hom_ext
      ext a
      by_cases hV : Nonempty ↑(unop V)
      · letI : Nonempty ↑(unop V) := hV
        apply Subtype.ext
        simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
        change rationalSectionValue (X := X) (unop V)
            (l.hom.app V (A.obj.map r a)) =
          (AlgebraicCycle.Sheaf.mapFun D.1 r.unop.le _).1
        rw [AlgebraicCycle.Sheaf.mapFunApplyNonempty]
        change rationalSectionValue (X := X) (unop V)
            (l.hom.app V (A.obj.map r a)) =
          rationalSectionValue (X := X) (unop U) (l.hom.app U a)
        have hn := congrArg (fun φ => φ a) (l.hom.naturality r)
        change l.hom.app V (A.obj.map r a) =
          (functionFieldSheaf X).val.map r (l.hom.app U a) at hn
        rw [hn, show r = (homOfLE r.unop.le).op from Subsingleton.elim _ _,
          rationalSectionValue_map r.unop.le]
      · letI : Subsingleton ↑((adelicResolution k D).X₁.obj.obj V) :=
          AlgebraicCycle.Sheaf.instSubsingleTonOfEmpty hV
        exact Subsingleton.elim _ _ }⟩, ?_⟩
  apply CategoryTheory.Sheaf.hom_ext
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext U
  apply AddCommGrpCat.hom_ext
  ext a
  change constSection (U := U)
      (rationalSectionValue (X := X) (unop U) (l.hom.app U a)) = l.hom.app U a
  exact constSection_rationalSectionValue (X := X) (unop U) (l.hom.app U a)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.adelicResolution_shortExact
statement:
lemma adelicResolution_shortExact : (adelicResolution k D).ShortExact where
  exact
proof:
:= adelicResolution_exact k D
  mono_f := adelicResolution_mono k D
  epi_g := adelicResolution_epi k D

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.principalPartsSheafIsoAdelic_hom_fac
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma principalPartsSheafIsoAdelic_hom_fac :
    (Modules.toSheafAb X).map (cokernel.π (divisorToFunctionField D.1)) ≫
        (principalPartsSheafIsoAdelic k D).hom =
      rationalToAdelicPrincipalParts k D
proof:
:= by
  let hQ := shortExact_map_toSheaf (rationalFunctionComplex_shortExact D.1)
  let hA := adelicResolution_shortExact k D
  exact IsColimit.comp_coconePointUniqueUpToIso_hom
    hQ.gIsCokernel hA.gIsCokernel WalkingParallelPair.one

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.principalPartsSheaf_isFlasque
statement:
lemma principalPartsSheaf_isFlasque
    (e : (Modules.toSheafAb X).obj (principalPartsSheaf D.1) ≅
      adelicPrincipalPartsSheaf k (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D)) :
    TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque ((Modules.toSheafAb X).obj (principalPartsSheaf D.1)) where
  epi {U V} r
proof:
:= by
    rw [← epi_comp_iff_of_isIso
      (((Modules.toSheafAb X).obj (principalPartsSheaf D.1)).obj.map r)
      (e.hom.hom.app V)]
    rw [e.hom.hom.naturality r]
    infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.principalPartsSheafIsoAdelic_hom_smulEnd
statement:
private lemma principalPartsSheafIsoAdelic_hom_smulEnd (c : k) :
    smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of k) (principalPartsSheaf D.1) c ≫
        (principalPartsSheafIsoAdelic k D).hom =
      (principalPartsSheafIsoAdelic k D).hom ≫
        adelicPrincipalPartsSmulEnd k
          (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D) c
proof:
:= by
  let hQ := shortExact_map_toSheaf (rationalFunctionComplex_shortExact D.1)
  letI : Epi ((Modules.toSheafAb X).map
      (cokernel.π (divisorToFunctionField D.1))) := hQ.epi_g
  rw [← cancel_epi
    ((Modules.toSheafAb X).map (cokernel.π (divisorToFunctionField D.1)))]
  simp only [← Category.assoc]
  rw [← smulEnd_naturality (R := CommRingCat.of k)
      (cokernel.π (divisorToFunctionField D.1)) c,
    principalPartsSheafIsoAdelic_hom_fac]
  rw [Category.assoc, principalPartsSheafIsoAdelic_hom_fac,
    rationalToAdelicPrincipalParts_smulEnd]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.principalPartsConnecting_surjective
statement:
lemma principalPartsConnecting_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (principalPartsConnecting k D)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  let S := (rationalFunctionComplex D.1).map (Modules.toSheafAb X)
  let hS := shortExact_map_toSheaf (rationalFunctionComplex_shortExact D.1)
  letI : TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque S.X₂ := by
    dsimp only [S, ShortComplex.map_X₂]
    exact functionFieldSheaf_isFlasque
  have hx : CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.map S.f 1 x = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.longSequence_exact₁
    hS 0 1 rfl x hx
  exact ⟨q, hq⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.principalPartsConnecting_ker
statement:
lemma principalPartsConnecting_ker :
    LinearMap.ker (principalPartsConnecting k D) =
      LinearMap.range (rationalToPrincipalPartsH0 k D)
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  constructor
  · intro hq
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at hq
    let hS := shortExact_map_toSheaf (rationalFunctionComplex_shortExact D.1)
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.longSequence_exact₃
      hS 0 1 rfl q hq
    exact ⟨f, hf⟩
  · rintro ⟨f, rfl⟩
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
    let hS := shortExact_map_toSheaf (rationalFunctionComplex_shortExact D.1)
    have hz := (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.longSequence_exact hS 0 1 rfl).zero 1
    have hz' := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hz f
    exact hz'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.principalPartsH0LinearEquiv_rationalToPrincipalPartsH0
statement:
lemma principalPartsH0LinearEquiv_rationalToPrincipalPartsH0
    (f : Scheme.Modules.H (functionFieldSheaf X) 0) :
    principalPartsH0LinearEquiv k D (rationalToPrincipalPartsH0 k D f) =
      (FunctionField.adeleFilt k X.functionField
        (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D)).mkQ
          (properCurveDiagonal k
            (rationalSectionValue (X := X) ⊤
              (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.equiv₀
                ((Modules.toSheafAb X).obj (functionFieldSheaf X)) isTerminalTop f)))
proof:
:= by
  let Ksheaf := (Modules.toSheafAb X).obj (functionFieldSheaf X)
  let Qsheaf := (Modules.toSheafAb X).obj (principalPartsSheaf D.1)
  let g := (Modules.toSheafAb X).map (cokernel.π (divisorToFunctionField D.1))
  let s := CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.equiv₀ Ksheaf isTerminalTop f
  have hnat : CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.equiv₀ Qsheaf isTerminalTop
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.map g 0 f) = g.hom.app (op ⊤) s :=
    (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.equiv₀_naturality (hT := isTerminalTop) (f := g) f).symm
  change principalPartsGlobalLinearEquiv k D
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.equiv₀ Qsheaf isTerminalTop
        (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.map g 0 f)) = _
  rw [hnat]
  have hfac := congrArg (fun (ψ : Ksheaf ⟶
      adelicPrincipalPartsSheaf k (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D)) =>
    ψ.hom.app (op ⊤) s) (principalPartsSheafIsoAdelic_hom_fac k D)
  change (principalPartsSheafIsoAdelic k D).hom.hom.app (op ⊤)
      (g.hom.app (op ⊤) s) =
    (adeleFiltOn k (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D) ⊤).mkQ
      (properCurveDiagonal k
        (rationalSectionValue (X := X) ⊤ s)) at hfac
  change (Submodule.quotEquivOfEq
      (adeleFiltOn k (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D) ⊤)
      (FunctionField.adeleFilt k X.functionField
        (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D))
      (adeleFiltOn_top k (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D)))
        ((principalPartsSheafIsoAdelic k D).hom.hom.app (op ⊤)
          (g.hom.app (op ⊤) s)) = _
  rw [hfac]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.principalPartsH0_mappedRange_eq_diagonal
statement:
lemma principalPartsH0_mappedRange_eq_diagonal :
    Submodule.map (principalPartsH0LinearEquiv k D).toLinearMap
        (LinearMap.range (rationalToPrincipalPartsH0 k D)) =
      Submodule.map
        (FunctionField.adeleFilt k X.functionField
          (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D)).mkQ
        (FunctionField.diagonalSubmodule k X.functionField)
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, ⟨f, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    let a := rationalSectionValue (X := X) ⊤
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.equiv₀
        ((Modules.toSheafAb X).obj (functionFieldSheaf X)) isTerminalTop f)
    have h := principalPartsH0LinearEquiv_rationalToPrincipalPartsH0 k D f
    have hm : (FunctionField.adeleFilt k X.functionField
        (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D)).mkQ
          (properCurveDiagonal k a) ∈
        Submodule.map
          (FunctionField.adeleFilt k X.functionField
            (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D)).mkQ
          (FunctionField.diagonalSubmodule k X.functionField) :=
      ⟨properCurveDiagonal k a, ⟨a, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact h.symm ▸ hm
  · rintro ⟨a, ⟨f, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    let e₀ := CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.equiv₀
      ((Modules.toSheafAb X).obj (functionFieldSheaf X)) isTerminalTop
    let x : Scheme.Modules.H (functionFieldSheaf X) 0 :=
      e₀.symm (constSection (U := op (⊤ : X.Opens)) f)
    refine ⟨rationalToPrincipalPartsH0 k D x, ⟨x, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    calc
      principalPartsH0LinearEquiv k D (rationalToPrincipalPartsH0 k D x) =
          (FunctionField.adeleFilt k X.functionField
            (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D)).mkQ
              (properCurveDiagonal k
                (rationalSectionValue (X := X) ⊤ (e₀ x))) :=
        principalPartsH0LinearEquiv_rationalToPrincipalPartsH0 k D x
      _ = _ := by
        rw [show e₀ x = constSection (U := op (⊤ : X.Opens)) f from
          e₀.apply_symm_apply _, rationalSectionValue_constSection,
          properCurveDiagonal_eq_diagonal]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.principalPartsH0_mappedRange_eq_properCurveDiagonal
statement:
lemma principalPartsH0_mappedRange_eq_properCurveDiagonal :
    Submodule.map (principalPartsH0LinearEquiv k D).toLinearMap
        (LinearMap.range (rationalToPrincipalPartsH0 k D)) =
      Submodule.map
        (FunctionField.adeleFilt k X.functionField
          (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D)).mkQ
        (properCurveDiagonalSubmodule (X := X) k)
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, ⟨f, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    let a := rationalSectionValue (X := X) ⊤
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.equiv₀
        ((Modules.toSheafAb X).obj (functionFieldSheaf X)) isTerminalTop f)
    have h := principalPartsH0LinearEquiv_rationalToPrincipalPartsH0 k D f
    have hm : (FunctionField.adeleFilt k X.functionField
        (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D)).mkQ
          (properCurveDiagonal k a) ∈
        Submodule.map
          (FunctionField.adeleFilt k X.functionField
            (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D)).mkQ
          (properCurveDiagonalSubmodule (X := X) k) :=
      ⟨properCurveDiagonal k a, ⟨a, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact h.symm ▸ hm
  · rintro ⟨a, ⟨f, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    let e₀ := CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.equiv₀
      ((Modules.toSheafAb X).obj (functionFieldSheaf X)) isTerminalTop
    let x : Scheme.Modules.H (functionFieldSheaf X) 0 :=
      e₀.symm (constSection (U := op (⊤ : X.Opens)) f)
    refine ⟨rationalToPrincipalPartsH0 k D x, ⟨x, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    calc
      principalPartsH0LinearEquiv k D (rationalToPrincipalPartsH0 k D x) =
          (FunctionField.adeleFilt k X.functionField
            (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D)).mkQ
              (properCurveDiagonal k
                (rationalSectionValue (X := X) ⊤ (e₀ x))) :=
        principalPartsH0LinearEquiv_rationalToPrincipalPartsH0 k D x
      _ = _ := by
        rw [show e₀ x = constSection (U := op (⊤ : X.Opens)) f from
          e₀.apply_symm_apply _, rationalSectionValue_constSection]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.finite_H_one_of_properCurveAdeleQuotient
statement:
theorem finite_H_one_of_properCurveAdeleQuotient
    (hfinite : Module.Finite k
      (FunctionField.AdeleSpace k X.functionField ⧸
        (FunctionField.adeleFilt k X.functionField
            (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D) +
          properCurveDiagonalSubmodule (X := X) k))) :
    Module.Finite k (Scheme.Modules.H D.1.sheaf 1)
proof:
:= by
  letI := hfinite
  exact Module.Finite.equiv (H1LinearEquivProperCurveAdeleQuotient k D).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.subsingleton_H_of_two_le
statement:
theorem subsingleton_H_of_two_le
    (e : (Modules.toSheafAb X).obj (principalPartsSheaf D.1) ≅
      adelicPrincipalPartsSheaf k (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D))
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    Subsingleton (Scheme.Modules.H D.1.sheaf n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hn
  rw [Nat.add_comm 2 m]
  let S := (rationalFunctionComplex D.1).map (Modules.toSheafAb X)
  let hS := shortExact_map_toSheaf (rationalFunctionComplex_shortExact D.1)
  letI : TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque S.X₂ := by
    dsimp only [S, ShortComplex.map_X₂]
    exact functionFieldSheaf_isFlasque
  letI : TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque S.X₃ := by
    dsimp only [S, ShortComplex.map_X₃]
    exact principalPartsSheaf_isFlasque k D e
  constructor
  intro x y
  have zero_of (z : Scheme.Modules.H D.1.sheaf (m + 2)) : z = 0 := by
    have hz : CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.map S.f (m + 2) z = 0 :=
      Subsingleton.elim _ _
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.longSequence_exact₁
      hS (m + 1) (m + 2) rfl z hz
    have hq0 : q = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [hq0, map_zero] at hq
    exact hq.symm
  exact (zero_of x).trans (zero_of y).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.affineSpectrum_h_eq_zero
statement:
theorem affineSpectrum_h_eq_zero
    (F : (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (i : ℕ) (hi : 0 < i) :
    Scheme.Modules.h k F i = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : i ≠ 0)
  rw [Scheme.Modules.h]
  letI : Subsingleton (F.H (j + 1)) :=
    AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero
      (quasicoherent_H_isZero F j)
  exact Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.affineSpectrum_eulerChar_eq_finrank_globalSections
statement:
theorem affineSpectrum_eulerChar_eq_finrank_globalSections
    (F : (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    Scheme.Modules.eulerChar k F =
      Module.finrank k
        ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of k)).obj F)
proof:
:= by
  rw [SchemeKTheory.eulerChar_eq_alternatingSum k F 0
    (fun i hi ↦ affineSpectrum_h_eq_zero k F i hi)]
  simp only [Nat.zero_add, Finset.range_one, Finset.sum_singleton, pow_zero, one_mul]
  rw [Scheme.Modules.h]
  exact_mod_cast (affineSpectrumHZeroLinearEquivSections k F).finrank_eq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.affineSpectrum_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic
statement:
theorem affineSpectrum_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic
    (F : (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] :
    F.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation k
      ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of k)).obj F) :=
    moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation F
  refine ⟨?_, 0, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    by_cases hi : i = 0
    · subst i
      exact Module.Finite.equiv
        (affineSpectrumHZeroLinearEquivSections k F).symm
    · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hi
      letI : Subsingleton (F.H (j + 1)) :=
        AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero
          (quasicoherent_H_isZero F j)
      exact Module.Finite.of_surjective
        (0 : k →ₗ[k] F.H (j + 1))
        (fun y ↦ ⟨0, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩)
  · intro i hi
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : i ≠ 0)
    exact AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero
      (quasicoherent_H_isZero F j)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.eulerChar_eq_h_zero_sub_h_one
statement:
lemma eulerChar_eq_h_zero_sub_h_one {X : Scheme.{u}} (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] (F : X.Modules)
    (hvanish : ∀ n, 1 < n → Subsingleton (F.H n)) :
    F.eulerChar k = (F.h k 0 : ℤ) - (F.h k 1 : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Modules.eulerChar,
    eulerChar_finsum_eq (N := 1) (fun n ↦ F.h k n)]
  · norm_num [Finset.sum_range_succ, sub_eq_add_neg]
  · intro n hn
    letI : Subsingleton (F.H n) := hvanish n hn
    exact Module.finrank_eq_zero_of_subsingleton k _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.full_riemann_roch_of_eulerChar_eq
statement:
theorem full_riemann_roch_of_eulerChar_eq {X : Scheme.{u}} (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [IsIntegral X] [IsNoetherian X]
    [IsRegularInCodimensionOne X]
    (D : SchemeWeilDivisor (X := X))
    (hRR :
      (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D.1).eulerChar k =
        AlgebraicCycle.degree k D.1 +
          (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.structureSheafModule X).eulerChar k)
    (hDvanish : ∀ n, 1 < n →
      Subsingleton
        (Scheme.Modules.H (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D.1) n))
    (hOvanish : ∀ n, 1 < n →
      Subsingleton
        (Scheme.Modules.H
          (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.structureSheafModule X) n)) :
    (Scheme.Modules.h k (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D.1) 0 : ℤ) -
        (Scheme.Modules.h k (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D.1) 1 : ℤ) =
      AlgebraicCycle.degree k D.1 +
        (Scheme.Modules.h k
          (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.structureSheafModule X) 0 : ℤ) -
        (Scheme.Modules.h k
          (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.structureSheafModule X) 1 : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eulerChar_eq_h_zero_sub_h_one k _ hDvanish,
    eulerChar_eq_h_zero_sub_h_one k _ hOvanish] at hRR
  simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc] using hRR

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.full_riemann_roch_structure_term
statement:
theorem full_riemann_roch_structure_term (D : SchemeWeilDivisor (X := X)) :
    (Scheme.Modules.h k (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D.1) 0 : ℤ) -
        (Scheme.Modules.h k (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D.1) 1 : ℤ) =
      AlgebraicCycle.degree k D.1 +
        (Scheme.Modules.h k (structureSheafModule X) 0 : ℤ) -
        (Scheme.Modules.h k (structureSheafModule X) 1 : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  apply full_riemann_roch_of_eulerChar_eq k D (riemann_roch_proper k D)
  · intro n hn
    letI : Subsingleton (Scheme.Modules.H D.1.sheaf n) :=
      subsingleton_H_of_two_le k D (principalPartsSheafIsoAdelic k D) n (by omega)
    exact ((hLinearEquivOfIso k (sheafIsoSheafViaSubmodule D.1) n).symm.toEquiv).subsingleton
  · intro n hn
    let D0 : SchemeWeilDivisor (X := X) :=
      ⟨0, fun _ hx ↦ (hx rfl).elim⟩
    letI : Subsingleton (Scheme.Modules.H D0.1.sheaf n) :=
      subsingleton_H_of_two_le k D0 (principalPartsSheafIsoAdelic k D0) n (by omega)
    letI : Subsingleton
        (Scheme.Modules.H (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D0.1) n) :=
      ((hLinearEquivOfIso k (sheafIsoSheafViaSubmodule D0.1) n).symm.toEquiv).subsingleton
    exact ((hLinearEquivOfIso k (unitIsoSheafZero (X := X)) n).toEquiv).subsingleton

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.h_one_eq_indexOfSpecialty_generalConstants
statement:
theorem h_one_eq_indexOfSpecialty_generalConstants
    (D : SchemeWeilDivisor (X := X)) :
    Scheme.Modules.h k (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D.1) 1 =
      FunctionField.indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants k X.functionField
        (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    Scheme.Modules.h k (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D.1) 1 =
        Scheme.Modules.h k D.1.sheaf 1 :=
      (h_eq_of_iso k (sheafIsoSheafViaSubmodule D.1) 1).symm
    _ = Module.finrank k
        (FunctionField.AdeleSpace k X.functionField ⧸
          (FunctionField.adeleFilt k X.functionField
              (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D) +
            FunctionField.diagonalSubmodule k X.functionField)) := by
      rw [Scheme.Modules.h]
      exact (H1LinearEquivAdeleQuotient k D).finrank_eq
    _ = FunctionField.finrankAdeleQuotient k X.functionField
        (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D) := rfl
    _ = FunctionField.indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants k X.functionField
        (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D) :=
      FunctionField.finrankAdeleQuotient_eq_indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants
        k X.functionField _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.h_one_eq_ell_canonical_sub_generalConstants
statement:
theorem h_one_eq_ell_canonical_sub_generalConstants
    {W : FunctionField.Divisor k X.functionField}
    (hW : FunctionField.IsCanonicalGeneralConstants k X.functionField W)
    (D : SchemeWeilDivisor (X := X)) :
    Scheme.Modules.h k (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D.1) 1 =
      FunctionField.ell k X.functionField
        (W - weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D)
proof:
:= by
  rw [h_one_eq_indexOfSpecialty_generalConstants k D]
  exact (FunctionField.duality_generalConstants k X.functionField hW _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.h_zero_structure_eq_ell_zero_generalConstants
statement:
theorem h_zero_structure_eq_ell_zero_generalConstants :
    Scheme.Modules.h k (structureSheafModule X) 0 =
      FunctionField.ell k X.functionField (0 : FunctionField.Divisor k X.functionField)
proof:
:= by
  let D0 : SchemeWeilDivisor (X := X) :=
    ⟨0, fun _ hx ↦ (hx rfl).elim⟩
  have hE0 : weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D0 = 0 := by
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro v
    let p : CodimOnePoint X := (codimOnePointEquivPlace k).symm v
    rw [← (codimOnePointEquivPlace k).apply_symm_apply v]
    rw [weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor_apply]
    rfl
  calc
    Scheme.Modules.h k (structureSheafModule X) 0 =
        Scheme.Modules.h k
          (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf (0 : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ)) 0 :=
      h_eq_of_iso k (unitIsoSheafZero (X := X)) 0
    _ = Scheme.Modules.h k
        (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D0.1) 0 := rfl
    _ = FunctionField.ell k X.functionField
        (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D0) := h_zero_eq_ell_submodule k D0
    _ = FunctionField.ell k X.functionField 0 := by rw [hE0]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.schemeGenus_eq_functionField_genusWithConstants
statement:
theorem schemeGenus_eq_functionField_genusWithConstants :
    schemeGenus (X := X) k =
      FunctionField.genusWithConstants k X.functionField
proof:
:= by
  let D0 : SchemeWeilDivisor (X := X) :=
    ⟨0, fun _ hx ↦ (hx rfl).elim⟩
  have hE0 : weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D0 = 0 := by
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro v
    let p : CodimOnePoint X := (codimOnePointEquivPlace k).symm v
    rw [← (codimOnePointEquivPlace k).apply_symm_apply v]
    rw [weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor_apply]
    rfl
  calc
    schemeGenus (X := X) k =
        Scheme.Modules.h k
          (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf (0 : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ)) 1 :=
      h_eq_of_iso k (unitIsoSheafZero (X := X)) 1
    _ = Scheme.Modules.h k
        (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D0.1) 1 := rfl
    _ = FunctionField.indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants k X.functionField
        (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D0) :=
      h_one_eq_indexOfSpecialty_generalConstants k D0
    _ = FunctionField.indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants k X.functionField 0 := by rw [hE0]
    _ = FunctionField.genusWithConstants k X.functionField := by
      have hi := FunctionField.indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants_eq
        k X.functionField (0 : FunctionField.Divisor k X.functionField)
      have hiZ :
          (FunctionField.indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants k X.functionField 0 : ℤ) =
            FunctionField.genusWithConstants k X.functionField := by
        simpa [FunctionField.Divisor.deg] using hi
      exact_mod_cast hiZ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.full_riemann_roch_generalConstants
statement:
theorem full_riemann_roch_generalConstants (D : SchemeWeilDivisor (X := X)) :
    (Scheme.Modules.h k (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D.1) 0 : ℤ) -
        (Scheme.Modules.h k (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D.1) 1 : ℤ) =
      AlgebraicCycle.degree k D.1 +
        FunctionField.ell k X.functionField
          (0 : FunctionField.Divisor k X.functionField) -
        (FunctionField.genusWithConstants k X.functionField : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [full_riemann_roch_structure_term k D,
    ← h_zero_structure_eq_ell_zero_generalConstants (X := X) k,
    ← schemeGenus_eq_functionField_genusWithConstants (X := X) k]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.exists_separatingElement_of_finrank_kaehler_eq_one
statement:
lemma exists_separatingElement_of_finrank_kaehler_eq_one
    (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    [Algebra.EssFiniteType k K] (htrans : ¬ Algebra.IsAlgebraic k K)
    (hfinrank : Module.finrank K Ω[K⁄k] = 1) :
    ∃ x : K, Transcendental k x ∧
      Algebra.IsSeparable (IntermediateField.adjoin k {x}) K
proof:
:= by
  haveI : FiniteDimensional K Ω[K⁄k] := FiniteDimensional.of_finrank_pos (by omega)
  have hnontrivial : Nontrivial Ω[K⁄k] :=
    Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos (by rw [hfinrank]; exact zero_lt_one)
  letI : Nontrivial Ω[K⁄k] := hnontrivial
  have hD : ∃ x : K, D k K x ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! h
    have hrange : Set.range (D k K) = {0} := by
      ext y
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
        simp [h x]
      · rintro rfl
        exact ⟨0, map_zero (D k K)⟩
    have htop : (⊤ : Submodule K Ω[K⁄k]) = ⊥ := by
      rw [← span_range_derivation k K, hrange, Submodule.span_singleton_eq_bot]
    exact top_ne_bot htop
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hD
  have hspan : ∀ y : Ω[K⁄k], ∃ c : K, c • D k K x = y :=
    (finrank_eq_one_iff_of_nonzero' (D k K x) hx).mp hfinrank
  let F := IntermediateField.adjoin k {x}
  letI : Algebra F K := F.toAlgebra
  letI : IsScalarTower k F K := IntermediateField.isScalarTower_mid' F
  haveI : Algebra.EssFiniteType F K := Algebra.EssFiniteType.of_comp k F K
  have hsubsingleton : Subsingleton Ω[K⁄F] := by
    constructor
    intro y z
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := KaehlerDifferential.map_surjective k F K y
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := KaehlerDifferential.map_surjective k F K z
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hspan y
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hspan z
    rw [← ha, ← hb, map_smul, map_smul, map_D]
    have hxF : x = algebraMap F K ⟨x, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k {x} (by simp)⟩ := rfl
    have hDx : D F K x = 0 := by
      calc
        D F K x = D F K (algebraMap F K
            ⟨x, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k {x} (by simp)⟩) := congrArg (D F K) hxF
        _ = 0 := Derivation.map_algebraMap (D F K) _
    have hDx' : D F K (algebraMap K K x) = 0 := by simpa using hDx
    rw [hDx', smul_zero, smul_zero]
  letI : Algebra.FormallyUnramified F K := ⟨hsubsingleton⟩
  have hsep : Algebra.IsSeparable F K :=
    (Algebra.FormallyUnramified.iff_isSeparable F K).mp inferInstance
  have hxtrans : Transcendental k x := by
    intro hxalg
    haveI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic k F :=
      IntermediateField.isAlgebraic_adjoin_simple hxalg.isIntegral
    haveI : Algebra.IsSeparable F K := hsep
    exact htrans (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.trans k F K)
  exact ⟨x, hxtrans, hsep⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.functionField_finrank_kaehler_eq_one_of_smooth
statement:
lemma functionField_finrank_kaehler_eq_one_of_smooth
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [IsIntegral X]
    [Algebra k X.functionField] [CompatibleAlgebra X k]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] :
    Module.finrank X.functionField Ω[X.functionField⁄k] = 1
proof:
:= by
  let f := X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)
  obtain ⟨U, hU, V, hV, hgen, e, hsmooth⟩ :=
    SmoothOfRelativeDimension.exists_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension
      (n := 1) (f := f) (genericPoint X)
  have hUtop : U = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    rintro y -
    simpa only [Scheme.Hom.mem_preimage, Subsingleton.elim y (f (genericPoint X))] using e hgen
  subst U
  letI : Nonempty V := ⟨⟨genericPoint X, hgen⟩⟩
  letI : Algebra k Γ(X, V) :=
    (structureRingHom (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) V).toAlgebra
  have hstructure :
      (structureRingHom (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) V).IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension
        1 := by
    have hbase :
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv.hom.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension 0 :=
      RingHom.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.equiv
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
    have hcomp := hsmooth.comp hbase
    convert hcomp using 1
    ext c
    change X.presheaf.map V.leTop.op
        ((f.app ⊤).hom ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv.hom c)) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE e).op
        ((f.app ⊤).hom ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv.hom c))
    rw [Subsingleton.elim (homOfLE e) V.leTop]
    rfl
  letI : Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 k Γ(X, V) := hstructure.toAlgebra
  have hsections : Module.rank Γ(X, V) Ω[Γ(X, V)⁄k] = 1 :=
    Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.rank_kaehlerDifferential 1
  letI : IsScalarTower k Γ(X, V) X.functionField :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun c => by
      symm
      change X.germToFunctionField V
        (structureRingHom (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) V c) =
          algebraMap k X.functionField c
      rw [structureRingHom_apply, X.presheaf.germ_res_apply]
      have htop :
          structureRingHom (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) ⊤ c =
            globalSec (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) c := by
        rw [structureRingHom_apply]
        have heq : (⊤ : X.Opens).leTop = 𝟙 (⊤ : X.Opens) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
        rw [heq]
        simp
      rw [← htop]
      exact (DFunLike.congr_fun
        (CompatibleAlgebra.algebraMap_eq (X := X) (k := k)) c).symm
  letI : IsFractionRing Γ(X, V) X.functionField :=
    functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen X V hV
  have hrank : Module.rank X.functionField Ω[X.functionField⁄k] = 1 := by
    calc
      Module.rank X.functionField Ω[X.functionField⁄k] =
          Module.rank Γ(X, V) Ω[X.functionField⁄k] :=
        IsLocalization.rank_eq X.functionField (nonZeroDivisors Γ(X, V)) le_rfl
      _ = Module.rank Γ(X, V) Ω[Γ(X, V)⁄k] :=
        IsLocalizedModule.rank_eq (nonZeroDivisors Γ(X, V)) le_rfl
          (KaehlerDifferential.map k k Γ(X, V) X.functionField)
      _ = 1 := hsections
  exact Module.rank_eq_one_iff_finrank_eq_one.mp hrank

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.exists_separatingElement_of_smooth
statement:
lemma exists_separatingElement_of_smooth {X : Scheme.{u}} (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [IsIntegral X] [IsNoetherian X]
    [IsRegularInCodimensionOne X] [Algebra k X.functionField] [CompatibleAlgebra X k]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [Order.KrullDimLE 1 X] [Nontrivial X] [IsFullConstantField k X.functionField] :
    ∃ x : X.functionField, Transcendental k x ∧
      Algebra.IsSeparable (IntermediateField.adjoin k {x}) X.functionField
proof:
:= by
  letI : Smooth (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
  letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := inferInstance
  letI : Algebra.EssFiniteType k X.functionField := functionField_essFiniteType k
  exact exists_separatingElement_of_finrank_kaehler_eq_one k X.functionField
    (Algebra.transcendental_iff_not_isAlgebraic.mp (functionField_transcendental (X := X) k))
    (functionField_finrank_kaehler_eq_one_of_smooth k)

proof:
:= by
  apply Module.ext'
  intro r y
  change (X.Γevaluation p.1).hom

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.finite_residueField_of_place
statement:
theorem finite_residueField_of_place (v : FunctionField.Place k X.functionField) :
    Module.Finite k v.residueField
proof:
:= by
  let p : CodimOnePoint X := (codimOnePointEquivPlace k).symm v
  have hcycle : @Module.Finite k (X.residueField p.1) _ _
      (AlgebraicCycle.instModuleCarrierResidueField k p.1) :=
    finite_residueField_of_coheight_eq_one k p.2
  let M : Module k (X.residueField p.1) :=
    @Algebra.toModule k (X.residueField p.1) _ _ (residueFieldAlgebra X k p.1)
  have hM : AlgebraicCycle.instModuleCarrierResidueField k p.1 = M :=
    cycleModule_eq_residueFieldAlgebraModule k p
  haveI hfiniteScheme : @Module.Finite k (X.residueField p.1) _ _ M := by
    rw [← hM]
    exact hcycle
  have hfinitePlace : Module.Finite k (placeOfCodimOnePoint k p).residueField :=
    Module.Finite.equiv (residueFieldEquivPlace (k := k) p).toLinearEquiv
  have hpv : placeOfCodimOnePoint k p = v :=
    (codimOnePointEquivPlace k).apply_symm_apply v
  rwa [hpv] at hfinitePlace

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.fromSpecStalk_comp_structure
statement:
theorem fromSpecStalk_comp_structure (X : Scheme.{u}) (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] (x : X) :
    X.fromSpecStalk x ≫ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (X.presheaf.stalk x)))
proof:
:= by
  apply AlgebraicGeometry.ext_to_Spec
  change (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv ≫
      (X.fromSpecStalk x ≫ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))).appTop =
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv ≫
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap k (X.presheaf.stalk x)))).appTop
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, ← Category.assoc]
  rw [show (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv ≫
      (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).appTop =
        CommRingCat.ofHom (globalSec (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k)) by rfl]
  rw [Scheme.fromSpecStalk_appTop]
  rw [← Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality]
  have hcompat : CommRingCat.ofHom
        (globalSec (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k)) ≫
      X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial =
        CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (X.presheaf.stalk x)) := by
    ext c
    change X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial
      (globalSec (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) c) =
        X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial
          (structureRingHom (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) ⊤ c)
    congr 1
    rw [structureRingHom_apply]
    have heq : (⊤ : X.Opens).leTop = 𝟙 (⊤ : X.Opens) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [heq]
    simp
  rw [← Category.assoc, hcompat]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.fromSpecFunctionField_comp_structure
statement:
theorem fromSpecFunctionField_comp_structure (X : Scheme.{u}) (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [IsIntegral X] [Algebra k X.functionField]
    [CompatibleAlgebra X k] :
    X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X) ≫ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k X.functionField))
proof:
:= by
  apply AlgebraicGeometry.ext_to_Spec
  change (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv ≫
      (X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X) ≫ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))).appTop =
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv ≫
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k X.functionField))).appTop
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, ← Category.assoc]
  rw [show (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv ≫
      (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).appTop =
        CommRingCat.ofHom (globalSec (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k)) by rfl]
  rw [Scheme.fromSpecStalk_appTop]
  rw [← Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality]
  have hcompat : CommRingCat.ofHom
        (globalSec (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k)) ≫ X.germToFunctionField ⊤ =
      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k X.functionField) := by
    ext c
    change (X.germToFunctionField ⊤).hom
      (globalSec (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) c) = algebraMap k X.functionField c
    have htop : structureRingHom (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) ⊤ c =
        globalSec (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) c := by
      rw [structureRingHom_apply]
      have heq : (⊤ : X.Opens).leTop = 𝟙 (⊤ : X.Opens) :=
        Subsingleton.elim _ _
      rw [heq]
      simp
    rw [← htop]
    exact (DFunLike.congr_fun
      (CompatibleAlgebra.algebraMap_eq (X := X) (k := k)) c).symm
  rw [show X.presheaf.germ ⊤ (genericPoint X) trivial = X.germToFunctionField ⊤ from rfl]
  rw [← Category.assoc, hcompat]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.coheight_eq_one_of_ne_genericPoint
statement:
theorem coheight_eq_one_of_ne_genericPoint (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral X]
    [Order.KrullDimLE 1 X] {z : X} (hz : z ≠ genericPoint X) : coheight z = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hle : z ≤ genericPoint X :=
    Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr ((genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial)
  have hlt : z < genericPoint X := lt_of_le_not_ge hle fun hge => hz
    (((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hge).antisymm
      (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hle)).eq)
  have h1 : 1 ≤ coheight z :=
    le_trans le_add_self (Order.coheight_add_one_le hlt)
  have h2 : coheight z ≤ 1 := by
    have h := (Order.coheight_le_krullDim z).trans
      (Order.KrullDimLE.krullDim_le (n := 1) (α := ↥X))
    exact_mod_cast h
  exact le_antisymm h2 h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.isClosed_singleton_of_coheight_eq_one
statement:
theorem isClosed_singleton_of_coheight_eq_one (X : Scheme.{u})
    [Order.KrullDimLE 1 X] {z : X} (hz : coheight z = 1) :
    IsClosed ({z} : Set X)
proof:
:= by
  refine isClosed_of_closure_subset fun y hy => ?_
  have hspec : Specializes z y := specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr hy
  have hle : y ≤ z := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr hspec
  apply Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr
  have hzy : z ≤ y := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hlt : y < z := lt_of_le_not_ge hle hnot
    have htwo : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ coheight y := by
      simpa only [hz, one_add_one_eq_two] using Order.coheight_add_one_le hlt
    have hone : coheight y ≤ 1 := by
      have h := (Order.coheight_le_krullDim y).trans
        (Order.KrullDimLE.krullDim_le (n := 1) (α := ↥X))
      exact_mod_cast h
    have : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ 1 := htwo.trans hone
    norm_num at this
  exact ((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hzy).antisymm hspec).eq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.closedPoint_ne_genericPoint
statement:
theorem closedPoint_ne_genericPoint (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral X] [Nontrivial X]
    (x : ClosedPoint X) : x.1 ≠ genericPoint X
proof:
:= by
  intro hx
  have hclosed : IsClosed ({genericPoint X} : Set X) := by
    simpa only [hx] using x.2
  have hsingle : ({genericPoint X} : Set X) = Set.univ := by
    calc
      ({genericPoint X} : Set X) = closure ({genericPoint X} : Set X) :=
        hclosed.closure_eq.symm
      _ = Set.univ := genericPoint_closure X
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := exists_pair_ne X
  have ha : a = genericPoint X := by
    simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using
      (show a ∈ ({genericPoint X} : Set X) by rw [hsingle]; trivial)
  have hb : b = genericPoint X := by
    simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using
      (show b ∈ ({genericPoint X} : Set X) by rw [hsingle]; trivial)
  exact hab (ha.trans hb.symm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.tilde_H_isZero
statement:
theorem tilde_H_isZero (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (n : ℕ) :
    IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb (Spec R)).obj (tilde M)) (n + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  letI : (tilde.functor R).PreservesZeroMorphisms :=
    Functor.preservesZeroMorphisms_of_additive _
  induction n generalizing M with
  | zero =>
      obtain ⟨I, _, f, hf⟩ := EnoughInjectives.presentation M
      let S := ShortComplex.mk f (cokernel.π f) (by cat_disch)
      have hS : S.ShortExact :=
        ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk (ShortComplex.exact_cokernel f)
      have hT : (S.map (tilde.functor R)).ShortExact :=
        tilde_map_shortExact S hS
      have hA : ((S.map (tilde.functor R)).map
          (Modules.toSheafAb (Spec R))).ShortExact :=
        shortExact_map_toSheaf hT
      letI : (S.map (tilde.functor R)).X₁.IsQuasicoherent := by
        change (tilde M).IsQuasicoherent
        infer_instance
      letI : (S.map (tilde.functor R)).X₂.IsQuasicoherent := by
        change (tilde I).IsQuasicoherent
        infer_instance
      letI : (S.map (tilde.functor R)).X₃.IsQuasicoherent := by
        change (tilde S.X₃).IsQuasicoherent
        infer_instance
      have hΓ : ((S.map (tilde.functor R)).map
          (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor R)).ShortExact :=
        (moduleSpecΓ_map_shortExact_iff (R := R)
          (S.map (tilde.functor R))).mpr hT
      have htop : Epi
          (((S.map (tilde.functor R)).map
            (Modules.toSheafAb (Spec R))).g.hom.app (.op ⊤)) := by
        rw [AddCommGrpCat.epi_iff_surjective]
        change Function.Surjective
          (((S.map (tilde.functor R)).map
            (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor R)).g).hom
        exact (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mp hΓ.epi_g
      have hLS := Sheaf.H.longSequence_exact hA 0 1 rfl
      refine ShortComplex.Exact.isZero_of_both_zeros (hLS.exact 2) ?_
        (zero_of_target_iso_zero _
          (IsZero.isoZero (tilde_H_isZero_of_injective I 0)))
      rw [← ShortComplex.Exact.epi_f_iff (hLS.exact 1),
        AddCommGrpCat.epi_iff_surjective]
      change Function.Surjective
        (Sheaf.H.map
          ((S.map (tilde.functor R)).map
            (Modules.toSheafAb (Spec R))).g 0)
      rw [← Equiv.surjective_comp
          (TopCat.Sheaf.H.equiv₀
            ((S.map (tilde.functor R)).map
              (Modules.toSheafAb (Spec R))).X₂).symm.toEquiv]
      change Function.Surjective
        ((Sheaf.H.map
          ((S.map (tilde.functor R)).map
            (Modules.toSheafAb (Spec R))).g 0) ∘
          (TopCat.Sheaf.H.equiv₀
            ((S.map (tilde.functor R)).map
              (Modules.toSheafAb (Spec R))).X₂).symm.toEquiv)
      conv =>
        right
        equals (TopCat.Sheaf.H.equiv₀
          ((S.map (tilde.functor R)).map
            (Modules.toSheafAb (Spec R))).X₃).symm.toEquiv ∘
            ((S.map (tilde.functor R)).map
              (Modules.toSheafAb (Spec R))).g.hom.app (.op ⊤) =>
          ext x
          exact Sheaf.H.equiv₀_symm_naturality isTerminalTop _ x
      rw [Equiv.comp_surjective, ← AddCommGrpCat.epi_iff_surjective]
      exact htop
  | succ n hn =>
      obtain ⟨I, _, f, hf⟩ := EnoughInjectives.presentation M
      let S := ShortComplex.mk f (cokernel.π f) (by cat_disch)
      have hS : S.ShortExact :=
        ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk (ShortComplex.exact_cokernel f)
      have hT : (S.map (tilde.functor R)).ShortExact :=
        tilde_map_shortExact S hS
      have hA : ((S.map (tilde.functor R)).map
          (Modules.toSheafAb (Spec R))).ShortExact :=
        shortExact_map_toSheaf hT
      exact ShortComplex.Exact.isZero_of_both_isZero
        ((Sheaf.H.longSequence_exact hA (n + 1) (n + 2) rfl).exact 2)
        (hn S.X₃) (tilde_H_isZero_of_injective I (n + 1))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.quasicoherent_H_isZero
statement:
theorem quasicoherent_H_isZero
    (F : (Spec R).Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (n : ℕ) :
    IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb (Spec R)).obj F) (n + 1)))
proof:

  letI : IsIso F.fromTildeΓ :=
    Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent F
  let e := (Modules.toSheafAb (Spec R)).mapIso (asIso F.fromTildeΓ)
  exact IsZero.of_iso
    (tilde_H_isZero ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor R).obj F) n)
    ((Sheaf.functorH _ (n + 1)).mapIso e.symm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.h_one_eq_indexOfSpecialty
statement:
theorem h_one_eq_indexOfSpecialty (D : SchemeWeilDivisor (X := X)) :
    Scheme.Modules.h k (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D.1) 1 =
      FunctionField.indexOfSpecialty k X.functionField
        (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    Scheme.Modules.h k (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D.1) 1 =
        Scheme.Modules.h k D.1.sheaf 1 :=
      (h_eq_of_iso k (sheafIsoSheafViaSubmodule D.1) 1).symm
    _ = Module.finrank k
        (FunctionField.AdeleSpace k X.functionField ⧸
          (FunctionField.adeleFilt k X.functionField
              (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D) +
            FunctionField.diagonalSubmodule k X.functionField)) := by
      rw [Scheme.Modules.h]
      exact (H1LinearEquivAdeleQuotient k D).finrank_eq
    _ = FunctionField.finrankAdeleQuotient k X.functionField
        (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D) := rfl
    _ = FunctionField.indexOfSpecialty k X.functionField
        (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D) :=
      FunctionField.finrank_adele_quotient k X.functionField _

    (D : SchemeWeilDivisor (X := X)) :
    Scheme.Modules.h k (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D.1) 1 =
      FunctionField.ell k X.functionField
