name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.schemeGenus_eq_functionField_genus
statement:
theorem schemeGenus_eq_functionField_genus :
    schemeGenus (X := X) k = FunctionField.genus k X.functionField
proof:
:= by
  let D0 : SchemeWeilDivisor (X := X) :=
    ⟨0, fun _ hx => (hx rfl).elim⟩
  have hE0 : weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D0 = 0 := by
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro v
    let p : CodimOnePoint X := (codimOnePointEquivPlace k).symm v
    rw [← (codimOnePointEquivPlace k).apply_symm_apply v]
    rw [weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor_apply]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ := FunctionField.exists_isCanonical k X.functionField
  calc
    schemeGenus (X := X) k =
        Scheme.Modules.h k
          (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf (0 : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ)) 1 :=
      h_eq_of_iso k (unitIsoSheafZero (X := X)) 1
    _ = Scheme.Modules.h k
        (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D0.1) 1 := rfl
    _ = FunctionField.indexOfSpecialty k X.functionField
        (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D0) := h_one_eq_indexOfSpecialty k D0
    _ = FunctionField.indexOfSpecialty k X.functionField 0 := by rw [hE0]
    _ = FunctionField.ell k X.functionField (W - 0) :=
      (FunctionField.duality k X.functionField hW 0).symm
    _ = FunctionField.genus k X.functionField := by
      simpa using FunctionField.ell_canonical k X.functionField hW

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.h_zero_eq_ell_submodule
statement:
theorem h_zero_eq_ell_submodule (D : SchemeWeilDivisor (X := X)) :
    Scheme.Modules.h k (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D.1) 0 =
      FunctionField.ell k X.functionField
        (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D)
proof:
:=
  (h_eq_of_iso k (sheafIsoSheafViaSubmodule D.1) 0).symm.trans (h_zero_eq_ell k D)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.full_riemann_roch_of_isCanonical
statement:
theorem full_riemann_roch_of_isCanonical {W : FunctionField.Divisor k X.functionField}
    (hW : FunctionField.IsCanonical k X.functionField W)
    (D : SchemeWeilDivisor (X := X)) :
    (Scheme.Modules.h k (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D.1) 0 : ℤ) -
        (Scheme.Modules.h k (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D.1) 1 : ℤ) =
      AlgebraicCycle.degree k D.1 + 1 - (schemeGenus (X := X) k : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  let E := weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D
  have hRR := FunctionField.riemann_roch k X.functionField hW E
  calc
    (Scheme.Modules.h k (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D.1) 0 : ℤ) -
          (Scheme.Modules.h k (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D.1) 1 : ℤ) =
        (FunctionField.ell k X.functionField E : ℤ) -
          (FunctionField.ell k X.functionField (W - E) : ℤ) := by
      rw [h_zero_eq_ell_submodule k D, h_one_eq_ell_canonical_sub k hW D]
    _ = FunctionField.Divisor.deg k X.functionField E + 1 -
        (FunctionField.genus k X.functionField : ℤ) := by omega
    _ = AlgebraicCycle.degree k D.1 + 1 - (schemeGenus (X := X) k : ℤ) := by
      rw [degree_weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D,
        schemeGenus_eq_functionField_genus k]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.full_riemann_roch
statement:
theorem full_riemann_roch (D : SchemeWeilDivisor (X := X)) :
    (Scheme.Modules.h k (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D.1) 0 : ℤ) -
        (Scheme.Modules.h k (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D.1) 1 : ℤ) =
      AlgebraicCycle.degree k D.1 + 1 - (schemeGenus (X := X) k : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ := FunctionField.exists_isCanonical k X.functionField
  exact full_riemann_roch_of_isCanonical k hW D

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.affineOpen_ringKrullDimLE_one
statement:
lemma affineOpen_ringKrullDimLE_one {X : Scheme.{u}} [Order.KrullDimLE 1 X]
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) : Ring.KrullDimLE 1 Γ(X, U)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ring.krullDimLE_iff]
  calc
    ringKrullDim Γ(X, U) = topologicalKrullDim (Spec Γ(X, U)) :=
      (PrimeSpectrum.topologicalKrullDim_eq_ringKrullDim Γ(X, U)).symm
    _ = topologicalKrullDim U :=
      (IsHomeomorph.topologicalKrullDim_eq _
        hU.isoSpec.hom.homeomorph.isHomeomorph).symm
    _ ≤ topologicalKrullDim X := topologicalKrullDim_subspace_le X U
    _ = Order.krullDim X :=
      Order.krullDim_eq_of_orderIso (irreducibleSetEquivPoints (α := X))
    _ ≤ 1 := Order.KrullDimLE.krullDim_le

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.functionField_essFiniteType
statement:
lemma functionField_essFiniteType {X : Scheme.{u}} (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [IsIntegral X]
    [Algebra k X.functionField] [CompatibleAlgebra X k]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] :
    Algebra.EssFiniteType k X.functionField
proof:
:= by
  let x : X := Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty X)
  let U : X.Opens := (X.affineCover.f (X.affineCover.idx x)).opensRange
  have hU : IsAffineOpen U := isAffineOpen_opensRange (X.affineCover.f _)
  have hxU : x ∈ U := X.affineCover.covers x
  letI : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨x, hxU⟩⟩
  letI : Algebra k Γ(X, U) := (structureRingHom (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) U).toAlgebra
  have hsec : Algebra.FiniteType k Γ(X, U) := by
    rw [← RingHom.finiteType_algebraMap]
    change (structureRingHom (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) U).FiniteType
    let f := X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)
    let e : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).Opens) := by simp
    have happ := f.finiteType_appLE (isAffineOpen_top _) hU e
    have hiso : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv.hom.FiniteType :=
      RingHom.FiniteType.of_surjective _
        (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
          (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv).2
    convert happ.comp hiso using 1
    ext c
    change X.presheaf.map U.leTop.op
        ((f.app ⊤).hom ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv.hom c)) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE e).op
        ((f.app ⊤).hom ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv.hom c))
    rw [Subsingleton.elim (homOfLE e) U.leTop]
    rfl
  haveI : Algebra.FiniteType k Γ(X, U) := hsec
  haveI : IsScalarTower k Γ(X, U) X.functionField :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun c => by
      symm
      change X.germToFunctionField U
        (structureRingHom (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) U c) =
          algebraMap k X.functionField c
      rw [structureRingHom_apply]
      rw [X.presheaf.germ_res_apply]
      have htop :
          structureRingHom (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) ⊤ c =
            globalSec (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) c := by
        rw [structureRingHom_apply]
        have heq : (⊤ : X.Opens).leTop = 𝟙 (⊤ : X.Opens) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
        rw [heq]
        simp
      rw [← htop]
      exact (DFunLike.congr_fun
        (CompatibleAlgebra.algebraMap_eq (X := X) (k := k)) c).symm
  letI : IsFractionRing Γ(X, U) X.functionField :=
    functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen X U hU
  haveI : Algebra.EssFiniteType Γ(X, U) X.functionField :=
    Algebra.EssFiniteType.of_isLocalization X.functionField (nonZeroDivisors Γ(X, U))
  exact Algebra.EssFiniteType.comp k Γ(X, U) X.functionField

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.integral_mvPolynomial_rank_le_one
statement:
lemma integral_mvPolynomial_rank_le_one (k A : Type u) [Field k] [CommRing A]
    [IsDomain A] [Algebra k A] [Ring.KrullDimLE 1 A] {n : ℕ}
    (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k →ₐ[k] A) (hinj : Function.Injective g)
    (hint : g.IsIntegral) : n ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hn
  have hn2 : 2 ≤ n := by omega
  let i₀ : Fin n := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  let i₁ : Fin n := ⟨1, by omega⟩
  let R := MvPolynomial (Fin n) k
  let P₀ : Ideal R := ⊥
  let P₁ : Ideal R := Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.X i₀}
  let P₂ : Ideal R := RingHom.ker
    (MvPolynomial.aeval (R := k) (fun _ : Fin n ↦ (0 : k))).toRingHom
  have hP₀ : P₀.IsPrime := by
    dsimp only [P₀, R]
    infer_instance
  have hP₁ : P₁.IsPrime := by
    dsimp only [P₁, R]
    exact (Ideal.span_singleton_prime (MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero i₀)).mpr
      MvPolynomial.X_prime
  have hP₂ : P₂.IsPrime := by
    dsimp only [P₂, R]
    exact RingHom.ker_isPrime _
  have hP₀P₁ : P₀ < P₁ := by
    rw [SetLike.lt_iff_le_and_exists]
    refine ⟨bot_le, MvPolynomial.X i₀, Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton _), ?_⟩
    simp [P₀, R]
  have hP₁P₂_le : P₁ ≤ P₂ := by
    rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ rfl
    simp [P₂, R]
  have hP₁P₂ : P₁ < P₂ := by
    refine lt_of_le_of_ne hP₁P₂_le ?_
    intro heq
    have hx₁ : MvPolynomial.X i₁ ∈ P₁ := by
      rw [heq]
      simp [P₂, R]
    dsimp only [P₁, R] at hx₁
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton, MvPolynomial.X_dvd_X] at hx₁
    exact (by simp [i₀, i₁] : i₀ ≠ i₁) hx₁
  letI : Algebra R A := g.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  haveI : Algebra.IsIntegral R A := ⟨hint⟩
  let Q₀ : Ideal A := ⊥
  have hQ₀ : Q₀.IsPrime := by
    dsimp only [Q₀]
    infer_instance
  have hQ₀_comap : Q₀.comap (algebraMap R A) = P₀ := by
    change RingHom.ker (algebraMap R A) = ⊥
    exact (RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot _).mp hinj
  letI : Q₀.IsPrime := hQ₀
  obtain ⟨Q₁, hQ₀Q₁_le, hQ₁, hQ₁_comap⟩ :=
    Ideal.exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral_of_isPrime P₁ Q₀
      (hQ₀_comap.trans_le hP₀P₁.le)
  letI : Q₁.IsPrime := hQ₁
  obtain ⟨Q₂, hQ₁Q₂_le, hQ₂, hQ₂_comap⟩ :=
    Ideal.exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral_of_isPrime P₂ Q₁
      (hQ₁_comap.trans_le hP₁P₂.le)
  letI : Q₂.IsPrime := hQ₂
  have hQ₀Q₁ : Q₀ < Q₁ := by
    refine lt_of_le_of_ne hQ₀Q₁_le ?_
    intro heq
    have := congrArg (Ideal.comap (algebraMap R A)) heq
    rw [hQ₀_comap, hQ₁_comap] at this
    exact hP₀P₁.ne this
  have hQ₁Q₂ : Q₁ < Q₂ := by
    refine lt_of_le_of_ne hQ₁Q₂_le ?_
    intro heq
    have := congrArg (Ideal.comap (algebraMap R A)) heq
    rw [hQ₁_comap, hQ₂_comap] at this
    exact hP₁P₂.ne this
  let q₀ : PrimeSpectrum A := ⟨Q₀, hQ₀⟩
  let q₁ : PrimeSpectrum A := ⟨Q₁, hQ₁⟩
  let q₂ : PrimeSpectrum A := ⟨Q₂, hQ₂⟩
  have hq₀q₁ : q₀ < q₁ := hQ₀Q₁
  have hq₁q₂ : q₁ < q₂ := hQ₁Q₂
  have hc₁ : (1 : ℕ∞) ≤ Order.coheight q₁ := by
    exact le_trans le_add_self (Order.coheight_add_one_le hq₁q₂)
  have hc₀ : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ Order.coheight q₀ := by
    calc
      (2 : ℕ∞) = 1 + 1 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ Order.coheight q₁ + 1 := by
        simpa [add_comm] using add_le_add_right hc₁ 1
      _ ≤ Order.coheight q₀ := Order.coheight_add_one_le hq₀q₁
  have hle : Order.coheight q₀ ≤ (1 : ℕ∞) := by
    have h := (Order.coheight_le_krullDim q₀).trans
      (Order.KrullDimLE.krullDim_le (n := 1) (α := PrimeSpectrum A))
    exact_mod_cast h
  have hbad : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ 1 := hc₀.trans hle
  norm_num at hbad

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.noetherNormalization_isTranscendenceBasis
statement:
lemma noetherNormalization_isTranscendenceBasis (k A : Type u) [Field k]
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [Algebra k A] {n : ℕ}
    (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k →ₐ[k] A) (hinj : Function.Injective g)
    (hint : g.IsIntegral) :
    IsTranscendenceBasis k (fun i : Fin n ↦ g (MvPolynomial.X i))
proof:
:= by
  let x : Fin n → A := fun i ↦ g (MvPolynomial.X i)
  have hind : AlgebraicIndependent k x := by
    change AlgebraicIndependent k (g ∘ MvPolynomial.X)
    exact (MvPolynomial.algebraicIndependent_X (Fin n) k).map' hinj
  refine hind.isTranscendenceBasis_iff_isAlgebraic.mpr ?_
  let T := Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range x)
  let e : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k ≃ₐ[k] T := hind.aevalEquiv
  letI : Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) A := g.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  haveI : Algebra.IsIntegral (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) A := ⟨hint⟩
  have haeval : MvPolynomial.aeval x = g := by
    ext i
    simp [x]
  have hcompat : (algebraMap T A).comp e.toRingEquiv.toRingHom =
      algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) A := by
    change (T.val.comp e).toRingHom = g.toRingHom
    congr 1
  refine ⟨fun a ↦ ?_⟩
  exact ((e.toRingEquiv.isIntegral_iff hcompat a).mp
    (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral a)).isAlgebraic

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.exists_transcendenceBasis_rank_le_one
statement:
lemma exists_transcendenceBasis_rank_le_one (k A : Type u) [Field k]
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [Algebra k A] [Algebra.FiniteType k A]
    [Ring.KrullDimLE 1 A] :
    ∃ n : ℕ, n ≤ 1 ∧ ∃ x : Fin n → A, IsTranscendenceBasis k x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, g, hinj, hint⟩ := exists_integral_inj_algHom_of_fg k A
  exact ⟨n, integral_mvPolynomial_rank_le_one k A g hinj hint,
    fun i ↦ g (MvPolynomial.X i),
    noetherNormalization_isTranscendenceBasis k A g hinj hint⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.exists_functionField_transcendenceBasis_rank_le_one
statement:
lemma exists_functionField_transcendenceBasis_rank_le_one {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [IsIntegral X]
    [Algebra k X.functionField] [CompatibleAlgebra X k]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [Order.KrullDimLE 1 X] :
    ∃ n : ℕ, n ≤ 1 ∧ ∃ x : Fin n → X.functionField,
      IsTranscendenceBasis k x
proof:
:= by
  let z : X := Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty X)
  let U : X.Opens := (X.affineCover.f (X.affineCover.idx z)).opensRange
  have hU : IsAffineOpen U := isAffineOpen_opensRange (X.affineCover.f _)
  have hzU : z ∈ U := X.affineCover.covers z
  letI : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨z, hzU⟩⟩
  letI : Algebra k Γ(X, U) :=
    (structureRingHom (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) U).toAlgebra
  have hsec : Algebra.FiniteType k Γ(X, U) := by
    rw [← RingHom.finiteType_algebraMap]
    change (structureRingHom (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) U).FiniteType
    let f := X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)
    let e : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).Opens) := by simp
    have happ := f.finiteType_appLE (isAffineOpen_top _) hU e
    have hiso : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv.hom.FiniteType :=
      RingHom.FiniteType.of_surjective _
        (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
          (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv).2
    convert happ.comp hiso using 1
    ext c
    change X.presheaf.map U.leTop.op
        ((f.app ⊤).hom ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv.hom c)) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE e).op
        ((f.app ⊤).hom ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv.hom c))
    rw [Subsingleton.elim (homOfLE e) U.leTop]
    rfl
  letI : Algebra.FiniteType k Γ(X, U) := hsec
  letI : Ring.KrullDimLE 1 Γ(X, U) := affineOpen_ringKrullDimLE_one U hU
  obtain ⟨n, hn, x, hx⟩ := exists_transcendenceBasis_rank_le_one k Γ(X, U)
  letI : IsScalarTower k Γ(X, U) X.functionField :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun c => by
      symm
      change X.germToFunctionField U
        (structureRingHom (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) U c) =
          algebraMap k X.functionField c
      rw [structureRingHom_apply]
      rw [X.presheaf.germ_res_apply]
      have htop :
          structureRingHom (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) ⊤ c =
            globalSec (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) c := by
        rw [structureRingHom_apply]
        have heq : (⊤ : X.Opens).leTop = 𝟙 (⊤ : X.Opens) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
        rw [heq]
        simp
      rw [← htop]
      exact (DFunLike.congr_fun
        (CompatibleAlgebra.algebraMap_eq (X := X) (k := k)) c).symm
  letI : IsFractionRing Γ(X, U) X.functionField :=
    functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen X U hU
  haveI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic Γ(X, U) X.functionField :=
    (IsFractionRing.isAlgebraic_iff' Γ(X, U) Γ(X, U) X.functionField).mp inferInstance
  exact ⟨n, hn, algebraMap Γ(X, U) X.functionField ∘ x, hx.algebraMap_comp⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.not_isAlgebraic_of_place
statement:
lemma not_isAlgebraic_of_place (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K]
    [Algebra k K] [IsFullConstantField k K]
    (v : FunctionField.Place k K) : ¬ Algebra.IsAlgebraic k K
proof:
:= by
  intro halg
  apply v.ne_top
  apply ValuationSubring.ext v.toValuationSubring ⊤
  intro z
  constructor
  · intro
    exact ValuationSubring.mem_top z
  · intro
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := IsFullConstantField.algebraic_mem (k := k) (K := K) z
      (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic z)
    exact v.triv_on_k c

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.functionField_transcendental
statement:
lemma functionField_transcendental {X : Scheme.{u}} (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [IsIntegral X] [IsNoetherian X]
    [IsRegularInCodimensionOne X] [Algebra k X.functionField]
    [CompatibleAlgebra X k] [Order.KrullDimLE 1 X] [Nontrivial X]
    [IsFullConstantField k X.functionField] :
    Algebra.Transcendental k X.functionField
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.transcendental_iff_not_isAlgebraic]
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := exists_pair_ne X
  by_cases ha : a = genericPoint X
  · have hb : b ≠ genericPoint X := fun h => hab (ha.trans h.symm)
    let p : CodimOnePoint X := ⟨b, coheight_eq_one_of_ne_genericPoint X hb⟩
    exact not_isAlgebraic_of_place k X.functionField (placeOfCodimOnePoint k p)
  · let p : CodimOnePoint X := ⟨a, coheight_eq_one_of_ne_genericPoint X ha⟩
    exact not_isAlgebraic_of_place k X.functionField (placeOfCodimOnePoint k p)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.exists_separatingElement
statement:
lemma exists_separatingElement {X : Scheme.{u}} (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [PerfectField k] [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [IsIntegral X]
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsRegularInCodimensionOne X]
    [Algebra k X.functionField] [CompatibleAlgebra X k]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [Order.KrullDimLE 1 X] [Nontrivial X]
    [IsFullConstantField k X.functionField] :
    ∃ x : X.functionField, Transcendental k x ∧
      Algebra.IsSeparable (IntermediateField.adjoin k {x}) X.functionField
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra.EssFiniteType k X.functionField := functionField_essFiniteType k
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsep⟩ :=
    exists_isTranscendenceBasis_and_isSeparable_of_perfectField k X.functionField
  obtain ⟨n, hn, y, hy⟩ :=
    exists_functionField_transcendenceBasis_rank_le_one (X := X) k
  have hcard : s.card = n := by
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := Cardinal.lift_mk_eq'.mp (hs.lift_cardinalMk_eq hy)
    simpa using Fintype.card_congr e
  have hsle : s.card ≤ 1 := hcard.trans_le hn
  have htrans : Algebra.Transcendental k X.functionField :=
    functionField_transcendental k
  obtain ⟨i⟩ := hs.nonempty_iff_transcendental.mpr htrans
  have hsne : s.Nonempty := ⟨i.1, i.2⟩
  have hspos : 0 < s.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr hsne
  have hscard : s.card = 1 := by omega
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hscard
  refine ⟨x, ?_, ?_⟩
  · let i : ({x} : Finset X.functionField) := ⟨x, by simp⟩
    simpa [i] using hs.1.transcendental i
  · have hadjoin :
        IntermediateField.adjoin k ((↑({x} : Finset X.functionField)) : Set X.functionField) =
          IntermediateField.adjoin k {x} := by
      congr 1
      ext z
      simp
    rw [hadjoin] at hsep
    exact hsep

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.ratFuncAlgebraOf_algebraMap
statement:
lemma ratFuncAlgebraOf_algebraMap (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K]
    [Algebra k K] (s : SeparatingElement k K) (f : k⟮X⟯) :
    @algebraMap k⟮X⟯ K _ _ (ratFuncAlgebraOf k K s) f =
      (IntermediateField.adjoin k {s.x}).val
        ((RatFunc.algEquivOfTranscendental s.x s.transcendental) f)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.Intrinsic.riemann_roch_proper
statement:
theorem riemann_roch_proper (D : SchemeWeilDivisor (X := X)) :
    (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D.1).eulerChar k =
      D.1.degree k +
        (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.structureSheafModule X).eulerChar k
proof:
:= by
  let s := separatingElement (X := X) k
  let E := IntermediateField.adjoin k {s.x}
  letI : Algebra k[X] X.functionField := polynomialAlgebraOf k X.functionField s
  letI : Algebra k⟮X⟯ X.functionField := ratFuncAlgebraOf k X.functionField s
  letI : IsScalarTower k k[X] X.functionField :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun c => by
      rw [polynomialAlgebraOf_algebraMap]
      simp
  letI : IsScalarTower k[X] k⟮X⟯ X.functionField :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun f => by
      rw [polynomialAlgebraOf_algebraMap, ratFuncAlgebraOf_algebraMap,
        RatFunc.algEquivOfTranscendental_algebraMap]
      simp
  letI : Algebra.EssFiniteType k X.functionField := functionField_essFiniteType k
  letI : IsScalarTower k E X.functionField :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun c => rfl
  letI : Algebra.EssFiniteType E X.functionField :=
    Algebra.EssFiniteType.of_comp k E X.functionField
  letI : Algebra.IsSeparable E X.functionField := s.isSeparable
  letI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic E X.functionField := inferInstance
  letI : Module.Finite E X.functionField :=
    Algebra.finite_of_essFiniteType_of_isAlgebraic
  let e₁ : E ≃+* k⟮X⟯ :=
    (RatFunc.algEquivOfTranscendental s.x s.transcendental).symm.toRingEquiv
  let e₂ : X.functionField ≃+* X.functionField := RingEquiv.refl X.functionField
  have hcomp : RingHom.comp (algebraMap k⟮X⟯ X.functionField) e₁ =
      RingHom.comp e₂ (algebraMap E X.functionField) := by
    ext z
    simp [e₁, e₂, ratFuncAlgebraOf_algebraMap]
  letI : Module.Finite k⟮X⟯ X.functionField :=
    Module.Finite.of_equiv_equiv e₁ e₂ hcomp
  letI : Algebra.IsSeparable k⟮X⟯ X.functionField :=
    Algebra.IsSeparable.of_equiv_equiv e₁ e₂ hcomp
  exact AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.riemann_roch_proper k D

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.powerSystem_solution_of_compatible
statement:
private theorem powerSystem_solution_of_compatible {ι : Type u} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → I) (b : ι → R) (N : ℕ)
    (hcompat : PowerSystemCompatible I s a b N) :
    ∃ m : I, ∀ i ∈ s, b i ^ (N + 1) • m = b i ^ N • a i
proof:
:= by
  let source := powerSystemSource s b N
  let target := powerSystemTarget I s a b N
  let gRange : LinearMap.range source →ₗ[R] I :=
    (Submodule.liftQ (LinearMap.ker source) target hcompat).comp
      source.quotKerEquivRange.symm.toLinearMap
  letI : Module.Injective R I := Module.injective_module_of_injective_object R I
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := Module.Injective.out (Submodule.subtype (LinearMap.range source))
    (Submodule.injective_subtype _) gRange
  refine ⟨h 1, fun i hi ↦ ?_⟩
  let e : ι →₀ R := Finsupp.single i 1
  let z : LinearMap.range source := ⟨source e, ⟨e, rfl⟩⟩
  have hz := hh z
  change h (source e) = gRange z at hz
  have hg : gRange z = target e := by
    change (Submodule.liftQ (LinearMap.ker source) target hcompat)
      (source.quotKerEquivRange.symm z) = target e
    rw [show z = ⟨source e, ⟨e, rfl⟩⟩ by rfl,
      LinearMap.quotKerEquivRange_symm_apply_image]
    exact Submodule.liftQ_apply (LinearMap.ker source) target e
  rw [hg] at hz
  have hs : source e = b i ^ (N + 1) := by
    change (∑ j ∈ s, (Finsupp.single i 1 : ι →₀ R) j * b j ^ (N + 1)) = _
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · simp
    · intro j hj hji
      simp [hji]
    · exact fun h ↦ (h hi).elim
  have ht : target e = b i ^ N • a i := by
    change (∑ j ∈ s, (Finsupp.single i 1 : ι →₀ R) j • (b j ^ N • a j)) = _
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · simp
    · intro j hj hji
      simp [hji]
    · exact fun h ↦ (h hi).elim
  rw [hs, ht] at hz
  calc
    b i ^ (N + 1) • h 1 = h (b i ^ (N + 1) • (1 : R)) :=
      (h.map_smul (b i ^ (N + 1)) 1).symm
    _ = h (b i ^ (N + 1)) := by simp
    _ = b i ^ N • a i := hz

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.powerEquation_raise
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hNT
  have hd := congr_arg (fun x : I ↦ b ^ d • x) h
  simpa only [smul_smul, ← pow_add, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using hd

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.powerSystem_compatible_exists
statement:
private theorem powerSystem_compatible_exists {ι : Type u} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → I) (b : ι → R)
    (hab : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, b j • a i = b i • a j) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, PowerSystemCompatible I s a b N
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      intro c hc
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at hc ⊢
      simp [powerSystemTarget]
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
      have habTail : ∀ j ∈ s, ∀ l ∈ s, b l • a j = b j • a l := by
        intro j hj l hl
        exact hab j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj) l (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hl)
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := ih habTail
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := powerSystem_solution_of_compatible I s a b N hN
      let delta : I := b i • m - a i
      let K : ℕ → Ideal R := fun q =>
        { carrier := {r | (r * b i ^ q) • delta = 0}
          zero_mem' := by simp
          add_mem' := by
            intro r t hr ht
            change ((r + t) * b i ^ q) • delta = 0
            change (r * b i ^ q) • delta = 0 at hr
            change (t * b i ^ q) • delta = 0 at ht
            rw [add_mul, add_smul, hr, ht, add_zero]
          smul_mem' := by
            intro r t ht
            change ((r * t) * b i ^ q) • delta = 0
            change (t * b i ^ q) • delta = 0 at ht
            rw [mul_assoc, mul_smul, ht, smul_zero] }
      have hK : Monotone K := by
        intro q r hqr t ht
        change (t * b i ^ r) • delta = 0
        change (t * b i ^ q) • delta = 0 at ht
        have hr : r = (r - q) + q := by omega
        rw [hr, pow_add]
        calc
          (t * (b i ^ (r - q) * b i ^ q)) • delta =
              b i ^ (r - q) • ((t * b i ^ q) • delta) := by
                rw [smul_smul]
                congr 1
                ring
          _ = 0 := by rw [ht, smul_zero]
      obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ :=
        monotone_stabilizes_iff_noetherian.mpr
          (inferInstance : IsNoetherian R R) ⟨K, hK⟩
      let T := max N N₀
      have hNT : N ≤ T := Nat.le_max_left _ _
      have hN₀T : N₀ ≤ T := Nat.le_max_right _ _
      have hKT : K T = K (T + 1) :=
        (hN₀ _ hN₀T).symm.trans (hN₀ _ (hN₀T.trans (Nat.le_succ T)))
      have hmT (j : ι) (hj : j ∈ s) :
          b j ^ (T + 1) • m = b j ^ T • a j :=
        powerEquation_raise I hNT (hm j hj)
      have hdelta (j : ι) (hj : j ∈ s) : b j ^ (T + 1) • delta = 0 := by
        calc
          b j ^ (T + 1) • delta =
              b i • (b j ^ (T + 1) • m) - b j ^ T • (b j • a i) := by
                dsimp [delta]
                rw [smul_sub, pow_succ]
                module
          _ = b i • (b j ^ T • a j) - b j ^ T • (b i • a j) := by
                rw [hmT j hj, hab i (Finset.mem_insert_self i s) j
                  (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)]
          _ = 0 := by module
      refine ⟨T, ?_⟩
      intro c hc
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at hc ⊢
      change (∑ j ∈ insert i s, c j * b j ^ (T + 1)) = 0 at hc
      rw [Finset.sum_insert hi] at hc
      have hcscalar : (∑ j ∈ s, c j * b j ^ (T + 1)) =
          -(c i * b i ^ (T + 1)) := by
        linear_combination hc
      have hcfirst : c i * b i ^ (T + 1) =
          -(∑ j ∈ s, c j * b j ^ (T + 1)) := by
        linear_combination hc
      have hciNext : c i ∈ K (T + 1) := by
        change (c i * b i ^ (T + 1)) • delta = 0
        rw [hcfirst, neg_smul, Finset.sum_smul]
        have : (∑ j ∈ s, (c j * b j ^ (T + 1)) • delta) = 0 := by
          apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
          intro j hj
          rw [mul_smul, hdelta j hj, smul_zero]
        rw [this, neg_zero]
      have hci : c i ∈ K T := by simpa only [hKT] using hciNext
      change (∑ j ∈ insert i s, c j • (b j ^ T • a j)) = 0
      rw [Finset.sum_insert hi]
      have htail : (∑ j ∈ s, c j • (b j ^ T • a j)) =
          ∑ j ∈ s, (c j * b j ^ (T + 1)) • m := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        calc
          c j • (b j ^ T • a j) = c j • (b j ^ (T + 1) • m) := by
            rw [hmT j hj]
          _ = (c j * b j ^ (T + 1)) • m := by rw [mul_smul]
      rw [htail, ← Finset.sum_smul, hcscalar, neg_smul]
      change (c i * b i ^ T) • delta = 0 at hci
      dsimp [delta] at hci
      rw [smul_sub, smul_smul] at hci
      rw [smul_smul, pow_succ]
      rw [← sub_eq_add_neg, sub_eq_zero]
      simpa only [mul_assoc] using (sub_eq_zero.mp hci).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.injective_finite_power_system_solution
statement:
private theorem injective_finite_power_system_solution {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι]
    (a : ι → I) (b : ι → R) (hab : ∀ i j, b j • a i = b i • a j) :
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (m : I), ∀ i, b i ^ (N + 1) • m = b i ^ N • a i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := powerSystem_compatible_exists I Finset.univ a b (by simpa using hab)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := powerSystem_solution_of_compatible I Finset.univ a b N hN
  exact ⟨N, m, fun i ↦ hm i (Finset.mem_univ i)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.basicOpenLocalizedEquiv_apply_mk
statement:
private theorem basicOpenLocalizedEquiv_apply_mk (f : R) (a : I)
    (g : Submonoid.powers f) :
    basicOpenLocalizedEquiv I f (LocalizedModule.mk a g) =
      StructureSheaf.const a g.1 (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) (by
        obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (Submonoid.mem_powers_iff g.1 f).mp g.2
        rw [← hn]
        exact PrimeSpectrum.le_basicOpen_pow f n)
proof:
:= by
  let q := StructureSheaf.toOpenₗ R I (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)
  letI : IsLocalizedModule.Away f q := inferInstance
  change IsLocalizedModule.iso (.powers f) q (LocalizedModule.mk a g) = _
  apply (IsLocalizedModule.iso (.powers f) q).symm.injective
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  symm
  apply IsLocalizedModule.iso_symm_apply' (.powers f) q _ a g
  change g.1 • StructureSheaf.const a g.1 (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) _ = q a
  rw [StructureSheaf.smul_const]
  let h1 : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (1 : R) := by simp
  change StructureSheaf.const (g.1 • a) g.1 (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) _ =
    StructureSheaf.const a 1 (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) h1
  apply StructureSheaf.const_eq_const_of_smul_eq_smul
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.normalizedFiniteBasicOpenPresentation
statement:
private theorem normalizedFiniteBasicOpenPresentation
    (U : Opens (PrimeSpectrum.Top R)) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set (PrimeSpectrum.Top R)))
    (s : (structureSheafInType R I).presheaf.obj (.op U)) :
    ∃ (ι : Type u) (_ : Fintype ι) (a : ι → I) (b : ι → R)
      (ibU : ∀ i, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (b i) ≤ U),
      (U ≤ ⨆ i, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (b i)) ∧
      (∀ i j, b j • a i = b i • a j) ∧
      ∀ i, (structureSheafInType R I).presheaf.map (ibU i).hom.op s =
        StructureSheaf.const (a i) (b i) _ le_rfl
proof:
:= by
  choose g hxg igU f H using fun x : U ↦ StructureSheaf.exists_const U s x.1 x.2
  have hfrac (i j : U) :
      LocalizedModule.mk (g i • f j)
          ⟨g i * g j, Submonoid.mem_powers _⟩ =
        LocalizedModule.mk (g j • f i)
          ⟨g i * g j, Submonoid.mem_powers _⟩ := by
    refine (basicOpenLocalizedEquiv I (g i * g j)).injective ?_
    rw [basicOpenLocalizedEquiv_apply_mk, basicOpenLocalizedEquiv_apply_mk]
    have hHi := H i
    have hHj := H j
    trans (structureSheafInType R I).presheaf.map (homOfLE ?_).op s
    · refine .trans (Subtype.ext <| funext fun x ↦ ?_)
        congr((structureSheafInType R I).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE ((PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_mul (g i) (g j)).trans_le inf_le_right)).op
          $(hHj))
      exact LocalizedModule.mk_eq.mpr
        ⟨1, by simp [Submonoid.smul_def, ← smul_assoc]; ring_nf⟩
    · refine congr((structureSheafInType R I).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE ((PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_mul (g i) (g j)).trans_le inf_le_left)).op
          $(hHi)).symm.trans (Subtype.ext <| funext fun x ↦ ?_)
      exact LocalizedModule.mk_eq.mpr
        ⟨1, by simp [Submonoid.smul_def, ← smul_assoc]⟩
    · exact ((PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_mul (g i) (g j)).trans_le inf_le_right).trans (igU _)
  simp only [LocalizedModule.mk_eq, Submonoid.smul_def, Subtype.exists,
    Submonoid.mem_powers_iff, exists_prop, exists_exists_eq_and, ← mul_smul,
    ← pow_succ, ← mul_assoc _ (_ * _)] at hfrac
  choose n hn using hfrac
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hU.elim_finite_subcover
    (fun i ↦ (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (g i) : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)))
    (fun _ ↦ (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen _).2)
    (fun x hx ↦ Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem ⟨x, hx⟩ (hxg _))
  let N := (t ×ˢ t).sup fun x ↦ n x.1 x.2 + 1
  refine ⟨t, inferInstance, fun i ↦ g i ^ N • f i, fun i ↦ g i ^ (N + 1),
    fun x ↦ by simpa using igU x.1, fun x hx ↦ by simpa using ht hx,
    fun i j ↦ ?_, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  · dsimp
    convert_to (g i * g ↑j) ^ N • g j • f i =
      (g i * g ↑j) ^ N • g i • f j
    · module
    · module
    have hle : n i j + 1 ≤ N :=
      (t ×ˢ t).le_sup (f := fun x ↦ n x.1 x.2 + 1) (b := ⟨_, _⟩) (by simp)
    rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel hle, pow_add, mul_smul, mul_smul]
    congr 1
    convert! (hn i j).symm using 1 <;> module
  · convert! congr((structureSheafInType R I).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE ?_).op $((H i).symm)) using 1
    · refine Subtype.ext <| funext fun x ↦ LocalizedModule.mk_eq.mpr ⟨1, ?_⟩
      simp [Submonoid.smul_def, pow_succ', mul_smul]
    · simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.structureSheaf_toOpen_surjective
statement:
theorem structureSheaf_toOpen_surjective
    (U : Opens (PrimeSpectrum.Top R)) :
    Function.Surjective (StructureSheaf.toOpenₗ R I U)
proof:
:= by
  letI : NoetherianSpace (PrimeSpectrum.Top R) :=
    PrimeSpectrum.instNoetherianSpace R
  intro s
  obtain ⟨ι, hι, a, b, ibU, iU, hab, H⟩ :=
    normalizedFiniteBasicOpenPresentation I U (NoetherianSpace.isCompact _) s
  letI : Fintype ι := hι
  obtain ⟨N, m, hm⟩ := injective_finite_power_system_solution I a b hab
  refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
  refine (structureSheafInType R I).eq_of_locally_eq'
    (fun i : ι ↦ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (b i)) U
    (fun i ↦ (ibU i).hom) iU _ _ fun i ↦ ?_
  change (structureSheafInType R I).presheaf.map (ibU i).hom.op
      (StructureSheaf.toOpenₗ R I U m) =
    (structureSheafInType R I).presheaf.map (ibU i).hom.op s
  rw [H i]
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun x ↦ ?_)
  change LocalizedModule.mk m (1 : x.1.asIdeal.primeCompl) =
    LocalizedModule.mk (a i) (⟨b i, x.2⟩ : x.1.asIdeal.primeCompl)
  refine LocalizedModule.mk_eq.mpr
    ⟨(⟨b i ^ N, x.1.asIdeal.primeCompl.pow_mem x.2 N⟩ : x.1.asIdeal.primeCompl), ?_⟩
  simpa [Submonoid.smul_def, smul_smul, pow_succ', mul_comm] using hm i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.tilde_toOpen_surjective
statement:
theorem tilde_toOpen_surjective (U : Opens (PrimeSpectrum.Top R)) :
    Function.Surjective
      (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde.toOpen (R := R) I U).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective]
  letI : Epi (ModuleCat.ofHom (StructureSheaf.toOpenₗ R I U)) :=
    (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mpr
      (structureSheaf_toOpen_surjective I U)
  unfold AlgebraicGeometry.tilde.toOpen
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.tilde_top_to_open_surjective
statement:
theorem tilde_top_to_open_surjective (U : Opens (PrimeSpectrum.Top R)) :
    Function.Surjective
      (((AlgebraicGeometry.modulesSpecToSheaf (R := R)).obj
        (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde I)).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (show U ≤ (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens) from le_top)).op)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := tilde_toOpen_surjective I U x
  refine ⟨(AlgebraicGeometry.tilde.toOpen (R := R) I ⊤).hom m, ?_⟩
  have h := AlgebraicGeometry.tilde.toOpen_res (R := R) I ⊤ U
    (homOfLE (show U ≤ (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens) from le_top))
  change _ = x
  have hm' := congr($(h).hom m)
  exact hm'.trans hm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.tilde_modulesSpecToSheaf_isFlasque
statement:
theorem tilde_modulesSpecToSheaf_isFlasque :
    TopCat.Presheaf.IsFlasque
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.modulesSpecToSheaf (R := R)).obj
        (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde I)).presheaf where
  epi {U V} i
proof:
:= by
    let topToU : (.op (⊤ : Opens (PrimeSpectrum.Top R))) ⟶ U :=
      (homOfLE (show U.unop ≤ (⊤ : Opens (PrimeSpectrum.Top R)) from le_top)).op
    have h : topToU ≫ i =
        (homOfLE (show V.unop ≤ (⊤ : Opens (PrimeSpectrum.Top R)) from le_top)).op :=
      Subsingleton.elim _ _
    letI : Epi
      ((((AlgebraicGeometry.modulesSpecToSheaf (R := R)).obj
        (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde I)).presheaf.map topToU)
        ≫ (((AlgebraicGeometry.modulesSpecToSheaf (R := R)).obj
          (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde I)).presheaf.map i)) := by
      rw [← Functor.map_comp, h, ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective]
      exact tilde_top_to_open_surjective I V.unop
    exact epi_of_epi
      (((AlgebraicGeometry.modulesSpecToSheaf (R := R)).obj
        (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde I)).presheaf.map topToU)
      (((AlgebraicGeometry.modulesSpecToSheaf (R := R)).obj
        (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde I)).presheaf.map i)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.tilde_toSheafAb_isFlasque
statement:
theorem tilde_toSheafAb_isFlasque :
    TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque
      ((Modules.toSheafAb (Spec R)).obj (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde I)) where
  epi {U V} i
proof:
:= by
    rw [AddCommGrpCat.epi_iff_surjective]
    change Function.Surjective
      (((AlgebraicGeometry.modulesSpecToSheaf (R := R)).obj
        (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde I)).presheaf.map i).hom
    exact (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mp
      ((tilde_modulesSpecToSheaf_isFlasque I).epi i)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.tilde_H_isZero_of_injective
statement:
theorem tilde_H_isZero_of_injective (n : ℕ) :
    Limits.IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb (Spec R)).obj
        (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde I)) (n + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  letI : TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque
      ((Modules.toSheafAb (Spec R)).obj (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde I)) :=
    tilde_toSheafAb_isFlasque I
  exact TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque.H_isZero _ n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.algebraicCycle_support_finite

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.algebraicCycleEquivFinsupp_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem algebraicCycleEquivFinsupp_apply {X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X]
    (D : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) (x : X) :
    algebraicCycleEquivFinsupp X D x = D x
proof:
:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor_apply
    (D : SchemeWeilDivisor (X := X)) (p : CodimOnePoint X) :
    weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D (codimOnePointEquivPlace k p) = D.1 p.1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor, Finsupp.domCongr_apply,
    Finsupp.equivMapDomain_apply, Finsupp.subtypeDomain_apply,
    algebraicCycleEquivFinsupp_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.finrank_residueField_cycleModule_eq_place_degree
statement:
theorem finrank_residueField_cycleModule_eq_place_degree (p : CodimOnePoint X) :
    @Module.finrank k (X.residueField p.1) _ _
        (AlgebraicCycle.instModuleCarrierResidueField k p.1) =
      (codimOnePointEquivPlace k p).degree
proof:
:= by
  let M : Module k (X.residueField p.1) :=
    @Algebra.toModule k (X.residueField p.1) _ _ (residueFieldAlgebra X k p.1)
  have hM : AlgebraicCycle.instModuleCarrierResidueField k p.1 = M := by
    apply Module.ext'
    intro r y
    change (X.Γevaluation p.1).hom
        (globalSec (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) r) * y =
      (X.residue p.1).hom
        ((X.presheaf.germ ⊤ p.1 trivial).hom
          (structureRingHom (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) ⊤ r)) * y
    apply congrArg (fun z : X.residueField p.1 => z * y)
    apply congrArg (X.residue p.1).hom
    apply congrArg (X.presheaf.germ ⊤ p.1 trivial).hom
    rw [structureRingHom_apply]
    have heq : (⊤ : X.Opens).leTop = 𝟙 (⊤ : X.Opens) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [heq]
    simp
  have hfin :
      @Module.finrank k (X.residueField p.1) _ _
          (AlgebraicCycle.instModuleCarrierResidueField k p.1) =
        @Module.finrank k (X.residueField p.1) _ _ M := by
    rw [hM]
  exact hfin.trans (finrank_residueField_eq_place_degree k p)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.finsum_mul_eq_finsupp_sum
statement:
private theorem finsum_mul_eq_finsupp_sum {Y : Type*} (D : Y →₀ ℤ) (w : Y → ℤ) :
    ∑ᶠ y, D y * w y = D.sum fun y n => n * w y
proof:
:= by
  rw [finsum_eq_finsetSum_of_support_subset _ (s := D.support)]
  · rfl
  · intro y hy
    apply Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr
    intro hzero
    exact hy (by simp only [hzero, zero_mul])

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.degree_weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor
statement:
theorem degree_weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor
    (D : SchemeWeilDivisor (X := X)) :
    AlgebraicCycle.degree k D.1 =
      FunctionField.Divisor.deg k X.functionField
        (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D)
proof:
:= by
  let f : X →₀ ℤ := algebraicCycleEquivFinsupp X D.1
  let fc : CodimOnePoint X →₀ ℤ :=
    Finsupp.subtypeDomain (fun x : X => coheight x = 1) f
  have hf : ∀ x ∈ f.support, coheight x = 1 := by
    intro x hx
    apply D.2
    have hne : f x ≠ 0 := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hx
    simpa only [f, algebraicCycleEquivFinsupp_apply, Function.mem_support] using hne
  calc
    AlgebraicCycle.degree k D.1 =
        ∑ᶠ x : X, f x * (Module.finrank k (X.residueField x) : ℤ) := by
      simp only [AlgebraicCycle.degree, f, algebraicCycleEquivFinsupp_apply]
    _ = f.sum (fun x n => n * (Module.finrank k (X.residueField x) : ℤ)) :=
      finsum_mul_eq_finsupp_sum f _
    _ = fc.sum (fun p n => n * (Module.finrank k (X.residueField p.1) : ℤ)) := by
      exact (Finsupp.sum_subtypeDomain_index hf).symm
    _ = ∑ᶠ p : CodimOnePoint X,
        fc p * (Module.finrank k (X.residueField p.1) : ℤ) :=
      (finsum_mul_eq_finsupp_sum fc _).symm
    _ = ∑ᶠ p : CodimOnePoint X,
        weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D (codimOnePointEquivPlace k p) *
          ((codimOnePointEquivPlace k p).degree : ℤ) := by
      apply finsum_congr
      intro p
      rw [weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor_apply]
      rw [show (Module.finrank k (X.residueField p.1) : ℤ) =
          ((codimOnePointEquivPlace k p).degree : ℤ) by
        exact congrArg (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℤ))
          (finrank_residueField_cycleModule_eq_place_degree k p)]
      simp only [fc, f, Finsupp.subtypeDomain_apply,
        algebraicCycleEquivFinsupp_apply]
    _ = ∑ᶠ v : FunctionField.Place k X.functionField,
        weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D v * (v.degree : ℤ) :=
      finsum_comp_equiv (codimOnePointEquivPlace k)
        (f := fun v : FunctionField.Place k X.functionField =>
          weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D v * (v.degree : ℤ))
    _ = FunctionField.Divisor.deg k X.functionField
        (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D) := by
      exact finsum_mul_eq_finsupp_sum _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor_schemePrincipalDivisor
statement:
theorem weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor_schemePrincipalDivisor
    (f : X.functionFieldˣ) :
    weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k (schemePrincipalDivisor f) =
      FunctionField.principalDivisor k X.functionField (Additive.ofMul f)
proof:
:= by
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro v
  let p : CodimOnePoint X := (codimOnePointEquivPlace k).symm v
  rw [← (codimOnePointEquivPlace k).apply_symm_apply v]
  rw [weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor_apply]
  change X.ord (f : X.functionField) p.1 =
    FunctionField.principalDivisor k X.functionField (Additive.ofMul f)
      (codimOnePointEquivPlace k p)
  have hp := valuation_eq_exp_neg_ord k p f.ne_zero
  have hq := FunctionField.Place.valuation_eq_exp_neg_principalDivisor
    (k := k) (K := X.functionField) (Additive.ofMul f) (codimOnePointEquivPlace k p)
  exact neg_injective (WithZero.exp_injective (hp.symm.trans hq))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.mem_carrier_top_iff_memRRspace
statement:
theorem mem_carrier_top_iff_memRRspace (D : SchemeWeilDivisor (X := X))
    (f : X.functionField) :
    f ∈ AlgebraicCycle.Sheaf.carrier D.1 ⊤ ↔
      FunctionField.memRRspace k X.functionField
        (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D) f
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : f = 0
  · subst f
    constructor
    · intro
      exact FunctionField.memRRspace.zero_mem _
    · intro
      exact AlgebraicCycle.Sheaf.zero_mem' D.1 ⊤
  constructor
  · intro h v
    let p : CodimOnePoint X := (codimOnePointEquivPlace k).symm v
    have hp := (AlgebraicCycle.Sheaf.mem_carrier_iff.mp h hf).2 p.1 trivial
    rw [← (codimOnePointEquivPlace k).apply_symm_apply v]
    rw [weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor_apply]
    change (placeOfCodimOnePoint k p).valuation f ≤ WithZero.exp (D.1 p.1)
    rw [valuation_eq_exp_neg_ord k p hf]
    apply WithZero.exp_le_exp.mpr
    omega
  · intro h
    rw [AlgebraicCycle.Sheaf.mem_carrier_iff]
    intro
    refine ⟨nonemptyTop X, fun z _ => ?_⟩
    by_cases hz : coheight z = 1
    · let p : CodimOnePoint X := ⟨z, hz⟩
      have hp := h (codimOnePointEquivPlace k p)
      rw [weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor_apply] at hp
      change (placeOfCodimOnePoint k p).valuation f ≤ WithZero.exp (D.1 p.1) at hp
      rw [valuation_eq_exp_neg_ord k p hf] at hp
      have hp' := WithZero.exp_le_exp.mp hp
      change 0 ≤ X.ord f p.1 + D.1 p.1
      omega
    · have hord : X.ord f z = 0 := Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hz f
      have hD : D.1 z = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hz (D.2 (show z ∈ D.1.support from hne))
      rw [hord, hD]
      omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.h_zero_eq_ell
statement:
theorem h_zero_eq_ell (D : SchemeWeilDivisor (X := X)) :
    Scheme.Modules.h k D.1.sheaf 0 =
      FunctionField.ell k X.functionField
        (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Modules.h, FunctionField.ell]
  exact (H0LinearEquivRRspace k D).finrank_eq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.isAlgebraic_germ_globalSection
statement:
theorem isAlgebraic_germ_globalSection (s : Γ(X, ⊤)) :
    IsAlgebraic k (X.germToFunctionField (⊤ : X.Opens) s)
proof:
:= by
  let f : X.functionField := X.germToFunctionField (⊤ : X.Opens) s
  have hfCarrier :
      f ∈ AlgebraicCycle.Sheaf.carrier (0 : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) (⊤ : X.Opens) := by
    let x : (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology (genericPoint X)).fiber.obj
        (⊤ : X.Opens) := ⟨⟨trivial⟩⟩
    have h := (unitToSheafZero.app (op (⊤ : X.Opens)) s).property x
    rw [eval_unitToSheafZero_app, mul_one] at h
    exact h
  let D0 : SchemeWeilDivisor (X := X) :=
    ⟨0, fun _ hx ↦ (hx rfl).elim⟩
  have hD0 : weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D0 = 0 := by
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro v
    let p : CodimOnePoint X := (codimOnePointEquivPlace k).symm v
    rw [← (codimOnePointEquivPlace k).apply_symm_apply v]
    rw [weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor_apply]
    rfl
  have hfRR : FunctionField.memRRspace k X.functionField 0 f := by
    have h := (mem_carrier_top_iff_memRRspace k D0 f).mp hfCarrier
    simpa only [hD0] using h
  apply FunctionField.Chart.isAlgebraic_of_placeValuation_le_one
    k X.functionField f
  intro v
  have hv := hfRR (FunctionField.chartToPlace k X.functionField v)
  rw [FunctionField.placeValuation_eq] at hv
  simpa only [Finsupp.zero_apply, WithZero.exp_zero] using hv

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.globalSectionsToRelativeConstantField_bijective
statement:
theorem globalSectionsToRelativeConstantField_bijective :
    Function.Bijective (globalSectionsToRelativeConstantField (X := X) k)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro s t hst
    apply X.germToFunctionField_injective (⊤ : X.Opens)
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hst
  · rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
    have hzAlg : IsAlgebraic k z := mem_algebraicClosure_iff.mp hz
    have hzRR : FunctionField.memRRspace k X.functionField 0 z := by
      intro v
      letI : IsScalarTower k v.toValuationSubring X.functionField :=
        IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
      have hzIntegral : _root_.IsIntegral v.toValuationSubring z :=
        _root_.IsIntegral.tower_top hzAlg.isIntegral
      have hzMem : z ∈ v.toValuationSubring :=
        LocalSubring.mem_of_isMax_of_isIntegral
          v.toValuationSubring.isMax_toLocalSubring hzIntegral
      rw [← v.valuationSubring_valuation, Valuation.mem_valuationSubring_iff] at hzMem
      simpa only [Finsupp.zero_apply, WithZero.exp_zero] using hzMem
    let D0 : SchemeWeilDivisor (X := X) :=
      ⟨0, fun _ hx ↦ (hx rfl).elim⟩
    have hD0 : weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D0 = 0 := by
      apply Finsupp.ext
      intro v
      let p : CodimOnePoint X := (codimOnePointEquivPlace k).symm v
      rw [← (codimOnePointEquivPlace k).apply_symm_apply v]
      rw [weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor_apply]
      rfl
    have hzCarrier : z ∈ AlgebraicCycle.Sheaf.carrier D0.1 (⊤ : X.Opens) :=
      (mem_carrier_top_iff_memRRspace k D0 z).mpr (by simpa only [hD0] using hzRR)
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_germ_eq_of_mem_carrier
      (X := X) (U := (⊤ : X.Opens)) trivial hzCarrier
    refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hs

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.globalSectionsEquivRelativeConstantField_globalSec
statement:
theorem globalSectionsEquivRelativeConstantField_globalSec (c : k) :
    globalSectionsEquivRelativeConstantField (X := X) k
        (globalSec (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) c) =
      algebraMap k (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) c
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change X.germToFunctionField (⊤ : X.Opens)
      (globalSec (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) c) =
    algebraMap k X.functionField c
  rw [CompatibleAlgebra.algebraMap_eq (X := X) (k := k)]
  apply congrArg (X.germToFunctionField (⊤ : X.Opens)).hom
  rw [structureRingHom_apply]
  have heq : (⊤ : X.Opens).leTop = 𝟙 (⊤ : X.Opens) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [heq]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.globalSec_relativeConstantField
statement:
theorem globalSec_relativeConstantField (c : relativeConstantField (X := X) k) :
    globalSec (X := X)
        (R := CommRingCat.of (relativeConstantField (X := X) k)) c =
      (globalSectionsEquivRelativeConstantField (X := X) k).symm c
proof:
:= by
  change (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso
      (CommRingCat.of (relativeConstantField (X := X) k))).inv ≫
        (relativeConstantMorphism (X := X) k).appTop).hom c) = _
  simp [relativeConstantMorphism]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.relativeConstantMorphism_comp_base
statement:
theorem relativeConstantMorphism_comp_base :
    relativeConstantMorphism (X := X) k ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap k (relativeConstantField (X := X) k))) =
      X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)
proof:
:= by
  apply AlgebraicGeometry.ext_to_Spec
  change (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv ≫
      (relativeConstantMorphism (X := X) k ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap k (relativeConstantField (X := X) k)))).appTop =
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv ≫
      (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).appTop
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, ← Category.assoc,
    ← Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality, Category.assoc]
  ext c
  change globalSec (X := X)
      (R := CommRingCat.of (relativeConstantField (X := X) k))
        (algebraMap k (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) c) =
    globalSec (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) c
  rw [globalSec_relativeConstantField]
  exact (globalSectionsEquivRelativeConstantField (X := X) k).symm_apply_eq.mpr
    (globalSectionsEquivRelativeConstantField_globalSec (X := X) k c).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.structureRingHom_relativeConstantField_algebraMap
statement:
theorem structureRingHom_relativeConstantField_algebraMap
    (U : X.Opens) (r : k) :
    structureRingHom (X := X)
        (R := CommRingCat.of (relativeConstantField (X := X) k)) U
        (algebraMap k (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) r) =
      structureRingHom (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) U r
proof:
:= by
  rw [structureRingHom_apply, structureRingHom_apply]
  apply congrArg (X.presheaf.map U.leTop.op).hom
  rw [globalSec_relativeConstantField]
  exact (globalSectionsEquivRelativeConstantField (X := X) k).symm_apply_eq.mpr
    (globalSectionsEquivRelativeConstantField_globalSec (X := X) k r).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.smulNatTrans_eq_relativeConstantField
statement:
theorem smulNatTrans_eq_relativeConstantField (F : X.Modules) (r : k) :
    smulNatTrans (R := CommRingCat.of k) F r =
      smulNatTrans
        (R := CommRingCat.of (relativeConstantField (X := X) k)) F
        (algebraMap k (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) r)
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext U
  letI : Module k Γ(F, U.unop) :=
    Module.compHom Γ(F, U.unop)
      (structureRingHom (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) U.unop)
  letI : Module (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) Γ(F, U.unop) :=
    Module.compHom Γ(F, U.unop)
      (structureRingHom (X := X)
        (R := CommRingCat.of (relativeConstantField (X := X) k)) U.unop)
  let sectionSMul : SMul Γ(X, U.unop) Γ(F, U.unop) := inferInstance
  letI : SMul Γ(X, U.unop) Γ(F, U.unop) := sectionSMul
  let sectionModule : Module Γ(X, U.unop) Γ(F, U.unop) := inferInstance
  letI : Module Γ(X, U.unop) Γ(F, U.unop) := sectionModule
  ext y
  change (DistribSMul.toAddMonoidHom Γ(F, U.unop) r) y =
    (DistribSMul.toAddMonoidHom Γ(F, U.unop)
      (algebraMap k (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) r)) y
  change @SMul.smul Γ(X, U.unop) Γ(F, U.unop) sectionModule.toSMul
      (structureRingHom (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) U.unop r) y =
    @SMul.smul Γ(X, U.unop) Γ(F, U.unop) sectionModule.toSMul
      (structureRingHom (X := X)
        (R := CommRingCat.of (relativeConstantField (X := X) k)) U.unop
        (algebraMap k (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) r)) y
  rw [structureRingHom_relativeConstantField_algebraMap]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.smulEnd_eq_relativeConstantField
statement:
theorem smulEnd_eq_relativeConstantField (F : X.Modules) (r : k) :
    smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of k) F r =
      smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of (relativeConstantField (X := X) k)) F
        (algebraMap k (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) r)
proof:
:= by
  change CategoryTheory.Sheaf.homEquiv.symm
      (smulNatTrans (R := CommRingCat.of k) F r) =
    CategoryTheory.Sheaf.homEquiv.symm
      (smulNatTrans
        (R := CommRingCat.of (relativeConstantField (X := X) k)) F
        (algebraMap k (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) r))
  rw [smulNatTrans_eq_relativeConstantField]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.smul_H_eq_relativeConstantField
statement:
theorem smul_H_eq_relativeConstantField (F : X.Modules) (n : ℕ)
    (r : k) (x : F.H n) :
    r • x = algebraMap k (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) r • x
proof:
:= by
  change x.comp
      (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀
        (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of k) F r)) (Nat.add_zero n) =
    x.comp
      (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀
        (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of
          (relativeConstantField (X := X) k)) F
          (algebraMap k (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) r)))
      (Nat.add_zero n)
  rw [smulEnd_eq_relativeConstantField]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.finrank_H_eq_relativeConstantField_mul
statement:
theorem finrank_H_eq_relativeConstantField_mul (F : X.Modules) (n : ℕ) :
    Module.finrank k (F.H n) =
      Module.finrank k (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) *
        Module.finrank (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) (F.H n)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Free k (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) :=
    Module.Free.of_divisionRing k (relativeConstantField (X := X) k)
  letI : Module.Free (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) (F.H n) :=
    Module.Free.of_divisionRing (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) (F.H n)
  exact (Module.finrank_mul_finrank k
    (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) (F.H n)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.eulerChar_eq_relativeConstantField_mul
statement:
theorem eulerChar_eq_relativeConstantField_mul (F : X.Modules) :
    F.eulerChar k =
      (Module.finrank k (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) : ℤ) *
        F.eulerChar (relativeConstantField (X := X) k)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.eulerChar, Scheme.Modules.h]
  calc
    (∑ᶠ n : ℕ, (-1 : ℤ) ^ n * (Module.finrank k (F.H n) : ℤ)) =
        ∑ᶠ n : ℕ,
          (Module.finrank k (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) : ℤ) *
            ((-1 : ℤ) ^ n *
              (Module.finrank (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) (F.H n) : ℤ)) := by
      apply finsum_congr
      intro n
      rw [finrank_H_eq_relativeConstantField_mul (X := X) k F n]
      push_cast
      ring
    _ = (Module.finrank k (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) : ℤ) *
        ∑ᶠ n : ℕ, (-1 : ℤ) ^ n *
          (Module.finrank (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) (F.H n) : ℤ) := by
      rw [mul_finsum]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.structureSheaf_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_relativeConstantField
statement:
theorem structureSheaf_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_relativeConstantField :
    (structureSheafModule X).HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic
      (relativeConstantField (X := X) k)
proof:
:= by
  have hχk := structureSheaf_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic (X := X) k
  refine ⟨?_, hχk.vanishing⟩
  intro n
  letI : Module.Finite k ((structureSheafModule X).H n) := hχk.finite n
  exact Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite k
    (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) ((structureSheafModule X).H n)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.riemann_roch_relativeConstantField
statement:
theorem riemann_roch_relativeConstantField (D : SchemeWeilDivisor (X := X)) :
    (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D.1).eulerChar
        (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) =
      AlgebraicCycle.degree (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) D.1 +
        (structureSheafModule X).eulerChar
          (relativeConstantField (X := X) k)
proof:
:=
  AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.riemann_roch
    (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) D.1
    (structureSheaf_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_relativeConstantField (X := X) k) D.2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.finrank_residueField_eq_relativeConstantField_mul
statement:
theorem finrank_residueField_eq_relativeConstantField_mul
    (p : CodimOnePoint X) :
    Module.finrank k (X.residueField p.1) =
      Module.finrank k (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) *
        Module.finrank (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) (X.residueField p.1)
proof:
:= by
  let M : Module k (X.residueField p.1) :=
    @Algebra.toModule k (X.residueField p.1)
      _ _ (residueFieldAlgebra X k p.1)
  let M0 : Module (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) (X.residueField p.1) :=
    @Algebra.toModule (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) (X.residueField p.1)
      _ _ (residueFieldAlgebra X (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) p.1)
  have hM : AlgebraicCycle.instModuleCarrierResidueField k p.1 = M :=
    cycleModule_eq_residueFieldAlgebraModule k p
  have hM0 : AlgebraicCycle.instModuleCarrierResidueField
      (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) p.1 = M0 :=
    cycleModule_eq_residueFieldAlgebraModule
      (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) p
  haveI hfinite0 : @Module.Finite (relativeConstantField (X := X) k)
      (X.residueField p.1) _ _ M0 := by
    rw [← hM0]
    exact finite_residueField_of_coheight_eq_one
      (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) p.2
  rw [hM, hM0]
  letI : Module k (X.residueField p.1) := M
  letI : Module (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) (X.residueField p.1) := M0
  letI : IsScalarTower k (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) (X.residueField p.1) :=
    relativeConstantFieldResidueFieldTower (X := X) k p.1
  exact (Module.finrank_mul_finrank k
    (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) (X.residueField p.1)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.ell_zero_eq_finrank_relativeConstantField
statement:
theorem ell_zero_eq_finrank_relativeConstantField :
    FunctionField.ell k X.functionField (0 : FunctionField.Divisor k X.functionField) =
      Module.finrank k (relativeConstantField (X := X) k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [FunctionField.ell]
  exact (RRspaceZeroLinearEquivRelativeConstantField (X := X) k).finrank_eq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.h_zero_structure_relativeConstantField
statement:
theorem h_zero_structure_relativeConstantField :
    Scheme.Modules.h (relativeConstantField (X := X) k)
      (structureSheafModule X) 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hk : Scheme.Modules.h k (structureSheafModule X) 0 =
      Module.finrank k (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) := by
    rw [h_zero_structure_eq_ell_zero_generalConstants (X := X) k,
      ell_zero_eq_finrank_relativeConstantField (X := X) k]
  have hscale := finrank_H_eq_relativeConstantField_mul
    (X := X) k (structureSheafModule X) 0
  change Scheme.Modules.h k (structureSheafModule X) 0 =
    Module.finrank k (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) *
      Scheme.Modules.h (relativeConstantField (X := X) k)
        (structureSheafModule X) 0 at hscale
  rw [hk] at hscale
  have hpos : 0 < Module.finrank k (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) :=
    Module.finrank_pos
  apply Nat.mul_left_cancel hpos
  simpa using hscale.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.full_riemann_roch_relativeConstantField
statement:
theorem full_riemann_roch_relativeConstantField (D : SchemeWeilDivisor (X := X)) :
    (Scheme.Modules.h (relativeConstantField (X := X) k)
        (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D.1) 0 : ℤ) -
      (Scheme.Modules.h (relativeConstantField (X := X) k)
        (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D.1) 1 : ℤ) =
    AlgebraicCycle.degree (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) D.1 + 1 -
      (schemeGenus (X := X) (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hDvanish : ∀ n, 1 < n → Subsingleton
      (Scheme.Modules.H (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D.1) n) := by
    intro n hn
    letI : Subsingleton (Scheme.Modules.H D.1.sheaf n) :=
      subsingleton_H_of_two_le k D (principalPartsSheafIsoAdelic k D) n (by omega)
    exact ((hLinearEquivOfIso (relativeConstantField (X := X) k)
      (sheafIsoSheafViaSubmodule D.1) n).symm.toEquiv).subsingleton
  have hOvanish : ∀ n, 1 < n →
      Subsingleton (Scheme.Modules.H (structureSheafModule X) n) := by
    intro n hn
    let D0 : SchemeWeilDivisor (X := X) :=
      ⟨0, fun _ hx ↦ (hx rfl).elim⟩
    letI : Subsingleton (Scheme.Modules.H D0.1.sheaf n) :=
      subsingleton_H_of_two_le k D0 (principalPartsSheafIsoAdelic k D0) n (by omega)
    letI : Subsingleton
        (Scheme.Modules.H (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D0.1) n) :=
      ((hLinearEquivOfIso (relativeConstantField (X := X) k)
        (sheafIsoSheafViaSubmodule D0.1) n).symm.toEquiv).subsingleton
    exact ((hLinearEquivOfIso (relativeConstantField (X := X) k)
      (unitIsoSheafZero (X := X)) n).toEquiv).subsingleton
  have hfull := full_riemann_roch_of_eulerChar_eq
    (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) D
    (riemann_roch_relativeConstantField (X := X) k D) hDvanish hOvanish
  rw [h_zero_structure_relativeConstantField (X := X) k] at hfull
  simpa [schemeGenus] using hfull

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.finrank_base_eq_finrank_mul_finrank
statement:
theorem finrank_base_eq_finrank_mul_finrank
    (k0 V : Type u) [Field k0] [AddCommGroup V]
    [Algebra k k0] [Module k V] [Module k0 V] [IsScalarTower k k0 V]
    [FiniteDimensional k k0] [FiniteDimensional k0 V] :
    Module.finrank k V = Module.finrank k k0 * Module.finrank k0 V
proof:
:=
  (Module.finrank_mul_finrank k k0 V).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.degree_base_eq_finrank_mul_degree_extension
statement:
theorem degree_base_eq_finrank_mul_degree_extension
    (k0 : Type u) [Field k0] [Algebra k k0]
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k0))]
    [FiniteDimensional k k0]
    (hfinrank : ∀ x : X,
      Module.finrank k (X.residueField x) =
        Module.finrank k k0 * Module.finrank k0 (X.residueField x))
    (D : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) :
    AlgebraicCycle.degree k D =
      (Module.finrank k k0 : ℤ) * AlgebraicCycle.degree k0 D
proof:
:= by
  simp only [AlgebraicCycle.degree]
  calc
    (∑ᶠ x : X, D x * (Module.finrank k (X.residueField x) : ℤ)) =
        ∑ᶠ x : X, (Module.finrank k k0 : ℤ) *
          (D x * (Module.finrank k0 (X.residueField x) : ℤ)) := by
      apply finsum_congr
      intro x
      rw [hfinrank x]
      push_cast
      ring
    _ = (Module.finrank k k0 : ℤ) *
        ∑ᶠ x : X, D x * (Module.finrank k0 (X.residueField x) : ℤ) := by
      rw [mul_finsum]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.degree_eq_relativeConstantField_mul
statement:
theorem degree_eq_relativeConstantField_mul (D : SchemeWeilDivisor (X := X)) :
    AlgebraicCycle.degree k D.1 =
      (Module.finrank k (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) : ℤ) *
        AlgebraicCycle.degree (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) D.1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [AlgebraicCycle.degree]
  calc
    (∑ᶠ x : X, D.1 x * (Module.finrank k (X.residueField x) : ℤ)) =
        ∑ᶠ x : X,
          (Module.finrank k (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) : ℤ) *
            (D.1 x *
              (Module.finrank (relativeConstantField (X := X) k)
                (X.residueField x) : ℤ)) := by
      apply finsum_congr
      intro x
      by_cases hx : D.1 x = 0
      · simp [hx]
      · have hcodim : coheight x = 1 := D.2 (by simpa [Function.mem_support] using hx)
        rw [finrank_residueField_eq_relativeConstantField_mul
          (X := X) k ⟨x, hcodim⟩]
        push_cast
        ring
    _ = (Module.finrank k (relativeConstantField (X := X) k) : ℤ) *
        ∑ᶠ x : X, D.1 x *
          (Module.finrank (relativeConstantField (X := X) k)
            (X.residueField x) : ℤ) := by
      rw [mul_finsum]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.finite_adeleQuotient
statement:
lemma finite_adeleQuotient (E : FunctionField.Divisor k X.functionField) :
    Module.Finite k
      (FunctionField.AdeleSpace k X.functionField ⧸
        (FunctionField.adeleFilt k X.functionField E +
          FunctionField.diagonalSubmodule k X.functionField))
proof:
:= by
  exact Module.Finite.equiv (FunctionField.adeleQuotientEquivChart k X.functionField E).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.finite_H_divisor
statement:
lemma finite_H_divisor (D : SchemeWeilDivisor (X := X)) (n : ℕ) :
    Module.Finite k (Scheme.Modules.H D.1.sheaf n)
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with _ | _ | n
  · haveI : Module.Finite k
        (FunctionField.RRspace k X.functionField
          (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D)) := by
      rw [FunctionField.RRspace_eq_chart]
      infer_instance
    exact Module.Finite.equiv (H0LinearEquivRRspace k D).symm
  · haveI : Module.Finite k
        (FunctionField.AdeleSpace k X.functionField ⧸
          (FunctionField.adeleFilt k X.functionField
              (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D) +
            FunctionField.diagonalSubmodule k X.functionField)) :=
      finite_adeleQuotient k (weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k D)
    exact Module.Finite.equiv (H1LinearEquivAdeleQuotient k D).symm
  · let e := principalPartsSheafIsoAdelic k D
    letI : Subsingleton (Scheme.Modules.H D.1.sheaf (n + 2)) :=
      subsingleton_H_of_two_le k D e (n + 2) (by omega)
    exact Module.Finite.of_surjective
      (0 : k →ₗ[k] Scheme.Modules.H D.1.sheaf (n + 2))
      (fun x => ⟨0, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_divisor
statement:
theorem hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_divisor (D : SchemeWeilDivisor (X := X)) :
    D.1.sheaf.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k where
  finite
proof:
:= finite_H_divisor k D
  vanishing := by
    refine ⟨1, fun n hn => ?_⟩
    exact subsingleton_H_of_two_le k D (principalPartsSheafIsoAdelic k D) n (by omega)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_submoduleDivisor
statement:
theorem hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_submoduleDivisor
    (D : SchemeWeilDivisor (X := X)) :
    (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D.1).HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k
proof:
:=
  hasEulerCharacteristic_of_iso k (sheafIsoSheafViaSubmodule D.1)
    (hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_divisor k D)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.structureSheaf_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic
statement:
theorem structureSheaf_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic :
    (structureSheafModule X).HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k
proof:
:= by
  let D0 : SchemeWeilDivisor (X := X) :=
    ⟨0, fun _ hx => (hx rfl).elim⟩
  have h0 : (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D0.1).HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k :=
    hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_submoduleDivisor k D0
  exact hasEulerCharacteristic_of_iso k (unitIsoSheafZero (X := X)).symm h0

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.riemann_roch_proper
statement:
theorem riemann_roch_proper (D : SchemeWeilDivisor (X := X)) :
    (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.sheaf D.1).eulerChar k =
      D.1.degree k + (structureSheafModule X).eulerChar k
proof:
:=
  AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.riemann_roch k D.1
    (structureSheaf_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k) D.2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.sheafPushforward_isEquivalence_of_iso
statement:
theorem sheafPushforward_isEquivalence_of_iso {X Y : TopCat.{u}} (e : X ≅ Y) :
    (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} e.hom).IsEquivalence
proof:
:= by
  letI : (Opens.mapMapIso e).functor.IsCocontinuous (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) :=
    ((Opens.mapMapIso e).toAdjunction.isCocontinuous_iff_coverPreserving
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)).mpr
      (coverPreserving_opens_map e.inv)
  letI : (Opens.mapMapIso e).inverse.IsCocontinuous
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) :=
    ((Opens.mapMapIso e).symm.toAdjunction.isCocontinuous_iff_coverPreserving
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)).mpr
      (coverPreserving_opens_map e.hom)
  letI : (Opens.mapMapIso e).functor.IsDenseSubsite (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) := by
    exact (Opens.mapMapIso e).isDenseSubsite_functor_of_isCocontinuous _ _
  change ((Opens.mapMapIso e).functor.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)).IsEquivalence
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.sheaf_H_isZero_of_pushforward_iso
statement:
theorem sheaf_H_isZero_of_pushforward_iso {X Y : TopCat.{u}} (e : X ≅ Y)
    (F : X.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u}) (n : ℕ)
    (h : IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
        ((TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} e.hom).obj F) n))) :
    IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H F n))
proof:
:= by
  let P := TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} e.hom
  letI : (Opens.mapMapIso e).functor.IsCocontinuous (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) :=
    ((Opens.mapMapIso e).toAdjunction.isCocontinuous_iff_coverPreserving
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)).mpr
      (coverPreserving_opens_map e.inv)
  letI : (Opens.mapMapIso e).inverse.IsCocontinuous
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) :=
    ((Opens.mapMapIso e).symm.toAdjunction.isCocontinuous_iff_coverPreserving
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)).mpr
      (coverPreserving_opens_map e.hom)
  letI : (Opens.mapMapIso e).functor.IsDenseSubsite (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) := by
    exact (Opens.mapMapIso e).isDenseSubsite_functor_of_isCocontinuous _ _
  letI : P.IsEquivalence := by
    change ((Opens.mapMapIso e).functor.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)).IsEquivalence
    infer_instance
  letI : PreservesBinaryBiproducts P :=
    preservesBinaryBiproducts_of_preservesBinaryProducts P
  letI : P.Additive := Functor.additive_of_preservesBinaryBiproducts P
  let Z := AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ)
  let c :
      (constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj Z ≅
        P.obj ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj Z) :=
    (equivCommuteConstant'
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (Opens.mapMapIso e).functor
      isTerminalTop isTerminalTop).app Z
  let E := Abelian.extFunctor (C := Y.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u}) n
  let hc : AddCommGrpCat.of
        (Ext (P.obj ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj Z))
          (P.obj F) n) ≅
      AddCommGrpCat.of
        (Ext ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj Z)
          (P.obj F) n) :=
    (E.mapIso c.op).app (P.obj F)
  have hP : IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (Ext (P.obj ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj Z))
        (P.obj F) n)) := IsZero.of_iso h hc
  letI : Subsingleton
      (Ext (P.obj ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj Z))
        (P.obj F) n) := AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero hP
  have hsub : Subsingleton (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H F n) := by
    constructor
    intro x y
    apply (P.mapExt_bijective_of_preservesInjectiveObjects
      ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj Z) F n).injective
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  letI := hsub
  exact AddCommGrpCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.module_H_isZero_of_pushforward_iso
statement:
theorem module_H_isZero_of_pushforward_iso {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (e : X ≅ Y) (F : X.Modules) (n : ℕ)
    (h : IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
        ((Modules.toSheafAb Y).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward e.hom).obj F)) n))) :
    IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb X).obj F) n))
proof:
:= by
  apply sheaf_H_isZero_of_pushforward_iso (Scheme.forgetToTop.mapIso e)
    ((Modules.toSheafAb X).obj F) n
  change IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
    (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
      ((Modules.toSheafAb Y).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward e.hom).obj F)) n))
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.module_H_isZero_pushforward_iso
statement:
theorem module_H_isZero_pushforward_iso {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (e : X ≅ Y) (F : X.Modules) (n : ℕ)
    (h : IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb X).obj F) n))) :
    IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
        ((Modules.toSheafAb Y).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward e.hom).obj F)) n))
proof:
:= by
  let Q := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward e.hom).obj F
  apply module_H_isZero_of_pushforward_iso e.symm Q n
  exact IsZero.of_iso h
    ((CategoryTheory.Sheaf.functorH _ n).mapIso
      ((Modules.toSheafAb X).mapIso (pushforwardCancelIso e F)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.module_H_isZero_of_pullback_inverse_iso
statement:
theorem module_H_isZero_of_pullback_inverse_iso {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (e : X ≅ Y) (F : X.Modules) (n : ℕ)
    (h : IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
        ((Modules.toSheafAb Y).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback e.inv).obj F)) n))) :
    IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb X).obj F) n))
proof:
:= by
  let emod : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward e.hom).obj F ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback e.inv).obj F :=
    (pushforwardNatIsoRestrictInverse e).app F ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback e.inv).app F
  have hpush : IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
        ((Modules.toSheafAb Y).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward e.hom).obj F)) n)) :=
    IsZero.of_iso h
      ((CategoryTheory.Sheaf.functorH _ n).mapIso
        ((Modules.toSheafAb Y).mapIso emod))
  exact module_H_isZero_of_pushforward_iso e F n hpush

name: FunctionField.eventually_mem_place
statement:
theorem eventually_mem_place (f : K) :
    ∀ᶠ v : Place k K in cofinite, f ∈ v.toValuationSubring
proof:
:= by
  have h := Chart.eventually_mem_placeValuationSubring k K f
  have h' := (chartToPlace k K).symm.injective.tendsto_cofinite.eventually h
  filter_upwards [h'] with v hv
  rw [← (chartToPlace k K).apply_symm_apply v, chartToPlace_apply,
    Place.ofChart_toValuationSubring]
  exact hv

name: FunctionField.adeleEquivChart_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adeleEquivChart_apply (a : AdeleSpace k K) (w : PlaceA k K) :

proof:
:=

name: FunctionField.adeleEquivChart_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adeleEquivChart_symm_apply (a : Chart.AdeleSpace k K) (v : Place k K) :
    ((adeleEquivChart k K).symm a).1 v = a.1 ((chartToPlace k K).symm v)

name: FunctionField.adeleEquivChart_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adeleEquivChart_smul (x : K) (a : AdeleSpace k K) :
    adeleEquivChart k K (x • a) = x • adeleEquivChart k K a
proof:
:= by
  ext w

name: FunctionField.mem_adeleFilt_equivChart
statement:
theorem mem_adeleFilt_equivChart (D : Divisor k K) (a : AdeleSpace k K) :
    adeleEquivChart k K a ∈
        Chart.adeleFilt k K ((divisorEquivChart k K).symm D) ↔
      a ∈ adeleFilt k K D
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ha v
    let w := (chartToPlace k K).symm v
    have hw := ha w
    rw [← placeValuation_eq] at hw
    simpa [w, divisorEquivChart, Finsupp.domCongr_apply] using hw
  · intro ha w
    have hv := ha (chartToPlace k K w)
    rw [placeValuation_eq] at hv
    simpa [divisorEquivChart, Finsupp.domCongr_apply] using hv

name: FunctionField.adeleFilt_mono
statement:
theorem adeleFilt_mono {D E : Divisor k K} (h : D ≤ E) :
    adeleFilt k K D ≤ adeleFilt k K E
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha v
  exact (ha v).trans (WithZero.exp_le_exp.mpr (h v))

name: FunctionField.adeleEquivChart_diagonal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adeleEquivChart_diagonal (f : K) :

proof:

  change f = f
