name: FunctionField.map_adeleFilt_equivChart
statement:
theorem map_adeleFilt_equivChart (D : Divisor k K) :
    Submodule.map (adeleEquivChart k K).toLinearMap (adeleFilt k K D) =
      Chart.adeleFilt k K ((divisorEquivChart k K).symm D)
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
    exact (mem_adeleFilt_equivChart k K D b).2 hb
  · intro ha
    refine ⟨(adeleEquivChart k K).symm a, ?_, by simp⟩
    exact (mem_adeleFilt_equivChart k K D _).1 (by simpa using ha)

name: FunctionField.map_diagonalSubmodule_equivChart
statement:
theorem map_diagonalSubmodule_equivChart :
    Submodule.map (adeleEquivChart k K).toLinearMap (diagonalSubmodule k K) =
      Chart.diagonalSubmodule k K
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b, ⟨f, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨f, (adeleEquivChart_diagonal k K f).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨f, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨diagonal k K f, ⟨f, rfl⟩, adeleEquivChart_diagonal k K f⟩

name: FunctionField.map_adeleFilt_add_diagonal_equivChart
statement:
theorem map_adeleFilt_add_diagonal_equivChart (D : Divisor k K) :
    Submodule.map (adeleEquivChart k K).toLinearMap
        (adeleFilt k K D + diagonalSubmodule k K) =
      Chart.adeleFilt k K ((divisorEquivChart k K).symm D) +
        Chart.diagonalSubmodule k K
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.add_eq_sup,
    Submodule.map_sup (adeleFilt k K D) (diagonalSubmodule k K)
      (adeleEquivChart k K).toLinearMap,
    map_adeleFilt_equivChart,
    map_diagonalSubmodule_equivChart, ← Submodule.add_eq_sup]

name: FunctionField.mem_adeleFilt_add_diagonal_equivChart
statement:
theorem mem_adeleFilt_add_diagonal_equivChart (D : Divisor k K) (a : AdeleSpace k K) :
    adeleEquivChart k K a ∈
        Chart.adeleFilt k K ((divisorEquivChart k K).symm D) +
          Chart.diagonalSubmodule k K ↔
      a ∈ adeleFilt k K D + diagonalSubmodule k K
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_adeleFilt_add_diagonal_equivChart k K D]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b, hb, hba⟩
    exact (adeleEquivChart k K).injective hba |>.symm ▸ hb
  · intro ha
    exact ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩

name: FunctionField.Place.map_toValuationSubring
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_toValuationSubring (e : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (v : Place k K) :
    (map e v).toValuationSubring =
      (v.valuation.comap e.symm.toRingEquiv.toRingHom).valuationSubring
proof: := rfl

name: FunctionField.Place.map_valuation_eq
statement:
theorem map_valuation_eq (e : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (v : Place k K) :
    (map e v).valuation = v.valuation.comap e.symm.toRingEquiv.toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  let q : Valuation K ℤᵐ⁰ := v.valuation.comap e.symm.toRingEquiv.toRingHom
  have hqnontrivial : q.IsNontrivial := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx0, hx1⟩ := v.valuation_isNontrivial
    refine ⟨e x, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [q] using hx0
    · simpa [q] using hx1
  letI : q.IsNontrivial := hqnontrivial
  letI : Nontrivial (MonoidWithZeroHom.valueGroup (.ofClass q)) := inferInstance
  letI : IsCyclic (MonoidWithZeroHom.valueGroup (.ofClass q)) := inferInstance
  letI : q.IsRankOneDiscrete := inferInstance
  let h := Valuation.isEquiv_valuation_valuationSubring q
  let V := q.valuationSubring
  let norm : MonoidWithZeroHom.ValueGroup₀ (.ofClass V.valuation) ≃*o ℤᵐ⁰ :=
    h.orderMonoidIso.symm.trans
      (Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.valueGroup₀_equiv_withZeroMulInt q)
  have hnorm : (map e v).normalization = norm :=
    orderMonoidIso_withZeroMulInt_unique _ _
  have hqsurj : Function.Surjective q := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := valuation_surjective v z
    refine ⟨e x, ?_⟩
    simpa [q] using hx
  ext x
  change (map e v).normalization (V.valuation.restrict x) = q x
  rw [hnorm]
  change (Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.valueGroup₀_equiv_withZeroMulInt q)
      (h.orderMonoidIso.symm (V.valuation.restrict x)) = q x
  rw [show h.orderMonoidIso.symm (V.valuation.restrict x) = q.restrict x by
    exact h.orderMonoidIso.symm_apply_eq.mpr (h.orderMonoidIso_spec x).symm]
  exact
    Valuation.IsRankOneDiscrete.valueGroup₀_equiv_withZeroMulInt_restrict_apply_of_surjective
      hqsurj x

name: FunctionField.Place.map_refl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_refl (v : Place k K) : map (AlgEquiv.refl : K ≃ₐ[k] K) v = v
proof:
:= by
  apply Place.ext
  rw [← valuationSubring_valuation (map (AlgEquiv.refl : K ≃ₐ[k] K) v),
    ← valuationSubring_valuation v, map_valuation_eq]
  congr 1

name: FunctionField.Place.map_trans
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_trans (e f : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (v : Place k K) :
    map f (map e v) = map (e.trans f) v
proof:
:= by
  apply Place.ext
  rw [← valuationSubring_valuation (map f (map e v)),
    ← valuationSubring_valuation (map (e.trans f) v), map_valuation_eq, map_valuation_eq,
    map_valuation_eq]
  congr 1

name: FunctionField.Place.degree_map

@[simp]
theorem degree_map (e : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (v : Place k K) :

name: FunctionField.Place.equiv_apply

@[simp]

name: FunctionField.Divisor.map_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_apply (e : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (D : Divisor k K) (v : Place k K) :

proof: := rfl

name: FunctionField.Divisor.map_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_single (e : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (v : Place k K) (n : ℤ) :

proof:
:=

name: FunctionField.Divisor.map_refl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_refl (D : Divisor k K) :
    map (AlgEquiv.refl : K ≃ₐ[k] K) D = D
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp

name: FunctionField.Divisor.map_trans
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_trans (e f : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (D : Divisor k K) :
    map f (map e D) = map (e.trans f) D
proof:
:= by
  have heq : f.symm.trans e.symm = (e.trans f).symm := by
    ext x
    rfl
  ext v
  simp only [map_apply]
  rw [Place.map_trans, heq]

name: FunctionField.Divisor.deg_map
statement:
theorem deg_map (e : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (D : Divisor k K) :
    deg k K (map e D) = deg k K D
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction D using Finsupp.induction with
  | zero => simp [deg, map]
  | single_add v n D hv hn ih =>
      rw [map_add, deg_add, deg_add, ih, map_single]
      congr 1
      simp [deg, Place.degree_map]

name: FunctionField.Divisor.deg_neg
statement: theorem deg_neg (D : Divisor k K) : deg k K (-D) = -deg k K D
proof:
:= by
  exact map_neg (degHom (k := k) (K := K)) D

name: FunctionField.Divisor.deg_sub
statement:
theorem deg_sub (D E : Divisor k K) :
    deg k K (D - E) = deg k K D - deg k K E
proof:
:= by
  simp [sub_eq_add_neg, deg_add, deg_neg]

name: FunctionField.Place.valuation_eq_exp_neg_principalDivisor
statement:
theorem Place.valuation_eq_exp_neg_principalDivisor (x : Additive Kˣ) (v : Place k K) :
    v.valuation (x.toMul : K) = WithZero.exp (-(principalDivisor k K x v))
proof:
:= by
  let w := (chartToPlace k K).symm v
  calc
    v.valuation (x.toMul : K) = (chartToPlace k K w).valuation (x.toMul : K) := by
      rw [(chartToPlace k K).apply_symm_apply]
    _ = placeValuation k K w (x.toMul : K) := by rw [placeValuation_eq]
    _ = WithZero.exp (-(principalDivisorA k K x w)) :=
      placeValuation_eq_exp_neg_principalDivisor k K x w
    _ = WithZero.exp (-(principalDivisor k K x v)) := by
      congr 2

name: FunctionField.Divisor.map_principalDivisor
statement:
theorem Divisor.map_principalDivisor (e : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (x : Kˣ) :
    Divisor.map e (principalDivisor k K (Additive.ofMul x)) =
      principalDivisor k K
        (Additive.ofMul (Units.map e.toRingEquiv.toMonoidHom x))
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  rw [Divisor.map_apply]
  apply neg_injective
  apply WithZero.exp_injective
  have hleft := Place.valuation_eq_exp_neg_principalDivisor
    (k := k) (K := K) (Additive.ofMul x) (Place.map e.symm v)
  have hright := Place.valuation_eq_exp_neg_principalDivisor
    (k := k) (K := K)
      (Additive.ofMul (Units.map e.toRingEquiv.toMonoidHom x)) v
  rw [Place.map_valuation_eq] at hleft
  exact hleft.symm.trans hright

name: FunctionField.divisorClassActionHom_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem divisorClassActionHom_mk (e : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (D : Divisor k K) :
    divisorClassActionHom e
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DivisorClassGroup (k := k) (K := K)) =
      QuotientAddGroup.mk (Divisor.map e D)
proof:
:=
  QuotientAddGroup.map_mk _ _ _ _ D

name: FunctionField.divisorClassAction_refl_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem divisorClassAction_refl_apply
    (q : DivisorClassGroup (k := k) (K := K)) :
    divisorClassAction (AlgEquiv.refl : K ≃ₐ[k] K) q = q
proof:
:= by
  induction q using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
  | H D =>
      rw [show divisorClassAction (AlgEquiv.refl : K ≃ₐ[k] K)
          (QuotientAddGroup.mk D) =
        divisorClassActionHom (AlgEquiv.refl : K ≃ₐ[k] K)
          (QuotientAddGroup.mk D) from rfl,
        divisorClassActionHom_mk]
      simp

name: FunctionField.divisorClassAction_trans_apply
statement:
theorem divisorClassAction_trans_apply (e f : K ≃ₐ[k] K)
    (q : DivisorClassGroup (k := k) (K := K)) :
    divisorClassAction f (divisorClassAction e q) =
      divisorClassAction (e.trans f) q
proof:
:= by
  induction q using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
  | H D =>
      change divisorClassActionHom f
          (divisorClassActionHom e (QuotientAddGroup.mk D)) =
        divisorClassActionHom (e.trans f) (QuotientAddGroup.mk D)
      rw [divisorClassActionHom_mk, divisorClassActionHom_mk,
        divisorClassActionHom_mk, Divisor.map_trans]

name: FunctionField.divisorClassDegree_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem divisorClassDegree_mk (D : Divisor k K) :
    divisorClassDegree (k := k) (K := K)
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DivisorClassGroup (k := k) (K := K)) =
      Divisor.deg k K D
proof: := rfl

name: FunctionField.divisorClassDegree_action
statement:
theorem divisorClassDegree_action (e : K ≃ₐ[k] K)
    (q : DivisorClassGroup (k := k) (K := K)) :
    divisorClassDegree (divisorClassAction e q) = divisorClassDegree q
proof:
:= by
  induction q using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
  | H D =>
      change divisorClassDegree
          (divisorClassActionHom e (QuotientAddGroup.mk D)) =
        divisorClassDegree (QuotientAddGroup.mk D)
      rw [divisorClassActionHom_mk, divisorClassDegree_mk,
        divisorClassDegree_mk, Divisor.deg_map]

name: FunctionField.picZeroAction_refl_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem picZeroAction_refl_apply (q : PicZero (k := k) (K := K)) :
    picZeroAction (AlgEquiv.refl : K ≃ₐ[k] K) q = q
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact divisorClassAction_refl_apply
    (q : DivisorClassGroup (k := k) (K := K))

name: FunctionField.picZeroAction_trans_apply
statement:
theorem picZeroAction_trans_apply (e f : K ≃ₐ[k] K)
    (q : PicZero (k := k) (K := K)) :
    picZeroAction f (picZeroAction e q) = picZeroAction (e.trans f) q
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact divisorClassAction_trans_apply e f
    (q : DivisorClassGroup (k := k) (K := K))

name: FunctionField.picZeroAction_involutive
statement:
theorem picZeroAction_involutive (e : K ≃ₐ[k] K)
    (he : e.trans e = AlgEquiv.refl) : Function.Involutive (picZeroAction e)
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  rw [picZeroAction_trans_apply, he]
  exact picZeroAction_refl_apply q

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.placeOfPoint_deg_one
statement:
theorem placeOfPoint_deg_one (P : W.Point) :
    (placeOfPoint W K P).degree = 1
proof:
:= by

  exact Chart.placeOfPoint_deg_one W K P

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.infinityPlace_deg_one
statement: theorem infinityPlace_deg_one : (infinityPlace (k := k) K).degree = 1
proof:

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_point_of_place_degree_one
statement:
theorem exists_point_of_place_degree_one (v : Place k K) (hv : v.degree = 1) :
    ∃ P : W.Point, v = placeOfPoint W K P
proof:
:= by
  let w := (chartToPlace k K).symm v
  have hw : placeDegree k K w = 1 := by
    rw [placeDegree_eq]
    simpa [w] using hv
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := Chart.exists_point_of_place_degree_one W K w hw
  refine ⟨P, ?_⟩
  rw [placeOfPoint, ← hP]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.genus_eq_one
statement: theorem genus_eq_one : FunctionField.genus k K = 1
proof:
:=
  (FunctionField.genus_eq_genusChart k K).trans (Chart.genus_eq_one W K)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.picTorsor_compat_groupLaw
statement:
theorem picTorsor_compat_groupLaw {x y : k} (h : W.Nonsingular x y) :
    picTorsor W K ⟨placeOfPoint W K (Point.some x y h),
        placeOfPoint_deg_one W K (Point.some x y h)⟩ =
      ClassGroup.mk W.FunctionField (CoordinateRing.XYIdeal' h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [picTorsor]
  change Chart.Internal.picTorsor' W K
      (degreeOnePlaceEquivChart (k := k) K
        ⟨placeOfPoint W K (Point.some x y h),
          placeOfPoint_deg_one W K (Point.some x y h)⟩) = _
  have hz : degreeOnePlaceEquivChart (k := k) K
      ⟨placeOfPoint W K (Point.some x y h),
        placeOfPoint_deg_one W K (Point.some x y h)⟩ =
      ⟨Chart.placeOfPoint W K (Point.some x y h),
        Chart.placeOfPoint_deg_one W K (Point.some x y h)⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact (chartToPlace k K).symm_apply_apply _
  rw [hz]
  exact Chart.Internal.picTorsor'_compat_groupLaw W K h

name: FunctionField.indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants_eq
statement:
theorem indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants_eq (D : Divisor k K) :
    (indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants k K D : ℤ) =
      ell k K D - (D.deg + ell k K (0 : Divisor k K) - genusWithConstants k K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants,
    Chart.indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants_eq, ell_eq_chart, ell_eq_chart]
  simp only [Divisor.chart_deg, map_zero, genusWithConstants]

name: FunctionField.finrankAdeleQuotient_eq_indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants
statement:
theorem finrankAdeleQuotient_eq_indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants (D : Divisor k K) :
    finrankAdeleQuotient k K D = indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants k K D
proof:
:= by
  rw [finrankAdeleQuotient_eq_chart, indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants]
  exact Chart.finrank_adele_quotient_generalConstants k K _

name: FunctionField.WeilDifferential.divOmegaGeneralConstants_chart
statement:
@[simp]
theorem divOmegaGeneralConstants_chart
    (omega : WeilDifferential k K) (homega : IsNonzero omega) :
    (divisorEquivChart k K).symm (divOmegaGeneralConstants omega homega) =
      Chart.WeilDifferential.divOmegaGeneralConstants (toChart omega)
        ((isNonzero_toChart omega).mp homega)
proof:
:= by
  simp [divOmegaGeneralConstants]

name: FunctionField.isCanonicalGeneralConstants_iff_chart
statement:
theorem isCanonicalGeneralConstants_iff_chart (W : Divisor k K) :
    IsCanonicalGeneralConstants k K W ↔
      Chart.IsCanonicalGeneralConstants k K ((divisorEquivChart k K).symm W)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨omega, homega, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨WeilDifferential.toChart omega,
      (WeilDifferential.isNonzero_toChart omega).mp homega, ?_⟩
    exact (WeilDifferential.divOmegaGeneralConstants_chart omega homega).symm
  · rintro ⟨omega, homega, hdiv⟩
    let eta := WeilDifferential.ofChart omega
    have hetaChart : WeilDifferential.toChart eta = omega :=
      (WeilDifferential.weilDifferentialAddEquivChart
        (k := k) (K := K)).apply_symm_apply omega
    have heta : WeilDifferential.IsNonzero eta := by
      apply (WeilDifferential.isNonzero_toChart eta).mpr
      rw [hetaChart]
      exact homega
    refine ⟨eta, heta, ?_⟩
    apply (divisorEquivChart k K).symm.injective
    rw [WeilDifferential.divOmegaGeneralConstants_chart]
    simpa only [hetaChart] using hdiv

name: FunctionField.exists_isCanonical_generalConstants
statement:
theorem exists_isCanonical_generalConstants :
    ∃ W : Divisor k K, IsCanonicalGeneralConstants k K W
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ := Chart.exists_isCanonical_generalConstants k K
  refine ⟨divisorEquivChart k K W, ?_⟩
  apply (isCanonicalGeneralConstants_iff_chart k K _).mpr
  simpa using hW

name: FunctionField.duality_generalConstants
proof:
:= by
  have hW' := (isCanonicalGeneralConstants_iff_chart k K W).mp hW
  rw [ell_eq_chart, indexOfSpecialtyWithConstants]
  simpa using Chart.duality_generalConstants k K hW'
    ((divisorEquivChart k K).symm D)

name: FunctionField.riemann_roch_generalConstants
statement:
theorem riemann_roch_generalConstants {W : Divisor k K}
    (hW : IsCanonicalGeneralConstants k K W) (D : Divisor k K) :
    (ell k K D : ℤ) =
      D.deg + ell k K (0 : Divisor k K) - (genusWithConstants k K : ℤ) +
        ell k K (W - D)
proof:
:= by
  have hW' := (isCanonicalGeneralConstants_iff_chart k K W).mp hW
  rw [ell_eq_chart, ell_eq_chart, ell_eq_chart]
  simpa [genusWithConstants] using
    Chart.riemann_roch_generalConstants k K hW'
      ((divisorEquivChart k K).symm D)

name: FunctionField.memRRspace.zero_mem
statement: theorem zero_mem (D : Divisor k K) : memRRspace k K D 0
proof: := fun v => by simp

name: FunctionField.memRRspace.add_mem
statement:
theorem add_mem {f g : K} (hf : memRRspace k K D f) (hg : memRRspace k K D g) :
    memRRspace k K D (f + g)
proof:
:= fun v =>
  (v.valuation.map_add f g).trans (max_le (hf v) (hg v))

name: FunctionField.memRRspace.smul_mem
statement:
theorem smul_mem (c : k) {f : K} (hf : memRRspace k K D f) :
    memRRspace k K D (c • f)
proof:
:= fun v => by
  by_cases hc : c = 0
  · simp [hc]
  rw [Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, Valuation.IsTrivialOn.eq_one c hc, one_mul]
  exact hf v

name: FunctionField.memRRspace_equivChart
statement:
theorem memRRspace_equivChart (D : Divisor k K) (f : K) :
    memRRspace k K D f ↔
      Chart.memRRspace k K ((divisorEquivChart k K).symm D) f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hf w
    have hv := hf (chartToPlace k K w)
    rw [placeValuation_eq] at hv
    simpa [divisorEquivChart, Finsupp.domCongr_apply] using hv
  · intro hf v
    let w := (chartToPlace k K).symm v
    have hw := hf w
    rw [← placeValuation_eq] at hw
    simpa [w, divisorEquivChart, Finsupp.domCongr_apply] using hw

name: FunctionField.RRspace_eq_chart
statement:
theorem RRspace_eq_chart (D : Divisor k K) :
    RRspace k K D = Chart.RRspace k K ((divisorEquivChart k K).symm D)
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  exact memRRspace_equivChart k K D f

name: FunctionField.ell_eq_chart
statement:
theorem ell_eq_chart (D : Divisor k K) :
    ell k K D = Chart.ell k K ((divisorEquivChart k K).symm D)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ell, Chart.ell, RRspace_eq_chart k K D]

name: FunctionField.Divisor.chart_deg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Divisor.chart_deg (D : Divisor k K) :
    Chart.deg k K ((divisorEquivChart k K).symm D) = D.deg
proof:
:= by
  have h := Divisor.deg_equivChart k K ((divisorEquivChart k K).symm D)
  simpa using h.symm

name: FunctionField.defect_eq_chart
statement:
theorem defect_eq_chart (D : Divisor k K) :
    defect k K D = Chart.defect k K ((divisorEquivChart k K).symm D)
proof:
:= by
  rw [defect, Chart.defect, ell_eq_chart, Divisor.chart_deg]

name: FunctionField.genus_eq_genusChart
statement: theorem genus_eq_genusChart : genus k K = Chart.genus k K
proof:
:= by
  let S : Set ℤ := {d | ∃ D : Divisor k K, defect k K D = d}
  have hS : S.Nonempty := ⟨defect k K 0, ⟨0, rfl⟩⟩
  have hub : ∀ d ∈ S, d ≤ (Chart.genus k K : ℤ) := by
    rintro d ⟨D, rfl⟩
    rw [defect_eq_chart]
    exact Chart.defect_le k K _
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := Chart.exists_defect_eq (k := k) (K := K)
  have happ : ∀ z < (Chart.genus k K : ℤ), ∃ d ∈ S, z < d := by
    intro z hz
    refine ⟨defect k K (divisorEquivChart k K E), ⟨_, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [defect_eq_chart]
    simpa [hE] using hz
  have hsup : sSup S = (Chart.genus k K : ℤ) :=
    csSup_eq_of_forall_le_of_forall_lt_exists_gt hS hub happ
  rw [genus]
  change (sSup S).toNat = _
  rw [hsup]
  simp

name: FunctionField.chart_isCanonical_iff_degree_ell
statement:
theorem chart_isCanonical_iff_degree_ell (E : DivisorA k K) :
    Chart.IsCanonical k K E ↔
      Chart.deg k K E = 2 * (Chart.genus k K : ℤ) - 2 ∧
        Chart.ell k K E = Chart.genus k K
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hE
    exact ⟨Chart.deg_canonical k K hE, Chart.ell_canonical k K hE⟩
  · rintro ⟨hdegE, hellE⟩
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := Chart.exists_isCanonical k K
    have hRR := Chart.riemann_roch k K hC E
    have hpos : 0 < Chart.ell k K (C - E) := by
      rw [hellE, hdegE] at hRR
      omega
    obtain ⟨x, hxeff⟩ :=
      Chart.exists_effective_add_principal_of_ell_pos k K (C - E) hpos
    let P := principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul x)
    have hdegzero : Chart.deg k K ((C - E) + P) = 0 := by
      rw [Chart.deg_add, Chart.deg_sub,
        deg_principalDivisorA_eq_zero, Chart.deg_canonical k K hC, hdegE]
      omega
    have hzero : (C - E) + P = 0 :=
      eq_zero_of_effective_deg_zero k K hxeff hdegzero
    have hCE : C + P = E := by
      calc
        C + P = E + ((C - E) + P) := by abel
        _ = E := by rw [hzero, add_zero]
    rcases hC with ⟨ω, hω, hdiv⟩
    have hxω : Chart.WeilDifferential.IsNonzero ((x : K) • ω) := by
      intro hx
      have hx0 : (x : K) • ω = 0 := by
        apply Chart.WeilDifferential.ext
        exact hx
      have hω0 := (Chart.WeilDifferential.smulWeil_eq_zero_iff
        (k := k) (K := K) (x : K) (Units.ne_zero x) ω).mp hx0
      apply hω
      rw [hω0]
      rfl
    refine ⟨(x : K) • ω, hxω, ?_⟩
    rw [Chart.WeilDifferential.divOmega_smul (k := k) (K := K) x ω hω hxω, hdiv]
    exact hCE

name: FunctionField.isCanonical_iff_deg_ell
statement:
theorem isCanonical_iff_deg_ell (W : Divisor k K) :
    IsCanonical k K W ↔
      W.deg = 2 * (genus k K : ℤ) - 2 ∧ ell k K W = genus k K
proof:
:= by
  rw [isCanonical_iff_chart, chart_isCanonical_iff_degree_ell]
  simp only [Divisor.chart_deg, ell_eq_chart, genus_eq_genusChart]

name: FunctionField.indexOfSpecialty_eq_chart
statement:
theorem indexOfSpecialty_eq_chart (D : Divisor k K) :
    indexOfSpecialty k K D =
      Chart.indexOfSpecialty k K ((divisorEquivChart k K).symm D)
proof:
:= by
  rw [indexOfSpecialty, Chart.indexOfSpecialty, ell_eq_chart, Divisor.chart_deg,
    genus_eq_genusChart]

name: FunctionField.finrankAdeleQuotient_eq_chart
statement:
theorem finrankAdeleQuotient_eq_chart (D : Divisor k K) :
    finrankAdeleQuotient k K D =
      Chart.finrankAdeleQuotient k K ((divisorEquivChart k K).symm D)
proof:
:=
  (adeleQuotientEquivChart k K D).finrank_eq

name: FunctionField.finrank_adele_quotient
statement:
theorem finrank_adele_quotient (D : Divisor k K) :
    finrankAdeleQuotient k K D = indexOfSpecialty k K D
proof:
:= by
  rw [finrankAdeleQuotient_eq_chart, Chart.finrank_adele_quotient,
    indexOfSpecialty_eq_chart]

name: FunctionField.sandwich
statement:
theorem sandwich {D E : Divisor k K} (h : D ≤ E) :
    sandwichRank k K D E h = E.deg - ell k K E - (D.deg - ell k K D)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sandwichRank]
  rw [Chart.sandwich]
  simp only [Divisor.chart_deg, ell_eq_chart]

name: FunctionField.WeilDifferential.finrank_differentialSpace
statement:
theorem WeilDifferential.finrank_differentialSpace (D : Divisor k K) :
    Module.finrank k (WeilDifferential.differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K) D) =
      indexOfSpecialty k K D
proof:
:= by
  rw [WeilDifferential.finrank_differentialSpace_eq_chart,
    Chart.WeilDifferential.finrank_differentialSpace, indexOfSpecialty_eq_chart]

name: FunctionField.exists_isCanonical
statement: theorem exists_isCanonical : ∃ W : Divisor k K, IsCanonical k K W
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ := Chart.exists_isCanonical k K
  refine ⟨divisorEquivChart k K W, ?_⟩
  apply (isCanonical_iff_chart k K _).mpr
  simpa using hW

name: FunctionField.duality
statement:
theorem duality {W : Divisor k K} (hW : IsCanonical k K W) (D : Divisor k K) :
    ell k K (W - D) = indexOfSpecialty k K D
proof:
:= by
  have hW' := (isCanonical_iff_chart k K W).mp hW
  rw [ell_eq_chart, indexOfSpecialty_eq_chart]
  simpa using Chart.duality k K hW' ((divisorEquivChart k K).symm D)

name: FunctionField.riemann_ineq
statement:
theorem riemann_ineq (D : Divisor k K) :
    (ell k K D : ℤ) ≥ D.deg + 1 - (genus k K : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ell_eq_chart]
  simpa [genus_eq_genusChart] using
    Chart.riemann_ineq k K ((divisorEquivChart k K).symm D)

name: FunctionField.riemann_roch
statement:
theorem riemann_roch {W : Divisor k K} (hW : IsCanonical k K W) (D : Divisor k K) :
    (ell k K D : ℤ) = D.deg + 1 - (genus k K : ℤ) + ell k K (W - D)
proof:
:= by
  have hW' := (isCanonical_iff_chart k K W).mp hW
  rw [ell_eq_chart, ell_eq_chart]
  simpa [genus_eq_genusChart] using
    Chart.riemann_roch k K hW' ((divisorEquivChart k K).symm D)

name: FunctionField.ell_canonical
statement: theorem ell_canonical : ell k K W = genus k K
proof:
:= by
  exact (isCanonical_iff_deg_ell k K W).mp hW |>.2

name: FunctionField.deg_canonical
statement: theorem deg_canonical : W.deg = 2 * (genus k K : ℤ) - 2
proof:
:= by
  exact (isCanonical_iff_deg_ell k K W).mp hW |>.1

name: FunctionField.ell_eq_of_deg_ge
statement:
theorem ell_eq_of_deg_ge (D : Divisor k K)
    (hdeg : D.deg ≥ 2 * (genus k K : ℤ) - 1) :
    (ell k K D : ℤ) = D.deg + 1 - (genus k K : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hW' := (isCanonical_iff_chart k K W).mp hW
  have hdeg' : Chart.deg k K ((divisorEquivChart k K).symm D) ≥
      2 * (Chart.genus k K : ℤ) - 1 := by simpa [genus_eq_genusChart] using hdeg
  rw [ell_eq_chart]
  simpa [genus_eq_genusChart] using
    Chart.ell_eq_of_deg_ge k K hW' ((divisorEquivChart k K).symm D) hdeg'

name: FunctionField.indexOfSpecialty_eq_ell
statement:
theorem indexOfSpecialty_eq_ell (D : Divisor k K) :
    (indexOfSpecialty k K D : ℤ) = ell k K (W - D)
proof:
:= by
  have hW' := (isCanonical_iff_chart k K W).mp hW
  rw [indexOfSpecialty_eq_chart, ell_eq_chart]
  simpa using Chart.indexOfSpecialty_eq_ell k K hW'
    ((divisorEquivChart k K).symm D)

name: FunctionField.clifford
statement:
theorem clifford {W : Divisor k K} (hW : IsCanonical k K W) (D : Divisor k K)
    (hdeg₀ : 0 ≤ D.deg) (hdeg₁ : D.deg ≤ 2 * (genus k K : ℤ) - 2)
    (hℓD : 0 < ell k K D) (hℓW : 0 < ell k K (W - D)) :
    2 * ((ell k K D : ℤ) - 1) ≤ D.deg
proof:
:= by
  have hW' := (isCanonical_iff_chart k K W).mp hW
  have hdeg₀' : 0 ≤ Chart.deg k K ((divisorEquivChart k K).symm D) := by
    simpa using hdeg₀
  have hdeg₁' : Chart.deg k K ((divisorEquivChart k K).symm D) ≤
      2 * (Chart.genus k K : ℤ) - 2 := by simpa [genus_eq_genusChart] using hdeg₁
  rw [ell_eq_chart k K D] at hℓD ⊢
  rw [ell_eq_chart k K (W - D)] at hℓW
  simpa [genus_eq_genusChart] using
    Chart.clifford k K hW' ((divisorEquivChart k K).symm D) hdeg₀' hdeg₁' hℓD hℓW

name: FunctionField.exists_nonspecial_divisor
statement:
theorem exists_nonspecial_divisor :
    ∃ D : Divisor k K, indexOfSpecialty k K D = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := Chart.exists_nonspecial_divisor k K
  refine ⟨divisorEquivChart k K D, ?_⟩
  rw [indexOfSpecialty_eq_chart]
  simpa using hD

name: FunctionField.intrinsicRRspaceDiffToAdeleFiltDiff_injective
statement:
theorem intrinsicRRspaceDiffToAdeleFiltDiff_injective (D E : Divisor k K) :
    Function.Injective (intrinsicRRspaceDiffToAdeleFiltDiff k K D E)
proof:
:= by
  intro z w hzw
  induction z using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
  | _ x =>
    induction w using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
    | _ y =>
      apply (Submodule.Quotient.eq
        (Submodule.comap (RRspace k K E).subtype (RRspace k K D))).mpr
      have hA :
          rrspaceToAdeleFilt k K E x - rrspaceToAdeleFilt k K E y ∈
            Submodule.comap (adeleFilt k K E).subtype (adeleFilt k K D) :=
        (Submodule.Quotient.eq
          (Submodule.comap (adeleFilt k K E).subtype (adeleFilt k K D))).mp (by
            simpa only [intrinsicRRspaceDiffToAdeleFiltDiff, Submodule.mapQ_apply] using hzw)
      intro v
      exact hA v

name: FunctionField.finrankIntrinsicRRspaceDiff_le_adeleFiltDiff
statement:
theorem finrankIntrinsicRRspaceDiff_le_adeleFiltDiff
    {D E : Divisor k K} (hDE : D ≤ E)
    (hres : ∀ v : Place k K, Module.Finite k v.residueField) :
    finrankIntrinsicRRspaceDiff k K D E ≤
      finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff k K D E
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Module.Finite k
      (adeleFilt k K E ⧸
        Submodule.comap (adeleFilt k K E).subtype (adeleFilt k K D)) :=
    moduleFinite_intrinsicAdeleFilt_quotient_of_le k K hDE hres
  exact LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective
    (intrinsicRRspaceDiffToAdeleFiltDiff_injective k K D E)

name: FunctionField.finrankIntrinsicRRspaceDiff_le_degree
statement:
theorem finrankIntrinsicRRspaceDiff_le_degree
    {D E : Divisor k K} (hDE : D ≤ E)
    (hres : ∀ v : Place k K, Module.Finite k v.residueField) :
    finrankIntrinsicRRspaceDiff k K D E ≤
      (Divisor.deg k K (E - D)).toNat
proof:
:= by
  rw [← finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff_of_le k K hDE hres]
  exact finrankIntrinsicRRspaceDiff_le_adeleFiltDiff k K hDE hres

name: FunctionField.finrankIntrinsicRRspaceDiff_add_ell
statement:
theorem finrankIntrinsicRRspaceDiff_add_ell
    {D E : Divisor k K} (hDE : D ≤ E)
    [Module.Finite k (RRspace k K E)] :
    finrankIntrinsicRRspaceDiff k K D E + ell k K D = ell k K E
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [finrankIntrinsicRRspaceDiff, ell]
  rw [← (Submodule.comapSubtypeEquivOfLe
    (RRspace_mono_intrinsic k K hDE)).finrank_eq]
  exact Submodule.finrank_quotient_add_finrank _

name: FunctionField.defect_mono_intrinsic
statement:
theorem defect_mono_intrinsic
    {D E : Divisor k K} (hDE : D ≤ E)
    (hres : ∀ v : Place k K, Module.Finite k v.residueField)
    [Module.Finite k (RRspace k K (0 : Divisor k K))] :
    defect k K D ≤ defect k K E
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Finite k (RRspace k K D) := moduleFinite_RRspace_of_zero k K hres D
  letI : Module.Finite k (RRspace k K E) := moduleFinite_RRspace_of_zero k K hres E
  have hdeg : 0 ≤ Divisor.deg k K (E - D) :=
    Divisor.deg_nonneg k K (fun v => sub_nonneg.mpr (hDE v))
  have hq := finrankIntrinsicRRspaceDiff_le_degree k K hDE hres
  have hsum := finrankIntrinsicRRspaceDiff_add_ell k K hDE
  have htoNat : ((Divisor.deg k K (E - D)).toNat : ℤ) =
      Divisor.deg k K (E - D) := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hdeg
  have hqZ : (finrankIntrinsicRRspaceDiff k K D E : ℤ) ≤
      Divisor.deg k K (E - D) := by
    rw [← htoNat]
    exact_mod_cast hq
  have hsumZ : (finrankIntrinsicRRspaceDiff k K D E : ℤ) +
      ell k K D = ell k K E := by
    exact_mod_cast hsum
  have hdegNeg : Divisor.deg k K (-D) = -Divisor.deg k K D := by
    have h := Divisor.deg_add k K D (-D)
    rw [add_neg_cancel, Divisor.deg_zero] at h
    omega
  have hdegSub : Divisor.deg k K (E - D) =
      Divisor.deg k K E - Divisor.deg k K D := by
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Divisor.deg_add, hdegNeg]
    abel
  rw [hdegSub] at hqZ
  dsimp only [defect]
  omega

name: FunctionField.intrinsicRRspaceDiffToAdeleFiltDiff_surjective_of_defect_eq
statement:
theorem intrinsicRRspaceDiffToAdeleFiltDiff_surjective_of_defect_eq
    {D E : Divisor k K} (hDE : D ≤ E)
    (hres : ∀ v : Place k K, Module.Finite k v.residueField)
    [Module.Finite k (RRspace k K (0 : Divisor k K))]
    (hdefect : defect k K D = defect k K E) :
    Function.Surjective (intrinsicRRspaceDiffToAdeleFiltDiff k K D E)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Finite k (RRspace k K D) := moduleFinite_RRspace_of_zero k K hres D
  letI : Module.Finite k (RRspace k K E) := moduleFinite_RRspace_of_zero k K hres E
  haveI : Module.Finite k
      (adeleFilt k K E ⧸
        Submodule.comap (adeleFilt k K E).subtype (adeleFilt k K D)) :=
    moduleFinite_intrinsicAdeleFilt_quotient_of_le k K hDE hres
  have hdeg : 0 ≤ Divisor.deg k K (E - D) :=
    Divisor.deg_nonneg k K (fun v => sub_nonneg.mpr (hDE v))
  have htoNat : ((Divisor.deg k K (E - D)).toNat : ℤ) =
      Divisor.deg k K (E - D) := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hdeg
  have hsum := finrankIntrinsicRRspaceDiff_add_ell k K hDE
  have hsumZ : (finrankIntrinsicRRspaceDiff k K D E : ℤ) +
      ell k K D = ell k K E := by
    exact_mod_cast hsum
  have hdegNeg : Divisor.deg k K (-D) = -Divisor.deg k K D := by
    have h := Divisor.deg_add k K D (-D)
    rw [add_neg_cancel, Divisor.deg_zero] at h
    omega
  have hdegSub : Divisor.deg k K (E - D) =
      Divisor.deg k K E - Divisor.deg k K D := by
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Divisor.deg_add, hdegNeg]
    abel
  have hdefect' : Divisor.deg k K D - ell k K D =
      Divisor.deg k K E - ell k K E := by
    dsimp only [defect] at hdefect
    omega
  have hrrDegree : finrankIntrinsicRRspaceDiff k K D E =
      (Divisor.deg k K (E - D)).toNat := by
    apply Int.ofNat_injective
    change (finrankIntrinsicRRspaceDiff k K D E : ℤ) =
      ((Divisor.deg k K (E - D)).toNat : ℤ)
    rw [htoNat, hdegSub]
    omega
  have hdim : finrankIntrinsicRRspaceDiff k K D E =
      finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff k K D E := by
    rw [finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff_of_le k K hDE hres]
    exact hrrDegree
  exact (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank hdim).mp
    (intrinsicRRspaceDiffToAdeleFiltDiff_injective k K D E)

name: FunctionField.defect_eq_of_intrinsicRRspaceDiffToAdeleFiltDiff_surjective
statement:
theorem defect_eq_of_intrinsicRRspaceDiffToAdeleFiltDiff_surjective
    {D E : Divisor k K} (hDE : D ≤ E)
    (hres : ∀ v : Place k K, Module.Finite k v.residueField)
    [Module.Finite k (RRspace k K (0 : Divisor k K))]
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (intrinsicRRspaceDiffToAdeleFiltDiff k K D E)) :
    defect k K D = defect k K E
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Finite k (RRspace k K D) := moduleFinite_RRspace_of_zero k K hres D
  letI : Module.Finite k (RRspace k K E) := moduleFinite_RRspace_of_zero k K hres E
  haveI : Module.Finite k
      (adeleFilt k K E ⧸
        Submodule.comap (adeleFilt k K E).subtype (adeleFilt k K D)) :=
    moduleFinite_intrinsicAdeleFilt_quotient_of_le k K hDE hres
  have hdim : finrankIntrinsicRRspaceDiff k K D E =
      finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff k K D E :=
    (LinearEquiv.ofBijective (intrinsicRRspaceDiffToAdeleFiltDiff k K D E)
      ⟨intrinsicRRspaceDiffToAdeleFiltDiff_injective k K D E, hsurj⟩).finrank_eq
  have hrrDegree : finrankIntrinsicRRspaceDiff k K D E =
      (Divisor.deg k K (E - D)).toNat := by
    rw [hdim, finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff_of_le k K hDE hres]
  have hdeg : 0 ≤ Divisor.deg k K (E - D) :=
    Divisor.deg_nonneg k K (fun v => sub_nonneg.mpr (hDE v))
  have htoNat : ((Divisor.deg k K (E - D)).toNat : ℤ) =
      Divisor.deg k K (E - D) := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hdeg
  have hsum := finrankIntrinsicRRspaceDiff_add_ell k K hDE
  have hsumZ : (finrankIntrinsicRRspaceDiff k K D E : ℤ) +
      ell k K D = ell k K E := by
    exact_mod_cast hsum
  have hdegNeg : Divisor.deg k K (-D) = -Divisor.deg k K D := by
    have h := Divisor.deg_add k K D (-D)
    rw [add_neg_cancel, Divisor.deg_zero] at h
    omega
  have hdegSub : Divisor.deg k K (E - D) =
      Divisor.deg k K E - Divisor.deg k K D := by
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Divisor.deg_add, hdegNeg]
    abel
  have hrrDegreeZ : (finrankIntrinsicRRspaceDiff k K D E : ℤ) =
      Divisor.deg k K (E - D) := by
    rw [hrrDegree, htoNat]
  dsimp only [defect]
  rw [hdegSub] at hrrDegreeZ
  omega

name: FunctionField.Place.finite_degree_eq
statement:
theorem finite_degree_eq (w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (ringOfIntegers k K)) :
    (Place.ofChart k K (Sum.inl w)).degree = placeDegree k K (Sum.inl w)
proof:
:= by
  exact (finiteResidueAlgEquiv k K w).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq.symm

name: FunctionField.Place.infinite_degree_eq
statement:
theorem infinite_degree_eq (w : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (infiniteIntegers k K)) :
    (Place.ofChart k K (Sum.inr w)).degree = placeDegree k K (Sum.inr w)
proof:
:= by
  exact (infiniteResidueAlgEquiv k K w).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq.symm

name: FunctionField.placeDegree_eq
statement:
theorem placeDegree_eq (w : PlaceA k K) :
    placeDegree k K w = (chartToPlace k K w).degree
proof:
:= by
  rcases w with w | w
  · exact (Place.finite_degree_eq k K w).symm
  · exact (Place.infinite_degree_eq k K w).symm

name: FunctionField.Divisor.deg_formula
statement:
theorem deg_formula (D : Divisor k K) :
    deg k K D = D.sum fun v n => n * (v.degree : ℤ)
proof: := rfl

name: FunctionField.Divisor.deg_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem deg_zero : deg k K (0 : Divisor k K) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [deg]

name: FunctionField.Divisor.deg_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem deg_single (v : Place k K) (n : ℤ) :
    deg k K (Finsupp.single v n) = n * (v.degree : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [deg]

name: FunctionField.Divisor.deg_add
statement: theorem deg_add (D E : Divisor k K) : deg k K (D + E) = deg k K D + deg k K E
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [deg, Finsupp.sum_add_index, add_mul]

name: FunctionField.Divisor.deg_nonneg
statement:
theorem deg_nonneg {D : Divisor k K} (hD : ∀ v, 0 ≤ D v) :
    0 ≤ deg k K D
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Finsupp.sum_nonneg fun v _ ↦
    mul_nonneg (hD v) (Int.natCast_nonneg v.degree)

name: FunctionField.Divisor.deg_equivChart
statement:
theorem deg_equivChart (D : DivisorA k K) :
    deg k K (divisorEquivChart k K D) = Chart.deg k K D
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction D using Finsupp.induction with
  | zero => simp [deg, Chart.deg, divisorEquivChart]
  | single_add a b f ha hb ih =>
      rw [map_add, deg_add, Chart.deg_add, ih]
      congr 1
      simp [deg, Chart.deg, divisorEquivChart, Finsupp.domCongr_apply,
        Finsupp.equivMapDomain_single, placeDegree_eq]

name: FunctionField.Divisor.deg_principal_eq_zero
statement:
theorem deg_principal_eq_zero (x : Kˣ) :
    deg k K (principalDivisor k K (Additive.ofMul x)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [principalDivisor]
  exact (deg_equivChart k K (principalDivisorA k K (Additive.ofMul x))).trans
    (deg_principalDivisorA_eq_zero k K x)

name: FunctionField.intrinsicAdeleLocalResidueMap_ker
statement:
theorem intrinsicAdeleLocalResidueMap_ker (D : Divisor k K) (v : Place k K) :
    (intrinsicAdeleLocalResidueMap k K D v).ker =
      Submodule.comap (adeleFilt k K (D + Finsupp.single v 1)).subtype
        (adeleFilt k K D)
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.coe_subtype]
  change IsLocalRing.residue v.toValuationSubring
      (intrinsicAdeleLocalNumerator k K D v a) = 0 ↔
    ∀ w, w.valuation ((a.1 : AdeleSpace k K).1 w) ≤ WithZero.exp (D w)
  rw [IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff, v.mem_maximalIdeal_iff_valuation_lt_one]
  dsimp only [intrinsicAdeleLocalNumerator]
  change v.valuation
      (v.uniformizer ^ (D v + 1) * (a.1 : AdeleSpace k K).1 v) < 1 ↔ _
  rw [map_mul, map_zpow₀, v.valuation_uniformizer]
  have hlocal :
      WithZero.exp (-1) ^ (D v + 1) * v.valuation ((a.1 : AdeleSpace k K).1 v) < 1 ↔
        v.valuation ((a.1 : AdeleSpace k K).1 v) ≤ WithZero.exp (D v) := by
    rw [← WithZero.exp_zsmul]
    simpa using FunctionField.Chart.exp_neg_mul_lt_one_iff_le
      (v.valuation ((a.1 : AdeleSpace k K).1 v)) (D v + 1)
  rw [hlocal]
  constructor
  · intro hv w
    by_cases hw : w = v
    · simpa [hw] using hv
    · have ha := a.property w
      simpa [Finsupp.single_apply, hw] using ha
  · intro ha
    exact ha v

name: FunctionField.intrinsicAdeleLocalResidueMap_surjective
statement:
theorem intrinsicAdeleLocalResidueMap_surjective (D : Divisor k K) (v : Place k K) :
    Function.Surjective (intrinsicAdeleLocalResidueMap k K D v)
proof:
:= by
  let π : K := v.uniformizer
  let n : ℤ := D v + 1
  intro y
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective y
  let x : K := π ^ (-n) * (z : K)
  let a₀ : AdeleSpace k K :=
    intrinsicAdeleUpdate k K (intrinsicZeroAdele k K) v x
  have ha₀ : a₀ ∈ adeleFilt k K (D + Finsupp.single v 1) := by
    intro w
    by_cases hw : w = v
    · subst w
      simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
      have hzle : v.valuation (z : K) ≤ 1 := by
        have hzmem : (z : K) ∈ v.valuation.valuationSubring := by
          rw [v.valuationSubring_valuation]
          exact z.property
        exact (Valuation.mem_valuationSubring_iff v.valuation (z : K)).mp hzmem
      have hvalue : v.valuation (a₀.1 v) =
          v.valuation (π ^ (-n)) * v.valuation (z : K) := by
        show v.valuation
            (Function.update (0 : Place k K → K) v x v) = _
        simp only [Function.update_self, x]
        exact v.valuation.map_mul _ _
      have hbound :
          v.valuation (π ^ (-n)) * v.valuation (z : K) ≤ WithZero.exp n := by
        have hπpow : v.valuation (π ^ (-n)) = WithZero.exp (-1) ^ (-n) := by
          rw [map_zpow₀]
          exact congrArg (fun t ↦ t ^ (-n)) v.valuation_uniformizer
        rw [hπpow]
        have hzle₀ : v.valuation (z : K) ≤ WithZero.exp (0 : ℤ) := by
          simpa using hzle
        calc
          WithZero.exp (-1) ^ (-n) * v.valuation (z : K)
              ≤ WithZero.exp (-1) ^ (-n) * WithZero.exp 0 :=
            mul_le_mul_right hzle₀ _
          _ = WithZero.exp n := by
            rw [← WithZero.exp_zsmul, ← WithZero.exp_add]
            simp
      simpa [n] using (le_of_eq hvalue).trans hbound
    · simp only [a₀, intrinsicAdeleUpdate, intrinsicZeroAdele,
        Function.update_of_ne hw, Pi.zero_apply, Valuation.map_zero,
        Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
      exact zero_le
  refine ⟨⟨a₀, ha₀⟩, ?_⟩
  have hnum :
      (intrinsicAdeleLocalNumerator k K D v ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ : K) = (z : K) := by
    dsimp [intrinsicAdeleLocalNumerator, a₀, intrinsicAdeleUpdate,
      intrinsicZeroAdele, x, n, π]
    simp only [Function.update_self]
    have hcancel :
        v.uniformizer ^ (D v + 1) * v.uniformizer ^ (-(D v + 1)) = (1 : K) := by
      rw [← zpow_add₀ v.uniformizer_ne_zero, add_neg_cancel, zpow_zero]
    calc
      v.uniformizer ^ (D v + 1) *
          (v.uniformizer ^ (-(D v + 1)) * (z : K)) =
          (v.uniformizer ^ (D v + 1) * v.uniformizer ^ (-(D v + 1))) * (z : K) := by
        ring
      _ = (z : K) := by rw [hcancel, one_mul]
  change IsLocalRing.residue v.toValuationSubring
      (intrinsicAdeleLocalNumerator k K D v ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩) = y
  exact congrArg (IsLocalRing.residue v.toValuationSubring)
    (Subtype.ext_iff.mpr hnum) ▸ hz

name: FunctionField.moduleFinite_intrinsicAdeleFilt_quotient_single
statement:
theorem moduleFinite_intrinsicAdeleFilt_quotient_single
    (D : Divisor k K) (v : Place k K) [Module.Finite k v.residueField] :
    Module.Finite k
      ((adeleFilt k K (D + Finsupp.single v 1)) ⧸
        Submodule.comap (adeleFilt k K (D + Finsupp.single v 1)).subtype
          (adeleFilt k K D))
proof:
:=
  Module.Finite.equiv (intrinsicAdeleFiltQuotientEquivResidueField k K D v).symm

name: FunctionField.finrank_intrinsicAdeleFilt_quotient_single
statement:
theorem finrank_intrinsicAdeleFilt_quotient_single
    (D : Divisor k K) (v : Place k K) [Module.Finite k v.residueField] :
    Module.finrank k
        ((adeleFilt k K (D + Finsupp.single v 1)) ⧸
          Submodule.comap (adeleFilt k K (D + Finsupp.single v 1)).subtype
            (adeleFilt k K D)) = v.degree
proof:
:=
  (intrinsicAdeleFiltQuotientEquivResidueField k K D v).finrank_eq

name: FunctionField.moduleFinite_intrinsicAdeleFilt_quotient_self
statement:
theorem moduleFinite_intrinsicAdeleFilt_quotient_self (D : Divisor k K) :
    Module.Finite k
      ((adeleFilt k K D) ⧸
        Submodule.comap (adeleFilt k K D).subtype (adeleFilt k K D))
proof:
:= by
  rw [show Submodule.comap (adeleFilt k K D).subtype (adeleFilt k K D) = ⊤ from
    Submodule.comap_subtype_self (adeleFilt k K D)]
  infer_instance

name: FunctionField.moduleFinite_intrinsicAdeleFilt_quotient_trans
statement:
theorem moduleFinite_intrinsicAdeleFilt_quotient_trans
    {D M N : Divisor k K} (hDM : D ≤ M) (hMN : M ≤ N)
    [Module.Finite k
      ((adeleFilt k K N) ⧸
        Submodule.comap (adeleFilt k K N).subtype (adeleFilt k K M))]
    [Module.Finite k
      ((adeleFilt k K M) ⧸
        Submodule.comap (adeleFilt k K M).subtype (adeleFilt k K D))] :
    Module.Finite k
      ((adeleFilt k K N) ⧸
        Submodule.comap (adeleFilt k K N).subtype (adeleFilt k K D))
proof:
:= by
  let p := adeleFilt k K N
  let q := Submodule.comap p.subtype (adeleFilt k K D)
  let r := Submodule.comap p.subtype (adeleFilt k K M)
  let pM := adeleFilt k K M
  let qM := Submodule.comap pM.subtype (adeleFilt k K D)
  have hqr : q ≤ r := Submodule.comap_mono (adeleFilt_mono k K hDM)
  let eR := Submodule.comapSubtypeEquivOfLe (adeleFilt_mono k K hMN)
  let qInR : Submodule k ↑r := Submodule.comap r.subtype q
  have hqmap : qM.map (eR.symm : pM →ₗ[k] r) = qInR := by
    rw [Submodule.map_equiv_eq_comap_symm eR.symm qM]
    rfl
  have eMq : (pM ⧸ qM) ≃ₗ[k] (r ⧸ qInR) :=
    Submodule.Quotient.equiv qM qInR eR.symm hqmap
  haveI : Module.Finite k (r ⧸ qInR) := Module.Finite.equiv eMq
  have hker : (q.mkQ.comp (r.subtype : r →ₗ[k] p)).ker = qInR := by
    rw [LinearMap.ker_comp, Submodule.ker_mkQ]
  have hrange : (q.mkQ.comp (r.subtype : r →ₗ[k] p)).range = r.map q.mkQ := by
    rw [LinearMap.range_comp, Submodule.range_subtype]
  have eQuot : (r ⧸ qInR) ≃ₗ[k] r.map q.mkQ := by
    rw [← hker, ← hrange]
    exact LinearMap.quotKerEquivRange (q.mkQ.comp (r.subtype : r →ₗ[k] p))
  haveI : Module.Finite k (r.map q.mkQ) := Module.Finite.equiv eQuot
  have eThird := Submodule.quotientQuotientEquivQuotient q r hqr
  haveI : Module.Finite k (p ⧸ r) := by
    dsimp only [p, r]
    infer_instance
  haveI : Module.Finite k ((p ⧸ q) ⧸ Submodule.map q.mkQ r) :=
    Module.Finite.equiv eThird.symm
  exact Module.Finite.of_submodule_quotient (Submodule.map q.mkQ r)

name: FunctionField.moduleFinite_intrinsicAdeleFilt_quotient_single_nat
statement:
theorem moduleFinite_intrinsicAdeleFilt_quotient_single_nat
    (D : Divisor k K) (v : Place k K) (n : ℕ) [Module.Finite k v.residueField] :
    Module.Finite k
      ((adeleFilt k K (D + Finsupp.single v (n : ℤ))) ⧸
        Submodule.comap
          (adeleFilt k K (D + Finsupp.single v (n : ℤ))).subtype
          (adeleFilt k K D))
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      have heq : D + Finsupp.single v ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) = D := by
        classical
        ext w
        simp
      rw [heq]
      exact moduleFinite_intrinsicAdeleFilt_quotient_self k K D
  | succ n ih =>
      have heq : D + Finsupp.single v ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) =
          D + Finsupp.single v (n : ℤ) + Finsupp.single v 1 := by
        classical
        ext w
        simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
        split <;> omega
      have hDM : D ≤ D + Finsupp.single v (n : ℤ) := by
        intro w
        simp only [Finsupp.add_apply]
        exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (by
          classical
          simp only [Finsupp.single_apply]
          split <;> omega)
      have hMN : D + Finsupp.single v (n : ℤ) ≤
          D + Finsupp.single v (n : ℤ) + Finsupp.single v 1 := by
        intro w
        simp only [Finsupp.add_apply]
        exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (by
          classical
          simp only [Finsupp.single_apply]
          split <;> omega)
      letI := ih
      haveI := moduleFinite_intrinsicAdeleFilt_quotient_single k K
        (D + Finsupp.single v (n : ℤ)) v
      rw [heq]
      exact moduleFinite_intrinsicAdeleFilt_quotient_trans k K hDM hMN

name: FunctionField.moduleFinite_intrinsicAdeleFilt_quotient_add_effective
statement:
theorem moduleFinite_intrinsicAdeleFilt_quotient_add_effective
    (D E : Divisor k K) (hE : ∀ v, 0 ≤ E v)
    (hres : ∀ v : Place k K, Module.Finite k v.residueField) :
    Module.Finite k
      ((adeleFilt k K (D + E)) ⧸
        Submodule.comap (adeleFilt k K (D + E)).subtype (adeleFilt k K D))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction E using Finsupp.induction generalizing D with
  | zero =>
      rw [add_zero]
      exact moduleFinite_intrinsicAdeleFilt_quotient_self k K D
  | single_add v n E hv hn ih =>
      have hEv : E v = 0 := Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hv
      have hEE : ∀ w, 0 ≤ E w := by
        intro w
        by_cases hw : w = v
        · subst w
          rw [hEv]
        · simpa [Finsupp.single_apply, hw] using hE w
      have hn₀ : 0 ≤ n := by
        simpa [Finsupp.single_apply, hEv] using hE v
      letI := ih D hEE
      letI : Module.Finite k v.residueField := hres v
      haveI := moduleFinite_intrinsicAdeleFilt_quotient_single_nat k K
        (D + E) v n.toNat
      have hncast : (n.toNat : ℤ) = n := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hn₀
      have heq : D + (Finsupp.single v n + E) =
          (D + E) + Finsupp.single v (n.toNat : ℤ) := by
        rw [hncast]
        abel
      have hDM : D ≤ D + E := by
        intro w
        exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (hEE w)
      have hMN : D + E ≤ (D + E) + Finsupp.single v (n.toNat : ℤ) := by
        intro w
        simp only [Finsupp.add_apply]
        exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (by
          simp only [Finsupp.single_apply]
          split <;> omega)
      rw [heq]
      exact moduleFinite_intrinsicAdeleFilt_quotient_trans k K hDM hMN

name: FunctionField.moduleFinite_intrinsicAdeleFilt_quotient_of_le
statement:
theorem moduleFinite_intrinsicAdeleFilt_quotient_of_le
    {D E : Divisor k K} (hDE : D ≤ E)
    (hres : ∀ v : Place k K, Module.Finite k v.residueField) :
    Module.Finite k
      ((adeleFilt k K E) ⧸
        Submodule.comap (adeleFilt k K E).subtype (adeleFilt k K D))
proof:
:= by
  have heff : ∀ v, 0 ≤ (E - D) v := fun v ↦ sub_nonneg.mpr (hDE v)
  have heq : D + (E - D) = E := by
    abel
  rw [← heq]
  exact moduleFinite_intrinsicAdeleFilt_quotient_add_effective k K D (E - D) heff hres

name: FunctionField.finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff_trans
statement:
theorem finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff_trans
    {D M N : Divisor k K} (hDM : D ≤ M) (hMN : M ≤ N)
    (hres : ∀ v : Place k K, Module.Finite k v.residueField) :
    finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff k K D N =
      finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff k K D M +
        finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff k K M N
proof:
:= by
  let p := adeleFilt k K N
  let q := Submodule.comap p.subtype (adeleFilt k K D)
  let r := Submodule.comap p.subtype (adeleFilt k K M)
  have hqr : q ≤ r := Submodule.comap_mono (adeleFilt_mono k K hDM)
  haveI : Module.Finite k (p ⧸ q) :=
    moduleFinite_intrinsicAdeleFilt_quotient_of_le k K (hDM.trans hMN) hres
  haveI : Module.Finite k (p ⧸ r) :=
    moduleFinite_intrinsicAdeleFilt_quotient_of_le k K hMN hres
  have e := Submodule.quotientQuotientEquivQuotient q r hqr
  have hadd := Submodule.finrank_quotient_add_finrank (r.map q.mkQ)
  have hrmap : Module.finrank k (r.map q.mkQ) =
      finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff k K D M := by
    let pM := adeleFilt k K M
    let qM := Submodule.comap pM.subtype (adeleFilt k K D)
    let qInR : Submodule k ↑r := Submodule.comap r.subtype q
    let eR := Submodule.comapSubtypeEquivOfLe (adeleFilt_mono k K hMN)
    have hqmap : qM.map (eR.symm : pM →ₗ[k] r) = qInR := by
      rw [Submodule.map_equiv_eq_comap_symm eR.symm qM]
      rfl
    have eM : (pM ⧸ qM) ≃ₗ[k] (r ⧸ qInR) :=
      Submodule.Quotient.equiv qM qInR eR.symm hqmap
    have hker : (q.mkQ.comp (r.subtype : r →ₗ[k] p)).ker = qInR := by
      rw [LinearMap.ker_comp, Submodule.ker_mkQ]
    have hrange : (q.mkQ.comp (r.subtype : r →ₗ[k] p)).range = r.map q.mkQ := by
      rw [LinearMap.range_comp, Submodule.range_subtype]
    have eQuot : (r ⧸ qInR) ≃ₗ[k] r.map q.mkQ := by
      rw [← hker, ← hrange]
      exact LinearMap.quotKerEquivRange (q.mkQ.comp (r.subtype : r →ₗ[k] p))
    dsimp only [finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff]
    rw [← eQuot.finrank_eq, eM.finrank_eq]
  calc
    Module.finrank k (p ⧸ q) =
        Module.finrank k ((p ⧸ q) ⧸ Submodule.map q.mkQ r) +
          Module.finrank k (Submodule.map q.mkQ r) := hadd.symm
    _ = Module.finrank k (p ⧸ r) +
        finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff k K D M := by
      rw [e.finrank_eq, hrmap]
    _ = finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff k K D M +
        finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff k K M N := by
      dsimp only [finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff]
      rw [add_comm]

name: FunctionField.finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff_add_one
statement:
theorem finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff_add_one
    {D M : Divisor k K} (v : Place k K) (hDM : D ≤ M)
    (hres : ∀ w : Place k K, Module.Finite k w.residueField) :
    finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff k K D (M + Finsupp.single v 1) =
      finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff k K D M + v.degree
proof:
:= by
  have hMN : M ≤ M + Finsupp.single v 1 := by
    intro w
    simp only [Finsupp.add_apply]
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (by
      classical
      simp only [Finsupp.single_apply]
      split <;> omega)
  rw [finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff_trans k K hDM hMN hres]
  letI : Module.Finite k v.residueField := hres v
  exact congrArg (finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff k K D M + ·)
    (finrank_intrinsicAdeleFilt_quotient_single k K M v)

name: FunctionField.finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff_single_nat
statement:
theorem finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff_single_nat
    (D : Divisor k K) (v : Place k K) (n : ℕ)
    (hres : ∀ w : Place k K, Module.Finite k w.residueField) :
    finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff k K D
        (D + Finsupp.single v (n : ℤ)) = n * v.degree
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      have heq : D + Finsupp.single v ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) = D := by
        classical
        ext w
        simp
      rw [heq]
      dsimp only [finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff]
      rw [show Submodule.comap (adeleFilt k K D).subtype (adeleFilt k K D) = ⊤ from
        Submodule.comap_subtype_self (adeleFilt k K D)]
      simp only [Nat.zero_mul]
      exact Module.finrank_eq_zero_of_subsingleton k
        ((adeleFilt k K D) ⧸ (⊤ : Submodule k (adeleFilt k K D)))
  | succ n ih =>
      let M := D + Finsupp.single v (n : ℤ)
      have hDM : D ≤ M := by
        intro w
        dsimp only [M]
        simp only [Finsupp.add_apply]
        exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (by
          classical
          simp only [Finsupp.single_apply]
          split <;> omega)
      have heq : D + Finsupp.single v ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) =
          M + Finsupp.single v 1 := by
        classical
        dsimp only [M]
        ext w
        simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
        split <;> omega
      rw [heq, finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff_add_one k K v hDM hres, ih]
      exact (Nat.succ_mul n v.degree).symm

name: FunctionField.finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff_add_effective
statement:
theorem finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff_add_effective
    (D E : Divisor k K) (hE : ∀ v, 0 ≤ E v)
    (hres : ∀ v : Place k K, Module.Finite k v.residueField) :
    finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff k K D (D + E) =
      (Divisor.deg k K E).toNat
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction E using Finsupp.induction generalizing D with
  | zero =>
      rw [add_zero, Divisor.deg_zero]
      dsimp only [finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff]
      rw [show Submodule.comap (adeleFilt k K D).subtype (adeleFilt k K D) = ⊤ from
        Submodule.comap_subtype_self (adeleFilt k K D)]
      exact Module.finrank_eq_zero_of_subsingleton k
        ((adeleFilt k K D) ⧸ (⊤ : Submodule k (adeleFilt k K D)))
  | single_add v n E hv hn ih =>
      have hEv : E v = 0 := Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hv
      have hEE : ∀ w, 0 ≤ E w := by
        intro w
        by_cases hw : w = v
        · subst w
          rw [hEv]
        · simpa [Finsupp.single_apply, hw] using hE w
      have hn₀ : 0 ≤ n := by
        simpa [Finsupp.single_apply, hEv] using hE v
      let M := D + E
      let N := M + Finsupp.single v (n.toNat : ℤ)
      have hDM : D ≤ M := by
        intro w
        exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (hEE w)
      have hMN : M ≤ N := by
        intro w
        dsimp only [N]
        simp only [Finsupp.add_apply]
        exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (by
          simp only [Finsupp.single_apply]
          split <;> omega)
      have hfirst := ih D hEE
      have hsecond : finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff k K M N = n.toNat * v.degree := by
        exact finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff_single_nat k K M v n.toNat hres
      have hdegE : 0 ≤ Divisor.deg k K E := Divisor.deg_nonneg k K hEE
      have hdegTotal : 0 ≤ Divisor.deg k K (Finsupp.single v n + E) :=
        Divisor.deg_nonneg k K hE
      have hdegree : Divisor.deg k K (Finsupp.single v n + E) =
          n * (v.degree : ℤ) + Divisor.deg k K E := by
        rw [Divisor.deg_add, Divisor.deg_single]
      have hdegNat : (Divisor.deg k K (Finsupp.single v n + E)).toNat =
          n.toNat * v.degree + (Divisor.deg k K E).toNat := by
        have hEcast : ((Divisor.deg k K E).toNat : ℤ) = Divisor.deg k K E :=
          Int.toNat_of_nonneg hdegE
        have hTotalCast :
            ((Divisor.deg k K (Finsupp.single v n + E)).toNat : ℤ) =
              Divisor.deg k K (Finsupp.single v n + E) :=
          Int.toNat_of_nonneg hdegTotal
        apply Int.ofNat_injective
        change ((Divisor.deg k K (Finsupp.single v n + E)).toNat : ℤ) =
          ((n.toNat * v.degree + (Divisor.deg k K E).toNat : ℕ) : ℤ)
        rw [hTotalCast, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, Int.toNat_of_nonneg hn₀, hEcast]
        exact hdegree
      have htotal : finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff k K D N =
          (Divisor.deg k K (Finsupp.single v n + E)).toNat := by
        rw [finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff_trans k K hDM hMN hres,
          hfirst, hsecond, hdegNat, Nat.add_comm]
      have heq : D + (Finsupp.single v n + E) = N := by
        dsimp only [N, M]
        rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg hn₀]
        abel
      rw [heq]
      exact htotal

name: FunctionField.finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff_of_le
statement:
theorem finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff_of_le
    {D E : Divisor k K} (hDE : D ≤ E)
    (hres : ∀ v : Place k K, Module.Finite k v.residueField) :
    finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff k K D E =
      (Divisor.deg k K (E - D)).toNat
proof:
:= by
  have heff : ∀ v, 0 ≤ (E - D) v := fun v ↦ sub_nonneg.mpr (hDE v)
  have h := finrankIntrinsicAdeleFiltDiff_add_effective k K D (E - D) heff hres
  have heq : D + (E - D) = E := by
    abel
  rwa [heq] at h

name: FunctionField.moduleFinite_intrinsicAdeleFilt_add_quotient
statement:
theorem moduleFinite_intrinsicAdeleFilt_add_quotient
    {D E : Divisor k K} (L : Submodule k (AdeleSpace k K)) (hDE : D ≤ E)
    (hres : ∀ v : Place k K, Module.Finite k v.residueField) :
    Module.Finite k
      ((adeleFilt k K E) ⧸
        Submodule.comap (adeleFilt k K E).subtype (adeleFilt k K D + L))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Module.Finite k
      ((adeleFilt k K E) ⧸
        Submodule.comap (adeleFilt k K E).subtype (adeleFilt k K D)) :=
    moduleFinite_intrinsicAdeleFilt_quotient_of_le k K hDE hres
  exact Module.Finite.equiv (Submodule.quotientQuotientEquivQuotient
    (Submodule.comap (adeleFilt k K E).subtype (adeleFilt k K D))
    (Submodule.comap (adeleFilt k K E).subtype (adeleFilt k K D + L))
    (Submodule.comap_mono (by
      rw [Submodule.add_eq_sup]
      exact le_sup_left)))

name: FunctionField.moduleFinite_intrinsicAdeleQuotient_of_bounded
statement:
theorem moduleFinite_intrinsicAdeleQuotient_of_bounded
    {D E : Divisor k K} (L : Submodule k (AdeleSpace k K)) (hDE : D ≤ E)
    (hres : ∀ v : Place k K, Module.Finite k v.residueField)
    (hbounded : adeleFilt k K E + L = ⊤) :
    Module.Finite k (AdeleSpace k K ⧸ (adeleFilt k K D + L))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := moduleFinite_intrinsicAdeleFilt_add_quotient k K L hDE hres
  have hker :
      Submodule.comap (adeleFilt k K E).subtype (adeleFilt k K D + L) ≤
        LinearMap.ker (((adeleFilt k K D + L).mkQ).comp
          (adeleFilt k K E).subtype) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply,
      Submodule.mkQ_apply]
    exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr hx
  refine Module.Finite.of_surjective (Submodule.liftQ _ _ hker) ?_
  intro y
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mkQ_surjective (adeleFilt k K D + L) y
  have hx : x ∈ adeleFilt k K E + L := by
    rw [hbounded]
    exact Submodule.mem_top
  rcases Submodule.mem_sup.mp hx with ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk ⟨a, ha⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [Submodule.liftQ_apply]
  show (adeleFilt k K D + L).mkQ a = (adeleFilt k K D + L).mkQ (a + b)
  have hb₀ : (adeleFilt k K D + L).mkQ b = 0 := by
    rw [Submodule.mkQ_apply]
    exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr (Submodule.mem_sup_right hb)
  rw [map_add, hb₀, add_zero]

name: FunctionField.intrinsicAdeleExceptionalFinite
statement:
theorem intrinsicAdeleExceptionalFinite (a : AdeleSpace k K) :
    {v : Place k K | ¬ v.valuation (a.1 v) ≤ 1}.Finite
proof:
:=
  (Filter.eventually_cofinite.mp a.property).subset (by
    intro v hv
    change a.1 v ∉ v.toValuationSubring
    rw [← Place.valuationSubring_valuation, Valuation.mem_valuationSubring_iff]
    exact hv)

name: FunctionField.mem_adeleFilt_intrinsicDivisorOfAdele
statement:
theorem mem_adeleFilt_intrinsicDivisorOfAdele (a : AdeleSpace k K) :
    a ∈ adeleFilt k K (intrinsicDivisorOfAdele k K a)
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  show v.valuation (a.1 v) ≤ WithZero.exp ((intrinsicDivisorOfAdele k K a) v)
  dsimp [intrinsicDivisorOfAdele, intrinsicAdeleExceptionalPlaces,
    Finsupp.onFinset_apply]
  by_cases hv : v.valuation (a.1 v) ≤ 1
  · have hnotlt : ¬ 1 < v.valuation (a.1 v) := not_lt.mpr hv
    have hnotmem : v ∉ intrinsicAdeleExceptionalPlaces k K a := by
      intro hmem
      have hgt := (intrinsicAdeleExceptionalFinite k K a).mem_toFinset.mp (by
        dsimp [intrinsicAdeleExceptionalPlaces] at hmem ⊢
        exact hmem)
      have hnotle : ¬ v.valuation (a.1 v) ≤ 1 := by simpa using hgt
      exact absurd hv hnotle
    split_ifs with hlt
    · exact (hnotlt hlt).elim
    · simpa [WithZero.exp_zero] using hv
  · have hlt : 1 < v.valuation (a.1 v) := not_le.mp hv
    have hmem : v ∈ intrinsicAdeleExceptionalPlaces k K a := by
      dsimp [intrinsicAdeleExceptionalPlaces]
      exact (intrinsicAdeleExceptionalFinite k K a).mem_toFinset.mpr (not_le.mpr hlt)
    have hval : v.valuation (a.1 v) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (zero_lt_one.trans hlt)
    split_ifs with hlt'
    · simp [WithZero.exp_log hval]
    · exact (hlt' hlt).elim

name: FunctionField.exists_adeleFilt_mem_intrinsic
statement:
theorem exists_adeleFilt_mem_intrinsic (a : AdeleSpace k K) :
    ∃ D : Divisor k K, a ∈ adeleFilt k K D
proof:
:=
  ⟨intrinsicDivisorOfAdele k K a, mem_adeleFilt_intrinsicDivisorOfAdele k K a⟩

name: FunctionField.exists_effective_bounded_adele_representatives_of_moduleFinite_quotient
statement:
theorem exists_effective_bounded_adele_representatives_of_moduleFinite_quotient
    (L : Submodule k (AdeleSpace k K))
    [Module.Finite k (AdeleSpace k K ⧸ L)] :
    ∃ E : Divisor k K, 0 ≤ E ∧ adeleFilt k K E + L = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Q := AdeleSpace k K ⧸ L
  let b := Module.finBasis k Q
  let rep : Fin (Module.finrank k Q) → AdeleSpace k K := fun i =>
    Classical.choose (Submodule.mkQ_surjective L (b i))
  have hrepQ (i : Fin (Module.finrank k Q)) : L.mkQ (rep i) = b i :=
    Classical.choose_spec (Submodule.mkQ_surjective L (b i))
  let D : Fin (Module.finrank k Q) → Divisor k K := fun i =>
    intrinsicDivisorOfAdele k K (rep i)
  let E : Divisor k K := ∑ i, (D i ⊔ 0)
  have hE : 0 ≤ E := by
    dsimp only [E]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => le_sup_right
  have hDE (i : Fin (Module.finrank k Q)) : D i ≤ E := by
    calc
      D i ≤ D i ⊔ 0 := le_sup_left
      _ ≤ E := by
        dsimp only [E]
        exact Finset.single_le_sum
          (fun j _ => show (0 : Divisor k K) ≤ D j ⊔ 0 from le_sup_right)
          (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hrepFilt (i : Fin (Module.finrank k Q)) : rep i ∈ adeleFilt k K E :=
    adeleFilt_mono k K (hDE i) (mem_adeleFilt_intrinsicDivisorOfAdele k K (rep i))
  refine ⟨E, hE, ?_⟩
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro x _
  let q : Q := L.mkQ x
  let y : AdeleSpace k K := ∑ i, (b.repr q i) • rep i
  have hyE : y ∈ adeleFilt k K E := by
    dsimp only [y]
    exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hrepFilt i)
  have hqy : L.mkQ y = q := by
    calc
      L.mkQ y = ∑ i, (b.repr q i) • L.mkQ (rep i) := by
        simp [y]
      _ = ∑ i, (b.repr q i) • b i := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [hrepQ i]
      _ = q := b.sum_repr q
  have hxy : x - y ∈ L := (Submodule.Quotient.eq L).mp (by
    change L.mkQ x = L.mkQ y
    simpa only [q] using hqy.symm)
  exact Submodule.mem_sup.mpr ⟨y, hyE, x - y, hxy, by abel⟩

name: FunctionField.moduleFinite_intrinsicAdeleQuotient_iff_exists_effective_bounded
statement:
theorem moduleFinite_intrinsicAdeleQuotient_iff_exists_effective_bounded
    (L : Submodule k (AdeleSpace k K))
    (hres : ∀ v : Place k K, Module.Finite k v.residueField) :
    Module.Finite k
        (AdeleSpace k K ⧸ (adeleFilt k K 0 + L)) ↔
      ∃ E : Divisor k K, 0 ≤ E ∧ adeleFilt k K E + L = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hfinite
    let L₀ := adeleFilt k K 0 + L
    letI : Module.Finite k (AdeleSpace k K ⧸ L₀) := hfinite
    obtain ⟨E, hE, hfull⟩ :=
      exists_effective_bounded_adele_representatives_of_moduleFinite_quotient k K L₀
    refine ⟨E, hE, ?_⟩
    have h₀E : adeleFilt k K 0 ≤ adeleFilt k K E := adeleFilt_mono k K hE
    dsimp only [L₀] at hfull
    rw [Submodule.add_eq_sup] at hfull ⊢
    rw [Submodule.add_eq_sup] at hfull
    rw [← sup_assoc, sup_eq_left.mpr h₀E] at hfull
    exact hfull
  · rintro ⟨E, hE, hfull⟩
    exact moduleFinite_intrinsicAdeleQuotient_of_bounded k K L hE hres hfull

name: FunctionField.WeilDifferential.differentialSpace_eq_dualAnnihilator
statement:
theorem differentialSpace_eq_dualAnnihilator (D : Divisor k K) :
    differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K) D =
      (adeleFilt k K D + diagonalSubmodule k K).dualAnnihilator
proof:
:= by
  ext phi
  rw [Submodule.mem_dualAnnihilator]
  rfl

name: FunctionField.WeilDifferential.adeleDualEquivChart_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adeleDualEquivChart_apply (phi : AdeleSpace k K →ₗ[k] k)
    (a : Chart.AdeleSpace k K) :
    adeleDualEquivChart (k := k) (K := K) phi a =
      phi ((adeleEquivChart k K).symm a)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: FunctionField.WeilDifferential.adeleDualEquivChart_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adeleDualEquivChart_symm_apply (phi : Chart.AdeleSpace k K →ₗ[k] k)
    (a : AdeleSpace k K) :
    (adeleDualEquivChart (k := k) (K := K)).symm phi a =
      phi (adeleEquivChart k K a)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: FunctionField.WeilDifferential.ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {omega eta : WeilDifferential k K} (h : omega.toFun = eta.toFun) :
    omega = eta
proof:
:= by
  cases omega
  cases eta
  cases h
  rfl

name: FunctionField.WeilDifferential.weilDifferentialAddEquivChart_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem weilDifferentialAddEquivChart_smul (x : K) (omega : WeilDifferential k K) :
    weilDifferentialAddEquivChart (k := k) (K := K) (x • omega) =
      x • weilDifferentialAddEquivChart (k := k) (K := K) omega
proof:
:=
  (weilDifferentialAddEquivChart (k := k) (K := K)).apply_symm_apply _

name: FunctionField.WeilDifferential.finrank_differentialSpace_eq_chart
statement:
theorem finrank_differentialSpace_eq_chart (D : Divisor k K) :
    Module.finrank k (differentialSpace (k := k) (K := K) D) =
      Module.finrank k (Chart.WeilDifferential.differentialSpace
        ((divisorEquivChart k K).symm D))
proof:
:=
  (differentialSpaceEquivChart (k := k) (K := K) D).finrank_eq

name: FunctionField.WeilDifferential.finrank_weilDifferential_eq_one
statement:
theorem finrank_weilDifferential_eq_one :
    Module.finrank K (WeilDifferential k K) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [(weilDifferentialEquivChart (k := k) (K := K)).finrank_eq]
  exact Chart.WeilDifferential.finrank_weilDifferential_eq_one (k := k) (K := K)

name: FunctionField.WeilDifferential.isNonzero_toChart
statement:
theorem isNonzero_toChart (omega : WeilDifferential k K) :
    IsNonzero omega ↔ Chart.WeilDifferential.IsNonzero (toChart omega)
proof:
:= by
  change omega.toFun ≠ 0 ↔
    adeleDualEquivChart (k := k) (K := K) omega.toFun ≠ 0
  exact (adeleDualEquivChart (k := k) (K := K)).map_ne_zero_iff.symm

name: FunctionField.WeilDifferential.divOmega_smul
statement:
theorem divOmega_smul (x : Kˣ) (omega : WeilDifferential k K) (homega : IsNonzero omega)
    (hxomega : IsNonzero ((x : K) • omega)) :
    divOmega ((x : K) • omega) hxomega =
      divOmega omega homega + principalDivisor k K (Additive.ofMul x)
proof:
:= by
  apply (divisorEquivChart k K).symm.injective
  simp only [divOmega, principalDivisor, map_add, AddEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hsmul : toChart ((x : K) • omega) = (x : K) • toChart omega :=
    weilDifferentialAddEquivChart_smul (k := k) (K := K) x omega
  have hxchart : Chart.WeilDifferential.IsNonzero ((x : K) • toChart omega) := by
    simpa only [hsmul] using
      ((isNonzero_toChart ((x : K) • omega)).mp hxomega)
  have hchart := Chart.WeilDifferential.divOmega_smul (k := k) (K := K) x
    (toChart omega) ((isNonzero_toChart omega).mp homega) hxchart
  simpa [hsmul, principalDivisor] using hchart

name: FunctionField.isCanonical_iff_chart
statement:
theorem isCanonical_iff_chart (W : Divisor k K) :
    IsCanonical k K W ↔
      Chart.IsCanonical k K ((divisorEquivChart k K).symm W)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨omega, homega, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨WeilDifferential.toChart omega,
      (WeilDifferential.isNonzero_toChart omega).mp homega, ?_⟩
    simp [WeilDifferential.divOmega]
  · rintro ⟨omega, homega, hdiv⟩
    let eta := WeilDifferential.ofChart omega
    have hetaChart : WeilDifferential.toChart eta = omega :=
      (WeilDifferential.weilDifferentialAddEquivChart
        (k := k) (K := K)).apply_symm_apply omega
    have heta : WeilDifferential.IsNonzero eta := by
      apply (WeilDifferential.isNonzero_toChart eta).mpr
      rw [hetaChart]
      exact homega
    refine ⟨eta, heta, ?_⟩
    apply (divisorEquivChart k K).symm.injective
    simp only [WeilDifferential.divOmega, AddEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    simpa only [hetaChart] using hdiv

name: FunctionField.RRspace_mono_intrinsic
statement:
theorem RRspace_mono_intrinsic {D E : Divisor k K} (h : D ≤ E) :
    RRspace k K D ≤ RRspace k K E
proof:
:= by
  intro f hf v
  exact (hf v).trans (WithZero.exp_le_exp.mpr (h v))

name: FunctionField.intrinsicLocalResidueMap_ker
statement:
theorem intrinsicLocalResidueMap_ker (D : Divisor k K) (v : Place k K) :
    (intrinsicLocalResidueMap k K D v).ker =
      Submodule.comap (RRspace k K (D + Finsupp.single v 1)).subtype
        (RRspace k K D)
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.coe_subtype]
  change IsLocalRing.residue v.toValuationSubring
      (localIntegralNumerator k K D v f) = 0 ↔
    ∀ w, w.valuation (f : K) ≤ WithZero.exp (D w)
  rw [IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff,
    v.mem_maximalIdeal_iff_valuation_lt_one]
  dsimp only [localIntegralNumerator]
  change v.valuation
      (v.uniformizer ^ (D v + 1) * (f : K)) < 1 ↔ _
  rw [map_mul, map_zpow₀, v.valuation_uniformizer]
  have hlocal :
      WithZero.exp (-1) ^ (D v + 1) * v.valuation (f : K) < 1 ↔
        v.valuation (f : K) ≤ WithZero.exp (D v) := by
    rw [← WithZero.exp_zsmul]
    simpa using FunctionField.Chart.exp_neg_mul_lt_one_iff_le
      (v.valuation (f : K)) (D v + 1)
  rw [hlocal]
  constructor
  · intro hv w
    by_cases hw : w = v
    · simpa [hw] using hv
    · have hf := f.property w
      simpa [Finsupp.single_apply, hw] using hf
  · intro hf
    exact hf v

name: FunctionField.moduleFinite_add_single_one
statement:
theorem moduleFinite_add_single_one (D : Divisor k K) (v : Place k K)
    [Module.Finite k (RRspace k K D)] [Module.Finite k v.residueField] :
    Module.Finite k (RRspace k K (D + Finsupp.single v 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hle : RRspace k K D ≤
      RRspace k K (D + Finsupp.single v 1) := by
    apply RRspace_mono_intrinsic k K
    intro w
    simp only [Finsupp.add_apply]
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (by
      classical
      simp only [Finsupp.single_apply]
      split <;> omega)
  let p := Submodule.comap
    (RRspace k K (D + Finsupp.single v 1)).subtype (RRspace k K D)
  letI : Module.Finite k p :=
    Module.Finite.equiv (Submodule.comapSubtypeEquivOfLe hle).symm
  let f := intrinsicLocalResidueMap k K D v
  letI : Module.Finite k f.range := inferInstance
  haveI hqker : Module.Finite k
      (RRspace k K (D + Finsupp.single v 1) ⧸ f.ker) :=
    Module.Finite.equiv f.quotKerEquivRange.symm
  haveI hqp : Module.Finite k
      (RRspace k K (D + Finsupp.single v 1) ⧸ p) :=
    Module.Finite.equiv (Submodule.quotEquivOfEq f.ker p
      (intrinsicLocalResidueMap_ker k K D v))
  exact Module.Finite.of_submodule_quotient p

name: FunctionField.moduleFinite_add_single_nat
statement:
theorem moduleFinite_add_single_nat (D : Divisor k K) (v : Place k K) (n : ℕ)
    [Module.Finite k (RRspace k K D)] [Module.Finite k v.residueField] :
    Module.Finite k (RRspace k K (D + Finsupp.single v (n : ℤ)))
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      have heq : D + Finsupp.single v ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) = D := by
        classical
        ext w
        simp
      rw [heq]
      infer_instance
  | succ n ih =>
      letI : Module.Finite k
          (RRspace k K (D + Finsupp.single v (n : ℤ))) := ih
      have hstep := moduleFinite_add_single_one k K
        (D + Finsupp.single v (n : ℤ)) v
      have heq : D + Finsupp.single v ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) =
          (D + Finsupp.single v (n : ℤ)) + Finsupp.single v 1 := by
        classical
        ext w
        simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
        split <;> omega
      rwa [heq]

name: FunctionField.moduleFinite_add_effective
statement:
theorem moduleFinite_add_effective (D E : Divisor k K)
    (hE : ∀ v, 0 ≤ E v)
    (hres : ∀ v : Place k K, Module.Finite k v.residueField)
    [Module.Finite k (RRspace k K D)] :
    Module.Finite k (RRspace k K (D + E))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction E using Finsupp.induction generalizing D with
  | zero =>
      rw [add_zero]
      infer_instance
  | single_add a b f ha hb ih =>
      have hfa : f a = 0 := Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp ha
      have hff : ∀ w, 0 ≤ f w := by
        intro w
        by_cases hw : w = a
        · subst w
          rw [hfa]
        · have hwE := hE w
          simpa [Finsupp.single_apply, hw] using hwE
      have hb0 : 0 ≤ b := by
        have haE := hE a
        simpa [Finsupp.single_apply, hfa] using haE
      letI : Module.Finite k (RRspace k K (D + f)) := ih D hff
      letI : Module.Finite k a.residueField := hres a
      have hsingle := moduleFinite_add_single_nat k K (D + f) a b.toNat
      have hbcast : (b.toNat : ℤ) = b := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hb0
      have heq : D + (Finsupp.single a b + f) =
          (D + f) + Finsupp.single a (b.toNat : ℤ) := by
        rw [hbcast]
        abel
      rwa [heq]

name: FunctionField.moduleFinite_RRspace_of_zero
statement:
theorem moduleFinite_RRspace_of_zero
    (hres : ∀ v : Place k K, Module.Finite k v.residueField)
    [Module.Finite k (RRspace k K (0 : Divisor k K))]
    (D : Divisor k K) : Module.Finite k (RRspace k K D)
proof:
:= by
  let E : Divisor k K := 0 ⊔ D
  have hE : ∀ v, 0 ≤ E v := fun v ↦ le_sup_left
  have hDE : D ≤ E := le_sup_right
  haveI hfiniteE : Module.Finite k (RRspace k K E) := by
    have h := moduleFinite_add_effective k K
      (0 : Divisor k K) E hE hres
    have heq : (0 : Divisor k K) + E = E := zero_add E
    rw [heq] at h
    exact h
  have hspace : RRspace k K D ≤ RRspace k K E :=
    RRspace_mono_intrinsic k K hDE
  let p := Submodule.comap (RRspace k K E).subtype (RRspace k K D)
  letI : Module.Finite k p := inferInstance
  exact Module.Finite.equiv (Submodule.comapSubtypeEquivOfLe hspace)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.WHASM.projDivisorGateOn_projectiveIntegral
statement:
theorem projDivisorGateOn_projectiveIntegral [Infinite k] :
    ProjDivisorGateOn (chowOpsOn_projectiveIntegral k) (chowCompatOn_projectiveIntegral k)
      (hP k)
proof:
:= by
  intro X _ _ _ _ _ L B D a b w hex hL e hB hD
  haveI : Epi b := hex.epi_g
  obtain ⟨P, hCB, hCD, hfr⟩ := E20.exists_pairCover_card_frames b hB hD hL
  refine ⟨P.toB, P.toD, hCB, hCD, ?_⟩
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k P.toB.scheme) := ⟨hP k P.toB hCB⟩
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k P.toD.scheme) := ⟨hP k P.toD hCD⟩
  have hT : E16.TwistGate P := twistGateOn (ProjectiveIntegral k) a b w hex hL e hB hD P hCB hCD
  have hZ : E16.ZeroSectionLink P L :=
    E20.zeroSectionLink_of_frames P w hex hL (fun i => (hfr i).some)
  have hK := cartierCapGateOn_of_weilGate (chowOpsOn_projectiveIntegral k)
    (chowCompatOn_projectiveIntegral k) P hL hCB hCD
    (weilGateOn (ProjectiveIntegral k) a b w hex hL e hB hD P hCB hCD)
  obtain ⟨σ, hreg, hid⟩ := hZ
  exact ⟨projDivisorDataOn_of_gates _ _ P hL hCB hCD hT (hK σ hreg hid)⟩
