name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoP_flag_mem_next_overlap
statement:
theorem m7geoP_flag_mem_next_overlap {X : Scheme.{u}} {E : X.Modules}
    (C : AffineFrameCover X E) (i : C.I) [Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)]
    {v : X} (hv : v ∈ C.U i) (t : ℕ) (ht : t < C.positiveRankDimension i) :
    m7g_w C i hv t ∈
      m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm (m7geo_nextIndex C i t ht).1) ⊓
        m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · apply (m7geo_J_mem_W_iff C i 0 (m7geo_nextIndex C i t ht).1 (m7g_Q C i hv t)).mpr
    apply (m7geo_stdChart_mem_coordinateOpen _ _ (m7geo_nextIndex C i t ht).2 _).mpr
    exact m7g_X_not_mem (I := (m7g_q C i hv).asIdeal)
      (lv := fun j : AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0 => (j.1 : ℕ))
      (by simp [m7geo_nextIndex])
  · change m7g_w C i hv t ∈ m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0)
    have h : m7g_w C i hv t ∈ (m7g_J C i 0).opensRange :=
      Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange.mpr ⟨m7g_Q C i hv t, rfl⟩
    simpa only [m7geoO_J0_range_eq_W0 C i] using h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoP_next_overlap_nonempty
statement:
theorem m7geoP_next_overlap_nonempty {X : Scheme.{u}} {E : X.Modules}
    (C : AffineFrameCover X E) (i : C.I) [Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)]
    {v : X} (hv : v ∈ C.U i) (t : ℕ) (ht : t < C.positiveRankDimension i) :
    Nonempty (pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) ⁻¹ᵁ
      (m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm (m7geo_nextIndex C i t ht).1) ⊓
        m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0)))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨pointClosureGenericPoint (m7g_w C i hv t), ?_⟩⟩
  change pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) (pointClosureGenericPoint _) ∈
    (m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm (m7geo_nextIndex C i t ht).1) ⊓
      m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0))
  rw [pointClosureι_genericPoint]
  exact m7geoP_flag_mem_next_overlap C i hv t ht

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoP_successor_ratio_ord_one
statement:
theorem m7geoP_successor_ratio_ord_one {X : Scheme.{u}} {E : X.Modules}
    (C : AffineFrameCover X E) [IsLocallyNoetherian C.scheme]
    (i : C.I) [Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)]
    {v : X} (hv : v ∈ C.U i) (t : ℕ) (ht : t < C.positiveRankDimension i)
    (z : pointClosureScheme (m7g_w C i hv t))
    (hznext : pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z = m7g_w C i hv (t + 1))
    (hz : coheight z = 1) :
    let a
proof:
:= m7geo_nextIndex C i t ht
    let U := m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a.1) ⊓
      m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0)
    haveI : Nonempty (pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) ⁻¹ᵁ U) :=
      m7geoP_next_overlap_nonempty C i hv t ht
    (pointClosureScheme (m7g_w C i hv t)).ord
      ((pointClosureScheme (m7g_w C i hv t)).germToFunctionField
        (pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) ⁻¹ᵁ U)
        ((pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t)).app U
          (m7geoF_ratio C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a.1)
            ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0)))) z = 1 := by
  let J := m7g_J C i 0
  have hzW : pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z ∈ J.opensRange := by
    rw [hznext]
    exact Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange.mpr ⟨m7g_Q C i hv (t + 1), rfl⟩
  letI : Nonempty (pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) ⁻¹ᵁ J.opensRange) := ⟨⟨z, hzW⟩⟩
  letI := m7geoP_next_overlap_nonempty C i hv t ht
  dsimp only
  rw [m7geoO_ratio_germ_eq_chart_variable C i (pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t))
    (m7geo_nextIndex C i t ht).2]
  exact m7geoN_flag_chart_variable_ord_one C i hv t ht z hznext hz

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoP_successor_not_mem_next
statement:
theorem m7geoP_successor_not_mem_next {X : Scheme.{u}} {E : X.Modules}
    (C : AffineFrameCover X E) (i : C.I) [Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)]
    {v : X} (hv : v ∈ C.U i) (t : ℕ) (ht : t < C.positiveRankDimension i) :
    m7g_w C i hv (t + 1) ∉
      m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm (m7geo_nextIndex C i t ht).1)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h' := (m7geo_J_mem_W_iff C i 0 (m7geo_nextIndex C i t ht).1
    (m7g_Q C i hv (t + 1))).mp h
  have hn := (m7geo_stdChart_mem_coordinateOpen _ _
    (m7geo_nextIndex C i t ht).2 _).mp h'
  apply hn
  rw [m7geo_Q_succ C i hv t ht]
  exact Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.subset_span rfl)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoP_flag_frame_field
statement:
theorem m7geoP_flag_frame_field {X : Scheme.{u}} {E : X.Modules}
    (C : AffineFrameCover X E) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsLocallyNoetherian C.scheme]
    (i : C.I) [Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)]
    {v : X} (hv : v ∈ C.U i) (t : ℕ) (ht : t < C.positiveRankDimension i)
    (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree (pointClosureScheme (m7g_w C i hv t))
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t))).obj
        (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)))
    (hrank : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank
      (pointClosureScheme (m7g_w C i hv t))
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t))).obj
        (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)) = 1) :
    ∃ (b₀ : pointClosureScheme (m7g_w C i hv t))
      (b : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme (m7g_w C i hv t))
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t))).obj
          (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)) b₀),
      ∀ z : pointClosureScheme (m7g_w C i hv t), coheight z = 1 →
        C.toBase (pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z) = v →
        Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame hM hrank b z =
          if pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z = m7g_w C i hv (t + 1) then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  let a := m7geo_nextIndex C i t ht
  have hw : m7g_w C i hv t ∈ m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a.1) :=
    (m7geoP_flag_mem_next_overlap C i hv t ht).1
  refine m7geoF_frame_field' C (m7g_w C i hv t) hM hrank v
    (m7g_w C i hv (t + 1)) i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a.1) hw
    (m7geoP_successor_not_mem_next C i hv t ht) ?_
  intro z hz hzv hc
  have heq := m7geoB_next_point_unique C i hv t ht z hz hzv hc
  have h0 := m7geoB_chart0_coverage C i hv t ht z hz hzv hc
  refine ⟨(C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0, h0, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  rw [if_pos heq]
  exact m7geoP_successor_ratio_ord_one C i hv t ht z heq hz

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D10.restrictedEq_ne_zero
statement:
theorem restrictedEq_ne_zero (x : X) (a : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (z : pointClosureScheme x)
    (ha : a (pointClosureι x z) ∉
      Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι x z)) :

proof:
:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D10.coeff_eq_of_frameCompare
statement:
theorem coeff_eq_of_frameCompare (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (x : X)
    (a₁ a₂ : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) {bpoint : pointClosureScheme x}
    (b : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme x)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι x)).obj L) bpoint)
    (c₀ : (pointClosureScheme x).functionField) (h : FrameCompare L x a₁ a₂ b c₀) (y : X) :
    properPushforward (pointClosureι x)
        (Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame
          (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL x)
          (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one L hL x) b).1 y +
      properPushforward (pointClosureι x) (AlgebraicGeometry.div c₀) y =
    C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a₁ x y - C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a₂ x y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hy : y ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι x)
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hy
    have h1 := AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_closedImmersion (pointClosureι x)
      (Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame
        (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL x)
        (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one L hL x) b).1 (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ())
      (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) z
    have h2 := AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_closedImmersion (pointClosureι x)
      (AlgebraicGeometry.div c₀) (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) z
    change AlgebraicCycle.pushforward (pointClosureι x) _ (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) _ +
      AlgebraicCycle.pushforward (pointClosureι x) _ (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) _ = _
    rw [h1, h2]
    change Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame _ _ b z +
      (pointClosureScheme x).ord c₀ z = _
    by_cases hz : coheight z = 1
    · obtain ⟨ha₁, ha₂, w, d, hzd, htr⟩ := h.2 z hz
      rw [Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame_eq_on_localData _ _ b d z hzd,
        C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_ord a₁ x z hz ha₁, C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_ord a₂ x z hz ha₂]
      change _ + _ = (pointClosureScheme x).ord (restrictedEq x a₁ z) z -
        (pointClosureScheme x).ord (restrictedEq x a₂ z) z
      have hr := b.regularTransitionFunction_ne_zero d
      have h2ne := restrictedEq_ne_zero x a₂ z ha₂
      rw [htr, (pointClosureScheme x).ord_mul hz (mul_ne_zero h.1 hr) h2ne,
        (pointClosureScheme x).ord_mul hz h.1 hr]
      ring
    · rw [C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_pointClosureι, C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_pointClosureι,
        if_neg hz, if_neg hz, Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hz]
      have h0 : Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame
          (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL x)
          (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one L hL x) b z = 0 :=
        Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hz _
      rw [h0]
      simp
  · have e1 := AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range (pointClosureι x)
      (Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame
        (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL x)
        (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one L hL x) b).1 (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) y hy
    have e2 := AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range (pointClosureι x)
      (AlgebraicGeometry.div c₀) (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) y hy
    have hns : ¬ x ⤳ y := fun hsp ↦ hy (by
      rw [range_pointClosureι]
      exact specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp hsp)
    change AlgebraicCycle.pushforward (pointClosureι x) _ (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) _ +
      AlgebraicCycle.pushforward (pointClosureι x) _ (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) _ = _
    rw [e1, e2, C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_not_specializes a₁ hns,
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_not_specializes a₂ hns]
    simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D10.frameSec_restrict
statement:
theorem frameSec_restrict (d : LineBundleLocalData S M x) (V W : S.Opens) (hV : V ≤ d.U)
    (hWV : W ≤ V) (c : Γ(S, V)) :
    C1Cap.frameSec d W (hWV.trans hV) (S.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op c) =
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op (C1Cap.frameSec d V hV c)
proof:
:= by
  unfold C1Cap.frameSec
  have hn := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (d.globalFrame.hom.val.naturality
    (Over.homMk (homOfLE hWV) :
      Over.mk (homOfLE (hWV.trans hV)) ⟶ Over.mk (homOfLE hV)).op)
    ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op V) c)
  refine Eq.trans (congrArg (fun z ↦ (d.globalFrame.hom.val.app
    (op (Over.mk (homOfLE (hWV.trans hV))))) z) ?_) hn
  exact C1Cap.app_presheaf_map (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)).inv
    (homOfLE hWV) c

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D10.exists_frameCoord
statement:
theorem exists_frameCoord (d : LineBundleLocalData S M x) (V : S.Opens) (hV : V ≤ d.U)
    (m : Γ(M, V)) : ∃ c : Γ(S, V), C1Cap.frameSec d V hV c = m
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)).hom.val.app (op V)
    (d.globalFrame.inv.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV))) m), ?_⟩
  unfold C1Cap.frameSec
  have hi : ∀ m, d.globalFrame.hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV)))
      (d.globalFrame.inv.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV))) m) = m := fun m ↦
    congrArg (fun ψ ↦ ψ.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV))) m) d.globalFrame.inv_hom_id
  have hj : ∀ c : Γ(SheafOfModules.free (R := S.ringCatSheaf) PUnit, V),
      (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app
      (op V) ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)).hom.val.app (op V) c) = c :=
    fun c ↦ C1Cap.iso_inv_hom_app (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)) V c
  rw [hj, hi]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D10.sectionCoordSec_spec
statement:
theorem sectionCoordSec_spec (d : LineBundleLocalData S M x) (s : Γ(M, ⊤)) :

      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op s
proof:
:=

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D10.sectionCoord_compat
statement:
theorem sectionCoord_compat {y : S} (d : LineBundleLocalData S M x)
    (e : LineBundleLocalData S M y) (s : Γ(M, ⊤)) :
    sectionCoord e s = sectionCoord d s * d.regularTransitionFunction e
proof:
:= by
  have hW : (d.U ⊓ e.U : S.Opens) ≤ e.U := inf_le_right
  have key : S.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ e.U)).op (sectionCoordSec e s) =
      S.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ d.U)).op (sectionCoordSec d s) *
        d.transitionSection e := by
    apply C1Cap.frameSec_injective e (d.U ⊓ e.U) inf_le_right
    have l1 := frameSec_restrict e e.U (d.U ⊓ e.U) le_rfl inf_le_right (sectionCoordSec e s)
    have l2 := frameSec_restrict d d.U (d.U ⊓ e.U) le_rfl inf_le_left (sectionCoordSec d s)
    have e1 := sectionCoordSec_spec e s
    have e2 := sectionCoordSec_spec d s
    have pmm : ∀ {V W : S.Opens} (h : W ≤ V) (h' : V ≤ ⊤),
        M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h').op s) =
          M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h.trans h')).op s := by
      intro V W h h'
      rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← M.presheaf.map_comp]
      rfl
    have L : C1Cap.frameSec e (d.U ⊓ e.U) inf_le_right
        (S.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ e.U)).op (sectionCoordSec e s)) =
        M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ ⊤)).op s := by
      rw [l1, e1, pmm]
    have R : C1Cap.frameSec e (d.U ⊓ e.U) inf_le_right
        (S.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ d.U)).op (sectionCoordSec d s) *
          d.transitionSection e) =
        M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ ⊤)).op s := by
      rw [C1Cap.frameSec_smul e (d.U ⊓ e.U) inf_le_right
        (S.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ d.U)).op (sectionCoordSec d s) *
          d.transitionSection e), mul_smul,
        ← C1Cap.frameSec_smul e (d.U ⊓ e.U) inf_le_right (d.transitionSection e),
        C1Cap.frameSec_transitionSection d e,
        ← C1Cap.frameSec_smul d (d.U ⊓ e.U) inf_le_left, l2, e2, pmm]
    exact L.trans R.symm
  unfold sectionCoord Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.regularTransitionFunction
  rw [Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.algebraMap_functionField_restrict
      (X := S) (inf_le_right : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ e.U) (sectionCoordSec e s), key, map_mul,
    ← Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.algebraMap_functionField_restrict
      (X := S) (inf_le_left : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ d.U) (sectionCoordSec d s)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D10.ClosureFrames.frameCompare
statement:
theorem ClosureFrames.frameCompare {x : X} {a₁ a₂ : C1Cap.LocalEquations X}
    (E : ClosureFrames L x a₁ a₂) :
    ∃ (bpoint : pointClosureScheme x)
      (b : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme x)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι x)).obj L) bpoint)
      (c₀ : (pointClosureScheme x).functionField), FrameCompare L x a₁ a₂ b c₀
proof:
:= by
  let η := pointClosureGenericPoint x
  refine ⟨η, E.frame η, E.coord η, E.coord_ne_zero η, fun z hz ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := E.eq_coord z hz
  exact ⟨h1, h2, z, E.frame z, (E.frame z).mem, by rw [h3, E.compat η z]⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D10.dimCapProperMeeting_of_movingFrames
statement:
theorem dimCapProperMeeting_of_movingFrames (h : MovingFrames L n) :
    DimCapProperMeeting (k := k) L hL n
proof:
:= fun g ↦ by
  obtain ⟨a₁, a₂, h₁, h₂, hc⟩ := h g
  exact ⟨DimCapProperData.ofFrames (k := k) L hL n g a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂ fun x hx hne ↦ by
    obtain ⟨E⟩ := hc x hx hne
    exact E.frameCompare⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D10.capDescends_of_movingFrames
statement:

  capDescends_of_properMeeting (k := k) L hL n
    (dimCapProperMeeting_of_movingFrames (k := k) L hL n h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.IsNaturalChar.eq_of_splitting
proof:
:= by
  have htop : φ S.Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj E) =
      ψ S.Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj E) := by
    rw [← hφ.iso S.top, ← hψ.iso S.top]
    exact hY
  funext n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro α
  apply S.injective
  have h1 := LinearMap.congr_fun (hφ.natural S.q S.d S.hd E hE n) α
  have h2 := LinearMap.congr_fun (hψ.natural S.q S.d S.hd E hE n) α
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at h1 h2
  rw [h1, h2, htop]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.IsAdditiveChar.unique
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ i ≤ e, φ S.Y (S.F i) = ψ S.Y (S.F i) := by
    intro i
    induction i with
    | zero =>
      intro _
      rw [hφ.iso S.base, hψ.iso S.base, hφ.line _ (S.L_line 0), hψ.line _ (S.L_line 0)]
    | succ i ih =>
      intro hi
      obtain ⟨a, b, w, hS⟩ := S.step i (by omega)
      funext n
      rw [hφ.additive a b w hS (S.F_vb i) (S.F_vb (i + 1)) (S.L_line (i + 1)).isFiniteLocallyFree n,
        hψ.additive a b w hS (S.F_vb i) (S.F_vb (i + 1)) (S.L_line (i + 1)).isFiniteLocallyFree n,
        ih (by omega), hφ.line _ (S.L_line (i + 1)), hψ.line _ (S.L_line (i + 1))]
  exact hφ.toIsNaturalChar.eq_of_splitting ops hψ.toIsNaturalChar hE S (key e le_rfl)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.IsMultiplicativeChar.unique
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ i ≤ e, φ S.Y (S.F i) = ψ S.Y (S.F i) := by
    intro i
    induction i with
    | zero =>
      intro _
      rw [hφ.iso S.base, hψ.iso S.base, hφ.line _ (S.L_line 0), hψ.line _ (S.L_line 0)]
    | succ i ih =>
      intro hi
      obtain ⟨a, b, w, hS⟩ := S.step i (by omega)
      funext n
      rw [hφ.mult a b w hS (S.F_vb i) (S.F_vb (i + 1)) (S.L_line (i + 1)).isFiniteLocallyFree n,
        hψ.mult a b w hS (S.F_vb i) (S.F_vb (i + 1)) (S.L_line (i + 1)).isFiniteLocallyFree n,
        ih (by omega), hφ.line _ (S.L_line (i + 1)), hψ.line _ (S.L_line (i + 1))]
  exact hφ.toIsNaturalChar.eq_of_splitting ops hψ.toIsNaturalChar hE S (key e le_rfl)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.IsAdditiveChar.unique_of_hasConstantRank
statement:
theorem IsAdditiveChar.unique_of_hasConstantRank {φ ψ : CharAssign k} {lv : LineVal k}
    (cp : ChowCompat ops) (hφ : IsAdditiveChar ops φ lv) (hψ : IsAdditiveChar ops ψ lv)
    [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X]
    {E : X.Modules} {e : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E (e + 1)) : φ X E = ψ X E
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S⟩ := exists_chowSplitting ops cp E e hE
  exact hφ.unique ops hψ hE.isFiniteLocallyFree S

proof:

  exact hφ.unique ops hψ hE.isFiniteLocallyFree S

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoP_twoStepLevel_first
statement:
theorem m7geoP_twoStepLevel_first (lv : σ → ℕ) {s₀ s₁ : σ} (hne : s₀ ≠ s₁)
    (t : ℕ) (j : σ) :
    (m7geoP_twoStepLevel lv s₀ s₁ t j ≤ t + 1 ↔
      m7geoP_twoStepLevel lv s₀ s₁ t j ≤ t ∨ j = s₀)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h0 : j = s₀
  · subst j
    simp [m7geoP_twoStepLevel]
  · by_cases h1 : j = s₁
    · subst j
      simp [m7geoP_twoStepLevel, hne.symm]
    · simp only [m7geoP_twoStepLevel, h0, h1, ite_false]
      by_cases h : lv j ≤ t <;> simp [h] <;> omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoP_twoStepLevel_second
statement:
theorem m7geoP_twoStepLevel_second (lv : σ → ℕ) {s₀ s₁ : σ} (hne : s₀ ≠ s₁)
    (t : ℕ) (j : σ) :
    (m7geoP_twoStepLevel lv s₀ s₁ t j ≤ t + 2 ↔
      m7geoP_twoStepLevel lv s₀ s₁ t j ≤ t + 1 ∨ j = s₁)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h0 : j = s₀
  · subst j
    simp [m7geoP_twoStepLevel, hne]
  · by_cases h1 : j = s₁
    · subst j
      simp [m7geoP_twoStepLevel, hne.symm]
    · simp only [m7geoP_twoStepLevel, h0, h1, ite_false]
      by_cases h : lv j ≤ t <;> simp [h] <;> omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoP_two_step_prime_chain
statement:
theorem m7geoP_two_step_prime_chain (I : Ideal R) [I.IsPrime] (lv : σ → ℕ)
    (s₀ s₁ : σ) (hne : s₀ ≠ s₁) (t : ℕ) :
    let ρ
proof:
:= m7geoP_twoStepLevel lv s₀ s₁ t
    let Q := RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I ρ t)
    let Q₀ := RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I ρ (t + 1))
    let Q₀₁ := RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I ρ (t + 2))
    Q < Q₀ ∧ Q₀ < Q₀₁ ∧
      Q₀ = Q ⊔ Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.X s₀} ∧
      Q₀₁ = Q₀ ⊔ Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.X s₁} := by
  let ρ := m7geoP_twoStepLevel lv s₀ s₁ t
  let Q := RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I ρ t)
  let Q₀ := RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I ρ (t + 1))
  let Q₀₁ := RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I ρ (t + 2))
  have hs₀ := m7geoP_twoStepLevel_first lv hne t
  have hs₁ := m7geoP_twoStepLevel_second lv hne t
  have hQ₀ : Q₀ = Q ⊔ Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.X s₀} :=
    m7g_ker_succ hs₀
  have hQ₀₁ : Q₀₁ = Q₀ ⊔ Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.X s₁} :=
    m7g_ker_succ (t := t + 1) (by simpa only [Nat.add_assoc] using hs₁)
  have hnot₀ : MvPolynomial.X s₀ ∉ Q :=
    m7g_X_not_mem (I := I) (lv := ρ) (s := s₀) (t := t) (by
      simp [ρ, m7geoP_twoStepLevel])
  have hnot₁ : MvPolynomial.X s₁ ∉ Q₀ :=
    m7g_X_not_mem (I := I) (lv := ρ) (s := s₁) (t := t + 1) (by
      simp [ρ, m7geoP_twoStepLevel, hne.symm])
  have hlt₀ : Q < Q₀ := by
    refine lt_of_le_not_ge (by rw [hQ₀]; exact le_sup_left) ?_
    intro h
    apply hnot₀
    apply h
    rw [hQ₀]
    exact Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.subset_span rfl)
  have hlt₁ : Q₀ < Q₀₁ := by
    refine lt_of_le_not_ge (by rw [hQ₀₁]; exact le_sup_left) ?_
    intro h
    apply hnot₁
    apply h
    rw [hQ₀₁]
    exact Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.subset_span rfl)
  exact ⟨hlt₀, hlt₁, hQ₀, hQ₀₁⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoP_chart_prime_chain
statement:
theorem m7geoP_chart_prime_chain (I : Ideal R) [I.IsPrime]
    (n t : ℕ) {a c : Fin (n + 1)} (ha0 : a ≠ 0) (hac : a ≠ c) (hc0 : c ≠ 0) :
    let s₀ : AffineChartIndex n a
proof:
:= ⟨0, Ne.symm ha0⟩
    let s₁ : AffineChartIndex n a := ⟨c, Ne.symm hac⟩
    let ρ := m7geoP_twoStepLevel (fun j : AffineChartIndex n a ↦ (j.1 : ℕ)) s₀ s₁ t
    let Q := RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I ρ t)
    let Q₀ := RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I ρ (t + 1))
    let Q₀₁ := RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I ρ (t + 2))
    Q < Q₀ ∧ Q₀ < Q₀₁ ∧
      Q₀ = Q ⊔ Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.X s₀} ∧
      Q₀₁ = Q₀ ⊔ Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.X s₁} := by
  let s₀ : AffineChartIndex n a := ⟨0, Ne.symm ha0⟩
  let s₁ : AffineChartIndex n a := ⟨c, Ne.symm hac⟩
  have hne : s₀ ≠ s₁ := by
    intro h
    have hval : (0 : Fin (n + 1)) = c := congrArg Subtype.val h
    exact hc0 hval.symm
  exact m7geoP_two_step_prime_chain I
    (fun j : AffineChartIndex n a ↦ (j.1 : ℕ)) s₀ s₁ hne t

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoP_chart_level_iff
statement:
theorem m7geoP_chart_level_iff (n t : ℕ) {a c : Fin (n + 1)}
    (ha0 : a ≠ 0) (hac : a ≠ c) (hct : t < (c : ℕ))
    (j : AffineChartIndex n a) :
    m7geoP_twoStepLevel (fun j : AffineChartIndex n a ↦ (j.1 : ℕ))
      ⟨0, Ne.symm ha0⟩ ⟨c, Ne.symm hac⟩ t j ≤ t ↔
      0 < (j.1 : ℕ) ∧ (j.1 : ℕ) ≤ t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h0 : j = (⟨0, Ne.symm ha0⟩ : AffineChartIndex n a)
  · subst j
    simp [m7geoP_twoStepLevel]
  · by_cases h1 : j = (⟨c, Ne.symm hac⟩ : AffineChartIndex n a)
    · subst j
      have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := by
        intro h
        have : (c : ℕ) = 0 := congrArg Fin.val h
        omega
      simp [m7geoP_twoStepLevel, hc0, hct]
    · have hj0 : (j.1 : ℕ) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h
        apply h0
        apply Subtype.ext
        apply Fin.ext
        exact h
      by_cases h : (j.1 : ℕ) ≤ t <;>
        simp [m7geoP_twoStepLevel, h0, h1, h, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hj0]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoP_chart_Q_X_mem_iff
statement:
theorem m7geoP_chart_Q_X_mem_iff (I : Ideal R) [I.IsPrime]
    (n t : ℕ) {a c : Fin (n + 1)}
    (ha0 : a ≠ 0) (hac : a ≠ c) (hct : t < (c : ℕ))
    (j : AffineChartIndex n a) :
    let ρ
proof:
:= m7geoP_twoStepLevel (fun j : AffineChartIndex n a ↦ (j.1 : ℕ))
      (⟨0, Ne.symm ha0⟩ : AffineChartIndex n a)
      (⟨c, Ne.symm hac⟩ : AffineChartIndex n a) t
    MvPolynomial.X j ∈ RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I ρ t) ↔
      0 < (j.1 : ℕ) ∧ (j.1 : ℕ) ≤ t := by
  simp only [RingHom.mem_ker, m7g_phi_X]
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have hlev : m7geoP_twoStepLevel (fun j : AffineChartIndex n a ↦ (j.1 : ℕ))
        ⟨0, Ne.symm ha0⟩ ⟨c, Ne.symm hac⟩ t j ≤ t := by
      by_contra hn
      simp [hn, MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero] at hz
    exact (m7geoP_chart_level_iff n t ha0 hac hct j).mp hlev
  · intro hj
    have hlev := (m7geoP_chart_level_iff n t ha0 hac hct j).mpr hj
    simp [hlev]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoP_chart_Q_comap
statement:
theorem m7geoP_chart_Q_comap (I : Ideal R) [I.IsPrime]
    (n t : ℕ) {a c : Fin (n + 1)} (ha0 : a ≠ 0) (hac : a ≠ c) :
    let ρ
proof:
:= m7geoP_twoStepLevel (fun j : AffineChartIndex n a ↦ (j.1 : ℕ))
      (⟨0, Ne.symm ha0⟩ : AffineChartIndex n a)
      (⟨c, Ne.symm hac⟩ : AffineChartIndex n a) t
    (RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I ρ t)).comap MvPolynomial.C = I := by
  exact m7g_comap_ker I _ t

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoP_chart_no_height_one
statement:
theorem m7geoP_chart_no_height_one (I : Ideal R) [I.IsPrime]
    (n t : ℕ) {a c : Fin (n + 1)}
    (ha0 : a ≠ 0) (hac : a ≠ c) (hc0 : c ≠ 0)
    (P : Ideal (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n a) R)) [P.IsPrime]
    (hQP : RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I
      (m7geoP_twoStepLevel (fun j : AffineChartIndex n a ↦ (j.1 : ℕ))
        ⟨0, Ne.symm ha0⟩ ⟨c, Ne.symm hac⟩ t) t) ≤ P)
    (h0P : MvPolynomial.X (⟨0, Ne.symm ha0⟩ : AffineChartIndex n a) ∈ P)
    (hcP : MvPolynomial.X (⟨c, Ne.symm hac⟩ : AffineChartIndex n a) ∈ P)
    (hheight : (P.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I
      (m7geoP_twoStepLevel (fun j : AffineChartIndex n a ↦ (j.1 : ℕ))
        ⟨0, Ne.symm ha0⟩ ⟨c, Ne.symm hac⟩ t) t)))).height = 1) : False
proof:
:= by
  let s₀ : AffineChartIndex n a := ⟨0, Ne.symm ha0⟩
  let s₁ : AffineChartIndex n a := ⟨c, Ne.symm hac⟩
  let ρ := m7geoP_twoStepLevel (fun j : AffineChartIndex n a ↦ (j.1 : ℕ)) s₀ s₁ t
  let Q := RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I ρ t)
  let Q₀ := RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I ρ (t + 1))
  let Q₀₁ := RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I ρ (t + 2))
  obtain ⟨hQR, hRS, hQ₀, hQ₀₁⟩ := m7geoP_chart_prime_chain I n t ha0 hac hc0
  have hSP : Q₀₁ ≤ P := by
    change RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I ρ (t + 2)) ≤ P
    rw [hQ₀₁, hQ₀]
    exact sup_le (sup_le hQP (Ideal.span_le.mpr (by simpa using h0P)))
      (Ideal.span_le.mpr (by simpa using hcP))
  haveI : Q.IsPrime := m7g_ker_isPrime I ρ t
  haveI : Q₀.IsPrime := m7g_ker_isPrime I ρ (t + 1)
  exact m7geoC_no_height_one_above_two_steps hQR hRS hSP hheight

name: SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf_genericRank_one
statement:
theorem tensorSheaf_genericRank_one {M N : X.Modules}
    (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree X M) (hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree X N)
    (hrankM : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X M = 1)
    (hrankN : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X N = 1) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X (tensorSheaf X M N) = 1
proof:
:= by
  let d := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleLocalDataAt X M hM hrankM
    (genericPoint X)
  let e := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleLocalDataAt X N hN hrankN
    (genericPoint X)
  exact (d.tensor e).genericRank_eq_one

name: SchemeKTheory.determinantFirstChern_eq_lineBundleFirstChern
statement:
theorem determinantFirstChern_eq_lineBundleFirstChern (M : X.Modules)
    (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree X M)
    (hrank : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X M = 1) :
    determinantFirstChern X M hM =
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleFirstChernClass hM hrank
proof:
:= by
  exact AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleFirstChernClass_iso
    (determinant_isFiniteLocallyFree X M hM) hM
    (determinant_genericRank X M hM) hrank
    (determinantRankOneIso X M hrank)

name: SchemeKTheory.determinantFirstChern_iso
proof:
:= by
  exact AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleFirstChernClass_iso
    (determinant_isFiniteLocallyFree X M hM)
    (determinant_isFiniteLocallyFree X N hN)
    (determinant_genericRank X M hM) (determinant_genericRank X N hN)
    (determinantMapIso X e)

name: SchemeKTheory.determinantFirstChern_exact
statement:
theorem determinantFirstChern_exact
    (E F G : {M : X.Modules // IsFiniteLocallyFree X M})
    (h : ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules
      (IsFiniteLocallyFree X) E F G) :
    determinantFirstChern X F.1 F.2 =
      determinantFirstChern X E.1 E.2 + determinantFirstChern X G.1 G.2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, g, zero, hS⟩ := h
  let S := ShortComplex.mk f g zero
  let hdetE := determinant_isFiniteLocallyFree X E.1 E.2
  let hdetF := determinant_isFiniteLocallyFree X F.1 F.2
  let hdetG := determinant_isFiniteLocallyFree X G.1 G.2
  let hdetTensor := tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree X
    (determinant X E.1) (determinant X G.1) hdetE hdetG
  let hrankE := determinant_genericRank X E.1 E.2
  let hrankF := determinant_genericRank X F.1 F.2
  let hrankG := determinant_genericRank X G.1 G.2
  let hrankTensor := tensorSheaf_genericRank_one X hdetE hdetG hrankE hrankG
  unfold determinantFirstChern
  calc
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleFirstChernClass hdetF hrankF =
        AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleFirstChernClass
          hdetTensor hrankTensor :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleFirstChernClass_iso
        hdetF hdetTensor hrankF hrankTensor
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.determinant_shortExact
          X S hS E.2 G.2)
    _ = AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleFirstChernClass hdetE hrankE +
        AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleFirstChernClass hdetG hrankG :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleFirstChernClass_tensor
        hdetE hdetG hdetTensor hrankE hrankG hrankTensor

name: SchemeKTheory.determinantFirstChern_unit
statement:
theorem determinantFirstChern_unit :
    determinantFirstChern X (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)
      (unit_isFiniteLocallyFree X) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [determinantFirstChern]
  calc
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleFirstChernClass
        (determinant_isFiniteLocallyFree X _ (unit_isFiniteLocallyFree X))
        (determinant_genericRank X _ (unit_isFiniteLocallyFree X)) =
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleFirstChernClass
        (unit_isFiniteLocallyFree X)
        (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank_unit X) :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleFirstChernClass_iso
        (determinant_isFiniteLocallyFree X _ (unit_isFiniteLocallyFree X))
        (unit_isFiniteLocallyFree X)
        (determinant_genericRank X _ (unit_isFiniteLocallyFree X))
        (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank_unit X)
        (determinantUnitIso X)
    _ = 0 := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleFirstChernClass_unit

name: SchemeKTheory.k0FirstChern_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem k0FirstChern_classOf (E : X.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) :
    k0FirstChern X (k0ClassOf X E hE) = determinantFirstChern X E hE
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.lift_classOf

name: SchemeKTheory.k0FirstChern_unit
statement:
theorem k0FirstChern_unit :
    k0FirstChern X (k0ClassOf X (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)
      (unit_isFiniteLocallyFree X)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [k0FirstChern_classOf, determinantFirstChern_unit]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.chTot_eq_tot
statement:
theorem chTot_eq_tot (E : X.Modules) :
    chTot ops cp hP E = tot (M := fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n)
      (PowerSeries.mk (chOpOn ops cp hP X E))
proof:
:= by
  unfold chTot tot
  simp only [PowerSeries.coeff_mk]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tdTot_eq_tot
statement:
theorem tdTot_eq_tot (E : X.Modules) :
    tdTot ops cp hP E = tot (M := fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n)
      (tdSeriesOn ops cp hP X E)
proof:
:= by
  unfold tdTot tot tdSeriesOn
  simp only [PowerSeries.coeff_mk]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tdInvTot_eq_tot
statement:
theorem tdInvTot_eq_tot (E : X.Modules) :
    tdInvTot ops cp hP E = tot (M := fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n)
      (PowerSeries.invOfUnit (tdSeriesOn ops cp hP X E) 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold tdInvTot tot tdInvOpOn
  rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.lowSub_of_loweringSub
statement:
theorem lowSub_of_loweringSub {n : ℕ} {T : Module.End ℚ (TotalChow X)}
    (h : T ∈ loweringSub X n) : T ∈ lowSub (fun i ↦ RationalDimChow X i) n
proof:
:=
  (mem_lowSub).2 ((mem_loweringSub).1 h)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.gser_ch
proof:
:=
  gSer_mk fun n ↦ lowSub_of_loweringSub (chOpOn_lowering (ops := ops) (cp := cp) (hP := hP) hW hE n)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.gser_td
proof:
:=
  gSer_mk fun n ↦ lowSub_of_loweringSub (tdOpOn_lowering (ops := ops) (cp := cp) (hP := hP) hW hE n)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.gser_tdInv
statement:
theorem gser_tdInv (hW : WhitneyConstRankOn ops cp hP) [Nonempty X] {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ}
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    GSer (lowFam fun i ↦ RationalDimChow X i)
      (PowerSeries.invOfUnit (tdSeriesOn ops cp hP X E) 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  exact lowSub_of_loweringSub (tdInvOpOn_lowering (ops := ops) (cp := cp) (hP := hP) hW hE n)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.chTot_lof_stable
statement:
theorem chTot_lof_stable (hW : WhitneyConstRankOn ops cp hP) [Nonempty X] {E : X.Modules}
    {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) {m N : ℕ} (hmN : m < N)
    (z : RationalDimChow X m) :
    chTot ops cp hP E (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun i ↦ RationalDimChow X i) m z) =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, chOpOn ops cp hP X E n
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun i ↦ RationalDimChow X i) m z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chTot_eq_tot]
  have := tot_lof_stable (gser_ch (hP := hP) hW hE) hmN z
  simpa only [PowerSeries.coeff_mk] using this

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tdTot_lof_stable
statement:
theorem tdTot_lof_stable (hW : WhitneyConstRankOn ops cp hP) [Nonempty X] {E : X.Modules}
    {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) {m N : ℕ} (hmN : m < N)
    (z : RationalDimChow X m) :
    tdTot ops cp hP E (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun i ↦ RationalDimChow X i) m z) =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, tdOpOn ops cp hP X E n
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun i ↦ RationalDimChow X i) m z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tdTot_eq_tot]
  have := tot_lof_stable (gser_td (hP := hP) hW hE) hmN z
  simpa only [tdSeriesOn, PowerSeries.coeff_mk] using this

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tdInvTot_lof_stable
statement:
theorem tdInvTot_lof_stable (hW : WhitneyConstRankOn ops cp hP) [Nonempty X] {E : X.Modules}
    {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) {m N : ℕ} (hmN : m < N)
    (z : RationalDimChow X m) :
    tdInvTot ops cp hP E (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun i ↦ RationalDimChow X i) m z) =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, tdInvOpOn ops cp hP X E n
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun i ↦ RationalDimChow X i) m z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tdInvTot_eq_tot]
  have := tot_lof_stable (gser_tdInv (hP := hP) hW hE) hmN z
  simpa only [tdInvOpOn] using this

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.chTot_lof_zero
statement:
theorem chTot_lof_zero [Nonempty X] {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r)
    (z : RationalDimChow X 0) :
    chTot ops cp hP E (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun i ↦ RationalDimChow X i) 0 z) =
      (r : ℚ) • DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun i ↦ RationalDimChow X i) 0 z
proof:
:= by
  unfold chTot
  rw [Alg.gsum_lof]
  simp [chOpOn_zero hE]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.chTot_additive
statement:
theorem chTot_additive {A B D : X.Modules} (a : A ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ D) (w : a ≫ b = 0)
    (h : (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact) {r s : ℕ} (hA : HasConstantRank X A r)
    (hD : HasConstantRank X D s) :
    chTot ops cp hP B = chTot ops cp hP A + chTot ops cp hP D
proof:
:= by
  rw [chTot_eq_tot, chTot_eq_tot, chTot_eq_tot, ← tot_add]
  congr 1
  refine PowerSeries.ext fun n ↦ ?_
  simp only [PowerSeries.coeff_mk, map_add]
  exact chOpOn_additive (hP := hP) hW a b w h hA hD n

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.chTot_directSum
statement:
theorem chTot_directSum {A D : X.Modules} {r s : ℕ} (hA : HasConstantRank X A r)
    (hD : HasConstantRank X D s) :
    chTot ops cp hP (A ⊞ D) = chTot ops cp hP A + chTot ops cp hP D
proof:
:=
  chTot_additive hW biprod.inl biprod.snd (by simp)
    (ShortComplex.Splitting.ofHasBinaryBiproduct A D).shortExact hA hD

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tdTot_mult
statement:
theorem tdTot_mult {A B D : X.Modules} (a : A ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ D) (w : a ≫ b = 0)
    (h : (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact) {r s : ℕ} (hA : HasConstantRank X A r)
    (hD : HasConstantRank X D s) :
    tdTot ops cp hP B = tdTot ops cp hP A * tdTot ops cp hP D
proof:
:= by
  rw [tdTot_eq_tot, tdTot_eq_tot, tdTot_eq_tot, ← tot_mul (gser_td (hP := hP) hW hA) (gser_td (hP := hP) hW hD)]
  congr 1
  refine PowerSeries.ext fun n ↦ ?_
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
  simp only [tdSeriesOn, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
  exact tdOpOn_mult (hP := hP) hW a b w h hA hD n

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tdTot_directSum
statement:
theorem tdTot_directSum {A D : X.Modules} {r s : ℕ} (hA : HasConstantRank X A r)
    (hD : HasConstantRank X D s) :
    tdTot ops cp hP (A ⊞ D) = tdTot ops cp hP A * tdTot ops cp hP D
proof:
:=
  tdTot_mult hW biprod.inl biprod.snd (by simp)
    (ShortComplex.Splitting.ofHasBinaryBiproduct A D).shortExact hA hD

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tdInvTot_mult
statement:
theorem tdInvTot_mult {A B D : X.Modules} (a : A ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ D) (w : a ≫ b = 0)
    (h : (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact) {r s : ℕ} (hA : HasConstantRank X A r)
    (hD : HasConstantRank X D s) :
    tdInvTot ops cp hP B = tdInvTot ops cp hP D * tdInvTot ops cp hP A
proof:
:= by
  rw [tdInvTot_eq_tot, tdInvTot_eq_tot, tdInvTot_eq_tot,
    ← tot_mul (gser_tdInv (hP := hP) hW hD) (gser_tdInv (hP := hP) hW hA)]
  congr 1
  refine PowerSeries.ext fun n ↦ ?_
  have := tdInvOpOn_mult (hP := hP) hW a b w h hA hD n
  unfold tdInvOpOn at this
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
  exact this

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tdTot_mul_tdInvTot
statement:
theorem tdTot_mul_tdInvTot {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    tdTot ops cp hP E * tdInvTot ops cp hP E = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [tdTot_eq_tot, tdInvTot_eq_tot, ← tot_mul (gser_td (hP := hP) hW hE) (gser_tdInv (hP := hP) hW hE),
    tdSeriesOn_mul_inv hE, tot_one]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tdInvTot_mul_tdTot
statement:
theorem tdInvTot_mul_tdTot {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    tdInvTot ops cp hP E * tdTot ops cp hP E = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [tdTot_eq_tot, tdInvTot_eq_tot, ← tot_mul (gser_tdInv (hP := hP) hW hE) (gser_td (hP := hP) hW hE),
    tdSeriesOn_inv_mul hE, tot_one]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.isUnit_tdTot
statement:
theorem isUnit_tdTot {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    IsUnit (tdTot ops cp hP E)
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨tdTot ops cp hP E, tdInvTot ops cp hP E, tdTot_mul_tdInvTot hW hE,
    tdInvTot_mul_tdTot hW hE⟩, rfl⟩

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.chTot_line
statement:
theorem chTot_line (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) :
    chTot ops cp hP L = Alg.gexp (totalCapOn ops L hL)
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro y
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  unfold chTot
  rw [Alg.gsum_lof, Alg.gexp_lof]
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_) _
  rw [chOpOn_line L hL j, one_div]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.chTot_line_evTot
statement:
theorem chTot_line_evTot (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) :
    chTot ops cp hP L = evTot (totalCapOn ops L hL) (PowerSeries.exp ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold chTot evTot tot evSer
  congr 1
  funext n
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mk, chOpOn_line L hL n, PowerSeries.coeff_exp]
  simp

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tdTot_line
statement:
theorem tdTot_line (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) :
    tdTot ops cp hP L =
      evTot (totalCapOn ops L hL) (CharacteristicClasses.toddLine ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold tdTot evTot tot evSer
  congr 1
  funext n
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mk, tdOpOn_line L hL n]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tdSeriesOn_line
statement:
theorem tdSeriesOn_line (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) :
    tdSeriesOn ops cp hP X L =
      evSer (totalCapOn ops L hL) (CharacteristicClasses.toddLine ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  refine PowerSeries.ext fun n ↦ ?_
  rw [tdSeriesOn, evSer, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, tdOpOn_line L hL n]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.constantCoeff_toddLine
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_toddLine :
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff (CharacteristicClasses.toddLine ℚ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply]
  simp [CharacteristicClasses.toddLine, bernoulli'PowerSeries]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tdInvOpOn_line
statement:
theorem tdInvOpOn_line (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (n : ℕ) :
    tdInvOpOn ops cp hP X L n =
      ((-1 : ℚ) ^ n / ((n + 1).factorial : ℚ)) • totalCapOn ops L hL ^ n
proof:
:= by
  unfold tdInvOpOn
  rw [tdSeriesOn_line L hL, invOfUnit_evSer _ _ tdInvLine constantCoeff_toddLine
    toddLine_mul_tdInvLine, evSer, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, tdInvLine, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tdInvTot_line
statement:
theorem tdInvTot_line (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) :
    tdInvTot ops cp hP L = evTot (totalCapOn ops L hL) tdInvLine
proof:
:= by
  unfold tdInvTot evTot tot evSer
  congr 1
  funext n
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mk, tdInvOpOn_line L hL n, tdInvLine, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.chernData_constRank
statement:
theorem chernData_constRank (hW : WhitneyConstRankOn ops cp hP) {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ}
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    ChernData (M := fun i ↦ RationalDimChow X i) (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X E) where
  zero
proof:
:= cOp_zero_coeff ops cp hP hE
  low := fun i ↦ lowSub_of_loweringSub (cOp_lowering (hP := hP) hW hE i)
  comm := fun i j ↦ cOp_comm (hP := hP) hW hE hE i j

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.chFromChern_eq_chTot
statement:
theorem chFromChern_eq_chTot (hW : WhitneyConstRankOn ops cp hP) {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ}
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    Alg.chFromChern (M := fun i ↦ RationalDimChow X i) r (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X E) =
      chTot ops cp hP E
proof:
:= by
  rw [(chernData_constRank hW hE).chFromChern_eq_tot, chTot_eq_tot]
  congr 1
  refine PowerSeries.ext fun n ↦ ?_
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, chOpOn_eq hE, chOfChern_eq_chG]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tdFromChern_eq_tdTot
statement:
theorem tdFromChern_eq_tdTot (hW : WhitneyConstRankOn ops cp hP) {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ}
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    Alg.tdFromChern (M := fun i ↦ RationalDimChow X i) (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X E) =
      tdTot ops cp hP E
proof:
:= by
  rw [(chernData_constRank hW hE).tdFromChern_eq_tot, tdTot_eq_tot]
  congr 1
  refine PowerSeries.ext fun n ↦ ?_
  rw [tdSeriesOn, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, tdOpOn_eq hE, tdOfChern_eq_tdG]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tdInvFromChern_eq_tdInvTot
statement:
theorem tdInvFromChern_eq_tdInvTot (hW : WhitneyConstRankOn ops cp hP) {E : X.Modules}
    {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    Alg.tdInvFromChern (M := fun i ↦ RationalDimChow X i)
        (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X E) = tdInvTot ops cp hP E
proof:
:= by
  rw [(chernData_constRank hW hE).tdInvFromChern_eq_tot, tdInvTot_eq_tot]
  congr 2
  refine PowerSeries.ext fun n ↦ ?_
  rw [tdSeriesOn, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, tdOpOn_eq hE, tdOfChern_eq_tdG]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tdInvFromChern_dual_eq
statement:
theorem tdInvFromChern_dual_eq (hW : WhitneyConstRankOn ops cp hP) [Nonempty X]
    {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    Alg.tdInvFromChern (M := fun i ↦ RationalDimChow X i)
        (Alg.dualChern (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X E)) = tdInvDualTot ops cp hP E
proof:
:=
  (chernData_constRank hW hE).dual.tdInvFromChern_eq_tot

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tdDualTot_mul_tdInvDualTot
statement:
theorem tdDualTot_mul_tdInvDualTot (hW : WhitneyConstRankOn ops cp hP) [Nonempty X]
    {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    tdDualTot ops cp hP E * tdInvDualTot ops cp hP E = 1
proof:
:=
  (chernData_constRank (hP := hP) hW hE).dual.tot_td_mul_inv

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tdInvDualTot_mul_tdDualTot
statement:
theorem tdInvDualTot_mul_tdDualTot (hW : WhitneyConstRankOn ops cp hP) [Nonempty X]
    {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    tdInvDualTot ops cp hP E * tdDualTot ops cp hP E = 1
proof:
:=
  (chernData_constRank (hP := hP) hW hE).dual.tot_inv_mul_td

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechComplex_d_zero
statement:
theorem coordinateCechComplex_d_zero (M : (space k n).Modules) :
    ((coordinateCechComplexFunctor k n).obj M).d 0 1 =
      (coordinateCechCosimplicialObject k n M).δ (0 : Fin 2) -
        (coordinateCechCosimplicialObject k n M).δ (1 : Fin 2)
proof:
:= by
  change
    (∑ i : Fin 2, (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) •
      (coordinateCechCosimplicialObject k n M).δ i) = _
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, one_zsmul,
    Fin.val_one, pow_one, neg_zsmul, one_zsmul]
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex_d_zero

      (coordinateCechCosimplicialObject k n (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d)).δ
          (0 : Fin 2) -
        (coordinateCechCosimplicialObject k n (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d)).δ
          (1 : Fin 2)
proof:
:=
  coordinateCechComplex_d_zero k n (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingSheafHZeroEquivDegreePiece_factorization
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingSheafHZeroEquivDegreePiece_factorization
    (d : ℕ) (e : ProjectiveTwistingCechZeroComparison k n (d : ℤ)) :
    (projectiveTwistingSheafHZeroEquivCoordinateCechZeroCocycles k n (d : ℤ) e).trans
        (projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechZeroCocyclesEquivDegreePiece k n d e) =
      projectiveTwistingSheafHZeroEquivDegreePiece k n d

:= by
  apply AddEquiv.ext
  intro x
  simp [projectiveTwistingSheafHZeroEquivCoordinateCechZeroCocycles,
    projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechZeroCocyclesEquivDegreePiece,
    projectiveTwistingSheafHZeroEquivDegreePiece]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechMap_comp

theorem projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechMap_comp {d e r : ℤ}

      projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechMap k n f ≫
