name: GRRBlueprintV4.RG7.codim_eq_coheightA
statement:
theorem codim_eq_coheightA [IsIntegral X] :
    ARRKG2A.codim i.ker = (coheight (i (genericPoint X))).toNat
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIntegral i.ker.subscheme := integralZA i
  have hg : (phiXA i).hom (genericPoint X) = genericPoint i.ker.subscheme := by
    have h1 := (genericPoint_spec X).image (phiXA i).hom.continuous
    have h2 : closure ((phiXA i).hom '' (Set.univ : Set X)) = Set.univ := by
      rw [Set.image_univ_of_surjective (phiXA i).hom.surjective, closure_univ]
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1.eq (genericPoint_spec _)
  have hi : i (genericPoint X) =
      i.ker.subschemeι ((phiXA i).hom (genericPoint X)) := by
    calc i (genericPoint X) = ((phiXA i).hom ≫ i.ker.subschemeι) (genericPoint X) := by
          rw [phiXA_comp]
      _ = _ := Scheme.Hom.comp_apply _ _ _
  unfold ARRKG2A.codim ARRKG2A.iZ
  rw [hi, hg]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.mem_loweringSub
statement:
theorem mem_loweringSub {n : ℕ} {T : Module.End ℚ (TotalChow X)} :
    T ∈ loweringSub X n ↔ ∀ (m : ℕ) (z : RationalDimChow X m) (j : ℕ), j + n ≠ m →
      T (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun i ↦ RationalDimChow X i) m z) j = 0
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.lowering_apply_support
proof:
:= by
  rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_of v, map_sum]
  change (DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun i ↦ RationalDimChow X i) j)
      (∑ i ∈ DFinsupp.support v, T (DirectSum.of (fun i ↦ RationalDimChow X i) i (v i))) = 0
  rw [map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i hi ↦ ?_
  have hi' : v i ≠ 0 := DFinsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hi
  have hib : i + b = m := by
    by_contra hc
    exact hi' (hv i hc)
  exact hT i (v i) j (by omega)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.totalPullOn_lof
statement:
theorem totalPullOn_lof {Y : Scheme.{u}} [Y.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian Y] [Fact (Cl X)] [Fact (Cl Y)] (ops : ChowOpsOn Cl) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat f] (d : ℕ) (hd : PureRelDim f d) (m : ℕ) (z : RationalDimChow Y m) :
    totalPullOn ops f d hd (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun i ↦ RationalDimChow Y i) m z) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun i ↦ RationalDimChow X i) (m + d) (ops.pull f d hd m z)
proof:
:= by
  simp [totalPullOn]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.totalPullOn_apply_add
statement:
theorem totalPullOn_apply_add {Y : Scheme.{u}} [Y.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian Y] [Fact (Cl X)] [Fact (Cl Y)] (ops : ChowOpsOn Cl) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat f] (d : ℕ) (hd : PureRelDim f d) (v : TotalChow Y) (j : ℕ) :
    totalPullOn ops f d hd v (j + d) = ops.pull f d hd j (v j)
proof:
:= by
  induction v using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of i x =>
    have h1 : totalPullOn ops f d hd (DirectSum.of (fun i ↦ RationalDimChow Y i) i x) =
        DirectSum.of (fun i ↦ RationalDimChow X i) (i + d) (ops.pull f d hd i x) :=
      totalPullOn_lof ops f d hd i x
    rw [h1]
    by_cases h : i = j
    · subst h
      rw [DirectSum.of_eq_same, DirectSum.of_eq_same]
    · rw [DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (by omega), DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (fun e ↦ h e.symm),
        map_zero]
  | add x y hx hy => simp [hx, hy]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.eq_of_pull_eq
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro α
  exact hinj (h α)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.pull_component_injective
statement:
theorem pull_component_injective (hinj : Function.Injective (totalPullOn ops g d hd)) (j : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (ops.pull g d hd j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro z hz
  have h0 : totalPullOn ops g d hd (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun i ↦ RationalDimChow X i) j z) = 0 := by
    rw [totalPullOn_lof, hz, map_zero]
  have := hinj (h0.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  have h2 := congrArg (fun w : TotalChow X ↦ w j) this
  simpa [DirectSum.lof_eq_of] using h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.descent_lowering
proof:
:= by
  intro m z j hj
  have e := LinearMap.congr_fun h (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun i ↦ RationalDimChow X i) m z)
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at e
  rw [totalPullOn_lof] at e
  have e2 := totalPullOn_apply_add ops g d hd
    (T (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun i ↦ RationalDimChow X i) m z)) j
  rw [e, hT' (m + d) _ (j + d) (by omega)] at e2
  have := pull_component_injective ops g d hd hinj j
  exact this (by rw [← e2]; simp)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.descent_zero
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_of_pull_eq ops g d hd hinj
  intro α
  have := LinearMap.congr_fun h α
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at this
  rw [this, hT']
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.chernOfCoverOn_zero_coeff
statement:
theorem chernOfCoverOn_zero_coeff {E : X.Modules} {e : ℕ} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    [Fact (Cl C.scheme)] (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = e + 1) :
    chernOfCoverOn ops C cp hC 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold chernOfCoverOn
  have h := PowerSeries.constantCoeff_invOfUnit (segreSeriesOn ops C cp hC) 1
  rw [pow_zero, one_smul, PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, h]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.chernOpOn'_zero_coeff
statement:
theorem chernOpOn'_zero_coeff (E : X.Modules) (r : ℕ) (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    chernOpOn' ops cp hP E r hE 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  cases r with
  | zero => simp [chernOpOn']
  | succ r =>
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hE
    haveI : Fact (Cl C.scheme) := ⟨hP C hC⟩
    rw [chernOpOn'_eq_chernOfCoverOn ops cp hP C hE hC]
    exact chernOfCoverOn_zero_coeff ops cp C hC

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.cOp_zero_coeff
statement:
theorem cOp_zero_coeff [Nonempty X] {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X E 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [constRankChernAssignOn'_eq ops cp hP E r hE]
  exact chernOpOn'_zero_coeff ops cp hP E r hE

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.cOp_rank_zero
statement:
theorem cOp_rank_zero [Nonempty X] {E : X.Modules} (hE : HasConstantRank X E 0) (i : ℕ) :
    constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X E i = if i = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [constRankChernAssignOn'_eq ops cp hP E 0 hE]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.cOp_line
statement:
theorem cOp_line [Nonempty X] (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (i : ℕ) :
    constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X L i =
      if i = 0 then 1 else if i = 1 then totalCapOn ops L hL else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [constRankChernAssignOn'_eq ops cp hP L 1 hL, chernOpOn'_line_series ops cp hP L hL]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.cOp_iso
statement:
theorem cOp_iso [Nonempty X] {E E' : X.Modules} (e : E ≅ E') (n : ℕ) :
    constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X E n = constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X E' n
proof:
:=
  congrFun (constRankChernAssignOn'_iso ops cp hP e) n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.cOp_flat
statement:
theorem cOp_flat {Y : Scheme.{u}} [Y.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian Y] [Fact (Cl Y)] [Nonempty X] [Nonempty Y] (g : X ⟶ Y) [g.IsOver (Spk k)]
    [Flat g] (d : ℕ) (hd : PureRelDim g d) (E : Y.Modules) {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank Y E r)
    (n : ℕ) :
    totalPullOn ops g d hd ∘ₗ constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP Y E n =
      constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E) n ∘ₗ
        totalPullOn ops g d hd
proof:
:=
  flatNaturalConstRankOn_constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP g d hd E r hE n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.hasConstantRank_middle
proof:
:= by
  have hB : IsFiniteLocallyFree X B :=
    isFiniteLocallyFree_middle_E9 (ShortComplex.mk a b w) h hA.isFiniteLocallyFree
      hD.isFiniteLocallyFree
  refine hasConstantRank_of_pointwise_rank B hB _ fun x ↦ ?_
  rw [rankAt_add x w h hA.isFiniteLocallyFree hD.isFiniteLocallyFree,
    rankAt_of_hasConstantRank hA, rankAt_of_hasConstantRank hD]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.hasConstantRank_unique
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_unique [Nonempty X] {E : X.Modules} {r s : ℕ}
    (hr : HasConstantRank X E r) (hs : HasConstantRank X E s) : r = s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x⟩ := ‹Nonempty X›
  exact (rankAt_of_hasConstantRank hr x).symm.trans (rankAt_of_hasConstantRank hs x)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.totalCapOn_mem_capAlg
statement:
theorem totalCapOn_mem_capAlg (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) :
    totalCapOn ops L hL ∈ capAlg ops X
proof:
:=
  Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨L, hL, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.capSet_comm
statement:
theorem capSet_comm (cp : ChowCompatOn ops) :
    ∀ x ∈ capSet ops X, ∀ y ∈ capSet ops X, x * y = y * x
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨L, hL, rfl⟩ _ ⟨M, hM, rfl⟩
  exact cp.cap_comm L M hL hM

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.capAlg_comm
statement:
theorem capAlg_comm (cp : ChowCompatOn ops) {x y : Module.End ℚ (TotalChow X)}
    (hx : x ∈ capAlg ops X) (hy : y ∈ capAlg ops X) : x * y = y * x
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∀ z ∈ capSet ops X, Commute z y := fun z hz ↦
    Algebra.commute_of_mem_adjoin_of_forall_mem_commute hy fun w hw ↦ capSet_comm ops cp z hz w hw
  have h2 : Commute y x :=
    Algebra.commute_of_mem_adjoin_of_forall_mem_commute hx fun z hz ↦ (h1 z hz).symm
  exact h2.symm.eq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.totalCapOn_mem_lowering
statement:
theorem totalCapOn_mem_lowering (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) :
    totalCapOn ops L hL ∈ loweringSub X 1
proof:
:= by
  intro m z j hj
  cases m with
  | zero => rw [totalCapOn_lof_zero_of_eq ops L hL rfl z]; rfl
  | succ m =>
    rw [totalCapOn_lof_succ_of_eq ops L hL rfl z z HEq.rfl, DirectSum.lof_eq_of]
    exact DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne m j _ (by omega)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.pull_capAlg
statement:
theorem pull_capAlg {Y : Scheme.{u}} [Y.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian Y] [Fact (Cl Y)] (cp : ChowCompatOn ops) (g : Y ⟶ X) [g.IsOver (Spk k)]
    [Flat g] (d : ℕ) (hd : PureRelDim g d) {a : Module.End ℚ (TotalChow X)}
    (ha : a ∈ capAlg ops X) :
    ∃ a' ∈ capAlg ops Y, totalPullOn ops g d hd ∘ₗ a = a' ∘ₗ totalPullOn ops g d hd
proof:
:= by
  induction ha using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨L, hL, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨_, totalCapOn_mem_capAlg ops _ (hasConstantRank_pullback Y g L 1 hL),
      cp.cap_pull g d hd L hL⟩
  | algebraMap r =>
    refine ⟨algebraMap ℚ _ r, Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ r, ?_⟩
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro v
    simp [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨x', hx', ex⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨y', hy', ey⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨x' + y', Subalgebra.add_mem _ hx' hy', by
      rw [LinearMap.comp_add, LinearMap.add_comp, ex, ey]⟩
  | mul x y _ _ hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨x', hx', ex⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨y', hy', ey⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨x' * y', Subalgebra.mul_mem _ hx' hy', ?_⟩
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro v
    have e1 := LinearMap.congr_fun ex (y v)
    have e2 := LinearMap.congr_fun ey v
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Module.End.mul_apply] at e1 e2 ⊢
    rw [e1, e2]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.filtration_rank
statement:
theorem filtration_rank {E : X.Modules} {e : ℕ} (S : ChowSplittingOn ops E e) :
    ∀ i ≤ e, HasConstantRank S.Y (S.F i) (i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    intro _
    obtain ⟨e0⟩ := S.base
    exact hasConstantRank_of_iso e0.symm (S.L_line 0)
  | succ i ih =>
    intro hi
    obtain ⟨a, b, w, h⟩ := S.step i (by omega)
    exact hasConstantRank_middle h (ih (by omega)) (S.L_line (i + 1))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.cOp_line_props
statement:
theorem cOp_line_props [Nonempty X] (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (n : ℕ) :
    constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X L n ∈ capAlg ops X ∧
      constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X L n ∈ loweringSub X n ∧
      (1 < n → constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X L n = 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cOp_line ops cp hP L hL n]
  by_cases h0 : n = 0
  · subst h0
    exact ⟨Subalgebra.one_mem _, (loweringFam X).one_mem, fun h ↦ absurd h (by omega)⟩
  · by_cases h1 : n = 1
    · subst h1
      exact ⟨by simpa using totalCapOn_mem_capAlg ops L hL,
        by simpa using totalCapOn_mem_lowering ops L hL, fun h ↦ absurd h (by omega)⟩
    · refine ⟨?_, ?_, fun _ ↦ by simp [h0, h1]⟩ <;> simp [h0, h1]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.filtration_props
statement:
theorem filtration_props [Nonempty X] {E : X.Modules} {e : ℕ} (S : ChowSplittingOn ops E e) :
    ∀ i ≤ e, ∀ n, constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP S.Y (S.F i) n ∈ capAlg ops S.Y ∧
      constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP S.Y (S.F i) n ∈ loweringSub S.Y n ∧
      (i + 1 < n → constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP S.Y (S.F i) n = 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    intro _ n
    obtain ⟨e0⟩ := S.base
    rw [cOp_iso ops cp hP e0 n]
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := cOp_line_props (ops := ops) (cp := cp) (hP := hP) (S.L 0)
      (S.L_line 0) n
    exact ⟨h1, h2, fun h ↦ h3 (by omega)⟩
  | succ i ih =>
    intro hi n
    obtain ⟨a, b, w, h⟩ := S.step i (by omega)
    have hA := filtration_rank S i (by omega)
    have hD := S.L_line (i + 1)
    have hconv := hW a b w h hA hD n
    rw [hconv]
    refine ⟨Subalgebra.sum_mem _ fun p _ ↦ ?_, Submodule.sum_mem _ fun p hp ↦ ?_, fun hn ↦ ?_⟩
    · exact (capAlg ops S.Y).mul_mem (ih (by omega) p.1).1
        (cOp_line_props (ops := ops) (cp := cp) (hP := hP) (S.L (i + 1)) hD p.2).1
    · have := (loweringFam S.Y).mul_mem (ih (by omega) p.1).2.1
        (cOp_line_props (ops := ops) (cp := cp) (hP := hP) (S.L (i + 1)) hD p.2).2.1
      rw [Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp] at this
      exact this
    · refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun p hp ↦ ?_
      have hp' := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp
      by_cases h2 : 1 < p.2
      · rw [(cOp_line_props (ops := ops) (cp := cp) (hP := hP) (S.L (i + 1)) hD p.2).2.2 h2]
        exact LinearMap.comp_zero _
      · rw [(ih (by omega) p.1).2.2 (by omega)]
        exact LinearMap.zero_comp _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.descent_cOp
statement:
theorem descent_cOp [Nonempty X] {E : X.Modules} {e : ℕ} (S : ChowSplittingOn ops E e)
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E (e + 1)) (n : ℕ) :
    totalPullOn ops S.q S.d S.hd ∘ₗ constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X E n =
      constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP S.Y (S.F e) n ∘ₗ totalPullOn ops S.q S.d S.hd
proof:
:= by
  rw [cOp_flat ops cp hP S.q S.d S.hd E hE n]
  obtain ⟨φ⟩ := S.top
  rw [cOp_iso ops cp hP φ.symm n]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.cOp_vanish
statement:
theorem cOp_vanish [Nonempty X] {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : r < n) : constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X E n = 0
proof:
:= by
  cases r with
  | zero =>
    rw [cOp_rank_zero ops cp hP hE n, if_neg (by omega)]
  | succ e =>
    obtain ⟨S⟩ := exists_chowSplittingOn ops cp hP e E hE
    refine descent_zero ops S.q S.d S.hd S.injective (descent_cOp hW S hE n) ?_
    exact (filtration_props hW S e le_rfl n).2.2 hn

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.cOp_lowering
statement:
theorem cOp_lowering [Nonempty X] {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) (n : ℕ) :
    constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X E n ∈ loweringSub X n
proof:
:= by
  cases r with
  | zero =>
    rw [cOp_rank_zero ops cp hP hE n]
    by_cases h : n = 0
    · subst h; rw [if_pos rfl]; exact (loweringFam X).one_mem
    · rw [if_neg h]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | succ e =>
    obtain ⟨S⟩ := exists_chowSplittingOn ops cp hP e E hE
    exact descent_lowering ops S.q S.d S.hd S.injective (descent_cOp hW S hE n)
      (filtration_props hW S e le_rfl n).2.1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.capAlg_commute_cOp
statement:
theorem capAlg_commute_cOp [Nonempty X] {F : X.Modules} {s : ℕ} (hF : HasConstantRank X F s)
    {a : Module.End ℚ (TotalChow X)} (ha : a ∈ capAlg ops X) (j : ℕ) :
    a * constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X F j = constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X F j * a
proof:
:= by
  cases s with
  | zero =>
    rw [cOp_rank_zero ops cp hP hF j]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  | succ f =>
    obtain ⟨S⟩ := exists_chowSplittingOn ops cp hP f F hF
    obtain ⟨a', ha', hpa⟩ := pull_capAlg ops cp S.q S.d S.hd ha
    have hb := (filtration_props (hP := hP) hW S f le_rfl j).1
    have hd := descent_cOp (hP := hP) hW S hF j
    apply eq_of_pull_eq ops S.q S.d S.hd S.injective
    intro α
    have e1 := LinearMap.congr_fun hpa
      (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X F j α)
    have e2 := LinearMap.congr_fun hd (a α)
    have e3 := LinearMap.congr_fun hd α
    have e4 := LinearMap.congr_fun hpa α
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at e1 e2 e3 e4
    simp only [Module.End.mul_apply]
    rw [e1, e3, e2, e4]
    have := capAlg_comm ops cp ha' hb
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun this (totalPullOn ops S.q S.d S.hd α)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.cOp_comm
statement:
theorem cOp_comm [Nonempty X] {E F : X.Modules} {r s : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r)
    (hF : HasConstantRank X F s) (i j : ℕ) :
    constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X E i * constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X F j =
      constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X F j * constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X E i
proof:
:= by
  cases r with
  | zero =>
    rw [cOp_rank_zero ops cp hP hE i]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  | succ e =>
    obtain ⟨S⟩ := exists_chowSplittingOn ops cp hP e E hE
    have ha := (filtration_props (hP := hP) hW S e le_rfl i).1
    have hF' := hasConstantRank_pullback S.Y S.q F s hF
    have hcomm := capAlg_commute_cOp (hP := hP) hW hF' ha j
    have hdE := descent_cOp (hP := hP) hW S hE i
    have hdF := cOp_flat ops cp hP S.q S.d S.hd F hF j
    apply eq_of_pull_eq ops S.q S.d S.hd S.injective
    intro α
    have e1 := LinearMap.congr_fun hdE
      (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X F j α)
    have e2 := LinearMap.congr_fun hdF (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X E i α)
    have e3 := LinearMap.congr_fun hdE α
    have e4 := LinearMap.congr_fun hdF α
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at e1 e2 e3 e4
    simp only [Module.End.mul_apply]
    rw [e1, e4, e2, e3]
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun hcomm _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.chOpOn_eq
statement:
theorem chOpOn_eq [Nonempty X] {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    chOpOn ops cp hP X E = chOfChern r (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X E)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∃ r, Nonempty (HasConstantRank X E r) := ⟨r, ⟨hE⟩⟩
  unfold chOpOn
  rw [dif_pos h]
  have hr : h.choose = r := hasConstantRank_unique h.choose_spec.some hE
  rw [hr]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.tdOpOn_eq
statement:
theorem tdOpOn_eq {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    tdOpOn ops cp hP X E = tdOfChern (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X E)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∃ r, Nonempty (HasConstantRank X E r) := ⟨r, ⟨hE⟩⟩
  unfold tdOpOn
  rw [dif_pos h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.chOpOn_zero
statement:
theorem chOpOn_zero [Nonempty X] {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    chOpOn ops cp hP X E 0 = (r : ℚ) • 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [chOpOn_eq hE]; rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.tdOpOn_zero
statement:
theorem tdOpOn_zero {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    tdOpOn ops cp hP X E 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [tdOpOn_eq hE]
  simp [tdOfChern]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.chOpOn_line
statement:
theorem chOpOn_line [Nonempty X] (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (n : ℕ) :
    chOpOn ops cp hP X L n = (1 / (n.factorial : ℚ)) • totalCapOn ops L hL ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [chOpOn_eq hL]
  have : constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X L =
      fun i ↦ if i = 0 then 1 else if i = 1 then totalCapOn ops L hL else 0 :=
    funext (cOp_line ops cp hP L hL)
  rw [this]
  exact chOfChern_line _ n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.tdOpOn_line
statement:
theorem tdOpOn_line [Nonempty X] (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (n : ℕ) :
    tdOpOn ops cp hP X L n =
      PowerSeries.coeff n (CharacteristicClasses.toddLine ℚ) • totalCapOn ops L hL ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [tdOpOn_eq hL]
  have : constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X L =
      fun i ↦ if i = 0 then 1 else if i = 1 then totalCapOn ops L hL else 0 :=
    funext (cOp_line ops cp hP L hL)
  rw [this]
  exact tdOfChern_line _ n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.chOpOn_iso
statement:
theorem chOpOn_iso [Nonempty X] {E E' : X.Modules} (e : E ≅ E') :
    chOpOn ops cp hP X E = chOpOn ops cp hP X E'
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : ∃ r, Nonempty (HasConstantRank X E r)
  · obtain ⟨r, ⟨hE⟩⟩ := h
    have hE' := hasConstantRank_of_iso e hE
    rw [chOpOn_eq hE, chOpOn_eq hE', constRankChernAssignOn'_iso ops cp hP e]
  · have h' : ¬ ∃ r, Nonempty (HasConstantRank X E' r) := fun ⟨r, ⟨hE'⟩⟩ ↦
      h ⟨r, ⟨hasConstantRank_of_iso e.symm hE'⟩⟩
    unfold chOpOn
    rw [dif_neg h, dif_neg h']

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.tdOpOn_iso
statement:
theorem tdOpOn_iso [Nonempty X] {E E' : X.Modules} (e : E ≅ E') :
    tdOpOn ops cp hP X E = tdOpOn ops cp hP X E'
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : ∃ r, Nonempty (HasConstantRank X E r)
  · obtain ⟨r, ⟨hE⟩⟩ := h
    have hE' := hasConstantRank_of_iso e hE
    rw [tdOpOn_eq hE, tdOpOn_eq hE', constRankChernAssignOn'_iso ops cp hP e]
  · have h' : ¬ ∃ r, Nonempty (HasConstantRank X E' r) := fun ⟨r, ⟨hE'⟩⟩ ↦
      h ⟨r, ⟨hasConstantRank_of_iso e.symm hE'⟩⟩
    unfold tdOpOn
    rw [dif_neg h, dif_neg h']

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.chOpOn_flat
statement:
theorem chOpOn_flat {Y : Scheme.{u}} [Y.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian Y] [Fact (Cl Y)] [Nonempty X] [Nonempty Y] (g : X ⟶ Y) [g.IsOver (Spk k)]
    [Flat g] (d : ℕ) (hd : PureRelDim g d) (E : Y.Modules) {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank Y E r)
    (n : ℕ) :
    totalPullOn ops g d hd ∘ₗ chOpOn ops cp hP Y E n =
      chOpOn ops cp hP X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E) n ∘ₗ totalPullOn ops g d hd
proof:
:= by
  rw [chOpOn_eq hE, chOpOn_eq (hasConstantRank_pullback X g E r hE), chOfChern_eq_chG,
    chOfChern_eq_chG]
  exact chG_inter (fun i ↦ cOp_flat ops cp hP g d hd E hE i) r n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.tdOpOn_flat
statement:
theorem tdOpOn_flat {Y : Scheme.{u}} [Y.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian Y] [Fact (Cl Y)] [Nonempty X] [Nonempty Y] (g : X ⟶ Y) [g.IsOver (Spk k)]
    [Flat g] (d : ℕ) (hd : PureRelDim g d) (E : Y.Modules) {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank Y E r)
    (n : ℕ) :
    totalPullOn ops g d hd ∘ₗ tdOpOn ops cp hP Y E n =
      tdOpOn ops cp hP X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E) n ∘ₗ totalPullOn ops g d hd
proof:
:= by
  rw [tdOpOn_eq hE, tdOpOn_eq (hasConstantRank_pullback X g E r hE), tdOfChern_eq_tdG,
    tdOfChern_eq_tdG]
  exact tdG_inter (fun i ↦ cOp_flat ops cp hP g d hd E hE i) n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.convData
statement:
theorem convData [Nonempty X] {A B D : X.Modules} (a : A ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ D) (w : a ≫ b = 0)
    (h : (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact) {r s : ℕ} (hA : HasConstantRank X A r)
    (hD : HasConstantRank X D s) :
    ConvData (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X A) (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X D)
      (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X B) where
  A0
proof:
:= cOp_zero_coeff ops cp hP hA
  D0 := cOp_zero_coeff ops cp hP hD
  AA := cOp_comm hW hA hA
  DD := cOp_comm hW hD hD
  AD := cOp_comm hW hA hD
  conv := fun n ↦ hW a b w h hA hD n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.chOpOn_additive
statement:
theorem chOpOn_additive [Nonempty X] {A B D : X.Modules} (a : A ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ D)
    (w : a ≫ b = 0) (h : (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact) {r s : ℕ}
    (hA : HasConstantRank X A r) (hD : HasConstantRank X D s) (n : ℕ) :
    chOpOn ops cp hP X B n = chOpOn ops cp hP X A n + chOpOn ops cp hP X D n
proof:
:= by
  have hB := hasConstantRank_middle h hA hD
  rw [chOpOn_eq hB, chOpOn_eq hA, chOpOn_eq hD, chOfChern_eq_chG, chOfChern_eq_chG,
    chOfChern_eq_chG]
  exact (convData hW a b w h hA hD).ch r s n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.tdOpOn_mult
statement:
theorem tdOpOn_mult [Nonempty X] {A B D : X.Modules} (a : A ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ D)
    (w : a ≫ b = 0) (h : (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact) {r s : ℕ}
    (hA : HasConstantRank X A r) (hD : HasConstantRank X D s) (n : ℕ) :
    tdOpOn ops cp hP X B n =
      ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, tdOpOn ops cp hP X A p.1 ∘ₗ tdOpOn ops cp hP X D p.2
proof:
:= by
  have hB := hasConstantRank_middle h hA hD
  rw [tdOpOn_eq hB, tdOfChern_eq_tdG, (convData hW a b w h hA hD).td n]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ ↦ ?_
  rw [tdOpOn_eq hA, tdOpOn_eq hD, tdOfChern_eq_tdG, tdOfChern_eq_tdG]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.chOpOn_directSum
proof:
:=
  chOpOn_additive hW biprod.inl biprod.snd (by simp)
    (ShortComplex.Splitting.ofHasBinaryBiproduct A D).shortExact hA hD n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.tdOpOn_directSum
statement:
theorem tdOpOn_directSum [Nonempty X] {A D : X.Modules} {r s : ℕ}
    (hA : HasConstantRank X A r) (hD : HasConstantRank X D s) (n : ℕ) :
    tdOpOn ops cp hP X (A ⊞ D) n =
      ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, tdOpOn ops cp hP X A p.1 ∘ₗ tdOpOn ops cp hP X D p.2
proof:
:=
  tdOpOn_mult hW biprod.inl biprod.snd (by simp)
    (ShortComplex.Splitting.ofHasBinaryBiproduct A D).shortExact hA hD n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.chOpOn_comm_cOp
statement:
theorem chOpOn_comm_cOp [Nonempty X] {E F : X.Modules} {r s : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r)
    (hF : HasConstantRank X F s) (n j : ℕ) :
    constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X F j * chOpOn ops cp hP X E n =
      chOpOn ops cp hP X E n * constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X F j
proof:
:= by
  rw [chOpOn_eq hE, chOfChern_eq_chG]
  exact chG_commute _ _ (fun i ↦ cOp_comm hW hF hE j i) r n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.tdOpOn_comm_cOp
statement:
theorem tdOpOn_comm_cOp [Nonempty X] {E F : X.Modules} {r s : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r)
    (hF : HasConstantRank X F s) (n j : ℕ) :
    constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X F j * tdOpOn ops cp hP X E n =
      tdOpOn ops cp hP X E n * constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X F j
proof:
:= by
  rw [tdOpOn_eq hE, tdOfChern_eq_tdG]
  exact tdG_commute _ _ (fun i ↦ cOp_comm hW hF hE j i) n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.chOpOn_comm
statement:
theorem chOpOn_comm [Nonempty X] {E F : X.Modules} {r s : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r)
    (hF : HasConstantRank X F s) (n m : ℕ) :
    chOpOn ops cp hP X E n * chOpOn ops cp hP X F m =
      chOpOn ops cp hP X F m * chOpOn ops cp hP X E n
proof:
:= by
  rw [chOpOn_eq hF, chOfChern_eq_chG]
  exact chG_commute _ _ (fun i ↦ (chOpOn_comm_cOp hW hE hF n i).symm) s m

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.tdOpOn_comm
statement:
theorem tdOpOn_comm [Nonempty X] {E F : X.Modules} {r s : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r)
    (hF : HasConstantRank X F s) (n m : ℕ) :
    tdOpOn ops cp hP X E n * tdOpOn ops cp hP X F m =
      tdOpOn ops cp hP X F m * tdOpOn ops cp hP X E n
proof:
:= by
  rw [tdOpOn_eq hF, tdOfChern_eq_tdG]
  exact tdG_commute _ _ (fun i ↦ (tdOpOn_comm_cOp hW hE hF n i).symm) m

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.chOpOn_lowering
statement:
theorem chOpOn_lowering [Nonempty X] {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r)
    (n : ℕ) : chOpOn ops cp hP X E n ∈ loweringSub X n
proof:
:= by
  rw [chOpOn_eq hE, chOfChern_eq_chG]
  exact chG_mem (𝒢 := loweringFam X) (fun i ↦ cOp_lowering hW hE i) r n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.tdOpOn_lowering
statement:
theorem tdOpOn_lowering [Nonempty X] {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r)
    (n : ℕ) : tdOpOn ops cp hP X E n ∈ loweringSub X n
proof:
:= by
  rw [tdOpOn_eq hE, tdOfChern_eq_tdG]
  exact tdG_mem (𝒢 := loweringFam X) (fun i ↦ cOp_lowering hW hE i) n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.chOpOn_lof_eq_zero
statement:
theorem chOpOn_lof_eq_zero [Nonempty X] {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r)
    {n m : ℕ} (hnm : m < n) (z : RationalDimChow X m) :
    chOpOn ops cp hP X E n (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun i ↦ RationalDimChow X i) m z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply DFinsupp.ext
  intro j
  exact chOpOn_lowering hW hE n m z j (by omega)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.tdOpOn_lof_eq_zero
statement:
theorem tdOpOn_lof_eq_zero [Nonempty X] {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r)
    {n m : ℕ} (hnm : m < n) (z : RationalDimChow X m) :
    tdOpOn ops cp hP X E n (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun i ↦ RationalDimChow X i) m z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply DFinsupp.ext
  intro j
  exact tdOpOn_lowering hW hE n m z j (by omega)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.constantCoeff_tdSeriesOn
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_tdSeriesOn {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff (tdSeriesOn ops cp hP X E) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, tdSeriesOn, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
  exact tdOpOn_zero hE

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.tdSeriesOn_mul_inv
statement:
theorem tdSeriesOn_mul_inv {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    tdSeriesOn ops cp hP X E * PowerSeries.invOfUnit (tdSeriesOn ops cp hP X E) 1 = 1
proof:
:=
  PowerSeries.mul_invOfUnit _ 1 (by simpa using constantCoeff_tdSeriesOn hE)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.tdSeriesOn_inv_mul
statement:
theorem tdSeriesOn_inv_mul {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    PowerSeries.invOfUnit (tdSeriesOn ops cp hP X E) 1 * tdSeriesOn ops cp hP X E = 1
proof:
:=
  PowerSeries.invOfUnit_mul _ 1 (by simpa using constantCoeff_tdSeriesOn hE)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.tdOpOn_conv_tdInvOpOn
statement:
theorem tdOpOn_conv_tdInvOpOn {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, tdOpOn ops cp hP X E p.1 * tdInvOpOn ops cp hP X E p.2 =
      if n = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (PowerSeries.coeff n) (tdSeriesOn_mul_inv (ops := ops) (cp := cp) (hP := hP) hE)
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_one] at this
  simpa [tdSeriesOn, tdInvOpOn] using this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.tdInvOpOn_conv_tdOpOn
statement:
theorem tdInvOpOn_conv_tdOpOn {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, tdInvOpOn ops cp hP X E p.1 * tdOpOn ops cp hP X E p.2 =
      if n = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (PowerSeries.coeff n) (tdSeriesOn_inv_mul (ops := ops) (cp := cp) (hP := hP) hE)
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_one] at this
  simpa [tdSeriesOn, tdInvOpOn] using this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.tdInvOpOn_lowering
statement:
theorem tdInvOpOn_lowering [Nonempty X] {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r)
    (n : ℕ) : tdInvOpOn ops cp hP X E n ∈ loweringSub X n
proof:
:=
  GSer.inv (𝒢 := loweringFam X) (c := tdOpOn ops cp hP X E)
    (fun i ↦ tdOpOn_lowering hW hE i) n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.tdInvOpOn_mult
statement:
theorem tdInvOpOn_mult [Nonempty X] {A B D : X.Modules} (a : A ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ D)
    (w : a ≫ b = 0) (h : (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact) {r s : ℕ}
    (hA : HasConstantRank X A r) (hD : HasConstantRank X D s) (n : ℕ) :
    tdInvOpOn ops cp hP X B n =
      ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, tdInvOpOn ops cp hP X D p.1 * tdInvOpOn ops cp hP X A p.2
proof:
:= by
  have hser : tdSeriesOn ops cp hP X B = tdSeriesOn ops cp hP X A * tdSeriesOn ops cp hP X D := by
    refine PowerSeries.ext fun m ↦ ?_
    rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
    simp only [tdSeriesOn, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
    exact tdOpOn_mult hW a b w h hA hD m
  unfold tdInvOpOn
  rw [hser, invOfUnit_mul_ring _ _ (by simpa using constantCoeff_tdSeriesOn hA)
    (by simpa using constantCoeff_tdSeriesOn hD), PowerSeries.coeff_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.IsNaturalCharCR.eq_of_splitting
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t⟩ := S.top
  have htop : φ S.Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj E) =
      ψ S.Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj E) := by
    rw [← hφ.iso ⟨t⟩, ← hψ.iso ⟨t⟩]; exact hY
  funext n
  apply eq_of_pull_eq ops S.q S.d S.hd S.injective
  intro α
  have h1 := LinearMap.congr_fun (hφ.natural S.q S.d S.hd E (e + 1) hE n) α
  have h2 := LinearMap.congr_fun (hψ.natural S.q S.d S.hd E (e + 1) hE n) α
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at h1 h2
  rw [h1, h2, htop]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.IsAdditiveCharCR.unique
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ i ≤ e, φ S.Y (S.F i) = ψ S.Y (S.F i) := by
    intro i
    induction i with
    | zero =>
      intro _
      obtain ⟨e0⟩ := S.base
      rw [hφ.iso ⟨e0⟩, hψ.iso ⟨e0⟩, hφ.line _ (S.L_line 0), hψ.line _ (S.L_line 0)]
    | succ i ih =>
      intro hi
      obtain ⟨a, b, w, hS⟩ := S.step i (by omega)
      funext n
      rw [hφ.additive a b w hS (filtration_rank S i (by omega)) (S.L_line (i + 1)) n,
        hψ.additive a b w hS (filtration_rank S i (by omega)) (S.L_line (i + 1)) n,
        ih (by omega), hφ.line _ (S.L_line (i + 1)), hψ.line _ (S.L_line (i + 1))]
  exact hφ.toIsNaturalCharCR.eq_of_splitting hψ.toIsNaturalCharCR hE S (key e le_rfl)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.IsMultiplicativeCharCR.unique
statement:
theorem IsMultiplicativeCharCR.unique {φ ψ : CharAssignOn Cl} {lv : LineValCR Cl}
    (hφ : IsMultiplicativeCharCR ops φ lv) (hψ : IsMultiplicativeCharCR ops ψ lv)
    {E : X.Modules} {e : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E (e + 1)) (S : ChowSplittingOn ops E e) :
    φ X E = ψ X E
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ i ≤ e, φ S.Y (S.F i) = ψ S.Y (S.F i) := by
    intro i
    induction i with
    | zero =>
      intro _
      obtain ⟨e0⟩ := S.base
      rw [hφ.iso ⟨e0⟩, hψ.iso ⟨e0⟩, hφ.line _ (S.L_line 0), hψ.line _ (S.L_line 0)]
    | succ i ih =>
      intro hi
      obtain ⟨a, b, w, hS⟩ := S.step i (by omega)
      funext n
      rw [hφ.mult a b w hS (filtration_rank S i (by omega)) (S.L_line (i + 1)) n,
        hψ.mult a b w hS (filtration_rank S i (by omega)) (S.L_line (i + 1)) n,
        ih (by omega), hφ.line _ (S.L_line (i + 1)), hψ.line _ (S.L_line (i + 1))]
  exact hφ.toIsNaturalCharCR.eq_of_splitting hψ.toIsNaturalCharCR hE S (key e le_rfl)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.IsAdditiveCharCR.unique_of_hasConstantRank
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S⟩ := exists_chowSplittingOn ops cp hP e E hE
  exact hφ.unique hψ hE S

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.IsMultiplicativeCharCR.unique_of_hasConstantRank
statement:
theorem IsMultiplicativeCharCR.unique_of_hasConstantRank (cp : ChowCompatOn ops)
    (hP : ProjBundleClosedPos Cl) {φ ψ : CharAssignOn Cl} {lv : LineValCR Cl}
    (hφ : IsMultiplicativeCharCR ops φ lv) (hψ : IsMultiplicativeCharCR ops ψ lv)
    {E : X.Modules} {e : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E (e + 1)) : φ X E = ψ X E
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S⟩ := exists_chowSplittingOn ops cp hP e E hE
  exact hφ.unique hψ hE S

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.cOp_isNaturalCR
statement:
theorem cOp_isNaturalCR :
    IsNaturalCharCR ops (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP) (chernLineValCR ops) where
  natural
proof:
:= flatNaturalConstRankOn_constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP
  iso := fun {_} _ _ _ _ _ {E E'} h ↦ by
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := h
    exact constRankChernAssignOn'_iso ops cp hP e
  line := fun {_} _ _ _ _ _ L hL ↦ funext (cOp_line ops cp hP L hL)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.chOpOn_isNaturalCR
statement:
theorem chOpOn_isNaturalCR :
    IsNaturalCharCR ops (chOpOn ops cp hP) (chLineValCR ops) where
  natural
proof:
:= by
    intro _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ g _ _ d hd E r hE n
    exact chOpOn_flat g d hd E hE n
  iso := fun {_} _ _ _ _ _ {E E'} h ↦ by
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := h
    exact chOpOn_iso e
  line := fun {_} _ _ _ _ _ L hL ↦ funext (chOpOn_line L hL)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.tdOpOn_isNaturalCR
statement:
theorem tdOpOn_isNaturalCR :
    IsNaturalCharCR ops (tdOpOn ops cp hP) (tdLineValCR ops) where
  natural
proof:
:= by
    intro _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ g _ _ d hd E r hE n
    exact tdOpOn_flat g d hd E hE n
  iso := fun {_} _ _ _ _ _ {E E'} h ↦ by
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := h
    exact tdOpOn_iso e
  line := fun {_} _ _ _ _ _ L hL ↦ funext (tdOpOn_line L hL)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.cOp_isMultiplicativeCR
statement:

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.exists_uniform_higherDirectImage_isZero
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.exists_uniform_higherDirectImage_isZero [IsNoetherian X]
    (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    (F : C.scheme.Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ m₀ : ℤ, ∀ m : ℤ, m₀ ≤ m → ∀ q' : ℕ,
      IsZero (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification C.toBase
        (twist C F (m - ((q' + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) (q' + 1))
proof:
:= by
  choose nr er using BundleRegularity.hrank C hpos
  have hloc : ∀ i, ∃ m₀ : ℤ, ∀ m : ℤ, m₀ ≤ m → ∀ (q' : ℕ) (g : Γ(X, C.U i)),
      Subsingleton ((SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyHAddPresheaf C.toBase
        (twist C F (m - ((q' + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) (q' + 1)).obj (op (X.basicOpen g))) := fun i ↦ by
    haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, C.U i) :=
      IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨C.U i, C.isAffine i⟩
    exact BundleRegularity.chart_vanishing_on_basicOpen C i (er i).some
      (fun M _ ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistGenerated Γ(X, C.U i) (nr i) M) F
  choose m₀ hm₀ using hloc
  have hcov : (Set.univ : Set X) ⊆ ⋃ i, (C.U i : Set X) := fun x _ ↦ by
    have hx : x ∈ (⨆ i, C.U i : X.Opens) := by
      rw [C.covers]
      trivial
    rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup] at hx
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 hx
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := isCompact_univ.elim_finite_subcover (fun i ↦ (C.U i : Set X))
    (fun i ↦ (C.U i).isOpen) hcov
  refine ⟨∑ i ∈ s, |m₀ i|, fun m hm q' ↦ ?_⟩
  let B : Set X.Opens := {V | ∃ i ∈ s, ∃ g : Γ(X, C.U i), X.basicOpen g = V}
  have hB : TopologicalSpace.Opens.IsBasis B := by
    rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd]
    intro W x hx
    have hxs := hs (Set.mem_univ x)
    rw [Set.mem_iUnion₂] at hxs
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩ := hxs
    obtain ⟨g, hgW, hxg⟩ := (C.isAffine i).exists_basicOpen_le ⟨x, hx⟩ hxi
    exact ⟨X.basicOpen g, ⟨i, hi, g, rfl⟩, hxg, hgW⟩
  refine SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_isZero_of_isBasis
    _ _ _ hB ?_
  rintro V ⟨i, hi, g, rfl⟩
  exact hm₀ i m (le_trans (le_trans (le_abs_self _)
    (Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ ↦ abs_nonneg (m₀ j)) hi)) hm) q' g

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.exists_isMumfordRegular_of_isFinitePresentation
statement:
theorem exists_isMumfordRegular_of_isFinitePresentation [IsNoetherian X]
    (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    (F : C.scheme.Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ m : ℤ, IsMumfordRegular C F m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m₀, h⟩ := BundleRegularity.exists_uniform_higherDirectImage_isZero C hpos F
  refine ⟨m₀, fun q hq ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨q', rfl⟩ : ∃ q', q = q' + 1 := ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩
  exact h m₀ le_rfl q'

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.exists_higherDirectImage_twist_isZero
statement:
theorem exists_higherDirectImage_twist_isZero [IsNoetherian X]
    (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    (F : C.scheme.Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ m₀ : ℤ, ∀ m : ℤ, m₀ ≤ m → ∀ q : ℕ, 0 < q →
      IsZero (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification C.toBase
        (twist C F m) q)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m₀, h⟩ := BundleRegularity.exists_uniform_higherDirectImage_isZero C hpos F
  refine ⟨m₀, fun m hm q hq ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨q', rfl⟩ : ∃ q', q = q' + 1 := ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩
  have h' := h (m + ((q' + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (by omega) q'
  rwa [add_sub_cancel_right] at h'

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial_coordinate
statement:
theorem intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial_coordinate
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinate R n i) =
      linearForm R M (b i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial, SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinate, linearForm]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.intrinsicToStandard_preimage_coordinateOpen
statement:
theorem intrinsicToStandard_preimage_coordinateOpen
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b ⁻¹ᵁ
        SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOpen R n i =
      linearOpen R M (b i)
proof:
:= by
  change
    Proj.map (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b)
          (irrelevant_le_map_intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b) ⁻¹ᵁ
        Proj.basicOpen (SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading R n)
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinate R n i) =
      Proj.basicOpen (symGrading R M) (linearForm R M (b i))
  rw [Proj.map_preimage_basicOpen]
  congr 1
  exact intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial_coordinate b i

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial_coordinateOverlapEquation
statement:

    (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j) =
      linearOverlapEquation R M (b i) (b j)
proof:

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.intrinsicToStandard_preimage_coordinateOverlapOpen
statement:

proof:
:= by

    intrinsicToStandard_preimage_coordinateOpen,
    intrinsicToStandard_preimage_coordinateOpen,
    linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.coordinateOverlapAwayCast_mk
statement:
private theorem coordinateOverlapAwayCast_mk
    {p q : SymmetricAlgebra R M} (h : p = q)
    (hp : p ∈ symGrading R M 2) (r : SymmetricAlgebra R M)
    (hr : r ∈ symGrading R M 2) :
    (RingEquiv.cast
        (R := fun a : SymmetricAlgebra R M ↦
          HomogeneousLocalization.Away (symGrading R M) a) h).toRingHom
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (symGrading R M) hp 1 r
          (by simpa using hr)) =
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (symGrading R M) (h ▸ hp) 1 r
        (by simpa using hr)
proof:
:= by
  subst q
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.coordinateOverlapAwayMapNormalized_ratio
statement:
@[simp]
private theorem coordinateOverlapAwayMapNormalized_ratio
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateOverlapAwayMapNormalized b i j
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapRatio R n i j) =
      linearOverlapRatio R M (b i) (b j)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coordinateOverlapAwayMapNormalized, RingHom.comp_apply,
    coordinateOverlapAwayMap, coordinateOverlapAwayTargetEquiv,
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapRatio, linearOverlapRatio,
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map_mk]
  simpa only [map_pow, intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial_coordinate] using
    coordinateOverlapAwayCast_mk
      (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial_coordinateOverlapEquation b i j)
      ((intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b).map_mem
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two R n i j))
      (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinate R n j ^ 2))
      ((intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b).map_mem
        (SetLike.pow_mem_graded 2
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinate_mem_degree_one R n j)))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.coordinateOverlapAwayMapNormalized_ratioUnit
statement:

private theorem coordinateOverlapAwayMapNormalized_ratioUnit

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.coordinateOverlapAwayMapNormalized_transitionUnit
statement:
@[simp]
private theorem coordinateOverlapAwayMapNormalized_transitionUnit
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M) (d : ℤ)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.coordinateOverlapAwayToSection_cast_heq

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.coordinateOverlapAwayToSection_map_heq
statement:
private theorem coordinateOverlapAwayToSection_map_heq
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M) (i j : Fin (n + 1))
    (z : SchemeProjectiveSpace.CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j) :
    HEq
      (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M)
        (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j))
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b)
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j) z))
      (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M)
        (linearOverlapEquation R M (b i) (b j))
        (coordinateOverlapAwayMapNormalized b i j z))
proof:
:= by
  exact coordinateOverlapAwayToSection_cast_heq
    (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial_coordinateOverlapEquation b i j)
    (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b)
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j) z)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.coordinateOverlapAwayToSection_comp_appLE_raw
statement:
private theorem coordinateOverlapAwayToSection_comp_appLE_raw
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Proj.awayToSection (SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading R n)
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j) ≫
        (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b).appLE
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j)
          (Proj.basicOpen (symGrading R M)
            (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b
              (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j)))
          (by
            have hpre :
                intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b ⁻¹ᵁ
                    SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j =
                  Proj.basicOpen (symGrading R M)
                    (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b
                      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j)) := by
              simpa only [SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapOpen,
                intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace] using
                Proj.map_preimage_basicOpen (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b)
                  (irrelevant_le_map_intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b)
                  (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j)
            exact hpre.ge) =
      CommRingCat.ofHom
          (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b)
            (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j)) ≫
        Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M)
          (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b
            (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j))
proof:
:= by
  exact Proj.awayToSection_comp_appLE (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b)
    (irrelevant_le_map_intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b)
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two R n i j)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.coordinateOverlapSectionMapRaw_transitionSectionUnit_heq
statement:
private theorem coordinateOverlapSectionMapRaw_transitionSectionUnit_heq
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M) (d : ℤ)
    (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    HEq
      (coordinateOverlapSectionMapRaw b i j
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.twistTransitionSectionUnit R n d i j).1)
      (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit R M d (b i) (b j)).1
proof:
:= by
  have hcomm := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (coordinateOverlapAwayToSection_comp_appLE_raw b i j)
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.twistTransitionUnit R n d i j).1
  change
    coordinateOverlapSectionMapRaw b i j
        (Proj.awayToSection (SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading R n)
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j)
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.twistTransitionUnit R n d i j).1) =
      Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M)
        (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j))
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b)
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j)
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.twistTransitionUnit R n d i j).1) at hcomm
  have hraw :
      coordinateOverlapSectionMapRaw b i j
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.twistTransitionSectionUnit R n d i j).1 =
        Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M)
          (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b
            (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j))
          (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b)
            (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j)
            (SchemeProjectiveSpace.twistTransitionUnit R n d i j).1) := by
    simpa [coordinateOverlapSectionMapRaw,
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.twistTransitionSectionUnit,
      Proj.basicOpenIsoAway_hom, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] using hcomm
  have hcast := coordinateOverlapAwayToSection_map_heq b i j
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.twistTransitionUnit R n d i j).1
  have hunit :
      coordinateOverlapAwayMapNormalized b i j
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.twistTransitionUnit R n d i j).1 =
        (linearTwistTransitionUnit R M d (b i) (b j)).1 :=
    congrArg Units.val
      (coordinateOverlapAwayMapNormalized_transitionUnit b d i j)
  have hcanonical :
      Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M)
          (linearOverlapEquation R M (b i) (b j))
          (coordinateOverlapAwayMapNormalized b i j
            (SchemeProjectiveSpace.twistTransitionUnit R n d i j).1) =
        (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit R M d (b i) (b j)).1 := by
    rw [hunit]
    rfl
  exact (heq_of_eq hraw).trans (hcast.trans (heq_of_eq hcanonical))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.scheme_appLE_eq_app_heq
statement:
private theorem scheme_appLE_eq_app_heq
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (U : Y.Opens) (V : X.Opens)
    (h : f ⁻¹ᵁ U = V) (z : Γ(Y, U)) :
    HEq (f.appLE U V h.ge z) (f.app U z)
proof:
:= by
  subst V
  simp [Scheme.Hom.appLE]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.intrinsicToStandard_app_transitionSectionUnit_heq
statement:
theorem intrinsicToStandard_app_transitionSectionUnit_heq
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M) (d : ℤ)
    (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    HEq
      ((intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b).app
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j)
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.twistTransitionSectionUnit R n d i j).1)
      (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit R M d (b i) (b j)).1
proof:
:= by
  let Vraw := Proj.basicOpen (symGrading R M)
    (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j))
  have hpre :
      intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b ⁻¹ᵁ
          SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j = Vraw := by
    simpa only [SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapOpen,
      intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace] using
      Proj.map_preimage_basicOpen (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b)
        (irrelevant_le_map_intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b)
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j)
  have happ := scheme_appLE_eq_app_heq
    (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b)
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j) Vraw hpre
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.twistTransitionSectionUnit R n d i j).1
  have hraw :=
    coordinateOverlapSectionMapRaw_transitionSectionUnit_heq b d i j
  exact happ.symm.trans hraw

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.intrinsicToStandard_preimage_liftedLinearOpen
statement:
private theorem intrinsicToStandard_preimage_liftedLinearOpen
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M)
    (i : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1))) :
    intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b ⁻¹ᵁ
        SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOpen R n (finULiftEquiv n i) =
      linearOpen R M (liftedBasis b i)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : liftedBasis b i = b (finULiftEquiv n i) := by
    simp [liftedBasis]
  rw [hb]
  exact intrinsicToStandard_preimage_coordinateOpen
    b (finULiftEquiv n i)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.intrinsicToStandard_preimage_liftedLinearOverlapOpen
statement:
private theorem intrinsicToStandard_preimage_liftedLinearOverlapOpen
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M)
    (ij : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) × ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1))) :
    intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b ⁻¹ᵁ
        SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapOpen
          R n (finULiftEquiv n ij.1)
            (finULiftEquiv n ij.2) =
      linearOverlapOpen R M
        (liftedBasis b ij.1) (liftedBasis b ij.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hb1 :
      liftedBasis b ij.1 = b (finULiftEquiv n ij.1) := by
    simp [liftedBasis]
  have hb2 :
      liftedBasis b ij.2 = b (finULiftEquiv n ij.2) := by
    simp [liftedBasis]
  rw [hb1, hb2]
  exact intrinsicToStandard_preimage_coordinateOverlapOpen
    b (finULiftEquiv n ij.1) (finULiftEquiv n ij.2)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.liftedCoordinateChartRestrictIso_hom_π
statement:
private theorem liftedCoordinateChartRestrictIso_hom_π
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M)
    (i : liftedChartIndex.{u} n) :
    (liftedCoordinateChartRestrictIso b).hom ≫
        Pi.π (preimageChartPushedUnitFamily b) i =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
          (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b)).map
            (Pi.π (standardChartPushedUnitFamily R n ∘
              finULiftEquiv n) i) ≫
        (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionIso
          (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b)
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOpen R n
            (finULiftEquiv n i))).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [liftedCoordinateChartRestrictIso,
    Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc, PreservesProduct.iso_hom]
  rw [Pi.mapIso_hom_π]
  rw [piComparison_comp_π_assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.liftedCoordinateOverlapRestrictIso_hom_π
statement:
private theorem liftedCoordinateOverlapRestrictIso_hom_π
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M)
    (ij : liftedOverlapIndex.{u} n) :
    (liftedCoordinateOverlapRestrictIso b).hom ≫
        Pi.π (preimageOverlapPushedUnitFamily b) ij =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
          (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b)).map

          (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b)
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapOpen
            R n (finULiftEquiv n ij.1)
              (finULiftEquiv n ij.2))).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [liftedCoordinateOverlapRestrictIso,
    Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc, PreservesProduct.iso_hom]

  rw [piComparison_comp_π_assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitRestrictCastIso_naturality
statement:
private theorem pushedUnitRestrictCastIso_naturality
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    {U V : X.Opens} {U' V' : Y.Opens}
    (hU : q ⁻¹ᵁ U = U') (hV : q ⁻¹ᵁ V = V')
    (h : V ≤ U) (h' : V' ≤ U') :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction h) ≫
        ((pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionIso q V) ≪≫
          eqToIso (congrArg
            (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y) hV)).hom =
      ((pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionIso q U) ≪≫
          eqToIso (congrArg
            (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y) hU)).hom ≫
        SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction h'
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom]
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  rw [pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionIso_naturality]
  rw [Category.assoc]
  rw [pushedUnitRestriction_eqToIso_naturality hU hV
    (q.preimage_mono h) h']
  simp only [Category.assoc]
