name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.fibre_of_section
statement:
theorem fibre_of_section :
    ∃ _ : IsIso (zeroι (F'.appTop t) ≫ pr'),
      inv (zeroι (F'.appTop t) ≫ pr') ≫ zeroMap t F' ≫ e.inv = i
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsSplitMono σ := IsSplitMono.mk' ⟨π, hσ⟩
  haveI : Mono σ := inferInstance
  have hσt : σ.appTop t = 0 := by
    rw [← he, Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop]
    have := zeroι_appTop t
    simp [this]
  let sW : Z ⟶ W' := sq.lift (i ≫ σ) (𝟙 Z) (by simp [hσ])
  have hsW1 : sW ≫ F' = i ≫ σ := sq.lift_fst _ _ _
  have hsW2 : sW ≫ pr' = 𝟙 Z := sq.lift_snd _ _ _
  have hsWt : sW.appTop (F'.appTop t) = 0 := by
    have : (sW ≫ F').appTop t = 0 := by
      rw [hsW1, Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop]
      simp [hσt]
    rwa [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop] at this
  let l : Z ⟶ zeroScheme (F'.appTop t) := zeroLift (F'.appTop t) sW hsWt
  have hl : l ≫ zeroι (F'.appTop t) = sW := zeroLift_zeroι _ _ _
  have hsl : l ≫ (zeroι (F'.appTop t) ≫ pr') = 𝟙 Z := by rw [← Category.assoc, hl, hsW2]
  have hηt : (zeroι (F'.appTop t) ≫ F').appTop t = 0 := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop]
    exact zeroι_appTop (F'.appTop t)
  let g : zeroScheme (F'.appTop t) ⟶ zeroScheme t := zeroLift t (zeroι (F'.appTop t) ≫ F') hηt
  have hg : g ≫ zeroι t = zeroι (F'.appTop t) ≫ F' := zeroLift_zeroι _ _ _
  have he' : e.inv ≫ σ = zeroι t := by rw [← he]; simp
  have hh : zeroι (F'.appTop t) ≫ F' = (g ≫ e.inv) ≫ σ := by
    rw [Category.assoc, he', hg]
  have hh2 : g ≫ e.inv = zeroι (F'.appTop t) ≫ pr' ≫ i := by
    calc g ≫ e.inv = (g ≫ e.inv) ≫ σ ≫ π := by rw [hσ]; simp
      _ = ((g ≫ e.inv) ≫ σ) ≫ π := by simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = (zeroι (F'.appTop t) ≫ F') ≫ π := by rw [← hh]
      _ = zeroι (F'.appTop t) ≫ pr' ≫ i := by rw [Category.assoc, sq.w]
  have hη2 : zeroι (F'.appTop t) ≫ F' = zeroι (F'.appTop t) ≫ pr' ≫ i ≫ σ := by
    rw [hh, hh2]; simp
  have hsl2 : (zeroι (F'.appTop t) ≫ pr') ≫ l = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [← cancel_mono (zeroι (F'.appTop t)), Category.assoc, Category.assoc, hl, Category.id_comp]
    apply sq.hom_ext
    · rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, hsW1, hη2]
    · rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, hsW2, Category.comp_id]
  haveI : IsIso (zeroι (F'.appTop t) ≫ pr') := ⟨l, hsl2, hsl⟩
  refine ⟨inferInstance, ?_⟩
  have hinv : inv (zeroι (F'.appTop t) ≫ pr') = l := IsIso.inv_eq_of_inv_hom_id hsl
  rw [hinv, ← cancel_mono σ]
  simp only [Category.assoc, he']
  rw [zeroMap_zeroι, ← Category.assoc, hl, hsW1]

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.hbcA_pencil_bundle
statement:
theorem hbcA_pencil_bundle
    (hmono : ∀ E : U.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFree U E → Mono (tMul t E))
    (hmonoW : ∀ E : Z.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFree Z E →
      Mono (tMul (F'.appTop t) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback c').obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E))))
    [IsIso (zeroι (F'.appTop t) ≫ c' ≫ pr)]
    (hsi : inv (zeroι (F'.appTop t) ≫ c' ≫ pr) ≫ zeroMap t F' ≫ e.inv = i)
    (E0 : Z.Modules) (hE0 : IsFiniteLocallyFree Z E0) (y : K0 M)
    (hy : k0ToG0 M y = finitePushforward F (flatPullbackG0 pr (g0ClassOf Z E0 hE0.isFinitePresentation))) :
    k0ToG0 A (pullbackK0 j₁ y) = finitePushforward i (g0ClassOf Z E0 hE0.isFinitePresentation)
proof:
:= by
  have hEc : IsCoherentLike Z E0 := hE0.isFinitePresentation
  letI : E0.IsFinitePresentation := hEc
  have hV₀ : IsCoherentLike W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E0) :=
    pullback_isFinitePresentation_global pr E0
  letI : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E0).IsFinitePresentation := hV₀
  have hV₁ : IsCoherentLike W' ((Scheme.Modules.pullback c').obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E0)) :=
    pullback_isFinitePresentation_global c' _
  letI : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback c').obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E0)).IsFinitePresentation := hV₁
  have hV₂ : IsCoherentLike (zeroScheme (F'.appTop t))
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (zeroι (F'.appTop t))).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback c').obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E0))) :=
    pullback_isFinitePresentation_global (zeroι (F'.appTop t)) _
  have hy' : k0ToG0 M y = finitePushforward F
      (g0ClassOf W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E0) hV₀) := by
    rw [hy, flatPullbackG0_classOf]
  haveI := hmonoW E0 hE0
  have h1 := hbc_chart F c c' F' sq t hmono _ hV₀ y hy'
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (zeroScheme t) := isLocallyNoetherian_subscheme _
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (zeroScheme (F'.appTop t)) := isLocallyNoetherian_subscheme _
  have h2 : k0ToG0 A (pullbackK0 j₁ y) =
      flatPullbackG0 e.hom (k0ToG0 (zeroScheme t)
        (pullbackK0 (zeroι t) (pullbackK0 c y))) := by
    rw [← he, ← pullbackK0_comp_apply, ← pullbackK0_comp_apply, k0ToG0_pullbackK0]
  rw [h2, h1, flatPullbackG0_iso_eq_finitePushforward_inv e]
  have hG : g0ClassOf (zeroScheme (F'.appTop t))
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (zeroι (F'.appTop t))).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback c').obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E0))) hV₂ =
      flatPullbackG0 (zeroι (F'.appTop t) ≫ c' ≫ pr) (g0ClassOf Z E0 hEc) := by
    rw [flatPullbackG0_classOf]
    refine g0ClassOf_iso _ _ _ ?_
    exact (Scheme.Modules.pullback (zeroι (F'.appTop t))).mapIso
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp c' pr).app E0) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (zeroι (F'.appTop t)) (c' ≫ pr)).app E0
  have hiso := flatPullbackG0_iso_eq_finitePushforward_inv (asIso (zeroι (F'.appTop t) ≫ c' ≫ pr))
  have h3 : flatPullbackG0 (zeroι (F'.appTop t) ≫ c' ≫ pr) =
      finitePushforward (inv (zeroι (F'.appTop t) ≫ c' ≫ pr)) := hiso
  rw [hG, h3]
  set x := g0ClassOf Z E0 hEc
  have hc1 : finitePushforward (zeroMap t F') (finitePushforward
      (inv (zeroι (F'.appTop t) ≫ c' ≫ pr)) x) =
      finitePushforward (inv (zeroι (F'.appTop t) ≫ c' ≫ pr) ≫ zeroMap t F') x :=
    (congrArg (fun f : _ →+ _ => f x)
      (finitePushforward_comp (inv (zeroι (F'.appTop t) ≫ c' ≫ pr)) (zeroMap t F'))).symm
  have hc2 := congrArg (fun f : _ →+ _ => f x)
    (finitePushforward_comp (inv (zeroι (F'.appTop t) ≫ c' ≫ pr) ≫ zeroMap t F') e.inv)
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply] at hc2
  rw [hc1, ← hc2]
  exact congrArg (fun f : _ →+ _ => f x)
    (finitePushforward_congr (by rw [Category.assoc]; exact hsi))

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.hbcA_pencil_generic
statement:
theorem hbcA_pencil_generic
    (hmono : ∀ E : U.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFree U E → Mono (tMul t E))
    (hmonoW : ∀ E : Z.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFree Z E →
      Mono (tMul (F'.appTop t) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback c').obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E))))
    [IsIso (zeroι (F'.appTop t) ≫ c' ≫ pr)]
    (hsi : inv (zeroι (F'.appTop t) ≫ c' ≫ pr) ≫ zeroMap t F' ≫ e.inv = i)
    (hres : Function.Bijective (k0ToG0 M)) (x : K0 Z) (y : K0 M)
    (hy : k0ToG0 M y = finitePushforward F (flatPullbackG0 pr (k0ToG0 Z x))) :
    k0ToG0 A (pullbackK0 j₁ y) = finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 Z x)
proof:
:= by
  let Ψ : G0 M ≃+ K0 M := (AddEquiv.ofBijective (k0ToG0 M) hres).symm
  have hΨ : ∀ g, k0ToG0 M (Ψ g) = g := fun g => (AddEquiv.ofBijective (k0ToG0 M) hres).apply_symm_apply g
  let L : K0 Z →+ G0 A := (k0ToG0 A).comp ((pullbackK0 j₁).comp (Ψ.toAddMonoidHom.comp
    ((finitePushforward F).comp ((flatPullbackG0 pr).comp (k0ToG0 Z)))))
  let R : K0 Z →+ G0 A := (finitePushforward i).comp (k0ToG0 Z)
  have hLR : L = R := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    intro E
    change k0ToG0 A (pullbackK0 j₁ (Ψ (finitePushforward F (flatPullbackG0 pr
        (k0ToG0 Z (k0ClassOf Z E.1 E.2)))))) = finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 Z (k0ClassOf Z E.1 E.2))
    rw [k0ToG0_classOf]
    exact hbcA_pencil_bundle F c c' F' sq t pr i j₁ e he hmono hmonoW hsi E.1 E.2 _ (by
      rw [hΨ])
  have hyΨ : y = Ψ (finitePushforward F (flatPullbackG0 pr (k0ToG0 Z x))) := by
    rw [← hy]; exact ((AddEquiv.ofBijective (k0ToG0 M) hres).symm_apply_apply y).symm
  have := DFunLike.congr_fun hLR x
  change k0ToG0 A (pullbackK0 j₁ (Ψ (finitePushforward F (flatPullbackG0 pr (k0ToG0 Z x))))) =
    finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 Z x) at this
  rw [hyΨ]; exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.infPoint_eq
statement: theorem infPoint_eq : infPoint k = zeroPt k ≫ chart k 0
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.infIdeal_comap_chart_zero
statement:
theorem infIdeal_comap_chart_zero :
    (infIdeal k).comap (chart k 0) = (zeroPt k).ker
proof:
:= by
  have H : IsPullback (zeroPt k) (𝟙 _) (chart k 0) (infPoint k) :=
    IsPullback.of_vert_isIso_mono ⟨by simp [infPoint_eq]⟩
  apply Scheme.IdealSheafData.ext
  funext W
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_comap_of_isOpenImmersion,
    Scheme.ker_ideal_of_isPullback_of_isOpenImmersion _ _ _ _ H]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.zeroPt_ker_ideal
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.ker_of_isAffine]
  have h1 : (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop (RingHom.ker (zeroPt k).appTop.hom)).ideal
      ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩ = RingHom.ker (zeroPt k).appTop.hom := by
    simp
  rw [h1]
  have h2 : RingHom.ker (zeroPt k).appTop.hom =
      Ideal.comap (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Polynomial k))).hom.hom
        (RingHom.ker (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : k))) := by
    ext x
    have hn := Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : k)))
    have hx := congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom x) hn
    simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply] at hx
    simp only [RingHom.mem_ker, Ideal.mem_comap]
    have hx' : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).hom.hom ((zeroPt k).appTop.hom x) =
        (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : k)) ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Polynomial k))).hom.hom x) := hx
    rw [← hx']
    exact (map_eq_zero_iff _ (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).hom).1).symm
  rw [h2]
  refine (Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Polynomial k))).hom.hom
    (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _).2 _).trans ?_
  rw [Polynomial.ker_evalRingHom]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.chartι_fst
statement:
theorem chartι_fst (U : A.affineOpens) :
    chartι (k := k) U ≫ pullback.fst _ _ =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.C : Γ(A, U.1) →+* Γ(A, U.1)[X])) ≫ U.2.fromSpec
proof:
:= by
  unfold chartι
  rw [Category.assoc, jChart_fst, GlobalCompletion.lineAffineι_toBase, lineAffineToOpen_eq]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.chartι_snd
statement:
theorem chartι_snd (U : A.affineOpens) :
    chartι (k := k) U ≫ pullback.snd _ _ =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.mapRingHom (DeformationSpace.kAlg A k (phiK (k := k) (A := A)) U))) ≫
        chart k 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold chartι
  rw [Category.assoc, jChart_snd, ← Category.assoc, lineAffineι_toLineOver]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.ideal_chart_J
statement:
theorem ideal_chart_J (J : A.IdealSheafData) (U : A.affineOpens) :
    ((J.comap (chartι (k := k) U ≫ pullback.fst _ _)).ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩).map
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of Γ(A, U.1)[X])).hom.hom =
      (J.ideal U).map (Polynomial.C : Γ(A, U.1) →+* Γ(A, U.1)[X])
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartι_fst, Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp, comap_ideal_top_affine]
  rw [Ideal.map_map]
  have hn := Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.C : Γ(A, U.1) →+* Γ(A, U.1)[X]))
  have hn' : ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of Γ(A, U.1)[X])).hom.hom).comp
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.C : Γ(A, U.1) →+* Γ(A, U.1)[X]))).appTop.hom =
      (Polynomial.C : Γ(A, U.1) →+* Γ(A, U.1)[X]).comp (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of Γ(A, U.1))).hom.hom :=
    congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom hn
  rw [hn', ← Ideal.map_map]
  exact congrArg (Ideal.map (Polynomial.C : Γ(A, U.1) →+* Γ(A, U.1)[X])) (ideal_comap_fromSpec J U)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.ideal_chart_inf
statement:
theorem ideal_chart_inf (U : A.affineOpens) :
    (((infIdeal k).comap (chartι (k := k) U ≫ pullback.snd _ _)).ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩).map
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of Γ(A, U.1)[X])).hom.hom =
      Ideal.span {(Polynomial.X : Γ(A, U.1)[X])}
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartι_snd, Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp, infIdeal_comap_chart_zero, comap_ideal_top_affine]
  rw [Ideal.map_map]
  have hn := Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.mapRingHom (DeformationSpace.kAlg A k (phiK (k := k) (A := A)) U)))
  have hn' : ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of Γ(A, U.1)[X])).hom.hom).comp
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.mapRingHom (DeformationSpace.kAlg A k (phiK (k := k) (A := A)) U)))).appTop.hom =
      (Polynomial.mapRingHom (DeformationSpace.kAlg A k (phiK (k := k) (A := A)) U)).comp (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k[X])).hom.hom :=
    congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom hn
  rw [hn', ← Ideal.map_map, zeroPt_ker_ideal, Ideal.map_span]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.ideal_chart
statement:
theorem ideal_chart (J : A.IdealSheafData) (U : A.affineOpens) :
    ((infCentre (k := k) J).ideal (imgOpen (chartι (k := k) U))).map (eRing (chartι (k := k) U)) =
      centreIdeal (J.ideal U)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ideal_imgOpen_map]
  have hc : (infCentre (k := k) J).comap (chartι (k := k) U) =
      J.comap (chartι (k := k) U ≫ pullback.fst _ _) ⊔
        (infIdeal k).comap (chartι (k := k) U ≫ pullback.snd _ _) := by
    unfold infCentre
    rw [(Scheme.IdealSheafData.map_gc _).l_sup, Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp,
      Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp]
  have hs : ∀ (I1 I2 : (Spec (CommRingCat.of Γ(A, U.1)[X])).IdealSheafData) (V),
      (I1 ⊔ I2).ideal V = I1.ideal V ⊔ I2.ideal V := fun _ _ _ => rfl
  rw [hc, hs, Ideal.map_sup, ideal_chart_J, ideal_chart_inf]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.chartι_natural
statement:
theorem chartι_natural {U V : A.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (GlobalCompletion.polyRes A h)) ≫ chartι (k := k) V =
      chartι (k := k) U
proof:
:= by
  apply pullback.hom_ext
  · rw [Category.assoc, chartι_fst, chartι_fst, ← Category.assoc,
      GlobalCompletion.specMap_polyRes_C, Category.assoc]
    congr 1
    exact IsAffineOpen.map_fromSpec V.2 U.2 (homOfLE h).op
  · rw [Category.assoc, chartι_snd, chartι_snd, ← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp,
      ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
    congr 3
    rw [GlobalCompletion.polyRes, Polynomial.mapRingHom_comp, DeformationSpace.res_comp_kAlg]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.piece_natural
statement:
theorem piece_natural {U V : A.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    (GlobalCompletion.gluingFunctor A J).map (homOfLE h) ≫ piece (k := k) J V = piece (k := k) J U
proof:
:= by
  symm
  exact gammaMap_natural (chartι (k := k) U) (infCentre (k := k) J) _ (ideal_chart J U)
    (chartι (k := k) V) (GlobalCompletion.polyRes A h) (chartι_natural h) _ (ideal_chart J V)
    (GlobalCompletion.map_centreIdeal_polyRes A J h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.blowupAffineι_phi0
statement:
theorem blowupAffineι_phi0 (U : A.affineOpens) :
    GlobalCompletion.blowupAffineι A J U ≫ phi0 (k := k) J = piece (k := k) J U
proof:
:=
  colimit.ι_desc _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.piece_toBase
statement:
theorem piece_toBase (U : A.affineOpens) :
    piece (k := k) J U ≫ GlobalBlowup.toBase (B0 (k := k) A) (infCentre (k := k) J) =
      ReesBlowup.projection (centreIdeal (J.ideal U)) ≫ chartι (k := k) U
proof:
:=
  (isPullback_gamma (chartι (k := k) U) (infCentre (k := k) J) _ (ideal_chart J U)).w.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.phi0_toBase_fst
statement:
theorem phi0_toBase_fst :
    phi0 (k := k) J ≫ GlobalBlowup.toBase _ _ ≫ pullback.fst _ _ =
      GlobalCompletion.blowupGlobalToBase A J
proof:
:= by
  refine Scheme.Cover.hom_ext (GlobalCompletion.gluingData A J).cover _ _ fun U ↦ ?_
  rw [Scheme.Cover.RelativeGluingData.cover_f]
  change GlobalCompletion.blowupAffineι A J U ≫ _ = GlobalCompletion.blowupAffineι A J U ≫ _
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, blowupAffineι_phi0, Category.assoc,
    ← (GlobalCompletion.isPullback_blowupAffine A J U).w]
  rw [← Category.assoc, piece_toBase, Category.assoc, chartι_fst]
  simp only [GlobalCompletion.gluingApp, IsAffineOpen.fromSpec, Category.assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.phi0_toBase_snd
statement:
theorem phi0_toBase_snd :
    phi0 (k := k) J ≫ GlobalBlowup.toBase _ _ ≫ pullback.snd _ _ =
      GlobalCompletion.blowupGlobalToLineOver A J k (phiK (k := k) (A := A)) ≫ chart k 0
proof:
:= by
  refine Scheme.Cover.hom_ext (GlobalCompletion.gluingData A J).cover _ _ fun U ↦ ?_
  rw [Scheme.Cover.RelativeGluingData.cover_f]
  change GlobalCompletion.blowupAffineι A J U ≫ _ = GlobalCompletion.blowupAffineι A J U ≫ _
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, blowupAffineι_phi0, Category.assoc,
    ← Category.assoc (GlobalCompletion.blowupAffineι A J U),
    GlobalCompletion.blowupAffineι_toLineOver]
  rw [← Category.assoc, piece_toBase, Category.assoc, chartι_snd]
  simp only [GlobalCompletion.blToLineOverU, Category.assoc]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.orderedModuleCoordinates_cosection
statement:
theorem orderedModuleCoordinates_cosection (D : OrderedKoszulData R) (rs : List R)
    (p : D.module × (Fin rs.length → R)) :
    (D.appendList rs).cosection ((orderedModuleCoordinates D rs).symm p) =
      D.cosection p.1 + ∑ i : Fin rs.length, p.2 i * rs.get i
proof:
:= by
  induction rs generalizing D with
  | nil =>
    change D.cosection p.1 = D.cosection p.1 + ∑ i : Fin 0, p.2 i * ([] : List R).get i
    simp
  | cons r rs ih =>
    change (D.append r |>.appendList rs).cosection
      ((orderedModuleCoordinates (D.append r) rs).symm
        ((p.1, p.2 0), fun i => p.2 i.succ)) = _
    rw [ih]
    change (D.cosection p.1 + r * p.2 0) + ∑ i : Fin rs.length, p.2 i.succ * rs.get i =
      D.cosection p.1 + ∑ i : Fin (rs.length+1), p.2 i * (r::rs).get i
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    simp only [List.get_cons_zero]
    simp [mul_comm, add_assoc]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.orderedListPiEquiv_cosection
statement:
theorem orderedListPiEquiv_cosection (rs : List R) (v : Fin rs.length → R) :
    ((emptyOrderedKoszulData (R := R)).appendList rs).cosection
      ((orderedListPiEquiv rs).symm v) = ∑ i : Fin rs.length, v i * rs.get i
proof:
:= by
  change ((emptyOrderedKoszulData (R := R)).appendList rs).cosection
    ((orderedModuleCoordinates emptyOrderedKoszulData rs).symm (0,v)) = _
  rw [orderedModuleCoordinates_cosection]
  change (0 : (Fin 0 →₀ R) →ₗ[R] R) 0 + _ = _
  rw [LinearMap.zero_apply, zero_add]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.orderedOfFnPiEquiv_cosection
statement:
theorem orderedOfFnPiEquiv_cosection {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n → R) (v : Fin n → R) :
    ((emptyOrderedKoszulData (R := R)).appendList (List.ofFn a)).cosection
      ((orderedOfFnPiEquiv a).symm v) = ∑ i : Fin n, v i * a i
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin (List.ofFn a).length ≃ Fin n := finCongr List.length_ofFn
  change ((emptyOrderedKoszulData (R := R)).appendList (List.ofFn a)).cosection
    ((orderedListPiEquiv (List.ofFn a)).symm (fun i => v (e i))) = _
  rw [orderedListPiEquiv_cosection]
  apply Fintype.sum_equiv e
  intro i
  simp only [List.get_ofFn]
  congr 2

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.finiteBasisOrderedEquiv_cosection
statement:
theorem finiteBasisOrderedEquiv_cosection {n : ℕ} (b : Module.Basis (Fin n) R M)
    (σ : M →ₗ[R] R) (x : M) :
    ((emptyOrderedKoszulData (R := R)).appendList (List.ofFn (fun i => σ (b i)))).cosection
      (finiteBasisOrderedEquiv b σ x) = σ x
proof:
:= by
  change ((emptyOrderedKoszulData (R := R)).appendList (List.ofFn (fun i => σ (b i)))).cosection
    ((orderedOfFnPiEquiv (fun i => σ (b i))).symm (fun i => b.repr x i)) = _
  rw [orderedOfFnPiEquiv_cosection]
  have h := congrArg σ (b.sum_repr x)
  simpa only [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] using h

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.finiteBasisOrderedEquiv_cosection_map
statement:
theorem finiteBasisOrderedEquiv_cosection_map {n : ℕ} (b : Module.Basis (Fin n) R M)
    (σ : M →ₗ[R] R) :
    σ.comp (finiteBasisOrderedEquiv b σ).symm.toLinearMap =
    ((emptyOrderedKoszulData (R := R)).appendList (List.ofFn (fun i => σ (b i)))).cosection
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  have h := finiteBasisOrderedEquiv_cosection b σ ((finiteBasisOrderedEquiv b σ).symm x)
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
  exact h.symm

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.koszulAcyclic_of_finiteBasis_weaklyRegular
statement:
theorem koszulAcyclic_of_finiteBasis_weaklyRegular {n : ℕ} (b : Module.Basis (Fin n) R M)
    (σ : M →ₗ[R] R)
    (reg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular R (List.ofFn (fun i => σ (b i)))) :
    KoszulAcyclic σ
proof:
:=
  koszulAcyclic_of_resolution_chainIso σ
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution.koszul _ reg)
    (finiteBasisWeakRegularChainIso b σ reg)

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.koszulAcyclic_of_enumeratedBasis_weaklyRegular
statement:
theorem koszulAcyclic_of_enumeratedBasis_weaklyRegular {I : Type u} {n : ℕ}
    (b : Module.Basis I R M) (enumeration : Fin n ≃ I) (σ : M →ₗ[R] R)
    (reg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular R
      (List.ofFn (fun i => σ (b (enumeration i))))) : KoszulAcyclic σ
proof:
:= by
  apply koszulAcyclic_of_finiteBasis_weaklyRegular (b.reindex enumeration.symm) σ
  simpa using reg

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.isLocallyKoszulRegular_of_finite_weaklyRegular_frames
statement:
theorem isLocallyKoszulRegular_of_finite_weaklyRegular_frames
    (h : LocallyFiniteWeaklyRegularFrames X M σ) : IsLocallyKoszulRegular X M σ
proof:
:= by
  intro V x hx
  obtain ⟨W, hWV, hxW, _, n, b, hb⟩ := h V x hx
  exact ⟨W, hWV, hxW, koszulAcyclic_of_finiteBasis_weaklyRegular b _ hb⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.g0ClassOf_cokernelCosection_of_finite_weaklyRegular_frames
statement:
theorem g0ClassOf_cokernelCosection_of_finite_weaklyRegular_frames [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    {r : ℕ} (hM : HasConstantRank X M r) (h : LocallyFiniteWeaklyRegularFrames X M σ) :
    g0ClassOf X (cokernel σ)
        (cokernel_isCoherentLike X hM.isFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation
          (tensorUnitSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree X).isFinitePresentation σ) =
      k0ToG0 X (lambdaMinusOne M hM)
proof:
:=
  g0ClassOf_cokernelCosection X M hM σ
    (isLocallyKoszulRegular_of_finite_weaklyRegular_frames X M σ h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.V4FIX.pushOn_eq_pushD9
statement:
theorem pushOn_eq_pushD9 {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [Y.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y] [Fact (P X)] [Fact (P Y)]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsProper f] (n : ℕ) :
    ops.push f n = D9.pushD9 (k := k) f n
proof:
:= by
  refine ratLinear_ext _ _ fun D ↦ ?_
  rw [D9.pushD9_mk0 (k := k) f n D]
  exact ops.push_mk f n D _ rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.V4FIX.pullOn_eq_pullD2
statement:
theorem pullOn_eq_pullD2 {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [Y.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y] [Fact (P X)] [Fact (P Y)]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat f] (d : ℕ) (hd : PureRelDim f d) (n : ℕ) :
    ops.pull f d hd n = D2.pullD2 (k := k) f d hd n
proof:
:= by
  refine ratLinear_ext _ _ fun D ↦ ?_
  rw [D2.pullD2_mk (k := k) f d hd n D]
  exact ops.pull_mk f d hd n D _ (fun x ↦ rfl)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.V4FIX.capOn_prime_anchor
statement:
theorem capOn_prime_anchor (v : X) (hv : height v = n + 1) :
    ops.cap L hL n ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv) : DimChow X (n + 1))) =
      (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (D5.primeCap (k := k) L hL n v hv)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b⟩ := Scheme.Modules.exists_lineBundleLocalDataAt (pointClosureScheme v)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj L)
    (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL v)
    (m7s_genericRank_pointClosure L hL v) (pointClosureGenericPoint v)
  rw [ops.cap_mk L hL n v hv (m7s_genericRank_pointClosure L hL v) b
      (D5.primeCycleOfFrame (k := k) L hL n v hv b) rfl,
    D5.primeCap_eq (k := k) L hL n v hv b]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.V4FIX.capOn_anchor
statement:
theorem capOn_anchor (D : dimensionCycles X (n + 1)) :
    ops.cap L hL n ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X (n + 1))) =
      (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (D5.capCycles (k := k) L hL n D)
proof:
:= by
  let φ1 : dimensionCycles X (n + 1) →+ RationalDimChow X n :=
    (ops.cap L hL n).toAddMonoidHom.comp ((tmul1 X (n + 1)).comp (mkHom X (n + 1)))
  let φ2 : dimensionCycles X (n + 1) →+ RationalDimChow X n :=
    (tmul1 X n).comp (D5.capCycles (k := k) L hL n)
  have key : D ∈ AddMonoidHom.eqLocus φ1 φ2 := by
    refine dimCycle_mem_of_prime _ (fun v hv ↦ ?_) D
    change φ1 _ = φ2 _
    change ops.cap L hL n ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv) : DimChow X (n + 1))) =
      (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (D5.capCycles (k := k) L hL n (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv))
    rw [D5.capCycles_dimPrimeCycle (k := k) L hL n v hv]
    exact capOn_prime_anchor (k := k) ops L hL n v hv
  exact key

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.V4FIX.chowOpsOn_ext
statement: theorem chowOpsOn_ext (ops ops' : ChowOpsOn P) : ops = ops'
proof:
:= by
  have hpush : @ops.push = @ops'.push := by
    repeat' (apply funext; intro _)
    rw [pushOn_eq_pushD9 ops, pushOn_eq_pushD9 ops']
  have hpull : @ops.pull = @ops'.pull := by
    repeat' (apply funext; intro _)
    rw [pullOn_eq_pullD2 ops, pullOn_eq_pullD2 ops']
  have hcap : @ops.cap = @ops'.cap := by
    repeat' (apply funext; intro _)
    refine ratLinear_ext _ _ fun D ↦ ?_
    rw [capOn_anchor (k := k) ops, capOn_anchor (k := k) ops']
  obtain ⟨a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6⟩ := ops
  obtain ⟨b1, b2, b3, b4, b5, b6⟩ := ops'
  dsimp only at hpush hpull hcap
  subst hpush hpull hcap
  rfl
