name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.V4FIX.chernOpOn'_ops_indep
statement:
theorem chernOpOn'_ops_indep (ops ops' : ChowOpsOn P) (cp : ChowCompatOn ops)
    (cp' : ChowCompatOn ops') (hP : ProjBundleClosedPos P)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X]
    [Fact (P X)] (E : X.Modules) (r : ℕ) (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    chernOpOn' ops cp hP E r hE = chernOpOn' ops' cp' hP E r hE
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl := chowOpsOn_ext ops ops'
  obtain rfl := chowCompatOn_subsingleton cp cp'
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.recurrence_of_filtration
statement:
theorem recurrence_of_filtration {A : Type*} [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (lam : ℕ → A)
    (hlam0 : lam 0 = 1) (σ : ℤ → A) (κ : ℕ → ℤ → A)
    (h0 : ∀ t, κ 0 t = σ t) (htop : ∀ t, κ r t = 0)
    (hstep : ∀ j, j < r → ∀ t : ℤ, -(j : ℤ) ≤ t → lam (j + 1) * σ t = κ (j + 1) t + κ j (t + 1))
    (d : ℤ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), (-1 : A) ^ k * lam k * σ (d - k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ m, m ≤ r →
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (-1 : A) ^ k * lam k * σ (d - k) = (-1) ^ m * κ m (d - m) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => intro _; simp [hlam0, h0]
    | succ m ih =>
      intro hm
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih (by omega)]
      have hs := hstep m (by omega) (d - ((m : ℤ) + 1)) (by omega)
      rw [show d - ((m : ℤ) + 1) + 1 = d - m by ring] at hs
      push_cast
      linear_combination (-1 : A) ^ (m + 1) * hs
  rw [key r le_rfl, htop, mul_zero]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.eq_zero_of_eventually_recurrence
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_eventually_recurrence {A : Type*} [CommRing A] (r : ℕ)
    (lam : ℕ → A) (hlamr : IsUnit (lam r)) (σ : ℤ → A)
    (hσ0 : σ 0 = 1) (hσneg : ∀ t : ℤ, -(r : ℤ) < t → t < 0 → σ t = 0)
    (hrec : ∀ d : ℤ, 1 ≤ d → ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), (-1 : A) ^ k * lam k * σ (d - k) = 0)
    (g : Fin r → A)
    (hg : ∀ᶠ m : ℕ in Filter.atTop, ∑ i : Fin r, g i * σ (((i : ℕ) : ℤ) + (m : ℤ)) = 0) :
    g = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  let τ : ℤ → A := fun m ↦ ∑ i : Fin r, g i * σ (((i : ℕ) : ℤ) + m)
  
  have hτrec : ∀ d : ℤ, 1 ≤ d →
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), (-1 : A) ^ k * lam k * τ (d - k) = 0 := by
    intro d hd
    have e1 : ∀ k : ℕ, (-1 : A) ^ k * lam k * τ (d - k) =
        ∑ i : Fin r, g i * ((-1 : A) ^ k * lam k * σ ((((i : ℕ) : ℤ) + d) - k)) := by
      intro k
      simp only [τ, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
      rw [show (((i : ℕ) : ℤ) + (d - (k : ℤ))) = (((i : ℕ) : ℤ) + d) - k by ring]
      ring
    simp only [e1]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ ↦ ?_
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hrec _ (by omega), mul_zero]
  
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.1 hg
  have hτev : ∀ t : ℤ, (M : ℤ) ≤ t → τ t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    have h := hM t.toNat (by omega)
    rw [show ((t.toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) = t by omega] at h
    exact h
  
  have hu : IsUnit ((-1 : A) ^ r * lam r) := (isUnit_one.neg.pow r).mul hlamr
  have key : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ t : ℤ, (M : ℤ) - j ≤ t → 1 - (r : ℤ) ≤ t → τ t = 0 := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => intro t ht _; exact hτev t (by simpa using ht)
    | succ j ih =>
      intro t ht1 ht2
      push_cast at ht1
      by_cases h : (M : ℤ) - j ≤ t
      · exact ih t h ht2
      · have hr' := hτrec (t + r) (by omega)
        rw [Finset.sum_range_succ] at hr'
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun k hk ↦ by
          simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hk
          rw [ih _ (by omega) (by omega), mul_zero]), zero_add,
          show t + (r : ℤ) - (r : ℤ) = t by ring] at hr'
        exact hu.mul_right_eq_zero.1 hr'
  have hback : ∀ t : ℤ, 1 - (r : ℤ) ≤ t → τ t = 0 := fun t ht ↦
    key (Int.toNat ((M : ℤ) - t)) t (by omega) ht
  
  have step : ∀ i : Fin r, (∀ j : Fin r, i < j → g j = 0) → g i = 0 := by
    intro i hi
    have h0 := hback (-((i : ℕ) : ℤ)) (by have := i.isLt; omega)
    have hs : τ (-((i : ℕ) : ℤ)) = g i := by
      simp only [τ]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
      · rw [show (((i : ℕ) : ℤ) + -((i : ℕ) : ℤ)) = 0 by ring, hσ0, mul_one]
      · intro j _ hji
        rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hji with hlt | hgt
        · have hlt' : (j : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) := hlt
          rw [hσneg _ (by have := i.isLt; omega) (by omega), mul_zero]
        · rw [hi j hgt, zero_mul]
      · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ i) h
    rw [← hs]
    exact h0
  have main : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ i : Fin r, r - 1 - (i : ℕ) = k → g i = 0 := by
    intro k
    induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | _ k ih =>
      intro i hik
      refine step i fun j hij ↦ ?_
      have hij' : (i : ℕ) < (j : ℕ) := hij
      have := j.isLt
      exact ih (r - 1 - (j : ℕ)) (by omega) j rfl
  funext i
  exact main _ i rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.germ_sum_smul
statement:
theorem germ_sum_smul {A ι α : Type*} [CommRing A] [Fintype ι] (l : Filter α) (g : ι → A)
    (f : ι → α → A) :
    ∑ i, g i • ((f i : α → A) : Filter.Germ l A) =
      ((fun m ↦ ∑ i, g i * f i m : α → A) : Filter.Germ l A)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hf : (fun m ↦ ∑ i, g i * f i m : α → A) = ∑ i, g i • f i := by
    funext m
    simp [Finset.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have key : ∀ s : Finset ι, ((∑ i ∈ s, g i • f i : α → A) : Filter.Germ l A) =
      ∑ i ∈ s, g i • ((f i : α → A) : Filter.Germ l A) := by
    intro s
    refine Finset.induction_on s ?_ ?_
    · simp
    · intro a s ha ih
      rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha, Filter.Germ.coe_add, ih,
        Filter.Germ.coe_smul]
  rw [hf, key]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.bijective_of_rankOne
statement:
theorem bijective_of_rankOne {R A : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] (φ : R →+* A)
    (e : A ≃+ R) (he : ∀ r x, e (φ r * x) = r * e x) : Function.Bijective φ
proof:
:= by
  set a := e.symm 1 with ha
  have hea : e a = 1 := e.apply_symm_apply 1
  have hx : ∀ x, x = φ (e x) * a := fun x ↦ by
    apply e.injective
    rw [he, hea, mul_one]
  have hr : ∀ r, e (φ r * a) = r := fun r ↦ by rw [he, hea, mul_one]
  constructor
  · intro r s h
    rw [← hr r, ← hr s, h]
  · set c := e 1
    set d := e (a * a)
    have h1 : (1 : A) = φ c * a := hx 1
    have h2 : a * a = φ d * a := hx (a * a)
    have h3 : a = φ (c * d) * a := by
      calc a = 1 * a := (one_mul a).symm
        _ = φ c * (a * a) := by rw [h1, mul_assoc]
        _ = φ (c * d) * a := by rw [h2, map_mul, mul_assoc]
    have hcd : c * d = 1 := by
      have := congrArg e h3
      rw [hr, hea] at this
      exact this.symm
    have hd : φ d = a := by
      calc φ d = φ d * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
        _ = φ (c * d) * a := by rw [h1, ← mul_assoc, ← map_mul, mul_comm d c]
        _ = a := by rw [hcd, map_one, one_mul]
    intro x
    refine ⟨e x * d, ?_⟩
    rw [map_mul, hd, ← hx]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.K0Basis.acyclic_chart
statement:
theorem acyclic_chart (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (n : ℕ)
    (W : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Modules) (hW : IsFiniteLocallyFree _ W) (p : ℕ) (d : ℤ)
    (hd : -(n : ℤ) ≤ d) :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n)
      (moduleTwist R n ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj W) d) (p + 1))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hW
  haveI : W.IsFinitePresentation := hW.isFinitePresentation
  haveI : W.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  let Qm : ModuleCat.{u} R := (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj W
  haveI : Module.FinitePresentation R Qm := moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation W
  haveI : Module.Finite R Qm := inferInstance
  let c := (tilde.adjunction (R := CommRingCat.of R)).counit.app W
  have hc : IsIso c := Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent W
  let e1 : projectiveBaseModuleTilde R Qm ≅ W := @asIso _ _ _ _ c hc
  let e2 : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj W ≅ projectiveBaseModulePullback R n Qm :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).mapIso e1.symm
  let e3 : moduleTwist R n ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj W) d ≅
      projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n Qm d :=
    tensorSheafSymmetry (space R n) _ _ ≪≫ tensorSheafMapIso (space R n) (Iso.refl _) e2
  exact Quillen.R_iso R n e3.symm (p + 1) (Quillen.baseModule_vanishing R n Qm p d hd)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.K0Basis.pushforward_isZero_of_subsingleton_sections
statement:
theorem pushforward_isZero_of_subsingleton_sections (F : (space R n).Modules)
    [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    [Subsingleton ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj F))] :
    IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj F)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isQuasicoherent_pushforward_toSpec R n F
  exact EulerIndependence.isZero_of_quasicoherent _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.K0Basis.twistingSheaf_pushforward_isZero_of_neg
statement:
theorem twistingSheaf_pushforward_isZero_of_neg [IsNoetherianRing R] (hn : 0 < n) (d : ℤ)
    (hd : d < 0) :
    IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := projectiveTwistingSheaf_isQuasicoherent R n d
  haveI := projectiveTwistingSheaf_H_zero_subsingleton_of_neg R n hn d hd
  have e := projectiveModuleHZeroLinearEquivSections R n (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d)
  haveI : Subsingleton ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d))) :=
    e.symm.toEquiv.subsingleton
  exact pushforward_isZero_of_subsingleton_sections R n _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.K0Basis.twistingSheaf_pushforward_isZero_of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem twistingSheaf_pushforward_isZero_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton R] (d : ℤ) :
    IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := projectiveTwistingSheaf_isQuasicoherent R n d
  haveI : Subsingleton ↑(CommRingCat.of R) := inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton R)
  haveI : Subsingleton ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d))) :=
    Module.subsingleton (CommRingCat.of R) _
  exact pushforward_isZero_of_subsingleton_sections R n _

name: SchemeKTheory.exists_shortExact_of_iso
statement:
theorem exists_shortExact_of_iso {𝒞 : Type*} [Category 𝒞] [Preadditive 𝒞]
    {A B D A' B' D' : 𝒞} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ D) (w : f ≫ g = 0)
    (hS : (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact) (eA : A ≅ A') (eB : B ≅ B') (eD : D ≅ D') :
    ∃ (f' : A' ⟶ B') (g' : B' ⟶ D') (w' : f' ≫ g' = 0),
      (ShortComplex.mk f' g' w').ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨eA.inv ≫ f ≫ eB.hom, eB.inv ≫ g ≫ eD.hom, by simp [reassoc_of% w], ?_⟩
  exact ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso
    (ShortComplex.isoMk eA eB eD (by simp) (by simp)) hS

name: SchemeKTheory.exists_shortExact_exteriorPowerSheaf_succ_rankOne
statement:
theorem exists_shortExact_exteriorPowerSheaf_succ_rankOne {K F L : Y.Modules}
    (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1)
    (f : K ⟶ F) (g : F ⟶ L) (zero : f ≫ g = 0) (hS : (ShortComplex.mk f g zero).ShortExact)
    (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ (f' : exteriorPowerSheaf Y K (n + 1) ⟶ exteriorPowerSheaf Y F (n + 1))
      (g' : exteriorPowerSheaf Y F (n + 1) ⟶ tensorSheaf Y (exteriorPowerSheaf Y K n) L)
      (w' : f' ≫ g' = 0), (ShortComplex.mk f' g' w').ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Fu := underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y
  let sh := moduleSheafification Y
  let Kp : ModulePresheaf Y := Fu.obj K
  let Fp : ModulePresheaf Y := Fu.obj F
  let Lp : ModulePresheaf Y := Fu.obj L
  let fp : Kp ⟶ Fp := Fu.map f
  let gp : Fp ⟶ Lp := Fu.map g
  let A := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower Kp (n + 1)
  let B := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower Fp (n + 1)
  let αp : A ⟶ B := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPowerMap fp (n + 1)
  let Λ := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower Kp n
  let kk : Λ ⊗ Kp ⟶ Λ ⊗ Fp := Λ ◁ fp
  let vD : Λ ⊗ Fp ⟶ Λ ⊗ Lp := Λ ◁ gp
  let φp : Λ ⊗ Fp ⟶ B := wedgeTensorMap fp n
  let ψK : Λ ⊗ Kp ⟶ A := wedgeTensorMap (𝟙 Kp) n
  let vC : Λ ⊗ Fp ⟶ cokernel αp := φp ≫ cokernel.π αp
  have hkD : kk ≫ vD = 0 := by
    apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
    intro W
    rw [PresheafOfModules.comp_app]
    apply exteriorPower_tensor_hom_ext
    intro κ z
    have h0 : gp.app W (fp.app W z) = 0 := (sections_leftExact Y f g zero hS W).2.2 z
    change ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk κ ⊗ₜ gp.app W (fp.app W z) =
      (0 : Λ ⊗ Kp ⟶ Λ ⊗ Lp).app W (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk κ ⊗ₜ z)
    rw [h0, TensorProduct.tmul_zero]
    rfl
  have hfac : kk ≫ φp = ψK ≫ αp := by
    apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
    intro W
    rw [PresheafOfModules.comp_app, PresheafOfModules.comp_app]
    apply exteriorPower_tensor_hom_ext
    intro κ z
    change φp.app W (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk κ ⊗ₜ fp.app W z) =
      αp.app W (ψK.app W (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk κ ⊗ₜ z))
    rw [wedgeTensorMap_app, wedgeTensorMap_app]
    change _ = ModuleCat.exteriorPower.map (fp.app W) (n + 1) _
    rw [ModuleCat.exteriorPower.map_mk, Fin.comp_snoc]
    rfl
  have hkC : kk ≫ vC = 0 := by
    simp only [vC, ← Category.assoc, hfac]
    simp only [Category.assoc, cokernel.condition, comp_zero]
  let uD : cokernel kk ⟶ Λ ⊗ Lp := cokernel.desc kk vD hkD
  let uC : cokernel kk ⟶ cokernel αp := cokernel.desc kk vC hkC
  have hloc := fun x : Y ↦ exists_local_splitting_rankOne Y f g zero hS hL x
  choose U hU hdata using hloc
  have hglob := sections_leftExact Y f g zero hS
  have key : ∀ (x : Y) (W : Y.Opens), W ≤ U x →
      Function.Injective (αp.app (op W)) ∧ Function.Bijective (uD.app (op W)) ∧
        Function.Bijective (uC.app (op W)) := by
    intro x W hW
    obtain ⟨⟨s, hs⟩, e, he⟩ := hdata x W hW
    obtain ⟨hinj, hex, hgf⟩ := hglob (op W)
    obtain ⟨r, hrf, hdec⟩ := exists_retraction (fp.app (op W)).hom (gp.app (op W)).hom
      s.hom hinj hgf hex hs
    have hsurj : Function.Surjective (gp.app (op W)).hom := fun l ↦ ⟨s l, hs l⟩
    have hexact : Function.Exact (fp.app (op W)).hom (gp.app (op W)).hom := fun y ↦
      ⟨fun h ↦ hex y h, by rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩; exact hgf k⟩
    have hφ : ∀ (κ : Fin n → Kp.obj (op W)) (y : Fp.obj (op W)),
        (φp.app (op W)).hom (exteriorPower.ιMulti _ n κ ⊗ₜ y) =
          exteriorPower.ιMulti _ (n + 1) (Fin.snoc ((fp.app (op W)).hom ∘ κ) y) :=
      fun κ y ↦ wedgeTensorMap_app fp n (op W) κ y
    have hgen : ∀ y : Fp.obj (op W), ∃ (k : Kp.obj (op W))
        (a : ((Y.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).obj (op W))),
        y = (fp.app (op W)).hom k + a • s e := by
      intro y
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := he ((gp.app (op W)).hom y)
      refine ⟨r y, a, ?_⟩
      have h1 := hdec y
      rw [ha, map_smul] at h1
      exact h1
    have hπ : Function.Surjective ((cokernel.π αp).app (op W)) := by
      have : Epi ((PresheafOfModules.evaluation _ (op W)).map (cokernel.π αp)) := inferInstance
      exact (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).1 this
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact exteriorPower.map_injective r (LinearMap.ext hrf)
    · apply cokernelDesc_app_bijective
      · exact LinearMap.lTensor_surjective _ hsurj
      · intro y hy
        exact (lTensor_exact _ hexact hsurj y).1 hy
    · apply cokernelDesc_app_bijective
      · intro c
        obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hπ c
        have hb := mem_range_map_sup_range_wedge (fp.app (op W)).hom n (φp.app (op W)).hom hφ
          (s e) hgen b
        obtain ⟨y1, ⟨z, rfl⟩, y2, ⟨x', rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hb
        refine ⟨x', ?_⟩
        have h0 : (cokernel.π αp).app (op W) (αp.app (op W) z) = 0 := by
          rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← PresheafOfModules.comp_app, cokernel.condition]
          rfl
        change (cokernel.π αp).app (op W) ((φp.app (op W)) x') =
          (cokernel.π αp).app (op W) ((αp.app (op W)) z + (φp.app (op W)) x')
        rw [map_add, h0, zero_add]
      · intro x' hx'
        obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_app_eq_of_cokernel_π_app_eq_zero αp (op W) _ hx'
        have h1 := lTensor_eq_zero_of_wedge_eq_map (fp.app (op W)).hom (gp.app (op W)).hom r n
          hgf hrf
          (φp.app (op W)).hom hφ x' z hz.symm
        exact (lTensor_exact _ hexact hsurj x').1 h1
  have hmono : Mono (sh.map αp) :=
    mono_moduleSheafification_map_of_injective_on_cover αp U hU (fun x W h ↦ (key x W h).1)
  have hWD : moduleLocalEquivalences Y uD :=
    moduleLocalEquivalences_of_bijective_on_cover uD U hU (fun x W h ↦ (key x W h).2.1)
  have hWC : moduleLocalEquivalences Y uC :=
    moduleLocalEquivalences_of_bijective_on_cover uC U hU (fun x W h ↦ (key x W h).2.2)
  haveI : IsIso (sh.map uD) := Localization.inverts sh (moduleLocalEquivalences Y) uD hWD
  haveI : IsIso (sh.map uC) := Localization.inverts sh (moduleLocalEquivalences Y) uC hWC
  let eD : tensorSheaf Y (exteriorPowerSheaf Y K n) L ≅ sh.obj (Λ ⊗ Lp) := by
    letI : MonoidalCategory Y.Modules := localizedMonoidalCategory Y
    exact tensorSheafIsoLocalizedTensor Y (sh.obj Λ) L ≪≫
      (Iso.refl (sh.obj Λ) ⊗ᵢ ((asIso (PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
        (structurePresheafId Y)).counit).app L).symm) ≪≫
      Localization.Monoidal.μ sh (moduleLocalEquivalences Y) (moduleTensorUnitIso Y) Λ Lp
  let eC : sh.obj (cokernel αp) ≅ tensorSheaf Y (exteriorPowerSheaf Y K n) L :=
    (asIso (sh.map uC)).symm ≪≫ asIso (sh.map uD) ≪≫ eD.symm
  have hzero : sh.map αp ≫ sh.map (cokernel.π αp) = 0 := by
    rw [← sh.map_comp, cokernel.condition, sh.map_zero]
  have hSE : (ShortComplex.mk (sh.map αp) (sh.map (cokernel.π αp)) hzero).ShortExact := by
    refine { exact := ?_, mono_f := hmono, epi_g := inferInstance }
    have h0 : (ShortComplex.mk αp (cokernel.π αp) (cokernel.condition αp)).Exact :=
      ShortComplex.exact_of_g_is_cokernel _ (cokernelIsCokernel αp)
    exact h0.map sh
  exact exists_shortExact_of_iso (A' := exteriorPowerSheaf Y K (n + 1))
    (B' := exteriorPowerSheaf Y F (n + 1)) _ _ hzero hSE (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) eC

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.pushClass_eq
statement:
theorem pushClass_eq (G : C.scheme.Modules) (h : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (push C G)) :
    pushClass C G = k0ClassOf X (push C G) h
proof:
:= by
  unfold pushClass
  rw [dif_pos h]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.pushClass_iso
statement: theorem pushClass_iso {G G' : C.scheme.Modules} (e : G ≅ G') : pushClass C G = pushClass C G'
proof:
:= by
  have e' : push C G ≅ push C G' := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.toBase).mapIso e
  by_cases h : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (push C G)
  · have h' := isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso X e' h
    rw [pushClass_eq C G h, pushClass_eq C G' h']
    exact k0ClassOf_iso X h h' e'
  · have h' : ¬ IsFiniteLocallyFree X (push C G') :=
      fun h' ↦ h (isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso X e'.symm h')
    unfold pushClass
    rw [dif_neg h, dif_neg h']

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.pushClass_of_isZero
statement:
theorem pushClass_of_isZero {G : C.scheme.Modules} (hZ : IsZero (push C G)) :
    pushClass C G = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (push C G) :=
    isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso X hZ.isoZero.symm (zero_isFiniteLocallyFree X)
  rw [pushClass_eq C G h]
  exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_isZero X.Modules (IsFiniteLocallyFree X) h hZ

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.exists_shortExact_of_functor_obj_eq
statement:
theorem exists_shortExact_of_functor_obj_eq {𝒜 : Type*} [Category 𝒜] [Abelian 𝒜] (F : 𝒜 ⥤ 𝒜)
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F] {A B D : 𝒜}
    (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ D) (w : f ≫ g = 0) (hS : (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact)
    {A' B' D' : 𝒜} (hA : F.obj A = A') (hB : F.obj B = B') (hD : F.obj D = D') :
    ∃ (f' : A' ⟶ B') (g' : B' ⟶ D') (w' : f' ≫ g' = 0),
      (ShortComplex.mk f' g' w').ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  subst hA hB hD
  exact ⟨F.map f, F.map g, ((ShortComplex.mk f g w).map F).zero,
    ShortComplex.ShortExact.map_of_exact hS F⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.twist_shortExact
statement:
theorem twist_shortExact {A B D : C.scheme.Modules} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ D) (w : f ≫ g = 0)
    (hS : (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact) (m : ℤ) :
    ∃ (f' : twist C A m ⟶ twist C B m) (g' : twist C B m ⟶ twist C D m) (w' : f' ≫ g' = 0),
      (ShortComplex.mk f' g' w').ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  let F := tensorSheafRightFunctor C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf m)
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits F :=
    tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits C.scheme _
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree m)
  letI : PreservesFiniteColimits F :=
    tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits C.scheme _
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree m)
  exact exists_shortExact_of_functor_obj_eq F f g w hS rfl rfl rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.higher_isZero_of_iso
statement:
theorem higher_isZero_of_iso {G G' : C.scheme.Modules} (e : G ≅ G') (q : ℕ)
    (h : IsZero (higher C G q)) : IsZero (higher C G' q)
proof:
:=
  h.of_iso (BundleRegularity.higherDirectImageIso C e q).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.higher_isZero_of_isZero
statement:
theorem higher_isZero_of_isZero {G : C.scheme.Modules} (hG : IsZero G) (q : ℕ) :
    IsZero (higher C G q)
proof:
:=
  Functor.map_isZero
    (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor C.toBase q) hG

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.pushforward_shortExact_of_higher_isZero
statement:
theorem pushforward_shortExact_of_higher_isZero {A B D : C.scheme.Modules}
    (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ D) (w : f ≫ g = 0) (hS : (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact)
    (hA1 : IsZero (higher C A 1)) :
    ∃ (f' : push C A ⟶ push C B) (g' : push C B ⟶ push C D) (w' : f' ≫ g' = 0),
      (ShortComplex.mk f' g' w').ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  let S := ShortComplex.mk f g w
  let P := Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.toBase
  have adj := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction C.toBase
  haveI : P.IsRightAdjoint := adj.isRightAdjoint
  haveI : Mono f := hS.mono_f
  have hex : (S.map P).Exact := hS.exact.map_of_mono_of_preservesKernel P hS.mono_f inferInstance
  have hw := SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalLongExactSheafification₂_exact C.toBase S hS 0
  have hepi0 : Epi ((SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor
      C.toBase 0).map g) :=
    hw.epi_f (hA1.eq_of_tgt _ _)
  have hepi : Epi (P.map g) :=
    (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.epi_affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor_zero_map_iff
      C.toBase g).1 hepi0
  refine ⟨P.map f, P.map g, (S.map P).zero, ?_⟩
  exact { exact := hex, mono_f := P.map_mono f, epi_g := hepi }

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.higher_isZero_of_shortExact
statement:
theorem higher_isZero_of_shortExact {A B D : C.scheme.Modules}
    (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ D) (w : f ≫ g = 0) (hS : (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact) (q : ℕ)
    (hBq : IsZero (higher C B (q + 1))) (hAq : IsZero (higher C A (q + 2))) :
    IsZero (higher C D (q + 1))
proof:
:=
  (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalLongExactSheafification₂_exact C.toBase
    (ShortComplex.mk f g w) hS (q + 1)).isZero_of_both_zeros
    (hBq.eq_of_src _ _) (hAq.eq_of_tgt _ _)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.twist_pullback_tensor_iso
statement:
theorem twist_pullback_tensor_iso (V : X.Modules) (F : C.scheme.Modules) (m : ℤ) :
    Nonempty (twist C (tensorSheaf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj V) F) m ≅
      tensorSheaf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj V) (twist C F m))
proof:
:=
  ⟨tensorSheafAssociator C.scheme _ _ _⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.twist_canonical_iso
statement:
theorem twist_canonical_iso (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) (a b : ℤ) :
    Nonempty (twist C (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf a) b ≅ C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (a + b))
proof:
:=
  ⟨SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.twistingTensorIso C hpos a b⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.pushClass_pullback_tensor
statement:
theorem pushClass_pullback_tensor (V : X.Modules)
    (hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree X V) (G : C.scheme.Modules) (hG : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (push C G)) :
    pushClass C (tensorSheaf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj V) G) =
      k0ClassOf X V hV * pushClass C G
proof:
:= by
  let e := (projectionFormulaIso C.toBase V hV G).symm
  have h' : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (tensorSheaf X V (push C G)) :=
    tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree X _ _ hV hG
  have h'' := isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso X e.symm h'
  rw [pushClass_eq C _ h'', pushClass_eq C G hG, k0ClassOf_iso X h'' h' e]
  exact (k0ClassOf_mul X ⟨V, hV⟩ ⟨push C G, hG⟩).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.pushClass_add_of_acyclic
statement:
theorem pushClass_add_of_acyclic [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    {A B D : C.scheme.Modules}
    (hA : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme A) (hB : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme B)
    (hD : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme D)
    (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ D) (w : f ≫ g = 0) (hS : (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact)
    (hvA : ∀ q : ℕ, IsZero (higher C A (q + 1))) (hvB : ∀ q : ℕ, IsZero (higher C B (q + 1)))
    (hvD : ∀ q : ℕ, IsZero (higher C D (q + 1))) :
    pushClass C B = pushClass C A + pushClass C D
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f', g', w', hS'⟩ := pushforward_shortExact_of_higher_isZero C f g w hS (hvA 0)
  have pA := SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushforward_isFiniteLocallyFree C hpos A hA hvA
  have pB := SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushforward_isFiniteLocallyFree C hpos B hB hvB
  have pD := SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushforward_isFiniteLocallyFree C hpos D hD hvD
  rw [pushClass_eq C A pA, pushClass_eq C B pB, pushClass_eq C D pD]
  exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_middle X.Modules (IsFiniteLocallyFree X) pA pB pD w'
    hS'

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.eventually_regular
statement:
theorem eventually_regular [IsNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    (F : C.scheme.Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme F) :
    ∀ᶠ m : ℕ in Filter.atTop, IsMumfordRegular C (twist C F m) 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀⟩ := SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.exists_isMumfordRegular C hpos F hF
  have hle : ∀ m : ℤ, m₀ ≤ m → IsMumfordRegular C F m := by
    intro m hm
    induction m, hm using Int.leInduction with
    | base => exact hm₀
    | succ n _ ih =>
      exact SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.isMumfordRegular_succ C hpos F hF n ih
  filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop m₀.toNat] with m hm
  exact (SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.isMumfordRegular_twist_iff C hpos F m).mp
    (hle m (by omega))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.hilbertFun_add
statement:
theorem hilbertFun_add [IsNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    {A B D : C.scheme.Modules}
    (hA : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme A) (hB : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme B)
    (hD : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme D)
    (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ D) (w : f ≫ g = 0) (hS : (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact) :
    hilbertFun C B =ᶠ[Filter.atTop] hilbertFun C A + hilbertFun C D
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_regular C hpos A hA, eventually_regular C hpos B hB,
    eventually_regular C hpos D hD] with m hmA hmB hmD
  obtain ⟨f', g', w', hS'⟩ := twist_shortExact C f g w hS m
  have tA := twist_isFiniteLocallyFree C A hA m
  have tB := twist_isFiniteLocallyFree C B hB m
  have tD := twist_isFiniteLocallyFree C D hD m
  exact pushClass_add_of_acyclic C hpos tA tB tD f' g' w' hS'
    (SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.higherDirectImage_isZero_of_isMumfordRegular
      C hpos _ tA hmA)
    (SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.higherDirectImage_isZero_of_isMumfordRegular
      C hpos _ tB hmB)
    (SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.higherDirectImage_isZero_of_isMumfordRegular
      C hpos _ tD hmD)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.hilbertFun_pullback_tensor
statement:
theorem hilbertFun_pullback_tensor [IsNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    (V : X.Modules) (hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree X V)
    (F : C.scheme.Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme F) :
    hilbertFun C (tensorSheaf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj V) F)
      =ᶠ[Filter.atTop] fun m ↦ k0ClassOf X V hV * hilbertFun C F m
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_regular C hpos F hF] with m hm
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := twist_pullback_tensor_iso C V F m
  have tF := twist_isFiniteLocallyFree C F hF m
  have hp := SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushforward_isFiniteLocallyFree C hpos _ tF
    (SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.higherDirectImage_isZero_of_isMumfordRegular
      C hpos _ tF hm)
  change pushClass C _ = k0ClassOf X V hV * pushClass C _
  rw [pushClass_iso C e]
  exact pushClass_pullback_tensor C V hV _ hp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.pb_mul_classOf
statement:
theorem pb_mul_classOf (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) (V : X.Modules)
    (hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree X V) (F : C.scheme.Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme F) :
    C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos (k0ClassOf X V hV) * k0ClassOf C.scheme F hF =
      k0ClassOf C.scheme (tensorSheaf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj V) F)
        (tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme _ _
          (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global C.toBase V hV) hF)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Flat C.toBase := C.toBase_flat hpos
  have h1 : C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos (k0ClassOf X V hV) =
      k0ClassOf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj V)
        (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global C.toBase V hV) := by
    change flatPullbackK0RingHom C.toBase (k0ClassOf X V hV) = _
    rw [flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply, flatPullbackK0_classOf]
  rw [h1]
  exact k0ClassOf_mul C.scheme ⟨_, pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global C.toBase V hV⟩ ⟨F, hF⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.exists_hilbertGerm_of
statement:
theorem exists_hilbertGerm_of (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    (hadd : ∀ {A B D : C.scheme.Modules}
      (_hA : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme A) (_hB : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme B)
      (_hD : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme D)
      (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ D) (w : f ≫ g = 0), (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact →
        hilbertFun C B =ᶠ[Filter.atTop] hilbertFun C A + hilbertFun C D)
    (hpt : ∀ (V : X.Modules) (hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree X V)
      (F : C.scheme.Modules) (_hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme F),
      hilbertFun C (tensorSheaf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj V) F)
        =ᶠ[Filter.atTop] fun m ↦ k0ClassOf X V hV * hilbertFun C F m)
    (hk0m : ∀ (V : X.Modules) (hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree X V)
      (F : C.scheme.Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme F),
      C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos (k0ClassOf X V hV) * k0ClassOf C.scheme F hF =
        k0ClassOf C.scheme (tensorSheaf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj V) F)
          (tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme _ _
            (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global C.toBase V hV) hF)) :
    letI
proof:
:= C.projectiveBundleK0Algebra hpos
    ∃ Φ : K0 C.scheme →ₗ[K0 X] Filter.Germ (Filter.atTop : Filter ℕ) (K0 X),
      ∀ (F : C.scheme.Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme F),
        Φ (k0ClassOf C.scheme F hF) =
          ((hilbertFun C F : ℕ → K0 X) : Filter.Germ (Filter.atTop : Filter ℕ) (K0 X)) := by
  letI := C.projectiveBundleK0Algebra hpos
  letI : AddCommGroup (K0 X) := (instCommRingK0 X).toAddCommGroup
  let fgen : {M : C.scheme.Modules // IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme M} →
      Filter.Germ (Filter.atTop : Filter ℕ) (K0 X) :=
    fun E ↦ ((hilbertFun C E.1 : ℕ → K0 X) : Filter.Germ (Filter.atTop : Filter ℕ) (K0 X))
  have hrel : ∀ A B D, ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn C.scheme.Modules
      (IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme) A B D → fgen B = fgen A + fgen D := by
    rintro ⟨A, hA⟩ ⟨B, hB⟩ ⟨D, hD⟩ ⟨f, g, w, hS⟩
    exact (Filter.Germ.coe_eq.2 (hadd hA hB hD f g w hS)).trans (Filter.Germ.coe_add _ _)
  let Φ₀ := ExactGrothendieck.lift fgen hrel
  have hΦ₀ : ∀ (F : C.scheme.Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme F),
      Φ₀ (k0ClassOf C.scheme F hF) =
        ((hilbertFun C F : ℕ → K0 X) : Filter.Germ (Filter.atTop : Filter ℕ) (K0 X)) := by
    intro F hF
    have h := ExactGrothendieck.lift_classOf fgen hrel ⟨F, hF⟩
    exact h
  have hadd₀ : ∀ x y : K0 C.scheme, Φ₀ (x + y) = Φ₀ x + Φ₀ y := fun x y ↦ by
    exact map_add Φ₀ x y
  have hneg₀ : ∀ x : K0 C.scheme, Φ₀ (-x) = -Φ₀ x := fun x ↦ by
    exact map_neg Φ₀ x
  have hzero₀ : Φ₀ (0 : K0 C.scheme) = 0 := by
    exact map_zero Φ₀
  have key : ∀ (x : K0 C.scheme) (a : K0 X),
      Φ₀ (C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos a * x) = a • Φ₀ x := by
    intro x
    refine k0_induction C.scheme
      (fun x ↦ ∀ a : K0 X, Φ₀ (C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos a * x) = a • Φ₀ x)
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ x
    · intro a
      rw [mul_zero, hzero₀, smul_zero]
    · intro x y hx hy a
      rw [mul_add, hadd₀, hx a, hy a, hadd₀, smul_add]
    · intro x hx a
      rw [mul_neg, hneg₀, hx a, hneg₀, smul_neg]
    · intro F hF a
      refine k0_induction X
        (fun a ↦ Φ₀ (C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos a * k0ClassOf C.scheme F hF) =
          a • Φ₀ (k0ClassOf C.scheme F hF)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ a
      · rw [map_zero, zero_mul, hzero₀, zero_smul]
      · intro a b ha hb
        rw [map_add, add_mul, hadd₀, ha, hb]
        exact (add_smul a b _).symm
      · intro a ha
        rw [map_neg, neg_mul, hneg₀, ha]
        exact (neg_smul a _).symm
      · intro V hV
        rw [hk0m V hV F hF, hΦ₀, hΦ₀]
        rw [Filter.Germ.coe_eq.2 (hpt V hV F hF)]
        rfl
  refine ⟨{ toFun := fun x ↦ Φ₀ x
            map_add' := hadd₀
            map_smul' := fun a x ↦ ?_ }, fun F hF ↦ hΦ₀ F hF⟩
  change Φ₀ (a • x) = a • Φ₀ x
  rw [Algebra.smul_def]
  exact key x a

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.exists_hilbertGerm
statement:
theorem exists_hilbertGerm [IsNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) :
    letI
proof:
:= C.projectiveBundleK0Algebra hpos
    ∃ Φ : K0 C.scheme →ₗ[K0 X] Filter.Germ (Filter.atTop : Filter ℕ) (K0 X),
      ∀ (F : C.scheme.Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme F),
        Φ (k0ClassOf C.scheme F hF) =
          ((hilbertFun C F : ℕ → K0 X) : Filter.Germ (Filter.atTop : Filter ℕ) (K0 X)) :=
  exists_hilbertGerm_of C hpos (hilbertFun_add C hpos) (hilbertFun_pullback_tensor C hpos)
    (pb_mul_classOf C hpos)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.z_pow
statement:
theorem z_pow (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) (j : ℕ) :
    C.tautologicalK0Class ^ j = C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class j
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp [C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_zero]
  | succ j ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, ih, tautologicalK0Class, C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_mul hpos]
    push_cast
    rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.hilbertGerm_z_pow
statement:
theorem hilbertGerm_z_pow (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    (Φ : K0 C.scheme → Filter.Germ (Filter.atTop : Filter ℕ) (K0 X))
    (hΦ : ∀ (F : C.scheme.Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme F),
      Φ (k0ClassOf C.scheme F hF) =
        ((hilbertFun C F : ℕ → K0 X) : Filter.Germ (Filter.atTop : Filter ℕ) (K0 X))) (j : ℕ) :
    Φ (C.tautologicalK0Class ^ j) =
      ((fun m : ℕ ↦ hilbertTwist C ((j : ℤ) + (m : ℤ)) : ℕ → K0 X) :
        Filter.Germ (Filter.atTop : Filter ℕ) (K0 X))
proof:
:= by
  rw [z_pow C hpos j, SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class, hΦ]
  congr 1
  funext m
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := twist_canonical_iso C hpos (j : ℤ) (m : ℤ)
  exact pushClass_iso C e

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.tautKernel_hasConstantRank
statement:
theorem tautKernel_hasConstantRank {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    HasConstantRank C.scheme (tautKernel C) (r - 1)
proof:
:=
  hasConstantRank_kernel C.scheme (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase E r hE)
    (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) C.tautologicalQuotient

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.unitMap_app
statement:
theorem unitMap_app (V : X.Opens) (r : Γ(X, V)) :
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (unitMap C) V r =
      (show Γ(pushUnitP C, V) from C.toBase.app V r)
proof:
:= by
  change (C.toBase.app V r : Γ(C.scheme, C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ V)) * 1 = _
  exact mul_one _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.restrict_unitMap_isIso_of_iso
statement:
theorem restrict_unitMap_isIso_of_iso (i : C.I)
    (Ei : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.U i).ι).obj (pushUnitP C) ≅
      SheafOfModules.unit (C.U i).toScheme.ringCatSheaf) :
    IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.U i).ι).map (unitMap C))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.isIso_iff_isIso_app]
  intro W
  let V : X.Opens := (C.U i).ι ''ᵁ W
  let α : Γ((C.U i).toScheme, W) ≅ Γ(X, V) := ((C.U i).ι.appIso W).symm
  let φ : Γ((C.U i).toScheme, W) →+* Γ(C.scheme, C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
    (C.toBase.app V).hom.comp α.hom.hom
  have hl : ∀ x, Ei.inv.app W (Ei.hom.app W x) = x := fun x ↦ by
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, Ei.hom_inv_id]
    rfl
  have hr : ∀ x, Ei.hom.app W (Ei.inv.app W x) = x := fun x ↦ by
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, Ei.inv_hom_id]
    rfl
  let e : Γ(C.scheme, C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ V) ≃+ Γ((C.U i).toScheme, W) :=
    { toFun := fun x ↦ Ei.hom.app W x
      invFun := fun x ↦ Ei.inv.app W x
      left_inv := fun x ↦ hl x
      right_inv := fun x ↦ hr x
      map_add' := fun x y ↦ map_add (Ei.hom.app W).hom x y }
  have he : ∀ r x, e (φ r * x) = r * e x := fun r x ↦
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul Ei.hom r x
  have hφ := bijective_of_rankOne φ e he
  have hfun : ∀ y : Γ(X, V), ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.U i).ι).map
      (unitMap C)).app W y = φ (α.inv y) := fun y ↦ by
    change Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (unitMap C) V y = _
    rw [unitMap_app]
    change _ = C.toBase.app V (α.hom (α.inv y))
    rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_apply]
  rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
  have hα : Function.Bijective α.inv := ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso α.inv
  exact (show _ = _ from funext hfun) ▸ hφ.comp hα

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.unitMap_isIso
statement: theorem unitMap_isIso (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) : IsIso (unitMap C)
proof:
:= by
  have hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop C.U :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := X) C.U).2 C.covers
  refine moduleHom_isIso_of_over_cover (unitMap C) C.U hU fun i ↦ ?_
  haveI := restrict_unitMap_isIso_of_iso C i (pushUnitRestrictIso C hpos i)
  exact SchemeProjectiveBundle.overMap_isIso_of_restrictMap (unitMap C) (C.U i)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.hilbertTwist_zero
statement:
theorem hilbertTwist_zero (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) :
    hilbertTwist C 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  let e : unitX (X := X) ≅ push C (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 0) :=
    pushforwardUnitIso C hpos ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.toBase).mapIso C.canonicalTwistingSheafZeroIso.symm
  have h : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (push C (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 0)) :=
    isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso X e (tensorUnitSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree X)
  unfold hilbertTwist pushClass
  rw [dif_pos h]
  calc _ = k0ClassOf X (tensorUnitSheaf X) (tensorUnitSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree X) :=
        (k0ClassOf_iso X _ _ e).symm
    _ = 1 := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.pushforward_canonical_isZero_of_neg
statement:
theorem pushforward_canonical_isZero_of_neg [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) {r : ℕ}
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) (t : ℤ) (ht₀ : -(r : ℤ) < t) (ht : t < 0) :
    IsZero (push C (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf t))
proof:
:= by
  refine BundleQuillen.isZero_of_restrict _ (fun i : C.I ↦ Spec Γ(X, C.U i))
    (fun i ↦ (C.isAffine i).fromSpec) ?_ ?_
  · intro y
    have hy : y ∈ (⨆ i, C.U i : X.Opens) := by
      rw [C.covers]
      trivial
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.1 hy
    have hy' : y ∈ Set.range (C.isAffine i).fromSpec := by
      rw [(C.isAffine i).range_fromSpec]
      exact hi
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hy'
    exact ⟨i, z, hz⟩
  · intro i
    obtain ⟨n, ⟨e⟩⟩ := BundleRegularity.hrank C hpos i
    refine IsZero.of_iso ?_ (pushforwardRestrictIso C i e _ ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward _).mapIso (standardChartEmbTwistIso C i e t))
    rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial Γ(X, C.U i) with hsub | hnt
    · exact SchemeProjectiveSpace.K0Basis.twistingSheaf_pushforward_isZero_of_subsingleton _ n t
    · haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, C.U i) :=
        IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨C.U i, C.isAffine i⟩
      obtain ⟨y⟩ : Nonempty (Spec Γ(X, C.U i)) := PrimeSpectrum.nonempty_iff_nontrivial.2 hnt
      have hx : (C.isAffine i).fromSpec y ∈ C.U i := by
        change (C.isAffine i).fromSpec y ∈ ((C.U i : X.Opens) : Set X)
        rw [← (C.isAffine i).range_fromSpec]
        exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
      have hcard := BundleQuillen.card_eq C hE i _ hx
      have hr : r = n + 1 := by
        rw [← hcard, Nat.card_congr e, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fin]
      exact SchemeProjectiveSpace.K0Basis.twistingSheaf_pushforward_isZero_of_neg _ n (by omega) t
        ht

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.pullback_twist_acyclic
statement:
theorem pullback_twist_acyclic [IsNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) {r : ℕ}
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) (V : X.Modules) (hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree X V)
    (t : ℤ) (ht : 1 - (r : ℤ) ≤ t) (q : ℕ) :
    IsZero (higher C (twist C ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj V) t) (q + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hP := pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global C.toBase V hV
  refine BundleRegularity.isZero_of_chart C hpos _ (twist_isFiniteLocallyFree C _ hP t) (q + 1) ?_
  intro i n e
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, C.U i) :=
    IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨C.U i, C.isAffine i⟩
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial Γ(X, C.U i) with hsub | hnt
  · 
    refine affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_isZero_of_isBasis _ _ _
      (B := (∅ : Set (Spec Γ(X, C.U i)).Opens)) ?_ (by simp)
    rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd]
    intro U x _
    exfalso
    have hx : (x : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, C.U i)).asIdeal = ⊤ :=
      (Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).2 (by rw [Subsingleton.elim (1 : Γ(X, C.U i)) 0]; exact zero_mem _)
    exact (x : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, C.U i)).isPrime.ne_top hx
  · obtain ⟨y⟩ : Nonempty (Spec Γ(X, C.U i)) := PrimeSpectrum.nonempty_iff_nontrivial.2 hnt
    have hx : (C.isAffine i).fromSpec y ∈ C.U i := by
      change (C.isAffine i).fromSpec y ∈ ((C.U i : X.Opens) : Set X)
      rw [← (C.isAffine i).range_fromSpec]
      exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
    have hcard := BundleQuillen.card_eq C hE i _ hx
    have hrn : r = n + 1 := by
      rw [← hcard, Nat.card_congr e, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fin]
    have hW := BundleRegularity.restrict_isFiniteLocallyFree (C.isAffine i).fromSpec V hV
    have h := SchemeProjectiveSpace.K0Basis.acyclic_chart Γ(X, C.U i) n _ hW q t (by omega)
    exact SchemeProjectiveSpace.Quillen.R_iso _ n
      (BundleRegularity.twistIso C i e _ t ≪≫
        tensorSheafMapIso _ (chartPullbackIso C i e V) (Iso.refl _)).symm (q + 1) h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.twist_pullback_unit_iso
statement:
theorem twist_pullback_unit_iso (t : ℤ) :
    Nonempty (twist C ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)) t ≅ C.canonicalTwistingSheaf t)
proof:
:=
  ⟨tensorSheafMapIso C.scheme (pullbackObjUnitIso C.toBase) (Iso.refl _) ≪≫
    tensorSheafLeftUnitor C.scheme _⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.pushforward_canonical_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem pushforward_canonical_isFiniteLocallyFree [IsNoetherian X]
    (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r)
    (t : ℤ) (ht : 1 - (r : ℤ) ≤ t) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree X (push C (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf t))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := twist_pullback_unit_iso C t
  exact SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushforward_isFiniteLocallyFree C hpos _
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree t)
    fun q ↦ higher_isZero_of_iso C e (q + 1)
      (pullback_twist_acyclic C hpos hE _ (unit_isFiniteLocallyFree X) t ht q)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.taut_shortExact
statement:
theorem taut_shortExact :
    (ShortComplex.mk (kernel.ι C.tautologicalQuotient) C.tautologicalQuotient
      (kernel.condition _)).ShortExact where
  exact
proof:
:= ShortComplex.exact_of_f_is_kernel _ (kernelIsKernel C.tautologicalQuotient)
  mono_f := inferInstance
  epi_g := inferInstance

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.koszulFiltration_shortExact
statement:
theorem koszulFiltration_shortExact (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) {r : ℕ}
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) (j : ℕ) (t : ℤ) :
    ∃ (f : twist C (exteriorPowerSheaf C.scheme (tautKernel C) (j + 1)) t ⟶
          twist C ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj (exteriorPowerSheaf X E (j + 1))) t)
      (g : twist C ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj (exteriorPowerSheaf X E (j + 1))) t ⟶
          twist C (exteriorPowerSheaf C.scheme (tautKernel C) j) (t + 1))
      (w : f ≫ g = 0), (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f1, g1, w1, h1⟩ := exists_shortExact_exteriorPowerSheaf_succ_rankOne C.scheme
    (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) _ _ _ (taut_shortExact C) j
  obtain ⟨f2, g2, w2, h2⟩ := exists_shortExact_of_iso f1 g1 w1 h1 (Iso.refl _)
    (pullbackExteriorPowerIso C.toBase E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree (j + 1)).symm (Iso.refl _)
  obtain ⟨f3, g3, w3, h3⟩ := twist_shortExact C f2 g2 w2 h2 t
  exact exists_shortExact_of_iso f3 g3 w3 h3 (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _)
    (twistTwistIso C hpos (exteriorPowerSheaf C.scheme (tautKernel C) j) 1 t (t + 1)
      (by ring))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.exteriorPowerTautKernel_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem exteriorPowerTautKernel_isFiniteLocallyFree {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) (j : ℕ) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme (exteriorPowerSheaf C.scheme (tautKernel C) j)
proof:
:=
  exteriorPowerSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme _
    (tautKernel_hasConstantRank C hE).isFiniteLocallyFree j

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.koszulFiltration_acyclic
statement:
theorem koszulFiltration_acyclic [IsNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) {r : ℕ}
    (hr : 0 < r) (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ r) (t : ℤ)
    (ht : 1 - (j : ℤ) ≤ t) (q : ℕ) :
    IsZero (higher C (twist C (exteriorPowerSheaf C.scheme (tautKernel C) j) t) (q + 1))
proof:
:= by
  suffices H : ∀ k j : ℕ, j + k = r → ∀ (t : ℤ), 1 - (j : ℤ) ≤ t → ∀ q : ℕ,
      IsZero (higher C (twist C (exteriorPowerSheaf C.scheme (tautKernel C) j) t) (q + 1)) from
    H (r - j) j (by omega) t ht q
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro j hjk t _ q
    have hj' : j = r := by omega
    subst hj'
    have hΛ : IsZero (exteriorPowerSheaf C.scheme (tautKernel C) j) :=
      isZero_exteriorPowerSheaf_of_rank_lt C.scheme (tautKernel C) (j - 1)
        (tautKernel_hasConstantRank C hE) j (by omega)
    have hT : IsZero (twist C (exteriorPowerSheaf C.scheme (tautKernel C) j) t) := by
      have h := (tensorSheafRightFunctor C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf t)).map_isZero hΛ
      exact h
    exact higher_isZero_of_isZero C hT (q + 1)
  | succ k ih =>
    intro j hjk t ht q
    have hjr : j < r := by omega
    obtain ⟨f, g, w, hS⟩ := koszulFiltration_shortExact C hpos hE j (t - 1)
    have hΛE := exteriorPowerSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree X E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree (j + 1)
    have hB : IsZero (higher C (twist C ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj
        (exteriorPowerSheaf X E (j + 1))) (t - 1)) (q + 1)) :=
      pullback_twist_acyclic C hpos hE _ hΛE (t - 1) (by omega) q
    have hA : IsZero (higher C (twist C (exteriorPowerSheaf C.scheme (tautKernel C) (j + 1))
        (t - 1)) (q + 1 + 1)) :=
      ih (j + 1) (by omega) (t - 1) (by push_cast; omega) (q + 1)
    have h := higher_isZero_of_shortExact C f g w hS q hB hA
    have ht' : t - 1 + 1 = t := by omega
    rw [ht'] at h
    exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.kappa_zero
statement: theorem kappa_zero (t : ℤ) : kappa C 0 t = hilbertTwist C t
proof:
:=
  pushClass_iso C (twistZeroIso C t)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.kappa_top
statement:
theorem kappa_top {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) (t : ℤ) : kappa C r t = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hΛ : IsZero (exteriorPowerSheaf C.scheme (tautKernel C) r) :=
    isZero_exteriorPowerSheaf_of_rank_lt C.scheme (tautKernel C) (r - 1)
      (tautKernel_hasConstantRank C hE) r (by omega)
  have hT : IsZero (twist C (exteriorPowerSheaf C.scheme (tautKernel C) r) t) := by
    have h := (tensorSheafRightFunctor C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf t)).map_isZero hΛ
    exact h
  have hP : IsZero (push C (twist C (exteriorPowerSheaf C.scheme (tautKernel C) r) t)) :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.toBase).map_isZero hT
  exact pushClass_of_isZero C hP

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.kappa_step
statement:
theorem kappa_step [IsNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) {r : ℕ}
    (hr : 0 < r) (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < r) (t : ℤ) (ht : -(j : ℤ) ≤ t) :
    lambdaClass X E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree (j + 1) * hilbertTwist C t =
      kappa C (j + 1) t + kappa C j (t + 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, g, w, hS⟩ := koszulFiltration_shortExact C hpos hE j t
  have hΛ := exteriorPowerSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree X E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree (j + 1)
  have hadd := pushClass_add_of_acyclic C hpos
    (twist_isFiniteLocallyFree C _ (exteriorPowerTautKernel_isFiniteLocallyFree C hE _) t)
    (twist_isFiniteLocallyFree C _ (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global C.toBase _ hΛ) t)
    (twist_isFiniteLocallyFree C _ (exteriorPowerTautKernel_isFiniteLocallyFree C hE _) (t + 1))
    f g w hS
    (koszulFiltration_acyclic C hpos hr hE (j + 1) (by omega) t (by push_cast; omega))
    (pullback_twist_acyclic C hpos hE _ hΛ t (by omega))
    (koszulFiltration_acyclic C hpos hr hE j (by omega) (t + 1) (by omega))
  have hpf := pushClass_pullback_tensor C _ hΛ (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf t)
    (pushforward_canonical_isFiniteLocallyFree C hpos hE t (by omega))
  unfold kappa
  rw [← hadd]
  exact hpf.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.K0Basis.hilbertTwist_recurrence
statement:
theorem hilbertTwist_recurrence [IsNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) {r : ℕ}
    (hr : 0 < r) (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) (d : ℤ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), (-1 : K0 X) ^ k * lambdaClass X E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree k *
      hilbertTwist C (d - k) = 0
proof:
:=
  recurrence_of_filtration r (lambdaClass X E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree)
    (lambdaClass_zero X E _) (hilbertTwist C) (kappa C) (kappa_zero C) (kappa_top C hr hE)
    (fun j hj t ht ↦ kappa_step C hpos hr hE j hj t ht) d hd

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.linearIndependent_powers
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_powers [IsNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    letI
proof:
:= C.projectiveBundleK0Algebra hpos
    LinearIndependent (K0 X) (fun i : Fin r ↦ C.tautologicalK0Class ^ (i : ℕ)) := by
  letI := C.projectiveBundleK0Algebra hpos
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦ⟩ := exists_hilbertGerm C hpos
  letI : AddCommGroup (K0 C.scheme) := (instCommRingK0 C.scheme).toAddCommGroup
  refine Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mpr fun g hg ↦ ?_
  have h1 := congrArg Φ hg
  rw [map_sum, map_zero] at h1
  simp only [map_smul, hilbertGerm_z_pow C hpos Φ hΦ] at h1
  rw [germ_sum_smul] at h1
  have h2 : ∀ᶠ m : ℕ in Filter.atTop,
      ∑ i : Fin r, g i * hilbertTwist C (((i : ℕ) : ℤ) + (m : ℤ)) = 0 := by
    have h3 := Filter.Germ.coe_eq.mp (h1.trans Filter.Germ.coe_zero.symm)
    filter_upwards [h3] with m hm
    exact hm
  have hσneg : ∀ t : ℤ, -(r : ℤ) < t → t < 0 → hilbertTwist C t = 0 := fun t ht₀ ht ↦
    pushClass_of_isZero C (pushforward_canonical_isZero_of_neg C hpos hE t ht₀ ht)
  have hg0 := eq_zero_of_eventually_recurrence r (lambdaClass X E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree)
    (isUnit_lambdaClass_top X E r hE) (hilbertTwist C)
    (hilbertTwist_zero C hpos) hσneg (hilbertTwist_recurrence C hpos hr hE) g h2
  intro i
  rw [hg0]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.projectiveBundleK0Basis_apply
statement:
theorem projectiveBundleK0Basis_apply [IsNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) (i : Fin r) :
    letI
proof:
:= C.projectiveBundleK0Algebra hpos
    C.projectiveBundleK0Basis hpos hr hE i = C.tautologicalK0Class ^ (i : ℕ) := by
  letI := C.projectiveBundleK0Algebra hpos
  exact Module.Basis.mk_apply _ _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.exists_dualCoordinates
statement:
theorem exists_dualCoordinates [IsNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    letI
proof:
:= C.projectiveBundleK0Algebra hpos
    ∃ φ : K0 C.scheme →ₗ[K0 X] (Fin r → K0 X),
      ∀ j : Fin r, φ (C.tautologicalK0Class ^ (j : ℕ)) = Pi.single j 1 := by
  letI := C.projectiveBundleK0Algebra hpos
  let b := C.projectiveBundleK0Basis hpos hr hE
  refine ⟨b.equivFun.toLinearMap, fun j ↦ ?_⟩
  have hb : b j = C.tautologicalK0Class ^ (j : ℕ) := C.projectiveBundleK0Basis_apply hpos hr hE j
  rw [LinearEquiv.coe_coe, ← hb]
  ext k
  simp [Pi.single_apply, eq_comm]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.projectiveBundlePullbackK0_injective
statement:
theorem projectiveBundlePullbackK0_injective [IsNoetherian X]
    (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    Function.Injective (C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos)
proof:
:= by
  letI := C.projectiveBundleK0Algebra hpos
  letI : AddCommGroup (K0 C.scheme) := (instCommRingK0 C.scheme).toAddCommGroup
  have hli := C.linearIndependent_powers hpos hr hE
  refine (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).2 fun a ha ↦ ?_
  have h := linearIndependent_iff'.1 hli {⟨0, hr⟩} (fun _ ↦ a) (by
    rw [Finset.sum_singleton]
    change a • C.tautologicalK0Class ^ (0 : ℕ) = 0
    rw [pow_zero, Algebra.smul_def, mul_one]
    exact ha) ⟨0, hr⟩ (Finset.mem_singleton_self _)
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.projectiveBundleK0Equiv_xi
statement:
theorem projectiveBundleK0Equiv_xi [IsNoetherian X] [Nontrivial (K0 X)]
    (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    letI
proof:
:= C.projectiveBundleK0Algebra hpos
    C.projectiveBundleK0Equiv hpos hr hE (chernXi (K0 X) r (lambdaChernCoeffs hE)) =
      C.tautologicalK0Class := by
  letI := C.projectiveBundleK0Algebra hpos
  exact ProjectiveBundleFormulaModel.equivOfBasis_xi _ _ _ _ _ _ _

name: ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.LineFilt.isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem LineFilt.isFiniteLocallyFree {W : Y.Modules} {m : Multiset (K0 Y)} (h : LineFilt Y W m) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree Y W
proof:
:= by
  cases h with
  | zero h => exact h.isFiniteLocallyFree
  | line h => exact h.isFiniteLocallyFree
  | step hF _ _ _ _ _ _ => exact hF

name: ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.LineFilt.of_iso
statement:
theorem LineFilt.of_iso {W W' : Y.Modules} {m : Multiset (K0 Y)} (h : LineFilt Y W m)
    (e : W ≅ W') : LineFilt Y W' m
proof:
:= by
  induction h generalizing W' with
  | zero h => exact LineFilt.zero (hasConstantRank_of_iso e h)
  | @line W h =>
    have h' := hasConstantRank_of_iso e h
    have := LineFilt.line h'
    rwa [show k0ClassOf Y W' h'.isFiniteLocallyFree = k0ClassOf Y W h.isFiniteLocallyFree from
      (k0ClassOf_iso Y h.isFiniteLocallyFree h'.isFiniteLocallyFree e).symm] at this
  | @step K F L m hF hL f g w hS hK ih =>
    refine LineFilt.step (isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso Y e hF) hL (f ≫ e.hom) (e.inv ≫ g) ?_ ?_ hK
    · rw [Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc e.hom, e.hom_inv_id, Category.id_comp, w]
    · refine ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso ?_ hS
      exact ShortComplex.isoMk (Iso.refl _) e (Iso.refl _)
        (by simp) (by simp)

name: ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.lambdaSeries_of_lineFilt
statement:
theorem lambdaSeries_of_lineFilt {W : Y.Modules} {m : Multiset (K0 Y)} (h : LineFilt Y W m)
    (hW : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y W) :
    lambdaSeries Y W hW =
      (m.map fun x => (1 + PowerSeries.C x * PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries (K0 Y))).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | zero h =>
    ext n
    simp only [Multiset.map_zero, Multiset.prod_zero, coeff_lambdaSeries]
    rcases n with _ | n
    · simp [lambdaClass_zero]
    · rw [lambdaClass_eq_zero_of_rank_lt Y _ 0 h (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)]
      simp
  | @line W h =>
    simpa using lambdaSeries_rankOne Y W h
  | @step K F L m hF hL f g w hS hK ih =>
    rw [lambdaSeries_shortExact hK.isFiniteLocallyFree hF hL.isFiniteLocallyFree f g w hS,
      lambdaSeries_rankOne Y L hL, ih hK.isFiniteLocallyFree, Multiset.map_cons,
      Multiset.prod_cons, mul_comm]

name: ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.natDegree_prod_one_add_le
statement:
theorem natDegree_prod_one_add_le {A : Type*} [CommRing A] (m : Multiset A) :
    (m.map fun x => (1 + Polynomial.C x * Polynomial.X : Polynomial A)).prod.natDegree ≤
      Multiset.card m
proof:
:= by
  refine (Polynomial.natDegree_multiset_prod_le _).trans ?_
  rw [Multiset.map_map]
  calc (m.map ((Polynomial.natDegree) ∘ fun x => (1 + Polynomial.C x * Polynomial.X : Polynomial A))).sum
      ≤ (m.map fun _ => 1).sum := by
        refine Multiset.sum_map_le_sum_map _ _ fun x _ => ?_
        simp only [Function.comp_apply]
        compute_degree
    _ = Multiset.card m := by simp

name: ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.koszulProd
statement:
theorem koszulProd {W : Y.Modules} {m : Multiset (K0 Y)} (h : LineFilt Y W m)
    (hW : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y W) {r : ℕ} (hr : Multiset.card m = r) :
    lamMinus Y W hW r = (m.map fun x => 1 - x).prod
proof:
:= by
  set P : Polynomial (K0 Y) :=
    (m.map fun x => (1 + Polynomial.C x * Polynomial.X : Polynomial (K0 Y))).prod with hP
  have hser : lambdaSeries Y W hW = (P : PowerSeries (K0 Y)) := by
    rw [lambdaSeries_of_lineFilt h hW, hP]
    have := map_multiset_prod (Polynomial.coeToPowerSeries.ringHom (R := K0 Y))
      (m.map fun x => (1 + Polynomial.C x * Polynomial.X : Polynomial (K0 Y)))
    rw [Multiset.map_map] at this
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, map_add, map_one, map_mul,
      Polynomial.coeToPowerSeries.ringHom_apply, Polynomial.coe_C, Polynomial.coe_X] at this
    exact this.symm
  have hcoeff : ∀ n, lambdaClass Y W hW n = P.coeff n := fun n => by
    rw [← coeff_lambdaSeries, hser, Polynomial.coeff_coe]
  have hdeg : P.natDegree < r + 1 := by
    have : P.natDegree ≤ Multiset.card m := natDegree_prod_one_add_le m
    omega
  have hev := Polynomial.eval_eq_sum_range' hdeg (-1 : K0 Y)
  unfold lamMinus
  have : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), (-1 : K0 Y) ^ n * lambdaClass Y W hW n =
      P.eval (-1) := by
    rw [hev]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
    rw [hcoeff, mul_comm]
  rw [this, hP, Polynomial.eval_multiset_prod, Multiset.map_map]
  refine congrArg Multiset.prod (Multiset.map_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_)
  simp [sub_eq_add_neg]

name: ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.LineFilt.twist
statement:
theorem LineFilt.twist {W : Y.Modules} {m : Multiset (K0 Y)} (h : LineFilt Y W m) :
    LineFilt Y (twistBy M W) (m.map fun x => x * k0ClassOf Y M hM.isFiniteLocallyFree)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | @zero W h =>
    simpa using LineFilt.zero (hasConstantRank_twistBy M hM h)
  | @line W h =>
    have h' := hasConstantRank_twistBy M hM h
    have := LineFilt.line h'
    simpa [k0ClassOf_twistBy M hM h.isFiniteLocallyFree h'.isFiniteLocallyFree] using this
  | @step K F L m hF hL f g w hS hK ih =>
    let T : Y.Modules ⥤ Y.Modules := tensorSheafRightFunctor Y M
    letI : PreservesFiniteLimits T :=
      tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits Y M hM.isFiniteLocallyFree
    letI : PreservesFiniteColimits T :=
      tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits Y M hM.isFiniteLocallyFree
    let SF := (ShortComplex.mk f g w).map T
    have hSF : SF.ShortExact := ShortComplex.ShortExact.map_of_exact hS T
    have hLM := hasConstantRank_twistBy M hM hL
    have hFM : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y (twistBy M F) := by
      rw [twistBy_eq]
      exact tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree Y F M hF hM.isFiniteLocallyFree
    have key : LineFilt Y (twistBy M F)
        (k0ClassOf Y (twistBy M L) hLM.isFiniteLocallyFree ::ₘ
          m.map fun x => x * k0ClassOf Y M hM.isFiniteLocallyFree) :=
      LineFilt.step (K := twistBy M K) (F := twistBy M F) (L := twistBy M L) hFM hLM
        SF.f SF.g SF.zero hSF ih
    rw [Multiset.map_cons,
      ← k0ClassOf_twistBy M hM hL.isFiniteLocallyFree hLM.isFiniteLocallyFree]
    exact key

name: ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.koszulProd_twist
statement:
theorem koszulProd_twist {W : Y.Modules} {m : Multiset (K0 Y)} (h : LineFilt Y W m)
    (hWM : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y (twistBy M W)) {r : ℕ} (hr : Multiset.card m = r) :
    lamMinus Y (twistBy M W) hWM r =
      (m.map fun x => 1 - x * k0ClassOf Y M hM.isFiniteLocallyFree).prod
proof:
:= by
  have := koszulProd (LineFilt.twist M hM h) hWM (r := r) (by rw [Multiset.card_map, hr])
  rw [this, Multiset.map_map]
  rfl

name: ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.map_koszulProd_twist
statement:
theorem map_koszulProd_twist {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (φ : K0 Y →+* R)
    {W : Y.Modules} {m : Multiset (K0 Y)} (h : LineFilt Y W m)
    (hWM : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y (twistBy M W)) {r : ℕ} (hr : Multiset.card m = r) :
    φ (lamMinus Y (twistBy M W) hWM r) =
      (m.map fun x => 1 - φ x * φ (k0ClassOf Y M hM.isFiniteLocallyFree)).prod
proof:
:= by
  rw [koszulProd_twist M hM h hWM hr, map_multiset_prod, Multiset.map_map]
  refine congrArg Multiset.prod (Multiset.map_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_)
  simp

name: ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.LineFilt.pullback
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | zero h => simpa using LineFilt.zero (hasConstantRank_pullback Z f _ 0 h)
  | @line W h =>
    have h' := hasConstantRank_pullback Z f W 1 h
    have := LineFilt.line h'
    simpa [flatPullbackK0_classOf] using this
  | @step K F L m hF hL f' g w hS hK ih =>
    haveI : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y K := hK.isFiniteLocallyFree
    haveI : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y F := hF
    haveI : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y L := hL.isFiniteLocallyFree
    let T : ShortComplex Y.Modules := ShortComplex.mk f' g w
    have hT := pullback_map_shortExact_global f T hS
    have key := LineFilt.step (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global f F hF)
      (hasConstantRank_pullback Z f L 1 hL) _ _ _ hT ih
    rw [Multiset.map_cons, flatPullbackK0_classOf]
    exact key

name: ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.card_stepClasses
statement:
theorem card_stepClasses (L : ℕ → Y.Modules) (L_line : ∀ i, HasConstantRank Y (L i) 1) (e : ℕ) :
    Multiset.card (stepClasses L L_line e) = e + 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [stepClasses]

name: ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.lineFilt_of_steps
statement:
theorem lineFilt_of_steps (F L : ℕ → Y.Modules) (F_vb : ∀ i, IsFiniteLocallyFree Y (F i))
    (L_line : ∀ i, HasConstantRank Y (L i) 1) (base : Nonempty (F 0 ≅ L 0)) (e : ℕ)
    (step : ∀ i < e, ∃ (a : F i ⟶ F (i + 1)) (b : F (i + 1) ⟶ L (i + 1)) (w : a ≫ b = 0),
      (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact) :
    LineFilt Y (F e) (stepClasses L L_line e)
proof:
:= by
  induction e with
  | zero =>
    obtain ⟨b⟩ := base
    have h := LineFilt.line (L_line 0)
    have h' := h.of_iso b.symm
    simpa [stepClasses] using h'
  | succ e ih =>
    obtain ⟨a, b, w, hS⟩ := step e (Nat.lt_succ_self e)
    have key := LineFilt.step (F_vb (e + 1)) (L_line (e + 1)) a b w hS
      (ih fun i hi => step i (by omega))
    have hset : stepClasses L L_line (e + 1) =
        k0ClassOf Y (L (e + 1)) (L_line (e + 1)).isFiniteLocallyFree ::ₘ
          stepClasses L L_line e := by
      simp only [stepClasses]
      rw [Finset.range_add_one, Finset.insert_val_of_notMem Finset.notMem_range_self,
        Multiset.map_cons]
    rw [hset]
    exact key

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionSubordinateAffine_neighborhood
statement:
theorem cosectionSubordinateAffine_neighborhood (y : Y) :
    ∃ i : cosectionSubordinateAffineIndex g, y ∈ i.1.2.1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨U,hU,rfl⟩, hyU, _⟩ :=
    X.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open (Set.mem_univ (g y)) isOpen_univ
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨V,hV,rfl⟩, hyV, hVU⟩ :=
    Y.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open
      (show y ∈ g ⁻¹ᵁ U from hyU) (g ⁻¹ᵁ U).isOpen
  exact ⟨⟨(⟨U,hU⟩,⟨V,hV⟩),hVU⟩,hyV⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionNativeZeroCentre_affine_categorical_isPullback
statement:
theorem cosectionNativeZeroCentre_affine_categorical_isPullback :
    IsPullback
      (pullback.snd
        (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
          (pulledCosection g σ)).subschemeι V.2.fromSpec)
      (pullback.fst
        (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
          (pulledCosection g σ)).subschemeι V.2.fromSpec ≫ pulledCosection_zeroCentreMap g E σ)
      (V.2.fromSpec ≫ g) (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ).subschemeι
proof:
:= by
  let hc := (cosectionZeroIdeal_chart_isPullback
    (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
      (pulledCosection g σ)) V).flip
  refine (cosectionNativeZeroCentre_affine_isPullback g U V h E σ).of_iso
    hc.isoPullback (.refl _) (.refl _) (.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
    exact hc.isoPullback_hom_snd.symm
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
    have hp := congrArg (fun f => f ≫ pulledCosection_zeroCentreMap g E σ) hc.isoPullback_hom_fst
    simpa only [Category.assoc] using hp.symm
  · simp
  · simp

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.pulledCosection_zeroCentreMap_isPullback
statement:
theorem pulledCosection_zeroCentreMap_isPullback :
    IsPullback
      (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
        (pulledCosection g σ)).subschemeι
      (pulledCosection_zeroCentreMap g E σ) g
      (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ).subschemeι
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.isPullback_of_openCover _ _ _ _ (cosectionSubordinateAffineCover g).openCover
  intro i
  have hc := cosectionNativeZeroCentre_affine_categorical_isPullback
    g i.1.1 i.1.2 i.2 E σ
  with_unfolding_all exact hc

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.pulledCosection_zeroCentrePullbackIso_fst
statement:
theorem pulledCosection_zeroCentrePullbackIso_fst :
    (pulledCosection_zeroCentrePullbackIso g E σ).hom ≫ pullback.fst _ _ =
      (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
        (pulledCosection g σ)).subschemeι
proof:
:=
  (pulledCosection_zeroCentreMap_isPullback g E σ).isoPullback_hom_fst

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.pulledCosection_zeroCentrePullbackIso_snd

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal_eq_comap
statement:
theorem quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal_eq_comap :
    quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E) (pulledCosection g σ) =
      (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ).comap g
proof:
:= by
  let J := quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E) (pulledCosection g σ)
  have hc := Scheme.Hom.ker_comp_of_isIso (pulledCosection_zeroCentrePullbackIso g E σ).hom
    (pullback.fst g (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ).subschemeι)
  have hj := congrArg Scheme.Hom.ker (pulledCosection_zeroCentrePullbackIso_fst g E σ)
  have hk := J.ker_subschemeι
  with_unfolding_all exact (hc.symm.trans (hj.trans hk)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.projBundle_pull_injective
statement:
theorem projBundle_pull_injective {e : ℕ} (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = e + 1) :
    haveI : Flat C.toBase
proof:
:= C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos e))
    Function.Injective (totalPull ops C.toBase e (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC)) := by
  haveI : Flat C.toBase := C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos e))
  intro α β h
  have h0 := segre_zero ops C cp hC
  have hα : segre ops C cp hC 0 α = α := by rw [h0]; rfl
  have hβ : segre ops C cp hC 0 β = β := by rw [h0]; rfl
  rw [← hα, ← hβ]
  change (totalPush ops C.toBase ∘ₗ ((xiCap ops C) ^ (e + 0)))
      (totalPull ops C.toBase e (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC) α) =
    (totalPush ops C.toBase ∘ₗ ((xiCap ops C) ^ (e + 0)))
      (totalPull ops C.toBase e (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC) β)
  rw [h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.exists_chowSplitting_of_injective
statement:
theorem exists_chowSplitting_of_injective (cp : ChowCompat ops)
    (hinj : ∀ {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)]
      [IsNoetherian X] {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E) {e : ℕ}
      (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = e + 1),
      haveI : Flat C.toBase := C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos e))
      Function.Injective (totalPull ops C.toBase e (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC)))
    (e : ℕ) : ∀ {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)]
      [IsNoetherian X] (E : X.Modules), HasConstantRank X E (e + 1) →
      Nonempty (ChowSplitting ops E e)
proof:
:= by
  induction e with
  | zero =>
    intro X _ _ _ E hE
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hE
    haveI : Flat C.toBase := C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos 0))
    have hP := hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase E 1 hE
    have hd0 := cp.projBundle_relDim C hC
    have hinj0 := hinj C hC
    exact ⟨{
      Y := C.scheme, q := C.toBase, d := 0, hd := hd0, injective := hinj0,
      F := fun _ ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj E,
      L := fun _ ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj E,
      F_vb := fun _ ↦ hP.isFiniteLocallyFree, L_line := fun _ ↦ hP, base := ⟨Iso.refl _⟩,
      step := fun i hi ↦ absurd hi (Nat.not_lt_zero i), top := ⟨Iso.refl _⟩ }⟩
  | succ e ih =>
    intro X _ _ _ E hE
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hE
    haveI : Flat C.toBase := C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos _))
    have hK := C.hasConstantRank_tautologicalKernel hE
    obtain ⟨S⟩ := ih C.tautologicalKernel hK
    have hpE := hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase E (e + 1 + 1) hE
    have hO := C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1
    have hd : PureRelDim (S.q ≫ C.toBase) ((e + 1) + S.d) :=
      PureRelDim.comp S.hd (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC)
    have hinjq : Function.Injective (totalPull ops (S.q ≫ C.toBase) ((e + 1) + S.d) hd) := by
      rw [cp.pull_comp S.q C.toBase S.d (e + 1) S.hd (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC) hd,
        LinearMap.coe_comp]
      exact S.injective.comp (hinj C hC)
    have hne : ∀ {i : ℕ}, i ≤ e → i ≠ e + 1 := fun h h' ↦ by omega
    refine ⟨{
      Y := S.Y, q := S.q ≫ C.toBase, d := (e + 1) + S.d, hd := hd,
      injective := hinjq,
      F := Function.update S.F (e + 1)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj E)),
      L := Function.update S.L (e + 1)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)),
      F_vb := ?_, L_line := ?_, base := ?_, step := ?_, top := ?_ }⟩
    · intro i
      rcases eq_or_ne i (e + 1) with rfl | hi
      · rw [Function.update_self]
        exact pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global _ _ hpE.isFiniteLocallyFree
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne hi]
        exact S.F_vb i
    · intro i
      rcases eq_or_ne i (e + 1) with rfl | hi
      · rw [Function.update_self]
        exact hasConstantRank_pullback _ S.q _ 1 hO
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne hi]
        exact S.L_line i
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne (hne (Nat.zero_le e)), Function.update_of_ne (hne (Nat.zero_le e))]
      exact S.base
    · intro i hi
      rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hi with hi | rfl
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne (hne hi.le), Function.update_of_ne (hne (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi)),
          Function.update_of_ne (hne (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi))]
        exact S.step i hi
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne (hne le_rfl), Function.update_self, Function.update_self]
        obtain ⟨φ⟩ := S.top
        haveI : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme C.tautologicalKernel := hK.isFiniteLocallyFree
        haveI : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj E) :=
          hpE.isFiniteLocallyFree
        haveI : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) := hO.isFiniteLocallyFree
        let T := ShortComplex.mk C.tautologicalKernelι C.tautologicalQuotient
          C.tautologicalKernelι_comp
        have hT := pullback_map_shortExact_global S.q T C.tautologicalKernel_shortExact
        refine ⟨φ.hom ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).map C.tautologicalKernelι,
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).map C.tautologicalQuotient, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, C.tautologicalKernelι_comp, Functor.map_zero,
            Limits.comp_zero]
        · refine ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso ?_ hT
          exact ShortComplex.isoMk φ.symm (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _)
            (by exact (φ.inv_hom_id_assoc _).trans (Category.comp_id _).symm)
            (by exact (Category.id_comp _).trans (Category.comp_id _).symm)
    · rw [Function.update_self]
      exact ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp S.q C.toBase).app E⟩
