name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIZSM.localSection_natural
statement:
theorem localSection_natural (f : R →+* S) (σ : M →ₛₗ[f] N)
    (hσ : Submodule.span S (Set.range σ) = ⊤) (φ : M →ₗ[R] R)
    (hφ : Submodule.span R (Set.range φ) = ⊤) (φ' : N →ₗ[S] S)
    (hφ' : Submodule.span S (Set.range φ') = ⊤) (hone : ∃ m, φ m = 1)
    (h : ∀ m, φ' (σ m) = f (φ m)) :
    localSection φ' hφ' ≫ semilinearSymmetricProjMap f σ hσ =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f) ≫ localSection φ hφ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hone
  have hL : Submodule.span S (Set.range (semilinearMapComp f (RingHom.id S) σ φ')) = ⊤ := by
    refine span_range_eq_top_of_one_mem _ ⟨n, ?_⟩
    change φ' (σ n) = 1
    rw [h, hn, map_one]
  have hR : Submodule.span S (Set.range (semilinearMapComp (RingHom.id R) f φ
      (ringHomSemilinear f))) = ⊤ := by
    refine span_range_eq_top_of_one_mem _ ⟨n, ?_⟩
    change f (φ n) = 1
    rw [hn, map_one]
  unfold localSection
  rw [reassoc_of% (specMap_comp_inv_rankOneToSpec f)]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  congr 1
  refine (semilinearSymmetricProjMap_comp _ _ _ _ _ _ hL).trans
    ((semilinearSymmetricProjMap_congr (RingHom.ext fun _ ↦ rfl) _ _ ?_ _ hR).trans
      (semilinearSymmetricProjMap_comp _ _ _ _ _ _ hR).symm)
  exact semilinearMap_heq_of_ringHom_eq (RingHom.ext fun _ ↦ rfl) _ _ fun m ↦ h m

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIZSM.chartSection_pullback
statement:
theorem chartSection_pullback (a : C.pullbackFrameIndex g) :
    (C.pullbackFrameCover g).chartSection q' hq' a ≫ C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a =
      C.pullbackFrameMap g a ≫ C.chartSection q hq a.1
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.obj (op (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a))) :=
    (C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionModule_free a
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.obj (op (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a))) :=
    (C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionModule_finite a
  have e1 : ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).isAffine a).isoSpec.hom ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (PullbackFrameSections.coefficientMap g (C.U a.1)
        (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a) a.2.2)) =
      C.pullbackFrameMap g a ≫ (C.isAffine a.1).isoSpec.hom := by
    have h : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (PullbackFrameSections.coefficientMap g (C.U a.1)
        (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a) a.2.2)) ≫ (C.isAffine a.1).isoSpec.inv =
        ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).isAffine a).isoSpec.inv ≫ C.pullbackFrameMap g a :=
      C.pullbackProjectiveChart_coefficient_toBase g a
    rw [← cancel_mono (C.isAffine a.1).isoSpec.inv, Category.assoc, Category.assoc,
      Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id, h, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  have hσ : ∀ m, quotientSectionMap q' (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a) (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap g a m)
      = PullbackFrameSections.coefficientMap g (C.U a.1) (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a) a.2.2
        (quotientSectionMap q (C.U a.1) m) := by
    intro m
    have h1 := PullbackFrameSections.sectionMap_naturality g q (C.U a.1)
      (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a) a.2.2 m
    have h2 := RiemannRoch.KNFS.pullbackUnitIso_sectionMap g (C.U a.1)
      (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a) a.2.2 ((q.val.app (op (C.U a.1))).hom m)
    change ((q'.val.app (op (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a))).hom) _ = _
    rw [hcomp]
    change ((AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso g).hom.val.app
      (op (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a))).hom
        ((((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map q).val.app (op (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a))).hom
          (PullbackFrameSections.sectionMap g E (C.U a.1) (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a) a.2.2 m)) = _
    rw [h1]
    exact h2
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hq (C.U a.1)
    (show (tensorUnitSheaf Y).val.obj (op (C.U a.1)) from (1 : Γ(Y, C.U a.1)))
  have hn' : quotientSectionMap q (C.U a.1) n = 1 := hn
  unfold chartSection
  rw [← Category.assoc (C.pullbackFrameMap g a), ← e1, Category.assoc]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  congr 1
  exact localSection_natural (PullbackFrameSections.coefficientMap g (C.U a.1)
      (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a) a.2.2) (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap g a) _
    (quotientSectionMap q (C.U a.1)) _ (quotientSectionMap q' (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)) _
    ⟨n, hn'⟩ hσ

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIZSM.quotientSection_pullback
statement:
theorem quotientSection_pullback :
    (C.pullbackFrameCover g).quotientSection q' hq' ≫ C.pullbackProjectiveMap g =
      g ≫ C.quotientSection q hq
proof:
:= by
  refine (C.pullbackFrameCover g).baseCover.hom_ext _ _ fun a ↦ ?_
  have h1 := (C.pullbackFrameCover g).baseCover_quotientSection q' hq' a
  have hb : (C.pullbackFrameCover g).baseCover.f a = (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a).ι := rfl
  have h2 := C.baseCover_quotientSection q hq a.1
  have h3 := C.pullbackFrameMap_comp_ι g a
  rw [← Category.assoc, h1, Category.assoc, pullbackProjectiveMap_chartι, ← Category.assoc,
    chartSection_pullback C g q hq q' hq' hcomp a, hb, ← Category.assoc, ← h3, Category.assoc,
    Category.assoc]
  have : (C.U a.1).ι ≫ C.quotientSection q hq = C.baseCover.f a.1 ≫ C.quotientSection q hq := rfl
  rw [this, h2]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIZSM.chartSection_transport
statement:
theorem chartSection_transport (i : C'.I) :
    (transport e C').chartSection q hq i ≫ (chartIso e C' i).hom = C'.chartSection q'' hq'' i
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C'.U i) (E'.val.obj (op (C'.U i))) := C'.sectionModule_free i
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C'.U i) (E'.val.obj (op (C'.U i))) := C'.sectionModule_finite i
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C'.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C'.U i))) :=
    (transport e C').sectionModule_free i
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C'.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C'.U i))) :=
    (transport e C').sectionModule_finite i
  unfold chartSection
  change (C'.isAffine i).isoSpec.hom ≫ localSection (quotientSectionMap q (C'.U i)) _ ≫
    (chartIsoOfLinearEquiv (sectionLinearEquivOfIso e (C'.U i))).hom = _
  congr 1
  unfold localSection
  rw [Category.assoc]
  congr 1
  set L := sectionLinearEquivOfIso e (C'.U i) with hLdef
  have hs : Submodule.span Γ(X, C'.U i) (Set.range (L.symm : E'.val.obj (op (C'.U i)) →ₗ[Γ(X, C'.U i)]
      E.val.obj (op (C'.U i)))) = ⊤ := by
    have h : Set.range (L.symm : E'.val.obj (op (C'.U i)) →ₗ[Γ(X, C'.U i)]
      E.val.obj (op (C'.U i))) = Set.univ := Set.range_eq_univ.mpr L.symm.surjective
    rw [h, Submodule.span_univ]
  have hh : semilinearMapComp (RingHom.id _) (RingHom.id _)
      (L.symm : E'.val.obj (op (C'.U i)) →ₗ[Γ(X, C'.U i)] E.val.obj (op (C'.U i)))
      (quotientSectionMap q (C'.U i)) = quotientSectionMap q'' (C'.U i) := by
    ext m
    change quotientSectionMap q (C'.U i) (L.symm m) = quotientSectionMap q'' (C'.U i) m
    have h : (e.hom.val.app (op (C'.U i))).hom ((e.inv.val.app (op (C'.U i))).hom m) = m :=
      congrArg (fun f : E' ⟶ E' => (f.val.app (op (C'.U i))).hom m) e.inv_hom_id
    have h2 : L.symm m = (e.inv.val.app (op (C'.U i))).hom m := rfl
    rw [h2, hqq]
    change (q''.val.app (op (C'.U i))).hom ((e.hom.val.app (op (C'.U i))).hom
      ((e.inv.val.app (op (C'.U i))).hom m)) = _
    rw [h]
    rfl
  have hL : Submodule.span Γ(X, C'.U i)
      (Set.range (semilinearMapComp (RingHom.id _) (RingHom.id _)
        (L.symm : E'.val.obj (op (C'.U i)) →ₗ[Γ(X, C'.U i)] E.val.obj (op (C'.U i)))
        (quotientSectionMap q (C'.U i)))) = ⊤ := by
    rw [hh]
    exact quotientSectionMap_spans q'' hq'' (C'.U i)
  have := semilinearSymmetricProjMap_comp (RingHom.id _) (RingHom.id _)
    (L.symm : E'.val.obj (op (C'.U i)) →ₗ[Γ(X, C'.U i)] E.val.obj (op (C'.U i)))
    (quotientSectionMap q (C'.U i)) hs (quotientSectionMap_spans q hq (C'.U i)) hL
  refine Eq.trans this ?_
  exact semilinearSymmetricProjMap_congr rfl _ _ (heq_of_eq hh) _ _

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIZSM.quotientSection_transport
statement:
theorem quotientSection_transport :
    (transport e C').quotientSection q hq ≫ (transportSchemeIso e C').hom =
      C'.quotientSection q'' hq''
proof:
:= by
  refine C'.baseCover.hom_ext _ _ fun i ↦ ?_
  have h1 := (transport e C').baseCover_quotientSection q hq i
  have h2 := C'.baseCover_quotientSection q'' hq'' i
  have h3 := chartι_transportSchemeHom e C' i
  have h4 := chartSection_transport e C' q q'' hqq hq hq'' i
  have hb : (transport e C').baseCover.f i = C'.baseCover.f i := rfl
  rw [← hb, ← Category.assoc, h1, Category.assoc]
  change _ ≫ (transport e C').chartι i ≫ transportSchemeHom e C' = _
  rw [h3, ← Category.assoc, h4, hb, h2]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIZSM.psi_snd

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIZSM.thetaIso_toBase
statement: theorem thetaIso_toBase : (thetaIso g CN).hom ≫ (Cz CN).toBase = (Ax g CN).toBase ≫ g
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := isoUnionLeft_toBase (Ax g CN) (Tx g CN)
  have h2 := isoUnionRight_toBase (Ax g CN) (Tx g CN)
  have h3 := transportSchemeIso_toBase (psi g (N := N)).symm (Dx g CN)
  have h4 := (Cz CN).pullbackProjectiveMap_toBase g
  have h5 : ((Ax g CN).isoUnionRight (Tx g CN)).inv ≫ (Tx g CN).toBase =
      ((Ax g CN).union (Tx g CN)).toBase := by
    rw [Iso.inv_comp_eq, h2]
  simp only [thetaIso, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, asIso_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [h4, reassoc_of% h3, reassoc_of% h5, ← h1]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIZSM.zeroSection_thetaIso
statement:
theorem zeroSection_thetaIso :
    (Ax g CN).zeroSection ≫ (thetaIso g CN).hom = g ≫ (Cz CN).zeroSection
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ∀ U : X.Opens, Function.Surjective
      ((biprod.snd : (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj N ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.app
        (op U)) := surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd
  have hL := KSpecialization.ARRHBCP.quotientSection_isoUnionLeft (Ax g CN) (Tx g CN) biprod.snd hs
  have hR := KSpecialization.ARRHBCP.quotientSection_isoUnionRight (Ax g CN) (Tx g CN) biprod.snd hs
  have e1 : (Ax g CN).zeroSection ≫ ((Ax g CN).isoUnionLeft (Tx g CN)).hom ≫
      ((Ax g CN).isoUnionRight (Tx g CN)).inv =
      (Tx g CN).quotientSection biprod.snd hs := by
    rw [← Category.assoc]
    have h0 : (Ax g CN).zeroSection = (Ax g CN).quotientSection biprod.snd hs := rfl
    rw [h0, hL, ← hR, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
  have hqq : (biprod.snd : (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj N ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) =
      (psi g (N := N)).symm.hom ≫ ((psi g (N := N)).hom ≫ biprod.snd) := by
    simp
  have e2 : (Tx g CN).quotientSection biprod.snd hs ≫
      (transportSchemeIso (psi g (N := N)).symm (Dx g CN)).hom =
      (Dx g CN).quotientSection ((psi g (N := N)).hom ≫ biprod.snd) (psi_surj g) :=
    quotientSection_transport (psi g (N := N)).symm (Dx g CN) biprod.snd
    ((psi g (N := N)).hom ≫ biprod.snd) hqq hs (psi_surj g)
  have e3 : (Dx g CN).quotientSection ((psi g (N := N)).hom ≫ biprod.snd) (psi_surj g) ≫
      (Cz CN).pullbackProjectiveMap g = g ≫ (Cz CN).zeroSection :=
    quotientSection_pullback (Cz CN) g biprod.snd
    (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd) ((psi g (N := N)).hom ≫ biprod.snd)
    (psi_surj g) (psi_snd g)
  simp only [thetaIso, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, asIso_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [reassoc_of% e1, reassoc_of% e2]
  exact e3

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.isIso_over_iSup
statement:
theorem isIso_over_iSup {X : Scheme.{u}} {A B : X.Modules} (φ : A ⟶ B) {J : Type u}
    (V : J → X.Opens) (h : ∀ j, IsIso (φ.over (V j))) : IsIso (φ.over (⨆ j, V j))
proof:
:= by
  rw [over_isIso_iff_restrictFunctor_map_isIso]
  refine isIso_of_restrictFunctor_cover (fun j ↦ ((V j : X.Opens) : Scheme.{u}))
    (fun j ↦ X.homOfLE (le_iSup V j)) ?_ ((restrictFunctor (⨆ j, V j).ι).map φ) ?_
  · rw [Opens.coversTop_iff]
    simp only [Scheme.opensRange_homOfLE]
    refine top_unique fun x _ ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp x.2
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨i, hi⟩
  · intro j
    have hj : IsIso ((restrictFunctor (V j).ι).map φ) :=
      (over_isIso_iff_restrictFunctor_map_isIso (V j) φ).1 (h j)
    have hcomp : X.homOfLE (le_iSup V j) ≫ (⨆ j, V j).ι = (V j).ι := Scheme.homOfLE_ι X _
    let e0 := restrictFunctorCongr hcomp
    let e1 := restrictFunctorComp (X.homOfLE (le_iSup V j)) (⨆ j, V j).ι
    have hG : IsIso ((restrictFunctor (X.homOfLE (le_iSup V j) ≫ (⨆ j, V j).ι)).map φ) := by
      have hn := e0.hom.naturality φ
      haveI : IsIso ((restrictFunctor (X.homOfLE (le_iSup V j) ≫ (⨆ j, V j).ι)).map φ ≫
          e0.hom.app B) := by
        rw [hn]; infer_instance
      exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right _ (e0.hom.app B)
    have hn := e1.hom.naturality φ
    haveI : IsIso (e1.hom.app A ≫
        (restrictFunctor (⨆ j, V j).ι ⋙ restrictFunctor (X.homOfLE (le_iSup V j))).map φ) := by
      rw [← hn]; infer_instance
    exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_left (e1.hom.app A)
      ((restrictFunctor (⨆ j, V j).ι ⋙ restrictFunctor (X.homOfLE (le_iSup V j))).map φ)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.endo_eq_mulSectionHom
statement:
theorem endo_eq_mulSectionHom (V : Y.Opens)
    (θ : (tensorUnitSheaf Y).over V ⟶ (tensorUnitSheaf Y).over V) :
    θ = LineBundleDual.mulSectionHom Y V
      (((SheafOfModules.evaluation (Y.ringCatSheaf.over V) (op (Over.mk (𝟙 V)))).map θ)
        (1 : Y.presheaf.obj (op V)))
proof:
:= by
  apply LineBundleLocalData.globalUnitOverHom_ext
  have h := LineBundleDual.mulSectionHom_app Y V
    (((SheafOfModules.evaluation (Y.ringCatSheaf.over V) (op (Over.mk (𝟙 V)))).map θ)
        (1 : Y.presheaf.obj (op V))) (op (Over.mk (𝟙 V))) (1 : Γ(Y, V))
  erw [h]
  have h1 : ∀ x : Γ(Y, V), Y.presheaf.map (Over.mk (𝟙 V)).hom.op x = x := fun x ↦ by
    change (Y.presheaf.map (𝟙 V).op) x = x
    rw [op_id, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
    rfl
  exact ((mul_one _).trans (h1 _)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.restrictHomOverLE_mulSectionHom
statement:
theorem restrictHomOverLE_mulSectionHom {V W : Y.Opens} (h : W ≤ V) (c : Γ(Y, V)) :
    restrictHomOverLE Y h (LineBundleDual.mulSectionHom Y V c) =
      LineBundleDual.mulSectionHom Y W (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op c)
proof:
:= by
  apply LineBundleDual.overHom_ext
  intro Z m
  change Γ(Y, Z.unop.left) at m
  change Y.presheaf.map (Z.unop.hom ≫ homOfLE h).op c * m =
    Y.presheaf.map Z.unop.hom.op (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op c) * m
  rw [op_comp, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.isIso_mulSectionHom
statement:
theorem isIso_mulSectionHom {V : Y.Opens} {r : Γ(Y, V)} (hr : IsUnit r) :
    IsIso (LineBundleDual.mulSectionHom Y V r)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hr
  refine ⟨LineBundleDual.mulSectionHom Y V ↑u⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← LineBundleDual.mulSectionHom_mul, u.inv_mul, LineBundleDual.mulSectionHom_one]
  · rw [← LineBundleDual.mulSectionHom_mul, u.mul_inv, LineBundleDual.mulSectionHom_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.isIso_over_of_isUnit_coeff
statement:
theorem isIso_over_of_isUnit_coeff {A B : Y.Modules} (φ : B ⟶ A) (V : Y.Opens)
    (eB : B.over V ≅ (tensorUnitSheaf Y).over V) (eA : A.over V ≅ (tensorUnitSheaf Y).over V)
    {W : Y.Opens} (h : W ≤ V) (hu : IsUnit (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (coeffAt φ V eB eA))) :
    IsIso (φ.over W)
proof:
:= by
  have hθ := endo_eq_mulSectionHom V (eB.inv ≫ φ.over V ≫ eA.hom)
  have h1 : restrictHomOverLE Y h (eB.inv ≫ φ.over V ≫ eA.hom) =
      LineBundleDual.mulSectionHom Y W (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (coeffAt φ V eB eA)) :=
    (congrArg (restrictHomOverLE Y h) hθ).trans (restrictHomOverLE_mulSectionHom h _)
  have hr : IsIso (restrictHomOverLE Y h (eB.inv ≫ φ.over V ≫ eA.hom)) := by
    rw [h1]; exact isIso_mulSectionHom hu
  rw [restrictHomOverLE_comp, restrictHomOverLE_comp, restrictHomOverLE_over] at hr
  have iB : IsIso (restrictHomOverLE Y h eB.inv) :=
    (LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE h eB.symm).isIso_hom
  have iA : IsIso (restrictHomOverLE Y h eA.hom) :=
    (LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE h eA).isIso_hom
  haveI := IsIso.of_isIso_comp_left (restrictHomOverLE Y h eB.inv)
    (φ.over W ≫ restrictHomOverLE Y h eA.hom)
  exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right (φ.over W) (restrictHomOverLE Y h eA.hom)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.coeffAt_eq
statement:
theorem coeffAt_eq {A B : Y.Modules} (φ : B ⟶ A) (V : Y.Opens)
    (eB : B.over V ≅ (tensorUnitSheaf Y).over V) (eA : A.over V ≅ (tensorUnitSheaf Y).over V) :
    coeffAt φ V eB eA = coefLE eA (φ.app V ((coefLE eB).symm (1 : Γ(Y, V))))
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.coef_map_eq
statement:
theorem coef_map_eq {A B : Y.Modules} (φ : B ⟶ A) (V : Y.Opens)
    (eB : B.over V ≅ (tensorUnitSheaf Y).over V) (eA : A.over V ≅ (tensorUnitSheaf Y).over V)
    (u : Γ(B, V)) :
    coefLE eA (φ.app V u) = coefLE eB u * coeffAt φ V eB eA
proof:
:= by
  have hu : u = coefLE eB u • (coefLE eB).symm (1 : Γ(Y, V)) := by
    rw [← LinearEquiv.map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    simp
  conv_lhs => rw [hu]
  have h1 : φ.app V (coefLE eB u • (coefLE eB).symm (1 : Γ(Y, V))) =
      coefLE eB u • φ.app V ((coefLE eB).symm (1 : Γ(Y, V))) :=
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul φ _ _
  erw [h1, (coefLE eA).map_smul, ← coeffAt_eq, smul_eq_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.exists_isIso_nbhd
statement:
theorem exists_isIso_nbhd {A B₁ B₂ : Y.Modules} (φ₁ : B₁ ⟶ A) (φ₂ : B₂ ⟶ A) (V : Y.Opens)
    (x : Y) (hx : x ∈ V) (e₁ : B₁.over V ≅ (tensorUnitSheaf Y).over V)
    (e₂ : B₂.over V ≅ (tensorUnitSheaf Y).over V) (eA : A.over V ≅ (tensorUnitSheaf Y).over V)
    (t : Γ(A, V)) (u₁ : Γ(B₁, V)) (u₂ : Γ(B₂, V))
    (ht : t = φ₁.app V u₁ + φ₂.app V u₂)
    (hgen : ∃ a : Γ(Y, V), (coefLE eA).symm (1 : Γ(Y, V)) = a • t) :
    ∃ W : Y.Opens, x ∈ W ∧ W ≤ V ∧ (IsIso (φ₁.over W) ∨ IsIso (φ₂.over W))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hgen
  have hτ : coefLE eA t =
      coefLE e₁ u₁ * coeffAt φ₁ V e₁ eA + coefLE e₂ u₂ * coeffAt φ₂ V e₂ eA := by
    have h2 := map_add (coefLE eA) (φ₁.app V u₁) (φ₂.app V u₂)
    rw [ht]
    erw [h2, coef_map_eq φ₁ V e₁ eA u₁, coef_map_eq φ₂ V e₂ eA u₂]
  have hunit : IsUnit (coefLE eA t) := by
    have h1 : (1 : Γ(Y, V)) = a * coefLE eA t := by
      have := congrArg (coefLE eA) ha
      erw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, (coefLE eA).map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at this
      exact this
    exact IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one a (by rw [mul_comm]; exact h1.symm)
  have hg : IsUnit (Y.presheaf.germ V x hx (coefLE eA t)) := hunit.map _
  rw [hτ, map_add] at hg
  rcases IsLocalRing.isUnit_or_isUnit_of_isUnit_add hg with h | h
  · rw [map_mul] at h
    have h' := (IsUnit.mul_iff.mp h).2
    have hxb : x ∈ Y.basicOpen (coeffAt φ₁ V e₁ eA) := (Y.mem_basicOpen _ x hx).mpr h'
    refine ⟨Y.basicOpen (coeffAt φ₁ V e₁ eA), hxb, Y.basicOpen_le _ |>.trans le_rfl, Or.inl ?_⟩
    exact isIso_over_of_isUnit_coeff φ₁ V e₁ eA (Y.basicOpen_le _)
      (Y.toRingedSpace.isUnit_res_basicOpen _)
  · rw [map_mul] at h
    have h' := (IsUnit.mul_iff.mp h).2
    have hxb : x ∈ Y.basicOpen (coeffAt φ₂ V e₂ eA) := (Y.mem_basicOpen _ x hx).mpr h'
    refine ⟨Y.basicOpen (coeffAt φ₂ V e₂ eA), hxb, Y.basicOpen_le _ |>.trans le_rfl, Or.inr ?_⟩
    exact isIso_over_of_isUnit_coeff φ₂ V e₂ eA (Y.basicOpen_le _)
      (Y.toRingedSpace.isUnit_res_basicOpen _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.exists_overTriv
statement:
theorem exists_overTriv {Z : Scheme.{u}} {N : Z.Modules} (h : HasConstantRank Z N 1) (x : Z) :
    ∃ V : Z.Opens, x ∈ V ∧ Nonempty (N.over V ≅ (tensorUnitSheaf Z).over V)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, -, hcard⟩ := h
  letI := hq
  have hcover : TopologicalSpace.IsOpenCover q.X := (Opens.coversTop_iff Z q.X).mp q.coversTop
  have hxU : x ∈ ⋃ i, (q.X i : Set Z) := by
    rw [hcover.iSup_set_eq_univ]; exact Set.mem_univ x
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hxU
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := hxU
  exact ⟨q.X i, hxi, LineBundleDual.exists_triv N q (hcard) i⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.a11GenericPoint_mem_basicOpen
statement:
theorem a11GenericPoint_mem_basicOpen (x : M) (hx : linearForm R M x ≠ 0)
    {f : SymmetricAlgebra R M} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    a11GenericPoint R M x hx ∈ Proj.basicOpen (symGrading R M) f
proof:
:=
  (Proj.mem_basicOpen (𝒜 := symGrading R M) (f := f) _).mpr
    (fun hmem ↦ hf (Ideal.mem_bot.mp hmem))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.a11GenericPoint_mem_of_isOpen
statement:
theorem a11GenericPoint_mem_of_isOpen (x : M) (hx : linearForm R M x ≠ 0)
    {u : Set (space R M)} (hu : IsOpen u) (hne : u.Nonempty) : a11GenericPoint R M x hx ∈ u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hne
  obtain ⟨U', hU', hyU', hle⟩ :=
    TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp
      (Proj.isBasis_basicOpen (symGrading R M)) (U := ⟨u, hu⟩) hy
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := hU'
  have hf : f ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    subst h0
    have := (Proj.mem_basicOpen (𝒜 := symGrading R M) (f := 0) y).mp hyU'
    exact this (Ideal.zero_mem _)
  exact hle (a11GenericPoint_mem_basicOpen R M x hx hf)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.a11_irreducibleSpace
statement:
theorem a11_irreducibleSpace (x : M) (hx : linearForm R M x ≠ 0) : IrreducibleSpace (space R M) where
  isPreirreducible_univ
proof:
:= by
    intro u v hu hv hune hvne
    refine ⟨a11GenericPoint R M x hx, Set.mem_univ _, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact a11GenericPoint_mem_of_isOpen R M x hx hu ⟨hune.choose, hune.choose_spec.2⟩
    · exact a11GenericPoint_mem_of_isOpen R M x hx hv ⟨hvne.choose, hvne.choose_spec.2⟩
  toNonempty := ⟨a11GenericPoint R M x hx⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D37.hasConstantRank_of_frameCover
proof:

            generators := fun i ↦ SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.equivOfIso (C.frame i)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tripleToChart_toAmbient
statement:
theorem tripleToChart_toAmbient (i j k : C.I) :
    C.tripleToChart i j k ≫ C.chartToAmbient j =
      pullback.snd (C.overlapToChart i j) (C.overlapToChart i k) ≫
        C.overlapToChart i k ≫ C.chartToAmbient i
proof:
:= by
  unfold tripleToChart
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← C.transition_toAmbient i j]
  rw [← Category.assoc, pullback.condition]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tripleToChart_range
statement:
theorem tripleToChart_range (i j k : C.I) :
    Set.range (C.tripleToChart i j k) ⊆
      Set.range (C.overlapToChart j k)
proof:
:= by
  rintro y ⟨x, rfl⟩
  let z : C.overlap i k :=
    pullback.snd (C.overlapToChart i j) (C.overlapToChart i k) x
  let b : X := C.chartToAmbient j (C.tripleToChart i j k x)
  have hbJ : b ∈ C.U j := by
    change C.chartToAmbient j (C.tripleToChart i j k x) ∈ C.U j
    rw [← C.chartToBase_comp_openImmersion j, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact (C.chartToBase j (C.tripleToChart i j k x)).2
  have hbase :
      C.chartToAmbient j (C.tripleToChart i j k x) =
        C.chartToAmbient i (C.overlapToChart i k z) := by
    simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using
      congrArg (fun f : C.tripleOverlap i j k ⟶ X ↦ f x)
        (C.tripleToChart_toAmbient i j k)
  have hbK : b ∈ C.U k := by
    change C.chartToAmbient j (C.tripleToChart i j k x) ∈ C.U k
    rw [hbase]
    have hIK :
        C.overlapToChart i k ≫ C.chartToAmbient i =
          C.overlapToIntersection i k ≫ (C.U i ⊓ C.U k).ι := by
      rw [← C.chartToBase_comp_openImmersion i, ← Category.assoc,
        C.overlapToChart_toBase]
      simp only [Category.assoc, Scheme.homOfLE_ι]
    rw [show C.chartToAmbient i (C.overlapToChart i k z) =
        (C.U i ⊓ C.U k).ι (C.overlapToIntersection i k z) by
      simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using
        congrArg (fun f : C.overlap i k ⟶ X ↦ f z) hIK]
    exact (C.overlapToIntersection i k z).2.2
  let q : (C.U j ⊓ C.U k).toScheme := ⟨b, hbJ, hbK⟩
  have hq :
      C.chartToBase j (C.tripleToChart i j k x) =
        X.homOfLE (inf_le_left : C.U j ⊓ C.U k ≤ C.U j) q := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (C.U j).ι
        (C.chartToBase j (C.tripleToChart i j k x)) =
      (C.U j).ι
        (X.homOfLE (inf_le_left : C.U j ⊓ C.U k ≤ C.U j) q)
    rw [show (C.U j).ι
          (C.chartToBase j (C.tripleToChart i j k x)) =
        C.chartToAmbient j (C.tripleToChart i j k x) by
      simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using
        congrArg (fun f : C.chart j ⟶ X ↦
          f (C.tripleToChart i j k x))
          (C.chartToBase_comp_openImmersion j)]
    rw [show (C.U j).ι
          (X.homOfLE (inf_le_left : C.U j ⊓ C.U k ≤ C.U j) q) =
        (C.U j ⊓ C.U k).ι q by
      simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using
        congrArg (fun f : (C.U j ⊓ C.U k).toScheme ⟶ X ↦ f q)
          (Scheme.homOfLE_ι X
            (inf_le_left : C.U j ⊓ C.U k ≤ C.U j))]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨t, ht, -⟩ := Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback
    (C.tripleToChart i j k x) q hq
  exact ⟨t, ht⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tripleFirstLeg_toChart
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem tripleFirstLeg_toChart (i j k : C.I) :

:=
  IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transitionTriple_fst

theorem transitionTriple_fst (i j k : C.I) :
    C.transitionTriple i j k ≫ pullback.fst _ _ =
      C.tripleFirstLeg i j k

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transitionTriple_fac

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistingSheafRestrictionComp_square_hom_eq
statement:
theorem twistingSheafRestrictionComp_square_hom_eq
    {R S T U M N P Q ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T] [CommRing U]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [AddCommGroup P] [Module T P] [Module.Free T P] [Module.Finite T P]
    [AddCommGroup Q] [Module U Q] [Module.Free U Q] [Module.Finite U Q]
    [Finite ι]
    {b : Module.Basis ι R M} {c : Module.Basis ι S N}
    {c' : Module.Basis ι T P} {e : Module.Basis ι U Q} {d : ℤ}
    {q : space S N ⟶ space R M} {r : space U Q ⟶ space S N}
    {q' : space T P ⟶ space R M} {r' : space U Q ⟶ space T P}
    [IsOpenImmersion q] [IsOpenImmersion r]
    [IsOpenImmersion q'] [IsOpenImmersion r']
    (hq : ∀ k, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b k) = linearOpen S N (c k))
    (hr : ∀ k, r ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen S N (c k) = linearOpen U Q (e k))
    (hq' : ∀ k, q' ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b k) = linearOpen T P (c' k))
    (hr' : ∀ k, r' ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen T P (c' k) = linearOpen U Q (e k))
    (h : r ≫ q = r' ≫ q')
    (Dq : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c d q)
    (Dr : TwistingSheafRestrictionData c e d r)
    (Dq' : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c' d q')
    (Dr' : TwistingSheafRestrictionData c' e d r')
    (hDq : Dq.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q hq).hom)
    (hDr : Dr.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso c e r hr).hom)
    (hDq' : Dq'.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c' q' hq').hom)
    (hDr' : Dr'.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso c' e r' hr').hom) :
    (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr h.symm).app
        (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d)) ≪≫
      twistingSheafRestrictionCompIso Dq Dr).hom =
      (twistingSheafRestrictionCompIso Dq' Dr').hom
proof:
:= by
  let Ds := twistingSheafRestrictionDataComp Dq' Dr'
  have hs : ∀ k, (r' ≫ q') ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b k) =
      linearOpen U Q (e k) := by
    intro k
    rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, hq' k, hr' k]
  have hDs : Ds.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b e (r' ≫ q') hs).hom := by
    simpa only [Ds, twistingSheafRestrictionDataComp,
      linearChartCochainsRestrictCompIso, Iso.trans_hom,
      Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.app_hom, hDq', hDr'] using
      linearChartCochainsRestrictCompIso_hom b c' e q' r' hq' hr'
  have hleft := twistingSheafRestrictionComp_congr_hom_eq
    hq hr hs h Dq Dr Ds hDq hDr hDs
  have hright := twistingSheafRestrictionComp_congr_hom_eq
    hq' hr' hs (rfl : r' ≫ q' = r' ≫ q') Dq' Dr' Ds
    hDq' hDr' hDs
  have hright' : (twistingSheafRestrictionCompIso Dq' Dr').hom =
      Ds.restrictIso.hom := by
    have hcongr :
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr
          (Eq.symm (rfl : r' ≫ q' = r' ≫ q'))).hom.app
            (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d) = 𝟙 _ := by
      change (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr
        (rfl : r' ≫ q' = r' ≫ q')).hom.app
          (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d) = 𝟙 _
      exact restrictFunctorCongr_refl_hom_app _ _
    simpa only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.app_hom, hcongr, Category.id_comp] using hright
  exact hleft.trans hright'.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.chartTwist_left_restrict_naturality
statement:
theorem chartTwist_left_restrict_naturality
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {E E' : X.Modules} (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') {i j : C'.I}
    (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    [Finite (C'.basisIndex i)]
    [Finite ((transport e C').basisIndex i)] :
    (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr
        (chartIso_leftRestriction e C' c)).app
          (C'.chartTwistingSheaf 1 i)) ≪≫
      twistingSheafRestrictionCompIso
        (c.leftTwistRestrictionData 1)
        (commonChartLeftTwistRestrictionData e C' c)).hom =
      (twistingSheafRestrictionCompIso
        (chartTwistRestrictionData e C' i)
        ((c.transport e C').leftTwistRestrictionData 1)).hom
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (C'.basisIndex i) := C'.basisIndex_finite i
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C'.U i) (E'.val.obj (op (C'.U i))) :=
    C'.sectionModule_free i
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C'.U i) (E'.val.obj (op (C'.U i))) :=
    C'.sectionModule_finite i
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C'.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C'.U i))) :=
    (transport e C').sectionModule_free i
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C'.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C'.U i))) :=
    (transport e C').sectionModule_finite i
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) := c.sectionModule_free
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) := c.sectionModule_finite
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    (c.transport e C').sectionModule_free
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    (c.transport e C').sectionModule_finite
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (chartIso e C' i).hom := inferInstance
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (commonChartIso e C' c).hom := inferInstance
  letI : IsOpenImmersion c.chartToLeft :=
    CommonBasicOpen.chartToLeft_isOpenImmersion c
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (c.transport e C').chartToLeft :=
    CommonBasicOpen.chartToLeft_isOpenImmersion (c.transport e C')
  apply twistingSheafRestrictionComp_square_hom_eq
    c.chartToLeft_preimage_linearOpen
    (fun k ↦ commonChartIso_preimage_leftLinearOpen e C' c k)
    (fun k ↦ chartIso_preimage_linearOpen e C' i k)
    (c.transport e C').chartToLeft_preimage_linearOpen
    (chartIso_leftRestriction e C' c).symm
    (c.leftTwistRestrictionData 1)
    (commonChartLeftTwistRestrictionData e C' c)
    (chartTwistRestrictionData e C' i)
    ((c.transport e C').leftTwistRestrictionData 1)
    (by rfl) (by rfl) (by rfl) (by rfl)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.chartTwist_right_restrict_naturality
statement:
theorem chartTwist_right_restrict_naturality
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {E E' : X.Modules} (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') {i j : C'.I}
    (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    [Finite (C'.basisIndex j)]
    [Finite ((transport e C').basisIndex j)] :
    (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr
        (chartIso_rightRestriction e C' c)).app
          (C'.chartTwistingSheaf 1 j)) ≪≫
      twistingSheafRestrictionCompIso
        (c.rightTwistRestrictionData 1)
        (commonChartRightTwistRestrictionData e C' c)).hom =
      (twistingSheafRestrictionCompIso
        (chartTwistRestrictionData e C' j)
        ((c.transport e C').rightTwistRestrictionData 1)).hom
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (C'.basisIndex j) := C'.basisIndex_finite j
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C'.U j) (E'.val.obj (op (C'.U j))) :=
    C'.sectionModule_free j
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C'.U j) (E'.val.obj (op (C'.U j))) :=
    C'.sectionModule_finite j
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C'.U j) (E.val.obj (op (C'.U j))) :=
    (transport e C').sectionModule_free j
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C'.U j) (E.val.obj (op (C'.U j))) :=
    (transport e C').sectionModule_finite j
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) := c.sectionModule_free
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) := c.sectionModule_finite
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    (c.transport e C').sectionModule_free
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    (c.transport e C').sectionModule_finite
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (chartIso e C' j).hom := inferInstance
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (commonChartIso e C' c).hom := inferInstance
  letI : IsOpenImmersion c.chartToRight :=
    CommonBasicOpen.chartToRight_isOpenImmersion c
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (c.transport e C').chartToRight :=
    CommonBasicOpen.chartToRight_isOpenImmersion (c.transport e C')
  apply twistingSheafRestrictionComp_square_hom_eq
    c.chartToRight_preimage_linearOpen
    (fun k ↦ commonChartIso_preimage_rightLinearOpen e C' c k)
    (fun k ↦ chartIso_preimage_linearOpen e C' j k)
    (c.transport e C').chartToRight_preimage_linearOpen
    (chartIso_rightRestriction e C' c).symm
    (c.rightTwistRestrictionData 1)
    (commonChartRightTwistRestrictionData e C' c)
    (chartTwistRestrictionData e C' j)
    ((c.transport e C').rightTwistRestrictionData 1)
    (by rfl) (by rfl) (by rfl) (by rfl)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E16.exists_pairCover_card
statement:
theorem exists_pairCover_card [Epi b] {r s : ℕ} (hB : HasConstantRank X B r)
    (hD : HasConstantRank X D s) :
    ∃ P : PairCover b, (∀ i, Nat.card (P.basisB i) = r) ∧ ∀ i, Nat.card (P.basisD i) = s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨CB, hCB⟩ := exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hB
  obtain ⟨CD, hCD⟩ := exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hD
  have key : ∀ x : X, ∃ (iB : CB.I) (iD : CD.I) (W : X.Opens), x ∈ W ∧ IsAffineOpen W ∧
      ∃ (hWB : W ≤ CB.U iB) (hWD : W ≤ CD.U iD), Function.Surjective (secMap b W) := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨iB, hiB⟩ := exists_mem_of_cover CB.covers x
    obtain ⟨iD, hiD⟩ := exists_mem_of_cover CD.covers x
    haveI : Fintype (CD.basisIndex iD) := @Fintype.ofFinite _ (CD.basisIndex_finite iD)
    obtain ⟨V, hVU, hxV, t, ht⟩ := Scheme.Modules.exists_open_lifts_of_finite_elements X b
      (CD.basisIndex iD) (CB.U iB ⊓ CD.U iD)
      (fun k => D.val.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : CB.U iB ⊓ CD.U iD ≤ CD.U iD)).op
        (CD.sectionBasis iD k)) x ⟨hiB, hiD⟩
    obtain ⟨W, hW, hxW, hWV⟩ := (Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens) hxV
    have hWB : W ≤ CB.U iB := hWV.trans (hVU.trans inf_le_left)
    have hWD : W ≤ CD.U iD := hWV.trans (hVU.trans inf_le_right)
    refine ⟨iB, iD, W, hxW, hW, hWB, hWD, ?_⟩
    have hle : Submodule.span Γ(X, W) (Set.range (CD.restrictedSectionBasis iD W hWD)) ≤
        LinearMap.range (secMap b W) := by
      rw [Submodule.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨B.val.map (homOfLE hWV).op (t k), ?_⟩
      have h1 := secMap_restrict b hWV (t k)
      have h2 : secMap b V (t k) = b.val.app (op V) (t k) := rfl
      have h3 := ht k
      change secMap b W (B.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE hWV).op (t k)) = _
      rw [h1, h2, h3]
      rw [← CD.restrictedSectionBasis_eq_restrict iD W hWD k]
      change D.val.map (homOfLE hWV).op (D.val.map (homOfLE hVU).op
        (D.val.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : CB.U iB ⊓ CD.U iD ≤ CD.U iD)).op
          (CD.sectionBasis iD k))) =
        D.val.map (homOfLE hWD).op (CD.sectionBasis iD k)
      rw [← PresheafOfModules.map_comp_apply, ← PresheafOfModules.map_comp_apply]
      rfl
    intro d
    have hd : d ∈ Submodule.span Γ(X, W) (Set.range (CD.restrictedSectionBasis iD W hWD)) := by
      rw [(CD.restrictedSectionBasis iD W hWD).span_eq]; trivial
    exact LinearMap.mem_range.mp (hle hd)
  choose iB iD W hxW hWaff hex using key
  choose hWB hWD hsurj using hex
  refine ⟨{
    I := X
    U := W
    covers := ?_
    isAffine := hWaff
    basisB := fun x => CB.basisIndex (iB x)
    basisD := fun x => CD.basisIndex (iD x)
    finB := fun x => CB.basisIndex_finite (iB x)
    finD := fun x => CD.basisIndex_finite (iD x)
    frameB := fun x => CB.restrictedFrame (iB x) (W x) (hWB x)
    frameD := fun x => CD.restrictedFrame (iD x) (W x) (hWD x)
    surj := hsurj }, fun x => hCB (iB x), fun x => hCD (iD x)⟩
  show (⨆ x, W x : X.Opens) = ⊤
  exact eq_top_iff.mpr fun x _ => Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨x, hxW x⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.DescentData.descendedToReindex_component
statement:
theorem descendedToReindex_component (i : I) :
    D.descendedToReindex ι ≫ (D.reindex ι).component i =
      D.component (ι i)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [descendedToReindex, component]
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  rw [(D.reindex ι).lift_ι]
  calc
    (kernel.ι (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight) ≫ D.chartCochainsToReindex ι) ≫
        Pi.π (D.reindex ι).chartTerm i =
      kernel.ι (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight) ≫
        (D.chartCochainsToReindex ι ≫ Pi.π (D.reindex ι).chartTerm i) :=
      Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = _ := congrArg (fun q => kernel.ι (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight) ≫ q)
      (D.chartCochainsToReindex_π ι i)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.DescentData.descendedToReindex_restrictionProjection

      (D.reindex ι).restrictionProjection i =
    D.restrictionProjection (ι i)
proof:

      (restrictFunctor (D.toAmbient (ι i))).map ((D.reindex ι).component i) ≫
        (restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso (D.toAmbient (ι i))).hom.app (D.module (ι i)) =
    (restrictFunctor (D.toAmbient (ι i))).map (D.component (ι i)) ≫
      (restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso (D.toAmbient (ι i))).hom.app (D.module (ι i))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20Frames.wRestrictUnitFrame_one
statement:
theorem wRestrictUnitFrame_one (d : WFrame L x) :
    (wRestrictUnitFrame d).hom.app (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U) (1 : Γ(d.U, d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)) =
      ((restrictAdjunction d.U.ι).unit.app L).app d.U (wFrameGen d)
proof:
:= by
  let m := (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op d.U)
    (1 : Γ(X, d.U))
  have hT : (↑((SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit).val.obj (op d.U)) : Type u) =
      ↑((SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit).val.obj
        (op (d.U.ι ''ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)))) := by
    rw [wImage_preimage_ι_self]
  have H : HEq ((wRestrictFrame d).hom.app (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U) (cast hT m)) (wFrameGen d) :=
    overFunctorEquiv_restrict_app_heq (le_refl d.U) d.globalFrame.hom m
  have e1 : (wRestrictUnitFrame d).hom.app (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U) (1 : Γ(d.U, d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)) =
      (wRestrictFrame d).hom.app (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)
        ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app
          (op (d.U.ι ''ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)))
          (1 : Γ(X, d.U.ι ''ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)))) := by
    simp only [wRestrictUnitFrame, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom,
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
    rw [restrictUnitIso_inv_one]
    rfl
  have ha : (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app
      (op (d.U.ι ''ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))) (1 : Γ(X, d.U.ι ''ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))) =
        cast hT m := by
    apply eq_of_heq
    refine (heq_of_opens_eq (P := fun O ↦ Γ(SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit, O))
      (fun O ↦ (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op O)
        (1 : Γ(X, O))) (wImage_preimage_ι_self d.U)).trans ?_
    exact (cast_heq hT m).symm
  rw [e1, ha, restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app]
  apply eq_of_heq
  exact H.trans (presheaf_map_heq L (wImage_preimage_ι_self d.U) _ (wFrameGen d)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20Frames.wPullbackUnitFrame_one
statement:
theorem wPullbackUnitFrame_one (d : WFrame L x) :
    (wPullbackUnitFrame f d).hom.app ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
        (1 : Γ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U : Scheme.{u}), (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))) =
      ((restrictAdjunction (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι).unit.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)).app
        (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U) (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app L).app d.U (wFrameGen d))
proof:
:= by
  have hK : (wPullbackUnitFrame f d).hom.app ((f ∣_ d.U) ⁻¹ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
      (1 : Γ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U : Scheme.{u}), (f ∣_ d.U) ⁻¹ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))) =
      (restrictPullbackIso f d.U L).hom.app ((f ∣_ d.U) ⁻¹ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f ∣_ d.U)).map (wRestrictUnitFrame d).hom).app
          ((f ∣_ d.U) ⁻¹ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
          ((pullbackUnitIso (f ∣_ d.U)).inv.app ((f ∣_ d.U) ⁻¹ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
            (1 : Γ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U : Scheme.{u}),
              (f ∣_ d.U) ⁻¹ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))))) := rfl
  have h1 := pullbackUnitIso_inv_one (f ∣_ d.U) (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)
  have h2 := pullback_map_unit (f ∣_ d.U) (wRestrictUnitFrame d).hom (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)
    (1 : Γ((d.U : Scheme.{u}), d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
  have h3 := wRestrictUnitFrame_one d
  have hsq := restrictPullbackIso_hom_unit f d.U L d.U (wFrameGen d)
  have hnat := app_presheaf_map (wPullbackUnitFrame f d).hom
    (eqToHom (preimage_morphismRestrict_eq f d.U d.U))
    (1 : Γ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U : Scheme.{u}), (f ∣_ d.U) ⁻¹ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)))
  rw [unit_presheaf_map_one] at hnat
  rw [hnat, hK, h1]
  erw [h2]
  rw [h3]
  exact hsq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20Frames.wHq
statement:
theorem wHq (d : WFrame L x) :
    ((overFunctorEquiv (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)).app
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) PUnit)).inv ≫
      (overEquiv (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)).functor.map (wPullbackGlobalFrame f d).hom ≫

proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20Frames.presheafOfModules_app_heq_of_obj_eq_E20
statement:
private theorem presheafOfModules_app_heq_of_obj_eq_E20
    {C : Type u} [Category.{u} C]
    {R : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ RingCat.{u}} {F G : _root_.PresheafOfModules.{u} R}
    (q : F ⟶ G) {A B : Cᵒᵖ} (hAB : A = B)
    (a : F.obj A) (b : F.obj B) (hab : HEq a b) :
    HEq (q.app A a) (q.app B b)
proof:
:= by
  subst B
  cases hab
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20Frames.wHH_aux
statement:
theorem wHH_aux {Z : Scheme.{u}} {M N : Z.Modules} {U V : Z.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (q : M.over U ⟶ N.over U) (m : M.val.obj (op V))
    (mR : ((restrictFunctor (Scheme.Opens.ι U)).obj M).val.obj
      (op ((Scheme.Opens.ι U) ⁻¹ᵁ V))) (hm : HEq mR m) :
    HEq ((((overFunctorEquiv U).app M).inv ≫ (overEquiv U).functor.map q ≫
      ((overFunctorEquiv U).app N).hom).val.app (op ((Scheme.Opens.ι U) ⁻¹ᵁ V)) mR)
      (q.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hVU))) m)
proof:
:= by
  let W : (U : Scheme.{u}).Opens := (Scheme.Opens.ι U) ⁻¹ᵁ V
  have hImage : (Scheme.Opens.ι U) ''ᵁ W = V := by
    dsimp only [W]
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf,
      Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι, inf_eq_right]
    exact hVU
  let αM := (overFunctorEquiv U).app M
  let αN := (overFunctorEquiv U).app N
  let t := αM.inv.val.app (op W) mR
  let r := ((overEquiv U).functor.map q).val.app (op W) t
  let z := αN.hom.val.app (op W) r
  change HEq z (q.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hVU))) m)
  have hz : HEq z r := overFunctorEquiv_hom_app_heq U W r
  have hr : HEq r (q.val.app (op (U.overEquivalence.inverse.obj W)) t) :=
    overEquiv_map_app_heq U W q t
  have ht : HEq t mR := overFunctorEquiv_inv_app_heq U W mR
  have hObj : U.overEquivalence.inverse.obj W = Over.mk (homOfLE hVU) := by
    refine CostructuredArrow.obj_ext _ _ hImage ?_
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hlast : HEq (q.val.app (op (U.overEquivalence.inverse.obj W)) t)
      (q.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hVU))) m) :=
    presheafOfModules_app_heq_of_obj_eq_E20 q.val (congrArg op hObj) t m (ht.trans hm)
  exact hz.trans (hr.trans hlast)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20Frames.wHH_aux3
statement:
theorem wHH_aux3 (d : WFrame L x)
    (φ : (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) PUnit).over (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U) ⟶
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L).over (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)) :
    HEq ((((overFunctorEquiv (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)).app
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) PUnit)).inv ≫
      (overEquiv (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)).functor.map φ ≫
        ((overFunctorEquiv (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)).app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)).hom).app
          ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)) (cast (wHT (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)) (wGen (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))))
      (φ.val.app
        (op (Over.mk (homOfLE (le_refl (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))))) (wGen (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)))
proof:
:=
  wHH_aux (le_refl (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)) φ (wGen (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
    (cast (wHT (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)) (wGen (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))) (cast_heq _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20Frames.wHH
statement:
theorem wHH (d : WFrame L x) :
    HEq ((((overFunctorEquiv (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)).app
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) PUnit)).inv ≫
      (overEquiv (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)).functor.map (wPullbackGlobalFrame f d).hom ≫
        ((overFunctorEquiv (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)).app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)).hom).app
          ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)) (cast (wHT (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)) (wGen (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))))
      ((wPullbackGlobalFrame f d).hom.val.app
        (op (Over.mk (homOfLE (le_refl (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))))) (wGen (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)))
proof:
:=
  wHH_aux3 f d (wPullbackGlobalFrame f d).hom

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20Frames.wHH'
statement:
theorem wHH' (d : WFrame L x) (y : Y) (hy : f y ∈ d.U) :
    HEq ((wPullbackRestrictFrame f d).hom.app ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
        (cast (wHT (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)) (wGen (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))))
      (wFrameGen (WFrame.ofData (pullbackWFrame f d y hy)))
proof:
:= by
  refine (heq_of_eq (congrArg
    (fun φ ↦ Scheme.Modules.Hom.app φ ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
      (cast (wHT (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)) (wGen (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))))
    (wHq f d))).symm.trans ((wHH f d).trans ?_)
  unfold wFrameGen wGen
  rw [show (WFrame.ofData (pullbackWFrame f d y hy)).globalFrame.hom =
    (wPullbackGlobalFrame f d).hom from pullbackWFrame_globalFrame_hom f d y hy]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20Frames.wHa
statement:
theorem wHa (U' : Y.Opens) :
    (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app
      (op (U'.ι ''ᵁ (U'.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U'))) (1 : Γ(Y, U'.ι ''ᵁ (U'.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U'))) =
        cast (wHT U') (wGen U')
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_of_heq
  refine (heq_of_opens_eq (P := fun O ↦ Γ(SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) PUnit, O))
    (fun O ↦ (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op O)
      (1 : Γ(Y, O))) (wImage_preimage_ι_self U')).trans ?_

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20Frames.wHe1
statement:
theorem wHe1 (d : WFrame L x) :
    (wPullbackRestrictFrame f d).hom.app ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
      ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app
        (op ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ''ᵁ ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))))
        (1 : Γ(Y, (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ''ᵁ ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))))) =
      (wPullbackUnitFrame f d).hom.app ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
        (1 : Γ(((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U : Y.Opens) : Scheme.{u}),
          (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [wPullbackRestrictFrame, Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom,
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  have h1 := iso_hom_inv_app (S := Y)
    (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := Y.ringCatSheaf))
    ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ''ᵁ ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)))
    (1 : Γ(Y, (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ''ᵁ ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))))
  have h3 := restrictUnitIso_hom_one (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
  exact congrArg (fun z ↦ ConcreteCategory.hom (Hom.app (wPullbackUnitFrame f d).hom
    ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))) z)
    ((congrArg (fun z ↦ ConcreteCategory.hom (Hom.app (restrictUnitIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι).hom
      ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))) z) h1).trans h3)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20Frames.wFrameGen_pullbackWFrame
statement:
theorem wFrameGen_pullbackWFrame (d : WFrame L x) (y : Y) (hy : f y ∈ d.U) :
    wFrameGen (WFrame.ofData (pullbackWFrame f d y hy)) =
      ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app L).app d.U (wFrameGen d)
proof:
:= by
  have e1 := wHe1 f d
  rw [wHa, wPullbackUnitFrame_one, restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app] at e1
  apply eq_of_heq
  refine (wHH' f d y hy).symm.trans ((heq_of_eq e1).trans ?_)
  exact presheaf_map_heq _ (wImage_preimage_ι_self (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)) _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearTransitionUnitOnOpen_add
statement:
theorem linearTransitionUnitOnOpen_add
    (d e : ℤ) (x y : M) (V : (space R M).Opens)
    (hV : V ≤ linearOverlapOpen R M x y) :
    linearTransitionUnitOnOpen R M (d + e) x y V hV =
      linearTransitionUnitOnOpen R M d x y V hV *
        linearTransitionUnitOnOpen R M e x y V hV
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [linearTransitionUnitOnOpen]
  rw [linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit_add, map_mul, map_mul]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearTransitionOverIso_add
statement:
theorem linearTransitionOverIso_add
    (d e : ℤ) (x y : M) (V : (space R M).Opens)
    (hVx : V ≤ linearOpen R M x) (hVy : V ≤ linearOpen R M y) :
    linearTransitionOverIso R M (d + e) x y V hVx hVy =
      linearTransitionOverIso R M e x y V hVx hVy ≪≫
        linearTransitionOverIso R M d x y V hVx hVy
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom]
  rw [linearTransitionOverIso_hom, linearTransitionOverIso_hom,
    linearTransitionOverIso_hom]
  simp only [pushedUnitMulOverIso, Functor.mapIso_hom]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  apply congrArg
    (SheafOfModules.overFunctor (space R M).ringCatSheaf V).map
  let F := Scheme.Modules.pushforward V.ι
  let a := linearTransitionUnitOnOpen R M d x y V (by
    rw [linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
    exact le_inf hVx hVy)
  let b := linearTransitionUnitOnOpen R M e x y V (by
    rw [linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
    exact le_inf hVx hVy)
  have hsum : linearTransitionUnitOnOpen R M (d + e) x y V (by
      rw [linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
      exact le_inf hVx hVy) = a * b := by
    exact linearTransitionUnitOnOpen_add d e x y V _
  have hmul :
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso (a * b)).hom =
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso b).hom ≫
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso a).hom := by
    simpa only [Iso.trans_hom] using congrArg Iso.hom
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso_mul a b)
  calc
    F.map (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso
          (linearTransitionUnitOnOpen R M (d + e) x y V _)).hom =
        F.map (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso (a * b)).hom := by
      rw [hsum]
    _ = F.map ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso b).hom ≫
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso a).hom) := by
      exact congrArg F.map hmul
    _ = F.map (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso b).hom ≫
        F.map (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso a).hom := by
      rw [F.map_comp]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitOpenFrame_overMap
statement:
theorem pushedUnitOpenFrame_overMap
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) {U V : Y.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U) :
    let F
proof:
:= SheafOfModules.overMap Y.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)
    let c := SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap Y.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)
    Scheme.Modules.freeOverMapIso Y U V hVU PUnit ≪≫
        F.mapIso (pushedUnitOpenFrame Y U) ≪≫
          c.app (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y U) =
      pushedUnitOpenFrame Y V ≪≫
        (pushedUnitToOpenOverIso hVU).symm := by
  dsimp only
  by_cases hV : Nonempty V
  · letI : Nonempty V := hV
    letI : Nonempty U := hV.map (fun v ↦ ⟨v.1, hVU v.2⟩)
    let p : Y := (Classical.choice hV).1
    let D : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData Y
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y (⊤ : Y.Opens)) p :=
      { U := ⊤
        mem := trivial
        frame := pushedUnitTopFrame Y }
    let hUtop : U ≤ (⊤ : Y.Opens) := le_top
    let hVtop : V ≤ (⊤ : Y.Opens) := le_top
    let AU := D.frameOverLE U hUtop
    let AV := D.frameOverLE V hVtop
    let r := pushedUnitRestrictionOverIso hUtop hVU
    let tU := pushedUnitToOpenOverIso hUtop
    let tV := pushedUnitToOpenOverIso hVtop
    let s := pushedUnitToOpenOverIso hVU
    let F := SheafOfModules.overMap Y.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)
    let c := SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap Y.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)
    have hA : Scheme.Modules.freeOverMapIso Y U V hVU PUnit ≪≫
          F.mapIso AU ≪≫
            c.app (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y ⊤) = AV := by
      simpa only [AU, AV, D, hUtop, hVtop, F, c] using
        Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.frameOverLE_trans
          D (V := U) (W := V) hUtop hVU
    have hr : c.inv.app (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y ⊤) ≫
          F.map tU.hom ≫
            c.hom.app (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y U) = r.hom := by
      change Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE Y hVU
          ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction hUtop).over U) =
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction hUtop).over V
      exact Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_over Y hVU _
    have htrans : r ≪≫ s = tV := by
      exact pushedUnitRestrictionOverIso_trans hUtop hVU
    have hrs : r.hom = tV.hom ≫ s.inv := by
      apply (cancel_mono s.hom).1
      rw [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
      exact congrArg Iso.hom htrans
    apply Iso.ext
    dsimp only [pushedUnitOpenFrame]
    simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.symm_hom]
    change
      (Scheme.Modules.freeOverMapIso Y U V hVU PUnit).hom ≫
          F.map (AU.hom ≫ tU.hom) ≫
            c.hom.app (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y U) =
        (AV.hom ≫ tV.hom) ≫ s.inv
    rw [F.map_comp]
    have hAhom := congrArg Iso.hom hA
    simp only [Iso.trans_hom] at hAhom
    change (Scheme.Modules.freeOverMapIso Y U V hVU PUnit).hom ≫
        F.map AU.hom ≫
          c.hom.app (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y ⊤) = AV.hom at hAhom
    calc
      _ = ((Scheme.Modules.freeOverMapIso Y U V hVU PUnit).hom ≫
              F.map AU.hom ≫
                c.hom.app (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y ⊤)) ≫
            (c.inv.app (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y ⊤) ≫
              F.map tU.hom ≫
                c.hom.app (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y U)) := by
          symm
          simp
      _ = AV.hom ≫ r.hom := by rw [hAhom, hr]
      _ = (AV.hom ≫ tV.hom) ≫ s.inv := by rw [hrs, Category.assoc]
  · letI : IsEmpty V := ⟨fun v ↦ hV ⟨v⟩⟩
    apply Iso.ext
    let q := SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso Y V PUnit
    let f := (Scheme.Modules.freeOverMapIso Y U V hVU PUnit ≪≫
      (SheafOfModules.overMap Y.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)).mapIso
        (pushedUnitOpenFrame Y U) ≪≫
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap Y.ringCatSheaf
        (homOfLE hVU)).app (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y U)).hom
    let g := (pushedUnitOpenFrame Y V ≪≫
      (pushedUnitToOpenOverIso hVU).symm).hom
    apply (cancel_epi q.inv).1
    exact Scheme.Modules.hom_ext_of_isEmpty_open
      (X := Y) (U := V) (q.inv ≫ f) (q.inv ≫ g)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitOpenOverIso_equiv
statement:
theorem pushedUnitOpenOverIso_equiv
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (V : Y.Opens) :
    (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V).functor.map
        (pushedUnitOpenOverIso Y V).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V).hom.app
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y V) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso V.ι).hom.app
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules V.toScheme) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso V.ι).inv ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V).inv.app
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y)
proof:
:= by
  let E := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V
  let P := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y V
  let Q := SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y
  let eF : E.functor.obj (P.over V) ≅ E.functor.obj (Q.over V) :=
    (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V).app P ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso V.ι).app
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules V.toScheme) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso V.ι).symm ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V).app Q).symm
  change E.functor.map
      (E.unitIso.hom.app (P.over V) ≫
        E.inverse.map eF.hom ≫
        E.unitIso.inv.app (Q.over V)) = eF.hom
  rw [E.functor.map_comp, E.functor.map_comp]
  have hc : E.functor.map (E.unitIso.inv.app (Q.over V)) =
      E.counitIso.hom.app (E.functor.obj (Q.over V)) := by
    exact (E.counit_app_functor (Q.over V)).symm
  have hn : E.functor.map (E.inverse.map eF.hom) ≫
      E.counitIso.hom.app (E.functor.obj (Q.over V)) =
        E.counitIso.hom.app (E.functor.obj (P.over V)) ≫ eF.hom :=
    E.counit_naturality eF.hom
  have h1 := congrArg
    (fun z ↦ E.functor.map (E.unitIso.hom.app (P.over V)) ≫
      E.functor.map (E.inverse.map eF.hom) ≫ z) hc
  have h2 := congrArg
    (fun z ↦ E.functor.map (E.unitIso.hom.app (P.over V)) ≫ z) hn
  have h3 : E.functor.map (E.unitIso.hom.app (P.over V)) ≫
        E.counitIso.hom.app (E.functor.obj (P.over V)) ≫ eF.hom =
      eF.hom := by
    have hu : E.functor.map (E.unitIso.hom.app (P.over V)) ≫
        E.counitIso.hom.app (E.functor.obj (P.over V)) =
          𝟙 (E.functor.obj (P.over V)) :=
      E.functor_unitIso_comp (P.over V)
    have hu' := congrArg (fun z ↦ z ≫ eF.hom) hu
    exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
      (hu'.trans (Category.id_comp eF.hom))
  exact h1.trans (h2.trans h3)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_hom_factorization
statement:
theorem intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_hom_factorization
    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (b : Module.Basis ι R M)
    (d : ℤ) (i : ι) (V : (space R M).Opens)
    (hVi : V ≤ linearOpen R M (b i)) :
    (intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b d i V hVi).hom =
      (pushedUnitOpenFrame (space R M) V).hom ≫
        (pushedUnitToOpenOverIso hVi).inv ≫
        (twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso R M b d i hVi).inv
proof:
:= by
  simp only [intrinsicTwistingFrameOver, Iso.trans_hom,
    Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_hom_comp_basisComponent
statement:
theorem intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_hom_comp_basisComponent
    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (b : Module.Basis ι R M)
    (d : ℤ) (i : ι) (V : (space R M).Opens)
    (hVi : V ≤ linearOpen R M (b i)) :
    (intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b d i V hVi).hom ≫
        (twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b d i).over V =
      (pushedUnitOpenFrame (space R M) V).hom ≫
        (pushedUnitToOpenOverIso hVi).inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_hom_factorization]
  simp only [Category.assoc, twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_overMap
statement:
theorem intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_overMap
    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (b : Module.Basis ι R M)
    (d : ℤ) (i : ι) {U V : (space R M).Opens}
    (hUi : U ≤ linearOpen R M (b i)) (hVU : V ≤ U) :
    let X
proof:
:= space R M
    let F := SheafOfModules.overMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)
    let c := SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)
    Scheme.Modules.freeOverMapIso X U V hVU PUnit ≪≫
        F.mapIso (intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b d i U hUi) ≪≫
          c.app (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d) =
      intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b d i V (hVU.trans hUi) := by
  dsimp only
  letI : IsIso ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction hUi).over U) :=
    pushedUnitRestriction_over_isIso_of_le hUi le_rfl
  letI : IsIso ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction hUi).over V) :=
    pushedUnitRestriction_over_isIso_of_le hUi hVU
  letI : IsIso ((twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b d i).over U) :=
    twistingSheafBasisComponent_over_isIso_of_le R M b d i hUi
  letI : IsIso ((twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b d i).over V) :=
    twistingSheafBasisComponent_over_isIso_of_le R M b d i (hVU.trans hUi)
  let s := pushedUnitToOpenOverIso hVU
  let r := pushedUnitRestrictionOverIso hUi hVU
  let tU := pushedUnitToOpenOverIso hUi
  let tV := pushedUnitToOpenOverIso (hVU.trans hUi)
  let qU := twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso R M b d i hUi
  let qV := twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso R M b d i (hVU.trans hUi)
  have hP := pushedUnitOpenFrame_overMap (space R M) hVU
  have hr : (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap (space R M).ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)).inv.app
      ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M)) U) ≫
      (SheafOfModules.overMap (space R M).ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)).map tU.inv ≫
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap (space R M).ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)).hom.app
      ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M)) (linearOpen R M (b i))) = r.inv := by
    change Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (space R M) hVU
        (inv ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction hUi).over U)) =
      inv ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction hUi).over V)
    exact restrictHomOverLE_inv_over
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction hUi) hVU
  have hq : (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap (space R M).ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)).inv.app
      ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M)) (linearOpen R M (b i))) ≫
      (SheafOfModules.overMap (space R M).ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)).map qU.inv ≫
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap (space R M).ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)).hom.app
      (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d) = qV.inv := by
    change Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (space R M) hVU
        (inv ((twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b d i).over U)) =
      inv ((twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b d i).over V)
    exact restrictHomOverLE_inv_over (twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b d i) hVU
  have htrans : r ≪≫ s = tV :=
    pushedUnitRestrictionOverIso_trans hUi hVU
  have hinv : s.inv ≫ r.inv = tV.inv := by
    exact congrArg Iso.inv htrans
  apply Iso.ext
  simp only [intrinsicTwistingFrameOver, Iso.trans_hom,
    Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.map_comp]
  have hPhom := congrArg Iso.hom hP
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.symm_hom] at hPhom
  change (Scheme.Modules.freeOverMapIso (space R M) U V hVU PUnit).hom ≫
      (SheafOfModules.overMap (space R M).ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)).map
          (pushedUnitOpenFrame (space R M) U).hom ≫
        (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap (space R M).ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)).hom.app
            ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M)) U) =
    (pushedUnitOpenFrame (space R M) V).hom ≫ s.inv at hPhom
  change (Scheme.Modules.freeOverMapIso (space R M) U V hVU PUnit).hom ≫
        (SheafOfModules.overMap (space R M).ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)).map
            (pushedUnitOpenFrame (space R M) U).hom ≫ (SheafOfModules.overMap
            (space R M).ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)).map tU.inv ≫
          (SheafOfModules.overMap (space R M).ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)).map qU.inv ≫
              (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap (space R M).ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)).hom.app
              (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d) =
    (pushedUnitOpenFrame (space R M) V).hom ≫ tV.inv ≫ qV.inv
  calc
    _ = ((Scheme.Modules.freeOverMapIso (space R M) U V hVU PUnit).hom ≫
            (SheafOfModules.overMap (space R M).ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)).map
                (pushedUnitOpenFrame (space R M) U).hom ≫
                (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap (space R M).ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)).hom.app
                ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M)) U)) ≫
          ((SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap (space R M).ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)).inv.app
              ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M)) U) ≫
              (SheafOfModules.overMap (space R M).ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)).map tU.inv ≫
              (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap (space R M).ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)).hom.app
              ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M)) (linearOpen R M (b i)))) ≫
          ((SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap (space R M).ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)).inv.app
              ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M)) (linearOpen R M (b i))) ≫
              (SheafOfModules.overMap (space R M).ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)).map qU.inv ≫
              (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap (space R M).ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)).hom.app
              (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d)) := by
        simp
    _ = ((pushedUnitOpenFrame (space R M) V).hom ≫ s.inv) ≫ r.inv ≫ qV.inv := by
      rw [hPhom, hr, hq]
    _ = (pushedUnitOpenFrame (space R M) V).hom ≫ tV.inv ≫ qV.inv := by
      rw [← hinv]
      simp only [Category.assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_relative
statement:
theorem intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_relative
    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (b : Module.Basis ι R M)
    (d : ℤ) (i j : ι) (V : (space R M).Opens)
    (hVi : V ≤ linearOpen R M (b i))
    (hVj : V ≤ linearOpen R M (b j)) :
    intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b d i V hVi ≪≫
        (intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b d j V hVj).symm =
      pushedUnitOpenFrame (space R M) V ≪≫
        linearTransitionOverIso R M (-d) (b i) (b j) V hVi hVj ≪≫
        (pushedUnitOpenFrame (space R M) V).symm
proof:
:= by
  let qi := twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso R M b d i hVi
  let qj := twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso R M b d j hVj
  let ai := pushedUnitToOpenOverIso hVi
  let aj := pushedUnitToOpenOverIso hVj
  let T := linearTransitionOverIso R M (-d) (b i) (b j) V hVi hVj
  let F := linearFrameChangeOverIso R M (-d) (b i) (b j) V hVi hVj
  have hq : qi.inv ≫ qj.hom = F.hom := by
    apply (cancel_epi qi.hom).1
    rw [Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
    exact (twistingSheafBasisComponent_linearFrameChange
      R M b d i j V hVi hVj).symm
  have hF : F.hom = ai.hom ≫ T.hom ≫ aj.inv := by
    simpa only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom] using congrArg Iso.hom
      (linearFrameChangeOverIso_normalize
        R M (-d) (b i) (b j) V hVi hVj)
  apply Iso.ext
  dsimp only [intrinsicTwistingFrameOver]
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.trans_inv,
    Iso.symm_inv, Category.assoc]
  change
    (pushedUnitOpenFrame (space R M) V).hom ≫
        ai.inv ≫ qi.inv ≫ qj.hom ≫ aj.hom ≫
          (pushedUnitOpenFrame (space R M) V).inv =
      (pushedUnitOpenFrame (space R M) V).hom ≫
        T.hom ≫ (pushedUnitOpenFrame (space R M) V).inv
  slice_lhs 3 4 => rw [hq]
  rw [hF]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver_hom_factorization
statement:
theorem intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver_hom_factorization
    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (b : Module.Basis ι R M)
    (d e : ℤ) (i : ι) (V : (space R M).Opens)
    (hVi : V ≤ linearOpen R M (b i)) :
    (intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver b d e i V hVi).hom =
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso (space R M) V
        (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d)
        (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b e)).inv ≫
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso (space R M) V
        (intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b d i V hVi)
        (intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b e i V hVi)).inv ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFreePUnitFrameOver V).inv ≫
      (intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b (d + e) i V hVi).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver,
    Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver,
    Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.trans_inv, Category.assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.restrictIsoOverLE_comp
statement:
private theorem restrictIsoOverLE_comp
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {A B C : Y.Modules} {U V : Y.Opens}
    (hVU : V ≤ U) (f : A.over U ≅ B.over U)
    (g : B.over U ≅ C.over U) :
    Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE hVU (f ≪≫ g) =
      Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE hVU f ≪≫
        Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE hVU g
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE_hom,
    Iso.trans_hom]
  exact Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_comp Y hVU _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.restrictIsoOverLE_symm
statement:
private theorem restrictIsoOverLE_symm
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {A B : Y.Modules} {U V : Y.Opens}
    (hVU : V ≤ U) (f : A.over U ≅ B.over U) :
    Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE hVU f.symm =
      (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE hVU f).symm
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver_restrict
statement:
theorem intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver_restrict
    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (b : Module.Basis ι R M)
    (d e : ℤ) (i : ι) {U V : (space R M).Opens}
    (hUi : U ≤ linearOpen R M (b i)) (hVU : V ≤ U) :
    Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE hVU
        (intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver b d e i U hUi) =
      intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver b d e i V (hVU.trans hUi)
proof:
:= by
  let X := space R M
  let DU := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b d i U hUi
  let EU := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b e i U hUi
  let SU := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b (d + e) i U hUi
  let DV := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b d i V (hVU.trans hUi)
  let EV := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b e i V (hVU.trans hUi)
  let SV := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b (d + e) i V (hVU.trans hUi)
  by_cases hU : Nonempty U
  · letI : Nonempty U := hU
    let GU := (SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X U PUnit).symm ≪≫
      Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver U DU EU
    let HU := (SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X U PUnit).symm ≪≫ SU
    have hlocal : intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver b d e i U hUi =
        GU.symm ≪≫ HU := by
      apply Iso.ext
      simp [intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver, GU, HU, X, DU, EU, SU]
    have hGU : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE hVU GU =
        (SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X V PUnit).symm ≪≫
          Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver V DV EV := by
      have h := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE_tensorFrame
        (X := X) hVU DU EU
      dsimp only at h
      rw [intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_overMap,
        intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_overMap] at h
      exact h
    have hHU : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE hVU HU =
        (SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X V PUnit).symm ≪≫ SV := by
      have h := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE_globalFreeFrame
        (X := X) hVU SU
      dsimp only at h
      rw [intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_overMap] at h
      exact h
    rw [hlocal, restrictIsoOverLE_comp,
      restrictIsoOverLE_symm, hGU, hHU]
    apply Iso.ext
    simp [intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver, DV, EV, SV]
  · letI : IsEmpty U := ⟨fun x ↦ hU ⟨x⟩⟩
    letI : IsEmpty V := ⟨fun x ↦
      False.elim (hU ⟨⟨x.1, hVU x.2⟩⟩)⟩
    apply Iso.ext
    exact Scheme.Modules.hom_ext_of_isEmpty_open
      (X := X) (U := V) _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.comparisonHom_eq_of_relativeIso_eq
statement:
private theorem comparisonHom_eq_of_relativeIso_eq
    {D : Type*} [Category D] {K A B : D}
    (a b : K ≅ A) (c d : K ≅ B)
    (h : a ≪≫ b.symm = c ≪≫ d.symm) :
    a.inv ≫ c.hom = b.inv ≫ d.hom
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi a.hom).1
  rw [Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  have hh := congrArg Iso.hom h
  change a.hom ≫ b.inv = c.hom ≫ d.inv at hh
  rw [← Category.assoc, hh, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id,
    Category.comp_id]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver_independent
statement:
theorem intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver_independent
    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (b : Module.Basis ι R M)
    (d e : ℤ) (i j : ι) (V : (space R M).Opens)
    (hVi : V ≤ linearOpen R M (b i))
    (hVj : V ≤ linearOpen R M (b j)) :
    (intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver b d e i V hVi).hom =
      (intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver b d e j V hVj).hom
proof:
:= by
  let Di := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b d i V hVi
  let Dj := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b d j V hVj
  let Ei := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b e i V hVi
  let Ej := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b e j V hVj
  let Si := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b (d + e) i V hVi
  let Sj := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b (d + e) j V hVj
  let Ti := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver V Di Ei
  let Tj := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver V Dj Ej
  apply comparisonHom_eq_of_relativeIso_eq Ti Tj Si Sj
  rw [Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver_relative_comp]
  rw [intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_relative,
    intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_relative,
    intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_relative]
  let P := pushedUnitOpenFrame (space R M) V
  let Td := linearTransitionOverIso R M (-d) (b i) (b j) V hVi hVj
  let Te := linearTransitionOverIso R M (-e) (b i) (b j) V hVi hVj
  let Ts := linearTransitionOverIso R M (-(d + e)) (b i) (b j) V hVi hVj
  change (P ≪≫ Te ≪≫ P.symm) ≪≫ (P ≪≫ Td ≪≫ P.symm) =
    P ≪≫ Ts ≪≫ P.symm
  have hT : Te ≪≫ Td = Ts := by
    dsimp only [Te, Td, Ts]
    rw [show -(d + e) = -d + -e by omega]
    exact (linearTransitionOverIso_add
      (-d) (-e) (b i) (b j) V hVi hVj).symm
  rw [← hT]
  apply Iso.ext
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tensorSheafMap_hom_over
statement:
theorem tensorSheafMap_hom_over
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {A A' B B' : Y.Modules}
    (f : A ⟶ A') (g : B ⟶ B') (U : Y.Opens) :
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap Y f g).over U =
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y U A B).inv ≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap Y U
          ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf U).map f)
          ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf U).map g) ≫
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y U A' B').hom
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y U A B).hom).1
  simp only [Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  let L := SheafOfModules.identitySheafificationOver
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) Y.ringCatSheaf U
  let F := PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀OfCommRingCat
    (Over.forget U) Y.presheaf
  let R' := (((Over.forget U).op ⋙ Y.presheaf) ⋙
    forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
  letI : MonoidalCategory (_root_.PresheafOfModules.{u}
      Y.ringCatSheaf.obj) := inferInstanceAs (MonoidalCategory
        (_root_.PresheafOfModules.{u}
          (Y.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)))
  letI : MonoidalCategory (_root_.PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (Y.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)) := inferInstance
  letI : MonoidalCategory (_root_.PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (Y.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj) := inferInstanceAs (MonoidalCategory
        (_root_.PresheafOfModules.{u} R'))
  let fg : (A.val ⊗ B.val) ⟶ (A'.val ⊗ B'.val) :=
    f.val ⊗ₘ g.val
  let μAB := Functor.Monoidal.μIso F A.val B.val
  let μA'B' := Functor.Monoidal.μIso F A'.val B'.val
  let ε := SheafOfModules.identitySheafificationOverNatIso
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) Y.ringCatSheaf U
  change
      L.map μAB.hom ≫ ε.hom.app (A.val ⊗ B.val) ≫
        (SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf U).map
          ((SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafification Y).map fg) =
      L.map (((F.map f.val) ⊗ₘ (F.map g.val))) ≫
        L.map μA'B'.hom ≫ ε.hom.app (A'.val ⊗ B'.val)
  have hε := ε.hom.naturality fg
  have hε' :
      L.map (F.map fg) ≫ ε.hom.app (A'.val ⊗ B'.val) =
        ε.hom.app (A.val ⊗ B.val) ≫
          (SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf U).map
            ((SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafification Y).map fg) := hε
  have hμ :
      μAB.hom ≫ F.map fg =
        ((F.map f.val) ⊗ₘ (F.map g.val)) ≫ μA'B'.hom := by
    dsimp only [μAB, μA'B', fg]
    exact (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ_natural
      F f.val g.val).symm
  calc
    _ = L.map μAB.hom ≫
        (ε.hom.app (A.val ⊗ B.val) ≫
          (SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf U).map
            ((SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafification Y).map fg)) :=
      Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = L.map μAB.hom ≫
        (L.map (F.map fg) ≫ ε.hom.app (A'.val ⊗ B'.val)) := by
      rw [hε']
    _ = (L.map μAB.hom ≫ L.map (F.map fg)) ≫
        ε.hom.app (A'.val ⊗ B'.val) :=
      (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = L.map (μAB.hom ≫ F.map fg) ≫
        ε.hom.app (A'.val ⊗ B'.val) := by
      rw [L.map_comp]
    _ = L.map (((F.map f.val) ⊗ₘ (F.map g.val)) ≫
          μA'B'.hom) ≫ ε.hom.app (A'.val ⊗ B'.val) := by
      exact congrArg
        (fun z ↦ L.map z ≫ ε.hom.app (A'.val ⊗ B'.val)) hμ
    _ = (L.map ((F.map f.val) ⊗ₘ (F.map g.val)) ≫
          L.map μA'B'.hom) ≫ ε.hom.app (A'.val ⊗ B'.val) := by
      rw [L.map_comp]
    _ = _ := Category.assoc _ _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tensorSheafMapIso_hom_over
statement:
theorem tensorSheafMapIso_hom_over
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {A A' B B' : Y.Modules}
    (f : A ≅ A') (g : B ≅ B') (U : Y.Opens) :
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap Y f.hom g.hom).over U =
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y U A B).inv ≫
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso Y U
          ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf U).mapIso f)
          ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf U).mapIso g)).hom ≫
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y U A' B').hom
proof:
:= by
  have h := tensorSheafMap_hom_over f.hom g.hom U
  let R' := (((Over.forget U).op ⋙ Y.presheaf) ⋙
    forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
  letI : MonoidalCategory (_root_.PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (Y.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj) :=
    inferInstanceAs (MonoidalCategory (_root_.PresheafOfModules.{u} R'))
  have hMap :
      SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap Y U
          ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf U).map f.hom)
          ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf U).map g.hom) =
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso Y U
          ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf U).mapIso f)
          ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf U).mapIso g)).hom := by
    change
      (SheafOfModules.identitySheafificationOver
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) Y.ringCatSheaf U).map
          (PresheafOfModules.Monoidal.tensorHom
            ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf U).map f.hom).val
            ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf U).map g.hom).val) =
        (SheafOfModules.identitySheafificationOver
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) Y.ringCatSheaf U).map
            (((SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf U).map f.hom).val ⊗ₘ
              ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf U).map g.hom).val)
    congr 1
  rw [hMap] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tensorSheafOverMapIso_comp_local
statement:
private theorem tensorSheafOverMapIso_comp_local
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.Opens)
    {A B C D E F : SheafOfModules.{u} (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)}
    (a : A ≅ B) (b : B ≅ C) (d : D ≅ E) (e : E ≅ F) :
    SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U a d ≪≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U b e =
      SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U (a ≪≫ b) (d ≪≫ e)
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  let R' := (((Over.forget U).op ⋙ X.presheaf) ⋙
    forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
  let F := SheafOfModules.identitySheafificationOver
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.ringCatSheaf U
  letI : MonoidalCategory
      (PresheafOfModules.{u} (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj) :=
    inferInstanceAs (MonoidalCategory (PresheafOfModules.{u} R'))
  let a' := (SheafOfModules.forget (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).mapIso a
  let b' := (SheafOfModules.forget (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).mapIso b
  let d' := (SheafOfModules.forget (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).mapIso d
  let e' := (SheafOfModules.forget (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).mapIso e
  change F.map (a'.hom ⊗ₘ d'.hom) ≫ F.map (b'.hom ⊗ₘ e'.hom) =
    F.map ((a'.hom ≫ b'.hom) ⊗ₘ (d'.hom ≫ e'.hom))
  calc
    _ = F.map ((a'.hom ⊗ₘ d'.hom) ≫ (b'.hom ⊗ₘ e'.hom)) := by
      rw [F.map_comp]
    _ = F.map ((a'.hom ≫ b'.hom) ⊗ₘ (d'.hom ≫ e'.hom)) := by
      congr 1
      exact MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_comp_tensorHom _ _ _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tensorSheafOverMapIso_inv_local
statement:
private theorem tensorSheafOverMapIso_inv_local
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.Opens)
    {A B C D : SheafOfModules.{u} (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)}
    (a : A ≅ B) (b : C ≅ D) :
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U a b).inv =
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U a.symm b.symm).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp [SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tensorFrameOverLocal_hom_naturality_of_commuting_frames
statement:
theorem tensorFrameOverLocal_hom_naturality_of_commuting_frames
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.Opens)
    {A A' B B' : SheafOfModules.{u} (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)}
    (a : A ≅ A') (b : B ≅ B')
    (d : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) PUnit ≅ A)
    (e : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) PUnit ≅ B)
    (d' : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) PUnit ≅ A')
    (e' : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) PUnit ≅ B')
    (u : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) PUnit ≅
      SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) PUnit)
    (hd : d.hom ≫ a.hom = u.hom ≫ d'.hom)
    (he : e.hom ≫ b.hom = u.hom ≫ e'.hom) :
    (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFreePUnitFrameOver U ≪≫
