      SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U d e).hom ≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap X U a.hom b.hom =
    (u ≪≫ u).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFreePUnitFrameOver U ≪≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U d' e').hom
proof:
:= by
  let tf := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFreePUnitFrameOver U
  let T {C D : SheafOfModules.{u} (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)}
      (x : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) PUnit ≅ C)
      (y : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) PUnit ≅ D) :=
    tf ≪≫ SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U x y
  let d'' := d' ≪≫ a.symm
  let e'' := e' ≪≫ b.symm
  have hdRel : d.hom ≫ d''.symm.hom = u.hom := by
    change d.hom ≫ a.hom ≫ d'.inv = u.hom
    calc
      d.hom ≫ a.hom ≫ d'.inv = (u.hom ≫ d'.hom) ≫ d'.inv := by
        exact congrArg (fun f => f ≫ d'.inv) hd
      _ = u.hom := by simp [Category.assoc]
  have heRel : e.hom ≫ e''.symm.hom = u.hom := by
    change e.hom ≫ b.hom ≫ e'.inv = u.hom
    calc
      e.hom ≫ b.hom ≫ e'.inv = (u.hom ≫ e'.hom) ≫ e'.inv := by
        exact congrArg (fun f => f ≫ e'.inv) he
      _ = u.hom := by simp [Category.assoc]
  have hdRelIso : d ≪≫ d''.symm = u := Iso.ext hdRel
  have heRelIso : e ≪≫ e''.symm = u := Iso.ext heRel
  have hMapRelative :
      SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U d e ≪≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U d''.symm e''.symm =
      SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U u u := by
    rw [tensorSheafOverMapIso_comp_local, hdRelIso, heRelIso]
  have hMapRelativeHom := congrArg Iso.hom hMapRelative
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom] at hMapRelativeHom
  have hRelativeHom :
      (T d e).hom ≫ (T d'' e'').inv = (u ≪≫ u).hom := by
    calc
      (T d e).hom ≫ (T d'' e'').inv =
          tf.hom ≫
            (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U d e).hom ≫
            (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U d'' e'').inv ≫
            tf.inv := by
          simp only [T, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.trans_inv,
            Category.assoc]
      _ = tf.hom ≫
            (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U d e).hom ≫
            (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U d''.symm e''.symm).hom ≫
            tf.inv := by
          rw [tensorSheafOverMapIso_inv_local]
      _ = tf.hom ≫
            (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U u u).hom ≫ tf.inv := by
        have hh := congrArg
          (fun f => tf.hom ≫ f ≫ tf.inv) hMapRelativeHom
        simpa only [Category.assoc] using hh
      _ = (u ≪≫ u).hom := by
        have ht := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFreePUnitFrameOver_naturality
          U u u
        simpa only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc] using
          congrArg Iso.hom ht
  have hTransport :
      T d'' e'' = T d' e' ≪≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U a.symm b.symm := by
    unfold T
    rw [← tensorSheafOverMapIso_comp_local]
    rfl
  have hTransportInv := congrArg Iso.inv hTransport
  simp only [Iso.trans_inv] at hTransportInv
  have hMapInv :
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U a.symm b.symm).inv =
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap X U a.hom b.hom := by
    calc
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U a.symm b.symm).inv =
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U a b).hom :=
        tensorSheafOverMapIso_inv_local U a.symm b.symm
      _ = SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap X U a.hom b.hom := rfl
  have hFinal := congrArg (fun f => f ≫ (T d' e').hom) hRelativeHom
  rw [hTransportInv] at hFinal
  rw [hMapInv] at hFinal
  simpa [T, Category.assoc] using hFinal

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitToOpenOverIso_refl_local
statement:
private theorem pushedUnitToOpenOverIso_refl_local
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.Opens) :
    pushedUnitToOpenOverIso (le_rfl : U ≤ U) = Iso.refl _
proof:
:= by
  let r := (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
    (le_rfl : U ≤ U)).over U
  letI : IsIso r := pushedUnitRestriction_over_isIso_of_le le_rfl le_rfl
  have hrr : r ≫ r = r := by
    simpa [r] using
      (pushedUnitRestriction_over_comp
        (hVU := le_rfl) (hWV := le_rfl) (A := U))
  have hr : r = 𝟙 _ := by
    apply (cancel_epi r).1
    calc
      r ≫ r = r := hrr
      _ = 𝟙 _ ≫ r := by simp
  apply Iso.ext
  simpa only [pushedUnitToOpenOverIso, r, asIso_hom, Iso.refl_hom] using hr

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver_hom_comp_basisComponents
statement:
theorem intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver_hom_comp_basisComponents
    {R M ι : Type u} [CommRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [Finite ι]
    (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (d e : ℤ) (i : ι) :
    let X
proof:
:= space R M
    let U := linearOpen R M (b i)
    (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver U
        (intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b d i U le_rfl)
        (intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b e i U le_rfl)).hom ≫
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X
        (twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b d i)
        (twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b e i)).over U =
    (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver U
        (pushedUnitOpenFrame X U) (pushedUnitOpenFrame X U)).hom := by
  dsimp only
  let X := space R M
  let U := linearOpen R M (b i)
  let f := twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b d i
  let g := twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b e i
  let fIso := twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso R M b d i le_rfl
  let gIso := twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso R M b e i le_rfl
  let frameD := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b d i U le_rfl
  let frameE := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b e i U le_rfl
  let pushedFrame := pushedUnitOpenFrame X U
  have hd : frameD.hom ≫ fIso.hom = pushedFrame.hom := by
    have h := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_hom_comp_basisComponent
      b d i U le_rfl
    calc
      frameD.hom ≫ fIso.hom = pushedFrame.hom ≫ 𝟙 _ := by
        simpa [U, X, frameD, fIso, pushedFrame,
          twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso,
          pushedUnitToOpenOverIso_refl_local] using h
      _ = pushedFrame.hom := by simp
  have he : frameE.hom ≫ gIso.hom = pushedFrame.hom := by
    have h := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_hom_comp_basisComponent
      b e i U le_rfl
    calc
      frameE.hom ≫ gIso.hom = pushedFrame.hom ≫ 𝟙 _ := by
        simpa [U, X, frameE, gIso, pushedFrame,
          twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso,
          pushedUnitToOpenOverIso_refl_local] using h
      _ = pushedFrame.hom := by simp
  have hTensor := tensorFrameOverLocal_hom_naturality_of_commuting_frames
    (X := X) U fIso gIso frameD frameE pushedFrame pushedFrame
    (Iso.refl _) hd he
  rw [tensorSheafMap_hom_over]
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver,
    Iso.trans_hom, Iso.refl_hom, Category.id_comp,
    Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  change
    (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFreePUnitFrameOver U).hom ≫
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U frameD frameE).hom ≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap X U
          ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U).map f)
          ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U).map g) ≫
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso X U
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X U)
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X U)).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFreePUnitFrameOver U).hom ≫
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U pushedFrame pushedFrame).hom ≫
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso X U
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X U)
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X U)).hom
  exact congrArg
    (fun z => z ≫ (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso X U
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X U)
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X U)).hom) hTensor

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tensorFrameOver_hom_naturality_of_commuting_frames
statement:
theorem tensorFrameOver_hom_naturality_of_commuting_frames
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (V : Y.Opens)
    {M M' N N' : Y.Modules} (a : M ≅ M') (b : N ≅ N')
    (d : SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over V) PUnit ≅ M.over V)
    (e : SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over V) PUnit ≅ N.over V)
    (d' : SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over V) PUnit ≅ M'.over V)
    (e' : SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over V) PUnit ≅ N'.over V)
    (u : SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over V) PUnit ≅
      SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over V) PUnit)
    (hd : d.hom ≫ a.hom.over V = u.hom ≫ d'.hom)
    (he : e.hom ≫ b.hom.over V = u.hom ≫ e'.hom) :
    (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver
      (X := Y) (M := M) V d e).hom ≫
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap Y a.hom b.hom).over V =
    (u ≪≫ u).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver
        (X := Y) (M := M') V d' e').hom
proof:
:= by
  let aV := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf V).mapIso a
  let bV := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf V).mapIso b
  let d'' := d' ≪≫ aV.symm
  let e'' := e' ≪≫ bV.symm
  have haV : aV.hom = a.hom.over V := rfl
  have hbV : bV.hom = b.hom.over V := rfl
  have hdRel : (d ≪≫ d''.symm).hom = u.hom := by
    change d.hom ≫ aV.hom ≫ d'.inv = u.hom
    calc
      d.hom ≫ aV.hom ≫ d'.inv =
          d.hom ≫ a.hom.over V ≫ d'.inv := by rw [haV]
      _ = (u.hom ≫ d'.hom) ≫ d'.inv := by
        exact congrArg (fun f ↦ f ≫ d'.inv) hd
      _ = u.hom := by simp [Category.assoc]
  have heRel : (e ≪≫ e''.symm).hom = u.hom := by
    change e.hom ≫ bV.hom ≫ e'.inv = u.hom
    calc
      e.hom ≫ bV.hom ≫ e'.inv =
          e.hom ≫ b.hom.over V ≫ e'.inv := by rw [hbV]
      _ = (u.hom ≫ e'.hom) ≫ e'.inv := by
        exact congrArg (fun f ↦ f ≫ e'.inv) he
      _ = u.hom := by simp [Category.assoc]
  have hdRelHom : d.hom ≫ d''.symm.hom = u.hom := by
    simpa only [Iso.trans_hom] using hdRel
  have heRelHom : e.hom ≫ e''.symm.hom = u.hom := by
    simpa only [Iso.trans_hom] using heRel
  have hRelative :
      Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver
          (X := Y) (M := M) V d e ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver
          (X := Y) (M := M) V d'' e'').symm = u ≪≫ u := by
    rw [Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver_relative_comp]
    apply Iso.ext
    simp only [Iso.trans_hom]
    rw [heRelHom, hdRelHom]
  have hMapOver :
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf V).map
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMapIso Y a.symm b.symm).hom =
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap Y a.symm.hom b.symm.hom).over V := rfl
  have hTransport :
      Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver
          (X := Y) (M := M) V d'' e'' =
        Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver
            (X := Y) (M := M') V d' e' ≪≫
          (SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf V).mapIso
            (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMapIso Y a.symm b.symm) := by
    apply Iso.ext
    let R' := (((Over.forget V).op ⋙ Y.presheaf) ⋙
      forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
    letI : MonoidalCategory (_root_.PresheafOfModules.{u}
        (Y.ringCatSheaf.over V).obj) :=
      inferInstanceAs (MonoidalCategory (_root_.PresheafOfModules.{u} R'))
    simp only [Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver,
      Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom]
    rw [hMapOver, tensorSheafMapIso_hom_over]
    simp [d'', e'', aV, bV, SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso,
      Category.assoc]
    let F := SheafOfModules.identitySheafificationOver
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) Y.ringCatSheaf V
    let I := SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y V M N
    let f₁ := d'.hom.val
    let f₂ := e'.hom.val
    let g₁ := ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf V).map a.inv).val
    let g₂ := ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf V).map b.inv).val
    change F.map ((f₁ ≫ g₁) ⊗ₘ (f₂ ≫ g₂)) ≫ I.hom =
      F.map (f₁ ⊗ₘ f₂) ≫ F.map (g₁ ⊗ₘ g₂) ≫ I.hom
    have ht : (f₁ ⊗ₘ f₂) ≫ (g₁ ⊗ₘ g₂) =
        (f₁ ≫ g₁) ⊗ₘ (f₂ ≫ g₂) :=
      MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_comp_tensorHom f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂
    calc
      _ = F.map ((f₁ ⊗ₘ f₂) ≫ (g₁ ⊗ₘ g₂)) ≫ I.hom := by
        exact congrArg (fun f ↦ F.map f ≫ I.hom) ht.symm
      _ = F.map (f₁ ⊗ₘ f₂) ≫ F.map (g₁ ⊗ₘ g₂) ≫ I.hom := by
        rw [F.map_comp]
        simp [Category.assoc]
  have hRelativeHom := congrArg Iso.hom hRelative
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom] at hRelativeHom
  have hTransportInv :
      (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver
        (X := Y) (M := M) V d'' e'').symm.hom =
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap Y a.hom b.hom).over V ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver
            (X := Y) (M := M') V d' e').symm.hom := by
    have h := congrArg Iso.hom hTransport
    simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom,
      SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMapIso_hom] at h
    have hInv := congrArg Iso.inv hTransport
    simp only [Iso.trans_inv, Functor.mapIso_inv] at hInv
    exact hInv
  calc
    _ = ((Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver
          (X := Y) (M := M) V d e).hom ≫
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap Y a.hom b.hom).over V ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver
          (X := Y) (M := M') V d' e').symm.hom) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver
            (X := Y) (M := M') V d' e').hom := by
      simp [Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc]
    _ = (u ≪≫ u).hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver
            (X := Y) (M := M') V d' e').hom := by
      rw [hTransportInv] at hRelativeHom
      exact congrArg
        (fun f ↦ f ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver
            (X := Y) (M := M') V d' e').hom) hRelativeHom

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_basisChange_relative
proof:
:= hVij.trans
      ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (c j)).le.trans inf_le_left)
    let hVcj : V ≤ linearOpen R M (c j) := hVij.trans
      ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (c j)).le.trans inf_le_right)
    intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b d i V hVbi ≪≫
        Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE hVij
          (twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso R M b c d i j) ≪≫
        (intrinsicTwistingFrameOver c d j V hVcj).symm =
      pushedUnitOpenFrame (space R M) V ≪≫
        linearTransitionOverIso R M (-d) (b i) (c j) V hVbi hVcj ≪≫
        (pushedUnitOpenFrame (space R M) V).symm := by
  dsimp only
  let hVbi : V ≤ linearOpen R M (b i) := hVij.trans
    ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (c j)).le.trans inf_le_left)
  let hVcj : V ≤ linearOpen R M (c j) := hVij.trans
    ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (c j)).le.trans inf_le_right)
  let qi := twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso R M b d i hVbi
  let qj := twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso R M c d j hVcj
  let ai := pushedUnitToOpenOverIso hVbi
  let aj := pushedUnitToOpenOverIso hVcj
  let T := linearTransitionOverIso R M (-d) (b i) (c j) V hVbi hVcj
  let F := linearFrameChangeOverIso R M (-d) (b i) (c j) V hVbi hVcj
  let B := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE hVij
    (twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso R M b c d i j)
  have hB : B.hom = qi.hom ≫ F.hom ≫ qj.inv := by
    exact twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso_restrict_hom
      R M b c d i j hVij
  have hF : F.hom = ai.hom ≫ T.hom ≫ aj.inv := by
    simpa only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom] using congrArg Iso.hom
      (linearFrameChangeOverIso_normalize
        R M (-d) (b i) (c j) V hVbi hVcj)
  apply Iso.ext
  simp only [intrinsicTwistingFrameOver, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom,
    Iso.trans_inv, Iso.symm_inv, Category.assoc]
  change
    (pushedUnitOpenFrame (space R M) V).hom ≫ ai.inv ≫ qi.inv ≫
      B.hom ≫ qj.hom ≫ aj.hom ≫
        (pushedUnitOpenFrame (space R M) V).inv =
    (pushedUnitOpenFrame (space R M) V).hom ≫ T.hom ≫
      (pushedUnitOpenFrame (space R M) V).inv
  rw [hB, hF]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver_basisChange_naturality
proof:
:= hVij.trans
      ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (c j)).le.trans inf_le_left)
    let hVcj : V ≤ linearOpen R M (c j) := hVij.trans
      ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (c j)).le.trans inf_le_right)
    let Bs := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE hVij
      (twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso R M b c (d + e) i j)
    intrinsicTwistingTensorBasisChangeOverIso b c d e i j hVij ≪≫
        intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver c d e j V hVcj =
      intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver b d e i V hVbi ≪≫ Bs := by
  dsimp only
  let X := space R M
  let hVbi : V ≤ linearOpen R M (b i) := hVij.trans
    ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (c j)).le.trans inf_le_left)
  let hVcj : V ≤ linearOpen R M (c j) := hVij.trans
    ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (c j)).le.trans inf_le_right)
  let Db := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b d i V hVbi
  let Eb := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b e i V hVbi
  let Sb := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b (d + e) i V hVbi
  let Dc := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver c d j V hVcj
  let Ec := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver c e j V hVcj
  let Sc := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver c (d + e) j V hVcj
  let Bd := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE hVij
    (twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso R M b c d i j)
  let Be := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE hVij
    (twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso R M b c e i j)
  let Bs := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE hVij
    (twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso R M b c (d + e) i j)
  let Tb := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver V Db Eb
  let Tc := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver V Dc Ec
  let Tbc := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver V
    (Db ≪≫ Bd) (Eb ≪≫ Be)
  let K := intrinsicTwistingTensorBasisChangeOverIso b c d e i j hVij
  have hK : Tb ≪≫ K = Tbc := by
    apply Iso.ext
    simp only [Tb, K, Tbc,
      intrinsicTwistingTensorBasisChangeOverIso,
      Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver,
      SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso, Bd, Be,
      Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc,
      Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
    congr 1
    let A := SheafOfModules.identitySheafificationOver
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.ringCatSheaf V
    let R' := (((Over.forget V).op ⋙ X.presheaf) ⋙
      forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
    letI : MonoidalCategory (_root_.PresheafOfModules.{u}
        (X.ringCatSheaf.over V).obj) :=
      inferInstanceAs (MonoidalCategory
        (_root_.PresheafOfModules.{u} R'))
    change A.map (Db.hom.val ⊗ₘ Eb.hom.val) ≫
        A.map (Bd.hom.val ⊗ₘ Be.hom.val) ≫ _ =
      A.map ((Db.hom.val ≫ Bd.hom.val) ⊗ₘ
        (Eb.hom.val ≫ Be.hom.val)) ≫ _
    rw [← A.map_comp_assoc,
      MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_comp_tensorHom]
  have hd := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_basisChange_relative
    b c d i j hVij
  have he := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_basisChange_relative
    b c e i j hVij
  have hs := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_basisChange_relative
    b c (d + e) i j hVij
  let P := pushedUnitOpenFrame X V
  let Td := linearTransitionOverIso R M (-d) (b i) (c j) V hVbi hVcj
  let Te := linearTransitionOverIso R M (-e) (b i) (c j) V hVbi hVcj
  let Ts := linearTransitionOverIso R M (-(d + e)) (b i) (c j) V hVbi hVcj
  change Db ≪≫ Bd ≪≫ Dc.symm = P ≪≫ Td ≪≫ P.symm at hd
  change Eb ≪≫ Be ≪≫ Ec.symm = P ≪≫ Te ≪≫ P.symm at he
  change Sb ≪≫ Bs ≪≫ Sc.symm = P ≪≫ Ts ≪≫ P.symm at hs
  have hT : Te ≪≫ Td = Ts := by
    dsimp only [Te, Td, Ts]
    rw [show -(d + e) = -d + -e by omega]
    exact (linearTransitionOverIso_add
      (-d) (-e) (b i) (c j) V hVbi hVcj).symm
  have hrel : Tbc ≪≫ Tc.symm = Sb ≪≫ Bs ≪≫ Sc.symm := by
    rw [Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver_relative_comp]
    change (Eb ≪≫ Be ≪≫ Ec.symm) ≪≫
      (Db ≪≫ Bd ≪≫ Dc.symm) = Sb ≪≫ Bs ≪≫ Sc.symm
    rw [he, hd, hs]
    rw [← hT]
    apply Iso.ext
    simp
  change K ≪≫ (Tc.symm ≪≫ Sc) = (Tb.symm ≪≫ Sb) ≪≫ Bs
  apply Iso.ext
  apply (cancel_epi Tb.hom).1
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc]
  have hKhom := congrArg Iso.hom hK
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom] at hKhom
  rw [← Category.assoc, hKhom]
  have hrelHom := congrArg Iso.hom hrel
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom] at hrelHom
  rw [← Category.assoc, hrelHom]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.intrinsicTwistingTensorFrame_compatible
statement:
theorem intrinsicTwistingTensorFrame_compatible
    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (b : Module.Basis ι R M)
    (d e : ℤ) :
    Presheaf.FamilyOfElementsOnObjects.IsCompatible
      (fun i : ι ↦ Scheme.Modules.localHomSection (space R M)
        (linearOpen R M (b i))
        (intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver b d e i
          (linearOpen R M (b i)) le_rfl).hom)
proof:
:= by
  intro V i j f g
  have hVi : V ≤ linearOpen R M (b i) := f.le
  have hVj : V ≤ linearOpen R M (b j) := g.le
  rw [show f = homOfLE hVi from Subsingleton.elim _ _,
    show g = homOfLE hVj from Subsingleton.elim _ _,
    Scheme.Modules.sheafHom_map_localHomSection,
    Scheme.Modules.sheafHom_map_localHomSection]
  apply congrArg
    (SheafOfModules.toSheaf ((space R M).ringCatSheaf.over V)).map
  change
    (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE hVi
      (intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver b d e i
        (linearOpen R M (b i)) le_rfl)).hom =
    (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE hVj
      (intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver b d e j
        (linearOpen R M (b j)) le_rfl)).hom
  rw [intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver_restrict,
    intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver_restrict]
  exact intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver_independent b d e i j V hVi hVj

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.intrinsicLinearOpen_coversTop
statement:
theorem intrinsicLinearOpen_coversTop
    {ι : Type u} (b : Module.Basis ι R M) :
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology (space R M)).CoversTop
      (fun i : ι ↦ linearOpen R M (b i))
proof:
:=
  (Opens.coversTop_iff
    (T := space R M) (fun i : ι ↦ linearOpen R M (b i))).2
      (linearOpen_iSup_eq_top R M b)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.intrinsicTwistingTensorHom_over
statement:
theorem intrinsicTwistingTensorHom_over
    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (b : Module.Basis ι R M)
    (d e : ℤ) (i : ι) :
    (intrinsicTwistingTensorHom b d e).over (linearOpen R M (b i)) =
      (intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver b d e i
        (linearOpen R M (b i)) le_rfl).hom
proof:
:=
  Scheme.Modules.glueHom_over (space R M)
    (fun j : ι ↦ linearOpen R M (b j))
    (intrinsicLinearOpen_coversTop b)
    (fun j : ι ↦ (intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver b d e j
      (linearOpen R M (b j)) le_rfl).hom)
    (intrinsicTwistingTensorFrame_compatible b d e) i

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.intrinsicTwistingTensorHom_over_le
statement:
theorem intrinsicTwistingTensorHom_over_le
    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (b : Module.Basis ι R M)
    (d e : ℤ) (i : ι) {V : (space R M).Opens}
    (hVi : V ≤ linearOpen R M (b i)) :
    (intrinsicTwistingTensorHom b d e).over V =
      (intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver b d e i V hVi).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_over (space R M) hVi
    (intrinsicTwistingTensorHom b d e)]
  rw [intrinsicTwistingTensorHom_over]
  change
    (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE hVi
      (intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver b d e i
        (linearOpen R M (b i)) le_rfl)).hom = _
  rw [intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver_restrict]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.intrinsicTwistingTensorHom_isIso
statement:
theorem intrinsicTwistingTensorHom_isIso
    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (b : Module.Basis ι R M)
    (d e : ℤ) : IsIso (intrinsicTwistingTensorHom b d e)
proof:
:=
  Scheme.Modules.glueHom_isIso (space R M)
    (fun i : ι ↦ linearOpen R M (b i))
    (intrinsicLinearOpen_coversTop b)
    (fun i : ι ↦ (intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver b d e i
      (linearOpen R M (b i)) le_rfl).hom)
    (intrinsicTwistingTensorFrame_compatible b d e)
    (fun _ ↦ inferInstance)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.modulesHom_ext_of_over_coversTop
statement:
private theorem modulesHom_ext_of_over_coversTop
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {M N : X.Modules} {I : Type u}
    (U : I → X.Opens)
    (hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop U)
    (f g : M ⟶ N)
    (h : ∀ i, f.over (U i) = g.over (U i)) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply (SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).map_injective
  apply Sheaf.hom_ext
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext W
  apply AddCommGrpCat.hom_ext
  ext m
  apply N.isSheaf.isSeparated W.unop
    (Sieve.ofObjects U W.unop) (hU W.unop)
  rintro Z a ⟨i, ⟨b⟩⟩
  have happ := congrArg
    (fun k ↦ k.val.app (op (Over.mk b))) (h i)
  change N.val.map a.op (f.val.app W m) =
    N.val.map a.op (g.val.app W m)
  calc
    N.val.map a.op (f.val.app W m) =
        (show N.val.obj (op Z) from
          f.val.app (op Z) (M.val.map a.op m)) :=
      (CategoryTheory.congr_fun (f.val.naturality a.op) m).symm
    _ = (show N.val.obj (op Z) from
        g.val.app (op Z) (M.val.map a.op m)) := by
      exact CategoryTheory.congr_fun happ _
    _ = (show N.val.obj (op Z) from
        N.val.map a.op (g.val.app W m)) := by
      exact CategoryTheory.congr_fun (g.val.naturality a.op) m

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.intrinsicTwistingTensorHom_basisChange_naturality
statement:
theorem intrinsicTwistingTensorHom_basisChange_naturality
    {ι κ : Type u} [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (c : Module.Basis κ R M)
    (d e : ℤ) :
    SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (space R M)
          (twistingSheafBasisChangeIso R M b c d).hom
          (twistingSheafBasisChangeIso R M b c e).hom ≫
        intrinsicTwistingTensorHom c d e =
      intrinsicTwistingTensorHom b d e ≫
        (twistingSheafBasisChangeIso R M b c (d + e)).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply modulesHom_ext_of_over_coversTop
    (space R M)
    (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ basisChangeOpen R M b c ij.1 ij.2)
    (basisChangeOpen_coversTop R M b c)
  intro ij
  rcases ij with ⟨i, j⟩
  let V := basisChangeOpen R M b c i j
  let hVij : V ≤ basisChangeOpen R M b c i j := le_rfl
  let hVbi : V ≤ linearOpen R M (b i) := hVij.trans
    ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (c j)).le.trans inf_le_left)
  let hVcj : V ≤ linearOpen R M (c j) := hVij.trans
    ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (c j)).le.trans inf_le_right)
  let Bd := twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso R M b c d i j
  let Be := twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso R M b c e i j
  let Bs := twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso R M b c (d + e) i j
  have hd :
      ((twistingSheafBasisChangeIso R M b c d).hom).over V = Bd.hom := by
    simpa only [V, Bd, twistingSheafBasisChangeIso, asIso_hom] using
      twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_over R M b c d i j
  have he :
      ((twistingSheafBasisChangeIso R M b c e).hom).over V = Be.hom := by
    simpa only [V, Be, twistingSheafBasisChangeIso, asIso_hom] using
      twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_over R M b c e i j
  have hBd :
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctor (space R M).ringCatSheaf V).mapIso
          (twistingSheafBasisChangeIso R M b c d) = Bd := by
    apply Iso.ext
    exact hd
  have hBe :
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctor (space R M).ringCatSheaf V).mapIso
          (twistingSheafBasisChangeIso R M b c e) = Be := by
    apply Iso.ext
    exact he
  have hs :
      ((twistingSheafBasisChangeIso R M b c (d + e)).hom).over V =
        Bs.hom := by
    simpa only [V, Bs, twistingSheafBasisChangeIso, asIso_hom] using
      twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_over R M b c (d + e) i j
  have hb : (intrinsicTwistingTensorHom b d e).over V =
      (intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver b d e i V hVbi).hom :=
    intrinsicTwistingTensorHom_over_le b d e i hVbi
  have hc : (intrinsicTwistingTensorHom c d e).over V =
      (intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver c d e j V hVcj).hom :=
    intrinsicTwistingTensorHom_over_le c d e j hVcj
  change
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (space R M)
        (twistingSheafBasisChangeIso R M b c d).hom
        (twistingSheafBasisChangeIso R M b c e).hom).over V ≫
      (intrinsicTwistingTensorHom c d e).over V =
    (intrinsicTwistingTensorHom b d e).over V ≫
      ((twistingSheafBasisChangeIso R M b c (d + e)).hom).over V
  rw [tensorSheafMapIso_hom_over, hBd, hBe, hb, hc, hs]
  change
    ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso (space R M) V
          (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d)
          (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b e)).inv ≫
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso (space R M) V Bd Be).hom ≫
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso (space R M) V
          (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M c d)
          (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M c e)).hom) ≫
      (intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver c d e j V hVcj).hom =
    (intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver b d e i V hVbi).hom ≫ Bs.hom
  exact congrArg Iso.hom
    (intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver_basisChange_naturality
      b c d e i j hVij)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.ideal_ne_bot_of_ne_bot
statement:
theorem ideal_ne_bot_of_ne_bot [IsIntegral X] {I : X.IdealSheafData} (hI : I ≠ ⊥) (U : X.affineOpens)
    (hU : Nonempty U.1) : I.ideal U ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply hI
  rw [← Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_eq_top_iff]
  have hη : genericPoint X ∈ U.1 :=
    ((genericPoint_spec X).mem_open_set_iff U.1.isOpen).mpr (by simpa using hU)
  have hmem : genericPoint X ∈ I.support := by
    rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.mem_support_iff_of_mem hη, h]
    simp [Scheme.zeroLocus_def]
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro x _
  exact (genericPoint_specializes x).mem_closed I.support.isClosed hmem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.exists_gen_section
statement:
theorem exists_gen_section (I : X.IdealSheafData) (U : X.affineOpens) (g : Γ(X, U.1))
    (hg : g ∈ I.ideal U) :
    ∃ s : Γ(ConormalSheaf.idealModule I, U.1),
      (ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι I).app U.1 s = g
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (I.subschemeι).app U.1 g = 0 := by
    rw [← RingHom.mem_ker, I.ker_subschemeι_app U]; exact hg
  have h2 := (ConormalSheaf.idealModule_exact I U.1 g).1 h1
  exact h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.res_comp
statement:
theorem res_comp {U V W : X.Opens} (h1 : V ≤ U) (h2 : W ≤ V) (t : Γ(M, U)) :
    M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h2).op (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h1).op t) =
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h2.trans h1)).op t
proof:
:= by
  rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.secHom_app
statement:
theorem secHom_app {U : X.Opens} (t : Γ(M, U)) (W : (Over U)ᵒᵖ) (a : Γ(X, W.unop.left)) :
    (secHom t).val.app W a = a • (M.presheaf.map W.unop.hom.op t : Γ(M, W.unop.left))
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.subsingleton_sections_of_not_nonempty
statement:
theorem subsingleton_sections_of_not_nonempty (W : X.Opens) (h : ¬ Nonempty W) :
    Subsingleton Γ(X, W)
proof:
:= by
  have : W = ⊥ := (TopologicalSpace.Opens.not_nonempty_iff_eq_bot W).mp (by simpa using h)
  subst this
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.ι_res
statement:
theorem ι_res {U W : X.Opens} (h : W ≤ U) (s : Γ(idealModule I, U)) :
    (idealModuleι I).app W ((idealModule I).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op s) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op ((idealModuleι I).app U s)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (idealModuleι I).mapPresheaf.naturality (homOfLE h).op
  have h2 := congrArg (fun f => (ConcreteCategory.hom f) s) h1
  simp only [CategoryTheory.comp_apply, Scheme.Modules.mapPresheaf_app] at h2
  exact h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.ι_smul
statement:
theorem ι_smul {W : X.Opens} (a : Γ(X, W)) (m : Γ(idealModule I, W)) :
    (idealModuleι I).app W (a • m) = a • (idealModuleι I).app W m
proof:
:=
  ((idealModuleι I).val.app (op W)).hom.map_smul a m

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.res_ne_zero
statement:
theorem res_ne_zero {U W : X.Opens} (h : W ≤ U) [Nonempty W] (g : Γ(X, U)) (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op g ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  apply hg
  apply map_injective_of_isIntegral X (homOfLE h)
  rw [h0, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.smul_unit_eq_mul
statement:
theorem smul_unit_eq_mul {W : X.Opens} (a : Γ(X, W)) (x : Γ(unitX X, W)) :
    a • x = a * (show Γ(X, W) from x)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.secHom_inj
statement:
theorem secHom_inj (U : X.affineOpens) (g : Γ(X, U.1)) (hg0 : g ≠ 0)
    (s : Γ(idealModule I, U.1)) (hs : (idealModuleι I).app U.1 s = g) (W : X.Opens) (h : W ≤ U.1) :
    Function.Injective (fun a : Γ(X, W) => a • (idealModule I).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op s)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  by_cases hW : Nonempty W
  · haveI := hW
    haveI : IsDomain Γ(X, W) := IsIntegral.component_integral W
    have h1 := congrArg ((idealModuleι I).app W) hab
    simp only [ι_smul, ι_res, hs] at h1
    have hne := res_ne_zero h g hg0
    have h2 : a * X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op g = b * X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op g := h1
    have h3 : (a - b) * X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op g = 0 := by
      rw [sub_mul, h2, sub_self]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp h3).resolve_right hne)
  · haveI := subsingleton_sections_of_not_nonempty W hW
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.presheaf_res_comp
statement:
theorem presheaf_res_comp {U V W : X.Opens} (h1 : V ≤ U) (h2 : W ≤ V) (a : Γ(X, U)) :
    X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h2).op (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h1).op a) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h2.trans h1)).op a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.exists_local_quot
statement:
theorem exists_local_quot (U : X.affineOpens) (g : Γ(X, U.1)) (hg : I.ideal U = Ideal.span {g})
    {W : X.Opens} (h : W ≤ U.1) (y : Γ(X, W)) (hy : I.subschemeι.app W y = 0)
    (V : X.affineOpens) (hVW : V.1 ≤ W) :
    ∃ b : Γ(X, V.1), b * X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hVW.trans h)).op g =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVW).op y
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVW).op y ∈ I.ideal V := by
    rw [← I.ker_subschemeι_app V]
    exact RingHom.mem_ker.mpr (ConormalSheaf.subschemeι_app_map_eq_zero _ _ y hy)
  have hVU : V ≤ U := hVW.trans h
  rw [← I.map_ideal hVU, hg, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hmem
  exact hmem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.secHom_surj
statement:
theorem secHom_surj (U : X.affineOpens) (g : Γ(X, U.1)) (hg : I.ideal U = Ideal.span {g})
    (hg0 : g ≠ 0)
    (s : Γ(idealModule I, U.1)) (hs : (idealModuleι I).app U.1 s = g) (W : X.Opens) (h : W ≤ U.1) :
    Function.Surjective (fun a : Γ(X, W) => a • (idealModule I).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op s)
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  by_cases hW : Nonempty W
  · haveI := hW
    let y : Γ(X, W) := (idealModuleι I).app W t
    have hy : I.subschemeι.app W y = 0 :=
      (idealModule_exact I W).apply_apply_eq_zero t
    have hex : ∀ x : W, ∃ (V : X.affineOpens) (hxV : x.1 ∈ V.1) (hVW : V.1 ≤ W)
        (b : Γ(X, V.1)), b * X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hVW.trans h)).op g =
          X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVW).op y := by
      intro x
      obtain ⟨_, ⟨V, hV, rfl⟩, hxV, hVW⟩ :=
        X.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open x.2 W.isOpen
      exact ⟨⟨V, hV⟩, hxV, hVW, exists_local_quot I U g hg h y hy ⟨V, hV⟩ hVW⟩
    choose V hxV hVW b hb using hex
    let S : TopCat.Sheaf Ab X := ⟨(unitMod X).presheaf, (unitMod X).isSheaf⟩
    have hcov : W ≤ ⨆ x : W, (V x).1 := by
      intro z hz
      exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨z, hz⟩, hxV ⟨z, hz⟩⟩
    have hcomp : TopCat.Presheaf.IsCompatible S.1 (fun x : W => (V x).1) b := by
      intro x x'
      have hne : Nonempty ((V x).1 ⊓ (V x').1 : X.Opens) := by
        obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := nonempty_preirreducible_inter (V x).1.isOpen (V x').1.isOpen
          ⟨x.1, hxV x⟩ ⟨x'.1, hxV x'⟩
        exact ⟨⟨z, hz⟩⟩
      haveI := hne
      haveI : IsDomain Γ(X, (V x).1 ⊓ (V x').1) := IsIntegral.component_integral _
      have hne0 := res_ne_zero (U := U.1) (W := (V x).1 ⊓ (V x').1)
        (inf_le_left.trans ((hVW x).trans h)) g hg0
      have e1 := hb x
      have e2 := hb x'
      have e1' := congrArg (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : (V x).1 ⊓ (V x').1 ≤ (V x).1)).op) e1
      have e2' := congrArg (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : (V x).1 ⊓ (V x').1 ≤ (V x').1)).op) e2
      rw [map_mul, presheaf_res_comp, presheaf_res_comp] at e1' e2'
      have h3 : (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : (V x).1 ⊓ (V x').1 ≤ (V x).1)).op (b x) -
          X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : (V x).1 ⊓ (V x').1 ≤ (V x').1)).op (b x')) *
          X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left.trans ((hVW x).trans h))).op g = 0 := by
        rw [sub_mul, e1', e2', sub_self]
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp h3).resolve_right hne0)
    obtain ⟨a, ha, -⟩ := S.existsUnique_gluing' (fun x : W => (V x).1) W
      (fun x => homOfLE (hVW x)) hcov b hcomp
    let a₀ : Γ(X, W) := a
    have ha0 : ∀ x : W, X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hVW x)).op a₀ = b x := fun x => ha x
    refine ⟨a₀, ?_⟩
    apply idealModuleι_app_injective I W
    have hlhs : (idealModuleι I).app W
        (a₀ • (idealModule I).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op s) =
        a₀ * X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op g := by
      rw [ι_smul, ι_res, hs]; rfl
    refine hlhs.trans ?_
    refine S.eq_of_locally_eq' (fun x : W => (V x).1) W (fun x => homOfLE (hVW x)) hcov _ _ ?_
    intro x
    change X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hVW x)).op (a₀ * X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op g) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hVW x)).op y
    rw [map_mul, presheaf_res_comp]
    rw [ha0 x]
    exact hb x
  · haveI := subsingleton_sections_of_not_nonempty W hW
    haveI : Subsingleton Γ(unitX X, W) := this
    haveI : Subsingleton Γ(idealModule I, W) :=
      (idealModuleι_app_injective I W).subsingleton
    exact ⟨0, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.secHom_bijective
statement:
theorem secHom_bijective (U : X.affineOpens) (g : Γ(X, U.1)) (hg : I.ideal U = Ideal.span {g})
    (hg0 : g ≠ 0) (s : Γ(idealModule I, U.1)) (hs : (idealModuleι I).app U.1 s = g)
    (W : (Over U.1)ᵒᵖ) : Function.Bijective ((secHom s).val.app W)
proof:
:= by
  have h := leOfHom W.unop.hom
  exact ⟨secHom_inj I U g hg0 s hs W.unop.left h, secHom_surj I U g hg hg0 s hs W.unop.left h⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.hasConstantRank_one_of_triv
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_one_of_triv {L : X.Modules} (V : X → X.Opens)
    (hV : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop V)
    (e : ∀ x, L.over (V x) ≅ (unitMod X).over (V x)) : HasConstantRank X L 1
proof:
:= by
  let iso : ∀ x, SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over (V x)) PUnit.{u + 1} ≅
      L.over (V x) := fun x ↦ SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit ≪≫ (e x).symm
  refine ⟨{ I := X, X := V, coversTop := hV
            generators := fun i ↦ SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.equivOfIso (iso i)
              (SheafOfModules.free.generatingSections PUnit.{u + 1}) }, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · constructor
    intro i
    infer_instance
  · constructor
    intro i
    constructor
    change Finite PUnit.{u + 1}
    infer_instance
  · intro i
    change Nat.card PUnit.{u + 1} = 1
    exact Nat.card_unique

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.secHomG_app_one
statement:
theorem secHomG_app_one {M : X.Modules} (t : Γ(M, ⊤)) (U : X.Opens) :
    ((secHomG t).val.app (op U)).hom (1 : Γ(X, U)) =
      (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op t : Γ(M, U))
proof:
:= by
  have h := (SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv M).apply_symm_apply
    (PresheafOfModules.sectionsMk (M := M.val)
      (fun W ↦ (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W.unop ≤ ⊤)).op t : Γ(M, W.unop)))
      (by
        intro W W' f
        change M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (leOfHom f.unop)).op
            (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W.unop ≤ ⊤)).op t) =
          M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W'.unop ≤ ⊤)).op t
        exact res_comp _ _ t))
  have h2 := congrArg (fun q => q.val (op U)) h
  exact h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.canonSection_app_one
statement:
theorem canonSection_app_one (U : X.Opens) :
    ((canonSection I).val.app (op U)).hom (1 : Γ(X, U)) =
      Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X (le_top : U ≤ ⊤) (ιDual I)
proof:
:=
  secHomG_app_one _ U

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.localGen_idealTriv
statement: theorem localGen_idealTriv : localGen (idealTriv I U g hg hg0 s hs) = s
proof:
:= by
  change (secHom s).val.app (topOver U.1) (1 : Γ(X, U.1)) = s
  rw [secHom_app]
  change (1 : Γ(X, U.1)) • (idealModule I).presheaf.map (𝟙 U.1).op s = s
  rw [one_smul]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.evalAt_canon
statement:
theorem evalAt_canon :
    evalAt (idealModule I) U.1 (localGen (idealTriv I U g hg hg0 s hs))
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X (le_top : U.1 ≤ ⊤) (ιDual I)) = g
proof:
:= by
  rw [localGen_idealTriv]
  exact hs

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.restrictHomOverLE_refl'
statement:
theorem restrictHomOverLE_refl' {N P : X.Modules} {V : X.Opens} (f : N.over V ⟶ P.over V) :
    Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X (le_refl V) f = f
proof:
:= by
  apply overHom_ext
  intro W m
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.canon_eq_dualTriv
statement:
theorem canon_eq_dualTriv :
    Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X (le_top : U.1 ≤ ⊤) (ιDual I) =
      (dualTriv (idealTriv I U g hg hg0 s hs)).val.app (topOver U.1) g
proof:
:= by
  rw [hom_eq_smul (idealTriv I U g hg hg0 s hs)
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X (le_top : U.1 ≤ ⊤) (ιDual I)), evalAt_canon I U g hg hg0 s hs]
  change _ = g • Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X (le_refl U.1) (idealTriv I U g hg hg0 s hs).hom
  rw [restrictHomOverLE_refl']

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.coeff_canon
statement:
theorem coeff_canon :
    sectionOverTrivializationCoefficient (canonSection I) U.1
      (dualFrame I U g hg hg0 s hs) = g
proof:
:= by
  unfold sectionOverTrivializationCoefficient
  have h1 := canonSection_app_one I U.1
  have h2 := canon_eq_dualTriv I U g hg hg0 s hs
  refine Eq.trans (congrArg (fun m => ((dualFrame I U g hg hg0 s hs).hom.val.app (topOver U.1)).hom m)
    (h1.trans h2)) ?_
  haveI := dualTriv_isIso (idealTriv I U g hg hg0 s hs)
  have h := congrArg (fun q => (q.val.app (topOver U.1)).hom g)
    (IsIso.hom_inv_id (dualTriv (idealTriv I U g hg hg0 s hs)))
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.sectionEvaluationIdeal_zero
statement:
theorem sectionEvaluationIdeal_zero {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] :
    sectionEvaluationIdeal (R := R) (0 : M) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  rintro y ⟨φ, rfl⟩
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.exists_cartierLineSection
statement:
theorem exists_cartierLineSection [IsIntegral X] (I : X.IdealSheafData) (hI : I ≠ ⊥)
    (hlp : IdealSheafIsLocallyPrincipal I) :
    ∃ (L : X.Modules) (_ : HasConstantRank X L 1) (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L),
      SectionIsRegular σ ∧ sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = I
proof:
:= by
  choose U hxU g hg using hlp
  have hg0 : ∀ x, g x ≠ 0 := by
    intro x h0
    apply ideal_ne_bot_of_ne_bot hI (U x) ⟨⟨x, hxU x⟩⟩
    rw [hg x, h0]
    simp
  have hgs : ∀ x, ∃ s : Γ(ConormalSheaf.idealModule I, (U x).1),
      (ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι I).app (U x).1 s = g x := fun x =>
    exists_gen_section I (U x) (g x) (by rw [hg x]; exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)
  choose s hs using hgs
  have hcov : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop (fun x => (U x).1) := by
    apply (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := X) _).2
    ext x
    simp only [TopologicalSpace.Opens.coe_iSup, Set.mem_iUnion, TopologicalSpace.Opens.coe_top,
      Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
    exact ⟨x, hxU x⟩
  have hI1 : HasConstantRank X (ConormalSheaf.idealModule I) 1 :=
    hasConstantRank_one_of_triv (fun x => (U x).1) hcov
      (fun x => idealTriv I (U x) (g x) (hg x) (hg0 x) (s x) (hs x))
  have hL : HasConstantRank X (lineBundleDual X (ConormalSheaf.idealModule I)) 1 :=
    lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank _ hI1
  haveI : (lineBundleDual X (ConormalSheaf.idealModule I)).IsLocallyFree :=
    hL.isFiniteLocallyFree.isLocallyFree
  haveI : (lineBundleDual X (ConormalSheaf.idealModule I)).IsFinitePresentation :=
    IsFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation X hL.isFiniteLocallyFree
  have hline : IsLocalLineFrame (lineBundleDual X (ConormalSheaf.idealModule I)) := fun x =>
    ⟨U x, hxU x, ⟨dualFrame I (U x) (g x) (hg x) (hg0 x) (s x) (hs x)⟩⟩
  have hEq : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf (canonSection I) = I := by
    refine Scheme.IdealSheafData.ext_of_iSup_eq_top U ?_ (fun x => ?_)
    · rw [eq_top_iff]
      intro z _
      exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨z, hxU z⟩
    · rw [sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_affine_overIso (canonSection I) (U x)
        (dualFrame I (U x) (g x) (hg x) (hg0 x) (s x) (hs x)),
        coeff_canon I (U x) (g x) (hg x) (hg0 x) (s x) (hs x), hg x]
  refine ⟨_, hL, canonSection I, ?_, hEq⟩
  refine sectionIsRegular_of_integral hline (canonSection I) (fun V hV h0 => ?_)
  apply ideal_ne_bot_of_ne_bot hI V hV
  rw [← hEq, eq_bot_iff]
  refine (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_le_affine (canonSection I) V).trans ?_
  change sectionEvaluationIdeal (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (canonSection I) V (1 : Γ(X, V))) ≤ ⊥
  exact ((congrArg sectionEvaluationIdeal h0).trans sectionEvaluationIdeal_zero).le

name: AlgebraicGeometry.D34.moduleCat_leftUnitor_tensorHom_tmul
statement:
theorem moduleCat_leftUnitor_tensorHom_tmul {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {M N : ModuleCat.{u} R}
    (f : M ⟶ 𝟙_ (ModuleCat.{u} R)) (l : M) (n : N) :
    (ConcreteCategory.hom (λ_ N).hom)
      ((ConcreteCategory.hom (f ⊗ₘ 𝟙 N)) (l ⊗ₜ[R] n)) = (ConcreteCategory.hom f l) • n
proof:
:= by
  rw [ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_tmul, ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor_hom_apply]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.D34.tensorTriv_inv_tensorUnitAt
statement:
theorem tensorTriv_inv_tensorUnitAt (V : X.Opens)
    (θ : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V) PUnit ≅ L.over V)
    {W : X.Opens} (hW : W ≤ V) (l : L.val.obj (op W)) (m : E.val.obj (op W)) :
    (tensorTriv L E V θ).inv.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hW))) (tensorUnitAt L E W l m) =
      ((((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V)).symm ≪≫ θ).inv.val.app
        (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hW))) l : Γ(X, W)) • m)
proof:
:= by
  have h := adjunct_tensorTriv_inv L E V θ
  rw [Scheme.Modules.moduleSheafificationOverHomEquiv_apply] at h
  let x : (tensorUnderlyingPresheaf L E).obj (op W) := l ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, W)] m
  have h2 := congrArg (fun φ => φ.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hW))) x) h
  refine h2.trans ?_
  unfold tensorTrivAdjunct
  dsimp only
  exact moduleCat_leftUnitor_tensorHom_tmul (R := Γ(X, W)) (M := L.val.obj (op W))
    (N := E.val.obj (op W))
    (((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V)).symm ≪≫ θ).inv.val.app
      (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hW)))) l m

name: AlgebraicGeometry.D34.trivSecEquiv_symm_apply_tensorUnitAt
statement:
theorem trivSecEquiv_symm_apply_tensorUnitAt (V : X.Opens)
    (θ : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V) PUnit ≅ L.over V)
    {W : X.Opens} (hW : W ≤ V) (l : L.val.obj (op W)) (m : E.val.obj (op W)) :
    (tensorTriv L E V θ).inv.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hW))) (tensorUnitAt L E W l m) =
      ((trivSecEquiv L V θ hW).symm l) • m
proof:
:=
  tensorTriv_inv_tensorUnitAt L E V θ hW l m

name: AlgebraicGeometry.D34.tensorTrivSec_symm_apply
statement:
theorem tensorTrivSec_symm_apply (V : X.Opens)
    (θ : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V) PUnit ≅ L.over V)
    {W : X.Opens} (hW : W ≤ V) (m' : (tensorSheaf X L E).val.obj (op W)) :
    (tensorTrivSec L E V θ hW).symm m' =
      (tensorTriv L E V θ).inv.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hW))) m'
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.D34.tensorTrivSec_apply
statement:
theorem tensorTrivSec_apply (V : X.Opens)
    (θ : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V) PUnit ≅ L.over V)
    {W : X.Opens} (hW : W ≤ V) (m : E.val.obj (op W)) :
    tensorTrivSec L E V θ hW m =
      tensorUnitAt L E W (trivSecEquiv L V θ hW 1) m
proof:
:= by
  apply (tensorTrivSec L E V θ hW).symm.injective
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, tensorTrivSec_symm_apply,
    trivSecEquiv_symm_apply_tensorUnitAt, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, one_smul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.D34.exists_unit_of_two_frames
statement:
theorem exists_unit_of_two_frames {R M : Type u} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (g₁ g₂ : R ≃ₗ[R] M) :
    ∃ u : Rˣ, g₂.symm (g₁ 1) = (u : R)
proof:
:= by
  have hg : ∀ (g : R ≃ₗ[R] M) (r : R), g r = r • g 1 := fun g r ↦ by
    have := g.map_smul r 1
    rwa [smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at this
  set u : R := g₂.symm (g₁ 1) with hu
  set u' : R := g₁.symm (g₂ 1) with hu'
  have h1 : g₁ 1 = u • g₂ 1 := by
    rw [← hg g₂ u, hu, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have h2 : g₂ 1 = u' • g₁ 1 := by
    rw [← hg g₁ u', hu', LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have h3 : g₁ 1 = g₁ (u * u') := by
    rw [hg g₁ (u * u'), mul_smul, ← h2, ← h1]
  have h4 : (1 : R) = u * u' := g₁.injective h3
  exact ⟨⟨u, u', h4.symm, by rw [mul_comm]; exact h4.symm⟩, rfl⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.topWord_not_surjective
statement:
theorem topWord_not_surjective (m p : ℕ) (hp : p < m)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (m + 1)) : ¬Function.Surjective a
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hc := Fintype.card_le_of_surjective a h
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at hc
  omega

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.topWord_lift_restriction
statement:
theorem topWord_lift_restriction (m p : ℕ) (hp : p < m)
    (y : almostSurjectiveWordCochain ℤ m p) :
    almostSurjectiveWordLift ℤ m p (almostSurjectiveWordRestriction ℤ m p y) = y
proof:
:= by
  have hr : almostSurjectiveWordRestriction ℤ m p
      (y - almostSurjectiveWordLift ℤ m p (almostSurjectiveWordRestriction ℤ m p y)) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, almostSurjectiveWordRestriction_lift, sub_self]
  have hz : y - almostSurjectiveWordLift ℤ m p
      (almostSurjectiveWordRestriction ℤ m p y) = 0 := by
    funext a
    exact almostSurjectiveWord_eq_zero_of_not_surjective_of_restriction_eq_zero
      ℤ m p _ hr a (topWord_not_surjective m p hp a.1)
  exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hz).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.topWord_restriction_contraction_differential_lift
statement:
theorem topWord_restriction_contraction_differential_lift (m p : ℕ)
    (c : surjectiveWordCochain ℤ m p) :
    almostSurjectiveWordRestriction ℤ m p
      (almostSurjectiveWordContraction ℤ m p
        (almostSurjectiveWordDifferential ℤ m p (almostSurjectiveWordLift ℤ m p c))) = c
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  let ac : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (m + 1) := fun j => (a.1 j).castSucc
  have ha : CoversOldVertices ac := (coversOldVertices_castSucc_iff_surjective a.1).2 a.2
  have hf : almostSurjectiveWordLift ℤ m p c ⟨ac, ha⟩ = c a :=
    congrFun (almostSurjectiveWordRestriction_lift ℤ m p c) a
  change (∑ r : Fin (p + 2), (-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val *
    if h : CoversOldVertices (Fin.cons (Fin.last m) ac ∘ r.succAbove) then
      almostSurjectiveWordLift ℤ m p c ⟨Fin.cons (Fin.last m) ac ∘ r.succAbove, h⟩
    else 0) = c a
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ, prepend_delete_zero]
  rw [dif_pos ha]
  simp only [Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, one_mul]
  rw [hf]
  have ht : (∑ r : Fin (p + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ r.succ.val *
      if h : CoversOldVertices (Fin.cons (Fin.last m) ac ∘ r.succ.succAbove) then
        almostSurjectiveWordLift ℤ m p c
          ⟨Fin.cons (Fin.last m) ac ∘ r.succ.succAbove, h⟩
      else 0) = 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro r _
    rw [prepend_delete_succ]
    by_cases h : CoversOldVertices (Fin.cons (Fin.last m) (ac ∘ r.succAbove))
    · rw [dif_pos h, almostSurjectiveWordLift_apply]
      have hn : ¬AvoidsLastVertex (Fin.cons (Fin.last m) (ac ∘ r.succAbove)) := by
        intro h'
        exact h' 0 (by simp only [Fin.cons_zero])
      rw [dif_neg hn, mul_zero]
    · rw [dif_neg h, mul_zero]
  rw [ht, add_zero]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.topWordCyclePrimitive_differential
statement:
theorem topWordCyclePrimitive_differential (n : ℕ) (x : topWordCycles (n + 1)) :
    almostSurjectiveWordDifferential ℤ (n + 1) n (topWordCyclePrimitive n x) =
      surjectiveWordToAlmost ℤ (n + 1) (n + 1) x.1
proof:
:= by
  change almostSurjectiveWordDifferential ℤ (n + 1) n
    (almostSurjectiveWordContraction ℤ (n + 1) n
      (surjectiveWordToAlmost ℤ (n + 1) (n + 1) x.1)) = _
  have hx : almostSurjectiveWordDifferential ℤ (n + 1) (n + 1)
      (surjectiveWordToAlmost ℤ (n + 1) (n + 1) x.1) = 0 := by
    rw [almostSurjectiveWordDifferential_toAlmost, x.2, map_zero]
  have h := almostSurjectiveWordDifferential_contraction ℤ (n + 1) n
    (surjectiveWordToAlmost ℤ (n + 1) (n + 1) x.1)
  simpa only [hx, map_zero, add_zero] using h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.topWordCycleDown_injective
statement: theorem topWordCycleDown_injective (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (topWordCycleDown n)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  have hr : almostSurjectiveWordRestriction ℤ (n + 1) n (topWordCyclePrimitive n x) =
      almostSurjectiveWordRestriction ℤ (n + 1) n (topWordCyclePrimitive n y) :=
    congrArg Subtype.val h
  have he : topWordCyclePrimitive n x = topWordCyclePrimitive n y := by
    rw [← topWord_lift_restriction (n + 1) n (by omega) (topWordCyclePrimitive n x),
      ← topWord_lift_restriction (n + 1) n (by omega) (topWordCyclePrimitive n y), hr]
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply surjectiveWordToAlmost_injective ℤ (n + 1) (n + 1)
  rw [← topWordCyclePrimitive_differential n x,
    ← topWordCyclePrimitive_differential n y, he]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.topWordCycleDown_surjective
statement: theorem topWordCycleDown_surjective (n : ℕ) : Function.Surjective (topWordCycleDown n)
proof:
:= by
  intro c
  let y := almostSurjectiveWordLift ℤ (n + 1) n c.1
  have hr : almostSurjectiveWordRestriction ℤ (n + 1) (n + 1)
      (almostSurjectiveWordDifferential ℤ (n + 1) n y) = 0 := by
    rw [← surjectiveWordDifferential_restriction, almostSurjectiveWordRestriction_lift]
    exact c.2
  let z : surjectiveWordCochain ℤ (n + 2) (n + 1) :=
    fun a => almostSurjectiveWordDifferential ℤ (n + 1) n y
      ⟨a.1, coversOldVertices_of_surjective a.1 a.2⟩
  have hj : surjectiveWordToAlmost ℤ (n + 1) (n + 1) z =
      almostSurjectiveWordDifferential ℤ (n + 1) n y := by
    funext a
    rw [surjectiveWordToAlmost_apply]
    by_cases ha : Function.Surjective a.1
    · rw [dif_pos ha]
    · rw [dif_neg ha]
      exact (almostSurjectiveWord_eq_zero_of_not_surjective_of_restriction_eq_zero
        ℤ (n + 1) (n + 1) _ hr a ha).symm
  have hz : surjectiveWordDifferential ℤ (n + 2) (n + 1) z = 0 := by
    apply surjectiveWordToAlmost_injective ℤ (n + 1) (n + 2)
    rw [map_zero, ← almostSurjectiveWordDifferential_toAlmost, hj,
      almostSurjectiveWordDifferential_comp_self]
  refine ⟨⟨z, hz⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  change almostSurjectiveWordRestriction ℤ (n + 1) n
    (almostSurjectiveWordContraction ℤ (n + 1) n
      (surjectiveWordToAlmost ℤ (n + 1) (n + 1) z)) = c.1
  rw [hj]
  exact topWord_restriction_contraction_differential_lift (n + 1) n c.1

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.topWord_single_vertex_surjective
statement:
theorem topWord_single_vertex_surjective (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin 1) :
    Function.Surjective a
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  exact ⟨0, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D37.projBundleClosedPos_projectiveIntegral
statement:
theorem projBundleClosedPos_projectiveIntegral {k : Type u} [CommRing k] [IsNoetherianRing k]
    (hT : TwistInvarianceStatement.{u}) (hS : SegreClosedImmersionStatement k) :
    D30.ProjBundleClosedPos (D28.ProjectiveIntegral k)
proof:
:= by
  intro X _ _ _ hX E C e hC
  obtain ⟨hI, N, j, hj⟩ := hX.out
  haveI := hj
  haveI := hI
  have hE : HasConstantRank X E (e + 1) := hasConstantRank_of_frameCover C hC
  obtain ⟨D, C', n, ι, hι, -⟩ := exists_closedImmersion_twist_into_product_pos N j E (e + 1) hE
  have hL : HasConstantRank X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (D : ℤ))) 1 :=
    hasConstantRank_pullback X j _ 1
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.hasConstantRank_twist (k := k) N (D : ℤ))
  obtain ⟨iso, -⟩ := hT _ E hL hE C C'
  obtain ⟨M, s, hs⟩ := hS N n
  refine ⟨C.isIntegral_scheme_of_card hC, M, iso.hom ≫ ι ≫ s, ?_⟩
  haveI := hι
  haveI := hs
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.e6_pushWeil_mapIso
statement:
theorem e6_pushWeil_mapIso {L M : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1) (v : X) (e : L ≅ M) {b₀ : pointClosureScheme v}
    (b : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme v)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj L) b₀) :
    properPushforward (pointClosureι v) (Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame
      (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure M hM v) (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one M hM v)
      (b.mapIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).mapIso e))).1 =
    properPushforward (pointClosureι v) (Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame
      (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL v) (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one L hL v)
      b).1
proof:
:= by
  rw [e4_weilDivisor_mapIso (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL v)
    (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure M hM v) (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one L hL v)
    (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one M hM v) b ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).mapIso e)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.cap_iso_component
statement:
theorem cap_iso_component {L M : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1) (e : L ≅ M) (m : ℕ) :
    ops.cap L hL m = ops.cap M hM m
proof:
:= by
  apply e4_linearMap_ext_of_prime
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨b⟩ := Scheme.Modules.exists_lineBundleLocalDataAt (pointClosureScheme v)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj L)
    (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL v) (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one L hL v)
    (pointClosureGenericPoint v)
  have hmM := m7s_pushWeil_mem (k := k) M hM m v hv
    (b.mapIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).mapIso e))
  exact (ops.cap_mk L hL m v hv (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one L hL v) b ⟨_, hmM⟩
    (e6_pushWeil_mapIso hL hM v e b)).trans
    (ops.cap_mk M hM m v hv (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one M hM v)
      (b.mapIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).mapIso e)) ⟨_, hmM⟩ rfl).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.totalCap_iso
statement:
theorem totalCap_iso {L M : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1) (e : L ≅ M) :
    totalCap ops L hL = totalCap ops M hM
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  cases n with
  | zero => apply LinearMap.ext; intro c; simp [totalCap, capComponent]
  | succ m =>
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro c
    simp only [totalCap, LinearMap.comp_apply, DirectSum.toModule_lof, capComponent,
      cap_iso_component ops hL hM e m]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.totalCap_of_tensor_iso
statement:
theorem totalCap_of_tensor_iso {N L' O : X.Modules} (hN : HasConstantRank X N 1)
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L' 1) (hO : HasConstantRank X O 1)
    (e : tensorSheaf X N L' ≅ O) :
    totalCap ops O hO = totalCap ops N hN + totalCap ops L' hL
proof:
:= by
  have hT : HasConstantRank X (tensorSheaf X N L') 1 := by
    have h := hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hN hL
    rwa [Nat.one_mul] at h
  rw [← totalCap_iso ops hT hO e]
  exact totalCap_tensor ops N L' hN hL hT

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.tautCoord_jointly_epi
statement:
theorem tautCoord_jointly_epi {T : C.scheme.Modules} (f g : C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1 ⟶ T)
    (h1 : tautCoordFst C ≫ f = tautCoordFst C ≫ g)
    (h2 : tautCoordSnd C ≫ f = tautCoordSnd C ≫ g) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  haveI := C.tautologicalQuotient_epi
  refine (cancel_epi C.tautologicalQuotient).1 ?_
  let F := Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase
  have hid : F.map biprod.fst ≫ F.map biprod.inl + F.map biprod.snd ≫ F.map biprod.inr =
      𝟙 (F.obj (L ⊞ M)) := by
    rw [← F.map_comp, ← F.map_comp, ← F.map_add, biprod.total, F.map_id]
  have key : ∀ u : F.obj (L ⊞ M) ⟶ T, u =
      F.map biprod.fst ≫ (F.map biprod.inl ≫ u) + F.map biprod.snd ≫ (F.map biprod.inr ≫ u) := by
    intro u
    conv_lhs => rw [← Category.id_comp u, ← hid]
    simp only [Preadditive.add_comp, Category.assoc]
  rw [key (C.tautologicalQuotient ≫ f), key (C.tautologicalQuotient ≫ g)]
  have e1 : F.map biprod.inl ≫ C.tautologicalQuotient ≫ f =
      F.map biprod.inl ≫ C.tautologicalQuotient ≫ g := by
    simpa [tautCoordFst] using h1
  have e2 : F.map biprod.inr ≫ C.tautologicalQuotient ≫ f =
      F.map biprod.inr ≫ C.tautologicalQuotient ≫ g := by
    simpa [tautCoordSnd] using h2
  rw [e1, e2]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.tensorDualCancel_nonempty
statement:
theorem tensorDualCancel_nonempty :
    Nonempty (tensorSheaf X (tensorSheaf X A (lineBundleDual X B)) B ≅ A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, -, hcard⟩ := id hB
  letI := hq
  let e := fun i ↦ (LineBundleDual.exists_triv B q hcard i).some
  let T := tensorLineBundleDualIso B q.X q.coversTop e
  exact ⟨tensorSheafAssociator X A (lineBundleDual X B) B ≪≫
    (tensorSheafBifunctor X).mapIso (Iso.prod (Iso.refl A)
      (tensorSheafSymmetry X (lineBundleDual X B) B ≪≫ T)) ≪≫
    tensorSheafRightUnitor X A⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.totalCap_split_dual
statement:
theorem totalCap_split_dual (hA : HasConstantRank X A 1)
    (hAD : HasConstantRank X (tensorSheaf X A (lineBundleDual X B)) 1) :
    totalCap ops A hA = totalCap ops (tensorSheaf X A (lineBundleDual X B)) hAD +
      totalCap ops B hB
proof:
:=
  totalCap_of_tensor_iso ops hAD hB hA (tensorDualCancel_nonempty hB A).some

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.evTrunc_smul_op
statement:
theorem evTrunc_smul_op {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℚ M] (n : ℕ) (H : Module.End ℚ M)
    (a : ℚ) (f : PowerSeries ℚ) : evTrunc n (a • H) f = evTrunc n H (PowerSeries.rescale a f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [evTrunc_eq_sum, evTrunc_eq_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
  rw [smul_pow, PowerSeries.coeff_rescale, smul_smul, mul_comm]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.totalCapOn_twist_step
statement:
theorem totalCapOn_twist_step (d e : ℤ) (h : d + 1 = e) :
    totalCapOn (opsV4 k) (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n e) (hcr k n e) =
      totalCapOn (opsV4 k) (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) (hcr k n d) + spaceH k n
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  have hT : HasConstantRank (space k n) (tensorSheaf (space k n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d)
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n 1)) 1 := by
    simpa using hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf (hcr k n d) (hcr k n 1)
  rw [← cap_isoOn (opsV4 k) hT (hcr k n (d + 1))
    ⟨projectiveTwistingTensorIso k n d 1⟩]
  exact totalCapOn_tensor (ops := opsV4 k) _ _ (hcr k n d) (hcr k n 1) hT

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.totalCapOn_twist
statement:
theorem totalCapOn_twist (d : ℤ) :
    totalCapOn (opsV4 k) (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) (hcr k n d) = (d : ℚ) • spaceH k n
proof:
:= by
  induction d using Int.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    rw [cap_isoOn (opsV4 k) (hcr k n 0) hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf
      ⟨projectiveTwistingZeroIso k n⟩, totalCapOn_tensorUnit]
    simp
  | succ i ih =>
    rw [totalCapOn_twist_step k n (i : ℤ) ((i : ℤ) + 1) rfl, ih]
    push_cast
    rw [add_smul, one_smul]
  | pred i ih =>
    have h := totalCapOn_twist_step k n (-(i : ℤ) - 1) (-(i : ℤ)) (by ring)
    rw [ih] at h
    
    have h2 : totalCapOn (opsV4 k) (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n (-(i : ℤ) - 1))
        (hcr k n (-(i : ℤ) - 1)) = ((-(i : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) : ℚ) • spaceH k n := by
      push_cast at h ⊢
      have key : ∀ {A : Type _} [AddCommGroup A] (a c H : A), a = c + H → c = a - H :=
        fun a c H h ↦ by rw [h]; abel
      refine (key (A := Module.End ℚ (TotalChow (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n))) _ _ _ h).trans ?_
      refine LinearMap.ext fun v ↦ ?_
      simp [sub_smul]
    exact h2

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.gateRHS_classOf
statement:
theorem gateRHS_classOf (hCh : ChExact k (closedPosV4 k)) (d : ℤ) :
    gateRHS k n hCh (k0ClassOf (space k n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d)
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree k n d)) =
      Ring.choose ((d : ℚ) + n) n • ptv k
proof:
:= by
  have hv := spaceFundClass_mem_S k n
  have hH : spaceH k n =
      totalCapOn (opsV4 k) (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n 1) (hcr k n 1) := rfl
  unfold gateRHS
  rw [chK0_classOf, fundClass_space_eq, chBundle_line k _ _ (hcr k n d) hv,
    totalCapOn_twist, evTrunc_smul_op, hH]
  have hw1 : evTrunc n (totalCapOn (opsV4 k) (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n 1) (hcr k n 1))
      (PowerSeries.rescale (d : ℚ) (PowerSeries.exp ℚ)) (spaceFundClass k n) ∈
      S (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k n) m) n :=
    (lowersDeg_totalCapOn k _ (hcr k n 1)).evTrunc_mem_S hv _
  rw [tdLine_pow_apply k _ (hcr k n 1) hw1 (n + 1)]
  have hc : Commute ((evTrunc n (totalCapOn (opsV4 k) (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n 1)
        (hcr k n 1)) tdSer) ^ (n + 1))
      (evTrunc n (totalCapOn (opsV4 k) (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n 1) (hcr k n 1))
        (PowerSeries.rescale (d : ℚ) (PowerSeries.exp ℚ))) :=
    Commute.pow_left (evTrunc_comm n _ _ _) (n + 1)
  rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, hc.eq, Module.End.mul_apply]
  exact caseI_spaceKn_class k n d

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.map_intCast_mul
statement:
theorem map_intCast_mul {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] {Y : Scheme.{u}} (F : K0 Y →+ A) (N : ℤ)
    (a : K0 Y) : F ((N : K0 Y) * a) = N • F a
proof:
:= by
  induction N using Int.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | succ i ih =>
    rw [Int.cast_add, Int.cast_one, add_mul, one_mul, map_add, ih, add_zsmul, one_zsmul]
  | pred i ih =>
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg (-(i : ℤ)) 1, Int.cast_add, add_mul, map_add, ih, Int.cast_neg (1 : ℤ),
      Int.cast_one, neg_mul, one_mul, map_neg, add_zsmul, neg_one_zsmul]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.chK0_spk
statement:
theorem chK0_spk (hCh : ChExact k (closedPosV4 k)) (w : K0 (Spk k)) :
    chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) hCh w (fundClass k (W := Spk k)) =
      ((eulerSpk k (k0ToG0 (Spk k) w) : ℤ) : ℚ) • ptv k
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) hCh (1 : K0 (Spk k)) (fundClass k (W := Spk k)) = ptv k := by
    have : (1 : K0 (Spk k)) =
        k0ClassOf _ (tensorUnitSheaf _) (tensorUnitSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree _) := rfl
    rw [this, chK0_classOf, fundClass_spk, chBundle_lof_zero, rkOf_unit]
    simp
  obtain ⟨N, rfl⟩ := spk_exists_intCast k w
  let Fv : K0 (Spk k) →+ TotalChow (Spk k) :=
    AddMonoidHom.mk' (fun w ↦ chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) hCh w (fundClass k (W := Spk k)))
      (fun a b ↦ by rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply])
  have hl := map_intCast_mul Fv N (1 : K0 (Spk k))
  have hr := map_intCast_mul ((eulerSpk k).comp (k0ToG0 (Spk k))) N (1 : K0 (Spk k))
  rw [mul_one] at hl hr
  change Fv _ = _
  rw [hl]
  change N • (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) hCh (1 : K0 (Spk k)) (fundClass k (W := Spk k))) = _
  rw [h1]
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply] at hr
  rw [hr, eulerSpk_one]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  exact (Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul ℚ N (ptv k)).symm

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.eulerChar_twist_eq
statement:
theorem eulerChar_twist_eq (hn : 0 < n) (d : ℤ) (h1 : -(n : ℤ) ≤ d) (h2 : d ≤ 0) :
    (((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).eulerChar k : ℤ) : ℚ) = Ring.choose ((d : ℚ) + n) n
proof:
:= by
  rcases h2.lt_or_eq with hlt | rfl
  · rw [eulerChar_projectiveTwistingSheaf_of_neg k n hn d h1 hlt]
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j : ℕ, d + n = j := ⟨(d + n).toNat, by omega⟩
    have hjn : j < n := by omega
    have hq : ((d : ℚ) + (n : ℚ)) = ((j : ℕ) : ℚ) := by
      have : ((d + n : ℤ) : ℚ) = ((j : ℤ) : ℚ) := by rw [hj]
      push_cast at this
      exact this
    rw [hq, Ring.choose_natCast, Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt hjn]
    simp
  · have h := eulerChar_projectiveTwistingSheaf_nat k n 0
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_add, Nat.choose_self] at h
    rw [h]
    simp [Ring.choose_natCast]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.gateRHS_eq
statement:
theorem gateRHS_eq (hCh : ChExact k (closedPosV4 k)) (hn : 0 < n) (y : K0 (space k n)) :
    gateRHS k n hCh y = ((eulerP k n hn (k0ToG0 (space k n) y) : ℤ) : ℚ) • ptv k
proof:
:= by
  let F1 : K0 (space k n) →+ TotalChow (Spk k) :=
    AddMonoidHom.mk' (gateRHS k n hCh) (fun a b ↦ by
      unfold gateRHS
      rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_add, map_add])
  let F2 : K0 (space k n) →+ TotalChow (Spk k) :=
    AddMonoidHom.mk' (fun y ↦ ((eulerP k n hn (k0ToG0 (space k n) y) : ℤ) : ℚ) • ptv k)
      (fun a b ↦ by simp only [map_add, Int.cast_add, add_smul])
  change F1 y = F2 y
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := projectiveSpace_k0_span k n y
  rw [hg, map_sum, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := spk_exists_intCast k (g i)
  rw [hN, map_intCast, projectiveTwistingK0Class_neg_one_pow, map_intCast_mul F1,
    map_intCast_mul F2]
  congr 1
  have hi : (i : ℕ) ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp i.isLt
  change gateRHS k n hCh (k0ClassOf (space k n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n (-((i : ℕ) : ℤ)))
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree k n _)) =
    ((eulerP k n hn (k0ToG0 (space k n) (k0ClassOf (space k n)
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n (-((i : ℕ) : ℤ)))
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree k n _)))  : ℤ) : ℚ) • ptv k
  rw [gateRHS_classOf, eulerP_classOf,
    eulerChar_twist_eq k n hn (-((i : ℕ) : ℤ)) (by omega) (by omega)]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.caseI_projSpace
statement:
theorem caseI_projSpace (hCh : ChExact k (closedPosV4 k)) (hn : 0 < n) :
    CaseI k (closedPosV4 k) hCh (toSpec k n) (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n 1) (hcr k n 1) (n + 1)
      (projectiveDerivedPushforward k n hn)
proof:
:= by
  intro y w hw
  change _ = gateRHS k n hCh y
  rw [chK0_spk k hCh w, gateRHS_eq k n hCh hn y, hw, eulerSpk_comp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoN_imageChartRingEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem m7geoN_imageChartRingEquiv_apply {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (j : Spec (CommRingCat.of A) ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (s : Γ(Y, j ''ᵁ ⊤)) :
    m7geoN_imageChartRingEquiv j s =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).hom
        (j.appLE (j ''ᵁ ⊤) ⊤ (j.preimage_image_eq ⊤).ge s)
proof:
:= by
  change (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).hom ((j.appIso ⊤).hom s) = _
  rw [Scheme.Hom.appIso_hom']

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoN_imageChartRingEquiv_transport_apply
statement:
private theorem m7geoN_imageChartRingEquiv_transport_apply
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (j : Spec (CommRingCat.of A) ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    {U : Y.Opens} (hU : j ''ᵁ ⊤ = U) (s : Γ(Y, U)) :
    (hU ▸ m7geoN_imageChartRingEquiv j) s =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).hom
        (j.appLE U ⊤ (by rw [← hU, j.preimage_image_eq]) s)
proof:
:= by
  cases hU
  exact m7geoN_imageChartRingEquiv_apply j s

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoN_rangeChartRingEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem m7geoN_rangeChartRingEquiv_apply {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (j : Spec (CommRingCat.of A) ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (s : Γ(Y, j.opensRange)) :
    m7geoN_rangeChartRingEquiv j s =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).hom
        (j.appLE j.opensRange ⊤ (j.preimage_opensRange ▸ le_rfl) s)
proof:
:= by
  exact m7geoN_imageChartRingEquiv_transport_apply j
    j.image_top_eq_opensRange s

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoN_rangeChartRingEquiv_symm_appLE
statement:
theorem m7geoN_rangeChartRingEquiv_symm_appLE {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (j : Spec (CommRingCat.of A) ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (b : A) :
    let hVU : (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).Opens) ≤
        j ⁻¹ᵁ j.opensRange
proof:
:= j.preimage_opensRange ▸ le_rfl
    (j.appLE j.opensRange ⊤ hVU)
      ((m7geoN_rangeChartRingEquiv j).symm b) =
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv b := by
  dsimp only
  apply (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.injective
  change (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).hom
      (j.appLE j.opensRange ⊤ (j.preimage_opensRange ▸ le_rfl)
        ((m7geoN_rangeChartRingEquiv j).symm b)) =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).hom
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv b)
  rw [← m7geoN_rangeChartRingEquiv_apply j]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoN_spec_top_prime_asIdeal
statement:
theorem m7geoN_spec_top_prime_asIdeal {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    (P : Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) :
    ((isAffineOpen_top (Spec (CommRingCat.of A))).primeIdealOf
      ⟨P, trivial⟩).asIdeal =
        P.asIdeal.comap (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).hom.hom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsAffineOpen.primeIdealOf, IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_hom,
    Scheme.Opens.toSpecΓ_top]
  change (((Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).toSpecΓ P).asIdeal) = _
  rw [← SpecMap_ΓSpecIso_hom]
  exact PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).hom.hom P

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoN_range_prime_comap
statement:
theorem m7geoN_range_prime_comap {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (j : Spec (CommRingCat.of A) ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (P : Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) :
    let hVU : (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).Opens) ≤
        j ⁻¹ᵁ j.opensRange
proof:
:= j.preimage_opensRange ▸ le_rfl
    ((isAffineOpen_top (Spec (CommRingCat.of A))).primeIdealOf
      ⟨P, trivial⟩).asIdeal.comap
        (j.appLE j.opensRange ⊤ hVU).hom =
      P.asIdeal.comap (m7geoN_rangeChartRingEquiv j).toRingHom := by
  dsimp only
  rw [m7geoN_spec_top_prime_asIdeal]
  ext s
  simp only [Ideal.mem_comap]
  change _ ∈ P.asIdeal ↔ m7geoN_rangeChartRingEquiv j s ∈ P.asIdeal
  rw [m7geoN_rangeChartRingEquiv_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoN_range_prime_succ
statement:
theorem m7geoN_range_prime_succ {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (j : Spec (CommRingCat.of A) ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (P Q : Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) (b : A)
    (hQ : Q.asIdeal = P.asIdeal ⊔ Ideal.span {b}) :
    let hVU : (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).Opens) ≤
        j ⁻¹ᵁ j.opensRange
proof:
:= j.preimage_opensRange ▸ le_rfl
    ((isAffineOpen_top (Spec (CommRingCat.of A))).primeIdealOf
      ⟨Q, trivial⟩).asIdeal.comap
        (j.appLE j.opensRange ⊤ hVU).hom =
      ((isAffineOpen_top (Spec (CommRingCat.of A))).primeIdealOf
        ⟨P, trivial⟩).asIdeal.comap
          (j.appLE j.opensRange ⊤ hVU).hom ⊔
        Ideal.span {(m7geoN_rangeChartRingEquiv j).symm b} := by
  dsimp only
  rw [m7geoN_range_prime_comap j Q,
    m7geoN_range_prime_comap j P, hQ]
  exact m7geoM_comap_sup_span_equiv
    (m7geoN_rangeChartRingEquiv j) P.asIdeal b

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoN_J0_prime_succ
statement:
theorem m7geoN_J0_prime_succ {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (i : C.I) [Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)]
    {v : X} (hv : v ∈ C.U i) (t : ℕ)
    (ht : t < C.positiveRankDimension i) :
    let J
proof:
:= m7g_J C i 0
    let Qt := m7g_Q C i hv t
    let Qnext := m7g_Q C i hv (t + 1)
    let W : C.scheme.affineOpens := ⟨J.opensRange, isAffineOpen_opensRange J⟩
    let hVU : (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of
      (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0)
        Γ(X, C.U i)))).Opens) ≤ J ⁻¹ᵁ W.1 :=
          J.preimage_opensRange ▸ le_rfl
    ((isAffineOpen_top (Spec (CommRingCat.of
      (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0)
        Γ(X, C.U i))))).primeIdealOf ⟨Qnext, trivial⟩).asIdeal.comap
        (J.appLE W.1 ⊤ hVU).hom =
      ((isAffineOpen_top (Spec (CommRingCat.of
        (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0)
          Γ(X, C.U i))))).primeIdealOf ⟨Qt, trivial⟩).asIdeal.comap
          (J.appLE W.1 ⊤ hVU).hom ⊔
        Ideal.span {(m7geoN_rangeChartRingEquiv J).symm
          (MvPolynomial.X (m7geo_nextIndex C i t ht))} := by
  simpa only using m7geoN_range_prime_succ
    (m7g_J C i 0) (m7g_Q C i hv t) (m7g_Q C i hv (t + 1))
    (MvPolynomial.X (m7geo_nextIndex C i t ht)) (m7geo_Q_succ C i hv t ht)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoN_flag_chart_variable_ord_one
statement:
theorem m7geoN_flag_chart_variable_ord_one {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    [IsLocallyNoetherian C.scheme]
    (i : C.I) [Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)]
    {v : X} (hv : v ∈ C.U i) (t : ℕ)
    (ht : t < C.positiveRankDimension i)
    (z : pointClosureScheme (m7g_w C i hv t))
    (hznext : pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z =
      m7g_w C i hv (t + 1)) (hz : coheight z = 1) :
    let J
proof:
:= m7g_J C i 0
    let W : C.scheme.affineOpens := ⟨J.opensRange, isAffineOpen_opensRange J⟩
    let hzW : pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z ∈ W.1 := by
      rw [hznext]
      change J (m7g_Q C i hv (t + 1)) ∈ J.opensRange
      rw [Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange]
      exact ⟨m7g_Q C i hv (t + 1), rfl⟩
    haveI : Nonempty (pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) ⁻¹ᵁ W.1) :=
      ⟨⟨z, hzW⟩⟩
    (pointClosureScheme (m7g_w C i hv t)).ord
      ((pointClosureScheme (m7g_w C i hv t)).germToFunctionField
        (pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) ⁻¹ᵁ W.1)
        ((pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t)).app W.1
          ((m7geoN_rangeChartRingEquiv J).symm
            (MvPolynomial.X (m7geo_nextIndex C i t ht))))) z = 1 := by
  let J := m7g_J C i 0
  let W : C.scheme.affineOpens := ⟨J.opensRange, isAffineOpen_opensRange J⟩
  have hzW : pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z ∈ W.1 := by
    rw [hznext]
    change J (m7g_Q C i hv (t + 1)) ∈ J.opensRange
    rw [Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange]
    exact ⟨m7g_Q C i hv (t + 1), rfl⟩
  dsimp only
  exact m7geoM_flag_ord_one_of_chart_ideal C i hv t z hznext hz
    ((m7geoN_rangeChartRingEquiv J).symm
      (MvPolynomial.X (m7geo_nextIndex C i t ht)))
    (m7geoN_J0_prime_succ C i hv t ht)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.a0_full_bridge._simp_1_2
proof:
:=
  fun {C} {inst} {FC} {CC} {hFC} [self : _] {X Y Z} f g x ↦
    (@ConcreteCategory.comp_apply.{w, v, u, u_1}
      C inst FC CC hFC self X Y Z f g x).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.a0_full_bridge._simp_1_3
statement:
theorem a0_full_bridge._simp_1_3.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} :
    ∀ {C : Type u₁} [instC : Category.{v₁} C]
      {D : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} D]
      (self : C ⥤ D) {X Y Z : C}
      (f : @Quiver.Hom C (@CategoryStruct.toQuiver C (@Category.toCategoryStruct C instC)) X Y)
      (g : @Quiver.Hom C (@CategoryStruct.toQuiver C (@Category.toCategoryStruct C instC)) Y Z),
      self.map f ≫ self.map g = self.map (f ≫ g)
proof:
:=
  fun {C} [instC : _] {D} [instD : _] self {X Y Z} f g ↦
    (@Functor.map_comp.{v₁, v₂, u₁, u₂} C instC D instD self X Y Z f g).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.restrictAppIso_naturality_apply
statement:
theorem restrictAppIso_naturality_apply {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion f] (M : Y.Modules) {U V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (x : Γ(M.restrict f, U)) :
    (M.restrictAppIso f V).hom
        ((M.restrict f).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op x) =
      M.presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (Scheme.Hom.image_mono f hVU)).op
        ((M.restrictAppIso f U).hom x)
proof:
:= by
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (Scheme.Modules.map_restrictAppIso_hom f M (homOfLE hVU).op) x

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.restrictAppIso_naturality_apply_inv
statement:
theorem restrictAppIso_naturality_apply_inv {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion f] (M : Y.Modules) {U V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (y : Γ(M, f ''ᵁ U)) :
    (M.restrict f).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op ((M.restrictAppIso f U).inv y) =
      (M.restrictAppIso f V).inv
        (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (Scheme.Hom.image_mono f hVU)).op y)
proof:
:= by
  have h := restrictAppIso_naturality_apply f M hVU ((M.restrictAppIso f U).inv y)
  have h2 := congrArg (M.restrictAppIso f V).inv h
  exact h2

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localFrameProjection_naturality_apply
statement:
theorem localFrameProjection_naturality_apply (d : ℤ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    {U V : (coordinateOpen k n i).toScheme.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (x : Γ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).restrict
      (coordinateOpen k n i).ι, U)) :
    (localFrameProjection k n d i).app V
        (((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).restrict
          (coordinateOpen k n i).ι).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op x) =
      (unitModules (coordinateOpen k n i).toScheme).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE hVU).op
        ((localFrameProjection k n d i).app U x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun q ↦ q x)
    ((localFrameProjection k n d i).val.naturality (homOfLE hVU).op)
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.scheme_modules_hom_naturality_apply
statement:
