theorem scheme_modules_hom_naturality_apply {X : Scheme.{u}} {M N : X.Modules} (f : M ⟶ N)
    {U V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U) (x : Γ(M, U)) :
    f.app V (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op x) =
      N.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op (f.app U x)
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun q ↦ q x) (f.val.naturality (homOfLE hVU).op)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_eq_localFrameProjection
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_eq_localFrameProjection
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d, coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p a)) :
    coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation k n d p a x =
      (coordinateCechStructureRestrictionAddEquiv k n p a).symm
        ((localFrameProjection k n d
            (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a)).app
          (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p a)
          (coordinateCechTwistingRestrictionAddEquiv k n d p a x))
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent_apply (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d, coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p a)) :
    coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent k n d p a x =
      coordinateCechBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent k n p a
          (coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation k n d p a x) *
        coordinateTwistingFrameLaurentMonomial k n d
          (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurent_eq_basicOpen
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurent_eq_basicOpen (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d, coordinateCechIntersection k n p a)) :
    coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurent k n d p a x =
      coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent k n d p a
        ((coordinateCechIntersectionBasicOpenSectionIso k n
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) p a).hom x)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex_succAbove_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex_succAbove_of_ne_zero (p : ℕ)
    (r : Fin (p + 2)) (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p (a ∘ r.succAbove) =
      coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex, Function.comp_apply]
  rw [Fin.succAbove_ne_zero_zero hr]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.cast_apply_index
statement:
theorem cast_apply_index {P : Sort*} {T : P → Sort*} (g : ∀ z, T z) {x y : P} (h : x = y) :
    h ▸ g x = g y
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface_image_le
statement:
theorem coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface_image_le (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (hi2 : coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p (a ∘ r.succAbove) =
      coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a) :
    coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a ≤
      hi2 ▸ coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove)
proof:
:= by
  convert (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι.preimage_mono
    (leOfHom (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p r a)) using 2
  · rfl
  · exact cast_apply_index
      (fun z ↦ (coordinateOpen k n z).ι ⁻¹ᵁ coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove))
      hi2

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image_naturality
statement:
theorem coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image_naturality
    (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2)) (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p r a).op ≫
        (eqToIso (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n (p + 1) a)).op.hom =
      (eqToIso (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n p
          (a ∘ r.succAbove))).op.hom ≫
        (imageCoface k n p r a).op
proof:
:=
  Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image_naturality_apply
statement:
theorem coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image_naturality_apply
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2)) (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d, coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove))) :
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
        (eqToIso (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n (p + 1) a)).op.hom
      ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
        (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p r a).op x) =
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map (imageCoface k n p r a).op
      ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
        (eqToIso (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n p
          (a ∘ r.succAbove))).op.hom x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
    ← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp,
    coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image_naturality]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.restrictAppIso_symm_naturality
statement:
theorem restrictAppIso_symm_naturality (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (hi2 : coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p (a ∘ r.succAbove) =
      coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)
    (y : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d,
      (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
        (hi2 ▸ coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove)))) :
    ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).restrict
        (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface_image_le k n p r a hi2)).op
      (((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).restrictAppIso
          (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι
          (hi2 ▸ coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove))).inv y) =
    ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).restrictAppIso
        (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι
        (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a)).inv
      ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (Scheme.Hom.image_mono
          (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι
          (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface_image_le k n p r a hi2))).op y)
proof:
:=
  restrictAppIso_naturality_apply_inv
    (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface_image_le k n p r a hi2) y

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localFrameProjection_symm_naturality
statement:
theorem localFrameProjection_symm_naturality (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (hi2 : coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p (a ∘ r.succAbove) =
      coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)
    (x : Γ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).restrict
        (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι,
      hi2 ▸ coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove))) :
    (localFrameProjection k n d (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).app
        (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a)
      (((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).restrict
          (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface_image_le k n p r a hi2)).op x) =
    (unitModules
        (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).toScheme).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface_image_le k n p r a hi2)).op
      ((localFrameProjection k n d (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).app
          (hi2 ▸ coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove)) x)
proof:
:=
  localFrameProjection_naturality_apply k n d (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)
    (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface_image_le k n p r a hi2) x

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.heq_cast_index
statement:
theorem heq_cast_index {P : Sort*} {T : P → Sort*} {x y : P} (h : x = y) (v : T x) :
    HEq v (h ▸ v)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOpen_ι_image_cast
statement:
theorem coordinateOpen_ι_image_cast {i1 i2 : Fin (n + 1)} (hi2 : i1 = i2)
    (U : (coordinateOpen k n i1).toScheme.Opens) :
    (coordinateOpen k n i2).ι ''ᵁ (hi2 ▸ U) = (coordinateOpen k n i1).ι ''ᵁ U
proof:
:= by
  subst hi2
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.imageCoface_le
statement:
theorem imageCoface_le (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2)) (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (hi2 : coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p (a ∘ r.succAbove) =
      coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a) :
    (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
        coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a ≤
      (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p (a ∘ r.succAbove))).ι ''ᵁ
        coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coordinateOpen_ι_image_cast k n hi2]
  exact Scheme.Hom.image_mono _ (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface_image_le k n p r a hi2)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.imageCoface_eq_homOfLE
statement:
theorem imageCoface_eq_homOfLE (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2)) (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (hi2 : coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p (a ∘ r.succAbove) =
      coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a) :
    imageCoface k n p r a = homOfLE (imageCoface_le k n p r a hi2)
proof:
:=
  Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.restrictAppIso_inv_cast_apply_heq
statement:
theorem restrictAppIso_inv_cast_apply_heq {i1 i2 : Fin (n + 1)} (hi2 : i1 = i2) (d : ℤ)
    (U1 : (coordinateOpen k n i1).toScheme.Opens)
    (z : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d, (coordinateOpen k n i1).ι ''ᵁ U1)) :
    HEq (((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).restrictAppIso (coordinateOpen k n i2).ι
            (hi2 ▸ U1)).inv ((coordinateOpen_ι_image_cast k n hi2 U1) ▸ z))
        (((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).restrictAppIso (coordinateOpen k n i1).ι U1).inv z)
proof:
:= by
  subst hi2
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localFrameProjection_cast_apply_heq
proof:
:= by
  subst hi2
  subst hU
  subst hx
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.appIso_inv_cast_apply_heq
proof:
:= by
  subst hi2
  subst hU
  subst hz
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.eq_of_heq_cast
statement:
theorem eq_of_heq_cast {P : Sort*} {T : P → Sort*} {x y : P} (h : x = y) {vx : T x} {vy : T y}
    (hv : HEq vx vy) : h ▸ vx = vy
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  exact eq_of_heq hv

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.restrictAppIso_inv_heq_eqToIso_map
statement:
theorem restrictAppIso_inv_heq_eqToIso_map {i1 i2 : Fin (n + 1)} (hi2 : i1 = i2) (d : ℤ)
    (U1 : (coordinateOpen k n i1).toScheme.Opens)
    (z : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d, (coordinateOpen k n i1).ι ''ᵁ U1)) :
    HEq (((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).restrictAppIso (coordinateOpen k n i1).ι U1).inv z)
        (((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).restrictAppIso (coordinateOpen k n i2).ι
            (hi2 ▸ U1)).inv
          ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
            (eqToIso (coordinateOpen_ι_image_cast k n hi2 U1)).op.hom z))
proof:
:= by
  subst hi2
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.presheaf_map_eqToIso_inv_heq_eq
statement:
theorem presheaf_map_eqToIso_inv_heq_eq (X : Scheme.{u})
    {A1 A2 B : X.Opens} (h1 : A1 = B) (h2 : A2 = B)
    {v1 : Γ(X, A1)} {v2 : Γ(X, A2)} (hv : HEq v1 v2) :
    X.presheaf.map (eqToIso h1).op.inv v1 = X.presheaf.map (eqToIso h2).op.inv v2
proof:
:= by
  subst h1
  subst h2
  simpa using eq_of_heq hv

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingRestrictionAddEquiv_eq
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingRestrictionAddEquiv_eq (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d, coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p a)) :
    coordinateCechTwistingRestrictionAddEquiv k n d p a x =
      ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).restrictAppIso
          (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a)).ι
          (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p a)).inv
        ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
          (eqToIso (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n p a)).op.hom x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingRestrictionAddEquiv_app_eq
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingRestrictionAddEquiv_app_eq (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d, coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p a)) :
    (coordinateCechTwistingRestrictionAddEquiv k n d p a) x =
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
        (eqToIso (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n p a)).op.hom x
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateCechTwistingRestrictionAddEquiv_eq]
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso, Iso.refl_inv]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.restriction_cast_compat
statement:
theorem restriction_cast_compat (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2)) (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (hi2 : coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p (a ∘ r.succAbove) =
      coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a) :
    (eqToIso (coordinateOpen_ι_image_cast k n hi2
        (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove)))).op.hom ≫
      (homOfLE (Scheme.Hom.image_mono
          (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι
          (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface_image_le k n p r a hi2))).op =
      (homOfLE (imageCoface_le k n p r a hi2)).op
proof:
:=
  Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.restriction_cast_compat_apply
statement:
theorem restriction_cast_compat_apply (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (hi2 : coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p (a ∘ r.succAbove) =
      coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)
    (w : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d,
      (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p (a ∘ r.succAbove))).ι ''ᵁ
        coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove))) :
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (imageCoface_le k n p r a hi2)).op w =
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (Scheme.Hom.image_mono
          (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι
          (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface_image_le k n p r a hi2))).op
        ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
          (eqToIso (coordinateOpen_ι_image_cast k n hi2
            (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove)))).op.hom w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp, restriction_cast_compat]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingRestrictionAddEquiv_coface
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingRestrictionAddEquiv_coface (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (hi2 : coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p (a ∘ r.succAbove) =
      coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d, coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove))) :
    coordinateCechTwistingRestrictionAddEquiv k n d (p + 1) a
        ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
          (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p r a).op x) =
      ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).restrict
          (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface_image_le k n p r a hi2)).op
        (((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).restrictAppIso
            (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι
            (hi2 ▸ coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove))).inv
          ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
            (eqToIso (coordinateOpen_ι_image_cast k n hi2
              (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove)))).op.hom
            ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
              (eqToIso (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n p
                (a ∘ r.succAbove))).op.hom x)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateCechTwistingRestrictionAddEquiv_eq,
    coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image_naturality_apply,
    imageCoface_eq_homOfLE k n p r a hi2, restriction_cast_compat_apply]
  exact (restrictAppIso_symm_naturality k n d p r a hi2 _).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechStructureRestrictionAddEquiv_symm_eq
statement:
theorem coordinateCechStructureRestrictionAddEquiv_symm_eq (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (y : Γ(unitModules (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a)).toScheme,
      coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p a)) :
    (coordinateCechStructureRestrictionAddEquiv k n p a).symm y =
      (space k n).presheaf.map
          (eqToIso (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n p a)).op.inv
        (((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a)).ι.appIso
          (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p a)).inv y)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.appIso_inv_naturality_apply
statement:
theorem appIso_inv_naturality_apply {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    {U V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U) (x : Γ(X, U)) :
    (f.appIso V).inv (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op x) =
      Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (f.image_mono hVU)).op ((f.appIso U).inv x)
proof:
:=
  ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (f.appIso_inv_naturality (homOfLE hVU).op) x

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.appIso_symm_naturality
statement:
theorem appIso_symm_naturality (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2)) (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (hi2 : coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p (a ∘ r.succAbove) =
      coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)
    (y : Γ(unitModules (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).toScheme,
      hi2 ▸ coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove))) :
    ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι.appIso
        (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a)).inv
      ((unitModules
          (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).toScheme).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface_image_le k n p r a hi2)).op y) =
    (space k n).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (Scheme.Hom.image_mono
          (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι
          (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface_image_le k n p r a hi2))).op
      (((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι.appIso
          (hi2 ▸ coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove))).inv y)
proof:
:=
  appIso_inv_naturality_apply (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι
    (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface_image_le k n p r a hi2) y

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.structure_restriction_cast_compat
statement:
theorem structure_restriction_cast_compat (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (hi2 : coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p (a ∘ r.succAbove) =
      coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a) :
    (homOfLE (Scheme.Hom.image_mono
          (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι
          (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface_image_le k n p r a hi2))).op ≫
      (eqToIso (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n (p + 1) a)).op.inv =
    (eqToIso ((coordinateOpen_ι_image_cast k n hi2
        (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove))).trans
      (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove)))).op.inv ≫
      (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p r a).op
proof:
:=
  Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechStructureRestrictionAddEquiv_symm_coface
statement:
theorem coordinateCechStructureRestrictionAddEquiv_symm_coface (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (hi2 : coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p (a ∘ r.succAbove) =
      coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)
    (y : Γ(unitModules (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).toScheme,
      hi2 ▸ coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove))) :
    (coordinateCechStructureRestrictionAddEquiv k n (p + 1) a).symm
        ((unitModules
            (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).toScheme).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface_image_le k n p r a hi2)).op y) =
      (space k n).presheaf.map (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p r a).op
        ((space k n).presheaf.map
          (eqToIso ((coordinateOpen_ι_image_cast k n hi2
              (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove))).trans
            (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove)))).op.inv
          (((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι.appIso
              (hi2 ▸ coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove))).inv
            y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateCechStructureRestrictionAddEquiv_symm_eq, appIso_symm_naturality k n p r a hi2 y]
  conv_lhs => rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  conv_rhs => rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rw [structure_restriction_cast_compat]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_coface
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_coface (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d, coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove))) :
    coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation k n d (p + 1) a
        ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
          (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p r a).op x) =
      (space k n).presheaf.map
          (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p r a).op
        (coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation k n d p
          (a ∘ r.succAbove) x)
proof:
:= by
  have hi2 : coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p (a ∘ r.succAbove) =
      coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a :=
    coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex_succAbove_of_ne_zero n p r a hr
  set w := (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
    (eqToIso (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove))).op.hom x
    with hw
  rw [coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_eq_localFrameProjection,
    coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_eq_localFrameProjection,
    coordinateCechTwistingRestrictionAddEquiv_coface k n d p r a hi2,
    localFrameProjection_symm_naturality k n d p r a hi2 _,
    coordinateCechStructureRestrictionAddEquiv_symm_coface k n p r a hi2 _]
  congr 1
  rw [coordinateCechStructureRestrictionAddEquiv_symm_eq,
    coordinateCechTwistingRestrictionAddEquiv_eq]
  exact presheaf_map_eqToIso_inv_heq_eq (space k n)
    ((coordinateOpen_ι_image_cast k n hi2
      (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove))).trans
      (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove)))
    (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove))
    (appIso_inv_cast_apply_heq (k := k) (n := n) hi2
      (heq_cast_index (T := fun z => (coordinateOpen k n z).toScheme.Opens) hi2
        (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove)))
      (localFrameProjection_cast_apply_heq k n hi2 d
        (heq_cast_index (T := fun z => (coordinateOpen k n z).toScheme.Opens) hi2
          (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove)))
        (restrictAppIso_inv_heq_eqToIso_map k n hi2 d
          (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove)) w))).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_app_eq
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_app_eq (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d, coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p a)) :
    coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation k n d p a x =
      (space k n).presheaf.map
        (eqToIso (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n p a)).op.inv
        ((unitModules
            (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a)).toScheme).presheaf.map
          (eqToHom ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a)).ι.preimage_image_eq
            (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p a)).symm).op
          ((Pi.π (fun j : Fin (n + 1) ↦
              pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n j))
              (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a)).app
            ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a)).ι ''ᵁ
              coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p a)
            ((kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)).app
              ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a)).ι ''ᵁ
                coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p a)
              ((coordinateCechTwistingRestrictionAddEquiv k n d p a) x))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_eq_localFrameProjection,
    coordinateCechStructureRestrictionAddEquiv_symm_eq, localFrameProjection_app_eq]
  simp only [Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso, Iso.refl_inv]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_le
statement:
theorem coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_le (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
        coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a ≤
      coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image]
  exact leOfHom (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p 0 a)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechZeroCoface_eq_homOfLE
statement:
theorem coordinateCechZeroCoface_eq_homOfLE (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p 0 a).op ≫
      (eqToIso (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n (p + 1) a)).op.hom =
      (homOfLE (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_le k n p a)).op
proof:
:=
  Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechZeroCoface_eq_homOfLE_apply
statement:
theorem coordinateCechZeroCoface_eq_homOfLE_apply (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d,
      coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))) :
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
        (eqToIso (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n (p + 1) a)).op.hom
      ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
        (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p 0 a).op x) =
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_le k n p a)).op x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp, coordinateCechZeroCoface_eq_homOfLE]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_coface_zero_heq
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_coface_zero_heq (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d,
      coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))) :
    HEq (coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation k n d (p + 1) a
          ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
            (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p 0 a).op x))
      ((Pi.π (fun j : Fin (n + 1) ↦ pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n j))
          (a 0)).app
        ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
          coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a)
        ((kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)).app
          ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
            coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a)
          ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
            (homOfLE (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_le k n p a)).op x)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_app_eq,
    coordinateCechTwistingRestrictionAddEquiv_app_eq,
    coordinateCechZeroCoface_eq_homOfLE_apply]
  set raw := (Pi.π (fun j : Fin (n + 1) ↦ pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n j))
        (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).app
      ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
        coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a)
      ((kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)).app
        ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
          coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a)
        ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_le k n p a)).op x)) with hraw
  set inner := (unitModules
        (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).toScheme).presheaf.map
      (eqToHom ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι.preimage_image_eq
        (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a)).symm).op raw with hinner
  have step1 : HEq ((space k n).presheaf.map
      (eqToIso (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n (p + 1) a)).op.inv inner)
      inner :=
    heq_presheaf_map_eqToIso_op_inv (X := space k n) _ inner
  have step2 : HEq inner raw :=
    heq_presheaf_map_eqToHom_op
      (X := (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).toScheme) _ raw
  exact step1.trans step2

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateComponent_compatibility_heq
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateComponent_compatibility_heq
    (d : ℤ) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) (W : (space k n).Opens) (hW : W ≤ coordinateOverlapOpen k n i j)
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d, W)) :
    HEq ((Pi.π (fun t : Fin (n + 1) ↦
          pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n t)) i).app W
        ((kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)).app W x))
      ((pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition k n d i j).app W
        ((pushedUnitRestriction
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_right)).app W
          ((Pi.π (fun t : Fin (n + 1) ↦
              pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n t)) j).app W
            ((kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)).app W x))))
proof:
:= by
  set raw_i := (Pi.π (fun t : Fin (n + 1) ↦
        pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n t)) i).app W
      ((kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)).app W x) with hraw_i
  have step1 : HEq raw_i
      ((pushedUnitRestriction
          ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_left)).app W raw_i) :=
    (pushedUnitRestriction_app_of_le_heq
      ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_left) W hW raw_i).symm
  have hcompat := projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateComponent_compatibility_apply_explicit
    k n d i j W x
  exact step1.trans (heq_of_eq hcompat)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateComponent_compatibility_mul
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateComponent_compatibility_mul (d : ℤ) (i j : Fin (n + 1))
    (W : (space k n).Opens) (hW : W ≤ coordinateOverlapOpen k n i j)
    (x' : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d, W)) :
    ∃ u : Γ(space k n, (coordinateOverlapOpen k n i j).ι ''ᵁ
      ((coordinateOverlapOpen k n i j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)),
    (space k n).presheaf.map
        (eqToIso (show (coordinateOverlapOpen k n i j).ι ''ᵁ
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen k n i j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W) = W by
          rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
          exact inf_eq_right.mpr hW)).hom.op
      ((space k n).presheaf.map
        (eqToIso (show (coordinateOpen k n i).ι ''ᵁ ((coordinateOpen k n i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W) = W by
          rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
          exact inf_eq_right.mpr
            (hW.trans ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_left)))).inv.op
        ((Pi.π (fun t : Fin (n + 1) ↦ pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n t)) i).app W
          ((kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)).app W x'))) =
      u *
      (space k n).presheaf.map
        (eqToIso (show (coordinateOverlapOpen k n i j).ι ''ᵁ
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen k n i j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W) = W by
          rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
          exact inf_eq_right.mpr hW)).hom.op
      ((space k n).presheaf.map
        (eqToIso (show (coordinateOpen k n j).ι ''ᵁ ((coordinateOpen k n j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W) = W by
          rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
          exact inf_eq_right.mpr
            (hW.trans ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_right)))).inv.op
        ((Pi.π (fun t : Fin (n + 1) ↦ pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n t)) j).app W
          ((kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)).app W x')))
proof:
:= by
  have hcompat := projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateComponent_compatibility_apply_explicit k n d
    i j W x'
  dsimp only [pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition, Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app,
    coordinateOverlapTransitionIso] at hcompat
  erw [unitMulSheafIso_hom_app_apply] at hcompat
  rw [pushedUnitRestriction_app_of_le_apply _ W hW,
    pushedUnitRestriction_app_of_le_apply _ W hW] at hcompat
  exact ⟨_, hcompat⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_heq
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_heq (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d, coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p a)) :
    HEq (coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation k n d p a x)
      ((Pi.π (fun j : Fin (n + 1) ↦ pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n j))
          (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a)).app
        ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a)).ι ''ᵁ
          coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p a)
        ((kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)).app
          ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a)).ι ''ᵁ
            coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p a)
          ((coordinateCechTwistingRestrictionAddEquiv k n d p a) x)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_app_eq]
  set raw := (Pi.π (fun j : Fin (n + 1) ↦ pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n j))
        (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a)).app
      ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a)).ι ''ᵁ
        coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p a)
      ((kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)).app
        ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a)).ι ''ᵁ
          coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p a)
        ((coordinateCechTwistingRestrictionAddEquiv k n d p a) x)) with hraw
  set inner := (unitModules
        (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a)).toScheme).presheaf.map
      (eqToHom ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a)).ι.preimage_image_eq
        (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p a)).symm).op raw with hinner
  have step1 : HEq ((space k n).presheaf.map
      (eqToIso (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n p a)).op.inv inner)
      inner :=
    heq_presheaf_map_eqToIso_op_inv (X := space k n) _ inner
  have step2 : HEq inner raw :=
    heq_presheaf_map_eqToHom_op
      (X := (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a)).toScheme) _ raw
  exact step1.trans step2

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.heq_module_presheaf_map_eqToIso_op_hom
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingRestrictionAddEquiv_eq_self
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingRestrictionAddEquiv_eq_self (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d, coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p a)) :
    HEq ((coordinateCechTwistingRestrictionAddEquiv k n d p a) x) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateCechTwistingRestrictionAddEquiv_app_eq]
  exact heq_module_presheaf_map_eqToIso_op_hom (M := projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d)
    (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n p a) x

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechZeroCoface_le_overlap
statement:
theorem coordinateCechZeroCoface_le_overlap (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateCechBasicOpen k n (p + 1) a ≤ coordinateOverlapOpen k n (a 0) (a 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
  refine le_inf ?_ ?_
  · have h0 : coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a = a 0 := rfl
    rw [← h0]
    exact coordinateCechBasicOpen_le_distinguishedCoordinateOpen k n (p + 1) a
  · have h1 : a 1 = coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove) := by
      simp [coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex]
    rw [h1]
    exact (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p 0 a).le.trans
      (coordinateCechBasicOpen_le_distinguishedCoordinateOpen k n p
        (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.hkey_lhs_transition_heq
statement:
theorem hkey_lhs_transition_heq (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d,
      coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))) :
    HEq (coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation k n d (p + 1) a
          ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
            (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p 0 a).op x))
      ((pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition k n d (a 0) (a 1)).app
          ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
            coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a)
        ((pushedUnitRestriction
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n (a 0) (a 1)).le.trans inf_le_right)).app
          ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
            coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a)
          ((Pi.π (fun t : Fin (n + 1) ↦ pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n t))
              (a 1)).app
            ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
              coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a)
            ((kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)).app
              ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
                coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a)
              ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
                (homOfLE (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_le k n p a)).op x)))))
proof:
:= by
  have hW : (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
      coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a ≤
      coordinateOverlapOpen k n (a 0) (a 1) := by
    rw [coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image]
    exact coordinateCechZeroCoface_le_overlap k n p a
  have fact1 := coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_coface_zero_heq k n d p a x
  have fact2 := projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateComponent_compatibility_heq k n d (a 0) (a 1)
    ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
      coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a)
    hW
    ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_le k n p a)).op x)
  exact fact1.trans fact2

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.xrestrict_eq_addx_restrict
statement:
theorem xrestrict_eq_addx_restrict (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d,
      coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove)))
    (hVU : (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
        coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a ≤
      (coordinateOpen k n
          (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι ''ᵁ
        coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove)) :
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_le k n p a)).op x =
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op
        ((coordinateCechTwistingRestrictionAddEquiv k n d p
            (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove)) x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateCechTwistingRestrictionAddEquiv_app_eq, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
    ← Functor.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechZeroCoface_chart_preimage_le
statement:
theorem coordinateCechZeroCoface_chart_preimage_le (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
        (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
      ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
        coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a) ≤
      coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
      coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a ≤
      (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
        (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι ''ᵁ
        coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p
          (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove) := by
    conv_rhs => rw [coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image]
    exact coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_le k n p a
  have h2 : (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
        (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
      ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
        coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a) ≤
      (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
          (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
        ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
            (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι ''ᵁ
          coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p
            (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove)) :=
    fun z hz => h1 hz
  rwa [Scheme.Hom.preimage_image_eq] at h2

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechBasicOpen_le_a1
statement:
theorem coordinateCechBasicOpen_le_a1 (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateCechBasicOpen k n (p + 1) a ≤
      coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
        (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : a 1 = coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove) := by
    simp [coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex]
  rw [← h0]
  have hoverlap := coordinateCechZeroCoface_le_overlap k n p a
  rw [coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf] at hoverlap
  exact hoverlap.trans inf_le_right

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_preimage_eq
statement:
theorem coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_preimage_eq (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
        (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι ''ᵁ
      ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
          (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
        ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
          coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a)) =
      coordinateCechBasicOpen k n (p + 1) a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι,
    ← coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n (p + 1) a]
  refine inf_eq_right.mpr ?_
  rw [coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image]
  exact coordinateCechBasicOpen_le_a1 k n p a

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_a1_coface_eq
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_a1_coface_eq (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d,
      coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))) :
    (space k n).presheaf.map (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p 0 a).op
        (coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation k n d p
          (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove) x) =
      (space k n).presheaf.map
        (eqToIso (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_preimage_eq k n p a)).op.inv
        (((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
            (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι.appIso
          ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
              (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
            ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
              coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a))).inv
          ((localFrameProjection k n d (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
              (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).app
            ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
                (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
              ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
                coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a))
            (((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).restrict
                (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
                  (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι).presheaf.map
              (homOfLE (coordinateCechZeroCoface_chart_preimage_le k n p a)).op
              ((coordinateCechTwistingRestrictionAddEquiv k n d p
                (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove)) x))))
proof:
:= by
  set Z := (coordinateCechTwistingRestrictionAddEquiv k n d p
      (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove)) x with hZ
  set Y := (localFrameProjection k n d
      (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).app
      (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))
      Z with hY
  have unfold1 : coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation k n d p
      (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove) x =
      (coordinateCechStructureRestrictionAddEquiv k n p
        (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove)).symm Y :=
    coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_eq_localFrameProjection k n d p
      (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove) x
  have step1 := appIso_inv_naturality_apply
    (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
      (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι
    (coordinateCechZeroCoface_chart_preimage_le k n p a) Y
  have unfold2 := congrArg
    ((space k n).presheaf.map (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p 0 a).op) unfold1
  rw [coordinateCechStructureRestrictionAddEquiv_symm_eq] at unfold2
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp] at unfold2
  rw [show (eqToIso (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n p
        (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).op.inv ≫
      (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p 0 a).op =
      (homOfLE (Scheme.Hom.image_mono (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
          (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι
        (coordinateCechZeroCoface_chart_preimage_le k n p a))).op ≫
        (eqToIso (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_preimage_eq k n p a)).op.inv from
    Subsingleton.elim _ _] at unfold2
  conv_rhs at unfold2 => rw [Functor.map_comp, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  rw [← step1] at unfold2
  have step6 := localFrameProjection_naturality_apply k n d
    (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))
    (coordinateCechZeroCoface_chart_preimage_le k n p a) Z
  rw [hY] at unfold2
  exact unfold2.trans (congrArg
    ((space k n).presheaf.map (eqToIso (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_preimage_eq k n p a)).op.inv)
    (congrArg
      ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
          (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι.appIso
        ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
            (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
          ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
            coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a))|>.inv)
      step6.symm))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_preimage_eq_a0V0
statement:
theorem coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_preimage_eq_a0V0 (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
        (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι ''ᵁ
      ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
          (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
        ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
          coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a)) =
      (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
        coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a
proof:
:=
  (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_preimage_eq k n p a).trans
    (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n (p + 1) a).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechZeroCoface_innermost_casts_eq_xrestrict
statement:
theorem coordinateCechZeroCoface_innermost_casts_eq_xrestrict (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d,
      coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))) :
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
        (eqToIso (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_preimage_eq_a0V0 k n p a)).op.inv
      ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (Scheme.Hom.image_mono (coordinateOpen k n
            (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι
          (coordinateCechZeroCoface_chart_preimage_le k n p a))).op
        ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
          (eqToIso (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n p
            (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).op.hom x)) =
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_le k n p a)).op x
proof:
:= by
  have hmorph : (eqToIso (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n p
        (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).op.hom ≫
      (homOfLE (Scheme.Hom.image_mono (coordinateOpen k n
          (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι
        (coordinateCechZeroCoface_chart_preimage_le k n p a))).op ≫
      (eqToIso (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_preimage_eq_a0V0 k n p a)).op.inv =
      (homOfLE (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_le k n p a)).op :=
    Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp,
    ← Functor.map_comp, hmorph]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_a1_coface_eq_xrestrict
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_a1_coface_eq_xrestrict (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d,
      coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))) :
    (space k n).presheaf.map (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p 0 a).op
        (coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation k n d p
          (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove) x) =
      (space k n).presheaf.map
        (eqToIso (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_preimage_eq k n p a)).op.inv
        (((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
            (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι.appIso
          ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
              (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
            ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
              coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a))).inv
          ((localFrameProjection k n d (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
              (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).app
            ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
                (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
              ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
                coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a))
            (((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).restrictAppIso
                (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
                  (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι
                ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
                    (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
                  ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
                    coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a))).inv
              ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
                (eqToIso (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_preimage_eq_a0V0 k n p a)).op.hom
                ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
                  (homOfLE (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_le k n p a)).op x)))))
proof:
:= by
  have base := coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_a1_coface_eq k n d p a x
  have step7 := restrictAppIso_naturality_apply_inv
    (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
      (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d)
    (coordinateCechZeroCoface_chart_preimage_le k n p a)
    ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
      (eqToIso (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n p
        (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).op.hom x)
  have hZeq : (coordinateCechTwistingRestrictionAddEquiv k n d p
      (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove)) x =
      ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).restrictAppIso
        (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
          (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι
        (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p
          (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).inv
        ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
          (eqToIso (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n p
            (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).op.hom x) :=
    coordinateCechTwistingRestrictionAddEquiv_eq k n d p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove) x
  have hinner := coordinateCechZeroCoface_innermost_casts_eq_xrestrict k n d p a x
  have combined : ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).restrict
        (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
          (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (coordinateCechZeroCoface_chart_preimage_le k n p a)).op
      ((coordinateCechTwistingRestrictionAddEquiv k n d p
        (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove)) x) =
      ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).restrictAppIso
          (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
            (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι
          ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
              (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
            ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
              coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a))).inv
        ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
          (eqToIso (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_preimage_eq_a0V0 k n p a)).op.hom
          ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
            (homOfLE (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_le k n p a)).op x)) := by
    rw [hZeq, step7]
    refine congrArg _ ?_
    have hcancel : (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
        (eqToIso (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_preimage_eq_a0V0 k n p a)).op.hom
        ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
          (eqToIso (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_preimage_eq_a0V0 k n p a)).op.inv
          ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
            (homOfLE (Scheme.Hom.image_mono (coordinateOpen k n
                (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι
              (coordinateCechZeroCoface_chart_preimage_le k n p a))).op
            ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
              (eqToIso (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n p
                (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).op.hom x))) =
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (Scheme.Hom.image_mono (coordinateOpen k n
              (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι
            (coordinateCechZeroCoface_chart_preimage_le k n p a))).op
          ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
            (eqToIso (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n p
              (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).op.hom x) := by
      rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
      simp
      rfl
    rw [← hcancel, hinner]
  exact base.trans (congrArg
    ((space k n).presheaf.map (eqToIso (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_preimage_eq k n p a)).op.inv)
    (congrArg
      ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
          (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι.appIso
        ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
            (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
          ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
            coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a))|>.inv)
      (congrArg
        ((localFrameProjection k n d (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
            (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).app
          ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
              (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
            ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
              coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a)))
        combined)))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_a0_coface_eq_xrestrict
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_a0_coface_eq_xrestrict (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d,
      coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))) :
    coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation k n d (p + 1) a
        ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
          (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p 0 a).op x) =
      (coordinateCechStructureRestrictionAddEquiv k n (p + 1) a).symm
        ((localFrameProjection k n d (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).app
          (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a)
          (((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).restrictAppIso
              (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι
              (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a)).inv
            ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
              (homOfLE (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_le k n p a)).op x)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_eq_localFrameProjection,
    coordinateCechTwistingRestrictionAddEquiv_eq,
    coordinateCechZeroCoface_eq_homOfLE_apply]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.hkey_iff_xrestrict
statement:
theorem hkey_iff_xrestrict (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d,
      coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove)))
    (u : Γ(space k n, coordinateCechBasicOpen k n (p + 1) a)) :
    (coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation k n d (p + 1) a
        ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
          (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p 0 a).op x) =
      u * (space k n).presheaf.map (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p 0 a).op
            (coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation k n d p
              (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove) x)) ↔
    ((coordinateCechStructureRestrictionAddEquiv k n (p + 1) a).symm
        ((localFrameProjection k n d (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).app
          (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a)
          (((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).restrictAppIso
              (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι
              (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a)).inv
            ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
              (homOfLE (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_le k n p a)).op x))) =
      u * (space k n).presheaf.map
          (eqToIso (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_preimage_eq k n p a)).op.inv
          (((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
              (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι.appIso
            ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
                (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
              ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
                coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a))).inv
            ((localFrameProjection k n d (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
                (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).app
              ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
                  (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
                ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
                  coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a))
              (((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).restrictAppIso
                  (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
                    (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι
                  ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
                      (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
                    ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
                      coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a))).inv
                ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
                  (eqToIso (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_preimage_eq_a0V0 k n p a)).op.hom
                  ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
                    (homOfLE (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_le k n p a)).op x))))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_a0_coface_eq_xrestrict,
    coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_a1_coface_eq_xrestrict]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitAmbient_image_preimage_eq
statement:
theorem pushedUnitAmbient_image_preimage_eq {X : Scheme.{u}} (U W : X.Opens) (hW : W ≤ U) :
    U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W) = W
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
  exact inf_eq_right.mpr hW

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitAmbientSection_eq_cast
statement:
theorem pushedUnitAmbientSection_eq_cast {X : Scheme.{u}} (U W : X.Opens) (hW : W ≤ U)
    (s : Γ(pushedUnit X U, W)) :
    pushedUnitAmbientSection U W hW s =
      X.presheaf.map (eqToIso (pushedUnitAmbient_image_preimage_eq U W hW)).op.inv s
proof:
:= by
  change X.presheaf.map _ ((U.ι.appIso (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)).inv s) = _
  rw [Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso]
  erw [ConcreteCategory.id_apply]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit_image_appIso_inv_map_eq_ambientSection
statement:
theorem pushedUnit_image_appIso_inv_map_eq_ambientSection {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.Opens)
    (V : U.toScheme.Opens) (s : Γ(pushedUnit X U, U.ι ''ᵁ V)) :
    (U.ι.appIso V).inv
        ((unitModules U.toScheme).presheaf.map
          (eqToHom (U.ι.preimage_image_eq V).symm).op s) =
      pushedUnitAmbientSection U (U.ι ''ᵁ V) (U.ι_image_le V) s
proof:
:= by
  rw [pushedUnitAmbientSection]
  have hpre : V ≤ U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (U.ι ''ᵁ V) := (U.ι.preimage_image_eq V).ge
  have hnat := appIso_inv_naturality_apply U.ι hpre s
  rw [show (eqToHom (U.ι.preimage_image_eq V).symm).op = (homOfLE hpre).op from
    Subsingleton.elim _ _]
  rw [show (eqToIso (pushedUnitAmbient_image_preimage_eq U (U.ι ''ᵁ V)
      (U.ι_image_le V))).op.inv =
        (homOfLE (Scheme.Hom.image_mono U.ι hpre)).op from Subsingleton.elim _ _]
  exact hnat

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitAmbientSection_eq_of_eq
statement:
theorem pushedUnitAmbientSection_eq_of_eq {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.Opens) {V W : X.Opens}
    (hVW : V = W) (hW : W ≤ U) (s : Γ(pushedUnit X U, W)) :
    X.presheaf.map (eqToIso hVW).op.inv
        (pushedUnitAmbientSection U V (hVW.le.trans hW)
          ((pushedUnit X U).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVW.le).op s)) =
      pushedUnitAmbientSection U W hW s
proof:
:= by
  subst hVW
  change X.presheaf.map (𝟙 (op V))
      (pushedUnitAmbientSection U V _
        ((pushedUnit X U).presheaf.map (𝟙 (op V)) s)) =
    pushedUnitAmbientSection U V hW s
  rw [Functor.map_id_apply, Functor.map_id_apply]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.presheaf_map_eqToIso_op_inv_hom_op_cancel
statement:
theorem presheaf_map_eqToIso_op_inv_hom_op_cancel {X : Scheme.{u}} {V W : X.Opens}
    (h₁ h₂ : V = W) (s : Γ(X, W)) :
    X.presheaf.map (eqToIso h₁).op.inv
        (X.presheaf.map (eqToIso h₂).hom.op s) = s
proof:
:= by
  subst W
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechOverlapComplement_mem_degree
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simpa [coordinateCechOverlapComplement] using
    (SetLike.prod_mem_graded (grading k n)
      (fun _ : Fin p ↦ (1 : ℕ))
      (fun t ↦ coordinate k n (a t.succ.succ))
      (F := Finset.univ)
      (fun t _ ↦ coordinate_mem_degree_one k n (a t.succ.succ)))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechEquation_eq_overlap_mul_complement
statement:
private theorem coordinateCechEquation_eq_overlap_mul_complement (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateCechEquation k n (p + 1) a =
      coordinateOverlapEquation k n (a 0) (a 1) *
        coordinateCechOverlapComplement k n p a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [coordinateCechEquation, coordinateOverlapEquation,
    coordinateCechOverlapComplement, Fin.prod_univ_succ]
  rw [show Fin.succ 0 = (1 : Fin (p + 2)) by rfl]
  exact (mul_assoc
    (coordinate k n (a 0)) (coordinate k n (a 1))
    (∏ i : Fin p, coordinate k n (a i.succ.succ))).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechOverlapComplement_toLaurent
statement:
private theorem coordinateCechOverlapComplement_toLaurent (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    polynomialToCoordinateLaurent k n (coordinateCechOverlapComplement k n p a) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (coordinateCechOverlapComplementLaurentExponent n p a) 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [coordinateCechOverlapComplement, map_prod]
  simpa only [polynomialToCoordinateLaurent_coordinate,
    coordinateCechOverlapComplementLaurentExponent] using
    (coordinateLaurent_prod_single_one k n (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin p))
      (fun t ↦ coordinateLaurentBasisExponent n (a t.succ.succ)))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechDenominatorLaurentExponent_split_overlap
statement:
private theorem coordinateCechDenominatorLaurentExponent_split_overlap (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateCechDenominatorLaurentExponent n (p + 1) a =
      coordinateLaurentBasisExponent n (a 0) +
        coordinateLaurentBasisExponent n (a 1) +
          coordinateCechOverlapComplementLaurentExponent n p a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coordinateCechDenominatorLaurentExponent,
    coordinateCechOverlapComplementLaurentExponent, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  rw [show Fin.succ 0 = (1 : Fin (p + 2)) by rfl]
  exact (add_assoc _ _ _).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapRatio_awayToCech_toLaurent
statement:
private theorem coordinateOverlapRatio_awayToCech_toLaurent (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateCechAwayToLaurent k n (p + 1) a
        (coordinateOverlapAwayToCech k n p a
          (coordinateOverlapRatio k n (a 0) (a 1))) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single
        (coordinateLaurentBasisExponent n (a 1) -
          coordinateLaurentBasisExponent n (a 0)) 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateOverlapAwayToCech, coordinateOverlapRatio,
    HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap_mk]
  erw [coordinateCechAwayToLaurent_mk]
  simp only [pow_one, map_mul, map_pow, polynomialToCoordinateLaurent_coordinate,
    coordinateCechOverlapComplement_toLaurent,
    coordinateCechEquationLaurentInverse_eq_single,
    AddMonoidAlgebra.single_pow, AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, one_pow, one_mul]
  congr 1
  rw [coordinateCechDenominatorLaurentExponent_split_overlap]
  abel
  all_goals
    simpa [add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using
      (SetLike.mul_mem_graded
        (SetLike.pow_mem_graded 2 (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n (a 1)))
        (SetLike.pow_mem_graded 1
          (coordinateCechOverlapComplement_mem_degree k n p a)))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapTransitionUnit_awayToCech_toLaurent
statement:
private theorem coordinateOverlapTransitionUnit_awayToCech_toLaurent (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateCechAwayToLaurent k n (p + 1) a
        (coordinateOverlapAwayToCech k n p a
          (twistTransitionUnit k n d (a 0) (a 1)).1) =
      coordinateTwistingTransitionLaurentMonomial k n d (a 0) (a 1)
proof:
:= by
  let F := (coordinateCechAwayToLaurent k n (p + 1) a).comp
    (coordinateOverlapAwayToCech k n p a)
  have hunit : Units.map F.toMonoidHom (coordinateOverlapRatioUnit k n (a 0) (a 1)) =
      coordinateLaurentMonomialUnit k n
        (coordinateLaurentBasisExponent n (a 1) -
          coordinateLaurentBasisExponent n (a 0)) := by
    apply Units.ext
    exact coordinateOverlapRatio_awayToCech_toLaurent k n p a
  change F ((coordinateOverlapRatioUnit k n (a 0) (a 1) ^ d).1) = _
  change (Units.map F.toMonoidHom
    (coordinateOverlapRatioUnit k n (a 0) (a 1) ^ d)).1 = _
  rw [map_zpow, hunit]
  cases d with
  | ofNat m =>
      simp [coordinateLaurentMonomialUnit, coordinateTwistingTransitionLaurentMonomial,
        AddMonoidAlgebra.single_pow]
  | negSucc m =>
      simp [coordinateLaurentMonomialUnit, coordinateTwistingTransitionLaurentMonomial,
        AddMonoidAlgebra.single_pow]
      congr 1
      rw [smul_sub]
      module

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapTransitionSection_eq_restrict
statement:
theorem coordinateOverlapTransitionSection_eq_restrict (d : ℤ) (i j : Fin (n + 1))
    (W : (space k n).Opens) (hW : W ≤ coordinateOverlapOpen k n i j) :
    coordinateOverlapTransitionSection k n d i j W hW =
      (space k n).presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op
        (twistTransitionSectionUnit k n d i j).1
proof:
:= by
  simp [coordinateOverlapTransitionSection, pushedUnitAmbientSection, restrictTopUnit,
    Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso]
  erw [ConcreteCategory.id_apply]
  erw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapTransitionSection_eq_awayToCech
statement:
private theorem coordinateOverlapTransitionSection_eq_awayToCech (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateOverlapTransitionSection k n d (a 0) (a 1)
        (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n (p + 1) a)
        (coordinateCechZeroCoface_le_overlap k n p a) =
      (coordinateCechBasicOpenIsoAway k n (p + 1) a).hom
        (coordinateOverlapAwayToCech k n p a
          (twistTransitionUnit k n d (a 0) (a 1)).1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateOverlapTransitionSection_eq_restrict]
  have hgeom := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (Proj.awayMap_awayToSection (grading k n)
      (coordinateCechOverlapComplement_mem_degree k n p a)
      (coordinateCechEquation_eq_overlap_mul_complement k n p a))
    (twistTransitionUnit k n d (a 0) (a 1)).1
  have hgeom' := hgeom.symm
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ConcreteCategory.hom_ofHom] at hgeom'
  change (Proj (grading k n)).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (Proj.basicOpen_mono (grading k n)
        (coordinateOverlapEquation k n (a 0) (a 1))
        (coordinateCechEquation k n (p + 1) a)
        ⟨coordinateCechOverlapComplement k n p a,
          coordinateCechEquation_eq_overlap_mul_complement k n p a⟩)).op
      ((Proj.awayToSection (grading k n)
        (coordinateOverlapEquation k n (a 0) (a 1)))
        (twistTransitionUnit k n d (a 0) (a 1)).1) =
    (Proj.awayToSection (grading k n) (coordinateCechEquation k n (p + 1) a))
      (coordinateOverlapAwayToCech k n p a
        (twistTransitionUnit k n d (a 0) (a 1)).1)
  exact hgeom'

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapTransitionSection_toLaurent
statement:
theorem coordinateOverlapTransitionSection_toLaurent (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateCechBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent k n (p + 1) a
        (coordinateOverlapTransitionSection k n d (a 0) (a 1)
          (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n (p + 1) a)
          (coordinateCechZeroCoface_le_overlap k n p a)) =
      coordinateTwistingTransitionLaurentMonomial k n d (a 0) (a 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateOverlapTransitionSection_eq_awayToCech,
    coordinateCechBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent_basicOpenIsoAway_hom,
    coordinateOverlapTransitionUnit_awayToCech_toLaurent]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateComponent_compatibility_overlapNative
statement:
private theorem coordinateComponent_compatibility_overlapNative (d : ℤ)
    (i j : Fin (n + 1)) (W : (space k n).Opens)
    (hW : W ≤ coordinateOverlapOpen k n i j)
    (x' : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d, W)) :
    let hO
proof:
:= pushedUnitAmbient_image_preimage_eq (coordinateOverlapOpen k n i j) W hW
    let u : (space k n).presheaf.obj
        (op ((coordinateOverlapOpen k n i j).ι ''ᵁ
          ((coordinateOverlapOpen k n i j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W))) := (restrictTopUnit
      (Units.map (coordinateOverlapOpen k n i j).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom
        (twistTransitionSectionUnit k n d i j))
      ((coordinateOverlapOpen k n i j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)).val
    (space k n).presheaf.map (eqToIso hO).hom.op
        ((space k n).presheaf.map
          (eqToIso (pushedUnitAmbient_image_preimage_eq (coordinateOpen k n i) W
            (hW.trans ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_left)))).inv.op
          ((Pi.π (fun t : Fin (n + 1) ↦
            pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n t)) i).app W
            ((kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)).app W x'))) =
      u * (space k n).presheaf.map (eqToIso hO).hom.op
        ((space k n).presheaf.map
          (eqToIso (pushedUnitAmbient_image_preimage_eq (coordinateOpen k n j) W
            (hW.trans ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_right)))).inv.op
          ((Pi.π (fun t : Fin (n + 1) ↦
            pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n t)) j).app W
            ((kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)).app W x'))) := by
  have hcompat := projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateComponent_compatibility_apply_explicit
    k n d i j W x'
  dsimp only [pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition, Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app,
    coordinateOverlapTransitionIso] at hcompat
  erw [unitMulSheafIso_hom_app_apply] at hcompat
  rw [pushedUnitRestriction_app_of_le_apply _ W hW,
    pushedUnitRestriction_app_of_le_apply _ W hW] at hcompat
  exact hcompat

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateComponent_compatibility_mul_explicit
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateComponent_compatibility_mul_explicit (d : ℤ)
    (i j : Fin (n + 1)) (W : (space k n).Opens)
    (hW : W ≤ coordinateOverlapOpen k n i j)
    (x' : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d, W)) :
    pushedUnitAmbientSection (coordinateOpen k n i) W
        (hW.trans ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_left))
        ((Pi.π (fun t : Fin (n + 1) ↦
            pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n t)) i).app W
          ((kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)).app W x')) =
      coordinateOverlapTransitionSection k n d i j W hW *
        pushedUnitAmbientSection (coordinateOpen k n j) W
          (hW.trans ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_right))
          ((Pi.π (fun t : Fin (n + 1) ↦
              pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n t)) j).app W
            ((kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)).app W x'))
proof:
:= by
  have hcompat := coordinateComponent_compatibility_overlapNative k n d i j W hW x'
  let hO := pushedUnitAmbient_image_preimage_eq
    (coordinateOverlapOpen k n i j) W hW
  have hmapped := congrArg
    (fun z ↦ ((space k n).presheaf.map (eqToIso hO).op.inv).hom z) hcompat
  erw [map_mul ((space k n).presheaf.map (eqToIso hO).op.inv).hom] at hmapped
  simp only [presheaf_map_eqToIso_op_inv_hom_op_cancel] at hmapped
  simp only [coordinateOverlapTransitionSection, pushedUnitAmbientSection_eq_cast]
  exact hmapped

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.xrestrict_eq_himg1_cast
statement:
theorem xrestrict_eq_himg1_cast (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d,
      coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))) :
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
        (eqToIso (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_preimage_eq_a0V0 k n p a)).op.hom
        ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_le k n p a)).op x) =
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_preimage_eq k n p a).le).op
        ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
          (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p 0 a).op x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp,
    ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.a1_full_bridge
statement:
theorem a1_full_bridge (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d,
      coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))) :
    (space k n).presheaf.map
        (eqToIso (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_preimage_eq k n p a)).op.inv
        (((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
            (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι.appIso
          ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
              (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
            ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
              coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a))).inv
          ((localFrameProjection k n d (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
              (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).app
            ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
                (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
              ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
                coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a))
            (((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).restrictAppIso
