                (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
                  (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι
                ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
                    (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
                  ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
                    coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a))).inv
              ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
                (eqToIso (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_preimage_eq_a0V0 k n p a)).op.hom
                ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
                  (homOfLE (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_le k n p a)).op x))))) =
      (space k n).presheaf.map
        (eqToIso (pushedUnitAmbient_image_preimage_eq
          (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
            (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove)))
          (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n (p + 1) a)
          (coordinateCechBasicOpen_le_a1 k n p a))).op.inv
        ((Pi.π (fun t : Fin (n + 1) ↦
            pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n t))
            (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
              (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).app
          (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n (p + 1) a)
          ((kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)).app
            (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n (p + 1) a)
            ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
              (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p 0 a).op x)))
proof:
:= by
  have hnatK0 := scheme_modules_hom_naturality_apply
    (kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d))
    (U := coordinateCechBasicOpen k n (p + 1) a)
    (V := (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
      (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι ''ᵁ
        ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
          (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
          ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
            coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a)))
    (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_preimage_eq k n p a).le
    ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
      (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p 0 a).op x)
  have hnatK : (kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)).app
        ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
          (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι ''ᵁ
          ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
            (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
            ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
              coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a)))
        ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
          (eqToIso (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_preimage_eq_a0V0 k n p a)).op.hom
          ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
            (homOfLE (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_le k n p a)).op x)) =
      (coordinateChartCochains k n).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_preimage_eq k n p a).le).op
        ((kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)).app
          (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n (p + 1) a)
          ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
            (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p 0 a).op x)) := by
    rw [xrestrict_eq_himg1_cast]
    exact hnatK0
  have hnatPi := scheme_modules_hom_naturality_apply
    (Pi.π (fun t : Fin (n + 1) ↦
      pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n t))
      (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove)))
    (U := coordinateCechBasicOpen k n (p + 1) a)
    (V := (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
      (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι ''ᵁ
        ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
          (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).ι ⁻¹ᵁ
          ((coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι ''ᵁ
            coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a)))
    (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_preimage_eq k n p a).le
    ((kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)).app
      (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n (p + 1) a)
      ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
        (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p 0 a).op x))
  rw [localFrameProjection_app_eq]
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso, Iso.refl_inv]
  erw [ConcreteCategory.id_apply]
  rw [hnatK, hnatPi]
  rw [pushedUnit_image_appIso_inv_map_eq_ambientSection]
  have hcollapse := pushedUnitAmbientSection_eq_of_eq
    (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
      (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove)))
    (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_preimage_eq k n p a)
    (coordinateCechBasicOpen_le_a1 k n p a)
    ((Pi.π (fun t : Fin (n + 1) ↦
      pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n t))
      (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))).app
        (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n (p + 1) a)
        ((kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)).app
          (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n (p + 1) a)
          ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
            (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p 0 a).op x)))
  exact hcollapse.trans (pushedUnitAmbientSection_eq_cast
    (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p
      (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove)))
    (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n (p + 1) a)
    (coordinateCechBasicOpen_le_a1 k n p a) _)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.xrestrict_eq_himg0_cast
statement:
theorem xrestrict_eq_himg0_cast (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d,
      coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))) :
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n (p + 1) a).le).op
        ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
          (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p 0 a).op x) =
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_le k n p a)).op x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.a0_full_bridge
statement:
theorem a0_full_bridge (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d,
      coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))) :
    (coordinateCechStructureRestrictionAddEquiv k n (p + 1) a).symm
        ((localFrameProjection k n d (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).app
          (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a)
          (((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).restrictAppIso
              (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a)).ι
              (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a)).inv
            ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
              (homOfLE (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_le k n p a)).op x))) =
      (space k n).presheaf.map
        (eqToIso (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n (p + 1) a)).inv.op
        ((Pi.π (fun t : Fin (n + 1) ↦
            pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n t)) (a 0)).app
          (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n (p + 1) a)
          ((kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)).app
            (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n (p + 1) a)
            ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
              (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p 0 a).op x)))
proof:
:= by
  have hnatK0 := scheme_modules_hom_naturality_apply
    (kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d))
    (U := coordinateCechBasicOpen k n (p + 1) a)
    (V := (coordinateOpen k n (a 0)).ι ''ᵁ coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a)
    (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n (p + 1) a).le
    ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
      (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p 0 a).op x)
  have hnatK : (kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)).app
        ((coordinateOpen k n (a 0)).ι ''ᵁ coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a)
        ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (coordinateCechZeroCoface_image_le k n p a)).op x) =
      (coordinateChartCochains k n).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n (p + 1) a).le).op
        ((kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)).app
          (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n (p + 1) a)
          ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
            (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p 0 a).op x)) := by
    rw [← xrestrict_eq_himg0_cast]; exact hnatK0
  have hnatPi := scheme_modules_hom_naturality_apply
    (Pi.π (fun t : Fin (n + 1) ↦ pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n t)) (a 0))
    (U := coordinateCechBasicOpen k n (p + 1) a)
    (V := (coordinateOpen k n (a 0)).ι ''ᵁ coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a)
    (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n (p + 1) a).le
    ((kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)).app
      (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n (p + 1) a)
      ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
        (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p 0 a).op x))
  rw [coordinateCechStructureRestrictionAddEquiv_symm_eq, localFrameProjection_app_eq]
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso, Iso.refl_inv]
  erw [ConcreteCategory.id_apply]
  erw [hnatK, hnatPi]
  rw [pushedUnit_image_appIso_inv_map_eq_ambientSection]
  have hcollapse := pushedUnitAmbientSection_eq_of_eq
    (coordinateOpen k n (a 0))
    (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n (p + 1) a)
    ((coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n (p + 1) a).ge.trans
      ((coordinateOpen k n (a 0)).ι_image_le
        (coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n (p + 1) a)))
    ((Pi.π (fun t : Fin (n + 1) ↦
      pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n t)) (a 0)).app
      (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n (p + 1) a)
      ((kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)).app
        (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n (p + 1) a)
        ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
          (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p 0 a).op x)))
  exact hcollapse.trans (pushedUnitAmbientSection_eq_cast
    (coordinateOpen k n (a 0))
    (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n (p + 1) a) _ _)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_zero_transition
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_zero_transition (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d,
      coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))) :
    coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation k n d (p + 1) a
        ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
          (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p 0 a).op x) =
      coordinateOverlapTransitionSection k n d (a 0) (a 1)
          (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n (p + 1) a)
          (coordinateCechZeroCoface_le_overlap k n p a) *
        (space k n).presheaf.map (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p 0 a).op
          (coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation k n d p
            (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove) x)
proof:
:= by
  apply (hkey_iff_xrestrict k n d p a x _).2
  rw [a0_full_bridge, a1_full_bridge]
  have hcompat :=
    projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateComponent_compatibility_mul_explicit
      k n d (a 0) (a 1) (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n (p + 1) a)
      (coordinateCechZeroCoface_le_overlap k n p a)
      ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
        (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p 0 a).op x)
  rw [pushedUnitAmbientSection_eq_cast, pushedUnitAmbientSection_eq_cast] at hcompat
  convert hcompat using 1 <;> congr 1

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.zeroFrameChange_of_frameEvaluation_transition
statement:
theorem zeroFrameChange_of_frameEvaluation_transition (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d,
      coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove)))
    (u : Γ(space k n, coordinateCechBasicOpen k n (p + 1) a))
    (hu : coordinateCechBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent k n (p + 1) a u =
      coordinateTwistingTransitionLaurentMonomial k n d (a 0) (a 1))
    (hkey :
      coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation k n d (p + 1) a
          ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
            (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p 0 a).op x) =
        u * (space k n).presheaf.map (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p 0 a).op
              (coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation k n d p
                (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove) x)) :
    coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent k n d (p + 1) a
        ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
          (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p 0 a).op x) =
      coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent k n d p
        (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove) x
proof:
:= by
  have hidx0 : coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n (p + 1) a = a 0 := rfl
  have hidx1 : coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove) = a 1 := by
    simp [coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex]
  rw [coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent_apply,
    coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent_apply, hkey, map_mul, hu,
    coordinateCechBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent_coface, hidx0, hidx1, mul_right_comm,
    coordinateTwistingTransitionLaurentMonomial_mul_frame, mul_comm]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.zeroFrameChange_of_transitionSection_toLaurent
statement:
theorem zeroFrameChange_of_transitionSection_toLaurent (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d,
      coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove)))
    (hu : coordinateCechBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent k n (p + 1) a
        (coordinateOverlapTransitionSection k n d (a 0) (a 1)
          (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n (p + 1) a)
          (coordinateCechZeroCoface_le_overlap k n p a)) =
      coordinateTwistingTransitionLaurentMonomial k n d (a 0) (a 1)) :
    coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent k n d (p + 1) a
        ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
          (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p 0 a).op x) =
      coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent k n d p
        (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove) x
proof:
:=
  zeroFrameChange_of_frameEvaluation_transition k n d p a x
    (coordinateOverlapTransitionSection k n d (a 0) (a 1)
      (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n (p + 1) a)
      (coordinateCechZeroCoface_le_overlap k n p a))
    hu (coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_zero_transition k n d p a x)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent_zeroCoface
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent_zeroCoface (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d,
      coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove))) :
    coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent k n d (p + 1) a
        ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
          (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p 0 a).op x) =
      coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent k n d p
        (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove) x
proof:
:=
  zeroFrameChange_of_transitionSection_toLaurent k n d p a x
    (coordinateOverlapTransitionSection_toLaurent k n d p a)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingCechLaurentNativeGeometry
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingCechLaurentNativeGeometry (d : ℤ) :
    ProjectiveTwistingCechLaurentNativeGeometry k n d where
  sameFrame
proof:
:= coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_coface k n d
  zeroFrameChange := coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent_zeroCoface k n d

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.ProjectiveTwistingCechLaurentNativeGeometry.nonzeroCoface
statement:
theorem ProjectiveTwistingCechLaurentNativeGeometry.nonzeroCoface
    {d : ℤ} (h : ProjectiveTwistingCechLaurentNativeGeometry k n d)
    (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2)) (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d,
      coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove))) :
    coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent k n d (p + 1) a
        ((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
          (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p r a).op x) =
      coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent k n d p
        (a ∘ r.succAbove) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent_apply,
    h.sameFrame p r a hr x,
    coordinateCechBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent_coface,
    coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent_apply,

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.ProjectiveTwistingCechLaurentNativeGeometry.cofaceCompatible
statement:
theorem ProjectiveTwistingCechLaurentNativeGeometry.cofaceCompatible
    {d : ℤ} (h : ProjectiveTwistingCechLaurentNativeGeometry k n d) :
    ProjectiveTwistingCechLaurentNativeCofaceCompatible k n d
proof:
:= by
  intro p r a x
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv_apply,
    coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurentPiece_coe,
    coordinateLaurentCoface_coe,
    coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv_apply,
    coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurentPiece_coe,
    coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurent_eq_basicOpen,
    coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurent_eq_basicOpen]
  have hsection := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface_section_compare k n
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) p r a) x
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  rw [hsection]
  rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  by_cases hr : r = 0
  · subst r
    exact h.zeroFrameChange p a
      ((coordinateCechIntersectionBasicOpenSectionIso k n
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) p
          (a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove)).hom x)
  · exact ProjectiveTwistingCechLaurentNativeGeometry.nonzeroCoface k n h p r a hr
      ((coordinateCechIntersectionBasicOpenSectionIso k n
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) p (a ∘ r.succAbove)).hom x)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautChart_unitHomEquiv_symm_sectionsOfTop_app
statement:
theorem tautChart_unitHomEquiv_symm_sectionsOfTop_app {Y : Scheme.{u}} (N : Y.Modules)
    (s : Γ(N, ⊤)) :
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (show SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules Y ⟶ N from
      N.unitHomEquiv.symm (SchemeProjectiveSpace.sectionsOfTop N s)) ⊤
      (1 : Y.presheaf.obj (op (⊤ : Y.Opens))) = s
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun t ↦ t.val (op (⊤ : Y.Opens)))
    (N.unitHomEquiv.apply_symm_apply (SchemeProjectiveSpace.sectionsOfTop N s))
  change Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (show SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules Y ⟶ N from
      N.unitHomEquiv.symm (SchemeProjectiveSpace.sectionsOfTop N s)) ⊤
      (1 : Y.presheaf.obj (op (⊤ : Y.Opens))) =
    N.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op s at h
  have q : (homOfLE (le_top : (⊤ : Y.Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op = 𝟙 (op ⊤) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [q, Functor.map_id_apply] at h
  exact h

theorem tautChart_unitHomEquiv_symm_sectionsOfTop_app' {Y : Scheme.{u}} (N : Y.Modules)

      N.unitHomEquiv.symm (SchemeProjectiveSpace.sectionsOfTop N s)) W
      (1 : Y.presheaf.obj (op W)) = N.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op s
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun t ↦ t.val (op W))
    (N.unitHomEquiv.apply_symm_apply (SchemeProjectiveSpace.sectionsOfTop N s))
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautChart_presheaf_aux
statement:
theorem tautChart_presheaf_aux {X : Scheme.{u}} {A B W T T₁ T₂ : X.Opens}
    (f₁ : op T₁ ⟶ op T) (f₂ : op A ⟶ op T₁) (f₃ : op W ⟶ op T) (f₄ : op T₂ ⟶ op T)
    (f₅ : op B ⟶ op T₂) (hA : W ≤ A) (hB : W ≤ B)
    (a : Γ(X, A)) (w : Γ(X, W)) (c : Γ(X, B))
    (g : Γ(X, T) ⟶ Γ(X, T)) (hg : g = 𝟙 _)
    (h : X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hA).op a = w * X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hB).op c) :
    X.presheaf.map f₁ (X.presheaf.map f₂ a) =
      g.hom (X.presheaf.map f₃ w) * X.presheaf.map f₄ (X.presheaf.map f₅ c)
proof:
:= by
  subst hg
  change _ = X.presheaf.map f₃ w * _
  have e₁ : f₂ ≫ f₁ = (homOfLE hA).op ≫ f₃ := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have e₂ : f₅ ≫ f₄ = (homOfLE hB).op ≫ f₃ := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp_apply, e₁, ← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp_apply,
    CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp_apply, e₂, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp_apply, h, map_mul]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautChart_ratio_key
statement:
theorem tautChart_ratio_key (x y m : M) :
    (space R M).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M x y).le.trans inf_le_left)).op
        (tautChart_ratioSection R M x m) =
      ((linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit R M 1 x y : Γ(space R M, linearOverlapOpen R M x y))) *
        (space R M).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M x y).le.trans inf_le_right)).op
          (tautChart_ratioSection R M y m)
proof:
:= by
  have hx := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (Proj.awayMap_awayToSection (symGrading R M) (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M y)
      (f := linearForm R M x) (x := linearOverlapEquation R M x y) rfl)
    (tautChart_ratio R M x m)
  have hy := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (Proj.awayMap_awayToSection (symGrading R M) (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M x)
      (f := linearForm R M y) (x := linearOverlapEquation R M x y)
      (by rw [linearOverlapEquation, mul_comm]))
    (tautChart_ratio R M y m)
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hx hy
  refine hx.symm.trans (Eq.trans ?_ (congrArg (fun z ↦
    (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit R M 1 x y : Γ(space R M, linearOverlapOpen R M x y)) * z)
    hy))
  change _ = (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M) (linearOverlapEquation R M x y))
      ((linearTwistTransitionUnit R M 1 x y : LinearOverlapRing R M x y)) * _
  rw [← map_mul]
  congr 1
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_ofHom, tautChart_ratio, HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap_mk,
    HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk,
    linearTwistTransitionUnit, zpow_one, linearOverlapRatioUnit_val, linearOverlapRatio,
    Localization.mk_mul]
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, Submonoid.coe_mul, pow_one]
  simp only [linearOverlapEquation]
  ring

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautChart_componentHom_compat
statement:
theorem tautChart_componentHom_compat (m x y : M) :
    tautChart_componentHom R M x m ≫
        SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
          ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M x y).le.trans inf_le_left) =
      tautChart_componentHom R M y m ≫
        SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
          ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M x y).le.trans inf_le_right) ≫
        pushedLinearOverlapTransition R M 1 x y
proof:
:= by
  apply SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModulesHom_ext_top
  change (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
        ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M x y).le.trans inf_le_left)).app ⊤
      ((tautChart_componentHom R M x m).app ⊤ (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ⊤))) =
    (pushedLinearOverlapTransition R M 1 x y).app ⊤
      ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
        ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M x y).le.trans inf_le_right)).app ⊤
        ((tautChart_componentHom R M y m).app ⊤ (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ⊤))))
  rw [tautChart_componentHom, tautChart_componentHom, tautChart_unitHomEquiv_symm_sectionsOfTop_app,
    tautChart_unitHomEquiv_symm_sectionsOfTop_app]
  simp only [SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction_app_apply,
    pushedLinearOverlapTransition, Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app,
    linearOverlapTransitionIso]
  simp [SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso_hom_app_apply,
    tautChart_component, SchemeProjectiveSpace.restrictTopUnit]
  exact tautChart_presheaf_aux _ _ _ _ _
    ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M x y).le.trans inf_le_left)
    ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M x y).le.trans inf_le_right) _ _ _ (𝟙 _) rfl
    (tautChart_ratio_key R M x y m)

statement:

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautChart_cochainHom_compatibility

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautChart_epi_of_restrict
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro Z g g' hc
  apply SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.modulesHom_ext_of_restrict_coversTop U ((Opens.coversTop_iff (T := Y) U).2 hU)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautChart_tautHom_self_comp_projection
statement:
theorem tautChart_tautHom_self_comp_projection (i : ι) :
    tautChart_restrictOne R M (linearOpen R M (b i)) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι).map
        (tautChart_tautHom R M b (b i)) ≫ linearLocalFrameProjection R M b 1 i = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModulesHom_ext_top
  change (linearLocalFrameProjection R M b 1 i).app ⊤
      ((tautChart_tautHom R M b (b i)).app ((linearOpen R M (b i)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤)
        ((tautChart_restrictOne R M (linearOpen R M (b i))).app ⊤
          (1 : (linearOpen R M (b i)).toScheme.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)))) =
      (1 : (linearOpen R M (b i)).toScheme.presheaf.obj (op ⊤))
  rw [tautChart_restrictOne, tautChart_unitHomEquiv_symm_sectionsOfTop_app,
    linearLocalFrameProjection_app_eq]
  have h1 : (Pi.π (fun j ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) (linearOpen R M (b j))) i).app
      ((linearOpen R M (b i)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤)
      ((kernel.ι (linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b 1)).app
        ((linearOpen R M (b i)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤)
        ((tautChart_tautHom R M b (b i)).app ((linearOpen R M (b i)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤)
          (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ((linearOpen R M (b i)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤))))) =
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) (linearOpen R M (b i))).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE le_top).op (tautChart_component R M (b i) (b i)) := by
    exact (tautChart_app3 _ _ _ _ _).trans ((congrArg
      (fun f : SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules (space R M) ⟶
          SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) (linearOpen R M (b i)) ↦
        f.app ((linearOpen R M (b i)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤)
          (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ((linearOpen R M (b i)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤))))
      (tautChart_tautHom_kernel_π R M b (b i) i)).trans
      (tautChart_unitHomEquiv_symm_sectionsOfTop_app' _ _ _))
  erw [h1]
  simp only [tautChart_component, tautChart_ratioSection_self]
  have e : ∀ {V W : (linearOpen R M (b i)).toScheme.Opens} (f : op V ⟶ op W)
      (x : (linearOpen R M (b i)).toScheme.presheaf.obj (op V)),
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules (linearOpen R M (b i)).toScheme).presheaf.map f x =
        (linearOpen R M (b i)).toScheme.presheaf.map f x := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
  erw [e, e, map_one]
  try rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautChart_tautHom_self_restrict_isIso
statement:
theorem tautChart_tautHom_self_restrict_isIso (i : ι) :
    Epi ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι).map
      (tautChart_tautHom R M b (b i)))
proof:
:= by
  have h := tautChart_tautHom_self_comp_projection R M b i
  haveI : IsSplitEpi ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι).map
      (tautChart_tautHom R M b (b i)) ≫ linearLocalFrameProjection R M b 1 i) :=
    IsSplitEpi.mk' ⟨tautChart_restrictOne R M (linearOpen R M (b i)), h⟩
  haveI : IsIso (linearLocalFrameProjection R M b 1 i) :=
    (twistingSheafOfBasisIndexLinearOpenIso R M b 1 i).isIso_inv
  have e : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι).map
      (tautChart_tautHom R M b (b i)) =
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι).map
        (tautChart_tautHom R M b (b i)) ≫ linearLocalFrameProjection R M b 1 i) ≫
        inv (linearLocalFrameProjection R M b 1 i) := by simp
  rw [e]
  exact epi_comp' (IsSplitEpi.epi _) (IsIso.epi_of_iso _)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautChart_tau_epi
statement: theorem tautChart_tau_epi : Epi (tautChart_tau R M b)
proof:
:= by
  apply tautChart_epi_of_restrict _ (fun i ↦ linearOpen R M (b i)) (linearOpen_iSup_eq_top R M b)
  intro i
  have h := tautChart_tautHom_self_restrict_isIso R M b i
  rw [← tautChart_ιFree_tau] at h
  exact tautChart_epi_map_of_epi_map_comp _ (SheafOfModules.ιFree i) _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautChart_tautHom_basisChange
statement:
theorem tautChart_tautHom_basisChange {κ : Type u} [Finite κ] (c : Module.Basis κ R M) (m : M) :
    tautChart_tautHom R M b m ≫ twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M b c 1 = tautChart_tautHom R M c m
proof:
:= by
  apply SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.modulesHom_ext_of_over_coversTop
    (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ basisChangeOpen R M b c ij.1 ij.2) (basisChangeOpen_coversTop R M b c)
  rintro ⟨i, j⟩
  let W := basisChangeOpen R M b c i j
  let F := SheafOfModules.overFunctor (space R M).ringCatSheaf W
  let qb := twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b 1 i
  let qc := twistingSheafBasisComponent R M c 1 j
  let rb := basisChangeLeftRestriction R M b c i j
  let rc := basisChangeRightRestriction R M b c i j
  let t := pushedLinearOverlapTransition R M (-1) (b i) (c j)
  letI : IsIso (qc.over W) := twistingSheafBasisComponent_over_isIso_of_le R M c 1 j
    ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (c j)).le.trans inf_le_right)
  letI : IsIso (rc.over W) := basisChangeRightRestriction_over_isIso_of_le R M b c i j le_rfl
  have hglob : tautChart_tautHom R M b m ≫ qb ≫ rb ≫ t = tautChart_tautHom R M c m ≫ qc ≫ rc := by
    have h1 : tautChart_tautHom R M b m ≫ qb = tautChart_componentHom R M (b i) m :=
      tautChart_tautHom_component R M b m i
    have h2 : tautChart_tautHom R M c m ≫ qc = tautChart_componentHom R M (c j) m :=
      tautChart_tautHom_component R M c m j
    rw [reassoc_of% h1, reassoc_of% h2]
    exact tautChart_componentHom_compat_neg R M m (b i) (c j)
  change F.map (tautChart_tautHom R M b m ≫ twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M b c 1) =
    F.map (tautChart_tautHom R M c m)
  rw [F.map_comp]
  change F.map (tautChart_tautHom R M b m) ≫ (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M b c 1).over W = _
  rw [twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_over]
  change (tautChart_tautHom R M b m).over W ≫
      (twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso R M b c 1 i j).hom = (tautChart_tautHom R M c m).over W
  have hL : (twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso R M b c 1 i j).hom ≫ qc.over W ≫ rc.over W =
      qb.over W ≫ rb.over W ≫ t.over W := by
    simp [twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso]
    erw [IsIso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  have hover : ∀ {A B D : (space R M).Modules} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ D),
      (f ≫ g).over W = f.over W ≫ g.over W := fun f g ↦ F.map_comp f g
  have hm : Mono (qc.over W ≫ rc.over W) :=
    @mono_comp _ _ _ _ _ _ (IsIso.mono_of_iso _) _ (IsIso.mono_of_iso _)
  refine (@cancel_mono _ _ _ _ _ _ hm _ _).1 ?_
  rw [Category.assoc, hL, ← hover, ← hover, ← hover, ← hover, ← hover, hglob]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautChart_degreeZero_symm_val
statement:
theorem tautChart_degreeZero_symm_val (a : R) :
    (((degreeZeroAlgEquiv (R := R) (M := M)).symm a : symGrading R M 0) :
      SymmetricAlgebra R M) = algebraMap R (SymmetricAlgebra R M) a
proof:
:= by
  have h := (degreeZeroAlgEquiv (R := R) (M := M)).symm.commutes a
  simp only [Algebra.algebraMap_self, RingHom.id_apply] at h
  rw [h]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautChart_ratio_smul
statement:
theorem tautChart_ratio_smul (x m : M) (a : R) :
    tautChart_ratio R M x (a • m) = tautChart_scalarHom R M x a * tautChart_ratio R M x m
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp only [tautChart_ratio, tautChart_scalarHom, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk,
    HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul, RingHom.comp_apply]
  change _ = (HomogeneousLocalization.val (HomogeneousLocalization.mk
    ⟨0, ((degreeZeroAlgEquiv (R := R) (M := M)).symm a : symGrading R M 0), 1, one_mem _⟩)) * _
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mk, tautChart_degreeZero_symm_val, Localization.mk_mul]
  congr 1
  · simp [linearForm, Algebra.smul_def]
  · ext; simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautChart_ratio_add
statement:
theorem tautChart_ratio_add (x m m' : M) :
    tautChart_ratio R M x (m + m') = tautChart_ratio R M x m + tautChart_ratio R M x m'
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp only [tautChart_ratio, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.val_add,
    Localization.add_mk_self]
  congr 1
  simp [linearForm]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautChart_linearOpen_ι_toSpec
statement:
theorem tautChart_linearOpen_ι_toSpec (x : M) :
    (linearOpen R M x).ι ≫ intrinsicToSpec (R := R) (M := M) =
      (Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (symGrading R M) (linearForm R M x)
          (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M x) Nat.zero_lt_one).hom ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (tautChart_scalarHom R M x))
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi (Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (symGrading R M) (linearForm R M x)
    (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M x) Nat.zero_lt_one).inv).1
  rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  change Proj.awayι (symGrading R M) (linearForm R M x)
      (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M x) Nat.zero_lt_one ≫ intrinsicToSpec (R := R) (M := M) = _
  unfold intrinsicToSpec
  rw [← Category.assoc, Proj.awayι_toSpecZero, ← Spec.map_comp]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautChart_scal_restrict
statement:
theorem tautChart_scal_restrict (x : M) (a : R) :
    (space R M).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : linearOpen R M x ≤ ⊤)).op (tautChart_scal R M a) =
      Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M) (linearForm R M x) (tautChart_scalarHom R M x a)
proof:
:= by
  let e := Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (symGrading R M) (linearForm R M x)
    (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M x) Nat.zero_lt_one
  have h1 := congrArg (fun φ ↦ Scheme.Hom.appTop φ ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv a))
    (tautChart_linearOpen_ι_toSpec R M x)
  simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at h1
  have h2 : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (tautChart_scalarHom R M x))).appTop
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv a) =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (LinearChartRing R M x))).inv
        (tautChart_scalarHom R M x a) :=
    (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (tautChart_scalarHom R M x))) a).symm
  have h3 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (Proj.basicOpenToSpec_app_top (symGrading R M)
    (linearForm R M x)) ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (LinearChartRing R M x))).inv
      (tautChart_scalarHom R M x a))
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, Iso.inv_hom_id_apply] at h3
  have h4 : ∀ y : Γ(space R M, ⊤), (linearOpen R M x).ι.appTop y =
      (linearOpen R M x).topIso.inv
        ((space R M).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : linearOpen R M x ≤ ⊤)).op y) :=
    fun y ↦ rfl
  rw [h2, h4] at h1
  exact (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (linearOpen R M x).topIso.inv).1 (h1.trans h3)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautChart_componentHom_add
statement:
theorem tautChart_componentHom_add (x m m' : M) :
    tautChart_componentHom R M x (m + m') = tautChart_componentHom R M x m + tautChart_componentHom R M x m'
proof:
:= by
  apply SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModulesHom_ext_top
  change (tautChart_componentHom R M x (m + m')).app ⊤ (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) =
    (tautChart_componentHom R M x m).app ⊤ (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) +
      (tautChart_componentHom R M x m').app ⊤ (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ⊤))
  rw [tautChart_componentHom, tautChart_componentHom, tautChart_componentHom,
    tautChart_unitHomEquiv_symm_sectionsOfTop_app, tautChart_unitHomEquiv_symm_sectionsOfTop_app,
    tautChart_unitHomEquiv_symm_sectionsOfTop_app]
  change (space R M).presheaf.map _ (tautChart_ratioSection R M x (m + m')) =
    (space R M).presheaf.map _ (tautChart_ratioSection R M x m) +
      (space R M).presheaf.map _ (tautChart_ratioSection R M x m')
  rw [← map_add, tautChart_ratioSection, tautChart_ratioSection, tautChart_ratioSection,
    tautChart_ratio_add]
  exact congrArg _ (map_add _ _ _)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautChart_componentHom_smul
statement:
theorem tautChart_componentHom_smul (x m : M) (a : R) :
    tautChart_componentHom R M x (a • m) =
      tautChart_mulBy R M (tautChart_scal R M a) ≫ tautChart_componentHom R M x m
proof:
:= by
  apply SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModulesHom_ext_top
  change (tautChart_componentHom R M x (a • m)).app ⊤ (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) =
    (tautChart_componentHom R M x m).app ⊤
      ((tautChart_mulBy R M (tautChart_scal R M a)).app ⊤ (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ⊤)))
  rw [tautChart_mulBy, tautChart_unitHomEquiv_symm_sectionsOfTop_app]
  have e1 : (tautChart_scal R M a : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) =
      (tautChart_scal R M a) • (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) := (mul_one _).symm
  rw [e1, Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul, tautChart_componentHom, tautChart_componentHom,
    tautChart_unitHomEquiv_symm_sectionsOfTop_app, tautChart_unitHomEquiv_symm_sectionsOfTop_app]
  change (show Γ((linearOpen R M x).toScheme, (linearOpen R M x).ι ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤) from
      (space R M).presheaf.map
        (eqToHom (tautChart_image_preimage_top R M (linearOpen R M x))).op
        (tautChart_ratioSection R M x (a • m))) =
    ((linearOpen R M x).ι.app ⊤ (tautChart_scal R M a)) *
      (show Γ((linearOpen R M x).toScheme, (linearOpen R M x).ι ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤) from
        (space R M).presheaf.map
          (eqToHom (tautChart_image_preimage_top R M (linearOpen R M x))).op
          (tautChart_ratioSection R M x m))
  rw [Scheme.Opens.ι_app, tautChart_ratioSection, tautChart_ratioSection, tautChart_ratio_smul, map_mul,
    map_mul, ← tautChart_scal_restrict]
  congr 1

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautChart_tautHom_add
statement:
theorem tautChart_tautHom_add (m m' : M) :
    tautChart_tautHom R M b (m + m') = tautChart_tautHom R M b m + tautChart_tautHom R M b m'
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (kernel.ι (linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b 1))).1
  apply Limits.Pi.hom_ext
  intro k
  refine ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (tautChart_tautHom_kernel_π R M b (m + m') k)).trans ?_
  refine (tautChart_componentHom_add R M (b k) m m').trans ?_
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (Preadditive.add_comp _ _ _ _ _ _).symm
  exact congrArg₂ (· + ·) (tautChart_tautHom_kernel_π R M b m k).symm
    (tautChart_tautHom_kernel_π R M b m' k).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautChart_tautHom_smul
statement:
theorem tautChart_tautHom_smul (a : R) (m : M) :
    tautChart_tautHom R M b (a • m) =
      tautChart_mulBy R M (tautChart_scal R M a) ≫ tautChart_tautHom R M b m
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (kernel.ι (linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b 1))).1
  apply Limits.Pi.hom_ext
  intro k
  refine ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (tautChart_tautHom_kernel_π R M b (a • m) k)).trans ?_
  refine (tautChart_componentHom_smul R M (b k) m a).trans ?_
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
  exact congrArg (fun f ↦ tautChart_mulBy R M (tautChart_scal R M a) ≫ f)
    (tautChart_tautHom_kernel_π R M b m k).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautChart_tautHom_app_sum
statement:
theorem tautChart_tautHom_app_sum {κ' : Type u} (l : κ' →₀ R) (v : κ' → M)
    (V : (space R M).Opens) :
    (tautChart_tautHom R M b (l.sum (fun i a ↦ a • v i))).app V
        (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op V)) =
      l.sum (fun i a ↦ ((space R M).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op (tautChart_scal R M a)) •
        (tautChart_tautHom R M b (v i)).app V (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op V)))
proof:
:= by
  let F : M →+ Γ(twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b 1, V) :=
    AddMonoidHom.mk' (fun m ↦ (tautChart_tautHom R M b m).app V (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op V)))
      (fun m m' ↦ by
        simp only [tautChart_tautHom_add, Scheme.Modules.Hom.add_app]
        rfl)
  refine (map_finsuppSum F l (fun i a ↦ a • v i)).trans ?_
  apply Finsupp.sum_congr
  intro i _
  change (tautChart_tautHom R M b (_ • v i)).app V _ = _
  rw [tautChart_tautHom_smul]
  change (tautChart_tautHom R M b (v i)).app V ((tautChart_mulBy R M (tautChart_scal R M _)).app V
    (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op V))) = _
  rw [tautChart_mulBy, tautChart_unitHomEquiv_symm_sectionsOfTop_app']
  refine (congrArg (fun z : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op V) ↦
    (tautChart_tautHom R M b (v i)).app V z)
    (mul_one ((space R M).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op
      (tautChart_scal R M (l i)))).symm).trans ?_
  exact Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul _ _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautChart_app_map
proof:
:= by
  have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (φ.mapPresheaf.naturality i.op) x
  simpa only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, Scheme.Modules.mapPresheaf_app] using h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautChart_projection_taut
statement:
theorem tautChart_projection_taut (k : ι) :
    (linearLocalFrameProjection R M b 1 k).app ⊤
      ((twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b 1).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_top : (linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ ⊤)).op
          ((tautChart_tautHom R M b (b k)).app ⊤ (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ⊤)))) =
      (1 : Γ((linearOpen R M (b k)).toScheme, ⊤))
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun f : SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules (linearOpen R M (b k)).toScheme ⟶
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules (linearOpen R M (b k)).toScheme ↦
        Scheme.Modules.Hom.app f ⊤ (1 : (linearOpen R M (b k)).toScheme.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)))
    (tautChart_tautHom_self_comp_projection R M b k)
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.id_app, ConcreteCategory.id_apply] at h
  rw [tautChart_restrictOne, tautChart_unitHomEquiv_symm_sectionsOfTop_app] at h
  have e : (tautChart_tautHom R M b (b k)).app ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤)
      (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤))) =
      (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b 1).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_top : (linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ ⊤)).op
          ((tautChart_tautHom R M b (b k)).app ⊤ (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ⊤))) := by
    rw [← tautChart_app_map]
    congr 1
  exact (congrArg (fun z ↦ (linearLocalFrameProjection R M b 1 k).app ⊤ z) e).symm.trans h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_unitHom_sectionsOfTop_comp
statement:
theorem tautSection_unitHom_sectionsOfTop_comp {Y : Scheme.{u}} {N N' : Y.Modules} (s : Γ(N, ⊤))
    (g : N ⟶ N') :
    N.unitHomEquiv.symm (SchemeProjectiveSpace.sectionsOfTop N s) ≫ g =
      N'.unitHomEquiv.symm (SchemeProjectiveSpace.sectionsOfTop N' (g.app ⊤ s))
proof:
:= by
  rw [SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv_symm_comp]
  congr 1
  apply PresheafOfModules.sections_ext
  intro V
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (g.val.naturality (homOfLE le_top).op) s

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_presheaf_map_comp
statement:
theorem tautSection_presheaf_map_comp {Y : Scheme.{u}} {U V W : Y.Opens} (f : op U ⟶ op V)
    (g : op V ⟶ op W) (x : Γ(Y, U)) :
    Y.presheaf.map g (Y.presheaf.map f x) = Y.presheaf.map (f ≫ g) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_presheaf_map_congr
statement:
theorem tautSection_presheaf_map_congr {Y : Scheme.{u}} {U W : Y.Opens} (f g : op U ⟶ op W)
    (x : Γ(Y, U)) : Y.presheaf.map f x = Y.presheaf.map g x
proof:
:= by
  have : f = g := Quiver.Hom.unop_inj (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  rw [this]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_opens_presheaf_map
statement:
theorem tautSection_opens_presheaf_map {Y : Scheme.{u}} (U : Y.Opens) {V V' : U.toScheme.Opens}
    (h : V ≤ V') (hh : U.ι ''ᵁ V ≤ U.ι ''ᵁ V') (x : Γ(U.toScheme, V')) :
    U.toScheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x =
      Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hh).op (show Γ(Y, U.ι ''ᵁ V') from x)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_id_apply
statement:
theorem tautSection_id_apply {Y : Scheme.{u}} {U : Y.Opens} (x : Γ(Y, U)) :
    (𝟙 Γ(Y, U) : Γ(Y, U) ⟶ Γ(Y, U)) x = x
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_norm1
statement:
theorem tautSection_norm1 {Y : Scheme.{u}} {U V W : Y.Opens} (e : op U ⟶ op V) (a : op V ⟶ op W)
    (z : Γ(Y, U)) :
    Y.presheaf.map a ((𝟙 (Y.presheaf.obj (op V))) (Y.presheaf.map e z)) =
      Y.presheaf.map (e ≫ a) z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, Category.id_comp,
    ← Functor.map_comp]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_norm2
statement:
theorem tautSection_norm2 {Y : Scheme.{u}} (W : Y.Opens) {V V' : W.toScheme.Opens} {U : Y.Opens}
    (e : op U ⟶ op (W.ι ''ᵁ V')) (h : V ≤ V')
    (z : Γ(Y, U)) :
    CommRingCat.Hom.hom (W.toScheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op)
        (CommRingCat.Hom.hom (Y.presheaf.map e) z) =
      Y.presheaf.map (e ≫ (homOfLE (W.ι.image_mono h)).op) z
proof:
:= by
  change Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (W.ι.image_mono h)).op (Y.presheaf.map e z) = _
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_presheaf_map_map
statement:
theorem tautSection_presheaf_map_map {Y : Scheme.{u}} {U V W : Y.Opens} (f : op U ⟶ op V)
    (g : op V ⟶ op W) (h : op U ⟶ op W) (x : Γ(Y, U)) :
    Y.presheaf.map g (Y.presheaf.map f x) = Y.presheaf.map h x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  congr 2

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_ratio_awayMap
statement:
theorem tautSection_ratio_awayMap (m x y : M) :
    HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap (symGrading R M) (f := linearForm R M x)
        (x := linearOverlapEquation R M x y) (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M y) rfl
        (tautSection_ratio R M m x) =
      linearOverlapRatio R M x y *
        HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap (symGrading R M) (f := linearForm R M y)
          (x := linearOverlapEquation R M x y) (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M x)
          (mul_comm _ _) (tautSection_ratio R M m y)
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp only [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul, tautSection_ratio, linearOverlapRatio]
  unfold HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_awayMap_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.val_awayMap_mk]
  simp only [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mk, pow_one, Localization.mk_mul]
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, Submonoid.coe_mul]
  simp only [linearOverlapEquation]
  ring

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_awayToSection_restrict
statement:
theorem tautSection_awayToSection_restrict (m x y : M) :
    (space R M).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M x y).le.trans inf_le_left)).op
        (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M) (linearForm R M x) (tautSection_ratio R M m x)) =
      Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M) (linearOverlapEquation R M x y)
        (HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap (symGrading R M) (f := linearForm R M x)
          (x := linearOverlapEquation R M x y) (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M y) rfl
          (tautSection_ratio R M m x))
proof:
:= by
  have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (Proj.awayMap_awayToSection (symGrading R M) (f := linearForm R M x)
      (x := linearOverlapEquation R M x y) (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M y) rfl)
    (tautSection_ratio R M m x)
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at h
  exact h.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_awayToSection_restrict'
statement:
theorem tautSection_awayToSection_restrict' (m x y : M) :
    (space R M).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M x y).le.trans inf_le_right)).op
        (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M) (linearForm R M y) (tautSection_ratio R M m y)) =
      Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M) (linearOverlapEquation R M x y)
        (HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap (symGrading R M) (f := linearForm R M y)
          (x := linearOverlapEquation R M x y) (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M x)
          (mul_comm _ _) (tautSection_ratio R M m y))
proof:
:= by
  have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (Proj.awayMap_awayToSection (symGrading R M) (f := linearForm R M y)
      (x := linearOverlapEquation R M x y) (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M x) (mul_comm _ _))
    (tautSection_ratio R M m y)
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at h
  exact h.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_key
statement:
theorem tautSection_key (m x y : M) {T : (space R M).Opens} (hT : T ≤ linearOverlapOpen R M x y) :
    (space R M).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (hT.trans ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M x y).le.trans inf_le_left))).op
        (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M) (linearForm R M x) (tautSection_ratio R M m x)) =
      (space R M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hT).op
          (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M) (linearOverlapEquation R M x y)
            (linearOverlapRatio R M x y)) *
        (space R M).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (hT.trans ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M x y).le.trans inf_le_right))).op
          (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M) (linearForm R M y) (tautSection_ratio R M m y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tautSection_presheaf_map_map
      (homOfLE ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M x y).le.trans inf_le_left)).op (homOfLE hT).op,
    ← tautSection_presheaf_map_map
      (homOfLE ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M x y).le.trans inf_le_right)).op (homOfLE hT).op,
    tautSection_awayToSection_restrict, tautSection_awayToSection_restrict', ← map_mul]
  congr 1
  rw [tautSection_ratio_awayMap]
  exact map_mul (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M) (linearOverlapEquation R M x y)).hom _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_image_top
statement:
theorem tautSection_image_top (x : M) :
    (linearOpen R M x).ι ''ᵁ ((linearOpen R M x).ι ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤) = linearOpen R M x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
  exact inf_top_eq _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_component_compat
statement:
theorem tautSection_component_compat (m x y : M) :
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
        ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M x y).le.trans inf_le_left)).app ⊤
        (tautSection_component R M m x) =
      (pushedLinearOverlapTransition R M 1 x y).app ⊤
        ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
          ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M x y).le.trans inf_le_right)).app ⊤
          (tautSection_component R M m y))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction_app_apply,
    pushedLinearOverlapTransition, Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app,
    linearOverlapTransitionIso]
  simp [tautSection_component, Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso]
  have h1 : linearTwistTransitionUnit R M 1 x y =
      linearOverlapRatioUnit R M x y := zpow_one _
  have hB : ∀ (f : SymmetricAlgebra R M) (hf : f ∈ symGrading R M 2) (hd : 0 < 2)
      (z : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (symGrading R M) f),
      (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (symGrading R M) f hf hd).hom.hom z =
        Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M) f z := fun _ _ _ _ ↦ rfl
  simp only [SchemeProjectiveSpace.restrictTopUnit, linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit, h1,
    Units.coe_map, MonoidHom.coe_coe, linearOverlapRatioUnit_val,
    RingHom.toMonoidHom_eq_coe, hB]
  erw [tautSection_norm1, tautSection_norm1, tautSection_norm2]
  refine (tautSection_presheaf_map_congr _ _ _).trans
    ((tautSection_key R M m x y ?_).trans ?_)
  · rw [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
  · exact congrArg₂ (· * ·) (tautSection_presheaf_map_congr _ _ _) (tautSection_presheaf_map_congr _ _ _)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_cochainHom_compat
statement:
theorem tautSection_cochainHom_compat (m : M) :
    tautSection_cochainHom R M b m ≫ linearDescentLeft R M b =
      tautSection_cochainHom R M b m ≫ linearDescentRight R M b 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  rintro ⟨i, j⟩
  rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, linearDescentLeft_π, linearDescentRight_π,
    tautSection_cochainHom, Pi.lift_π_assoc, Pi.lift_π_assoc, tautSection_unitComponentHom,
    tautSection_unitComponentHom]
  refine (tautSection_unitHom_sectionsOfTop_comp _ _).trans
    (Eq.trans ?_ (tautSection_unitHom_sectionsOfTop_comp _ _).symm)
  congr 2
  exact tautSection_component_compat R M m (b i) (b j)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_tautHom_π
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem tautSection_tautHom_π (m : M) (j : ι) :
    tautSection_tautHom R M b m ≫
        kernel.ι (linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b 1) ≫
          Pi.π (fun a : ι ↦
            SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) (linearOpen R M (b a))) j =
      tautSection_unitComponentHom R M b m j
proof:
:= by
  rw [tautSection_tautHom, twistingSheafOfBasisIndexLift_ι_assoc, tautSection_cochainHom, Pi.lift_π]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_unitComponentHom_eq
statement:
theorem tautSection_unitComponentHom_eq (m : M) (j : ι) :
    tautSection_unitComponentHom R M b m j = tautSection_unitComp R M m (b j)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_unitHom_eq
statement:
theorem tautSection_unitHom_eq {Y : Scheme.{u}} {P : Y.Modules}
    (u : SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules Y ⟶ P) :
    P.unitHomEquiv.symm (SchemeProjectiveSpace.sectionsOfTop P
      (u.app ⊤ (show Γ(SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules Y, ⊤) from (1 : Γ(Y, ⊤))))) = u
proof:
:= by
  apply P.unitHomEquiv.injective
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  apply PresheafOfModules.sections_ext
  intro V
  refine (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (u.val.naturality (homOfLE le_top).op)
    (show Γ(SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules Y, ⊤) from (1 : Γ(Y, ⊤)))).symm.trans ?_
  exact congrArg (fun x ↦ u.val.app _ x) (map_one (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op).hom)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_unitHom_ext
statement:
theorem tautSection_unitHom_ext {Y : Scheme.{u}} {P : Y.Modules}
    (u v : SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules Y ⟶ P)
    (h : u.app ⊤ (show Γ(SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules Y, ⊤) from (1 : Γ(Y, ⊤))) =
      v.app ⊤ (show Γ(SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules Y, ⊤) from (1 : Γ(Y, ⊤)))) :
    u = v
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tautSection_unitHom_eq u, ← tautSection_unitHom_eq v, h]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_unitHom_app_one
statement:
theorem tautSection_unitHom_app_one {Y : Scheme.{u}} {P : Y.Modules} (s : Γ(P, ⊤)) (V : Y.Opens) :
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (P.unitHomEquiv.symm (SchemeProjectiveSpace.sectionsOfTop P s)) V
      (show Γ(SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules Y, V) from (1 : Γ(Y, V))) =
      P.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op s
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun t : P.val.sections ↦ t.val (op V))
    (P.unitHomEquiv.apply_symm_apply (SchemeProjectiveSpace.sectionsOfTop P s))
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_presheaf_map_heq
statement:
theorem tautSection_presheaf_map_heq {Y : Scheme.{u}} {U V : Y.Opens} (f : op U ⟶ op V)
    (h : U = V) (z : Γ(Y, U)) : HEq (Y.presheaf.map f z) z
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  have : f = 𝟙 _ := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  subst this
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_pushedUnit_eqToHom_app_heq
statement:
theorem tautSection_pushedUnit_eqToHom_app_heq {Y : Scheme.{u}} {U U' : Y.Opens} (h : U = U')
    (W : Y.Opens) (s : Γ(SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y U, W)) :
    HEq ((eqToHom (congrArg (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y) h)).app W s) s
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_pushedUnit_presheaf_map
statement:
theorem tautSection_pushedUnit_presheaf_map {Y : Scheme.{u}} (U : Y.Opens) {V W : Y.Opens}
    (f : op V ⟶ op W) (h : U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W) ≤ U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V))
    (s : Γ(SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y U, V)) :
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y U).presheaf.map f s =
      (show Γ(Y, U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)) from
        Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (show Γ(Y, U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V)) from s))
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_PROI_app
statement:
theorem tautSection_PROI_app {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q] (U : X.Opens)
    (W : Y.Opens) (w : Γ(X, U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (q ''ᵁ W)))) :
    (SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionIso q U).hom.app W w =
      (show Γ(Y, (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ ((q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)) from
        (q.appIso ((q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ ((q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W))).hom
          (X.presheaf.map
            (eqToHom (SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersion_open_eq q U W)).op
            w))
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_appIso_map_heq
proof:
:= by
  subst hA
  rw [Scheme.Hom.appIso_hom, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  refine (tautSection_presheaf_map_heq _ (by rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_image_eq]) _).trans ?_
  have hn := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (q.naturality g) z
  rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hn
  rw [hn]
  exact tautSection_presheaf_map_heq _ (by rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_image_eq]) _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_unitComp_restrict
statement:
theorem tautSection_unitComp_restrict (q : space S N ⟶ space R M) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (x : M) (x' : N) (hU : q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M x = linearOpen S N x') (m : M) (m' : N)
    (H : HEq (q.app (linearOpen R M x)
        (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M) (linearForm R M x) (tautSection_ratio R M m x)))
      (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading S N) (linearForm S N x') (tautSection_ratio S N m' x'))) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).inv ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map (tautSection_unitComp R M m x) ≫
        (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionIso q (linearOpen R M x)).hom ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space S N)) hU) =
      tautSection_unitComp S N m' x'
proof:
:= by
  apply tautSection_unitHom_ext
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  let U := linearOpen R M x
  have hk : U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (q ''ᵁ ⊤)) ≤ U := U.ι_image_le _
  have ha : (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).inv.app ⊤
      (show Γ(SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules (space S N), ⊤) from (1 : Γ(space S N, ⊤))) =
      (show Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules (space R M)), ⊤) from (1 : Γ(space R M, q ''ᵁ ⊤))) := by
    exact map_one (q.appIso ⊤).inv.hom
  have hu : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map (tautSection_unitComp R M m x)).app ⊤
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).inv.app ⊤
        (show Γ(SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules (space S N), ⊤) from (1 : Γ(space S N, ⊤)))) =
      (show Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) U), ⊤) from
        (space R M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hk).op
          (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M) (linearForm R M x) (tautSection_ratio R M m x))) := by
    rw [ha]
    change Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (tautSection_unitComp R M m x) (q ''ᵁ ⊤)
      (show Γ(SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules (space R M), q ''ᵁ ⊤) from
        (1 : Γ(space R M, q ''ᵁ ⊤))) = _
    rw [tautSection_unitComp, tautSection_unitHom_app_one,
      tautSection_pushedUnit_presheaf_map _ _ (U.ι.image_mono (U.ι.preimage_mono le_top))]
    simp only [tautSection_component, Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso, Iso.refl_inv]
    erw [tautSection_norm1]
  have hR : HEq (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (tautSection_unitComp S N m' x') ⊤
      (show Γ(SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules (space S N), ⊤) from (1 : Γ(space S N, ⊤))))
      (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading S N) (linearForm S N x') (tautSection_ratio S N m' x')) := by
    rw [tautSection_unitComp, tautSection_unitHom_app_one,
      tautSection_pushedUnit_presheaf_map _ _ le_rfl]
    simp only [tautSection_component, Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso, Iso.refl_inv]
    erw [tautSection_norm1]
    exact tautSection_presheaf_map_heq _ (tautSection_image_top S N x').symm _
  have hA : (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ ((q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤) = q ⁻¹ᵁ U := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
    exact inf_top_eq _
  rw [hu]
  apply eq_of_heq
  refine (tautSection_pushedUnit_eqToHom_app_heq hU ⊤ _).trans ?_
  refine HEq.trans ?_ hR.symm
  erw [tautSection_PROI_app]
  rw [tautSection_presheaf_map_comp]
  exact (tautSection_appIso_map_heq q hA _ _).trans H

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_tautHom_restrict
statement:
theorem tautSection_tautHom_restrict (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (c : Module.Basis ι S N)
    (q : space S N ⟶ space R M) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (hU : ∀ i, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b i) = linearOpen S N (c i))
    (D : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c 1 q)
    (hD : D.chartIso = linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q hU) (m : M) (m' : N)
    (H : ∀ i, HEq (q.app (linearOpen R M (b i))
        (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M) (linearForm R M (b i)) (tautSection_ratio R M m (b i))))
      (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading S N) (linearForm S N (c i))
        (tautSection_ratio S N m' (c i)))) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map (tautSection_tautHom R M b m) ≫ D.restrictIso.hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).hom ≫ tautSection_tautHom S N c m'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Iso.inv_comp_eq]
  refine (cancel_mono (kernel.ι (linearDescentLeft S N c - linearDescentRight S N c 1))).1 ?_
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro j
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [tautSection_tautHom_π, tautSection_unitComponentHom_eq]
  rw [reassoc_of% (AffineFrameCover.twistingSheafRestrictionData_restrictIso_hom_ι D), hD]
  simp only [linearChartCochainsRestrictIso, Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc, pushedUnitPiCastIso,
    Pi.mapIso_hom_π]
  rw [reassoc_of% pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso_hom_π]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc, ← Functor.map_comp_assoc, Category.assoc,
    tautSection_tautHom_π, tautSection_unitComponentHom_eq]
  exact tautSection_unitComp_restrict q (b j) (c j) (hU j) m m' (H j)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_awayToSection_mk_heq
statement:
theorem tautSection_awayToSection_mk_heq {p p' : SymmetricAlgebra S N} (h : p = p') {d : ℕ}
    (hp : p ∈ symGrading S N d) (hp' : p' ∈ symGrading S N d) (a a' : SymmetricAlgebra S N)
    (ha : a = a') (hx : a ∈ symGrading S N (1 • d)) (hx' : a' ∈ symGrading S N (1 • d)) :
    HEq (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading S N) p
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (symGrading S N) hp 1 a hx))
      (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading S N) p'
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (symGrading S N) hp' 1 a' hx'))
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  subst ha
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_symmetricProjMap_app_ratio_heq
statement:
theorem tautSection_symmetricProjMap_app_ratio_heq (φ : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hspan : Submodule.span S (Set.range φ) = ⊤) (m x : M) :
    HEq ((symmetricProjMap φ hspan).app (linearOpen R M x)
        (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M) (linearForm R M x) (tautSection_ratio R M m x)))
      (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading S N) (linearForm S N (φ x))
        (tautSection_ratio S N (φ m) (φ x)))
proof:
:= by
  have hcomm := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (Proj.awayToSection_comp_appLE (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ)
      (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ hspan)
      (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M x)) (tautSection_ratio R M m x)
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hcomm
  change HEq ((Proj.map (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ)
      (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ hspan)).app
        (Proj.basicOpen (symGrading R M) (linearForm R M x))
        (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M) (linearForm R M x) (tautSection_ratio R M m x))) _
  rw [Scheme.Hom.app_eq_appLE]
  refine (heq_of_eq hcomm).trans ?_
  simp only [tautSection_ratio, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map_mk]
  exact tautSection_awayToSection_mk_heq (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap_linearForm φ x) _ _ _ _
    (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap_linearForm φ m) _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_semilinearSymmetricProjMap_app_ratio_heq
statement:
theorem tautSection_semilinearSymmetricProjMap_app_ratio_heq (f : R →+* S) (φ : M →ₛₗ[f] N)
    (hspan : Submodule.span S (Set.range φ) = ⊤) (m x : M) :
    HEq ((semilinearSymmetricProjMap f φ hspan).app (linearOpen R M x)
        (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M) (linearForm R M x) (tautSection_ratio R M m x)))
      (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading S N) (linearForm S N (φ x))
        (tautSection_ratio S N (φ m) (φ x)))
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra R S := f.toAlgebra
  letI : Module R N := Module.compHom N f
  letI : IsScalarTower R S N :=
    ⟨fun r s n ↦ by
      change (f r * s) • n = f r • s • n
      rw [mul_smul]⟩
  let hspan' :
      Submodule.span S (Set.range (semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f φ)) = ⊤ := by
    change Submodule.span S (Set.range φ) = ⊤
    exact hspan
  exact tautSection_symmetricProjMap_app_ratio_heq (semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f φ) hspan' m x

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_semilinearSymmetricProjMap_app_ratio_heq'
statement:
theorem tautSection_semilinearSymmetricProjMap_app_ratio_heq' (f : R →+* S) (φ : M →ₛₗ[f] N)
    (hspan : Submodule.span S (Set.range φ) = ⊤) (m x : M) (y : N) (hy : φ x = y) :
    HEq ((semilinearSymmetricProjMap f φ hspan).app (linearOpen R M x)
        (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M) (linearForm R M x) (tautSection_ratio R M m x)))
      (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading S N) (linearForm S N y)
        (tautSection_ratio S N (φ m) y))
proof:
:= by
  subst hy
  exact tautSection_semilinearSymmetricProjMap_app_ratio_heq f φ hspan m x

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_chartToLeft_app_ratio_heq
statement:
theorem tautSection_chartToLeft_app_ratio_heq (cb : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    (m : E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (a : C.basisIndex i) :
    HEq (cb.chartToLeft.app
        (linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i a))
        (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))))
          (linearForm Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i a))
          (tautSection_ratio Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) m (C.sectionBasis i a))))
      (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading Γ(X, cb.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op cb.affineOpen.1)))
        (linearForm Γ(X, cb.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op cb.affineOpen.1))
          (cb.leftSectionBasis a))
        (tautSection_ratio Γ(X, cb.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op cb.affineOpen.1))
          (cb.leftRestriction m) (cb.leftSectionBasis a)))
proof:
:= by
  exact tautSection_semilinearSymmetricProjMap_app_ratio_heq'
    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE cb.affineOpen_le_left).op).hom
    cb.leftRestriction cb.leftRestriction_spans m (C.sectionBasis i a) _
    (cb.leftRestriction_sectionBasis a)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_chartToRight_app_ratio_heq
statement:
theorem tautSection_chartToRight_app_ratio_heq (cb : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    (m : E.val.obj (op (C.U j))) (a : C.basisIndex j) :
    HEq (cb.chartToRight.app
        (linearOpen Γ(X, C.U j) (E.val.obj (op (C.U j))) (C.sectionBasis j a))
        (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading Γ(X, C.U j) (E.val.obj (op (C.U j))))
          (linearForm Γ(X, C.U j) (E.val.obj (op (C.U j))) (C.sectionBasis j a))
          (tautSection_ratio Γ(X, C.U j) (E.val.obj (op (C.U j))) m (C.sectionBasis j a))))
      (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading Γ(X, cb.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op cb.affineOpen.1)))
        (linearForm Γ(X, cb.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op cb.affineOpen.1))
          (cb.rightSectionBasis a))
        (tautSection_ratio Γ(X, cb.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op cb.affineOpen.1))
          (cb.rightRestriction m) (cb.rightSectionBasis a)))
proof:
:= by
  exact tautSection_semilinearSymmetricProjMap_app_ratio_heq'
    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE cb.affineOpen_le_right).op).hom
    cb.rightRestriction cb.rightRestriction_spans m (C.sectionBasis j a) _
    (cb.rightRestriction_sectionBasis a)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_tautHom_leftRestrict
statement:
theorem tautSection_tautHom_leftRestrict (cb : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    (m : E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) :
    letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i)
proof:
:= C.basisIndex_finite i
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor cb.chartToLeft).map
        (tautSection_tautHom Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i) m) ≫
        (cb.leftTwistRestrictionData 1).restrictIso.hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso cb.chartToLeft).hom ≫
        tautSection_tautHom Γ(X, cb.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op cb.affineOpen.1))
          cb.leftSectionBasis (cb.leftRestriction m) := by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  exact tautSection_tautHom_restrict (C.sectionBasis i) cb.leftSectionBasis cb.chartToLeft
    cb.chartToLeft_preimage_linearOpen (cb.leftTwistRestrictionData 1) rfl m
    (cb.leftRestriction m) (fun a ↦ tautSection_chartToLeft_app_ratio_heq cb m a)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautSection_tautHom_rightRestrict
statement:
theorem tautSection_tautHom_rightRestrict (cb : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    (m : E.val.obj (op (C.U j))) :
    letI : Finite (C.basisIndex j)
proof:
:= C.basisIndex_finite j
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor cb.chartToRight).map
        (tautSection_tautHom Γ(X, C.U j) (E.val.obj (op (C.U j))) (C.sectionBasis j) m) ≫
        (cb.rightTwistRestrictionData 1).restrictIso.hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso cb.chartToRight).hom ≫
        tautSection_tautHom Γ(X, cb.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op cb.affineOpen.1))
          cb.rightSectionBasis (cb.rightRestriction m) := by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex j) := C.basisIndex_finite j
  exact tautSection_tautHom_restrict (C.sectionBasis j) cb.rightSectionBasis cb.chartToRight
    cb.chartToRight_preimage_linearOpen (cb.rightTwistRestrictionData 1) rfl m
    (cb.rightRestriction m) (fun a ↦ tautSection_chartToRight_app_ratio_heq cb m a)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautChart_component_eq_L1a
statement:

    tautChart_component R M x m = tautSection_component R M m x

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautChart_tautHom_eq_L1a
statement: theorem tautChart_tautHom_eq_L1a (m : M) : tautChart_tautHom R M b m = tautSection_tautHom R M b m
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (kernel.ι (linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b 1))).1
  apply Limits.Pi.hom_ext
  intro k
  refine ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (tautChart_tautHom_kernel_π R M b m k)).trans ?_
  refine Eq.trans ?_ ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (tautSection_tautHom_π R M b m k)).symm
  rw [tautChart_componentHom, tautSection_unitComponentHom, tautChart_component_eq_L1a]
