name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC3.caseII_of_pencilLci
statement:
theorem caseII_of_pencilLci (K : PencilK P) (h : ChExact k (closedPosV4 k))
    (O : PencilOpenLci K h) : CaseII k (closedPosV4 k) h P.i
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  have hz := O.zeroSectionLift x
  set ℓ := K.lift x with hℓ
  have hy : y = pullbackK0 P.j ℓ := K.injA (by rw [hxy, hℓ, K.hbcA x])
  subst hy
  have hqj : totalPushOn (opsV4 k) P.q ∘ₗ totalPushOn (opsV4 k) P.j = LinearMap.id := by
    rw [← totalPushOn_comp (opsV4 k) P.j P.q,
      totalPushOn_congr (opsV4 k) P.qj, totalPushOn_id]
  have hqe : totalPushOn (opsV4 k) P.q ∘ₗ totalPushOn (opsV4 k) P.e =
      totalPushOn (opsV4 k) P.i ∘ₗ totalPushOn (opsV4 k) P.π := by
    rw [← totalPushOn_comp (opsV4 k) P.e P.q, ← totalPushOn_comp (opsV4 k) P.π P.i,
      totalPushOn_congr (opsV4 k) P.qe]
  have e1 : chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h (pullbackK0 P.j ℓ) (fundClass k (W := P.A)) =
      totalPushOn (opsV4 k) P.q (totalPushOn (opsV4 k) P.j
        (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h (pullbackK0 P.j ℓ) (fundClass k (W := P.A)))) :=
    (LinearMap.congr_fun hqj _).symm
  rw [e1, chK0_push (closedPosV4 k) h P.j ℓ, K.fibreRel, map_add, O.kdisj x, zero_add,
    ← chK0_push (closedPosV4 k) h P.e ℓ]
  have e2 := LinearMap.congr_fun hqe
    (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h (pullbackK0 P.e ℓ) (fundClass k (W := P.E)))
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at e2
  rw [e2, hz]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC3.zsClassP_of_eq
statement:
theorem zsClassP_of_eq (M : ZSModel i π s e) (x : K0 X) (ε : K0 E)
    (hε : ε = pullbackK0 π x * M.kosE) :
    ε = pullbackK0 M.φ.hom
      (pullbackK0 (RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).toBase x * kosClassX M.CX M.hN)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hε]
  have h1 : pullbackK0 π x =
      pullbackK0 M.φ.hom (pullbackK0 (RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).toBase x) := by
    rw [pullbackK0_comp_apply, M.hφπ]
  have hm := (pullbackK0RingHom M.φ.hom).map_mul
    (pullbackK0 (RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).toBase x) (kosClassX M.CX M.hN)
  simp only [pullbackK0RingHom_apply] at hm
  rw [h1, ZSModel.kosE, ← hm]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC3.zeroSection_of_gates_K0
statement:
theorem zeroSection_of_gates_K0 (h : ChExact k (closedPosV4 k)) (G : ZSChowGates M h)
    (x : K0 X) (ε : K0 E) (hε : ε = pullbackK0 π x * M.kosE) :
    totalPushOn (opsV4 k) π (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h ε (fundClass k (W := E))) =
      tauX k (closedPosV4 k) h i x
proof:
:= by
  haveI := M.flat
  have hP := zsClassP_of_eq M x ε hε
  set P := RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN with hPdef
  set y : K0 P.scheme := pullbackK0 P.toBase x * kosClassX M.CX M.hN with hy
  have h1 : totalPushOn (opsV4 k) M.φ.hom (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h ε (fundClass k (W := E))) =
      chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h y (fundClass k (W := P.scheme)) := by
    rw [hP, chK0_push (closedPosV4 k) h M.φ.hom y, G.fundPush]
  have h2 : totalPushOn (opsV4 k) π (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h ε (fundClass k (W := E))) =
      totalPushOn (opsV4 k) P.toBase
        (totalPushOn (opsV4 k) M.φ.hom (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h ε (fundClass k (W := E)))) := by
    have hcomp : totalPushOn (opsV4 k) P.toBase ∘ₗ totalPushOn (opsV4 k) M.φ.hom =
        totalPushOn (opsV4 k) π := by
      rw [← totalPushOn_comp (opsV4 k) M.φ.hom P.toBase, totalPushOn_congr (opsV4 k) M.hφπ]
    exact (LinearMap.congr_fun hcomp _).symm
  rw [h2, h1]
  have h3 : chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h y = chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h (kosClassX M.CX M.hN) *
      chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h (pullbackK0 P.toBase x) := by
    rw [hy, mul_comm, G.chMul]
  rw [h3, Module.End.mul_apply, ← G.fundPull]
  have h4 := LinearMap.congr_fun (chK_pull_flat (k := k) P.toBase
    ((cpV4 k).projBundle_relDim P M.hC) x) (fundClass k (W := X))
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at h4
  have h5 : chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h (pullbackK0 P.toBase x)
      (totalPullOn (opsV4 k) P.toBase (e + 1) ((cpV4 k).projBundle_relDim P M.hC)
        (fundClass k (W := X))) =
      totalPullOn (opsV4 k) P.toBase (e + 1) ((cpV4 k).projBundle_relDim P M.hC)
        (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h x (fundClass k (W := X))) := h4.symm
  rw [h5, G.zxTot]
  rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC3.liftLci_fix
statement:
theorem liftLci_fix (lam : K0 (totalGlobal A i.ker))
    (hlam : pullbackK0 (subschemeTotalGlobalι A i.ker) lam = 1) (x : K0 X) :
    lam * liftLci i hA C x = liftLci i hA C x
proof:
:= by
  haveI := BundleCoversProjBundleG2.isLocallyNoetherian_total i.ker hA
  have hp := DeformationRegularWSheafLCI.regPushOfRegularCover_projection
    (BundleCoversProjBundleG2.hasBundleCovers_total i.ker hA) C lam
    (pullbackK0 (totalToClosedBase A i.ker) (pullbackK0 (phiXA i).inv x))
  rw [pullbackK0RingHom_apply, hlam, one_mul] at hp
  exact hp.symm

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC3.kdisj_of_geoLci
statement:
theorem kdisj_of_geoLci (hAreg : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme A)
    (h : ChExact k (closedPosV4 k)) (G : KDGeoLci i hA C φk) : ∀ x : K0 X,
    chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h ((concretePencilK_lci i hA C φk hAreg).lift x)
      (totalCapOn (opsV4 k) (concretePencilK_lci i hA C φk hAreg).LP
        (concretePencilK_lci i hA C φk hAreg).hLP
        (fundClass k (W := (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).M))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨LP, hLP, hfr, htriv⟩ := G
  intro x
  have hcls : totalCapOn (opsV4 k) (concretePencilK_lci i hA C φk hAreg).LP
      (concretePencilK_lci i hA C φk hAreg).hLP
      (fundClass k (W := (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).M)) =
      totalCapOn (opsV4 k) LP hLP (fundClass k (W := (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).M)) :=
    add_right_cancel (b := totalPushOn (opsV4 k) (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).e
      (fundClass k (W := (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).E)))
      ((concretePencilK_lci i hA C φk hAreg).fibreRel.symm.trans hfr)
  rw [hcls]
  exact chK0_cap_of_fix _ LP hLP _ (liftLci_fix i hA C _ htriv x)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC3.kdGeoLci_proved
statement: theorem kdGeoLci_proved : KDGeoLci i hA C φk
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIntegral X := (Fact.out : D28.ProjectiveIntegral k X).1
  haveI hZi : IsIntegral i.ker.subscheme := integralZA i
  have G : ∃ (L N : (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).M.Modules)
      (_ : HasConstantRank (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).M L 1)
      (_ : HasConstantRank (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).M N 1)
      (σ₁ : tensorUnitSheaf (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).M ⟶ L)
      (σE : tensorUnitSheaf (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).M ⟶ N),
      sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ₁ = (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).j.ker ∧
      sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σE = (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).e.ker ∧
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (subschemeTotalGlobalι A i.ker)).obj L ≅
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (subschemeTotalGlobalι A i.ker)).obj N) :=
    kdGate_general A i.ker k φk
  obtain ⟨L, N, hL, hN, σ₁, σE, hid₁, hidE, ⟨e⟩⟩ := G
  haveI : IsNoetherian (totalGlobal A i.ker) := total_isNoetherian (k := k) i.ker hA
  haveI : IsIntegral (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).M :=
    SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_totalGlobal
      A i.ker
  haveI : IsIntegral (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).A := inferInstanceAs (IsIntegral A)
  haveI hEI : IsIntegral (component A i.ker) :=
    G2C1.isIntegral_componentC i.ker C.toQuasiregular hA
  haveI : IsIntegral (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).E := hEI
  have hGne1 : (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).j
      (genericPoint (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).A) ≠
      genericPoint (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).M := fibre_generic_ne A i.ker φk 1
  have hGneE : (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).e
      (genericPoint (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).E) ≠
      genericPoint (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).M := component_generic_ne A i.ker φk
  obtain ⟨d, hZ₁⟩ := exists_height_generic hA
  have hXh : height (genericPoint (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).M) = ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [height_generic_eq_succ k hL σ₁ (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).j hid₁ hGne1]
    change height (genericPoint A) + 1 = _
    rw [hZ₁]
    push_cast; rfl
  have hE : height (genericPoint (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).E) = (d : ℕ∞) := by
    have h := height_generic_eq_succ k hN σE (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).e hidE hGneE
    rw [hXh] at h
    have h' : height (genericPoint (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).E) + 1 = (d : ℕ∞) + 1 := by
      rw [← h]; push_cast; rfl
    exact AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ENat_add_one_cancel h'
  refine ⟨LPof L N, hasConstantRank_LPof hL hN, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (A5FR.fibreRel_cheap (k := k) hL hN σ₁ (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).j hid₁ σE
      (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).e hidE hXh hZ₁ hE)
  · exact pullbackK0_LPof_eq_one _ L N hL hN e

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC3.kdisj_lci
statement:
theorem kdisj_lci (hAreg : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme A)
    (h : ChExact k (closedPosV4 k)) : ∀ x : K0 X,
    chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h ((concretePencilK_lci i hA C φk hAreg).lift x)
      (totalCapOn (opsV4 k) (concretePencilK_lci i hA C φk hAreg).LP
        (concretePencilK_lci i hA C φk hAreg).hLP
        (fundClass k (W := (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).M))) = 0
proof:
:=
  kdisj_of_geoLci i hA C φk hAreg h (kdGeoLci_proved i hA C φk)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC3.zeroSection_lci
statement:
theorem zeroSection_lci [IsIntegral X] (hAreg : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme A) {e : ℕ}
    (M : ZSModel (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).i (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).π
      (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).s e)
    [Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k (RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).scheme)]
    (h : ChExact k (closedPosV4 k)) (G : ZSChowGates M h)
    (bridge : lambdaMinusOne (RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).tautologicalKernel
      ((RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).hasConstantRank_tautologicalKernel M.hE) =
      kosClassX M.CX M.hN) (x : K0 X) :
    totalPushOn (opsV4 k) (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).π
        (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h (pullbackK0 (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).e
          ((concretePencilK_lci i hA C φk hAreg).lift x))
          (fundClass k (W := (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).E))) =
      tauX k (closedPosV4 k) h (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).i x
proof:
:=
  zeroSection_of_gates_K0 M h G x _ (hbcE_K0_kosE i hA C φk hAreg M bridge x)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC3.isIso_of_cover_zero
statement: theorem isIso_of_cover_zero [IsIntegral X] (h0 : r = 0) : IsIso i
proof:
:= by
  have hco : coheight (i (genericPoint X)) = 0 := by
    rw [G2C.coheight_eq_of_cover i C, h0]
    rfl
  have hmax : IsMax (i (genericPoint X)) := Order.coheight_eq_zero.mp hco
  have h1 : genericPoint A ⤳ i (genericPoint X) := genericPoint_specializes _
  have h2 : i (genericPoint X) ⤳ genericPoint A :=
    hmax (show i (genericPoint X) ≤ genericPoint A from h1)
  have hη : i (genericPoint X) = genericPoint A := (h2.antisymm h1).eq
  haveI : Surjective i := by
    refine ⟨fun y ↦ ?_⟩
    have hcl : IsClosed (Set.range i) := i.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range
    have hmem : genericPoint A ∈ Set.range i := ⟨genericPoint X, hη⟩
    have : closure {genericPoint A} ⊆ Set.range i :=
      hcl.closure_subset_iff.mpr (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hmem)
    have hy : y ∈ closure {genericPoint A} := by
      rw [(genericPoint_spec A).def]; trivial
    exact this hy
  exact isIso_of_isClosedImmersion_of_surjective i

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC3.caseII_ambient_lci_zero
statement:
theorem caseII_ambient_lci_zero (h : ChExact k (closedPosV4 k)) (h0 : r = 0) :
    CaseII k (closedPosV4 k) h i
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIntegral X := (Fact.out : D28.ProjectiveIntegral k X).1
  haveI : IsIso i := isIso_of_cover_zero i C h0
  have hr : HasConstantRank X (conormalSheaf i) 0 := by
    have := G2C.conormal_hasConstantRank_of_cover i C
    rw [h0] at this
    exact this
  exact CIIFZ.caseII_of_isIso k h i hr (injA_ambient hA hAreg)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC3.caseII_ambient_lci_pos
statement: theorem caseII_ambient_lci_pos (h0 : r ≠ 0) : CaseII k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) i
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIntegral X := (Fact.out : D28.ProjectiveIntegral k X).1
  haveI : IsIntegral i.ker.subscheme := integralZA i
  haveI : IsNoetherian (totalGlobal A i.ker) := total_isNoetherian (k := k) i.ker hA
  haveI : IsNoetherian (subschemeTotalGlobal A i.ker) := KG2B.isNoetherian_W i.ker hA
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e, r = e + 1 := ⟨r - 1, by omega⟩
  have hNr : HasConstantRank (ARRKG2A.Zs A i.ker) (ARRKG2A.Nsh i.ker) (e + 1) := by
    have := G2C1.hNrankC C.toQuasiregular
    rw [he] at this
    exact this
  obtain ⟨CNZ, hCNZ⟩ := exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hNr
  let φk : k →+* Γ(A, ⊤) := canonφA
  let M := zsModel_lci i hA C φk e he CNZ hCNZ
  have hfact : ProjectiveIntegral k M.CX.scheme := by
    obtain ⟨hI, N, j, hj⟩ := (inferInstance : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k
      (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).E)).out
    haveI := hI
    haveI := hj
    exact ⟨CIICLASS.isIntegral_of_iso M.φ.symm, N, M.φ.inv ≫ j, inferInstance⟩
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k M.CX.scheme) := ⟨hfact⟩
  have hbridge := CIIMB.lambdaMinusOne_taut_eq_kosClassX M.CX
    (M.CX.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card M.hC (Nat.succ_pos _)) M.CX M.hN M.hE
    (M.CX.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card M.hC (Nat.succ_pos _))
  have hchow : ZSChowGates M (chEx k) :=
    CIIFZ.zsChowGates_of_chMul M (chEx k) (fun a b => CIIMB.chK_mul' (chEx k) a b)
  exact caseII_of_pencilLci (concretePencilK_lci i hA C φk hAreg) (chEx k)
    ⟨kdisj_lci i hA C φk hAreg (chEx k),
      fun x => zeroSection_lci i hA C φk hAreg M (chEx k) hchow hbridge x⟩

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC3.caseII_ambient_lci
statement: theorem caseII_ambient_lci : CaseII k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) i
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0 : r = 0
  · exact caseII_ambient_lci_zero i hA hAreg C _ h0
  · exact caseII_ambient_lci_pos i hA hAreg C h0

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.chartToLeft_preimage_linearOpen
statement:
theorem chartToLeft_preimage_linearOpen
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) (a : C.basisIndex i) :
    c.chartToLeft ⁻¹ᵁ
        linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))
          (C.sectionBasis i a) =
        linearOpen Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))
        (c.leftSectionBasis a)
proof:
:= by
  unfold chartToLeft
  rw [semilinearSymmetricProjMap_preimage_linearOpen]
  exact c.leftRestriction_sectionBasis a ▸ rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.chartToRight_preimage_linearOpen
statement:
theorem chartToRight_preimage_linearOpen
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) (a : C.basisIndex j) :
    c.chartToRight ⁻¹ᵁ
        linearOpen Γ(X, C.U j) (E.val.obj (op (C.U j)))
          (C.sectionBasis j a) =
        linearOpen Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))
        (c.rightSectionBasis a)
proof:
:= by
  unfold chartToRight
  rw [semilinearSymmetricProjMap_preimage_linearOpen]
  exact c.rightRestriction_sectionBasis a ▸ rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.leftRestriction_transitionUnit
statement:
theorem leftRestriction_transitionUnit
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) (d : ℤ) (a b : C.basisIndex i) :
    let R
proof:
:= Γ(X, C.U i)
    let S := Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
    let M := E.val.obj (op (C.U i))
    let N := E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)
    let f : R →+* S :=
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_left).op).hom
    let φ : M →ₛₗ[f] N := c.leftRestriction
    Units.map
        (semilinearLinearOverlapAwayMapNormalized
          (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N)
          f φ (C.sectionBasis i a) (C.sectionBasis i b)).toMonoidHom
        (linearTwistTransitionUnit R M d
          (C.sectionBasis i a) (C.sectionBasis i b)) =
      linearTwistTransitionUnit S N d
        (φ (C.sectionBasis i a)) (φ (C.sectionBasis i b)) := by
  dsimp only
  rw [semilinearLinearOverlapAwayMapNormalized_transitionUnit]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.rightRestriction_transitionUnit
statement:
theorem rightRestriction_transitionUnit
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) (d : ℤ) (a b : C.basisIndex j) :
    let R
proof:
:= Γ(X, C.U j)
    let S := Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
    let M := E.val.obj (op (C.U j))
    let N := E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)
    let f : R →+* S :=
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_right).op).hom
    let φ : M →ₛₗ[f] N := c.rightRestriction
    Units.map
        (semilinearLinearOverlapAwayMapNormalized
          (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N)
          f φ (C.sectionBasis j a) (C.sectionBasis j b)).toMonoidHom
        (linearTwistTransitionUnit R M d
          (C.sectionBasis j a) (C.sectionBasis j b)) =
      linearTwistTransitionUnit S N d
        (φ (C.sectionBasis j a)) (φ (C.sectionBasis j b)) := by
  dsimp only
  rw [semilinearLinearOverlapAwayMapNormalized_transitionUnit]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechCoface_zero_component
statement:
theorem coordinateCechCoface_zero_component (M : (space k n).Modules)
    (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (coordinateCechCosimplicialObject k n M).δ (0 : Fin 2) ≫
          (coordinateCechOneTermIso k n M).hom ≫
          Pi.π (fun ij : Fin (n + 1) × Fin (n + 1) ↦
            M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateOverlapOpen k n ij.1 ij.2))) (i, j) =
      (coordinateCechZeroTermIso k n M).hom ≫
          Pi.π (fun a : Fin (n + 1) ↦
            M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateCechCover k n a))) j ≫
          M.presheaf.map
            (homOfLE
              ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_right)).op
proof:
:= by
  let e₀ : (Fin 1 → Fin (n + 1)) ≃ Fin (n + 1) :=
    { toFun := fun a ↦ a default
      invFun := fun a _ ↦ a
      left_inv := fun a ↦ by
        funext t
        exact congrArg a (Subsingleton.elim default t)
      right_inv := fun _ ↦ rfl }
  let e₁ : (Fin 2 → Fin (n + 1)) ≃ Fin (n + 1) × Fin (n + 1) :=
    finTwoArrowEquiv _
  let a₀ : Fin 1 → Fin (n + 1) := fun _ ↦ j
  let a₁ : Fin 2 → Fin (n + 1) := ![i, j]
  let C₀ := fun a : Fin 1 → Fin (n + 1) ↦
    M.presheaf.obj
      (op (∏ᶜ fun t : Fin 1 ↦ coordinateCechCover k n (a t)))
  let C₁ := fun a : Fin 2 → Fin (n + 1) ↦
    M.presheaf.obj
      (op (∏ᶜ fun t : Fin 2 ↦ coordinateCechCover k n (a t)))
  let q : Fin 1 → Fin 2 := fun t ↦ (0 : Fin 2).succAbove t
  let f₀ := fun a : Fin (n + 1) ↦
    M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateCechCover k n a))
  let f₁ := fun ij : Fin (n + 1) × Fin (n + 1) ↦
    M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateOverlapOpen k n ij.1 ij.2))
  have hreindex₁ :
      (Pi.reindex e₁ f₁).hom ≫ Pi.π f₁ (i, j) =
        Pi.π (f₁ ∘ e₁) a₁ := by
    exact Pi.reindex_hom_π e₁ f₁ a₁
  have hreindex₀ :
      (Pi.reindex e₀ f₀).hom ≫ Pi.π f₀ j ≫
          M.presheaf.map
            (homOfLE
              ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_right)).op =
        Pi.π (f₀ ∘ e₀) a₀ ≫
          M.presheaf.map
            (homOfLE
              ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_right)).op := by
    have h := Pi.reindex_hom_π_assoc e₀ f₀ a₀
        (M.presheaf.map
          (homOfLE
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_right)).op)
    dsimp [e₀, a₀] at h
    exact h
  have hproduct₁ :
      (∏ᶜ fun t : Fin 2 ↦ coordinateCechCover k n (a₁ t)) =
        coordinateOverlapOpen k n i j := by
    rw [coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact le_inf (Pi.π _ (0 : Fin 2)).le (Pi.π _ (1 : Fin 2)).le
    · refine (Pi.lift (P := coordinateCechCover k n i ⊓
          coordinateCechCover k n j) (fun t ↦ homOfLE ?_)).le
      fin_cases t
      · exact inf_le_left
      · exact inf_le_right
  let ι₁ : C₁ a₁ ≅ f₁ (i, j) :=
    (M.presheaf.mapIso (eqToIso hproduct₁).op).symm
  let ι₀ : C₀ a₀ ≅ f₀ j :=
    (M.presheaf.mapIso
      (productUniqueIso
        (fun t : Fin 1 ↦ coordinateCechCover k n (a₀ t))).op).symm
  have hone :
      (coordinateCechOneTermIso k n M).hom ≫ Pi.π f₁ (i, j) =
        Pi.π C₁ a₁ ≫ ι₁.hom := by
    simp only [coordinateCechOneTermIso, id_eq, Iso.trans_hom]
    rw [Category.assoc, hreindex₁, Pi.mapIso_hom_π]
  have hzero :
      (coordinateCechZeroTermIso k n M).hom ≫ Pi.π f₀ j ≫
          M.presheaf.map
            (homOfLE
              ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_right)).op =
        Pi.π C₀ a₀ ≫ ι₀.hom ≫
          M.presheaf.map
            (homOfLE
              ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_right)).op := by
    simp only [coordinateCechZeroTermIso, id_eq, Iso.trans_hom]
    rw [Category.assoc, hreindex₀, Pi.mapIso_hom_π_assoc]
  rw [hone, hzero]
  have hδ :
      (coordinateCechCosimplicialObject k n M).δ (0 : Fin 2) ≫ Pi.π C₁ a₁ =
        Pi.π C₀ (a₁ ∘ q) ≫
          M.presheaf.map
            (Pi.lift (P := ∏ᶜ fun t : Fin 2 ↦ coordinateCechCover k n (a₁ t))
              (fun t : Fin 1 ↦
                Pi.π (fun s : Fin 2 ↦ coordinateCechCover k n (a₁ s)) (q t))).op := by
    have hcech :
        (((Functor.rightOp
          (Limits.FormalCoproduct.mk _ (coordinateCechCover k n)).cech).map
            (SimplexCategory.δ (0 : Fin 2))).unop) =
          (Limits.FormalCoproduct.mk _ (coordinateCechCover k n)).mapPower q := by
      rfl
    change (Pi.lift _ ≫ Pi.π C₁ a₁) = _
    rw [Pi.lift_π]
    rw [hcech]
    rfl
  have hq : a₁ ∘ q = a₀ := by
    funext t
    fin_cases t
    simp [a₁, a₀, e₁, q, finTwoArrowEquiv]
  have pi_transport (x y : Fin 1 → Fin (n + 1)) (h : x = y) :
      Pi.π C₀ x ≫ eqToHom (congrArg C₀ h) = Pi.π C₀ y := by
    subst y
    simp
  have hπ := pi_transport (a₁ ∘ q) a₀ hq
  rw [← Category.assoc, hδ]
  rw [← hπ]
  have htransport :
      eqToHom (congrArg C₀ hq) =
        M.presheaf.map
          (eqToHom (congrArg
            (fun a : Fin 1 → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              op (∏ᶜ fun t : Fin 1 ↦ coordinateCechCover k n (a t))) hq)) := by
    dsimp only [C₀]
    rw [eqToHom_map]
  rw [htransport]
  dsimp only [ι₁, ι₀, Iso.symm, Functor.mapIso]
  simp only [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechCoface_one_component
statement:
theorem coordinateCechCoface_one_component (M : (space k n).Modules)
    (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (coordinateCechCosimplicialObject k n M).δ (1 : Fin 2) ≫
          (coordinateCechOneTermIso k n M).hom ≫
          Pi.π (fun ij : Fin (n + 1) × Fin (n + 1) ↦
            M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateOverlapOpen k n ij.1 ij.2))) (i, j) =
      (coordinateCechZeroTermIso k n M).hom ≫
          Pi.π (fun a : Fin (n + 1) ↦
            M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateCechCover k n a))) i ≫
          M.presheaf.map
            (homOfLE
              ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_left)).op
proof:
:= by
  let e₀ : (Fin 1 → Fin (n + 1)) ≃ Fin (n + 1) :=
    { toFun := fun a ↦ a default
      invFun := fun a _ ↦ a
      left_inv := fun a ↦ by
        funext t
        exact congrArg a (Subsingleton.elim default t)
      right_inv := fun _ ↦ rfl }
  let e₁ : (Fin 2 → Fin (n + 1)) ≃ Fin (n + 1) × Fin (n + 1) :=
    finTwoArrowEquiv _
  let a₀ : Fin 1 → Fin (n + 1) := fun _ ↦ i
  let a₁ : Fin 2 → Fin (n + 1) := ![i, j]
  let C₀ := fun a : Fin 1 → Fin (n + 1) ↦
    M.presheaf.obj
      (op (∏ᶜ fun t : Fin 1 ↦ coordinateCechCover k n (a t)))
  let C₁ := fun a : Fin 2 → Fin (n + 1) ↦
    M.presheaf.obj
      (op (∏ᶜ fun t : Fin 2 ↦ coordinateCechCover k n (a t)))
  let q : Fin 1 → Fin 2 := fun t ↦ (1 : Fin 2).succAbove t
  let f₀ := fun a : Fin (n + 1) ↦
    M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateCechCover k n a))
  let f₁ := fun ij : Fin (n + 1) × Fin (n + 1) ↦
    M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateOverlapOpen k n ij.1 ij.2))
  have hreindex₁ :
      (Pi.reindex e₁ f₁).hom ≫ Pi.π f₁ (i, j) =
        Pi.π (f₁ ∘ e₁) a₁ := by
    exact Pi.reindex_hom_π e₁ f₁ a₁
  have hreindex₀ :
      (Pi.reindex e₀ f₀).hom ≫ Pi.π f₀ i ≫
          M.presheaf.map
            (homOfLE
              ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_left)).op =
        Pi.π (f₀ ∘ e₀) a₀ ≫
          M.presheaf.map
            (homOfLE
              ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_left)).op := by
    have h := Pi.reindex_hom_π_assoc e₀ f₀ a₀
        (M.presheaf.map
          (homOfLE
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_left)).op)
    dsimp [e₀, a₀] at h
    exact h
  have hproduct₁ :
      (∏ᶜ fun t : Fin 2 ↦ coordinateCechCover k n (a₁ t)) =
        coordinateOverlapOpen k n i j := by
    rw [coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact le_inf (Pi.π _ (0 : Fin 2)).le (Pi.π _ (1 : Fin 2)).le
    · refine (Pi.lift (P := coordinateCechCover k n i ⊓
          coordinateCechCover k n j) (fun t ↦ homOfLE ?_)).le
      fin_cases t
      · exact inf_le_left
      · exact inf_le_right
  let ι₁ : C₁ a₁ ≅ f₁ (i, j) :=
    (M.presheaf.mapIso (eqToIso hproduct₁).op).symm
  let ι₀ : C₀ a₀ ≅ f₀ i :=
    (M.presheaf.mapIso
      (productUniqueIso
        (fun t : Fin 1 ↦ coordinateCechCover k n (a₀ t))).op).symm
  have hone :
      (coordinateCechOneTermIso k n M).hom ≫ Pi.π f₁ (i, j) =
        Pi.π C₁ a₁ ≫ ι₁.hom := by
    simp only [coordinateCechOneTermIso, id_eq, Iso.trans_hom]
    rw [Category.assoc, hreindex₁, Pi.mapIso_hom_π]
  have hzero :
      (coordinateCechZeroTermIso k n M).hom ≫ Pi.π f₀ i ≫
          M.presheaf.map
            (homOfLE
              ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_left)).op =
        Pi.π C₀ a₀ ≫ ι₀.hom ≫
          M.presheaf.map
            (homOfLE
              ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_left)).op := by
    simp only [coordinateCechZeroTermIso, id_eq, Iso.trans_hom]
    rw [Category.assoc, hreindex₀, Pi.mapIso_hom_π_assoc]
  rw [hone, hzero]
  have hδ :
      (coordinateCechCosimplicialObject k n M).δ (1 : Fin 2) ≫ Pi.π C₁ a₁ =
        Pi.π C₀ (a₁ ∘ q) ≫
          M.presheaf.map
            (Pi.lift (P := ∏ᶜ fun t : Fin 2 ↦ coordinateCechCover k n (a₁ t))
              (fun t : Fin 1 ↦
                Pi.π (fun s : Fin 2 ↦ coordinateCechCover k n (a₁ s)) (q t))).op := by
    have hcech :
        (((Functor.rightOp
          (Limits.FormalCoproduct.mk _ (coordinateCechCover k n)).cech).map
            (SimplexCategory.δ (1 : Fin 2))).unop) =
          (Limits.FormalCoproduct.mk _ (coordinateCechCover k n)).mapPower q := by
      rfl
    change (Pi.lift _ ≫ Pi.π C₁ a₁) = _
    rw [Pi.lift_π]
    rw [hcech]
    rfl
  have hq : a₁ ∘ q = a₀ := by
    funext t
    fin_cases t
    simp [a₁, a₀, q]
  have pi_transport (x y : Fin 1 → Fin (n + 1)) (h : x = y) :
      Pi.π C₀ x ≫ eqToHom (congrArg C₀ h) = Pi.π C₀ y := by
    subst y
    simp
  have hπ := pi_transport (a₁ ∘ q) a₀ hq
  rw [← Category.assoc, hδ]
  rw [← hπ]
  have htransport :
      eqToHom (congrArg C₀ hq) =
        M.presheaf.map
          (eqToHom (congrArg
            (fun a : Fin 1 → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              op (∏ᶜ fun t : Fin 1 ↦ coordinateCechCover k n (a t))) hq)) := by
    dsimp only [C₀]
    rw [eqToHom_map]
  rw [htransport]
  dsimp only [ι₁, ι₀, Iso.symm, Functor.mapIso]
  simp only [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.exists_wFrame
statement: theorem exists_wFrame (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (x : X) : Nonempty (WFrame L x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin, hcard⟩ := hL
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := hqfin
  have hcover : IsOpenCover q.X := (Opens.coversTop_iff X q.X).mp q.coversTop
  have hxUnion : x ∈ ⋃ i, (q.X i : Set X) := by
    rw [hcover.iSup_set_eq_univ]
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxUnion
  letI : (q.generators i).IsFiniteType :=
    SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType i
  letI : Finite (q.generators i).I := inferInstance
  letI : Fintype (q.generators i).I := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have hcard' : Fintype.card (q.generators i).I = 1 := by
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
    exact hcard i
  letI : Unique (q.generators i).I :=
    (Fintype.card_eq_one_iff_nonempty_unique.mp hcard').some
  let eI : PUnit ≃ (q.generators i).I := Equiv.ofUnique PUnit _
  let eFree : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over (q.X i)) PUnit ≅
      SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over (q.X i)) (q.generators i).I :=
    (SheafOfModules.freeFunctor (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over (q.X i))).mapIso eI.toIso
  exact ⟨{ U := q.X i
           mem := hxi
           frame := eFree ≪≫ asIso (q.generators i).π }⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.wImage_preimage_ι_self
statement: theorem wImage_preimage_ι_self (U : X.Opens) : U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U) = U
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι, inf_eq_right]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.wRestrictUnitFrame_one
statement:
theorem wRestrictUnitFrame_one (d : WFrame L x) :
    (wRestrictUnitFrame d).hom.app (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U) (1 : Γ(d.U, d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)) =
      ((restrictAdjunction d.U.ι).unit.app L).app d.U (wFrameGen d)
proof:
:= by
  let m := (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op d.U)
    (1 : Γ(X, d.U))
  have hT : (↑((SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit).val.obj (op d.U)) : Type u) =
      ↑((SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit).val.obj
        (op (d.U.ι ''ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)))) := by
    rw [wImage_preimage_ι_self]
  have H : HEq ((wRestrictFrame d).hom.app (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U) (cast hT m)) (wFrameGen d) :=
    overFunctorEquiv_restrict_app_heq (le_refl d.U) d.globalFrame.hom m
  have e1 : (wRestrictUnitFrame d).hom.app (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U) (1 : Γ(d.U, d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)) =
      (wRestrictFrame d).hom.app (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)
        ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app
          (op (d.U.ι ''ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)))
          (1 : Γ(X, d.U.ι ''ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)))) := by
    simp only [wRestrictUnitFrame, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom,
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
    rw [restrictUnitIso_inv_one]
    rfl
  have ha : (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app
      (op (d.U.ι ''ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))) (1 : Γ(X, d.U.ι ''ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))) =
        cast hT m := by
    apply eq_of_heq
    refine (heq_of_opens_eq (P := fun O ↦ Γ(SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit, O))
      (fun O ↦ (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op O)
        (1 : Γ(X, O))) (wImage_preimage_ι_self d.U)).trans ?_
    exact (cast_heq hT m).symm
  rw [e1, ha, restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app]
  apply eq_of_heq
  exact H.trans (presheaf_map_heq L (wImage_preimage_ι_self d.U) _ (wFrameGen d)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.wPullbackUnitFrame_one
statement:
theorem wPullbackUnitFrame_one (d : WFrame L x) :
    (wPullbackUnitFrame f d).hom.app ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
        (1 : Γ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U : Scheme.{u}), (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))) =
      ((restrictAdjunction (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι).unit.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)).app
        (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U) (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app L).app d.U (wFrameGen d))
proof:
:= by
  have hK : (wPullbackUnitFrame f d).hom.app ((f ∣_ d.U) ⁻¹ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
      (1 : Γ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U : Scheme.{u}), (f ∣_ d.U) ⁻¹ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))) =
      (restrictPullbackIso f d.U L).hom.app ((f ∣_ d.U) ⁻¹ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f ∣_ d.U)).map (wRestrictUnitFrame d).hom).app
          ((f ∣_ d.U) ⁻¹ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
          ((pullbackUnitIso (f ∣_ d.U)).inv.app ((f ∣_ d.U) ⁻¹ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
            (1 : Γ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U : Scheme.{u}),
              (f ∣_ d.U) ⁻¹ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))))) := rfl
  have h1 := pullbackUnitIso_inv_one (f ∣_ d.U) (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)
  have h2 := pullback_map_unit (f ∣_ d.U) (wRestrictUnitFrame d).hom (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)
    (1 : Γ((d.U : Scheme.{u}), d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
  have h3 := wRestrictUnitFrame_one d
  have hsq := restrictPullbackIso_hom_unit f d.U L d.U (wFrameGen d)
  have hnat := app_presheaf_map (wPullbackUnitFrame f d).hom
    (eqToHom (preimage_morphismRestrict_eq f d.U d.U))
    (1 : Γ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U : Scheme.{u}), (f ∣_ d.U) ⁻¹ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)))
  rw [unit_presheaf_map_one] at hnat
  rw [hnat, hK, h1]
  erw [h2]
  rw [h3]
  exact hsq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.iso_cancel_aux
statement:
theorem iso_cancel_aux {C : Type*} [Category C] {A B A' B' : C} (a : A' ≅ A) (b : B' ≅ B)
    (R : A ⟶ B) : a.inv ≫ (a.hom ≫ R ≫ b.inv) ≫ b.hom = R
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.pullbackWFrame_globalFrame_hom
statement:
theorem pullbackWFrame_globalFrame_hom (d : WFrame L x) (y : Y)
    (hy : f y ∈ d.U) :
    (pullbackWFrame f d y hy).globalFrame.hom = (wPullbackGlobalFrame f d).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [LineBundleLocalData.globalFrame, pullbackWFrame, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom]
  exact Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.wHT
statement:
theorem wHT (U' : Y.Opens) :
    (↑((SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) PUnit).val.obj (op U')) : Type u) =
      ↑((SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) PUnit).val.obj
        (op (U'.ι ''ᵁ (U'.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U'))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [wImage_preimage_ι_self]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.wHq
statement:
theorem wHq (d : WFrame L x) :
    ((overFunctorEquiv (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)).app
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) PUnit)).inv ≫
      (overEquiv (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)).functor.map (wPullbackGlobalFrame f d).hom ≫
        ((overFunctorEquiv (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)).app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)).hom =
      (wPullbackRestrictFrame f d).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [wPullbackGlobalFrame, Functor.FullyFaithful.preimageIso_hom,
    Functor.FullyFaithful.map_preimage]
  exact iso_cancel_aux ((overFunctorEquiv (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)).app _)
    ((overFunctorEquiv (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)).app _) _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.wHH_gen
statement:
theorem wHH_gen {Y : Scheme.{u}} {M N : Y.Modules} (U : Y.Opens) (q : M.over U ⟶ N.over U)
    (m : ↑(M.val.obj (op U)))
    (hT : (↑(M.val.obj (op U)) : Type u) = ↑(M.val.obj (op (U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U))))) :
    HEq ((((overFunctorEquiv U).app M).inv ≫ (overEquiv U).functor.map q ≫
        ((overFunctorEquiv U).app N).hom).app (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U) (cast hT m))
      (q.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE (le_refl U)))) m)
proof:
:=
  overFunctorEquiv_restrict_app_heq (le_refl U) q m

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.wHH
statement:
theorem wHH (d : WFrame L x) :
    HEq ((((overFunctorEquiv (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)).app
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) PUnit)).inv ≫
      (overEquiv (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)).functor.map (wPullbackGlobalFrame f d).hom ≫
        ((overFunctorEquiv (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)).app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)).hom).app
          ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)) (cast (wHT (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)) (wGen (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))))
      ((wPullbackGlobalFrame f d).hom.val.app
        (op (Over.mk (homOfLE (le_refl (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))))) (wGen (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)))
proof:
:=
  by apply wHH_gen

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.wHH'
statement:
theorem wHH' (d : WFrame L x) (y : Y) (hy : f y ∈ d.U) :
    HEq ((wPullbackRestrictFrame f d).hom.app ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
        (cast (wHT (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)) (wGen (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))))
      (wFrameGen (WFrame.ofData (pullbackWFrame f d y hy)))
proof:
:= by
  refine (heq_of_eq (congrArg
    (fun φ ↦ Scheme.Modules.Hom.app φ ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
      (cast (wHT (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)) (wGen (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))))
    (wHq f d))).symm.trans ((wHH f d).trans ?_)
  unfold wFrameGen wGen
  rw [show (WFrame.ofData (pullbackWFrame f d y hy)).globalFrame.hom =
    (wPullbackGlobalFrame f d).hom from pullbackWFrame_globalFrame_hom f d y hy]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.wHa
statement:
theorem wHa (U' : Y.Opens) :
    (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app
      (op (U'.ι ''ᵁ (U'.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U'))) (1 : Γ(Y, U'.ι ''ᵁ (U'.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U'))) =
        cast (wHT U') (wGen U')
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_of_heq
  refine (heq_of_opens_eq (P := fun O ↦ Γ(SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) PUnit, O))
    (fun O ↦ (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op O)
      (1 : Γ(Y, O))) (wImage_preimage_ι_self U')).trans ?_
  exact (cast_heq (wHT U') (wGen U')).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.wHe1
statement:
theorem wHe1 (d : WFrame L x) :
    (wPullbackRestrictFrame f d).hom.app ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
      ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app
        (op ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ''ᵁ ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))))
        (1 : Γ(Y, (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ''ᵁ ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))))) =
      (wPullbackUnitFrame f d).hom.app ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
        (1 : Γ(((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U : Y.Opens) : Scheme.{u}),
          (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [wPullbackRestrictFrame, Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom,
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  have h1 := iso_hom_inv_app (S := Y)
    (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := Y.ringCatSheaf))
    ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ''ᵁ ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)))
    (1 : Γ(Y, (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ''ᵁ ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))))
  have h3 := restrictUnitIso_hom_one (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
  exact congrArg (fun z ↦ ConcreteCategory.hom (Hom.app (wPullbackUnitFrame f d).hom
    ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))) z)
    ((congrArg (fun z ↦ ConcreteCategory.hom (Hom.app (restrictUnitIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι).hom
      ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))) z) h1).trans h3)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.wFrameGen_pullbackWFrame
statement:
theorem wFrameGen_pullbackWFrame (d : WFrame L x) (y : Y) (hy : f y ∈ d.U) :
    wFrameGen (WFrame.ofData (pullbackWFrame f d y hy)) =
      ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app L).app d.U (wFrameGen d)
proof:
:= by
  have e1 := wHe1 f d
  rw [wHa, wPullbackUnitFrame_one, restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app] at e1
  apply eq_of_heq
  refine (wHH' f d y hy).symm.trans ((heq_of_eq e1).trans ?_)
  exact presheaf_map_heq _ (wImage_preimage_ι_self (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)) _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.wFrameSec_smul
statement:
theorem wFrameSec_smul (d : WFrame M x) (V : S.Opens) (hV : V ≤ d.U)
    (c : Γ(S, V)) : wFrameSec d V hV c = c • wFrameSec d V hV 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold wFrameSec
  have h1 : (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op V) c =
      c • (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op V)
        (1 : Γ(S, V)) := by
    have h := ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app
      (op V)).hom.map_smul c (1 : Γ(S, V))
    exact (congrArg (fun z ↦ (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app
      (op V) z) (show c = c * (1 : Γ(S, V)) from (mul_one c).symm)).trans h
  rw [h1]
  exact (d.globalFrame.hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV)))).hom.map_smul c _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.wFrameSec_one
statement:
theorem wFrameSec_one (d : WFrame M x) (V : S.Opens) (hV : V ≤ d.U) :
    wFrameSec d V hV 1 = M.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op (wFrameGen d)
proof:
:= by
  unfold wFrameSec wFrameGen
  have hn := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (d.globalFrame.hom.val.naturality
    (Over.homMk (homOfLE hV) : Over.mk (homOfLE hV) ⟶ Over.mk (homOfLE (le_refl d.U))).op)
    ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op d.U)
      (1 : Γ(S, d.U)))
  refine Eq.trans (congrArg (fun z ↦ (d.globalFrame.hom.val.app
    (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV)))) z) ?_) hn
  have h2 := app_presheaf_map (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)).inv
    (homOfLE hV) (1 : Γ(S, d.U))
  rw [unit_presheaf_map_one] at h2
  exact h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.WFrame.exists_coord
statement:
theorem WFrame.exists_coord (d : WFrame L x) (V : X.Opens) (hV : V ≤ d.U) (m : Γ(L, V)) :
    ∃ c : Γ(X, V), wFrameSec d V hV c = m
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).hom.val.app (op V)
    (d.globalFrame.inv.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV))) m), ?_⟩
  unfold wFrameSec
  have hi : ∀ m, d.globalFrame.hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV)))
      (d.globalFrame.inv.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV))) m) = m := fun m ↦
    congrArg (fun ψ ↦ ψ.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV))) m) d.globalFrame.inv_hom_id
  have hj : ∀ c : Γ(SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit, V),
      (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app
      (op V) ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).hom.val.app (op V) c) = c :=
    fun c ↦ C1Cap.iso_inv_hom_app (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)) V c
  rw [hj, hi]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.wCoord_spec
statement:
theorem wCoord_spec (d : WFrame L x) (s : Γ(L, ⊤)) :
    wFrameSec d d.U le_rfl (wCoord d s) = L.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op s
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (d.exists_coord d.U le_rfl (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op s))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.whitneyConv_of_splitPullback_E13
statement:
theorem whitneyConv_of_splitPullback_E13 {Y : Scheme.{u}} [Y.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian Y] (g : Y ⟶ X) [g.IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat g]
    (d : ℕ) (hd : PureRelDim g d) (hinj : Function.Injective (totalPull ops g d hd))
    {A B D : X.Modules} (hA : IsFiniteLocallyFree X A) (hB : IsFiniteLocallyFree X B)
    (hD : IsFiniteLocallyFree X D)
    (eB : (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj B ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj A ⊞ (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj D)
    (h : WhitneyConv (X := Y) (geometricChernAssign ops cp) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj A)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj A ⊞ (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj D)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj D)) :
    WhitneyConv (X := X) (geometricChernAssign ops cp) A B D
proof:
:=
  whitneyConv_descent ops (geometricChernAssign_isNatural ops cp) g d hd hinj hA hB hD
    (whitneyConv_of_iso_E9 ops (geometricChernAssign_isNatural ops cp) (Iso.refl _) eB.symm
      (Iso.refl _) h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.lineSubWhitney_of_torsor_E13
statement:
theorem lineSubWhitney_of_torsor_E13 (hT : SplittingTorsorGate ops) (hS : SplitLineWhitney ops cp) :
    LineSubWhitney ops cp
proof:
:= by
  intro Y _ _ _ L B D a b w hex hL hB hD
  obtain ⟨Z, _, _, _, g, _, _, d, hd, hinj, ⟨eB⟩⟩ := hT a b w hex hL hB hD
  exact whitneyConv_of_splitPullback_E13 ops cp g d hd hinj hL.isFiniteLocallyFree hB hD eB
    (hS (hasConstantRank_pullback Z g L 1 hL)
      (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global g D hD))

name: SchemeKTheory.hasConstantRank_free_type
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_free_type (X : Scheme.{u}) (I : Type u) [Finite I] :
    HasConstantRank X (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I) (Nat.card I)
proof:
:=
  ⟨(SheafOfModules.free.generatingSections (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I).localGeneratorsData,
    inferInstance, inferInstance, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.rankZeroNilpotent_space
statement:
theorem rankZeroNilpotent_space (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (n : ℕ)
    (hR : RankZeroNilpotent (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) :
    RankZeroNilpotent (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space R n)
proof:
:= by
  refine rankZeroNilpotent_of_iso (spaceIsoTrivialBundle R n) ?_
  have hE := hasConstantRank_free_type (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)))
  rw [Nat.card_ulift, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fin] at hE
  exact AffineFrameCover.rankZeroNilpotent_scheme _ (fun _ ↦ ⟨⟨0⟩⟩) n.succ_pos hE hR

name: SchemeKTheory.lambdaNilpotent_space
statement:
theorem lambdaNilpotent_space (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (n : ℕ)
    (hR : RankZeroNilpotent (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) :
    LambdaNilpotent (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space R n)
proof:
:=
  lambdaNilpotent_of_rankZeroNilpotent (rankZeroNilpotent_space R n hR)

name: SchemeKTheory.rankZeroNilpotent_space_of_isLocalRing
statement:
theorem rankZeroNilpotent_space_of_isLocalRing (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [IsLocalRing R] (n : ℕ) : RankZeroNilpotent (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space R n)
proof:
:=
  rankZeroNilpotent_space R n (rankZeroNilpotent_spec_of_isLocalRing R)

name: SchemeKTheory.lambdaNilpotent_space_of_isLocalRing
statement:
theorem lambdaNilpotent_space_of_isLocalRing (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [IsLocalRing R] (n : ℕ) : LambdaNilpotent (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space R n)
proof:

name: SchemeKTheory.pcl_linearEquiv
statement:
theorem pcl_linearEquiv {A B : Type u} [AddCommGroup A] [Module R A] [AddCommGroup B] [Module R B]
    [Module.Finite R A] [Module.Projective R A] [Module.Finite R B] [Module.Projective R B]
    (e : A ≃ₗ[R] B) : pcl R A = pcl R B
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso (ModuleCat.{u} R) (IsFGProj R) _ _
    (show IsFGProj R (ModuleCat.of R PUnit.{u + 1}) from ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩)
    (ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _) e.toModuleIso

name: SchemeKTheory.pcl_prod
statement:
theorem pcl_prod (A C : Type u) [AddCommGroup A] [Module R A] [AddCommGroup C] [Module R C]
    [Module.Finite R A] [Module.Projective R A] [Module.Finite R C] [Module.Projective R C] :
    pcl R (A × C) = pcl R A + pcl R C
proof:
:=
  pcl_ses (LinearMap.inl R _ _) (LinearMap.snd R _ _) LinearMap.inl_injective
    Function.Exact.inl_snd LinearMap.snd_surjective

name: SchemeKTheory.tildeK_pcl
statement:
theorem tildeK_pcl (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [Module.Projective R M] :
    tildeK R (pcl R M) =
      k0ClassOf (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) ((tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of R)).obj
        (ModuleCat.of R M)) (tilde_isFiniteLocallyFree R (ModuleCat.of R M))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tildeK, pcl, ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf, ExactGrothendieck.map_classOf]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.tildeK_pcl_self
statement: theorem tildeK_pcl_self : tildeK R (pcl R R) = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine (tildeK_pcl R R).trans ((k0ClassOf_iso _ _ (unit_isFiniteLocallyFree _)
    tildeSelf).trans ?_)
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.tildeK_pcl_pi_fin
statement:
theorem tildeK_pcl_pi_fin (m : ℕ) :
    tildeK R (pcl R (Fin m → R)) = (m : K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    have h0 : pcl R (Fin 0 → R) = 0 :=
      ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_isZero (ModuleCat.{u} R) (IsFGProj R) _
        (ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _)
    rw [h0, map_zero, Nat.cast_zero]
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [← pcl_linearEquiv R (Fin.consLinearEquiv R (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) ↦ R)), pcl_prod,
      map_add, tildeK_pcl_self, ih, Nat.cast_succ]
    exact add_comm _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.exists_eq_intCast_spec_of_free
statement:
theorem exists_eq_intCast_spec_of_free [Nontrivial R]
    (hfree : ∀ (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M]
      [Module.Projective R M], Module.Free R M)
    (a : K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) : ∃ k : ℤ, a = k
proof:
:= by
  refine k0_induction _ (fun a ↦ ∃ k : ℤ, a = k) ⟨0, Int.cast_zero.symm⟩ ?_ ?_ ?_ a
  · rintro a b ⟨k, rfl⟩ ⟨l, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨k + l, (Int.cast_add k l).symm⟩
  · rintro a ⟨k, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨-k, (Int.cast_neg k).symm⟩
  · intro E hE
    haveI : E.IsFinitePresentation := hE.isFinitePresentation
    haveI := finite_moduleSpecΓ R E
    haveI := projective_moduleSpecΓ_of_isFiniteLocallyFree R E hE
    let N := (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj E
    haveI := hfree N
    let b := Module.finBasis R N
    haveI : IsIso (Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓ (R := CommRingCat.of R) E) :=
      Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent (R := CommRingCat.of R) E
    refine ⟨Module.finrank R N, ?_⟩
    have h1 : k0ClassOf _ E hE = k0ClassOf _ ((tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of R)).obj N)
        (tilde_isFiniteLocallyFree R N) :=
      (k0ClassOf_iso _ _ hE (asIso (Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓ (R := CommRingCat.of R) E))).symm
    have h2 := k0ClassOf_iso _ (tilde_isFiniteLocallyFree R N)
      (tilde_isFiniteLocallyFree R (ModuleCat.of R (Fin (Module.finrank R N) → R)))
      ((tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of R)).mapIso b.equivFun.toModuleIso)
    rw [h1, h2, ← tildeK_pcl, tildeK_pcl_pi_fin, Int.cast_natCast]

name: SchemeKTheory.rankZeroNilpotent_spec_of_free
statement:
theorem rankZeroNilpotent_spec_of_free [Nontrivial R]
    (hfree : ∀ (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M]
      [Module.Projective R M], Module.Free R M) :
    RankZeroNilpotent (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_intCast_spec_of_free R hfree a
  obtain ⟨x⟩ : Nonempty (PrimeSpectrum R) := inferInstance
  have hk : k = 0 := by
    have := ha x
    rwa [map_intCast] at this
  rw [hk, Int.cast_zero]
  exact IsNilpotent.zero

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.pulledCosection_unit
statement:
theorem pulledCosection_unit {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) {E : X.Modules}
    (σ : E ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app E ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).map (pulledCosection g σ) =
    σ ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app (tensorUnitSheaf X) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).map (Chow.C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso g).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hn := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.naturality σ
  dsimp only [Functor.comp_map, Functor.id_map] at hn
  have hp := congrArg (fun f => f ≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).map (Chow.C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso g).hom) hn.symm
  simp only [pulledCosection, Functor.map_comp] at hp ⊢
  with_unfolding_all exact hp

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.pulledCosection_unit_structure
statement:
theorem pulledCosection_unit_structure {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) {E : X.Modules}
    (σ : E ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app E ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).map (pulledCosection g σ) =
    σ ≫ SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit g.toRingCatSheafHom
proof:
:= by
  rw [pulledCosection_unit]
  have hu := SheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction_homEquiv_pullbackObjUnitToUnit
    g.toRingCatSheafHom
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit] at hu
  change σ ≫ _ = σ ≫ _
  congr 1

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.pulledCosection_unit_app
statement:
theorem pulledCosection_unit_app {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) {E : X.Modules}
    (σ : E ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) (V : X.Opens) (x : Γ(E,V)) :
    (pulledCosection g σ).app (g ⁻¹ᵁ V)
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app E).app V x) =
      g.app V (σ.app V x)
proof:
:= by
  exact congrArg (fun f => f.app V x) (pulledCosection_unit_structure g σ)

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.pulledCosection_zeroIdeal_le_ker
statement:
theorem pulledCosection_zeroIdeal_le_ker :
    quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ ≤
      ((quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
        (pulledCosection g σ)).subschemeι ≫ g).ker
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_ofIdeals_iff.mpr
  intro U a ha
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := ha
  let P := (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E
  let τ := pulledCosection g σ
  let J := quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal Y P τ
  let y := ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app E).app U.1 x
  have hz := congrArg (fun f : P ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward J.subschemeι).obj
    (tensorUnitSheaf J.subscheme) => f.app (g ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) y)
    (cosectionConormal_structureMap_zero Y P τ)
  change J.subschemeι.app (g ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) (τ.app (g ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) y) = 0 at hz
  rw [pulledCosection_unit_app] at hz
  exact hz

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.scalarExtendedCosection_tmul
statement:
theorem scalarExtendedCosection_tmul (σ : M →ₗ[R] R) (a : S) (x : M) :
    scalarExtendedCosection (S := S) σ (a ⊗ₜ[R] x) = a * algebraMap R S (σ x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [scalarExtendedCosection, Algebra.smul_def, mul_comm]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.scalarExtendedCosection_image
statement:
theorem scalarExtendedCosection_image (σ : M →ₗ[R] R) :
    cosectionImageIdeal (scalarExtendedCosection (S := S) σ) =
      (cosectionImageIdeal σ).map (algebraMap R S)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
    induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simpa using (Ideal.zero_mem ((cosectionImageIdeal σ).map (algebraMap R S)))
    | tmul a x =>
      rw [scalarExtendedCosection_tmul]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ a (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ⟨x, rfl⟩)
    | add x y hx hy => simpa only [map_add] using Ideal.add_mem _ hx hy
  · rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    change algebraMap R S (σ x) ∈ cosectionImageIdeal (scalarExtendedCosection (S := S) σ)
    exact ⟨1 ⊗ₜ[R] x, by rw [scalarExtendedCosection_tmul, one_mul]⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.scalarExtendedZeroRingMap_projection
statement:

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.scalarExtendedZeroRing_isPushout
statement:
theorem scalarExtendedZeroRing_isPushout (σ : M →ₗ[R] R) :
    IsPushout (CommRingCat.ofHom (cosectionZeroQuotient σ))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)) (CommRingCat.ofHom (scalarExtendedZeroRingMap (S := S) σ))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (cosectionZeroQuotient (scalarExtendedCosection (S := S) σ)))
proof:
:= by
  apply IsPushout.flip
  refine SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineDeformationSpace.isPushout_of_surjective _ _ _ _ rfl Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective ?_
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_ofHom, cosectionZeroQuotient, Ideal.mk_ker]
  exact (scalarExtendedCosection_image (S := S) σ).le

statement:

      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (cosectionZeroQuotient (scalarExtendedCosection (S := S) σ))))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (cosectionZeroQuotient σ)))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))
proof:
:=
  isPullback_SpecMap_of_isPushout _ _ _ _ (scalarExtendedZeroRing_isPushout (S := S) σ)

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.scalarExtendedCotangentMap_generator
statement:
theorem scalarExtendedCotangentMap_generator (σ : M →ₗ[R] R) (x : M) :
    scalarExtendedCotangentMap (S := S) σ
      (cosectionTensorCotangentMap σ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] x)) =
    cosectionTensorCotangentMap (scalarExtendedCosection (S := S) σ)
      (1 ⊗ₜ[S] (1 ⊗ₜ[R] x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [cosectionTensorCotangentMap_one_tmul, cosectionTensorCotangentMap_one_tmul]
  change Ideal.mapCotangent _ _ (Algebra.ofId R S) _
    ((cosectionImageIdeal σ).toCotangent (cosectionImageFactor σ x)) = _
  rw [Ideal.mapCotangent_toCotangent]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  change algebraMap R S (σ x) = scalarExtendedCosection (S := S) σ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] x)
  exact ((scalarExtendedCosection_tmul (S := S) σ 1 x).trans (one_mul _)).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.weaklyRegular_scalarExtension
statement:

proof:

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.scalarExtendedCosection_basis_weaklyRegular
statement:
theorem scalarExtendedCosection_basis_weaklyRegular [Module.Flat R S] {n : ℕ}
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin n) R M) (σ : M →ₗ[R] R)

statement:

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingTransportedHigherDifferential_contraction
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingTransportedHigherDifferential_contraction (d : ℤ)
    (hd : -(n : ℤ) ≤ d) (p : ℕ)
    (x : coordinateCechHigherTerm k n (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) (p + 1)) :
    coordinateCechTwistingTransportedHigherDifferential k n d p
          (coordinateCechTwistingTransportedHigherContraction k n d hd p x) +
        coordinateCechTwistingTransportedHigherContraction k n d hd (p + 1)
          (coordinateCechTwistingTransportedHigherDifferential k n d (p + 1) x) =
      x
proof:
:= by
  apply (coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv k n d (p + 1)).injective
  simpa only [map_add,
    coordinateCechTwistingTransportedHigherDifferential_toLaurent,
    coordinateCechTwistingTransportedHigherContraction_toLaurent] using

      (coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv k n d (p + 1) x)

  have h := coordinateCechTwistingTransportedHigherDifferential_contraction
    k n d hd p x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E21.capDivisorGate_of_cycleIdentity
statement:
theorem capDivisorGate_of_cycleIdentity {B D : X.Modules} {b : B ⟶ D} (P : PairCover b)
    {L : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) {e : ℕ}
    (hCB : ∀ i, Nat.card (P.toB.basisIndex i) = e + 1 + 1)
    (hCD : ∀ i, Nat.card (P.toD.basisIndex i) = e + 1)
    (hI : CartierCycleIdentity (k := k) P hL (cp.projBundle_relDim P.toB hCB)
      (cp.projBundle_relDim P.toD hCD)) :
    E16.CapDivisorGate ops cp P hL hCB hCD
proof:
:= by
  intro β
  have hlin : totalPush ops P.jHom ∘ₗ E15.pullProj ops cp P.toD hCD =
      totalCap ops (E16.twistedLine P.toB L) (E16.hasConstantRank_twistedLine P.toB hL) ∘ₗ
        E15.pullProj ops cp P.toB hCB := by
    apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
    intro n
    apply D13.ratLinear_ext
    intro Z
    have h1 := hI n Z
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, E15.pullProj, totalPull, DirectSum.toModule_lof,
      totalPush, totalCap]
    rw [D2.pull_eq_pullD2, D2.pull_eq_pullD2, D2.pullD2_mk, D2.pullD2_mk,
      D9.push_eq_pushD9, D9.pushD9_mk0]
    change _ = capComponent ops (E16.twistedLine P.toB L)
      (E16.hasConstantRank_twistedLine P.toB hL) (n + e + 1) _
    simp only [capComponent, LinearMap.comp_apply]
    rw [D13.cap_anchor (k := k) ops]
    exact congrArg (fun c : DimChow P.toB.scheme (n + e) =>
      DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n => RationalDimChow P.toB.scheme n) (n + e)
        ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] c)) h1
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun hlin β

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E21.cartierCycleIdentity_of_primeFibreIdentity
proof:
:= by
  intro m Z
  let φ1 : dimensionCycles X m →+ DimChow P.toB.scheme (m + e) :=
    (D13.mkHom P.toB.scheme (m + e)).comp (pushPullHom (k := k) P hdD m)
  let φ2 : dimensionCycles X m →+ DimChow P.toB.scheme (m + e) :=
    (D5.capCycles (k := k) (E16.twistedLine P.toB L)
        (E16.hasConstantRank_twistedLine P.toB hL) (m + e)).comp (capPullHom P hdB m)
  have key : Z ∈ AddMonoidHom.eqLocus φ1 φ2 := by
    refine D13.dimCycle_mem_of_prime _ (fun v hv ↦ ?_) Z
    obtain ⟨w, hw, q, hq, hB, hD, hcap⟩ := hP m v hv
    change φ1 _ = φ2 _
    have e1 : pushPullCycle (k := k) P hdD (dimPrimeCycle v m hv) = pushPrimeCycle (k := k) P q hq := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change properPushforward P.jHom (flatPullback P.toD.toBase (dimPrimeCycle v m hv).1) = _
      rw [hD]
      rfl
    have e2 : capPullCycle P hdB (dimPrimeCycle v m hv) = dimPrimeCycle w _ hw := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact hB
    change (QuotientAddGroup.mk (pushPullCycle (k := k) P hdD (dimPrimeCycle v m hv)) :
        DimChow P.toB.scheme (m + e)) =
      D5.capCycles (k := k) (E16.twistedLine P.toB L)
        (E16.hasConstantRank_twistedLine P.toB hL) (m + e)
          (capPullCycle P hdB (dimPrimeCycle v m hv))
    rw [e1, e2, D5.capCycles_dimPrimeCycle, hcap]
  exact key

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E21.flatPullback_prime_eq_prime_of_flag
statement:
theorem flatPullback_prime_eq_prime_of_flag {d : ℕ}
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = d + 1)
    (hd : PureRelDim C.toBase d) (m : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = m) :
    ∃ (w : C.scheme) (hw : height w = ((m + d : ℕ) : ℕ∞)),
      flatPullback C.toBase (dimPrimeCycle v m hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle w (m + d) hw).1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F⟩ := m7geo_flag_exists C hC v
  have hw : height (F.w 0) = ((m + d : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [hd (F.w 0) (by rw [F.coeff_zero]; exact one_ne_zero), F.base 0, hv]
    push_cast
    rfl
  refine ⟨F.w 0, hw, ?_⟩
  ext x
  rw [flatPullback_apply, m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply, m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply]
  by_cases hx : x = F.w 0
  · subst hx
    simp [F.base 0, F.coeff_zero]
  · rw [if_neg hx]
    by_cases hπ : C.toBase x = v
    · have h0 : flatPullbackCoeff C.toBase x = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hx (F.coeff_unique x hπ hne)
      simp [h0]
    · simp [hπ]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E21.fibreGate_holds
proof:
:= by
  intro m v hv
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hwB⟩ :=
    flatPullback_prime_eq_prime_of_flag (k := k) P.toB hCB (cp.projBundle_relDim P.toB hCB) m v hv
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqD⟩ :=
    flatPullback_prime_eq_prime_of_flag (k := k) P.toD hCD (cp.projBundle_relDim P.toD hCD) m v hv
  exact ⟨w, hw, q, hq, hwB, hqD⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E21.cartierCapGate_of_divisorGate
proof:
:= by
  intro σ hreg hid
  refine capDivisorGate_of_cycleIdentity ops cp P hL hCB hCD ?_
  refine cartierCycleIdentity_of_primeFibreIdentity P hL _ _ ?_
  intro m v hv
  obtain ⟨w, hw, q, hq, hB, hD⟩ := fibreGate_holds ops cp P hCB hCD m v hv
  exact ⟨w, hw, q, hq, hB, hD, hW σ hreg hid m v hv w hw q hq hB hD⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E21.pp_prime_apply
statement:
theorem pp_prime_apply {V W : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian V] (j : V ⟶ W) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    (q : V) (n : ℕ) (hq : height q = n) (y : W) :
    properPushforward j (dimPrimeCycle q n hq).1 y = if y = j q then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hr : y ∈ Set.range j
  · obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hr
    rw [pp_apply_image, m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply]
    by_cases hx : x = q
    · subst hx; simp
    · rw [if_neg hx, if_neg]
      intro h
      exact hx (j.isEmbedding.injective h)
  · rw [pp_apply_notRange j _ y hr, if_neg]
    rintro rfl
    exact hr ⟨q, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E21.divisorGate_of_weilGate
proof:
:= by
  intro σ hreg hid m v hv w hw q hq hB hD
  obtain ⟨hjq, b₀, bf, hcoef⟩ := hW σ hreg hid m v hv w hw q hq hB hD
  refine D5.primeCap_eq_mk (k := k) _ _ (m + e) w hw bf (pushPrimeCycle (k := k) P q hq) ?_
  ext y
  change properPushforward P.jHom (dimPrimeCycle q _ hq).1 y = _
  rw [pp_prime_apply]
  by_cases hy : y ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι w)
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [pp_apply_image]
    exact (hcoef z).symm
  · rw [pp_apply_notRange _ _ y hy, if_neg]
    rintro rfl
    exact hy hjq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E21.cartierCapGate_of_weilGate
statement:
theorem cartierCapGate_of_weilGate {B D : X.Modules} {b : B ⟶ D} (P : PairCover b)
    {L : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) {e : ℕ}
    (hCB : ∀ i, Nat.card (P.toB.basisIndex i) = e + 1 + 1)
    (hCD : ∀ i, Nat.card (P.toD.basisIndex i) = e + 1)
    (hW : WeilGate P hL e) : E16.CartierCapGate ops cp P hL hCB hCD
proof:
:=
  cartierCapGate_of_divisorGate ops cp P hL hCB hCD (divisorGate_of_weilGate P hL e hW)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.V4FIX.comm_of_mem_adjoin
proof:
:= by
