name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.V4FIX.chernOpOn'_zero_comm
statement:
theorem chernOpOn'_zero_comm {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (Cl X)] (E : X.Modules)
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E 0) (i : ℕ) (T : Module.End ℚ (TotalChow X)) :
    chernOpOn' ops cp hP E 0 hE i * T = T * chernOpOn' ops cp hP E 0 hE i
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i = 0 <;> simp [chernOpOn', hi]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.V4FIX.isNaturalCharOn_of_flatNaturalOn
statement:
theorem isNaturalCharOn_of_flatNaturalOn
    (hnat : FlatNaturalOn ops (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP)) :
    IsNaturalCharOn ops (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP)
proof:
:=
  ⟨hnat, by
    intro X _ _ _ _ _ E E' h
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := h
    exact constRankChernAssignOn'_iso ops cp hP e⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.V4FIX.chernOpOn'_comm_lines
statement:
theorem chernOpOn'_comm_lines (L M : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1) (i j : ℕ) :
    chernOpOn' ops cp hP L 1 hL i * chernOpOn' ops cp hP M 1 hM j =
      chernOpOn' ops cp hP M 1 hM j * chernOpOn' ops cp hP L 1 hL i
proof:
:= by
  have hc := cp.cap_comm L M hL hM
  rw [chernOpOn'_line_series ops cp hP L hL, chernOpOn'_line_series ops cp hP M hM]
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0 <;> by_cases hi1 : i = 1 <;> by_cases hj0 : j = 0 <;>
    by_cases hj1 : j = 1 <;> simp [hi0, hi1, hj0, hj1]
  all_goals exact hc

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.V4FIX.chernAssign_pullback_mem_adjoin
statement:
theorem chernAssign_pullback_mem_adjoin {E : X.Modules} {e : ℕ} (S : ChowSplittingOn ops E e)
    (n : ℕ) :
    constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP S.Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj E) n ∈
      Algebra.adjoin ℚ (Set.range fun j ↦ totalCapOn ops (S.L j) (S.L_line j))
proof:
:= by
  have hφ := isNaturalCharOn_of_flatNaturalOn ops cp hP hnat
  have hline : ∀ j n, constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP S.Y (S.L j) n ∈
      Algebra.adjoin ℚ (Set.range fun j ↦ totalCapOn ops (S.L j) (S.L_line j)) := by
    intro j n
    rw [constRankChernAssignOn'_eq ops cp hP (S.L j) 1 (S.L_line j),
      chernOpOn'_line_series ops cp hP (S.L j) (S.L_line j)]
    by_cases h0 : n = 0
    · simp only [h0, if_true]
      exact Subalgebra.one_mem _
    · by_cases h1 : n = 1
      · simp only [h1, if_true, one_ne_zero, if_false]
        exact Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨j, rfl⟩
      · simp only [h0, h1, if_false]
        exact Subalgebra.zero_mem _
  have hF : ∀ i, i ≤ e → ∀ n, constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP S.Y (S.F i) n ∈
      Algebra.adjoin ℚ (Set.range fun j ↦ totalCapOn ops (S.L j) (S.L_line j)) := by
    intro i
    induction i with
    | zero =>
      intro _ n
      obtain ⟨e0⟩ := S.base
      rw [constRankChernAssignOn'_iso ops cp hP e0]
      exact hline 0 n
    | succ i ih =>
      intro hi n
      obtain ⟨a, b, w, h⟩ := S.step i (Nat.lt_of_succ_le hi)
      have W := whitneyOn_flag_of_lineSubOn ops hφ H S i (Nat.le_of_succ_le hi) a b w h
        (S.F_vb (i + 1)) (S.L_line (i + 1)).isFiniteLocallyFree n
      rw [W]
      exact Subalgebra.sum_mem _ fun p _ ↦
        Subalgebra.mul_mem _ (ih (Nat.le_of_succ_le hi) p.1) (hline (i + 1) p.2)
  obtain ⟨t⟩ := S.top
  rw [constRankChernAssignOn'_iso ops cp hP t.symm]
  exact hF e le_rfl n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.V4FIX.cap_comm_chernOpOn'
statement:
theorem cap_comm_chernOpOn' (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (G : X.Modules)
    (r : ℕ) (hG : HasConstantRank X G r) (m : ℕ) :
    totalCapOn ops L hL * chernOpOn' ops cp hP G r hG m =
      chernOpOn' ops cp hP G r hG m * totalCapOn ops L hL
proof:
:= by
  cases r with
  | zero => exact (chernOpOn'_zero_comm ops cp hP G hG m _).symm
  | succ e =>
    obtain ⟨S⟩ := exists_chowSplittingOn ops cp hP e G hG
    have hGq := hasConstantRank_pullback S.Y S.q G (e + 1) hG
    have hmem := chernAssign_pullback_mem_adjoin ops cp hP hnat H S m
    rw [constRankChernAssignOn'_eq ops cp hP _ (e + 1) hGq] at hmem
    have hcomm := comm_of_mem_adjoin (fun j ↦ totalCapOn ops (S.L j) (S.L_line j))
      (totalCapOn ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback S.Y S.q L 1 hL))
      (fun j ↦ cp.cap_comm _ _ _ _) hmem
    have h1 := cp.cap_pull S.q S.d S.hd L hL
    have h2 := chernOpOn'_pull_flat S.q ops cp S.d S.hd hP G (e + 1) hG m
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro α
    apply S.injective
    have e1 := LinearMap.congr_fun h1 (chernOpOn' ops cp hP G (e + 1) hG m α)
    have e2 := LinearMap.congr_fun h2 α
    have e3 := LinearMap.congr_fun h2 (totalCapOn ops L hL α)
    have e4 := LinearMap.congr_fun h1 α
    have e5 := LinearMap.congr_fun hcomm (totalPullOn ops S.q S.d S.hd α)
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at e1 e2 e3 e4
    simp only [Module.End.mul_apply] at e5 ⊢
    rw [e1, e2, e3, e4]
    exact e5

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.V4FIX.chernOpOn'_comm
statement:
theorem chernOpOn'_comm (E F : X.Modules) (e f : ℕ) (hE : HasConstantRank X E e)
    (hF : HasConstantRank X F f) (i j : ℕ) :
    chernOpOn' ops cp hP E e hE i * chernOpOn' ops cp hP F f hF j =
      chernOpOn' ops cp hP F f hF j * chernOpOn' ops cp hP E e hE i
proof:
:= by
  cases e with
  | zero => exact (chernOpOn'_zero_comm ops cp hP E hE i _)
  | succ e =>
    obtain ⟨S⟩ := exists_chowSplittingOn ops cp hP e E hE
    have hEq := hasConstantRank_pullback S.Y S.q E (e + 1) hE
    have hFq := hasConstantRank_pullback S.Y S.q F f hF
    have hmem := chernAssign_pullback_mem_adjoin ops cp hP hnat H S i
    rw [constRankChernAssignOn'_eq ops cp hP _ (e + 1) hEq] at hmem
    have hcomm := comm_of_mem_adjoin (fun j ↦ totalCapOn ops (S.L j) (S.L_line j))
      (chernOpOn' ops cp hP ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj F) f hFq j)
      (fun t ↦ (cap_comm_chernOpOn' ops cp hP hnat H (S.L t) (S.L_line t) _ f hFq j).symm) hmem
    have h1 := chernOpOn'_pull_flat S.q ops cp S.d S.hd hP E (e + 1) hE i
    have h2 := chernOpOn'_pull_flat S.q ops cp S.d S.hd hP F f hF j
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro α
    apply S.injective
    have e1 := LinearMap.congr_fun h1 (chernOpOn' ops cp hP F f hF j α)
    have e2 := LinearMap.congr_fun h2 α
    have e3 := LinearMap.congr_fun h2 (chernOpOn' ops cp hP E (e + 1) hE i α)
    have e4 := LinearMap.congr_fun h1 α
    have e5 := LinearMap.congr_fun hcomm (totalPullOn ops S.q S.d S.hd α)
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at e1 e2 e3 e4
    simp only [Module.End.mul_apply] at e5 ⊢
    rw [e1, e2, e3, e4]
    exact e5.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.V4FIX.chernOpOn'_comm_projectiveIntegral
statement:
theorem chernOpOn'_comm_projectiveIntegral [Infinite k]
    (hD31 : ∀ {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)]
      [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X)] {E : X.Modules}
      (C : AffineFrameCover X E), ∃ (N : ℕ) (j : C.scheme ⟶ space k N), IsClosedImmersion j)
    (H : LineSubWhitneyOn (constRankChernAssignOn' (chowOpsOn_projectiveIntegral k)
      (chowCompatOn_projectiveIntegral k) (projBundleClosedPos_of_closedImmersion hD31)))
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X]
    [Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X)] (E F : X.Modules) (e f : ℕ) (hE : HasConstantRank X E e)
    (hF : HasConstantRank X F f) (i j : ℕ) :
    chernOpOn' (chowOpsOn_projectiveIntegral k) (chowCompatOn_projectiveIntegral k)
        (projBundleClosedPos_of_closedImmersion hD31) E e hE i *
      chernOpOn' (chowOpsOn_projectiveIntegral k) (chowCompatOn_projectiveIntegral k)
        (projBundleClosedPos_of_closedImmersion hD31) F f hF j =
    chernOpOn' (chowOpsOn_projectiveIntegral k) (chowCompatOn_projectiveIntegral k)
        (projBundleClosedPos_of_closedImmersion hD31) F f hF j *
      chernOpOn' (chowOpsOn_projectiveIntegral k) (chowCompatOn_projectiveIntegral k)
        (projBundleClosedPos_of_closedImmersion hD31) E e hE i
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIntegral X := (Fact.out : ProjectiveIntegral k X).1
  have hconn : ∀ {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)]
      [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X)], PreconnectedSpace X := by
    intro X _ _ _ hX
    haveI : IsIntegral X := hX.out.1
    infer_instance
  exact chernOpOn'_comm _ _ _
    (flatNaturalOn_constRankChernAssignOn' _ _ _ hconn) H E F e f hE hF i j

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D15.fnMap_algebraMap
statement:
theorem fnMap_algebraMap (hp : p (genericPoint Z') = genericPoint Z) (V : Z.Opens)
    [Nonempty V] [Nonempty (p ⁻¹ᵁ V)] (s : Γ(Z, V)) :
    Z'.germToFunctionField (p ⁻¹ᵁ V) (p.app V s) =
      fnMap p hp (Z.germToFunctionField V s)
proof:
:= by
  have hηV : genericPoint Z ∈ V :=
    ((genericPoint_spec Z).mem_open_set_iff V.isOpen).mpr (by simpa using ‹Nonempty V›)
  have hx : p (genericPoint Z') ∈ V := by rw [hp]; exact hηV
  have h1 : Z.germToFunctionField V s = Z.presheaf.germ V (genericPoint Z) hηV s := rfl
  have h2 : Z'.germToFunctionField (p ⁻¹ᵁ V) (p.app V s) =
      Z'.presheaf.germ (p ⁻¹ᵁ V) (genericPoint Z') hx (p.app V s) := rfl
  rw [h2, h1, ← Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply]
  unfold fnMap
  rw [RingHom.comp_apply]
  congr 1
  have := TopCat.Presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes Z.presheaf hηV (specializes_of_eq hp)
  exact (congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom s) this).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D15.pointClosureIdeal_le_map
statement:
theorem pointClosureIdeal_le_map (ξ : X) (v : Y) (h : f ξ = v) :
    pointClosureIdeal v ≤ (pointClosureIdeal ξ).map f
proof:
:= by
  unfold pointClosureIdeal
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.map_vanishingIdeal]
  apply Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal_antimono
  rw [TopologicalSpace.Closeds.closure_le]
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hy
  have : f x ∈ closure {f ξ} := by
    have := (specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp ((specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr hx : ξ ⤳ x).map f.continuous))
    exact this
  rw [h] at this
  exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D15.closureMap_ι
statement:
theorem closureMap_ι (ξ : X) (v : Y) (h : f ξ = v) :
    closureMap f ξ v h ≫ pointClosureι v = pointClosureι ξ ≫ f
proof:
:=
  Scheme.IdealSheafData.subschemeMap_subschemeι _ _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D15.closureMap_generic
statement:
theorem closureMap_generic (ξ : X) (v : Y) (h : f ξ = v) :
    closureMap f ξ v h (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme ξ)) =
      genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v)
proof:
:= by
  apply (pointClosureι v).isEmbedding.injective
  have h1 := congrArg (fun φ => φ (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme ξ))) (closureMap_ι f ξ v h)
  simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at h1
  rw [h1]
  change f (pointClosureι ξ (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme ξ))) = _
  rw [f17_pc_generic, f17_pc_generic, h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D15.fnMap_closureMap
statement:
theorem fnMap_closureMap (n : ℕ) (ξ : X) (v : Y) (h : f ξ = v) (hv : height v = n + 1) :
    fnMap (closureMap f ξ v h) (closureMap_generic f ξ v h) =
      f17Φ (f := f) (g := genGen (k := k) n v hv 1 one_ne_zero)
        (h.trans (f17_pc_generic v).symm)
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro a
  obtain ⟨a0, rfl⟩ := f17σ₀_surjective (f := f) (g := genGen (k := k) n v hv 1 one_ne_zero)
    (h.trans (f17_pc_generic v).symm) a
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (f17Φ_σ₀ (f := f) (g := genGen (k := k) n v hv 1 one_ne_zero)
    (h.trans (f17_pc_generic v).symm) a0).symm
  obtain ⟨U, hx, s, rfl⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.exists_germ_eq Y.presheaf a0
  unfold f17σ₀ f17τ₀ fnMap
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
  have hE : f (pointClosureι ξ (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme ξ))) =
      pointClosureι v (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v)) := by
    rw [f17_pc_generic, h, f17_pc_generic]
  have hηU : pointClosureι v (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v)) ∈ U := hE ▸ hx
  rw [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes_apply Y.presheaf hx]
  change (Scheme.Hom.stalkMap (closureMap f ξ v h) _).hom
    ((((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalkSpecializes _).hom
      ((Scheme.Hom.stalkMap (pointClosureι v) (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v))).hom
        ((Y.presheaf.germ U (pointClosureι v (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v))) _) s)))) = _
  rw [Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply (pointClosureι v) U _ hηU s,
    TopCat.Presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes_apply (pointClosureScheme v).presheaf _,
    Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply (closureMap f ξ v h) _ _ _,
    Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply f U _ hx s,
    Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply (pointClosureι ξ) _ _ _]
  have hc := congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom s)
    (Scheme.Hom.congr_app (closureMap_ι f ξ v h) U)
  refine (congrArg (fun t => (pointClosureScheme ξ).presheaf.germ _
    (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme ξ)) _ t) hc).trans ?_
  exact TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ _ _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D15.rtf_pullbackFrame
statement:
theorem rtf_pullbackFrame (hp : p (genericPoint Z') = genericPoint Z) {M : Z.Modules} {x x' : Z}
    (b : LineBundleLocalData Z M x) (d : LineBundleLocalData Z M x') (y y' : Z')
    (hy : p y ∈ b.U) (hy' : p y' ∈ d.U) :
    (C1Cap.pullbackFrame p b y hy).regularTransitionFunction
        (C1Cap.pullbackFrame p d y' hy') =
      fnMap p hp (b.regularTransitionFunction d)
proof:
:= by
  unfold LineBundleLocalData.regularTransitionFunction
  rw [C1Cap.transitionSection_pullbackFrame p b d y y' hy hy']
  haveI : Nonempty (p ⁻¹ᵁ (b.U ⊓ d.U)) :=
    ⟨⟨genericPoint Z', by
      change p (genericPoint Z') ∈ b.U ⊓ d.U
      rw [hp]; exact ⟨b.genericPoint_mem, d.genericPoint_mem⟩⟩⟩
  exact fnMap_algebraMap p hp (b.U ⊓ d.U) _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D15.pf_U
statement:
theorem pf_U (ξ : X) (v : Y) (h : f ξ = v) {x : pointClosureScheme v}
    (b : LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme v)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj L) x)
    (y : pointClosureScheme ξ) (hy : closureMap f ξ v h y ∈ b.U) :
    (pf f L ξ v h b y hy).U = closureMap f ξ v h ⁻¹ᵁ b.U
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D15.pf_rtf
statement:
theorem pf_rtf (ξ : X) (v : Y) (h : f ξ = v) {x x' : pointClosureScheme v}
    (b : LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme v)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj L) x)
    (d : LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme v)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj L) x')
    (y y' : pointClosureScheme ξ) (hy : closureMap f ξ v h y ∈ b.U)
    (hy' : closureMap f ξ v h y' ∈ d.U) :
    (pf f L ξ v h b y hy).regularTransitionFunction (pf f L ξ v h d y' hy') =
      fnMap (closureMap f ξ v h) (closureMap_generic f ξ v h) (b.regularTransitionFunction d)
proof:
:= by
  unfold pf
  rw [LineBundleLocalData.regularTransitionFunction_mapIso]
  exact rtf_pullbackFrame _ _ b d y y' hy hy'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D15.coeff_pf
statement:
theorem coeff_pf (ξ : X) (v : Y) (h : f ξ = v) {x x' : pointClosureScheme v}
    (b : LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme v)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj L) x)
    (d : LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme v)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj L) x')
    (z : pointClosureScheme ξ) (hz : closureMap f ξ v h z ∈ d.U) :
    lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame
      (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) ξ)
      (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) ξ) (pfGen f L ξ v h b) z =
      (pointClosureScheme ξ).ord (fnMap (closureMap f ξ v h) (closureMap_generic f ξ v h)
        (b.regularTransitionFunction d)) z
proof:
:= by
  rw [lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame_eq_on_localData
    (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) ξ)
    (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) ξ) (pfGen f L ξ v h b)
    (pf f L ξ v h d z hz) z hz]
  unfold pfGen
  exact congrArg (fun t => (pointClosureScheme ξ).ord t z)
    (pf_rtf (k := k) f L ξ v h b d (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme ξ)) z
      (by rw [closureMap_generic]; exact b.genericPoint_mem) hz)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D15.xiEq
statement:
theorem xiEq (n : ℕ) (v : Y) (hv : height v = n + 1)
    (ξ : {ξ // ξ ∈ (f17Ξ_finite f (genGen (k := k) n v hv 1 one_ne_zero)).toFinset}) :
    f ξ.1 = v
proof:
:=
  (((f17Ξ_finite f (genGen (k := k) n v hv 1 one_ne_zero)).mem_toFinset.mp ξ.2).1).trans
    (f17_pc_generic v)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D15.flatPullback_primeCycle_pointwise
statement:
theorem flatPullback_primeCycle_pointwise (n : ℕ) (v : Y) (hv : height v = n + 1)
    {x₀ : pointClosureScheme v}
    (b : LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme v)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj L) x₀) (x : X) :
    flatPullback f (properPushforward (pointClosureι v)
      (lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL v)
        (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one L hL v) b).1) x =
    ∑ ξ ∈ (f17Ξ_finite f (genGen (k := k) n v hv 1 one_ne_zero)).toFinset.attach,
      (flatPullbackCoeff f ξ.1 : ℤ) *
        properPushforward (pointClosureι ξ.1)
          (lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame
            (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
              (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) ξ.1)
            (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
              (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) ξ.1)
            (pfGen f L ξ.1 v (xiEq (k := k) f n v hv ξ) b)).1 x
proof:
:= by
  set hfin := f17Ξ_finite f (genGen (k := k) n v hv 1 one_ne_zero) with hfindef
  rw [flatPullback_apply]
  by_cases hrange : f x ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι v)
  swap
  · have h0 : properPushforward (pointClosureι v)
        (lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL v)
          (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one L hL v) b).1 (f x) = 0 := by
      unfold properPushforward
      exact pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range _ _ _ _ _ hrange
    rw [h0, zero_mul]
    symm
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro ξ _
    have : ¬ ξ.1 ⤳ x := fun hs ↦ hrange (f17_range (g := genGen (k := k) n v hv 1 one_ne_zero)
      (hfin.mem_toFinset.mp ξ.2).1 hs)
    rw [f17_pc_apply_eq_zero this, mul_zero]
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hrange
  obtain ⟨d⟩ := Scheme.Modules.exists_lineBundleLocalDataAt (pointClosureScheme v)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj L)
    (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL v)
    (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one L hL v) w
  set h := b.regularTransitionFunction d with hh
  have hne : h ≠ 0 := b.regularTransitionFunction_ne_zero d
  set g := genGen (k := k) n v hv h hne with hgdef
  have hH : height (f17η g) = n + 1 := by
    change height (pointClosureι v (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v))) = _
    rw [f17_pc_generic]; exact hv
  have main := f17_pointwise_pos (f := f) (g := g) (dimensionCatenary_of_finiteType k) hd hH x
  rw [flatPullback_apply] at main
  have e1 : properPushforward (pointClosureι v)
      (lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL v)
        (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one L hL v) b).1 (f x) = AlgebraicGeometry.div h w := by
    rw [← hw, f17_pc_apply, lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame_apply,
      lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame_eq_on_localData
        (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL v)
        (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one L hL v) b d w d.mem, div_eq_ord]
  have e2 : properPushforward (pointClosureι v) (AlgebraicGeometry.div h) (f x) =
      AlgebraicGeometry.div h w := by
    rw [← hw]; exact f17_pc_apply _ w
  rw [e1]
  change properPushforward (pointClosureι v) (AlgebraicGeometry.div h) (f x) * _ = _ at main
  rw [e2] at main
  refine main.trans (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ξ _ ↦ ?_)
  congr 1
  have hξ := xiEq (k := k) f n v hv ξ
  by_cases hs : ξ.1 ⤳ x
  swap
  · rw [f17_pc_apply_eq_zero hs, f17_pc_apply_eq_zero hs]
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ : x ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι ξ.1) := by
    rw [range_pointClosureι]; exact specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp hs
  rw [← hz, f17_pc_apply, f17_pc_apply]
  have hpz : closureMap f ξ.1 v hξ z = w := by
    apply (pointClosureι v).isEmbedding.injective
    have h1 := congrArg (fun φ => φ z) (closureMap_ι f ξ.1 v hξ)
    simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at h1
    rw [h1]
    change f (pointClosureι ξ.1 z) = _
    rw [hz, hw]
  have hzd : closureMap f ξ.1 v hξ z ∈ d.U := by rw [hpz]; exact d.mem
  rw [lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame_apply, coeff_pf (k := k) f L hL ξ.1 v hξ b d z hzd,
    div_eq_ord]
  have hΦ := fnMap_closureMap (k := k) f n ξ.1 v hξ hv
  have : (f17Φ (f := f) (g := g) ((hfin.mem_toFinset.mp ξ.2).1)) = fnMap (closureMap f ξ.1 v hξ)
      (closureMap_generic f ξ.1 v hξ) := hΦ.symm
  rw [this]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D15.xi_height
statement:
theorem xi_height (n : ℕ) (v : Y) (hv : height v = n + 1)
    (ξ : {ξ // ξ ∈ (f17Ξ_finite f (genGen (k := k) n v hv 1 one_ne_zero)).toFinset}) :
    height ξ.1 = ((n + d + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  have hmem := ((f17Ξ_finite f (genGen (k := k) n v hv 1 one_ne_zero)).mem_toFinset.mp ξ.2)
  rw [hd ξ.1 hmem.2, xiEq (k := k) f n v hv ξ, hv]
  push_cast
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D15.D'_eq_sum
statement:
theorem D'_eq_sum (n : ℕ) (v : Y) (hv : height v = n + 1)
    (D' : dimensionCycles X (n + d + 1))
    (hD' : D'.1 = flatPullback f (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv).1) :
    D' = ∑ ξ ∈ (f17Ξ_finite f (genGen (k := k) n v hv 1 one_ne_zero)).toFinset.attach,
      (flatPullbackCoeff f ξ.1 : ℤ) • dimPrimeCycle ξ.1 (n + d + 1)
        (xi_height (k := k) f hd n v hv ξ)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.ext
  intro x
  rw [hD', flatPullback_apply, f17_sum_apply]
  have hterm : ∀ ξ : {ξ // ξ ∈ (f17Ξ_finite f (genGen (k := k) n v hv 1 one_ne_zero)).toFinset},
      (((flatPullbackCoeff f ξ.1 : ℤ) • dimPrimeCycle ξ.1 (n + d + 1)
        (xi_height (k := k) f hd n v hv ξ) : dimensionCycles X (n + d + 1)) :
          AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) x = if x = ξ.1 then (flatPullbackCoeff f ξ.1 : ℤ) else 0 := by
    intro ξ
    have h1 : (((flatPullbackCoeff f ξ.1 : ℤ) • dimPrimeCycle ξ.1 (n + d + 1)
        (xi_height (k := k) f hd n v hv ξ) : dimensionCycles X (n + d + 1)) :
          AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) x =
        (flatPullbackCoeff f ξ.1 : ℤ) * (dimPrimeCycle ξ.1 (n + d + 1)
        (xi_height (k := k) f hd n v hv ξ)).1 x := rfl
    rw [h1, m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun ξ _ ↦ hterm ξ)]
  rw [Finset.sum_attach (f17Ξ_finite f (genGen (k := k) n v hv 1 one_ne_zero)).toFinset
    (fun ξ ↦ if x = ξ then (flatPullbackCoeff f ξ : ℤ) else 0)]
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
  rw [m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply]
  by_cases hx : x ∈ (f17Ξ_finite f (genGen (k := k) n v hv 1 one_ne_zero)).toFinset
  · rw [if_pos hx]
    have := ((f17Ξ_finite f (genGen (k := k) n v hv 1 one_ne_zero)).mem_toFinset.mp hx).1
    rw [if_pos (this.trans (f17_pc_generic v))]
    ring
  · rw [if_neg hx]
    by_cases hfx : f x = v
    · have hc : flatPullbackCoeff f x = 0 := by
        by_contra hc
        exact hx ((f17Ξ_finite f (genGen (k := k) n v hv 1 one_ne_zero)).mem_toFinset.mpr
          ⟨hfx.trans (f17_pc_generic v).symm, hc⟩)
      simp [hc]
    · rw [if_neg hfx]; simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D15.capPull_succ
statement:
theorem capPull_succ (n : ℕ) (v : Y) (hv : height v = n + 1)
    (D' : dimensionCycles X (n + d + 1))
    (hD' : D'.1 = flatPullback f (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv).1) :
    flatPullbackChowOfFiniteType k f hd n (D5.primeCap (k := k) L hL n v hv) =
      D5.capCycles (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) (n + d) D'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b⟩ := Scheme.Modules.exists_lineBundleLocalDataAt (pointClosureScheme v)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj L)
    (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL v)
    (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one L hL v) (pointClosureGenericPoint v)
  rw [D5.primeCap_eq (k := k) L hL n v hv b, D'_eq_sum (k := k) f hd n v hv D' hD',
    map_sum]
  have hR : ∀ ξ ∈ (f17Ξ_finite f (genGen (k := k) n v hv 1 one_ne_zero)).toFinset.attach,
      D5.capCycles (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) (n + d)
        ((flatPullbackCoeff f ξ.1 : ℤ) • dimPrimeCycle ξ.1 (n + d + 1)
          (xi_height (k := k) f hd n v hv ξ)) =
      (flatPullbackCoeff f ξ.1 : ℤ) • (QuotientAddGroup.mk
        (D5.primeCycleOfFrame (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
          (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) (n + d) ξ.1
          (xi_height (k := k) f hd n v hv ξ) (pfGen f L ξ.1 v (xiEq (k := k) f n v hv ξ) b)) :
          DimChow X (n + d)) := by
    intro ξ _
    rw [map_zsmul, D5.capCycles_dimPrimeCycle, D5.primeCap_eq]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hR]
  have hsum : ∀ (P : {ξ // ξ ∈ (f17Ξ_finite f (genGen (k := k) n v hv 1 one_ne_zero)).toFinset} →
      dimensionCycles X (n + d)),
      ∑ ξ ∈ (f17Ξ_finite f (genGen (k := k) n v hv 1 one_ne_zero)).toFinset.attach,
        (flatPullbackCoeff f ξ.1 : ℤ) • (QuotientAddGroup.mk (P ξ) : DimChow X (n + d)) =
      (QuotientAddGroup.mk (∑ ξ ∈ (f17Ξ_finite f (genGen (k := k) n v hv 1 one_ne_zero)).toFinset.attach,
        (flatPullbackCoeff f ξ.1 : ℤ) • P ξ) : DimChow X (n + d)) := by
    intro P
    have := map_sum (QuotientAddGroup.mk' (dimRationalEquivalence X (n + d)))
      (fun ξ ↦ (flatPullbackCoeff f ξ.1 : ℤ) • P ξ)
      (f17Ξ_finite f (genGen (k := k) n v hv 1 one_ne_zero)).toFinset.attach
    simp only [map_zsmul] at this
    exact this.symm
  rw [hsum]
  change QuotientAddGroup.mk _ = _
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.ext
  intro x
  rw [f17_sum_apply]
  exact flatPullback_primeCycle_pointwise (k := k) f hd L hL n v hv b x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D15.pointClosure_unique_of_height_zero
statement:
theorem pointClosure_unique_of_height_zero {Y : Scheme.{u}} (v : Y) (hv : height v = 0)
    (y : pointClosureScheme v) : y = genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v)
proof:
:= by
  apply (pointClosureι v).isEmbedding.injective
  rw [f17_pc_generic]
  by_contra hne
  have hsp : v ⤳ pointClosureι v y := C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι v y
  have hlt := f17_lt_of_specializes hsp (Ne.symm hne)
  have := Order.height_add_one_le hlt
  rw [hv] at this
  exact absurd this (by simp)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D15.coeff_zero_of_mem_D15
statement:
theorem coeff_zero_of_mem_D15 {W : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral W] [IsLocallyNoetherian W]
    {M : W.Modules} {b₀ : W} (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree W M)
    (hr : SingularCurve.genericRank W M = 1) (b : LineBundleLocalData W M b₀) (p : W)
    (hp : p ∈ b.U) : lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame hM hr b p = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame_eq_on_localData hM hr b b p hp]
  by_cases hpc : coheight p = 1
  · exact W.ord_of_isUnit (b.transitionSection_isUnit b) hpc ⟨hp, hp⟩
  · exact Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hpc _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D15.capPull_zero
statement:
theorem capPull_zero {e : ℕ} (hde : d = e + 1) (v : Y) (hv : height v = 0)
    (D' : dimensionCycles X (e + 1))
    (hD' : D'.1 = flatPullback f (dimPrimeCycle v 0 hv).1) :
    D5.capCycles (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
      (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) e D' = 0
proof:
:= by
  show (compactCycleFinsupp D'.1).sum (fun w m ↦ m • D5.primeCapOrZero (k := k)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L) (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) e w) = 0
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro ξ hξ
  have hξ' : D'.1 ξ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, compactCycleFinsupp_apply] at hξ
    exact hξ
  rw [hD', flatPullback_apply, m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply] at hξ'
  have hfx : f ξ = v := by
    by_contra hne
    exact hξ' (by simp [hne])
  have hc : flatPullbackCoeff f ξ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    exact hξ' (by simp [h0])
  have hheight : height ξ = ((e : ℕ) : ℕ∞) + 1 := by
    rw [hd ξ hc, hfx, hv, hde]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hP : D5.primeCapOrZero (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
      (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) e ξ = 0 := by
    unfold D5.primeCapOrZero
    rw [dif_pos hheight]
    obtain ⟨b⟩ := Scheme.Modules.exists_lineBundleLocalDataAt (pointClosureScheme v)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj L)
      (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL v)
      (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one L hL v) (pointClosureGenericPoint v)
    rw [D5.primeCap_eq (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
      (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) e ξ hheight (pfGen f L ξ v hfx b)]
    have hz : D5.primeCycleOfFrame (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) e ξ hheight (pfGen f L ξ v hfx b) = 0 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change properPushforward (pointClosureι ξ) (lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame
        (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
          (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) ξ)
        (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
          (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) ξ) (pfGen f L ξ v hfx b)).1 = 0
      have hW : (lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame
        (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
          (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) ξ)
        (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
          (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) ξ) (pfGen f L ξ v hfx b)).1 = 0 := by
        apply Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.ext
        intro z
        rw [lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame_apply]
        refine coeff_zero_of_mem_D15 _ _ _ z ?_
        change closureMap f ξ v hfx z ∈ b.U
        rw [pointClosure_unique_of_height_zero v hv (closureMap f ξ v hfx z)]
        exact b.genericPoint_mem
      rw [hW]
      exact properPushforward_zero _
    rw [hz]
    rfl
  beta_reduce
  rw [hP, smul_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D15.capPullGate_of_flat
statement: theorem capPullGate_of_flat : D13.CapPullGate (k := k) f hd L hL
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun n v hv D' hD' ↦ capPull_succ (k := k) f hd L hL n v hv D' hD',
   fun _ hde v hv D' hD' ↦ capPull_zero (k := k) f hd L hL hde v hv D' hD'⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D15.cap_pull_D15
statement:
theorem cap_pull_D15 :
    totalPull ops f d hd ∘ₗ totalCap ops L hL =
      totalCap ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) ∘ₗ totalPull ops f d hd
proof:
:=
  D13.cap_pull_of_gate (k := k) f hd L hL ops (capPullGate_of_flat (k := k) f hd L hL)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.projBundleClosedPosK
statement:
theorem projBundleClosedPosK [IsNoetherianRing k] (hT : D37.TwistInvarianceStatement.{u}) :
    D30.ProjBundleClosedPos (ProjectiveIntegralK k)
proof:
:= by
  intro X _ _ _ hX E C e hC
  obtain ⟨hI, N, j, hj, hjk⟩ := hX.out
  haveI := hj
  haveI := hI
  have hE : HasConstantRank X E (e + 1) := D37.hasConstantRank_of_frameCover C hC
  obtain ⟨D, C', n, ι, hι, hιf⟩ :=
    D37.exists_closedImmersion_twist_into_product_pos N j E (e + 1) hE
  have hL : HasConstantRank X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (D : ℤ))) 1 :=
    hasConstantRank_pullback X j _ 1
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.hasConstantRank_twist (k := k) N (D : ℤ))
  obtain ⟨iso, hiso⟩ := hT _ E hL hE C C'
  haveI := hι
  haveI := SegreD36.isClosedImmersion_segreHomStd (k := k) N n
  refine ⟨C.isIntegral_scheme_of_card hC, SegreD36.segreDim N n,
    iso.hom ≫ ι ≫ SegreD36.segreHomStd N n, inferInstance, ?_⟩
  change _ = C.toBase ≫ X ↘ Spk k
  rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, SegreD36.segreHomStd, SegreD36.segreHom_toSpec,
    ← Category.assoc ι, hιf, Category.assoc, hjk, ← Category.assoc iso.hom, hiso]

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3C.hbcA_projective
statement:
theorem hbcA_projective [IsIntegral X] (hX : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme X)
    (φk : k →+* Γ(space k n, ⊤))
    (x : K0 i.ker.subscheme) (y : K0 (totalGlobal (space k n) i.ker))
    (hy : k0ToG0 (totalGlobal (space k n) i.ker) y =
      finitePushforward (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k n) i.ker)
        (flatPullbackG0 (totalToClosedBase (space k n) i.ker) (k0ToG0 i.ker.subscheme x))) :
    k0ToG0 (space k n) (pullbackK0 (fibreιGlobal (space k n) i.ker k φk 1) y) =
      finitePushforward i.ker.subschemeι (k0ToG0 i.ker.subscheme x)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIntegral i.ker.subscheme := isIntegral_ker_subscheme k n i
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (space k n) := inferInstance
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (totalGlobal (space k n) i.ker) := inferInstance
  exact CIIL3B.hbcA_pencil (space k n) i.ker k φk (bijective_k0ToG0_total k n i hX) x y hy

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3C.hbcE_projective_of_gate
statement:
theorem hbcE_projective_of_gate [IsIntegral X] (hX : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme X)
    (φk : k →+* Γ(space k n, ⊤)) (G : OEGate (space k n) i.ker)
    (x : K0 i.ker.subscheme) (y : K0 (totalGlobal (space k n) i.ker))
    (hy : k0ToG0 (totalGlobal (space k n) i.ker) y =
      finitePushforward (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k n) i.ker)
        (flatPullbackG0 (totalToClosedBase (space k n) i.ker) (k0ToG0 i.ker.subscheme x))) :
    haveI : IsIso (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k n) i.ker)
        (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf G.σ).subschemeι ≫ totalToClosedBase (space k n) i.ker)
proof:
:=
      haveI := CIIL3B.isIso_fst_comp_totalToClosedBase (space k n) i.ker
      CIIL3B.isIso_fst_comp_of_ker_eq (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k n) i.ker)
        (totalToClosedBase (space k n) i.ker)
        (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf G.σ).subschemeι (componentToTotal (space k n) i.ker)
        (by rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_subschemeι]; exact G.hid)
    k0ToG0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf G.σ).subscheme
        (pullbackK0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf G.σ).subschemeι y) =
      finitePushforward
        (inv (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k n) i.ker)
          (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf G.σ).subschemeι ≫ totalToClosedBase (space k n) i.ker) ≫
          pullback.snd (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k n) i.ker)
            (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf G.σ).subschemeι)
        (k0ToG0 i.ker.subscheme x) := by
  haveI : IsIntegral i.ker.subscheme := isIntegral_ker_subscheme k n i
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (space k n) := inferInstance
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (totalGlobal (space k n) i.ker) := inferInstance
  haveI := G.qc
  haveI := G.fp
  exact CIIL3B.hbcE_pencil (space k n) i.ker k φk G.σ G.hL G.hreg G.hid
    (bijective_k0ToG0_total k n i hX) x y hy

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3C.hbcE_projective
statement:
theorem hbcE_projective [IsIntegral X] (hX : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme X)
    (φk : k →+* Γ(space k n, ⊤))
    (x : K0 i.ker.subscheme) (y : K0 (totalGlobal (space k n) i.ker))
    (hy : k0ToG0 (totalGlobal (space k n) i.ker) y =
      finitePushforward (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k n) i.ker)
        (flatPullbackG0 (totalToClosedBase (space k n) i.ker) (k0ToG0 i.ker.subscheme x))) :
    haveI : IsIso (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k n) i.ker)
        (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf (oeGate k n φk i.ker).σ).subschemeι ≫
          totalToClosedBase (space k n) i.ker)
proof:
:=
      haveI := CIIL3B.isIso_fst_comp_totalToClosedBase (space k n) i.ker
      CIIL3B.isIso_fst_comp_of_ker_eq (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k n) i.ker)
        (totalToClosedBase (space k n) i.ker)
        (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf (oeGate k n φk i.ker).σ).subschemeι
        (componentToTotal (space k n) i.ker)
        (by rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_subschemeι]; exact (oeGate k n φk i.ker).hid)
    k0ToG0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf (oeGate k n φk i.ker).σ).subscheme
        (pullbackK0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf (oeGate k n φk i.ker).σ).subschemeι y) =
      finitePushforward
        (inv (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k n) i.ker)
          (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf (oeGate k n φk i.ker).σ).subschemeι ≫
            totalToClosedBase (space k n) i.ker) ≫
          pullback.snd (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k n) i.ker)
            (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf (oeGate k n φk i.ker).σ).subschemeι)
        (k0ToG0 i.ker.subscheme x) :=
  hbcE_projective_of_gate k n i hX φk (oeGate k n φk i.ker) x y hy

    (C C' : AffineFrameCover X E) (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) :
    HEq (((C.union C').canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d).iso (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inl j))
      ((C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d).iso i j)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [canonicalTwistTransitionSystem, twistOverlapIsoOfRestrictLocalCompatibility]
  congr 1
  · simp only [C.transition_union_inl C' i j,
      C.unionInl_overlapToChart C' j i,
      C.chartTwistingSheaf_union_inl C' d j]
  · congr 1
    · exact C.unionInl_twistOverlapRestrictTarget C' d i j
    · simp only [C.transition_union_inl C' i j,
        C.unionInl_overlapToChart C' j i,
        C.chartTwistingSheaf_union_inl C' d j]
    · exact C.unionInl_gluedOverlapIso C' d i j _ _
    · letI : IsOpenImmersion ((C.union C').transition (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inl j)) :=
        (C.union C').transition_isOpenImmersion' (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inl j)
      letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.transition i j) :=
        C.transition_isOpenImmersion' i j
      have ha : (C.union C').transition (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inl j) ≫
          (C.union C').overlapToChart (Sum.inl j) (Sum.inl i) =
          C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i := by
        rw [C.transition_union_inl C' i j]
        rfl
      exact restrictFunctorIsoPullback_heq_of_f_eq _ _ _ ha

    SingularCurve.genericRank (pointClosureScheme v)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj L) = 1
proof:

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerShortExact.contractionAux_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma contractionAux_apply (r : F →ₗ[R] K) (g : F →ₗ[R] L) (n : ℕ) (y : F) (v : Fin n → F) :
    contractionAux r g n y v = exteriorPower.ιMulti R n (r ∘ v) ⊗ₜ g y
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerShortExact.contraction_map
statement:
lemma contraction_map (f : K →ₗ[R] F) (r : F →ₗ[R] K) (g : F →ₗ[R] L) (n : ℕ)
    (hgf : ∀ k, g (f k) = 0) (z : ⋀[R]^(n + 1) K) :
    contraction r g n (exteriorPower.map (n + 1) f z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : (contraction r g n) ∘ₗ exteriorPower.map (n + 1) f = 0 := by
    apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext (N := ⋀[R]^n K ⊗[R] L)
    ext v
    simp [contraction, exteriorPower.map_apply_ιMulti,
      AlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin_apply, hgf]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h z

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerShortExact.contraction_snoc
statement:
lemma contraction_snoc (f : K →ₗ[R] F) (r : F →ₗ[R] K) (g : F →ₗ[R] L) (n : ℕ)
    (hgf : ∀ k, g (f k) = 0) (hrf : ∀ k, r (f k) = k) (κ : Fin n → K) (y : F) :
    contraction r g n (exteriorPower.ιMulti R (n + 1) (Fin.snoc (f ∘ κ) y)) =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ n) • (exteriorPower.ιMulti R n κ ⊗ₜ g y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [contraction, exteriorPower.alternatingMapLinearEquiv_apply_ιMulti,
    AlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin_apply, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
  have hκ : r ∘ (f ∘ κ) = κ := by
    funext i
    simp [hrf]
  simp [Fin.snoc_castSucc, hgf, Fin.snoc_last, Fin.removeNth_last, Fin.init_snoc, hκ]

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerShortExact.exists_retraction
statement:
lemma exists_retraction (f : K →ₗ[R] F) (g : F →ₗ[R] L) (s : L →ₗ[R] F)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (hgf : ∀ k, g (f k) = 0)
    (hex : ∀ y, g y = 0 → ∃ k, f k = y) (hs : ∀ l, g (s l) = l) :
    ∃ r : F →ₗ[R] K, (∀ k, r (f k) = k) ∧ ∀ y, y = f (r y) + s (g y)
proof:
:= by
  let t : F →ₗ[R] F := LinearMap.id - s ∘ₗ g
  have ht : ∀ y, t y ∈ LinearMap.range f := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hex (t y) (by simp [t, hs])
    exact ⟨k, hk⟩
  let r : F →ₗ[R] K := (LinearEquiv.ofInjective f hf).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
    t.codRestrict (LinearMap.range f) ht
  have hfr : ∀ y, f (r y) = t y := by
    intro y
    have h1 := LinearEquiv.ofInjective_apply f (h := hf)
      ((LinearEquiv.ofInjective f hf).symm (t.codRestrict (LinearMap.range f) ht y))
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h1
    simp only [r, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
    rw [← h1]
    rfl
  refine ⟨r, fun k ↦ hf ?_, fun y ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [hfr]
    simp [t, hgf]
  · rw [hfr]
    simp [t]

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerShortExact.lTensor_eq_zero_of_wedge_eq_map
statement:
lemma lTensor_eq_zero_of_wedge_eq_map (f : K →ₗ[R] F) (g : F →ₗ[R] L) (r : F →ₗ[R] K) (n : ℕ)
    (hgf : ∀ k, g (f k) = 0) (hrf : ∀ k, r (f k) = k)
    (φ : ⋀[R]^n K ⊗[R] F →ₗ[R] ⋀[R]^(n + 1) F)
    (hφ : ∀ (κ : Fin n → K) (y : F),
      φ (exteriorPower.ιMulti R n κ ⊗ₜ y) = exteriorPower.ιMulti R (n + 1) (Fin.snoc (f ∘ κ) y))
    (x : ⋀[R]^n K ⊗[R] F) (z : ⋀[R]^(n + 1) K)
    (hx : φ x = exteriorPower.map (n + 1) f z) :
    LinearMap.lTensor (⋀[R]^n K) g x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ x, contraction r g n (φ x) =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ n) • LinearMap.lTensor (⋀[R]^n K) g x := by
    intro x
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | tmul ω y =>
        have hω : ω ∈ Submodule.span R (Set.range (exteriorPower.ιMulti R n)) := by
          rw [exteriorPower.ιMulti_span]
          trivial
        induction hω using Submodule.span_induction with
        | mem w hw =>
            obtain ⟨κ, rfl⟩ := hw
            rw [hφ, contraction_snoc f r g n hgf hrf, LinearMap.lTensor_tmul]
        | zero => simp
        | add a b _ _ ha hb =>
            simp only [TensorProduct.add_tmul, map_add, ha, hb, smul_add]
        | smul c a _ ha =>
            rw [← TensorProduct.smul_tmul', map_smul, map_smul, ha, map_smul, smul_comm]
    | add a b ha hb =>
        simp only [map_add, ha, hb, smul_add]
  have h0 : ((-1 : ℤ) ^ n) • LinearMap.lTensor (⋀[R]^n K) g x = 0 := by
    rw [← key, hx, contraction_map f r g n hgf]
  have hu : ((-1 : ℤ) ^ n) * (-1) ^ n = 1 := by
    rw [← mul_pow]
    simp
  calc LinearMap.lTensor (⋀[R]^n K) g x
      = (((-1 : ℤ) ^ n) * (-1) ^ n) • LinearMap.lTensor (⋀[R]^n K) g x := by rw [hu, one_smul]
    _ = 0 := by rw [mul_smul, h0, smul_zero]

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerShortExact.mem_range_map_sup_range_wedge
statement:
lemma mem_range_map_sup_range_wedge (f : K →ₗ[R] F) (n : ℕ)
    (φ : ⋀[R]^n K ⊗[R] F →ₗ[R] ⋀[R]^(n + 1) F)
    (hφ : ∀ (κ : Fin n → K) (y : F),
      φ (exteriorPower.ιMulti R n κ ⊗ₜ y) = exteriorPower.ιMulti R (n + 1) (Fin.snoc (f ∘ κ) y))
    (ε : F) (hgen : ∀ y : F, ∃ (k : K) (a : R), y = f k + a • ε)
    (w : ⋀[R]^(n + 1) F) :
    w ∈ LinearMap.range (exteriorPower.map (n + 1) f) ⊔ LinearMap.range φ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set N := LinearMap.range (exteriorPower.map (n + 1) f) ⊔ LinearMap.range φ with hN
  let s : Set F := Set.range f ∪ {ε}
  have hs : Submodule.span R s = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro y _
    obtain ⟨k, a, rfl⟩ := hgen y
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.subset_span (Or.inl ⟨k, rfl⟩))
      (Submodule.smul_mem _ a (Submodule.subset_span (Or.inr rfl)))
  have hmemf : ∀ v : Fin (n + 1) → F, (∀ i, v i ∈ Set.range f) →
      exteriorPower.ιMulti R (n + 1) v ∈ N := by
    intro v hv
    choose κ hκ using hv
    have hvκ : v = f ∘ κ := funext fun i ↦ (hκ i).symm
    subst hvκ
    exact Submodule.mem_sup_left ⟨exteriorPower.ιMulti R (n + 1) κ,
      exteriorPower.map_apply_ιMulti _ _⟩
  have hsnoc : ∀ κ : Fin n → K,
      exteriorPower.ιMulti R (n + 1) (Fin.snoc (f ∘ κ) ε) ∈ N := fun κ ↦
    Submodule.mem_sup_right ⟨exteriorPower.ιMulti R n κ ⊗ₜ ε, hφ κ ε⟩
  have key : ∀ v : Fin (n + 1) → F, Set.range v ⊆ s →
      exteriorPower.ιMulti R (n + 1) v ∈ N := by
    intro v hv
    by_cases h : ∃ i, v i = ε
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h
      by_cases h2 : ∃ j, Fin.removeNth i v j = ε
      · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := h2
        have h0 : exteriorPower.ιMulti R (n + 1) v = 0 :=
          (exteriorPower.ιMulti R (n + 1)).map_eq_zero_of_eq v (i := i) (j := i.succAbove j)
            (by rw [hi, ← hj]; rfl) (Fin.succAbove_ne i j).symm
        rw [h0]
        exact N.zero_mem
      · push Not at h2
        have hw : ∀ j, Fin.removeNth i v j ∈ Set.range f := by
          intro j
          rcases hv ⟨i.succAbove j, rfl⟩ with h' | h'
          · exact h'
          · exact absurd h' (h2 j)
        choose κ hκ using hw
        have hrm : Fin.removeNth i v = f ∘ κ := funext fun j ↦ (hκ j).symm
        have hv' : v = i.insertNth ε (f ∘ κ) := by
          rw [← hi, ← hrm, Fin.insertNth_self_removeNth]
        have e1 := AlternatingMap.map_insertNth (exteriorPower.ιMulti R (n + 1)) i ε (f ∘ κ)
        have e2 := AlternatingMap.map_insertNth (exteriorPower.ιMulti R (n + 1))
          (Fin.last n) ε (f ∘ κ)
        rw [Fin.insertNth_last'] at e2
        rw [hv', e1]
        have e3 : exteriorPower.ιMulti R (n + 1) (Matrix.vecCons ε (f ∘ κ)) ∈ N := by
          have : exteriorPower.ιMulti R (n + 1) (Matrix.vecCons ε (f ∘ κ)) =
              (-1) ^ (n : ℕ) • exteriorPower.ιMulti R (n + 1) (Fin.snoc (f ∘ κ) ε) := by
            rw [e2, Fin.val_last, smul_smul, ← mul_pow]
            simp
          rw [this]
          exact N.smul_of_tower_mem _ (hsnoc κ)
        exact N.smul_of_tower_mem _ e3
    · push Not at h
      apply hmemf
      intro i
      rcases hv ⟨i, rfl⟩ with h' | h'
      · exact h'
      · exact absurd h' (h i)
  have htop := exteriorPower.ιMulti_span_of_span R (n + 1) F hs
  have hle : Submodule.span R
      (⇑(exteriorPower.ιMulti R (n + 1)) '' {a | Set.range a ⊆ s}) ≤ N := by
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    exact key v hv
  rw [htop] at hle
  exact hle Submodule.mem_top

name: SchemeKTheory.moduleLocalEquivalences_of_bijective_on_cover
statement:
theorem moduleLocalEquivalences_of_bijective_on_cover {P Q : ModulePresheaf Y} (p : P ⟶ Q)
    (U : Y → Y.Opens)
    (hU : ∀ x, x ∈ U x)
    (hp : ∀ (x : Y) (W : Y.Opens), W ≤ U x → Function.Bijective (p.app (op W))) :
    moduleLocalEquivalences Y p
proof:
:= by
  change (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y).W ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map p)
  rw [GrothendieckTopology.W_iff_isLocallyBijective]
  refine ⟨⟨?_⟩, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  · intro V a b hab x hx
    refine ⟨V.unop ⊓ U x, homOfLE inf_le_left, ?_, ⟨hx, hU x⟩⟩
    apply (hp x _ inf_le_right).1
    have hab' : p.app V a = p.app V b := hab
    have e1 := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply p
      (homOfLE inf_le_left : V.unop ⊓ U x ⟶ V.unop).op a
    have e2 := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply p
      (homOfLE inf_le_left : V.unop ⊓ U x ⟶ V.unop).op b
    exact e1.trans ((congrArg _ hab').trans e2.symm)
  · intro V s x hx
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := (hp x (V ⊓ U x) inf_le_right).2
      (Q.map (homOfLE inf_le_left : V ⊓ U x ⟶ V).op s)
    exact ⟨V ⊓ U x, homOfLE inf_le_left, ⟨t, ht⟩, ⟨hx, hU x⟩⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.cokernelDesc_app_bijective
statement:
theorem cokernelDesc_app_bijective {P E Q : ModulePresheaf Y} (k : P ⟶ E) (v : E ⟶ Q)
    (hkv : k ≫ v = 0) (W : (Y.Opens)ᵒᵖ)
    (hv : Function.Surjective (v.app W))
    (hker : ∀ e, v.app W e = 0 → ∃ p, k.app W p = e) :
    Function.Bijective ((cokernel.desc k v hkv).app W)
proof:
:= by
  have hπ : Function.Surjective ((cokernel.π k).app W) := by
    have : Epi ((PresheafOfModules.evaluation _ W).map (cokernel.π k)) := inferInstance
    exact (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).1 this
  have hfac : ∀ e, (cokernel.desc k v hkv).app W ((cokernel.π k).app W e) = v.app W e := by
    intro e
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← PresheafOfModules.comp_app, cokernel.π_desc]
  have hkπ : ∀ p, (cokernel.π k).app W (k.app W p) = 0 := by
    intro p
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← PresheafOfModules.comp_app, cokernel.condition]
    rfl
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a b hab
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hπ a
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hπ b
    rw [hfac, hfac] at hab
    rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub] at hab ⊢
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hker _ hab
    rw [← hp, hkπ]
  · intro q
    obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ := hv q
    exact ⟨_, hfac e⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.exists_app_eq_of_cokernel_π_app_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_app_eq_of_cokernel_π_app_eq_zero {P Q : ModulePresheaf Y} (p : P ⟶ Q)
    (W : (Y.Opens)ᵒᵖ)
    (b : Q.obj W) (hb : (cokernel.π p).app W b = 0) : ∃ a, p.app W a = b
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : (ShortComplex.mk p (cokernel.π p) (cokernel.condition p)).Exact :=
    ShortComplex.exact_of_g_is_cokernel _ (cokernelIsCokernel p)
  have h1 := h0.map (PresheafOfModules.evaluation _ W)
  exact (ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff _).1 h1 b hb

name: SchemeKTheory.mono_moduleSheafification_map_of_injective_on_cover
statement:
theorem mono_moduleSheafification_map_of_injective_on_cover {P Q : ModulePresheaf Y} (p : P ⟶ Q)
    (U : Y → Y.Opens)
    (hU : ∀ x, x ∈ U x)
    (hp : ∀ (x : Y) (W : Y.Opens), W ≤ U x → Function.Injective (p.app (op W))) :
    Mono ((moduleSheafification Y).map p)
proof:
:= by
  let sh := moduleSheafification Y
  have hsub : ∀ (x : Y) (W : Y.Opens), W ≤ U x → ∀ z : (kernel p).obj (op W), z = 0 := by
    intro x W hW z
    have hmono : Mono ((PresheafOfModules.evaluation _ (op W)).map (kernel.ι p)) :=
      inferInstance
    have hinj := (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).1 hmono
    have h1 : (p.app (op W)) (((kernel.ι p).app (op W)) z) = 0 := by
      change ((kernel.ι p ≫ p).app (op W)) z = 0
      rw [kernel.condition]
      rfl
    apply hinj
    apply hp x W hW
    change (p.app (op W)).hom (((kernel.ι p).app (op W)).hom z) =
      (p.app (op W)).hom (((kernel.ι p).app (op W)).hom 0)
    rw [LinearMap.map_zero, LinearMap.map_zero]
    exact h1
  have hW : moduleLocalEquivalences Y (0 : kernel p ⟶ kernel p) := by
    apply moduleLocalEquivalences_of_bijective_on_cover _ U hU
    intro x W hW'
    constructor
    · intro a b _
      rw [hsub x W hW' a, hsub x W hW' b]
    · intro b
      exact ⟨0, by rw [hsub x W hW' b]; rfl⟩
  have hiso : IsIso (sh.map (0 : kernel p ⟶ kernel p)) :=
    Localization.inverts sh (moduleLocalEquivalences Y) _ hW
  have hz : IsZero (sh.obj (kernel p)) := by
    rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero]
    have h0 : sh.map (0 : kernel p ⟶ kernel p) = 0 := sh.map_zero _ _
    rw [h0] at hiso
    calc 𝟙 _ = inv (0 : sh.obj (kernel p) ⟶ _) ≫ 0 := (IsIso.inv_hom_id _).symm
      _ = 0 := comp_zero
  have hk : IsZero (kernel (sh.map p)) := hz.of_iso (PreservesKernel.iso sh p).symm
  exact Preadditive.mono_of_kernel_zero (hk.eq_of_src _ _)

name: SchemeKTheory.exteriorPower_tensor_hom_ext
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.tensor_ext
  intro ω y
  have H : a.hom ∘ₗ (TensorProduct.mk R' (M.exteriorPower n) N).flip y =
      b.hom ∘ₗ (TensorProduct.mk R' (M.exteriorPower n) N).flip y := by
    apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext (M := M) (N := Q)
    ext κ
    exact h κ y
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun H ω

name: SchemeKTheory.exteriorPower_iso₁_inv_apply
statement:
lemma exteriorPower_iso₁_inv_apply {R' : Type u} [CommRing R'] (M : ModuleCat.{u} R') (y : M) :
    (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.iso₁ M).inv y = ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ y)
proof:
:= by
  calc (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.iso₁ M).inv y =
      (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.iso₁ M).inv ((ModuleCat.exteriorPower.iso₁ M).hom
        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ y))) := by
        rw [ModuleCat.exteriorPower.iso₁_hom_apply]
    _ = _ := Iso.hom_inv_id_apply _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.wedgeTensorMap_app
statement:
lemma wedgeTensorMap_app {M N : ModulePresheaf Y} (fp : M ⟶ N) (n : ℕ) (W : (Y.Opens)ᵒᵖ)
    (κ : Fin n → M.obj W) (y : N.obj W) :
    (wedgeTensorMap fp n).app W (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk κ ⊗ₜ y) =
      ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (Fin.snoc (fp.app W ∘ κ) y)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (wedgeTensorMap fp n).app W (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk κ ⊗ₜ y) =
      ModuleCat.exteriorPower.wedgeProduct (M := N.obj W) n 1
        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.map (fp.app W) n (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk κ) ⊗ₜ
          (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.iso₁ (N.obj W)).inv y) := rfl
  rw [h1, ModuleCat.exteriorPower.map_mk, exteriorPower_iso₁_inv_apply,
    ModuleCat.exteriorPower.wedgeProduct_tmul_mk, Fin.append_right_eq_snoc]

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerShortExact.sections_leftExact
statement:
theorem sections_leftExact {K F L : Y.Modules} (f : K ⟶ F) (g : F ⟶ L) (zero : f ≫ g = 0)
    (hS : (ShortComplex.mk f g zero).ShortExact) (W : (Y.Opens)ᵒᵖ) :
    Function.Injective (((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).map f).app W) ∧
    (∀ y, ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).map g).app W y = 0 →
      ∃ k, ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).map f).app W k = y) ∧
    (∀ k, ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).map g).app W
      (((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).map f).app W k) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  letI : (underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).IsRightAdjoint :=
    (moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).isRightAdjoint
  let ev := underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y ⋙
    PresheafOfModules.evaluation (Y.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat) W
  haveI := hS.mono_f
  have h1 : Mono (ev.map f) := inferInstance
  have hex : ((ShortComplex.mk f g zero).map ev).Exact :=
    hS.exact.map_of_mono_of_preservesKernel ev hS.mono_f inferInstance
  refine ⟨(ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).1 h1,
    fun y hy ↦ (ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff _).1 hex y hy, fun k ↦ ?_⟩
  have h2 : (ev.map (f ≫ g)) k = 0 := by
    rw [zero, Functor.map_zero]
    rfl
  rw [Functor.map_comp] at h2
  exact h2

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerShortExact.exists_local_splitting_rankOne
statement:
theorem exists_local_splitting_rankOne {K F L : Y.Modules} (f : K ⟶ F) (g : F ⟶ L)
    (zero : f ≫ g = 0)
    (hS : (ShortComplex.mk f g zero).ShortExact) (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1) (x : Y) :
    ∃ V : Y.Opens, x ∈ V ∧ ∀ W : Y.Opens, W ≤ V →
      (∃ s : ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).obj L).obj (op W) ⟶
          ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).obj F).obj (op W),
        ∀ l, ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).map g).app (op W) (s l) = l) ∧
      ∃ e : ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).obj L).obj (op W),
        ∀ l, ∃ a : ((Y.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).obj (op W)), l = a • e
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin, hcard⟩ := hL
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := hqfin
  have hcover : TopologicalSpace.IsOpenCover q.X := (Opens.coversTop_iff Y q.X).mp q.coversTop
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ : ∃ i, x ∈ q.X i := by
    have hxUnion : x ∈ ⋃ i, (q.X i : Set Y) := by
      rw [hcover.iSup_set_eq_univ]
      exact Set.mem_univ x
    simpa using hxUnion
  let I := (q.generators i).I
  have hI : Nat.card I = 1 := hcard i
  obtain ⟨hsub, hne⟩ := Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.mp hI
  letI : Unique I := @Unique.mk' I ⟨Classical.choice hne⟩ hsub
  letI : Fintype I := Fintype.ofFinite I
  haveI : Epi g := hS.epi_g
  let π := asIso (q.generators i).π
  obtain ⟨V, hVU, hxV, s, hs⟩ :=
    Scheme.Modules.exists_open_section_of_epi_free_over Y I g (q.X i) π x hxi
  refine ⟨V, hxV, fun W hWV ↦ ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · let W' : (Over V)ᵒᵖ := op (Over.mk (homOfLE hWV))
    refine ⟨s.val.app W', fun l ↦ ?_⟩
    have h := congrArg (fun h ↦ h.val.app W' l) hs
    exact h
  · let eI : I ≃ PUnit.{u + 1} := Equiv.ofUnique I PUnit
    let θ : SheafOfModules.unit (Y.ringCatSheaf.over (q.X i)) ≅ L.over (q.X i) :=
      SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit.symm ≪≫
        (SheafOfModules.freeFunctor (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over (q.X i))).mapIso eI.symm.toIso ≪≫ π
    let W' : (Over (q.X i))ᵒᵖ := op (Over.mk (homOfLE (hWV.trans hVU)))
    refine ⟨θ.hom.val.app W' (1 : (Y.ringCatSheaf.over (q.X i)).obj.obj W'), fun l ↦ ?_⟩
    have hl : θ.hom.val.app W' (θ.inv.val.app W' l) = l := by
      have h := congrArg (fun h ↦ h.val.app W' l) θ.inv_hom_id
      exact h
    refine ⟨θ.inv.val.app W' l, ?_⟩
    conv_lhs => rw [← hl]
    let R0 := (Y.ringCatSheaf.over (q.X i)).obj.obj W'
    let one : ↑((SheafOfModules.unit (Y.ringCatSheaf.over (q.X i))).val.obj W') := (1 : R0)
    let c : R0 := θ.inv.val.app W' l
    have h2 := (θ.hom.val.app W').hom.map_smul c one
    have h3 : c • one = θ.inv.val.app W' l := mul_one c
    exact (congrArg (fun z ↦ (θ.hom.val.app W') z) h3.symm).trans h2

name: SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf_exteriorPowerSheaf_succ_of_shortExact_rankOne
statement:
theorem k0ClassOf_exteriorPowerSheaf_succ_of_shortExact_rankOne {K F L : Y.Modules}
    (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1)
    (f : K ⟶ F) (g : F ⟶ L) (zero : f ≫ g = 0) (hS : (ShortComplex.mk f g zero).ShortExact)
    (n : ℕ)
    (hFn : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y (exteriorPowerSheaf Y F (n + 1)))
    (hKn1 : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y (exteriorPowerSheaf Y K (n + 1)))
    (hKn : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y (exteriorPowerSheaf Y K n)) :
    k0ClassOf Y (exteriorPowerSheaf Y F (n + 1)) hFn =
      k0ClassOf Y (exteriorPowerSheaf Y K (n + 1)) hKn1 +
        k0ClassOf Y (exteriorPowerSheaf Y K n) hKn * k0ClassOf Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Fu := underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y
  let sh := moduleSheafification Y
  let Kp : ModulePresheaf Y := Fu.obj K
  let Fp : ModulePresheaf Y := Fu.obj F
  let Lp : ModulePresheaf Y := Fu.obj L
  let fp : Kp ⟶ Fp := Fu.map f
  let gp : Fp ⟶ Lp := Fu.map g
  let A := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower Kp (n + 1)
  let B := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower Fp (n + 1)
  let αp : A ⟶ B := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPowerMap fp (n + 1)
  let Λ := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower Kp n
  let kk : Λ ⊗ Kp ⟶ Λ ⊗ Fp := Λ ◁ fp
  let vD : Λ ⊗ Fp ⟶ Λ ⊗ Lp := Λ ◁ gp
  let φp : Λ ⊗ Fp ⟶ B := wedgeTensorMap fp n
  let ψK : Λ ⊗ Kp ⟶ A := wedgeTensorMap (𝟙 Kp) n
  let vC : Λ ⊗ Fp ⟶ cokernel αp := φp ≫ cokernel.π αp
  have hfg : fp ≫ gp = 0 := by
    simp only [fp, gp, ← Functor.map_comp, zero, Functor.map_zero]
  have hkD : kk ≫ vD = 0 := by
    apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
    intro W
    rw [PresheafOfModules.comp_app]
    apply exteriorPower_tensor_hom_ext
    intro κ z
    have h0 : gp.app W (fp.app W z) = 0 := (sections_leftExact Y f g zero hS W).2.2 z
    change ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk κ ⊗ₜ gp.app W (fp.app W z) =
      (0 : Λ ⊗ Kp ⟶ Λ ⊗ Lp).app W (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk κ ⊗ₜ z)
    rw [h0, TensorProduct.tmul_zero]
    rfl
  have hfac : kk ≫ φp = ψK ≫ αp := by
    apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
    intro W
    rw [PresheafOfModules.comp_app, PresheafOfModules.comp_app]
    apply exteriorPower_tensor_hom_ext
    intro κ z
    change φp.app W (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk κ ⊗ₜ fp.app W z) =
      αp.app W (ψK.app W (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk κ ⊗ₜ z))
    rw [wedgeTensorMap_app, wedgeTensorMap_app]
    change _ = ModuleCat.exteriorPower.map (fp.app W) (n + 1) _
    rw [ModuleCat.exteriorPower.map_mk, Fin.comp_snoc]
    rfl
  have hkC : kk ≫ vC = 0 := by
    simp only [vC, ← Category.assoc, hfac]
    simp only [Category.assoc, cokernel.condition, comp_zero]
  let T := cokernel kk
  let uD : T ⟶ Λ ⊗ Lp := cokernel.desc kk vD hkD
  let uC : T ⟶ cokernel αp := cokernel.desc kk vC hkC
  
  have hloc := fun x : Y ↦ exists_local_splitting_rankOne Y f g zero hS hL x
  choose U hU hdata using hloc
  have hglob := sections_leftExact Y f g zero hS
  have key : ∀ (x : Y) (W : Y.Opens), W ≤ U x →
      Function.Injective (αp.app (op W)) ∧ Function.Bijective (uD.app (op W)) ∧
        Function.Bijective (uC.app (op W)) := by
    intro x W hW
    obtain ⟨⟨s, hs⟩, e, he⟩ := hdata x W hW
    obtain ⟨hinj, hex, hgf⟩ := hglob (op W)
    obtain ⟨r, hrf, hdec⟩ := exists_retraction (fp.app (op W)).hom (gp.app (op W)).hom
      s.hom hinj hgf hex hs
    have hsurj : Function.Surjective (gp.app (op W)).hom := fun l ↦ ⟨s l, hs l⟩
    have hexact : Function.Exact (fp.app (op W)).hom (gp.app (op W)).hom := fun y ↦
      ⟨fun h ↦ hex y h, by rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩; exact hgf k⟩
    have hφ : ∀ (κ : Fin n → Kp.obj (op W)) (y : Fp.obj (op W)),
        (φp.app (op W)).hom (exteriorPower.ιMulti _ n κ ⊗ₜ y) =
          exteriorPower.ιMulti _ (n + 1) (Fin.snoc ((fp.app (op W)).hom ∘ κ) y) :=
      fun κ y ↦ wedgeTensorMap_app fp n (op W) κ y
    have hgen : ∀ y : Fp.obj (op W), ∃ (k : Kp.obj (op W))
        (a : ((Y.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).obj (op W))),
        y = (fp.app (op W)).hom k + a • s e := by
      intro y
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := he ((gp.app (op W)).hom y)
      refine ⟨r y, a, ?_⟩
      have h1 := hdec y
      rw [ha, map_smul] at h1
      exact h1
    have hπ : Function.Surjective ((cokernel.π αp).app (op W)) := by
      have : Epi ((PresheafOfModules.evaluation _ (op W)).map (cokernel.π αp)) := inferInstance
      exact (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).1 this
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact exteriorPower.map_injective r (LinearMap.ext hrf)
    · apply cokernelDesc_app_bijective
      · exact LinearMap.lTensor_surjective _ hsurj
      · intro y hy
        exact (lTensor_exact _ hexact hsurj y).1 hy
    · apply cokernelDesc_app_bijective
      · intro c
        obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hπ c
        have hb := mem_range_map_sup_range_wedge (fp.app (op W)).hom n (φp.app (op W)).hom hφ
          (s e) hgen b
        obtain ⟨y1, ⟨z, rfl⟩, y2, ⟨x', rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hb
        refine ⟨x', ?_⟩
        have h0 : (cokernel.π αp).app (op W) (αp.app (op W) z) = 0 := by
          rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← PresheafOfModules.comp_app, cokernel.condition]
          rfl
        change (cokernel.π αp).app (op W) ((φp.app (op W)) x') =
          (cokernel.π αp).app (op W) ((αp.app (op W)) z + (φp.app (op W)) x')
        rw [map_add, h0, zero_add]
      · intro x' hx'
        obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_app_eq_of_cokernel_π_app_eq_zero αp (op W) _ hx'
        have h1 := lTensor_eq_zero_of_wedge_eq_map (fp.app (op W)).hom (gp.app (op W)).hom r n
          hgf hrf
          (φp.app (op W)).hom hφ x' z hz.symm
        exact (lTensor_exact _ hexact hsurj x').1 h1
  have hmono : Mono (sh.map αp) :=
    mono_moduleSheafification_map_of_injective_on_cover αp U hU (fun x W h ↦ (key x W h).1)
  have hWD : moduleLocalEquivalences Y uD :=
    moduleLocalEquivalences_of_bijective_on_cover uD U hU (fun x W h ↦ (key x W h).2.1)
  have hWC : moduleLocalEquivalences Y uC :=
    moduleLocalEquivalences_of_bijective_on_cover uC U hU (fun x W h ↦ (key x W h).2.2)
  haveI : IsIso (sh.map uD) := Localization.inverts sh (moduleLocalEquivalences Y) uD hWD
  haveI : IsIso (sh.map uC) := Localization.inverts sh (moduleLocalEquivalences Y) uC hWC
  let eD : tensorSheaf Y (exteriorPowerSheaf Y K n) L ≅ sh.obj (Λ ⊗ Lp) := by
    letI : MonoidalCategory Y.Modules := localizedMonoidalCategory Y
    exact tensorSheafIsoLocalizedTensor Y (sh.obj Λ) L ≪≫
      (Iso.refl (sh.obj Λ) ⊗ᵢ ((asIso (PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
        (structurePresheafId Y)).counit).app L).symm) ≪≫
      Localization.Monoidal.μ sh (moduleLocalEquivalences Y) (moduleTensorUnitIso Y) Λ Lp
  let eC : sh.obj (cokernel αp) ≅ tensorSheaf Y (exteriorPowerSheaf Y K n) L :=
    (asIso (sh.map uC)).symm ≪≫ asIso (sh.map uD) ≪≫ eD.symm
  have hC : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y (sh.obj (cokernel αp)) :=
    isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso Y eC.symm
      (tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree Y _ _ hKn hL.isFiniteLocallyFree)
  have hzero : sh.map αp ≫ sh.map (cokernel.π αp) = 0 := by
    rw [← sh.map_comp, cokernel.condition, sh.map_zero]
  have hSE : (ShortComplex.mk (sh.map αp) (sh.map (cokernel.π αp)) hzero).ShortExact := by
    refine { exact := ?_, mono_f := hmono, epi_g := inferInstance }
    have h0 : (ShortComplex.mk αp (cokernel.π αp) (cokernel.condition αp)).Exact :=
      ShortComplex.exact_of_g_is_cokernel _ (cokernelIsCokernel αp)
    exact h0.map sh
  have hrel := ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_middle Y.Modules (IsFiniteLocallyFree Y)
    hKn1 hFn hC hzero hSE
  rw [show k0ClassOf Y (exteriorPowerSheaf Y K n) hKn * k0ClassOf Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree =
      k0ClassOf Y (tensorSheaf Y (exteriorPowerSheaf Y K n) L)
        (tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree Y _ _ hKn hL.isFiniteLocallyFree) from
      k0ClassOf_mul Y ⟨_, hKn⟩ ⟨L, hL.isFiniteLocallyFree⟩,
    ← k0ClassOf_iso Y hC _ eC]
  exact hrel

name: SchemeKTheory.lambdaClass_succ_of_shortExact_rankOne
statement:
theorem lambdaClass_succ_of_shortExact_rankOne {K F L : Y.Modules}
    (hK : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y K) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y F) (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1)
    (f : K ⟶ F) (g : F ⟶ L) (zero : f ≫ g = 0) (hS : (ShortComplex.mk f g zero).ShortExact)
    (n : ℕ) :
    lambdaClass Y F hF (n + 1) =
      lambdaClass Y K hK (n + 1) +
        lambdaClass Y K hK n * k0ClassOf Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree
proof:
:=
  k0ClassOf_exteriorPowerSheaf_succ_of_shortExact_rankOne Y hL f g zero hS n _ _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackFrameCoefficient_refinement
statement:
theorem pullbackFrameCoefficient_refinement (j : C.pullbackFrameIndex g) (W : X.affineOpens)
    (h : W.1 ≤ C.pullbackFrameOpen g j) :
    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom.comp
      (PullbackFrameSections.coefficientMap g (C.U j.1) (C.pullbackFrameOpen g j) j.2.2) =
    PullbackFrameSections.coefficientMap g (C.U j.1) W.1 (h.trans j.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro r
  change X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op
    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE j.2.2).op (g.app (C.U j.1) r)) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h.trans j.2.2)).op (g.app (C.U j.1) r)
  have hc : X.presheaf.map (homOfLE j.2.2).op ≫ X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h.trans j.2.2)).op := by
    rw [← X.presheaf.map_comp]
    rfl
  exact congrArg (fun a => a (g.app (C.U j.1) r)) hc

statement:

proof:

      (PullbackFrameSections.coefficientMap g (C.U j.1) (C.pullbackFrameOpen g j) j.2.2)
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap g j)
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE h).op)) =
      Set.range (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap g (C.pullbackRefinedIndex g j W h)) := by
    congr 1
    funext s

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackProjectiveChartMap_refinement
statement:
theorem pullbackProjectiveChartMap_refinement (j : C.pullbackFrameIndex g) (W : X.affineOpens)
    (h : W.1 ≤ C.pullbackFrameOpen g j) :
    C.pullbackProjectiveRefinementMap g j W h ≫ C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g j =
      C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g (C.pullbackRefinedIndex g j W h)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, W.1) (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.obj (op W.1)) :=
    (C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionModule_free (C.pullbackRefinedIndex g j W h)
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, W.1) (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.obj (op W.1)) :=
    (C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionModule_finite (C.pullbackRefinedIndex g j W h)
  unfold pullbackProjectiveRefinementMap pullbackProjectiveChartMap
  refine (semilinearSymmetricProjMap_comp
    (PullbackFrameSections.coefficientMap g (C.U j.1) (C.pullbackFrameOpen g j) j.2.2)
    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap g j)
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE h).op)
    (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap_spans g j) ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).restriction_spans j W.1 h)
    (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap_refinement_spans g j W h)).trans ?_
  exact semilinearSymmetricProjMap_congr (C.pullbackFrameCoefficient_refinement g j W h)
    _ _ (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap_refinement_heq g j W h)
    (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap_refinement_spans g j W h)
    (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap_spans g (C.pullbackRefinedIndex g j W h))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.PullbackFrameSections.sectionMap_target_restrict
statement:
theorem sectionMap_target_restrict (g : X ⟶ Y) (M : Y.Modules)
    (U : Y.Opens) (U' : Y.Opens) (hU : U' ≤ U)
    (V : X.Opens) (hV : V ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U') (s : M.val.obj (op U)) :
    sectionMap g M U' V hV (M.val.map (homOfLE hU).op s) =
      sectionMap g M U V (hV.trans (g.preimage_mono hU)) s
proof:
:= by
  let P := (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj M
  have hn := congrArg (fun a => a.hom s)
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app M).val.naturality (homOfLE hU).op).symm
  change ((P.presheaf.map ((Opens.map g.base).map (homOfLE hU)).op)
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app M).app U s)) =
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app M).app U'
      (M.val.map (homOfLE hU).op s)) at hn
  have ht := congrArg (fun x => P.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op x) hn.symm
  change sectionMap g M U' V hV (M.val.map (homOfLE hU).op s) =
    (P.presheaf.map ((Opens.map g.base).map (homOfLE hU)).op ≫
      P.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op)
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app M).app U s) at ht
  rw [← P.presheaf.map_comp] at ht
  exact ht

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.tautChart_localFrame_coefficient
statement:
theorem tautChart_localFrame_coefficient (i : ι) (m : M) :
    (linearLocalFrameProjection R M b 1 i).app ⊤
      ((tautChartLocalSection R M b i m).app ⊤
        (1 : (linearOpen R M (b i)).toScheme.presheaf.obj (op ⊤))) =
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules (linearOpen R M (b i)).toScheme).presheaf.map
        (eqToHom ((linearOpen R M (b i)).ι.preimage_image_eq ⊤).symm).op
        ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) (linearOpen R M (b i))).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE le_top).op (tautChart_component R M (b i) m))
proof:
:= by
  change (linearLocalFrameProjection R M b 1 i).app ⊤
      ((tautChart_tautHom R M b m).app ((linearOpen R M (b i)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤)
        ((tautChart_restrictOne R M (linearOpen R M (b i))).app ⊤
          (1 : (linearOpen R M (b i)).toScheme.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)))) = _
  rw [tautChart_restrictOne, tautChart_unitHomEquiv_symm_sectionsOfTop_app,
    linearLocalFrameProjection_app_eq]
  have h1 : (Pi.π (fun j ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) (linearOpen R M (b j))) i).app
      ((linearOpen R M (b i)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤)
      ((kernel.ι (linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b 1)).app
        ((linearOpen R M (b i)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤)
        ((tautChart_tautHom R M b m).app ((linearOpen R M (b i)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤)
          (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ((linearOpen R M (b i)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤))))) =
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) (linearOpen R M (b i))).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE le_top).op (tautChart_component R M (b i) m) := by
    exact (tautChart_app3 _ _ _ _ _).trans ((congrArg
      (fun f : SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules (space R M) ⟶
          SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) (linearOpen R M (b i)) ↦
        f.app ((linearOpen R M (b i)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤)
          (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ((linearOpen R M (b i)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤))))
      (tautChart_tautHom_kernel_π R M b m i)).trans
      (tautChart_unitHomEquiv_symm_sectionsOfTop_app' _ _ _))
  erw [h1]

theorem tautChart_localFrame_evaluationIdeal (i : ι) (m : M) :

          (1 : (linearOpen R M (b i)).toScheme.presheaf.obj (op ⊤))) =

proof:
:= by
  let eU : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι).obj
        (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b 1)).val.obj (op ⊤) ≃ₗ[
          (linearOpen R M (b i)).toScheme.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)]

    ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (linearOpen R M (b i)).toScheme.ringCatSheaf (op ⊤)).mapIso
      (twistingSheafOfBasisIndexLinearOpenIso R M b 1 i).symm).toLinearEquiv

    ((tautChartLocalSection R M b i m).app ⊤

    (a : Module.End ℚ M) (b : Module.End ℚ N) (h : P ∘ₗ a = b ∘ₗ P) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.end_sum_intertwines

    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, P ∘ₗ a i = b i ∘ₗ P) :
