name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.powerSeries_mul_coeff_intertwines
statement:
theorem powerSeries_mul_coeff_intertwines (P : M →ₗ[ℚ] N)
    (φ ψ : PowerSeries (Module.End ℚ M)) (φ' ψ' : PowerSeries (Module.End ℚ N))
    (hφ : ∀ n, P ∘ₗ PowerSeries.coeff n φ = PowerSeries.coeff n φ' ∘ₗ P)
    (hψ : ∀ n, P ∘ₗ PowerSeries.coeff n ψ = PowerSeries.coeff n ψ' ∘ₗ P) (n : ℕ) :
    P ∘ₗ PowerSeries.coeff n (φ * ψ) = PowerSeries.coeff n (φ' * ψ') ∘ₗ P
proof:
:= by
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
  apply end_sum_intertwines
  intro x hx
  simp only [Module.End.mul_eq_comp]
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_assoc, hφ x.1, LinearMap.comp_assoc,
    hψ x.2, ← LinearMap.comp_assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.powerSeries_pow_coeff_intertwines
statement:
theorem powerSeries_pow_coeff_intertwines (P : M →ₗ[ℚ] N)
    (φ : PowerSeries (Module.End ℚ M)) (ψ : PowerSeries (Module.End ℚ N))
    (h : ∀ n, P ∘ₗ PowerSeries.coeff n φ = PowerSeries.coeff n ψ ∘ₗ P)
    (j n : ℕ) : P ∘ₗ PowerSeries.coeff n (φ ^ j) =
      PowerSeries.coeff n (ψ ^ j) ∘ₗ P
proof:
:= by
  induction j generalizing n with
  | zero =>
    simp only [pow_zero, PowerSeries.coeff_one]
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · simp only [if_pos hn]
      change P ∘ₗ LinearMap.id = LinearMap.id ∘ₗ P
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_id, LinearMap.id_comp]
    · simp only [if_neg hn, LinearMap.comp_zero, LinearMap.zero_comp]
  | succ j ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, pow_succ]
    exact powerSeries_mul_coeff_intertwines P (φ ^ j) φ (ψ ^ j) ψ ih h n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.psumOp_intertwines
statement:
theorem psumOp_intertwines (P : M →ₗ[ℚ] N)
    (a : ℕ → Module.End ℚ M) (b : ℕ → Module.End ℚ N)
    (h : ∀ n, P ∘ₗ a n = b n ∘ₗ P) (n : ℕ) :
    P ∘ₗ psumOp a n = psumOp b n ∘ₗ P
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => simp only [psumOp, LinearMap.comp_zero, LinearMap.zero_comp]
  | succ n =>
    apply end_smul_intertwines
    apply powerSeries_mul_coeff_intertwines
    · intro j
      simp only [PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
      exact end_smul_intertwines P _ _ _ (h (j + 1))
    · intro j
      exact invOfUnit_coeff_intertwines P a b h j

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.chOfChern_intertwines
statement:
theorem chOfChern_intertwines (P : M →ₗ[ℚ] N)
    (a : ℕ → Module.End ℚ M) (b : ℕ → Module.End ℚ N)
    (h : ∀ n, P ∘ₗ a n = b n ∘ₗ P) (r n : ℕ) :
    P ∘ₗ chOfChern r a n = chOfChern r b n ∘ₗ P
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    apply end_smul_intertwines
    change P ∘ₗ LinearMap.id = LinearMap.id ∘ₗ P
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_id, LinearMap.id_comp]
  | succ n =>
    exact end_smul_intertwines P _ _ _ (psumOp_intertwines P a b h (n + 1))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.tdOfChern_intertwines
statement:
theorem tdOfChern_intertwines (P : M →ₗ[ℚ] N)
    (a : ℕ → Module.End ℚ M) (b : ℕ → Module.End ℚ N)
    (h : ∀ n, P ∘ₗ a n = b n ∘ₗ P) (n : ℕ) :
    P ∘ₗ tdOfChern a n = tdOfChern b n ∘ₗ P
proof:
:= by
  unfold tdOfChern
  apply end_sum_intertwines
  intro j hj
  apply end_smul_intertwines
  apply powerSeries_pow_coeff_intertwines
  intro m
  simp only [PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
  exact end_smul_intertwines P _ _ _ (psumOp_intertwines P a b h m)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.psumOp_chernOp_pull_flat
statement:
theorem psumOp_chernOp_pull_flat (L : Y.Modules) (r : ℕ)
    (hL : HasConstantRank Y L r) (i : ℕ) :
    totalPull ops g d hd ∘ₗ psumOp (chernOp ops cp L r hL) i =
      psumOp (chernOp ops cp ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj L) r
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X g L r hL)) i ∘ₗ totalPull ops g d hd
proof:
:=
  psumOp_intertwines (totalPull ops g d hd) _ _
    (fun n ↦ chernOp_pull_flat g ops cp d hd L r hL n) i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.chOp_pull_flat
statement:
theorem chOp_pull_flat (L : Y.Modules) (r : ℕ)
    (hL : HasConstantRank Y L r) (i : ℕ) :
    totalPull ops g d hd ∘ₗ chOp ops cp L r hL i =
      chOp ops cp ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj L) r
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X g L r hL) i ∘ₗ totalPull ops g d hd
proof:
:=
  chOfChern_intertwines (totalPull ops g d hd) _ _
    (fun n ↦ chernOp_pull_flat g ops cp d hd L r hL n) r i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.tdOp_pull_flat
statement:
theorem tdOp_pull_flat (L : Y.Modules) (r : ℕ)
    (hL : HasConstantRank Y L r) (i : ℕ) :
    totalPull ops g d hd ∘ₗ tdOp ops cp L r hL i =
      tdOp ops cp ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj L) r
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X g L r hL) i ∘ₗ totalPull ops g d hd
proof:
:=
  tdOfChern_intertwines (totalPull ops g d hd) _ _
    (fun n ↦ chernOp_pull_flat g ops cp d hd L r hL n) i

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.subRestriction_spans
statement:
theorem subRestriction_spans
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) (W : X.affineOpens)
    (hWc : W.1 ≤ c.affineOpen.1) :
    Submodule.span Γ(X, W.1)
      (Set.range (c.subRestriction W hWc)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply top_unique
  rw [← (C.restrictedSectionBasis i W.1
    (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left)).span_eq]
  apply Submodule.span_le.2
  rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
  apply Submodule.subset_span
  refine ⟨c.leftSectionBasis k, ?_⟩
  exact C.restrictedSectionBasis_trans i c.affineOpen.1 W.1
    c.affineOpen_le_left hWc k

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.subRestriction_isBaseChange
statement:
theorem subRestriction_isBaseChange
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) (W : X.affineOpens)
    (hWc : W.1 ≤ c.affineOpen.1) :
    let f
proof:
:= (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWc).op).hom
    letI : Algebra Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) Γ(X, W.1) := f.toAlgebra
    letI : Module Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1)) :=
      Module.compHom (E.val.obj (op W.1)) f
    letI : IsScalarTower Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) Γ(X, W.1)
        (E.val.obj (op W.1)) :=
      ⟨fun r t n ↦ by
        change (f r * t) • n = f r • t • n
        rw [mul_smul]⟩
    IsBaseChange Γ(X, W.1)
      (semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f
        (c.subRestriction W hWc)) := by
  dsimp only
  let f := (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWc).op).hom
  letI : Algebra Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) Γ(X, W.1) := f.toAlgebra
  letI : Module Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1)) :=
    Module.compHom (E.val.obj (op W.1)) f
  letI : IsScalarTower Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) Γ(X, W.1)
      (E.val.obj (op W.1)) :=
    ⟨fun r t n ↦ by
      change (f r * t) • n = f r • t • n
      rw [mul_smul]⟩
  let bA := c.leftSectionBasis
  let bW := C.restrictedSectionBasis i W.1
    (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left)
  let φ := semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f
    (c.subRestriction W hWc)
  have hfree :
      IsBaseChange Γ(X, W.1)
        (Finsupp.linearCombination Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) bW) :=
    IsBaseChange.of_basis Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) bW
  have hcomp :
      IsBaseChange Γ(X, W.1)
        ((Finsupp.linearCombination Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) bW).comp
          bA.repr.toLinearMap) :=
    IsBaseChange.comp_equiv bA.repr
      (Finsupp.linearCombination Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) bW) hfree
  have heq :
      (Finsupp.linearCombination Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) bW).comp
          bA.repr.toLinearMap = φ := by
    apply bA.ext
    intro k
    simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
      Function.comp_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self,
      Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul]
    dsimp only [bA, bW, φ]
    change C.restrictedSectionBasis i W.1
        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left) k =
      E.val.map (homOfLE hWc).op (c.leftSectionBasis k)
    exact (C.restrictedSectionBasis_trans i c.affineOpen.1 W.1
      c.affineOpen_le_left hWc k).symm
  change IsBaseChange Γ(X, W.1) φ
  rw [← heq]
  exact hcomp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.specMap_subRestriction_comp_isoSpec_inv
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem specMap_subRestriction_comp_isoSpec_inv
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) (W : X.affineOpens)
    (hWc : W.1 ≤ c.affineOpen.1) :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWc).op).hom) ≫
        c.affineOpen.2.isoSpec.inv =
      W.2.isoSpec.inv ≫ X.homOfLE hWc
proof:
:= by
  have hf :
      CommRingCat.ofHom
          (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWc).op).hom =
        X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWc).op := by
    apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
    rfl
  rw [hf]
  apply (cancel_epi W.2.isoSpec.hom).1
  simp only [Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  rw [IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_hom,
    Scheme.Opens.toSpecΓ_SpecMap_presheaf_map_assoc,
    ← c.affineOpen.2.isoSpec_hom]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.restrictionChartTo_comp_chartToBase
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem restrictionChartTo_comp_chartToBase
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    (s : C.I) (W : X.affineOpens) (hWs : W.1 ≤ C.U s)
    (hWc : W.1 ≤ c.affineOpen.1) :
    c.restrictionChartTo s W hWs hWc ≫ c.chartToBase =
      C.restrictionChartToBase s W hWs ≫ X.homOfLE hWc
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1)) :=
    Module.Free.of_basis (C.restrictedSectionBasis s W.1 hWs)
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1)) := by
    letI : Finite (C.basisIndex s) := C.basisIndex_finite s
    exact Module.Finite.of_basis (C.restrictedSectionBasis s W.1 hWs)
  change
    semilinearSymmetricProjMap
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWc).op).hom
        (c.subRestriction W hWc)
        (c.subRestriction_spans W hWc) ≫
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.toSpecZero
            (symGrading Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
              (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))) ≫
          Spec.map
            (degreeZeroAlgEquiv
              (R := Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1))
              (M := E.val.obj
                (op c.affineOpen.1))).symm.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.hom) ≫
        c.affineOpen.2.isoSpec.inv) =
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.toSpecZero
            (symGrading Γ(X, W.1)
              (E.val.obj (op W.1))) ≫
          Spec.map
            (degreeZeroAlgEquiv
              (R := Γ(X, W.1))
              (M := E.val.obj
                (op W.1))).symm.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.hom) ≫
        W.2.isoSpec.inv) ≫
      X.homOfLE hWc
  refine (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans ?_
  refine (congrArg (· ≫ _) (semilinearSymmetricProjMap_toSpec
    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWc).op).hom (c.subRestriction W hWc)
    (c.subRestriction_spans W hWc))).trans ?_
  refine (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans ?_
  refine (congrArg (_ ≫ ·) (c.specMap_subRestriction_comp_isoSpec_inv W hWc)).trans ?_
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.isPullback_restrictionChartTo
statement:
theorem isPullback_restrictionChartTo
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    (s : C.I) (W : X.affineOpens) (hWs : W.1 ≤ C.U s)
    (hWc : W.1 ≤ c.affineOpen.1) :
    IsPullback
      (c.restrictionChartTo s W hWs hWc)
      (C.restrictionChartToBase s W hWs)
      c.chartToBase
      (X.homOfLE hWc)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1)) :=
    Module.Free.of_basis (C.restrictedSectionBasis s W.1 hWs)
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1)) := by
    letI : Finite (C.basisIndex s) := C.basisIndex_finite s
    exact Module.Finite.of_basis (C.restrictedSectionBasis s W.1 hWs)
  have hSpec :
      IsPullback
        (semilinearSymmetricProjMap
          (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWc).op).hom
          (c.subRestriction W hWc)
          (c.subRestriction_spans W hWc))
        (intrinsicToSpec
          (R := Γ(X, W.1)) (M := E.val.obj (op W.1)))
        (intrinsicToSpec
          (R := Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1))
          (M := E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWc).op).hom)) :=
    isPullback_semilinearSymmetricProjMap_toSpec_of_isBaseChange
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWc).op).hom
      (c.subRestriction W hWc)
      (c.subRestriction_spans W hWc)
      (c.subRestriction_isBaseChange W hWc)
  have hmap :
      semilinearSymmetricProjMap
          (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWc).op).hom
          (c.subRestriction W hWc)
          (c.subRestriction_spans W hWc) =
        c.restrictionChartTo s W hWs hWc := by
    unfold restrictionChartTo
    rfl
  refine hSpec.of_iso
    (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _)
    W.2.isoSpec.symm c.affineOpen.2.isoSpec.symm
    (by
      exact (Category.comp_id _).trans
        (hmap.trans (Category.id_comp _).symm)) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · exact c.specMap_subRestriction_comp_isoSpec_inv W hWc

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.subRestriction_ringHom_comp
statement:
theorem subRestriction_ringHom_comp
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) (W : X.affineOpens)
    (hWc : W.1 ≤ c.affineOpen.1)
    (target : C.I) (hct : c.affineOpen.1 ≤ C.U target) :
    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWc).op).hom.comp
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hct).op).hom =
    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hWc.trans hct)).op).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro r
  change X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWc).op
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hct).op r) =
    X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hWc.trans hct)).op r
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← X.presheaf.map_comp]
  congr 2

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.subRestriction_comp_heq
statement:
theorem subRestriction_comp_heq
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) (W : X.affineOpens)
    (hWc : W.1 ≤ c.affineOpen.1)
    (target : C.I) (hct : c.affineOpen.1 ≤ C.U target)
    (φ : E.val.obj (op (C.U target)) →ₛₗ[
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hct).op).hom]
      E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))
    (hφ : ∀ m, φ m = E.val.map (homOfLE hct).op m) :
    HEq
      (semilinearMapComp
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hct).op).hom
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWc).op).hom
        φ (c.subRestriction W hWc))
      (directRestriction target W (hWc.trans hct))
proof:
:= by
  apply semilinearMap_heq_of_ringHom_eq
    (c.subRestriction_ringHom_comp W hWc target hct)
  intro m
  change E.val.map (homOfLE hWc).op (φ m) =
    E.val.map (homOfLE (hWc.trans hct)).op m
  rw [hφ, ← PresheafOfModules.map_comp_apply]
  congr 2

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.subRestriction_comp_spans
statement:
theorem subRestriction_comp_spans
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) (W : X.affineOpens)
    (hWc : W.1 ≤ c.affineOpen.1)
    (target : C.I) (hct : c.affineOpen.1 ≤ C.U target)
    (φ : E.val.obj (op (C.U target)) →ₛₗ[
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hct).op).hom]
      E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))
    (hφ : ∀ m, φ m = E.val.map (homOfLE hct).op m) :
    Submodule.span Γ(X, W.1)
      (Set.range
        (semilinearMapComp
          (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hct).op).hom
          (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWc).op).hom
          φ (c.subRestriction W hWc))) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hrange :
      Set.range
          (semilinearMapComp
            (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hct).op).hom
            (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWc).op).hom
            φ (c.subRestriction W hWc)) =
        Set.range (directRestriction target W (hWc.trans hct)) := by
    ext n
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨m, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
      change E.val.map (homOfLE (hWc.trans hct)).op m =
        E.val.map (homOfLE hWc).op (φ m)
      rw [hφ, ← PresheafOfModules.map_comp_apply]
      congr 2
    · rintro ⟨m, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
      change E.val.map (homOfLE hWc).op (φ m) =
        E.val.map (homOfLE (hWc.trans hct)).op m
      rw [hφ, ← PresheafOfModules.map_comp_apply]
      congr 2
  rw [hrange]
  exact C.restriction_spans target W.1 (hWc.trans hct)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.restrictionChartTo_comp
statement:
theorem restrictionChartTo_comp
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    (source : C.I) (W : X.affineOpens)
    (hWsource : W.1 ≤ C.U source)
    (hWc : W.1 ≤ c.affineOpen.1)
    (target : C.I) (hct : c.affineOpen.1 ≤ C.U target)
    (φ : E.val.obj (op (C.U target)) →ₛₗ[
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hct).op).hom]
      E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))
    (hφ : ∀ m, φ m = E.val.map (homOfLE hct).op m)
    (hφspans :
      Submodule.span Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (Set.range φ) = ⊤) :
    c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc ≫
        semilinearSymmetricProjMap
          (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hct).op).hom φ hφspans =
      directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource
        target (hWc.trans hct)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1)) :=
    Module.Free.of_basis
      (C.restrictedSectionBasis source W.1 hWsource)
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1)) := by
    letI : Finite (C.basisIndex source) :=
      C.basisIndex_finite source
    exact Module.Finite.of_basis
      (C.restrictedSectionBasis source W.1 hWsource)
  unfold restrictionChartTo directRestrictionChartMap
  refine Eq.trans
    (semilinearSymmetricProjMap_comp
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hct).op).hom
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWc).op).hom
      φ (c.subRestriction W hWc)
      hφspans (c.subRestriction_spans W hWc)
      (c.subRestriction_comp_spans W hWc target hct φ hφ)) ?_
  exact semilinearSymmetricProjMap_congr
    (c.subRestriction_ringHom_comp W hWc target hct)
    (semilinearMapComp
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hct).op).hom
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWc).op).hom
      φ (c.subRestriction W hWc))
    (directRestriction target W (hWc.trans hct))
    (c.subRestriction_comp_heq W hWc target hct φ hφ)
    (c.subRestriction_comp_spans W hWc target hct φ hφ)
    (C.restriction_spans target W.1 (hWc.trans hct))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.restrictionChartTo_comp_left
statement:
theorem restrictionChartTo_comp_left
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    (source : C.I) (W : X.affineOpens)
    (hWsource : W.1 ≤ C.U source)
    (hWc : W.1 ≤ c.affineOpen.1) :
    c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc ≫ c.chartToLeft =
      directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource i
        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left)
proof:
:= by
  exact c.restrictionChartTo_comp source W hWsource hWc
    i c.affineOpen_le_left c.leftRestriction
    (fun _ ↦ rfl) c.leftRestriction_spans

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.restrictionChartTo_comp_right
statement:
theorem restrictionChartTo_comp_right
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    (source : C.I) (W : X.affineOpens)
    (hWsource : W.1 ≤ C.U source)
    (hWc : W.1 ≤ c.affineOpen.1) :
    c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc ≫ c.chartToRight =
      directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource j
        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right)
proof:
:= by
  exact c.restrictionChartTo_comp source W hWsource hWc
    j c.affineOpen_le_right c.rightRestriction
    (fun _ ↦ rfl) c.rightRestriction_spans

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.directRestrictionChartMap_congr
statement:
theorem directRestrictionChartMap_congr
    (source target : C.I) (W : X.affineOpens)
    (hWs hWs' : W.1 ≤ C.U source)
    (hWt hWt' : W.1 ≤ C.U target) :
    HEq
      (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWs target hWt)
      (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWs' target hWt')
proof:
:= by
  cases Subsingleton.elim hWs hWs'

name: CategoryTheory.homEquiv_symm_comp_conjugate
statement:
theorem homEquiv_symm_comp_conjugate
    {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D]
    {L₁ L₂ : C ⥤ D} {R₁ R₂ : D ⥤ C}
    (a₁ : L₁ ⊣ R₁) (a₂ : L₂ ⊣ R₂) (α : L₂ ⟶ L₁)
    {N : C} {M : D} (c : N ⟶ R₁.obj M) :
    (a₂.homEquiv N M).symm (c ≫ (conjugateEquiv a₁ a₂ α).app M) =
      α.app N ≫ (a₁.homEquiv N M).symm c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Adjunction.homEquiv_counit, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  rw [conjugateEquiv_counit]
  rw [← α.naturality_assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullbackComponent_eq_restrictionProjection
statement:
theorem pullbackComponent_eq_restrictionProjection
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {I : Type u} (D : DescentData X I) (i : I)
    [IsOpenImmersion (D.toAmbient i)] :
    pullbackComponent D i =
      (restrictFunctorIsoPullback (D.toAmbient i)).inv.app D.descended ≫
        D.restrictionProjection i
proof:
:= by
  let f := D.toAmbient i
  have hc := Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq_hom_app_counit
    (restrictAdjunction f) (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f) (D.module i)
  change (restrictFunctorIsoPullback f).hom.app ((pushforward f).obj (D.module i)) ≫
      (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).counit.app (D.module i) =
      (restrictAdjunction f).counit.app (D.module i) at hc
  have hc' : (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).counit.app (D.module i) =
      (restrictFunctorIsoPullback f).inv.app ((pushforward f).obj (D.module i)) ≫
        (restrictAdjunction f).counit.app (D.module i) := by
    rw [← hc, Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc]
  unfold pullbackComponent DescentData.restrictionProjection
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_counit, hc']
  rw [← (restrictFunctorIsoPullback f).inv.naturality_assoc]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit_mate
statement:
theorem pushforwardPullbackUnit_mate
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    {N : X.Modules} {M : Y.Modules} (c : N ⟶ (pushforward f).obj M) :
    ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (g ≫ f)).homEquiv _ _).symm
      (c ≫ pushforwardPullbackUnit f g M) =
      (pullbackComp g f).inv.app N ≫
        (pullback g).map
          (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).homEquiv _ _).symm c)
proof:
:= by
  have hm := CategoryTheory.homEquiv_symm_comp_conjugate
    ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).comp (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g))
    (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (g ≫ f)) (pullbackComp g f).inv
    (c ≫ (pushforward f).map ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app M))
  rw [conjugateEquiv_pullbackComp_inv] at hm
  unfold pushforwardPullbackUnit
  rw [← Category.assoc, hm]
  congr 1
  rw [Adjunction.comp_homEquiv]
  change ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).homEquiv _ _).symm
    (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).homEquiv _ _).symm
      (c ≫ (pushforward f).map ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app M))) = _
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right_symm]
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left_symm, Adjunction.homEquiv_symm_unit]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.conjugateEquiv_pullbackCongr_hom
statement:
theorem conjugateEquiv_pullbackCongr_hom
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f g : Y ⟶ X} (h : f = g) :
    conjugateEquiv (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g)
      (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f) (pullbackCongr h).hom =
        (pushforwardCongr h).inv
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  have hp : pushforwardCongr (rfl : f = f) = Iso.refl (pushforward f) := by
    apply Iso.ext
    apply NatTrans.ext
    funext M
    exact pushforwardCongr_rfl f M
  rw [hp]
  simp [pullbackCongr]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr_symm_hom_eq_inv
statement:
theorem pushforwardCongr_symm_hom_eq_inv
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f g : Y ⟶ X} (h : f = g) :
    (pushforwardCongr h.symm).hom = (pushforwardCongr h).inv
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  have hp : pushforwardCongr (rfl : f = f) = Iso.refl (pushforward f) := by
    apply Iso.ext
    apply NatTrans.ext
    funext M
    exact pushforwardCongr_rfl f M
  rw [hp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr_mate
statement:
theorem pullbackCongr_mate
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f g : Y ⟶ X} (h : f = g)
    {N : X.Modules} {M : Y.Modules} (c : N ⟶ (pushforward g).obj M) :
    ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).homEquiv _ _).symm
      (c ≫ (pushforwardCongr h).inv.app M) =
      (pullbackCongr h).hom.app N ≫
        ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).homEquiv _ _).symm c
proof:
:= by
  have hm := CategoryTheory.homEquiv_symm_comp_conjugate
    (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g) (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f)
    (pullbackCongr h).hom c
  rw [conjugateEquiv_pullbackCongr_hom] at hm
  exact hm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullbackComponent_transition
statement:
theorem pullbackComponent_transition
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {I : Type u} (D : DescentData X I) (ij : I × I) :
    (pullbackComp (D.left ij) (D.toAmbient ij.1)).inv.app D.descended ≫
      (pullback (D.left ij)).map (pullbackComponent D ij.1) ≫
        (D.transition ij).hom =
      (pullbackCongr (D.fac ij)).hom.app D.descended ≫
        (pullbackComp (D.right ij) (D.toAmbient ij.2)).inv.app D.descended ≫
          (pullback (D.right ij)).map (pullbackComponent D ij.2)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg
    (fun a => a ≫ (pushforward (D.left ij ≫ D.toAmbient ij.1)).map
      (D.transition ij).hom) (D.component_compatibility ij)
  simp only [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id] at h
  rw [(pushforward (D.left ij ≫ D.toAmbient ij.1)).map_id, Category.comp_id] at h
  rw [pushforwardCongr_symm_hom_eq_inv (D.fac ij)] at h
  have hm := congrArg
    (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (D.left ij ≫ D.toAmbient ij.1)).homEquiv _ _).symm)
      h
  simp only [← Category.assoc] at hm
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right_symm,
    pushforwardPullbackUnit_mate, pullbackCongr_mate,
    pushforwardPullbackUnit_mate] at hm
  simpa only [Category.assoc, pullbackComponent] using hm

statement:
theorem canonicalTwist_pullbackComponent_eq (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (d : ℤ) (i : C.I) :
    Scheme.Modules.pullbackComponent
      (C.twistingSheafDescentData d (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d)) i =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (C.chartι i)).inv.app
        (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf d) ≫
          (C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso d i).hom
proof:
:= by

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistPullbackRecovery_eq
statement:
theorem canonicalTwistPullbackRecovery_eq (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (d : ℤ) (i : C.I) :
    C.canonicalTwistPullbackRecovery d i =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (C.chartι i)).inv.app
        (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf d) ≫
          (C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso d i).hom
proof:
:=

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwist_pullbackComponent_transition
statement:
theorem canonicalTwist_pullbackComponent_transition (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) :
    let D
proof:
:= C.twistingSheafDescentData d (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d)
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (D.left (i, j)) (D.toAmbient i)).inv.app D.descended ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (D.left (i, j))).map
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComponent D i) ≫ (D.transition (i, j)).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (D.fac (i, j))).hom.app D.descended ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (D.right (i, j)) (D.toAmbient j)).inv.app D.descended ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback (D.right (i, j))).map
            (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComponent D j) :=
  Scheme.Modules.pullbackComponent_transition
    (C.twistingSheafDescentData d (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d)) (i, j)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistChartIso_pullback_recovery
statement:
theorem transportTwistChartIso_pullback_recovery (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (i : C'.I) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback ((transport e C').chartι i)).inv.app
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (transportSchemeIso e C').hom).obj
          (C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)) ≫
      (transportTwistChartIso e C' i).hom ≫
        ((transport e C').canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 i).hom =
      (transportTwistPullbackChartIso e C' i).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [transportTwistChartIso, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.app_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistPullbackChartIso_recovery_formula
statement:
theorem transportTwistPullbackChartIso_recovery_formula (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (i : C'.I) :
    (transportTwistPullbackChartIso e C' i).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp ((transport e C').chartι i)
        (transportSchemeIso e C').hom).hom.app (C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (chartι_transportSchemeIso_hom e C' i)).hom.app
        (C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (chartIso e C' i).hom (C'.chartι i)).inv.app
        (C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (chartIso e C' i).hom).map
        (C'.canonicalTwistPullbackRecovery 1 i) ≫
      (chartTwistIso e C' i).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [canonicalTwistPullbackRecovery_eq]
  simp only [transportTwistPullbackChartIso, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom,
    Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.app_hom, Iso.app_inv]

name: SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorCongr_hom_sections
statement:
lemma restrictFunctorCongr_hom_sections {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f g : X ⟶ Y}
    [IsOpenImmersion f] [IsOpenImmersion g] (p : f = g) (M : Y.Modules) (U : X.Opens) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr p).hom.app M).app U =
      M.presheaf.map (eqToHom (show g ''ᵁ U = f ''ᵁ U by simp [p])).op
proof: := rfl

lemma restrictFunctor_map_sections {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion f]

    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).map a).app U = a.app (f ''ᵁ U)

name: SchemeKTheory.restrictIso_cast
statement:
lemma restrictIso_cast {X : Scheme.{u}} {U V : X.Opens} (p : U = V)
    (M N : X.Modules)
    (h : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj M ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj N) :
    let e : V.toScheme ⟶ U.toScheme
proof:
:= eqToHom (congrArg Scheme.Opens.toScheme p.symm)
    let f := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr (opens_eqToHom_comp_ι p.symm).symm ≪≫
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp e U.ι
    f.app M ≪≫ (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor e).mapIso h ≪≫ (f.app N).symm =
      (p ▸ h) := by
  subst V
  have hf : Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr
      (opens_eqToHom_comp_ι (rfl : U = U)).symm ≪≫
        Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp (𝟙 U.toScheme) U.ι =
      (Functor.rightUnitor (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι)).symm ≪≫
        Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι)
          Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorId.symm := by
    ext A W s
    simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, NatTrans.comp_app, Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app,
      restrictFunctorCongr_hom_sections,
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp_hom_app_app,
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft_hom, Functor.whiskerLeft_app,
      Functor.rightUnitor_inv_app, Category.id_comp,
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorId_inv_app_app]
    rw [← Functor.map_comp]
    rfl
  dsimp only
  simp only [eqToHom_refl]
  rw [hf]
  apply Iso.ext
  simp [(Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorId.inv.naturality h.hom).symm]

name: SchemeKTheory.restrictIso_cast_morphism
statement:
lemma restrictIso_cast_morphism {X : Scheme.{u}} {U V : X.Opens} (p : U = V)
    (e : V.toScheme ⟶ U.toScheme) [IsOpenImmersion e]
    (he : e = eqToHom (congrArg Scheme.Opens.toScheme p.symm))
    (comm : e ≫ U.ι = V.ι) (M N : X.Modules)
    (h : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj M ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj N) :
    let f
proof:
:= Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr comm.symm ≪≫
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp e U.ι
    f.app M ≪≫ (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor e).mapIso h ≪≫ (f.app N).symm =
      (p ▸ h) := by
  subst e
  exact restrictIso_cast p M N h

name: SchemeKTheory.restrictIsoFreeOnOpensRange_ι
statement:
lemma restrictIsoFreeOnOpensRange_ι {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.Opens)
    (M : X.Modules) (I : Type u)
    (h : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj M ≅
      SheafOfModules.free (R := U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) I) :
    (U.opensRange_ι ▸ restrictIsoFreeOnOpensRange U.ι M I h) ≪≫
      restrictFreeIso U.ι I = h
proof:
:= by
  have he : U.ι.isoOpensRange.hom = eqToHom (congrArg Scheme.Opens.toScheme U.opensRange_ι.symm) :=
    congrArg Iso.hom (opens_ι_isoOpensRange U)
  have hc := restrictIso_cast_morphism U.opensRange_ι U.ι.isoOpensRange.hom he
    U.ι.isoOpensRange_hom_ι M (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I)
    (restrictIsoFreeOnOpensRange U.ι M I h)
  have hr := restrictIsoFreeOnOpensRange_roundtrip U.ι M I h
  dsimp only at hc
  rw [← hc]
  exact hr

name: SchemeKTheory.freeFrame_eq_mp_eq_rec
statement:
lemma freeFrame_eq_mp_eq_rec {X : Scheme.{u}} {U V : X.Opens} (p : U = V)
    (M : X.Modules) (I : Type u)
    (a : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) I ≅ M.over U)
    (q : (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) I ≅ M.over U) =
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V) I ≅ M.over V)) :
    Eq.mp q a = (p ▸ a)
proof:
:= by
  subst V
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.freeFrame_cast_restrict
statement:
lemma freeFrame_cast_restrict {X : Scheme.{u}} {U V : X.Opens} (p : U = V)
    (M : X.Modules) (I : Type u)
    (a : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) I ≅ M.over U) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V).app M).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V).functor.mapIso
        (((freeOverIso X V I).symm ≪≫ (p ▸ a)).symm) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V).app (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I) =
    (p ▸ (((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app M).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.mapIso
        (((freeOverIso X U I).symm ≪≫ a).symm) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I)))
proof:
:= by
  subst V
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.freeTrivializationLocalFrame_ι_roundtrip
statement:
lemma freeTrivializationLocalFrame_ι_roundtrip {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.Opens)
    (M : X.Modules) (I : Type u)
    (h : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj M ≅
      SheafOfModules.free (R := U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) I) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app M).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.mapIso
        (((freeOverIso X U I).symm ≪≫
          (U.opensRange_ι ▸ freeTrivializationLocalFrame U.ι M I h)).symm) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I) ≪≫
      restrictFreeIso U.ι I = h
proof:
:= by
  have hc := freeFrame_cast_restrict U.opensRange_ι M I
    (freeTrivializationLocalFrame U.ι M I h)
  have ho : ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U.ι.opensRange).app M).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U.ι.opensRange).functor.mapIso
        (((freeOverIso X U.ι.opensRange I).symm ≪≫
          freeTrivializationLocalFrame U.ι M I h).symm) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U.ι.opensRange).app
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I) =
      restrictIsoFreeOnOpensRange U.ι M I h := by
    simpa [freeTrivializationLocalFrame] using
      overIsoFreeOnOpensRange_restrict_roundtrip U.ι M I h
  rw [ho] at hc
  have ht := congrArg (fun a => a ≪≫ restrictFreeIso U.ι I) hc
  rw [restrictIsoFreeOnOpensRange_ι] at ht
  simpa only [Iso.trans_assoc] using ht

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackFrameCover_frameRestrictIso
statement:
theorem pullbackFrameCover_frameRestrictIso (j : C.pullbackFrameIndex g) :
    (C.pullbackFrameCover g).frameRestrictIso j = C.pullbackFrameRestrictIso g j
proof:
:= by
  have hf : (C.pullbackFrameCover g).frame j =
      (show SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over (C.pullbackFrameOpen g j))
          (C.basisIndex j.1) ≅ ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).over (C.pullbackFrameOpen g j) from
        (C.pullbackFrameOpen g j).opensRange_ι ▸
        SchemeKTheory.freeTrivializationLocalFrame (C.pullbackFrameOpen g j).ι
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E) (C.basisIndex j.1)
          (C.pullbackFrameRestrictIso g j)) := by
    exact SchemeKTheory.freeFrame_eq_mp_eq_rec (C.pullbackFrameOpen g j).opensRange_ι
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E) (C.basisIndex j.1) _ _
  unfold frameRestrictIso globalFreeFrame
  rw [hf]
  exact SchemeKTheory.freeTrivializationLocalFrame_ι_roundtrip
    (C.pullbackFrameOpen g j) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
    (C.basisIndex j.1) (C.pullbackFrameRestrictIso g j)

name: SchemeKTheory.restrictFreeIso_unit_generator
statement:
lemma restrictFreeIso_unit_generator {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (I : Type u) (k : I) (U : Y.Opens) :
    (restrictFreeIso q I).hom.app (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).unit.app
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I)).app U
          ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op U))) =
      (SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op (q ⁻¹ᵁ U))
proof:
:= by
  have hu := congrArg (fun a => a.app U ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op U)))
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback_unit_coherence q
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I))
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app,
    ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hu
  have hf := SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.adjUnit_pullbackFreeIso_apply q I k (op U)
  change (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso q I).hom.app (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q).unit.app
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I)).app U
        ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op U))) = _ at hf
  change (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso q I).hom.app (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)
    (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).hom.app
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I)).app (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)
        (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I)).app U
            ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op U)))) = _
  exact (congrArg (fun x => (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso q I).hom.app (q ⁻¹ᵁ U) x) hu).trans hf

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.frameRestrictIso_unit_basis
statement:
lemma frameRestrictIso_unit_basis (i : C.I) (k : C.basisIndex i) :
    (C.frameRestrictIso i).hom.app ((C.U i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i)
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction (C.U i).ι).unit.app E).app (C.U i)
        (C.sectionBasis i k)) =
      (SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op ((C.U i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sectionBasis_apply_frame]
  simp only [frameRestrictIso, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom,
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.app_hom, Iso.app_inv,
    SchemeKTheory.overFunctorEquiv_hom_sections,
    SchemeKTheory.overFunctorEquiv_inv_sections, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
    ConcreteCategory.id_apply, SchemeKTheory.overEquiv_map_sections]
  change (SchemeKTheory.restrictFreeIso (C.U i).ι (C.basisIndex i)).hom.app
    ((C.U i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i)
      (((C.globalFreeFrame i).inv.val.app
        (op (Over.mk (homOfLE ((C.U i).ι_image_le ((C.U i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i)))))).hom
        (E.presheaf.map (homOfLE ((C.U i).ι.image_preimage_le (C.U i))).op
          (((C.globalFreeFrame i).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 (C.U i))))).hom
            ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op (C.U i)))))) = _
  let A : Over (C.U i) := Over.mk (𝟙 (C.U i))
  let B : Over (C.U i) := Over.mk
    (homOfLE ((C.U i).ι_image_le ((C.U i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i)))
  let t : B ⟶ A := Over.homMk (homOfLE ((C.U i).ι.image_preimage_le (C.U i)))
  let F := (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf (X.ringCatSheaf.over (C.U i)).obj).obj
  let H := PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf (X.ringCatSheaf.over (C.U i)).obj
  let ah := H.map (C.globalFreeFrame i).hom.val
  let ai := H.map (C.globalFreeFrame i).inv.val
  have ht := ai.naturality t.op
  have hi : ah.app (op A) ≫ ai.app (op A) = 𝟙 _ := by
    have hv : (C.globalFreeFrame i).hom.val ≫ (C.globalFreeFrame i).inv.val = 𝟙 _ :=
      congrArg (fun a => a.val) (C.globalFreeFrame i).hom_inv_id
    change (H.map (C.globalFreeFrame i).hom.val).app (op A) ≫
      (H.map (C.globalFreeFrame i).inv.val).app (op A) = _
    rw [← NatTrans.comp_app, ← Functor.map_comp, hv]
    rfl
  have hn : ah.app (op A) ≫ (F (E.over (C.U i)).val).map t.op ≫ ai.app (op B) =
      (F ((SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (C.basisIndex i )).over (C.U i)).val).map t.op := by
    rw [ht, ← Category.assoc, hi, Category.id_comp]
  have hs := congrArg (fun a => a.hom ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op (C.U i)))) hn
  change ((C.globalFreeFrame i).inv.val.app (op B)).hom
      (E.presheaf.map (homOfLE ((C.U i).ι.image_preimage_le (C.U i))).op
        (((C.globalFreeFrame i).hom.val.app (op A)).hom
          ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op (C.U i))))) =
    (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction (C.U i).ι).unit.app
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (C.basisIndex i))).app (C.U i)
        ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op (C.U i)))) at hs
  exact (congrArg (fun x => (SchemeKTheory.restrictFreeIso (C.U i).ι (C.basisIndex i)).hom.app
    ((C.U i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i) x) hs).trans
      (SchemeKTheory.restrictFreeIso_unit_generator (C.U i).ι (C.basisIndex i) k (C.U i))

name: SchemeKTheory.squareFrame_unit_generator
statement:
lemma squareFrame_unit_generator {X Y W V : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : X ⟶ Y) (q : W ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (v : V ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion v] (f : W ⟶ V) (comm : q ≫ g = f ≫ v)
    (M : Y.Modules) (I : Type u)
    (a : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).obj M ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := V.ringCatSheaf) I)
    (U : Y.Opens) (s : M.val.obj (op U)) (k : I)
    (hs : a.hom.app (v ⁻¹ᵁ U) (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction v).unit.app M).app U s) =
      (SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op (v ⁻¹ᵁ U))) :
    (((pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso g q v f comm).app M ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).mapIso a ≪≫ AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f I).hom).app
        (q ⁻¹ᵁ g ⁻¹ᵁ U)
          (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).unit.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj M)).app
            (g ⁻¹ᵁ U) (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app M).app U s)) =
    (SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op (q ⁻¹ᵁ g ⁻¹ᵁ U))
proof:
:= by
  let x := ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction v).unit.app M).app U s
  let z := ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).obj M)).app (v ⁻¹ᵁ U) x
  let b := (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map a.hom ≫ (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f I).hom
  have hu := Scheme.Modules.pullbackRestrictSquare_unit_sections g q v f comm M U s
  have hc := congrArg (fun t => t.app U z)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr comm.symm).hom.naturality b)
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app,
    ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hc
  have hn := congrArg (fun t => t.app (v ⁻¹ᵁ U) x)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.naturality a.hom)
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hn
  have hb : b.app (f ⁻¹ᵁ v ⁻¹ᵁ U) z =
      (SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op (f ⁻¹ᵁ v ⁻¹ᵁ U)) := by
    have ht := congrArg (fun t => (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f I).hom.app
      (f ⁻¹ᵁ v ⁻¹ᵁ U) t) hn.symm
    have ht2 := congrArg (fun t => (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f I).hom.app
      (f ⁻¹ᵁ v ⁻¹ᵁ U) (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := V.ringCatSheaf) I)).app (v ⁻¹ᵁ U) t)) hs
    exact ht.trans (ht2.trans (SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.adjUnit_pullbackFreeIso_apply f I k (op (v ⁻¹ᵁ U))))
  have hcast : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr comm.symm).hom.app
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := W.ringCatSheaf) I)).app U
        ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op (f ⁻¹ᵁ v ⁻¹ᵁ U))) =
      (SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op (q ⁻¹ᵁ g ⁻¹ᵁ U)) := by
    simp only [Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr_hom_app_app]
    exact (SheafOfModules.freeSection k).property (eqToHom _).op
  change b.app (q ⁻¹ᵁ g ⁻¹ᵁ U)
    (((pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso g q v f comm).hom.app M).app (q ⁻¹ᵁ g ⁻¹ᵁ U)
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).unit.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj M)).app
        (g ⁻¹ᵁ U) (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app M).app U s))) = _
  have ht := congrArg (fun t => b.app (q ⁻¹ᵁ g ⁻¹ᵁ U) t) hu.symm
  exact ht.trans (hc.symm.trans ((congrArg (fun t => ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr comm.symm).hom.app
    (SheafOfModules.free (R := W.ringCatSheaf) I)).app U t) hb).trans hcast))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackFrameSectionMap_unit_generator
statement:
lemma pullbackFrameSectionMap_unit_generator (j : C.pullbackFrameIndex g) (k : C.basisIndex j.1) :
    (C.pullbackFrameRestrictIso g j).hom.app ((C.pullbackFrameOpen g j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ C.pullbackFrameOpen g j)
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction (C.pullbackFrameOpen g j).ι).unit.app
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)).app (C.pullbackFrameOpen g j)
          (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap g j (C.sectionBasis j.1 k))) =
    (SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval
      (op ((C.pullbackFrameOpen g j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ C.pullbackFrameOpen g j))
proof:
:= by
  let q := (C.pullbackFrameOpen g j).ι
  let M := (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E
  let a : M ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).obj
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := (C.pullbackFrameOpen g j).toScheme.ringCatSheaf) (C.basisIndex j.1)) :=
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).unit.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map (C.pullbackFrameRestrictIso g j).hom
  have htop := SchemeKTheory.squareFrame_unit_generator g q (C.U j.1).ι
    (C.pullbackFrameMap g j) (C.pullbackFrameMap_comp_ι g j).symm E (C.basisIndex j.1)
    (C.frameRestrictIso j.1) (C.U j.1) (C.sectionBasis j.1 k) k
    (C.frameRestrictIso_unit_basis j.1 k)
  have hn := congrArg (fun t => t.hom
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app E).app (C.U j.1)
        (C.sectionBasis j.1 k))) (a.val.naturality (homOfLE j.2.2).op)
  change a.app (C.pullbackFrameOpen g j)
    (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap g j (C.sectionBasis j.1 k)) =
      ((SheafOfModules.free (R := (C.pullbackFrameOpen g j).toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
        (C.basisIndex j.1)).val.map ((Opens.map q.base).map (homOfLE j.2.2)).op).hom
          (a.app (g ⁻¹ᵁ C.U j.1)
            (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app E).app (C.U j.1)
              (C.sectionBasis j.1 k))) at hn
  change a.app (g ⁻¹ᵁ C.U j.1)
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app E).app (C.U j.1)
      (C.sectionBasis j.1 k)) = _ at htop
  have ht := congrArg (fun s => ((SheafOfModules.free
    (R := (C.pullbackFrameOpen g j).toScheme.ringCatSheaf) (C.basisIndex j.1)).val.map
      ((Opens.map q.base).map (homOfLE j.2.2)).op).hom s) htop
  exact hn.trans (ht.trans ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).property
    ((Opens.map q.base).map (homOfLE j.2.2)).op))

name: SchemeKTheory.restrictUnit_ι_injective
statement:
lemma restrictUnit_ι_injective {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.Opens) (M : X.Modules) :
    Function.Injective (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction U.ι).unit.app M).app U)
proof:
:= by
  have p : U.ι ''ᵁ U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U = U := by simp
  have he : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction U.ι).unit.app M).app U =
      M.presheaf.map (eqToHom p).op := by
    simp only [Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app]
    congr 2
  have hi : M.presheaf.map (eqToHom p).op ≫ M.presheaf.map (eqToHom p.symm).op = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [← Functor.map_comp]
    simp
  rw [he]
  intro s t h
  have ht := congrArg (fun z => M.presheaf.map (eqToHom p.symm).op z) h
  change (M.presheaf.map (eqToHom p).op ≫ M.presheaf.map (eqToHom p.symm).op).hom s =
    (M.presheaf.map (eqToHom p).op ≫ M.presheaf.map (eqToHom p.symm).op).hom t at ht
  rw [hi] at ht
  exact ht

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackFrameSectionMap_basis
statement:
theorem pullbackFrameSectionMap_basis (j : C.pullbackFrameIndex g) (k : C.basisIndex j.1) :
    C.pullbackFrameSectionMap g j (C.sectionBasis j.1 k) = (C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionBasis j k
proof:
:= by
  apply SchemeKTheory.restrictUnit_ι_injective (C.pullbackFrameOpen g j) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
  let e := (SheafOfModules.evaluation (C.pullbackFrameOpen g j).toScheme.ringCatSheaf
    (op ((C.pullbackFrameOpen g j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ C.pullbackFrameOpen g j))).mapIso (C.pullbackFrameRestrictIso g j)
  apply e.toLinearEquiv.injective
  change (C.pullbackFrameRestrictIso g j).hom.app ((C.pullbackFrameOpen g j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ C.pullbackFrameOpen g j)
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction (C.pullbackFrameOpen g j).ι).unit.app
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)).app (C.pullbackFrameOpen g j)
          (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap g j (C.sectionBasis j.1 k))) = _
  have hd := (C.pullbackFrameCover g).frameRestrictIso_unit_basis j k
  rw [C.pullbackFrameCover_frameRestrictIso g j] at hd
  exact (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap_unit_generator g j k).trans hd.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackFrameSectionMap_isBaseChange
statement:
theorem pullbackFrameSectionMap_isBaseChange (j : C.pullbackFrameIndex g) :
    let f
proof:
:= PullbackFrameSections.coefficientMap g (C.U j.1) (C.pullbackFrameOpen g j) j.2.2
    let N := ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.obj (op (C.pullbackFrameOpen g j))
    letI : Algebra Γ(Y, C.U j.1) Γ(X, C.pullbackFrameOpen g j) := f.toAlgebra
    letI : Module Γ(Y, C.U j.1) N := Module.compHom N f
    letI : IsScalarTower Γ(Y, C.U j.1) Γ(X, C.pullbackFrameOpen g j) N :=
      ⟨fun r s n ↦ by change (f r * s) • n = f r • s • n; rw [mul_smul]⟩
    IsBaseChange Γ(X, C.pullbackFrameOpen g j) (semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f
      (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap g j)) := by
  dsimp only
  let f := PullbackFrameSections.coefficientMap g (C.U j.1) (C.pullbackFrameOpen g j) j.2.2
  let N := ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.obj (op (C.pullbackFrameOpen g j))
  letI : Algebra Γ(Y, C.U j.1) Γ(X, C.pullbackFrameOpen g j) := f.toAlgebra
  letI : Module Γ(Y, C.U j.1) N := Module.compHom N f
  letI : IsScalarTower Γ(Y, C.U j.1) Γ(X, C.pullbackFrameOpen g j) N :=
    ⟨fun r s n ↦ by change (f r * s) • n = f r • s • n; rw [mul_smul]⟩
  let bU := C.sectionBasis j.1
  let bV : Module.Basis (C.basisIndex j.1) Γ(X, C.pullbackFrameOpen g j) N :=
    (C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionBasis j
  let φ := semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap g j)
  have hfree : IsBaseChange Γ(X, C.pullbackFrameOpen g j)
      (Finsupp.linearCombination Γ(Y, C.U j.1) bV) :=
    IsBaseChange.of_basis Γ(Y, C.U j.1) bV
  have hcomp := IsBaseChange.comp_equiv bU.repr
    (Finsupp.linearCombination Γ(Y, C.U j.1) bV) hfree
  have heq : (Finsupp.linearCombination Γ(Y, C.U j.1) bV).comp bU.repr.toLinearMap = φ := by
    apply bU.ext
    intro i
    simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, Function.comp_apply,
      Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul]
    exact (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap_basis g j i).symm
  change IsBaseChange Γ(X, C.pullbackFrameOpen g j) φ
  rw [← heq]
  exact hcomp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.whitneyConv_pull_convolution
statement:
theorem whitneyConv_pull_convolution {φ : CharAssign k} {lv : LineVal k}
    (hφ : IsNaturalChar ops φ lv) {Y : Scheme.{u}} [Y.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian Y] (g : Y ⟶ X) [g.IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat g]
    (d : ℕ) (hd : PureRelDim g d) {A D : X.Modules}
    (hA : IsFiniteLocallyFree X A) (hD : IsFiniteLocallyFree X D) (n : ℕ) :
    totalPull ops g d hd ∘ₗ (∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, φ X A p.1 ∘ₗ φ X D p.2) =
      ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n,
        φ Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj A) p.1 ∘ₗ
          φ Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj D) p.2 ∘ₗ totalPull ops g d hd
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro α
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ ↦ ?_
  have a := LinearMap.congr_fun (hφ.natural g d hd A hA p.1) (φ X D p.2 α)
  have b := LinearMap.congr_fun (hφ.natural g d hd D hD p.2) α
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at a b
  rw [a, b]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.whitneyConv_descent
statement:
theorem whitneyConv_descent {φ : CharAssign k} {lv : LineVal k}
    (hφ : IsNaturalChar ops φ lv) {Y : Scheme.{u}} [Y.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian Y] (g : Y ⟶ X) [g.IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat g]
    (d : ℕ) (hd : PureRelDim g d) (hinj : Function.Injective (totalPull ops g d hd))
    {A B D : X.Modules} (hA : IsFiniteLocallyFree X A) (hB : IsFiniteLocallyFree X B)
    (hD : IsFiniteLocallyFree X D)
    (h : WhitneyConv (X := Y) φ ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj A)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj B) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj D)) :
    WhitneyConv (X := X) φ A B D
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro α
  apply hinj
  have h1 := LinearMap.congr_fun (hφ.natural g d hd B hB n) α
  have h2 := LinearMap.congr_fun (whitneyConv_pull_convolution ops hφ g d hd hA hD n) α
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at h1 h2
  rw [h1, h2, h n]
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.whitneyConv_descent_splitting
statement:
theorem whitneyConv_descent_splitting {φ : CharAssign k} {lv : LineVal k}
    (hφ : IsNaturalChar ops φ lv) {E : X.Modules} {e : ℕ} (S : ChowSplitting ops E e)
    {A B D : X.Modules} (hA : IsFiniteLocallyFree X A) (hB : IsFiniteLocallyFree X B)
    (hD : IsFiniteLocallyFree X D)
    (h : WhitneyConv (X := S.Y) φ ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj A)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj B) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj D)) :
    WhitneyConv (X := X) φ A B D
proof:
:=
  whitneyConv_descent ops hφ S.q S.d S.hd S.injective hA hB hD h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.directSum_whitney_reduces_to_flag_tops
statement:
theorem directSum_whitney_reduces_to_flag_tops
    (hA : IsFiniteLocallyFree X A) (hD : IsFiniteLocallyFree X D)
    (hAD : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (A ⊞ D))
    (S : ChowSplitting ops A e)
    (T : ChowSplitting ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj D) f)
    (h : WhitneyConv (X := T.Y) (geometricChernAssign ops cp)
      ((directSumLeftSplitting ops cp S T).F e) ((directSumLeftSplitting ops cp S T).F e ⊞
        (directSumRightSplitting ops cp S T).F f) ((directSumRightSplitting ops cp S T).F f)) :
    WhitneyConv (X := X) (geometricChernAssign ops cp) A (A ⊞ D) D
proof:
:= by
  have hnat := geometricChernAssign_isNatural ops cp
  letI : (directSumLeftSplitting ops cp S T).q.IsOver (Spk k) :=
    (directSumLeftSplitting ops cp S T).instIsOver
  refine whitneyConv_descent_splitting ops hnat (directSumLeftSplitting ops cp S T) hA hAD hD ?_
  obtain ⟨bA⟩ := (directSumLeftSplitting ops cp S T).top
  obtain ⟨bD⟩ := (directSumRightSplitting ops cp S T).top
  obtain ⟨bAD⟩ := directSum_common_top ops cp S T
  intro n
  have e1 := hnat.iso (X := T.Y) ⟨bA.symm⟩
  have e2 := hnat.iso (X := T.Y) ⟨bD.symm⟩
  have e3 := hnat.iso (X := T.Y) ⟨bAD⟩
  have h' := h n
  refine (congrFun e3 n).trans (h'.trans (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ ↦ ?_))
  rw [← congrFun e1 p.1, ← congrFun e2 p.2]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.iSup_pullbackFrameOpen
statement:
theorem iSup_pullbackFrameOpen (i : C.I) :
    (⨆ V : {V : X.affineOpens // V.1 ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i}, V.1.1) = g ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact iSup_le fun V => V.2
  · obtain ⟨κ, hsub, heq⟩ := Opens.isBasis_iff_cover.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens (g ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i)
    calc
      g ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i = sSup κ := heq
      _ ≤ _ := by
        refine sSup_le fun V hV => ?_
        exact le_iSup_of_le ⟨⟨V, hsub hV⟩, heq.symm ▸ le_sSup hV⟩ le_rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackFrameOpen_covers
statement: theorem pullbackFrameOpen_covers : IsOpenCover (C.pullbackFrameOpen g)
proof:
:= by
  change (⨆ j : C.pullbackFrameIndex g, j.2.1.1) = ⊤
  unfold pullbackFrameIndex
  rw [iSup_sigma]
  simp_rw [C.iSup_pullbackFrameOpen g]
  exact g.iSup_preimage_eq_top C.covers

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackFrameMap_comp_ι

@[reassoc]
theorem pullbackFrameMap_comp_ι (j : C.pullbackFrameIndex g) :

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.sectionBasis_transport
statement:
theorem sectionBasis_transport (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    (i : C'.I) (k : C'.basisIndex i) :
    (sectionLinearEquivOfIso e (C'.U i))
      ((transport e C').sectionBasis i k) = C'.sectionBasis i k
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sectionBasis_apply_frame, sectionLinearEquivOfIso, globalFreeFrame, transport,
    Iso.trans_hom]
  change e.hom.app (C'.U i) (e.inv.app (C'.U i) _) = _
  change (sectionLinearEquivOfIso e (C'.U i))
      ((sectionLinearEquivOfIso e (C'.U i)).symm _) = _
  exact LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.sectionBasis_transport_symm
statement:
theorem sectionBasis_transport_symm (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    (i : C'.I) (k : C'.basisIndex i) :
    (sectionLinearEquivOfIso e (C'.U i)).symm (C'.sectionBasis i k) =
      (transport e C').sectionBasis i k
proof:
:= by
  apply (sectionLinearEquivOfIso e (C'.U i)).injective
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, sectionBasis_transport]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.chartIso_preimage_linearOpen
statement:
theorem chartIso_preimage_linearOpen (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (i : C'.I) (k : C'.basisIndex i) :
    (chartIso e C' i).hom ⁻¹ᵁ basisLinearOpen C' i k =
      basisLinearOpen (transport e C') i k
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C'.U i) (E'.val.obj (op (C'.U i))) :=
    C'.sectionModule_free i
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C'.U i) (E'.val.obj (op (C'.U i))) :=
    C'.sectionModule_finite i
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C'.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C'.U i))) :=
    (transport e C').sectionModule_free i
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C'.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C'.U i))) :=
    (transport e C').sectionModule_finite i
  let f : E'.val.obj (op (C'.U i)) →ₗ[Γ(X, C'.U i)]
      E.val.obj (op (C'.U i)) := (sectionLinearEquivOfIso e (C'.U i)).symm
  have hs : Submodule.span Γ(X, C'.U i) (Set.range f) = ⊤ := by
    have hf : Set.range f = Set.univ := Set.range_eq_univ.mpr
      (sectionLinearEquivOfIso e (C'.U i)).symm.surjective
    rw [hf, Submodule.span_univ]
  change (symmetricProjMap
    f hs) ⁻¹ᵁ
      linearOpen Γ(X, C'.U i) (E'.val.obj (op (C'.U i)))
        (C'.sectionBasis i k) =
      linearOpen Γ(X, C'.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C'.U i)))
        ((transport e C').sectionBasis i k)
  rw [symmetricProjMap_preimage_linearOpen]
  exact congrArg (linearOpen Γ(X, C'.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C'.U i))))
    (show f (C'.sectionBasis i k) = (transport e C').sectionBasis i k from
      sectionBasis_transport_symm e C' i k)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.chartIso_preimage_linearOverlapOpen
statement:
theorem chartIso_preimage_linearOverlapOpen (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (i : C'.I)
    (k l : C'.basisIndex i) :
    (chartIso e C' i).hom ⁻¹ᵁ basisLinearOverlapOpen C' i k l =
      basisLinearOverlapOpen (transport e C') i k l
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C'.U i) (E'.val.obj (op (C'.U i))) :=
    C'.sectionModule_free i
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C'.U i) (E'.val.obj (op (C'.U i))) :=
    C'.sectionModule_finite i
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C'.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C'.U i))) :=
    (transport e C').sectionModule_free i
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C'.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C'.U i))) :=
    (transport e C').sectionModule_finite i
  let f : E'.val.obj (op (C'.U i)) →ₗ[Γ(X, C'.U i)]
      E.val.obj (op (C'.U i)) := (sectionLinearEquivOfIso e (C'.U i)).symm
  have hs : Submodule.span Γ(X, C'.U i) (Set.range f) = ⊤ := by
    have hf : Set.range f = Set.univ := Set.range_eq_univ.mpr
      (sectionLinearEquivOfIso e (C'.U i)).symm.surjective
    rw [hf, Submodule.span_univ]
  change (symmetricProjMap
    f hs) ⁻¹ᵁ
      linearOverlapOpen Γ(X, C'.U i) (E'.val.obj (op (C'.U i)))
        (C'.sectionBasis i k) (C'.sectionBasis i l) =
      linearOverlapOpen Γ(X, C'.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C'.U i)))
        ((transport e C').sectionBasis i k)
        ((transport e C').sectionBasis i l)
  rw [symmetricProjMap_preimage_linearOverlapOpen]
  exact congrArg₂
    (linearOverlapOpen Γ(X, C'.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C'.U i))))
    (show f (C'.sectionBasis i k) = (transport e C').sectionBasis i k from
      sectionBasis_transport_symm e C' i k)
    (show f (C'.sectionBasis i l) = (transport e C').sectionBasis i l from
      sectionBasis_transport_symm e C' i l)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentNonnegativeVertices_nonempty_iff_not_allNegative
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentNonnegativeVertices_nonempty_iff_not_allNegative
    (e : CoordinateLaurentExponent n) :
    (coordinateLaurentNonnegativeVertices n e).Nonempty ↔
      ¬e.AllNegative n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩ hall
    have hei : 0 ≤ e i :=
      (mem_coordinateLaurentNonnegativeVertices n e i).mp hi
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hei) (hall i)
  · intro h
    by_contra hempty
    apply h
    intro i
    have hi : i ∉ coordinateLaurentNonnegativeVertices n e := by
      intro hi
      exact hempty ⟨i, hi⟩
    have : ¬0 ≤ e i := by
      simpa only [mem_coordinateLaurentNonnegativeVertices] using hi
    omega

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentDefaultContractionVertex_nonnegative_of_not_allNegative
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentDefaultContractionVertex_nonnegative_of_not_allNegative
    (e : CoordinateLaurentExponent n) (h : ¬e.AllNegative n) :
    0 ≤ e (coordinateLaurentDefaultContractionVertex n e)
proof:
:=
  coordinateLaurentDefaultContractionVertex_nonnegative n e
    ((coordinateLaurentNonnegativeVertices_nonempty_iff_not_allNegative n e).2 h)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentAllNegativePieceProjection_apply_coeff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateLaurentAllNegativePieceProjection_apply_coeff
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : coordinateLaurentPiece k n d p a)
    (e : CoordinateLaurentExponent n) :
    (coordinateLaurentAllNegativePieceProjection k n d p a x).1 e =
      if e.AllNegative n then x.1 e else 0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjection_apply_coeff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjection_apply_coeff

    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (e : CoordinateLaurentExponent n) :
    (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjection k n d p x a).1 e =
      if e.AllNegative n then (x a).1 e else 0
proof:

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentObstructionContractionPolynomial_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateLaurentObstructionContractionPolynomial_apply
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (x : coordinateLaurentHigherTerm k n d (p + 1))
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (e : CoordinateLaurentExponent n) :
    coordinateLaurentObstructionContractionPolynomial k n d p x a e =
      if e.AllNegative n then 0
      else (x (Fin.cons (coordinateLaurentDefaultContractionVertex n e) a)).1 e
proof:
:= by
  simp [coordinateLaurentObstructionContractionPolynomial, Finsupp.onFinset_apply]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentObstructionContractionPolynomial_mem_piece
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentObstructionContractionPolynomial_mem_piece
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (x : coordinateLaurentHigherTerm k n d (p + 1))
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateLaurentObstructionContractionPolynomial k n d p x a ∈
      coordinateLaurentPiece k n d p a
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  rw [coordinateLaurentObstructionContractionPolynomial_apply] at he
  by_cases hall : e.AllNegative n
  · simp [hall] at he
  · simp only [hall, ↓reduceIte] at he
    let i := coordinateLaurentDefaultContractionVertex n e
    have hsource := (x (Fin.cons i a)).2 e he
    obtain ⟨hdegree, hallowed⟩ := hsource
    have hi : 0 ≤ e i :=
      coordinateLaurentDefaultContractionVertex_nonnegative_of_not_allNegative n e hall
    exact ⟨hdegree, (e.allowedOn_cons_iff n i hi p a).mp hallowed⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentObstructionContraction_apply_coeff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateLaurentObstructionContraction_apply_coeff
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (x : coordinateLaurentHigherTerm k n d (p + 1))
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (e : CoordinateLaurentExponent n) :
    ((coordinateLaurentObstructionContraction k n d p x a).1 e) =
      if e.AllNegative n then 0
      else (x (Fin.cons (coordinateLaurentDefaultContractionVertex n e) a)).1 e
proof:
:=
  coordinateLaurentObstructionContractionPolynomial_apply k n d p x a e

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_allNegativeProjection
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_allNegativeProjection
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (x : coordinateLaurentHigherTerm k n d p) :
    coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d p
        (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjection k n d p x) =
      coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjection k n d (p + 1)
        (coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d p x)
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro e
  by_cases hall : e.AllNegative n
  · simp [coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_apply_coeff, hall]
  · simp [coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_apply_coeff, hall]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_obstructionContraction
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_obstructionContraction
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (x : coordinateLaurentHigherTerm k n d (p + 1)) :
    coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d p
          (coordinateLaurentObstructionContraction k n d p x) +
        coordinateLaurentObstructionContraction k n d (p + 1)
          (coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d (p + 1) x) =
      x - coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjection k n d (p + 1) x
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro e
  by_cases hall : e.AllNegative n
  · change
      (coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d p
          (coordinateLaurentObstructionContraction k n d p x) a).1 e +
        (coordinateLaurentObstructionContraction k n d (p + 1)
          (coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d (p + 1) x) a).1 e =
        (x a).1 e -
          (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjection k n d (p + 1) x a).1 e
    simp only [coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_apply_coeff,
      coordinateLaurentObstructionContraction_apply_coeff,
      coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjection_apply_coeff, hall, if_pos,
      mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero, sub_self]
  · change
      (coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d p
          (coordinateLaurentObstructionContraction k n d p x) a).1 e +
        (coordinateLaurentObstructionContraction k n d (p + 1)
          (coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d (p + 1) x) a).1 e =
        (x a).1 e -
          (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjection k n d (p + 1) x a).1 e
    simp only [coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_apply_coeff,
      coordinateLaurentObstructionContraction_apply_coeff,
      coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjection_apply_coeff, hall, ↓reduceIte, sub_zero]
    exact alternating_prepend_identity k n p
      (coordinateLaurentDefaultContractionVertex n e) (fun b ↦ (x b).1 e) a

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentAllNegative_degree_bounds
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentAllNegative_degree_bounds
    (e : CoordinateLaurentExponent n) (d : ℤ)
    (hdegree : coordinateLaurentTotalDegree n e = d)
    (hall : e.AllNegative n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    d ≤ e i ∧ e i ≤ -1
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : (∑ j : Fin (n + 1), e j) = d := by
    change Finsupp.degree e = d at hdegree
    rwa [Finsupp.degree_eq_sum] at hdegree
  have hrest : ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, e j ≤ 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_nonpos
    intro j _
    exact le_of_lt (hall j)
  have hsplit :
      (∑ j : Fin (n + 1), e j) =
        (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, e j) + e i := by
    exact
      (Finset.sum_erase_add Finset.univ (fun j ↦ e j)
        (Finset.mem_univ i)).symm
  constructor
  · omega
  · have hi := hall i
    omega

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentHigherTerm_smul_apply_coeff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateLaurentHigherTerm_smul_apply_coeff (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (c : k) (x : coordinateLaurentHigherTerm k n d p)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (e : CoordinateLaurentExponent n) :
    ((c • x) a).1 e = c * (x a).1 e
proof:
:=
  rfl

statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjectionLinear_apply_coeff

    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (e : CoordinateLaurentExponent n) :
    ((coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjectionLinear k n d p x) a).1 e =
      if e.AllNegative n then (x a).1 e else 0

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeCoefficients_injective
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeCoefficients_injective
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective
      (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeCoefficients k n d p)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext a
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro e
  by_cases hall : e.AllNegative n
  · by_cases hdegree : coordinateLaurentTotalDegree n e = d
    · let ee : coordinateLaurentAllNegativeDegreeExponent n d :=
        ⟨e, hdegree, hall⟩
      exact congrFun (congrFun hxy a) ee
    · have hxzero : (x.1 a).1 e = 0 := by
        by_contra hx
        exact hdegree ((x.1 a).2 e hx).1
      have hyzero : (y.1 a).1 e = 0 := by
        by_contra hy
        exact hdegree ((y.1 a).2 e hy).1
      rw [hxzero, hyzero]
  · obtain ⟨x', hx⟩ := x.2
    obtain ⟨y', hy⟩ := y.2
    have hxzero : (x.1 a).1 e = 0 := by
      calc
        _ = ((coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjectionLinear k n d p x') a).1 e :=
          congrArg (fun z : coordinateLaurentHigherTerm k n d p ↦ (z a).1 e) hx.symm
        _ = 0 := by simp [hall]
    have hyzero : (y.1 a).1 e = 0 := by
      calc
        _ = ((coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjectionLinear k n d p y') a).1 e :=
          congrArg (fun z : coordinateLaurentHigherTerm k n d p ↦ (z a).1 e) hy.symm
        _ = 0 := by simp [hall]
    rw [hxzero, hyzero]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjection_range_finite
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjection_range_finite
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    Module.Finite k
      (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjectionLinear k n d p).range
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Finite k
      (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeCoefficientSpace k n d p) := by
    infer_instance
  exact Module.Finite.of_injective
    (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeCoefficients k n d p)
    (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeCoefficients_injective k n d p)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentAllNegativePositiveCycles_finite
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentAllNegativePositiveCycles_finite
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    Module.Finite k (coordinateLaurentAllNegativePositiveCycles k n d p)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Finite k
      (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjectionLinear k n d (p + 1)).range :=
    coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjection_range_finite k n d (p + 1)
  exact Module.Finite.of_injective
    (coordinateLaurentAllNegativePositiveCycles k n d p).subtype
    Subtype.val_injective

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentAllNegativePositiveCyclesToCohomology_surjective
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentAllNegativePositiveCyclesToCohomology_surjective
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective
      (coordinateLaurentAllNegativePositiveCyclesToCohomology k n d p)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ :=
    (coordinateLaurentPositiveBoundaries k n d p).mkQ_surjective z
  have hprojCycle :
      coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjectionLinear k n d (p + 1) x.1 ∈
        coordinateLaurentPositiveCycles k n d p := by
    change coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d (p + 1)
        (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjection k n d (p + 1) x.1) = 0
    rw [coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_allNegativeProjection]
    change coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjection k n d (p + 2)
      (coordinateLaurentHigherDifferentialLinear k n d (p + 1) x.1) = 0
    rw [x.2]
    exact map_zero _
  let pxRange :
      (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjectionLinear k n d (p + 1)).range :=
    ⟨coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjectionLinear k n d (p + 1) x.1,
      ⟨x.1, rfl⟩⟩
  let px : coordinateLaurentAllNegativePositiveCycles k n d p :=
    ⟨pxRange, hprojCycle⟩
  refine ⟨px, ?_⟩
  apply (Submodule.Quotient.eq
    (coordinateLaurentPositiveBoundaries k n d p)).2
  change
    coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjectionLinear k n d (p + 1) x.1 - x.1 ∈
      (coordinateLaurentHigherDifferentialLinear k n d p).range
  refine ⟨-(coordinateLaurentObstructionContractionLinear k n d p x.1), ?_⟩
  have hhom := coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_obstructionContraction
    k n d p x.1
  have hx : coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d (p + 1) x.1 = 0 := x.2
  rw [hx, map_zero, add_zero] at hhom
  change coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d p
      (-(coordinateLaurentObstructionContraction k n d p x.1)) =
    coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjection k n d (p + 1) x.1 - x.1
  rw [map_neg, hhom]
  abel

statement:

    (coordinateLaurentAllNegativePositiveCyclesToCohomology k n d p)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesToCechCycles_iCycles
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesToCechCycles_iCycles
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesToCechCycles k n d p ≫
        (projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex k n d).iCycles (p + 1) =
      AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
        ((coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv k n d (p + 1)).symm.toAddMonoidHom.comp
          (coordinateLaurentPositiveCycles k n d p).subtype.toAddMonoidHom)
proof:
:= by
  let K := projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex k n d
  let e := coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv k n d (p + 1)
  let f : AddCommGrpCat.of (coordinateLaurentPositiveCycles k n d p) ⟶
      K.X (p + 1) :=
    AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (e.symm.toAddMonoidHom.comp
      (coordinateLaurentPositiveCycles k n d p).subtype.toAddMonoidHom)
  have hf : f ≫ K.d (p + 1) (p + 2) = 0 := by
    apply AddCommGrpCat.ext
    intro x
    change coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential k n d (p + 1)
      (e.symm x.1) = 0
    apply (coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv k n d (p + 2)).injective
    rw [coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential_eq_transported_unconditional,
      coordinateCechTwistingTransportedHigherDifferential_toLaurent]
    rw [e.apply_symm_apply, map_zero]
    exact x.2
  have hnext : (ComplexShape.up ℕ).next (p + 1) = p + 2 := by
    unfold ComplexShape.next
    split
    next h =>
      have hh := h.choose_spec
      simp only [ComplexShape.up_Rel] at hh
      omega
    next h =>
      exact (h ⟨p + 2, by simp only [ComplexShape.up_Rel]; omega⟩).elim
  change K.liftCycles f (p + 2) hnext hf ≫ K.iCycles (p + 1) = f
  let hf' : f ≫ (K.sc (p + 1)).g = 0 := by
    change f ≫ K.dFrom (p + 1) = 0
    have hr : (ComplexShape.up ℕ).Rel (p + 1) (p + 2) := by
      simp only [ComplexShape.up_Rel]
      omega
    rw [K.dFrom_eq hr, ← Category.assoc, hf, zero_comp]
  exact (K.sc (p + 1)).liftCycles_i f hf'

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesToCechCycles_bijective
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesToCechCycles_bijective
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective
      (coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesToCechCycles k n d p).hom
proof:
:= by
  let K := projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex k n d
  let e := coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv k n d (p + 1)
  constructor
  · intro x y hxy
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply e.symm.injective
    have hx := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesToCechCycles_iCycles k n d p) x
    have hy := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesToCechCycles_iCycles k n d p) y
    have hx' : (K.iCycles (p + 1)).hom
        (coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesToCechCycles k n d p x) = e.symm x.1 :=
      hx
    have hy' : (K.iCycles (p + 1)).hom
        (coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesToCechCycles k n d p y) = e.symm y.1 :=
      hy
    exact hx'.symm.trans
      ((congrArg (fun z ↦ (K.iCycles (p + 1)).hom z) hxy).trans hy')
  · intro y
    have hcycle :
        coordinateLaurentHigherDifferentialLinear k n d (p + 1)
          (e ((K.iCycles (p + 1)).hom y)) = 0 := by
      have hnative := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (K.iCycles_d (p + 1) (p + 2)) y
      change coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential k n d (p + 1)
        ((K.iCycles (p + 1)).hom y) = 0 at hnative
      have h := congrArg
        (coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv k n d (p + 2)) hnative
      rw [coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential_eq_transported_unconditional,
        coordinateCechTwistingTransportedHigherDifferential_toLaurent,
        map_zero] at h
      exact h
    let x : coordinateLaurentPositiveCycles k n d p :=
      ⟨e ((K.iCycles (p + 1)).hom y), hcycle⟩
    refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
    apply (AddCommGrpCat.mono_iff_injective (K.iCycles (p + 1))).mp inferInstance
    have hx := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesToCechCycles_iCycles k n d p) x
    have hx' : (K.iCycles (p + 1)).hom
        (coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesToCechCycles k n d p x) = e.symm x.1 :=
      hx
    exact hx'.trans (by simp only [x, e, AddEquiv.symm_apply_apply])

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentPositiveBoundaries_le_ker_cyclesToCechHomology
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentPositiveBoundaries_le_ker_cyclesToCechHomology
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    (coordinateLaurentPositiveBoundaries k n d p).toAddSubgroup ≤
      (coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesToCechHomology k n d p).ker
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  let K := projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex k n d
  let ePrev := coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv k n d p
  let e := coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv k n d (p + 1)
  change x.1 ∈ (coordinateLaurentHigherDifferentialLinear k n d p).range at hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hx
  let yNative : coordinateCechHigherTerm k n (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) p :=
    ePrev.symm y
  have hcycleEq :
      coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesCechCyclesAddEquiv k n d p x =
        K.toCycles p (p + 1) yNative := by
    apply (AddCommGrpCat.mono_iff_injective (K.iCycles (p + 1))).mp inferInstance
    have hleft := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesToCechCycles_iCycles k n d p) x
    have hright := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (K.toCycles_i p (p + 1)) yNative
    have hmiddle : e.symm x.1 =
        coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential k n d p yNative := by
      apply e.injective
      rw [e.apply_symm_apply,
        coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential_eq_transported_unconditional,
        coordinateCechTwistingTransportedHigherDifferential_toLaurent]
      change x.1 = coordinateLaurentHigherDifferentialLinear k n d p
        (ePrev yNative)
      rw [show ePrev yNative = y by simp [yNative]]
      exact hy.symm
    have hleft' : (K.iCycles (p + 1)).hom
        (coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesCechCyclesAddEquiv k n d p x) = e.symm x.1 :=
      hleft
    have hright' : (K.iCycles (p + 1)).hom (K.toCycles p (p + 1) yNative) =
        coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential k n d p yNative :=
      hright
    exact hleft'.trans (hmiddle.trans hright'.symm)
  change (K.homologyπ (p + 1)).hom
    (coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesCechCyclesAddEquiv k n d p x) = 0
  rw [hcycleEq]
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (K.toCycles_comp_homologyπ p (p + 1)) yNative

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentPositiveCohomologyToCechHomology_surjective
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentPositiveCohomologyToCechHomology_surjective
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective
      (coordinateLaurentPositiveCohomologyToCechHomology k n d p)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ :=
    (AddCommGrpCat.epi_iff_surjective
      ((projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex k n d).homologyπ (p + 1))).mp
        inferInstance z
  let x : coordinateLaurentPositiveCycles k n d p :=
    (coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesCechCyclesAddEquiv k n d p).symm y
  refine ⟨(coordinateLaurentPositiveBoundaries k n d p).mkQ x, ?_⟩
  change (coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesToCechHomology k n d p) x = z
  change ((projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex k n d).homologyπ (p + 1)).hom
    (coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesCechCyclesAddEquiv k n d p x) = z
  rw [show coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesCechCyclesAddEquiv k n d p x = y by
    simp [x]]
  exact hy
