name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechToCycles_comp_cyclesToLaurentPositiveCohomology
statement:
theorem coordinateCechToCycles_comp_cyclesToLaurentPositiveCohomology
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    (projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex k n d).toCycles p (p + 1) ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
          (coordinateCechCyclesToLaurentPositiveCohomology k n d p) =
      0
proof:
:= by
  let K := projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex k n d
  let ePrev := coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv k n d p
  let e := coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv k n d (p + 1)
  let E := coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesCechCyclesAddEquiv k n d p
  apply AddCommGrpCat.ext
  intro y
  let yNative : coordinateCechHigherTerm k n (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) p := y
  change (coordinateLaurentPositiveBoundaries k n d p).mkQ
      (E.symm (K.toCycles p (p + 1) yNative)) = 0
  apply (Submodule.Quotient.eq
    (coordinateLaurentPositiveBoundaries k n d p)).2
  simp only [sub_zero]
  change (E.symm (K.toCycles p (p + 1) yNative)).1 ∈
    (coordinateLaurentHigherDifferentialLinear k n d p).range
  refine ⟨ePrev yNative, ?_⟩
  have hright := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (K.toCycles_i p (p + 1)) yNative
  have hleft := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesToCechCycles_iCycles k n d p)
    (E.symm (K.toCycles p (p + 1) yNative))
  have hval : (E.symm (K.toCycles p (p + 1) yNative)).1 =
      e ((K.iCycles (p + 1)).hom (K.toCycles p (p + 1) yNative)) := by
    apply e.symm.injective
    rw [e.symm_apply_apply]
    calc
      e.symm (E.symm (K.toCycles p (p + 1) yNative)).1 =
          (K.iCycles (p + 1)).hom
            (E (E.symm (K.toCycles p (p + 1) yNative))) := hleft.symm
      _ = (K.iCycles (p + 1)).hom (K.toCycles p (p + 1) yNative) := by
        rw [E.apply_symm_apply]
  have hright' :
      (K.iCycles (p + 1)).hom (K.toCycles p (p + 1) yNative) =
        coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential k n d p yNative :=
    hright
  rw [hval, hright']
  change coordinateLaurentHigherDifferentialLinear k n d p (ePrev yNative) =
    e (coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential k n d p yNative)
  rw [coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential_eq_transported_unconditional,
    coordinateCechTwistingTransportedHigherDifferential_toLaurent]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechHomologyπ_comp_homologyToLaurentPositiveCohomology
statement:
theorem coordinateCechHomologyπ_comp_homologyToLaurentPositiveCohomology
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    (projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex k n d).homologyπ (p + 1) ≫
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
          (coordinateCechHomologyToLaurentPositiveCohomology k n d p) =
      AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
        (coordinateCechCyclesToLaurentPositiveCohomology k n d p)
proof:
:= by
  let K := projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex k n d
  let ψ : K.cycles (p + 1) ⟶
      AddCommGrpCat.of (coordinateLaurentPositiveCohomology k n d p) :=
    AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
      (coordinateCechCyclesToLaurentPositiveCohomology k n d p)
  have hzero : K.toCycles p (p + 1) ≫ ψ = 0 :=
    coordinateCechToCycles_comp_cyclesToLaurentPositiveCohomology k n d p
  change K.homologyπ (p + 1) ≫
      ((K.homologyIsCokernel p (p + 1) (complexShapeUp_prev_succ p)).desc
        (CokernelCofork.ofπ ψ hzero)) = ψ
  exact (K.homologyIsCokernel p (p + 1) (complexShapeUp_prev_succ p)).fac
    (CokernelCofork.ofπ ψ hzero) WalkingParallelPair.one

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechHomologyToLaurentPositiveCohomology_leftInverse
statement:
theorem coordinateCechHomologyToLaurentPositiveCohomology_leftInverse
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    Function.LeftInverse
      (coordinateCechHomologyToLaurentPositiveCohomology k n d p)
      (coordinateLaurentPositiveCohomologyToCechHomology k n d p)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ :=
    (coordinateLaurentPositiveBoundaries k n d p).mkQ_surjective z
  have hfac := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (coordinateCechHomologyπ_comp_homologyToLaurentPositiveCohomology k n d p)
    (coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesCechCyclesAddEquiv k n d p x)
  rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hfac
  change coordinateCechHomologyToLaurentPositiveCohomology k n d p
      (((projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex k n d).homologyπ (p + 1)).hom
        (coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesCechCyclesAddEquiv k n d p x)) =
    coordinateCechCyclesToLaurentPositiveCohomology k n d p
      (coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesCechCyclesAddEquiv k n d p x) at hfac
  change coordinateCechHomologyToLaurentPositiveCohomology k n d p
      (((projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex k n d).homologyπ (p + 1)).hom
        (coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesCechCyclesAddEquiv k n d p x)) =
    (coordinateLaurentPositiveBoundaries k n d p).mkQ x
  rw [hfac]
  change (coordinateLaurentPositiveBoundaries k n d p).mkQ
      ((coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesCechCyclesAddEquiv k n d p).symm
        (coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesCechCyclesAddEquiv k n d p x)) =
    (coordinateLaurentPositiveBoundaries k n d p).mkQ x
  rw [AddEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechChosenDegreeOneComparison_delta
statement:
theorem coordinateCechChosenDegreeOneComparison_delta
    (F : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space k n).toPresheafedSpace)
    (hF : CoordinateCechAcyclic k n F)
    (x : ↑((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor k n 0).obj
      (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveQuotient k n F))) :
    coordinateCechChosenDegreeOneComparisonAddEquiv k n F hF
        (coordinateCechChosenZeroDeltaAddHom k n F hF x) =
      coordinateCechChosenZeroSheafHDeltaAddHom k n F
        ((coordinateCechH0SheafH0NatIso k n).hom.app
          (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveQuotient k n F) x)
proof:
:= by
  let S := coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplex k n F
  let T := S.map (coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor k n)
  have hS : S.ShortExact :=
    coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplex_shortExact k n F
  have hT : T.ShortExact :=
    coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_shortExact_of_acyclic k n S hS hF
  let e₀ := coordinateCechH0SheafH0NatIso k n
  let δC : T.X₃.homology 0 ⟶ T.X₁.homology 1 := hT.δ 0 1 rfl
  let δE : AddCommGrpCat.of (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H S.X₃ 0) ⟶
      AddCommGrpCat.of (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H S.X₁ 1) :=
    AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.δ hS 0 1 rfl)
  have hCexact := hT.homology_exact₃ 0 1 rfl
  have hEall := CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.longSequence_exact hS 0 1 rfl
  have hzE : AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.map S.g 0) ≫ δE = 0 := by
    have hz := hEall.toIsComplex.zero 1
    dsimp [δE, CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.longSequence] at hz
    exact hz
  have hzCE :
      (coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor k n 0).map S.g ≫
        e₀.hom.app S.X₃ ≫ δE = 0 := by
    have hmap : (TopCat.Sheaf.H0Functor
          (space k n).toPresheafedSpace).map S.g =
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.map S.g 0) := rfl
    rw [← Category.assoc, e₀.hom.naturality, Category.assoc,
      hmap, hzE, comp_zero]
  haveI : Epi δC := by
    have hI₁ : IsZero (T.X₂.homology 1) :=
      coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor_obj_isZero_of_injective
        k n S.X₂ 1 one_ne_zero
    exact (hT.homology_exact₁ 0 1 rfl).epi_f (hI₁.eq_of_tgt _ _)
  let forward : T.X₁.homology 1 ⟶
      AddCommGrpCat.of (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H S.X₁ 1) :=
    hCexact.gIsCokernel.desc
      (CokernelCofork.ofπ (e₀.hom.app S.X₃ ≫ δE) hzCE)
  have hfac : δC ≫ forward = e₀.hom.app S.X₃ ≫ δE := by
    dsimp [forward, δC]
    exact hCexact.gIsCokernel.fac _ WalkingParallelPair.one
  have hx := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hfac x
  change forward.hom (δC.hom x) = δE.hom (e₀.hom.app S.X₃ x)
  exact hx

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechChosenZeroDelta_surjective
statement:
theorem coordinateCechChosenZeroDelta_surjective
    (F : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space k n).toPresheafedSpace)

    Function.Surjective (coordinateCechChosenZeroDeltaAddHom k n F hF)

:= by

  let T := S.map (coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor k n)
  have hT : T.ShortExact :=
    coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_shortExact_of_acyclic k n S
      (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplex_shortExact k n F) hF
  have hI₁ : IsZero (T.X₂.homology 1) :=
    coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor_obj_isZero_of_injective
      k n S.X₂ 1 one_ne_zero
  haveI : Epi (hT.δ 0 1 rfl) :=
    (hT.homology_exact₁ 0 1 rfl).epi_f (hI₁.eq_of_tgt _ _)
  exact (AddCommGrpCat.epi_iff_surjective (hT.δ 0 1 rfl)).mp inferInstance

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechChosenZeroDelta_naturality
statement:
theorem coordinateCechChosenZeroDelta_naturality
    {F G : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space k n).toPresheafedSpace}
    (hF : CoordinateCechAcyclic k n F) (hG : CoordinateCechAcyclic k n G)
    (f : F ⟶ G)
    (x : ↑((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor k n 0).obj
      (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveQuotient k n F))) :
    coordinateCechChosenZeroDeltaAddHom k n G hG
        ((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor k n 0).map
          (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplexMap k n f).τ₃ x) =
      (coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor k n 1).map f
        (coordinateCechChosenZeroDeltaAddHom k n F hF x)
proof:
:= by
  let SF := coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplex k n F
  let SG := coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplex k n G
  let φ := coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplexMap k n f
  let TF := SF.map (coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor k n)
  let TG := SG.map (coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor k n)
  have hTF : TF.ShortExact :=
    coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_shortExact_of_acyclic k n SF
      (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplex_shortExact k n F) hF
  have hTG : TG.ShortExact :=
    coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_shortExact_of_acyclic k n SG
      (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplex_shortExact k n G) hG
  have hn := HomologicalComplex.HomologySequence.δ_naturality
    ((coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor k n).mapShortComplex.map φ)
      hTF hTG 0 1 rfl
  have hx := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hn x
  change (hTG.δ 0 1 rfl).hom
      ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        ((coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor k n).map φ.τ₃) 0).hom x) =
    (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
      ((coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor k n).map f) 1).hom
        ((hTF.δ 0 1 rfl).hom x)
  exact hx.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechChosenZeroSheafHDelta_naturality
statement:
theorem coordinateCechChosenZeroSheafHDelta_naturality
    {F G : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space k n).toPresheafedSpace}
    (f : F ⟶ G)
    (x : CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
      (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveQuotient k n F) 0) :
    coordinateCechChosenZeroSheafHDeltaAddHom k n G
        (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.map
          (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplexMap k n f).τ₃ 0 x) =
      CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.map f 1
        (coordinateCechChosenZeroSheafHDeltaAddHom k n F x)
proof:
:= by
  exact CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.δ_naturality 0 1 rfl
    (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplex_shortExact k n F)
    (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplex_shortExact k n G)
    (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplexMap k n f) x

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparison_delta
statement:
theorem coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparison_delta
    (F : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space k n).toPresheafedSpace)
    (hF : CoordinateCechAcyclic k n F) (q : ℕ)
    (x : ↑((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor k n (q + 1)).obj
      (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveQuotient k n F))) :
    coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparisonAddEquiv k n F hF (q + 1)
        (coordinateCechChosenPositiveDeltaAddEquiv k n F hF q x) =
      coordinateCechChosenPositiveSheafHDeltaAddEquiv k n F q
        (coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparisonAddEquiv k n
          (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveQuotient k n F)
          (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveQuotient_acyclic k n F hF) q x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparisonAddEquiv]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechChosenPositiveDelta_naturality
statement:
theorem coordinateCechChosenPositiveDelta_naturality
    {F G : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space k n).toPresheafedSpace}
    (hF : CoordinateCechAcyclic k n F) (hG : CoordinateCechAcyclic k n G)
    (f : F ⟶ G) (q : ℕ)
    (x : ↑((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor k n (q + 1)).obj
      (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveQuotient k n F))) :
    coordinateCechChosenPositiveDeltaAddEquiv k n G hG q
        ((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor k n (q + 1)).map
          (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplexMap k n f).τ₃ x) =
      (coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor k n (q + 2)).map f
        (coordinateCechChosenPositiveDeltaAddEquiv k n F hF q x)
proof:
:= by
  let SF := coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplex k n F
  let SG := coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplex k n G
  let φ := coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplexMap k n f
  let TF := SF.map (coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor k n)
  let TG := SG.map (coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor k n)
  have hTF : TF.ShortExact :=
    coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_shortExact_of_acyclic k n SF
      (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplex_shortExact k n F) hF
  have hTG : TG.ShortExact :=
    coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_shortExact_of_acyclic k n SG
      (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplex_shortExact k n G) hG
  have hn := HomologicalComplex.HomologySequence.δ_naturality
    ((coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor k n).mapShortComplex.map φ) hTF hTG
      (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl
  have hx := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hn x
  change (hTG.δ (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl).hom
      ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        ((coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor k n).map φ.τ₃) (q + 1)).hom x) =
    (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
      ((coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor k n).map f) (q + 2)).hom
        ((hTF.δ (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl).hom x)
  exact hx.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechChosenPositiveSheafHDelta_naturality
statement:
theorem coordinateCechChosenPositiveSheafHDelta_naturality
    {F G : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space k n).toPresheafedSpace}
    (f : F ⟶ G) (q : ℕ)
    (x : CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
      (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveQuotient k n F) (q + 1)) :
    coordinateCechChosenPositiveSheafHDeltaAddEquiv k n G q
        (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.map
          (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplexMap k n f).τ₃ (q + 1) x) =
      CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.map f (q + 2)
        (coordinateCechChosenPositiveSheafHDeltaAddEquiv k n F q x)
proof:
:= by
  change CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.δ
      (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplex_shortExact k n G)
        (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.map
        (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplexMap k n f).τ₃ (q + 1) x) =
    CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.map f (q + 2)
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.δ
        (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplex_shortExact k n F)
          (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl x)
  exact CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.δ_naturality (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl
    (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplex_shortExact k n F)
    (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplex_shortExact k n G)
    (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplexMap k n f) x

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparison_naturality
statement:
theorem coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparison_naturality
    {F G : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space k n).toPresheafedSpace}
    (hF : CoordinateCechAcyclic k n F) (hG : CoordinateCechAcyclic k n G)
    (f : F ⟶ G) (q : ℕ)
    (x : ↑((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor k n (q + 1)).obj F)) :
    coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparisonAddEquiv k n G hG q
        ((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor k n (q + 1)).map f x) =
      CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.map f (q + 1)
        (coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparisonAddEquiv k n F hF q x)
proof:
:= by
  induction q generalizing F G with
  | zero =>
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := coordinateCechChosenZeroDelta_surjective k n F hF x
      let c := (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplexMap k n f).τ₃
      rw [← coordinateCechChosenZeroDelta_naturality k n hF hG f y]
      change coordinateCechChosenDegreeOneComparisonAddEquiv k n G hG
          (coordinateCechChosenZeroDeltaAddHom k n G hG
            ((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor k n 0).map c y)) =
        CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.map f 1
          (coordinateCechChosenDegreeOneComparisonAddEquiv k n F hF
            (coordinateCechChosenZeroDeltaAddHom k n F hF y))
      rw [coordinateCechChosenDegreeOneComparison_delta k n G hG,
        coordinateCechChosenDegreeOneComparison_delta k n F hF]
      have h₀ := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
        ((coordinateCechH0SheafH0NatIso k n).hom.naturality c) y
      have hmap : (TopCat.Sheaf.H0Functor
          (space k n).toPresheafedSpace).map c =
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.map c 0) := rfl
      rw [hmap] at h₀
      change
        ((coordinateCechH0SheafH0NatIso k n).hom.app
          (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveQuotient k n G)).hom
            (((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor k n 0).map c).hom y) =
          CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.map c 0
            (((coordinateCechH0SheafH0NatIso k n).hom.app
              (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveQuotient k n F)).hom y) at h₀
      rw [h₀]
      exact coordinateCechChosenZeroSheafHDelta_naturality k n f
        ((coordinateCechH0SheafH0NatIso k n).hom.app
          (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveQuotient k n F) y)
  | succ q ih =>
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ :=
        (coordinateCechChosenPositiveDeltaAddEquiv k n F hF q).surjective x
      let QF := coordinateCechChosenInjectiveQuotient k n F
      let QG := coordinateCechChosenInjectiveQuotient k n G
      let hQF := coordinateCechChosenInjectiveQuotient_acyclic k n F hF
      let hQG := coordinateCechChosenInjectiveQuotient_acyclic k n G hG
      let c := (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplexMap k n f).τ₃
      rw [← coordinateCechChosenPositiveDelta_naturality k n hF hG f q y,
        coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparison_delta k n G hG q,
        coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparison_delta k n F hF q,
        ih hQF hQG c y]
      exact coordinateCechChosenPositiveSheafHDelta_naturality k n f q
        (coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparisonAddEquiv k n QF hQF q y)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechBasicOpen_ι_comp_toSpec
statement:
theorem coordinateCechBasicOpen_ι_comp_toSpec
    (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p a).ι ≫ toSpec k n =
      Proj.basicOpenToSpec (grading k n) (coordinateCechEquation k n p a) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          ((algebraMap (grading k n 0)
            (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading k n)
              (coordinateCechEquation k n p a))).comp
              (degreeZeroEquiv k n).symm.toRingHom))
proof:
:= by
  have h :
      (Proj.basicOpen (grading k n) (coordinateCechEquation k n p a)).ι ≫
          (Proj.toSpecZero (grading k n) ≫
            Spec.map (degreeZeroEquiv k n).symm.toCommRingCatIso.hom) =
        Proj.basicOpenToSpec (grading k n) (coordinateCechEquation k n p a) ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            ((algebraMap (grading k n 0)
              (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading k n)
                (coordinateCechEquation k n p a))).comp
                (degreeZeroEquiv k n).symm.toRingHom)) := by
    rw [← cancel_epi (Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading k n)
      (coordinateCechEquation k n p a)
      (coordinateCechEquation_mem_degree k n p a) (by omega)).inv]
    rw [← Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec_hom, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
    rw [← Category.assoc]
    change Proj.awayι (grading k n) (coordinateCechEquation k n p a)
        (coordinateCechEquation_mem_degree k n p a) (by omega) ≫
          (Proj.toSpecZero (grading k n) ≫
            Spec.map (degreeZeroEquiv k n).symm.toCommRingCatIso.hom) = _
    rw [← Category.assoc, Proj.awayι_toSpecZero, ← Spec.map_comp]
    rfl
    all_goals first
      | exact coordinateCechEquation_mem_degree k n p a
      | omega
  simpa only [coordinateCechBasicOpen, space, toSpec, toSpecZero] using h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent_structureRingHom
statement:
theorem coordinateCechBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent_structureRingHom
    (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) (c : k) :
    coordinateCechBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent k n p a
        (structureRingHom (X := space k n) (R := CommRingCat.of k)
          (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p a) c) =
      algebraMap k (CoordinateLaurentPolynomial k n) c
proof:
:= by
  let α : CommRingCat.of k ⟶ CommRingCat.of
      (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading k n)
        (coordinateCechEquation k n p a)) :=
    CommRingCat.ofHom
      ((algebraMap (grading k n 0)
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading k n)
          (coordinateCechEquation k n p a))).comp
            (degreeZeroEquiv k n).symm.toRingHom)
  have happ := congrArg (fun f ↦ f.appTop)
    (coordinateCechBasicOpen_ι_comp_toSpec k n p a)
  have hc := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom happ
    ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv.hom c)
  simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hc
  have hα := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality α) c
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hα
  rw [← hα] at hc
  have hbasic := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (Proj.basicOpenToSpec_app_top (grading k n)
      (coordinateCechEquation k n p a))
    ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of
      (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading k n)
        (coordinateCechEquation k n p a)))).inv.hom (α.hom c))
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, Iso.inv_hom_id_apply] at hbasic
  change
    (ConcreteCategory.hom
      (Scheme.Hom.appTop (Proj.basicOpenToSpec (grading k n)
        (coordinateCechEquation k n p a))))
        (ConcreteCategory.hom
          (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of
            (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading k n)
              (coordinateCechEquation k n p a)))).inv
            (ConcreteCategory.hom α c)) =
      ConcreteCategory.hom (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p a).topIso.inv
        (ConcreteCategory.hom (coordinateCechBasicOpenIsoAway k n p a).hom
          (ConcreteCategory.hom α c)) at hbasic
  have hc2 := hc.trans hbasic
  have hc' := congrArg (fun z ↦
    (Proj.basicOpen (grading k n)
      (coordinateCechEquation k n p a)).topIso.hom.hom z) hc2
  change structureRingHom (X := space k n) (R := CommRingCat.of k)
      (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p a) c =
    (coordinateCechBasicOpenIsoAway k n p a).hom.hom (α.hom c) at hc'
  have hinv := congrArg
    (fun z ↦ (coordinateCechBasicOpenIsoAway k n p a).inv.hom z) hc'
  simp only [Iso.hom_inv_id_apply] at hinv
  unfold coordinateCechBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent
  change coordinateCechAwayToLaurent k n p a
      ((coordinateCechBasicOpenIsoAway k n p a).inv.hom
        (structureRingHom (X := space k n) (R := CommRingCat.of k)
          (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p a) c)) = _
  rw [hinv]
  have hC : MvPolynomial.C c ∈ grading k n (0 * (p + 1)) := by
    simpa using
      (MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_C (σ := Fin (n + 1)) (R := k) c)
  have hαmk : α.hom c =
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading k n)
        (coordinateCechEquation_mem_degree k n p a) 0 (MvPolynomial.C c) hC := by
    apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
    simp [α, HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_eq,
      HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom, degreeZeroEquiv]
  rw [hαmk, coordinateCechAwayToLaurent_mk]
  simp only [pow_zero, mul_one]
  change AddMonoidAlgebra.mapDomain (coordinateExponentToLaurent n)
      (Finsupp.single 0 c) = AddMonoidAlgebra.single 0 c
  rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.mapDomain_single]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechIntersectionBasicOpenSectionIso_smul
statement:
theorem coordinateCechIntersectionBasicOpenSectionIso_smul
    (M : (space k n).Modules) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) (c : k)
    (x : Γ(M, coordinateCechIntersection k n p a)) :
    (coordinateCechIntersectionBasicOpenSectionIso k n M p a).hom.hom
        ((structureRingHom (X := space k n) (R := CommRingCat.of k)
          (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a) c) • x) =
      (structureRingHom (X := space k n) (R := CommRingCat.of k)
        (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p a) c) •
        (coordinateCechIntersectionBasicOpenSectionIso k n M p a).hom.hom x
proof:
:= by
  change M.val.map _
      ((structureRingHom (X := space k n) (R := CommRingCat.of k)
        (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a) c) • x) = _
  rw [M.val.map_smul]
  congr 1

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_smul
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_smul
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (r : Γ(space k n, coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p a))
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d,
      coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p a)) :
    coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation k n d p a (r • x) =
      r * coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation k n d p a x
proof:
:= by
  let i := (coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a)).ι
  let W := coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p a
  let M := projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d
  let h := coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart_image k n p a
  let eR₁ := (space k n).presheaf.mapIso (eqToIso h).op
  let eR₂ := i.appIso W
  let eR := eR₁ ≪≫ eR₂
  let eM₁ := M.presheaf.mapIso (eqToIso h).op
  let eM₂ := (M.restrictAppIso i W).symm
  let eM₃ := (coordinateCechTwistingFrameAppIso k n d p a).symm
  change eR.inv.hom (eM₃.hom (eM₂.hom (eM₁.hom (r • x)))) =
    r * eR.inv.hom (eM₃.hom (eM₂.hom (eM₁.hom x)))
  have h₁ : eM₁.hom (r • x) = eR₁.hom r • eM₁.hom x := by
    change M.val.map _ (r • x) = _
    rw [M.val.map_smul]
    congr 1
  have h₂ (s : Γ(space k n, i ''ᵁ W))
      (y : Γ(M, i ''ᵁ W)) :
      eM₂.hom (s • y) = eR₂.hom s • eM₂.hom y := by
    exact Scheme.Modules.smul_restrictAppIso_inv_apply i M W s y
  have h₃ (s : Γ((coordinateOpen k n
      (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a)).toScheme, W))
      (y : Γ(M.restrict i, W)) :
      eM₃.hom (s • y) = s • eM₃.hom y := by
    change ((projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateIso k n d
      (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a)).inv.val.app (op W)).hom
        (s • y) = s •
          ((projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateIso k n d
            (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a)).inv.val.app (op W)).hom y
    exact map_smul _ s y
  rw [h₁, h₂, h₃]
  change eR.inv.hom (eR.hom r *
      (show Γ((coordinateOpen k n
        (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a)).toScheme, W) from
          eM₃.hom (eM₂.hom (eM₁.hom x)))) = _
  rw [map_mul, Iso.hom_inv_id_apply]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingFrameEvaluation_smul
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingFrameEvaluation_smul
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) (c : k)
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d,
      coordinateCechIntersection k n p a)) :
    coordinateCechTwistingFrameEvaluation k n d p a
        ((structureRingHom (X := space k n) (R := CommRingCat.of k)
          (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a) c) • x) =
      (structureRingHom (X := space k n) (R := CommRingCat.of k)
        (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p a) c) •
        coordinateCechTwistingFrameEvaluation k n d p a x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coordinateCechTwistingFrameEvaluation, AddEquiv.trans_apply]
  change coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation k n d p a
      ((coordinateCechIntersectionBasicOpenSectionIso k n
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) p a).hom.hom
          ((structureRingHom (X := space k n) (R := CommRingCat.of k)
            (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a) c) • x)) = _
  rw [coordinateCechIntersectionBasicOpenSectionIso_smul]
  change coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation k n d p a
      ((structureRingHom (X := space k n) (R := CommRingCat.of k)
        (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p a) c) •
          (coordinateCechIntersectionBasicOpenSectionIso k n
            (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) p a).hom.hom x) =
    (structureRingHom (X := space k n) (R := CommRingCat.of k)
      (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p a) c) *
        coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation k n d p a
          ((coordinateCechIntersectionBasicOpenSectionIso k n
            (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) p a).hom.hom x)
  exact coordinateCechTwistingBasicOpenFrameEvaluation_smul k n d p a _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv_smul
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv_smul
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) (c : k)
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d, coordinateCechIntersection k n p a)) :
    coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv k n d p a
        ((smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of k)
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) c).hom.app
            (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a)) x) =
      c • coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv k n d p a x
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurent k n d p a
      ((structureRingHom (X := space k n) (R := CommRingCat.of k)
        (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a) c) • x) =
    c • coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurent k n d p a x
  rw [coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurent_apply,
    coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurent_apply,
    coordinateCechTwistingFrameEvaluation_smul]
  change coordinateCechBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent k n p a
      ((structureRingHom (X := space k n) (R := CommRingCat.of k)
        (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p a) c) *
          coordinateCechTwistingFrameEvaluation k n d p a x) *
      coordinateTwistingFrameLaurentMonomial k n d
        (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a) = _
  rw [map_mul, coordinateCechBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent_structureRingHom]
  rw [Algebra.smul_def, mul_assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv_smul
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv_smul
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (c : k)
    (x : coordinateCechHigherTerm k n (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) p) :
    coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv k n d p
        ((((coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor k n).map
          (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of k)
            (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) c)).f p).hom x) =
      c • coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv k n d p x
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  rw [coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv_apply]
  change coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv k n d p a
      ((Limits.Pi.map (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
          (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of k)
            (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) c).hom.app
              (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b))) ≫
        Limits.Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.obj
            (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b))) a).hom x) = _
  have hπ := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (Limits.Pi.map_π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
      (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of k)
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) c).hom.app
          (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b))) a) x
  rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hπ
  rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  calc
    _ = coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv k n d p a
          ((smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of k)
            (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) c).hom.app
              (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a))
            ((Limits.Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.obj
                (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b))) a).hom x)) :=
        congrArg (coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv k n d p a) hπ
    _ = c • coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv k n d p a
          ((Limits.Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
            (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.obj
              (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b))) a).hom x) :=
        coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv_smul k n d p a c _
    _ = _ := by
      change c • coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv k n d p a
          ((Limits.Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
            (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.obj
              (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b))) a).hom x) =
        c • coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv k n d p x a
      rw [coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv_apply]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesCechCycles_smul
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesCechCycles_smul
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (c : k) (x : coordinateLaurentPositiveCycles k n d p) :
    (((projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex k n d).cyclesMap
      ((coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor k n).map
        (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of k)
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) c)) (p + 1)).hom
        (coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesCechCyclesAddEquiv k n d p x)) =
      coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesCechCyclesAddEquiv k n d p (c • x)
proof:
:= by
  let K := projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex k n d
  let φ := (coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor k n).map
    (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of k) (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) c)
  let E := coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesCechCyclesAddEquiv k n d p
  let e := coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv k n d (p + 1)
  apply (AddCommGrpCat.mono_iff_injective (K.iCycles (p + 1))).mp inferInstance
  have hmap := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (K.cyclesMap_i φ (p + 1)) (E x)
  rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hmap
  change (K.iCycles (p + 1)).hom ((K.cyclesMap φ (p + 1)).hom (E x)) =
    (φ.f (p + 1)).hom ((K.iCycles (p + 1)).hom (E x)) at hmap
  have hx : (K.iCycles (p + 1)).hom (E x) = e.symm x.1 := by
    exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesToCechCycles_iCycles k n d p) x
  have hcx : (K.iCycles (p + 1)).hom (E (c • x)) = e.symm (c • x).1 := by
    exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesToCechCycles_iCycles k n d p) (c • x)
  have hscalar : (φ.f (p + 1)).hom (e.symm x.1) = e.symm (c • x).1 := by
    apply e.injective
    rw [coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv_smul,
      e.apply_symm_apply, e.apply_symm_apply]
    rfl
  exact hmap.trans ((congrArg (φ.f (p + 1)).hom hx).trans
    (hscalar.trans hcx.symm))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechPositiveHomology_smul_eq_map
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechPositiveHomology_smul_eq_map
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (c : k)
    (x : ↑((projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex k n d).homology (p + 1))) :
    c • x =
      ((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor k n (p + 1)).map
        (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of k)
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) c)).hom x
proof:
:= by
  let K := projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex k n d
  let φ := (coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor k n).map
    (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of k) (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) c)
  let e := coordinateLaurentPositiveCohomologyCechHomologyAddEquiv k n d p
  let eL := coordinateLaurentPositiveCohomologyCechHomologyLinearEquiv k n d p
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := e.surjective x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ :=
    (coordinateLaurentPositiveBoundaries k n d p).mkQ_surjective z
  change c • eL ((coordinateLaurentPositiveBoundaries k n d p).mkQ y) =
    ((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor k n (p + 1)).map
      (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of k)
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) c)).hom
      (eL ((coordinateLaurentPositiveBoundaries k n d p).mkQ y))
  rw [← eL.map_smul]
  have hq : c • (coordinateLaurentPositiveBoundaries k n d p).mkQ y =
      (coordinateLaurentPositiveBoundaries k n d p).mkQ (c • y) := by
    rw [map_smul]
  rw [hq]
  change e ((coordinateLaurentPositiveBoundaries k n d p).mkQ (c • y)) =
    ((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor k n (p + 1)).map
      (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of k)
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) c)).hom
      (e ((coordinateLaurentPositiveBoundaries k n d p).mkQ y))
  rw [coordinateLaurentPositiveCohomologyCechHomologyAddEquiv_mkQ,
    coordinateLaurentPositiveCohomologyCechHomologyAddEquiv_mkQ]
  have hnat := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (K.homologyπ_naturality φ (p + 1))
    (coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesCechCyclesAddEquiv k n d p y)
  rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hnat
  change ((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor k n (p + 1)).map
      (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of k)
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) c)).hom
      ((K.homologyπ (p + 1)).hom
        (coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesCechCyclesAddEquiv k n d p y)) =
    (K.homologyπ (p + 1)).hom
      ((K.cyclesMap φ (p + 1)).hom
        (coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesCechCyclesAddEquiv k n d p y)) at hnat
  have hcycles := coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesCechCycles_smul k n d p c y
  exact (congrArg (K.homologyπ (p + 1)).hom hcycles).symm.trans hnat.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechSheafHPositiveAddEquiv_smul
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechSheafHPositiveAddEquiv_smul
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (c : k)
    (x : ↑((projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex k n d).homology (p + 1))) :
    projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechSheafHPositiveAddEquiv k n d p (c • x) =
      c • projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechSheafHPositiveAddEquiv k n d p x
proof:
:= by
  rw [projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechPositiveHomology_smul_eq_map]
  let F := projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d
  let y : CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (space k n).ringCatSheaf).obj F) (p + 1) :=
    projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechSheafHPositiveAddEquiv k n d p x
  have hnat := coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparison_naturality k n
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateCechAcyclic k n d)
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateCechAcyclic k n d)
    (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of k)
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) c) p x
  change _ = CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.map (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of k) F c)
    (p + 1) y at hnat
  have hsmul : c • y = CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.map
      (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of k) F c) (p + 1) y :=
    @smul_eq_H_map (space k n) (CommRingCat.of k)
      (projectiveSpaceOverSpec k n) F c (p + 1) y
  change _ = c • y
  exact hnat.trans hsmul.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.twistPullHomAux_canonicalTwistTransition_pullHom'_finalChart
statement:
theorem twistPullHomAux_canonicalTwistTransition_pullHom'_finalChart
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) (source : C.I)
    (W : X.affineOpens) (hWsource : W.1 ≤ C.U source)
    (hWc : W.1 ≤ c.affineOpen.1)
    [Module.Free Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))]
    [Module.Finite Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))]
    [Finite (C.basisIndex i)] [Finite (C.basisIndex j)]
    (hOpenR : IsOpenImmersion
      (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc))
    (hOpenL : IsOpenImmersion
      (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource i
        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left)))
    (hOpenS : IsOpenImmersion
      (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource j
        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right)))
    (d : ℤ) {D : Scheme.{u}} (q : D ⟶ C.scheme)
    (g : D ⟶ C.restrictionChart source W hWsource)
    (a : D ⟶ c.chart)
    (fL : D ⟶ C.chart i) (fR : D ⟶ C.chart j)
    (ha : g ≫ c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc = a)
    (haL : a ≫ c.chartToLeft = fL)
    (haR : a ≫ c.chartToRight = fR)
    (hgL : g ≫ directRestrictionChartMap (C := C)
        source W hWsource i (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left) =
      fL)
    (hgR : g ≫ directRestrictionChartMap (C := C)
        source W hWsource j (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right) =
      fR)
    (hfL : fL ≫ C.chartι i = q)
    (hfR : fR ≫ C.chartι j = q) :
    Pseudofunctor.DescentData'.pullHom'
        (C.twistTransitionHomChosen
          (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d))
        q fL fR hfL hfR =
      Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
        (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
        (c.canonicalTwistComparisonFinalPullbackIso
          source W hWsource hWc hOpenR hOpenL hOpenS d).hom
        g fL fR
        hgL hgR
proof:
:= by
  let r := c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc
  let L := directRestrictionChartMap (C := C)
    source W hWsource i (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left)
  let R := directRestrictionChartMap (C := C)
    source W hWsource j (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right)
  have hrL : r ≫ c.chartToLeft = L :=
    c.restrictionChartTo_comp_left source W hWsource hWc
  have hrR : r ≫ c.chartToRight = R :=
    c.restrictionChartTo_comp_right source W hWsource hWc
  have hgrL : (g ≫ r) ≫ c.chartToLeft = fL :=
    (congrArg (fun z ↦ z ≫ c.chartToLeft) ha).trans haL
  have hgrR : (g ≫ r) ≫ c.chartToRight = fR :=
    (congrArg (fun z ↦ z ≫ c.chartToRight) ha).trans haR
  calc
    _ =
        Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
          (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
          (C.transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso d i j c).hom
          a fL fR haL haR :=
      twistPullHomAux_canonicalTwistTransition_pullHom'_commonChartMap
        C d i j c q a fL fR haL haR hfL hfR
    _ =
        Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
          (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
          (C.transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso d i j c).hom
          (g ≫ r) fL fR
          hgrL hgrR := by
      exact twistPullHomAux_pullHom_congr_g
        c.chartToLeft c.chartToRight
        (C.transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso d i j c).hom
        a (g ≫ r) fL fR
        ha.symm haL haR hgrL hgrR
    _ =
        Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
          (Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
            (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
            (C.transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso d i j c).hom
            r L R hrL hrR)
          g fL fR
          hgL hgR := by
      exact
        (Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom_pullHom
          (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
          (C.transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso d i j c).hom
          r L R g fL fR
          hrL hrR hgL hgR).symm
    _ = _ := by
      rw [twistPullHomAux_pullHom_transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso_eq_final
        c source W hWsource hWc hOpenR hOpenL hOpenS d]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechCohomology_X3_isZero_of_shortExact
statement:
theorem coordinateCechCohomology_X3_isZero_of_shortExact
    (S : ShortComplex
      (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space k n).toPresheafedSpace))
    (hS : S.ShortExact) (h₁ : CoordinateCechAcyclic k n S.X₁)
    [Injective S.X₂] (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≠ 0)
    (hleft : IsZero
      ((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor k n (i + 1)).obj S.X₁)) :
    IsZero ((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor k n i).obj S.X₃)
proof:
:= by
  let T := S.map (coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor k n)
  have hT : T.ShortExact :=
    coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_shortExact_of_acyclic k n S hS h₁
  have hIᵢ := coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor_obj_isZero_of_injective
    k n S.X₂ i hi
  have hIᵢ₁ := coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor_obj_isZero_of_injective
    k n S.X₂ (i + 1) (Nat.succ_ne_zero i)
  change IsZero (T.X₃.homology i)
  change IsZero (T.X₂.homology i) at hIᵢ
  change IsZero (T.X₂.homology (i + 1)) at hIᵢ₁
  change IsZero (T.X₁.homology (i + 1)) at hleft
  exact hleft.of_iso
    (hT.δIso i (i + 1) (rfl : i + 1 = i + 1) hIᵢ hIᵢ₁)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.sheafH_isZero_of_coordinateCech_isZero
statement:
theorem sheafH_isZero_of_coordinateCech_isZero
    (F : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space k n).toPresheafedSpace)
    (hlocal : CoordinateCechAcyclic k n F) (q : ℕ)
    (hcech : IsZero
      ((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor k n (q + 1)).obj F)) :
    IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H F (q + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  induction q generalizing F with
  | zero =>
      obtain ⟨I, _, f, hf⟩ := EnoughInjectives.presentation F
      let S := ShortComplex.mk f (cokernel.π f) (by cat_disch)
      have hS : S.ShortExact :=
        ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk (ShortComplex.exact_cokernel f)
      have hLS := CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.longSequence_exact hS 0 1 rfl
      refine ShortComplex.Exact.isZero_of_both_zeros (hLS.exact 2) ?_
        (zero_of_target_iso_zero _
          (IsZero.isoZero (sheafH_isZero_of_injective k n I 0)))
      rw [← ShortComplex.Exact.epi_f_iff (hLS.exact 1)]
      change Epi
        ((TopCat.Sheaf.H0Functor (space k n).toPresheafedSpace).map S.g)
      exact sheafH0_map_epi_of_coordinateCech_acyclic k n S hS hlocal hcech
  | succ q hq =>
      obtain ⟨I, _, f, hf⟩ := EnoughInjectives.presentation F
      let S := ShortComplex.mk f (cokernel.π f) (by cat_disch)
      have hS : S.ShortExact :=
        ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk (ShortComplex.exact_cokernel f)
      have hlocal₃ : CoordinateCechAcyclic k n S.X₃ :=
        hlocal.X3_of_shortExact k n S hS
      have hcech₃ : IsZero
          ((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor k n (q + 1)).obj S.X₃) :=
        coordinateCechCohomology_X3_isZero_of_shortExact
          k n S hS hlocal (q + 1) (Nat.succ_ne_zero q) hcech
      exact ShortComplex.Exact.isZero_of_both_isZero
        ((CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.longSequence_exact hS
          (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl).exact 2)
        (hq S.X₃ hlocal₃ hcech₃)
        (sheafH_isZero_of_injective k n I (q + 1))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.sheafH_isZero_of_coordinateCech_vanishesAbove
statement:
theorem sheafH_isZero_of_coordinateCech_vanishesAbove
    (F : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space k n).toPresheafedSpace)
    (hlocal : CoordinateCechAcyclic k n F) (b q : ℕ) (hbq : b < q + 1)
    (hcech : ∀ i, b < i →
      IsZero ((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor k n i).obj F)) :
    IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H F (q + 1)))
proof:
:=
  sheafH_isZero_of_coordinateCech_isZero k n F hlocal q
    (hcech (q + 1) hbq)

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.koszulDiff_natural
statement:
theorem koszulDiff_natural (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (σ : M →ₗ[R] R) (τ : N →ₗ[R] R)
    (h : τ.comp f = σ) (n : ℕ) :
    (koszulDiff τ n).comp (exteriorPower.map (n + 1) f) =
      (exteriorPower.map n f).comp (koszulDiff σ n)
proof:
:= by
  apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext
  refine AlternatingMap.ext fun v ↦ ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.compAlternatingMap_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    exteriorPower.map_apply_ιMulti, koszulDiff_ιMulti, map_sum, map_zsmul, map_smul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  have hi := LinearMap.congr_fun h (v i)
  change τ (f (v i)) = σ (v i) at hi
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  rw [hi]
  congr 2

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.koszulExteriorEquiv_differential
statement:
theorem koszulExteriorEquiv_differential (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N)
    (σ : M →ₗ[R] R) (n : ℕ) :
    (koszulDiff (σ.comp e.symm.toLinearMap) n).comp
      (koszulExteriorEquiv e (n + 1)).toLinearMap =
    (koszulExteriorEquiv e n).toLinearMap.comp (koszulDiff σ n)
proof:
:= by
  apply koszulDiff_natural
  ext x
  simp

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.koszulAcyclic_linearEquiv_iff
statement:
theorem koszulAcyclic_linearEquiv_iff (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (σ : M →ₗ[R] R) :
    KoszulAcyclic σ ↔ KoszulAcyclic (σ.comp e.symm.toLinearMap)
proof:
:= by
  have forward : ∀ {A B : Type u} [AddCommGroup A] [Module R A]
      [AddCommGroup B] [Module R B] (f : A ≃ₗ[R] B) (t : A →ₗ[R] R),
      KoszulAcyclic t → KoszulAcyclic (t.comp f.symm.toLinearMap) := by
    intro A B _ _ _ _ f t ht n x hx
    let q := koszulExteriorEquiv f (n + 1)
    have hcycle : koszulDiff t n (q.symm x) = 0 := by
      have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (koszulExteriorEquiv_differential f t n) (q.symm x)
      have hz : koszulExteriorEquiv f n (koszulDiff t n (q.symm x)) = 0 := by
        change koszulDiff (t.comp f.symm.toLinearMap) n (q (q.symm x)) =
          koszulExteriorEquiv f n (koszulDiff t n (q.symm x)) at h
        rw [q.apply_symm_apply] at h
        exact h.symm.trans hx
      exact (koszulExteriorEquiv f n).injective (hz.trans (map_zero _).symm)
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := ht n (q.symm x) hcycle
    refine ⟨koszulExteriorEquiv f (n + 2) y, ?_⟩
    have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (koszulExteriorEquiv_differential f t (n + 1)) y
    change koszulDiff (t.comp f.symm.toLinearMap) (n + 1)
      (koszulExteriorEquiv f (n + 2) y) = q (koszulDiff t (n + 1) y) at h
    rw [hy] at h
    exact h.trans (q.apply_symm_apply x)
  constructor
  · exact forward e σ
  · intro h
    have hh := forward e.symm (σ.comp e.symm.toLinearMap) h
    have he : (σ.comp e.symm.toLinearMap).comp e.toLinearMap = σ := by ext; simp
    simp only [LinearEquiv.symm_symm] at hh
    rwa [he] at hh

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.koszulDiff_basis_coordinates
statement:
theorem koszulDiff_basis_coordinates {I : Type u} (b : Module.Basis I R M)

    (koszulDiff (σ.comp b.repr.symm.toLinearMap) n).comp
      (koszulExteriorEquiv b.repr (n + 1)).toLinearMap =
    (koszulExteriorEquiv b.repr n).toLinearMap.comp (koszulDiff σ n)
proof:
:=
  koszulExteriorEquiv_differential b.repr σ n

proof:

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.basis_coordinate_cosection_single

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.subsingleton_exteriorPower_of_basis
statement:
theorem subsingleton_exteriorPower_of_basis {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [LinearOrder I]
    (b : Module.Basis I R M) (n : ℕ) (hn : Fintype.card I < n) :
    Subsingleton (⋀[R]^n M)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : IsEmpty (Set.powersetCard I n) := ⟨fun s ↦ by
    have h1 := Set.powersetCard.card_eq s
    have h2 := Finset.card_le_univ (s : Finset I)
    omega⟩
  exact (b.exteriorPower n).repr.injective.subsingleton

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.koszulAcyclic_of_empty_basis
statement:
theorem koszulAcyclic_of_empty_basis {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [LinearOrder I]
    [IsEmpty I] (b : Module.Basis I R M) (σ : M →ₗ[R] R) : KoszulAcyclic σ
proof:
:= by
  intro n x _
  haveI := subsingleton_exteriorPower_of_basis b (n + 1) (by simp)
  exact ⟨0, by simp [Subsingleton.elim x 0]⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.singletonConeCoordinate_bijective
statement:
theorem singletonConeCoordinate_bijective (b : Module.Basis (Fin 1) R M) :
    Function.Bijective (singletonConeCoordinate b)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x y h
    apply (exteriorPower.oneEquiv R M).injective
    apply b.repr.injective
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro i
    have hi : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    subst hi
    exact congrArg Prod.snd h
  · intro z
    haveI : Subsingleton ((self (ModuleCat.of R R)).resolution.complex.X 1) :=
      ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp ((self (ModuleCat.of R R)).isZero 1 (by simp [self]))
    refine ⟨(exteriorPower.oneEquiv R M).symm ((show R from z.2) • b 0), ?_⟩
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    · change b.repr (exteriorPower.oneEquiv R M
        ((exteriorPower.oneEquiv R M).symm ((show R from z.2) • b 0))) 0 = z.2
      simp

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.singletonConeCoordinate_differential
statement:
theorem singletonConeCoordinate_differential (b : Module.Basis (Fin 1) R M)
    (σ : M →ₗ[R] R) :
    ((self (ModuleCat.of R R)).coneDZero (σ (b 0))).hom.comp
      (singletonConeCoordinate b) =
    (exteriorPower.zeroEquiv R M).toLinearMap.comp (koszulDiff σ 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [koszulDiff_zero_compat]
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change ((self (ModuleCat.of R R)).resolution.complex.d 1 0) 0 + _ = _
  rw [map_zero, zero_add]
  change σ (b 0) • b.repr (exteriorPower.oneEquiv R M x) 0 =
    σ (exteriorPower.oneEquiv R M x)
  have bx : exteriorPower.oneEquiv R M x =
      b.repr (exteriorPower.oneEquiv R M x) 0 • b 0 := by
    simpa using (b.sum_repr (exteriorPower.oneEquiv R M x)).symm
  conv_rhs => rw [bx, map_smul]
  simp [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosection_injective_of_singleton_weaklyRegular
statement:
theorem cosection_injective_of_singleton_weaklyRegular (b : Module.Basis (Fin 1) R M)
    (σ : M →ₗ[R] R)
    (h : RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular R [σ (b 0)]) : Function.Injective σ
proof:
:= by
  have hr := (RingTheory.Sequence.isWeaklyRegular_cons_iff R (σ (b 0)) []).mp h
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro x hx
  have bx : x = (b.repr x 0) • b 0 := by
    simpa using (b.sum_repr x).symm
  have hc : σ (b 0) • (b.repr x 0) = 0 := by
    rw [bx, map_smul] at hx
    simpa [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using hx
  have hz := hr.1.right_eq_zero_of_smul hc
  rw [bx, hz, zero_smul]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.koszulAcyclic_of_singleton_weaklyRegular
statement:
theorem koszulAcyclic_of_singleton_weaklyRegular (b : Module.Basis (Fin 1) R M)
    (σ : M →ₗ[R] R)
    (h : RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular R [σ (b 0)]) : KoszulAcyclic σ
proof:
:= by
  intro n x hx
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    let d := self (ModuleCat.of R R)
    have hr := (RingTheory.Sequence.isWeaklyRegular_cons_iff R (σ (b 0)) []).mp h
    let dc := d.cone (σ (b 0)) hr.1
    have hcycle : dc.resolution.complex.d 1 0 (singletonConeCoordinate b x) = 0 := by
      change d.coneDZero (σ (b 0)) (singletonConeCoordinate b x) = 0
      have hc := LinearMap.congr_fun (singletonConeCoordinate_differential b σ) x
      exact hc.trans ((congrArg (exteriorPower.zeroEquiv R M) hx).trans
        (map_zero (exteriorPower.zeroEquiv R M)))
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := dc.resolution_exact_lift 0 (singletonConeCoordinate b x) hcycle
    haveI : Subsingleton (dc.resolution.complex.X 2) :=
      ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp (dc.isZero 2 (by simp [dc, d, cone, self]))
    have hy0 : y = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    have hzcone : singletonConeCoordinate b x = 0 :=
      hy.symm.trans ((congrArg (fun z => (dc.resolution.complex.d 2 1).hom z) hy0).trans
        (map_zero (dc.resolution.complex.d 2 1).hom))
    have hz : x = 0 := (singletonConeCoordinate_bijective b).1
      (hzcone.trans (map_zero (singletonConeCoordinate b)).symm)
    exact ⟨0, by simp [hz]⟩
  | succ n =>
    haveI := subsingleton_exteriorPower_of_basis (I := Fin 1) b (n + 1 + 1) (by simp)
    exact ⟨0, by simp [Subsingleton.elim x 0]⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.isLocallyKoszulRegular_of_singleton_frames
statement:
theorem isLocallyKoszulRegular_of_singleton_frames
    (h : LocallySingletonWeaklyRegularFrames X M σ) : IsLocallyKoszulRegular X M σ
proof:
:= by
  intro V x hx
  obtain ⟨W, hWV, hxW, _, b, hb⟩ := h V x hx
  exact ⟨W, hWV, hxW, koszulAcyclic_of_singleton_weaklyRegular b _ hb⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.isLocallyKoszulRegular_of_empty_frames
statement:
theorem isLocallyKoszulRegular_of_empty_frames
    (h : LocallyEmptyFrames X M) : IsLocallyKoszulRegular X M σ
proof:
:= by
  intro V x hx
  obtain ⟨W, hWV, hxW, _, ⟨b⟩⟩ := h V x hx
  exact ⟨W, hWV, hxW, koszulAcyclic_of_empty_basis b _⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.g0ClassOf_cokernelCosection_of_singleton_frames
statement:
theorem g0ClassOf_cokernelCosection_of_singleton_frames [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1) (h : LocallySingletonWeaklyRegularFrames X M σ) :
    g0ClassOf X (cokernel σ)
        (cokernel_isCoherentLike X hM.isFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation
          (tensorUnitSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree X).isFinitePresentation σ) =
      k0ToG0 X (lambdaMinusOne M hM)
proof:
:=
  g0ClassOf_cokernelCosection X M hM σ
    (isLocallyKoszulRegular_of_singleton_frames X M σ h)

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.g0ClassOf_cokernelCosection_of_empty_frames
statement:
theorem g0ClassOf_cokernelCosection_of_empty_frames [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hM : HasConstantRank X M 0) (h : LocallyEmptyFrames X M) :
    g0ClassOf X (cokernel σ)
        (cokernel_isCoherentLike X hM.isFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation
          (tensorUnitSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree X).isFinitePresentation σ) =
      k0ToG0 X (lambdaMinusOne M hM)
proof:
:=
  g0ClassOf_cokernelCosection X M hM σ
    (isLocallyKoszulRegular_of_empty_frames X M σ h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.lowPart_tot
statement:
theorem lowPart_tot {G : PowerSeries (Alg.Op M)} (hG : GSer (lowFam M) G) (N : ℕ) :
    lowPart N (tot G) = PowerSeries.coeff N G
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro y
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, lowPart_lof, tot_lof]
  by_cases hN : N ≤ n
  · rw [if_pos hN]
    have hcomp : ∀ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), m ≠ N →
        DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ M (n - N) (PowerSeries.coeff m G (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M n y)) = 0 := by
      intro m hm hmN
      have hm' := Finset.mem_range.mp hm
      exact (hG m) n y (n - N) (by omega)
    rw [map_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single N (fun m hm hmN => hcomp m hm hmN)
      (fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)) h)]
    exact (low_lof_ge (hG N) hN y).symm
  · rw [if_neg hN, low_lof_lt (hG N) (by omega) y]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.lineFilt_coverG

theorem lineFilt_coverG :
    ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.LineFilt C.scheme
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj E))
      (pullClassesG S C)
proof:
:= by

  have e1 : (ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.stepClasses S.L S.L_line e).map
      (flatPullbackK0 C.toBase) = pullClassesG S C := by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.isFiniteLocallyFree_twistedG
statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_twistedG (hE : HasConstantRank X E (e + 1)) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme (ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.twistBy (twistNegG S C)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj E)))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := flat_toBaseG S C hC
  have h1 := hasConstantRank_pullback S.Y S.q E (e + 1) hE
  have h2 := hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase _ (e + 1) h1

    (hasConstantRank_twistNegG S C) h2).isFiniteLocallyFree

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.koszul_coverG
statement:
theorem koszul_coverG (hE : HasConstantRank X E (e + 1)) :
    ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.lamMinus C.scheme
        (ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.twistBy (twistNegG S C)
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj E)))
        (isFiniteLocallyFree_twistedG S C hC hE) (e + 1) =
      ((pullClassesG S C).map fun x =>
        1 - x * k0ClassOf C.scheme (twistNegG S C)
          (hasConstantRank_twistNegG S C).isFiniteLocallyFree).prod
proof:
:=
  ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.koszulProd_twist (twistNegG S C) (hasConstantRank_twistNegG S C)
    (lineFilt_coverG S C hC) (isFiniteLocallyFree_twistedG S C hC hE) (card_pullClassesG S C)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.xiCapOn_add_twistNegG
statement:
theorem xiCapOn_add_twistNegG [Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k C.scheme)] :
    xiCapOn (opsV4 k) C + totalCapOn (opsV4 k) (twistNegG S C) (hasConstantRank_twistNegG S C) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i) := fun i => by
    have := C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos (e + 1))
    exact this i
  have hT : HasConstantRank C.scheme (tensorSheaf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1))) 1 := by
    have h := hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
      (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1))
    rwa [Nat.one_mul] at h
  have h := totalCapOn_tensor (ops := opsV4 k) (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1)) (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1)) hT
  have e1 : tensorSheaf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1)) ≅
      C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 0 :=
    AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.twistingTensorIso C hpos 1 (-1) ≪≫
      eqToIso (by norm_num)
  rw [cap_isoOn (opsV4 k) hT hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf ⟨e1 ≪≫ C.canonicalTwistingSheafZeroIso⟩,
    totalCapOn_tensorUnit] at h
  exact h.symm
