name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.isLineClass_ell_m
statement:
theorem isLineClass_ell_m (i : ℕ) : IsLineKClass C.scheme
    (k0ClassOf C.scheme (piL S C i) (hasConstantRank_piL S C i).isFiniteLocallyFree *
      k0ClassOf C.scheme (twistNegG S C) (hasConstantRank_twistNegG S C).isFiniteLocallyFree)
proof:
:=
  isLineClass_mul ⟨_, hasConstantRank_piL S C i, rfl⟩ ⟨_, hasConstantRank_twistNegG S C, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.chK_ell_m
statement:
theorem chK_ell_m (i : ℕ) :
    chK k C.scheme
      (k0ClassOf C.scheme (piL S C i) (hasConstantRank_piL S C i).isFiniteLocallyFree *
        k0ClassOf C.scheme (twistNegG S C) (hasConstantRank_twistNegG S C).isFiniteLocallyFree) =
      Alg.gexp (kRoot S C i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.k0ClassOf_mul_line (hasConstantRank_twistNegG S C) (hasConstantRank_piL S C i),
    chK_line _ (GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.hasConstantRank_tensor_line (hasConstantRank_twistNegG S C)
      (hasConstantRank_piL S C i)),
    totalCapOn_tensor (ops := opsV4 k) (piL S C i) (twistNegG S C) (hasConstantRank_piL S C i)
      (hasConstantRank_twistNegG S C)
      (GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.hasConstantRank_tensor_line (hasConstantRank_twistNegG S C) (hasConstantRank_piL S C i))]
  have h := xiCapOn_add_twistNegG S C hC
  have h' : totalCapOn (opsV4 k) (twistNegG S C) (hasConstantRank_twistNegG S C) =
      -xiCapOn (opsV4 k) C := LinearMap.ext fun v => by
    have := LinearMap.congr_fun h v
    rw [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply] at this
    rw [LinearMap.neg_apply]
    exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right this
  rw [h', ← kRoot_eq_add_neg]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.chK_koszul
statement:
theorem chK_koszul (n : ℕ) :
    lamProd S C n ∈ lineSpan C.scheme ∧
      chK k C.scheme (lamProd S C n) = tot (M := fun n => RationalDimChow C.scheme n) (kSer S C n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [lamProd] using one_mem_lineSpan (W := C.scheme)
    · simp only [lamProd, Finset.range_zero, Finset.prod_empty, kSer, chK_one]
      exact (tot_one).symm
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ih
    have hell := isLineClass_ell_m S C n
    have hmem : lamProd S C n * (k0ClassOf C.scheme (piL S C n)
        (hasConstantRank_piL S C n).isFiniteLocallyFree *
        k0ClassOf C.scheme (twistNegG S C)
          (hasConstantRank_twistNegG S C).isFiniteLocallyFree) ∈ lineSpan C.scheme :=
      lineSpan_mul_line hell h1
    have hstep : lamProd S C (n + 1) = lamProd S C n -
        lamProd S C n * (k0ClassOf C.scheme (piL S C n)
          (hasConstantRank_piL S C n).isFiniteLocallyFree *
          k0ClassOf C.scheme (twistNegG S C)
            (hasConstantRank_twistNegG S C).isFiniteLocallyFree) := by
      have h0 : lamProd S C (n + 1) = lamProd S C n * (1 - k0ClassOf C.scheme (piL S C n)
          (hasConstantRank_piL S C n).isFiniteLocallyFree *
          k0ClassOf C.scheme (twistNegG S C)
            (hasConstantRank_twistNegG S C).isFiniteLocallyFree) :=
        Finset.prod_range_succ _ n
      rw [h0, sub_eq_add_neg, sub_eq_add_neg, mul_add, mul_one, mul_neg]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hstep]; exact sub_mem h1 hmem
    · rw [hstep, map_sub, chK_mul_line hell h1, h2, chK_ell_m S C hC n, gexp_eq_tot_expLine]
      have hs : kSer S C (n + 1) = kSer S C n * (1 - expLine (kRoot S C n)) := rfl
      rw [hs, tot_mul (gSer_kSer S C n) (gSer_sub GSer.one (gSer_expLine (kRoot_lowSub S C n))),
        tot_sub, tot_one, mul_sub, mul_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.map_expR_alg
statement:
theorem map_expR_alg {K : Type*} [CommRing K] [Algebra ℚ K] {R : Type*} [Semiring R] [Algebra ℚ R]
    (φ : K →ₐ[ℚ] R) (w : K) :
    PowerSeries.map φ.toRingHom (expR w) =
      PowerSeries.mk fun m => ((m.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) • (φ w) ^ m
proof:
:= by
  refine PowerSeries.ext fun m => ?_
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_map, coeff_expR, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
  change φ (algebraMap ℚ K (1 / (m.factorial : ℚ)) * w ^ m) = _
  rw [map_mul, AlgHom.commutes, map_pow, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, smul_mul_assoc,
    one_mul, one_div]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.kSer_eq_map
statement:
theorem kSer_eq_map {K : Type*} [CommRing K] [Algebra ℚ K]
    (φ : K →ₐ[ℚ] Module.End ℚ (TotalChow C.scheme)) (z : ℕ → K) (x : K)
    (hz : ∀ i, φ (z i) = aOp S C i) (hx : φ x = xiOp S C) (n : ℕ) :
    kSer S C n = PowerSeries.map φ.toRingHom
      ((Finset.range n).prod fun i => 1 - expR (z i - x))
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [kSer]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_range_succ, map_mul, ← ih, map_sub, map_one, map_expR_alg]
    have hr : φ (z n - x) = kRoot S C n := by
      rw [map_sub, hz, hx]; rfl
    rw [hr]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.push_aOp
statement:
theorem push_aOp (i : ℕ) :
    totalPushOn (opsV4 k) C.toBase ∘ₗ aOp S C i =
      rootOp (opsV4 k) S i ∘ₗ totalPushOn (opsV4 k) C.toBase
proof:
:= by
  have h := CIIL1D.chernOpOn'_push C.toBase (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) (hPk k) (S.L i) 1 (S.L_line i) 1
  have e1 := congrFun (chernOpOn'_line_series (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) (hPk k)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj (S.L i)) (hasConstantRank_piL S C i)) 1
  have e2 := congrFun (chernOpOn'_line_series (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) (hPk k) (S.L i) (S.L_line i)) 1
  simp only [one_ne_zero, if_false, if_true] at e1 e2
  rw [e1, e2] at h
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.exists_coverLift
statement:
theorem exists_coverLift :
    ∃ (K : Type u) (_ : CommRing K) (_ : Algebra ℚ K)
      (φ : K →ₐ[ℚ] Module.End ℚ (TotalChow C.scheme)),
      Function.Injective φ ∧ (∃ z : ℕ → K, ∀ i, φ (z i) = aOp S C i) ∧
        ∃ x : K, φ x = xiOp S C
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ∀ a ∈ (Set.range (aOp S C) ∪ {xiOp S C} : Set (Module.End ℚ (TotalChow C.scheme))),
      ∀ b ∈ (Set.range (aOp S C) ∪ {xiOp S C} : Set (Module.End ℚ (TotalChow C.scheme))),
      a * b = b * a := by
    rintro a (⟨i, rfl⟩ | ha) b (⟨j, rfl⟩ | hb)
    · exact aOp_comm_aOp S C i j
    · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hb]; exact aOp_comm_xiOp S C i
    · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp ha]; exact (aOp_comm_xiOp S C j).symm
    · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp ha, Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hb]
  obtain ⟨K, c1, c2, φ, hinj, hl⟩ := M7ASM.exists_comm_lift (R := Module.End ℚ (TotalChow C.scheme)) _ hs
  choose z hz using fun i => hl (aOp S C i) (Or.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hl (xiOp S C) (Or.inr rfl)
  exact ⟨K, c1, c2, φ, hinj, ⟨z, hz⟩, ⟨x, hx⟩⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.push_intertwines_add
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.comp_add, LinearMap.add_comp, ha, hb]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.push_intertwines_mul'
proof:
:= by
  rw [Module.End.mul_eq_comp, Module.End.mul_eq_comp, ← LinearMap.comp_assoc, ha,
    LinearMap.comp_assoc, hb, ← LinearMap.comp_assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.push_algebraMap
statement:
theorem push_algebraMap (F : FlagLift (opsV4 k) S)
    {K : Type*} [CommRing K] [Algebra ℚ K]
    (φ : K →ₐ[ℚ] Module.End ℚ (TotalChow C.scheme)) (a : ℚ) :
    totalPushOn (opsV4 k) C.toBase ∘ₗ φ (algebraMap ℚ K a) =
      F.φ (algebraMap ℚ F.K a) ∘ₗ totalPushOn (opsV4 k) C.toBase
proof:
:= by
  rw [AlgHom.commutes, AlgHom.commutes, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,
    Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  exact LinearMap.ext fun v => by simp [Module.End.one_eq_id]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.push_gen
statement:
theorem push_gen (F : FlagLift (opsV4 k) S)
    {K : Type*} [CommRing K] [Algebra ℚ K]
    (φ : K →ₐ[ℚ] Module.End ℚ (TotalChow C.scheme)) (z : ℕ → K)
    (hz : ∀ i, φ (z i) = aOp S C i) (n : ℕ) :
    totalPushOn (opsV4 k) C.toBase ∘ₗ φ (z n) =
      F.φ (F.root n) ∘ₗ totalPushOn (opsV4 k) C.toBase
proof:
:=
  (congrArg (fun T => totalPushOn (opsV4 k) C.toBase ∘ₗ T) (hz n)).trans
    ((push_aOp S C n).trans
      (congrArg (fun T => T ∘ₗ totalPushOn (opsV4 k) C.toBase) (F.root_spec n).symm))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.push_mul_X
statement:
theorem push_mul_X (F : FlagLift (opsV4 k) S)
    {K : Type*} [CommRing K] [Algebra ℚ K]
    (φ : K →ₐ[ℚ] Module.End ℚ (TotalChow C.scheme)) (z : ℕ → K)
    (hz : ∀ i, φ (z i) = aOp S C i) (p : MvPolynomial ℕ ℚ) (n : ℕ)
    (hp : totalPushOn (opsV4 k) C.toBase ∘ₗ φ (MvPolynomial.aeval z p) =
      F.φ (MvPolynomial.aeval F.root p) ∘ₗ totalPushOn (opsV4 k) C.toBase) :
    totalPushOn (opsV4 k) C.toBase ∘ₗ φ (MvPolynomial.aeval z (p * MvPolynomial.X n)) =
      F.φ (MvPolynomial.aeval F.root (p * MvPolynomial.X n)) ∘ₗ
        totalPushOn (opsV4 k) C.toBase
proof:
:= by
  have hB := push_gen S C F φ z hz n
  have a1 : MvPolynomial.aeval z (p * MvPolynomial.X n) = MvPolynomial.aeval z p * z n := by
    rw [map_mul (MvPolynomial.aeval z), MvPolynomial.aeval_X]
  have a2 : MvPolynomial.aeval F.root (p * MvPolynomial.X n) =
      MvPolynomial.aeval F.root p * F.root n := by
    rw [map_mul (MvPolynomial.aeval F.root), MvPolynomial.aeval_X]
  rw [a1, a2]
  have e1 : φ (MvPolynomial.aeval z p * z n) = φ (MvPolynomial.aeval z p) * φ (z n) :=
    map_mul φ _ _
  have e2 : F.φ (MvPolynomial.aeval F.root p * F.root n) =
      F.φ (MvPolynomial.aeval F.root p) * F.φ (F.root n) := map_mul F.φ _ _
  rw [e1, e2]
  exact push_intertwines_mul' _ hp hB

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.proj_formula_universal
statement:
theorem proj_formula_universal (F : FlagLift (opsV4 k) S)
    {K : Type*} [CommRing K] [Algebra ℚ K]
    (φ : K →ₐ[ℚ] Module.End ℚ (TotalChow C.scheme)) (z : ℕ → K)
    (hz : ∀ i, φ (z i) = aOp S C i) (u : MvPolynomial ℕ ℚ) :
    totalPushOn (opsV4 k) C.toBase ∘ₗ φ (MvPolynomial.aeval z u) =
      F.φ (MvPolynomial.aeval F.root u) ∘ₗ totalPushOn (opsV4 k) C.toBase
proof:
:= by
  induction u using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C a =>
    rw [MvPolynomial.aeval_C, MvPolynomial.aeval_C]
    exact push_algebraMap S C F φ a
  | add p q hp hq =>
    simp only [map_add]
    exact push_intertwines_add _ hp hq
  | mul_X p n hp => exact push_mul_X S C F φ z hz p n hp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.nroots_eq_sUniv
statement:
theorem nroots_eq_sUniv (F : FlagLift (opsV4 k) S) :
    nroots F = (sUniv e).map (MvPolynomial.aeval F.root)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [nroots, rts, sUniv, Multiset.map_map, Function.comp_apply, map_neg,
    MvPolynomial.aeval_X]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.coeff_Gt_eval
statement:
theorem coeff_Gt_eval {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [Algebra ℚ A] (g : MvPolynomial ℕ ℚ →ₐ[ℚ] A)
    (e D j k : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff j ((Gt ((sUniv e).map g) D).coeff k) = g (cUniv e D j k)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Gt_map g.toRingHom (sUniv e) D
  rw [AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe] at h
  rw [h, Polynomial.coeff_map, PowerSeries.coeff_map]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.term_eq
statement:
theorem term_eq (F : FlagLift (opsV4 k) S) {K : Type*} [CommRing K] [Algebra ℚ K]
    (φ : K →ₐ[ℚ] Module.End ℚ (TotalChow C.scheme)) (z : ℕ → K)
    (hz : ∀ i, φ (z i) = aOp S C i) (x : K) (hx : φ x = xiOp S C)
    (c : MvPolynomial ℕ ℚ) (j : ℕ) :
    haveI
proof:
:= flat_toBaseG S C hC
    totalPushOn (opsV4 k) C.toBase ∘ₗ (φ (MvPolynomial.aeval z c) * (φ x) ^ j) ∘ₗ
        totalPullOn (opsV4 k) C.toBase (e + 1) ((cpV4 k).projBundle_relDim C hC) =
      F.φ (MvPolynomial.aeval F.root c) * sandwichOn (opsV4 k) C (cpV4 k) hC j := by
  haveI := flat_toBaseG S C hC
  have h := proj_formula_universal S C F φ z hz c
  unfold sandwichOn
  rw [hx]
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro v
  have h1 := LinearMap.congr_fun h (((xiOp S C) ^ j) (totalPullOn (opsV4 k) C.toBase (e + 1)
    ((cpV4 k).projBundle_relDim C hC) v))
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Module.End.mul_apply] at h1 ⊢
  exact h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.sum_range_ext
statement:
theorem sum_range_ext {G : Type*} [AddCommMonoid G] (f : ℕ → G) {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (h0 : ∀ k, a ≤ k → f k = 0) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range a, f k = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range b, f k
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono hab) fun k _ hk' =>
    h0 k (by simpa using hk')

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.coeff_kSer_expansion
statement:
theorem coeff_kSer_expansion {K : Type*} [CommRing K] [Algebra ℚ K]
    (φ : K →ₐ[ℚ] Module.End ℚ (TotalChow C.scheme)) (z : ℕ → K) (x : K)
    (hz : ∀ i, φ (z i) = aOp S C i) (hx : φ x = xiOp S C) (N : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff N (kSer S C (e + 1)) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range ((Gt (sUniv e) N).natDegree + 1),
        if k ≤ N then φ (MvPolynomial.aeval z (cUniv e N (N - k) k)) * (φ x) ^ k else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [kSer_eq_map S C φ z x hz hx (e + 1), PowerSeries.coeff_map]
  have hprod : ((Finset.range (e + 1)).prod fun i => 1 - expR (z i - x)) =
      ((((sUniv e).map (MvPolynomial.aeval z)).map fun n => 1 - expR (-(n + x)))).prod := by
    rw [Finset.prod_eq_multiset_prod]
    simp only [sUniv, Multiset.map_map, Function.comp_apply, map_neg, MvPolynomial.aeval_X]
    refine congrArg Multiset.prod (Multiset.map_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_)
    congr 2
    ring
  rw [hprod, coeff_prod_expR _ x N N le_rfl]
  have hG : Gt ((sUniv e).map (MvPolynomial.aeval z)) N =
      (Gt (sUniv e) N).map (PowerSeries.map (MvPolynomial.aeval (R := ℚ) z).toRingHom) := by
    have := Gt_map (MvPolynomial.aeval (R := ℚ) z).toRingHom (sUniv e) N
    simpa using this
  rw [hG, map_sum]
  set P := (Gt (sUniv e) N).map (PowerSeries.map (MvPolynomial.aeval (R := ℚ) z).toRingHom) with hP
  have hnat : P.natDegree ≤ (Gt (sUniv e) N).natDegree := Polynomial.natDegree_map_le
  rw [sum_range_ext _ (b := (Gt (sUniv e) N).natDegree + 1) (by omega) ?_]
  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    split_ifs with hk
    · have hc : PowerSeries.coeff (N - k) (P.coeff k) =
          MvPolynomial.aeval z (cUniv e N (N - k) k) := by
        rw [hP, Polynomial.coeff_map, PowerSeries.coeff_map]
        rfl
      rw [hc, map_mul, map_pow]
      rfl
    · exact map_zero _
  · intro k hk
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by omega)]
    simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.zsumOp_expansion
statement:
theorem zsumOp_expansion (F : FlagLift (opsV4 k) S) (D m : ℕ) :
    zsumOp S C hC F D m =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range ((Gt (sUniv e) D).natDegree + 1),
        if e + 1 ≤ j ∧ j - (e + 1) ≤ m then
          F.φ (MvPolynomial.aeval F.root (cUniv e D (m - (j - (e + 1))) j)) *
            sandwichOn (opsV4 k) C (cpV4 k) hC j
        else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold zsumOp
  rw [nroots_eq_sUniv]
  have hG : Gt ((sUniv e).map (MvPolynomial.aeval (R := ℚ) F.root)) D =
      (Gt (sUniv e) D).map (PowerSeries.map (MvPolynomial.aeval (R := ℚ) F.root).toRingHom) := by
    have := Gt_map (MvPolynomial.aeval (R := ℚ) F.root).toRingHom (sUniv e) D
    simpa using this
  have hnat : (Gt ((sUniv e).map (MvPolynomial.aeval (R := ℚ) F.root)) D).natDegree ≤
      (Gt (sUniv e) D).natDegree := by
    rw [hG]; exact Polynomial.natDegree_map_le
  rw [sum_range_ext _ (b := (Gt (sUniv e) D).natDegree + 1) (by omega) ?_]
  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    split_ifs with hj
    · rw [coeff_Gt_eval (MvPolynomial.aeval (R := ℚ) F.root) e D]
    · rfl
  · intro j hj
    split_ifs with hj'
    · rw [Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by omega)]
      simp
    · rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.zxOp_koszul_eq_zsum
statement:
theorem zxOp_koszul_eq_zsum (F : FlagLift (opsV4 k) S) (m : ℕ) :
    zxOp k (hPk k) (GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.chExact_projectiveIntegral (k := k)) C hC
        (lamProd S C (e + 1)) m = zsumOp S C hC F (e + 1 + m) m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, c1, c2, φ, hinj, ⟨z, hz⟩, ⟨x, hx⟩⟩ := exists_coverLift S C hC
  haveI := flat_toBaseG S C hC
  have hch : chK0 k (hPk k) (GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.chExact_projectiveIntegral (k := k))
      (lamProd S C (e + 1)) = tot (kSer S C (e + 1)) := (chK_koszul S C hC (e + 1)).2
  unfold zxOp
  rw [hch, lowPart_tot (gSer_kSer S C (e + 1)), coeff_kSer_expansion S C φ z x hz hx,
    zsumOp_expansion S C hC F]
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro v
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  by_cases hjN : j ≤ e + 1 + m
  · rw [if_pos hjN]
    have ht := LinearMap.congr_fun
      (term_eq S C hC F φ z hz x hx (cUniv e (e + 1 + m) (e + 1 + m - j) j) j) v
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Module.End.mul_apply] at ht
    by_cases hj1 : e + 1 ≤ j
    · rw [if_pos ⟨hj1, by omega⟩]
      have hm : e + 1 + m - j = m - (j - (e + 1)) := by omega
      rw [hm] at ht ⊢
      exact ht
    · rw [if_neg (by omega)]
      have h0 := sandwichOn_eq_zero_of_lt (opsV4 k) C (cpV4 k) hC (j := j) (by omega)
      rw [h0] at ht
      simpa using ht
  · rw [if_neg hjN, if_neg (by omega)]
    simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoG_appIso_inv_restrict
statement:
theorem m7geoG_appIso_inv_restrict {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion f] (U : Y.Opens)
    (hU : U ≤ f ''ᵁ ⊤) (s : Γ(X, ⊤)) :
    (f.appLE U (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) le_rfl).hom
      ((Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hU).op).hom ((f.appIso ⊤).inv s)) =
      ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op).hom s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.map_appLE]
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply]
  rw [Scheme.Hom.appIso_inv_appLE]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoG_ratio_on_literal_chart
proof:
:= C.basisIndex_finite i
    ((m7geoF_j C i l).appLE
      (m7geoF_W C i c ⊓ m7geoF_W C i l)
      (m7geoF_j C i l ⁻¹ᵁ (m7geoF_W C i c ⊓ m7geoF_W C i l)) le_rfl).hom
      (m7geoF_ratio C i c l) =
      (((C.literalLinearOpen ⟨i, l⟩).toScheme.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE le_top).op).hom
        (show Γ((C.literalLinearOpen ⟨i, l⟩).toScheme, ⊤) from
          tautChart_component Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))
            (C.sectionBasis i l) (C.sectionBasis i c))) := by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  exact m7geoG_appIso_inv_restrict (m7geoF_j C i l)
    (m7geoF_W C i c ⊓ m7geoF_W C i l)
    (inf_le_right.trans
      (Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange (m7geoF_j C i l)).ge) _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoG_chartι_preimage_overlap
statement:
theorem m7geoG_chartι_preimage_overlap {X : Scheme.{u}} {E : X.Modules}
    (C : AffineFrameCover X E) (i : C.I) (c l : C.basisIndex i) :
    C.chartι i ⁻¹ᵁ (m7geoF_W C i c ⊓ m7geoF_W C i l) =
      C.literalLinearOpen ⟨i, c⟩ ⊓ C.literalLinearOpen ⟨i, l⟩
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  exact and_congr (m7geo_chartι_mem_W C i c y)
    (m7geo_chartι_mem_W C i l y)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoG_chartι_preimage_linear_overlap
statement:
theorem m7geoG_chartι_preimage_linear_overlap {X : Scheme.{u}} {E : X.Modules}
    (C : AffineFrameCover X E) (i : C.I) (c l : C.basisIndex i) :
    C.chartι i ⁻¹ᵁ (m7geoF_W C i c ⊓ m7geoF_W C i l) =
      linearOverlapOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))
        (C.sectionBasis i c) (C.sectionBasis i l)
proof:
:= by
  rw [m7geoG_chartι_preimage_overlap, linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoG_basis_reindex
statement:
theorem m7geoG_basis_reindex {X : Scheme.{u}} {E : X.Modules}
    (C : AffineFrameCover X E) (i : C.I) [Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)]
    (a : Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1)) :
    m7g_b C i a = C.sectionBasis i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a)
proof:
:= by
  simp [m7g_b]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D18.repCap_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem repCap_of_isUnit {L : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (s : Γ(L, ⊤)) (n : ℕ)
    (w : X) (hw : IsUnit (eqOf hL s w)) : RepCap (k := k) L hL n (eqOf hL s) w
proof:
:= by
  intro hh
  have hne : ∀ z : pointClosureScheme w, eqOf hL s (pointClosureι w z) ∉
      Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι w z) := by
    intro z hz
    have hass := D14.associated_of_specializes (eqFrames hL s)
      (C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι w z)
    have hu := hass.isUnit_iff.mpr hw
    unfold Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes at hz
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff] at hz
    exact hz hu
  obtain ⟨bp, b, c₀, hc⟩ :=
    (D14.ClosureFrames.ofLocalEquationFrames (eqFrames hL s) w hne).frameCompare
  let G : DimRelationGenerator X n :=
    ⟨pointClosureScheme w, pointClosureι w, c₀, hc.1,
      fun y hy ↦ D5.height_pointClosure_of_coheight_one (k := k) n w hh y hy⟩
  refine ⟨D5.primeCycleOfFrame (k := k) L hL n w hh b + G.cycle, ?_, fun y ↦ ?_⟩
  · have hG : (QuotientAddGroup.mk G.cycle : DimChow X n) = 0 :=
      (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff _).mpr (AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨G, rfl⟩)
    rw [D5.primeCap_eq (k := k) L hL n w hh b, QuotientAddGroup.mk_add, hG, add_zero]
  · have := D10.coeff_eq_of_frameCompare (k := k) L hL w (eqOf hL s) (fun _ ↦ 1) b c₀ hc y
    rw [D8.c1CapPrimeCoeff_one, sub_zero] at this
    exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D18.isProperForD_closure
statement:
theorem isProperForD_closure {L : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (s : Γ(L, ⊤)) (n : ℕ)
    (v : X) (hv : height v = n + 1) (hη : IsUnit (eqOf hL s v)) :
    IsProperForD (closureGen (k := k) n v hv) (eqOf hL s)
proof:
:= by
  have hgv : pointClosureι v (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v)) = v := by
    rw [← C1Cap.pointClosureGenericPoint_eq_genericPoint, pointClosureι_genericPoint]
  refine D14.isProperForD_of_frames (closureGen (k := k) n v hv) (eqFrames hL s)
    (by change IsUnit (eqOf hL s (pointClosureι v (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v))))
        rw [hgv]; exact hη)
    (fun w _ hw ↦ absurd ⟨1, isUnit_one, map_one _⟩ hw)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D18.exists_of_coeff_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_of_coeff_ne_zero (b : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (v w : X)
    (h : C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff b v w ≠ 0) :
    ∃ x : pointClosureScheme v, pointClosureι v x = w ∧ coheight x = 1 ∧
      b.pullback (pointClosureι v) x ∈
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalk x)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : v ⤳ w := by
    by_contra hh
    exact h (C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_not_specializes b hh)
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := C1Cap.exists_pointClosureι_eq hs
  rw [c1CapPrimeCoeff_pointClosureι_eq] at h
  unfold cbW at h
  by_cases hx : coheight x = 1
  · rw [if_pos hx] at h
    refine ⟨x, rfl, hx, ?_⟩
    by_contra hnm
    apply h
    have hu : IsUnit (b.pullback (pointClosureι v) x) := IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal.mp hnm
    rw [Ring.ord_of_isUnit hu]
    simp
  · rw [if_neg hx] at h
    exact absurd rfl h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D18.gateData_of_generated
statement:
theorem gateData_of_generated [Infinite k] {L M : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1)
    (hLg : ∀ p : X, ∃ s : Γ(L, ⊤), ∃ d : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData X L p,
      IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ d.U p d.mem (D10.sectionCoordSec d s)))
    (hMg : ∀ p : X, ∃ s : Γ(M, ⊤), ∃ d : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData X M p,
      IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ d.U p d.mem (D10.sectionCoordSec d s)))
    (m : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = m + 2) :
    ∃ a b : C1Cap.LocalEquations X, GateData (k := k) L M hL hM m v a b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨sL, hsL⟩ := D14.sectionsAvoidFinite_of_generated (k := k) L hLg {v}
    (Set.finite_singleton v)
  have hLv : IsUnit (eqOf hL sL v) := hsL v rfl (frameOf hL v)
  have hPa : IsProperForD (closureGen (k := k) (m + 1) v hv) (eqOf hL sL) :=
    isProperForD_closure (k := k) hL sL (m + 1) v hv hLv
  have hfin := hPa.finite
  obtain ⟨sM, hsM⟩ := D14.sectionsAvoidFinite_of_generated (k := k) M hMg
    ({v} ∪ pointClosureι v '' {w : pointClosureScheme v | coheight w = 1 ∧
      (eqOf hL sL).pullback (pointClosureι v) w ∈
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalk w)})
    ((Set.finite_singleton v).union (hfin.image _))
  have hMv : IsUnit (eqOf hM sM v) := hsM v (Or.inl rfl) (frameOf hM v)
  have hPb : IsProperForD (closureGen (k := k) (m + 1) v hv) (eqOf hM sM) :=
    isProperForD_closure (k := k) hM sM (m + 1) v hv hMv
  have hU1 : ∀ x : pointClosureScheme v, coheight x = 1 →
      (eqOf hL sL).pullback (pointClosureι v) x ∈
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalk x) →
      IsUnit (eqOf hM sM (pointClosureι v x)) := fun x hx1 hax ↦
    hsM _ (Or.inr ⟨x, ⟨hx1, hax⟩, rfl⟩) (frameOf hM _)
  have hjoint : ∀ z : pointClosureScheme v, coheight z ≤ 2 →
      ∀ q : Ideal ((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalk z), q.IsPrime →
        (eqOf hL sL).pullback (pointClosureι v) z ∈ q →
        (eqOf hM sM).pullback (pointClosureι v) z ∈ q →
        q = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalk z) := by
    intro z hz q hq haq hbq
    by_contra hqm
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxq⟩ := Scheme.exists_specializes_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_eq z q
    subst hxq
    have hxz : x ≠ z := by
      rintro rfl
      exact hqm (SchemeLocalOrdSymmetry.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_self hx)
    have hx1 : coheight x = 1 :=
      C1Cap.coheight_eq_one_of_mem_stalkPrime hx hxz hz (hPb.ne_zero z) hbq
    have hax := (mem_maximalIdeal_iff_of_associated (hPa.associated hx)).mp haq
    have hbx := (mem_maximalIdeal_iff_of_associated (hPb.associated hx)).mp hbq
    have hbu := hU1 x hx1 hax
    exact ((IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).mp hbx) (hbu.map _)
  refine ⟨eqOf hL sL, eqOf hM sM, ⟨⟨hPa.ne_zero, hPb.ne_zero, hPa.associated, hPb.associated,
    hjoint⟩, repCap_of_isUnit (k := k) hM sM (m + 1) v hMv,
    repCap_of_isUnit (k := k) hL sL (m + 1) v hLv, fun w hw ↦ ?_, fun w hw ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨x, rfl, hx1, hbx⟩ := exists_of_coeff_ne_zero (eqOf hM sM) v w hw
    apply repCap_of_isUnit (k := k) hL sL m
    by_contra hna
    have hax : (eqOf hL sL).pullback (pointClosureι v) x ∈
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalk x) := by
      rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff]
      intro hu
      exact hna ((D14.pullback_isUnit_iff (closureGen (k := k) (m + 1) v hv) x).mp hu)
    have hbu := hU1 x hx1 hax
    exact ((IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).mp hbx) (hbu.map _)
  · obtain ⟨x, rfl, hx1, hax⟩ := exists_of_coeff_ne_zero (eqOf hL sL) v w hw
    exact repCap_of_isUnit (k := k) hM sM m _ (hU1 x hx1 hax)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D18.capCommGate_of_generated
statement:
theorem capCommGate_of_generated [Infinite k] (ops : ChowOps k) {L M : X.Modules}
    {hL : HasConstantRank X L 1} {hM : HasConstantRank X M 1}
    (hLg : ∀ p : X, ∃ s : Γ(L, ⊤), ∃ d : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData X L p,
      IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ d.U p d.mem (D10.sectionCoordSec d s)))
    (hMg : ∀ p : X, ∃ s : Γ(M, ⊤), ∃ d : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData X M p,
      IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ d.U p d.mem (D10.sectionCoordSec d s))) :
    D17.CapCommGate ops L M hL hM
proof:
:=
  capCommGate_of_properMeeting (k := k) ops
    (fun m v hv ↦ gateData_of_generated (k := k) hL hM hLg hMg m v hv)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D18.capCommute_of_generated
statement:
theorem capCommute_of_generated [Infinite k] (ops : ChowOps k) {L M : X.Modules}
    {hL : HasConstantRank X L 1} {hM : HasConstantRank X M 1}
    (hLg : ∀ p : X, ∃ s : Γ(L, ⊤), ∃ d : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData X L p,
      IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ d.U p d.mem (D10.sectionCoordSec d s)))
    (hMg : ∀ p : X, ∃ s : Γ(M, ⊤), ∃ d : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData X M p,
      IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ d.U p d.mem (D10.sectionCoordSec d s))) :
    D17.CapCommute ops L M hL hM
proof:
:=
  D17.capCommute_of_gate (capCommGate_of_generated (k := k) ops hLg hMg)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIMB.coeff_poly
statement:
theorem coeff_poly (c : ℕ → A) (r n : ℕ) :
    (poly c r).coeff n = if n < r + 1 then c n else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [poly, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X_pow]
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
  simp [Finset.mem_range]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIMB.coe_poly
statement:
theorem coe_poly (c : ℕ → A) (r : ℕ) (hc : ∀ n, r < n → c n = 0) :
    ((poly c r : Polynomial A) : PowerSeries A) = PowerSeries.mk c
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_coe, coeff_poly, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
  split_ifs with h
  · rfl
  · exact (hc n (by omega)).symm

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIMB.alg_bridge
statement:
theorem alg_bridge (a d : ℕ → A) (L ℓ : A) (hLℓ : L * ℓ = 1) (r : ℕ)
    (ha : ∀ n, r < n → a n = 0) (hd : ∀ n, r < n → d n = 0)
    (h : PowerSeries.mk d * (1 + PowerSeries.C L * PowerSeries.X) =
      PowerSeries.mk a * (1 + PowerSeries.X)) :
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), (-1 : A) ^ n * d n =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), (-1 : A) ^ n * (a n * ℓ ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  have hJ := SchemeKTheory.TautKernelLambda.sum_alt_eq d a L h r
  set kos : A := ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), (-1 : A) ^ n * (a n * ℓ ^ n) with hkos
  
  have hpoly : poly d r * (1 + Polynomial.C L * Polynomial.X) =
      poly a r * (1 + Polynomial.X) := by
    apply Polynomial.coe_injective
    have h1 := coe_poly d r hd
    have h2 := coe_poly a r ha
    simp only [Polynomial.coe_mul, Polynomial.coe_add, Polynomial.coe_one, Polynomial.coe_C,
      Polynomial.coe_X, h1, h2]
    exact h
  have hev := congrArg (Polynomial.eval (-ℓ)) hpoly
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_one, Polynomial.eval_C,
    Polynomial.eval_X] at hev
  have hz : (1 + L * -ℓ) = 0 := by linear_combination (-1 : A) * hLℓ
  rw [hz, mul_zero] at hev
  have hpa : (poly a r).eval (-ℓ) = kos := by
    simp only [poly, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
      Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X, hkos]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
    rw [neg_pow]; ring
  rw [hpa] at hev
  
  have h1 : kos * (1 - ℓ) = 0 := by rw [sub_eq_add_neg]; exact hev.symm
  have hLk : L * kos = kos := by
    have : L * kos = L * (ℓ * kos) := by
      congr 1; linear_combination h1
    rw [this, ← mul_assoc, hLℓ, one_mul]
  have hLrk : ∀ m : ℕ, L ^ m * kos = kos := by
    intro m; induction m with
    | zero => simp
    | succ m ih => rw [pow_succ, mul_assoc, hLk, ih]
  have hJ' : ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), (-1 : A) ^ b * a b * L ^ (r - b) = L ^ r * kos := by
    rw [hkos, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b hb => ?_
    have hb' : b ≤ r := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hb)
    have : L ^ r = L ^ (r - b) * L ^ b := by rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
    have hb1 : L ^ b * ℓ ^ b = 1 := by rw [← mul_pow, hLℓ, one_pow]
    calc (-1 : A) ^ b * a b * L ^ (r - b)
        = (-1 : A) ^ b * a b * L ^ (r - b) * (L ^ b * ℓ ^ b) := by rw [hb1, mul_one]
      _ = L ^ r * ((-1 : A) ^ b * (a b * ℓ ^ b)) := by rw [this]; ring
  rw [hJ, hJ', hLrk]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIMB.isLineK_mul
statement: theorem isLineK_mul {x y : K0 Y} (hx : IsLineK Y x) (hy : IsLineK Y y) : IsLineK Y (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L', hL', rfl⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨L, hL, rfl⟩ := hy
  have hT : HasConstantRank Y (tensorSheaf Y L' L) 1 := by
    have := hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hL' hL
    rwa [Nat.mul_one] at this
  exact ⟨tensorSheaf Y L' L, hT,
    k0ClassOf_mul Y ⟨L', hL'.isFiniteLocallyFree⟩ ⟨L, hL.isFiniteLocallyFree⟩⟩

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIMB.rescale_C'
statement:
theorem rescale_C' {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (a m : R) :
    PowerSeries.rescale a (PowerSeries.C m) = PowerSeries.C m
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_rescale, PowerSeries.coeff_C]
  split_ifs with h
  · subst h; simp
  · simp

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIMB.lambdaSeries_of_line
statement:
theorem lambdaSeries_of_line {y : K0 Y} (hy : IsLineK Y y) :
    ((Additive.toMul (lambdaT Y y) : (PowerSeries (K0 Y))ˣ) : PowerSeries (K0 Y)) =
      1 + PowerSeries.C y * PowerSeries.X
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, hL, rfl⟩ := hy
  rw [lambdaT_classOf, toMul_ofMul, coe_lambdaSeriesUnit, lambdaSeries_rankOne _ _ hL]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIMB.lambdaT_sum_line
statement:
theorem lambdaT_sum_line {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → K0 Y)
    (hf : ∀ i, IsLineK Y (f i)) :
    ((Additive.toMul (lambdaT Y (∑ i ∈ s, f i)) : (PowerSeries (K0 Y))ˣ) : PowerSeries (K0 Y)) =
      ∏ i ∈ s, (1 + PowerSeries.C (f i) * PowerSeries.X)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.prod_insert ha, map_add, toMul_add, Units.val_mul, ih,
      lambdaSeries_of_line (hf a)]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIMB.lambdaOp_sum_line
statement:
theorem lambdaOp_sum_line {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → K0 Y)
    (hf : ∀ i, IsLineK Y (f i)) (n : ℕ) :
    lambdaOp Y n (∑ i ∈ s, f i) =
      PowerSeries.coeff n (∏ i ∈ s, (1 + PowerSeries.C (f i) * PowerSeries.X))
proof:
:= by
  rw [lambdaOp, lambdaT_sum_line s f hf]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIMB.lambdaOp_mul_line
statement:
theorem lambdaOp_mul_line [IsNoetherian Y] {W : Y.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hW : HasConstantRank Y W r)
    {M : Y.Modules} (hM : HasConstantRank Y M 1) (n : ℕ) :
    lambdaOp Y n (k0ClassOf Y W hW.isFiniteLocallyFree * k0ClassOf Y M hM.isFiniteLocallyFree) =
      lambdaClass Y W hW.isFiniteLocallyFree n * k0ClassOf Y M hM.isFiniteLocallyFree ^ n
proof:
:= by
  let T := SchemeProjectiveBundle.flagTower r W hW
  have hinj : Function.Injective (flatPullbackK0 T.q) :=
    SchemeProjectiveBundle.splitting_injective SchemeProjectiveBundle.pbInjectiveHyp hW
  apply hinj
  have hmul : ∀ x z : K0 Y, flatPullbackK0 T.q (x * z) = flatPullbackK0 T.q x * flatPullbackK0 T.q z := by
    intro x z
    have := (flatPullbackK0RingHom T.q).map_mul x z
    simpa only [flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply] using this
  have hsum : flatPullbackK0 T.q (k0ClassOf Y W hW.isFiniteLocallyFree) =
      ∑ i, k0ClassOf T.Y (T.L i) (T.rankOne i).isFiniteLocallyFree :=
    T.pullback_class_eq_sum hW.isFiniteLocallyFree
  set M' : K0 T.Y := flatPullbackK0 T.q (k0ClassOf Y M hM.isFiniteLocallyFree) with hM'
  have hM'line : IsLineK T.Y M' :=
    ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pullback T.q).obj M, hasConstantRank_pullback T.Y T.q M 1 hM,
      flatPullbackK0_classOf T.q M hM.isFiniteLocallyFree⟩
  have hm : ∀ i, IsLineK T.Y
      (k0ClassOf T.Y (T.L i) (T.rankOne i).isFiniteLocallyFree) := fun i =>
    ⟨T.L i, T.rankOne i, rfl⟩
  have hy : ∀ i, IsLineK T.Y
      (k0ClassOf T.Y (T.L i) (T.rankOne i).isFiniteLocallyFree * M') := fun i =>
    isLineK_mul (hm i) hM'line
  
  have hL : flatPullbackK0 T.q (lambdaOp Y n (k0ClassOf Y W hW.isFiniteLocallyFree *
      k0ClassOf Y M hM.isFiniteLocallyFree)) =
      PowerSeries.coeff n (∏ i, (1 + PowerSeries.C
        (k0ClassOf T.Y (T.L i) (T.rankOne i).isFiniteLocallyFree * M') * PowerSeries.X)) := by
    rw [GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.flatPullbackK0_lambdaOp, hmul, hsum, Finset.sum_mul,
      lambdaOp_sum_line Finset.univ _ hy]
  
  have hW' : flatPullbackK0 T.q (lambdaClass Y W hW.isFiniteLocallyFree n) =
      PowerSeries.coeff n (∏ i, (1 + PowerSeries.C
        (k0ClassOf T.Y (T.L i) (T.rankOne i).isFiniteLocallyFree) * PowerSeries.X)) := by
    rw [← lambdaOp_classOf, GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.flatPullbackK0_lambdaOp, hsum, lambdaOp_sum_line Finset.univ _ hm]
  have hpow : flatPullbackK0 T.q (k0ClassOf Y M hM.isFiniteLocallyFree ^ n) = M' ^ n := by
    have := map_pow (flatPullbackK0RingHom T.q) (k0ClassOf Y M hM.isFiniteLocallyFree) n
    simpa only [flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply] using this
  have hres : (∏ i, (1 + PowerSeries.C
      (k0ClassOf T.Y (T.L i) (T.rankOne i).isFiniteLocallyFree * M') * PowerSeries.X)) =
      PowerSeries.rescale M' (∏ i, (1 + PowerSeries.C
        (k0ClassOf T.Y (T.L i) (T.rankOne i).isFiniteLocallyFree) * PowerSeries.X)) := by
    rw [map_prod]
    refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    simp only [map_add, map_one, map_mul, PowerSeries.rescale_X, rescale_C']
    ring
  rw [hL, hmul, hW', hpow, hres, PowerSeries.coeff_rescale, mul_comm]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIMB.lambdaMinusOne_taut_eq_kosX
statement:
theorem lambdaMinusOne_taut_eq_kosX :
    lambdaMinusOne C.tautologicalKernel (C.hasConstantRank_tautologicalKernel hE) =
      GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.kosX C.scheme
        (k0ClassOf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj N)
            (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase N r hN).isFiniteLocallyFree *
          k0ClassOf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1))
            (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1)).isFiniteLocallyFree) r
proof:
:= by
  haveI := C.isNoetherian_scheme
  have hW := hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase N r hN
  have hK := C.hasConstantRank_tautologicalKernel hE
  have hM := C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1)
  rw [lambdaMinusOne_eq_sum, GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.kosX]
  have hser := SchemeKTheory.TautKernelLambda.lambdaSeries_taut_mul C hN hE
  have eK : lambdaSeries C.scheme C.tautologicalKernel hK.isFiniteLocallyFree =
      PowerSeries.mk (fun n => lambdaClass C.scheme C.tautologicalKernel hK.isFiniteLocallyFree n) :=
    PowerSeries.ext fun n => by rw [coeff_lambdaSeries, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
  have eW : lambdaSeries C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj N)
      hW.isFiniteLocallyFree =
      PowerSeries.mk (fun n => lambdaClass C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj N)
        hW.isFiniteLocallyFree n) :=
    PowerSeries.ext fun n => by rw [coeff_lambdaSeries, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
  rw [eK, eW] at hser
  have key := alg_bridge
    (fun n => lambdaClass C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj N)
        hW.isFiniteLocallyFree n)
    (fun n => lambdaClass C.scheme C.tautologicalKernel hK.isFiniteLocallyFree n)
    (k0ClassOf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
      (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).isFiniteLocallyFree)
    (k0ClassOf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1)) hM.isFiniteLocallyFree)
    (GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.k0_twist_inv C hpos) r
    (fun n hn => lambdaClass_eq_zero_of_rank_lt C.scheme _ r hW n hn)
    (fun n hn => lambdaClass_eq_zero_of_rank_lt C.scheme _ r hK n hn) hser
  rw [key]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
  rw [lambdaOp_mul_line hW hM n]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.hom_ext_of_over_coversTop
statement:
theorem hom_ext_of_over_coversTop
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {M N : X.Modules} {I : Type u}
    (U : I → X.Opens)
    (hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop U)
    (f g : M ⟶ N)
    (h : ∀ i, f.over (U i) = g.over (U i)) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply (SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).map_injective
  apply Sheaf.hom_ext
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext W
  apply AddCommGrpCat.hom_ext
  ext m
  apply N.isSheaf.isSeparated W.unop
    (Sieve.ofObjects U W.unop) (hU W.unop)
  rintro Z a ⟨i, ⟨b⟩⟩
  have happ := congrArg
    (fun k ↦ k.val.app (op (Over.mk b))) (h i)
  change N.val.map a.op (f.val.app W m) =
    N.val.map a.op (g.val.app W m)
  calc
    N.val.map a.op (f.val.app W m) =
        (show N.val.obj (op Z) from
          f.val.app (op Z) (M.val.map a.op m)) :=
      (CategoryTheory.congr_fun (f.val.naturality a.op) m).symm
    _ = (show N.val.obj (op Z) from
        g.val.app (op Z) (M.val.map a.op m)) := by
      exact CategoryTheory.congr_fun happ _
    _ = (show N.val.obj (op Z) from
        N.val.map a.op (g.val.app W m)) := by
      exact CategoryTheory.congr_fun (g.val.naturality a.op) m

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearFrameChangeOverIso_self
statement:
theorem linearFrameChangeOverIso_self
    (d : ℤ) (x : M) (V : (space R M).Opens)
    (hVx : V ≤ linearOpen R M x) :
    linearFrameChangeOverIso R M d x x V hVx hVx =
      Iso.refl _
proof:
:= by
  let F := linearFrameChangeOverIso R M d x x V hVx hVx
  have hFF : F.hom ≫ F.hom = F.hom := by
    simpa only [Iso.trans_hom] using congrArg Iso.hom
      (linearFrameChangeOverIso_trans R M d
        x x x V hVx hVx hVx)
  apply Iso.ext
  apply (cancel_epi F.hom).1
  simpa only [F, Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id] using hFF

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso_restrict_hom_comp
statement:
theorem twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso_restrict_hom_comp
    (d : ℤ) (i : ι) (j : κ) (k : τ)
    {V : (space R M).Opens}
    (hVbc : V ≤ basisChangeOpen R M b c i j)
    (hVce : V ≤ basisChangeOpen R M c e j k)
    (hVbe : V ≤ basisChangeOpen R M b e i k) :
    Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (space R M) hVbc
          (twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso R M b c d i j).hom ≫
        Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (space R M) hVce
          (twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso R M c e d j k).hom =
      Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (space R M) hVbe
        (twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso R M b e d i k).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hVb : V ≤ linearOpen R M (b i) :=
    hVbc.trans ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (c j)).le.trans
      inf_le_left)
  have hVc : V ≤ linearOpen R M (c j) :=
    hVbc.trans ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (c j)).le.trans
      inf_le_right)
  have hVe : V ≤ linearOpen R M (e k) :=
    hVce.trans ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (c j) (e k)).le.trans
      inf_le_right)
  let eb := twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso R M b d i hVb
  let ec := twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso R M c d j hVc
  let ee := twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso R M e d k hVe
  let Fbc := linearFrameChangeOverIso R M (-d)
    (b i) (c j) V hVb hVc
  let Fce := linearFrameChangeOverIso R M (-d)
    (c j) (e k) V hVc hVe
  let Fbe := linearFrameChangeOverIso R M (-d)
    (b i) (e k) V hVb hVe
  have hF : Fbc.hom ≫ Fce.hom = Fbe.hom := by
    simpa only [Iso.trans_hom] using congrArg Iso.hom
      (linearFrameChangeOverIso_trans R M (-d)
        (b i) (c j) (e k) V hVb hVc hVe)
  rw [twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso_restrict_hom
      R M b c d i j hVbc,
    twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso_restrict_hom
      R M c e d j k hVce,
    twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso_restrict_hom
      R M b e d i k hVbe]
  change (eb.hom ≫ Fbc.hom ≫ ec.inv) ≫
      (ec.hom ≫ Fce.hom ≫ ee.inv) =
    eb.hom ≫ Fbe.hom ≫ ee.inv
  simp only [Category.assoc, ec.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg
    (fun q ↦ eb.hom ≫ q ≫ ee.inv) hF

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.basisChangeTripleOpen_iSup_eq_top
statement:
theorem basisChangeTripleOpen_iSup_eq_top :
    ⨆ q : (ι × κ) × τ, basisChangeTripleOpen R M b c e q = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm le_top
  intro x hx
  have hb : x ∈ ⨆ i, linearOpen R M (b i) := by
    rw [linearOpen_iSup_eq_top R M b]
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  have hc : x ∈ ⨆ j, linearOpen R M (c j) := by
    rw [linearOpen_iSup_eq_top R M c]
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  have he : x ∈ ⨆ k, linearOpen R M (e k) := by
    rw [linearOpen_iSup_eq_top R M e]
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hb
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hc
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp he
  apply Opens.mem_iSup.mpr
  exact ⟨((i, j), k), ⟨⟨hi, hj⟩, hk⟩⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_comp
statement:
theorem twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_comp
    (d : ℤ) :
    twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M b c d ≫
        twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M c e d =
      twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M b e d
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext_of_over_coversTop
    (space R M) (basisChangeTripleOpen R M b c e)
    (basisChangeTripleOpen_coversTop R M b c e)
  intro q
  let V := basisChangeTripleOpen R M b c e q
  have hVb : V ≤ linearOpen R M (b q.1.1) :=
    inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left
  have hVc : V ≤ linearOpen R M (c q.1.2) :=
    inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right
  have hVe : V ≤ linearOpen R M (e q.2) :=
    inf_le_right
  have hVbc : V ≤ basisChangeOpen R M b c q.1.1 q.1.2 := by
    rw [basisChangeOpen, linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
    exact le_inf hVb hVc
  have hVce : V ≤ basisChangeOpen R M c e q.1.2 q.2 := by
    rw [basisChangeOpen, linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
    exact le_inf hVc hVe
  have hVbe : V ≤ basisChangeOpen R M b e q.1.1 q.2 := by
    rw [basisChangeOpen, linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
    exact le_inf hVb hVe
  have hbc :
      (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M b c d).over V =
        Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (space R M) hVbc
            (twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso
              R M b c d q.1.1 q.1.2).hom := by
    calc
      _ = Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (space R M) hVbc
            ((twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M b c d).over
              (basisChangeOpen R M b c q.1.1 q.1.2)) := by
        rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_over]
      _ = _ := congrArg
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (space R M) hVbc)
        (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_over
          R M b c d q.1.1 q.1.2)
  have hce :
      (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M c e d).over V =
        Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (space R M) hVce
            (twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso
              R M c e d q.1.2 q.2).hom := by
    calc
      _ = Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (space R M) hVce
            ((twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M c e d).over
              (basisChangeOpen R M c e q.1.2 q.2)) := by
        rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_over]
      _ = _ := congrArg
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (space R M) hVce)
        (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_over
          R M c e d q.1.2 q.2)
  have hbe :
      (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M b e d).over V =
        Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (space R M) hVbe
            (twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso
              R M b e d q.1.1 q.2).hom := by
    calc
      _ = Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (space R M) hVbe
            ((twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M b e d).over
              (basisChangeOpen R M b e q.1.1 q.2)) := by
        rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_over]
      _ = _ := congrArg
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (space R M) hVbe)
        (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_over
          R M b e d q.1.1 q.2)
  change (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M b c d ≫
      twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M c e d).over V =
    (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M b e d).over V
  change (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M b c d).over V ≫
      (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M c e d).over V =
    (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M b e d).over V
  rw [hbc, hce, hbe]
  exact twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso_restrict_hom_comp
    R M b c e d q.1.1 q.1.2 q.2 hVbc hVce hVbe

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_self
statement:
theorem twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_self
    (d : ℤ) :
    twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M b b d = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext_of_over_coversTop
    (space R M) (fun i : ι ↦ linearOpen R M (b i))
    (linearOpen_coversTop R M b)
  intro i
  let V := linearOpen R M (b i)
  have hVii : V ≤ basisChangeOpen R M b b i i := by
    rw [basisChangeOpen, linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
    exact le_inf le_rfl le_rfl
  have hlocal :
      (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M b b d).over V =
        Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (space R M) hVii
          (twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso
            R M b b d i i).hom := by
    calc
      _ = Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (space R M) hVii
          ((twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M b b d).over
            (basisChangeOpen R M b b i i)) := by
        rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_over]
      _ = _ := congrArg
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (space R M) hVii)
        (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_over R M b b d i i)
  rw [hlocal,
    twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso_restrict_hom
      R M b b d i i hVii]
  let eb := twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso R M b d i le_rfl
  let F := linearFrameChangeOverIso R M (-d)
    (b i) (b i) V le_rfl le_rfl
  change eb.hom ≫ F.hom ≫ eb.inv = 𝟙 _
  have hF : F.hom = 𝟙 _ := by
    simpa only [Iso.refl_hom] using congrArg Iso.hom
      (linearFrameChangeOverIso_self R M (-d) (b i) V le_rfl)
  rw [hF]
  change eb.hom ≫ eb.inv = 𝟙 _
  exact eb.hom_inv_id

statement:
theorem restrictionChartTo_preimage_leftLinearOpen
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    (W : X.affineOpens) (hWc : W.1 ≤ c.affineOpen.1)
    [Module.Free Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))]
    [Module.Finite Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))]
    (hWs : W.1 ≤ C.U s) (a : C.basisIndex i) :
    c.restrictionChartTo s W hWs hWc ⁻¹ᵁ
        linearOpen Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
          (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))
          (c.leftSectionBasis a) =
      linearOpen Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))
        (C.restrictedSectionBasis i W.1
          (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left) a)
proof:
:= by
  unfold restrictionChartTo
  change
    semilinearSymmetricProjMap
          (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWc).op).hom
          (c.subRestriction W hWc)
          (c.subRestriction_spans W hWc) ⁻¹ᵁ
        linearOpen Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
          (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))
          (c.leftSectionBasis a) =
      linearOpen Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))
        (C.restrictedSectionBasis i W.1
          (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left) a)
  rw [semilinearSymmetricProjMap_preimage_linearOpen]
  congr 1
  exact C.restrictedSectionBasis_trans i c.affineOpen.1 W.1
    c.affineOpen_le_left hWc a

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.restrictionChartTo_left_app_transitionSectionUnit_heq
statement:
theorem restrictionChartTo_left_app_transitionSectionUnit_heq
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    (W : X.affineOpens) (hWc : W.1 ≤ c.affineOpen.1)
    [Module.Free Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))]
    [Module.Finite Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))]
    (hWs : W.1 ≤ C.U s) (d : ℤ) (a b : C.basisIndex i) :
    HEq
      ((c.restrictionChartTo s W hWs hWc).app
        (linearOverlapOpen Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
          (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))
          (c.leftSectionBasis a) (c.leftSectionBasis b))
        (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit
          Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) d
          (c.leftSectionBasis a) (c.leftSectionBasis b)).1)
      (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit
        Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1)) d
        (C.restrictedSectionBasis i W.1
          (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left) a)
        (C.restrictedSectionBasis i W.1
          (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left) b)).1
proof:
:= by
  have ht :=
    semilinearSymmetricProjMap_app_transitionSectionUnit_heq
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWc).op).hom
      (c.subRestriction W hWc)
      (c.subRestriction_spans W hWc) d
      (c.leftSectionBasis a) (c.leftSectionBasis b)
  have ha :
      c.subRestriction W hWc (c.leftSectionBasis a) =
        C.restrictedSectionBasis i W.1
          (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left) a :=
    C.restrictedSectionBasis_trans i c.affineOpen.1 W.1
      c.affineOpen_le_left hWc a
  have hb :
      c.subRestriction W hWc (c.leftSectionBasis b) =
        C.restrictedSectionBasis i W.1
          (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left) b :=

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.restrictionChartTo_twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_naturality
statement:
theorem restrictionChartTo_twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_naturality
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    (W : X.affineOpens) (hWc : W.1 ≤ c.affineOpen.1)
    [Module.Free Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))]
    [Module.Finite Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))]
    [Finite (C.basisIndex i)] [Finite (C.basisIndex j)]
    (hWs : W.1 ≤ C.U s)
    (hOpen : IsOpenImmersion (c.restrictionChartTo s W hWs hWc))
    (d : ℤ) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
        (c.restrictionChartTo s W hWs hWc)).map
          (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom
            Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))
            c.leftSectionBasis c.rightSectionBasis d) ≫
        (c.restrictionChartToRightTwistRestrictIso
          W hWc hWs hOpen d).hom =
      (c.restrictionChartToLeftTwistRestrictIso
          W hWc hWs hOpen d).hom ≫
        twistingSheafBasisChangeHom
          Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))
          (C.restrictedSectionBasis i W.1
            (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left))
          (C.restrictedSectionBasis j W.1
            (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right)) d
proof:
:= by
  letI := hOpen
  convert
    (@twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_restrict_naturality
      _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
        inferInstance inferInstance
      c.leftSectionBasis c.rightSectionBasis
      (C.restrictedSectionBasis i W.1
        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left))
      (C.restrictedSectionBasis j W.1
        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right))
      d (c.restrictionChartTo s W hWs hWc) hOpen
      (c.restrictionChartTo_preimage_leftLinearOpen W hWc hWs)
      (c.restrictionChartTo_preimage_rightLinearOpen W hWc hWs)
      (c.restrictionChartTo_preimage_basisChangeOpen W hWc hWs)
      (c.restrictionChartTo_app_basisChangeTransitionSectionUnit_heq
        W hWc hWs (-d))
      (c.restrictionChartToLeftTwistRestrictionData
        W hWc hWs hOpen d)
      (c.restrictionChartToRightTwistRestrictionData
        W hWc hWs hOpen d)
      (by rfl) (by rfl)) using 1 <;>
        rfl

    CommonBasicOpen.chartToLeft_isOpenImmersion c
  letI := hOpenR
  letI := hOpenS
  unfold restrictionChartToLeftAmbientTwistRestrictIso

  convert
    (@twistingSheafRestrictionComp_congr_hom_eq
      _ _ _ _ _ _ _
      _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
      _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
      _ _ _ _
      c.chartToLeft

      (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource i
        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left))

      hOpenR hOpenS

      (c.restrictionChartTo_preimage_leftLinearOpen
        W hWc hWsource)

        source i W hWsource (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left))

        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left) hOpenS d)

  all_goals

      twistingSheafRestrictionCompIso, Iso.trans_hom,

    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) (source : C.I)

    (hWc : W.1 ≤ c.affineOpen.1)
    [Module.Free Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))]
    [Module.Finite Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))]
    [Finite (C.basisIndex i)] [Finite (C.basisIndex j)]
    (hOpenR : IsOpenImmersion
      (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc))
    (hOpenL : IsOpenImmersion
      (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource i
        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left)))
    (hOpenS : IsOpenImmersion
      (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource j
        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right)))
    (d : ℤ) :
    (c.canonicalTwistComparisonFinalRestrictIso
      source W hWsource hWc hOpenR hOpenL hOpenS d).hom =
      (directTwistRestrictIso source i W hWsource
        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left) hOpenL d).hom ≫
        twistingSheafBasisChangeHom
          Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))
          (C.restrictedSectionBasis i W.1
            (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left))
          (C.restrictedSectionBasis j W.1
            (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right)) d ≫
        (directTwistRestrictIso source j W hWsource
          (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right) hOpenS d).inv
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsOpenImmersion c.chartToLeft :=
    CommonBasicOpen.chartToLeft_isOpenImmersion c
  letI : IsOpenImmersion c.chartToRight :=
    CommonBasicOpen.chartToRight_isOpenImmersion c
  letI := hOpenR
  letI := hOpenL
  letI := hOpenS
  unfold canonicalTwistComparisonFinalRestrictIso
  unfold transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonRestrictIso
  calc
    _ =
        (((@restrictCompPrefixIso'
              _ _ _
              (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource i
                (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left))
              c.chartToLeft
              (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc)
              hOpenL (CommonBasicOpen.chartToLeft_isOpenImmersion c) hOpenR
              (c.restrictionChartTo_comp_left source W hWsource hWc)
              (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)) ≪≫
            (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
              (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc)).mapIso
                ((c.leftTwistRestrictionData d).restrictIso) ≪≫
            c.restrictionChartToLeftTwistRestrictIso
              W hWc hWsource hOpenR d) ≪≫
          (c.restrictionChartToLeftTwistRestrictIso
            W hWc hWsource hOpenR d).symm ≪≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
            (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc)).mapIso
              (c.twistingSheafBasisIso d) ≪≫
          c.restrictionChartToRightTwistRestrictIso
            W hWc hWsource hOpenR d ≪≫
          ((@restrictCompPrefixIso'
              _ _ _
              (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource j
                (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right))
              c.chartToRight
              (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc)
              hOpenS (CommonBasicOpen.chartToRight_isOpenImmersion c) hOpenR
              (c.restrictionChartTo_comp_right source W hWsource hWc)
              (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j)) ≪≫
            (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
              (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc)).mapIso
                ((c.rightTwistRestrictionData d).restrictIso) ≪≫
            c.restrictionChartToRightTwistRestrictIso
              W hWc hWsource hOpenR d).symm).hom := by
      exact mapIso_threefold_factorization
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
          (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc))
        ((c.leftTwistRestrictionData d).restrictIso)
        (c.twistingSheafBasisIso d)
        ((c.rightTwistRestrictionData d).restrictIso)
        (@restrictCompPrefixIso'
          _ _ _
          (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource i
            (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left))
          c.chartToLeft
          (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc)
          hOpenL (CommonBasicOpen.chartToLeft_isOpenImmersion c) hOpenR
          (c.restrictionChartTo_comp_left source W hWsource hWc)
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i))
        (@restrictCompPrefixIso'
          _ _ _
          (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource j
            (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right))
          c.chartToRight
          (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc)
          hOpenS (CommonBasicOpen.chartToRight_isOpenImmersion c) hOpenR
          (c.restrictionChartTo_comp_right source W hWsource hWc)
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j))
        (c.restrictionChartToLeftTwistRestrictIso
          W hWc hWsource hOpenR d)
        (c.restrictionChartToRightTwistRestrictIso
          W hWc hWsource hOpenR d)
    _ = _ := by
      have hnat :
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
              (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc)).map
                (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom
                  Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
                  (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))
                  c.leftSectionBasis c.rightSectionBasis d) ≫
              (c.restrictionChartToRightTwistRestrictIso
                W hWc hWsource hOpenR d).hom =
            (c.restrictionChartToLeftTwistRestrictIso
                W hWc hWsource hOpenR d).hom ≫
              twistingSheafBasisChangeHom
                Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))
                (C.restrictedSectionBasis i W.1
                  (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left))
                (C.restrictedSectionBasis j W.1
                  (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right)) d := by
        convert
          c.restrictionChartTo_twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_naturality
            W hWc hWsource hOpenR d using 1 <;>
              rfl
      have hmiddle :
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
              (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc)).mapIso
                (c.twistingSheafBasisIso d)).hom ≫
              (c.restrictionChartToRightTwistRestrictIso
                W hWc hWsource hOpenR d).hom =
            (c.restrictionChartToLeftTwistRestrictIso
                W hWc hWsource hOpenR d).hom ≫
              (twistingSheafBasisChangeIso
                Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))
                (C.restrictedSectionBasis i W.1
                  (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left))
                (C.restrictedSectionBasis j W.1
                  (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right)) d).hom := by
        simpa only [Functor.mapIso_hom,
          CommonBasicOpen.twistingSheafBasisIso,
          twistingSheafBasisChangeIso, asIso_hom,
          CommonBasicOpen.leftTwistingSheaf,
          CommonBasicOpen.rightTwistingSheaf] using hnat
      convert
        fivefold_factorization_of_coherence
          (c.restrictionChartToLeftAmbientTwistRestrictIso
            source W hWsource hWc hOpenR hOpenL d)
          (directTwistRestrictIso source i W hWsource
            (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left) hOpenL d)
          (c.restrictionChartToLeftTwistRestrictIso
            W hWc hWsource hOpenR d)
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
            (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc)).mapIso
              (c.twistingSheafBasisIso d))
          (c.restrictionChartToRightTwistRestrictIso
            W hWc hWsource hOpenR d)
          (c.restrictionChartToRightAmbientTwistRestrictIso
            source W hWsource hWc hOpenR hOpenS d)
          (directTwistRestrictIso source j W hWsource
            (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right) hOpenS d)
          (twistingSheafBasisChangeIso
            Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))
            (C.restrictedSectionBasis i W.1
              (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left))
            (C.restrictedSectionBasis j W.1
              (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right)) d)
          (c.leftTwistRestrictionFactorization
            source W hWsource hWc hOpenR hOpenL d)
          hmiddle
          (c.rightTwistRestrictionFactorization
            source W hWsource hWc hOpenR hOpenS d) using 1 <;>
              rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.leftTwistPullbackFactorization
statement:
theorem leftTwistPullbackFactorization
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) (source : C.I)
    (W : X.affineOpens) (hWsource : W.1 ≤ C.U source)
    (hWc : W.1 ≤ c.affineOpen.1)
    [Module.Free Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))]
    [Module.Finite Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))]
    [Finite (C.basisIndex i)]
    (hOpenR : IsOpenImmersion
      (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc))
    (hOpenS : IsOpenImmersion
      (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource i
        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left)))
    (d : ℤ) :
    (c.restrictionChartToLeftAmbientTwistPullbackIso
      source W hWsource hWc hOpenR hOpenS d).hom =
      (directTwistPullbackIso source i W hWsource
        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left) hOpenS d).hom
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsOpenImmersion c.chartToLeft :=
    CommonBasicOpen.chartToLeft_isOpenImmersion c
  letI := hOpenR
  letI := hOpenS
  unfold restrictionChartToLeftAmbientTwistPullbackIso
    directTwistPullbackIso
    restrictionChartToLeftTwistPullbackIso
  change
    (pullbackRestrictionCompIso
          (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource i
            (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left))
          c.chartToLeft
          (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc)
          (c.restrictionChartTo_comp_left source W hWsource hWc)
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i) ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback
          (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc)).mapIso
            ((c.leftTwistRestrictionData d).pullbackIso) ≪≫
        (c.restrictionChartToLeftTwistRestrictionData
          W hWc hWsource hOpenR d).pullbackIso).hom =
      (directTwistRestrictionData source i W hWsource
        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left) hOpenS d).pullbackIso.hom
  dsimp only [AffineFrameCover.chartTwistingSheaf]
  simp only [id_eq]
  rw [pullbackRestrictionCompIso_twistingSheafRestriction_hom]
  have hrestrict :=
    twistingSheafRestrictionComp_congr_hom_eq
      c.chartToLeft_preimage_linearOpen
      (c.restrictionChartTo_preimage_leftLinearOpen
        W hWc hWsource)
      (directRestrictionChartMap_preimage_linearOpen
        source i W hWsource (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left))
      (c.restrictionChartTo_comp_left source W hWsource hWc)
      (c.leftTwistRestrictionData d)
      (c.restrictionChartToLeftTwistRestrictionData
        W hWc hWsource hOpenR d)
      (directTwistRestrictionData source i W hWsource
        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left) hOpenS d)
      (by rfl) (by rfl) (by rfl)
  simp only [TwistingSheafRestrictionData.pullbackIso,
    Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom]
  exact congrArg
    (fun z ↦
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback
        (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource i
          (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left))).app
            (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex
              Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))
                (C.sectionBasis i) d)).inv ≫ z)
    hrestrict

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.canonicalTwistComparisonFinalPullbackIso_hom_eq
statement:
theorem canonicalTwistComparisonFinalPullbackIso_hom_eq
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) (source : C.I)
    (W : X.affineOpens) (hWsource : W.1 ≤ C.U source)
    (hWc : W.1 ≤ c.affineOpen.1)
    [Module.Free Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))]
    [Module.Finite Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))]
    [Finite (C.basisIndex i)] [Finite (C.basisIndex j)]
    (hOpenR : IsOpenImmersion
      (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc))
    (hOpenL : IsOpenImmersion
      (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource i
        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left)))
    (hOpenS : IsOpenImmersion
      (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource j
        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right)))
    (d : ℤ) :
    (c.canonicalTwistComparisonFinalPullbackIso
      source W hWsource hWc hOpenR hOpenL hOpenS d).hom =
      (directTwistPullbackIso source i W hWsource
        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left) hOpenL d).hom ≫
        twistingSheafBasisChangeHom
          Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))
          (C.restrictedSectionBasis i W.1
            (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left))
          (C.restrictedSectionBasis j W.1
            (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right)) d ≫
        (directTwistPullbackIso source j W hWsource
          (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right) hOpenS d).inv
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsOpenImmersion c.chartToLeft :=
    CommonBasicOpen.chartToLeft_isOpenImmersion c
  letI : IsOpenImmersion c.chartToRight :=
    CommonBasicOpen.chartToRight_isOpenImmersion c
  letI := hOpenR
  letI := hOpenL
  letI := hOpenS
  unfold canonicalTwistComparisonFinalPullbackIso
  unfold transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso
  calc
    _ =
        (c.restrictionChartToLeftAmbientTwistPullbackIso
            source W hWsource hWc hOpenR hOpenL d ≪≫
          (c.restrictionChartToLeftTwistPullbackIso
            source W hWsource hWc hOpenR d).symm ≪≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback
            (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc)).mapIso
              (c.twistingSheafBasisIso d) ≪≫
          c.restrictionChartToRightTwistPullbackIso
            source W hWsource hWc hOpenR d ≪≫
          (c.restrictionChartToRightAmbientTwistPullbackIso
            source W hWsource hWc hOpenR hOpenS d).symm).hom := by
      exact mapIso_threefold_factorization
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback
          (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc))
        ((c.leftTwistRestrictionData d).pullbackIso)
        (c.twistingSheafBasisIso d)
        ((c.rightTwistRestrictionData d).pullbackIso)
        (@pullbackRestrictionCompIso _ _ _
          (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource i
            (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left))
          c.chartToLeft
          (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc)
          hOpenL (CommonBasicOpen.chartToLeft_isOpenImmersion c) hOpenR
          (c.restrictionChartTo_comp_left source W hWsource hWc)
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i))
        (@pullbackRestrictionCompIso _ _ _
          (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource j
            (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right))
          c.chartToRight
          (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc)
          hOpenS (CommonBasicOpen.chartToRight_isOpenImmersion c) hOpenR
          (c.restrictionChartTo_comp_right source W hWsource hWc)
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j))
        (c.restrictionChartToLeftTwistPullbackIso
          source W hWsource hWc hOpenR d)
        (c.restrictionChartToRightTwistPullbackIso
          source W hWsource hWc hOpenR d)
    _ = _ := by
      have hmiddle :
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
              (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc)).mapIso
                (c.twistingSheafBasisIso d)).hom ≫
              (c.restrictionChartToRightTwistPullbackIso
                source W hWsource hWc hOpenR d).hom =
            (c.restrictionChartToLeftTwistPullbackIso
                source W hWsource hWc hOpenR d).hom ≫
              (twistingSheafBasisChangeIso
                Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))
                (C.restrictedSectionBasis i W.1
                  (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left))
                (C.restrictedSectionBasis j W.1
                  (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right)) d).hom := by
        change
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback
              (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc)).map
                (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom
                  Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
                  (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))
                  c.leftSectionBasis c.rightSectionBasis d) ≫
              (c.restrictionChartToRightTwistRestrictionData
                W hWc hWsource hOpenR d).pullbackIso.hom =
            (c.restrictionChartToLeftTwistRestrictionData
                W hWc hWsource hOpenR d).pullbackIso.hom ≫
              twistingSheafBasisChangeHom
                Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))
                (C.restrictedSectionBasis i W.1
                  (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left))
                (C.restrictedSectionBasis j W.1
                  (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right)) d
        apply twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_pullback_naturality_of_restrict
        exact c.restrictionChartTo_twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_naturality
          W hWc hWsource hOpenR d
      convert
        fivefold_factorization_of_coherence
          (c.restrictionChartToLeftAmbientTwistPullbackIso
            source W hWsource hWc hOpenR hOpenL d)
          (directTwistPullbackIso source i W hWsource
            (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left) hOpenL d)
          (c.restrictionChartToLeftTwistPullbackIso
            source W hWsource hWc hOpenR d)
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
            (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc)).mapIso
              (c.twistingSheafBasisIso d))
          (c.restrictionChartToRightTwistPullbackIso
            source W hWsource hWc hOpenR d)
          (c.restrictionChartToRightAmbientTwistPullbackIso
            source W hWsource hWc hOpenR hOpenS d)
          (directTwistPullbackIso source j W hWsource
            (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right) hOpenS d)
          (twistingSheafBasisChangeIso
            Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))
            (C.restrictedSectionBasis i W.1
              (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left))
            (C.restrictedSectionBasis j W.1
              (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right)) d)
          (c.leftTwistPullbackFactorization
            source W hWsource hWc hOpenR hOpenL d)
          hmiddle
          (c.rightTwistPullbackFactorization
            source W hWsource hWc hOpenR hOpenS d) using 1 <;>
              rfl

proof:

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tripleCocycleSecondChart_right_chartι_eq_directK
statement:
theorem tripleCocycleSecondChart_right_chartι_eq_directK
    (i j k : C.I) (q : (C.tripleCocycleCover i j k).I₀) :
    (C.tripleCocycleSecondChart i j k q ≫
        q.1.1.2.chartToRight) ≫ C.chartι k =
      ((C.tripleCocycleCover i j k).f q ≫
        pullback.snd (C.overlapToChart i j) (C.overlapToChart i k) ≫
        C.transition i k ≫ C.overlapToChart k i) ≫ C.chartι k
proof:
:= by
  have hright := congrArg (fun z ↦ z ≫ C.chartι k)
    (C.tripleCocycleSecondChart_right i j k q)
  calc
    _ = (C.tripleCocycleCover i j k).f q ≫
          C.transitionTriple i j k ≫ C.transitionTriple j k i ≫
          pullback.snd (C.overlapToChart k i) (C.overlapToChart k j) ≫
          C.overlapToChart k j ≫ C.chartι k := by
        exact hright
    _ = _ := by
      rw [C.transitionTriple_fac_assoc j k i,
        ← C.overlapToChart_chartι_eq j k,
        C.transitionTriple_fst_assoc i j k,
        C.tripleFirstLeg_toChart_assoc]
      unfold tripleToChart
      simp only [Category.assoc]
      rw [← C.overlapToChart_chartι_eq i j,
        ← C.overlapToChart_chartι_eq i k,
        ← pullback.condition_assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistChosenTripleLocalToChartK_eq
statement:
theorem twistChosenTripleLocalToChartK_eq (i j k : C.I)
    (l : (C.twistChosenTripleCocycleCover i j k).I₀) :
    C.twistChosenTripleLocalToChartK i j k l =
      (C.twistChosenTripleCocycleCover i j k).f l ≫
        (C.twistChosenPullback₃ i j k).p₃
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (C.chartι k)).1
  unfold twistChosenTripleLocalToChartK
  let q := C.twistChosenTripleCocycleIndex i j k l
  let a := C.twistChosenTripleCocycleToLocal i j k l
  have hlocal := congrArg (fun z ↦ a ≫ z)
    (C.tripleCocycleSecondChart_right_chartι_eq_directK i j k q)
  change a ≫ ((C.tripleCocycleSecondChart i j k q ≫
      q.1.1.2.chartToRight) ≫ C.chartι k) =
    ((C.twistChosenTripleCocycleCover i j k).f l ≫
      (C.twistChosenPullback₃ i j k).p₃) ≫ C.chartι k
  calc
    _ = a ≫ (((C.tripleCocycleCover i j k).f q ≫
          pullback.snd (C.overlapToChart i j)
            (C.overlapToChart i k) ≫
          C.transition i k ≫ C.overlapToChart k i) ≫
          C.chartι k) := hlocal
    _ = _ := by
      dsimp only [a, q]
      simp only [Category.assoc]
      rw [C.twistChosenTripleCocycleToLocal_fac_assoc]
      exact congrArg
        (fun z ↦ (C.twistChosenTripleCocycleCover i j k).f l ≫
          z ≫ C.chartι k)
        (C.twistChosenTripleToTripleOverlap_toChartK i j k)

    Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
        (C.twistChosenTriplePullHomIJ T i j k)
        ((C.twistChosenTripleCocycleCover i j k).f l)
        (C.twistChosenTripleLocalToChartI i j k l)
        (C.twistChosenTripleLocalToChartJ i j k l)
        (hgf₁ := (C.twistChosenTripleLocalToChartI_eq i j k l).symm)
        (hgf₂ := (C.twistChosenTripleLocalToChartJ_eq i j k l).symm) =
      C.twistChosenTripleLocalPullHomIJ T i j k l

    ((C.twistChosenTripleCocycleCover i j k).f l ≫
      (C.twistChosenPullback₃ i j k).p)
    (C.twistChosenPullback₃ i j k).p₁
    (C.twistChosenPullback₃ i j k).p₂
    (C.twistChosenTripleLocalToChartI i j k l)
    (C.twistChosenTripleLocalToChartJ i j k l)

    (C.twistChosenPullback₃_w₁ i j k)

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.local_refl_step_a
statement:
theorem local_refl_step_a (U : X.affineOpens) (c : CommonBasicOpen U U) :
    (chartIdentifications I).localTransition U U c ≫ overlapToChart I U U =
      (basicOpenOverlapCover I U U).f c ≫ overlapToChart I U U
proof:
:= by
  rw [ChartIdentifications.localTransition_eq]
  unfold ChartIdentifications.targetMap ChartIdentifications.targetIso chartIdentifications
  rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, Iso.trans_inv, Category.assoc,
    ← commonBasicOpenChartIso_hom_chartMap, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc,
    ← commonBasicOpenChartIso_hom_chartMap]
  congr 1
  exact eqToHom_comp_of_heq (congrArg (chart I) c.swap_affineOpen).symm
    (basicOpenChartMap I U c.left) (basicOpenChartMap I U c.right)
    (basicOpenChartMap_heq_of_basicOpen_eq U I c.left c.right c.basicOpen_eq)

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.overlapToIntersection_eq

        X.homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_intersection
proof:
:= by
  unfold basicOpenOverlapCover
  rw [← Scheme.Cover.pullbackHom_map, ← commonBasicOpenChartIso_hom_toCommonBase, Category.assoc,
    Category.assoc, CommonBasicOpen.affineOpenIsoInIntersection_hom_baseCover]

proof:

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.local_refl_step_b
statement:

      (basicOpenOverlapCover I U U).f c ≫ overlapToIntersection I U U

  rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, Iso.trans_inv, Category.assoc,
    overlapToIntersection_eq, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc,
    overlapToIntersection_eq]
  congr 1
  exact eqToHom_comp_of_heq (congrArg (chart I) c.swap_affineOpen).symm
    (chartToOpen I c.affineOpen ≫ X.homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_intersection)
    (chartToOpen I c.swap.affineOpen ≫ X.homOfLE c.swap.affineOpen_le_intersection)
    (heq_chartToOpen_comp_homOfLE I c.swap_affineOpen.symm
      c.affineOpen_le_intersection c.swap.affineOpen_le_intersection)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5FR.closure_max_span
statement:
theorem closure_max_span {W : Scheme.{u}} (w : W) (z : pointClosureScheme w)
    (g : W.presheaf.stalk (pointClosureι w z))
    (hm : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (W.presheaf.stalk (pointClosureι w z)) = Ideal.span {g}) :
    IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((pointClosureScheme w).presheaf.stalk z) =
      Ideal.span {((pointClosureι w).stalkMap z).hom g}
proof:
:=
  E27.maximalIdeal_eq_span_image ((pointClosureι w).stalkMap z).hom
    ((pointClosureι w).stalkMap_surjective z) g ⊥ bot_le (by rw [hm, sup_bot_eq])

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5FR.closure_image_ne_zero_of_max
statement:
theorem closure_image_ne_zero_of_max {W : Scheme.{u}} (w : W) (z : pointClosureScheme w)
    (g : W.presheaf.stalk (pointClosureι w z)) (hne : w ≠ pointClosureι w z)
    (hmax : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((pointClosureScheme w).presheaf.stalk z) =
      Ideal.span {((pointClosureι w).stalkMap z).hom g}) :
    ((pointClosureι w).stalkMap z).hom g ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  rw [h0, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot.mpr rfl] at hmax
  have h : w ⤳ pointClosureι w z := specializes_pointClosureι z
  have h' : (pointClosureι w) (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme w)) ⤳ pointClosureι w z := by
    rw [E27.pointClosureι_genericPoint']; exact h
  have hker : RingHom.ker ((pointClosureι w).stalkMap z).hom =
      Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h := by
    rw [ker_stalkMap_eq_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (pointClosureι w) z h']
    exact E27.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_congr (E27.pointClosureι_genericPoint' w) h' h
  have hmax' : Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (W.presheaf.stalk (pointClosureι w z)) := by
    rw [← hker, RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, ← hmax, IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap]
  exact hne (E27.eq_of_stalkPrime_eq_maximal h hmax')

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5FR.maximalIdeal_eq_ker_stalkMap_generic
statement:

proof:
