    (RingHom.ker_isMaximal_of_surjective (ι.stalkMap (genericPoint Z)).hom
      (ι.stalkMap_surjective (genericPoint Z)))).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5FR.ord_eq_one_at_lift
statement:
theorem ord_eq_one_at_lift {L : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (ι : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι]
    (hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = ι.ker)
    (w : X) (hne : w ≠ ι (genericPoint Z))
    (z : pointClosureScheme w)
    (hz : pointClosureι w z = ι (genericPoint Z))
    (hcoh : coheight z = 1) :
    (pointClosureScheme w).ord
      (D10.sectionCoord (closureFrame (hL := hL) w z)
        (wPullbackSection (pointClosureι w) (E26.sectionOfHom σ))) z = 1
proof:
:= by
  haveI : L.IsLocallyFree := hL.isFiniteLocallyFree.isLocallyFree
  haveI : L.IsFinitePresentation :=
    IsFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation X hL.isFiniteLocallyFree
  have haux : ∀ (y : X) (hy : ι (genericPoint Z) = y) (d : WFrame L y),
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk y) =
        Ideal.span {X.presheaf.germ d.U y d.mem (wCoord d (E26.sectionOfHom σ))} := by
    intro y hy d
    subst hy
    exact (maximalIdeal_eq_ker_stalkMap_generic ι).trans
      (E27.ker_stalkMap_eq_span_germ_wCoord σ ι hid (genericPoint Z) d)
  have hm := haux (pointClosureι w z) hz.symm (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z))
  have hmax := closure_max_span w z _ hm
  have hne0 := closure_image_ne_zero_of_max w z _ (by rw [hz]; exact hne) hmax
  rw [E25.sectionCoord_eq_algebraMap_germ _ _ z (closureFrame (hL := hL) w z).mem,
    E27.germ_sectionCoordSec_closureFrame hL w _ z]
  exact Scheme.ord_algebraMap_eq_one_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal hcoh hne0 hmax.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5FR.height_genericPoint_closedImmersion_lt
statement:
theorem height_genericPoint_closedImmersion_lt {n : ℕ} (ι : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι]
    (hZ : height (genericPoint Z) = (n : ℕ∞)) (p : Z) : height (ι p) ≤ (n : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  rw [height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion ι p, ← hZ]
  exact Order.height_mono (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr (genericPoint_specializes p))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5FR.generic_not_mem_range
statement:
theorem generic_not_mem_range {n : ℕ} (ι : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι]
    (hX : height (genericPoint X) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
    (hZ : height (genericPoint Z) = (n : ℕ∞)) : genericPoint X ∉ Set.range ι
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨p, hp⟩
  have h := height_genericPoint_closedImmersion_lt ι hZ p
  rw [hp, hX] at h
  have : n + 1 ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast h
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5FR.weil_coeff_ite
statement:
theorem weil_coeff_ite {L : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (ι : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι]
    (hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = ι.ker) {n : ℕ}
    (hX : height (genericPoint X) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
    (hZ : height (genericPoint Z) = (n : ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ (bf : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme (genericPoint X))
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι (genericPoint X))).obj L)
        (pointClosureGenericPoint (genericPoint X))),
      ∀ z : pointClosureScheme (genericPoint X),
        Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame
          (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL (genericPoint X))
          (m7s_genericRank_pointClosure L hL (genericPoint X)) bf z =
        if pointClosureι (genericPoint X) z = ι (genericPoint Z) then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI : L.IsLocallyFree := hL.isFiniteLocallyFree.isLocallyFree
  haveI : L.IsFinitePresentation :=
    IsFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation X hL.isFiniteLocallyFree
  have hnotw := generic_not_mem_range ι hX hZ
  have hιq : height (ι (genericPoint Z)) = (n : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion ι, hZ]
  have hne : genericPoint X ≠ ι (genericPoint Z) := fun h => hnotw ⟨_, h.symm⟩
  let z₀ : pointClosureScheme (genericPoint X) := pointClosureGenericPoint (genericPoint X)
  have hsupp : pointClosureι (genericPoint X) z₀ ∉ (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).support := by
    rw [hid, pointClosureι_genericPoint]
    exact E26.notMem_support_ker ι _ hnotw
  have hu := E26.wCoord_isUnit_of_notMem_support σ (pointClosureι (genericPoint X) z₀) hsupp
    (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι (genericPoint X) z₀))
  have hM := isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL (genericPoint X)
  have hrank := m7s_genericRank_pointClosure L hL (genericPoint X)
  obtain ⟨bf, hb⟩ := E26.exists_refFrame (hL := hL) (genericPoint X) (E26.sectionOfHom σ) z₀ hu
  
  have hlift : ι (genericPoint Z) ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι (genericPoint X)) := by
    rw [range_pointClosureι]
    exact specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp (genericPoint_specializes _)
  obtain ⟨zq, hzq⟩ := hlift
  have hcohq : coheight zq = 1 :=
    E28.coheight_eq_one_of_height (genericPoint X) (n := n) hX (ι (genericPoint Z)) hιq zq hzq
  refine ⟨bf, fun z => ?_⟩
  by_cases hz : pointClosureι (genericPoint X) z = ι (genericPoint Z)
  · rw [if_pos hz]
    have hc : coheight z = 1 :=
      E28.coheight_eq_one_of_height (genericPoint X) (n := n) hX (ι (genericPoint Z)) hιq z hz
    rw [E25.coeff_eq_ord_sectionCoord hM hrank bf _ hb (closureFrame (hL := hL) _ z) z
      (closureFrame (hL := hL) _ z).mem]
    exact ord_eq_one_at_lift hL σ ι hid (genericPoint X) hne z hz hc
  · rw [if_neg hz]
    by_cases hc : coheight z = 1
    · by_cases hr : pointClosureι (genericPoint X) z ∈ Set.range ι
      · exfalso
        obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hr
        have hspec : ι (genericPoint Z) ⤳ ι p :=
          (genericPoint_specializes p).map ι.continuous
        have hle : pointClosureι (genericPoint X) z ≤ ι (genericPoint Z) := by
          rw [Scheme.le_iff_specializes, ← hp]; exact hspec
        have hlt : pointClosureι (genericPoint X) z < ι (genericPoint Z) :=
          lt_of_le_not_ge hle (fun h' => hz (by
            have h1 := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hle
            have h2 := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp h'
            exact (h2.antisymm h1).eq))
        rw [← hzq] at hlt
        have hzz : z < zq := (E28.pointClosureι_lt_iff (genericPoint X) z zq).mp hlt
        have := Order.coheight_add_one_le hzz
        rw [hcohq, hc] at this
        norm_num at this
      · exact E28.coeff_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range hL (genericPoint X) hM hrank σ ι hid bf hb z hr
    · exact E25.coeff_eq_zero_of_coheight_ne hM hrank bf z hc

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5FR.cap_generic_eq_push
statement:
theorem cap_generic_eq_push {L : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (ι : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι] [ι.IsOver (Spk k)]
    (hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = ι.ker) {n : ℕ}
    (hX : height (genericPoint X) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
    (hZ : height (genericPoint Z) = (n : ℕ∞)) :
    ops.cap L hL n ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint X) (n + 1) hX) : DimChow X (n + 1))) =
      ops.push ι n ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint Z) n hZ) : DimChow Z n))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨bf, hcoef⟩ := weil_coeff_ite hL σ ι hid hX hZ
  have hjq : ι (genericPoint Z) ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι (genericPoint X)) := by
    rw [range_pointClosureι]
    exact specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp (genericPoint_specializes _)
  let D : dimensionCycles Z n := dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint Z) n hZ
  let D' : dimensionCycles X n :=
    ⟨properPushforward ι D.1,
      properPushforward_mem_dimensionCycles ι (heightCompatible_of_finiteType k ι) D.2⟩
  have hD' : D'.1 = properPushforward (pointClosureι (genericPoint X))
      (Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame
        (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL (genericPoint X))
        (m7s_genericRank_pointClosure L hL (genericPoint X)) bf).1 := by
    ext y
    change properPushforward ι (dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint Z) n hZ).1 y = _
    rw [E21.pp_prime_apply]
    by_cases hy : y ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι (genericPoint X))
    · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hy
      rw [E21.pp_apply_image]
      exact (hcoef z).symm
    · rw [E21.pp_apply_notRange _ _ y hy, if_neg]
      rintro rfl
      exact hy hjq
  rw [ops.cap_mk L hL n (genericPoint X) hX (m7s_genericRank_pointClosure L hL _) bf D' hD']
  exact (ops.push_mk ι n D D' rfl).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D8.properPushforward_weil_eq_coeff
statement:
theorem properPushforward_weil_eq_coeff (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (x : X)
    {bpoint : pointClosureScheme x}
    (b : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme x)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι x)).obj L) bpoint)
    (a : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (hb : LocalEqOfFrame L x a b) :
    ⇑(properPushforward (pointClosureι x)
      (Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame
        (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL x)
        (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one L hL x) b).1) = C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a x
proof:
:= by
  funext y
  change AlgebraicCycle.pushforward (pointClosureι x) _ (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) y = _
  by_cases hy : y ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι x)
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hy
    have h := AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_closedImmersion (pointClosureι x)
      (Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame
        (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL x)
        (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one L hL x) b).1 (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ())
      (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) z
    rw [h]
    change Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame _ _ b z = _
    by_cases hz : coheight z = 1
    · obtain ⟨ha, w, d, hzd, htr⟩ := hb z hz
      rw [Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame_eq_on_localData _ _ b d z hzd, htr,
        C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_ord a x z hz ha]
    · rw [C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_pointClosureι, if_neg hz]
      exact Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hz _
  · rw [AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range _ _ _ _ _ hy,
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_not_specializes]
    intro h
    apply hy
    rw [range_pointClosureι]
    exact specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_resLE_unitTop
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistOverlap_resLE_unitTop
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (U : Y.Opens) (V : X.Opens)
    (h : f ⁻¹ᵁ U = V) (a : Γ(Y, U)ˣ) (b : Γ(X, V)ˣ)
    (hab : HEq (f.app U a.1) b.1) :
    Units.map (f.resLE U V h.ge).appTop.hom.toMonoidHom
        (Units.map U.topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom a) =
      Units.map V.topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom b
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  have ha : f.app U a.1 = b.1 := eq_of_heq hab
  have hr : U.topIso.inv ≫ (f.resLE U (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) le_rfl).appTop =
      f.app U ≫ (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).topIso.inv := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.appTop, Scheme.Hom.resLE_app_top]
    rw [← Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.id_comp, Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app]
  apply Units.ext
  have hx := RingHom.congr_fun (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom hr) a.1
  simpa only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply, Units.coe_map, RingHom.toMonoidHom_eq_coe, MonoidHom.coe_coe, ha] using hx

      (Units.map (C.pullbackTwistOverlapTargetOpen g a k l).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom
        (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit Γ(Y, C.U a.1) (E.val.obj (op (C.U a.1)))
          d (C.sectionBasis a.1 k) (C.sectionBasis a.1 l))) =
    Units.map (C.pullbackTwistOverlapSourceOpen g a k l).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom
      (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit Γ(X, C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.obj (op (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)))
        d ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionBasis a k)
          ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionBasis a l))
proof:
:=
  pullbackTwistOverlap_resLE_unitTop (C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a) _ _
    (C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap_preimage_basisOverlap g a k l) _ _
    (C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap_app_twistTransition_heq g a d k l)

statement:
theorem pullbackTwistOverlapMap_transition_naturality (a : C.pullbackFrameIndex g)
    (d : ℤ) (k l : C.basisIndex a.1) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (C.pullbackTwistOverlapMap g a k l)).map
      (linearOverlapTransitionIso Γ(Y, C.U a.1) (E.val.obj (op (C.U a.1)))
        d (C.sectionBasis a.1 k) (C.sectionBasis a.1 l)).hom ≫
      (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso (C.pullbackTwistOverlapMap g a k l)).hom =
    (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso (C.pullbackTwistOverlapMap g a k l)).hom ≫
      (linearOverlapTransitionIso Γ(X, C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.obj (op (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)))
        d ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionBasis a k)
          ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionBasis a l)).hom
proof:
:= by
  have h := pullbackTwist_unitMul_naturality (C.pullbackTwistOverlapMap g a k l)
    (Units.map (C.pullbackTwistOverlapTargetOpen g a k l).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom
      (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit Γ(Y, C.U a.1) (E.val.obj (op (C.U a.1)))
        d (C.sectionBasis a.1 k) (C.sectionBasis a.1 l)))
  rw [C.pullbackTwistOverlapMap_transitionUnit g a d k l] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_PiLiftPushforward_π
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem pullbackTwistOverlap_PiLiftPushforward_π
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) {ι : Type u} (F : ι → X.Modules)
    {M : Y.Modules} (h : ∀ i, M ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj (F i)) (i : ι) :
    (Pi.lift h ≫ (PreservesProduct.iso (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f) F).inv) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map (Pi.π F i) = h i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← piComparison_comp_π (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f) F i]
  change (Pi.lift h ≫ (PreservesProduct.iso (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f) F).inv) ≫
    ((PreservesProduct.iso (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f) F).hom ≫ Pi.π _ i) = _
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, Pi.lift_π]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_eq
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_eq
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (U : Y.Opens) (V : X.Opens)
    (h : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U) :
    pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap f U V h =
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).map
        (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit (f.resLE U V h).toRingCatSheafHom) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (f.resLE U V h) U.ι).hom.app
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules V.toScheme) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι f h)).hom.app
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules V.toScheme) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp V.ι f).inv.app
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules V.toScheme)
proof:
:= by
  let r := f.resLE U V h
  have hu : (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction r).unit.app
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules U.toScheme) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward r).map (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso r).hom =
      SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit r.toRingCatSheafHom := by
    change (SheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction r.toRingCatSheafHom).unit.app _ ≫
      (SheafOfModules.pushforward r.toRingCatSheafHom).map
        (SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit r.toRingCatSheafHom) = _
    simpa only [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit] using
      SheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction_homEquiv_pullbackObjUnitToUnit
        r.toRingCatSheafHom
  dsimp only [pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap, Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit]
  have hn := (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp r U.ι).hom.naturality
    (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso r).hom
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  erw [← reassoc_of% hn]
  simp only [← Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rw [hu]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_open_le
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_open_le
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (U : Y.Opens) (V : X.Opens)
    (h : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U) (W : Y.Opens) :
    V.ι ''ᵁ (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ W)) ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ (U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf,
    Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι,
    Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι, Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf]
  exact inf_le_inf h le_rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_app
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_app
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (U : Y.Opens) (V : X.Opens)
    (h : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U) (W : Y.Opens) (s : Γ(SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y U, W)) :
    (pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap f U V h).app W s =
      f.appLE (U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)) (V.ι ''ᵁ (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ W)))
        (pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_open_le f U V h W) s
proof:
:= by
  have hc : V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ W) = (f.resLE U V h) ⁻¹ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W) := by
    symm
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage]
  rw [pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_eq]
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app,
    Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp_hom_app_app, Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp_inv_app_app,
    Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr_hom_app_app, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage]
  change (f.resLE U V h).appLE (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W) (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ W)) hc.le s = _
  rw [Scheme.Hom.resLE_appLE]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_restrict
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_restrict
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (U U' : Y.Opens) (V V' : X.Opens)
    (hU : U' ≤ U) (hV : V' ≤ V) (h : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U) (h' : V' ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U') :
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction hU ≫
      pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap f U' V' h' =
    pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap f U V h ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction hV)
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext
  intro W
  ext s
  change (pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap f U' V' h').app W
      ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction hU).app W s) =
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction hV).app (f ⁻¹ᵁ W)
      ((pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap f U V h).app W s)
  rw [pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_app, pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_app]
  simp only [SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction_app_apply]
  have hl := f.map_appLE (pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_open_le f U' V' h' W)
    (homOfLE (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestrictionOpen hU W)).op
  have hr := f.appLE_map (pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_open_le f U V h W)
    (homOfLE (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestrictionOpen hV (f ⁻¹ᵁ W))).op
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (hl.trans hr.symm) s

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_pushforwardPi_hom_ext
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistOverlap_pushforwardPi_hom_ext
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) {ι : Type u} (F : ι → X.Modules)
    {M : Y.Modules} {a b : M ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj (∏ᶜ F)}
    (h : ∀ i, a ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map (Pi.π F i) =
      b ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map (Pi.π F i)) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (PreservesProduct.iso (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f) F).hom).1
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro i
  simpa only [Category.assoc, PreservesProduct.iso_hom, piComparison_comp_π] using h i

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_leftSquare_of_components
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistOverlap_leftSquare_of_components
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) {ι : Type u}
    (T₀ : ι → Y.Modules) (T₁ : ι × ι → Y.Modules)
    (S₀ : ι → X.Modules) (S₁ : ι × ι → X.Modules)
    (rT : ∀ ij, T₀ ij.1 ⟶ T₁ ij) (rS : ∀ ij, S₀ ij.1 ⟶ S₁ ij)
    (α₀ : ∀ i, T₀ i ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj (S₀ i))
    (α₁ : ∀ ij, T₁ ij ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj (S₁ ij))
    (tL : (∏ᶜ T₀) ⟶ ∏ᶜ T₁) (sL : (∏ᶜ S₀) ⟶ ∏ᶜ S₁)
    (a₀ : (∏ᶜ T₀) ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj (∏ᶜ S₀))
    (a₁ : (∏ᶜ T₁) ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj (∏ᶜ S₁))
    (hT : ∀ ij, tL ≫ Pi.π T₁ ij = Pi.π T₀ ij.1 ≫ rT ij)
    (hS : ∀ ij, sL ≫ Pi.π S₁ ij = Pi.π S₀ ij.1 ≫ rS ij)
    (h₀ : ∀ i, a₀ ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map (Pi.π S₀ i) = Pi.π T₀ i ≫ α₀ i)
    (h₁ : ∀ ij, a₁ ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map (Pi.π S₁ ij) = Pi.π T₁ ij ≫ α₁ ij)
    (h : ∀ ij, rT ij ≫ α₁ ij = α₀ ij.1 ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map (rS ij)) :
    tL ≫ a₁ = a₀ ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map sL
proof:
:= by
  apply pullbackTwistOverlap_pushforwardPi_hom_ext f S₁
  intro ij
  rw [Category.assoc, h₁, ← Category.assoc, hT]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp, hS, Functor.map_comp]
  simp only [← Category.assoc]
  rw [h₀]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [h]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlapSource_le_left
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistOverlapSource_le_left (a : C.pullbackFrameIndex g)
    (k l : C.basisIndex a.1) :
    C.pullbackTwistOverlapSourceOpen g a k l ≤ C.pullbackTwistSourceOpen g a k
proof:
:= by
  have ht : C.pullbackTwistOverlapTargetOpen g a k l ≤ C.pullbackTwistTargetOpen g a k :=
    (linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf Γ(Y, C.U a.1) (E.val.obj (op (C.U a.1)))
      (C.sectionBasis a.1 k) (C.sectionBasis a.1 l)).le.trans inf_le_left
  have hp := ((Opens.map (C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a).base).map (homOfLE ht)).le
  simpa only [pullbackTwistOverlapTargetOpen, pullbackTwistTargetOpen,
    pullbackTwistOverlapSourceOpen, pullbackTwistSourceOpen,
    C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap_preimage_basisOverlap g a k l,
    C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap_preimage_basisOpen g a k] using hp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlapSource_le_right
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistOverlapSource_le_right (a : C.pullbackFrameIndex g)
    (k l : C.basisIndex a.1) :
    C.pullbackTwistOverlapSourceOpen g a k l ≤ C.pullbackTwistSourceOpen g a l
proof:
:= by
  have ht : C.pullbackTwistOverlapTargetOpen g a k l ≤ C.pullbackTwistTargetOpen g a l :=
    (linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf Γ(Y, C.U a.1) (E.val.obj (op (C.U a.1)))
      (C.sectionBasis a.1 k) (C.sectionBasis a.1 l)).le.trans inf_le_right
  have hp := ((Opens.map (C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a).base).map (homOfLE ht)).le
  simpa only [pullbackTwistOverlapTargetOpen, pullbackTwistTargetOpen,
    pullbackTwistOverlapSourceOpen, pullbackTwistSourceOpen,
    C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap_preimage_basisOverlap g a k l,
    C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap_preimage_basisOpen g a l] using hp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlapPushedUnitMap_restrict_left
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistOverlapPushedUnitMap_restrict_left (a : C.pullbackFrameIndex g)
    (k l : C.basisIndex a.1) :
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
      ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf Γ(Y, C.U a.1) (E.val.obj (op (C.U a.1)))
        (C.sectionBasis a.1 k) (C.sectionBasis a.1 l)).le.trans inf_le_left) ≫
      C.pullbackTwistOverlapPushedUnitMap g a k l =
    C.pullbackTwistChartPushedUnitMap g a k ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a)).map
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction (C.pullbackTwistOverlapSource_le_left g a k l))
proof:
:= by
  exact pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_restrict (C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a)
    (C.pullbackTwistTargetOpen g a k) (C.pullbackTwistOverlapTargetOpen g a k l)
    (C.pullbackTwistSourceOpen g a k) (C.pullbackTwistOverlapSourceOpen g a k l)
    ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf Γ(Y, C.U a.1) (E.val.obj (op (C.U a.1)))
      (C.sectionBasis a.1 k) (C.sectionBasis a.1 l)).le.trans inf_le_left)
    (C.pullbackTwistOverlapSource_le_left g a k l)
    (C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap_preimage_basisOpen g a k).ge
    (C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap_preimage_basisOverlap g a k l).ge

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistSourceDescentLeft_π
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistSourceDescentLeft_π (a : C.pullbackFrameIndex g)
    (kl : C.basisIndex a.1 × C.basisIndex a.1) :
    linearDescentLeft Γ(X, C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.obj (op (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)))
        ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionBasis a) ≫
      Pi.π (fun kl : C.basisIndex a.1 × C.basisIndex a.1 ↦
        SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).chart a)
          (C.pullbackTwistOverlapSourceOpen g a kl.1 kl.2)) kl =
    Pi.π (fun k : C.basisIndex a.1 ↦
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).chart a)
        (C.pullbackTwistSourceOpen g a k)) kl.1 ≫
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
        (C.pullbackTwistOverlapSource_le_left g a kl.1 kl.2)
proof:
:= by
  letI := C.pullbackTwistOverlap_source_module g a
  change linearDescentLeft _ _ _ ≫ Pi.π _ kl = _
  unfold linearDescentLeft
  rw [Pi.lift_π]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistChartCochainMap_descentLeft
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistChartCochainMap_descentLeft (a : C.pullbackFrameIndex g) :
    linearDescentLeft Γ(Y, C.U a.1) (E.val.obj (op (C.U a.1))) (C.sectionBasis a.1) ≫
      C.pullbackTwistOverlapCochainMap g a =
    C.pullbackTwistChartCochainMap g a ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a)).map
        (linearDescentLeft Γ(X, C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)
          (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.obj (op (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)))
          ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionBasis a))
proof:
:= by
  letI := C.pullbackTwistOverlap_source_module g a
  have hleft := pullbackTwistOverlap_leftSquare_of_components (C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a)
    (fun k : C.basisIndex a.1 ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (C.chart a.1)
      (C.pullbackTwistTargetOpen g a k))
    (fun kl : C.basisIndex a.1 × C.basisIndex a.1 ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit
      (C.chart a.1) (C.pullbackTwistOverlapTargetOpen g a kl.1 kl.2))
    (fun k : C.basisIndex a.1 ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit
      ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).chart a) (C.pullbackTwistSourceOpen g a k))
    (fun kl : C.basisIndex a.1 × C.basisIndex a.1 ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit
      ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).chart a) (C.pullbackTwistOverlapSourceOpen g a kl.1 kl.2))
    (fun kl ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
      ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf Γ(Y, C.U a.1) (E.val.obj (op (C.U a.1))) (C.sectionBasis a.1 kl.1)
        (C.sectionBasis a.1 kl.2)).le.trans inf_le_left))
    (fun kl ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
      (C.pullbackTwistOverlapSource_le_left g a kl.1 kl.2))
    (C.pullbackTwistChartPushedUnitMap g a)
    (fun kl ↦ C.pullbackTwistOverlapPushedUnitMap g a kl.1 kl.2)
    (linearDescentLeft Γ(Y, C.U a.1) (E.val.obj (op (C.U a.1))) (C.sectionBasis a.1))
    (linearDescentLeft Γ(X, C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.obj (op (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)))
      ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionBasis a))
    (C.pullbackTwistChartCochainMap g a) (C.pullbackTwistOverlapCochainMap g a)
    (fun kl ↦ by
      exact Pi.lift_π _ kl)
    (fun kl ↦ C.pullbackTwistSourceDescentLeft_π g a kl)
    (fun (k : C.basisIndex a.1) ↦ by
      have hk := C.pullbackTwistChartCochainMap_π g a k
      exact hk)
    (fun (kl : C.basisIndex a.1 × C.basisIndex a.1) ↦ by
      have hkl := C.pullbackTwistOverlapCochainMap_π g a kl
      exact hkl)
    (fun (kl : C.basisIndex a.1 × C.basisIndex a.1) ↦
      C.pullbackTwistOverlapPushedUnitMap_restrict_left g a kl.1 kl.2)
  set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency true in
    exact hleft

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_mul
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_mul
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (U : Y.Opens) (V : X.Opens)
    (h : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U) (a : Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤)ˣ) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).map (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso a).hom ≫
        pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap f U V h =
      pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap f U V h ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward V.ι).map
            (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso
              (Units.map (f.resLE U V h).appTop.hom.toMonoidHom a)).hom)
proof:
:= by
  let r := f.resLE U V h
  let b := Units.map r.appTop.hom.toMonoidHom a
  let η := SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit r.toRingCatSheafHom
  let t := (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp r U.ι) ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι f h)) ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp V.ι f).symm
  have hu := pullbackTwist_unitToPushforward_mul_naturality r a
  have hn := t.hom.naturality (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso b).hom
  rw [pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_eq]
  change (Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).map (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso a).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).map η ≫ t.hom.app _ =
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).map η ≫ t.hom.app _) ≫ _
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc, hu, Functor.map_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  congr 1

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlapPushedUnitMap_transition
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistOverlapPushedUnitMap_transition (a : C.pullbackFrameIndex g)
    (d : ℤ) (k l : C.basisIndex a.1) :
    pushedLinearOverlapTransition Γ(Y, C.U a.1) (E.val.obj (op (C.U a.1)))
        d (C.sectionBasis a.1 k) (C.sectionBasis a.1 l) ≫
      C.pullbackTwistOverlapPushedUnitMap g a k l =
    C.pullbackTwistOverlapPushedUnitMap g a k l ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a)).map
        (pushedLinearOverlapTransition Γ(X, C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)
          (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.obj (op (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)))
          d ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionBasis a k) ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionBasis a l))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pushedLinearOverlapTransition, linearOverlapTransitionIso]
  have ht := C.pullbackTwistOverlapMap_transitionUnit g a d k l
  dsimp only [pullbackTwistOverlapSourceOpen] at ht
  erw [← ht]
  exact pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_mul (C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a)
    (C.pullbackTwistOverlapTargetOpen g a k l) (C.pullbackTwistOverlapSourceOpen g a k l)
    (C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap_preimage_basisOverlap g a k l).ge _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_rightSquare_of_components
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistOverlap_rightSquare_of_components
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) {ι : Type u}
    (T₀ : ι → Y.Modules) (T₁ : ι × ι → Y.Modules)
    (S₀ : ι → X.Modules) (S₁ : ι × ι → X.Modules)
    (rT : ∀ ij, T₀ ij.2 ⟶ T₁ ij) (rS : ∀ ij, S₀ ij.2 ⟶ S₁ ij)
    (α₀ : ∀ i, T₀ i ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj (S₀ i))
    (α₁ : ∀ ij, T₁ ij ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj (S₁ ij))
    (tL : (∏ᶜ T₀) ⟶ ∏ᶜ T₁) (sL : (∏ᶜ S₀) ⟶ ∏ᶜ S₁)
    (a₀ : (∏ᶜ T₀) ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj (∏ᶜ S₀))
    (a₁ : (∏ᶜ T₁) ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj (∏ᶜ S₁))
    (hT : ∀ ij, tL ≫ Pi.π T₁ ij = Pi.π T₀ ij.2 ≫ rT ij)
    (hS : ∀ ij, sL ≫ Pi.π S₁ ij = Pi.π S₀ ij.2 ≫ rS ij)
    (h₀ : ∀ i, a₀ ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map (Pi.π S₀ i) = Pi.π T₀ i ≫ α₀ i)
    (h₁ : ∀ ij, a₁ ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map (Pi.π S₁ ij) = Pi.π T₁ ij ≫ α₁ ij)
    (h : ∀ ij, rT ij ≫ α₁ ij = α₀ ij.2 ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map (rS ij)) :
    tL ≫ a₁ = a₀ ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map sL
proof:
:= by
  apply pullbackTwistOverlap_pushforwardPi_hom_ext f S₁
  intro ij
  rw [Category.assoc, h₁, ← Category.assoc, hT]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp, hS, Functor.map_comp]
  simp only [← Category.assoc]
  rw [h₀]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [h]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistChartCochainMap_descentRight
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistChartCochainMap_descentRight (a : C.pullbackFrameIndex g) (d : ℤ) :
    linearDescentRight Γ(Y, C.U a.1) (E.val.obj (op (C.U a.1))) (C.sectionBasis a.1) d ≫
      C.pullbackTwistOverlapCochainMap g a =
    C.pullbackTwistChartCochainMap g a ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a)).map
        (linearDescentRight Γ(X, C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)
          (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.obj (op (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)))
          ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionBasis a) d)
proof:
:= by
  letI := C.pullbackTwistOverlap_source_module g a
  have hright := pullbackTwistOverlap_rightSquare_of_components (C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a)
    (fun k : C.basisIndex a.1 ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (C.chart a.1)
      (C.pullbackTwistTargetOpen g a k))
    (fun kl : C.basisIndex a.1 × C.basisIndex a.1 ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit
      (C.chart a.1) (C.pullbackTwistOverlapTargetOpen g a kl.1 kl.2))
    (fun k : C.basisIndex a.1 ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit
      ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).chart a) (C.pullbackTwistSourceOpen g a k))
    (fun kl : C.basisIndex a.1 × C.basisIndex a.1 ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit
      ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).chart a) (C.pullbackTwistOverlapSourceOpen g a kl.1 kl.2))
    (fun kl ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
      ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf Γ(Y, C.U a.1) (E.val.obj (op (C.U a.1))) (C.sectionBasis a.1 kl.1)
        (C.sectionBasis a.1 kl.2)).le.trans inf_le_right) ≫
      pushedLinearOverlapTransition Γ(Y, C.U a.1) (E.val.obj (op (C.U a.1)))
        d (C.sectionBasis a.1 kl.1) (C.sectionBasis a.1 kl.2))
    (fun kl ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
      (C.pullbackTwistOverlapSource_le_right g a kl.1 kl.2) ≫
      pushedLinearOverlapTransition Γ(X, C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.obj (op (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)))
        d ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionBasis a kl.1) ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionBasis a kl.2))
    (C.pullbackTwistChartPushedUnitMap g a)
    (fun kl ↦ C.pullbackTwistOverlapPushedUnitMap g a kl.1 kl.2)
    (linearDescentRight Γ(Y, C.U a.1) (E.val.obj (op (C.U a.1))) (C.sectionBasis a.1) d)
    (linearDescentRight Γ(X, C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.obj (op (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)))
      ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionBasis a) d)
    (C.pullbackTwistChartCochainMap g a) (C.pullbackTwistOverlapCochainMap g a)
    (fun kl ↦ by
      exact Pi.lift_π _ kl)
    (fun kl ↦ C.pullbackTwistSourceDescentRight_π g a d kl)
    (fun (k : C.basisIndex a.1) ↦ by
      have hk := C.pullbackTwistChartCochainMap_π g a k
      exact hk)
    (fun (kl : C.basisIndex a.1 × C.basisIndex a.1) ↦ by
      have hkl := C.pullbackTwistOverlapCochainMap_π g a kl
      exact hkl)
    (fun (kl : C.basisIndex a.1 × C.basisIndex a.1) ↦
      C.pullbackTwistOverlapPushedUnitMap_right_component g a d kl.1 kl.2)
  set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency true in
    exact hright

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_top_heq
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_top_heq
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ Y) (U : Y.Opens) (V : X.Opens)
    (h : q ⁻¹ᵁ U = V) (a : Γ(Y, U)) (b : Γ(X, V))
    (hab : HEq (q.app U a) b) :
    let hU : U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : Y.Opens)) = U
proof:
:= by
      rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι, inf_top_eq]
    let hV : V.ι ''ᵁ (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : X.Opens)) = V := by
      rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι, inf_top_eq]
    HEq ((pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap q U V h.ge).app ⊤
      (Y.presheaf.map (eqToHom hU).op a))
      (X.presheaf.map (eqToHom hV).op b) := by
  cases h
  have ha : q.app U a = b := eq_of_heq hab
  dsimp only
  apply heq_of_eq
  rw [pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_app]
  let A := U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : Y.Opens))
  let B := (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ ((q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : X.Opens))
  have hA : A = U := by
    dsimp only [A]
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι, inf_top_eq]
  have hB : B = q ⁻¹ᵁ U := by
    dsimp only [B]
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι, inf_top_eq]
  have e : B ≤ q ⁻¹ᵁ A := by
    simpa only [A, B, Scheme.Hom.preimage_top] using
      pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_open_le q U (q ⁻¹ᵁ U) le_rfl ⊤
  change q.appLE A B e (Y.presheaf.map (eqToHom hA).op a) =
    X.presheaf.map (eqToHom hB).op b
  have hc : Y.presheaf.map (eqToHom hA).op ≫ q.appLE A B e =
      q.app U ≫ X.presheaf.map (eqToHom hB).op := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.map_appLE, Scheme.Hom.app_eq_appLE, Scheme.Hom.appLE_map]
  have hx := RingHom.congr_fun (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom hc) a
  simpa only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply, ha] using hx

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_tautComponent_natural
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistOverlap_tautComponent_natural
    {R S M N : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N]
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    (q : space S N ⟶ space R M) (x m : M) (x' m' : N)
    (hU : q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M x = linearOpen S N x')
    (hRatio : HEq (q.app (linearOpen R M x) (tautChart_ratioSection R M x m))
      (tautChart_ratioSection S N x' m')) :
    tautChart_componentHom R M x m ≫
        pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap q (linearOpen R M x) (linearOpen S N x') hU.ge =
      SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit q.toRingCatSheafHom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map (tautChart_componentHom S N x' m')
proof:
:= by
  apply SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModulesHom_ext_top
  change (pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap q (linearOpen R M x) (linearOpen S N x') hU.ge).app ⊤
      ((tautChart_componentHom R M x m).app ⊤ (1 : Γ(space R M, ⊤))) =
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map (tautChart_componentHom S N x' m')).app ⊤
      (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit q.toRingCatSheafHom) ⊤ (1 : Γ(space R M, ⊤)))
  rw [Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app]
  change (pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap q (linearOpen R M x) (linearOpen S N x') hU.ge).app ⊤
      ((tautChart_componentHom R M x m).app ⊤ (1 : Γ(space R M, ⊤))) =
    (tautChart_componentHom S N x' m').app ⊤ (q.appTop (1 : Γ(space R M, ⊤)))
  rw [map_one q.appTop.hom]
  simp only [tautChart_componentHom, tautChart_unitHomEquiv_symm_sectionsOfTop_app]
  apply eq_of_heq
  exact pullbackTwistOverlap_pushedUnitMap_top_heq q (linearOpen R M x)
    (linearOpen S N x') hU (tautChart_ratioSection R M x m)
    (tautChart_ratioSection S N x' m') hRatio

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_pushforwardBasisComponent_hom_ext
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistOverlap_pushforwardBasisComponent_hom_ext
    {S N : Type u} [CommRing S] [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N]
    [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N] {κ : Type u} [Finite κ]
    (b : Module.Basis κ S N) {Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : space S N ⟶ Y) (d : ℤ)
    {P : Y.Modules}
    {f g : P ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).obj (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex S N b d)}
    (h : ∀ k, f ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map (twistingSheafBasisComponent S N b d k) =
      g ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map (twistingSheafBasisComponent S N b d k)) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map
    (kernel.ι (linearDescentLeft S N b - linearDescentRight S N b d)))).1
  apply pullbackTwistOverlap_pushforwardPi_hom_ext q
    (fun k : κ ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space S N) (linearOpen S N (b k)))
  intro k
  simpa only [twistingSheafBasisComponent, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc] using h k

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistChartPushedUnitMap_tautComponent
statement:

    (m : E.val.obj (op (C.U a.1))) (k : C.basisIndex a.1) :

          (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.obj (op (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)))
          ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionBasis a k) (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap g a m))

    (C.sectionBasis a.1 k) m ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionBasis a k)
    (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap g a m) (C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap_preimage_basisOpen g a k)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackChartTwistToPushforward_tautHom
statement:
theorem pullbackChartTwistToPushforward_tautHom (a : C.pullbackFrameIndex g)
    (m : E.val.obj (op (C.U a.1))) :
    tautChart_tautHom Γ(Y, C.U a.1) (E.val.obj (op (C.U a.1))) (C.sectionBasis a.1) m ≫
      C.pullbackChartTwistToPushforward g a 1 =
    SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit (C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a).toRingCatSheafHom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a)).map
        (tautChart_tautHom Γ(X, C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)
          (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.obj (op (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)))
          ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionBasis a) (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap g a m))
proof:
:= by
  letI := C.pullbackTwistOverlap_source_module g a
  apply pullbackTwistOverlap_pushforwardBasisComponent_hom_ext
    ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionBasis a) (C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a) 1
  intro k
  rw [Category.assoc]
  erw [C.pullbackChartTwistToPushforward_basisComponent g a 1 k]
  rw [
    ← Category.assoc, tautChart_tautHom_component]
  rw [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp]
  have hs := tautChart_tautHom_component Γ(X, C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.obj (op (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)))
    ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionBasis a) (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap g a m) k
  exact (C.pullbackTwistChartPushedUnitMap_tautComponent g a m k).trans
    (congrArg (fun f => SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
    (C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a).toRingCatSheafHom ≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a)).map f) hs).symm

theorem pullbackChartTwistHom_tautHom (a : C.pullbackFrameIndex g)
    (m : E.val.obj (op (C.U a.1))) :

        (tautChart_tautHom Γ(Y, C.U a.1) (E.val.obj (op (C.U a.1)))
          (C.sectionBasis a.1) m) ≫ C.pullbackChartTwistHom g a 1 =
    (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso (C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a)).hom ≫
      tautChart_tautHom Γ(X, C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.obj (op (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)))
        ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionBasis a) (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap g a m)
proof:
:= by
  let q := C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a
  let adj := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q
  apply (adj.homEquiv _ _).injective
  dsimp only [adj, q]
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left]
  have ha := C.pullbackChartTwistHom_adjoint g a 1
  erw [ha]
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
  have hu : adj.homEquiv _ _ (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso q).hom =
      SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit q.toRingCatSheafHom := by
    exact SheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction_homEquiv_pullbackObjUnitToUnit
      q.toRingCatSheafHom
  dsimp only [adj, q] at hu
  erw [hu]
  exact C.pullbackChartTwistToPushforward_tautHom g a m

theorem pullbackTwistOverlap_isIso_preimage
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ Y) (U : Y.Opens) (V : X.Opens)
    (h : V ≤ q ⁻¹ᵁ U) {P Q : Y.Modules} (f : P ⟶ Q)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).map f)] :
    IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback V.ι).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map f))
proof:
:= by
  let r := q.resLE U V h
  let e : Scheme.Modules.pullback q ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback V.ι ≅
      Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback r :=
    Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp V.ι q ≪≫
      Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι q h).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp r U.ι).symm
  haveI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback r).map f) := by
    dsimp only [Functor.comp_map]
    infer_instance
  exact pullbackTwistOverlap_isIso_map_of_natIso e f

theorem pullbackTwistOverlap_isIso_map_of_square
    {A B : Type*} [Category A] [Category B] (F : A ⥤ B)
    {P Q R S : A} (a : P ⟶ Q) (f : Q ⟶ R) (e : P ⟶ S) (b : S ⟶ R)
    (h : a ≫ f = e ≫ b) [IsIso (F.map a)] [IsIso (F.map e)] [IsIso (F.map b)] :

proof:

theorem pullbackChartTwistHom_basis_isIso (a : C.pullbackFrameIndex g)
    (k : C.basisIndex a.1) :
    IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (C.pullbackTwistSourceOpen g a k).ι).map
      (C.pullbackChartTwistHom g a 1))
proof:
:= by
  letI := C.pullbackTwistOverlap_source_module g a
  letI := C.pullbackTwistOverlap_source_free g a
  letI := C.pullbackTwistOverlap_source_moduleFinite g a
  letI := C.pullbackTwistOverlap_source_finite g a
  let q := C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a
  let U := C.pullbackTwistTargetOpen g a k
  let V := C.pullbackTwistSourceOpen g a k
  let t := tautChart_tautHom Γ(Y, C.U a.1) (E.val.obj (op (C.U a.1)))
    (C.sectionBasis a.1) (C.sectionBasis a.1 k)
  let s := tautChart_tautHom Γ(X, C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.obj (op (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)))
    ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionBasis a)
    (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap g a (C.sectionBasis a.1 k))
  haveI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map t) :=
    pullbackTwistOverlap_tautSelf_isIso _ _ _ _
  haveI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).map t) :=
    pullbackTwistOverlap_isIso_map_of_natIso (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).symm t
  haveI := C.pullbackTwistSourceTautSelf_isIso g a k
  haveI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).map s) :=
    pullbackTwistOverlap_isIso_map_of_input_eq (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι)
      (fun m => tautChart_tautHom Γ(X, C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.obj (op (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)))
        ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionBasis a) m)
      (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap g a (C.sectionBasis a.1 k))
      ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionBasis a k) (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap_basis g a k)
  haveI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback V.ι).map s) :=
    pullbackTwistOverlap_isIso_map_of_natIso (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback V.ι).symm s
  haveI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback V.ι).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map t)) :=
    pullbackTwistOverlap_isIso_preimage q U V (C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap_preimage_basisOpen g a k).ge t
  have ht : (Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map t ≫ C.pullbackChartTwistHom g a 1 =
      (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso q).hom ≫ s :=
    C.pullbackChartTwistHom_tautHom g a (C.sectionBasis a.1 k)
  exact pullbackTwistOverlap_isIso_map_of_square (Scheme.Modules.pullback V.ι)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map t) (C.pullbackChartTwistHom g a 1)
    (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso q).hom s ht

theorem pullbackTwistOverlap_homEquiv_conjugateEquiv
    {A B : Type*} [Category A] [Category B]
    {L₁ L₂ : A ⥤ B} {R₁ R₂ : B ⥤ A}
    (adj₁ : L₁ ⊣ R₁) (adj₂ : L₂ ⊣ R₂) (α : L₂ ⟶ L₁)
    (P : A) (Q : B) (f : L₁.obj P ⟶ Q) :
    (adj₂.homEquiv P Q) (α.app P ≫ f) =
      (adj₁.homEquiv P Q) f ≫ (conjugateEquiv adj₁ adj₂ α).app Q
proof:
:= by
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, Functor.map_comp]
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← unit_conjugateEquiv]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← (conjugateEquiv adj₁ adj₂ α).naturality f]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistOverlap_restrictedAdjoint
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistOverlap_restrictedAdjoint
    {X Y W V : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) (q : W ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (v : V ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion v] (h : W ⟶ V) (comm : q ≫ g = h ≫ v)
    (M : Y.Modules) (N : X.Modules) (f : (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj M ⟶ N) :
    let e
proof:
:= AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso g q v h comm
    let adjL := (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction v).comp
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction h)
    let adjR := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).comp
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q)
    (adjL.homEquiv M ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj N))
        (e.inv.app M ≫ (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map f) ≫
      (conjugateEquiv adjL adjR e.hom).app ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj N) =
    (adjR.homEquiv M ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj N))
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map f) := by
  dsimp only
  have hh := pullbackTwistOverlap_homEquiv_conjugateEquiv
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction v).comp (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction h))
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).comp (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q))
    (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso g q v h comm).hom M
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj N)
    ((AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso g q v h comm).inv.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map f)
  simpa only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc] using hh.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.eFrame_U_le
statement:
theorem eFrame_U_le {p : X} (f : LineBundleLocalData X A p) (d : LineBundleLocalData X B p) :
    ∀ m : ℕ, f.U ⊓ d.U ≤ (eFrame f d m).U
  | 0 => le_rfl
  | m + 1 => le_inf (eFrame_U_le f d m) inf_le_right

                                                                 
def tauSec (t : Γ(B, ⊤)) (m : ℕ) :
    Γ(tensorSheaf X A (tensorPowSucc B m), ⊤) →+ Γ(tensorSheaf X A (tensorPowSucc B (m + 1)), ⊤)
proof:
:=
  AddMonoidHom.mk' (fun z =>
    (tensorSheafAssociator X A (tensorPowSucc B m) B).hom.val.app (op ⊤)
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.tensorSheafPureTensorSection _ B ⊤ z t))
    (fun z z' => by
      rw [pure_add_left]
      exact map_add ((tensorSheafAssociator X A (tensorPowSucc B m) B).hom.val.app (op ⊤)).hom _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.coord_tauSec
statement:
theorem coord_tauSec {p : X} (f : LineBundleLocalData X A p) (d : LineBundleLocalData X B p)
    (t : Γ(B, ⊤)) (m : ℕ) (z : Γ(tensorSheaf X A (tensorPowSucc B m), ⊤)) :
    X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (eFrame_U_le f d (m + 1))).op
        (sectionCoordSec (eFrame f d (m + 1)) (tauSec t m z)) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : f.U ⊓ d.U ≤ d.U)).op (sectionCoordSec d t) *
        X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (eFrame_U_le f d m)).op (sectionCoordSec (eFrame f d m) z)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : sectionCoordSec (eFrame f d (m + 1)) (tauSec t m z) =
      sectionCoordSec ((eFrame f d m).tensor d)
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.tensorSheafPureTensorSection _ B ⊤ z t) :=
    sectionCoordSec_mapIso ((eFrame f d m).tensor d)
      (tensorSheafAssociator X A (tensorPowSucc B m) B) _
  have r1 : ∀ {V W U : X.Opens} (h1 : W ≤ V) (h2 : U ≤ W) (x : Γ(X, V)),
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h2).op (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h1).op x) =
        X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h2.trans h1)).op x := by
    intro V W U h1 h2 x
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← X.presheaf.map_comp]
    rfl
  rw [h1, sectionCoordSec_tensor]
  erw [map_mul]
  refine (congrArg₂ (· * ·) (r1 _ _ _) (r1 _ _ _)).trans (mul_comm _ _)

theorem pushforwardPullbackUnit_comp_ambient
    (g : A ⟶ B) (f : B ⟶ C) (k : C ⟶ D) (M : B.Modules) :
    (pushforwardComp f k).inv.app M ≫
      (pushforward k).map (pushforwardPullbackUnit f g M) ≫
      (pushforwardComp (g ≫ f) k).hom.app ((pullback g).obj M) =
    pushforwardPullbackUnit (f ≫ k) g M ≫
      (pushforwardCongr (Category.assoc g f k).symm).hom.app ((pullback g).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext
  intro U
  simp only [Hom.comp_app, pushforwardComp_inv_app_app,
    pushforwardComp_hom_app_app, pushforward_map_app,
    pushforwardPullbackUnit, pushforwardCongr_hom_app_app]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Category.id_comp,
    Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage]
  simp
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit_square_of_comp
statement:
theorem pushforwardPullbackUnit_square_of_comp
    (g : A ⟶ B) (f : B ⟶ C) (k : C ⟶ D) (f' : B ⟶ D)
    (hf : f ≫ k = f') (hg : g ≫ f' = (g ≫ f) ≫ k) (M : B.Modules) :
    ((pushforwardCongr hf.symm).app M ≪≫
      ((pushforwardComp f k).app M).symm).hom ≫
      (pushforward k).map (pushforwardPullbackUnit f g M) =
    pushforwardPullbackUnit f' g M ≫
      ((pushforwardCongr hg).app ((pullback g).obj M) ≪≫
        ((pushforwardComp (g ≫ f) k).app ((pullback g).obj M)).symm).hom
proof:
:= by
  subst f'
  apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext
  intro U
  simp only [Hom.comp_app, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom,
    pushforward_map_app, pushforwardPullbackUnit,
    pushforwardComp_hom_app_app, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage,
    Category.assoc]
  simp
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.unionInl_pushforwardPullbackUnit_square
statement:
theorem unionInl_pushforwardPullbackUnit_square (C C' : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) :
    (C.unionDescentInl_chartTermIso C' d i).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.isoUnionLeft C').hom).map
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit (C.chartι i) (C.overlapToChart i j)
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)) =
      Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit
        ((C.union C').chartι (Sum.inl i))
        ((C.union C').overlapToChart (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inl j))
        (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i) ≫
      (C.unionDescentInl_overlapTermIso C' d i j).hom
proof:
:= by
  let f := C.chartι i
  let g := C.overlapToChart i j
  let k := (C.isoUnionLeft C').hom
  let f' := (C.union C').chartι (Sum.inl i)
  let M := C.chartTwistingSheaf d i
  have hf : f ≫ k = f' := C.chartι_isoUnionLeft_hom C' i
  have hg : g ≫ f' = (g ≫ f) ≫ k := by
    calc
      g ≫ f' = g ≫ (f ≫ k) := congrArg (fun q => g ≫ q) hf.symm
      _ = (g ≫ f) ≫ k := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
  change ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr hf.symm).app M ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f k).app M).symm).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward k).map (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit f g M) =
    Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit f' g M ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr hg).app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj M) ≪≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (g ≫ f) k).app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj M)).symm).hom
  exact Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit_square_of_comp g f k f' hf hg M

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.unionInr_pushforwardPullbackUnit_square
statement:
theorem unionInr_pushforwardPullbackUnit_square (C C' : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C'.I) :

          (C'.chartTwistingSheaf d i)) =

        ((C.union C').chartι (Sum.inr i))
        ((C.union C').overlapToChart (Sum.inr i) (Sum.inr j))
        (C'.chartTwistingSheaf d i) ≫

proof:

  let f' := (C.union C').chartι (Sum.inr i)

  have hf : f ≫ k = f' := C.chartι_isoUnionRight_hom C' i
  have hg : g ≫ f' = (g ≫ f) ≫ k := by
    calc
      g ≫ f' = g ≫ (f ≫ k) := congrArg (fun q => g ≫ q) hf.symm

  change ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr hf.symm).app M ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f k).app M).symm).hom ≫

        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (g ≫ f) k).app

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.unionDescentInl_descentLeft_natural
statement:
theorem unionDescentInl_descentLeft_natural (C C' : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (d : ℤ) :
    (C.unionDescentInl C' d).descentLeft ≫
      (C.unionDescentInl_overlapCochainsIso C' d).hom =
    (C.unionDescentInl_chartCochainsIso C' d).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.isoUnionLeft C').hom).map
        (C.twistingSheafDescentData d
          (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d)).descentLeft
proof:
:= by
  let D := C.twistingSheafDescentData d (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d)
  let D' := C.unionDescentInl C' d
  let F := Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.isoUnionLeft C').hom
  exact Scheme.Modules.DescentData.descentLeft_natural_of_components D D' F
    (C.unionDescentInl_chartCochainsIso C' d)
    (C.unionDescentInl_overlapCochainsIso C' d)
    (fun i => C.unionDescentInl_chartTermIso C' d i)
    (fun ij => C.unionDescentInl_overlapTermIso C' d ij.1 ij.2)
    (fun i => C.unionDescentInl_chartCochainsIso_hom_π C' d i)
    (fun ij => C.unionDescentInl_overlapCochainsIso_hom_π C' d ij)
    (fun ij => C.unionInl_pushforwardPullbackUnit_square C' d ij.1 ij.2)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.unionDescentInr_descentLeft_natural

proof:

  let D' := C.unionDescentInr C' d

    (fun i => C.unionDescentInr_chartTermIso C' d i)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E24.pullback_locally_generated
statement:
theorem pullback_locally_generated (i : C.I) [Fintype (C.basisIndex i)]
    (V0 : T.Opens) (hV0 : V0 ≤ π ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i)
    (s : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).obj E).val.obj (op V0)) :
    ∃ (J : Type u) (W : J → T.Opens) (hW : ∀ j, W j ≤ V0) (_ : V0 ≤ ⨆ j, W j)
      (a : ∀ j, C.basisIndex i → Γ(T, W j)), ∀ j,
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).obj E).presheaf.map (homOfLE (hW j)).op s =
          ∑ k : C.basisIndex i, a j k •
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).obj E).presheaf.map (homOfLE (hW j)).op
              (PullbackFrameSections.sectionMap π E (C.U i) V0 hV0 (C.sectionBasis i k))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨κ, hsub, heq⟩ := Opens.isBasis_iff_cover.mp T.isBasis_affineOpens V0
  refine ⟨{V : T.affineOpens // V.1 ≤ V0}, fun j => j.1.1, fun j => j.2, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc V0 = sSup κ := heq
      _ ≤ _ := by
        refine sSup_le fun V hV => ?_
        exact le_iSup_of_le ⟨⟨V, hsub hV⟩, heq.symm ▸ le_sSup hV⟩ le_rfl
  · intro j k
    exact (C.pullbackFrameCover π).sectionBasis ⟨i, ⟨j.1, j.2.trans hV0⟩⟩ |>.repr
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).obj E).presheaf.map (homOfLE j.2).op s) k
  · intro j
    let jj : C.pullbackFrameIndex π := ⟨i, ⟨j.1, j.2.trans hV0⟩⟩
    let bs := (C.pullbackFrameCover π).sectionBasis jj
    have hk : ∀ k, ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).obj E).presheaf.map (homOfLE j.2).op
        (PullbackFrameSections.sectionMap π E (C.U i) V0 hV0 (C.sectionBasis i k)) = bs k := by
      intro k
      exact (PullbackFrameSections.sectionMap_restrict π E (C.U i) hV0 j.2
        (C.sectionBasis i k)).trans (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap_basis π jj k)
    letI : Fintype ((C.pullbackFrameCover π).basisIndex jj) :=
      (inferInstance : Fintype (C.basisIndex i))
    simp only [hk]
    exact (bs.sum_repr _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E24.vMap_app_unit
statement:
theorem vMap_app_unit (U : S.Opens) (e : Γ(B, U)) :
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).map b) ≫ C.tautologicalQuotient).app (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ U)
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction C.toBase).unit.app B).app U e) =
    C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.app U (b.app U e)
proof:
:= by
  rw [taut_app_eq_quotient_unit, Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
    Chow.C1Cap.pullback_map_unit]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E24.exists_vMap_scalar
statement:
theorem exists_vMap_scalar (ij : Σ i : C.I, C.basisIndex i) (e : Γ(B, C.U ij.1)) :
    ∃ f : Γ(C.scheme, litU C ij),
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).map b) ≫ C.tautologicalQuotient).app (litU C ij)
        (PullbackFrameSections.sectionMap C.toBase B (C.U ij.1) (litU C ij) (litU_le C ij) e) =
      f • litG C ij
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := litG_generates C ij ((C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map
    (homOfLE (litU_le C ij)).op (C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.app (C.U ij.1) (b.app (C.U ij.1) e)))
  refine ⟨f, ?_⟩
  refine Eq.trans ?_ hf
  change (((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).map b) ≫ C.tautologicalQuotient).app (litU C ij)
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj B).presheaf.map (homOfLE (litU_le C ij)).op
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction C.toBase).unit.app B).app (C.U ij.1) e)) = _
  rw [tautChart_app_map, vMap_app_unit]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E24.ker_le_of_pluckerHu
statement:
theorem ker_le_of_pluckerHu (h : PluckerHu P) :
    kernelSubobject (E18.vMap P.toD b) ≤
      kernelSubobject (E18.uMap P.toB P.toD P.jHom P.jHom_toBase)
proof:
:= by
  letI : ∀ ij : (Σ i : P.toD.I, P.toD.basisIndex i), Fintype (P.toB.basisIndex ij.1) :=
    fun ij => @Fintype.ofFinite _ (P.toB.basisIndex_finite ij.1)
  choose c hc using h
  have hv := fun ij k => exists_vMap_scalar b P.toD ij (P.toB.sectionBasis ij.1 k)
  choose f hf using hv
  have key := E22.kernelSubobject_le_of_sections
    (A := (Scheme.Modules.pullback P.toD.toBase).obj B)
    (Q := P.toD.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    (C := (Scheme.Modules.pullback P.jHom).obj (P.toB.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))
    (E18.uMap P.toB P.toD P.jHom P.jHom_toBase)
    (E18.vMap P.toD b) (I := Σ i : P.toD.I, P.toD.basisIndex i) (litU P.toD)
    ((Opens.coversTop_iff (T := P.toD.scheme) (litU P.toD)).2 (litU_cover P.toD))
    (κ := fun ij => P.toB.basisIndex ij.1) (mu P) (litG P.toD) c f
  refine key ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro ij V hV s
    obtain ⟨J, W, hW, cov, a, ha⟩ := pullback_locally_generated P.toB P.toD.toBase ij.1 V
      (hV.trans (litU_le P.toD ij)) s
    refine ⟨J, W, hW, cov, a, fun j => ?_⟩
    rw [ha j]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    congr 1
    refine (PullbackFrameSections.sectionMap_restrict P.toD.toBase B (P.toB.U ij.1)
      (hV.trans (litU_le P.toD ij)) (hW j) (P.toB.sectionBasis ij.1 k)).trans ?_
    exact (PullbackFrameSections.sectionMap_restrict P.toD.toBase B (P.toB.U ij.1)
      (litU_le P.toD ij) ((hW j).trans hV) (P.toB.sectionBasis ij.1 k)).symm
  · intro ij V hV r hr
    exact litG_free P.toD ij V hV r hr
  · intro ij k
    exact hf ij k
  · intro ij k
    have h1 := hc ij k (f ij k) (hf ij k)
    exact h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E24.twistIso_of_pluckerHu
statement:
theorem twistIso_of_pluckerHu (h : PluckerHu P) :
    Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P.jHom).obj (P.toB.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) ≅
      P.toD.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
proof:
:=
  E18.twistIso_of_kernel_le P.toB P.toD P.jHom P.jHom_toBase b (ker_le_of_pluckerHu P h)

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.presheaf_map_homOfLE_transport
statement:
theorem presheaf_map_homOfLE_transport {V W : X.Opens} (h : V = W) (pV : V ≤ U.1) (pW : W ≤ U.1) :
    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE pW).op).hom =
      (h ▸ RingEquiv.refl Γ(X, V) : Γ(X, V) ≃+* Γ(X, W)).toRingHom.comp
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE pV).op).hom
proof:
:= by

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.presheaf_map_homOfLE_basicOpen_transport
statement:
theorem presheaf_map_homOfLE_basicOpen_transport (f g : Γ(X, U.1))
    (h : X.basicOpen f = X.basicOpen g) :
    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le g)).op).hom =
      (h ▸ RingEquiv.refl Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) :
          Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) ≃+* Γ(X, X.basicOpen g)).toRingHom.comp
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op).hom
proof:
:=
  presheaf_map_homOfLE_transport U h (X.basicOpen_le f) (X.basicOpen_le g)

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenGeneratorRingEquiv_comp_algebraMap
statement:
theorem basicOpenGeneratorRingEquiv_comp_algebraMap (f g : Γ(X, U.1))
    (h : X.basicOpen f = X.basicOpen g) :
    (basicOpenGeneratorRingEquiv U f g h).toRingHom.comp
        (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) (Localization.Away f)) =
      algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) (Localization.Away g)
proof:
:= by
  letI := U.2.isLocalization_basicOpen f
  letI := U.2.isLocalization_basicOpen g
  have hf : ∀ r, basicOpenSectionsEquiv U f (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) (Localization.Away f) r) =
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op).hom r :=
    (IsLocalization.algEquiv (Submonoid.powers f)
      (Localization.Away f) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f)).commutes
  have hg : ∀ r, basicOpenSectionsEquiv U g (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) (Localization.Away g) r) =
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le g)).op).hom r :=
    (IsLocalization.algEquiv (Submonoid.powers g)
      (Localization.Away g) Γ(X, X.basicOpen g)).commutes
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro r
  show (basicOpenGeneratorRingEquiv U f g h) (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) (Localization.Away f) r) =
    algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) (Localization.Away g) r
  show (basicOpenSectionsEquiv U g).symm
      ((h ▸ RingEquiv.refl Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) : Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) ≃+* Γ(X, X.basicOpen g))
        (basicOpenSectionsEquiv U f (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) (Localization.Away f) r))) =
    algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) (Localization.Away g) r
  rw [hf]
  have htrans : (h ▸ RingEquiv.refl Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) :
        Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) ≃+* Γ(X, X.basicOpen g))
        ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op).hom r) =
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le g)).op).hom r := by
    rw [presheaf_map_homOfLE_basicOpen_transport U f g h]
    rfl
  rw [htrans, ← hg]
  simp

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.localizedIdeal_map_basicOpenGeneratorRingEquiv
statement:
theorem localizedIdeal_map_basicOpenGeneratorRingEquiv (f g : Γ(X, U.1))
    (h : X.basicOpen f = X.basicOpen g) :
    (localizedIdeal (I.ideal U) f).map (basicOpenGeneratorRingEquiv U f g h).toRingHom =
      localizedIdeal (I.ideal U) g
proof:
:= by
  unfold localizedIdeal
  rw [Ideal.map_map, basicOpenGeneratorRingEquiv_comp_algebraMap]

name: SchemeCurveCharacteristicClasses.degree_lineBundleWeilDivisorWithTrivialization_eq
statement:
theorem degree_lineBundleWeilDivisorWithTrivialization_eq
    (M : X.Modules) (hM : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X M)
    (hrank : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X M = 1)
    (t : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.RationalTrivialization X M) :
    AlgebraicCycle.degree k
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithTrivialization
          hM hrank t).1 =
      AlgebraicCycle.degree k
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisor hM hrank).1
proof:
:= by
  let b := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleReferenceFrame hM hrank
  have hchange :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithTrivialization_change
      hM hrank t b
  have hdegree := congrArg (fun D : AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.WeilDivisor X ↦
    AlgebraicCycle.degree k D.1) hchange
  have hprincipal := SchemeBridge.degree_principal_eq_zero_of_structureSheaf_finite
    k (SchemeBridge.structureSheaf_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
      (t.transitionFunction b) (t.transitionFunction_ne_zero b)
  change AlgebraicCycle.degree k
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCycleWithTrivialization
        hM hrank t) =
    AlgebraicCycle.degree k
      (AlgebraicGeometry.div (t.transitionFunction b) +
        AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCycleWithFrame
          hM hrank b) at hdegree
  rw [AlgebraicCycle.degree_sum, hprincipal, zero_add] at hdegree
  change AlgebraicCycle.degree k
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCycleWithTrivialization
        hM hrank t) =
    AlgebraicCycle.degree k
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCycleWithFrame hM hrank
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleReferenceFrame hM hrank))
  simpa [b] using hdegree

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.lineWord_cases
statement:
theorem lineWord_cases (a : {a : Fin 2 → Fin 2 // Function.Surjective a}) :
    a = lineForwardWord ∨ a = lineReverseWord
proof:
:= by
  rcases a with ⟨a, ha⟩
  have hn : a 0 ≠ a 1 := by
    intro h
    rcases ha 0 with ⟨i, hi⟩
    rcases ha 1 with ⟨j, hj⟩
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp_all
  generalize h0 : a 0 = i
  generalize h1 : a 1 = j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
  · simp_all
  · left
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext t
    fin_cases t <;> simp_all [lineForwardWord]
  · right
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext t
    fin_cases t <;> simp_all [lineReverseWord]
  · simp_all

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.lineOrientation_scalar_cycle
statement:
theorem lineOrientation_scalar_cycle :
    ∀ a : Fin 3 → Fin 2, Function.Surjective a →
      (∑ r : Fin 3, (-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val *
        if Function.Surjective (a ∘ r.succAbove) then
          if a (r.succAbove 0) = 0 then 1 else -1
        else 0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  decide

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.lineNegativeCochain_cycle
statement:
theorem lineNegativeCochain_cycle (d : ℤ)
    (c : coordinateLaurentAllNegativeDegreeExponent 1 d → ℤ) :
    coordinateLaurentSurjectiveWordDifferential ℤ 1 d 1 (lineNegativeCochain d c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext a e
  change (∑ r : Fin 3, (-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val *
    if h : Function.Surjective (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove) then
      lineNegativeCochain d c ⟨a.1 ∘ r.succAbove, h⟩ e else 0) = 0
  have h := lineOrientation_scalar_cycle a.1 a.2
  calc
    _ = (∑ r : Fin 3, (-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val *
        if Function.Surjective (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove) then
          if a.1 (r.succAbove 0) = 0 then 1 else -1
        else 0) * c e := by
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro r _
      simp only [lineNegativeCochain, Function.comp_apply]
      split_ifs <;> ring
    _ = 0 := by rw [h, zero_mul]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.lineComparison_differential
statement:
theorem lineComparison_differential (d : ℤ)
    (c : coordinateLaurentAllNegativeSurjectiveCoefficientSpace ℤ 1 d 1)
    (e : coordinateLaurentAllNegativeDegreeExponent 1 d) :
    coordinateLaurentSurjectiveWordDifferential ℤ 1 d 1 c lineComparisonWord e =
      c lineReverseWord e + c lineForwardWord e
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : Function.Surjective (lineComparisonWord.1 ∘ (0 : Fin 3).succAbove) := by decide
  have h1 : ¬Function.Surjective (lineComparisonWord.1 ∘ (1 : Fin 3).succAbove) := by decide
  have h2 : Function.Surjective (lineComparisonWord.1 ∘ (2 : Fin 3).succAbove) := by decide
  have e0 : (⟨lineComparisonWord.1 ∘ (0 : Fin 3).succAbove, h0⟩ :
      {a : Fin 2 → Fin 2 // Function.Surjective a}) = lineReverseWord := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change lineComparisonWord.1 ∘ (0 : Fin 3).succAbove = lineReverseWord.1
    decide
  have e2 : (⟨lineComparisonWord.1 ∘ (2 : Fin 3).succAbove, h2⟩ :
      {a : Fin 2 → Fin 2 // Function.Surjective a}) = lineForwardWord := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change lineComparisonWord.1 ∘ (2 : Fin 3).succAbove = lineForwardWord.1
    decide
  change (∑ r : Fin 3, (-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val *
    if h : Function.Surjective (lineComparisonWord.1 ∘ r.succAbove) then
      c ⟨lineComparisonWord.1 ∘ r.succAbove, h⟩ e else 0) = _
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  simp only [dif_pos h0, dif_neg h1, dif_pos h2, e0, e2]
  norm_num

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.lineNegativeCyclesToWordCycles_bijective
statement:
theorem lineNegativeCyclesToWordCycles_bijective (d : ℤ) :
    Function.Bijective (lineNegativeCyclesToWordCycles d)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x y h
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients_injective ℤ 1 d 1
    exact congrArg Subtype.val h
  · intro z
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients_surjective ℤ 1 d 1 z.1
    have hc : coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients ℤ 1 d 2
        (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeDifferential ℤ 1 d 1 y) = 0 := by
      rw [coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients_differential, hy]
      exact z.2
    have hz : coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeDifferential ℤ 1 d 1 y = 0 :=
      coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients_injective ℤ 1 d 2
        (by simpa only [map_zero] using hc)
    have hcycle : y.1 ∈ coordinateLaurentPositiveCycles ℤ 1 d 0 :=
      congrArg Subtype.val hz
    refine ⟨⟨y, hcycle⟩, ?_⟩
    exact Subtype.ext hy

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.lineSingletonWord_not_surjective
statement:
theorem lineSingletonWord_not_surjective :
    ∀ a : Fin 1 → Fin 2, ¬Function.Surjective a
proof: := by decide

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.lineBoundary_negative_coeff_zero
statement:
theorem lineBoundary_negative_coeff_zero (d : ℤ)
    (x : coordinateLaurentHigherTerm ℤ 1 d 0)
    (a : Fin 2 → Fin 2) (e : coordinateLaurentAllNegativeDegreeExponent 1 d) :
    (coordinateLaurentHigherDifferentialLinear ℤ 1 d 0 x a).1 e.1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  change (coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential ℤ 1 d 0 x a).1 e.1 = 0
  rw [coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_apply_coeff]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro r _
  rw [coordinateLaurentHigherTerm_coeff_eq_zero_of_allNegative_of_not_surjective
    ℤ 1 d 0 x (a ∘ r.succAbove) e.1 e.2.2
    (lineSingletonWord_not_surjective (a ∘ r.succAbove)), mul_zero]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.lineNegativeCycle_class_eq_zero
statement:
theorem lineNegativeCycle_class_eq_zero (d : ℤ)
    (x : coordinateLaurentAllNegativePositiveCycles ℤ 1 d 0)
    (hx : coordinateLaurentAllNegativePositiveCyclesToCohomology ℤ 1 d 0 x = 0) :
    x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hm : coordinateLaurentAllNegativePositiveCyclesToCycles ℤ 1 d 0 x ∈
      coordinateLaurentPositiveBoundaries ℤ 1 d 0 :=
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mp hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hm
  change coordinateLaurentHigherDifferentialLinear ℤ 1 d 0 y = x.1.1 at hy
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients_injective ℤ 1 d 1
  funext a e
  change (x.1.1 a.1).1 e.1 = 0
  rw [← hy]
  exact lineBoundary_negative_coeff_zero d y a.1 e

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.lineLaurentDegree_eq
statement:
theorem lineLaurentDegree_eq (e : CoordinateLaurentExponent 1) :
    coordinateLaurentTotalDegree 1 e = e 0 + e 1
proof:

  · exact Fin.sum_univ_two _
  · intro i

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.PullbackFrameSections.coefficientMap_target_restrict
statement:
theorem coefficientMap_target_restrict (g : X ⟶ Y) (U U' : Y.Opens) (hU : U' ≤ U)
    (V : X.Opens) (hV : V ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U') :
    (coefficientMap g U' V hV).comp (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hU).op).hom =
      coefficientMap g U V (hV.trans (g.preimage_mono hU))
proof:
:=
  congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom (g.map_appLE hV (homOfLE hU).op)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.commonPullbackSectionMap_spans
statement:
theorem commonPullbackSectionMap_spans {i j : C.I} (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) (W : X.affineOpens)
    (h : W.1 ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ c.affineOpen.1) :
    Submodule.span Γ(X, W.1) (Set.range (C.commonPullbackSectionMap g c W h)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hbig := C.pullbackFrameSectionMap_spans g (C.commonPullbackIndex g c W h)
  apply top_unique
  rw [← hbig]
  apply Submodule.span_mono
  rintro _ ⟨s, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨c.leftRestriction s, ?_⟩
  exact PullbackFrameSections.sectionMap_target_restrict g E (C.U i) c.affineOpen.1
    c.affineOpen_le_left W.1 h s

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.commonPullback_comp_restriction_heq
statement:
theorem commonPullback_comp_restriction_heq {i j : C.I} (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    (W : X.affineOpens) (h : W.1 ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ c.affineOpen.1)
    (t : C.I) (hct : c.affineOpen.1 ≤ C.U t) :
    HEq (semilinearMapComp (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hct).op).hom
      (PullbackFrameSections.coefficientMap g c.affineOpen.1 W.1 h)
      (E.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE hct).op) (C.commonPullbackSectionMap g c W h))
      (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap g ⟨t, ⟨W, h.trans (g.preimage_mono hct)⟩⟩)
proof:
:= by
  apply semilinearMap_heq_of_ringHom_eq
    (PullbackFrameSections.coefficientMap_target_restrict g (C.U t) c.affineOpen.1 hct W.1 h)
  exact PullbackFrameSections.sectionMap_target_restrict g E (C.U t) c.affineOpen.1 hct W.1 h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.commonPullback_comp_restriction_spans
statement:
theorem commonPullback_comp_restriction_spans {i j : C.I} (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    (W : X.affineOpens) (h : W.1 ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ c.affineOpen.1)
    (t : C.I) (hct : c.affineOpen.1 ≤ C.U t) :
    Submodule.span Γ(X, W.1) (Set.range (semilinearMapComp
      (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hct).op).hom
      (PullbackFrameSections.coefficientMap g c.affineOpen.1 W.1 h)
      (E.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE hct).op) (C.commonPullbackSectionMap g c W h))) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hr : Set.range (semilinearMapComp (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hct).op).hom
      (PullbackFrameSections.coefficientMap g c.affineOpen.1 W.1 h)
      (E.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE hct).op) (C.commonPullbackSectionMap g c W h)) =
      Set.range (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap g ⟨t, ⟨W, h.trans (g.preimage_mono hct)⟩⟩) := by
    congr 1
    funext s
    exact PullbackFrameSections.sectionMap_target_restrict g E (C.U t) c.affineOpen.1 hct W.1 h s
  rw [hr]
  exact C.pullbackFrameSectionMap_spans g ⟨t, ⟨W, h.trans (g.preimage_mono hct)⟩⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.commonPullbackProjectiveMap_comp_restriction
statement:
theorem commonPullbackProjectiveMap_comp_restriction {i j : C.I} (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    (W : X.affineOpens) (h : W.1 ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ c.affineOpen.1)
    (t : C.I) (hct : c.affineOpen.1 ≤ C.U t) :
    C.commonPullbackProjectiveMap g c W h ≫ semilinearSymmetricProjMap
      (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hct).op).hom (E.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE hct).op)
      (C.restriction_spans t c.affineOpen.1 hct) =
    C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g ⟨t, ⟨W, h.trans (g.preimage_mono hct)⟩⟩
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, W.1) (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.obj (op W.1)) :=
    (C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionModule_free (C.commonPullbackIndex g c W h)
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, W.1) (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.obj (op W.1)) :=
    (C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionModule_finite (C.commonPullbackIndex g c W h)
  unfold commonPullbackProjectiveMap pullbackProjectiveChartMap
  refine (semilinearSymmetricProjMap_comp
    (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hct).op).hom
    (PullbackFrameSections.coefficientMap g c.affineOpen.1 W.1 h)
    (E.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE hct).op) (C.commonPullbackSectionMap g c W h)
    (C.restriction_spans t c.affineOpen.1 hct) (C.commonPullbackSectionMap_spans g c W h)
    (C.commonPullback_comp_restriction_spans g c W h t hct)).trans ?_
  exact semilinearSymmetricProjMap_congr
    (PullbackFrameSections.coefficientMap_target_restrict g (C.U t) c.affineOpen.1 hct W.1 h)
    _ _ (C.commonPullback_comp_restriction_heq g c W h t hct)
    (C.commonPullback_comp_restriction_spans g c W h t hct)
    (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap_spans g ⟨t, ⟨W, h.trans (g.preimage_mono hct)⟩⟩)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.commonPullbackProjectiveMap_comp_left
statement:
theorem commonPullbackProjectiveMap_comp_left {i j : C.I} (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    (W : X.affineOpens) (h : W.1 ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ c.affineOpen.1) :
    C.commonPullbackProjectiveMap g c W h ≫ c.chartToLeft =
      C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g (C.commonPullbackIndex g c W h)
proof:
:=

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.commonPullbackProjectiveMap_comp_right
statement:
theorem commonPullbackProjectiveMap_comp_right {i j : C.I} (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    (W : X.affineOpens) (h : W.1 ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ c.affineOpen.1) :
    C.commonPullbackProjectiveMap g c W h ≫ c.chartToRight =
      C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g ⟨j, ⟨W, h.trans (g.preimage_mono c.affineOpen_le_right)⟩⟩

:=

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.commonPullbackProjectiveMap_chartι_compatible
statement:
theorem commonPullbackProjectiveMap_chartι_compatible {i j : C.I} (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    (W : X.affineOpens) (h : W.1 ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ c.affineOpen.1) :
    C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g (C.commonPullbackIndex g c W h) ≫ C.chartι i =
      C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g ⟨j, ⟨W, h.trans (g.preimage_mono c.affineOpen_le_right)⟩⟩ ≫ C.chartι j
proof:
:= by
  rw [← C.commonPullbackProjectiveMap_comp_left g c W h,
    ← C.commonPullbackProjectiveMap_comp_right g c W h, Category.assoc, C.chartToLeft_chartι c]
