name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackProjectiveRefinementMap_chartι_overlap
statement:
theorem pullbackProjectiveRefinementMap_chartι_overlap (a b : C.pullbackFrameIndex g)
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen a.1 b.1) (W : X.affineOpens)
    (hWa : W.1 ≤ C.pullbackFrameOpen g a) (hWb : W.1 ≤ C.pullbackFrameOpen g b)
    (hWc : W.1 ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ c.affineOpen.1) :
    C.pullbackProjectiveRefinementMap g a W hWa ≫ C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a ≫ C.chartι a.1 =
      C.pullbackProjectiveRefinementMap g b W hWb ≫ C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g b ≫ C.chartι b.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc, C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap_refinement g a W hWa,
    ← Category.assoc, C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap_refinement g b W hWb]
  exact C.commonPullbackProjectiveMap_chartι_compatible g c W hWc

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.commonPullbackRefinementOpen_covers
statement:
theorem commonPullbackRefinementOpen_covers (a b : C.pullbackFrameIndex g) :
    IsOpenCover (C.commonPullbackRefinementOpen g a b)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsOpenCover.mk
  refine top_le_iff.mp fun x _ => ?_
  have hya : g x.1 ∈ C.U a.1 := a.2.2 x.2.1
  have hyb : g x.1 ∈ C.U b.1 := b.2.2 x.2.2
  obtain ⟨f, e, hfe, hxf⟩ := exists_basicOpen_le_affine_inter
    (C.isAffine a.1) (C.isAffine b.1) (g x.1) ⟨hya, hyb⟩
  let c : C.CommonBasicOpen a.1 b.1 := ⟨f, e, hfe⟩
  let O : X.Opens := (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a ⊓ C.pullbackFrameOpen g b) ⊓ g ⁻¹ᵁ c.affineOpen.1
  have hxO : x.1 ∈ O := ⟨x.2, hxf⟩
  obtain ⟨κ, hsub, heq⟩ := Opens.isBasis_iff_cover.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens O
  rw [heq] at hxO
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hxW⟩ := Opens.mem_sSup.mp hxO
  have hWO : W ≤ O := heq.symm ▸ le_sSup hW
  let r : C.commonPullbackRefinementIndex g a b :=
    ⟨c, ⟨⟨W, hsub hW⟩, hWO.trans (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left),
      hWO.trans (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right), hWO.trans inf_le_right⟩⟩
  apply Opens.mem_iSup.mpr
  exact ⟨r, hxW⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.commonPullbackRefinementChartι_compatible
statement:
theorem commonPullbackRefinementChartι_compatible (a b : C.pullbackFrameIndex g)
    (r : C.commonPullbackRefinementIndex g a b) :
    C.pullbackProjectiveRefinementMap g a r.2.1 r.2.2.1 ≫
        C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a ≫ C.chartι a.1 =
      C.pullbackProjectiveRefinementMap g b r.2.1 r.2.2.2.1 ≫
        C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g b ≫ C.chartι b.1
proof:
:=
  C.pullbackProjectiveRefinementMap_chartι_overlap g a b r.1 r.2.1 r.2.2.1 r.2.2.2.1 r.2.2.2.2

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.quasicoherent_sheafH_isZero_of_dimension
statement:
theorem quasicoherent_sheafH_isZero_of_dimension
    (M : (space k n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (q : ℕ) (hnq : n < q + 1) :
    IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
        ((Modules.toSheafAb (space k n)).obj M) (q + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  apply sheafH_isZero_of_coordinateCech_isZero k n
    ((Modules.toSheafAb (space k n)).obj M)
    (quasicoherent_coordinateCechAcyclic k n M) q
  change IsZero (((coordinateCechComplexFunctor k n).obj M).homology (q + 1))
  exact coordinateCechHomology_isZero_of_dimension k n M hnq

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.exists_hyperplaneKernel_generator_coordinateOpen
statement:
theorem exists_hyperplaneKernel_generator_coordinateOpen
    (s : grading k n 1) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    ∃ a : Γ(space k n, coordinateOpen k n i),
      (hyperplaneι k n s).ker.ideal
          ⟨coordinateOpen k n i, coordinateOpen_isAffine k n i⟩ =
        Ideal.span {a}
proof:
:= by
  let I := hyperplaneIdeal k n s
  let q := GradedIdealQuotient.quotientMap (grading k n) I
  let U : (space k n).affineOpens :=
    ⟨coordinateOpen k n i, coordinateOpen_isAffine k n i⟩
  rw [(hyperplaneι k n s).ker_apply U]
  let eA : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading k n) (coordinate k n i) ≃+*
      Γ(space k n, coordinateOpen k n i) :=
    (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) Nat.zero_lt_one).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  let eB : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (GradedIdealQuotient.grading (grading k n) I)
      (q (coordinate k n i)) ≃+*
      Γ(hyperplane k n s,
        Proj.basicOpen (GradedIdealQuotient.grading (grading k n) I)
          (q (coordinate k n i))) :=
    (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (GradedIdealQuotient.grading (grading k n) I)
      (q (coordinate k n i)) (q.2 (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i))
      Nat.zero_lt_one).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  apply (exists_eq_span_comap_equiv_iff eA
    (RingHom.ker ((hyperplaneι k n s).app U).hom)).mp
  refine ⟨hyperplaneChartEquation k n s i, ?_⟩
  rw [RingHom.comap_ker]
  have hcomm := Proj.awayToSection_comp_appLE q
    (GradedIdealQuotient.irrelevant_le_map (grading k n) I)
    (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i)
  have hcommRing :
      ((hyperplaneι k n s).app U).hom.comp eA.toRingHom =
        eB.toRingHom.comp
          (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map q (coordinate k n i)) := by
    ext x
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom hcomm) x
  rw [hcommRing]
  calc
    RingHom.ker (eB.toRingHom.comp
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map q (coordinate k n i))) =
        RingHom.ker (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map q (coordinate k n i)) :=
      RingHom.ker_comp_of_injective _ eB.injective
    _ = Ideal.span {hyperplaneChartEquation k n s i} :=
      GradedIdealQuotient.ker_awayMap_principal (grading k n) s
        (coordinate k n i) s.2 (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.isLocallyPrincipalClosedImmersion_hyperplane
statement:
theorem isLocallyPrincipalClosedImmersion_hyperplane
    (s : grading k n 1) :
    IsLocallyPrincipalClosedImmersion (hyperplaneι k n s)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  have hx : x ∈ ⨆ i : Fin (n + 1), coordinateOpen k n i := by
    rw [coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top]
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp hx
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_hyperplaneKernel_generator_coordinateOpen k n s i
  exact ⟨⟨coordinateOpen k n i, coordinateOpen_isAffine k n i⟩, hi, a, ha⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E30.chartToBase_flat'
statement: theorem chartToBase_flat' (i : C.I) : Flat (C.chartToBase i)
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty (C.basisIndex i) with h | h
  · letI : IsEmpty (C.basisIndex i) := h
    have hE : IsEmpty (space Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))) :=
      isEmpty_space_of_isEmpty_basis (C.sectionBasis i)
    haveI : IsEmpty (C.chart i) := by
      change IsEmpty (C.affineData i).scheme
      rw [C.affineData_scheme i]
      exact hE
    infer_instance
  · exact C.chartToBase_flat i h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E30.toBase_flat'
statement: theorem toBase_flat' : Flat C.toBase
proof:
:= by
  apply IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.of_openCover C.baseCover
  intro i
  change Flat (pullback.snd C.toBase (C.U i).ι)
  let h := C.isPullback_chartι_toBase i
  rw [← MorphismProperty.cancel_left_of_respectsIso
      (@Flat) h.isoPullback.hom,
    h.isoPullback_hom_snd]
  exact chartToBase_flat' C i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E30.weilGate_hnot
statement:
theorem weilGate_hnot {B D : X.Modules} {b : B ⟶ D} (P : PairCover b) {L : X.Modules}
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (e : ℕ) :
    ∀ σ : tensorUnitSheaf P.toB.scheme ⟶ E16.twistedLine P.toB L,
      SectionIsRegular σ → sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = P.jHom.ker →
      ∀ (m : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = m)
        (w : P.toB.scheme) (hw : height w = ((m + e + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
        (q : P.toD.scheme) (hq : height q = ((m + e : ℕ) : ℕ∞)),
        flatPullback P.toB.toBase (dimPrimeCycle v m hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle w _ hw).1 →
        flatPullback P.toD.toBase (dimPrimeCycle v m hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle q _ hq).1 →
        w ∉ Set.range P.jHom
proof:
:= by
  intro σ hreg hid m v hv w hw q hq hB hD hmem
  obtain ⟨q', hq'⟩ := hmem
  have hN := E16.hasConstantRank_twistedLine P.toB hL
  haveI : (E16.twistedLine P.toB L).IsLocallyFree := hN.isFiniteLocallyFree.isLocallyFree
  haveI : (E16.twistedLine P.toB L).IsFinitePresentation :=
    IsFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation P.toB.scheme hN.isFiniteLocallyFree
  
  have hcoef : flatPullbackCoeff P.toB.toBase (P.jHom q') = 1 := by
    have h1 := congrArg (fun c : AlgebraicCycle P.toB.scheme ℤ => c w) hB
    simp only [flatPullback_apply, M7.m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply, if_true] at h1
    rw [hq']
    by_cases hv' : P.toB.toBase w = v
    · rw [if_pos hv', one_mul] at h1
      exact_mod_cast h1
    · rw [if_neg hv', zero_mul] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (by norm_num)
  
  haveI : Flat P.toD.toBase := toBase_flat' P.toD
  haveI : Flat (P.jHom ≫ P.toB.toBase) := by
    rw [P.jHom_toBase]
    infer_instance
  
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, ⟨eU⟩⟩ := isLocalLineFrame_of_hasConstantRank hN (P.jHom q')
  have hideal : P.jHom.ker.ideal U =
      Ideal.ofList [sectionOverTrivializationCoefficient σ U.1 eU] := by
    rw [← hid, sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_affine_overIso σ U eU]
    simp [Ideal.ofList]
  have hreg' : RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular Γ(P.toB.scheme, U)
      [sectionOverTrivializationCoefficient σ U.1 eU] :=
    (RingTheory.Sequence.isWeaklyRegular_singleton_iff _ _).mpr
      (sectionOverTrivializationCoefficient_isRegular σ hreg U eU).left
  let d : KoszulClosedImmersionChartAt P.jHom q' :=
    ⟨U, hxU, [sectionOverTrivializationCoefficient σ U.1 eU], hideal, hreg'⟩
  have hker := d.ker_stalkMap
  have hreg2 := d.equations_regular
  have hlen : d.pointed.equations.length = 1 := by
    have hc : d.chart.equations = [sectionOverTrivializationCoefficient σ U.1 eU] := rfl
    simp only [KoszulOpenPullbackChart.At.equations, KoszulOpenPullbackChart.stalkEquations,
      KoszulOpenPullbackChart.localStalkEquations,
      KoszulOpenPullbackChart.standardStalkEquations, List.length_map]
    exact congrArg List.length hc
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := List.length_eq_one_iff.mp hlen
  rw [hg] at hker hreg2
  have hker' : RingHom.ker (P.jHom.stalkMap q').hom = Ideal.span {g} := by
    rw [hker]
    simp [Ideal.ofList]
  exact E27.false_of_mem_range_of_regular_kernel P.toB.toBase P.jHom q' hcoef g hker'
    ((RingTheory.Sequence.isWeaklyRegular_singleton_iff _ _).mp hreg2)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E30.weilGate_of_hjq_hord
statement:
theorem weilGate_of_hjq_hord {B D : X.Modules} {b : B ⟶ D} (P : PairCover b) {L : X.Modules}
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (e : ℕ)
    (hjq : ∀ σ : tensorUnitSheaf P.toB.scheme ⟶ E16.twistedLine P.toB L,
      SectionIsRegular σ → sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = P.jHom.ker →
      ∀ (m : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = m)
        (w : P.toB.scheme) (hw : height w = ((m + e + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
        (q : P.toD.scheme) (hq : height q = ((m + e : ℕ) : ℕ∞)),
        flatPullback P.toB.toBase (dimPrimeCycle v m hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle w _ hw).1 →
        flatPullback P.toD.toBase (dimPrimeCycle v m hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle q _ hq).1 →
        P.jHom q ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι w))
    (hord : ∀ σ : tensorUnitSheaf P.toB.scheme ⟶ E16.twistedLine P.toB L,
      SectionIsRegular σ → sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = P.jHom.ker →
      ∀ (m : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = m)
        (w : P.toB.scheme) (hw : height w = ((m + e + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
        (q : P.toD.scheme) (hq : height q = ((m + e : ℕ) : ℕ∞)),
        flatPullback P.toB.toBase (dimPrimeCycle v m hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle w _ hw).1 →
        flatPullback P.toD.toBase (dimPrimeCycle v m hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle q _ hq).1 →
        ∀ z : pointClosureScheme w,
          (pointClosureScheme w).ord
            (D10.sectionCoord (closureFrame (L := E16.twistedLine P.toB L)
              (hL := E16.hasConstantRank_twistedLine P.toB hL) w z)
              (wPullbackSection (pointClosureι w) (sectionOfHom σ))) z =
          if pointClosureι w z = P.jHom q then 1 else 0) :
    E21.WeilGate P hL e
proof:
:=
  weilGate_of_ord P hL e (weilGate_hnot P hL e) hjq hord

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.specMap_basicOpenSectionsEquiv_hom_inv
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem specMap_basicOpenSectionsEquiv_hom_inv
    (U : X.affineOpens) (f : Γ(X, U.1)) :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (basicOpenSectionsEquiv U f).toRingHom) ≫
        Scheme.Spec.map
          (basicOpenSectionsEquiv U f).symm.toCommRingCatIso.op.hom = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  change
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (basicOpenSectionsEquiv U f).toRingHom) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (basicOpenSectionsEquiv U f).symm.toRingHom) = 𝟙 _
  rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_id]
  congr 1
  apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
  ext r
  simp

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.specMap_basicOpenSectionsEquiv_basicOpenBaseIso
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem specMap_basicOpenSectionsEquiv_basicOpenBaseIso
    (U : X.affineOpens) (f : Γ(X, U.1)) :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (basicOpenSectionsEquiv U f).toRingHom) ≫
        (basicOpenBaseIso U f).hom = (X.affineBasicOpen f).2.isoSpec.inv
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [basicOpenBaseIso, CategoryTheory.Functor.mapIso]
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom]
  rw [← Category.assoc,
    specMap_basicOpenSectionsEquiv_hom_inv, Category.id_comp]
  rfl

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenSectionsEquiv_symm_comp_restriction
statement:
theorem basicOpenSectionsEquiv_symm_comp_restriction
    (U : X.affineOpens) (f : Γ(X, U.1)) :
    (basicOpenSectionsEquiv U f).symm.toRingHom.comp
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op).hom =
      algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) (Localization.Away f)
proof:
:= by
  letI := U.2.isLocalization_basicOpen f
  have h : (basicOpenSectionsEquiv U f).toRingHom.comp
      (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) (Localization.Away f)) =
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op).hom := by
    ext r
    exact (IsLocalization.algEquiv (Submonoid.powers f)
      (Localization.Away f) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f)).commutes r
  rw [← h]
  ext r
  simp

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenBaseIso_hom_homOfLE
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem basicOpenBaseIso_hom_homOfLE
    (U : X.affineOpens) (f : Γ(X, U.1)) :
    (basicOpenBaseIso U f).hom ≫
        X.homOfLE (X.affineBasicOpen_le f) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) (Localization.Away f))) ≫
        U.2.isoSpec.inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono U.1.ι]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Scheme.homOfLE_ι,
    IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_inv_ι]
  change
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (basicOpenSectionsEquiv U f).symm.toRingHom) ≫
        (X.affineBasicOpen f).2.fromSpec =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) (Localization.Away f))) ≫
        U.2.fromSpec
  rw [← U.2.map_fromSpec (X.affineBasicOpen f).2
    (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op]
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  congr 1
  apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
  exact basicOpenSectionsEquiv_symm_comp_restriction U f

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.isPullback_basicOpenChartMap
statement:
theorem isPullback_basicOpenChartMap
    (U : X.affineOpens) (f : Γ(X, U.1)) :
    IsPullback
      (basicOpenChartMap I U f)
      (chartToOpen I (X.affineBasicOpen f))
      (chartToOpen I U)
      (X.homOfLE (X.affineBasicOpen_le f))
proof:
:= by
  let c := basicOpenComparison I U f
  refine (isPullback_reesProjMap_toCoefficientSpec (I.ideal U) f).of_iso
    c.projIso.symm (Iso.refl _) (basicOpenBaseIso U f) U.2.isoSpec.symm
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · dsimp only [basicOpenChartMap]
    simp [c]
  · apply (cancel_epi c.projIso.hom).1
    calc
      c.projIso.hom ≫ reesProjToSpec (localizedIdeal (I.ideal U) f) ≫
            (basicOpenBaseIso U f).hom =
          (c.projIso.hom ≫
            reesProjToSpec (localizedIdeal (I.ideal U) f)) ≫
              (basicOpenBaseIso U f).hom :=
        (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = (reesProjToSpec (I.ideal (X.affineBasicOpen f)) ≫
            Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
              (basicOpenSectionsEquiv U f).toRingHom)) ≫
              (basicOpenBaseIso U f).hom :=
        congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ (basicOpenBaseIso U f).hom)
          c.projIso_hom_toSpec
      _ = reesProjToSpec (I.ideal (X.affineBasicOpen f)) ≫
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
                (basicOpenSectionsEquiv U f).toRingHom) ≫
              (basicOpenBaseIso U f).hom) :=
        Category.assoc _ _ _
      _ = reesProjToSpec (I.ideal (X.affineBasicOpen f)) ≫
            (X.affineBasicOpen f).2.isoSpec.inv :=
        congrArg (fun q ↦ reesProjToSpec
          (I.ideal (X.affineBasicOpen f)) ≫ q)
            (specMap_basicOpenSectionsEquiv_basicOpenBaseIso U f)
      _ = chartToOpen I (X.affineBasicOpen f) := by
        rfl
      _ = c.projIso.hom ≫ c.projIso.inv ≫
            chartToOpen I (X.affineBasicOpen f) := by
        rw [Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  · simpa only [Iso.refl_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp,
      chartToOpen, SchemeRelativeProj.AffineData.toBase] using
      congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ U.2.isoSpec.inv)
        (reesProjToSpec_eq_affineData_toSpecBase X U (I.ideal U))
  · simpa only [Iso.symm_hom, Category.comp_id] using
      (basicOpenBaseIso_hom_homOfLE U f).symm

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.CommonBasicOpen.affineOpen_le_intersection
statement:
theorem affineOpen_le_intersection (c : CommonBasicOpen U V) :
    c.affineOpen.1 ≤ U.1 ⊓ V.1
proof:
:= by
  refine le_inf (X.affineBasicOpen_le c.left) ?_
  change X.basicOpen c.left ≤ V.1
  rw [c.basicOpen_eq]
  exact X.affineBasicOpen_le c.right

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.CommonBasicOpen.affineOpenIsoInIntersection_hom_baseCover
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem affineOpenIsoInIntersection_hom_baseCover
    (c : CommonBasicOpen U V) :
    c.affineOpenIsoInIntersection.hom ≫
        (CommonBasicOpen.baseCover U V).f c =
      X.homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_intersection

:=

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.CommonBasicOpen.affineOpenIsoInIntersection_hom_toLeft
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem affineOpenIsoInIntersection_hom_toLeft
    (c : CommonBasicOpen U V) :
    c.affineOpenIsoInIntersection.hom ≫
          (CommonBasicOpen.baseCover U V).f c ≫
          X.homOfLE (inf_le_left : U.1 ⊓ V.1 ≤ U.1) =

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.isPullback_basicOpenOverlapCover_toChart
statement:
theorem isPullback_basicOpenOverlapCover_toChart
    (U V : X.affineOpens) (c : CommonBasicOpen U V) :
    IsPullback
      ((basicOpenOverlapCover I U V).f c ≫ overlapToChart I U V)
      ((CommonBasicOpen.baseCover U V).pullbackHom
        (overlapToIntersection I U V) c)
      (chartToOpen I U)
      ((CommonBasicOpen.baseCover U V).f c ≫
        X.homOfLE (inf_le_left : U.1 ⊓ V.1 ≤ U.1))
proof:
:= by
  change IsPullback
    (pullback.fst (overlapToIntersection I U V)
        ((CommonBasicOpen.baseCover U V).f c) ≫
      pullback.fst (chartToOpen I U)
        (X.homOfLE (inf_le_left : U.1 ⊓ V.1 ≤ U.1)))
    (pullback.snd (overlapToIntersection I U V)
      ((CommonBasicOpen.baseCover U V).f c))
    (chartToOpen I U)
    ((CommonBasicOpen.baseCover U V).f c ≫
      X.homOfLE (inf_le_left : U.1 ⊓ V.1 ≤ U.1))
  exact (IsPullback.of_hasPullback _ _).paste_horiz
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback _ _)

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.isPullback_commonBasicOpenChart
statement:
theorem isPullback_commonBasicOpenChart
    (U V : X.affineOpens) (c : CommonBasicOpen U V) :
    IsPullback
      (basicOpenChartMap I U c.left)
      (chartToOpen I c.affineOpen ≫
        c.affineOpenIsoInIntersection.hom)
      (chartToOpen I U)
      ((CommonBasicOpen.baseCover U V).f c ≫
        X.homOfLE (inf_le_left : U.1 ⊓ V.1 ≤ U.1))
proof:
:= by
  show IsPullback
      (basicOpenChartMap I U c.left)
      (chartToOpen I (X.affineBasicOpen c.left) ≫
        c.affineOpenIsoInIntersection.hom)
      (chartToOpen I U)
      ((CommonBasicOpen.baseCover U V).f c ≫
        X.homOfLE (inf_le_left : U.1 ⊓ V.1 ≤ U.1))
  refine (isPullback_basicOpenChartMap I U c.left).of_iso
    (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) c.affineOpenIsoInIntersection (Iso.refl _)
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp
  · simp
  · simp
  · exact (c.affineOpenIsoInIntersection_hom_toLeft.trans (Category.comp_id _).symm).symm

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.commonBasicOpenChartIso_hom_chartMap
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem commonBasicOpenChartIso_hom_chartMap
    (U V : X.affineOpens) (c : CommonBasicOpen U V) :
    (commonBasicOpenChartIso I U V c).hom ≫
        basicOpenChartMap I U c.left =
      (basicOpenOverlapCover I U V).f c ≫ overlapToChart I U V
proof:
:=
  (isPullback_basicOpenOverlapCover_toChart I U V c).isoIsPullback_hom_fst
    _ _ (isPullback_commonBasicOpenChart I U V c)

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.commonBasicOpenChartIso_hom_toCommonBase
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem commonBasicOpenChartIso_hom_toCommonBase
    (U V : X.affineOpens) (c : CommonBasicOpen U V) :
    (commonBasicOpenChartIso I U V c).hom ≫ chartToOpen I c.affineOpen ≫
        c.affineOpenIsoInIntersection.hom =
      (CommonBasicOpen.baseCover U V).pullbackHom
        (overlapToIntersection I U V) c
proof:
:= by
  show ((isPullback_basicOpenOverlapCover_toChart I U V c).isoIsPullback _ _
      (isPullback_commonBasicOpenChart I U V c)).hom ≫ chartToOpen I c.affineOpen ≫
        c.affineOpenIsoInIntersection.hom =
      (CommonBasicOpen.baseCover U V).pullbackHom
        (overlapToIntersection I U V) c
  exact (isPullback_basicOpenOverlapCover_toChart I U V c).isoIsPullback_hom_snd
    _ _ (isPullback_commonBasicOpenChart I U V c)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E28.presheaf_map_map
statement:
theorem presheaf_map_map (M : W.Modules) {U V T : W.Opens} (h1 : V ≤ U) (h2 : T ≤ V)
    (x : Γ(M, U)) :
    M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h2).op (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h1).op x) =
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h2.trans h1)).op x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E28.presheaf_map_smul
statement:
theorem presheaf_map_smul (M : W.Modules) {U V : W.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) (r : Γ(W, U))
    (x : Γ(M, U)) :
    M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (r • x) =
      W.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op r • M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x
proof:
:= by
  have := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (M.map_comp_smul (homOfLE h) r) x
  exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E28.restrict_wFrameSec
statement:
theorem restrict_wFrameSec {y : W} (d : WFrame L y) (V : W.Opens) (hV : V ≤ d.U)
    (c : Γ(W, d.U)) :
    L.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op (wFrameSec d d.U le_rfl c) =
      wFrameSec d V hV (W.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [wFrameSec_smul d d.U le_rfl c, wFrameSec_smul d V hV, wFrameSec_one, wFrameSec_one,
    presheaf_map_smul, presheaf_map_map]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E28.isUnit_germ_wCoord
statement:
theorem isUnit_germ_wCoord (σ : tensorUnitSheaf W ⟶ L) {y : W} (d : WFrame L y)
    (hy : y ∉ (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).support) :
    IsUnit (W.presheaf.germ d.U y d.mem (wCoord d (sectionOfHom σ)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hVaff, hyV, hVU⟩ := exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset d.mem
  have hVle : V ≤ d.U := hVU
  let Va : W.affineOpens := ⟨V, hVaff⟩
  have h1 : y ∉ W.zeroLocus (U := V) ((sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).ideal Va) := by
    intro h
    exact hy ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.mem_supportSet_iff_of_mem (U := Va) hyV).mpr h)
  rw [Scheme.mem_zeroLocus_iff] at h1
  push Not at h1
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfy⟩ := h1
  have hfa : f ∈ sectionAffineEvaluationIdeal σ Va := sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_le_affine σ Va hf
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := hfa
  have hs : Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ V (1 : Γ(W, V)) =
      L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op (sectionOfHom σ) := by
    have h := C1Cap.app_presheaf_map σ (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)) (1 : Γ(W, ⊤))
    have h1 : ((tensorUnitSheaf W).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op) (1 : Γ(W, ⊤)) =
        (1 : Γ(W, V)) := C1Cap.unit_presheaf_map_one _
    rw [h1] at h
    exact h
  have hsec : Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ V (1 : Γ(W, V)) =
      wFrameSec d V hVle (W.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVle).op (wCoord d (sectionOfHom σ))) := by
    rw [hs, ← restrict_wFrameSec, wCoord_spec, presheaf_map_map]
  have hfe : f = W.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVle).op (wCoord d (sectionOfHom σ)) *
      φ (wFrameSec d V hVle 1) := by
    rw [← hφ]
    change φ (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ V (1 : Γ(W, V))) = _
    rw [hsec, wFrameSec_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  have hu : IsUnit (W.presheaf.germ V y hyV f) := (W.mem_basicOpen (U := V) f y hyV).mp hfy
  rw [hfe, map_mul] at hu
  have hu2 := isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left hu
  rwa [W.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE hVle) y hyV] at hu2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E28.isUnit_eqOfSection_of_not_mem_support
statement:
theorem isUnit_eqOfSection_of_not_mem_support (hL : HasConstantRank W L 1)
    (σ : tensorUnitSheaf W ⟶ L) {y : W} (hy : y ∉ (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).support) :
    IsUnit (W.presheaf.germ (wFrameAt L hL y).U y (wFrameAt L hL y).mem
      (wCoord (wFrameAt L hL y) (sectionOfHom σ)))
proof:
:=
  isUnit_germ_wCoord σ (wFrameAt L hL y) hy

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E28.not_mem_support_ker
statement:
theorem not_mem_support_ker {V : Scheme.{u}} (j : V ⟶ W) [IsClosedImmersion j] {y : W}
    (hy : y ∉ Set.range j) : y ∉ j.ker.support
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h1 : (j.ker.support : Set W) = closure (Set.range j) := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.support_ker]
  rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, h1, j.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range.closure_eq] at h
  exact hy h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E28.isUnit_eqOfSection_of_not_mem_range
statement:
theorem isUnit_eqOfSection_of_not_mem_range (hL : HasConstantRank W L 1)
    (σ : tensorUnitSheaf W ⟶ L) {V : Scheme.{u}} (j : V ⟶ W) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    (hσ : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = j.ker) {y : W} (hy : y ∉ Set.range j) :
    IsUnit (W.presheaf.germ (wFrameAt L hL y).U y (wFrameAt L hL y).mem
      (wCoord (wFrameAt L hL y) (sectionOfHom σ)))
proof:
:=
  isUnit_eqOfSection_of_not_mem_support hL σ (by rw [hσ]; exact not_mem_support_ker j hy)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E28.closure_coord_isUnit
statement:
theorem closure_coord_isUnit (w : X) (s : Γ(L, ⊤)) (z : pointClosureScheme w)
    (hu : IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z)).U (pointClosureι w z)
      (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z)).mem (wCoord (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z)) s))) :
    IsUnit ((pointClosureScheme w).presheaf.germ (closureFrame (hL := hL) w z).U z
      (closureFrame (hL := hL) w z).mem
      (D10.sectionCoordSec (closureFrame (hL := hL) w z) (wPullbackSection (pointClosureι w) s)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold closureFrame
  rw [sectionCoordSec_pullbackWFrame (pointClosureι w) (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z)) s _
    (wCoord_spec _ s) z (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z)).mem]
  have h := Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply (pointClosureι w) (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z)).U z
    (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z)).mem (wCoord (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z)) s)
  have h' := hu.map (Scheme.Hom.stalkMap (pointClosureι w) z).hom
  exact (congrArg IsUnit h).mp h'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E28.coeff_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range
statement:
theorem coeff_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (w : X)
    (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree (pointClosureScheme w)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι w)).obj L))
    (hrank : SingularCurve.genericRank (pointClosureScheme w)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι w)).obj L) = 1)
    (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) {V : Scheme.{u}} (j : V ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    (hσ : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = j.ker) {b₀ : pointClosureScheme w}
    (bf : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme w)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι w)).obj L) b₀)
    (hb : D10.sectionCoord bf (wPullbackSection (pointClosureι w) (sectionOfHom σ)) = 1)
    (z : pointClosureScheme w) (hz : pointClosureι w z ∉ Set.range j) :
    Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame hM hrank bf z = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hc : coheight z = 1
  · exact E25.coeff_eq_zero_of_isUnit hM hrank bf _ hb (closureFrame (hL := hL) w z) z
      (closureFrame (hL := hL) w z).mem hc
      (closure_coord_isUnit w _ z (isUnit_eqOfSection_of_not_mem_range hL σ j hσ hz))
  · exact E25.coeff_eq_zero_of_coheight_ne hM hrank bf z hc

name: RiemannRoch.KNFA.away_kernel_of_generators
statement:
theorem away_kernel_of_generators {κ : Type*} (q : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (s : κ → A) (f : A)
    (hs : ∀ k, s k ∈ 𝒜 1) (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 1)
    (hker : RingHom.ker q.toRingHom = Ideal.span (Set.range s)) :
    RingHom.ker (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map q f) =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun k =>
        GradedIdealQuotient.awayEquation 𝒜 (s k) f (hs k) hf)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨m, a, ha, rfl⟩ := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_surjective 𝒜 hf z
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker] at hz
    have hzval := congrArg HomogeneousLocalization.val hz
    simp only [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map_mk,
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.val_zero] at hzval
    rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk'] at hzval
    obtain ⟨⟨_, r, rfl⟩, hr⟩ := (IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff _ _).mp hzval
    have hmem : f ^ r * a ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range s) := by
      rw [← hker, RingHom.mem_ker]
      change q (f ^ r * a) = 0
      rw [map_mul, map_pow]
      exact hr
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Finsupp.mem_ideal_span_range_iff_exists_finsupp.mp hmem
    let b' : κ → 𝒜 (r + m) := fun k => DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 (c k * f) (r + m)
    have hb'k : ∀ k, (b' k : A) * s k =
        (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 (c k * f * s k) ((r + m) + 1) : A) := fun k =>
      (DirectSum.coe_decompose_mul_add_of_right_mem 𝒜 (hs k)).symm
    have h1 : (∑ k ∈ c.support, c k * f * s k) = f ^ (r + 1) * a := by
      calc (∑ k ∈ c.support, c k * f * s k)
          = (∑ k ∈ c.support, c k * s k) * f := by
            rw [Finset.sum_mul]
            exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => by ring)
        _ = f ^ r * a * f := by
            have := hc
            simp only [Finsupp.sum] at this
            rw [this]
        _ = f ^ (r + 1) * a := by ring
    have hsum : (∑ k ∈ c.support, (b' k : A) * s k) = f ^ (r + 1) * a := by
      calc (∑ k ∈ c.support, (b' k : A) * s k)
          = ∑ k ∈ c.support,
              (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 (c k * f * s k) ((r + m) + 1) : A) :=
            Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => hb'k k)
        _ = (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 (∑ k ∈ c.support, c k * f * s k) ((r + m) + 1) : A) := by
            rw [DirectSum.decompose_sum]
            have hh := map_sum (DirectSum.component ℕ ℕ (fun i => 𝒜 i) ((r + m) + 1))
              (fun k => DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 (c k * f * s k)) c.support
            rw [← AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum]
            exact congrArg Subtype.val hh.symm
        _ = f ^ (r + 1) * a := by
            rw [h1]
            apply DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_same
            convert SetLike.mul_mem_graded (SetLike.pow_mem_graded (r + 1) hf) ha using 1
            simp [add_assoc, add_comm]
    have hv : ∀ (t : Finset κ) (g : κ → HomogeneousLocalization.Away 𝒜 f),
        (∑ k ∈ t, g k).val = ∑ k ∈ t, (g k).val := fun t g =>
      map_sum (algebraMap (HomogeneousLocalization.Away 𝒜 f)
        (Localization (Submonoid.powers f))) g t
    have hzeq : HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk 𝒜 hf m a ha =
        ∑ k ∈ c.support, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk 𝒜 hf (r + m) (b' k)
          (by simp) *
          GradedIdealQuotient.awayEquation 𝒜 (s k) f (hs k) hf := by
      apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
      rw [hv]
      simp only [GradedIdealQuotient.awayEquation, HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul,
        HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, Localization.mk_mul]
      rw [← Localization.mk_sum, hsum, Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
      refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
      simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, Submonoid.coe_mul]
      ring
    rw [hzeq]
    refine Ideal.sum_mem _ (fun k _ => Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨k, rfl⟩))
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
    change HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map
      q f (GradedIdealQuotient.awayEquation 𝒜 (s k) f (hs k) hf) = 0
    rw [GradedIdealQuotient.awayEquation, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map_mk]
    apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
    simp only [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.val_zero]
    rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk', IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff]
    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul]
    change q.toRingHom (s k) = 0
    rw [← RingHom.mem_ker, hker]
    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨k, rfl⟩

name: RiemannRoch.KNFA.proj_kernel_basicOpen_of_generators
statement:
theorem proj_kernel_basicOpen_of_generators {κ : Type*}
    (q : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (hrel : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map q)
    [QuasiCompact (Proj.map q hrel)] (s : κ → A) (f : A)
    (hs : ∀ k, s k ∈ 𝒜 1) (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 1)
    (hker : RingHom.ker q.toRingHom = Ideal.span (Set.range s)) :
    (Proj.map q hrel).ker.ideal
      ⟨Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 f, Proj.isAffineOpen_basicOpen 𝒜 f hf Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun k => Proj.awayToSection 𝒜 f
        (GradedIdealQuotient.awayEquation 𝒜 (s k) f (hs k) hf))
proof:
:= by
  let U : (Proj 𝒜).affineOpens :=
    ⟨Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 f, Proj.isAffineOpen_basicOpen 𝒜 f hf Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
  rw [Scheme.Hom.ker_apply]
  let eA := (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway 𝒜 f hf Nat.zero_lt_one).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  let eB := (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway ℬ (q f) (q.map_mem hf) Nat.zero_lt_one).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  have hcomm := Proj.awayToSection_comp_appLE q hrel hf
  have hcommRing : ((Proj.map q hrel).app U).hom.comp eA.toRingHom =
      eB.toRingHom.comp (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map q f) := by
    ext x
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom hcomm) x
  have hk : (RingHom.ker ((Proj.map q hrel).app U).hom).comap eA.toRingHom =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun k =>
        GradedIdealQuotient.awayEquation 𝒜 (s k) f (hs k) hf) := by
    rw [RingHom.comap_ker, hcommRing]
    exact (RingHom.ker_comp_of_injective _ eB.injective).trans
      (away_kernel_of_generators 𝒜 ℬ q s f hs hf hker)
  have hm := congrArg (Ideal.map eA.toRingHom) hk
  have hcancel : Ideal.map eA.toRingHom
      ((RingHom.ker ((Proj.map q hrel).app U).hom).comap eA.toRingHom) =
      RingHom.ker ((Proj.map q hrel).app U).hom :=
    Ideal.map_comap_eq_self_of_equiv eA _
  rw [hcancel, Ideal.map_span, ← Set.range_comp] at hm
  exact hm

name: RiemannRoch.KNFA.ker_symmetricAlgebraMap_of_surjective_ker
statement:
theorem ker_symmetricAlgebraMap_of_surjective_ker (φ : M →ₗ[R] M')
    (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) (N : Submodule R M) (hker : LinearMap.ker φ = N) :
    RingHom.ker (symmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) φ) = E12.symIdeal N
proof:
:= by
  let e1 : (M ⧸ N) ≃ₗ[R] M' :=
    (Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ hker.symm).trans (LinearMap.quotKerEquivOfSurjective φ hφ)
  have hcomp : (e1 : (M ⧸ N) →ₗ[R] M').restrictScalars R ∘ₗ N.mkQ = φ := by
    ext m; simp [e1]
  have key : ∀ x, symmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) φ x =
      symmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) e1.toLinearMap (symmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) N.mkQ x) := by
    intro x
    have h := congrArg (fun F => F x)
      (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap_comp (R := R) (S := R) (T := R) N.mkQ
        (e1 : (M ⧸ N) →ₗ[R] M'))
    rw [hcomp] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hinj : Function.Injective (symmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) e1.toLinearMap) :=
    (rankTwo_symmetricAlgebraEquiv R e1).injective
  rw [← E12.ker_symmetricAlgebraMap_mkQ_E12]
  ext x
  simp only [RingHom.mem_ker, key]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact hinj (h.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  · intro h
    rw [h, map_zero]

name: RiemannRoch.KNFA.symIdeal_span
statement:
theorem symIdeal_span (S : Set M) :
    E12.symIdeal (Submodule.span R S) = Ideal.span (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M '' S)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [E12.symIdeal, Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
    refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun m _ =>
      SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M m ∈ Ideal.span (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M '' S)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hm
    · intro x hx
      exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    · simp
    · intro x y _ _ hx hy
      rw [map_add]
      exact Ideal.add_mem _ hx hy
    · intro c x _ hx
      rw [map_smul, Algebra.smul_def]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hx
  · exact Ideal.span_mono (Set.image_mono Submodule.subset_span)

name: RiemannRoch.KNFA.ker_eq_span_adapted
statement:
theorem ker_eq_span_adapted (b : Module.Basis (κ ⊕ PUnit.{u + 1}) R M) (φ : M →ₗ[R] R)
    (h0 : ∀ j, φ (b (Sum.inl j)) = 0) (h1 : φ (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) = 1) :
    LinearMap.ker φ = Submodule.span R (Set.range fun j => b (Sum.inl j))
proof:
:= by
  have hφ : φ = b.coord (Sum.inr PUnit.unit) := by
    refine b.ext (fun i => ?_)
    rcases i with j | ⟨⟩
    · simp [h0]
    · simp [h1]
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro v hv
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, hφ, Module.Basis.coord_apply] at hv
    have hrep := b.linearCombination_repr v
    rw [← hrep, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply]
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro i _
    rcases i with j | ⟨⟩
    · exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩)
    · simp [hv]
  · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact h0 j

name: RiemannRoch.KNFA.surjective_of_adapted
statement:
theorem surjective_of_adapted (b : Module.Basis (κ ⊕ PUnit.{u + 1}) R M) (φ : M →ₗ[R] R)
    (h1 : φ (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) = 1) : Function.Surjective φ
proof:
:= fun r =>
  ⟨r • b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit), by simp [h1]⟩

name: RiemannRoch.KNFA.ker_symmetricAlgebraMap_of_adapted
statement:
theorem ker_symmetricAlgebraMap_of_adapted (b : Module.Basis (κ ⊕ PUnit.{u + 1}) R M)
    (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (h0 : ∀ j, φ (b (Sum.inl j)) = 0) (h1 : φ (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) = 1) :
    RingHom.ker (symmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) φ) =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun j => linearForm R M (b (Sum.inl j)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [ker_symmetricAlgebraMap_of_surjective_ker φ (surjective_of_adapted b φ h1) _
    (ker_eq_span_adapted b φ h0 h1), symIdeal_span, ← Set.range_comp]
  rfl

name: RiemannRoch.KNFA.ker_awayMap_adapted
statement:
theorem ker_awayMap_adapted (b : Module.Basis (κ ⊕ PUnit.{u + 1}) R M)
    (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (h0 : ∀ j, φ (b (Sum.inl j)) = 0) (h1 : φ (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) = 1) :
    RingHom.ker (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) φ)
      (linearForm R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)))) =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun j =>
        tautChart_ratio R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) (b (Sum.inl j)))
proof:
:=
  away_kernel_of_generators (symGrading R M) (symGrading R R)
    (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) φ) (fun j => linearForm R M (b (Sum.inl j)))
    (linearForm R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)))
    (fun _ => linearForm_mem_degree_one R M _) (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M _)
    (ker_symmetricAlgebraMap_of_adapted b φ h0 h1)

name: RiemannRoch.KNFA.awayMap_ratio
statement:
theorem awayMap_ratio (b : Module.Basis (κ ⊕ PUnit.{u + 1}) R M)
    (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (h0 : ∀ j, φ (b (Sum.inl j)) = 0) (h1 : φ (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) = 1)
    (j : κ) :
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) φ)
      (linearForm R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)))
      (tautChart_ratio R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) (b (Sum.inl j))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← RingHom.mem_ker, ker_awayMap_adapted b φ h0 h1]
  exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩

name: RiemannRoch.KNFA.chart_kernel_ideal_adapted
statement:
theorem chart_kernel_ideal_adapted (b : Module.Basis (κ ⊕ PUnit.{u + 1}) R M)
    (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (h0 : ∀ j, φ (b (Sum.inl j)) = 0) (h1 : φ (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) = 1) :
    (symmetricProjMap (S := R) φ
        (SchemeProjectiveBundle.E14.span_range_of_surjective (surjective_of_adapted b φ h1))).ker.ideal
      ⟨linearOpen R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)),
        Proj.isAffineOpen_basicOpen _ _ (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M _) Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun j =>
        tautChart_ratioSection R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) (b (Sum.inl j)))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion (symmetricProjMap (S := R) φ
      (SchemeProjectiveBundle.E14.span_range_of_surjective (surjective_of_adapted b φ h1))) :=
    SchemeProjectiveBundle.E14.isClosedImmersion_symmetricProjMap_of_surjective
      (surjective_of_adapted b φ h1)
  haveI : QuasiCompact (Proj.map (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) φ)
      (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) φ
        (SchemeProjectiveBundle.E14.span_range_of_surjective (surjective_of_adapted b φ h1)))) :=
    inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact (symmetricProjMap (S := R) φ
      (SchemeProjectiveBundle.E14.span_range_of_surjective (surjective_of_adapted b φ h1))))
  exact proj_kernel_basicOpen_of_generators (symGrading R M) (symGrading R R)
    (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) φ)
    (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) φ
      (SchemeProjectiveBundle.E14.span_range_of_surjective (surjective_of_adapted b φ h1)))
    (fun j => linearForm R M (b (Sum.inl j)))
    (linearForm R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)))
    (fun _ => linearForm_mem_degree_one R M _) (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M _)
    (ker_symmetricAlgebraMap_of_adapted b φ h0 h1)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechFreeAbMappedOpComplex_exactAt_of_injective
statement:
theorem coordinateCechFreeAbMappedOpComplex_exactAt_of_injective
    (I : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space k n).toPresheafedSpace) [Injective I]
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≠ 0) :
    (coordinateCechFreeAbMappedOpComplex k n I).ExactAt i
proof:
:= by
  let F := preadditiveYoneda.obj I
  letI : F.PreservesHomology := by
    change (preadditiveYonedaObj I ⋙
      forget₂ (ModuleCat (End I)) AddCommGrpCat).PreservesHomology
    infer_instance
  have h := (coordinateCechFreeAbChainComplex_exactAt k n i hi).op
  have hF : ∀ (S : ShortComplex
      (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space k n).toPresheafedSpace)ᵒᵖ),
      S.Exact → (S.map F).Exact :=
    ((Functor.exact_tfae F).out 2 1).mp
      (inferInstance : F.PreservesHomology)
  change ((((coordinateCechFreeAbChainComplex k n).op).sc i).map F).Exact
  exact hF (((coordinateCechFreeAbChainComplex k n).op).sc i) h
