name: KSpecialization.ARRHS.pullbackSection_unit_app
statement:
theorem pullbackSection_unit_app (U : Y.Opens) (g : Γ(Λ, U)) :
    (KSpecialization.AR7R.pullbackSection F s).app (F ⁻¹ᵁ U)
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction F).unit.app Λ).app U g) =
      F.app U (s.app U g)
proof:
:= by
  have hη : (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction F).unit.app (tensorUnitSheaf Y) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).map (pullbackObjUnitIso F).hom =
      SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit F.toRingCatSheafHom := by
    have hp := SheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction_homEquiv_pullbackObjUnitToUnit
      F.toRingCatSheafHom
    rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit] at hp
    exact hp
  have e : (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction F).unit.app Λ ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).map (KSpecialization.AR7R.pullbackSection F s) =
      s ≫ SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit F.toRingCatSheafHom := by
    have nat := Adjunction.unit_naturality (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction F) s
    rw [KSpecialization.AR7R.pullbackSection, Functor.map_comp]
    erw [← Category.assoc, nat, Category.assoc, hη]
    rfl
  have h2 := congrArg (fun φ : Λ ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj (tensorUnitSheaf W) =>
    φ.app U g) e
  exact h2

name: KSpecialization.ARRHS.mono_of_wFrames
statement:
theorem mono_of_wFrames {N : X.Modules} (φ : N ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X)
    (h : ∀ x : X, ∃ e : WFrame N x, ∀ (V : X.Opens) (hV : V ≤ e.U), x ∈ V →
      ∀ c : Γ(X, V), φ.app V (wFrameSec e V hV c) = 0 → c = 0) : Mono φ
proof:
:= by
  apply KSpecialization.ARRG67.mono_of_injective_sections
  intro V a b hab
  have hx : φ.app V.unop (a - b) = 0 := by
    change φ.val.app V (a - b) = 0
    rw [map_sub]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hab
  choose e he using h
  let T : TopCat.Sheaf Ab X := ⟨N.presheaf, N.isSheaf⟩
  have hab' : a - b = 0 := by
    refine T.eq_of_locally_eq' (fun x : V.unop => (e x).U ⊓ V.unop) V.unop
      (fun x => homOfLE inf_le_right) ?_ (a - b) 0 ?_
    · intro y hy
      have hy2 : y ∈ ((e y).U ⊓ V.unop : X.Opens) := ⟨(e y).mem, hy⟩
      exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hy2⟩
    · intro x
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (e x).exists_coord ((e x).U ⊓ V.unop) inf_le_left
        (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : (e x).U ⊓ V.unop ≤ V.unop)).op (a - b))
      have h1 : φ.app ((e x).U ⊓ V.unop) (wFrameSec (e x) _ inf_le_left c) = 0 := by
        rw [hc, app_presheaf_map, hx, map_zero]
      have hmem : (x : X) ∈ ((e x).U ⊓ V.unop : X.Opens) := ⟨(e x).mem, x.2⟩
      have h0 := he x _ inf_le_left hmem c h1
      have h2 : wFrameSec (e x) ((e x).U ⊓ V.unop) inf_le_left c = 0 := by
        rw [h0, wFrameSec_smul, zero_smul]
      rw [← hc, h2]
      exact (map_zero _).symm
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hab'

name: KSpecialization.ARRHS.dualEval_app_wFrameSec
statement:
theorem dualEval_app_wFrameSec {y : Y} (d : WFrame (lineBundleDual Y L) y) (U : Y.Opens)
    (hU : U ≤ d.U) (c : Γ(Y, U)) :
    (dualEval σ).app U (wFrameSec d U hU c) =
      c * Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hU).op ((dualEval σ).app d.U (wFrameGen d))
proof:
:= by
  rw [wFrameSec_smul, Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul, wFrameSec_one, app_presheaf_map]
  rfl

name: KSpecialization.ARRHS.isUnit_germ_dualEval_wFrameGen
statement:
theorem isUnit_germ_dualEval_wFrameGen (hline : IsLocalLineFrame L) (hreg : SectionIsRegular σ)
    {y : Y} (d : WFrame (lineBundleDual Y L) y) {y' : Y} (hy' : y' ∈ d.U)
    (hnot : y' ∉ Set.range (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι) :
    IsUnit (Y.presheaf.germ d.U y' hy' ((dualEval σ).app d.U (wFrameGen d)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V', hV', hqV, hVd⟩ := (Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp Y.isBasis_affineOpens) hy'
  let U' : Y.affineOpens := ⟨V', hV'⟩
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.range_subschemeι] at hnot
  have hz : y' ∉ Y.zeroLocus (U := U'.1) ((sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).ideal U') := by
    rw [← Scheme.IdealSheafData.mem_support_iff_of_mem hqV]
    exact hnot
  rw [Scheme.mem_zeroLocus_iff] at hz
  push Not at hz
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfu⟩ := hz
  have hb : (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι.app U'.1 f = 0 := by
    rw [← (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).ker_subschemeι_app U'] at hf
    exact RingHom.mem_ker.mp hf
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := exists_dual_global σ hline hreg U'.1 f hb
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := d.exists_coord U'.1 hVd G
  have hf' : f = c * Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVd).op ((dualEval σ).app d.U (wFrameGen d)) := by
    rw [← dualEval_app_wFrameSec σ d U'.1 hVd c, hc]
    exact hG.symm
  have hu : IsUnit (Y.presheaf.germ U'.1 y' hqV f) := (Y.mem_basicOpen f y' hqV).1 hfu
  rw [hf', map_mul, Y.presheaf.germ_res_apply] at hu
  exact isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_right hu

name: KSpecialization.ARRHS.pullbackSection_wFrameSec
statement:
theorem pullbackSection_wFrameSec {W : Scheme.{u}} (F : W ⟶ Y) {y : Y}
    (d : WFrame (lineBundleDual Y L) y) (w : W) (hw : F w ∈ d.U)
    (V : W.Opens) (hV : V ≤ (WFrame.ofData (pullbackWFrame F d w hw)).U) (c : Γ(W, V)) :
    (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ)).app V
        (wFrameSec (WFrame.ofData (pullbackWFrame F d w hw)) V hV c) =
      c * W.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op (F.app d.U ((dualEval σ).app d.U (wFrameGen d)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [wFrameSec_smul, Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul, wFrameSec_one, app_presheaf_map,
    wFrameGen_pullbackWFrame]
  erw [pullbackSection_unit_app]
  rfl

name: KSpecialization.ARRHS.mono_pullbackSection_of_generic
statement:
theorem mono_pullbackSection_of_generic (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1) (hreg : SectionIsRegular σ)
    {W : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral W] (F : W ⟶ Y)
    (hη : F (genericPoint W) ∉ Set.range (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι) :
    Mono (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))
proof:
:= by
  have hline : IsLocalLineFrame L := isLocalLineFrame_of_hasConstantRank_one hL
  have hΛ1 : HasConstantRank Y (lineBundleDual Y L) 1 := lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank L hL
  apply mono_of_wFrames
  intro w
  let d : WFrame (lineBundleDual Y L) (F w) := (exists_wFrame hΛ1 (F w)).some
  refine ⟨WFrame.ofData (pullbackWFrame F d w d.mem), ?_⟩
  intro V hV hwV c hc
  rw [pullbackSection_wFrameSec σ F d w d.mem V hV c] at hc
  haveI : Nonempty V := ⟨⟨w, hwV⟩⟩
  have hηV : genericPoint W ∈ V :=
    (genericPoint_specializes w).mem_open V.isOpen hwV
  have hηd : F (genericPoint W) ∈ d.U := hV hηV
  have hunit := isUnit_germ_dualEval_wFrameGen σ hline hreg d hηd hη
  have hb : IsUnit (W.presheaf.germ V (genericPoint W) hηV
      (W.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op (F.app d.U ((dualEval σ).app d.U (wFrameGen d))))) := by
    rw [W.presheaf.germ_res_apply]
    have := hunit.map (F.stalkMap (genericPoint W)).hom
    rw [Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply] at this
    exact this
  haveI : IsDomain Γ(W, V) := inferInstance
  have hc' : c * W.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op
      (F.app d.U ((dualEval σ).app d.U (wFrameGen d))) = (0 : Γ(W, V)) := hc
  rcases eq_zero_or_eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero hc' with h | h
  · exact h
  · exfalso
    have h0 := congrArg (W.presheaf.germ V (genericPoint W) hηV) h
    rw [map_zero] at h0
    rw [h0] at hb
    exact not_isUnit_zero hb

name: KSpecialization.ARRHS.range_sectionEvaluation_subschemeι
statement:
theorem range_sectionEvaluation_subschemeι (hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = j.ker) :
    Set.range (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι = Set.range j
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.range_subschemeι, hid]
  rw [Scheme.Hom.support_ker]
  exact j.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range.closure_eq

name: KSpecialization.ARRHS.mono_pullbackSection_of_ker
statement:
theorem mono_pullbackSection_of_ker [L.IsQuasicoherent] [L.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (hreg : SectionIsRegular σ)
    (hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = j.ker)
    {W : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral W] (F : W ⟶ X)
    (hη : F (genericPoint W) ∉ Set.range j) :
    Mono (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))
proof:
:=
  mono_pullbackSection_of_generic σ hL hreg F (by
    rw [range_sectionEvaluation_subschemeι σ j hid]
    exact hη)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.flatPullbackK0_one'
statement: theorem flatPullbackK0_one' : flatPullbackK0 f (1 : K0 Z) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply]; exact map_one _

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.flatPullbackK0_lambdaOp
statement:
theorem flatPullbackK0_lambdaOp (n : ℕ) (x : K0 Z) :
    flatPullbackK0 f (lambdaOp Z n x) = lambdaOp X n (flatPullbackK0 f x)
proof:
:= by
  let Φ : Additive (PowerSeries (K0 Z))ˣ →+ Additive (PowerSeries (K0 X))ˣ :=
    MonoidHom.toAdditive (Units.map (PowerSeries.map (flatPullbackK0RingHom f)).toMonoidHom)
  have key : Φ.comp (lambdaT Z) = (lambdaT X).comp (flatPullbackK0 f) := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    intro E
    change Φ (lambdaT Z (k0ClassOf Z E.1 E.2)) =
      lambdaT X (flatPullbackK0 f (k0ClassOf Z E.1 E.2))
    rw [lambdaT_classOf, flatPullbackK0_classOf, lambdaT_classOf]
    change Additive.ofMul (Units.map _ (lambdaSeriesUnit Z E.1 E.2)) =
      Additive.ofMul (lambdaSeriesUnit X _ _)
    congr 1
    apply Units.ext
    simp only [Units.coe_map, coe_lambdaSeriesUnit]
    refine PowerSeries.ext fun m => ?_
    rw [RingHom.toMonoidHom_eq_coe, MonoidHom.coe_coe, PowerSeries.coeff_map, coeff_lambdaSeries,
      coeff_lambdaSeries, flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply, flatPullbackK0_lambdaClass]
  have h := DFunLike.congr_fun key x
  have h2 := congrArg (fun a : Additive (PowerSeries (K0 X))ˣ =>
    ((Additive.toMul a : (PowerSeries (K0 X))ˣ) : PowerSeries (K0 X))) h
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply] at h2
  unfold lambdaOp
  have h3 := congrArg (PowerSeries.coeff n) h2
  rw [← h3]
  change flatPullbackK0 f _ = _
  rw [← flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply]
  rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.lamMinus_eq_kosX
statement:
theorem lamMinus_eq_kosX {Y : Scheme.{u}} (W : Y.Modules) (hW : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y W) (r : ℕ) :
    ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.lamMinus Y W hW r = kosX Y (k0ClassOf Y W hW) r
proof:
:= by
  unfold ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.lamMinus kosX
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
  rw [lambdaOp_classOf]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.flatPullbackK0_kosX
statement:
theorem flatPullbackK0_kosX (x : K0 Z) (r : ℕ) :
    flatPullbackK0 f (kosX Z x r) = kosX X (flatPullbackK0 f x) r
proof:
:= by
  unfold kosX
  rw [map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
  have h1 := flatPullbackK0_one' f
  rw [← flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply, map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply,
    flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply, h1, flatPullbackK0_lambdaOp]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.k0_twist_inv
statement:
theorem k0_twist_inv {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Y] {B : Y.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover Y B)
    (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) :
    k0ClassOf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
        (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).isFiniteLocallyFree *
      k0ClassOf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1))
        (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1)).isFiniteLocallyFree = 1
proof:
:= by
  haveI := C.isNoetherian_scheme
  rw [k0ClassOf_mul_line (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1))
    (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)]
  have e1 : tensorSheaf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1)) ≅
      tensorUnitSheaf C.scheme :=
    AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.twistingTensorIso C hpos 1 (-1) ≪≫ eqToIso (by norm_num) ≪≫
      C.canonicalTwistingSheafZeroIso
  have h1 : (1 : K0 C.scheme) = k0ClassOf C.scheme (tensorUnitSheaf C.scheme)
      (hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf (Y := C.scheme)).isFiniteLocallyFree := rfl
  rw [h1]
  exact k0ClassOf_iso _ _ _ e1

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.flatPullbackK0_congr'
statement:
theorem flatPullbackK0_congr' {A B : Scheme.{u}} (a b : A ⟶ B) [Flat a] [Flat b] (h : a = b) :
    flatPullbackK0 a = flatPullbackK0 b
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.flatPullbackK0_twistNeg
statement:
theorem flatPullbackK0_twistNeg (hposC : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    (hposD : ∀ i, Nonempty ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).basisIndex i))
    [Flat (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g)] :
    flatPullbackK0 (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g)
        (k0ClassOf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1))
          (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1)).isFiniteLocallyFree) =
      k0ClassOf (C.pullbackFrameCover g).scheme
        ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1))
        ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1)).isFiniteLocallyFree
proof:
:= by
  haveI := C.isNoetherian_scheme
  haveI := (C.pullbackFrameCover g).isNoetherian_scheme
  have hP1 : flatPullbackK0 (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g)
      (k0ClassOf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
        (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).isFiniteLocallyFree) =
      k0ClassOf (C.pullbackFrameCover g).scheme ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
        ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).isFiniteLocallyFree := by
    rw [flatPullbackK0_classOf]
    exact (k0ClassOf_iso _ _ _ (C.pullbackCanonicalTwistingSheafOneIso g)).symm
  have h1 := k0_twist_inv C hposC
  have h2 := k0_twist_inv (C.pullbackFrameCover g) hposD
  set a := flatPullbackK0 (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g)
    (k0ClassOf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1))
      (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1)).isFiniteLocallyFree) with ha
  set p1 := k0ClassOf (C.pullbackFrameCover g).scheme ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).isFiniteLocallyFree
  set m1 := k0ClassOf (C.pullbackFrameCover g).scheme
    ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1))
    ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1)).isFiniteLocallyFree
  have h3 : a * p1 = 1 := by
    rw [← hP1, ha, ← flatPullbackK0_mul, mul_comm, h1, flatPullbackK0_one']
  calc a = a * 1 := (mul_one a).symm
    _ = a * (p1 * m1) := by rw [h2]
    _ = (a * p1) * m1 := (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = m1 := by rw [h3, one_mul]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.flatPullbackK0_pull_pull
statement:
theorem flatPullbackK0_pull_pull (E : Y.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y E)
    [Flat C.toBase] [Flat (C.pullbackFrameCover g).toBase] [Flat (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g)] :
    flatPullbackK0 (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g)
        (k0ClassOf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj E)
          (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global C.toBase E hE)) =
      k0ClassOf (C.pullbackFrameCover g).scheme
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (C.pullbackFrameCover g).toBase).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E))
        (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global _ _ (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global g E hE))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← flatPullbackK0_classOf C.toBase E hE]
  have e1 := DFunLike.congr_fun (flatPullbackK0_comp (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) C.toBase)
    (k0ClassOf Y E hE)
  have e2 := DFunLike.congr_fun (flatPullbackK0_comp (C.pullbackFrameCover g).toBase g)
    (k0ClassOf Y E hE)
  have e3 := DFunLike.congr_fun (flatPullbackK0_congr' (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g ≫ C.toBase)
    ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).toBase ≫ g) (C.pullbackProjectiveMap_toBase g)) (k0ClassOf Y E hE)
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply] at e1 e2
  rw [e1, e3, ← e2, flatPullbackK0_classOf, flatPullbackK0_classOf]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.flatPullbackK0_kosClassX
statement:
theorem flatPullbackK0_kosClassX [Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k (CX.pullbackFrameCover S.q).scheme)] :
    letI
proof:
:= AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.pullbackProjectiveMap_flat CX S.q
    flatPullbackK0 (CX.pullbackProjectiveMap S.q) (kosClassX CX hE) =
      lamProd S (CX.pullbackFrameCover S.q) (e + 1) := by
  letI := AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.pullbackProjectiveMap_flat CX S.q
  have hposC : ∀ i, Nonempty (CX.basisIndex i) := fun i =>
    CX.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hCX (Nat.succ_pos (e + 1)) i
  have hCF := CX.pullbackFrameCover_card S.q hCX
  have hposD : ∀ i, Nonempty ((CX.pullbackFrameCover S.q).basisIndex i) := fun i =>
    (CX.pullbackFrameCover S.q).nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hCF (Nat.succ_pos (e + 1)) i
  haveI := CX.toBase_flat (CX.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hCX (Nat.succ_pos (e + 1)))
  haveI := (CX.pullbackFrameCover S.q).toBase_flat
    ((CX.pullbackFrameCover S.q).nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hCF (Nat.succ_pos (e + 1)))
  unfold kosClassX
  rw [flatPullbackK0_kosX, flatPullbackK0_mul,
    flatPullbackK0_pull_pull CX S.q E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree,
    flatPullbackK0_twistNeg CX S.q hposC hposD]
  have hcl := ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.k0ClassOf_twistBy
    (twistNegG S (CX.pullbackFrameCover S.q)) (hasConstantRank_twistNegG S (CX.pullbackFrameCover S.q))
    (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global _ _ (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global S.q E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree))
    (isFiniteLocallyFree_twistedG S (CX.pullbackFrameCover S.q) hCF hE)
  rw [← hcl, ← lamMinus_eq_kosX, koszul_coverG S (CX.pullbackFrameCover S.q) hCF hE]
  simp only [lamProd, pullClassesG, Multiset.map_map, Finset.prod_eq_multiset_prod]
  rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.pull_zxOp
statement:
theorem pull_zxOp (w : K0 CX.scheme) (m : ℕ) :
    letI
proof:
:= AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.pullbackProjectiveMap_flat CX q
    totalPullOn (opsV4 k) q d hd ∘ₗ
        zxOp k (hPk k) (GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.chExact_projectiveIntegral (k := k)) CX hC w m =
      zxOp k (hPk k) (GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.chExact_projectiveIntegral (k := k))
          (CX.pullbackFrameCover q) (CX.pullbackFrameCover_card q hC)
          (flatPullbackK0 (CX.pullbackProjectiveMap q) w) m ∘ₗ totalPullOn (opsV4 k) q d hd := by
  letI := pullbackProjectiveMap_isOver (k := k) CX q
  letI := AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.pullbackProjectiveMap_flat CX q
  letI := CX.toBase_flat (CX.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos r))
  let D := CX.pullbackFrameCover q
  let hD := CX.pullbackFrameCover_card q hC
  letI := D.toBase_flat (D.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hD (Nat.succ_pos r))
  let PG := totalPullOn (opsV4 k) q d hd
  let hdF := CX.pullbackProjectiveMap_pureRelDim k q d hd
  let PF := totalPullOn (opsV4 k) (CX.pullbackProjectiveMap q) d hdF
  let PC := totalPullOn (opsV4 k) CX.toBase r ((cpV4 k).projBundle_relDim CX hC)
  let PD := totalPullOn (opsV4 k) D.toBase r ((cpV4 k).projBundle_relDim D hD)
  have hb : PG ∘ₗ totalPushOn (opsV4 k) CX.toBase = totalPushOn (opsV4 k) D.toBase ∘ₗ PF :=
    (cpV4 k).base_change CX.toBase q D.toBase (CX.pullbackProjectiveMap q) d hd hdF
      (CX.isPullback_pullbackProjectiveMap q)
  have hc : PF ∘ₗ PC = PD ∘ₗ PG := projection_totalPullOn_flat CX q (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) d hd hC
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro v
  unfold zxOp
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  have hb' : ∀ z, PG (totalPushOn (opsV4 k) CX.toBase z) =
      totalPushOn (opsV4 k) D.toBase (PF z) := fun z => LinearMap.congr_fun hb z
  have hc' : PF (PC v) = PD (PG v) := LinearMap.congr_fun hc v
  have hl : PF (lowPart (M := fun n => RationalDimChow CX.scheme n) (r + m)
      (chK0 k (hPk k) (GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.chExact_projectiveIntegral (k := k)) w) (PC v)) =
      lowPart (M := fun n => RationalDimChow D.scheme n) (r + m)
        (chK0 k (hPk k) (GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.chExact_projectiveIntegral (k := k))
          (flatPullbackK0 (CX.pullbackProjectiveMap q) w)) (PF (PC v)) :=
    lowPart_pull_flat (CX.pullbackProjectiveMap q) hdF w (r + m) (PC v)
  rw [hb', hl, hc']

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.seg_unique
statement:
theorem seg_unique (u : M →ₗ[ℚ] N) (ε s : ℕ → Module.End ℚ M) (ε' s' : ℕ → Module.End ℚ N)
    (hε : ∀ a, u ∘ₗ ε a = ε' a ∘ₗ u)
    (h1 : ∀ m, ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ε a * s (m - a) = if m = 0 then 1 else 0)
    (h1' : ∀ m, ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ε' a * s' (m - a) = if m = 0 then 1 else 0)
    (hs0 : s 0 = 1) (hs0' : s' 0 = 1) :
    ∀ j, u ∘ₗ s j = s' j ∘ₗ u
proof:
:= by
  have hε0 : ε 0 = 1 := by
    have := h1 0
    simpa [hs0] using this
  have hε0' : ε' 0 = 1 := by
    have := h1' 0
    simpa [hs0'] using this
  intro j
  induction j using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ j ih =>
    have e1 := h1 j
    have e2 := h1' j
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ', hε0, one_mul, Nat.sub_zero] at e1
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ', hε0', one_mul, Nat.sub_zero] at e2
    have hs : s j = (if j = 0 then 1 else 0) -
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range j, ε (k + 1) * s (j - (k + 1)) := eq_sub_of_add_eq' e1
    have hs' : s' j = (if j = 0 then 1 else 0) -
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range j, ε' (k + 1) * s' (j - (k + 1)) := eq_sub_of_add_eq' e2
    have hT : u ∘ₗ (∑ k ∈ Finset.range j, ε (k + 1) * s (j - (k + 1))) =
        (∑ k ∈ Finset.range j, ε' (k + 1) * s' (j - (k + 1))) ∘ₗ u := by
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro v
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply, map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => ?_
      have hk' := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
      exact LinearMap.congr_fun (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.push_intertwines_mul' u (hε (k + 1))
        (ih (j - (k + 1)) (by omega))) v
    have hδ : u ∘ₗ (if j = 0 then (1 : Module.End ℚ M) else 0) =
        (if j = 0 then (1 : Module.End ℚ N) else 0) ∘ₗ u := by
      split_ifs
      · rfl
      · simp
    rw [hs, hs', LinearMap.comp_sub, LinearMap.sub_comp, hT, hδ]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.map_specPreimage
statement:
theorem map_specPreimage {A R : CommRingCat.{u}} (g : Spec A ⟶ Spec R) :
    Spec.map (specPreimage g) = g
proof:
:= by
  unfold specPreimage
  exact Scheme.Spec.map_preimage g

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.kappa_spec
statement:
theorem kappa_spec (U : B.affineOpens) :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (kappa π U)) =
      (GlobalBlowup.isAffineOpen B U).isoSpec.inv ≫ U.1.ι ≫ π
proof:
:=
  map_specPreimage _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.kappa_res
statement:
theorem kappa_res {U V : B.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    (GlobalBlowup.res B h).comp (kappa π V) = kappa π U
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ((GlobalBlowup.res B h).comp (kappa π V))) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (kappa π U)) := by
    rw [kappa_spec, show CommRingCat.ofHom ((GlobalBlowup.res B h).comp (kappa π V)) =
        CommRingCat.ofHom (kappa π V) ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom (GlobalBlowup.res B h) from rfl,
      Spec.map_comp, kappa_spec, ← Category.assoc, GlobalBlowup.specMap_res_comp_isoSpec_inv B h]
    simp
  have := Spec.map_injective h1
  exact congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.chartT_fst
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem chartT_fst (U : B.affineOpens) :
    chartT π (r := r) U ≫ pullback.fst _ _ =
      toSpec Γ(B, U.1) r ≫ (GlobalBlowup.isAffineOpen B U).isoSpec.inv ≫ U.1.ι
proof:
:=
  pullback.lift_fst _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.chartT_snd
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem chartT_snd (U : B.affineOpens) :
    chartT π (r := r) U ≫ pullback.snd _ _ = SchemeProjectiveSpace.map (kappa π U) r
proof:
:=
  pullback.lift_snd _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.chartMap_fst
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem chartMap_fst (U : B.affineOpens) (s : Fin (r + 1) → Γ(B, U.1))
    (hs : I.ideal U = Ideal.span (Set.range s)) :
    chartMap π I U s hs ≫ pullback.fst _ _ = GlobalBlowup.gluingApp B I U ≫ U.1.ι
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartMap, Category.assoc, chartT_fst, ← Category.assoc, chartRho_toSpec,
    GlobalBlowup.gluingApp_eq]
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.chartMap_snd
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem chartMap_snd (U : B.affineOpens) (s : Fin (r + 1) → Γ(B, U.1))
    (hs : I.ideal U = Ideal.span (Set.range s)) :
    chartMap π I U s hs ≫ pullback.snd _ _ = chartPsi (I.ideal U) s hs (kappa π U)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartMap, Category.assoc, chartT_snd, chartPsi]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.ideal_eq_span_res
statement:
theorem ideal_eq_span_res {W U : B.affineOpens} (hWU : W ≤ U) (s : Fin (r + 1) → Γ(B, U.1))
    (hs : I.ideal U = Ideal.span (Set.range s)) :
    I.ideal W = Ideal.span (Set.range fun j ↦ GlobalBlowup.res B hWU (s j))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← I.map_ideal hWU, hs, Ideal.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.gluingApp_natural
statement:
theorem gluingApp_natural {W U : B.affineOpens} (hWU : W ≤ U) :
    ReesBlowupOfEq.schemeMapOfEq (I.ideal U) (GlobalBlowup.res B hWU) (I.ideal W)
        (I.map_ideal hWU) ≫ GlobalBlowup.gluingApp B I U =
      GlobalBlowup.gluingApp B I W ≫ B.homOfLE (hWU : W.1 ≤ U.1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [GlobalBlowup.gluingApp_eq, GlobalBlowup.gluingApp_eq, ← Category.assoc,
    ReesBlowupOfEq.schemeMapOfEq_comp_projection, Category.assoc, Category.assoc,
    GlobalBlowup.specMap_res_comp_isoSpec_inv B hWU]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.chartMap_natural
statement:
theorem chartMap_natural {W U : B.affineOpens} (hWU : W ≤ U) (s : Fin (r + 1) → Γ(B, U.1))
    (hs : I.ideal U = Ideal.span (Set.range s)) :
    ReesBlowupOfEq.schemeMapOfEq (I.ideal U) (GlobalBlowup.res B hWU) (I.ideal W)
        (I.map_ideal hWU) ≫ chartMap π I U s hs =
      chartMap π I W (fun j ↦ GlobalBlowup.res B hWU (s j)) (ideal_eq_span_res I hWU s hs)
proof:
:= by
  apply pullback.hom_ext
  · rw [Category.assoc, chartMap_fst, chartMap_fst]
    calc ReesBlowupOfEq.schemeMapOfEq (I.ideal U) (GlobalBlowup.res B hWU) (I.ideal W)
          (I.map_ideal hWU) ≫ GlobalBlowup.gluingApp B I U ≫ U.1.ι
        = (ReesBlowupOfEq.schemeMapOfEq (I.ideal U) (GlobalBlowup.res B hWU) (I.ideal W)
          (I.map_ideal hWU) ≫ GlobalBlowup.gluingApp B I U) ≫ U.1.ι := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = (GlobalBlowup.gluingApp B I W ≫ B.homOfLE (hWU : W.1 ≤ U.1)) ≫ U.1.ι := by
          rw [gluingApp_natural I hWU]
      _ = GlobalBlowup.gluingApp B I W ≫ B.homOfLE (hWU : W.1 ≤ U.1) ≫ U.1.ι :=
          Category.assoc _ _ _
      _ = GlobalBlowup.gluingApp B I W ≫ W.1.ι := by rw [Scheme.homOfLE_ι]
  · rw [Category.assoc, chartMap_snd, chartMap_snd]
    exact chartPsi_schemeMapOfEq (I.ideal U) s hs (GlobalBlowup.res B hWU) (kappa π U)
      (kappa π W) (kappa_res π hWU) (I.ideal W) _ (I.map_ideal hWU)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.chartMap_unit
statement:
theorem chartMap_unit (U : B.affineOpens) (s s' : Fin (r + 1) → Γ(B, U.1))
    (hs : I.ideal U = Ideal.span (Set.range s)) (hs' : I.ideal U = Ideal.span (Set.range s'))
    (u : Γ(B, U.1)ˣ) (h : ∀ j, s' j = (u : Γ(B, U.1)) * s j) :
    chartMap π I U s' hs' = chartMap π I U s hs
proof:
:= by
  apply pullback.hom_ext
  · rw [chartMap_fst, chartMap_fst]
  · rw [chartMap_snd, chartMap_snd]
    exact chartPsi_unit (I.ideal U) s hs u s' h hs' (kappa π U)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.mem_range_affineι_iff
statement:
theorem mem_range_affineι_iff (U : B.affineOpens) (x : GlobalBlowup.blowup B I) :
    x ∈ Set.range (GlobalBlowup.affineι B I U) ↔ GlobalBlowup.toBase B I x ∈ U.1
proof:
:= by
  have h := (GlobalBlowup.gluingData B I).preimage_toBase_eq_range_ι U
  refine (Set.ext_iff.mp h x).symm.trans ?_
  change GlobalBlowup.toBase B I x ∈ Set.range (U.1.ι) ↔ _
  rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
  exact Iff.rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.schemeMapOfEq_comp_affineι
statement:
theorem schemeMapOfEq_comp_affineι {W U : B.affineOpens} (h : W ≤ U) :
    ReesBlowupOfEq.schemeMapOfEq (I.ideal U) (GlobalBlowup.res B h) (I.ideal W)
        (I.map_ideal h) ≫ GlobalBlowup.affineι B I U = GlobalBlowup.affineι B I W
proof:
:=
  colimit.w (GlobalBlowup.gluingData B I).functor (homOfLE h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.GenData.gMap_covers
statement:
theorem GenData.gMap_covers (a b : D.ι) (p : D.overlap a b) :
    ∃ (W : {W : B.affineOpens // W ≤ D.V a ∧ W ≤ D.V b})
      (y : ReesBlowup.scheme (I.ideal W.1)), D.gMap a b W.1 W.2.1 W.2.2 y = p
proof:
:= by
  set x : GlobalBlowup.blowup B I := D.overlapι a b p with hx
  have hxa : x ∈ Set.range (GlobalBlowup.affineι B I (D.V a)) :=
    ⟨(pullback.fst _ _ : D.overlap a b ⟶ _) p, rfl⟩
  have hxb : x ∈ Set.range (GlobalBlowup.affineι B I (D.V b)) :=
    ⟨(pullback.snd _ _ : D.overlap a b ⟶ _) p, by
      rw [hx, GenData.overlapι, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply,
        ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, pullback.condition]⟩
  have hb0 : GlobalBlowup.toBase B I x ∈ (D.V a).1 ⊓ (D.V b).1 :=
    ⟨(mem_range_affineι_iff I _ x).mp hxa, (mem_range_affineι_iff I _ x).mp hxb⟩
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨V, hV, rfl⟩, hxV, hVU⟩ :=
    B.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open hb0 ((D.V a).1 ⊓ (D.V b).1).2
  let W : B.affineOpens := ⟨V, hV⟩
  have hWa : W ≤ D.V a := fun y hy ↦ (hVU hy).1
  have hWb : W ≤ D.V b := fun y hy ↦ (hVU hy).2
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (mem_range_affineι_iff I W x).mpr hxV
  refine ⟨⟨W, hWa, hWb⟩, y, ?_⟩
  apply (D.overlapι a b).isOpenEmbedding.injective
  have h1 : D.overlapι a b (D.gMap a b W hWa hWb y) = GlobalBlowup.affineι B I W y := by
    rw [GenData.overlapι, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply (D.gMap a b W hWa hWb),
      GenData.gMap, pullback.lift_fst, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, schemeMapOfEq_comp_affineι]
  rw [h1, hy]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.GenData.agree
statement:
theorem GenData.agree (a b : D.ι) :
    pullback.fst (GlobalBlowup.affineι B I (D.V a)) (GlobalBlowup.affineι B I (D.V b)) ≫
        chartMap π I (D.V a) (D.s a) (D.span_eq a) =
      pullback.snd (GlobalBlowup.affineι B I (D.V a)) (GlobalBlowup.affineι B I (D.V b)) ≫
        chartMap π I (D.V b) (D.s b) (D.span_eq b)
proof:
:= by
  apply (D.overlapCover a b).hom_ext
  intro W
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := D.compat a b W.1 W.2.1 W.2.2
  change D.gMap a b W.1 W.2.1 W.2.2 ≫ _ = D.gMap a b W.1 W.2.1 W.2.2 ≫ _
  have e1 : D.gMap a b W.1 W.2.1 W.2.2 ≫ pullback.fst _ _ =
      ReesBlowupOfEq.schemeMapOfEq (I.ideal (D.V a)) (GlobalBlowup.res B W.2.1) (I.ideal W.1)
        (I.map_ideal W.2.1) := pullback.lift_fst _ _ _
  have e2 : D.gMap a b W.1 W.2.1 W.2.2 ≫ pullback.snd _ _ =
      ReesBlowupOfEq.schemeMapOfEq (I.ideal (D.V b)) (GlobalBlowup.res B W.2.2) (I.ideal W.1)
        (I.map_ideal W.2.2) := pullback.lift_snd _ _ _
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, e1, e2, chartMap_natural π I W.2.1 (D.s a) (D.span_eq a),
    chartMap_natural π I W.2.2 (D.s b) (D.span_eq b)]
  exact (chartMap_unit π I W.1 _ _ (ideal_eq_span_res I W.2.1 (D.s a) (D.span_eq a))
    (ideal_eq_span_res I W.2.2 (D.s b) (D.span_eq b)) u hu).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.GenData.affineι_phi
statement:
theorem GenData.affineι_phi (a : D.ι) :
    GlobalBlowup.affineι B I (D.V a) ≫ D.phi π =
      chartMap π I (D.V a) (D.s a) (D.span_eq a)
proof:
:=
  D.blowupCover.ι_glueMorphisms _ _ a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.GenData.phi_fst
statement: theorem GenData.phi_fst : D.phi π ≫ pullback.fst _ _ = GlobalBlowup.toBase B I
proof:
:= by
  apply D.blowupCover.hom_ext
  intro a
  change GlobalBlowup.affineι B I (D.V a) ≫ D.phi π ≫ _ = GlobalBlowup.affineι B I (D.V a) ≫ _
  rw [← Category.assoc, D.affineι_phi, chartMap_fst]
  exact (GlobalBlowup.isPullback_affine B I (D.V a)).w

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.isPullback_chartT
statement:
theorem isPullback_chartT (U : B.affineOpens) :
    IsPullback (toSpec Γ(B, U.1) r) (chartT π (r := r) U)
      ((GlobalBlowup.isAffineOpen B U).isoSpec.inv ≫ U.1.ι) (pullback.fst π (toSpec k r))
proof:
:= by
  have hs := (isPullback_map_toSpec (kappa π U) r).flip
  have ht : IsPullback (pullback.fst π (toSpec k r)) (pullback.snd π (toSpec k r)) π
      (toSpec k r) := IsPullback.of_hasPullback _ _
  refine IsPullback.of_bot (h₃₁ := toSpec k r) (v₂₁ := pullback.snd π (toSpec k r))
    (v₂₂ := π) ?_ ?_ ht
  · rw [chartT_snd, Category.assoc, ← kappa_spec]
    exact hs
  · rw [chartT_fst]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.GenData.isPullback_chartRho
statement:
theorem GenData.isPullback_chartRho (a : D.ι) :
    IsPullback (chartRho (I.ideal (D.V a)) (D.s a) (D.span_eq a))
      (GlobalBlowup.affineι B I (D.V a)) (chartT π (r := r) (D.V a)) (D.phi π)
proof:
:= by
  have hL := isPullback_chartT π (r := r) (D.V a)
  have hP : IsPullback (ReesBlowup.projection (I.ideal (D.V a)))
      (GlobalBlowup.affineι B I (D.V a))
      ((GlobalBlowup.isAffineOpen B (D.V a)).isoSpec.inv ≫ (D.V a).1.ι)
      (GlobalBlowup.toBase B I) := by
    refine (GlobalBlowup.isPullback_affine B I (D.V a)).of_iso (Iso.refl _)
      (GlobalBlowup.isAffineOpen B (D.V a)).isoSpec (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · simp
    · simp
    · simp
    · simp
  refine IsPullback.of_right (h₁₂ := toSpec _ r) (h₂₂ := pullback.fst π (toSpec k r)) ?_ ?_ hL
  · rw [chartRho_toSpec, D.phi_fst]
    exact hP
  · rw [D.affineι_phi]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.GenData.isClosedImmersion_phi
statement: theorem GenData.isClosedImmersion_phi : IsClosedImmersion (D.phi π)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.of_openCover (𝒰 := D.targetCover π)
  intro a
  have hsq := D.isPullback_chartRho π a
  change IsClosedImmersion (pullback.snd (D.phi π) (chartT π (D.V a)))
  rw [← MorphismProperty.cancel_left_of_respectsIso @IsClosedImmersion
      hsq.flip.isoPullback.hom, hsq.flip.isoPullback_hom_snd]
  exact isClosedImmersion_chartRho _ _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.isGG_of_finite
statement:
theorem isGG_of_finite {Y : Scheme.{u}} {E V : Y.Modules} (J : Type u) [Finite J]
    (e : V ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J) (g : V ⟶ E) [Epi g] : IsGG E
proof:
:= by
  let f : J ≃ ULift.{u} (Fin (Nat.card J)) := (Finite.equivFin J).trans Equiv.ulift.symm
  exact ⟨Nat.card J, V, ⟨e ≪≫ (SheafOfModules.freeFunctor (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)).mapIso
    f.toIso⟩, g, inferInstance⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.pos_of_isGG_rank
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hN
  have hN0 : N = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hN
  subst hN0
  have h1 : IsZero (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin 0))) := by
    have := isZero_exteriorPowerSheaf_free Y (ULift.{u} (Fin 0)) 1 (by simp)
    exact IsZero.of_iso this (exteriorPowerSheafOneIso Y _).symm
  have hV : IsZero V := IsZero.of_iso h1 e
  have hE0 : IsZero E := (IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero E).2 ((cancel_epi g).1 (hV.eq_of_src _ _))
  have hc : k0ClassOf Y E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree = 0 :=
    ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_isZero Y.Modules (IsFiniteLocallyFree Y)
      hE.isFiniteLocallyFree hE0
  obtain ⟨y⟩ := ‹Nonempty Y›
  have := rankAtRingHom_classOf y E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree
  rw [hc, map_zero, rankAt_of_hasConstantRank hE] at this
  omega

name: SchemeKTheory.sub_path
proof:
:= by
  refine (sub_eq_add_neg a b).trans ?_
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (@sub_eq_add_neg (K0 Y) (instCommRingK0 Y).toAddGroupWithOne.toAddGroup.toSubNegMonoid a b).symm
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.nil_iff
statement:
theorem nil_iff {Y : Scheme.{u}} (a b : K0 Y) : IsNilpotent (a - b : K0 Y) ↔
    IsNilpotent (@HSub.hSub (K0 Y) (K0 Y) (K0 Y) (@instHSub (K0 Y) (@SubNegMonoid.toSub (K0 Y)
      (@AddGroup.toSubNegMonoid (K0 Y) (instCommRingK0 Y).toAddGroupWithOne.toAddGroup))) a b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_path]

name: SchemeKTheory.aux_nil_add
statement:
theorem aux_nil_add {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (k m F : R) (r : ℕ) (hF : F = k + m)
    (h1 : IsNilpotent (k - (r : R))) (h2 : IsNilpotent (m - 1)) :
    IsNilpotent (F - ((r + 1 : ℕ) : R))
proof:
:= by
  have : F - ((r + 1 : ℕ) : R) = (k - (r : R)) + (m - 1) := by
    rw [hF]; push_cast; ring
  rw [this]
  exact isNilpotent_add' h1 h2

name: SchemeKTheory.isNilpotent_sub_rank_of_isGG
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_sub_rank_of_isGG : ∀ (r : ℕ) {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Y] [Nonempty Y]
    {E : Y.Modules} (hE : HasConstantRank Y E r), IsGG E →
      IsNilpotent (k0ClassOf Y E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree - (r : K0 Y))
  | 0, Y, _, _, E, hE, _ => by
    have h1
proof:
:= lambdaClass_eq_zero_of_rank_lt Y E 0 hE 1 (by omega)
    rw [lambdaClass_one] at h1
    rw [h1]
    simp
  | r + 1, Y, _, _, E, hE, ⟨N, V, ⟨e⟩, g, hg⟩ => by
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := SchemeProjectiveBundle.exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hE
    have hpos := C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos r)
    haveI : Flat C.toBase := C.toBase_flat hpos
    haveI : IsNoetherian C.scheme := C.isNoetherian_scheme
    haveI : Nonempty C.scheme := by
      obtain ⟨y⟩ := ‹Nonempty Y›
      obtain ⟨z, _⟩ := C.toBase_surjective hpos y
      exact ⟨z⟩
    have hNpos : 0 < N := pos_of_isGG_rank hE e g
    have hP : (Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).PreservesEpimorphisms :=
      Functor.preservesEpimorphisms_of_adjunction (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction _)
    have hρ : Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).map g) :=
      Functor.map_epi (Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase) g
    let e' : (Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj V ≅
        SheafOfModules.free (R := C.scheme.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin N)) :=
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).mapIso e ≪≫ pullbackFreeIso C.toBase _
    have hM := C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1
    have hK := C.hasConstantRank_tautologicalKernel hE
    
    have hu : IsNilpotent (k0ClassOf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) hM.isFiniteLocallyFree
        - 1) := by
      have hepi : Epi (e.inv ≫ g) := epi_comp' inferInstance hg
      exact @SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.isNilpotent_tautologicalK0Class_sub_one_of_epi_free
        _ _ C (ULift.{u} (Fin N)) _ (by simpa using hNpos) (e.inv ≫ g) hepi
    
    obtain ⟨J', hJ', V', e'', φ, hφ⟩ := exists_epi_free_tensor_kernel (J := ULift.{u} (Fin N)) hM e'
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).map g) C.tautologicalQuotient
    have hgg : IsGG (tensorSheaf C.scheme C.tautologicalKernel (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)) :=
      @isGG_of_finite _ _ _ J' hJ' e'' φ hφ
    have hKM : HasConstantRank C.scheme
        (tensorSheaf C.scheme C.tautologicalKernel (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)) r := by
      simpa using hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hK hM
    have ih := isNilpotent_sub_rank_of_isGG r hKM hgg
    have hmul : k0ClassOf C.scheme C.tautologicalKernel hK.isFiniteLocallyFree *
        k0ClassOf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) hM.isFiniteLocallyFree =
        k0ClassOf C.scheme (tensorSheaf C.scheme C.tautologicalKernel (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))
          hKM.isFiniteLocallyFree :=
      k0ClassOf_mul C.scheme ⟨_, hK.isFiniteLocallyFree⟩ ⟨_, hM.isFiniteLocallyFree⟩
    rw [← hmul] at ih
    have hKnil : IsNilpotent (k0ClassOf C.scheme C.tautologicalKernel hK.isFiniteLocallyFree -
        (r : K0 C.scheme)) := by
      have := isNilpotent_sub_of_mul (R := K0 C.scheme)
        (e := k0ClassOf C.scheme C.tautologicalKernel hK.isFiniteLocallyFree)
        (l := k0ClassOf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) hM.isFiniteLocallyFree)
        (r := (r : K0 C.scheme)) ((nil_iff _ _).1 ih) ((nil_iff _ _).1 hu)
      exact (nil_iff _ _).2 this
    
    have hF := hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase E (r + 1) hE
    have hmid := lambdaClass_succ_of_shortExact_rankOne C.scheme hK.isFiniteLocallyFree
      hF.isFiniteLocallyFree hM C.tautologicalKernelι C.tautologicalQuotient
      C.tautologicalKernelι_comp C.tautologicalKernel_shortExact 0
    rw [zero_add, lambdaClass_one, lambdaClass_one, lambdaClass_zero, one_mul] at hmid
    have hnilF : IsNilpotent (k0ClassOf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj E)
        hF.isFiniteLocallyFree - ((r + 1 : ℕ) : K0 C.scheme)) := by
      have := aux_nil_add (R := K0 C.scheme) _ _ _ r hmid ((nil_iff _ _).1 hKnil)
        ((nil_iff _ _).1 hu)
      exact (nil_iff _ _).2 this
    
    let p := C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos
    have hinj : Function.Injective p := SchemeProjectiveBundle.pbInjectiveHyp Y E C hpos (Nat.succ_pos r) hE
    have hp : p (k0ClassOf Y E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree - ((r + 1 : ℕ) : K0 Y)) =
        k0ClassOf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj E) hF.isFiniteLocallyFree -
          ((r + 1 : ℕ) : K0 C.scheme) := by
      rw [map_sub, map_natCast]
      congr 1
      exact (flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply C.toBase _).trans
        (flatPullbackK0_classOf C.toBase E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree)
    rw [← hp] at hnilF
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hnilF
    refine ⟨k, hinj ?_⟩
    rw [map_pow, hk, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F22.exists_generator
statement:
theorem exists_generator (A₀ : AlgebraicCycle U ℤ) (hA₀ : A₀ ∈ dimensionCycles U 0)
    (hmult : ∀ A ∈ dimensionCycles U 0, ∃ c : ℤ, A = c • A₀) :
    ∀ e : ℕ, ∃ G ∈ genSet B e 0, ∀ C ∈ genSet B e 0, ∃ c : ℤ, C = c • G
proof:
:= by
  intro e
  induction e with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨flatPullback (B.π 0) A₀, AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨A₀, hA₀, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    intro C hC
    have hle : genSet B 0 0 ≤ AddSubgroup.zmultiples (flatPullback (B.π 0) A₀) := by
      rw [genSet, AddSubgroup.closure_le]
      rintro _ ⟨A, hA, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hmult A hA
      exact AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples_iff.mpr
        ⟨c, (map_zsmul (flatPullbackHom (B.π 0)) c A₀).symm⟩
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples_iff.mp (hle hC)
    exact ⟨c, hc.symm⟩
  | succ e ih =>
    obtain ⟨G, hG, hGm⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨properPushforward (B.ι e) G,
      AddSubgroup.subset_closure (Or.inl ⟨G, hG, rfl⟩), ?_⟩
    intro C hC
    have hle : genSet B (e + 1) 0 ≤
        AddSubgroup.zmultiples (properPushforward (B.ι e) G) := by
      rw [genSet, AddSubgroup.closure_le]
      rintro C' (⟨C0, hC0, rfl⟩ | ⟨A, hA, hle, rfl⟩)
      · obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hGm C0 hC0
        exact AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples_iff.mpr
          ⟨c, (map_zsmul (properPushforwardHom (B.ι e)) c G).symm⟩
      · exact absurd hle (by omega)
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples_iff.mp (hle hC)
    exact ⟨c, hc.symm⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F22.generation_dimZero
statement:
theorem generation_dimZero (A₀ : AlgebraicCycle U ℤ) (hA₀ : A₀ ∈ dimensionCycles U 0)
    (hmult : ∀ A ∈ dimensionCycles U 0, ∃ c : ℤ, A = c • A₀) (e : ℕ) :
    ∃ G ∈ dimensionCycles (B.P e) 0, ∀ D ∈ dimensionCycles (B.P e) 0,
      ∃ (N : ℕ) (c : ℤ), N ≠ 0 ∧ (N : ℤ) • D - c • G ∈ relC (B.P e) 0
proof:
:= by
  letI := bundleOver B K
  obtain ⟨G, hG, hGm⟩ := exists_generator B A₀ hA₀ hmult e
  refine ⟨G, genSet_le_dim B K e 0 hG, fun D hD ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨N, hN, C, hC, hr⟩ := generation B K e 0 D hD
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hGm C hC
  exact ⟨N, c, hN, hr⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F22.isClosed_pt0
statement: theorem isClosed_pt0 : IsClosed ({pt0 k} : Set (Spk k))
proof:
:= by
  have : ({pt0 k} : Set (Spk k)) = Set.univ :=
    Set.eq_univ_of_forall fun x ↦ Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [this]; exact isClosed_univ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F22.height_pt0
statement: theorem height_pt0 : height (pt0 k) = 0
proof: := height_eq_zero_of_isClosed (isClosed_pt0 k)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F22.baseCycle_mult
statement:
theorem baseCycle_mult (A : AlgebraicCycle (Spk k) ℤ) :
    A = (A (pt0 k)) • (baseCycle k).1
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  have hx : x = pt0 k := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  subst hx
  simp [baseCycle, dimPrimeCycle]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F22.generator_pj
statement:
theorem generator_pj (e : ℕ) :
    ∃ G ∈ dimensionCycles (Pj (Spk k) e) 0, ∀ D ∈ dimensionCycles (Pj (Spk k) e) 0,
      ∃ (N : ℕ) (c : ℤ), N ≠ 0 ∧ (N : ℤ) • D - c • G ∈ relC (Pj (Spk k) e) 0
proof:
:= by
  letI := isTower_trivialProjective k (Spk k)
  exact generation_dimZero (trivialProjective (Spk k)) k (baseCycle k).1 (baseCycle k).2
    (fun A _ ↦ ⟨A (pt0 k), baseCycle_mult k A⟩) e

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F22.rationalDimChow_span
statement:
theorem rationalDimChow_span (G : dimensionCycles X 0)
    (h : ∀ D ∈ dimensionCycles X 0,
      ∃ (N : ℕ) (c : ℤ), N ≠ 0 ∧ (N : ℤ) • D - c • G.1 ∈ relC X 0)
    (x : RationalDimChow X 0) :
    ∃ q : ℚ, x = q • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk G : DimChow X 0))
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ D : dimensionCycles X 0, ∃ q : ℚ,
      ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X 0)) =
        q • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk G : DimChow X 0)) := by
    intro D
    obtain ⟨N, c, hN, hr⟩ := h D.1 D.2
    obtain ⟨hmem, hrel⟩ := mem_relC.mp hr
    have h0 : (QuotientAddGroup.mk (⟨_, hmem⟩ : dimensionCycles X 0) : DimChow X 0) = 0 :=
      (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff _).mpr hrel
    have hsub : (⟨_, hmem⟩ : dimensionCycles X 0) = (N : ℤ) • D - c • G := rfl
    rw [hsub] at h0
    simp only [QuotientAddGroup.mk_sub, QuotientAddGroup.mk_zsmul, sub_eq_zero] at h0
    have hN' : (N : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hN
    have e1 : (N : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X 0) =
        (c : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk G : DimChow X 0) := by
      calc (N : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X 0)
          = ((N : ℤ) • (1 : ℚ)) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X 0) := by simp
        _ = (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] ((N : ℤ) • (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X 0)) :=
            TensorProduct.smul_tmul _ _ _
        _ = (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (c • (QuotientAddGroup.mk G : DimChow X 0)) := by rw [h0]
        _ = (c • (1 : ℚ)) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk G : DimChow X 0) :=
            (TensorProduct.smul_tmul _ _ _).symm
        _ = (c : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk G : DimChow X 0) := by simp
    refine ⟨(N : ℚ)⁻¹ * c, ?_⟩
    calc (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X 0)
        = (N : ℚ)⁻¹ • ((N : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X 0)) := by
          rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hN']
      _ = (N : ℚ)⁻¹ • ((c : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk G : DimChow X 0)) := by rw [e1]
      _ = ((N : ℚ)⁻¹ * c) • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk G : DimChow X 0)) := by
          rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul,
            mul_one]
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | tmul a y =>
    induction y using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H D =>
      obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := key D
      refine ⟨a * q, ?_⟩
      rw [mul_smul, ← hq, TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨q1, h1⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨q2, h2⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨q1 + q2, by rw [h1, h2, add_smul]⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F22.degQ_bijective_of_span
statement:
theorem degQ_bijective_of_span (g : RationalDimChow X 0)
    (hspan : ∀ x : RationalDimChow X 0, ∃ q : ℚ, x = q • g) :
    Function.Bijective (degQ k X)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, degQ_surjective (k := k) (X := X)⟩
  have hg : degQ k X g ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := degQ_surjective (k := k) (X := X) 1
    obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hspan x
    rw [map_smul, h0, smul_zero] at hx
    exact zero_ne_one hx
  intro x y hxy
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hspan x
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := hspan y
  simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at hxy
  rw [mul_right_cancel₀ hg hxy]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F22.rationalDimChow_pj_span
statement:
theorem rationalDimChow_pj_span (e : ℕ) :
    ∃ g : RationalDimChow (Pj (Spk k) e) 0, ∀ x : RationalDimChow (Pj (Spk k) e) 0,
      ∃ q : ℚ, x = q • g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G, hG, h⟩ := generator_pj k e
  exact ⟨_, rationalDimChow_span ⟨G, hG⟩ h⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F22.pj_nonempty
statement:
theorem pj_nonempty : ∀ e : ℕ, Nonempty (Pj (Spk k) e)
  | 0 => ⟨(inv (Pπ (Spk k) 0)) (pt0 k)⟩
  | e + 1 => by
    obtain ⟨x⟩
proof:
:= pj_nonempty e
    exact ⟨(Pι (Spk k) e) x⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F22.degQ_pj_bijective
statement: theorem degQ_pj_bijective (e : ℕ) : Function.Bijective (degQ k (Pj (Spk k) e))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := rationalDimChow_pj_span k e
  exact degQ_bijective_of_span k g hg

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F22.pointClass_relation
statement:
theorem pointClass_relation (e : ℕ) (x y : Pj (Spk k) e) (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set _))
    (hy : IsClosed ({y} : Set _)) :
    (Module.finrank k ((Pj (Spk k) e).residueField x) : ℚ) • pointClass y hy =
      (Module.finrank k ((Pj (Spk k) e).residueField y) : ℚ) • pointClass x hx
proof:
:= by
  apply (degQ_pj_bijective k e).1
  simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, degQ_pointClass]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F22.smul_pointClass_bijective_of_finrank_one
statement:
theorem smul_pointClass_bijective_of_finrank_one (e : ℕ) (x : Pj (Spk k) e)
    (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set _))
    (h1 : Module.finrank k ((Pj (Spk k) e).residueField x) = 1) :
    Function.Bijective fun a : ℚ ↦ a • pointClass x hx
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨smul_pointClass_injective (k := k) x hx, fun z ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := (degQ_pj_bijective k e).2 (degQ k _ z)
  refine ⟨degQ k _ z, (degQ_pj_bijective k e).1 ?_⟩
  simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, degQ_pointClass, h1]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechChosenDegreeOneComparison_delta_of_shortExact
statement:
theorem coordinateCechChosenDegreeOneComparison_delta_of_shortExact
    (S : ShortComplex
      (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space k n).toPresheafedSpace))
    (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (h₁ : CoordinateCechAcyclic k n S.X₁)
    (x : ↑((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor k n 0).obj S.X₃)) :
    coordinateCechChosenDegreeOneComparisonAddEquiv k n S.X₁ h₁
        (((coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_shortExact_of_acyclic
          k n S hS h₁).δ 0 1 rfl).hom x) =
      CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.δ hS 0 1 rfl
        ((coordinateCechH0SheafH0NatIso k n).hom.app S.X₃ x)
proof:
:= by
  let C := coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor k n
  let T := coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplex k n S.X₁
  let hT := coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplex_shortExact k n S.X₁
  let φ := shortComplexToCoordinateCechChosenInjective k n S hS
  have hCS : (S.map C).ShortExact :=
    coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_shortExact_of_acyclic k n S hS h₁
  have hCT : (T.map C).ShortExact :=
    coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_shortExact_of_acyclic k n T hT h₁
  have hδC := HomologicalComplex.HomologySequence.δ_naturality
    (C.mapShortComplex.map φ) hCS hCT 0 1 rfl
  have hCeq :
      (hCS.δ 0 1 rfl).hom x =
        (hCT.δ 0 1 rfl).hom
          ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (C.map φ.τ₃) 0).hom x) := by
    change hCS.δ 0 1 rfl ≫
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (C.map φ.τ₁) 1 =
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (C.map φ.τ₃) 0 ≫
        hCT.δ 0 1 rfl at hδC
    rw [show φ.τ₁ = 𝟙 _ from rfl] at hδC
    rw [C.map_id] at hδC
    rw [HomologicalComplex.homologyMap_id] at hδC
    have hx := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hδC x
    change (hCS.δ 0 1 rfl).hom x =
      (hCT.δ 0 1 rfl).hom
        ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (C.map φ.τ₃) 0).hom x) at hx
    exact hx
  rw [hCeq]
  change coordinateCechChosenDegreeOneComparisonAddEquiv k n S.X₁ h₁
      (coordinateCechChosenZeroDeltaAddHom k n S.X₁ h₁
        ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (C.map φ.τ₃) 0).hom x)) = _
  rw [coordinateCechChosenDegreeOneComparison_delta]
  have h₀ := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    ((coordinateCechH0SheafH0NatIso k n).hom.naturality φ.τ₃) x
  have hmap : (TopCat.Sheaf.H0Functor
      (space k n).toPresheafedSpace).map φ.τ₃ =
    AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.map φ.τ₃ 0) := rfl
  rw [hmap] at h₀
  change
    ((coordinateCechH0SheafH0NatIso k n).hom.app
      (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveQuotient k n S.X₁)).hom
        (((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor k n 0).map φ.τ₃).hom x) =
      CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.map φ.τ₃ 0
        (((coordinateCechH0SheafH0NatIso k n).hom.app S.X₃).hom x) at h₀
  change coordinateCechChosenZeroSheafHDeltaAddHom k n S.X₁
      (((coordinateCechH0SheafH0NatIso k n).hom.app
        (coordinateCechChosenInjectiveQuotient k n S.X₁)).hom
          (((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor k n 0).map φ.τ₃).hom x)) = _
  rw [h₀]
  have hδH := CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.δ_naturality 0 1 rfl
    hS hT φ
      (((coordinateCechH0SheafH0NatIso k n).hom.app S.X₃).hom x)
  change CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.δ hT 0 1 rfl
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.map φ.τ₃ 0
        (((coordinateCechH0SheafH0NatIso k n).hom.app S.X₃).hom x)) =
    CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.δ hS 0 1 rfl
      (((coordinateCechH0SheafH0NatIso k n).hom.app S.X₃).hom x)
  rw [show φ.τ₁ = 𝟙 _ from rfl,
    CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.map_id_apply] at hδH
  exact hδH

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparison_delta_of_shortExact
statement:
theorem coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparison_delta_of_shortExact
    (S : ShortComplex
      (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space k n).toPresheafedSpace))
    (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (h₁ : CoordinateCechAcyclic k n S.X₁)
    (h₃ : CoordinateCechAcyclic k n S.X₃)
    (q : ℕ)
    (x : ↑((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor k n (q + 1)).obj S.X₃)) :
    coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparisonAddEquiv k n S.X₁ h₁ (q + 1)
        (((coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_shortExact_of_acyclic
          k n S hS h₁).δ (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl).hom x) =
      CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.δ hS (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl
        (coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparisonAddEquiv
          k n S.X₃ h₃ q x)
proof:
:= by
  let C := coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor k n
  let T := coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplex k n S.X₁
  let hT := coordinateCechChosenInjectiveShortComplex_shortExact k n S.X₁
  let hQ := coordinateCechChosenInjectiveQuotient_acyclic k n S.X₁ h₁
  let φ := shortComplexToCoordinateCechChosenInjective k n S hS
  have hCS : (S.map C).ShortExact :=
    coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_shortExact_of_acyclic k n S hS h₁
  have hCT : (T.map C).ShortExact :=
    coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_shortExact_of_acyclic k n T hT h₁
  have hδC := HomologicalComplex.HomologySequence.δ_naturality
    (C.mapShortComplex.map φ) hCS hCT (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl
  have hCeq :
      (hCS.δ (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl).hom x =
        (hCT.δ (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl).hom
          ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (C.map φ.τ₃) (q + 1)).hom x) := by
    change hCS.δ (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl ≫
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (C.map φ.τ₁) (q + 2) =
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (C.map φ.τ₃) (q + 1) ≫
        hCT.δ (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl at hδC
    rw [show φ.τ₁ = 𝟙 _ from rfl] at hδC
    rw [C.map_id] at hδC
    rw [HomologicalComplex.homologyMap_id] at hδC
    have hx := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hδC x
    change (hCS.δ (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl).hom x =
      (hCT.δ (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl).hom
        ((HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (C.map φ.τ₃) (q + 1)).hom x) at hx
    exact hx
  rw [hCeq]
  change coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparisonAddEquiv k n S.X₁ h₁ (q + 1)
      (coordinateCechChosenPositiveDeltaAddEquiv k n S.X₁ h₁ q
        (((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor k n (q + 1)).map φ.τ₃).hom x)) = _
  rw [coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparison_delta]
  have hcmp :=
    coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparison_naturality k n h₃ hQ φ.τ₃ q x
  rw [hcmp]
  have hδH := CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.δ_naturality
    (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl hS hT φ
      (coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparisonAddEquiv k n S.X₃ h₃ q x)
  change CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.δ hT (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.map φ.τ₃ (q + 1)
        (coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparisonAddEquiv
          k n S.X₃ h₃ q x)) =
    CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.δ hS (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl
      (coordinateCechChosenPositiveComparisonAddEquiv
        k n S.X₃ h₃ q x)
  rw [show φ.τ₁ = 𝟙 _ from rfl,
    CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.map_id_apply] at hδH
  exact hδH

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.sheafHom_map_localHomSection
statement:
lemma sheafHom_map_localHomSection {M N : X.Modules} {U V : X.Opens}
    (hVU : V ≤ U) (f : M.over U ⟶ N.over U) :
    (sheafHom ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj M)
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj N)).obj.map
        (homOfLE hVU).op (localHomSection X U f) =
      localHomSection X V (restrictHomOverLE X hVU f)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_over
proof:
:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_comp
statement:
lemma restrictHomOverLE_comp {L M N : X.Modules} {U V : X.Opens}
    (hVU : V ≤ U) (f : L.over U ⟶ M.over U) (g : M.over U ⟶ N.over U) :
    restrictHomOverLE X hVU (f ≫ g) =
      restrictHomOverLE X hVU f ≫ restrictHomOverLE X hVU g
proof:
:= by
  apply (SheafOfModules.forget (X.ringCatSheaf.over V)).map_injective
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro W
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_trans

lemma restrictHomOverLE_trans {M N : X.Modules} {U V W : X.Opens}
    (hWV : W ≤ V) (hVU : V ≤ U) (f : M.over U ⟶ N.over U) :
    restrictHomOverLE X hWV (restrictHomOverLE X hVU f) =
      restrictHomOverLE X (hWV.trans hVU) f
proof:
:= by
  apply (SheafOfModules.forget (X.ringCatSheaf.over W)).map_injective
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro Z
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.hom_ext_of_isEmpty_open
statement:
lemma hom_ext_of_isEmpty_open {M N : X.Modules} {U : X.Opens}
    [hUempty : IsEmpty U] (f g : M.over U ⟶ N.over U) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro W
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  have hW : W.unop.left = ⊥ := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · intro p hp
      exact (hUempty.false
        (show U from ⟨p, W.unop.hom.le hp⟩)).elim
    · exact bot_le
  let R := (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj.obj W
  haveI : Subsingleton R := by
    change Subsingleton Γ(X, W.unop.left)
    rw [hW]
    infer_instance
  ext m
  have hone : (1 : R) = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  let a := (f.val.app W) m
  let b := (g.val.app W) m
  change a = b
  calc
    a = (1 : R) • a := (one_smul R a).symm
    _ = (0 : R) • a := congrArg (fun r : R ↦ r • a) hone
    _ = 0 := zero_smul R a
    _ = (0 : R) • b := (zero_smul R b).symm
    _ = (1 : R) • b := congrArg (fun r : R ↦ r • b) hone.symm
    _ = b := one_smul R b

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.gluedUnderlyingHom_over
statement:
lemma gluedUnderlyingHom_over {M N : X.Modules} {I : Type u}
    (U : I → X.Opens)
    (hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop U)
    (f : ∀ i, M.over (U i) ⟶ N.over (U i))
    (hf : Presheaf.FamilyOfElementsOnObjects.IsCompatible
      (fun i ↦ localHomSection X (U i) (f i))) (i : I) :
    ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).overPullback AddCommGrpCat (U i)).map
        (gluedUnderlyingHom X U hU f hf) =
      (SheafOfModules.toSheaf (X.ringCatSheaf.over (U i))).map (f i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sheafHomSectionsEquiv_symm_apply_coe_apply]
  change
    ((sheafHomSectionsEquiv _ _).symm
      (sheafHomSectionsEquiv _ _
        (hf.section_ hU
          (sheafHom ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj M)
            ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj N)).property))).1 (op (U i)) = _
  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  exact hf.section_apply hU
    (sheafHom ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj M)
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj N)).property i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.gluedUnderlyingHom_map_smul
statement:
lemma gluedUnderlyingHom_map_smul {M N : X.Modules} {I : Type u}
    (U : I → X.Opens)
    (hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop U)
    (f : ∀ i, M.over (U i) ⟶ N.over (U i))
    (hf : Presheaf.FamilyOfElementsOnObjects.IsCompatible
      (fun i ↦ localHomSection X (U i) (f i)))
    (W : X.Opensᵒᵖ) (r : X.presheaf.obj W) (m : M.val.obj W) :
    (show N.val.obj W from
      (gluedUnderlyingHom X U hU f hf).hom.app W (r • m)) =
      r • (show N.val.obj W from
        (gluedUnderlyingHom X U hU f hf).hom.app W m)
proof:
:= by
  let α := gluedUnderlyingHom X U hU f hf
  apply N.isSheaf.isSeparated W.unop (Sieve.ofObjects U W.unop) (hU W.unop)
  rintro Z a ⟨i, ⟨b⟩⟩
  have hlocalSheaf := gluedUnderlyingHom_over X U hU f hf i
  have hlocal := congr_app (congrArg (fun k ↦ k.hom) hlocalSheaf)
    (op (Over.mk b))
  change N.val.map a.op (α.hom.app W (r • m)) =
    N.val.map a.op
      (r • (show N.val.obj W from α.hom.app W m))
  calc
    N.val.map a.op (α.hom.app W (r • m)) =
        (show N.val.obj (op Z) from
          α.hom.app (op Z) (M.val.map a.op (r • m))) :=
      (CategoryTheory.congr_fun (α.hom.naturality a.op) (r • m)).symm
    _ = (show N.val.obj (op Z) from α.hom.app (op Z)
        (X.presheaf.map a.op r •
          (show M.val.obj (op Z) from M.val.map a.op m))) := by
      exact congrArg (fun z : M.val.obj (op Z) ↦
        (show N.val.obj (op Z) from α.hom.app (op Z) z))
          ((M.val.map a.op).hom.map_smul r m)
    _ = (show N.val.obj (op Z) from
        (f i).val.app (op (Over.mk b))
          (X.presheaf.map a.op r •
            (show M.val.obj (op Z) from M.val.map a.op m))) := by
      exact CategoryTheory.congr_fun hlocal _
    _ = X.presheaf.map a.op r •
        (show N.val.obj (op Z) from (f i).val.app (op (Over.mk b))
          (show M.val.obj (op Z) from M.val.map a.op m)) := by
      exact (f i).val.app (op (Over.mk b)) |>.hom.map_smul _ _
    _ = X.presheaf.map a.op r •
        (show N.val.obj (op Z) from
          α.hom.app (op Z) (M.val.map a.op m)) := by
      exact congrArg (fun z ↦ X.presheaf.map a.op r • z)
        (CategoryTheory.congr_fun hlocal _).symm
    _ = (show N.val.obj (op Z) from N.val.map a.op
        (r • (show N.val.obj W from α.hom.app W m))) := by
      calc
        X.presheaf.map a.op r •
            (show N.val.obj (op Z) from
              α.hom.app (op Z) (M.val.map a.op m)) =
            X.presheaf.map a.op r •
              (show N.val.obj (op Z) from N.val.map a.op (α.hom.app W m)) :=
          congrArg (fun z ↦ X.presheaf.map a.op r • z)
            (CategoryTheory.congr_fun (α.hom.naturality a.op) m)
        _ = (show N.val.obj (op Z) from N.val.map a.op
            (r • (show N.val.obj W from α.hom.app W m))) :=
          ((N.val.map a.op).hom.map_smul r _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.glueHom_over
statement:
lemma glueHom_over {M N : X.Modules} {I : Type u}
    (U : I → X.Opens)
    (hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop U)
    (f : ∀ i, M.over (U i) ⟶ N.over (U i))
    (hf : Presheaf.FamilyOfElementsOnObjects.IsCompatible
      (fun i ↦ localHomSection X (U i) (f i))) (i : I) :
    (glueHom X U hU f hf).over (U i) = f i
proof:
:= by
  apply (SheafOfModules.toSheaf
    (X.ringCatSheaf.over (U i))).map_injective
  exact gluedUnderlyingHom_over X U hU f hf i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.glueHom_isIso
statement:
theorem glueHom_isIso {M N : X.Modules} {I : Type u}
    (U : I → X.Opens)
    (hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop U)
    (f : ∀ i, M.over (U i) ⟶ N.over (U i))
    (hf : Presheaf.FamilyOfElementsOnObjects.IsCompatible
      (fun i ↦ localHomSection X (U i) (f i)))
    (hi : ∀ i, IsIso (f i)) : IsIso (glueHom X U hU f hf)
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsIso ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).map
      (glueHom X U hU f hf)) := by
    change IsIso (gluedUnderlyingHom X U hU f hf)
    apply Sheaf.isIso_of_coversTop hU
    intro i
    rw [gluedUnderlyingHom_over X U hU f hf i]
    letI := hi i
    exact Functor.map_isIso (SheafOfModules.toSheaf
      (X.ringCatSheaf.over (U i))) (f i)
  let F := SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf
  let hF : F.ReflectsIsomorphisms := by
    have : (F ⋙ sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
        AddCommGrpCat).ReflectsIsomorphisms :=
      inferInstanceAs ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
        PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf X.ringCatSheaf.obj).ReflectsIsomorphisms)
    exact reflectsIsomorphisms_of_comp F
      (sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat)
  exact hF.reflects (glueHom X U hU f hf)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.moduleSheafificationOverIso_hom_adjunct
statement:
lemma moduleSheafificationOverIso_hom_adjunct
    (U : X.Opens)
    (P : _root_.PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)) :
    let adj
proof:
:= PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
      (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)
    adj.homEquiv _ _ (moduleSheafificationOverIso X U P).hom =
      moduleSheafificationUnitOver X U P := by
  let adj := PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
    (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)
  let rη := moduleSheafificationUnitOver X U P
  let Q := ((moduleSheafification X).obj P).over U
  have hc : adj.homEquiv
      ((SheafOfModules.forget (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).obj Q) Q
        (adj.counit.app Q) = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [← adj.homEquiv_symm_id Q]
    exact Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _
  change adj.homEquiv _ _
    ((PresheafOfModules.sheafification
      (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)).map rη ≫
        adj.counit.app Q) = rη
  rw [adj.homEquiv_naturality_left]
  change rη ≫ adj.homEquiv
    ((SheafOfModules.forget (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).obj Q) Q
      (adj.counit.app Q) = rη
  rw [hc]
  exact Category.comp_id rη

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.moduleSheafificationOverIso_hom_adjunct_pushforward
statement:
lemma moduleSheafificationOverIso_hom_adjunct_pushforward
    (U : X.Opens) (P : _root_.PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)) :
    (PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)).homEquiv
      ((PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀OfCommRingCat (Over.forget U) X.presheaf).obj P)
      (((moduleSheafification X).obj P).over U) (moduleSheafificationOverIso X U P).hom =
      moduleSheafificationUnitOver X U P
proof: := moduleSheafificationOverIso_hom_adjunct X U P

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exteriorPowerSheafOverIso_hom_adjunct
statement:
lemma exteriorPowerSheafOverIso_hom_adjunct
    (U : X.Opens) (M : X.Modules) (n : ℕ) :
    let adj
proof:
:= PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
      (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)
    adj.homEquiv _ _ (exteriorPowerSheafOverIso X U M n).hom =
      (exteriorPowerRestrictPresheafIso X U M.val n).hom ≫
        moduleSheafificationUnitOver X U
          (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower M.val n) := by
  dsimp only
  unfold exteriorPowerSheafOverIso
  rw [Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom]
  unfold SheafOfModules.identitySheafificationOver
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left]
  erw [moduleSheafificationOverIso_hom_adjunct_pushforward]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.moduleSheafificationOverHomEquiv_apply
statement:
lemma moduleSheafificationOverHomEquiv_apply
    (U : X.Opens)
    (P : _root_.PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))
    (M : SheafOfModules (X.ringCatSheaf.over U))
    (f : ((moduleSheafification X).obj P).over U ⟶ M) :
    moduleSheafificationOverHomEquiv X U P M f =
      moduleSheafificationUnitOver X U P ≫
        (SheafOfModules.forget (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).map f
proof:
:= by
  let e := moduleSheafificationOverIso X U P
  let adj := PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
    (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)
  change adj.homEquiv _ _ (e.hom ≫ f) = _
  calc
    _ = adj.homEquiv _ _ e.hom ≫
        ((SheafOfModules.forget (X.ringCatSheaf.over U) ⋙
          PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars
            (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)).map f) :=
      adj.homEquiv_naturality_right e.hom f
    _ = _ := by
      rw [moduleSheafificationOverIso_hom_adjunct X U P]
      rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.moduleSheafificationOverHomEquiv_restrict_app
statement:
lemma moduleSheafificationOverHomEquiv_restrict_app
    {U V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (P : _root_.PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))
    (M : X.Modules)
    (f : ((moduleSheafification X).obj P).over U ⟶ M.over U)
    (W : (Over V)ᵒᵖ) :
    (moduleSheafificationOverHomEquiv X V P (M.over V)
      (restrictHomOverLE X hVU f)).app W =
    (moduleSheafificationOverHomEquiv X U P (M.over U) f).app
      ((Over.map (homOfLE hVU)).op.obj W)
proof:
:= by
  rw [moduleSheafificationOverHomEquiv_apply,
    moduleSheafificationOverHomEquiv_apply]
  rfl
