name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictedSplitDeterminantPresheafIso_hom
statement:
@[simp]
lemma restrictedSplitDeterminantPresheafIso_hom
    {S : ShortComplex X.Modules} (U : X.Opens)
    (h : (S.map (overRestrictionFunctor X U)).Splitting)
    (I J : Type u) [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [LinearOrder I] [LinearOrder J]
    (e₁ : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) I ≅ S.X₁.over U)
    (e₃ : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) J ≅ S.X₃.over U) :
    (restrictedSplitDeterminantPresheafIso X U h I J e₁ e₃).hom =
      restrictedSplitDeterminantPresheafHom X U h
        (Fintype.card I) (Fintype.card J)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [restrictedSplitDeterminantPresheafIso,
    restrictedSplitDeterminantPresheafHom, Iso.trans_hom,
    PresheafOfModules.splitDeterminantIso_hom]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictedSplitDeterminantPresheafHom_independent_of_splitting
statement:
lemma restrictedSplitDeterminantPresheafHom_independent_of_splitting
    {S : ShortComplex X.Modules} (U : X.Opens)
    (h k : (S.map (overRestrictionFunctor X U)).Splitting)
    (I J : Type u) [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [LinearOrder I] [LinearOrder J]
    (e₁ : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) I ≅ S.X₁.over U)
    (e₃ : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) J ≅ S.X₃.over U) :
    restrictedSplitDeterminantPresheafHom X U h
        (Fintype.card I) (Fintype.card J) =
      restrictedSplitDeterminantPresheafHom X U k
        (Fintype.card I) (Fintype.card J)
proof:
:= by
  let F := underlyingCommPresheafOverFunctor X U
  let e₁' : PresheafOfModules.constantFree
      (R := (Over.forget U).op ⋙ X.presheaf) I ≅
      F.obj ((S.map (overRestrictionFunctor X U)).X₁) :=
    (underlyingFreeOverIsoConstantFree X U I).symm ≪≫ F.mapIso e₁
  let e₃' : PresheafOfModules.constantFree
      (R := (Over.forget U).op ⋙ X.presheaf) J ≅
      F.obj ((S.map (overRestrictionFunctor X U)).X₃) :=
    (underlyingFreeOverIsoConstantFree X U J).symm ≪≫ F.mapIso e₃
  dsimp only [restrictedSplitDeterminantPresheafHom]
  rw [PresheafOfModules.splitDeterminantHom_independent_of_splitting
    (h.map F) (k.map F) I J e₁' e₃']

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.moduleSheafificationOverHomEquiv_localSplitDeterminantCore
statement:
lemma moduleSheafificationOverHomEquiv_localSplitDeterminantCore
    {S : ShortComplex X.Modules} (U : X.Opens)
    (h : (S.map (overRestrictionFunctor X U)).Splitting) (a c : ℕ) :
    moduleSheafificationOverHomEquiv X U
      (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower (underlyingCommPresheaf X S.X₁) a ⊗
        PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower (underlyingCommPresheaf X S.X₃) c)
      ((exteriorPowerSheaf X S.X₂ (a + c)).over U)
      (localSplitDeterminantCore X U h a c) =
    restrictedSplitDeterminantPresheafHom X U h a c ≫
      moduleSheafificationUnitOver X U
        (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower
          (underlyingCommPresheaf X S.X₂) (a + c))
proof:
:= by
  let P := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower (underlyingCommPresheaf X S.X₁) a ⊗
    PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower (underlyingCommPresheaf X S.X₃) c
  let Q := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower
    (underlyingCommPresheaf X S.X₂) (a + c)
  let φ := restrictedSplitDeterminantPresheafHom X U h a c
  let eP := moduleSheafificationOverIso X U P
  let eQ := moduleSheafificationOverIso X U Q
  let adj := PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
    (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)
  let A := SheafOfModules.identitySheafificationOver
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.ringCatSheaf U
  change adj.homEquiv _ _
    (eP.hom ≫ eP.inv ≫ A.map φ ≫ eQ.hom) =
      φ ≫ moduleSheafificationUnitOver X U Q
  calc
    _ = adj.homEquiv _ _ (A.map φ ≫ eQ.hom) :=
      congrArg (adj.homEquiv _ _)
        (eP.hom_inv_id_assoc (A.map φ ≫ eQ.hom))
    _ = φ ≫ adj.homEquiv _ _ eQ.hom := by
      change adj.homEquiv _ _
        ((PresheafOfModules.sheafification
          (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)).map φ ≫ eQ.hom) = _
      exact adj.homEquiv_naturality_left φ eQ.hom
    _ = _ := congrArg (fun k ↦ φ ≫ k)
      (moduleSheafificationOverIso_hom_adjunct X U Q)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.localSplitDeterminantIso_hom
statement:
@[simp]
lemma localSplitDeterminantIso_hom
    {S : ShortComplex X.Modules} (U : X.Opens)
    (h : (S.map (overRestrictionFunctor X U)).Splitting)
    (I J : Type u) [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [LinearOrder I] [LinearOrder J]
    (e₁ : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) I ≅ S.X₁.over U)
    (e₃ : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) J ≅ S.X₃.over U) :
    (localSplitDeterminantIso X U h I J e₁ e₃).hom =
      localSplitDeterminantHom X U h (Fintype.card I) (Fintype.card J)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [localSplitDeterminantIso, localSplitDeterminantHom,
    localSplitDeterminantCore,
    Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, determinantSheafPrefixIso_hom,
    restrictedSplitDeterminantPresheafIso_hom, SheafOfModules.Hom.over,
    Category.assoc]
  rw [show (SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U).map
      (determinantSheafPrefix X (Fintype.card I) (Fintype.card J)) =
    (determinantSheafPrefix X (Fintype.card I) (Fintype.card J)).over U from rfl]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.localSplitDeterminantHom_isIso
statement:
theorem localSplitDeterminantHom_isIso
    {S : ShortComplex X.Modules} (U : X.Opens)
    (h : (S.map (overRestrictionFunctor X U)).Splitting)
    (I J : Type u) [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [LinearOrder I] [LinearOrder J]
    (e₁ : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) I ≅ S.X₁.over U)
    (e₃ : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) J ≅ S.X₃.over U) :
    IsIso (localSplitDeterminantHom X U h
      (Fintype.card I) (Fintype.card J))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← localSplitDeterminantIso_hom X U h I J e₁ e₃]
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_localSplitDeterminantCore
statement:
lemma restrictHomOverLE_localSplitDeterminantCore
    {S : ShortComplex X.Modules} {U V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (h : (S.map (overRestrictionFunctor X U)).Splitting) (a c : ℕ) :
    restrictHomOverLE X hVU (localSplitDeterminantCore X U h a c) =
      localSplitDeterminantCore X V (splittingOverLE X hVU h) a c
proof:
:= by
  let P := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower (underlyingCommPresheaf X S.X₁) a ⊗
    PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower (underlyingCommPresheaf X S.X₃) c
  apply (moduleSheafificationOverHomEquiv X V P
    ((exteriorPowerSheaf X S.X₂ (a + c)).over V)).injective
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro W
  rw [moduleSheafificationOverHomEquiv_restrict_app]
  rw [moduleSheafificationOverHomEquiv_localSplitDeterminantCore,
    moduleSheafificationOverHomEquiv_localSplitDeterminantCore]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_localSplitDeterminantHom
statement:
lemma restrictHomOverLE_localSplitDeterminantHom
    {S : ShortComplex X.Modules} {U V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (h : (S.map (overRestrictionFunctor X U)).Splitting) (a c : ℕ) :
    restrictHomOverLE X hVU (localSplitDeterminantHom X U h a c) =
      localSplitDeterminantHom X V (splittingOverLE X hVU h) a c
proof:
:= by
  rw [localSplitDeterminantHom, restrictHomOverLE_comp,
    restrictHomOverLE_over,
    restrictHomOverLE_localSplitDeterminantCore]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.localSplitDeterminantHom_independent_of_splitting
statement:
lemma localSplitDeterminantHom_independent_of_splitting
    {S : ShortComplex X.Modules} (U : X.Opens)
    (h k : (S.map (overRestrictionFunctor X U)).Splitting)
    (I J : Type u) [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [LinearOrder I] [LinearOrder J]
    (e₁ : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) I ≅ S.X₁.over U)
    (e₃ : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) J ≅ S.X₃.over U) :
    localSplitDeterminantHom X U h (Fintype.card I) (Fintype.card J) =
      localSplitDeterminantHom X U k (Fintype.card I) (Fintype.card J)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [localSplitDeterminantHom, localSplitDeterminantCore]
  rw [restrictedSplitDeterminantPresheafHom_independent_of_splitting
    X U h k I J e₁ e₃]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isLocallySurjective_of_epi
statement:
theorem isLocallySurjective_of_epi {M N : X.Modules} (f : M ⟶ N) [Epi f] :
    TopCat.Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective
      (((toAddCommGrpSheaf X).map f).hom)
proof:
:= by
  rw [TopCat.Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi]
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exists_open_lifts_of_finite_elements
statement:
theorem exists_open_lifts_of_finite_elements
    {M N : X.Modules} (f : M ⟶ N) [Epi f]
    (I : Type u) [Fintype I] (U : X.Opens)
    (s : I → N.val.obj (op U)) (x : X) (hxU : x ∈ U) :
    ∃ (V : X.Opens) (hVU : V ≤ U), x ∈ V ∧
      ∃ t : I → M.val.obj (op V),
        ∀ i, f.val.app (op V) (t i) =
          N.val.map (homOfLE hVU).op (s i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let φ := ((toAddCommGrpSheaf X).map f).hom
  have hφ : TopCat.Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective φ :=
    isLocallySurjective_of_epi X f
  have hloc := (TopCat.Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff φ).mp hφ
  have hi : ∀ i : I, ∃ (V : X.Opens) (hV : V ≤ U),
      (∃ y : M.val.obj (op V),
        f.val.app (op V) y = N.val.map (homOfLE hV).op (s i)) ∧ x ∈ V := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨V, hV, ⟨y, hy⟩, hxV⟩ := hloc U (s i) x hxU
    exact ⟨V, hV, ⟨y, hy⟩, hxV⟩
  choose V hVU hpre hxV using hi
  choose y hy using hpre
  let W : X.Opens := U ⊓ ⨅ i, V i
  have hWU : W ≤ U := inf_le_left
  have hWV (i : I) : W ≤ V i :=
    inf_le_right.trans (iInf_le (fun j ↦ V j) i)
  have hxW : x ∈ W := by
    constructor
    · exact hxU
    · change x ∈ ((⨅ i, V i : X.Opens) : Set X)
      rw [Opens.coe_iInf]
      exact Set.mem_iInter.mpr hxV
  refine ⟨W, hWU, hxW, fun i ↦ M.val.map (homOfLE (hWV i)).op (y i), ?_⟩
  intro i
  rw [PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply f.val]
  rw [hy i]
  change N.val.map (homOfLE (hWV i)).op
      (N.val.map (homOfLE (hVU i)).op (s i)) =
    N.val.map (homOfLE hWU).op (s i)
  calc
    N.val.map (homOfLE (hWV i)).op
        (N.val.map (homOfLE (hVU i)).op (s i)) =
      N.val.map ((homOfLE (hVU i)).op ≫ (homOfLE (hWV i)).op) (s i) :=
        (CategoryTheory.congr_fun
          (N.val.map_comp (homOfLE (hVU i)).op (homOfLE (hWV i)).op) (s i)).symm
    _ = N.val.map (homOfLE hWU).op (s i) := by
      congr 2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exists_open_lifts_of_finite_sections
statement:
theorem exists_open_lifts_of_finite_sections
    {M N : X.Modules} (f : M ⟶ N) [Epi f]
    (I : Type u) [Fintype I] (s : I → N.sections) (x : X) :
    ∃ (U : X.Opens), x ∈ U ∧
      ∃ t : I → M.val.obj (op U),
        ∀ i, f.val.app (op U) (t i) = (s i).eval (op U)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let φ := ((toAddCommGrpSheaf X).map f).hom
  have hφ : TopCat.Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective φ :=
    isLocallySurjective_of_epi X f
  have hloc := (TopCat.Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff φ).mp hφ
  have hi : ∀ i : I, ∃ (V : X.Opens) (hV : V ≤ ⊤),
      (∃ y : M.val.obj (op V),
        f.val.app (op V) y =
          N.val.map (homOfLE hV).op ((s i).eval (op ⊤))) ∧ x ∈ V := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨V, hV, ⟨y, hy⟩, hxV⟩ :=
      hloc ⊤ ((s i).eval (op ⊤)) x (by simp)
    refine ⟨V, hV, ⟨y, ?_⟩, hxV⟩
    change f.val.app (op V) y =
      N.val.map (homOfLE hV).op ((s i).eval (op ⊤)) at hy
    exact hy
  choose V hVtop hpre hxV using hi
  choose y hy using hpre
  let U : X.Opens := ⨅ i, V i
  have hxU : x ∈ U := by
    change x ∈ ((⨅ i, V i : X.Opens) : Set X)
    rw [Opens.coe_iInf]
    exact Set.mem_iInter.mpr hxV
  refine ⟨U, hxU, fun i ↦ M.val.map
    (homOfLE (iInf_le (fun j ↦ V j) i)).op (y i), ?_⟩
  intro i
  rw [PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply f.val]
  rw [hy i]
  rw [PresheafOfModules.sections_property (s i) (homOfLE (hVtop i)).op]
  exact PresheafOfModules.sections_property (s i)
    (homOfLE (iInf_le (fun j ↦ V j) i)).op

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.overSectionOfElement_eval
statement:
@[simp]
lemma overSectionOfElement_eval (M : X.Modules) (U : X.Opens)
    (t : M.val.obj (op U)) (V : (Over U)ᵒᵖ) :
    (overSectionOfElement X M U t).eval V =
      M.val.map V.unop.hom.op t
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.sectionsMap_overSectionOfElement
statement:
lemma sectionsMap_overSectionOfElement {M N : X.Modules} (f : M ⟶ N)
    (U : X.Opens) (t : M.val.obj (op U)) :
    SheafOfModules.sectionsMap (f.over U)
        (overSectionOfElement X M U t) =
      overSectionOfElement X N U (f.val.app (op U) t)
proof:
:= by
  apply PresheafOfModules.sections_ext
  intro V
  change f.val.app (op V.unop.left)
      (M.val.map V.unop.hom.op t) =
    N.val.map V.unop.hom.op (f.val.app (op U) t)
  exact PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply f.val V.unop.hom.op t

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.sectionsMap_freeOverIso_hom_freeSection
statement:
lemma sectionsMap_freeOverIso_hom_freeSection
    (U : X.Opens) (I : Type u) (i : I) :
    SheafOfModules.sectionsMap (SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X U I).hom
        (SheafOfModules.freeSection i) =
      overSectionOfElement X
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I) U
        ((SheafOfModules.freeSection i).eval (op U))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← SheafOfModules.freeHomEquiv_apply]
  apply ((SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I).over U).unitHomEquiv.symm.injective
  rw [SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv_symm_freeHomEquiv_apply]
  rw [SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso, SheafOfModules.ιFree_mapFreeIso_hom]
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro V
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply (LinearMap.ringLmapEquivSelf _ ℤ _).injective
  simp only [LinearMap.ringLmapEquivSelf_apply]
  let q := overSectionOfElement X
    (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I) U
    ((SheafOfModules.freeSection i).eval (op U))
  have hq :
      ((((SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I).over U).unitHomEquiv.symm q).val.app V)
          (1 : (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj.obj V) =
        q.eval V := by
    rw [← SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv_apply_coe]
    exact congrArg (fun z ↦ z.eval V)
      (((SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I).over U).unitHomEquiv.apply_symm_apply q)
  dsimp only [q] at hq
  change _ =
    (((((SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I).over U).unitHomEquiv.symm
      (overSectionOfElement X
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I) U
        ((SheafOfModules.freeSection i).eval (op U)))).val.app V).hom)
      (1 : (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj.obj V)
  rw [hq]
  change (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i).val.app (op V.unop.left)
      (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op V.unop.left)) =
    ((SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I).val.map
      V.unop.hom.op ((SheafOfModules.freeSection i).eval (op U)))
  rw [PresheafOfModules.sections_property (SheafOfModules.freeSection i)
    V.unop.hom.op]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.overMapSection_eval
statement:
@[simp]
lemma overMapSection_eval {U V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U)
    {P : SheafOfModules (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)} (s : P.sections)
    (W : (Over V)ᵒᵖ) :
    (overMapSection X hVU s).eval W =
      s.eval ((Over.map (homOfLE hVU)).op.obj W)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.sectionsMap_overMapSection
statement:
lemma sectionsMap_overMapSection {U V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U)
    {P Q : SheafOfModules (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)} (f : P ⟶ Q)
    (s : P.sections) :
    SheafOfModules.sectionsMap
        ((SheafOfModules.overMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)).map f)
        (overMapSection X hVU s) =
      overMapSection X hVU (SheafOfModules.sectionsMap f s)
proof:
:= by
  apply PresheafOfModules.sections_ext
  intro W
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.sectionsMap_overFunctorMap_hom_overMapSection
statement:
lemma sectionsMap_overFunctorMap_hom_overMapSection {U V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (M : X.Modules) (s : (M.over U).sections) :
    SheafOfModules.sectionsMap
        ((SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)).app M).hom
        (overMapSection X hVU s) =
      overSectionOfElement X M V
        (M.val.map (homOfLE hVU).op
          (s.eval (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))))
proof:
:= by
  apply PresheafOfModules.sections_ext
  intro W
  let a : (Over.map (homOfLE hVU)).obj W.unop ⟶ Over.mk (𝟙 U) :=
    Over.homMk (W.unop.hom ≫ homOfLE hVU)
  have hs := PresheafOfModules.sections_property s a.op
  change M.val.map ((homOfLE hVU).op ≫ W.unop.hom.op)
      (s.eval (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))) =
    s.eval ((Over.map (homOfLE hVU)).op.obj W) at hs
  change s.eval ((Over.map (homOfLE hVU)).op.obj W) =
    M.val.map W.unop.hom.op
      (M.val.map (homOfLE hVU).op
        (s.eval (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))))
  rw [← M.val.map_comp_apply]
  exact hs.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.sectionsMap_overFunctorMap_inv_overSectionOfElement
statement:
lemma sectionsMap_overFunctorMap_inv_overSectionOfElement {U V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (M : X.Modules) (t : M.val.obj (op U)) :
    SheafOfModules.sectionsMap
        ((SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)).inv.app M)
        (overSectionOfElement X M V (M.val.map (homOfLE hVU).op t)) =
      overMapSection X hVU (overSectionOfElement X M U t)
proof:
:= by
  let c := SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)
  have hinj : Function.Injective (SheafOfModules.sectionsMap (c.hom.app M)) := by
    intro a b hab
    have h := congrArg (SheafOfModules.sectionsMap (c.inv.app M)) hab
    simpa only [← SheafOfModules.sectionsMap_comp, c.hom_inv_id_app,
      SheafOfModules.sectionsMap_id] using h
  apply hinj
  rw [← SheafOfModules.sectionsMap_comp, c.inv_hom_id_app]
  change overSectionOfElement X M V (M.val.map (homOfLE hVU).op t) = _
  have heval :
      (overSectionOfElement X M U t).eval (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) = t := by
    change M.val.map (𝟙 (op U)) t = t
    rw [M.val.map_id]
    rfl
  have h := sectionsMap_overFunctorMap_hom_overMapSection X hVU M
    (overSectionOfElement X M U t)
  rw [heval] at h
  exact h.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.sectionsMap_freeOverMapIso_hom_freeSection
statement:
lemma sectionsMap_freeOverMapIso_hom_freeSection
    (U V : X.Opens) (hVU : V ≤ U) (I : Type u) (i : I) :
    SheafOfModules.sectionsMap (freeOverMapIso X U V hVU I).hom
        (SheafOfModules.freeSection i) =
      overMapSection X hVU (SheafOfModules.freeSection i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← SheafOfModules.freeHomEquiv_apply]
  let F := SheafOfModules.overMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)
  apply (F.obj (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) I)).unitHomEquiv.symm.injective
  rw [SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv_symm_freeHomEquiv_apply]
  rw [freeOverMapIso, SheafOfModules.ιFree_mapFreeIso_hom]
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro W
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply (LinearMap.ringLmapEquivSelf _ ℤ _).injective
  simp only [LinearMap.ringLmapEquivSelf_apply]
  let q := overMapSection X hVU (SheafOfModules.freeSection i)
  have hq :
      ((((F.obj (SheafOfModules.free
        (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) I)).unitHomEquiv.symm q).val.app W)
          (1 : (X.ringCatSheaf.over V).obj.obj W) = q.eval W) := by
    rw [← SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv_apply_coe]
    exact congrArg (fun z ↦ z.eval W)
      (((F.obj (SheafOfModules.free
        (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) I)).unitHomEquiv.apply_symm_apply q))
  dsimp only [q] at hq
  change _ =
    (((((F.obj (SheafOfModules.free
      (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) I)).unitHomEquiv.symm
        (overMapSection X hVU (SheafOfModules.freeSection i))).val.app W).hom)
      (1 : (X.ringCatSheaf.over V).obj.obj W))
  rw [hq]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exists_open_section_of_epi_free_over
statement:
theorem exists_open_section_of_epi_free_over
    {M N : X.Modules} (I : Type u) [Fintype I] (g : M ⟶ N) [Epi g]
    (U : X.Opens)
    (e : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) I ≅ N.over U)
    (x : X) (hxU : x ∈ U) :
    ∃ (V : X.Opens) (hVU : V ≤ U), x ∈ V ∧
      ∃ s : N.over V ⟶ M.over V, s ≫ g.over V = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let T : (Over U)ᵒᵖ := op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))
  let basisElement (i : I) : N.val.obj (op U) :=
    e.hom.val.app T ((SheafOfModules.freeSection i).eval T)
  obtain ⟨V, hVU, hxV, t, ht⟩ :=
    exists_open_lifts_of_finite_elements X g I U basisElement x hxU
  let F := SheafOfModules.overMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)
  let eV : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V) I ≅ N.over V :=
    freeOverMapIso X U V hVU I ≪≫ F.mapIso e ≪≫
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)).app N
  let liftHom : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V) I ⟶ M.over V :=
    (M.over V).freeHomEquiv.symm
      (fun i ↦ overSectionOfElement X M V (t i))
  have hlift : liftHom ≫ g.over V = eV.hom := by
    apply (N.over V).freeHomEquiv.injective
    funext i
    rw [SheafOfModules.freeHomEquiv_comp_apply]
    dsimp only [liftHom]
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rw [sectionsMap_overSectionOfElement, ht i]
    rw [SheafOfModules.freeHomEquiv_apply]
    dsimp only [eV]
    rw [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom]
    rw [SheafOfModules.sectionsMap_comp, SheafOfModules.sectionsMap_comp]
    rw [sectionsMap_freeOverMapIso_hom_freeSection]
    rw [sectionsMap_overMapSection]
    symm
    calc
      _ = overSectionOfElement X N V
          (N.val.map (homOfLE hVU).op
            ((SheafOfModules.sectionsMap e.hom
              (SheafOfModules.freeSection i)).eval
                (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))))) :=
        sectionsMap_overFunctorMap_hom_overMapSection X hVU N
          (SheafOfModules.sectionsMap e.hom (SheafOfModules.freeSection i))
      _ = _ := by rfl
  refine ⟨V, hVU, hxV, eV.inv ≫ liftHom, ?_⟩
  rw [Category.assoc, hlift, eV.inv_hom_id]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exists_open_section_of_epi_free
statement:
theorem exists_open_section_of_epi_free
    {M : X.Modules} (I : Type u)
    (g : M ⟶ SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I)
    [Epi g] [Fintype I] (x : X) :
    ∃ (U : X.Opens), x ∈ U ∧
      ∃ s : (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I).over U ⟶ M.over U,
        s ≫ g.over U = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, t, ht⟩ :=
    exists_open_lifts_of_finite_sections X g I SheafOfModules.freeSection x
  let liftHom :
      SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) I ⟶ M.over U :=
    (M.over U).freeHomEquiv.symm
      (fun i ↦ overSectionOfElement X M U (t i))
  refine ⟨U, hxU, (SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X U I).inv ≫ liftHom, ?_⟩
  apply (cancel_epi (SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X U I).hom).1
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, Category.comp_id]
  apply ((SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I).over U).freeHomEquiv.injective
  funext i
  rw [SheafOfModules.freeHomEquiv_comp_apply]
  dsimp only [liftHom]
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [sectionsMap_overSectionOfElement, ht i]
  rw [SheafOfModules.freeHomEquiv_apply]
  exact (sectionsMap_freeOverIso_hom_freeSection X U I i).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exists_open_splitting_of_shortExact_free_right
statement:
theorem exists_open_splitting_of_shortExact_free_right
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (I : Type u) [Fintype I]
    (e : S.X₃ ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I) (x : X) :
    ∃ (U : X.Opens), x ∈ U ∧
      Nonempty (S.map (overRestrictionFunctor X U)).Splitting
proof:
:= by
  letI : Epi S.g := hS.epi_g
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, sFree, hsFree⟩ :=
    exists_open_section_of_epi_free X I (S.g ≫ e.hom) x
  let F := overRestrictionFunctor X U
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits F := by
    dsimp only [F, overRestrictionFunctor]
    exact overFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits X U
  letI : PreservesFiniteColimits F := by
    dsimp only [F, overRestrictionFunctor]
    exact overFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits X U
  have hSU : (S.map F).ShortExact :=
    ShortComplex.ShortExact.map_of_exact hS F
  let eU : F.obj S.X₃ ≅
      F.obj (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I) := F.mapIso e
  change sFree ≫ F.map (S.g ≫ e.hom) = 𝟙 _ at hsFree
  have hs : eU.hom ≫ sFree ≫ F.map S.g = 𝟙 (F.obj S.X₃) := by
    rw [← cancel_mono eU.hom]
    change F.map e.hom ≫ sFree ≫ F.map S.g ≫ F.map e.hom = F.map e.hom
    exact calc
      F.map e.hom ≫ sFree ≫ F.map S.g ≫ F.map e.hom =
          F.map e.hom ≫ (sFree ≫ F.map (S.g ≫ e.hom)) := by
        calc
          F.map e.hom ≫ sFree ≫ F.map S.g ≫ F.map e.hom =
              F.map e.hom ≫ (sFree ≫ (F.map S.g ≫ F.map e.hom)) :=
            (Category.assoc (F.map e.hom ≫ sFree) (F.map S.g) (F.map e.hom)).trans
              (Category.assoc (F.map e.hom) sFree
                (F.map S.g ≫ F.map e.hom))
          _ = F.map e.hom ≫ (sFree ≫ F.map (S.g ≫ e.hom)) :=
            congrArg (fun k ↦ F.map e.hom ≫ (sFree ≫ k))
              (F.map_comp S.g e.hom).symm
      _ = F.map e.hom := by
        calc
          F.map e.hom ≫ (sFree ≫ F.map (S.g ≫ e.hom)) =
              F.map e.hom ≫ 𝟙 _ :=
            congrArg (fun k ↦ F.map e.hom ≫ k) hsFree
          _ = F.map e.hom := Category.comp_id _
  refine ⟨U, hxU, ⟨ShortComplex.Splitting.ofExactOfSection
    (S.map F) hSU.exact (eU.hom ≫ sFree) hs hSU.mono_f⟩⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exists_nested_open_splitting_of_shortExact_finiteLocallyFree_right
statement:
theorem exists_nested_open_splitting_of_shortExact_finiteLocallyFree_right
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (h₃ : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X S.X₃) (x : X) :
    ∃ (U : X.Opens) (hxU : x ∈ U) (V : (U : Scheme).Opens),
      (⟨x, hxU⟩ : (U : Scheme)) ∈ V ∧
        Nonempty
          (((S.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι)).map
            (overRestrictionFunctor (U : Scheme) V)).Splitting)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin⟩ := h₃.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := hqfin
  have hcover : IsOpenCover q.X :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff X q.X).mp q.coversTop
  have hxUnion : x ∈ ⋃ i, (q.X i : Set X) := by
    rw [hcover.iSup_set_eq_univ]
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hxUnion
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := hxUnion
  let U := q.X i
  let Y : Scheme.{u} := U
  let y : Y := ⟨x, hxi⟩
  let f : Y ⟶ X := Scheme.Opens.ι U
  let I := (q.generators i).I
  letI : (q.generators i).IsFiniteType :=
    SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType i
  letI : Finite I := by
    dsimp only [I]
    infer_instance
  letI : Fintype I := Fintype.ofFinite I
  let F := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor.{u} f
  letI : F.IsLeftAdjoint := by
    dsimp only [F]
    infer_instance
  letI : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor.{u} f).IsLeftAdjoint := by
    infer_instance
  letI hPres : PreservesColimitsOfShape.{u, u, u, u, u + 1, u + 1} (Discrete I)
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor.{u} f) := by
    infer_instance
  letI : F.Additive := by
    constructor
    intro M N a b
    rfl
  letI : F.PreservesZeroMorphisms :=
    Functor.preservesZeroMorphisms_of_additive F
  let SU := S.map F
  have hSU : SU.ShortExact :=
    Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor_map_shortExact f S hS
  let FreeX : X.Modules :=
    SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I
  let eOver : FreeX.over U ≅ S.X₃.over U :=
    (SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X U I).symm ≪≫ asIso (q.generators i).π
  let eRestr : F.obj FreeX ≅ F.obj S.X₃ :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app FreeX).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.mapIso eOver ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app S.X₃
  let eFree :
      SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I ≅ F.obj FreeX :=
    @SheafOfModules.mapFreeIso _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor.{u} f) I hPres
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso f).symm
  let eTarget : SU.X₃ ≅
      SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I :=
    eRestr.symm ≪≫ eFree.symm
  obtain ⟨V, hyV, hsplit⟩ :=
    exists_open_splitting_of_shortExact_free_right Y SU hSU I eTarget y
  exact ⟨U, hxi, V, hyV, hsplit⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exists_open_splitting_of_shortExact_finiteLocallyFree_right
statement:
theorem exists_open_splitting_of_shortExact_finiteLocallyFree_right
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (h₃ : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X S.X₃) (x : X) :
    ∃ (V : X.Opens), x ∈ V ∧
      Nonempty (S.map (overRestrictionFunctor X V)).Splitting
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin⟩ := h₃.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := hqfin
  have hcover : IsOpenCover q.X :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff X q.X).mp q.coversTop
  have hxUnion : x ∈ ⋃ i, (q.X i : Set X) := by
    rw [hcover.iSup_set_eq_univ]
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hxUnion
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := hxUnion
  let I := (q.generators i).I
  letI : (q.generators i).IsFiniteType :=
    SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType i
  letI : Finite I := by
    dsimp only [I]
    infer_instance
  letI : Fintype I := Fintype.ofFinite I
  letI : Epi S.g := hS.epi_g
  obtain ⟨V, hVU, hxV, s, hs⟩ :=
    exists_open_section_of_epi_free_over X I S.g (q.X i)
      (asIso (q.generators i).π) x hxi
  let F := overRestrictionFunctor X V
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits F := by
    dsimp only [F, overRestrictionFunctor]
    exact overFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits X V
  letI : PreservesFiniteColimits F := by
    dsimp only [F, overRestrictionFunctor]
    exact overFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits X V
  have hSV : (S.map F).ShortExact :=
    ShortComplex.ShortExact.map_of_exact hS F
  change s ≫ F.map S.g = 𝟙 _ at hs
  exact ⟨V, hxV, ⟨ShortComplex.Splitting.ofExactOfSection
    (S.map F) hSV.exact s hs hSV.mono_f⟩⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exists_determinantLocalDataAt
statement:
theorem exists_determinantLocalDataAt
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (h₁ : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X S.X₁)
    (h₃ : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X S.X₃) (x : X) :
    Nonempty (DeterminantLocalData X S x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨q₁, hq₁, hq₁fin⟩ := h₁.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  obtain ⟨q₃, hq₃, hq₃fin⟩ := h₃.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  letI : q₁.IsLocallyFreeData := hq₁
  letI : q₁.IsFiniteType := hq₁fin
  letI : q₃.IsLocallyFreeData := hq₃
  letI : q₃.IsFiniteType := hq₃fin
  have hcover₁ : IsOpenCover q₁.X :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff X q₁.X).mp q₁.coversTop
  have hcover₃ : IsOpenCover q₃.X :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff X q₃.X).mp q₃.coversTop
  have hxUnion₁ : x ∈ ⋃ i, (q₁.X i : Set X) := by
    rw [hcover₁.iSup_set_eq_univ]
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  have hxUnion₃ : x ∈ ⋃ i, (q₃.X i : Set X) := by
    rw [hcover₃.iSup_set_eq_univ]
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hxUnion₁ hxUnion₃
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := hxUnion₁
  obtain ⟨j, hxj⟩ := hxUnion₃
  let I := (q₁.generators i).I
  let J := (q₃.generators j).I
  letI : (q₁.generators i).IsFiniteType :=
    SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType i
  letI : (q₃.generators j).IsFiniteType :=
    SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType j
  letI : Finite I := by
    dsimp only [I]
    infer_instance
  letI : Finite J := by
    dsimp only [J]
    infer_instance
  letI : Fintype I := Fintype.ofFinite I
  letI : Fintype J := Fintype.ofFinite J
  have hη₁ : genericPoint X ∈ q₁.X i := by
    let hspec : Specializes (genericPoint X) x :=
      (genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial
    exact hspec.mem_open (q₁.X i).isOpen hxi
  have hη₃ : genericPoint X ∈ q₃.X j := by
    let hspec : Specializes (genericPoint X) x :=
      (genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial
    exact hspec.mem_open (q₃.X j).isOpen hxj
  have hrank₁ : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X S.X₁ = Nat.card I := by
    simpa only [I] using
      (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank_eq_natCard_localGenerators
        X S.X₁ q₁ i hη₁)
  have hrank₃ : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X S.X₃ = Nat.card J := by
    simpa only [J] using
      (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank_eq_natCard_localGenerators
        X S.X₃ q₃ j hη₃)
  let U := q₁.X i ⊓ q₃.X j
  have hxU : x ∈ U := ⟨hxi, hxj⟩
  let F₁ := SheafOfModules.overMap X.ringCatSheaf
    (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U ≤ q₁.X i))
  let F₃ := SheafOfModules.overMap X.ringCatSheaf
    (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U ≤ q₃.X j))
  let e₁U : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) I ≅ S.X₁.over U :=
    freeOverMapIso X (q₁.X i) U inf_le_left I ≪≫
      F₁.mapIso (asIso (q₁.generators i).π) ≪≫
        (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf
          (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U ≤ q₁.X i))).app S.X₁
  let e₃U : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) J ≅ S.X₃.over U :=
    freeOverMapIso X (q₃.X j) U inf_le_right J ≪≫
      F₃.mapIso (asIso (q₃.generators j).π) ≪≫
        (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf
          (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U ≤ q₃.X j))).app S.X₃
  letI : Epi S.g := hS.epi_g
  obtain ⟨V, hVU, hxV, s, hs⟩ :=
    exists_open_section_of_epi_free_over X J S.g U e₃U x hxU
  let F := overRestrictionFunctor X V
  let G := SheafOfModules.overMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)
  let e₁V : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V) I ≅ S.X₁.over V :=
    freeOverMapIso X U V hVU I ≪≫ G.mapIso e₁U ≪≫
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)).app S.X₁
  let e₃V : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V) J ≅ S.X₃.over V :=
    freeOverMapIso X U V hVU J ≪≫ G.mapIso e₃U ≪≫
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)).app S.X₃
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits F := by
    dsimp only [F, overRestrictionFunctor]
    exact overFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits X V
  letI : PreservesFiniteColimits F := by
    dsimp only [F, overRestrictionFunctor]
    exact overFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits X V
  have hSV : (S.map F).ShortExact :=
    ShortComplex.ShortExact.map_of_exact hS F
  change s ≫ F.map S.g = 𝟙 _ at hs
  let split : (S.map F).Splitting :=
    ShortComplex.Splitting.ofExactOfSection
      (S.map F) hSV.exact s hs hSV.mono_f
  exact ⟨
    { U := V
      mem := hxV
      I := I
      J := J
      finiteI := inferInstance
      finiteJ := inferInstance
      rank₁ := hrank₁
      rank₃ := hrank₃
      e₁ := e₁V
      e₃ := e₃V
      splitting := split }⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.determinantLocalDataAt_coversTop
statement:
theorem determinantLocalDataAt_coversTop
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (h₁ : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X S.X₁)
    (h₃ : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X S.X₃) :
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop
      (fun x : X ↦ (determinantLocalDataAt X S hS h₁ h₃ x).U)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Opens.coversTop_iff, IsOpenCover]
  apply top_unique
  intro x hx
  change x ∈ ((⨆ y : X,
    (determinantLocalDataAt X S hS h₁ h₃ y).U : X.Opens) : Set X)
  rw [Opens.coe_iSup]
  exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
    ⟨x, (determinantLocalDataAt X S hS h₁ h₃ x).mem⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.determinantLocalHomAt_isIso
statement:
theorem determinantLocalHomAt_isIso
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (h₁ : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X S.X₁)
    (h₃ : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X S.X₃) (x : X) :
    IsIso (determinantLocalHomAt X S hS h₁ h₃ x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let d := determinantLocalDataAt X S hS h₁ h₃ x
  letI : Fintype d.I := Fintype.ofFinite d.I
  letI : Fintype d.J := Fintype.ofFinite d.J
  letI : LinearOrder d.I := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
  letI : LinearOrder d.J := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
  have hrank₁ : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X S.X₁ =
      Fintype.card d.I := by
    simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using d.rank₁
  have hrank₃ : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X S.X₃ =
      Fintype.card d.J := by
    simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using d.rank₃
  change IsIso (localSplitDeterminantHom X d.U d.splitting
    (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X S.X₁)
    (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X S.X₃))
  rw [hrank₁, hrank₃]
  exact localSplitDeterminantHom_isIso X d.U d.splitting d.I d.J d.e₁ d.e₃

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.determinantLocalHomAt_compatible
statement:
theorem determinantLocalHomAt_compatible
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (h₁ : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X S.X₁)
    (h₃ : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X S.X₃) :
    Presheaf.FamilyOfElementsOnObjects.IsCompatible
      (fun x : X ↦ localHomSection X
        (determinantLocalDataAt X S hS h₁ h₃ x).U
        (determinantLocalHomAt X S hS h₁ h₃ x))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro Z x y f g
  let dx := determinantLocalDataAt X S hS h₁ h₃ x
  let dy := determinantLocalDataAt X S hS h₁ h₃ y
  have hZx : Z ≤ dx.U := f.le
  have hZy : Z ≤ dy.U := g.le
  rw [show f = homOfLE hZx from Subsingleton.elim _ _,
    show g = homOfLE hZy from Subsingleton.elim _ _,
    sheafHom_map_localHomSection, sheafHom_map_localHomSection]
  change (SheafOfModules.toSheaf (X.ringCatSheaf.over Z)).map
      (restrictHomOverLE X hZx (determinantLocalHomAt X S hS h₁ h₃ x)) =
    (SheafOfModules.toSheaf (X.ringCatSheaf.over Z)).map
      (restrictHomOverLE X hZy (determinantLocalHomAt X S hS h₁ h₃ y))
  apply congrArg (SheafOfModules.toSheaf (X.ringCatSheaf.over Z)).map
  change restrictHomOverLE X hZx
      (localSplitDeterminantHom X dx.U dx.splitting
        (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X S.X₁)
        (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X S.X₃)) =
    restrictHomOverLE X hZy
      (localSplitDeterminantHom X dy.U dy.splitting
        (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X S.X₁)
        (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X S.X₃))
  rw [restrictHomOverLE_localSplitDeterminantHom,
    restrictHomOverLE_localSplitDeterminantHom]
  letI : Fintype dx.I := Fintype.ofFinite dx.I
  letI : Fintype dx.J := Fintype.ofFinite dx.J
  letI : LinearOrder dx.I := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
  letI : LinearOrder dx.J := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
  have hrank₁ : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X S.X₁ =
      Fintype.card dx.I := by
    simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using dx.rank₁
  have hrank₃ : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X S.X₃ =
      Fintype.card dx.J := by
    simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using dx.rank₃
  rw [hrank₁, hrank₃]
  let F := SheafOfModules.overMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hZx)
  let e₁Z : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over Z) dx.I ≅ S.X₁.over Z :=
    freeOverMapIso X dx.U Z hZx dx.I ≪≫ F.mapIso dx.e₁ ≪≫
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hZx)).app S.X₁
  let e₃Z : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over Z) dx.J ≅ S.X₃.over Z :=
    freeOverMapIso X dx.U Z hZx dx.J ≪≫ F.mapIso dx.e₃ ≪≫
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hZx)).app S.X₃
  exact localSplitDeterminantHom_independent_of_splitting X Z
    (splittingOverLE X hZx dx.splitting)
    (splittingOverLE X hZy dy.splitting) dx.I dx.J e₁Z e₃Z

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.determinantShortExactHom_over
statement:
lemma determinantShortExactHom_over
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (h₁ : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X S.X₁)
    (h₃ : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X S.X₃) (x : X) :
    (determinantShortExactHom X S hS h₁ h₃).over
        (determinantLocalDataAt X S hS h₁ h₃ x).U =
      determinantLocalHomAt X S hS h₁ h₃ x
proof:
:= by
  exact glueHom_over X
    (fun x : X ↦ (determinantLocalDataAt X S hS h₁ h₃ x).U)
    (determinantLocalDataAt_coversTop X S hS h₁ h₃)
    (determinantLocalHomAt X S hS h₁ h₃)
    (determinantLocalHomAt_compatible X S hS h₁ h₃) x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.determinantShortExactHom_isIso
statement:
theorem determinantShortExactHom_isIso
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (h₁ : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X S.X₁)
    (h₃ : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X S.X₃) :
    IsIso (determinantShortExactHom X S hS h₁ h₃)
proof:
:= by
  exact glueHom_isIso X
    (fun x : X ↦ (determinantLocalDataAt X S hS h₁ h₃ x).U)
    (determinantLocalDataAt_coversTop X S hS h₁ h₃)
    (determinantLocalHomAt X S hS h₁ h₃)
    (determinantLocalHomAt_compatible X S hS h₁ h₃)
    (determinantLocalHomAt_isIso X S hS h₁ h₃)

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.polynomial_map_mem_reesAlgebra_map
statement:
theorem polynomial_map_mem_reesAlgebra_map
    (e : R ≃+* S) (I : Ideal R) (p : reesAlgebra I) :
    Polynomial.map e.toRingHom (p : R[X]) ∈
      reesAlgebra (I.map e.toRingHom)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_reesAlgebra_iff]
  intro n
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_map, ← Ideal.map_pow]
  exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem e.toRingHom (p.2 n)

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv_apply
    (e : R ≃+* S) (I : Ideal R) (p : reesAlgebra I) :
    ((reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv e I p : reesAlgebra (I.map e.toRingHom)) :
        S[X]) =
      Polynomial.map e.toRingHom (p : R[X])
proof:
:=

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv_symm_apply
    (e : R ≃+* S) (I : Ideal R)
    (q : reesAlgebra (I.map e.toRingHom)) :
    (((reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv e I).symm q : reesAlgebra I) : R[X]) =

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.gradedReesEquivHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gradedReesEquivHom_apply
    (e : R ≃+* S) (I : Ideal R) (p : reesAlgebra I) :
    gradedReesEquivHom e I p = reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv e I p
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.gradedReesEquivInv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gradedReesEquivInv_apply
    (e : R ≃+* S) (I : Ideal R)
    (q : reesAlgebra (I.map e.toRingHom)) :
    gradedReesEquivInv e I q = (reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv e I).symm q

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.gradedReesEquivInv_comp_hom
statement:
theorem gradedReesEquivInv_comp_hom (e : R ≃+* S) (I : Ideal R) :
    (gradedReesEquivInv e I).comp (gradedReesEquivHom e I) =
      GradedRingHom.id (grading I)
proof:
:= by
  apply DFunLike.ext _ _
  intro p
  change
    (reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv e I).symm
        (reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv e I p) = p
  exact (reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv e I).symm_apply_apply p

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.gradedReesEquivHom_comp_inv
statement:
theorem gradedReesEquivHom_comp_inv (e : R ≃+* S) (I : Ideal R) :
    (gradedReesEquivHom e I).comp (gradedReesEquivInv e I) =
      GradedRingHom.id (grading (I.map e.toRingHom))
proof:
:= by
  apply DFunLike.ext _ _
  intro q
  change
    reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv e I
        ((reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv e I).symm q) = q
  exact (reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv e I).apply_symm_apply q

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivHom
statement:
theorem irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivHom
    (e : R ≃+* S) (I : Ideal R) :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading (I.map e.toRingHom)) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading I)).map (gradedReesEquivHom e I)
proof:
:= by
  refine (HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_irrelevant_le
    (grading (I.map e.toRingHom))).2 ?_
  intro d hd q hq
  have hq' :
      (reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv e I).symm q ∈ grading I d :=
    (gradedReesEquivInv e I).map_mem hq
  have hirr :
      (reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv e I).symm q ∈
        HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading I) :=
    HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem (grading I) hd hq'
  rw [← (reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv e I).apply_symm_apply q]
  exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (gradedReesEquivHom e I) hirr

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivInv
statement:
theorem irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivInv
    (e : R ≃+* S) (I : Ideal R) :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading I) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading (I.map e.toRingHom))).map
        (gradedReesEquivInv e I)
proof:
:= by
  refine (HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_irrelevant_le (grading I)).2 ?_
  intro d hd p hp
  have hp' : reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv e I p ∈
      grading (I.map e.toRingHom) d :=
    (gradedReesEquivHom e I).map_mem hp
  have hirr : reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv e I p ∈
      HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading (I.map e.toRingHom)) :=
    HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem
      (grading (I.map e.toRingHom)) hd hp'
  rw [← (reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv e I).symm_apply_apply p]
  exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (gradedReesEquivInv e I) hirr

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesProjMapOfRingEquiv_comp_inv
statement:
theorem reesProjMapOfRingEquiv_comp_inv (e : R ≃+* S) (I : Ideal R) :
    reesProjMapOfRingEquiv e I ≫ reesProjMapOfRingEquivInv e I =
      𝟙 (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading (I.map e.toRingHom)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold reesProjMapOfRingEquiv reesProjMapOfRingEquivInv
  calc
    AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map (gradedReesEquivHom e I)
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivHom e I) ≫
        AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map (gradedReesEquivInv e I)
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivInv e I) =
      AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map
        ((gradedReesEquivHom e I).comp (gradedReesEquivInv e I))
        (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivInv e I)
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivHom e I)) := by
      exact (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map_comp
        (gradedReesEquivInv e I) (gradedReesEquivHom e I)
        (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivInv e I)
        (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivHom e I)).symm
    _ = 𝟙 (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading (I.map e.toRingHom))) := by
      convert AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map_id
      rw [gradedReesEquivHom_comp_inv]

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesProjMapOfRingEquivInv_comp
statement:
theorem reesProjMapOfRingEquivInv_comp (e : R ≃+* S) (I : Ideal R) :
    reesProjMapOfRingEquivInv e I ≫ reesProjMapOfRingEquiv e I =
      𝟙 (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading I))
proof:
:= by
  unfold reesProjMapOfRingEquiv reesProjMapOfRingEquivInv
  calc
    AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map (gradedReesEquivInv e I)
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivInv e I) ≫
        AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map (gradedReesEquivHom e I)
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivHom e I) =
      AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map
        ((gradedReesEquivInv e I).comp (gradedReesEquivHom e I))
        (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivHom e I)
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivInv e I)) := by
      exact (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map_comp
        (gradedReesEquivHom e I) (gradedReesEquivInv e I)
        (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivHom e I)
        (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivInv e I)).symm
    _ = 𝟙 (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading I)) := by
      convert AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map_id
      rw [gradedReesEquivInv_comp_hom]

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.degreeZeroAlgEquiv_gradedReesEquivHom
statement:
theorem degreeZeroAlgEquiv_gradedReesEquivHom
    (e : R ≃+* S) (I : Ideal R) :
    (degreeZeroAlgEquiv (I.map e.toRingHom)).toRingHom.comp
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.degreeZeroMap (gradedReesEquivHom e I)) =
      e.toRingHom.comp (degreeZeroAlgEquiv I).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  exact Polynomial.coeff_map e.toRingHom 0

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.degreeZeroMap_gradedReesEquivHom_comp_degreeZeroAlgEquiv_symm
statement:
theorem degreeZeroMap_gradedReesEquivHom_comp_degreeZeroAlgEquiv_symm
    (e : R ≃+* S) (I : Ideal R) :
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.degreeZeroMap (gradedReesEquivHom e I)).comp
        (degreeZeroAlgEquiv I).symm.toRingHom =
      (degreeZeroAlgEquiv (I.map e.toRingHom)).symm.toRingHom.comp e.toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro r
  apply (degreeZeroAlgEquiv (I.map e.toRingHom)).injective
  have h := RingHom.congr_fun
    (degreeZeroAlgEquiv_gradedReesEquivHom e I)
    ((degreeZeroAlgEquiv I).symm r)
  change
    degreeZeroAlgEquiv (I.map e.toRingHom)
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.degreeZeroMap (gradedReesEquivHom e I)
          ((degreeZeroAlgEquiv I).symm r)) =
      degreeZeroAlgEquiv (I.map e.toRingHom)
        ((degreeZeroAlgEquiv (I.map e.toRingHom)).symm (e r))
  rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  change
    degreeZeroAlgEquiv (I.map e.toRingHom)
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.degreeZeroMap (gradedReesEquivHom e I)
          ((degreeZeroAlgEquiv I).symm r)) =
      e (degreeZeroAlgEquiv I ((degreeZeroAlgEquiv I).symm r)) at h
  rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesProjMapOfRingEquiv_toSpec
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem reesProjMapOfRingEquiv_toSpec (e : R ≃+* S) (I : Ideal R) :
    reesProjMapOfRingEquiv e I ≫ reesProjToSpec I =
      reesProjToSpec (I.map e.toRingHom) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom e.toRingHom)
proof:
:= by
  unfold reesProjMapOfRingEquiv reesProjToSpec
  rw [← Category.assoc, AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map_toSpecZero]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  apply congrArg (fun k ↦
    AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.toSpecZero (grading (I.map e.toRingHom)) ≫ k)
  rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
  exact degreeZeroMap_gradedReesEquivHom_comp_degreeZeroAlgEquiv_symm e I

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.AffineOverlapComparison.projIso_hom_toSpec
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem projIso_hom_toSpec (c : AffineOverlapComparison I J) :

      reesProjToSpec J ≫

proof:

  subst J

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.PairwiseAtlas.tripleToChart_toBase
statement:
theorem tripleToChart_toBase (U V W : X.affineOpens) :
    a.tripleToChart U V W ≫ chartToBase I V =
      pullback.snd (overlapToChart I U V) (overlapToChart I U W) ≫
        overlapToChart I U W ≫ chartToBase I U
proof:
:= by
  unfold tripleToChart
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← a.transition_toBase U V]
  rw [← Category.assoc, pullback.condition]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.PairwiseAtlas.tripleToChart_range
statement:
theorem tripleToChart_range (U V W : X.affineOpens) :
    Set.range (a.tripleToChart U V W) ⊆
      Set.range (overlapToChart I V W)
proof:
:= by
  rintro y ⟨x, rfl⟩
  let z : overlap I U W :=
    pullback.snd (overlapToChart I U V) (overlapToChart I U W) x
  let b : X := chartToBase I V (a.tripleToChart U V W x)
  have hbV : b ∈ V.1 := by
    change (chartToBase I V (a.tripleToChart U V W x)) ∈ V.1
    rw [← chartToOpen_comp_ι, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact ((chartToOpen I V) (a.tripleToChart U V W x)).2
  have hbase :
      chartToBase I V (a.tripleToChart U V W x) =
        chartToBase I U (overlapToChart I U W z) := by
    simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using
      congrArg (fun f : tripleOverlap I U V W ⟶ X ↦ f x)
        (a.tripleToChart_toBase U V W)
  have hbW : b ∈ W.1 := by
    change chartToBase I V (a.tripleToChart U V W x) ∈ W.1
    rw [hbase]
    have hUW :
        overlapToChart I U W ≫ chartToBase I U =
          overlapToIntersection I U W ≫ (U.1 ⊓ W.1).ι := by
      rw [← chartToOpen_comp_ι, ← Category.assoc, overlapToChart_toOpen]
      simp only [Category.assoc, Scheme.homOfLE_ι]
    rw [show chartToBase I U (overlapToChart I U W z) =
        (U.1 ⊓ W.1).ι (overlapToIntersection I U W z) by
      simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using
        congrArg (fun f : overlap I U W ⟶ X ↦ f z) hUW]
    exact (overlapToIntersection I U W z).2.2
  let q : (V.1 ⊓ W.1).toScheme := ⟨b, hbV, hbW⟩
  have hq :
      chartToOpen I V (a.tripleToChart U V W x) =
        X.homOfLE (inf_le_left : V.1 ⊓ W.1 ≤ V.1) q := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change V.1.ι (chartToOpen I V (a.tripleToChart U V W x)) =
      V.1.ι (X.homOfLE (inf_le_left : V.1 ⊓ W.1 ≤ V.1) q)
    rw [show V.1.ι (chartToOpen I V (a.tripleToChart U V W x)) =
        chartToBase I V (a.tripleToChart U V W x) by
      simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using
        congrArg (fun f : chart I V ⟶ X ↦ f (a.tripleToChart U V W x))
          (chartToOpen_comp_ι I V)]
    rw [show V.1.ι (X.homOfLE (inf_le_left : V.1 ⊓ W.1 ≤ V.1) q) =
        (V.1 ⊓ W.1).ι q by
      simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using
        congrArg (fun f : (V.1 ⊓ W.1).toScheme ⟶ X ↦ f q)
          (Scheme.homOfLE_ι X (inf_le_left : V.1 ⊓ W.1 ≤ V.1))]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨t, ht, -⟩ := Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback
    (a.tripleToChart U V W x) q hq
  exact ⟨t, ht⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.e4_linearMap_ext_of_prime
statement:
theorem e4_linearMap_ext_of_prime {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module ℚ N] (m : ℕ)
    (f g : RationalDimChow X m →ₗ[ℚ] N)
    (h : ∀ (v : X) (hv : height v = m),
      f ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v m hv) : DimChow X m)) =
        g ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v m hv) : DimChow X m))) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  have hD : ∀ D : dimensionCycles X m,
      (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X m) ∈ LinearMap.eqLocus f g := by
    intro D
    exact m7s_mem_of_prime (LinearMap.eqLocus f g) Set.univ
      (fun v hv _ ↦ h v hv) D (Set.subset_univ _)
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro c
  induction c using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul q x =>
    induction x using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H D =>
      have h1 := hD D
      have h2 : f ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X m)) =
        g ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X m)) := h1
      have h3 : q ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X m) =
          q • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X m)) := by
        rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      rw [h3, map_smul, map_smul, h2]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.e4_weilDivisor_mapIso
statement:
theorem e4_weilDivisor_mapIso {W : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral W] [IsLocallyNoetherian W]
    {M N : W.Modules} {w : W}
    (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree W M) (hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree W N)
    (hrM : SingularCurve.genericRank W M = 1) (hrN : SingularCurve.genericRank W N = 1)
    (b : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData W M w) (e : M ≅ N) :
    Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hN hrN (b.mapIso e) =
      Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hM hrM b
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext p
  let d := Scheme.Modules.lineBundleLocalDataAt W M hM hrM p
  rw [Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame_apply,
    Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame_apply,
    Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame_eq_on_localData hM hrM b d p d.mem,
    Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame_eq_on_localData hN hrN (b.mapIso e)
      (d.mapIso e) p d.mem,
    Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.regularTransitionFunction_mapIso]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.cap_tensor_component
statement:
theorem cap_tensor_component (L M : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1) (hLM : HasConstantRank X (tensorSheaf X L M) 1) (m : ℕ) :
    ops.cap (tensorSheaf X L M) hLM m = ops.cap L hL m + ops.cap M hM m
proof:
:= by
  apply e4_linearMap_ext_of_prime
  intro v hv
  let P := pointClosureι v
  have hfL := isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL v
  have hfM := isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure M hM v
  have hfLM := isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure (tensorSheaf X L M) hLM v
  have hrL := genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one L hL v
  have hrM := genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one M hM v
  have hrLM := genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one (tensorSheaf X L M) hLM v
  obtain ⟨b⟩ := Scheme.Modules.exists_lineBundleLocalDataAt (pointClosureScheme v)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P).obj L) hfL hrL (pointClosureGenericPoint v)
  obtain ⟨c⟩ := Scheme.Modules.exists_lineBundleLocalDataAt (pointClosureScheme v)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P).obj M) hfM hrM (pointClosureGenericPoint v)
  haveI : IsIso (pullbackTensorSheafHom P L M) :=
    pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_isFiniteLocallyFree P L M hL.isFiniteLocallyFree
      hM.isFiniteLocallyFree
  let e := asIso (pullbackTensorSheafHom P L M)
  have hT : IsFiniteLocallyFree (pointClosureScheme v)
      (tensorSheaf (pointClosureScheme v) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P).obj L)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P).obj M)) :=
    isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso _ e hfLM
  have hrT : SingularCurve.genericRank (pointClosureScheme v)
      (tensorSheaf (pointClosureScheme v) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P).obj L)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P).obj M)) = 1 :=
    (SingularCurve.genericRank_iso (pointClosureScheme v) e).symm.trans hrLM
  let bLM := (b.tensor c).mapIso e.symm
  have hdiv : Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hfLM hrLM bLM =
      Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hfL hrL b +
        Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hfM hrM c := by
    rw [e4_weilDivisor_mapIso hT hfLM hrT hrLM (b.tensor c) e.symm,
      Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame_tensor hfL hfM hT hrL hrM hrT b c]
  have hmL := m7s_pushWeil_mem (k := k) L hL m v hv b
  have hmM := m7s_pushWeil_mem (k := k) M hM m v hv c
  have hmLM := m7s_pushWeil_mem (k := k) (tensorSheaf X L M) hLM m v hv bLM
  have hsum : properPushforward P
      (Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hfLM hrLM bLM).1 =
      properPushforward P (Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hfL hrL b).1 +
        properPushforward P (Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hfM hrM c).1 := by
    rw [hdiv, ← properPushforward_add]
    rfl
  rw [LinearMap.add_apply,
    ops.cap_mk (tensorSheaf X L M) hLM m v hv hrLM bLM ⟨_, hmLM⟩ rfl,
    ops.cap_mk L hL m v hv hrL b ⟨_, hmL⟩ rfl,
    ops.cap_mk M hM m v hv hrM c ⟨_, hmM⟩ rfl,
    ← TensorProduct.tmul_add, ← QuotientAddGroup.mk_add]
  congr 2
  exact Subtype.ext hsum

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.totalCap_tensor
statement:
theorem totalCap_tensor (L M : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1) (hLM : HasConstantRank X (tensorSheaf X L M) 1) :
    totalCap ops (tensorSheaf X L M) hLM = totalCap ops L hL + totalCap ops M hM
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro c
  simp only [totalCap, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, DirectSum.toModule_lof]
  cases n with
  | zero => simp [capComponent]
  | succ m =>
    simp only [capComponent, LinearMap.comp_apply, cap_tensor_component ops L M hL hM hLM m,
      LinearMap.add_apply, map_add]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.totalCap_tensor'
statement:
theorem totalCap_tensor' (L M : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1) :
    ∃ hLM : HasConstantRank X (tensorSheaf X L M) 1,
      totalCap ops (tensorSheaf X L M) hLM = totalCap ops L hL + totalCap ops M hM
proof:
:= by
  have h := hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hL hM
  rw [Nat.one_mul] at h
  exact ⟨h, totalCap_tensor ops L M hL hM h⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K8.capDivisorGateOn_of_cycleIdentity
statement:
theorem capDivisorGateOn_of_cycleIdentity {B D : X.Modules} {b : B ⟶ D} (P : PairCover b)
    [Fact (Cl P.toB.scheme)] [Fact (Cl P.toD.scheme)]
    {L : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) {e : ℕ}
    (hCB : ∀ i, Nat.card (P.toB.basisIndex i) = e + 1 + 1)
    (hCD : ∀ i, Nat.card (P.toD.basisIndex i) = e + 1)
    (hI : E21.CartierCycleIdentity (k := k) P hL (cp.projBundle_relDim P.toB hCB)
      (cp.projBundle_relDim P.toD hCD)) :
    CapDivisorGateOn ops cp P hL hCB hCD
proof:
:= by
  intro β
  have hlin : totalPushOn ops P.jHom ∘ₗ pullProjOn ops cp P.toD hCD =
      totalCapOn ops (E16.twistedLine P.toB L) (E16.hasConstantRank_twistedLine P.toB hL) ∘ₗ
        pullProjOn ops cp P.toB hCB := by
    apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
    intro n
    apply D13.ratLinear_ext
    intro Z
    have h1 := hI n Z
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, pullProjOn, totalPullOn, DirectSum.toModule_lof,
      totalPushOn, totalCapOn]
    rw [pull_eq_pullD2On, pull_eq_pullD2On, D2.pullD2_mk, D2.pullD2_mk,
      push_eq_pushD9On, D9.pushD9_mk0]
    change _ = capComponentOn ops (E16.twistedLine P.toB L)
      (E16.hasConstantRank_twistedLine P.toB hL) (n + e + 1) _
    simp only [capComponentOn, LinearMap.comp_apply]
    rw [cap_anchorOn ops]
    exact congrArg (fun c : DimChow P.toB.scheme (n + e) =>
      DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n => RationalDimChow P.toB.scheme n) (n + e)
        ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] c)) h1
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun hlin β

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K8.fibreGateOn_holds

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K8.cartierCapGateOn_of_divisorGate
statement:
theorem cartierCapGateOn_of_divisorGate {B D : X.Modules} {b : B ⟶ D}
    (P : PairCover b) [Fact (Cl P.toB.scheme)] [Fact (Cl P.toD.scheme)]
    {L : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) {e : ℕ}
    (hCB : ∀ i, Nat.card (P.toB.basisIndex i) = e + 1 + 1)
    (hCD : ∀ i, Nat.card (P.toD.basisIndex i) = e + 1)
    (hW : E21.DivisorGate (k := k) P hL e) :
    CartierCapGateOn ops cp P hL hCB hCD
proof:
:= by
  intro σ hreg hid
  refine capDivisorGateOn_of_cycleIdentity ops cp P hL hCB hCD ?_
  refine E21.cartierCycleIdentity_of_primeFibreIdentity P hL _ _ ?_
  intro m v hv
  obtain ⟨w, hw, q, hq, hB, hD⟩ := fibreGateOn_holds ops cp P hCB hCD m v hv
  exact ⟨w, hw, q, hq, hB, hD, hW σ hreg hid m v hv w hw q hq hB hD⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K8.cartierCapGateOn_of_weilGate
statement:
theorem cartierCapGateOn_of_weilGate {B D : X.Modules} {b : B ⟶ D} (P : PairCover b)
    [Fact (Cl P.toB.scheme)] [Fact (Cl P.toD.scheme)]
    {L : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) {e : ℕ}
    (hCB : ∀ i, Nat.card (P.toB.basisIndex i) = e + 1 + 1)
    (hCD : ∀ i, Nat.card (P.toD.basisIndex i) = e + 1)
    (hW : E21.WeilGate P hL e) : CartierCapGateOn ops cp P hL hCB hCD
proof:

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_chartι_opensRange
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_chartι_opensRange (i : C.I) :
    (C.chartι i).opensRange = C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i
proof:
:= by
  have h := C.isPullback_chartι_toBase i
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro x ⟨y, rfl⟩
    change C.toBase (C.chartι i y) ∈ C.U i
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, C.chartι_toBase, ← C.chartToBase_comp_openImmersion,
      Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact (C.chartToBase i y).2
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, -⟩ := Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback (f := C.toBase)
      (g := (C.U i).ι) x ⟨C.toBase x, hx⟩ rfl
    exact ⟨h.isoPullback.inv z, by rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, h.isoPullback_inv_fst, hz]⟩

statement: theorem a11_basis_nonempty (i : C.I) (y : C.chart i) : Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)
proof:
:= by

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.a11_isIntegral_of_surjective
statement:
theorem a11_isIntegral_of_surjective [IsIntegral X]
    (hsurj : ∀ x : X, ∃ p : C.scheme, C.toBase p = x) : IsIntegral C.scheme
proof:
:= by
  have hnon : Nonempty C.scheme := by
    obtain ⟨p, _⟩ := hsurj (Classical.choice inferInstance)
    exact ⟨p⟩
  
  haveI : IsReduced C.scheme := by
    haveI : ∀ x : C.scheme, _root_.IsReduced (C.scheme.presheaf.stalk x) := by
      intro x
      obtain ⟨i, y, hy⟩ := C.cover.exists_eq x
      haveI : IsDomain Γ(X, C.U i) := C.a11_chart_isDomain i y
      haveI : IsDomain ((C.chart i).presheaf.stalk y) :=
        a11_stalk_isDomain Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) y
      subst hy
      exact isReduced_of_injective ((C.chartι i).stalkMap y).hom
        (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _).1
    exact isReduced_of_isReduced_stalk _
  
  have hchart : ∀ (i : C.I) (_ : C.chart i), IrreducibleSpace (C.chart i) := by
    intro i y
    haveI : IsDomain Γ(X, C.U i) := C.a11_chart_isDomain i y
    obtain ⟨k⟩ := C.a11_basis_nonempty i y
    exact a11_irreducibleSpace Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i k)
      (a11_linearForm_ne_zero (C.sectionBasis i) k)
  have hrange : ∀ i, ((C.chartι i).opensRange : Set C.scheme) = C.toBase ⁻¹' (C.U i : Set X) := by
    intro i
    rw [tautQuotient_chartι_opensRange]
    rfl
  let V : {i : C.I // (C.U i : Set X).Nonempty} → C.scheme.Opens :=
    fun j => (C.chartι j.1).opensRange
  have hover : ∀ j : {i : C.I // (C.U i : Set X).Nonempty}, ∀ x : X, x ∈ (C.U j.1 : Set X) →
      ∃ y : C.chart j.1, C.toBase (C.chartι j.1 y) = x := by
    intro j x hx
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hsurj x
    have : p ∈ ((C.chartι j.1).opensRange : Set C.scheme) := by
      rw [hrange]; exact Set.mem_preimage.mpr (by rw [hp]; exact hx)
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := this
    exact ⟨y, by rw [hy, hp]⟩
  have hirr : ∀ j, IsPreirreducible (V j : Set C.scheme) := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := j.2
    obtain ⟨y, _⟩ := hover j x hx
    haveI := hchart j.1 y
    have := (IrreducibleSpace.isIrreducible_univ (C.chart j.1)).image (C.chartι j.1)
      (C.chartι j.1).continuous.continuousOn
    rw [Set.image_univ] at this
    exact this.isPreirreducible
  have hn : Pairwise ((¬ Disjoint · ·) on V) := by
    intro i j _
    obtain ⟨x, -, hxi, hxj⟩ := (IrreducibleSpace.isIrreducible_univ X).isPreirreducible
      (C.U i.1).1 (C.U j.1).1 (C.U i.1).2 (C.U j.1).2 (by simpa using i.2) (by simpa using j.2)
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hsurj x
    intro hd
    have h1 := disjoint_iff.mp hd
    have hpi : p ∈ (V i : Set C.scheme) := by
      show p ∈ ((C.chartι i.1).opensRange : Set C.scheme)
      rw [hrange]; exact Set.mem_preimage.mpr (by rw [hp]; exact hxi)
    have hpj : p ∈ (V j : Set C.scheme) := by
      show p ∈ ((C.chartι j.1).opensRange : Set C.scheme)
      rw [hrange]; exact Set.mem_preimage.mpr (by rw [hp]; exact hxj)
    have : p ∈ (V i ⊓ V j : C.scheme.Opens) := ⟨hpi, hpj⟩
    rw [h1] at this
    exact this
  haveI : IrreducibleSpace C.scheme :=
    { isPreirreducible_univ :=
        IsPreirreducible.of_subset_iUnion hn hirr isOpen_univ (by
          intro z _
          have hz : C.toBase z ∈ ⋃ i, (C.U i : Set X) := by
            rw [C.covers.iSup_set_eq_univ]; trivial
          obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hz
          refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨i, ⟨_, hi⟩⟩, ?_⟩
          show z ∈ ((C.chartι i).opensRange : Set C.scheme)
          rw [hrange]; exact hi)
      toNonempty := hnon }
  exact isIntegral_of_irreducibleSpace_of_isReduced _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.localChartSection_chartToAmbient
statement:
theorem localChartSection_chartToAmbient (i : C.I)
    (φ : E.val.obj (op (C.U i)) →ₗ[Γ(X, C.U i)] Γ(X, C.U i))
    (hφ : Submodule.span Γ(X, C.U i) (Set.range φ) = ⊤) :
    C.localChartSection i φ hφ ≫ C.chartToAmbient i = (C.U i).ι
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := localSection_toSpec_assoc φ hφ ((C.isAffine i).isoSpec.inv ≫ (C.U i).ι)
  have h2 : (C.isAffine i).isoSpec.hom ≫ (C.isAffine i).isoSpec.inv ≫ (C.U i).ι = (C.U i).ι :=
    Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc _ _
  change (C.isAffine i).isoSpec.hom ≫ localSection φ hφ ≫
        ((Proj.toSpecZero (symGrading Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))) ≫
          Spec.map (degreeZeroAlgEquiv (R := Γ(X, C.U i))
            (M := E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))).symm.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.hom) ≫
          (C.isAffine i).isoSpec.inv) ≫ (C.U i).ι = _
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  exact (congrArg (fun g ↦ (C.isAffine i).isoSpec.hom ≫ g) h1).trans h2

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.toBase_surjective_of_nonempty_basis
statement:
theorem toBase_surjective_of_nonempty_basis
    (hne : ∀ i, (C.U i : Set X).Nonempty → Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) (x : X) :
    ∃ p : C.scheme, C.toBase p = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp (by
    rw [C.covers.iSup_set_eq_univ]; exact Set.mem_univ x : x ∈ ⋃ i, (C.U i : Set X))
  obtain ⟨k⟩ := hne i ⟨x, hi⟩
  let φ : E.val.obj (op (C.U i)) →ₗ[Γ(X, C.U i)] Γ(X, C.U i) := (C.sectionBasis i).coord k
  have hφ : Submodule.span Γ(X, C.U i) (Set.range φ) = ⊤ :=
    span_range_eq_top_of_one_mem φ ⟨C.sectionBasis i k, by simp [φ]⟩
  refine ⟨C.chartι i (C.localChartSection i φ hφ ⟨x, hi⟩), ?_⟩
  have h1 : C.toBase (C.chartι i (C.localChartSection i φ hφ ⟨x, hi⟩)) =
      (C.chartι i ≫ C.toBase) (C.localChartSection i φ hφ ⟨x, hi⟩) := rfl
  rw [h1, C.chartι_toBase, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, C.localChartSection_chartToAmbient]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.isIntegral_scheme

name: SchemeKTheory.exists_mem_localGenerators
statement:
theorem exists_mem_localGenerators {M : Y.Modules}
    (q : SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.{u} M) (x : Y) : ∃ i, x ∈ q.X i

name: SchemeKTheory.rankAt_eq_card_of_mem
statement:
theorem rankAt_eq_card_of_mem {M : Y.Modules} (q : SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.{u} M)
    [q.IsLocallyFreeData] [q.IsFiniteType] (i : q.I) {x : Y} (hx : x ∈ q.X i) :
    rankAt x M = Nat.card (q.generators i).I
proof:
:= by
  letI instWOverAb : ∀ U : Y.Opens,
      ((Opens.grothendieckTopology ↥Y).over U).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u} :=
    fun U ↦ inferInstance
  letI instHOverAb : ∀ U : Y.Opens,
      HasWeakSheafify ((Opens.grothendieckTopology ↥Y).over U) AddCommGrpCat.{u} :=
    fun U ↦ inferInstance
  let G := q.generators i
  have hG : G.IsFiniteType :=
    SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType i
  letI : Finite G.I := hG.finite
  let eOver : (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) G.I).over (q.X i) ≅
      M.over (q.X i) :=
    (SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso Y (q.X i) G.I).symm ≪≫ asIso G.π
  let e := stalkFreeLinearEquivAtOfOverIso M x (q.X i) hx G.I eOver
  have h := SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleQuillen.rankAt_free x G.I
  exact e.finrank_eq.symm.trans h

name: SchemeKTheory.rankAt_of_hasConstantRank
statement:
theorem rankAt_of_hasConstantRank {M : Y.Modules} {r : ℕ} (h : HasConstantRank Y M r) (x : Y) :
    rankAt x M = r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin, hcard⟩ := h
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := hqfin
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_mem_localGenerators q x
  exact (rankAt_eq_card_of_mem q i hi).trans (hcard i)

name: SchemeKTheory.rankAt_tensorSheaf
statement:
theorem rankAt_tensorSheaf {M N : Y.Modules} (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y M)
    (hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y N) (x : Y) :
    rankAt x (tensorSheaf Y M N) = rankAt x M * rankAt x N
proof:
:= by
  letI instWOverAb : ∀ U : Y.Opens,
      ((Opens.grothendieckTopology ↥Y).over U).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u} :=
    fun U ↦ inferInstance
  letI instHOverAb : ∀ U : Y.Opens,
      HasWeakSheafify ((Opens.grothendieckTopology ↥Y).over U) AddCommGrpCat.{u} :=
    fun U ↦ inferInstance
  obtain ⟨qM, hqM, hqMfin⟩ := hM.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  obtain ⟨qN, hqN, hqNfin⟩ := hN.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_mem_localGenerators qM x
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_mem_localGenerators qN x
  have hij : x ∈ (@tensorLocalGeneratorsData Y M N qM qN hqM hqN).X (i, j) := by
    change x ∈ qM.X i ⊓ qN.X j
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_inf.mpr ⟨hi, hj⟩
  have h0 := @rankAt_eq_card_of_mem Y _ (@tensorLocalGeneratorsData Y M N qM qN hqM hqN) _ _
    (i, j) x hij
  have h1 := @rankAt_eq_card_of_mem Y _ qM hqM hqMfin i x hi
  have h2 := @rankAt_eq_card_of_mem Y _ qN hqN hqNfin j x hj
  have h3 : ∀ p : qM.I × qN.I,
      Nat.card ((@tensorLocalGeneratorsData Y M N qM qN hqM hqN).generators p).I =
        Nat.card (qM.generators p.1).I * Nat.card (qN.generators p.2).I := by
    intro p
    change Nat.card (Σ _ : (qM.generators p.1).I, (qN.generators p.2).I) = _
    exact (Nat.card_congr (Equiv.sigmaEquivProd (qM.generators p.1).I
      (qN.generators p.2).I)).trans (Nat.card_prod _ _)
  exact (h0.trans (h3 (i, j))).trans (congrArg₂ (· * ·) h1.symm h2.symm)

name: SchemeKTheory.rankAt_pullback
statement:
theorem rankAt_pullback {Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ Z) (M : Z.Modules)
    (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree Z M) (y : Y) :
    rankAt y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M) = rankAt (f y) M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin⟩ := hM.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := hqfin
  let C := pullbackLocalGeneratorsOpenCover f q
  let I : C.I₀ → Type u := fun i ↦ (q.generators i).I
  letI : ∀ i, Finite (I i) := fun i ↦ by
    letI : (q.generators i).IsFiniteType :=
      SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType i
    dsimp only [I]
    infer_instance
  let q' := freeTrivializedOpenCoverLocalGeneratorsData C ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M) I
    (pullbackLocalGeneratorsOpenCoverIso f q)
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_mem_localGenerators q' y
  have hfi : f y ∈ q.X i := by
    have hi' : y ∈ (C.f i).opensRange := hi
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hi'
    have hc : C.f i ≫ f = pullback.snd f ((localGeneratorsOpenCover q).f i) ≫
        (localGeneratorsOpenCover q).f i := pullback.condition
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hc]
    exact (pullback.snd f ((localGeneratorsOpenCover q).f i) z).2
  exact (rankAt_eq_card_of_mem q' i hi).trans (rankAt_eq_card_of_mem q i hfi).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.rankAtRingHom_flatPullbackK0
statement:
theorem rankAtRingHom_flatPullbackK0 {Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ Z) [Flat f] (y : Y) (a : K0 Z) :
    rankAtRingHom y (flatPullbackK0 f a) = rankAtRingHom (f y) a
proof:
:= by
  refine k0_induction _ (fun a ↦ rankAtRingHom y (flatPullbackK0 f a) = rankAtRingHom (f y) a)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ a
  · simp only [map_zero]
  · intro a b ha hb
    simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
  · intro a ha
    simp only [map_neg, ha]
  · intro F hF

      rankAt_pullback f F hF y]

name: SchemeKTheory.constantRankGenerators_of_preconnectedSpace
statement:
theorem constantRankGenerators_of_preconnectedSpace (X : Scheme.{u}) [PreconnectedSpace X] :
    ConstantRankGenerators X
proof:
:= by
  intro E hE
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin⟩ := hE.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := hqfin
  have hlc : IsLocallyConstant (fun x : X ↦ rankAt x E) := by
    rw [IsLocallyConstant.iff_exists_open]
    intro x
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_mem_localGenerators q x
    exact ⟨q.X i, (q.X i).isOpen, hi, fun x' hx' ↦
      (rankAt_eq_card_of_mem q i hx').trans (rankAt_eq_card_of_mem q i hi).symm⟩
  have hcov : IsOpenCover (fun i : {i : q.I // ∃ x, x ∈ q.X i} ↦ q.X i.1) := by
    refine IsOpenCover.mk (eq_top_iff.2 fun x _ ↦ ?_)
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_mem_localGenerators q x
    exact Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨⟨i, x, hi⟩, hi⟩
  let q' : SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.{u} E :=
    { I := {i : q.I // ∃ x, x ∈ q.X i}
      X := fun i ↦ q.X i.1
      coversTop := (Opens.coversTop_iff X _).2 hcov
      generators := fun i ↦ q.generators i.1 }
  have h1 : q'.IsLocallyFreeData :=
    SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsLocallyFreeData.mk (q := q') fun i ↦
      SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsLocallyFreeData.isIso (q := q) i.1
  have h2 : q'.IsFiniteType :=
    SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.mk (p := q') fun i ↦
      SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType (p := q) i.1
  by_cases hne : Nonempty X
  · obtain ⟨x₀⟩ := hne
    refine ⟨rankAt x₀ E, q', h1, h2, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := i.2
    change Nat.card (q.generators i.1).I = _
    exact (rankAt_eq_card_of_mem q i.1 hx).symm.trans (hlc.apply_eq_of_preconnectedSpace x x₀)
  · exact ⟨0, q', h1, h2, fun i ↦ (hne ⟨i.2.choose⟩).elim⟩

theorem rankZeroNilpotent_of_iso {Y : Scheme.{u}} (e : X ≅ Y) (h : RankZeroNilpotent Y) :

proof:
:= by

  have hid : flatPullbackK0 e.hom (flatPullbackK0 e.inv a) = a := by
    have := congrArg (fun φ : K0 X →+ K0 X ↦ φ a) (flatPullbackK0_comp e.hom e.inv)
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, e.hom_inv_id,
      flatPullbackK0_id, AddMonoidHom.id_apply] at this
    exact this
  have hb : IsNilpotent (flatPullbackK0 e.inv a) := h _ fun y ↦ by
    rw [rankAtRingHom_flatPullbackK0, ha]
  rw [← hid, ← flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply]
  exact hb.map _

name: SchemeKTheory.k0Class_free_fin_eq
statement:
theorem k0Class_free_fin_eq (n : ℕ) :
    k0ClassOf X (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin n)))
      (free_isFiniteLocallyFree X _) = (n : K0 X)
proof:
:= by
  refine (k0Class_free_fin X n).trans ?_
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    exact (@zero_nsmul (K0 X) (QuotientAddGroup.Quotient.addGroup _).toAddMonoid _).trans
      Nat.cast_zero.symm
  | succ n ih =>
    refine (@succ_nsmul (K0 X) (QuotientAddGroup.Quotient.addGroup _).toAddMonoid _ n).trans ?_
    rw [ih]
    exact (Nat.cast_succ n).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf_free

    k0ClassOf X (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I) (free_isFiniteLocallyFree X I) =
      (Nat.card I : K0 X)
proof:
:= by
  let n := Nat.card I
  let e : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I ≅
      SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) :=
    (SheafOfModules.freeFunctor (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).mapIso
      ((Finite.equivFin I).trans Equiv.ulift.symm).toIso
  refine (k0ClassOf_iso X (free_isFiniteLocallyFree X I)
    (free_isFiniteLocallyFree X (ULift.{u} (Fin n))) e).trans ?_
  exact k0Class_free_fin_eq n

name: SchemeKTheory.eq_intCast_rankAtRingHom_of_forall_mem_open
statement:
theorem eq_intCast_rankAtRingHom_of_forall_mem_open (x₀ : X)
    (hx₀ : ∀ U : X.Opens, x₀ ∈ U → U = ⊤) (a : K0 X) :
    a = ((rankAtRingHom x₀ a : ℤ) : K0 X)
proof:
:= by
  refine k0_induction _ (fun a ↦ a = ((rankAtRingHom x₀ a : ℤ) : K0 X)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ a
  · simp only [map_zero, Int.cast_zero]
  · intro a b ha hb
    rw [map_add, Int.cast_add, ← ha, ← hb]
  · intro a ha
    rw [map_neg, Int.cast_neg, ← ha]
  · intro E hE
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin⟩ := hE.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
    letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
    letI : q.IsFiniteType := hqfin
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_mem_localGenerators q x₀
    have hU : q.X i = ⊤ := hx₀ _ hi
    letI : (q.generators i).IsFiniteType :=
      SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType i
    letI : Finite (q.generators i).I := inferInstance
    let g := (localGeneratorsOpenCover q).f i
    have hg : IsIso g := by
      rw [isIso_iff_isOpenImmersion_and_surjective]
      refine ⟨inferInstance, ⟨fun x ↦ ?_⟩⟩
      have hx : x ∈ q.X i := hU ▸ trivial
      exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩
    let e : E ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (q.generators i).I :=
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackId X).app E).symm ≪≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (IsIso.inv_hom_id g)).app E).symm ≪≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (inv g) g).app E).symm ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (inv g)).mapIso
          (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback g).app E).symm ≪≫
            localGeneratorsOpenCoverIso q i) ≪≫
        AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso (inv g) _
    refine (k0ClassOf_iso X hE (free_isFiniteLocallyFree X _) e).trans
      ((k0ClassOf_free (q.generators i).I).trans ((Int.cast_natCast _).symm.trans ?_))
    exact congrArg (fun z : ℤ ↦ (z : K0 X)) ((rankAtRingHom_classOf x₀ E hE).trans
      (congrArg (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℤ)) (rankAt_eq_card_of_mem q i hi))).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.rankZeroNilpotent_of_forall_mem_open
statement:
theorem rankZeroNilpotent_of_forall_mem_open (x₀ : X) (hx₀ : ∀ U : X.Opens, x₀ ∈ U → U = ⊤) :

proof:
