name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec_surjective
statement:
theorem toSpec_surjective (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (toSpec R n)
proof:
:= by
  let φ := coefficientToCoordinateAway R n 0
  let ψ : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading R n) (coordinate R n 0) →+* R :=
    MvPolynomial.constantCoeff.comp (awayCoordinateEquiv R n 0).toRingHom
  have hψφ : ψ.comp φ = RingHom.id R := by
    ext a
    have h1 : awayCoordinateHom R n 0 (MvPolynomial.C a) = φ a := by
      simp [awayCoordinateHom, φ]
    change MvPolynomial.constantCoeff (awayCoordinateEquiv R n 0 (φ a)) = a
    rw [← h1]
    change MvPolynomial.constantCoeff ((RingEquiv.ofBijective (awayCoordinateHom R n 0)
      ⟨awayCoordinateHom_injective R n 0, awayCoordinateHom_surjective R n 0⟩).symm
        ((RingEquiv.ofBijective (awayCoordinateHom R n 0)
          ⟨awayCoordinateHom_injective R n 0, awayCoordinateHom_surjective R n 0⟩)
            (MvPolynomial.C a))) = a
    rw [RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply, MvPolynomial.constantCoeff_C]
  let ι := Proj.awayι (grading R n) (coordinate R n 0) (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n 0)
    Nat.zero_lt_one
  have hι : ι ≫ toSpec R n = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) := by
    change ι ≫ Proj.toSpecZero (grading R n) ≫ _ = _
    rw [Proj.awayι_toSpecZero_assoc, ← Spec.map_comp]
    rfl
  intro p
  refine ⟨ι (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ) p), ?_⟩
  change (ι ≫ toSpec R n) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ) p) = p
  rw [hι]
  change (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) p = p
  rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, hψφ]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.toBase_surjective
statement:
theorem toBase_surjective (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) :
    Function.Surjective C.toBase
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := C.covers.exists_mem x
  haveI := C.basisIndex_finite i
  have hcard : 0 < Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) := by
    haveI := hpos i
    exact Nat.card_pos
  let n := Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) - 1
  let e : C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1) :=
    (Finite.equivFin _).trans (finCongr (Nat.sub_add_cancel hcard).symm)
  have hx : x ∈ Set.range (C.isAffine i).fromSpec := by
    rw [IsAffineOpen.range_fromSpec]
    exact hi
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec_surjective Γ(X, C.U i) n p
  refine ⟨standardChartEmb C i e y, ?_⟩
  change (standardChartEmb C i e ≫ C.toBase) y = _
  rw [standardChartEmb_toBase]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.rankZeroNilpotent_scheme
statement:
theorem rankZeroNilpotent_scheme [IsNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) (hX : RankZeroNilpotent X) :
    RankZeroNilpotent C.scheme
proof:
:= by
  letI := C.projectiveBundleK0Algebra hpos
  letI : Flat C.toBase := C.toBase_flat hpos
  let p := C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos
  let N := nilradical (K0 C.scheme)
  let mk := Ideal.Quotient.mk N
  have hp : ∀ c, p c = flatPullbackK0 C.toBase c := fun c ↦ flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply _ c
  have hpN : nilradical (K0 X) ≤ N.comap p := fun a ha ↦
    mem_nilradical.2 ((mem_nilradical.1 ha).map p)
  let pbar := Ideal.quotientMap N p hpN
  
  have hlam : ∀ k, mk (C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos (lambdaClass X E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree k)) = (r.choose k : _) := by
    intro k
    have h := congrArg pbar (lambdaNilpotent_of_rankZeroNilpotent hX E r hE k)
    rw [Ideal.quotientMap_mk, Ideal.quotientMap_mk, map_natCast] at h
    rw [h, map_natCast]
  
  have hw : (mk C.tautologicalK0Class - 1) ^ r = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg mk (C.k0_relation_koszul hpos hr hE)
    simp only [map_sum, map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, map_one, map_zero, hlam] at h
    rw [sub_eq_neg_add, add_pow]
    rw [← h]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ ?_
    ring
  haveI : IsReduced (K0 C.scheme ⧸ N) :=
    (Ideal.isRadical_iff_quotient_reduced N).1 (Ideal.radical_isRadical ⊥)
  have hw1 : mk C.tautologicalK0Class = 1 := sub_eq_zero.1 (IsNilpotent.eq_zero ⟨r, hw⟩)
  
  have hspan : ∀ a : K0 C.scheme, ∃ c : K0 X, mk a = mk (p c) := by
    intro a
    have ha := C.span_eq_top hpos hr hE (Submodule.mem_top (x := a))
    refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun a _ ↦ ∃ c : K0 X, mk a = mk (p c)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ha
    · rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
      rw [map_pow, map_one, map_one]
      rw [hw1, one_pow]
    · exact ⟨0, by rw [map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]⟩
    · rintro a b - - ⟨c, hc⟩ ⟨d, hd⟩
      exact ⟨c + d, by rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hc, hd]⟩
    · rintro b a - ⟨c, hc⟩
      refine ⟨b * c, ?_⟩
      rw [Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, map_mul, map_mul, hc]
      rfl
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hspan a
  have hc0 : ∀ x : X, rankAtRingHom x c = 0 := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := C.toBase_surjective hpos x
    rw [← rankAtRingHom_flatPullbackK0, ← hp, ← rankAtQuot_mk, ← hc, rankAtQuot_mk, ha y]
  have hpc : mk (p c) = 0 :=
    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.2 (mem_nilradical.2 ((hX c hc0).map p))
  exact mem_nilradical.1 (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.1 (hc.trans hpc))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.lambdaNilpotent_scheme
statement:

name: TopCat.Sheaf.app_top_surjective_of_shortExact_H1_isZero
statement:
theorem app_top_surjective_of_shortExact_H1_isZero {X : TopCat.{u}}
    (S : ShortComplex (X.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u})) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (h₁ : IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H S.X₁ 1))) :
    Function.Surjective (S.g.1.app (op (⊤ : Opens X))).hom
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  let e₂ := CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.equiv₀ S.X₂
    (isTerminalTop : IsTerminal (⊤ : Opens X))
  let e₃ := CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.equiv₀ S.X₃
    (isTerminalTop : IsTerminal (⊤ : Opens X))
  let z := e₃.symm x
  have hzδ : z.comp hS.extClass (rfl : 0 + 1 = 1) = 0 :=
    (AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero h₁).elim _ _
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₃ _ hS z
    (rfl : 0 + 1 = 1) hzδ
  refine ⟨e₂ w, ?_⟩
  rw [CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.equiv₀_naturality]
  change e₃ (w.comp (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ S.g) (add_zero 0)) = x
  rw [hw]
  exact e₃.apply_symm_apply x

name: TopCat.Sheaf.map_evalTop_shortExact_of_H1_isZero
statement:
theorem map_evalTop_shortExact_of_H1_isZero {X : TopCat.{u}}
    (S : ShortComplex (X.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u})) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (h₁ : IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H S.X₁ 1))) :
    (S.map (TopCat.Sheaf.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u} X ⋙
      (evaluation (Opens X)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
        (op (⊤ : Opens X)))).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  have hT : (S.map (H0Functor X)).Exact := by
    rw [ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff]
    intro x hx
    change x.comp (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ S.g) (add_zero 0) = 0 at hx
    change ∃ y : CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H S.X₁ 0,
      y.comp (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ S.f) (add_zero 0) = x
    exact CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₂ _ hS x hx
  haveI : Mono ((S.map (H0Functor X)).f) := by
    letI : Mono S.f := hS.mono_f
    change Mono (AddCommGrpCat.ofHom
      ((CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ S.f).postcomp _ (add_zero 0)))
    exact CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mono_postcomp_mk₀_of_mono _ S.f
  haveI : Epi ((S.map (H0Functor X)).g) := by
    rw [AddCommGrpCat.epi_iff_surjective]
    intro z
    have hzδ : z.comp hS.extClass (rfl : 0 + 1 = 1) = 0 :=
      (AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero h₁).elim _ _
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₃ _ hS z
      (rfl : 0 + 1 = 1) hzδ
    exact ⟨w, hw⟩
  exact ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso
    (S.mapNatIso (H0EvalTopNatIso X))
    (ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk' hT inferInstance inferInstance)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechIntersection_app_surjective_of_acyclic
statement:
theorem coordinateCechIntersection_app_surjective_of_acyclic
    (S : ShortComplex
      (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space k n).toPresheafedSpace))
    (hS : S.ShortExact) (h₁ : CoordinateCechAcyclic k n S.X₁)
    (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    Function.Surjective
      (S.g.1.app (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a))).hom
proof:
:= by
  let j := (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).ι
  let P := j.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u})
  let T := S.map P
  have hT : T.ShortExact :=
    Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback_map_shortExact _ j.isOpenEmbedding S hS
  have hlocal := h₁ p a 0
  change IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H T.X₁ 1)) at hlocal
  have hsurj := TopCat.Sheaf.app_top_surjective_of_shortExact_H1_isZero T hT hlocal
  have htop : j.isOpenEmbedding.functor.obj
      (⊤ : Opens (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).toScheme.toPresheafedSpace) =
        coordinateCechIntersection k n p a := by
    exact Scheme.Opens.ι_image_top _
  change Function.Surjective
    (S.g.1.app (j.isOpenEmbedding.functor.op.obj
      (op (⊤ : Opens
        (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).toScheme.toPresheafedSpace)))).hom at hsurj
  rw [show j.isOpenEmbedding.functor.op.obj
      (op (⊤ : Opens
        (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).toScheme.toPresheafedSpace)) =
      op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a) from congrArg op htop] at hsurj
  exact hsurj

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechIntersection_map_eval_shortExact_of_acyclic
statement:
theorem coordinateCechIntersection_map_eval_shortExact_of_acyclic
    (S : ShortComplex
      (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space k n).toPresheafedSpace))
    (hS : S.ShortExact) (h₁ : CoordinateCechAcyclic k n S.X₁)
    (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (S.map (TopCat.Sheaf.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space k n).toPresheafedSpace ⋙
      (evaluation (Opens (space k n).toPresheafedSpace)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
        (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a)))).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  let j := (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).ι
  let P := j.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u})
  let T := S.map P
  have hT : T.ShortExact :=
    Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback_map_shortExact _ j.isOpenEmbedding S hS
  have hlocal := h₁ p a 0
  change IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H T.X₁ 1)) at hlocal
  have htopShort := TopCat.Sheaf.map_evalTop_shortExact_of_H1_isZero T hT hlocal
  have htop : j.isOpenEmbedding.functor.obj
      (⊤ : Opens (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).toScheme.toPresheafedSpace) =
        coordinateCechIntersection k n p a := by
    exact Scheme.Opens.ι_image_top _
  letI : (TopCat.Sheaf.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u}
      (space k n).toPresheafedSpace ⋙
    (evaluation (Opens (space k n).toPresheafedSpace)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
      (j.isOpenEmbedding.functor.op.obj
        (op (⊤ : Opens
          (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).toScheme.toPresheafedSpace)))).PreservesZeroMorphisms := by
    change (TopCat.Sheaf.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u}
      (space k n).toPresheafedSpace ⋙
        (evaluation (Opens (space k n).toPresheafedSpace)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          (op (j.isOpenEmbedding.functor.obj
            (⊤ : Opens
              (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).toScheme.toPresheafedSpace)))).PreservesZeroMorphisms
    infer_instance
  change (S.map (TopCat.Sheaf.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u}
      (space k n).toPresheafedSpace ⋙
    (evaluation (Opens (space k n).toPresheafedSpace)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
      (j.isOpenEmbedding.functor.op.obj
        (op (⊤ : Opens
          (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).toScheme.toPresheafedSpace))))).ShortExact at htopShort
  let e : j.isOpenEmbedding.functor.op.obj
        (op (⊤ : Opens
          (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).toScheme.toPresheafedSpace)) ≅
      op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a) :=
    eqToIso (congrArg op htop)
  let eF := Functor.isoWhiskerLeft
    (TopCat.Sheaf.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space k n).toPresheafedSpace)
    ((evaluation (Opens (space k n).toPresheafedSpace)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).mapIso e)
  exact ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso (S.mapNatIso eF) htopShort

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_epi_of_acyclic

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_mono_of_acyclic
statement:
theorem coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_mono_of_acyclic
    (S : ShortComplex
      (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space k n).toPresheafedSpace))
    (hS : S.ShortExact) (h₁ : CoordinateCechAcyclic k n S.X₁)

      S.f.1.app (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a))))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_exact_degree_of_acyclic
statement:
theorem coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_exact_degree_of_acyclic
    (S : ShortComplex
      (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space k n).toPresheafedSpace))
    (hS : S.ShortExact) (h₁ : CoordinateCechAcyclic k n S.X₁)
    (p : ℕ) :
    (((S.map (coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor k n)).map
      (HomologicalComplex.eval AddCommGrpCat.{u} (ComplexShape.up ℕ) p))).Exact
proof:
:= by
  change (ShortComplex.mk
    (CategoryTheory.Limits.Pi.map
      (fun a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) =>
        S.f.1.app (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a))))
    (CategoryTheory.Limits.Pi.map
      (fun a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) =>
        S.g.1.app (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a)))) _).Exact
  rw [ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff]
  intro x hx
  let e₁ := Concrete.productEquiv
    (fun a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) =>
      S.X₁.1.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a)))
  let e₂ := Concrete.productEquiv
    (fun a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) =>
      S.X₂.1.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a)))
  have hx_a (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
      (S.g.1.app (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a))).hom (e₂ x a) = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun y =>
      (CategoryTheory.Limits.Pi.π
        (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) =>
          S.X₃.1.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b))) a).hom y) hx
    change ((CategoryTheory.Limits.Pi.map
      (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) =>
        S.g.1.app (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b))) ≫
      CategoryTheory.Limits.Pi.π
        (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) =>
          S.X₃.1.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b))) a).hom x =
      (CategoryTheory.Limits.Pi.π
        (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) =>
          S.X₃.1.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b))) a).hom 0) at h
    rw [CategoryTheory.Limits.Pi.map_π] at h
    simpa [e₂] using h
  have hex (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
      ∃ y : S.X₁.1.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a)),
        (S.f.1.app (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a))).hom y = e₂ x a := by
    have ha := (coordinateCechIntersection_map_eval_shortExact_of_acyclic
      k n S hS h₁ p a).exact
    rw [ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff] at ha
    exact ha (e₂ x a) (hx_a a)
  let yFamily := fun a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) => Classical.choose (hex a)
  let y := e₁.symm yFamily
  refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
  apply e₂.injective
  funext a
  have ha := Classical.choose_spec (hex a)
  simp only [e₂, Concrete.productEquiv_apply_apply]
  change ((CategoryTheory.Limits.Pi.map
      (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) =>
        S.f.1.app (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b))) ≫
      CategoryTheory.Limits.Pi.π
        (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) =>
          S.X₂.1.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b))) a).hom y =
    (CategoryTheory.Limits.Pi.π
      (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) =>
        S.X₂.1.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b))) a).hom x)
  rw [CategoryTheory.Limits.Pi.map_π]
  change (S.f.1.app (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a))).hom
    ((CategoryTheory.Limits.Pi.π
      (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) =>
        S.X₁.1.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b))) a).hom y) =
    (CategoryTheory.Limits.Pi.π
      (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) =>
        S.X₂.1.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b))) a).hom x
  rw [show (CategoryTheory.Limits.Pi.π
      (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) =>
        S.X₁.1.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b))) a).hom y =
      yFamily a by simp [y, e₁]]
  dsimp only [yFamily]
  simpa only [e₂, Concrete.productEquiv_apply_apply] using ha

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_shortExact_of_acyclic
statement:
theorem coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_shortExact_of_acyclic
    (S : ShortComplex
      (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space k n).toPresheafedSpace))
    (hS : S.ShortExact) (h₁ : CoordinateCechAcyclic k n S.X₁) :

        k n S hS h₁ p

        k n S hS h₁ p
      epi_g := coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_epi_of_acyclic
        k n S hS h₁ p }

    [Y.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian Y]

name: GradedIdealQuotient.awayQuotientEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem awayQuotientEquiv_mk (s f : A) (hs : s ∈ 𝒜 1) (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 1)
    (x : HomogeneousLocalization.Away 𝒜 f) :
    awayQuotientEquiv 𝒜 s f hs hf
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {awayEquation 𝒜 s f hs hf}) x) =
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map
        (quotientMap 𝒜 (principalIdeal 𝒜 s hs)) f x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [awayQuotientEquiv, RingEquiv.trans_apply, Ideal.quotEquivOfEq_mk]
  exact RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective_apply_mk
    (awayMap_surjective 𝒜 (principalIdeal 𝒜 s hs) f hf) x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.maximalIdeal_mem_minimalPrimes_ker_stalkMap_of_mem_genericPoints
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_mem_minimalPrimes_ker_stalkMap_of_mem_genericPoints
    {Z X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (f : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion f] (z : Z) (hz : z ∈ genericPoints Z) :
    IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (f z)) ∈
      (RingHom.ker (f.stalkMap z).hom).minimalPrimes
proof:
:= by
  have hσ : Function.Surjective (f.stalkMap z).hom := f.stalkMap_surjective z
  letI : Ring.KrullDimLE 0 ↑(Z.presheaf.stalk z) :=
    krullDimLE_of_coheight (coheight_eq_zero_of_mem_genericPoints hz)
  have hkerle : RingHom.ker (f.stalkMap z).hom ≤
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (f z)) :=
    IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal (RingHom.ker_ne_top _)
  refine ⟨⟨(IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal _).isPrime, hkerle⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro q ⟨hqPrime, hIq⟩ hqle
  haveI := hqPrime
  have hmapPrime : (Ideal.map (f.stalkMap z).hom q).IsPrime :=
    Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective hσ hIq
  have hmapMax : (Ideal.map (f.stalkMap z).hom q).IsMaximal :=
    Ring.krullDimLE_zero_iff.mp inferInstance _ hmapPrime
  haveI := hmapMax
  have hqeq : Ideal.comap (f.stalkMap z).hom
      (Ideal.map (f.stalkMap z).hom q) = q := by
    rw [Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ hσ, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot]
    exact sup_eq_left.mpr hIq
  have hqMax : q.IsMaximal := by
    rw [← hqeq]
    exact Ideal.comap_isMaximal_of_surjective _ hσ
  exact le_of_eq (IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hqMax).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.coheight_eq_one_of_principal_stalk_kernel_at_generic
statement:
theorem coheight_eq_one_of_principal_stalk_kernel_at_generic
    {Z X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian X] [IsIntegral X]
    (f : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion f] (z : Z) (hz : z ∈ genericPoints Z)
    (a : X.presheaf.stalk (f z)) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hker : RingHom.ker (f.stalkMap z).hom = Ideal.span {a}) :
    coheight (f z) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hmin : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (f z)) ∈
      (Ideal.span {a}).minimalPrimes := by
    rw [← hker]
    exact maximalIdeal_mem_minimalPrimes_ker_stalkMap_of_mem_genericPoints f z hz
  have hheight : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (f z))).height ≤ 1 :=
    Ideal.height_le_one_of_isPrincipal_of_mem_minimalPrimes_of_isLocalRing _ hmin
  have hle : coheight (f z) ≤ 1 := by
    have hdim : ringKrullDim ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (f z)) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [← IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim]
      exact_mod_cast hheight
    rw [ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight] at hdim
    exact_mod_cast hdim
  have hne : coheight (f z) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    letI : Ring.KrullDimLE 0 ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (f z)) :=
      krullDimLE_of_coheight hzero
    let hfield : IsField ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (f z)) :=
      Ring.KrullDimLE.isField_of_isDomain
    letI : Field ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (f z)) := hfield.toField
    have htop : Ideal.span {a} = ⊤ :=
      Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top.mpr (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr ha)
    exact RingHom.ker_ne_top (f.stalkMap z).hom (hker.trans htop)
  exact (Order.le_one_iff.mp hle).resolve_left hne

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.hyperplaneChart_localStalkElement
statement:
theorem hyperplaneChart_localStalkElement (s : grading k n 1) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    [IsOpenImmersion (coordinateAwayι k n i)]
    (w : (pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) (hyperplaneι k n s)
      (coordinateAwayι k n i) : Scheme.{u})) :
    (hyperplaneChart k n s i).localStalkElement w =
      AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.affineStalkElement
        (hyperplaneChartEquation k n s i)
        (pullback.snd (hyperplaneι k n s) (coordinateAwayι k n i) w)
proof:
:= by
  let c := hyperplaneChart k n s i
  change
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.targetStalkIsoOfArrowIso
      (pullback.snd (hyperplaneι k n s) (coordinateAwayι k n i))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {c.equation}))))
      c.sourceIso c.targetIso c.commutes w).hom
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.affineStalkElement c.equation
          ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {c.equation}))))
              (c.sourceIso.hom w))) = _
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.targetStalkIsoOfArrowIso_affineStalkElement]
  change ((𝟙 (Spec (.of c.R)) : Spec (.of c.R) ⟶ Spec (.of c.R)).stalkMap
      (pullback.snd (hyperplaneι k n s) (coordinateAwayι k n i) w)).hom
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.affineStalkElement c.equation
          (pullback.snd (hyperplaneι k n s) (coordinateAwayι k n i) w)) = _
  rw [Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_id]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateAway_isDomain
statement:
theorem coordinateAway_isDomain (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    IsDomain (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading k n) (coordinate k n i))
proof:
:= by
  have hX : coordinate k n i ≠ 0 := MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero i
  haveI hloc : IsDomain (Localization.Away (coordinate k n i)) := by
    apply IsLocalization.isDomain_of_le_nonZeroDivisors
      (M := Submonoid.powers (coordinate k n i))
    rintro a ⟨r, rfl⟩
    exact mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero r hX)
  haveI : Nontrivial
      (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)) := by
    refine ⟨1, 0, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
    have hv := congrArg HomogeneousLocalization.val h
    rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_one, HomogeneousLocalization.val_zero] at hv
    exact one_ne_zero hv
  haveI : NoZeroDivisors
      (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)) := by
    refine ⟨fun {a b} hab ↦ ?_⟩
    have hv : HomogeneousLocalization.val a * HomogeneousLocalization.val b = 0 := by
      rw [← HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul, hab, HomogeneousLocalization.val_zero]
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hv with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective _
        (h.trans HomogeneousLocalization.val_zero.symm))
    · exact Or.inr (HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective _
        (h.trans HomogeneousLocalization.val_zero.symm))
  exact NoZeroDivisors.to_isDomain _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.hyperplaneChartEquation_ne_zero
statement:
theorem hyperplaneChartEquation_ne_zero (s : grading k n 1) (hs : s ≠ 0)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) : hyperplaneChartEquation k n s i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have hv := congrArg HomogeneousLocalization.val hzero
  simp only [hyperplaneChartEquation, GradedIdealQuotient.awayEquation,
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.val_zero] at hv
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk'] at hv
  obtain ⟨⟨_, r, rfl⟩, hr⟩ := (IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff _ _).mp hv
  have hX : coordinate k n i ≠ 0 := MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero i
  have hs' : (s : Polynomial k n) ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hs (Subtype.ext h)
  exact hs' ((mul_eq_zero.mp hr).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero r hX))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coheight_hyperplaneι_eq_one
statement:
theorem coheight_hyperplaneι_eq_one (s : grading k n 1) (hs : s ≠ 0)
    (z : hyperplane k n s) (hz : z ∈ genericPoints (hyperplane k n s)) :
    coheight (hyperplaneι k n s z) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hx : hyperplaneι k n s z ∈
      (⨆ i : Fin (n + 1), coordinateOpen k n i) := by
    rw [coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top]
    exact Set.mem_univ _
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp hx
  have hirange : hyperplaneι k n s z ∈ (coordinateAwayι k n i).opensRange := by
    change hyperplaneι k n s z ∈
      Proj.basicOpen (grading k n) (coordinate k n i) at hi
    change hyperplaneι k n s z ∈
      (Proj.awayι (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) Nat.zero_lt_one).opensRange
    rw [Proj.opensRange_awayι]
    exact hi
  have hzrange : z ∈ Set.range (pullback.fst (hyperplaneι k n s)
      (coordinateAwayι k n i)) := by
    rw [Scheme.Pullback.range_fst]
    exact Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange.mp hirange
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hzrange
  letI : IsDomain
      (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)) :=
    coordinateAway_isDomain k n i
  let c := hyperplaneChart k n s i
  letI : IsDomain c.R := by
    change IsDomain (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading k n) (coordinate k n i))
    exact coordinateAway_isDomain k n i
  exact AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.coheight_eq_one_of_principal_stalk_kernel_at_generic
    (hyperplaneι k n s) _ hz (c.stalkElement w)
      (c.stalkElement_ne_zero (hyperplaneChartEquation_ne_zero k n s hs i) w)
      (c.ker_stalkMap w)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.mem_genericPoints_hyperplane_of_coheight_eq_one
statement:
theorem mem_genericPoints_hyperplane_of_coheight_eq_one
    (s : grading k n 1) (hs : s ≠ 0) (z : hyperplane k n s)
    (hz : coheight (hyperplaneι k n s z) = 1) :
    z ∈ genericPoints (hyperplane k n s)
proof:
:= by
  let C : irreducibleComponents (hyperplane k n s) :=
    ⟨irreducibleComponent z, irreducibleComponent_mem_irreducibleComponents z⟩
  let η : hyperplane k n s := (genericPoints.ofComponent C).1
  have hηG : η ∈ genericPoints (hyperplane k n s) :=
    (genericPoints.ofComponent C).2
  have hzηspec : Specializes η z :=
    (genericPoints.isGenericPoint_ofComponent C).specializes mem_irreducibleComponent
  by_contra hzG
  have hzη : z ≠ η := fun h ↦ hzG (h ▸ hηG)
  have himgle : hyperplaneι k n s z ≤ hyperplaneι k n s η :=
    Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr (hzηspec.map (hyperplaneι k n s).continuous)
  have himglt : hyperplaneι k n s z < hyperplaneι k n s η :=
    lt_of_le_not_ge himgle fun hge ↦ hzη ((hyperplaneι k n s).isEmbedding.injective
      (((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hge).antisymm
        (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp himgle)).eq))
  have hcodim := Order.coheight_add_one_le himglt
  rw [coheight_hyperplaneι_eq_one k n s hs η hηG, hz] at hcodim
  norm_num at hcodim

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.hyperplane_fundamental_grade
proof:
:= by
  apply (coheight_hyperplaneι_eq_one k n s hs z ?_).symm
  rw [← fundamentalCycle_support]
  exact hz

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.hyperplaneCycle_apply_hyperplaneι
statement:
@[simp]
theorem hyperplaneCycle_apply_hyperplaneι (s : grading k n 1) (hs : s ≠ 0)
    (z : hyperplane k n s) (hz : coheight (hyperplaneι k n s z) = 1) :
    (hyperplaneCycle k n s hs).1 (hyperplaneι k n s z) =
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.genericMultiplicity z : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  change (AlgebraicCycle.pushforward (hyperplaneι k n s)
    (fundamentalCycle (hyperplane k n s)) (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℕ∞)) coheight)
      (hyperplaneι k n s z) = _
  rw [AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_closedImmersion (hyperplaneι k n s)
    (fundamentalCycle (hyperplane k n s)) (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℕ∞)) coheight
    (hyperplane_fundamental_grade k n s hs) z]
  exact AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.fundamentalCycle_apply_of_mem_genericPoints
    (mem_genericPoints_hyperplane_of_coheight_eq_one k n s hs z hz)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E27.weilGate_mem_range
statement:
theorem weilGate_mem_range {B D : X.Modules} {b : B ⟶ D} (P : PairCover b)
    {e : ℕ} (m : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = m)
    (w : P.toB.scheme) (hw : height w = ((m + e + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
    (q : P.toD.scheme) (hq : height q = ((m + e : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
    (hB : flatPullback P.toB.toBase (dimPrimeCycle v m hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle w _ hw).1)
    (hD : flatPullback P.toD.toBase (dimPrimeCycle v m hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle q _ hq).1) :
    P.jHom q ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι w)
proof:
:= by
  have hq1 := congrArg (fun c : AlgebraicCycle P.toD.scheme ℤ => c q) hD
  simp only [flatPullback_apply, M7.m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply, if_true] at hq1
  have hqv : P.toD.toBase q = v := by
    by_contra hne
    rw [if_neg hne] at hq1
    simp at hq1
  have hj : P.toB.toBase (P.jHom q) = v := by
    rw [← hqv, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, P.jHom_toBase]
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxf, hcoef⟩ :=
    exists_specializes_fibre_coeff_ne_zero P.toB.toBase (P.jHom q)
  have hxv : P.toB.toBase x = v := hxf.trans hj
  have hB1 := congrArg (fun c : AlgebraicCycle P.toB.scheme ℤ => c x) hB
  simp only [flatPullback_apply, M7.m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply, hxv, if_true, one_mul] at hB1
  have hxw : x = w := by
    by_contra hne
    rw [if_neg hne] at hB1
    exact hcoef (by exact_mod_cast hB1)
  subst hxw
  rw [range_pointClosureι]
  exact specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp hx

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.sectionBasis_apply_frame
statement:
theorem sectionBasis_apply_frame (i : C.I) (k : C.basisIndex i) :
    C.sectionBasis i k =
      ((C.globalFreeFrame i).hom.val.app
        (op (Over.mk (𝟙 (C.U i))))).hom
        ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op (C.U i)))
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  let eFree :=
    (PresheafOfModules.evaluation
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
      (op (C.U i))).mapIso
        (SchemeKTheory.underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree X
          (C.basisIndex i))
  let eFrame :=
    (SheafOfModules.evaluation (X.ringCatSheaf.over (C.U i))
      (op (Over.mk (𝟙 (C.U i))))).mapIso
        (C.globalFreeFrame i)
  unfold sectionBasis
  simp only [Module.Basis.coe_map, Function.comp_apply]
  unfold sectionLinearEquiv
  change (eFree.symm ≪≫ eFrame).toLinearEquiv
      (Finsupp.basisSingleOne k) =
    eFrame.toLinearEquiv
      ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op (C.U i)))
  change eFrame.toLinearEquiv
      (eFree.symm.toLinearEquiv (Finsupp.basisSingleOne k)) =
    eFrame.toLinearEquiv
      ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op (C.U i)))
  congr 1
  apply eFree.toLinearEquiv.injective
  have he :
      eFree.symm.toLinearEquiv = eFree.toLinearEquiv.symm := rfl
  rw [he]
  rw [eFree.toLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  change ModuleCat.freeMk k =
    eFree.hom.hom
      ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op (C.U i)))
  exact (SchemeKTheory.underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree_hom_freeSection_eval
    X (C.basisIndex i) k (op (C.U i))).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictedSectionBasis_apply_frame
statement:
theorem restrictedSectionBasis_apply_frame (i : C.I) (V : X.Opens)
    (hVU : V ≤ C.U i) (k : C.basisIndex i) :
    C.restrictedSectionBasis i V hVU k =
      ((C.restrictedGlobalFreeFrame i V hVU).hom.val.app
        (op (Over.mk (𝟙 V)))).hom
        ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op V))
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  let eFree :=
    (PresheafOfModules.evaluation
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
      (op V)).mapIso
        (SchemeKTheory.underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree X
          (C.basisIndex i))
  let eFrame :=
    (SheafOfModules.evaluation (X.ringCatSheaf.over V)
      (op (Over.mk (𝟙 V)))).mapIso
        (C.restrictedGlobalFreeFrame i V hVU)
  unfold restrictedSectionBasis
  simp only [Module.Basis.coe_map, Function.comp_apply]
  unfold restrictedSectionLinearEquiv
  change (eFree.symm ≪≫ eFrame).toLinearEquiv
      (Finsupp.basisSingleOne k) =
    eFrame.toLinearEquiv
      ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op V))
  change eFrame.toLinearEquiv
      (eFree.symm.toLinearEquiv (Finsupp.basisSingleOne k)) =
    eFrame.toLinearEquiv
      ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op V))
  congr 1
  apply eFree.toLinearEquiv.injective
  have he :
      eFree.symm.toLinearEquiv = eFree.toLinearEquiv.symm := rfl
  rw [he]
  rw [eFree.toLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  change ModuleCat.freeMk k =
    eFree.hom.hom
      ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op V))
  exact (SchemeKTheory.underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree_hom_freeSection_eval
    X (C.basisIndex i) k (op V)).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.sectionBasis_apply_overFrame
statement:
theorem sectionBasis_apply_overFrame (i : C.I) (k : C.basisIndex i) :
    C.sectionBasis i k =
      ((C.frame i).hom.val.app
        (op (Over.mk (𝟙 (C.U i))))).hom
        ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval
          (op (Over.mk (𝟙 (C.U i)))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sectionBasis_apply_frame]
  let T : (Over (C.U i))ᵒᵖ := op (Over.mk (𝟙 (C.U i)))
  let eOver :=
    (SheafOfModules.evaluation (X.ringCatSheaf.over (C.U i)) T).mapIso
      (SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X (C.U i) (C.basisIndex i))
  change ((C.frame i).hom.val.app T).hom
      (eOver.symm.toLinearEquiv
        ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op (C.U i)))) =
    ((C.frame i).hom.val.app T).hom
      ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval T)
  congr 1
  apply eOver.toLinearEquiv.injective
  have he : eOver.symm.toLinearEquiv = eOver.toLinearEquiv.symm := rfl
  rw [he, eOver.toLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have h := congrArg (fun s ↦ s.eval T)
    (Scheme.Modules.sectionsMap_freeOverIso_hom_freeSection
      X (C.U i) (C.basisIndex i) k)
  have h' := h.symm
  change
    ((SheafOfModules.free
      (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (C.basisIndex i)).val.map
        (𝟙 (C.U i)).op).hom
          ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op (C.U i))) =
      ((SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X (C.U i)
        (C.basisIndex i)).hom.val.app T).hom
          ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval T) at h'
  rw [show (𝟙 (C.U i)).op = 𝟙 (op (C.U i)) by rfl] at h'
  rw [(SheafOfModules.free
    (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (C.basisIndex i)).val.map_id] at h'
  change (SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op (C.U i)) =
    ((SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X (C.U i)
      (C.basisIndex i)).hom.val.app T).hom
        ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval T)
  exact h'

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictedSectionBasis_apply_overFrame
statement:
theorem restrictedSectionBasis_apply_overFrame (i : C.I) (V : X.Opens)
    (hVU : V ≤ C.U i) (k : C.basisIndex i) :
    C.restrictedSectionBasis i V hVU k =
      ((C.restrictedFrame i V hVU).hom.val.app
        (op (Over.mk (𝟙 V)))).hom
        ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval
          (op (Over.mk (𝟙 V))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [restrictedSectionBasis_apply_frame]
  let T : (Over V)ᵒᵖ := op (Over.mk (𝟙 V))
  let eOver :=
    (SheafOfModules.evaluation (X.ringCatSheaf.over V) T).mapIso
      (SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X V (C.basisIndex i))
  change ((C.restrictedFrame i V hVU).hom.val.app T).hom
      (eOver.symm.toLinearEquiv
        ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op V))) =
    ((C.restrictedFrame i V hVU).hom.val.app T).hom
      ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval T)
  congr 1
  apply eOver.toLinearEquiv.injective
  have he : eOver.symm.toLinearEquiv = eOver.toLinearEquiv.symm := rfl
  rw [he, eOver.toLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have h := congrArg (fun s ↦ s.eval T)
    (Scheme.Modules.sectionsMap_freeOverIso_hom_freeSection
      X V (C.basisIndex i) k)
  have h' := h.symm
  change
    ((SheafOfModules.free
      (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (C.basisIndex i)).val.map
        (𝟙 V).op).hom
          ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op V)) =
      ((SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X V
        (C.basisIndex i)).hom.val.app T).hom
          ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval T) at h'
  rw [show (𝟙 V).op = 𝟙 (op V) by rfl] at h'
  rw [(SheafOfModules.free
    (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (C.basisIndex i)).val.map_id] at h'
  change (SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op V) =
    ((SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X V
      (C.basisIndex i)).hom.val.app T).hom
        ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval T)
  exact h'

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictedSectionBasis_eq_restrict
statement:
theorem restrictedSectionBasis_eq_restrict (i : C.I) (V : X.Opens)
    (hVU : V ≤ C.U i) (k : C.basisIndex i) :
    E.val.map (homOfLE hVU).op (C.sectionBasis i k) =
      C.restrictedSectionBasis i V hVU k
proof:
:= by
  rw [sectionBasis_apply_overFrame,
    restrictedSectionBasis_apply_overFrame]
  let TU : (Over (C.U i))ᵒᵖ :=
    op (Over.mk (𝟙 (C.U i)))
  let TV : (Over V)ᵒᵖ :=
    op (Over.mk (𝟙 V))
  have hsections :
      SheafOfModules.sectionsMap
          (C.restrictedFrame i V hVU).hom
          (SheafOfModules.freeSection k) =
        Scheme.Modules.overSectionOfElement X E V
          (E.val.map (homOfLE hVU).op
            ((SheafOfModules.sectionsMap
              (C.frame i).hom
              (SheafOfModules.freeSection k)).eval TU)) := by
    unfold restrictedFrame
    rw [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom]
    rw [SheafOfModules.sectionsMap_comp,
      SheafOfModules.sectionsMap_comp]
    rw [Scheme.Modules.sectionsMap_freeOverMapIso_hom_freeSection]
    rw [Scheme.Modules.sectionsMap_overMapSection]
    change
      SheafOfModules.sectionsMap
          ((SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf
            (homOfLE hVU)).app E).hom
          (Scheme.Modules.overMapSection X hVU
            (SheafOfModules.sectionsMap
              (C.frame i).hom (SheafOfModules.freeSection k))) =
        Scheme.Modules.overSectionOfElement X E V
          (E.val.map (homOfLE hVU).op
            ((SheafOfModules.sectionsMap
              (C.frame i).hom
              (SheafOfModules.freeSection k)).eval
                (op (Over.mk (𝟙 (C.U i))))))
    exact
      Scheme.Modules.sectionsMap_overFunctorMap_hom_overMapSection
        X hVU E
          (SheafOfModules.sectionsMap
            (C.frame i).hom (SheafOfModules.freeSection k))
  have htop := congrArg (fun s ↦ s.eval TV) hsections
  have htop' := htop.symm
  change
    (E.val.map (𝟙 V).op).hom
        ((E.val.map (homOfLE hVU).op).hom
          (((C.frame i).hom.val.app TU).hom
            ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval TU))) =
      ((C.restrictedFrame i V hVU).hom.val.app TV).hom
        ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval TV) at htop'
  rw [show (𝟙 V).op = 𝟙 (op V) by rfl] at htop'
  rw [E.val.map_id] at htop'
  change
    (E.val.map (homOfLE hVU).op).hom
        (((C.frame i).hom.val.app TU).hom
          ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval TU)) =
      ((C.restrictedFrame i V hVU).hom.val.app TV).hom
        ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval TV)
  exact htop'

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restriction_spans
statement:
theorem restriction_spans (i : C.I) (V : X.Opens)
    (hVU : V ≤ C.U i) :
    Submodule.span Γ(X, V)
        (Set.range (E.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE hVU).op)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff, ← (C.restrictedSectionBasis i V hVU).span_eq,
    Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
  apply Submodule.subset_span
  refine ⟨C.sectionBasis i k, ?_⟩
  exact C.restrictedSectionBasis_eq_restrict i V hVU k

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F20.generator_cycle_eq_zero
statement: theorem generator_cycle_eq_zero (g : DimRelationGenerator (Spk k) 0) : g.cycle.1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : Subsingleton g.Y :=
    ⟨fun a b ↦ g.i.isEmbedding.injective (Subsingleton.elim _ _)⟩
  have hdiv : div g.f = 0 := by
    ext w
    by_contra hne
    have h1 : coheight w = 1 := div_support hne
    have h0 : coheight w = 0 :=
      Order.coheight_eq_zero.mpr fun b _ ↦ le_of_eq (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
    rw [h0] at h1
    exact absurd h1 (by norm_num)
  change properPushforward g.i (div g.f) = 0
  rw [hdiv, properPushforward_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F20.degChow_mk
statement:

    degChow k X (QuotientAddGroup.mk D) = AlgebraicCycle.degree k D.1
proof:
:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F20.degChow_dimPrimeCycle
statement:
theorem degChow_dimPrimeCycle (x : X) (hx : height x = 0) :
    degChow k X (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle x 0 hx)) =
      (Module.finrank k (X.residueField x) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [degChow_mk, AlgebraicCycle.degree, finsum_eq_single _ x (fun y hy ↦ by
    simp [dimPrimeCycle, Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single_apply, hy])]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F20.degQ_tmul
statement:
theorem degQ_tmul (a : ℚ) (x : DimChow X 0) :
    degQ k X (a ⊗ₜ[ℤ] x) = a * (degChow k X x : ℚ)

:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F20.finrank_pos_of_isClosed
statement:
theorem finrank_pos_of_isClosed {x : X} (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set X)) :
    0 < Module.finrank k (X.residueField x)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.finite_residueField_of_isClosed k hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F20.height_eq_zero_of_isClosed
statement: theorem height_eq_zero_of_isClosed {x : X} (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set X)) : height x = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine Order.height_eq_zero.mpr fun b hb ↦ ?_
  have h1 := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hb
  have h2 : b ∈ closure ({x} : Set X) := specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp h1
  rw [hx.closure_eq] at h2
  exact le_of_eq (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp h2).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F20.exists_closedPoint
statement: theorem exists_closedPoint [Nonempty X] : ∃ x : X, IsClosed ({x} : Set X)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := compactSpace_of_proper k X
  obtain ⟨x, -, hx⟩ := (isClosed_univ (X := X)).exists_closed_singleton
    (Set.univ_nonempty)
  exact ⟨x, hx⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F20.degQ_pointClass
statement:
theorem degQ_pointClass (x : X) (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set X)) :
    degQ k X (pointClass x hx) = (Module.finrank k (X.residueField x) : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pointClass, degQ_tmul, degChow_dimPrimeCycle, one_mul]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F20.degQ_pointClass_ne_zero
statement:
theorem degQ_pointClass_ne_zero (x : X) (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set X)) :
    degQ k X (pointClass x hx) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [degQ_pointClass]
  exact_mod_cast (finrank_pos_of_isClosed hx).ne'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F20.smul_pointClass_injective
statement:
theorem smul_pointClass_injective (x : X) (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set X)) :
    Function.Injective fun a : ℚ ↦ a • pointClass x hx
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  have h := congrArg (degQ k X) hab
  simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at h
  exact mul_right_cancel₀ (degQ_pointClass_ne_zero x hx) h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F20.degQ_surjective
statement: theorem degQ_surjective [Nonempty X] : Function.Surjective (degQ k X)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_closedPoint (k := k) (X := X)
  intro q
  refine ⟨(q / degQ k X (pointClass x hx)) • pointClass x hx, ?_⟩
  rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (degQ_pointClass_ne_zero x hx)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F20.nontrivial_rationalDimChow_zero
statement: theorem nontrivial_rationalDimChow_zero [Nonempty X] : Nontrivial (RationalDimChow X 0)
proof:
:=
  (degQ_surjective (k := k) (X := X)).nontrivial

statement: theorem degQ_surjective_projectiveSpace (n : ℕ) : Function.Surjective (degQ k (space k n))

:=
  degQ_surjective (k := k) (X := space k n)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.chartTwistingSheaf_union_inl
statement:
theorem chartTwistingSheaf_union_inl (C C' : AffineFrameCover X E) (d : ℤ) (i : C.I) :
    (C.union C').chartTwistingSheaf d (Sum.inl i) = C.chartTwistingSheaf d i
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.chartTwistingSheaf_union_inr
statement:
theorem chartTwistingSheaf_union_inr (C C' : AffineFrameCover X E) (d : ℤ) (i : C'.I) :
    (C.union C').chartTwistingSheaf d (Sum.inr i) = C'.chartTwistingSheaf d i

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.unionTwistCompat_of_chartCompatibility
statement:
theorem unionTwistCompat_of_chartCompatibility (C C' : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (hL : C.UnionTwistChartCompatibilityInl C' 1)
    (hR : C.UnionTwistChartCompatibilityInr C' 1) :
    UnionTwistCompat C C'
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · let f := Scheme.Modules.glueHom C.scheme
        (fun i : C.I ↦ (C.chartι i).opensRange) C.chartOpens_coversTop
        (fun i : C.I ↦ (C.unionTwistChartOverIsoInl C' 1 i).hom) hL
    haveI : IsIso f := Scheme.Modules.glueHom_isIso C.scheme
      (fun i : C.I ↦ (C.chartι i).opensRange) C.chartOpens_coversTop
      (fun i : C.I ↦ (C.unionTwistChartOverIsoInl C' 1 i).hom) hL (fun _ ↦ inferInstance)
    exact ⟨asIso f⟩
  · let f := Scheme.Modules.glueHom C'.scheme
        (fun i : C'.I ↦ (C'.chartι i).opensRange) C'.chartOpens_coversTop
        (fun i : C'.I ↦ (C.unionTwistChartOverIsoInr C' 1 i).hom) hR
    haveI : IsIso f := Scheme.Modules.glueHom_isIso C'.scheme
      (fun i : C'.I ↦ (C'.chartι i).opensRange) C'.chartOpens_coversTop
      (fun i : C'.I ↦ (C.unionTwistChartOverIsoInr C' 1 i).hom) hR (fun _ ↦ inferInstance)
    exact ⟨asIso f⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1B.segreInvR_iff
statement:
theorem segreInvR_iff {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (r : ℕ) (e s : ℕ → R) :
    SegreInvR r e s ↔ ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.SegreInv r e s
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1B.SegreInvR.of_injective
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun j hj => hι (by rw [map_zero]; exact h.1 j hj), fun m => hι ?_⟩
  have := h.2 m
  rw [map_sum]
  simp only [map_mul]
  rw [this]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1B.chernOfCoverOn_mul_segreOn
statement:
theorem chernOfCoverOn_mul_segreOn {e : ℕ} (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = e + 1)
    (m : ℕ) :
    ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
        (((-1 : ℚ) ^ a) • chernOfCoverOn ops C cp hC a) * segreOn ops C cp hC (m - a) =
      if m = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (segreSeriesOn ops C cp hC) = ((1 : (Module.End ℚ (TotalChow X))ˣ) :
      Module.End ℚ (TotalChow X)) := by
    rw [← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply]
    simp only [segreSeriesOn, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
    rw [segreOn_zero ops C cp hC]
    rfl
  have hinv := PowerSeries.invOfUnit_mul (segreSeriesOn ops C cp hC) 1 h0
  have hco := congrArg (PowerSeries.coeff m) hinv
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul, Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk,
    PowerSeries.coeff_one] at hco
  rw [← hco]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
  have : (((-1 : ℚ) ^ a) • chernOfCoverOn ops C cp hC a) =
      PowerSeries.coeff a (PowerSeries.invOfUnit (segreSeriesOn ops C cp hC) 1) := by
    unfold chernOfCoverOn
    rw [smul_smul, ← mul_pow]
    norm_num
  rw [this]
  simp only [segreSeriesOn, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1B.sandwichOn_eq_phi
statement:
theorem sandwichOn_eq_phi {e : ℕ} (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = e + 1) (j : ℕ) :
    sandwichOn ops C cp hC j =
      if e ≤ j then segreOn ops C cp hC (j - e) else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · change sandwichOn ops C cp hC j = sandwichOn ops C cp hC (e + (j - e))
    congr 1
    omega
  · exact sandwichOn_eq_zero_of_lt ops C cp hC (by omega)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1B.chernOpOn'_unit
statement:
theorem chernOpOn'_unit (hU : HasConstantRank X (tensorUnitSheaf X) 1) (i : ℕ) :
    chernOpOn' ops cp hP (tensorUnitSheaf X) 1 hU i = if i = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [chernOpOn'_line_series ops cp hP (tensorUnitSheaf X) hU]
  by_cases h0 : i = 0
  · simp [h0]
  · by_cases h1 : i = 1
    · subst h1
      have := totalCapOn_tensorUnit ops (P := X)
      simp only [one_ne_zero, if_false, if_true]
      exact this
    · simp [h0, h1]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1B.chernOpOn'_unit_summand
statement:
theorem chernOpOn'_unit_summand {M : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hM : HasConstantRank X M r)
    (hW : WhitneyUnitSummand ops cp hP M) (n : ℕ)
    (hB : HasConstantRank X (M ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X) (r + 1)) :
    chernOpOn' ops cp hP (M ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X) (r + 1) hB n = chernOpOn' ops cp hP M r hM n
proof:
:= by
  have hU := hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf (Y := X)
  have h := hW n
  rw [constRankChernAssignOn'_eq ops cp hP _ (r + 1) hB] at h
  rw [h]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (n, 0)]
  · rw [constRankChernAssignOn'_eq ops cp hP M r hM,
      constRankChernAssignOn'_eq ops cp hP _ 1 hU, chernOpOn'_unit ops cp hP hU]
    simp [Module.End.one_eq_id, LinearMap.comp_id]
  · intro p hp hne
    rw [Finset.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
    have hp2 : p.2 ≠ 0 := fun h2 => hne (by
      have : p.1 = n := by omega
      exact Prod.ext this h2)
    rw [constRankChernAssignOn'_eq ops cp hP _ 1 hU, chernOpOn'_unit ops cp hP hU]
    simp [hp2]
  · intro hn
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mpr (by simp)) hn

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1B.segreInvR_unit_summand
statement:
theorem segreInvR_unit_summand {M : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hM : HasConstantRank X M r)
    (hW : WhitneyUnitSummand ops cp hP M)
    (hz : ∀ j, r < j → chernOpOn' ops cp hP M r hM j = 0)
    (C : AffineFrameCover X (M ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X)) [Fact (Cl C.scheme)]
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = r + 1) :
    SegreInvR r (fun a => ((-1 : ℚ) ^ a) • chernOpOn' ops cp hP M r hM a)
      (segreOn ops C cp hC)
proof:
:= by
  have hB : HasConstantRank X (M ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X) (r + 1) :=
    hasConstantRank_biprod_E13 hM hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf
  have hcher : ∀ a, chernOpOn' ops cp hP M r hM a = chernOfCoverOn ops C cp hC a := fun a => by
    rw [← chernOpOn'_unit_summand ops cp hP hM hW a hB,
      chernOpOn'_eq_chernOfCoverOn ops cp hP C (r := r) hB hC]
  refine ⟨fun j hj => by simp [hz j hj], fun m => ?_⟩
  have := chernOfCoverOn_mul_segreOn ops cp C hC m
  simp only [hcher]
  exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1B.segreInvR_rankOne
statement:
theorem segreInvR_rankOne {L : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (C : AffineFrameCover X (L ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X)) [Fact (Cl C.scheme)]
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = 1 + 1) :
    SegreInvR 1 (fun a => ((-1 : ℚ) ^ a) • chernOpOn' ops cp hP L 1 hL a)
      (segreOn ops C cp hC)
proof:
:= by
  have hLU : HasConstantRank X (L ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X) 2 :=
    hasConstantRank_biprod_E13 hL hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf
  refine segreInvR_unit_summand ops cp hP hL ?_ ?_ C hC
  · exact whitneyConvOn_lines ops cp hP hL hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf hLU
  · intro j hj
    rw [chernOpOn'_line_series ops cp hP L hL]
    have h0 : j ≠ 0 := by omega
    have h1 : j ≠ 1 := by omega
    simp [h0, h1]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1B.lineFilt_of_splitting
statement:
theorem lineFilt_of_splitting (S : ChowSplittingOn ops E e) :
    ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.LineFilt S.Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj E)
      (ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.stepClasses S.L S.L_line e)
proof:
:=
  (ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.lineFilt_of_steps S.F S.L S.F_vb S.L_line S.base e S.step).of_iso
    S.top.some

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1B.koszul_splitting
statement:
theorem koszul_splitting (S : ChowSplittingOn ops E e) (M : S.Y.Modules)
    (hM : HasConstantRank S.Y M 1)
    (hWM : IsFiniteLocallyFree S.Y
      (ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.twistBy M ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj E))) :
    ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.lamMinus S.Y
        (ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.twistBy M ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj E)) hWM (e + 1) =
      ((ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.stepClasses S.L S.L_line e).map fun x =>
        1 - x * k0ClassOf S.Y M hM.isFiniteLocallyFree).prod
proof:
:=
  ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.koszulProd_twist M hM (lineFilt_of_splitting ops S) hWM
    (ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.card_stepClasses S.L S.L_line e)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7s_lof_mem_totG
statement:
theorem m7s_lof_mem_totG {S : Set C.scheme} {n t m : ℕ} (hm : n + t ≤ m)
    {c : RationalDimChow C.scheme m} (hc : c ∈ m7sSuppSpan (W := C.scheme) S m) :
    DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow C.scheme m) m c ∈ m7sTotG C S n t
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (⟨m, hm⟩ : {m : ℕ // n + t ≤ m}) (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hc)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7s_xi_mem_totG
statement:
theorem m7s_xi_mem_totG {S : Set C.scheme} (hS : ∀ x y : C.scheme, x ∈ S → x ⤳ y → y ∈ S)
    {n t : ℕ} {x : TotalChow C.scheme} (hx : x ∈ m7sTotG C S n (t + 1)) :
    xiCap ops C x ∈ m7sTotG C S n t
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : m7sTotG C S n (t + 1) ≤ (m7sTotG C S n t).comap (xiCap ops C) from h hx
  refine iSup_le fun m ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := m
  rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro c hc
  obtain ⟨m', rfl⟩ : ∃ m', m = m' + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
  simp only [Submodule.mem_comap]
  have hcap : xiCap ops C (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow C.scheme m) (m' + 1) c) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow C.scheme m) m'
        (ops.cap (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) m' c) := by
    rw [xiCap, totalCap, DirectSum.toModule_lof]
    rfl
  rw [hcap]
  exact m7s_lof_mem_totG C (by omega) (m7s_cap_mem ops _ _ m' _ hS hc)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7s_push_totG_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : m7sTotG C S n 0 ≤ LinearMap.ker (totalPush ops C.toBase) from h hx
  refine iSup_le fun m ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := m
  rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro c hc
  simp only [Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.mem_ker]
  rw [totalPush, DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    m7s_push_eq_zero' ops C.toBase m S (fun x hx ↦ (hS x hx).trans_le (by exact_mod_cast hm)) hc,
    map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7s_specClosed_lt
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hxy
  have h : C.toBase y ≤ C.toBase x :=
    Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr (hxy.map C.toBase.continuous)
  exact (Order.height_mono h).trans_lt hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7s_cap_step
statement:
theorem m7s_cap_step {e n : ℕ} {v : X} (hv : height v = n) (F : M7sFlag C e v) {t s : ℕ}
    (hts : t + 1 + s = e) (h : height (F.w t) = ((n + s + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
    (h' : height (F.w (t + 1)) = ((n + s : ℕ) : ℕ∞)) :
    ops.cap (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (n + s)
        ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (F.w t) (n + s + 1) h) :
          DimChow C.scheme (n + s + 1))) -
      (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (F.w (t + 1)) (n + s) h') :
          DimChow C.scheme (n + s)) ∈
      m7sSuppSpan {x : C.scheme | height (C.toBase x) < n} (n + s)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b₀, b, hb⟩ := F.frame t (by omega)
  set Wd := Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame
    (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure _ (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (F.w t))
    (m7s_genericRank_pointClosure _ (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (F.w t)) b with hWd
  have hmem := m7s_pushWeil_mem (k := k) _ (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (n + s) (F.w t) h b
  rw [ops.cap_mk _ (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (n + s) (F.w t) h (m7s_genericRank_pointClosure _ (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (F.w t)) b
    ⟨_, hmem⟩ rfl, ← TensorProduct.tmul_sub, ← QuotientAddGroup.mk_sub]
  refine m7s_mem_suppSpan _ ?_
  intro x hx
  change (properPushforward (pointClosureι (F.w t)) Wd.1) x -
    (dimPrimeCycle (F.w (t + 1)) (n + s) h').1 x ≠ 0 at hx
  rw [m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply] at hx
  obtain ⟨z0, hz0, hιz0⟩ := F.step t (by omega)
  by_cases hxr : x ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι (F.w t))
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hxr
    have hD : properPushforward (pointClosureι (F.w t)) Wd.1 (pointClosureι (F.w t) z) =
        Wd.1 z :=
      pushforward_apply_closedImmersion (pointClosureι (F.w t)) Wd.1 (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ())
        (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) z
    rw [hD] at hx
    have hspec : v ⤳ C.toBase (pointClosureι (F.w t) z) := by
      have h1 : F.w t ⤳ pointClosureι (F.w t) z := by
        rw [specializes_iff_mem_closure, ← range_pointClosureι]
        exact ⟨z, rfl⟩
      simpa [F.base t] using h1.map C.toBase.continuous
    by_cases hpv : C.toBase (pointClosureι (F.w t) z) = v
    · exfalso
      apply hx
      by_cases hcz : coheight z = 1
      · rw [hWd, Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame_apply, hb z hcz hpv, sub_self]
      · have hW0 : Wd.1 z = 0 := by
          by_contra h0
          exact hcz (Wd.2 h0)
        have hne : pointClosureι (F.w t) z ≠ F.w (t + 1) := by
          intro heq
          rw [← hιz0] at heq
          exact hcz ((pointClosureι (F.w t)).isEmbedding.injective heq ▸ hz0)
        rw [hW0, if_neg hne, sub_zero]
    · have hlt : C.toBase (pointClosureι (F.w t) z) < v :=
        lt_of_le_not_ge (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr hspec)
          (fun hge ↦ hpv (hspec.antisymm (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hge)).eq.symm)
      change height (C.toBase (pointClosureι (F.w t) z)) < n
      rw [← hv]
      exact Order.height_strictMono hlt
        ((Order.height_mono hlt.le).trans_lt (by rw [hv]; exact ENat.coe_lt_top n))
  · exfalso
    apply hx
    have hne : x ≠ F.w (t + 1) := fun heq ↦ hxr ⟨z0, hιz0.trans heq.symm⟩
    rw [properPushforward, pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range _ _ _ _ x hxr,
      if_neg hne, sub_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7s_main
statement:
theorem m7s_main {e n : ℕ} {v : X} (hv : height v = n) (F : M7sFlag C e v)
    (h0 : height (F.w 0) = ((n + e : ℕ) : ℕ∞)) :
    ∀ t s, t + s = e → ∃ h : height (F.w t) = ((n + s : ℕ) : ℕ∞),
      ((xiCap ops C) ^ t) (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow C.scheme m) (n + e)
          ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (F.w 0) (n + e) h0) :
            DimChow C.scheme (n + e)))) -
        DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow C.scheme m) (n + s)
          ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (F.w t) (n + s) h) :
            DimChow C.scheme (n + s))) ∈
        m7sTotG C {x | height (C.toBase x) < n} n s
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | zero =>
    intro s hs
    obtain rfl : s = e := by omega
    refine ⟨h0, ?_⟩
    rw [pow_zero, Module.End.one_apply, sub_self]
    exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | succ t ih =>
    intro s hs
    obtain ⟨h, hmem⟩ := ih (s + 1) (by omega)
    obtain ⟨z0, hz0, hιz0⟩ := F.step t (by omega)
    have hgen : genericPoint (pointClosureScheme (F.w t)) = pointClosureGenericPoint (F.w t) :=
      ((pointClosureGenericPoint_isGeneric (F.w t)).eq (genericPoint_spec _)).symm
    have h' : height (F.w (t + 1)) = ((n + s : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
      have hc := dimensionCatenary_of_finiteType k (X := C.scheme)
        (pointClosureScheme (F.w t)) (pointClosureι (F.w t)) z0 hz0
      rw [hgen, pointClosureι_genericPoint, h, hιz0] at hc
      exact ENat_add_one_cancel (by rw [hc]; push_cast; ring)
    refine ⟨h', ?_⟩
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]
    set A := ((xiCap ops C) ^ t) (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow C.scheme m) (n + e)
          ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (F.w 0) (n + e) h0) :
            DimChow C.scheme (n + e))))
    set B := DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow C.scheme m) (n + (s + 1))
          ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (F.w t) (n + (s + 1)) h) :
            DimChow C.scheme (n + (s + 1))))
    have hxiB : xiCap ops C B = DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow C.scheme m) (n + s)
        (ops.cap (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (n + s)
          ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (F.w t) (n + (s + 1)) h) :
            DimChow C.scheme (n + (s + 1))))) := by
      rw [xiCap, totalCap, DirectSum.toModule_lof]
      rfl
    have hsplit : xiCap ops C A - DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow C.scheme m) (n + s)
          ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (F.w (t + 1)) (n + s) h') :
            DimChow C.scheme (n + s))) =
        xiCap ops C (A - B) + DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow C.scheme m) (n + s)
          (ops.cap (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (n + s)
            ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (F.w t) (n + (s + 1)) h) :
              DimChow C.scheme (n + (s + 1)))) -
            (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (F.w (t + 1)) (n + s) h') :
              DimChow C.scheme (n + s))) := by
      rw [map_sub, hxiB, map_sub]
      abel
    rw [hsplit]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ (m7s_xi_mem_totG ops C (m7s_specClosed_lt C n) hmem)
      (m7s_lof_mem_totG C le_rfl (m7s_cap_step ops C hv F (by omega) h h'))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.segre_zero
statement:
theorem segre_zero {e : ℕ} (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = e + 1) :
    segre ops C cp hC 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Flat C.toBase := C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos e))
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  let M : Submodule ℚ (RationalDimChow X n) :=
    LinearMap.ker ((segre ops C cp hC 0).comp (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) n) -
      (1 : Module.End ℚ (TotalChow X)).comp (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) n))
  suffices hM : ∀ c, c ∈ M by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro c
    have := hM c
    rwa [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.sub_apply, sub_eq_zero] at this
  intro c
  induction c using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => exact M.zero_mem
  | add a b ha hb => exact M.add_mem ha hb
  | tmul q a =>
    have hq : q ⊗ₜ[ℤ] a = q • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] a) := by
      rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    rw [hq]
    refine M.smul_mem q ?_
    induction a using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H D =>
    refine m7s_mem_of_prime M Set.univ ?_ D (Set.subset_univ _)
    intro v hv _
    obtain ⟨F⟩ := m7geo_flag_exists C hC v
    have hd := cp.projBundle_relDim C hC
    have h0 : height (F.w 0) = ((n + e : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
      rw [hd (F.w 0) (by rw [F.coeff_zero]; exact one_ne_zero), F.base 0, hv]
      push_cast; rfl
    
    have hpull : ops.pull C.toBase e hd n ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v n hv) : DimChow X n)) =
        (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (F.w 0) (n + e) h0) :
          DimChow C.scheme (n + e)) := by
      refine ops.pull_mk C.toBase e hd n _ _ ?_
      intro x
      rw [m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply, m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply]
      by_cases hx : x = F.w 0
      · subst hx
        rw [if_pos rfl, if_pos (F.base 0), F.coeff_zero]
        simp
      · rw [if_neg hx]
        by_cases hpx : C.toBase x = v
        · rw [if_pos hpx, one_mul]
          by_contra hc
          exact hx (F.coeff_unique x hpx (by exact_mod_cast Ne.symm hc))
        · rw [if_neg hpx, zero_mul]
    
    have hwe : height (F.w e) = ((n + 0 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) :=
      (m7s_main ops C hv F h0 e 0 (by omega)).1
    have hv0 : height v = ((n + 0 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := hv
    have hpush : ops.push C.toBase (n + 0) ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (F.w e) (n + 0) hwe) : DimChow C.scheme (n + 0))) =
        (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 0) hv0) : DimChow X (n + 0)) := by
      refine ops.push_mk C.toBase n _ _ ?_
      ext y
      rw [properPushforward_apply_eq_sum_of_subset C.toBase _ y {F.w e} (by
        intro x _ hx
        rw [m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply] at hx
        by_contra hxe
        exact hx (if_neg (by simpa using hxe)))]
      rw [m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply]
      by_cases hy : y = v
      · subst hy
        rw [if_pos rfl, Finset.filter_singleton, if_pos (F.base e), Finset.sum_singleton,
          m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply, if_pos rfl, F.degree]
        simp
      · rw [if_neg hy, Finset.filter_singleton, if_neg (by rw [F.base e]; exact Ne.symm hy),
          Finset.sum_empty]
    obtain ⟨hwe', hmain⟩ := m7s_main ops C hv F h0 e 0 (by omega)
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.sub_apply, sub_eq_zero]
    change totalPush ops C.toBase (((xiCap ops C) ^ (e + 0))
      (totalPull ops C.toBase e (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC)
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) n _))) = _
    rw [totalPull, DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply, hpull, Nat.add_zero,
      ← sub_add_cancel (((xiCap ops C) ^ e) _) _, map_add,
      m7s_push_totG_eq_zero ops C (fun x hx ↦ hx) hmain, zero_add, totalPush,
      DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply, hpush]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D17.capCommute_of_gate
statement: theorem capCommute_of_gate (G : CapCommGate ops L M hL hM) : CapCommute ops L M hL hM
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  cases n with
  | zero => apply LinearMap.ext; intro c; simp [totalCap, capComponent]
  | succ n =>
    cases n with
    | zero => apply LinearMap.ext; intro c; simp [totalCap, capComponent]
    | succ m =>
      have key : (ops.cap L hL m).comp (ops.cap M hM (m + 1)) =
          (ops.cap M hM m).comp (ops.cap L hL (m + 1)) :=
        e4_linearMap_ext_of_prime (m + 2) _ _ (fun v hv ↦ G m v hv)
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro c
      have := LinearMap.congr_fun key c
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at this
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, totalCap, DirectSum.toModule_lof, capComponent, this]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D17.capCommute_iff_gate
statement: theorem capCommute_iff_gate : CapCommute ops L M hL hM ↔ CapCommGate ops L M hL hM
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h m v hv
    have := LinearMap.congr_fun h (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) (m + 2)
      ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v (m + 2) hv) : DimChow X (m + 2))))
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, totalCap, DirectSum.toModule_lof, capComponent] at this
    simp only [DirectSum.lof_eq_of] at this
    exact DirectSum.of_injective (β := fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) m this
  · exact capCommute_of_gate

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D17.cap_comm_of_gate
statement:
theorem cap_comm_of_gate
    (G : ∀ (L M : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1),
      CapCommGate ops L M hL hM) (L M : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1) :
    totalCap ops L hL ∘ₗ totalCap ops M hM = totalCap ops M hM ∘ₗ totalCap ops L hL
proof:
:=
  capCommute_of_gate (G L M hL hM)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D17.capCommute_symm
statement: theorem capCommute_symm (h : CapCommute ops L M hL hM) : CapCommute ops M L hM hL
proof: := h.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D17.capCommute_self
statement: theorem capCommute_self : CapCommute ops L L hL hL
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D17.capCommute_congr_left
statement:
theorem capCommute_congr_left {L' : X.Modules} {hL' : HasConstantRank X L' 1} (e : L ≅ L')
    (h : CapCommute ops L' M hL' hM) : CapCommute ops L M hL hM
proof:
:= by
  unfold CapCommute at *
  rwa [E7.totalCap_iso ops hL hL' e]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D17.capCommute_congr_right
statement:
theorem capCommute_congr_right {M' : X.Modules} {hM' : HasConstantRank X M' 1} (e : M ≅ M')
    (h : CapCommute ops L M' hL hM') : CapCommute ops L M hL hM
proof:
:=
  capCommute_symm (capCommute_congr_left e (capCommute_symm h))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D17.capCommute_unit_left
statement:
theorem capCommute_unit_left (hO : HasConstantRank X (tensorUnitSheaf X) 1) :
    CapCommute ops (tensorUnitSheaf X) M hO hM
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : totalCap ops (tensorUnitSheaf X) hO = 0 := E7.totalCap_tensorUnit ops
  unfold CapCommute
  rw [h0]; simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D17.capCommute_tensor_right
statement:
theorem capCommute_tensor_right {N : X.Modules} {hN : HasConstantRank X N 1}
    (hMN : HasConstantRank X (tensorSheaf X M N) 1)
    (h1 : CapCommute ops L M hL hM) (h2 : CapCommute ops L N hL hN) :
    CapCommute ops L (tensorSheaf X M N) hL hMN
proof:
:= by
  unfold CapCommute at *
  rw [totalCap_tensor ops M N hM hN hMN, LinearMap.comp_add, LinearMap.add_comp, h1, h2]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D17.capCommute_dual_right
statement:
theorem capCommute_dual_right (h : CapCommute ops L M hL hM) :
    CapCommute ops L (lineBundleDual X M) hL (lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank M hM)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : totalCap ops (lineBundleDual X M) (lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank M hM) =
      -totalCap ops M hM := by
    have h := E7.totalCap_add_dual ops hM
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro c
    have h1 := LinearMap.congr_fun h c
    rw [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply] at h1
    rw [LinearMap.neg_apply]
    exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right h1
  unfold CapCommute at *
  rw [hd, LinearMap.comp_neg, LinearMap.neg_comp, h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D17.capCommute_of_cover
statement:
theorem capCommute_of_cover (U₁ U₂ : X.Opens) (hcov : ∀ x : X, x ∈ U₁ ∨ x ∈ U₂)
    (e₁ : (tensorUnitSheaf X).over U₁ ≅ L.over U₁) (e₂ : (tensorUnitSheaf X).over U₂ ≅ M.over U₂) :
    CapCommute ops L M hL hM
proof:
:= by
  unfold CapCommute
  rw [E7.totalCap_mul_eq_zero_of_cover ops L M hL hM U₁ U₂ hcov e₁ e₂,
    E7.totalCap_mul_eq_zero_of_cover ops M L hM hL U₂ U₁ (fun x ↦ (hcov x).symm) e₂ e₁]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D17.capCommute_of_sub
statement:
theorem capCommute_of_sub {A B C D : X.Modules} {hA : HasConstantRank X A 1}
    {hB : HasConstantRank X B 1} {hC : HasConstantRank X C 1} {hD : HasConstantRank X D 1}
    (hLe : totalCap ops L hL = totalCap ops A hA - totalCap ops B hB)
    (hMe : totalCap ops M hM = totalCap ops C hC - totalCap ops D hD)
    (hAC : CapCommute ops A C hA hC) (hAD : CapCommute ops A D hA hD)
    (hBC : CapCommute ops B C hB hC) (hBD : CapCommute ops B D hB hD) :
    CapCommute ops L M hL hM
proof:
:= by
  unfold CapCommute at *
  rw [hLe, hMe, LinearMap.sub_comp, LinearMap.comp_sub, LinearMap.comp_sub,
    LinearMap.sub_comp, LinearMap.comp_sub, LinearMap.comp_sub, hAC, hAD, hBC, hBD]
  abel

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D17.capCommute_of_quotients
statement:
theorem capCommute_of_quotients {A B C D : X.Modules} {hA : HasConstantRank X A 1}
    {hB : HasConstantRank X B 1} {hC : HasConstantRank X C 1} {hD : HasConstantRank X D 1}
    (eL : L ≅ tensorSheaf X A (lineBundleDual X B))
    (eM : M ≅ tensorSheaf X C (lineBundleDual X D))
    (hAC : CapCommute ops A C hA hC) (hAD : CapCommute ops A D hA hD)
    (hBC : CapCommute ops B C hB hC) (hBD : CapCommute ops B D hB hD) :
    CapCommute ops L M hL hM
proof:
:= by
  have hNL : HasConstantRank X (tensorSheaf X A (lineBundleDual X B)) 1 := by
    have h := hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hA (lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank B hB)
    rwa [Nat.one_mul] at h
  have hNM : HasConstantRank X (tensorSheaf X C (lineBundleDual X D)) 1 := by
    have h := hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hC (lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank D hD)
    rwa [Nat.one_mul] at h
  refine capCommute_of_sub ?_ ?_ hAC hAD hBC hBD
  · rw [E7.totalCap_iso ops hL hNL eL, E7.totalCap_tensor_dual ops hA hB hNL]
  · rw [E7.totalCap_iso ops hM hNM eM, E7.totalCap_tensor_dual ops hC hD hNM]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E27.fibreIdeal_le_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem fibreIdeal_le_maximalIdeal (y : X) :
    fibreIdeal f y ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  exact le_of_eq (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E27.fibre_eq_of_fibreIdeal_le
statement:
theorem fibre_eq_of_fibreIdeal_le {x' y : X} (h : x' ⤳ y)
    (hle : fibreIdeal f y ≤ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h) : f x' = f y
proof:
:= by
  have hcomm := Scheme.Hom.stalkSpecializes_stalkMap f x' y h
  have h1 : (Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h).comap (f.stalkMap y).hom =
      Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (f.base.hom.map_specializes h) := by
    unfold Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes
    rw [Ideal.comap_comap, ← CommRingCat.hom_comp, ← hcomm, CommRingCat.hom_comp,
      ← Ideal.comap_comap, IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap]
  have hle' : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk (f y)) ≤
      Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (f.base.hom.map_specializes h) := by
    rw [← h1, ← Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    exact hle
  have hmax : Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (f.base.hom.map_specializes h) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk (f y)) :=
    ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal _).eq_of_le
      (Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_isPrime _).ne_top hle').symm
  have e := Scheme.fromSpecStalk_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (f.base.hom.map_specializes h)
  have e2 : Y.fromSpecStalk (f y) ⟨Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes
      (f.base.hom.map_specializes h), Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_isPrime _⟩ =
      Y.fromSpecStalk (f y) (IsLocalRing.closedPoint _) := by
    congr 1
    exact PrimeSpectrum.ext hmax
  rw [e2, Scheme.fromSpecStalk_closedPoint] at e
  exact e.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E27.stalkPrime_mono
statement:
theorem stalkPrime_mono {x'' x' y : X} (h'' : x'' ⤳ x') (h' : x' ⤳ y) :
    Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (h''.trans h') ≤ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h'
proof:
:= by
  unfold Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes
  rw [← TopCat.Presheaf.stalkSpecializes_comp (X.presheaf) h'' h', CommRingCat.hom_comp,
    ← Ideal.comap_comap]
  apply Ideal.comap_mono
  exact IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal
    (Ideal.IsPrime.ne_top (Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_isPrime h''))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E27.flatPullbackCoeff_ne_zero_of_minimal
statement:
theorem flatPullbackCoeff_ne_zero_of_minimal (x : X)
    (hmin : ∀ x' : X, x' ⤳ x → f x' = f x → x' = x) : flatPullbackCoeff f x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hIle : fibreIdeal f x ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x) := fibreIdeal_le_maximalIdeal f x
  
  have hprime : ∀ Q : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ fibreIdeal f x), Q.IsPrime → Q.IsMaximal := by
    intro Q hQ
    have hcp : (Q.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk (fibreIdeal f x))).IsPrime := Ideal.comap_isPrime _ _
    obtain ⟨x', h, hP⟩ := Scheme.exists_specializes_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_eq x
      (Q.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk (fibreIdeal f x)))
    have hIQ : fibreIdeal f x ≤ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h := by
      rw [hP]
      intro a ha
      rw [Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr ha]
      exact Q.zero_mem
    have hf := fibre_eq_of_fibreIdeal_le f h hIQ
    obtain rfl : x = x' := (hmin x' h hf).symm
    have hm : Q.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk (fibreIdeal f x)) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x) := by
      rw [← hP]
      unfold Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes
      rw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkSpecializes_refl]
      simp
    have hmax : (Q.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk (fibreIdeal f x))).IsMaximal := by
      rw [hm]; exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal _
    have := Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mk (fibreIdeal f x)) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective Q
    rw [← this]
    rcases Ideal.map_eq_top_or_isMaximal_of_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mk (fibreIdeal f x))
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective hmax with h1 | h1
    · exact absurd (this ▸ h1) hQ.ne_top
    · exact h1
  haveI : Ring.KrullDimLE 0 (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ fibreIdeal f x) := Ring.KrullDimLE.mk₀ hprime
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ fibreIdeal f x) := inferInstance
  haveI : IsArtinianRing (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ fibreIdeal f x) := isArtinianRing_iff_krullDimLE_zero.mpr inferInstance
  have hfin : IsFiniteLength (X.presheaf.stalk x) (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ fibreIdeal f x) := by
    rw [isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian]
    exact ⟨isNoetherian_quotient (fibreIdeal f x),
      isArtinian_of_surjective_algebraMap (Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (I := fibreIdeal f x))⟩
  have hne : Nontrivial (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ fibreIdeal f x) := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr
    (ne_top_of_le_ne_top (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal (X.presheaf.stalk x)).ne_top hIle)
  unfold flatPullbackCoeff
  intro h0
  rcases ENat.toNat_eq_zero.mp h0 with h | h
  · have : Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x) (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ fibreIdeal f x) = 0 := h
    rw [Module.length_eq_zero_iff] at this
    exact (not_subsingleton _) this
  · exact (Module.length_ne_top_iff.mpr hfin) h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E27.exists_minimalFibrePoint
statement:
theorem exists_minimalFibrePoint (y : X) :
    ∃ x : X, x ⤳ y ∧ f x = f y ∧ ∀ x' : X, x' ⤳ x → f x' = f x → x' = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpm⟩ := Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_le (fibreIdeal_le_maximalIdeal f y)
  haveI : p.IsPrime := hp.1.1
  obtain ⟨x, h, hP⟩ := Scheme.exists_specializes_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_eq y p
  have hIp : fibreIdeal f y ≤ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h := by rw [hP]; exact hp.1.2
  have hf : f x = f y := fibre_eq_of_fibreIdeal_le f h hIp
  refine ⟨x, h, hf, fun x'' h'' hf'' => ?_⟩
  have h3 : x'' ⤳ y := h''.trans h
  have hf3 : f x'' = f y := hf''.trans hf
  have hle1 : fibreIdeal f y ≤ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h3 := by
    have := m6pb_ideal_le_prime f h3 hf3
    exact this
  have hle2 : Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h3 ≤ p := by
    rw [← hP]; exact stalkPrime_mono h'' h
  haveI : (Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h3).IsPrime := Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_isPrime h3
  have hp3 : p ≤ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h3 := hp.2 ⟨inferInstance, hle1⟩ hle2
  exact Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_injective h3 h ((le_antisymm hle2 hp3).trans hP.symm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E27.exists_specializes_fibre_coeff_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_specializes_fibre_coeff_ne_zero (y : X) :
    ∃ x : X, x ⤳ y ∧ f x = f y ∧ flatPullbackCoeff f x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hxy, hf, hmin⟩ := exists_minimalFibrePoint f y
  exact ⟨x, hxy, hf, flatPullbackCoeff_ne_zero_of_minimal f x hmin⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1CL.prod_isNoetherian

proof:
:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1CL.projectiveIntegralK_prod_proj

theorem projectiveIntegralK_prod_proj {Y : Scheme.{u}} [Y.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian Y] (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (n : ℕ) :
    @ProjectiveIntegralK k _ (pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n)) (prodOver Y n)
      (prod_lft (k := k) n) (prod_isNoetherian (k := k) n)
proof:
:= by
  letI := prodOver (k := k) Y n
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) ↘ Spk k) := prod_lft (k := k) n

statement:
theorem coordinateCechHomology_isZero_of_orderedNormalization
    (hnorm : CoordinateCechOrderedNormalization k n M)
    {q : ℕ} (hnq : n < q) :
    IsZero (((coordinateCechComplexFunctor k n).obj M).homology q)
proof:
:= by
  let f := coordinateCechToOrderedComplexMap k n M
  letI : QuasiIsoAt f q := hnorm q
  have htarget :
      IsZero ((coordinateOrderedCechComplex k n M).homology q) :=
    (HomologicalComplex.ExactAt.of_isZero
      (coordinateOrderedCechComplex_X_isZero k n M hnq)).isZero_homology
  letI : IsIso (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap f q) :=
    (quasiIsoAt_iff_isIso_homologyMap f q).mp inferInstance
  exact htarget.of_iso (asIso (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap f q))
