    (hnorm : CoordinateCechOrderedNormalization k n M)
    (q : ℕ) (hnq : n < q + 1) :
    IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
        ((Modules.toSheafAb (space k n)).obj M) (q + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  apply sheafH_isZero_of_coordinateCech_isZero k n
    ((Modules.toSheafAb (space k n)).obj M)
    (quasicoherent_coordinateCechAcyclic k n M) q
  change IsZero (((coordinateCechComplexFunctor k n).obj M).homology (q + 1))
  exact coordinateCechHomology_isZero_of_orderedNormalization
    k n M hnorm hnq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.invOfUnit_coeff_intertwines
statement:
theorem invOfUnit_coeff_intertwines
    {M : Type u} {N : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℚ M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module ℚ N] (P : M →ₗ[ℚ] N)
    (a : ℕ → Module.End ℚ M) (b : ℕ → Module.End ℚ N)
    (ha : ∀ n, P ∘ₗ a n = b n ∘ₗ P) (n : ℕ) :
    P ∘ₗ PowerSeries.coeff n (PowerSeries.invOfUnit (PowerSeries.mk a) 1) =
      PowerSeries.coeff n (PowerSeries.invOfUnit (PowerSeries.mk b) 1) ∘ₗ P
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · subst n
      rw [PowerSeries.coeff_invOfUnit, PowerSeries.coeff_invOfUnit]
      simp only [inv_one, Units.val_one]
      change P ∘ₗ LinearMap.id = LinearMap.id ∘ₗ P
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_id, LinearMap.id_comp]
    · rw [PowerSeries.coeff_invOfUnit, PowerSeries.coeff_invOfUnit]
      simp only [if_neg hn, inv_one, Units.val_one, neg_one_mul]
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro m
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.neg_apply, map_neg,
        LinearMap.sum_apply, map_sum]
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro x hx
      by_cases hxn : x.2 < n
      · simp only [if_pos hxn, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, Module.End.mul_apply]
        have h1 := LinearMap.congr_fun (ha x.1)
          (PowerSeries.coeff x.2 (PowerSeries.invOfUnit (PowerSeries.mk a) 1) m)
        have h2 := LinearMap.congr_fun (ih x.2 hxn) m
        exact h1.trans (congrArg (b x.1) h2)
      · simp only [if_neg hxn, LinearMap.zero_apply, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.chernOfCover_pull_flat
statement:
theorem chernOfCover_pull_flat {E : Y.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover Y E) {r : ℕ}
    (hC : ∀ j, Nat.card (C.basisIndex j) = r + 1) (i : ℕ) :
    totalPull ops g d hd ∘ₗ chernOfCover ops C cp hC i =
      chernOfCover ops (C.pullbackFrameCover g) cp (C.pullbackFrameCover_card g hC) i ∘ₗ
        totalPull ops g d hd
proof:
:= by
  have h := invOfUnit_coeff_intertwines (totalPull ops g d hd)
    (segre ops C cp hC)
    (segre ops (C.pullbackFrameCover g) cp (C.pullbackFrameCover_card g hC))
    (fun j ↦ segre_pull_flat C g ops cp d hd hC j) i
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro α
  simp only [chernOfCover, segreSeries, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul]
  exact congrArg (fun z ↦ ((-1 : ℚ) ^ i) • z) (LinearMap.congr_fun h α)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.chernOp_pull_flat
statement:
theorem chernOp_pull_flat (L : Y.Modules) (r : ℕ) (hL : HasConstantRank Y L r) (i : ℕ) :
    totalPull ops g d hd ∘ₗ chernOp ops cp L r hL i =
      chernOp ops cp ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj L) r
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X g L r hL) i ∘ₗ totalPull ops g d hd
proof:
:= by
  cases r with
  | zero =>
    by_cases hi : i = 0
    · simp only [chernOp, if_pos hi]
      change totalPull ops g d hd ∘ₗ LinearMap.id = LinearMap.id ∘ₗ totalPull ops g d hd
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_id, LinearMap.id_comp]
    · simp only [chernOp, if_neg hi, LinearMap.comp_zero, LinearMap.zero_comp]
  | succ r =>
    let C := (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hL).choose
    have hC := (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hL).choose_spec
    rw [chernOp_eq_chernOfCover ops cp C hL hC,
      chernOp_eq_chernOfCover ops cp (C.pullbackFrameCover g)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X g L (r + 1) hL) (C.pullbackFrameCover_card g hC)]
    exact chernOfCover_pull_flat g ops cp d hd C hC i

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.ker_chart_ideal
proof:
:= by
  set φ := CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom a) with hφ
  have hr : Set.range (Spec.map φ ≫ chart k j) ⊆ Set.range (chart k j) := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_base, TopCat.coe_comp]
    exact Set.range_comp_subset_range _ _
  have hlift : IsOpenImmersion.lift (chart k j) (Spec.map φ ≫ chart k j) hr = Spec.map φ := by
    rw [← cancel_mono (chart k j), IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac]
  have H := IsOpenImmersion.isPullback_lift_id (Spec.map φ ≫ chart k j) (chart k j) hr
  rw [hlift] at H
  have h1 := Scheme.ker_ideal_of_isPullback_of_isOpenImmersion
    (Spec.map φ ≫ chart k j) _ (𝟙 _) (chart k j) H ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩
  have hker : (Spec.map φ).ker.ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩ =
      (RingHom.ker φ.hom).comap (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k[X])).hom.hom := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.ker_apply]
    ext x
    have h := Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality φ
    have h2 := congrArg (fun q => q.hom x) h
    simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply] at h2
    simp only [RingHom.mem_ker, Ideal.mem_comap]
    change (Scheme.Hom.appTop (Spec.map φ)).hom x = 0 ↔ _
    rw [← map_eq_zero_iff (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).hom.hom
      (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _).1, h2]
  have key : (Spec.map φ ≫ chart k j).ker.ideal (chartOpen k j) =
      Ideal.comap (secEquiv k j).symm (RingHom.ker φ.hom) := by
    ext x
    have hx := congrArg (fun I => (((chart k j).appIso ⊤).hom.hom x) ∈ I) h1
    simp only [Ideal.mem_comap] at hx
    have hinv : (CommRingCat.Hom.hom ((chart k j).appIso ⊤).inv)
        ((CommRingCat.Hom.hom ((chart k j).appIso ⊤).hom) x) = x := by
      rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply]; simp
    rw [hinv, hker] at hx
    refine (Eq.to_iff hx).symm.trans ?_
    exact Iff.rfl
  rw [key, Ideal.comap_symm, show RingHom.ker φ.hom = Ideal.span {Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a} from
    Polynomial.ker_evalRingHom a, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.mO_eq_zero
statement: theorem mO_eq_zero : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (α0 k)) ≫ chart k 0 = mO k
proof:
:= by

  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  have h : (α0 k).comp (chartEquiv k 0).toRingHom = HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap (grading k 1)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k 1 1) (rfl : x01 k = _) := by
    ext z
    simp [α0]
  rw [h]
  exact Proj.SpecMap_awayMap_awayι _ _ _ _ _

      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k 1 0) (mul_comm _ _ : x01 k = _) := by
    ext z

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.α_prod
statement: theorem α_prod : α0 k Polynomial.X * α1 k Polynomial.X = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : (chartEquiv k 0).symm Polynomial.X =
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateRatio k 1 0 ⟨1, by decide⟩ := by
    rw [← chartEquiv_coordinateRatio k 0 ⟨1, by decide⟩]
    simp
  have h1 : (chartEquiv k 1).symm Polynomial.X =
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateRatio k 1 1 ⟨0, by decide⟩ := by
    rw [← chartEquiv_coordinateRatio k 1 ⟨0, by decide⟩]
    simp
  simp only [α0, α1, RingHom.comp_apply, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom, h0, h1]
  rw [SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateRatio, SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateRatio,
    HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap_mk]
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk,
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.val_one, Localization.mk_mul]
  rw [← Localization.mk_one, Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  simp only [Submonoid.coe_mul, Submonoid.coe_one, x01]
  ring

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.chartEquiv_symm_C

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.overlapOpen_eq
statement: theorem overlapOpen_eq : overlapOpen k = mO k ''ᵁ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : (chartOpen k 0).1 = (chart k 0).opensRange := Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange _
  have h1 : (chartOpen k 1).1 = (chart k 1).opensRange := Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange _
  have hm : mO k ''ᵁ ⊤ = (mO k).opensRange := Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange _
  have hx : (mO k).opensRange = (chart k 0).opensRange ⊓ (chart k 1).opensRange :=

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.trans_gen
statement:
theorem trans_gen (j : Fin 2) (αj : k[X] →+* R01 k)
    (hm : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom αj) ≫ chart k j = mO k)
    (hle : overlapOpen k ≤ (chartOpen k j).1) (t : k[X]) :
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (R01 k))).hom.hom
      ((Φ k).hom ((P1 k).presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op (secEquiv k j t))) = αj t
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := Scheme.Hom.map_appLE (mO k) (overlapOpen_le k) (homOfLE hle).op
  have h2 := congrArg (fun f => f.hom (secEquiv k j t)) h1
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply] at h2
  change (Φ k).hom ((P1 k).presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op (secEquiv k j t)) = _ at h2
  rw [h2]
  have e1 : (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of k[X])).Opens) ≤ chart k j ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k j).1 :=
    (Scheme.Hom.preimage_image_eq (chart k j) ⊤).ge
  have e2 : (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of (R01 k))).Opens) ≤
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom αj)) ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤ := le_rfl
  have h3 : ∀ e0 : (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of (R01 k))).Opens) ≤ mO k ⁻¹ᵁ (chartOpen k j).1,
      Scheme.Hom.appLE (mO k) (chartOpen k j).1 ⊤ e0 =
      Scheme.Hom.appLE (chart k j) (chartOpen k j).1 ⊤ e1 ≫
        Scheme.Hom.appLE (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom αj)) ⊤ ⊤ e2 := by
    intro e0
    rw [Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE]
    exact appLE_eq_of_eq hm.symm _ _ _ _
  rw [h3]
  have h4 : Scheme.Hom.appLE (chart k j) (chartOpen k j).1 ⊤ e1 = ((chart k j).appIso ⊤).hom :=
    (Scheme.Hom.appIso_hom' (chart k j) ⊤).symm
  have h5 : Scheme.Hom.appLE (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom αj)) ⊤ ⊤ e2 =
      Scheme.Hom.appTop (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom αj)) := by
    simp [Scheme.Hom.appLE, Scheme.Hom.appTop]
  rw [h4, h5, CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply]
  have h6 : (CommRingCat.Hom.hom ((chart k j).appIso ⊤).hom) (secEquiv k j t) =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k[X])).inv.hom t := by
    change (CommRingCat.Hom.hom ((chart k j).appIso ⊤).hom)
      ((CommRingCat.Hom.hom ((chart k j).appIso ⊤).inv)
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k[X])).inv.hom t)) = _
    rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply]; simp
  refine (congrArg (fun z => (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (R01 k))).hom.hom
    ((Scheme.Hom.appTop (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom αj))).hom z)) h6).trans ?_
  have h7 := Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality (CommRingCat.ofHom αj)
  have h8 := congrArg (fun q => q.hom ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k[X])).inv.hom t)) h7
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply] at h8
  refine h8.trans ?_
  have h9 : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k[X])).hom.hom
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k[X])).inv.hom t) = t := by
    rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply]; simp
  exact congrArg αj h9

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.Ψ_res1

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.hcomp_of_poly
statement:
theorem hcomp_of_poly (p0 q0 p1 q1 : k[X]) (h : α0 k p0 * α1 k q1 = α1 k p1 * α0 k q0) :
    (P1 k).presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : (chartOpen k 0).1 ⊓ (chartOpen k 1).1 ≤
        (chartOpen k 0).1)).op (secEquiv k 0 p0) *
      (P1 k).presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : (chartOpen k 0).1 ⊓ (chartOpen k 1).1 ≤
        (chartOpen k 1).1)).op (secEquiv k 1 q1) =
    (P1 k).presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : (chartOpen k 0).1 ⊓ (chartOpen k 1).1 ≤
        (chartOpen k 1).1)).op (secEquiv k 1 p1) *
      (P1 k).presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : (chartOpen k 0).1 ⊓ (chartOpen k 1).1 ≤
        (chartOpen k 0).1)).op (secEquiv k 0 q0)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ψ_injective k
  rw [map_mul, map_mul, Ψ_res0, Ψ_res1, Ψ_res1, Ψ_res0]
  exact h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.chartOpen_val
statement: theorem chartOpen_val (j : Fin 2) : (chartOpen k j).1 = (chart k j).opensRange
proof:
:=
  Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.pointInf_toSpec
statement: theorem pointInf_toSpec : pointInf k ≫ SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k 1 = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  unfold pointInf
  rw [Category.assoc, chart_toSpec, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_id]
  congr 1
  refine CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext fun a => ?_)
  simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.not_mem_chart_of_eval_zero
statement:
theorem not_mem_chart_of_eval_zero (i i' : Fin 2)
    (hD : chart k i ⁻¹ᵁ (chart k i').opensRange = PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (Polynomial.X : k[X]))
    (y : Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :
    chart k i (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : k))) y) ∉
      (chart k i').opensRange
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h1 : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : k))) y ∈
      chart k i ⁻¹ᵁ (chart k i').opensRange := h
  rw [hD] at h1
  apply h1
  change (Polynomial.X : k[X]) ∈ (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : k)) y).asIdeal
  rw [PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal, Ideal.mem_comap]
  simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.pointInf_not_mem
statement:
theorem pointInf_not_mem (y : Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :
    pointInf k y ∉ (chartOpen k 1).1
proof:
:= by
  have := not_mem_chart_of_eval_zero k 0 1 (chart_zero_preimage k) y
  rw [chartOpen_val]
  exact this

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.pointAt_zero_not_mem
statement:
theorem pointAt_zero_not_mem (y : Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :
    SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationSpace.pointAt k 0 y ∉ (chartOpen k 0).1
proof:
:= by
  have := not_mem_chart_of_eval_zero k 1 0 (chart_one_preimage k) y
  rw [chartOpen_val]
  exact this

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.ker_ideal_top_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem ker_ideal_top_of_disjoint {Y X : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion f]
    (V : X.affineOpens) (h : ∀ y, f y ∉ V.1) : f.ker.ideal V = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine ideal_eq_top_of_disjoint_support _ V (fun z hz hzs => ?_)
  have hzs' : z ∈ ((Scheme.Hom.ker f).support : Set X) := hzs
  rw [Scheme.Hom.support_ker, f.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range.closure_eq] at hzs'
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hzs'
  exact h y hz

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.evalL_toLaurent
statement:
theorem evalL_toLaurent (c : k) (hc : c ≠ 0) (p : k[X]) :
    evalL k c hc (Polynomial.toLaurent p) = Polynomial.eval c p
proof:
:= by
  unfold evalL
  exact IsLocalization.lift_eq (M := Submonoid.powers (Polynomial.X : k[X])) (S := k[T;T⁻¹]) _ p

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.evalL_T_one
statement: theorem evalL_T_one (c : k) (hc : c ≠ 0) : evalL k c hc (T 1) = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Polynomial.toLaurent_X, evalL_toLaurent]; simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.evalL_T_neg_one
statement: theorem evalL_T_neg_one (c : k) (hc : c ≠ 0) : evalL k c hc (T (-1)) = c⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have h : (T (-1) : k[T;T⁻¹]) * T 1 = 1 := by
    rw [← T_add]; simp
  have h2 := congrArg (evalL k c hc) h
  rw [map_mul, evalL_T_one, map_one] at h2
  exact eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left h2

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.evalL_C
statement: theorem evalL_C (c : k) (hc : c ≠ 0) (a : k) : evalL k c hc (C a) = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Polynomial.toLaurent_C, evalL_toLaurent]; simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.overlapHom_comp_α0
statement:
theorem overlapHom_comp_α0 :
    (overlapHom (RingHom.id k)).comp (α0 k) = lineLaurent (RingHom.id k)
proof:
:= by
  have h := overlapHom_awayMap_zero (RingHom.id k)
  refine RingHom.ext fun z => ?_
  have h2 := RingHom.congr_fun h ((chartEquiv k 0).symm z)
  simpa [α0] using h2

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.overlapHom_comp_α1
statement:
theorem overlapHom_comp_α1 :
    (overlapHom (RingHom.id k)).comp (α1 k) =
      (LaurentPolynomial.invert (R := k)).toRingHom.comp (lineLaurent (RingHom.id k))
proof:
:= by
  have h := overlapHom_awayMap_one (RingHom.id k)
  refine RingHom.ext fun z => ?_
  have h2 := RingHom.congr_fun h ((chartEquiv k 1).symm z)
  simpa [α1] using h2

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.βh_α0
statement: theorem βh_α0 (c : k) (hc : c ≠ 0) : (βh k c hc).comp (α0 k) = Polynomial.evalRingHom c⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  unfold βh
  rw [RingHom.comp_assoc, overlapHom_comp_α0]
  refine Polynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a => ?_) ?_
  · rw [RingHom.comp_apply, lineLaurent_C, ← LaurentPolynomial.C_eq_algebraMap, evalL_C]
    simp
  · rw [RingHom.comp_apply, lineLaurent_X, evalL_T_neg_one]
    simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.βh_α1
statement: theorem βh_α1 (c : k) (hc : c ≠ 0) : (βh k c hc).comp (α1 k) = Polynomial.evalRingHom c
proof:
:= by
  unfold βh
  rw [RingHom.comp_assoc, overlapHom_comp_α1]
  refine Polynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a => ?_) ?_
  · rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.comp_apply, lineLaurent_C, ← LaurentPolynomial.C_eq_algebraMap]
    simp [evalL_C]
  · rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.comp_apply, lineLaurent_X]
    simp [evalL_T_one]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.pointAt_eq_chart_zero
statement:
theorem pointAt_eq_chart_zero (c : k) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationSpace.pointAt k c =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom c⁻¹)) ≫ chart k 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.DeformationSpace.pointAt
  rw [← βh_α1 k c hc, ← βh_α0 k c hc, CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, CommRingCat.ofHom_comp,
    Spec.map_comp, Spec.map_comp, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, mO_eq_zero, mO_eq_one]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.chartOpen_sup_eq_top
statement: theorem chartOpen_sup_eq_top : (chartOpen k 0).1 ⊔ (chartOpen k 1).1 = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have h := SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top k 1
  rw [chartOpen_val, chartOpen_val]
  refine top_le_iff.mp ?_
  rw [← h]
  refine iSup_le fun i => ?_
  fin_cases i
  · exact (opensRange_chart k 0).symm.le.trans le_sup_left
  · exact (opensRange_chart k 1).symm.le.trans le_sup_right

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.secEquiv_ne_zero
statement: theorem secEquiv_ne_zero (j : Fin 2) {p : k[X]} (hp : p ≠ 0) : secEquiv k j p ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  fun h => hp ((secEquiv k j).injective (by rw [h, map_zero]))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.ker_ideal_congr
statement:
theorem ker_ideal_congr {Y X : Scheme.{u}} {f g : Y ⟶ X} [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiCompact g]
    (h : f = g) (V : X.affineOpens) : f.ker.ideal V = g.ker.ideal V
proof:
:= by

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.ker_pointAt_U1
proof:
:=
  ker_chart_ideal k 1 c

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.ker_pointInf_U0
proof:
:=

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.ker_pointInf_U1
statement: theorem ker_pointInf_U1 : (pointInf k).ker.ideal (chartOpen k 1) = ⊤

:=

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.ker_pointAt_zero_U0
statement: theorem ker_pointAt_zero_U0 : (pointAt k 0).ker.ideal (chartOpen k 0) = ⊤

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.ker_pointAt_U0

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.pointAt_inj_KDGa
statement:
theorem pointAt_inj_KDGa (c c' : k) (x y : Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (h : pointAt k c x = pointAt k c' y) : c = c'
proof:
:= by
  unfold pointAt at h
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at h
  have h2 := (chart k 1).isOpenEmbedding.injective h
  have h3 : PrimeSpectrum.comap (evalRingHom c) x = PrimeSpectrum.comap (evalRingHom c') y := h2
  have h4 : (X - C c : k[X]) ∈ (PrimeSpectrum.comap (evalRingHom c) x).asIdeal := by
    rw [PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal, Ideal.mem_comap]
    simp
  rw [h3, PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal, Ideal.mem_comap] at h4
  simp only [coe_evalRingHom, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C] at h4
  by_contra hne
  have hu : IsUnit (c' - c) := (sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hne)).isUnit
  exact y.isPrime.ne_top (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ h4 hu)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.pointAt_ker_ne_bot
statement: theorem pointAt_ker_ne_bot (c : k) : (pointAt k c).ker ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  haveI : IsIso (pointAt k c) := IsClosedImmersion.isIso_iff_ker_eq_bot.mpr h
  obtain ⟨y⟩ : Nonempty (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := inferInstance
  have hne : c ≠ c + 1 := by
    intro h'
    simp at h'
  set z := pointAt k (c + 1) y with hz
  set y' := (inv (pointAt k c)) z with hy'
  have hy'z : pointAt k c y' = z := by
    rw [hy', ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, IsIso.inv_hom_id]; rfl
  exact hne (pointAt_inj_KDGa k c (c + 1) _ _ hy'z)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.pointInf_ker_ne_bot
statement: theorem pointInf_ker_ne_bot : (pointInf k).ker ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  haveI : IsIso (pointInf k) := IsClosedImmersion.isIso_iff_ker_eq_bot.mpr h
  obtain ⟨y⟩ : Nonempty (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := inferInstance
  set z := pointAt k 0 y with hz
  set y' := (inv (pointInf k)) z with hy'
  have hy'z : pointInf k y' = z := by
    rw [hy', ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, IsIso.inv_hom_id]; rfl
  apply pointInf_not_mem k y'
  rw [hy'z, chartOpen_val]
  exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.exists_cartierData_P1_two_points
statement:
theorem exists_cartierData_P1_two_points (c : k) :
    ∃ (𝓛 : (P1 k).Modules) (_ : HasConstantRank (P1 k) 𝓛 1)
      (σc σi : tensorUnitSheaf (P1 k) ⟶ 𝓛),
      SectionIsRegular σc ∧ SectionIsRegular σi ∧
        sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σc = (pointAt k c).ker ∧
        sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σi = (pointInf k).ker
proof:
:= by
  have hcov := chartOpen_sup_eq_top k
  by_cases hc : c = 0
  · subst hc
    have hX : (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (0 : k) : k[X]) ≠ 0 := Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero 0
    refine exists_two_sections_of_charts (pointAt k 0).ker (pointInf k).ker
      (pointAt_ker_ne_bot k 0) (pointInf_ker_ne_bot k) (chartOpen k 0) (chartOpen k 1) hcov
      (secEquiv k 0 1) (secEquiv k 1 (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C 0))
      ?_ (ker_pointAt_U1 k 0) ?_ (secEquiv_ne_zero k 1 hX)
      (secEquiv k 0 (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C 0)) (secEquiv k 1 1)
      (ker_pointInf_U0 k) ?_ ?_
    · rw [ker_pointAt_zero_U0, map_one, Ideal.span_singleton_one]
    · exact secEquiv_ne_zero k 0 one_ne_zero
    · rw [ker_pointInf_U1, map_one, Ideal.span_singleton_one]
    · refine hcomp_of_poly k _ _ _ _ ?_
      simp only [map_one, mul_one, map_zero, sub_zero]
      exact α_prod k
  · have hX : (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C c : k[X]) ≠ 0 := Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero c
    have hX' : (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C c⁻¹ : k[X]) ≠ 0 := Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero c⁻¹
    have hu : IsUnit (secEquiv k 1 (Polynomial.C (-c))) :=
      (Polynomial.isUnit_C.mpr (neg_ne_zero.mpr hc).isUnit).map (secEquiv k 1)
    refine exists_two_sections_of_charts (pointAt k c).ker (pointInf k).ker
      (pointAt_ker_ne_bot k c) (pointInf_ker_ne_bot k) (chartOpen k 0) (chartOpen k 1) hcov
      (secEquiv k 0 (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C c⁻¹)) (secEquiv k 1 (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C c))
      (ker_pointAt_U0 k c hc) (ker_pointAt_U1 k c) (secEquiv_ne_zero k 0 hX')
      (secEquiv_ne_zero k 1 hX)
      (secEquiv k 0 (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C 0)) (secEquiv k 1 (Polynomial.C (-c)))
      (ker_pointInf_U0 k) ?_ ?_
    · rw [ker_pointInf_U1, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top.mpr hu]
    · refine hcomp_of_poly k _ _ _ _ ?_
      have e1 : α0 k (Polynomial.C c) = α1 k (Polynomial.C c) := α_C_eq k c
      have e2 : α0 k (Polynomial.C (-c)) = α1 k (Polynomial.C (-c)) := α_C_eq k (-c)
      have e3 : α0 k (Polynomial.C c) * α0 k (Polynomial.C c⁻¹) = 1 := by
        rw [← map_mul, ← Polynomial.C_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc, Polynomial.C_1, map_one]
      have e4 : α0 k (Polynomial.C (-c)) = - α0 k (Polynomial.C c) := by
        rw [Polynomial.C_neg, map_neg]
      simp only [map_sub, map_zero, sub_zero]
      rw [← e2, e4, ← e1]
      linear_combination α_prod k - e3

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E10.frameEquiv_restrict
statement:
theorem frameEquiv_restrict {L : X.Modules} {W : X.Opens}
    (e : L.over W ≅ (tensorUnitSheaf X).over W) {V : X.Opens} (hVW : V ≤ W) (m : Γ(L, W)) :
    frameEquiv e hVW (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVW).op m) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVW).op (frameEquiv e le_rfl m)
proof:
:= by
  have h := e.hom.val.naturality (Over.homMk (homOfLE hVW) (Category.comp_id _) :
    Over.mk (homOfLE hVW) ⟶ Over.mk (𝟙 W)).op
  have h1 := congrArg (fun φ => (ConcreteCategory.hom φ) m) h
  simp only [CategoryTheory.comp_apply] at h1
  exact h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E10.app_restrict
statement:
theorem app_restrict {A B : X.Modules} (f : A ⟶ B) {V W : X.Opens} (hVW : V ≤ W) (m : Γ(A, W)) :
    B.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVW).op (f.app W m) = f.app V (A.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVW).op m)
proof:
:= by
  have h := f.mapPresheaf.naturality (homOfLE hVW).op
  have h1 := congrArg (fun φ => (ConcreteCategory.hom φ) m) h
  simp only [CategoryTheory.comp_apply, Scheme.Modules.mapPresheaf_app] at h1
  exact h1.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E10.frame_app
statement:
theorem frame_app {A B : X.Modules} (f : A ⟶ B) {W : X.Opens}
    (eA : A.over W ≅ (tensorUnitSheaf X).over W) (eB : B.over W ≅ (tensorUnitSheaf X).over W)
    {V : X.Opens} (hVW : V ≤ W) (a : Γ(A, V)) :
    frameEquiv eB hVW (f.app V a) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVW).op (scal f eA eB) * frameEquiv eA hVW a
proof:
:= by
  set a0 : Γ(A, W) := (frameEquiv eA le_rfl).symm 1 with ha0
  have h0 : frameEquiv eA hVW (A.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVW).op a0) = 1 := by
    rw [frameEquiv_restrict, ha0, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact map_one _
  have ha : a = (frameEquiv eA hVW a) • A.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVW).op a0 := by
    apply (frameEquiv eA hVW).injective
    rw [map_smul, h0]
    simp
  conv_lhs => rw [ha]
  rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul, map_smul, ← app_restrict f hVW a0, frameEquiv_restrict]
  simp only [scal, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [mul_comm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E10.presheaf_map_comp_apply
statement:
theorem presheaf_map_comp_apply {V V' W : X.Opens} (h1 : V ≤ V') (h2 : V' ≤ W) (r : Γ(X, W)) :
    X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h1.trans h2)).op r =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h1).op (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h2).op r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← X.presheaf.map_comp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E10.bijective_app_of_unit
statement:
theorem bijective_app_of_unit {A B : X.Modules} (f : A ⟶ B) {W : X.Opens}
    (eA : A.over W ≅ (tensorUnitSheaf X).over W) (eB : B.over W ≅ (tensorUnitSheaf X).over W)
    {V' : X.Opens} (hV'W : V' ≤ W)
    (hu : IsUnit (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV'W).op (scal f eA eB))) {V : X.Opens} (hVV' : V ≤ V') :
    Function.Bijective (f.app V)
proof:
:= by
  have hu' : IsUnit (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hVV'.trans hV'W)).op (scal f eA eB)) := by
    rw [presheaf_map_comp_apply hVV' hV'W]
    exact hu.map _
  obtain ⟨u, hu0⟩ := hu'
  have key := frame_app f eA eB (hVV'.trans hV'W)
  constructor
  · intro a a' h
    have h2 := congrArg (frameEquiv eB (hVV'.trans hV'W)) h
    rw [key, key, ← hu0] at h2
    exact (frameEquiv eA (hVV'.trans hV'W)).injective ((Units.mul_right_inj u).1 h2)
  · intro b
    refine ⟨(frameEquiv eA (hVV'.trans hV'W)).symm (↑u⁻¹ * frameEquiv eB (hVV'.trans hV'W) b), ?_⟩
    apply (frameEquiv eB (hVV'.trans hV'W)).injective
    rw [key, ← hu0, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, ← mul_assoc, Units.mul_inv, one_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E10.isIso_over_of_unit
statement:
theorem isIso_over_of_unit {A B : X.Modules} (f : A ⟶ B) {W : X.Opens}
    (eA : A.over W ≅ (tensorUnitSheaf X).over W) (eB : B.over W ≅ (tensorUnitSheaf X).over W)
    {V' : X.Opens} (hV'W : V' ≤ W)
    (hu : IsUnit (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV'W).op (scal f eA eB))) : IsIso (f.over V')
proof:
:= by
  haveI : (SheafOfModules.forget (X.ringCatSheaf.over V')).ReflectsIsomorphisms :=
    (SheafOfModules.fullyFaithfulForget _).reflectsIsomorphisms
  rw [← isIso_iff_of_reflects_iso _ (SheafOfModules.forget (X.ringCatSheaf.over V') ⋙
    PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _), NatTrans.isIso_iff_isIso_app]
  intro T
  rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
  exact bijective_app_of_unit f eA eB hV'W hu (leOfHom T.unop.hom)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E10.local_unit
statement:
theorem local_unit {A A' B : X.Modules} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : A' ⟶ B)
    (hjoint : ∀ {T : X.Modules} (u v : B ⟶ T), f ≫ u = f ≫ v → g ≫ u = g ≫ v → u = v)
    {W : X.Opens} (eA : A.over W ≅ (tensorUnitSheaf X).over W)
    (eA' : A'.over W ≅ (tensorUnitSheaf X).over W) (eB : B.over W ≅ (tensorUnitSheaf X).over W)
    (x : X) (hx : x ∈ W) :
    ∃ (V' : X.Opens) (h : V' ≤ W), x ∈ V' ∧
      (IsUnit (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (scal f eA eB)) ∨
        IsUnit (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (scal g eA' eB)))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Epi (biprod.desc f g) :=
    ⟨fun u v h => hjoint u v (by simpa using biprod.inl ≫= h) (by simpa using biprod.inr ≫= h)⟩
  obtain ⟨V, hVW, hxV, t, ht⟩ := Scheme.Modules.exists_open_lifts_of_finite_elements X
    (biprod.desc f g) PUnit W (fun _ => (frameEquiv eB le_rfl).symm 1) x hx
  set τ : Γ(A ⊞ A', V) := t PUnit.unit with hτ
  have ht' : (biprod.desc f g).app V τ =
      B.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVW).op ((frameEquiv eB le_rfl).symm 1) := ht PUnit.unit
  set α : Γ(A, V) := (biprod.fst : A ⊞ A' ⟶ A).app V τ
  set β : Γ(A', V) := (biprod.snd : A ⊞ A' ⟶ A').app V τ
  have hτ2 : τ = (biprod.inl : A ⟶ A ⊞ A').app V α + (biprod.inr : A' ⟶ A ⊞ A').app V β := by
    have h : ((biprod.fst ≫ biprod.inl + biprod.snd ≫ biprod.inr : A ⊞ A' ⟶ A ⊞ A').app V) τ =
        τ := by
      rw [biprod.total]; rfl
    simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.add_app, Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app] at h
    exact h.symm
  have e1 := congrArg (fun φ : A ⟶ B => φ.app V α) (biprod.inl_desc f g)
  have e2 := congrArg (fun φ : A' ⟶ B => φ.app V β) (biprod.inr_desc f g)
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app] at e1 e2
  have hsum : f.app V α + g.app V β =
      B.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVW).op ((frameEquiv eB le_rfl).symm 1) := by
    rw [← ht', hτ2, map_add]
    exact congrArg₂ (· + ·) e1.symm e2.symm
  have h1 : (1 : Γ(X, V)) = X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVW).op (scal f eA eB) * frameEquiv eA hVW α +
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVW).op (scal g eA' eB) * frameEquiv eA' hVW β := by
    have h2 := congrArg (frameEquiv eB hVW) hsum
    rw [map_add, frame_app f eA eB hVW, frame_app g eA' eB hVW, frameEquiv_restrict,
      LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, map_one (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVW).op).hom] at h2
    exact h2.symm
  have hgerm : ∀ r : Γ(X, W), X.presheaf.germ V x hxV (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVW).op r) =
      X.presheaf.germ W x hx r := fun r => X.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE hVW) x hxV r
  have h3 := congrArg (X.presheaf.germ V x hxV) h1
  rw [map_one, map_add, map_mul, map_mul, hgerm, hgerm] at h3
  rcases IsLocalRing.isUnit_or_isUnit_of_add_one h3.symm with hu | hu
  · obtain ⟨V', i, hxV', hu'⟩ := X.toRingedSpace.isUnit_res_of_isUnit_germ W (scal f eA eB) x hx
      (isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left hu)
    exact ⟨V', leOfHom i, hxV', Or.inl hu'⟩
  · obtain ⟨V', i, hxV', hu'⟩ := X.toRingedSpace.isUnit_res_of_isUnit_germ W (scal g eA' eB) x hx
      (isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left hu)
    exact ⟨V', leOfHom i, hxV', Or.inr hu'⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E10.exists_nhds_isIso
statement:
theorem exists_nhds_isIso {A A' B : X.Modules} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : A' ⟶ B)
    (hjoint : ∀ {T : X.Modules} (u v : B ⟶ T), f ≫ u = f ≫ v → g ≫ u = g ≫ v → u = v)
    (hA : IsLocalLineFrame A) (hA' : IsLocalLineFrame A') (hB : IsLocalLineFrame B) (x : X) :
    ∃ V : X.Opens, x ∈ V ∧ (IsIso (f.over V) ∨ IsIso (g.over V))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U₁, hx₁, ⟨e₁⟩⟩ := hA x
  obtain ⟨U₂, hx₂, ⟨e₂⟩⟩ := hA' x
  obtain ⟨U₃, hx₃, ⟨e₃⟩⟩ := hB x
  let W : X.Opens := U₁.1 ⊓ U₂.1 ⊓ U₃.1
  have hxW : x ∈ W := ⟨⟨hx₁, hx₂⟩, hx₃⟩
  have h1 : W ≤ U₁.1 := inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left
  have h2 : W ≤ U₂.1 := inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right
  have h3 : W ≤ U₃.1 := inf_le_right
  obtain ⟨V', hV', hxV', hu⟩ := local_unit f g hjoint (restrictOverIsoLE h1 e₁)
    (restrictOverIsoLE h2 e₂) (restrictOverIsoLE h3 e₃) x hxW
  refine ⟨V', hxV', ?_⟩
  rcases hu with hu | hu
  · exact Or.inl (isIso_over_of_unit f _ _ hV' hu)
  · exact Or.inr (isIso_over_of_unit g _ _ hV' hu)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E10.exists_cover_isIso
statement:
theorem exists_cover_isIso {A A' B : X.Modules} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : A' ⟶ B)
    (hjoint : ∀ {T : X.Modules} (u v : B ⟶ T), f ≫ u = f ≫ v → g ≫ u = g ≫ v → u = v)
    (hA : IsLocalLineFrame A) (hA' : IsLocalLineFrame A') (hB : IsLocalLineFrame B) :
    ∃ U₁ U₂ : X.Opens, IsIso (f.over U₁) ∧ IsIso (g.over U₂) ∧ ∀ x : X, x ∈ U₁ ∨ x ∈ U₂
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Jf := {V : X.Opens // IsIso (f.over V)}
  let Jg := {V : X.Opens // IsIso (g.over V)}
  refine ⟨⨆ j : Jf, j.1, ⨆ j : Jg, j.1,
    E7.isIso_over_iSup f (fun j : Jf ↦ j.1) (fun j ↦ j.2),
    E7.isIso_over_iSup g (fun j : Jg ↦ j.1) (fun j ↦ j.2), ?_⟩
  intro x
  obtain ⟨V, hxV, h | h⟩ := exists_nhds_isIso f g hjoint hA hA' hB x
  · exact Or.inl (TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨V, h⟩, hxV⟩)
  · exact Or.inr (TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨V, h⟩, hxV⟩)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E10.xi_relation
statement:
theorem xi_relation (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1) :
    (xiCap ops C - totalCap ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase L 1 hL)) ∘ₗ
      (xiCap ops C - totalCap ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj M)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase M 1 hM)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U₁, U₂, h₁, h₂, hcov⟩ := exists_cover_isIso (E7.tautFst C) (E7.tautSnd C)
    (fun u v h1 h2 ↦ tautCoord_jointly_epi C u v h1 h2)
    (isLocalLineFrame_of_hasConstantRank (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase L 1 hL))
    (isLocalLineFrame_of_hasConstantRank (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase M 1 hM))
    (isLocalLineFrame_of_hasConstantRank (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))
  haveI := h₁
  haveI := h₂
  exact E7.xi_relation_of_cover ops C hL hM U₁ U₂ hcov

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.sectionCoordSec_compat
statement:
theorem sectionCoordSec_compat {x y : S} (d : LineBundleLocalData S M x)
    (e : LineBundleLocalData S M y) (s : Γ(M, ⊤)) :
    S.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ e.U)).op (sectionCoordSec e s) =
      S.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ d.U)).op (sectionCoordSec d s) *
        d.transitionSection e
proof:
:= by
  apply C1Cap.frameSec_injective e (d.U ⊓ e.U) inf_le_right
  have l1 := frameSec_restrict e e.U (d.U ⊓ e.U) le_rfl inf_le_right (sectionCoordSec e s)
  have l2 := frameSec_restrict d d.U (d.U ⊓ e.U) le_rfl inf_le_left (sectionCoordSec d s)
  have e1 := sectionCoordSec_spec e s
  have e2 := sectionCoordSec_spec d s
  have pmm : ∀ {V W : S.Opens} (h : W ≤ V) (h' : V ≤ ⊤),
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h').op s) =
        M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h.trans h')).op s := by
    intro V W h h'
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← M.presheaf.map_comp]
    rfl
  have L : C1Cap.frameSec e (d.U ⊓ e.U) inf_le_right
      (S.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ e.U)).op (sectionCoordSec e s)) =
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ ⊤)).op s := by
    rw [l1, e1, pmm]
  have R : C1Cap.frameSec e (d.U ⊓ e.U) inf_le_right
      (S.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ d.U)).op (sectionCoordSec d s) *
        d.transitionSection e) =
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ ⊤)).op s := by
    rw [C1Cap.frameSec_smul e (d.U ⊓ e.U) inf_le_right
      (S.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ d.U)).op (sectionCoordSec d s) *
        d.transitionSection e), mul_smul,
      ← C1Cap.frameSec_smul e (d.U ⊓ e.U) inf_le_right (d.transitionSection e),
      C1Cap.frameSec_transitionSection d e,
      ← C1Cap.frameSec_smul d (d.U ⊓ e.U) inf_le_left, l2, e2, pmm]
  exact L.trans R.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.germ_coord_eq_mul_unit
statement:
theorem germ_coord_eq_mul_unit (E : C1Cap.LocalEquationFrames M a) (x y p : S)
    (hx : p ∈ (E.frame x).U) (hy : p ∈ (E.frame y).U) :
    ∃ u : (S.presheaf.stalk p)ˣ,
      S.presheaf.germ (E.frame y).U p hy (E.coord y) =
        S.presheaf.germ (E.frame x).U p hx (E.coord x) * (u : S.presheaf.stalk p)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : p ∈ (E.frame x).U ⊓ (E.frame y).U := ⟨hx, hy⟩
  have h1 := S.presheaf.germ_res_apply
    (homOfLE (inf_le_right : (E.frame x).U ⊓ (E.frame y).U ≤ (E.frame y).U)) p hp (E.coord y)
  have h2 := S.presheaf.germ_res_apply
    (homOfLE (inf_le_left : (E.frame x).U ⊓ (E.frame y).U ≤ (E.frame x).U)) p hp (E.coord x)
  have hc := congrArg (S.presheaf.germ ((E.frame x).U ⊓ (E.frame y).U) p hp) (E.compat x y)
  have hu : IsUnit (S.presheaf.germ ((E.frame x).U ⊓ (E.frame y).U) p hp
      ((E.frame x).transitionSection (E.frame y))) :=
    ((E.frame x).transitionSection_isUnit (E.frame y)).map _
  obtain ⟨u, hu'⟩ := hu
  refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
  rw [hu', ← h1, hc, map_mul, h2]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.stalkSpecializes_eq_mul_unit
statement:
theorem stalkSpecializes_eq_mul_unit (E : C1Cap.LocalEquationFrames M a) {x y : S} (h : x ⤳ y) :
    ∃ u : (S.presheaf.stalk x)ˣ,
      (S.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom (a y) = a x * (u : S.presheaf.stalk x)
proof:
:= by
  have hy := (E.frame y).mem
  have hx' := h.mem_open (E.frame y).U.isOpen hy
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := germ_coord_eq_mul_unit E x y x (E.frame x).mem hx'
  refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
  rw [← E.germ_coord y, ← E.germ_coord x, S.presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes_apply (E.frame y).mem h]
  exact hu

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.associated_of_specializes
statement:
theorem associated_of_specializes (E : C1Cap.LocalEquationFrames M a) {x y : S} (h : x ⤳ y) :
    Associated ((S.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom (a y)) (a x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := stalkSpecializes_eq_mul_unit E h
  rw [hu]
  exact (associated_mul_isUnit_left_iff u.isUnit).mpr (Associated.refl _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.isOpen_isUnit
statement:
theorem isOpen_isUnit (E : C1Cap.LocalEquationFrames M a) :
    IsOpen {w : S | IsUnit (a w)}
proof:
:= by
  rw [isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open]
  intro w hw
  refine ⟨(S.basicOpen (E.coord w) : Set S), fun w' hw' ↦ ?_, (S.basicOpen (E.coord w)).isOpen, ?_⟩
  · have hU : w' ∈ (E.frame w).U := S.basicOpen_le _ hw'
    have h1 := (S.mem_basicOpen (E.coord w) w' hU).mp hw'
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := germ_coord_eq_mul_unit E w' w w' (E.frame w').mem hU
    rw [hu, E.germ_coord w'] at h1
    exact isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left h1
  · refine (S.mem_basicOpen (E.coord w) w (E.frame w).mem).mpr ?_
    rw [E.germ_coord w]
    exact hw

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.finite_coheight_one_of_isClosed
statement:
theorem finite_coheight_one_of_isClosed {F : Set Y} (hF : IsClosed F)
    (hη : genericPoint Y ∉ F) : {w | w ∈ F ∧ coheight w = 1}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  letI : QuasiSober F := hF.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.quasiSober
  have hclosure : closure F ≠ Set.univ := by
    intro h
    apply hη
    rw [← hF.closure_eq]
    simpa only [h] using (Set.mem_univ (genericPoint Y))
  exact TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace.finite_coheight_one_of_closure_ne_univ hclosure

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.exists_closed_not_isUnitAt
statement:
theorem exists_closed_not_isUnitAt (f : Y.functionField) (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    ∃ F : Set Y, IsClosed F ∧ genericPoint Y ∉ F ∧ ∀ w, w ∉ F → IsUnitAt f w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, -, f', hne, hff, hu⟩ := exists_isUnit_germ_eq f hf
  refine ⟨(U : Set Y)ᶜ, U.isOpen.isClosed_compl, ?_, fun w hw ↦ ?_⟩
  · simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, not_not]
    exact ((genericPoint_spec Y).mem_open_set_iff U.isOpen).mpr (by simpa using hne)
  · have hwU : w ∈ U := by simpa using hw
    refine ⟨Y.presheaf.germ U w hwU f', hu.map _, ?_⟩
    rw [Scheme.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField]
    exact hff

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.pullback_isUnit_iff
statement:
theorem pullback_isUnit_iff (g : DimRelationGenerator X n) (y : g.Y) :
    IsUnit (a.pullback g.i y) ↔ IsUnit (a (g.i y))
proof:
:=
  isUnit_map_iff (g.i.stalkMap y).hom _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.isProperForD_of_frames
statement:
theorem isProperForD_of_frames (g : DimRelationGenerator X n) (E : C1Cap.LocalEquationFrames L a)
    (hη : IsUnit (a (g.i (genericPoint g.Y))))
    (hf : ∀ w : g.Y, coheight w = 1 → ¬ IsUnitAt g.f w → IsUnit (a (g.i w))) :
    IsProperForD g a
proof:
:= by
  haveI : NoetherianSpace g.Y := g.i.isClosedEmbedding.isInducing.noetherianSpace
  have hassoc : ∀ ⦃x y : g.Y⦄ (h : x ⤳ y),
      Associated ((g.Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom (a.pullback g.i y)) (a.pullback g.i x) := by
    intro x y h
    have h1 := associated_of_specializes E (h.map g.i.continuous)
    have h2 := h1.map (g.i.stalkMap x).hom
    have h3 := g.i.stalkSpecializes_stalkMap_apply x y h (a (g.i y))
    change Associated ((g.Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom ((g.i.stalkMap y).hom (a (g.i y))))
      ((g.i.stalkMap x).hom (a (g.i x)))
    rw [← h3]
    exact h2
  have hηY : IsUnit (a.pullback g.i (genericPoint g.Y)) := (pullback_isUnit_iff g _).mpr hη
  have hopen : IsOpen {y : g.Y | IsUnit (a.pullback g.i y)} := by
    have : {y : g.Y | IsUnit (a.pullback g.i y)} = g.i ⁻¹' {w : X | IsUnit (a w)} := by
      ext y
      exact pullback_isUnit_iff g y
    rw [this]
    exact (isOpen_isUnit E).preimage g.i.continuous
  have hcl : IsClosed {y : g.Y | IsUnit (a.pullback g.i y)}ᶜ := hopen.isClosed_compl
  have hηF : genericPoint g.Y ∉ {y : g.Y | IsUnit (a.pullback g.i y)}ᶜ := fun h ↦ h hηY
  refine ⟨fun y ↦ ?_, hassoc, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h0
    have h1 := hassoc (genericPoint_specializes y)
    rw [h0, map_zero] at h1
    exact hηY.ne_zero ((associated_zero_iff_eq_zero _).mp h1.symm)
  · refine (finite_coheight_one_of_isClosed hcl hηF).subset ?_
    rintro w ⟨hw1, hw⟩
    exact ⟨fun hu ↦ ((IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).mp hw) hu, hw1⟩
  · intro w hw1 hw
    by_contra hnu
    have := hf w hw1 hnu
    exact ((IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).mp hw) ((pullback_isUnit_iff g w).mpr this)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.restrictedEq_eq_pointCoord
statement:
theorem restrictedEq_eq_pointCoord (E : C1Cap.LocalEquationFrames L a) (x : X)
    (z : pointClosureScheme x) : restrictedEq x a z = C1Cap.pointCoord E x z
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty (pointClosureι x ⁻¹ᵁ (E.frame (pointClosureι x z)).U) :=
    ⟨⟨z, (E.frame (pointClosureι x z)).mem⟩⟩
  unfold restrictedEq
  rw [← E.germ_coord (pointClosureι x z)]
  erw [Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply]
  rw [Scheme.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.restrictedEq_one
statement:
theorem restrictedEq_one (x : X) (z : pointClosureScheme x) :
    restrictedEq x (fun _ ↦ (1 : _)) z = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold restrictedEq
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.genericRank_eq_one_of_hasConstantRank
statement:
theorem genericRank_eq_one_of_hasConstantRank {L : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) :
    SingularCurve.genericRank X L = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin, hcard⟩ := hL
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := hqfin
  have hcover : TopologicalSpace.IsOpenCover q.X :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := X) q.X).mp q.coversTop
  have hη : genericPoint X ∈ ⋃ i, (q.X i : Set X) := by
    rw [hcover.iSup_set_eq_univ]
    exact Set.mem_univ _
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hη
  rw [SingularCurve.genericRank_eq_natCard_localGenerators _ _ q i hi, hcard i]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.movingFrames_of_avoiding
statement:
theorem movingFrames_of_avoiding (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (n : ℕ)
    (h : SectionsAvoidFinite L) : MovingFrames L n
proof:
:= fun g ↦ by
  haveI : NoetherianSpace g.Y := g.i.isClosedEmbedding.isInducing.noetherianSpace
  have hrk := genericRank_eq_one_of_hasConstantRank hL
  let frame : ∀ y : X, LineBundleLocalData X L y :=
    fun y ↦ Scheme.Modules.lineBundleLocalDataAt X L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree hrk y
  obtain ⟨F, hFc, hFη, hF⟩ := exists_closed_not_isUnitAt g.f g.hf
  have hfin : {w : g.Y | coheight w = 1 ∧ ¬ IsUnitAt g.f w}.Finite :=
    (finite_coheight_one_of_isClosed hFc hFη).subset fun w ⟨h1, h2⟩ ↦
      ⟨by_contra fun hw ↦ h2 (hF w hw), h1⟩
  have hP : ({g.i (genericPoint g.Y)} ∪
      g.i '' {w : g.Y | coheight w = 1 ∧ ¬ IsUnitAt g.f w} : Set X).Finite :=
    (Set.finite_singleton _).union (hfin.image _)
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := h _ hP
  let E := LocalEquationFrames.ofSection frame s
  have h₁ : IsProperForD g _ := isProperForD_of_frames g E
    (hs _ (Or.inl rfl) (frame _))
    (fun w hw1 hw ↦ hs _ (Or.inr ⟨w, ⟨hw1, hw⟩, rfl⟩) (frame _))
  refine ⟨_, fun _ ↦ 1, h₁, isProperForD_one g, fun x hx hne ↦ ?_⟩
  exact ⟨ClosureFrames.ofLocalEquationFrames E x fun z ↦
    notMem_stalkPrime_of_proper g _ h₁ hne z⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.capDescends_of_avoiding
statement:
theorem capDescends_of_avoiding (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (n : ℕ)
    (h : SectionsAvoidFinite L) : CapDescends (k := k) L hL n
proof:
:=
  capDescends_of_movingFrames (k := k) L hL n (movingFrames_of_avoiding (k := k) L hL n h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.frameSec_add
statement:
theorem frameSec_add (d : LineBundleLocalData S M x) (V : S.Opens) (hV : V ≤ d.U)
    (c c' : Γ(S, V)) : C1Cap.frameSec d V hV (c + c') =
      C1Cap.frameSec d V hV c + C1Cap.frameSec d V hV c'
proof:
:= by
  unfold C1Cap.frameSec
  have h1 := ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op V)).hom.map_add
    c c'
  have h2 := (d.globalFrame.hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV)))).hom.map_add
    ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op V) c)
    ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op V) c')
  exact (congrArg (d.globalFrame.hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV)))) h1).trans h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.sectionCoordSec_add

theorem sectionCoordSec_add (d : LineBundleLocalData S M x) (s t : Γ(M, ⊤)) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.sectionCoordSec_smul

theorem sectionCoordSec_smul (d : LineBundleLocalData S M x) (a : Γ(S, ⊤)) (s : Γ(M, ⊤)) :

      sectionCoordSec d s
proof:
:= by

  rw [sectionCoordSec_spec, C1Cap.frameSec_smul d d.U le_rfl, mul_smul,
    ← C1Cap.frameSec_smul d d.U le_rfl (sectionCoordSec d s), sectionCoordSec_spec]
  exact Scheme.Modules.map_smul M (homOfLE le_top) a s

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.germ_sectionCoordSec_eq_mul_unit
statement:
theorem germ_sectionCoordSec_eq_mul_unit {y : S} (d : LineBundleLocalData S M x)
    (e : LineBundleLocalData S M y) (s : Γ(M, ⊤)) (p : S) (hd : p ∈ d.U) (he : p ∈ e.U) :
    ∃ u : (S.presheaf.stalk p)ˣ,
      S.presheaf.germ e.U p he (sectionCoordSec e s) =
        S.presheaf.germ d.U p hd (sectionCoordSec d s) * (u : S.presheaf.stalk p)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : p ∈ d.U ⊓ e.U := ⟨hd, he⟩
  have h1 := S.presheaf.germ_res_apply
    (homOfLE (inf_le_right : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ e.U)) p hp (sectionCoordSec e s)
  have h2 := S.presheaf.germ_res_apply
    (homOfLE (inf_le_left : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ d.U)) p hp (sectionCoordSec d s)
  have hc := congrArg (S.presheaf.germ (d.U ⊓ e.U) p hp) (sectionCoordSec_compat d e s)
  have hu : IsUnit (S.presheaf.germ (d.U ⊓ e.U) p hp (d.transitionSection e)) :=
    (d.transitionSection_isUnit e).map _
  obtain ⟨u, hu'⟩ := hu
  refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
  rw [hu', ← h1, hc, map_mul, h2]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.isUnit_germ_sectionCoordSec_iff
statement:
theorem isUnit_germ_sectionCoordSec_iff {y : S} (d : LineBundleLocalData S M x)
    (e : LineBundleLocalData S M y) (s : Γ(M, ⊤)) (p : S) (hd : p ∈ d.U) (he : p ∈ e.U) :
    IsUnit (S.presheaf.germ e.U p he (sectionCoordSec e s)) ↔
      IsUnit (S.presheaf.germ d.U p hd (sectionCoordSec d s))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := germ_sectionCoordSec_eq_mul_unit d e s p hd he
  rw [hu]
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left h, fun h ↦ h.mul u.isUnit⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.sectionsAvoidFinite_of_generated
statement:
theorem sectionsAvoidFinite_of_generated [Infinite k]
    (h : ∀ p : X, ∃ s : Γ(L, ⊤), ∃ d : LineBundleLocalData X L p,
      IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ d.U p d.mem (sectionCoordSec d s))) :
    ∀ P : Set X, P.Finite → ∃ s : Γ(L, ⊤), ∀ p ∈ P, ∀ d : LineBundleLocalData X L p,
      IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ d.U p d.mem (sectionCoordSec d s))
proof:
:= by
  intro P hP
  choose s0 d0 hd0 using h
  haveI : Finite P := hP.to_subtype
  letI : Module k Γ(L, ⊤) := Module.compHom _ (scalarHom (k := k) (X := X))
  letI : ∀ p : P, Module k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk p)) :=
    fun p ↦ Module.compHom _ (residueScalarHom (k := k) (p : X))
  have hφ : ∀ p : P, coordResidueLinear (k := k) L (p : X) (d0 p) ≠ 0 := by
    intro p h0
    have := LinearMap.congr_fun h0 (s0 p)
    change IsLocalRing.residue _ _ = 0 at this
    rw [IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff] at this
    exact ((IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal).mpr (hd0 p)) this
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_forall_ne_zero_of_infinite (K := k)
    (fun p : P ↦ coordResidueLinear (k := k) L (p : X) (d0 p)) hφ
  refine ⟨s, fun p hp d ↦ ?_⟩
  have h1 := hs ⟨p, hp⟩
  change IsLocalRing.residue _ _ ≠ 0 at h1
  rw [Ne, IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff] at h1
  exact (isUnit_germ_sectionCoordSec_iff (d0 p) d s p (d0 p).mem d.mem).mpr
    (IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal.mp h1)

name: KSpecialization.ARRHBCP.hbcP_of_zeroSection
statement:
theorem hbcP_of_zeroSection (hZ : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme (Zs k n J))
    (CN : AffineFrameCover (Zs k n J) (Nsh k n J))
    (hzs : (Cov k n J CN).zeroSection ≫ EιOfIso k n J CN (isoE0 k n J hZ CN) =
      secInf k n J ≫ subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k n) J)
    (w : K0 (Ws k n J)) :
    pullbackK0 (EιOfIso k n J CN (isoE0 k n J hZ CN)) (FpK k n J hZ w) =
      spK k n J CN (resEOfIso k n J hZ CN (isoE0 k n J hZ CN)) (r₁K k n J w)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherian (space k n) := SchemeProjectiveSpace.isNoetherian k n
  haveI := (Cov k n J CN).isNoetherian_scheme
  haveI : IsNoetherian (Zs k n J) := inferInstance
  let G := KSpecialization.CIIL3C.oeGate k n (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.rhoP k n) J
  haveI := G.qc
  haveI := G.fp
  let F := subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k n) J
  let ε := EιOfIso k n J CN (isoE0 k n J hZ CN)
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion ε := by
    unfold ε EιOfIso
    infer_instance
  let I := sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf G.σ
  have hker1 : I.subschemeι.ker = (componentToTotal (space k n) J).ker := by
    rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_subschemeι]; exact G.hid
  have hkerE : ε.ker = I.subschemeι.ker := by
    rw [hker1]
    exact Scheme.Hom.ker_comp_of_isIso _ _
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian I.subscheme := CIIL3B.isLocallyNoetherian_subscheme I
  let κ : Es k n J CN ⟶ I.subscheme := IsClosedImmersion.lift I.subschemeι ε hkerE.symm.le
  have hκ : κ ≫ I.subschemeι = ε := IsClosedImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _
  haveI : IsIso κ := IsClosedImmersion.isIso_of_ker_eq ε I.subschemeι κ hκ hkerE
  haveI := CIIL3B.isIso_fst_comp_totalToClosedBase (space k n) J
  haveI hρ : IsIso (pullback.fst F I.subschemeι ≫ totalToClosedBase (space k n) J) :=
    CIIL3B.isIso_fst_comp_of_ker_eq F (totalToClosedBase (space k n) J) I.subschemeι
      (componentToTotal (space k n) J) hker1
  haveI : IsFinite F := inferInstance
  have hL := G.hL
  have hreg := G.hreg
  have hs : Mono (pullbackSection F (dualEval G.σ)) :=
    KSpecialization.ARRHS.mono_pullbackSection_exceptional (space k n) J G.σ k
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.rhoP k n) hL hreg G.hid
  have hres := CIIL3B.bijective_k0ToG0_of_resolution (ARRPE.resolutionM k n J hZ)
  have hy : k0ToG0 (Ms k n J) (FpK k n J hZ w) = finitePushforward F (k0ToG0 (Ws k n J) w) :=
    ARRL1C.k0ToG0_Fp (ARRPE.resolutionM k n J hZ) F w
  have hG := hbcE_general G.σ F hL hreg hs hres w _ hy
  have hψη := inv_comp_fst_eq_secInf (space k n) J I.subschemeι hker1
  let ρ : pullback F I.subschemeι ≅ Zs k n J :=
    asIso (pullback.fst F I.subschemeι ≫ totalToClosedBase (space k n) J)
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (pullback F I.subschemeι) :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (pullback.fst F I.subschemeι)
  have hsec : ρ.inv ≫ pullback.fst F I.subschemeι = secInf k n J := hψη
  have hzsκ : (Cov k n J CN).zeroSection ≫ κ = ρ.inv ≫ pullback.snd F I.subschemeι := by
    rw [← cancel_mono I.subschemeι, Category.assoc, hκ, hzs, Category.assoc, ← pullback.condition,
      ← Category.assoc, hsec]
  have hzs' : ρ.inv ≫ pullback.snd F I.subschemeι ≫ (asIso κ).inv = (Cov k n J CN).zeroSection := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← hzsκ]
    simp
  have hcomp : ∀ x : G0 (Zs k n J),
      finitePushforward (asIso κ).inv (finitePushforward (pullback.snd F I.subschemeι)
        (finitePushforward ρ.inv x)) =
      finitePushforward (Cov k n J CN).zeroSection x := by
    intro x
    have h1 := finitePushforward_congr hzs'
    rw [← h1, ARRG45C.finitePushforward_comp ρ.inv (pullback.snd F I.subschemeι ≫ (asIso κ).inv),
      ARRG45C.finitePushforward_comp (pullback.snd F I.subschemeι) (asIso κ).inv]
    rfl
  have e1 : pullbackK0 ε (FpK k n J hZ w) =
      pullbackK0 (asIso κ).hom (pullbackK0 I.subschemeι (FpK k n J hZ w)) := by
    rw [pullbackK0_comp_apply]
    simp [hκ]
  have step : k0ToG0 (Es k n J CN) (pullbackK0 ε (FpK k n J hZ w)) =
      finitePushforward (Cov k n J CN).zeroSection (k0ToG0 (Zs k n J) (r₁K k n J w)) := by
    have hr1 : r₁K k n J w = pullbackK0 (secInf k n J) w := pullbackK0RingHom_apply _ _
    rw [e1, k0ToG0_pullbackK0_iso, hG,
      k0ToG0_eq_pushforward_inv ρ (pullbackK0 (pullback.fst F I.subschemeι) w),
      pullbackK0_comp_apply, hsec, hcomp, hr1]
  calc pullbackK0 ε (FpK k n J hZ w)
      = (resEOfIso k n J hZ CN (isoE0 k n J hZ CN)).res
          (k0ToG0 (Es k n J CN) (pullbackK0 ε (FpK k n J hZ w))) :=
        (DFunLike.congr_fun (resEOfIso k n J hZ CN (isoE0 k n J hZ CN)).left _).symm
    _ = _ := by rw [step]; rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionAffineBasis_length_eq
statement:
theorem cosectionAffineBasis_length_eq {n r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r)
    (C : SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover X E) (i : C.I)
    (W : X.affineOpens) (hW : W.1 ≤ C.U i) (x : X) (hx : x ∈ W.1)
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin n) Γ(X,W) Γ(E,W.1)) : n = r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex : ∃ y : Spec Γ(X,W), W.2.fromSpec y = x := by
    have hr : x ∈ Set.range W.2.fromSpec := by
      rw [W.2.range_fromSpec]
      exact hx
    exact hr
  obtain ⟨y,_⟩ := hex
  letI : Nontrivial Γ(X,W) := PrimeSpectrum.nonempty_iff_nontrivial.mp ⟨y⟩
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  letI : Fintype (C.basisIndex i) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have hb := Module.finrank_eq_card_basis b
  let bc : Module.Basis (C.basisIndex i) Γ(X,W) Γ(E,W.1) :=
    C.restrictedSectionBasis i W.1 hW
  have hc := Module.finrank_eq_card_basis bc
  have hcard := SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleQuillen.card_eq C hE i x (hW hx)
  calc
    n = Module.finrank Γ(X,W) Γ(E,W.1) := by simpa using hb.symm
    _ = Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) := by simpa [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hc
    _ = r := hcard

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.cocycle_first_second_toAmbient
statement:
theorem cocycle_first_second_toAmbient (i j k : C.I)
    (q : (C.cocycleRefinementCover i j k).I₀) :
    C.cocycleToFirstLocal i j k q ≫
        (C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f q.1.1 ≫
        C.overlapToChart i j ≫ C.chartToAmbient i =
      C.cocycleToSecondLocal i j k q ≫
        (C.basicOpenOverlapCover j k).f q.1.2 ≫
        C.overlapToChart j k ≫ C.chartToAmbient j
proof:
:= by
  rw [C.cocycleToFirstLocal_fac_assoc,
    C.cocycleToSecondLocal_fac_assoc]
  simp only [Category.assoc, transitionTriple_fst_assoc,
    tripleFirstLeg_toChart_assoc, tripleToChart]
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc,
    ← C.transition_toAmbient i j]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.cocycle_second_third_toAmbient

        (C.basicOpenOverlapCover k i).f q.2 ≫
        C.overlapToChart k i ≫ C.chartToAmbient k
proof:
:= by
  rw [C.cocycleToSecondLocal_fac_assoc,
    C.cocycleToThirdLocal_fac_assoc]
  simp only [Category.assoc, transitionTriple_fst_assoc,
    tripleFirstLeg_toChart_assoc, tripleToChart]
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc,
    ← C.transition_toAmbient j k]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [C.tripleFirstLeg_toChart_assoc]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.cocycleFirstBase_ι
statement:
theorem cocycleFirstBase_ι (i j k : C.I)
    (q : (C.cocycleRefinementCover i j k).I₀) :
    C.cocycleFirstBase i j k q ≫ q.1.1.affineOpen.1.ι =
      C.cocycleToFirstLocal i j k q ≫
        (C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f q.1.1 ≫
        C.overlapToChart i j ≫ C.chartToAmbient i
proof:
:= by
  unfold cocycleFirstBase
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [CommonBasicOpen.chartToBase_comp_openImmersion]
  rw [← q.1.1.chartToLeft_comp_chartToAmbient]
  simp only [Category.assoc,
    commonBasicOpenChartIso_hom_chartToLeft_assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.cocycleSecondBase_ι
statement:
theorem cocycleSecondBase_ι (i j k : C.I)
    (q : (C.cocycleRefinementCover i j k).I₀) :
    C.cocycleSecondBase i j k q ≫ q.1.2.affineOpen.1.ι =
      C.cocycleToSecondLocal i j k q ≫
        (C.basicOpenOverlapCover j k).f q.1.2 ≫
        C.overlapToChart j k ≫ C.chartToAmbient j
proof:
:= by
  unfold cocycleSecondBase
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [CommonBasicOpen.chartToBase_comp_openImmersion]
  rw [← q.1.2.chartToLeft_comp_chartToAmbient]
  simp only [Category.assoc,
    commonBasicOpenChartIso_hom_chartToLeft_assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.cocycleThirdBase_ι
statement:
theorem cocycleThirdBase_ι (i j k : C.I)
    (q : (C.cocycleRefinementCover i j k).I₀) :
    C.cocycleThirdBase i j k q ≫ q.2.affineOpen.1.ι =
      C.cocycleToThirdLocal i j k q ≫
        (C.basicOpenOverlapCover k i).f q.2 ≫
        C.overlapToChart k i ≫ C.chartToAmbient k
proof:
:= by
  unfold cocycleThirdBase
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [CommonBasicOpen.chartToBase_comp_openImmersion]
  rw [← q.2.chartToLeft_comp_chartToAmbient]
  simp only [Category.assoc,
    commonBasicOpenChartIso_hom_chartToLeft_assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.cocycleFirstSecondBase
statement:
theorem cocycleFirstSecondBase (i j k : C.I)
    (q : (C.cocycleRefinementCover i j k).I₀) :
    C.cocycleFirstBase i j k q ≫ q.1.1.affineOpen.1.ι =
      C.cocycleSecondBase i j k q ≫ q.1.2.affineOpen.1.ι
proof:
:= by
  rw [C.cocycleFirstBase_ι, C.cocycleSecondBase_ι]
  exact C.cocycle_first_second_toAmbient i j k q

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.cocycleFirstThirdBase
statement:
theorem cocycleFirstThirdBase (i j k : C.I)
    (q : (C.cocycleRefinementCover i j k).I₀) :
    C.cocycleFirstBase i j k q ≫ q.1.1.affineOpen.1.ι =
      C.cocycleThirdBase i j k q ≫ q.2.affineOpen.1.ι
proof:
:= by
  rw [C.cocycleFirstBase_ι, C.cocycleThirdBase_ι]
  exact (C.cocycle_first_second_toAmbient i j k q).trans
    (C.cocycle_second_third_toAmbient i j k q)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tripleBaseLift_toA
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem tripleBaseLift_toA {Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (A B D : X.Opens)
    (fA : Z ⟶ A.toScheme) (fB : Z ⟶ B.toScheme)
    (fD : Z ⟶ D.toScheme)
    (hAB : fA ≫ A.ι = fB ≫ B.ι)
    (hAD : fA ≫ A.ι = fD ≫ D.ι) :
    tripleBaseLift A B D fA fB fD hAB hAD ≫
        X.homOfLE (inf_le_left : (A ⊓ B) ⊓ D ≤ A ⊓ B) ≫
        X.homOfLE (inf_le_left : A ⊓ B ≤ A) =
      fA
proof:
:= by
  unfold tripleBaseLift
  rw [IsPullback.lift_fst_assoc, IsPullback.lift_fst]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tripleBaseLift_toB
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem tripleBaseLift_toB {Z : Scheme.{u}}

    (fA : Z ⟶ A.toScheme) (fB : Z ⟶ B.toScheme)
    (fD : Z ⟶ D.toScheme)
    (hAB : fA ≫ A.ι = fB ≫ B.ι)
    (hAD : fA ≫ A.ι = fD ≫ D.ι) :
    tripleBaseLift A B D fA fB fD hAB hAD ≫
        X.homOfLE (inf_le_left : (A ⊓ B) ⊓ D ≤ A ⊓ B) ≫
        X.homOfLE (inf_le_right : A ⊓ B ≤ B) =

proof:
:= by

  rw [IsPullback.lift_fst_assoc, IsPullback.lift_snd]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tripleBaseLift_toD
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem tripleBaseLift_toD {Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (A B D : X.Opens)
    (fA : Z ⟶ A.toScheme) (fB : Z ⟶ B.toScheme)
    (fD : Z ⟶ D.toScheme)
    (hAB : fA ≫ A.ι = fB ≫ B.ι)
    (hAD : fA ≫ A.ι = fD ≫ D.ι) :
    tripleBaseLift A B D fA fB fD hAB hAD ≫
        X.homOfLE (inf_le_right : (A ⊓ B) ⊓ D ≤ D) =

proof:
