name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.TripleBaseCommonBasicOpen.isOpenCover
statement:
theorem isOpenCover (A B D : X.affineOpens) :
    IsOpenCover
      (fun e : TripleBaseCommonBasicOpen A B D ↦ e.inIntersection)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsOpenCover.mk
  refine top_le_iff.mp fun x _ ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨f, g, hfg, hxf⟩ :=
    exists_basicOpen_le_affine_inter A.2 B.2
      x.1 ⟨x.2.1.1, x.2.1.2⟩
  let F : X.affineOpens := X.affineBasicOpen (U := A) f
  obtain ⟨p, r, hpr, hxp⟩ :=
    exists_basicOpen_le_affine_inter F.2 D.2
      x.1 ⟨hxf, x.2.2⟩
  apply Opens.mem_iSup.mpr
  refine ⟨⟨f, g, hfg, p, r, hpr⟩, ?_⟩
  change (x.1 : X) ∈ X.basicOpen p
  exact hxp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.pullbackFrameOfOverIso_U
statement:
@[simp] theorem pullbackFrameOfOverIso_U [IsIntegral Y] (e : (tensorUnitSheaf X).over U ≅ L.over U)
    (y : Y) (hy : f y ∈ U) : (pullbackFrameOfOverIso f U e y hy).U = f ⁻¹ᵁ U
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.coeff_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
theorem coeff_eq_zero_of_mem (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree W M)
    (hr : SingularCurve.genericRank W M = 1) (b : LineBundleLocalData W M b₀) (p : W)
    (hp : p ∈ b.U) : lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame hM hr b p = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame_eq_on_localData hM hr b b p hp]
  by_cases hpc : coheight p = 1
  · exact W.ord_of_isUnit (b.transitionSection_isUnit b) hpc ⟨hp, hp⟩
  · exact Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hpc _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.cap_prime_support
statement:
theorem cap_prime_support (N : P.Modules) (hN : HasConstantRank P N 1) (U : P.Opens)
    (e : (tensorUnitSheaf P).over U ≅ N.over U) (m : ℕ) (v : P) (hv : height v = m + 1) :
    ∃ D : dimensionCycles P m,
      D.1.support ⊆ (U : Set P)ᶜ ∩ Set.range (pointClosureι v) ∧
      ops.cap N hN m ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v (m + 1) hv) : DimChow P (m + 1))) =
        (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow P m)
proof:
:= by
  have hfl := isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure N hN v
  have hrV := genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one N hN v
  have hgen : genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v) = pointClosureGenericPoint v :=
    ((pointClosureGenericPoint_isGeneric v).eq (genericPoint_spec _)).symm
  
  have key : ∀ {b₀ : pointClosureScheme v}
      (b : LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme v)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj N) b₀),
      ∃ D : dimensionCycles P m,
        D.1 = properPushforward (pointClosureι v) (lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hfl hrV b).1 ∧
        D.1.support ⊆ pointClosureι v '' {z | lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame hfl hrV b z ≠ 0} ∧
        ops.cap N hN m ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
          (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v (m + 1) hv) : DimChow P (m + 1))) =
          (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow P m) := by
    intro b₀ b
    have hmem := m7s_pushWeil_mem (k := k) N hN m v hv b
    refine ⟨⟨_, hmem⟩, rfl, ?_, ops.cap_mk N hN m v hv hrV b ⟨_, hmem⟩ rfl⟩
    change (properPushforward (pointClosureι v)
      (lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hfl hrV b).1).support ⊆ _
    rw [properPushforward, AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_support_closedImmersion (pointClosureι v) _
      (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl)]
    exact Set.image_mono (fun z hz ↦ hz)
  by_cases hvU : v ∈ U
  · have hy : pointClosureι v (pointClosureGenericPoint v) ∈ U := by
      rw [pointClosureι_genericPoint]; exact hvU
    let b := pullbackFrameOfOverIso (pointClosureι v) U e (pointClosureGenericPoint v) hy
    obtain ⟨D, -, hsupp, hcap⟩ := key b
    refine ⟨D, ?_, hcap⟩
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := hsupp hx
    refine ⟨?_, z, rfl⟩
    intro hzU
    apply hz
    exact coeff_eq_zero_of_mem hfl hrV b z hzU
  · obtain ⟨b⟩ := Scheme.Modules.exists_lineBundleLocalDataAt (pointClosureScheme v)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj N) hfl hrV (pointClosureGenericPoint v)
    obtain ⟨D, -, hsupp, hcap⟩ := key b
    refine ⟨D, ?_, hcap⟩
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨z, -, rfl⟩ := hsupp hx
    refine ⟨?_, z, rfl⟩
    intro hzU
    have hsp : v ⤳ pointClosureι v z := C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι v z
    exact hvU (((hsp.mem_open U.isOpen hzU)) |> fun h ↦ h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.cap_prime_eq_zero_of_range_subset
statement:
theorem cap_prime_eq_zero_of_range_subset (N : P.Modules) (hN : HasConstantRank P N 1)
    (U : P.Opens) (e : (tensorUnitSheaf P).over U ≅ N.over U) (m : ℕ) (w : P)
    (hw : height w = m + 1) (hr : Set.range (pointClosureι w) ⊆ U) :
    ops.cap N hN m ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
      (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle w (m + 1) hw) : DimChow P (m + 1))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hcap⟩ := cap_prime_support ops N hN U e m w hw
  have h0 : D = 0 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    ext x
    by_contra hx
    obtain ⟨hxU, y, rfl⟩ := hD (show x ∈ D.1.support from hx)
    exact hxU (hr ⟨y, rfl⟩)
  rw [hcap, h0, QuotientAddGroup.mk_zero, TensorProduct.tmul_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.range_pointClosureι_subset_of_isClosed
statement:
theorem range_pointClosureι_subset_of_isClosed {S : Set P} (hS : IsClosed S) (w : P)
    (hw : w ∈ S) : Set.range (pointClosureι w) ⊆ S
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
  exact (C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι w z).mem_closed hS hw

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.cap_cap_eq_zero_component
statement:
theorem cap_cap_eq_zero_component (N₁ N₂ : P.Modules) (hN₁ : HasConstantRank P N₁ 1)
    (hN₂ : HasConstantRank P N₂ 1) (U₁ U₂ : P.Opens) (hcov : ∀ x : P, x ∈ U₁ ∨ x ∈ U₂)
    (e₁ : (tensorUnitSheaf P).over U₁ ≅ N₁.over U₁)
    (e₂ : (tensorUnitSheaf P).over U₂ ≅ N₂.over U₂) (m : ℕ) :
    ops.cap N₁ hN₁ m ∘ₗ ops.cap N₂ hN₂ (m + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply e4_linearMap_ext_of_prime
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hcap⟩ := cap_prime_support ops N₂ hN₂ U₂ e₂ (m + 1) v hv
  change ops.cap N₁ hN₁ m (ops.cap N₂ hN₂ (m + 1) _) = 0
  rw [hcap]
  have hmem := m7s_mem_of_prime (LinearMap.ker (ops.cap N₁ hN₁ m)) ((U₂ : Set P)ᶜ)
    (fun w hw hwS ↦ by
      change ops.cap N₁ hN₁ m _ = 0
      refine cap_prime_eq_zero_of_range_subset ops N₁ hN₁ U₁ e₁ m w hw ?_
      intro y hy
      have hy' := range_pointClosureι_subset_of_isClosed
        (S := (U₂ : Set P)ᶜ) U₂.isOpen.isClosed_compl w hwS hy
      exact (hcov y).resolve_right hy')
    D (fun x hx ↦ (hD hx).1)
  exact hmem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.totalCap_mul_eq_zero_of_cover
statement:
theorem totalCap_mul_eq_zero_of_cover (N₁ N₂ : P.Modules) (hN₁ : HasConstantRank P N₁ 1)
    (hN₂ : HasConstantRank P N₂ 1) (U₁ U₂ : P.Opens) (hcov : ∀ x : P, x ∈ U₁ ∨ x ∈ U₂)
    (e₁ : (tensorUnitSheaf P).over U₁ ≅ N₁.over U₁)
    (e₂ : (tensorUnitSheaf P).over U₂ ≅ N₂.over U₂) :
    totalCap ops N₁ hN₁ ∘ₗ totalCap ops N₂ hN₂ = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro c
  cases n with
  | zero => simp [totalCap, capComponent]
  | succ m =>
    cases m with
    | zero => simp [totalCap, capComponent]
    | succ m =>
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, totalCap, DirectSum.toModule_lof, capComponent,
        LinearMap.zero_apply]
      have := LinearMap.congr_fun (cap_cap_eq_zero_component ops N₁ N₂ hN₁ hN₂ U₁ U₂ hcov e₁ e₂ m) c
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply] at this
      rw [this, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.cap_tensorUnit_eq_zero
statement:
theorem cap_tensorUnit_eq_zero (m : ℕ) :
    ops.cap (tensorUnitSheaf P) (hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf (Y := P)) m = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply e4_linearMap_ext_of_prime
  intro v hv
  rw [LinearMap.zero_apply]
  exact cap_prime_eq_zero_of_range_subset ops _ _ ⊤ (Iso.refl _) m v hv (fun _ _ ↦ trivial)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.totalCap_tensorUnit
statement:
theorem totalCap_tensorUnit : totalCap ops (tensorUnitSheaf P)
    (hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf (Y := P)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro c
  cases n with
  | zero => simp [totalCap, capComponent]
  | succ m => simp [totalCap, capComponent, cap_tensorUnit_eq_zero ops m]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.cap_iso_component
statement:
theorem cap_iso_component {L M : P.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank P L 1)
    (hM : HasConstantRank P M 1) (e : L ≅ M) (m : ℕ) :
    ops.cap L hL m = ops.cap M hM m
proof:
:= by
  apply e4_linearMap_ext_of_prime
  intro v hv
  let Q := pointClosureι v
  have hfL := isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL v
  have hfM := isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure M hM v
  have hrL := genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one L hL v
  have hrM := genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one M hM v
  obtain ⟨b⟩ := Scheme.Modules.exists_lineBundleLocalDataAt (pointClosureScheme v)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback Q).obj L) hfL hrL (pointClosureGenericPoint v)
  let e' : (Scheme.Modules.pullback Q).obj L ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback Q).obj M :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback Q).mapIso e
  have hdiv := e4_weilDivisor_mapIso hfL hfM hrL hrM b e'
  have hmL := m7s_pushWeil_mem (k := k) L hL m v hv b
  rw [ops.cap_mk L hL m v hv hrL b ⟨_, hmL⟩ rfl,
    ops.cap_mk M hM m v hv hrM (b.mapIso e') ⟨_, hmL⟩ (by rw [hdiv])]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.totalCap_iso
statement:
theorem totalCap_iso {L M : P.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank P L 1)
    (hM : HasConstantRank P M 1) (e : L ≅ M) :
    totalCap ops L hL = totalCap ops M hM
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  cases n with
  | zero => apply LinearMap.ext; intro c; simp [totalCap, capComponent]
  | succ m =>
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro c
    simp only [totalCap, LinearMap.comp_apply, DirectSum.toModule_lof, capComponent,
      cap_iso_component ops hL hM e m]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.exists_tensorDual_iso
statement:
theorem exists_tensorDual_iso {B : P.Modules} (hB : HasConstantRank P B 1) :
    Nonempty (tensorSheaf P B (lineBundleDual P B) ≅ tensorUnitSheaf P)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, -, hcard⟩ := id hB
  letI := hq
  exact ⟨tensorLineBundleDualIso B q.X q.coversTop
    (fun i ↦ (LineBundleDual.exists_triv B q hcard i).some)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.totalCap_add_dual
statement:
theorem totalCap_add_dual {B : P.Modules} (hB : HasConstantRank P B 1) :
    totalCap ops B hB + totalCap ops (lineBundleDual P B) (lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank B hB)
      = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hD := lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank B hB
  have hT : HasConstantRank P (tensorSheaf P B (lineBundleDual P B)) 1 := by
    have h := hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hB hD
    rwa [Nat.one_mul] at h
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := exists_tensorDual_iso hB
  have h := totalCap_tensor ops B (lineBundleDual P B) hB hD hT
  rw [totalCap_iso ops hT hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf e, totalCap_tensorUnit] at h
  exact h.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.totalCap_tensor_dual
statement:
theorem totalCap_tensor_dual {A B : P.Modules} (hA : HasConstantRank P A 1)
    (hB : HasConstantRank P B 1)
    (hN : HasConstantRank P (tensorSheaf P A (lineBundleDual P B)) 1) :
    totalCap ops (tensorSheaf P A (lineBundleDual P B)) hN =
      totalCap ops A hA - totalCap ops B hB
proof:
:= by
  have hD := lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank B hB
  rw [totalCap_tensor ops A (lineBundleDual P B) hA hD hN]
  have h := totalCap_add_dual ops hB
  have hd : totalCap ops (lineBundleDual P B) hD = -totalCap ops B hB := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro c
    have h1 := LinearMap.congr_fun h c
    rw [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply] at h1
    rw [LinearMap.neg_apply]
    exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right h1
  rw [hd]
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro c
  simp [sub_eq_add_neg]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.totalCap_sub_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem totalCap_sub_mul_eq_zero {A B₁ B₂ : P.Modules} (hA : HasConstantRank P A 1)
    (hB₁ : HasConstantRank P B₁ 1) (hB₂ : HasConstantRank P B₂ 1)
    (φ₁ : B₁ ⟶ A) (φ₂ : B₂ ⟶ A) (U₁ U₂ : P.Opens) [IsIso (φ₁.over U₁)] [IsIso (φ₂.over U₂)]
    (hcov : ∀ x : P, x ∈ U₁ ∨ x ∈ U₂) :
    (totalCap ops A hA - totalCap ops B₁ hB₁) ∘ₗ (totalCap ops A hA - totalCap ops B₂ hB₂) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hN : ∀ B : P.Modules, HasConstantRank P B 1 →
      HasConstantRank P (tensorSheaf P A (lineBundleDual P B)) 1 := fun B hB ↦ by
    have h := hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hA (lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank B hB)
    rwa [Nat.one_mul] at h
  have h := totalCap_mul_eq_zero_of_cover ops (tensorSheaf P A (lineBundleDual P B₁))
    (tensorSheaf P A (lineBundleDual P B₂)) (hN B₁ hB₁) (hN B₂ hB₂) U₁ U₂ hcov
    (trivOfIso hB₁ φ₁ U₁) (trivOfIso hB₂ φ₂ U₂)
  rwa [totalCap_tensor_dual ops hA hB₁ (hN B₁ hB₁), totalCap_tensor_dual ops hA hB₂ (hN B₂ hB₂)]
    at h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.xi_relation_of_cover
statement:
theorem xi_relation_of_cover (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1)
    (U₁ U₂ : C.scheme.Opens) [IsIso ((tautFst C).over U₁)] [IsIso ((tautSnd C).over U₂)]
    (hcov : ∀ x : C.scheme, x ∈ U₁ ∨ x ∈ U₂) :
    (xiCap ops C - totalCap ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase L 1 hL)) ∘ₗ
      (xiCap ops C - totalCap ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj M)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase M 1 hM)) = 0
proof:
:=
  totalCap_sub_mul_eq_zero ops (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase L 1 hL)
    (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase M 1 hM) (tautFst C) (tautSnd C) U₁ U₂ hcov

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.section_biprod_decomp
statement:
theorem section_biprod_decomp (U : Z.Opens) (b : Γ(L ⊞ M, U)) :
    b = (biprod.inl : L ⟶ L ⊞ M).app U ((biprod.fst : L ⊞ M ⟶ L).app U b) +
      (biprod.inr : M ⟶ L ⊞ M).app U ((biprod.snd : L ⊞ M ⟶ M).app U b)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun f : L ⊞ M ⟶ L ⊞ M ↦ f.app U b) (biprod.total (X := L) (Y := M))
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.add_app, Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, Scheme.Modules.Hom.id_app] at h
  exact h.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.tautologicalPushforwardHom_app_eq
statement:
theorem tautologicalPushforwardHom_app_eq (e : Γ(L ⊞ M, U)) :
    C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.app U e =
      C.tautologicalQuotient.app (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ U)
        (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction C.toBase).unit.app (L ⊞ M)).app U e)
proof:
:= by
  let adj := pullbackPushforwardAdjunction C.toBase
  have hα : C.tautologicalPushforwardHom =
      adj.unit.app (L ⊞ M) ≫ (pushforward C.toBase).map C.tautologicalQuotient :=
    ((adj.homEquiv _ _).apply_symm_apply C.tautologicalPushforwardHom).symm.trans
      (Adjunction.homEquiv_unit _ _ _ _)
  rw [hα]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.pullback_comp_app_unit
statement:
theorem pullback_comp_app_unit {Z : Scheme.{u}} (p : Z ⟶ X) {E E' : X.Modules}
    {G : Z.Modules} (σ : (Scheme.Modules.pullback p).obj E ⟶ G) (f : E' ⟶ E) (e : Γ(E', U)) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p).map f ≫ σ).app (p ⁻¹ᵁ U) (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p).unit.app E').app U e) =
      σ.app (p ⁻¹ᵁ U) (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p).unit.app E).app U (f.app U e))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, C1Cap.pullback_map_unit]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.tautFst_app_unit
statement:
theorem tautFst_app_unit (l : Γ(L, U)) :
    (tautFst C).app (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ U) (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction C.toBase).unit.app L).app U l) =
      C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.app U ((biprod.inl : L ⟶ L ⊞ M).app U l)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tautologicalPushforwardHom_app_eq]
  exact pullback_comp_app_unit U C.toBase C.tautologicalQuotient (biprod.inl : L ⟶ L ⊞ M) l

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.tautSnd_app_unit
statement:
theorem tautSnd_app_unit (m : Γ(M, U)) :
    (tautSnd C).app (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ U) (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction C.toBase).unit.app M).app U m) =
      C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.app U ((biprod.inr : M ⟶ L ⊞ M).app U m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tautologicalPushforwardHom_app_eq]
  exact pullback_comp_app_unit U C.toBase C.tautologicalQuotient (biprod.inr : M ⟶ L ⊞ M) m

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.tautologicalPushforwardHom_app_decomp
statement:
theorem tautologicalPushforwardHom_app_decomp (b : Γ(L ⊞ M, U)) :
    C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.app U b =
      (tautFst C).app (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ U) (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction C.toBase).unit.app L).app U
          ((biprod.fst : L ⊞ M ⟶ L).app U b)) +
        (tautSnd C).app (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ U) (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction C.toBase).unit.app M).app U
          ((biprod.snd : L ⊞ M ⟶ M).app U b))
proof:
:= by
  rw [tautFst_app_unit, tautSnd_app_unit]
  have h := map_add (C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.app U).hom
    ((biprod.inl : L ⟶ L ⊞ M).app U ((biprod.fst : L ⊞ M ⟶ L).app U b))
    ((biprod.inr : M ⟶ L ⊞ M).app U ((biprod.snd : L ⊞ M ⟶ M).app U b))
  rw [← section_biprod_decomp U b] at h
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.local_cover_at
statement:
theorem local_cover_at (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1) (x : C.scheme) :
    ∃ W : C.scheme.Opens, x ∈ W ∧ (IsIso ((tautFst C).over W) ∨ IsIso ((tautSnd C).over W))
proof:
:= by
  have hA := C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1
  have h1 := hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase L 1 hL
  have h2 := hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase M 1 hM
  obtain ⟨VA, hxA, ⟨tA⟩⟩ := exists_overTriv hA x
  obtain ⟨V1, hx1, ⟨t1⟩⟩ := exists_overTriv h1 x
  obtain ⟨V2, hx2, ⟨t2⟩⟩ := exists_overTriv h2 x
  obtain ⟨⟨i, k⟩, y, hy⟩ := C.literalLinearOpenCover.exists_eq x
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  let j : (C.literalLinearOpen ⟨i, k⟩).toScheme ⟶ C.scheme :=
    (C.literalLinearOpen ⟨i, k⟩).ι ≫ C.chartι i
  change j y = x at hy
  let V₀ : C.scheme.Opens := VA ⊓ V1 ⊓ V2
  have hxV₀ : x ∈ V₀ := ⟨⟨hxA, hx1⟩, hx2⟩
  let V' : (C.literalLinearOpen ⟨i, k⟩).toScheme.Opens := j ⁻¹ᵁ V₀
  let V : C.scheme.Opens := j ''ᵁ V'
  have hxV : x ∈ V := ⟨y, by simpa [V', V₀] using hy ▸ hxV₀, hy⟩
  have hVle : V ≤ V₀ := by
    change j ''ᵁ (j ⁻¹ᵁ V₀) ≤ V₀
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf]
    exact inf_le_right
  have hVU : V ≤ C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i :=
    (j.image_le_opensRange V').trans (tautQuotient_toBase_range_le C i k)
  have hVA : V ≤ VA := hVle.trans (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left)
  have hV1 : V ≤ V1 := hVle.trans (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right)
  have hV2 : V ≤ V2 := hVle.trans inf_le_right
  let eA := LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE hVA tA
  let e₁ := LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE hV1 t1
  let e₂ := LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE hV2 t2
  let adj := pullbackPushforwardAdjunction C.toBase
  let Ui : C.scheme.Opens := C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i
  let tt : Γ(C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1, Ui) := tautQuotient_t C i k
  let b : Γ(L ⊞ M, C.U i) := C.sectionBasis i k
  let u₁' : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj L, Ui) :=
    (adj.unit.app L).app (C.U i) ((biprod.fst : L ⊞ M ⟶ L).app (C.U i) b)
  let u₂' : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj M, Ui) :=
    (adj.unit.app M).app (C.U i) ((biprod.snd : L ⊞ M ⟶ M).app (C.U i) b)
  let t : Γ(C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1, V) :=
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op tt
  let u₁ : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj L, V) :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj L).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op u₁'
  let u₂ : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj M, V) :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op u₂'
  have htt : tt = (tautFst C).app Ui u₁' + (tautSnd C).app Ui u₂' := by
    have h0 := C.tautologicalPushforwardHom_app i k
    have h1' := tautologicalPushforwardHom_app_decomp C (C.U i) b
    exact h0.symm.trans h1'
  have ht : t = (tautFst C).app V u₁ + (tautSnd C).app V u₂ := by
    change (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op tt = _
    rw [htt, map_add]
    erw [C1Cap.app_presheaf_map (tautFst C) (homOfLE hVU) u₁',
      C1Cap.app_presheaf_map (tautSnd C) (homOfLE hVU) u₂']
  have hgen : ∃ a : Γ(C.scheme, V), (coefLE eA).symm (1 : Γ(C.scheme, V)) = a • t := by
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := tautQuotient_generating_of_unitIso j (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheafLiteralLinearOpenIso 1 ⟨i, k⟩)
      (tautQuotient_toBase_range_le C i k) tt (tautQuotient_literal_t C i k) V'
      ((coefLE eA).symm (1 : Γ(C.scheme, V)))
    exact ⟨a, ha⟩
  obtain ⟨W, hxW, hWV, hW⟩ := exists_isIso_nbhd (tautFst C) (tautSnd C) V x hxV e₁ e₂ eA t u₁ u₂
    ht hgen
  exact ⟨W, hxW, hW⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.exists_coordinate_cover
statement:
theorem exists_coordinate_cover (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1) :
    ∃ U₁ U₂ : C.scheme.Opens, IsIso ((tautFst C).over U₁) ∧ IsIso ((tautSnd C).over U₂) ∧
      ∀ x : C.scheme, x ∈ U₁ ∨ x ∈ U₂
proof:
:= by
  let J₁ : Type u := {V : C.scheme.Opens // IsIso ((tautFst C).over V)}
  let J₂ : Type u := {V : C.scheme.Opens // IsIso ((tautSnd C).over V)}
  refine ⟨⨆ V : J₁, V.1, ⨆ V : J₂, V.1, isIso_over_iSup (tautFst C) (fun V : J₁ ↦ V.1)
    (fun V ↦ V.2), isIso_over_iSup (tautSnd C) (fun V : J₂ ↦ V.1) (fun V ↦ V.2), ?_⟩
  intro x
  obtain ⟨W, hxW, h | h⟩ := local_cover_at C hL hM x
  · left
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨W, h⟩, hxW⟩
  · right
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨W, h⟩, hxW⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E7.xi_relation
statement:
theorem xi_relation (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1) :
    (xiCap ops C - totalCap ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase L 1 hL)) ∘ₗ
      (xiCap ops C - totalCap ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj M)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase M 1 hM)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U₁, U₂, h₁, h₂, hcov⟩ := exists_coordinate_cover C hL hM
  exact xi_relation_of_cover ops C hL hM U₁ U₂ hcov

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D37.padInc_padCollapse
statement: theorem padInc_padCollapse : padInc X I ≫ padCollapse X I = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  refine Sigma.hom_ext _ _ (fun i => ?_)
  rw [Category.comp_id]
  unfold padInc padCollapse
  rw [← Category.assoc, Sigma.ι_desc, Sigma.ι_desc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D37.exists_closedImmersion_twist_into_free_pad
statement:
theorem exists_closedImmersion_twist_into_free_pad {k : Type u} [CommRing k] [IsNoetherianRing k]
    (N : ℕ) {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (j : X ⟶ space k N) [IsClosedImmersion j] (E : X.Modules) (r : ℕ)
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    ∃ (D : ℕ) (I : Type u) (_ : Fintype I)
      (C : AffineFrameCover X
        (tensorSheaf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (D : ℤ))) E))
      (C' : AffineFrameCover X (FreeM X (Option I)))
      (f : C.scheme ⟶ C'.scheme),
      IsClosedImmersion f ∧ f ≫ C'.toBase = C.toBase
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : E.IsFinitePresentation :=
    IsFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation X hE.isFiniteLocallyFree
  obtain ⟨D, I, hI, φ, hφ⟩ := D31.exists_epi_free_twist_of_finitePresentation N j E
  haveI : Epi (padCollapse X I ≫ φ) := epi_comp _ _
  have hV : HasConstantRank X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (D : ℤ))) 1 :=
    hasConstantRank_pullback X j _ 1
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.hasConstantRank_twist (k := k) N (D : ℤ))
  have hD := (hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hV hE).isFiniteLocallyFree
  have hB : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (FreeM X (Option I)) := by
    have h : HasConstantRank X (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (Option I))
        (Nat.card (Option I)) :=
      ⟨(SheafOfModules.free.generatingSections (R := X.ringCatSheaf)
        (Option I)).localGeneratorsData, inferInstance, inferInstance, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩
    exact h.isFiniteLocallyFree
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := E14.exists_pairCover (padCollapse X I ≫ φ) hB hD
  exact ⟨D, I, hI, P.toD, P.toB, P.jHom, inferInstance, P.jHom_toBase⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D37.exists_closedImmersion_twist_into_product_pos
statement:
theorem exists_closedImmersion_twist_into_product_pos {k : Type u} [CommRing k] [IsNoetherianRing
    k] (N : ℕ)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ space k N) [IsClosedImmersion j] (E : X.Modules) (r : ℕ)
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    ∃ (D : ℕ) (C : AffineFrameCover X
        (tensorSheaf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (D : ℤ))) E))
      (n : ℕ) (ι : C.scheme ⟶ pullback (toSpec k N) (toSpec k n)),
        IsClosedImmersion ι ∧ ι ≫ pullback.fst _ _ = C.toBase ≫ j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, I, hI, C, C', f, hf1, hf2⟩ := exists_closedImmersion_twist_into_free_pad N j E r hE
  refine ⟨D, C, Fintype.card I, ?_⟩
  exact D35.exists_closedImmersion_proj_prod
    (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq (Fintype.card_option (α := I))) j C C' f hf2

name: SchemeCurveCharacteristicClasses.curve_hirzebruchRiemannRoch_characteristicNumber
statement:
theorem curve_hirzebruchRiemannRoch_characteristicNumber
    (z : SchemeKTheory.K0 X) :
    (SchemeKTheory.k0Euler k
        (fun E hE ↦
          (geometricFreeCartierPresentationOfFiniteLocallyFree
            (X := X) k ⟨E, hE⟩).targetFinite) z : ℚ) =
      integral
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.rationalGradedDegreeOfStructureSheafFinite k
          (SchemeBridge.structureSheaf_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k))
        (geometricAdditiveChernCharacter X z *
          toddClass (canonicalTangentFirstChern (X := X) k))
proof:
:=

    (geometricFreeCartierPresentationOfFiniteLocallyFree k) z

name: SchemeKTheory.alternating_telescope
statement:
theorem alternating_telescope {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (a b : ℕ → R) (l : R)
    (h0 : a 0 = b 0) (hs : ∀ n, a (n + 1) = b (n + 1) + b n * l) (m : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (-1 : R) ^ k * a k * l ^ (m - k) = (-1) ^ m * b m
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [h0]
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, mul_one, hs m]
    have hsum : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (-1 : R) ^ k * a k * l ^ (m + 1 - k) =
        l * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (-1 : R) ^ k * a k * l ^ (m - k) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk ↦ ?_
      have hk : k ≤ m := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
      rw [show m + 1 - k = (m - k) + 1 by omega, pow_succ]
      ring
    rw [hsum, ih]
    ring

name: SchemeKTheory.koszul_relation
statement:
theorem koszul_relation {F L : Y.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hF : HasConstantRank Y F r) (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1) (σ : F ⟶ L) [Epi σ] :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (r + 1),
        (-1 : K0 Y) ^ k * lambdaClass Y F hF.isFiniteLocallyFree k *
          k0ClassOf Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree ^ (r - k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hK : HasConstantRank Y (kernel σ) (r - 1) := hasConstantRank_kernel Y hF hL σ
  have hS : (ShortComplex.mk (kernel.ι σ) σ (kernel.condition σ)).ShortExact :=
    { exact := ShortComplex.exact_kernel σ
      mono_f := inferInstance
      epi_g := inferInstance }
  rw [alternating_telescope (lambdaClass Y F hF.isFiniteLocallyFree)
      (lambdaClass Y (kernel σ) hK.isFiniteLocallyFree) _
      (by rw [lambdaClass_zero, lambdaClass_zero])
      (lambdaClass_succ_of_shortExact_rankOne Y hK.isFiniteLocallyFree
        hF.isFiniteLocallyFree hL _ _ _ hS) r,
    lambdaClass_eq_zero_of_rank_lt Y (kernel σ) (r - 1) hK r (by omega), mul_zero]

name: SchemeKTheory.isUnit_lambdaClass_top
statement:
theorem isUnit_lambdaClass_top (M : Y.Modules) (r : ℕ) (h : HasConstantRank Y M r) :
    IsUnit (lambdaClass Y M h.isFiniteLocallyFree r)
proof:
:=
  isUnit_k0ClassOf_of_rankOne Y _ (hasConstantRank_exteriorPowerSheaf_top Y M r h)

name: SchemeKTheory.k0_induction
statement:
theorem k0_induction (P : K0 Y → Prop) (h0 : P 0) (hadd : ∀ a b, P a → P b → P (a + b))
    (hneg : ∀ a, P a → P (-a))
    (h : ∀ (F : Y.Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y F), P (k0ClassOf Y F hF))
    (x : K0 Y) : P x
proof:
:= by
  let T : AddSubgroup (K0 Y) :=
    { carrier := {a | P a}
      add_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb ↦ hadd a b ha hb
      zero_mem' := h0
      neg_mem' := fun {a} ha ↦ hneg a ha }
  change x ∈ T
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective _ x
  induction y using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => exact T.zero_mem
  | add a b ha hb =>
    rw [map_add]
    exact T.add_mem ha hb
  | single F n =>
    rw [← Finsupp.smul_single_one, map_zsmul]
    exact T.zsmul_mem (h F.1 F.2) n

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechIntersection_eq_supportIntersection
statement:
theorem coordinateCechIntersection_eq_supportIntersection {p : ℕ}
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateCechIntersection k n p a =
      coordinateCechSupportIntersection k n
        (coordinateCechWordSupport n a)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · let t (i : coordinateCechWordSupport n a) : Fin (p + 1) :=
      Classical.choose
        ((mem_coordinateCechWordSupport_iff n a i.1).1 i.2)
    have ht (i : coordinateCechWordSupport n a) :
        a (t i) = i.1 :=
      Classical.choose_spec
        ((mem_coordinateCechWordSupport_iff n a i.1).1 i.2)
    exact (Pi.lift fun i : coordinateCechWordSupport n a ↦
      Pi.π
          (fun t : Fin (p + 1) ↦ coordinateCechCover k n (a t))
          (t i) ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg (coordinateCechCover k n) (ht i))).le
  · exact (Pi.lift fun t : Fin (p + 1) ↦
      Pi.π
        (fun i : coordinateCechWordSupport n a ↦
          coordinateCechCover k n i.1)
        ⟨a t, (mem_coordinateCechWordSupport_iff n a (a t)).2
          ⟨t, rfl⟩⟩).le

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechSupportEnumeration_injective
statement:
theorem coordinateCechSupportEnumeration_injective
    (S : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (m : ℕ) (hS : S.card = m) :
    Function.Injective (coordinateCechSupportEnumeration n S m hS)
proof:
:=
  Subtype.val_injective.comp (S.orderIsoOfFin hS).injective

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechWordSupport_enumeration
statement:
theorem coordinateCechWordSupport_enumeration
    (S : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (m : ℕ) (hS : S.card = m) :
    coordinateCechWordSupport n
        (coordinateCechSupportEnumeration n S m hS) = S
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.ext
  intro i
  rw [mem_coordinateCechWordSupport_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact (S.orderIsoOfFin hS j).2
  · intro hi
    let iS : S := ⟨i, hi⟩
    exact ⟨(S.orderIsoOfFin hS).symm iS, by
      change ((S.orderIsoOfFin hS)
        ((S.orderIsoOfFin hS).symm iS)).1 = i
      rw [(S.orderIsoOfFin hS).apply_symm_apply]⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechDeleteRestriction_comp_supportSectionIso
statement:
theorem coordinateCechDeleteRestriction_comp_supportSectionIso
    {p : ℕ} (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (S : Finset (Fin (n + 1)))
    (ha : coordinateCechWordSupport n a = S)
    (hdelete :
      coordinateCechWordSupport n (a ∘ r.succAbove) = S) :
    coordinateCechDeleteRestriction k n M a r ≫
        (coordinateCechWordSectionIsoOfSupportEq k n M a S ha).hom =
      (coordinateCechWordSectionIsoOfSupportEq k n M
        (a ∘ r.succAbove) S hdelete).hom
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [coordinateCechDeleteRestriction,
    coordinateCechWordSectionIsoOfSupportEq, Iso.symm_hom,
    Functor.mapIso_hom]
  change M.presheaf.map _ ≫ M.presheaf.map _ = M.presheaf.map _
  rw [← M.presheaf.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.flatPullbackCoeff_toSpec_generic
statement:
theorem flatPullbackCoeff_toSpec_generic :
    flatPullbackCoeff (toSpec k n) (genericPoint (space k n)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hη : toSpec k n (genericPoint (space k n)) = genericPoint (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hbot := AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.maximalIdeal_stalk_eq_bot_of_eq_genericPoint hη
  have hI : Ideal.map (CommRingCat.Hom.hom (Scheme.Hom.stalkMap (toSpec k n)
        (genericPoint (space k n))))
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).presheaf.stalk
        (toSpec k n (genericPoint (space k n))))) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((space k n).presheaf.stalk (genericPoint (space k n))) := by
    rw [hbot, Ideal.map_bot]
    exact (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.maximalIdeal_stalk_eq_bot_of_eq_genericPoint rfl).symm
  unfold flatPullbackCoeff
  rw [hI]
  haveI : IsSimpleModule ((space k n).presheaf.stalk (genericPoint (space k n)))
      (((space k n).presheaf.stalk (genericPoint (space k n))) ⧸
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((space k n).presheaf.stalk (genericPoint (space k n)))) :=
    isSimpleModule_iff_isCoatom.mpr (Ideal.isMaximal_def.mp inferInstance)
  rw [Module.length_eq_one]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.toSpec_height_eq_zero
statement: theorem toSpec_height_eq_zero (x : space k n) : height (toSpec k n x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : toSpec k n x = F20.pt0 k := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [this]
  exact height_pt0 k

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.height_genericPoint_space
statement: theorem height_genericPoint_space : height (genericPoint (space k n)) = (n : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  have h := pureRelDim_projectiveSpace_toSpec k n (genericPoint (space k n))
    (by rw [flatPullbackCoeff_toSpec_generic]; exact one_ne_zero)
  rw [h, toSpec_height_eq_zero, zero_add]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.flatPullbackCoeff_toSpec_eq_zero
statement:
theorem flatPullbackCoeff_toSpec_eq_zero {x : space k n} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint (space k n)) :
    flatPullbackCoeff (toSpec k n) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hc
  have h := pureRelDim_projectiveSpace_toSpec k n x hc
  rw [toSpec_height_eq_zero, zero_add] at h
  have hle : x ≤ genericPoint (space k n) := (genericPoint_spec (space k n)).specializes trivial
  have hlt : x < genericPoint (space k n) := lt_iff_le_not_ge.mpr ⟨hle, fun hge ↦ hx (by
    have h1 : x ⤳ genericPoint (space k n) := hge
    have h2 : IsGenericPoint x (⊤ : Set (space k n)) := by
      have := (specializes_iff_closure_subset.mp h1)
      rw [(genericPoint_spec (space k n)).def] at this
      exact Set.eq_univ_of_univ_subset this
    exact h2.eq (genericPoint_spec (space k n)))⟩
  have := Order.height_strictMono hlt (by rw [h]; exact ENat.coe_lt_top n)
  rw [height_genericPoint_space, h] at this
  exact lt_irrefl _ this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.spaceFundClass_eq
statement:
theorem spaceFundClass_eq (hd : height (genericPoint (space k n)) = ((0 + n : ℕ) : ℕ∞)) :
    spaceFundClass k n =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k n) m) (0 + n)
        ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk
          (dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint (space k n)) (0 + n) hd) : DimChow (space k n) (0 + n)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold spaceFundClass
  rw [totalPullOn, DirectSum.toModule_lof]
  refine congrArg (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow (space k n) m) (0 + n)) ?_
  refine (opsK k).pull_mk (toSpec k n) n (pureRelDim_projectiveSpace_toSpec k n) 0
    (dimPrimeCycle (F20.pt0 k) 0 (height_pt0 k)) (dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint (space k n)) (0 + n) hd) ?_
  intro x
  have hD : (dimPrimeCycle (F20.pt0 k) 0 (height_pt0 k)).1 (toSpec k n x) = 1 := by
    simp [dimPrimeCycle, Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single_apply,
      Subsingleton.elim (toSpec k n x) (F20.pt0 k)]
  rw [hD, one_mul]
  by_cases hx : x = genericPoint (space k n)
  · subst hx
    simp [dimPrimeCycle, Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single_apply,
      flatPullbackCoeff_toSpec_generic]
  · simp [dimPrimeCycle, Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single_apply, hx,
      flatPullbackCoeff_toSpec_eq_zero k n hx]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.affineChartResidueIso_scalar
statement:
theorem affineChartResidueIso_scalar
    {K A : Type u} [CommRing K] [CommRing A] [Algebra K A]
    {P : Scheme.{u}} (e : P ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of A))
    (π : P ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
    (hπ : e.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K A)) = π) (z : P) :
    CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (e.hom z).asIdeal.ResidueField) ≫
      (affineChartResidueIso e z).hom =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of K)).inv ≫ π.appTop ≫ P.Γevaluation z
proof:
:= by
  have ha : CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (e.hom z).asIdeal.ResidueField) =
      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K A) ≫
        CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A (e.hom z).asIdeal.ResidueField) := by
    ext k
    exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply K A _ k
  change CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (e.hom z).asIdeal.ResidueField) ≫
    (Scheme.Spec.residueFieldIso (CommRingCat.of A) (e.hom z)).inv ≫
      e.hom.residueFieldMap z = _
  rw [ha, Category.assoc]
  erw [Scheme.Spec.algebraMap_residueFieldIso_inv_assoc]
  change CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K A) ≫
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv ≫
      (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).Γevaluation (e.hom z) ≫ e.hom.residueFieldMap z = _
  rw [Scheme.Γevaluation_naturality, ← Category.assoc,
    Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality, Category.assoc]
  erw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop_assoc, hπ]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.affineChartResidue_trdeg
statement:
theorem affineChartResidue_trdeg
    {K A : Type u} [Field K] [CommRing A] [Algebra K A]
    {P : Scheme.{u}} (e : P ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of A))
    (π : P ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
    (hπ : e.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K A)) = π) (z : P) :
    letI : P.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
proof:
:= ⟨π⟩
    letI : Algebra K (P.residueField z) := (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.kRes K P z).toAlgebra
    Algebra.trdeg K (P.residueField z) = Algebra.trdeg K (e.hom z).asIdeal.ResidueField := by
  letI : P.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) := ⟨π⟩
  letI : Algebra K (P.residueField z) := (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.kRes K P z).toAlgebra
  exact (affineChartResidueAlgEquiv (K := K) e π hπ z).trdeg_eq.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.primeResidue_trdeg_eq_of_eq
statement:
theorem primeResidue_trdeg_eq_of_eq
    {K A : Type u} [CommRing K] [CommRing A] [Algebra K A]
    {p q : PrimeSpectrum A} (h : p = q) :
    Algebra.trdeg K p.asIdeal.ResidueField = Algebra.trdeg K q.asIdeal.ResidueField
proof:
:= by
  subst q
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.residueFieldMap_kRes
statement:
theorem residueFieldMap_kRes
    {K : Type u} [Field K] {U F : Scheme.{u}}
    [U.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [F.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    (j : U ⟶ F) [j.IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] (z : U) (k : K) :
    (j.residueFieldMap z).hom (kRes K F (j z) k) = kRes K U z k
proof:
:= by
  have hΓ : j.appTop.hom (kΓ K F k) = kΓ K U k := by
    change ((F ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).appTop ≫ j.appTop).hom
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of K)).inv.hom k) = _
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, CategoryTheory.comp_over]
    rfl
  change (j.residueFieldMap z).hom ((F.Γevaluation (j z)).hom (kΓ K F k)) =
    (U.Γevaluation z).hom (kΓ K U k)
  rw [Scheme.Γevaluation_naturality_apply, hΓ]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.preimmersionResidue_trdeg
statement:
theorem preimmersionResidue_trdeg
    {K : Type u} [Field K] {U F : Scheme.{u}}
    [U.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [F.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    (j : U ⟶ F) [j.IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsPreimmersion j] (z : U) :
    letI : Algebra K (F.residueField (j z))
proof:
:= (kRes K F (j z)).toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra K (U.residueField z) := (kRes K U z).toAlgebra
    Algebra.trdeg K (U.residueField z) = Algebra.trdeg K (F.residueField (j z)) := by
  letI : Algebra K (F.residueField (j z)) := (kRes K F (j z)).toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra K (U.residueField z) := (kRes K U z).toAlgebra
  exact (preimmersionResidueAlgEquiv (K := K) j z).trdeg_eq.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.nativeResidue_trdeg_eq_of_point_eq
statement:
theorem nativeResidue_trdeg_eq_of_point_eq
    {K : Type u} [Field K] {F : Scheme.{u}} [F.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    {p q : F} (h : p = q) :
    letI : Algebra K (F.residueField p)
proof:
:= (kRes K F p).toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra K (F.residueField q) := (kRes K F q).toAlgebra
    Algebra.trdeg K (F.residueField p) = Algebra.trdeg K (F.residueField q) := by
  subst q
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.specField_kRes_isIso
statement:
theorem specField_kRes_isIso (K : Type u) [Field K]
    (q : Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :
    letI : (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
proof:
:= ⟨𝟙 _⟩
    IsIso (CommRingCat.ofHom (kRes K (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) q)) := by
  letI : (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) := ⟨𝟙 _⟩
  letI : Algebra K ((Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).residueField q) :=
    (kRes K (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) q).toAlgebra
  apply (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective _).mpr
  let e := specFieldResidueAlgEquiv K q
  have he : (fun k ↦ e k) = kRes K (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) q := by
    funext k
    have h := e.commutes k
    change e k = kRes K (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) q k at h
    exact h
  change Function.Bijective (kRes K (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) q)
  rw [← he]
  exact e.bijective

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackProjectiveFiberChartResidue_trdeg
statement:
theorem pullbackProjectiveFiberChartResidue_trdeg (t : C.scheme)
    (V : (g.fiber (C.toBase t)).affineOpens) :
    let K : Type u
proof:
:= Y.residueField (C.toBase t)
    let L : Type u := C.scheme.residueField t
    letI _fieldK : Field K := inferInstance
    letI _fieldL : Field L := inferInstance
    letI _algKL : Algebra K L := (C.toBase.residueFieldMap t).hom.toAlgebra
    let A : Type u := Γ(V, ⊤)
    letI _ringA : CommRing A := inferInstance
    letI _algKA : Algebra K A :=
      (affineScalarRingMap (g.fiberToSpecResidueField (C.toBase t)) V).toAlgebra
    let U : Scheme := (C.pullbackProjectiveFiberMap g t ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 : Scheme)
    let W : Scheme := V
    letI : U.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=
      ⟨(C.pullbackProjectiveFiberMap g t ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι ≫
        (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g).fiberToSpecResidueField t⟩
    letI : W.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
      ⟨V.1.ι ≫ g.fiberToSpecResidueField (C.toBase t)⟩
    ∀ z : U,
    let w : W := (C.pullbackProjectiveFiberMap g t ∣_ V.1) z
    letI : Algebra L (U.residueField z) :=
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.kRes L U z).toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra K (W.residueField w) :=
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.kRes K W w).toAlgebra
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.flatPullbackCoeff (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g)
      ((C.pullbackProjectiveMap g).fiberι t
        ((C.pullbackProjectiveFiberMap g t ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι z)) ≠ 0 →
    Algebra.trdeg L (U.residueField z) = Algebra.trdeg K (W.residueField w) := by
  intro K L A U W z w hc
  letI fieldK : Field K := inferInstance
  letI fieldL : Field L := inferInstance
  letI ringA : CommRing A := inferInstance
  letI algKL : Algebra K L := (C.toBase.residueFieldMap t).hom.toAlgebra
  letI algKA : Algebra K A :=
    (affineScalarRingMap (g.fiberToSpecResidueField (C.toBase t)) V).toAlgebra
  letI : U.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=
    ⟨(C.pullbackProjectiveFiberMap g t ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι ≫
      (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g).fiberToSpecResidueField t⟩
  letI : W.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
    ⟨V.1.ι ≫ g.fiberToSpecResidueField (C.toBase t)⟩
  letI : Algebra L (U.residueField z) :=
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.kRes L U z).toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra K (W.residueField w) :=
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.kRes K W w).toAlgebra
  let T : Type u := L ⊗[K] A
  letI ringT : CommRing T := inferInstance
  let q : PrimeSpectrum T := (C.pullbackProjectiveFiberTensorChartIso g t V).hom z
  let p : PrimeSpectrum A := PrimeSpectrum.comap
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := K) (A := L) (B := A)).toRingHom q
  have hq : q.asIdeal ∈ minimalPrimes T :=
    C.pullbackProjectiveFiberTensorChart_minimalPrime g t V z hc
  have hf := fibreFieldTensor_component_residueField_trdeg (K := K) (L := L) (A := A) hq
  have he : p = (W.isoSpec.hom w : PrimeSpectrum A) :=
    C.pullbackProjectiveFiberTensorChart_contraction g t V z
  have hsL := (C.pullbackProjectiveFiberTensorResidueAlgEquiv g t V z).trdeg_eq
  have hsK := (C.originalProjectiveFiberChartResidueAlgEquiv g t V w).trdeg_eq
  exact hsL.symm.trans (hf.trans ((primeResidue_trdeg_eq_of_eq (K := K) he).trans hsK))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackProjectiveFiberResidue_trdeg
statement:
theorem pullbackProjectiveFiberResidue_trdeg (t : C.scheme) :
    let K : Type u
proof:
:= Y.residueField (C.toBase t)
    let L : Type u := C.scheme.residueField t
    letI _fieldK : Field K := inferInstance
    letI _fieldL : Field L := inferInstance
    let F : Scheme := (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g).fiber t
    let G : Scheme := g.fiber (C.toBase t)
    letI : F.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=
      ⟨(C.pullbackProjectiveMap g).fiberToSpecResidueField t⟩
    letI : G.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
      ⟨g.fiberToSpecResidueField (C.toBase t)⟩
    ∀ ξ : F,
    let η : G := C.pullbackProjectiveFiberMap g t ξ
    letI : Algebra L (F.residueField ξ) :=
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.kRes L F ξ).toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra K (G.residueField η) :=
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.kRes K G η).toAlgebra
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.flatPullbackCoeff (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g)
      ((C.pullbackProjectiveMap g).fiberι t ξ) ≠ 0 →
    Algebra.trdeg L (F.residueField ξ) = Algebra.trdeg K (G.residueField η) := by
  intro K L F G ξ η hc
  letI fieldK : Field K := inferInstance
  letI fieldL : Field L := inferInstance
  letI : F.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=
    ⟨(C.pullbackProjectiveMap g).fiberToSpecResidueField t⟩
  letI : G.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
    ⟨g.fiberToSpecResidueField (C.toBase t)⟩
  letI : Algebra L (F.residueField ξ) :=
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.kRes L F ξ).toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra K (G.residueField η) :=
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.kRes K G η).toAlgebra
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨V, hV, rfl⟩, hηV, _⟩ := G.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open
    (show η ∈ (⊤ : G.Opens) from trivial) (⊤ : G.Opens).isOpen
  let V' : G.affineOpens := ⟨V, hV⟩
  let m : F ⟶ G := C.pullbackProjectiveFiberMap g t
  let U : Scheme := (m ⁻¹ᵁ V : Scheme)
  let zU : U := ⟨ξ, hηV⟩
  let w : (V : Scheme) := (m ∣_ V) zU
  letI : U.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=
    ⟨(m ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι ≫ (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g).fiberToSpecResidueField t⟩
  letI : (V : Scheme).Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
    ⟨(Scheme.Opens.ι (X := G) V) ≫ g.fiberToSpecResidueField (C.toBase t)⟩
  letI : ((m ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) := ⟨rfl⟩
  letI : (Scheme.Opens.ι (X := G) V).IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) := ⟨rfl⟩
  letI : Algebra L (U.residueField zU) :=
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.kRes L U zU).toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra K ((V : Scheme).residueField w) :=
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.kRes K (V : Scheme) w).toAlgebra
  have hcU : AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.flatPullbackCoeff (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g)
      ((C.pullbackProjectiveMap g).fiberι t ((m ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι zU)) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [zU, Scheme.Opens.ι_apply] using hc
  have ht := C.pullbackProjectiveFiberChartResidue_trdeg g t V' zU hcU
  have hu := preimmersionResidue_trdeg (K := L) (m ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι zU
  have hv := preimmersionResidue_trdeg (K := K) (Scheme.Opens.ι (X := G) V) w
  have he : (Scheme.Opens.ι (X := G) V) w = η := by
    have h := congrArg (fun k ↦ k zU) (morphismRestrict_ι m V)
    simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, zU, Scheme.Opens.ι_apply] using h
  have hp := nativeResidue_trdeg_eq_of_point_eq (K := K) he
  exact hu.symm.trans (ht.trans (hv.trans hp))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.freeAbSheafHomAddEquiv_naturality_right
statement:
theorem freeAbSheafHomAddEquiv_naturality_right
    (F G : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} X)
    (g : TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque.freeAbSheaf (⊤ : Opens X) ⟶ F)
    (f : F ⟶ G) :
    freeAbSheafHomAddEquiv X ⊤ G (g ≫ f) =
      f.hom.app (op (⊤ : Opens X)) (freeAbSheafHomAddEquiv X ⊤ F g)
proof:
:= by
  change TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque.freeAbSheafHomEquiv ⊤ G (g ≫ f) =
    f.hom.app (op (⊤ : Opens X))
      (TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque.freeAbSheafHomEquiv ⊤ F g)
  simp only [TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque.freeAbSheafHomEquiv, Equiv.trans_apply]
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
  erw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.constantIntSheafHomSectionsAddEquiv_naturality_right
statement:
theorem constantIntSheafHomSectionsAddEquiv_naturality_right
    (F G : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} X)
    (g : constantIntSheaf X ⟶ F) (f : F ⟶ G) :
    constantIntSheafHomSectionsAddEquiv X G (g ≫ f) =
      f.hom.app (op (⊤ : Opens X))
        (constantIntSheafHomSectionsAddEquiv X F g)
proof:
:= by
  change AddCommGrpCat.uliftZMultiplesAddEquiv _
      ((constantSheafAdj (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
        Limits.isTerminalTop).homEquiv _ G (g ≫ f)) =
    f.hom.app (op (⊤ : Opens X))
      (AddCommGrpCat.uliftZMultiplesAddEquiv _
        ((constantSheafAdj (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
          Limits.isTerminalTop).homEquiv _ F g))
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.appLE_mem_baseSubring
statement:
lemma appLE_mem_baseSubring {W : X.Opens} {V : S.Opens} (h : W ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (a : Γ(S, V)) :
    f.appLE V W h a ∈ baseSubring f W
proof:
:=
  Subring.subset_closure ⟨V, h, a, rfl⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.map_mem_baseSubring
statement:
lemma map_mem_baseSubring {W W' : X.Opens} (i : W' ≤ W) {c : Γ(X, W)}
    (hc : c ∈ baseSubring f W) : X.presheaf.map (homOfLE i).op c ∈ baseSubring f W'
proof:
:= by
  have : baseSubring f W ≤ (baseSubring f W').comap (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE i).op).hom := by
    rw [baseSubring, Subring.closure_le]
    rintro _ ⟨V, h, a, rfl⟩
    change (f.appLE V W h ≫ X.presheaf.map (homOfLE i).op) a ∈ baseSubring f W'
    rw [Scheme.Hom.appLE_map]
    exact appLE_mem_baseSubring f _ a
  exact this hc

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.D_appLE_eq_zero
statement:
theorem D_appLE_eq_zero {W : X.Opens} (hW : IsAffineOpen W) (h : W ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V₀)
    {V : S.Opens} (hV : W ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (a : Γ(S, V)) :
    letI
proof:
:= (f.appLE V₀ W h).hom.toAlgebra
    KaehlerDifferential.D Γ(S, V₀) Γ(X, W) (f.appLE V W hV a) = 0 := by
  letI := (f.appLE V₀ W h).hom.toAlgebra
  have key : ∀ w : W, ∃ a₀ : Γ(S, V₀), S.basicOpen a₀ ≤ V ∧ f.base w ∈ S.basicOpen a₀ := by
    intro w
    obtain ⟨a₀, hle, hmem⟩ := hV₀.exists_basicOpen_le (V := V ⊓ V₀)
      ⟨f.base w, ⟨hV w.2, h w.2⟩⟩ (h w.2)
    exact ⟨a₀, hle.trans inf_le_left, hmem⟩
  choose a₀ ha₀V ha₀w using key
  let r : W → Γ(X, W) := fun w ↦ f.appLE V₀ W h (a₀ w)
  let s : Set Γ(X, W) := Set.range r
  have hspan : Ideal.span s = ⊤ := by
    rw [← hW.iSup_basicOpen_eq_self_iff]
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact iSup_le fun t ↦ X.basicOpen_le _
    · intro y hy
      refine TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨r ⟨y, hy⟩, ⟨y, hy⟩, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      change y ∈ X.basicOpen (f.appLE V₀ W h (a₀ ⟨y, hy⟩))
      rw [Scheme.basicOpen_appLE]
      exact ⟨hy, ha₀w ⟨y, hy⟩⟩
  haveI : ∀ t : s, IsLocalization.Away t.1 Γ(X, X.basicOpen t.1) := fun t ↦
    hW.isLocalization_basicOpen t.1
  letI : ∀ t : s, Algebra Γ(S, V₀) Γ(X, X.basicOpen t.1) := fun t ↦
    (f.appLE V₀ (X.basicOpen t.1) ((X.basicOpen_le _).trans h)).hom.toAlgebra
  haveI : ∀ t : s, IsScalarTower Γ(S, V₀) Γ(X, W) Γ(X, X.basicOpen t.1) := fun t ↦
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
      change (f.appLE V₀ (X.basicOpen t.1) _).hom =
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le t.1)).op).hom.comp (f.appLE V₀ W h).hom
      rw [← CommRingCat.hom_comp, Scheme.Hom.appLE_map])
  refine Module.eq_zero_of_isLocalized_span s hspan
    (fun t ↦ Ω[Γ(X, X.basicOpen t.1)⁄Γ(S, V₀)])
    (fun t ↦ KaehlerDifferential.map Γ(S, V₀) Γ(S, V₀) Γ(X, W) Γ(X, X.basicOpen t.1)) _ ?_
  rintro ⟨_, w, rfl⟩
  letI : Algebra Γ(S, V₀) Γ(X, X.basicOpen (r w)) :=
    (f.appLE V₀ (X.basicOpen (r w)) ((X.basicOpen_le _).trans h)).hom.toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(S, V₀) Γ(X, W) Γ(X, X.basicOpen (r w)) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
      change (f.appLE V₀ (X.basicOpen (r w)) _).hom =
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le (r w))).op).hom.comp (f.appLE V₀ W h).hom
      rw [← CommRingCat.hom_comp, Scheme.Hom.appLE_map])
  change KaehlerDifferential.map Γ(S, V₀) Γ(S, V₀) Γ(X, W) Γ(X, X.basicOpen (r w))
    (KaehlerDifferential.D _ _ _) = 0
  rw [KaehlerDifferential.map_D]
  have hT : X.basicOpen (r w) ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ S.basicOpen (a₀ w) := by
    change X.basicOpen (f.appLE V₀ W h (a₀ w)) ≤ _
    rw [Scheme.basicOpen_appLE]
    exact inf_le_right
  have hres : algebraMap Γ(X, W) Γ(X, X.basicOpen (r w)) (f.appLE V W hV a) =
      f.appLE (S.basicOpen (a₀ w)) (X.basicOpen (r w)) hT
        (S.presheaf.map (homOfLE (ha₀V w)).op a) := by
    change (f.appLE V W hV ≫ X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le _)).op) a =
      (S.presheaf.map (homOfLE (ha₀V w)).op ≫ f.appLE _ (X.basicOpen (r w)) hT) a
    rw [Scheme.Hom.appLE_map, Scheme.Hom.map_appLE]
  rw [hres]
  letI : Algebra Γ(S, S.basicOpen (a₀ w)) Γ(X, X.basicOpen (r w)) :=
    (f.appLE _ (X.basicOpen (r w)) hT).hom.toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(S, V₀) Γ(S, S.basicOpen (a₀ w)) Γ(X, X.basicOpen (r w)) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
      change (f.appLE V₀ (X.basicOpen (r w)) _).hom =
        (f.appLE _ (X.basicOpen (r w)) hT).hom.comp
          (S.presheaf.map (homOfLE (S.basicOpen_le (a₀ w))).op).hom
      rw [← CommRingCat.hom_comp, Scheme.Hom.map_appLE])
  haveI := hV₀.isLocalization_basicOpen (a₀ w)
  haveI : Algebra.FormallyUnramified Γ(S, V₀) Γ(S, S.basicOpen (a₀ w)) :=
    Algebra.FormallyUnramified.of_isLocalization (Submonoid.powers (a₀ w))
  change KaehlerDifferential.D _ _
    (algebraMap Γ(S, S.basicOpen (a₀ w)) Γ(X, X.basicOpen (r w)) _) = 0
  rw [← KaehlerDifferential.map_D Γ(S, V₀) Γ(S, V₀),
    Subsingleton.elim (KaehlerDifferential.D _ _ _) 0, map_zero]

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.D_eq_zero_of_mem_baseSubring
statement:
theorem D_eq_zero_of_mem_baseSubring {W : X.Opens} (hW : IsAffineOpen W) (h : W ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V₀)
    {c : Γ(X, W)} (hc : c ∈ baseSubring f W) :
    letI
proof:
:= (f.appLE V₀ W h).hom.toAlgebra
    KaehlerDifferential.D Γ(S, V₀) Γ(X, W) c = 0 := by
  letI := (f.appLE V₀ W h).hom.toAlgebra
  induction hc using Subring.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨V, hV, a, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact D_appLE_eq_zero f hV₀ hW h hV a
  | zero => exact map_zero _
  | one => exact (KaehlerDifferential.D _ _).map_one_eq_zero
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | neg x _ hx => rw [map_neg, hx, neg_zero]
  | mul x y _ _ hx hy => rw [Derivation.leibniz, hx, hy, smul_zero, smul_zero, add_zero]

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.compareMap_bijective
statement:
theorem compareMap_bijective {W : X.Opens} (hW : IsAffineOpen W) (h : W ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V₀) :
    Function.Bijective (compareMap f h)
proof:
:= by
  letI := (f.appLE V₀ W h).hom.toAlgebra
  letI := baseAlgebra f h
  letI : Algebra (baseSubring f W) Γ(X, W) := (baseInclusion f W).hom.toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(S, V₀) (baseSubring f W) Γ(X, W) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  have hmap : KaehlerDifferential.map Γ(S, V₀) Γ(S, V₀) (baseSubring f W) Γ(X, W) = 0 := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro y
    have hy : y ∈ Submodule.span (baseSubring f W)
        (Set.range (KaehlerDifferential.D Γ(S, V₀) (baseSubring f W))) := by
      rw [KaehlerDifferential.span_range_derivation]
      trivial
    induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hy
      rw [KaehlerDifferential.map_D, LinearMap.zero_apply]
      exact D_eq_zero_of_mem_baseSubring f hV₀ hW h c.2
    | zero => simp
    | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
      rw [LinearMap.zero_apply] at hx hy ⊢
      rw [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
    | smul a x _ hx =>
      rw [LinearMap.zero_apply] at hx ⊢
      rw [map_smul, hx, smul_zero]
  constructor
  · rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro ω hω
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ :=
      (KaehlerDifferential.exact_mapBaseChange_map Γ(S, V₀) (baseSubring f W) Γ(X, W) ω).mp hω
    clear hω
    induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => exact map_zero _
    | tmul x y => rw [KaehlerDifferential.mapBaseChange_tmul, hmap, LinearMap.zero_apply,
        smul_zero]
    | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  · exact KaehlerDifferential.map_surjective Γ(S, V₀) (baseSubring f W) Γ(X, W)

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.kaehler_semilinear_ext
statement:
theorem kaehler_semilinear_ext {R B B' M : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    [CommRing B'] (σ : B →+* B') [AddCommGroup M] [Module B' M] (F G : Ω[B⁄R] → M)
    (hF0 : F 0 = 0) (hG0 : G 0 = 0)
    (hFa : ∀ x y, F (x + y) = F x + F y) (hGa : ∀ x y, G (x + y) = G x + G y)
    (hFs : ∀ (a : B) x, F (a • x) = σ a • F x) (hGs : ∀ (a : B) x, G (a • x) = σ a • G x)
    (hD : ∀ b, F (KaehlerDifferential.D R B b) = G (KaehlerDifferential.D R B b)) :
    F = G
proof:
:= by
  funext ω
  have hω : ω ∈ Submodule.span B (Set.range (KaehlerDifferential.D R B)) := by
    rw [KaehlerDifferential.span_range_derivation]
    trivial
  induction hω using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact hD b
  | zero => rw [hF0, hG0]
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [hFa, hGa, hx, hy]
  | smul a x _ hx => rw [hFs, hGs, hx]

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.relativePresheaf_map_compareMap
statement:
theorem relativePresheaf_map_compareMap {U V : X.Opens} (i : V ≤ U) (h : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V₀)
    (ω : letI := (f.appLE V₀ U h).hom.toAlgebra; Ω[Γ(X, U)⁄Γ(S, V₀)]) :
    letI
proof:
:= (f.appLE V₀ U h).hom.toAlgebra
    letI := (f.appLE V₀ V (i.trans h)).hom.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra Γ(X, U) Γ(X, V) := (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE i).op).hom.toAlgebra
    haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(S, V₀) Γ(X, U) Γ(X, V) := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
      change (f.appLE V₀ V _).hom = (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE i).op).hom.comp (f.appLE V₀ U h).hom
      rw [← CommRingCat.hom_comp, Scheme.Hom.appLE_map])
    (relativePresheaf f).map (homOfLE i).op (compareMap f h ω) =
      compareMap f (i.trans h) (KaehlerDifferential.map Γ(S, V₀) Γ(S, V₀) Γ(X, U) Γ(X, V) ω) := by
  letI := (f.appLE V₀ U h).hom.toAlgebra
  letI := (f.appLE V₀ V (i.trans h)).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra Γ(X, U) Γ(X, V) := (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE i).op).hom.toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(S, V₀) Γ(X, U) Γ(X, V) := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
    change (f.appLE V₀ V _).hom = (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE i).op).hom.comp (f.appLE V₀ U h).hom
    rw [← CommRingCat.hom_comp, Scheme.Hom.appLE_map])
  revert ω
  rw [← funext_iff]
  refine kaehler_semilinear_ext (M := (relativePresheaf f).obj (op V))
    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE i).op).hom _ _ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · change (relativePresheaf f).map (homOfLE i).op (compareMap f h 0) = 0
    rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  · exact map_zero _
  · intro x y
    change (relativePresheaf f).map (homOfLE i).op (compareMap f h (x + y)) =
      (relativePresheaf f).map (homOfLE i).op (compareMap f h x) +
        (relativePresheaf f).map (homOfLE i).op (compareMap f h y)
    rw [map_add, map_add]
  · intro x y
    exact (congrArg (compareMap f (i.trans h)) (map_add _ x y)).trans (map_add _ _ _)
  · intro a x
    change (relativePresheaf f).map (homOfLE i).op (compareMap f h (a • x)) = _
    rw [map_smul]
    exact PresheafOfModules.map_smul _ _ _ _
  · intro a x
    change compareMap f (i.trans h) (KaehlerDifferential.map Γ(S, V₀) Γ(S, V₀) Γ(X, U) Γ(X, V)
      (a • x)) = _
    rw [map_smul, ← algebraMap_smul Γ(X, V) a, map_smul]
    rfl
  · intro b
    change (relativePresheaf f).map (homOfLE i).op
        (compareMap f h (KaehlerDifferential.D Γ(S, V₀) Γ(X, U) b)) =
      compareMap f (i.trans h) (KaehlerDifferential.map Γ(S, V₀) Γ(S, V₀) Γ(X, U) Γ(X, V)
        (KaehlerDifferential.D Γ(S, V₀) Γ(X, U) b))
    have l1 : compareMap f h (KaehlerDifferential.D Γ(S, V₀) Γ(X, U) b) =
        CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d (f := (baseMap f).app (op U)) b := by
      letI := baseAlgebra f h
      letI : Algebra (baseSubring f U) Γ(X, U) := (baseInclusion f U).hom.toAlgebra
      haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(S, V₀) (baseSubring f U) Γ(X, U) :=
        IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
      exact KaehlerDifferential.map_D Γ(S, V₀) (baseSubring f U) Γ(X, U) Γ(X, U) b
    have l2 : ∀ c : Γ(X, V), compareMap f (i.trans h) (KaehlerDifferential.D Γ(S, V₀) Γ(X, V) c) =
        CommRingCat.KaehlerDifferential.d (f := (baseMap f).app (op V)) c := by
      intro c
      letI := baseAlgebra f (i.trans h)
      letI : Algebra (baseSubring f V) Γ(X, V) := (baseInclusion f V).hom.toAlgebra
      haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(S, V₀) (baseSubring f V) Γ(X, V) :=
        IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
      exact KaehlerDifferential.map_D Γ(S, V₀) (baseSubring f V) Γ(X, V) Γ(X, V) c
    have l3 : KaehlerDifferential.map Γ(S, V₀) Γ(S, V₀) Γ(X, U) Γ(X, V)
        (KaehlerDifferential.D Γ(S, V₀) Γ(X, U) b) =
        KaehlerDifferential.D Γ(S, V₀) Γ(X, V) (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE i).op b) :=
      KaehlerDifferential.map_D _ _ _ _ b
    exact (congrArg ((relativePresheaf f).map (homOfLE i).op) l1).trans
      ((PresheafOfModules.DifferentialsConstruction.relativeDifferentials'_map_d
        (baseMap f) (homOfLE i).op b).trans
        ((l2 _).symm.trans (congrArg (compareMap f (i.trans h)) l3.symm)))

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.relative_frameMap_bijective
statement:
theorem relative_frameMap_bijective {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (h : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V₀)
    {I : Type u}
    (b : letI := (f.appLE V₀ U h).hom.toAlgebra; Module.Basis I Γ(X, U) Ω[Γ(X, U)⁄Γ(S, V₀)])
    (g : Γ(X, U)) :
    Function.Bijective (frameMap (relativePresheaf f) (fun i ↦ compareMap f h (b i))
      (X.basicOpen g) (X.basicOpen_le g))
proof:
:= by
  letI := (f.appLE V₀ U h).hom.toAlgebra
  have hg : X.basicOpen g ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V₀ := (X.basicOpen_le g).trans h
  letI := (f.appLE V₀ (X.basicOpen g) hg).hom.toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(S, V₀) Γ(X, U) Γ(X, X.basicOpen g) := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
    change (f.appLE V₀ (X.basicOpen g) _).hom =
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le g)).op).hom.comp (f.appLE V₀ U h).hom
    rw [← CommRingCat.hom_comp, Scheme.Hom.appLE_map])
  haveI := hU.isLocalization_basicOpen g
  let b' : Module.Basis I Γ(X, X.basicOpen g) Ω[Γ(X, X.basicOpen g)⁄Γ(S, V₀)] :=
    b.ofIsLocalizedModule Γ(X, X.basicOpen g) (Submonoid.powers g)
      (KaehlerDifferential.map Γ(S, V₀) Γ(S, V₀) Γ(X, U) Γ(X, X.basicOpen g))
  have hfam : (fun i ↦ (relativePresheaf f).map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le g)).op
      (compareMap f h (b i))) = fun i ↦ compareMap f hg (b' i) := by
    funext i
    rw [Module.Basis.ofIsLocalizedModule_apply]
    exact relativePresheaf_map_compareMap f (X.basicOpen_le g) h (b i)
  have hfun : ⇑(frameMap (relativePresheaf f) (fun i ↦ compareMap f h (b i)) (X.basicOpen g)
      (X.basicOpen_le g)) =
      ⇑(compareMap f hg) ∘ ⇑(Finsupp.linearCombination Γ(X, X.basicOpen g) ⇑b') := by
    funext l
    rw [frameMap, hfam, Function.comp_apply, Finsupp.apply_linearCombination]
    rfl
  rw [hfun]
  refine (compareMap_bijective f hV₀ (hU.basicOpen g) hg).comp ?_
  rw [← Module.Basis.coe_repr_symm]
  exact b'.repr.symm.bijective

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.relativeSheaf_hasConstantRank
statement:
theorem relativeSheaf_hasConstantRank (n : ℕ) [hf : SmoothOfRelativeDimension n f] :
    HasConstantRank X (relativeSheaf f) n
proof:
:= by
  apply hasConstantRank_of_localFrames
  intro y
  obtain ⟨V₀, hV₀, U, hU, hyU, e, hsm⟩ :=
    SmoothOfRelativeDimension.exists_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension (n := n) (f := f) y
  letI := (f.appLE V₀ U e).hom.toAlgebra
  haveI : Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension n Γ(S, V₀) Γ(X, U) := hsm
  haveI : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨y, hyU⟩⟩
  haveI : Algebra.IsStandardSmooth Γ(S, V₀) Γ(X, U) :=
    Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.isStandardSmooth n
  have hrank := Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.rank_kaehlerDifferential
    (R := Γ(S, V₀)) (S := Γ(X, U)) n
  let b := (Module.finBasisOfFinrankEq _ _ (Module.finrank_eq_of_rank_eq hrank)).reindex
    (Equiv.ulift.{u}).symm
  exact ⟨U, hU, hyU, fun i ↦ compareMap f e (b i), relative_frameMap_bijective f hV₀ hU e b⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (n : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension n f] :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree X (relativeSheaf f)
proof:
:=
  (relativeSheaf_hasConstantRank f n).isFiniteLocallyFree

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.lift_generator_supp
statement:
theorem lift_generator_supp (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j] {n : ℕ}
    (g : DimRelationGenerator U n) :
    ∃ R : dimensionCycles X n, R ∈ dimRationalEquivalence X n ∧
      (∀ u, R.1 (j u) = g.cycle.1 u) ∧ ∀ x, R.1 x ≠ 0 → j (f17η g) ⤳ x
proof:
:= by
  have hU : DimensionCatenary U := dimensionCatenary_of_finiteType K
  have hX : DimensionCatenary X := dimensionCatenary_of_finiteType K
  have hid : PureRelDim (𝟙 U) 0 := pureRelDim_openImmersion K (𝟙 U)
  have hj : PureRelDim j 0 := pureRelDim_openImmersion K j
  by_cases hH : height (f17η g) = n + 1
  swap
  · refine ⟨0, zero_mem _, fun u ↦ ?_, fun x hx ↦ absurd rfl hx⟩
    have h0 := f17_pullback_zero_of_ne (f := 𝟙 U) (g := g) hU hid hH
    rw [flatPullback_id] at h0
    have h1 : g.cycle.1 u = 0 := by rw [h0]; rfl
    rw [h1]
    rfl
  set ξ0 : U := f17η g with hξ0def
  set η' : X := j ξ0 with hη'
  have hdim : ∀ w : pointClosureScheme η', coheight w = 1 →
      height (pointClosureι η' w) = n := by
    intro w hw
    have h1 := hX _ (pointClosureι η') w hw
    have h2 : height η' = n + 1 := by rw [hη', m6pb_height_openImmersion K j, hH]
    rw [f17_pc_generic, h2] at h1
    exact ENat_add_one_cancel h1
  let mkg : (f' : (pointClosureScheme η').functionField) → f' ≠ 0 → DimRelationGenerator X n :=
    fun f' hf' ↦ { Y := pointClosureScheme η', i := pointClosureι η', f := f', hf := hf',
                   dimension := hdim }
  have hξ : j ξ0 = f17η (mkg 1 one_ne_zero) := (f17_pc_generic η').symm
  have hid0 : (𝟙 U : U ⟶ U) ξ0 = f17η g := rfl
  set c := f17Φ (f := 𝟙 U) (g := g) hid0 g.f with hc
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := f17Φ_ne_zero hid0
  
  have hτ : Function.Surjective (f17τ₀ (f := j) ξ0) := by
    unfold f17τ₀
    have h1 := (pointClosureι ξ0).stalkMap_surjective (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme ξ0))
    have h2 := (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
      (j.stalkMap (pointClosureι ξ0 (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme ξ0))))).2
    intro b
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h1 b
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h2 x
    exact ⟨y, by rw [RingHom.comp_apply]; exact (congrArg _ hy).trans hx⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hτ c
  let f' : (pointClosureScheme η').functionField := f17σ₀ (f := j) (g := mkg 1 one_ne_zero) hξ a
  have hΦ : f17Φ (f := j) (g := mkg 1 one_ne_zero) hξ f' = c := by
    rw [f17Φ_σ₀]; exact ha
  have hf'0 : f' ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hc0
    rw [← hΦ, h, map_zero]
  let g' := mkg f' hf'0
  refine ⟨g'.cycle, AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨g', rfl⟩, fun u ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  swap
  · intro x hx
    have hx' : x ∈ (properPushforward g'.i (div g'.f)).support := hx
    rw [properPushforward, pushforward_support_closedImmersion g'.i (div g'.f) (fun _ ↦ ())
      (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl)] at hx'
    obtain ⟨y, -, rfl⟩ := hx'
    have h1 : η' ⤳ pointClosureι η' y := by
      rw [specializes_iff_mem_closure, ← range_pointClosureι]
      exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact h1
  have hHg' : height (f17η g') = n + 1 := by
    change height (pointClosureι η' (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme η'))) = _
    rw [f17_pc_generic, hη', m6pb_height_openImmersion K j, hH]
  have hξ' : j ξ0 = f17η g' := hξ
  have e1 := F6.pointwise_single (f := j) (g := g') hU hj hHg' ξ0 hξ'
    (by rw [flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion]; exact one_ne_zero)
    (fun ξ hξξ _ ↦ j.isOpenEmbedding.injective (hξξ.trans hξ'.symm)) u
  have e2 := F6.pointwise_single (f := 𝟙 U) (g := g) hU hid hH ξ0 hid0
    (by rw [flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion]; exact one_ne_zero)
    (fun ξ hξξ _ ↦ hξξ) u
  rw [flatPullback_id] at e2
  rw [flatPullback_apply, flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion j u,
    flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion j ξ0] at e1
  rw [flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion] at e2
  simp only [Nat.cast_one, one_mul, mul_one] at e1 e2
  rw [e1, e2]
  have : f17Φ (f := j) (g := g') hξ' g'.f = c := hΦ
  rw [this]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.range_affineSpaceMap
statement:
theorem range_affineSpaceMap {U V : Scheme.{u}} (J0 : V ⟶ U) :

proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.lineSpecIso_hom_comp

      linePi A
proof:
:= by

  ext a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.chartIncl_comm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.range_chartIncl
statement: theorem range_chartIncl : Set.range (chartIncl hU0) = lineProj U ⁻¹' (U0 : Set U)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.lineOver_lft
statement: theorem lineOver_lft : LocallyOfFiniteType ((Line U) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.line_core
statement: theorem line_core (n : ℕ) : FibreClosedPointCycle (lineProj U) n
proof:
:= by
  letI := lineOver K U
  haveI := lineOver_lft K U
  intro ξ v hv hcξ hfξ hξv hne
  obtain ⟨U0, hU0, hmem, -⟩ :=
    exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (x := lineProj U v) (U := ⊤) (by simp)
  set j' := chartIncl hU0 with hj'
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(U, U0) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨U0, hU0⟩
  have hrange := range_chartIncl hU0
  have hvr : v ∈ Set.range j' := by rw [hrange]; exact hmem
  have hξr : ξ ∈ Set.range j' := by
    rw [hrange]
    change lineProj U ξ ∈ U0
    rw [hfξ]; exact hmem
  obtain ⟨v0, rfl⟩ := hvr
  obtain ⟨ξ0, rfl⟩ := hξr
  have hcomm := chartIncl_comm hU0
  have hfj : ∀ u, lineProj U (j' u) = hU0.fromSpec (linePi (Γ(U, U0)) u) := fun u ↦ by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hcomm, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  have hJinj : Function.Injective hU0.fromSpec := hU0.fromSpec.isOpenEmbedding.injective
  have hcoeff : ∀ u, flatPullbackCoeff (lineProj U) (j' u) =
      flatPullbackCoeff (linePi (Γ(U, U0))) u := by
    intro u
    have h1 := m6pb_coeff_comp j' (lineProj U) u
    rw [flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion j' u, mul_one, hcomm, m6pb_coeff_comp,
      flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion hU0.fromSpec, one_mul] at h1
    exact h1.symm
  have hπ : linePi (Γ(U, U0)) ξ0 = linePi (Γ(U, U0)) v0 :=
    hJinj (by rw [← hfj, ← hfj]; exact hfξ)
  have hξ0v0 : ξ0 ⤳ v0 := j'.isOpenEmbedding.isInducing.specializes_iff.mp hξv
  have hne0 : ξ0 ≠ v0 := fun h ↦ hne (by rw [h])
  have hcξ0 : flatPullbackCoeff (linePi (Γ(U, U0))) ξ0 ≠ 0 := by rwa [← hcoeff]
  have hv0 : height v0 = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [← m6pb_height_openImmersion K j' v0]; exact hv
  letI : (Spec (CommRingCat.of (Γ(U, U0))[X])).Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
    ⟨j' ≫ (Line U) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)⟩
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType ((Spec (CommRingCat.of (Γ(U, U0))[X])) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (j' ≫ (Line U) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
    infer_instance
  have hW : DimensionCatenary (Spec (CommRingCat.of (Γ(U, U0))[X])) :=
    dimensionCatenary_of_finiteType K
  obtain ⟨g, hgη, hht, hg1, hg2⟩ :=
    exists_closedPoint_generator hW ξ0 v0 hcξ0 hπ hξ0v0 hne0 hv0
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hRj, hRsupp⟩ := lift_generator_supp K j' g
  refine ⟨R.1, mem_relC.mpr ⟨R.2, hR⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hRj]; exact hg1
  · rw [hfj, m6pb_height_openImmersion K hU0.fromSpec]
    have h1 := pureRelDim_linePi ξ0 hcξ0
    rw [hht] at h1
    have h2 : height (linePi (Γ(U, U0)) ξ0) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
      push_cast at h1 ⊢
      exact ENat_add_one_cancel h1.symm
    rw [h2]
  · intro x hxv hx
    by_cases hxr : x ∈ Set.range j'
    · obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hxr
      rw [hRj] at hx
      have hu : u ≠ v0 := fun h ↦ hxv (by rw [h])
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hg2 u hu hx
      refine ⟨h1.map j'.continuous, fun h ↦ h2 (hJinj ?_)⟩
      rw [← hfj, ← hfj]; exact h
    · have h1 := hRsupp x hx
      rw [hgη] at h1
      refine ⟨h1, fun h ↦ hxr ?_⟩
      rw [hrange]
      change lineProj U x ∈ U0
      rw [h]; exact hmem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.line_pureRelDim
statement: theorem line_pureRelDim : PureRelDim (lineProj U) 1
proof:
:= by
  letI := lineOver K U
  haveI := lineOver_lft K U
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨U0, hU0, hmem, -⟩ :=
    exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (x := lineProj U x) (U := ⊤) (by simp)
  set j' := chartIncl hU0 with hj'
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(U, U0) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨U0, hU0⟩
  have hxr : x ∈ Set.range j' := by rw [range_chartIncl hU0]; exact hmem
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hxr
  have hcomm := chartIncl_comm hU0
  have hfj : lineProj U (j' u) = hU0.fromSpec (linePi (Γ(U, U0)) u) := by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hcomm, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  have hcoeff : flatPullbackCoeff (lineProj U) (j' u) =
      flatPullbackCoeff (linePi (Γ(U, U0))) u := by
    have h1 := m6pb_coeff_comp j' (lineProj U) u
    rw [flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion j' u, mul_one, hcomm, m6pb_coeff_comp,
      flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion hU0.fromSpec, one_mul] at h1
    exact h1.symm
  have h1 := pureRelDim_linePi u (by rwa [← hcoeff])
  rw [hfj, m6pb_height_openImmersion K j' u, m6pb_height_openImmersion K hU0.fromSpec]
  exact h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.line_generic_unique
statement: theorem line_generic_unique : FibreGenericUnique (lineProj U)
proof:
:= by
  intro ξ ξ' hf hc hc'
  obtain ⟨U0, hU0, hmem, -⟩ :=
    exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (x := lineProj U ξ) (U := ⊤) (by simp)
  set j' := chartIncl hU0 with hj'
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(U, U0) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨U0, hU0⟩
  have hrange := range_chartIncl hU0
  have hξr : ξ ∈ Set.range j' := by rw [hrange]; exact hmem
  have hξ'r : ξ' ∈ Set.range j' := by
    rw [hrange]
    change lineProj U ξ' ∈ U0
    rw [← hf]; exact hmem
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hξr
  obtain ⟨u', rfl⟩ := hξ'r
  have hcomm := chartIncl_comm hU0
  have hfj : ∀ u, lineProj U (j' u) = hU0.fromSpec (linePi (Γ(U, U0)) u) := fun u ↦ by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hcomm, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  have hJinj : Function.Injective hU0.fromSpec := hU0.fromSpec.isOpenEmbedding.injective
  have hcoeff : ∀ u, flatPullbackCoeff (lineProj U) (j' u) =
      flatPullbackCoeff (linePi (Γ(U, U0))) u := by
    intro u
    have h1 := m6pb_coeff_comp j' (lineProj U) u
    rw [flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion j' u, mul_one, hcomm, m6pb_coeff_comp,
      flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion hU0.fromSpec, one_mul] at h1
    exact h1.symm
  have hπ : linePi (Γ(U, U0)) u = linePi (Γ(U, U0)) u' :=
    hJinj (by rw [← hfj, ← hfj]; exact hf)
  have e1 := eq_extended_of_coeff_ne_zero u (by rwa [← hcoeff])
  have e2 := eq_extended_of_coeff_ne_zero u' (by rwa [← hcoeff])
  have : u = u' := by
    apply PrimeSpectrum.ext
    rw [e1, e2]
    have := congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal hπ
    change (PrimeSpectrum.comap (C : (Γ(U, U0)) →+* (Γ(U, U0))[X]) u).asIdeal =
      (PrimeSpectrum.comap (C : (Γ(U, U0)) →+* (Γ(U, U0))[X]) u').asIdeal at this
    rw [this]
  rw [this]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.flatPullbackRationalChow_line_surjective
statement:
theorem flatPullbackRationalChow_line_surjective [CompactSpace U] (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (flatPullbackRationalChow (lineProj U)
      (by letI := lineOver K U; haveI := lineOver_lft K U; exact dimensionCatenary_of_finiteType K)
      (line_pureRelDim K U) n)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : CompactSpace (Line U) := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace (lineProj U)
  exact flatPullbackRationalChow_surjective _ (line_pureRelDim K U) (line_generic_unique U)
    (line_core K U n)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.degreeZeroMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degreeZeroMap_apply (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (x : 𝒜 0) :
    degreeZeroMap f x = ⟨f x.1, f.map_mem x.2⟩
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map_toSpecZero
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem map_toSpecZero (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ)
    (hf : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map f) :
    map f hf ≫ toSpecZero 𝒜 =
      toSpecZero ℬ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (degreeZeroMap f))
proof:
:= by
  refine (mapAffineOpenCover f hf).openCover.hom_ext _ _ fun s ↦ ?_
  simp only [Scheme.AffineOpenCover.openCover_f, mapAffineOpenCover_f,
    awayι_comp_map_assoc f hf s.1.2 (s.2.1 : A) s.2.2]
  rw [awayι_toSpecZero, awayι_toSpecZero_assoc]
  rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  ext x
  simp [HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map,
    HomogeneousLocalization.map_mk, degreeZeroMap]

name: SchemeRelativeProj.AffineData.toBase_comp_openImmersion
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem toBase_comp_openImmersion : d.toBase ≫ U.1.ι = d.toAmbient
proof:
:=
