name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionAffineChart_scheme_square
statement:
theorem cosectionAffineChart_scheme_square :
    Spec.map (g.appLE U.1 V.1 h) ≫ U.2.fromSpec = V.2.fromSpec ≫ g
proof:
:=
  IsAffineOpen.SpecMap_appLE_fromSpec g U.2 V.2 h

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionAffineChartPullback_naturality
statement:
theorem cosectionAffineChartPullback_naturality {E F : X.Modules} (σ : E ⟶ F) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.2.fromSpec).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map σ) ≫
      ((cosectionAffineChartPullbackNatIso g U V h).app F).hom =
    ((cosectionAffineChartPullbackNatIso g U V h).app E).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map (g.appLE U.1 V.1 h))).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.fromSpec).map σ)
proof:
:=
  (cosectionAffineChartPullbackNatIso g U V h).hom.naturality σ

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionAffinePulledSection_coefficient
statement:
theorem cosectionAffinePulledSection_coefficient (E : X.Modules)
    (σ : E ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) (x : Γ(E,U.1)) :
    (pulledCosection g σ).app V.1 (cosectionAffinePulledSection g U V h E x) =
      g.appLE U.1 V.1 h (σ.app U.1 x)
proof:
:= by
  have hn := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply (pulledCosection g σ).val
    (homOfLE h).op (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app E).app U.1 x)
  change (pulledCosection g σ).app V.1 (cosectionAffinePulledSection g U V h E x) =
    Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op
      ((pulledCosection g σ).app (g ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app E).app U.1 x)) at hn
  rw [hn, pulledCosection_unit_app]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionAffineImage_map_le
statement:
theorem cosectionAffineImage_map_le (E : X.Modules)
    (σ : E ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) :
    (cosectionImageIdeal (affineCosection X E σ U)).map (g.appLE U.1 V.1 h).hom ≤
      cosectionImageIdeal (affineCosection Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
        (pulledCosection g σ) V)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr
  rintro a ⟨x,rfl⟩
  exact ⟨cosectionAffinePulledSection g U V h E x,
    cosectionAffinePulledSection_coefficient g U V h E σ x⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionAffineChart_preimage_eq
statement:
theorem cosectionAffineChart_preimage_eq (O : X.Opens) :
    (Spec.map (g.appLE U.1 V.1 h)) ⁻¹ᵁ (U.2.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ O) =
      V.2.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ O)
proof:
:= by
  change (Spec.map (g.appLE U.1 V.1 h) ≫ U.2.fromSpec) ⁻¹ᵁ O =
    (V.2.fromSpec ≫ g) ⁻¹ᵁ O
  rw [cosectionAffineChart_scheme_square]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionAffineChartPullback_app
statement:
theorem cosectionAffineChartPullback_app (E : X.Modules) :
    (cosectionAffineChartPullbackNatIso g U V h).app E =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback V.2.fromSpec).app
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp V.2.fromSpec g).app E ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (cosectionAffineChart_scheme_square g U V h).symm).app E ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (Spec.map (g.appLE U.1 V.1 h)) U.2.fromSpec).app E).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map (g.appLE U.1 V.1 h))).mapIso
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.2.fromSpec).app E).symm
proof:
:= by
  with_unfolding_all rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionAffineChartPullback_prefix_unit
statement:
theorem cosectionAffineChartPullback_prefix_unit (E : X.Modules) (O : X.Opens) (x : Γ(E,O)) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp V.2.fromSpec g).hom.app E).app
      (V.2.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ O))
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback V.2.fromSpec).hom.app
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)).app (V.2.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ O))
        (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction V.2.fromSpec).unit.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)).app (g ⁻¹ᵁ O)
          (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app E).app O x))) =
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (V.2.fromSpec ≫ g)).unit.app E).app O x
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := Chow.C1Cap.restrictFunctorIsoPullback_hom_restrict V.2.fromSpec
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E) (g ⁻¹ᵁ O)
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app E).app O x)
  have h2 := Chow.C1Cap.pullbackComp_hom_unit V.2.fromSpec g E O x
  have hp := congrArg (fun y => ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp V.2.fromSpec g).hom.app E).app
    (V.2.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ O)) y) h1
  exact hp.trans h2

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionAffineChartPullbackPrefixIso_unit
statement:
theorem cosectionAffineChartPullbackPrefixIso_unit (E : X.Modules) (O : X.Opens) (x : Γ(E,O)) :
    (cosectionAffineChartPullbackPrefixIso g V E).hom.app
      (V.2.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ O))
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction V.2.fromSpec).unit.app
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)).app (g ⁻¹ᵁ O)
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app E).app O x)) =
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (V.2.fromSpec ≫ g)).unit.app E).app O x
proof:
:= by
  have hp := cosectionAffineChartPullback_prefix_unit g V E O x
  with_unfolding_all exact hp

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionAffineChartPullbackTailIso_unit
statement:
theorem cosectionAffineChartPullbackTailIso_unit (E : X.Modules) (O : X.Opens) (x : Γ(E,O)) :
    (cosectionAffineChartPullbackTailIso g U V h E).hom.app
      ((Spec.map (g.appLE U.1 V.1 h)) ⁻¹ᵁ (U.2.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ O))
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
        (Spec.map (g.appLE U.1 V.1 h) ≫ U.2.fromSpec)).unit.app E).app O x) =
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Spec.map (g.appLE U.1 V.1 h))).unit.app
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.fromSpec).obj E)).app (U.2.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ O)
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction U.2.fromSpec).unit.app E).app O x)
proof:
:= by
  have h4 := Chow.C1Cap.pullbackComp_inv_unit (Spec.map (g.appLE U.1 V.1 h))
    U.2.fromSpec E O x
  have h5 := Chow.C1Cap.pullback_map_unit (Spec.map (g.appLE U.1 V.1 h))
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.2.fromSpec).inv.app E)
    (U.2.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ O)
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction U.2.fromSpec).unit.app E).app O x)
  have h6 := Chow.C1Cap.restrictFunctorIsoPullback_inv_unit U.2.fromSpec E O x
  have hp := congrArg (fun y =>
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map (g.appLE U.1 V.1 h))).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.2.fromSpec).inv.app E)).app
        ((Spec.map (g.appLE U.1 V.1 h)) ⁻¹ᵁ (U.2.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ O)) y) h4
  have hm := congrArg (fun y =>
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Spec.map (g.appLE U.1 V.1 h))).unit.app
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.fromSpec).obj E)).app (U.2.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ O) y) h6
  with_unfolding_all exact hp.trans (h5.trans hm)

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionAffineChartPullback_suffix_unit
statement:
theorem cosectionAffineChartPullback_suffix_unit (E : X.Modules) (O : X.Opens) (x : Γ(E,O)) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map (g.appLE U.1 V.1 h))).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.fromSpec).obj E)).presheaf.map
      (eqToHom (cosectionAffineChart_preimage_eq g U V h O)).op
      ((cosectionAffineChartPullbackTailIso g U V h E).hom.app
        (V.2.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ O))
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (cosectionAffineChart_scheme_square g U V h).symm).hom.app E).app
          (V.2.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ O))
          (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (V.2.fromSpec ≫ g)).unit.app E).app O x))) =
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Spec.map (g.appLE U.1 V.1 h))).unit.app
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.fromSpec).obj E)).app (U.2.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ O)
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction U.2.fromSpec).unit.app E).app O x)
proof:
:= by
  have ha := Chow.C1Cap.pullbackCongr_hom_unit
    (cosectionAffineChart_scheme_square g U V h).symm E O x
  have ht := cosectionAffineChartPullbackTailIso_unit g U V h E O x
  have hn := Chow.C1Cap.app_presheaf_map
    (cosectionAffineChartPullbackTailIso g U V h E).hom
    (eqToHom (cosectionAffineChart_preimage_eq g U V h O))
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (cosectionAffineChart_scheme_square g U V h).symm).hom.app E).app
      (V.2.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ O))
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (V.2.fromSpec ≫ g)).unit.app E).app O x))
  have hp := congrArg (fun y => (cosectionAffineChartPullbackTailIso g U V h E).hom.app
    ((Spec.map (g.appLE U.1 V.1 h)) ⁻¹ᵁ (U.2.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ O)) y) ha
  with_unfolding_all exact hn.symm.trans (hp.trans ht)

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionAffineChartPullback_factored
statement:
theorem cosectionAffineChartPullback_factored (E : X.Modules) :
    (cosectionAffineChartPullbackNatIso g U V h).app E =
      cosectionAffineChartPullbackPrefixIso g V E ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (cosectionAffineChart_scheme_square g U V h).symm).app E ≪≫
      cosectionAffineChartPullbackTailIso g U V h E
proof:
:= by
  rw [cosectionAffineChartPullback_app]
  simp only [cosectionAffineChartPullbackPrefixIso, cosectionAffineChartPullbackTailIso,
    Iso.trans_assoc]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionAffineChartPullback_unit
statement:
theorem cosectionAffineChartPullback_unit (E : X.Modules) (O : X.Opens) (x : Γ(E,O)) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map (g.appLE U.1 V.1 h))).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.fromSpec).obj E)).presheaf.map
      (eqToHom (cosectionAffineChart_preimage_eq g U V h O)).op
      (((cosectionAffineChartPullbackNatIso g U V h).app E).hom.app
        (V.2.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ O))
        (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction V.2.fromSpec).unit.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)).app (g ⁻¹ᵁ O)
          (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app E).app O x))) =
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Spec.map (g.appLE U.1 V.1 h))).unit.app
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.fromSpec).obj E)).app (U.2.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ O)
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction U.2.fromSpec).unit.app E).app O x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cosectionAffineChartPullback_factored]
  have hp := cosectionAffineChartPullbackPrefixIso_unit g V E O x
  have hs := cosectionAffineChartPullback_suffix_unit g U V h E O x
  have hm := congrArg (fun y =>
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map (g.appLE U.1 V.1 h))).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.fromSpec).obj E)).presheaf.map
      (eqToHom (cosectionAffineChart_preimage_eq g U V h O)).op
      ((cosectionAffineChartPullbackTailIso g U V h E).hom.app
        (V.2.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ O))
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (cosectionAffineChart_scheme_square g U V h).symm).hom.app E).app
          (V.2.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ O)) y))) hp
  with_unfolding_all exact hm.trans hs

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionAffinePulledSection_smul
statement:
theorem cosectionAffinePulledSection_smul (E : X.Modules) (r : Γ(X,U.1)) (x : Γ(E,U.1)) :
    cosectionAffinePulledSection g U V h E (r • x) =
      g.appLE U.1 V.1 h r • cosectionAffinePulledSection g U V h E x
proof:
:= by
  have hu := Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app E) r x
  with_unfolding_all
    change (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app E).app U.1 (r • x)) =
      g.app U.1 r • (show Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E,g ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) from
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app E).app U.1 x)) at hu
  have hm := ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).map_smul (homOfLE h) (g.app U.1 r)
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app E).app U.1 x)
  change ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app E).app U.1 (r • x)) = _
  rw [hu]
  exact hm

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionAffineNativeTensorMap_one_tmul
statement:
theorem cosectionAffineNativeTensorMap_one_tmul (E : X.Modules) (x : Γ(E,U.1)) :
    cosectionAffineNativeTensorMap g U V h E ((1 : Γ(Y,V.1)) ⊗ₜ[Γ(X,U.1)] x) =
      cosectionAffinePulledSection g U V h E x
proof:
:= by
  change cosectionAffineNativeTensorMap g U V h E ((1 : Γ(Y,V.1)) ⊗ₜ[Γ(X,U.1)] x) =
    cosectionAffineNativeSectionMap g U V h E x
  erw [← ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj_homEquiv_apply]
  exact congrArg (fun f => f x)
    (((ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj (g.appLE U.1 V.1 h).hom).homEquiv _ _).apply_symm_apply
      (cosectionAffineNativeSectionMap g U V h E))

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionAffineNativeTensorMap_coefficient
statement:
theorem cosectionAffineNativeTensorMap_coefficient (E : X.Modules)
    (σ : E ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) (x : Γ(E,U.1)) :
    affineCosection Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E) (pulledCosection g σ) V
      (cosectionAffineNativeTensorMap g U V h E ((1 : Γ(Y,V.1)) ⊗ₜ[Γ(X,U.1)] x)) =
    g.appLE U.1 V.1 h (affineCosection X E σ U x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cosectionAffineNativeTensorMap_one_tmul]
  exact cosectionAffinePulledSection_coefficient g U V h E σ x

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionAffineNativeTensorMap_tmul
statement:
theorem cosectionAffineNativeTensorMap_tmul (E : X.Modules) (a : Γ(Y,V.1)) (x : Γ(E,U.1)) :
    cosectionAffineNativeTensorMap g U V h E (a ⊗ₜ[Γ(X,U.1)] x) =
      a • cosectionAffinePulledSection g U V h E x
proof:
:= by
  let M := ModuleCat.of Γ(X,U.1) Γ(E,U.1)
  let F := ModuleCat.extendScalars (g.appLE U.1 V.1 h).hom
  letI : Module Γ(Y,V.1) (F.obj M) := (F.obj M).isModule
  have hs := ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.smul_tmul (g.appLE U.1 V.1 h).hom (M := M) a 1 x
  simp only [mul_one] at hs
  have hm := congrArg (cosectionAffineNativeTensorMap g U V h E) hs.symm
  have hl := (cosectionAffineNativeTensorMap g U V h E).hom.map_smul a
    ((1 : Γ(Y,V.1)) ⊗ₜ[Γ(X,U.1)] x)
  have hg := cosectionAffineNativeTensorMap_one_tmul g U V h E x
  have hc := congrArg (fun y : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E,V.1) => a • y) hg
  with_unfolding_all exact hm.trans (hl.trans hc)

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionAffineNativeTensorMap_tmul_coefficient
statement:
theorem cosectionAffineNativeTensorMap_tmul_coefficient (E : X.Modules)
    (σ : E ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) (a : Γ(Y,V.1)) (x : Γ(E,U.1)) :
    affineCosection Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E) (pulledCosection g σ) V
      (cosectionAffineNativeTensorMap g U V h E (a ⊗ₜ[Γ(X,U.1)] x)) =
    a * g.appLE U.1 V.1 h (affineCosection X E σ U x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cosectionAffineNativeTensorMap_tmul]
  have hs := (affineCosection Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
    (pulledCosection g σ) V).map_smul a (cosectionAffinePulledSection g U V h E x)
  have hc := cosectionAffinePulledSection_coefficient g U V h E σ x
  have hp := congrArg (fun y => a * y) hc
  with_unfolding_all exact hs.trans hp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.chartι_transportSchemeIso_hom
statement:
theorem chartι_transportSchemeIso_hom (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (i : C'.I) :
    (transport e C').chartι i ≫ (transportSchemeIso e C').hom =
      (chartIso e C' i).hom ≫ C'.chartι i
proof:
:=
  chartι_transportSchemeHom e C' i

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistChartRestrictionIndependence_iff_overlapEquality
statement:
theorem transportTwistChartRestrictionIndependence_iff_overlapEquality
    (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') :
    TransportTwistChartRestrictionIndependence e C' ↔
      TransportTwistChartOverlapEquality e C'
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h i j
    exact h i j inf_le_left inf_le_right
  · intro h i j V hVi hVj
    have hV : V ≤ ((transport e C').chartι i).opensRange ⊓
        ((transport e C').chartι j).opensRange := le_inf hVi hVj
    have ht := congrArg
      (fun a => Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (transport e C').scheme hV a) (h i j)
    simpa only [Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_trans] using ht

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistChartCompatibility_of_restrictionIndependence
statement:
theorem transportTwistChartCompatibility_of_restrictionIndependence
    (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    (h : TransportTwistChartRestrictionIndependence e C') :
    TransportTwistChartCompatibility e C'
proof:
:= by
  intro V i j f g
  have hVi : V ≤ ((transport e C').chartι i).opensRange := f.le
  have hVj : V ≤ ((transport e C').chartι j).opensRange := g.le
  rw [show f = homOfLE hVi from Subsingleton.elim _ _,
    show g = homOfLE hVj from Subsingleton.elim _ _,
    Scheme.Modules.sheafHom_map_localHomSection,
    Scheme.Modules.sheafHom_map_localHomSection]
  exact congrArg
    (fun a => (SheafOfModules.toSheaf ((transport e C').scheme.ringCatSheaf.over V)).map a)
    (h i j hVi hVj)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistHom_over
statement:
theorem transportTwistHom_over (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (h : TransportTwistChartCompatibility e C')
    (i : C'.I) :
    (transportTwistHom e C' h).over ((transport e C').chartι i).opensRange =
      (transportTwistChartOverIso e C' i).hom
proof:
:=
  Scheme.Modules.glueHom_over (transport e C').scheme
    (fun j : C'.I => ((transport e C').chartι j).opensRange)
    (transport e C').chartOpens_coversTop
    (fun j => (transportTwistChartOverIso e C' j).hom) h i

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistHom_isIso
statement:
theorem transportTwistHom_isIso (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (h : TransportTwistChartCompatibility e C') :
    IsIso (transportTwistHom e C' h)
proof:
:=
  Scheme.Modules.glueHom_isIso (transport e C').scheme
    (fun i : C'.I => ((transport e C').chartι i).opensRange)
    (transport e C').chartOpens_coversTop
    (fun i => (transportTwistChartOverIso e C' i).hom) h (fun _ => inferInstance)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistCompat_of_chartCompatibility
statement:
theorem transportTwistCompat_of_chartCompatibility (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (h : TransportTwistChartCompatibility e C') :
    TransportTwistCompat e C'
proof:
:=
  ⟨transportTwistIsoOfChartCompatibility e C' h⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistCompat_of_restrictionIndependence
statement:
theorem transportTwistCompat_of_restrictionIndependence (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    (h : TransportTwistChartRestrictionIndependence e C') :
    TransportTwistCompat e C'
proof:
:=
  transportTwistCompat_of_chartCompatibility e C'
    (transportTwistChartCompatibility_of_restrictionIndependence e C' h)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistCompat_of_chartOverlapEquality
statement:
theorem transportTwistCompat_of_chartOverlapEquality (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (h : TransportTwistChartOverlapEquality e C') :
    TransportTwistCompat e C'
proof:
:=
  transportTwistCompat_of_restrictionIndependence e C'
    ((transportTwistChartRestrictionIndependence_iff_overlapEquality e C').2 h)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.TwistData.sec_natural
statement:
theorem sec_natural (i : C₀.I) {V V' : X.Opens} (hV : V ≤ C₀.U i) (hV' : V' ≤ V)
    (s : E₁.val.obj (op V)) :
    T.sec i V' (hV'.trans hV) (E₁.val.map (homOfLE hV').op s) =
      E₀.val.map (homOfLE hV').op (T.sec i V hV s)
proof:
:= by
  change ((T.e i).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE (hV'.trans hV)))))
      (E₁.val.map (homOfLE hV').op s) =
    E₀.val.map (homOfLE hV').op (((T.e i).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV)))) s)
  exact (PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply (T.e i).hom.val
    (X := op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV))) (Y := op (Over.mk (homOfLE (hV'.trans hV))))
    (Quiver.Hom.op (Over.homMk (homOfLE hV'))) s)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.TwistData.chartIso_hom_toBase
statement:
theorem chartIso_hom_toBase (i : C₀.I) :
    (T.chartIso i).hom ≫ C₀.chartToBase i = T.cover.chartToBase i
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C₀.U i) (E₀.val.obj (op (C₀.U i))) := C₀.sectionModule_free i
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C₀.U i) (E₀.val.obj (op (C₀.U i))) := C₀.sectionModule_finite i
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C₀.U i) (E₁.val.obj (op (C₀.U i))) := T.cover.sectionModule_free i
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C₀.U i) (E₁.val.obj (op (C₀.U i))) := T.cover.sectionModule_finite i
  change (chartIsoOfLinearEquiv (T.sec i (C₀.U i) le_rfl)).hom ≫
    intrinsicToSpec (R := Γ(X, C₀.U i))
      (M := E₀.val.obj (op (C₀.U i))) ≫ (C₀.isAffine i).isoSpec.inv =
    intrinsicToSpec (R := Γ(X, C₀.U i))
      (M := E₁.val.obj (op (C₀.U i))) ≫ (C₀.isAffine i).isoSpec.inv
  rw [← Category.assoc, chartIsoOfLinearEquiv_toSpec]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.TwistData.chartIso_hom_toAmbient
statement:
theorem chartIso_hom_toAmbient (i : C₀.I) :
    (T.chartIso i).hom ≫ C₀.chartToAmbient i = T.cover.chartToAmbient i
proof:
:= by
  change (T.chartIso i).hom ≫ (C₀.chartToBase i ≫ (C₀.U i).ι) =
    T.cover.chartToBase i ≫ (C₀.U i).ι
  rw [← Category.assoc, chartIso_hom_toBase]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.TwistData.commonChartIsoR_eq
statement:
theorem commonChartIsoR_eq (c : C₀.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    T.commonChartIsoR c = T.commonChartIso c
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E₀.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    c.sectionModule_free
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E₀.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    c.sectionModule_finite
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E₁.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    (c.twist T).sectionModule_free
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E₁.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    (c.twist T).sectionModule_finite
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := T.unit i j c.affineOpen.1 c.affineOpen_le_left c.affineOpen_le_right
  exact AlgebraicGeometry.D34.chartIsoOfLinearEquiv_eq_of_smul _ _ u hu

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.TwistData.commonChartIso_hom_toBase
statement:
theorem commonChartIso_hom_toBase (c : C₀.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (T.commonChartIso c).hom ≫ c.chartToBase = (c.twist T).chartToBase
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E₀.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    c.sectionModule_free
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E₀.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    c.sectionModule_finite
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E₁.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    (c.twist T).sectionModule_free
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E₁.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    (c.twist T).sectionModule_finite
  change (chartIsoOfLinearEquiv (T.sec i c.affineOpen.1 c.affineOpen_le_left)).hom ≫
    intrinsicToSpec (R := Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1))
      (M := E₀.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) ≫ c.affineOpen.2.isoSpec.inv =
    intrinsicToSpec (R := Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1))
      (M := E₁.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) ≫ c.affineOpen.2.isoSpec.inv
  rw [← Category.assoc, chartIsoOfLinearEquiv_toSpec]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.TwistData.commonChartIso_hom_toAmbient
statement:
theorem commonChartIso_hom_toAmbient (c : C₀.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (T.commonChartIso c).hom ≫ c.chartToAmbient = (c.twist T).chartToAmbient
proof:
:= by
  change (T.commonChartIso c).hom ≫ (c.chartToBase ≫ c.affineOpen.1.ι) =
    (c.twist T).chartToBase ≫ c.affineOpen.1.ι
  rw [← Category.assoc, commonChartIso_hom_toBase]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.TwistData.sec_leftRestriction
statement:
theorem sec_leftRestriction (c : C₀.CommonBasicOpen i j) (s : E₁.val.obj (op (C₀.U i))) :
    T.sec i c.affineOpen.1 c.affineOpen_le_left ((c.twist T).leftRestriction s) =
      c.leftRestriction (T.sec i (C₀.U i) le_rfl s)
proof:
:=
  T.sec_natural i le_rfl c.affineOpen_le_left s

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.TwistData.sec_rightRestriction
statement:
theorem sec_rightRestriction (c : C₀.CommonBasicOpen i j) (s : E₁.val.obj (op (C₀.U j))) :
    T.sec j c.affineOpen.1 c.affineOpen_le_right ((c.twist T).rightRestriction s) =
      c.rightRestriction (T.sec j (C₀.U j) le_rfl s)
proof:
:=
  T.sec_natural j le_rfl c.affineOpen_le_right s

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.TwistData.chartIso_leftRestriction
statement:
theorem chartIso_leftRestriction (c : C₀.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (c.twist T).chartToLeft ≫ (T.chartIso i).hom =
      (T.commonChartIso c).hom ≫ c.chartToLeft
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C₀.U i) (E₀.val.obj (op (C₀.U i))) := C₀.sectionModule_free i
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C₀.U i) (E₀.val.obj (op (C₀.U i))) := C₀.sectionModule_finite i
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C₀.U i) (E₁.val.obj (op (C₀.U i))) := T.cover.sectionModule_free i
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C₀.U i) (E₁.val.obj (op (C₀.U i))) := T.cover.sectionModule_finite i
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E₀.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    c.sectionModule_free
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E₀.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    c.sectionModule_finite
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E₁.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    (c.twist T).sectionModule_free
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E₁.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    (c.twist T).sectionModule_finite
  let f := (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_left).op).hom
  let φ : E₁.val.obj (op (C₀.U i)) →ₛₗ[f]
      E₁.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1) := (c.twist T).leftRestriction
  let φ' : E₀.val.obj (op (C₀.U i)) →ₛₗ[f]
      E₀.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1) := c.leftRestriction
  let eM := T.sec i (C₀.U i) le_rfl
  let eN := T.sec i c.affineOpen.1 c.affineOpen_le_left
  have hcomm : ∀ m : E₀.val.obj (op (C₀.U i)),
      φ (eM.symm m) = eN.symm (φ' m) := by
    intro m
    apply eN.injective
    change T.sec i c.affineOpen.1 c.affineOpen_le_left
        ((c.twist T).leftRestriction (eM.symm m)) =
      T.sec i c.affineOpen.1 c.affineOpen_le_left
        (eN.symm (c.leftRestriction m))
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    have h0 := T.sec_leftRestriction c (eM.symm m)
    rw [show T.sec i (C₀.U i) le_rfl (eM.symm m) = m from eM.apply_symm_apply m] at h0
    exact h0
  have h := semilinearProjMap_iso_square_auto f φ φ' eM eN
    (show Submodule.span Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (Set.range φ) = ⊤ from
      (c.twist T).leftRestriction_spans)
    (show Submodule.span Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (Set.range φ') = ⊤ from
      c.leftRestriction_spans) hcomm
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.TwistData.chartIso_rightRestriction
statement:
theorem chartIso_rightRestriction (c : C₀.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (c.twist T).chartToRight ≫ (T.chartIso j).hom =
      (T.commonChartIso c).hom ≫ c.chartToRight
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C₀.U j) (E₀.val.obj (op (C₀.U j))) := C₀.sectionModule_free j
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C₀.U j) (E₀.val.obj (op (C₀.U j))) := C₀.sectionModule_finite j
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C₀.U j) (E₁.val.obj (op (C₀.U j))) := T.cover.sectionModule_free j
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C₀.U j) (E₁.val.obj (op (C₀.U j))) := T.cover.sectionModule_finite j
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E₀.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    c.sectionModule_free
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E₀.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    c.sectionModule_finite
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E₁.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    (c.twist T).sectionModule_free
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E₁.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    (c.twist T).sectionModule_finite
  let f := (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_right).op).hom
  let φ : E₁.val.obj (op (C₀.U j)) →ₛₗ[f]
      E₁.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1) := (c.twist T).rightRestriction
  let φ' : E₀.val.obj (op (C₀.U j)) →ₛₗ[f]
      E₀.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1) := c.rightRestriction
  let eM := T.sec j (C₀.U j) le_rfl
  let eN := T.sec j c.affineOpen.1 c.affineOpen_le_right
  have hcomm : ∀ m : E₀.val.obj (op (C₀.U j)),
      φ (eM.symm m) = eN.symm (φ' m) := by
    intro m
    apply eN.injective
    change T.sec j c.affineOpen.1 c.affineOpen_le_right
        ((c.twist T).rightRestriction (eM.symm m)) =
      T.sec j c.affineOpen.1 c.affineOpen_le_right
        (eN.symm (c.rightRestriction m))
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    have h0 := T.sec_rightRestriction c (eM.symm m)
    rw [show T.sec j (C₀.U j) le_rfl (eM.symm m) = m from eM.apply_symm_apply m] at h0
    exact h0
  have h := semilinearProjMap_iso_square_auto f φ φ' eM eN
    (show Submodule.span Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (Set.range φ) = ⊤ from
      (c.twist T).rightRestriction_spans)
    (show Submodule.span Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (Set.range φ') = ⊤ from
      c.rightRestriction_spans) hcomm
  rw [← T.commonChartIsoR_eq c]
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.TwistData.overlapIso_hom_toChart
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem overlapIso_hom_toChart (i j : C₀.I) :

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.TwistData.overlapIso_hom_toIntersection

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.TwistData.baseCover_twist_f
statement:
theorem baseCover_twist_f {i j : C₀.I} (c : C₀.CommonBasicOpen i j) :

proof: := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.TwistData.componentIso_hom_toOverlap
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem componentIso_hom_toOverlap {i j : C₀.I} (c : C₀.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (T.componentIso c).hom ≫ (C₀.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c =
      (T.cover.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f (c.twist T) ≫ (T.overlapIso i j).hom
proof:

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.TwistData.componentIso_hom_toCommonBase
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem componentIso_hom_toCommonBase {i j : C₀.I} (c : C₀.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (T.componentIso c).hom ≫
        (CommonBasicOpen.baseCover C₀ i j).pullbackHom
          (C₀.overlapToIntersection i j) c =
      (CommonBasicOpen.baseCover T.cover i j).pullbackHom
        (T.cover.overlapToIntersection i j) (c.twist T)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.TwistData.componentIso_commonChartIso
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem componentIso_commonChartIso {i j : C₀.I} (c : C₀.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (T.componentIso c).hom ≫ (C₀.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j c).hom =
      (T.cover.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j (c.twist T)).hom ≫ (T.commonChartIso c).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono c.chartToLeft).1
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [C₀.commonBasicOpenChartIso_hom_chartToLeft]
  rw [componentIso_hom_toOverlap_assoc]
  rw [overlapIso_hom_toChart]
  simp only [← Category.assoc]
  rw [← T.cover.commonBasicOpenChartIso_hom_chartToLeft_assoc]
  rw [chartIso_leftRestriction]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.TwistData.componentIso_localTransition
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem componentIso_localTransition {i j : C₀.I} (c : C₀.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (T.componentIso c).hom ≫ C₀.localTransition i j c =
      T.cover.localTransition i j (c.twist T) ≫ (T.overlapIso j i).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (C₀.overlapToChart j i)).1
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [C₀.localTransition_toChart]
  rw [componentIso_commonChartIso_assoc]
  rw [← chartIso_rightRestriction]
  simp only [← Category.assoc]
  rw [← T.cover.localTransition_toChart]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← overlapIso_hom_toChart]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.TwistData.twist_untwist
statement:
theorem twist_untwist {i j : C₀.I} (d : T.cover.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (T.untwist d).twist T = d
proof:
:= by
  cases d
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.TwistData.overlapIso_transition
statement:
theorem overlapIso_transition (i j : C₀.I) :
    (T.overlapIso i j).hom ≫ C₀.transition i j =
      T.cover.transition i j ≫ (T.overlapIso j i).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.Cover.hom_ext (T.cover.basicOpenOverlapCover i j)
  intro d
  let c := T.untwist d
  have hd : c.twist T = d := T.twist_untwist d
  rw [← hd]
  rw [← componentIso_hom_toOverlap_assoc]
  rw [C₀.basicOpenOverlapCover_transition]
  rw [componentIso_localTransition]
  rw [← T.cover.basicOpenOverlapCover_transition]
  exact Category.assoc _ _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.TwistData.chartι_schemeHom
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem chartι_schemeHom (i : C₀.I) :
    T.cover.chartι i ≫ T.schemeHom = (T.chartIso i).hom ≫ C₀.chartι i
proof:
:=
  Multicoequalizer.π_desc _ _ _ _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.TwistData.overlapIso_inv_toChart
statement:
theorem overlapIso_inv_toChart (i j : C₀.I) :
    (T.overlapIso i j).inv ≫ T.cover.overlapToChart i j =
      C₀.overlapToChart i j ≫ (T.chartIso i).inv
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (T.chartIso i).hom).1
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  calc
    (T.overlapIso i j).inv ≫ T.cover.overlapToChart i j ≫
        (T.chartIso i).hom =
      (T.overlapIso i j).inv ≫
        ((T.overlapIso i j).hom ≫ C₀.overlapToChart i j) := by
          simpa only [Category.assoc] using
            congrArg (fun f ↦ (T.overlapIso i j).inv ≫ f)
              (T.overlapIso_hom_toChart i j).symm
    _ = C₀.overlapToChart i j := by
      rw [← Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.id_comp]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.TwistData.overlapIso_inv_transition
statement:
theorem overlapIso_inv_transition (i j : C₀.I) :
    (T.overlapIso i j).inv ≫ T.cover.transition i j =
      C₀.transition i j ≫ (T.overlapIso j i).inv
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (T.overlapIso j i).hom).1
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  calc
    (T.overlapIso i j).inv ≫
        (T.cover.transition i j ≫ (T.overlapIso j i).hom) =
      (T.overlapIso i j).inv ≫
        ((T.overlapIso i j).hom ≫ C₀.transition i j) := by
          rw [T.overlapIso_transition]
    _ = C₀.transition i j := by simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.TwistData.chartι_schemeInv
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem chartι_schemeInv (i : C₀.I) :
    C₀.chartι i ≫ T.schemeInv = (T.chartIso i).inv ≫ T.cover.chartι i
proof:
:=
  Multicoequalizer.π_desc _ _ _ _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.TwistData.schemeIso_toBase
statement:
theorem schemeIso_toBase :
    T.schemeIso.hom ≫ C₀.toBase = T.cover.toBase
proof:
:= by
  apply Multicoequalizer.hom_ext _ _ _
  intro i
  change C₀.I at i
  change T.cover.chartι i ≫ (T.schemeHom ≫ C₀.toBase) =
    T.cover.chartι i ≫ T.cover.toBase
  calc
    _ = (T.chartIso i).hom ≫ (C₀.chartι i ≫ C₀.toBase) := by
          simpa only [Category.assoc] using
            congrArg (fun f ↦ f ≫ C₀.toBase)
              (T.chartι_schemeHom i)
    _ = (T.chartIso i).hom ≫ C₀.chartToAmbient i := by
          exact congrArg (fun f ↦ (T.chartIso i).hom ≫ f)
            (C₀.chartι_toBase i)
    _ = T.cover.chartToAmbient i := T.chartIso_hom_toAmbient i
    _ = _ := (T.cover.chartι_toBase i).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.range_infPoint_disjoint_chart_one
statement:
theorem range_infPoint_disjoint_chart_one :
    Disjoint (Set.range (infPoint k)) (Set.range (chart k 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  rintro _ ⟨p, rfl⟩ ⟨q, hq⟩
  have hmem : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : k)))) p ∈
      chart k 0 ⁻¹ᵁ (chart k 1).opensRange := by
    change (chart k 0) _ ∈ (chart k 1).opensRange
    exact ⟨q, hq⟩
  rw [chart_zero_preimage] at hmem
  apply hmem
  change (Polynomial.X : Polynomial k) ∈ Ideal.comap (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : k)) p.asIdeal
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.not_mem_infIdeal_support
statement:
theorem not_mem_infIdeal_support {z : P1 k} (hz : z ∈ Set.range (chart k 1)) :
    z ∉ (infIdeal k).support
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hs : ((infIdeal k).support : Set (P1 k)) = closure (Set.range (infPoint k)) :=
    Scheme.Hom.support_ker (infPoint k)
  have hopen : IsOpen (Set.range (chart k 1)) := (chart k 1).isOpenEmbedding.isOpen_range
  have h1 : z ∈ closure (Set.range (infPoint k)) := by rw [← hs]; exact h
  have h2 := hopen.inter_closure (s := Set.range (chart k 1)) (t := Set.range (infPoint k))
    ⟨hz, h1⟩
  rw [(range_infPoint_disjoint_chart_one k).symm.inter_eq, closure_empty] at h2
  exact h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.infCentre_ne_bot
statement:
theorem infCentre_ne_bot [Nonempty A] (J : A.IdealSheafData) :
    infCentre (k := k) J ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hle : (infIdeal k).comap (pullback.snd (A ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)) ≤ ⊥ := by
    rw [← h]; exact le_sup_right
  obtain ⟨a⟩ : Nonempty A := inferInstance
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x : Spec (CommRingCat.of (Polynomial k)),
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.C : k →+* Polynomial k))) x = (A ↘ Spk k) a :=
    Polynomial.comap_C_surjective (R := k) ((A ↘ Spk k) a)
  obtain ⟨b, -, hb⟩ := Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback (f := A ↘ Spk k)
    (g := toSpec k 1) a (chart k 1 x) (by
      have e : toSpec k 1 (chart k 1 x) =
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.C : k →+* Polynomial k))) x := by
        rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, chart_toSpec]
      exact hx.symm.trans e.symm)
  have h1 : (⊥ : (prodP1 (k := k) A).IdealSheafData).support ≤
      ((infIdeal k).comap (pullback.snd (A ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1))).support :=
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_antitone hle
  have hb' : b ∈ ((infIdeal k).comap (pullback.snd (A ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1))).support :=
    h1 (by rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_bot]; trivial)
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_comap] at hb'
  exact not_mem_infIdeal_support k ⟨x, rfl⟩ (hb ▸ hb')

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.prodP1_lft
statement:
theorem prodP1_lft [LocallyOfFiniteType (A ↘ Spk k)] :
    letI
proof:
:= prodP1Over (k := k) (A := A)
    LocallyOfFiniteType ((prodP1 (k := k) A) ↘ Spk k) := by
  letI := prodP1Over (k := k) (A := A)
  change LocallyOfFiniteType (pullback.fst (A ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ≫ A ↘ Spk k)
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (toSpec k 1) := inferInstance
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.prodP1_isNoetherian
statement:
theorem prodP1_isNoetherian [LocallyOfFiniteType (A ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian A] :
    IsNoetherian (prodP1 (k := k) A)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsProper (pullback.fst (A ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)) := inferInstance
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (pullback.fst (A ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)) := inferInstance
  exact
    { __ := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (pullback.fst (A ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1))
      __ := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace (pullback.fst (A ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)) }

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.projectiveIntegralK_blowup_centre
statement:
theorem projectiveIntegralK_blowup_centre [Nonempty A] [LocallyOfFiniteType (A ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian A] (hA : ProjectiveIntegralK k A) (J : A.IdealSheafData) :
    letI
proof:
:= prodP1Over (k := k) (A := A)
    letI := blowupOver (k := k) (infCentre (k := k) J)
    haveI := prodP1_lft (k := k) (A := A)
    haveI := prodP1_isNoetherian (k := k) (A := A)
    haveI := blowup_locallyOfFiniteType
      (projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod hA 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
      (infCentre (k := k) J) (infCentre_ne_bot J)
    haveI := blowup_isNoetherian
      (projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod hA 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
      (infCentre (k := k) J) (infCentre_ne_bot J)
    ProjectiveIntegralK k
      (GlobalBlowup.blowup (prodP1 (k := k) A) (infCentre (k := k) J)) :=
  letI := prodP1Over (k := k) (A := A)
  haveI := prodP1_lft (k := k) (A := A)
  haveI := prodP1_isNoetherian (k := k) (A := A)
  projectiveIntegralK_blowup_prod hA 1 (Y := prodP1 (k := k) A) (Iso.refl _)
    (Category.id_comp _) (infCentre (k := k) J) (infCentre_ne_bot J)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.a11Psi_add
statement:
theorem a11Psi_add (n n' : Γ(tautQuotient_N C, C.U i)) :
    a11Psi C i (n + n') = a11Psi C i n + a11Psi C i n'
proof:
:= by
  unfold a11Psi
  erw [map_add, map_add]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.a11Psi_t
statement:
theorem a11Psi_t (k : C.basisIndex i) :
    a11Psi C i (tautQuotient_t C i k) = tautQuotient_chartTaut C i k
proof:
:= by
  unfold a11Psi tautQuotient_t tautQuotient_chartSection
  erw [← Functor.map_comp_apply, ← op_comp, eqToHom_trans, eqToHom_refl, op_id,
    Functor.map_id_apply]
  have := congrArg (fun f => Scheme.Modules.Hom.app f ⊤ (tautQuotient_chartTaut C i k))
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 i).inv_hom_id
  simpa only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.id_app, ConcreteCategory.id_apply] using this

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.a11Psi_smul
statement:
theorem a11Psi_smul (a : Γ(X, C.U i)) (n : Γ(tautQuotient_N C, C.U i)) :
    a11Psi C i (a • n) =
      (show Γ(C.chart i, ⊤) from tautChart_scal Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) a) •
        a11Psi C i n
proof:
:= by
  unfold a11Psi
  have h1 : a • n = (C.toBase.app (C.U i) a) • (show Γ(C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1,
      C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i) from n) := rfl
  rw [h1, Scheme.Modules.map_smul]
  have hr : C.scheme.presheaf.map (eqToHom (tautQuotient_chartι_image_top C i)).op
      (C.toBase.app (C.U i) a) =
      ((C.chartι i).appIso ⊤).inv (tautChart_scal Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) a) := by
    rw [← a11_scal_eq C i a]
    exact (Iso.hom_inv_id_apply _ _).symm
  rw [hr]
  erw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.a11Psi_alpha_term
statement:
theorem a11Psi_alpha_term (a : Γ(X, C.U i)) (l : C.basisIndex i) :
    a11Psi C i (C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.app (C.U i) (a • C.sectionBasis i l)) =
      (show Γ(C.chart i, ⊤) from tautChart_scal Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) a) •
        tautQuotient_chartTaut C i l
proof:
:= by
  erw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul]
  rw [a11Psi_smul, tautologicalPushforwardHom_app, a11Psi_t]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.a11Psi_alpha
statement:
theorem a11Psi_alpha (m : E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) :
    letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i)
proof:
:= C.basisIndex_finite i
    a11Psi C i (C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.app (C.U i) m) =
      (tautChart_tautHom Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i) m).app ⊤
        (1 : (space Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))).presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) := by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  let b := C.sectionBasis i
  have hm : m = (b.repr m).sum (fun l a => a • b l) := by
    rw [← Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, b.linearCombination_repr]
  let F : E.val.obj (op (C.U i)) →+ Γ(C.chartTwistingSheaf 1 i, ⊤) :=
    AddMonoidHom.mk' (fun m => a11Psi C i (C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.app (C.U i) m))
      (fun m m' => by
        have : C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.app (C.U i) (m + m') =
            C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.app (C.U i) m +
              C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.app (C.U i) m' :=
          map_add (C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.app (C.U i)).hom m m'
        rw [this, a11Psi_add])
  have h1 : F m = (b.repr m).sum (fun l a => F (a • b l)) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hm]
    exact map_finsuppSum F _ _
  change F m = _
  rw [h1]
  conv_rhs => rw [hm]
  rw [tautChart_tautHom_app_sum Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) b (b.repr m) b ⊤]
  refine Finsupp.sum_congr fun l _ => ?_
  have q : ∀ x : (space Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))).presheaf.obj (op ⊤),
      (space Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_top : (⊤ : (space Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))).Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op x
        = x := fun x => by
    rw [show (homOfLE (le_top : (⊤ : (space Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))).Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op
      = 𝟙 _ from Subsingleton.elim _ _, Functor.map_id_apply]
  refine (a11Psi_alpha_term C i _ l).trans ?_
  erw [q]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.a11Psi_zero
statement: theorem a11Psi_zero : a11Psi C i (0 : Γ(tautQuotient_N C, C.U i)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := a11Psi_add C i 0 0
  rw [add_zero] at this
  exact left_eq_add.mp this

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.a11_alpha_app_injective
statement:
theorem a11_alpha_app_injective (m : E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))
    (h : C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.app (C.U i) m = 0) : m = 0
proof:
:= by

  exact a11_tautHom_injective Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i) m h1.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.commonChartIso_preimage_basisChangeOpen
statement:
theorem commonChartIso_preimage_basisChangeOpen (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') {i j : C'.I}
    (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j) (a : C'.basisIndex i)
    (b : C'.basisIndex j)
    [Module.Free Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))]
    [Module.Finite Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))]
    [Module.Free Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))]
    [Module.Finite Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))] :
    (commonChartIso e C' c).hom ⁻¹ᵁ
      basisChangeOpen Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
        (E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))
        c.leftSectionBasis c.rightSectionBasis a b =
      basisChangeOpen Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
        (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))
        (c.transport e C').leftSectionBasis
        (c.transport e C').rightSectionBasis a b
proof:
:= by
  let f : E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1) →ₗ[Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)]
      E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1) :=
    (sectionLinearEquivOfIso e c.affineOpen.1).symm
  have hs : Submodule.span Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (Set.range f) = ⊤ := by
    have hf : Set.range f = Set.univ := Set.range_eq_univ.mpr
      (sectionLinearEquivOfIso e c.affineOpen.1).symm.surjective
    rw [hf, Submodule.span_univ]
  change symmetricProjMap f hs ⁻¹ᵁ
      linearOverlapOpen Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
        (E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))
        (c.leftSectionBasis a) (c.rightSectionBasis b) =
      linearOverlapOpen Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
        (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))
        ((c.transport e C').leftSectionBasis a)
        ((c.transport e C').rightSectionBasis b)
  rw [symmetricProjMap_preimage_linearOverlapOpen]
  have hL : f (c.leftSectionBasis a) =
      (c.transport e C').leftSectionBasis a := by
    change (sectionLinearEquivOfIso e c.affineOpen.1).symm
      (c.leftSectionBasis a) = (c.transport e C').leftSectionBasis a
    rw [← leftSectionBasis_transport e C' c a]
    exact LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply _ _
  have hR : f (c.rightSectionBasis b) =
      (c.transport e C').rightSectionBasis b := by
    change (sectionLinearEquivOfIso e c.affineOpen.1).symm
      (c.rightSectionBasis b) = (c.transport e C').rightSectionBasis b
    rw [← rightSectionBasis_transport e C' c b]
    exact LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply _ _
  rw [hL, hR]

statement:
theorem commonChartIso_transitionSectionUnit_heq (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') {i j : C'.I}

        (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) (-1)
        ((c.transport e C').leftSectionBasis a)

:= by
  let f : E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1) →ₗ[Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)]

    have hf : Set.range f = Set.univ := Set.range_eq_univ.mpr
      (sectionLinearEquivOfIso e c.affineOpen.1).symm.surjective
    rw [hf, Submodule.span_univ]
  have hL : f (c.leftSectionBasis a) =

      (c.rightSectionBasis b) = (c.transport e C').rightSectionBasis b
    rw [← rightSectionBasis_transport e C' c b]
    exact LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply _ _
  have h := symmetricProjMap_app_transitionSectionUnit_heq f hs (-1)

  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.commonChart_basisChange_restrict_naturality
statement:
theorem commonChart_basisChange_restrict_naturality (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') {i j : C'.I}
    (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    [Finite (C'.basisIndex i)] [Finite (C'.basisIndex j)]
    [Finite ((transport e C').basisIndex i)]
    [Finite ((transport e C').basisIndex j)]
    [Module.Free Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))]
    [Module.Finite Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))]
    [Module.Free Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))]
    [Module.Finite Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))] :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (commonChartIso e C' c).hom).map
        (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
          (E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))
          c.leftSectionBasis c.rightSectionBasis 1) ≫
      (commonChartRightTwistRestrictionData e C' c).restrictIso.hom =
    (commonChartLeftTwistRestrictionData e C' c).restrictIso.hom ≫
      twistingSheafBasisChangeHom Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
        (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))
        (c.transport e C').leftSectionBasis
        (c.transport e C').rightSectionBasis 1
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (C'.basisIndex i) := C'.basisIndex_finite i
  letI : Finite (C'.basisIndex j) := C'.basisIndex_finite j
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) := c.sectionModule_free
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) := c.sectionModule_finite
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) := (c.transport e C').sectionModule_free
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) := (c.transport e C').sectionModule_finite
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (commonChartIso e C' c).hom := inferInstance
  let q := (commonChartIso e C' c).hom
  let DL := commonChartLeftTwistRestrictionData e C' c
  let DR := commonChartRightTwistRestrictionData e C' c
  have hL : ∀ a, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) (c.leftSectionBasis a) =
      linearOpen Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
        (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))
        ((c.transport e C').leftSectionBasis a) := by
    intro a
    exact commonChartIso_preimage_leftLinearOpen e C' c a
  have hR : ∀ b, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) (c.rightSectionBasis b) =
      linearOpen Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
        (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))
        ((c.transport e C').rightSectionBasis b) := by
    intro b
    exact commonChartIso_preimage_rightLinearOpen e C' c b
  have hLR : ∀ a b, q ⁻¹ᵁ basisChangeOpen Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))
      c.leftSectionBasis c.rightSectionBasis a b =
      basisChangeOpen Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
        (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))
        (c.transport e C').leftSectionBasis
        (c.transport e C').rightSectionBasis a b := by
    intro a b
    exact commonChartIso_preimage_basisChangeOpen e C' c a b
  have hT : ∀ a b, HEq
      (q.app (basisChangeOpen Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
          (E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))
          c.leftSectionBasis c.rightSectionBasis a b)
        (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
          (E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) (-1)
          (c.leftSectionBasis a) (c.rightSectionBasis b)).1)
      (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
        (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) (-1)
        ((c.transport e C').leftSectionBasis a)
        ((c.transport e C').rightSectionBasis b)).1 := by
    intro a b
    exact commonChartIso_transitionSectionUnit_heq e C' c a b
  have hDL : DL.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso c.leftSectionBasis
        (c.transport e C').leftSectionBasis q hL).hom := by
    rfl
  have hDR : DR.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso c.rightSectionBasis
        (c.transport e C').rightSectionBasis q hR).hom := by
    rfl
  exact twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_restrict_naturality
    c.leftSectionBasis c.rightSectionBasis
    (c.transport e C').leftSectionBasis
    (c.transport e C').rightSectionBasis 1 q
    hL hR hLR hT DL DR hDL hDR

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.commonChart_twistingSheafBasisIso_naturality
statement:
theorem commonChart_twistingSheafBasisIso_naturality (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') {i j : C'.I}
    (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (commonChartIso e C' c).hom).map
        (c.twistingSheafBasisIso 1).hom ≫
      (commonChartRightTwistRestrictionData e C' c).pullbackIso.hom =
    (commonChartLeftTwistRestrictionData e C' c).pullbackIso.hom ≫
      ((c.transport e C').twistingSheafBasisIso 1).hom
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (C'.basisIndex i) := C'.basisIndex_finite i
  letI : Finite (C'.basisIndex j) := C'.basisIndex_finite j
  letI : Finite ((transport e C').basisIndex i) :=
    (transport e C').basisIndex_finite i
  letI : Finite ((transport e C').basisIndex j) :=
    (transport e C').basisIndex_finite j
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) := c.sectionModule_free
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) := c.sectionModule_finite
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) := (c.transport e C').sectionModule_free
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) := (c.transport e C').sectionModule_finite
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (commonChartIso e C' c).hom := inferInstance
  let DL := commonChartLeftTwistRestrictionData e C' c
  let DR := commonChartRightTwistRestrictionData e C' c
  have h := twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_pullback_naturality_of_restrict
    c.leftSectionBasis c.rightSectionBasis
    (c.transport e C').leftSectionBasis
    (c.transport e C').rightSectionBasis 1
    (commonChartIso e C' c).hom DL DR
    (commonChart_basisChange_restrict_naturality e C' c)
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.PullbackFrameSections.coefficientMap_eq_appLE
statement:
theorem coefficientMap_eq_appLE (g : X ⟶ Y) (U : Y.Opens) (V : X.Opens)

proof: := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.PullbackFrameSections.sectionMap_restrict
statement:
theorem sectionMap_restrict (g : X ⟶ Y) (M : Y.Modules) (U : Y.Opens)
    {V W : X.Opens} (hV : V ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U) (hWV : W ≤ V) (s : M.val.obj (op U)) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj M).val.map (homOfLE hWV).op
      (sectionMap g M U V hV s) = sectionMap g M U W (hWV.trans hV) s
proof:
:= by
  let P := (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj M
  change P.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op
      (P.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op _) =
    P.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hWV.trans hV)).op _
  calc
    _ = (P.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op ≫ P.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op) _ := rfl
    _ = _ := by rw [← P.presheaf.map_comp]; rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.PullbackFrameSections.sectionMap_naturality
statement:
theorem sectionMap_naturality (g : X ⟶ Y) {M N : Y.Modules} (a : M ⟶ N)
    (U : Y.Opens) (V : X.Opens) (h : V ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U) (s : M.val.obj (op U)) :
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map a).val.app (op V)).hom
      (sectionMap g M U V h s) =
    sectionMap g N U V h ((a.val.app (op U)).hom s)
proof:
:= by
  have hu := congrArg (fun b => (b.val.app (op U)).hom s)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.naturality a).symm
  have hn := congrArg (fun b => b.hom
      ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app M).val.app (op U)).hom s))
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map a).val.naturality (homOfLE h).op)
  change (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map a).val.app (op (g ⁻¹ᵁ U))).hom
      ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app M).val.app (op U)).hom s) =
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app N).val.app (op U)).hom
      ((a.val.app (op U)).hom s) at hu
  change (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map a).val.app (op V)).hom
      (sectionMap g M U V h s) =
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj N).val.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
      ((((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map a).val.app (op (g ⁻¹ᵁ U))).hom
        ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app M).val.app (op U)).hom s)) at hn
  exact hn.trans (congrArg
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj N).val.map (homOfLE h).op).hom hu)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.PullbackFrameSections.freeSectionBasis_apply
statement:
theorem freeSectionBasis_apply (X : Scheme.{u}) (I : Type u) [Finite I]
    (U : X.Opens) (i : I) :
    freeSectionBasis X I U i = (SheafOfModules.freeSection i).eval (op U)
proof:
:= by
  let e := (PresheafOfModules.evaluation
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat) (op U)).mapIso
        (SchemeKTheory.underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree X I)
  change e.toLinearEquiv.symm (Finsupp.basisSingleOne i) = _
  apply e.toLinearEquiv.injective
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact (SchemeKTheory.underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree_hom_freeSection_eval X I i (op U)).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.PullbackFrameSections.sectionMap_free_generator
statement:
theorem sectionMap_free_generator (g : X ⟶ Y) (I : Type u) (i : I)
    (U : Y.Opens) (V : X.Opens) (h : V ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U) :
    ((AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso g I).hom.val.app (op V)).hom
      (sectionMap g (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I) U V h
        ((SheafOfModules.freeSection i).eval (op U))) =
      (SheafOfModules.freeSection i).eval (op V)
proof:
:= by
  let a := (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso g I).hom
  have hn := congrArg (fun f => f.hom
      ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I)).val.app (op U)).hom
        ((SheafOfModules.freeSection i).eval (op U))))
    (a.val.naturality (homOfLE h).op)
  have hg := SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.adjUnit_pullbackFreeIso_apply g I i (op U)
  change ((a.val.app (op (g ⁻¹ᵁ U))).hom
      ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I)).val.app (op U)).hom
        ((SheafOfModules.freeSection i).eval (op U)))) =
      (SheafOfModules.freeSection i).eval (op (g ⁻¹ᵁ U)) at hg
  change ((a.val.app (op V)).hom
      (sectionMap g (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I) U V h
        ((SheafOfModules.freeSection i).eval (op U)))) =
      ((SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I).val.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
        ((a.val.app (op (g ⁻¹ᵁ U))).hom
          ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app
            (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I)).val.app (op U)).hom
            ((SheafOfModules.freeSection i).eval (op U)))) at hn
  rw [hg] at hn
  exact hn.trans ((SheafOfModules.freeSection i).property (homOfLE h).op)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.PullbackFrameSections.sectionMap_free_basis
statement:
theorem sectionMap_free_basis (g : X ⟶ Y) (I : Type u) [Finite I]
    (U : Y.Opens) (V : X.Opens) (h : V ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U) (i : I) :
    sectionMap g (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I) U V h
      (freeSectionBasis Y I U i) = pulledFreeSectionBasis g I V i
proof:
:= by
  let e := (SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op V)).mapIso
      (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso g I)
  apply e.toLinearEquiv.injective
  rw [freeSectionBasis_apply]
  change _ = e.toLinearEquiv (e.toLinearEquiv.symm (freeSectionBasis X I V i))
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, freeSectionBasis_apply]
  exact sectionMap_free_generator g I i U V h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.PullbackFrameSections.sectionMap_free_isBaseChange
statement:
theorem sectionMap_free_isBaseChange (g : X ⟶ Y) (I : Type u) [Finite I]
    (U : Y.Opens) (V : X.Opens) (h : V ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U) :
    let f
proof:
:= coefficientMap g U V h
    let N := ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I)).val.obj (op V)
    letI : Algebra Γ(Y, U) Γ(X, V) := f.toAlgebra
    letI : Module Γ(Y, U) N := Module.compHom N f
    letI : IsScalarTower Γ(Y, U) Γ(X, V) N :=
      ⟨fun r s n ↦ by change (f r * s) • n = f r • s • n; rw [mul_smul]⟩
    IsBaseChange Γ(X, V) (semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f
      (sectionMap g (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I) U V h)) := by
  dsimp only
  let f := coefficientMap g U V h
  let N := ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I)).val.obj (op V)
  letI : Algebra Γ(Y, U) Γ(X, V) := f.toAlgebra
  letI : Module Γ(Y, U) N := Module.compHom N f
  letI : IsScalarTower Γ(Y, U) Γ(X, V) N :=
    ⟨fun r s n ↦ by change (f r * s) • n = f r • s • n; rw [mul_smul]⟩
  let bU := freeSectionBasis Y I U
  let bV := pulledFreeSectionBasis g I V
  let φ := semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f
    (sectionMap g (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I) U V h)
  have hfree : IsBaseChange Γ(X, V) (Finsupp.linearCombination Γ(Y, U) bV) :=
    IsBaseChange.of_basis Γ(Y, U) bV
  have hcomp := IsBaseChange.comp_equiv bU.repr
    (Finsupp.linearCombination Γ(Y, U) bV) hfree
  have heq : (Finsupp.linearCombination Γ(Y, U) bV).comp bU.repr.toLinearMap = φ := by
    apply bU.ext
    intro i
    simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, Function.comp_apply,
      Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul]
    exact (sectionMap_free_basis g I U V h i).symm
  change IsBaseChange Γ(X, V) φ
  rw [← heq]
  exact hcomp

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.exists_kernelBasis
statement:
theorem exists_kernelBasis (μ : Module.Basis ι A F) (ρ : F →ₗ[A] L) (g : L) (z : ι → A) (j : ι)
    (hz : z j = 1) (hρ : ∀ k, ρ (μ k) = z k • g) (hg : ∀ a : A, a • g = 0 → a = 0)
    (κ : K →ₗ[A] F) (hκ : Function.Injective κ) (hrange : ∀ f, ρ f = 0 → ∃ k, κ k = f)
    (hκρ : ∀ k, ρ (κ k) = 0) :
    ∃ e : Module.Basis {m // m ≠ j} A K, ∀ m, κ (e m) = μ m - z m • μ j
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : ∀ m : {m // m ≠ j}, ρ (μ m - z m • μ j) = 0 := by
    intro m
    rw [map_sub, map_smul, hρ, hρ, hz, smul_smul, mul_one, sub_self]
  choose ε hε using fun m : {m // m ≠ j} => hrange _ (hmem m)
  let T : ({m // m ≠ j} → A) →ₗ[A] K :=
    { toFun := fun a => ∑ m, a m • ε m
      map_add' := fun a b => by simp [add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      map_smul' := fun r a => by simp [Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul] }
  have hT : ∀ a, κ (T a) = ∑ m : {m // m ≠ j}, a m • (μ m - z m • μ j) := by
    intro a
    change κ (∑ m, a m • ε m) = _
    rw [map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => ?_
    rw [map_smul, hε]
  have coord : ∀ a (m0 : {m // m ≠ j}), μ.repr (κ (T a)) m0 = a m0 := by
    intro a m0
    rw [hT]
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, map_sub, Finsupp.coe_finsetSum, Finset.sum_apply,
      Finsupp.smul_apply, Finsupp.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul, Module.Basis.repr_self,
      Finsupp.single_apply]
    have hj : (j : ι) ≠ m0 := fun h => m0.2 h.symm
    simp [hj]
    simp only [Subtype.coe_inj, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  have hinj : Function.Injective T := by
    intro a b hab
    funext m
    rw [← coord a m, ← coord b m, hab]
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective T := by
    intro k
    let f := κ k
    let c : ι → A := fun l => μ.repr f l
    have hf : f = ∑ l, c l • μ l := (μ.sum_repr f).symm
    have hρf : ρ f = 0 := hκρ k
    have hsum : (∑ l, c l * z l) = 0 := by
      apply hg
      rw [Finset.sum_smul, ← hρf, hf, map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
      rw [map_smul, hρ, smul_smul]
    have hsplit : ∀ (M : Type u) [AddCommMonoid M] (h : ι → M),
        ∑ l, h l = h j + ∑ m : {m // m ≠ j}, h m := fun M _ h =>
      Fintype.sum_eq_add_sum_subtype_ne h j
    have hcj : c j = - ∑ m : {m // m ≠ j}, c m * z m := by
      rw [hsplit A (fun l => c l * z l), hz, mul_one] at hsum
      exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hsum
    refine ⟨fun m => c m, ?_⟩
    apply hκ
    rw [hT]
    change _ = f
    rw [hf, hsplit F (fun l => c l • μ l), hcj]
    simp only [smul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, neg_smul, Finset.sum_smul, smul_smul]
    abel
  let E : ({m // m ≠ j} → A) ≃ₗ[A] K := LinearEquiv.ofBijective T ⟨hinj, hsurj⟩
  refine ⟨Module.Basis.ofEquivFun E.symm, fun m => ?_⟩
  rw [Module.Basis.coe_ofEquivFun, LinearEquiv.symm_symm]
  change κ (T (Pi.single m 1)) = _
  rw [hT]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single m]
  · simp
  · intro m' _ hm'
    simp [hm']
  · simp

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.ker_le_span_of_localization
statement:
theorem ker_le_span_of_localization (h : A) [IsLocalization.Away h B] (f : A →+* C)
    [IsLocalization.Away (f h) D] (f' : B →+* D)
    (hcomm : ∀ a, f' (algebraMap A B a) = algebraMap C D (f a)) {κ : Type*} (θ : κ → A)
    (hker : RingHom.ker f ≤ Ideal.span (Set.range θ)) :
    RingHom.ker f' ≤ Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => algebraMap A B (θ i))
proof:
:= by
  intro b hb
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker] at hb
  obtain ⟨⟨a, ⟨_, N, rfl⟩⟩, hab⟩ := IsLocalization.surj (Submonoid.powers h) b
  have h1 : algebraMap C D (f a) = 0 := by
    rw [← hcomm, ← hab, map_mul, hb, zero_mul]
  obtain ⟨⟨_, k, rfl⟩, hk⟩ := (IsLocalization.map_eq_zero_iff (Submonoid.powers (f h)) D _).mp h1
  have h2 : h ^ k * a ∈ RingHom.ker f := by
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker, map_mul, map_pow]
    exact hk
  have h3 := hker h2
  have h4 : algebraMap A B (h ^ k * a) ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range fun i => algebraMap A B (θ i)) := by
    have := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (algebraMap A B) h3
    rwa [Ideal.map_span, ← Set.range_comp] at this
  have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap A B (h ^ (N + k))) :=
    IsLocalization.map_units B (⟨h ^ (N + k), N + k, rfl⟩ : Submonoid.powers h)
  apply (Ideal.unit_mul_mem_iff_mem _ hu).mp
  have : b * algebraMap A B (h ^ (N + k)) = algebraMap A B (h ^ k * a) := by
    rw [pow_add, map_mul, ← mul_assoc, hab, ← map_mul, mul_comm]
  rw [mul_comm, this]
  exact h4

name: SchemeKTheory.overIsoFreeOnOpensRange_functor_hom
statement:
theorem overIsoFreeOnOpensRange_functor_hom {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q] (M : X.Modules) (I : Type u)
    (h : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj M ≅
      SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I) :
    (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv q.opensRange).functor.map
      (overIsoFreeOnOpensRange q M I h).hom =
    ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv q.opensRange).app M).hom ≫
      (restrictIsoFreeOnOpensRange q M I h).hom ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv q.opensRange).app
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I)).inv
proof:
:= by
  unfold overIsoFreeOnOpensRange
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.trans_inv,
    Functor.mapIso_inv, Functor.map_comp]
  simp

name: SchemeKTheory.restrictIsoFreeOnOpensRange_roundtrip
statement:
theorem restrictIsoFreeOnOpensRange_roundtrip {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q] (M : X.Modules) (I : Type u)
    (h : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj M ≅
      SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I) :
    (restrictFunctorOpenImmersionFactorIso q).app M ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q.isoOpensRange.hom).mapIso
        (restrictIsoFreeOnOpensRange q M I h) ≪≫
      ((restrictFunctorOpenImmersionFactorIso q).app
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I)).symm ≪≫
      restrictFreeIso q I = h
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  simp [restrictIsoFreeOnOpensRange]

name: SchemeKTheory.overIsoFreeOnOpensRange_restrict_roundtrip
statement:
theorem overIsoFreeOnOpensRange_restrict_roundtrip {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q] (M : X.Modules) (I : Type u)
    (h : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj M ≅
      SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv q.opensRange).app M).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv q.opensRange).functor.mapIso
        (overIsoFreeOnOpensRange q M I h) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv q.opensRange).app
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I) =
    restrictIsoFreeOnOpensRange q M I h
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom]
  rw [overIsoFreeOnOpensRange_functor_hom]
  simp

name: SchemeKTheory.freeTrivializationLocalFrame_roundtrip
statement:
theorem freeTrivializationLocalFrame_roundtrip {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q] (M : X.Modules) (I : Type u)
    (h : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj M ≅
      SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I) :
    (restrictFunctorOpenImmersionFactorIso q).app M ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q.isoOpensRange.hom).mapIso
        (((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv q.opensRange).app M).symm ≪≫
          (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv q.opensRange).functor.mapIso
            (((freeOverIso X q.opensRange I).symm ≪≫
              freeTrivializationLocalFrame q M I h).symm) ≪≫
          (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv q.opensRange).app
            (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I)) ≪≫
      ((restrictFunctorOpenImmersionFactorIso q).app
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I)).symm ≪≫
      restrictFreeIso q I = h
proof:
:= by
  have hf : ((freeOverIso X q.opensRange I).symm ≪≫
      freeTrivializationLocalFrame q M I h).symm = overIsoFreeOnOpensRange q M I h := by
    simp [freeTrivializationLocalFrame]
  rw [hf, overIsoFreeOnOpensRange_restrict_roundtrip,
    restrictIsoFreeOnOpensRange_roundtrip]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullbackRestrictSquare_unit_sections
statement:
theorem pullbackRestrictSquare_unit_sections {X Y W V : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : X ⟶ Y) (q : W ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (v : V ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion v] (h : W ⟶ V) (comm : q ≫ g = h ≫ v)
    (M : Y.Modules) (U : Y.Opens) (s : M.val.obj (op U)) :
    ((pushforwardCongr comm.symm).hom.app ((restrictFunctor v ⋙ pullback h).obj M)).app U
      (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction h).unit.app ((restrictFunctor v).obj M)).app (v ⁻¹ᵁ U)
        (((restrictAdjunction v).unit.app M).app U s)) =
    ((pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso g q v h comm).hom.app M).app (q ⁻¹ᵁ g ⁻¹ᵁ U)
      (((restrictAdjunction q).unit.app ((pullback g).obj M)).app (g ⁻¹ᵁ U)
        (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app M).app U s))
proof:
:= by
  have hu := congrArg (fun a => a.app U s)
    (pullbackRestrictSquare_unit_coherence g q v h comm M)
  simp only [Hom.comp_app, pushforward_map_app, pushforwardComp_hom_app_app,
    pushforwardComp_inv_app_app, Functor.comp_map, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hu
  change ((pushforwardCongr comm.symm).hom.app ((restrictFunctor v ⋙ pullback h).obj M)).app U
      (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction h).unit.app ((restrictFunctor v).obj M)).app (v ⁻¹ᵁ U)
        (((restrictAdjunction v).unit.app M).app U s)) =
    ((pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso g q v h comm).hom.app M).app (q ⁻¹ᵁ g ⁻¹ᵁ U)
      (((restrictAdjunction q).unit.app ((pullback g).obj M)).app (g ⁻¹ᵁ U)
        (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app M).app U s)) at hu
  exact hu

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameRecovery_recover_square
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameRecovery_recover_square
    {A B : Type*} [Category A] [Category B] (F : A ⥤ B)
    {M T R : A} {N S U : B} {t : M ⟶ T} {s : N ⟶ S}
    {H : F.obj T ⟶ S} [IsIso H]
    {K : F.obj M ⟶ N} (h : F.map t ≫ H = K ≫ s) (e : R ≅ T) (d : U ≅ S) :
    F.map (t ≫ e.inv) ≫ (F.mapIso e ≪≫ asIso H ≪≫ d.symm).hom =
      K ≫ s ≫ d.inv
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Functor.map_comp, Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, asIso_hom,
    Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp_assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id,
    CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp]
  simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg (fun z => z ≫ d.inv) h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameRecovery_natural_conjugation
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameRecovery_natural_conjugation
    {A B : Type*} [Category A] [Category B] {F G : A ⥤ B} (e : F ≅ G)
    {M N : A} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    e.hom.app M ≫ G.map f ≫ e.inv.app N = F.map f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← e.hom.naturality_assoc]
  simp only [Iso.hom_inv_id_app, Category.comp_id]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameRecovery_restriction_route
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameRecovery_restriction_route
    {Z V W : Scheme.{u}} (s : W ⟶ Z) (q : V ⟶ Z) (r : W ⟶ V)
    [IsOpenImmersion s] [IsOpenImmersion q] [IsOpenImmersion r]
    (h : r ≫ q = s) {M N : Z.Modules} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr h.symm ≪≫ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp r q).hom.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor r).map ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map f) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr h.symm ≪≫ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp r q).inv.app N =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor s).map f
proof:
:=
  pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameRecovery_natural_conjugation
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr h.symm ≪≫ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp r q) f

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameRecovery_common_left_cancel
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameRecovery_common_left_cancel
    (a b : C.pullbackFrameIndex g) (c : (C.pullbackFrameCover g).CommonBasicOpen a b)
    (F : c.chart.Modules)
    (f h : (Scheme.Modules.pullback c.chartToLeft).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).chartι a)).obj
        ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)) ⟶ F) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback c.chartToLeft).map
      ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).pullbackTwistOverlap_chartCanonicalQuotient a ≫
        ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 a).inv) ≫ f =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback c.chartToLeft).map
      ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).pullbackTwistOverlap_chartCanonicalQuotient a ≫
        ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 a).inv) ≫ h ↔ f = h
proof:
:= by
  letI := pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameRecovery_recovered_quotient_epi
    (C.pullbackFrameCover g) a c.chartToLeft
  exact cancel_epi _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameRecovery_common_right_cancel
statement:

      ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).pullbackTwistOverlap_chartCanonicalQuotient b ≫

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.isPullback_overlapToBaseOpen
statement:
theorem isPullback_overlapToBaseOpen (i j : C.I) :
    IsPullback
      (C.overlapToChart j i)
      (C.overlapToIntersection j i ≫
        X.homOfLE (inf_le_right : C.U j ⊓ C.U i ≤ C.U i))
      (C.chartToAmbient j)
      (C.U i).ι
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ :
      IsPullback
        (C.overlapToChart j i)
        (C.overlapToIntersection j i)
        (C.chartToBase j)
        (X.homOfLE
          (inf_le_left : C.U j ⊓ C.U i ≤ C.U j)) :=
    IsPullback.of_hasPullback _ _
  have h₂ := isPullback_opens_inf (C.U j) (C.U i)
  rw [← C.chartToBase_comp_openImmersion j]
  exact h₁.paste_vert h₂

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.isPullback_transition_overlapToBaseOpen
statement:
theorem isPullback_transition_overlapToBaseOpen (i j : C.I) :
    IsPullback
      (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i)
      (C.overlapToChart i j ≫ C.chartToBase i)
      (C.chartToAmbient j)
      (C.U i).ι
proof:
:= by
  have hbase :
      C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToIntersection j i ≫
          X.homOfLE (inf_le_right : C.U j ⊓ C.U i ≤ C.U i) =
        C.overlapToChart i j ≫ C.chartToBase i := by
    apply (cancel_mono (C.U i).ι).1
    calc
      C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToIntersection j i ≫
            X.homOfLE (inf_le_right : C.U j ⊓ C.U i ≤ C.U i) ≫
            (C.U i).ι =
          C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i ≫
            C.chartToAmbient j := by
        simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg
          (fun q ↦ C.transition i j ≫ q)
          (C.isPullback_overlapToBaseOpen i j).w.symm
      _ = C.overlapToChart i j ≫ C.chartToAmbient i :=
        (C.transition_toAmbient i j).symm
      _ = C.overlapToChart i j ≫ C.chartToBase i ≫
          (C.U i).ι := by
        simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg
          (fun q ↦ C.overlapToChart i j ≫ q)
          (C.chartToBase_comp_openImmersion i).symm
  letI : IsIso (C.transition i j) :=
    C.glueData.toGlueData.t_isIso i j
  refine (C.isPullback_overlapToBaseOpen i j).of_iso'
    (asIso (C.transition i j))
    (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp
  · exact hbase.trans (Category.comp_id _).symm
  · simp
  · simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.overlapIsoGluedPullback_hom_fst
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem overlapIsoGluedPullback_hom_fst (i j : C.I) :
    (C.overlapIsoGluedPullback i j).hom ≫
        pullback.fst (C.chartι i) (C.chartι j) =
      C.overlapToChart i j
proof:
:= by
  exact IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso_hom_comp
    (C.glueData.vPullbackConeIsLimit i j)
    (limit.isLimit (cospan (C.chartι i) (C.chartι j)))
    WalkingCospan.left

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.overlapIsoGluedPullback_hom_snd
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem overlapIsoGluedPullback_hom_snd (i j : C.I) :
    (C.overlapIsoGluedPullback i j).hom ≫
        pullback.snd (C.chartι i) (C.chartι j) =
      C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i
proof:
:= by
  exact IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso_hom_comp
    (C.glueData.vPullbackConeIsLimit i j)
    (limit.isLimit (cospan (C.chartι i) (C.chartι j)))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.isPullback_chartι_toBase
statement:
theorem isPullback_chartι_toBase (i : C.I) :
    IsPullback
      (C.chartι i)
      (C.chartToBase i)
      C.toBase
      (C.U i).ι
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.isPullback_of_openCover
    (C.chartι i) (C.chartToBase i) C.toBase (C.U i).ι C.cover
  intro j
  change IsPullback
    (pullback.snd (C.chartι i) (C.chartι j))
    (pullback.fst (C.chartι i) (C.chartι j) ≫ C.chartToBase i)
    (C.chartι j ≫ C.toBase)
    (C.U i).ι
  rw [C.chartι_toBase]
  refine (C.isPullback_transition_overlapToBaseOpen i j).of_iso
    (C.overlapIsoGluedPullback i j)
    (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · exact (C.overlapIsoGluedPullback_hom_snd i j).symm
  · exact (C.overlapIsoGluedPullback_hom_fst_assoc i j
      (C.chartToBase i)).symm
  · simp
  · simp

name: CIIB3.mem_ideal_iff_exists

theorem mem_ideal_iff_exists (U : X.affineOpens) (a : Γ(X, U.1)) :

proof:
