name: CIIB3.presheaf_map_map
statement:
theorem presheaf_map_map {U V W : X.Opens} (h1 : V ≤ U) (h2 : W ≤ V) (y : Γ(X, U)) :
    X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h2).op (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h1).op y) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h2.trans h1)).op y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

name: CIIB3.mem_span_of_local
statement:
theorem mem_span_of_local {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] (V : X.affineOpens) (s : ι → Γ(X, V.1))
    (a : Γ(X, V.1))
    (h : ∀ x : X, x ∈ V.1 → ∃ (W : X.Opens) (hW : W ≤ V.1), x ∈ W ∧
      ∃ c : ι → Γ(X, W), X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op a =
        ∑ k, c k * X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op (s k)) :
    a ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range s)
proof:
:= by
  refine (Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).1 ?_
  apply Ideal.le_of_localization_maximal
  intro P hP
  rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
  let p : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, V.1) := ⟨P, hP.isPrime⟩
  let x : X := V.2.fromSpec p
  have hxV : x ∈ V.1 := by
    have : x ∈ Set.range V.2.fromSpec := ⟨p, rfl⟩
    rwa [V.2.range_fromSpec] at this
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hxW, c, hc⟩ := h x hxV
  obtain ⟨f, hfW, hxf⟩ := V.2.exists_basicOpen_le (V := W) ⟨x, hxW⟩ hxV
  have hfP : f ∉ P := by
    have : p ∈ V.2.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ X.basicOpen f := hxf
    rw [V.2.fromSpec_preimage_basicOpen] at this
    exact this
  haveI := V.2.isLocalization_basicOpen f
  have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap Γ(X, V.1) (Localization.AtPrime P) f) :=
    IsLocalization.map_units (M := P.primeCompl) (Localization.AtPrime P) ⟨f, hfP⟩
  let g : Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) →+* Localization.AtPrime P :=
    IsLocalization.Away.lift f hu
  have hg : ∀ y : Γ(X, V.1), g (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op y) =
      algebraMap Γ(X, V.1) (Localization.AtPrime P) y := fun y =>
    IsLocalization.lift_eq (M := Submonoid.powers f) _ y
  have h1 := congrArg (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hfW).op) hc
  rw [presheaf_map_map] at h1
  rw [map_sum] at h1
  simp only [map_mul, presheaf_map_map] at h1
  have h2 := congrArg g h1
  rw [hg, map_sum] at h2
  simp only [map_mul, hg] at h2
  rw [h2]
  refine Ideal.sum_mem _ (fun k _ => ?_)
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨k, rfl⟩))

name: CIIB3.tensorTrivSec_symm_natural
statement:
theorem tensorTrivSec_symm_natural (L E : X.Modules) (V : X.Opens)
    (θ : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V) PUnit ≅ L.over V)
    {W W' : X.Opens} (hW : W ≤ V) (hW' : W' ≤ W)
    (m' : (tensorSheaf X L E).val.obj (op W)) :
    (tensorTrivSec L E V θ (hW'.trans hW)).symm
        ((tensorSheaf X L E).val.map (homOfLE hW').op m') =
      E.val.map (homOfLE hW').op ((tensorTrivSec L E V θ hW).symm m')
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorTrivSec_symm_apply, tensorTrivSec_symm_apply]
  exact PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply (tensorTriv L E V θ).inv.val
    (X := op (Over.mk (homOfLE hW))) (Y := op (Over.mk (homOfLE (hW'.trans hW))))
    (Quiver.Hom.op (Over.homMk (homOfLE hW'))) m'

name: CIIB3.tensorTrivSec_symm_unit
statement:
theorem tensorTrivSec_symm_unit (L E : X.Modules) (V₁ V₂ : X.Opens)
    (θ₁ : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V₁) PUnit ≅ L.over V₁)
    (θ₂ : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V₂) PUnit ≅ L.over V₂)
    {W : X.Opens} (h₁ : W ≤ V₁) (h₂ : W ≤ V₂) :
    ∃ u : (Γ(X, W))ˣ, ∀ m' : (tensorSheaf X L E).val.obj (op W),
      (tensorTrivSec L E V₂ θ₂ h₂).symm m' =
        (u : Γ(X, W)) • (tensorTrivSec L E V₁ θ₁ h₁).symm m'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_unit_of_two_frames (trivSecEquiv L V₁ θ₁ h₁)
    (trivSecEquiv L V₂ θ₂ h₂)
  refine ⟨u, fun m' => ?_⟩
  set m := (tensorTrivSec L E V₁ θ₁ h₁).symm m' with hm
  have hm' : m' = tensorUnitAt L E W (trivSecEquiv L V₁ θ₁ h₁ 1) m := by
    rw [← tensorTrivSec_apply, hm, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [hm', tensorTrivSec_symm_apply, trivSecEquiv_symm_apply_tensorUnitAt, hu]

name: CIIB3.presheaf_map_comp_apply
statement:
theorem presheaf_map_comp_apply (M : X.Modules) {U V W : X.Opens} (h1 : V ≤ U) (h2 : W ≤ V)
    (m : Γ(M, U)) :
    M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h2).op (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h1).op m) =
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h2.trans h1)).op m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← M.presheaf.map_comp]
  rfl

name: CIIB3.map_secGen
statement:
theorem map_secGen (V : X.Opens)
    (θ : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V) PUnit ≅ L.over V)
    {W : X.Opens} (hW : W ≤ V) (k : ι) :
    X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op (secGen I L φ V θ le_rfl k) = secGen I L φ V θ hW k
proof:
:= by
  unfold secGen
  have h1 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom ((idealModuleι I).mapPresheaf.naturality (homOfLE hW).op)
    ((tensorTrivSec L (idealModule I) V θ le_rfl).symm
      ((tensorSheaf X L (idealModule I)).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op
        (sGlob I L φ k)))
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at h1
  refine h1.symm.trans ?_
  congr 1
  have h2 := tensorTrivSec_symm_natural L (idealModule I) V θ (le_refl V) hW
    ((tensorSheaf X L (idealModule I)).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op
        (sGlob I L φ k))
  refine h2.symm.trans ?_
  congr 1
  exact presheaf_map_comp_apply (tensorSheaf X L (idealModule I)) (le_top : V ≤ ⊤) hW
    (sGlob I L φ k)

name: CIIB3.ideal_le_span_gen
statement:
theorem ideal_le_span_gen [Epi φ] (V : X.affineOpens)
    (θ : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V.1) PUnit ≅ L.over V.1) :
    I.ideal V ≤ Ideal.span (Set.range (secGen I L φ V.1 θ le_rfl))
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (mem_ideal_iff_exists X I V a).1 ha
  refine mem_span_of_local V _ a ?_
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hxW, t, ht⟩ := exists_local_preimage_of_epi φ V.1
    (tensorTrivSec L (idealModule I) V.1 θ le_rfl m) x hx
  refine ⟨W, hW, hxW, fun k => Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (prFree ι k) W t, ?_⟩
  have hd := free_app_decomp ι φ W t
  rw [ht] at hd
  have h2 := congrArg (fun y => (idealModuleι I).app W
      ((tensorTrivSec L (idealModule I) V.1 θ hW).symm y)) hd
  simp only at h2
  have hLHS : (idealModuleι I).app W ((tensorTrivSec L (idealModule I) V.1 θ hW).symm
      ((tensorSheaf X L (idealModule I)).presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op
        (tensorTrivSec L (idealModule I) V.1 θ le_rfl m))) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op a := by
    have h3 := tensorTrivSec_symm_natural L (idealModule I) V.1 θ (le_refl _) hW
      (tensorTrivSec L (idealModule I) V.1 θ le_rfl m)
    have h4 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      ((idealModuleι I).mapPresheaf.naturality (homOfLE hW).op) m
    simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at h4
    refine (congrArg ((idealModuleι I).app W) h3).trans ?_
    rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    exact h4.trans (congrArg _ hm)
  have hRHS : (idealModuleι I).app W ((tensorTrivSec L (idealModule I) V.1 θ hW).symm
      (∑ k, (show Γ(X, W) from Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (prFree ι k) W t) •
        (tensorSheaf X L (idealModule I)).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op
          (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (inFree ι k ≫ φ) ⊤ (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))))) =
      ∑ k, (show Γ(X, W) from Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (prFree ι k) W t) *
        secGen I L φ V.1 θ hW k := by
    have hs := map_sum (tensorTrivSec L (idealModule I) V.1 θ hW).symm
      (fun k => (show Γ(X, W) from Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (prFree ι k) W t) •
        (tensorSheaf X L (idealModule I)).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op
          (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (inFree ι k ≫ φ) ⊤ (1 : Γ(X, ⊤)))) Finset.univ
    erw [hs]
    have hi := map_sum ((idealModuleι I).app W).hom
      (fun k => (tensorTrivSec L (idealModule I) V.1 θ hW).symm
        ((show Γ(X, W) from Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (prFree ι k) W t) •
        (tensorSheaf X L (idealModule I)).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op
          (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (inFree ι k ≫ φ) ⊤ (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))))) Finset.univ
    erw [hi]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
    erw [LinearEquiv.map_smul]
    erw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul]
    rfl
  have h6 := hLHS.symm.trans (h2.trans hRHS)
  refine h6.trans (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_))
  rw [map_secGen]

name: CIIB3.exists_trivCover
statement:
theorem exists_trivCover (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) :
    Nonempty (TrivCover X L)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := exists_affineFrameCover_of_constantRank hL
  refine ⟨{ ι := C.I, W := fun c => ⟨C.U c, C.isAffine c⟩, cover := C.covers, θ := fun c => ?_ }⟩
  have hc : Nat.card (C.basisIndex c) = 1 := hC c
  haveI : Unique (C.basisIndex c) := (Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.mp hc).2 |>.some |> fun a ↦
    ⟨⟨a⟩, fun b ↦ (Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.mp hc).1.elim b a⟩
  exact ((SheafOfModules.freeFunctor (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over (C.U c))).mapIso
      (Equiv.toIso (Equiv.equivPUnit (C.basisIndex c)).symm)) ≪≫ C.frame c

name: CIIB3.centreGenerators_of_epi
statement:
theorem centreGenerators_of_epi (I : X.IdealSheafData) (L : X.Modules)
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι]
    (φ : FreeM X ι ⟶ tensorSheaf X L (idealModule I)) [Epi φ] :
    Nonempty (CentreGenerators X I)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T⟩ := exists_trivCover L hL
  let e : ι ≃ Fin (Fintype.card ι) := Fintype.equivFin ι
  have hu : ∀ c c' : T.ι, ∃ u : (Γ(X, (T.W c).1 ⊓ (T.W c').1))ˣ,
      ∀ m' : (tensorSheaf X L (idealModule I)).val.obj (op ((T.W c).1 ⊓ (T.W c').1)),
        (tensorTrivSec L (idealModule I) (T.W c').1 (T.θ c') inf_le_right).symm m' =
          (u : Γ(X, (T.W c).1 ⊓ (T.W c').1)) •
            (tensorTrivSec L (idealModule I) (T.W c).1 (T.θ c) inf_le_left).symm m' :=
    fun c c' => tensorTrivSec_symm_unit L (idealModule I) (T.W c).1 (T.W c').1 (T.θ c) (T.θ c')
      inf_le_left inf_le_right
  choose u0 hu0 using hu
  refine ⟨{ n := Fintype.card ι
            ι := T.ι
            W := T.W
            cover := T.cover
            s := fun c k => secGen I L φ (T.W c).1 (T.θ c) le_rfl (e.symm k)
            mem := ?_
            span := ?_
            u := fun c c' => (u0 c c')⁻¹
            glue := ?_ }⟩
  · intro c k
    exact (mem_ideal_iff_exists X I (T.W c) _).2 ⟨_, rfl⟩
  · intro c
    refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
    · have h := ideal_le_span_gen I L φ (T.W c) (T.θ c)
      rwa [← e.symm.surjective.range_comp] at h
    · refine Ideal.span_le.2 ?_
      rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
      exact (mem_ideal_iff_exists X I (T.W c) _).2 ⟨_, rfl⟩
  · intro c c' k
    have h1 := map_secGen I L φ (T.W c).1 (T.θ c) (inf_le_left : (T.W c).1 ⊓ (T.W c').1 ≤ _)
      (e.symm k)
    have h2 := map_secGen I L φ (T.W c').1 (T.θ c') (inf_le_right : (T.W c).1 ⊓ (T.W c').1 ≤ _)
      (e.symm k)
    have hB : secGen I L φ (T.W c').1 (T.θ c') (inf_le_right : (T.W c).1 ⊓ (T.W c').1 ≤ _)
        (e.symm k) = ((u0 c c' : (Γ(X, (T.W c).1 ⊓ (T.W c').1))ˣ) : Γ(X, (T.W c).1 ⊓ (T.W c').1)) *
        secGen I L φ (T.W c).1 (T.θ c) (inf_le_left : (T.W c).1 ⊓ (T.W c').1 ≤ _) (e.symm k) := by
      unfold secGen
      rw [hu0 c c']
      erw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul]
      rfl
    show X.presheaf.map _ (secGen I L φ (T.W c).1 (T.θ c) le_rfl (e.symm k)) =
      (((u0 c c')⁻¹ : (Γ(X, (T.W c).1 ⊓ (T.W c').1))ˣ) : Γ(X, (T.W c).1 ⊓ (T.W c').1)) *
        X.presheaf.map _ (secGen I L φ (T.W c').1 (T.θ c') le_rfl (e.symm k))
    rw [h1, h2, hB, ← mul_assoc, Units.inv_mul, one_mul]

name: CategoryTheory.transition_naturality_from_recovery
statement:
theorem transition_naturality_from_recovery
    {C : Type*} [Category C]
    {A₁ A₂ B₁ B₂ P₁ P₂ Q₁ Q₂ : C}
    (δA : A₁ ⟶ A₂) (δB : B₁ ⟶ B₂)
    (σ₁ : A₁ ⟶ B₁) (σ₂ : A₂ ⟶ B₂)
    (a₁ : A₁ ⟶ P₁) (a₂ : A₂ ⟶ P₂)
    (u₁ : B₁ ⟶ Q₁) (u₂ : B₂ ⟶ Q₂)
    (η : P₁ ⟶ Q₁) (τ : P₂ ≅ Q₂)
    (T : P₁ ⟶ P₂) (T' : Q₁ ⟶ Q₂)
    (hσ : σ₁ ≫ δB = δA ≫ σ₂)
    (h₁ : a₁ ≫ η = σ₁ ≫ u₁) (h₂ : a₂ ≫ τ.hom = σ₂ ≫ u₂)
    (hu : u₁ ≫ T' = δB ≫ u₂) (hT : T ≫ τ.hom = η ≫ T') :
    a₁ ≫ T = δA ≫ a₂
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono τ.hom).1
  calc
    (a₁ ≫ T) ≫ τ.hom = a₁ ≫ η ≫ T' := by rw [Category.assoc, hT]
    _ = σ₁ ≫ u₁ ≫ T' := by erw [← Category.assoc, h₁, Category.assoc]
    _ = σ₁ ≫ δB ≫ u₂ := by rw [hu]
    _ = δA ≫ σ₂ ≫ u₂ := by rw [← Category.assoc, hσ, Category.assoc]
    _ = (δA ≫ a₂) ≫ τ.hom := by erw [Category.assoc, h₂]

name: CategoryTheory.comparison_equality_from_recoveries
statement:
theorem comparison_equality_from_recoveries
    {C : Type*} [Category C] {A₁ A₂ B₁ B₂ P₁ P₂ : C}
    (δA : A₁ ≅ A₂) (δB : B₁ ≅ B₂)
    (p₁ : B₁ ≅ P₁) (p₂ : B₂ ≅ P₂) (t : P₁ ≅ P₂)
    (α₁ : A₁ ⟶ B₁) (α₂ : A₂ ⟶ B₂)
    (a₁ : A₁ ⟶ P₁) (a₂ : A₂ ⟶ P₂)
    (h₁ : α₁ ≫ p₁.hom = a₁) (h₂ : α₂ ≫ p₂.hom = a₂)
    (hp : p₁.hom ≫ t.hom = δB.hom ≫ p₂.hom)
    (ha : a₁ ≫ t.hom = δA.hom ≫ a₂) :
    α₁ = δA.hom ≫ α₂ ≫ δB.inv
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (p₁.hom ≫ t.hom)).1
  calc
    α₁ ≫ (p₁.hom ≫ t.hom) = a₁ ≫ t.hom := by rw [← Category.assoc, h₁]
    _ = δA.hom ≫ a₂ := ha
    _ = (δA.hom ≫ α₂ ≫ δB.inv) ≫ (p₁.hom ≫ t.hom) := by
      rw [hp]
      simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, h₂]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback_transport_recovery
statement:
theorem pullback_transport_recovery
    {V W W' Y Y' Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (l : V ⟶ W) (f : W ⟶ Y) (k : Y ⟶ Z)
    (a : W ⟶ Y') (q : Y' ⟶ Z) (b : V ⟶ W') (r : W' ⟶ Y')
    (hc : f ≫ k = a ≫ q) (ho : b ≫ r = l ≫ a)
    (M : Z.Modules) {P : Y'.Modules} {Q : W.Modules}
    (c : (pullback q).obj M ⟶ P) (θ : (pullback a).obj P ≅ Q) :
    (pullbackComp l f).inv.app ((pullback k).obj M) ≫
      (pullback l).map ((pullbackComp f k).hom.app M ≫
        (pullbackCongr hc).hom.app M ≫ (pullbackComp a q).inv.app M ≫
        (pullback a).map c ≫ θ.hom) ≫
      (pullback l).map θ.inv ≫ (pullbackComp l a).hom.app P ≫
      (pullbackCongr ho.symm).hom.app P ≫ (pullbackComp b r).inv.app P =
    (pullbackComp (l ≫ f) k).hom.app M ≫
      (pullbackCongr (show (l ≫ f) ≫ k = b ≫ (r ≫ q) from
        by rw [Category.assoc, hc, ← Category.assoc, ← ho, Category.assoc])).hom.app M ≫
      (pullbackComp b (r ≫ q)).inv.app M ≫
      (pullback b).map ((pullbackComp r q).inv.app M ≫ (pullback r).map c)
proof:
:= by
  have hθ : (pullback l).map θ.hom ≫ (pullback l).map θ.inv = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, θ.hom_inv_id]
    exact (pullback l).map_id _
  simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  rw [reassoc_of% hθ]
  have hn₁ : (pullback l).map ((pullback a).map c) ≫
      (pullbackComp l a).hom.app P =
      (pullbackComp l a).hom.app ((pullback q).obj M) ≫
        (pullback (l ≫ a)).map c := (pullbackComp l a).hom.naturality c
  rw [reassoc_of% hn₁]
  rw [(pullbackCongr ho.symm).hom.naturality_assoc c]
  rw [(pullbackComp b r).inv.naturality c]
  have hh := congrArg
    (fun x => (pullbackComp l f).inv.app ((pullback k).obj M) ≫ x ≫
      (pullback b).map ((pullback r).map c))
    (pullback_transport_cube l f k a q b r hc ho M)
  simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc] at hh
  exact hh

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback_transport_square_congr
statement:
theorem pullback_transport_square_congr
    {V Y Z W : Scheme.{u}} {f f' : V ⟶ Y} (k : Y ⟶ Z)
    (b : V ⟶ W) {g g' : W ⟶ Z}
    (hf : f = f') (hg : g = g')
    (hc : f ≫ k = b ≫ g) (hc' : f' ≫ k = b ≫ g') (M : Z.Modules) :
    (pullbackComp f k).hom.app M ≫ (pullbackCongr hc).hom.app M ≫
      (pullbackComp b g).inv.app M ≫ (pullback b).map ((pullbackCongr hg).hom.app M) =
    (pullbackCongr hf).hom.app ((pullback k).obj M) ≫
      (pullbackComp f' k).hom.app M ≫ (pullbackCongr hc').hom.app M ≫
      (pullbackComp b g').inv.app M
proof:
:= by
  cases hf
  cases hg
  have hi : (pullbackCongr (rfl : f = f)).hom.app ((pullback k).obj M) = 𝟙 _ := rfl
  have hj : (pullbackCongr (rfl : g = g)).hom.app M = 𝟙 _ := rfl
  rw [hi, hj, (pullback b).map_id]
  rw [Category.id_comp]
  exact congrArg (fun c => (pullbackComp f k).hom.app M ≫
    (pullbackCongr hc).hom.app M ≫ c)
    (Category.comp_id ((pullbackComp b g).inv.app M))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback_comparison_recovery_along
statement:
theorem pullback_comparison_recovery_along
    {V W Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : V ⟶ W) (f : W ⟶ Y)
    {M N : Y.Modules} {P : W.Modules}
    (α : (pullback f).obj M ⟶ (pullback f).obj N)
    (p : (pullback f).obj N ⟶ P) (b : (pullback f).obj M ⟶ P)
    (h : α ≫ p = b) :
    ((pullbackComp g f).inv.app M ≫ (pullback g).map α ≫
      (pullbackComp g f).hom.app N) ≫
      ((pullbackComp g f).inv.app N ≫ (pullback g).map p) =
    (pullbackComp g f).inv.app M ≫ (pullback g).map b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc]
  rw [← (pullback g).map_comp, h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullbackRecoveryAlong_transition

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullback_transport_recovery_square
statement:
theorem pullback_transport_recovery_square
    {V W W' Y Y' Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (l : V ⟶ W) (f : W ⟶ Y) (k : Y ⟶ Z)
    (a : W ⟶ Y') (q : Y' ⟶ Z) (b : V ⟶ W') (r : W' ⟶ Y')
    (hc : f ≫ k = a ≫ q) (ho : b ≫ r = l ≫ a)
    (M : Z.Modules) {P : Y'.Modules} {Q : W.Modules}
    (c : (Scheme.Modules.pullback q).obj M ⟶ P)
    (θ : (Scheme.Modules.pullback a).obj P ≅ Q) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp l f).inv.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback k).obj M) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback l).map
        ((pullbackComparisonSquareIso f k a q hc M).hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback a).map c ≫ θ.hom) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback l).map θ.inv ≫
        (pullbackComparisonSquareIso l a b r ho.symm P).hom =
    (pullbackComparisonSquareIso (l ≫ f) k b (r ≫ q)
      (by rw [Category.assoc, hc, ← Category.assoc, ← ho, Category.assoc]) M).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback b).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp r q).inv.app M ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback r).map c)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [pullbackComparisonSquareIso, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom,
    Iso.app_hom, Iso.app_inv, Category.assoc] using
    Scheme.Modules.pullback_transport_recovery l f k a q b r hc ho M c θ

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullback_transport_recovery_named
statement:
theorem pullback_transport_recovery_named
    {V W W' Y Y' Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (l : V ⟶ W) (f : W ⟶ Y) (k : Y ⟶ Z)
    (a : W ⟶ Y') (q : Y' ⟶ Z) (b : V ⟶ W') (r : W' ⟶ Y')
    (hc : f ≫ k = a ≫ q) (ho : b ≫ r = l ≫ a)
    (M : Z.Modules) {P : Y'.Modules} {Q : W.Modules}
    (c : (Scheme.Modules.pullback q).obj M ⟶ P)
    (θ : (Scheme.Modules.pullback a).obj P ≅ Q)
    (v : (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback k).obj M) ⟶ Q)
    (η : (Scheme.Modules.pullback l).obj Q ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback b).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback r).obj P))
    (hv : v = (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f k).hom.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr hc).hom.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp a q).inv.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback a).map c ≫ θ.hom)
    (hη : η = (Scheme.Modules.pullback l).mapIso θ.symm ≪≫
      pullbackComparisonSquareIso l a b r ho.symm P) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp l f).inv.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback k).obj M) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback l).map v ≫ η.hom =
    (pullbackComparisonSquareIso (l ≫ f) k b (r ≫ q)
      (by rw [Category.assoc, hc, ← Category.assoc, ← ho, Category.assoc]) M).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback b).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp r q).inv.app M ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback r).map c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hv, hη]
  simpa only [pullbackComparisonSquareIso, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom,
    Iso.app_hom, Iso.app_inv, Functor.mapIso_hom, Category.assoc] using
    Scheme.Modules.pullback_transport_recovery l f k a q b r hc ho M c θ

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistTransportLeftRecovery
statement:
theorem canonicalTwistTransportLeftRecovery (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (i j : C'.I) :
    let l
proof:
:= (transport e C').overlapToChart i j
    let f := (transport e C').chartι i
    let k := (transportSchemeIso e C').hom
    let a := (chartIso e C' i).hom
    let q := C'.chartι i
    let b := (overlapIso e C' i j).hom
    let r := C'.overlapToChart i j
    let M := C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1
    let c := C'.canonicalTwistPullbackRecovery 1 i
    let θ := chartTwistIso e C' i
    let hc : f ≫ k = a ≫ q := chartι_transportSchemeIso_hom e C' i
    let ho : b ≫ r = l ≫ a := overlapIso_hom_toChart e C' i j
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp l f).inv.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback k).obj M) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback l).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f k).hom.app M ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr hc).hom.app M ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp a q).inv.app M ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback a).map c ≫ θ.hom) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback l).map θ.inv ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp l a).hom.app (C'.chartTwistingSheaf 1 i) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr ho.symm).hom.app (C'.chartTwistingSheaf 1 i) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp b r).inv.app (C'.chartTwistingSheaf 1 i) =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (l ≫ f) k).hom.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (show (l ≫ f) ≫ k = b ≫ (r ≫ q) from
        by rw [Category.assoc, hc, ← Category.assoc, ← ho, Category.assoc])).hom.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp b (r ≫ q)).inv.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback b).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp r q).inv.app M ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback r).map c) :=
  Scheme.Modules.pullback_transport_recovery
    ((transport e C').overlapToChart i j) ((transport e C').chartι i)
    (transportSchemeIso e C').hom (chartIso e C' i).hom (C'.chartι i)
    (overlapIso e C' i j).hom (C'.overlapToChart i j)
    (chartι_transportSchemeIso_hom e C' i) (overlapIso_hom_toChart e C' i j)
    (C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (C'.canonicalTwistPullbackRecovery 1 i)
    (chartTwistIso e C' i)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistTransportRightRecovery
statement:
theorem canonicalTwistTransportRightRecovery (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (i j : C'.I) :

proof:
:= ((transport e C').transition i j ≫ (transport e C').overlapToChart j i)
    let f := (transport e C').chartι j
    let k := (transportSchemeIso e C').hom
    let a := (chartIso e C' j).hom
    let q := C'.chartι j
    let b := (overlapIso e C' i j).hom
    let r := (C'.transition i j ≫ C'.overlapToChart j i)
    let M := C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1
    let c := C'.canonicalTwistPullbackRecovery 1 j
    let θ := chartTwistIso e C' j
    let hc : f ≫ k = a ≫ q := chartι_transportSchemeIso_hom e C' j
    let ho : b ≫ r = l ≫ a := overlapIso_hom_toSecondChart e C' i j
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp l f).inv.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback k).obj M) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback l).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f k).hom.app M ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr hc).hom.app M ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp a q).inv.app M ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback a).map c ≫ θ.hom) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback l).map θ.inv ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp l a).hom.app (C'.chartTwistingSheaf 1 j) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr ho.symm).hom.app (C'.chartTwistingSheaf 1 j) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp b r).inv.app (C'.chartTwistingSheaf 1 j) =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (l ≫ f) k).hom.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (show (l ≫ f) ≫ k = b ≫ (r ≫ q) from
        by rw [Category.assoc, hc, ← Category.assoc, ← ho, Category.assoc])).hom.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp b (r ≫ q)).inv.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback b).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp r q).inv.app M ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback r).map c) :=
  Scheme.Modules.pullback_transport_recovery
    (((transport e C').transition i j ≫ (transport e C').overlapToChart j i)) ((transport e C').chartι j)
    (transportSchemeIso e C').hom (chartIso e C' j).hom (C'.chartι j)
    (overlapIso e C' i j).hom ((C'.transition i j ≫ C'.overlapToChart j i))
    (chartι_transportSchemeIso_hom e C' j) (overlapIso_hom_toSecondChart e C' i j)

statement:
theorem transportTwistPullbackChartIso_left_recovery_square (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (i j : C'.I) :
    let l
proof:
:= (transport e C').overlapToChart i j
    let f := (transport e C').chartι i
    let k := (transportSchemeIso e C').hom
    let a := (chartIso e C' i).hom
    let q := C'.chartι i
    let b := (overlapIso e C' i j).hom

    let c := C'.canonicalTwistPullbackRecovery 1 i
    let hc : f ≫ k = a ≫ q := chartι_transportSchemeIso_hom e C' i
    let ho : b ≫ r = l ≫ a := overlapIso_hom_toChart e C' i j
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp l f).inv.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback k).obj M) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback l).map (transportTwistPullbackChartIso e C' i).hom ≫
      (twistOverlapSourceTransportIso e C' i j).hom =

      (Scheme.Modules.pullback b).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp r q).inv.app M ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback r).map c) :=
  pullback_transport_recovery_named
    ((transport e C').overlapToChart i j) ((transport e C').chartι i)
    (transportSchemeIso e C').hom (chartIso e C' i).hom (C'.chartι i)
    (overlapIso e C' i j).hom (C'.overlapToChart i j)
    (chartι_transportSchemeIso_hom e C' i) (overlapIso_hom_toChart e C' i j)
    (C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (C'.canonicalTwistPullbackRecovery 1 i)
    (chartTwistIso e C' i) (transportTwistPullbackChartIso e C' i).hom
    (twistOverlapSourceTransportIso e C' i j)
    (transportTwistPullbackChartIso_recovery_formula e C' i)
    (twistOverlapSourceTransportIso_eq_square e C' i j)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistPullbackChartIso_right_recovery_square
statement:
theorem transportTwistPullbackChartIso_right_recovery_square (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (i j : C'.I) :
    let l
proof:
:= ((transport e C').transition i j ≫ (transport e C').overlapToChart j i)
    let f := (transport e C').chartι j
    let k := (transportSchemeIso e C').hom
    let a := (chartIso e C' j).hom
    let q := C'.chartι j
    let b := (overlapIso e C' i j).hom
    let r := (C'.transition i j ≫ C'.overlapToChart j i)
    let M := C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1
    let c := C'.canonicalTwistPullbackRecovery 1 j
    let hc : f ≫ k = a ≫ q := chartι_transportSchemeIso_hom e C' j
    let ho : b ≫ r = l ≫ a := overlapIso_hom_toSecondChart e C' i j
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp l f).inv.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback k).obj M) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback l).map (transportTwistPullbackChartIso e C' j).hom ≫
      (twistOverlapTargetTransportIso e C' i j).hom =
    (pullbackComparisonSquareIso (l ≫ f) k b (r ≫ q)
      (by rw [Category.assoc, hc, ← Category.assoc, ← ho, Category.assoc]) M).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback b).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp r q).inv.app M ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback r).map c) :=
  pullback_transport_recovery_named
    (((transport e C').transition i j ≫ (transport e C').overlapToChart j i)) ((transport e C').chartι j)
    (transportSchemeIso e C').hom (chartIso e C' j).hom (C'.chartι j)
    (overlapIso e C' i j).hom ((C'.transition i j ≫ C'.overlapToChart j i))
    (chartι_transportSchemeIso_hom e C' j) (overlapIso_hom_toSecondChart e C' i j)
    (C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (C'.canonicalTwistPullbackRecovery 1 j)
    (chartTwistIso e C' j) (transportTwistPullbackChartIso e C' j).hom
    (twistOverlapTargetTransportIso e C' i j)
    (transportTwistPullbackChartIso_recovery_formula e C' j)
    (twistOverlapTargetTransportIso_eq_square e C' i j)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullback_transport_squareIso_congr
statement:
theorem pullback_transport_squareIso_congr
    {V Y Z W : Scheme.{u}} {f f' : V ⟶ Y} (k : Y ⟶ Z)
    (b : V ⟶ W) {g g' : W ⟶ Z}
    (hf : f = f') (hg : g = g')
    (hc : f ≫ k = b ≫ g) (hc' : f' ≫ k = b ≫ g') (M : Z.Modules) :
    (pullbackComparisonSquareIso f k b g hc M).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback b).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr hg).hom.app M) =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr hf).hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback k).obj M) ≫
      (pullbackComparisonSquareIso f' k b g' hc' M).hom
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [pullbackComparisonSquareIso, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom,
    Iso.app_hom, Iso.app_inv, Category.assoc] using
    Scheme.Modules.pullback_transport_square_congr k b hf hg hc hc' M

statement:

      (transport e C').chartι j) ≫ (transportSchemeIso e C').hom =

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistOverlapAmbientIso_transition
statement:
theorem transportTwistOverlapAmbientIso_transition (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (i j : C'.I) :
    let D
proof:
:= C'.twistingSheafDescentData 1 (C'.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1)
    let Dn := (transport e C').twistingSheafDescentData 1
      ((transport e C').canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1)
    (transportTwistOverlapLeftAmbientIso e C' i j).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (overlapIso e C' i j).hom).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (D.fac (i,j))).hom.app D.descended) =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (Dn.fac (i,j))).hom.app
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (transportSchemeIso e C').hom).obj D.descended) ≫
      (transportTwistOverlapRightAmbientIso e C' i j).hom := by
  exact pullback_transport_squareIso_congr
    (transportSchemeIso e C').hom (overlapIso e C' i j).hom
    (((transport e C').twistingSheafDescentData 1
      ((transport e C').canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1)).fac (i,j))
    ((C'.twistingSheafDescentData 1 (C'.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1)).fac (i,j))
    (transportTwistOverlapAmbient_fac e C' i j)
    (transportTwistOverlapSecondAmbient_fac e C' i j) (C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tensorOverlap_tr_pullback_conjugation
statement:
theorem tensorOverlap_tr_pullback_conjugation
    {Y Z W : Scheme.{u}} (s : W ⟶ Y) (q : Z ⟶ Y) (r : W ⟶ Z)
    [IsOpenImmersion s] [IsOpenImmersion q] [IsOpenImmersion r]
    (h : r ≫ q = s) {M N : Y.Modules}
    (φ : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj M ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj N) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback s).inv.app M ≫
      tensorOverlap_tr s q r h φ ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback s).hom.app N =
    (pullbackRestrictionCompIso s q r h M).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback r).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).inv.app M ≫ φ ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).hom.app N) ≫
      (pullbackRestrictionCompIso s q r h N).inv
proof:
:= by
  let ψ := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).inv.app M ≫ φ ≫
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).hom.app N
  have hn : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback r).hom.app
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).obj M) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback r).map ψ ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback r).inv.app
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).obj N) =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor r).map ψ := by
    simpa only [Iso.app_hom, Iso.app_inv] using
      (restrictFunctor_map_eq_pullback_map_conj r ψ).symm
  have hc : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).hom.app M ≫ ψ ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).inv.app N = φ := by
    dsimp only [ψ]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app, Category.comp_id]
  simp only [pullbackRestrictionCompIso, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.trans_inv,
    Iso.symm_hom, Iso.symm_inv, Iso.app_hom, Iso.app_inv, Functor.mapIso_hom,
    Functor.mapIso_inv, Category.assoc]
  rw [reassoc_of% hn]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc, ← Functor.map_comp_assoc]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [hc]
  simp only [tensorOverlap_tr, restrictCompPrefixIso', Iso.trans_hom, Iso.trans_inv,
    Iso.app_hom, Iso.app_inv, Category.assoc]

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenSectionsEquiv_algebraMap

      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op g
proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrict_pushforwardPullbackUnit_isIso_of_isPullback
statement:
theorem restrict_pushforwardPullbackUnit_isIso_of_isPullback
    {W X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (i : X ⟶ Z) (j : Y ⟶ Z) (f : W ⟶ X) (g : W ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion i] [IsOpenImmersion g]
    (hp : IsPullback f g i j) (M : Y.Modules) :
    IsIso
      ((restrictFunctor i).map
        (pushforwardPullbackUnit j g M))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Hom.isIso_iff_isIso_app]
  intro U
  let V := j ⁻¹ᵁ (i ''ᵁ U)
  have hBC :
      g ''ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) = V := by
    dsimp only [V]
    exact
      IsOpenImmersion.image_preimage_eq_preimage_image_of_isPullback
        hp U
  have hV : g ''ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ V) = V := by
    rw [← hBC, Scheme.Hom.preimage_image_eq g]
  let η :=
    Hom.app
      ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app M) V
  let c :=
    Hom.app
      ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback g).inv.app M)
        (g ⁻¹ᵁ V)
  have hη :
      η ≫ c =
        Hom.app
          ((restrictAdjunction g).unit.app M) V := by
    have h := congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ.app V)
      (pullbackUnit_restrictFunctorIsoPullback_inv g M)
    simpa only [Hom.comp_app, pushforward_map_app] using h
  haveI hc : IsIso c := by
    dsimp only [c]
    infer_instance
  haveI hunit :
      IsIso
        (Hom.app
          ((restrictAdjunction g).unit.app M) V) := by
    rw [restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app]
    change IsIso
      (M.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (g.image_preimage_le V)).op)
    let e : op V ≅ op (g ''ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ V)) :=
      eqToIso (congrArg op hV.symm)
    have he :
        (homOfLE (g.image_preimage_le V)).op = e.hom :=
      Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [he]
    infer_instance
  haveI hηc : IsIso (η ≫ c) := by
    rw [hη]
    infer_instance
  haveI hηiso : IsIso η :=
    IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right η c
  unfold pushforwardPullbackUnit
  rw [Functor.map_comp, Hom.comp_app]
  change IsIso
    (η ≫
      Hom.app
        ((pushforwardComp g j).hom.app
          ((pullback g).obj M))
          (i ''ᵁ U))
  infer_instance

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeSheafHom_ι
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeSheafHom_ι
    (hpos : ∀ k : C.I, Nonempty (C.basisIndex k))
    (d : ℕ) :
    let D
proof:
:=
      (C.pushforwardInducedSymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem hpos d).descentData
    C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeSheafHom hpos d ≫
        kernel.ι (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight) =
      C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartCochain hpos d := by
  dsimp only
  let D :=
    (C.pushforwardInducedSymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem hpos d).descentData
  let a := C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartCochain hpos d
  let ha := C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartCochain_compatible hpos d
  change D.lift a ha ≫ kernel.ι (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight) = a
  exact D.lift_ι a ha

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeSheafHom_component
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeSheafHom_component
    (hpos : ∀ k : C.I, Nonempty (C.basisIndex k))
    (i : C.I) (d : ℕ) :
    C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeSheafHom hpos d ≫
        (C.pushforwardInducedSymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem
          hpos d).descentData.component i =
      C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartTerm hpos i d
proof:
:= by
  let D :=
    (C.pushforwardInducedSymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem hpos d).descentData
  let f := C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartCochain hpos d
  let hf := C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartCochain_compatible hpos d
  change D.lift f hf ≫ D.component i =
    C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartTerm hpos i d
  dsimp only [Scheme.Modules.DescentData.component]
  rw [← Category.assoc, D.lift_ι]
  exact C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartCochain_π hpos i d

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeSheafHom_restrictionProjection
statement:
theorem canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeSheafHom_restrictionProjection
    (hpos : ∀ k : C.I, Nonempty (C.basisIndex k))
    (i : C.I) (d : ℕ) :
    let D
proof:
:=
      (C.pushforwardInducedSymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem hpos d).descentData
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.U i).ι).map
          (C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeSheafHom hpos d) ≫
        (@Scheme.Modules.DescentData.restrictionProjection
          _ _ D i (by
            dsimp only [D, SymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem.descentData]
            infer_instance)) =
      (C.positiveRankCanonicalTwistingSheafPushforwardRestrictionIso
        i d).hom := by
  dsimp only
  let D :=
    (C.pushforwardInducedSymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem hpos d).descentData
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.U i).ι
  let M := C.canonicalTwistingSheafPushforward d
  let e :=
    C.positiveRankCanonicalTwistingSheafPushforwardRestrictionIso i d
  change
    G.map (C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeSheafHom hpos d) ≫
          G.map (D.component i) ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction (C.U i).ι).counit.app
              (C.chartSymmetricDegreeSheaf i d) =
      e.hom
  rw [← G.map_comp_assoc,
    C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeSheafHom_component hpos i d]
  have hterm :
      C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartTerm hpos i d =
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction (C.U i).ι).unit.app M ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.U i).ι).map e.hom := by
    dsimp only [canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartTerm,
      canonicalPushforwardPullbackToChartSymmetricDegreeIso, M, e]
    simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.app_inv,
      Functor.map_comp]
    exact Scheme.Modules.pullbackUnit_restrictFunctorIsoPullback_inv_assoc
      (C.U i).ι (C.canonicalTwistingSheafPushforward d)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.U i).ι).map
        (C.positiveRankCanonicalTwistingSheafPushforwardRestrictionIso
          i d).hom)
  let adj := Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction (C.U i).ι
  have hcounit :
      G.map ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.U i).ι).map e.hom) ≫
          adj.counit.app (C.chartSymmetricDegreeSheaf i d) =
        adj.counit.app (G.obj M) ≫ e.hom := by
    simpa only [Functor.comp_map, Functor.id_map] using
      adj.counit.naturality e.hom
  have htriangle :
      G.map (adj.unit.app M) ≫ adj.counit.app (G.obj M) =
        𝟙 (G.obj M) :=
    adj.left_triangle_components M
  calc
    G.map (C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartTerm hpos i d) ≫
          adj.counit.app (C.chartSymmetricDegreeSheaf i d) =
        G.map (adj.unit.app M ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.U i).ι).map e.hom) ≫
            adj.counit.app (C.chartSymmetricDegreeSheaf i d) :=
      congrArg
        (fun k ↦ G.map k ≫
          adj.counit.app (C.chartSymmetricDegreeSheaf i d)) hterm
    _ = G.map (adj.unit.app M) ≫
          G.map ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.U i).ι).map e.hom) ≫
            adj.counit.app (C.chartSymmetricDegreeSheaf i d) := by
      rw [Functor.map_comp]
      exact Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = G.map (adj.unit.app M) ≫ adj.counit.app (G.obj M) ≫
          e.hom :=
      congrArg (fun k ↦ G.map (adj.unit.app M) ≫ k) hcounit
    _ = e.hom := by
      calc
        G.map (adj.unit.app M) ≫ adj.counit.app (G.obj M) ≫ e.hom =
            (G.map (adj.unit.app M) ≫ adj.counit.app (G.obj M)) ≫
              e.hom :=
          (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
        _ = (𝟙 (G.obj M)) ≫ e.hom :=
          congrArg (fun k ↦ k ≫ e.hom) htriangle
        _ = e.hom := Category.id_comp _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeLocalCochain_project
statement:
theorem canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeLocalCochain_project
    (hpos : ∀ k : C.I, Nonempty (C.basisIndex k))
    (i : C.I) (d : ℕ) :
    let D
proof:
:=
      (C.pushforwardInducedSymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem hpos d).descentData
    C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeLocalCochain hpos i d ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.U i).ι).map
          (Pi.π D.chartTerm i) =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso
        (C.U i).ι).inv.app (C.chartSymmetricDegreeSheaf i d) := by
  dsimp only
  let D :=
    (C.pushforwardInducedSymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem hpos d).descentData
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.U i).ι
  let M := C.canonicalTwistingSheafPushforward d
  let N := C.chartSymmetricDegreeSheaf i d
  let e :=
    C.positiveRankCanonicalTwistingSheafPushforwardRestrictionIso i d
  let a := C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartCochain hpos d
  let f := C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeSheafHom hpos d
  let ε := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso
    (C.U i).ι).app N
  change (e.inv ≫ G.map a) ≫ G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm i) = ε.inv
  apply (cancel_mono ε.hom).1
  have ha :
      a ≫ Pi.π D.chartTerm i =
        f ≫ D.component i := by
    exact
      (C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartCochain_π
        hpos i d).trans
          (C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeSheafHom_component
            hpos i d).symm
  have hf :
      G.map f ≫
          (@Scheme.Modules.DescentData.restrictionProjection
            _ _ D i (by
              dsimp only [D, SymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem.descentData]
              infer_instance)) =
        e.hom :=
    C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeSheafHom_restrictionProjection
      hpos i d
  change
    ((e.inv ≫ G.map a) ≫ G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm i)) ≫ ε.hom =
      ε.inv ≫ ε.hom
  calc
    ((e.inv ≫ G.map a) ≫ G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm i)) ≫ ε.hom =
        e.inv ≫ G.map (a ≫ Pi.π D.chartTerm i) ≫ ε.hom := by
      simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
    _ = e.inv ≫ G.map (f ≫ D.component i) ≫ ε.hom :=
      congrArg (fun q ↦ e.inv ≫ G.map q ≫ ε.hom) ha
    _ = e.inv ≫
          (G.map f ≫ G.map (D.component i) ≫ ε.hom) := by
      simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
    _ = e.inv ≫ e.hom := by
      exact congrArg (fun q ↦ e.inv ≫ q) hf
    _ = 𝟙 N := e.inv_hom_id
    _ = ε.inv ≫ ε.hom := ε.inv_hom_id.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.symmetricDegreeRestrictedRightLeg_isIso
statement:
theorem symmetricDegreeRestrictedRightLeg_isIso
    (hpos : ∀ k : C.I, Nonempty (C.basisIndex k))
    (i j : C.I) (d : ℕ) :
    IsIso (C.symmetricDegreeRestrictedRightLeg hpos i j d)
proof:
:= by
  let D :=
    (C.pushforwardInducedSymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem hpos d).descentData
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.U i).ι
  let r :=
    X.homOfLE
      (inf_le_right : C.U i ⊓ C.U j ≤ C.U j)
  haveI hunit :
      IsIso
        (G.map
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit
            (D.toAmbient j) (D.right (i, j)) (D.module j))) := by
    dsimp only [D, G, r, SymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem.descentData]
    exact
      Scheme.Modules.restrict_pushforwardPullbackUnit_isIso_of_isPullback
        (C.U i).ι (C.U j).ι
        (X.homOfLE
          (inf_le_left : C.U i ⊓ C.U j ≤ C.U i))
        (X.homOfLE
          (inf_le_right : C.U i ⊓ C.U j ≤ C.U j))
        (isPullback_opens_inf (C.U i) (C.U j))
        (C.chartSymmetricDegreeSheaf j d)
  dsimp only [symmetricDegreeRestrictedRightLeg]
  infer_instance

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.symmetricDegree_cancel_aux
statement:
theorem symmetricDegree_cancel_aux {𝒞 : Type*} [CategoryTheory.Category 𝒞]
    {W A Bi Bj Y Z : 𝒞} (K : W ⟶ A) (Pi : A ⟶ Bi) (Pj : A ⟶ Bj)
    (rL : Bi ⟶ Z) (rR : Bj ⟶ Z) (ε : Bi ⟶ Y) (F : Y ⟶ A)
    (hK : (K ≫ Pi) ≫ rL = (K ≫ Pj) ≫ rR)
    (hε : rL = ε ≫ F ≫ Pj ≫ rR) :
    (K ≫ Pj) ≫ rR = (((K ≫ Pi) ≫ ε ≫ F) ≫ Pj) ≫ rR
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (K ≫ Pj) ≫ rR = (K ≫ Pi) ≫ rL := hK.symm
    _ = (K ≫ Pi) ≫ (ε ≫ F ≫ Pj ≫ rR) := congrArg (fun q ↦ (K ≫ Pi) ≫ q) hε
    _ = (((K ≫ Pi) ≫ ε ≫ F) ≫ Pj) ≫ rR := by simp only [CategoryTheory.Category.assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.symmetricDegreeRestrictedKernel_generatedByLocalCochain
statement:
theorem symmetricDegreeRestrictedKernel_generatedByLocalCochain
    (hpos : ∀ k : C.I, Nonempty (C.basisIndex k))
    (i : C.I) (d : ℕ) :
    let D
proof:
:=
      (C.pushforwardInducedSymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem hpos d).descentData
    let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.U i).ι
    G.map (kernel.ι (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight)) =
      G.map (kernel.ι (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight)) ≫
        G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm i) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso
          (C.U i).ι).hom.app (C.chartSymmetricDegreeSheaf i d) ≫
        C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeLocalCochain hpos i d := by
  dsimp only
  let D :=
    (C.pushforwardInducedSymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem hpos d).descentData
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.U i).ι
  let N := C.chartSymmetricDegreeSheaf i d
  let a := C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartCochain hpos d
  let e :=
    C.positiveRankCanonicalTwistingSheafPushforwardRestrictionIso i d
  let F := C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeLocalCochain hpos i d
  let ε := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso
    (C.U i).ι).app N
  change
    G.map (kernel.ι (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight)) =
      G.map (kernel.ι (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight)) ≫
        G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm i) ≫ ε.hom ≫ F
  apply (cancel_mono
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictPiIso (C.U i).ι D.chartTerm).hom).1
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro j
  slice_lhs 2 3 =>
    rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictPiIso_hom_π]
  slice_rhs 5 6 =>
    rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictPiIso_hom_π]
  let rL :=
    G.map
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit
        (D.toAmbient i) (D.left (i, j)) (D.module i))
  let rR := C.symmetricDegreeRestrictedRightLeg hpos i j d
  letI : IsIso rR :=
    C.symmetricDegreeRestrictedRightLeg_isIso hpos i j d
  have hKij :
      (G.map
          (kernel.ι (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight)) ≫
        G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm i)) ≫ rL =
      (G.map
          (kernel.ι (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight)) ≫
        G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm j)) ≫ rR := by
    have h := congrArg (fun q ↦ G.map q)
      (D.component_compatibility (i, j))
    simp only [Scheme.Modules.DescentData.component,
      Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc] at h
    simpa only [rL, rR, symmetricDegreeRestrictedRightLeg,
      Category.assoc] using h
  have haij :
      (a ≫ Pi.π D.chartTerm i) ≫
          Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit
            (D.toAmbient i) (D.left (i, j)) (D.module i) =
        (a ≫ Pi.π D.chartTerm j) ≫
          Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit
            (D.toAmbient j) (D.right (i, j)) (D.module j) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr
            (D.fac (i, j)).symm).hom.app
              ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (D.right (i, j))).obj
                (D.module j)) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward
            (D.left (i, j) ≫ D.toAmbient i)).map
              (D.transition (i, j)).inv := by
    let q := Pi.π
      (fun kl : C.I × C.I ↦ D.overlapTerm kl) (i, j)
    calc
      (a ≫ Pi.π D.chartTerm i) ≫
            Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit
              (D.toAmbient i) (D.left (i, j)) (D.module i) =
          (a ≫ D.descentLeft) ≫ q := by
        simp only [q, Category.assoc, D.descentLeft_π]
      _ = (a ≫ D.descentRight) ≫ q :=
        congrArg (fun k ↦ k ≫ q)
          (C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartCochain_compatible
            hpos d)
      _ = (a ≫ Pi.π D.chartTerm j) ≫
            Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit
              (D.toAmbient j) (D.right (i, j)) (D.module j) ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr
              (D.fac (i, j)).symm).hom.app
                ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (D.right (i, j))).obj
                  (D.module j)) ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pushforward
              (D.left (i, j) ≫ D.toAmbient i)).map
                (D.transition (i, j)).inv := by
        simp only [q, Category.assoc, D.descentRight_π]
  have hFij :
      (F ≫ G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm i)) ≫ rL =
        (F ≫ G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm j)) ≫ rR := by
    have h := congrArg (fun q ↦ e.inv ≫ G.map q) haij
    simpa only [F, canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeLocalCochain,
      rL, rR, symmetricDegreeRestrictedRightLeg,
      Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc] using h
  have hεF :
      ε.hom ≫ F ≫ G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm i) = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [← Category.assoc]
    calc
      ε.hom ≫ (F ≫ G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm i)) =
          ε.hom ≫ ε.inv :=
        congrArg (fun q ↦ ε.hom ≫ q)
          (C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeLocalCochain_project
            hpos i d)
      _ = 𝟙 _ := ε.hom_inv_id
  have hεFij :
      rL =
        ε.hom ≫ F ≫ G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm j) ≫ rR := by
    calc
      rL =
          (ε.hom ≫ F ≫ G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm i)) ≫ rL := by
        rw [hεF, Category.id_comp]
      _ = ε.hom ≫
          ((F ≫ G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm i)) ≫ rL) := by
        simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = ε.hom ≫
          ((F ≫ G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm j)) ≫ rR) :=
        congrArg (fun q ↦ ε.hom ≫ q) hFij
      _ = _ := by simp only [Category.assoc]
  apply (cancel_mono rR).1
  simpa only [Category.assoc] using
    symmetricDegree_cancel_aux (G.map (kernel.ι (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight)))
      (G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm i)) (G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm j)) rL rR ε.hom F hKij hεFij

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.symmetricDegreeLocalKernelLift_restrictionProjection
statement:
theorem symmetricDegreeLocalKernelLift_restrictionProjection
    (hpos : ∀ k : C.I, Nonempty (C.basisIndex k))
    (i : C.I) (d : ℕ) :
    let D
proof:
:=
      (C.pushforwardInducedSymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem hpos d).descentData
    C.symmetricDegreeLocalKernelLift hpos i d ≫
        (@Scheme.Modules.DescentData.restrictionProjection
          _ _ D i (by
            dsimp only [D, SymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem.descentData]
            infer_instance)) =
      𝟙 (C.chartSymmetricDegreeSheaf i d) := by
  dsimp only
  let D :=
    (C.pushforwardInducedSymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem hpos d).descentData
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.U i).ι
  let e :=
    C.positiveRankCanonicalTwistingSheafPushforwardRestrictionIso i d
  let f := C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeSheafHom hpos d
  let p :=
    @Scheme.Modules.DescentData.restrictionProjection
      _ _ D i (by
        dsimp only [D, SymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem.descentData]
        infer_instance)
  change (e.inv ≫ G.map f) ≫ p = 𝟙 _
  have hf : G.map f ≫ p = e.hom :=
    C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeSheafHom_restrictionProjection
      hpos i d
  calc
    (e.inv ≫ G.map f) ≫ p =
        e.inv ≫ (G.map f ≫ p) := Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = e.inv ≫ e.hom :=
      congrArg (fun q ↦ e.inv ≫ q) hf
    _ = 𝟙 _ := e.inv_hom_id

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.symmetricDegreeLocalKernelLift_ι
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem symmetricDegreeLocalKernelLift_ι
    (hpos : ∀ k : C.I, Nonempty (C.basisIndex k))
    (i : C.I) (d : ℕ) :
    let D
proof:
:=
      (C.pushforwardInducedSymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem hpos d).descentData
    let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.U i).ι
    C.symmetricDegreeLocalKernelLift hpos i d ≫
        G.map (kernel.ι (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight)) =
      C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeLocalCochain hpos i d := by
  dsimp only
  let D :=
    (C.pushforwardInducedSymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem hpos d).descentData
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.U i).ι
  let e :=
    C.positiveRankCanonicalTwistingSheafPushforwardRestrictionIso i d
  let f := C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeSheafHom hpos d
  let a := C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartCochain hpos d
  change
    (e.inv ≫ G.map f) ≫
        G.map (kernel.ι (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight)) =
      e.inv ≫ G.map a
  rw [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp,
    C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeSheafHom_ι hpos d]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.symmetricDegreeRestrictionProjection_localKernelLift
statement:
theorem symmetricDegreeRestrictionProjection_localKernelLift
    (hpos : ∀ k : C.I, Nonempty (C.basisIndex k))
    (i : C.I) (d : ℕ) :
    let D
proof:
:=
      (C.pushforwardInducedSymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem hpos d).descentData
    (@Scheme.Modules.DescentData.restrictionProjection
        _ _ D i (by
          dsimp only [D, SymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem.descentData]
          infer_instance)) ≫
        C.symmetricDegreeLocalKernelLift hpos i d =
      𝟙 ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.U i).ι).obj
        (C.pushforwardInducedSymmetricDegreeSheaf hpos d)) := by
  dsimp only
  let D :=
    (C.pushforwardInducedSymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem hpos d).descentData
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.U i).ι
  let φ := D.descentLeft - D.descentRight
  letI : G.Additive := by
    constructor
    intro A B q r
    rfl
  letI : G.PreservesZeroMorphisms :=
    Functor.preservesZeroMorphisms_of_additive G
  letI : G.PreservesHomology :=
    Functor.preservesHomology_of_map_exact G
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor_map_exact (C.U i).ι)
  letI : PreservesLimit (parallelPair φ 0) G :=
    Functor.PreservesHomology.preservesKernel G φ
  let N := C.chartSymmetricDegreeSheaf i d
  let F := C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeLocalCochain hpos i d
  let p :=
    @Scheme.Modules.DescentData.restrictionProjection
      _ _ D i (by
        dsimp only [D, SymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem.descentData]
        infer_instance)
  let l := C.symmetricDegreeLocalKernelLift hpos i d
  have hgen := C.symmetricDegreeRestrictedKernel_generatedByLocalCochain hpos i d
  dsimp only at hgen
  change p ≫ l = 𝟙 _
  apply (cancel_mono
    (G.map (kernel.ι (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight)))).1
  calc
    (p ≫ l) ≫
          G.map (kernel.ι (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight)) =
        p ≫ F := by
      rw [Category.assoc,
        C.symmetricDegreeLocalKernelLift_ι hpos i d]
    _ = (G.map (kernel.ι (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight)) ≫
          G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm i)) ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso
              (C.U i).ι).hom.app N ≫ F := by
      dsimp only [p, Scheme.Modules.DescentData.restrictionProjection,
        Scheme.Modules.DescentData.component]
      rw [Functor.map_comp]
      dsimp only [D, G, N,
        SymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem.descentData]
      simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = G.map (kernel.ι (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight)) :=
      (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans hgen.symm
    _ = 𝟙 _ ≫
          G.map (kernel.ι (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight)) :=
      (Category.id_comp _).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeSheafHom_restrict_isIso
statement:
theorem canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeSheafHom_restrict_isIso
    (hpos : ∀ k : C.I, Nonempty (C.basisIndex k))
    (i : C.I) (d : ℕ) :
    IsIso
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.U i).ι).map
        (C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeSheafHom hpos d))
proof:
:= by
  let D :=
    (C.pushforwardInducedSymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem hpos d).descentData
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.U i).ι
  let f := C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeSheafHom hpos d
  let p :=
    @Scheme.Modules.DescentData.restrictionProjection
      _ _ D i (by
        dsimp only [D, SymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem.descentData]
        infer_instance)
  haveI hp : IsIso p := by
    change IsIso (C.symmetricDegreeLocalKernelIso hpos i d).inv
    infer_instance
  haveI hcomp : IsIso (G.map f ≫ p) := by
    rw [C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeSheafHom_restrictionProjection
      hpos i d]
    infer_instance
  exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right (G.map f) p

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeSheafHom_isIso
statement:
theorem canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeSheafHom_isIso
    (hpos : ∀ k : C.I, Nonempty (C.basisIndex k))
    (d : ℕ) :
    IsIso (C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeSheafHom hpos d)
proof:
:= by
  let f := C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeSheafHom hpos d
  let hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop C.U :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := X) C.U).2 C.covers
  letI : IsIso
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).map f) := by
    apply Sheaf.isIso_of_coversTop hU
    intro i
    letI hrestrict :
        IsIso
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.U i).ι).map f) :=
      C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeSheafHom_restrict_isIso
        hpos i d
    letI hover : IsIso (f.over (C.U i)) :=
      overMap_isIso_of_restrictMap f (C.U i)
    exact Functor.map_isIso
      (SheafOfModules.toSheaf (X.ringCatSheaf.over (C.U i)))
      (f.over (C.U i))
  let F := SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf
  let hF : F.ReflectsIsomorphisms := by
    have : (F ⋙ sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
        AddCommGrpCat).ReflectsIsomorphisms :=
      inferInstanceAs ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
        PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf X.ringCatSheaf.obj).ReflectsIsomorphisms)
    exact reflectsIsomorphisms_of_comp F
      (sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat)
  exact hF.reflects f

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.inv_map_comp_eq_comp_inv_map
statement:
private theorem inv_map_comp_eq_comp_inv_map
    {C : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} C] {D : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} D]
    (F : C ⥤ D) {X' X Y' Y : C}
    (r : X' ⟶ X) (d' : X' ⟶ Y') (d : X ⟶ Y) (r' : Y' ⟶ Y)
    [IsIso (F.map r)] [IsIso (F.map r')]
    (h : d' ≫ r' = r ≫ d) :
    inv (F.map r) ≫ F.map d' = F.map d ≫ inv (F.map r')
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (F.map r')).1
  rw [Category.assoc, ← F.map_comp, h, F.map_comp]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.stalkFunctor_map_bijective_of_app_bijective_below
statement:
theorem stalkFunctor_map_bijective_of_app_bijective_below
    {F G : TopCat.Presheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} X} (f : F ⟶ G)
    (x : X) (U : Opens X) (hxU : x ∈ U)
    (hf : ∀ (V : Opens X), V ≤ U → Function.Bijective (f.app (op V))) :
    Function.Bijective ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map f)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro s t hst
    obtain ⟨U₁, hU₁U, hxU₁, s, rfl⟩ := F.exists_le_germ_eq s hxU
    obtain ⟨U₂, hU₂U, hxU₂, t, rfl⟩ := F.exists_le_germ_eq t hxU
    rw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply,
      TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply] at hst
    obtain ⟨W, hxW, iWU₁, iWU₂, heq⟩ := G.germ_eq x hxU₁ hxU₂ _ _ hst
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
      ← f.naturality, ← f.naturality,
      ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at heq
    replace heq := (hf W (iWU₁.le.trans hU₁U)).1 heq
    exact F.germ_ext W hxW iWU₁ iWU₂ heq
  · intro t
    obtain ⟨V, hVU, hxV, s, hs⟩ := G.exists_le_germ_eq t hxU
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := (hf V hVU).2 s
    refine ⟨F.germ V x hxV r, ?_⟩
    rw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply, hr, hs]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.freeAbPresheafMap_app_bijective_below
statement:
theorem freeAbPresheafMap_app_bijective_below
    {U V W : Opens X} (i : U ⟶ V) (hWU : W ≤ U) :
    Function.Bijective
      ((Functor.whiskerRight (yoneda.map i) AddCommGrpCat.free).app (op W))
proof:
:= by
  let j : W ⟶ U := homOfLE hWU
  have hi : Function.Bijective ((yoneda.map i).app (op W)) := by
    change Function.Bijective (fun g : W ⟶ U ↦ g ≫ i)
    exact ⟨
      fun _ _ _ ↦ Subsingleton.elim _ _,
      fun _ ↦ ⟨j, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩⟩
  haveI : IsIso ((yoneda.map i).app (op W)) :=
    (isIso_iff_bijective _).2 hi
  change Function.Bijective
    (AddCommGrpCat.free.map ((yoneda.map i).app (op W)))
  exact ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.freeAbSheafMap_stalk_isIso_of_app_bijective_below
statement:
theorem freeAbSheafMap_stalk_isIso_of_app_bijective_below
    {U V : Opens X} (i : U ⟶ V) (x : X) (N : Opens X) (hxN : x ∈ N)
    (hf : ∀ (W : Opens X), W ≤ N → Function.Bijective
      ((Functor.whiskerRight (yoneda.map i) AddCommGrpCat.free).app (op W))) :
    IsIso ((TopCat.Sheaf.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u} X ⋙
      TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map
        (TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque.freeAbSheafMap i))
proof:
:= by
  let P := yoneda.obj U ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free
  let Q := yoneda.obj V ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free
  let f : P ⟶ Q := Functor.whiskerRight (yoneda.map i) AddCommGrpCat.free
  let S := TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x
  haveI hf' : IsIso (S.map f) :=
    (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective _).2
      (stalkFunctor_map_bijective_of_app_bijective_below f x N hxN hf)
  haveI hP : IsIso (S.map (CategoryTheory.toSheafify
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) P)) :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_unit_toSheafify_isIso x AddCommGrpCat.{u} P
  haveI hQ : IsIso (S.map (CategoryTheory.toSheafify
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) Q)) :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_unit_toSheafify_isIso x AddCommGrpCat.{u} Q
  change IsIso (S.map (CategoryTheory.sheafifyMap
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) f))
  have hnat :
      S.map (CategoryTheory.toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) P) ≫
          S.map (CategoryTheory.sheafifyMap (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) f) =
        S.map f ≫
          S.map (CategoryTheory.toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) Q) := by
    rw [← S.map_comp, ← S.map_comp, CategoryTheory.toSheafify_naturality]
  haveI : IsIso
      (S.map (CategoryTheory.toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) P) ≫
        S.map (CategoryTheory.sheafifyMap (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) f)) := by
    rw [hnat]
    infer_instance
  exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_left
    (S.map (CategoryTheory.toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) P)) _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.freeAbSheafMap_stalk_isIso
statement:
theorem freeAbSheafMap_stalk_isIso
    {U V : Opens X} (i : U ⟶ V) (x : X) (hxU : x ∈ U) :
    IsIso ((TopCat.Sheaf.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u} X ⋙
      TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map
        (TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque.freeAbSheafMap i))
proof:
:= by
  exact freeAbSheafMap_stalk_isIso_of_app_bijective_below i x U hxU
    (fun W hWU ↦ freeAbPresheafMap_app_bijective_below i hWU)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.freeAbPresheafMap_inf_app_bijective_below
statement:
theorem freeAbPresheafMap_inf_app_bijective_below
    (U V W : Opens X) (hWU : W ≤ U) :
    Function.Bijective
      ((Functor.whiskerRight
        (yoneda.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ≤ V)))
          AddCommGrpCat.free).app (op W))
proof:
:= by
  let i : U ⊓ V ⟶ V := homOfLE inf_le_right
  have hi : Function.Bijective ((yoneda.map i).app (op W)) := by
    change Function.Bijective (fun g : W ⟶ U ⊓ V ↦ g ≫ i)
    constructor
    · intro _ _ _
      exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    · intro z
      refine ⟨homOfLE (le_inf hWU z.le), ?_⟩
      exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  haveI : IsIso ((yoneda.map i).app (op W)) :=
    (isIso_iff_bijective _).2 hi
  change Function.Bijective (AddCommGrpCat.free.map ((yoneda.map i).app (op W)))
  exact ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.freeAbSheafMap_inf_stalk_isIso
statement:
theorem freeAbSheafMap_inf_stalk_isIso
    (U V : Opens X) (x : X) (hxU : x ∈ U) :
    IsIso ((TopCat.Sheaf.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u} X ⋙
      TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map
        (TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque.freeAbSheafMap
          (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ≤ V))))
proof:
:= by
  exact freeAbSheafMap_stalk_isIso_of_app_bijective_below
    (homOfLE inf_le_right) x U hxU
      (fun W hWU ↦ freeAbPresheafMap_inf_app_bijective_below U V W hWU)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechPrependIndex_comp_delta_zero
statement:
theorem coordinateCechPrependIndex_comp_delta_zero
    (p : ℕ) (i₀ : Fin (n + 1))
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateCechPrependIndex n i₀ a ∘
        (SimplexCategory.δ (0 : Fin (p + 2))).toOrderHom.toFun = a
proof:
:= by
  funext t

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechPrependIndex_comp_delta_succ
statement:
theorem coordinateCechPrependIndex_comp_delta_succ
    (p : ℕ) (i₀ : Fin (n + 1))
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) (j : Fin (p + 2)) :
    coordinateCechPrependIndex n i₀ a ∘
        (SimplexCategory.δ j.succ).toOrderHom.toFun =
      coordinateCechPrependIndex n i₀
        (a ∘ (SimplexCategory.δ j).toOrderHom.toFun)
proof:
:= by
  funext t
  cases t using Fin.cases with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ t =>
      simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      rw [show
        (SimplexCategory.δ j.succ).toOrderHom.toFun t.succ =
          (j.succAbove t).succ by
        exact Fin.succ_succAbove_succ j t]
      rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechPrependIndex_comp_sigma_succ
statement:
theorem coordinateCechPrependIndex_comp_sigma_succ
    (p : ℕ) (i₀ : Fin (n + 1))
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) (j : Fin (p + 1)) :
    coordinateCechPrependIndex n i₀ a ∘
        (SimplexCategory.σ j.succ).toOrderHom.toFun =
      coordinateCechPrependIndex n i₀
        (a ∘ (SimplexCategory.σ j).toOrderHom.toFun)
proof:
:= by
  funext t
  cases t using Fin.cases with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ t =>
      simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      rw [show
        (SimplexCategory.σ j.succ).toOrderHom.toFun t.succ =
          (j.predAbove t).succ by
        exact Fin.succ_predAbove_succ j t]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechPrependPresheafMap_bijective_below
statement:
theorem coordinateCechPrependPresheafMap_bijective_below
    (i₀ : Fin (n + 1)) {p : ℕ} (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (W : (space k n).Opens) (hW : W ≤ coordinateCechCover k n i₀) :
    Function.Bijective
      ((Functor.whiskerRight
        (yoneda.map (coordinateCechPrependProjection k n i₀ a))
          AddCommGrpCat.free).app (op W))
proof:
:= by
  let i := coordinateCechPrependProjection k n i₀ a
  have hi : Function.Bijective ((yoneda.map i).app (op W)) := by
    change Function.Bijective (fun g : W ⟶ _ ↦ g ≫ i)
    constructor
    · intro _ _ _
      exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    · intro z
      refine ⟨Pi.lift (Fin.cases (homOfLE hW) (fun j ↦ z ≫ Pi.π _ j)), ?_⟩
      exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  haveI : IsIso ((yoneda.map i).app (op W)) :=
    (isIso_iff_bijective _).2 hi
  change Function.Bijective (AddCommGrpCat.free.map ((yoneda.map i).app (op W)))
  exact ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechPrependProjection_stalk_isIso
statement:
theorem coordinateCechPrependProjection_stalk_isIso
    (x : (space k n).toPresheafedSpace) (i₀ : Fin (n + 1))
    (hx : x ∈ coordinateCechCover k n i₀)
    {p : ℕ} (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    IsIso ((coordinateCechStalkFunctor k n x).map
      (coordinateCechPrependProjection k n i₀ a))
proof:
:= by
  exact freeAbSheafMap_stalk_isIso_of_app_bijective_below
    (coordinateCechPrependProjection k n i₀ a) x
      (coordinateCechCover k n i₀) hx
      (coordinateCechPrependPresheafMap_bijective_below k n i₀ a)

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.TripleRangeData.cocycleToFirstLocal_fac
statement:

theorem cocycleToFirstLocal_fac (U V W : X.affineOpens)

theorem cocycleToSecondLocal_fac (U V W : X.affineOpens)

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.TripleRangeData.cocycle_first_transition
statement:
theorem cocycle_first_transition (U V W : X.affineOpens)
