name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechNativeHigherCoface_apply
statement:
theorem coordinateCechNativeHigherCoface_apply
    (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (x : coordinateCechHigherTerm k n M p)
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (Pi.π
      (fun b : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
        M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) b)))
      a).hom
        ((coordinateCechNativeHigherCoface k n M p r).hom x) =
      coordinateCechDeleteRestriction k n M a r
        ((Pi.π
          (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
            M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b)))
          (a ∘ r.succAbove)).hom x)
proof:
:= by
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (coordinateCechHigherCoface_component k n M p r a) x

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential_apply
statement:
theorem coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential_apply
    (p : ℕ) (x : coordinateCechHigherTerm k n M p)
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (Pi.π
      (fun b : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
        M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) b)))
      a).hom
        ((coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom x) =
      ∑ r : Fin (p + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
        coordinateCechDeleteRestriction k n M a r
          ((Pi.π
            (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b)))
            (a ∘ r.succAbove)).hom x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential_eq_alternatingCofaces]
  let ev :
      (coordinateCechHigherTerm k n M p ⟶
        coordinateCechHigherTerm k n M (p + 1)) →+
          coordinateCechHigherTerm k n M (p + 1) :=
    { toFun := fun f ↦ f.hom x
      map_zero' := rfl
      map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl }
  have hsum :
      (∑ r : Fin (p + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
          coordinateCechNativeHigherCoface k n M p r).hom x =
        ∑ r : Fin (p + 2),
          (((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
            coordinateCechNativeHigherCoface k n M p r).hom x := by
    change ev (∑ r : Fin (p + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
      coordinateCechNativeHigherCoface k n M p r) = _
    exact map_sum ev _ Finset.univ
  rw [hsum, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  change
    (Pi.π
      (fun b : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
        M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) b)))
      a).hom
        (((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
          (coordinateCechNativeHigherCoface k n M p r).hom x) =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
        coordinateCechDeleteRestriction k n M a r
          ((Pi.π
            (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b)))
            (a ∘ r.succAbove)).hom x)
  rw [map_zsmul]
  congr 1
  exact coordinateCechNativeHigherCoface_apply k n M p r x a

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechFixedSupportWord_support
statement:
theorem coordinateCechFixedSupportWord_support
    (S : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (m : ℕ) (hS : S.card = m)
    {p : ℕ} (v : {v : Fin (p + 1) → Fin m // Function.Surjective v}) :
    coordinateCechWordSupport n
        (coordinateCechFixedSupportWord n S m hS v) = S
proof:
:=
  (coordinateCechWordSupport_comp_eq_of_surjective n
      (coordinateCechSupportEnumeration n S m hS) v.1 v.2).trans
    (coordinateCechWordSupport_enumeration n S m hS)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechFixedSupportCochain_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateCechFixedSupportCochain_apply
    (S : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (m : ℕ) (hS : S.card = m)
    (p : ℕ) (x : coordinateCechHigherTerm k n M p)
    (v : {v : Fin (p + 1) → Fin m // Function.Surjective v}) :
    coordinateCechFixedSupportCochain k n M S m hS p x v =
      (coordinateCechWordSectionIsoOfSupportEq k n M
        (coordinateCechFixedSupportWord n S m hS v) S
        (coordinateCechFixedSupportWord_support n S m hS v)).hom
          ((Pi.π
            (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b)))
            (coordinateCechFixedSupportWord n S m hS v)).hom x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechFixedSupportCochain_differential
statement:
theorem coordinateCechFixedSupportCochain_differential
    (S : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (m : ℕ) (hS : S.card = m)
    (p : ℕ) (x : coordinateCechHigherTerm k n M p)
    (hxsmall :
      ∀ a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1),
        (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card < m →
          (Pi.π
            (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b)))
            a).hom x = 0) :
    surjectiveWordModuleDifferential ℤ
        (coordinateCechSupportSections k n M S) m p
        (coordinateCechFixedSupportCochain k n M S m hS p x) =
      coordinateCechFixedSupportCochain k n M S m hS (p + 1)
        ((coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom x)
proof:
:= by
  funext v
  rw [surjectiveWordModuleDifferential_apply]
  rw [coordinateCechFixedSupportCochain_apply,
    coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential_apply]
  rw [map_sum]
  simp_rw [map_zsmul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  by_cases h : Function.Surjective (v.1 ∘ r.succAbove)
  · rw [dif_pos h, coordinateCechFixedSupportCochain_apply]
    let vr : {w : Fin (p + 1) → Fin m // Function.Surjective w} :=
      ⟨v.1 ∘ r.succAbove, h⟩
    have htarget :
        coordinateCechWordSupport n
            (coordinateCechFixedSupportWord n S m hS v) = S :=
      coordinateCechFixedSupportWord_support n S m hS v
    have hdelete :
        coordinateCechWordSupport n
            (coordinateCechFixedSupportWord n S m hS v ∘
              r.succAbove) = S := by
      change coordinateCechWordSupport n
        (coordinateCechSupportEnumeration n S m hS ∘
          (v.1 ∘ r.succAbove)) = S
      exact
        (coordinateCechWordSupport_comp_eq_of_surjective n
          (coordinateCechSupportEnumeration n S m hS)
          (v.1 ∘ r.succAbove) h).trans
            (coordinateCechWordSupport_enumeration n S m hS)
    have hcomp :=
      coordinateCechDeleteRestriction_comp_supportSectionIso
        k n M (coordinateCechFixedSupportWord n S m hS v) r
          S htarget hdelete
    have helem := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hcomp
      ((Pi.π
        (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
          M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b)))
        (coordinateCechFixedSupportWord n S m hS v ∘
          r.succAbove)).hom x)
    have hz := congrArg (fun z ↦ ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) • z) helem.symm
    simpa only [vr, coordinateCechFixedSupportWord,
      Function.comp_def, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] using hz
  · rw [dif_neg h]
    have hlt :
        (coordinateCechWordSupport n
          (coordinateCechFixedSupportWord n S m hS v ∘
            r.succAbove)).card < m := by
      simpa only [coordinateCechFixedSupportWord, Function.comp_def] using
        coordinateCechWordSupport_card_comp_lt_of_injective_of_not_surjective
          n (coordinateCechSupportEnumeration n S m hS)
            (coordinateCechSupportEnumeration_injective n S m hS)
              (v.1 ∘ r.succAbove) h
    have hxzero := hxsmall
      (coordinateCechFixedSupportWord n S m hS v ∘ r.succAbove) hlt
    rw [hxzero, map_zero, map_zero, smul_zero]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechFixedSupport_cocycle_is_boundary
statement:
theorem coordinateCechFixedSupport_cocycle_is_boundary
    (S : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (m : ℕ) (hS : S.card = m)
    (p : ℕ) (hmp : m ≤ p + 1)
    (x : coordinateCechHigherTerm k n M (p + 1))
    (hxsmall :
      ∀ a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1),
        (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card < m →
          (Pi.π
            (fun b : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              M.presheaf.obj
                (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) b)))
            a).hom x = 0)
    (hcycle :
      (coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M (p + 1)).hom x = 0) :
    ∃ b : surjectiveWordModuleCochain
        (coordinateCechSupportSections k n M S) m p,
      surjectiveWordModuleDifferential ℤ
          (coordinateCechSupportSections k n M S) m p b =
        coordinateCechFixedSupportCochain k n M S m hS (p + 1) x
proof:
:= by
  have hc :
      surjectiveWordModuleDifferential ℤ
          (coordinateCechSupportSections k n M S) m (p + 1)
          (coordinateCechFixedSupportCochain k n M S m hS (p + 1) x) = 0 := by
    rw [coordinateCechFixedSupportCochain_differential
      k n M S m hS (p + 1) x hxsmall, hcycle]
    funext v
    rw [coordinateCechFixedSupportCochain_apply]
    simp
  exact surjectiveWordAddCommGroup_cocycle_is_boundary
    (coordinateCechSupportSections k n M S) m p hmp
      (coordinateCechFixedSupportCochain k n M S m hS (p + 1) x) hc

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechWordToSupportIndex_surjective
statement:
theorem coordinateCechWordToSupportIndex_surjective
    {p m : ℕ} (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (ha : (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card = m) :
    Function.Surjective (coordinateCechWordToSupportIndex n a ha)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  let iS : coordinateCechWordSupport n a :=
    (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).orderIsoOfFin ha i
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ :=
    (mem_coordinateCechWordSupport_iff n a iS.1).1 iS.2
  refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
  apply ((coordinateCechWordSupport n a).orderIsoOfFin ha).injective
  change
    (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).orderIsoOfFin ha
        (((coordinateCechWordSupport n a).orderIsoOfFin ha).symm
          ⟨a t, _⟩) =
      (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).orderIsoOfFin ha i
  rw [((coordinateCechWordSupport n a).orderIsoOfFin ha).apply_symm_apply]
  exact Subtype.ext ht

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechSupportEnumeration_comp_wordToSupportIndex
statement:
theorem coordinateCechSupportEnumeration_comp_wordToSupportIndex
    {p m : ℕ} (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (ha : (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card = m) :
    coordinateCechSupportEnumeration n
        (coordinateCechWordSupport n a) m ha ∘
      coordinateCechWordToSupportIndex n a ha = a
proof:
:= by
  funext t
  change
    (((coordinateCechWordSupport n a).orderIsoOfFin ha)
      (((coordinateCechWordSupport n a).orderIsoOfFin ha).symm
        ⟨a t, _⟩)).1 = a t
  rw [((coordinateCechWordSupport n a).orderIsoOfFin ha).apply_symm_apply]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechWordToSupportIndex_fixedSupportWord
statement:
theorem coordinateCechWordToSupportIndex_fixedSupportWord
    (S : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (m : ℕ) (hS : S.card = m)
    {p : ℕ} (v : {v : Fin (p + 1) → Fin m // Function.Surjective v}) :
    coordinateCechWordToSupportIndex n
        (coordinateCechFixedSupportWord n S m hS v)
        (by
          rw [coordinateCechFixedSupportWord_support n S m hS v]
          exact hS) =
      v.1
proof:
:= by
  let a := coordinateCechFixedSupportWord n S m hS v
  let ha : (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card = m := by
    rw [coordinateCechFixedSupportWord_support n S m hS v]
    exact hS
  have hsupport : coordinateCechWordSupport n a = S :=
    coordinateCechFixedSupportWord_support n S m hS v
  have henum :
      coordinateCechSupportEnumeration n
          (coordinateCechWordSupport n a) m ha =
        coordinateCechSupportEnumeration n S m hS := by
    funext i
    simp [coordinateCechSupportEnumeration, Finset.orderEmbOfFin_apply,
      hsupport]
  have hrec :=
    coordinateCechSupportEnumeration_comp_wordToSupportIndex n a ha
  rw [henum] at hrec
  funext t
  apply coordinateCechSupportEnumeration_injective n S m hS
  have ht := congrFun hrec t
  simpa only [a, coordinateCechFixedSupportWord, Function.comp_apply] using ht

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechFixedSupportPrimitiveExtension_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateCechFixedSupportPrimitiveExtension_apply
    (m p : ℕ)
    (b : ∀ S : CoordinateCechSupportOfCard n m,
      surjectiveWordModuleCochain
        (coordinateCechSupportSections k n M S.1) m p)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (Pi.π
      (fun c : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
        M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p c)))
      a).hom
        (coordinateCechFixedSupportPrimitiveExtension k n M m p b) =
      coordinateCechFixedSupportPrimitiveValue k n M m p b a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [coordinateCechFixedSupportPrimitiveExtension, map_sum,
    Finset.sum_eq_single a]
  · rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, Pi.ι_π_eq_id,
      ConcreteCategory.id_apply]
  · intro c _ hc
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, Pi.ι_π_of_ne _ hc]
    rfl
  · intro ha
    exact (ha (Finset.mem_univ a)).elim

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechWordSectionIso_primitiveValue_of_support_eq
statement:
theorem coordinateCechWordSectionIso_primitiveValue_of_support_eq
    (m p : ℕ)
    (b : ∀ T : CoordinateCechSupportOfCard n m,
      surjectiveWordModuleCochain
        (coordinateCechSupportSections k n M T.1) m p)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (S : Finset (Fin (n + 1)))
    (ha : coordinateCechWordSupport n a = S)
    (hS : S.card = m) :
    (coordinateCechWordSectionIsoOfSupportEq k n M a S ha).hom
        (coordinateCechFixedSupportPrimitiveValue k n M m p b a) =
      b ⟨S, hS⟩
        ⟨coordinateCechWordToSupportIndex n a
            (by rw [ha]; exact hS),
          coordinateCechWordToSupportIndex_surjective n a
            (by rw [ha]; exact hS)⟩
proof:
:= by
  subst S
  dsimp only [coordinateCechFixedSupportPrimitiveValue]
  rw [dif_pos hS]
  exact Iso.hom_inv_id_apply _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechFixedSupportCochain_primitiveExtension
statement:
theorem coordinateCechFixedSupportCochain_primitiveExtension
    (S : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (m : ℕ) (hS : S.card = m)
    (p : ℕ)
    (b : ∀ T : CoordinateCechSupportOfCard n m,
      surjectiveWordModuleCochain
        (coordinateCechSupportSections k n M T.1) m p) :
    coordinateCechFixedSupportCochain k n M S m hS p
        (coordinateCechFixedSupportPrimitiveExtension k n M m p b) =
      b ⟨S, hS⟩
proof:
:= by
  funext v
  rw [coordinateCechFixedSupportCochain_apply,
    coordinateCechFixedSupportPrimitiveExtension_apply]
  rw [coordinateCechWordSectionIso_primitiveValue_of_support_eq
    k n M m p b (coordinateCechFixedSupportWord n S m hS v)
      S (coordinateCechFixedSupportWord_support n S m hS v) hS]
  apply congrArg (b ⟨S, hS⟩)
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact coordinateCechWordToSupportIndex_fixedSupportWord n S m hS v

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechFixedSupportPrimitiveExtension_differential_apply_of_card
statement:
theorem coordinateCechFixedSupportPrimitiveExtension_differential_apply_of_card
    (m p : ℕ)
    (x : coordinateCechHigherTerm k n M (p + 1))
    (b : ∀ S : CoordinateCechSupportOfCard n m,
      surjectiveWordModuleCochain
        (coordinateCechSupportSections k n M S.1) m p)
    (hb : ∀ S : CoordinateCechSupportOfCard n m,
      surjectiveWordModuleDifferential ℤ
          (coordinateCechSupportSections k n M S.1) m p (b S) =
        coordinateCechFixedSupportCochain k n M S.1 m S.2 (p + 1) x)
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (ha : (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card = m) :
    (Pi.π
      (fun c : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
        M.presheaf.obj
          (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) c)))
      a).hom
        ((coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom
          (coordinateCechFixedSupportPrimitiveExtension k n M m p b)) =
      (Pi.π
        (fun c : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
          M.presheaf.obj
            (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) c)))
        a).hom x
proof:
:= by
  let S : CoordinateCechSupportOfCard n m :=
    ⟨coordinateCechWordSupport n a, ha⟩
  let v : {v : Fin (p + 2) → Fin m // Function.Surjective v} :=
    ⟨coordinateCechWordToSupportIndex n a ha,
      coordinateCechWordToSupportIndex_surjective n a ha⟩
  let y :=
    coordinateCechFixedSupportPrimitiveExtension k n M m p b
  have hysmall :
      ∀ c : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1),
        (coordinateCechWordSupport n c).card < m →
          (Pi.π
            (fun d : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              M.presheaf.obj
                (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p d)))
            c).hom y = 0 := by
    intro c hc
    rw [coordinateCechFixedSupportPrimitiveExtension_apply]
    dsimp only [coordinateCechFixedSupportPrimitiveValue]
    rw [dif_neg (ne_of_lt hc)]
  have hchain :=
    coordinateCechFixedSupportCochain_differential
      k n M S.1 m S.2 p y hysmall
  rw [coordinateCechFixedSupportCochain_primitiveExtension
    k n M S.1 m S.2 p b] at hchain
  have hextract :
      coordinateCechFixedSupportCochain k n M S.1 m S.2 (p + 1)
          ((coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom y) =
        coordinateCechFixedSupportCochain k n M S.1 m S.2 (p + 1) x :=
    hchain.symm.trans (hb S)
  have hv := congrFun hextract v
  rw [coordinateCechFixedSupportCochain_apply,
    coordinateCechFixedSupportCochain_apply] at hv
  have hword :
      coordinateCechFixedSupportWord n S.1 m S.2 v = a := by
    exact coordinateCechSupportEnumeration_comp_wordToSupportIndex n a ha
  have hcomponent := (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
    (coordinateCechWordSectionIsoOfSupportEq k n M
      (coordinateCechFixedSupportWord n S.1 m S.2 v) S.1
        (coordinateCechFixedSupportWord_support n S.1 m S.2 v)).hom).1 hv
  rw [hword] at hcomponent
  simpa only [y] using hcomponent

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechFixedSupportLayer_cocycle_primitive
statement:
theorem coordinateCechFixedSupportLayer_cocycle_primitive
    (m p : ℕ) (hmp : m ≤ p + 1)
    (x : coordinateCechHigherTerm k n M (p + 1))
    (hxsmall :
      ∀ a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1),
        (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card < m →
          (Pi.π
            (fun c : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              M.presheaf.obj
                (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) c)))
            a).hom x = 0)
    (hcycle :
      (coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M (p + 1)).hom x = 0) :
    ∃ y : coordinateCechHigherTerm k n M p,
      (∀ a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1),
        (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card = m →
          (Pi.π
            (fun c : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              M.presheaf.obj
                (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) c)))
            a).hom
              ((coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom y) =
            (Pi.π
              (fun c : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
                M.presheaf.obj
                  (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) c)))
              a).hom x) ∧
      (∀ a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1),
        (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card ≠ m →
          (Pi.π
            (fun c : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              M.presheaf.obj
                (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p c)))
            a).hom y = 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hprimitive (S : CoordinateCechSupportOfCard n m) :=
    coordinateCechFixedSupport_cocycle_is_boundary
      k n M S.1 m S.2 p hmp x hxsmall hcycle
  choose b hb using hprimitive
  let y :=
    coordinateCechFixedSupportPrimitiveExtension k n M m p b
  refine ⟨y, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a ha
    exact coordinateCechFixedSupportPrimitiveExtension_differential_apply_of_card
      k n M m p x b hb a ha
  · intro a ha
    rw [coordinateCechFixedSupportPrimitiveExtension_apply]
    dsimp only [coordinateCechFixedSupportPrimitiveValue]
    rw [dif_neg ha]

name: SchemeCurveCharacteristicClasses.degree_rationalChowClassOfFunctionFieldDivisor
statement:
theorem degree_rationalChowClassOfFunctionFieldDivisor
    (W : FunctionField.Divisor k X.functionField) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.rationalGradedDegreeOfStructureSheafFinite k
        (SchemeBridge.structureSheaf_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
        (rationalChowClassOfFunctionFieldDivisor k W) =
      (AlgebraicCycle.degree k
        (schemeWeilDivisorOfFunctionFieldDivisor k W).1 : ℚ)
proof:

    chowWeilDivisorOfFunctionFieldDivisor] using

name: SchemeCurveCharacteristicClasses.tangentFirstChernOfCanonicalDivisor_half_degree
statement:
theorem tangentFirstChernOfCanonicalDivisor_half_degree
    (W : FunctionField.Divisor k X.functionField)
    (hW : FunctionField.IsCanonical k X.functionField W) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.rationalGradedDegreeOfStructureSheafFinite k
        (SchemeBridge.structureSheaf_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
        (((1 : ℚ) / 2) • tangentFirstChernOfCanonicalDivisor k W) =
      ((AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.structureSheafModule X).eulerChar k : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tangentFirstChernOfCanonicalDivisor]
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.rationalGradedDegreeOfStructureSheafFinite_smul, map_neg]
  change (1 / 2 : ℚ) *
      (-AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.rationalGradedDegreeOfStructureSheafFinite k
        (SchemeBridge.structureSheaf_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
          (rationalChowClassOfFunctionFieldDivisor k W)) = _
  rw [degree_rationalChowClassOfFunctionFieldDivisor k W]
  rw [SchemeBridge.degree_weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor]
  rw [show SchemeBridge.weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor k
      (schemeWeilDivisorOfFunctionFieldDivisor k W) = W from
    (SchemeBridge.weilDivisorEquivFunctionFieldDivisor k).apply_symm_apply W]
  rw [FunctionField.deg_canonical k X.functionField hW]
  rw [← SchemeBridge.schemeGenus_eq_functionField_genus (X := X) k]
  rw [structureSheafEulerChar_eq_one_sub_schemeGenus k]
  push_cast
  ring

name: SchemeCurveCharacteristicClasses.integral_canonicalToddClass

    integral
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.rationalGradedDegreeOfStructureSheafFinite k

        (toddClass (canonicalTangentFirstChern (X := X) k)) =

name: SchemeCurveCharacteristicClasses.eulerChar_eq_geometric_integral_of_cartierWalk
statement:
theorem eulerChar_eq_geometric_integral_of_cartierWalk
    (E : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X M})
    (n : ℤ)
    (walk : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.CartierWalk k
      (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.structureModule X) E.1 n)
    (hrank : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X E.1 = 1)
    (hfirstChern :
      AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.rationalGradedDegreeOfStructureSheafFinite k
          (SchemeBridge.structureSheaf_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
          ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] SchemeKTheory.determinantFirstChern X E.1 E.2) =
        (n : ℚ)) :
    (E.1.eulerChar k : ℚ) =
      AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.rationalGradedDegreeOfStructureSheafFinite k
        (SchemeBridge.structureSheaf_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
        ((geometricAdditiveChernData X).rank E •
            (((1 : ℚ) / 2) • canonicalTangentFirstChern (X := X) k) +
          (geometricAdditiveChernData X).firstChern E)
proof:
:= by
  have hrankQ : (geometricAdditiveChernData X).rank E = 1 := by
    change (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X E.1 : ℚ) = 1
    exact congrArg (fun m : ℕ ↦ (m : ℚ)) hrank
  have h := eulerChar_eq_integral_rank_firstChern_of_cartierWalk_additive
    k (geometricAdditiveChernData X) E n walk
      (canonicalTangentFirstChern (X := X) k)
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.rationalGradedDegreeOfStructureSheafFinite k
        (SchemeBridge.structureSheaf_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k))
      hrankQ hfirstChern (canonicalTangentFirstChern_half_degree (X := X) k)
  simpa only [add_comm] using h

name: SchemeCurveCharacteristicClasses.eulerChar_eq_geometric_characteristicNumber_of_cartierWalk
statement:
theorem eulerChar_eq_geometric_characteristicNumber_of_cartierWalk
    (E : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X M})
    (n : ℤ)
    (walk : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.CartierWalk k
      (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.structureModule X) E.1 n)
    (hrank : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X E.1 = 1)
    (hfirstChern :
      AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.rationalGradedDegreeOfStructureSheafFinite k
          (SchemeBridge.structureSheaf_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
          ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] SchemeKTheory.determinantFirstChern X E.1 E.2) =
        (n : ℚ)) :
    (E.1.eulerChar k : ℚ) =
      integral
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.rationalGradedDegreeOfStructureSheafFinite k
          (SchemeBridge.structureSheaf_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k))
        (geometricAdditiveChernCharacter X
            (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ E) *
          toddClass (canonicalTangentFirstChern (X := X) k))
proof:
:= by
  change (E.1.eulerChar k : ℚ) =
    integral
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.rationalGradedDegreeOfStructureSheafFinite k
        (SchemeBridge.structureSheaf_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k))
      ((geometricAdditiveChernData X).chernCharacter
          (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ E) *
        toddClass (canonicalTangentFirstChern (X := X) k))
  rw [integral_additiveChernCharacter_mul_toddClass,
    CurveAdditiveChernData.chernCharacter_classOf]
  exact eulerChar_eq_geometric_integral_of_cartierWalk k E n walk hrank hfirstChern

name: SchemeCurveCharacteristicClasses.degree_determinantFirstChern_of_genericRank_one

  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorClass,

name: SchemeCurveCharacteristicClasses.formula_of_geometricFreeCartierPresentations

theorem formula_of_geometricFreeCartierPresentations

:=

statement:

      GeometricCurveFreeCartierPresentation k E)
    (z : SchemeKTheory.K0 X) :
    (SchemeKTheory.k0Euler k
        (fun E hE ↦ (hpresentation ⟨E, hE⟩).targetFinite) z : ℚ) =
      integral

    ((geometricAdditiveChernData X).chernCharacter z *

name: SheafOfModules.Presentation.mapOfFreeIso_isFinite
statement:
theorem Presentation.mapOfFreeIso_isFinite {M : SheafOfModules.{u} R} (P : M.Presentation)
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} R ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} R)
    [PreservesColimitsOfShape WalkingParallelPair F] [F.PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    {σ ι : Type u} [Finite σ] [Finite ι] (a : free (R := R) σ ≅ F.obj (free P.generators.I))
    (b : free (R := R) ι ≅ F.obj (free P.relations.I)) :
    (P.mapOfFreeIso F a b).IsFinite where
  isFiniteType_generators
proof:
:= { finite := by change Finite σ; infer_instance }
  isFiniteType_relations := { finite := by change Finite ι; infer_instance }

name: SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation_copower
statement:
theorem isFinitePresentation_copower (I : Type u) [Finite I] (M : SheafOfModules.{u} R)
    [M.IsFinitePresentation] : ((copowerFunctor (R := R) I).obj M).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := IsFinitePresentation.exists_quasicoherentData M
  haveI : (q.copower I).IsFinitePresentation := QuasicoherentData.copower_isFinitePresentation q I
  exact IsFinitePresentation.mk (R := R) (M := (copowerFunctor (R := R) I).obj M)
    ⟨q.copower I, this⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf_isCoherentLike
statement:
theorem tensorSheaf_isCoherentLike (V F : X.Modules) (hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree X V)
    (hF : IsCoherentLike X F) : IsCoherentLike X (tensorSheaf X V F)
proof:
:= by
  letI instWOverAb : ∀ U : X.Opens,
      ((Opens.grothendieckTopology ↥X).over U).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u} :=
    fun U ↦ inferInstance
  letI instHOverAb : ∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasWeakSheafify ((Opens.grothendieckTopology ↥X).over U) AddCommGrpCat.{u} :=
    fun U ↦ inferInstance
  letI instW2 : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (Z : Over U),
      (((Opens.grothendieckTopology ↥X).over U).over Z).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u} :=
    fun U Z ↦ inferInstance
  letI instH2 : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (Z : Over U),
      HasWeakSheafify (((Opens.grothendieckTopology ↥X).over U).over Z) AddCommGrpCat.{u} :=
    fun U Z ↦ inferInstance
  letI : F.IsFinitePresentation := hF
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin⟩ := hV.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := hqfin
  haveI : ∀ i, ((tensorSheaf X V F).over (q.X i)).IsFinitePresentation := by
    intro i
    let U := q.X i
    letI : (q.generators i).IsFiniteType :=
      SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType i
    let I := (q.generators i).I
    letI : Finite I := by
      dsimp only [I]
      infer_instance
    let e : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) I ≅ V.over U :=
      asIso (q.generators i).π
    haveI : (F.over U).IsFinitePresentation := SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation_over F U
    have h0 : ((finiteCopowerOverFunctor X U I).obj (F.over U)).IsFinitePresentation :=
      SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation_copower I _
    let E : (finiteCopowerOverFunctor X U I).obj (F.over U) ≅ (tensorSheaf X V F).over U :=
      (tensorSheafOverFreeLeftNatIso X U I).symm.app (F.over U) ≪≫
        (tensorSheafOverLeftFunctorMapIso X U e).app (F.over U) ≪≫
        (tensorSheafLeftFunctorOverNatIso X U V).app F
    exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).prop_of_iso E h0
  exact SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation_of_over_cover (tensorSheaf X V F) q.X q.coversTop

name: SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafRightFunctor_map_shortExact_of_finiteLocallyFree_right
statement:
theorem tensorSheafRightFunctor_map_shortExact_of_finiteLocallyFree_right (F : X.Modules)
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact) (h₃ : IsFiniteLocallyFree X S.X₃) :
    (S.map (tensorSheafRightFunctor X F)).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  choose V hxV hsplit using
    Scheme.Modules.exists_open_splitting_of_shortExact_finiteLocallyFree_right X S hS h₃
  have hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop V := by
    apply (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := X) V).2
    rw [TopologicalSpace.IsOpenCover, eq_top_iff]
    intro x _
    exact Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨x, hxV x⟩
  apply Scheme.Modules.shortExact_of_over_cover X _ V hU
  intro x
  let T := tensorSheafOverLeftFunctor X (V x) (F.over (V x))
  have h1 : ((S.map (overRestrictionFunctor X (V x))).map T).ShortExact :=
    ((hsplit x).some.map T).shortExact
  have h2 : (S.map (overRestrictionFunctor X (V x) ⋙ T)).ShortExact := by
    simpa only [ShortComplex.map_comp] using h1
  have h3 : (S.map (tensorSheafLeftFunctor X F ⋙ overRestrictionFunctor X (V x))).ShortExact :=
    ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso (S.mapNatIso (tensorSheafLeftFunctorOverNatIso X (V x) F)) h2
  have h4 : (S.map (tensorSheafRightFunctor X F ⋙ overRestrictionFunctor X (V x))).ShortExact :=
    ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso
      (S.mapNatIso (Functor.isoWhiskerRight (tensorSheafRightFunctorIsoLeftFunctor X F) _).symm) h3
  simpa only [ShortComplex.map_comp] using h4

name: SchemeKTheory.shortExactIn_of_shortComplex
statement:
private theorem shortExactIn_of_shortComplex {P : X.Modules → Prop}
    (A B D : {E : X.Modules // P E}) (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (hA : A.1 = S.X₁) (hB : B.1 = S.X₂) (hD : D.1 = S.X₃) :
    ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules P A B D
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := A
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := B
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := D
  change a = S.X₁ at hA
  change b = S.X₂ at hB
  change d = S.X₃ at hD
  subst hA hB hD
  exact ⟨S.f, S.g, S.zero, hS⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.g0TensorObject_exactRight
statement:
theorem g0TensorObject_exactRight (V : {M : X.Modules // IsFiniteLocallyFree X M})
    (A B C : {M : X.Modules // IsCoherentLike X M})
    (h : ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules (IsCoherentLike X) A B C) :
    ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules (IsCoherentLike X)
      (g0TensorObject X V A) (g0TensorObject X V B) (g0TensorObject X V C)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, g, zero, hS⟩ := h
  let S := ShortComplex.mk f g zero
  let F := tensorSheafLeftFunctor X V.1
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits F := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits X V.1 V.2
  letI : PreservesFiniteColimits F := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits X V.1 V.2
  exact shortExactIn_of_shortComplex X _ _ _ (S.map F)
    (ShortComplex.ShortExact.map_of_exact hS F) rfl rfl rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.g0TensorObject_exactLeft
statement:
theorem g0TensorObject_exactLeft (A B C : {M : X.Modules // IsFiniteLocallyFree X M})
    (F : {M : X.Modules // IsCoherentLike X M})
    (h : ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules (IsFiniteLocallyFree X) A B C) :
    ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules (IsCoherentLike X)
      (g0TensorObject X A F) (g0TensorObject X B F) (g0TensorObject X C F)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, g, zero, hS⟩ := h
  let S := ShortComplex.mk f g zero
  exact shortExactIn_of_shortComplex X _ _ _ (S.map (tensorSheafRightFunctor X F.1))
    (tensorSheafRightFunctor_map_shortExact_of_finiteLocallyFree_right X F.1 S hS C.2) rfl rfl rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.g0LeftMul_classOf
statement:
theorem g0LeftMul_classOf (V : {M : X.Modules // IsFiniteLocallyFree X M})
    (F : {M : X.Modules // IsCoherentLike X M}) :
    g0LeftMul X V (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ F) =
      ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ (g0TensorObject X V F)
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.lift_classOf _ _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.k0ActG0_classOf
statement:
theorem k0ActG0_classOf (V : {M : X.Modules // IsFiniteLocallyFree X M}) :
    k0ActG0 X (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ V) = g0LeftMul X V
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.lift_classOf _ _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf_iso
statement:
theorem g0ClassOf_iso {E F : X.Modules} (hE : IsCoherentLike X E) (hF : IsCoherentLike X F)
    (e : E ≅ F) : g0ClassOf X E hE = g0ClassOf X F hF
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso X.Modules (IsCoherentLike X)
    hE hF (show IsCoherentLike X (0 : X.Modules) from inferInstanceAs
      (0 : X.Modules).IsFinitePresentation) (isZero_zero _) e

name: SchemeKTheory.k0ActG0_one
statement: theorem k0ActG0_one (z : G0 X) : k0ActG0 X 1 z = z
proof:
:= by
  change k0ActG0 X (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ (tensorUnitObject X)) z = z
  rw [k0ActG0_classOf]
  change g0LeftMul X (tensorUnitObject X) z = AddMonoidHom.id _ z
  congr 1
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
  intro F
  rw [g0LeftMul_classOf, AddMonoidHom.id_apply]
  exact g0ClassOf_iso X _ F.2 (tensorSheafLeftUnitor X F.1)

name: SchemeKTheory.g0LeftMul_tensor
statement:
theorem g0LeftMul_tensor (V W : {M : X.Modules // IsFiniteLocallyFree X M}) (z : G0 X) :
    g0LeftMul X (k0TensorObject X V W) z = g0LeftMul X V (g0LeftMul X W z)
proof:
:= by
  change g0LeftMul X (k0TensorObject X V W) z = ((g0LeftMul X V).comp (g0LeftMul X W)) z
  congr 1
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
  intro F
  rw [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, g0LeftMul_classOf, g0LeftMul_classOf, g0LeftMul_classOf]
  exact g0ClassOf_iso X _ _ (tensorSheafAssociator X V.1 W.1 F.1)

name: SchemeKTheory.k0ActG0_mul
statement:
theorem k0ActG0_mul (x y : K0 X) (z : G0 X) :
    k0ActG0 X (x * y) z = k0ActG0 X x (k0ActG0 X y z)
proof:
:= by
  
  have h1 : ∀ V W : {M : X.Modules // IsFiniteLocallyFree X M},
      k0ActG0 X (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ V * ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ W) =
        (k0ActG0 X (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ V)).comp
          (k0ActG0 X (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ W)) := by
    intro V W
    rw [k0ClassOf_mul, k0ActG0_classOf, k0ActG0_classOf, k0ActG0_classOf]
    exact AddMonoidHom.ext fun z ↦ g0LeftMul_tensor X V W z
  
  have h2 : ∀ (V : {M : X.Modules // IsFiniteLocallyFree X M}) (y : K0 X),
      k0ActG0 X (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ V * y) =
        (k0ActG0 X (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ V)).comp (k0ActG0 X y) := by
    intro V
    let L : K0 X →+ (G0 X →+ G0 X) :=
      (k0ActG0 X).comp (AddMonoidHom.mulLeft (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ V))
    let R : K0 X →+ (G0 X →+ G0 X) :=
      { toFun := fun y ↦ (k0ActG0 X (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ V)).comp (k0ActG0 X y)
        map_zero' := AddMonoidHom.ext fun _ ↦ by simp
        map_add' := fun a b ↦ AddMonoidHom.ext fun _ ↦ by simp }
    have hLR : L = R := ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _ (fun W ↦ h1 V W)
    intro y
    exact congrArg (fun f : K0 X →+ (G0 X →+ G0 X) ↦ f y) hLR
  
  let L : K0 X →+ (G0 X →+ G0 X) := (k0ActG0 X).comp (AddMonoidHom.mulRight y)
  let R : K0 X →+ (G0 X →+ G0 X) :=
    { toFun := fun x ↦ (k0ActG0 X x).comp (k0ActG0 X y)
      map_zero' := AddMonoidHom.ext fun _ ↦ by simp
      map_add' := fun a b ↦ AddMonoidHom.ext fun _ ↦ by simp }
  have hLR : L = R := ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _ (fun V ↦ h2 V y)
  exact congrArg (fun f : K0 X →+ (G0 X →+ G0 X) ↦ f x z) hLR

name: SchemeKTheory.smul_def
statement: theorem smul_def (x : K0 X) (z : G0 X) : x • z = k0ActG0 X x z
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf_smul_g0ClassOf
statement:
theorem k0ClassOf_smul_g0ClassOf (V F : X.Modules) (hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree X V)
    (hF : IsCoherentLike X F) :
    k0ClassOf X V hV • g0ClassOf X F hF =
      g0ClassOf X (tensorSheaf X V F) (tensorSheaf_isCoherentLike X V F hV hF)
proof:
:= by
  change k0ActG0 X (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ ⟨V, hV⟩)
    (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ ⟨F, hF⟩) = _
  rw [k0ActG0_classOf, g0LeftMul_classOf]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.k0ToG0_mul
statement: theorem k0ToG0_mul (x y : K0 X) : k0ToG0 X (x * y) = x • k0ToG0 X y
proof:
:= by
  let L : K0 X →+ (K0 X →+ G0 X) :=
    { toFun := fun x ↦ (k0ToG0 X).comp (AddMonoidHom.mulLeft x)
      map_zero' := AddMonoidHom.ext fun _ ↦ by simp
      map_add' := fun a b ↦ AddMonoidHom.ext fun _ ↦ by simp [add_mul] }
  let R : K0 X →+ (K0 X →+ G0 X) :=
    { toFun := fun x ↦ (k0ActG0 X x).comp (k0ToG0 X)
      map_zero' := AddMonoidHom.ext fun _ ↦ by simp
      map_add' := fun a b ↦ AddMonoidHom.ext fun _ ↦ by simp }
  have hLR : L = R := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    intro V
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    intro W
    change k0ToG0 X (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ V * ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ W) =
      k0ActG0 X (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ V) (k0ToG0 X (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ W))
    rw [k0ClassOf_mul, k0ActG0_classOf]
    change k0ToG0 X (k0ClassOf X _ (k0TensorObject X V W).2) =
      g0LeftMul X V (k0ToG0 X (k0ClassOf X W.1 W.2))
    rw [k0ToG0_classOf, k0ToG0_classOf]
    change _ = g0LeftMul X V (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ ⟨W.1, _⟩)
    rw [g0LeftMul_classOf]
    rfl
  exact congrArg (fun f : K0 X →+ (K0 X →+ G0 X) ↦ f x y) hLR

name: SchemeKTheory.projectionFormula_of_classOf
statement:
theorem projectionFormula_of_classOf (f : Y ⟶ X) (φ : G0 Y →+ G0 X)
    (h : ∀ (V : X.Modules) (hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree X V) (F : Y.Modules)
      (hF : IsCoherentLike Y F),
      φ (g0ClassOf Y (tensorSheaf Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj V) F)
          (tensorSheaf_isCoherentLike Y _ F (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global f V hV) hF)) =
        k0ClassOf X V hV • φ (g0ClassOf Y F hF))
    (x : G0 Y) (y : K0 X) :
    φ (pullbackK0 f y • x) = y • φ x
proof:
:= by
  let L : K0 X →+ (G0 Y →+ G0 X) :=
    { toFun := fun y ↦ φ.comp (k0ActG0 Y (pullbackK0 f y))
      map_zero' := AddMonoidHom.ext fun _ ↦ by simp
      map_add' := fun a b ↦ AddMonoidHom.ext fun _ ↦ by simp }
  let R : K0 X →+ (G0 Y →+ G0 X) :=
    { toFun := fun y ↦ (k0ActG0 X y).comp φ
      map_zero' := AddMonoidHom.ext fun _ ↦ by simp
      map_add' := fun a b ↦ AddMonoidHom.ext fun _ ↦ by simp }
  have hLR : L = R := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    rintro ⟨V, hV⟩
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    rintro ⟨F, hF⟩
    change φ (k0ActG0 Y (pullbackK0 f (k0ClassOf X V hV)) (g0ClassOf Y F hF)) =
      k0ActG0 X (k0ClassOf X V hV) (φ (g0ClassOf Y F hF))
    rw [pullbackK0_classOf, ← smul_def, ← smul_def, k0ClassOf_smul_g0ClassOf]
    exact h V hV F hF
  exact congrArg (fun g : K0 X →+ (G0 Y →+ G0 X) ↦ g y x) hLR

name: SchemeKTheory.finitePushforward_projectionFormula
statement:
theorem finitePushforward_projectionFormula (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsFinite f] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (x : G0 Y) (y : K0 X) :
    finitePushforward f (pullbackK0 f y • x) = y • finitePushforward f x
proof:
:= by
  refine projectionFormula_of_classOf f (finitePushforward f) (fun V hV F hF ↦ ?_) x y
  rw [finitePushforward_classOf, finitePushforward_classOf, k0ClassOf_smul_g0ClassOf]
  exact g0ClassOf_iso X _ _ (projectionFormulaIso f V hV F).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.closedImmersion_projectionFormula
statement:
theorem closedImmersion_projectionFormula (i : Y ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (x : G0 Y) (y : K0 X) :
    finitePushforward i (pullbackK0 i y • x) = y • finitePushforward i x
proof:
:=
  finitePushforward_projectionFormula i x y

name: SchemeKTheory.finitePushforward_k0ToG0_mul_pullback
statement:
theorem finitePushforward_k0ToG0_mul_pullback (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsFinite f] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (a : K0 Y) (b : K0 X) :
    finitePushforward f (k0ToG0 Y (a * pullbackK0RingHom f b)) =
      b • finitePushforward f (k0ToG0 Y a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm, k0ToG0_mul, pullbackK0RingHom_apply, finitePushforward_projectionFormula]

name: SchemeKTheory.projectiveDerivedPushforward_projectionFormula_of_higher
statement:
theorem projectiveDerivedPushforward_projectionFormula_of_higher (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hR : ∀ (V : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Modules)
      (hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) V)
      (M : (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space R n).Modules)
      (hM : IsCoherentLike (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space R n) M) (q : ℕ),
      Nonempty (SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveHigherDirectImage R n
          ⟨tensorSheaf _ ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec R n)).obj V) M,
            tensorSheaf_isCoherentLike _ _ M
              (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec R n) V hV) hM⟩
          q ≅
        tensorSheaf _ V (SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveHigherDirectImage R n ⟨M, hM⟩ q)))
    (x : G0 (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space R n)) (y : K0 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) :
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveDerivedPushforward R n hn
        (pullbackK0 (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec R n) y • x) =
      y • SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveDerivedPushforward R n hn x
proof:
:= by
  refine projectionFormula_of_classOf _ _ (fun V hV F hF ↦ ?_) x y
  rw [SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveDerivedPushforward_classOf,
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveDerivedPushforward_classOf, smul_def,
    GrothendieckRiemannRoch.map_alternatingSum]
  congr 1
  funext q
  rw [← smul_def, k0ClassOf_smul_g0ClassOf]
  exact g0ClassOf_iso _ _ _ (hR V hV F hF q).some

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameCoherence_open_square
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameCoherence_open_square
    {X Y W V : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (q : W ⟶ X) (v : V ⟶ Y) (h : W ⟶ V)
    [IsOpenImmersion q] [IsOpenImmersion v] (comm : q ≫ f = h ≫ v) (M : Y.Modules) :
    (pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso f q v h comm).hom.app M =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M) ≫
        (pullbackComparisonSquareIso q f h v comm M).hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback h).map ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback v).inv.app M)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso, pullbackComparisonSquareIso,
    Iso.trans_hom, Iso.app_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.app_inv, NatTrans.comp_app,
    Functor.isoWhiskerLeft_hom, Functor.isoWhiskerRight_inv,
    Functor.whiskerLeft_app, Functor.whiskerRight_app, Category.assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameCoherence_open_square_iso
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameCoherence_open_square_iso
    {X Y W V : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (q : W ⟶ X) (v : V ⟶ Y) (h : W ⟶ V)
    [IsOpenImmersion q] [IsOpenImmersion v] (comm : q ≫ f = h ≫ v) (M : Y.Modules) :
    (pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso f q v h comm).app M =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M) ≪≫
        pullbackComparisonSquareIso q f h v comm M ≪≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback h).mapIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback v).app M).symm
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  simpa only [Iso.app_hom, Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.app_inv,
    Category.assoc] using pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameCoherence_open_square f q v h comm M

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameCoherence_square_symm
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameCoherence_square_symm
    {A B C D : Scheme.{u}} (r : D ⟶ B) (q : B ⟶ A) (a : D ⟶ C) (v : C ⟶ A)
    (h : r ≫ q = a ≫ v) (M : A.Modules) :
    (pullbackComparisonSquareIso r q a v h M).symm =
      pullbackComparisonSquareIso a v r q h.symm M
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  simp only [pullbackComparisonSquareIso, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.trans_inv, Iso.symm_hom,
    Iso.app_hom, Iso.app_inv, Iso.symm_inv, Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr,
    eqToIso.hom, eqToIso.inv, eqToHom_app, Category.assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameCoherence_open_boundary_cube
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameCoherence_open_boundary_cube
    {A A' B B' D D' Z Z' : Scheme.{u}}
    (z : A ⟶ A') (qC : B ⟶ A) (q : B' ⟶ A') (qB : B ⟶ B')
    (rC : Z ⟶ B) (r : Z' ⟶ B') (a : Z ⟶ Z')
    (lC : D ⟶ A) (l : D' ⟶ A') (k : D ⟶ D')
    (tC : Z ⟶ D) (t : Z' ⟶ D')
    [IsOpenImmersion rC] [IsOpenImmersion r] [IsOpenImmersion lC] [IsOpenImmersion l]
    (hQ : qB ≫ q = qC ≫ z) (hU : a ≫ r = rC ≫ qB)
    (hO : t ≫ l = r ≫ q) (hT : a ≫ t = tC ≫ k)
    (hL : k ≫ l = lC ≫ z) (hC : tC ≫ lC = rC ≫ qC) (M : A'.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor rC).mapIso
      (pullbackComparisonSquareIso qC z qB q hQ.symm M) ≪≫
    (pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso qB rC r a hU.symm).app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).obj M) ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback a).mapIso ((pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso q r l t hO.symm).app M) ≪≫
    pullbackComparisonSquareIso a t tC k hT ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor l).obj M) ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback tC).mapIso ((pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso z lC l k hL.symm).app M).symm =
    (pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso qC rC lC tC hC.symm).app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback z).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  have hc := congrArg Iso.hom
    (pullbackComparisonSquareIso_boundary_cube z qC q qB rC r a lC l k tC t hQ hU hO hT hL hC M)
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Category.assoc] at hc
  simp only [pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameCoherence_open_square_iso,
    Iso.trans_hom, Iso.trans_inv, Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.mapIso_inv, Iso.symm_hom,
    Iso.symm_inv, Iso.app_hom, Iso.app_inv, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  rw [(Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback rC).hom.naturality_assoc]
  simp only [← Functor.map_comp_assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_app, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id,
    Category.id_comp]
  simp only [Functor.comp_obj, Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  have hn := pullbackComparisonSquareIso_naturality a t tC k hT
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback l).inv.app M)
  rw [reassoc_of% hn]
  simp only [← Functor.map_comp_assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_app, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id,
    Category.id_comp]
  rw [← Iso.symm_hom (pullbackComparisonSquareIso lC z k l hL.symm M),
    pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameCoherence_square_symm]
  rw [reassoc_of% hc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameCoherence_square_hom
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameCoherence_square_hom
    {A B C D : Scheme.{u}} (r : D ⟶ B) (q : B ⟶ A) (a : D ⟶ C) (v : C ⟶ A)
    (h : r ≫ q = a ≫ v) (M : A.Modules) :
    (pullbackComparisonSquareIso r q a v h M).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp r q ≪≫ Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr h ≪≫

:= by

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameCoherence_quotient_chase
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameCoherence_quotient_chase
    {A : Type*} [Category A] {B P Q R S T F V W U : A}
    {tQuot : R ⟶ T} {sQuot : S ⟶ U} {H : T ⟶ U} {K : R ⟶ S}
    (hq : tQuot ≫ H = K ≫ sQuot)
    (eBase : B ≅ P) (eDom : P ≅ Q) (eTarget : Q ≅ R) (eSource : B ≅ S)
    (eTw : F ≅ V) (eTargetRec : V ≅ T) (eSourceRec : W ≅ U)
    (tGlobal : Q ⟶ V) (sGlobal : B ⟶ W) (t0 : P ⟶ F)
    (ht : tQuot = eTarget.inv ≫ tGlobal ≫ eTargetRec.hom)
    (hs : sQuot = eSource.inv ≫ sGlobal ≫ eSourceRec.hom)
    (hc : eBase.hom ≫ eDom.hom ≫ eTarget.hom ≫ K = eSource.hom)
    (hn : t0 ≫ eTw.hom = eDom.hom ≫ tGlobal) :
    t0 ≫ eTw.hom ≫ eTargetRec.hom ≫ H ≫ eSourceRec.inv = eBase.inv ≫ sGlobal
proof:
:= by
  have ht' : eTarget.hom ≫ tQuot = tGlobal ≫ eTargetRec.hom := by
    rw [ht]
    simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  apply (cancel_epi eBase.hom).1
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  rw [reassoc_of% hn, ← reassoc_of% ht', reassoc_of% hq, reassoc_of% hc, hs]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameCoherence_restrict_quotient_square
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameCoherence_restrict_quotient_square
    {Y Z W : Scheme.{u}} (s : W ⟶ Y) (q : Z ⟶ Y) (r : W ⟶ Z)
    [IsOpenImmersion s] [IsOpenImmersion q] [IsOpenImmersion r]
    (h : r ≫ q = s) {P M N : Y.Modules} (J : P ⟶ M) (T : P ⟶ N)
    (φ : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj M ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj N)
    (hφ : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map J ≫ φ =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map T) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor s).map J ≫ tensorOverlap_tr s q r h φ =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor s).map T
proof:
:= by
  let e := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr h.symm ≪≫
    Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp r q
  have hn := e.hom.naturality J
  change (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor s).map J ≫
    e.hom.app M ≫ (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor r).map φ ≫ e.inv.app N = _
  rw [reassoc_of% hn]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc, hφ]
  exact pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameRecovery_natural_conjugation e T

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameCoherence_over_quotient_square
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameCoherence_over_quotient_square
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (U : Y.Opens) {P M N : Y.Modules}
    (J : P ⟶ M) (T : P ⟶ N)
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj M ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj N)
    (he : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map J ≫ e.hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map T) :
    J.over U ≫ (overIsoOfRestrictIso U e).hom = T.over U
proof:
:= by
  apply (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map_injective
  rw [Functor.map_comp, overIsoOfRestrictIso_map]
  have hn := (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.naturality J
  rw [reassoc_of% hn, reassoc_of% he]
  exact pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameRecovery_natural_conjugation
    (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U) T

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameCoherence_range_quotient_square
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameCoherence_range_quotient_square
    {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (q : Z ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    {P M N : Y.Modules} (J : P ⟶ M) (T : P ⟶ N)
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj M ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj N)
    (he : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map J ≫ e.hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map T) :
    J.over q.opensRange ≫ (tensorOverlap_OI q e).hom = T.over q.opensRange
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorOverlap_OI_eq]
  apply pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameCoherence_over_quotient_square
  simpa only [Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc, tensorOverlap_tr] using
    pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameCoherence_restrict_quotient_square
      q.opensRange.ι q q.isoOpensRange.inv q.isoOpensRange_inv_comp J T e.hom he

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameCoherence_over_overlap
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameCoherence_over_overlap
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {P M N : Y.Modules} (J : P ⟶ M) [Epi J] (T : P ⟶ N)
    {U U' V : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) (h' : V ≤ U')
    (φ : M.over U ⟶ N.over U) (ψ : M.over U' ⟶ N.over U')
    (hφ : J.over U ≫ φ = T.over U) (hψ : J.over U' ≫ ψ = T.over U') :
    Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE Y h φ = Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE Y h' ψ
proof:
:= by
  have hl := congrArg (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE Y h) hφ
  have hr := congrArg (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE Y h') hψ
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_comp,
    Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_over] at hl hr
  let F := (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V).functor
  have hi : Epi (F.map (J.over V)) := by
    have hJ := pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameRecovery_natural_conjugation
      (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V) J
    simp only [Functor.comp_map] at hJ
    change Epi ((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V).functor.map (J.over V))
    rw [← hJ]
    letI : Epi ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).map J) := inferInstance
    letI : Epi ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V).hom.app P) := inferInstance
    letI : Epi ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V).inv.app M) := inferInstance
    infer_instance
  letI : Epi (J.over V) := F.epi_of_epi_map hi
  exact (cancel_epi (J.over V)).mp (hl.trans hr.symm)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameCoherence_chart_quotient_domain_prefix
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameCoherence_chart_quotient_domain_prefix
    (a : C.pullbackFrameIndex g) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).chartι a)).mapIso
      (pullbackComparisonSquareIso (C.pullbackFrameCover g).toBase g
        (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) C.toBase (C.pullbackProjectiveMap_toBase g).symm E)).hom ≫
    ((pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g)
      ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).chartι a) (C.chartι a.1)
      (C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a) (C.pullbackProjectiveMap_chartι g a)).app
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj E)).hom ≫
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a)).mapIso
      ((pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso C.toBase (C.chartι a.1) (C.U a.1).ι
        (C.chartToBase a.1) (C.pullbackTwistOverlap_chartBase_comm a.1)).app E)).hom ≫
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a) (C.chartToBase a.1) ≪≫
      Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (C.isPullback_pullbackProjectiveChartMap_toBase g a).w ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).chartToBase a)
        (C.pullbackFrameMap g a)).symm).hom.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.U a.1).ι).obj E) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).chartToBase a)).map
        ((pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso g (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a).ι (C.U a.1).ι
          (C.pullbackFrameMap g a) (C.pullbackFrameMap_comp_ι g a).symm).inv.app E)) =
    ((pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso (C.pullbackFrameCover g).toBase
      ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).chartι a) (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a).ι
      ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).chartToBase a)
      ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).pullbackTwistOverlap_chartBase_comm a)).app
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)).hom
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.app_hom,
    pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameCoherence_square_hom, Category.assoc] using
    C.pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameCoherence_chart_open_domain_hom_proof g a

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameCoherence_chart_compatible

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.overlapToIntersection_eq_assoc
statement:
theorem overlapToIntersection_eq_assoc {W : Scheme.{u}} (U V : X.affineOpens)
    (c : CommonBasicOpen U V) (g : (U.1 ⊓ V.1).toScheme ⟶ W) :
    (basicOpenOverlapCover I U V).f c ≫ overlapToIntersection I U V ≫ g =
      (commonBasicOpenChartIso I U V c).hom ≫ chartToOpen I c.affineOpen ≫
        X.homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_intersection ≫ g
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc, overlapToIntersection_eq, Category.assoc, Category.assoc]

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.key_overlapToIntersection
statement:
theorem key_overlapToIntersection (U V : X.affineOpens) (c : CommonBasicOpen U V) :
    (basicOpenOverlapCover I U V).f c ≫ overlapToIntersection I U V =
      (chartIdentifications I).localTransition U V c ≫ overlapToIntersection I V U ≫
        X.homOfLE (le_of_eq (inf_comm (a := V.1) (b := U.1)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [ChartIdentifications.localTransition_eq]
  unfold ChartIdentifications.targetMap ChartIdentifications.targetIso chartIdentifications
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.trans_inv, overlapToIntersection_eq_assoc,
    Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, Scheme.homOfLE_homOfLE]
  rw [overlapToIntersection_eq]
  congr 1
  exact (eqToHom_comp_of_heq (congrArg (chart I) c.swap_affineOpen).symm
    (chartToOpen I c.affineOpen ≫ X.homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_intersection)
    (chartToOpen I c.swap.affineOpen ≫
      X.homOfLE (c.swap.affineOpen_le_intersection.trans (le_of_eq (inf_comm (a := V.1) (b := U.1)))))
    (heq_chartToOpen_comp_homOfLE I c.swap_affineOpen.symm c.affineOpen_le_intersection
      (c.swap.affineOpen_le_intersection.trans (le_of_eq (inf_comm (a := V.1) (b := U.1)))))).symm

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.compatible_step_b
statement:
theorem compatible_step_b (U V : X.affineOpens) (c d : CommonBasicOpen U V) :
    pullback.fst ((basicOpenOverlapCover I U V).f c) ((basicOpenOverlapCover I U V).f d) ≫
        (chartIdentifications I).localTransition U V c ≫ overlapToIntersection I V U =
      pullback.snd ((basicOpenOverlapCover I U V).f c) ((basicOpenOverlapCover I U V).f d) ≫
        (chartIdentifications I).localTransition U V d ≫ overlapToIntersection I V U
proof:
:= by
  refine (cancel_mono (X.homOfLE (le_of_eq (inf_comm (a := V.1) (b := U.1))))).mp ?_
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← key_overlapToIntersection, ← key_overlapToIntersection, ← Category.assoc,
    ← Category.assoc, pullback.condition]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.directSum_common_detects
statement:
theorem directSum_common_detects (S : ChowSplitting ops A e)
    (T : ChowSplitting ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj D) f)
    (F G : Module.End ℚ (TotalChow X)) :
    totalPull ops (T.q ≫ S.q) (S.d + T.d) (PureRelDim.comp T.hd S.hd) ∘ₗ F =
      totalPull ops (T.q ≫ S.q) (S.d + T.d) (PureRelDim.comp T.hd S.hd) ∘ₗ G ↔ F = G
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.directSum_common_top
statement:
theorem directSum_common_top (S : ChowSplitting ops A e)
    (T : ChowSplitting ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj D) f) :
    Nonempty (((Scheme.Modules.pullback (T.q ≫ S.q)).obj (A ⊞ D)) ≅
      (directSumLeftSplitting ops cp S T).F e ⊞ (directSumRightSplitting ops cp S T).F f)
proof:
:= by
  let P := Scheme.Modules.pullback (T.q ≫ S.q)
  letI : PreservesBinaryBiproducts P := preservesBinaryBiproducts_of_preservesBinaryCoproducts P
  letI : P.Additive := Functor.additive_of_preservesBinaryBiproducts P
  letI : PreservesBinaryBiproduct A D P := preservesBinaryBiproduct_of_preservesBiproduct _ _ _
  obtain ⟨bA⟩ := (directSumLeftSplitting ops cp S T).top
  obtain ⟨bD⟩ := (directSumRightSplitting ops cp S T).top
  exact ⟨P.mapBiprod A D ≪≫ biprod.mapIso bA.symm bD.symm⟩

theorem directSum_common_chern_top (S : ChowSplitting ops A e)

    geometricChernAssign ops cp T.Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (T.q ≫ S.q)).obj (A ⊞ D)) =
      geometricChernAssign ops cp T.Y
        ((directSumLeftSplitting ops cp S T).F e ⊞ (directSumRightSplitting ops cp S T).F f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b⟩ := directSum_common_top ops cp S T
  exact geometricChernAssign_iso ops cp _ b

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.exists_directSum_common_flags
statement:
