name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.directSum_line_convolution
statement:
theorem directSum_line_convolution (L M : X.Modules)
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n,
      chernOp ops cp L 1 hL p.1 ∘ₗ chernOp ops cp M 1 hM p.2) =
      if n = 0 then 1 else if n = 1 then totalCap ops L hL + totalCap ops M hM
      else if n = 2 then totalCap ops L hL ∘ₗ totalCap ops M hM else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [chernOp_line_series ops cp L hL, chernOp_line_series ops cp M hM]
  rcases n with _ | (_ | (_ | n))
  · simp [Module.End.one_eq_id]
  · simp [Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_succ, Module.End.one_eq_id, add_comm]
  · simp [Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_succ, Module.End.one_eq_id]
  · have hz : ∀ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal (n + 3),
        (if p.1 = 0 then 1 else if p.1 = 1 then totalCap ops L hL else 0) ∘ₗ
        (if p.2 = 0 then 1 else if p.2 = 1 then totalCap ops M hM else 0) = 0 := by
      intro p hp
      have hp' := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp
      have hlarge : 2 ≤ p.1 ∨ 2 ≤ p.2 := by omega
      rcases hlarge with h | h
      · have h0 : p.1 ≠ 0 := by omega
        have h1 : p.1 ≠ 1 := by omega
        simp [h0, h1]
      · have h0 : p.2 ≠ 0 := by omega
        have h1 : p.2 ≠ 1 := by omega
        simp [h0, h1]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero hz]
    simp

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.coneExteriorSection_ιMulti
statement:
theorem coneExteriorSection_ιMulti (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → F) :
    coneExteriorSection (R := R) n (exteriorPower.ιMulti R n v) =
      exteriorPower.ιMulti R (n + 1) (Matrix.vecCons (0, 1) (LinearMap.inl R F R ∘ v))
proof:
:= by
  simp [coneExteriorSection, exteriorPower.alternatingMapLinearEquiv_apply_ιMulti,
    AlternatingMap.curryLeft_apply_apply, Function.comp_def]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.coneExteriorInsert_ιMulti
statement:
theorem coneExteriorInsert_ιMulti (n : ℕ) (y : F × R) (v : Fin n → F) :
    coneExteriorInsert (R := R) n y (exteriorPower.ιMulti R n v) =
      exteriorPower.ιMulti R (n + 1) (Matrix.vecCons y (LinearMap.inl R F R ∘ v))
proof:
:= by
  change exteriorPower.alternatingMapLinearEquiv _ (exteriorPower.ιMulti R n v) = _
  rw [exteriorPower.alternatingMapLinearEquiv_apply_ιMulti]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.coneExteriorWedge_tmul
statement:
theorem coneExteriorWedge_tmul (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → F) (y : F × R) :
    coneExteriorWedge (R := R) n (exteriorPower.ιMulti R n v ⊗ₜ[R] y) =
      exteriorPower.ιMulti R (n + 1) (Fin.snoc (LinearMap.inl R F R ∘ v) y)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coneExteriorWedge, LinearMap.smul_apply, TensorProduct.lift.tmul,
    LinearMap.flip_apply]
  rw [coneExteriorInsert_ιMulti]
  have h := AlternatingMap.map_insertNth (exteriorPower.ιMulti R (n + 1))
    (Fin.last n) y (LinearMap.inl R F R ∘ v)
  rw [Fin.insertNth_last', Fin.val_last] at h
  exact h.symm

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.coneExteriorSection_sign
statement:
theorem coneExteriorSection_sign (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → F) :
    coneExteriorSection (R := R) n (exteriorPower.ιMulti R n v) =
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ n • coneExteriorWedge (R := R) n
        (exteriorPower.ιMulti R n v ⊗ₜ[R] (0, 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [coneExteriorSection_ιMulti, coneExteriorWedge_tmul]
  have h := AlternatingMap.map_insertNth (exteriorPower.ιMulti R (n + 1))
    (Fin.last n) (0, 1) (LinearMap.inl R F R ∘ v)
  rw [Fin.insertNth_last', Fin.val_last] at h
  rw [h, smul_smul, ← mul_pow]
  simp

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.coneExteriorSecond_inl
statement:
theorem coneExteriorSecond_inl (n : ℕ) (x : ⋀[R]^(n + 1) F) :
    coneExteriorSecond (R := R) n (exteriorPower.map (n + 1) (LinearMap.inl R F R) x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [coneExteriorSecond, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
  rw [ExteriorPowerShortExact.contraction_map (LinearMap.inl R F R)
    (LinearMap.fst R F R) (LinearMap.snd R F R) n (by intro; rfl)]
  exact map_zero _

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.coneExteriorSecond_section
statement:
theorem coneExteriorSecond_section (n : ℕ) :
    (coneExteriorSecond (R := R) (F := F) n).comp (coneExteriorSection n) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext
  refine AlternatingMap.ext fun v ↦ ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.compAlternatingMap_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    LinearMap.id_apply, coneExteriorSection_sign, map_zsmul, coneExteriorWedge_tmul]
  dsimp only [coneExteriorSecond, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
  rw [ExteriorPowerShortExact.contraction_snoc (LinearMap.inl R F R)
    (LinearMap.fst R F R) (LinearMap.snd R F R) n (by intro; rfl) (by intro; rfl)]
  simp only [map_zsmul, LinearMap.snd_apply, TensorProduct.rid_tmul, one_smul]
  rw [smul_smul, ← mul_pow]
  simp

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.coneExteriorFirst_section
statement:
theorem coneExteriorFirst_section (n : ℕ) :
    (exteriorPower.map (n + 1) (LinearMap.fst R F R)).comp
      (coneExteriorSection (R := R) n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext
  refine AlternatingMap.ext fun v ↦ ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.compAlternatingMap_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    LinearMap.zero_apply, coneExteriorSection_ιMulti, exteriorPower.map_apply_ιMulti]
  exact (exteriorPower.ιMulti R (n + 1)).map_coord_zero 0 rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.coneExteriorFirst_inl
statement:
theorem coneExteriorFirst_inl (n : ℕ) :
    (exteriorPower.map n (LinearMap.fst R F R)).comp
      (exteriorPower.map n (LinearMap.inl R F R)) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  rw [← exteriorPower.map_comp]
  have h : (LinearMap.fst R F R).comp (LinearMap.inl R F R) = LinearMap.id := by ext; rfl
  rw [h, exteriorPower.map_id]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.coneExteriorWedge_decompose_tmul
statement:
theorem coneExteriorWedge_decompose_tmul (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → F) (y : F × R) :
    coneExteriorWedge (R := R) n (exteriorPower.ιMulti R n v ⊗ₜ[R] y) =
    exteriorPower.map (n + 1) (LinearMap.inl R F R)
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ n • exteriorPower.ιMulti R (n + 1) (Matrix.vecCons y.1 v)) +
    coneExteriorSection n (y.2 • ((-1 : ℤ) ^ n • exteriorPower.ιMulti R n v))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coneExteriorWedge, LinearMap.smul_apply, TensorProduct.lift.tmul,
    LinearMap.flip_apply, coneExteriorInsert_ιMulti]
  have hy : y = LinearMap.inl R F R y.1 + y.2 • (0, 1) := by ext <;> simp
  conv_lhs => rw [hy]
  rw [AlternatingMap.map_vecCons_add, AlternatingMap.map_vecCons_smul, smul_add]
  rw [map_zsmul, exteriorPower.map_apply_ιMulti]
  rw [(coneExteriorSection (R := R) (F := F) n).map_smul, map_zsmul,
    coneExteriorSection_ιMulti]
  rw [smul_comm]
  congr 2
  congr 1
  funext j
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) j <;> rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.coneExterior_generate
statement:
theorem coneExterior_generate (n : ℕ) (z : ⋀[R]^(n + 1) (F × R)) :
    ∃ (x : ⋀[R]^(n + 1) F) (y : ⋀[R]^n F),
      exteriorPower.map (n + 1) (LinearMap.inl R F R) x + coneExteriorSection n y = z
proof:
:= by
  let S := LinearMap.range (exteriorPower.map (n + 1) (LinearMap.inl R F R)) ⊔
    LinearMap.range (coneExteriorSection (R := R) (F := F) n)
  have hw : ∀ t, coneExteriorWedge (R := R) (F := F) n t ∈ S := by
    intro t
    induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | add a b ha hb => simpa using S.add_mem ha hb
    | tmul ω y =>
      have hω : ω ∈ Submodule.span R (Set.range (exteriorPower.ιMulti R n)) := by
        rw [exteriorPower.ιMulti_span]; trivial
      induction hω using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem ω hω =>
        obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hω
        rw [coneExteriorWedge_decompose_tmul]
        exact S.add_mem (Submodule.mem_sup_left ⟨_, rfl⟩) (Submodule.mem_sup_right ⟨_, rfl⟩)
      | zero => simp
      | add a b _ _ ha hb => simpa only [TensorProduct.add_tmul, map_add] using S.add_mem ha hb
      | smul r a _ ha =>
        simpa only [TensorProduct.smul_tmul, TensorProduct.tmul_smul, map_smul] using S.smul_mem r ha
  have hz := ExteriorPowerShortExact.mem_range_map_sup_range_wedge
    (LinearMap.inl R F R) n (coneExteriorWedge n) (coneExteriorWedge_tmul n)
    (0, 1) (fun y => ⟨y.1, y.2, by ext <;> simp⟩) z
  have hle : LinearMap.range (coneExteriorWedge (R := R) (F := F) n) ≤ S := by
    rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
    exact hw t
  have hzS : z ∈ S := (sup_le le_sup_left hle) hz
  obtain ⟨a, ⟨x, rfl⟩, b, ⟨y, rfl⟩, hxy⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hzS
  exact ⟨x, y, hxy⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.coneCosection_inl
statement:
theorem coneCosection_inl (σ : F →ₗ[R] R) (r : R) :
    (coneCosection σ r).comp (LinearMap.inl R F R) = σ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [coneCosection]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.coneCosection_distinguished
statement:
theorem coneCosection_distinguished (σ : F →ₗ[R] R) (r : R) :
    coneCosection σ r (0, 1) = r
proof: := by simp [coneCosection]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.coneExterior_differential_inl
statement:
theorem coneExterior_differential_inl (σ : F →ₗ[R] R) (r : R) (n : ℕ) :
    (koszulDiff (coneCosection σ r) n).comp
      (exteriorPower.map (n + 1) (LinearMap.inl R F R)) =
    (exteriorPower.map n (LinearMap.inl R F R)).comp (koszulDiff σ n)
proof:
:=
  koszulDiff_natural _ _ _ (coneCosection_inl σ r) n

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cone_removeNth_vecCons
statement:
theorem cone_removeNth_vecCons {A : Type*} (n : ℕ) (x : A) (v : Fin (n + 1) → A)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    i.succ.removeNth (Matrix.vecCons x v) = Matrix.vecCons x (i.removeNth v)
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun k => ?_) j
  · simp [Fin.removeNth]
  · simp [Fin.removeNth, Fin.succ_succAbove_succ]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.coneExterior_differential_section
statement:
theorem coneExterior_differential_section (σ : F →ₗ[R] R) (r : R) (n : ℕ) :
    (koszulDiff (coneCosection σ r) (n + 1)).comp (coneExteriorSection (n + 1)) =
    r • exteriorPower.map (n + 1) (LinearMap.inl R F R) -
      (coneExteriorSection n).comp (koszulDiff σ n)
proof:
:= by
  apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext
  refine AlternatingMap.ext fun v ↦ ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.compAlternatingMap_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, coneExteriorSection_ιMulti,
    koszulDiff_ιMulti, map_sum, map_zsmul, map_smul, exteriorPower.map_apply_ιMulti]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, one_smul,
    coneCosection_distinguished, Fin.removeNth_zero]
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [cone_removeNth_vecCons]
  simp only [Matrix.cons_val_succ, Fin.val_succ, pow_succ, mul_neg_one, neg_smul]
  have hi : coneCosection σ r ((LinearMap.inl R F R) (v i)) = σ (v i) :=
    LinearMap.congr_fun (coneCosection_inl σ r) (v i)
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  rw [hi]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.coneExteriorEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem coneExteriorEquiv_symm_apply (n : ℕ) (x : ⋀[R]^(n + 1) F) (y : ⋀[R]^n F) :
    (coneExteriorEquiv (R := R) n).symm (x, y) =
      exteriorPower.map (n + 1) (LinearMap.inl R F R) x + coneExteriorSection n y
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.coneExterior_differential_decomposition
statement:
theorem coneExterior_differential_decomposition (σ : F →ₗ[R] R) (r : R) (n : ℕ)
    (x : ⋀[R]^(n + 2) F) (y : ⋀[R]^(n + 1) F) :
    koszulDiff (coneCosection σ r) (n + 1)
      ((coneExteriorEquiv (R := R) (n + 1)).symm (x, y)) =
    (coneExteriorEquiv (R := R) n).symm
      (koszulDiff σ (n + 1) x + r • y, -(koszulDiff σ n y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [coneExteriorEquiv_symm_apply, coneExteriorEquiv_symm_apply, map_add]
  have h1 := LinearMap.congr_fun (coneExterior_differential_inl σ r (n + 1)) x
  have h2 := LinearMap.congr_fun (coneExterior_differential_section σ r n) y
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply] at h1 h2
  rw [h1, h2, map_add, map_smul, map_neg]
  abel

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.coneExterior_differential_coordinates
statement:
theorem coneExterior_differential_coordinates (σ : F →ₗ[R] R) (r : R) (n : ℕ)
    (z : ⋀[R]^(n + 2) (F × R)) :
    coneExteriorEquiv n (koszulDiff (coneCosection σ r) (n + 1) z) =
    (koszulDiff σ (n + 1) (coneExteriorEquiv (n + 1) z).1 +
      r • (coneExteriorEquiv (n + 1) z).2,
      -(koszulDiff σ n (coneExteriorEquiv (n + 1) z).2))
proof:
:= by
  let q := coneExteriorEquiv (R := R) (F := F) (n + 1)
  have h := coneExterior_differential_decomposition σ r n (q z).1 (q z).2
  change koszulDiff (coneCosection σ r) (n + 1) (q.symm (q z)) = _ at h
  rw [q.symm_apply_apply] at h
  exact (congrArg (coneExteriorEquiv (R := R) (F := F) n) h).trans
    ((coneExteriorEquiv (R := R) (F := F) n).apply_symm_apply _)

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.coneExteriorSection_zero_oneEquiv
statement:
theorem coneExteriorSection_zero_oneEquiv :
    (exteriorPower.oneEquiv R (F × R)).toLinearMap.comp
      (coneExteriorSection (R := R) (F := F) 0) =
    (LinearMap.inr R F R).comp (exteriorPower.zeroEquiv R F).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext
  refine AlternatingMap.ext fun v ↦ ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.compAlternatingMap_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    coneExteriorSection_ιMulti, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    exteriorPower.zeroEquiv_ιMulti]
  change exteriorPower.oneEquiv R (F × R)
    (exteriorPower.ιMulti R 1 (Matrix.vecCons (0, 1) (LinearMap.inl R F R ∘ v))) =
    (LinearMap.inr R F R) 1
  rw [exteriorPower.oneEquiv_ιMulti]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.coneExterior_differential_zero
statement:
theorem coneExterior_differential_zero (σ : F →ₗ[R] R) (r : R)
    (x : ⋀[R]^1 F) (y : ⋀[R]^0 F) :
    exteriorPower.zeroEquiv R (F × R)
      (koszulDiff (coneCosection σ r) 0 ((coneExteriorEquiv (R := R) 0).symm (x, y))) =
    σ (exteriorPower.oneEquiv R F x) + r * exteriorPower.zeroEquiv R F y
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (koszulDiff_zero_compat (coneCosection σ r))
    ((coneExteriorEquiv (R := R) 0).symm (x, y))
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe] at h
  rw [h, coneExteriorEquiv_symm_apply, map_add]
  have h1 := LinearMap.congr_fun (exteriorPower.oneEquiv_naturality (LinearMap.inl R F R)) x
  have h2 := LinearMap.congr_fun (coneExteriorSection_zero_oneEquiv (R := R) (F := F)) y
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe] at h1 h2
  rw [h1, h2]
  simp [coneCosection]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.coneExterior_differential_zero_coordinates
statement:
theorem coneExterior_differential_zero_coordinates (σ : F →ₗ[R] R) (r : R)
    (x : ⋀[R]^1 F) (y : ⋀[R]^0 F) :
    (exteriorPower.zeroEquiv R F).symm
      (exteriorPower.zeroEquiv R (F × R)
        (koszulDiff (coneCosection σ r) 0 ((coneExteriorEquiv (R := R) 0).symm (x, y)))) =
    koszulDiff σ 0 x + r • y
proof:
:= by
  apply (exteriorPower.zeroEquiv R F).injective
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, coneExterior_differential_zero, map_add, map_smul]
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (koszulDiff_zero_compat σ) x
  exact congrArg (fun t => t + r • exteriorPower.zeroEquiv R F y) h.symm

name: RiemannRoch.KNFB.projection_taut_gen
statement:
theorem projection_taut_gen (k : ι) (m : M) :
    (linearLocalFrameProjection R M b 1 k).app ⊤
      ((twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b 1).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_top : (linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ ⊤)).op
          ((tautChart_tautHom R M b m).app ⊤ (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ⊤)))) =
      (linearOpen R M (b k)).topIso.inv.hom (tautChart_ratioSection R M (b k) m)
proof:
:= by
  have e : (tautChart_tautHom R M b m).app ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤)
      (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤))) =
      (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b 1).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_top : (linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ ⊤)).op
          ((tautChart_tautHom R M b m).app ⊤ (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ⊤))) := by
    rw [← tautChart_app_map]
    congr 1
  rw [← e, linearLocalFrameProjection_app_eq]
  have h1 : (Pi.π (fun j ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) (linearOpen R M (b j))) k).app
      ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤)
      ((kernel.ι (linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b 1)).app
        ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤)
        ((tautChart_tautHom R M b m).app ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤)
          (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤))))) =
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) (linearOpen R M (b k))).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE le_top).op (tautChart_component R M (b k) m) := by
    exact (tautChart_app3 _ _ _ _ _).trans ((congrArg
      (fun f : SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules (space R M) ⟶
          SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) (linearOpen R M (b k)) ↦
        f.app ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤)
          (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤))))
      (tautChart_tautHom_kernel_π R M b m k)).trans
      (tautChart_unitHomEquiv_symm_sectionsOfTop_app' _ _ _))
  erw [h1]
  simp only [tautChart_component]
  change ((space R M).presheaf.map _ ) (((space R M).presheaf.map _ )
      (((space R M).presheaf.map _ ) _)) = _
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  rw [Scheme.Opens.topIso_inv]
  rfl

name: RiemannRoch.KNFB.literal_t_gen
statement:
theorem literal_t_gen (i : C.I) (k m : C.basisIndex i) :
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheafLiteralLinearOpenIso 1 ⟨i, k⟩).hom.app ⊤
      ((C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE ((((C.literalLinearOpen ⟨i, k⟩).ι ≫ C.chartι i).image_le_opensRange ⊤).trans
          (tautQuotient_toBase_range_le C i k))).op (tautQuotient_t C i m)) =
      (C.literalLinearOpen ⟨i, k⟩).topIso.inv.hom
        (tautChart_ratioSection Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i k)
          (C.sectionBasis i m))
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  simp only [SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistingSheafLiteralLinearOpenIso,
    id_eq]
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
    Iso.app_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp_hom_app_app]
  rw [tautQuotient_t, tautQuotient_chartSection]
  refine (congrArg (fun z => (SchemeProjectiveBundle.twistingSheafOfBasisIndexLinearOpenIso
    Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i) 1 k).inv.app ⊤ z)
      (tautQuotient_restrictionIso_taut C i k _ _ _ _)).trans ?_
  exact projection_taut_gen _ _ (C.sectionBasis i) k (C.sectionBasis i m)

name: RiemannRoch.KNFB.kappa_zc
statement:
theorem kappa_zc (m : C.basisIndex ij.1) :
    (kappa C ij).hom (zc C ij (isAffineOpen_litU C ij) (le_refl (litU C ij)) m) =
      (epsilon C ij).hom
        (tautChart_ratioSection Γ(X, C.U ij.1) (E.val.obj (op (C.U ij.1))) (C.sectionBasis ij.1 ij.2)
          (C.sectionBasis ij.1 m))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← literal_t_gen C ij.1 ij.2 m]
  have h := qW_Fbasis_eq C ij (isAffineOpen_litU C ij) (le_refl (litU C ij)) m
  have hq : qW C (litU C ij) (Fbasis C ij (isAffineOpen_litU C ij) (le_refl (litU C ij)) m) =
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE ((((C.literalLinearOpen ij).ι ≫ C.chartι ij.1).image_le_opensRange ⊤).trans
          (tautQuotient_toBase_range_le C ij.1 ij.2))).op (tautQuotient_t C ij.1 m) :=
    qW_Fbasis C ij (isAffineOpen_litU C ij) (le_refl (litU C ij)) m
  rw [hq] at h
  rw [h]
  let F := C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1
  let T := (C.canonicalTwistingSheafLiteralLinearOpenIso 1 ij).hom
  let w := (kappa C ij).hom (zc C ij (isAffineOpen_litU C ij) (le_refl (litU C ij)) m)
  let x : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (litJ C ij)).obj F, ⊤) :=
    F.presheaf.map (homOfLE ((litJ C ij).image_le_opensRange ⊤ |>.trans
      (tautQuotient_toBase_range_le C ij.1 ij.2))).op (tautQuotient_t C ij.1 ij.2)
  have hx : T.app ⊤ x = (1 : Γ((C.literalLinearOpen ij).toScheme, ⊤)) :=
    tautQuotient_literal_t C ij.1 ij.2
  have hz : zc C ij (isAffineOpen_litU C ij) (le_refl (litU C ij)) m =
      ((litJ C ij).appIso ⊤).inv.hom w :=
    (Iso.hom_inv_id_apply ((litJ C ij).appIso ⊤) _).symm
  have hgW : gW C ij (le_refl (litU C ij)) = x := by
    change F.presheaf.map _ (F.presheaf.map _ _) = F.presheaf.map _ _
    rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
    rfl
  rw [hgW]
  have key := Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul T w x
  change T.app ⊤ (w • x) = _ at key
  have e3 : T.app ⊤ (show Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (litJ C ij)).obj F, ⊤) from
      (zc C ij (isAffineOpen_litU C ij) (le_refl (litU C ij)) m •
        (show Γ(F, litU C ij) from x))) =
      T.app ⊤ (w • x) := by
    rw [hz]
    rfl
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (e3.trans key).symm
  rw [hx]
  change w = w * 1
  rw [mul_one]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.degreeOne_irreducible
statement:
theorem degreeOne_irreducible (s : grading k n 1) (hs : s ≠ 0) :
    Irreducible (s : Polynomial k n)
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.irreducible_of_totalDegree_eq_one
  · exact s.2.totalDegree (fun h ↦ hs (Subtype.ext h))
  · intro x hx
    by_cases hx0 : x = 0
    · subst x
      exfalso
      apply hs
      apply Subtype.ext
      ext m
      simpa using (zero_dvd_iff.mp (hx m))
    · exact isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hx0

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.hyperplaneIdeal_isPrime
statement:
theorem hyperplaneIdeal_isPrime (s : grading k n 1) (hs : s ≠ 0) :
    (hyperplaneIdeal k n s).toIdeal.IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  rw [GradedIdealQuotient.principalIdeal_toIdeal]
  exact Ideal.isPrime_span_singleton_of_prime (degreeOne_irreducible k n s hs).prime

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.exists_coordinate_not_mem_hyperplaneIdeal
statement:
theorem exists_coordinate_not_mem_hyperplaneIdeal
    (s : grading k n 1) (hs : s ≠ 0) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ∃ i : Fin (n + 1),
      coordinate k n i ∉ (hyperplaneIdeal k n s).toIdeal
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  simp only [not_exists, not_not] at h
  let i₀ : Fin (n + 1) := ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ n⟩
  let i₁ : Fin (n + 1) := ⟨1, Nat.succ_lt_succ hn⟩
  have hi : i₀ ≠ i₁ := by
    intro e
    have := congrArg Fin.val e
    norm_num [i₀, i₁] at this
  have hs0 : (s : Polynomial k n) ∣ coordinate k n i₀ := by
    have hi₀mem := h i₀
    rw [GradedIdealQuotient.principalIdeal_toIdeal,
      Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hi₀mem
    exact hi₀mem
  have hs1 : (s : Polynomial k n) ∣ coordinate k n i₁ := by
    have hi₁mem := h i₁
    rw [GradedIdealQuotient.principalIdeal_toIdeal,
      Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hi₁mem
    exact hi₁mem
  let X₀ : grading k n 1 :=
    ⟨coordinate k n i₀, coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i₀⟩
  let X₁ : grading k n 1 :=
    ⟨coordinate k n i₁, coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i₁⟩
  have hX0 : X₀ ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    exact MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero i₀ (congrArg Subtype.val hzero)
  have hX1 : X₁ ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    exact MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero i₁ (congrArg Subtype.val hzero)
  have hassoc0 : Associated (s : Polynomial k n) (coordinate k n i₀) :=
    (degreeOne_irreducible k n s hs).associated_of_dvd
      (degreeOne_irreducible k n X₀ hX0) hs0
  have hassoc1 : Associated (s : Polynomial k n) (coordinate k n i₁) :=
    (degreeOne_irreducible k n s hs).associated_of_dvd
      (degreeOne_irreducible k n X₁ hX1) hs1
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (hassoc0.symm.trans hassoc1).dvd
  let v : Fin (n + 1) → k := fun j ↦ if j = i₁ then 1 else 0
  have heval := congrArg (MvPolynomial.eval v) hc
  simp [coordinate, v, hi] at heval

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.asHomogeneousIdeal_hyperplaneι_genericHyperplanePoint
statement:
theorem asHomogeneousIdeal_hyperplaneι_genericHyperplanePoint
    (s : grading k n 1) (hs : s ≠ 0) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ((hyperplaneι k n s) (genericHyperplanePoint k n s hs hn)).asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal =
      (hyperplaneIdeal k n s).toIdeal
proof:
:= by
  change Ideal.comap
      (GradedIdealQuotient.quotientMap (grading k n) (hyperplaneIdeal k n s)) ⊥ = _
  rw [← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot]
  ext x
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker, GradedIdealQuotient.quotientMap_apply,
    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.genericHyperplanePoint_mem_genericPoints
statement:
theorem genericHyperplanePoint_mem_genericPoints
    (s : grading k n 1) (hs : s ≠ 0) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    genericHyperplanePoint k n s hs hn ∈ genericPoints (hyperplane k n s)
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsNoetherian (hyperplane k n s) := by
    letI : CompactSpace (hyperplane k n s) :=
      (hyperplaneι k n s).isClosedEmbedding.compactSpace
    exact { __ := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (hyperplaneι k n s) }
  apply AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.mem_genericPoints_of_isMax
  intro z _
  rw [Scheme.le_iff_specializes, specializes_iff_mem_closure]
  exact (ProjectiveSpectrum.le_iff_mem_closure _
    (genericHyperplanePoint k n s hs hn) z).mp (by
      change (⊥ : HomogeneousIdeal _) ≤ z.asHomogeneousIdeal
      exact bot_le)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.isIntegral_hyperplane
statement:
theorem isIntegral_hyperplane
    (s : grading k n 1) (hs : s ≠ 0) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    IsIntegral (hyperplane k n s)
proof:
:= by
  let I := hyperplaneIdeal k n s
  let 𝒬 := GradedIdealQuotient.grading (grading k n) I
  have hprime : I.toIdeal.IsPrime := hyperplaneIdeal_isPrime k n s hs
  letI : IsDomain (Polynomial k n ⧸ I.toIdeal) :=
    (Ideal.Quotient.isDomain_iff_prime I.toIdeal).mpr hprime
  let η : hyperplane k n s := genericHyperplanePoint k n s hs hn
  have hη_basicOpen {f : Polynomial k n ⧸ I.toIdeal} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
      η ∈ Proj.basicOpen 𝒬 f :=
    (Proj.mem_basicOpen (𝒜 := 𝒬) (f := f) η).mpr
      (fun hmem ↦ by
        change f ∈ (⊥ : HomogeneousIdeal 𝒬).toIdeal at hmem
        exact hf (Ideal.mem_bot.mp hmem))
  have hη_open {u : Set (hyperplane k n s)}
      (hu : IsOpen u) (hne : u.Nonempty) : η ∈ u := by
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hne
    obtain ⟨U', hU', hyU', hle⟩ :=
      TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp
        (Proj.isBasis_basicOpen 𝒬) (U := ⟨u, hu⟩) hy
    obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := hU'
    have hf : f ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      subst h0
      have := (Proj.mem_basicOpen (𝒜 := 𝒬) (f := 0) y).mp hyU'
      exact this (Ideal.zero_mem _)
    exact hle (hη_basicOpen hf)
  letI : IrreducibleSpace (hyperplane k n s) :=
    { isPreirreducible_univ := by
        intro u v hu hv hune hvne
        refine ⟨η, Set.mem_univ _, ?_, ?_⟩
        · exact hη_open hu ⟨hune.choose, hune.choose_spec.2⟩
        · exact hη_open hv ⟨hvne.choose, hvne.choose_spec.2⟩
      toNonempty := ⟨η⟩ }
  have hAtPrime (x : ProjectiveSpectrum 𝒬) :
      IsDomain (HomogeneousLocalization.AtPrime 𝒬
        x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) := by
    haveI hloc : IsDomain
        (Localization.AtPrime x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) := by
      apply IsLocalization.isDomain_of_le_nonZeroDivisors
        (M := x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal.primeCompl)
      intro a ha
      exact mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero
        (fun h0 ↦ ha (h0 ▸ Ideal.zero_mem _))
    haveI : Nontrivial
        (HomogeneousLocalization.AtPrime 𝒬 x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) := by
      refine ⟨1, 0, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
      have hval := congrArg HomogeneousLocalization.val h
      rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_one, HomogeneousLocalization.val_zero] at hval
      exact one_ne_zero hval
    haveI : NoZeroDivisors
        (HomogeneousLocalization.AtPrime 𝒬 x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) := by
      refine ⟨fun {a b} hab ↦ ?_⟩
      have hval : HomogeneousLocalization.val a * HomogeneousLocalization.val b = 0 := by
        rw [← HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul, hab, HomogeneousLocalization.val_zero]
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hval with h | h
      · exact Or.inl (HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective _
          (h.trans HomogeneousLocalization.val_zero.symm))
      · exact Or.inr (HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective _
          (h.trans HomogeneousLocalization.val_zero.symm))
    exact NoZeroDivisors.to_isDomain _
  letI : ∀ x : hyperplane k n s,
      IsDomain ((hyperplane k n s).presheaf.stalk x) := fun x ↦ by
    let e := Proj.stalkIso' 𝒬 x
    letI : IsDomain (HomogeneousLocalization.AtPrime 𝒬
        x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) := hAtPrime x
    exact e.toMulEquiv.isDomain _
  haveI : IsReduced (hyperplane k n s) := by
    haveI : ∀ x : hyperplane k n s,
        _root_.IsReduced ((hyperplane k n s).presheaf.stalk x) := fun x ↦ inferInstance
    exact isReduced_of_isReduced_stalk _
  exact isIntegral_of_irreducibleSpace_of_isReduced _

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.nonempty_of_fact
statement: theorem nonempty_of_fact : Nonempty W
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIntegral W := (Fact.out : ProjectiveIntegral k W).1
  infer_instance

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.exists_rank
statement:
theorem exists_rank {E : W.Modules} (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree W E) :
    ∃ r, HasConstantRank W E r
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty W := nonempty_of_fact k
  haveI : PreconnectedSpace W := preconnected_projectiveIntegral (k := k) (X := W)
  exact hasConstantRank_of_isFiniteLocallyFree_of_preconnected hE

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.rkOf_eq
statement: theorem rkOf_eq {E : W.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank W E r) : rkOf E = r
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty W := nonempty_of_fact k
  have h : ∃ r, Nonempty (HasConstantRank W E r) := ⟨r, ⟨hE⟩⟩
  unfold rkOf
  rw [dif_pos h]
  exact hasConstantRank_unique h.choose_spec.some hE

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.chernSeq_eq
statement:
theorem chernSeq_eq (hP : ProjBundleClosedPos (ProjectiveIntegral k)) (E : W.Modules) :
    chernSeq k hP E = constRankChernAssignOn' (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) hP W E
proof: := rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.whitneyConstRank_of_isMultiplicative
statement:
theorem whitneyConstRank_of_isMultiplicative (hP : ProjBundleClosedPos (ProjectiveIntegral k))
    (hM : IsMultiplicativeCharOn (opsV4 k)
      (constRankChernAssignOn' (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) hP) (chernLineValOn (opsV4 k))) :
    WhitneyConstRankOn (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) hP
proof:
:= by
  intro X _ _ _ _ _ A B D a b w hs r s hA hD
  intro n
  exact hM.mult a b w hs hA.isFiniteLocallyFree
    (hasConstantRank_middle hs hA hD).isFiniteLocallyFree hD.isFiniteLocallyFree n

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.chExact_of_whitney
statement:
theorem chExact_of_whitney (hP : ProjBundleClosedPos (ProjectiveIntegral k))
    (hW : WhitneyConstRankOn (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) hP) : ChExact k hP
proof:
:= by
  intro W _ _ _ _ A B D f g w hs hA hB hD
  haveI : Nonempty W := nonempty_of_fact k
  obtain ⟨r, hAr⟩ := exists_rank k hA
  obtain ⟨s, hDs⟩ := exists_rank k hD
  have hBr := hasConstantRank_middle hs hAr hDs
  unfold chBundle
  rw [rkOf_eq k hBr, rkOf_eq k hAr, rkOf_eq k hDs]
  have hconv := convData (ops := opsV4 k) (cp := cpV4 k) (hP := hP) hW f g w hs hAr hDs
  exact chFromChern_conv hconv r s

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.chExact_of_isMultiplicative
statement:
theorem chExact_of_isMultiplicative (hP : ProjBundleClosedPos (ProjectiveIntegral k))
    (hM : IsMultiplicativeCharOn (opsV4 k)
      (constRankChernAssignOn' (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) hP) (chernLineValOn (opsV4 k))) :
    ChExact k hP
proof:
:=
  chExact_of_whitney hP (whitneyConstRank_of_isMultiplicative hP hM)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.chBundle_directSum
statement:
theorem chBundle_directSum (hP : ProjBundleClosedPos (ProjectiveIntegral k))
    (h : ChExact k hP) {A D : W.Modules} (hA : IsFiniteLocallyFree W A)
    (hD : IsFiniteLocallyFree W D) :
    chBundle k hP (A ⊞ D) = chBundle k hP A + chBundle k hP D
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty W := nonempty_of_fact k
  obtain ⟨r, hAr⟩ := exists_rank k hA
  obtain ⟨s, hDs⟩ := exists_rank k hD
  have hS := (ShortComplex.Splitting.ofHasBinaryBiproduct A D).shortExact
  exact h biprod.inl biprod.snd (by simp) hS hA
    (hasConstantRank_middle hS hAr hDs).isFiniteLocallyFree hD

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.chBundle_line
statement:
theorem chBundle_line (hP : ProjBundleClosedPos (ProjectiveIntegral k)) (L : W.Modules)
    (hL : HasConstantRank W L 1) :
    chBundle k hP L = Alg.gexp (totalCapOn (opsV4 k) L hL)
proof:
:= by
  have hr := rkOf_eq k hL
  set u := totalCapOn (opsV4 k) L hL with hu
  have hc1 : chernSeq k hP L 1 = u := by
    rw [chernSeq_line k hP L hL]; simp [lineChern, chernLineValOn, hu]
  have hc2 : ∀ j, 2 ≤ j → chernSeq k hP L j = 0 := by
    intro j hj
    rw [chernSeq_line k hP L hL]
    simp [lineChern, chernLineValOn, show j ≠ 0 by omega, show j ≠ 1 by omega]
  have hps := Alg.powerSum_line u (chernSeq k hP L) hc1 hc2
  unfold chBundle Alg.chFromChern
  rw [hr]
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro y
  have key : (1 : Module.End ℚ (TotalChow W)) +
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (if m = 0 then (0 : Module.End ℚ (TotalChow W)) else
        (PowerSeries.coeff m (CharacteristicClasses.chLine ℚ)) • Alg.powerSum (chernSeq k hP L) m) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((j.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) • u ^ j := by
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ' _ n, Finset.sum_range_succ' _ n]
    simp only [if_true, add_zero, Nat.factorial_zero, Nat.cast_one, inv_one, one_smul, pow_zero]
    rw [add_comm]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ ↦ ?_
    rw [if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero m), hps (m + 1) (by omega)]
    simp [CharacteristicClasses.chLine, PowerSeries.coeff_exp]
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.one_apply,
    Alg.gsum_lof, Alg.gexp_lof, Nat.cast_one, one_smul]
  rw [← key]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.m7geoC_awayCoordinateEquiv_ratio
statement:
theorem m7geoC_awayCoordinateEquiv_ratio (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ)
    {a b : Fin (n + 1)} (hba : b ≠ a) :
    awayCoordinateEquiv R n a (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.isLocalizationElem
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n a) (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n b)) =
      MvPolynomial.X ⟨b, hba⟩
proof:
:= by
  unfold awayCoordinateEquiv
  rw [RingEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
  change _ = awayCoordinateHom R n a (MvPolynomial.X ⟨b, hba⟩)
  rw [awayCoordinateHom, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X']
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp [coordinateRatio, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.m7geoC_stdChart_mem_coordinateOpen
statement:
theorem m7geoC_stdChart_mem_coordinateOpen (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ)
    {a b : Fin (n + 1)} (hba : b ≠ a)
    (Q : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n a) R)) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_stdChart R n a Q ∈ coordinateOpen R n b ↔
      MvPolynomial.X (⟨b, hba⟩ : AffineChartIndex n a) ∉ Q.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  have hpre := Proj.awayι_preimage_basicOpen (grading R n)
    (f_deg := coordinate_mem_degree_one R n a) (hm := Nat.zero_lt_one)
    (g_deg := coordinate_mem_degree_one R n b) (hm' := Nat.zero_lt_one)
  change Spec.map (awayCoordinateEquiv R n a).toCommRingCatIso.hom Q ∈
    Proj.awayι (grading R n) (coordinate R n a) (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n a)
      Nat.zero_lt_one ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen (grading R n) (coordinate R n b) ↔ _
  rw [hpre]
  change awayCoordinateEquiv R n a
      (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.isLocalizationElem
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n a) (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n b)) ∉ Q.asIdeal ↔ _
  rw [m7geoC_awayCoordinateEquiv_ratio R n hba]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoC_J_mem_W_iff_X
statement:
theorem m7geoC_J_mem_W_iff_X {a b : Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1)}
    (hba : b ≠ a)
    (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a)
      Γ(X, C.U i))) :
    m7g_J C i a P ∈ m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm b) ↔
      MvPolynomial.X (⟨b, hba⟩ : AffineChartIndex _ a) ∉ P.asIdeal
proof:
:=
  (m7geo_J_mem_W_iff C i a b P).trans
    (m7geoC_stdChart_mem_coordinateOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) hba P)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoC_two_vanishing_in_chart
statement:
theorem m7geoC_two_vanishing_in_chart
    (x : C.scheme) (hx : C.toBase x ∈ C.U i)
    (c : Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1)) (hc0 : c ≠ 0)
    (h0 : x ∉ m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0))
    (hc : x ∉ m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm c)) :
    ∃ (a : Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1))
      (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a)
        Γ(X, C.U i))) (ha0 : a ≠ 0) (hac : a ≠ c),
      MvPolynomial.X (⟨0, Ne.symm ha0⟩ : AffineChartIndex _ a) ∈ P.asIdeal ∧
      MvPolynomial.X (⟨c, Ne.symm hac⟩ : AffineChartIndex _ a) ∈ P.asIdeal ∧
      m7g_J C i a P = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, P, hP⟩ := m7g_exists_J C i x hx
  have haW : m7g_J C i a P ∈
      m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a) := by
    rw [m7geo_J_mem_W_iff C i]
    have hrange : m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a P ∈
        Set.range (m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a) :=
      ⟨P, rfl⟩
    rw [m6pb_range_stdChart] at hrange
    exact hrange
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    subst a
    exact h0 (hP ▸ haW)
  have hac : a ≠ c := by
    intro h
    subst a
    exact hc (hP ▸ haW)
  have h0P : MvPolynomial.X (⟨0, Ne.symm ha0⟩ : AffineChartIndex _ a) ∈ P.asIdeal := by
    have hnot : m7g_J C i a P ∉
        m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0) := by
      rw [hP]
      exact h0
    rw [m7geoC_J_mem_W_iff_X C i (Ne.symm ha0)] at hnot
    exact not_not.mp hnot
  have hcP : MvPolynomial.X (⟨c, Ne.symm hac⟩ : AffineChartIndex _ a) ∈ P.asIdeal := by
    have hnot : m7g_J C i a P ∉
        m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm c) := by
      rw [hP]
      exact hc
    rw [m7geoC_J_mem_W_iff_X C i (Ne.symm hac)] at hnot
    exact not_not.mp hnot
  exact ⟨a, P, ha0, hac, h0P, hcP, hP⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoC_two_vanishing_closure
statement:
theorem m7geoC_two_vanishing_closure {v : X} (hv : v ∈ C.U i)
    (t : ℕ) (z : pointClosureScheme (m7g_w C i hv t))
    (hzv : C.toBase (pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z) = v)
    (c : Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1)) (hc0 : c ≠ 0)
    (h0 : pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z ∉
      m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0))
    (hc : pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z ∉
      m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm c)) :
    ∃ (a : Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1))
      (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a)
        Γ(X, C.U i))) (ha0 : a ≠ 0) (hac : a ≠ c),
      t < (a : ℕ) ∧
      MvPolynomial.X (⟨0, Ne.symm ha0⟩ : AffineChartIndex _ a) ∈ P.asIdeal ∧
      MvPolynomial.X (⟨c, Ne.symm hac⟩ : AffineChartIndex _ a) ∈ P.asIdeal ∧
      m7g_J C i a P = pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z
proof:
:= by
  have hx : C.toBase (pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z) ∈ C.U i := by
    rw [hzv]
    exact hv
  obtain ⟨a, P, ha0, hac, h0P, hcP, hP⟩ :=
    m7geoC_two_vanishing_in_chart C i _ hx c hc0 h0 hc
  have hza : pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z ∈
      m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a) := by
    rw [← hP, m7geo_J_mem_W_iff C i]
    have hrange : m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a P ∈
        Set.range (m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a) :=
      ⟨P, rfl⟩
    rw [m6pb_range_stdChart] at hrange
    exact hrange
  have hsp : m7g_w C i hv t ⤳ pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z := by
    rw [specializes_iff_mem_closure, ← range_pointClosureι]
    exact ⟨z, rfl⟩
  have hwa : m7g_w C i hv t ∈
      m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a) :=
    hsp.mem_open (m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a)).isOpen hza
  change m7g_J C i 0 (m7g_Q C i hv t) ∈ _ at hwa
  rw [m7geoC_J_mem_W_iff_X C i ha0] at hwa
  have hat : t < (a : ℕ) := by
    by_contra h
    have hle : (a : ℕ) ≤ t := by omega
    apply hwa
    change MvPolynomial.X (⟨a, ha0⟩ : AffineChartIndex _ 0) ∈
      RingHom.ker (m7g_phi (m7g_q C i hv).asIdeal
        (fun j : AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0 ↦ (j.1 : ℕ)) t)
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker, m7g_phi_X, if_pos hle]
  exact ⟨a, P, ha0, hac, hat, h0P, hcP, hP⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoC_no_height_one_above_two_steps
statement:
theorem m7geoC_no_height_one_above_two_steps {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    {Q R S P : Ideal A} [Q.IsPrime] [R.IsPrime] [P.IsPrime]
    (hQR : Q < R) (hRS : R < S) (hSP : S ≤ P)
    (hheight : (P.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk Q)).height = 1) : False
proof:
:= by
  have hRP : R ≤ P := hRS.le.trans hSP
  have hPR : P = R := m7geo_eq_of_quotient_height_one hQR hRP hheight
  have hSR : S ≤ R := by simpa only [hPR] using hSP
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hSR) hRS

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistPullHom_comp_of_chosenTripleComp
statement:
theorem twistPullHom_comp_of_chosenTripleComp
    {d : ℤ} (T : C.TwistTransitionSystem d)
    (hT : C.TwistChosenTripleComp T)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ C.scheme)
    {i j k : C.I}
    (fᵢ : Y ⟶ C.chart i) (fⱼ : Y ⟶ C.chart j)
    (fₖ : Y ⟶ C.chart k)
    (hfᵢ : fᵢ ≫ C.chartι i = q)
    (hfⱼ : fⱼ ≫ C.chartι j = q)
    (hfₖ : fₖ ≫ C.chartι k = q) :
    C.twistPullHom T q fᵢ fⱼ hfᵢ hfⱼ ≫
        C.twistPullHom T q fⱼ fₖ hfⱼ hfₖ =
      C.twistPullHom T q fᵢ fₖ hfᵢ hfₖ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hgI, hgJ, hgK⟩ :=
    (C.twistChosenPullback₃ i j k).exists_lift
      fᵢ fⱼ fₖ q hfᵢ hfⱼ hfₖ
  have hgq : g ≫ (C.twistChosenPullback₃ i j k).p = q := by
    rw [← C.twistChosenPullback₃_w₁ i j k,
      ← Category.assoc, hgI, hfᵢ]
  have hIJ :
      Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
          (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
          (C.twistChosenTriplePullHomIJ T i j k)
          g fᵢ fⱼ hgI hgJ =
        C.twistPullHom T q fᵢ fⱼ hfᵢ hfⱼ := by
    simpa only [twistChosenTriplePullHomIJ, twistPullHom] using
      (Pseudofunctor.DescentData'.pullHom_pullHom'
        (sq := fun a b ↦ C.glueData.chosenPullback a b)
        (C.twistTransitionHom T)
        g (C.twistChosenPullback₃ i j k).p q
        (C.twistChosenPullback₃ i j k).p₁
        (C.twistChosenPullback₃ i j k).p₂
        fᵢ fⱼ hgq
        (C.twistChosenPullback₃_w₁ i j k)
        (C.twistChosenPullback₃_w₂ i j k)
        hgI hgJ)
  have hJK :
      Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
          (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
          (C.twistChosenTriplePullHomJK T i j k)
          g fⱼ fₖ hgJ hgK =
        C.twistPullHom T q fⱼ fₖ hfⱼ hfₖ := by
    simpa only [twistChosenTriplePullHomJK, twistPullHom] using
      (Pseudofunctor.DescentData'.pullHom_pullHom'
        (sq := fun a b ↦ C.glueData.chosenPullback a b)
        (C.twistTransitionHom T)
        g (C.twistChosenPullback₃ i j k).p q
        (C.twistChosenPullback₃ i j k).p₂
        (C.twistChosenPullback₃ i j k).p₃
        fⱼ fₖ hgq
        (C.twistChosenPullback₃_w₂ i j k)
        (C.twistChosenPullback₃_w₃ i j k)
        hgJ hgK)
  have hIK :
      Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
          (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
          (C.twistChosenTriplePullHomIK T i j k)
          g fᵢ fₖ hgI hgK =
        C.twistPullHom T q fᵢ fₖ hfᵢ hfₖ := by
    simpa only [twistChosenTriplePullHomIK, twistPullHom] using
      (Pseudofunctor.DescentData'.pullHom_pullHom'
        (sq := fun a b ↦ C.glueData.chosenPullback a b)
        (C.twistTransitionHom T)
        g (C.twistChosenPullback₃ i j k).p q
        (C.twistChosenPullback₃ i j k).p₁
        (C.twistChosenPullback₃ i j k).p₃
        fᵢ fₖ hgq
        (C.twistChosenPullback₃_w₁ i j k)
        (C.twistChosenPullback₃_w₃ i j k)
        hgI hgK)
  calc
    _ =
        Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
            (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
            (C.twistChosenTriplePullHomIJ T i j k)
            g fᵢ fⱼ hgI hgJ ≫
          Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
            (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
            (C.twistChosenTriplePullHomJK T i j k)
            g fⱼ fₖ hgJ hgK := by
      rw [hIJ, hJK]
    _ =
        Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
          (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
          (C.twistChosenTriplePullHomIJ T i j k ≫
            C.twistChosenTriplePullHomJK T i j k)
          g fᵢ fₖ hgI hgK :=
      twistPullHomAux_pullHom_comp
        (C.twistChosenPullback₃ i j k).p₁
        (C.twistChosenPullback₃ i j k).p₂
        (C.twistChosenPullback₃ i j k).p₃
        (C.twistChosenTriplePullHomIJ T i j k)
        (C.twistChosenTriplePullHomJK T i j k)
        g fᵢ fⱼ fₖ hgI hgJ hgK
    _ =
        Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
          (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
          (C.twistChosenTriplePullHomIK T i j k)
          g fᵢ fₖ hgI hgK := by
      rw [hT.comp i j k]
    _ = _ := hIK

name: KSpecialization.ARRHU.comap_ideal_top_le
statement:
theorem comap_ideal_top_le {U V : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine U] [IsAffine V] (g : U ⟶ V)
    (J : V.IdealSheafData) :
    (J.comap g).ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top U⟩ ≤
      (J.ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top V⟩).map g.appTop.hom
proof:
:= by
  let K : U.IdealSheafData := Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
      ((J.ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top V⟩).map g.appTop.hom)
  have hK : K.ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top U⟩ =
      (J.ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top V⟩).map g.appTop.hom := by
    simp [K]
  have hmap := Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_map_of_isAffineHom K g ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top V⟩
  have h : J ≤ K.map g := by
    refine Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_of_isAffine ?_
    rw [hmap]
    intro x hx
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap]
    exact hK ▸ Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hx
  have := Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_map_iff_comap_le.1 h ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top U⟩
  exact hK ▸ this

name: KSpecialization.ARRHU.comap_eq_comap_comap
statement:
theorem comap_eq_comap_comap {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (I : Y.IdealSheafData)
    (V : Y.Opens) (U : X.Opens) (h : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V) :
    (I.comap V.ι).comap (f.resLE V U h) = (I.comap f).comap U.ι
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp, ← Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp,
    Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι]

name: KSpecialization.ARRHU.mem_comap_ι_top_iff
statement:
theorem mem_comap_ι_top_iff {X : Scheme.{u}} (J : X.IdealSheafData) (U : X.affineOpens)
    (s : Γ((U : X.Opens), ⊤)) :
    s ∈ (J.comap (U : X.Opens).ι).ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩ ↔
      (U : X.Opens).topIso.hom s ∈ J.ideal U
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsAffine (U : X.Opens) := U.2
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_comap_of_isOpenImmersion J (U : X.Opens).ι
    ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩, Ideal.mem_comap]
  have h : (((U : X.Opens).ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : (U : X.Opens).toScheme.Opens) : X.Opens)) = (U : X.Opens) :=
    Scheme.Opens.ι_image_top _
  have := mem_ideal_map_eqToHom J (U1 := ⟨(U : X.Opens).ι ''ᵁ ⊤, (isAffineOpen_top _).image_of_isOpenImmersion _⟩)
    (U2 := U) h ((Scheme.Hom.appIso (U : X.Opens).ι ⊤).inv s)
  refine this.trans (iff_of_eq (congrArg (· ∈ J.ideal U) ?_))
  simp [Scheme.Opens.topIso]
  rfl

name: KSpecialization.ARRHU.comap_ideal_le_span
statement:
theorem comap_ideal_le_span {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (I : Y.IdealSheafData)
    (V : Y.affineOpens) (U : X.affineOpens) (h : (U : X.Opens) ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ (V : Y.Opens)) :
    (I.comap f).ideal U ≤ Ideal.span ((f.appLE V U h).hom '' (I.ideal V))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsAffine (U : X.Opens) := U.2
  haveI : IsAffine (V : Y.Opens) := V.2
  have h1 := comap_ideal_top_le (f.resLE V U h) (I.comap (V : Y.Opens).ι)
  rw [comap_eq_comap_comap f I V U h] at h1
  intro r hr
  have e : ∀ x : Γ(X, (U : X.Opens)),
      (U : X.Opens).topIso.hom.hom ((U : X.Opens).topIso.inv.hom x) = x := fun x =>
    Iso.inv_hom_id_apply (U : X.Opens).topIso x
  have hρ : (U : X.Opens).topIso.inv r ∈
      ((I.comap f).comap (U : X.Opens).ι).ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩ := by
    rw [mem_comap_ι_top_iff, e]
    exact hr
  have h2 := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (U : X.Opens).topIso.hom.hom (h1 hρ)
  have hc : (f.resLE V U h).appTop ≫ (U : X.Opens).topIso.hom =
      (V : Y.Opens).topIso.hom ≫ f.appLE V U h := by
    have hr' : (f.resLE V U h).appTop =
        (V : Y.Opens).topIso.hom ≫ f.appLE V U h ≫ (U : X.Opens).topIso.inv :=
      Scheme.Hom.resLE_app_top f h
    rw [hr']
    simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  have hcomp : (U : X.Opens).topIso.hom.hom.comp (f.resLE V U h).appTop.hom =
      (f.appLE V U h).hom.comp (V : Y.Opens).topIso.hom.hom := by
    have := congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom hc
    rw [CommRingCat.hom_comp, CommRingCat.hom_comp] at this
    exact this
  rw [e, Ideal.map_map, hcomp, ← Ideal.map_map] at h2
  have h3 : Ideal.map (V : Y.Opens).topIso.hom.hom
      ((I.comap (V : Y.Opens).ι).ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩) ≤ I.ideal V := by
    rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro a ha
    exact (mem_comap_ι_top_iff I V a).1 ha
  exact Ideal.map_mono (f := (f.appLE V U h).hom) h3 h2

name: KSpecialization.ARRHU.killedOn_of_sections
statement:
theorem killedOn_of_sections {X : Scheme.{u}} (P : X.IdealSheafData) (U : X.affineOpens)
    (E : X.Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent]
    (h : ∀ r ∈ P.ideal U, ∀ m : Γ(E, (U : X.Opens)), r • m = 0) : KilledOn P U E
proof:
:= by
  intro r hr
  haveI : IsAffine (U : X.Opens) := U.2
  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U : X.Opens).ι).obj E).IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  refine AR5R.Nilp.tMul_eq_zero_of_smul_top
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U : X.Opens).ι).obj E) _ (fun m => ?_)
  have e : ((U : X.Opens).ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : (U : X.Opens).toScheme.Opens) : X.Opens) = U :=
    Scheme.Opens.ι_image_top _
  have hm := h r hr (E.presheaf.map (eqToHom e.symm).op m)
  have := congrArg (E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_of_eq e)).op) hm
  rw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul, map_zero] at this
  have h2 : ∀ m' : Γ(E, (U : X.Opens).ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : (U : X.Opens).toScheme.Opens)),
      E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_of_eq e)).op (E.presheaf.map (eqToHom e.symm).op m') = m' :=
    fun m' => by
      rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
      simp
  rw [h2 m] at this
  have key : ∀ (r' : Γ((U : X.Opens), ⊤))
      (m' : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U : X.Opens).ι).obj E, ⊤)),
      r' • m' = (((U : X.Opens).ι.appIso ⊤).inv r' •
        (@id Γ(E, (U : X.Opens).ι ''ᵁ ⊤) m') : Γ(E, (U : X.Opens).ι ''ᵁ ⊤)) := fun _ _ => rfl
  refine (key _ m).trans ?_
  have hl : ((U : X.Opens).ι.appIso ⊤).inv (localGen (U : X.Opens) r) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_of_eq e)).op r := by
    simp [localGen]
    rfl
  rw [hl]
  exact this

name: KSpecialization.ARRHU.comap_smul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem comap_smul_eq_zero
    (hF : ∀ (V : Y.affineOpens), ∀ a ∈ I.ideal V, ∀ m : Γ(E, F ⁻¹ᵁ (V : Y.Opens)),
      (F.app (V : Y.Opens)).hom a • m = 0)
    (V : Y.affineOpens) (hU : IsAffineOpen (F ⁻¹ᵁ (V : Y.Opens)))
    (r : Γ(W, F ⁻¹ᵁ (V : Y.Opens))) (hr : r ∈ (I.comap F).ideal ⟨F ⁻¹ᵁ (V : Y.Opens), hU⟩)
    (m : Γ(E, F ⁻¹ᵁ (V : Y.Opens))) : r • m = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := comap_ideal_le_span F I V ⟨F ⁻¹ᵁ (V : Y.Opens), hU⟩ le_rfl hr
  refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun r _ => r • m = 0) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ h
  · rintro _ ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    have := hF V a ha m
    rw [Scheme.Hom.app_eq_appLE] at this
    exact this
  · exact zero_smul _ _
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy
    rw [add_smul, hx, hy, add_zero]
  · intro c x _ hx
    rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_smul, hx, smul_zero]

name: KSpecialization.ARRHU.isIso_adjUnit_comap
statement:
theorem isIso_adjUnit_comap
    (hF : ∀ (V : Y.affineOpens), ∀ a ∈ I.ideal V, ∀ m : Γ(E, F ⁻¹ᵁ (V : Y.Opens)),
      (F.app (V : Y.Opens)).hom a • m = 0) :
    IsIso (adjUnit (I.comap F).subschemeι E)
proof:
:= by
  refine isIso_adjUnit_of_killedOn (I.comap F) E (ι := Y.affineOpens)
    (fun V => ⟨F ⁻¹ᵁ (V : Y.Opens), V.2.preimage F⟩) ?_ (fun V =>
      killedOn_of_sections _ _ E (fun r hr m =>
        comap_smul_eq_zero F I E hF V (V.2.preimage F) r hr m))
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.preimage_iSup, iSup_affineOpens_eq_top]
  rfl

name: KSpecialization.ARRHU.isIso_adjUnit_fst
statement:
theorem isIso_adjUnit_fst
    (hF : ∀ (V : Y.affineOpens), ∀ a ∈ I.ideal V, ∀ m : Γ(E, F ⁻¹ᵁ (V : Y.Opens)),
      (F.app (V : Y.Opens)).hom a • m = 0) :
    IsIso (adjUnit (pullback.fst F I.subschemeι) E)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isIso_adjUnit_comap F I E hF
  let J := I.comap F
  let G := (Scheme.Modules.pullback J.subschemeι).obj E
  haveI : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.fst F I.subschemeι)).Full :=
    (pushforwardFullyFaithful (pullback.fst F I.subschemeι)).full
  haveI : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.fst F I.subschemeι)).Faithful :=
    (pushforwardFullyFaithful (pullback.fst F I.subschemeι)).faithful
  let e : E ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.fst F I.subschemeι)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (I.comapIso F).hom).obj G) :=
    asIso (adjUnit J.subschemeι E) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (I.comapIso_hom_fst F).symm).app G ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (I.comapIso F).hom (pullback.fst F I.subschemeι)).app G).symm
  exact (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
    (pullback.fst F I.subschemeι)).isIso_unit_app_of_iso e

name: KSpecialization.ARRHU.hunit_ARRHU
statement:
theorem hunit_ARRHU (hL : SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank Y L 1)
    {W : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian W] (F : W ⟶ Y) [IsFinite F]
    (V : W.Modules) (hV : IsCoherentLike W V) :
    IsIso (adjUnit (pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι)
      (cokernel (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)))
        (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) V)))
proof:
:= by
  have hline : IsLocalLineFrame L := isLocalLineFrame_of_hasConstantRank_one hL
  have hΛ1 : SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank Y (lineBundleDual Y L) 1 :=
    lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank L hL
  have hΛ : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y (lineBundleDual Y L) := hΛ1.isFiniteLocallyFree
  have hΛW1 := SchemeKTheory.hasConstantRank_pullback W F _ 1 hΛ1
  have hΛW : IsFiniteLocallyFree W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)) :=
    hΛW1.isFiniteLocallyFree
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits Y _ hΛ
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits Y _ hΛ
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits W _ hΛW
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits W _ hΛW
  have hTW : ∀ E, IsCoherentLike W E → IsCoherentLike W
      ((tensorSheafLeftFunctor W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L))).obj E) :=
    fun E hE => tensorSheaf_isCoherentLike W _ _ hΛW hE
  have hcW := sigmaT_central (locallyTrivial_of_hasConstantRank_one hΛW1)
    (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))
  have hTV := hTW V hV
  have hE : IsCoherentLike W (cokernel (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)))
        (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) V)) :=
    (kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike (Y := W)).cokernel _ hTV hV
  haveI : (cokernel (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)))
        (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) V)).IsFinitePresentation := hE
  have hK := killed_cokernel hcW kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike hTW hV
  have hc := pushCompat F (dualEval σ) hΛ
  have hk := hc.killed (finitePush_obj F) _ hK
  have hkill : IdealKills (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj (cokernel (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)))
        (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) V))) :=
    (ar7Bridge σ hline).idealKills_of_killed _ hk.1 hk.2
  exact isIso_adjUnit_fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ) _ (fun V' a ha m => hkill V' a ha m)

name: KSpecialization.ARRHU.hbc_cartier_ARRHU
statement:
theorem hbc_cartier_ARRHU (hL : SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank Y L 1)
    (hreg : SectionIsRegular σ)
    [IsLocallyNoetherian (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme]
    {W : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian W] (F : W ⟶ Y) [IsFinite F]
    (hs : Mono (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ)))
    (V : W.Modules) (hV : IsCoherentLike W V) (hVfl : IsFiniteLocallyFree W V)
    (y : K0 Y) (hy : k0ToG0 Y y = finitePushforward F (g0ClassOf W V hV)) :
    ∃ (G : (pullback F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι).Modules)
      (hG : IsCoherentLike _ G),
      k0ToG0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme
        (pullbackK0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι y) =
      finitePushforward (pullback.snd F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι)
        (g0ClassOf _ G hG)
proof:
:=
  hbc_cartier_ARRG67_fibre σ hL hreg F hs V hV hVfl y hy (hunit_ARRHU σ hL F V hV)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.D34.exists_affineFrameCover_of_constantRank
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin, hc⟩ := hM
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := hqfin
  choose κ hsub heq using
    fun i ↦ Opens.isBasis_iff_cover.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens (q.X i)
  let U : (Σ i : q.I, κ i) → X.Opens := fun j ↦ j.2
  refine ⟨
    { I := Σ i : q.I, κ i
      U := U
      covers := ?_
      isAffine := fun j ↦ hsub j.1 j.2.2
      basisIndex := fun j ↦ (q.generators j.1).I
      basisIndex_finite := fun j ↦ by
        letI : (q.generators j.1).IsFiniteType :=
          SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType j.1
        infer_instance
      frame := fun j ↦ ?_ }, fun j ↦ hc j.1⟩
  · have hcover : IsOpenCover q.X :=
      (Opens.coversTop_iff X q.X).mp q.coversTop
    rw [IsOpenCover, iSup_sigma, ← hcover]
    refine iSup_congr fun i ↦ ?_
    rw [heq i, sSup_eq_iSup']
  · let F := SheafOfModules.overMap X.ringCatSheaf
      (homOfLE (show U j ≤ q.X j.1 by
        dsimp only [U]
        simp [heq, le_sSup]))
    exact
      Scheme.Modules.freeOverMapIso X (q.X j.1) (U j)
          (show U j ≤ q.X j.1 by
            dsimp only [U]
            simp [heq, le_sSup])
          (q.generators j.1).I ≪≫
        F.mapIso (asIso (q.generators j.1).π) ≪≫
          (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf
            (homOfLE (show U j ≤ q.X j.1 by
              dsimp only [U]
              simp [heq, le_sSup]))).app M

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoO_W0_le_J0_range
statement:
theorem m7geoO_W0_le_J0_range {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (i : C.I) [Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)] :
    m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0) ≤
      (m7g_J C i 0).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  have hyUi : C.toBase y ∈ C.U i :=
    m7geoF_W_le C i _ hy
  obtain ⟨a, Q, hQ⟩ := m7g_exists_J C i y hyUi
  have h0 : m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a Q ∈
      coordinateOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0 := by
    rw [← m7geo_J_mem_W_iff C i a 0 Q]
    rw [hQ]
    exact hy
  obtain ⟨Q0, hQ0⟩ :
      m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a Q ∈
        Set.range (m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i)
          (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0) := by
    rw [m6pb_range_stdChart]
    exact h0
  rw [Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange]
  refine ⟨Q0, ?_⟩
  change C.chartι i (inv (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace (m7g_b C i))
    (m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0 Q0)) = y
  rw [hQ0]
  exact hQ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoO_J0_range_eq_W0
statement:
theorem m7geoO_J0_range_eq_W0 {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (i : C.I) [Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)] :
    (m7g_J C i 0).opensRange =
      m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro y hy
    rw [Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange] at hy
    obtain ⟨Q, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [m7geo_J_mem_W_iff C i 0 0 Q]
    have hRange : m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0 Q ∈
        Set.range (m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i)
          (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0) := ⟨Q, rfl⟩
    rw [m6pb_range_stdChart] at hRange
    exact hRange
  · exact m7geoO_W0_le_J0_range C i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoO_eq_of_app_heq

theorem m7geoO_eq_of_app_heq {S Y : Scheme.{u}}

    (hxy : HEq (j.app U x) (j.app U y)) : x = y
proof:

  apply (asIso (j.app U)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.injective

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoO_overlap_le_J0_range
statement:
theorem m7geoO_overlap_le_J0_range {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (i : C.I) [Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoO_inverse_variable_restrict
statement:
theorem m7geoO_inverse_variable_restrict {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (j : Spec (CommRingCat.of A) ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (U : Y.Opens) (hU : U ≤ j.opensRange) (b : A) :
    j.app U
      (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hU).op
        ((m7geoN_rangeChartRingEquiv j).symm b)) =
      (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv b)
proof:
:= by
  have hW : (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).Opens) ≤
      j ⁻¹ᵁ j.opensRange := j.preimage_opensRange ▸ le_rfl
  have h := m7geoK_appLE_restrict_top j j.opensRange U hU hW
    ((m7geoN_rangeChartRingEquiv j).symm b)
  rw [m7geoN_rangeChartRingEquiv_symm_appLE] at h
  simpa only [Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app] using h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoO_ratio_eq_chart_variable_restrict
statement:
theorem m7geoO_ratio_eq_chart_variable_restrict {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (i : C.I) [Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)]
    {a : Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1)} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    let J
proof:
:= m7g_J C i 0
    let U := m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a) ⊓
      m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0)
    let hUW : U ≤ J.opensRange := m7geoO_overlap_le_J0_range C i a
    m7geoF_ratio C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a)
      ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0) =
        C.scheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUW).op
          ((m7geoN_rangeChartRingEquiv J).symm
            (MvPolynomial.X ⟨a, ha⟩)) := by
  let J := m7g_J C i 0
  let U := m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a) ⊓
    m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0)
  have hUW : U ≤ J.opensRange := m7geoO_overlap_le_J0_range C i a
  let b : MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0)
      Γ(X, C.U i) := MvPolynomial.X ⟨a, ha⟩
  let x : Γ(C.scheme, J.opensRange) := (m7geoN_rangeChartRingEquiv J).symm b
  let ratio : Γ(C.scheme, U) :=
    m7geoF_ratio C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a)
      ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0)
  let restrictX : Γ(C.scheme, U) := C.scheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUW).op x
  have hpre := m7geoL_J0_preimage_global_overlap C i a
  have hratio := m7geoL_J0_global_ratio_affine_variable_eq C i ha
  have hvar := m7geoO_inverse_variable_restrict J U hUW b
  have hvarCast := congrArg
    (fun s : Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of (MvPolynomial
        (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0) Γ(X, C.U i))),
        J ⁻¹ᵁ U) => hpre ▸ s) hvar
  rw [m7geoO_restrict_top_cast _ hpre] at hvarCast
  have hpull : J.app U ratio = J.app U restrictX :=
    m7geoO_eq_of_open_cast _ hpre _ _ (hratio.trans hvarCast.symm)
  dsimp only
  exact m7geoO_eq_of_app_heq J U hUW ratio restrictX (heq_of_eq hpull)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoO_pullback_germ_restrict
statement:
theorem m7geoO_pullback_germ_restrict {S Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral S]
    (f : S ⟶ Y) {U V : Y.Opens}
    [Nonempty (f ⁻¹ᵁ U)] [Nonempty (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)]
    (hUV : U ≤ V) (s : Γ(Y, V)) :
    S.germToFunctionField (f ⁻¹ᵁ U)
      (f.app U (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUV).op s)) =
        S.germToFunctionField (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (f.app V s)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun g => g s) (f.naturality (homOfLE hUV).op)
  change f.app U (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUV).op s) =
    S.presheaf.map (homOfLE ((TopologicalSpace.Opens.map f.base).monotone hUV)).op
      (f.app V s) at h
  rw [h]
  exact Scheme.m7geo_germToFunctionField_restrict _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoO_ratio_germ_eq_chart_variable
statement:
theorem m7geoO_ratio_germ_eq_chart_variable {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (i : C.I) [Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)] [IsIntegral S]
    (f : S ⟶ C.scheme)
    {a : Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1)} (ha : a ≠ 0)
    [Nonempty (f ⁻¹ᵁ (m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a) ⊓
      m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0)))]
    [Nonempty (f ⁻¹ᵁ (m7g_J C i 0).opensRange)] :
    S.germToFunctionField
      (f ⁻¹ᵁ (m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a) ⊓
        m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0)))
      (f.app _ (m7geoF_ratio C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a)
        ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0))) =
      S.germToFunctionField (f ⁻¹ᵁ (m7g_J C i 0).opensRange)
        (f.app _ ((m7geoN_rangeChartRingEquiv (m7g_J C i 0)).symm
          (MvPolynomial.X ⟨a, ha⟩)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [m7geoO_ratio_eq_chart_variable_restrict C i ha]
  exact m7geoO_pullback_germ_restrict f (m7geoO_overlap_le_J0_range C i a) _

name: KSpecialization.AR5R.specMap_essImage_of_killed
statement:
theorem specMap_essImage_of_killed (φ : R →+* S) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (E : (Spec (.of R)).Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hE : ∀ r ∈ RingHom.ker φ, tMul ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv r) E = 0) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).essImage E
proof:
:= by
  let M : ModuleCat (CommRingCat.of R) := (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj E).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤)
  have htors : Module.IsTorsionBySet R M (RingHom.ker φ : Set R) := by
    rintro m ⟨r, hr⟩
    change r • m = 0
    have hr' : r ∈ RingHom.ker φ := hr
    exact smul_eq_zero_of_tMul _ E (hE r hr') ⊤ m
  letI : Module (R ⧸ RingHom.ker φ) M := htors.module
  let e : S →+* R ⧸ RingHom.ker φ := (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective hφ).symm.toRingHom
  letI : Module S M := Module.compHom M e
  let N : ModuleCat S := ModuleCat.of S M
  let lin : M ≃ₗ[R] (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).obj N :=
    { AddEquiv.refl M with
      map_smul' := fun r m ↦ by
        change r • m = (e (φ r)) • m
        simp only [e, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe,
          RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective_symm_apply]
        exact (htors.mk_smul r m).symm }
  exact specMap_essImage_of_iso φ E N lin.toModuleIso.symm

name: KSpecialization.AR5R.affine_essImage_of_killed
statement:
theorem affine_essImage_of_killed {X' Y' : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine Y'] (f : X' ⟶ Y')
    [IsClosedImmersion f] (E : Y'.Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hE : ∀ s ∈ RingHom.ker f.appTop.hom, tMul s E = 0) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).essImage E
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsAffine X' := isAffine_of_isAffineHom f
  have hφ : Function.Surjective f.appTop.hom := f.app_surjective ⊤ (isAffineOpen_top Y')
  let E'' := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward Y'.isoSpec.hom).obj E
  haveI : E''.IsQuasicoherent := isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isAffine _ E
  have hE'' : ∀ s ∈ RingHom.ker f.appTop.hom,
      tMul ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of Γ(Y', ⊤))).inv s) E'' = 0 := fun s hs =>
    tMul_pushforward_eq_zero_of _ _ s (by
      change Y'.isoSpec.hom.appTop ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(Y', ⊤)).inv s) = s
      simp [Scheme.isoSpec]) E (hE s hs)
  obtain ⟨F0, ⟨e0⟩⟩ := specMap_essImage_of_killed f.appTop.hom hφ E'' hE''
  refine ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pushforward X'.isoSpec.inv).obj F0, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  have hcomm : X'.isoSpec.inv ≫ f =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f.appTop.hom) ≫ Y'.isoSpec.inv :=
    (Scheme.isoSpec_inv_naturality f).symm
  exact (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp X'.isoSpec.inv f).app F0 ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr hcomm).app F0 ≪≫
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp _ Y'.isoSpec.inv).app F0).symm ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward Y'.isoSpec.inv).mapIso e0 ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp Y'.isoSpec.hom Y'.isoSpec.inv).app E ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr Y'.isoSpec.hom_inv_id).app E ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardId Y').app E

name: KSpecialization.AR5R.tMul_mul
statement:
theorem tMul_mul (s t : Γ(Y, ⊤)) (E : Y.Modules) :
    tMul (s * t) E = tMul s E ≫ tMul t E
proof:
:= by
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro U
  ext m
  change tRes (s * t) U • m = tRes t U • (tRes s U • m)
  have h : tRes (s * t) U = tRes s U * tRes t U := map_mul (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op).hom s t
  have hc : tRes s U * tRes t U = tRes t U * tRes s U :=
    mul_comm (G := Γ(Y, U.unop)) (tRes s U : Γ(Y, U.unop)) (tRes t U : Γ(Y, U.unop))
  rw [h, ← mul_smul, hc]

name: KSpecialization.AR5R.tMul_one
statement: theorem tMul_one (E : Y.Modules) : tMul (1 : Γ(Y, ⊤)) E = 𝟙 E
proof:
:= by
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro U
  ext m
  change tRes (1 : Γ(Y, ⊤)) U • m = m
  have h : tRes (1 : Γ(Y, ⊤)) U = 1 := map_one (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op).hom
  rw [h, one_smul]

name: KSpecialization.AR5R.tMul_naturality
statement:
theorem tMul_naturality (s : Γ(Y, ⊤)) {A B : Y.Modules} (m : A ⟶ B) :
    m ≫ tMul s B = tMul s A ≫ m
proof:
:=
  (tNatTrans s).naturality m

name: KSpecialization.AR5R.tMul_eq_zero_of_iso
statement:
theorem tMul_eq_zero_of_iso (s : Γ(Y, ⊤)) {A B : Y.Modules} (e : A ≅ B) (h : tMul s B = 0) :
    tMul s A = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := tMul_naturality s e.hom
  rw [h, Limits.comp_zero] at this
  have h2 : tMul s A ≫ e.hom = 0 := this.symm
  exact (cancel_mono e.hom).1 (by rw [h2, Limits.zero_comp])

name: KSpecialization.AR5R.mem_ideal_map_eqToHom
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U2, hU2⟩ := U2
  obtain ⟨U1, hU1⟩ := U1
