  simp

name: KSpecialization.AR5R.exists_localGen_of_mem_ker
statement:
theorem exists_localGen_of_mem_ker (I : Y.IdealSheafData) (W : Y.affineOpens)
    (s : Γ((W : Y.Opens), ⊤))
    (hs : s ∈ RingHom.ker ((I.subschemeι ∣_ (W : Y.Opens)).appTop.hom)) :
    ∃ a ∈ I.ideal W, s = localGen (W : Y.Opens) a
proof:
:= by
  let V : Y.Opens := W
  haveI : IsAffine V := W.2
  let U' : Y.Opens := V.ι ''ᵁ ⊤
  have hU' : IsAffineOpen U' := (isAffineOpen_top V).image_of_isOpenImmersion V.ι
  have hinj : Function.Injective (I.subscheme.presheaf.map
      (eqToHom (image_morphismRestrict_preimage I.subschemeι V ⊤)).op).hom :=
    (I.subscheme.presheaf.mapIso
      (eqToIso (image_morphismRestrict_preimage I.subschemeι V ⊤)).op
      ).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.injective
  have hk : RingHom.ker ((I.subschemeι ∣_ V).appTop.hom) = I.ideal ⟨U', hU'⟩ := by
    rw [morphismRestrict_appTop]
    erw [CommRingCat.hom_comp]
    refine (RingHom.ker_comp_of_injective _ hinj).trans ?_
    exact Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_subschemeι_app (I := I) ⟨U', hU'⟩
  rw [hk] at hs
  have h : ((⟨U', hU'⟩ : Y.affineOpens) : Y.Opens) = (W : Y.Opens) := Scheme.Opens.ι_image_top V
  refine ⟨Y.presheaf.map (eqToHom h.symm).op s, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (mem_ideal_map_eqToHom I (U1 := ⟨U', hU'⟩) (U2 := W) h s).1 hs
  · change s = Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_of_eq h)).op (Y.presheaf.map (eqToHom h.symm).op s)
    rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
    simp

name: KSpecialization.AR5R.localGen_mul
statement:
theorem localGen_mul (W : Y.Opens) (a b : Γ(Y, W)) :
    localGen W (a * b) = localGen W a * localGen W b
proof:
:=
  map_mul (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_of_eq (Scheme.Opens.ι_image_top W))).op).hom a b

name: KSpecialization.AR5R.killedOn_of_mono
statement:
theorem killedOn_of_mono {A B : Y.Modules} (m : A ⟶ B) [Mono m] (h : KilledOn P W B) :
    KilledOn P W A
proof:
:= by
  intro r hr
  let R := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (W : Y.Opens).ι
  haveI : Mono (R.map m) := inferInstance
  have h1 := tMul_naturality (localGen (W : Y.Opens) r) (R.map m)
  rw [h r hr, Limits.comp_zero] at h1
  exact (cancel_mono (R.map m)).1 (by rw [← h1, Limits.zero_comp])

name: KSpecialization.AR5R.killedOn_mono_of_le
statement:
theorem killedOn_mono_of_le {P Q : Y.IdealSheafData} (hPQ : P ≤ Q) {E : Y.Modules}
    (h : KilledOn Q W E) : KilledOn P W E
proof:
:=
  fun r hr => h r (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_mono hPQ W hr)

name: KSpecialization.AR5R.smul_gen_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
theorem smul_gen_eq_zero_of_mem {I : Y.IdealSheafData} {E : Y.Modules} (hE : IdealKills I E)
    {W : Y.affineOpens} {a : Γ(Y, (W : Y.Opens))} (ha' : a ∈ I.ideal W)
    (U : (W : Y.Opens).toScheme.Opens) (m : Γ(E, (W : Y.Opens).ι ''ᵁ U)) :
    Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (image_le_self (W : Y.Opens) U)).op a • m = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine smul_eq_zero_of_local (E := E) hE (U := (W : Y.Opens).ι ''ᵁ U) _
    (fun W' hW' => ?_) m
  exact res_res_mem_ideal (image_le_self (W : Y.Opens) U) ha' hW'

name: KSpecialization.AR5R.tMul_localGen_restrict_of_mem
statement:
theorem tMul_localGen_restrict_of_mem {I : Y.IdealSheafData} (E : Y.Modules)
    (hE : IdealKills I E) (W : Y.affineOpens) {a : Γ(Y, (W : Y.Opens))} (ha : a ∈ I.ideal W) :
    tMul (localGen (W : Y.Opens) a)
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (W : Y.Opens).ι).obj E) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro U
  ext m
  have key : ∀ (r : Γ((W : Y.Opens), U.unop))
      (m : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (W : Y.Opens).ι).obj E, U.unop)),
      r • m = (((W : Y.Opens).ι.appIso U.unop).inv r • (@id Γ(E, (W : Y.Opens).ι ''ᵁ U.unop) m) :
        Γ(E, (W : Y.Opens).ι ''ᵁ U.unop)) := fun _ _ => rfl
  have hr : ((W : Y.Opens).ι.appIso U.unop).inv (tRes (localGen (W : Y.Opens) a) U) =
      Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (image_le_self W U.unop)).op a := appIso_inv_localGen _ a U.unop
  change tRes (localGen (W : Y.Opens) a) U • m = 0
  refine (key _ m).trans ?_
  rw [hr]
  exact smul_gen_eq_zero_of_mem hE ha U.unop _

name: KSpecialization.AR5R.killedOn_pushforward
statement:
theorem killedOn_pushforward (I : Y.IdealSheafData) (G : I.subscheme.Modules) (W : Y.affineOpens) :
    KilledOn I W ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward I.subschemeι).obj G)
proof:
:=
  fun _ ha => tMul_localGen_restrict_of_mem _ (idealKills_pushforward I G) W ha

name: KSpecialization.AR5R.isIso_adjUnit_of_killedOn
statement:
theorem isIso_adjUnit_of_killedOn (I : Y.IdealSheafData) (E : Y.Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent]
    {ι : Type*} (W : ι → Y.affineOpens) (hW : (⨆ c, (W c : Y.Opens)) = ⊤)
    (hE : ∀ c, KilledOn I (W c) E) :
    IsIso (ProjectionFormula.adjUnit I.subschemeι E)
proof:
:= by
  let i := I.subschemeι
  let U : ι → Y.Opens := fun c ↦ (W c : Y.Opens)
  have hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y).CoversTop U := (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := Y) U).2 hW
  refine moduleHom_isIso_of_over_cover _ U hU fun c ↦ ?_
  rw [over_isIso_iff_restrictFunctor_map_isIso, restrictFunctor_map_isIso_iff_pullback_map_isIso]
  haveI : IsAffine (W c : Y.Opens) := (W c).2
  obtain ⟨F, ⟨e⟩⟩ := affine_essImage_of_killed (i ∣_ (W c : Y.Opens))
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (W c : Y.Opens).ι).obj E) (fun s hs => by
      obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := exists_localGen_of_mem_ker I (W c) s hs
      exact hE c a ha)
  have hu : IsIso (ProjectionFormula.adjUnit (i ∣_ (W c : Y.Opens))
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (W c : Y.Opens).ι).obj E)) := by
    change IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (i ∣_ (W c : Y.Opens))).unit.app _)
    exact (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (i ∣_ (W c : Y.Opens))).isIso_unit_app_of_iso
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (W c : Y.Opens).ι).app E).symm ≪≫ e.symm)
  have hres := ProjectionFormula.adjUnit_restrict i (W c : Y.Opens) E
  have : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (W c : Y.Opens).ι).map (ProjectionFormula.adjUnit i E) ≫
      (pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso i (W c : Y.Opens)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj E)).hom) := by
    rw [hres]
    have h2 : IsIso ((pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict i (W c : Y.Opens)).hom.app E) :=
      ((pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict i (W c : Y.Opens)).app E).isIso_hom
    exact @IsIso.comp_isIso _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hu (@Functor.map_isIso _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ h2)
  exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right _ (pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso i (W c : Y.Opens)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj E)).hom

name: KSpecialization.AR5R.tMul_factors_through_unit
statement:
theorem tMul_factors_through_unit {X' Y' : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine Y'] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y']
    (f : X' ⟶ Y') [IsClosedImmersion f] (E : Y'.Modules) [E.IsFinitePresentation]
    (s : Γ(Y', ⊤)) (hs : ∀ t ∈ RingHom.ker f.appTop.hom, tMul s E ≫ tMul t E = 0) :
    ∃ h : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E) ⟶ E,
      tMul s E = ProjectionFormula.adjUnit f E ≫ h
proof:
:= by
  haveI : (cokernel (tMul s E)).IsFinitePresentation := cokernel_isFinitePresentation _
  haveI : (Abelian.image (tMul s E)).IsFinitePresentation :=
    kernel_isFinitePresentation (cokernel.π (tMul s E))
  let G := Abelian.image (tMul s E)
  let e : E ⟶ G := Abelian.factorThruImage (tMul s E)
  let m : G ⟶ E := Abelian.image.ι (tMul s E)
  have hem : e ≫ m = tMul s E := Abelian.image.fac _
  have hG : ∀ t ∈ RingHom.ker f.appTop.hom, tMul t G = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    have h1 : e ≫ tMul t G ≫ m = 0 := by
      rw [← tMul_naturality t m, ← Category.assoc, hem]
      exact hs t ht
    exact (cancel_epi e).1 ((cancel_mono m).1 (by simpa using h1))
  obtain ⟨F, ⟨iso⟩⟩ := affine_essImage_of_killed f G hG
  haveI hu : IsIso (ProjectionFormula.adjUnit f G) := by
    change IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app _)
    exact (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).isIso_unit_app_of_iso iso.symm
  have hn := ProjectionFormula.adjUnit_naturality f e
  refine ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map e) ≫
    inv (ProjectionFormula.adjUnit f G) ≫ m, ?_⟩
  rw [← hem]
  have : e = ProjectionFormula.adjUnit f E ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map e) ≫
        inv (ProjectionFormula.adjUnit f G) := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← hn, Category.assoc, IsIso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
  conv_lhs => rw [this]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: KSpecialization.AR5R.killedOn_of_killedOnPow_one
statement:
theorem killedOn_of_killedOnPow_one {I : X.IdealSheafData} {W : X.affineOpens} {E : X.Modules}
    (h : KilledOnPow I 1 W E) : KilledOn I W E
proof:
:=
  fun r hr => h r (by rwa [pow_one])

name: KSpecialization.AR5R.killedOnPow_mono_of_le
statement:
theorem killedOnPow_mono_of_le {I : X.IdealSheafData} {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n)
    {W : X.affineOpens} {E : X.Modules} (h : KilledOnPow I m W E) : KilledOnPow I n W E
proof:
:=
  fun r hr => h r (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right hmn hr)

name: KSpecialization.AR5R.killedOnPow_kernel_unit
statement:
theorem killedOnPow_kernel_unit [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData) (m : ℕ)
    (E : X.Modules) [E.IsFinitePresentation] (W : X.affineOpens)
    (hE : KilledOnPow I (m + 1) W E) :
    KilledOnPow I m W (kernel (ProjectionFormula.adjUnit I.subschemeι E))
proof:
:= by
  intro r hr
  let i := I.subschemeι
  let η := ProjectionFormula.adjUnit i E
  let κ : kernel η ⟶ E := kernel.ι η
  let Wo : X.Opens := W
  haveI : IsAffine (Wo : Scheme.{u}) := W.2
  let s := localGen Wo r
  let R := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor Wo.ι
  let P := Scheme.Modules.pullback Wo.ι
  let c : R ≅ P := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback Wo.ι
  haveI : (P.obj E).IsFinitePresentation := pullback_isFinitePresentation_global Wo.ι E
  have hs : ∀ t ∈ RingHom.ker (i ∣_ Wo).appTop.hom, tMul s (P.obj E) ≫ tMul t (P.obj E) = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := exists_localGen_of_mem_ker I W t ht
    rw [← tMul_mul, ← localGen_mul]
    have hra : r * a ∈ (I.ideal W) ^ (m + 1) := by
      rw [pow_succ]; exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hr ha
    exact tMul_eq_zero_of_iso _ (c.app E).symm (hE (r * a) hra)
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := tMul_factors_through_unit (i ∣_ Wo) (P.obj E) s hs
  have hres := ProjectionFormula.adjUnit_restrict i Wo E
  have hiso : IsIso ((pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict i Wo).hom.app E) :=
    ((pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict i Wo).app E).isIso_hom
  haveI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (i ∣_ Wo)).map
      ((pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict i Wo).hom.app E)) := inferInstance
  have hκ0 : P.map κ ≫ P.map η = 0 := by
    rw [← P.map_comp, kernel.condition, Functor.map_zero]
  have h2 : P.map κ ≫ ProjectionFormula.adjUnit (i ∣_ Wo) (P.obj E) = 0 := by
    have h3 : (P.map κ ≫ ProjectionFormula.adjUnit (i ∣_ Wo) (P.obj E)) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (i ∣_ Wo)).map
          ((pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict i Wo).hom.app E) = 0 :=
      calc (P.map κ ≫ ProjectionFormula.adjUnit (i ∣_ Wo) (P.obj E)) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (i ∣_ Wo)).map
            ((pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict i Wo).hom.app E)
          = P.map κ ≫ (ProjectionFormula.adjUnit (i ∣_ Wo) (P.obj E) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (i ∣_ Wo)).map
            ((pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict i Wo).hom.app E)) := Category.assoc _ _ _
        _ = P.map κ ≫ (P.map η ≫
          (pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso i Wo ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj E)).hom) :=
            congrArg (fun z => P.map κ ≫ z) hres.symm
        _ = (P.map κ ≫ P.map η) ≫
          (pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso i Wo ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj E)).hom :=
            (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
        _ = 0 := by rw [hκ0, Limits.zero_comp]
    exact (cancel_mono ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (i ∣_ Wo)).map
      ((pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict i Wo).hom.app E))).1
        (h3.trans Limits.zero_comp.symm)
  haveI : Mono (R.map κ) := inferInstance
  haveI : Mono (P.map κ) := by
    have hnat : R.map κ ≫ (c.app E).hom = (c.app (kernel η)).hom ≫ P.map κ :=
      c.hom.naturality κ
    have hP : P.map κ = (c.app (kernel η)).inv ≫ R.map κ ≫ (c.app E).hom := by
      rw [hnat]; simp
    rw [hP]
    infer_instance
  have h4 : tMul s (P.obj (kernel η)) ≫ P.map κ = 0 := by
    rw [← tMul_naturality s (P.map κ), hh, ← Category.assoc, h2, Limits.zero_comp]
  have h5 : tMul s (P.obj (kernel η)) = 0 :=
    (cancel_mono (P.map κ)).1 (h4.trans Limits.zero_comp.symm)
  exact tMul_eq_zero_of_iso s (c.app (kernel η)) h5

name: KSpecialization.AR5R.killedOn_coimage_unit
statement:
theorem killedOn_coimage_unit (E : X.Modules) (W : X.affineOpens) :
    KilledOn I W (Abelian.coimage (ProjectionFormula.adjUnit I.subschemeι E))
proof:
:=
  killedOn_of_mono (Abelian.factorThruCoimage (ProjectionFormula.adjUnit I.subschemeι E))
    (killedOn_pushforward I _ W)

name: KSpecialization.AR5R.g0Class_mem_range_of_killedOn
statement:
theorem g0Class_mem_range_of_killedOn {ι : Type*} (W : ι → X.affineOpens)
    (hW : (⨆ c, (W c : X.Opens)) = ⊤) (E : X.Modules) [E.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hE : ∀ c, KilledOn I (W c) E) :
    g0Class X E ∈ (finitePushforward I.subschemeι).range
proof:
:= by
  haveI hu := isIso_adjUnit_of_killedOn I E W hW hE
  haveI hF : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback I.subschemeι).obj E).IsFinitePresentation :=
    pullback_isFinitePresentation_global I.subschemeι E
  refine ⟨g0Class I.subscheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback I.subschemeι).obj E), ?_⟩
  change finitePushforward I.subschemeι
    (g0ClassOf I.subscheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback I.subschemeι).obj E) hF) = _
  rw [finitePushforward_classOf]
  exact (ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso X.Modules (IsCoherentLike X)
    (show IsCoherentLike X E from inferInstanceAs E.IsFinitePresentation)
    (finitePushObject I.subschemeι ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pullback I.subschemeι).obj E, hF⟩).2
    (show IsCoherentLike X (0 : X.Modules) from inferInstanceAs (0 : X.Modules).IsFinitePresentation)
    (isZero_zero _) (@asIso _ _ _ _ (ProjectionFormula.adjUnit I.subschemeι E) hu)).symm

name: KSpecialization.AR5R.g0Class_mem_range_of_killedOnPow
statement:
theorem g0Class_mem_range_of_killedOnPow {ι : Type*} (W : ι → X.affineOpens)
    (hW : (⨆ c, (W c : X.Opens)) = ⊤) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : X.Modules) [E.IsFinitePresentation],
      (∀ c, KilledOnPow I (n + 1) (W c) E) →
        g0Class X E ∈ (finitePushforward I.subschemeι).range
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro E _ hE
    exact g0Class_mem_range_of_killedOn I W hW E (fun c => killedOn_of_killedOnPow_one (hE c))
  | succ n ih =>
    intro E _ hE
    let i := I.subschemeι
    let η := ProjectionFormula.adjUnit i E
    haveI hF : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj E).IsFinitePresentation :=
      pullback_isFinitePresentation_global i E
    haveI hT : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj E)).IsFinitePresentation :=
      (finitePushObject i ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj E, hF⟩).2
    haveI hK : (kernel η).IsFinitePresentation := kernel_isFinitePresentation η
    let κ : kernel η ⟶ E := kernel.ι η
    haveI hB : (cokernel κ).IsFinitePresentation := cokernel_isFinitePresentation κ
    have hS : (ShortComplex.mk κ (cokernel.π κ) (cokernel.condition κ)).ShortExact :=
      ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk' (ShortComplex.exact_cokernel κ) inferInstance inferInstance
    have hmid := g0Class_middle X (cokernel.condition κ) hS
    have hKc : g0Class X (kernel η) ∈ (finitePushforward i).range :=
      ih (kernel η) (fun c => killedOnPow_kernel_unit I (n + 1) E (W c) (hE c))
    have hBc : g0Class X (cokernel κ) ∈ (finitePushforward i).range := by
      have hcok : cokernel κ ≅ Abelian.coimage η := Iso.refl _
      haveI : (Abelian.coimage η).IsFinitePresentation := hB
      have hcoim := g0Class_mem_range_of_killedOn I W hW (Abelian.coimage η)
        (fun c => killedOn_coimage_unit I E (W c))
      exact hcoim
    rw [hmid]
    exact add_mem hKc hBc

name: SchemeKTheory.classOf_mul_rankOne
statement:
theorem classOf_mul_rankOne {L M : Y.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1)
    (hM : HasConstantRank Y M 1) :
    ∃ hLM : HasConstantRank Y (tensorSheaf Y L M) 1,
      k0ClassOf Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree * k0ClassOf Y M hM.isFiniteLocallyFree =
        k0ClassOf Y (tensorSheaf Y L M) hLM.isFiniteLocallyFree
proof:
:= by
  have h := hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hL hM
  rw [Nat.one_mul] at h
  exact ⟨h, k0ClassOf_mul Y ⟨L, hL.isFiniteLocallyFree⟩ ⟨M, hM.isFiniteLocallyFree⟩⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.one_eq_classOf_tensorUnitSheaf
statement:
theorem one_eq_classOf_tensorUnitSheaf :
    (1 : K0 Y) = k0ClassOf Y (tensorUnitSheaf Y) hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf.isFiniteLocallyFree
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.exists_rankOne_pow
statement:
theorem exists_rankOne_pow {L : Y.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ (N : Y.Modules) (hN : HasConstantRank Y N 1),
      k0ClassOf Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree ^ n = k0ClassOf Y N hN.isFiniteLocallyFree
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact ⟨_, hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf, by rw [pow_zero]; rfl⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨N, hN, hNe⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨hNL, hNLe⟩ := classOf_mul_rankOne hN hL
    exact ⟨_, hNL, by rw [pow_succ, hNe, hNLe]⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.lambdaClass_pullback_of
statement:
theorem lambdaClass_pullback_of (E : Z.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree Z E) (k : ℕ) :
    φ (lambdaClass Z E hE k) =
      lambdaClass W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E)
        (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global f E hE) k
proof:
:= by
  unfold lambdaClass
  rw [hφ]
  exact k0ClassOf_iso W _ _ (pullbackExteriorPowerIso f E hE k)

name: SchemeKTheory.logDeriv_eq_of_mul
statement:
theorem logDeriv_eq_of_mul {A : Type v} [CommRing A] (u : (PowerSeries A)ˣ) (S : PowerSeries A)
    (h : S * (u : PowerSeries A) = X * d⁄dX A (u : PowerSeries A)) : logDeriv u = S
proof:
:= by
  rw [logDeriv, ← h, mul_assoc, Units.mul_inv, mul_one]

name: SchemeKTheory.derivative_map
statement:
theorem derivative_map {A B : Type v} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (g : A →+* B) (p : PowerSeries A) :
    d⁄dX B (PowerSeries.map g p) = PowerSeries.map g (d⁄dX A p)
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simp [coeff_derivative, coeff_map, map_mul, map_add, map_natCast]

name: SchemeKTheory.logDeriv_map
statement:
theorem logDeriv_map {A B : Type v} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (g : A →+* B)
    (u : (PowerSeries A)ˣ) :
    logDeriv (Units.map (PowerSeries.map g).toMonoidHom u) = PowerSeries.map g (logDeriv u)
proof:
:= by
  apply logDeriv_eq_of_mul
  rw [Units.coe_map, RingHom.toMonoidHom_eq_coe, MonoidHom.coe_coe, ← map_mul, logDeriv_mul_self,
    map_mul, map_X, derivative_map]

name: SchemeKTheory.adams_pullback
statement: theorem adams_pullback (k : ℕ) (x : K0 Z) : φ (adams Z k x) = adams W k (φ x)
proof:
:= by
  let a : K0 Z →+ K0 W := φ.toAddMonoidHom.comp (adams Z k)
  let b : K0 Z →+ K0 W := (adams W k).comp φ.toAddMonoidHom
  have hab : a = b := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    intro E
    change φ (adams Z k (k0ClassOf Z E.1 E.2)) = adams W k (φ (k0ClassOf Z E.1 E.2))
    rw [hφ, adams_apply, adams_apply, map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, map_one]
    congr 1
    change φ (coeff k (logDeriv (Additive.toMul (lambdaT Z (k0ClassOf Z E.1 E.2))))) =
      coeff k (logDeriv (Additive.toMul (lambdaT W _)))
    rw [lambdaT_classOf, lambdaT_classOf, toMul_ofMul, toMul_ofMul]
    have hu : lambdaSeriesUnit W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E.1)
        (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global f E.1 E.2) =
        Units.map (PowerSeries.map φ).toMonoidHom (lambdaSeriesUnit Z E.1 E.2) := by
      apply Units.ext
      rw [Units.coe_map, coe_lambdaSeriesUnit, coe_lambdaSeriesUnit]
      ext n
      change coeff n (lambdaSeries W _ _) = coeff n (PowerSeries.map φ (lambdaSeries Z E.1 E.2))
      rw [coeff_map, coeff_lambdaSeries, coeff_lambdaSeries,
        lambdaClass_pullback_of f φ hφ E.1 E.2 n]
    rw [hu, logDeriv_map, coeff_map]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hab x

name: SchemeKTheory.flatPullbackK0_adams
statement:
theorem flatPullbackK0_adams (q : W ⟶ Z) [Flat q] (k : ℕ) (x : K0 Z) :
    flatPullbackK0 q (adams Z k x) = adams W k (flatPullbackK0 q x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply, ← flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply]
  exact adams_pullback q (flatPullbackK0RingHom q) (fun E hE ↦ by
    rw [flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply, flatPullbackK0_classOf]) k x

name: SchemeKTheory.newton_of_mul
statement:
theorem newton_of_mul {A : Type v} [CommRing A] (S Λ : PowerSeries A)
    (hΛ : constantCoeff Λ = 1) (hS : coeff 0 S = 0) (h : S * Λ = X * d⁄dX A Λ)
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    (-1 : A) ^ (m + 1) * coeff m S =
      ∑ l ∈ Finset.Ico 1 m, (-1 : A) ^ (l + 1) * coeff l Λ *
          ((-1 : A) ^ (m - l + 1) * coeff (m - l) S) +
        (-1 : A) ^ (m + 1) * (m : A) * coeff m Λ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, m = n + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
  have hk := congrArg (coeff (n + 1)) h
  rw [mul_comm, coeff_mul, Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ
    (fun i j ↦ coeff i Λ * coeff j S), coeff_succ_X_mul, coeff_derivative,
    Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.range_eq_Ico,
    Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot (Nat.succ_pos n)] at hk
  simp only [Nat.sub_zero, Nat.sub_self, hS, mul_zero, add_zero] at hk
  rw [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply] at hΛ
  rw [hΛ, one_mul] at hk
  have hsum : ∑ l ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (n + 1), (-1 : A) ^ (l + 1) * coeff l Λ *
        ((-1 : A) ^ (n + 1 - l + 1) * coeff (n + 1 - l) S) =
      (-1 : A) ^ (n + 1 + 2) * ∑ l ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (n + 1), coeff l Λ * coeff (n + 1 - l) S := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l hl ↦ ?_
    rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hl
    rw [show n + 1 + 2 = (l + 1) + (n + 1 - l + 1) by omega, pow_add]
    ring
  rw [hsum]
  push_cast at hk ⊢
  linear_combination ((-1 : A) ^ (n + 1 + 1)) * hk

name: SchemeKTheory.coeff_adamsSeries
statement:
theorem coeff_adamsSeries (k : ℕ) (x : K0 Y) :
    coeff k (adamsSeries Y x) = (-1 : K0 Y) ^ (k + 1) * adams Y k x
proof:
:= by
  rw [adams_apply, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_add, show k + 1 + (k + 1) = 2 * (k + 1) by ring, pow_mul]
  norm_num

name: SchemeKTheory.adams_newton
statement:
theorem adams_newton (E : Y.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y E) (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    adams Y m (k0ClassOf Y E hE) =
      ∑ l ∈ Finset.Ico 1 m, (-1 : K0 Y) ^ (l + 1) * lambdaClass Y E hE l *
          adams Y (m - l) (k0ClassOf Y E hE) +
        (-1 : K0 Y) ^ (m + 1) * (m : K0 Y) * lambdaClass Y E hE m
proof:
:= by
  have key := newton_of_mul (adamsSeries Y (k0ClassOf Y E hE)) (lambdaSeries Y E hE)
    (constantCoeff_lambdaSeries Y E hE)
    (by
      change coeff 0 (logDeriv _) = 0
      simp only [logDeriv, mul_assoc, coeff_zero_X_mul])
    (by
      have h := adamsSeries_mul_lambda Y (k0ClassOf Y E hE)
      rwa [lambdaT_classOf, toMul_ofMul, coe_lambdaSeriesUnit] at h) m hm
  simp only [coeff_lambdaSeries] at key
  simp only [← adams_apply] at key
  rw [key]

name: SchemeKTheory.adams_sum_rankOne
statement:
theorem adams_sum_rankOne {Y : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (L : ι → Y.Modules)
    (hL : ∀ i, HasConstantRank Y (L i) 1) (k : ℕ) :
    adams Y (k + 1) (∑ i ∈ s, k0ClassOf Y (L i) (hL i).isFiniteLocallyFree) =
      ∑ i ∈ s, k0ClassOf Y (L i) (hL i).isFiniteLocallyFree ^ (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ adams_classOf_rankOne Y (L i) (hL i) k

name: SchemeKTheory.adams_pow_rankOne
statement:
theorem adams_pow_rankOne {Y : Scheme.{u}} {L : Y.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1)
    (n k : ℕ) :
    adams Y (k + 1) (k0ClassOf Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree ^ n) =
      k0ClassOf Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree ^ (n * (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hNe⟩ := exists_rankOne_pow hL n
  rw [hNe, adams_classOf_rankOne Y N hN, ← hNe, ← pow_mul]

name: SchemeKTheory.pullback_classOf_eq_sum_of_lambda
statement:
theorem pullback_classOf_eq_sum_of_lambda {Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [Flat q] {r : ℕ}
    (E : X.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) (L : Fin r → Y.Modules)
    (hL : ∀ i, HasConstantRank Y (L i) 1)
    (hlam : ∀ n, flatPullbackK0 q (lambdaClass X E hE n) =
      (Finset.univ.val.map fun i ↦ k0ClassOf Y (L i) (hL i).isFiniteLocallyFree).esymm n) :
    flatPullbackK0 q (k0ClassOf X E hE) = ∑ i, k0ClassOf Y (L i) (hL i).isFiniteLocallyFree
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lambdaClass_one X E hE, hlam 1, esymm_one']
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.adams_mul_classOf
statement:
theorem adams_mul_classOf {E F : X.Modules} {r s : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r)
    (hF : HasConstantRank X F s) (k : ℕ) :
    adams X (k + 1) (k0ClassOf X E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree * k0ClassOf X F hF.isFiniteLocallyFree) =
      adams X (k + 1) (k0ClassOf X E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree) *
        adams X (k + 1) (k0ClassOf X F hF.isFiniteLocallyFree)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Y, q, _, _, L, hL, M, hM, hinj, hlamE, hlamF⟩ :=
    splitting_principle_two pbInjectiveHyp hE hF
  apply hinj
  have hqE := pullback_classOf_eq_sum_of_lambda q E _ L hL hlamE
  have hqF := pullback_classOf_eq_sum_of_lambda q F _ M hM hlamF
  rw [flatPullbackK0_adams, flatPullbackK0_mul, flatPullbackK0_mul, flatPullbackK0_adams,
    flatPullbackK0_adams, hqE, hqF, adams_sum_rankOne _ L hL k, adams_sum_rankOne _ M hM k, Finset.sum_mul_sum,
    Finset.sum_mul_sum, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
  rw [map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨hLM, hLMe⟩ := classOf_mul_rankOne (hL i) (hM j)
  rw [hLMe, adams_classOf_rankOne Y _ hLM, ← hLMe, mul_pow]

name: SchemeKTheory.adams_adams_classOf
statement:
theorem adams_adams_classOf {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) (k l : ℕ) :
    adams X (k + 1) (adams X (l + 1) (k0ClassOf X E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree)) =
      adams X ((k + 1) * (l + 1)) (k0ClassOf X E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Y, q, _, _, L, hL, hinj, hqE, -⟩ := splitting_principle' hE
  apply hinj
  rw [flatPullbackK0_adams, flatPullbackK0_adams, flatPullbackK0_adams, hqE,
    adams_sum_rankOne _ L hL l, map_sum, show (k + 1) * (l + 1) = k * (l + 1) + l + 1 by ring,
    adams_sum_rankOne _ L hL (k * (l + 1) + l)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
  rw [adams_pow_rankOne (hL i)]
  congr 1
  ring

name: SchemeKTheory.adams_mul
statement:
theorem adams_mul (hrank : ConstantRankGenerators X) (k : ℕ) (x y : K0 X) :
    adams X (k + 1) (x * y) = adams X (k + 1) x * adams X (k + 1) y
proof:
:= by
  have hgen : ∀ E : {M : X.Modules // IsFiniteLocallyFree X M}, ∀ y : K0 X,
      adams X (k + 1) (k0ClassOf X E.1 E.2 * y) =
        adams X (k + 1) (k0ClassOf X E.1 E.2) * adams X (k + 1) y := by
    intro E
    obtain ⟨r, hE⟩ := hrank E.1 E.2
    let a : K0 X →+ K0 X :=
      (adams X (k + 1)).comp (AddMonoidHom.mulLeft (k0ClassOf X E.1 E.2))
    let b : K0 X →+ K0 X :=
      (AddMonoidHom.mulLeft (adams X (k + 1) (k0ClassOf X E.1 E.2))).comp (adams X (k + 1))
    have hab : a = b := by
      apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
      intro F
      obtain ⟨s, hF⟩ := hrank F.1 F.2
      exact adams_mul_classOf (E := E.1) (F := F.1) hE hF k
    exact fun y ↦ DFunLike.congr_fun hab y
  let a : K0 X →+ K0 X := (adams X (k + 1)).comp (AddMonoidHom.mulRight y)
  let b : K0 X →+ K0 X :=
    (AddMonoidHom.mulRight (adams X (k + 1) y)).comp (adams X (k + 1))
  have hab : a = b := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    intro E
    exact hgen E y
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hab x

name: SchemeKTheory.adams_adams
statement:
theorem adams_adams (hrank : ConstantRankGenerators X) (k l : ℕ) (x : K0 X) :
    adams X (k + 1) (adams X (l + 1) x) = adams X ((k + 1) * (l + 1)) x
proof:
:= by
  let a : K0 X →+ K0 X := (adams X (k + 1)).comp (adams X (l + 1))
  have hab : a = adams X ((k + 1) * (l + 1)) := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    intro E
    obtain ⟨r, hE⟩ := hrank E.1 E.2
    exact adams_adams_classOf (E := E.1) hE k l
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hab x

name: SchemeKTheory.adams_one_eq_one
statement: theorem adams_one_eq_one (k : ℕ) : adams X (k + 1) (1 : K0 X) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [one_eq_classOf_tensorUnitSheaf, adams_classOf_rankOne X _ hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf,
    ← one_eq_classOf_tensorUnitSheaf,
    one_pow]

name: SchemeKTheory.adamsRingHom_apply
statement:
theorem adamsRingHom_apply (hrank : ConstantRankGenerators X) {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (x : K0 X) :
    adamsRingHom hrank m x = adams X m x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, m = k + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.adamsRingHom_newton
statement:
theorem adamsRingHom_newton (hrank : ConstantRankGenerators X) (E : X.Modules)
    (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    adamsRingHom hrank m (k0ClassOf X E hE) =
      ∑ l ∈ Finset.Ico 1 m, (-1 : K0 X) ^ (l + 1) * lambdaClass X E hE l *
          adamsRingHom hrank (m - l) (k0ClassOf X E hE) +
        (-1 : K0 X) ^ (m + 1) * (m : K0 X) * lambdaClass X E hE m
proof:
:= by
  rw [adamsRingHom_apply hrank hm, adams_newton X E hE m hm]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l hl ↦ ?_
  rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hl
  rw [adamsRingHom_apply hrank (by omega)]

name: SchemeKTheory.adamsRingHom_comp
statement:
theorem adamsRingHom_comp (hrank : ConstantRankGenerators X) {m n : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hn : 1 ≤ n) : (adamsRingHom hrank m).comp (adamsRingHom hrank n) = adamsRingHom hrank (m * n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, m = k + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ : ∃ l, n = l + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  ext x
  rw [RingHom.comp_apply, adamsRingHom_apply hrank hm, adamsRingHom_apply hrank hn,
    adamsRingHom_apply hrank (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 (by positivity)), adams_adams hrank]

name: SchemeKTheory.adamsRingHom_classOf_rankOne
statement:
theorem adamsRingHom_classOf_rankOne (hrank : ConstantRankGenerators X) (L : X.Modules)
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    adamsRingHom hrank m (k0ClassOf X L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree) =
      k0ClassOf X L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree ^ m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, m = k + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
  rw [adamsRingHom_apply hrank hm, adams_classOf_rankOne X L hL]

name: KSpecialization.ARRHBCP.componentToTotal_totalToIntegerP1
statement:
theorem componentToTotal_totalToIntegerP1 :
    InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToTotal Y J ≫ InfinityGlobal.totalToIntegerP1 Y J =
      InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentι Y J ≫ infinityToInteger Y J ≫ infinityPoint
proof:
:= by
  unfold InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToTotal
  rw [Category.assoc, (infinity_isPullback Y J).w]

name: KSpecialization.ARRHBCP.inv_comp_fst_eq_secInf
statement:
theorem inv_comp_fst_eq_secInf {A : Scheme.{u}} (ι : A ⟶ totalGlobal Y J) [IsClosedImmersion ι]
    (hker : ι.ker = (InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToTotal Y J).ker)
    [IsIso (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) ι ≫ totalToClosedBase Y J)] :
    inv (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) ι ≫ totalToClosedBase Y J) ≫
        pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) ι =
      CategoryTheory.Limits.prod.lift (𝟙 J.subscheme)
          (closedBaseToInteger Y J ≫ infinityPoint) ≫ (totalIsoIntegerP1Product Y J).inv
proof:
:= by
  let lam : A ⟶ InfinityExceptionalGlobal.component Y J :=
    IsClosedImmersion.lift (InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToTotal Y J) ι hker.symm.le
  have hlam : lam ≫ InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToTotal Y J = ι :=
    IsClosedImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _
  have hterm : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (a b : T ⟶ Spec (.of integerRing)), a = b :=
    fun a b => specULiftZIsTerminal.hom_ext _ _
  set ρ := pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) ι ≫ totalToClosedBase Y J with hρ
  rw [← cancel_mono (totalIsoIntegerP1Product Y J).hom]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  apply CategoryTheory.Limits.prod.hom_ext
  · simp only [Category.assoc, totalIsoIntegerP1Product_fst, CategoryTheory.Limits.prod.lift_fst]
    exact IsIso.inv_hom_id ρ
  · simp only [Category.assoc, totalIsoIntegerP1Product_snd, CategoryTheory.Limits.prod.lift_snd]
    have h1 : ι ≫ InfinityGlobal.totalToIntegerP1 Y J =
        lam ≫ InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentι Y J ≫ infinityToInteger Y J ≫ infinityPoint := by
      rw [← componentToTotal_totalToIntegerP1, ← Category.assoc, hlam]
    have hc : pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) ι ≫ subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J =
        pullback.snd (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) ι ≫ ι := pullback.condition
    rw [← KSpecialization.CIIL3B.subschemeTotalGlobalι_totalToIntegerP1 Y J,
      ← Category.assoc (pullback.fst _ _), hc, Category.assoc, h1]
    have key : inv ρ ≫ pullback.snd (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) ι ≫ lam ≫
        InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentι Y J ≫ infinityToInteger Y J =
        closedBaseToInteger Y J := hterm _ _
    have := congrArg (fun f => f ≫ infinityPoint) key
    simpa only [Category.assoc] using this

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.isPullback_basicOpenOverlapCover_toChart
statement:

    (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    IsPullback
      ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c ≫ C.overlapToChart i j)
      ((CommonBasicOpen.baseCover C i j).pullbackHom
        (C.overlapToIntersection i j) c)
      (C.chartToBase i)
      ((CommonBasicOpen.baseCover C i j).f c ≫
        X.homOfLE (inf_le_left : C.U i ⊓ C.U j ≤ C.U i))
proof:
:= by
  change IsPullback
    (pullback.fst (C.overlapToIntersection i j)
        ((CommonBasicOpen.baseCover C i j).f c) ≫
      pullback.fst (C.chartToBase i)
        (X.homOfLE (inf_le_left : C.U i ⊓ C.U j ≤ C.U i)))
    (pullback.snd (C.overlapToIntersection i j)
      ((CommonBasicOpen.baseCover C i j).f c))
    (C.chartToBase i)
    ((CommonBasicOpen.baseCover C i j).f c ≫
      X.homOfLE (inf_le_left : C.U i ⊓ C.U j ≤ C.U i))
  exact (IsPullback.of_hasPullback _ _).paste_horiz
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback _ _)

statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem commonBasicOpenChartIso_hom_chartToLeft
    (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (C.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j c).hom ≫ c.chartToLeft =
      (C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c ≫ C.overlapToChart i j
proof:
:=
  (C.isPullback_basicOpenOverlapCover_toChart i j c).isoIsPullback_hom_fst
    _ _ (C.isPullback_commonBasicOpenChart i j c)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.commonBasicOpenChartIso_hom_toCommonBase
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem commonBasicOpenChartIso_hom_toCommonBase
    (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (C.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j c).hom ≫ c.chartToBase ≫
        c.affineOpenIsoInIntersection.hom =
      (CommonBasicOpen.baseCover C i j).pullbackHom
        (C.overlapToIntersection i j) c
proof:
:= by
  show
    ((C.isPullback_basicOpenOverlapCover_toChart i j c).isoIsPullback _ _
      (C.isPullback_commonBasicOpenChart i j c)).hom ≫
        c.chartToBase ≫ c.affineOpenIsoInIntersection.hom =
      (CommonBasicOpen.baseCover C i j).pullbackHom
        (C.overlapToIntersection i j) c
  exact
    (C.isPullback_basicOpenOverlapCover_toChart i j c).isoIsPullback_hom_snd
      _ _ (C.isPullback_commonBasicOpenChart i j c)

name: SchemeKTheory.exists_epi_exteriorPowerSheaf_succ_tensor
statement:
theorem exists_epi_exteriorPowerSheaf_succ_tensor {K F L : Y.Modules}
    (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1)
    (f : K ⟶ F) (g : F ⟶ L) (zero : f ≫ g = 0) (hS : (ShortComplex.mk f g zero).ShortExact)
    (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ φ : exteriorPowerSheaf Y F (n + 1) ⟶ tensorSheaf Y (exteriorPowerSheaf Y K n) L, Epi φ
proof:
:= by
  let Fu := underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y
  let sh := moduleSheafification Y
  let Kp : ModulePresheaf Y := Fu.obj K
  let Fp : ModulePresheaf Y := Fu.obj F
  let Lp : ModulePresheaf Y := Fu.obj L
  let fp : Kp ⟶ Fp := Fu.map f
  let gp : Fp ⟶ Lp := Fu.map g
  let A := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower Kp (n + 1)
  let B := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower Fp (n + 1)
  let αp : A ⟶ B := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPowerMap fp (n + 1)
  let Λ := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower Kp n
  let kk : Λ ⊗ Kp ⟶ Λ ⊗ Fp := Λ ◁ fp
  let vD : Λ ⊗ Fp ⟶ Λ ⊗ Lp := Λ ◁ gp
  let φp : Λ ⊗ Fp ⟶ B := wedgeTensorMap fp n
  let ψK : Λ ⊗ Kp ⟶ A := wedgeTensorMap (𝟙 Kp) n
  let vC : Λ ⊗ Fp ⟶ cokernel αp := φp ≫ cokernel.π αp
  have hfg : fp ≫ gp = 0 := by
    simp only [fp, gp, ← Functor.map_comp, zero, Functor.map_zero]
  have hkD : kk ≫ vD = 0 := by
    apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
    intro W
    rw [PresheafOfModules.comp_app]
    apply exteriorPower_tensor_hom_ext
    intro κ z
    have h0 : gp.app W (fp.app W z) = 0 := (sections_leftExact Y f g zero hS W).2.2 z
    change ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk κ ⊗ₜ gp.app W (fp.app W z) =
      (0 : Λ ⊗ Kp ⟶ Λ ⊗ Lp).app W (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk κ ⊗ₜ z)
    rw [h0, TensorProduct.tmul_zero]
    rfl
  have hfac : kk ≫ φp = ψK ≫ αp := by
    apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
    intro W
    rw [PresheafOfModules.comp_app, PresheafOfModules.comp_app]
    apply exteriorPower_tensor_hom_ext
    intro κ z
    change φp.app W (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk κ ⊗ₜ fp.app W z) =
      αp.app W (ψK.app W (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk κ ⊗ₜ z))
    rw [wedgeTensorMap_app, wedgeTensorMap_app]
    change _ = ModuleCat.exteriorPower.map (fp.app W) (n + 1) _
    rw [ModuleCat.exteriorPower.map_mk, Fin.comp_snoc]
    rfl
  have hkC : kk ≫ vC = 0 := by
    simp only [vC, ← Category.assoc, hfac]
    simp only [Category.assoc, cokernel.condition, comp_zero]
  let T := cokernel kk
  let uD : T ⟶ Λ ⊗ Lp := cokernel.desc kk vD hkD
  let uC : T ⟶ cokernel αp := cokernel.desc kk vC hkC
  
  have hloc := fun x : Y ↦ exists_local_splitting_rankOne Y f g zero hS hL x
  choose U hU hdata using hloc
  have hglob := sections_leftExact Y f g zero hS
  have key : ∀ (x : Y) (W : Y.Opens), W ≤ U x →
      Function.Injective (αp.app (op W)) ∧ Function.Bijective (uD.app (op W)) ∧
        Function.Bijective (uC.app (op W)) := by
    intro x W hW
    obtain ⟨⟨s, hs⟩, e, he⟩ := hdata x W hW
    obtain ⟨hinj, hex, hgf⟩ := hglob (op W)
    obtain ⟨r, hrf, hdec⟩ := exists_retraction (fp.app (op W)).hom (gp.app (op W)).hom
      s.hom hinj hgf hex hs
    have hsurj : Function.Surjective (gp.app (op W)).hom := fun l ↦ ⟨s l, hs l⟩
    have hexact : Function.Exact (fp.app (op W)).hom (gp.app (op W)).hom := fun y ↦
      ⟨fun h ↦ hex y h, by rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩; exact hgf k⟩
    have hφ : ∀ (κ : Fin n → Kp.obj (op W)) (y : Fp.obj (op W)),
        (φp.app (op W)).hom (exteriorPower.ιMulti _ n κ ⊗ₜ y) =
          exteriorPower.ιMulti _ (n + 1) (Fin.snoc ((fp.app (op W)).hom ∘ κ) y) :=
      fun κ y ↦ wedgeTensorMap_app fp n (op W) κ y
    have hgen : ∀ y : Fp.obj (op W), ∃ (k : Kp.obj (op W))
        (a : ((Y.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).obj (op W))),
        y = (fp.app (op W)).hom k + a • s e := by
      intro y
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := he ((gp.app (op W)).hom y)
      refine ⟨r y, a, ?_⟩
      have h1 := hdec y
      rw [ha, map_smul] at h1
      exact h1
    have hπ : Function.Surjective ((cokernel.π αp).app (op W)) := by
      have : Epi ((PresheafOfModules.evaluation _ (op W)).map (cokernel.π αp)) := inferInstance
      exact (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).1 this
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact exteriorPower.map_injective r (LinearMap.ext hrf)
    · apply cokernelDesc_app_bijective
      · exact LinearMap.lTensor_surjective _ hsurj
      · intro y hy
        exact (lTensor_exact _ hexact hsurj y).1 hy
    · apply cokernelDesc_app_bijective
      · intro c
        obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hπ c
        have hb := mem_range_map_sup_range_wedge (fp.app (op W)).hom n (φp.app (op W)).hom hφ
          (s e) hgen b
        obtain ⟨y1, ⟨z, rfl⟩, y2, ⟨x', rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hb
        refine ⟨x', ?_⟩
        have h0 : (cokernel.π αp).app (op W) (αp.app (op W) z) = 0 := by
          rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← PresheafOfModules.comp_app, cokernel.condition]
          rfl
        change (cokernel.π αp).app (op W) ((φp.app (op W)) x') =
          (cokernel.π αp).app (op W) ((αp.app (op W)) z + (φp.app (op W)) x')
        rw [map_add, h0, zero_add]
      · intro x' hx'
        obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_app_eq_of_cokernel_π_app_eq_zero αp (op W) _ hx'
        have h1 := lTensor_eq_zero_of_wedge_eq_map (fp.app (op W)).hom (gp.app (op W)).hom r n
          hgf hrf
          (φp.app (op W)).hom hφ x' z hz.symm
        exact (lTensor_exact _ hexact hsurj x').1 h1
  have hmono : Mono (sh.map αp) :=
    mono_moduleSheafification_map_of_injective_on_cover αp U hU (fun x W h ↦ (key x W h).1)
  have hWD : moduleLocalEquivalences Y uD :=
    moduleLocalEquivalences_of_bijective_on_cover uD U hU (fun x W h ↦ (key x W h).2.1)
  have hWC : moduleLocalEquivalences Y uC :=
    moduleLocalEquivalences_of_bijective_on_cover uC U hU (fun x W h ↦ (key x W h).2.2)
  haveI : IsIso (sh.map uD) := Localization.inverts sh (moduleLocalEquivalences Y) uD hWD
  haveI : IsIso (sh.map uC) := Localization.inverts sh (moduleLocalEquivalences Y) uC hWC
  let eD : tensorSheaf Y (exteriorPowerSheaf Y K n) L ≅ sh.obj (Λ ⊗ Lp) := by
    letI : MonoidalCategory Y.Modules := localizedMonoidalCategory Y
    exact tensorSheafIsoLocalizedTensor Y (sh.obj Λ) L ≪≫
      (Iso.refl (sh.obj Λ) ⊗ᵢ ((asIso (PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
        (structurePresheafId Y)).counit).app L).symm) ≪≫
      Localization.Monoidal.μ sh (moduleLocalEquivalences Y) (moduleTensorUnitIso Y) Λ Lp
  let eC : sh.obj (cokernel αp) ≅ tensorSheaf Y (exteriorPowerSheaf Y K n) L :=
    (asIso (sh.map uC)).symm ≪≫ asIso (sh.map uD) ≪≫ eD.symm
  refine ⟨sh.map (cokernel.π αp) ≫ eC.hom, ?_⟩
  haveI hP : sh.PreservesEpimorphisms :=
    Functor.preservesEpimorphisms_of_adjunction (moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y)
  have hE : Epi (sh.map (cokernel.π αp)) := Functor.map_epi sh (cokernel.π αp)
  exact epi_comp' hE (inferInstance : Epi eC.hom)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.RG7.iη_eq_genericA
statement:
theorem iη_eq_genericA (h0 : (coheight (i (genericPoint X))).toNat = 0) :
    i (genericPoint X) = genericPoint A
proof:
:= by
  let C := quasiregularCover_amb i hAreg hX
  have hco : coheight (i (genericPoint X)) = 0 := by
    have h := coheight_eq_of_quasiregularCover_amb k i C
    rw [h0] at h
    simpa using h
  have hmax : IsMax (i (genericPoint X)) := Order.coheight_eq_zero.mp hco
  have h1 : genericPoint A ⤳ i (genericPoint X) := genericPoint_specializes _
  have h2 : i (genericPoint X) ⤳ genericPoint A :=
    hmax (show i (genericPoint X) ≤ genericPoint A from h1)
  exact (h2.antisymm h1).eq

name: GRRBlueprintV4.RG7.isIso_of_rank_zeroA
statement: theorem isIso_of_rank_zeroA (h0 : (coheight (i (genericPoint X))).toNat = 0) : IsIso i
proof:
:= by
  have hη := iη_eq_genericA i hA hAreg hX h0
  haveI : Surjective i := by
    refine ⟨fun y ↦ ?_⟩
    have hcl : IsClosed (Set.range i) := i.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range
    have hmem : genericPoint A ∈ Set.range i := ⟨genericPoint X, hη⟩
    have : closure {genericPoint A} ⊆ Set.range i :=
      hcl.closure_subset_iff.mpr (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hmem)
    have hy : y ∈ closure {genericPoint A} := by
      rw [(genericPoint_spec A).def]; trivial
    exact this hy
  exact isIso_of_isClosedImmersion_of_surjective i

name: GRRBlueprintV4.RG7.caseII_ambient_zero
statement:
theorem caseII_ambient_zero (h : ChExact k (closedPosV4 k))
    (h0 : (coheight (i (genericPoint X))).toNat = 0) : CaseII k (closedPosV4 k) h i
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIso i := isIso_of_rank_zeroA i hA hAreg hX h0
  have hr : HasConstantRank X (conormalSheaf i) 0 := by
    have := libConormalAmb_hasConstantRank i (quasiregularCover_amb i hAreg hX)
    rw [h0] at this
    exact this
  exact CIIFZ.caseII_of_isIso k h i hr (injA_ambient hA hAreg)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.RG7.caseII_ambient_pos
statement:
theorem caseII_ambient_pos (h0 : (coheight (i (genericPoint X))).toNat ≠ 0) :
    CaseII k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) i
proof:
:= by
  have hZ := regularZA i hX
  haveI : IsIntegral i.ker.subscheme := integralZA i
  haveI : IsNoetherian (totalGlobal A i.ker) := total_isNoetherian (k := k) i.ker hA
  haveI : IsNoetherian (subschemeTotalGlobal A i.ker) := KG2B.isNoetherian_W i.ker hA
  let D := ARRKG2A.inputsOfKG2B i.ker hA hAreg hZ
  have hcodim := codim_eq_coheightA i
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e, ARRKG2A.codim i.ker = e + 1 :=
    ⟨ARRKG2A.codim i.ker - 1, by omega⟩
  have hNr : HasConstantRank (ARRKG2A.Zs A i.ker) (ARRKG2A.Nsh i.ker) (e + 1) := by
    have := ARRKG2A.hNrank D
    rw [he] at this
    exact this
  obtain ⟨CNZ, hCNZ⟩ := exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hNr
  let φk : k →+* Γ(A, ⊤) := canonφA
  let M := zsModelXA i hA hAreg hX φk D e he CNZ hCNZ
  have hfact : ProjectiveIntegral k M.CX.scheme := by
    obtain ⟨hI, N, j, hj⟩ := (inferInstance : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k
      (concreteGeomXA i hA hAreg hX φk).E)).out
    haveI := hI
    haveI := hj
    exact ⟨CIICLASS.isIntegral_of_iso M.φ.symm, N, M.φ.inv ≫ j, inferInstance⟩
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k M.CX.scheme) := ⟨hfact⟩
  have hbridge := CIIMB.lambdaMinusOne_taut_eq_kosClassX M.CX
    (M.CX.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card M.hC (Nat.succ_pos _)) M.CX M.hN M.hE
    (M.CX.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card M.hC (Nat.succ_pos _))
  have hchow : ZSChowGates M (chEx k) :=
    CIIFZ.zsChowGates_of_chMul M (chEx k) (fun a b => CIIMB.chK_mul' (chEx k) a b)
  exact caseII_ambient_of_open i hA hAreg hX φk (chEx k)
    ⟨kdisj_proved_A i hA hAreg hX φk, fun x ε hε =>
      zeroSection_of_gates M (chEx k) hchow hbridge (injE_componentA i hA hAreg hX) x ε hε⟩

name: GRRBlueprintV4.RG7.caseII_ambient
statement: theorem caseII_ambient : CaseII k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) i
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIntegral X := (Fact.out : D28.ProjectiveIntegral k X).1
  by_cases h0 : (coheight (i (genericPoint X))).toNat = 0
  · exact caseII_ambient_zero i hA hAreg hX _ h0
  · exact caseII_ambient_pos i hA hAreg hX h0

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F13.restrictCycle_apply
statement:
theorem restrictCycle_apply [CompactSpace X] (i : Z ⟶ X) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (E : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) (z : Z) : restrictCycle i hi E z = E (i z)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F13.properPushforward_restrictCycle
statement:
theorem properPushforward_restrictCycle [CompactSpace X]
    (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] (E : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ)
    (hE : ∀ x, x ∉ Set.range i → E x = 0) :
    properPushforward i (restrictCycle i i.isEmbedding.injective E) = E
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.range i
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [properPushforward_eq_pushforward_closedImmersion i _ (fun z : Z ↦ height z)
      (fun x : X ↦ height x)
      (fun z _ ↦ (height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion i z).symm)]
    exact pushforward_apply_closedImmersion i _ (fun z : Z ↦ height z) (fun x : X ↦ height x)
      (fun z _ ↦ (height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion i z).symm) z
  · rw [hE x hx]
    rw [properPushforward_eq_pushforward_closedImmersion i _ (fun z : Z ↦ height z)
      (fun x : X ↦ height x)
      (fun z _ ↦ (height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion i z).symm)]
    exact pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range i _ _ _ x hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F13.restrictCycle_mem_dimensionCycles
statement:
theorem restrictCycle_mem_dimensionCycles [CompactSpace X] (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    {n : ℕ} {E : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ} (hE : E ∈ dimensionCycles X n) :
    restrictCycle i i.isEmbedding.injective E ∈ dimensionCycles Z n
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  have := hE (show E (i z) ≠ 0 from hz)
  change height z = (n : ℕ∞)
  rw [← height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion i z]
  exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F13.exists_mem_of_open_closed
statement:
theorem exists_mem_of_open_closed (j : W ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (i : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (hrange : Set.range i = (Set.range j)ᶜ) (P : AddSubgroup (AlgebraicCycle X ℤ))
    {n : ℕ}
    (hW : ∀ D' ∈ dimensionCycles W n, ∃ N : ℕ, N ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ C ∈ P, C ∈ dimensionCycles X n ∧
      (N : ℤ) • D' - flatPullback j C ∈ relC W n)
    (hZ : ∀ B ∈ dimensionCycles Z n, ∃ N : ℕ, N ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ C ∈ P, C ∈ dimensionCycles X n ∧
      (N : ℤ) • properPushforward i B - C ∈ relC X n)
    (D : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) (hD : D ∈ dimensionCycles X n) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, N ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ C ∈ P, C ∈ dimensionCycles X n ∧ (N : ℤ) • D - C ∈ relC X n
proof:
:= by
  have hj0 : PureRelDim j 0 := pureRelDim_openImmersion K j
  have hDW : flatPullback j D ∈ dimensionCycles W n :=
    flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles j hj0 hD
  obtain ⟨N1, hN1, C, hCP, hCd, hr1⟩ := hW _ hDW
  have hCW : flatPullback j C ∈ dimensionCycles W n := flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles j hj0 hCd
  have hM : (N1 : ℤ) • D - C ∈ dimensionCycles X n := sub_mem (zsmul_mem hD _) hCd
  have hM' : (N1 : ℤ) • flatPullback j D - flatPullback j C ∈ dimensionCycles W n :=
    sub_mem (zsmul_mem hDW _) hCW
  obtain ⟨E, hEj, hrE⟩ := F6.exact_middle K j ⟨(N1 : ℤ) • D - C, hM⟩
    ⟨(N1 : ℤ) • flatPullback j D - flatPullback j C, hM'⟩ (mem_relC.mp hr1).2 (by
      intro u
      change ((N1 : ℤ) • D - C) (j u) = ((N1 : ℤ) • flatPullback j D - flatPullback j C) u
      have e1 := map_zsmul (flatPullbackHom j) (N1 : ℤ) D
      have e2 := map_sub (flatPullbackHom j) ((N1 : ℤ) • D) C
      simp only [Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_sub, Pi.sub_apply, Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_zsmul,
        Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, flatPullback_apply, flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion]
      simp)
  have hEsupp : ∀ x, x ∉ Set.range i → E.1 x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    have : x ∈ Set.range j := by
      by_contra h
      exact hx (by rw [hrange]; exact h)
    exact hEj x this
  have hEd : E.1 ∈ dimensionCycles X n := E.2
  have hBd := restrictCycle_mem_dimensionCycles i hEd
  obtain ⟨N2, hN2, C2, hC2P, hC2d, hr2⟩ := hZ _ hBd
  rw [properPushforward_restrictCycle i E.1 hEsupp] at hr2
  refine ⟨N2 * N1, mul_ne_zero hN2 hN1, (N2 : ℤ) • C + C2, add_mem (zsmul_mem hCP _) hC2P,
    add_mem (zsmul_mem hCd _) hC2d, ?_⟩
  have hrel1 : ((N1 : ℤ) • D - C) - E.1 ∈ relC X n :=
    mem_relC.mpr ⟨sub_mem hM hEd, hrE⟩
  have e : ((N2 * N1 : ℕ) : ℤ) • D - ((N2 : ℤ) • C + C2) =
      (N2 : ℤ) • (((N1 : ℤ) • D - C) - E.1) + ((N2 : ℤ) • E.1 - C2) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_mul, mul_smul]
    simp only [smul_sub]
    abel
  rw [e]
  exact add_mem (zsmul_mem hrel1 _) hr2

name: GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.powerSum_delta
statement:
theorem powerSum_delta {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℚ A] (c : ℕ → A)
    (h : ∀ i, c i = if i = 0 then 1 else 0) (m : ℕ) : powerSum c m = 0
proof:
:= by
  cases m with
  | zero => simp [powerSum]
  | succ m =>
    rw [powerSum]
    have : ∀ i : Fin m, c ((i : ℕ) + 1) = 0 := fun i ↦ by rw [h]; simp
    simp [this, h (m + 1)]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.gsum_zero
statement: theorem gsum_zero : gsum (fun _ : ℕ ↦ (0 : Op M)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  ext y
  simp [gsum]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.gexp_zero
statement: theorem gexp_zero : gexp (0 : Op M) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  have hs : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((j.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) • (0 : Op M) ^ j = 1 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
    simp [zero_pow]
  ext y
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, gexp_lof, hs]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.tdInvFromChern_delta
statement:
theorem tdInvFromChern_delta (c : ℕ → Op M) (h : ∀ i, c i = if i = 0 then 1 else 0) :
    tdInvFromChern c = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : logTd c = 0 := by
    unfold logTd
    have : (fun m : ℕ ↦ if m = 0 then (0 : Op M) else
        logCoeff (fun j ↦ PowerSeries.coeff j (CharacteristicClasses.toddLine ℚ)) m •
          powerSum c m) = fun _ ↦ 0 := by
      funext m
      by_cases hm : m = 0
      · simp [hm]
      · simp [hm, powerSum_delta c h m]
    rw [this, gsum_zero]
  unfold tdInvFromChern
  rw [h0, neg_zero, gexp_zero]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.dualChern_delta
statement:
theorem dualChern_delta (c : ℕ → Op M) (h : ∀ i, c i = if i = 0 then 1 else 0) :
    ∀ i, dualChern c i = if i = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= fun i ↦ by
  by_cases hi : i = 0 <;> simp [dualChern, h, hi]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.conormalSheaf_id_rank
statement:
theorem conormalSheaf_id_rank (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    HasConstantRank X (conormalSheaf (𝟙 X)) 0
proof:
:= by
  let gens : ∀ j : X.affineOpens,
      SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.AffineNormalCone.RegularGenerators
        Γ(X, j) ((Scheme.Hom.ker (𝟙 X : X ⟶ X)).ideal j) := fun j ↦
    { length := 0
      gen := Fin.elim0
      isWeaklyRegular := RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular.nil _ _
      span_eq := by simp }
  exact hasConstantRank_pullback (r := 0) (f := (𝟙 X : X ⟶ X).toImage) (h :=
    SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.conormal_hasConstantRank_of_regular
      (Scheme.Hom.ker (𝟙 X : X ⟶ X)) X.affineOpens (fun j ↦ j)
      (fun z ↦ by
        obtain ⟨j, hj, hz, -⟩ := (TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp
          (Scheme.isBasis_affineOpens X))
          (show (Scheme.Hom.ker (𝟙 X : X ⟶ X)).subschemeι z ∈ (⊤ : X.Opens) from trivial)
        exact ⟨⟨j, hj⟩, hz⟩)
      gens (fun j ↦ rfl))

name: GRRBlueprintV4.tdInvN_id
statement:
theorem tdInvN_id (hP : ProjBundleClosedPos (ProjectiveIntegral k))
    (hr : HasConstantRank X (conormalSheaf (𝟙 X)) 0) : tdInvN k hP (𝟙 X) = 1
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIntegral X := (Fact.out : ProjectiveIntegral k X).1
  have hc : ∀ j, chernSeq k hP (conormalSheaf (𝟙 X)) j = if j = 0 then 1 else 0 := fun j ↦ by
    unfold chernSeq
    rw [constRankChernAssignOn'_eq (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) hP _ 0 hr]
    rfl
  unfold tdInvN
  exact Alg.tdInvFromChern_delta _ (Alg.dualChern_delta _ hc)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.finitePushforward_id
statement: theorem finitePushforward_id : finitePushforward (𝟙 X) = AddMonoidHom.id (G0 X)
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _
  intro E
  have hE : ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ E = g0ClassOf _ E.1 E.2 := rfl
  rw [hE, AddMonoidHom.id_apply, finitePushforward_classOf]
  exact SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf_iso X _ _ ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardId X).app E.1)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.caseII_id
statement:
theorem caseII_id (hP : ProjBundleClosedPos (ProjectiveIntegral k)) (h : ChExact k hP)
    (hr : HasConstantRank X (conormalSheaf (𝟙 X)) 0)
    (hinj : Function.Injective (k0ToG0 X)) :
    CaseII k hP h (𝟙 X)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  rw [finitePushforward_id] at hxy
  have : y = x := hinj hxy
  subst this
  unfold tauX
  rw [tdInvN_id k hP hr, totalPushOn_id]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistOverlapSourceLocalSchemeIso_hom_eq_squareRoute

theorem twistOverlapSourceLocalSchemeIso_hom_eq_squareRoute
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)

    [IsOpenImmersion c.chartToLeft]
    [IsOpenImmersion (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom]
    [IsOpenImmersion ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ≫ c.chartToLeft)]
    [IsOpenImmersion ((C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι ≫ C.overlapToChart i j)] :

        (C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι).app

        (pullbackRestrictionCompIso

          (C.overlapToChart i j) (C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι
          (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver_hom_chartToLeft i j c).symm
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)).inv ≫
        (pullbackRestrictionCompIso
          ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ≫ c.chartToLeft)
          c.chartToLeft (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom rfl
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)).hom

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistTransition_pullback_commonChart_eq_route
statement:
theorem canonicalTwistTransition_pullback_commonChart_eq_route
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι).map
        ((C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d).iso i j).hom =
      C.canonicalTwistTransitionCommonChartRoute d i j c
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.transition i j) :=
    C.transition_isOpenImmersion' i j
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.overlapToChart i j) :=
    C.overlapToChart_isOpenImmersion i j
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i) :=
    @IsOpenImmersion.comp _ _ _ (C.transition i j) (C.overlapToChart j i)
      (C.transition_isOpenImmersion' i j)
      (C.overlapToChart_isOpenImmersion j i)
  letI : IsOpenImmersion c.chartToLeft :=
    CommonBasicOpen.chartToLeft_isOpenImmersion c
  letI : IsOpenImmersion c.chartToRight :=
    CommonBasicOpen.chartToRight_isOpenImmersion c
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom := by
    infer_instance
  letI : IsOpenImmersion
      ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ≫ c.chartToLeft) :=
    @IsOpenImmersion.comp _ _ _
      (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom c.chartToLeft
      (by infer_instance) (CommonBasicOpen.chartToLeft_isOpenImmersion c)
  letI : IsOpenImmersion
      ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ≫ c.chartToRight) :=
    @IsOpenImmersion.comp _ _ _
      (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom c.chartToRight
      (by infer_instance) (CommonBasicOpen.chartToRight_isOpenImmersion c)
  let U := C.twistComparisonOpen i j c
  let e := C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c
  let M := C.chartTwistingSheaf d i
  let N := C.chartTwistingSheaf d j
  let qL := C.overlapToChart i j
  let qR := C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i
  let AL := pullbackRestrictionCompIso (e.hom ≫ c.chartToLeft)
    qL U.ι (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver_hom_chartToLeft i j c).symm M
  let AR := pullbackRestrictionCompIso (e.hom ≫ c.chartToRight)
    qR U.ι (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver_hom_chartToRight i j c).symm N
  let BL := pullbackRestrictionCompIso (e.hom ≫ c.chartToLeft)
    c.chartToLeft e.hom rfl M
  let BR := pullbackRestrictionCompIso (e.hom ≫ c.chartToRight)
    c.chartToRight e.hom rfl N
  let f := ((C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d).iso i j).hom
  let φ := (C.transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso d i j c).hom
  have hPull := C.twistPullHomAux_canonicalTwistTransition_pullHom_commonChart d i j c
  rw [CommonBasicOpen.twistPullHomAux_pullHom_eq_pullbackRestrictionComp] at hPull
  rw [CommonBasicOpen.twistPullHomAux_pullHom_eq_pullbackRestrictionComp
    c.chartToLeft c.chartToRight φ e.hom
    (e.hom ≫ c.chartToLeft) (e.hom ≫ c.chartToRight) rfl rfl] at hPull
  change AL.hom ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).map f ≫ AR.inv =
    BL.hom ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback e.hom).map φ ≫ BR.inv at hPull
  have hRoute := iso_square_conj AL AR BL BR
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).map f)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback e.hom).map φ) hPull
  unfold canonicalTwistTransitionCommonChartRoute
  exact hRoute

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistOverlapLocalSchemeIso_hom_eq_squareRoute
statement:
theorem twistOverlapLocalSchemeIso_hom_eq_squareRoute
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (C.twistOverlapLocalSchemeIso d i j c).hom =
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback
        (C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι).app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (C.overlapToChart i j)).obj
            (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i))).hom ≫
      C.canonicalTwistTransitionCommonChartRoute d i j c ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback
        (C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι).app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
            (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i)).obj
              (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j))).inv
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.transition i j) :=
    C.transition_isOpenImmersion' i j
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.overlapToChart i j) :=
    C.overlapToChart_isOpenImmersion i j
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i) :=
    @IsOpenImmersion.comp _ _ _ (C.transition i j) (C.overlapToChart j i)
      (C.transition_isOpenImmersion' i j)
      (C.overlapToChart_isOpenImmersion j i)
  letI : IsOpenImmersion c.chartToLeft :=
    CommonBasicOpen.chartToLeft_isOpenImmersion c
  letI : IsOpenImmersion c.chartToRight :=
    CommonBasicOpen.chartToRight_isOpenImmersion c
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom := by
    infer_instance
  letI : IsOpenImmersion
      ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ≫ c.chartToLeft) :=
    @IsOpenImmersion.comp _ _ _
      (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom c.chartToLeft
      (by infer_instance) (CommonBasicOpen.chartToLeft_isOpenImmersion c)
  letI : IsOpenImmersion
      ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ≫ c.chartToRight) :=
    @IsOpenImmersion.comp _ _ _
      (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom c.chartToRight
      (by infer_instance) (CommonBasicOpen.chartToRight_isOpenImmersion c)
  letI : IsOpenImmersion
      ((C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι ≫ C.overlapToChart i j) := by
    infer_instance
  letI : IsOpenImmersion
      ((C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι ≫
        (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i)) := by
    infer_instance
  unfold twistOverlapLocalSchemeIso
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom]
  rw [C.twistOverlapSourceLocalSchemeIso_hom_eq_squareRoute d i j c,
    C.twistOverlapTargetLocalSchemeIso_inv_eq_squareRoute d i j c]
  unfold canonicalTwistTransitionCommonChartRoute
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.invOfUnit_line
statement:
theorem invOfUnit_line (x : Module.End ℚ M) :
    invOfUnit (mk (fun i ↦ if i = 0 then (1 : Module.End ℚ M) else if i = 1 then x else 0)) 1 =
      mk (fun n ↦ (-x) ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  set φ : PowerSeries (Module.End ℚ M) :=
    mk (fun i ↦ if i = 0 then (1 : Module.End ℚ M) else if i = 1 then x else 0)
  set ψ : PowerSeries (Module.End ℚ M) := mk (fun n ↦ (-x) ^ n)
  have hφ : φ = 1 + C x * PowerSeries.X := by
    ext n
    rcases n with _ | _ | n
    · simp [φ]
    · simp [φ, coeff_one]
    · simp [φ, coeff_one, coeff_succ_mul_X]
  have hψφ : ψ * φ = 1 := by
    rw [hφ, mul_add, mul_one]
    ext n
    rcases n with _ | n
    · simp [ψ]
    · rw [map_add, ← mul_assoc, coeff_succ_mul_X, coeff_mul_C]
      simp [ψ, coeff_one, pow_succ]
  have h1 : constantCoeff φ = ((1 : (Module.End ℚ M)ˣ) : Module.End ℚ M) := by
    simp [φ]
  have := mul_invOfUnit φ 1 h1
  calc invOfUnit φ 1 = (ψ * φ) * invOfUnit φ 1 := by rw [hψφ, one_mul]
    _ = ψ := by rw [mul_assoc, this, mul_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.psumOp_line
statement:
theorem psumOp_line (x : Module.End ℚ M) (m : ℕ) :
    psumOp (fun i ↦ if i = 0 then 1 else if i = 1 then x else 0) (m + 1) = x ^ (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [psumOp]
  rw [invOfUnit_line]
  have hC : (mk (fun n ↦ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) •
      (fun i ↦ if i = 0 then (1 : Module.End ℚ M) else if i = 1 then x else 0) (n + 1))) =
      C x := by
    ext n
    rcases n with _ | n
    · simp
    · simp
  rw [hC, coeff_C_mul, coeff_mk]
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd m with h | h
  · rw [Even.neg_pow h x, Even.neg_one_pow h, one_smul, pow_succ']
  · rw [Odd.neg_pow h x, Odd.neg_one_pow h, pow_succ', mul_neg, neg_smul, one_smul, neg_neg]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.coeff_exp_subst_toddLogSeries
