name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.X_mul_derivative_toddLogSeries
statement:
private theorem X_mul_derivative_toddLogSeries :
    PowerSeries.X * d⁄dX ℚ toddLogSeries = 1 - bernoulliPowerSeries ℚ
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rcases n with _ | n
  · simp [bernoulliPowerSeries]
  · rw [coeff_succ_X_mul, coeff_derivative, toddLogSeries, coeff_mk, map_sub, coeff_one,
      bernoulliPowerSeries, coeff_mk]
    simp only [toddLogCoeff, Nat.succ_ne_zero, if_false, Algebra.algebraMap_self,
      RingHom.id_apply, zero_sub, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul]
    push_cast
    field_simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.derivative_bernoulli'
proof:
:= by
  set T := bernoulli'PowerSeries ℚ
  set e := PowerSeries.exp ℚ
  set B := bernoulliPowerSeries ℚ
  set dL := d⁄dX ℚ toddLogSeries
  have h1 : T * (e - 1) = PowerSeries.X * e := bernoulli'PowerSeries_mul_exp_sub_one ℚ
  have h2 : d⁄dX ℚ T * (e - 1) + T * e = e + PowerSeries.X * e := by
    have := congrArg (d⁄dX ℚ) h1
    rw [Derivation.leibniz, Derivation.leibniz, map_sub, Derivation.map_one_eq_zero,
      derivative_exp, derivative_X, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul,
      smul_eq_mul] at this
    linear_combination this
  have h3 : PowerSeries.X * dL = 1 - B := X_mul_derivative_toddLogSeries
  have h4 : B * (e - 1) = PowerSeries.X := bernoulliPowerSeries_mul_exp_sub_one ℚ
  have hX : (PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries ℚ) ≠ 0 := X_ne_zero
  have he : e - 1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg (coeff 1) h
    simp [e, coeff_exp] at this
  have key : (PowerSeries.X * (e - 1)) * (d⁄dX ℚ T - dL * T) = 0 := by
    linear_combination
      PowerSeries.X * h2 - (e - 1) * T * h3 + T * h4 - (1 + PowerSeries.X) * h1
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp key with h | h
  · exact absurd h (mul_ne_zero hX he)
  · exact sub_eq_zero.mp h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.exp_subst_toddLogSeries
statement:
private theorem exp_subst_toddLogSeries :
    (PowerSeries.exp ℚ).subst toddLogSeries = bernoulli'PowerSeries ℚ
proof:
:= by
  set E := (PowerSeries.exp ℚ).subst toddLogSeries
  set T := bernoulli'PowerSeries ℚ
  set dL := d⁄dX ℚ toddLogSeries
  have hdE : d⁄dX ℚ E = E * dL := by
    rw [derivative_subst ℚ hasSubst_toddLogSeries, derivative_exp]
  have hT0 : constantCoeff T = 1 := by
    simp [T, bernoulli'PowerSeries, ← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply]
  have hE0 : constantCoeff E = 1 := by
    rw [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, coeff_exp_subst_toddLogSeries]
    simp
  have hTT : T * T⁻¹ = 1 := PowerSeries.mul_inv_cancel T (by rw [hT0]; exact one_ne_zero)
  have hF : E * T⁻¹ = 1 := by
    apply derivative.ext
    · rw [Derivation.leibniz, derivative_inv', derivative_bernoulli', hdE,
        Derivation.map_one_eq_zero, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
      linear_combination (-(E * dL * T⁻¹)) * hTT
    · rw [map_mul, hE0, constantCoeff_inv, hT0, map_one]; norm_num
  calc E = E * T⁻¹ * T := by rw [mul_assoc, mul_comm T⁻¹, hTT, mul_one]
    _ = T := by rw [hF, one_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.sum_coeff_toddLogSeries_pow
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeff_exp_subst_toddLogSeries, exp_subst_toddLogSeries]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.coeff_pow_mk_smul_pow
statement:
private theorem coeff_pow_mk_smul_pow (x : Module.End ℚ M) (a : ℕ → ℚ) (j m : ℕ) :
    coeff m ((mk fun n ↦ a n • x ^ n) ^ j) = coeff m ((mk a) ^ j) • x ^ m
proof:
:= by
  induction j generalizing m with
  | zero =>
    rw [pow_zero, pow_zero, coeff_one, coeff_one]
    split_ifs with h
    · subst h; simp
    · simp
  | succ j ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, coeff_mul, coeff_mul, Finset.sum_smul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp ↦ ?_
    rw [Finset.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
    rw [ih, coeff_mk, coeff_mk, smul_mul_smul, ← pow_add, hp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.chOfChern_line
statement:
theorem chOfChern_line (x : Module.End ℚ M) (m : ℕ) :
    chOfChern 1 (fun i ↦ if i = 0 then 1 else if i = 1 then x else 0) m =
      (1 / (m.factorial : ℚ)) • x ^ m
proof:
:= by
  rcases m with _ | m
  · simp [chOfChern]
  · simp only [chOfChern]
    rw [psumOp_line]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.tdOfChern_line
statement:
theorem tdOfChern_line (x : Module.End ℚ M) (m : ℕ) :
    tdOfChern (fun i ↦ if i = 0 then 1 else if i = 1 then x else 0) m =
      PowerSeries.coeff m (CharacteristicClasses.toddLine ℚ) • x ^ m
proof:
:= by
  have hP : (PowerSeries.mk fun n ↦ toddLogCoeff n •
      psumOp (fun i ↦ if i = 0 then (1 : Module.End ℚ M) else if i = 1 then x else 0) n) =
      PowerSeries.mk fun n ↦ toddLogCoeff n • x ^ n := by
    ext n
    rcases n with _ | n
    · simp [toddLogCoeff]
    · rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, psumOp_line]
  unfold tdOfChern
  rw [hP]
  simp_rw [coeff_pow_mk_smul_pow, smul_smul]
  rw [← Finset.sum_smul]
  congr 1
  exact sum_coeff_toddLogSeries_pow m

name: ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso_hom_mk_eq_det
proof:
:= by
  let f : M [⋀^Fin n]→ₗ[R] R :=
    (topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso b).hom.hom.compAlternatingMap mk
  have hf : f = b.det := by
    rw [AlternatingMap.eq_smul_basis_det b f]
    have hfb : f b = 1 := topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso_hom_mk b
    rw [hfb, one_smul]
  change f v = b.det v
  rw [hf]

name: ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso_hom_map_inv_one
statement:
theorem topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso_hom_map_inv_one {n : ℕ}
    (bM : Module.Basis (Fin n) R M) (bN : Module.Basis (Fin n) R N)
    (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso bN).hom
        (map f n ((topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso bM).inv 1)) =
      bN.det (f ∘ bM)
proof:
:= by
  rw [topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso_inv_one]
  rw [map_mk]
  exact topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso_hom_mk_eq_det bN (f ∘ bM)

name: LinearEquiv.frameTransition_eq_div
statement:
theorem frameTransition_eq_div
    (leftFrame : K ≃ₗ[K] L) (rightFrame : K ≃ₗ[K] N)
    (e : L ≃ₗ[K] N) (a b : K) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (h : e (leftFrame a) = rightFrame b) :
    rightFrame.symm (e (leftFrame 1)) = b / a
proof:
:= by
  have hleft (q : K) : leftFrame q = q • leftFrame 1 := by
    rw [← leftFrame.map_smul]
    simp
  have hcoord := congrArg rightFrame.symm h
  rw [hleft, e.map_smul, rightFrame.symm.map_smul,
    rightFrame.symm_apply_apply] at hcoord
  apply (eq_div_iff ha).2
  rw [mul_comm]
  exact hcoord

name: ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorFrame_common_coordinates
statement:
theorem topExteriorFrame_common_coordinates {n : ℕ}
    (leftIso : P ≅ M) (rightIso : P ≅ N)
    (bP : Module.Basis (Fin n) K P)
    (bM : Module.Basis (Fin n) K M)
    (bN : Module.Basis (Fin n) K N) :
    map (leftIso.inv ≫ rightIso.hom) n
        ((topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso bM).inv
          (bM.det (leftIso.hom ∘ bP))) =
      (topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso bN).inv
        (bN.det (rightIso.hom ∘ bP))
proof:
:= by
  have hleft :
      (topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso bM).inv
          (bM.det (leftIso.hom ∘ bP)) =
        map leftIso.hom n (mk bP) := by
    apply (topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso bM).toLinearEquiv.injective
    change (topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso bM).hom
        ((topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso bM).inv
          (bM.det (leftIso.hom ∘ bP))) =
      (topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso bM).hom
        (map leftIso.hom n (mk bP))
    rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_apply, map_mk]
    exact (topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso_hom_mk_eq_det
      bM (leftIso.hom ∘ bP)).symm
  have hright :
      (topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso bN).inv
          (bN.det (rightIso.hom ∘ bP)) =
        map rightIso.hom n (mk bP) := by
    apply (topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso bN).toLinearEquiv.injective
    change (topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso bN).hom
        ((topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso bN).inv
          (bN.det (rightIso.hom ∘ bP))) =
      (topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso bN).hom
        (map rightIso.hom n (mk bP))
    rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_apply, map_mk]
    exact (topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso_hom_mk_eq_det
      bN (rightIso.hom ∘ bP)).symm
  rw [hleft, hright]
  change
    ((functor K n).map leftIso.hom ≫
      (functor K n).map (leftIso.inv ≫ rightIso.hom)) (mk bP) =
      (functor K n).map rightIso.hom (mk bP)
  rw [← (functor K n).map_comp]
  simp

name: ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorFrameTransition_eq_det_div
statement:
theorem topExteriorFrameTransition_eq_det_div {n : ℕ}
    (leftIso : P ≅ M) (rightIso : P ≅ N)
    (bP : Module.Basis (Fin n) K P)
    (bM : Module.Basis (Fin n) K M)
    (bN : Module.Basis (Fin n) K N)
    (hdetLeft : bM.det (leftIso.hom ∘ bP) ≠ 0) :
    (topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso bN).hom
        (map (leftIso.inv ≫ rightIso.hom) n
          ((topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso bM).inv 1)) =
      bN.det (rightIso.hom ∘ bP) / bM.det (leftIso.hom ∘ bP)
proof:
:= by
  let frameM : K ≃ₗ[K] ↑(M.exteriorPower n) :=
    (topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso bM).toLinearEquiv.symm
  let frameN : K ≃ₗ[K] ↑(N.exteriorPower n) :=
    (topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso bN).toLinearEquiv.symm
  let e : ↑(M.exteriorPower n) ≃ₗ[K] ↑(N.exteriorPower n) :=
    ((functor K n).mapIso (leftIso.symm ≪≫ rightIso)).toLinearEquiv
  let a := bM.det (leftIso.hom ∘ bP)
  let b := bN.det (rightIso.hom ∘ bP)
  have hleft : frameM a = map leftIso.hom n (mk bP) := by
    apply (topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso bM).toLinearEquiv.injective
    change (topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso bM).hom (frameM a) = _
    rw [show frameM a = (topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso bM).inv a by rfl]
    rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_apply, map_mk]
    exact (topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso_hom_mk_eq_det
      bM (leftIso.hom ∘ bP)).symm
  have hright : frameN b = map rightIso.hom n (mk bP) := by
    apply (topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso bN).toLinearEquiv.injective
    change (topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso bN).hom (frameN b) = _
    rw [show frameN b = (topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso bN).inv b by rfl]
    rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_apply, map_mk]
    exact (topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso_hom_mk_eq_det
      bN (rightIso.hom ∘ bP)).symm
  have he :
      e (map leftIso.hom n (mk bP)) = map rightIso.hom n (mk bP) := by
    change
      ((functor K n).map leftIso.hom ≫
        (functor K n).map (leftIso.inv ≫ rightIso.hom)) (mk bP) =
        (functor K n).map rightIso.hom (mk bP)
    rw [← (functor K n).map_comp]
    simp
  have hcommon : e (frameM a) = frameN b := by
    rw [hleft, hright]
    exact he
  have hratio :=
    LinearEquiv.frameTransition_eq_div frameM frameN e a b hdetLeft hcommon
  change
    (topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso bN).hom
        (map (leftIso.inv ≫ rightIso.hom) n
          ((topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso bM).inv 1)) = b / a at hratio
  exact hratio

name: LinearMap.det_tensorProduct_map
statement:
theorem det_tensorProduct_map
    (bM : Module.Basis I R M) (bN : Module.Basis J R N)
    (f : M →ₗ[R] M) (g : N →ₗ[R] N) :
    LinearMap.det (TensorProduct.map f g) =
      LinearMap.det f ^ Fintype.card J * LinearMap.det g ^ Fintype.card I
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← det_toMatrix (bM.tensorProduct bN)]
  rw [TensorProduct.toMatrix_map]
  rw [Matrix.det_kronecker]
  rw [det_toMatrix, det_toMatrix]

name: PresheafOfModules.exteriorPowerStalkAddHom_germ
statement:
@[simp]
lemma exteriorPowerStalkAddHom_germ
    (M : PresheafOfModules.{u} (R ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))
    (n : ℕ) (x : X) (U : Opens X) (hx : x ∈ U)
    (z : (exteriorPower M n).obj (op U)) :
    exteriorPowerStalkAddHom M n x
        (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (exteriorPower M n).presheaf U x hx z) =
      ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mapSemilinear (germSemilinear M U x hx) n z
proof:
:= by
  change (ConcreteCategory.hom
      (colimit.ι ((OpenNhds.inclusion x).op ⋙ (exteriorPower M n).presheaf)
          (op ⟨U, hx⟩) ≫
        colimit.desc ((OpenNhds.inclusion x).op ⋙ (exteriorPower M n).presheaf)
          (exteriorPowerStalkCocone M n x))) z = _
  rw [colimit.ι_desc]
  rfl

name: PresheafOfModules.exteriorPowerStalkAddHom_germ_mk
statement:
@[simp]
lemma exteriorPowerStalkAddHom_germ_mk
    (M : PresheafOfModules.{u} (R ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))
    (n : ℕ) (x : X) (U : Opens X) (hx : x ∈ U)
    (a : Fin n → M.obj (op U)) :
    exteriorPowerStalkAddHom M n x
        (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (exteriorPower M n).presheaf U x hx
          (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk a)) =
      ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk
        (fun i ↦ TopCat.Presheaf.germ M.presheaf U x hx (a i))
proof:
:= by
  change (ConcreteCategory.hom
      (colimit.ι ((OpenNhds.inclusion x).op ⋙ (exteriorPower M n).presheaf)
          (op ⟨U, hx⟩) ≫
        colimit.desc ((OpenNhds.inclusion x).op ⋙ (exteriorPower M n).presheaf)
          (exteriorPowerStalkCocone M n x)))
      (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk a) = _
  rw [colimit.ι_desc]
  exact ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mapSemilinear_mk
    (germSemilinear M U x hx) n a

name: PresheafOfModules.exists_common_germ_rep
statement:
lemma exists_common_germ_rep
    (M : PresheafOfModules.{u} (R ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))
    (x : X) {n : ℕ}
    (a : Fin n → (stalkFunctorLinear (R := R) x).obj M) :
    ∃ (U : Opens X) (hx : x ∈ U) (b : Fin n → M.obj (op U)),
      ∀ i, TopCat.Presheaf.germ M.presheaf U x hx (b i) = a i
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      exact ⟨⊤, trivial, fun i ↦ Fin.elim0 i, fun i ↦ Fin.elim0 i⟩
  | succ n ih =>
      obtain ⟨U₀, b₀, hb₀⟩ := Concrete.colimit_exists_rep
        ((OpenNhds.inclusion x).op ⋙ M.presheaf) (a 0)
      rcases U₀ with ⟨⟨U, hxU⟩⟩
      obtain ⟨V, hxV, b, hb⟩ := ih (fun i ↦ a i.succ)
      let W : Opens X := U ⊓ V
      have hxW : x ∈ W := ⟨hxU, hxV⟩
      let iU : W ⟶ U := homOfLE inf_le_left
      let iV : W ⟶ V := homOfLE inf_le_right
      let c₀ : M.obj (op W) := M.presheaf.map iU.op b₀
      let c : Fin n → M.obj (op W) := fun i ↦ M.presheaf.map iV.op (b i)
      refine ⟨W, hxW, Fin.cases c₀ c, ?_⟩
      intro i
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j ↦ ?_) i
      · change TopCat.Presheaf.germ M.presheaf W x hxW
            (M.presheaf.map iU.op b₀) = a 0
        rw [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply M.presheaf iU x hxW b₀]
        exact hb₀
      · change TopCat.Presheaf.germ M.presheaf W x hxW
            (M.presheaf.map iV.op (b j)) = a j.succ
        rw [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply M.presheaf iV x hxW (b j)]
        exact hb j

name: PresheafOfModules.exteriorPowerStalkLinearMap_surjective
statement:
theorem exteriorPowerStalkLinearMap_surjective
    (M : PresheafOfModules.{u} (R ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))
    (n : ℕ) (x : X) :
    Function.Surjective (exteriorPowerStalkLinearMap M n x)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  have hz : z ∈ Submodule.span (R.stalk x)
      (Set.range (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk
        (M := (stalkFunctorLinear (R := R) x).obj M) (n := n))) := by
    change z ∈ Submodule.span (R.stalk x)
      (Set.range (_root_.exteriorPower.ιMulti (R.stalk x) n))
    rw [_root_.exteriorPower.ιMulti_span]
    trivial
  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
      obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hz
      obtain ⟨U, hx, b, hb⟩ := exists_common_germ_rep M x a
      refine ⟨TopCat.Presheaf.germ (exteriorPower M n).presheaf U x hx
        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk b), ?_⟩
      change exteriorPowerStalkAddHom M n x
          (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (exteriorPower M n).presheaf U x hx
            (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk b)) = ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk a
      rw [exteriorPowerStalkAddHom_germ_mk]
      exact congrArg ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (funext hb)
  | zero =>
      exact ⟨0, map_zero (exteriorPowerStalkLinearMap M n x)⟩
  | add a b _ _ ha hb =>
      obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := ha
      obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := hb
      refine ⟨a' + b', ?_⟩
      rw [map_add, ha', hb']
  | smul r a _ ha =>
      obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := ha
      refine ⟨r • a', ?_⟩
      rw [map_smul, ha']

name: SchemeKTheory.determinant_genericRank
statement:
theorem determinant_genericRank [IsIntegral X] (M : X.Modules)
    (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree X M) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X (determinant X M) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin⟩ := hM.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := hqfin
  let qdet := determinantLocalGeneratorsData X M q
  let p : Σ i : q.I, q.X i := Classical.choice <|
    show Nonempty (Σ i : q.I, q.X i) from by
      have hcover : IsOpenCover q.X := (Opens.coversTop_iff X q.X).mp q.coversTop
      let x : X := genericPoint X
      have hx : x ∈ ⋃ i, (q.X i : Set X) := by
        rw [hcover.iSup_set_eq_univ]
        exact Set.mem_univ x
      simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hx
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hx
      exact ⟨⟨i, x, hi⟩⟩
  have hη : genericPoint X ∈ qdet.X p := by
    let hspec : Specializes (genericPoint X) p.2.1 :=
      (genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial
    exact hspec.mem_open (qdet.X p).isOpen p.2.2
  have h := AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank_eq_natCard_localGenerators
    X (determinant X M) qdet p hη
  change AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X (determinant X M) =
    Nat.card PUnit at h
  simpa using h

name: SchemeKTheory.determinantGenericStalkLinearEquiv_mk_germs
statement:
theorem determinantGenericStalkLinearEquiv_mk_germs
    [IsIntegral X] (M : X.Modules) (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree X M)
    (U : Opens X) (hη : genericPoint X ∈ U)
    (a : Fin (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X M) →
      (underlyingCommPresheaf X M).obj (op U)) :
    determinantGenericStalkLinearEquiv X M hM
        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (fun i ↦
          TopCat.Presheaf.germ (underlyingCommPresheaf X M).presheaf
            U (genericPoint X) hη (a i))) =
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ
        (((moduleSheafification X ⋙ underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).obj
          (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower (underlyingCommPresheaf X M)
            (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X M))).presheaf)
        U (genericPoint X) hη
        (by
          change ↑(((moduleSheafification X ⋙ underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).obj
            (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower (underlyingCommPresheaf X M)
              (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X M))).obj (op U))
          exact (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app
            (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower (underlyingCommPresheaf X M)
              (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X M))).app (op U)).hom
                (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk a))
proof:
:= by
  let n := AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X M
  let η := genericPoint X
  let P := underlyingCommPresheaf X M
  let W := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower P n
  let e := determinantGenericStalkExteriorPowerLinearEquiv X M hM
  let s := exteriorPowerSheafStalkIso X M n η
  let z : ↑((PresheafOfModules.stalkFunctorLinear (R := X.presheaf) η).obj W) :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.germ W.presheaf U η hη
      (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk a)
  let w : ↑(((AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericStalkFunctor X).obj M).exteriorPower n) :=
    ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (fun i ↦
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ P.presheaf U η hη (a i))
  have hez : e z = w := by
    change PresheafOfModules.exteriorPowerStalkAddHom P n η
        (TopCat.Presheaf.germ W.presheaf U η hη
          (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk a)) =
      ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (fun i ↦
        TopCat.Presheaf.germ P.presheaf U η hη (a i))
    exact PresheafOfModules.exteriorPowerStalkAddHom_germ_mk
      P n η U hη a
  have hsymm : e.symm w = z := e.symm_apply_eq.mpr hez.symm
  change s.toLinearEquiv (e.symm w) = _
  rw [hsymm]
  change PresheafOfModules.stalkMapLinear
      ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app W) η
        (TopCat.Presheaf.germ W.presheaf U η hη
          (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk a)) =
    TopCat.Presheaf.germ
      (((moduleSheafification X ⋙ underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).obj W).presheaf)
      U η hη
      (by
        change ↑(((moduleSheafification X ⋙ underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).obj W).obj
          (op U))
        exact (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app W).app (op U)).hom
          (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk a))
  exact TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply U η hη
    ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map
        ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app W))
    (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk a)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveCoordinateChartScalarRingHom_flat
statement:
theorem projectiveCoordinateChartScalarRingHom_flat
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (projectiveCoordinateChartScalarRingHom R n i).Flat
proof:
:= by
  let f := projectiveCoordinateChartScalarRingHom R n i
  let e := awayCoordinateEquiv R n i
  change f.Flat
  apply (RingHom.Flat.respectsIso.cancel_right_isIso
    (CommRingCat.ofHom f) e.toCommRingCatIso.hom).mp
  change (e.toRingHom.comp f).Flat
  have hcomp :
      e.toRingHom.comp f =
        MvPolynomial.C (R := R) (σ := AffineChartIndex n i) := by
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro a
    apply e.symm.injective
    simp [e, f, awayCoordinateEquiv, awayCoordinateHom,
      projectiveCoordinateChartScalarRingHom,
      coefficientToCoordinateAway,
      HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_eq]
  rw [hcomp]
  change (algebraMap R
    (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) R)).Flat
  exact RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff.mpr Module.Flat.of_free

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec_isFlat
statement: theorem toSpec_isFlat : Flat (toSpec R n)
proof:
:= by
  refine (IsZariskiLocalAtSource.iff_of_openCover
    (coordinateOpenCover R n)).mpr ?_
  intro i
  change Flat ((coordinateOpen R n i).ι ≫ toSpec R n)
  rw [projectiveCoordinateOpen_ι_toSpec]
  letI :
      (projectiveCoordinateChartScalarRingHom R n i).Flat :=
    projectiveCoordinateChartScalarRingHom_flat R n i
  apply MorphismProperty.comp_mem (@Flat)
  · exact MorphismProperty.of_isIso (@Flat) _
  · exact Flat.SpecMap_iff.mpr
      (projectiveCoordinateChartScalarRingHom_flat R n i)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.intrinsicToSpec_flat_of_basis
statement:
theorem intrinsicToSpec_flat_of_basis
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M) :
    Flat (intrinsicToSpec (R := R) (M := M))
proof:

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.chartToBase_flat
statement:
theorem chartToBase_flat (i : C.I) (hi : Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) :
    Flat (C.chartToBase i)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  letI : Nonempty (C.basisIndex i) := hi
  let b : Module.Basis
      (Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1)) Γ(X, C.U i)
      (E.val.obj (Opposite.op (C.U i))) :=
    (C.sectionBasis i).reindex (C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i)
  unfold chartToBase affineData intrinsicAffineData
  dsimp only [SchemeRelativeProj.AffineData.toBase,
    SchemeRelativeProj.AffineData.toSpecBase]
  apply MorphismProperty.comp_mem (@Flat)
  · exact intrinsicToSpec_flat_of_basis b

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.toBase_flat
statement:
theorem toBase_flat
    (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) :
    Flat C.toBase
proof:
:= by

  intro i
  change Flat (pullback.snd C.toBase (C.U i).ι)
  let h := C.isPullback_chartι_toBase i
  rw [← MorphismProperty.cancel_left_of_respectsIso
      (@Flat) h.isoPullback.hom,
    h.isoPullback_hom_snd]
  exact C.chartToBase_flat i (hpos i)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.projectiveBundleFlatPullbackG0_classOf
statement:
@[simp]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingCechIntersectionSpecModule_isQuasicoherent
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingCechIntersectionSpecModule_isQuasicoherent
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (projectiveTwistingCechIntersectionSpecModule k n d p a).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsAffine (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).toScheme :=
    coordinateCechIntersection_isAffine k n p a
  letI : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
      (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).ι).obj
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d)).IsQuasicoherent :=
    projectiveTwistingCechIntersection_isQuasicoherent k n d p a
  exact pullback_isQuasicoherent_of_isAffine
    (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).toScheme.isoSpec.inv _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingCechIntersectionSpecModule_H_isZero
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingCechIntersectionSpecModule_H_isZero
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) (q : ℕ) :
    IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (Sheaf.H
        ((Modules.toSheafAb
          (Spec Γ((coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).toScheme, ⊤))).obj
            (projectiveTwistingCechIntersectionSpecModule k n d p a))
        (q + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsNoetherianRing
      Γ((coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).toScheme, ⊤) :=
    coordinateCechIntersection_isNoetherianRing k n p a
  letI : (projectiveTwistingCechIntersectionSpecModule k n d p a).IsQuasicoherent :=
    projectiveTwistingCechIntersectionSpecModule_isQuasicoherent k n d p a
  exact AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.quasicoherent_H_isZero
    (projectiveTwistingCechIntersectionSpecModule k n d p a) q

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingCechIntersection_H_isZero
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingCechIntersection_H_isZero
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) (q : ℕ) :
    IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (Sheaf.H
        ((Modules.toSheafAb (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).toScheme).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
            (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).ι).obj
              (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d)))
        (q + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsAffine (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).toScheme :=
    coordinateCechIntersection_isAffine k n p a
  apply AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.module_H_isZero_of_pullback_inverse_iso
    (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).toScheme.isoSpec
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
      (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).ι).obj
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d)) (q + 1)
  exact projectiveTwistingCechIntersectionSpecModule_H_isZero k n d p a q

name: SchemeKTheory.isNilpotent_mul_of_left
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_mul_of_left {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {a : R} (ha : IsNilpotent a) (b : R) :
    IsNilpotent (a * b)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ha
  exact ⟨n, by rw [mul_pow, hn, zero_mul]⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.isNilpotent_add'
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_add' {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {a b : R} (ha : IsNilpotent a)
    (hb : IsNilpotent b) : IsNilpotent (a + b)
proof:
:=
  (Commute.all a b).isNilpotent_add ha hb

name: SchemeKTheory.isNilpotent_sub_of_mul
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_sub_of_mul {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {e l r : R}
    (h : IsNilpotent (e * l - r)) (hl : IsNilpotent (l - 1)) : IsNilpotent (e - r)
proof:
:= by
  have : e - r = (e * l - r) + -((l - 1) * e) := by ring
  rw [this]
  exact isNilpotent_add' h (isNilpotent_mul_of_left hl e).neg

name: SchemeKTheory.isNilpotent_inv_sub_one
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_inv_sub_one {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (u : Rˣ)
    (h : IsNilpotent ((u : R) - 1)) : IsNilpotent (((u⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have : ((u⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) - 1 = -(((u : R) - 1) * ((u⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R)) := by
    rw [sub_mul, Units.mul_inv, one_mul]; ring
  rw [this]
  exact (isNilpotent_mul_of_left h _).neg

name: SchemeKTheory.isNilpotent_mul_sub_one
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_mul_sub_one {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {a b : R}
    (ha : IsNilpotent (a - 1)) (hb : IsNilpotent (b - 1)) : IsNilpotent (a * b - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have : a * b - 1 = (a - 1) * b + (b - 1) := by ring
  rw [this]
  exact isNilpotent_add' (isNilpotent_mul_of_left ha b) hb

name: SchemeKTheory.lambdaClass_free
statement:
theorem lambdaClass_free (I : Type u) [Finite I]
    (hI : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I)) (k : ℕ) :
    lambdaClass Y (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I) hI k =
      ((Nat.card I).choose k : K0 Y)
proof:
:= by
  letI : LinearOrder I := LinearOrder.lift' (Finite.equivFin I) (Finite.equivFin I).injective
  unfold lambdaClass
  rw [k0ClassOf_iso Y _ (free_isFiniteLocallyFree Y _) (exteriorPowerSheafFreeIso Y I k),
    k0ClassOf_free, Set.powersetCard.card]

name: SchemeKTheory.sub_one_pow_eq_zero_of_epi_free
statement:
theorem sub_one_pow_eq_zero_of_epi_free {L : Y.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1)
    (I : Type u) [Finite I] (hI : 0 < Nat.card I)
    (σ : SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I ⟶ L) [Epi σ] :
    (k0ClassOf Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree - 1) ^ Nat.card I = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := @koszul_relation Y _ _ _ hI (hasConstantRank_free_type Y I) hL σ ‹_›
  simp only [lambdaClass_free] at h
  rw [sub_eq_neg_add, add_pow, ← h]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ ?_
  ring

name: SchemeKTheory.isNilpotent_sub_one_of_epi_free
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_sub_one_of_epi_free {L : Y.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1)
    (I : Type u) [Finite I] (hI : 0 < Nat.card I)
    (σ : SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I ⟶ L) [Epi σ] :
    IsNilpotent (k0ClassOf Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree - 1)
proof:
:=
  ⟨_, sub_one_pow_eq_zero_of_epi_free Y hL I hI σ⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.rankAtRingHom_pullbackK0RingHom
statement:
theorem rankAtRingHom_pullbackK0RingHom {Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ Z) (y : Y) (a : K0 Z) :
    rankAtRingHom y (pullbackK0RingHom f a) = rankAtRingHom (f y) a
proof:
:= by
  refine k0_induction Z (fun a ↦ rankAtRingHom y (pullbackK0RingHom f a) =
    rankAtRingHom (f y) a) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ a
  · simp only [map_zero]
  · intro a b ha hb
    simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
  · intro a ha
    simp only [map_neg, ha]
  · intro F hF
    rw [pullbackK0RingHom_classOf, rankAtRingHom_classOf, rankAtRingHom_classOf,
      rankAt_pullback f F hF y]

name: SchemeKTheory.rankAtRingHom_eq_of_constantRankGenerators
statement:
theorem rankAtRingHom_eq_of_constantRankGenerators (h : ConstantRankGenerators Y) (a : K0 Y)
    (y y' : Y) : rankAtRingHom y a = rankAtRingHom y' a
proof:
:= by
  refine k0_induction Y (fun a ↦ rankAtRingHom y a = rankAtRingHom y' a) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ a
  · simp only [map_zero]
  · intro a b ha hb
    simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
  · intro a ha
    simp only [map_neg, ha]
  · intro F hF
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := h F hF
    rw [rankAtRingHom_classOf, rankAtRingHom_classOf, rankAt_of_hasConstantRank hr,
      rankAt_of_hasConstantRank hr]

name: SchemeKTheory.isNilpotent_pullbackK0RingHom_of_rankAt_eq_zero
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_pullbackK0RingHom_of_rankAt_eq_zero {Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hZ : RankZeroNilpotent Z) (hZr : ConstantRankGenerators Z) (y₀ : Y) (a : K0 Z)
    (ha : rankAtRingHom y₀ (pullbackK0RingHom f a) = 0) :
    IsNilpotent (pullbackK0RingHom f a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankAtRingHom_pullbackK0RingHom] at ha
  exact (hZ a fun z ↦ (rankAtRingHom_eq_of_constantRankGenerators hZr a z (f y₀)).trans ha).map _

name: SchemeKTheory.isNilpotent_pullbackK0RingHom_space_field
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_pullbackK0RingHom_space_field (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ)
    (f : Y ⟶ SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n) (y₀ : Y) (a : K0 (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n))
    (ha : rankAtRingHom y₀ (pullbackK0RingHom f a) = 0) :
    IsNilpotent (pullbackK0RingHom f a)
proof:
:=
  isNilpotent_pullbackK0RingHom_of_rankAt_eq_zero f
    (rankZeroNilpotent_space_of_isLocalRing k n)
    (constantRankGenerators_of_isIntegral _) y₀ a ha

name: SchemeKTheory.rankZeroNilpotent_of_forall_isNilpotent_sub_rank
statement:
theorem rankZeroNilpotent_of_forall_isNilpotent_sub_rank [Nonempty Y]
    (hY : ConstantRankGenerators Y)
    (h : ∀ (E : Y.Modules) (r : ℕ) (hE : HasConstantRank Y E r),
      IsNilpotent (k0ClassOf Y E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree - r)) :
    RankZeroNilpotent Y
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ a : K0 Y, ∃ n : ℤ, IsNilpotent (a - n) ∧ ∀ y, rankAtRingHom y a = n := by
    intro a
    refine k0_induction Y (fun a ↦ ∃ n : ℤ, IsNilpotent (a - n) ∧ ∀ y, rankAtRingHom y a = n)
      ⟨0, by simp, fun y ↦ by simp⟩ ?_ ?_ ?_ a
    · rintro a b ⟨n, hn, hn'⟩ ⟨m, hm, hm'⟩
      refine ⟨n + m, ?_, fun y ↦ by rw [map_add, hn', hm']⟩
      have : a + b - ((n + m : ℤ) : K0 Y) = (a - n) + (b - m) := by
        rw [Int.cast_add]; exact add_sub_add_comm a b _ _
      rw [this]
      exact isNilpotent_add' hn hm
    · rintro a ⟨n, hn, hn'⟩
      refine ⟨-n, ?_, fun y ↦ by rw [map_neg, hn']⟩
      have : -a - ((-n : ℤ) : K0 Y) = -(a - n) := by
        rw [Int.cast_neg]; exact (neg_sub_neg a _).trans (neg_sub a _).symm
      rw [this]
      exact hn.neg
    · intro F hF
      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hY F hF
      refine ⟨r, ?_, fun y ↦ ?_⟩
      · have := h F r hr
        rwa [Int.cast_natCast]
      · rw [rankAtRingHom_classOf, rankAt_of_hasConstantRank hr]
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hn'⟩ := key a
  obtain ⟨y⟩ := ‹Nonempty Y›
  have h0 : n = 0 := (hn' y).symm.trans (ha y)
  rw [h0, Int.cast_zero, sub_zero] at hn
  exact hn

name: SchemeKTheory.isNilpotent_sub_rank_of_flagTower
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_sub_rank_of_flagTower [IsNoetherian Y] {E : Y.Modules} {r : ℕ}
    (hE : HasConstantRank Y E r) (T : SchemeProjectiveBundle.FlagTower E r)
    (hL : ∀ i, IsNilpotent (k0ClassOf T.Y (T.L i) (T.rankOne i).isFiniteLocallyFree - 1)) :
    IsNilpotent (k0ClassOf Y E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree - r)
proof:
:= by
  let φ := flatPullbackK0RingHom T.q
  have hinj : Function.Injective φ := by
    have h := T.injective SchemeProjectiveBundle.pbInjectiveHyp inferInstance
    intro a b hab
    exact h (by rw [← flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply, ← flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply]; exact hab)
  have hφ : φ (k0ClassOf Y E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree - r) =
      ∑ i, (k0ClassOf T.Y (T.L i) (T.rankOne i).isFiniteLocallyFree - 1) := by
    rw [map_sub, map_natCast, flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply,
      T.pullback_class_eq_sum hE.isFiniteLocallyFree]
    have e : ∑ i, (k0ClassOf T.Y (T.L i) (T.rankOne i).isFiniteLocallyFree - 1) =
        ∑ i, k0ClassOf T.Y (T.L i) (T.rankOne i).isFiniteLocallyFree - (r : K0 T.Y) := by
      have h1 := Finset.sum_sub_distrib (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin r)))
        (fun i ↦ k0ClassOf T.Y (T.L i) (T.rankOne i).isFiniteLocallyFree) (fun _ ↦ (1 : K0 T.Y))
      have h2 : ∑ _i : Fin r, (1 : K0 T.Y) = (r : K0 T.Y) := by simp
      exact h1.trans (congrArg _ h2)
    exact e.symm
  have hnil : IsNilpotent (φ (k0ClassOf Y E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree - r)) := by
    rw [hφ]
    exact isNilpotent_sum fun i _ ↦ hL i
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hnil
  exact ⟨N, hinj (by rw [map_pow, hN, map_zero])⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.rankZeroNilpotent_of_flagTower_lines
statement:
theorem rankZeroNilpotent_of_flagTower_lines [IsNoetherian Y] [Nonempty Y]
    (hY : ConstantRankGenerators Y)
    (h : ∀ (E : Y.Modules) (r : ℕ) (_ : HasConstantRank Y E r),
      ∃ T : SchemeProjectiveBundle.FlagTower E r, ∀ i,
        IsNilpotent (k0ClassOf T.Y (T.L i) (T.rankOne i).isFiniteLocallyFree - 1)) :
    RankZeroNilpotent Y
proof:
:=
  rankZeroNilpotent_of_forall_isNilpotent_sub_rank hY fun E r hE ↦
    let ⟨T, hT⟩ := h E r hE
    isNilpotent_sub_rank_of_flagTower hE T hT

name: SchemeKTheory.mk_lambdaClass_pullback_of_lambdaNilpotent
statement:
theorem mk_lambdaClass_pullback_of_lambdaNilpotent {Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hZ : LambdaNilpotent Z) (E : Z.Modules) (r : ℕ) (hE : HasConstantRank Z E r) (k : ℕ) :
    Ideal.Quotient.mk (nilradical (K0 Y))
        (lambdaClass Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E)
          (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global f E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree) k) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (nilradical (K0 Y)) (r.choose k : K0 Y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lambdaClass_pullback_of f (pullbackK0RingHom f) (pullbackK0RingHom_classOf f) E
    hE.isFiniteLocallyFree k]
  have h := hZ E r hE k
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq, mem_nilradical] at h ⊢
  have := h.map (pullbackK0RingHom f)
  rwa [RingHom.map_sub, map_natCast] at this

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.isNilpotent_tautologicalK0Class_sub_one_of_epi_free
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_tautologicalK0Class_sub_one_of_epi_free (I : Type u) [Finite I]
    (hI : 0 < Nat.card I) (σ : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I ⟶ E) [Epi σ] :
    IsNilpotent (C.tautologicalK0Class - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hP : (Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).PreservesEpimorphisms :=
    Functor.preservesEpimorphisms_of_adjunction (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction _)
  haveI : Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).map σ) :=
    @Functor.map_epi _ _ _ _ (Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase) hP _ _ σ ‹_›
  let τ := (pullbackFreeIso C.toBase I).inv ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).map σ ≫
    C.tautologicalQuotient
  have hτ : Epi τ := epi_comp' inferInstance (epi_comp' inferInstance inferInstance)
  exact @isNilpotent_sub_one_of_epi_free C.scheme _ (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    I _ hI τ hτ

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.hasConstantRank_of_localFrames'
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_of_localFrames' (n : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ y : X, ∃ (U : X.Opens) (_ : y ∈ U) (I : Type u) (_ : Finite I) (_ : Nat.card I = n)
      (x : I → P.obj (op U)), ∀ (V : X.Opens) (hV : V ≤ U),
        Function.Bijective (frameMap P x V hV)) :
    HasConstantRank X ((moduleSheafification X).obj P) n
proof:
:= by
  choose U hyU I hI hcard x hx using h
  let e : ∀ y : X, SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over (U y)) (I y) ≅
      ((moduleSheafification X).obj P).over (U y) := fun y ↦
    (overIsoFreeOfForall (x y) (hx y)).symm
  refine ⟨{ I := X, X := U, coversTop := ?_
            generators := fun y ↦ SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.equivOfIso (e y)
              (SheafOfModules.free.generatingSections (I y)) }, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Opens.coversTop_iff]
    exact top_le_iff.mp fun y _ ↦ TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨y, hyU y⟩
  · constructor
    intro y
    infer_instance
  · constructor
    intro y
    haveI : (SheafOfModules.free.generatingSections (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over (U y))
        (I y)).IsFiniteType :=
      SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.IsFiniteType.mk (hI y)
    exact SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.equivOfIso_isFiniteType _ (e y)
  · intro y
    exact hcard y

name: SchemeKTheory.hasConstantRank_of_iso
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_of_iso {X : Scheme.{u}} {M N : X.Modules} (e : M ≅ N) {r : ℕ}
    (hM : HasConstantRank X M r) : HasConstantRank X N r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hfin, hcard⟩ := hM
  refine ⟨{ I := q.I, X := q.X, coversTop := q.coversTop
            generators := fun i ↦ SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.equivOfIso
              ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf (q.X i)).mapIso e) (q.generators i) },
    ?_, ?_, hcard⟩
  · constructor
    intro i
    haveI := hq.isIso i
    exact SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.equivOfIso_isIso _ _
  · constructor
    intro i
    haveI := hfin.isFiniteType i
    exact SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.equivOfIso_isFiniteType _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.restrict_smul
statement:
theorem restrict_smul {M : X.Modules} {U V : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) (r : Γ(X, U))
    (f : M.over U ⟶ (unitMod X).over U) :
    Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X h (r • f) =
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op r) • Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X h f
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_def, smul_def, Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_comp, res_mulSectionHom]

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.coef_smul_id
statement:
theorem coef_smul_id {V : X.Opens} (φ : (unitMod X).over V ⟶ (unitMod X).over V) :
    coef φ • 𝟙 _ = φ
proof:
:=
  (hom_eq_smul (Iso.refl ((unitMod X).over V)) φ).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.coef_smul
statement: theorem coef_smul {V : X.Opens} (a : Γ(X, V)) : coef (a • 𝟙 ((unitMod X).over V)) = a
proof:
:= by
  change X.presheaf.map (𝟙 V).op a * 1 = a
  rw [op_id, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, mul_one]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.ιFree_coordProj
statement:
theorem ιFree_coordProj (i j : I) :
    SheafOfModules.ιFree i ≫ coordProj (X := X) (U := U) j = if i = j then 𝟙 _ else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← SheafOfModules.freeCofan_inj]
  exact Cofan.IsColimit.fac _ _ i

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.sum_coordProj_ιFree
statement:
theorem sum_coordProj_ιFree :
    ∑ j, coordProj (X := X) (U := U) j ≫ SheafOfModules.ιFree j =
      𝟙 (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) I)
proof:
:= by
  apply Cofan.IsColimit.hom_ext (SheafOfModules.isColimitFreeCofan I)
  intro k
  erw [SheafOfModules.freeCofan_inj, Preadditive.comp_sum, Category.comp_id]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k]
  · erw [← Category.assoc, ιFree_coordProj, if_pos rfl, Category.id_comp]
  · intro j _ hj
    erw [← Category.assoc, ιFree_coordProj, if_neg (Ne.symm hj), zero_comp]
  · intro h
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ k) h

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.frameSec_coframe
statement:
theorem frameSec_coframe (i j : I) :
    frameSec L e i ≫ coframe L e j = if i = j then 𝟙 _ else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [frameSec, coframe, Category.assoc, e.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  exact ιFree_coordProj i j

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.sum_coframe_frameSec
statement: theorem sum_coframe_frameSec : ∑ j, coframe L e j ≫ frameSec L e j = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coframe, frameSec, Category.assoc]
  erw [← Preadditive.comp_sum]
  simp only [← Category.assoc]
  erw [← Preadditive.sum_comp, sum_coordProj_ιFree, Category.id_comp, e.hom_inv_id]

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.comp_smul'
statement:
theorem comp_smul' {V : X.Opens} {M N : SheafOfModules.{u} (X.ringCatSheaf.over V)}
    (φ : M ⟶ N) (a : Γ(X, V)) (ψ : N ⟶ (unitMod X).over V) : φ ≫ (a • ψ) = a • (φ ≫ ψ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_def, smul_def, Category.assoc]

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.comp_smul_id
statement:
theorem comp_smul_id {V : X.Opens} {M : SheafOfModules.{u} (X.ringCatSheaf.over V)}
    (ψ : M ⟶ (unitMod X).over V) (a : Γ(X, V)) : ψ ≫ (a • 𝟙 _) = a • ψ
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_def, smul_def, Category.id_comp]

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.res_frameSec_coframe
statement:
theorem res_frameSec_coframe {V : X.Opens} (hV : V ≤ U) (i j : I) :
    Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X hV (frameSec L e i) ≫
      Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X hV (coframe L e j) = if i = j then 𝟙 _ else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_comp, frameSec_coframe]
  split_ifs
  · exact restrictHomOverLE_id hV
  · exact (restrictAddHom (M := unitMod X) (N := unitMod X) hV).map_zero

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.res_sum_coframe_frameSec
statement:
theorem res_sum_coframe_frameSec {V : X.Opens} (hV : V ≤ U) :
    ∑ j, Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X hV (coframe L e j) ≫
      Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X hV (frameSec L e j) = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_comp]
  rw [← restrictHomOverLE_id (M := L) hV, ← sum_coframe_frameSec L e]
  exact (map_sum (restrictAddHom (M := L) (N := L) hV) _ _).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.frame_bijective
statement:
theorem frame_bijective {V : X.Opens} (hV : V ≤ U) :
    Function.Bijective (Cotangent.frameMap (dualPre X L) (coframe L e) V hV)
proof:
:= by
  have hfm : ∀ l, Cotangent.frameMap (dualPre X L) (coframe L e) V hV l =
      ∑ j, l j • Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X hV (coframe L e j) := by
    intro l
    rw [Cotangent.frameMap, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum_fintype]
    · rfl
    · intro j
      exact zero_smul _ _
  have hev : ∀ (l : I →₀ Γ(X, V)) (i : I),
      coef (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X hV (frameSec L e i) ≫
        (∑ j, l j • Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X hV (coframe L e j))) = l i := by
    intro l i
    rw [Preadditive.comp_sum]
    simp only [comp_smul', res_frameSec_coframe]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · rw [if_pos rfl, coef_smul]
    · intro j _ hj
      rw [if_neg (Ne.symm hj), smul_zero]
    · intro h
      exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ i) h
  constructor
  · intro l l' h
    rw [hfm, hfm] at h
    ext i
    rw [← hev l i, ← hev l' i, h]
  · intro lam
    change L.over V ⟶ (unitMod X).over V at lam
    refine ⟨Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm
      (fun j ↦ coef (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X hV (frameSec L e j) ≫ lam)), ?_⟩
    rw [hfm]
    conv_rhs => rw [← Category.id_comp lam, ← res_sum_coframe_frameSec (L := L) (e := e) hV]
    rw [Preadditive.sum_comp]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
    change coef (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X hV (frameSec L e j) ≫ lam) • _ = _
    rw [Category.assoc]
    conv_rhs => rw [← coef_smul_id (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X hV (frameSec L e j) ≫ lam)]
    exact (comp_smul_id _ _).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank_of
statement:
theorem lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank_of {X : Scheme.{u}} (L : X.Modules) {n : ℕ}
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L n) : HasConstantRank X (lineBundleDual X L) n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hfin, hcard⟩ := hL
  have hcov : ∀ y : X, ∃ i, y ∈ q.X i := by
    intro y
    have h := q.coversTop
    rw [Opens.coversTop_iff] at h
    have hy : y ∈ (⨆ i, q.X i : X.Opens) := by rw [h]; trivial
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.1 hy
  apply hasConstantRank_of_iso ((asIso (PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
    (structurePresheafId X)).counit).app (lineBundleDual X L))
  apply Cotangent.hasConstantRank_of_localFrames' (dualPre X L) n
  intro y
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcov y
  haveI := hq.isIso i
  haveI : Finite (q.generators i).I := (hfin.isFiniteType i).finite
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite (q.generators i).I
  classical
  let e : L.over (q.X i) ≅ SheafOfModules.free (q.generators i).I :=
    (asIso (q.generators i).π).symm
  exact ⟨q.X i, hi, (q.generators i).I, inferInstance, hcard i, coframe L e,
    fun V hV ↦ frame_bijective L e hV⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.relativeTangent_hasConstantRank
statement:
theorem relativeTangent_hasConstantRank (n : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension n f] :
    HasConstantRank X (relativeTangent f) n
proof:
:=
  lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank_of _ (relativeSheaf_hasConstantRank f n)

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.relativeTangent_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem relativeTangent_isFiniteLocallyFree (n : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension n f] :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree X (relativeTangent f)
proof:
:=
  (relativeTangent_hasConstantRank f n).isFiniteLocallyFree

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.tangentOfHom_hasConstantRank
statement:
theorem tangentOfHom_hasConstantRank [IsAffine S] (n : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension n f] :
    HasConstantRank X (tangentOfHom f) n
proof:
:=
  lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank_of _ (hasConstantRank_of_smooth X f n)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E27.coeff_eq_one_of_flatPullback_prime
statement:
theorem coeff_eq_one_of_flatPullback_prime {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian Z]
    (f : Z ⟶ Y) {n n' : ℕ} (v : Y) (hv : height v = n) (w : Z) (hw : height w = n')
    (h : flatPullback f (dimPrimeCycle v n hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle w n' hw).1) :
    f w = v ∧ flatPullbackCoeff f w = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := congrArg (fun c : AlgebraicCycle Z ℤ => c w) h
  simp only [flatPullback_apply, M7.m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply, if_true] at h1
  by_cases hfw : f w = v
  · refine ⟨hfw, ?_⟩
    rw [if_pos hfw, one_mul] at h1
    exact_mod_cast h1
  · rw [if_neg hfw] at h1
    simp at h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E27.flat_jHom_comp
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.jHom_toBase]
  exact P.toD.toBase_flat fun i => by
    have := hCD i
    exact Nat.card_pos_iff.mp (by omega) |>.1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E27.hnot_of_regular
statement:
theorem hnot_of_regular {B D : X.Modules} {b : B ⟶ D} (P : PairCover b) {L : X.Modules}
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) {e : ℕ}
    (hCD : ∀ i, Nat.card (P.toD.basisIndex i) = e + 1)
    (σ : tensorUnitSheaf P.toB.scheme ⟶ E16.twistedLine P.toB L)
    (hreg : SectionIsRegular σ) (hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = P.jHom.ker)
    (m : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = m)
    (w : P.toB.scheme) (hw : height w = ((m + e + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
    (hB : flatPullback P.toB.toBase (dimPrimeCycle v m hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle w _ hw).1) :
    w ∉ Set.range P.jHom
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨q', hq'⟩
  have hN := E16.hasConstantRank_twistedLine P.toB hL
  haveI : (E16.twistedLine P.toB L).IsLocallyFree := hN.isFiniteLocallyFree.isLocallyFree
  haveI : (E16.twistedLine P.toB L).IsFinitePresentation :=
    IsFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation P.toB.scheme hN.isFiniteLocallyFree
  obtain ⟨-, hw1⟩ := coeff_eq_one_of_flatPullback_prime P.toB.toBase v hv w hw hB
  rw [← hq'] at hw1
  haveI := flat_jHom_comp P hCD
  let d : D23.WFrame (E16.twistedLine P.toB L) (P.jHom q') := (D23.exists_wFrame hN _).some
  exact false_of_mem_range_of_regular_kernel P.toB.toBase P.jHom q' hw1 _
    (ker_stalkMap_eq_span_germ_wCoord σ P.jHom hid q' d)
    (isSMulRegular_germ_wCoord σ hreg d)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E27.germ_sectionCoordSec_closureFrame
statement:
theorem germ_sectionCoordSec_closureFrame {L : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (w : X) (s : Γ(L, ⊤)) (z : pointClosureScheme w) :
    (pointClosureScheme w).presheaf.germ (closureFrame (hL := hL) w z).U z
      (closureFrame (hL := hL) w z).mem
      (D10.sectionCoordSec (closureFrame (hL := hL) w z) (wPullbackSection (pointClosureι w) s)) =
    ((pointClosureι w).stalkMap z).hom
      (X.presheaf.germ (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z)).U (pointClosureι w z)
        (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z)).mem (wCoord (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z)) s))
proof:
:= by
  unfold closureFrame
  rw [sectionCoordSec_pullbackWFrame (pointClosureι w) (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z)) s _
    (wCoord_spec _ s) z (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z)).mem]
  exact (Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply (pointClosureι w) (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z)).U z
    (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z)).mem (wCoord (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z)) s)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E27.germ_stalkCongr_apply
statement:
theorem germ_stalkCongr_apply {Y : Scheme.{u}} {x y : Y} (e : x = y) (U : Y.Opens) (hx : x ∈ U)
    (hy : y ∈ U) (r : Γ(Y, U)) :
    (Y.presheaf.stalkCongr (Inseparable.of_eq e)).hom (Y.presheaf.germ U x hx r) =
      Y.presheaf.germ U y hy r
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E27.ord_eq_one_at_jq
statement:
theorem ord_eq_one_at_jq {B D : X.Modules} {b : B ⟶ D} (P : PairCover b) {L : X.Modules}
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) {e : ℕ}
    (hCD : ∀ i, Nat.card (P.toD.basisIndex i) = e + 1)
    (σ : tensorUnitSheaf P.toB.scheme ⟶ E16.twistedLine P.toB L)
    (hreg : SectionIsRegular σ) (hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = P.jHom.ker)
    (m : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = m)
    (w : P.toB.scheme) (hw : height w = ((m + e + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
    (q : P.toD.scheme) (hq : height q = ((m + e : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
    (hB : flatPullback P.toB.toBase (dimPrimeCycle v m hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle w _ hw).1)
    (hD : flatPullback P.toD.toBase (dimPrimeCycle v m hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle q _ hq).1)
    (z : pointClosureScheme w) (hz : pointClosureι w z = P.jHom q) :
    (pointClosureScheme w).ord
      (D10.sectionCoord (closureFrame (L := E16.twistedLine P.toB L)
        (hL := E16.hasConstantRank_twistedLine P.toB hL) w z)
        (wPullbackSection (pointClosureι w) (E26.sectionOfHom σ))) z = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hN := E16.hasConstantRank_twistedLine P.toB hL
  haveI : (E16.twistedLine P.toB L).IsLocallyFree := hN.isFiniteLocallyFree.isLocallyFree
  haveI : (E16.twistedLine P.toB L).IsFinitePresentation :=
    IsFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation P.toB.scheme hN.isFiniteLocallyFree
  have hnotw := hnot_of_regular P hL hCD σ hreg hid m v hv w hw hB
  obtain ⟨hqv, hq1⟩ := coeff_eq_one_of_flatPullback_prime P.toD.toBase v hv q hq hD
  obtain ⟨hwv, -⟩ := coeff_eq_one_of_flatPullback_prime P.toB.toBase v hv w hw hB
  have hq1' : flatPullbackCoeff (P.jHom ≫ P.toB.toBase) q = 1 := by
    rw [P.jHom_toBase]; exact hq1
  have hwf : P.toB.toBase w = P.toB.toBase (pointClosureι w z) := by
    rw [hz, hwv, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, P.jHom_toBase, hqv]
  have hne : w ≠ P.jHom q := fun h => hnotw ⟨q, h.symm⟩
  let d := wFrameAt (E16.twistedLine P.toB L) hN (pointClosureι w z)
  let d' : WFrame (E16.twistedLine P.toB L) (P.jHom q) := ⟨d.U, hz ▸ d.mem, d.frame⟩
  have hcoord : wCoord d' (E26.sectionOfHom σ) = wCoord d (E26.sectionOfHom σ) := rfl
  have hker := ker_stalkMap_eq_span_germ_wCoord σ P.jHom hid q d'
  have hmax := closure_maximalIdeal_eq_span P.toB.toBase P.jHom q hq1' w z hz.symm hwf _ hker
  have hne0 := closure_image_ne_zero P.toB.toBase P.jHom q hq1' w z hz.symm hwf hne _ hker
  have hcoh := coheight_closure_eq_one P.toB.toBase P.jHom q hq1' w z hz.symm hwf hne _ hker
  have hg : (P.toB.scheme.presheaf.stalkCongr (Inseparable.of_eq hz.symm)).hom
      (P.toB.scheme.presheaf.germ d'.U (P.jHom q) d'.mem (wCoord d' (E26.sectionOfHom σ))) =
      P.toB.scheme.presheaf.germ d.U (pointClosureι w z) d.mem
        (wCoord d (E26.sectionOfHom σ)) := by
    rw [hcoord]
    exact germ_stalkCongr_apply hz.symm d.U _ _ _
  rw [hg] at hmax hne0
  rw [E25.sectionCoord_eq_algebraMap_germ _ _ z (closureFrame (hL := hN) w z).mem,
    germ_sectionCoordSec_closureFrame hN w _ z]
  exact Scheme.ord_algebraMap_eq_one_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal hcoh hne0 hmax.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearForm_mem_degree_one
statement:
theorem linearForm_mem_degree_one (x : M) :
    linearForm R M x ∈ symGrading R M 1
proof:
:= by
  change SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M x ∈
    LinearMap.range
        (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M :
          M →ₗ[R] SymmetricAlgebra R M) ^ 1
  rw [pow_one]
  exact LinearMap.mem_range_self _ x

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.irrelevant_le_span_basisLinearForms
statement:
theorem irrelevant_le_span_basisLinearForms {ι : Type u} (b : Module.Basis ι R M) :
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (symGrading R M)).toIdeal ≤
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun i ↦ linearForm R M (b i))
proof:
:= by
  let I : Ideal (SymmetricAlgebra R M) :=
    Ideal.span (Set.range fun i ↦ linearForm R M (b i))
  let IR : Submodule R (SymmetricAlgebra R M) :=
    (I : Submodule (SymmetricAlgebra R M) (SymmetricAlgebra R M)).restrictScalars R
  have hlinear (m : M) : linearForm R M m ∈ I := by
    have hm : m ∈ Submodule.span R (Set.range b) := by
      rw [b.span_eq]
      exact Submodule.mem_top
    induction hm using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem m hm =>
        obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hm
        exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self i)
    | zero =>
        simp [linearForm]
    | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
        simpa [linearForm, map_add] using I.add_mem hx hy
    | smul r x _ hx =>
        simpa [linearForm, map_smul, Algebra.smul_def] using
          I.mul_mem_left (algebraMap R (SymmetricAlgebra R M) r) hx
  have hrange :
      LinearMap.range
          (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M :
            M →ₗ[R] SymmetricAlgebra R M) ≤ IR := by
    rintro a ⟨m, rfl⟩
    exact hlinear m
  have hpow (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) :
      LinearMap.range
            (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M :
              M →ₗ[R] SymmetricAlgebra R M) ^ d ≤
        IR := by
    cases d with
    | zero =>
        omega
    | succ e =>
        rw [pow_succ]
        exact Submodule.mul_le.mpr fun a _ b hb ↦ I.mul_mem_left a (hrange hb)
  refine (HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_irrelevant_le (symGrading R M)).2 ?_
  intro d hd p hp
  exact hpow d hd hp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearOpen_iSup_eq_top
statement:
theorem linearOpen_iSup_eq_top {ι : Type u} (b : Module.Basis ι R M) :
    ⨆ i, linearOpen R M (b i) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply Proj.iSup_basicOpen_eq_top
  exact irrelevant_le_span_basisLinearForms R M b

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearOpen_isAffine
statement:
theorem linearOpen_isAffine (x : M) :
    IsAffineOpen (linearOpen R M x)
proof:
:= by
  exact Proj.isAffineOpen_basicOpen (symGrading R M) (linearForm R M x)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearOverlapRatio_mul_inv
statement:
theorem linearOverlapRatio_mul_inv (x y : M) :
    linearOverlapRatio R M x y * linearOverlapRatioInv R M x y = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp only [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul, linearOverlapRatio,
    linearOverlapRatioInv, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk,
    HomogeneousLocalization.val_one, Localization.mk_mul]
  rw [← Localization.mk_one]
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, Submonoid.coe_mul, mul_one, pow_one]
  change linearForm R M y ^ 2 * linearForm R M x ^ 2 =
    (linearForm R M x * linearForm R M y) *

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearTripleRatio_cocycle
statement:
theorem linearTripleRatio_cocycle (x y z : M) :
    linearTripleRatioXY R M x y z * linearTripleRatioYZ R M x y z =
      linearTripleRatioXZ R M x y z
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp only [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul, linearTripleRatioXY,
    linearTripleRatioYZ, linearTripleRatioXZ,
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, Localization.mk_mul]
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, Submonoid.coe_mul, pow_one]
  change
    linearTripleEquation R M x y z *
        ((linearForm R M y ^ 2 * linearForm R M z) *
          (linearForm R M z ^ 2 * linearForm R M x)) =
      (linearTripleEquation R M x y z *
          linearTripleEquation R M x y z) *
        (linearForm R M z ^ 2 * linearForm R M y)
  simp only [linearTripleEquation]
  ring

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearTwistTransitionUnit_cocycle
statement:

          (linearTwistTransitionUnit R M d x y) *
        Units.map (linearOverlapToTripleYZ R M x y z).toMonoidHom

    linearOverlapRatioTripleUnitXZ R M x y z ^ d
  rw [linearOverlapRatioTripleUnit_cocycle]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E22.kernel_ι_comp_eq_zero_of_sections
statement:
theorem kernel_ι_comp_eq_zero_of_sections (u : A ⟶ C) (v : A ⟶ Q) {I : Type u}
    (U : I → Y.Opens) (hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y).CoversTop U)
    {κ : I → Type u} [∀ i, Fintype (κ i)]
    (μ : ∀ i, κ i → Γ(A, U i)) (g : ∀ i, Γ(Q, U i)) (c : ∀ i, Γ(C, U i))
    (f : ∀ i, κ i → Γ(Y, U i))
    (hgen : ∀ i (V : Y.Opens) (hV : V ≤ U i) (s : Γ(A, V)),
      ∃ (J : Type u) (W : J → Y.Opens) (hW : ∀ j, W j ≤ V) (_ : V ≤ ⨆ j, W j)
        (a : ∀ j, κ i → Γ(Y, W j)), ∀ j, A.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hW j)).op s =
          ∑ k, a j k • A.presheaf.map (homOfLE ((hW j).trans hV)).op (μ i k))
    (hfree : ∀ i (V : Y.Opens) (hV : V ≤ U i) (r : Γ(Y, V)),
      r • Q.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op (g i) = 0 → r = 0)
    (hv : ∀ i k, v.app (U i) (μ i k) = f i k • g i)
    (hu : ∀ i k, u.app (U i) (μ i k) = f i k • c i) :
    kernel.ι v ≫ u = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext
  intro V
  ext s
  change u.app V (( kernel.ι v).app V s) = 0
  set s' : Γ(A, V) := (kernel.ι v).app V s with hs'
  have hvs : v.app V s' = 0 := by
    have h1 : (kernel.ι v ≫ v).app V s = 0 := by
      rw [kernel.condition]; rfl
    exact h1
  have hcover : V ≤ ⨆ i, V ⊓ U i := by
    have : (⨆ i, U i : Y.Opens) = ⊤ := (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := Y) U).1 hU
    rw [← inf_iSup_eq, this, inf_top_eq]
  refine sections_eq_zero_of_locally (fun i => V ⊓ U i) (fun i => inf_le_left) hcover _ ?_
  intro i
  rw [← tautChart_app_map u]
  set V1 : Y.Opens := V ⊓ U i with hV1
  have hV1U : V1 ≤ U i := inf_le_right
  set s1 : Γ(A, V1) := A.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V1 ≤ V)).op s' with hs1
  have hvs1 : v.app V1 s1 = 0 := by
    rw [hs1, tautChart_app_map, hvs]
    exact map_zero (Q.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V1 ≤ V)).op).hom
  obtain ⟨J, W, hW, cov, a, ha⟩ := hgen i V1 hV1U s1
  refine sections_eq_zero_of_locally W hW cov _ ?_
  intro j
  rw [← tautChart_app_map u]
  rw [ha j]
  have hvW : v.app (W j) (A.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hW j)).op s1) = 0 := by
    rw [tautChart_app_map, hvs1]
    exact map_zero (Q.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hW j)).op).hom
  rw [ha j] at hvW
  have hv' : ∀ k, v.app (W j) (a j k • A.presheaf.map (homOfLE ((hW j).trans hV1U)).op (μ i k)) =
      (a j k * Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE ((hW j).trans hV1U)).op (f i k)) •
        Q.presheaf.map (homOfLE ((hW j).trans hV1U)).op (g i) := by
    intro k
    rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul, tautChart_app_map, hv, Scheme.Modules.map_smul, mul_smul]
  have hzero : ∑ k, a j k * Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE ((hW j).trans hV1U)).op (f i k) = 0 := by
    apply hfree i (W j) ((hW j).trans hV1U)
    rw [Finset.sum_smul, ← hvW, map_sum (v.app (W j)).hom]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => (hv' k).symm
  have hu' : ∀ k, u.app (W j) (a j k • A.presheaf.map (homOfLE ((hW j).trans hV1U)).op (μ i k)) =
      (a j k * Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE ((hW j).trans hV1U)).op (f i k)) •
        C.presheaf.map (homOfLE ((hW j).trans hV1U)).op (c i) := by
    intro k
    rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul, tautChart_app_map, hu, Scheme.Modules.map_smul, mul_smul]
  rw [map_sum (u.app (W j)).hom, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => hu' k, ← Finset.sum_smul, hzero,
    zero_smul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E22.kernelSubobject_le_of_sections
statement:
theorem kernelSubobject_le_of_sections (u : A ⟶ C) (v : A ⟶ Q) {I : Type u}
    (U : I → Y.Opens) (hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y).CoversTop U)
    {κ : I → Type u} [∀ i, Fintype (κ i)]
    (μ : ∀ i, κ i → Γ(A, U i)) (g : ∀ i, Γ(Q, U i)) (c : ∀ i, Γ(C, U i))
    (f : ∀ i, κ i → Γ(Y, U i))
    (hgen : ∀ i (V : Y.Opens) (hV : V ≤ U i) (s : Γ(A, V)),
      ∃ (J : Type u) (W : J → Y.Opens) (hW : ∀ j, W j ≤ V) (_ : V ≤ ⨆ j, W j)
        (a : ∀ j, κ i → Γ(Y, W j)), ∀ j, A.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hW j)).op s =
          ∑ k, a j k • A.presheaf.map (homOfLE ((hW j).trans hV)).op (μ i k))
    (hfree : ∀ i (V : Y.Opens) (hV : V ≤ U i) (r : Γ(Y, V)),
      r • Q.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op (g i) = 0 → r = 0)
    (hv : ∀ i k, v.app (U i) (μ i k) = f i k • g i)
    (hu : ∀ i k, u.app (U i) (μ i k) = f i k • c i) :
    kernelSubobject v ≤ kernelSubobject u
proof:
:= by
  have := kernel_ι_comp_eq_zero_of_sections u v U hU μ g c f hgen hfree hv hu
  refine le_kernelSubobject u _ ?_
  rw [← kernelSubobject_arrow, Category.assoc, this, comp_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D31.exists_epi_free_twist_of_finitePresentation
statement:
theorem exists_epi_free_twist_of_finitePresentation {k : Type u} [CommRing k] [IsNoetherianRing k]
    (N : ℕ) {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (j : X ⟶ space k N) [IsClosedImmersion j] (E : X.Modules) [E.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ (D : ℕ) (I : Type u) (_ : Fintype I)
      (φ : FreeM X I ⟶
        tensorSheaf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (D : ℤ))) E),
      Epi φ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj E).IsFinitePresentation :=
    isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_isFinite j E
  obtain ⟨D, G, hG⟩ := serre_generation k N ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj E)
  letI := hG
  let V := projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (D : ℤ)
  let L' : X.Modules := tensorSheaf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj V) E
  let e : tensorSheaf (space k N) V ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj E) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj L' :=
    projectionFormulaIso j V (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree k N _) E
  haveI : Finite G.I := hG.finite
  letI : Fintype G.I := Fintype.ofFinite G.I
  let e1 : FreeM (space k N) G.I ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj L' := G.π ≫ e.hom
  haveI : Epi e1 := epi_comp' G.epi inferInstance
  haveI hP : Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).map e1) := inferInstance
  haveI hC := ClosedImmersionCoverF11.counit_epi j L'
  let φ : FreeM X G.I ⟶ L' :=
    (pullbackFreeIso j G.I).inv ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback j).map e1 ≫ ClosedImmersionCoverF11.counitHom j L'
  haveI : Epi (φ) := epi_comp' (inferInstance : Epi (pullbackFreeIso j G.I).inv) (epi_comp' hP hC)
  exact ⟨D, G.I, inferInstance, φ, inferInstance⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D31.exists_closedImmersion_twist_into_free
statement:
theorem exists_closedImmersion_twist_into_free {k : Type u} [CommRing k] [IsNoetherianRing k]
    (N : ℕ) {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (j : X ⟶ space k N) [IsClosedImmersion j] (E : X.Modules) (r : ℕ)
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    ∃ (D : ℕ) (I : Type u) (_ : Fintype I)
      (C : AffineFrameCover X
        (tensorSheaf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (D : ℤ))) E))
      (C' : AffineFrameCover X (FreeM X I))
      (f : C.scheme ⟶ C'.scheme),
      IsClosedImmersion f ∧ f ≫ C'.toBase = C.toBase
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : E.IsFinitePresentation :=
    IsFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation X hE.isFiniteLocallyFree
  obtain ⟨D, I, hI, φ, hφ⟩ := exists_epi_free_twist_of_finitePresentation N j E
  have hV : HasConstantRank X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (D : ℤ))) 1 :=
    hasConstantRank_pullback X j _ 1 (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.hasConstantRank_twist (k := k)
        N (D : ℤ))
  have hD := (hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hV hE).isFiniteLocallyFree
  have hB : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (FreeM X I) := by
    have h : HasConstantRank X (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I) (Nat.card I) :=
      ⟨(SheafOfModules.free.generatingSections (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I).localGeneratorsData,
        inferInstance, inferInstance, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩
    exact h.isFiniteLocallyFree
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := E14.exists_pairCover φ hB hD
  exact ⟨D, I, hI, P.toD, P.toB, P.jHom, inferInstance, P.jHom_toBase⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.commonChartIso_hom_toBase
statement:
theorem commonChartIso_hom_toBase (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    {i j : C'.I} (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (commonChartIso e C' c).hom ≫ c.chartToBase =
      (c.transport e C').chartToBase
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    c.sectionModule_free
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    c.sectionModule_finite
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    (c.transport e C').sectionModule_free
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    (c.transport e C').sectionModule_finite
  change (chartIsoOfLinearEquiv (sectionLinearEquivOfIso e c.affineOpen.1)).hom ≫
    intrinsicToSpec (R := Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1))
      (M := E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) ≫ c.affineOpen.2.isoSpec.inv =
    intrinsicToSpec (R := Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1))
      (M := E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) ≫ c.affineOpen.2.isoSpec.inv
  rw [← Category.assoc, chartIsoOfLinearEquiv_toSpec]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.commonChartIso_hom_toAmbient
statement:
theorem commonChartIso_hom_toAmbient (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    {i j : C'.I} (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (commonChartIso e C' c).hom ≫ c.chartToAmbient =
      (c.transport e C').chartToAmbient
proof:
:= by
  change (commonChartIso e C' c).hom ≫
      (c.chartToBase ≫ c.affineOpen.1.ι) =
    (c.transport e C').chartToBase ≫ c.affineOpen.1.ι
  rw [← Category.assoc, commonChartIso_hom_toBase]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.chartIso_leftRestriction
statement:
theorem chartIso_leftRestriction (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    {i j : C'.I} (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (c.transport e C').chartToLeft ≫ (chartIso e C' i).hom =
      (commonChartIso e C' c).hom ≫ c.chartToLeft
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C'.U i) (E'.val.obj (op (C'.U i))) := C'.sectionModule_free i
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C'.U i) (E'.val.obj (op (C'.U i))) := C'.sectionModule_finite i
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C'.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C'.U i))) :=
    (transport e C').sectionModule_free i
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C'.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C'.U i))) :=
    (transport e C').sectionModule_finite i
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    c.sectionModule_free
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    c.sectionModule_finite
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    (c.transport e C').sectionModule_free
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    (c.transport e C').sectionModule_finite
  let f := (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_left).op).hom
  let φ : E.val.obj (op (C'.U i)) →ₛₗ[f]
      E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1) := (c.transport e C').leftRestriction
  let φ' : E'.val.obj (op (C'.U i)) →ₛₗ[f]
      E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1) := c.leftRestriction
  let eM := sectionLinearEquivOfIso e (C'.U i)
  let eN := sectionLinearEquivOfIso e c.affineOpen.1
  have hcomm : ∀ m : E'.val.obj (op (C'.U i)),
      φ (eM.symm m) = eN.symm (φ' m) := by
    intro m
    apply eN.injective
    change (sectionLinearEquivOfIso e c.affineOpen.1)
        ((c.transport e C').leftRestriction
          ((sectionLinearEquivOfIso e (C'.U i)).symm m)) =
      (sectionLinearEquivOfIso e c.affineOpen.1)
        ((sectionLinearEquivOfIso e c.affineOpen.1).symm
          (c.leftRestriction m))
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    simpa only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using
      sectionIso_leftRestriction e C' c
        ((sectionLinearEquivOfIso e (C'.U i)).symm m)
  have h := semilinearProjMap_iso_square_auto f φ φ' eM eN
    (show Submodule.span Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (Set.range φ) = ⊤ from
      (c.transport e C').leftRestriction_spans)
    (show Submodule.span Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (Set.range φ') = ⊤ from
      c.leftRestriction_spans) hcomm
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.chartIso_rightRestriction
statement:
theorem chartIso_rightRestriction (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    {i j : C'.I} (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (c.transport e C').chartToRight ≫ (chartIso e C' j).hom =
      (commonChartIso e C' c).hom ≫ c.chartToRight
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C'.U j) (E'.val.obj (op (C'.U j))) := C'.sectionModule_free j
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C'.U j) (E'.val.obj (op (C'.U j))) := C'.sectionModule_finite j
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C'.U j) (E.val.obj (op (C'.U j))) :=
    (transport e C').sectionModule_free j
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C'.U j) (E.val.obj (op (C'.U j))) :=
    (transport e C').sectionModule_finite j
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    c.sectionModule_free
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    c.sectionModule_finite
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    (c.transport e C').sectionModule_free
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    (c.transport e C').sectionModule_finite
  let f := (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_right).op).hom
  let φ : E.val.obj (op (C'.U j)) →ₛₗ[f]
      E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1) := (c.transport e C').rightRestriction
  let φ' : E'.val.obj (op (C'.U j)) →ₛₗ[f]
      E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1) := c.rightRestriction
  let eM := sectionLinearEquivOfIso e (C'.U j)
  let eN := sectionLinearEquivOfIso e c.affineOpen.1
  have hcomm : ∀ m : E'.val.obj (op (C'.U j)),
      φ (eM.symm m) = eN.symm (φ' m) := by
    intro m
    apply eN.injective
    change (sectionLinearEquivOfIso e c.affineOpen.1)
        ((c.transport e C').rightRestriction
          ((sectionLinearEquivOfIso e (C'.U j)).symm m)) =
      (sectionLinearEquivOfIso e c.affineOpen.1)
        ((sectionLinearEquivOfIso e c.affineOpen.1).symm
          (c.rightRestriction m))
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    simpa only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using
      sectionIso_rightRestriction e C' c
        ((sectionLinearEquivOfIso e (C'.U j)).symm m)
  have h := semilinearProjMap_iso_square_auto f φ φ' eM eN
    (show Submodule.span Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (Set.range φ) = ⊤ from
      (c.transport e C').rightRestriction_spans)
    (show Submodule.span Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (Set.range φ') = ⊤ from
      c.rightRestriction_spans) hcomm
  exact h
