name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.esymm_cons_succ
statement:
theorem esymm_cons_succ (a : R) (s : Multiset R) (n : ℕ) :
    (a ::ₘ s).esymm (n + 1) = s.esymm (n + 1) + a * s.esymm n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Multiset.esymm, Multiset.powersetCard_cons, Multiset.map_add, Multiset.sum_add,
    Multiset.map_map, Function.comp_def, Multiset.prod_cons, Multiset.sum_map_mul_left]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.esymm_zero'
statement: theorem esymm_zero' (s : Multiset R) : s.esymm 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [Multiset.esymm, Multiset.powersetCard_zero_left]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.esymm_one'
statement: theorem esymm_one' (s : Multiset R) : s.esymm 1 = s.sum
proof:
:= by
  simp [Multiset.esymm, Multiset.powersetCard_one, Multiset.map_map]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.esymm_map_ringHom
statement:
theorem esymm_map_ringHom {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S) (s : Multiset R) (n : ℕ) :
    (s.map f).esymm n = f (s.esymm n)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Multiset.esymm, Multiset.powersetCard_map, Multiset.map_map, Function.comp_def,
    map_multiset_sum, map_multiset_prod]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.esymm_eq_zero_of_card_lt
statement:
theorem esymm_eq_zero_of_card_lt (s : Multiset R) {n : ℕ} (h : Multiset.card s < n) :
    s.esymm n = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [Multiset.esymm, Multiset.powersetCard_eq_empty _ h]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.coeff_prod_one_add_C_mul_X
statement:
theorem coeff_prod_one_add_C_mul_X (s : Multiset R) (n : ℕ) :
    ((s.map fun a ↦ 1 + C a * X).prod).coeff n = s.esymm n
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on generalizing n with
  | empty =>
    cases n with
    | zero => simp [esymm_zero']
    | succ n => simp [Multiset.esymm, coeff_one]
  | cons a s ih =>
    rw [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons, add_mul, one_mul, mul_assoc, coeff_add,
      coeff_C_mul]
    cases n with
    | zero => rw [coeff_X_mul_zero, mul_zero, add_zero, ih, esymm_zero', esymm_zero']
    | succ n => rw [coeff_X_mul, ih, ih, esymm_cons_succ]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.univ_val_map_cons
statement:
theorem univ_val_map_cons {α : Type*} {r : ℕ} (a : α) (f : Fin r → α) :
    Finset.univ.val.map (Fin.cons a f : Fin (r + 1) → α) = a ::ₘ Finset.univ.val.map f
proof:
:= by
  simp [Fin.univ_val_map, List.ofFn_succ]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.FlagTower.pullback_class_eq_sum
statement:
theorem pullback_class_eq_sum (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) :
    flatPullbackK0 T.q (k0ClassOf X E hE) =
      ∑ i, k0ClassOf T.Y (T.L i) (T.rankOne i).isFiniteLocallyFree
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lambdaClass_one X E hE, T.lambda_eq hE, esymm_one']
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.FlagTower.class_pullback_eq_sum
statement:
theorem class_pullback_eq_sum (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) :
    k0ClassOf T.Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback T.q).obj E)
        (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global T.q E hE) =
      ∑ i, k0ClassOf T.Y (T.L i) (T.rankOne i).isFiniteLocallyFree
proof:
:= by
  rw [← flatPullbackK0_classOf T.q E hE, T.pullback_class_eq_sum hE]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.FlagTower.prod_eq_multiset_prod
statement:
theorem prod_eq_multiset_prod (f : Fin r → K0 T.Y) :
    ∏ i, (1 + C (f i) * Polynomial.X) =
      ((Finset.univ.val.map f).map fun a ↦ 1 + C a * Polynomial.X).prod
proof:
:= by
  rw [Multiset.map_map]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.FlagTower.lambdaClass_pullback_eq_coeff
statement:
theorem lambdaClass_pullback_eq_coeff (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) (n : ℕ) :
    lambdaClass T.Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback T.q).obj E)
        (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global T.q E hE) n =
      (∏ i, (1 + C (k0ClassOf T.Y (T.L i) (T.rankOne i).isFiniteLocallyFree) *
        Polynomial.X)).coeff n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← flatPullbackK0_lambdaClass T.Y T.q E hE, T.lambda_eq hE, prod_eq_multiset_prod,
    coeff_prod_one_add_C_mul_X]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.coeff_lambdaPolynomial
statement:
theorem coeff_lambdaPolynomial (Y : Scheme.{u}) (M : Y.Modules) (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y M)
    (N n : ℕ) :
    (lambdaPolynomial Y M hM N).coeff n = if n < N + 1 then lambdaClass Y M hM n else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lambdaPolynomial, finsetSum_coeff, coeff_C_mul_X_pow]
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
  simp [Finset.mem_range]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.FlagTower.map_lambdaPolynomial
statement:
theorem map_lambdaPolynomial (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    (lambdaPolynomial X E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree r).map (flatPullbackK0RingHom T.q) =
      ∏ i, (1 + C (k0ClassOf T.Y (T.L i) (T.rankOne i).isFiniteLocallyFree) * Polynomial.X)
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [coeff_map, coeff_lambdaPolynomial, prod_eq_multiset_prod, coeff_prod_one_add_C_mul_X]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply, T.lambda_eq]
  · rw [map_zero, esymm_eq_zero_of_card_lt]
    simp only [Multiset.card_map, Finset.card_val, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    omega

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.splitting_injective
statement:
theorem splitting_injective (hinj : PBInjectiveHyp.{u}) (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    Function.Injective (flatPullbackK0 (flagTower r E hE).q)
proof:
:=
  (flagTower r E hE).injective hinj inferInstance

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.splitting_principle
statement:
theorem splitting_principle (hinj : PBInjectiveHyp.{u}) (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (q : Y ⟶ X) (_ : Flat q) (_ : IsProper q) (L : Fin r → Y.Modules)
      (hL : ∀ i, HasConstantRank Y (L i) 1),
      Function.Injective (flatPullbackK0 q) ∧
      flatPullbackK0 q (k0ClassOf X E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree) =
        ∑ i, k0ClassOf Y (L i) (hL i).isFiniteLocallyFree ∧
      ∀ n, lambdaClass Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).obj E)
          (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global q E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree) n =
        (∏ i, (1 + C (k0ClassOf Y (L i) (hL i).isFiniteLocallyFree) * Polynomial.X)).coeff n
proof:
:=
  let T := flagTower r E hE
  ⟨T.Y, T.q, inferInstance, inferInstance, T.L, T.rankOne, T.injective hinj inferInstance,
    T.pullback_class_eq_sum hE.isFiniteLocallyFree,
    T.lambdaClass_pullback_eq_coeff hE.isFiniteLocallyFree⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.isNoetherian_of_isProper
statement:
theorem isNoetherian_of_isProper {Y X : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsProper q] [IsNoetherian X] :
    IsNoetherian Y

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.splitting_principle_two
statement:
theorem splitting_principle_two {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (hinj : PBInjectiveHyp.{u})
    {E F : X.Modules} {r s : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) (hF : HasConstantRank X F s) :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (q : Y ⟶ X) (_ : Flat q) (_ : IsProper q)
      (L : Fin r → Y.Modules) (hL : ∀ i, HasConstantRank Y (L i) 1)
      (M : Fin s → Y.Modules) (hM : ∀ j, HasConstantRank Y (M j) 1),
      Function.Injective (flatPullbackK0 q) ∧
      (∀ n, flatPullbackK0 q (lambdaClass X E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree n) =
        (Finset.univ.val.map fun i ↦ k0ClassOf Y (L i) (hL i).isFiniteLocallyFree).esymm n) ∧
      (∀ n, flatPullbackK0 q (lambdaClass X F hF.isFiniteLocallyFree n) =
        (Finset.univ.val.map fun j ↦ k0ClassOf Y (M j) (hM j).isFiniteLocallyFree).esymm n)
proof:
:= by
  let T₁ := flagTower r E hE
  let T₂ := flagTower s ((Scheme.Modules.pullback T₁.q).obj F)
    (hasConstantRank_pullback T₁.Y T₁.q F s hF)
  let T := T₁.comp T₂.q fun hinj hX ↦ by
    haveI := hX
    exact T₂.injective hinj (isNoetherian_of_isProper T₁.q)
  refine ⟨T.Y, T.q, inferInstance, inferInstance, T.L, T.rankOne, T₂.L, T₂.rankOne,
    T.injective hinj inferInstance, T.lambda_eq _, fun n ↦ ?_⟩
  change flatPullbackK0 (T₂.q ≫ T₁.q) _ = _
  rw [← flatPullbackK0_comp, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, flatPullbackK0_lambdaClass]
  exact T₂.lambda_eq _ n

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pbInjectiveHyp
statement: theorem pbInjectiveHyp : PBInjectiveHyp.{u}
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ _ C hpos _ hr hE ↦ C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0_injective hpos hr hE

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.splitting_principle'
statement:
theorem splitting_principle' {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ}
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (q : Y ⟶ X) (_ : Flat q) (_ : IsProper q) (L : Fin r → Y.Modules)
      (hL : ∀ i, HasConstantRank Y (L i) 1),
      Function.Injective (flatPullbackK0 q) ∧
      flatPullbackK0 q (k0ClassOf X E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree) =
        ∑ i, k0ClassOf Y (L i) (hL i).isFiniteLocallyFree ∧
      ∀ n, lambdaClass Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).obj E)
          (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global q E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree) n =
        (∏ i, (1 + C (k0ClassOf Y (L i) (hL i).isFiniteLocallyFree) * Polynomial.X)).coeff n
proof:
:=
  splitting_principle pbInjectiveHyp hE

name: MvPolynomial.monomial_one_dvd_iff
statement:
theorem monomial_one_dvd_iff {s : σ →₀ ℕ} {x : MvPolynomial σ R} :
    monomial s 1 ∣ x ↔ ∀ t, coeff t x ≠ 0 → s ≤ t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [monomial_one_dvd_iff_modMonomial_eq_zero]
  constructor
  · intro h t ht
    by_contra hle
    apply ht
    rw [← coeff_modMonomial_of_not_le x hle, h, coeff_zero]
  · intro h
    ext t
    rw [coeff_zero]
    by_cases hle : s ≤ t
    · exact coeff_modMonomial_of_le x hle
    · rw [coeff_modMonomial_of_not_le x hle]
      by_contra hc
      exact hle (h t hc)

name: MvPolynomial.X_pow_dvd_of_dvd_mul_X_pow
statement:
theorem X_pow_dvd_of_dvd_mul_X_pow {i j : σ} (hij : i ≠ j) (r m : ℕ) {a : MvPolynomial σ R}
    (h : X i ^ r ∣ a * X j ^ m) : X i ^ r ∣ a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [X_pow_eq_monomial] at h ⊢
  rw [monomial_one_dvd_iff] at h ⊢
  intro t ht
  have hcoeff : coeff (t + Finsupp.single j m) (a * monomial (Finsupp.single j m) (1 : R)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [coeff_mul_monomial, mul_one]
    exact ht
  have hle := h _ hcoeff
  rw [Finsupp.single_le_iff] at hle ⊢
  simpa [Finsupp.single_apply, Ne.symm hij] using hle

name: MvPolynomial.X_mem_nonZeroDivisors
statement:
theorem X_mem_nonZeroDivisors (i : σ) :
    (X i : MvPolynomial σ R) ∈ nonZeroDivisors (MvPolynomial σ R)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ p : MvPolynomial σ R, p * X i = 0 → p = 0 := by
    intro p hp
    ext m
    have hm := congrArg (coeff (m + Finsupp.single i 1)) hp
    rwa [coeff_mul_X, coeff_zero] at hm
  rw [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff]
  exact ⟨fun x hx => key x (by rwa [mul_comm] at hx), key⟩

name: MvPolynomial.X_pow_mem_nonZeroDivisors
statement:
theorem X_pow_mem_nonZeroDivisors (i : σ) (r : ℕ) :
    (X i ^ r : MvPolynomial σ R) ∈ nonZeroDivisors (MvPolynomial σ R)
proof:
:=
  pow_mem (X_mem_nonZeroDivisors i) r

name: MvPolynomial.powers_X_le_nonZeroDivisors
statement:
theorem powers_X_le_nonZeroDivisors (i : σ) :
    Submonoid.powers (X i : MvPolynomial σ R) ≤ nonZeroDivisors (MvPolynomial σ R)
proof:
:=
  Submonoid.powers_le.mpr (X_mem_nonZeroDivisors i)

name: MvPolynomial.X_mul_X_mem_nonZeroDivisors
statement:
theorem X_mul_X_mem_nonZeroDivisors (i j : σ) :
    (X i * X j : MvPolynomial σ R) ∈ nonZeroDivisors (MvPolynomial σ R)
proof:
:=
  mul_mem (X_mem_nonZeroDivisors i) (X_mem_nonZeroDivisors j)

name: MvPolynomial.X_pow_mul_X_pow_mem_nonZeroDivisors
statement:
theorem X_pow_mul_X_pow_mem_nonZeroDivisors (i j : σ) (r m : ℕ) :
    (X i ^ r * X j ^ m : MvPolynomial σ R) ∈ nonZeroDivisors (MvPolynomial σ R)
proof:
:=
  mul_mem (pow_mem (X_mem_nonZeroDivisors i) r) (pow_mem (X_mem_nonZeroDivisors j) m)

name: MvPolynomial.prod_X_mem_nonZeroDivisors
statement:
theorem prod_X_mem_nonZeroDivisors {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → σ) :
    (∏ t ∈ s, X (f t) : MvPolynomial σ R) ∈ nonZeroDivisors (MvPolynomial σ R)
proof:
:=
  prod_mem fun t _ => X_mem_nonZeroDivisors (f t)

name: MvPolynomial.powers_X_mul_X_le_nonZeroDivisors
statement:
theorem powers_X_mul_X_le_nonZeroDivisors (i j : σ) :
    Submonoid.powers (X i * X j : MvPolynomial σ R) ≤ nonZeroDivisors (MvPolynomial σ R)
proof:
:=
  Submonoid.powers_le.mpr (X_mul_X_mem_nonZeroDivisors i j)

name: CharacteristicClasses.coeff_chLine

name: CharacteristicClasses.constantCoeff_chRoot

theorem constantCoeff_toddRoot (a : A) :

name: CharacteristicClasses.chRoot_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chRoot_zero : chRoot A 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_one, coeff_chRoot]
  rcases n with (_ | n)
  · simp
  · simp [pow_succ]

name: CharacteristicClasses.toddRoot_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toddRoot_zero : toddRoot A 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_one, coeff_toddRoot]
  rcases n with (_ | n)
  · simp [bernoulli'_zero]
  · simp [pow_succ]

name: CharacteristicClasses.chRoot_neg_mul
statement:
theorem chRoot_neg_mul (a : A) :
    chRoot A (-a) * chRoot A a = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [chRoot_add, neg_add_cancel, chRoot_zero]

name: CharacteristicClasses.chRoot_mul_neg
statement:
theorem chRoot_mul_neg (a : A) :
    chRoot A a * chRoot A (-a) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [chRoot_add, add_neg_cancel, chRoot_zero]

name: CharacteristicClasses.toddLine_mul_exp_sub_one
statement:
theorem toddLine_mul_exp_sub_one :
    toddLine A * (chLine A - 1) = PowerSeries.X * chLine A
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [toddLine, chLine] using bernoulli'PowerSeries_mul_exp_sub_one A

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E19.kernel_ι_comp_eq_zero_of_local
statement:
theorem kernel_ι_comp_eq_zero_of_local (u : A ⟶ C) (v : A ⟶ Q) {I : Type u} (U : I → W.Opens)
    (hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology W).CoversTop U)
    (w : ∀ i, Q.over (U i) ⟶ C.over (U i))
    (h : ∀ i, u.over (U i) = v.over (U i) ≫ w i) : kernel.ι v ≫ u = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext_of_over_coversTop W U hU
  intro i
  have h1 : (kernel.ι v ≫ u).over (U i) = (kernel.ι v).over (U i) ≫ u.over (U i) :=
    Functor.map_comp (SheafOfModules.overFunctor _ (U i)) _ _
  have h2 : (kernel.ι v ≫ v).over (U i) = (kernel.ι v).over (U i) ≫ v.over (U i) :=
    Functor.map_comp (SheafOfModules.overFunctor _ (U i)) _ _
  rw [h1, h i, ← Category.assoc, ← h2, kernel.condition]
  change SheafOfModules.Hom.over (0 : kernel v ⟶ Q) (U i) ≫ w i = SheafOfModules.Hom.over 0 (U i)
  have hz : ∀ {M N : W.Modules}, SheafOfModules.Hom.over (0 : M ⟶ N) (U i) = 0 :=
    fun {M N} => Functor.map_zero (SheafOfModules.overFunctor _ (U i)) M N
  rw [hz, zero_comp]
  exact (hz (M := kernel v) (N := C)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E19.kernelSubobject_le_of_local
statement:
theorem kernelSubobject_le_of_local (u : A ⟶ C) (v : A ⟶ Q) {I : Type u} (U : I → W.Opens)
    (hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology W).CoversTop U)
    (w : ∀ i, Q.over (U i) ⟶ C.over (U i))
    (h : ∀ i, u.over (U i) = v.over (U i) ≫ w i) :
    kernelSubobject v ≤ kernelSubobject u
proof:
:= by
  have := kernel_ι_comp_eq_zero_of_local u v U hU w h
  refine le_kernelSubobject u _ ?_
  rw [← kernelSubobject_arrow, Category.assoc, this, comp_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E19.ker_le_of_localGate
statement:
theorem ker_le_of_localGate (h : LocalGate P) :
    kernelSubobject (E18.vMap P.toD b) ≤
      kernelSubobject (E18.uMap P.toB P.toD P.jHom P.jHom_toBase)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, U, hU, w, hw⟩ := h
  exact kernelSubobject_le_of_local _ _ U hU w hw

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E19.twistIso_of_localGate
statement:
theorem twistIso_of_localGate (h : LocalGate P) :
    Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P.jHom).obj (P.toB.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) ≅
      P.toD.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
proof:
:=
  E18.twistIso_of_kernel_le P.toB P.toD P.jHom P.jHom_toBase b (ker_le_of_localGate P h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.exists_generator
statement:
theorem exists_generator {B : Type*} [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] (Q : Ideal B[X]) [hQ : Q.IsPrime]
    (hQ0 : Q.comap (C : B →+* B[X]) = ⊥) (hQne : Q ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ F : B[X], F ≠ 0 ∧ F ∈ Q ∧ ∀ Q' : Ideal B[X], Q'.IsPrime →
      Q'.comap (C : B →+* B[X]) = ⊥ → F ∈ Q' → Q' = Q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let M : Submonoid B[X] := (nonZeroDivisors B).map C
  have hdisj : ∀ P : Ideal B[X], P.comap (C : B →+* B[X]) = ⊥ → Disjoint (M : Set B[X]) P := by
    intro P hP
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro _ ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ hmem
    have h1 : b ∈ P.comap (C : B →+* B[X]) := hmem
    rw [hP, Ideal.mem_bot] at h1
    exact zero_notMem_nonZeroDivisors (h1 ▸ hb)
  have hprime : ∀ P : Ideal B[X], P.IsPrime → P.comap (C : B →+* B[X]) = ⊥ →
      (P.map (algebraMap B[X] (FractionRing B)[X])).IsPrime := fun P hP h0 ↦
    IsLocalization.isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint M (FractionRing B)[X] P hP (hdisj P h0)
  have hunder : ∀ P : Ideal B[X], P.IsPrime → P.comap (C : B →+* B[X]) = ⊥ →
      (P.map (algebraMap B[X] (FractionRing B)[X])).under B[X] = P := fun P hP h0 ↦
    IsLocalization.under_map_of_isPrime_disjoint M (FractionRing B)[X] hP (hdisj P h0)
  set QK := Q.map (algebraMap B[X] (FractionRing B)[X]) with hQK
  haveI hQKp : QK.IsPrime := hprime Q hQ hQ0
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap B[X] (FractionRing B)[X]) :=
    Polynomial.map_injective _ (IsFractionRing.injective B (FractionRing B))
  have hQKne : QK ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro h
    apply hQne
    rw [eq_bot_iff]
    intro x hx
    have : algebraMap B[X] (FractionRing B)[X] x ∈ QK := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hx
    rw [h, Ideal.mem_bot, map_eq_zero_iff _ hinj] at this
    rw [this]; exact zero_mem _
  have hQKmax : QK.IsMaximal := Ideal.IsPrime.isMaximal hQKp hQKne
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := (IsPrincipalIdealRing.principal QK).principal
  have hg0 : g ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hQKne (by rw [hg]; simp)
  obtain ⟨⟨F, m⟩, hFm⟩ := IsLocalization.surj M g
  have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap B[X] (FractionRing B)[X] (m : B[X])) := IsLocalization.map_units _ m
  refine ⟨F, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h0
    rw [h0, map_zero] at hFm
    exact hg0 ((mul_eq_zero.mp hFm).resolve_right hu.ne_zero)
  · have h1 : algebraMap B[X] (FractionRing B)[X] F ∈ QK := by
      rw [← hFm, hg]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self g)
    have h2 : F ∈ QK.under B[X] := h1
    rwa [hunder Q hQ hQ0] at h2
  · intro Q' hQ' hQ'0 hF
    haveI := hprime Q' hQ' hQ'0
    have h1 : algebraMap B[X] (FractionRing B)[X] F ∈ Q'.map (algebraMap B[X] (FractionRing B)[X]) :=
      Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hF
    rw [← hFm] at h1
    have h2 : g ∈ Q'.map (algebraMap B[X] (FractionRing B)[X]) :=
      (Ideal.mul_unit_mem_iff_mem _ hu).mp h1
    have h3 : QK ≤ Q'.map (algebraMap B[X] (FractionRing B)[X]) := by
      rw [hg, Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]; exact h2
    have h4 : QK = Q'.map (algebraMap B[X] (FractionRing B)[X]) :=
      hQKmax.eq_of_le (Ideal.IsPrime.ne_top inferInstance) h3
    rw [← hunder Q' hQ' hQ'0, ← h4, hunder Q hQ hQ0]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.eq_extended_of_coeff_ne_zero
statement:
theorem eq_extended_of_coeff_ne_zero (x : Spec (CommRingCat.of A[X]))
    (hx : flatPullbackCoeff (linePi A) x ≠ 0) :
    x.asIdeal = (PrimeSpectrum.comap (C : A →+* A[X]) x).asIdeal.map (C : A →+* A[X])
proof:
:= by
  set f := linePi A with hfdef
  let P : PrimeSpectrum A := PrimeSpectrum.comap (C : A →+* A[X]) x
  haveI : P.asIdeal.IsPrime := P.isPrime
  haveI hPprime : (P.asIdeal.map (C : A →+* A[X])).IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_map_C_of_isPrime
  let Q0 : PrimeSpectrum A[X] := ⟨P.asIdeal.map (C : A →+* A[X]), hPprime⟩
  have hQ0le : Q0 ≤ x := by
    change P.asIdeal.map (C : A →+* A[X]) ≤ x.asIdeal
    rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    exact le_rfl
  have hcomapQ0 : PrimeSpectrum.comap (C : A →+* A[X]) Q0 = P := by
    ext a
    change C a ∈ P.asIdeal.map (C : A →+* A[X]) ↔ a ∈ P.asIdeal
    rw [Ideal.mem_map_C_iff]
    constructor
    · intro h
      simpa using h 0
    · intro h m
      rw [Polynomial.coeff_C]
      split_ifs
      · exact h
      · exact zero_mem _
  by_contra hne
  apply hx
  exact m6pb_coeff_eq_zero_of_specializes f
    ((PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes Q0 x).mp hQ0le) (fun h ↦ hne (by rw [← h, hcomapQ0])) hcomapQ0

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.pureRelDim_linePi
statement: theorem pureRelDim_linePi [IsNoetherianRing A] : PureRelDim (linePi A) 1
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq
  have hQ := eq_extended_of_coeff_ne_zero q hq
  set P : PrimeSpectrum A := PrimeSpectrum.comap (C : A →+* A[X]) q with hP
  rw [m6pb_height_spec, m6pb_height_spec]
  have h1 := SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.PrimeSpectrum.coheight_eq_ringKrullDim_quotient q
  have h2 := SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.PrimeSpectrum.coheight_eq_ringKrullDim_quotient P
  have h3 : ringKrullDim (A[X] ⧸ q.asIdeal) = ringKrullDim (A ⧸ P.asIdeal) + 1 := by
    rw [hQ]
    exact (ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv
      (Ideal.polynomialQuotientEquivQuotientPolynomial P.asIdeal)).symm.trans
      Polynomial.ringKrullDim_of_isNoetherianRing
  rw [h3, ← h2] at h1
  have e : (linePi A) q = P := rfl
  rw [e]
  exact_mod_cast h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.ord_algebraMap_of_isUnit
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Ring.KrullDimLE 1 (X.presheaf.stalk z) := krullDimLE_of_coheight hz
  rw [Scheme.ord_eq_ordHom_of_coheight_eq_one hz]
  unfold Scheme.ordHom
  have h0 : x ≠ 0 := hxu.ne_zero
  rw [Ring.ordFrac_eq_ord (X.presheaf.stalk z) h0]
  have hnz : x ∈ nonZeroDivisors (X.presheaf.stalk z) := mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero h0
  rw [Ring.ordMonoidWithZeroHom_eq_ord hnz, Ring.ord_of_isUnit hxu]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.ord_algebraMap_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Ring.KrullDimLE 1 (X.presheaf.stalk z) := krullDimLE_of_coheight hz
  rw [Scheme.ord_eq_ordHom_of_coheight_eq_one hz]
  unfold Scheme.ordHom
  rw [Ring.ordFrac_eq_ord (X.presheaf.stalk z) hx0]
  have hnz : x ∈ nonZeroDivisors (X.presheaf.stalk z) := mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hx0
  rw [Ring.ordMonoidWithZeroHom_eq_ord hnz]
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp (Ring.ord_ne_top hnz)
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    apply hxnu
    have h1 : Ring.ord (X.presheaf.stalk z) x = 0 := by rw [← hn]; rfl
    rw [Ring.ord, Module.length_eq_zero_iff] at h1
    have h2 : Ideal.span {x} = ⊤ := by
      rw [← Ideal.Quotient.subsingleton_iff]; exact h1
    rwa [Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top] at h2
  rw [← hn]
  simp only [ENat.recTopCoe_coe, WithZero.recZeroCoe_coe, id_eq]
  simpa using hn0

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.specFun_eq
statement:
theorem specFun_eq (F : S) (y : Spec (CommRingCat.of S)) :
    specFun S F = algebraMap ((Spec (CommRingCat.of S)).presheaf.stalk y)
      (Spec (CommRingCat.of S)).functionField
      ((Spec (CommRingCat.of S)).presheaf.germ ⊤ y trivial
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of S)).inv F))
proof:
:= by
  unfold specFun
  rw [Scheme.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.isUnit_germ_iff
statement:
theorem isUnit_germ_iff (F : S) (y : Spec (CommRingCat.of S)) :
    IsUnit ((Spec (CommRingCat.of S)).presheaf.germ ⊤ y trivial
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of S)).inv F)) ↔ F ∉ y.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Scheme.mem_basicOpen_top, basicOpen_eq_of_affine]
  exact PrimeSpectrum.mem_basicOpen (R := S) F y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.ord_specFun_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem ord_specFun_of_not_mem (F : S) {y : Spec (CommRingCat.of S)} (hy : coheight y = 1)
    (hF : F ∉ y.asIdeal) : Scheme.ord (specFun S F) y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [specFun_eq F y]
  exact ord_algebraMap_of_isUnit hy ((isUnit_germ_iff F y).mpr hF)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.gammaInv_ne_zero
statement:
theorem gammaInv_ne_zero {F : S} (hF0 : F ≠ 0) :
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of S)).inv F ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply hF0
  have := congrArg (ConcreteCategory.hom (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of S)).hom) h
  simpa using this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.ord_specFun_ne_zero
statement:
theorem ord_specFun_ne_zero {F : S} (hF0 : F ≠ 0) {y : Spec (CommRingCat.of S)}
    (hy : coheight y = 1) (hF : F ∈ y.asIdeal) : Scheme.ord (specFun S F) y ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [specFun_eq F y]
  refine ord_algebraMap_ne_zero hy ?_ (fun h ↦ ((isUnit_germ_iff F y).mp h) hF)
  intro h0
  have := germ_injective_of_isIntegral (X := Spec (CommRingCat.of S)) (U := ⊤) y trivial
    (h0.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  exact gammaInv_ne_zero hF0 this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.specFun_ne_zero
statement: theorem specFun_ne_zero {F : S} (hF0 : F ≠ 0) : specFun S F ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := Scheme.germToFunctionField_injective (Spec (CommRingCat.of S)) ⊤
    (h.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  exact gammaInv_ne_zero hF0 this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.coheight_spec
statement:
theorem coheight_spec (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (q : Spec R) :
    coheight q = Order.height (α := PrimeSpectrum R) q
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Order.coheight_orderIso (specOrderIsoPrimeSpectrum R) q]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.coheight_spec_eq
statement:
theorem coheight_spec_eq (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (q : Spec R) :
    coheight q = ((q.asIdeal.height : ℕ∞))
proof:
:= by
  rw [coheight_spec, ← PrimeSpectrum.height_eq_orderHeight]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.height_eq_one_of_gen
statement:
theorem height_eq_one_of_gen {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [IsNoetherianRing B]
    (Q : Ideal B[X]) [hQ : Q.IsPrime] (hQ0 : Q.comap (C : B →+* B[X]) = ⊥) (hQne : Q ≠ ⊥)
    (F : B[X]) (hFQ : F ∈ Q)
    (hF : ∀ Q' : Ideal B[X], Q'.IsPrime → Q'.comap (C : B →+* B[X]) = ⊥ → F ∈ Q' → Q' = Q) :
    Q.height = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hmin : Q ∈ (Ideal.span {F}).minimalPrimes := by
    refine ⟨⟨hQ, (Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem Q).mpr hFQ⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro Q' ⟨hQ', hFQ'⟩ hle
    have hF' : F ∈ Q' := (Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem Q').mp hFQ'
    have hc : Q'.comap (C : B →+* B[X]) = ⊥ := by
      rw [eq_bot_iff, ← hQ0]
      exact Ideal.comap_mono hle
    exact (hF Q' hQ' hc hF').symm.le
  have h1 := Ideal.height_le_one_of_isPrincipal_of_mem_minimalPrimes _ Q hmin
  have h2 : Q.height ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hQne (Ideal.height_eq_zero_iff_eq_bot.mp h)
  exact le_antisymm h1 (Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr h2)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.exists_closedPoint_generator
statement:
theorem exists_closedPoint_generator
    (hW : DimensionCatenary (Spec (CommRingCat.of A[X]))) {n : ℕ}
    (ξ0 v0 : Spec (CommRingCat.of A[X]))
    (hcξ : flatPullbackCoeff (linePi A) ξ0 ≠ 0) (hπ : linePi A ξ0 = linePi A v0)
    (hsp : ξ0 ⤳ v0) (hne : ξ0 ≠ v0) (hv : height v0 = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ g : DimRelationGenerator (Spec (CommRingCat.of A[X])) (n + 1),
      f17η g = ξ0 ∧ height ξ0 = ((n + 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ∧ g.cycle.1 v0 ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ x, x ≠ v0 → g.cycle.1 x ≠ 0 → ξ0 ⤳ x ∧ linePi A x ≠ linePi A v0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set q : PrimeSpectrum A := PrimeSpectrum.comap (C : A →+* A[X]) ξ0 with hq
  haveI hqp : q.asIdeal.IsPrime := q.isPrime
  have hξ := eq_extended_of_coeff_ne_zero ξ0 hcξ
  have hv0q : PrimeSpectrum.comap (C : A →+* A[X]) v0 = q := hπ.symm
  let φ : A[X] →+* (A ⧸ q.asIdeal)[X] := Polynomial.mapRingHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk q.asIdeal)
  have hφs : Function.Surjective φ := Polynomial.map_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hker : RingHom.ker φ = ξ0.asIdeal := by
    rw [Polynomial.ker_mapRingHom, Ideal.mk_ker]
    exact hξ.symm
  have hle : ξ0.asIdeal ≤ v0.asIdeal := (PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes ξ0 v0).mpr hsp
  have hne' : v0.asIdeal ≠ ξ0.asIdeal := fun h ↦ hne (PrimeSpectrum.ext h.symm)
  haveI : IsDomain (A ⧸ q.asIdeal) := Ideal.Quotient.isDomain q.asIdeal
  haveI : v0.asIdeal.IsPrime := v0.isPrime
  set Qb : Ideal (A ⧸ q.asIdeal)[X] := v0.asIdeal.map φ with hQb
  haveI hQbp : Qb.IsPrime :=
    Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective hφs (by rw [hker]; exact hle)
  have hcomap : Qb.comap φ = v0.asIdeal := by
    rw [hQb, Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective φ hφs, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, hker]
    exact sup_eq_left.mpr hle
  have hQ0 : Qb.comap (C : (A ⧸ q.asIdeal) →+* (A ⧸ q.asIdeal)[X]) = ⊥ := by
    ext b
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective b
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.mem_bot, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    have h1 : (C (Ideal.Quotient.mk q.asIdeal a) : (A ⧸ q.asIdeal)[X]) = φ (C a) := by
      simp [φ]
    rw [h1, ← Ideal.mem_comap, hcomap]
    have h2 : a ∈ q.asIdeal ↔ C a ∈ v0.asIdeal := by
      have := congrArg (fun J : PrimeSpectrum A ↦ a ∈ J.asIdeal) hv0q
      simpa using this.symm
    exact h2.symm
  have hQne : Qb ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro h
    apply hne'
    rw [← hcomap, h, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, hker]
  obtain ⟨F, hF0, hFQ, hFuniq⟩ := exists_generator Qb hQ0 hQne
  have hht : Qb.height = 1 := height_eq_one_of_gen Qb hQ0 hQne F hFQ hFuniq
  let Y : Scheme.{u} := Spec (CommRingCat.of (A ⧸ q.asIdeal)[X])
  let ι : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A[X]) := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion ι := IsClosedImmersion.spec_of_surjective _ hφs
  let y0 : Y := (⟨Qb, hQbp⟩ : PrimeSpectrum (A ⧸ q.asIdeal)[X])
  have hιy : ∀ y : Y, ι y = PrimeSpectrum.comap φ y := fun _ ↦ rfl
  have hιy0 : ι y0 = v0 := PrimeSpectrum.ext hcomap
  have hcoh0 : coheight y0 = 1 := by
    rw [coheight_spec_eq]; exact hht
  have hgen : ι (genericPoint Y) = ξ0 := by
    rw [genericPoint_eq_bot_of_affine, hιy]
    apply PrimeSpectrum.ext
    change Ideal.comap φ ⊥ = ξ0.asIdeal
    rw [← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, hker]
  have hheight : height ξ0 = ((n + 1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
    have h := hW Y ι y0 hcoh0
    rw [hιy0, hgen, hv] at h
    rw [← h]; push_cast; rfl
  have hdim : ∀ y : Y, coheight y = 1 → height (ι y) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
    intro y hy
    have h := hW Y ι y hy
    rw [hgen, hheight] at h
    push_cast at h ⊢
    exact ENat_add_one_cancel h
  let g : DimRelationGenerator (Spec (CommRingCat.of A[X])) (n + 1) :=
    { Y := Y, i := ι, f := specFun _ F, hf := specFun_ne_zero hF0, dimension := hdim }
  have hval : ∀ y : Y, g.cycle.1 (ι y) = Scheme.ord (specFun _ F) y := by
    intro y
    change properPushforward ι (div (specFun _ F)) (ι y) = _
    unfold properPushforward
    exact pushforward_apply_closedImmersion ι _ (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) y
  have hFy0 : F ∈ y0.asIdeal := hFQ
  refine ⟨g, hgen, hheight, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hιy0, hval]
    exact ord_specFun_ne_zero hF0 hcoh0 hFy0
  · intro x hxv hcx
    have hx : x ∈ (properPushforward ι (div (specFun _ F))).support := hcx
    rw [properPushforward, pushforward_support_closedImmersion ι (div (specFun _ F))
      (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl)] at hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hx
    have hcy : coheight y = 1 := div_support hy
    have hordy : Scheme.ord (specFun _ F) y ≠ 0 := hy
    have hyy0 : y ≠ y0 := by
      rintro rfl
      exact hxv hιy0
    have hFy : F ∈ y.asIdeal := by
      by_contra hFn
      exact hordy (ord_specFun_of_not_mem F hcy hFn)
    refine ⟨?_, fun hπy ↦ hyy0 ?_⟩
    · rw [← hgen]
      exact ((f17_genericPoint_specializes Y y).map ι.continuous)
    · 
      have e : φ.comp (C : A →+* A[X]) =
          (C : (A ⧸ q.asIdeal) →+* (A ⧸ q.asIdeal)[X]).comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk q.asIdeal) := by
        ext a <;> simp [φ]
      have h1 : Ideal.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk q.asIdeal)
          (Ideal.comap (C : (A ⧸ q.asIdeal) →+* (A ⧸ q.asIdeal)[X]) y.asIdeal) = q.asIdeal := by
        rw [Ideal.comap_comap, ← e, ← Ideal.comap_comap]
        have := congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal hπy
        change Ideal.comap (C : A →+* A[X]) (Ideal.comap φ y.asIdeal) =
          Ideal.comap (C : A →+* A[X]) v0.asIdeal at this
        rw [Ideal.comap_comap] at this ⊢
        rw [this]
        exact congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal hv0q
      have h2 : Ideal.comap (C : (A ⧸ q.asIdeal) →+* (A ⧸ q.asIdeal)[X]) y.asIdeal = ⊥ := by
        apply Ideal.comap_injective_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
        rw [h1, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, Ideal.mk_ker]
      exact PrimeSpectrum.ext (hFuniq y.asIdeal y.isPrime h2 hFy)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.affineScalarRingMap_spec
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem affineScalarRingMap_spec {K : Type u} [CommRing K] {Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (b : Z ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (V : Z.affineOpens) :
    (V : Scheme).isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (affineScalarRingMap b V)) =
      V.1.ι ≫ b
proof:
:= by
  change (V : Scheme).isoSpec.hom ≫
    Spec.map ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of K)).inv ≫ (V.1.ι ≫ b).appTop) = _
  rw [Spec.map_comp, ← Category.assoc, Scheme.isoSpec_hom_naturality]
  simp [Scheme.isoSpec_Spec_hom]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.isPullback_affineScalarChart
statement:
theorem isPullback_affineScalarChart
    {K L : Type u} [CommRing K] [CommRing L] [Algebra K L]
    {P Z : Scheme.{u}} {m : P ⟶ Z} {a : P ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
    {b : Z ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
    (h : IsPullback m a b (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))))
    (V : Z.affineOpens) :
    IsPullback ((m ∣_ V.1) ≫ (V : Scheme).isoSpec.hom)
      ((m ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι ≫ a)
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (affineScalarRingMap b V)))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))
proof:
:= by
  exact ((isPullback_morphismRestrict m V.1).paste_vert h).of_iso
    (Iso.refl _) (V : Scheme).isoSpec (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _)
    (by simp) (by simp) (by simpa using (affineScalarRingMap_spec b V).symm) (by simp)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.affineScalarChartIso_hom_includeRight
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem affineScalarChartIso_hom_includeRight
    {K L : Type u} [CommRing K] [CommRing L] [Algebra K L]
    {P Z : Scheme.{u}} {m : P ⟶ Z} {a : P ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
    {b : Z ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}
    (h : IsPullback m a b (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))))
    (V : Z.affineOpens) :
    letI _algKA : Algebra K Γ(V, ⊤)
proof:
:= (affineScalarRingMap b V).toAlgebra
    (affineScalarChartIso h V).hom ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := K) (A := L) (B := Γ(V, ⊤))).toRingHom) =
      (m ∣_ V.1) ≫ (V : Scheme).isoSpec.hom := by
  letI _algKA : Algebra K Γ(V, ⊤) := (affineScalarRingMap b V).toAlgebra
  change ((isPullback_affineScalarChart h V).flip.isoPullback.hom ≫
    (pullbackSpecIso K L Γ(V, ⊤)).hom) ≫ _ = _
  rw [Category.assoc]
  exact (congrArg (fun k ↦ (isPullback_affineScalarChart h V).flip.isoPullback.hom ≫ k)
    (pullbackSpecIso_hom_snd K L Γ(V, ⊤))).trans
      (isPullback_affineScalarChart h V).flip.isoPullback_hom_snd

statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem affineScalarChartIso_hom_includeLeft

      (m ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι ≫ a := by
  letI _algKA : Algebra K Γ(V, ⊤) := (affineScalarRingMap b V).toAlgebra
  change ((isPullback_affineScalarChart h V).flip.isoPullback.hom ≫
    (pullbackSpecIso K L Γ(V, ⊤)).hom) ≫ _ = _

statement:
theorem affineScalarChartIso_includeRight_apply
    {K L : Type u} [CommRing K] [CommRing L] [Algebra K L]
    {P Z : Scheme.{u}} {m : P ⟶ Z} {a : P ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.fibre_generization_eq_of_coeff
statement:
theorem fibre_generization_eq_of_coeff
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (y : Y) (z : f.fiber y)
    (hc : AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.flatPullbackCoeff f (f.fiberι y z) ≠ 0)
    {z' : f.fiber y} (hz : z' ⤳ z) : z' = z
proof:
:= by
  apply (f.fiberι y).isEmbedding.injective
  by_contra hne
  apply hc
  apply AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_coeff_eq_zero_of_specializes f
    (hz.map (f.fiberι y).continuous) hne
  exact (show f (f.fiberι y z') = y from (f.fiberHomeo y z').property).trans
    (show f (f.fiberι y z) = y from (f.fiberHomeo y z).property).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.fibre_affineChart_minimalPrime_of_coeff
statement:
theorem fibre_affineChart_minimalPrime_of_coeff
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (y : Y)
    (U : (f.fiber y).Opens) {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    (e : (U : Scheme) ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) (z : (U : Scheme))
    (hc : AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.flatPullbackCoeff f (f.fiberι y (U.ι z)) ≠ 0) :
    (e.hom z).asIdeal ∈ minimalPrimes A
proof:
:= by
  apply PrimeSpectrum.isMin_iff.mp
  intro p hp
  have hs : p ⤳ e.hom z := (PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes _ _).mp hp
  have he : e.inv (e.hom z) = z := by
    simp [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  have hu : U.ι (e.inv p) = U.ι z :=
    fibre_generization_eq_of_coeff f y (U.ι z) hc
      (by simpa only [he] using (hs.map e.inv.continuous).map U.ι.continuous)
  have hz : e.inv p = z := U.ι.isEmbedding.injective hu
  have hq : p = e.hom z := by
    have h := congrArg e.hom hz
    simpa [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using h
  exact hq.ge

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.fibre_coeff_ne_zero_iff_generization_max
statement:
theorem fibre_coeff_ne_zero_iff_generization_max
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (f : X ⟶ Y) (y : Y) (z : f.fiber y) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.flatPullbackCoeff f (f.fiberι y z) ≠ 0 ↔
      ∀ z' : f.fiber y, z' ⤳ z → z' = z
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hc z' hz
    exact fibre_generization_eq_of_coeff f y z hc hz
  · intro hmax
    apply AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_coeff_ne_zero_of_max f (f.fiberι y z)
    intro x hx hfx
    have hxy : f x = y := hfx.trans (f.fiberHomeo y z).property
    let z' : f.fiber y := (f.fiberHomeo y).symm ⟨x, hxy⟩
    have he : f.fiberι y z' = x := f.fiberι_fiberHomeo_symm y ⟨x, hxy⟩
    have hs : z' ⤳ z := (f.fiberι y).isEmbedding.isInducing.specializes_iff.mp
      (by rw [he]; exact hx)
    exact he.symm.trans (congrArg (f.fiberι y) (hmax z' hs))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.fibre_coeff_ne_zero_of_affineChart_minimalPrime
statement:
theorem fibre_coeff_ne_zero_of_affineChart_minimalPrime
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (f : X ⟶ Y) (y : Y)
    (U : (f.fiber y).Opens) {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    (e : (U : Scheme) ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) (z : (U : Scheme))
    (hq : (e.hom z).asIdeal ∈ minimalPrimes A) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.flatPullbackCoeff f (f.fiberι y (U.ι z)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (fibre_coeff_ne_zero_iff_generization_max f y (U.ι z)).mpr
  intro z' hz
  have hm : z' ∈ U := hz.mem_open U.2 z.2
  let zU : (U : Scheme) := ⟨z', hm⟩
  have hu : U.ι zU = z' := rfl
  have hs : zU ⤳ z := U.ι.isEmbedding.isInducing.specializes_iff.mp
    (by rw [hu]; exact hz)
  let p : PrimeSpectrum A := e.hom zU
  let q : PrimeSpectrum A := e.hom z
  have hp : p ≤ q := (PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes p q).mpr
    (hs.map e.hom.continuous)
  have hmin : IsMin q := PrimeSpectrum.isMin_iff.mpr hq
  have he : p = q := le_antisymm hp (hmin hp)
  have hzU : zU = z := e.hom.isEmbedding.injective he
  exact hu.symm.trans (congrArg U.ι hzU)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackProjectiveFiberTensorChart_minimalPrime
statement:
theorem pullbackProjectiveFiberTensorChart_minimalPrime (t : C.scheme)
    (V : (g.fiber (C.toBase t)).affineOpens) :
    let K : Type u
proof:
:= Y.residueField (C.toBase t)
    let L : Type u := C.scheme.residueField t
    letI _ringK : CommRing K := inferInstance
    letI _ringL : CommRing L := inferInstance
    letI _algKL : Algebra K L := (C.toBase.residueFieldMap t).hom.toAlgebra
    letI _algKA : Algebra K Γ(V, ⊤) :=
      (affineScalarRingMap (g.fiberToSpecResidueField (C.toBase t)) V).toAlgebra
    ∀ z : (C.pullbackProjectiveFiberMap g t ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 : Scheme),
      AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.flatPullbackCoeff (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g)
        ((C.pullbackProjectiveMap g).fiberι t
          ((C.pullbackProjectiveFiberMap g t ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι z)) ≠ 0 →
      ((C.pullbackProjectiveFiberTensorChartIso g t V).hom z).asIdeal ∈
        minimalPrimes (L ⊗[K] Γ(V, ⊤)) := by
  intro K L z hc
  exact fibre_affineChart_minimalPrime_of_coeff (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) t
    (C.pullbackProjectiveFiberMap g t ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)
    (C.pullbackProjectiveFiberTensorChartIso g t V) z hc

proof:
:= Y.residueField (C.toBase t)

    letI _algKL : Algebra K L := (C.toBase.residueFieldMap t).hom.toAlgebra
    letI _algKA : Algebra K Γ(V, ⊤) :=
      (affineScalarRingMap (g.fiberToSpecResidueField (C.toBase t)) V).toAlgebra
    (C.pullbackProjectiveFiberTensorChartIso g t V).hom ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := K) (A := L) (B := Γ(V, ⊤))).toRingHom) =
      (C.pullbackProjectiveFiberMap g t ∣_ V.1) ≫ (V : Scheme).isoSpec.hom := by

  letI ringK : CommRing K := inferInstance

  have h : IsPullback (C.pullbackProjectiveFiberMap g t)
    ((C.pullbackProjectiveMap g).fiberToSpecResidueField t)
    (g.fiberToSpecResidueField (C.toBase t))
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) :=

statement:

        ((C.pullbackProjectiveFiberMap g t ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι z)) ≠ 0) :

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackProjectiveFiberTensorChart_projection_point
statement:
theorem pullbackProjectiveFiberTensorChart_projection_point (t : C.scheme)
    (V : (g.fiber (C.toBase t)).affineOpens)

    g.fiberι (C.toBase t) (V.1.ι ((C.pullbackProjectiveFiberMap g t ∣_ V.1) z)) =
      (C.pullbackFrameCover g).toBase ((C.pullbackProjectiveMap g).fiberι t

      C.pullbackProjectiveFiberMap g t ((C.pullbackProjectiveFiberMap g t ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι z) := by

      (morphismRestrict_ι (C.pullbackProjectiveFiberMap g t) V.1)

    (C.pullbackProjectiveFiberMap_fiberι_apply g t _)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackProjectiveFiberTensorChart_source_coeff_ne_zero
statement:
theorem pullbackProjectiveFiberTensorChart_source_coeff_ne_zero
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (t : C.scheme)
    (V : (g.fiber (C.toBase t)).affineOpens)
    (z : (C.pullbackProjectiveFiberMap g t ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 : Scheme))
    (hc : AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.flatPullbackCoeff (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g)
      ((C.pullbackProjectiveMap g).fiberι t
        ((C.pullbackProjectiveFiberMap g t ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι z)) ≠ 0) :

      ((C.pullbackProjectiveMap g).fiberι t
        ((C.pullbackProjectiveFiberMap g t ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι z))) ≠ 0

    (V : Scheme).isoSpec ((C.pullbackProjectiveFiberMap g t ∣_ V.1) z)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackProjectiveMap_source_coeff_ne_zero
statement:
theorem pullbackProjectiveMap_source_coeff_ne_zero [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (z : (C.pullbackFrameCover g).scheme)
    (hc : AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.flatPullbackCoeff (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) z ≠ 0) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.flatPullbackCoeff g ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).toBase z) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let f := C.pullbackProjectiveMap g
  let t : C.scheme := f z
  let ξ : f.fiber t := f.asFiber z
  let m := C.pullbackProjectiveFiberMap g t
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨V, hV, rfl⟩, hξV, _⟩ :=
    (g.fiber (C.toBase t)).isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open
      (show m ξ ∈ (⊤ : (g.fiber (C.toBase t)).Opens) from trivial)
      (⊤ : (g.fiber (C.toBase t)).Opens).isOpen
  let V' : (g.fiber (C.toBase t)).affineOpens := ⟨V, hV⟩
  let zU : (m ⁻¹ᵁ V : Scheme) := ⟨ξ, hξV⟩
  have hc' : AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.flatPullbackCoeff f
      (f.fiberι t ((m ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι zU)) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [zU, Scheme.Opens.ι_apply, ξ, t, f, Scheme.Hom.fiberι_asFiber] using hc
  have hs := C.pullbackProjectiveFiberTensorChart_source_coeff_ne_zero g t V' zU hc'
  simpa only [zU, Scheme.Opens.ι_apply, ξ, t, f, Scheme.Hom.fiberι_asFiber] using hs

    letI _ringL : CommRing L := inferInstance
    letI _algKL : Algebra K L := (C.toBase.residueFieldMap t).hom.toAlgebra
    letI _algKA : Algebra K Γ(V, ⊤) :=
      (affineScalarRingMap (g.fiberToSpecResidueField (C.toBase t)) V).toAlgebra
    ∀ z : (C.pullbackProjectiveFiberMap g t ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 : Scheme),
      AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.flatPullbackCoeff (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g)
        ((C.pullbackProjectiveMap g).fiberι t
          ((C.pullbackProjectiveFiberMap g t ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι z)) ≠ 0 ↔
      ((C.pullbackProjectiveFiberTensorChartIso g t V).hom z).asIdeal ∈
        minimalPrimes (L ⊗[K] Γ(V, ⊤)) := by
  intro K L z
  constructor
  · exact C.pullbackProjectiveFiberTensorChart_minimalPrime g t V z
  · exact fibre_coeff_ne_zero_of_affineChart_minimalPrime (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) t
      (C.pullbackProjectiveFiberMap g t ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)
      (C.pullbackProjectiveFiberTensorChartIso g t V) z

@[simp]
lemma wedge_tmul_mk (p q : ℕ) (hq : q ≠ 0) (x : Fin p → M) (y : Fin q → M) :
    wedge (M := M) p q hq (mk x ⊗ₜ mk y) = mk (Fin.append x y)

name: ModuleCat.exteriorPower.wedgeProduct_tmul_mk
statement:
@[simp]
lemma wedgeProduct_tmul_mk (p q : ℕ) (x : Fin p → M) (y : Fin q → M) :
    wedgeProduct (M := M) p q (mk x ⊗ₜ mk y) = mk (Fin.append x y)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hq : q = 0
  · subst q
    rw [show wedgeProduct (M := M) p 0 = wedgeZero (M := M) p by
      simp [wedgeProduct]]
    change ((ρ_ (M.exteriorPower p)).hom)
      (mk x ⊗ₜ[R] ((iso₀ M).hom (mk y))) = _
    rw [iso₀_hom_apply, ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.rightUnitor_hom_apply, one_smul]
    rw [Fin.append_right_nil x y rfl]
    congr 1
  · simp [wedgeProduct, hq]

name: ModuleCat.exteriorPower.wedgeProduct_naturality
statement:
lemma wedgeProduct_naturality {N : ModuleCat.{u} R} (f : M ⟶ N) (p q : ℕ) :
    ((map f p) ⊗ₘ (map f q)) ≫ wedgeProduct (M := N) p q =
      wedgeProduct (M := M) p q ≫ map f (p + q)
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.tensor_ext
  intro a b
  have ha : a ∈ Submodule.span R (Set.range (mk (M := M) (n := p))) := by
    change a ∈ Submodule.span R
      (Set.range (_root_.exteriorPower.ιMulti R p (M := M)))
    rw [_root_.exteriorPower.ιMulti_span]
    change True
    trivial
  have hb : b ∈ Submodule.span R (Set.range (mk (M := M) (n := q))) := by
    change b ∈ Submodule.span R
      (Set.range (_root_.exteriorPower.ιMulti R q (M := M)))
    rw [_root_.exteriorPower.ιMulti_span]
    change True
    trivial
  induction ha, hb using Submodule.span_induction₂ with
  | mem_mem a b ha hb =>
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := ha
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hb
      change wedgeProduct (M := N) p q
          (((map f p) ⊗ₘ (map f q)) (mk x ⊗ₜ[R] mk y)) =
        map f (p + q) (wedgeProduct (M := M) p q (mk x ⊗ₜ[R] mk y))
      rw [ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_tmul, map_mk, map_mk,
        wedgeProduct_tmul_mk, wedgeProduct_tmul_mk, map_mk]
      congr 1
      funext i
      refine Fin.addCases (fun j ↦ ?_) (fun j ↦ ?_) i <;>
        simp [Function.comp_apply]
  | zero_left => simp
  | zero_right => simp
  | add_left _ _ _ _ _ _ h₁ h₂ =>
      simpa only [TensorProduct.add_tmul, map_add] using congrArg₂ (· + ·) h₁ h₂
  | add_right _ _ _ _ _ _ h₁ h₂ =>
      simpa only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add] using congrArg₂ (· + ·) h₁ h₂
  | smul_left r _ _ _ _ h =>
      simpa only [← TensorProduct.smul_tmul', map_smul] using congrArg (r • ·) h
  | smul_right r _ _ _ _ h =>
      simpa only [TensorProduct.tmul_smul, map_smul] using congrArg (r • ·) h

name: ModuleCat.exteriorPower.alternatingMap_update_eq_zero_of_mem_span
statement:
lemma alternatingMap_update_eq_zero_of_mem_span
    {N : ModuleCat.{u} R} {n : ℕ}
    (f : M.AlternatingMap N n) (v : Fin n → M) (j : Fin n) (z : M)
    (hz : z ∈ Submodule.span R
      (Set.range (fun i : {i : Fin n // i ≠ j} ↦ v i))) :
    f (Function.update v j z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem z hz =>
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hz
      exact f.map_update_self v i.property.symm
  | zero =>
      exact f.map_coord_zero j (by simp)
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
      calc
        f (Function.update v j (x + y)) =
            f (Function.update v j x) + f (Function.update v j y) :=
          f.map_update_add v j x y
        _ = 0 := by rw [hx, hy, add_zero]
  | smul r x _ hx =>
      calc
        f (Function.update v j (r • x)) = r • f (Function.update v j x) :=
          f.map_update_smul v j r x
        _ = 0 := by rw [hx, smul_zero]

name: ModuleCat.exteriorPower.alternatingMap_update_add_of_mem_span
statement:
lemma alternatingMap_update_add_of_mem_span
    {N : ModuleCat.{u} R} {n : ℕ}
    (f : M.AlternatingMap N n) (v : Fin n → M) (j : Fin n) (z : M)
    (hz : z ∈ Submodule.span R
      (Set.range (fun i : {i : Fin n // i ≠ j} ↦ v i))) :
    f (Function.update v j (v j + z)) = f v
proof:
:= by
  calc
    f (Function.update v j (v j + z)) =
        f (Function.update v j (v j)) + f (Function.update v j z) :=
      f.map_update_add v j (v j) z
    _ = f v + 0 := by
      rw [Function.update_eq_self,
        alternatingMap_update_eq_zero_of_mem_span f v j z hz]
    _ = f v := add_zero _

name: ModuleCat.exteriorPower.alternatingMap_append_add_right_of_mem_span_left
statement:
lemma alternatingMap_append_add_right_of_mem_span_left
    {N : ModuleCat.{u} R} {a c : ℕ}
    (f : M.AlternatingMap N (a + c))
    (left : Fin a → M) (right add : Fin c → M)
    (hadd : ∀ j, add j ∈ Submodule.span R (Set.range left)) :
    f (Fin.append left (right + add)) = f (Fin.append left right)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let mixed (t : Finset (Fin c)) : Fin c → M :=
    fun j ↦ if j ∈ t then right j + add j else right j
  have hmain : ∀ t : Finset (Fin c),
      f (Fin.append left (mixed t)) = f (Fin.append left right) := by
    intro t
    induction t using Finset.induction with
    | empty => simp [mixed]
    | @insert j t hj ih =>
        let v : Fin (a + c) → M := Fin.append left (mixed t)
        let target : Fin (a + c) := Fin.natAdd a j
        have hfun : Fin.append left (mixed (insert j t)) =
            Function.update v target (v target + add j) := by
          funext i
          refine Fin.addCases (fun i ↦ ?_) (fun k ↦ ?_) i
          · have hne : Fin.castAdd c i ≠ Fin.natAdd a j := by
              intro h
              have hval := congrArg Fin.val h
              simp at hval
              omega
            simp [v, target, mixed, hne]
          · by_cases hkj : k = j
            · subst k
              simp [v, target, mixed, hj]
            · have hne : Fin.natAdd a k ≠ Fin.natAdd a j := by
                intro h
                exact hkj ((Fin.natAdd_inj a).mp h)
              simp [v, target, mixed, hj, hkj, hne]
        have hsubset : Set.range left ⊆
            Set.range (fun i : {i : Fin (a + c) // i ≠ target} ↦ v i) := by
          rintro z ⟨i, rfl⟩
          have hne : Fin.castAdd c i ≠ target := by
            intro h
            have hval := congrArg Fin.val h
            simp [target] at hval
            omega
          refine ⟨⟨Fin.castAdd c i, hne⟩, ?_⟩
          simp [v]
        have hz : add j ∈ Submodule.span R
            (Set.range (fun i : {i : Fin (a + c) // i ≠ target} ↦ v i)) :=
          Submodule.span_mono hsubset (hadd j)
        calc
          f (Fin.append left (mixed (insert j t))) =
              f (Function.update v target (v target + add j)) :=
            congrArg (fun w ↦ f w) hfun
          _ = f v := alternatingMap_update_add_of_mem_span f v target (add j) hz
          _ = f (Fin.append left right) := ih
  change f (Fin.append left (fun j ↦ right j + add j)) =
    f (Fin.append left right)
  simpa [mixed] using hmain Finset.univ

name: ModuleCat.exteriorPower.map_mem_span_range_comp_of_span_eq_top

name: ModuleCat.exteriorPower.exteriorPowerFree_succ_card_subsingleton
statement:
lemma exteriorPowerFree_succ_card_subsingleton
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]

name: ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso_hom_basis
statement:
@[simp]
lemma topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso_hom_basis {n : ℕ}
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin n) R M)
    (s : Set.powersetCard (Fin n) n) :
    (topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso b).hom ((b.exteriorPower n) s) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let B := b.exteriorPower n
  let s₀ : Set.powersetCard (Fin n) n :=
    Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv (OrderEmbedding.id (Fin n))
  letI : Subsingleton (Set.powersetCard (Fin n) n) :=
    ⟨fun s t ↦ Subtype.ext (by
      have hs : s.val = Finset.univ :=
        s.val.card_eq_iff_eq_univ.mp (by simpa using s.prop)
      have ht : t.val = Finset.univ :=
        t.val.card_eq_iff_eq_univ.mp (by simpa using t.prop)
      rw [hs, ht])⟩
  change (Finsupp.uniqueLinearEquiv R R s₀) (B.repr (B s)) = 1
  rw [Module.Basis.repr_self, show s₀ = s from Subsingleton.elim _ _,
    Finsupp.uniqueLinearEquiv_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same]

name: ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso_hom_mk
statement:

lemma topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso_hom_mk {n : ℕ}
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin n) R M) :
    (topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso b).hom (mk b) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s₀ : Set.powersetCard (Fin n) n :=
    Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv (OrderEmbedding.id (Fin n))
  have hb : (b.exteriorPower n) s₀ = mk b := by
    rw [_root_.exteriorPower.basis_apply]
    change mk (b ∘ Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s₀) = mk b
    rw [show Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm s₀ =
      OrderEmbedding.id (Fin n) by
        exact Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm_apply_apply _]
    rfl
  rw [← hb]
  apply topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso_hom_basis

name: ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso_inv_one
proof:
:= by
  apply (topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso b).toLinearEquiv.injective
  have hi := congrArg
    (fun q : ModuleCat.of R R ⟶ ModuleCat.of R R ↦ q 1)
    (topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso b).inv_hom_id
  change (topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso b).hom
    ((topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso b).inv 1) = 1 at hi
  change (topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso b).hom
      ((topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso b).inv 1) =
    (topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso b).hom (mk b)
  rw [hi, topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso_hom_mk]

    intro i
    have hi : i ∈ s₀ := by simp [s₀]
    exact (Set.powersetCard.mem_range_ofFinEmbEquiv_symm_iff_mem s₀ i).mpr hi
  rw [topExteriorPowerFreeFamily, Set.range_comp, hs.range_eq]

name: ModuleCat.exteriorPower.eq_topExteriorPowerTrivialization_hom_smul_generator
statement:
lemma eq_topExteriorPowerTrivialization_hom_smul_generator
    (I : Type u) [Fintype I] [LinearOrder I]
    (e : ModuleCat.of R (I →₀ R) ≅ M)

      topExteriorPowerGenerator I e

name: ModuleCat.exteriorPower.hom_ext_topExteriorPower_tensor

name: ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerFreeIso_hom_basis
statement:
@[simp]
lemma topExteriorPowerFreeIso_hom_basis (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (I : Type u) [Fintype I] [LinearOrder I]
    (s₀ : Set.powersetCard I (Fintype.card I)) :
    (topExteriorPowerFreeIso R I).hom
        ((Finsupp.basisSingleOne (R := R)).exteriorPower (Fintype.card I) s₀) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b : Module.Basis (Set.powersetCard I (Fintype.card I)) R
      (⋀[R]^(Fintype.card I) (I →₀ R)) :=
    (Finsupp.basisSingleOne (R := R)).exteriorPower (Fintype.card I)
  let t₀ : Set.powersetCard I (Fintype.card I) :=
    ⟨Finset.univ, Finset.card_univ⟩
  letI : Subsingleton (Set.powersetCard I (Fintype.card I)) :=
    ⟨fun s t ↦ Subtype.ext (by
      have hs : s.val = Finset.univ :=
        s.val.card_eq_iff_eq_univ.mp (by simpa using s.prop)
      have ht : t.val = Finset.univ :=
        t.val.card_eq_iff_eq_univ.mp (by simpa using t.prop)
      rw [hs, ht])⟩
  change (Finsupp.uniqueLinearEquiv R R t₀) (b.repr (b s₀)) = 1
  rw [Module.Basis.repr_self]
  rw [show t₀ = s₀ from Subsingleton.elim _ _,
    Finsupp.uniqueLinearEquiv_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same]

name: ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerFreeIso_hom_generator

name: ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerGenerator_eq_map_freeGenerator
statement:
lemma topExteriorPowerGenerator_eq_map_freeGenerator
    (I : Type u) [Fintype I] [LinearOrder I]
    (e : ModuleCat.of R (I →₀ R) ≅ M) :
    topExteriorPowerGenerator I e =
      map e.hom (Fintype.card I) (topExteriorPowerFreeGenerator R I)
proof:
:= by
  apply (topExteriorPowerTrivialization I e).toLinearEquiv.injective
  change (topExteriorPowerTrivialization I e).hom
      (topExteriorPowerGenerator I e) =
    (topExteriorPowerTrivialization I e).hom
      (map e.hom (Fintype.card I) (topExteriorPowerFreeGenerator R I))
  rw [topExteriorPowerTrivialization_hom_generator]
  have hmap :
      map e.inv (Fintype.card I)
          (map e.hom (Fintype.card I) (topExteriorPowerFreeGenerator R I)) =
        topExteriorPowerFreeGenerator R I := by
    have hcomp :
        map e.hom (Fintype.card I) ≫ map e.inv (Fintype.card I) =
          𝟙 ((functor R (Fintype.card I)).obj (ModuleCat.of R (I →₀ R))) := by
      change (functor R (Fintype.card I)).map e.hom ≫
          (functor R (Fintype.card I)).map e.inv = _
      rw [← (functor R (Fintype.card I)).map_comp, e.hom_inv_id]
      exact (functor R (Fintype.card I)).map_id (ModuleCat.of R (I →₀ R))
    change ((map e.hom (Fintype.card I) ≫ map e.inv (Fintype.card I))
      (topExteriorPowerFreeGenerator R I)) = _
    rw [hcomp]
    rfl
  change 1 = (topExteriorPowerFreeIso R I).hom
    (map e.inv (Fintype.card I)
      (map e.hom (Fintype.card I) (topExteriorPowerFreeGenerator R I)))
  rw [hmap, topExteriorPowerFreeIso_hom_generator]

name: ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerGenerator_eq_mk
statement:
lemma topExteriorPowerGenerator_eq_mk
    (I : Type u) [Fintype I] [LinearOrder I]

    topExteriorPowerGenerator I e =
      mk (e.hom ∘ topExteriorPowerFreeFamily R I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [topExteriorPowerGenerator_eq_map_freeGenerator,
    topExteriorPowerFreeGenerator_eq_mk, map_mk]

name: ModuleCat.exteriorPower.span_range_topExteriorPowerFamily
statement:
lemma span_range_topExteriorPowerFamily
    (I : Type u) [Fintype I] [LinearOrder I]
    (e : ModuleCat.of R (I →₀ R) ≅ M) :
    Submodule.span R
      (Set.range (e.hom ∘ topExteriorPowerFreeFamily R I)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.range_comp, Submodule.span_image,
    span_range_topExteriorPowerFreeFamily, Submodule.map_top]
  apply LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr
  intro y
  exact ⟨e.inv y, by simp⟩

name: ModuleCat.exteriorPower.splitDeterminantHom_independent_of_splitting
statement:
lemma splitDeterminantHom_independent_of_splitting
    {S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R)} (h k : S.Splitting)
    (I J : Type u) [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [LinearOrder I] [LinearOrder J]
    (e₁ : ModuleCat.of R (I →₀ R) ≅ S.X₁)
    (e₃ : ModuleCat.of R (J →₀ R) ≅ S.X₃) :
    splitDeterminantHom h (Fintype.card I) (Fintype.card J) =
      splitDeterminantHom k (Fintype.card I) (Fintype.card J)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let x : Fin (Fintype.card I) → S.X₁ :=
    e₁.hom ∘ topExteriorPowerFreeFamily R I
  let y : Fin (Fintype.card J) → S.X₃ :=
    e₃.hom ∘ topExteriorPowerFreeFamily R J
  let d : S.X₃ ⟶ S.X₁ := (k.s - h.s) ≫ h.r
  have hx : Submodule.span R (Set.range x) = ⊤ := by
    simpa [x] using span_range_topExteriorPowerFamily I e₁
  have hsection : k.s = h.s + d ≫ S.f := by
    have hs : k.s - h.s = d ≫ S.f := by
      simpa only [d, Category.assoc] using splitting_section_sub_eq h k
    rw [← hs]
    abel
  have hright : k.s ∘ y =
      (h.s ∘ y) + (S.f ∘ d ∘ y) := by
    funext j
    rw [hsection]
    rfl
  have hadd : ∀ j, (S.f ∘ d ∘ y) j ∈
      Submodule.span R (Set.range (S.f ∘ x)) := by
    intro j
    exact map_mem_span_range_comp_of_span_eq_top S.f x hx (d (y j))
  have hAlt :
      mk (Fin.append (S.f ∘ x) ((h.s ∘ y) + (S.f ∘ d ∘ y))) =
        mk (Fin.append (S.f ∘ x) (h.s ∘ y)) :=
    alternatingMap_append_add_right_of_mem_span_left
      (mk (M := S.X₂)
        (n := Fintype.card I + Fintype.card J))
      (S.f ∘ x) (h.s ∘ y) (S.f ∘ d ∘ y) hadd
  apply hom_ext_topExteriorPower_tensor I J e₁ e₃
  rw [topExteriorPowerGenerator_eq_mk I e₁,
    topExteriorPowerGenerator_eq_mk J e₃,
    splitDeterminantHom_tmul_mk, splitDeterminantHom_tmul_mk]
  change mk (Fin.append (S.f ∘ x) (h.s ∘ y)) =
    mk (Fin.append (S.f ∘ x) (k.s ∘ y))
  rw [hright]
  exact hAlt.symm

name: ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerTensorTrivialization_hom_generator
statement:
@[simp]
lemma topExteriorPowerTensorTrivialization_hom_generator
    {A C : ModuleCat.{u} R}
    (I J : Type u) [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [LinearOrder I] [LinearOrder J]
    (eA : ModuleCat.of R (I →₀ R) ≅ A)
    (eC : ModuleCat.of R (J →₀ R) ≅ C) :
    (topExteriorPowerTensorTrivialization I J eA eC).hom
        (topExteriorPowerGenerator I eA ⊗ₜ
          topExteriorPowerGenerator J eC) = 1
proof:
:= by
  change ((λ_ (ModuleCat.of R R)).hom)
    ((topExteriorPowerTrivialization I eA).hom
          (topExteriorPowerGenerator I eA) ⊗ₜ[R]
      (topExteriorPowerTrivialization J eC).hom
          (topExteriorPowerGenerator J eC)) = 1
  rw [topExteriorPowerTrivialization_hom_generator,
    topExteriorPowerTrivialization_hom_generator,
    ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor_hom_apply, one_smul]

lemma topExteriorPowerFinsuppFreeIso_inv_one
    (I : Type u) [Fintype I]
    (U : (TopologicalSpace.Opens X)ᵒᵖ) :
    (topExteriorPowerFinsuppFreeIso X I).inv.app U
        (1 : X.presheaf.obj U) =
      topExteriorPowerFinsuppFreeGenerator X I U
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : LinearOrder I := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
  rw [topExteriorPowerFinsuppFreeGenerator]
  let e := ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerFreeIso
    (X.presheaf.obj U) I
  have hgenerator :
      e.hom (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerFreeGenerator
        (X.presheaf.obj U) I) = 1 :=
    ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerFreeIso_hom_generator
      (X.presheaf.obj U) I
  calc
    e.inv 1 = e.inv (e.hom
        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerFreeGenerator
          (X.presheaf.obj U) I)) := congrArg e.inv hgenerator.symm
    _ = ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerFreeGenerator
          (X.presheaf.obj U) I := e.hom_inv_id_apply _

name: SchemeKTheory.splitDeterminantSheafIso_independent_of_splitting
statement:
lemma splitDeterminantSheafIso_independent_of_splitting
    {S : ShortComplex X.Modules} (h k : S.Splitting)
    (I J : Type u) [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [LinearOrder I] [LinearOrder J]
    (e₁ : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I ≅ S.X₁)
    (e₃ : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) J ≅ S.X₃) :
    splitDeterminantSheafIso X h I J e₁ e₃ =
      splitDeterminantSheafIso X k I J e₁ e₃
proof:
:= by
  let F := underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X
  let e₁' : PresheafOfModules.constantFree (R := X.presheaf) I ≅
      (S.map F).X₁ :=
    (underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree X I).symm ≪≫ F.mapIso e₁
  let e₃' : PresheafOfModules.constantFree (R := X.presheaf) J ≅
      (S.map F).X₃ :=
    (underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree X J).symm ≪≫ F.mapIso e₃
  have hp := PresheafOfModules.splitDeterminantHom_independent_of_splitting
    (h.map F) (k.map F) I J e₁' e₃'
  apply Iso.ext
  rw [splitDeterminantSheafIso_hom, splitDeterminantSheafIso_hom]
  dsimp only [splitDeterminantSheafHom]
  rw [hp]

name: SchemeKTheory.determinantLocalChartTopWedge_eq_map
statement:
lemma determinantLocalChartTopWedge_eq_map
    (M : X.Modules) (q : M.LocalGeneratorsData)
    [q.IsLocallyFreeData] [q.IsFiniteType]
    (i : q.I) :
    determinantLocalChartTopWedge X M q i =
      (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPowerMap
        (underlyingCommPresheafOverHomForExteriorPower X (q.X i)
          (q.generators i).π)
        (Nat.card (q.generators i).I)).app
          (Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 (q.X i))))
            (determinantLocalChartFreeTopWedge X M q i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let I := (q.generators i).I
  letI : (q.generators i).IsFiniteType :=
    SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType i
  letI : Finite I := by
    dsimp only [I]
    infer_instance
  letI : Fintype I := Fintype.ofFinite I
  letI : LinearOrder I := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
  let T := Opposite.op (Over.mk (𝟙 (q.X i)))
  let f := (underlyingCommPresheafOverHomForExteriorPower X (q.X i)
    (q.generators i).π).app T
  let x : Fin (Nat.card I) →
      (underlyingCommPresheafOverForExteriorPower X (q.X i)
        (SheafOfModules.free
          (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over (q.X i)) I)).obj T := fun j ↦
    (SheafOfModules.freeSection
      (determinantLocalChartIndexEquiv X M q i j)).eval T
  let y : Fin (Nat.card I) →
      (underlyingCommPresheafOverForExteriorPower X (q.X i)
        (M.over (q.X i))).obj T := fun j ↦
    ((q.generators i).s
      (determinantLocalChartIndexEquiv X M q i j)).eval T
  have hxy : f ∘ x = y := by
    funext j
    let a : I := determinantLocalChartIndexEquiv X M q i j
    have h := congrFun
      ((M.over (q.X i)).freeHomEquiv.apply_symm_apply (q.generators i).s) a
    rw [SheafOfModules.freeHomEquiv_apply] at h
    dsimp only [f, x, y, Function.comp_apply]
    exact congrArg (fun s ↦ s.eval T) h
  have hmap := ModuleCat.exteriorPower.map_mk f x
  change ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk y =
    ModuleCat.exteriorPower.map f (Nat.card I) (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk x)
  rw [hmap, hxy]

    (determinantLocalGeneratingSections X M q p).s PUnit.unit =

name: SchemeKTheory.coversTop_sigmaPoints
statement:
theorem coversTop_sigmaPoints {M : X.Modules} (q : M.LocalGeneratorsData) :
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop
      (fun p : Σ i : q.I, q.X i ↦ q.X p.1)
proof:
:= by
  have hq := q.coversTop
  rw [Opens.coversTop_iff, IsOpenCover] at hq ⊢
  rw [iSup_sigma, ← hq]
  apply iSup_congr
  intro i
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact iSup_le (fun _ ↦ le_rfl)
  · by_cases hi : Nonempty (q.X i)
    · exact le_iSup (fun _ : q.X i ↦ q.X i) hi.some
    · intro x hx
      exact (hi ⟨x, hx⟩).elim

name: SchemeKTheory.determinant_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem determinant_isFiniteLocallyFree (M : X.Modules)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.RG7.hbcA_XA
statement:
theorem hbcA_XA [IsNoetherian (totalGlobal A i.ker)]
    [IsIntegral X] (x : K0 X) :
    k0ToG0 A (pullbackK0 (fibreιGlobal A i.ker k φk 1)
      (liftK' i.ker hA hAreg (regularZA i hX) (pullbackK0 (phiXA i).inv x))) =
      finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X x)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian i.ker.subscheme :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian i.ker.subschemeι
  have h := hbcA_ambient i.ker hA hAreg (regularZA i hX) φk (pullbackK0 (phiXA i).inv x) _
    (liftK'_spec i.ker hA hAreg (regularZA i hX) _)
  rw [h, k0ToG0_phiXA]
  calc finitePushforward i.ker.subschemeι (finitePushforward (phiXA i).hom (k0ToG0 X x))
      = finitePushforward ((phiXA i).hom ≫ i.ker.subschemeι) (k0ToG0 X x) := by
        rw [ARRG45C.finitePushforward_comp]; rfl
    _ = finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X x) := by
        rw [ARRG45C.finitePushforward_congr (phiXA_comp i)]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.RG7.hbcE_XA
statement:

          (liftK' i.ker hA hAreg (regularZA i hX) (pullbackK0 (phiXA i).inv x))) =
      finitePushforward ((phiXA i).hom ≫ zeroE i.ker φk) (k0ToG0 X x)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian i.ker.subscheme :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian i.ker.subschemeι
  rw [hbcE_concrete' i.ker hA hAreg (regularZA i hX) φk, k0ToG0_phiXA,
    ARRG45C.finitePushforward_comp]
  rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.RG7.injE_componentA

proof:

  haveI : IsIntegral X := (Fact.out : D28.ProjectiveIntegral k X).1
  have hZ := regularZA i hX

  haveI := z_lft (k := k) i.ker
  haveI := z_noeth i.ker
  have hZK := KG2B.projectiveIntegralK_Z i.ker hA

  haveI := component_isNoetherian i.ker (KG2B.coverJ i.ker hAreg hZ) hZK
  exact (k0ToG0_bijective_of_projectiveIntegralK (KG2B.projectiveIntegralK_E i.ker hA hAreg hZ)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.xiCap_transport_bundleIso
statement:
theorem xiCap_transport_bundleIso (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') :
    xiCap ops (AffineFrameCover.transport e C') =
      totalCap ops
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (AffineFrameCover.transportSchemeIso e C').hom).obj
          (C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))
        (hasConstantRank_pullback _ _ _ 1 (C'.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))
proof:
:=
  cp.cap_iso ((AffineFrameCover.transport e C').hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.xiCap_pow_transport_push
statement:
theorem xiCap_pow_transport_push (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (j : ℕ) :
    letI
proof:
:= transportSchemeIso_isOver (k := k) e C'
    totalPush ops (AffineFrameCover.transportSchemeIso e C').hom ∘ₗ
      (xiCap ops (AffineFrameCover.transport e C')) ^ j =
    ((xiCap ops C') ^ j) ∘ₗ totalPush ops (AffineFrameCover.transportSchemeIso e C').hom := by
  letI := transportSchemeIso_isOver (k := k) e C'
  have h : totalPush ops (AffineFrameCover.transportSchemeIso e C').hom ∘ₗ
      xiCap ops (AffineFrameCover.transport e C') =
      xiCap ops C' ∘ₗ totalPush ops (AffineFrameCover.transportSchemeIso e C').hom := by
    rw [xiCap_transport_bundleIso ops cp e C']
    exact cp.cap_push _ _ _
  exact (Module.End.commute_pow_left_of_commute h.symm j).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.transport_totalPush_projection
statement:
theorem transport_totalPush_projection (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') :
    letI
proof:
:= transportSchemeIso_isOver (k := k) e C'
    totalPush ops (AffineFrameCover.transport e C').toBase =
      totalPush ops C'.toBase ∘ₗ totalPush ops (AffineFrameCover.transportSchemeIso e C').hom := by
  letI := transportSchemeIso_isOver (k := k) e C'
  rw [← cp.push_comp]
  exact totalPush_congr ops (AffineFrameCover.transportSchemeIso_toBase e C').symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.transport_totalPull_projection
statement:
theorem transport_totalPull_projection (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    {r : ℕ} (hC' : ∀ i, Nat.card (C'.basisIndex i) = r + 1) :
    letI
proof:
:= transportSchemeIso_isOver (k := k) e C'
    letI := transportProjection_flat e C' hC'
    letI := C'.toBase_flat (C'.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC' (Nat.succ_pos r))
    totalPull ops (AffineFrameCover.transport e C').toBase r
      (cp.projBundle_relDim (AffineFrameCover.transport e C') hC') =
    totalPull ops (AffineFrameCover.transportSchemeIso e C').hom 0
      (pureRelDim_of_iso (AffineFrameCover.transportSchemeIso e C')) ∘ₗ
      totalPull ops C'.toBase r (cp.projBundle_relDim C' hC') := by
  letI := transportSchemeIso_isOver (k := k) e C'
  letI := transportProjection_flat e C' hC'
  letI := C'.toBase_flat (C'.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC' (Nat.succ_pos r))
  have hfg : PureRelDim ((AffineFrameCover.transportSchemeIso e C').hom ≫ C'.toBase)
      (r + 0) := by
    rw [AffineFrameCover.transportSchemeIso_toBase]
    exact cp.projBundle_relDim (AffineFrameCover.transport e C') hC'
  exact (totalPull_congr ops (AffineFrameCover.transportSchemeIso_toBase e C').symm r
    (cp.projBundle_relDim (AffineFrameCover.transport e C') hC') hfg).trans
    (cp.pull_comp _ _ 0 r (pureRelDim_of_iso (AffineFrameCover.transportSchemeIso e C'))
      (cp.projBundle_relDim C' hC') hfg)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.sandwich_transport_bundleIso
statement:
theorem sandwich_transport_bundleIso (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    {r : ℕ} (hC' : ∀ i, Nat.card (C'.basisIndex i) = r + 1) (j : ℕ) :
    sandwich ops (AffineFrameCover.transport e C') cp hC' j =
      sandwich ops C' cp hC' j

    (AffineFrameCover.transportSchemeIso e C')

    (AffineFrameCover.transportTwistGlobalCompat e C') j

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.segre_transport_bundleIso
statement:
theorem segre_transport_bundleIso (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')

    segre ops (AffineFrameCover.transport e C') cp hC' i = segre ops C' cp hC' i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.segre_bundleIso
statement:
theorem segre_bundleIso (e : E ≅ E') (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') {r : ℕ}
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = r + 1)
    (hC' : ∀ i, Nat.card (C'.basisIndex i) = r + 1) (i : ℕ) :
    segre ops C cp hC i = segre ops C' cp hC' i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.segreOp_eq_segre
statement:
theorem segreOp_eq_segre (C : AffineFrameCover X E) {r : ℕ}
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E (r + 1))
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = r + 1) :
    segreOp ops cp E (r + 1) hE = segre ops C cp hC
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  exact segre_indep ops cp (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hE).choose C
    (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hE).choose_spec hC i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.segreOp_bundleIso
statement:
theorem segreOp_bundleIso (e : E ≅ E') (r : ℕ)
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) (hE' : HasConstantRank X E' r) :
    segreOp ops cp E r hE = segreOp ops cp E' r hE'
proof:
:= by
  cases r with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ r =>
    funext i
    exact segre_bundleIso ops cp e
      (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hE).choose
      (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hE').choose
      (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hE).choose_spec
      (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hE').choose_spec i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.chernOfCover_transport_bundleIso
statement:
theorem chernOfCover_transport_bundleIso (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    {r : ℕ} (hC' : ∀ i, Nat.card (C'.basisIndex i) = r + 1) :
    chernOfCover ops (AffineFrameCover.transport e C') cp hC' =
      chernOfCover ops C' cp hC'
proof:
:= by
  have hs : segreSeries ops (AffineFrameCover.transport e C') cp hC' =
      segreSeries ops C' cp hC' :=
    congrArg PowerSeries.mk (funext (segre_transport_bundleIso ops cp e C' hC'))
  funext i
  unfold chernOfCover
  rw [hs]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.chernOfCover_bundleIso
statement:
theorem chernOfCover_bundleIso (e : E ≅ E') (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') {r : ℕ}
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = r + 1)
    (hC' : ∀ i, Nat.card (C'.basisIndex i) = r + 1) :
    chernOfCover ops C cp hC = chernOfCover ops C' cp hC'

:=
  (chernOfCover_indep ops cp C (AffineFrameCover.transport e C') hC hC').trans
    (chernOfCover_transport_bundleIso ops cp e C' hC')

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.chernOp_bundleIso
statement:
theorem chernOp_bundleIso (e : E ≅ E') (r : ℕ)
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) (hE' : HasConstantRank X E' r) :
    chernOp ops cp E r hE = chernOp ops cp E' r hE'
proof:
:= by
  cases r with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ r =>
    let C' := (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hE').choose
    have hC' := (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hE').choose_spec
    rw [chernOp_eq_chernOfCover ops cp (AffineFrameCover.transport e C') hE hC',
      chernOp_eq_chernOfCover ops cp C' hE' hC']
    exact chernOfCover_transport_bundleIso ops cp e C' hC'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.chOp_bundleIso

theorem chOp_bundleIso (e : E ≅ E') (r : ℕ)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.tdOp_bundleIso
statement:
theorem tdOp_bundleIso (e : E ≅ E') (r : ℕ)

    tdOp ops cp E r hE = tdOp ops cp E' r hE'
proof:
:= by

  rw [chernOp_bundleIso ops cp e r hE hE']

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.sandwich_compare
statement:
theorem sandwich_compare (j : ℕ) :
    sandwichOn (opsV4 k) (CX.pullbackFrameCover S.q) (cpV4 k) (CX.pullbackFrameCover_card S.q hCX) j ∘ₗ
        totalPullOn (opsV4 k) S.q S.d S.hd =
      sandwichOn (opsV4 k) C0 (cpV4 k) hC0 j ∘ₗ totalPullOn (opsV4 k) S.q S.d S.hd
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sandwichOn_pull_flat CX S.q (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) S.d S.hd hCX j]
  by_cases hj : j < e + 1
  · rw [sandwichOn_eq_zero_of_lt (opsV4 k) CX (cpV4 k) hCX hj,
      sandwichOn_eq_zero_of_lt (opsV4 k) C0 (cpV4 k) hC0 hj]
    simp
  · have hj' : e + 1 ≤ j := by omega
    rw [sandwichOn_eq_phi (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) CX hCX j, if_pos hj',
      sandwichOn_eq_phi (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) C0 hC0 j, if_pos hj']
    have hGq := hasConstantRank_pullback S.Y S.q E (e + 1) hE
    have hSegX := segreInvR_unit_summand_projectiveIntegral (k := k) hE CX hCX
    have hSegF := segreInvR_unit_summand_projectiveIntegral (k := k) hGq C0 hC0
    exact seg_unique (totalPullOn (opsV4 k) S.q S.d S.hd)
      (fun a => ((-1 : ℚ) ^ a) • chernOpOn' (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) (hPk k) E (e + 1) hE a)
      (segreOn (opsV4 k) CX (cpV4 k) hCX)
      (fun a => ((-1 : ℚ) ^ a) • chernOpOn' (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) (hPk k)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj E) (e + 1) hGq a)
      (segreOn (opsV4 k) C0 (cpV4 k) hC0)
      (fun a => by
        rw [LinearMap.comp_smul, LinearMap.smul_comp,
          chernOpOn'_pull_flat S.q (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) S.d S.hd (hPk k) E (e + 1) hE a])
      hSegX.2 hSegF.2 (segreOn_zero (opsV4 k) CX (cpV4 k) hCX)
      (segreOn_zero (opsV4 k) C0 (cpV4 k) hC0) (j - (e + 1))

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.zsumOp_comp_pull
statement:
theorem zsumOp_comp_pull {B₁ B₂ : S.Y.Modules} (C₁ : AffineFrameCover S.Y B₁)
    (C₂ : AffineFrameCover S.Y B₂)
    (hC₁ : ∀ i, Nat.card (C₁.basisIndex i) = (e + 1) + 1)
    (hC₂ : ∀ i, Nat.card (C₂.basisIndex i) = (e + 1) + 1)
    [Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k C₁.scheme)] [Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k C₂.scheme)]
    (h : ∀ j, sandwichOn (opsV4 k) C₁ (cpV4 k) hC₁ j ∘ₗ totalPullOn (opsV4 k) S.q S.d S.hd =
      sandwichOn (opsV4 k) C₂ (cpV4 k) hC₂ j ∘ₗ totalPullOn (opsV4 k) S.q S.d S.hd)
    (F : FlagLift (opsV4 k) S) (D m : ℕ) :
    zsumOp S C₁ hC₁ F D m ∘ₗ totalPullOn (opsV4 k) S.q S.d S.hd =
      zsumOp S C₂ hC₂ F D m ∘ₗ totalPullOn (opsV4 k) S.q S.d S.hd
proof:
:= by
  unfold zsumOp
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro v
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  split_ifs with hj
  · have hv := LinearMap.congr_fun (h j) v
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Module.End.mul_apply] at hv ⊢
    rw [hv]
  · rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.hZ_projectiveIntegral
statement:
theorem hZ_projectiveIntegral (F : FlagLift (opsV4 k) S) (D m : ℕ) (hm : m < D) :
    totalPullOn (opsV4 k) S.q S.d S.hd ∘ₗ
        zxOp k (hPk k) (GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.chExact_projectiveIntegral (k := k)) CX hCX
          (kosClassX CX hE) m =
      zscoreFlagOp (cpV4 k) F C0 hC0 D m ∘ₗ totalPullOn (opsV4 k) S.q S.d S.hd
proof:
:= by
  have hCF := CX.pullbackFrameCover_card S.q hCX
  rw [pull_zxOp CX S.q S.hd hCX (kosClassX CX hE) m, flatPullbackK0_kosClassX S CX hCX hE,
    zxOp_koszul_eq_zsum S (CX.pullbackFrameCover S.q) hCF F m,
    zsumOp_comp_pull (S := S) (CX.pullbackFrameCover S.q) C0 hCF hC0
      (sandwich_compare CX hCX C0 hC0 hE) F (e + 1 + m) m]
  have h1 := flag_zscore_graded_projectiveIntegral F hE C0 hC0 (e + 1 + m) m (by omega)
  have h2 := flag_zscore_graded_projectiveIntegral F hE C0 hC0 D m hm
  have h3 : zsumOp S C0 hC0 F (e + 1 + m) m =
      zscoreFlagOp (chowCompatOn_projectiveIntegral k) F C0 hC0 (e + 1 + m) m := rfl
  rw [h3, h1, ← h2]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.zx_eq_tdNinvOp
statement:
theorem zx_eq_tdNinvOp (F : FlagLift (opsV4 k) S) (m : ℕ) :
    zxOp k (hPk k) (GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.chExact_projectiveIntegral (k := k)) CX hCX
        (kosClassX CX hE) m =
      tdNinvOp (chernOpOn' (chowOpsOn_projectiveIntegral k) (chowCompatOn_projectiveIntegral k)
        (hP k) E (e + 1) hE) m
proof:
:=
  zscore_descent_projectiveIntegral F hE C0 hC0 (m + 1) m (Nat.lt_succ_self m) _
    (hZ_projectiveIntegral CX hCX C0 hC0 hE F (m + 1) m (Nat.lt_succ_self m))

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.zx_eq_tdNinvOp_final
statement:
theorem zx_eq_tdNinvOp_final (m : ℕ) :
    zxOp k (hPk k) (GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.chExact_projectiveIntegral (k := k)) CX hCX
        (kosClassX CX hE) m =
      tdNinvOp (chernOpOn' (chowOpsOn_projectiveIntegral k) (chowCompatOn_projectiveIntegral k)
        (hP k) E (e + 1) hE) m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S⟩ := exists_chowSplittingOn (chowOpsOn_projectiveIntegral k)
    (chowCompatOn_projectiveIntegral k) (hP k) e E hE
  obtain ⟨F⟩ := exists_flagLift (chowOpsOn_projectiveIntegral k)
    (chowCompatOn_projectiveIntegral k) S
  have hGq := hasConstantRank_pullback S.Y S.q E (e + 1) hE
  obtain ⟨C0, hC0⟩ := exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank
    (hasConstantRank_biprod_E13 hGq (hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf (Y := S.Y)))
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k C0.scheme) := ⟨hP k C0 hC0⟩
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k (CX.pullbackFrameCover S.q).scheme) :=
    ⟨hP k _ (CX.pullbackFrameCover_card S.q hCX)⟩
  exact zx_eq_tdNinvOp CX hCX C0 hC0 hE F m

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesAwayMap_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reesAwayMap_mk (I : Ideal R) (g : R) {d : ℕ} (s : reesAlgebra I)
    (hs : s ∈ grading I d) (n : ℕ) (p : reesAlgebra I)
    (hp : p ∈ grading I (n • d)) :
    reesAwayMap I g s (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading I) hs n p hp) =
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading (localizedIdeal I g))
        ((gradedLocalizationMap I g).map_mem hs) n
        (gradedLocalizationMap I g p)
        ((gradedLocalizationMap I g).map_mem hp)
proof:
:= by
  exact HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map_mk
    (gradedLocalizationMap I g) s hs n p hp

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesAwayMap_comp_fromZero
statement:
theorem reesAwayMap_comp_fromZero (I : Ideal R) (g : R) (s : reesAlgebra I) :
    (reesAwayMap I g s).comp
        (HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom
          (grading I) (Submonoid.powers s)) =
      (HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom
          (grading (localizedIdeal I g))
          (Submonoid.powers (gradedLocalizationMap I g s))).comp
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.degreeZeroMap (gradedLocalizationMap I g))
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro x
  change
    HomogeneousLocalization.map (gradedLocalizationMap I g)
        (by
          rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
          exact ⟨n, by simp⟩)
        (HomogeneousLocalization.mk
          (⟨0, x, 1, one_mem _⟩ :
            HomogeneousLocalization.NumDenSameDeg
