              (grading I) (Submonoid.powers s))) =
      HomogeneousLocalization.mk
        (⟨0, AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.degreeZeroMap (gradedLocalizationMap I g) x,
            1, one_mem _⟩ :
          HomogeneousLocalization.NumDenSameDeg
            (grading (localizedIdeal I g))
            (Submonoid.powers (gradedLocalizationMap I g s)))
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.map_mk]
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp only [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mk,
    AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.degreeZeroMap]
  congr 1
  exact Subtype.ext (map_one (gradedLocalizationMap I g))

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesAwayMap_comp_coefficientToReesAway
statement:
theorem reesAwayMap_comp_coefficientToReesAway
    (I : Ideal R) (g : R) (s : reesAlgebra I) :
    (reesAwayMap I g s).comp (coefficientToReesAway I s) =
      (coefficientToReesAway (localizedIdeal I g)
        (gradedLocalizationMap I g s)).comp
          (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g))
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro r
  have hzero :
      AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.degreeZeroMap (gradedLocalizationMap I g)
          ((degreeZeroAlgEquiv I).symm r) =
        (degreeZeroAlgEquiv (localizedIdeal I g)).symm
          (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g) r) := by
    apply (degreeZeroAlgEquiv (localizedIdeal I g)).injective
    have h := RingHom.congr_fun
      (degreeZeroAlgEquiv_gradedLocalizationMap I g)
      ((degreeZeroAlgEquiv I).symm r)
    change
      degreeZeroAlgEquiv (localizedIdeal I g)
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.degreeZeroMap (gradedLocalizationMap I g)
            ((degreeZeroAlgEquiv I).symm r)) =
        algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)
          (degreeZeroAlgEquiv I ((degreeZeroAlgEquiv I).symm r)) at h
    rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
    simpa only [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using h
  have hAway := RingHom.congr_fun (reesAwayMap_comp_fromZero I g s)
    ((degreeZeroAlgEquiv I).symm r)
  change
    reesAwayMap I g s
        (HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom
          (grading I) (Submonoid.powers s) ((degreeZeroAlgEquiv I).symm r)) =
      HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom
        (grading (localizedIdeal I g))
        (Submonoid.powers (gradedLocalizationMap I g s))
        ((degreeZeroAlgEquiv (localizedIdeal I g)).symm
          (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g) r))
  rw [← hzero]
  exact hAway

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesAwaySpecMap_toBase
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem reesAwaySpecMap_toBase (I : Ideal R) (g : R) (s : reesAlgebra I) :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (reesAwayMap I g s)) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (coefficientToReesAway I s)) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (coefficientToReesAway (localizedIdeal I g)
            (gradedLocalizationMap I g s))) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro r
  exact RingHom.congr_fun (reesAwayMap_comp_coefficientToReesAway I g s) r

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesAwayι_comp_affineData_toSpecBase
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem reesAwayι_comp_affineData_toSpecBase
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.affineOpens) (I : Ideal Γ(X, U.1))
    {d : ℕ} (s : reesAlgebra I) (hs : s ∈ grading I d) (hd : 0 < d) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.awayι (grading I) s hs hd ≫
        (affineData X U I).toSpecBase =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (coefficientToReesAway I s))
proof:
:= by
  change
    AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.awayι (grading I) s hs hd ≫
        AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.toSpecZero (grading I) ≫
          Spec.map
            (degreeZeroAlgEquiv I).symm.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.hom =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (coefficientToReesAway I s))
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.awayι_toSpecZero_assoc]
  rw [← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.mapFreePUnitIsoUnit_naturality
statement:
theorem mapFreePUnitIsoUnit_naturality
    {C : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} C]
    {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    {R : Sheaf J RingCat.{u}}
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [HasWeakSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    {D : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} D]
    {K : GrothendieckTopology D}
    {S : Sheaf K RingCat.{u}}
    [HasSheafify K AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [HasWeakSheafify K AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [K.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} R ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} S)
    [PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete PUnit) F]
    (η : SheafOfModules.unit S ≅ F.obj (SheafOfModules.unit R)) :
    (SheafOfModules.mapFreeIso F PUnit η).hom ≫
        F.map (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := R)).hom ≫ η.inv =
      (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S)).hom
proof:
:= by
  let uR := SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := R)
  let uS := SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S)
  have hgenR (i : PUnit) :
      SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := R) i ≫ uR.hom = 𝟙 _ := by
    obtain rfl : i = default := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    simp only [uR, SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit,
      SheafOfModules.ιFree]
    change (coproductUniqueIso fun _ : PUnit ↦
      SheafOfModules.unit R).inv ≫
        (coproductUniqueIso fun _ : PUnit ↦
          SheafOfModules.unit R).hom = 𝟙 _
    exact Iso.inv_hom_id _
  have hgenS (i : PUnit) :
      SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := S) i ≫ uS.hom = 𝟙 _ := by
    obtain rfl : i = default := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    simp only [uS, SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit,
      SheafOfModules.ιFree]
    change (coproductUniqueIso fun _ : PUnit ↦
      SheafOfModules.unit S).inv ≫
        (coproductUniqueIso fun _ : PUnit ↦
          SheafOfModules.unit S).hom = 𝟙 _
    exact Iso.inv_hom_id _
  have hfree :
      (SheafOfModules.mapFreeIso F PUnit η).hom ≫ F.map uR.hom ≫ η.inv =
        uS.hom := by
    apply (SheafOfModules.unit S).freeHomEquiv.injective
    funext i
    apply (SheafOfModules.unit S).unitHomEquiv.symm.injective
    rw [SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv_symm_freeHomEquiv_apply,
      SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv_symm_freeHomEquiv_apply]
    have hι :
        SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := S) i ≫
            (SheafOfModules.mapFreeIso F PUnit η).hom =
          η.hom ≫ F.map (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := R) i) :=
      SheafOfModules.ιFree_mapFreeIso_hom F PUnit η i
    have hcomp :
        F.map (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := R) i) ≫ F.map uR.hom =
          F.map (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := R) i ≫ uR.hom) :=
      (F.map_comp _ _).symm
    have hcomp' :
        η.hom ≫ F.map (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := R) i) ≫
          F.map uR.hom ≫ η.inv =
        η.hom ≫ F.map (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := R) i ≫ uR.hom) ≫
          η.inv := by
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using
        congrArg (fun z ↦ η.hom ≫ z ≫ η.inv) hcomp
    have hleft :
        η.hom ≫ F.map (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := R) i) ≫
          F.map uR.hom ≫ η.inv = 𝟙 _ := by
      calc
        _ = η.hom ≫ F.map
              (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := R) i ≫ uR.hom) ≫ η.inv := hcomp'
        _ = η.hom ≫ F.map (𝟙 _) ≫ η.inv := by rw [hgenR i]
        _ = 𝟙 _ := by
          simpa only [Category.assoc, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp,
            F.map_id, Iso.hom_inv_id]
    have hstep := congrArg
      (fun z ↦ z ≫ F.map uR.hom ≫ η.inv) hι
    calc
      SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := S) i ≫
          ((SheafOfModules.mapFreeIso F PUnit η).hom ≫ F.map uR.hom ≫ η.inv) =
        η.hom ≫ F.map (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := R) i) ≫
          F.map uR.hom ≫ η.inv := by
            simpa only [Category.assoc] using hstep
      _ = 𝟙 _ := hleft
      _ = SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := S) i ≫ uS.hom := by rw [hgenS i]
  exact hfree

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.homEquiv_comp_leftAdjointIso
statement:
theorem homEquiv_comp_leftAdjointIso
    {C : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} C]
    {D : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} D]
    {F₁ F₂ : C ⥤ D} {G₁ G₂ : D ⥤ C}
    (A₁ : F₁ ⊣ G₁) (A₂ : F₂ ⊣ G₂) (e : F₁ ≅ F₂)
    {X : C} {Y : D} (t : F₂.obj X ⟶ Y) :
    A₁.homEquiv X Y (e.hom.app X ≫ t) ≫
        (CategoryTheory.conjugateEquiv A₁ A₂ e.inv).app Y =
      A₂.homEquiv X Y t
proof:
:= by
  let ρ := CategoryTheory.conjugateEquiv A₁ A₂ e.inv
  let η₁ : X ⟶ G₁.obj (F₁.obj X) := by
    simpa only [Functor.comp_obj, Functor.id_obj] using A₁.unit.app X
  let η₂ : X ⟶ G₂.obj (F₂.obj X) := by
    simpa only [Functor.comp_obj, Functor.id_obj] using A₂.unit.app X
  have hu : η₁ ≫ ρ.app (F₁.obj X) =
      η₂ ≫ G₂.map (e.inv.app X) := by
    simpa only [η₁, η₂, ρ, Functor.comp_obj, Functor.id_obj] using
      (CategoryTheory.unit_conjugateEquiv A₁ A₂ e.inv X)
  calc
    _ = η₁ ≫ G₁.map (e.hom.app X) ≫
          (G₁.map t ≫ ρ.app Y) := by
      simp only [Adjunction.homEquiv_apply, η₁, ρ, Functor.comp_obj,
        Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
    _ = η₁ ≫ G₁.map (e.hom.app X) ≫
          (ρ.app (F₂.obj X) ≫ G₂.map t) := by
      rw [ρ.naturality t]
    _ = η₁ ≫ (ρ.app (F₁.obj X) ≫
          G₂.map (e.hom.app X)) ≫ G₂.map t := by
      calc
        _ = (η₁ ≫ (G₁.map (e.hom.app X) ≫
              ρ.app (F₂.obj X))) ≫ G₂.map t := by
            simp only [Category.assoc]
        _ = (η₁ ≫ (ρ.app (F₁.obj X) ≫
              G₂.map (e.hom.app X))) ≫ G₂.map t := by
            rw [ρ.naturality (e.hom.app X)]
        _ = _ := by simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = η₂ ≫ G₂.map (e.inv.app X) ≫
          G₂.map (e.hom.app X) ≫ G₂.map t := by
      calc
        _ = (η₁ ≫ ρ.app (F₁.obj X)) ≫
              G₂.map (e.hom.app X) ≫ G₂.map t := by
            simp only [Category.assoc]
        _ = (η₂ ≫ G₂.map (e.inv.app X)) ≫
              G₂.map (e.hom.app X) ≫ G₂.map t := by
            rw [hu]
        _ = _ := by simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = η₂ ≫ G₂.map t := by
      calc
    _ = η₂ ≫ G₂.map (e.inv.app X ≫ e.hom.app X) ≫ G₂.map t := by
          simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
        _ = η₂ ≫ G₂.map t := by
          simp only [Iso.inv_hom_id_app, G₂.map_id,
            Category.id_comp, Category.assoc]
    _ = A₂.homEquiv X Y t := by
      simpa only [Adjunction.homEquiv_apply, Functor.comp_obj,
        Functor.id_obj, η₂, Category.assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistingSheafRestrictionData_basisComponent_naturality_over
statement:
theorem twistingSheafRestrictionData_basisComponent_naturality_over
    {R S M N ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [Finite ι]
    {b : Module.Basis ι R M} {c : Module.Basis ι S N}
    {d : ℤ} {q : space S N ⟶ space R M} [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (h : ∀ i, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b i) =
      linearOpen S N (c i))
    (D : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c d q)
    (hD : D.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q h).hom)
    (i : ι) (V : (space S N).Opens) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
          (twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b d i)).over V ≫
        (((pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionIso q
            (linearOpen R M (b i))) ≪≫
          eqToIso (congrArg
            (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space S N))
            (h i))).hom).over V =
      D.restrictIso.hom.over V ≫
        (twistingSheafBasisComponent S N c d i).over V
proof:
:= by
  have hι := twistingSheafRestrictionData_basisComponent_naturality
    h D hD i
  exact congrArg (fun f ↦ f.over V) hι

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistingSheafRestrictionData_basisComponent_naturality_openLift
statement:
theorem twistingSheafRestrictionData_basisComponent_naturality_openLift
    {R S M N ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [Finite ι]
    {b : Module.Basis ι R M} {c : Module.Basis ι S N}
    {d : ℤ} {q : space S N ⟶ space R M} [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (h : ∀ i, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b i) =
      linearOpen S N (c i))
    (D : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c d q)
    (hD : D.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q h).hom)
    (i : ι) :
    let U
proof:
:= linearOpen R M (b i)
    let V := linearOpen S N (c i)
    let p := restrictOpenLift q U V (h i)
    let F := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q ⋙
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι
    let K := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι ⋙
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor p
    let e : F ≅ K := restrictFunctorOpenLiftIso q U V (h i)
    let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι
    let PU := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) U
    let T := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d
    let f := twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b d i
    let g := twistingSheafBasisComponent S N c d i
    let cast := pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso q U V (h i)
    K.map f ≫ e.inv.app PU ≫ G.map cast.hom =
      e.inv.app T ≫ (G.map D.restrictIso.hom ≫ G.map g) := by
  dsimp only
  let U := linearOpen R M (b i)
  let V := linearOpen S N (c i)
  let p := restrictOpenLift q U V (h i)
  let F := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q ⋙
    Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι
  let K := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι ⋙
    Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor p
  let e := restrictFunctorOpenLiftIso q U V (h i)
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι
  let PU := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) U
  let T := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d
  let f := twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b d i
  let g := twistingSheafBasisComponent S N c d i
  let cast := pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso q U V (h i)
  have hComponent := twistingSheafRestrictionData_basisComponent_naturality
    h D hD i
  change (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map f ≫ cast.hom =
    D.restrictIso.hom ≫ g at hComponent
  have hComponentV := congrArg G.map hComponent
  change F.map f ≫ G.map cast.hom =
    G.map D.restrictIso.hom ≫ G.map g at hComponentV
  have hInv := e.inv.naturality f
  change K.map f ≫ e.inv.app PU = e.inv.app T ≫ F.map f at hInv
  change (K.map f ≫ e.inv.app PU) ≫ G.map cast.hom =
    e.inv.app T ≫ (G.map D.restrictIso.hom ≫ G.map g)
  calc
    _ = (e.inv.app T ≫ F.map f) ≫ G.map cast.hom := by
      rw [hInv]
    _ = e.inv.app T ≫ (F.map f ≫ G.map cast.hom) := by
      exact Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = e.inv.app T ≫ (G.map D.restrictIso.hom ≫ G.map g) := by
      exact congrArg (fun z ↦ e.inv.app T ≫ z) hComponentV

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictFunctorOpenLiftIso_inv_app_heq
statement:
theorem restrictFunctorOpenLiftIso_inv_app_heq
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (U : X.Opens) (V : Y.Opens) (h : q ⁻¹ᵁ U = V)
    (M : X.Modules) (W : (V : Scheme.{u}).Opens)
    (x : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι ⋙
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (restrictOpenLift q U V h)).obj M).val.obj (op W)) :
    HEq (((restrictFunctorOpenLiftIso q U V h).inv.app M).val.app (op W) x) x
proof:
:= by
  unfold restrictFunctorOpenLiftIso
  rw [Iso.trans_inv, Iso.trans_inv, NatTrans.comp_app, NatTrans.comp_app,
    SheafOfModules.comp_val, PresheafOfModules.comp_app,
    ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  rw [SheafOfModules.comp_val, PresheafOfModules.comp_app,
    ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  change HEq
    ((((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp V.ι q).hom.app M).app W)
      ((((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr
          (restrictOpenLift_ι q U V h).symm).inv.app M).app W)
        ((((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp
            (restrictOpenLift q U V h) U.ι).inv.app M).app W) x))) x
  rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp_inv_app_app,
    Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr_inv_app_app,
    Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp_hom_app_app]
  simp only [eqToHom_op]
  change HEq
    ((M.presheaf ⋙ forget Ab).map (eqToHom _)
      ((M.presheaf ⋙ forget Ab).map (eqToHom _)
        ((M.presheaf ⋙ forget Ab).map (eqToHom _) x))) x
  rw [eqToHom_map_comp_apply, eqToHom_map_comp_apply]
  exact functor_map_eqToHom_heq (M.presheaf ⋙ forget Ab) _ x

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso_naturality
statement:
theorem restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso_naturality
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (U : X.Opens) (V : Y.Opens) (h : q ⁻¹ᵁ U = V)
    {M N : X.Modules} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    let H
proof:
:= Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (restrictOpenLift q U V h)
    H.map ((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map (f.over U)) ≫
      (restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso q U V h N).hom =
    (restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso q U V h M).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V).functor.map
        (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map f).over V) := by
  dsimp only [restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso]
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q
  let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (restrictOpenLift q U V h)
  let F := G ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι
  let K := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι ⋙ H
  let e := restrictFunctorOpenLiftIso q U V h
  let EU := Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U
  let EV := Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V
  have hEU := EU.hom.naturality f
  change (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map (f.over U) ≫
      (EU.app N).hom =
    (EU.app M).hom ≫ (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map f at hEU
  have he : K.map f ≫ (e.app N).inv =
      (e.app M).inv ≫ F.map f := by
    exact e.inv.naturality f
  have hEV := EV.inv.naturality (G.map f)
  change F.map f ≫ (EV.app (G.obj N)).symm.hom =
      (EV.app (G.obj M)).symm.hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V).functor.map ((G.map f).over V) at hEV
  change H.map ((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map (f.over U)) ≫
      (H.map ((EU.app N).hom) ≫ (e.app N).inv ≫
        (EV.app (G.obj N)).symm.hom) =
    (H.map ((EU.app M).hom) ≫ (e.app M).inv ≫
      (EV.app (G.obj M)).symm.hom) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V).functor.map ((G.map f).over V)
  calc
    _ = H.map ((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map (f.over U) ≫
          (EU.app N).hom) ≫ (e.app N).inv ≫
          (EV.app (G.obj N)).symm.hom := by
      simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
    _ = H.map ((EU.app M).hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map f) ≫
          (e.app N).inv ≫ (EV.app (G.obj N)).symm.hom := by
      rw [hEU]
    _ = H.map ((EU.app M).hom) ≫ K.map f ≫
          (e.app N).inv ≫ (EV.app (G.obj N)).symm.hom := by
      simp only [Functor.map_comp, Functor.comp_map, Category.assoc, H, K]
    _ = H.map ((EU.app M).hom) ≫ (e.app M).inv ≫
          F.map f ≫ (EV.app (G.obj N)).symm.hom := by
      slice_lhs 2 3 => rw [he]
      simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = H.map ((EU.app M).hom) ≫ (e.app M).inv ≫
          (EV.app (G.obj M)).symm.hom ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V).functor.map ((G.map f).over V) := by
      rw [hEV]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistingSheafRestrictionData_basisComponent_naturality_overLift
statement:
theorem twistingSheafRestrictionData_basisComponent_naturality_overLift
    {R S M N ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [Finite ι]
    {b : Module.Basis ι R M} {c : Module.Basis ι S N}
    {d : ℤ} {q : space S N ⟶ space R M} [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (h : ∀ i, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b i) =
      linearOpen S N (c i))
    (D : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c d q)
    (hD : D.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q h).hom)
    (i : ι) :
    let U
proof:
:= linearOpen R M (b i)
    let V := linearOpen S N (c i)
    let p := restrictOpenLift q U V (h i)
    let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor p
    let EU := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U
    let EV := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V
    let A := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso q U V (h i)
    let PU := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) U
    let T := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d
    let f := twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b d i
    let g := twistingSheafBasisComponent S N c d i
    let cast := pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso q U V (h i)
    H.map (EU.functor.map (f.over U)) ≫
        (A PU).hom ≫ EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over V) =
      (A T).hom ≫ EV.functor.map (D.restrictIso.hom.over V) ≫
        EV.functor.map (g.over V) := by
  dsimp only
  let U := linearOpen R M (b i)
  let V := linearOpen S N (c i)
  let p := restrictOpenLift q U V (h i)
  let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor p
  let EU := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U
  let EV := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V
  let A := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso q U V (h i)
  let PU := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) U
  let T := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d
  let f := twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b d i
  let g := twistingSheafBasisComponent S N c d i
  let cast := pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso q U V (h i)
  have hAlpha := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso_naturality q U V (h i) f
  have hGlobal := twistingSheafRestrictionData_basisComponent_naturality
    h D hD i
  change (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map f ≫ cast.hom =
    D.restrictIso.hom ≫ g at hGlobal
  have hOver := congrArg (fun z ↦ z.over V) hGlobal
  change ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map f).over V ≫
      cast.hom.over V = D.restrictIso.hom.over V ≫ g.over V at hOver
  have hOverE := congrArg EV.functor.map hOver
  simp only [Functor.map_comp] at hOverE
  change H.map (EU.functor.map (f.over U)) ≫ (A PU).hom ≫
      EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over V) =
    (A T).hom ≫ EV.functor.map (D.restrictIso.hom.over V) ≫
      EV.functor.map (g.over V)
  calc
    _ = (H.map (EU.functor.map (f.over U)) ≫ (A PU).hom) ≫
          EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over V) := by
      simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = ((A T).hom ≫
          EV.functor.map (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map f).over V)) ≫
          EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over V) := by
      rw [hAlpha]
    _ = (A T).hom ≫
          (EV.functor.map (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map f).over V) ≫
            EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over V)) := by
      exact Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = (A T).hom ≫
          (EV.functor.map (D.restrictIso.hom.over V) ≫
            EV.functor.map (g.over V)) := by
      rw [hOverE]
    _ = _ := Category.assoc _ _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistingSheafRestrictionData_tensorNaturality_over
statement:
theorem twistingSheafRestrictionData_tensorNaturality_over
    {R S M N ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [Finite ι]
    {b : Module.Basis ι R M} {c : Module.Basis ι S N}
    {d e : ℤ} {q : space S N ⟶ space R M} [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (Dd : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c d q)
    (De : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c e q)
    (Ds : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c (d + e) q)
    (hTensor :
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
          (intrinsicTwistingTensorHom b d e) ≫ Ds.restrictIso.hom =
        (SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q
            (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d)
            (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b e)).hom ≫
          SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (space S N)
            Dd.restrictIso.hom De.restrictIso.hom ≫
          intrinsicTwistingTensorHom c d e)
    (V : (space S N).Opens) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
          (intrinsicTwistingTensorHom b d e)).over V ≫
        Ds.restrictIso.hom.over V =
      (SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q
          (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d)
          (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b e)).hom.over V ≫
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (space S N)
          Dd.restrictIso.hom De.restrictIso.hom).over V ≫
        (intrinsicTwistingTensorHom c d e).over V
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun f ↦ f.over V) hTensor
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.freePUnitIsoUnit_pullback_naturality
statement:
theorem freePUnitIsoUnit_pullback_naturality
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f PUnit).hom ≫
        (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
          (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map
          (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
            (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)).hom ≫
        (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso f).hom
proof:
:= by
  let F := Scheme.Modules.pullback f
  let q := AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f PUnit
  let uX := SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
    (R := X.ringCatSheaf)
  let uY := SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
    (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)
  let η := SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso f
  have hXgen (i : PUnit) :
      SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i ≫
        (coproductUniqueIso fun _ : PUnit ↦
          SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).hom = 𝟙 _ := by
    obtain rfl : i = default := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    change (coproductUniqueIso fun _ : PUnit ↦
      SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).inv ≫
        (coproductUniqueIso fun _ : PUnit ↦
          SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).hom = 𝟙 _
    exact Iso.inv_hom_id _
  have hYgen (i : PUnit) :
      SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) i ≫
        (coproductUniqueIso fun _ : PUnit ↦
          SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf).hom = 𝟙 _ := by
    obtain rfl : i = default := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    change (coproductUniqueIso fun _ : PUnit ↦
      SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf).inv ≫
        (coproductUniqueIso fun _ : PUnit ↦
          SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf).hom = 𝟙 _
    exact Iso.inv_hom_id _
  have hfree : uX.hom = q.inv ≫ F.map uY.hom ≫ η.hom := by
    apply (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).freeHomEquiv.injective
    funext i
    apply (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).unitHomEquiv.symm.injective
    rw [SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv_symm_freeHomEquiv_apply,
      SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv_symm_freeHomEquiv_apply]
    simp only [uX, uY, η, q, SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit]
    have hgen :
        SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i ≫
            (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f PUnit).inv =
          (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso f).inv ≫
            F.map (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) i) :=
      SchemeKTheory.ιFree_comp_pullbackObjFreeIso_inv f i
    rw [← Category.assoc, hgen]
    rw [← Category.assoc
      ((SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso f).inv ≫
        F.map (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) i))
      (F.map ((coproductUniqueIso fun _ : PUnit ↦
        SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf).hom))
      (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso f).hom]
    rw [Category.assoc (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso f).inv
      (F.map (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) i))
      (F.map ((coproductUniqueIso fun _ : PUnit ↦
        SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf).hom))]
    rw [← F.map_comp, hYgen i, hXgen i]
    change 𝟙 (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X) =
      ((SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso f).inv ≫
        F.map (𝟙 (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y))) ≫
        (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso f).hom
    have hId : F.map (𝟙 (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y)) =
        𝟙 (F.obj (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y)) := F.map_id _
    rw [hId, Category.comp_id]
    exact (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso f).inv_hom_id.symm
  calc
    _ = q.hom ≫ (q.inv ≫ F.map uY.hom ≫ η.hom) := by rw [hfree]
    _ = F.map uY.hom ≫ η.hom := by simp [Category.assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictOpenLiftFreePUnitIso_naturality
statement:
theorem restrictOpenLiftFreePUnitIso_naturality
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion p] :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor p).map
        (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
          (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback p).hom.app
        (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) =
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback p).hom.app
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback p).map
        (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
          (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).hom
proof:
:= by
  exact (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback p).hom.naturality
    (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
      (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).hom

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictOpenLiftFreePUnitIso_pullback_naturality
statement:
theorem restrictOpenLiftFreePUnitIso_pullback_naturality
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion p] :
    (restrictOpenLiftFreePUnitIso p).hom ≫
        (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
          (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor p).map
          (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
            (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback p).hom.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) ≫
        (pullbackUnitToTensorUnitIso p).hom ≫
        (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso p).hom
proof:
:= by
  let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor p
  let F := Scheme.Modules.pullback p
  let β := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback p
  let q := AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso p PUnit
  let uX := SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)
  let uY := SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)
  let η := SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso p
  let θ := pullbackUnitToTensorUnitIso p
  let eX := eqToIso (show SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf =
    SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X by rfl)
  have hPull : q.hom ≫ uY.hom = F.map uX.hom ≫ η.hom :=
    freePUnitIsoUnit_pullback_naturality p
  have heX : uX.hom ≫ eX.hom = uX.hom := by
    simp only [eX, eqToIso_refl, Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
  have hTheta : F.map uX.hom ≫ θ.hom = F.map uX.hom := by
    change F.map uX.hom ≫ F.map eX.hom = F.map uX.hom
    rw [← F.map_comp, heX]
  change (β.app (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit)).hom ≫
      q.hom ≫ uY.hom = H.map uX.hom ≫
        (β.app (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).hom ≫ θ.hom ≫ η.hom
  calc
    _ = (β.app (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit)).hom ≫
          (q.hom ≫ uY.hom) := by
      exact Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = (β.app (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit)).hom ≫
          (F.map uX.hom ≫ η.hom) := by
      rw [hPull]
    _ = ((β.app (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit)).hom ≫
          F.map uX.hom) ≫ η.hom := by
      exact Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = ((β.app (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit)).hom ≫
          F.map uX.hom ≫ θ.hom) ≫ η.hom := by
      exact congrArg
        (fun z ↦ ((β.app (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit)).hom ≫ z) ≫ η.hom)
        hTheta.symm
    _ = ((β.app (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit)).hom ≫
          F.map uX.hom) ≫ θ.hom ≫ η.hom := by
      exact congrArg (fun z ↦ z ≫ η.hom) (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = (H.map uX.hom ≫
          (β.app (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).hom) ≫ θ.hom ≫ η.hom := by
      exact congrArg (fun z ↦ z ≫ θ.hom ≫ η.hom)
        (β.hom.naturality uX.hom).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictOverEquivIso_hom_overFunctorEquiv_naturality
statement:
theorem restrictOverEquivIso_hom_overFunctorEquiv_naturality
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {U V : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) (M : Y.Modules) :
    (restrictOverEquivIso h M).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE h)).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.app M) =
      (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V).hom.app M ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr
          (Scheme.homOfLE_ι Y h).symm).hom.app M ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp (Y.homOfLE h) U.ι).hom.app M
proof:
:= by
  let F := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE h)
  let αU := (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app M
  have hcancel : F.map αU.inv ≫ F.map αU.hom = 𝟙 _ := by
    have h := congrArg F.map αU.inv_hom_id
    simpa [F, αU] using h
  unfold restrictOverEquivIso restrictFunctorOpenCompIso'
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Category.assoc]
  let pre := (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V).hom.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr
        (Scheme.homOfLE_ι Y h).symm).hom.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp (Y.homOfLE h) U.ι).hom.app M
  change pre ≫ (F.map αU.inv ≫ F.map αU.hom) = pre
  exact congrArg (fun z ↦ pre ≫ z) hcancel

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.overEquivTensorUnitIso_restrict_naturality
statement:
theorem overEquivTensorUnitIso_restrict_naturality
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {U V : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) :
    (restrictOverEquivIso h (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y)).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE h)).map
          (overEquivTensorUnitIso Y U).hom =
      (overEquivTensorUnitIso Y V).hom ≫
        (pullbackUnitRestrictIso h).hom
proof:
:= by
  let hcomp : Y.homOfLE h ≫ U.ι = V.ι := Scheme.homOfLE_ι Y h
  have hAlpha := restrictOverEquivIso_hom_overFunctorEquiv_naturality h
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y)
  let F := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE h)
  let αU := (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y)
  let pullU := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).hom.app
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y)
  let etaU := (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso U.ι).hom
  let tail := F.map pullU ≫ F.map etaU
  unfold overEquivTensorUnitIso
  rw [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.trans_hom, Functor.map_comp]
  calc
    _ = ((restrictOverEquivIso h (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y)).hom ≫
          F.map αU.hom) ≫ tail := by
      simp only [SchemeKTheory.overEquivFunctorObj_overIso_pullbackObj,
        Iso.trans_hom, Iso.app_hom, F, αU, pullU, etaU, tail, Functor.map_comp,
        Category.assoc]
    _ = (((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V).hom.app
            (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr
            (Scheme.homOfLE_ι Y h).symm).hom.app
            (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y)) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp
            (Y.homOfLE h) U.ι).hom.app
              (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y)) ≫ tail := by
      change
        ((restrictOverEquivIso h (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y)).hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE h)).map
            ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.app
              (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y))) ≫ tail =
        (((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V).hom.app
              (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y) ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr
              (Scheme.homOfLE_ι Y h).symm).hom.app
              (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y)) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp (Y.homOfLE h) U.ι).hom.app
            (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y)) ≫ tail
      exact congrArg (fun z ↦ z ≫ tail) hAlpha
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [SchemeKTheory.overEquivFunctorObj_overIso_pullbackObj,
        pullbackUnitRestrictIso, pullbackRestrictionCompIso, tail,
        Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.app_hom, Iso.app_inv,
        Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.mapIso_inv,
        Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app, Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc,
        Category.assoc, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
      rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.unitToPushforwardObjUnit_comp
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem unitToPushforwardObjUnit_comp
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit (g.toRingCatSheafHom) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).map
        (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit (f.toRingCatSheafHom)) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f g).hom.app
        (SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf)) =
    SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
      ((f ≫ g).toRingCatSheafHom)
proof:
:= by
  ext U x
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackObjUnitIso_comp_hom
statement:
theorem pullbackObjUnitIso_comp_hom
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f g).hom.app
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Z) ≫
      (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso (f ≫ g)).hom =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map
        (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso g).hom ≫
      (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso f).hom
proof:
:= by
  let A := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).comp
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f)
  let B := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (f ≫ g)
  let c := Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f g
  let k := Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f g
  let O := SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Z
  let I := SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X
  let u := (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso (f ≫ g)).hom
  let v := (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso g).hom
  let w := (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso f).hom
  let Af := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f
  let Ag := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g
  let ug := SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
    (g.toRingCatSheafHom)
  let uf := SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
    (f.toRingCatSheafHom)
  have hF : Af.homEquiv ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj O) I
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map v ≫ w) = v ≫ uf := by
    calc
      _ = v ≫ Af.homEquiv (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y) I w :=
        Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left Af v w
      _ = v ≫ uf := by
        change v ≫
            (SheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f.toRingCatSheafHom).homEquiv
              _ _ (SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit f.toRingCatSheafHom) =
          v ≫ SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit f.toRingCatSheafHom
        erw [SheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction_homEquiv_pullbackObjUnitToUnit]
  have hG : Ag.homEquiv O ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj I)
        (v ≫ uf) = ug ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).map uf := by
    calc
      _ = Ag.homEquiv O (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y) v ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).map uf :=
        Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right Ag v uf
      _ = ug ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).map uf := by
        change
          (SheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g.toRingCatSheafHom).homEquiv
              _ _ (SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit g.toRingCatSheafHom) ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).map uf =
          SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit g.toRingCatSheafHom ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).map uf
        erw [SheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction_homEquiv_pullbackObjUnitToUnit]
  have hL := homEquiv_comp_leftAdjointIso A B c u
  rw [Scheme.Modules.conjugateEquiv_pullbackComp_inv f g] at hL
  have hR : A.homEquiv O I
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map v ≫ w) ≫ k.hom.app I =
      B.homEquiv O I u := by
    calc
      _ = (Ag.homEquiv O ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj I)
            (Af.homEquiv ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj O) I
              ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map v ≫ w))) ≫ k.hom.app I := by
          change
            ((Af.homEquiv ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj O) I).trans
              (Ag.homEquiv O ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj I)))
                ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map v ≫ w) ≫ k.hom.app I =
              (Ag.homEquiv O ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj I)
                (Af.homEquiv ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj O) I
                  ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map v ≫ w))) ≫ k.hom.app I
          rfl
      _ = (ug ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).map uf) ≫ k.hom.app I := by
          rw [hF, hG]
      _ = SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
            ((f ≫ g).toRingCatSheafHom) := unitToPushforwardObjUnit_comp f g
      _ = B.homEquiv O I u := by
          change SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit ((f ≫ g).toRingCatSheafHom) =
            (SheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
              ((f ≫ g).toRingCatSheafHom)).homEquiv _ _
              (SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit ((f ≫ g).toRingCatSheafHom))
          erw [SheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction_homEquiv_pullbackObjUnitToUnit]
  apply (A.homEquiv O I).injective
  apply (cancel_mono (k.hom.app I)).1
  exact hL.trans hR.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso_hom_app_heq
statement:
theorem pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso_hom_app_heq
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (U : Y.Opens) (W : (U : Scheme.{u}).Opens)
    (s : Γ(SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y U, U.ι ''ᵁ W)) :
    HEq ((pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso Y U).hom.app W s) s
proof:
:= by
  change HEq
    ((ConcreteCategory.hom
      (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
        (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso U.ι).hom.app
            (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules U.toScheme)) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).inv) W)) s) s
  rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  change HEq
    ((((Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).inv.app W).hom)
      ((((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction U.ι).counit.app
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules U.toScheme)).app W).hom s)) s
  rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction_counit_app_app]
  simp [Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso, Scheme.Modules.Hom.app,
    Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso]
  exact functor_map_eqToHom_heq
    ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules U.toScheme).presheaf ⋙ forget Ab) _ s

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso_restriction_naturality
statement:
theorem pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso_restriction_naturality
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {U V : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) :
    (restrictFunctorOpenCompIso' h
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y U)).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE h)).map
        (pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso Y U).hom ≫
      (restrictFunctorOpenCompIso' h
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y)).inv =
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).map
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction h) ≫
      (pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso Y V).hom
proof:
:= by
  ext W s
  let W0 : Y.Opens := V.ι ''ᵁ W
  have hW0 : W0 ≤ V := by
    calc
      W0 ≤ V.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : (V : Scheme.{u}).Opens) :=
        Scheme.Hom.image_mono V.ι le_top
      _ = V := by
        rw [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
  let U₁ : (U : Scheme.{u}).Opens := (Y.homOfLE h) ''ᵁ W
  let ePU := restrictFunctorOpenCompIso' h
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y U)
  let eUnit := restrictFunctorOpenCompIso' h
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y)
  let x₁ := ePU.hom.val.app (op W) s
  let x₂ := (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE h)).map
      (pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso Y U).hom).val.app (op W)) x₁
  let x₃ := eUnit.inv.val.app (op W) x₂
  let y₁ := (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).map
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction h)).val.app (op W)) s
  let y₂ := (pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso Y V).hom.val.app (op W) y₁
  apply eq_of_heq
  change HEq x₃ y₂
  have hx₁ : HEq x₁ s :=
    restrictFunctorOpenCompIso'_hom_app_heq h
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y U) W s
  have hx₂ : HEq x₂ x₁ := by
    change HEq ((pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso Y U).hom.app U₁ x₁) x₁
    exact pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso_hom_app_heq U U₁ x₁
  have hx₃ : HEq x₃ x₂ :=
    restrictFunctorOpenCompIso'_inv_app_heq h
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y) W x₂
  have hy₁ : HEq y₁ s := by
    change HEq ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction h).app W0 s) s
    exact SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction_app_of_le_heq
      h W0 hW0 s
  have hy₂ : HEq y₂ y₁ := by
    change HEq ((pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso Y V).hom.app W y₁) y₁
    exact pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso_hom_app_heq V W y₁
  exact (hx₃.trans (hx₂.trans hx₁)).trans
    (hy₁.symm.trans hy₂.symm)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictAdjunction_homEquiv_restrictUnitIso_hom
statement:
theorem restrictAdjunction_homEquiv_restrictUnitIso_hom
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q] :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).homEquiv
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y)
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).hom =
      SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit q.toRingCatSheafHom
proof:
:= by
  let A := Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q
  let u := SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit q.toRingCatSheafHom
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_apply]
  ext W x
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app,
    AddCommGrpCat.Hom.comp_apply, Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app]
  rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app]
  change
    ((X.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (Set.image_preimage_subset q W.1)).op ≫
        (q.appIso (q ⁻¹ᵁ W)).hom) x) =
      (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
        q.toRingCatSheafHom).val.app (op W) x
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.app_appIso_inv q W]
  rw [SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit_val_app_apply]
  change
    (q.app W ≫ (q.appIso (q ⁻¹ᵁ W)).inv ≫
      (q.appIso (q ⁻¹ᵁ W)).hom) x = (q.app W) x
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.id_comp,
    ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso_inv_hom
statement:
theorem pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso_inv_hom
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (U : Y.Opens) :
    (pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso Y U).inv =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map
        (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit U.ι.toRingCatSheafHom)
proof:
:= by
  let A := Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction U.ι
  let u := SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit U.ι.toRingCatSheafHom
  let e := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso U.ι).app
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules U.toScheme)
  have hRestr := restrictAdjunction_homEquiv_restrictUnitIso_hom U.ι
  have hSymm :
      (A.homEquiv (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y)
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf U.toScheme)).symm u =
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).hom := by
    apply (A.homEquiv (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y)
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf U.toScheme)).injective
    simpa [A, u] using hRestr.symm
  have hTriangle :
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map u ≫
          A.counit.app (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf U.toScheme) := by
    rw [← hSymm, Adjunction.homEquiv_symm_apply]
    rfl
  have hCounit :
      A.counit.app (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf U.toScheme) = e.hom := by
    rfl
  change
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).hom ≫
        e.inv = _
  calc
    _ = ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map u ≫ e.hom) ≫ e.inv := by
      rw [hTriangle, hCounit]
      rfl
    _ = (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map u ≫ (e.hom ≫ e.inv) :=
      Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map u ≫ 𝟙 _ :=
      congrArg (fun z ↦ (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map u ≫ z)
        e.hom_inv_id
    _ = (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map u := Category.comp_id _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushedUnitOpenOverIso_inv_eq_unitToPushforward
statement:
theorem pushedUnitOpenOverIso_inv_eq_unitToPushforward
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (U : Y.Opens) :
    (pushedUnitOpenOverIso Y U).inv =
      (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
        U.ι.toRingCatSheafHom).over U
proof:
:= by
  let E := (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor
  let P := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y U
  let Q := SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y
  let αP := (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app P
  let αQ := (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app Q
  let c := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso U.ι).app
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules U.toScheme)
  let r := Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι
  let u := SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
    U.ι.toRingCatSheafHom
  have hIso : E.mapIso (pushedUnitOpenOverIso Y U) =
      αP ≪≫ c ≪≫ r.symm ≪≫ αQ.symm := by
    apply Iso.ext
    simpa [E, αP, αQ, c, r] using
      (pushedUnitOpenOverIso_equiv Y U)
  have hInv := congrArg Iso.inv hIso
  have hMapInv : E.map (pushedUnitOpenOverIso Y U).inv =
      (αP ≪≫ c ≪≫ r.symm ≪≫ αQ.symm).inv := by
    simpa only [Functor.mapIso_inv] using hInv
  have hNat := (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.naturality u
  change E.map (u.over U) ≫ αP.hom = αQ.hom ≫
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map u at hNat
  have hScheme := pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso_inv_hom Y U
  have hScheme' : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map u =
      (pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso Y U).inv := by
    change (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map
        (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit U.ι.toRingCatSheafHom) =
      (pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso Y U).inv
    exact hScheme.symm
  have hUnitIso : (pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso Y U).inv =
      r.hom ≫ c.inv := by
    dsimp only [pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso, r, c, Iso.trans_inv,
      Iso.symm_inv]
    rfl
  have hUnitRestr := hScheme'.trans hUnitIso
  have hMove : E.map (u.over U) =
      (αP ≪≫ c ≪≫ r.symm ≪≫ αQ.symm).inv := by
    apply (cancel_mono αP.hom).1
    calc
      E.map (u.over U) ≫ αP.hom =
          αQ.hom ≫ (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map u := hNat
      _ = αQ.hom ≫ r.hom ≫ c.inv := by
          simpa only [Category.assoc] using
            congrArg (fun f => αQ.hom ≫ f) hUnitRestr
      _ = (αP ≪≫ c ≪≫ r.symm ≪≫ αQ.symm).inv ≫ αP.hom := by
          simp only [Iso.trans_inv, Iso.symm_inv, Category.assoc,
            Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  apply E.map_injective
  rw [hMapInv]
  exact hMove.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictOpenImmersionTensorUnitIso_eq_restrictUnitIso
statement:
theorem restrictOpenImmersionTensorUnitIso_eq_restrictUnitIso
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q] :
    (restrictOpenImmersionTensorUnitIso q).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).hom
proof:
:= by
  let A := Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q
  let B := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q
  let u := SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit q.toRingCatSheafHom
  have hRestr := restrictAdjunction_homEquiv_restrictUnitIso_hom q
  have hBridge :
      A.homEquiv (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y)
          (restrictOpenImmersionTensorUnitIso q).hom = u := by
    change A.homEquiv _ _
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).hom.app
            (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X) ≫
          (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso q).hom) = u
    calc
      _ =
          A.homEquiv _ _
              ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).hom.app
                (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)) ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map
              (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso q).hom :=
        Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right A
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).hom.app
            (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X))
          (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso q).hom
      _ =
          B.unit.app (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X) ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map
              (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso q).hom := by
        change
          A.homEquiv _ _
              ((A.leftAdjointUniq B).hom.app
                (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)) ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map
              (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso q).hom = _
        rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app]
      _ =
          B.homEquiv _ _ (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso q).hom := by
        simpa only [Category.id_comp, Adjunction.homEquiv_unit] using
          (Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right B
            (𝟙 ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).obj
              (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)))
            (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso q).hom).symm
      _ = u := by
        change
          (SheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
            q.toRingCatSheafHom).homEquiv _ _
            (SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit
              q.toRingCatSheafHom) = _
        erw [SheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction_homEquiv_pullbackObjUnitToUnit]
  apply (A.homEquiv _ _).injective
  exact hBridge.trans hRestr.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictUnitIso_comp_hom
statement:
theorem restrictUnitIso_comp_hom
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion f] [IsOpenImmersion g] :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp g f).hom.app
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor g).map
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso f).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso g).hom =
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso (g ≫ f)).hom
proof:
:= by
  ext W x
  change
    (g.appIso W).hom
        ((f.appIso (g ''ᵁ W)).hom
          ((X.presheaf.map (eqToHom (by simp)).op) x)) =
      ((g ≫ f).appIso W).hom x
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_appIso g f W]
  simp [Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictUnitIso_congr_inv_hom
statement:
theorem restrictUnitIso_congr_inv_hom
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f g : Y ⟶ X}
    [IsOpenImmersion f] [IsOpenImmersion g] (h : f = g) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr h.symm).inv.app
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso g).hom =
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso f).hom
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  have hh := restrictFunctorCongr_refl_hom_app f
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)
  have hi :
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr (rfl : f = f)).inv.app
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X) = 𝟙 _ := by
    have h' := congrArg
      (fun a ↦ a ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr (rfl : f = f)).inv.app
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)) hh
    simpa using h'.symm
  rw [hi]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictUnitIso_openLift_naturality
statement:
theorem restrictUnitIso_openLift_naturality
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (U : X.Opens) (V : Y.Opens) (h : q ⁻¹ᵁ U = V) :
    let p
proof:
:= restrictOpenLift q U V h
    let R := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι
    let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor p
    let e := restrictFunctorOpenLiftIso q U V h
    H.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso p).hom =
      (e.app (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)).inv ≫
        R.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso V.ι).hom := by
  dsimp only
  let p := restrictOpenLift q U V h
  let R := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι
  let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor p
  let e := restrictFunctorOpenLiftIso q U V h
  let cL := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp p U.ι
  let cR := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp V.ι q
  have hLift : p ≫ U.ι = V.ι ≫ q := restrictOpenLift_ι q U V h
  have hL := restrictUnitIso_comp_hom U.ι p
  have hR := restrictUnitIso_comp_hom q V.ι
  have hC := restrictUnitIso_congr_inv_hom hLift
  calc
    _ = cL.inv.app (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X) ≫
          (cL.hom.app (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X) ≫
            H.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).hom ≫
              (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso p).hom) := by
      rw [← Category.assoc, cL.inv_hom_id_app, Category.id_comp]
    _ = cL.inv.app (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso (p ≫ U.ι)).hom := by
      rw [← hL]
    _ = cL.inv.app (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X) ≫
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr hLift.symm).inv.app
              (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X) ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso (V.ι ≫ q)).hom) := by
      rw [hC]
    _ = cL.inv.app (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X) ≫
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr hLift.symm).inv.app
              (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X) ≫
            (cR.hom.app (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X) ≫
              R.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).hom ≫
                (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso V.ι).hom)) := by
      rw [← hR]
    _ = _ := by
      dsimp only [e, cL, cR]
      unfold restrictFunctorOpenLiftIso
      rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionIso_hom_app
statement:
theorem pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionIso_hom_app
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (U : X.Opens) (W : Y.Opens)
    (x : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X U), W)) :
    ((pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionIso q U).hom.app W) x =
      (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionSectionIso q U W).hom x
proof:
:= by
  change (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionSectionIso q U W).hom x =
    (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionSectionIso q U W).hom x
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictUnitToPushforwardOpenImmersion_naturality
statement:
theorem restrictUnitToPushforwardOpenImmersion_naturality
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q] (U : X.Opens) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
        (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit U.ι.toRingCatSheafHom) ≫
      (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionIso q U).hom =
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).hom ≫
      SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι.toRingCatSheafHom
proof:
:= by
  let uU : SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X U :=
    SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
      (Scheme.Hom.toRingCatSheafHom U.ι)
  let uV : SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y ⟶
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y (q ⁻¹ᵁ U) :=
    SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
      (Scheme.Hom.toRingCatSheafHom (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι)
  let W : Y.Opens := ⊤
  let B : X.Opens := U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (q ''ᵁ W))
  let A : Y.Opens := (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ ((q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)
  apply (cancel_epi (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).inv).1
  have hcancel :
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).inv ≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).hom ≫ uV) = uV := by
    exact Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q) _
  conv_rhs =>
    dsimp only [SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit,
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules]
    change (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).inv ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).hom ≫ uV)
    rw [hcancel]
  apply SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModulesHom_ext_top
  unfold SheafOfModules.evaluation
  rw [Functor.comp_map]
  rw [Functor.comp_map]
  simp only [PresheafOfModules.evaluation_map,
    SheafOfModules.forget_map]
  change
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).inv ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
          (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
            (Scheme.Hom.toRingCatSheafHom U.ι)) ≫
        (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionIso q U).hom).app
          (⊤ : Y.Opens) (1 : Y.presheaf.obj (op (⊤ : Y.Opens))) =
      uV.app (⊤ : Y.Opens)
        (1 : Y.presheaf.obj (op (⊤ : Y.Opens)))
  have hInvOne :
      ConcreteCategory.hom
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).inv.app W)
          (1 : Y.presheaf.obj (op W)) =
        (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op (q ''ᵁ W))) := by
    change (q.appIso W).inv (1 : Y.presheaf.obj (op W)) =
      (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op (q ''ᵁ W)))
    exact map_one _
  have hBaseOne :
      ConcreteCategory.hom
          (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map uU).app W)
          ((ConcreteCategory.hom
              ((Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).inv.app W))
            (1 : Y.presheaf.obj (op W))) =
      (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op B)) := by
    change ConcreteCategory.hom (uU.app (q ''ᵁ W))
      ((ConcreteCategory.hom ((Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).inv.app W))
        (1 : Y.presheaf.obj (op W))) =
      (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op B))
    rw [hInvOne]
    change ConcreteCategory.hom
        ((SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
          (Scheme.Hom.toRingCatSheafHom U.ι)).val.app
            (op (q ''ᵁ W)))
      (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op (q ''ᵁ W))) =
      (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op B))
    rw [SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit_val_app_apply]
    change
      (Scheme.Hom.toRingCatSheafHom U.ι).hom.app
          (op (q ''ᵁ W))
          (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op (q ''ᵁ W))) =
        (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op B))
    exact map_one _
  have hComparisonOne :
      ConcreteCategory.hom
          ((pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionIso q U).hom.app W)
          (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op B)) =
        (1 : Y.presheaf.obj (op A)) := by
    rw [pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionIso_hom_app]
    change (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionSectionRingIso q U W).hom
        (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op B)) =
      (1 : Y.presheaf.obj (op A))
    exact map_one _
  have hRightOne :
      ConcreteCategory.hom (uV.app W) (1 : Y.presheaf.obj (op W)) =
        (1 : Y.presheaf.obj (op A)) := by
    change ConcreteCategory.hom
        ((SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
          (Scheme.Hom.toRingCatSheafHom (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι)).val.app (op W))
        (1 : Y.presheaf.obj (op W)) = (1 : Y.presheaf.obj (op A))
    rw [SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit_val_app_apply]
    change
      (Scheme.Hom.toRingCatSheafHom (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).hom.app
          (op W) (1 : Y.presheaf.obj (op W)) =
        (1 : Y.presheaf.obj (op A))
    exact map_one _
  change
    ConcreteCategory.hom
        ((pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionIso q U).hom.app W)
        ((ConcreteCategory.hom
            (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map uU).app W))
          ((ConcreteCategory.hom
              ((Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).inv.app W))
            (1 : Y.presheaf.obj (op W)))) =
      ConcreteCategory.hom (uV.app W) (1 : Y.presheaf.obj (op W))
  rw [hBaseOne, hComparisonOne, hRightOne]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso_openLift_naturality
statement:
theorem pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso_openLift_naturality
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (U : X.Opens) (V : Y.Opens) (h : q ⁻¹ᵁ U = V) :
    let p
proof:
:= restrictOpenLift q U V h
    let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor p
    let R := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι
    let e := restrictFunctorOpenLiftIso q U V h
    let PU := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X U
    let cast := pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso q U V h
    H.map (pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso X U).hom ≫
        H.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso p).hom =
      e.inv.app PU ≫ R.map cast.hom ≫
        (pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso Y V).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso V.ι).hom := by
  cases h
  dsimp only
  let p := restrictOpenLift q U (q ⁻¹ᵁ U) rfl
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q
  let R := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι
  let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor p
  let F := G ⋙ R
  let K := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι
  let J := K ⋙ H
  let e := restrictFunctorOpenLiftIso q U (q ⁻¹ᵁ U) rfl
  let PU := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X U
  let cast := pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso q U
    (q ⁻¹ᵁ U) rfl
  let αU := Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι
  let αq := Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q
  let αp := Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso p
  let αV := Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι
  let uX := SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit U.ι.toRingCatSheafHom
  let uY := SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
    (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι.toRingCatSheafHom
  let Lunit : H.obj (K.obj (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)) ≅
      SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf (q ⁻¹ᵁ U : Scheme) :=
    H.mapIso αU ≪≫ αp
  let Runit : H.obj (K.obj (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)) ≅
      SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf (q ⁻¹ᵁ U : Scheme) :=
    (e.app (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)).symm ≪≫
      R.mapIso αq ≪≫ αV
  let L : H.obj (K.obj PU) ≅
      SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf (q ⁻¹ᵁ U : Scheme) :=
    H.mapIso (pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso X U) ≪≫
      H.mapIso αU ≪≫ αp
  let T : H.obj (K.obj PU) ≅
      SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf (q ⁻¹ᵁ U : Scheme) :=
    (e.app PU).symm ≪≫ R.mapIso cast ≪≫
      pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso Y (q ⁻¹ᵁ U) ≪≫ αV
  have hUnit : Lunit = Runit := by
    apply Iso.ext
    simpa only [Lunit, Runit, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom,
      Functor.mapIso_hom, e, αU, αq, αp, αV, H, R] using
      (restrictUnitIso_openLift_naturality q U (q ⁻¹ᵁ U) rfl)
  have hUnitInvIso : Lunit.inv = Runit.inv :=
    congrArg Iso.inv hUnit
  have hE : F.map uX ≫ e.hom.app PU =
      e.hom.app (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X) ≫ J.map uX :=
    e.hom.naturality uX
  have hBase : G.map uX ≫ cast.hom = αq.hom ≫ uY := by
    simpa only [cast, pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso,
      Iso.trans_hom, Iso.refl_hom, eqToIso_refl, Category.comp_id,
      G, αq, uX, uY] using
      (restrictUnitToPushforwardOpenImmersion_naturality q U)
  have hBaseInv : G.map uX = αq.hom ≫ uY ≫ cast.inv := by
    calc
      G.map uX = G.map uX ≫ (cast.hom ≫ cast.inv) := by
        rw [Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
      _ = (G.map uX ≫ cast.hom) ≫ cast.inv := by
        exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = (αq.hom ≫ uY) ≫ cast.inv := by rw [hBase]
      _ = αq.hom ≫ uY ≫ cast.inv := by
        exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
  have hF : F.map uX =
      R.map αq.hom ≫ R.map uY ≫ R.map cast.inv := by
    have h := congrArg R.map hBaseInv
    simpa only [F, Functor.comp_map, Functor.map_comp] using h
  have hInv : L.inv = T.inv := by
    change αp.inv ≫ H.map αU.inv ≫
          H.map (pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso X U).inv =
        αV.inv ≫ (pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso Y
          (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)).inv ≫ R.map cast.inv ≫ e.hom.app PU
    rw [pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso_inv_hom,
      pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso_inv_hom]
    calc
      _ = Lunit.inv ≫ J.map uX := by
        simp only [Lunit, Iso.trans_inv, Functor.mapIso_inv,
          J, K, uX, Functor.comp_map]
        exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = Runit.inv ≫ J.map uX := by rw [hUnitInvIso]
      _ = αV.inv ≫ R.map αq.inv ≫
          (e.hom.app (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X) ≫ J.map uX) := by
        simp only [Runit, Iso.trans_inv, Iso.symm_inv,
          Functor.mapIso_inv]
        simp only [Category.assoc]
        rfl
      _ = αV.inv ≫ R.map αq.inv ≫
          (F.map uX ≫ e.hom.app PU) := by rw [← hE]
      _ = αV.inv ≫ R.map αq.inv ≫
          (R.map αq.hom ≫ R.map uY ≫ R.map cast.inv) ≫
            e.hom.app PU := by rw [hF]
      _ = αV.inv ≫ R.map uY ≫ R.map cast.inv ≫ e.hom.app PU := by
        have hCancel : R.map αq.inv ≫ R.map αq.hom = 𝟙 _ := by
          calc
            _ = R.map (αq.inv ≫ αq.hom) :=
              (Functor.map_comp R αq.inv αq.hom).symm
            _ = R.map (𝟙 _) := congrArg R.map (Iso.inv_hom_id αq)
            _ = 𝟙 _ := R.map_id _
        calc
          _ = αV.inv ≫ (R.map αq.inv ≫ R.map αq.hom) ≫
              R.map uY ≫ R.map cast.inv ≫ e.hom.app PU := by
                simp only [Category.assoc]
          _ = αV.inv ≫ R.map uY ≫ R.map cast.inv ≫ e.hom.app PU := by
                rw [hCancel, Category.id_comp]
  calc
    L.hom = L.hom ≫ (T.inv ≫ T.hom) := by
      rw [T.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
    _ = (L.hom ≫ T.inv) ≫ T.hom := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = (L.hom ≫ L.inv) ≫ T.hom := by rw [hInv]
    _ = T.hom := by rw [L.hom_inv_id, Category.id_comp]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushedUnitOpenOverIso_restriction
statement:
theorem pushedUnitOpenOverIso_restriction
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {U V : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) :
    Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE Y h
        (pushedUnitOpenOverIso Y U).hom =
      (pushedUnitToOpenOverIso h).hom ≫
        (pushedUnitOpenOverIso Y V).hom
proof:
:= by
  let E := (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V).functor
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι
  let F := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE h)
  let PUU := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y U
  let PUV := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y V
  let Q := SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y
  let ηPU := (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app PUU
  let ηQU := (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app Q
  let ηPUV := (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V).app PUU
  let ηPVV := (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V).app PUV
  let ηQV := (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V).app Q
  let cPU := restrictFunctorOpenCompIso' h PUU
  let cQ := restrictFunctorOpenCompIso' h Q
  let eU := pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso Y U
  let eV := pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso Y V
  let RPU := restrictOverEquivIso h PUU
  let RQ := restrictOverEquivIso h Q
  let EU := (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor
  apply E.map_injective
  rw [overEquiv_map_restrictHomOverLE]
  have hT : E.map (pushedUnitToOpenOverIso h).hom =
      ηPUV.hom ≫ G.map (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction h) ≫
        ηPVV.inv := by
    apply (cancel_mono ηPVV.hom).1
    change E.map ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction h).over V) ≫
        ηPVV.hom = ηPUV.hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).map
            (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction h)
    exact (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V).hom.naturality
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction h)
  have hP : RPU.hom ≫ F.map ηPU.hom = ηPUV.hom ≫ cPU.hom := by
    change (restrictOverEquivIso h PUU).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE h)).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.app PUU) =
      (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V).hom.app PUU ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr
          (Scheme.homOfLE_ι Y h).symm).hom.app PUU ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp (Y.homOfLE h) U.ι).hom.app PUU
    exact restrictOverEquivIso_hom_overFunctorEquiv_naturality h PUU
  have hQ : RQ ≪≫ F.mapIso ηQU = ηQV ≪≫ cQ := by
    apply Iso.ext
    change (restrictOverEquivIso h Q).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE h)).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.app Q) =
      (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V).hom.app Q ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr
          (Scheme.homOfLE_ι Y h).symm).hom.app Q ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp (Y.homOfLE h) U.ι).hom.app Q
    exact restrictOverEquivIso_hom_overFunctorEquiv_naturality h Q
  have hQinv : F.map ηQU.inv ≫ RQ.inv = cQ.inv ≫ ηQV.inv := by
    have h := congrArg Iso.inv hQ
    simpa only [Iso.trans_inv, Functor.mapIso_inv] using h
  have hOU : EU.map (pushedUnitOpenOverIso Y U).hom =
      ηPU.hom ≫ eU.hom ≫ ηQU.inv := by
    rw [pushedUnitOpenOverIso_equiv Y U]
    rfl
  have hOV : E.map (pushedUnitOpenOverIso Y V).hom =
      ηPVV.hom ≫ eV.hom ≫ ηQV.inv := by
    rw [pushedUnitOpenOverIso_equiv Y V]
    rfl
  have hScheme : cPU.hom ≫ F.map eU.hom ≫ cQ.inv =
      G.map (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction h) ≫ eV.hom := by
    simpa only [cPU, cQ, eU, eV, F, G] using
      pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso_restriction_naturality h
  rw [Functor.map_comp, hT, hOU, hOV]
  calc
    _ = (RPU.hom ≫ F.map ηPU.hom) ≫ F.map eU.hom ≫
          (F.map ηQU.inv ≫ RQ.inv) := by
      rfl
    _ = (ηPUV.hom ≫ cPU.hom) ≫ F.map eU.hom ≫
          (cQ.inv ≫ ηQV.inv) := by rw [hP, hQinv]
    _ = ηPUV.hom ≫
          (cPU.hom ≫ F.map eU.hom ≫ cQ.inv) ≫ ηQV.inv := by
      simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = ηPUV.hom ≫
          (G.map (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction h) ≫ eV.hom) ≫
          ηQV.inv := by rw [hScheme]
    _ = ηPUV.hom ≫ G.map (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction h) ≫
          eV.hom ≫ ηQV.inv := by simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = (ηPUV.hom ≫ G.map (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction h) ≫
          ηPVV.inv) ≫ (ηPVV.hom ≫ eV.hom ≫ ηQV.inv) := by
      simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushedUnitOpenOverIso_as_overIsoOfRestrictIso
statement:
theorem pushedUnitOpenOverIso_as_overIsoOfRestrictIso
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (U : Y.Opens) :
    pushedUnitOpenOverIso Y U =
      overIsoOfRestrictIso U (pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso Y U)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushedUnitOpenOverIso_hom_app_heq
statement:
theorem pushedUnitOpenOverIso_hom_app_heq
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (U : Y.Opens) (W : (U : Scheme.{u}).Opens)
    (x : (((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.obj
        ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y U).over U)).val.obj (op W)))
    (y : (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y U)).val.obj (op W)))
    (hxy : HEq x y) :
    HEq
      ((pushedUnitOpenOverIso Y U).hom.val.app
        (op (U.overEquivalence.inverse.obj W)) x)
      ((pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso Y U).hom.val.app (op W) y)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [pushedUnitOpenOverIso_as_overIsoOfRestrictIso] using
    (overIsoOfRestrictIso_hom_app_heq U
      (pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso Y U) W x y hxy)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushedUnitOpenOverIso_inv_app_heq
statement:
theorem pushedUnitOpenOverIso_inv_app_heq
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (U : Y.Opens) (W : (U : Scheme.{u}).Opens)
    (x : (((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.obj
        ((SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y).over U)).val.obj (op W)))
    (y : (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y)).val.obj (op W)))
    (hxy : HEq x y) :
    HEq
      ((pushedUnitOpenOverIso Y U).inv.val.app
        (op (U.overEquivalence.inverse.obj W)) x)
      ((pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso Y U).inv.val.app (op W) y)
proof:
:= by
  have hIso : (pushedUnitOpenOverIso Y U).symm =
      overIsoOfRestrictIso U (pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso Y U).symm := by
    rw [pushedUnitOpenOverIso_as_overIsoOfRestrictIso]
    rfl
  have h := overIsoOfRestrictIso_hom_app_heq U
    (pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso Y U).symm W x y hxy
  rw [← hIso] at h
  simpa only [Iso.symm_hom] using h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.overEquivFreePUnitIso_unit_naturality
statement:
theorem overEquivFreePUnitIso_unit_naturality
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (U : Y.Opens) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map
        (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
          (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over U)).hom) ≫
      (overEquivUnitIso Y U).hom =
    (overEquivFreePUnitIso Y U).hom ≫
      (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
        (R := (U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf)).hom
proof:
:= by
  let F := (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor
  let ξ := overEquivUnitIso Y U
  let m := SheafOfModules.mapFreeIso F PUnit ξ.symm
  have h := mapFreePUnitIsoUnit_naturality F ξ.symm
  apply (cancel_epi m.hom).1
  simpa only [Category.assoc, Iso.symm_inv, Iso.symm_hom,
    Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc,
      F, ξ, m, overEquivFreePUnitIso] using h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.overEquivTensorSheafIso_hom_naturality
statement:
theorem overEquivTensorSheafIso_hom_naturality
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    {M M' N N' : X.Modules} (a : M ≅ M') (b : N ≅ N') :
    let E
proof:
:= (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor
    E.map (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U
      ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U).mapIso a)
      ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U).mapIso b)).hom ≫
        (overEquivTensorSheafIso X U M' N').hom =
      (overEquivTensorSheafIso X U M N).hom ≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (U : Scheme)
          (E.map ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U).map a.hom))
          (E.map ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U).map b.hom)) := by
  dsimp only
  let E := (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor
  let P := Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι
  let α (A : X.Modules) :=
    SchemeKTheory.overEquivFunctorObj_overIso_pullbackObj U A
  let τ (A B : X.Modules) := SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso X U A B
  let β (A B : X.Modules) := SchemeKTheory.openPullbackTensorIso U.ι A B
  let δ (A B : X.Modules) :=
    SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMapIso (U : Scheme) (α A).symm (α B).symm
  let aU := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U).mapIso a
  let bU := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U).mapIso b
  have hα {A B : X.Modules} (f : A ⟶ B) :
      E.map (f.over U) ≫ (α B).hom = (α A).hom ≫ P.map f := by
    have hOver := (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.naturality f
    have hOverKey :
        (SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U ⋙ E).map f =
          E.map (f.over U) := rfl
    rw [hOverKey] at hOver
    have hOver' : E.map (f.over U) ≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app B).hom =
      ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app A).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map f := by
      convert hOver using 1 <;> rfl
    have hRestrict' : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map f ≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).app B).hom =
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).app A).hom ≫ P.map f := by
      simpa only [Iso.app_hom] using
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).hom.naturality f
    change E.map (f.over U) ≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app B).hom ≫
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).app B).hom =
      ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app A).hom ≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).app A).hom ≫ P.map f
    calc
      _ = (E.map (f.over U) ≫
            ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app B).hom) ≫
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).app B).hom := by
        simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = (((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app A).hom ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map f) ≫
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).app B).hom := by
        exact congrArg (fun z ↦ z ≫
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).app B).hom) hOver'
      _ = ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app A).hom ≫
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map f ≫
              ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).app B).hom) :=
        Category.assoc _ _ _
      _ = ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app A).hom ≫
            (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).app A).hom ≫
              P.map f) :=
        congrArg _ hRestrict'
      _ = (((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app A).hom ≫
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).app A).hom) ≫
            P.map f := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = _ := by rfl
  have hαa : E.map aU.hom ≫ (α M').hom = (α M).hom ≫ P.map a.hom := by
    simpa only [aU, Functor.mapIso_hom] using hα a.hom
  have hαb : E.map bU.hom ≫ (α N').hom = (α N).hom ≫ P.map b.hom := by
    simpa only [bU, Functor.mapIso_hom] using hα b.hom
  have hmoveA : P.map a.hom ≫ (α M').symm.hom =
      (α M).symm.hom ≫ E.map aU.hom := by
    have hm := congrArg
      (fun z ↦ (α M).inv ≫ z ≫ (α M').symm.hom) hαa
    simpa only [Category.assoc, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.inv_hom_id,
      Iso.hom_inv_id, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc,
      Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp] using hm.symm
  have hmoveB : P.map b.hom ≫ (α N').symm.hom =
      (α N).symm.hom ≫ E.map bU.hom := by
    have hm := congrArg

    simpa only [Category.assoc, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.inv_hom_id,
      Iso.hom_inv_id, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc,
      Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp] using hm.symm
  have hδ :
      SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (U : Scheme) (P.map a.hom) (P.map b.hom) ≫
          (δ M' N').hom =
        (δ M N).hom ≫ SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (U : Scheme)
          (E.map aU.hom) (E.map bU.hom) := by
    simp only [δ, SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMapIso_hom]
    rw [SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap_comp, hmoveA, hmoveB,

  have hτ :

        (τ M N).inv ≫

    exact tensorSheafMapIso_hom_over a b U
  have hτ' :

    calc

            (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U aU bU).hom ≫
            (τ M' N').hom) := by
        simp only [Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
      _ = _ := by rw [← hτ]
  have hτE :
      E.map (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U aU bU).hom ≫

      change
        (E.map (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U aU bU).hom ≫

      rw [hτE]
    _ = E.map (τ M N).hom ≫

    _ = E.map (τ M N).hom ≫
          (α (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X M N)).hom ≫
          (β M N).hom ≫ SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (U : Scheme)
