name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.overEquivTensorSheafIso_hom_naturality_map
statement:
theorem overEquivTensorSheafIso_hom_naturality_map
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    {M M' N N' : X.Modules} (f : M ⟶ M') (g : N ⟶ N') :
    let E
proof:
:= (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor
    E.map (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap X U
      ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U).map f)
      ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U).map g)) ≫
        (overEquivTensorSheafIso X U M' N').hom =
      (overEquivTensorSheafIso X U M N).hom ≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (U : Scheme)
          (E.map (f.over U)) (E.map (g.over U)) := by
  dsimp only
  let E := (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor
  let P := Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι
  let α (A : X.Modules) :=
    SchemeKTheory.overEquivFunctorObj_overIso_pullbackObj U A
  let τ (A B : X.Modules) := SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso X U A B
  let β (A B : X.Modules) := SchemeKTheory.openPullbackTensorIso U.ι A B
  let δ (A B : X.Modules) :=
    SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMapIso (U : Scheme) (α A).symm (α B).symm
  let fU := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U).map f
  let gU := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U).map g
  have hα {A B : X.Modules} (k : A ⟶ B) :
      E.map (k.over U) ≫ (α B).hom = (α A).hom ≫ P.map k := by
    have hOver := (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.naturality k
    have hOverKey :
        (SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U ⋙ E).map k =
          E.map (k.over U) := rfl
    rw [hOverKey] at hOver
    have hOver' : E.map (k.over U) ≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app B).hom =
      ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app A).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map k := by
      convert hOver using 1 <;> rfl
    have hRestrict' : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map k ≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).app B).hom =
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).app A).hom ≫ P.map k := by
      simpa only [Iso.app_hom] using
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).hom.naturality k
    change E.map (k.over U) ≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app B).hom ≫
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).app B).hom =
      ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app A).hom ≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).app A).hom ≫ P.map k
    calc
      _ = (E.map (k.over U) ≫
            ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app B).hom) ≫
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).app B).hom := by
        simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = (((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app A).hom ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map k) ≫
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).app B).hom := by
        exact congrArg (fun z ↦ z ≫
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).app B).hom) hOver'
      _ = ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app A).hom ≫
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map k ≫
              ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).app B).hom) :=
        Category.assoc _ _ _
      _ = ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app A).hom ≫
            (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).app A).hom ≫
              P.map k) := congrArg _ hRestrict'
      _ = (((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app A).hom ≫
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).app A).hom) ≫
            P.map k := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = _ := by rfl
  have hαf : E.map (fU) ≫ (α M').hom = (α M).hom ≫ P.map f := by
    simpa only [fU] using hα f
  have hαg : E.map (gU) ≫ (α N').hom = (α N).hom ≫ P.map g := by
    simpa only [gU] using hα g
  have hmoveF : P.map f ≫ (α M').symm.hom =
      (α M).symm.hom ≫ E.map fU := by
    have hm := congrArg
      (fun z ↦ (α M).inv ≫ z ≫ (α M').symm.hom) hαf
    simpa only [Category.assoc, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.inv_hom_id,
      Iso.hom_inv_id, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc,
      Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp] using hm.symm
  have hmoveG : P.map g ≫ (α N').symm.hom =
      (α N).symm.hom ≫ E.map gU := by
    have hm := congrArg
      (fun z ↦ (α N).inv ≫ z ≫ (α N').symm.hom) hαg
    simpa only [Category.assoc, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.inv_hom_id,
      Iso.hom_inv_id, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc,
      Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp] using hm.symm
  have hδ :
      SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (U : Scheme) (P.map f) (P.map g) ≫
          (δ M' N').hom =
        (δ M N).hom ≫ SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (U : Scheme)
          (E.map fU) (E.map gU) := by
    simp only [δ, SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMapIso_hom]
    rw [SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap_comp, hmoveF, hmoveG,
      SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap_comp]
  have hτ :
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X f g).over U =
        (τ M N).inv ≫
          SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap X U fU gU ≫
          (τ M' N').hom := by
    exact tensorSheafMap_hom_over f g U
  have hτ' :
      SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap X U fU gU ≫ (τ M' N').hom =
        (τ M N).hom ≫ (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X f g).over U := by
    calc
      _ = (τ M N).hom ≫ ((τ M N).inv ≫
            SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap X U fU gU ≫
            (τ M' N').hom) := by
        simp only [Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
      _ = _ := by rw [← hτ]
  have hτE :
      E.map (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap X U fU gU) ≫
          E.map (τ M' N').hom =
        E.map (τ M N).hom ≫
          E.map ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X f g).over U) := by
    have h := congrArg E.map hτ'
    simpa only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc] using h
  let m := SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X f g
  have hβ := SchemeKTheory.openPullbackTensorIso_hom_naturality U.ι f g
  change
    E.map (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap X U fU gU) ≫
        E.map (τ M' N').hom ≫
          (α (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X M' N')).hom ≫
            (β M' N').hom ≫ (δ M' N').hom =
      E.map (τ M N).hom ≫ (α (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X M N)).hom ≫
        (β M N).hom ≫ (δ M N).hom ≫
          SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (U : Scheme)
            (E.map fU) (E.map gU)
  calc
    _ = E.map (τ M N).hom ≫ E.map (m.over U) ≫
          (α (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X M' N')).hom ≫
          (β M' N').hom ≫ (δ M' N').hom := by
      change
        (E.map (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap X U fU gU) ≫
          E.map (τ M' N').hom) ≫
            (α (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X M' N')).hom ≫
              (β M' N').hom ≫ (δ M' N').hom =
        (E.map (τ M N).hom ≫
          E.map ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X f g).over U)) ≫
            (α (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X M' N')).hom ≫
              (β M' N').hom ≫ (δ M' N').hom
      rw [hτE]
    _ = E.map (τ M N).hom ≫
          (α (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X M N)).hom ≫ P.map m ≫
          (β M' N').hom ≫ (δ M' N').hom := by
      calc
        _ = E.map (τ M N).hom ≫
              (E.map (m.over U) ≫
                (α (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X M' N')).hom) ≫
              (β M' N').hom ≫ (δ M' N').hom := by
          simp only [Category.assoc]
        _ = E.map (τ M N).hom ≫
              ((α (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X M N)).hom ≫ P.map m) ≫
              (β M' N').hom ≫ (δ M' N').hom := by
          rw [hα m]
    _ = E.map (τ M N).hom ≫
          (α (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X M N)).hom ≫
          (β M N).hom ≫ SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (U : Scheme)
            (P.map f) (P.map g) ≫ (δ M' N').hom := by
      calc
        _ = (E.map (τ M N).hom ≫
              (α (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X M N)).hom) ≫
              (P.map m ≫ (β M' N').hom) ≫ (δ M' N').hom := by
          simp only [Category.assoc]
        _ = _ := by
          change
            E.map (τ M N).hom ≫
                (α (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X M N)).hom ≫
                (P.map (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X f g) ≫
                  (β M' N').hom) ≫ (δ M' N').hom = _
          rw [hβ]
          simp only [Category.assoc, β, P]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [hδ]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso_viaRestriction_hom_naturality
statement:
theorem restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso_viaRestriction_hom_naturality
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (U : X.Opens) (V : Y.Opens) (h : q ⁻¹ᵁ U = V)
    {M M' N N' : X.Modules} (a : M ⟶ M') (b : N ⟶ N') :
    let H
proof:
:= Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (restrictOpenLift q U V h)
    let EU := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U
    let EV := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V
    H.map (EU.functor.map ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X a b).over U)) ≫
        (restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso_viaRestriction q U V h M' N').hom =
      (restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso_viaRestriction q U V h M N).hom ≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
          (EV.functor.map (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map a).over V))
          (EV.functor.map (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map b).over V)) := by
  dsimp only
  let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (restrictOpenLift q U V h)
  let EU := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U
  let EV := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V
  let E := EV.functor
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q
  let F := SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf V
  let A (P : X.Modules) := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso q U V h P
  let β (P Q : X.Modules) :=
    SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q P Q
  let βV (P Q : X.Modules) := F.mapIso (β P Q)
  let τ (P Q : Y.Modules) := SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y V P Q
  let α (P Q : Y.Modules) := overEquivTensorSheafIso Y V P Q
  have hA := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso_naturality q U V h
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X a b)
  change H.map (EU.functor.map
      ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X a b).over U)) ≫
        (A (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X M' N')).hom =
      (A (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X M N)).hom ≫
        E.map (((G.map (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X a b)).over V)) at hA
  have hβ := SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso_hom_naturality
    (q := q) a b
  have hβV := congrArg F.map hβ
  simp only [Functor.map_comp] at hβV
  have hβE := congrArg E.map hβV
  simp only [Functor.map_comp] at hβE
  change
    E.map ((G.map (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X a b)).over V) ≫
        E.map ((βV M' N').hom) =
      E.map ((βV M N).hom) ≫
        E.map ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap Y (G.map a) (G.map b)).over V) at hβE
  have hτ := tensorSheafMap_hom_over (G.map a) (G.map b) V
  have hτ' :
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap Y (G.map a) (G.map b)).over V ≫
          (τ (G.obj M') (G.obj N')).inv =
        (τ (G.obj M) (G.obj N)).inv ≫
          SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap Y V
            ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf V).map (G.map a))
            ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf V).map (G.map b)) := by
    change
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap Y (G.map a) (G.map b)).over V ≫
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y V (G.obj M') (G.obj N')).inv =
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y V (G.obj M) (G.obj N)).inv ≫
          SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap Y V
            ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf V).map (G.map a))
            ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf V).map (G.map b))
    rw [hτ]
    calc
      ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y V (G.obj M) (G.obj N)).inv ≫
          SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap Y V
            ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf V).map (G.map a))
            ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf V).map (G.map b))) ≫
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y V (G.obj M') (G.obj N')).hom ≫
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y V (G.obj M') (G.obj N')).inv =
        ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y V (G.obj M) (G.obj N)).inv ≫
          SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap Y V
            ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf V).map (G.map a))
            ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf V).map (G.map b))) ≫
          ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y V (G.obj M') (G.obj N')).hom ≫
            (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y V (G.obj M') (G.obj N')).inv) :=
          Category.assoc _ _ _
      _ = ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y V (G.obj M) (G.obj N)).inv ≫
          SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap Y V
            ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf V).map (G.map a))
            ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf V).map (G.map b))) ≫ 𝟙 _ := by
          rw [Iso.hom_inv_id]
      _ = _ := Category.comp_id _
  have hτE := congrArg E.map hτ'
  simp only [Functor.map_comp] at hτE
  have hα := overEquivTensorSheafIso_hom_naturality_map
    Y V (G.map a) (G.map b)
  change E.map
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap Y V
          ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf V).map (G.map a))
          ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf V).map (G.map b))) ≫
      (α (G.obj M') (G.obj N')).hom =
    (α (G.obj M) (G.obj N)).hom ≫
      SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
        (E.map ((G.map a).over V)) (E.map ((G.map b).over V)) at hα
  change
    H.map (EU.functor.map
        ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X a b).over U)) ≫
      (A (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X M' N')).hom ≫
      E.map ((βV M' N').hom) ≫
      E.map (τ (G.obj M') (G.obj N')).inv ≫
      (α (G.obj M') (G.obj N')).hom =
    (A (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X M N)).hom ≫
      E.map ((βV M N).hom) ≫
      E.map (τ (G.obj M) (G.obj N)).inv ≫
      (α (G.obj M) (G.obj N)).hom ≫
      SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
        (E.map ((G.map a).over V)) (E.map ((G.map b).over V))
  calc
    _ = (H.map (EU.functor.map
          ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X a b).over U)) ≫
        (A (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X M' N')).hom) ≫
        E.map ((βV M' N').hom) ≫
        E.map (τ (G.obj M') (G.obj N')).inv ≫
        (α (G.obj M') (G.obj N')).hom := by
      simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = ((A (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X M N)).hom ≫
        E.map (((G.map (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X a b)).over V))) ≫
        E.map ((βV M' N').hom) ≫
        E.map (τ (G.obj M') (G.obj N')).inv ≫
        (α (G.obj M') (G.obj N')).hom := by
      rw [hA]
    _ = (A (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X M N)).hom ≫
        E.map ((βV M N).hom) ≫
        E.map ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap Y (G.map a) (G.map b)).over V) ≫
        E.map (τ (G.obj M') (G.obj N')).inv ≫
        (α (G.obj M') (G.obj N')).hom := by
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using
        congrArg
          (fun z => (A (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X M N)).hom ≫ z ≫
            E.map (τ (G.obj M') (G.obj N')).inv ≫
            (α (G.obj M') (G.obj N')).hom) hβE
    _ = (A (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X M N)).hom ≫
        E.map ((βV M N).hom) ≫
        E.map (τ (G.obj M) (G.obj N)).inv ≫
        E.map (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap Y V
          ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf V).map (G.map a))
          ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf V).map (G.map b))) ≫
        (α (G.obj M') (G.obj N')).hom := by
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using
        congrArg
          (fun z => (A (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X M N)).hom ≫
            E.map ((βV M N).hom) ≫ z ≫
            (α (G.obj M') (G.obj N')).hom) hτE
    _ = _ := by
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using
        congrArg
          (fun z => (A (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X M N)).hom ≫
            E.map ((βV M N).hom) ≫
            E.map (τ (G.obj M) (G.obj N)).inv ≫ z) hα

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso_viaRestriction_post_naturality
statement:
theorem restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso_viaRestriction_post_naturality
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (U : X.Opens) (V : Y.Opens) (h : q ⁻¹ᵁ U = V)
    {M N : X.Modules} {P Q : Y.Modules}
    (a : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj M ⟶ P)
    (b : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj N ⟶ Q) :
    let E
proof:
:= (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V).functor
    (restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso_viaRestriction q U V h M N).hom ≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
          (E.map (a.over V)) (E.map (b.over V)) =
      (restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso q U V h
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X M N)).hom ≫
        E.map ((SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q M N).hom.over V) ≫
        E.map (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y V
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj M)
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj N)).inv ≫
        E.map (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap Y V
          ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf V).map a)
          ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf V).map b)) ≫
        (overEquivTensorSheafIso Y V P Q).hom := by
  dsimp only
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q
  let E := (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V).functor
  let F := SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf V
  let A (T : X.Modules) := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso q U V h T
  let β (T R : X.Modules) := SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q T R
  let τ (T R : Y.Modules) := SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y V T R
  let α (T R : Y.Modules) := overEquivTensorSheafIso Y V T R
  have hα := overEquivTensorSheafIso_hom_naturality_map Y V a b
  change E.map (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap Y V (F.map a) (F.map b)) ≫
      (α P Q).hom =
    (α (G.obj M) (G.obj N)).hom ≫
      SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
        (E.map (a.over V)) (E.map (b.over V)) at hα
  change
    (A (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X M N)).hom ≫
        E.map ((β M N).hom.over V) ≫
        E.map (τ (G.obj M) (G.obj N)).inv ≫
        (α (G.obj M) (G.obj N)).hom ≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
          (E.map (a.over V)) (E.map (b.over V)) =
      (A (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X M N)).hom ≫
        E.map ((β M N).hom.over V) ≫
        E.map (τ (G.obj M) (G.obj N)).inv ≫
        E.map (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap Y V (F.map a) (F.map b)) ≫
        (α P Q).hom
  calc
    _ = (A (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X M N)).hom ≫
        E.map ((β M N).hom.over V) ≫
        E.map (τ (G.obj M) (G.obj N)).inv ≫
        ((α (G.obj M) (G.obj N)).hom ≫
          SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
            (E.map (a.over V)) (E.map (b.over V))) := by
      simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = (A (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X M N)).hom ≫
        E.map ((β M N).hom.over V) ≫
        E.map (τ (G.obj M) (G.obj N)).inv ≫
        (E.map (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap Y V (F.map a) (F.map b)) ≫
          (α P Q).hom) := by
      rw [← hα]
    _ = _ := by simp only [Category.assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso_hom_naturality
statement:
theorem restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso_hom_naturality
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (U : X.Opens) (V : Y.Opens) (h : q ⁻¹ᵁ U = V)
    {M M' N N' : X.Modules} (a : M ⟶ M') (b : N ⟶ N') :
    let H
proof:
:= Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (restrictOpenLift q U V h)
    let EU := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U
    let EV := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V
    H.map (EU.functor.map ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X a b).over U)) ≫
        (restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso q U V h M' N').hom =
      (restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso q U V h M N).hom ≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
          (EV.functor.map (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map a).over V))
          (EV.functor.map (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map b).over V)) := by
  dsimp only
  let p := restrictOpenLift q U V h
  let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor p
  let EU := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U
  let EV := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V
  let E := EU.functor
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q
  let τ (A B : X.Modules) := SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso X U A B
  let α (A B : X.Modules) := overEquivTensorSheafIso X U A B
  let I (A B : X.Modules) := (E.mapIso (τ A B)).symm ≪≫ α A B
  let β (A B : X.Modules) := SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso p
    (E.obj (A.over U)) (E.obj (B.over U))
  let A (C : X.Modules) := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso q U V h C
  let aU := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U).map a
  let bU := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U).map b
  have hI :
      E.map ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X a b).over U) ≫
          (I M' N').hom =
        (I M N).hom ≫ SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (U : Scheme)
          (E.map aU) (E.map bU) := by
    have hOver := tensorSheafMap_hom_over a b U
    have hOverE := congrArg E.map hOver
    simp only [Functor.map_comp] at hOverE
    have hα := overEquivTensorSheafIso_hom_naturality_map X U a b
    change E.map
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap X U aU bU) ≫
          (α M' N').hom =
      (α M N).hom ≫ SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (U : Scheme)
        (E.map aU) (E.map bU) at hα
    have hOverE' :
      E.map ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X a b).over U) =
        E.map (τ M N).inv ≫
            E.map (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap X U aU bU) ≫
            (E.mapIso (τ M' N')).hom := by
      exact hOverE
    calc
      _ = E.map (τ M N).inv ≫
            E.map (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap X U aU bU) ≫
            (E.mapIso (τ M' N')).hom ≫
            (E.mapIso (τ M' N')).symm.hom ≫ (α M' N').hom := by
        rw [hOverE']
        simp only [I, Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc]
      _ = E.map (τ M N).inv ≫
            E.map (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap X U aU bU) ≫
            (α M' N').hom := by
        simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
      _ = E.map (τ M N).inv ≫
            ((α M N).hom ≫ SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (U : Scheme)
              (E.map aU) (E.map bU)) := by
        exact congrArg (fun z ↦ E.map (τ M N).inv ≫ z) hα
      _ = (I M N).hom ≫ SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (U : Scheme)
            (E.map aU) (E.map bU) := by
        simp only [I, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Functor.mapIso_inv,
          Category.assoc]
  have hIH := congrArg H.map hI
  have hIH' :
          H.map (E.map ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X a b).over U)) ≫
          H.map (I M' N').hom =
        H.map (I M N).hom ≫ H.map
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (U : Scheme) (E.map aU) (E.map bU)) := by
    simpa only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc] using hIH
  have hβ := SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso_hom_naturality
    (q := p) (E.map aU) (E.map bU)
  have hA := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso_naturality q U V h a
  have hB := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso_naturality q U V h b
  have hTensorMap :
      SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
          (H.map (E.map aU)) (H.map (E.map bU)) ≫
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMapIso (V : Scheme) (A M') (A N')).hom =
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMapIso (V : Scheme) (A M) (A N)).hom ≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
          (EV.functor.map ((G.map a).over V))
          (EV.functor.map ((G.map b).over V)) := by
    simp only [SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMapIso_hom]
    rw [SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap_comp, SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap_comp,
      hA, hB]
  change
    H.map (E.map ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X a b).over U)) ≫
        H.map (I M' N').hom ≫ (β M' N').hom ≫
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMapIso (V : Scheme) (A M') (A N')).hom =
      H.map (I M N).hom ≫ (β M N).hom ≫
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMapIso (V : Scheme) (A M) (A N)).hom ≫
          SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
            (EV.functor.map ((G.map a).over V))
            (EV.functor.map ((G.map b).over V))
  calc
    _ = (H.map (E.map ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X a b).over U)) ≫
          H.map (I M' N').hom) ≫ (β M' N').hom ≫
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMapIso (V : Scheme) (A M') (A N')).hom := by
      simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = (H.map (I M N).hom ≫ H.map
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (U : Scheme) (E.map aU) (E.map bU))) ≫
          (β M' N').hom ≫
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMapIso (V : Scheme) (A M') (A N')).hom := by
      rw [hIH']
    _ = H.map (I M N).hom ≫
          (H.map (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (U : Scheme)
            (E.map aU) (E.map bU)) ≫ (β M' N').hom) ≫
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMapIso (V : Scheme) (A M') (A N')).hom := by
      simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = H.map (I M N).hom ≫
          ((β M N).hom ≫ SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
            (H.map (E.map aU)) (H.map (E.map bU))) ≫
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMapIso (V : Scheme) (A M') (A N')).hom := by
      rw [hβ]
    _ = H.map (I M N).hom ≫ (β M N).hom ≫
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
            (H.map (E.map aU)) (H.map (E.map bU)) ≫
            (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMapIso (V : Scheme) (A M') (A N')).hom) := by
      simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = H.map (I M N).hom ≫ (β M N).hom ≫
          ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMapIso (V : Scheme) (A M) (A N)).hom ≫
            SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
              (EV.functor.map ((G.map a).over V))
              (EV.functor.map ((G.map b).over V))) := by
      rw [hTensorMap]
    _ = _ := by simp only [Category.assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushedUnitTopFrame_equivToFreeUnit
statement:
theorem pushedUnitTopFrame_equivToFreeUnit (Y : Scheme.{u}) :
    let U : Y.Opens
proof:
:= ⊤
    (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map
        (pushedUnitTopFrame Y).hom ≫
      (pushedUnitOpenFrameEquivToUnit Y U).hom =
    (overEquivFreePUnitIso Y U).hom ≫
      (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
        (R := (U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf)).hom := by
  let U : Y.Opens := ⊤
  have h := overEquivFreePUnitIso_unit_naturality Y U
  simpa [U, pushedUnitTopFrame, pushedUnitOpenFrameEquivToUnit,
    overEquivUnitIso, SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheafOverIso] using h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushedUnitOpenFrame_equivToFreeUnit
statement:
theorem pushedUnitOpenFrame_equivToFreeUnit
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (U : Y.Opens) :
    (pushedUnitOpenFrame Y U).hom ≫
        (pushedUnitOpenOverIso Y U).hom =
      (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
        (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over U)).hom
proof:
:= by
  let h : U ≤ (⊤ : Y.Opens) := le_top
  let F := SheafOfModules.overMap Y.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE h)
  let c := SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap Y.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE h)
  let Q := SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y
  let q := Scheme.Modules.freeOverMapIso Y (⊤ : Y.Opens) U h PUnit
  have hRestr := pushedUnitOpenOverIso_restriction h
  have hTop : (pushedUnitTopFrame Y).hom ≫
      (pushedUnitOpenOverIso Y ⊤).hom =
        (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
          (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over (⊤ : Y.Opens))).hom := by
    simp only [pushedUnitTopFrame, Iso.trans_hom,
      SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheafOverIso, Iso.refl_hom,
      Iso.symm_hom]
    calc
      _ = ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
          (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over (⊤ : Y.Opens))).hom ≫ 𝟙 _) ≫
          (pushedUnitOpenOverIso Y ⊤).inv ≫
          (pushedUnitOpenOverIso Y ⊤).hom := rfl
      _ = (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
          (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over (⊤ : Y.Opens))).hom ≫
          ((pushedUnitOpenOverIso Y ⊤).inv ≫
            (pushedUnitOpenOverIso Y ⊤).hom) := by
          exact Category.assoc _ _ _
      _ = (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
          (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over (⊤ : Y.Opens))).hom ≫ 𝟙 _ := by
          rw [Iso.inv_hom_id]
      _ = (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
          (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over (⊤ : Y.Opens))).hom := by
          exact Category.comp_id _
  have hOverMapUnit : q.hom ≫
      F.map (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
        (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over (⊤ : Y.Opens))).hom ≫
      c.hom.app Q =
        (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
          (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over U)).hom := by
    have hn := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.freePUnitIsoUnit_overMap_naturality
      (X := Y) h
    change q.inv ≫
        (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
          (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over U)).hom =
      F.map (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
        (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over (⊤ : Y.Opens))).hom ≫
        (SheafOfModules.overMapUnitIso
          (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (homOfLE h)).hom at hn
    have hc : c.hom.app Q =
        (SheafOfModules.overMapUnitIso
          (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (homOfLE h)).hom := by
      rfl
    calc
      q.hom ≫ F.map (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
          (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over (⊤ : Y.Opens))).hom ≫ c.hom.app Q =
        q.hom ≫ (F.map (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
          (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over (⊤ : Y.Opens))).hom ≫
          (SheafOfModules.overMapUnitIso
            (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (homOfLE h)).hom) := by
          rw [hc]
      _ = q.hom ≫ (q.inv ≫
          (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
            (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over U)).hom) := by rw [hn.symm]
      _ = (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
          (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over U)).hom := by
          rw [q.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  calc
    _ = q.hom ≫ F.map (pushedUnitTopFrame Y).hom ≫
          c.hom.app (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y ⊤) ≫
          (pushedUnitToOpenOverIso h).hom ≫
          (pushedUnitOpenOverIso Y U).hom := by
        unfold pushedUnitOpenFrame
        dsimp only [Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom]
        rfl
    _ = q.hom ≫ F.map (pushedUnitTopFrame Y).hom ≫
          c.hom.app (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y ⊤) ≫
          Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE Y h
            (pushedUnitOpenOverIso Y ⊤).hom := by
        rw [← hRestr]
    _ = q.hom ≫ F.map (pushedUnitTopFrame Y).hom ≫
          c.hom.app (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y ⊤) ≫
          c.inv.app (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y ⊤) ≫
          F.map (pushedUnitOpenOverIso Y ⊤).hom ≫ c.hom.app Q := by
        rfl
    _ = q.hom ≫ F.map (pushedUnitTopFrame Y).hom ≫
          F.map (pushedUnitOpenOverIso Y ⊤).hom ≫ c.hom.app Q := by
        rw [Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc]
    _ = q.hom ≫ F.map ((pushedUnitTopFrame Y).hom ≫
          (pushedUnitOpenOverIso Y ⊤).hom) ≫ c.hom.app Q := by
        rw [← F.map_comp_assoc]
    _ = q.hom ≫ F.map (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
          (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over (⊤ : Y.Opens))).hom ≫
          c.hom.app Q := by rw [hTop]
    _ = (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
          (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over U)).hom := hOverMapUnit

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushedUnitOpenFrame_overEquiv_freeUnit
statement:
theorem pushedUnitOpenFrame_overEquiv_freeUnit
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (U : Y.Opens) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor).map
        (pushedUnitOpenFrame Y U).hom ≫
      (pushedUnitOpenFrameEquivToUnit Y U).hom =
    (overEquivFreePUnitIso Y U).hom ≫
      (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
        (R := (U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf)).hom
proof:
:= by
  let E := (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor
  have hUnit : overEquivUnitIso Y U = overEquivTensorUnitIso Y U := by
    change ((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.mapIso
        (Iso.refl (SheafOfModules.unit (Y.ringCatSheaf.over U))) ≪≫
        overEquivTensorUnitIso Y U) = overEquivTensorUnitIso Y U
    rw [Functor.mapIso_refl]
    exact Iso.refl_trans _
  calc
    E.map (pushedUnitOpenFrame Y U).hom ≫
        (pushedUnitOpenFrameEquivToUnit Y U).hom =
      E.map ((pushedUnitOpenFrame Y U).hom ≫
        (pushedUnitOpenOverIso Y U).hom) ≫
          (overEquivTensorUnitIso Y U).hom := by
        dsimp only [pushedUnitOpenFrameEquivToUnit]
        rw [Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom]
        rw [← E.map_comp_assoc]
    _ = E.map (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
          (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over U)).hom ≫
          (overEquivUnitIso Y U).hom := by
        rw [pushedUnitOpenFrame_equivToFreeUnit]
        rw [hUnit]
        rfl
    _ = (overEquivFreePUnitIso Y U).hom ≫
          (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
            (R := (U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf)).hom :=
        overEquivFreePUnitIso_unit_naturality Y U

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushedUnitOpenFrameEquivToUnit_hom
statement:
theorem pushedUnitOpenFrameEquivToUnit_hom
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (U : Y.Opens) :
    (pushedUnitOpenFrameEquivToUnit Y U).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.app
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y U) ≫
        (pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso Y U).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).hom
proof:
:= by
  let E := (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor
  let αP := (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y U)
  let αQ := (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y)
  have hTensor :
      αQ.inv ≫ (overEquivTensorUnitIso Y U).hom =
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).hom := by
    have hIso : overEquivTensorUnitIso Y U =
        (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app
            (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y) ≪≫
          restrictOpenImmersionTensorUnitIso U.ι := by
      unfold overEquivTensorUnitIso
        SchemeKTheory.overEquivFunctorObj_overIso_pullbackObj
        restrictOpenImmersionTensorUnitIso
      rfl
    rw [hIso, Iso.trans_hom]
    rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
    exact restrictOpenImmersionTensorUnitIso_eq_restrictUnitIso U.ι
  have hTensor' :
      (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).inv.app
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y) ≫
      (overEquivTensorUnitIso Y U).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).hom := by
    simpa only [αQ, Iso.app_inv] using hTensor
  change E.map (pushedUnitOpenOverIso Y U).hom ≫
      (overEquivTensorUnitIso Y U).hom =
    αP.hom ≫ (pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso Y U).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).hom
  rw [pushedUnitOpenOverIso_as_overIsoOfRestrictIso,
    overIsoOfRestrictIso_map]
  rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, hTensor']
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushedUnitOpenFrameEquivToUnit_openLift_naturality
statement:
theorem pushedUnitOpenFrameEquivToUnit_openLift_naturality
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (U : X.Opens) (V : Y.Opens) (h : q ⁻¹ᵁ U = V) :
    let p
proof:
:= restrictOpenLift q U V h
    let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor p
    let R := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι
    let e := restrictFunctorOpenLiftIso q U V h
    let PU := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X U
    let cast := pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso q U V h
    let A := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso q U V h PU
    H.map (pushedUnitOpenFrameEquivToUnit X U).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso p).hom =
      A.hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V).functor.map (cast.hom.over V) ≫
        (pushedUnitOpenFrameEquivToUnit Y V).hom := by
  cases h
  dsimp only
  let p := restrictOpenLift q U (q ⁻¹ᵁ U) rfl
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q
  let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor p
  let R := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι
  let e := restrictFunctorOpenLiftIso q U (q ⁻¹ᵁ U) rfl
  let PU := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X U
  let PV := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)
  let cast := pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso q U
    (q ⁻¹ᵁ U) rfl
  let EV := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)
  let A := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso q U (q ⁻¹ᵁ U) rfl PU
  let αX := (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app PU
  let αY₀ := (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)).app
    (G.obj PU)
  let αY := (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)).app PV
  have hA : A.hom = H.map αX.hom ≫ e.inv.app PU ≫ αY₀.inv := by
    rfl
  have hOver :=
    (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)).hom.naturality cast.hom
  change EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)) ≫ αY.hom =
      αY₀.hom ≫ R.map cast.hom at hOver
  have hCast : αY₀.inv ≫
      EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)) ≫ αY.hom =
    R.map cast.hom := by
    calc
      _ = αY₀.inv ≫
          (EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)) ≫ αY.hom) :=
        (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = αY₀.inv ≫ (αY₀.hom ≫ R.map cast.hom) := by
        rw [hOver]
      _ = R.map cast.hom := by
        simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  have hCounit :
      H.map (pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso X U).hom ≫
          H.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso p).hom =
        e.inv.app PU ≫ R.map cast.hom ≫
          (pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso Y (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)).hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).hom := by
    simpa only [H, R, e, PU, cast] using
      (pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso_openLift_naturality q U
        (q ⁻¹ᵁ U) rfl)
  calc
    H.map (pushedUnitOpenFrameEquivToUnit X U).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso p).hom =
      H.map αX.hom ≫
        (H.map (pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso X U).hom ≫
          H.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso p).hom) := by
      rw [pushedUnitOpenFrameEquivToUnit_hom, ← Iso.app_hom]
      simp only [αX, PU, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
    _ = H.map αX.hom ≫
          (e.inv.app PU ≫ R.map cast.hom ≫
            (pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso Y (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)).hom ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).hom) := by
      rw [hCounit]
    _ = H.map αX.hom ≫ e.inv.app PU ≫
          (αY₀.inv ≫ EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)) ≫
            αY.hom ≫ (pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso Y
              (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)).hom ≫
              (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).hom) := by
      rw [← hCast]
      simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = A.hom ≫ EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)) ≫
          (pushedUnitOpenFrameEquivToUnit Y (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)).hom := by
      calc
        _ = (H.map αX.hom ≫ e.inv.app PU ≫ αY₀.inv) ≫
              (EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)) ≫ αY.hom ≫
                (pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso Y (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)).hom ≫
                (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).hom) := by
          simp only [Category.assoc]
        _ = A.hom ≫
              (EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)) ≫ αY.hom ≫
                (pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso Y (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)).hom ≫
                (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).hom) := by
          exact congrArg
            (fun f => f ≫
              (EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)) ≫ αY.hom ≫
                (pushedUnitOpenSchemeUnitIso Y (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)).hom ≫
                (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).hom)) hA.symm
        _ = A.hom ≫ EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)) ≫
              (pushedUnitOpenFrameEquivToUnit Y (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)).hom := by
          have hAlphaY : αY.hom =
              (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)).hom.app PV := by
            simp only [αY, PV, Iso.app_hom]
          rw [hAlphaY, pushedUnitOpenFrameEquivToUnit_hom]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso_unitToPushforward_naturality
statement:
theorem restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso_unitToPushforward_naturality
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (U : X.Opens) (V : Y.Opens) (h : q ⁻¹ᵁ U = V) :
    let p
proof:
:= restrictOpenLift q U V h
    let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor p
    let EU := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U
    let EV := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V
    let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q
    let PU := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X U
    let uX := SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit U.ι.toRingCatSheafHom
    let uY := SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit V.ι.toRingCatSheafHom
    let α := Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q
    let cast := pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso q U V h
    let C₀ := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso_viaRestriction q U V h
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X) (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)
    let C₁ := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso_viaRestriction q U V h PU PU
    H.map (EU.functor.map
        ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X uX uX).over U)) ≫
        C₁.hom ≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
          (EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over V))
          (EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over V)) =
      C₀.hom ≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
          (EV.functor.map (α.hom.over V))
          (EV.functor.map (α.hom.over V)) ≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
          (EV.functor.map (uY.over V))
          (EV.functor.map (uY.over V)) := by
  cases h
  dsimp only
  let W := q ⁻¹ᵁ U
  let p := restrictOpenLift q U W rfl
  let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor p
  let EU := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U
  let EV := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv W
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q
  let PU := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X U
  let uX := SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit U.ι.toRingCatSheafHom
  let uY := SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit W.ι.toRingCatSheafHom
  let α := Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q
  let cast := pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso q U W rfl
  let C₀ := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso_viaRestriction q U W rfl
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X) (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)
  let C₁ := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso_viaRestriction q U W rfl PU PU
  have hC := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso_viaRestriction_hom_naturality
    q U W rfl uX uX
  change H.map (EU.functor.map
    ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X uX uX).over U)) ≫ C₁.hom =
    C₀.hom ≫ SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (W : Scheme)
      (EV.functor.map ((G.map uX).over W))
      (EV.functor.map ((G.map uX).over W)) at hC
  have hC' := congrArg
    (fun z => z ≫ SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (W : Scheme)
      (EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over W))
      (EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over W))) hC
  have hUnit₀ := restrictUnitToPushforwardOpenImmersion_naturality q U
  have hUnit : G.map uX ≫ cast.hom = α.hom ≫ uY := by
    simpa only [cast, pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso,
      Iso.trans_hom, Iso.refl_hom, eqToIso_refl, Category.comp_id,
      G, α, uX, uY, W] using hUnit₀
  have hUnitV := congrArg (fun z => z.over W) hUnit
  change (G.map uX).over W ≫ cast.hom.over W =
      α.hom.over W ≫ uY.over W at hUnitV
  have hUnitEV := congrArg EV.functor.map hUnitV
  simp only [Functor.map_comp] at hUnitEV
  calc
    _ = (C₀.hom ≫
          SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (W : Scheme)
            (EV.functor.map ((G.map uX).over W))
            (EV.functor.map ((G.map uX).over W))) ≫
          SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (W : Scheme)
            (EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over W))
            (EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over W)) := by
        simpa only [Category.assoc] using hC'
    _ = C₀.hom ≫
          SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (W : Scheme)
            (EV.functor.map ((G.map uX).over W) ≫
              EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over W))
            (EV.functor.map ((G.map uX).over W) ≫
              EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over W)) := by
        simp only [Category.assoc]
        rw [SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap_comp]
    _ = C₀.hom ≫
          SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (W : Scheme)
            (EV.functor.map (α.hom.over W) ≫ EV.functor.map (uY.over W))
            (EV.functor.map (α.hom.over W) ≫ EV.functor.map (uY.over W)) := by
        rw [hUnitEV]
    _ = C₀.hom ≫
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (W : Scheme)
            (EV.functor.map (α.hom.over W))
            (EV.functor.map (α.hom.over W)) ≫
          SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (W : Scheme)
            (EV.functor.map (uY.over W))
            (EV.functor.map (uY.over W))) := by
        rw [← SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap_comp]
    _ = _ := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushedUnitOpenFrame_hom_factorization
statement:
theorem pushedUnitOpenFrame_hom_factorization
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (U : Y.Opens) :
    (pushedUnitOpenFrame Y U).hom =
      (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
        (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over U)).hom ≫
        (pushedUnitOpenOverIso Y U).inv
proof:
:= by
  let f := (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
    (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over U)).hom
  let p := pushedUnitOpenOverIso Y U
  have hFree : (f ≫ p.inv) ≫ p.hom = f := by
    calc
      _ = f ≫ (p.inv ≫ p.hom) := Category.assoc _ _ _
      _ = f ≫ 𝟙 _ := congrArg (fun z => f ≫ z) p.inv_hom_id
      _ = f := Category.comp_id _
  apply (cancel_mono p.hom).1
  change (pushedUnitOpenFrame Y U).hom ≫ p.hom = (f ≫ p.inv) ≫ p.hom
  exact (pushedUnitOpenFrame_equivToFreeUnit Y U).trans hFree.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushedUnitOpenFrame_hom_factorization_unitToPushforward
statement:
theorem pushedUnitOpenFrame_hom_factorization_unitToPushforward

        (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over U)).hom ≫

          U.ι.toRingCatSheafHom).over U
proof:
:= by

    pushedUnitOpenOverIso_inv_eq_unitToPushforward]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushedUnitTensorFrame_hom_factorization_unitToPushforward
statement:
theorem pushedUnitTensorFrame_hom_factorization_unitToPushforward
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (U : Y.Opens) :
    let f0
proof:
:= SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
      (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over U)
    let eX := eqToIso (rfl :
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y).over U =
        SheafOfModules.unit (Y.ringCatSheaf.over U))
    let f := f0 ≪≫ eX.symm
    let a := SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
      U.ι.toRingCatSheafHom
    let p := pushedUnitOpenFrame Y U
    (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver
      (X := Y) (M := SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y) U f f).hom ≫
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap Y a a).over U =
    (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver
      (X := Y) (M := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y U) U p p).hom := by
  dsimp only
  let f0 := SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
    (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over U)
  let eX := eqToIso (rfl :
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y).over U =
        SheafOfModules.unit (Y.ringCatSheaf.over U))
  let f := f0 ≪≫ eX.symm
  let a := SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
    U.ι.toRingCatSheafHom
  let p := pushedUnitOpenFrame Y U
  let aIso := (pushedUnitOpenOverIso Y U).symm
  have hIso : aIso.hom = a.over U := by
    simpa only [aIso, Iso.symm_hom] using
      pushedUnitOpenOverIso_inv_eq_unitToPushforward Y U
  have hFrame := pushedUnitOpenFrame_hom_factorization_unitToPushforward Y U
  have hf : f.hom = f0.hom := by
    dsimp [f, eX]
    exact Category.comp_id _
  have hSquare : f.hom ≫ aIso.hom = p.hom := by
    rw [hf, hIso]
    exact hFrame.symm
  have hTensor := tensorFrameOverLocal_hom_naturality_of_commuting_frames
    (X := Y) U aIso aIso f f p p (Iso.refl _) hSquare hSquare
  rw [tensorSheafMap_hom_over]
  let tf := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFreePUnitFrameOver U
  let τ0 := SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y U
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y) (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y)
  let τ1 := SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y U
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y U) (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y U)
  change
    (tf.hom ≫
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso Y U f f).hom ≫ τ0.hom) ≫
        (τ0.inv ≫ SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap Y U
          (a.over U) (a.over U) ≫ τ1.hom) =
      tf.hom ≫
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso Y U p p).hom ≫ τ1.hom
  have hLocal := congrArg (fun z => z ≫ τ1.hom) hTensor
  change
    (tf.hom ≫
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso Y U f f).hom ≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap Y U aIso.hom aIso.hom) ≫ τ1.hom =
    (Iso.refl _ ≪≫ Iso.refl _).hom ≫
      (tf.hom ≫ (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso Y U p p).hom) ≫ τ1.hom
      at hLocal
  rw [hIso] at hLocal
  calc
    _ = tf.hom ≫
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso Y U f f).hom ≫
          SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap Y U (a.over U) (a.over U) ≫ τ1.hom := by
      simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
    _ = _ := hLocal
    _ = _ := rfl

proof:
