name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushedUnitOpenFrame_openLift_naturality
statement:
theorem pushedUnitOpenFrame_openLift_naturality
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (U : X.Opens) (V : Y.Opens) (h : q ⁻¹ᵁ U = V) :
    let p
proof:
:= restrictOpenLift q U V h
    let EU := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U
    let EV := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V
    let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor p
    let cast := pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso q U V h
    let A := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso q U V h
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X U)
    let B := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivFreePUnitIso q U V h
    H.map (EU.functor.map (pushedUnitOpenFrame X U).hom) ≫
        A.hom ≫ EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over V) =
      B.hom ≫ EV.functor.map (pushedUnitOpenFrame Y V).hom := by
  cases h
  dsimp only
  let p := restrictOpenLift q U (q ⁻¹ᵁ U) rfl
  let EU := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U
  let EV := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)
  let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor p
  let PU := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X U
  let cast := pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso q U (q ⁻¹ᵁ U) rfl
  let A := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso q U (q ⁻¹ᵁ U) rfl PU
  let B := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivFreePUnitIso q U (q ⁻¹ᵁ U) rfl
  let θX := pushedUnitOpenFrameEquivToUnit X U
  let θY := pushedUnitOpenFrameEquivToUnit Y (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)
  let ξX := overEquivFreePUnitIso X U
  let ξY := overEquivFreePUnitIso Y (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)
  let gX := SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
    (R := (U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf)
  let gY := SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
    (R := (q ⁻¹ᵁ U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf)
  let ρ := restrictOpenLiftFreePUnitIso p
  let β := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback p
  let θ := pullbackUnitToTensorUnitIso p
  let η := SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso p
  let F := Scheme.Modules.pullback p
  let eX := eqToIso
    (rfl : SheafOfModules.unit ((U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf) =
      SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf (U : Scheme))
  let uX := SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
    (R := (U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf)
  have heX : uX.hom ≫ eX.hom = uX.hom := by
    rfl
  have heXg : gX.hom ≫ eX.hom = gX.hom := by
    simpa only [gX, uX] using heX
  have hBetaTheta :
      β.hom.app (SheafOfModules.unit ((U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf)) ≫
          θ.hom = H.map eX.hom ≫
        β.hom.app (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf (U : Scheme)) := by
    change β.hom.app (SheafOfModules.unit ((U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf)) ≫
        F.map eX.hom = H.map eX.hom ≫
          β.hom.app (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf (U : Scheme))
    exact (β.hom.naturality eX.hom).symm
  have hUnitFrame :
      H.map θX.hom ≫ (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso p).hom =
        A.hom ≫ EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)) ≫ θY.hom := by
    simpa only [H, A, EV, cast, θX, θY, p] using
      (pushedUnitOpenFrameEquivToUnit_openLift_naturality q U
        (q ⁻¹ᵁ U) rfl)
  have hFrameX :
      EU.functor.map (pushedUnitOpenFrame X U).hom ≫ θX.hom =
        ξX.hom ≫ gX.hom := by
    simpa only [EU, θX, ξX, gX] using
      pushedUnitOpenFrame_overEquiv_freeUnit X U
  have hFrameY :
      EV.functor.map
          (pushedUnitOpenFrame Y (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)).hom ≫ θY.hom =
        ξY.hom ≫ gY.hom := by
    simpa only [EV, θY, ξY, gY] using
      pushedUnitOpenFrame_overEquiv_freeUnit Y (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)
  have hTensorUnit :
      β.hom.app (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf (U : Scheme)) ≫ η.hom =
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso p).hom := by
    simpa only [restrictOpenImmersionTensorUnitIso, Iso.trans_hom,
      Iso.app_hom, η] using
        (restrictOpenImmersionTensorUnitIso_eq_restrictUnitIso p)
  have hGeneratorBridge :
      H.map gX.hom ≫
          (β.hom.app (SheafOfModules.unit ((U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf)) ≫
            θ.hom ≫ η.hom) =
        H.map gX.hom ≫ (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso p).hom := by
    calc
      _ = H.map gX.hom ≫
            ((β.hom.app (SheafOfModules.unit ((U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf)) ≫
              θ.hom) ≫ η.hom) := by
        simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = H.map gX.hom ≫
            ((H.map eX.hom ≫
              β.hom.app (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf (U : Scheme))) ≫
                η.hom) :=
        congrArg (fun f => H.map gX.hom ≫ f ≫ η.hom) hBetaTheta
      _ = (H.map gX.hom ≫ H.map eX.hom) ≫
            (β.hom.app (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf (U : Scheme)) ≫
              η.hom) := by
        simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = H.map (gX.hom ≫ eX.hom) ≫
            (β.hom.app (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf (U : Scheme)) ≫
              η.hom) := by
        rw [← H.map_comp]
      _ = H.map gX.hom ≫
            (β.hom.app (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf (U : Scheme)) ≫
              η.hom) := by
        exact congrArg
          (fun f => f ≫
            (β.hom.app (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf (U : Scheme)) ≫
              η.hom))
          (congrArg H.map heXg)
      _ = H.map gX.hom ≫ (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso p).hom := by
        exact congrArg (fun f => H.map gX.hom ≫ f) hTensorUnit
  have hGenerator :
      H.map gX.hom ≫ (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso p).hom =
        ρ.hom ≫ gY.hom := by
    calc
      H.map gX.hom ≫ (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso p).hom =
          H.map gX.hom ≫
            (β.hom.app (SheafOfModules.unit ((U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf)) ≫
              θ.hom ≫ η.hom) := hGeneratorBridge.symm
      _ = ρ.hom ≫ gY.hom := by
        exact (restrictOpenLiftFreePUnitIso_pullback_naturality p).symm
  have hB : H.map ξX.hom ≫ ρ.hom = B.hom ≫ ξY.hom := by
    simp only [B, restrictOpenLiftOverEquivFreePUnitIso,
      Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.symm_hom,
      ξX, ξY, ρ, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id,
      Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, Category.comp_id]
    rfl
  apply (cancel_mono θY.hom).1
  calc
    _ = H.map (EU.functor.map (pushedUnitOpenFrame X U).hom) ≫
          (H.map θX.hom ≫ (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso p).hom) := by
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using
        congrArg (fun f =>
          H.map (EU.functor.map (pushedUnitOpenFrame X U).hom) ≫ f)
          hUnitFrame.symm
    _ = H.map
          (EU.functor.map (pushedUnitOpenFrame X U).hom ≫ θX.hom) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso p).hom := by
      rw [← Category.assoc, ← H.map_comp]
    _ = H.map (ξX.hom ≫ gX.hom) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso p).hom := by
      rw [hFrameX]
    _ = H.map ξX.hom ≫ H.map gX.hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso p).hom := by
      rw [Functor.map_comp]
      simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = H.map ξX.hom ≫ ρ.hom ≫ gY.hom := by
      rw [← hGenerator]
    _ = B.hom ≫
          EV.functor.map (pushedUnitOpenFrame Y
            (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)).hom ≫ θY.hom := by
      rw [hFrameY]
      exact congrArg (fun f => f ≫ gY.hom) hB

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLift_naturality
statement:
theorem intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLift_naturality
    {R S M N ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [Finite ι]
    {b : Module.Basis ι R M} {c : Module.Basis ι S N}
    {d : ℤ} {q : space S N ⟶ space R M} [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (hOpen : ∀ i, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b i) =
      linearOpen S N (c i))
    (D : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c d q)
    (hD : D.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q hOpen).hom)
    (i : ι) :
    let U
proof:
:= linearOpen R M (b i)
    let V := linearOpen S N (c i)
    let p := restrictOpenLift q U V (hOpen i)
    let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor p
    let EU := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U
    let EV := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V
    H.map (EU.functor.map
        (intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b d i U le_rfl).hom) ≫
      (restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso q U V (hOpen i)
        (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d)).hom ≫
      EV.functor.map (D.restrictIso.hom.over V) =
    (restrictOpenLiftOverEquivFreePUnitIso q U V (hOpen i)).hom ≫
      EV.functor.map
        (intrinsicTwistingFrameOver c d i V le_rfl).hom := by
  dsimp only
  let U := linearOpen R M (b i)
  let V := linearOpen S N (c i)
  let p := restrictOpenLift q U V (hOpen i)
  let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor p
  let EU := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U
  let EV := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V
  let A := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso q U V (hOpen i)
  let B := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivFreePUnitIso q U V (hOpen i)
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q
  let PU := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) U
  let PV := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space S N) V
  let T := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d
  let f := twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b d i
  let g := twistingSheafBasisComponent S N c d i
  let cast := pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso q U V (hOpen i)
  let aP := B.hom
  let aO := (A PU).hom ≫ EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over V)
  let aQ := (A T).hom ≫ EV.functor.map (D.restrictIso.hom.over V)
  let l := H.map (EU.functor.map (pushedUnitOpenFrame
    (space R M) U).hom)
  let alphaX := pushedUnitToOpenOverIso (le_rfl : U ≤ U)
  let alphaY := pushedUnitToOpenOverIso (le_rfl : V ≤ V)
  let mX := H.mapIso (EU.functor.mapIso alphaX)
  let mY := EV.functor.mapIso alphaY
  let m := mX.inv
  let m' := mY.inv
  let l' := EV.functor.map (pushedUnitOpenFrame (space S N) V).hom
  let rIsoX := twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso R M b d i le_rfl
  let rIsoY := twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso S N c d i le_rfl
  let rMapIso := H.mapIso (EU.functor.mapIso rIsoX)
  let rMapIso' := EV.functor.mapIso rIsoY
  let r := H.map (EU.functor.map (f.over U))
  let r' := EV.functor.map (g.over V)
  let fPUX := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
    (le_rfl : U ≤ U)
  let fPUY := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
    (le_rfl : V ≤ V)
  have hl : l ≫ aO = aP ≫ l' := by
    simpa only [l, aO, aP, l', H, EU, EV, A, B, PU, cast] using
      (pushedUnitOpenFrame_openLift_naturality q U V (hOpen i))
  have hA := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso_naturality
    q U V (hOpen i) fPUX
  change H.map (EU.functor.map (fPUX.over U)) ≫ (A PU).hom =
      (A PU).hom ≫ EV.functor.map ((G.map fPUX).over V) at hA
  have hCast := pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso_naturality q
    (hWU := le_rfl) (hTV := le_rfl)
    (hU := hOpen i) (hW := hOpen i)
  have hCastV := congrArg (fun z => z.over V) hCast
  change (G.map fPUX).over V ≫ cast.hom.over V =
      cast.hom.over V ≫ fPUY.over V at hCastV
  have hCastEV := congrArg EV.functor.map hCastV
  simp only [Functor.map_comp] at hCastEV
  have hForward : mX.hom ≫ aO = aO ≫ mY.hom := by
    change H.map (EU.functor.map (fPUX.over U)) ≫
        (A PU).hom ≫ EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over V) =
      (A PU).hom ≫ EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over V) ≫
        EV.functor.map (fPUY.over V)
    calc
      _ = (A PU).hom ≫ EV.functor.map ((G.map fPUX).over V) ≫
            EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over V) := by
        simpa only [Category.assoc] using
          congrArg (fun z => z ≫ EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over V)) hA
      _ = (A PU).hom ≫
            (EV.functor.map ((G.map fPUX).over V) ≫
              EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over V)) := by
        simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = (A PU).hom ≫
            (EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over V) ≫
              EV.functor.map (fPUY.over V)) :=
        congrArg (fun z => (A PU).hom ≫ z) hCastEV
      _ = _ := by simp only [Category.assoc]
  have hm : m ≫ aO = aO ≫ m' := by
    calc
      _ = mX.inv ≫
            (aO ≫ (mY.hom ≫ mY.inv)) := by
        simp only [m, mY.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
      _ = mX.inv ≫
            ((aO ≫ mY.hom) ≫ mY.inv) := by
        exact congrArg (fun z => mX.inv ≫ z)
          (Category.assoc aO mY.hom mY.inv).symm
      _ = mX.inv ≫
            ((mX.hom ≫ aO) ≫ mY.inv) :=
        congrArg (fun z => mX.inv ≫ (z ≫ mY.inv))
          hForward.symm
      _ = (mX.inv ≫ mX.hom) ≫ (aO ≫ mY.inv) := by
        simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = aO ≫ mY.inv := by
        rw [mX.inv_hom_id]
        simp only [Category.id_comp]
  have hr : r ≫ aO = aQ ≫ r' := by
    dsimp only [r, r', aO, aQ, H, EU, EV, A, cast, PU, T, f, g,
      U, V, p]
    exact twistingSheafRestrictionData_basisComponent_naturality_overLift
      hOpen D hD i
  have hRHom : rMapIso.hom = r := by
    simp only [rMapIso, r, rIsoX,
      twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso, Functor.mapIso_hom,
      asIso_hom]
    rfl
  have hRHom' : rMapIso'.hom = r' := by
    simp only [rMapIso', r', rIsoY,
      twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso, Functor.mapIso_hom,
      asIso_hom]
    rfl
  letI : IsIso r := by
    rw [← hRHom]
    infer_instance
  letI : IsIso r' := by
    rw [← hRHom']
    infer_instance
  have hRInv : rMapIso.inv = inv r := by
    have hIso : rMapIso = asIso r := Iso.ext hRHom
    rw [hIso]
    rfl
  have hRInv' : rMapIso'.inv = inv r' := by
    have hIso : rMapIso' = asIso r' := Iso.ext hRHom'
    rw [hIso]
    rfl
  have hFrame := frameChange_naturality_of_three_squares
    aP aO aQ l m r l' m' r' hl hm hr
  have hSourceFrame :
      H.map (EU.functor.map
        (intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b d i U le_rfl).hom) =
      l ≫ m ≫ inv r := by
    have hSourceFrame' :
        H.map (EU.functor.map
          (intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b d i U le_rfl).hom) =
        l ≫ m ≫ rMapIso.inv := by
      dsimp only [intrinsicTwistingFrameOver, l, m, mX, alphaX,
        rMapIso]
      simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Functor.map_comp,
        Functor.mapIso_inv, rIsoX, twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso]
      rfl
    rw [hSourceFrame', hRInv]
  have hTargetFrame :
      EV.functor.map (intrinsicTwistingFrameOver c d i V le_rfl).hom =
      l' ≫ m' ≫ inv r' := by
    have hTargetFrame' :
        EV.functor.map (intrinsicTwistingFrameOver c d i V le_rfl).hom =
          l' ≫ m' ≫ rMapIso'.inv := by
      dsimp only [intrinsicTwistingFrameOver, l', m', mY, alphaY,
        rMapIso']
      simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Functor.map_comp,
        Functor.mapIso_inv, rIsoY, twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso]
      rfl
    rw [hTargetFrame', hRInv']
  calc
    _ = l ≫ m ≫ inv r ≫ aQ := by
      rw [hSourceFrame]
      rfl
    _ = aP ≫ l' ≫ m' ≫ inv r' := hFrame
    _ = _ := by rw [← hTargetFrame]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.isoLiftThroughEquivalence_map
statement:
theorem isoLiftThroughEquivalence_map
    {C : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} C]
    {D : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} D]
    (E : C ≌ D) {P Q : C}
    (e : E.functor.obj P ≅ E.functor.obj Q) :
    E.functor.map (isoLiftThroughEquivalence E e).hom = e.hom
proof:
:= by
  change E.functor.map
      (E.unitIso.hom.app P ≫ E.inverse.map e.hom ≫ E.unitIso.inv.app Q) = e.hom
  rw [E.functor.map_comp, E.functor.map_comp]
  have hc : E.functor.map (E.unitIso.inv.app Q) =
      E.counitIso.hom.app (E.functor.obj Q) :=
    (E.counit_app_functor Q).symm
  have hn : E.functor.map (E.inverse.map e.hom) ≫
      E.counitIso.hom.app (E.functor.obj Q) =
    E.counitIso.hom.app (E.functor.obj P) ≫ e.hom :=
    E.counit_naturality e.hom
  have h1 := congrArg
    (fun z ↦ E.functor.map (E.unitIso.hom.app P) ≫
      E.functor.map (E.inverse.map e.hom) ≫ z) hc
  have h2 := congrArg
    (fun z ↦ E.functor.map (E.unitIso.hom.app P) ≫ z) hn
  have h3 : E.functor.map (E.unitIso.hom.app P) ≫
      E.counitIso.hom.app (E.functor.obj P) ≫ e.hom = e.hom := by
    have hu : E.functor.map (E.unitIso.hom.app P) ≫
        E.counitIso.hom.app (E.functor.obj P) = 𝟙 (E.functor.obj P) :=
      E.functor_unitIso_comp P
    have hu' := congrArg (fun z ↦ z ≫ e.hom) hu
    exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
      (hu'.trans (Category.id_comp e.hom))
  exact h1.trans (h2.trans h3)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLiftTransport_action
statement:
theorem intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLiftTransport_action
    {R S M N ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [Finite ι]
    {b : Module.Basis ι R M} {c : Module.Basis ι S N}
    {d : ℤ} {q : space S N ⟶ space R M} [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (D : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c d q)
    (hOpen : ∀ i, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b i) =
      linearOpen S N (c i))
    (hD : D.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q hOpen).hom)
    (i : ι) :
    let X
proof:
:= space R M
    let Y := space S N
    let U := linearOpen R M (b i)
    let V := linearOpen S N (c i)
    let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (restrictOpenLift q U V (hOpen i))
    let EU := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U
    let EV := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V
    let E := EV.functor
    let T := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d
    let A := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso q U V (hOpen i)
    let B := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivFreePUnitIso q U V (hOpen i)
    let F := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLiftTransport hOpen D hD i
    H.map (EU.functor.map (intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b d i U le_rfl).hom) ≫
        (A T).hom = B.hom ≫ E.map F.val.hom := by
  dsimp only
  let X := space R M
  let Y := space S N
  let U := linearOpen R M (b i)
  let V := linearOpen S N (c i)
  let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (restrictOpenLift q U V (hOpen i))
  let EU := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U
  let EV := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V
  let E := EV.functor
  let T := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d
  let A := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso q U V (hOpen i)
  let B := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivFreePUnitIso q U V (hOpen i)
  let F := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLiftTransport hOpen D hD i
  have hFrame := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLift_naturality hOpen D hD i
  change H.map (EU.functor.map
      (intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b d i U le_rfl).hom) ≫
      (A T).hom ≫ E.map (D.restrictIso.hom.over V) =
    B.hom ≫ E.map (intrinsicTwistingFrameOver c d i V le_rfl).hom at hFrame
  have hF := F.property
  change F.val.hom ≫ D.restrictIso.hom.over V =
    (intrinsicTwistingFrameOver c d i V le_rfl).hom at hF
  have hFE := congrArg E.map hF
  simp only [Functor.map_comp] at hFE
  have hSq := hFrame
  rw [hFE.symm] at hSq
  have hSq' :
      H.map (EU.functor.map
          (intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b d i U le_rfl).hom) ≫
        (A T).hom = B.hom ≫ E.map F.val.hom := by
    apply (cancel_mono (E.map (D.restrictIso.hom.over V))).1
    simpa only [Category.assoc] using hSq
  exact hSq'

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushedUnitToOpenOverIso_refl_completion
statement:
private theorem pushedUnitToOpenOverIso_refl_completion
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (V : X.Opens) :
    pushedUnitToOpenOverIso (le_rfl : V ≤ V) = Iso.refl _
proof:
:= by
  let r := (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
    (le_rfl : V ≤ V)).over V
  letI : IsIso r := pushedUnitRestriction_over_isIso_of_le le_rfl le_rfl
  have hrr : r ≫ r = r := by
    simpa [r] using
      (pushedUnitRestriction_over_comp
        (hVU := le_rfl) (hWV := le_rfl) (A := V))
  have hr : r = 𝟙 _ := by
    apply (cancel_epi r).1
    calc
      r ≫ r = r := hrr
      _ = 𝟙 _ ≫ r := by simp
  apply Iso.ext
  simpa only [pushedUnitToOpenOverIso, r, asIso_hom, Iso.refl_hom] using hr

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver_openLiftTransport_comp_basisComponents
statement:
theorem intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver_openLiftTransport_comp_basisComponents
    {R S M N ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [Finite ι]
    {b : Module.Basis ι R M} {c : Module.Basis ι S N}
    {d e : ℤ} {q : space S N ⟶ space R M} [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (Dd : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c d q)
    (De : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c e q)
    (hOpen : ∀ i, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b i) =
      linearOpen S N (c i))
    (hDd : Dd.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q hOpen).hom)
    (hDe : De.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q hOpen).hom)
    (i : ι) :
    let Y
proof:
:= space S N
    let V := linearOpen S N (c i)
    let Fd := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLiftTransport hOpen Dd hDd i
    let Fe := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLiftTransport hOpen De hDe i
    (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver V Fd.val Fe.val).hom ≫
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap Y
        (Dd.restrictIso.hom ≫ twistingSheafBasisComponent S N c d i)
        (De.restrictIso.hom ≫ twistingSheafBasisComponent S N c e i)).over V =
    (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver V
      (pushedUnitOpenFrame Y V) (pushedUnitOpenFrame Y V)).hom := by
  dsimp only
  let Y := space S N
  let V := linearOpen S N (c i)
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q
  let Fd := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLiftTransport hOpen Dd hDd i
  let Fe := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLiftTransport hOpen De hDe i
  let frameD := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver c d i V le_rfl
  let frameE := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver c e i V le_rfl
  let pushedFrame := pushedUnitOpenFrame Y V
  let f' := twistingSheafBasisComponent S N c d i
  let g' := twistingSheafBasisComponent S N c e i
  let fIso := twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso S N c d i le_rfl
  let gIso := twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso S N c e i le_rfl
  let aIso :=
    (SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf V).mapIso Dd.restrictIso ≪≫ fIso
  let bIso :=
    (SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf V).mapIso De.restrictIso ≪≫ gIso
  have hFrameD : frameD.hom ≫ fIso.hom = pushedFrame.hom := by
    have h := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_hom_comp_basisComponent
      c d i V le_rfl
    calc
      frameD.hom ≫ fIso.hom = pushedFrame.hom ≫ 𝟙 _ := by
        simpa [V, Y, frameD, fIso, pushedFrame,
          twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso,
          pushedUnitToOpenOverIso_refl_completion] using h
      _ = pushedFrame.hom := by simp
  have hFrameE : frameE.hom ≫ gIso.hom = pushedFrame.hom := by
    have h := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_hom_comp_basisComponent
      c e i V le_rfl
    calc
      frameE.hom ≫ gIso.hom = pushedFrame.hom ≫ 𝟙 _ := by
        simpa [V, Y, frameE, gIso, pushedFrame,
          twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso,
          pushedUnitToOpenOverIso_refl_completion] using h
      _ = pushedFrame.hom := by simp
  have hFd := Fd.property
  change Fd.val.hom ≫ Dd.restrictIso.hom.over V = frameD.hom at hFd
  have hFe := Fe.property
  change Fe.val.hom ≫ De.restrictIso.hom.over V = frameE.hom at hFe
  have ha : aIso.hom = Dd.restrictIso.hom.over V ≫ f'.over V := rfl
  have hb : bIso.hom = De.restrictIso.hom.over V ≫ g'.over V := rfl
  have hD : Fd.val.hom ≫ aIso.hom = pushedFrame.hom := by
    calc
      Fd.val.hom ≫ aIso.hom =
          Fd.val.hom ≫ Dd.restrictIso.hom.over V ≫ f'.over V := by
        rw [ha]
      _ = frameD.hom ≫ f'.over V :=
        congrArg (fun f => f ≫ f'.over V) hFd
      _ = pushedFrame.hom := hFrameD
  have hE : Fe.val.hom ≫ bIso.hom = pushedFrame.hom := by
    calc
      Fe.val.hom ≫ bIso.hom =
          Fe.val.hom ≫ De.restrictIso.hom.over V ≫ g'.over V := by
        rw [hb]
      _ = frameE.hom ≫ g'.over V :=
        congrArg (fun f => f ≫ g'.over V) hFe
      _ = pushedFrame.hom := hFrameE
  have hTensor := tensorFrameOverLocal_hom_naturality_of_commuting_frames
    (X := Y) V aIso bIso Fd.val Fe.val pushedFrame pushedFrame
    (Iso.refl _) hD hE
  rw [tensorSheafMap_hom_over]
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver,
    Iso.trans_hom, Iso.refl_hom, Category.id_comp,
    Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  change
    (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFreePUnitFrameOver V).hom ≫
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso Y V Fd.val Fe.val).hom ≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap Y V aIso.hom bIso.hom ≫
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y V
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y V)
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y V)).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFreePUnitFrameOver V).hom ≫
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso Y V pushedFrame pushedFrame).hom ≫
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y V
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y V)
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y V)).hom
  exact congrArg
    (fun z => z ≫ (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y V
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y V)
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y V)).hom) hTensor

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver_openLift_naturality
statement:
theorem intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver_openLift_naturality
    {R S M N ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [Finite ι]
    {b : Module.Basis ι R M} {c : Module.Basis ι S N}
    {d e : ℤ} {q : space S N ⟶ space R M} [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (Dd : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c d q)
    (De : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c e q)
    (Ds : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c (d + e) q)
    (hOpen : ∀ i, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b i) =
      linearOpen S N (c i))
    (hDd : Dd.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q hOpen).hom)
    (hDe : De.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q hOpen).hom)
    (hDs : Ds.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q hOpen).hom)
    (i : ι) :
    let V
proof:
:= linearOpen S N (c i)
    let Fd := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLiftTransport
      hOpen Dd hDd i
    let Fe := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLiftTransport
      hOpen De hDe i
    let Fs := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLiftTransport
      hOpen Ds hDs i
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (space S N)
        Dd.restrictIso.hom De.restrictIso.hom).over V ≫
      (intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver c d e i V le_rfl).hom =
    ((Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver V Fd.val Fe.val).symm ≪≫
      Fs.val).hom ≫ Ds.restrictIso.hom.over V := by
  dsimp only
  let V := linearOpen S N (c i)
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q
  let Td := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d
  let Te := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b e
  let Ts := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b (d + e)
  let Td' := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex S N c d
  let Te' := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex S N c e
  let Ts' := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex S N c (d + e)
  let Fd := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLiftTransport hOpen Dd hDd i
  let Fe := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLiftTransport hOpen De hDe i
  let Fs := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLiftTransport hOpen Ds hDs i
  let fd := Fd.val
  let fe := Fe.val
  let fs := Fs.val
  let gd := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver c d i V le_rfl
  let ge := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver c e i V le_rfl
  let gs := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver c (d + e) i V le_rfl
  let Tsrc := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver V fd fe
  let Ttgt := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver V gd ge
  have hTensor := tensorFrameOver_hom_naturality_of_commuting_frames
    (Y := space S N) V Dd.restrictIso De.restrictIso fd fe gd ge
    (Iso.refl _) Fd.property Fe.property
  have hTensor' : Tsrc.hom ≫
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (space S N)
        Dd.restrictIso.hom De.restrictIso.hom).over V = Ttgt.hom := by
    simpa only [Tsrc, Ttgt, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.refl_hom,
      Category.id_comp] using hTensor
  have hSum := Fs.property
  have hTensorInv :
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (space S N)
        Dd.restrictIso.hom De.restrictIso.hom).over V ≫ Ttgt.inv = Tsrc.inv := by
    apply (cancel_epi Tsrc.hom).1
    calc
      Tsrc.hom ≫
          ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (space S N)
            Dd.restrictIso.hom De.restrictIso.hom).over V ≫ Ttgt.inv) =
        (Tsrc.hom ≫
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (space S N)
            Dd.restrictIso.hom De.restrictIso.hom).over V) ≫ Ttgt.inv :=
          (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = Ttgt.hom ≫ Ttgt.inv := by rw [hTensor']
      _ = 𝟙 _ := Iso.hom_inv_id _
      _ = Tsrc.hom ≫ Tsrc.inv := (Iso.hom_inv_id _).symm
  change (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (space S N)
      Dd.restrictIso.hom De.restrictIso.hom).over V ≫
    (Ttgt.symm ≪≫ gs).hom =
    (Tsrc.symm ≪≫ fs).hom ≫ Ds.restrictIso.hom.over V
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom]
  calc
    _ = ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (space S N)
          Dd.restrictIso.hom De.restrictIso.hom).over V ≫ Ttgt.inv) ≫ gs.hom :=
        (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = Tsrc.inv ≫ gs.hom :=
      congrArg (fun f ↦ f ≫ gs.hom) hTensorInv
    _ = Tsrc.inv ≫ (fs.hom ≫ Ds.restrictIso.hom.over V) := by rw [← hSum]
    _ = (Tsrc.inv ≫ fs.hom) ≫ Ds.restrictIso.hom.over V :=
      (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso_twistingComponents_naturality
statement:
theorem restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso_twistingComponents_naturality
    {R S M N ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [Finite ι]
    {b : Module.Basis ι R M} {c : Module.Basis ι S N}
    {d e : ℤ} {q : space S N ⟶ space R M} [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (Dd : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c d q)
    (De : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c e q)
    (hOpen : ∀ i, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b i) =
      linearOpen S N (c i))
    (hDd : Dd.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q hOpen).hom)
    (hDe : De.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q hOpen).hom)
    (i : ι) :
    let X
proof:
:= space R M
    let Y := space S N
    let U := linearOpen R M (b i)
    let V := linearOpen S N (c i)
    let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (restrictOpenLift q U V (hOpen i))
    let EU := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U
    let EV := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V
    let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q
    let Td := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d
    let Te := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b e
    let PU := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X U
    let PV := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y V
    let f := twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b d i
    let g := twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b e i
    let f' := twistingSheafBasisComponent S N c d i
    let g' := twistingSheafBasisComponent S N c e i
    let cast := pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso q U V (hOpen i)
    let C₀ := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso_viaRestriction q U V (hOpen i) Td Te
    let C₁ := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso_viaRestriction q U V (hOpen i) PU PU
    H.map (EU.functor.map ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X f g).over U)) ≫
        C₁.hom ≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
          (EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over V))
          (EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over V)) =
      C₀.hom ≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
          (EV.functor.map (Dd.restrictIso.hom.over V))
          (EV.functor.map (De.restrictIso.hom.over V)) ≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
          (EV.functor.map (f'.over V))
          (EV.functor.map (g'.over V)) := by
  dsimp only
  let X := space R M
  let Y := space S N
  let U := linearOpen R M (b i)
  let V := linearOpen S N (c i)
  let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (restrictOpenLift q U V (hOpen i))
  let EU := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U
  let EV := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q
  let Td := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d
  let Te := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b e
  let PU := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X U
  let PV := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y V
  let f := twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b d i
  let g := twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b e i
  let f' := twistingSheafBasisComponent S N c d i
  let g' := twistingSheafBasisComponent S N c e i
  let cast := pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso q U V (hOpen i)
  let C₀ := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso_viaRestriction q U V (hOpen i) Td Te
  let C₁ := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso_viaRestriction q U V (hOpen i) PU PU
  have hC := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso_viaRestriction_hom_naturality
    q U V (hOpen i) f g
  change H.map (EU.functor.map
      ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X f g).over U)) ≫ C₁.hom =
    C₀.hom ≫ SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
      (EV.functor.map ((G.map f).over V))
      (EV.functor.map ((G.map g).over V)) at hC
  have hC' := congrArg
    (fun z => z ≫ SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
      (EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over V))
      (EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over V))) hC
  have hfd := twistingSheafRestrictionData_basisComponent_naturality
    hOpen Dd hDd i
  have hge := twistingSheafRestrictionData_basisComponent_naturality
    hOpen De hDe i
  change G.map f ≫ cast.hom = Dd.restrictIso.hom ≫ (f') at hfd
  change G.map g ≫ cast.hom = De.restrictIso.hom ≫ (g') at hge
  have hfdV := congrArg (fun z => z.over V) hfd
  have hgeV := congrArg (fun z => z.over V) hge
  change (G.map f).over V ≫ cast.hom.over V =
      Dd.restrictIso.hom.over V ≫ f'.over V at hfdV
  change (G.map g).over V ≫ cast.hom.over V =
      De.restrictIso.hom.over V ≫ g'.over V at hgeV
  have hfdE := congrArg EV.functor.map hfdV
  have hgeE := congrArg EV.functor.map hgeV
  simp only [Functor.map_comp] at hfdE hgeE
  change H.map (EU.functor.map
      ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X f g).over U)) ≫ C₁.hom ≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
          (EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over V))
          (EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over V)) =
    C₀.hom ≫
      SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
        (EV.functor.map (Dd.restrictIso.hom.over V))
        (EV.functor.map (De.restrictIso.hom.over V)) ≫
      SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
        (EV.functor.map (f'.over V))
        (EV.functor.map (g'.over V))
  calc
    _ = (C₀.hom ≫
          SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
            (EV.functor.map ((G.map f).over V))
            (EV.functor.map ((G.map g).over V))) ≫
          SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
            (EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over V))
            (EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over V)) := by
        simpa only [Category.assoc] using hC'
    _ = C₀.hom ≫
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
            (EV.functor.map ((G.map f).over V))
            (EV.functor.map ((G.map g).over V)) ≫
          SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
            (EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over V))
            (EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over V))) := by
        simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = C₀.hom ≫
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
            (EV.functor.map ((G.map f).over V) ≫
              EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over V))
            (EV.functor.map ((G.map g).over V) ≫
              EV.functor.map (cast.hom.over V))) := by
        rw [SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap_comp]
    _ = C₀.hom ≫
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
            (EV.functor.map (Dd.restrictIso.hom.over V) ≫
              EV.functor.map (f'.over V))
            (EV.functor.map (De.restrictIso.hom.over V) ≫
              EV.functor.map (g'.over V))) := by
        rw [hfdE, hgeE]
    _ = _ := by rw [SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap_comp]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistingSheafRestrictionData_tensorNaturality_of_basisOpens

theorem twistingSheafRestrictionData_tensorNaturality_of_basisOpens
    {R S M N ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [Finite ι]
    {b : Module.Basis ι R M} {c : Module.Basis ι S N}
    {d e : ℤ} {q : space S N ⟶ space R M} [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (Dd : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c d q)
    (De : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c e q)
    (Ds : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c (d + e) q)
    (hLocal : ∀ i,
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
          (intrinsicTwistingTensorHom b d e)).over
            (linearOpen S N (c i)) ≫
        Ds.restrictIso.hom.over (linearOpen S N (c i)) =
      (SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q
          (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d)
          (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b e)).hom.over
            (linearOpen S N (c i)) ≫
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (space S N)
          Dd.restrictIso.hom De.restrictIso.hom).over
            (linearOpen S N (c i)) ≫
        (intrinsicTwistingTensorHom c d e).over
          (linearOpen S N (c i))) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
          (intrinsicTwistingTensorHom b d e) ≫ Ds.restrictIso.hom =
      (SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q
          (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d)
          (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b e)).hom ≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (space S N)
          Dd.restrictIso.hom De.restrictIso.hom ≫
        intrinsicTwistingTensorHom c d e
proof:
:= by
  apply modulesHom_ext_of_over_coversTop
    (fun i : ι ↦ linearOpen S N (c i))
    (intrinsicLinearOpen_coversTop c)
  exact hLocal

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistingSheafRestrictionData_tensorNaturality_of_sourceFrameAction
statement:
theorem twistingSheafRestrictionData_tensorNaturality_of_sourceFrameAction
    {R S M N ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [Finite ι]
    {b : Module.Basis ι R M} {c : Module.Basis ι S N}
    {d e : ℤ} {q : space S N ⟶ space R M} [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (Dd : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c d q)
    (De : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c e q)
    (Ds : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c (d + e) q)
    (hOpen : ∀ i, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b i) =
      linearOpen S N (c i))
    (hDd : Dd.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q hOpen).hom)
    (hDe : De.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q hOpen).hom)
    (hDs : Ds.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q hOpen).hom)
    (hAction : ∀ i,
      let X := space R M
      let Y := space S N
      let U := linearOpen R M (b i)
      let V := linearOpen S N (c i)
      let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
        (restrictOpenLift q U V (hOpen i))
      let EU := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U
      let EV := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V
      let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q
      let Td := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d
      let Te := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b e
      let Ts := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b (d + e)
      let A (T : X.Modules) := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso q U V (hOpen i) T
      let Fd := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLiftTransport hOpen Dd hDd i
      let Fe := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLiftTransport hOpen De hDe i
      let Fs := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLiftTransport hOpen Ds hDs i
      let Tframe := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver V
        Fd.val Fe.val
      H.map (EU.functor.map
          (intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver b d e i U le_rfl).hom) ≫
        (A Ts).hom =
      (A (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X Td Te)).hom ≫
        EV.functor.map
          ((SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q Td Te).hom.over V) ≫
        EV.functor.map Tframe.symm.hom ≫
        EV.functor.map Fs.val.hom) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
          (intrinsicTwistingTensorHom b d e) ≫ Ds.restrictIso.hom =
      (SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q
          (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d)
          (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b e)).hom ≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (space S N)
          Dd.restrictIso.hom De.restrictIso.hom ≫
        intrinsicTwistingTensorHom c d e
proof:
:= by
  apply twistingSheafRestrictionData_tensorNaturality_of_basisOpens
    Dd De Ds
  intro i
  rw [intrinsicTwistingTensorHom_over c d e i]
  let X := space R M
  let Y := space S N
  let U := linearOpen R M (b i)
  let V := linearOpen S N (c i)
  let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (restrictOpenLift q U V (hOpen i))
  let EU := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U
  let EV := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V
  let E := EV.functor
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q
  let Td := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d
  let Te := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b e
  let Ts := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b (d + e)
  let A (T : X.Modules) := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso q U V (hOpen i) T
  let Fd := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLiftTransport hOpen Dd hDd i
  let Fe := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLiftTransport hOpen De hDe i
  let Fs := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLiftTransport hOpen Ds hDs i
  let Tframe := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver V
    Fd.val Fe.val
  have hA := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso_naturality q U V (hOpen i)
    (intrinsicTwistingTensorHom b d e)
  change H.map (EU.functor.map
      ((intrinsicTwistingTensorHom b d e).over U)) ≫ (A Ts).hom =
    (A (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X Td Te)).hom ≫
      E.map (((G.map (intrinsicTwistingTensorHom b d e)).over V)) at hA
  rw [intrinsicTwistingTensorHom_over b d e i] at hA
  have hAct := hAction i
  change H.map (EU.functor.map
      (intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver b d e i U le_rfl).hom) ≫
      (A Ts).hom =
      (A (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X Td Te)).hom ≫
        E.map (((SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q Td Te).hom.over V)) ≫
        E.map (Tframe.symm.hom) ≫ E.map (Fs.val.hom) at hAct
  have hActionDs := congrArg
    (fun z => z ≫ E.map (Ds.restrictIso.hom.over V)) hAct
  have hTensorFrame := intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver_openLift_naturality
    Dd De Ds hOpen hDd hDe hDs i
  have hTensorFrameE := congrArg E.map hTensorFrame
  simp only [Functor.map_comp] at hTensorFrameE
  change E.map ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap Y
        Dd.restrictIso.hom De.restrictIso.hom).over V) ≫
      E.map (intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver c d e i V le_rfl).hom =
    E.map (Tframe.symm.hom) ≫ E.map (Fs.val.hom) ≫
      E.map (Ds.restrictIso.hom.over V) at hTensorFrameE
  have hActionDs' :
      H.map (EU.functor.map
          (intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver b d e i U le_rfl).hom) ≫
        (A Ts).hom ≫ E.map (Ds.restrictIso.hom.over V) =
      (A (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X Td Te)).hom ≫
        E.map (((SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q Td Te).hom.over V)) ≫
        E.map ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap Y
          Dd.restrictIso.hom De.restrictIso.hom).over V) ≫
        E.map (intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver c d e i V le_rfl).hom := by
    calc
      _ = (A (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X Td Te)).hom ≫
          E.map (((SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q Td Te).hom.over V)) ≫
          E.map (Tframe.symm.hom) ≫ E.map (Fs.val.hom) ≫
          E.map (Ds.restrictIso.hom.over V) := hActionDs
      _ = (A (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X Td Te)).hom ≫
          E.map (((SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q Td Te).hom.over V)) ≫
          E.map ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap Y
            Dd.restrictIso.hom De.restrictIso.hom).over V) ≫
          E.map (intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver c d e i V le_rfl).hom := by
        simpa only [Category.assoc] using
          congrArg
            (fun z => (A (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X Td Te)).hom ≫
              E.map (((SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q Td Te).hom.over V)) ≫ z)
            hTensorFrameE.symm
  have hA' := congrArg
    (fun z => z ≫ E.map (Ds.restrictIso.hom.over V)) hA
  have hLocalE :
      (A (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X Td Te)).hom ≫
          E.map (((G.map (intrinsicTwistingTensorHom b d e)).over V)) ≫
          E.map (Ds.restrictIso.hom.over V) =
        (A (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X Td Te)).hom ≫
          E.map (((SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q Td Te).hom.over V)) ≫
          E.map ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap Y
            Dd.restrictIso.hom De.restrictIso.hom).over V) ≫
          E.map (intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver c d e i V le_rfl).hom := by
    simpa only [Category.assoc] using hA'.symm.trans hActionDs'
  apply E.map_injective
  apply (cancel_epi (A (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X Td Te)).hom).1
  simpa only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc] using hLocalE

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver_openLift_action_of_middleSquare
statement:
theorem intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver_openLift_action_of_middleSquare
    {R S M N ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [Finite ι]
    {b : Module.Basis ι R M} {c : Module.Basis ι S N}
    {d e : ℤ} {q : space S N ⟶ space R M} [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (Dd : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c d q)
    (De : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c e q)
    (Ds : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c (d + e) q)
    (hOpen : ∀ i, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b i) =
      linearOpen S N (c i))
    (hDd : Dd.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q hOpen).hom)
    (hDe : De.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q hOpen).hom)
    (hDs : Ds.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q hOpen).hom)
    (i : ι)
    (hMiddle :
      let X := space R M
      let Y := space S N
      let U := linearOpen R M (b i)
      let V := linearOpen S N (c i)
      let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
        (restrictOpenLift q U V (hOpen i))
      let EU := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U
      let EV := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V
      let E := EV.functor
      let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q
      let Td := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d
      let Te := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b e
      let A (T : X.Modules) := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso q U V (hOpen i) T
      let Fd := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLiftTransport hOpen Dd hDd i
      let Fe := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLiftTransport hOpen De hDe i
      let Tframe := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver V
        Fd.val Fe.val
      let B := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivFreePUnitIso q U V (hOpen i)
      H.map (EU.functor.map
          ((Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver U
            (intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b d i U le_rfl)
            (intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b e i U le_rfl)).symm.hom)) ≫
        B.hom =
      (A (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X Td Te)).hom ≫
        E.map (((SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q Td Te).hom.over V)) ≫
        E.map Tframe.symm.hom) :
    let X
proof:
:= space R M
    let Y := space S N
    let U := linearOpen R M (b i)
    let V := linearOpen S N (c i)
    let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
      (restrictOpenLift q U V (hOpen i))
    let EU := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U
    let EV := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V
    let E := EV.functor
    let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q
    let Td := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d
    let Te := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b e
    let Ts := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b (d + e)
    let A (T : X.Modules) := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso q U V (hOpen i) T
    let Fd := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLiftTransport hOpen Dd hDd i
    let Fe := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLiftTransport hOpen De hDe i
    let Fs := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLiftTransport hOpen Ds hDs i
    let Tframe := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver V
      Fd.val Fe.val
    H.map (EU.functor.map
        (intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver b d e i U le_rfl).hom) ≫
      (A Ts).hom =
    (A (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X Td Te)).hom ≫
      E.map (((SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q Td Te).hom.over V)) ≫
      E.map Tframe.symm.hom ≫ E.map Fs.val.hom := by
  let X := space R M
  let Y := space S N
  let U := linearOpen R M (b i)
  let V := linearOpen S N (c i)
  let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (restrictOpenLift q U V (hOpen i))
  let EU := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U
  let EV := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V
  let E := EV.functor
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q
  let Td := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d
  let Te := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b e
  let Ts := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b (d + e)
  let A (T : X.Modules) := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso q U V (hOpen i) T
  let B := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivFreePUnitIso q U V (hOpen i)
  let Fd := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLiftTransport hOpen Dd hDd i
  let Fe := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLiftTransport hOpen De hDe i
  let Fs := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLiftTransport hOpen Ds hDs i
  let Tframe := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver V Fd.val Fe.val
  let sourceTensorFrame := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver U
    (intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b d i U le_rfl)
    (intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b e i U le_rfl)
  let sourceSumFrame := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b (d + e) i U le_rfl
  let l := H.map (EU.functor.map sourceTensorFrame.symm.hom)
  let rMapIso := (H.mapIso (EU.functor.mapIso sourceSumFrame)).symm
  let r := rMapIso.hom
  let l' := E.map Tframe.symm.hom
  let rMapIso' := (E.mapIso Fs.val).symm
  let r' := rMapIso'.hom
  let aP := (A (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X Td Te)).hom ≫
    E.map (((SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q Td Te).hom.over V))
  have hl : l ≫ B.hom = aP ≫ l' := by
    exact hMiddle
  have hm : (𝟙 _) ≫ B.hom = B.hom ≫ (𝟙 _) := by
    simp
  have hFsVal :
      E.map (Fs.val.hom) = B.inv ≫
        H.map (EU.functor.map sourceSumFrame.hom) ≫ (A Ts).hom := by
    dsimp [Fs, intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLiftTransport]
    exact isoLiftThroughEquivalence_map EV _
  have hFsInv : rMapIso'.inv = B.inv ≫ rMapIso.inv ≫ (A Ts).hom := by
    change E.map (Fs.val.hom) = _
    rw [hFsVal]
    simp only [rMapIso, Iso.symm_inv, Functor.mapIso_hom,
      Functor.mapIso_inv, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  have hr : r ≫ B.hom = (A Ts).hom ≫ r' := by
    apply (cancel_mono (rMapIso'.inv ≫ (A Ts).inv)).1
    calc
      (r ≫ B.hom) ≫ (rMapIso'.inv ≫ (A Ts).inv) =
          (rMapIso.hom ≫ B.hom) ≫
            ((B.inv ≫ rMapIso.inv ≫ (A Ts).hom) ≫ (A Ts).inv) := by
              rw [hFsInv]
      _ = 𝟙 _ := by
        simp
      _ = ((A Ts).hom ≫ rMapIso'.hom) ≫
            (rMapIso'.inv ≫ (A Ts).inv) := by
        simp [Ts, H, EU]
  letI : IsIso r := by
    dsimp [r]
    infer_instance
  letI : IsIso r' := by
    dsimp [r']
    infer_instance
  have hFrame := frameChange_naturality_of_three_squares
    aP B.hom (A Ts).hom l (𝟙 _) r l' (𝟙 _) r' hl hm hr
  rw [← (show rMapIso.inv = inv r by
      have hIso : rMapIso = asIso r := Iso.ext rfl
      rw [hIso]
      rfl),
    ← (show rMapIso'.inv = inv r' by
      have hIso : rMapIso' = asIso r' := Iso.ext rfl
      rw [hIso]
      rfl)] at hFrame
  simpa only [l, l', rMapIso, rMapIso', r, r', aP, A, sourceTensorFrame,
    sourceSumFrame, Tframe, Fd, Fe, Fs, intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver,
    Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_inv, Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.map_comp,
    Category.assoc,
    Category.id_comp] using hFrame

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistingSheafRestrictionData_tensorNaturality_of_middleFrameSquare
statement:
theorem twistingSheafRestrictionData_tensorNaturality_of_middleFrameSquare
    {R S M N ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [Finite ι]
    {b : Module.Basis ι R M} {c : Module.Basis ι S N}
    {d e : ℤ} {q : space S N ⟶ space R M} [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (Dd : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c d q)
    (De : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c e q)
    (Ds : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c (d + e) q)
    (hOpen : ∀ i, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b i) =
      linearOpen S N (c i))
    (hDd : Dd.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q hOpen).hom)
    (hDe : De.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q hOpen).hom)
    (hDs : Ds.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q hOpen).hom)
    (hMiddle : ∀ i,
      let X := space R M
      let Y := space S N
      let U := linearOpen R M (b i)
      let V := linearOpen S N (c i)
      let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
        (restrictOpenLift q U V (hOpen i))
      let EU := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U
      let EV := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V
      let E := EV.functor
      let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q
      let Td := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d
      let Te := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b e
      let A (T : X.Modules) := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso q U V (hOpen i) T
      let Fd := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLiftTransport hOpen Dd hDd i
      let Fe := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLiftTransport hOpen De hDe i
      let Tframe := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver V
        Fd.val Fe.val
      let B := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivFreePUnitIso q U V (hOpen i)
      H.map (EU.functor.map
          ((Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver U
            (intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b d i U le_rfl)
            (intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b e i U le_rfl)).symm.hom)) ≫
        B.hom =
      (A (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X Td Te)).hom ≫
        E.map (((SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q Td Te).hom.over V)) ≫
        E.map Tframe.symm.hom) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
          (intrinsicTwistingTensorHom b d e) ≫ Ds.restrictIso.hom =
      (SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q
          (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d)
          (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b e)).hom ≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (space S N)
          Dd.restrictIso.hom De.restrictIso.hom ≫
        intrinsicTwistingTensorHom c d e
proof:
:= by
  apply twistingSheafRestrictionData_tensorNaturality_of_sourceFrameAction
    Dd De Ds hOpen hDd hDe hDs
  intro i
  exact intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver_openLift_action_of_middleSquare
    Dd De Ds hOpen hDd hDe hDs i (hMiddle i)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.intrinsicTwistingTensorHom_restrictFactorization
statement:
theorem intrinsicTwistingTensorHom_restrictFactorization
    {R M ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [Finite ι]
    (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (d e : ℤ) (i : ι)
    {U : (space R M).Opens}
    (hUi : U ≤ linearOpen R M (b i)) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map
          (intrinsicTwistingTensorHom b d e) =
      (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).inv.app
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf (space R M)
            (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d)
            (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b e)) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map
          ((intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver b d e i U hUi).hom) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.app
          (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b (d + e))
proof:
:= by
  let GU := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι
  let E := (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor
  let ee := Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U
  let TS := SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf (space R M)
      (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d)
      (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b e)
  let Tsum := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b (d + e)
  change GU.map (intrinsicTwistingTensorHom b d e) =
    ee.inv.app TS ≫
      E.map ((intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver b d e i U hUi).hom) ≫
      ee.hom.app Tsum
  calc
    GU.map (intrinsicTwistingTensorHom b d e) =
        (ee.inv.app TS ≫ ee.hom.app TS) ≫
          GU.map (intrinsicTwistingTensorHom b d e) := by simp
    _ = ee.inv.app TS ≫
          (E.map ((intrinsicTwistingTensorHom b d e).over U) ≫
            ee.hom.app Tsum) := by
      have hn := (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.naturality
        (intrinsicTwistingTensorHom b d e)
      have hpre := congrArg
        (fun z ↦ (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).inv.app TS ≫ z)
        hn.symm
      have hkey :
          (SheafOfModules.overFunctor (space R M).ringCatSheaf U ⋙
            (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor).map
              (intrinsicTwistingTensorHom b d e) =
            (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map
              ((intrinsicTwistingTensorHom b d e).over U) := rfl
      rw [hkey] at hpre
      convert hpre using 1
      all_goals simp only [E, GU, ee, TS, Tsum, Category.assoc]
      all_goals rfl
    _ = ee.inv.app TS ≫ E.map
          ((intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver b d e i U hUi).hom) ≫
          ee.hom.app Tsum := by
      rw [intrinsicTwistingTensorHom_over_le b d e i hUi]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.minimalPrime_under_of_flat
statement:
theorem minimalPrime_under_of_flat
    {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [Module.Flat R S] {q : Ideal S} (hq : q ∈ minimalPrimes S) :
    q.under R ∈ minimalPrimes R
proof:
:= by
  letI : q.IsPrime := hq.1.1
  refine ⟨⟨inferInstance, bot_le⟩, ?_⟩
  intro p hp hpq
  letI : p.IsPrime := hp.1
  obtain ⟨Q, hQq, hQprime, hQover⟩ :=
    q.exists_ideal_le_liesOver_of_le (p := p) (q := q.under R) hpq
  letI : Q.IsPrime := hQprime
  letI : Q.LiesOver p := hQover
  have hqQ : q ≤ Q := hq.2 ⟨hQprime, bot_le⟩ hQq
  have hQ : Q = q := le_antisymm hQq hqQ
  exact le_of_eq ((Q.over_def p).trans (congrArg (Ideal.under R) hQ)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.exists_minimalPrime_over_of_faithfullyFlat
statement:
theorem exists_minimalPrime_over_of_faithfullyFlat
    {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [Module.FaithfullyFlat R S] {p : Ideal R} (hp : p ∈ minimalPrimes R) :
    ∃ q ∈ minimalPrimes S, q.under R = p
proof:
:= by
  letI : p.IsPrime := hp.1.1
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQover⟩ := p.exists_isPrime_liesOver_of_faithfullyFlat (B := S)
  letI : Q.IsPrime := hQ
  letI : Q.LiesOver p := hQover
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqQ⟩ := (⊥ : Ideal S).exists_minimalPrimes_le (J := Q) bot_le
  refine ⟨q, hq, le_antisymm ?_ ?_⟩
  · rw [Q.over_def p]
    exact Ideal.comap_mono hqQ
  · exact hp.2 (minimalPrime_under_of_flat hq).1 (by
      rw [Q.over_def p]
      exact Ideal.comap_mono hqQ)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.minimalPrimes_image_under_of_faithfullyFlat
statement:
theorem minimalPrimes_image_under_of_faithfullyFlat
    {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [Module.FaithfullyFlat R S] :
    Ideal.under R '' minimalPrimes S = minimalPrimes R
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
    exact minimalPrime_under_of_flat hq
  · intro hp
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hqp⟩ := exists_minimalPrime_over_of_faithfullyFlat (S := S) hp
    exact ⟨q, hq, hqp⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.fieldTensor_minimalPrime_under
statement:
theorem fieldTensor_minimalPrime_under
    {K L A : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] [CommRing A]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra K A] {q : Ideal (A ⊗[K] L)}
    (hq : q ∈ minimalPrimes (A ⊗[K] L)) :
    q.under A ∈ minimalPrimes A
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Free K L := Module.Free.of_divisionRing K L

statement:
theorem fieldTensor_exists_minimalPrime_over
    {K L A : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] [CommRing A]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra K A] {p : Ideal A} (hp : p ∈ minimalPrimes A) :
    ∃ q ∈ minimalPrimes (A ⊗[K] L), q.under A = p

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.algebraMap_quotient_injective_of_minimalPrime_flat
statement:
theorem algebraMap_quotient_injective_of_minimalPrime_flat
    {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [IsDomain R] [Algebra R S]
    [Module.Flat R S] {q : Ideal S} (hq : q ∈ minimalPrimes S) :
    Function.Injective (algebraMap R (S ⧸ q))
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : q.under R = ⊥ := by
    have := minimalPrime_under_of_flat (R := R) hq
    simpa only [IsDomain.minimalPrimes_eq_singleton_bot, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using this
  apply (injective_iff_map_eq_zero (algebraMap R (S ⧸ q))).mpr
  intro r hr
  have hrq : algebraMap R S r ∈ q := by
    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp
    simpa only [Ideal.Quotient.mk_algebraMap] using hr
  have : r ∈ q.under R := hrq
  simpa only [hq0, Ideal.mem_bot] using this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.trdeg_quotient_eq_of_minimalPrime_flat_integral
statement:
theorem trdeg_quotient_eq_of_minimalPrime_flat_integral
    {K : Type u} {R S : Type v} [Field K] [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [IsDomain R]
    [Algebra K R] [Algebra K S] [Algebra R S] [IsScalarTower K R S]
    [Module.Flat R S] [Algebra.IsIntegral R S]
    {q : Ideal S} (hq : q ∈ minimalPrimes S) :
    Algebra.trdeg K (S ⧸ q) = Algebra.trdeg K R
proof:
:= by
  letI : q.IsPrime := hq.1.1
  letI : FaithfulSMul R (S ⧸ q) :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective R (S ⧸ q)).mpr
      (algebraMap_quotient_injective_of_minimalPrime_flat hq)
  haveI : Algebra.IsIntegral R (S ⧸ q) := Algebra.IsIntegral.trans S
  exact SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.trdeg_eq_of_isAlgebraic K R (S ⧸ q)

:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.rationalFunctionTensor_isDomain
statement:
theorem rationalFunctionTensor_isDomain
    {K L σ : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    IsDomain (L ⊗[K] FractionRing (MvPolynomial σ K))
proof:
:= by
  let P := MvPolynomial σ K
  let T := L ⊗[K] P
  let F := FractionRing P
  let U := L ⊗[K] F
  let φ : T →ₐ[L] U := Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id L L)
    (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K P F)
  letI : Algebra T U := φ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  letI : IsScalarTower L T U := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' φ.comp_algebraMap.symm
  letI : IsDomain T :=
    (MvPolynomial.algebraTensorAlgEquiv K L (σ := σ)).toRingEquiv.toMulEquiv.isDomain _
  have hφ : (algebraMap T U).comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom =
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap P F) := by
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro p
    change φ (1 ⊗ₜ[K] p) = 1 ⊗ₜ[K] algebraMap P F p
    rfl
  letI : IsLocalization
      ((nonZeroDivisors P).map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := K) (A := L))) U :=
    IsLocalization.tensorProduct_tensorProduct_right K L (nonZeroDivisors P) F hφ
  letI : Module.Free K P := Module.Free.of_divisionRing K P
  have hinj : Function.Injective
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : P →ₐ[K] T) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_injective (algebraMap K L).injective
  apply IsLocalization.isDomain_of_le_nonZeroDivisors (R := T)
    (M := (nonZeroDivisors P).map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := K) (A := L))) U
  rintro _ ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  apply mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero
  simpa only [map_zero] using hinj.ne (nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hp)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.rationalFunctionTensor_trdeg
statement:
theorem rationalFunctionTensor_trdeg
    {K L σ : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] :
    Algebra.trdeg L (L ⊗[K] FractionRing (MvPolynomial σ K)) = Cardinal.mk σ
proof:
:= by
  let P := MvPolynomial σ K
  let T := L ⊗[K] P
  let F := FractionRing P
  let U := L ⊗[K] F
  let φ : T →ₐ[L] U := Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id L L)
    (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K P F)
  letI : Algebra T U := φ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  letI : IsScalarTower L T U := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' φ.comp_algebraMap.symm
  letI : IsDomain T :=
    (MvPolynomial.algebraTensorAlgEquiv K L (σ := σ)).toRingEquiv.toMulEquiv.isDomain _
  have hφ : (algebraMap T U).comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom =
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap P F) := by
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro p
    change φ (1 ⊗ₜ[K] p) = 1 ⊗ₜ[K] algebraMap P F p
    rfl
  letI : IsLocalization
      ((nonZeroDivisors P).map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := K) (A := L))) U :=
    IsLocalization.tensorProduct_tensorProduct_right K L (nonZeroDivisors P) F hφ
  letI : Module.Free K P := Module.Free.of_divisionRing K P
  have hinj : Function.Injective
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : P →ₐ[K] T) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_injective (algebraMap K L).injective
  have hM : (nonZeroDivisors P).map
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := K) (A := L)) ≤ nonZeroDivisors T := by
    rintro _ ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    apply mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero
    simpa only [map_zero] using hinj.ne (nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hp)
  letI : IsDomain U := rationalFunctionTensor_isDomain (K := K) (L := L) (σ := σ)
  letI : FaithfulSMul T U := (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective T U).mpr
    (IsLocalization.injective U hM)
  letI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic T U := IsLocalization.isAlgebraic U
    ((nonZeroDivisors P).map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := K) (A := L)))
  calc
    Algebra.trdeg L U = Algebra.trdeg L T :=
      SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.trdeg_eq_of_isAlgebraic L T U
    _ = Algebra.trdeg L (MvPolynomial σ L) :=
      (MvPolynomial.algebraTensorAlgEquiv K L (σ := σ)).trdeg_eq
    _ = Cardinal.mk σ := by rw [MvPolynomial.trdeg_of_isDomain, Cardinal.lift_id]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D32.hasAmpleGenerators_of_open_closed
statement:
theorem hasAmpleGenerators_of_open_closed {k : Type u} [Field k] (N : ℕ)
    (hext : ProjExtGate k N) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X]
    (i : X ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i] (ι : Y ⟶ space k N) [IsOpenImmersion ι]
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) : HasAmpleGenerators L
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian Y := isLocallyNoetherian_of_isOpenImmersion ι
  haveI hLfp : L.IsFinitePresentation :=
    IsFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation X hL.isFiniteLocallyFree
  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj L).IsFinitePresentation :=
    isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_isFinite i L
  obtain ⟨G, hG, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hext Y ι ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj L)
  haveI := hG
  obtain ⟨D, Gs, hGs⟩ := serre_generation k N G
  letI := hGs
  let V := projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (D : ℤ)
  let B : X.Modules := twistPullbackNat (k := k) N (i ≫ ι) D
  have hB : HasConstantRank X B 1 := hasConstantRank_twistPullbackNat N (i ≫ ι) D
  refine ⟨B, hB, twistPullbackNat_generated N (i ≫ ι) D, ?_⟩
  let VY : Y.Modules := (Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj V
  have hVY : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y VY :=
    pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global ι V (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree k N _)
  let B' : X.Modules := (Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj VY
  let cB : B' ≅ B := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp i ι).app V
  let L' : X.Modules := tensorSheaf X B' L
  have hL' : HasConstantRank X (tensorSheaf X L B) 1 := by
    have h := hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hL hB
    rwa [Nat.one_mul] at h
  let e1 : tensorSheaf Y VY ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj L) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj L' :=
    projectionFormulaIso i VY hVY L
  haveI : Finite Gs.I := hGs.finite
  letI : Fintype Gs.I := Fintype.ofFinite Gs.I
  let γ : (Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj G ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj L :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback ι).app G).symm ≪≫ e
  let β : (Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj (tensorSheaf (space k N) V G) ≅
      tensorSheaf Y VY ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj L) :=
    openPullbackTensorIso ι V G ≪≫ tensorSheafMapIso Y (Iso.refl VY) γ
  let π0 : FreeM (space k N) Gs.I ⟶ tensorSheaf (space k N) V G := Gs.π
  haveI : Epi π0 := Gs.epi
  let ψ : FreeM Y Gs.I ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj L' :=
    (pullbackFreeIso ι Gs.I).inv ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).map π0 ≫ β.hom ≫ e1.hom
  haveI hP : Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).map π0) := inferInstance
  haveI : Epi ψ :=
    epi_comp' (inferInstance : Epi (pullbackFreeIso ι Gs.I).inv)
      (epi_comp' hP (epi_comp' inferInstance inferInstance))
  haveI hP2 : Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).map ψ) := inferInstance
  haveI hC := ClosedImmersionCoverF11.counit_epi i L'
  let φ : FreeM X Gs.I ⟶ L' :=
    (pullbackFreeIso i Gs.I).inv ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback i).map ψ ≫ ClosedImmersionCoverF11.counitHom i L'
  haveI : Epi φ := epi_comp' (inferInstance : Epi (pullbackFreeIso i Gs.I).inv)
    (epi_comp' hP2 hC)
  let φ' : FreeM X Gs.I ⟶ tensorSheaf X L B :=
    φ ≫ (tensorSheafSymmetry X _ _).hom ≫ tensorSheafMap X (𝟙 L) cB.hom
  haveI : Epi φ' := epi_comp' inferInstance
    (epi_comp' inferInstance (by
      haveI : IsIso (tensorSheafMap X (𝟙 L) cB.hom) :=
        (tensorSheafMapIso X (Iso.refl L) cB).isIso_hom
      infer_instance))
  exact isPointwiseGenerated_of_epi_free Gs.I hL' φ'

    (hcomap : (((m7geo_closure_preimage_affine w U).primeIdealOf ⟨z, hzU⟩).asIdeal).comap
      ((pointClosureι w).app U.1).hom =
      RingHom.ker ((pointClosureι w).app U.1).hom ⊔ Ideal.span {x}) :

proof:

    (pointClosureScheme w).ord

  let V := pointClosureι w ⁻¹ᵁ U.1

      Ideal.span {((pointClosureι w).app U.1 x)} :=
    m7geo_principal_of_comap_kernel_sup _
      (m7geo_closure_app_surjective w U) _ x hcomap
  exact Scheme.m7geo_ord_germ_eq_one' V (m7geo_closure_preimage_affine w U)
    ⟨z, hzU⟩ hz _ hprincipal

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.irrelevant_le_map_gradedLocalizationMap
statement:
theorem irrelevant_le_map_gradedLocalizationMap (I : Ideal R) (g : R) :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading (localizedIdeal I g)) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading I)).map (gradedLocalizationMap I g)
proof:
:= by
  refine (HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_irrelevant_le
    (grading (localizedIdeal I g))).2 ?_
  intro d hd q hq
  obtain ⟨p, n, hpn⟩ := exists_reesLocalizationMap_mul_denominator I g q
  have hpn' :
      q * (gradedLocalizationMap I g (reesDenominator I g)) ^ n =
        gradedLocalizationMap I g p := by
    simpa only [gradedLocalizationMap_apply] using hpn
  have hden_source : reesDenominator I g ∈ grading I 0 := by
    exact SetLike.algebraMap_mem_graded (grading I) g
  have hden_target :
      gradedLocalizationMap I g (reesDenominator I g) ∈
        grading (localizedIdeal I g) 0 :=
    (gradedLocalizationMap I g).map_mem hden_source
  have hproduct :
      q * (gradedLocalizationMap I g (reesDenominator I g)) ^ n ∈
        grading (localizedIdeal I g) d := by
    simpa using SetLike.mul_mem_graded
      (A := grading (localizedIdeal I g)) hq
      (SetLike.pow_mem_graded (A := grading (localizedIdeal I g)) n hden_target)
  let p_d : grading I d := DirectSum.decompose (grading I) p d
  have hmap_p_d :
      gradedLocalizationMap I g (p_d : reesAlgebra I) =
        gradedLocalizationMap I g p := by
    calc
      gradedLocalizationMap I g (p_d : reesAlgebra I) =
          (DirectSum.decompose (grading (localizedIdeal I g))
            (gradedLocalizationMap I g p) d :
              reesAlgebra (localizedIdeal I g)) := by
            dsimp only [p_d]
            exact (gradedLocalizationMap I g).map_directSumDecompose
      _ = gradedLocalizationMap I g p := by
        rw [← hpn']
        exact DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_same _ hproduct
  have hp_d_irrelevant :
      (p_d : reesAlgebra I) ∈
        HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading I) :=
    HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem (grading I) hd p_d.2
  have hmap_p_d_mem :
      gradedLocalizationMap I g (p_d : reesAlgebra I) ∈
        ((HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading I)).map
          (gradedLocalizationMap I g)).toIdeal :=
    Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (gradedLocalizationMap I g) hp_d_irrelevant
  have hden_mul_inv :
      gradedLocalizationMap I g (reesDenominator I g) *
          reesDenominatorInverse I g = 1 := by
    simpa only [gradedLocalizationMap_apply] using
      reesLocalizationMap_denominator_mul_inverse I g
  have hq :
      q = (reesDenominatorInverse I g) ^ n *
        gradedLocalizationMap I g (p_d : reesAlgebra I) := by
    calc
      q = q * 1 := (mul_one q).symm
      _ = q * (gradedLocalizationMap I g (reesDenominator I g) *
          reesDenominatorInverse I g) ^ n := by
            rw [hden_mul_inv, one_pow]
      _ = (reesDenominatorInverse I g) ^ n *
          (q * (gradedLocalizationMap I g (reesDenominator I g)) ^ n) := by
            rw [mul_pow]
            ac_rfl
      _ = (reesDenominatorInverse I g) ^ n * gradedLocalizationMap I g p := by
            rw [hpn']
      _ = (reesDenominatorInverse I g) ^ n *
          gradedLocalizationMap I g (p_d : reesAlgebra I) := by
            rw [hmap_p_d]
  rw [hq]
  exact ((HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading I)).map
    (gradedLocalizationMap I g)).toIdeal.mul_mem_left _ hmap_p_d_mem

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.degreeZeroMap_comp_degreeZeroAlgEquiv_symm
statement:
theorem degreeZeroMap_comp_degreeZeroAlgEquiv_symm (I : Ideal R) (g : R) :
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.degreeZeroMap (gradedLocalizationMap I g)).comp
        (degreeZeroAlgEquiv I).symm.toRingHom =
      (degreeZeroAlgEquiv (localizedIdeal I g)).symm.toRingHom.comp
        (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g))
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro r
  apply (degreeZeroAlgEquiv (localizedIdeal I g)).injective
  have h := RingHom.congr_fun
    (degreeZeroAlgEquiv_gradedLocalizationMap I g)
    ((degreeZeroAlgEquiv I).symm r)
  change
    degreeZeroAlgEquiv (localizedIdeal I g)
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.degreeZeroMap (gradedLocalizationMap I g)
          ((degreeZeroAlgEquiv I).symm r)) =
      degreeZeroAlgEquiv (localizedIdeal I g)
        ((degreeZeroAlgEquiv (localizedIdeal I g)).symm
          (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g) r))
  rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  change
    degreeZeroAlgEquiv (localizedIdeal I g)
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.degreeZeroMap (gradedLocalizationMap I g)
          ((degreeZeroAlgEquiv I).symm r)) =
      algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)
        (degreeZeroAlgEquiv I ((degreeZeroAlgEquiv I).symm r)) at h
  rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
  exact h
