name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr_comp_ambient
statement:
theorem pushforwardCongr_comp_ambient
    {f g : A ⟶ B} (p : f = g) (k : B ⟶ C) (M : A.Modules) :
    (pushforwardComp f k).inv.app M ≫
      (pushforward k).map ((pushforwardCongr p).hom.app M) ≫
      (pushforwardComp g k).hom.app M =
    (pushforwardCongr (congrArg (fun h => h ≫ k) p)).hom.app M
proof:
:= by
  cases p
  apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext
  intro U
  simp only [Hom.comp_app, pushforwardComp_inv_app_app,
    pushforwardComp_hom_app_app, pushforward_map_app,
    pushforwardCongr_hom_app_app]
  simp
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.ambientFac
proof:
:= by
  calc
    a ≫ (f ≫ k) = (a ≫ f) ≫ k := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = (b ≫ g) ≫ k := congrArg (fun q => q ≫ k) h
    _ = b ≫ (g ≫ k) := Category.assoc _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.rightRestriction_comp_ambient
statement:
theorem rightRestriction_comp_ambient
    (a : P ⟶ Q) (b : P ⟶ R) (f : Q ⟶ S) (g : R ⟶ S)
    (h : a ≫ f = b ≫ g) (k : S ⟶ T)
    (M : Q.Modules) (N : R.Modules)
    (t : (pullback a).obj M ≅ (pullback b).obj N) :
    (pushforwardComp g k).inv.app N ≫
      (pushforward k).map (rightRestriction a b f g h M N t) ≫
      (pushforwardComp (a ≫ f) k).hom.app ((pullback a).obj M) =
    rightRestriction a b (f ≫ k) (g ≫ k) (ambientFac a b f g h k) M N t ≫
      (pushforwardCongr (Category.assoc a f k).symm).hom.app
        ((pullback a).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext
  intro U
  simp only [rightRestriction, Hom.comp_app, pushforwardComp_inv_app_app,
    pushforwardComp_hom_app_app, pushforward_map_app, pushforwardPullbackUnit,
    pushforwardCongr_hom_app_app, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, Category.assoc]
  simp
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.rightRestriction_square_of_comp
statement:
theorem rightRestriction_square_of_comp
    (a : P ⟶ Q) (b : P ⟶ R) (f : Q ⟶ S) (g : R ⟶ S)
    (h : a ≫ f = b ≫ g) (k : S ⟶ T)
    (f' : Q ⟶ T) (g' : R ⟶ T)
    (hf : f ≫ k = f') (hg : g ≫ k = g')
    (h' : a ≫ f' = b ≫ g')
    (hL : a ≫ f' = (a ≫ f) ≫ k)
    (M : Q.Modules) (N : R.Modules)
    (t t' : (pullback a).obj M ≅ (pullback b).obj N) (ht : t' = t) :
    rightRestriction a b f' g' h' M N t' ≫
      ((pushforwardCongr hL).app ((pullback a).obj M) ≪≫
        ((pushforwardComp (a ≫ f) k).app ((pullback a).obj M)).symm).hom =
    ((pushforwardCongr hg.symm).app N ≪≫
      ((pushforwardComp g k).app N).symm).hom ≫
      (pushforward k).map (rightRestriction a b f g h M N t)
proof:
:= by
  subst f'
  subst g'
  subst t'
  apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext
  intro U
  simp only [rightRestriction, Hom.comp_app, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom,
    pushforwardComp_hom_app_app,
    pushforward_map_app, pushforwardPullbackUnit,
    pushforwardCongr_hom_app_app, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage,
    Category.assoc]
  simp
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.rightRestriction_square_of_comp_rightCast
statement:
theorem rightRestriction_square_of_comp_rightCast
    (a : P ⟶ Q) (b b' : P ⟶ R) (hb : b' = b)
    (f : Q ⟶ S) (g : R ⟶ S) (h : a ≫ f = b ≫ g)
    (k : S ⟶ T) (f' : Q ⟶ T) (g' : R ⟶ T)
    (hf : f ≫ k = f') (hg : g ≫ k = g')
    (h' : a ≫ f' = b' ≫ g')
    (hL : a ≫ f' = (a ≫ f) ≫ k)
    (M : Q.Modules) (N : R.Modules)
    (t : (pullback a).obj M ≅ (pullback b).obj N)
    (t' : (pullback a).obj M ≅ (pullback b').obj N)
    (ht : HEq t' t) :
    rightRestriction a b' f' g' h' M N t' ≫
      ((pushforwardCongr hL).app ((pullback a).obj M) ≪≫
        ((pushforwardComp (a ≫ f) k).app ((pullback a).obj M)).symm).hom =
    ((pushforwardCongr hg.symm).app N ≪≫
      ((pushforwardComp g k).app N).symm).hom ≫
      (pushforward k).map (rightRestriction a b f g h M N t)
proof:
:= by
  cases hb
  have ht' : t' = t := eq_of_heq ht
  subst t'
  exact rightRestriction_square_of_comp a b f g h k f' g' hf hg h' hL M N t t rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.unionInl_descentRight_component
statement:
theorem unionInl_descentRight_component (C C' : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) :
    let D
proof:
:= C.twistingSheafDescentData d (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d)
    let D' := C.unionDescentInl C' d
    (C.unionDescentInl_chartTermIso C' d j).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.isoUnionLeft C').hom).map
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit
          (D.toAmbient j) (D.right (i, j)) (D.module j) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (D.fac (i, j)).symm).hom.app
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (D.right (i, j))).obj (D.module j)) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (D.left (i, j) ≫ D.toAmbient i)).map
            (D.transition (i, j)).inv) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit
        (D'.toAmbient j) (D'.right (i, j)) (D'.module j) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (D'.fac (i, j)).symm).hom.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (D'.right (i, j))).obj (D'.module j)) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (D'.left (i, j) ≫ D'.toAmbient i)).map
          (D'.transition (i, j)).inv) ≫
      (C.unionDescentInl_overlapTermIso C' d i j).hom := by
  let D := C.twistingSheafDescentData d (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d)
  let D' := C.unionDescentInl C' d
  let a := C.overlapToChart i j
  let b := C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i
  let b' := (C.union C').transition (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inl j) ≫
    (C.union C').overlapToChart (Sum.inl j) (Sum.inl i)
  let f := C.chartι i
  let g := C.chartι j
  let k := (C.isoUnionLeft C').hom
  let f' := (C.union C').chartι (Sum.inl i)
  let g' := (C.union C').chartι (Sum.inl j)
  let M := C.chartTwistingSheaf d i
  let N := C.chartTwistingSheaf d j
  let t := D.transition (i, j)
  let t' := D'.transition (i, j)
  have hb : b' = b := C.unionInl_descentRight C' d i j
  have hf : f ≫ k = f' := C.chartι_isoUnionLeft_hom C' i
  have hg : g ≫ k = g' := C.chartι_isoUnionLeft_hom C' j
  have h : a ≫ f = b ≫ g := D.fac (i, j)
  have h' : a ≫ f' = b' ≫ g' := D'.fac (i, j)
  have hL : a ≫ f' = (a ≫ f) ≫ k := by
    calc
      a ≫ f' = a ≫ (f ≫ k) := congrArg (fun q => a ≫ q) hf.symm
      _ = (a ≫ f) ≫ k := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
  have ht : HEq t' t := C.unionInl_descentTransition C' d i j
  have hs := Scheme.Modules.rightRestriction_square_of_comp_rightCast
    a b b' hb f g h k f' g' hf hg h' hL M N t t' ht
  change ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr hg.symm).app N ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp g k).app N).symm).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward k).map
        (Scheme.Modules.rightRestriction a b f g h M N t) =
    Scheme.Modules.rightRestriction a b' f' g' h' M N t' ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr hL).app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback a).obj M) ≪≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (a ≫ f) k).app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback a).obj M)).symm).hom
  exact hs.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.unionDescentInl_descentRight_natural
statement:
theorem unionDescentInl_descentRight_natural (C C' : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (d : ℤ) :
    (C.unionDescentInl C' d).descentRight ≫
      (C.unionDescentInl_overlapCochainsIso C' d).hom =
    (C.unionDescentInl_chartCochainsIso C' d).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.isoUnionLeft C').hom).map
        (C.twistingSheafDescentData d
          (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d)).descentRight
proof:
:= by
  let D := C.twistingSheafDescentData d (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d)
  let D' := C.unionDescentInl C' d
  let F := Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.isoUnionLeft C').hom
  exact Scheme.Modules.DescentData.descentRight_natural_of_components D D' F
    (C.unionDescentInl_chartCochainsIso C' d)
    (C.unionDescentInl_overlapCochainsIso C' d)
    (fun i => C.unionDescentInl_chartTermIso C' d i)
    (fun ij => C.unionDescentInl_overlapTermIso C' d ij.1 ij.2)
    (fun i => C.unionDescentInl_chartCochainsIso_hom_π C' d i)
    (fun ij => C.unionDescentInl_overlapCochainsIso_hom_π C' d ij)
    (fun ij => C.unionInl_descentRight_component C' d ij.1 ij.2)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.unionInr_descentRight_component
statement:
theorem unionInr_descentRight_component (C C' : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C'.I) :
    let D
proof:
:= C'.twistingSheafDescentData d (C'.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d)
    let D' := C.unionDescentInr C' d
    (C.unionDescentInr_chartTermIso C' d j).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.isoUnionRight C').hom).map

          (D.toAmbient j) (D.right (i, j)) (D.module j) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (D.fac (i, j)).symm).hom.app
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (D.right (i, j))).obj (D.module j)) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (D.left (i, j) ≫ D.toAmbient i)).map
            (D.transition (i, j)).inv) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit
        (D'.toAmbient j) (D'.right (i, j)) (D'.module j) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (D'.fac (i, j)).symm).hom.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (D'.right (i, j))).obj (D'.module j)) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (D'.left (i, j) ≫ D'.toAmbient i)).map
          (D'.transition (i, j)).inv) ≫
      (C.unionDescentInr_overlapTermIso C' d i j).hom := by
  let D := C'.twistingSheafDescentData d (C'.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d)
  let D' := C.unionDescentInr C' d
  let a := C'.overlapToChart i j
  let b := C'.transition i j ≫ C'.overlapToChart j i
  let b' := (C.union C').transition (Sum.inr i) (Sum.inr j) ≫
    (C.union C').overlapToChart (Sum.inr j) (Sum.inr i)
  let f := C'.chartι i
  let g := C'.chartι j
  let k := (C.isoUnionRight C').hom
  let f' := (C.union C').chartι (Sum.inr i)
  let g' := (C.union C').chartι (Sum.inr j)
  let M := C'.chartTwistingSheaf d i
  let N := C'.chartTwistingSheaf d j
  let t := D.transition (i, j)
  let t' := D'.transition (i, j)
  have hb : b' = b := C.unionInr_descentRight C' d i j
  have hf : f ≫ k = f' := C.chartι_isoUnionRight_hom C' i
  have hg : g ≫ k = g' := C.chartι_isoUnionRight_hom C' j
  have h : a ≫ f = b ≫ g := D.fac (i, j)
  have h' : a ≫ f' = b' ≫ g' := D'.fac (i, j)
  have hL : a ≫ f' = (a ≫ f) ≫ k := by
    calc
      a ≫ f' = a ≫ (f ≫ k) := congrArg (fun q => a ≫ q) hf.symm
      _ = (a ≫ f) ≫ k := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
  have ht : HEq t' t := C.unionInr_descentTransition C' d i j
  have hs := Scheme.Modules.rightRestriction_square_of_comp_rightCast
    a b b' hb f g h k f' g' hf hg h' hL M N t t' ht
  change ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr hg.symm).app N ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp g k).app N).symm).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward k).map
        (Scheme.Modules.rightRestriction a b f g h M N t) =
    Scheme.Modules.rightRestriction a b' f' g' h' M N t' ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr hL).app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback a).obj M) ≪≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (a ≫ f) k).app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback a).obj M)).symm).hom
  exact hs.symm

      (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E0))

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.hbcE_pencil_bundle
statement:
theorem hbcE_pencil_bundle (hL : SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank M L 1) (hreg : SectionIsRegular σ)
    (hMono : ∀ E0 : Z.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFree Z E0 →
      Mono (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual M L)))
        (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E0)))
    (hpres : ∀ E0 : Z.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFree Z E0 →
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward s).obj E0) ≅
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj
          (cokernel (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual M L)))
            (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E0)))))
    (E0 : Z.Modules) (hE0 : IsFiniteLocallyFree Z E0) (y : K0 M)
    (hy : k0ToG0 M y = finitePushforward F (flatPullbackG0 pr
      (g0ClassOf Z E0 hE0.isFinitePresentation))) :
    k0ToG0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme
        (pullbackK0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι y) =
      finitePushforward s (g0ClassOf Z E0 hE0.isFinitePresentation)
proof:
:= by
  have hEc : IsCoherentLike Z E0 := hE0.isFinitePresentation
  letI : E0.IsFinitePresentation := hEc
  have hV₀ : IsCoherentLike W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E0) :=
    pullback_isFinitePresentation_global pr E0
  have hy' : k0ToG0 M y = finitePushforward F
      (g0ClassOf W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E0) hV₀) := by
    rw [hy, flatPullbackG0_classOf]
  haveI := hMono E0 hE0
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := hpres E0 hE0
  have hGc := (finitePushObject s ⟨E0, hEc⟩).2
  rw [finitePushforward_classOf]
  exact hbc_cartier_closed σ hL hreg F _ hV₀ y hy' _ hGc e

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.hbcE_pencil_generic
statement:
theorem hbcE_pencil_generic (hL : SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank M L 1) (hreg : SectionIsRegular σ)
    (hMono : ∀ E0 : Z.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFree Z E0 →
      Mono (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual M L)))
        (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E0)))
    (hpres : ∀ E0 : Z.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFree Z E0 →
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward s).obj E0) ≅
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj
          (cokernel (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual M L)))
            (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E0)))))
    (hres : Function.Bijective (k0ToG0 M)) (x : K0 Z) (y : K0 M)
    (hy : k0ToG0 M y = finitePushforward F (flatPullbackG0 pr (k0ToG0 Z x))) :
    k0ToG0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme
        (pullbackK0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι y) =
      finitePushforward s (k0ToG0 Z x)
proof:
:= by
  let Ψ : G0 M ≃+ K0 M := (AddEquiv.ofBijective (k0ToG0 M) hres).symm
  have hΨ : ∀ g, k0ToG0 M (Ψ g) = g := fun g =>
    (AddEquiv.ofBijective (k0ToG0 M) hres).apply_symm_apply g
  let L' : K0 Z →+ G0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme :=
    (k0ToG0 _).comp ((pullbackK0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι).comp
      (Ψ.toAddMonoidHom.comp ((finitePushforward F).comp
        ((flatPullbackG0 pr).comp (k0ToG0 Z)))))
  let R : K0 Z →+ G0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme :=
    (finitePushforward s).comp (k0ToG0 Z)
  have hLR : L' = R := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    intro E
    change k0ToG0 _ (pullbackK0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι
        (Ψ (finitePushforward F (flatPullbackG0 pr (k0ToG0 Z (k0ClassOf Z E.1 E.2)))))) =
      finitePushforward s (k0ToG0 Z (k0ClassOf Z E.1 E.2))
    rw [k0ToG0_classOf]
    exact hbcE_pencil_bundle σ F pr s hL hreg hMono hpres E.1 E.2 _ (by rw [hΨ])
  have hyΨ : y = Ψ (finitePushforward F (flatPullbackG0 pr (k0ToG0 Z x))) := by
    rw [← hy]; exact ((AddEquiv.ofBijective (k0ToG0 M) hres).symm_apply_apply y).symm
  have := DFunLike.congr_fun hLR x
  change k0ToG0 _ (pullbackK0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι
      (Ψ (finitePushforward F (flatPullbackG0 pr (k0ToG0 Z x))))) =
    finitePushforward s (k0ToG0 Z x) at this
  rw [hyΨ]; exact this

name: GradedIdealQuotient.principalIdeal_toIdeal
proof:
:=

name: GradedIdealQuotient.ker_awayMap_principal
statement:
theorem ker_awayMap_principal (s f : A) (hs : s ∈ 𝒜 1) (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 1) :
    RingHom.ker (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map
      (quotientMap 𝒜 (principalIdeal 𝒜 s hs)) f) =
      Ideal.span {awayEquation 𝒜 s f hs hf}
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨m, a, ha, rfl⟩ := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_surjective 𝒜 hf z
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker] at hz
    have hzval := congrArg HomogeneousLocalization.val hz
    simp only [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map_mk,
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.val_zero] at hzval
    rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk'] at hzval
    obtain ⟨⟨_, r, rfl⟩, hr⟩ := (IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff _ _).mp hzval
    have hmem : f ^ r * a ∈ (principalIdeal 𝒜 s hs).toIdeal := by
      rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
      simpa only [quotientMap_apply, map_mul, map_pow] using hr
    rw [principalIdeal_toIdeal, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hmem
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hmem
    let b' : 𝒜 (r + m) := DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 (b * f) (r + m)
    have hb' : (b' : A) * s = f ^ (r + 1) * a := by
      have hmul : (b * f) * s = f ^ (r + 1) * a := by
        calc
          (b * f) * s = f * (b * s) := by ring
          _ = f * (f ^ r * a) := by rw [hb]
          _ = f ^ (r + 1) * a := by ring
      calc
        (b' : A) * s =
            (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 ((b * f) * s) ((r + m) + 1) : A) := by
          exact (DirectSum.coe_decompose_mul_add_of_right_mem 𝒜 hs).symm
        _ = (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 (f ^ (r + 1) * a) ((r + m) + 1) : A) := by
          rw [hmul]
        _ = f ^ (r + 1) * a := by
          apply DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_same
          convert SetLike.mul_mem_graded (SetLike.pow_mem_graded (r + 1) hf) ha using 1 <;>
            simp [add_assoc, add_comm]
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
    refine ⟨HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk 𝒜 hf (r + m) b' (by simpa using b'.2), ?_⟩
    apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
    simp only [awayEquation, HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul,
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, Localization.mk_mul]
    rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, Submonoid.coe_mul]
    rw [hb']
    ring
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    intro z hz
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
    subst z
    change HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map
      (quotientMap 𝒜 (principalIdeal 𝒜 s hs)) f (awayEquation 𝒜 s f hs hf) = 0
    rw [awayEquation, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map_mk]
    apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
    simp only [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.val_zero]
    rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk', IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff]
    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul]
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk (principalIdeal 𝒜 s hs).toIdeal s = 0
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, principalIdeal_toIdeal]
    exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton s)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.mem_range_hyperplaneι_iff
statement:
theorem mem_range_hyperplaneι_iff (s : grading k n 1) (x : space k n) :
    x ∈ Set.range (hyperplaneι k n s) ↔
      (s : Polynomial k n) ∈ x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal
proof:
:= by
  change x ∈ Set.range
      (GradedIdealQuotient.projMap (grading k n) (hyperplaneIdeal k n s)) ↔ _
  refine (GradedIdealQuotient.mem_range_projMap_iff
    (grading k n) (hyperplaneIdeal k n s) x).trans ?_
  rw [GradedIdealQuotient.principalIdeal_toIdeal, Ideal.span_le]
  exact Set.singleton_subset_iff

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.ker_hyperplaneChartMap
statement:
theorem ker_hyperplaneChartMap (s : grading k n 1) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    RingHom.ker (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map
      (GradedIdealQuotient.quotientMap (grading k n) (hyperplaneIdeal k n s))
      (coordinate k n i)) = Ideal.span {hyperplaneChartEquation k n s i}
proof:
:= by
  exact GradedIdealQuotient.ker_awayMap_principal (grading k n) s (coordinate k n i) s.2
    (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i)

name: KSpecialization.ARRHBCP.exists_factor_of_range
statement:
theorem exists_factor_of_range {X W M : Scheme.{u}} [IsReduced X] (F : W ⟶ M)
    [IsClosedImmersion F] (g : X ⟶ M) (h : ∀ x, g x ∈ Set.range F) :
    ∃ f : X ⟶ W, f ≫ F = g
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Surjective (pullback.snd F g) := by
    rw [surjective_iff, ← Set.range_eq_univ, Scheme.Pullback.range_snd]
    exact Set.eq_univ_of_forall h
  haveI : IsIso (pullback.snd F g) := isIso_of_isClosedImmersion_of_surjective _
  refine ⟨inv (pullback.snd F g) ≫ pullback.fst F g, ?_⟩
  rw [Category.assoc, pullback.condition, IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

name: KSpecialization.ARRHBCP.quotientSection_isoUnionLeft
statement:
theorem quotientSection_isoUnionLeft :
    C.quotientSection q hq ≫ (C.isoUnionLeft C').hom = (C.union C').quotientSection q hq
proof:
:= by
  refine C.baseCover.hom_ext _ _ fun (i : C.I) ↦ ?_
  have h1 := C.baseCover_quotientSection q hq i
  have h2 := (C.union C').baseCover_quotientSection q hq (Sum.inl i)
  have e1 : C.baseCover.f i ≫ C.quotientSection q hq ≫ (C.isoUnionLeft C').hom =
      C.chartSection q hq i ≫ (C.union C').chartι (Sum.inl i) := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, h1]
    exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg (fun g => C.chartSection q hq i ≫ g)
      (AffineFrameCover.chartι_isoUnionLeft_hom C C' i))
  exact e1.trans h2.symm

name: KSpecialization.ARRHBCP.quotientSection_isoUnionRight
statement:
theorem quotientSection_isoUnionRight :
    C'.quotientSection q hq ≫ (C.isoUnionRight C').hom = (C.union C').quotientSection q hq
proof:
:= by
  refine C'.baseCover.hom_ext _ _ fun (i : C'.I) ↦ ?_
  have h1 := C'.baseCover_quotientSection q hq i
  have h2 := (C.union C').baseCover_quotientSection q hq (Sum.inr i)
  have e1 : C'.baseCover.f i ≫ C'.quotientSection q hq ≫ (C.isoUnionRight C').hom =
      C'.chartSection q hq i ≫ (C.union C').chartι (Sum.inr i) := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, h1]
    exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg (fun g => C'.chartSection q hq i ≫ g)
      (AffineFrameCover.chartι_isoUnionRight_hom C C' i))
  exact e1.trans h2.symm

name: KSpecialization.ARRHBCP.zeroSection_isoE0
statement:
theorem zeroSection_isoE0 (hZ : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme (Zs k n J))
    (CN : AffineFrameCover (Zs k n J) (Nsh k n J)) :
    (Cov k n J CN).zeroSection ≫ (isoE0 k n J hZ CN).hom =
      (localFrameCover (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ)).zeroSection ≫
        (localFrameComponentIso (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ)).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hL := quotientSection_isoUnionLeft (Cov k n J CN)
    (localFrameCover (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ)) biprod.snd
    (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd)
  have hR := quotientSection_isoUnionRight (Cov k n J CN)
    (localFrameCover (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ)) biprod.snd
    (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd)
  have e : ((Cov k n J CN).zeroSection ≫
        (AffineFrameCover.isoUnionLeft (Cov k n J CN)
          (localFrameCover (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ))).hom) ≫
        (AffineFrameCover.isoUnionRight (Cov k n J CN)
          (localFrameCover (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ))).inv =
      (localFrameCover (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ)).zeroSection := by
    refine (congrArg (fun g => g ≫ _) hL).trans ?_
    refine (congrArg (fun g => g ≫ _) hR.symm).trans ?_
    rw [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
    rfl
  have hiso : (isoE0 k n J hZ CN).hom =
      (AffineFrameCover.isoUnionLeft (Cov k n J CN)
          (localFrameCover (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ))).hom ≫
        (AffineFrameCover.isoUnionRight (Cov k n J CN)
          (localFrameCover (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ))).inv ≫
        (localFrameComponentIso (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ)).hom := by
    simp only [isoE0, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [hiso, ← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc]
  exact congrArg (fun g => g ≫ (localFrameComponentIso (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ)).hom) e

name: KSpecialization.ARRHBCP.hzs_of_chart
statement:
theorem hzs_of_chart (hZ : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme (Zs k n J))
    (CN : AffineFrameCover (Zs k n J) (Nsh k n J)) (hc : ChartGate k n J hZ) :
    (Cov k n J CN).zeroSection ≫ EιOfIso k n J CN (isoE0 k n J hZ CN) =
      secInf k n J ≫ subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k n) J
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : EιOfIso k n J CN (isoE0 k n J hZ CN) =
      (isoE0 k n J hZ CN).hom ≫ componentToTotal (space k n) J := rfl
  rw [h1, ← Category.assoc, zeroSection_isoE0 k n J hZ CN, Category.assoc]
  refine (localFrameCover (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ)).baseCover.hom_ext _ _
    fun (i : (Cq k n J hZ).J) ↦ ?_
  have h2 := (localFrameCover (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ)).baseCover_quotientSection biprod.snd
    (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd) i
  have h3 : (localFrameCover (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ)).baseCover.f i ≫
      (localFrameCover (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ)).zeroSection ≫
        (localFrameComponentIso (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ)).hom ≫
          componentToTotal (space k n) J =
      (localFrameCover (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ)).chartSection biprod.snd
        (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd) i ≫
        localFrameToTotal (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ) i := by
    have e3 : (localFrameCover (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ)).chartι i ≫
        (localFrameComponentIso (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ)).hom ≫
          componentToTotal (space k n) J =
        localFrameToTotal (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ) i :=
      (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
        ((congrArg (fun g => g ≫ componentToTotal (space k n) J)
          (localFrameComponentIso_chart (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ) i)).trans
          (localFrameToTotal_recovery (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ) i).symm)
    refine ((Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
      (congrArg (fun g => g ≫ (localFrameComponentIso (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ)).hom ≫
        componentToTotal (space k n) J) h2)).trans ?_
    exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg (fun g => _ ≫ g) e3)
  exact h3.trans (hc i)

name: KSpecialization.ARRHBCP.chartGate_of_range
statement:
theorem chartGate_of_range (hZ : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme (Zs k n J))
    (hr : RangeGate k n J hZ) : ChartGate k n J hZ
proof:
:= by
  unfold ChartGate
  intro (i : (localFrameCover (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ)).I)
  haveI : IsReduced (Zs k n J) := inferInstance
  haveI : IsReduced ((localFrameCover (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ)).U i).toScheme := inferInstance
  haveI := CIIL3B.isIso_fst_comp_totalToClosedBase (space k n) J
  let C := localFrameCover (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ)
  let cs := C.chartSection biprod.snd (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd) i
  let F := subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k n) J
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := exists_factor_of_range F
    (cs ≫ localFrameToTotal (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ) i) (hr i)
  let e := cs ≫ localFrameToComponent (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ) i
  have hAe : cs ≫ localFrameToTotal (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ) i =
      e ≫ componentToTotal (space k n) J := by
    rw [localFrameToTotal_recovery]
    exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
  have hcond : h ≫ F = e ≫ componentToTotal (space k n) J := hh.trans hAe
  have hbase : e ≫ componentToCentre (space k n) J = C.baseCover.f i :=
    (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
      ((congrArg (fun g => cs ≫ g)
        (localFrameToComponent_toCentre (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ) i)).trans
        (C.chartSection_chartToAmbient biprod.snd
          (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd) i))
  have hh2 : h ≫ totalToClosedBase (space k n) J = C.baseCover.f i := by
    rw [← cancel_mono (iZ k n J)]
    have h3 := totalToClosedBase_subschemeι (space k n) J
    have h4 := componentToTotal_toBase (space k n) J
    calc (h ≫ totalToClosedBase (space k n) J) ≫ iZ k n J
        = h ≫ F ≫ totalGlobalToBase (space k n) J := by
          rw [Category.assoc]; exact congrArg (fun g => h ≫ g) h3
      _ = (e ≫ componentToTotal (space k n) J) ≫ totalGlobalToBase (space k n) J := by
          rw [← Category.assoc, hcond]
      _ = e ≫ componentToCentre (space k n) J ≫ iZ k n J := by
          rw [Category.assoc]; exact congrArg (fun g => e ≫ g) h4
      _ = C.baseCover.f i ≫ iZ k n J :=
          (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans (congrArg (fun g => g ≫ iZ k n J) hbase)
  let ρ := pullback.fst F (componentToTotal (space k n) J) ≫ totalToClosedBase (space k n) J
  have hlift : pullback.lift h e hcond ≫ ρ = C.baseCover.f i := by
    simp only [ρ, ← Category.assoc, pullback.lift_fst]
    exact hh2
  have hL : pullback.lift h e hcond = C.baseCover.f i ≫ inv ρ := by
    exact (Category.comp_id _).symm.trans ((congrArg (fun g => pullback.lift h e hcond ≫ g)
      (IsIso.hom_inv_id ρ).symm).trans ((Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
        (congrArg (fun g => g ≫ inv ρ) hlift)))
  have hsec := inv_comp_fst_eq_secInf (space k n) J (componentToTotal (space k n) J) rfl
  have hsec' : inv ρ ≫ pullback.fst F (componentToTotal (space k n) J) = secInf k n J := hsec
  calc cs ≫ localFrameToTotal (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ) i = h ≫ F := hh.symm
    _ = (pullback.lift h e hcond ≫ pullback.fst F (componentToTotal (space k n) J)) ≫ F := by
        rw [pullback.lift_fst]
    _ = C.baseCover.f i ≫ secInf k n J ≫ F := by
        rw [hL]
        exact (congrArg (fun g => (g ≫ pullback.fst F (componentToTotal (space k n) J)) ≫ F) rfl).trans
          (((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg (fun g => (C.baseCover.f i ≫ inv ρ) ≫ g)
            (rfl : pullback.fst F (componentToTotal (space k n) J) ≫ F =
              pullback.fst F (componentToTotal (space k n) J) ≫ F))).trans
            (((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg (fun g => C.baseCover.f i ≫ g)
              ((Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans (congrArg (fun g => g ≫ F) hsec')))).trans rfl))

name: KSpecialization.ARRHBCP.hbcP_of_range
statement:
theorem hbcP_of_range (hZ : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme (Zs k n J))
    (CN : AffineFrameCover (Zs k n J) (Nsh k n J)) (hr : RangeGate k n J hZ)
    (w : K0 (Ws k n J)) :
    pullbackK0 (EιOfIso k n J CN (isoE0 k n J hZ CN)) (FpK k n J hZ w) =
      spK k n J CN (resEOfIso k n J hZ CN (isoE0 k n J hZ CN)) (r₁K k n J w)
proof:
:=
  hbcP_of_zeroSection k n J hZ CN
    (hzs_of_chart k n J hZ CN (chartGate_of_range k n J hZ hr)) w

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoB_sub_zeroVars_mem
statement:
theorem m7geoB_sub_zeroVars_mem (S : Set σ) (f : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    f - m7geoB_zeroVars S f ∈ Ideal.span (X '' S)
proof:
:= by
  induction f using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C a => simp [m7geoB_zeroVars]
  | add p q hp hq =>
    rw [map_add, add_sub_add_comm]
    exact add_mem hp hq
  | mul_X p j hp =>
    rw [map_mul]
    have e : p * X j - m7geoB_zeroVars S p * m7geoB_zeroVars S (X j) =
        (p - m7geoB_zeroVars S p) * X j +
          m7geoB_zeroVars S p * (X j - m7geoB_zeroVars S (X j)) := by ring
    rw [e]
    refine add_mem (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hp) (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ ?_)
    by_cases hj : j ∈ S
    · simp [m7geoB_zeroVars, hj]
      exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
    · simp [m7geoB_zeroVars, hj]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoB_phi_ker_eq_coeff_sup_vars
statement:
theorem m7geoB_phi_ker_eq_coeff_sup_vars (I : Ideal R) (lv : σ → ℕ) (t : ℕ) :
    RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I lv t) =
      I.map C ⊔ Ideal.span (X '' {j | lv j ≤ t})
proof:
:= by
  let S : Set σ := {j | lv j ≤ t}
  have hcomp : m7g_phi I lv t =
      (MvPolynomial.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).comp (m7geoB_zeroVars S) := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro a
      simp [m7g_phi_C, m7geoB_zeroVars]
    · intro j
      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, m7g_phi_X]
      by_cases hj : lv j ≤ t <;> simp [S, hj, m7geoB_zeroVars]
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro f hf
    have hmap : m7geoB_zeroVars S f ∈ I.map C := by
      have hkernel : m7geoB_zeroVars S f ∈
          RingHom.ker (MvPolynomial.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) := by
        change (MvPolynomial.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) (m7geoB_zeroVars S f) = 0
        change m7g_phi I lv t f = 0 at hf
        rw [hcomp, RingHom.comp_apply] at hf
        exact hf
      simpa only [MvPolynomial.ker_map, Ideal.mk_ker] using hkernel
    have hsub := m7geoB_sub_zeroVars_mem S f
    have e : f = m7geoB_zeroVars S f + (f - m7geoB_zeroVars S f) := by ring
    rw [e]
    exact add_mem (Ideal.mem_sup_left hmap) (Ideal.mem_sup_right hsub)
  · refine sup_le ?_ ?_
    · exact (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap).mpr (by rw [m7g_comap_ker])
    · rw [Ideal.span_le]
      rintro p ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
      change m7g_phi I lv t (X j) = 0
      rw [m7g_phi_X, if_pos (show lv j ≤ t from hj)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoB_exists_chart_of_W
statement:
theorem m7geoB_exists_chart_of_W (x : C.scheme) (hx : C.toBase x ∈ C.U i)
    (a : Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1))
    (ha : x ∈ m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a)) :
    ∃ P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a)
      Γ(X, C.U i)), m7g_J C i a P = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, Q, hQ⟩ := m7g_exists_J C i x hx
  have ha' : m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) b Q ∈
      coordinateOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a := by
    exact (m7geo_J_mem_W_iff C i _ _ Q).mp (hQ ▸ ha)
  have hrange : m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) b Q ∈
      Set.range (m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a) := by
    rw [m6pb_range_stdChart]
    exact ha'
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := hrange
  refine ⟨P, ?_⟩
  rw [← hQ]
  exact congrArg (fun y ↦
    (inv (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace (m7g_b C i)) ≫ C.chartι i) y) hP

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoB_chart_Q_le_actual
statement:
theorem m7geoB_chart_Q_le_actual (t : ℕ)
    {a c : Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1)}
    (ha0 : a ≠ 0) (hac : a ≠ c) (hct : t < (c : ℕ))
    (Qa : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a)
      Γ(X, C.U i))) (hQa : m7g_J C i a Qa = m7g_w C i hv t) :
    RingHom.ker (m7g_phi (m7g_q C i hv).asIdeal
      (m7geoP_twoStepLevel (fun j : AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a ↦
        (j.1 : ℕ)) ⟨0, Ne.symm ha0⟩ ⟨c, Ne.symm hac⟩ t) t) ≤ Qa.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  let I := (m7g_q C i hv).asIdeal
  let ρ := m7geoP_twoStepLevel
    (fun j : AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a ↦ (j.1 : ℕ))
    (⟨0, Ne.symm ha0⟩ : AffineChartIndex _ a) ⟨c, Ne.symm hac⟩ t
  have hbase : C.toBase (m7g_J C i a Qa) = v := by
    rw [hQa]
    exact m7g_base C i hv t
  have hcoeff : I.map MvPolynomial.C ≤ Qa.asIdeal := by
    have heq : Qa.asIdeal.comap MvPolynomial.C = I := by
      exact congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal (m7g_comap_eq_q C i hv Qa hbase)
    exact (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap).mpr heq.symm.le
  rw [m7geoB_phi_ker_eq_coeff_sup_vars]
  refine sup_le hcoeff ?_
  rw [Ideal.span_le]
  rintro p ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
  have hflag : 0 < (j.1 : ℕ) ∧ (j.1 : ℕ) ≤ t :=
    (m7geoP_chart_level_iff (C.positiveRankDimension i) t ha0 hac hct j).mp hj
  have hj0 : (j.1 : Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have : (j.1 : ℕ) = 0 := congrArg Fin.val h
    omega
  have hmem0 : MvPolynomial.X (⟨j.1, hj0⟩ : AffineChartIndex _ 0) ∈
      (m7g_Q C i hv t).asIdeal := by
    change MvPolynomial.X (⟨j.1, hj0⟩ : AffineChartIndex _ 0) ∈
      RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I
        (fun k : AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0 ↦ (k.1 : ℕ)) t)
    change m7g_phi I
      (fun k : AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0 ↦ (k.1 : ℕ)) t
        (MvPolynomial.X ⟨j.1, hj0⟩) = 0
    rw [m7g_phi_X, if_pos hflag.2]
  have hnotW : m7g_w C i hv t ∉
      m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm j.1) := by
    change m7g_J C i 0 (m7g_Q C i hv t) ∉ _
    rw [m7geoC_J_mem_W_iff_X C i hj0]
    exact not_not.mpr hmem0
  have hnotW' : m7g_J C i a Qa ∉
      m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm j.1) := by
    rw [hQa]
    exact hnotW
  rw [m7geoC_J_mem_W_iff_X C i j.2] at hnotW'
  exact not_not.mp hnotW'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoB_chart_Q_represents_w
statement:
theorem m7geoB_chart_Q_represents_w (t : ℕ)
    {a c : Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1)}
    (ha0 : a ≠ 0) (hac : a ≠ c) (hat : t < (a : ℕ))
    (hct : t < (c : ℕ)) :
    let I
proof:
:= (m7g_q C i hv).asIdeal
    let ρ := m7geoP_twoStepLevel
      (fun j : AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a ↦ (j.1 : ℕ))
      (⟨0, Ne.symm ha0⟩ : AffineChartIndex _ a) ⟨c, Ne.symm hac⟩ t
    m7g_J C i a ⟨RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I ρ t), m7g_ker_isPrime I ρ t⟩ =
      m7g_w C i hv t := by
  let I := (m7g_q C i hv).asIdeal
  let ρ := m7geoP_twoStepLevel
    (fun j : AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a ↦ (j.1 : ℕ))
    (⟨0, Ne.symm ha0⟩ : AffineChartIndex _ a) ⟨c, Ne.symm hac⟩ t
  let Q : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a)
      Γ(X, C.U i)) := ⟨RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I ρ t), m7g_ker_isPrime I ρ t⟩
  have hwa : m7g_w C i hv t ∈
      m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a) := by
    change m7g_J C i 0 (m7g_Q C i hv t) ∈ _
    rw [m7geoC_J_mem_W_iff_X C i ha0]
    exact m7g_X_not_mem (I := I)
      (lv := fun j : AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0 ↦ (j.1 : ℕ))
      (s := ⟨a, ha0⟩) (t := t) (by simpa using (show ¬ (a : ℕ) ≤ t by omega))
  obtain ⟨Qa, hQa⟩ := m7geoB_exists_chart_of_W C i (m7g_w C i hv t)
    (by rw [m7g_base C i hv t]; exact hv) a hwa
  have hle : Q.asIdeal ≤ Qa.asIdeal :=
    m7geoB_chart_Q_le_actual C i hv t ha0 hac hct Qa hQa
  have hnot0 : MvPolynomial.X (⟨0, Ne.symm ha0⟩ : AffineChartIndex _ a) ∉
      Q.asIdeal := by
    change MvPolynomial.X (⟨0, Ne.symm ha0⟩ : AffineChartIndex _ a) ∉
      RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I ρ t)
    exact m7g_X_not_mem (I := I) (lv := ρ) (s := ⟨0, Ne.symm ha0⟩)
      (t := t) (by simp [ρ, m7geoP_twoStepLevel])
  obtain ⟨Q0, hQ0⟩ := m7g_overlap C i (Ne.symm ha0) Q hnot0
  have hsp : m7g_J C i a Q ⤳ m7g_J C i a Qa :=
    ((PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes _ _).mp hle).map (m7g_J C i a).continuous
  have hsp0 : m7g_J C i 0 Q0 ⤳ m7g_J C i 0 (m7g_Q C i hv t) := by
    simpa only [hQ0, hQa, m7g_w] using hsp
  have hle0 : Q0.asIdeal ≤ (m7g_Q C i hv t).asIdeal :=
    (PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes _ _).mpr
      ((m7g_J C i 0).isOpenEmbedding.isInducing.specializes_iff.mp hsp0)
  have hbaseQ : C.toBase (m7g_J C i a Q) = v := by
    rw [m7g_J_apply_toBase]
    have hcomap : PrimeSpectrum.comap MvPolynomial.C Q = m7g_q C i hv :=
      PrimeSpectrum.ext (m7geoP_chart_Q_comap I
        (C.positiveRankDimension i) t ha0 hac)
    rw [hcomap]
    exact (C.isAffine i).fromSpec_primeIdealOf ⟨v, hv⟩
  have hbase0 : C.toBase (m7g_J C i 0 Q0) = v := by
    rw [hQ0]
    exact hbaseQ
  have hcoeff : I.map MvPolynomial.C ≤ Q0.asIdeal := by
    have heq : Q0.asIdeal.comap MvPolynomial.C = I :=
      congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal (m7g_comap_eq_q C i hv Q0 hbase0)
    exact (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap).mpr heq.symm.le
  have hQ0le : (m7g_Q C i hv t).asIdeal ≤ Q0.asIdeal := by
    change RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I
      (fun j : AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0 ↦ (j.1 : ℕ)) t) ≤
        Q0.asIdeal
    rw [m7geoB_phi_ker_eq_coeff_sup_vars]
    refine sup_le hcoeff ?_
    rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro p ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
    have hjle : (j.1 : ℕ) ≤ t := hj
    have hja : (j.1 : Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1)) ≠ a := by
      intro heq
      have : (j.1 : ℕ) = (a : ℕ) := congrArg Fin.val heq
      omega
    have hjpos : 0 < (j.1 : ℕ) := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h ↦ j.2 (Fin.ext h)
    have hmemQ : MvPolynomial.X (⟨j.1, hja⟩ : AffineChartIndex _ a) ∈ Q.asIdeal := by
      exact (m7geoP_chart_Q_X_mem_iff I
        (C.positiveRankDimension i) t ha0 hac hct ⟨j.1, hja⟩).mpr
          ⟨hjpos, hjle⟩
    have hnotW : m7g_J C i a Q ∉
        m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm j.1) := by
      rw [m7geoC_J_mem_W_iff_X C i hja]
      exact not_not.mpr hmemQ
    have hnotW0 : m7g_J C i 0 Q0 ∉
        m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm j.1) := by
      rw [hQ0]
      exact hnotW
    rw [m7geoC_J_mem_W_iff_X C i j.2] at hnotW0
    exact not_not.mp hnotW0
  have hQ0eq : Q0 = m7g_Q C i hv t := PrimeSpectrum.ext (le_antisymm hle0 hQ0le)
  rw [hQ0eq] at hQ0
  exact hQ0.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoB_chart_Q_actual
statement:
theorem m7geoB_chart_Q_actual (t : ℕ)
    {a c : Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1)}
    (ha0 : a ≠ 0) (hac : a ≠ c) (hat : t < (a : ℕ))
    (hct : t < (c : ℕ))
    (Qa : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a)
      Γ(X, C.U i))) (hQa : m7g_J C i a Qa = m7g_w C i hv t) :
    Qa.asIdeal = RingHom.ker (m7g_phi (m7g_q C i hv).asIdeal
      (m7geoP_twoStepLevel (fun j : AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a ↦
        (j.1 : ℕ)) ⟨0, Ne.symm ha0⟩ ⟨c, Ne.symm hac⟩ t) t)
proof:
:= by
  let I := (m7g_q C i hv).asIdeal
  let ρ := m7geoP_twoStepLevel
    (fun j : AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a ↦ (j.1 : ℕ))
    (⟨0, Ne.symm ha0⟩ : AffineChartIndex _ a) ⟨c, Ne.symm hac⟩ t
  let Q : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a)
      Γ(X, C.U i)) := ⟨RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I ρ t), m7g_ker_isPrime I ρ t⟩
  have hJQ : m7g_J C i a Q = m7g_w C i hv t :=
    m7geoB_chart_Q_represents_w C i hv t ha0 hac hat hct
  have heq : Qa = Q := (m7g_J C i a).isOpenEmbedding.injective (hQa.trans hJQ.symm)
  exact congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal heq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoB_no_two_step_in_closure
statement:
theorem m7geoB_no_two_step_in_closure {Y : Scheme.{u}} {A : Type u}
    [CommRing A] (J : Spec (CommRingCat.of A) ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion J]
    (w : Y) (z : pointClosureScheme w) (hz : coheight z = 1)
    (Q Q₀ Q₀₁ P : PrimeSpectrum A)
    (hJQ : J Q = w) (hJP : J P = pointClosureι w z)
    (hQQ₀ : Q.asIdeal < Q₀.asIdeal) (hQ₀Q₀₁ : Q₀.asIdeal < Q₀₁.asIdeal)
    (hQ₀₁P : Q₀₁.asIdeal ≤ P.asIdeal) : False
proof:
:= by
  let ι := pointClosureι w
  let g := pointClosureGenericPoint w
  have hιg : ι g = w := pointClosureι_genericPoint w
  have hspQ₀ : w ⤳ J Q₀ := by
    rw [← hJQ]
    exact ((PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes _ _).mp hQQ₀.le).map J.continuous
  have hmem : J Q₀ ∈ Set.range ι := by
    rw [range_pointClosureι]
    exact specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp hspQ₀
  obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀⟩ := hmem
  have hspgz₀ : g ⤳ z₀ := ι.isEmbedding.isInducing.specializes_iff.mp (by
    rw [hιg, hz₀]
    exact hspQ₀)
  have hQ₀P : Q₀.asIdeal < P.asIdeal := lt_of_lt_of_le hQ₀Q₀₁ hQ₀₁P
  have hspz₀z : z₀ ⤳ z := ι.isEmbedding.isInducing.specializes_iff.mp (by
    rw [hz₀, ← hJP]
    exact ((PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes _ _).mp hQ₀P.le).map J.continuous)
  have hJinj := J.isOpenEmbedding.injective
  have hιinj := ι.isEmbedding.injective
  have hz₀ne : z₀ ≠ g := by
    intro heq
    have hJ : J Q₀ = J Q := by
      calc
        J Q₀ = ι z₀ := hz₀.symm
        _ = ι g := congrArg ι heq
        _ = J Q := hιg.trans hJQ.symm
    exact hQQ₀.ne (congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal (hJinj hJ)).symm
  have hz₀z : z₀ ≠ z := by
    intro heq
    have hJ : J Q₀ = J P := by
      calc
        J Q₀ = ι z₀ := hz₀.symm
        _ = ι z := congrArg ι heq
        _ = J P := hJP.symm
    exact hQ₀P.ne (congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal (hJinj hJ))
  have hanti : ∀ a b : pointClosureScheme w, a ≤ b → b ≤ a → a = b :=
    fun a b hab hba ↦
      ((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hba).antisymm (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hab)).eq
  have hlt₀g : z₀ < g := by
    have hle : z₀ ≤ g := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr hspgz₀
    exact lt_of_le_not_ge hle (fun hge ↦ hz₀ne (hanti _ _ hle hge))
  have hltz₀ : z < z₀ := by
    have hle : z ≤ z₀ := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr hspz₀z
    exact lt_of_le_not_ge hle (fun hge ↦ hz₀z (hanti _ _ hle hge).symm)
  have h1 := Order.coheight_add_one_le hltz₀
  have h2 := Order.coheight_add_one_le hlt₀g
  have hlow : (1 : ℕ∞) ≤ coheight z₀ := by
    calc
      (1 : ℕ∞) = 0 + 1 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ coheight g + 1 := by
        simpa only [add_comm] using add_le_add_right
          (show (0 : ℕ∞) ≤ coheight g from zero_le) 1
      _ ≤ coheight z₀ := h2
  have hlow2 : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ coheight z := by
    calc
      (2 : ℕ∞) = 1 + 1 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ coheight z₀ + 1 := by simpa only [add_comm] using add_le_add_right hlow 1
      _ ≤ coheight z := h1
  rw [hz] at hlow2
  norm_num at hlow2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoB_no_two_vanishing
statement:
theorem m7geoB_no_two_vanishing (t : ℕ) (ht : t < C.positiveRankDimension i)
    (z : pointClosureScheme (m7g_w C i hv t)) (hz : coheight z = 1)
    (hzv : C.toBase (pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z) = v)
    (h0 : pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z ∉
      m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0))
    (hc : pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z ∉
      m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm
        ⟨t + 1, by omega⟩)) : False
proof:
:= by
  let c : Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1) := ⟨t + 1, by omega⟩
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := by
    intro heq
    have : (c : ℕ) = 0 := congrArg Fin.val heq
    dsimp [c] at this
    omega
  obtain ⟨a, P, ha0, hac, hat, h0P, hcP, hP⟩ :=
    m7geoC_two_vanishing_closure C i hv t z hzv c hc0 h0 hc
  have hct : t < (c : ℕ) := by dsimp [c]; omega
  let I := (m7g_q C i hv).asIdeal
  let ρ := m7geoP_twoStepLevel
    (fun j : AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a ↦ (j.1 : ℕ))
    (⟨0, Ne.symm ha0⟩ : AffineChartIndex _ a) ⟨c, Ne.symm hac⟩ t
  let Q : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a)
      Γ(X, C.U i)) := ⟨RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I ρ t), m7g_ker_isPrime I ρ t⟩
  let Q₀ : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a)
      Γ(X, C.U i)) := ⟨RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I ρ (t + 1)),
        m7g_ker_isPrime I ρ (t + 1)⟩
  let Q₀₁ : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a)
      Γ(X, C.U i)) := ⟨RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I ρ (t + 2)),
        m7g_ker_isPrime I ρ (t + 2)⟩
  have hJQ : m7g_J C i a Q = m7g_w C i hv t :=
    m7geoB_chart_Q_represents_w C i hv t ha0 hac hat hct
  have hsp : m7g_w C i hv t ⤳ pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z := by
    rw [specializes_iff_mem_closure, ← range_pointClosureι]
    exact ⟨z, rfl⟩
  have hQP : Q.asIdeal ≤ P.asIdeal := by
    have hsp' : m7g_J C i a Q ⤳ m7g_J C i a P := by
      rw [hJQ, hP]
      exact hsp
    exact (PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes _ _).mpr
      ((m7g_J C i a).isOpenEmbedding.isInducing.specializes_iff.mp hsp')
  obtain ⟨hQR, hRS, hQ₀, hQ₀₁⟩ := m7geoP_chart_prime_chain I
    (C.positiveRankDimension i) t ha0 hac hc0
  have hQ₀₁P : Q₀₁.asIdeal ≤ P.asIdeal := by
    change RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I ρ (t + 2)) ≤ P.asIdeal
    rw [hQ₀₁, hQ₀]
    exact sup_le (sup_le hQP (Ideal.span_le.mpr (by simpa using h0P)))
      (Ideal.span_le.mpr (by simpa using hcP))
  exact m7geoB_no_two_step_in_closure (m7g_J C i a) (m7g_w C i hv t)
    z hz Q Q₀ Q₀₁ P hJQ hP hQR hRS hQ₀₁P

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoB_chart0_coverage
statement:
theorem m7geoB_chart0_coverage (t : ℕ) (ht : t < C.positiveRankDimension i)
    (z : pointClosureScheme (m7g_w C i hv t)) (hz : coheight z = 1)
    (hzv : C.toBase (pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z) = v)
    (hc : pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z ∉
      m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm
        ⟨t + 1, by omega⟩)) :
    pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z ∈
      m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h0
  exact m7geoB_no_two_vanishing C i hv t ht z hz hzv h0 hc

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoB_next_point_unique
statement:
theorem m7geoB_next_point_unique [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (t : ℕ) (ht : t < C.positiveRankDimension i)
    (z : pointClosureScheme (m7g_w C i hv t)) (hz : coheight z = 1)
    (hzv : C.toBase (pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z) = v)
    (hc : pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z ∉
      m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm
        ⟨t + 1, by omega⟩)) :
    pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z = m7g_w C i hv (t + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := m7geoB_chart0_coverage C i hv t ht z hz hzv hc
  have hx : C.toBase (pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z) ∈ C.U i := by
    rw [hzv]
    exact hv
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := m7geoB_exists_chart_of_W C i
    (pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z) hx 0 h0
  exact m7geo_closure_chart0_unique_of_not_mem_W C i hv t ht z hz P hP.symm hc

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.affine_inside_cover
statement:
theorem affine_inside_cover (V : X.Opens) :
    V ≤ ⨆ U : {U : X.affineOpens // U.1 ≤ V}, U.1.1
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨W, hW, rfl⟩, hxW, hWV⟩ :=
    X.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open hx V.isOpen
  exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨⟨W,hW⟩,hWV⟩,hxW⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.moduleHom_eq_of_affine_app_eq
statement:
theorem moduleHom_eq_of_affine_app_eq {M N : X.Modules} (f g : M ⟶ N)
    (h : ∀ U : X.affineOpens, f.val.app (op U.1) = g.val.app (op U.1)) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro V
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro s
  let T : TopCat.Sheaf Ab X := ⟨N.presheaf, N.isSheaf⟩
  apply T.eq_of_locally_eq' (fun U : {U : X.affineOpens // U.1 ≤ V.unop} => U.1.1)
    V.unop (fun U => homOfLE U.2) (affine_inside_cover X V.unop)
  intro U
  have hf := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply f.val (homOfLE U.2).op s
  have hg := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply g.val (homOfLE U.2).op s
  exact hf.symm.trans ((congrArg (fun k => k (M.val.map (homOfLE U.2).op s)) (h U.1)).trans hg)

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.zeroStructureMap_cosection_zero
statement:
theorem zeroStructureMap_cosection_zero (h : IsCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ I) :
    σ ≫ zeroStructureMap X I = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply moduleHom_eq_of_affine_app_eq X
  intro U
  exact zeroStructureMap_affine_cosection_zero X I E σ h U

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.zeroStructureMap_epi
statement: theorem zeroStructureMap_epi : Epi (zeroStructureMap X I)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro N f g hfg
  apply moduleHom_eq_of_affine_app_eq X
  intro U
  letI : Epi (zeroStructureMapApp X I U.1) :=
    (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mpr (zeroStructureMap_affine_surjective X I U)
  apply (cancel_epi (zeroStructureMapApp X I U.1)).mp
  exact congrArg (fun k => k.val.app (op U.1)) hfg

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.zeroStructureMap_exact
statement:
theorem zeroStructureMap_exact (h : IsCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ I) :
    (ShortComplex.mk σ (zeroStructureMap X I)
      (zeroStructureMap_cosection_zero X I E σ h)).Exact
proof:
:= by
  let S := ShortComplex.mk σ (zeroStructureMap X I)
    (zeroStructureMap_cosection_zero X I E σ h)
  let F := underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X
  let sh := moduleSheafification X
  have hex : ((S.map F).map sh).Exact := by
    apply exact_moduleSheafification_map_of_locally_exact
    intro V x hx
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨W, hW, rfl⟩, hxW, hWV⟩ :=
      X.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open hx V.isOpen
    refine ⟨W, hWV, hxW, ?_⟩
    intro b hb
    have hk : b ∈ LinearMap.ker (zeroStructureMapApp X I W).hom := hb
    rw [zeroStructureMap_affine_kernel X I E σ h ⟨W,hW⟩] at hk
    exact hk
  let c := asIso (PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (structurePresheafId X)).counit
  let e : ((S.map F).map sh) ≅ S := ShortComplex.isoMk
    (c.app E) (c.app (tensorUnitSheaf X))
    (c.app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward I.subschemeι).obj (tensorUnitSheaf I.subscheme)))
    ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).counit.naturality σ).symm
    ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).counit.naturality (zeroStructureMap X I)).symm
  exact ShortComplex.exact_of_iso e hex

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.zeroSchemeCokernelIso_projection
statement:
theorem zeroSchemeCokernelIso_projection (h : IsCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ I) :
    cokernel.π σ ≫ (zeroSchemeCokernelIso X I E σ h).hom = zeroStructureMap X I
proof:
:= by
  letI := zeroStructureMap_epi X I
  exact colimit.isoColimitCocone_ι_hom _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.zeroSchemePushforward_isCoherentLike
statement:
theorem zeroSchemePushforward_isCoherentLike [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (h : IsCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ I) (hE : IsCoherentLike X E) :
    IsCoherentLike X ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward I.subschemeι).obj (tensorUnitSheaf I.subscheme))
proof:
:=
  (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation X.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
    (zeroSchemeCokernelIso X I E σ h)
    (cokernel_isCoherentLike X hE (tensorUnitSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree X).isFinitePresentation σ)

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.zeroSchemePushforward_isQuasicoherent
statement:
theorem zeroSchemePushforward_isQuasicoherent [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (h : IsCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ I) (hE : IsCoherentLike X E) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward I.subschemeι).obj (tensorUnitSheaf I.subscheme)).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  letI : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward I.subschemeι).obj
      (tensorUnitSheaf I.subscheme)).IsFinitePresentation :=
    zeroSchemePushforward_isCoherentLike X I E σ h hE
  infer_instance

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.g0ClassOf_zeroSchemePushforward
statement:
theorem g0ClassOf_zeroSchemePushforward [IsLocallyNoetherian X] {r : ℕ}
    (h : IsCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ I) (hE : HasConstantRank X E r)
    (hreg : LocallyFiniteWeaklyRegularFrames X E σ) :
    g0ClassOf X ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward I.subschemeι).obj (tensorUnitSheaf I.subscheme))
      (zeroSchemePushforward_isCoherentLike X I E σ h hE.isFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation) =
        k0ToG0 X (lambdaMinusOne E hE)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = g0ClassOf X (cokernel σ)
        (cokernel_isCoherentLike X hE.isFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation
          (tensorUnitSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree X).isFinitePresentation σ) :=
      g0ClassOf_iso X _ _ (zeroSchemeCokernelIso X I E σ h).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.DescentData.descendedIsoOfNaturality_ι
statement:
theorem descendedIsoOfNaturality_ι
    (D : DescentData Y I) (D' : DescentData Z I)
    (F : Y.Modules ⥤ Z.Modules) [F.Additive]
    [PreservesLimit (parallelPair (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight) 0) F]
    (eC : D'.chartCochains ≅ F.obj D.chartCochains)
    (eO : D'.overlapCochains ≅ F.obj D.overlapCochains)
    (hLeft : D'.descentLeft ≫ eO.hom = eC.hom ≫ F.map D.descentLeft)
    (hRight : D'.descentRight ≫ eO.hom = eC.hom ≫ F.map D.descentRight) :
    (descendedIsoOfNaturality D D' F eC eO hLeft hRight).hom ≫
      F.map (kernel.ι (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight)) =
      kernel.ι (D'.descentLeft - D'.descentRight) ≫ eC.hom
proof:
:= by
  unfold descendedIsoOfNaturality
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc,
    PreservesKernel.iso_inv_ι, kernel.mapIso_hom, kernel.lift_ι]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.DescentData.descendedIsoOfNaturality_component
statement:
theorem descendedIsoOfNaturality_component
    (D : DescentData Y I) (D' : DescentData Z I)
    (F : Y.Modules ⥤ Z.Modules) [F.Additive]
    [PreservesLimit (parallelPair (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight) 0) F]
    (eC : D'.chartCochains ≅ F.obj D.chartCochains)
    (eO : D'.overlapCochains ≅ F.obj D.overlapCochains)
    (hLeft : D'.descentLeft ≫ eO.hom = eC.hom ≫ F.map D.descentLeft)
    (hRight : D'.descentRight ≫ eO.hom = eC.hom ≫ F.map D.descentRight)
    (eTerm : ∀ i, D'.chartTerm i ≅ F.obj (D.chartTerm i))
    (hπ : ∀ i, eC.hom ≫ F.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm i) =
      Pi.π D'.chartTerm i ≫ (eTerm i).hom) (i : I) :
    (descendedIsoOfNaturality D D' F eC eO hLeft hRight).hom ≫
      F.map (D.component i) = D'.component i ≫ (eTerm i).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [component, Functor.map_comp]
  calc
    _ = ((descendedIsoOfNaturality D D' F eC eO hLeft hRight).hom ≫
        F.map (kernel.ι (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight))) ≫
          F.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm i) := by simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = (kernel.ι (D'.descentLeft - D'.descentRight) ≫ eC.hom) ≫
          F.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm i) := by
      rw [descendedIsoOfNaturality_ι D D' F eC eO hLeft hRight]
    _ = _ := by simp only [Category.assoc, hπ i]

name: SheafOfModules.identitySheafificationOverComparison_unit
statement:
theorem identitySheafificationOverComparison_unit (U : C) (P : PresheafOfModules.{u} R.obj) :
    (PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 (R.over U).obj)).unit.app
        ((restrictPresheaf J R U).obj P) ≫
      (SheafOfModules.forget _ ⋙ PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝟙 (R.over U).obj)).map
        (identitySheafificationOverComparison J R U P) =
    (restrictPresheaf J R U).map
      ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 R.obj)).unit.app P)
proof:
:= by
  let adj := PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 R.obj)
  let η := adj.unit.app P
  let rη : (restrictPresheaf J R U).obj P ⟶
      (SheafOfModules.forget _ ⋙ PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝟙 (R.over U).obj)).obj
        ((overFunctor R U).obj ((identitySheafification J R).obj P)) :=
    (restrictPresheaf J R U).map η
  have h := ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 (R.over U).obj)).homEquiv
    ((restrictPresheaf J R U).obj P) ((overFunctor R U).obj ((identitySheafification J R).obj P))
    ).apply_symm_apply rη
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, Adjunction.homEquiv_counit] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.comparison_unit_apply
statement:
theorem comparison_unit_apply (Q : PresheafOfModules.{u} (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))
    (W : (Over U)ᵒᵖ) (q : Q.obj (op W.unop.left)) :
    (SheafOfModules.identitySheafificationOverComparison (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
        X.ringCatSheaf U Q).val.app W
      (((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)).unit.app
        ((SheafOfModules.restrictPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.ringCatSheaf U).obj
          Q)).app W q) =
    ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app Q).app (op W.unop.left) q
proof:
:= by
  have h := SheafOfModules.identitySheafificationOverComparison_unit
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.ringCatSheaf U Q
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (congrArg (fun φ ↦ PresheafOfModules.Hom.app φ W) h) q

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.finsuppSheafIso_inv_ιFree_apply
statement:
theorem finsuppSheafIso_inv_ιFree_apply [Finite I] (i : I) : (finsuppSheafIso X I).inv.val.app (op U)
      ((SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i).val.app (op U) (1 : Γ(X, U))) =
      ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app (finsuppFreePresheaf X I)).app (op U)
        (ModuleCat.freeMk i)
proof:
:= by
    let adj := PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (structurePresheafId X)
    let G := underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X
    let M : X.Modules := SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I
    let ε := (asIso adj.counit).app M
    have hc : G.map ε.inv = adj.unit.app (G.obj M) := by
      rw [← cancel_mono (G.map ε.hom), ← G.map_comp, ε.inv_hom_id, G.map_id]
      exact (adj.right_triangle_components M).symm
    have hinv : (finsuppSheafIso X I).inv =
        ε.inv ≫ (moduleSheafification X).map (underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree X I).hom := rfl
    have hnat := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (congrArg (fun φ ↦ PresheafOfModules.Hom.app φ (op U))
      (adj.unit.naturality (underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree X I).hom))
      ((SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i).val.app (op U) (1 : Γ(X, U)))
    have hσ := underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree_hom_freeSection_eval X I i (op U)
    have hε := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (congrArg (fun φ ↦ PresheafOfModules.Hom.app φ (op U)) hc)
      ((SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i).val.app (op U) (1 : Γ(X, U)))
    rw [hinv]
    change ((moduleSheafification X).map (underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree X I).hom).val.app (op U)
      ((G.map ε.inv).app (op U) _) = _
    erw [hε]
    change ((adj.unit.app (G.obj M)) ≫ G.map ((moduleSheafification X).map
      (underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree X I).hom)).app (op U) _ = _
    erw [← hnat]
    exact congrArg _ hσ

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.identitySheafificationOverIso_inv_unit_free
statement:
theorem identitySheafificationOverIso_inv_unit_free [Finite I] (i : I) : (SheafOfModules.identitySheafificationOverIso (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      X.ringCatSheaf U (finsuppFreePresheaf X I)).inv.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))
      (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app (finsuppFreePresheaf X I)).app (op U)
        (ModuleCat.freeMk i)) =
      ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)).unit.app
        ((SheafOfModules.restrictPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.ringCatSheaf U).obj
          (finsuppFreePresheaf X I))).app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) (ModuleCat.freeMk i)
proof:
:= by
    have h1 := comparison_unit_apply (U := U) (finsuppFreePresheaf X I) (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) (ModuleCat.freeMk i)
    have h2 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))) (SheafOfModules.identitySheafificationOverIso (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      X.ringCatSheaf U (finsuppFreePresheaf X I)).hom_inv_id)
      (((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)).unit.app
        ((SheafOfModules.restrictPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.ringCatSheaf U).obj
          (finsuppFreePresheaf X I))).app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) (ModuleCat.freeMk i))
    erw [← h1]
    exact h2

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.identitySheafificationOver_frameHom_unit_free
statement:
theorem identitySheafificationOver_frameHom_unit_free [Finite I]
    [IsIso ((SheafOfModules.identitySheafificationOver (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      X.ringCatSheaf U).map (frameHom P x))] (i : I) : (asIso ((SheafOfModules.identitySheafificationOver (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      X.ringCatSheaf U).map (frameHom P x))).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))
      (((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)).unit.app
        ((SheafOfModules.restrictPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.ringCatSheaf U).obj
          (finsuppFreePresheaf X I))).app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) (ModuleCat.freeMk i)) =
      ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)).unit.app
        ((SheafOfModules.restrictPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.ringCatSheaf U).obj
          P)).app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) (x i)
proof:
:= by
    have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (congrArg (fun φ ↦ PresheafOfModules.Hom.app φ (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))))
      ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)).unit.naturality
        (frameHom P x))) (ModuleCat.freeMk i)
    have hf : (frameHom P x).app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) (ModuleCat.freeMk i) = x i := by
      rw [frameHom_app_apply]
      simp [frameMap, ModuleCat.freeMk]
      erw [PresheafOfModules.map_id]
      rfl
    rw [← hf]
    exact h.symm

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.overIsoFree_inv_ιFree
statement:
theorem overIsoFree_inv_ιFree [Finite I] (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (hx : ∀ g : Γ(X, U), Function.Bijective (frameMap P x (X.basicOpen g) (X.basicOpen_le g)))
    (i : I) :
    (SheafOfModules.ιFree i ≫ (overIsoFree x hU hx).inv).val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))
      (1 : Γ(X, U)) = sheafifyUnitApp U (x i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let top : (Over U)ᵒᵖ := op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))
  letI := isIso_sheafify_frameHom x hU hx
  let A := SheafOfModules.identitySheafificationOverIso (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      X.ringCatSheaf U P
  let B := asIso ((SheafOfModules.identitySheafificationOver (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      X.ringCatSheaf U).map (frameHom P x))
  let C := SheafOfModules.identitySheafificationOverIso (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      X.ringCatSheaf U (finsuppFreePresheaf X I)
  let D := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U).mapIso (finsuppSheafIso X I)
  let E := freeOverIso X U I
  have he : (overIsoFree x hU hx).inv = E.hom ≫ D.inv ≫ C.inv ≫ B.hom ≫ A.hom := rfl
  
  have hE : SheafOfModules.ιFree i ≫ E.hom =
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U).map (SheafOfModules.ιFree i) := by
    show SheafOfModules.ιFree i ≫ (freeOverIso X U I).hom = _
    unfold freeOverIso
    erw [SheafOfModules.ιFree_mapFreeIso_hom]
    exact Category.id_comp _
  
  
  have hA := comparison_unit_apply (U := U) P top (x i)
  rw [he, ← Category.assoc, hE]
  change A.hom.val.app top (B.hom.val.app top (C.inv.val.app top
    ((finsuppSheafIso X I).inv.val.app (op U)
      ((SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i).val.app (op U) (1 : Γ(X, U)))))) = _
  rw [finsuppSheafIso_inv_ιFree_apply i, identitySheafificationOverIso_inv_unit_free i,
    identitySheafificationOver_frameHom_unit_free x i]
  exact hA

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.overIsoFree_frame_apply
statement:
theorem overIsoFree_frame_apply (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (hx : ∀ g : Γ(X, U), Function.Bijective (frameMap P x (X.basicOpen g) (X.basicOpen_le g))) {N : SheafOfModules.{u} (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)}
    (φ : ((moduleSheafification X).obj P).over U ⟶ N) (i : I) :
    φ.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) (sheafifyUnitApp U (x i)) =
      (SheafOfModules.ιFree i ≫ (overIsoFree x hU hx).inv ≫ φ).val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))
        (1 : Γ(X, U))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← overIsoFree_inv_ιFree x hU hx i]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.overHom_ext_of_frame
statement:
theorem overHom_ext_of_frame (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (hx : ∀ g : Γ(X, U), Function.Bijective (frameMap P x (X.basicOpen g) (X.basicOpen_le g))) {N : SheafOfModules.{u} (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)}
    (φ ψ : ((moduleSheafification X).obj P).over U ⟶ N)
    (h : ∀ i, φ.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) (sheafifyUnitApp U (x i)) =
      ψ.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) (sheafifyUnitApp U (x i))) : φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_epi (overIsoFree x hU hx).inv]
  refine Cofan.IsColimit.hom_ext (SheafOfModules.isColimitFreeCofan I) _ _ (fun i ↦ ?_)
  rw [SheafOfModules.freeCofan_inj]
  apply LineBundleDual.unitMod_hom_ext
  have h1 := overIsoFree_frame_apply x hU hx φ i
  have h2 := overIsoFree_frame_apply x hU hx ψ i
  exact h1.symm.trans ((h i).trans h2)

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.coframe_sheafifyUnitApp
statement:
theorem coframe_sheafifyUnitApp [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (hx : ∀ g : Γ(X, U), Function.Bijective (frameMap P x (X.basicOpen g) (X.basicOpen_le g))) (i j : I) :
    (coframe _ (overIsoFree x hU hx) j).val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) (sheafifyUnitApp U (x i)) =
      if i = j then (1 : Γ(X, U)) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [overIsoFree_frame_apply x hU hx, ← Category.assoc]
  change (frameSec _ (overIsoFree x hU hx) i ≫ coframe _ (overIsoFree x hU hx) j).val.app _ _ = _
  rw [frameSec_coframe]
  split_ifs
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_localSection_splitTransport
statement:
theorem rankTwo_localSection_splitTransport (e : M ≃ₗ[R] (R × R)) :
    localSection ((LinearMap.fst R R R).comp e.toLinearMap)
        (rankTwo_fstEquiv_spans R e) ≫ (chartIsoOfLinearEquiv e).hom =
      rankTwo_leftSection R
proof:
:= by
  have he : Submodule.span R (Set.range e.symm.toLinearMap) = ⊤ := by
    have hr : Set.range e.symm.toLinearMap = Set.univ :=
      Set.range_eq_univ.mpr e.symm.surjective
    rw [hr, Submodule.span_univ]
  rw [rankTwo_localSection_originalProjMap]
  change (inv (rankOneToSpec R) ≫
    symmetricProjMap ((LinearMap.fst R R R).comp e.toLinearMap)
      (rankTwo_fstEquiv_spans R e)) ≫
      symmetricProjMap e.symm.toLinearMap he = _
  have hcomp : ((LinearMap.fst R R R).comp e.toLinearMap).restrictScalars R ∘ₗ
      e.symm.toLinearMap = LinearMap.fst R R R := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro m
    change (e (e.symm m)).1 = m.1
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have hs : Submodule.span R (Set.range
      (((LinearMap.fst R R R).comp e.toLinearMap).restrictScalars R ∘ₗ e.symm.toLinearMap)) = ⊤ := by
    rw [hcomp]
    exact rankTwo_fst_spans R
  rw [Category.assoc, symmetricProjMap_comp e.symm.toLinearMap
    ((LinearMap.fst R R R).comp e.toLinearMap) he
    (rankTwo_fstEquiv_spans R e) hs]
  rw [symmetricProjMap_congr hcomp _ (rankTwo_fst_spans R)]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_localSection_rightSplitTransport
statement:
theorem rankTwo_localSection_rightSplitTransport (e : M ≃ₗ[R] (R × R)) :
    localSection ((LinearMap.snd R R R).comp e.toLinearMap)
        (rankTwo_sndEquiv_spans R e) ≫ (chartIsoOfLinearEquiv e).hom =
      rankTwo_rightSection R
proof:
:= by
  have he : Submodule.span R (Set.range e.symm.toLinearMap) = ⊤ := by
    have hr : Set.range e.symm.toLinearMap = Set.univ :=
      Set.range_eq_univ.mpr e.symm.surjective
    rw [hr, Submodule.span_univ]
  rw [rankTwo_localSection_originalProjMap]
  change (inv (rankOneToSpec R) ≫
    symmetricProjMap ((LinearMap.snd R R R).comp e.toLinearMap)
      (rankTwo_sndEquiv_spans R e)) ≫
      symmetricProjMap e.symm.toLinearMap he = _
  have hcomp : ((LinearMap.snd R R R).comp e.toLinearMap).restrictScalars R ∘ₗ
      e.symm.toLinearMap = LinearMap.snd R R R := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro m
    change (e (e.symm m)).2 = m.2
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have hs : Submodule.span R (Set.range
      (((LinearMap.snd R R R).comp e.toLinearMap).restrictScalars R ∘ₗ e.symm.toLinearMap)) = ⊤ := by
    rw [hcomp]
    exact rankTwo_snd_spans R
  rw [Category.assoc, symmetricProjMap_comp e.symm.toLinearMap
    ((LinearMap.snd R R R).comp e.toLinearMap) he
    (rankTwo_sndEquiv_spans R e) hs]
  rw [symmetricProjMap_congr hcomp _ (rankTwo_snd_spans R)]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_originalSplitLinearChart_covers
statement:
theorem rankTwo_originalSplitLinearChart_covers (x : C.scheme) :
    ∃ (i : C.I) (k : PUnit.{u+1} ⊕ PUnit.{u+1}),
      x ∈ Set.range
        ((Proj.awayι (symGrading Γ(X, C.U i) (Γ(X, C.U i) × Γ(X, C.U i)))
          (linearForm Γ(X, C.U i) (Γ(X, C.U i) × Γ(X, C.U i))
            (rankTwo_splitBasis Γ(X, C.U i) k))
          (linearForm_mem_degree_one Γ(X, C.U i) (Γ(X, C.U i) × Γ(X, C.U i))
            (rankTwo_splitBasis Γ(X, C.U i) k)) zero_lt_one ≫
          (rankTwo_unitPairChartSplitIso C i).inv) ≫ C.chartι i)
proof:
:= by
  let i := C.cover.idx x
  have hx : x ∈ Set.range (C.chartι i) := C.cover.covers x
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hx
  let e := rankTwo_unitPairChartSplitIso C i
  let U := linearAffineOpenCover Γ(X, C.U i) (Γ(X, C.U i) × Γ(X, C.U i))
    (rankTwo_splitBasis Γ(X, C.U i))
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := U.covers (e.hom z)
  refine ⟨i, U.idx (e.hom z), w, ?_⟩
  have he : e.inv (e.hom z) = z := by
    have h := congrArg (fun f : C.chart i ⟶ C.chart i => f z) e.hom_inv_id
    exact h
  change C.chartι i (e.inv ((U.f (U.idx (e.hom z))) w)) = x
  rw [hw, he, hz]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_canonicalChartSplitBasis_tautHom
statement:
theorem rankTwo_canonicalChartSplitBasis_tautHom (i : C.I)
    (m : (tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U i))) :
    letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i)
proof:
:= C.basisIndex_finite i
    (tautChart_tautHom Γ(X, C.U i)
      ((tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U i)))
      (C.sectionBasis i) m ≫ (C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 i).inv) ≫
      (rankTwo_canonicalChartSplitBasisIso C i 1).hom =
    tautChart_tautHom Γ(X, C.U i)
      ((tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U i)))
      (rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis X (C.U i)) m := by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  let e := C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 i
  let f := twistingSheafBasisChangeIso Γ(X, C.U i)
    ((tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U i)))
    (C.sectionBasis i) (rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis X (C.U i)) 1
  let q := tautChart_tautHom Γ(X, C.U i)
    ((tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i) m
  change (q ≫ e.inv) ≫ (e.hom ≫ f.hom) = _
  calc
    (q ≫ e.inv) ≫ (e.hom ≫ f.hom) = q ≫ f.hom := by
      exact rankTwo_cartierIso_middle_cancel q e f.hom
    _ = _ := tautChart_tautHom_basisChange Γ(X, C.U i)
      ((tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U i)))
      (C.sectionBasis i) (rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis X (C.U i)) m

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_originalGlobalLeft_effectiveCartierCharts
statement:
theorem rankTwo_originalGlobalLeft_effectiveCartierCharts (x : C.scheme) :
    ∃ (U : Scheme.{u}) (t : U ⟶ C.scheme) (ht : IsOpenImmersion t),
      letI
proof:
:= ht
      ∃ c : PrincipalOpenPullbackChart (rankTwo_globalLeftSection C) t,

  let ha : a ∈ symGrading Γ(X, C.U i) (Γ(X, C.U i) × Γ(X, C.U i)) 1 :=
    linearForm_mem_degree_one Γ(X, C.U i) (Γ(X, C.U i) × Γ(X, C.U i))
      (rankTwo_splitBasis Γ(X, C.U i) k)
  let t := (Proj.awayι (symGrading Γ(X, C.U i) (Γ(X, C.U i) × Γ(X, C.U i)))
    a ha zero_lt_one ≫ (rankTwo_unitPairChartSplitIso C i).inv) ≫ C.chartι i
  exact ⟨_, t, inferInstance, rankTwo_originalGlobalLeftPrincipal C i a ha, hx,
    rankTwo_originalGlobalLeftPrincipal_regular C i a ha⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_originalTautological_basisExpansion
statement:
theorem rankTwo_originalTautological_basisExpansion (i : C.I)
    (m : E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) :
    letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i)
proof:
:= C.basisIndex_finite i
    letI : Fintype (C.basisIndex i) := Fintype.ofFinite (C.basisIndex i)
    (C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.val.app (op (C.U i))).hom m =
      ∑ k, (C.sectionBasis i).repr m k • tautQuotient_t C i k := by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  letI : Fintype (C.basisIndex i) := Fintype.ofFinite (C.basisIndex i)
  have hb (k : C.basisIndex i) :
      (C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.val.app (op (C.U i))).hom (C.sectionBasis i k) =
        tautQuotient_t C i k := C.tautologicalPushforwardHom_app i k
  conv_lhs => rw [← (C.sectionBasis i).sum_repr m]
  rw [map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  rw [map_smul, hb]

      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction C.toBase).unit.app E).app U m) =
    (C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.val.app (op U)).hom m
proof:
:= by
  have h : ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction C.toBase).homEquiv E
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)) C.tautologicalQuotient =
      C.tautologicalPushforwardHom := by
    unfold tautologicalQuotient
    exact Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _
  change ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction C.toBase).unit.app E ≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.toBase).map C.tautologicalQuotient).app U m = _
  erw [← Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, h]
  rfl

      ∑ k, (C.sectionBasis i).repr m k • tautQuotient_t C i k := by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientFrameRecovery_unframe_square
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotientFrameRecovery_unframe_square
    {A B : Type*} [Category A] [Category B] (F : A ⥤ B)
    {P T V : A} {Q U W : B} (e : P ≅ T) (d : Q ≅ U)
    (t : P ⟶ V) (s : Q ⟶ W) (tf : T ⟶ V) (sf : U ⟶ W)
    (K : F.obj T ⟶ U) (H : F.obj V ⟶ W)
    (ht : tf = e.inv ≫ t) (hs : sf = d.inv ≫ s)
    (h : F.map tf ≫ H = K ≫ sf) :
    F.map t ≫ H = F.map e.hom ≫ K ≫ d.inv ≫ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [ht, hs] at h
  have hh := congrArg (fun z => F.map e.hom ≫ z) h
  simpa only [← Functor.map_comp_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, Functor.map_id,
    Category.id_comp, Category.assoc] using hh

      (Scheme.Modules.pullback ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).chartToBase a)).map

          (Scheme.Modules.pullback (C.pullbackFrameMap g a)).map (C.frameRestrictIso a.1).inv ≫
          ((pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso g (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a).ι (C.U a.1).ι
            (C.pullbackFrameMap g a) (C.pullbackFrameMap_comp_ι g a).symm).app E).inv)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientFrameRecovery_source_frame_hom
statement:

      (Scheme.Modules.pullback ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).chartToBase a)).map

            (C.pullbackFrameMap g a) (C.pullbackFrameMap_comp_ι g a).symm).app E).hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback (C.pullbackFrameMap g a)).map (C.frameRestrictIso a.1).hom ≫
          (pullbackFreeIso (C.pullbackFrameMap g a) (C.basisIndex a.1)).hom) ≫
    (pullbackFreeIso ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).chartToBase a) (C.basisIndex a.1)).hom
proof:
