name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoM_pointClosure_ker_chart
statement:
theorem m7geoM_pointClosure_ker_chart {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (j : Spec (CommRingCat.of A) ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (P : Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) :
    let W : Y.affineOpens
proof:
:= ⟨j.opensRange, isAffineOpen_opensRange j⟩
    let hW : j P ∈ W.1 := by
      rw [Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange]
      exact ⟨P, rfl⟩
    let hVU : (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).Opens) ≤ j ⁻¹ᵁ W.1 := by
      intro x _
      change j x ∈ j.opensRange
      rw [Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange]
      exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
    RingHom.ker ((pointClosureι (j P)).app W.1).hom =
      ((isAffineOpen_top (Spec (CommRingCat.of A))).primeIdealOf
        ⟨P, trivial⟩).asIdeal.comap (j.appLE W.1 ⊤ hVU).hom := by
  let W : Y.affineOpens := ⟨j.opensRange, isAffineOpen_opensRange j⟩
  have hW : j P ∈ W.1 := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange]
    exact ⟨P, rfl⟩
  have hVU : (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).Opens) ≤ j ⁻¹ᵁ W.1 := by
    intro x _
    change j x ∈ j.opensRange
    rw [Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange]
    exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
  have hprime := IsAffineOpen.comap_primeIdealOf_appLE
    W.1 W.2 ⊤ (isAffineOpen_top (Spec (CommRingCat.of A))) hVU
    (show P ∈ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).Opens) from trivial)
  dsimp only
  rw [m7geo_pointClosure_app_ker (j P) W hW]
  exact (congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal hprime).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoM_flag_closure_ker_J0
statement:
theorem m7geoM_flag_closure_ker_J0 {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (i : C.I) [Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)]
    {v : X} (hv : v ∈ C.U i) (t : ℕ) :
    let J
proof:
:= m7g_J C i 0
    let Q := m7g_Q C i hv t
    let W : C.scheme.affineOpens := ⟨J.opensRange, isAffineOpen_opensRange J⟩
    let hVU : (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of
      (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0)
        Γ(X, C.U i)))).Opens) ≤ J ⁻¹ᵁ W.1 := by
      intro x _
      change J x ∈ J.opensRange
      rw [Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange]
      exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
    RingHom.ker ((pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t)).app W.1).hom =
      ((isAffineOpen_top (Spec (CommRingCat.of
        (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0)
          Γ(X, C.U i))))).primeIdealOf ⟨Q, trivial⟩).asIdeal.comap
        (J.appLE W.1 ⊤ hVU).hom := by
  simpa only [m7g_w] using
    (m7geoM_pointClosure_ker_chart (m7g_J C i 0) (m7g_Q C i hv t))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoM_chart_prime_comap
statement:
theorem m7geoM_chart_prime_comap {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (j : Spec (CommRingCat.of A) ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (P : Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) :
    let W : Y.affineOpens
proof:
:= ⟨j.opensRange, isAffineOpen_opensRange j⟩
    let hW : j P ∈ W.1 := by
      rw [Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange]
      exact ⟨P, rfl⟩
    let hVU : (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).Opens) ≤ j ⁻¹ᵁ W.1 := by
      intro x _
      change j x ∈ j.opensRange
      rw [Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange]
      exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
    (W.2.primeIdealOf ⟨j P, hW⟩).asIdeal =
      ((isAffineOpen_top (Spec (CommRingCat.of A))).primeIdealOf
        ⟨P, trivial⟩).asIdeal.comap (j.appLE W.1 ⊤ hVU).hom := by
  let W : Y.affineOpens := ⟨j.opensRange, isAffineOpen_opensRange j⟩
  have hW : j P ∈ W.1 := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange]
    exact ⟨P, rfl⟩
  have hVU : (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).Opens) ≤ j ⁻¹ᵁ W.1 := by
    intro x _
    change j x ∈ j.opensRange
    rw [Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange]
    exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
  have hprime := IsAffineOpen.comap_primeIdealOf_appLE
    W.1 W.2 ⊤ (isAffineOpen_top (Spec (CommRingCat.of A))) hVU
    (show P ∈ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).Opens) from trivial)
  dsimp only
  exact (congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal hprime).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoM_flag_next_prime_J0
statement:
theorem m7geoM_flag_next_prime_J0 {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (i : C.I) [Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)]
    {v : X} (hv : v ∈ C.U i) (t : ℕ) :
    let J
proof:
:= m7g_J C i 0
    let Q := m7g_Q C i hv (t + 1)
    let W : C.scheme.affineOpens := ⟨J.opensRange, isAffineOpen_opensRange J⟩
    let hW : m7g_w C i hv (t + 1) ∈ W.1 := by
      change J Q ∈ J.opensRange
      rw [Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange]
      exact ⟨Q, rfl⟩
    let hVU : (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of
      (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0)
        Γ(X, C.U i)))).Opens) ≤ J ⁻¹ᵁ W.1 := by
      intro x _
      change J x ∈ J.opensRange
      rw [Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange]
      exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
    (W.2.primeIdealOf ⟨m7g_w C i hv (t + 1), hW⟩).asIdeal =
      ((isAffineOpen_top (Spec (CommRingCat.of
        (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0)
          Γ(X, C.U i))))).primeIdealOf ⟨Q, trivial⟩).asIdeal.comap
        (J.appLE W.1 ⊤ hVU).hom := by
  simpa only [m7g_w] using
    (m7geoM_chart_prime_comap (m7g_J C i 0) (m7g_Q C i hv (t + 1)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoM_closure_prime_comap
statement:
theorem m7geoM_closure_prime_comap {Y : Scheme.{u}} (w : Y)
    (W : Y.affineOpens) (z : pointClosureScheme w)
    (hzW : pointClosureι w z ∈ W.1) :
    let V
proof:
:= pointClosureι w ⁻¹ᵁ W.1
    (((m7geo_closure_preimage_affine w W).primeIdealOf ⟨z, hzW⟩).asIdeal).comap
      ((pointClosureι w).app W.1).hom =
      (W.2.primeIdealOf ⟨pointClosureι w z, hzW⟩).asIdeal := by
  have h := IsAffineOpen.comap_primeIdealOf_appLE
    W.1 W.2 (pointClosureι w ⁻¹ᵁ W.1)
    (m7geo_closure_preimage_affine w W) le_rfl hzW
  dsimp only
  simpa only [Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app, PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal] using
    congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoM_flag_closure_next_prime_comap
statement:
theorem m7geoM_flag_closure_next_prime_comap {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (i : C.I) [Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)]
    {v : X} (hv : v ∈ C.U i) (t : ℕ)
    (z : pointClosureScheme (m7g_w C i hv t))
    (hznext : pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z =
      m7g_w C i hv (t + 1)) :
    let J
proof:
:= m7g_J C i 0
    let Qnext := m7g_Q C i hv (t + 1)
    let W : C.scheme.affineOpens := ⟨J.opensRange, isAffineOpen_opensRange J⟩
    let hzW : pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z ∈ W.1 := by
      rw [hznext]
      change J Qnext ∈ J.opensRange
      rw [Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange]
      exact ⟨Qnext, rfl⟩
    let hVU : (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of
      (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0)
        Γ(X, C.U i)))).Opens) ≤ J ⁻¹ᵁ W.1 := by
      intro x _
      change J x ∈ J.opensRange
      rw [Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange]
      exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
    (((m7geo_closure_preimage_affine (m7g_w C i hv t) W).primeIdealOf
        ⟨z, hzW⟩).asIdeal).comap
      ((pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t)).app W.1).hom =
      ((isAffineOpen_top (Spec (CommRingCat.of
        (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0)
          Γ(X, C.U i))))).primeIdealOf ⟨Qnext, trivial⟩).asIdeal.comap
        (J.appLE W.1 ⊤ hVU).hom := by
  let J := m7g_J C i 0
  let Qnext := m7g_Q C i hv (t + 1)
  let W : C.scheme.affineOpens := ⟨J.opensRange, isAffineOpen_opensRange J⟩
  have hzW : pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z ∈ W.1 := by
    rw [hznext]
    change J Qnext ∈ J.opensRange
    rw [Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange]
    exact ⟨Qnext, rfl⟩
  have hVU : (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of
      (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0)
        Γ(X, C.U i)))).Opens) ≤ J ⁻¹ᵁ W.1 := by
    intro x _
    change J x ∈ J.opensRange
    rw [Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange]
    exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
  have hWnext : m7g_w C i hv (t + 1) ∈ W.1 := by
    change J Qnext ∈ J.opensRange
    rw [Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange]
    exact ⟨Qnext, rfl⟩
  have hpoint :
      (⟨pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z, hzW⟩ : W.1) =
        ⟨m7g_w C i hv (t + 1), hWnext⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hznext
  have h1 := m7geoM_closure_prime_comap (m7g_w C i hv t) W z hzW
  have h2 := m7geoM_flag_next_prime_J0 C i hv t
  dsimp only
  calc
    _ = (W.2.primeIdealOf
        ⟨pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z, hzW⟩).asIdeal := h1
    _ = (W.2.primeIdealOf
        ⟨m7g_w C i hv (t + 1), hWnext⟩).asIdeal := by
          rw [hpoint]
    _ = _ := h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoM_flag_ord_one_of_chart_ideal
statement:
theorem m7geoM_flag_ord_one_of_chart_ideal {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    [IsLocallyNoetherian C.scheme]
    (i : C.I) [Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)]
    {v : X} (hv : v ∈ C.U i) (t : ℕ)
    (z : pointClosureScheme (m7g_w C i hv t))
    (hznext : pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z =
      m7g_w C i hv (t + 1)) (hz : coheight z = 1) :
    let J
proof:
:= m7g_J C i 0
    let Qt := m7g_Q C i hv t
    let Qnext := m7g_Q C i hv (t + 1)
    let W : C.scheme.affineOpens := ⟨J.opensRange, isAffineOpen_opensRange J⟩
    let hzW : pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z ∈ W.1 := by
      rw [hznext]
      change J Qnext ∈ J.opensRange
      rw [Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange]
      exact ⟨Qnext, rfl⟩
    let hVU : (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of
      (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0)
        Γ(X, C.U i)))).Opens) ≤ J ⁻¹ᵁ W.1 := by
      intro y _
      change J y ∈ J.opensRange
      rw [Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange]
      exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
    ∀ x : Γ(C.scheme, W.1),
      ((isAffineOpen_top (Spec (CommRingCat.of
        (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0)
          Γ(X, C.U i))))).primeIdealOf ⟨Qnext, trivial⟩).asIdeal.comap
          (J.appLE W.1 ⊤ hVU).hom =
        ((isAffineOpen_top (Spec (CommRingCat.of
          (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0)
            Γ(X, C.U i))))).primeIdealOf ⟨Qt, trivial⟩).asIdeal.comap
            (J.appLE W.1 ⊤ hVU).hom ⊔ Ideal.span {x} →
      haveI : Nonempty (pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) ⁻¹ᵁ W.1) :=
        ⟨⟨z, hzW⟩⟩
      (pointClosureScheme (m7g_w C i hv t)).ord
        ((pointClosureScheme (m7g_w C i hv t)).germToFunctionField
          (pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) ⁻¹ᵁ W.1)
          ((pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t)).app W.1 x)) z = 1 := by
  let J := m7g_J C i 0
  let Qt := m7g_Q C i hv t
  let Qnext := m7g_Q C i hv (t + 1)
  let W : C.scheme.affineOpens := ⟨J.opensRange, isAffineOpen_opensRange J⟩
  have hzW : pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z ∈ W.1 := by
    rw [hznext]
    change J Qnext ∈ J.opensRange
    rw [Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange]
    exact ⟨Qnext, rfl⟩
  have hVU : (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of
      (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0)
        Γ(X, C.U i)))).Opens) ≤ J ⁻¹ᵁ W.1 := by
    intro y _
    change J y ∈ J.opensRange
    rw [Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange]
    exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
  dsimp only
  intro x hchart
  have hcomap :
      (((m7geo_closure_preimage_affine (m7g_w C i hv t) W).primeIdealOf
        ⟨z, hzW⟩).asIdeal).comap
          ((pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t)).app W.1).hom =
        RingHom.ker ((pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t)).app W.1).hom ⊔
          Ideal.span {x} := by
    rw [m7geoM_flag_closure_next_prime_comap C i hv t z hznext,
      m7geoM_flag_closure_ker_J0 C i hv t]
    exact hchart
  exact m7geo_closure_ord_one_of_comap (m7g_w C i hv t) W z hzW hz x hcomap

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoM_comap_sup_span_equiv
proof:
:= by
  change (I ⊔ Ideal.span {b}).comap e =

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.locallyPrincipal_ker_fibreι
statement:
theorem locallyPrincipal_ker_fibreι :
    IdealSheafIsLocallyPrincipal (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk c).ker
proof:
:= by
  have H := fibre_isPullback_P1Global Y J k φk c
  have h1 : IsLocallyPrincipalClosedImmersion (pullback.snd (pointAt k c) (toP1Global Y J k φk)) :=
    isLocallyPrincipalClosedImmersion_pullback_snd (pointAt k c) (toP1Global Y J k φk)
      (locallyPrincipal_ker_pointAt k c)
  have h2 := isLocallyPrincipalClosedImmersion_comp_of_isIso H.isoPullback.hom _ h1
  rw [H.isoPullback_hom_snd] at h2
  exact h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.pointAt_inj
statement:
theorem pointAt_inj (c c' : k) (x y : Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (h : pointAt k c x = pointAt k c' y) : c = c'
proof:
:= by
  unfold pointAt at h
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at h
  have h2 := (chart k 1).isOpenEmbedding.injective h
  have h3 : PrimeSpectrum.comap (evalRingHom c) x = PrimeSpectrum.comap (evalRingHom c') y := h2
  have h4 : (X - C c : k[X]) ∈ (PrimeSpectrum.comap (evalRingHom c) x).asIdeal := by
    rw [PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal, Ideal.mem_comap]
    simp
  rw [h3, PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal, Ideal.mem_comap] at h4
  simp only [coe_evalRingHom, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C] at h4
  by_contra hne
  have hu : IsUnit (c' - c) := (sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hne)).isUnit
  exact y.isPrime.ne_top (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ h4 hu)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.fibre_comm
statement:
theorem fibre_comm : ∃ s : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k),
    s ≫ pointAt k c = fibreιGlobal Y J k φk c ≫ toP1Global Y J k φk
proof:
:=
  ⟨_, (fibre_isPullback_P1Global Y J k φk c).w⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.fibre_ker_ne_bot
statement: theorem fibre_ker_ne_bot [IsIntegral Y] : (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk c).ker ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  haveI : IsIso (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk c) := IsClosedImmersion.isIso_iff_ker_eq_bot.mpr h
  obtain ⟨y⟩ : Nonempty Y := inferInstance
  have hne : c ≠ c + 1 := by
    intro h'
    simp at h'
  set z := fibreιGlobal Y J k φk (c + 1) y with hz
  set y' := (inv (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk c)) z with hy'
  have hy'z : fibreιGlobal Y J k φk c y' = z := by
    rw [hy', ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, IsIso.inv_hom_id]; rfl
  obtain ⟨s1, hs1⟩ := fibre_comm Y J k φk c
  obtain ⟨s2, hs2⟩ := fibre_comm Y J k φk (c + 1)
  have e1 := congrArg (fun q => q y') hs1
  have e2 := congrArg (fun q => q y) hs2
  simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at e1 e2
  rw [hy'z] at e1
  exact hne (pointAt_inj k c (c + 1) _ _ (e1.trans e2.symm))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.exists_cartierData_fibre
statement:
theorem exists_cartierData_fibre [IsIntegral Y] :
    ∃ (L : (totalGlobal Y J).Modules) (_ : SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank (totalGlobal Y J) L 1)
      (σ : SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf (totalGlobal Y J) ⟶ L),
      SectionIsRegular σ ∧
        sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk c).ker
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isIntegral_totalGlobal Y J
  exact exists_cartierLineSection _ (fibre_ker_ne_bot Y J k φk c)
    (locallyPrincipal_ker_fibreι Y J k φk c)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankFlat_isPullback
statement:
theorem rankFlat_isPullback :
    IsPullback (g ∣_ characteristicRankOpen E hE r)
      (g ⁻¹ᵁ characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι g
proof:
:=
  isPullback_morphismRestrict g (characteristicRankOpen E hE r)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankFlat_preimage_rank
statement:
theorem rankFlat_preimage_rank (x : (g ⁻¹ᵁ characteristicRankOpen E hE r : Scheme)) :
    rankAt (g ((g ⁻¹ᵁ characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι x)) E = r
proof: := x.property

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankFlat_ranks_subset
statement:
theorem rankFlat_ranks_subset :
    rankAssembly_ranks ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
      (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global g E hE) ⊆ rankAssembly_ranks E hE
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (characteristic_rankAt_range_finite _
    (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global g E hE)).mem_toFinset.mp hs
  apply (characteristic_rankAt_range_finite E hE).mem_toFinset.mpr

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankFlat_restrict_pureRelDim
statement:
theorem rankFlat_restrict_pureRelDim (d : ℕ) (hd : PureRelDim g d) :
    PureRelDim (g ∣_ characteristicRankOpen E hE r) d
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hc : flatPullbackCoeff g ((g ⁻¹ᵁ characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι x) =
      flatPullbackCoeff (g ∣_ characteristicRankOpen E hE r) x := by
    have h := congrArg (fun f ↦ flatPullbackCoeff f x)
      (morphismRestrict_ι g (characteristicRankOpen E hE r))
    rw [m6pb_coeff_comp, m6pb_coeff_comp,
      flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι
        ((g ∣_ characteristicRankOpen E hE r) x),
      flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion (g ⁻¹ᵁ characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι x,
      mul_one, one_mul] at h
    exact h.symm
  have h := hd ((g ⁻¹ᵁ characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι x) (hc.symm ▸ hx)
  have hp := congrArg (fun f ↦ f x) (morphismRestrict_ι g (characteristicRankOpen E hE r))
  simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at hp
  rw [m6pb_height_openImmersion k (g ⁻¹ᵁ characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι,
    ← hp, m6pb_height_openImmersion k (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι] at h
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankFlat_push_baseChange
statement:
theorem rankFlat_push_baseChange :
    totalPull ops g d hd ∘ₗ totalPush ops (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι =
    totalPush ops (g ⁻¹ᵁ characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι ∘ₗ
      totalPull ops (g ∣_ characteristicRankOpen E hE r) d
        (rankFlat_restrict_pureRelDim (k := k) g E hE r d hd)
proof:
:=
  cp.base_change (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι g
    (g ⁻¹ᵁ characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι (g ∣_ characteristicRankOpen E hE r)
    d hd (rankFlat_restrict_pureRelDim (k := k) g E hE r d hd) (rankFlat_isPullback g E hE r)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankFlat_pull_composition
statement:
theorem rankFlat_pull_composition :
    totalPull ops (g ⁻¹ᵁ characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι 0
      (pureRelDim_openImmersion k _) ∘ₗ totalPull ops g d hd =
    totalPull ops (g ∣_ characteristicRankOpen E hE r) d
      (rankFlat_restrict_pureRelDim (k := k) g E hE r d hd) ∘ₗ
      totalPull ops (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι 0
        (pureRelDim_openImmersion k _)
proof:
:= by
  have hl := cp.pull_comp (g ⁻¹ᵁ characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι g 0 d
    (pureRelDim_openImmersion k _) hd
    (PureRelDim.comp (pureRelDim_openImmersion k _) hd)
  have hr := cp.pull_comp (g ∣_ characteristicRankOpen E hE r)
    (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι d 0
    (rankFlat_restrict_pureRelDim (k := k) g E hE r d hd)
    (pureRelDim_openImmersion k _)
    (PureRelDim.comp (rankFlat_restrict_pureRelDim (k := k) g E hE r d hd)
      (pureRelDim_openImmersion k _))
  simp only [Nat.add_zero, Nat.zero_add] at hl hr
  have hc := totalPull_congr ops (morphismRestrict_ι g (characteristicRankOpen E hE r)) d
    (by simpa only [Nat.zero_add] using
      (PureRelDim.comp (rankFlat_restrict_pureRelDim (k := k) g E hE r d hd)
        (pureRelDim_openImmersion k (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι)))
    (PureRelDim.comp (pureRelDim_openImmersion k _) hd)
  exact hl.symm.trans (hc.symm.trans hr)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankFlat_preimage_hasConstantRank
statement:
theorem rankFlat_preimage_hasConstantRank :
    HasConstantRank (g ⁻¹ᵁ characteristicRankOpen E hE r : Scheme)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (g ⁻¹ᵁ characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)) r
proof:
:= by
  apply hasConstantRank_of_pointwise_rank
  · exact pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global _ _
      (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global g E hE)
  · intro x
    rw [rankAt_pullback _ _ (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global g E hE),
      rankAt_pullback g E hE]
    exact x.property

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankFlat_chern_restrict_pull
statement:
theorem rankFlat_chern_restrict_pull (i : ℕ) :
    totalPull ops (g ∣_ characteristicRankOpen E hE r) d
      (rankFlat_restrict_pureRelDim (k := k) g E hE r d hd) ∘ₗ
      chernOp ops cp ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι).obj E)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankFlat_chern_preimage_intertwines
statement:
theorem rankFlat_chern_preimage_intertwines (i : ℕ)
    (hr : r ∈ rankAssembly_ranks ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
      (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global g E hE)) :
    totalPull ops (g ⁻¹ᵁ characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι 0 (pureRelDim_openImmersion k _) ∘ₗ
      (totalPull ops g d hd ∘ₗ rankVaryingChernOp E hE ops cp i) =
    totalPull ops (g ⁻¹ᵁ characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι 0 (pureRelDim_openImmersion k _) ∘ₗ
      (rankVaryingChernOp ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
        (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global g E hE) ops cp i ∘ₗ totalPull ops g d hd)
proof:
:= by
  let P := totalPull ops g d hd
  let J := totalPull ops (g ⁻¹ᵁ characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι 0
    (pureRelDim_openImmersion k _)
  let V := totalPull ops (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι 0 (pureRelDim_openImmersion k _)
  let R := totalPull ops (g ∣_ characteristicRankOpen E hE r) d
    (rankFlat_restrict_pureRelDim (k := k) g E hE r d hd)
  let a := chernOp ops cp ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι).obj E)
    r (characteristicRankOpen_hasConstantRank E hE r) i
  let b := chernOp ops cp ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (g ⁻¹ᵁ characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι).obj
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)) r (rankFlat_preimage_hasConstantRank g E hE r) i
  have hP : J ∘ₗ P = R ∘ₗ V := rankFlat_pull_composition g E hE r ops cp d hd
  have hA : V ∘ₗ rankVaryingChernOp E hE ops cp i = a ∘ₗ V :=
    rankVaryingChernOp_recover E hE ops cp i r (rankFlat_ranks_subset g E hE hr)
  have hB : J ∘ₗ rankVaryingChernOp ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
      (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global g E hE) ops cp i = b ∘ₗ J :=
    rankFlat_chern_source_recover g E hE r ops cp i hr
  have hR : R ∘ₗ a = b ∘ₗ R := rankFlat_chern_restrict_pull g E hE r ops cp d hd i
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change J (P (rankVaryingChernOp E hE ops cp i x)) =
    J (rankVaryingChernOp ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
      (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global g E hE) ops cp i (P x))

    _ = R (V (rankVaryingChernOp E hE ops cp i x)) := LinearMap.congr_fun hP _
    _ = R (a (V x)) := congrArg R (LinearMap.congr_fun hA x)
    _ = b (R (V x)) := LinearMap.congr_fun hR _
    _ = b (J (P x)) := congrArg b (LinearMap.congr_fun hP x).symm
    _ = _ := (LinearMap.congr_fun hB (P x)).symm

theorem gradedRename_coordinate {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {m n : ℕ}
    (e : Fin (m + 1) ≃ Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin (m + 1)) :
    gradedRename e (coordinate R m i) = coordinate R n (e i)
proof:
:= by
  exact MvPolynomial.rename_X e i

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.gradedRename_comp
statement:
theorem gradedRename_comp {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {m n r : ℕ}
    (e : Fin (m + 1) ≃ Fin (n + 1))
    (f : Fin (n + 1) ≃ Fin (r + 1)) :
    (gradedRename (R := R) f).comp (gradedRename (R := R) e) =
      gradedRename (R := R) (e.trans f)
proof:
:= by
  apply DFunLike.coe_injective
  funext p
  change MvPolynomial.rename f (MvPolynomial.rename e p) =
    MvPolynomial.rename (f ∘ e) p
  exact MvPolynomial.rename_rename e f p

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.gradedRename_refl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gradedRename_refl {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) :
    gradedRename (Equiv.refl (Fin (n + 1))) = GradedRingHom.id (grading R n)
proof:
:= by
  apply DFunLike.coe_injective
  funext p
  change MvPolynomial.rename (Equiv.refl (Fin (n + 1))) p = p
  exact MvPolynomial.rename_id_apply p

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.irrelevant_le_map_gradedRename
statement:
theorem irrelevant_le_map_gradedRename {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {m n : ℕ}
    (e : Fin (m + 1) ≃ Fin (n + 1)) :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading R n) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading R m)).map (gradedRename e)
proof:
:= by
  refine (HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_irrelevant_le (grading R n)).2 ?_
  intro d hd p hp
  have hpX : p ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range (MvPolynomial.X (R := R))) := by
    rw [show Set.range (MvPolynomial.X (R := R)) =
        MvPolynomial.X '' (Set.univ : Set (Fin (n + 1))) by simp]
    rw [MvPolynomial.mem_ideal_span_X_image]
    intro a ha
    have hdeg : a.degree = d := by
      rw [Finsupp.degree_eq_weight_one]
      exact hp (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp ha)
    have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
      intro ha0
      subst a
      simp at hdeg
      omega
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Finsupp.ne_iff.mp ha0
    exact ⟨i, Set.mem_univ _, hi⟩
  apply (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_) hpX
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  have h := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (gradedRename e)
    (HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem (grading R m) Nat.zero_lt_one
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one R m (e.symm i)))
  rw [gradedRename_coordinate e (e.symm i), e.apply_symm_apply] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.preimage_coordinateOpen_reindexMap
proof:
:= by
  change Proj.map (gradedRename e) (irrelevant_le_map_gradedRename e) ⁻¹ᵁ
      Proj.basicOpen (grading R m) (coordinate R m i) =
    Proj.basicOpen (grading R n) (coordinate R n (e i))
  rw [Proj.map_preimage_basicOpen]
  congr 1
  exact gradedRename_coordinate e i

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.sectionIso_leftRestriction

    sectionLinearEquivOfIso e c.affineOpen.1
        ((c.transport e C').leftRestriction s) =
      c.leftRestriction (sectionLinearEquivOfIso e (C'.U i) s)
proof:
:= by
  change e.hom.app c.affineOpen.1
      (E.presheaf.map (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_left).op s) =
    E'.presheaf.map (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_left).op

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.semilinearProjMap_id_eq

theorem semilinearProjMap_id_eq (φ : M →ₗ[R] N)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.semilinearProjMap_iso_square
statement:
theorem semilinearProjMap_iso_square
    (f : R →+* S) (φ : M →ₛₗ[f] N) (φ' : M' →ₛₗ[f] N')
    (eM : M ≃ₗ[R] M') (eN : N ≃ₗ[S] N')
    (hφ : Submodule.span S (Set.range φ) = ⊤)
    (hφ' : Submodule.span S (Set.range φ') = ⊤)
    (hcomm : ∀ m : M', φ (eM.symm m) = eN.symm (φ' m))
    (hcomp1 : Submodule.span S
      (Set.range (semilinearMapComp (RingHom.id R) f
        (linearAsIdSemilinear (eM.symm : M' →ₗ[R] M)) φ)) = ⊤)
    (hcomp2 : Submodule.span S
      (Set.range (semilinearMapComp f (RingHom.id S) φ'
        (linearAsIdSemilinear (eN.symm : N' →ₗ[S] N)))) = ⊤) :
    semilinearSymmetricProjMap f φ hφ ≫ (chartIsoOfLinearEquiv eM).hom =
      (chartIsoOfLinearEquiv eN).hom ≫
        semilinearSymmetricProjMap f φ' hφ'
proof:
:= by
  have hM : Submodule.span R (Set.range (eM.symm : M' →ₗ[R] M)) = ⊤ := by
    have h : Set.range (eM.symm : M' →ₗ[R] M) = Set.univ :=
      Set.range_eq_univ.mpr eM.symm.surjective
    rw [h, Submodule.span_univ]
  have hN : Submodule.span S (Set.range (eN.symm : N' →ₗ[S] N)) = ⊤ := by
    have h : Set.range (eN.symm : N' →ₗ[S] N) = Set.univ :=
      Set.range_eq_univ.mpr eN.symm.surjective
    rw [h, Submodule.span_univ]
  change semilinearSymmetricProjMap f φ hφ ≫
      symmetricProjMap (eM.symm : M' →ₗ[R] M) hM =
    symmetricProjMap (eN.symm : N' →ₗ[S] N) hN ≫
      semilinearSymmetricProjMap f φ' hφ'
  rw [← semilinearProjMap_id_eq (eM.symm : M' →ₗ[R] M),
    ← semilinearProjMap_id_eq (eN.symm : N' →ₗ[S] N)]
  rw [semilinearSymmetricProjMap_comp (RingHom.id R) f
    (linearAsIdSemilinear (eM.symm : M' →ₗ[R] M)) φ _ _ hcomp1]
  rw [semilinearSymmetricProjMap_comp f (RingHom.id S) φ'
    (linearAsIdSemilinear (eN.symm : N' →ₗ[S] N)) _ _ hcomp2]
  apply semilinearSymmetricProjMap_congr
  · simp
  · apply semilinearMap_heq_of_ringHom_eq
    · simp
    · exact hcomm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.semilinearProjMap_iso_square_auto
statement:
theorem semilinearProjMap_iso_square_auto
    (f : R →+* S) (φ : M →ₛₗ[f] N) (φ' : M' →ₛₗ[f] N')
    (eM : M ≃ₗ[R] M') (eN : N ≃ₗ[S] N')
    (hφ : Submodule.span S (Set.range φ) = ⊤)
    (hφ' : Submodule.span S (Set.range φ') = ⊤)
    (hcomm : ∀ m : M', φ (eM.symm m) = eN.symm (φ' m)) :
    semilinearSymmetricProjMap f φ hφ ≫ (chartIsoOfLinearEquiv eM).hom =
      (chartIsoOfLinearEquiv eN).hom ≫
        semilinearSymmetricProjMap f φ' hφ'
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp1 : Submodule.span S
      (Set.range (semilinearMapComp (RingHom.id R) f
        (linearAsIdSemilinear (eM.symm : M' →ₗ[R] M)) φ)) = ⊤ := by
    have hrange : Set.range (semilinearMapComp (RingHom.id R) f
        (linearAsIdSemilinear (eM.symm : M' →ₗ[R] M)) φ) =
        Set.range φ := by
      ext n
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨m', rfl⟩
        exact ⟨eM.symm m', rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨m, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨eM m, ?_⟩
        simp [semilinearMapComp]
    rw [hrange]
    exact hφ
  have hcomp2 : Submodule.span S
      (Set.range (semilinearMapComp f (RingHom.id S) φ'
        (linearAsIdSemilinear (eN.symm : N' →ₗ[S] N)))) = ⊤ := by
    have hrange : Set.range (semilinearMapComp f (RingHom.id S) φ'
        (linearAsIdSemilinear (eN.symm : N' →ₗ[S] N))) =
        Set.range (semilinearMapComp (RingHom.id R) f
          (linearAsIdSemilinear (eM.symm : M' →ₗ[R] M)) φ) := by
      ext n
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨m', rfl⟩
        exact ⟨m', hcomm m'⟩
      · rintro ⟨m', rfl⟩
        exact ⟨m', (hcomm m').symm⟩
    rw [hrange]
    exact hcomp1
  exact semilinearProjMap_iso_square f φ φ' eM eN hφ hφ' hcomm hcomp1 hcomp2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.scalarTensor_minimalPrime_comap
statement:
theorem scalarTensor_minimalPrime_comap (e : R ≃ₐ[K] S)
    {q : Ideal S} (hq : q ∈ minimalPrimes S) :
    q.comap e.toRingHom ∈ minimalPrimes R
proof:
:= by
  have h := @Ideal.minimalPrimes_comap_of_surjective R S inferInstance inferInstance
    e.toRingHom e.surjective (⊥ : Ideal S) q hq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.scalarTensor_quotient_trdeg_comap

theorem scalarTensor_quotient_trdeg_comap (e : R ≃ₐ[K] S) (q : Ideal S) :
    Algebra.trdeg K (R ⧸ q.comap e.toRingHom) = Algebra.trdeg K (S ⧸ q)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : q = (q.comap e.toRingHom).map e.toRingHom :=

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.rationalFieldExtensionTensor_trdeg
statement:
theorem rationalFieldExtensionTensor_trdeg
    {q : Ideal (L ⊗[K] F)} (hq : q ∈ minimalPrimes (L ⊗[K] F)) :
    Algebra.trdeg L ((L ⊗[K] F) ⧸ q) = Cardinal.mk σ
proof:
:= by
  let T := (L ⊗[K] FractionRing (MvPolynomial σ K))
    ⊗[FractionRing (MvPolynomial σ K)] F
  letI : CommRing T := inferInstance
  let e : T ≃ₐ[L] L ⊗[K] F := rightScalarTensorCancel
  let p : Ideal T := q.comap e.toRingHom
  have hp : p ∈ minimalPrimes T := scalarTensor_minimalPrime_comap e hq
  have htr := rationalFunctionTensor_algebraicExtension_trdeg
    (K := K) (L := L) (σ := σ) (F := F) p hp
  calc
    Algebra.trdeg L ((L ⊗[K] F) ⧸ q) = Algebra.trdeg L (T ⧸ p) :=
      (scalarTensor_quotient_trdeg_comap e q).symm
    _ = Cardinal.mk σ := htr

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.localization_quotient_trdeg
statement:
theorem localization_quotient_trdeg
    {K R S : Type u} [Field K] [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra K R] [Algebra K S] [Algebra R S] [IsScalarTower K R S]
    (M : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization M S]
    (q : Ideal R) [q.IsPrime] (hd : Disjoint (M : Set R) (q : Set R)) :
    Algebra.trdeg K (S ⧸ q.map (algebraMap R S)) = Algebra.trdeg K (R ⧸ q)
proof:
:= by
  let Q := q.map (algebraMap R S)
  have hQ : Q.IsPrime := IsLocalization.isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint M S q inferInstance hd
  letI : Q.IsPrime := hQ
  have hc : Q.under R = q := IsLocalization.under_map_of_isPrime_disjoint M S inferInstance hd
  letI : Algebra (R ⧸ q) (S ⧸ Q) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.algebraQuotientOfLEComap (show q ≤ Q.under R from hc.symm.le)
  haveI : IsScalarTower K (R ⧸ q) (S ⧸ Q) := by
    refine IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun k ↦ ?_
    symm
    change Ideal.quotientMap Q (algebraMap R S) _ (algebraMap K (R ⧸ q) k) = _
    rw [Ideal.quotientMap_algebraMap]
    simp only [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply, Ideal.Quotient.mk_algebraMap]
  letI : IsLocalization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid (R ⧸ q) M) (S ⧸ Q) := inferInstance
  letI : FaithfulSMul (R ⧸ q) (S ⧸ Q) :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective (R ⧸ q) (S ⧸ Q)).mpr
      (Ideal.quotientMap_injective' hc.le)
  letI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (R ⧸ q) (S ⧸ Q) :=
    IsLocalization.isAlgebraic (S ⧸ Q) (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid (R ⧸ q) M)
  exact SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.trdeg_eq_of_isAlgebraic K (R ⧸ q) (S ⧸ Q)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.fieldTensor_trdeg_quotient
statement:
theorem fieldTensor_trdeg_quotient
    {K L F : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Field F]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra K F]
    {q : Ideal (L ⊗[K] F)} (hq : q ∈ minimalPrimes (L ⊗[K] F)) :
    Algebra.trdeg L ((L ⊗[K] F) ⧸ q) = Algebra.trdeg K F
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_isTranscendenceBasis K F
  let M := IntermediateField.adjoin K (Set.range ((↑) : s → F))
  let B := FractionRing (MvPolynomial s K)
  let e : B ≃ₐ[K] M := hs.1.aevalEquivField
  let j : B →ₐ[K] F := M.val.comp e.toAlgHom
  letI : Algebra B F := j.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  letI : IsScalarTower K B F := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' j.comp_algebraMap.symm
  letI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic M F := hs.isAlgebraic_field
  haveI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic B F :=
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_ringHom_of_comp_eq e.toRingHom (RingHom.id F)
      e.surjective Function.injective_id (by rfl)
  calc
    Algebra.trdeg L ((L ⊗[K] F) ⧸ q) = Cardinal.mk s :=
      rationalFieldExtensionTensor_trdeg (σ := s) hq
    _ = Algebra.trdeg K F := hs.cardinalMk_eq_trdeg

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.domainFieldTensor_trdeg_quotient
statement:
theorem domainFieldTensor_trdeg_quotient
    {K L A : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra K A]
    {q : Ideal (L ⊗[K] A)} (hq : q ∈ minimalPrimes (L ⊗[K] A)) :
    Algebra.trdeg L ((L ⊗[K] A) ⧸ q) = Algebra.trdeg K A
proof:
:= by
  let T := L ⊗[K] A
  let F := FractionRing A
  let U := L ⊗[K] F
  letI : CommRing T := inferInstance
  letI : CommRing U := inferInstance
  let φ : T →ₐ[L] U := Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id L L)
    (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K A F)
  letI : Algebra T U := φ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  letI : IsScalarTower L T U := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' φ.comp_algebraMap.symm
  let M := (nonZeroDivisors A).map
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := K) (A := L))
  have hφ : (algebraMap T U).comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom =
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap A F) := by
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro a
    rfl
  letI : IsLocalization M U :=
    IsLocalization.tensorProduct_tensorProduct_right K L (nonZeroDivisors A) F hφ
  letI : q.IsPrime := hq.1.1
  letI : Algebra A T := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  letI : Module.Free K L := Module.Free.of_divisionRing K L
  letI : Module.Flat A T := Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.commRight K A L).toLinearEquiv.symm
  have hq0 : q.under A = ⊥ := by
    have h := minimalPrime_under_of_flat (R := A) hq
    simpa only [IsDomain.minimalPrimes_eq_singleton_bot, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using h
  have hd : Disjoint (M : Set T) (q : Set T) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro _ ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ hqa
    have : a ∈ q.under A := hqa
    rw [hq0, Ideal.mem_bot] at this
    exact nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero ha this
  let Q := q.map (algebraMap T U)
  have hc : Q.under T = q := IsLocalization.under_map_of_isPrime_disjoint M U inferInstance hd
  have hQ : Q ∈ minimalPrimes U := by
    have h := (IsLocalization.minimalPrimes_map M U (⊥ : Ideal T))
    rw [Ideal.map_bot] at h
    change Q ∈ (⊥ : Ideal U).minimalPrimes
    rw [h]
    change Q.under T ∈ minimalPrimes T
    rw [hc]
    exact hq
  letI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic A F := IsLocalization.isAlgebraic F (nonZeroDivisors A)
  calc
    Algebra.trdeg L (T ⧸ q) = Algebra.trdeg L (U ⧸ Q) :=
      (localization_quotient_trdeg M q hd).symm
    _ = Algebra.trdeg K F := fieldTensor_trdeg_quotient hQ
    _ = Algebra.trdeg K A :=
      SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.trdeg_eq_of_isAlgebraic K A F

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.exists_datum_principal
statement:
theorem exists_datum_principal (V : W.Modules) (hV : IsCoherentLike W V) :
    ∃ (G : (zeroScheme t).Modules) (_ : IsCoherentLike (zeroScheme t) G),
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (zeroι t)).obj G ≅
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj (cokernel (tMul (F.appTop t) V)))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : ((pushCokernelObject F t V hV).1).IsFinitePresentation :=
    (pushCokernelObject F t V hV).2.1
  obtain ⟨G, hG, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_pushforward_iso_of_killed t (pushCokernelObject F t V hV).1
    (pushCokernelObject F t V hV).2.2
  exact ⟨G, hG, ⟨e⟩⟩

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.hbc_principal_iso
statement:
theorem hbc_principal_iso
    (hmono : ∀ (E : Y.Modules), IsFiniteLocallyFree Y E → Mono (tMul t E))
    (V : W.Modules) (hV : IsCoherentLike W V) [Mono (tMul (F.appTop t) V)]
    (G : (zeroScheme t).Modules) (hG : IsCoherentLike (zeroScheme t) G)
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (zeroι t)).obj G ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj (cokernel (tMul (F.appTop t) V)))
    (y : K0 Y) (hy : k0ToG0 Y y = finitePushforward F (g0ClassOf W V hV)) :
    k0ToG0 (zeroScheme t) (pullbackK0 (zeroι t) y) = g0ClassOf (zeroScheme t) G hG
proof:
:= by
  rw [← CIIL3.zeroGysin_k0ToG0 t hmono, hy, zeroGysin, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply,
    schemeGysin_finitePushforward_of_mono F t V hV]
  have h1 : ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf Y.Modules
        (Killed (IsCoherentLike Y) (tNatTrans t))
        (pushCokernelObject F t V hV).1 (pushCokernelObject F t V hV).2 =
      pushZero t (g0ClassOf (zeroScheme t) G hG) := by
    change _ = pushFibre t (zeroι t) (zeroι_appTop t) (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ ⟨G, hG⟩)
    rw [pushFibre_classOf]
    exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso _ _ _ _ (killed_zero t) (isZero_zero _) e.symm
  rw [h1]
  exact congrArg (fun f : G0 (zeroScheme t) →+ G0 (zeroScheme t) => f _)
    (pullFibre_comp_pushZero t) |>.trans (by simp)

name: SchemeKTheory.hasConstantRank_one_of_openCover_unitTrivializations

    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (𝒰 : Y.OpenCover.{u}) (M : Y.Modules)
