name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E28.base_eq_of_flatPullback_prime
statement:
theorem base_eq_of_flatPullback_prime {n n' : ℕ} (v : Y) (hv : height v = n) (w : Z)
    (hw : height w = n')
    (h : flatPullback f (dimPrimeCycle v n hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle w n' hw).1) : f w = v
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := congrArg (fun c : AlgebraicCycle Z ℤ => c w) h
  simp only [flatPullback_apply, M7.m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply, if_true] at h1
  by_contra hne
  rw [if_neg hne] at h1
  simp at h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E28.specializes_of_fibre
statement:
theorem specializes_of_fibre {n n' : ℕ} (v : Y) (hv : height v = n) (q : Z)
    (hq : height q = n')
    (h : flatPullback f (dimPrimeCycle v n hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle q n' hq).1)
    (p : Z) (hp : f p = v) : q ⤳ p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxf, hcoef⟩ := E27.exists_specializes_fibre_coeff_ne_zero f p
  have h1 := congrArg (fun c : AlgebraicCycle Z ℤ => c x) h
  simp only [flatPullback_apply, M7.m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply, hxf, hp, if_true, one_mul] at h1
  have hxq : x = q := by
    by_contra hne
    rw [if_neg hne] at h1
    exact hcoef (by exact_mod_cast h1)
  subst hxq
  exact hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E28.specializes_of_base_specializes
statement:
theorem specializes_of_base_specializes [Flat f] {n n' : ℕ} (v : Y) (hv : height v = n)
    (q : Z) (hq : height q = n')
    (h : flatPullback f (dimPrimeCycle v n hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle q n' hq).1)
    (p : Z) (hp : v ⤳ f p) : q ⤳ p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀, hf₀⟩ := Flat.generalizingMap f hp
  exact (specializes_of_fibre f v hv q hq h p₀ hf₀).trans hp₀

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E28.pointClosureι_le_iff
statement:
theorem pointClosureι_le_iff (a b : pointClosureScheme w) :
    pointClosureι w a ≤ pointClosureι w b ↔ a ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.le_iff_specializes, Scheme.le_iff_specializes]
  exact (pointClosureι w).isEmbedding.isInducing.specializes_iff

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E28.pointClosureι_lt
statement:
theorem pointClosureι_lt {a b : pointClosureScheme w} (h : a < b) :
    pointClosureι w a < pointClosureι w b
proof:
:=
  lt_of_le_not_ge ((pointClosureι_le_iff w a b).mpr h.le)
    (fun h' ↦ h.not_ge ((pointClosureι_le_iff w b a).mp h'))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E28.pointClosureι_le_generic
statement: theorem pointClosureι_le_generic (z : pointClosureScheme w) : pointClosureι w z ≤ w
proof:
:=
  Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr (C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι w z)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E28.pointClosureι_lt_iff
statement:
theorem pointClosureι_lt_iff (a b : pointClosureScheme w) :
    pointClosureι w a < pointClosureι w b ↔ a < b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lt_iff_le_not_ge, pointClosureι_le_iff]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E28.no_three_chain
statement:
theorem no_three_chain {n : ℕ} (hw : height w = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)) (a : W)
    (ha : height a = (n : ℕ∞)) {z y a' : pointClosureScheme w} (hz : pointClosureι w z = a)
    (h1 : z < y) (h2 : y < a') : False
proof:
:= by
  have e1 := Order.height_add_one_le (pointClosureι_lt w h1)
  have e2 := Order.height_add_one_le (pointClosureι_lt w h2)
  have e3 : height (pointClosureι w a') ≤ height w :=
    Order.height_mono (pointClosureι_le_generic w a')
  rw [hz, ha] at e1
  rw [hw] at e3
  have h4 : (n : ℕ∞) + 1 + 1 ≤ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) :=
    (add_le_add_left e1 1).trans (e2.trans e3)
  have h5 : n + 1 + 1 ≤ n + 1 := by exact_mod_cast h4
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E28.coheight_eq_one_of_height
statement:
theorem coheight_eq_one_of_height {n : ℕ} (hw : height w = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)) (a : W)
    (ha : height a = (n : ℕ∞)) (z : pointClosureScheme w) (hz : pointClosureι w z = a) :
    coheight z = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hη : pointClosureι w (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme w)) = w :=
    FiniteTypeCodimension.pointClosureι_genericPoint_eq w
  have hlt : z < genericPoint (pointClosureScheme w) := by
    refine lt_of_le_not_ge (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr (genericPoint_specializes z)) ?_
    intro hle
    have h1 : pointClosureι w (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme w)) ≤ pointClosureι w z :=
      (pointClosureι_le_iff w _ _).mpr hle
    have h2 := Order.height_mono h1
    rw [hη, hz, hw, ha] at h2
    have : n + 1 ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast h2
    omega
  apply le_antisymm
  · have : coheight z ≤ ((1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
      rw [Order.coheight_le_coe_iff]
      intro y hy
      rw [Nat.cast_one, Order.lt_one_iff, Order.coheight_eq_zero]
      intro a' ha'
      by_contra hne
      exact no_three_chain w hw a ha hz hy (lt_of_le_not_ge ha' hne)
    simpa using this
  · have := Order.coheight_add_one_le hlt
    exact le_trans (by simp) this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E28.specializes_jq_of_mem_closure
statement:
theorem specializes_jq_of_mem_closure [Flat P.toD.toBase]
    (hB : flatPullback P.toB.toBase (dimPrimeCycle v m hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle w _ hw).1)
    (hD : flatPullback P.toD.toBase (dimPrimeCycle v m hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle q _ hq).1)
    (p : P.toD.scheme) (hp : w ⤳ P.jHom p) : P.jHom q ⤳ P.jHom p
proof:
:= by
  have hwv := base_eq_of_flatPullback_prime P.toB.toBase v hv w hw hB
  have hvp : v ⤳ P.toD.toBase p := by
    have h1 := hp.map P.toB.toBase.continuous
    rwa [hwv, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, P.jHom_toBase] at h1
  exact (specializes_of_base_specializes P.toD.toBase v hv q hq hD p hvp).map P.jHom.continuous

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E28.height_jq
statement: theorem height_jq : height (P.jHom q) = ((m + e : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  rw [height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion P.jHom q, hq]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E28.exists_lift_coheight_one
statement:
theorem exists_lift_coheight_one
    (hB : flatPullback P.toB.toBase (dimPrimeCycle v m hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle w _ hw).1)
    (hD : flatPullback P.toD.toBase (dimPrimeCycle v m hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle q _ hq).1) :
    ∃ zq : pointClosureScheme w, pointClosureι w zq = P.jHom q ∧ coheight zq = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨zq, hzq⟩ := E27.weilGate_mem_range P m v hv w hw q hq hB hD
  exact ⟨zq, hzq, coheight_eq_one_of_height w (n := m + e) hw (P.jHom q)
    (height_jq P q hq) zq hzq⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E28.eq_jq_of_coheight_one
statement:
theorem eq_jq_of_coheight_one [Flat P.toD.toBase]
    (hB : flatPullback P.toB.toBase (dimPrimeCycle v m hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle w _ hw).1)
    (hD : flatPullback P.toD.toBase (dimPrimeCycle v m hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle q _ hq).1)
    (z : pointClosureScheme w) (hz : coheight z = 1)
    (hr : pointClosureι w z ∈ Set.range P.jHom) : pointClosureι w z = P.jHom q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hr
  have hwz : w ⤳ pointClosureι w z := C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι w z
  rw [← hp] at hwz
  have hjq := specializes_jq_of_mem_closure P v hv w hw q hq hB hD p hwz
  by_contra hne
  have hle : pointClosureι w z ≤ P.jHom q := by
    rw [Scheme.le_iff_specializes, ← hp]
    exact hjq
  have hlt : pointClosureι w z < P.jHom q := lt_of_le_not_ge hle (fun h' ↦ hne (by
    have h1 := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hle
    have h2 := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp h'
    exact (h2.antisymm h1).eq))
  obtain ⟨zq, hzq, hc⟩ := exists_lift_coheight_one P v hv w hw q hq hB hD
  rw [← hzq] at hlt
  have hzz : z < zq := (pointClosureι_lt_iff w z zq).mp hlt
  have := Order.coheight_add_one_le hzz
  rw [hc, hz] at this
  norm_num at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E28.coeff_eq_ite_of_parts
statement:
theorem coeff_eq_ite_of_parts {k : Type u} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X]
    {B D : X.Modules} {b : B ⟶ D} (P : PairCover b) {e m : ℕ} (v : X) (hv : height v = m)
    (w : P.toB.scheme) (hw : height w = ((m + e + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
    (q : P.toD.scheme) (hq : height q = ((m + e : ℕ) : ℕ∞)) [Flat P.toD.toBase]
    (hB : flatPullback P.toB.toBase (dimPrimeCycle v m hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle w _ hw).1)
    (hD : flatPullback P.toD.toBase (dimPrimeCycle v m hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle q _ hq).1)
    (c : pointClosureScheme w → ℤ) (h0 : ∀ z, coheight z ≠ 1 → c z = 0)
    (hunit : ∀ z, coheight z = 1 → pointClosureι w z ∉ Set.range P.jHom → c z = 0)
    (hone : ∀ z, pointClosureι w z = P.jHom q → c z = 1) (z : pointClosureScheme w) :
    c z = if pointClosureι w z = P.jHom q then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : pointClosureι w z = P.jHom q
  · rw [if_pos h]
    exact hone z h
  · rw [if_neg h]
    by_cases hc : coheight z = 1
    · by_cases hr : pointClosureι w z ∈ Set.range P.jHom
      · exact absurd (eq_jq_of_coheight_one P v hv w hw q hq hB hD z hc hr) h
      · exact hunit z hc hr
    · exact h0 z hc

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E28.flat_toD
statement: theorem flat_toD (hCD : ∀ i, Nat.card (P.toD.basisIndex i) = e + 1) : Flat P.toD.toBase
proof:
:=
  AffineFrameCover.toBase_flat P.toD (fun i ↦ m7g_nonempty P.toD hCD i)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinate_isLocallyFree
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinate_isLocallyFree (d : ℤ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen k n i).ι).obj
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d)).IsLocallyFree
proof:
:= by
  letI : (unitModules (coordinateOpen k n i).toScheme).IsLocallyFree :=
    SheafOfModules.unit_isLocallyFree
      (R := (coordinateOpen k n i).toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
  exact SheafOfModules.isLocallyFree_of_iso
    (R := (coordinateOpen k n i).toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
    (projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateIso k n d i)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinate_isFinitePresentation
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinate_isFinitePresentation (d : ℤ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen k n i).ι).obj
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d)).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation
    (coordinateOpen k n i).toScheme.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
      (projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateIso k n d i)
      (SheafOfModules.unit_isFinitePresentation
        (R := (coordinateOpen k n i).toScheme.ringCatSheaf))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFinitePresentation
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFinitePresentation (d : ℤ) :
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  let X := ProjectiveTwistSpace k n
  let M := projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d
  let U : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)) → X.Opens :=
    fun i ↦ coordinateOpen k n i.down
  have hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop U :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := X) U).2 (by
      change ⨆ i : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1)), coordinateOpen k n i.down = ⊤
      simpa only [U, iSup_ulift] using coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top k n)
  letI : ∀ i, (M.over (U i)).IsFinitePresentation := fun i ↦ by
    let R := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι).obj M
    letI : R.IsFinitePresentation :=
      (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation (U i).toScheme.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
        (projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateIso k n d i.down)
        (SheafOfModules.unit_isFinitePresentation
          (R := (U i).toScheme.ringCatSheaf))
    let N := (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).inverse.obj R
    letI : N.IsFinitePresentation :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.isFinitePresentation_overEquiv_inverse (U i) R
    let e : M.over (U i) ≅ N :=
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).unitIso.app (M.over (U i)) ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).inverse.mapIso
          ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv (U i)).app M)
    exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation (X.ringCatSheaf.over (U i))).prop_of_iso
      e.symm inferInstance
  exact SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation_of_over_cover M U hU

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingSheaf_isQuasicoherent
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingSheaf_isQuasicoherent (d : ℤ) :
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  letI : (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).IsFinitePresentation :=
    projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFinitePresentation k n d
  infer_instance

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.ι_mem_one
statement:
lemma ι_mem_one {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (m : M) :
    ExteriorAlgebra.ι R m ∈ ⋀[R]^1 M
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [pow_one] using LinearMap.mem_range_self _ m

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.psiOne_sq
statement:
lemma psiOne_sq (r : F →ₗ[R] K) (g : F →ₗ[R] Q) (m : F) :
    psiOne r g m * psiOne r g m = 0
proof:
:= by
  set a := ExteriorAlgebra.ι R (r m)
  set b := ExteriorAlgebra.ι R (g m)
  have h1 : psiOne r g m = a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : ExteriorAlgebra R Q) +
      (1 : ExteriorAlgebra R K) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b := rfl
  rw [h1, add_mul, mul_add, mul_add]
  have e1 : (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : ExteriorAlgebra R Q) * a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : ExteriorAlgebra R Q) :
      GT R K Q) = 0 := by
    rw [← GradedTensorProduct.includeLeft_apply, ← map_mul, ExteriorAlgebra.ι_sq_zero, map_zero]
  have e2 : ((1 : ExteriorAlgebra R K) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b * (1 : ExteriorAlgebra R K) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b :
      GT R K Q) = 0 := by
    rw [← GradedTensorProduct.includeRight_apply, ← map_mul, ExteriorAlgebra.ι_sq_zero, map_zero]
  have e3 : (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : ExteriorAlgebra R Q) * (1 : ExteriorAlgebra R K) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b :
      GT R K Q) = a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b :=
    GradedTensorProduct.tmul_one_mul_one_tmul _ _ a b
  have e4 : ((1 : ExteriorAlgebra R K) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b * a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : ExteriorAlgebra R Q) :
      GT R K Q) = -(a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b) := by
    have := GradedTensorProduct.tmul_coe_mul_coe_tmul (R := R) (fun i : ℕ ↦ ⋀[R]^i K)
      (fun i : ℕ ↦ ⋀[R]^i Q) (1 : ExteriorAlgebra R K) (⟨b, ι_mem_one _⟩ : ⋀[R]^1 Q)
      (⟨a, ι_mem_one _⟩ : ⋀[R]^1 K) (1 : ExteriorAlgebra R Q)
    simp only [one_mul, mul_one] at this
    rw [this]
    simp
  rw [e1, e2, e3, e4]
  abel

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.psi_ι
statement:
lemma psi_ι (r : F →ₗ[R] K) (g : F →ₗ[R] Q) (m : F) :
    psi r g (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R m) = psiOne r g m
proof:
:=
  ExteriorAlgebra.lift_ι_apply R (psiOne r g) (psiOne_sq r g) m

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.psi_comp_map
statement:
lemma psi_comp_map (f : K →ₗ[R] F) (r : F →ₗ[R] K) (g : F →ₗ[R] Q)
    (hrf : ∀ k, r (f k) = k) (hgf : ∀ k, g (f k) = 0) :
    (psi r g).comp (ExteriorAlgebra.map f) =
      GradedTensorProduct.includeLeft (fun i : ℕ ↦ ⋀[R]^i K) (fun i : ℕ ↦ ⋀[R]^i Q)
proof:
:= by
  apply ExteriorAlgebra.hom_ext
  ext k
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, AlgHom.comp_apply,
    ExteriorAlgebra.map_apply_ι, psi_ι]
  simp [psiOne, hrf, hgf]

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.algebraMapInv_eq_zero
statement:
lemma algebraMapInv_eq_zero {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≠ 0)
    (a : ExteriorAlgebra R M) (ha : a ∈ ⋀[R]^i M) :
    ExteriorAlgebra.algebraMapInv a = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hi
  rw [← exteriorPower.ιMulti_span_fixedDegree] at ha
  induction ha using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hx
      rw [ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_succ_apply, map_mul]
      simp [ExteriorAlgebra.algebraMapInv]
  | zero => exact map_zero _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [map_smul, hx, smul_zero]

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.decompose_zero_eq
statement:
lemma decompose_zero_eq {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (a : ExteriorAlgebra R M) :
    (decompose (fun i : ℕ ↦ ⋀[R]^i M) a 0 : ExteriorAlgebra R M) =
      algebraMap R _ (ExteriorAlgebra.algebraMapInv a)
proof:
:= by
  have ha : a ∈ (⊤ : Submodule R (ExteriorAlgebra R M)) := Submodule.mem_top
  rw [← ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_span] at ha
  induction ha using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨⟨n, v⟩, rfl⟩ := hx
      rcases n with _ | k
      · simp only [ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_zero_apply, map_one]
        exact decompose_of_mem_same (fun i : ℕ ↦ ⋀[R]^i M) SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem
      · have hmem : ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti R (k + 1) v ∈ ⋀[R]^(k + 1) M :=
          (exteriorPower.ιMulti R (k + 1) v).2
        rw [decompose_of_mem_ne (fun i : ℕ ↦ ⋀[R]^i M) hmem (Nat.succ_ne_zero k),
          algebraMapInv_eq_zero (Nat.succ_ne_zero k) _ hmem, map_zero]
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => simp [hx, hy]
  | smul c x _ hx =>
      rw [decompose_smul, DirectSum.smul_apply, Submodule.coe_smul, hx, map_smul, smul_eq_mul,
        map_mul, Algebra.smul_def]

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.theta_tmul
statement:
lemma theta_tmul (a : ExteriorAlgebra R K) (b : ExteriorAlgebra R Q) :
    theta R K Q (a ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b) = ExteriorAlgebra.algebraMapInv a • b
proof:
:= by
  rw [theta, GradedTensorProduct.lift_tmul]
  simp [Algebra.smul_def]

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.theta_comp_psi
statement:
lemma theta_comp_psi (r : F →ₗ[R] K) (g : F →ₗ[R] Q) :
    (theta R K Q).comp (psi r g) = ExteriorAlgebra.map g
proof:
:= by
  apply ExteriorAlgebra.hom_ext
  ext m
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, AlgHom.comp_apply,
    ExteriorAlgebra.map_apply_ι, psi_ι]
  simp only [psiOne, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
    AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, GradedTensorProduct.includeLeft_apply,
    GradedTensorProduct.includeRight_apply, map_add, theta_tmul]
  simp [ExteriorAlgebra.algebraMapInv]

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.coe_proj
statement:
lemma coe_proj {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (i : ℕ) (x : ExteriorAlgebra R M) :
    (proj R M i x : ExteriorAlgebra R M) = decompose (fun i : ℕ ↦ ⋀[R]^i M) x i
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.proj_of_mem
statement:
lemma proj_of_mem {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (i : ℕ) (x : ExteriorAlgebra R M)
    (hx : x ∈ ⋀[R]^i M) : proj R M i x = ⟨x, hx⟩
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (decompose_of_mem_same (fun i : ℕ ↦ ⋀[R]^i M) hx)

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.of_symm_includeLeft_mul
statement:
lemma of_symm_includeLeft_mul (a : ExteriorAlgebra R K)
    (w : ExteriorAlgebra R K ⊗[R] ExteriorAlgebra R Q) :
    (GradedTensorProduct.of R (fun i : ℕ ↦ ⋀[R]^i K) (fun i : ℕ ↦ ⋀[R]^i Q)).symm
        (GradedTensorProduct.includeLeft (fun i : ℕ ↦ ⋀[R]^i K) (fun i : ℕ ↦ ⋀[R]^i Q) a *
          GradedTensorProduct.of R (fun i : ℕ ↦ ⋀[R]^i K) (fun i : ℕ ↦ ⋀[R]^i Q) w) =
      (LinearMap.mulLeft R a).rTensor _ w
proof:
:= by
  induction w using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a₂ b₂ =>
      have h1 : GradedTensorProduct.of R (fun i : ℕ ↦ ⋀[R]^i K) (fun i : ℕ ↦ ⋀[R]^i Q)
          (a₂ ⊗ₜ b₂) = a₂ ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : ExteriorAlgebra R Q) *
            (1 : ExteriorAlgebra R K) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b₂ :=
        (GradedTensorProduct.tmul_one_mul_one_tmul _ _ a₂ b₂).symm
      rw [h1, GradedTensorProduct.includeLeft_apply, ← mul_assoc,
        ← GradedTensorProduct.includeLeft_apply, ← GradedTensorProduct.includeLeft_apply,
        ← map_mul, GradedTensorProduct.includeLeft_apply,
        GradedTensorProduct.tmul_one_mul_one_tmul]
      rfl
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, mul_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add]

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.rho_map_mul_of_lt
statement:
lemma rho_map_mul_of_lt (f : K →ₗ[R] F) (r : F →ₗ[R] K) (g : F →ₗ[R] Q)
    (hrf : ∀ k, r (f k) = k) (hgf : ∀ k, g (f k) = 0) (i j p : ℕ) (hp : i < p)
    (a : ExteriorAlgebra R K) (ha : a ∈ ⋀[R]^p K) (y : ExteriorAlgebra R F) :
    rho i j r g (ExteriorAlgebra.map f a * y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hpsi : psi r g (ExteriorAlgebra.map f a) =
      GradedTensorProduct.includeLeft (fun i : ℕ ↦ ⋀[R]^i K) (fun i : ℕ ↦ ⋀[R]^i Q) a := by
    rw [← psi_comp_map f r g hrf hgf]
    rfl
  simp only [rho, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, map_mul,
    hpsi, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
  rw [← GradedTensorProduct.symm_of_of (fun i : ℕ ↦ ⋀[R]^i K) (fun i : ℕ ↦ ⋀[R]^i Q)
    (psi r g y), of_symm_includeLeft_mul]
  rw [LinearMap.rTensor, ← LinearMap.comp_apply (TensorProduct.map _ _), ← TensorProduct.map_comp]
  have h0 : proj R K i ∘ₗ LinearMap.mulLeft R a = 0 := by
    refine LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, coe_proj,
      LinearMap.zero_apply, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]
    exact DirectSum.coe_decompose_mul_of_left_mem_of_not_le _ ha (by omega)
  rw [LinearMap.comp_id, h0, TensorProduct.map_zero_left, LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.map_proj_rTensor_mulLeft
statement:
lemma map_proj_rTensor_mulLeft (i j : ℕ) (a : ⋀[R]^i K)
    (w : ExteriorAlgebra R K ⊗[R] ExteriorAlgebra R Q) :
    TensorProduct.map (proj R K i) (proj R Q j)
        ((LinearMap.mulLeft R (a : ExteriorAlgebra R K)).rTensor _ w) =
      a ⊗ₜ proj R Q j (theta R K Q
        (GradedTensorProduct.of R (fun i : ℕ ↦ ⋀[R]^i K) (fun i : ℕ ↦ ⋀[R]^i Q) w))
proof:
:= by
  induction w using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a₂ b₂ =>
      rw [LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, TensorProduct.map_tmul, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply]
      have e1 : GradedTensorProduct.of R (fun i : ℕ ↦ ⋀[R]^i K) (fun i : ℕ ↦ ⋀[R]^i Q)
          (a₂ ⊗ₜ b₂) = a₂ ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b₂ := rfl
      rw [e1, theta_tmul, map_smul, TensorProduct.tmul_smul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      congr 1
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [coe_proj, DirectSum.coe_decompose_mul_of_left_mem_of_le (fun i : ℕ ↦ ⋀[R]^i K) a.2 le_rfl,
        Nat.sub_self,
        decompose_zero_eq, SetLike.val_smul, Algebra.smul_def, Algebra.commutes]
  | add x y hx hy =>
      rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, map_add, map_add, TensorProduct.tmul_add]

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.rho_map_mul
statement:
lemma rho_map_mul (f : K →ₗ[R] F) (r : F →ₗ[R] K) (g : F →ₗ[R] Q)
    (hrf : ∀ k, r (f k) = k) (hgf : ∀ k, g (f k) = 0) (i j : ℕ)
    (a : ⋀[R]^i K) (y : ExteriorAlgebra R F) :
    rho i j r g (ExteriorAlgebra.map f (a : ExteriorAlgebra R K) * y) =
      a ⊗ₜ proj R Q j (ExteriorAlgebra.map g y)
proof:
:= by
  have hpsi : psi r g (ExteriorAlgebra.map f a) =
      GradedTensorProduct.includeLeft (fun i : ℕ ↦ ⋀[R]^i K) (fun i : ℕ ↦ ⋀[R]^i Q) a := by
    rw [← psi_comp_map f r g hrf hgf]
    rfl
  simp only [rho, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, map_mul,
    hpsi, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
  rw [← GradedTensorProduct.symm_of_of (fun i : ℕ ↦ ⋀[R]^i K) (fun i : ℕ ↦ ⋀[R]^i Q)
    (psi r g y), of_symm_includeLeft_mul]
  have hg : ExteriorAlgebra.map g y = theta R K Q (psi r g y) := by
    rw [← theta_comp_psi r g]
    rfl
  rw [hg]
  exact map_proj_rTensor_mulLeft i j a _

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.coe_exteriorPower_map
statement:
lemma coe_exteriorPower_map {M N : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module R N] (n : ℕ) (g : M →ₗ[R] N) (x : ⋀[R]^n M) :
    ((exteriorPower.map n g x : ⋀[R]^n N) : ExteriorAlgebra R N) =
      ExteriorAlgebra.map g (x : ExteriorAlgebra R M)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (⋀[R]^n N).subtype ∘ₗ exteriorPower.map n g =
      (ExteriorAlgebra.map g).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (⋀[R]^n M).subtype := by
    apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext
    ext v
    simp [exteriorPower.map_apply_ιMulti, ExteriorAlgebra.map_apply_ιMulti]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h x

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.map_exteriorPower_eq_pow
statement:
lemma map_exteriorPower_eq_pow (f : K →ₗ[R] F) (i : ℕ) :
    Submodule.map (ExteriorAlgebra.map f).toLinearMap (⋀[R]^i K) =
      LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R ∘ₗ f) ^ i
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.map_pow, ExteriorAlgebra.ι_range_map_map, ← LinearMap.range_comp]

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.mem_range_pow_iff
statement:
lemma mem_range_pow_iff (f : K →ₗ[R] F) (i : ℕ) (z : ExteriorAlgebra R F) :
    z ∈ LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R ∘ₗ f) ^ i ↔
      ∃ a : ⋀[R]^i K, ExteriorAlgebra.map f (a : ExteriorAlgebra R K) = z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_exteriorPower_eq_pow, Submodule.mem_map]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a, a.2, rfl⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.range_ι_le_sup
statement:
lemma range_ι_le_sup (f : K →ₗ[R] F) (r : F →ₗ[R] K) (s : Q →ₗ[R] F) (g : F →ₗ[R] Q)
    (hdec : ∀ y, y = f (r y) + s (g y)) :
    LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R (M := F)) ≤
      LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R ∘ₗ f) ⊔ LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R ∘ₗ s)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
  rw [hdec y, map_add]
  exact Submodule.add_mem_sup ⟨r y, rfl⟩ ⟨g y, rfl⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.range_mul_comm_le
statement:
lemma range_mul_comm_le (f : K →ₗ[R] F) (s : Q →ₗ[R] F) :
    LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R ∘ₗ s) * LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R ∘ₗ f) ≤
      LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R ∘ₗ f) * LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R ∘ₗ s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.mul_le]
  rintro _ ⟨q, rfl⟩ _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
  have h := ExteriorAlgebra.ι_add_mul_swap (R := R) (f k) (s q)
  have h2 : ExteriorAlgebra.ι R (s q) * ExteriorAlgebra.ι R (f k) =
      -(ExteriorAlgebra.ι R (f k) * ExteriorAlgebra.ι R (s q)) := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right h
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply]
  rw [h2]
  exact Submodule.neg_mem _ (Submodule.mul_mem_mul ⟨k, rfl⟩ ⟨q, rfl⟩)

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.pow_succ_le
statement:
lemma pow_succ_le (f : K →ₗ[R] F) (r : F →ₗ[R] K) (s : Q →ₗ[R] F) (g : F →ₗ[R] Q)
    (hdec : ∀ y, y = f (r y) + s (g y)) (m : ℕ) :
    LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R (M := F)) ^ (m + 1) ≤
      LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R ∘ₗ f) *
          LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R (M := F)) ^ m ⊔
        LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R ∘ₗ s) ^ (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  set V := LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R (M := F))
  set A := LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R ∘ₗ f)
  set S := LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R ∘ₗ s)
  have hA : A ≤ V := by rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩; exact ⟨f k, rfl⟩
  have hS : S ≤ V := by rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩; exact ⟨s k, rfl⟩
  have hV : V ≤ A ⊔ S := range_ι_le_sup f r s g hdec
  induction m with
  | zero => simpa [pow_one, pow_zero, Submodule.mul_one] using hV
  | succ m ih =>
      rw [pow_succ' V (m + 1)]
      calc V * V ^ (m + 1) ≤ (A ⊔ S) * (A * V ^ m ⊔ S ^ (m + 1)) := mul_le_mul' hV ih
        _ = A * (A * V ^ m) ⊔ A * S ^ (m + 1) ⊔ (S * (A * V ^ m) ⊔ S * S ^ (m + 1)) := by
            rw [Submodule.sup_mul, Submodule.mul_sup, Submodule.mul_sup]
        _ ≤ A * V ^ (m + 1) ⊔ S ^ (m + 1 + 1) := by
            have hAV : A * V ^ m ≤ V ^ (m + 1) := by
              rw [pow_succ' V m]; exact mul_le_mul' hA le_rfl
            have hSV : S * V ^ m ≤ V ^ (m + 1) := by
              rw [pow_succ' V m]; exact mul_le_mul' hS le_rfl
            refine sup_le (sup_le ?_ ?_) (sup_le ?_ ?_)
            · exact le_sup_of_le_left (mul_le_mul' le_rfl hAV)
            · exact le_sup_of_le_left (mul_le_mul' le_rfl
                (pow_le_pow_left' hS (m + 1)))
            · refine le_sup_of_le_left ?_
              calc S * (A * V ^ m) = S * A * V ^ m := (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
                _ ≤ A * S * V ^ m := mul_le_mul' (range_mul_comm_le f s) le_rfl
                _ = A * (S * V ^ m) := mul_assoc _ _ _
                _ ≤ A * V ^ (m + 1) := mul_le_mul' le_rfl hSV
            · exact le_sup_of_le_right (by rw [← pow_succ'])

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.mem_mul_of_map_eq_zero
statement:
lemma mem_mul_of_map_eq_zero (f : K →ₗ[R] F) (r : F →ₗ[R] K) (s : Q →ₗ[R] F) (g : F →ₗ[R] Q)
    (hdec : ∀ y, y = f (r y) + s (g y)) (hgs : ∀ q, g (s q) = q) (hgf : ∀ k, g (f k) = 0)
    (m : ℕ) (x : ⋀[R]^(m + 1) F) (hx : exteriorPower.map (m + 1) g x = 0) :
    (x : ExteriorAlgebra R F) ∈
      LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R ∘ₗ f) *
        LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R (M := F)) ^ m
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := pow_succ_le f r s g hdec m x.2
  obtain ⟨u, hu, v, hv, huv⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 h1
  have hgu : ExteriorAlgebra.map g u = 0 := by
    have hle : LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R ∘ₗ f) *
        LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R (M := F)) ^ m ≤
          LinearMap.ker (ExteriorAlgebra.map g).toLinearMap := by
      rw [Submodule.mul_le]
      rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩ w _
      simp [ExteriorAlgebra.map_apply_ι, hgf]
    exact hle hu
  have hS : LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R ∘ₗ s) ^ (m + 1) =
      Submodule.map (ExteriorAlgebra.map s).toLinearMap (⋀[R]^(m + 1) Q) :=
    (map_exteriorPower_eq_pow s (m + 1)).symm
  rw [hS] at hv
  obtain ⟨v', -, rfl⟩ := hv
  have hgv : ExteriorAlgebra.map g (ExteriorAlgebra.map s v') = v' := by
    rw [← AlgHom.comp_apply, ExteriorAlgebra.map_comp_map]
    have : g ∘ₗ s = LinearMap.id := LinearMap.ext hgs
    rw [this, ExteriorAlgebra.map_id, AlgHom.id_apply]
  have hx' : ExteriorAlgebra.map g (x : ExteriorAlgebra R F) = 0 := by
    rw [← coe_exteriorPower_map, hx, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]
  rw [← huv, map_add, hgu, zero_add, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, hgv] at hx'
  rw [← huv, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, hx', map_zero, add_zero]
  exact hu

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.rho_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
lemma rho_eq_zero_of_mem (f : K →ₗ[R] F) (r : F →ₗ[R] K) (g : F →ₗ[R] Q)
    (hrf : ∀ k, r (f k) = k) (hgf : ∀ k, g (f k) = 0) (i j m : ℕ) (z : ExteriorAlgebra R F)
    (hz : z ∈ LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R ∘ₗ f) ^ (i + 1) *
      LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R (M := F)) ^ m) :
    rho i j r g z = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hle : LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R ∘ₗ f) ^ (i + 1) *
      LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R (M := F)) ^ m ≤ LinearMap.ker (rho i j r g) := by
    rw [Submodule.mul_le]
    intro a ha y _
    obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := (mem_range_pow_iff f (i + 1) a).1 ha
    exact rho_map_mul_of_lt f r g hrf hgf i j (i + 1) (Nat.lt_succ_self i) _ a'.2 y
  exact hle hz

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.map_mem_exteriorPower
statement:
lemma map_mem_exteriorPower (f : K →ₗ[R] F) (i : ℕ) (a : ⋀[R]^i K) :
    ExteriorAlgebra.map f (a : ExteriorAlgebra R K) ∈ ⋀[R]^i F
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coe_exteriorPower_map]
  exact (exteriorPower.map i f a).2

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.coe_wedgeLin_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coe_wedgeLin_tmul (f : K →ₗ[R] F) (i j n : ℕ) (h : i + j = n) (a : ⋀[R]^i K)
    (b : ⋀[R]^j F) :
    ((wedgeLin f i j n h (a ⊗ₜ b) : ⋀[R]^n F) : ExteriorAlgebra R F) =
      ExteriorAlgebra.map f (a : ExteriorAlgebra R K) * (b : ExteriorAlgebra R F)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.wedgeLin_mem_mul
statement:
lemma wedgeLin_mem_mul (f : K →ₗ[R] F) (i j n : ℕ) (h : i + j = n)
    (y : ⋀[R]^i K ⊗[R] ⋀[R]^j F) :
    ((wedgeLin f i j n h y : ⋀[R]^n F) : ExteriorAlgebra R F) ∈
      LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R ∘ₗ f) ^ i *
        LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R (M := F)) ^ j
proof:
:= by
  induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a b =>
      rw [coe_wedgeLin_tmul]
      exact Submodule.mul_mem_mul ((mem_range_pow_iff f i _).2 ⟨a, rfl⟩) b.2
  | add x y hx hy =>
      rw [map_add, Submodule.coe_add]
      exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.mem_range_wedgeLin_iff
statement:
lemma mem_range_wedgeLin_iff (f : K →ₗ[R] F) (i j n : ℕ) (h : i + j = n) (x : ⋀[R]^n F) :
    x ∈ LinearMap.range (wedgeLin f i j n h) ↔
      (x : ExteriorAlgebra R F) ∈ LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R ∘ₗ f) ^ i *
        LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R (M := F)) ^ j
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact wedgeLin_mem_mul f i j n h y
  · intro hx
    have key : ∃ y, ((wedgeLin f i j n h y : ⋀[R]^n F) : ExteriorAlgebra R F) = x := by
      refine Submodule.mul_induction_on
        (C := fun z => ∃ y, ((wedgeLin f i j n h y : ⋀[R]^n F) : ExteriorAlgebra R F) = z) hx
        ?_ ?_
      · intro m hm v hv
        obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (mem_range_pow_iff f i m).1 hm
        exact ⟨a ⊗ₜ (⟨v, hv⟩ : ⋀[R]^j F), rfl⟩
      · rintro z₁ z₂ ⟨y₁, hy₁⟩ ⟨y₂, hy₂⟩
        exact ⟨y₁ + y₂, by rw [map_add, Submodule.coe_add, hy₁, hy₂]⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := key
    exact ⟨y, Subtype.ext hy⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.map_eq_zero_of_mem_mul
statement:
lemma map_eq_zero_of_mem_mul (f : K →ₗ[R] F) (g : F →ₗ[R] Q) (hgf : ∀ k, g (f k) = 0)
    (i j : ℕ) (z : ExteriorAlgebra R F)
    (hz : z ∈ LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R ∘ₗ f) ^ (i + 1) *
      LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R (M := F)) ^ j) :
    ExteriorAlgebra.map g z = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hle : LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R ∘ₗ f) ^ (i + 1) *
      LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R (M := F)) ^ j ≤
        LinearMap.ker (ExteriorAlgebra.map g).toLinearMap := by
    rw [pow_succ', mul_assoc, Submodule.mul_le]
    rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩ w _
    simp [ExteriorAlgebra.map_apply_ι, hgf]
  exact hle hz

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.map_wedgeLin_eq_zero
statement:
lemma map_wedgeLin_eq_zero (f : K →ₗ[R] F) (g : F →ₗ[R] Q) (hgf : ∀ k, g (f k) = 0)
    (i j n : ℕ) (h : i + 1 + j = n) (z : ⋀[R]^(i + 1) K ⊗[R] ⋀[R]^j F) :
    exteriorPower.map n g (wedgeLin f (i + 1) j n h z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [coe_exteriorPower_map, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]
  exact map_eq_zero_of_mem_mul f g hgf i j _ (wedgeLin_mem_mul f (i + 1) j n h z)

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.exact_wedgeLin_one
statement:
lemma exact_wedgeLin_one (f : K →ₗ[R] F) (r : F →ₗ[R] K) (s : Q →ₗ[R] F) (g : F →ₗ[R] Q)
    (hdec : ∀ y, y = f (r y) + s (g y)) (hgs : ∀ q, g (s q) = q) (hgf : ∀ k, g (f k) = 0)
    (m : ℕ) (h : 1 + m = m + 1) :
    Function.Exact (wedgeLin f 1 m (m + 1) h) (exteriorPower.map (m + 1) g)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  constructor
  · intro hy
    have h1 := mem_mul_of_map_eq_zero f r s g hdec hgs hgf m y hy
    rw [← pow_one (LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι R ∘ₗ f))] at h1
    exact (mem_range_wedgeLin_iff f 1 m (m + 1) h y).2 h1
  · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
    exact map_wedgeLin_eq_zero f g hgf 0 m (m + 1) h z

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.rho_wedgeLin
statement:
lemma rho_wedgeLin (f : K →ₗ[R] F) (r : F →ₗ[R] K) (g : F →ₗ[R] Q)
    (hrf : ∀ k, r (f k) = k) (hgf : ∀ k, g (f k) = 0) (i j n : ℕ) (h : i + j = n)
    (x : ⋀[R]^i K ⊗[R] ⋀[R]^j F) :
    rho i j r g (wedgeLin f i j n h x : ExteriorAlgebra R F) =
      LinearMap.lTensor _ (exteriorPower.map j g) x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a b =>
      rw [coe_wedgeLin_tmul, rho_map_mul f r g hrf hgf, LinearMap.lTensor_tmul]
      congr 1
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [coe_proj, coe_exteriorPower_map]
      exact decompose_of_mem_same (fun i : ℕ ↦ ⋀[R]^i Q) (by
        rw [← coe_exteriorPower_map]; exact (exteriorPower.map j g b).2)
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, Submodule.coe_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add]

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.wedgeLin_succ_mem
statement:
lemma wedgeLin_succ_mem (f : K →ₗ[R] F) (i j n : ℕ) (h₁ : i + 1 + j = n) (h₂ : i + (j + 1) = n)
    (h : 1 + j = j + 1) (κ : ⋀[R]^i K) (z : ⋀[R]^1 K ⊗[R] ⋀[R]^j F) :
    wedgeLin f i (j + 1) n h₂ (κ ⊗ₜ wedgeLin f 1 j (j + 1) h z) ∈
      LinearMap.range (wedgeLin f (i + 1) j n h₁)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_range_wedgeLin_iff, coe_wedgeLin_tmul, pow_succ, mul_assoc]
  refine Submodule.mul_mem_mul ((mem_range_pow_iff f i _).2 ⟨κ, rfl⟩) ?_
  have := wedgeLin_mem_mul f 1 j (j + 1) h z
  rwa [pow_one] at this

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.exteriorPower_map_zero_bijective
statement:
lemma exteriorPower_map_zero_bijective (g : F →ₗ[R] Q) :
    Function.Bijective (exteriorPower.map 0 g)
proof:
:= by
  have h : exteriorPower.map 0 g =
      ((exteriorPower.zeroEquiv R F).trans (exteriorPower.zeroEquiv R Q).symm).toLinearMap := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    apply (exteriorPower.zeroEquiv R Q).injective
    simp only [LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun (exteriorPower.zeroEquiv_naturality g) x
  rw [h]
  exact LinearEquiv.bijective _

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.wedgeLin_lTensor_mem
statement:
lemma wedgeLin_lTensor_mem (f : K →ₗ[R] F) (i j n : ℕ) (h₁ : i + 1 + j = n)
    (h₂ : i + (j + 1) = n) (h : 1 + j = j + 1) (x : ⋀[R]^i K ⊗[R] (⋀[R]^1 K ⊗[R] ⋀[R]^j F)) :
    wedgeLin f i (j + 1) n h₂ (LinearMap.lTensor _ (wedgeLin f 1 j (j + 1) h) x) ∈
      LinearMap.range (wedgeLin f (i + 1) j n h₁)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul κ z =>
      rw [LinearMap.lTensor_tmul]
      exact wedgeLin_succ_mem f i j n h₁ h₂ h κ z
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.lTensor_bijective_of_bijective
statement:
lemma lTensor_bijective_of_bijective {M N P : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [AddCommGroup P] [Module R P] (φ : N →ₗ[R] P)
    (hφ : Function.Bijective φ) : Function.Bijective (LinearMap.lTensor M φ)
proof:
:= by
  have h : LinearMap.lTensor M φ = ((LinearEquiv.ofBijective φ hφ).lTensor M).toLinearMap := by
    rw [LinearEquiv.coe_lTensor]
    rfl
  rw [h]
  exact LinearEquiv.bijective _

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.lTensor_map_wedgeLin_eq_zero
statement:
lemma lTensor_map_wedgeLin_eq_zero {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (f : K →ₗ[R] F) (g : F →ₗ[R] Q) (hgf : ∀ k, g (f k) = 0) (j : ℕ) (h : 1 + j = j + 1)
    (y : M ⊗[R] (⋀[R]^1 K ⊗[R] ⋀[R]^j F)) :
    LinearMap.lTensor M (exteriorPower.map (j + 1) g)
      (LinearMap.lTensor M (wedgeLin f 1 j (j + 1) h) y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← LinearMap.lTensor_comp]
  have h0 : exteriorPower.map (j + 1) g ∘ₗ wedgeLin f 1 j (j + 1) h = 0 :=
    LinearMap.ext fun z => map_wedgeLin_eq_zero f g hgf 0 j (j + 1) h z
  rw [h0, LinearMap.lTensor_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.exact_lTensor_wedgeLin_one
statement:
lemma exact_lTensor_wedgeLin_one (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (f : K →ₗ[R] F) (r : F →ₗ[R] K) (s : Q →ₗ[R] F) (g : F →ₗ[R] Q)
    (hdec : ∀ y, y = f (r y) + s (g y)) (hgs : ∀ q, g (s q) = q) (hgf : ∀ k, g (f k) = 0)
    (m : ℕ) (h : 1 + m = m + 1) :
    Function.Exact (LinearMap.lTensor M (wedgeLin f 1 m (m + 1) h))
      (LinearMap.lTensor M (exteriorPower.map (m + 1) g))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := exact_wedgeLin_one f r s g hdec hgs hgf m h
  have h2 : Function.Surjective (exteriorPower.map (m + 1) g) :=
    exteriorPower.map_surjective fun q => ⟨s q, hgs q⟩
  exact lTensor_exact (M := ⋀[R]^1 K ⊗[R] ⋀[R]^m F) (N := ⋀[R]^(m + 1) F)
    (P := ⋀[R]^(m + 1) Q) M h1 h2

name: ProjectiveBundleAR3.twist_isFinitePresentation
statement:
theorem twist_isFinitePresentation (F : C.scheme.Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] (d : ℤ) :
    (twist C F d).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:=
  SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohQ.fp_of_iso (tensorSheafSymmetry C.scheme _ _)
    (tensorSheaf_isCoherentLike C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf d) F
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree d) ‹F.IsFinitePresentation›)

name: ProjectiveBundleAR3.chart_isZero_coh
statement:
theorem chart_isZero_coh [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (i : C.I) {n : ℕ}
    (e : C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1)) (G : C.scheme.Modules) [G.IsFinitePresentation] (k : ℕ)
    (h : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification C.toBase G k)) :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n)
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e)).obj G) k)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, C.U i) :=
    IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨C.U i, C.isAffine i⟩
  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e)).obj
    G).IsFinitePresentation := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor _ G
  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e)).obj
    G).IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  exact SchemeProjectiveSpace.RegularityChart.isZero_of_topH _ n _ k
    (BundleRegularity.chart_topH_subsingleton C i e G k h)

name: ProjectiveBundleAR3.chartRegular_coh
statement:
theorem chartRegular_coh [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (i : C.I) {n : ℕ}
    (e : C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1)) (F : C.scheme.Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] (m : ℤ)
    (hreg : IsMumfordRegular C F m) :
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.IsMumfordRegular Γ(X, C.U i) n
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e)).obj F) m
proof:
:= fun q hq ↦ by
  haveI := twist_isFinitePresentation C F (m - q)
  exact SchemeProjectiveSpace.Quillen.R_iso _ n (BundleRegularity.twistIso C i e F (m - q)) q
    (chart_isZero_coh C i e _ q (hreg q hq))

name: ProjectiveBundleAR3.restrict_counit_epi_coh
statement:
theorem restrict_counit_epi_coh [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (i : C.I) {n : ℕ}
    (e : C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1)) (F : C.scheme.Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hreg : IsMumfordRegular C F 0) :
    Epi ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e)).map (quillenCounit C F))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, C.U i) :=
    IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨C.U i, C.isAffine i⟩
  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e)).obj
    F).IsFinitePresentation := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor _ F
  exact BundleRegularity.epi_of_counit_fac
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction C.toBase)
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n))
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.isAffine i).fromSpec)
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e)) (BundleRegularity.BC C i e) F
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.CohReg.epi_counit_of_isMumfordRegular Γ(X, C.U i) n _
      (chartRegular_coh C i e F 0 hreg))

name: ProjectiveBundleAR3.epi_counit_of_isMumfordRegular_coh
statement:
theorem epi_counit_of_isMumfordRegular_coh [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    (F : C.scheme.Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] (hreg : IsMumfordRegular C F 0) :
    Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction C.toBase).counit.app F)
proof:
:= by
  choose nr er using BundleRegularity.hrank C hpos
  refine BundleRegularity.epi_of_restrict _
    (fun i ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.space Γ(X, C.U i) (nr i))
    (fun i ↦ standardChartEmb C i (er i).some) ?_
    (fun i ↦ restrict_counit_epi_coh C i (er i).some F hreg)
  intro x
  have hx : C.toBase x ∈ (⨆ i, C.U i : X.Opens) := by
    rw [C.covers]
    trivial
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.1 hx
  have hx' : x ∈ ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) (nr i) ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤).ι ≫
      standardChartEmb C i (er i).some).opensRange := by
    rw [standardChartEmb_opensRange_top]
    exact hi
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hx'
  exact ⟨i, (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) (nr i) ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤).ι w,
    by rw [← hw, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]⟩

name: ProjectiveBundleAR3.exists_epi_counit_twist
statement:
theorem exists_epi_counit_twist [IsNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    {N : ℕ} (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N)
    (G : C.scheme.Modules) [G.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ m : ℤ, Epi (quillenCounit C (twist C G m)) ∧
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.toBase).obj (twist C G m)).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_isMumfordRegular_of_isFinitePresentation C hpos G
  haveI := twist_isFinitePresentation C G m
  refine ⟨m, epi_counit_of_isMumfordRegular_coh C hpos _
    ((isMumfordRegular_twist_iff C hpos G m).1 hm), ?_⟩
  exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation X.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
    (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationZeroIso C.toBase (twist C G m))
    (higherDirectImage_isFinitePresentation hrank (twist C G m) 0)

name: ProjectiveBundleAR3.hasCovers_projectiveBundle
statement:
theorem hasCovers_projectiveBundle [IsNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    {N : ℕ} (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N)
    (hX : ResolutionAmbientAR2.HasCovers X) : ResolutionAmbientAR2.HasCovers C.scheme
proof:
:= by
  intro G hG
  haveI := hG
  obtain ⟨m, hε, hfp⟩ := exists_epi_counit_twist C hpos hrank G
  obtain ⟨T, hT, g, hg⟩ := hX _ hfp
  haveI := hg
  haveI := hε
  let L := C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (-m)
  have hL : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme L := C.canonicalTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree _
  have hP := pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global C.toBase T hT
  let R := tensorSheafRightFunctor C.scheme L
  haveI := tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits C.scheme L hL
  haveI : R.PreservesEpimorphisms := preservesEpimorphisms_of_preservesColimitsOfShape R
  let e0 : R.obj (twist C G m) ≅ G :=
    twistTwistIso C hpos G m (-m) 0 (by ring) ≪≫ twistZeroIso C G
  refine ⟨tensorSheaf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj T) L,
    tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme _ _ hP hL,
    R.map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).map g ≫ quillenCounit C (twist C G m)) ≫ e0.hom, ?_⟩
  haveI : Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).map g ≫ quillenCounit C (twist C G m)) :=
    epi_comp _ _
  have hRε : Epi (R.map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).map g ≫
      quillenCounit C (twist C G m))) := Functor.map_epi R _
  exact epi_comp' hRε (inferInstance : Epi e0.hom)

name: ProjectiveBundleAR3.ringKrullDim_sections_coordinateOpen_le_of
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_sections_coordinateOpen_le_of (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 1)) {d : ℕ} (hR : ringKrullDim R ≤ d) :
    ringKrullDim Γ(SchemeProjectiveSpace.space R n, SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOpen R n j)
      ≤ ((d + n : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (coordinateSectionsEquiv R n j),
    MvPolynomial.ringKrullDim_of_isNoetherianRing]
  have : Nat.card (SchemeProjectiveSpace.AffineChartIndex n j) = n := by
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype_compl]
    simp
  rw [this]
  push_cast
  exact add_le_add_left hR _

name: ProjectiveBundleAR3.finiteDimAffineCover_projectiveBundle
statement:
theorem finiteDimAffineCover_projectiveBundle [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) {N : ℕ} (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N) {d : ℕ}
    (hd : ∀ i, ringKrullDim Γ(X, C.U i) ≤ d) :
    ResolutionAmbientAR2.FiniteDimAffineCover C.scheme (d + N)
proof:
:= by
  choose nr er using BundleRegularity.hrank C hpos
  have hnr : ∀ i, nr i ≤ N := fun i ↦ by
    obtain ⟨n', hn', hn'N, ⟨e'⟩⟩ := hrank i
    have h1 := Nat.card_congr e'
    have h2 := Nat.card_congr (er i).some
    simp only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fin] at h1 h2
    omega
  let f : ∀ i, SchemeProjectiveSpace.space Γ(X, C.U i) (nr i) ⟶ C.scheme :=
    fun i ↦ standardChartEmb C i (er i).some
  let W : (Σ i : C.I, Fin (nr i + 1)) → C.scheme.Opens :=
    fun p ↦ f p.1 ''ᵁ SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOpen Γ(X, C.U p.1) (nr p.1) p.2
  refine ⟨Σ i : C.I, Fin (nr i + 1), W, ?_, fun p ↦ ?_, fun p ↦ ?_⟩
  · refine top_le_iff.mp (fun x _ ↦ ?_)
    have hx : C.toBase x ∈ (⨆ i, C.U i : X.Opens) := by
      rw [C.covers]
      trivial
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.1 hx
    have hx' : x ∈ ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) (nr i) ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤).ι ≫
        standardChartEmb C i (er i).some).opensRange := by
      rw [standardChartEmb_opensRange_top]
      exact hi
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hx'
    have hw' : f i ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) (nr i) ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤).ι w) = x := by
      rw [← hw, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    have hwc : (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) (nr i) ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤).ι w ∈
        (⨆ k : Fin (nr i + 1),
          SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (nr i) k) := by
      rw [SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top]
      trivial
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.1 hwc
    refine TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨⟨i, k⟩, ?_⟩
    exact ⟨_, hk, hw'⟩
  · exact (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOpen_isAffine _ _ p.2).image_of_isOpenImmersion (f p.1)
  · haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, C.U p.1) :=
      IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨C.U p.1, C.isAffine p.1⟩
    rw [ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv ((f p.1).appIso
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOpen Γ(X, C.U p.1) (nr p.1) p.2)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv]
    refine (ringKrullDim_sections_coordinateOpen_le_of _ _ p.2 (hd p.1)).trans ?_
    exact_mod_cast Nat.add_le_add_left (hnr p.1) d

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.projectiveBundleRelationLower_degree_lt
statement:
theorem projectiveBundleRelationLower_degree_lt (a : Fin r → A) :
    (projectiveBundleRelationLower A r a).degree < r
proof:
:= by
  exact degree_sum_fin_lt a

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.projectiveBundleRelationPolynomial_isMonicOfDegree
statement:
theorem projectiveBundleRelationPolynomial_isMonicOfDegree
    [Nontrivial A] (a : Fin r → A) :
    (projectiveBundleRelationPolynomial A r a).IsMonicOfDegree r
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hr : r = 0
  · subst r
    simp [projectiveBundleRelationPolynomial, projectiveBundleRelationLower]
  · refine (isMonicOfDegree_X_pow A r).add_right ?_
    let q := projectiveBundleRelationLower A r a
    change q.natDegree < r
    by_cases hq : q = 0
    · rw [hq, natDegree_zero]
      exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hr
    · exact (natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hq).2
        (projectiveBundleRelationLower_degree_lt A r a)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.projectiveBundleRelationPolynomial_monic
statement:
theorem projectiveBundleRelationPolynomial_monic
    [Nontrivial A] (a : Fin r → A) :
    (projectiveBundleRelationPolynomial A r a).Monic
proof:
:=
  (projectiveBundleRelationPolynomial_isMonicOfDegree A r a).monic

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.projectiveBundleRelationPolynomial_natDegree
statement:
theorem projectiveBundleRelationPolynomial_natDegree
    [Nontrivial A] (a : Fin r → A) :
    (projectiveBundleRelationPolynomial A r a).natDegree = r
proof:
:=
  (projectiveBundleRelationPolynomial_isMonicOfDegree A r a).natDegree_eq

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.ProjectiveBundleFormulaModel.basis_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem basis_apply (i : Fin r) :
    basis A r a i = xi A r a ^ (i : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [basis, xi]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.ProjectiveBundleFormulaModel.coefficientEquiv_ofCoefficients
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coefficientEquiv_ofCoefficients (c : Fin r →₀ A) :
    coefficientEquiv A r a (ofCoefficients A r a c) = c
proof:
:=
  (coefficientEquiv A r a).apply_symm_apply c

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.ProjectiveBundleFormulaModel.ofCoefficients_coefficientEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofCoefficients_coefficientEquiv
    (x : ProjectiveBundleFormulaModel A r a) :
    ofCoefficients A r a (coefficientEquiv A r a x) = x
proof:
:=
  (coefficientEquiv A r a).symm_apply_apply x

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.ProjectiveBundleFormulaModel.sum_coefficients
statement:
theorem sum_coefficients (x : ProjectiveBundleFormulaModel A r a) :
    ∑ i : Fin r,
        coefficientEquiv A r a x i • xi A r a ^ (i : ℕ) =
      x
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [coefficientEquiv, basis_apply] using
    (basis A r a).sum_repr x

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.ProjectiveBundleFormulaModel.algebraMap_injective
statement:
theorem algebraMap_injective (hr : 0 < r) :
    Function.Injective
      (algebraMap A (ProjectiveBundleFormulaModel A r a))
proof:
:= by
  let i0 : Fin r := ⟨0, hr⟩
  intro x y hxy
  have hsmul :
      x • basis A r a i0 = y • basis A r a i0 := by
    simpa [basis_apply, i0, Algebra.smul_def] using hxy
  have hcoord := congrArg
    (fun z ↦ (basis A r a).repr z i0) hsmul
  simp only [map_smul] at hcoord
  simpa only [Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.smul_apply,
    Finsupp.single_eq_same,
    smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using hcoord

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.ProjectiveBundleFormulaModel.aeval_relation
statement:
theorem aeval_relation :
    aeval (xi A r a) (projectiveBundleRelationPolynomial A r a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact AdjoinRoot.eval₂_root (projectiveBundleRelationPolynomial A r a)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.ProjectiveBundleFormulaModel.xi_pow_rank
statement:
theorem xi_pow_rank :
    xi A r a ^ r =
      -∑ i : Fin r, algebraMap A (ProjectiveBundleFormulaModel A r a) (a i) *
        xi A r a ^ (i : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := aeval_relation A r a
  simp only [projectiveBundleRelationPolynomial,
    projectiveBundleRelationLower, map_add, aeval_X_pow,
    map_sum, aeval_mul, aeval_C] at h
  exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.ProjectiveBundleFormulaModel.lift_xi
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_xi
    {B : Type v} [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    (y : B)
    (hy : aeval y (projectiveBundleRelationPolynomial A r a) = 0) :
    lift A r a y hy (xi A r a) = y
proof:
:= by
  exact AdjoinRoot.liftAlgHom_root _ _ _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.ProjectiveBundleFormulaModel.lift_unique
statement:
theorem lift_unique
    {B : Type v} [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    (y : B)
    (hy : aeval y (projectiveBundleRelationPolynomial A r a) = 0)
    (f : ProjectiveBundleFormulaModel A r a →ₐ[A] B)
    (hf : f (xi A r a) = y) :
    f = lift A r a y hy
proof:
:= by
  apply AdjoinRoot.algHom_ext
  change f (xi A r a) = lift A r a y hy (xi A r a)
  rw [hf, lift_xi]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.ProjectiveBundleFormulaModel.lift_bijective_of_basis
statement:
theorem lift_bijective_of_basis
    {B : Type v} [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    (y : B)
    (hy : aeval y (projectiveBundleRelationPolynomial A r a) = 0)
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin r) A B)
    (hb : ∀ i : Fin r, b i = y ^ (i : ℕ)) :
    Function.Bijective (lift A r a y hy)
proof:
:= by
  let e :
      ProjectiveBundleFormulaModel A r a ≃ₗ[A] B :=
    (coefficientEquiv A r a).trans b.repr.symm
  have he :
      (lift A r a y hy).toLinearMap = e.toLinearMap := by
    apply (basis A r a).ext
    intro i
    change lift A r a y hy (basis A r a i) = e (basis A r a i)
    conv_lhs => rw [basis_apply]
    rw [map_pow, lift_xi, ← hb i]
    change b i =
      b.repr.symm ((basis A r a).repr (basis A r a i))
    rw [(basis A r a).repr_self, b.repr_symm_single_one]
  change Function.Bijective (lift A r a y hy).toLinearMap
  rw [he]
  exact e.bijective

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.ProjectiveBundleFormulaModel.algebraMap_injective_of_power_basis
statement:
theorem algebraMap_injective_of_power_basis
    {B : Type v} [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    (hr : 0 < r)
    (y : B)
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin r) A B)
    (hb : ∀ i : Fin r, b i = y ^ (i : ℕ)) :
    Function.Injective (algebraMap A B)
proof:
:= by
  let i0 : Fin r := ⟨0, hr⟩
  intro x z hxz
  have hsmul :
      x • b i0 = z • b i0 := by
    rw [hb i0]
    simpa [i0, Algebra.smul_def] using hxz
  have hcoord := congrArg (fun w ↦ b.repr w i0) hsmul
  simpa using hcoord

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.ProjectiveBundleFormulaModel.equivOfBasis_xi
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equivOfBasis_xi
    {B : Type v} [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    (y : B)
    (hy : aeval y (projectiveBundleRelationPolynomial A r a) = 0)
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin r) A B)
    (hb : ∀ i : Fin r, b i = y ^ (i : ℕ)) :
    equivOfBasis A r a y hy b hb (xi A r a) = y
proof:
:= by
  exact lift_xi A r a y hy

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.chernXi_pow_rank
statement:
theorem chernXi_pow_rank [Nontrivial A] (c : Fin r → A) :
    chernXi A r c ^ r =
      -∑ i : Fin r,
        algebraMap A (ChernProjectiveBundleFormulaModel A r c)
            ((-1 : A) ^ ((Fin.rev i : ℕ) + 1) * c (Fin.rev i)) *
          chernXi A r c ^ (i : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  exact ProjectiveBundleFormulaModel.xi_pow_rank A r
    (chernRelationCoefficients A r c)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.chernBasis_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chernBasis_apply [Nontrivial A] (c : Fin r → A) (i : Fin r) :
    chernBasis A r c i = chernXi A r c ^ (i : ℕ)
proof:
:=
  ProjectiveBundleFormulaModel.basis_apply A r
    (chernRelationCoefficients A r c) i

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.CommonBasicOpen.inIntersection_mul
statement:
theorem inIntersection_mul (c d : CommonBasicOpen U V) :
    (c.mul d).inIntersection = c.inIntersection ⊓ d.inIntersection
proof:
:= by
  change (U.1 ⊓ V.1).ι ⁻¹ᵁ X.basicOpen (c.left * d.left) =
    (U.1 ⊓ V.1).ι ⁻¹ᵁ X.basicOpen c.left ⊓
      (U.1 ⊓ V.1).ι ⁻¹ᵁ X.basicOpen d.left
  rw [Scheme.basicOpen_mul, Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf]

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.CommonBasicOpen.baseCover_opensRange
statement:
theorem baseCover_opensRange (c : CommonBasicOpen U V) :
    ((baseCover U V).f c).opensRange = c.inIntersection
proof:

    c.inIntersection.opensRange_ι

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.CommonBasicOpen.baseCover_mul_opensRange
statement:
theorem baseCover_mul_opensRange (c d : CommonBasicOpen U V) :
    ((baseCover U V).f (c.mul d)).opensRange =
      ((baseCover U V).f c).opensRange ⊓ ((baseCover U V).f d).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  rw [baseCover_opensRange, baseCover_opensRange, baseCover_opensRange,
    inIntersection_mul]

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenOverlapCover_mul_opensRange
statement:
theorem basicOpenOverlapCover_mul_opensRange
    (U V : X.affineOpens) (c d : CommonBasicOpen U V) :
    ((basicOpenOverlapCover I U V).f (c.mul d)).opensRange =
      ((basicOpenOverlapCover I U V).f c).opensRange ⊓
        ((basicOpenOverlapCover I U V).f d).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  change (pullback.fst (overlapToIntersection I U V)
      ((CommonBasicOpen.baseCover U V).f (c.mul d))).opensRange =
    (pullback.fst (overlapToIntersection I U V)
      ((CommonBasicOpen.baseCover U V).f c)).opensRange ⊓
    (pullback.fst (overlapToIntersection I U V)
      ((CommonBasicOpen.baseCover U V).f d)).opensRange
  rw [Scheme.Hom.opensRange_pullbackFst, Scheme.Hom.opensRange_pullbackFst,
    Scheme.Hom.opensRange_pullbackFst, CommonBasicOpen.baseCover_mul_opensRange,
    Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf]

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenOverlapCover_mul_range
statement:
theorem basicOpenOverlapCover_mul_range
    (U V : X.affineOpens) (c d : CommonBasicOpen U V) :

      Set.range ((basicOpenOverlapCover I U V).f c) ∩
        Set.range ((basicOpenOverlapCover I U V).f d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.coe_opensRange, basicOpenOverlapCover_mul_opensRange]
