name: SchemeReesAlgebra.AffineOverlapComparison.trans_symm
statement:
theorem trans_symm (c : AffineOverlapComparison K L) :
    c.trans c.symm = refl K
proof:
:= by
  rcases c with ⟨e, h⟩
  simp [symm, trans, refl]

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.AffineOverlapComparison.projIso_symm
statement:
theorem projIso_symm (c : AffineOverlapComparison K L) :
    c.symm.projIso = c.projIso.symm
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  apply (cancel_mono c.projIso.hom).mp
  have h := congrArg Iso.hom (projIso_cocycle c c.symm)
  rw [trans_symm, projIso_refl] at h
  simpa only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.refl_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.inv_hom_id] using h.symm

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.AffineOverlapComparison.projIso_inv_comp_eqToHom_changeTarget
statement:
theorem projIso_inv_comp_eqToHom_changeTarget {M : Ideal S}
    (c : AffineOverlapComparison K L) (h : L = M) :
    c.projIso.inv ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg
          (fun J : Ideal S ↦ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading J)) h) =
      (c.changeTarget h).projIso.inv
proof:
:= by
  rcases c with ⟨e, he⟩
  subst L
  subst M
  rfl

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenComparisonMulNormalized_projIso_inv
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem basicOpenComparisonMulNormalized_projIso_inv
    (U : X.affineOpens) (f g : Γ(X, U.1)) :
    (basicOpenComparisonMul I U f g).projIso.inv ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg
          (fun J : Ideal (Localization.Away
              (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) g)) ↦
            AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading J))
          (localizedIdeal_basicOpenComparisonMul I U f g)) =
      (basicOpenComparisonMulNormalized I U f g).projIso.inv
proof:
:= by
  exact AffineOverlapComparison.projIso_inv_comp_eqToHom_changeTarget
    (basicOpenComparisonMul I U f g) (localizedIdeal_basicOpenComparisonMul I U f g)

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenMulRestrictionComparison_projIso_hom
statement:
theorem basicOpenMulRestrictionComparison_projIso_hom
    (U : X.affineOpens) (f g : Γ(X, U.1)) :
    (basicOpenMulRestrictionComparison I U f g).projIso.hom =
      (basicOpenComparison I U (f * g)).projIso.hom ≫
        (basicOpenComparisonMulNormalized I U f g).projIso.inv
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg Iso.hom (AffineOverlapComparison.projIso_cocycle
    (basicOpenComparisonMulNormalized I U f g).symm (basicOpenComparison I U (f * g)))
  have hs := AffineOverlapComparison.projIso_symm (basicOpenComparisonMulNormalized I U f g)
  exact h.trans (congrArg
    (fun e ↦ (basicOpenComparison I U (f * g)).projIso.hom ≫ e.hom) hs)

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenChartMapMulTo_eq_comparison
statement:
theorem basicOpenChartMapMulTo_eq_comparison
    (U : X.affineOpens) (f g : Γ(X, U.1)) :
    basicOpenChartMapMulTo I U f g =
      (basicOpenMulRestrictionComparison I U f g).projIso.hom ≫
        reesProjMap (I.ideal (X.affineBasicOpen f))
          (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) g)
proof:
:= by
  have hN := basicOpenComparisonMulNormalized_projIso_inv I U f g
  have h1 := basicOpenMulRestrictionComparison_projIso_hom I U f g
  unfold basicOpenChartMapMulTo
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (congrArg (· ≫ _) h1).symm
  refine (congrArg (fun m ↦ _ ≫ m) (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm).trans ?_
  refine (congrArg (fun m ↦ _ ≫ m ≫ _) hN).trans ?_
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenMulRestrictionComparison_comp_algebraMap
statement:
theorem basicOpenMulRestrictionComparison_comp_algebraMap
    (U : X.affineOpens) (f g : Γ(X, U.1)) :
    (basicOpenMulRestrictionComparison I U f g).sectionsEquiv.toRingHom.comp
        (algebraMap Γ(X, X.basicOpen f)
          (Localization.Away (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) g))) =
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (by
        change X.basicOpen (f * g) ≤ X.basicOpen f
        rw [Scheme.basicOpen_mul]
        exact inf_le_left)).op).hom
proof:
:= by
  letI := U.2.isLocalization_basicOpen f
  apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers f)
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro x
  change (basicOpenComparison I U (f * g)).sectionsEquiv
      ((basicOpenComparisonMul I U f g).sectionsEquiv.symm
        (algebraMap Γ(X, X.basicOpen f)
          (Localization.Away (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) g))
          (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) x))) =
    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (by
      change X.basicOpen (f * g) ≤ X.basicOpen f
      rw [Scheme.basicOpen_mul]
      exact inf_le_left)).op).hom
      (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) x)
  have hmul := RingHom.congr_fun
    (awayMulEquivOfIsLocalization_comp_algebraMap
      (S := Γ(X, X.basicOpen f)) f g) x
  rw [show algebraMap Γ(X, X.basicOpen f)
      (Localization.Away (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) g))
      (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) x) =
      (basicOpenComparisonMul I U f g).sectionsEquiv
        (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) (Localization.Away (f * g)) x) from hmul.symm]
  rw [RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  change basicOpenSectionsEquiv U (f * g)
      (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) (Localization.Away (f * g)) x) = _
  rw [basicOpenSectionsEquiv_algebraMap]
  change algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen (f * g)) x =
    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (by
      change X.basicOpen (f * g) ≤ X.basicOpen f
      rw [Scheme.basicOpen_mul]
      exact inf_le_left)).op).hom
      ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op).hom x)
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.restrictionComparison_heq
statement:
theorem restrictionComparison_heq
    {C C' E E' : X.affineOpens} (hC : C = C') (hE : E = E')
    {a : Γ(X, C.1)} {a' : Γ(X, C'.1)}
    (hEC : E.1 ≤ C.1) (hE'C' : E'.1 ≤ C'.1)
    (c : AffineOverlapComparison (localizedIdeal (I.ideal C) a) (I.ideal E))
    (c' : AffineOverlapComparison (localizedIdeal (I.ideal C') a') (I.ideal E'))
    (hc : c.sectionsEquiv.toRingHom.comp
        (algebraMap Γ(X, C.1) (Localization.Away a)) =
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hEC).op).hom)
    (hc' : c'.sectionsEquiv.toRingHom.comp
        (algebraMap Γ(X, C'.1) (Localization.Away a')) =
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hE'C').op).hom) :
    HEq (c.projIso.hom ≫ reesProjMap (I.ideal C) a)
      (c'.projIso.hom ≫ reesProjMap (I.ideal C') a')
proof:
:= by
  subst C'
  subst E'
  have hcomp : c.sectionsEquiv.toRingHom.comp
        (algebraMap Γ(X, C.1) (Localization.Away a)) =
      c'.sectionsEquiv.toRingHom.comp
        (algebraMap Γ(X, C.1) (Localization.Away a')) :=
    hc.trans hc'.symm
  have hval : ∀ p : reesAlgebra (I.ideal C),
      ((((gradedReesEquivHom c.sectionsEquiv
          (localizedIdeal (I.ideal C) a)).comp
        (gradedLocalizationMap (I.ideal C) a)) p :
          reesAlgebra ((localizedIdeal (I.ideal C) a).map
            c.sectionsEquiv.toRingHom)) : Polynomial Γ(X, E.1)) =
      ((((gradedReesEquivHom c'.sectionsEquiv
          (localizedIdeal (I.ideal C) a')).comp
        (gradedLocalizationMap (I.ideal C) a')) p :
          reesAlgebra ((localizedIdeal (I.ideal C) a').map
            c'.sectionsEquiv.toRingHom)) : Polynomial Γ(X, E.1)) := by
    intro p
    change Polynomial.map c.sectionsEquiv.toRingHom
        (Polynomial.map (algebraMap Γ(X, C.1) (Localization.Away a))
          (p : Polynomial Γ(X, C.1))) =
      Polynomial.map c'.sectionsEquiv.toRingHom
        (Polynomial.map (algebraMap Γ(X, C.1) (Localization.Away a'))
          (p : Polynomial Γ(X, C.1)))
    rw [Polynomial.map_map, Polynomial.map_map, hcomp]
  have hraw := Proj_map_heq_of_pointwise_eq
    (c.map_ideal.trans c'.map_ideal.symm)
    ((gradedReesEquivHom c.sectionsEquiv (localizedIdeal (I.ideal C) a)).comp
      (gradedLocalizationMap (I.ideal C) a))
    ((gradedReesEquivHom c'.sectionsEquiv (localizedIdeal (I.ideal C) a')).comp
      (gradedLocalizationMap (I.ideal C) a'))
    hval
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp
      (irrelevant_le_map_gradedLocalizationMap (I.ideal C) a)
      (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivHom c.sectionsEquiv
        (localizedIdeal (I.ideal C) a)))
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp
      (irrelevant_le_map_gradedLocalizationMap (I.ideal C) a')
      (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivHom c'.sectionsEquiv
        (localizedIdeal (I.ideal C) a')))
  exact (AffineOverlapComparison.heq_projIso_hom_comp_reesProjMap
      (I.ideal C) a c).trans
    (hraw.trans
      (AffineOverlapComparison.heq_projIso_hom_comp_reesProjMap
        (I.ideal C) a' c').symm)

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenChartMapMulTo_heq_of_affineOpen_eq
statement:
theorem basicOpenChartMapMulTo_heq_of_affineOpen_eq
    (U V : X.affineOpens) (f g : Γ(X, U.1)) (f' g' : Γ(X, V.1))
    (hC : X.affineBasicOpen f = X.affineBasicOpen f')
    (hE : X.affineBasicOpen (f * g) = X.affineBasicOpen (f' * g')) :
    HEq (basicOpenChartMapMulTo I U f g)
      (basicOpenChartMapMulTo I V f' g')
proof:
:= by
  let c := basicOpenMulRestrictionComparison I U f g
  let c' := basicOpenMulRestrictionComparison I V f' g'
  have hcore := restrictionComparison_heq I hC hE
    (by
      change X.basicOpen (f * g) ≤ X.basicOpen f
      rw [Scheme.basicOpen_mul]
      exact inf_le_left)
    (by
      change X.basicOpen (f' * g') ≤ X.basicOpen f'
      rw [Scheme.basicOpen_mul]
      exact inf_le_left)
    c c'
    (basicOpenMulRestrictionComparison_comp_algebraMap I U f g)
    (basicOpenMulRestrictionComparison_comp_algebraMap I V f' g')
  exact (heq_of_eq (basicOpenChartMapMulTo_eq_comparison I U f g)).trans
    (hcore.trans
      (heq_of_eq (basicOpenChartMapMulTo_eq_comparison I V f' g')).symm)

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.comp_eqToHom_of_heq_both
statement:
theorem comp_eqToHom_of_heq_both {A B A' B' : Scheme.{u}}
    (hA : A = A') (hB : B = B') (φ : A ⟶ B) (φ' : A' ⟶ B')
    (hφ : HEq φ φ') :
    φ ≫ eqToHom hB = eqToHom hA ≫ φ'
proof:
:= by
  subst A'
  subst B'
  rw [eq_of_heq hφ]
  simp

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.comp_eqToIso_inv_of_heq_both
statement:
theorem comp_eqToIso_inv_of_heq_both {A B A' B' : Scheme.{u}}
    (hA : A' = A) (hB : B' = B) (φ : A ⟶ B) (φ' : A' ⟶ B')
    (hφ : HEq φ φ') :
    φ ≫ (eqToIso hB).inv = (eqToIso hA).inv ≫ φ'
proof:
:= by
  subst A'
  subst B'
  rw [eq_of_heq hφ]
  simp

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.CommonBasicOpen.mulToLeft_comp_rightChartMap
statement:
theorem mulToLeft_comp_rightChartMap (c d : CommonBasicOpen U V) :
    mulToLeft I c d ≫ rightChartMap I c = rightChartMap I (c.mul d)
proof:
:= by
  have hrest := basicOpenChartMapMulTo_heq_of_affineOpen_eq I U V
    c.left d.left c.right d.right c.swap_affineOpen.symm
      (c.mul d).swap_affineOpen.symm
  have htransport := comp_eqToIso_inv_of_heq_both
    (congrArg (chart I) (c.mul d).swap_affineOpen)
    (congrArg (chart I) c.swap_affineOpen)
    (basicOpenChartMapMulTo I U c.left d.left)
    (basicOpenChartMapMulTo I V c.right d.right) hrest
  unfold mulToLeft rightChartMap
  rw [← Category.assoc, htransport, Category.assoc]
  rw [basicOpenChartMapMulTo_comp]
  rfl

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.CommonBasicOpen.mulToSecond_comp
statement:
theorem mulToSecond_comp (c d : CommonBasicOpen U V) :
    mulToSecond I c d ≫ basicOpenChartMap I U d.left =
      basicOpenChartMap I U (c.mul d).left
proof:
:= by
  unfold mulToSecond
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [basicOpenChartMapMulTo_comp,
    eqToHom_comp_basicOpenChartMap_of_eq I U (mul_comm c.left d.left)]
  rfl

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.CommonBasicOpen.mulToSecond_eq_mulToRight
statement:
theorem mulToSecond_eq_mulToRight (c d : CommonBasicOpen U V) :
    mulToSecond I c d = mulToRight I c d
proof:
:= by
  let iA := eqToIso (congrArg (chart I) (d.mul c).swap_affineOpen)
  let iB := eqToIso (congrArg (chart I) d.swap_affineOpen)
  have hrest := basicOpenChartMapMulTo_heq_of_affineOpen_eq I U V
    d.left c.left d.right c.right d.swap_affineOpen.symm
      (d.mul c).swap_affineOpen.symm
  have htransport := comp_eqToIso_inv_of_heq_both
    (congrArg (chart I) (d.mul c).swap_affineOpen)
    (congrArg (chart I) d.swap_affineOpen)
    (basicOpenChartMapMulTo I U d.left c.left)
    (basicOpenChartMapMulTo I V d.right c.right) hrest
  change basicOpenChartMapMulTo I U d.left c.left ≫ iB.inv =
    iA.inv ≫ basicOpenChartMapMulTo I V d.right c.right at htransport
  have hmap :
      basicOpenChartMapMulTo I U d.left c.left =
        iA.inv ≫ basicOpenChartMapMulTo I V d.right c.right ≫ iB.hom := by
    calc
      basicOpenChartMapMulTo I U d.left c.left =
          basicOpenChartMapMulTo I U d.left c.left ≫ iB.inv ≫ iB.hom := by
            rw [Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
      _ = iA.inv ≫ basicOpenChartMapMulTo I V d.right c.right ≫ iB.hom := by
        rw [← Category.assoc, htransport, Category.assoc]
  have hsource :
      eqToHom (congrArg
          (fun f ↦ chart I (X.affineBasicOpen f)) (mul_comm c.left d.left)) ≫ iA.inv =
        eqToHom (congrArg (chart I) (mulRightAffineOpen_eq c d)) := by
    unfold iA
    change eqToHom (congrArg
        (fun f ↦ chart I (X.affineBasicOpen f)) (mul_comm c.left d.left)) ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg (chart I) (d.mul c).swap_affineOpen).symm =
        eqToHom (congrArg (chart I) (mulRightAffineOpen_eq c d))
    rw [eqToHom_trans]
  unfold mulToSecond mulToRight
  rw [hmap, ← Category.assoc, hsource]

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.CommonBasicOpen.mulToSecond_comp_rightChartMap
statement:
theorem mulToSecond_comp_rightChartMap (c d : CommonBasicOpen U V) :
    mulToSecond I c d ≫ rightChartMap I d = rightChartMap I (c.mul d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mulToSecond_eq_mulToRight, mulToRight_comp]

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.chartIdentifications_localTransition_overlapToChart
statement:
theorem chartIdentifications_localTransition_overlapToChart
    (U V : X.affineOpens) (c : CommonBasicOpen U V) :
    (chartIdentifications I).localTransition U V c ≫ overlapToChart I V U =
      (commonBasicOpenChartIso I U V c).hom ≫
        CommonBasicOpen.rightChartMap I c
proof:
:= by
  rw [ChartIdentifications.localTransition_eq]
  unfold ChartIdentifications.targetMap ChartIdentifications.targetIso chartIdentifications
  unfold CommonBasicOpen.rightChartMap
  rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, Iso.trans_inv, Category.assoc,
    ← commonBasicOpenChartIso_hom_chartMap, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  rfl

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback_hom_fst_chartIso
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback_hom_fst_chartIso
    (U V : X.affineOpens) (c d : CommonBasicOpen U V) :
    (basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback I U V c d).hom ≫
        pullback.fst ((basicOpenOverlapCover I U V).f c)
          ((basicOpenOverlapCover I U V).f d) ≫
        (commonBasicOpenChartIso I U V c).hom =
      (commonBasicOpenChartIso I U V (c.mul d)).hom ≫
        CommonBasicOpen.mulToLeft I c d
proof:
:= by
  letI : Mono (basicOpenChartMap I U c.left) :=
    (isPullback_basicOpenChartMap I U c.left).mono_fst_of_mono
  apply (cancel_mono (basicOpenChartMap I U c.left)).mp
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [commonBasicOpenChartIso_hom_chartMap,
    basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback_hom_fac_assoc,
    ← commonBasicOpenChartIso_hom_chartMap,
    CommonBasicOpen.mulToLeft_comp]

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback_hom_snd_chartIso
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback_hom_snd_chartIso
    (U V : X.affineOpens) (c d : CommonBasicOpen U V) :
    (basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback I U V c d).hom ≫
        pullback.snd ((basicOpenOverlapCover I U V).f c)
          ((basicOpenOverlapCover I U V).f d) ≫
        (commonBasicOpenChartIso I U V d).hom =
      (commonBasicOpenChartIso I U V (c.mul d)).hom ≫
        CommonBasicOpen.mulToSecond I c d
proof:
:= by
  letI : Mono (basicOpenChartMap I U d.left) :=
    (isPullback_basicOpenChartMap I U d.left).mono_fst_of_mono
  apply (cancel_mono (basicOpenChartMap I U d.left)).mp
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [commonBasicOpenChartIso_hom_chartMap,
    basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback_hom_snd_fac_assoc,
    ← commonBasicOpenChartIso_hom_chartMap,
    CommonBasicOpen.mulToSecond_comp]

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.compatible_step_a
statement:
theorem compatible_step_a (U V : X.affineOpens) (c d : CommonBasicOpen U V) :
    pullback.fst ((basicOpenOverlapCover I U V).f c)
          ((basicOpenOverlapCover I U V).f d) ≫
        (chartIdentifications I).localTransition U V c ≫ overlapToChart I V U =
      pullback.snd ((basicOpenOverlapCover I U V).f c)
          ((basicOpenOverlapCover I U V).f d) ≫
        (chartIdentifications I).localTransition U V d ≫ overlapToChart I V U
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi (basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback I U V c d).hom).mp
  rw [chartIdentifications_localTransition_overlapToChart,
    chartIdentifications_localTransition_overlapToChart]
  rw [basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback_hom_fst_chartIso_assoc,
    basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback_hom_snd_chartIso_assoc,
    CommonBasicOpen.mulToLeft_comp_rightChartMap,
    CommonBasicOpen.mulToSecond_comp_rightChartMap]

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.chartIdentifications_localTransition_compatible
statement:
theorem chartIdentifications_localTransition_compatible
    (U V : X.affineOpens) (c d : CommonBasicOpen U V) :
    pullback.fst ((basicOpenOverlapCover I U V).f c)
          ((basicOpenOverlapCover I U V).f d) ≫
        (chartIdentifications I).localTransition U V c =
      pullback.snd ((basicOpenOverlapCover I U V).f c)
          ((basicOpenOverlapCover I U V).f d) ≫
        (chartIdentifications I).localTransition U V d
proof:
:=
  (IsPullback.of_hasPullback (chartToOpen I V)
    (X.homOfLE (inf_le_left : V.1 ⊓ U.1 ≤ V.1))).hom_ext
    (compatible_step_a I U V c d) (compatible_step_b I U V c d)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateFinsetProd_mem
statement:
theorem coordinateFinsetProd_mem (s : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) :
    coordinateFinsetProd R n s ∈ grading R n s.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    simp only [coordinateFinsetProd, Finset.prod_empty, Finset.card_empty]
    exact SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem
  | insert i s hi ih =>
    simp only [coordinateFinsetProd, Finset.prod_insert hi] at ih ⊢
    rw [show (insert i s).card = 1 + s.card from
        (Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hi).trans (Nat.add_comm s.card 1)]
    exact SetLike.mul_mem_graded (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i) ih

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateFinsetOpen_eq_inf
statement:
theorem coordinateFinsetOpen_eq_inf (s : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) :
    coordinateFinsetOpen R n s = s.inf (coordinateOpen R n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  show Proj.basicOpen (grading R n) (∏ i ∈ s, coordinate R n i) =
    s.inf (fun i => Proj.basicOpen (grading R n) (coordinate R n i))
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    simp only [Finset.prod_empty, Proj.basicOpen_one, Finset.inf_empty]
  | insert i s hi ih =>
    simp only [Finset.prod_insert hi, Finset.inf_insert, Proj.basicOpen_mul]
    rw [← ih]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateFinsetOpen_isAffineOpen
statement:
theorem coordinateFinsetOpen_isAffineOpen
    (s : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (hs : s.Nonempty) :
    IsAffineOpen (coordinateFinsetOpen R n s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateFinsetOpen]
  have hmem : (∏ i ∈ s, coordinate R n i) ∈ grading R n s.card := by
    have := coordinateFinsetProd_mem R n s
    rwa [coordinateFinsetProd] at this
  exact Proj.isAffineOpen_basicOpen (grading R n) (∏ i ∈ s, coordinate R n i)
    hmem (Finset.card_pos.mpr hs)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateFinsetOpen_singleton
statement:
theorem coordinateFinsetOpen_singleton (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateFinsetOpen R n {i} = coordinateOpen R n i
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateFinsetOpen, coordinateOpen, Finset.prod_singleton]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinatePairwise_isAffineOpen
statement:
theorem coordinatePairwise_isAffineOpen (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    IsAffineOpen (coordinateOpen R n i ⊓ coordinateOpen R n j)
proof:
:= by
  show IsAffineOpen (Proj.basicOpen (grading R n) (coordinate R n i) ⊓
    Proj.basicOpen (grading R n) (coordinate R n j))
  rw [← Proj.basicOpen_mul]
  exact Proj.isAffineOpen_basicOpen (grading R n) (coordinate R n i * coordinate R n j)
    (SetLike.mul_mem_graded (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i) (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n j))
    Nat.zero_lt_two

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinatePairwiseOpen_eq_inf
statement:
theorem coordinatePairwiseOpen_eq_inf (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinatePairwiseOpen R n i j = coordinateOpen R n i ⊓ coordinateOpen R n j
proof:
:= by
  show Proj.basicOpen (grading R n) (coordinate R n i * coordinate R n j) =
    Proj.basicOpen (grading R n) (coordinate R n i) ⊓ Proj.basicOpen (grading R n) (coordinate R n j)
  exact Proj.basicOpen_mul (grading R n) (coordinate R n i) (coordinate R n j)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinatePairwiseOpen_isAffineOpen
statement:
theorem coordinatePairwiseOpen_isAffineOpen (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    IsAffineOpen (coordinatePairwiseOpen R n i j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinatePairwiseOpen_eq_inf]
  exact coordinatePairwise_isAffineOpen R n i j

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.restrictScalarsExt_mk
statement:
lemma restrictScalarsExt_mk {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (φ : R →+* S) (N : ModuleCat.{u} S) (k : ℕ)
    (x : Fin k → ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).obj N)) :
    restrictScalarsExt φ N k (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk x) =
      ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (M := N) x
proof:
:=
  ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mapSemilinear_mk _ _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.pushforwardExtApp_mk
statement:
lemma pushforwardExtApp_mk {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (N : X.Modules) (k : ℕ) (U : Y.Opensᵒᵖ)
    (x : Fin k → (underlyingCommPresheaf Y ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj N)).obj U) :
    (pushforwardExtApp f N k U).hom (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk x) =
      (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app
        (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower (underlyingCommPresheaf X N) k)).app
          ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj U)).hom
        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk
          (M := (underlyingCommPresheaf X N).obj ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj U)) x)
proof:
:= by
  change (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app
        (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower (underlyingCommPresheaf X N) k)).app
          ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj U)).hom
      ((restrictScalarsExt (f.app U.unop).hom
        (N.val.obj ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj U)) k).hom (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk x)) = _
  rw [restrictScalarsExt_mk]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.adjUnit_exteriorPowerMap_mk
statement:
lemma adjUnit_exteriorPowerMap_mk (X : Scheme.{u})
    {P Q : PresheafOfModules.{u} (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)}
    (g : P ⟶ Q) (k : ℕ) (V : X.Opensᵒᵖ) (x : Fin k → P.obj V) :
    (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app
        (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower Q k)).app V).hom
        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (fun i ↦ (g.app V).hom (x i))) =
      (((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map ((moduleSheafification X).map
          (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPowerMap g k))).app V).hom
        ((((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app
          (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower P k)).app V).hom
            (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk x))
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun q ↦ (q.app V).hom (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk x))
    ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.naturality
      (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPowerMap g k))
  simp only [Functor.id_map, Functor.comp_map, PresheafOfModules.comp_app] at h
  erw [ModuleCat.hom_comp, ModuleCat.hom_comp] at h
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply] at h
  erw [ModuleCat.exteriorPower.map_mk] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.homEquiv_pushforwardExtHom
statement:
lemma homEquiv_pushforwardExtHom {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (N : X.Modules) (k : ℕ) :
    (moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).homEquiv _ _ (pushforwardExtHom f N k) =
      pushforwardExtPresheafHom f N k
proof:
:=
  Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.pushforwardExtHom_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem pushforwardExtHom_naturality {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    {N N' : X.Modules} (a : N ⟶ N') (k : ℕ) :
    extMap ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map a) k ≫
        pushforwardExtHom f N' k =
      pushforwardExtHom f N k ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map (extMap a k)
proof:
:= by
  apply (moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).homEquiv _ _ |>.injective
  conv_lhs =>
    erw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left]
    erw [homEquiv_pushforwardExtHom]
  conv_rhs =>
    erw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
    erw [homEquiv_pushforwardExtHom]
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro U
  simp only [PresheafOfModules.comp_app]
  apply ModuleCat.exteriorPower.hom_ext
  ext x
  simp only [ModuleCat.AlternatingMap.postcomp_apply]
  change (pushforwardExtApp f N' k U).hom
      (((PresheafOfModules.exteriorPowerMap
        (M := underlyingCommPresheaf Y ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj N))
        (N := underlyingCommPresheaf Y ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj N'))
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map a).val k).app U).hom
          (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk x)) =
    (((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).map ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
      (extMap a k))).app U).hom
        ((pushforwardExtApp f N k U).hom (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk x))
  dsimp only [PresheafOfModules.exteriorPowerMap]
  erw [ModuleCat.exteriorPower.map_mk]
  refine (pushforwardExtApp_mk f N' k U _).trans ?_
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (congrArg _ (pushforwardExtApp_mk f N k U x)).symm
  exact adjUnit_exteriorPowerMap_mk X a.val k ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj U) x

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.extMap_comp
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma extMap_comp {X : Scheme.{u}} {N N' N'' : X.Modules} (a : N ⟶ N') (b : N' ⟶ N'')
    (k : ℕ) : extMap (a ≫ b) k = extMap a k ≫ extMap b k
proof:
:= by
  unfold extMap
  refine Eq.trans ?_ ((moduleSheafification X).map_comp _ _)
  congr 1
  exact (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPowerFunctor k).map_comp
    (X := underlyingCommPresheaf X N) (Y := underlyingCommPresheaf X N')
    (Z := underlyingCommPresheaf X N'') a.val b.val

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.adjUnit_naturality
statement:
lemma adjUnit_naturality {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) {M M' : Y.Modules} (a : M ⟶ M') :
    a ≫ adjUnit f M' =
      adjUnit f M ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map a)
proof:
:=
  ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit_naturality a).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.homEquiv_pullbackExtHom
statement:
lemma homEquiv_pullbackExtHom {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : Y.Modules)
    (k : ℕ) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).homEquiv _ _ (pullbackExteriorPowerHom f M k) =
      extMap (adjUnit f M) k ≫
        pushforwardExtHom f ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M) k
proof:
:=
  Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.pullbackExt_key
statement:
lemma pullbackExt_key {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    {M M' : Y.Modules} (a : M ⟶ M') (k : ℕ) :
    extMap a k ≫ extMap (adjUnit f M') k ≫
        pushforwardExtHom f ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M') k =
      (extMap (adjUnit f M) k ≫
        pushforwardExtHom f ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M) k) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
        (extMap ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map a) k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← extMap_comp_assoc, adjUnit_naturality, extMap_comp_assoc,
    pushforwardExtHom_naturality, Category.assoc]

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.pullbackExteriorPowerHom_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem pullbackExteriorPowerHom_naturality {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    {M M' : Y.Modules} (a : M ⟶ M') (k : ℕ) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map (extMap a k) ≫ pullbackExteriorPowerHom f M' k =
      pullbackExteriorPowerHom f M k ≫ extMap ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map a) k
proof:
:= by
  apply ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).homEquiv _ _).injective
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left, Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right,
    homEquiv_pullbackExtHom, homEquiv_pullbackExtHom]
  exact pullbackExt_key f a k

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.homEquiv_symm_unit_apply
statement:
lemma homEquiv_symm_unit_apply (X : Scheme.{u})
    {P : PresheafOfModules.{u} (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)} {M : X.Modules}
    (φ : P ⟶ (underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).obj M) (V : X.Opensᵒᵖ) (y : P.obj V) :
    (((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map
        (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).homEquiv _ _).symm φ)).app V).hom
      ((((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app P).app V).hom y) = (φ.app V).hom y
proof:
:= by
  have h := (moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).homEquiv_unit P M
    (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).homEquiv _ _).symm φ)
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
  have h' := congrArg (fun q ↦ (q.app V).hom y) h
  simp only [PresheafOfModules.comp_app] at h'
  erw [ModuleCat.hom_comp] at h'
  exact h'.symm

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.extMap_id
statement:
@[simp]
lemma extMap_id {X : Scheme.{u}} (N : X.Modules) (k : ℕ) :
    extMap (𝟙 N) k = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  unfold extMap
  refine Eq.trans ?_ ((moduleSheafification X).map_id _)
  congr 1
  exact (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPowerFunctor k).map_id (underlyingCommPresheaf X N)

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.isIso_of_iso
statement:
lemma isIso_of_iso {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) {M N : Y.Modules} (e : M ≅ N)
    (k : ℕ) (h : IsIso (pullbackExteriorPowerHom f N k)) : IsIso (pullbackExteriorPowerHom f M k)
proof:
:= by
  have hn := pullbackExteriorPowerHom_naturality f e.hom k
  have : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map (extMap e.hom k) ≫
      pullbackExteriorPowerHom f N k) := inferInstance
  rw [hn] at this
  exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right _ (extMap ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map e.hom) k)

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.isIso_congr
statement:
lemma isIso_congr {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {φ ψ : X ⟶ Y} (h : φ = ψ) (M : Y.Modules) (k : ℕ)
    (hφ : IsIso (pullbackExteriorPowerHom φ M k)) : IsIso (pullbackExteriorPowerHom ψ M k)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  exact hφ

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.pushforwardExtHom_comp
statement:
theorem pushforwardExtHom_comp {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ Z)
    (N : X.Modules) (k : ℕ) :
    extMap ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp g h).hom.app N) k ≫
        pushforwardExtHom (g ≫ h) N k ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp g h).inv.app (exteriorPowerSheaf X N k) =
      pushforwardExtHom h ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).obj N) k ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward h).map (pushforwardExtHom g N k)
proof:
:= by
  apply (moduleSheafificationAdjunction Z).homEquiv _ _ |>.injective
  conv_lhs =>
    erw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left]
    erw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
    erw [homEquiv_pushforwardExtHom]
  conv_rhs =>
    erw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
    erw [homEquiv_pushforwardExtHom]
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro U
  simp only [PresheafOfModules.comp_app]
  apply ModuleCat.exteriorPower.hom_ext
  ext x
  simp only [ModuleCat.AlternatingMap.postcomp_apply]
  change (((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Z).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp g h).inv.app (exteriorPowerSheaf X N k))).app U).hom
      ((pushforwardExtApp (g ≫ h) N k U).hom
        (((PresheafOfModules.exteriorPowerMap
          (M := underlyingCommPresheaf Z
            ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward g ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward h).obj N))
          (N := underlyingCommPresheaf Z ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (g ≫ h)).obj N))
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp g h).hom.app N).val k).app U).hom
            (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk x))) =
    (((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Z).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward h).map (pushforwardExtHom g N k))).app U).hom
      ((pushforwardExtApp h ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).obj N) k U).hom
        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk x))
  dsimp only [PresheafOfModules.exteriorPowerMap]
  erw [ModuleCat.exteriorPower.map_mk]
  refine Eq.trans (congrArg _ (pushforwardExtApp_mk (g ≫ h) N k U _)) ?_
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (congrArg _ (pushforwardExtApp_mk h _ k U x)).symm
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (homEquiv_symm_unit_apply Y (pushforwardExtPresheafHom g N k)
    ((Opens.map h.base).op.obj U) (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk x)).symm
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (pushforwardExtApp_mk g N k ((Opens.map h.base).op.obj U) x).symm
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.pfc_naturality
statement:
lemma pfc_naturality {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ Z) {N N' : X.Modules}
    (φ : N ⟶ N') :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward h).map ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).map φ) ≫
        (pfc g h N').hom =
      (pfc g h N).hom ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (g ≫ h)).map φ
proof:
:=
  (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp g h).hom.naturality φ

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.adjUnit_comp
statement:
lemma adjUnit_comp {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ Z) (A : Z.Modules) :
    adjUnit (g ≫ h) A ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (g ≫ h)).map (compIso g h A).inv =
      adjUnit h A ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward h).map
          (adjUnit g ((Scheme.Modules.pullback h).obj A)) ≫
        (pfc g h ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback h).obj A))).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hc := unit_conjugateEquiv
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction h).comp
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g))
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (g ≫ h))
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g h).inv A
  rw [Scheme.Modules.conjugateEquiv_pullbackComp_inv, Adjunction.comp_unit_app] at hc
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  exact hc.symm

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.homEquiv_comp
statement:
lemma homEquiv_comp {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ Z) (A : Z.Modules)
    {B : X.Modules} (φ : (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback h).obj A) ⟶ B) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (g ≫ h)).homEquiv _ _
        ((compIso g h A).inv ≫ φ) =
      adjUnit h A ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward h).map
          (adjUnit g ((Scheme.Modules.pullback h).obj A) ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).map φ) ≫
        (pfc g h B).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
  change adjUnit (g ≫ h) A ≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (g ≫ h)).map ((compIso g h A).inv ≫ φ) = _
  rw [Functor.map_comp, ← Category.assoc (adjUnit (g ≫ h) A), adjUnit_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Functor.map_comp]
  rw [← pfc_naturality]

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.pushforwardExtHom_comp'
statement:
lemma pushforwardExtHom_comp' {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ Z)
    (N : X.Modules) (k : ℕ) :
    extMap (pfc g h N).hom k ≫ pushforwardExtHom (g ≫ h) N k =
      pushforwardExtHom h ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).obj N) k ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward h).map (pushforwardExtHom g N k) ≫
          (pfc g h (exteriorPowerSheaf X N k)).hom
proof:
:= by
  have e : extMap (pfc g h N).hom k ≫ pushforwardExtHom (g ≫ h) N k ≫
      (pfc g h (exteriorPowerSheaf X N k)).inv =
      pushforwardExtHom h ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).obj N) k ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward h).map (pushforwardExtHom g N k) :=
    pushforwardExtHom_comp g h N k
  rw [← Category.assoc, Iso.comp_inv_eq] at e
  rw [e, Category.assoc]

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.pullbackExteriorPowerHom_comp
statement:
theorem pullbackExteriorPowerHom_comp {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ Z) (M : Z.Modules)
    (k : ℕ) :
    (compIso g h (exteriorPowerSheaf Z M k)).inv ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map (pullbackExteriorPowerHom h M k) ≫
          pullbackExteriorPowerHom g ((Scheme.Modules.pullback h).obj M) k =
      pullbackExteriorPowerHom (g ≫ h) M k ≫ extMap (compIso g h M).inv k
proof:
:= by
  apply ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (g ≫ h)).homEquiv _ _).injective
  rw [homEquiv_comp]
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right, homEquiv_pullbackExtHom]
  have e1 : adjUnit g ((Scheme.Modules.pullback h).obj (exteriorPowerSheaf Z M k)) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map
        (pullbackExteriorPowerHom h M k) ≫ pullbackExteriorPowerHom g ((Scheme.Modules.pullback h).obj M) k) =
      pullbackExteriorPowerHom h M k ≫
        extMap (adjUnit g ((Scheme.Modules.pullback h).obj M)) k ≫
          pushforwardExtHom g
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback h).obj M)) k := by
    rw [Functor.map_comp, ← Category.assoc, ← adjUnit_naturality, Category.assoc]
    congr 1
    rw [← homEquiv_pullbackExtHom, Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
    rfl
  have e2 : adjUnit h (exteriorPowerSheaf Z M k) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward h).map (pullbackExteriorPowerHom h M k) =
      extMap (adjUnit h M) k ≫
        pushforwardExtHom h ((Scheme.Modules.pullback h).obj M) k := by
    rw [← homEquiv_pullbackExtHom, Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
    rfl
  rw [e1, Functor.map_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [reassoc_of% e2]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Functor.map_comp]
  rw [← pushforwardExtHom_naturality_assoc h]
  rw [← pushforwardExtHom_naturality (g ≫ h)]
  rw [← extMap_comp_assoc]
  rw [← extMap_comp_assoc (adjUnit (g ≫ h) M), adjUnit_comp]
  rw [← Category.assoc (adjUnit h M), extMap_comp_assoc (adjUnit h M ≫ _),
    pushforwardExtHom_comp']

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.isIso_comp_iff
statement:
theorem isIso_comp_iff {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ Z) (M : Z.Modules)
    (k : ℕ) :
    IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map (pullbackExteriorPowerHom h M k) ≫
        pullbackExteriorPowerHom g ((Scheme.Modules.pullback h).obj M) k) ↔
      IsIso (pullbackExteriorPowerHom (g ≫ h) M k)
proof:
:= by
  have e := pullbackExteriorPowerHom_comp g h M k
  constructor
  · intro hL
    have : IsIso (pullbackExteriorPowerHom (g ≫ h) M k ≫
        extMap (compIso g h M).inv k) := by
      rw [← e]; infer_instance
    exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right _ (extMap (compIso g h M).inv k)
  · intro hR
    have : IsIso ((compIso g h (exteriorPowerSheaf Z M k)).inv ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map (pullbackExteriorPowerHom h M k) ≫
          pullbackExteriorPowerHom g ((Scheme.Modules.pullback h).obj M) k) := by
      rw [e]; infer_instance
    exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_left (compIso g h (exteriorPowerSheaf Z M k)).inv _

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.restrictScalarsExt_bijective
statement:
lemma restrictScalarsExt_bijective {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (φ : R ≃+* S) (N : ModuleCat.{u} S) (k : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective (restrictScalarsExt φ.toRingHom N k).hom
proof:
:= by
  let f := (restrictScalarsExt φ.toRingHom N k).hom
  let g := (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mapSemilinear (idSemilinearInv φ N) k).hom
  have hf : ∀ x : Fin k → ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ.toRingHom).obj N),
      f (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk x) = ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (M := N) x :=
    fun x ↦ restrictScalarsExt_mk _ N k x
  have hg : ∀ x : Fin k → N, g (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk x) =
      ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (M := (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (φ : R →+* S)).obj N) x :=
    fun x ↦ ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mapSemilinear_mk _ k x
  refine Function.bijective_iff_has_inverse.2 ⟨g, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y
    have hy : y ∈ Submodule.span R (Set.range (exteriorPower.ιMulti R k
        (M := ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ.toRingHom).obj N)))) := by
      rw [exteriorPower.ιMulti_span]; trivial
    induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hy
      exact (congrArg g (hf x)).trans (hg x)
    | zero => simp only [map_zero]
    | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb]
    | smul r a _ ha =>
      rw [f.map_smul]
      change g ((φ r) • f a) = r • a
      rw [g.map_smulₛₗ]
      change (φ.symm (φ r)) • g (f a) = r • a
      rw [RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply, ha]
  · intro z
    have hz : z ∈ Submodule.span S (Set.range (exteriorPower.ιMulti S k (M := N))) := by
      rw [exteriorPower.ιMulti_span]; trivial
    induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem z hz =>
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hz
      exact (congrArg f (hg x)).trans (hf x)
    | zero => simp only [map_zero]
    | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb]
    | smul s a _ ha =>
      rw [g.map_smulₛₗ]
      change f ((φ.symm s) • g a) = s • a
      rw [f.map_smul]
      change (φ (φ.symm s)) • f (g a) = s • a
      rw [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply, ha]

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.runit_homEquiv
statement:
lemma runit_homEquiv {U Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : U ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion q] (x : Y.Modules)
    {B : U.Modules} (φ : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj x ⟶ B) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).homEquiv _ _ φ =
      runit q x ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map φ
proof:
:=
  Adjunction.homEquiv_unit _ _ _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.runit_comp
statement:
lemma runit_comp {U Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : U ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion q] (x : Y.Modules) :
    runit q x ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).app x).hom =
      adjUnit q x
proof:
:=
  Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q)
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q) x

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.pullbackExteriorPowerHom_eq_restrict
statement:
theorem pullbackExteriorPowerHom_eq_restrict {U Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : U ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (N : Y.Modules) (k : ℕ) :
    pullbackExteriorPowerHom q N k =
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).app (exteriorPowerSheaf Y N k)).inv ≫
        restrictExtHom q N k ≫
          extMap ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).app N).hom k
proof:
:= by
  apply ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q).homEquiv _ _).injective
  rw [homEquiv_pullbackExtHom]
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
  change _ = adjUnit q (exteriorPowerSheaf Y N k) ≫ _
  rw [← runit_comp q (exteriorPowerSheaf Y N k), Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp,
    Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  rw [Functor.map_comp, ← Category.assoc, ← runit_homEquiv, restrictExtHom,
    Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [Category.assoc, ← pushforwardExtHom_naturality, ← extMap_comp_assoc,
    runit_comp]

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.rsExtApp'_mk
statement:
lemma rsExtApp'_mk (M : PresheafOfModules.{u} (Q ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))
    (k : ℕ) (X : Cᵒᵖ) (x : Fin k → ((PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars α).obj M).obj X) :
    (rsExtApp' α M k X).hom (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk x) =
      ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (M := M.obj X) x
proof:
:=
  restrictScalarsExt_mk (α.app X).hom (M.obj X) k x

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.rsExtHom_app_bijective
statement:
lemma rsExtHom_app_bijective (hα : ∀ X, IsIso (α.app X))
    (M : PresheafOfModules.{u} (Q ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)) (k : ℕ) (X : Cᵒᵖ) :
    Function.Bijective ((rsExtHom α M k).app X).hom
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIso (α.app X) := hα X
  have he : ((asIso (α.app X)).ringCatIsoToRingEquiv.toRingHom : P.obj X →+* Q.obj X) =
      (α.app X).hom := by
    simp [Iso.ringCatIsoToRingEquiv_toRingHom]
  have hb := restrictScalarsExt_bijective (asIso (α.app X)).ringCatIsoToRingEquiv
    (M.obj X) k
  rw [he] at hb
  exact hb

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.rsExtHom_isIso
statement:
lemma rsExtHom_isIso (hα : ∀ X, IsIso (α.app X))
    (M : PresheafOfModules.{u} (Q ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)) (k : ℕ) :
    IsIso (rsExtHom α M k)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : ∀ X, IsIso ((rsExtHom α M k).app X) := fun X ↦
    (LinearEquiv.ofBijective _ (rsExtHom_app_bijective α hα M k X)).toModuleIso.isIso_hom
  exact (PresheafOfModules.isoMk (fun X ↦ asIso ((rsExtHom α M k).app X))
    (fun X Y f ↦ (rsExtHom α M k).naturality f)).isIso_hom

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.adjUnit_naturality_apply
statement:
lemma adjUnit_naturality_apply (X : Scheme.{u})
    {A B : PresheafOfModules.{u} (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)}
    (g : A ⟶ B) (V : X.Opensᵒᵖ) (z : A.obj V) :
    (((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map ((moduleSheafification X).map g)).app V).hom
        ((((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app A).app V).hom z) =
      (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app B).app V).hom ((g.app V).hom z)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun q ↦ (q.app V).hom z)
    ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.naturality g)
  simp only [Functor.id_map, Functor.comp_map, PresheafOfModules.comp_app] at h
  erw [ModuleCat.hom_comp, ModuleCat.hom_comp] at h
  exact h.symm

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.restrictPsi_inv_mk
statement:
lemma restrictPsi_inv_mk {U Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : U ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (N : Y.Modules) (k : ℕ) (V : U.Opensᵒᵖ)
    (x : Fin k → (underlyingCommPresheaf U ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj N)).obj V) :
    (((restrictPsi q N k).inv.app V).hom
        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk
          (M := (underlyingCommPresheaf Y N).obj (q.opensFunctor.op.obj V)) x)) =
      ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk x
proof:
:= by
  have hhom : (((restrictPsi q N k).hom.app V).hom (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk x)) =
      ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk
        (M := (underlyingCommPresheaf Y N).obj (q.opensFunctor.op.obj V)) x :=
    rsExtApp'_mk (openRestrictionRingHom q)
      ((PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀OfCommRingCat q.opensFunctor Y.presheaf).obj
        (underlyingCommPresheaf Y N)) k V x
  rw [← hhom]
  have hi := congrArg (fun φ ↦ (φ.app V).hom (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk x))
    (restrictPsi q N k).hom_inv_id
  simp only [PresheafOfModules.comp_app, PresheafOfModules.id_app] at hi
  erw [ModuleCat.hom_comp] at hi
  exact hi

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.restrictExtHom_eq
statement:
theorem restrictExtHom_eq {U Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : U ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (N : Y.Modules) (k : ℕ) :
    restrictExtHom q N k =
      (openRestrictionSheafificationIso q
          (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower (underlyingCommPresheaf Y N) k)).inv ≫
        (moduleSheafification U).map (restrictPsi q N k).inv
proof:
:= by
  apply ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).homEquiv _ _).injective
  rw [restrictExtHom, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, runit_homEquiv]
  apply (moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).homEquiv _ _ |>.injective
  conv_lhs =>
    erw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left]
    erw [homEquiv_pushforwardExtHom]
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro W
  simp only [PresheafOfModules.comp_app]
  apply ModuleCat.exteriorPower.hom_ext
  ext x
  simp only [ModuleCat.AlternatingMap.postcomp_apply]
  let V' : U.Opensᵒᵖ := (Opens.map q.base).op.obj W
  let j : W ⟶ Opposite.op (q ''ᵁ V'.unop) := (homOfLE (q.image_preimage_le W.unop)).op
  let P := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower (underlyingCommPresheaf Y N) k
  let O := openRestrictionSheafificationIso q P
  change (pushforwardExtApp q ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj N) k W).hom
      (((PresheafOfModules.exteriorPowerMap (M := underlyingCommPresheaf Y N)
        (N := underlyingCommPresheaf Y ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj N))) (runit q N).val k).app W).hom
        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk x)) =
    (((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor U).map
        ((moduleSheafification U).map (restrictPsi q N k).inv)).app V').hom
      ((((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor U).map O.inv).app V').hom
        ((((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).map (runit q (exteriorPowerSheaf Y N k))).app
          W).hom ((((moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).unit.app P).app W).hom
            (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk x))))
  dsimp only [PresheafOfModules.exteriorPowerMap]
  erw [ModuleCat.exteriorPower.map_mk]
  refine (pushforwardExtApp_mk q _ k W _).trans ?_
  have hA : (((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).map
        (runit q (exteriorPowerSheaf Y N k))).app W).hom
      ((((moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).unit.app P).app W).hom
        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk x)) =
      (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).unit.app P).app (Opposite.op (q ''ᵁ V'.unop))).hom
        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (fun i ↦ ((underlyingCommPresheaf Y N).map j).hom (x i))) := by
    have hn := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply
      ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).unit.app P) j (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk x)
    erw [PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower_map_mk] at hn
    exact hn.symm
  have hB := congrArg (fun φ ↦ (φ.app V').hom
      (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk
        (M := (underlyingCommPresheaf Y N).obj (Opposite.op (q ''ᵁ V'.unop)))
        (fun i ↦ ((underlyingCommPresheaf Y N).map j).hom (x i))))
    (openRestrictionSheafificationIso_inv_unit q P)
  simp only [PresheafOfModules.comp_app] at hB
  erw [ModuleCat.hom_comp] at hB
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (congrArg _ (congrArg _ hA)).symm
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (congrArg _ hB).symm
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (adjUnit_naturality_apply U (restrictPsi q N k).inv V' _).symm
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (congrArg _ (restrictPsi_inv_mk q N k V' _)).symm
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.restrictExtHom_isIso
statement:
theorem restrictExtHom_isIso {U Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : U ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (N : Y.Modules) (k : ℕ) : IsIso (restrictExtHom q N k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [restrictExtHom_eq]
  exact IsIso.comp_isIso' (Iso.isIso_inv _) (Functor.map_isIso _ _)

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.isIso_openImmersion
statement:
theorem isIso_openImmersion {U Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : U ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (N : Y.Modules) (k : ℕ) : IsIso (pullbackExteriorPowerHom q N k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pullbackExteriorPowerHom_eq_restrict]
  haveI := restrictExtHom_isIso q N k
  infer_instance

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.unitHom_ext
proof:
:= by
  apply M.unitHomEquiv.injective
  ext V
  exact h V

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.extFreeIso_hom_unit_mk
statement:
lemma extFreeIso_hom_unit_mk (X : Scheme.{u}) (J : Type u) [Fintype J] [LinearOrder J]
    (k : ℕ) (S : Set.powersetCard J k) (V : X.Opensᵒᵖ) :
    ((extFreeIso X J k).hom.val.app V).hom
      ((((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app
          (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower
            (underlyingCommPresheaf X (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) J)) k)).app V).hom
        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk
          (M := (underlyingCommPresheaf X (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) J)).obj V)
          (fun i ↦ ((SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf)
            (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm S i)).val.app V).hom
              (1 : X.presheaf.obj V)))) =
      ((SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) S).val.app V).hom (1 : X.presheaf.obj V)
proof:
:= by
  let P₀ := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower
    (underlyingCommPresheaf X (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) J)) k
  let P₁ := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower (finsuppFreePresheaf X J) k
  let P₂ := finsuppFreePresheaf X (Set.powersetCard J k)
  let P₃ := underlyingCommPresheaf X
    (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (Set.powersetCard J k))
  let α : P₀ ⟶ P₁ := (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPowerFunctor k).map
    (underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree X J).hom
  let β : P₁ ⟶ P₂ := (extFinsuppFreeIso X J k).hom
  let γ : P₂ ⟶ P₃ := (underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree X (Set.powersetCard J k)).inv
  let s := Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm S
  let w : P₀.obj V := ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk
    (M := (underlyingCommPresheaf X (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) J)).obj V)
    (fun i ↦ ((SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (s i)).val.app V).hom
      (1 : X.presheaf.obj V))
  let g : P₁.obj V := ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (M := (finsuppFreePresheaf X J).obj V)
    (fun i ↦ Finsupp.single (s i) (1 : X.presheaf.obj V))
  let eS : P₃.obj V :=
    ((SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) S).val.app V).hom (1 : X.presheaf.obj V)
  have hαw : α.app V w = g := by
    change ModuleCat.exteriorPower.map ((underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree X J).hom.app V) k w = g
    rw [ModuleCat.exteriorPower.map_mk]
    congr 1
    funext i
    exact underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree_hom_freeSection_eval X J (s i) V
  have hβg : β.app V g = Finsupp.single S (1 : X.presheaf.obj V) := by
    let b : Module.Basis (Set.powersetCard J k) (X.presheaf.obj V)
        (⋀[X.presheaf.obj V]^k (J →₀ X.presheaf.obj V)) :=
      (Finsupp.basisSingleOne (R := X.presheaf.obj V) (ι := J)).exteriorPower k
    have hb : b S = g := by
      rw [exteriorPower.basis_apply]
      rfl
    change b.repr g = _
    rw [← hb, Module.Basis.repr_self]
  have hγ : γ.app V (Finsupp.single S (1 : X.presheaf.obj V)) = eS := by
    have h1 := underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree_hom_freeSection_eval X (Set.powersetCard J k) S V
    have h2 := congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ.app V ((SheafOfModules.freeSection S).eval V))
      (underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree X (Set.powersetCard J k)).hom_inv_id
    change γ.app V (ModuleCat.freeMk S) = _
    rw [← h1]
    exact h2
  have hα := moduleSheafification_map_unit_apply X α V w
  rw [hαw] at hα
  have hβ := moduleSheafification_map_unit_apply X β V g
  rw [hβg] at hβ
  have hγ' := moduleSheafification_map_unit_apply X γ V (Finsupp.single S (1 : X.presheaf.obj V))
  rw [hγ] at hγ'
  have hε : (((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map
      ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).counit.app
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (Set.powersetCard J k)))).app V).hom
      ((((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app P₃).app V).hom eS) = eS := by
    have h := (moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).right_triangle_components
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (Set.powersetCard J k))
    have hV := congrArg (fun k ↦ k.app V) h
    exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hV eS
  change (((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map
      ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).counit.app
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (Set.powersetCard J k)))).app V).hom
    ((((moduleSheafification X ⋙ underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map γ).app V).hom
      ((((moduleSheafification X ⋙ underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map β).app V).hom
        ((((moduleSheafification X ⋙ underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map α).app V).hom
          ((((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app P₀).app V).hom w)))) = eS
  rw [hα, hβ, hγ', hε]

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.extFreeIso_inv_ιFree
statement:
lemma extFreeIso_inv_ιFree (X : Scheme.{u}) (J : Type u) [Fintype J] [LinearOrder J]
    (k : ℕ) (S : Set.powersetCard J k) (V : X.Opensᵒᵖ) :
    ((SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) S ≫ (extFreeIso X J k).inv).val.app V).hom
        (1 : X.presheaf.obj V) =
      (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app
          (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower
            (underlyingCommPresheaf X (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) J)) k)).app V).hom
        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk
          (M := (underlyingCommPresheaf X (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) J)).obj V)
          (fun i ↦ ((SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf)
            (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm S i)).val.app V).hom
              (1 : X.presheaf.obj V)))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := congrArg
    (fun (φ : exteriorPowerSheaf X (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) J) k ⟶
        exteriorPowerSheaf X (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) J) k) ↦
      (φ.val.app V).hom
        ((((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app
          (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower
            (underlyingCommPresheaf X (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) J)) k)).app V).hom
        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk
          (M := (underlyingCommPresheaf X (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) J)).obj V)
          (fun i ↦ ((SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf)
            (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm S i)).val.app V).hom
              (1 : X.presheaf.obj V)))))
    (extFreeIso X J k).hom_inv_id
  change ((extFreeIso X J k).inv.val.app V).hom
    (((SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) S).val.app V).hom (1 : X.presheaf.obj V)) = _
  rw [← extFreeIso_hom_unit_mk X J k S V]
  exact h1

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.adjUnit_pullbackFreeIso_apply
statement:
lemma adjUnit_pullbackFreeIso_apply {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (J : Type u) (j : J)
    (V : Y.Opensᵒᵖ) :
    (((AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f J).hom.val.app ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)).hom
      (((adjUnit f (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J)).val.app V).hom
        (((SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) j).val.app V).hom
          (1 : Y.presheaf.obj V)))) =
      ((SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) j).val.app
        ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)).hom (1 : X.presheaf.obj ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V))
proof:
:= by
  have e : SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) j ≫
        adjUnit f (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f J).hom =
      SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit f.toRingCatSheafHom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) j) := by
    have h1 : adjUnit f (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f J).hom =
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).homEquiv _ _
          (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f J).hom :=
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).homEquiv_unit _ _ _).symm
    rw [h1, ← Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left, pullback_map_ιFree_comp_pullbackFreeIso_hom,
      Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
    erw [SheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction_homEquiv_pullbackObjUnitToUnit]
  have h := congrArg (fun φ ↦ (φ.val.app V).hom (1 : Y.presheaf.obj V)) e
  refine h.trans ?_
  change ((SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) j).val.app
      ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)).hom ((f.toRingCatSheafHom.hom.app V).hom 1) = _
  rw [map_one]

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.free_generator
statement:
theorem free_generator {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (J : Type u) [Fintype J]
    [LinearOrder J] (k : ℕ) (S : Set.powersetCard J k) :
    SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) S ≫
        (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f (Set.powersetCard J k)).inv ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map (extFreeIso Y J k).inv ≫
            pullbackExteriorPowerHom f (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J) k ≫
              extMap (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f J).hom k ≫
                (extFreeIso X J k).hom =
      SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) S
proof:
:= by
  have key2 : SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) S ≫ (extFreeIso Y J k).inv ≫
      (extMap (adjUnit f (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J)) k ≫
        pushforwardExtHom f
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J)) k) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
        (extMap (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f J).hom k ≫
          (extFreeIso X J k).hom) =
      SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit f.toRingCatSheafHom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) S) := by
    apply unitHom_ext
    intro V
    have hGY := extFreeIso_inv_ιFree Y J k S V
    have h2 : ((extMap (adjUnit f (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J)) k).val.app
        V).hom
        ((((moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).unit.app
          (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower
            (underlyingCommPresheaf Y (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J)) k)).app V).hom
        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk
          (M := (underlyingCommPresheaf Y (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J)).obj V)
          (fun i ↦ ((SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)
            (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm S i)).val.app V).hom
              (1 : Y.presheaf.obj V)))) =
        (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).unit.app
          (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower
            (underlyingCommPresheaf Y ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj
              ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj
                (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J)))) k)).app V).hom
        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk
          (fun i ↦ ((adjUnit f (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J)).val.app V).hom
            (((SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)
              (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm S i)).val.app V).hom
                (1 : Y.presheaf.obj V)))) :=
      (adjUnit_exteriorPowerMap_mk Y
        (adjUnit f (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J)).val k V _).symm
    have h3 := (homEquiv_symm_unit_apply Y (pushforwardExtPresheafHom f
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J)) k) V
        _).trans
      (pushforwardExtApp_mk f
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J)) k V
          (fun i ↦ ((adjUnit f (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J)).val.app V).hom
            (((SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)
              (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm S i)).val.app V).hom
                (1 : Y.presheaf.obj V))))
    have h3' : ((pushforwardExtHom f ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J)) k).val.app V).hom
        ((((moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).unit.app
          (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower
            (underlyingCommPresheaf Y ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J)))) k)).app V).hom
        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (fun i ↦ ((adjUnit f (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J)).val.app V).hom
            (((SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)
              (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm S i)).val.app V).hom
                (1 : Y.presheaf.obj V))))) =
        (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app
          (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower (underlyingCommPresheaf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J))) k)).app ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)).hom
        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (M := (underlyingCommPresheaf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J))).obj ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)) (fun i ↦ ((adjUnit f (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J)).val.app V).hom
            (((SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)
              (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm S i)).val.app V).hom
                (1 : Y.presheaf.obj V)))) := h3
    have h4 : ((extMap (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f J).hom k).val.app ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)).hom
        ((((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app
          (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower (underlyingCommPresheaf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J))) k)).app ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)).hom
        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (M := (underlyingCommPresheaf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J))).obj ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)) (fun i ↦ ((adjUnit f (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J)).val.app V).hom
            (((SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)
              (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm S i)).val.app V).hom
                (1 : Y.presheaf.obj V))))) =
        (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app
          (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower (underlyingCommPresheaf X
            (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) J)) k)).app ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)).hom
        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk
          (M := (underlyingCommPresheaf X (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) J)).obj ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V))
          (fun i ↦ ((AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f J).hom.val.app ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)).hom
            ((fun i ↦ ((adjUnit f (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J)).val.app V).hom
            (((SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)
              (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm S i)).val.app V).hom
                (1 : Y.presheaf.obj V))) i))) :=
      (adjUnit_exteriorPowerMap_mk X (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f J).hom.val k ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)
        (fun i ↦ ((adjUnit f (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J)).val.app V).hom
            (((SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)
              (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm S i)).val.app V).hom
                (1 : Y.presheaf.obj V)))).symm
    have h5 : (fun i ↦ ((AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f J).hom.val.app ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)).hom
            ((fun i ↦ ((adjUnit f (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J)).val.app V).hom
            (((SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)
              (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm S i)).val.app V).hom
                (1 : Y.presheaf.obj V))) i)) =
        fun i ↦ ((SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf)
            (Set.powersetCard.ofFinEmbEquiv.symm S i)).val.app ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)).hom
              (1 : X.presheaf.obj ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)) :=
      funext fun i ↦ adjUnit_pullbackFreeIso_apply f J _ V
    have h6 := extFreeIso_hom_unit_mk X J k S ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)
    have h7 : ((SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit f.toRingCatSheafHom).val.app V).hom
        (1 : Y.presheaf.obj V) = (1 : X.presheaf.obj ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)) := by
      change (f.toRingCatSheafHom.hom.app V).hom 1 = 1
      exact map_one _
    change ((extFreeIso X J k).hom.val.app ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)).hom
        (((extMap (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f J).hom k).val.app ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)).hom
          (((pushforwardExtHom f ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J)) k).val.app V).hom
            (((extMap (adjUnit f (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J)) k).val.app V).hom
              (((SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) S ≫
                (extFreeIso Y J k).inv).val.app V).hom (1 : Y.presheaf.obj V))))) =
      ((SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) S).val.app ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)).hom
        (((SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit f.toRingCatSheafHom).val.app V).hom
          (1 : Y.presheaf.obj V))
    rw [hGY, h2, h3', h4, h5, h6, h7]
  have key : (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) S) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map (extFreeIso Y J k).inv ≫
        pullbackExteriorPowerHom f (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J) k ≫
          extMap (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f J).hom k ≫
            (extFreeIso X J k).hom =
      (pullbackObjUnitIso f).hom ≫ SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) S := by
    apply ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).homEquiv _ _).injective
    refine ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).homEquiv_naturality_left _ _).trans ?_
    refine (whisker_eq _
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).homEquiv_naturality_left _ _)).trans ?_
    refine (whisker_eq _ (whisker_eq _
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).homEquiv_naturality_right _ _))).trans ?_
    refine (whisker_eq _ (whisker_eq _ (eq_whisker
      (homEquiv_pullbackExtHom f (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J) k) _))).trans ?_
    refine key2.trans ?_
    refine Eq.trans ?_
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).homEquiv_naturality_right _ _).symm
    exact eq_whisker
      (SheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction_homEquiv_pullbackObjUnitToUnit
        f.toRingCatSheafHom).symm _
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
    ((eq_whisker (ιFree_comp_pullbackObjFreeIso_inv f S) _).trans
      ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans ((whisker_eq _ key).trans (Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc _ _))))

name: SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.isIso_free
statement:
theorem isIso_free {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (J : Type u) [Finite J] (k : ℕ) :
    IsIso (pullbackExteriorPowerHom f (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J) k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Fintype J := Fintype.ofFinite J
  letI : LinearOrder J := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
  let c := pullbackExteriorPowerHom f (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J) k
  let A := (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f (Set.powersetCard J k)).inv ≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map (extFreeIso Y J k).inv
  let B := extMap (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f J).hom k ≫
    (extFreeIso X J k).hom
  have key : (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f (Set.powersetCard J k)).inv ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map (extFreeIso Y J k).inv ≫ c ≫
        extMap (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f J).hom k ≫
          (extFreeIso X J k).hom = 𝟙 _ := by
    apply Cofan.IsColimit.hom_ext
      (SheafOfModules.isColimitFreeCofan (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (Set.powersetCard J k))
    intro S
    change SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) S ≫
        (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f (Set.powersetCard J k)).inv ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map (extFreeIso Y J k).inv ≫ c ≫
            extMap (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f J).hom k ≫
              (extFreeIso X J k).hom =
      SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) S
    exact free_generator f J k S
  haveI : IsIso A := by dsimp only [A]; infer_instance
  haveI : IsIso B := by dsimp only [B]; infer_instance
  have hc : c = inv A ≫ inv B := by
    rw [← cancel_epi A, ← cancel_mono B]
    simp only [Category.assoc, IsIso.hom_inv_id_assoc, IsIso.inv_hom_id]
    simpa only [A, B, Category.assoc] using key
  change IsIso c
  rw [hc]
  infer_instance

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackExteriorPowerHom_isIso
statement:
theorem pullbackExteriorPowerHom_isIso {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (M : Y.Modules)
    (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y M) (k : ℕ) : IsIso (pullbackExteriorPowerHom f M k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin⟩ := hM.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := hqfin
  let W : q.I → Y.Opens := q.X
  let U : q.I → X.Opens := fun i ↦ f ⁻¹ᵁ W i
  have hW : (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y).CoversTop W := q.coversTop
  have hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop U := by
    rw [Opens.coversTop_iff] at hW ⊢
    exact f.iSup_preimage_eq_top hW
  apply moduleHom_isIso_of_over_cover (pullbackExteriorPowerHom f M k) U hU
  intro i
  apply (over_isIso_iff_restrictFunctor_map_isIso (U i) _).2
  apply (restrictFunctor_map_isIso_iff_pullback_map_isIso (U i).ι _).2
  letI : (q.generators i).IsFiniteType :=
    SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType i
  have hfree : IsIso (pullbackExteriorPowerHom (f ∣_ W i)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (W i).ι).obj M) k) :=
    isIso_of_iso _ (pullbackIsoFreeOfGeneratingSections (W i) (q.generators i)) k
      (isIso_free _ _ k)
  have hcomp : IsIso (pullbackExteriorPowerHom ((U i).ι ≫ f) M k) := by
    apply isIso_congr (morphismRestrict_ι f (W i))
    apply (isIso_comp_iff (f ∣_ W i) (W i).ι M k).1
    haveI := isIso_openImmersion (W i).ι M k
    infer_instance
  have h2 := (isIso_comp_iff (U i).ι f M k).2 hcomp
  haveI := isIso_openImmersion (U i).ι ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M) k
  exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right _
    (pullbackExteriorPowerHom (U i).ι ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M) k)

name: SchemeKTheory.flatPullbackK0_k0ClassOf_exteriorPowerSheaf
statement:
theorem flatPullbackK0_k0ClassOf_exteriorPowerSheaf {Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ Z) [Flat f]
    (M : Z.Modules) (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree Z M) (k : ℕ)
    (hΛ : IsFiniteLocallyFree Z (exteriorPowerSheaf Z M k))
    (hΛ' : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y (exteriorPowerSheaf Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M) k)) :
    flatPullbackK0 f (k0ClassOf Z (exteriorPowerSheaf Z M k) hΛ) =
      k0ClassOf Y (exteriorPowerSheaf Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M) k) hΛ'
proof:
:= by
  rw [flatPullbackK0_classOf]
  exact k0ClassOf_iso Y _ hΛ' (pullbackExteriorPowerIso f M hM k)

name: SchemeKTheory.flatPullbackK0_lambdaClass
statement:
theorem flatPullbackK0_lambdaClass {Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ Z) [Flat f] (M : Z.Modules)
    (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree Z M) (k : ℕ) :

      lambdaClass Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M)
        (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global f M hM) k
proof:
:=
  flatPullbackK0_k0ClassOf_exteriorPowerSheaf Y f M hM k _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E12.symmetricAlgebraMap_mkQ_eq
statement:
theorem symmetricAlgebraMap_mkQ_eq (N : Submodule R M) (x : SymmetricAlgebra R M) :
    symmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) N.mkQ x = symQuotAlg N x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap r =>
    refine (symmetricAlgebraMap_algebraMap (R := R) (S := R) N.mkQ r).trans ?_
    exact ((symQuotAlg N).commutes r).symm
  | ι m =>
    rw [symmetricAlgebraMap_ι]
    exact (SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply ((SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (M ⧸ N)) ∘ₗ N.mkQ) m).symm
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul, map_mul, ha, hb]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E12.symQuotAlg_surjective
statement: theorem symQuotAlg_surjective (N : Submodule R M) : Function.Surjective (symQuotAlg N)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  induction y using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap r => exact ⟨algebraMap R _ r, (symQuotAlg N).commutes r⟩
  | ι q =>
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := N.mkQ_surjective q
    exact ⟨SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M m, SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply _ m⟩
  | mul a b ha hb =>
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hb
    exact ⟨x * y, map_mul _ _ _⟩
  | add a b ha hb =>
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hb
    exact ⟨x + y, map_add _ _ _⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E12.symQuotDescent_comp
statement:
theorem symQuotDescent_comp (N : Submodule R M) (x : SymmetricAlgebra R M) :
    symQuotDescent N (symQuotAlg N x) = Ideal.Quotient.mk (symIdeal N) x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap r =>
    rw [(symQuotAlg N).commutes, (symQuotDescent N).commutes]
    rfl
  | ι m =>
    change symQuotDescent N (SymmetricAlgebra.lift _ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M m)) = _
    rw [SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply]
    change symQuotDescent N (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (M ⧸ N) (N.mkQ m)) = _
    unfold symQuotDescent
    rw [SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply]
    rfl
  | mul a b ha hb => rw [map_mul, map_mul, ha, hb, map_mul]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E12.ker_symmetricAlgebraMap_mkQ_E12
statement:
theorem ker_symmetricAlgebraMap_mkQ_E12 (N : Submodule R M) :
    RingHom.ker (symmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) N.mkQ) = symIdeal N
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker, symmetricAlgebraMap_mkQ_eq]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, ← symQuotDescent_comp, h, map_zero]
  · intro h
    refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun x _ => symQuotAlg N x = 0) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ h
    · rintro _ ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩
      change (SymmetricAlgebra.lift _) (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M n) = 0
      rw [SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply]
      change SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (M ⧸ N) (N.mkQ n) = 0
      rw [(Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero N).mpr hn |> fun h => (show N.mkQ n = 0 from h)]
      exact map_zero _
    · exact map_zero _
    · intro a b _ _ ha hb; rw [map_add, ha, hb, add_zero]
    · intro a b _ hb; rw [smul_eq_mul, map_mul, hb, mul_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E12.symIdeal_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem symIdeal_isHomogeneous (N : Submodule R M) :
    (symIdeal N).IsHomogeneous (symGrading R M)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.homogeneous_span
  rintro x ⟨n, -, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  change _ ∈ LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M) ^ 1
  rw [pow_one]
  exact ⟨n, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E12.symmetricAlgebraMap_mkQ_surjective

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E12.quotEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotEquiv_mk (a : SymmetricAlgebra R M) :
    quotEquiv N (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a) = symmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) N.mkQ a
proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E12.symGrading_surj
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Submodule.map (symQuotAlg N).toLinearMap
      (LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M)) =
      LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (M ⧸ N)) := by
    rw [← LinearMap.range_comp]
    have : (symQuotAlg N).toLinearMap ∘ₗ SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M =
        SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (M ⧸ N) ∘ₗ N.mkQ := SymmetricAlgebra.lift_comp_ι _
    rw [this, LinearMap.range_comp, Submodule.range_mkQ, Submodule.map_top]
  have h2 := Submodule.map_pow (M := LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M)) (symQuotAlg N) n
  rw [h1] at h2
  have hy' : y ∈ Submodule.map (symQuotAlg N).toLinearMap
      (LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M) ^ n) := by rw [h2]; exact hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hy'
  exact ⟨x, hx, (symmetricAlgebraMap_mkQ_eq N x)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E12.gradedQuotMap_comp_core

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E12.gradedQuotMap_irrelevant
statement:
theorem gradedQuotMap_irrelevant :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (symGrading R (M ⧸ N)) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant
        (GradedIdealQuotient.grading (symGrading R M) (symHomIdeal N))).map
          (gradedQuotMap N)
proof:
:= by
  rw [HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le]
  intro i hi x hx
  have hm := (gradedQuotInv N).map_mem hx
  have h := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (gradedQuotMap N)
    (HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem _ hi hm)
  change gradedQuotMap N (gradedQuotInv N x) ∈ _ at h
  rw [gradedQuotMap_inv_apply_core] at h
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E12.gradedQuotInv_irrelevant
statement:
theorem gradedQuotInv_irrelevant :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant
      (GradedIdealQuotient.grading (symGrading R M) (symHomIdeal N)) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (symGrading R (M ⧸ N))).map (gradedQuotInv N)
proof:
:= by
  rw [HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le]
  intro i hi x hx
  have hm := (gradedQuotMap N).map_mem hx
  have h := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (gradedQuotInv N)
    (HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem _ hi hm)
  change gradedQuotInv N (gradedQuotMap N x) ∈ _ at h
  rw [gradedQuotInv_map_apply_core] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.chartToReverseOverlap_toChart
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem chartToReverseOverlap_toChart
    (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    C.chartToReverseOverlap i j c ≫ C.overlapToChart j i =
      c.chartToRight
proof:
:= by

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.chartToReverseOverlap_toIntersection
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem chartToReverseOverlap_toIntersection
    (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    C.chartToReverseOverlap i j c ≫ C.overlapToIntersection j i =
      c.chartToBase ≫ c.toReverseIntersection
proof:
:= by
