name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.isPullback_chartToReverseOverlap
statement:
theorem isPullback_chartToReverseOverlap
    (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    IsPullback
      (C.chartToReverseOverlap i j c)
      c.chartToBase
      (C.overlapToIntersection j i)
      c.toReverseIntersection
proof:
:= by
  refine IsPullback.of_right ?_ ?_ (IsPullback.of_hasPullback _ _)
  · convert c.isPullback_chartToRight_chartToBase using 1
    all_goals
      first
      | rfl
      | simpa only [CommonBasicOpen.toReverseIntersection,
          Scheme.homOfLE_homOfLE]
      | exact heq_of_eq (by
          simpa only [overlapToChart] using
            C.chartToReverseOverlap_toChart i j c)
  · exact chartToReverseOverlap_toIntersection C i j c

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.localTransition_toChart
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem localTransition_toChart
    (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    C.localTransition i j c ≫ C.overlapToChart j i =
      (C.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j c).hom ≫ c.chartToRight
proof:
:= by
  unfold localTransition
  rw [Category.assoc, chartToReverseOverlap_toChart]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.localTransition_toIntersection
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem localTransition_toIntersection
    (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    C.localTransition i j c ≫ C.overlapToIntersection j i =
      (C.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j c).hom ≫
        c.chartToBase ≫ c.toReverseIntersection
proof:
:= by
  unfold localTransition
  rw [Category.assoc, chartToReverseOverlap_toIntersection]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.localTransition_toAmbient
statement:
theorem localTransition_toAmbient
    (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c ≫
          C.overlapToChart i j ≫ C.chartToAmbient i =
      C.localTransition i j c ≫
          C.overlapToChart j i ≫ C.chartToAmbient j
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j c).hom ≫ c.chartToLeft) ≫
          C.chartToAmbient i := by
      rw [← Category.assoc, ← C.commonBasicOpenChartIso_hom_chartToLeft i j c]
      rfl
    _ = (C.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j c).hom ≫ c.chartToAmbient := by
      convert congrArg (fun f ↦ (C.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j c).hom ≫ f)
        (CommonBasicOpen.chartToLeft_comp_chartToAmbient c) using 1 <;> rfl
    _ = ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j c).hom ≫ c.chartToRight) ≫
          C.chartToAmbient j := by
      convert congrArg (fun f ↦ (C.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j c).hom ≫ f)
        (CommonBasicOpen.chartToRight_comp_chartToAmbient c).symm using 1 <;> rfl
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← C.localTransition_toChart i j c]
      exact Category.assoc _ _ _

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.exists_fibre_iso
statement:
theorem exists_fibre_iso (c : k) :
    ∃ e : Y ≅ zeroScheme (lineFn Y k φk c),
      e.hom ≫ zeroι _ ≫ GlobalCompletion.lineTι Y J = GlobalCompletion.fibreιGlobal Y J k φk c
proof:
:= by
  have hsq := DeformationSpace.quotient_isPullback Y ⊥ k φk _
    (DeformationSpace.lineHom_bot_compat Y k φk c) c (fun _ ↦ rfl)
  haveI := RelativeSpec.quotientHom_isClosedImmersion (DeformationSpace.algebraData Y ⊥) _
    (DeformationSpace.lineHom_bot_compat Y k φk c)
  obtain ⟨eQ, heQ⟩ := zeroScheme_fibre c (DeformationSpace.toLineOver Y ⊥ k φk) _ _ hsq
  refine ⟨(DeformationSpace.lineFibreIso Y k φk c).symm ≪≫ eQ, ?_⟩
  have heQ' : eQ.hom ≫ zeroι (lineFn Y k φk c) = (RelativeSpec.quotientHom
      (DeformationSpace.algebraData Y ⊥) _ (DeformationSpace.lineHom_bot_compat Y k φk c)).map :=
    heQ
  calc ((DeformationSpace.lineFibreIso Y k φk c).symm ≪≫ eQ).hom ≫ zeroι (lineFn Y k φk c) ≫
        GlobalCompletion.lineTι Y J
      = (DeformationSpace.lineFibreIso Y k φk c).inv ≫ (eQ.hom ≫ zeroι (lineFn Y k φk c)) ≫
        GlobalCompletion.lineTι Y J := by simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [heQ']; rfl

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.sigma_toBase
statement:
theorem sigma_toBase (c : k) (e : Y ≅ zeroScheme (lineFn Y k φk c))
    (he : e.hom ≫ zeroι _ ≫ GlobalCompletion.lineTι Y J = GlobalCompletion.fibreιGlobal Y J k φk c) :
    (e.hom ≫ zeroι _) ≫ DeformationSpace.toBase Y ⊥ = 𝟙 Y
proof:
:= by
  have hT : GlobalCompletion.lineTι Y J ≫ GlobalCompletion.totalGlobalToBase Y J =
      DeformationSpace.toBase Y ⊥ := pushout.inr_desc _ _ _
  have h := GlobalCompletion.fibreιGlobal_toBase Y J k φk c
  rw [← he, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, hT] at h
  simpa only [Category.assoc] using h

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.lineFn_one_eq
statement: theorem lineFn_one_eq : lineFn Y k φk 1 = lineFn Y k φk 0 - 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold lineFn aLine
  have : ((Polynomial.X : k[X]) - Polynomial.C (1 : k)) =
      (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (0 : k)) - 1 := by simp
  rw [this]
  simp only [map_sub, map_one]

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.fibreZero_appTop_lineFn_one
statement:
theorem fibreZero_appTop_lineFn_one (e : Y ≅ zeroScheme (lineFn Y k φk 0)) :
    (e.hom ≫ zeroι _).appTop (lineFn Y k φk 1) = -1
proof:
:= by
  rw [lineFn_one_eq, Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop]
  have h0 : (zeroι (lineFn Y k φk 0)).appTop (lineFn Y k φk 0) = 0 := zeroι_appTop _
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, map_sub, map_one]
  rw [h0, map_zero, zero_sub]

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.lineFn_one_ne_zero
statement: theorem lineFn_one_ne_zero [IsIntegral Y] : lineFn Y k φk 1 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e₀, he₀⟩ := exists_fibre_iso Y ⊥ k φk 0
  intro h0
  have h1 := fibreZero_appTop_lineFn_one Y k φk e₀
  rw [h0, map_zero] at h1
  have h2 : (1 : Γ(Y, ⊤)) = 0 := by
    have : (-1 : Γ(Y, ⊤)) = 0 := h1.symm
    simp at this
  exact one_ne_zero h2

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.lineFn_one_pullback_ne_zero
statement:
theorem lineFn_one_pullback_ne_zero [IsIntegral Y] [IsIntegral J.subscheme] :
    (subschemeToLineGlobal Y J).appTop (lineFn Y k φk 1) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e₀, he₀⟩ := exists_fibre_iso Y J k φk 0
  have hσ := sigma_toBase Y J k φk 0 e₀ he₀
  let sW : J.subscheme ⟶ subschemeUGlobal Y J :=
    (isPullback_subschemeLine Y J).lift (J.subschemeι ≫ e₀.hom ≫ zeroι _) (𝟙 _) (by
      rw [Category.assoc, hσ]; simp)
  have hsW : sW ≫ subschemeToLineGlobal Y J = J.subschemeι ≫ e₀.hom ≫ zeroι _ :=
    (isPullback_subschemeLine Y J).lift_fst _ _ _
  intro h
  have h1 : sW.appTop ((subschemeToLineGlobal Y J).appTop (lineFn Y k φk 1)) = 0 := by
    rw [h, map_zero]
  have h2 : (sW ≫ subschemeToLineGlobal Y J).appTop (lineFn Y k φk 1) = -1 := by
    rw [hsW, Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop]
    have h3 := fibreZero_appTop_lineFn_one Y k φk e₀
    simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
    rw [h3]
    simp
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop] at h2
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at h2
  rw [h, map_zero] at h2
  have h4 : (1 : Γ(J.subscheme, ⊤)) = 0 := by
    have : (-1 : Γ(J.subscheme, ⊤)) = 0 := h2.symm
    simp at this
  exact one_ne_zero h4

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.hbcA_pencil
statement:
theorem hbcA_pencil [IsIntegral Y] [IsIntegral J.subscheme] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian (totalGlobal Y J)]
    (hres : Function.Bijective (k0ToG0 (totalGlobal Y J)))
    (x : K0 J.subscheme) (y : K0 (totalGlobal Y J))
    (hy : k0ToG0 (totalGlobal Y J) y = finitePushforward (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)
      (flatPullbackG0 (totalToClosedBase Y J) (k0ToG0 J.subscheme x))) :
    k0ToG0 Y (pullbackK0 (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk 1) y) =
      finitePushforward J.subschemeι (k0ToG0 J.subscheme x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_fibre_iso Y J k φk 1
  obtain ⟨e₀, he₀⟩ := exists_fibre_iso Y J k φk 0
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (subschemeTotalGlobal Y J) :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (DeformationSpace.line Y) :=
    isLocallyNoetherian_of_isOpenImmersion (lineTι Y J)
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (subschemeUGlobal Y J) :=
    isLocallyNoetherian_of_isOpenImmersion (subschemeTιGlobal Y J)
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian J.subscheme := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian J.subschemeι
  haveI : IsIntegral (DeformationSpace.line Y) := IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_line Y
  haveI : IsIntegral (subschemeTotalGlobal Y J) := IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_subschemeTotalGlobal Y J
  have hσ0 := sigma_toBase Y J k φk 0 e₀ he₀
  haveI : Nonempty (subschemeUGlobal Y J) := by
    let sW : J.subscheme ⟶ subschemeUGlobal Y J :=
      (isPullback_subschemeLine Y J).lift (J.subschemeι ≫ e₀.hom ≫ zeroι _) (𝟙 _) (by
        rw [Category.assoc, hσ0]; simp)
    obtain ⟨z⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty J.subscheme)
    exact ⟨sW z⟩
  haveI : IsIntegral (subschemeUGlobal Y J) := isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion (subschemeTιGlobal Y J)
  have hmono : ∀ E : (DeformationSpace.line Y).Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFree _ E →
      Mono (tMul (lineFn Y k φk 1) E) := fun E hE =>
    mono_tMul_of_isIntegral _ (lineFn_one_ne_zero Y k φk) E hE
  have hmonoW : ∀ E : J.subscheme.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFree _ E →
      Mono (tMul ((subschemeToLineGlobal Y J).appTop (lineFn Y k φk 1))
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (subschemeTιGlobal Y J)).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (totalToClosedBase Y J)).obj E))) := fun E hE =>
    mono_tMul_of_isIntegral _ (lineFn_one_pullback_ne_zero Y J k φk) _
      (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global _ _ (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global _ _ hE))
  have hσ := sigma_toBase Y J k φk 1 e he
  have hsq' : IsPullback (subschemeToLineGlobal Y J) (subschemeTιGlobal Y J ≫ totalToClosedBase Y J)
      (DeformationSpace.toBase Y ⊥) J.subschemeι := by
    rw [subschemeTι_totalToClosedBase]; exact isPullback_subschemeLine Y J
  obtain ⟨hiso, hsi⟩ := fibre_of_section (DeformationSpace.toBase Y ⊥) (e.hom ≫ zeroι _) hσ
    (lineFn Y k φk 1) e rfl (subschemeToLineGlobal Y J) _ J.subschemeι hsq'
  haveI := hiso
  exact hbcA_pencil_generic (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (lineTι Y J) (subschemeTιGlobal Y J)
    (subschemeToLineGlobal Y J) (isPullback_lineTι_subschemeTotal Y J) (lineFn Y k φk 1)
    (totalToClosedBase Y J) J.subschemeι (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk 1) e he hmono hmonoW hsi hres x y hy

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistingSheaf_genericRank_one
statement:
theorem canonicalTwistingSheaf_genericRank_one (d : ℤ) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank C.scheme
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf d) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let 𝒰 := C.literalLinearOpenCover
  let h := C.canonicalTwistingSheafLiteralLinearOpenCoverIso d
  let q :=
    SchemeKTheory.unitTrivializedOpenCoverLocalGeneratorsData
      𝒰 (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf d) h
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := by
    dsimp only [q]
    infer_instance
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := by
    dsimp only [q]
    infer_instance
  let i := 𝒰.idx (genericPoint C.scheme)
  have hi : genericPoint C.scheme ∈ q.X i := by
    change genericPoint C.scheme ∈ (𝒰.f i).opensRange
    exact 𝒰.covers (genericPoint C.scheme)
  have hrank :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank_eq_natCard_localGenerators
      C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf d) q i hi
  change AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank C.scheme
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf d) = Nat.card PUnit at hrank
  simpa using hrank

      ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint W) d hd) :

name: GRRBlueprintV4.interw_lineChern
statement:
theorem interw_lineChern (i : X ⟶ Z) [IsClosedImmersion i] [i.IsOver (Spk k)]
    (L : Z.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank Z L 1) (j : ℕ) :
    Alg.Interw (totalPushOn (opsV4 k) i)
      (lineChern k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj L) (hasConstantRank_pullback X i L 1 hL) j)
      (lineChern k L hL j)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lineChern, chernLineValOn]
  by_cases h0 : j = 0
  · rw [if_pos h0, if_pos h0]; exact Alg.Interw.one
  · by_cases h1 : j = 1
    · rw [if_neg h0, if_neg h0, if_pos h1, if_pos h1]
      intro v
      exact LinearMap.congr_fun ((cpV4 k).cap_push i L hL) v
    · rw [if_neg h0, if_neg h0, if_neg h1, if_neg h1]; exact Alg.Interw.zero

name: GRRBlueprintV4.interw_tdLine
statement:
theorem interw_tdLine (i : X ⟶ Z) [IsClosedImmersion i] [i.IsOver (Spk k)]
    (L : Z.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank Z L 1) :
    Alg.Interw (totalPushOn (opsV4 k) i)
      (tdLine k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj L) (hasConstantRank_pullback X i L 1 hL))
      (tdLine k L hL)
proof:
:=
  Alg.Interw.tdFromChern (totalPushOn_degPres k i) (interw_lineChern k i L hL)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.grr_of_inputs
statement:
theorem grr_of_inputs (π : Z ⟶ Y) [π.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsProper π]
    (i : X ⟶ Z) [IsClosedImmersion i] [i.IsOver (Spk k)] [(i ≫ π).IsOver (Spk k)]
    (O1 : Z.Modules) (hO1 : HasConstantRank Z O1 1) (m : ℕ) (piG : G0 Z →+ G0 Y) {r : ℕ}
    (h : GRRInputsV4 k π i O1 hO1 m piG r) (x : K0 X) (w : K0 Y)
    (hw : k0ToG0 Y w = piG (finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X x))) :
    chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h.chExact w (fundClass k (W := Y)) =
      totalPushOn (opsV4 k) (i ≫ π)
        (((tdLine k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj O1)
          (hasConstantRank_pullback X i O1 1 hO1)) ^ m) (tauX k (closedPosV4 k) h.chExact i x))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h.resZ (finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X x))
  rw [h.caseI y w (by rw [hy]; exact hw), h.caseII x y hy]
  rw [← (Alg.Interw.pow (interw_tdLine k i O1 hO1) m) (tauX k (closedPosV4 k) h.chExact i x),
    totalPushOn_comp (opsV4 k) i π]
  rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.chernSeq_line
statement:
theorem chernSeq_line (hP : ProjBundleClosedPos (ProjectiveIntegral k)) (L : W.Modules)
    (hL : HasConstantRank W L 1) (j : ℕ) : chernSeq k hP L j = lineChern k L hL j
proof:

name: GRRBlueprintV4.tdFromChern_chernSeq_line

theorem tdFromChern_chernSeq_line (hP : ProjBundleClosedPos (ProjectiveIntegral k))

proof:

name: GRRBlueprintV4.rkOf_unit
statement: theorem rkOf_unit [Nonempty W] : rkOf (W := W) (tensorUnitSheaf W) = 1
proof:
:= by

    ⟨1, ⟨hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf⟩⟩
  unfold rkOf
  rw [dif_pos h]
  obtain ⟨x⟩ := ‹Nonempty W›

name: GRRBlueprintV4.chBundle_lof_zero
statement:

    (z : RationalDimChow W 0) :
    chBundle k hP E (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow W n) 0 z) =
      (rkOf E : ℚ) • DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow W n) 0 z
proof:
:= by
  unfold chBundle Alg.chFromChern

name: GRRBlueprintV4.RK0.iη_eq_generic
statement:
theorem iη_eq_generic (hr : HasConstantRank X (conormalSheaf i) 0) :
    i (genericPoint X) = genericPoint (space k n)
proof:
:= by
  let C := SchemeKTheory.F14.quasiregularCover k n i (projectiveSpace_regStalks k n) hX
  have hC : HasConstantRank X (conormalSheaf i) (coheight (i (genericPoint X))).toNat :=
    SchemeKTheory.F5.libConormal_hasConstantRank k n i C
  have h0 : (coheight (i (genericPoint X))).toNat = 0 := M7ASM.hasConstantRank_unique hC hr
  have hco : coheight (i (genericPoint X)) = 0 := by
    rw [SchemeKTheory.F12.coheight_eq_of_quasiregularCover k n i C, h0]; rfl
  have hmax : IsMax (i (genericPoint X)) := Order.coheight_eq_zero.mp hco
  have h1 : genericPoint (space k n) ⤳ i (genericPoint X) := genericPoint_specializes _
  have h2 : i (genericPoint X) ⤳ genericPoint (space k n) :=
    hmax (show i (genericPoint X) ≤ genericPoint (space k n) from h1)
  exact (h2.antisymm h1).eq

name: GRRBlueprintV4.RK0.surjective_of_rank_zero
statement: theorem surjective_of_rank_zero (hr : HasConstantRank X (conormalSheaf i) 0) : Surjective i
proof:
:= by
  have hη := iη_eq_generic k n i hX hr
  refine ⟨fun y ↦ ?_⟩
  have hcl : IsClosed (Set.range i) := i.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range
  have hmem : genericPoint (space k n) ∈ Set.range i := ⟨genericPoint X, hη⟩
  have : closure {genericPoint (space k n)} ⊆ Set.range i :=
    hcl.closure_subset_iff.mpr (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hmem)
  have hy : y ∈ closure {genericPoint (space k n)} := by
    rw [(genericPoint_spec (space k n)).def]; trivial
  exact this hy

name: GRRBlueprintV4.RK0.isIso_of_rank_zero
statement: theorem isIso_of_rank_zero (hr : HasConstantRank X (conormalSheaf i) 0) : IsIso i
proof:
:= by
  haveI := surjective_of_rank_zero k n i hX hr
  exact isIso_of_isClosedImmersion_of_surjective i

name: GRRBlueprintV4.RK0.caseII_rank_zero
statement:
theorem caseII_rank_zero (h : ChExact k (closedPosV4 k))
    (hr : HasConstantRank X (conormalSheaf i) 0) : CaseII k (closedPosV4 k) h i
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIntegral X := (Fact.out : D28.ProjectiveIntegral k X).1
  haveI : IsIso i := isIso_of_rank_zero k n i hX hr
  haveI : IsNoetherian (space k n) := SchemeProjectiveSpace.isNoetherian k n
  haveI := space_lft k n
  have injZ : Function.Injective (k0ToG0 (space k n)) :=
    (k0ToG0_bijective_of_projectiveIntegralK (space_member k n)
      (projectiveSpace_regStalks k n)).1
  exact CIIFZ.caseII_of_isIso k h i hr injZ

name: SchemeKTheory.rankAt_unit
statement:
theorem rankAt_unit (x : Y) :
    rankAt x (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf) = 1
proof:
:=
  (unitStalkLinearEquivAt x).finrank_eq.trans (Module.finrank_self _)

name: SchemeKTheory.free_finite_stalk_free
statement:
theorem free_finite_stalk_free (x : Y) (I : Type u) [Finite I] :
    Module.Free (Y.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((stalkLinearFunctor x).obj (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I)) ∧
      Module.Finite (Y.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((stalkLinearFunctor x).obj (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI hfree : Module.Free (Y.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((stalkLinearFunctor x).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)) :=
    Module.Free.of_equiv (unitStalkLinearEquivAt x).symm
  letI (i : I) : Module.Finite (Y.presheaf.stalk x)
      ((stalkLinearFunctor x).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)) :=
    Module.Finite.equiv (unitStalkLinearEquivAt x).symm
  let e₁ : (stalkLinearFunctor x).obj
        (∐ fun _ : I ↦ SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf) ≅
      ∐ fun _ : I ↦ (stalkLinearFunctor x).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf) :=
    PreservesCoproduct.iso (stalkLinearFunctor x)
      (fun _ : I ↦ SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)
  let e₂ : (∐ fun _ : I ↦ (stalkLinearFunctor x).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)) ≅
      ModuleCat.of (Y.presheaf.stalk x)
        (⨁ (i : I), (stalkLinearFunctor x).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)) :=
    ModuleCat.coprodIsoDirectSum
      (fun _ : I ↦ (stalkLinearFunctor x).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf))
  let e := (e₁.trans e₂).toLinearEquiv
  change Module.Free (Y.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((stalkLinearFunctor x).obj (∐ fun _ : I ↦ SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)) ∧
      Module.Finite (Y.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((stalkLinearFunctor x).obj (∐ fun _ : I ↦ SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf))
  letI hsum : Module.Free (Y.presheaf.stalk x)
      (⨁ (i : I), ((stalkLinearFunctor x).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf))) :=
    Module.Free.directSum (R := Y.presheaf.stalk x)
      (fun _ : I ↦ ((stalkLinearFunctor x).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)))
  exact ⟨Module.Free.of_equiv (M := ⨁ (i : I),
      ((stalkLinearFunctor x).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf))) e.symm,
    Module.Finite.equiv e.symm⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.free_finite_stalk
statement:
theorem free_finite_stalk (M : Y.Modules) (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y M) (x : Y) :
    Module.Free (Y.presheaf.stalk x) ((stalkLinearFunctor x).obj M) ∧
      Module.Finite (Y.presheaf.stalk x) ((stalkLinearFunctor x).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin⟩ := hM.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := hqfin
  have hcover : IsOpenCover q.X :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff Y q.X).mp q.coversTop
  have hxUnion : x ∈ ⋃ i, (q.X i : Set Y) := by
    rw [hcover.iSup_set_eq_univ]
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hxUnion
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := hxUnion
  let I := (q.generators i).I
  letI : (q.generators i).IsFiniteType :=
    SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType i
  letI : Finite I := by
    dsimp only [I]
    infer_instance
  let eOver : (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I).over (q.X i) ≅ M.over (q.X i) :=
    (SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso Y (q.X i) I).symm ≪≫ asIso (q.generators i).π
  let e := stalkFreeLinearEquivAtOfOverIso M x (q.X i) hxi I eOver
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := free_finite_stalk_free x I
  exact ⟨Module.Free.of_equiv e, Module.Finite.equiv e⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.rankAt_add
statement:
theorem rankAt_add (x : Y) {E F G : Y.Modules} {f : E ⟶ F} {g : F ⟶ G}
    (zero : f ≫ g = 0) (h : (ShortComplex.mk f g zero).ShortExact)
    (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y E) (hG : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y G) :
    rankAt x F = rankAt x E + rankAt x G
proof:
:= by
  let S := ShortComplex.mk f g zero
  have hS : (S.map (stalkLinearFunctor x)).ShortExact :=
    ShortComplex.ShortExact.map_of_exact h (stalkLinearFunctor x)
  obtain ⟨hE1, hE2⟩ := free_finite_stalk E hE x
  obtain ⟨hG1, hG2⟩ := free_finite_stalk G hG x
  letI : Module.Free (Y.presheaf.stalk x) ((S.map (stalkLinearFunctor x)).X₁) := hE1
  letI : Module.Finite (Y.presheaf.stalk x) ((S.map (stalkLinearFunctor x)).X₁) := hE2
  letI : Module.Free (Y.presheaf.stalk x) ((S.map (stalkLinearFunctor x)).X₃) := hG1
  letI : Module.Finite (Y.presheaf.stalk x) ((S.map (stalkLinearFunctor x)).X₃) := hG2
  exact ModuleCat.free_shortExact_finrank_add hS rfl rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.rankInt_exact
statement:
private theorem rankInt_exact (x : Y)
    (E F G : {M : Y.Modules // IsFiniteLocallyFree Y M})
    (h : ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn Y.Modules (IsFiniteLocallyFree Y) E F G) :
    rankInt x F = rankInt x E + rankInt x G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, g, zero, hS⟩ := h
  unfold rankInt
  rw [← Nat.cast_add]
  exact congrArg (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℤ)) (rankAt_add x zero hS E.2 G.2)

name: SchemeKTheory.k0RankAt_one
statement: theorem k0RankAt_one (x : Y) : k0RankAt x 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  change ExactGrothendieck.lift (rankInt x) (rankInt_exact x)
    (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ (tensorUnitObject Y)) = 1
  rw [ExactGrothendieck.lift_classOf]
  change ((rankAt x (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf) : ℕ) : ℤ) = 1
  rw [rankAt_unit]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.k0_nontrivial
statement: theorem k0_nontrivial [Nonempty Y] : Nontrivial (K0 Y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x⟩ := ‹Nonempty Y›
  refine ⟨⟨1, 0, fun h ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  have := congrArg (k0RankAt x) h
  rw [k0RankAt_one, map_zero] at this
  exact one_ne_zero this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.over_line
statement:
theorem over_line (m : ℕ) (U : Scheme.{u}) :
    (𝔸(LL.{u} m; Line U) ↘ U) = 𝔸(LL.{u} m; Line U) ↘ Line U ≫ lineProj U
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.stepHom_over
statement:
theorem stepHom_over (m : ℕ) (U : Scheme.{u}) :
    stepHom m U ≫ 𝔸(LL.{u} m; Line U) ↘ Line U ≫ lineProj U = 𝔸(LL.{u} (m + 1); U) ↘ U
proof:
:= by
  unfold stepHom
  rw [← Category.assoc, homOfVector_over, homOfVector_over]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.stepInv_over
statement:
theorem stepInv_over (m : ℕ) (U : Scheme.{u}) :
    stepInv m U ≫ 𝔸(LL.{u} (m + 1); U) ↘ U = 𝔸(LL.{u} m; Line U) ↘ Line U ≫ lineProj U
proof:
:= by
  unfold stepInv
  rw [homOfVector_over]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.stepHom_line
statement:
theorem stepHom_line (m : ℕ) (U : Scheme.{u}) :
    stepHom m U ≫ 𝔸(LL.{u} m; Line U) ↘ Line U =
      homOfVector (𝔸(LL.{u} (m + 1); U) ↘ U) (fun _ => coord U (ULift.up (Fin.last m)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold stepHom
  rw [homOfVector_over]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.stepHom_coord
statement:
theorem stepHom_coord (m : ℕ) (U : Scheme.{u}) (i : LL.{u} m) :
    (stepHom m U).appTop (coord (Line U) i) = coord U (ULift.up i.down.castSucc)
proof:
:= by
  unfold stepHom
  rw [homOfVector_appTop_coord]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.stepInv_coord_last
statement:
theorem stepInv_coord_last (m : ℕ) (U : Scheme.{u}) :
    (stepInv m U).appTop (coord U (ULift.up (Fin.last m))) =
      (𝔸(LL.{u} m; Line U) ↘ Line U).appTop (coord U PUnit.unit)
proof:
:= by
  unfold stepInv
  rw [homOfVector_appTop_coord]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.stepInv_coord_cast
statement:
theorem stepInv_coord_cast (m : ℕ) (U : Scheme.{u}) (j : Fin m) :
    (stepInv m U).appTop (coord U (ULift.up j.castSucc)) = coord (Line U) (ULift.up j)
proof:
:= by
  unfold stepInv
  rw [homOfVector_appTop_coord]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.stepHom_lineCoord
statement:
theorem stepHom_lineCoord (m : ℕ) (U : Scheme.{u}) :
    (stepHom m U).appTop ((𝔸(LL.{u} m; Line U) ↘ Line U).appTop (coord U PUnit.unit)) =
      coord U (ULift.up (Fin.last m))
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun f => Scheme.Hom.appTop f (coord U PUnit.unit)) (stepHom_line m U)
  simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, CommRingCat.comp_apply, homOfVector_appTop_coord] at h
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.stepInv_stepHom
statement: theorem stepInv_stepHom (m : ℕ) (U : Scheme.{u}) : stepInv m U ≫ stepHom m U = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply AffineSpace.hom_ext
  · apply AffineSpace.hom_ext
    · rw [Category.assoc, Category.id_comp]
      change stepInv m U ≫ stepHom m U ≫ 𝔸(LL.{u} m; Line U) ↘ Line U ≫ lineProj U = _
      rw [stepHom_over, stepInv_over]
    · intro i
      obtain ⟨⟩ := i
      rw [Category.assoc, Category.id_comp, stepHom_line, Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop]
      simp only [CommRingCat.comp_apply, homOfVector_appTop_coord]
      exact stepInv_coord_last m U
  · intro i
    obtain ⟨i⟩ := i
    rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop]
    simp only [CommRingCat.comp_apply, stepHom_coord]
    rw [stepInv_coord_cast]
    simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.stepHom_stepInv
statement: theorem stepHom_stepInv (m : ℕ) (U : Scheme.{u}) : stepHom m U ≫ stepInv m U = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply AffineSpace.hom_ext
  · rw [Category.id_comp, Category.assoc, stepInv_over, stepHom_over]
  · intro i
    obtain ⟨i⟩ := i
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop]
      simp only [CommRingCat.comp_apply]
      rw [stepInv_coord_last, stepHom_lineCoord]
      simp
    · rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop]
      simp only [CommRingCat.comp_apply]
      rw [stepInv_coord_cast, stepHom_coord]
      simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.tIso_over
statement:
theorem tIso_over : ∀ (m : ℕ) (U : Scheme.{u}),
    (tIso m U).hom ≫ 𝔸(LL.{u} m; U) ↘ U = towerProj m U
  | 0, U => by simp only [tIso, towerProj, Iso.symm_hom, asIso_inv]; exact @IsIso.inv_hom_id _ _ _ _ _ (isIsoOverZero U)
  | m + 1, U => by
    have ih
proof:
:= tIso_over m (Line U)
    simp only [tIso, towerProj, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc]
    show (tIso m (Line U)).hom ≫ (stepIso m U).inv ≫ 𝔸(LL.{u} (m + 1); U) ↘ U =
      towerProj m (Line U) ≫ lineProj U
    rw [← ih, Category.assoc]
    exact congrArg _ (stepInv_over m U)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.bc_fst
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem bc_fst (U : Scheme.{u}) {Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} (h : Y' ⟶ Y) :
    bc U h ≫ pullback.fst _ _ = pullback.fst _ _
proof:
:= by
  unfold bc pullback.map
  simp only [Category.comp_id]
  exact pullback.lift_fst _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.bc_snd
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem bc_snd (U : Scheme.{u}) {Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} (h : Y' ⟶ Y) :
    bc U h ≫ pullback.snd _ _ = pullback.snd _ _ ≫ h
proof:
:= by
  unfold bc pullback.map
  simp only [Category.comp_id]
  exact pullback.lift_snd _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.bc_isPullback
statement:
theorem bc_isPullback (U : Scheme.{u}) {Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} (h : Y' ⟶ Y) :
    IsPullback (bc U h) (pullback.snd _ _) (pullback.snd _ _) h
proof:
:= by
  refine (IsPullback.paste_horiz_iff (IsPullback.of_hasPullback (terminal.from U)
    (terminal.from Y)) (bc_snd U h)).mp ?_
  rw [bc_fst, terminal.comp_from]
  exact IsPullback.of_hasPullback _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.range_bc
statement:
theorem range_bc (U : Scheme.{u}) {Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} (h : Y' ⟶ Y) :
    Set.range (bc U h) = pullback.snd (terminal.from U) (terminal.from Y) ⁻¹' Set.range h
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (bc_isPullback U h).isoPullback_hom_fst]
  haveI : IsIso (bc_isPullback U h).isoPullback.hom := inferInstance
  rw [m6pb_range_iso_comp, Scheme.Pullback.range_fst]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.awayMap_surjective'
statement:
theorem awayMap_surjective' (hsurj : ∀ i, ∀ y ∈ ℬ i, ∃ x ∈ 𝒜 i, ψ x = y) {d : ℕ} (s : A)
    (hs : s ∈ 𝒜 d) : Function.Surjective (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map ψ s)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨m, x, hx, rfl⟩ := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_surjective
    ℬ (ψ.map_mem hs) z
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hax⟩ := hsurj _ x hx
  subst hax
  refine ⟨HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk 𝒜 hs m a ha, ?_⟩
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map_mk]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.isPullback_away'
statement:
theorem isPullback_away' {d : ℕ} (s : A) (hs : s ∈ 𝒜 d) (hd : 0 < d) :
    IsPullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map ψ s)))
      (Proj.awayι ℬ (ψ s) (ψ.map_mem hs) hd)
      (Proj.awayι 𝒜 s hs hd)
      (Proj.map ψ hirr)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsOpenImmersion.isPullback
  · exact Proj.awayι_comp_map ψ hirr hd s hs
  · simpa only [Proj.opensRange_awayι] using Proj.map_preimage_basicOpen ψ hirr s

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.isClosedImmersion_projMap'
statement:
theorem isClosedImmersion_projMap' (hsurj : ∀ i, ∀ y ∈ ℬ i, ∃ x ∈ 𝒜 i, ψ x = y) :
    IsClosedImmersion (Proj.map ψ hirr)
proof:
:= by
  let 𝒰 := Proj.affineOpenCover 𝒜
  apply IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.of_openCover (𝒰 := 𝒰.openCover)
  intro s
  have hsq := isPullback_away' 𝒜 ℬ ψ hirr (s.2 : A) s.2.2 s.1.2
  change IsClosedImmersion (pullback.snd (Proj.map ψ hirr)
    (Proj.awayι 𝒜 (s.2 : A) s.2.2 s.1.2))
  rw [← MorphismProperty.cancel_left_of_respectsIso @IsClosedImmersion
      hsq.flip.isoPullback.hom,
    hsq.flip.isoPullback_hom_snd]
  exact IsClosedImmersion.spec_of_surjective _
    (awayMap_surjective' 𝒜 ℬ ψ hsurj (s.2 : A) s.2.2)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.mem_range_projMap_iff'
statement:
theorem mem_range_projMap_iff' (hψ : Function.Surjective ψ) (x : Proj 𝒜) :
    x ∈ Set.range (Proj.map ψ hirr) ↔ RingHom.ker ψ ≤ x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩ a ha
    change ψ a ∈ y.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal
    have hqa : ψ a = 0 := ha
    rw [hqa]
    exact Ideal.zero_mem _
  · intro hIx
    have hcmap :
        (x.asHomogeneousIdeal.map ψ).toIdeal.comap ψ =
          x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal := by
      rw [HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_map,
        Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ hψ,
        ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot,
        sup_eq_left.mpr hIx]
    let y : Proj ℬ :=
      { asHomogeneousIdeal := x.asHomogeneousIdeal.map ψ
        isPrime := Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective hψ hIx
        not_irrelevant_le := by
          intro hirr'
          apply x.not_irrelevant_le
          rw [HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le]
          intro d hd a ha
          have hqa : ψ a ∈ HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ :=
            HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem ℬ hd (ψ.map_mem ha)
          have hqmap : ψ a ∈ (x.asHomogeneousIdeal.map ψ).toIdeal := hirr' hqa
          change a ∈ x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal
          rw [← hcmap]
          exact hqmap }
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    apply ProjectiveSpectrum.ext
    exact HomogeneousIdeal.ext hcmap

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.psiVars_homog
statement: theorem psiVars_homog (e : ℕ) (j : Fin (e + 2)) : (psiVars.{u} e j).IsHomogeneous 1
proof:
:= by
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j
  · simp only [psiVars, Fin.cons_zero]
    exact MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_zero _ _ _
  · simp only [psiVars, Fin.cons_succ]
    exact MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_X _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.psi_apply
statement:
theorem psi_apply (e : ℕ) (x : MvPolynomial (Fin (e + 2)) RZ.{u}) :
    psi e x = MvPolynomial.aeval (psiVars.{u} e) x
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.psi_surj
statement:
theorem psi_surj (e : ℕ) : ∀ i, ∀ y ∈ grading RZ.{u} e i, ∃ x ∈ grading RZ.{u} (e + 1) i,
    psi e x = y
proof:
:= by
  intro i y hy
  refine ⟨MvPolynomial.rename Fin.succ y, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [MvPolynomial.mem_homogeneousSubmodule] at hy ⊢
    exact hy.rename_isHomogeneous
  · rw [psi_apply, MvPolynomial.aeval_rename]
    have : (psiVars.{u} e) ∘ Fin.succ = MvPolynomial.X := by
      funext j; simp [psiVars]
    rw [this]
    exact MvPolynomial.aeval_X_left_apply y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.psi_surjective
statement: theorem psi_surjective (e : ℕ) : Function.Surjective (psi.{u} e)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  refine ⟨MvPolynomial.rename Fin.succ y, ?_⟩
  rw [psi_apply, MvPolynomial.aeval_rename]
  have : (psiVars.{u} e) ∘ Fin.succ = MvPolynomial.X := by
    funext j; simp [psiVars]
  rw [this]
  exact MvPolynomial.aeval_X_left_apply y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.psi_irr
statement:
theorem psi_irr (e : ℕ) : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading RZ.{u} e) ≤
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading RZ.{u} (e + 1))).map (psi e)
proof:
:= by
  rw [HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le]
  intro i hi y hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := psi_surj e i y hy
  exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (psi e) (HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem _ hi hx)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.psi_ker
statement:
theorem psi_ker (e : ℕ) : RingHom.ker (psi.{u} e) =
    Ideal.span {(MvPolynomial.X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin (e + 2)) RZ.{u})}
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : (psi.{u} e).toRingHom = (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : MvPolynomial (Fin (e + 1)) RZ.{u})).comp
      (MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv RZ.{u} (e + 1)).toRingEquiv.toRingHom := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro r; simp [psi_apply, MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv_apply]
    · intro j
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j
      · simp [psi_apply, psiVars, MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv_X_zero]
      · simp [psi_apply, psiVars, MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv_X_succ]
  ext f
  rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  change psi e f = 0 ↔ _
  have h1 : psi e f = (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : MvPolynomial (Fin (e + 1)) RZ.{u}))
      (MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv RZ.{u} (e + 1) f) := RingHom.congr_fun hcomp f
  rw [h1, ← RingHom.mem_ker, Polynomial.ker_evalRingHom, Ideal.mem_span_singleton, map_zero,
    sub_zero]
  rw [← MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv_X_zero (R := RZ.{u}) (n := e + 1)]
  exact map_dvd_iff (MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv RZ.{u} (e + 1))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.mem_range_projMap_psi
statement:
theorem mem_range_projMap_psi (e : ℕ) (x : Proj (grading RZ.{u} (e + 1))) :
    x ∈ Set.range (Proj.map (psi.{u} e) (psi_irr e)) ↔
      (MvPolynomial.X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin (e + 2)) RZ.{u}) ∈ x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_range_projMap_iff' _ _ _ _ (psi_surjective e), psi_ker, Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.tIsoW_over
statement:
theorem tIsoW_over (e : ℕ) (U : Scheme.{u}) :
    (tIsoW e U).hom ≫ pullback.fst _ _ = towerProj e U
proof: := tIso_over e U

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.Jchart_π
statement:
theorem Jchart_π (U : Scheme.{u}) (e : ℕ) (a : Fin (e + 1)) :
    Jchart U e a ≫ Pπ U e = towerProj e U
proof:
:= by
  unfold Jchart
  rw [Category.assoc]
  have h : Jw U e a ≫ Pπ U e = pullback.fst _ _ :=
    bc_fst U (phi.{u} e a ≫ m6pb_stdChart RZ.{u} e a)
  rw [h, tIsoW_over]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.range_Jchart
statement:
theorem range_Jchart (U : Scheme.{u}) (e : ℕ) (a : Fin (e + 1)) :
    Set.range (Jchart U e a) = Pσ U e ⁻¹' (coordinateOpen RZ.{u} e a : Set (space RZ.{u} e))
proof:
:= by
  unfold Jchart
  rw [m6pb_range_iso_comp]
  have h := range_bc U (phi.{u} e a ≫ m6pb_stdChart RZ.{u} e a)
  change Set.range (bc U (phi.{u} e a ≫ m6pb_stdChart RZ.{u} e a)) = _
  rw [h, m6pb_range_iso_comp, m6pb_range_stdChart]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.exists_chart
statement:
theorem exists_chart (U : Scheme.{u}) (e : ℕ) (x : Pj U e) :
    ∃ a : Fin (e + 1), x ∈ Set.range (Jchart U e a)
proof:
:= by
  have hx : Pσ U e x ∈ (⊤ : (space RZ.{u} e).Opens) := trivial
  rw [← coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top] at hx
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp hx
  exact ⟨a, by rw [range_Jchart]; exact ha⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.Pι_π
statement: theorem Pι_π (U : Scheme.{u}) (e : ℕ) : Pι U e ≫ Pπ U (e + 1) = Pπ U e
proof:
:=
  bc_fst U (psiMap.{u} e)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.range_Pι
statement:
theorem range_Pι (U : Scheme.{u}) (e : ℕ) :
    Set.range (Pι U e) = (Set.range (Jchart U (e + 1) 0))ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  have h := range_bc U (psiMap.{u} e)
  unfold Pι
  rw [h, range_Jchart]
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_compl_iff, SetLike.mem_coe]
  change _ ∈ Set.range (Proj.map (psi.{u} e) (psi_irr e)) ↔ _
  rw [mem_range_projMap_psi]
  constructor
  · intro h hx
    exact ((Proj.mem_basicOpen _ _ _).mp hx) h
  · intro h
    by_contra hc
    exact h ((Proj.mem_basicOpen _ _ _).mpr hc)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.terminal_from_space
statement:
theorem terminal_from_space (e : ℕ) :
    terminal.from (space RZ.{u} e) =
      toSpec RZ.{u} e ≫ terminal.from (Spec (CommRingCat.of RZ.{u}))
proof:
:=
  (terminal.comp_from _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.Pπ_relDim
statement: theorem Pπ_relDim (e : ℕ) : PureRelDim (Pπ U e) e
proof:
:= by
  letI : (Pj U e).Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) := ⟨Pπ U e ≫ U ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)⟩
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (Pj U e ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (Pπ U e ≫ U ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
    infer_instance
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨a, v, rfl⟩ := exists_chart U e x
  have hv : flatPullbackCoeff (Pπ U e) (Jchart U e a v) ≠ 0 := hx
  letI := towerOver K e U
  haveI := tower_lft K e U
  have key := m6pb_pureRelDim_transfer K (Pπ U e) (Jchart U e a) (towerProj e U) (𝟙 U)
    (by rw [Jchart_π, Category.comp_id]) (towerPureRelDim K e U) v hv
  exact key

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.isTower_trivialProjective
statement:
theorem isTower_trivialProjective : IsTower (trivialProjective U) where
  iso0
proof:
:= inferInstanceAs (IsIso (Pπ U 0))
  ι_closed := fun e => inferInstanceAs (IsClosedImmersion (Pι U e))
  j_open := fun e => inferInstanceAs (IsOpenImmersion (Jchart U (e + 1) 0))
  ι_π := fun e => Pι_π U e
  j_π := fun e => Jchart_π U (e + 1) 0
  range_eq := fun e => range_Pι U e
  flat := fun e => inferInstanceAs (Flat (Pπ U e))
  qc := fun e => inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact (Pπ U e))
  lft := fun e => inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType (Pπ U e))
  relDim := fun e => Pπ_relDim K U e

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F17.generation_trivialProjective
statement:
theorem generation_trivialProjective [CompactSpace U] (e m : ℕ) :
    letI
proof:
:= isTower_trivialProjective K U
    ∀ D ∈ dimensionCycles ((trivialProjective U).P e) m,
      ∃ N : ℕ, N ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ C ∈ genSet (trivialProjective U) e m,
        (N : ℤ) • D - C ∈ relC ((trivialProjective U).P e) m := by
  letI := isTower_trivialProjective K U
  exact generation (trivialProjective U) K e m

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.basicOpenOverlapCover_transition
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem basicOpenOverlapCover_transition
    (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c ≫ C.transition i j =
      C.localTransition i j c
proof:
:=
  Scheme.Cover.ι_glueMorphisms _ _ _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transition_toAmbient
statement:
theorem transition_toAmbient (i j : C.I) :
    C.overlapToChart i j ≫ C.chartToAmbient i =
      C.transition i j ≫
        C.overlapToChart j i ≫ C.chartToAmbient j
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.Cover.hom_ext (C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j)
  intro c
  simpa only [Category.assoc,
    basicOpenOverlapCover_transition_assoc] using
    C.localTransition_toAmbient i j c

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.chartToRight_eq_chartToLeft_self
statement:
theorem chartToRight_eq_chartToLeft_self
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i i) :
    c.chartToRight = c.chartToLeft
proof:
:= by
  unfold chartToRight chartToLeft rightRestriction leftRestriction
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.localTransition_self
statement:
theorem localTransition_self
    (i : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i i) :
    C.localTransition i i c =
      (C.basicOpenOverlapCover i i).f c
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (C.overlapToChart i i)).1
  rw [C.localTransition_toChart,
    c.chartToRight_eq_chartToLeft_self,
    C.commonBasicOpenChartIso_hom_chartToLeft]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transition_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transition_self (i : C.I) :
    C.transition i i = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.Cover.hom_ext (C.basicOpenOverlapCover i i)
  intro c
  simpa only [basicOpenOverlapCover_transition,
    Category.comp_id] using C.localTransition_self i c

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.overlapIso_hom_toSecondChart
statement:
theorem overlapIso_hom_toSecondChart (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (i j : C'.I) :
    (overlapIso e C' i j).hom ≫
        (C'.transition i j ≫ C'.overlapToChart j i) =
      ((transport e C').transition i j ≫
        (transport e C').overlapToChart j i) ≫
          (chartIso e C' j).hom
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ((transport e C').transition i j ≫
        (overlapIso e C' j i).hom) ≫ C'.overlapToChart j i := by
          simpa only [Category.assoc] using
            congrArg (fun f ↦ f ≫ C'.overlapToChart j i)
              (overlapIso_transition e C' i j)
    _ = _ := by
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using
        congrArg (fun f ↦ (transport e C').transition i j ≫ f)
          (overlapIso_hom_toChart e C' j i)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistOverlapCompat_of_components
statement:
theorem transportTwistOverlapCompat_of_components (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    (h : ∀ (i j : C'.I)
      (c : (transport e C').CommonBasicOpen i j),
      (twistOverlapNaturalityLeft e C' i j).over
          ((transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j c) =
        (twistOverlapNaturalityRight e C' i j).over
          ((transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j c)) :
    TransportTwistOverlapCompat e C'
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext_of_over_coversTop
    ((transport e C').overlap i j)
    (fun c : (transport e C').CommonBasicOpen i j ↦
      (transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j c)
    ((transport e C').twistComparisonOpen_coversTop i j)
    _ _ (fun c ↦ h i j c)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistOverlapCompat_iff_components
statement:
theorem transportTwistOverlapCompat_iff_components (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') :
    TransportTwistOverlapCompat e C' ↔
      ∀ (i j : C'.I) (c : (transport e C').CommonBasicOpen i j),
        (twistOverlapNaturalityLeft e C' i j).over
            ((transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j c) =
          (twistOverlapNaturalityRight e C' i j).over
            ((transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j c)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h i j c
    exact congrArg (fun f ↦ f.over ((transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j c))
      (h i j)
  · exact transportTwistOverlapCompat_of_components e C'

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechIntersection_isNoetherianRing
statement:
theorem coordinateCechIntersection_isNoetherianRing
    (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    IsNoetherianRing
      Γ((coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).toScheme, ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsAffine (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).toScheme :=
    coordinateCechIntersection_isAffine k n p a
  exact IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian
    ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).toScheme⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingCechIntersection_isFinitePresentation
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingCechIntersection_isFinitePresentation
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).ι).obj
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d)).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  letI : (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).IsFinitePresentation :=
    projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFinitePresentation k n d
  exact AlgebraicGeometry.isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor
    (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).ι (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingCechIntersection_isQuasicoherent
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingCechIntersection_isQuasicoherent
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).ι).obj
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d)).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  letI :
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).ι).obj
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d)).IsFinitePresentation :=
    projectiveTwistingCechIntersection_isFinitePresentation k n d p a
  infer_instance

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.gradedMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gradedMap_apply {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) (p : Polynomial R n) :
    gradedMap f n p = MvPolynomial.map f p
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.gradedMap_coordinate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gradedMap_coordinate {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    gradedMap f n (coordinate R n i) = coordinate S n i
proof:
:= by
  simp [gradedMap, coordinate]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.irrelevant_le_map_gradedMap
statement:
theorem irrelevant_le_map_gradedMap {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading S n) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading R n)).map (gradedMap f n)
proof:
:= by
  refine (HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_irrelevant_le (grading S n)).2 ?_
  intro d hd p hp
  have hpX : p ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range (MvPolynomial.X (R := S))) := by
    rw [show Set.range (MvPolynomial.X (R := S)) =
        MvPolynomial.X '' (Set.univ : Set (Fin (n + 1))) by simp]
    rw [MvPolynomial.mem_ideal_span_X_image]
    intro m hm
    have hdeg : m.degree = d := by
      rw [Finsupp.degree_eq_weight_one]
      exact hp (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hm)
    have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by
      intro hm0
      subst m
      simp at hdeg
      omega
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Finsupp.ne_iff.mp hm0
    exact ⟨i, Set.mem_univ _, hi⟩
  apply (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_) hpX
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  simpa [gradedMap, coordinate] using
    Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (gradedMap f n)
      (HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem (grading R n) Nat.zero_lt_one
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.degreeZeroEquiv_gradedMap
statement:
theorem degreeZeroEquiv_gradedMap {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) :
    (degreeZeroEquiv S n).toRingHom.comp
        (Proj.degreeZeroMap (gradedMap f n)) =
      f.comp (degreeZeroEquiv R n).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  exact MvPolynomial.constantCoeff_map f p.1

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.map_toSpec
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem map_toSpec {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) :
    map f n ≫ toSpec R n = toSpec S n ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)
proof:
:= by
  change Proj.map (gradedMap f n) (irrelevant_le_map_gradedMap f n) ≫
      (Proj.toSpecZero (grading R n) ≫
        Spec.map (degreeZeroEquiv R n).symm.toCommRingCatIso.hom) =
    (Proj.toSpecZero (grading S n) ≫
        Spec.map (degreeZeroEquiv S n).symm.toCommRingCatIso.hom) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)
  rw [← Category.assoc, Proj.map_toSpecZero]
  rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  congr 1
  ext r
  simp [Proj.degreeZeroMap, gradedMap, degreeZeroEquiv]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.preimage_coordinateOpen
statement:
theorem preimage_coordinateOpen {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    map f n ⁻¹ᵁ coordinateOpen R n i = coordinateOpen S n i
proof:
:= by
  change Proj.map (gradedMap f n) (irrelevant_le_map_gradedMap f n) ⁻¹ᵁ
      Proj.basicOpen (grading R n) (coordinate R n i) =
    Proj.basicOpen (grading S n) (coordinate S n i)
  rw [Proj.map_preimage_basicOpen]
  congr 1
  exact gradedMap_coordinate f n i

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateAwayι_comp_map
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem coordinateAwayι_comp_map {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Proj.awayι (grading S n) (gradedMap f n (coordinate R n i))
        ((gradedMap f n).map_mem (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i)) Nat.zero_lt_one ≫ map f n =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (coordinateAwayMap f n i)) ≫
        Proj.awayι (grading R n) (coordinate R n i)
          (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i) Nat.zero_lt_one
proof:
:= by
  exact Proj.awayι_comp_map (gradedMap f n) (irrelevant_le_map_gradedMap f n)
    Nat.zero_lt_one (coordinate R n i) (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.algebraBaseChangeMap_toSpec

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.mul_mem_span_of_mul_mem_span
statement:
private theorem mul_mem_span_of_mul_mem_span {A B : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    (s : Set B) (w : B) (h : ∀ x ∈ s, w * x ∈ Submodule.span A s) :
    ∀ x ∈ Submodule.span A s, w * x ∈ Submodule.span A s
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx => exact h x hx
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [mul_smul_comm]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hx

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.zpow_mem_span_of_relation
statement:
theorem zpow_mem_span_of_relation {A B : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (a : Fin r → A) (z : Bˣ)
    (hz : Polynomial.aeval (z : B)
      (projectiveBundleRelationPolynomial A r a) = 0)
    (ha : IsUnit (a ⟨0, hr⟩)) (n : ℤ) :
    ((z ^ n : Bˣ) : B) ∈
      Submodule.span A (Set.range fun i : Fin r ↦ (z : B) ^ (i : ℕ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ : ∃ s, r = s + 1 := ⟨r - 1, by omega⟩
  have ha0 : IsUnit (a 0) := ha
  set M := Submodule.span A (Set.range fun i : Fin (s + 1) ↦ (z : B) ^ (i : ℕ)) with hM
  have hpow : ∀ i ≤ s, (z : B) ^ i ∈ M := fun i hi ↦
    Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨i, by omega⟩, rfl⟩
  have hrel : (z : B) ^ (s + 1) + ∑ i : Fin (s + 1), a i • (z : B) ^ (i : ℕ) = 0 := by
    have h := hz
    simp only [projectiveBundleRelationPolynomial,
      projectiveBundleRelationLower, map_add, map_pow,
      Polynomial.aeval_X, map_sum, map_mul, Polynomial.aeval_C] at h
    simpa only [Algebra.smul_def] using h
  
  have hzr : (z : B) ^ (s + 1) ∈ M := by
    rw [eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hrel]
    exact neg_mem (sum_mem fun i _ ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hpow i (by omega)))
  
  have hmulz : ∀ x ∈ M, (z : B) * x ∈ M := by
    refine mul_mem_span_of_mul_mem_span _ _ ?_
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [← pow_succ']
    by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) + 1 ≤ s
    · exact hpow _ hi
    · have : (i : ℕ) + 1 = s + 1 := by omega
      rw [this]; exact hzr
  
  have hinv : ((z⁻¹ : Bˣ) : B) ∈ M := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ] at hrel
    have e : (z : B) ^ s + (a 0 • ((z⁻¹ : Bˣ) : B) +
        ∑ i : Fin s, a i.succ • (z : B) ^ (i : ℕ)) =
        ((z⁻¹ : Bˣ) : B) * ((z : B) ^ (s + 1) + (a 0 • (z : B) ^ ((0 : Fin (s + 1)) : ℕ) +
          ∑ i : Fin s, a i.succ • (z : B) ^ ((i.succ : Fin (s + 1)) : ℕ))) := by
      rw [mul_add, mul_add, Finset.mul_sum, pow_succ', Units.inv_mul_cancel_left,
        Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, mul_smul_comm, mul_one]
      congr 2
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
      rw [Fin.val_succ, pow_succ', mul_smul_comm, Units.inv_mul_cancel_left]
    rw [hrel, mul_zero] at e
    have h0 : a 0 • ((z⁻¹ : Bˣ) : B) ∈ M := by
      have : a 0 • ((z⁻¹ : Bˣ) : B) =
          -((z : B) ^ s + ∑ i : Fin s, a i.succ • (z : B) ^ (i : ℕ)) := by
        linear_combination e
      rw [this]
      exact neg_mem (add_mem (hpow s le_rfl)
        (sum_mem fun i _ ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hpow i (by omega))))
    have := Submodule.smul_mem M (↑ha0.unit⁻¹ : A) h0
    rwa [smul_smul, IsUnit.val_inv_mul, one_smul] at this
  
  have hmulzi : ∀ x ∈ M, ((z⁻¹ : Bˣ) : B) * x ∈ M := by
    refine mul_mem_span_of_mul_mem_span _ _ ?_
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := i
    cases i with
    | zero => simpa using hinv
    | succ k =>
      change ((z⁻¹ : Bˣ) : B) * (z : B) ^ (k + 1) ∈ M
      rw [pow_succ', Units.inv_mul_cancel_left]
      exact hpow k (by omega)
  refine Int.induction_on n ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simpa using hpow 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
  · intro k hk
    rw [zpow_add_one, Units.val_mul, mul_comm]
    exact hmulz _ hk
  · intro k hk
    rw [zpow_sub_one, Units.val_mul, mul_comm]
    exact hmulzi _ hk

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.overEquiv_functor_additive

name: AlgebraicGeometry.pullback_map_shortExact_of_finiteLocallyFree_right
statement:
theorem pullback_map_shortExact_of_finiteLocallyFree_right
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (S : ShortComplex Y.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (h₃ : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree Y S.X₃) :
    (S.map (Scheme.Modules.pullback f)).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  choose V hxV hsplit using
    Scheme.Modules.exists_open_splitting_of_shortExact_finiteLocallyFree_right Y S hS h₃
  let P := S.map (Scheme.Modules.pullback f)
  let U : Y → X.Opens := fun y ↦ f ⁻¹ᵁ V y
  have hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop U := by
    apply (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := X) U).2
    rw [TopologicalSpace.IsOpenCover, eq_top_iff]
    intro x _
    exact Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨f.base x, hxV (f.base x)⟩
  apply Scheme.Modules.shortExact_of_restrict_cover X P U hU
  intro y
  let g := f ∣_ V y
  let s : (S.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (V y).ι)).Splitting :=
    Scheme.Modules.restrictSplittingOfOverSplitting S (V y) (hsplit y).some
  have hG : ((S.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (V y).ι)).map
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback g)).ShortExact :=
    (s.map (Scheme.Modules.pullback g)).shortExact
  have hright :
      (S.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (V y).ι ⋙
        Scheme.Modules.pullback g)).ShortExact := by
    simpa only [ShortComplex.map_comp] using hG
  have hleft :
      (S.map (Scheme.Modules.pullback f ⋙
        Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U y).ι)).ShortExact :=
    ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso
      (S.mapNatIso (pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso f (U y).ι (V y).ι g
        (morphismRestrict_ι f (V y)).symm)).symm hright
  simpa only [P, ShortComplex.map_comp] using hleft

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackK0Object_exact
statement:
theorem pullbackK0Object_exact
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (A B C : {M : Y.Modules // IsFiniteLocallyFree Y M})
    (h : ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn Y.Modules
      (IsFiniteLocallyFree Y) A B C) :
    ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules
      (IsFiniteLocallyFree X) (flatPullbackK0Object f A)
      (flatPullbackK0Object f B) (flatPullbackK0Object f C)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, zero, hshort⟩ := h
  let T : ShortComplex Y.Modules := ShortComplex.mk a b zero
  let P := T.map (Scheme.Modules.pullback f)
  exact ⟨P.f, P.g, P.zero,
    pullback_map_shortExact_of_finiteLocallyFree_right f T hshort C.2⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackK0_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pullbackK0_classOf
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (E : Y.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y E) :
    pullbackK0 f (k0ClassOf Y E hE) =
      k0ClassOf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E)
        (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global f E hE)
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.map_classOf (flatPullbackK0Object f)
    (pullbackK0Object_exact f) ⟨E, hE⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackK0_eq_flatPullbackK0
statement:
theorem pullbackK0_eq_flatPullbackK0
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [Flat f] :
    pullbackK0 f = flatPullbackK0 f
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackK0_id
statement:
theorem pullbackK0_id (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    pullbackK0 (𝟙 X) = AddMonoidHom.id (K0 X)
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
  rintro ⟨E, hE⟩
  change pullbackK0 (𝟙 X) (k0ClassOf X E hE) = k0ClassOf X E hE
  rw [pullbackK0_classOf]
  exact k0ClassOf_iso X _ hE ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackId X).app E)

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackK0_comp
statement:
theorem pullbackK0_comp
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    (pullbackK0 f).comp (pullbackK0 g) = pullbackK0 (f ≫ g)
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
  rintro ⟨E, hE⟩
  change pullbackK0 f (pullbackK0 g (k0ClassOf Z E hE)) =
    pullbackK0 (f ≫ g) (k0ClassOf Z E hE)
  rw [pullbackK0_classOf, pullbackK0_classOf, pullbackK0_classOf]
  exact k0ClassOf_iso X _ _ ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f g).app E)

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackK0_comp_apply
statement:
theorem pullbackK0_comp_apply
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (x : K0 Z) :
    pullbackK0 f (pullbackK0 g x) = pullbackK0 (f ≫ g) x
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (pullbackK0_comp f g) x

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackK0_one
statement:
theorem pullbackK0_one
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    pullbackK0 f 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  let hY := tensorUnitSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree Y
  let hX := tensorUnitSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree X
  change pullbackK0 f (k0ClassOf Y (tensorUnitSheaf Y) hY) =
    k0ClassOf X (tensorUnitSheaf X) hX
  rw [pullbackK0_classOf]
  let e :
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (tensorUnitSheaf Y) ≅
        tensorUnitSheaf X :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).mapIso
        (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
          (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)).symm ≪≫
      AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f PUnit ≪≫
      SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)
  exact k0ClassOf_iso X _ hX e

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackK0RingHom_toAddMonoidHom
statement:
theorem pullbackK0RingHom_toAddMonoidHom
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (pullbackK0RingHom f).toAddMonoidHom = pullbackK0 f
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
  intro E
  change (pullbackK0RingHom f) (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ E) =
    (pullbackK0 f) (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ E)
  unfold pullbackK0RingHom pullbackK0
  rw [k0RingLift_classOf, ExactGrothendieck.map_classOf]

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackK0RingHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pullbackK0RingHom_apply
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : K0 Y) :
    pullbackK0RingHom f x = pullbackK0 f x
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (pullbackK0RingHom_toAddMonoidHom f) x

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackK0RingHom_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pullbackK0RingHom_classOf
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (E : Y.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y E) :
    pullbackK0RingHom f (k0ClassOf Y E hE) =
      k0ClassOf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E)
        (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global f E hE)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pullbackK0RingHom_apply, pullbackK0_classOf]

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackK0_mul
statement:
theorem pullbackK0_mul
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (x y : K0 Y) :
    pullbackK0 f (x * y) = pullbackK0 f x * pullbackK0 f y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pullbackK0RingHom_apply, ← pullbackK0RingHom_apply,
    ← pullbackK0RingHom_apply]
  exact map_mul (pullbackK0RingHom f) x y

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackK0RingHom_id
statement:
theorem pullbackK0RingHom_id (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    pullbackK0RingHom (𝟙 X) = RingHom.id (K0 X)

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackK0RingHom_comp
statement:
theorem pullbackK0RingHom_comp
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    (pullbackK0RingHom f).comp (pullbackK0RingHom g) =
      pullbackK0RingHom (f ≫ g)

:= by

  rw [RingHom.comp_apply, pullbackK0RingHom_apply, pullbackK0RingHom_apply,
    pullbackK0RingHom_apply, pullbackK0_comp_apply]

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackK0RingHom_eq_flatPullbackK0RingHom
statement:

    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [Flat f] :

    pullbackK0_eq_flatPullbackK0]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.isoTrans_hom_naturality
statement:
theorem isoTrans_hom_naturality
    {C : Type*} [Category C]
    {A₁ A₂ B₁ B₂ D₁ D₂ : C}
    (f : A₁ ⟶ A₂) (g : B₁ ⟶ B₂) (h : D₁ ⟶ D₂)
    (a₁ : A₁ ≅ B₁) (a₂ : A₂ ≅ B₂)
    (b₁ : B₁ ≅ D₁) (b₂ : B₂ ≅ D₂)
    (ha : f ≫ a₂.hom = a₁.hom ≫ g)
    (hb : g ≫ b₂.hom = b₁.hom ≫ h) :
    f ≫ (a₂ ≪≫ b₂).hom = (a₁ ≪≫ b₁).hom ≫ h
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [reassoc_of% ha]
  rw [hb]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.isoOpensRange_inv_preimage_preimage

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.isoOpensRange_hom_preimage

theorem isoOpensRange_hom_preimage

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.iso_symm_hom_preimage_inv_preimage
statement:
theorem iso_symm_hom_preimage_inv_preimage
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (e : X ≅ Y) (U : Y.Opens) :
    U = e.symm.hom ⁻¹ᵁ (e.symm.inv ⁻¹ᵁ U)
