name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitRestriction_eqToIso_naturality
statement:
theorem pushedUnitRestriction_eqToIso_naturality
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {U U' V V' : X.Opens}
    (hU : U = U') (hV : V = V') (h : V ≤ U) (h' : V' ≤ U') :
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction h ≫
        (eqToIso (congrArg
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X) hV)).hom =
      (eqToIso (congrArg
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X) hU)).hom ≫
        SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction h'
proof:
:= by
  subst U'
  subst V'
  simp only [eqToIso_refl, Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id,
    Category.id_comp]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitPiCastIso_naturality
statement:
theorem pushedUnitPiCastIso_naturality
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {ι κ : Type u} [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    (U U' : ι → Y.Opens) (V V' : κ → Y.Opens)
    (hU : ∀ i, U i = U' i) (hV : ∀ k, V k = V' k)
    (s : κ → ι) (h : ∀ k, V k ≤ U (s k))
    (h' : ∀ k, V' k ≤ U' (s k)) :
    pushedUnitPiRestrictionMap U V s h ≫
        (pushedUnitPiCastIso V V' hV).hom =
      (pushedUnitPiCastIso U U' hU).hom ≫
        pushedUnitPiRestrictionMap U' V' s h'
proof:
:= by
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro k
  simp only [Category.assoc, pushedUnitPiRestrictionMap,
    pushedUnitPiCastIso]
  rw [Pi.mapIso_hom_π]
  conv_lhs => rw [← Category.assoc, Pi.lift_π]
  slice_rhs 2 3 => rw [Pi.lift_π]
  rw [Pi.mapIso_hom_π_assoc]
  rw [Category.assoc]
  rw [pushedUnitRestriction_eqToIso_naturality
    (hU (s k)) (hV k) _ _]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitPiInversePreimageIso_naturality
statement:
theorem pushedUnitPiInversePreimageIso_naturality
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {ι κ : Type u} [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    (e : X ≅ Y) (U : ι → Y.Opens) (V : κ → Y.Opens)
    (s : κ → ι) (h : ∀ k, V k ≤ U (s k)) :
    pushedUnitPiRestrictionMap U V s h ≫
        (pushedUnitPiInversePreimageIso e V).hom =
      (pushedUnitPiInversePreimageIso e U).hom ≫
        pushedUnitPiRestrictionMap
          (fun i ↦ e.symm.hom ⁻¹ᵁ (e.symm.inv ⁻¹ᵁ U i))
          (fun k ↦ e.symm.hom ⁻¹ᵁ (e.symm.inv ⁻¹ᵁ V k)) s
          (fun k ↦ e.symm.hom.preimage_mono
            (e.symm.inv.preimage_mono (h k)))
proof:
:= by
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro k
  simp only [Category.assoc, pushedUnitPiRestrictionMap,
    pushedUnitPiInversePreimageIso]
  rw [Pi.mapIso_hom_π]
  conv_lhs => rw [← Category.assoc, Pi.lift_π]
  slice_rhs 2 3 => rw [Pi.lift_π]
  rw [Pi.mapIso_hom_π_assoc]
  rw [Category.assoc]
  rw [pushedUnitRestriction_eqToIso_naturality
    (iso_symm_hom_preimage_inv_preimage e (U (s k)))
    (iso_symm_hom_preimage_inv_preimage e (V k)) _ _]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitPiRestrictOpen_naturality
statement:
theorem pushedUnitPiRestrictOpen_naturality
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι κ : Type u} [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    (W : X.Opens) (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : κ → X.Opens)
    (s : κ → ι) (h : ∀ k, V k ≤ U (s k)) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).map
          (pushedUnitPiRestrictionMap U V s h) ≫
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitPiRestrictIso W V).hom =
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitPiRestrictIso W U).hom ≫
        pushedUnitPiRestrictionMap
          (fun i ↦ W.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U i)
          (fun k ↦ W.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V k) s
          (fun k ↦ W.ι.preimage_mono (h k))
proof:
:= by
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro k
  simp only [Category.assoc, pushedUnitPiRestrictionMap, Pi.lift_π,
    Iso.trans_hom, Pi.mapIso_hom_π_assoc,
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitPiRestrictIso,
    PreservesProduct.iso_hom, piComparison_comp_π_assoc]
  rw [Pi.mapIso_hom_π]
  rw [piComparison_comp_π_assoc]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc, Pi.lift_π]
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  rw [Category.assoc]
  rw [SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestrictIso_naturality]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitPiRestrictIsoOfIso_naturality
statement:
theorem pushedUnitPiRestrictIsoOfIso_naturality
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {ι κ : Type u} [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    (e : X ≅ Y) (U : ι → Y.Opens) (V : κ → Y.Opens)
    (s : κ → ι) (h : ∀ k, V k ≤ U (s k)) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor e.symm.inv).map
          (pushedUnitPiRestrictionMap U V s h) ≫
        (pushedUnitPiRestrictIsoOfIso e V).hom =
      (pushedUnitPiRestrictIsoOfIso e U).hom ≫
        pushedUnitPiRestrictionMap
          (fun i ↦ e.symm.inv ⁻¹ᵁ U i)
          (fun k ↦ e.symm.inv ⁻¹ᵁ V k) s
          (fun k ↦ e.symm.inv.preimage_mono (h k))
proof:
:= by
  have hα :
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor e.symm.inv).map
            (pushedUnitPiRestrictionMap U V s h) ≫
          ((pushforwardNatIsoRestrictInverse e.symm).app
            (∏ᶜ fun k ↦
              SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y (V k))).symm.hom =
        ((pushforwardNatIsoRestrictInverse e.symm).app
            (∏ᶜ fun i ↦
              SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y (U i))).symm.hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward e.symm.hom).map
            (pushedUnitPiRestrictionMap U V s h) := by
    exact (pushforwardNatIsoRestrictInverse e.symm).inv.naturality
      (pushedUnitPiRestrictionMap U V s h)
  simp only [pushedUnitPiRestrictIsoOfIso, Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [reassoc_of% hα]
  apply (cancel_epi
    ((pushforwardNatIsoRestrictInverse e.symm).app
      (∏ᶜ fun i ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y (U i))).symm.hom).2
  simp only [Functor.mapIso_hom]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc]
  rw [pushedUnitPiInversePreimageIso_naturality e U V s h]
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  apply (cancel_epi
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward e.symm.hom).map
      (pushedUnitPiInversePreimageIso e U).hom)).2
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro k
  simp only [Category.assoc, pushedUnitPiRestrictionMap, Pi.lift_π, Iso.trans_hom,
    Pi.mapIso_hom_π_assoc,
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitPiPushforwardIso,
    PreservesProduct.iso_hom, piComparison_comp_π_assoc]
  rw [Pi.mapIso_hom_π]
  rw [piComparison_comp_π_assoc]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc]
  rw [Pi.lift_π]
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitPushforwardIso_naturality]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitPiOpenImmersionPreimageCastIso_naturality
statement:
theorem pushedUnitPiOpenImmersionPreimageCastIso_naturality
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {ι κ : Type u} [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : κ → X.Opens)
    (s : κ → ι) (h : ∀ k, V k ≤ U (s k)) :
    pushedUnitPiRestrictionMap
          (fun i ↦ q.isoOpensRange.hom ⁻¹ᵁ
            (q.opensRange.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U i))
          (fun k ↦ q.isoOpensRange.hom ⁻¹ᵁ
            (q.opensRange.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V k)) s
          (fun k ↦ q.isoOpensRange.hom.preimage_mono
            (q.opensRange.ι.preimage_mono (h k))) ≫
        (pushedUnitPiOpenImmersionPreimageCastIso q V).hom =
      (pushedUnitPiOpenImmersionPreimageCastIso q U).hom ≫
        pushedUnitPiRestrictionMap
          (fun i ↦ q ⁻¹ᵁ U i) (fun k ↦ q ⁻¹ᵁ V k) s
          (fun k ↦ q.preimage_mono (h k))
proof:
:= by
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro k
  simp only [Category.assoc, pushedUnitPiRestrictionMap,
    pushedUnitPiOpenImmersionPreimageCastIso]
  rw [Pi.mapIso_hom_π]
  conv_lhs => rw [← Category.assoc, Pi.lift_π]
  slice_rhs 2 3 => rw [Pi.lift_π]
  rw [Pi.mapIso_hom_π_assoc]
  rw [Category.assoc]
  rw [pushedUnitRestriction_eqToIso_naturality
    (isoOpensRange_hom_preimage q (U (s k)))
    (isoOpensRange_hom_preimage q (V k)) _ _]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersion_open_eq
statement:
theorem pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersion_open_eq
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (U : X.Opens) (W : Y.Opens) :
    q ''ᵁ ((q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ ((q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)) =
      U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (q ''ᵁ W))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Opens.ι_image_ι_preimage,
    Scheme.Opens.ι_image_ι_preimage]
  apply TopologicalSpace.Opens.ext
  apply Set.ext
  intro x
  simp only [SetLike.mem_coe]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hyU, hyW⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨hyU, ⟨y, hyW, rfl⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨hxU, y, hyW, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨y, ⟨hxU, hyW⟩, rfl⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionSectionIso_hom_map_mul
statement:
theorem pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionSectionIso_hom_map_mul
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (U : X.Opens) (W : Y.Opens)
    (x y : Γ(X, U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (q ''ᵁ W)))) :
    (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionSectionIso q U W).hom (x * y) =
      (show Γ(Y, (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ
          ((q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)) from
        (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionSectionIso q U W).hom x) *
      (show Γ(Y, (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ
          ((q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)) from
        (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionSectionIso q U W).hom y)
proof:
:= by
  change
    (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionSectionRingIso q U W).hom (x * y) =
      (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionSectionRingIso q U W).hom x *
        (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionSectionRingIso q U W).hom y
  exact map_mul _ x y

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.restrictTopUnit_topIso_inv_val
statement:
theorem restrictTopUnit_topIso_inv_val
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.Opens) (a : Γ(X, U)ˣ)
    (V : U.toScheme.Opens) :
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.restrictTopUnit
      (Units.map U.topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom a) V).1 =
      (show Γ(U.toScheme, V) from
        X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (U.ι_image_le V)).op a.1)
proof:
:= by
  change X.presheaf.map _ (X.presheaf.map _ a.1) =
    X.presheaf.map _ a.1
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  congr 2

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionSectionIso_hom_restrictTopUnit
statement:
theorem pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionSectionIso_hom_restrictTopUnit
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (U : X.Opens) (a : Γ(X, U)ˣ) (b : Γ(Y, q ⁻¹ᵁ U)ˣ)
    (hab : q.app U a.1 = b.1) (W : Y.Opens) :
    (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionSectionIso q U W).hom
        (show Γ(X, U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (q ''ᵁ W))) from
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.restrictTopUnit
            (Units.map U.topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom a)
            (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (q ''ᵁ W))).1) =
      (show Γ(Y, (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ
          ((q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)) from
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.restrictTopUnit
          (Units.map (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom b)
          ((q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)).1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [restrictTopUnit_topIso_inv_val,
    restrictTopUnit_topIso_inv_val]
  let A := (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ ((q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)
  let B := U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (q ''ᵁ W))
  let hBA : B = q ''ᵁ A :=
    (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersion_open_eq q U W).symm
  let hAU : A ≤ q ⁻¹ᵁ U := (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι_image_le _
  let k : op U ⟶ op (q ''ᵁ A) :=
    (homOfLE (by
      rw [← hBA]
      exact U.ι_image_le _)).op
  have hnat := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (q.naturality k) a.1
  change
    (q.appIso A).hom
        (X.presheaf.map (eqToIso hBA.symm).op.hom
          (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (U.ι_image_le _)).op a.1)) =
      Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hAU).op b.1
  rw [← hab]
  rw [Scheme.Hom.appIso_hom, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  have hsource :
      (homOfLE (U.ι_image_le (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (q ''ᵁ W)))).op ≫
          (eqToIso hBA.symm).op.hom =
        k := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply, hsource]
  rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hnat
  rw [hnat]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  congr 2

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionSectionIso_hom_restrictTopUnit_mul
statement:
theorem pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionSectionIso_hom_restrictTopUnit_mul
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (U : X.Opens) (a : Γ(X, U)ˣ) (b : Γ(Y, q ⁻¹ᵁ U)ˣ)
    (hab : q.app U a.1 = b.1) (W : Y.Opens)
    (z : Γ(X, U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (q ''ᵁ W)))) :
    (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionSectionIso q U W).hom
        ((show Γ(X, U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (q ''ᵁ W))) from
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.restrictTopUnit
            (Units.map U.topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom a)
            (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (q ''ᵁ W))).1) * z) =
      (show Γ(Y, (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ
          ((q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)) from
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.restrictTopUnit
          (Units.map (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom b)
          ((q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)).1) *
        (show Γ(Y, (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ
            ((q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)) from
          (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionSectionIso q U W).hom z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionSectionIso_hom_map_mul]
  rw [pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionSectionIso_hom_restrictTopUnit
    q U a b hab W]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionSectionIso_naturality
statement:
theorem pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionSectionIso_naturality
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (U : X.Opens) {W Z : Y.Opens} (f : op W ⟶ op Z) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X U)).presheaf.map f ≫
        (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionSectionIso q U Z).hom =
      (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionSectionIso q U W).hom ≫
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y
          (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)).presheaf.map f
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  let AW := (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ ((q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)
  let AZ := (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ ((q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ Z)
  have hZW : Z ≤ W := leOfHom f.unop
  let hAZAW : AZ ≤ AW :=
    (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι.image_mono ((q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι.preimage_mono hZW)
  let k : op AW ⟶ op AZ := (homOfLE hAZAW).op
  let BW := U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (q ''ᵁ W))
  let BZ := U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (q ''ᵁ Z))
  let hBZBW : BZ ≤ BW :=
    U.ι.image_mono (U.ι.preimage_mono (q.image_mono hZW))
  let hW := pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersion_open_eq q U W
  let hZ := pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersion_open_eq q U Z
  let xBW : Γ(X, BW) := x
  have hsource :
      X.presheaf.map (eqToIso hZ).op.hom
          (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hBZBW).op xBW) =
        X.presheaf.map (q.opensFunctor.op.map k)
          (X.presheaf.map (eqToIso hW).op.hom xBW) := by
    have hmorph :
        (homOfLE hBZBW).op ≫ (eqToIso hZ).op.hom =
          (eqToIso hW).op.hom ≫ q.opensFunctor.op.map k :=
      Subsingleton.elim _ _
    calc
      _ = X.presheaf.map
          ((homOfLE hBZBW).op ≫ (eqToIso hZ).op.hom) xBW := by
            rw [Functor.map_comp_apply]
      _ = X.presheaf.map
          ((eqToIso hW).op.hom ≫ q.opensFunctor.op.map k) xBW := by
            rw [hmorph]
            rfl
      _ = _ := by
        rw [Functor.map_comp_apply]
        rfl
  have hnat := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (q.appIso_hom_naturality k)
      (X.presheaf.map (eqToIso hW).op.hom xBW)
  change
    (q.appIso AZ).hom
        (X.presheaf.map (eqToIso hZ).op.hom
          (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hBZBW).op xBW)) =
      Y.presheaf.map k
        ((q.appIso AW).hom
          (X.presheaf.map (eqToIso hW).op.hom xBW))
  rw [hsource]
  rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hnat
  exact hnat

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitMulRestrictOpenImmersionIso_naturality
statement:
theorem pushedUnitMulRestrictOpenImmersionIso_naturality
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (U : X.Opens) (a : Γ(X, U)ˣ) (b : Γ(Y, q ⁻¹ᵁ U)ˣ)
    (hab : q.app U a.1 = b.1) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).map
            (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso
              (Units.map U.topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom a)).hom) ≫
        (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionIso q U).hom =
      (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionIso q U).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).map
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso
            (Units.map (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom b)).hom
proof:
:= by
  ext W z
  change
    (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionSectionIso q U W).hom
        ((show Γ(X, U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (q ''ᵁ W))) from
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.restrictTopUnit
            (Units.map U.topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom a)
            (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (q ''ᵁ W))).1) *
          (show Γ(X, U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (q ''ᵁ W))) from z)) =
      (show Γ(Y, (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ
          ((q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)) from
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.restrictTopUnit
          (Units.map (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom b)
          ((q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)).1) *
        (show Γ(Y, (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ
            ((q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)) from
          (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionSectionIso q U W).hom z)
  exact
    pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionSectionIso_hom_restrictTopUnit_mul
      q U a b hab W z

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitMulRestrictOpenImmersionIso_naturality_cast
statement:
theorem pushedUnitMulRestrictOpenImmersionIso_naturality_cast
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (U : X.Opens) (V : Y.Opens) (hV : q ⁻¹ᵁ U = V)
    (a : Γ(X, U)ˣ) (b : Γ(Y, V)ˣ)
    (hab : HEq (q.app U a.1) b.1) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).map
            (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso
              (Units.map U.topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom a)).hom) ≫
        ((pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionIso q U) ≪≫
          eqToIso (congrArg
            (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y) hV)).hom =
      ((pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionIso q U) ≪≫
          eqToIso (congrArg
            (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y) hV)).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward V.ι).map
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso
            (Units.map V.topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom b)).hom
proof:
:= by
  subst V
  simpa only [Iso.trans_hom, eqToIso_refl, Iso.refl_hom,
    Category.comp_id] using
    pushedUnitMulRestrictOpenImmersionIso_naturality
      q U a b (eq_of_heq hab)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionIso_naturality
statement:
theorem pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionIso_naturality
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    {U V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction hVU) ≫
        (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionIso q V).hom =
      (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionIso q U).hom ≫
        SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
          (q.preimage_mono hVU)
proof:
:= by
  ext W x
  let AU := (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ ((q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)
  let AV := (q ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι ''ᵁ ((q ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)
  let hAVAU : AV ≤ AU :=
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestrictionOpen
      (q.preimage_mono hVU) W
  let k : op AU ⟶ op AV := (homOfLE hAVAU).op
  let BU := U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (q ''ᵁ W))
  let BV := V.ι ''ᵁ (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (q ''ᵁ W))
  let hBVBU : BV ≤ BU :=
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestrictionOpen hVU (q ''ᵁ W)
  let hU := pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersion_open_eq q U W
  let hV := pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersion_open_eq q V W
  let xBU : Γ(X, BU) := x
  have hsource :
      X.presheaf.map (eqToIso hV).op.hom
          (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hBVBU).op xBU) =
        X.presheaf.map (q.opensFunctor.op.map k)
          (X.presheaf.map (eqToIso hU).op.hom xBU) := by
    have hmorph :
        (homOfLE hBVBU).op ≫ (eqToIso hV).op.hom =
          (eqToIso hU).op.hom ≫ q.opensFunctor.op.map k :=
      Subsingleton.elim _ _
    calc
      _ = X.presheaf.map
          ((homOfLE hBVBU).op ≫ (eqToIso hV).op.hom) xBU := by
            rw [Functor.map_comp_apply]
      _ = X.presheaf.map
          ((eqToIso hU).op.hom ≫ q.opensFunctor.op.map k) xBU := by
            rw [hmorph]
            rfl
      _ = _ := by
        rw [Functor.map_comp_apply]
        rfl
  have hnat := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (q.appIso_hom_naturality k)
      (X.presheaf.map (eqToIso hU).op.hom xBU)
  change
    (q.appIso AV).hom
        (X.presheaf.map (eqToIso hV).op.hom
          (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hBVBU).op xBU)) =
      Y.presheaf.map k
        ((q.appIso AU).hom
          (X.presheaf.map (eqToIso hU).op.hom xBU))
  rw [hsource]
  rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hnat
  exact hnat

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitPiRestrictIso_hom_π
statement:
theorem pushedUnitPiRestrictIso_hom_π
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} [Finite ι]
    (V : X.Opens) (U : ι → X.Opens) (i : ι) :
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitPiRestrictIso V U).hom ≫
        Pi.π (fun j ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit V.toScheme
          (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U j)) i =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).map
          (Pi.π (fun j ↦
            SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X (U j)) i) ≫
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestrictIso V (U i)).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitPiRestrictIso,
    Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc, PreservesProduct.iso_hom]
  rw [Pi.mapIso_hom_π]
  rw [piComparison_comp_π_assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitPiRestrictIsoOfIso_hom_π
statement:
theorem pushedUnitPiRestrictIsoOfIso_hom_π
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} [Finite ι]
    (e : X ≅ Y) (U : ι → Y.Opens) (i : ι) :
    (pushedUnitPiRestrictIsoOfIso e U).hom ≫
        Pi.π (fun j ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X
          (e.symm.inv ⁻¹ᵁ U j)) i =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor e.symm.inv).map
          (Pi.π (fun j ↦
            SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y (U j)) i) ≫
        (pushedUnitRestrictIsoOfIso e (U i)).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pushedUnitPiRestrictIsoOfIso,
    pushedUnitRestrictIsoOfIso, Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc,
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitPiPushforwardIso,
    PreservesProduct.iso_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom,
    pushedUnitPiInversePreimageIso]
  rw [Pi.mapIso_hom_π]
  rw [piComparison_comp_π_assoc]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc]
  rw [Pi.mapIso_hom_π]
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  have hnat :=
    (pushforwardNatIsoRestrictInverse e.symm).inv.naturality
      (Pi.π (fun j ↦
        SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y (U j)) i)
  have hnat' :
      ((pushforwardNatIsoRestrictInverse e.symm).app
          (∏ᶜ fun j ↦
            SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y (U j))).symm.hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward e.symm.hom).map
            (Pi.π (fun j ↦
              SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y (U j)) i) =
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor e.symm.inv).map
            (Pi.π (fun j ↦
              SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y (U j)) i) ≫
          ((pushforwardNatIsoRestrictInverse e.symm).app
            (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y (U i))).symm.hom := by
    exact hnat.symm
  slice_lhs 1 2 => rw [hnat']
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitPiRestrictIsoOfIso_hom_π_hom
statement:
theorem pushedUnitPiRestrictIsoOfIso_hom_π_hom
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} [Finite ι]
    (e : X ≅ Y) (U : ι → Y.Opens) (i : ι) :
    (pushedUnitPiRestrictIsoOfIso e U).hom ≫
        Pi.π (fun j ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X
          (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U j)) i =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor e.hom).map
          (Pi.π (fun j ↦
            SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y (U j)) i) ≫
        (pushedUnitRestrictIsoOfIso e (U i)).hom
proof:
:=
  pushedUnitPiRestrictIsoOfIso_hom_π e U i

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitPiOpenImmersionPreimageCastIso_hom_π
statement:
theorem pushedUnitPiOpenImmersionPreimageCastIso_hom_π
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} [Finite ι]
    (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q] (U : ι → X.Opens) (i : ι) :
    (pushedUnitPiOpenImmersionPreimageCastIso q U).hom ≫
        Pi.π (fun j ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y
          (q ⁻¹ᵁ U j)) i =
      Pi.π (fun j ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y
          (q.isoOpensRange.hom ⁻¹ᵁ
            (q.opensRange.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U j))) i ≫
        (pushedUnitOpenImmersionPreimageCastIso q (U i)).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pushedUnitPiOpenImmersionPreimageCastIso,
    pushedUnitOpenImmersionPreimageCastIso, Pi.mapIso_hom_π]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso_hom_π
statement:
theorem pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso_hom_π
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} [Finite ι]
    (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q] (U : ι → X.Opens) (i : ι) :
    (pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso q U).hom ≫
        Pi.π (fun j ↦
          SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y (q ⁻¹ᵁ U j)) i =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
          (Pi.π (fun j ↦
            SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X (U j)) i) ≫
        (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionIso q (U i)).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso,
    Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc, PreservesProduct.iso_hom]
  rw [Pi.mapIso_hom_π]
  rw [piComparison_comp_π_assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso_naturality
statement:
theorem pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso_naturality
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {ι κ : Type u} [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : κ → X.Opens)
    (s : κ → ι) (h : ∀ k, V k ≤ U (s k)) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
          (pushedUnitPiRestrictionMap U V s h) ≫
        (pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso q V).hom =
      (pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso q U).hom ≫
        pushedUnitPiRestrictionMap
          (fun i ↦ q ⁻¹ᵁ U i) (fun k ↦ q ⁻¹ᵁ V k) s
          (fun k ↦ q.preimage_mono (h k))
proof:
:= by
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro k
  simp only [Category.assoc, pushedUnitPiRestrictionMap, Pi.lift_π]
  rw [pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso_hom_π q V k]
  slice_rhs 1 2 =>
    rw [pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso_hom_π]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc]
  rw [Pi.lift_π]
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionIso_naturality]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearDescentLeftOpenImmersionPreimage_naturality
statement:
theorem linearDescentLeftOpenImmersionPreimage_naturality
    {R M ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [Finite ι]
    (b : Module.Basis ι R M)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ space R M) [IsOpenImmersion q] :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
          (linearDescentLeft R M b) ≫
        (pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso q
          (fun ij : ι × ι ↦
            linearOverlapOpen R M (b ij.1) (b ij.2))).hom =
      (pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso q
          (fun i : ι ↦ linearOpen R M (b i))).hom ≫
        linearDescentLeftPreimage b q
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [linearDescentLeft, linearDescentLeftPreimage,
    pushedUnitPiRestrictionMap] using
    pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso_naturality q
      (fun i : ι ↦ linearOpen R M (b i))
      (fun ij : ι × ι ↦
        linearOverlapOpen R M (b ij.1) (b ij.2))
      (fun ij ↦ ij.1)
      (fun ij ↦
        (linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b ij.1) (b ij.2)).le.trans
          inf_le_left)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearDescentLeftRestrictIso_naturality
statement:
theorem linearDescentLeftRestrictIso_naturality
    {R S M N ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [Finite ι]
    (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (c : Module.Basis ι S N)
    (q : space S N ⟶ space R M) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (hU : ∀ i, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b i) =
      linearOpen S N (c i))
    (hV : ∀ i j, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOverlapOpen R M (b i) (b j) =
      linearOverlapOpen S N (c i) (c j)) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
          (linearDescentLeft R M b) ≫
        (linearOverlapCochainsRestrictIso b c q hV).hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q hU).hom ≫
        linearDescentLeft S N c
proof:
:= by
  let U := fun i : ι ↦ linearOpen R M (b i)
  let V := fun ij : ι × ι ↦
    linearOverlapOpen R M (b ij.1) (b ij.2)
  let U' := fun i : ι ↦ linearOpen S N (c i)
  let V' := fun ij : ι × ι ↦
    linearOverlapOpen S N (c ij.1) (c ij.2)
  let fPre := linearDescentLeftPreimage b q
  have hBase :
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
            (linearDescentLeft R M b) ≫
          (pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso q V).hom =
        (pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso q U).hom ≫ fPre := by
    exact linearDescentLeftOpenImmersionPreimage_naturality b q
  have hCast :
      fPre ≫
          (pushedUnitPiCastIso
            (fun ij : ι × ι ↦ q ⁻¹ᵁ V ij) V'
            (fun ij ↦ hV ij.1 ij.2)).hom =
        (pushedUnitPiCastIso
            (fun i : ι ↦ q ⁻¹ᵁ U i) U' hU).hom ≫
          linearDescentLeft S N c := by
    simpa only [fPre, U, V, U', V', linearDescentLeftPreimage,
      linearDescentLeft, pushedUnitPiRestrictionMap] using
      pushedUnitPiCastIso_naturality
        (fun i : ι ↦ q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b i))
        (fun i : ι ↦ linearOpen S N (c i))
        (fun ij : ι × ι ↦
          q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOverlapOpen R M (b ij.1) (b ij.2))
        (fun ij : ι × ι ↦
          linearOverlapOpen S N (c ij.1) (c ij.2))
        hU (fun ij ↦ hV ij.1 ij.2) (fun ij ↦ ij.1)
        (fun ij ↦ q.preimage_mono
          ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b ij.1) (b ij.2)).le.trans
            inf_le_left))
        (fun ij ↦
          (linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf S N (c ij.1) (c ij.2)).le.trans
            inf_le_left)
  have hBoth :=
    isoTrans_hom_naturality
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
        (linearDescentLeft R M b))
      fPre (linearDescentLeft S N c)
      (pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso q U)
      (pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso q V)
      (pushedUnitPiCastIso
        (fun i : ι ↦ q ⁻¹ᵁ U i) U' hU)
      (pushedUnitPiCastIso
        (fun ij : ι × ι ↦ q ⁻¹ᵁ V ij) V'
        (fun ij ↦ hV ij.1 ij.2))
      hBase hCast
  simpa only [linearChartCochainsRestrictIso,
    linearOverlapCochainsRestrictIso, U, V, U', V'] using hBoth

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearOverlapAwayToSection_cast_heq
statement:
private theorem linearOverlapAwayToSection_cast_heq
    {S N : Type u} [CommRing S] [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N]
    [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    {p q : SymmetricAlgebra S N} (h : p = q)
    (z : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (symGrading S N) p) :

        ((RingEquiv.cast
          (R := fun a : SymmetricAlgebra S N ↦
            HomogeneousLocalization.Away (symGrading S N) a) h) z))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearOverlapAwayToSection_map_heq
statement:
private theorem linearOverlapAwayToSection_map_heq
    {R S M N : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Module S N] [IsScalarTower R S N]
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    (φ : M →ₗ[R] N) (x y : M) (z : LinearOverlapRing R M x y) :
    HEq
      (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading S N)
        (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ (linearOverlapEquation R M x y))
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ)
          (linearOverlapEquation R M x y) z))
      (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading S N)
        (linearOverlapEquation S N (φ x) (φ y))
        (linearOverlapAwayMapNormalized φ x y z))
proof:
:= by
  exact linearOverlapAwayToSection_cast_heq
    (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap_linearOverlapEquation φ x y)
    (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ)
      (linearOverlapEquation R M x y) z)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearOverlapAwayToSection_comp_appLE_raw
statement:
private theorem linearOverlapAwayToSection_comp_appLE_raw
    {R S M N : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Module S N] [IsScalarTower R S N]
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    (φ : M →ₗ[R] N) (hspan : Submodule.span S (Set.range φ) = ⊤)
    (x y : M) :
    Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M)
          (linearOverlapEquation R M x y) ≫
        (symmetricProjMap φ hspan).appLE (linearOverlapOpen R M x y)
          (Proj.basicOpen (symGrading S N)
            (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ
              (linearOverlapEquation R M x y)))
          (by
            have hpre :
                symmetricProjMap φ hspan ⁻¹ᵁ linearOverlapOpen R M x y =
                  Proj.basicOpen (symGrading S N)
                    (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ
                      (linearOverlapEquation R M x y)) := by
              simpa only [linearOverlapOpen, symmetricProjMap] using
                Proj.map_preimage_basicOpen (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ)
                  (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ hspan)
                  (linearOverlapEquation R M x y)
            exact hpre.ge) =
      CommRingCat.ofHom
          (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ)
            (linearOverlapEquation R M x y)) ≫
        Proj.awayToSection (symGrading S N)
          (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ
            (linearOverlapEquation R M x y))
proof:
:= by
  exact Proj.awayToSection_comp_appLE (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ)
    (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ hspan)
    (linearOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two R M x y)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearOverlapSectionMapRaw_transitionSectionUnit_heq
statement:
theorem linearOverlapSectionMapRaw_transitionSectionUnit_heq
    {R S M N : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Module S N] [IsScalarTower R S N]
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    (φ : M →ₗ[R] N) (hspan : Submodule.span S (Set.range φ) = ⊤)
    (d : ℤ) (x y : M) :
    HEq
      (linearOverlapSectionMapRaw φ hspan x y
        (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit R M d x y).1)
      (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit S N d (φ x) (φ y)).1
proof:
:= by
  have hcomm := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (linearOverlapAwayToSection_comp_appLE_raw φ hspan x y)
    (linearTwistTransitionUnit R M d x y).1
  change
    linearOverlapSectionMapRaw φ hspan x y
        (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M)
          (linearOverlapEquation R M x y)
          (linearTwistTransitionUnit R M d x y).1) =
      Proj.awayToSection (symGrading S N)
        (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ
          (linearOverlapEquation R M x y))
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ)
          (linearOverlapEquation R M x y)
          (linearTwistTransitionUnit R M d x y).1) at hcomm
  have hraw :
      linearOverlapSectionMapRaw φ hspan x y
          (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit R M d x y).1 =
        Proj.awayToSection (symGrading S N)
          (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ
            (linearOverlapEquation R M x y))
          (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ)
            (linearOverlapEquation R M x y)
            (linearTwistTransitionUnit R M d x y).1) := by
    simpa [linearOverlapSectionMapRaw,
      linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit, Proj.basicOpenIsoAway_hom,
      ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] using hcomm
  have hcast := linearOverlapAwayToSection_map_heq
    (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N) φ x y
      (linearTwistTransitionUnit R M d x y).1
  have hunit :
      linearOverlapAwayMapNormalized φ x y
          (linearTwistTransitionUnit R M d x y).1 =
        (linearTwistTransitionUnit S N d (φ x) (φ y)).1 :=
    congrArg Units.val
      (linearOverlapAwayMapNormalized_transitionUnit φ d x y)
  have hcanonical :
      Proj.awayToSection (symGrading S N)
          (linearOverlapEquation S N (φ x) (φ y))
          (linearOverlapAwayMapNormalized φ x y
            (linearTwistTransitionUnit R M d x y).1) =
        (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit S N d (φ x) (φ y)).1 := by
    rw [hunit]
    rfl
  exact (heq_of_eq hraw).trans (hcast.trans (heq_of_eq hcanonical))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.symmetricProjMap_app_transitionSectionUnit_heq
statement:
theorem symmetricProjMap_app_transitionSectionUnit_heq
    {R S M N : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Module S N] [IsScalarTower R S N]
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    (φ : M →ₗ[R] N) (hspan : Submodule.span S (Set.range φ) = ⊤)
    (d : ℤ) (x y : M) :
    HEq
      ((symmetricProjMap φ hspan).app (linearOverlapOpen R M x y)
        (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit R M d x y).1)
      (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit S N d (φ x) (φ y)).1
proof:
:= by
  let Vraw := Proj.basicOpen (symGrading S N)
    (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ (linearOverlapEquation R M x y))
  have hpre :
      symmetricProjMap φ hspan ⁻¹ᵁ linearOverlapOpen R M x y = Vraw := by
    simpa only [linearOverlapOpen, symmetricProjMap] using
      Proj.map_preimage_basicOpen (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ)
        (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ hspan)
        (linearOverlapEquation R M x y)
  have happ := scheme_appLE_eq_app_heq (symmetricProjMap φ hspan)
    (linearOverlapOpen R M x y) Vraw hpre
    (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit R M d x y).1
  have hraw :=
    linearOverlapSectionMapRaw_transitionSectionUnit_heq
      φ hspan d x y
  exact happ.symm.trans hraw

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.semilinearSymmetricProjMap_app_transitionSectionUnit_heq
statement:
theorem semilinearSymmetricProjMap_app_transitionSectionUnit_heq
    {R S M N : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N]
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    (f : R →+* S) (φ : M →ₛₗ[f] N)
    (hspan : Submodule.span S (Set.range φ) = ⊤)
    (d : ℤ) (x y : M) :
    HEq
      ((semilinearSymmetricProjMap f φ hspan).app
        (linearOverlapOpen R M x y)
        (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit R M d x y).1)
      (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit S N d (φ x) (φ y)).1
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra R S := f.toAlgebra
  letI : Module R N := Module.compHom N f
  letI : IsScalarTower R S N :=
    ⟨fun r s n ↦ by
      change (f r * s) • n = f r • s • n
      rw [mul_smul]⟩
  let hspan' :
      Submodule.span S
          (Set.range (semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f φ)) = ⊤ := by
    change Submodule.span S (Set.range φ) = ⊤
    exact hspan
  change HEq
    ((symmetricProjMap
        (semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f φ) hspan').app
      (linearOverlapOpen R M x y)
      (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit R M d x y).1)
    (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit S N d
      ((semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f φ) x)
      ((semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f φ) y)).1
  exact symmetricProjMap_app_transitionSectionUnit_heq
    (semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f φ) hspan' d x y

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedLinearOverlapTransitionRestrictOpenImmersionIso_naturality
statement:
theorem pushedLinearOverlapTransitionRestrictOpenImmersionIso_naturality
    {R S M N : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N]
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    (q : space S N ⟶ space R M) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (d : ℤ) (x y : M) (x' y' : N)
    (hV : q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOverlapOpen R M x y =
      linearOverlapOpen S N x' y')
    (hT : HEq
      (q.app (linearOverlapOpen R M x y)
        (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit R M d x y).1)
      (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit S N d x' y').1) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
          (pushedLinearOverlapTransition R M d x y) ≫
        ((pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionIso q
            (linearOverlapOpen R M x y)) ≪≫
          eqToIso (congrArg
            (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space S N)) hV)).hom =
      ((pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionIso q
            (linearOverlapOpen R M x y)) ≪≫
          eqToIso (congrArg
            (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space S N)) hV)).hom ≫
        pushedLinearOverlapTransition S N d x' y'
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [pushedLinearOverlapTransition,
    linearOverlapTransitionIso] using
    pushedUnitMulRestrictOpenImmersionIso_naturality_cast
      q (linearOverlapOpen R M x y)
        (linearOverlapOpen S N x' y') hV
        (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit R M d x y)
        (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit S N d x' y') hT

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearDescentRight_eq_bare_comp_transition
statement:
theorem linearDescentRight_eq_bare_comp_transition
    {R M ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [Finite ι] (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (d : ℤ) :
    linearDescentRight R M b d =
      linearDescentRightBare b ≫
        linearOverlapTransitionEndomorphism b d
proof:
:= by
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro ij
  simp only [linearDescentRight, linearDescentRightBare,
    linearOverlapTransitionEndomorphism, pushedUnitPiRestrictionMap,
    Category.assoc, Pi.lift_π]
  slice_rhs 1 2 => rw [Pi.lift_π]
  rw [Category.assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearRestrictionMapRestrictIso_naturality
statement:
theorem linearRestrictionMapRestrictIso_naturality
    {R S M N ι κ : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    (U : ι → (space R M).Opens) (V : κ → (space R M).Opens)
    (U' : ι → (space S N).Opens) (V' : κ → (space S N).Opens)
    (q : space S N ⟶ space R M) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (hU : ∀ i, q ⁻¹ᵁ U i = U' i)
    (hV : ∀ k, q ⁻¹ᵁ V k = V' k)
    (s : κ → ι) (h : ∀ k, V k ≤ U (s k))
    (h' : ∀ k, V' k ≤ U' (s k)) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
          (pushedUnitPiRestrictionMap U V s h) ≫
        ((pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso q V) ≪≫
          pushedUnitPiCastIso (fun k ↦ q ⁻¹ᵁ V k) V' hV).hom =
      ((pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso q U) ≪≫
          pushedUnitPiCastIso (fun i ↦ q ⁻¹ᵁ U i) U' hU).hom ≫
        pushedUnitPiRestrictionMap U' V' s h'
proof:
:= by
  have hBase :=
    pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso_naturality q U V s h
  have hCast :=
    pushedUnitPiCastIso_naturality
      (fun i ↦ q ⁻¹ᵁ U i) U'
      (fun k ↦ q ⁻¹ᵁ V k) V' hU hV s
      (fun k ↦ q.preimage_mono (h k)) h'
  exact isoTrans_hom_naturality
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
      (pushedUnitPiRestrictionMap U V s h))
    (pushedUnitPiRestrictionMap
      (fun i ↦ q ⁻¹ᵁ U i) (fun k ↦ q ⁻¹ᵁ V k) s
      (fun k ↦ q.preimage_mono (h k)))
    (pushedUnitPiRestrictionMap U' V' s h')
    (pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso q U)
    (pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso q V)
    (pushedUnitPiCastIso (fun i ↦ q ⁻¹ᵁ U i) U' hU)
    (pushedUnitPiCastIso (fun k ↦ q ⁻¹ᵁ V k) V' hV)
    hBase hCast

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearDescentRightBareRestrictIso_naturality
statement:
theorem linearDescentRightBareRestrictIso_naturality
    {R S M N ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [Finite ι]
    (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (c : Module.Basis ι S N)
    (q : space S N ⟶ space R M) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (hU : ∀ i, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b i) =
      linearOpen S N (c i))
    (hV : ∀ i j, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOverlapOpen R M (b i) (b j) =
      linearOverlapOpen S N (c i) (c j)) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
          (linearDescentRightBare b) ≫
        (linearOverlapCochainsRestrictIso b c q hV).hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q hU).hom ≫
        linearDescentRightBare c
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [linearDescentRightBare, linearChartCochainsRestrictIso,
    linearOverlapCochainsRestrictIso] using
    linearRestrictionMapRestrictIso_naturality
      (fun i : ι ↦ linearOpen R M (b i))
      (fun ij : ι × ι ↦
        linearOverlapOpen R M (b ij.1) (b ij.2))
      (fun i : ι ↦ linearOpen S N (c i))
      (fun ij : ι × ι ↦
        linearOverlapOpen S N (c ij.1) (c ij.2))
      q hU (fun ij ↦ hV ij.1 ij.2) (fun ij ↦ ij.2)
      (fun ij ↦
        (linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b ij.1) (b ij.2)).le.trans
          inf_le_right)
      (fun ij ↦
        (linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf S N (c ij.1) (c ij.2)).le.trans
          inf_le_right)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearDescentRightRestrictIso_naturality
statement:
theorem linearDescentRightRestrictIso_naturality
    {R S M N ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [Finite ι]
    (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (c : Module.Basis ι S N) (d : ℤ)
    (q : space S N ⟶ space R M) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (hU : ∀ i, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b i) =
      linearOpen S N (c i))
    (hV : ∀ i j, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOverlapOpen R M (b i) (b j) =
      linearOverlapOpen S N (c i) (c j))
    (hT : LinearOverlapTransitionRestrictionNaturality b c d q hV) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
          (linearDescentRight R M b d) ≫
        (linearOverlapCochainsRestrictIso b c q hV).hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q hU).hom ≫
        linearDescentRight S N c d
proof:
:= by
  rw [linearDescentRight_eq_bare_comp_transition,
    linearDescentRight_eq_bare_comp_transition]
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [hT]
  rw [reassoc_of% linearDescentRightBareRestrictIso_naturality
    b c q hU hV]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearDescentLeftOpen_naturality
statement:
theorem linearDescentLeftOpen_naturality
    {R M ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [Finite ι]
    (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (V : (space R M).Opens) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).map
          (linearDescentLeft R M b) ≫
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitPiRestrictIso V
          (fun ij : ι × ι ↦
            linearOverlapOpen R M (b ij.1) (b ij.2))).hom =
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitPiRestrictIso V
          (fun i : ι ↦ linearOpen R M (b i))).hom ≫
        linearDescentLeftPreimage b V.ι
proof:
:= by
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro ij
  simp only [Category.assoc, linearDescentLeftPreimage, Pi.lift_π,
    Iso.trans_hom, Pi.mapIso_hom_π_assoc,
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitPiRestrictIso,
    PreservesProduct.iso_hom, piComparison_comp_π_assoc]
  rw [Pi.mapIso_hom_π]
  rw [piComparison_comp_π_assoc]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc,
    linearDescentLeft_π]
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  rw [Category.assoc]
  rw [SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestrictIso_naturality]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.chartToLeft_app_transitionSectionUnit_heq
statement:
theorem chartToLeft_app_transitionSectionUnit_heq

          (C.sectionBasis i a) (C.sectionBasis i b))
        (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit
          Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) d
          (C.sectionBasis i a) (C.sectionBasis i b)).1)
      (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit
        Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) d
        (c.leftSectionBasis a) (c.leftSectionBasis b)).1
proof:

  have ht :=
    semilinearSymmetricProjMap_app_transitionSectionUnit_heq
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_left).op).hom

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.chartToRight_app_transitionSectionUnit_heq

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.leftTwistRestriction_linearDescentLeft_naturality

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.leftTwistTransitionRestrictionNaturality
statement:
theorem leftTwistTransitionRestrictionNaturality (d : ℤ) :
    LeftTwistTransitionRestrictionNaturality c d
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  unfold LeftTwistTransitionRestrictionNaturality
  unfold LinearOverlapTransitionRestrictionNaturality
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro ab
  simp only [Category.assoc, linearOverlapTransitionEndomorphism,
    Pi.lift_π, linearOverlapCochainsRestrictIso, Iso.trans_hom,
    pushedUnitPiCastIso, Pi.mapIso_hom_π_assoc]
  slice_lhs 3 4 => rw [Pi.mapIso_hom_π]
  rw [reassoc_of%
    pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso_hom_π c.chartToLeft
      (fun ij : C.basisIndex i × C.basisIndex i ↦
        linearOverlapOpen
          Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))
          (C.sectionBasis i ij.1) (C.sectionBasis i ij.2)) ab]
  slice_rhs 1 2 =>
    rw [pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso_hom_π]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc]
  rw [Pi.lift_π]
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  congr 1
  exact
    pushedLinearOverlapTransitionRestrictOpenImmersionIso_naturality
      c.chartToLeft d
      (C.sectionBasis i ab.1) (C.sectionBasis i ab.2)
      (c.leftSectionBasis ab.1) (c.leftSectionBasis ab.2)
      (c.chartToLeft_preimage_linearOverlapOpen ab.1 ab.2)
      (c.chartToLeft_app_transitionSectionUnit_heq d ab.1 ab.2)

name: SchemeKTheory.ARR.one_sub_pow_eq_geom_mul
statement:
theorem one_sub_pow_eq_geom_mul (ℓ : A) (j : ℕ) :
    1 - ℓ ^ j = (∑ a ∈ Finset.range j, ℓ ^ a) * (1 - ℓ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm, mul_neg_geom_sum]

name: SchemeKTheory.ARR.adams_prod_one_sub
statement:
theorem adams_prod_one_sub {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (ψ : A →+* A) (j : ℕ) (ℓ : ι → A)
    (hψ : ∀ i ∈ s, ψ (ℓ i) = ℓ i ^ j) :
    ψ (∏ i ∈ s, (1 - ℓ i)) =
      (∏ i ∈ s, ∑ a ∈ Finset.range j, ℓ i ^ a) * ∏ i ∈ s, (1 - ℓ i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_prod, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
  rw [map_sub, map_one, hψ i hi, one_sub_pow_eq_geom_mul]

name: SchemeKTheory.ARR.adams_push_of_koszul
statement:
theorem adams_push_of_koszul {AZ AP : Type*} [CommRing AZ] [CommRing AP]
    (ψZ : AZ →+* AZ) (ψP : AP →+* AP) (p : AZ →+* AP) (s : AP →+* AZ)
    (hsp : ∀ x, s (p x) = x) (hψp : ∀ x, ψP (p x) = p (ψZ x))
    (push : AZ →+ AP) (proj : ∀ y x, push (s y * x) = y * push x)
    (lam tP : AP) (tZ : AZ) (koszul : push 1 = lam) (hlam : ψP lam = tP * lam)
    (ht : s tP = tZ) (x : AZ) :
    ψP (push x) = push (ψZ x * tZ)
proof:
:= by
  have hpush : ∀ z, push z = p z * lam := fun z => by
    rw [← koszul, ← proj, mul_one, hsp]
  have hz : ψZ x * tZ = s (p (ψZ x) * tP) * 1 := by
    rw [mul_one, map_mul, hsp, ht]
  rw [hpush, map_mul, hlam, hψp, hz, proj, koszul, mul_assoc]

name: KSpecialization.AR7R.sigmaT_app_eq
statement:
theorem sigmaT_app_eq {Λ : X.Modules} (s : Λ ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) (E : X.Modules) :
    (sigmaT Λ s).app E =
      tensorSheafMap X s (𝟙 E) ≫ (tensorSheafLeftUnitor X E).hom
proof:
:= by
  have h := theta_koszul s E
  change (thetaIso Λ).hom.app E ≫ _ = _
  refine h.trans ?_
  have e : evalPre s E = ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map s ⊗ₘ
      (underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map (𝟙 E)) ≫
      (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor (underlyingCommPresheaf X E)).hom := by
    unfold evalPre
    exact congrArg (· ≫ _) (MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_id _ _).symm
  refine Eq.trans (congrArg (fun q => (moduleSheafification X).map q ≫ cnt E) e) ?_
  refine Eq.trans (congrArg (· ≫ cnt E) ((moduleSheafification X).map_comp _ _))
    (Category.assoc _ _ _) |>.trans ?_
  rfl

name: KSpecialization.AR7R.projectionMap_unit_key
statement:
theorem projectionMap_unit_key (G : W.Modules) :
    projectionMap F (tensorUnitSheaf Y) G ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).map
        (tensorSheafMap W (pullbackObjUnitIso F).hom (𝟙 G) ≫ (tensorSheafLeftUnitor W G).hom) =
      (tensorSheafLeftUnitor Y ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj G)).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hη : adjUnit F (tensorUnitSheaf Y) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).map (pullbackObjUnitIso F).hom =
      SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit F.toRingCatSheafHom := by
    have hp := SheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction_homEquiv_pullbackObjUnitToUnit
      F.toRingCatSheafHom
    rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit] at hp
    exact hp
  unfold projectionMap
  rw [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc, ← pushforwardTensorSheafHom_naturality_assoc,
    tensorSheafMap_comp_assoc, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.comp_id, hη]
  exact unit_compat F G

name: KSpecialization.AR7R.sigmaT_push
statement:
theorem sigmaT_push (E : W.Modules) :
    tensorSheafMap Y s (𝟙 ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj E)) ≫
        (tensorSheafLeftUnitor Y ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj E)).hom =
      projectionMap F Λ E ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).map
        (tensorSheafMap W (pullbackSection F s) (𝟙 E) ≫ (tensorSheafLeftUnitor W E).hom)
proof:
:= by
  have nat := projectionMap_naturality F s E
  have key := projectionMap_unit_key F E
  rw [← key, ← Category.assoc, nat, Category.assoc]
  simp only [Functor.map_comp, pullbackSection]
  have c := tensorSheafMap_comp W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).map s) (pullbackObjUnitIso F).hom
    (𝟙 E) (𝟙 E)
  rw [Category.id_comp] at c
  have c' : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).map
        (tensorSheafMap W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).map s) (𝟙 E)) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).map (tensorSheafMap W (pullbackObjUnitIso F).hom (𝟙 E)) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).map
        (tensorSheafMap W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).map s ≫ (pullbackObjUnitIso F).hom)
          (𝟙 E)) := by
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, c]
  rw [reassoc_of% c']

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E27.ker_stalkMap_eq_map_germ
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_eq_map_germ {V W : Scheme.{u}} (j : V ⟶ W) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    (U : W.affineOpens) (q : V) (hq : j q ∈ U.1) :
    RingHom.ker (j.stalkMap q).hom =
      (RingHom.ker (j.app U.1).hom).map (W.presheaf.germ U.1 (j q) hq).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hq' : q ∈ j ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 := hq
  have hV : IsAffineOpen (j ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) := IsAffineHom.isAffine_preimage _ U.2
  letI : Algebra Γ(W, U.1) (W.presheaf.stalk (j q)) :=
    W.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk ⟨j q, hq⟩
  haveI hlocW := U.2.isLocalization_stalk ⟨j q, hq⟩
  letI : Algebra Γ(V, j ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) (V.presheaf.stalk q) :=
    V.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk ⟨q, hq'⟩
  haveI hlocV := hV.isLocalization_stalk ⟨q, hq'⟩
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (j.app U.1).hom := j.app_surjective U.1 U.2
  have hgerm : ∀ r : Γ(W, U.1), (j.stalkMap q).hom (W.presheaf.germ U.1 (j q) hq r) =
      V.presheaf.germ (j ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) q hq' ((j.app U.1).hom r) := fun r =>
    Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply j U.1 q hq r
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro s hs
    obtain ⟨⟨r, t⟩, hrt⟩ := IsLocalization.surj
      (U.2.primeIdealOf ⟨j q, hq⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl s
    have hs0 : (j.stalkMap q).hom s = 0 := hs
    have h1 := congrArg (j.stalkMap q).hom hrt
    rw [map_mul, hs0, zero_mul] at h1
    have h2 : V.presheaf.germ (j ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) q hq' ((j.app U.1).hom r) = 0 := by
      have := hgerm r
      rw [← this]
      exact h1.symm
    have h3 : algebraMap Γ(V, j ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) (V.presheaf.stalk q) ((j.app U.1).hom r) = 0 := h2
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (IsLocalization.map_eq_zero_iff
      (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨q, hq'⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl _ _).mp h3
    obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀⟩ := hsurj (m : Γ(V, j ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))
    have hmu : IsUnit (algebraMap Γ(V, j ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) (V.presheaf.stalk q) (m : Γ(V, j ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))) :=
      IsLocalization.map_units (V.presheaf.stalk q) m
    have hm₀u : IsUnit (W.presheaf.germ U.1 (j q) hq m₀) := by
      refine isUnit_of_map_unit (j.stalkMap q).hom _ ?_
      rw [hgerm, hm₀]
      exact hmu
    have htu : IsUnit (algebraMap Γ(W, U.1) (W.presheaf.stalk (j q)) (t : Γ(W, U.1))) :=
      IsLocalization.map_units (W.presheaf.stalk (j q)) t
    have hker : m₀ * r ∈ RingHom.ker (j.app U.1).hom := by
      rw [RingHom.mem_ker, map_mul, hm₀]
      exact hm
    have hmem : s * (algebraMap Γ(W, U.1) (W.presheaf.stalk (j q)) (t : Γ(W, U.1)) *
        W.presheaf.germ U.1 (j q) hq m₀) ∈
        (RingHom.ker (j.app U.1).hom).map (W.presheaf.germ U.1 (j q) hq).hom := by
      have : s * (algebraMap Γ(W, U.1) (W.presheaf.stalk (j q)) (t : Γ(W, U.1)) *
          W.presheaf.germ U.1 (j q) hq m₀) =
          W.presheaf.germ U.1 (j q) hq (m₀ * r) := by
        rw [map_mul, ← mul_assoc, hrt, mul_comm]
        rfl
      rw [this]
      exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hker
    exact (Ideal.mul_unit_mem_iff_mem _ (htu.mul hm₀u)).mp hmem
  · rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro a ha
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, RingHom.mem_ker, hgerm]
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker] at ha
    rw [ha, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E27.ker_stalkMap_eq_map_germ_ker
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_eq_map_germ_ker {V W : Scheme.{u}} (j : V ⟶ W) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    (U : W.affineOpens) (q : V) (hq : j q ∈ U.1) :
    RingHom.ker (j.stalkMap q).hom = (j.ker.ideal U).map (W.presheaf.germ U.1 (j q) hq).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.ker_apply]
  exact ker_stalkMap_eq_map_germ j U q hq

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.localizedIdeal_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem localizedIdeal_pow (I : Ideal R) (g : R) (n : ℕ) :
    localizedIdeal I g ^ n =
      (I ^ n).map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g))
proof:

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.algebraMap_mem_localizedIdeal_pow
proof:
:= by

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.polynomial_map_mem_reesAlgebra
statement:
theorem polynomial_map_mem_reesAlgebra {I : Ideal R} {g : R}
    (p : reesAlgebra I) :
    Polynomial.map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) (p : R[X]) ∈
      reesAlgebra (localizedIdeal I g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_reesAlgebra_iff]
  intro n
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_map, localizedIdeal_pow]
  exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (p.2 n)

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.polynomial_map_eq_iff_exists_pow_mul_eq
statement:
theorem polynomial_map_eq_iff_exists_pow_mul_eq (g : R) (p q : R[X]) :
    Polynomial.map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) p =
        Polynomial.map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) q ↔
      ∃ n : ℕ, (Polynomial.C g) ^ n * p = (Polynomial.C g) ^ n * q
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra R[X] (Localization.Away g)[X] :=
    Polynomial.algebra R (Localization.Away g)
  letI : IsLocalization (Submonoid.powers (Polynomial.C g))
      (Localization.Away g)[X] := by
    rw [← Submonoid.map_powers (Polynomial.C : R →+* R[X]) g]
    exact Polynomial.isLocalization (R := R)
      (Submonoid.powers g) (Localization.Away g)
  change
    algebraMap R[X] (Localization.Away g)[X] p =
        algebraMap R[X] (Localization.Away g)[X] q ↔ _
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨⟨c, hc⟩, h⟩ :=
      (IsLocalization.eq_iff_exists (S := (Localization.Away g)[X])
        (Submonoid.powers (Polynomial.C g))).mp h
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (Submonoid.mem_powers_iff c (Polynomial.C g)).mp hc
    exact ⟨n, by simpa only [hn] using h⟩
  · rintro ⟨n, h⟩
    exact (IsLocalization.eq_iff_exists (S := (Localization.Away g)[X])
      (Submonoid.powers (Polynomial.C g))).mpr
        ⟨⟨(Polynomial.C g) ^ n, n, rfl⟩, h⟩

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesLocalizationAwayMap_injective
statement:
theorem reesLocalizationAwayMap_injective (I : Ideal R) (g : R) :
    Function.Injective (reesLocalizationAwayMap I g)
proof:
:= by
  unfold reesLocalizationAwayMap IsLocalization.Away.lift
  rw [IsLocalization.lift_injective_iff]
  intro p q
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h' := congrArg (reesLocalizationAwayMap I g) h
    simpa only [reesLocalizationAwayMap_algebraMap] using h'
  · intro h
    have hpoly :
        Polynomial.map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) (p : R[X]) =
          Polynomial.map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) (q : R[X]) := by
      simpa only [reesLocalizationMap_apply] using
        congrArg
          (fun z : reesAlgebra (localizedIdeal I g) =>
            (z : (Localization.Away g)[X])) h
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (polynomial_map_eq_iff_exists_pow_mul_eq g (p : R[X]) (q : R[X])).mp hpoly
    apply (IsLocalization.eq_iff_exists
      (S := Localization.Away (reesDenominator I g))
      (Submonoid.powers (reesDenominator I g))).mpr
    refine ⟨⟨reesDenominator I g ^ n, n, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    simpa [reesDenominator] using hn

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.exists_reesLocalizationMap_mul_denominator
statement:
theorem exists_reesLocalizationMap_mul_denominator
    (I : Ideal R) (g : R) (q : reesAlgebra (localizedIdeal I g)) :
    ∃ (p : reesAlgebra I) (n : ℕ),
      q * (reesLocalizationMap I g (reesDenominator I g)) ^ n =
        reesLocalizationMap I g p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Algebra R[X] (Localization.Away g)[X] :=
    Polynomial.algebra R (Localization.Away g)
  letI : IsLocalization (Submonoid.powers (Polynomial.C g))
      (Localization.Away g)[X] := by
    rw [← Submonoid.map_powers (Polynomial.C : R →+* R[X]) g]
    exact Polynomial.isLocalization (R := R)
      (Submonoid.powers g) (Localization.Away g)
  obtain ⟨n, p₀, hp₀⟩ :=
    IsLocalization.Away.surj (S := (Localization.Away g)[X])
      (Polynomial.C g) (q : (Localization.Away g)[X])
  have hp₀' :
      (q : (Localization.Away g)[X]) *
          (Polynomial.C (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g) g)) ^ n =
        Polynomial.map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) p₀ := by
    simpa [Polynomial.algebraMap_def] using hp₀
  have hp₀_coeff_mem (i : ℕ) :
      algebraMap R (Localization.Away g) (p₀.coeff i) ∈
        (I ^ i).map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) := by
    have hq :
        ((q : (Localization.Away g)[X]).coeff i) ∈
          (I ^ i).map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) := by
      simpa only [localizedIdeal_pow] using q.2 i
    have hmul :=
      ((I ^ i).map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g))).mul_mem_left
        ((algebraMap R (Localization.Away g) g) ^ n) hq
    have hcoeff :
        ((q : (Localization.Away g)[X]).coeff i) *
            (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g) g) ^ n =
          algebraMap R (Localization.Away g) (p₀.coeff i) := by
      simpa only [← Polynomial.C_pow, Polynomial.coeff_mul_C,
        Polynomial.coeff_map] using
          congrArg (fun p : (Localization.Away g)[X] => p.coeff i) hp₀'
    rw [← hcoeff]
    simpa only [mul_comm] using hmul
  have hdenominator (i : {i : ℕ // i ∈ p₀.support}) :
      ∃ d : Submonoid.powers g, (d : R) * p₀.coeff i.1 ∈ I ^ i.1 := by
    obtain ⟨d, hd, hdi⟩ :=
      (IsLocalization.algebraMap_mem_map_algebraMap_iff
        (S := Localization.Away g) (Submonoid.powers g)
        (I ^ i.1) (p₀.coeff i.1)).mp (hp₀_coeff_mem i.1)
    exact ⟨⟨d, hd⟩, hdi⟩
  let d (i : {i : ℕ // i ∈ p₀.support}) : Submonoid.powers g :=
    Classical.choose (hdenominator i)
  have hd (i : {i : ℕ // i ∈ p₀.support}) :
      (d i : R) * p₀.coeff i.1 ∈ I ^ i.1 :=
    Classical.choose_spec (hdenominator i)
  let D : Submonoid.powers g := Finset.univ.prod d
  have hD_coeff (i : ℕ) : (D : R) * p₀.coeff i ∈ I ^ i := by
    by_cases hi : i ∈ p₀.support
    · let j : {i : ℕ // i ∈ p₀.support} := ⟨i, hi⟩
      have hdvd : d j ∣ D := by
        dsimp only [D]
        exact Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem d (Finset.mem_univ j)
      obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hdvd
      have heR : (D : R) = (d j : R) * (e : R) :=
        congrArg Subtype.val he
      rw [heR]
      simpa [j, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using
        (I ^ i).mul_mem_left (e : R) (hd j)
    · simp [Polynomial.notMem_support_iff.mp hi]
  let p : reesAlgebra I :=
    ⟨Polynomial.C (D : R) * p₀, fun i => by
      simpa only [Polynomial.coeff_C_mul] using hD_coeff i⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ :=
    (Submonoid.mem_powers_iff (D : R) g).mp D.2
  refine ⟨p, n + m, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [Subalgebra.coe_mul, Subalgebra.coe_pow,
    reesLocalizationMap_apply, reesDenominator, p,
    Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, Polynomial.algebraMap_eq,
    Polynomial.map_C]
  calc
    _ = ((q : (Localization.Away g)[X]) *
          (Polynomial.C (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g) g)) ^ n) *
        (Polynomial.C (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g) g)) ^ m := by
          rw [pow_add, ← mul_assoc]
    _ = Polynomial.map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) p₀ *
        (Polynomial.C (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g) g)) ^ m := by
          rw [hp₀']
    _ = Polynomial.C (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g) (D : R)) *
        Polynomial.map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) p₀ := by
          rw [← hm, map_pow, Polynomial.C_pow]
          ac_rfl
    _ = Polynomial.map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g))
        (Polynomial.C (D : R) * p₀) := by
          rw [Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_C]

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesLocalizationAwayMap_surjective
statement:
theorem reesLocalizationAwayMap_surjective (I : Ideal R) (g : R) :
    Function.Surjective (reesLocalizationAwayMap I g)
proof:
:= by
  unfold reesLocalizationAwayMap IsLocalization.Away.lift
  rw [IsLocalization.lift_surjective_iff]
  intro q
  obtain ⟨p, n, h⟩ := exists_reesLocalizationMap_mul_denominator I g q
  refine ⟨⟨p, ⟨reesDenominator I g ^ n, n, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
  simpa only [map_pow] using h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F6.pointwise_single
statement:
theorem pointwise_single [Flat f] [QuasiCompact f] (hX : DimensionCatenary X) {d : ℕ}
    (hf : PureRelDim f d) (hH : height (f17η g) = k + 1) (ξ0 : X) (hξ0 : f ξ0 = f17η g)
    (hc : flatPullbackCoeff f ξ0 ≠ 0)
    (huniq : ∀ ξ, f ξ = f17η g → flatPullbackCoeff f ξ ≠ 0 → ξ = ξ0) (x : X) :
    flatPullback f g.cycle.1 x = (flatPullbackCoeff f ξ0 : ℤ) *
      properPushforward (pointClosureι ξ0) (div (f17Φ hξ0 g.f)) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [f17_pointwise_pos hX hf hH x]
  have hmem : ξ0 ∈ (f17Ξ_finite f g).toFinset := (Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).mpr ⟨hξ0, hc⟩
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem (⟨ξ0, hmem⟩ : {a // a ∈ (f17Ξ_finite f g).toFinset})
    (Finset.mem_attach _ _)]
  intro b _ hne
  exfalso
  apply hne
  have hb := (Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).mp b.2
  exact Subtype.ext (huniq b.1 hb.1 hb.2)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F6.lift_generator
statement:
theorem lift_generator (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j] {n : ℕ}
    (g : DimRelationGenerator U n) :
    ∃ R : dimensionCycles X n, R ∈ dimRationalEquivalence X n ∧
      ∀ u, R.1 (j u) = g.cycle.1 u
proof:
:= by
  have hU : DimensionCatenary U := dimensionCatenary_of_finiteType K
  have hX : DimensionCatenary X := dimensionCatenary_of_finiteType K
  have hid : PureRelDim (𝟙 U) 0 := pureRelDim_openImmersion K (𝟙 U)
  have hj : PureRelDim j 0 := pureRelDim_openImmersion K j
  by_cases hH : height (f17η g) = n + 1
  swap
  · refine ⟨0, zero_mem _, fun u ↦ ?_⟩
    have h0 := f17_pullback_zero_of_ne (f := 𝟙 U) (g := g) hU hid hH
    rw [flatPullback_id] at h0
    have h1 : g.cycle.1 u = 0 := by rw [h0]; rfl
    rw [h1]
    rfl
  set ξ0 : U := f17η g with hξ0def
  set η' : X := j ξ0 with hη'
  have hdim : ∀ w : pointClosureScheme η', coheight w = 1 →
      height (pointClosureι η' w) = n := by
    intro w hw
    have h1 := hX _ (pointClosureι η') w hw
    have h2 : height η' = n + 1 := by rw [hη', m6pb_height_openImmersion K j, hH]
    rw [f17_pc_generic, h2] at h1
    exact ENat_add_one_cancel h1
  let mkg : (f' : (pointClosureScheme η').functionField) → f' ≠ 0 → DimRelationGenerator X n :=
    fun f' hf' ↦ { Y := pointClosureScheme η', i := pointClosureι η', f := f', hf := hf',
                   dimension := hdim }
  have hξ : j ξ0 = f17η (mkg 1 one_ne_zero) := (f17_pc_generic η').symm
  have hid0 : (𝟙 U : U ⟶ U) ξ0 = f17η g := rfl
  set c := f17Φ (f := 𝟙 U) (g := g) hid0 g.f with hc
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := f17Φ_ne_zero hid0
  
  have hτ : Function.Surjective (f17τ₀ (f := j) ξ0) := by
    unfold f17τ₀
    have h1 := (pointClosureι ξ0).stalkMap_surjective (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme ξ0))
    have h2 := (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
      (j.stalkMap (pointClosureι ξ0 (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme ξ0))))).2
    intro b
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h1 b
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h2 x
    exact ⟨y, by rw [RingHom.comp_apply]; exact (congrArg _ hy).trans hx⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hτ c
  let f' : (pointClosureScheme η').functionField := f17σ₀ (f := j) (g := mkg 1 one_ne_zero) hξ a
  have hΦ : f17Φ (f := j) (g := mkg 1 one_ne_zero) hξ f' = c := by
    rw [f17Φ_σ₀]; exact ha
  have hf'0 : f' ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hc0
    rw [← hΦ, h, map_zero]
  let g' := mkg f' hf'0
  refine ⟨g'.cycle, AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨g', rfl⟩, fun u ↦ ?_⟩
  have hHg' : height (f17η g') = n + 1 := by
    change height (pointClosureι η' (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme η'))) = _
    rw [f17_pc_generic, hη', m6pb_height_openImmersion K j, hH]
  have hξ' : j ξ0 = f17η g' := hξ
  have e1 := pointwise_single (f := j) (g := g') hU hj hHg' ξ0 hξ'
    (by rw [flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion]; exact one_ne_zero)
    (fun ξ hξξ _ ↦ j.isOpenEmbedding.injective (hξξ.trans hξ'.symm)) u
  have e2 := pointwise_single (f := 𝟙 U) (g := g) hU hid hH ξ0 hid0
    (by rw [flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion]; exact one_ne_zero)
    (fun ξ hξξ _ ↦ hξξ) u
  rw [flatPullback_id] at e2
  rw [flatPullback_apply, flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion j u,
    flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion j ξ0] at e1
  rw [flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion] at e2
  simp only [Nat.cast_one, one_mul, mul_one] at e1 e2
  rw [e1, e2]
  have : f17Φ (f := j) (g := g') hξ' g'.f = c := hΦ
  rw [this]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F6.exists_lift_relation
proof:
:= by
  induction h using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem D hD =>
      obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := hD
      exact lift_generator K j g
  | zero => exact ⟨0, zero_mem _, fun u ↦ rfl⟩
  | add D E _ _ hD hE =>
      obtain ⟨R1, h1, e1⟩ := hD
      obtain ⟨R2, h2, e2⟩ := hE
      refine ⟨R1 + R2, add_mem h1 h2, fun u ↦ ?_⟩
      change R1.1 (j u) + R2.1 (j u) = D.1 u + E.1 u
      rw [e1, e2]
  | neg D _ hD =>
      obtain ⟨R1, h1, e1⟩ := hD
      refine ⟨-R1, neg_mem h1, fun u ↦ ?_⟩
      change -R1.1 (j u) = -D.1 u
      rw [e1]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F6.exact_middle
statement:
theorem exact_middle (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j] {n : ℕ}
    (D : dimensionCycles X n) (D' : dimensionCycles U n) (hD' : D' ∈ dimRationalEquivalence U n)
    (hres : ∀ u, D.1 (j u) = D'.1 u) :
    ∃ E : dimensionCycles X n, (∀ x ∈ Set.range j, E.1 x = 0) ∧
      D - E ∈ dimRationalEquivalence X n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hRu⟩ := exists_lift_relation K j D' hD'
  refine ⟨D - R, ?_, by simpa using hR⟩
  rintro _ ⟨u, rfl⟩
  change D.1 (j u) - R.1 (j u) = 0
  rw [hres, hRu, sub_self]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D35.map_comp_symm
statement:
theorem map_comp_symm {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (e : R ≃+* S) (n : ℕ) :
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.map (e : R →+* S) n ≫ SchemeProjectiveSpace.map (e.symm : S →+* R) n =
      𝟙 (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space S n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold SchemeProjectiveSpace.map SchemeProjectiveSpace.space
  calc
    Proj.map (gradedMap (e : R →+* S) n) (irrelevant_le_map_gradedMap _ n) ≫
        Proj.map (gradedMap (e.symm : S →+* R) n) (irrelevant_le_map_gradedMap _ n) =
      Proj.map ((gradedMap (e : R →+* S) n).comp (gradedMap (e.symm : S →+* R) n))
        (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp (irrelevant_le_map_gradedMap _ n)
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedMap _ n)) :=
      (Proj.map_comp _ _ _ _).symm
    _ = 𝟙 (Proj (grading S n)) := by
      convert Proj.map_id
      apply GradedRingHom.ext
      intro p
      change MvPolynomial.map (e : R →+* S) (MvPolynomial.map (e.symm : S →+* R) p) = p
      rw [MvPolynomial.map_map]
      have : (e : R →+* S).comp (e.symm : S →+* R) = RingHom.id S := by ext; simp
      rw [this, MvPolynomial.map_id]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D35.rho0_toSpec
statement:
theorem rho0_toSpec {n : ℕ} (eJ : J ≃ Fin (n + 1)) :
    rho0 (k := k) eJ ≫ SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k n = (singleCover (k := k) J).toBase
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isIso_chartι (k := k) J
  rw [← cancel_epi ((singleCover (k := k) J).chartι PUnit.unit)]
  unfold rho0
  simp only [Category.assoc, IsIso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  have h0 := intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace_comp_toSpec (singleBasis (k := k) eJ)
  erw [SchemeProjectiveSpace.map_toSpec, ← Category.assoc, h0]
  rw [AffineFrameCover.chartι_toBase]
  change _ = ((singleCover (k := k) J).chartToBase PUnit.unit) ≫
    ((singleCover (k := k) J).U PUnit.unit).ι
  have h1 : (isAffineOpen_top (Yk k)).fromSpec = Spec.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv := by
    rw [IsAffineOpen.fromSpec_top]
    simp
  erw [show Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (RingEquiv.toRingHom (kΓ (k := k)))) =
    (isAffineOpen_top (Yk k)).fromSpec from h1.symm]
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D35.exists_isPullback_free
statement:
theorem exists_isPullback_free {n : ℕ} (eJ : J ≃ Fin (n + 1)) (g : X ⟶ Yk k)
    (C : AffineFrameCover X (FreeM X J)) :
    ∃ ρ : C.scheme ⟶ SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n,
      IsPullback ρ C.toBase (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k n) g
proof:
:= by
  let Cs := singleCover (k := k) J
  let D := Cs.pullbackFrameCover g
  let e : FreeM X J ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj (FreeM (Yk k) J) := (pullbackFreeIso g J).symm
  let T := AffineFrameCover.transport e D
  let i1 : T.scheme ≅ D.scheme := AffineFrameCover.transportSchemeIso e D
  let i2 : T.scheme ≅ C.scheme := AffineFrameCover.isoOfCovers T C
  have h1 : i1.hom ≫ D.toBase = T.toBase := AffineFrameCover.transportSchemeIso_toBase e D
  have h2 : i2.hom ≫ C.toBase = T.toBase := AffineFrameCover.isoOfCovers_toBase T C
  have hp0 : IsPullback (Cs.pullbackProjectiveMap g) D.toBase Cs.toBase g :=
    Cs.isPullback_pullbackProjectiveMap g
  haveI : IsIso (rho0 (k := k) eJ) := inferInstance
  have hp1 : IsPullback (Cs.pullbackProjectiveMap g ≫ rho0 eJ) D.toBase
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k n) g := by
    refine hp0.of_iso (Iso.refl _) (asIso (rho0 (k := k) eJ)) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · simp
    · simp
    · simp [rho0_toSpec]; rfl
    · simp
  let e₁ : D.scheme ≅ C.scheme := i1.symm ≪≫ i2
  refine ⟨e₁.inv ≫ (Cs.pullbackProjectiveMap g ≫ rho0 eJ), ?_⟩
  refine hp1.of_iso e₁ (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp
  · simp only [e₁, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc, h2]
    rw [← h1]; simp
  · simp
  · simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D35.isPullback_free

theorem isPullback_free {n : ℕ} (eJ : J ≃ Fin (n + 1)) (g : X ⟶ Yk k)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D35.freeBundleIso_hom_fst

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem freeBundleIso_hom_fst {n : ℕ} (eJ : J ≃ Fin (n + 1)) (g : X ⟶ Yk k)
