name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.E14.exists_adapted_basis
statement:
theorem exists_adapted_basis (φ : M →ₗ[R] M') (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) (n : M)
    (hker : LinearMap.ker φ = R ∙ n) (hinj : Function.Injective fun r : R => r • n) :
    ∃ (b : Module.Basis (PUnit.{u + 1} ⊕ Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex R M') R M),
      b (Sum.inl PUnit.unit) = n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := Module.projective_lifting_property φ LinearMap.id hφ
  have hn : φ n = 0 := by
    have : n ∈ LinearMap.ker φ := by rw [hker]; exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self n
    exact this
  let f : (R × M') →ₗ[R] M :=
    LinearMap.coprod ((LinearMap.toSpanSingleton R M n)) σ
  have hf_apply : ∀ r m', f (r, m') = r • n + σ m' := by
    intro r m'; simp [f]
  have hφσ : ∀ m', φ (σ m') = m' := fun m' => by
    have := congrArg (fun g => g m') hσ
    simpa using this
  have hbij : Function.Bijective f := by
    constructor
    · rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
      rintro ⟨r, m'⟩ h
      rw [hf_apply] at h
      have h1 : m' = 0 := by
        have := congrArg φ h
        rw [map_add, map_smul, hn, smul_zero, zero_add, hφσ, map_zero] at this
        exact this
      subst h1
      rw [map_zero, add_zero] at h
      have : r = 0 := hinj (by simpa using h)
      subst this
      rfl
    · intro m
      have hm : m - σ (φ m) ∈ LinearMap.ker φ := by
        rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, map_sub, hφσ, sub_self]
      rw [hker, Submodule.mem_span_singleton] at hm
      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hm
      exact ⟨(r, φ m), by rw [hf_apply, hr]; abel⟩
  let e : (R × M') ≃ₗ[R] M := LinearEquiv.ofBijective f hbij
  refine ⟨(Module.Basis.prod (Module.Basis.singleton PUnit.{u + 1} R)
    (Module.Free.chooseBasis R M')).map e, ?_⟩
  simp [e, hf_apply]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.E14.symmetricProjMap_factor
statement:
theorem symmetricProjMap_factor (N : Submodule R M)
    [Module.Free R (M ⧸ N)] [Module.Finite R (M ⧸ N)]
    (e : (M ⧸ N) ≃ₗ[R] M') (φ : M →ₗ[R] M') (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hcomp : (e : (M ⧸ N) →ₗ[R] M').restrictScalars R ∘ₗ N.mkQ = φ) :
    symmetricProjMap (S := R) φ (span_range_of_surjective hφ) =
      (chartIsoOfLinearEquiv e).inv ≫
        symmetricProjMap (S := R) N.mkQ (E12.mkQ_spans N)
proof:
:= by
  have hspan : Submodule.span R
      (Set.range ((e : (M ⧸ N) →ₗ[R] M').restrictScalars R ∘ₗ N.mkQ)) = ⊤ := by
    rw [hcomp]; exact span_range_of_surjective hφ
  have h1 := symmetricProjMap_comp (S := R) (T := R) N.mkQ (e : (M ⧸ N) →ₗ[R] M')
    (E12.mkQ_spans N) (span_range_of_surjective e.surjective) hspan
  rw [symmetricProjMap_congr hcomp.symm _ hspan, ← h1]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.E14.chart_zero_scheme_E14
statement:
theorem chart_zero_scheme_E14
    (φ : M →ₗ[R] M') (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) (n : M)
    (hker : LinearMap.ker φ = R ∙ n) (hinj : Function.Injective fun r : R => r • n) :
    ∃ (b : Module.Basis (PUnit.{u + 1} ⊕ Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex R M') R M),
      b (Sum.inl PUnit.unit) = n ∧
      (∃ e : space R M' ≅ Proj (GradedIdealQuotient.grading (symGrading R M)
          (rankTwo_coordinateIdeal R b (Sum.inl PUnit.unit))),
        e.hom ≫ rankTwo_coordinateQuotient R b (Sum.inl PUnit.unit) =
          symmetricProjMap (S := R) φ (span_range_of_surjective hφ)) ∧
      ∀ k, IsRegular (rankTwo_coordinatePrincipalChart R b k (Sum.inl PUnit.unit)).equation
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_adapted_basis φ hφ n hker hinj
  refine ⟨b, hb, ?_⟩
  set l : PUnit.{u + 1} ⊕ Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex R M' := Sum.inl PUnit.unit with hl
  have hN : R ∙ b l = LinearMap.ker φ := by rw [hl, hb, hker]
  haveI := E12.quotCoord_free b l
  haveI := E12.quotCoord_finite b l
  obtain ⟨⟨e0, he0⟩, -, hreg⟩ := E12.coordinate_zero_scheme_E12 b l
  let e1 : (M ⧸ (R ∙ b l)) ≃ₗ[R] M' :=
    (Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ hN).trans (LinearMap.quotKerEquivOfSurjective φ hφ)
  have hcomp : (e1 : (M ⧸ (R ∙ b l)) →ₗ[R] M').restrictScalars R ∘ₗ (R ∙ b l).mkQ = φ := by
    ext m; simp [e1]
  refine ⟨⟨(chartIsoOfLinearEquiv e1).symm ≪≫ e0, ?_⟩, hreg⟩
  change ((chartIsoOfLinearEquiv e1).inv ≫ e0.hom) ≫ rankTwo_coordinateQuotient R b l = _
  rw [Category.assoc, he0, symmetricProjMap_factor (R ∙ b l) e1 φ hφ hcomp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.flag_zscore_graded
statement:
theorem flag_zscore_graded (hE : HasConstantRank X E (e + 1))
    (C : AffineFrameCover S.Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj E ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf S.Y))
    [Fact (Cl C.scheme)] (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = (e + 1) + 1) (D m : ℕ)
    (hm : m < D) :
    zscoreFlagOp cp F C hC D m =
      F.φ (PowerSeries.coeff m ((nroots F).map (uRoot F.K)).prod)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s', hs', hSegK⟩ := exists_segreLift cp hP hnat H F hE C hC
  have key := zscore_graded (nroots F) s' (by rw [card_nroots]; exact hSegK) D m hm
  rw [card_nroots] at key
  have key2 := congrArg F.φ key
  rw [map_sum] at key2
  rw [← key2]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  unfold gradedTerm
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [map_mul, hs', sandwichOn_eq_phi ops cp C hC j, if_pos h.1]
  · exact (map_zero _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.zscore_flag_td
statement:
theorem zscore_flag_td (hE : HasConstantRank X E (e + 1))
    (C : AffineFrameCover S.Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj E ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf S.Y))
    [Fact (Cl C.scheme)] (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = (e + 1) + 1) (D m : ℕ)
    (hm : m < D) :
    zscoreFlagOp cp F C hC D m =
      tdNinvOp (chernOpOn' ops cp hP ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj E) (e + 1)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback S.Y S.q E (e + 1) hE)) m
proof:
:= by
  rw [flag_zscore_graded cp hP hnat H F hE C hC D m hm, tdNinvOp_flag cp hP hnat H F hE m]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.zscore_descent
statement:
theorem zscore_descent (hE : HasConstantRank X E (e + 1))
    (C : AffineFrameCover S.Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj E ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf S.Y))
    [Fact (Cl C.scheme)] (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = (e + 1) + 1) (D m : ℕ)
    (hm : m < D) (ZX : Module.End ℚ (TotalChow X))
    (hZ : totalPullOn ops S.q S.d S.hd ∘ₗ ZX =
      zscoreFlagOp cp F C hC D m ∘ₗ totalPullOn ops S.q S.d S.hd) :
    ZX = tdNinvOp (chernOpOn' ops cp hP E (e + 1) hE) m
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro α
  apply S.injective
  have h1 := LinearMap.congr_fun hZ α
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at h1
  rw [h1, zscore_flag_td cp hP hnat H F hE C hC D m hm]
  have hint := tdNinvOp_inter
    (u := totalPullOn ops S.q S.d S.hd) (c := chernOpOn' ops cp hP E (e + 1) hE)
    (c' := chernOpOn' ops cp hP ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj E) (e + 1)
      (hasConstantRank_pullback S.Y S.q E (e + 1) hE))
    (fun a => chernOpOn'_pull_flat S.q ops cp S.d S.hd hP E (e + 1) hE a) m
  have := LinearMap.congr_fun hint α
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at this
  exact this.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.segreMap_toSpec
statement:
theorem segreMap_toSpec (hc : ∃ a₀, c a₀ = 1) :
    segreMap e κ c hc ≫ toSpec k M = toSpec R n ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom κ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold segreMap
  change Proj.map (segreGraded e κ c) (irrelevant_le_map_segreGraded e κ c hc) ≫
      (Proj.toSpecZero (grading k M) ≫
        Spec.map (degreeZeroEquiv k M).symm.toCommRingCatIso.hom) =
    (Proj.toSpecZero (grading R n) ≫
        Spec.map (degreeZeroEquiv R n).symm.toCommRingCatIso.hom) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom κ)
  rw [← Category.assoc, Proj.map_toSpecZero]
  rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  congr 1
  ext r
  simp [Proj.degreeZeroMap, degreeZeroEquiv, segreGraded]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.segreHom_toSpec
statement:
theorem segreHom_toSpec :
    segreHom (k := k) e ≫ toSpec k M =
      pullback.fst (toSpec k N) (toSpec k n) ≫ toSpec k N
proof:
:= by
  refine (segreCover k N n).hom_ext _ _ fun i ↦ ?_
  change jChart k N n i ≫ segreHom e ≫ toSpec k M = jChart k N n i ≫ _
  rw [jChart_segreHom_assoc, jChart_fst_assoc, awayChart_comp_toSpec]
  exact segreMap_toSpec e _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.exists_closedImmersion_prod_over
statement:
theorem exists_closedImmersion_prod_over {X : Scheme.{u}} (π : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (h : ∃ (N : ℕ) (j : X ⟶ space k N), IsClosedImmersion j ∧ j ≫ toSpec k N = π) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ (M : ℕ) (s : pullback π (toSpec k n) ⟶ space k M), IsClosedImmersion s ∧
      s ≫ toSpec k M = pullback.fst π (toSpec k n) ≫ π
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, j, hj, hjk⟩ := h
  refine ⟨SegreD36.segreDim N n, SegreD36.segreOnStd N n π j hjk,
    SegreD36.isClosedImmersion_segreOnStd N n π j hjk, ?_⟩
  have h1 := (SegreD36.isPullback_prodMap (n := n) π j hjk).w
  unfold SegreD36.segreOnStd SegreD36.segreOn
  rw [Category.assoc, SegreD36.segreHom_toSpec, ← Category.assoc (SegreD36.prodMap _ _ _), h1,
    Category.assoc, hjk]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.exists_closedImmersion_prod_prod_over
statement:
theorem exists_closedImmersion_prod_prod_over {X : Scheme.{u}} (π : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (h : ∃ (N : ℕ) (j : X ⟶ space k N), IsClosedImmersion j ∧ j ≫ toSpec k N = π) (a b : ℕ) :
    ∃ (M : ℕ) (s : pullback (pullback.fst π (toSpec k a) ≫ π) (toSpec k b) ⟶ space k M),
      IsClosedImmersion s ∧
        s ≫ toSpec k M = pullback.fst _ _ ≫ pullback.fst π (toSpec k a) ≫ π
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, s, hs, hsk⟩ := exists_closedImmersion_prod_over π h a
  obtain ⟨M', s', hs', hsk'⟩ := exists_closedImmersion_prod_over
    (pullback.fst π (toSpec k a) ≫ π) ⟨M, s, hs, hsk⟩ b
  exact ⟨M', s', hs', hsk'⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.a11_unitHom_eq_zero_of_cover
proof:
:= by
  have hall : ∀ W : X.affineOpens, Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ W (1 : Γ(X, W)) = 0 := by
    intro W
    let T : TopCat.Sheaf Ab X := ⟨L.presheaf, L.isSheaf⟩
    let ι' := {p : X.affineOpens × I // p.1.1 ≤ W.1 ∧ p.1.1 ≤ U p.2}
    have hcov : W.1 ≤ ⨆ p : ι', p.1.1.1 := by
      intro y hy
      have hy' : y ∈ ⨆ i, U i := by rw [hU]; trivial
      obtain ⟨i, hyi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hy'
      obtain ⟨W', hW', hyW', hWle⟩ :=
        (Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens) (show y ∈ U i ⊓ W.1 from ⟨hyi, hy⟩)
      exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨(⟨W', hW'⟩, i), hWle.trans inf_le_right,
        hWle.trans inf_le_left⟩, hyW'⟩
    apply T.eq_of_locally_eq' (fun p : ι' => p.1.1.1) W.1 (fun p => homOfLE p.2.1) hcov
    intro p
    change L.presheaf.map (homOfLE p.2.1).op (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ W (1 : Γ(X, W))) =
      L.presheaf.map (homOfLE p.2.1).op 0
    rw [section_app_one_restrict σ p.2.1, ← section_app_one_restrict σ p.2.2, h p.1.2, map_zero,
      map_zero]
  apply KoszulComplexSheaf.moduleHom_eq_of_affine_app_eq X
  intro W
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro r
  have hsm : ∀ r' : Γ(X, W.1), Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ W r' =
      r' • Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ W (1 : Γ(X, W)) := by
    intro r'
    have h := Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul σ r' (1 : Γ(X, W))
    erw [smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at h
    exact h
  rw [show (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (σ.val.app (op W.1))) r = Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ W r from rfl,
    hsm r, hall W]
  first | rfl | (simp; done) | (erw [smul_zero]; rfl)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.a11_unitSection_eq_zero_of_comp_alpha_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  refine a11_unitHom_eq_zero_of_cover s C.U C.covers fun i => ?_
  have h1 : Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (s ≫ C.tautologicalPushforwardHom) (C.U i)
      (1 : Γ(X, C.U i)) = 0 := by
    rw [h]
    rfl
  exact a11_alpha_app_injective C i _ h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.a11_originalCoordinate_nonvanishing
statement:
theorem a11_originalCoordinate_nonvanishing {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (C : AffineFrameCover X (tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X))
    (s : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X)
    [IsIntegral C.scheme] (hs : s ≠ 0) :
    ∀ U : C.scheme.affineOpens, Nonempty U.1 →
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
        ((C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso C.toBase).inv ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).map s ≫ C.tautologicalQuotient) U
        (1 : Γ(C.scheme,U)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro U hU h0
  apply hs
  have hline := isLocalLineFrame_of_hasConstantRank (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
  have hz := unitSection_eq_zero_of_integral hline _ U (by simpa using hU) h0
  have := (originalCoordinateSection_eq_zero_iff C s).1 hz
  exact a11_unitSection_eq_zero_of_comp_alpha_eq_zero C s this

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.polynomialToCoordinateLaurent_coordinate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem polynomialToCoordinateLaurent_coordinate (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    polynomialToCoordinateLaurent k n (coordinate k n i) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (coordinateLaurentBasisExponent n i) 1
proof:
:= by
  change AddMonoidAlgebra.mapDomain (coordinateExponentToLaurent n)
      (Finsupp.single (Finsupp.single i 1) 1) =
    AddMonoidAlgebra.single (coordinateLaurentBasisExponent n i) 1
  rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.mapDomain_single]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechEquationLaurentUnit_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateCechEquationLaurentUnit_val (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (coordinateCechEquationLaurentUnit k n p a : CoordinateLaurentPolynomial k n) =
      polynomialToCoordinateLaurent k n (coordinateCechEquation k n p a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold coordinateCechEquationLaurentUnit coordinateCechEquation
  rw [Units.coe_prod, map_prod]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro t _
  simpa only [coordinateLaurentMonomialUnit] using
    (polynomialToCoordinateLaurent_coordinate k n (a t)).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechEquationLaurent_mul_inverse
statement:
theorem coordinateCechEquationLaurent_mul_inverse (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    polynomialToCoordinateLaurent k n (coordinateCechEquation k n p a) *
        coordinateCechEquationLaurentInverse k n p a = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coordinateCechEquationLaurentUnit_val k n p a]
  exact (coordinateCechEquationLaurentUnit k n p a).val_inv

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechEquationLaurent_isUnit
statement:
theorem coordinateCechEquationLaurent_isUnit (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    IsUnit (polynomialToCoordinateLaurent k n (coordinateCechEquation k n p a))
proof:
:=
  ⟨coordinateCechEquationLaurentUnit k n p a,
    coordinateCechEquationLaurentUnit_val k n p a⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechLocalizationToLaurent_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateCechLocalizationToLaurent_mk (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) (q : ℕ) (f : Polynomial k n) :
    coordinateCechLocalizationToLaurent k n p a
        (Localization.mk f
          ⟨coordinateCechEquation k n p a ^ q, by
            exact ⟨q, rfl⟩⟩) =
      polynomialToCoordinateLaurent k n f *
        coordinateCechEquationLaurentInverse k n p a ^ q
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [coordinateCechLocalizationToLaurent] using
    (Localization.awayLift_mk
      (polynomialToCoordinateLaurent k n)
      (coordinateCechEquation k n p a) f
      (coordinateCechEquationLaurentInverse k n p a)
      (coordinateCechEquationLaurent_mul_inverse k n p a) q)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechAwayToLaurent_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateCechAwayToLaurent_mk (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) (q : ℕ) (f : Polynomial k n)
    (hf : f ∈ grading k n (q • (p + 1))) :
    coordinateCechAwayToLaurent k n p a
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading k n)
          (coordinateCechEquation_mem_degree k n p a) q f hf) =
      polynomialToCoordinateLaurent k n f *
        coordinateCechEquationLaurentInverse k n p a ^ q
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coordinateCechAwayToLaurent, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
    HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk,
    coordinateCechLocalizationToLaurent_mk]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent_basicOpenIsoAway_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateCechBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent_basicOpenIsoAway_hom (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (z : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading k n) (coordinateCechEquation k n p a)) :
    coordinateCechBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent k n p a
        ((coordinateCechBasicOpenIsoAway k n p a).hom z) =
      coordinateCechAwayToLaurent k n p a z
proof:
:= by
  change coordinateCechAwayToLaurent k n p a
      ((coordinateCechBasicOpenIsoAway k n p a).inv
        ((coordinateCechBasicOpenIsoAway k n p a).hom z)) = _
  rw [Iso.hom_inv_id_apply]

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45.zeroIdeal_le_ker
statement:
theorem zeroIdeal_le_ker {S : Scheme.{u}} (g : S ⟶ Y) (hg : g.appTop t = 0) :
    zeroIdeal t ≤ g.ker
proof:
:= by
  unfold Scheme.Hom.ker
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_ofIdeals_iff]
  intro U
  change (Ideal.span {t}).map (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op).hom ≤ _
  rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Ideal.mem_comap, RingHom.mem_ker]
  have h := g.naturality (homOfLE (le_top : (U : Y.Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op
  have h2 := congr(($h).hom t)
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply] at h2
  have hg' : (g.app ⊤).hom t = 0 := hg
  rw [h2, hg', map_zero]

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45.ker_zeroι
statement: theorem ker_zeroι : (zeroι t).ker = zeroIdeal t
proof: := Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_subschemeι _

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45.liftZero_zeroι
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem liftZero_zeroι {S : Scheme.{u}} (g : S ⟶ Y) (hg : g.appTop t = 0) :

proof:
:=

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45.zeroSchemeIso_inv_zeroι
statement:
theorem zeroSchemeIso_inv_zeroι (hs : s ≫ π = 𝟙 B) (hst : s.appTop t = 0)
    (huniv : ∀ {S : Scheme.{u}} (g : S ⟶ T), g.appTop t = 0 → g ≫ π ≫ s = g) :
    (zeroSchemeIso π s t hs hst huniv).inv ≫ zeroι t = s
proof:
:=
  liftZero_zeroι t s hst

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45.appTop_comp_apply
statement:
theorem appTop_comp_apply {S T U : Scheme.{u}} (g : S ⟶ T) (h : T ⟶ U) (x : Γ(U, ⊤)) :
    (g ≫ h).appTop.hom x = g.appTop.hom (h.appTop.hom x)
proof:
:= by

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45.coordOf_comp
statement:
theorem coordOf_comp {S T : Scheme.{u}} (g : S ⟶ T) (χ : T ⟶ Spec (.of R[X])) :
    g.appTop.hom (coordOf χ) = coordOf (g ≫ χ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold coordOf
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop]
  rfl

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45.coordOf_zeroPt
statement:
theorem coordOf_zeroPt {S : Scheme.{u}} (γ : S ⟶ Spec (.of R)) :
    coordOf (γ ≫ zeroPt R) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coordOf_comp]
  unfold coordOf zeroPt
  have h := Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : R)))
  have h2 := congr(($h).hom (Polynomial.X : R[X]))
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom,
    Polynomial.coe_evalRingHom, Polynomial.eval_X, map_zero] at h2
  rw [← h2, map_zero]

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45.exists_factor_zeroPt
statement:
theorem exists_factor_zeroPt {S : Scheme.{u}} (h : S ⟶ Spec (.of R[X])) (h0 : coordOf h = 0) :
    ∃ γ : S ⟶ Spec (.of R), h = γ ≫ zeroPt R
proof:
:= by
  let θ : CommRingCat.of R[X] ⟶ Γ(S, ⊤) := (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R[X])).inv ≫ h.appTop
  let ψ : CommRingCat.of R ⟶ Γ(S, ⊤) := CommRingCat.ofHom Polynomial.C ≫ θ
  refine ⟨S.toSpecΓ ≫ Spec.map ψ, ?_⟩
  apply ext_of_isAffine
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, Scheme.toSpecΓ_appTop]
  rw [← cancel_epi (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R[X])).inv]
  have hθ : θ = CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : R)) ≫ ψ := by
    refine CommRingCat.hom_ext (Polynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a => ?_) ?_)
    · simp [ψ]
    · have : θ.hom Polynomial.X = 0 := h0
      simp [ψ, this]
  have e1 : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R[X])).inv ≫ (zeroPt R).appTop ≫ (Spec.map ψ).appTop ≫
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(S, ⊤)).hom =
        CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : R)) ≫ ψ := by
    unfold zeroPt
    rw [Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality, ← Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality_assoc]
    simp
  rw [e1, ← hθ]

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45.lineQ_lineπ
statement: theorem lineQ_lineπ : lineQ Y k φ ≫ lineπ Y = (lineFibreIso Y k φ 0).hom
proof:
:=

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45.lineS_lineπ
statement: theorem lineS_lineπ : lineS Y k φ ≫ lineπ Y = 𝟙 Y
proof:
:= by

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45.line_isPullback
statement:
theorem line_isPullback : IsPullback (lineQ Y k φ)
    (quotientToPoint Y ⊥ k φ _ (lineHom_bot_compat Y k φ 0)) (lineχ Y k φ) (zeroPt k)
proof:
:=
  quotient_isPullback Y ⊥ k φ _ (lineHom_bot_compat Y k φ 0) 0 (fun _ ↦ rfl)

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45.lineS_lineT
statement: theorem lineS_lineT : (lineS Y k φ).appTop.hom (lineT Y k φ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold lineT
  rw [coordOf_comp]
  have h : lineS Y k φ ≫ lineχ Y k φ = ((lineFibreIso Y k φ 0).inv ≫
      quotientToPoint Y ⊥ k φ _ (lineHom_bot_compat Y k φ 0)) ≫ zeroPt k := by
    rw [lineS, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, (line_isPullback Y k φ).w]
  rw [h]
  exact coordOf_zeroPt _

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45.line_huniv
statement:
theorem line_huniv {S : Scheme.{u}} (g : S ⟶ line Y) (hg : g.appTop.hom (lineT Y k φ) = 0) :
    g ≫ lineπ Y ≫ lineS Y k φ = g
proof:
:= by
  unfold lineT at hg
  rw [coordOf_comp] at hg
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := exists_factor_zeroPt _ hg
  have hg' : g = (line_isPullback Y k φ).lift g γ hγ ≫ lineQ Y k φ :=
    ((line_isPullback Y k φ).lift_fst g γ hγ).symm
  conv_lhs => rw [hg']
  rw [Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc (lineQ Y k φ), lineQ_lineπ, lineS]
  simp

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45.subS_subschemeToLine
statement:
theorem subS_subschemeToLine : subS Y J k φ ≫ subschemeToLineGlobal Y J =
    J.subschemeι ≫ lineS Y k φ
proof:
:=
  (isPullback_subschemeLine Y J).lift_fst _ _ _

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45.subS_polynomialToClosedBase
statement: theorem subS_polynomialToClosedBase : subS Y J k φ ≫ polynomialToClosedBase Y J = 𝟙 _
proof:
:=
  (isPullback_subschemeLine Y J).lift_snd _ _ _

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45.subS_subT
statement: theorem subS_subT : (subS Y J k φ).appTop.hom (subT Y J k φ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold subT
  rw [← appTop_comp_apply, subS_subschemeToLine, appTop_comp_apply,
    lineS_lineT, map_zero]

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45.sub_huniv
statement:
theorem sub_huniv {S : Scheme.{u}} (g : S ⟶ subschemeUGlobal Y J)
    (hg : g.appTop.hom (subT Y J k φ) = 0) :
    g ≫ polynomialToClosedBase Y J ≫ subS Y J k φ = g
proof:
:= by
  refine (isPullback_subschemeLine Y J).hom_ext ?_ ?_
  · have h1 : (g ≫ subschemeToLineGlobal Y J).appTop.hom (lineT Y k φ) = 0 := by
      rw [appTop_comp_apply]; exact hg
    have h2 := line_huniv Y k φ _ h1
    have hc : polynomialToClosedBase Y J ≫ J.subschemeι =
        subschemeToLineGlobal Y J ≫ lineπ Y := (isPullback_subschemeLine Y J).w.symm
    calc (g ≫ polynomialToClosedBase Y J ≫ subS Y J k φ) ≫ subschemeToLineGlobal Y J
        = g ≫ (polynomialToClosedBase Y J ≫ J.subschemeι) ≫ lineS Y k φ := by
          rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, subS_subschemeToLine, Category.assoc]
      _ = g ≫ (subschemeToLineGlobal Y J ≫ lineπ Y) ≫ lineS Y k φ := by rw [hc]
      _ = g ≫ subschemeToLineGlobal Y J := by
          simpa only [Category.assoc] using h2
  · rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, subS_polynomialToClosedBase, Category.comp_id]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.mem_chartOf
statement: theorem mem_chartOf (q : space k N) : q ∈ coordinateOpen k N (chartOf q)

:=

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.jFrame_unit
statement:
theorem jFrame_unit (p : X) :
    IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ (jFrame j p).U p (jFrame j p).mem
      (sectionCoordSec (jFrame j p) (jSec j (chartOf (j p)))))
proof:
:= by
  unfold jFrame jSec
  rw [sectionCoordSec_pullbackFrame]
  have hu := (tsec_unit k N (chartOf (j p)) (j p) (mem_chartOf (j p)) (frame1 (j p))).map
    (j.stalkMap p).hom
  rw [Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply] at hu
  exact hu

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.ψ_pullback
statement:
theorem ψ_pullback (p : X) (V : (space k N).Opens) (hv : j p ∈ V) (x : Γ(space k N, V)) :
    ψ p (j ⁻¹ᵁ V) hv (Scheme.Hom.app j V x) = resMap j p (ψ (j p) V hv x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold ψ resMap
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.evalAt_jFrame
statement:
theorem evalAt_jFrame (p : X) :
    evalAt (jRho j) (jFrame j) (jSec j) p =
      (resMap j p).comp (evalP k N (j p) (frame1 (j p)))
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro r
    unfold evalAt evalP jRho
    simp only [MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C, RingHom.comp_apply]
    exact ψ_pullback j p ⊤ trivial (rhoP k N r)
  · intro i
    unfold evalAt evalP
    simp only [MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X', RingHom.comp_apply]
    unfold jSec jFrame
    rw [sectionCoordSec_pullbackFrame]
    exact ψ_pullback j p _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.mem_hker_iff
statement:
theorem mem_hker_iff (p : X) (n : ℕ) (r : MvPolynomial (Fin (N + 1)) k) (hr : r ∈ grading k N n) :
    r ∈ RiemannRoch.GradedAvoidD29.hker (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (N + 1)) k)
      (evalAt (jRho j) (jFrame j) (jSec j)) p ↔
    r ∈ (j p).asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal
proof:
:= by
  unfold RiemannRoch.GradedAvoidD29.hker
  have h1 : r ∈ ((RingHom.ker (evalAt (jRho j) (jFrame j) (jSec j) p)).homogeneousCore
      (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (N + 1)) k)).toIdeal ↔
      r ∈ RingHom.ker (evalAt (jRho j) (jFrame j) (jSec j) p) :=
    ⟨fun h => Ideal.toIdeal_homogeneousCore_le _ _ h,
     fun h => Ideal.mem_homogeneousCore_of_homogeneous_of_mem ⟨n, hr⟩ h⟩
  rw [h1, RingHom.mem_ker, evalAt_jFrame, RingHom.comp_apply,
    map_eq_zero_iff (resMap j p) (resMap j p).injective]
  exact evalP_eq_zero_iff k N (chartOf (j p)) (j p) (mem_chartOf (j p)) (frame1 (j p)) n r hr

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.separates_jFrame
statement:
theorem separates_jFrame [IsClosedImmersion j] :
    Separates (jRho j) (jFrame j) (jSec j)
proof:
:= by
  intro S p _ q _ h
  have hI : (j p).asHomogeneousIdeal = (j q).asHomogeneousIdeal := by
    apply HomogeneousIdeal.ext'
    intro n r hr
    have := mem_hker_iff j p n r hr
    have h2 := mem_hker_iff j q n r hr
    rw [h] at this
    exact (this.symm.trans h2).symm.trans Iff.rfl |>.symm
  have hjq : j p = j q := ProjectiveSpectrum.ext hI
  exact (Scheme.Hom.isClosedEmbedding j).injective hjq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.localAvoidance_closedImmersion
statement:
theorem localAvoidance_closedImmersion (j : X ⟶ space k N) [IsClosedImmersion j] (L : X.Modules)
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) : LocalAvoidance L
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B', hB', hB'g, hLg⟩ := hasAmpleGenerators_of_closedImmersion (k := k) N j L hL
  exact localAvoidance_of_chartData L ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj (O1 k N)) B' hL
    (hasConstantRank_pullback X j _ 1 (hasConstantRank_twist (k := k) N (0 + 1))) hB'
    (fun p => hB'g p) (fun p => hLg p) (jRho j) (jFrame j) (jSec j) (fun p => chartOf (j p))
    (jFrame_unit j) (separates_jFrame j)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.capDescends_of_closedImmersion_anyField
statement:
theorem capDescends_of_closedImmersion_anyField [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian X] (j : X ⟶ space k N) [IsClosedImmersion j] (L : X.Modules)
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (n : ℕ) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D5.CapDescends (k := k) L hL n

:=
  capDescends_of_localAvoidance (k := k) L hL n (localAvoidance_closedImmersion j L hL)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.D34.projMap_eq_of_scalar
statement:
theorem projMap_eq_of_scalar (f g : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ)
    (hf : ℬ₊ ≤ 𝒜₊.map f) (hg : ℬ₊ ≤ 𝒜₊.map g)
    (c : B) (hc : c ∈ ℬ 0)
    (h : ∀ (i : ℕ) (x : A), x ∈ 𝒜 i → g x = c ^ i * f x) :
    Proj.map g hg = Proj.map f hf
proof:
:= by
  refine (Proj.mapAffineOpenCover g hg).openCover.hom_ext _ _ fun s ↦ ?_
  simp only [Scheme.AffineOpenCover.openCover_f, Proj.mapAffineOpenCover_f]
  rw [Proj.awayι_comp_map g hg s.1.2 s.2.1 s.2.2]
  have hs' : s.2.1 ∈ 𝒜 s.1.1 := s.2.2
  have hfs : f s.2.1 ∈ ℬ s.1.1 := f.2 s.2.2
  have hpos : 0 < s.1.1 := s.1.2
  have hcpow : c ^ s.1.1 ∈ ℬ 0 := by
    simpa using SetLike.pow_mem_graded s.1.1 hc
  have hgs : g s.2.1 = f s.2.1 * c ^ s.1.1 := by
    rw [h _ _ s.2.2]
    exact mul_comm _ _
  have key := Proj.SpecMap_awayMap_awayι (𝒜 := ℬ) hfs hpos hcpow hgs
  rw [← key, Category.assoc, Proj.awayι_comp_map f hf s.1.2 s.2.1 s.2.2,
    ← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 2
  apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro x
  obtain ⟨n, a, ha, rfl⟩ := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_surjective 𝒜 hs' x
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
    Away.map_mk, awayMap_mk]
  have e : g a = f a * (c ^ s.1.1) ^ n := by
    rw [h _ a ha, ← pow_mul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm, mul_comm n]
  simp only [e]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.D34.gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap_smul_apply
statement:
theorem gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap_smul_apply (φ : M →ₗ[R] N) (r : R) (i : ℕ)
    (x : SymmetricAlgebra R M) (hx : x ∈ symGrading R M i) :
    gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap (r • φ) x =
      (algebraMap R (SymmetricAlgebra R N) r) ^ i * gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ x
proof:
:= by
  change x ∈ LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M : M →ₗ[R] SymmetricAlgebra R M) ^ i at hx
  refine Submodule.pow_induction_on_left'
    (M := LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M : M →ₗ[R] SymmetricAlgebra R M))
    (C := fun e y _ ↦ gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap (r • φ) y =
      (algebraMap R (SymmetricAlgebra R N) r) ^ e * gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ y)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ hx
  · intro a
    change symmetricAlgebraMap (r • φ) (algebraMap R (SymmetricAlgebra R M) a) =
      (algebraMap R (SymmetricAlgebra R N) r) ^ 0 *
        symmetricAlgebraMap φ (algebraMap R (SymmetricAlgebra R M) a)
    have h1 := symmetricAlgebraMap_algebraMap (R := R) (S := R) (M := M) (N := N) (r • φ) a
    have h2 := symmetricAlgebraMap_algebraMap (R := R) (S := R) (M := M) (N := N) φ a
    rw [pow_zero, one_mul]
    exact h1.trans h2.symm
  · intro y z d hy hz hy' hz'
    rw [map_add, map_add, hy', hz', mul_add]
  · intro y hy d z hz hz'
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hy
    change symmetricAlgebraMap (r • φ) (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M m * z) =
      (algebraMap R (SymmetricAlgebra R N) r) ^ (d + 1) *
        symmetricAlgebraMap φ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M m * z)
    have hz'' : symmetricAlgebraMap (r • φ) z =
        (algebraMap R (SymmetricAlgebra R N) r) ^ d * symmetricAlgebraMap φ z := hz'
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, symmetricAlgebraMap_ι, symmetricAlgebraMap_ι, hz'',
      LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul, Algebra.smul_def, pow_succ]
    ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.D34.symmetricProjMap_smul
statement:
theorem symmetricProjMap_smul (φ : M →ₗ[R] N) (u : Rˣ)
    (hspan : Submodule.span R (Set.range φ) = ⊤)
    (hspan' : Submodule.span R (Set.range ((u : R) • φ)) = ⊤) :
    symmetricProjMap ((u : R) • φ) hspan' = symmetricProjMap φ hspan
proof:
:= by
  unfold symmetricProjMap
  refine projMap_eq_of_scalar _ _ _ _ (algebraMap R (SymmetricAlgebra R N) (u : R)) ?_
    (fun i x hx ↦ gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap_smul_apply φ u i x hx)
  change algebraMap R (SymmetricAlgebra R N) u ∈
    LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R N : N →ₗ[R] SymmetricAlgebra R N) ^ 0
  rw [pow_zero]
  exact Submodule.algebraMap_mem (u : R)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.D34.chartIsoOfLinearEquiv_eq_of_smul
statement:
theorem chartIsoOfLinearEquiv_eq_of_smul (e e' : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (u : Rˣ)
    (h : ∀ m, e' m = (u : R) • e m) :
    chartIsoOfLinearEquiv e' = chartIsoOfLinearEquiv e
proof:
:= by
  have hsymm : (e'.symm : N →ₗ[R] M) = ((u⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) • (e.symm : N →ₗ[R] M) := by
    ext n
    apply e'.injective
    change e' (e'.symm n) = e' (((u⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) • e.symm n)
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, h, map_smul, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, smul_smul,
      Units.mul_inv, one_smul]
  have hsp : ∀ (v : N ≃ₗ[R] M), Submodule.span R (Set.range (v : N →ₗ[R] M)) = ⊤ := fun v ↦ by
    have : Set.range (v : N →ₗ[R] M) = Set.univ := Set.range_eq_univ.mpr v.surjective
    rw [this, Submodule.span_univ]
  have hsp' : Submodule.span R (Set.range (((u⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) • (e.symm : N →ₗ[R] M))) = ⊤ := by
    rw [← hsymm]; exact hsp e'.symm
  have hhom : (chartIsoOfLinearEquiv e').hom = (chartIsoOfLinearEquiv e).hom := by
    change symmetricProjMap (e'.symm : N →ₗ[R] M) (hsp e'.symm) =
      symmetricProjMap (e.symm : N →ₗ[R] M) (hsp e.symm)
    rw [symmetricProjMap_congr hsymm (hsp e'.symm) hsp']
    exact symmetricProjMap_smul _ _ _ _
  exact Iso.ext hhom

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.alternatingSum_eq_of_vanish
statement:
theorem alternatingSum_eq_of_vanish {m n : ℕ} (t : ℕ → A)
    (hm : ∀ i, m < i → t i = 0) (hn : ∀ i, n < i → t i = 0) :
    alternatingSum m t = alternatingSum n t
proof:
:= by
  wlog h : m ≤ n generalizing m n
  · exact (this hn hm (by omega)).symm
  unfold alternatingSum
  apply Finset.sum_subset
  · intro i hi
    simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hi ⊢
    omega
  · intro i hi hni
    simp only [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hi hni
    rw [hm i (by omega), smul_zero]

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.alternatingSum_of_concentrated
statement:
theorem alternatingSum_of_concentrated (n : ℕ) (t : ℕ → A) (h : ∀ i, 0 < i → t i = 0) :
    alternatingSum n t = t 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold alternatingSum
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 0]
  · simp
  · intro b _ hb
    rw [h b (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hb), smul_zero]
  · intro h0
    simp at h0

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.hleray_of_generators
statement:
theorem hleray_of_generators
    (n₁ n₂ n : ℕ)
    (higher₁ : Object → ℕ → ExactGrothendieck.Group Object' Exact')
    (higher₂ : Object' → ℕ → B)
    (higherComposite : Object → ℕ → B)
    (hlong₁ : ∀ X Y Z, Exact X Y Z →
      LongExactWitness n₁ (higher₁ X) (higher₁ Y) (higher₁ Z))
    (hlong₂ : ∀ X Y Z, Exact' X Y Z →
      LongExactWitness n₂ (higher₂ X) (higher₂ Y) (higher₂ Z))
    (hlongComposite : ∀ X Y Z, Exact X Y Z →
      LongExactWitness n (higherComposite X) (higherComposite Y) (higherComposite Z))
    (S : Object → Prop)
    (hgen : ∀ X, ExactGrothendieck.classOf Object Exact X ∈
      AddSubgroup.closure {z | ∃ G, S G ∧ ExactGrothendieck.classOf Object Exact G = z})
    (hS : ∀ G, S G →
      derivedPushforward n₂ higher₂ hlong₂ (alternatingSum n₁ (higher₁ G)) =
        alternatingSum n (higherComposite G)) :
    ∀ X, derivedPushforward n₂ higher₂ hlong₂ (alternatingSum n₁ (higher₁ X)) =
        alternatingSum n (higherComposite X)
proof:
:= by
  intro X
  let f := (derivedPushforward n₂ higher₂ hlong₂).comp (derivedPushforward n₁ higher₁ hlong₁)
  let g := derivedPushforward n higherComposite hlongComposite
  have hle : AddSubgroup.closure
      {z | ∃ G, S G ∧ ExactGrothendieck.classOf Object Exact G = z} ≤ (f - g).ker := by
    rw [AddSubgroup.closure_le]
    rintro z ⟨G, hG, rfl⟩
    change (f - g) _ = 0
    rw [AddMonoidHom.sub_apply, sub_eq_zero]
    simp only [f, g, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, derivedPushforward_classOf]
    exact hS G hG
  have hX := hle (hgen X)
  rw [AddMonoidHom.mem_ker, AddMonoidHom.sub_apply, sub_eq_zero] at hX
  simpa only [f, g, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, derivedPushforward_classOf] using hX

name: GrothendieckRiemannRoch.leray_euler_of_acyclic
statement:
theorem leray_euler_of_acyclic
    (n₁ n₂ n : ℕ)
    (higher₁ : Object → ℕ → ExactGrothendieck.Group Object' Exact')
    (higher₂ : Object' → ℕ → B)
    (higherComposite : Object → ℕ → B)
    (hlong₂ : ∀ X Y Z, Exact' X Y Z →
      LongExactWitness n₂ (higher₂ X) (higher₂ Y) (higher₂ Z))
    (push : Object → Object') (G : Object)
    (hconc : ∀ i, 0 < i → higher₁ G i = 0)
    (h0 : higher₁ G 0 = ExactGrothendieck.classOf Object' Exact' (push G))
    (hdeg : ∀ j, higherComposite G j = higher₂ (push G) j)
    (hb₂ : ∀ j, n₂ < j → higher₂ (push G) j = 0)
    (hb : ∀ j, n < j → higherComposite G j = 0) :
    derivedPushforward n₂ higher₂ hlong₂ (alternatingSum n₁ (higher₁ G)) =
      alternatingSum n (higherComposite G)
proof:
:= by
  rw [alternatingSum_of_concentrated n₁ _ hconc, h0, derivedPushforward_classOf,
    alternatingSum_eq_of_vanish (higher₂ (push G)) hb₂
      (fun j hj ↦ by rw [← hdeg]; exact hb j hj)]
  unfold alternatingSum
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ by rw [hdeg]

name: SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages_comp_of_acyclic_generation
statement:
theorem derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages_comp_of_acyclic_generation
    (nXY nYZ nXZ : ℕ)
    (higherXY : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M} → ℕ → Y.Modules)
    (hcoherentXY : ∀ E i, SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike Y (higherXY E i))
    (hlongXY : ∀ A B C,
      ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X) A B C →
        GrothendieckRiemannRoch.LongExactWitness nXY
          (higherDirectImageClass higherXY hcoherentXY A)
          (higherDirectImageClass higherXY hcoherentXY B)
          (higherDirectImageClass higherXY hcoherentXY C))
    (higherYZ : {M : Y.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike Y M} → ℕ → Z.Modules)
    (hcoherentYZ : ∀ E i, SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike Z (higherYZ E i))
    (hlongYZ : ∀ A B C,
      ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn Y.Modules (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike Y) A B C →
        GrothendieckRiemannRoch.LongExactWitness nYZ
          (higherDirectImageClass higherYZ hcoherentYZ A)
          (higherDirectImageClass higherYZ hcoherentYZ B)
          (higherDirectImageClass higherYZ hcoherentYZ C))
    (higherXZ : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M} → ℕ → Z.Modules)
    (hcoherentXZ : ∀ E i, SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike Z (higherXZ E i))
    (hlongXZ : ∀ A B C,
      ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X) A B C →
        GrothendieckRiemannRoch.LongExactWitness nXZ
          (higherDirectImageClass higherXZ hcoherentXZ A)
          (higherDirectImageClass higherXZ hcoherentXZ B)
          (higherDirectImageClass higherXZ hcoherentXZ C))
    (hgen : ∀ E, ExactGrothendieck.classOf _
        (ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X)) E ∈
      AddSubgroup.closure {z | ∃ G, IsHigherAcyclic higherXY G ∧
        ExactGrothendieck.classOf _
          (ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X)) G = z})
    (hcollapse : ∀ G, IsHigherAcyclic higherXY G → ∀ j,
      Nonempty (higherXZ G j ≅ higherYZ ⟨higherXY G 0, hcoherentXY G 0⟩ j))
    (hbYZ : ∀ E j, nYZ < j → IsZero (higherYZ E j))
    (hbXZ : ∀ E j, nXZ < j → IsZero (higherXZ E j)) :
    (derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages nYZ higherYZ hcoherentYZ hlongYZ).comp
        (derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages nXY higherXY hcoherentXY hlongXY) =
      derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages nXZ higherXZ hcoherentXZ hlongXZ
proof:
:= by
  have hzeroZ : SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike Z (0 : Z.Modules) :=
    show (0 : Z.Modules).IsFinitePresentation from inferInstance
  refine derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages_comp_of_leray_euler nXY nYZ nXZ
    higherXY hcoherentXY hlongXY higherYZ hcoherentYZ hlongYZ higherXZ hcoherentXZ hlongXZ ?_
  refine GrothendieckRiemannRoch.hleray_of_generators nXY nYZ nXZ
    (higherDirectImageClass higherXY hcoherentXY)
    (higherDirectImageClass higherYZ hcoherentYZ)
    (higherDirectImageClass higherXZ hcoherentXZ) hlongXY hlongYZ hlongXZ
    (IsHigherAcyclic higherXY) hgen ?_
  intro G hG
  refine GrothendieckRiemannRoch.leray_euler_of_acyclic nXY nYZ nXZ
    (higherDirectImageClass higherXY hcoherentXY)
    (higherDirectImageClass higherYZ hcoherentYZ)
    (higherDirectImageClass higherXZ hcoherentXZ) hlongYZ
    (fun G ↦ ⟨higherXY G 0, hcoherentXY G 0⟩) G ?_ rfl ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro i hi
    exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_isZero _ _ (hcoherentXY G i) (hG i hi)
  · intro j
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := hcollapse G hG j
    exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso _ _ _ _ hzeroZ (isZero_zero _) e
  · intro j hj
    exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_isZero _ _ _ (hbYZ _ j hj)
  · intro j hj
    exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_isZero _ _ _ (hbXZ G j hj)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twist_isHigherAcyclic_of_large
statement:

statement:
theorem projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward_comp_of_acyclicCollapse [IsLocallyNoetherian X]

    (higherYZ : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M} → ℕ → Z.Modules)

      GrothendieckRiemannRoch.LongExactWitness nYZ
        (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.higherDirectImageClass higherYZ hcoherentYZ A)
        (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.higherDirectImageClass higherYZ hcoherentYZ B)
        (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.higherDirectImageClass higherYZ hcoherentYZ D))
    (higherXZ : {M : C.scheme.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike C.scheme M} →
      ℕ → Z.Modules)
    (hcoherentXZ : ∀ E i, SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike Z (higherXZ E i))
    (hlongXZ : ∀ A B D, ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn C.scheme.Modules
        (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike C.scheme) A B D →
      GrothendieckRiemannRoch.LongExactWitness nXZ
        (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.higherDirectImageClass higherXZ hcoherentXZ A)
        (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.higherDirectImageClass higherXZ hcoherentXZ B)
        (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.higherDirectImageClass higherXZ hcoherentXZ D))
    (hgen : ∀ E, ExactGrothendieck.classOf _
        (ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn C.scheme.Modules
          (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike C.scheme)) E ∈ acyclicSubgroup hrank)
    (hcollapse : ∀ G, SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.IsHigherAcyclic
        (projectiveBundleHigherDirectImageLongExactSystem hrank).higher G →
      ∀ j, Nonempty (higherXZ G j ≅
        higherYZ ⟨(projectiveBundleHigherDirectImageLongExactSystem hrank).higher G 0,
          (projectiveBundleHigherDirectImageLongExactSystem hrank).higher_mem G 0⟩ j))
    (hbYZ : ∀ E j, nYZ < j → IsZero (higherYZ E j))
    (hbXZ : ∀ E j, nXZ < j → IsZero (higherXZ E j)) :
    (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages nYZ higherYZ
        hcoherentYZ hlongYZ).comp (projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank) =
      SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages nXZ higherXZ
        hcoherentXZ hlongXZ
proof:
:=
  SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages_comp_of_acyclic_generation
    N nYZ nXZ (projectiveBundleHigherDirectImageLongExactSystem hrank).higher
    (projectiveBundleHigherDirectImageLongExactSystem hrank).higher_mem
    (projectiveBundleHigherDirectImageLongExactSystem hrank).longExactWitness
    higherYZ hcoherentYZ hlongYZ higherXZ hcoherentXZ hlongXZ hgen hcollapse hbYZ hbXZ

        (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.higherDirectImageClass

        (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.higherDirectImageClass

    (hbYZ : ∀ (E : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M}) j, nYZ < j →

    hlongYZ _ hcoherentXZ hlongXZ hgen (fun G hG j ↦ hL2 G.1 hG j) hbYZ hbXZ

    (hlongXZ : ∀ A B D, ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn C.scheme.Modules
        (SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike C.scheme) A B D →
      GrothendieckRiemannRoch.LongExactWitness nXZ
        (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.higherDirectImageClass
          (fun E i ↦ affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (C.toBase ≫ g) E.1 i)
          hcoherentXZ A)
        (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.higherDirectImageClass
          (fun E i ↦ affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (C.toBase ≫ g) E.1 i)
          hcoherentXZ B)
        (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.higherDirectImageClass
          (fun E i ↦ affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (C.toBase ≫ g) E.1 i)
          hcoherentXZ D))
    (hbYZ : ∀ (E : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike X M}) j, nYZ < j →
      IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification g E.1 j))
    (hbXZ : ∀ (E : {M : C.scheme.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsCoherentLike C.scheme M}) j,
      nXZ < j → IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (C.toBase ≫ g) E.1 j)) :
    (SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages nYZ
        (fun E i ↦ affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification g E.1 i)
        hcoherentYZ hlongYZ).comp (projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank) =
      SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfHigherDirectImages nXZ
        (fun E i ↦ affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (C.toBase ≫ g) E.1 i)
        hcoherentXZ hlongXZ
proof:
:=
  projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward_comp_affineLocal_of_L2 hrank hr hE g nYZ nXZ
    (fun M hM j ↦ SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_comp_of_acyclic
      C.toBase g M hM j) hcoherentYZ hlongYZ hcoherentXZ hlongXZ hbYZ hbXZ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.range_subset_toBase_preimage
statement:
theorem range_subset_toBase_preimage (g : T ⟶ X) (hg : ∀ t, g t ∈ centreComplement X I) :
    Set.range g ⊆ Set.range (centreComplement X I).ι
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
  rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
  exact hg t

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.liftAway_toBase
statement:
theorem liftAway_toBase (g : T ⟶ X) (hg : ∀ t, g t ∈ centreComplement X I) :
    liftAway I g hg ≫ toBase X I = g
proof:
:= by
  haveI := toBase_restrict_isIso X I
  unfold liftAway
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  have h1 : (toBase X I ⁻¹ᵁ centreComplement X I).ι ≫ toBase X I =
      (toBase X I ∣_ centreComplement X I) ≫ (centreComplement X I).ι :=
    (morphismRestrict_ι _ _).symm
  rw [h1, IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  exact IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.eq_of_toBase_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_toBase_eq (g₁ g₂ : T ⟶ blowup X I) (h : g₁ ≫ toBase X I = g₂ ≫ toBase X I)
    (hg : ∀ t, (g₁ ≫ toBase X I) t ∈ centreComplement X I) : g₁ = g₂
proof:
:= by
  haveI := toBase_restrict_isIso X I
  have h1 : (toBase X I ⁻¹ᵁ centreComplement X I).ι ≫ toBase X I =
      (toBase X I ∣_ centreComplement X I) ≫ (centreComplement X I).ι :=
    (morphismRestrict_ι _ _).symm
  haveI : Mono ((toBase X I ⁻¹ᵁ centreComplement X I).ι ≫ toBase X I) := by
    rw [h1]; infer_instance
  have hr : ∀ g : T ⟶ blowup X I, (∀ t, (g ≫ toBase X I) t ∈ centreComplement X I) →
      Set.range g ⊆ Set.range (toBase X I ⁻¹ᵁ centreComplement X I).ι := by
    intro g hg' _ ⟨t, ht⟩
    rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
    subst ht
    exact hg' t
  have hg2 : ∀ t, (g₂ ≫ toBase X I) t ∈ centreComplement X I := by rw [← h]; exact hg
  have e₁ := IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac (toBase X I ⁻¹ᵁ centreComplement X I).ι g₁ (hr g₁ hg)
  have e₂ := IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac (toBase X I ⁻¹ᵁ centreComplement X I).ι g₂ (hr g₂ hg2)
  have hl : IsOpenImmersion.lift (toBase X I ⁻¹ᵁ centreComplement X I).ι g₁ (hr g₁ hg) =
      IsOpenImmersion.lift (toBase X I ⁻¹ᵁ centreComplement X I).ι g₂ (hr g₂ hg2) := by
    rw [← cancel_mono ((toBase X I ⁻¹ᵁ centreComplement X I).ι ≫ toBase X I)]
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, e₁, e₂]
    exact h
  rw [← e₁, hl, e₂]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.mem_centreComplement_of_snd
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_centreComplement]
  intro h
  have h1 : (infIdeal k).comap (pullback.snd (A ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)) ≤ infCentre (k := k) J :=
    le_sup_right
  have h2 := Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_antitone h1 h
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_comap] at h2
  exact not_mem_infIdeal_support k hx h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.jChart_one_away
statement:
theorem jChart_one_away (t : DeformationSpace.line A) :
    jChart (k := k) (A := A) 1 t ∈ centreComplement (B0 (k := k) A) (infCentre (k := k) J)
proof:
:= by
  apply mem_centreComplement_of_snd
  refine ⟨DeformationSpace.toLineOver A ⊥ k (phiK (k := k) (A := A)) t, ?_⟩
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← jChart_snd]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.phi1_toBase
statement: theorem phi1_toBase : phi1 (k := k) J ≫ GlobalBlowup.toBase _ _ = jChart 1
proof:
:=
  liftAway_toBase _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.phi1_toBase_fst
statement:
theorem phi1_toBase_fst : phi1 (k := k) J ≫ GlobalBlowup.toBase _ _ ≫ pullback.fst _ _ =
    DeformationSpace.toBase A ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc, phi1_toBase, jChart_fst]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.phi1_toBase_snd
statement:
theorem phi1_toBase_snd : phi1 (k := k) J ≫ GlobalBlowup.toBase _ _ ≫ pullback.snd _ _ =
    DeformationSpace.toLineOver A ⊥ k (phiK (k := k) (A := A)) ≫ chart k 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc, phi1_toBase, jChart_snd]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.gm_toBase_eq
statement:
theorem gm_toBase_eq :
    GlobalCompletion.gmToBlowupGlobal A J ≫ phi0 (k := k) J ≫ GlobalBlowup.toBase _ _ =
      DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial A ≫ phi1 (k := k) J ≫ GlobalBlowup.toBase _ _
proof:
:= by
  apply pullback.hom_ext
  · rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, phi0_toBase_fst,
      phi1_toBase_fst, GlobalCompletion.gmToBlowupGlobal_toBase,
      GlobalCompletion.gmToTrivial_toBase]
  · rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, phi0_toBase_snd,
      phi1_toBase_snd]
    have h := congrArg (· ≫ GlobalCompletion.toP1Global A J k (phiK (k := k) (A := A)))
      (GlobalCompletion.gmToBlowupGlobal_blowupGlobalι A J)
    simp only [Category.assoc, GlobalCompletion.blowupGlobalι_toP1,
      GlobalCompletion.lineTι_toP1] at h
    exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.gm_compat
statement:
theorem gm_compat :
    GlobalCompletion.gmToBlowupGlobal A J ≫ phi0 (k := k) J =
      DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial A ≫ phi1 (k := k) J
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_of_toBase_eq _ _ _ (by simpa only [Category.assoc] using gm_toBase_eq J) ?_
  intro t
  apply mem_centreComplement_of_snd
  refine ⟨DeformationSpace.toLineOver A ⊥ k (phiK (k := k) (A := A))
    (DeformationSpace.gmToTrivial A t), ?_⟩
  have h := congrArg (fun f => (f ≫ pullback.snd (A ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)) t) (gm_toBase_eq J)
  simp only [Category.assoc, phi1_toBase_snd] at h
  exact h.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.blowupGlobalι_phi
statement: theorem blowupGlobalι_phi : GlobalCompletion.blowupGlobalι A J ≫ phi (k := k) J = phi0 (k := k) J
proof:
:=
  pushout.inl_desc _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.lineTι_phi
statement: theorem lineTι_phi : GlobalCompletion.lineTι A J ≫ phi (k := k) J = phi1 (k := k) J
proof:
:=
  pushout.inr_desc _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.phi_toBase_fst
statement:
theorem phi_toBase_fst : phi (k := k) J ≫ GlobalBlowup.toBase _ _ ≫ pullback.fst _ _ =
    GlobalCompletion.totalGlobalToBase A J
proof:
:= by
  apply pushout.hom_ext
  · change GlobalCompletion.blowupGlobalι A J ≫ _ = GlobalCompletion.blowupGlobalι A J ≫ _
    rw [← Category.assoc, blowupGlobalι_phi, phi0_toBase_fst]
    exact (pushout.inl_desc _ _ _).symm
  · change GlobalCompletion.lineTι A J ≫ _ = GlobalCompletion.lineTι A J ≫ _
    rw [← Category.assoc, lineTι_phi, phi1_toBase_fst]
    exact (pushout.inr_desc _ _ _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.phi_toBase_snd
statement:
theorem phi_toBase_snd : phi (k := k) J ≫ GlobalBlowup.toBase _ _ ≫ pullback.snd _ _ =
    GlobalCompletion.toP1Global A J k (phiK (k := k) (A := A))
proof:
:= by
  apply pushout.hom_ext
  · change GlobalCompletion.blowupGlobalι A J ≫ _ = GlobalCompletion.blowupGlobalι A J ≫ _
    rw [← Category.assoc, blowupGlobalι_phi, phi0_toBase_snd, GlobalCompletion.blowupGlobalι_toP1]
  · change GlobalCompletion.lineTι A J ≫ _ = GlobalCompletion.lineTι A J ≫ _
    rw [← Category.assoc, lineTι_phi, phi1_toBase_snd, GlobalCompletion.lineTι_toP1]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.opensRange_jChart
statement:
theorem opensRange_jChart (i : Fin 2) :
    (jChart (k := k) (A := A) i).opensRange =
      pullback.snd (A ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (chart k i).opensRange
proof:
:=
  GlobalCompletion.opensRange_eq_preimage_of_isPullback (isPullback_jChart i).flip

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.opensRange_lineAffineι
statement:
theorem opensRange_lineAffineι (U : A.affineOpens) :
    (GlobalCompletion.lineAffineι A U).opensRange = DeformationSpace.toBase A ⊥ ⁻¹ᵁ U.1
proof:
:= by
  have h := GlobalCompletion.opensRange_eq_preimage_of_isPullback
    (GlobalCompletion.isPullback_lineAffine A U)
  rw [h, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.opensRange_chartι
statement:
theorem opensRange_chartι (U : A.affineOpens) :
    (chartι (k := k) U).opensRange =
      (jChart (k := k) (A := A) 0).opensRange ⊓ pullback.fst (A ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ U.1
proof:
:= by
  unfold chartι
  rw [Scheme.Hom.opensRange_comp, opensRange_lineAffineι, ← jChart_fst (k := k) (A := A) 0,
    Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.opensRange_blowupAffine_total
statement:
theorem opensRange_blowupAffine_total (U : A.affineOpens) :
    (GlobalCompletion.blowupAffineι A J U ≫ GlobalCompletion.blowupGlobalι A J).opensRange =
      GlobalCompletion.toP1Global A J k (phiK (k := k) (A := A)) ⁻¹ᵁ (chart k 0).opensRange ⊓
        GlobalCompletion.totalGlobalToBase A J ⁻¹ᵁ U.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [GlobalCompletion.preimage_opensRange_chart_zero, Scheme.Hom.opensRange_comp,
    GlobalCompletion.opensRange_eq_preimage_of_isPullback
      (GlobalCompletion.isPullback_blowupAffine A J U), Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
  have : GlobalCompletion.blowupGlobalToBase A J =
      GlobalCompletion.blowupGlobalι A J ≫ GlobalCompletion.totalGlobalToBase A J :=
    (pushout.inl_desc _ _ _).symm
  rw [this, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.phi_preimage_piece
statement:
theorem phi_preimage_piece (U : A.affineOpens) :
    phi (k := k) J ⁻¹ᵁ
        (GlobalBlowup.affineι (B0 (k := k) A) (infCentre (k := k) J) (imgOpen (chartι (k := k) U))).opensRange =
      (GlobalCompletion.blowupAffineι A J U ≫ GlobalCompletion.blowupGlobalι A J).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  rw [opensRange_blowupAffine_total (k := k),
    GlobalCompletion.opensRange_eq_preimage_of_isPullback
      (GlobalBlowup.isPullback_affine (B0 (k := k) A) (infCentre (k := k) J) (imgOpen (chartι (k := k) U))),
    Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
  have himg : (imgOpen (chartι (k := k) U)).1 = (chartι (k := k) U).opensRange :=
    Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange _
  rw [himg, opensRange_chartι, opensRange_jChart]
  ext x
  have h1 : ∀ x, pullback.fst (A ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)
      (GlobalBlowup.toBase _ _ (phi (k := k) J x)) = GlobalCompletion.totalGlobalToBase A J x := by
    intro x
    have := congrArg (fun f => f x) (phi_toBase_fst (k := k) J)
    simpa [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using this
  have h2 : ∀ x, pullback.snd (A ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)
      (GlobalBlowup.toBase _ _ (phi (k := k) J x)) =
      GlobalCompletion.toP1Global A J k (phiK (k := k) (A := A)) x := by
    intro x
    have := congrArg (fun f => f x) (phi_toBase_snd (k := k) J)
    simpa [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using this
  simp [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, h1, h2]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.isIso_schemeMapOfEq
statement:
theorem isIso_schemeMapOfEq {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (I : Ideal R) (f : R →+* S)
    (hf : Function.Bijective f) (K : Ideal S) (h : I.map f = K) :
    IsIso (ReesBlowupOfEq.schemeMapOfEq I f K h)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra R S := f.toAlgebra
  haveI : Module.Flat R S :=
    Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv (M := R) (LinearEquiv.ofBijective (Algebra.linearMap R S) hf).symm
  have S1 := ReesBlowupOfEq.isPullback_schemeMapOfEq I K h
  haveI : IsIso (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))) := by
    rw [isIso_SpecMap_iff]; exact hf
  have := MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (P := MorphismProperty.isomorphisms Scheme) S1.flip
    (by exact (MorphismProperty.isomorphisms.iff _).mpr inferInstance)
  exact (MorphismProperty.isomorphisms.iff _).mp this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.isPullback_phi_piece
statement:
theorem isPullback_phi_piece (U : A.affineOpens) :
    IsPullback
      (ReesBlowupOfEq.schemeMapOfEq ((infCentre (k := k) J).ideal (imgOpen (chartι (k := k) U)))
        (eRing (chartι (k := k) U)) (centreIdeal (J.ideal U)) (ideal_chart J U))
      (GlobalCompletion.blowupAffineι A J U ≫ GlobalCompletion.blowupGlobalι A J)
      (GlobalBlowup.affineι (B0 (k := k) A) (infCentre (k := k) J) (imgOpen (chartι (k := k) U)))
      (phi (k := k) J)
proof:
:= by
  refine IsOpenImmersion.isPullback _ _ _ _ ?_ (phi_preimage_piece J U)
  rw [Category.assoc, blowupGlobalι_phi, blowupAffineι_phi0]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.isIso_phi_restrict_piece
statement:
theorem isIso_phi_restrict_piece (U : A.affineOpens) :
    IsIso (phi (k := k) J ∣_
      (GlobalBlowup.affineι (B0 (k := k) A) (infCentre (k := k) J)
        (imgOpen (chartι (k := k) U))).opensRange)
proof:
:= by
  have S := (isPullback_phi_piece (k := k) J U).flip
  haveI : IsIso (ReesBlowupOfEq.schemeMapOfEq ((infCentre (k := k) J).ideal (imgOpen (chartι (k := k) U)))
        (eRing (chartι (k := k) U)) (centreIdeal (J.ideal U)) (ideal_chart J U)) :=
    isIso_schemeMapOfEq _ _ (eRing_bijective _) _ _
  refine (MorphismProperty.isomorphisms.iff _).mp ?_
  refine (MorphismProperty.arrow_mk_iso_iff (MorphismProperty.isomorphisms Scheme)
    (morphismRestrictOpensRange (phi (k := k) J)
      (GlobalBlowup.affineι (B0 (k := k) A) (infCentre (k := k) J) (imgOpen (chartι (k := k) U))))).mpr ?_
  have e := S.isoPullback_hom_snd
  haveI : IsIso (S.isoPullback.hom ≫ pullback.snd (phi (k := k) J)
      (GlobalBlowup.affineι (B0 (k := k) A) (infCentre (k := k) J) (imgOpen (chartι (k := k) U)))) := by
    rw [e]; infer_instance
  exact (MorphismProperty.isomorphisms.iff _).mpr (IsIso.of_isIso_comp_left S.isoPullback.hom _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.opensRange_jChart_le_centreComplement
statement:
theorem opensRange_jChart_le_centreComplement :
    (jChart (k := k) (A := A) 1).opensRange ≤
      centreComplement (B0 (k := k) A) (infCentre (k := k) J)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  apply mem_centreComplement_of_snd
  rw [opensRange_jChart] at hx
  exact hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.phi_preimage_blOne
statement:
theorem phi_preimage_blOne :
    phi (k := k) J ⁻¹ᵁ blOne J = (GlobalCompletion.lineTι A J).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  rw [← GlobalCompletion.preimage_opensRange_chart_one A J k (phiK (k := k) (A := A))]
  ext x
  have h2 : ∀ x, pullback.snd (A ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)
      (GlobalBlowup.toBase _ _ (phi (k := k) J x)) =
      GlobalCompletion.toP1Global A J k (phiK (k := k) (A := A)) x := by
    intro x
    have := congrArg (fun f => f x) (phi_toBase_snd (k := k) J)
    simpa [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using this
  simp [opensRange_jChart, h2]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.range_phi1_subset
statement:
theorem range_phi1_subset :
    Set.range (phi1 (k := k) J) ⊆ Set.range (blOne (k := k) J).ι
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
  rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
  show GlobalBlowup.toBase _ _ (phi1 (k := k) J t) ∈ (jChart (k := k) (A := A) 1).opensRange
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, phi1_toBase]
  exact ⟨t, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.phi1'_ι
statement: theorem phi1'_ι : phi1' (k := k) J ≫ (blOne (k := k) J).ι = phi1 (k := k) J
proof:
:=
  IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.isPullback_phi_blOne
statement:
theorem isPullback_phi_blOne :
    IsPullback (phi1' (k := k) J) (GlobalCompletion.lineTι A J) (blOne (k := k) J).ι
      (phi (k := k) J)
proof:
:= by
  refine IsOpenImmersion.isPullback _ _ _ _ ?_ ?_
  · rw [lineTι_phi, phi1'_ι]
  · rw [Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]; exact phi_preimage_blOne J

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.isIso_phi1'
statement: theorem isIso_phi1' : IsIso (phi1' (k := k) J)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := toBase_restrict_isIso (B0 (k := k) A) (infCentre (k := k) J)
  haveI : IsIso (GlobalBlowup.toBase (B0 (k := k) A) (infCentre (k := k) J) ∣_
      (jChart (k := k) (A := A) 1).opensRange) :=
    isIso_morphismRestrict_of_le _ (opensRange_jChart_le_centreComplement J) inferInstance
  have h : phi1' (k := k) J ≫ (GlobalBlowup.toBase (B0 (k := k) A) (infCentre (k := k) J) ∣_
      (jChart (k := k) (A := A) 1).opensRange) = (jChart (k := k) (A := A) 1).isoOpensRange.hom := by
    rw [← cancel_mono (jChart (k := k) (A := A) 1).opensRange.ι, Category.assoc,
      morphismRestrict_ι, ← Category.assoc, phi1'_ι, phi1_toBase]
    exact (Scheme.Hom.isoOpensRange_hom_ι _).symm
  have : IsIso (phi1' (k := k) J ≫ (GlobalBlowup.toBase (B0 (k := k) A) (infCentre (k := k) J) ∣_
      (jChart (k := k) (A := A) 1).opensRange)) := by rw [h]; infer_instance
  exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right (phi1' (k := k) J)
    (GlobalBlowup.toBase (B0 (k := k) A) (infCentre (k := k) J) ∣_
      (jChart (k := k) (A := A) 1).opensRange)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.isIso_phi_restrict_blOne
statement:
theorem isIso_phi_restrict_blOne :
    IsIso (phi (k := k) J ∣_ (blOne (k := k) J).ι.opensRange)
proof:
:= by
  have S := (isPullback_phi_blOne (k := k) J).flip
  haveI := isIso_phi1' (k := k) J
  refine (MorphismProperty.isomorphisms.iff _).mp ?_
  refine (MorphismProperty.arrow_mk_iso_iff (MorphismProperty.isomorphisms Scheme)
    (morphismRestrictOpensRange (phi (k := k) J) (blOne (k := k) J).ι)).mpr ?_
  have e := S.isoPullback_hom_snd
  haveI : IsIso (S.isoPullback.hom ≫ pullback.snd (phi (k := k) J) (blOne (k := k) J).ι) := by
    rw [e]; infer_instance
  exact (MorphismProperty.isomorphisms.iff _).mpr (IsIso.of_isIso_comp_left S.isoPullback.hom _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.chart_cover_P1
statement: theorem chart_cover_P1 (p : P1 k) : p ∈ Set.range (chart k 0) ∨ p ∈ Set.range (chart k 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top k 1
  have hp : p ∈ (⨆ i : Fin 2, coordinateOpen k 1 i) := by rw [h]; trivial
  rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup] at hp
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hp
  fin_cases i
  · left
    have : p ∈ (chart k 0).opensRange := by rw [opensRange_chart]; exact hi
    exact this
  · right
    have : p ∈ (chart k 1).opensRange := by rw [opensRange_chart]; exact hi
    exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.coverFam_iSup
statement: theorem coverFam_iSup : ⨆ o, coverFam (k := k) J o = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro x _
  rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup]
  set b := GlobalBlowup.toBase (B0 (k := k) A) (infCentre (k := k) J) x with hb
  rcases chart_cover_P1 (k := k) (pullback.snd (A ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) b) with h0 | h1
  · have hA : pullback.fst (A ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) b ∈ (⨆ U : A.affineOpens, U.1) := by
      rw [iSup_affineOpens_eq_top]; trivial
    rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup] at hA
    obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := hA
    refine ⟨some U, ?_⟩
    show x ∈ (GlobalBlowup.affineι (B0 (k := k) A) (infCentre (k := k) J)
      (imgOpen (chartι (k := k) U))).opensRange
    rw [GlobalCompletion.opensRange_eq_preimage_of_isPullback
      (GlobalBlowup.isPullback_affine (B0 (k := k) A) (infCentre (k := k) J)
        (imgOpen (chartι (k := k) U))), Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
    have himg : (imgOpen (chartι (k := k) U)).1 = (chartι (k := k) U).opensRange :=
      Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange _
    rw [himg, opensRange_chartι, opensRange_jChart]
    show b ∈ (pullback.snd (A ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ (chart k 0).opensRange ⊓
      pullback.fst (A ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1) ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)
    exact ⟨h0, hU⟩
  · refine ⟨none, ?_⟩
    show x ∈ (blOne (k := k) J).ι.opensRange
    rw [Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
    show b ∈ (jChart (k := k) (A := A) 1).opensRange
    rw [opensRange_jChart]
    exact h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.totalIsoBlowup_over
statement:
theorem totalIsoBlowup_over :
    letI
proof:
:= totalOver (k := k) J
    letI := prodP1Over (k := k) (A := A)
    letI := blowupOver (k := k) (B := prodP1 (k := k) A) (infCentre (k := k) J)
    (totalIsoBlowup (k := k) J).hom ≫
        (GlobalBlowup.blowup (B0 (k := k) A) (infCentre (k := k) J) ↘ Spk k) =
      (GlobalCompletion.totalGlobal A J ↘ Spk k) := by
  letI := totalOver (k := k) J
  letI := prodP1Over (k := k) (A := A)
  letI := blowupOver (k := k) (B := prodP1 (k := k) A) (infCentre (k := k) J)
  change phi (k := k) J ≫ (GlobalBlowup.toBase _ _ ≫ pullback.fst _ _ ≫ A ↘ Spk k) =
    GlobalCompletion.totalGlobalToBase A J ≫ A ↘ Spk k
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, Category.assoc (phi (k := k) J), phi_toBase_fst]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.total_lft
statement:
theorem total_lft [Nonempty A] [LocallyOfFiniteType (A ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian A]
    (hA : ProjectiveIntegralK k A) :
    letI
proof:
:= totalOver (k := k) J
    LocallyOfFiniteType (GlobalCompletion.totalGlobal A J ↘ Spk k) := by
  letI := totalOver (k := k) J
  letI := prodP1Over (k := k) (A := A)
  letI := blowupOver (k := k) (B := prodP1 (k := k) A) (infCentre (k := k) J)
  haveI := prodP1_lft (k := k) (A := A)
  haveI := prodP1_isNoetherian (k := k) (A := A)
  haveI := blowup_locallyOfFiniteType
    (projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod hA 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
    (infCentre (k := k) J) (infCentre_ne_bot J)
  have he := totalIsoBlowup_over (k := k) J
  change LocallyOfFiniteType (GlobalCompletion.totalGlobal A J ↘ Spk k)
  rw [← he]
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.total_isNoetherian
statement:
theorem total_isNoetherian [Nonempty A] [LocallyOfFiniteType (A ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian A]
    (hA : ProjectiveIntegralK k A) : IsNoetherian (GlobalCompletion.totalGlobal A J)
proof:
:= by
  letI := prodP1Over (k := k) (A := A)
  haveI := prodP1_lft (k := k) (A := A)
  haveI := prodP1_isNoetherian (k := k) (A := A)
  haveI := blowup_isNoetherian
    (projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod hA 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
    (infCentre (k := k) J) (infCentre_ne_bot J)
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (GlobalCompletion.totalGlobal A J) :=
    isLocallyNoetherian_of_isOpenImmersion (totalIsoBlowup (k := k) J).hom
  haveI : CompactSpace (GlobalCompletion.totalGlobal A J) :=
    (totalIsoBlowup (k := k) J).hom.homeomorph.symm.compactSpace
  exact {}

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.projectiveIntegralK_total
statement:
theorem projectiveIntegralK_total [Nonempty A] [LocallyOfFiniteType (A ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian A]
    (hA : ProjectiveIntegralK k A) :
    letI
proof:
:= totalOver (k := k) J
    haveI := total_lft (k := k) J hA
    haveI := total_isNoetherian (k := k) J hA
    ProjectiveIntegralK k (GlobalCompletion.totalGlobal A J) := by
  letI := totalOver (k := k) J
  haveI := total_lft (k := k) J hA
  haveI := total_isNoetherian (k := k) J hA
  letI := prodP1Over (k := k) (A := A)
  haveI := prodP1_lft (k := k) (A := A)
  haveI := prodP1_isNoetherian (k := k) (A := A)
  letI := blowupOver (k := k) (B := prodP1 (k := k) A) (infCentre (k := k) J)
  haveI := blowup_locallyOfFiniteType
    (projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod hA 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
    (infCentre (k := k) J) (infCentre_ne_bot J)
  haveI := blowup_isNoetherian
    (projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod hA 1 (Iso.refl _) (Category.id_comp _))
    (infCentre (k := k) J) (infCentre_ne_bot J)
  exact projectiveIntegralK_of_iso (projectiveIntegralK_blowup_centre hA J)
    (totalIsoBlowup (k := k) J) (totalIsoBlowup_over (k := k) J)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankComponentAssembly_recover
statement:
theorem rankComponentAssembly_recover (ops : ChowOps k)
    (a : ∀ r, Module.End ℚ (TotalChow (characteristicRankOpen E hE r : Scheme)))
    (s : ℕ) (hs : s ∈ rankAssembly_ranks E hE) :
    (totalPull ops (characteristicRankOpen E hE s).ι 0
      (pureRelDim_openImmersion k (characteristicRankOpen E hE s).ι)).comp
      (rankComponentAssembly E hE ops a) =
    (a s).comp (totalPull ops (characteristicRankOpen E hE s).ι 0
      (pureRelDim_openImmersion k (characteristicRankOpen E hE s).ι))
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  simp only [rankComponentAssembly, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply, map_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single s]
  · exact LinearMap.congr_fun (rankAssembly_total_pull_push_self E hE ops s)
      (a s (totalPull ops (characteristicRankOpen E hE s).ι 0
        (pureRelDim_openImmersion k _) x))
  · intro b hb hbs
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun
      (rankAssembly_total_pull_push_other E hE ops s b (Ne.symm hbs))
      (a b (totalPull ops (characteristicRankOpen E hE b).ι 0
        (pureRelDim_openImmersion k _) x))
  · intro h
    exact (h hs).elim

statement:
theorem rankVaryingChernOp_constantRank (r : ℕ) (hr : HasConstantRank X E r) (i : ℕ) :
    rankVaryingChernOp E hE ops cp i = chernOp ops cp E r hr i
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  apply rankAssembly_total_joint_injective E hE ops
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := (characteristic_rankAt_range_finite E hE).mem_toFinset.mp hs

  have h2 := LinearMap.congr_fun (chernOp_pull_flat (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι
