name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.linearOverlapTransitionRestrictionNaturality_of_app_heq
statement:
theorem linearOverlapTransitionRestrictionNaturality_of_app_heq
    {R S M N ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [Finite ι]
    (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (c : Module.Basis ι S N) (d : ℤ)
    (q : space S N ⟶ space R M) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (hV : ∀ a k, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOverlapOpen R M (b a) (b k) =
      linearOverlapOpen S N (c a) (c k))
    (hT : ∀ a k,
      HEq
        (q.app (linearOverlapOpen R M (b a) (b k))
          (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit R M d (b a) (b k)).1)
        (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit S N d (c a) (c k)).1) :
    LinearOverlapTransitionRestrictionNaturality b c d q hV
proof:
:= by
  unfold LinearOverlapTransitionRestrictionNaturality
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro ak
  simp only [Category.assoc, linearOverlapTransitionEndomorphism,
    Pi.lift_π, linearOverlapCochainsRestrictIso, Iso.trans_hom,
    pushedUnitPiCastIso, Pi.mapIso_hom_π_assoc]
  slice_lhs 3 4 => rw [Pi.mapIso_hom_π]
  rw [reassoc_of%
    pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso_hom_π q
      (fun ab : ι × ι ↦
        linearOverlapOpen R M (b ab.1) (b ab.2)) ak]
  slice_rhs 1 2 =>
    rw [pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso_hom_π]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc]
  rw [Pi.lift_π]
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  congr 1
  exact pushedLinearOverlapTransitionRestrictOpenImmersionIso_naturality
    q d (b ak.1) (b ak.2) (c ak.1) (c ak.2)
      (hV ak.1 ak.2) (hT ak.1 ak.2)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.mapIso_threefold_factorization
statement:
theorem mapIso_threefold_factorization
    {A B : Type*} [Category A] [Category B]
    (F : A ⥤ B)
    {X Y Z W : A} {P₀ Q₀ Y' Z' : B}
    (L : X ≅ Y) (M : Y ≅ Z) (R : W ≅ Z)
    (P : P₀ ≅ F.obj X) (Q : Q₀ ≅ F.obj W)
    (S : F.obj Y ≅ Y') (T : F.obj Z ≅ Z') :
    (P ≪≫ F.mapIso (L ≪≫ M ≪≫ R.symm) ≪≫ Q.symm).hom =
      ((P ≪≫ F.mapIso L ≪≫ S) ≪≫ S.symm ≪≫
        F.mapIso M ≪≫ T ≪≫
          (Q ≪≫ F.mapIso R ≪≫ T).symm).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.mapIso_trans, F.mapIso_trans, F.mapIso_symm]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.fivefold_factorization_of_coherence
statement:
theorem fivefold_factorization_of_coherence
    {A : Type*} [Category A]
    {X Y Z W V Q : A}
    (L L₀ : X ≅ Y) (S : Z ≅ Y) (M : Z ≅ W)
    (T : W ≅ V) (R R₀ : Q ≅ V) (B : Y ≅ V)
    (hL : L.hom = L₀.hom)
    (hM : M.hom ≫ T.hom = S.hom ≫ B.hom)
    (hR : R.hom = R₀.hom) :
    (L ≪≫ S.symm ≪≫ M ≪≫ T ≪≫ R.symm).hom =
      (L₀ ≪≫ B ≪≫ R₀.symm).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hLIso : L = L₀ := Iso.ext hL
  have hRIso : R = R₀ := Iso.ext hR
  rw [hLIso, hRIso]
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom]
  slice_lhs 3 4 => rw [hM]
  slice_lhs 2 3 => rw [Iso.inv_hom_id]
  rw [Category.id_comp]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.modulesHom_ext_of_over_coversTop
statement:
theorem modulesHom_ext_of_over_coversTop
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {M N : Y.Modules} {I : Type u}
    (U : I → Y.Opens)
    (hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y).CoversTop U)
    {f g : M ⟶ N}
    (h : ∀ i, f.over (U i) = g.over (U i)) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  let F := (SheafOfModules.toSheaf Y.ringCatSheaf).obj M
  let G := (SheafOfModules.toSheaf Y.ringCatSheaf).obj N
  apply (SheafOfModules.toSheaf Y.ringCatSheaf).map_injective
  apply (sheafHomSectionsEquiv F G).symm.injective
  apply hU.sections_ext (sheafHom F G)
  intro i
  simp only [sheafHomSectionsEquiv_symm_apply_coe_apply]
  change
    (SheafOfModules.toSheaf (Y.ringCatSheaf.over (U i))).map
        (f.over (U i)) =
      (SheafOfModules.toSheaf (Y.ringCatSheaf.over (U i))).map
      (g.over (U i))
  rw [h i]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictFunctor_map_over_eq_of_over_eq
statement:
theorem restrictFunctor_map_over_eq_of_over_eq
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    {M N : X.Modules} {f g : M ⟶ N}
    {U : X.Opens} {V : Y.Opens}
    (hVU : q ''ᵁ V ≤ U) (h : f.over U = g.over U) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map f).over V =
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map g).over V
proof:
:= by
  ext W x
  let A : Y.Opens := W.unop.left
  have hAV : A ≤ V := leOfHom W.unop.hom
  have hAU : q ''ᵁ A ≤ U :=
    (q.image_mono hAV).trans hVU
  have hA := congrArg
    (fun k ↦ k.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hAU)))) h
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hA x

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictOpenLift_ι
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem restrictOpenLift_ι
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X)
    (U : X.Opens) (V : Y.Opens) (h : q ⁻¹ᵁ U = V) :
    restrictOpenLift q U V h ≫ U.ι = V.ι ≫ q
proof:
:=
  IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso_naturality
statement:
theorem pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso_naturality
    {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (q : Z ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    {U W : Y.Opens} {V T : Z.Opens}
    (hWU : W ≤ U) (hTV : T ≤ V)
    (hU : q ⁻¹ᵁ U = V) (hW : q ⁻¹ᵁ W = T) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction hWU) ≫
        (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso q W T hW).hom =
      (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso q U V hU).hom ≫
        SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction hTV
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso,
    Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [reassoc_of%
    pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionIso_naturality q hWU]
  rw [pushedUnitRestriction_eqToIso_naturality
    hU hW (q.preimage_mono hWU) hTV]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.frameChange_naturality_of_three_squares
statement:
theorem frameChange_naturality_of_three_squares
    {A : Type*} [Category A]
    {P O Q P' O' Q' : A}
    (aP : P ⟶ P') (aO : O ⟶ O') (aQ : Q ⟶ Q')
    (l : P ⟶ O) (m : O ⟶ O) (r : Q ⟶ O)
    (l' : P' ⟶ O') (m' : O' ⟶ O') (r' : Q' ⟶ O')
    [IsIso r] [IsIso r']
    (hl : l ≫ aO = aP ≫ l')
    (hm : m ≫ aO = aO ≫ m')
    (hr : r ≫ aO = aQ ≫ r') :
    l ≫ m ≫ inv r ≫ aQ =
      aP ≫ l' ≫ m' ≫ inv r'
proof:
:= by
  have hinv :
      inv r ≫ aQ = aO ≫ inv r' := by
    apply (cancel_mono r').1
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [← hr]
    simp
  slice_lhs 3 4 =>
    rw [hinv]
  slice_lhs 2 3 =>
    rw [hm]
  slice_lhs 1 2 =>
    rw [hl]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictKernelComparisonIso_hom_ι
statement:
theorem restrictKernelComparisonIso_hom_ι
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : T ⟶ S) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    {M N : S.Modules} (φ : M ⟶ N)
    {M' N' : T.Modules} (ψ : M' ⟶ N')
    (eM : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj M ≅ M')
    (eN : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj N ≅ N')
    (h : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).map φ ≫ eN.hom =
      eM.hom ≫ ψ) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictKernelComparisonIso
        f φ ψ eM eN h).hom ≫ kernel.ι ψ =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).map (kernel.ι φ) ≫ eM.hom
proof:
:= by
  let F := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f
  letI : F.Additive := by
    constructor
    intro A B p q
    rfl
  letI : F.PreservesZeroMorphisms :=
    Functor.preservesZeroMorphisms_of_additive F
  letI : F.PreservesHomology :=
    Functor.preservesHomology_of_map_exact F
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor_map_exact f)
  letI : PreservesLimit (parallelPair φ 0) F :=
    Functor.PreservesHomology.preservesKernel F φ
  unfold Scheme.Modules.restrictKernelComparisonIso
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [show
    (kernel.mapIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).map φ)
        ψ eM eN h).hom ≫ kernel.ι ψ =
      kernel.ι ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).map φ) ≫ eM.hom by
        simp [kernel.mapIso]]
  unfold Scheme.Modules.restrictKernelIso
  apply (cancel_epi
    (PreservesKernel.iso F φ).inv).1
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistingSheafRestrictionData_pullbackIso_hom_ι
statement:
theorem twistingSheafRestrictionData_pullbackIso_hom_ι
    {R S M N ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    {b : Module.Basis ι R M} {c : Module.Basis ι S N}
    {d : ℤ} {q : space S N ⟶ space R M} [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (D : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c d q) :
    D.pullbackIso.hom ≫
        kernel.ι
          (linearDescentLeft S N c - linearDescentRight S N c d) =
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).app
          (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d)).inv ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
          (kernel.ι
            (linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b d)) ≫
        D.chartIso.hom
proof:
:= by
  unfold TwistingSheafRestrictionData.pullbackIso
    TwistingSheafRestrictionData.restrictIso
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom]
  let a :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).app
      (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d)).inv
  let φ := linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b d
  let ψ := linearDescentLeft S N c - linearDescentRight S N c d
  calc
    a ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictKernelComparisonIso q
          φ ψ D.chartIso D.overlapIso D.naturality).hom ≫
        kernel.ι ψ =
      a ≫ ((Scheme.Modules.restrictKernelComparisonIso q
        φ ψ D.chartIso D.overlapIso D.naturality).hom ≫
          kernel.ι ψ) := Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = a ≫ ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
          (kernel.ι φ) ≫ D.chartIso.hom) :=
      congrArg (fun z ↦ a ≫ z)
        (restrictKernelComparisonIso_hom_ι q φ ψ
          D.chartIso D.overlapIso D.naturality)
    _ = a ≫ (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
          (kernel.ι φ) ≫ D.chartIso.hom :=
      (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistingSheafRestrictionData_restrictIso_hom_ι
statement:
theorem twistingSheafRestrictionData_restrictIso_hom_ι
    {R S M N ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    {b : Module.Basis ι R M} {c : Module.Basis ι S N}
    {d : ℤ} {q : space S N ⟶ space R M} [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (D : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c d q) :
    D.restrictIso.hom ≫
        kernel.ι
          (linearDescentLeft S N c - linearDescentRight S N c d) =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
          (kernel.ι
            (linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b d)) ≫
        D.chartIso.hom
proof:
:= by
  unfold TwistingSheafRestrictionData.restrictIso
  exact restrictKernelComparisonIso_hom_ι q
    (linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b d)
    (linearDescentLeft S N c - linearDescentRight S N c d)
    D.chartIso D.overlapIso D.naturality

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistingSheafRestrictionCompIso_hom_eq
statement:
theorem twistingSheafRestrictionCompIso_hom_eq
    {R S T M N P ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [AddCommGroup P] [Module T P] [Module.Free T P] [Module.Finite T P]
    {b : Module.Basis ι R M} {c : Module.Basis ι S N}
    {e : Module.Basis ι T P} {d : ℤ}
    {q : space S N ⟶ space R M} {r : space T P ⟶ space S N}
    [IsOpenImmersion q] [IsOpenImmersion r]
    (Dq : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c d q)
    (Dr : TwistingSheafRestrictionData c e d r)
    (Dcomp : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b e d (r ≫ q))
    (hChart :
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp r q).app
            (linearChartCochains R M b) ≪≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor r).mapIso Dq.chartIso ≪≫
          Dr.chartIso).hom =
        Dcomp.chartIso.hom) :
    (twistingSheafRestrictionCompIso Dq Dr).hom =
      Dcomp.restrictIso.hom
proof:
:= by
  let φ :=
    linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b d
  let ψ :=
    linearDescentLeft S N c - linearDescentRight S N c d
  let χ :=
    linearDescentLeft T P e - linearDescentRight T P e d
  apply (cancel_mono (kernel.ι χ)).1
  simp only [twistingSheafRestrictionCompIso, Iso.trans_hom,
    Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.app_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [twistingSheafRestrictionData_restrictIso_hom_ι Dr]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc]
  rw [twistingSheafRestrictionData_restrictIso_hom_ι Dq]
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  have hn := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp r q).hom.naturality
    (kernel.ι φ)
  change
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (r ≫ q)).map (kernel.ι φ) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp r q).hom.app
            (linearChartCochains R M b) =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp r q).hom.app
          (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor r).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
            (kernel.ι φ)) at hn
  slice_lhs 1 3 =>
    rw [← reassoc_of% hn]
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.app_hom] at hChart
  slice_lhs 2 4 =>
    rw [hChart]
  exact (twistingSheafRestrictionData_restrictIso_hom_ι Dcomp).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistingSheafRestrictionDataComp_restrictIso_hom
statement:
theorem twistingSheafRestrictionDataComp_restrictIso_hom
    {R S T M N P ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [AddCommGroup P] [Module T P] [Module.Free T P] [Module.Finite T P]
    {b : Module.Basis ι R M} {c : Module.Basis ι S N}
    {e : Module.Basis ι T P} {d : ℤ}
    {q : space S N ⟶ space R M} {r : space T P ⟶ space S N}
    [IsOpenImmersion q] [IsOpenImmersion r]
    (Dq : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c d q)
    (Dr : TwistingSheafRestrictionData c e d r) :
    (twistingSheafRestrictionCompIso Dq Dr).hom =
      (twistingSheafRestrictionDataComp Dq Dr).restrictIso.hom
proof:
:=
  twistingSheafRestrictionCompIso_hom_eq Dq Dr
    (twistingSheafRestrictionDataComp Dq Dr) rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistingSheafRestrictionData_congr_hom
statement:
theorem twistingSheafRestrictionData_congr_hom
    {R S M N ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    {b : Module.Basis ι R M} {c : Module.Basis ι S N}
    {d : ℤ} {q q' : space S N ⟶ space R M}
    [IsOpenImmersion q] [IsOpenImmersion q']
    (hqq' : q = q')
    (D : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c d q)
    (D' : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c d q')
    (hChart :
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr hqq').app
            (linearChartCochains R M b) ≪≫
          D'.chartIso).hom =
        D.chartIso.hom) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr hqq').app
          (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d) ≪≫
        D'.restrictIso).hom =
      D.restrictIso.hom
proof:
:= by
  let φ :=
    linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b d
  let ψ :=
    linearDescentLeft S N c - linearDescentRight S N c d
  apply (cancel_mono (kernel.ι ψ)).1
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [twistingSheafRestrictionData_restrictIso_hom_ι D']
  change
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr hqq').hom.app (kernel φ) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q').map (kernel.ι φ) ≫
            D'.chartIso.hom =
      D.restrictIso.hom ≫ kernel.ι ψ
  have hn := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr hqq').hom.naturality
    (kernel.ι φ)
  slice_lhs 1 3 =>
    rw [← reassoc_of% hn]
  change
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr hqq').hom.app
          (linearChartCochains R M b) ≫
        D'.chartIso.hom =
      D.chartIso.hom at hChart
  slice_lhs 2 3 =>
    rw [hChart]
  exact (twistingSheafRestrictionData_restrictIso_hom_ι D).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCompIso_hom
statement:
theorem pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCompIso_hom
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) (r : Z ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion q] [IsOpenImmersion r] (U : X.Opens) :
    (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCompIso q r U).hom =
      (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionIso (r ≫ q) U).hom
proof:
:= by
  ext W x
  simp only [pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCompIso, Iso.trans_hom,
    Iso.app_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom,
    Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp_hom_app_app,
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app,
    ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  change
    (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionSectionRingIso r (q ⁻¹ᵁ U) W).hom
        ((pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionSectionRingIso q U (r ''ᵁ W)).hom
          _) =
      (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionSectionRingIso (r ≫ q) U W).hom x
  simp only [pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionSectionRingIso, Iso.trans_hom,
    ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.comp_appIso]
  simp
  let A :=
    (r ⁻¹ᵁ (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)).ι ''ᵁ
      ((r ⁻¹ᵁ (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)
  let B :=
    (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ
      ((q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (r ''ᵁ W))
  let hAB : r ''ᵁ A = B :=
    pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersion_open_eq r (q ⁻¹ᵁ U) W
  let k : op B ⟶ op (r ''ᵁ A) := (eqToHom hAB).op
  rw [show eqToHom _ = k by apply Subsingleton.elim]
  change
    (r.appIso A).hom
        ((Y.presheaf.map k)
          ((q.appIso B).hom _)) =
      (r.appIso A).hom
        ((q.appIso (r ''ᵁ A)).hom _)
  congr 1
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  rw [← q.appIso_hom_naturality k]
  rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  repeat rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  convert rfl using 1
  all_goals simp [A, B]
  convert rfl using 1
  congr 1
  change
    X.presheaf.map _ (X.presheaf.map _ (X.presheaf.map _ x)) =
      X.presheaf.map _ (X.presheaf.map _ x)
  repeat rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  congr 2

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionCompIso_hom
statement:
theorem pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionCompIso_hom
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} [Finite ι]
    (q : Y ⟶ X) (r : Z ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion q] [IsOpenImmersion r] (U : ι → X.Opens) :
    (pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionCompIso q r U).hom =
      (pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso (r ≫ q) U).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro i
  simp only [pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionCompIso,
    Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc, Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.app_hom]
  dsimp only [pushedUnitPiCastIso]
  rw [Pi.mapIso_hom_π]
  slice_lhs 3 4 =>
    rw [pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso_hom_π]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  have hi := congrArg
    (fun f ↦ (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor r).map f)
    (pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso_hom_π q U i)
  simp only [Functor.map_comp] at hi
  slice_lhs 2 5 =>
    rw [reassoc_of% hi]
  have hn := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp r q).hom.naturality
    (Pi.π (fun j ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X (U j)) i)
  change
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (r ≫ q)).map
          (Pi.π (fun j ↦
            SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X (U j)) i) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp r q).hom.app
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X (U i)) =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp r q).hom.app
          (∏ᶜ fun j ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X (U j)) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor r).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
            (Pi.π (fun j ↦
              SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X (U j)) i)) at hn
  slice_lhs 1 5 =>
    rw [reassoc_of% hn.symm]
  change
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (r ≫ q)).map
          (Pi.π (fun j ↦
            SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X (U j)) i) ≫
        (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCompIso q r (U i)).hom =
      _
  rw [pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCompIso_hom]
  rw [pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso_hom_π]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushedUnitPiCastIso_hom_trans
statement:
theorem pushedUnitPiCastIso_hom_trans
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} [Finite ι]
    (U V W : ι → Y.Opens)
    (h : ∀ i, U i = V i) (k : ∀ i, V i = W i) :
    (pushedUnitPiCastIso U V h).hom ≫
        (pushedUnitPiCastIso V W k).hom =
      (pushedUnitPiCastIso U W
        (fun i ↦ (h i).trans (k i))).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro i
  simp only [Category.assoc, pushedUnitPiCastIso,
    Pi.mapIso_hom_π]
  rw [Pi.mapIso_hom_π_assoc]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso_cast_naturality
statement:
theorem pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso_cast_naturality
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} [Finite ι]
    (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (U U' : ι → X.Opens) (h : ∀ i, U i = U' i) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
          (pushedUnitPiCastIso U U' h).hom ≫
        (pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso q U').hom =
      (pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso q U).hom ≫
        (pushedUnitPiCastIso
          (fun i ↦ q ⁻¹ᵁ U i)
          (fun i ↦ q ⁻¹ᵁ U' i)
          (fun i ↦ congrArg (fun V ↦ q ⁻¹ᵁ V) (h i))).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hUU' : U = U' := funext h
  subst U'
  have hSource :
      (pushedUnitPiCastIso U U h).hom =
        𝟙 (∏ᶜ fun i ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X (U i)) := by
    apply Pi.hom_ext
    intro i
    simp [pushedUnitPiCastIso]
  have hTarget :
      (pushedUnitPiCastIso
        (fun i ↦ q ⁻¹ᵁ U i)
        (fun i ↦ q ⁻¹ᵁ U i)
        (fun i ↦ congrArg (fun V ↦ q ⁻¹ᵁ V) (h i))).hom =
          𝟙 (∏ᶜ fun i ↦
            SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y (q ⁻¹ᵁ U i)) := by
    apply Pi.hom_ext
    intro i
    simp [pushedUnitPiCastIso]
  rw [hSource, hTarget]
  rw [show
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
        (𝟙 (∏ᶜ fun i ↦
          SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X (U i))) =
      𝟙 _ from
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map_id _]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.linearChartCochainsRestrictCompIso_hom
statement:
theorem linearChartCochainsRestrictCompIso_hom
    {R S T M N P ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [AddCommGroup P] [Module T P] [Module.Free T P] [Module.Finite T P]
    [Finite ι]
    (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (c : Module.Basis ι S N)
    (e : Module.Basis ι T P)
    (q : space S N ⟶ space R M) (r : space T P ⟶ space S N)
    [IsOpenImmersion q] [IsOpenImmersion r]
    (hq : ∀ i, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b i) =
      linearOpen S N (c i))
    (hr : ∀ i, r ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen S N (c i) =
      linearOpen T P (e i)) :
    (linearChartCochainsRestrictCompIso b c e q r hq hr).hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b e (r ≫ q)
        (fun i ↦ by
          rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, hq i, hr i])).hom
proof:
:= by
  let U := fun i : ι ↦ linearOpen R M (b i)
  let V := fun i : ι ↦ linearOpen S N (c i)
  let W := fun i : ι ↦ linearOpen T P (e i)
  let A := fun i : ι ↦ r ⁻¹ᵁ (q ⁻¹ᵁ U i)
  let B := fun i : ι ↦ r ⁻¹ᵁ V i
  let D := fun i : ι ↦ (r ≫ q) ⁻¹ᵁ U i
  let hAB : ∀ i, A i = B i :=
    fun i ↦ congrArg (fun O ↦ r ⁻¹ᵁ O) (hq i)
  let hBW : ∀ i, B i = W i := hr
  let hAD : ∀ i, A i = D i := fun i ↦ by simp [A, D]
  let hDW : ∀ i, D i = W i := fun i ↦ by
    dsimp only [D, U, W]
    rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, hq i, hr i]
  have hCasts :
      (pushedUnitPiCastIso A B hAB).hom ≫
          (pushedUnitPiCastIso B W hBW).hom =
        (pushedUnitPiCastIso A D hAD).hom ≫
          (pushedUnitPiCastIso D W hDW).hom := by
    rw [pushedUnitPiCastIso_hom_trans,
      pushedUnitPiCastIso_hom_trans]
  have hCastNaturality :=
    pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso_cast_naturality
      r (fun i ↦ q ⁻¹ᵁ U i) V hq
  have hProduct :=
    pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionCompIso_hom q r U
  simp only [linearChartCochainsRestrictCompIso,
    linearChartCochainsRestrictIso, Iso.trans_hom,
    Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.app_hom]
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  slice_lhs 3 5 =>
    rw [reassoc_of% hCastNaturality]
  change
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp r q).hom.app
          (∏ᶜ fun i ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) (U i)) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor r).map
          (pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso q U).hom ≫
        (pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso r
          (fun i ↦ q ⁻¹ᵁ U i)).hom ≫
        (pushedUnitPiCastIso A B hAB).hom ≫
        (pushedUnitPiCastIso B W hBW).hom =
      _
  slice_lhs 4 5 =>
    rw [hCasts]
  simp only [pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionCompIso,
    Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom] at hProduct
  change
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp r q).hom.app
          (∏ᶜ fun i ↦
            SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) (U i)) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor r).map
          (pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso q U).hom ≫
        (pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso r
          (fun i ↦ q ⁻¹ᵁ U i)).hom ≫
        (pushedUnitPiCastIso A D hAD).hom =
      (pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso (r ≫ q) U).hom at hProduct
  slice_lhs 1 5 =>
    rw [reassoc_of% hProduct]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictFunctorCongr_refl_hom_app
statement:
theorem restrictFunctorCongr_refl_hom_app
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (M : X.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr (rfl : q = q)).hom.app M =
      𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  ext W x
  rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr_hom_app_app]
  change M.presheaf.map
    (eqToHom (show q ''ᵁ W = q ''ᵁ W by rfl)).op x = x
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackRestrictionCompIso_twistingSheafRestriction_hom
statement:
theorem pullbackRestrictionCompIso_twistingSheafRestriction_hom
    {R S T M N P ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [AddCommGroup P] [Module T P] [Module.Free T P] [Module.Finite T P]
    {b : Module.Basis ι R M} {c : Module.Basis ι S N}
    {e : Module.Basis ι T P} {d : ℤ}
    {q : space S N ⟶ space R M} {r : space T P ⟶ space S N}
    {s : space T P ⟶ space R M}
    [IsOpenImmersion q] [IsOpenImmersion r] [IsOpenImmersion s]
    (h : r ≫ q = s)
    (Dq : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c d q)
    (Dr : TwistingSheafRestrictionData c e d r) :
    (pullbackRestrictionCompIso s q r h
          (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d) ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback r).mapIso Dq.pullbackIso ≪≫
        Dr.pullbackIso).hom =
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback s).app
            (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d)).symm ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr h.symm).app
          (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d) ≪≫
        twistingSheafRestrictionCompIso Dq Dr).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pullbackRestrictionCompIso,
    TwistingSheafRestrictionData.pullbackIso,
    twistingSheafRestrictionCompIso, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom,
    Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.app_hom, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  have hq :
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor r).map
            (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).app
              (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d)).inv) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback r).hom.app
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj
              (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d)) =
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback r).hom.app
              ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).obj
                (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d)) ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pullback r).map
              (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).app
                (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d)).inv) :=
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback r).hom.naturality _
  slice_lhs 5 6 =>
    rw [hq.symm]
  have hcancelq :
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor r).map
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).hom.app
              (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d)) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor r).map
            (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).app
              (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d)).inv) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback r).hom.app
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj
              (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d)) =
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback r).hom.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj
            (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d)) := by
    rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc]
    simp
  slice_lhs 4 6 =>
    rw [hcancelq]
  have hDq := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback r).hom.naturality
    Dq.restrictIso.hom
  slice_lhs 4 5 =>
    rw [hDq.symm]
  have hcancelr :
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback r).hom.app
            (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex S N c d) ≫
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback r).app
            (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex S N c d)).inv ≫
          Dr.restrictIso.hom =
        Dr.restrictIso.hom := by
    simp
  slice_lhs 5 7 =>
    rw [hcancelr]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.linearChartCochainsRestrictIso_congr_hom
statement:
theorem linearChartCochainsRestrictIso_congr_hom
    {R S M N ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [Finite ι]
    (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (c : Module.Basis ι S N)
    {q q' : space S N ⟶ space R M}
    [IsOpenImmersion q] [IsOpenImmersion q']
    (hqq' : q = q')
    (h : ∀ i, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b i) =
      linearOpen S N (c i))
    (h' : ∀ i, q' ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b i) =
      linearOpen S N (c i)) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr hqq').app
          (linearChartCochains R M b) ≪≫
        linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q' h').hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q h).hom
proof:
:= by
  subst q'
  have hhh' : h = h' := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  subst h'
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom]
  change
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr (rfl : q = q)).hom.app
          (linearChartCochains R M b) ≫
        (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q h).hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q h).hom
  rw [restrictFunctorCongr_refl_hom_app]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.linearChartCochainsRestrictIso_hom_π
statement:
theorem linearChartCochainsRestrictIso_hom_π
    {R S M N ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [Finite ι]
    (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (c : Module.Basis ι S N)
    (q : space S N ⟶ space R M) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (h : ∀ i, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b i) =
      linearOpen S N (c i)) (i : ι) :
    (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q h).hom ≫
        Pi.π (fun j ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit
          (space S N) (linearOpen S N (c j))) i =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
          (Pi.π (fun j ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit
            (space R M) (linearOpen R M (b j))) i) ≫
        ((pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionIso q
            (linearOpen R M (b i))) ≪≫
          eqToIso (congrArg
            (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space S N))
            (h i))).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [linearChartCochainsRestrictIso, pushedUnitPiCastIso,
    Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [Pi.mapIso_hom_π]
  slice_lhs 1 2 =>
    rw [pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso_hom_π]
  rw [Category.assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistingSheafRestrictionData_basisComponent_naturality
statement:
theorem twistingSheafRestrictionData_basisComponent_naturality
    {R S M N ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [Finite ι]
    {b : Module.Basis ι R M} {c : Module.Basis ι S N}
    {d : ℤ} {q : space S N ⟶ space R M} [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (h : ∀ i, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b i) =
      linearOpen S N (c i))
    (D : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c d q)
    (hD : D.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q h).hom)
    (i : ι) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
          (twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b d i) ≫
        ((pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionIso q
            (linearOpen R M (b i))) ≪≫
          eqToIso (congrArg
            (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space S N))
            (h i))).hom =
      D.restrictIso.hom ≫
        twistingSheafBasisComponent S N c d i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [twistingSheafBasisComponent, Functor.map_comp,
    Category.assoc]
  slice_lhs 2 3 =>
    rw [← linearChartCochainsRestrictIso_hom_π b c q h i]
  rw [← hD]
  slice_lhs 1 2 =>
    rw [← twistingSheafRestrictionData_restrictIso_hom_ι D]
  rw [Category.assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_over_comp_basisComponent
statement:
theorem twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_over_comp_basisComponent
    {R M ι κ : Type u}
    [CommRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (c : Module.Basis κ R M)
    (d : ℤ) (i : ι) (j : κ) :
    (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M b c d).over
          (basisChangeOpen R M b c i j) ≫
        (twistingSheafBasisComponent R M c d j).over
          (basisChangeOpen R M b c i j) =
      (twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b d i).over
          (basisChangeOpen R M b c i j) ≫
        (linearFrameChangeOverIso R M (-d) (b i) (c j)
          (basisChangeOpen R M b c i j)
          ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (c j)).le.trans
            inf_le_left)
          ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (c j)).le.trans
            inf_le_right)).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_over]
  dsimp only [twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso,
    linearFrameChangeOverIso, basisChangeLeftRestriction,
    basisChangeRightRestriction]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_restrict_basisChangeOpen
statement:
theorem twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_restrict_basisChangeOpen
    {R M ι κ : Type u}
    [CommRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (c : Module.Basis κ R M)
    (d : ℤ) (i : ι) (j : κ) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
        (basisChangeOpen R M b c i j).ι).map
          (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M b c d) =
      (twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalIso R M b c d i j).hom
proof:
:= by
  let U := basisChangeOpen R M b c i j
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι
  let E := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U
  change G.map (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M b c d) =
    (twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalIso R M b c d i j).hom
  apply (cancel_epi ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.app
    (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d))).1
  apply (cancel_mono ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).inv.app
    (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M c d))).1
  slice_lhs 1 2 =>
    rw [← (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.naturality
      (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M b c d)]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  change E.functor.map
      ((twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M b c d).over U) =
    _
  rw [twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_over]
  dsimp only [twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalIso,
    twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso]
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, asIso_hom, Iso.symm_hom, asIso_inv,
    Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_inv, Category.assoc]
  let qb := twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b d i
  let qc := twistingSheafBasisComponent R M c d j
  let rb := basisChangeLeftRestriction R M b c i j
  let rc := basisChangeRightRestriction R M b c i j
  let t := pushedLinearOverlapTransition R M (-d) (b i) (c j)
  have hUc : U ≤ linearOpen R M (c j) := by
    exact (linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (c j)).le.trans
      inf_le_right
  letI : IsIso (qc.over U) :=
    twistingSheafBasisComponent_over_isIso_of_le R M c d j hUc
  letI : IsIso (rc.over U) :=
    basisChangeRightRestriction_over_isIso_of_le R M b c i j le_rfl
  letI : IsIso ((qc ≫ rc).over U) := by
    change IsIso (qc.over U ≫ rc.over U)
    infer_instance
  letI : IsIso (E.functor.map ((qc ≫ rc).over U)) :=
    Functor.map_isIso E.functor ((qc ≫ rc).over U)
  letI : IsIso (G.map qc) := by
    letI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
        (linearOpen R M (c j)).ι).map qc) :=
      twistingSheafBasisComponent_restrict_isIso R M c d j
    exact restrictMap_isIso_of_le qc hUc
  letI : IsIso (G.map rc) :=
    basisChangeRightRestriction_restrict_isIso R M b c i j
  letI : IsIso (G.map (qc ≫ rc)) := by
    rw [G.map_comp]
    infer_instance
  have hframe :=
    frameChange_naturality_of_three_squares
      ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.app
        (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d))
      ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.app
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) U))
      ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.app
        (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M c d))
      (E.functor.map ((qb ≫ rb).over U))
      (E.functor.map (t.over U))
      (E.functor.map ((qc ≫ rc).over U))
      (G.map (qb ≫ rb))
      (G.map t)
      (G.map (qc ≫ rc))
      ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.naturality (qb ≫ rb))
      ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.naturality t)
      ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.naturality (qc ≫ rc))
  dsimp only [qb, qc, rb, rc, t] at hframe
  have hframe' := congrArg
    (fun z ↦ z ≫ (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).inv.app
      (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M c d)) hframe
  simp only [Category.assoc] at hframe'
  rw [(Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom_inv_id_app] at hframe'
  simp only [Category.comp_id] at hframe'
  dsimp only [U] at hframe'
  simpa only [Functor.map_comp, SheafOfModules.Hom.over,
    Functor.map_inv, IsIso.inv_comp, Category.assoc] using hframe'

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.modulesHom_ext_of_restrict_coversTop
statement:
theorem modulesHom_ext_of_restrict_coversTop
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {M N : Y.Modules} {I : Type u}
    (U : I → Y.Opens)
    (hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y).CoversTop U)
    {f g : M ⟶ N}
    (h : ∀ i, (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι).map f =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι).map g) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply modulesHom_ext_of_over_coversTop U hU
  intro i
  apply (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).functor.map_injective
  change
    (SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf (U i) ⋙
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).functor).map f =
    (SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf (U i) ⋙
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).functor).map g
  apply (cancel_mono
    ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv (U i)).hom.app N)).1
  rw [(Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv (U i)).hom.naturality f,
    (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv (U i)).hom.naturality g, h i]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.frameChange_formula_of_functorIso
statement:
private theorem frameChange_formula_of_functorIso
    {A B : Type*} [Category A] [Category B]
    (F G : A ⥤ B) (e : F ≅ G) {P O Q : A}
    (l : P ⟶ O) (m : O ⟶ O) (r : Q ⟶ O) (f : P ⟶ Q)
    [IsIso (F.map r)] [IsIso (G.map r)]
    (hf : G.map f = G.map l ≫ G.map m ≫ inv (G.map r)) :
    F.map f = F.map l ≫ F.map m ≫ inv (F.map r)
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (e.hom.app Q)).1
  rw [e.hom.naturality f, hf]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  exact (frameChange_naturality_of_three_squares
    (e.hom.app P) (e.hom.app O) (e.hom.app Q)
    (F.map l) (F.map m) (F.map r)
    (G.map l) (G.map m) (G.map r)
    (e.hom.naturality l) (e.hom.naturality m) (e.hom.naturality r)).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_restrict_naturality
statement:
theorem twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_restrict_naturality
    {R S M N ι κ : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (c : Module.Basis κ R M)
    (b' : Module.Basis ι S N) (c' : Module.Basis κ S N)
    (d : ℤ) (q : space S N ⟶ space R M) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (hb : ∀ a, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b a) =
      linearOpen S N (b' a))
    (hc : ∀ k, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (c k) =
      linearOpen S N (c' k))
    (hbc : ∀ a k, q ⁻¹ᵁ basisChangeOpen R M b c a k =
      basisChangeOpen S N b' c' a k)
    (ht : ∀ a k, HEq
      (q.app (basisChangeOpen R M b c a k)
        (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit R M (-d) (b a) (c k)).1)
      (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit S N (-d)
        (b' a) (c' k)).1)
    (Db : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b b' d q)
    (Dc : TwistingSheafRestrictionData c c' d q)
    (hDb : Db.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b b' q hb).hom)
    (hDc : Dc.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso c c' q hc).hom) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
          (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M b c d) ≫
        Dc.restrictIso.hom =
      Db.restrictIso.hom ≫
        twistingSheafBasisChangeHom S N b' c' d
proof:
:= by
  apply modulesHom_ext_of_restrict_coversTop
    (fun ak : ι × κ ↦ basisChangeOpen S N b' c' ak.1 ak.2)
    (basisChangeOpen_coversTop S N b' c')
  intro ak
  rcases ak with ⟨a, k⟩
  let U := basisChangeOpen R M b c a k
  let V := basisChangeOpen S N b' c' a k
  let Gq := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q
  let GU := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι
  let GV := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι
  let p := restrictOpenLift q U V (hbc a k)
  let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor p
  let F := Gq ⋙ GV
  let K := GU ⋙ H
  let e := restrictFunctorOpenLiftIso q U V (hbc a k)
  let B := twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M b c d
  let B' := twistingSheafBasisChangeHom S N b' c' d
  let qb := twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b d a
  let qc := twistingSheafBasisComponent R M c d k
  let rb := basisChangeLeftRestriction R M b c a k
  let rc := basisChangeRightRestriction R M b c a k
  let t := pushedLinearOverlapTransition R M (-d) (b a) (c k)
  let qb' := twistingSheafBasisComponent S N b' d a
  let qc' := twistingSheafBasisComponent S N c' d k
  let rb' := basisChangeLeftRestriction S N b' c' a k
  let rc' := basisChangeRightRestriction S N b' c' a k
  let t' := pushedLinearOverlapTransition S N (-d) (b' a) (c' k)
  let pU := pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso q U V (hbc a k)
  have hqb := twistingSheafRestrictionData_basisComponent_naturality
    hb Db hDb a
  have hqc := twistingSheafRestrictionData_basisComponent_naturality
    hc Dc hDc k
  have hrb := pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso_naturality q
    ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b a) (c k)).le.trans inf_le_left)
    ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf S N (b' a) (c' k)).le.trans inf_le_left)
    (hb a) (hbc a k)
  have hrc := pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso_naturality q
    ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b a) (c k)).le.trans inf_le_right)
    ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf S N (b' a) (c' k)).le.trans inf_le_right)
    (hc k) (hbc a k)
  have ht' :=
    pushedLinearOverlapTransitionRestrictOpenImmersionIso_naturality
      q (-d) (b a) (c k) (b' a) (c' k) (hbc a k) (ht a k)
  have hqb' :
      Gq.map qb ≫
          (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso q
            (linearOpen R M (b a)) (linearOpen S N (b' a))
            (hb a)).hom =
        Db.restrictIso.hom ≫ qb' := by
    exact hqb
  have hqc' :
      Gq.map qc ≫
          (pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso q
            (linearOpen R M (c k)) (linearOpen S N (c' k))
            (hc k)).hom =
        Dc.restrictIso.hom ≫ qc' := by
    exact hqc
  have hl0 :
      Gq.map (qb ≫ rb) ≫ pU.hom =
        Db.restrictIso.hom ≫ (qb' ≫ rb') := by
    dsimp only [Gq, qb, rb, qb', rb', pU, U, V, basisChangeOpen,
      basisChangeLeftRestriction]
    simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
    slice_lhs 2 3 =>
      rw [hrb]
    rw [reassoc_of% hqb']
  have hm0 :
      Gq.map t ≫ pU.hom = pU.hom ≫ t' := by
    exact ht'
  have hr0 :
      Gq.map (qc ≫ rc) ≫ pU.hom =
        Dc.restrictIso.hom ≫ (qc' ≫ rc') := by
    dsimp only [Gq, qc, rc, qc', rc', pU, U, V, basisChangeOpen,
      basisChangeRightRestriction]
    simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
    slice_lhs 2 3 =>
      rw [hrc]
    rw [reassoc_of% hqc']
  have hl :
      F.map (qb ≫ rb) ≫ GV.map pU.hom =
        GV.map Db.restrictIso.hom ≫ GV.map (qb' ≫ rb') := by
    simpa only [F, Functor.comp_map, Functor.map_comp] using
      congrArg GV.map hl0
  have hm :
      F.map t ≫ GV.map pU.hom =
        GV.map pU.hom ≫ GV.map t' := by
    simpa only [F, Functor.comp_map, Functor.map_comp] using
      congrArg GV.map hm0
  have hr :
      F.map (qc ≫ rc) ≫ GV.map pU.hom =
        GV.map Dc.restrictIso.hom ≫ GV.map (qc' ≫ rc') := by
    simpa only [F, Functor.comp_map, Functor.map_comp] using
      congrArg GV.map hr0
  have hUc : U ≤ linearOpen R M (c k) :=
    (linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b a) (c k)).le.trans inf_le_right
  letI : IsIso (GU.map qc) := by
    letI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
        (linearOpen R M (c k)).ι).map qc) :=
      twistingSheafBasisComponent_restrict_isIso R M c d k
    exact restrictMap_isIso_of_le qc hUc
  letI : IsIso (GU.map rc) :=
    basisChangeRightRestriction_restrict_isIso R M b c a k
  letI : IsIso (K.map (qc ≫ rc)) := by
    change IsIso (H.map (GU.map (qc ≫ rc)))
    rw [GU.map_comp, H.map_comp]
    infer_instance
  have hVcp : V ≤ linearOpen S N (c' k) :=
    (linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf S N (b' a) (c' k)).le.trans inf_le_right
  letI : IsIso (GV.map qc') := by
    letI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
        (linearOpen S N (c' k)).ι).map qc') :=
      twistingSheafBasisComponent_restrict_isIso S N c' d k
    exact restrictMap_isIso_of_le qc' hVcp
  letI : IsIso (GV.map rc') :=
    basisChangeRightRestriction_restrict_isIso S N b' c' a k
  letI : IsIso (GV.map (qc' ≫ rc')) := by
    rw [GV.map_comp]
    infer_instance
  have hrconj :
      F.map (qc ≫ rc) =
        e.hom.app (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M c d) ≫
          K.map (qc ≫ rc) ≫
          e.inv.app (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) U) := by
    apply (cancel_mono
      (e.hom.app (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) U))).1
    rw [e.hom.naturality (qc ≫ rc)]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [e.inv_hom_id_app]
    rw [← Category.assoc, Category.comp_id]
  letI : IsIso (F.map (qc ≫ rc)) := by
    rw [hrconj]
    infer_instance
  have hsourceK :
      K.map B =
        K.map (qb ≫ rb) ≫ K.map t ≫ inv (K.map (qc ≫ rc)) := by
    change H.map (GU.map B) = _
    rw [twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_restrict_basisChangeOpen
      b c d a k]
    dsimp only [twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalIso, B, qb, rb, t, qc, rc]
    simp only [Iso.trans_hom, asIso_hom, Iso.symm_hom, asIso_inv,
      Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_inv, Category.assoc]
    dsimp only [K]
    simp only [Functor.comp_map]
    rw [IsIso.inv_comp]
  have hsource :
      F.map B =
        F.map (qb ≫ rb) ≫ F.map t ≫ inv (F.map (qc ≫ rc)) :=
    frameChange_formula_of_functorIso F K e (qb ≫ rb) t (qc ≫ rc) B hsourceK
  have htarget :
      GV.map B' =
        GV.map (qb' ≫ rb') ≫ GV.map t' ≫
          inv (GV.map (qc' ≫ rc')) := by
    rw [twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_restrict_basisChangeOpen
      b' c' d a k]
    dsimp only [twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalIso,
      B', qb', rb', t', qc', rc']
    simp only [Iso.trans_hom, asIso_hom, Iso.symm_hom, asIso_inv,
      Functor.map_comp, IsIso.inv_comp, Category.assoc]
    dsimp only [GV]
  have hframe :=
    frameChange_naturality_of_three_squares
      (GV.map Db.restrictIso.hom) (GV.map pU.hom)
      (GV.map Dc.restrictIso.hom)
      (F.map (qb ≫ rb)) (F.map t) (F.map (qc ≫ rc))
      (GV.map (qb' ≫ rb')) (GV.map t') (GV.map (qc' ≫ rc'))
      hl hm hr
  change F.map B ≫ GV.map Dc.restrictIso.hom =
    GV.map Db.restrictIso.hom ≫ GV.map B'
  rw [hsource, htarget]
  exact hframe

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_pullback_naturality_of_restrict
statement:
theorem twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_pullback_naturality_of_restrict
    {R S M N ι κ : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (c : Module.Basis κ R M)
    (b' : Module.Basis ι S N) (c' : Module.Basis κ S N)
    (d : ℤ) (q : space S N ⟶ space R M) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (Db : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b b' d q)
    (Dc : TwistingSheafRestrictionData c c' d q)
    (h :
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
            (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M b c d) ≫
          Dc.restrictIso.hom =
        Db.restrictIso.hom ≫
          twistingSheafBasisChangeHom S N b' c' d) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map
          (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M b c d) ≫
        Dc.pullbackIso.hom =
      Db.pullbackIso.hom ≫
        twistingSheafBasisChangeHom S N b' c' d
proof:
:= by
  unfold TwistingSheafRestrictionData.pullbackIso
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc]
  change
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map
          (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M b c d) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).inv.app
          (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M c d) ≫
        Dc.restrictIso.hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).inv.app
          (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d) ≫
        Db.restrictIso.hom ≫
          twistingSheafBasisChangeHom S N b' c' d
  slice_lhs 1 2 =>
    rw [(Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).inv.naturality
      (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M b c d)]
  rw [Category.assoc, h]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistingSheafRestrictionComp_congr_hom_eq
statement:
theorem twistingSheafRestrictionComp_congr_hom_eq
    {R S T M N P ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [AddCommGroup P] [Module T P] [Module.Free T P] [Module.Finite T P]
    [Finite ι]
    {b : Module.Basis ι R M} {c : Module.Basis ι S N}
    {e : Module.Basis ι T P} {d : ℤ}
    {q : space S N ⟶ space R M} {r : space T P ⟶ space S N}
    {s : space T P ⟶ space R M}
    [IsOpenImmersion q] [IsOpenImmersion r] [IsOpenImmersion s]
    (hq : ∀ i, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b i) =
      linearOpen S N (c i))
    (hr : ∀ i, r ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen S N (c i) =
      linearOpen T P (e i))
    (hs : ∀ i, s ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b i) =
      linearOpen T P (e i))
    (h : r ≫ q = s)
    (Dq : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c d q)
    (Dr : TwistingSheafRestrictionData c e d r)
    (Ds : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b e d s)
    (hDq : Dq.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q hq).hom)
    (hDr : Dr.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso c e r hr).hom)
    (hDs : Ds.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b e s hs).hom) :
    (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr h.symm).app
          (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d)) ≪≫
        twistingSheafRestrictionCompIso Dq Dr).hom =
      Ds.restrictIso.hom
proof:
:= by
  let hc : ∀ i, (r ≫ q) ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b i) =
      linearOpen T P (e i) :=
    fun i ↦ by
      rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, hq i, hr i]
  have hcomp :
      (twistingSheafRestrictionDataComp Dq Dr).chartIso.hom =
        (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b e (r ≫ q) hc).hom := by
    simpa only [twistingSheafRestrictionDataComp,
      linearChartCochainsRestrictCompIso, Iso.trans_hom,
      Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.app_hom, hDq, hDr] using
      linearChartCochainsRestrictCompIso_hom b c e q r hq hr
  have hChart :
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr h.symm).app
            (linearChartCochains R M b)) ≪≫
          (twistingSheafRestrictionDataComp Dq Dr).chartIso).hom =
        Ds.chartIso.hom := by
    simp only [Iso.trans_hom]
    rw [hcomp, hDs]
    exact linearChartCochainsRestrictIso_congr_hom
      b e h.symm hs hc
  calc
    _ = (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr h.symm).app
            (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d)) ≪≫
          (twistingSheafRestrictionDataComp Dq Dr).restrictIso).hom := by
      simp only [Iso.trans_hom]
      rw [twistingSheafRestrictionDataComp_restrictIso_hom]
    _ = Ds.restrictIso.hom :=
      twistingSheafRestrictionData_congr_hom h.symm Ds
        (twistingSheafRestrictionDataComp Dq Dr) hChart

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver_hom_chartToLeft
statement:
theorem commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver_hom_chartToLeft
    (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ≫ c.chartToLeft =
      (C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι ≫ C.overlapToChart i j
proof:
:= by
  change
    (((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c).isoOpensRange.inv ≫
      (C.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j c).hom) ≫ c.chartToLeft =
        ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c).opensRange.ι ≫
          C.overlapToChart i j
  have hleft :=
    C.commonBasicOpenChartIso_hom_chartToLeft i j c
  calc
    _ = ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c).isoOpensRange.inv ≫
        ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j c).hom ≫
          c.chartToLeft) := Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c).isoOpensRange.inv ≫
        ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c ≫
          C.overlapToChart i j) :=
      congrArg
        (fun f ↦
          ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c).isoOpensRange.inv ≫ f)
        hleft
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← Category.assoc,
        ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c).isoOpensRange_inv_comp]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver_hom_chartToRight
statement:
theorem commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver_hom_chartToRight
    (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ≫ c.chartToRight =
      (C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι ≫
        C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i
proof:
:= by
  change
    (((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c).isoOpensRange.inv ≫
      (C.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j c).hom) ≫ c.chartToRight =
        ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c).opensRange.ι ≫
          C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i
  have hright := C.localTransition_toChart i j c
  have htransition :=
    C.basicOpenOverlapCover_transition i j c
  calc
    _ = ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c).isoOpensRange.inv ≫
        ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j c).hom ≫
          c.chartToRight) := Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c).isoOpensRange.inv ≫
        (C.localTransition i j c ≫ C.overlapToChart j i) :=
      congrArg
        (fun f ↦
          ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c).isoOpensRange.inv ≫ f)
        hright.symm
    _ = ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c).isoOpensRange.inv ≫
        (((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c ≫ C.transition i j) ≫
          C.overlapToChart j i) :=
      congrArg
        (fun f ↦
          ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c).isoOpensRange.inv ≫
            (f ≫ C.overlapToChart j i))
        htransition.symm
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc,
        ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c).isoOpensRange_inv_comp]
      rw [Category.assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.mulRestrictionFirst_leftSectionBasis
statement:
theorem mulRestrictionFirst_leftSectionBasis
    (i j : C.I) (c e : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) (a : C.basisIndex i) :
    c.mulRestrictionFirst e (c.leftSectionBasis a) =
      (c.mul e).leftSectionBasis a
proof:
:= by
  change E.val.map (homOfLE (c.mul_affineOpen_le_first e)).op
      (C.restrictedSectionBasis i c.affineOpen.1
        c.affineOpen_le_left a) =
    C.restrictedSectionBasis i (c.mul e).affineOpen.1
      (c.mul e).affineOpen_le_left a
  exact C.restrictedSectionBasis_trans i c.affineOpen.1
    (c.mul e).affineOpen.1 c.affineOpen_le_left
      (c.mul_affineOpen_le_first e) a

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.mulRestrictionFirst_rightSectionBasis
statement:
theorem mulRestrictionFirst_rightSectionBasis
    (i j : C.I) (c e : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) (a : C.basisIndex j) :
    c.mulRestrictionFirst e (c.rightSectionBasis a) =
      (c.mul e).rightSectionBasis a
proof:
:= by
  change E.val.map (homOfLE (c.mul_affineOpen_le_first e)).op
      (C.restrictedSectionBasis j c.affineOpen.1
        c.affineOpen_le_right a) =
    C.restrictedSectionBasis j (c.mul e).affineOpen.1
      (c.mul e).affineOpen_le_right a
  exact C.restrictedSectionBasis_trans j c.affineOpen.1
    (c.mul e).affineOpen.1 c.affineOpen_le_right
      (c.mul_affineOpen_le_first e) a

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.mulChartToFirst_preimage_leftLinearOpen
statement:
theorem mulChartToFirst_preimage_leftLinearOpen
    (i j : C.I) (c e : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) (a : C.basisIndex i) :
    c.mulChartToFirst e ⁻¹ᵁ
        linearOpen Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))
          (c.leftSectionBasis a) =
      linearOpen Γ(X, (c.mul e).affineOpen.1)
        (E.val.obj (op (c.mul e).affineOpen.1))
          ((c.mul e).leftSectionBasis a)
proof:
:= by
  have h :=
    semilinearSymmetricProjMap_preimage_linearOpen
      (X.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (c.mul_affineOpen_le_first e)).op).hom
      (c.mulRestrictionFirst e) (c.mulRestrictionFirst_spans e)
        (c.leftSectionBasis a)
  rw [C.mulRestrictionFirst_leftSectionBasis i j c e a] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.mulChartToFirst_preimage_leftLinearOverlapOpen
statement:
theorem mulChartToFirst_preimage_leftLinearOverlapOpen
    (i j : C.I) (c e : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    (a k : C.basisIndex i) :
    c.mulChartToFirst e ⁻¹ᵁ
        linearOverlapOpen Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
          (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))
            (c.leftSectionBasis a) (c.leftSectionBasis k) =
      linearOverlapOpen Γ(X, (c.mul e).affineOpen.1)
        (E.val.obj (op (c.mul e).affineOpen.1))
          ((c.mul e).leftSectionBasis a)
          ((c.mul e).leftSectionBasis k)
proof:
:= by
  have h :=
    semilinearSymmetricProjMap_preimage_linearOverlapOpen
      (X.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (c.mul_affineOpen_le_first e)).op).hom
      (c.mulRestrictionFirst e) (c.mulRestrictionFirst_spans e)
        (c.leftSectionBasis a) (c.leftSectionBasis k)
  rw [C.mulRestrictionFirst_leftSectionBasis i j c e,
    C.mulRestrictionFirst_leftSectionBasis i j c e] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.mulChartToFirst_app_leftTransitionSectionUnit_heq
statement:
theorem mulChartToFirst_app_leftTransitionSectionUnit_heq
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) (c e : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    (a k : C.basisIndex i) :
    HEq
      ((c.mulChartToFirst e).app
        (linearOverlapOpen Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
          (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))
            (c.leftSectionBasis a) (c.leftSectionBasis k))
        (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
          (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) d
            (c.leftSectionBasis a) (c.leftSectionBasis k)).1)
      (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit Γ(X, (c.mul e).affineOpen.1)
        (E.val.obj (op (c.mul e).affineOpen.1)) d
          ((c.mul e).leftSectionBasis a)
          ((c.mul e).leftSectionBasis k)).1
proof:

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.mulFirstLeftAmbientRestrictionIso_hom_eq
statement:
theorem mulFirstLeftAmbientRestrictionIso_hom_eq
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) (c e : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (C.mulFirstLeftAmbientRestrictionIso d i j c e).hom =
      ((c.mul e).leftTwistRestrictionData d).pullbackIso.hom
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (c.mulChartToFirst e) :=
    C.mulChartToFirst_isOpenImmersion c e
  change
    (pullbackRestrictionCompIso
          (c.mul e).chartToLeft c.chartToLeft
          (c.mulChartToFirst e)
          (c.mulChartToFirst_comp_chartToLeft e)
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i) ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (c.mulChartToFirst e)).mapIso
          ((c.leftTwistRestrictionData d).pullbackIso) ≪≫
        (C.mulFirstLeftTwistRestrictionData d i j c e).pullbackIso).hom =
      ((c.mul e).leftTwistRestrictionData d).pullbackIso.hom
  dsimp only [AffineFrameCover.chartTwistingSheaf]
  simp only [id_eq]
  rw [pullbackRestrictionCompIso_twistingSheafRestriction_hom]
  have hrestrict :=
    twistingSheafRestrictionComp_congr_hom_eq
      c.chartToLeft_preimage_linearOpen
      (C.mulChartToFirst_preimage_leftLinearOpen i j c e)
      (c.mul e).chartToLeft_preimage_linearOpen
      (c.mulChartToFirst_comp_chartToLeft e)
      (c.leftTwistRestrictionData d)
      (C.mulFirstLeftTwistRestrictionData d i j c e)
      ((c.mul e).leftTwistRestrictionData d)
      (by rfl) (by rfl) (by rfl)
  simp only [TwistingSheafRestrictionData.pullbackIso,
    Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom]
  exact congrArg
    (fun z ↦
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback
        (c.mul e).chartToLeft).app
          (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex
            Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))
              (C.sectionBasis i) d)).inv ≫ z)
    hrestrict

  exact congrArg
    (fun z ↦
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback
        (c.mul e).chartToLeft).app
          (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex
            Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))
              (C.sectionBasis i) d)).inv ≫ z)
    hrestrict

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.mulSecondRightAmbientRestrictionIso_hom_eq
statement:
theorem mulSecondRightAmbientRestrictionIso_hom_eq
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) (c e : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (C.mulSecondRightAmbientRestrictionIso d i j c e).hom =
      ((c.mul e).rightTwistRestrictionData d).pullbackIso.hom
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex j) := C.basisIndex_finite j
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (c.mulChartToSecond e) :=
    C.mulChartToSecond_isOpenImmersion c e
  change
    (pullbackRestrictionCompIso
          (c.mul e).chartToRight e.chartToRight
          (c.mulChartToSecond e)
          (c.mulChartToSecond_comp_chartToRight e)
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j) ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (c.mulChartToSecond e)).mapIso
          ((e.rightTwistRestrictionData d).pullbackIso) ≪≫
        (C.mulSecondRightTwistRestrictionData d i j c e).pullbackIso).hom =
      ((c.mul e).rightTwistRestrictionData d).pullbackIso.hom
  dsimp only [AffineFrameCover.chartTwistingSheaf]
  simp only [id_eq]
  rw [pullbackRestrictionCompIso_twistingSheafRestriction_hom]
  have hrestrict :=
    twistingSheafRestrictionComp_congr_hom_eq
      e.chartToRight_preimage_linearOpen
      (C.mulChartToSecond_preimage_rightLinearOpen i j c e)
      (c.mul e).chartToRight_preimage_linearOpen
      (c.mulChartToSecond_comp_chartToRight e)
      (e.rightTwistRestrictionData d)
      (C.mulSecondRightTwistRestrictionData d i j c e)
      ((c.mul e).rightTwistRestrictionData d)
      (by rfl) (by rfl) (by rfl)
  simp only [TwistingSheafRestrictionData.pullbackIso,
    Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom]
  exact congrArg
    (fun z ↦
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback
        (c.mul e).chartToRight).app
          (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex
            Γ(X, C.U j) (E.val.obj (op (C.U j)))
              (C.sectionBasis j) d)).inv ≫ z)
    hrestrict

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.mulFirst_twistingSheafBasisIso_naturality
statement:
theorem mulFirst_twistingSheafBasisIso_naturality
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) (c e : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (c.mulChartToFirst e)).mapIso
          (c.twistingSheafBasisIso d) ≪≫
        C.mulFirstRightTwistRestrictionIso d i j c e).hom =
      (C.mulFirstLeftTwistRestrictionIso d i j c e ≪≫
        (c.mul e).twistingSheafBasisIso d).hom
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex j) := C.basisIndex_finite j
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (c.mulChartToFirst e) :=
    C.mulChartToFirst_isOpenImmersion c e
  change
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (c.mulChartToFirst e)).map
          (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom
            Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))
            c.leftSectionBasis c.rightSectionBasis d) ≫
        (C.mulFirstRightTwistRestrictionData d i j c e).pullbackIso.hom =
      (C.mulFirstLeftTwistRestrictionData d i j c e).pullbackIso.hom ≫
        twistingSheafBasisChangeHom
          Γ(X, (c.mul e).affineOpen.1)
          (E.val.obj (op (c.mul e).affineOpen.1))
          (c.mul e).leftSectionBasis (c.mul e).rightSectionBasis d
  apply twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_pullback_naturality_of_restrict
  exact @twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_restrict_naturality
    _ _ _ _ _ _
    _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
    c.leftSectionBasis c.rightSectionBasis
    (c.mul e).leftSectionBasis (c.mul e).rightSectionBasis d
    (c.mulChartToFirst e)
    (C.mulChartToFirst_isOpenImmersion c e)
    (C.mulChartToFirst_preimage_leftLinearOpen i j c e)
    (C.mulChartToFirst_preimage_rightLinearOpen i j c e)
    (C.mulChartToFirst_preimage_basisChangeOpen i j c e)
    (C.mulChartToFirst_app_basisChangeTransitionSectionUnit_heq (-d)
      i j c e)
    (C.mulFirstLeftTwistRestrictionData d i j c e)
    (C.mulFirstRightTwistRestrictionData d i j c e)
    (by rfl) (by rfl)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.mulSecond_twistingSheafBasisIso_naturality
statement:
theorem mulSecond_twistingSheafBasisIso_naturality
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) (c e : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :

          (e.twistingSheafBasisIso d) ≪≫
        C.mulSecondRightTwistRestrictionIso d i j c e).hom =
      (C.mulSecondLeftTwistRestrictionIso d i j c e ≪≫
        (c.mul e).twistingSheafBasisIso d).hom
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex j) := C.basisIndex_finite j
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (c.mulChartToSecond e) :=
    C.mulChartToSecond_isOpenImmersion c e
  change
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (c.mulChartToSecond e)).map
          (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom
            Γ(X, e.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op e.affineOpen.1))

        (C.mulSecondRightTwistRestrictionData d i j c e).pullbackIso.hom =
      (C.mulSecondLeftTwistRestrictionData d i j c e).pullbackIso.hom ≫
        twistingSheafBasisChangeHom
          Γ(X, (c.mul e).affineOpen.1)

          (c.mul e).leftSectionBasis (c.mul e).rightSectionBasis d
  apply twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_pullback_naturality_of_restrict
  exact @twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_restrict_naturality
    _ _ _ _ _ _
    _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
    e.leftSectionBasis e.rightSectionBasis
    (c.mul e).leftSectionBasis (c.mul e).rightSectionBasis d
    (c.mulChartToSecond e)
    (C.mulChartToSecond_isOpenImmersion c e)
    (C.mulChartToSecond_preimage_leftLinearOpen i j c e)
    (C.mulChartToSecond_preimage_rightLinearOpen i j c e)
    (C.mulChartToSecond_preimage_basisChangeOpen i j c e)
    (C.mulChartToSecond_app_basisChangeTransitionSectionUnit_heq (-d)
      i j c e)
    (C.mulSecondLeftTwistRestrictionData d i j c e)
    (C.mulSecondRightTwistRestrictionData d i j c e)
    (by rfl) (by rfl)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistComparisonFirstCoherence
statement:
theorem canonicalTwistComparisonFirstCoherence
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) (c e : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistComparisonPullbackFirstIso_hom_eq_factored
statement:
theorem canonicalTwistComparisonPullbackFirstIso_hom_eq_factored
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) (c e : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (C.canonicalTwistComparisonPullbackFirstIso d i j c e).hom =
      (C.canonicalTwistComparisonPullbackFirstFactoredIso d i j c e).hom
proof:
:= by
  change
    (C.mulFirstLeftPullbackPrefixIso d i j c e ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (c.mulChartToFirst e)).mapIso
          ((c.leftTwistRestrictionData d).pullbackIso ≪≫
            c.twistingSheafBasisIso d ≪≫
              (c.rightTwistRestrictionData d).pullbackIso.symm) ≪≫
        (C.mulFirstRightPullbackPrefixIso d i j c e).symm).hom =
      ((C.mulFirstLeftPullbackPrefixIso d i j c e ≪≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback (c.mulChartToFirst e)).mapIso
            ((c.leftTwistRestrictionData d).pullbackIso) ≪≫
          C.mulFirstLeftTwistRestrictionIso d i j c e) ≪≫
        (C.mulFirstLeftTwistRestrictionIso d i j c e).symm ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (c.mulChartToFirst e)).mapIso
          (c.twistingSheafBasisIso d) ≪≫
        C.mulFirstRightTwistRestrictionIso d i j c e ≪≫
        (C.mulFirstRightPullbackPrefixIso d i j c e ≪≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback (c.mulChartToFirst e)).mapIso
            ((c.rightTwistRestrictionData d).pullbackIso) ≪≫
          C.mulFirstRightTwistRestrictionIso d i j c e).symm).hom
  exact mapIso_threefold_factorization
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (c.mulChartToFirst e))
    ((c.leftTwistRestrictionData d).pullbackIso)
    (c.twistingSheafBasisIso d)
    ((c.rightTwistRestrictionData d).pullbackIso)
    (C.mulFirstLeftPullbackPrefixIso d i j c e)
    (C.mulFirstRightPullbackPrefixIso d i j c e)
    (C.mulFirstLeftTwistRestrictionIso d i j c e)
    (C.mulFirstRightTwistRestrictionIso d i j c e)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistComparisonPullbackSecondIso_hom_eq_factored
statement:
theorem canonicalTwistComparisonPullbackSecondIso_hom_eq_factored
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) (c e : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (C.canonicalTwistComparisonPullbackSecondIso d i j c e).hom =
      (C.canonicalTwistComparisonPullbackSecondFactoredIso d i j c e).hom
proof:
:= by
  change
    (C.mulSecondLeftPullbackPrefixIso d i j c e ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (c.mulChartToSecond e)).mapIso
          ((e.leftTwistRestrictionData d).pullbackIso ≪≫
            e.twistingSheafBasisIso d ≪≫
              (e.rightTwistRestrictionData d).pullbackIso.symm) ≪≫
        (C.mulSecondRightPullbackPrefixIso d i j c e).symm).hom =
      ((C.mulSecondLeftPullbackPrefixIso d i j c e ≪≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback (c.mulChartToSecond e)).mapIso
            ((e.leftTwistRestrictionData d).pullbackIso) ≪≫
          C.mulSecondLeftTwistRestrictionIso d i j c e) ≪≫
        (C.mulSecondLeftTwistRestrictionIso d i j c e).symm ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (c.mulChartToSecond e)).mapIso
          (e.twistingSheafBasisIso d) ≪≫
        C.mulSecondRightTwistRestrictionIso d i j c e ≪≫
        (C.mulSecondRightPullbackPrefixIso d i j c e ≪≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback (c.mulChartToSecond e)).mapIso
            ((e.rightTwistRestrictionData d).pullbackIso) ≪≫
          C.mulSecondRightTwistRestrictionIso d i j c e).symm).hom
  exact mapIso_threefold_factorization
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (c.mulChartToSecond e))
    ((e.leftTwistRestrictionData d).pullbackIso)
    (e.twistingSheafBasisIso d)
    ((e.rightTwistRestrictionData d).pullbackIso)
    (C.mulSecondLeftPullbackPrefixIso d i j c e)
    (C.mulSecondRightPullbackPrefixIso d i j c e)
    (C.mulSecondLeftTwistRestrictionIso d i j c e)
    (C.mulSecondRightTwistRestrictionIso d i j c e)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistComparisonPullbackFirstIso_hom_eq
statement:
theorem canonicalTwistComparisonPullbackFirstIso_hom_eq
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) (c e : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    (h : C.CanonicalTwistComparisonFirstCoherence d i j c e) :
    (C.canonicalTwistComparisonPullbackFirstIso d i j c e).hom =
      (C.transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso d i j (c.mul e)).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [C.canonicalTwistComparisonPullbackFirstIso_hom_eq_factored
    d i j c e]
  change
    (C.mulFirstLeftAmbientRestrictionIso d i j c e ≪≫
        (C.mulFirstLeftTwistRestrictionIso d i j c e).symm ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (c.mulChartToFirst e)).mapIso
          (c.twistingSheafBasisIso d) ≪≫
        C.mulFirstRightTwistRestrictionIso d i j c e ≪≫
        (C.mulFirstRightAmbientRestrictionIso d i j c e).symm).hom =
      (((c.mul e).leftTwistRestrictionData d).pullbackIso ≪≫
        (c.mul e).twistingSheafBasisIso d ≪≫
        ((c.mul e).rightTwistRestrictionData d).pullbackIso.symm).hom
  exact fivefold_factorization_of_coherence
    (C.mulFirstLeftAmbientRestrictionIso d i j c e)
    ((c.mul e).leftTwistRestrictionData d).pullbackIso
    (C.mulFirstLeftTwistRestrictionIso d i j c e)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (c.mulChartToFirst e)).mapIso
      (c.twistingSheafBasisIso d))
    (C.mulFirstRightTwistRestrictionIso d i j c e)
    (C.mulFirstRightAmbientRestrictionIso d i j c e)
    ((c.mul e).rightTwistRestrictionData d).pullbackIso
    ((c.mul e).twistingSheafBasisIso d)
    h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistComparisonPullbackSecondIso_hom_eq
statement:
theorem canonicalTwistComparisonPullbackSecondIso_hom_eq
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) (c e : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    (h : C.CanonicalTwistComparisonSecondCoherence d i j c e) :
    (C.canonicalTwistComparisonPullbackSecondIso d i j c e).hom =
      (C.transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso d i j (c.mul e)).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [C.canonicalTwistComparisonPullbackSecondIso_hom_eq_factored
    d i j c e]
  change
    (C.mulSecondLeftAmbientRestrictionIso d i j c e ≪≫
        (C.mulSecondLeftTwistRestrictionIso d i j c e).symm ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (c.mulChartToSecond e)).mapIso
          (e.twistingSheafBasisIso d) ≪≫
        C.mulSecondRightTwistRestrictionIso d i j c e ≪≫
        (C.mulSecondRightAmbientRestrictionIso d i j c e).symm).hom =
      (((c.mul e).leftTwistRestrictionData d).pullbackIso ≪≫
        (c.mul e).twistingSheafBasisIso d ≪≫
        ((c.mul e).rightTwistRestrictionData d).pullbackIso.symm).hom
  exact fivefold_factorization_of_coherence
    (C.mulSecondLeftAmbientRestrictionIso d i j c e)
    ((c.mul e).leftTwistRestrictionData d).pullbackIso
    (C.mulSecondLeftTwistRestrictionIso d i j c e)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (c.mulChartToSecond e)).mapIso
      (e.twistingSheafBasisIso d))
    (C.mulSecondRightTwistRestrictionIso d i j c e)
