name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistComparisonMulNaturality_of_coherence
statement:
theorem canonicalTwistComparisonMulNaturality_of_coherence
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I)
    (h₁ : ∀ c e : C.CommonBasicOpen i j,
      C.CanonicalTwistComparisonFirstCoherence d i j c e)
    (h₂ : ∀ c e : C.CommonBasicOpen i j,
      C.CanonicalTwistComparisonSecondCoherence d i j c e) :
    C.CanonicalTwistComparisonMulNaturality d i j
proof:
:= by
  intro c e
  exact ⟨
    C.canonicalTwistComparisonPullbackFirstIso_hom_eq d i j c e (h₁ c e),
    C.canonicalTwistComparisonPullbackSecondIso_hom_eq d i j c e (h₂ c e)⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistComparisonMulNaturality
statement:
theorem canonicalTwistComparisonMulNaturality
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) :
    C.CanonicalTwistComparisonMulNaturality d i j
proof:
:=
  C.canonicalTwistComparisonMulNaturality_of_coherence d i j
    (fun c e ↦ C.canonicalTwistComparisonFirstCoherence d i j c e)
    (fun c e ↦ C.canonicalTwistComparisonSecondCoherence d i j c e)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistComparisonOpen_coversTop
statement:
theorem twistComparisonOpen_coversTop (i j : C.I) :
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology (C.overlap i j)).CoversTop
      (fun c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j ↦
        C.twistComparisonOpen i j c)
proof:
:=
  (Opens.coversTop_iff
    (T := C.overlap i j)
    (fun c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j ↦
      C.twistComparisonOpen i j c)).2
      (C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).isOpenCover_opensRange

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistOverlapLocalRestrictionIndependence_of_mul
statement:
theorem twistOverlapLocalRestrictionIndependence_of_mul
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I)
    (h : C.TwistOverlapMulRestrictionCompatibility d i j) :
    C.TwistOverlapLocalRestrictionIndependence d i j
proof:
:= by
  intro c e V hVc hVe
  let W := C.twistComparisonOpen i j (c.mul e)
  have hWc : W ≤ C.twistComparisonOpen i j c := by
    dsimp only [W, twistComparisonOpen]
    rw [C.basicOpenOverlapCover_mul_opensRange i j c e]
    exact inf_le_left
  have hWe : W ≤ C.twistComparisonOpen i j e := by
    dsimp only [W, twistComparisonOpen]
    rw [C.basicOpenOverlapCover_mul_opensRange i j c e]
    exact inf_le_right
  have hVW : V ≤ W := by
    dsimp only [W, twistComparisonOpen]
    rw [C.basicOpenOverlapCover_mul_opensRange i j c e]
    exact le_inf hVc hVe
  have hc := (h c e).1
  have he := (h c e).2
  change
    Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (C.overlap i j) hVc
        (C.twistOverlapLocalIso d i j c).hom =
      Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (C.overlap i j) hVe
        (C.twistOverlapLocalIso d i j e).hom
  calc
    Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (C.overlap i j) hVc
        (C.twistOverlapLocalIso d i j c).hom =
      Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (C.overlap i j) hVW
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (C.overlap i j) hWc
          (C.twistOverlapLocalIso d i j c).hom) := by
            rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_trans]
    _ = Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (C.overlap i j) hVW
        (C.twistOverlapLocalIso d i j (c.mul e)).hom :=
      congrArg
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (C.overlap i j) hVW) hc
    _ = Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (C.overlap i j) hVW
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (C.overlap i j) hWe
          (C.twistOverlapLocalIso d i j e).hom) :=
      congrArg
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (C.overlap i j) hVW) he.symm
    _ = Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (C.overlap i j) hVe
        (C.twistOverlapLocalIso d i j e).hom := by
            rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_trans]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistOverlapLocalHom_compatible
statement:
theorem twistOverlapLocalHom_compatible
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I)
    (h : C.TwistOverlapLocalRestrictionIndependence d i j) :
    Presheaf.FamilyOfElementsOnObjects.IsCompatible
      (fun c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j ↦
        Scheme.Modules.localHomSection (C.overlap i j)
          (C.twistComparisonOpen i j c)
          (C.twistOverlapLocalIso d i j c).hom)
proof:
:= by
  intro V c e f g
  have hVc : V ≤ C.twistComparisonOpen i j c := f.le
  have hVe : V ≤ C.twistComparisonOpen i j e := g.le
  rw [show f = homOfLE hVc from Subsingleton.elim _ _,
    show g = homOfLE hVe from Subsingleton.elim _ _,
    Scheme.Modules.sheafHom_map_localHomSection,
    Scheme.Modules.sheafHom_map_localHomSection]
  change (SheafOfModules.toSheaf
      ((C.overlap i j).ringCatSheaf.over V)).map
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (C.overlap i j) hVc
          (C.twistOverlapLocalIso d i j c).hom) =
    (SheafOfModules.toSheaf
      ((C.overlap i j).ringCatSheaf.over V)).map
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (C.overlap i j) hVe
          (C.twistOverlapLocalIso d i j e).hom)
  exact congrArg
    (SheafOfModules.toSheaf
      ((C.overlap i j).ringCatSheaf.over V)).map
    (h c e hVc hVe)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistOverlapHomOfLocalCompatibility_over
statement:
theorem twistOverlapHomOfLocalCompatibility_over
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I)
    (h : C.TwistOverlapLocalRestrictionIndependence d i j)
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (C.twistOverlapHomOfLocalCompatibility d i j h).over
        (C.twistComparisonOpen i j c) =
      (C.twistOverlapLocalIso d i j c).hom
proof:
:=
  Scheme.Modules.glueHom_over (C.overlap i j)
    (fun e : C.CommonBasicOpen i j ↦
      C.twistComparisonOpen i j e)
    (C.twistComparisonOpen_coversTop i j)
    (fun e : C.CommonBasicOpen i j ↦
      (C.twistOverlapLocalIso d i j e).hom)
    (C.twistOverlapLocalHom_compatible d i j h) c

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistOverlapHomOfLocalCompatibility_isIso
statement:
theorem twistOverlapHomOfLocalCompatibility_isIso
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I)
    (h : C.TwistOverlapLocalRestrictionIndependence d i j) :
    IsIso (C.twistOverlapHomOfLocalCompatibility d i j h)
proof:
:=
  Scheme.Modules.glueHom_isIso (C.overlap i j)
    (fun c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j ↦
      C.twistComparisonOpen i j c)
    (C.twistComparisonOpen_coversTop i j)
    (fun c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j ↦
      (C.twistOverlapLocalIso d i j c).hom)
    (C.twistOverlapLocalHom_compatible d i j h)
    (fun _ ↦ inferInstance)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.functor_map_eqToHom_heq
statement:
theorem functor_map_eqToHom_heq
    {D : Type v} [Category.{w} D] (F : D ⥤ Type u)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushforwardCongr₂_hom_app_val_app_eq
statement:
theorem pushforwardCongr₂_hom_app_val_app_eq
    {C : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} C]
    {D : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} D]
    {J : GrothendieckTopology C} {K : GrothendieckTopology D}
    {F G : C ⥤ D}
    {T : Sheaf J RingCat.{u}} {S : Sheaf K RingCat.{u}}
    [Functor.IsContinuous F J K]
    [Functor.IsContinuous G J K]
    (φ : T ⟶ (G.sheafPushforwardContinuous RingCat J K).obj S)
    {ψ : T ⟶ (F.sheafPushforwardContinuous RingCat J K).obj S}
    (e : F ≅ G)
    (he : φ ≫ (Functor.sheafPushforwardContinuousNatTrans e.hom _ _ _).app S = ψ)
    (M : SheafOfModules S) (U : Cᵒᵖ)
    (x : M.val.obj (op (G.obj U.unop))) :
    ((SheafOfModules.pushforwardCongr₂ φ e he).hom.app M).val.app U x =
      M.val.map (e.hom.app U.unop).op x
proof:
:= by
  unfold SheafOfModules.pushforwardCongr₂
  rw [Iso.trans_hom, NatTrans.comp_app]
  rw [SheafOfModules.comp_val, PresheafOfModules.comp_app,
    ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  simp only [SheafOfModules.pushforwardNatIso,
    SheafOfModules.pushforwardNatTrans,
    SheafOfModules.pushforwardCongr_hom_app_val_app]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.overIsoOfRestrictIso_map
statement:
theorem overIsoOfRestrictIso_map
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {M N : Y.Modules} (U : Y.Opens)
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj M ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj N) :
    (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map
        (overIsoOfRestrictIso U e).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.app M ≫ e.hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).inv.app N
proof:
:= by
  unfold overIsoOfRestrictIso
  dsimp only
  simp
  change (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).inv.app N ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).counitIso.inv.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.obj (N.over U)) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map
          ((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).unitIso.inv.app (N.over U))) =
    (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).inv.app N
  rw [(Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).counitIso_functor_comp (N.over U)]
  exact Category.comp_id _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictFunctor_map_eq_of_over_eq_overIsoOfRestrictIso
statement:
theorem restrictFunctor_map_eq_of_over_eq_overIsoOfRestrictIso
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {M N : Y.Modules} (U : Y.Opens)
    (f : M ⟶ N)
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj M ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj N)
    (h : f.over U = (overIsoOfRestrictIso U e).hom) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map f = e.hom
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi
    ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.app M)).1
  apply (cancel_mono
    ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).inv.app N)).1
  slice_lhs 1 2 =>
    rw [← (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.naturality f]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  change
    (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map (f.over U) =
      (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.app M ≫
        e.hom ≫ (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).inv.app N
  rw [h, overIsoOfRestrictIso_map]

statement:
theorem mulFirst_twistingSheafBasisIso_restrict_naturality
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) (c e : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    ((C.mulFirstRestrictFunctor' c e).mapIso
          (c.twistingSheafBasisIso d) ≪≫
        C.mulFirstRightTwistRestrictIso d i j c e).hom =
      (C.mulFirstLeftTwistRestrictIso d i j c e ≪≫
        (c.mul e).twistingSheafBasisIso d).hom
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex j) := C.basisIndex_finite j
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (c.mulChartToFirst e) :=
    C.mulChartToFirst_isOpenImmersion c e
  change
    (C.mulFirstRestrictFunctor' c e).map
          (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom
            Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))
            c.leftSectionBasis c.rightSectionBasis d) ≫
        (C.mulFirstRightTwistRestrictIso d i j c e).hom =
      (C.mulFirstLeftTwistRestrictIso d i j c e).hom ≫
        twistingSheafBasisChangeHom
          Γ(X, (c.mul e).affineOpen.1)
          (E.val.obj (op (c.mul e).affineOpen.1))
          (c.mul e).leftSectionBasis (c.mul e).rightSectionBasis d
  exact @twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_restrict_naturality
    _ _ _ _ _ _
    _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
    c.leftSectionBasis c.rightSectionBasis
    (c.mul e).leftSectionBasis (c.mul e).rightSectionBasis d
    (c.mulChartToFirst e)
    (C.mulChartToFirst_isOpenImmersion c e)
    (C.mulChartToFirst_preimage_leftLinearOpen i j c e)
    (C.mulChartToFirst_preimage_rightLinearOpen i j c e)
    (C.mulChartToFirst_preimage_basisChangeOpen i j c e)
    (C.mulChartToFirst_app_basisChangeTransitionSectionUnit_heq (-d)
      i j c e)
    (C.mulFirstLeftTwistRestrictionData d i j c e)
    (C.mulFirstRightTwistRestrictionData d i j c e)
    (by rfl) (by rfl)

  unfold mulSecondRightRestrictPrefixIso mulSecondRestrictFunctor'
    mulSecondRightTwistRestrictIso restrictCompPrefixIso'
  convert
    (@twistingSheafRestrictionComp_congr_hom_eq
      _ _ _ _ _ _ _
      _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
      _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
      _ _ _ _
      e.chartToRight (c.mulChartToSecond e) (c.mul e).chartToRight
      (CommonBasicOpen.chartToRight_isOpenImmersion e)
      (C.mulChartToSecond_isOpenImmersion c e)
      (CommonBasicOpen.chartToRight_isOpenImmersion (c.mul e))
      e.chartToRight_preimage_linearOpen
      (C.mulChartToSecond_preimage_rightLinearOpen i j c e)
      (c.mul e).chartToRight_preimage_linearOpen
      (c.mulChartToSecond_comp_chartToRight e)
      (e.rightTwistRestrictionData d)
      (C.mulSecondRightTwistRestrictionData d i j c e)
      ((c.mul e).rightTwistRestrictionData d)
      (by rfl) (by rfl) (by rfl)) using 1
  all_goals
    simp only [chartTwistingSheaf, CommonBasicOpen.rightTwistingSheaf,
      id_eq, twistingSheafRestrictionCompIso, Iso.trans_hom,
      Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.app_hom, ← Category.assoc]
    rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistComparisonRestrictSecondIso_hom_eq
statement:
theorem canonicalTwistComparisonRestrictSecondIso_hom_eq
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) (c e : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (C.canonicalTwistComparisonRestrictSecondIso d i j c e).hom =
      (C.transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonRestrictIso
        d i j (c.mul e)).hom
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (c.mulChartToSecond e) :=
    C.mulChartToSecond_isOpenImmersion c e
  rw [C.canonicalTwistComparisonRestrictSecondIso_hom_eq_factored
    d i j c e]
  unfold canonicalTwistComparisonRestrictSecondFactoredIso
    transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonRestrictIso
  exact fivefold_factorization_of_coherence
    (C.mulSecondLeftRestrictPrefixIso d i j c e ≪≫
      (C.mulSecondRestrictFunctor' c e).mapIso
        ((e.leftTwistRestrictionData d).restrictIso) ≪≫
      C.mulSecondLeftTwistRestrictIso d i j c e)
    ((c.mul e).leftTwistRestrictionData d).restrictIso
    (C.mulSecondLeftTwistRestrictIso d i j c e)
    ((C.mulSecondRestrictFunctor' c e).mapIso
      (e.twistingSheafBasisIso d))
    (C.mulSecondRightTwistRestrictIso d i j c e)
    (C.mulSecondRightRestrictPrefixIso d i j c e ≪≫
      (C.mulSecondRestrictFunctor' c e).mapIso
        ((e.rightTwistRestrictionData d).restrictIso) ≪≫
      C.mulSecondRightTwistRestrictIso d i j c e)
    ((c.mul e).rightTwistRestrictionData d).restrictIso
    ((c.mul e).twistingSheafBasisIso d)
    (C.mulSecondLeftRestrictFactorization_hom_eq d i j c e)
    (C.mulSecond_twistingSheafBasisIso_restrict_naturality d i j c e)
    (C.mulSecondRightRestrictFactorization_hom_eq d i j c e)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver_mulFirst

theorem commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver_mulFirst
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (i j : C.I) (c e : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    (h : C.twistComparisonOpen i j (c.mul e) ≤
      C.twistComparisonOpen i j c) :
    (C.overlap i j).homOfLE h ≫
        (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom =
      (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j (c.mul e)).hom ≫
        c.mulChartToFirst e
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono c.chartToLeft).1
  simp only [Category.assoc,
    C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver_hom_chartToLeft,
    c.mulChartToFirst_comp_chartToLeft]
  rw [← Category.assoc, Scheme.homOfLE_ι]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver_mulSecond
statement:
theorem commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver_mulSecond
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)

        (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j e).hom =
      (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j (c.mul e)).hom ≫

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.functor_map_eq_iso_conj
statement:
theorem functor_map_eq_iso_conj
    {A B : Type*} [Category A] [Category B]
    {F G : A ⥤ B} (e : F ≅ G) {P Q : A} (f : P ⟶ Q) :
    F.map f =
      e.hom.app P ≫ G.map f ≫ e.inv.app Q
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (e.hom.app Q)).1
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [e.inv_hom_id_app, Category.comp_id]
  exact e.hom.naturality f

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.overEquiv_map_restrictHomOverLE
statement:
theorem overEquiv_map_restrictHomOverLE
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {M N : Y.Modules} {U V : Y.Opens}
    (h : V ≤ U) (f : M.over U ⟶ N.over U) :
    (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V).functor.map
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE Y h f) =
      (restrictOverEquivIso h M).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE h)).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map f) ≫
        (restrictOverEquivIso h N).inv
proof:
:= by
  unfold Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE
  ext W x
  let V₀ : Y.Opens := V.ι ''ᵁ W
  have hV₀V : V₀ ≤ V := by
    change V.ι ''ᵁ W ≤ V
    calc
      V.ι ''ᵁ W ≤ V.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : (V : Scheme.{u}).Opens) :=
        Scheme.Hom.image_mono V.ι le_top
      _ = V.ι.opensRange := Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange V.ι
      _ = V := Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι V
  have hV₀U : V₀ ≤ U := hV₀V.trans h
  let hm : M.val.obj (op V₀) := x
  let WU : (U : Scheme.{u}).Opens := (Y.homOfLE h) ''ᵁ W
  have hImage : U.ι ''ᵁ WU = V₀ := by
    simp [WU, V₀, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_image]
  have hpre : U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V₀ = WU := by
    rw [← hImage]
    exact U.ι.preimage_image_eq WU
  have hmain := Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv_restrict_app_heq hV₀U f hm
  dsimp only at hmain
  have hObj₁ :
      (Over.map (homOfLE h)).obj (V.overEquivalence.inverse.obj W) =
        U.overEquivalence.inverse.obj WU := by
    refine CostructuredArrow.obj_ext _ _ ?_ ?_
    · ext y
      simp only [Over.map_obj_left]
      dsimp [WU, TopologicalSpace.Opens.overEquivalence, Over.map,
        CostructuredArrow.mk]
      simp only [Over.mk_left, SetLike.mem_coe]
      change y ∈ Subtype.val '' (W : Set V) ↔
        y ∈ Subtype.val '' (WU : Set U)
      simp only [Set.mem_image]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨y, hyV⟩, hyW, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨⟨y, h hyV⟩,
          ⟨⟨y, hyV⟩, hyW, Scheme.homOfLE_apply' h y hyV⟩, rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨x, hxU⟩, hxWU, rfl⟩
        rcases hxWU with ⟨⟨y, hyV⟩, hyW, hyEq⟩
        have hxy : y = x := by
          exact (Scheme.homOfLE_apply h ⟨y, hyV⟩).symm.trans
            (congrArg Subtype.val hyEq)
        subst y
        exact ⟨⟨x, hyV⟩, hyW, rfl⟩
    · exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hObj₂ : U.overEquivalence.inverse.obj WU =
      Over.mk (homOfLE hV₀U) := by
    refine CostructuredArrow.obj_ext _ _ hImage ?_
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hObj := hObj₁.trans hObj₂
  let qR := Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE Y h f
  have hxm : HEq x hm := by
    dsimp only [hm, V₀]
    rfl
  have hqR :
      HEq (qR.val.app (op (V.overEquivalence.inverse.obj W)) x)
        (f.val.app
          (op ((Over.map (homOfLE h)).obj
            (V.overEquivalence.inverse.obj W))) x) := by
    dsimp only [qR]
    unfold Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE
    rw [SheafOfModules.comp_val, PresheafOfModules.comp_app,
      ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
    rfl
  have hLeft₀ :
      HEq (qR.val.app (op (V.overEquivalence.inverse.obj W)) x)
        (f.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV₀U))) hm) := by
    exact presheafOfModules_app_heq_of_obj_eq f.val
      (congrArg op hObj) x hm hxm
  have hLeft := (overEquiv_map_app_heq' V W qR x).trans hLeft₀
  let αU_M := (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app M
  let αU_N := (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app N
  let qRestr := αU_M.inv ≫
    (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map f ≫ αU_N.hom
  have hRcat :
      (restrictOverEquivIso h M).hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE h)).map
            ((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map f) ≫
          (restrictOverEquivIso h N).inv =
        (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V).hom.app M ≫
          (restrictFunctorOpenCompIso' h M).hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE h)).map qRestr ≫
          (restrictFunctorOpenCompIso' h N).inv ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V).inv.app N := by
    simp [restrictOverEquivIso, restrictFunctorOpenCompIso',
      αU_M, αU_N, qRestr, Category.assoc, Functor.map_comp]
  let WUp : (U : Scheme.{u}).Opens := U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ V₀
  have hImageU : U.ι ''ᵁ WUp = V₀ := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf,
      Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι, inf_eq_right]
    exact hV₀U
  let mImage : M.val.obj (op (U.ι ''ᵁ WUp)) := by
    rw [hImageU]
    exact hm
  let mRestr : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj M).val.obj
      (op WUp) := mImage
  have hmain' :
      HEq (qRestr.val.app (op WUp) mRestr)
        (f.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV₀U))) hm) := by
    simpa only [qRestr, αU_M, αU_N, WUp, mRestr, mImage] using hmain
  let xV := ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V).hom.app M).val.app
    (op W) x
  let xU := ((restrictFunctorOpenCompIso' h M).hom).val.app
    (op W) xV
  have hxV : HEq xV x := by
    dsimp only [xV]
    exact overFunctorEquiv_hom_app_heq' V W x
  have hxU : HEq xU xV := by
    dsimp only [xU]
    exact restrictFunctorOpenCompIso'_hom_app_heq h M W xV
  have hmImage : HEq hm mImage := by
    simp [mImage]
  have hxUm : HEq xU mRestr := by
    change HEq xU mImage
    exact hxU.trans (hxV.trans (hxm.trans hmImage))
  let zU := ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE h)).map qRestr).val.app
    (op W) xU
  have hzU : HEq zU (qRestr.val.app (op WUp) mRestr) := by
    dsimp only [zU]
    change HEq
      (qRestr.val.app (op WU) xU)
      (qRestr.val.app (op WUp) mRestr)
    exact presheafOfModules_app_heq_of_obj_eq qRestr.val
      (congrArg op hpre.symm) xU mRestr hxUm
  let zV := ((restrictFunctorOpenCompIso' h N).inv).val.app
    (op W) zU
  have hzV : HEq zV zU := by
    have hhom := restrictFunctorOpenCompIso'_hom_app_heq h N W zV
    have hcancel :
        (((restrictFunctorOpenCompIso' h N).hom).val.app (op W) zV) = zU := by
      exact congrArg (fun g ↦ g.val.app (op W) zU)
        (Iso.inv_hom_id (restrictFunctorOpenCompIso' h N))
    exact hhom.symm.trans (heq_of_eq hcancel)
  let z := ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V).inv.app N).val.app
    (op W) zV
  have hz : HEq z zV := by
    dsimp only [z]
    exact overFunctorEquiv_inv_app_heq' V W zV
  rw [hRcat]
  apply eq_of_heq
  have hRoute :
      HEq z (f.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV₀U))) hm) :=
    hz.trans (hzV.trans (hzU.trans hmain'))
  exact hLeft.trans hRoute.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.overIsoOfRestrictIso_hom_app_heq
statement:
theorem overIsoOfRestrictIso_hom_app_heq
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {M N : Y.Modules} (U : Y.Opens)
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj M ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj N)
    (W : (U : Scheme.{u}).Opens)
    (x : ((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.obj
      (M.over U)).val.obj (op W))
    (y : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj M).val.obj (op W))
    (hxy : HEq x y) :
    HEq
      ((overIsoOfRestrictIso U e).hom.val.app
        (op (U.overEquivalence.inverse.obj W)) x)
      (e.hom.val.app (op W) y)
proof:
:= by
  let q := (overIsoOfRestrictIso U e).hom
  let x₁ :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.app M).val.app (op W) x
  let x₂ := e.hom.val.app (op W) x₁
  let x₃ :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).inv.app N).val.app (op W) x₂
  have hmap :=
    congrArg
      (fun f ↦ f.val.app (op W) x)
      (overIsoOfRestrictIso_map U e)
  have hmap' :
      (((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map q).val.app (op W) x) =
        x₃ := by
    change
      (((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map q).val.app (op W) x) =
        x₃ at hmap
    exact hmap
  have hx₁ : HEq x₁ x := by
    dsimp only [x₁]
    exact overFunctorEquiv_hom_app_heq' U W x
  have hx₂ :
      HEq x₂ (e.hom.val.app (op W) y) := by
    dsimp only [x₂]
    exact presheafOfModules_app_heq_of_obj_eq e.hom.val rfl x₁ y
      (hx₁.trans hxy)
  have hx₃ : HEq x₃ x₂ := by
    dsimp only [x₃]
    exact overFunctorEquiv_inv_app_heq' U W x₂
  have hfunctor :=
    overEquiv_map_app_heq' U W q x
  exact hfunctor.symm.trans
    ((heq_of_eq hmap').trans (hx₃.trans hx₂))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrict_overIsoOfRestrictIso_hom
statement:
theorem restrict_overIsoOfRestrictIso_hom
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {M N : Y.Modules} {U V : Y.Opens}
    (h : V ≤ U)
    (eU : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj M ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj N)
    (eV : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj M ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj N)
    (hscheme :
      (restrictFunctorOpenCompIso' h M).hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE h)).map eU.hom =
        eV.hom ≫ (restrictFunctorOpenCompIso' h N).hom) :
    Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE Y h
        (overIsoOfRestrictIso U eU).hom =
      (overIsoOfRestrictIso V eV).hom
proof:
:= by
  let qU := (overIsoOfRestrictIso U eU).hom
  let qV := (overIsoOfRestrictIso V eV).hom
  let qR := Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE Y h qU
  apply (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V).functor.map_injective
  ext W x
  apply eq_of_heq
  let WU := (Y.homOfLE h) ''ᵁ W
  let xV :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V).hom.app M).val.app (op W) x
  let xU :=
    ((restrictFunctorOpenCompIso' h M).hom).val.app (op W) xV
  let xO :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).inv.app M).val.app
      (op WU) xU
  let zU :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE h)).map
      eU.hom).val.app (op W) xU
  let zV := eV.hom.val.app (op W) xV
  let zK :=
    ((restrictFunctorOpenCompIso' h N).hom).val.app (op W) zV
  have hxV : HEq xV x := by
    dsimp only [xV]
    exact overFunctorEquiv_hom_app_heq' V W x
  have hxU : HEq xU xV := by
    dsimp only [xU]
    exact restrictFunctorOpenCompIso'_hom_app_heq h M W xV
  have hxO : HEq xO xU := by
    dsimp only [xO]
    exact overFunctorEquiv_inv_app_heq' U WU xU
  have hz : zU = zK := by
    have hz' :=
      congrArg (fun f ↦ f.val.app (op W) xV) hscheme
    change zU = zK at hz'
    exact hz'
  have hzK : HEq zK zV := by
    dsimp only [zK]
    exact restrictFunctorOpenCompIso'_hom_app_heq h N W zV
  have hqU :
      HEq
        (qU.val.app (op (U.overEquivalence.inverse.obj WU)) xO)
        zU := by
    exact overIsoOfRestrictIso_hom_app_heq U eU WU xO xU hxO
  have hqV :
      HEq
        (qV.val.app (op (V.overEquivalence.inverse.obj W)) x)
        zV := by
    exact overIsoOfRestrictIso_hom_app_heq V eV W x xV hxV.symm
  have hrestrict :
      HEq
        (qR.val.app (op (V.overEquivalence.inverse.obj W)) x)
        (qU.val.app (op (U.overEquivalence.inverse.obj WU)) xO) := by
    have hObj :
        (Over.map (homOfLE h)).obj
            (V.overEquivalence.inverse.obj W) =
          U.overEquivalence.inverse.obj WU := by
      refine CostructuredArrow.obj_ext _ _ ?_ ?_
      · ext x
        simp only [Over.map_obj_left]
        dsimp [WU, TopologicalSpace.Opens.overEquivalence, Over.map,
          CostructuredArrow.mk]
        simp only [Over.mk_left, SetLike.mem_coe]
        change
          x ∈ Subtype.val '' (W : Set V) ↔
            x ∈ Subtype.val '' (WU : Set U)
        simp only [Set.mem_image]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨⟨y, hyV⟩, hyW, rfl⟩
          exact ⟨⟨y, h hyV⟩,
            ⟨⟨y, hyV⟩, hyW,
              Scheme.homOfLE_apply' h y hyV⟩, rfl⟩
        · rintro ⟨⟨x, hxU⟩, hxWU, rfl⟩
          rcases hxWU with ⟨⟨y, hyV⟩, hyW, hyEq⟩
          have hxy : y = x := by
            exact (Scheme.homOfLE_apply h ⟨y, hyV⟩).symm.trans
              (congrArg Subtype.val hyEq)
          subst y
          exact ⟨⟨x, hyV⟩, hyW, rfl⟩
      · exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    change HEq
      (qU.val.app
        ((Over.map (homOfLE h)).op.obj
          (op (V.overEquivalence.inverse.obj W))) x)
      (qU.val.app (op (U.overEquivalence.inverse.obj WU)) xO)
    exact presheafOfModules_app_heq_of_obj_eq qU.val
      (congrArg op hObj) x xO
      (hxV.symm.trans (hxU.symm.trans hxO.symm))
  have hmapR :=
    overEquiv_map_app_heq' V W qR x
  have hmapV :=
    overEquiv_map_app_heq' V W qV x
  exact hmapR.trans
    (hrestrict.trans
      (hqU.trans
        ((heq_of_eq hz).trans
          (hzK.trans (hqV.symm.trans hmapV.symm)))))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.modulesHom_ext_of_app_heq_id
statement:
theorem modulesHom_ext_of_app_heq_id
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {M N : Y.Modules} {f g : M ⟶ N}
    (hf : ModulesHomAppHEqId f) (hg : ModulesHomAppHEqId g) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  ext W x
  exact eq_of_heq ((hf W x).trans (hg W x).symm)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.ModulesHomAppHEqId.comp
statement:
theorem ModulesHomAppHEqId.comp
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {M N P : Y.Modules} {f : M ⟶ N} {g : N ⟶ P}
    (hf : ModulesHomAppHEqId f) (hg : ModulesHomAppHEqId g) :
    ModulesHomAppHEqId (f ≫ g)
proof:
:= by
  intro W x
  change HEq (g.val.app (op W) (f.val.app (op W) x)) x
  exact (hg W (f.val.app (op W) x)).trans (hf W x)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.ModulesHomAppHEqId.restrict_map
statement:
theorem ModulesHomAppHEqId.restrict_map
    {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    {M N : Z.Modules} {f : M ⟶ N}
    (hf : ModulesHomAppHEqId f) :
    ModulesHomAppHEqId ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map f)
proof:
:= by
  intro W x
  exact hf (q ''ᵁ W) x

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictFunctorOpenCompIso'_inv_app_heq
statement:
theorem restrictFunctorOpenCompIso'_inv_app_heq
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {U V : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) (M : Y.Modules)
    (W : (V : Scheme.{u}).Opens)
    (x : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE h)).obj

    (b : V ⟶ B) (q : B ⟶ A)
    [IsOpenImmersion r] [IsOpenImmersion a]
    [IsOpenImmersion b] [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (h : r ≫ a = b ≫ q) {M N : A.Modules} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor r).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor a).map f) ≫
        (restrictRestrictionSquareIso r a b q h N).hom =
      (restrictRestrictionSquareIso r a b q h M).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor b).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map f)

          Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor r).map f ≫

      (restrictRestrictionSquareNatIso r a b q h).hom.app M ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q ⋙

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.mapIso_threefold_conjugation
statement:
theorem mapIso_threefold_conjugation
    {A B : Type*} [Category A] [Category B]
    (F : A ⥤ B)
    {X Y Z W : A} {P₀ Q₀ : B}
    (L : X ≅ Y) (M : Y ≅ Z) (R : W ≅ Z)
    (P : P₀ ≅ F.obj X) (Q : Q₀ ≅ F.obj W) :
    ((P ≪≫ F.mapIso L) ≪≫ F.mapIso M ≪≫
        (Q ≪≫ F.mapIso R).symm).hom =
      (P ≪≫ F.mapIso (L ≪≫ M ≪≫ R.symm) ≪≫ Q.symm).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.mapIso_trans, F.mapIso_trans, F.mapIso_symm]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeFirstFivefoldIso_hom_eq_expanded
statement:
theorem twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeFirstFivefoldIso_hom_eq_expanded
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) (c e : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    (h : C.twistComparisonOpen i j (c.mul e) ≤
      C.twistComparisonOpen i j c) :
    (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeFirstFivefoldIso
        d i j c e h).hom =
      (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeFirstExpandedIso
        d i j c e).hom
proof:
:= by
  unfold twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeFirstFivefoldIso
    twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeFirstExpandedIso
  exact fivefold_factorization_of_coherence
      (restrictFunctorOpenCompIso' h
          (C.twistOverlapRestrictSource d i j) ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
          ((C.overlap i j).homOfLE h)).mapIso
            (C.twistOverlapSourceRestrictLocalSchemeIso d i j c) ≪≫
        C.twistOverlapMulFirstLeftRestrictSquareIso d i j c e h)
      (C.twistOverlapSourceRestrictLocalSchemeIso
          d i j (c.mul e) ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
          (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j (c.mul e)).hom).mapIso
            (C.mulFirstLeftRestrictPrefixIso d i j c e))
      (C.twistOverlapMulFirstLeftRestrictSquareIso d i j c e h)
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
        ((C.overlap i j).homOfLE h)).mapIso
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
            (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom).mapIso
              (C.transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonRestrictIso
                d i j c)))
      (C.twistOverlapMulFirstRightRestrictSquareIso d i j c e h)
      (restrictFunctorOpenCompIso' h
          (C.twistOverlapRestrictTarget d i j) ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
          ((C.overlap i j).homOfLE h)).mapIso
            (C.twistOverlapTargetRestrictLocalSchemeIso d i j c) ≪≫
        C.twistOverlapMulFirstRightRestrictSquareIso d i j c e h)
      (C.twistOverlapTargetRestrictLocalSchemeIso
          d i j (c.mul e) ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
          (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j (c.mul e)).hom).mapIso
            (C.mulFirstRightRestrictPrefixIso d i j c e))
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
        (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j (c.mul e)).hom).mapIso
          ((C.mulFirstRestrictFunctor' c e).mapIso
            (C.transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonRestrictIso
              d i j c)))
      (C.twistOverlapRestrictSource_mulFirst_coherence d i j c e h)
      (C.twistOverlapMulFirstMiddle_naturality d i j c e h)
      (C.twistOverlapRestrictTarget_mulFirst_coherence d i j c e h)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeIso_mulFirst_naturality
statement:
theorem twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeIso_mulFirst_naturality
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) (c e : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    (h : C.twistComparisonOpen i j (c.mul e) ≤
      C.twistComparisonOpen i j c) :
    (restrictFunctorOpenCompIso' h
        (C.twistOverlapRestrictSource d i j)).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
        ((C.overlap i j).homOfLE h)).map
          (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeIso d i j c).hom =
      (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeIso
          d i j (c.mul e)).hom ≫
        (restrictFunctorOpenCompIso' h
          (C.twistOverlapRestrictTarget d i j)).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp := congrArg
    (fun f ↦ f ≫
      (restrictFunctorOpenCompIso' h
        (C.twistOverlapRestrictTarget d i j)).hom)
    (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeFirstIso_hom_eq_mul
      d i j c e h)
  unfold twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeFirstIso at hcomp
  simpa only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom,
    Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id] using hcomp

        d i j (c.mul e)

      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
        ((C.overlap i j).homOfLE h)).mapIso
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
            (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j e).hom).mapIso
              (C.transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonRestrictIso
                d i j e)))
      (C.twistOverlapMulSecondRightRestrictSquareIso d i j c e h)
      (restrictFunctorOpenCompIso' h
          (C.twistOverlapRestrictTarget d i j) ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
          ((C.overlap i j).homOfLE h)).mapIso
            (C.twistOverlapTargetRestrictLocalSchemeIso d i j e) ≪≫
        C.twistOverlapMulSecondRightRestrictSquareIso d i j c e h)
      (C.twistOverlapTargetRestrictLocalSchemeIso
          d i j (c.mul e) ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
          (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j (c.mul e)).hom).mapIso
            (C.mulSecondRightRestrictPrefixIso d i j c e))
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
        (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j (c.mul e)).hom).mapIso
          ((C.mulSecondRestrictFunctor' c e).mapIso
            (C.transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonRestrictIso
              d i j e)))
      (C.twistOverlapRestrictSource_mulSecond_coherence d i j c e h)
      (C.twistOverlapMulSecondMiddle_naturality d i j c e h)
      (C.twistOverlapRestrictTarget_mulSecond_coherence d i j c e h)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeSecondExpandedIso_hom_eq_canonical
statement:
theorem twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeSecondExpandedIso_hom_eq_canonical
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) (c e : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeSecondExpandedIso
        d i j c e).hom =
      (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeSecondCanonicalIso
        d i j c e).hom
proof:
:= by
  unfold twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeSecondExpandedIso
    twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeSecondCanonicalIso
    canonicalTwistComparisonRestrictSecondIso
  exact mapIso_threefold_conjugation
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
      (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j (c.mul e)).hom)
    (C.mulSecondLeftRestrictPrefixIso d i j c e)
    ((C.mulSecondRestrictFunctor' c e).mapIso
      (C.transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonRestrictIso d i j e))
    (C.mulSecondRightRestrictPrefixIso d i j c e)
    (C.twistOverlapSourceRestrictLocalSchemeIso d i j (c.mul e))
    (C.twistOverlapTargetRestrictLocalSchemeIso d i j (c.mul e))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeSecondCanonicalIso_hom_eq_mul
statement:
theorem twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeSecondCanonicalIso_hom_eq_mul
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) (c e : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeSecondCanonicalIso
        d i j c e).hom =
      (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeIso
        d i j (c.mul e)).hom
proof:
:= by
  unfold twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeSecondCanonicalIso
    twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeIso
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom]
  rw [C.canonicalTwistComparisonRestrictSecondIso_hom_eq d i j c e]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeSecondIso_hom_eq_mul
statement:
theorem twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeSecondIso_hom_eq_mul
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) (c e : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    (h : C.twistComparisonOpen i j (c.mul e) ≤
      C.twistComparisonOpen i j e) :
    (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeSecondIso
        d i j c e h).hom =
      (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeIso
        d i j (c.mul e)).hom
proof:
:=
  (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeSecondIso_hom_eq_fivefold
      d i j c e h).trans
    ((C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeSecondFivefoldIso_hom_eq_expanded
        d i j c e h).trans
      ((C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeSecondExpandedIso_hom_eq_canonical
          d i j c e).trans
        (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeSecondCanonicalIso_hom_eq_mul
          d i j c e)))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeIso_mulSecond_naturality
statement:
theorem twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeIso_mulSecond_naturality
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) (c e : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    (h : C.twistComparisonOpen i j (c.mul e) ≤
      C.twistComparisonOpen i j e) :
    (restrictFunctorOpenCompIso' h
        (C.twistOverlapRestrictSource d i j)).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
        ((C.overlap i j).homOfLE h)).map
          (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeIso d i j e).hom =
      (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeIso
          d i j (c.mul e)).hom ≫
        (restrictFunctorOpenCompIso' h
          (C.twistOverlapRestrictTarget d i j)).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp := congrArg
    (fun f ↦ f ≫
      (restrictFunctorOpenCompIso' h
        (C.twistOverlapRestrictTarget d i j)).hom)
    (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeSecondIso_hom_eq_mul
      d i j c e h)
  unfold twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeSecondIso at hcomp
  simpa only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom,
    Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id] using hcomp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistOverlapRestrictLocalIso_mulSecond_compatibility
statement:
theorem twistOverlapRestrictLocalIso_mulSecond_compatibility
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) (c e : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    (h : C.twistComparisonOpen i j (c.mul e) ≤
      C.twistComparisonOpen i j e) :
    Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (C.overlap i j) h
        (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalIso d i j e).hom =
      (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalIso d i j (c.mul e)).hom
proof:
:= by
  unfold twistOverlapRestrictLocalIso
  exact restrict_overIsoOfRestrictIso_hom h
    (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeIso d i j e)
    (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeIso d i j (c.mul e))
    (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeIso_mulSecond_naturality
      d i j c e h)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistOverlapRestrictMulRestrictionCompatibility
statement:
theorem canonicalTwistOverlapRestrictMulRestrictionCompatibility
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) :
    C.TwistOverlapRestrictMulRestrictionCompatibility d i j
proof:
:= by
  intro c e
  exact ⟨
    C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalIso_mulFirst_compatibility d i j c e
      (show C.twistComparisonOpen i j (c.mul e) ≤
        C.twistComparisonOpen i j c by
        change ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f (c.mul e)).opensRange ≤
          ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c).opensRange
        rw [C.basicOpenOverlapCover_mul_opensRange i j c e]
        exact inf_le_left),
    C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalIso_mulSecond_compatibility d i j c e
      (show C.twistComparisonOpen i j (c.mul e) ≤
        C.twistComparisonOpen i j e by
        change ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f (c.mul e)).opensRange ≤
          ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f e).opensRange
        rw [C.basicOpenOverlapCover_mul_opensRange i j c e]
        exact inf_le_right)⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistOverlapRestrictLocalRestrictionIndependence_of_mul
statement:
theorem twistOverlapRestrictLocalRestrictionIndependence_of_mul
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I)
    (h : C.TwistOverlapRestrictMulRestrictionCompatibility d i j) :
    C.TwistOverlapRestrictLocalRestrictionIndependence d i j
proof:
:= by
  intro c e V hVc hVe
  let W := C.twistComparisonOpen i j (c.mul e)
  have hWc : W ≤ C.twistComparisonOpen i j c := by
    dsimp only [W, twistComparisonOpen]
    rw [C.basicOpenOverlapCover_mul_opensRange i j c e]
    exact inf_le_left
  have hWe : W ≤ C.twistComparisonOpen i j e := by
    dsimp only [W, twistComparisonOpen]
    rw [C.basicOpenOverlapCover_mul_opensRange i j c e]
    exact inf_le_right
  have hVW : V ≤ W := by
    dsimp only [W, twistComparisonOpen]
    rw [C.basicOpenOverlapCover_mul_opensRange i j c e]
    exact le_inf hVc hVe
  have hc := (h c e).1
  have he := (h c e).2
  change
    Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (C.overlap i j) hVc
        (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalIso d i j c).hom =
      Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (C.overlap i j) hVe
        (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalIso d i j e).hom
  calc
    Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (C.overlap i j) hVc
        (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalIso d i j c).hom =
      Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (C.overlap i j) hVW
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (C.overlap i j) hWc
          (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalIso d i j c).hom) := by
            rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_trans]
    _ = Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (C.overlap i j) hVW
        (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalIso d i j (c.mul e)).hom :=
      congrArg
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (C.overlap i j) hVW) hc
    _ = Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (C.overlap i j) hVW
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (C.overlap i j) hWe
          (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalIso d i j e).hom) :=
      congrArg
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (C.overlap i j) hVW) he.symm
    _ = Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (C.overlap i j) hVe
        (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalIso d i j e).hom := by
            rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_trans]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistOverlapRestrictLocalHom_compatible
statement:
theorem twistOverlapRestrictLocalHom_compatible
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I)
    (h : C.TwistOverlapRestrictLocalRestrictionIndependence d i j) :
    Presheaf.FamilyOfElementsOnObjects.IsCompatible
      (fun c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j ↦
        Scheme.Modules.localHomSection (C.overlap i j)
          (C.twistComparisonOpen i j c)
          (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalIso d i j c).hom)
proof:
:= by
  intro V c e f g
  have hVc : V ≤ C.twistComparisonOpen i j c := f.le
  have hVe : V ≤ C.twistComparisonOpen i j e := g.le
  rw [show f = homOfLE hVc from Subsingleton.elim _ _,
    show g = homOfLE hVe from Subsingleton.elim _ _,
    Scheme.Modules.sheafHom_map_localHomSection,
    Scheme.Modules.sheafHom_map_localHomSection]
  change (SheafOfModules.toSheaf
      ((C.overlap i j).ringCatSheaf.over V)).map
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (C.overlap i j) hVc
          (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalIso d i j c).hom) =
    (SheafOfModules.toSheaf
      ((C.overlap i j).ringCatSheaf.over V)).map
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (C.overlap i j) hVe
          (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalIso d i j e).hom)
  exact congrArg
    (SheafOfModules.toSheaf
      ((C.overlap i j).ringCatSheaf.over V)).map
    (h c e hVc hVe)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistOverlapRestrictHomOfLocalCompatibility_over
statement:
theorem twistOverlapRestrictHomOfLocalCompatibility_over
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I)
    (h : C.TwistOverlapRestrictLocalRestrictionIndependence d i j)
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (C.twistOverlapRestrictHomOfLocalCompatibility d i j h).over
        (C.twistComparisonOpen i j c) =
      (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalIso d i j c).hom
proof:
:=
  Scheme.Modules.glueHom_over (C.overlap i j)
    (fun e : C.CommonBasicOpen i j ↦
      C.twistComparisonOpen i j e)
    (C.twistComparisonOpen_coversTop i j)
    (fun e : C.CommonBasicOpen i j ↦
      (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalIso d i j e).hom)
    (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalHom_compatible d i j h) c

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistOverlapRestrictHomOfLocalCompatibility_restrict
statement:
theorem twistOverlapRestrictHomOfLocalCompatibility_restrict
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I)
    (h : C.TwistOverlapRestrictLocalRestrictionIndependence d i j)
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
        (C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι).map
          (C.twistOverlapRestrictHomOfLocalCompatibility d i j h) =
      (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeIso d i j c).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply restrictFunctor_map_eq_of_over_eq_overIsoOfRestrictIso
  simpa only [twistOverlapRestrictLocalIso] using
    C.twistOverlapRestrictHomOfLocalCompatibility_over d i j h c

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistOverlapRestrictHomOfLocalCompatibility_isIso
statement:
theorem twistOverlapRestrictHomOfLocalCompatibility_isIso
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I)
    (h : C.TwistOverlapRestrictLocalRestrictionIndependence d i j) :
    IsIso (C.twistOverlapRestrictHomOfLocalCompatibility d i j h)
proof:
:=
  Scheme.Modules.glueHom_isIso (C.overlap i j)
    (fun c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j ↦
      C.twistComparisonOpen i j c)
    (C.twistComparisonOpen_coversTop i j)
    (fun c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j ↦
      (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalIso d i j c).hom)
    (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalHom_compatible d i j h)
    (fun _ ↦ inferInstance)

proof:
:=
  twistingSheafRestrictionCompIso.congr_simp Dq Dq' hDq Dr Dr' hDr

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateRestriction_C
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinateRestriction_C (r : R) :
    coordinateRestriction R n (MvPolynomial.C r) = MvPolynomial.C r
proof:
:= by
  simp [coordinateRestriction]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateRestriction_X_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinateRestriction_X_zero :
    coordinateRestriction R n (MvPolynomial.X 0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [coordinateRestriction]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateRestriction_X_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinateRestriction_X_succ (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateRestriction R n (MvPolynomial.X i.succ) = MvPolynomial.X i
proof:
:= by
  simp [coordinateRestriction]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateRestriction_rename
statement:
theorem coordinateRestriction_rename (p : Polynomial R n) :
    coordinateRestriction R n (MvPolynomial.rename Fin.succ p) = p
proof:
:= by
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C r => simp
  | add p q hp hq => simp [hp, hq]
  | mul_X p i hp => simp [hp]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateRestriction_degree_surjective
statement:
theorem coordinateRestriction_degree_surjective (d : ℕ) (p : Polynomial R n)
    (hp : p ∈ grading R n d) :
    ∃ a ∈ grading R (n + 1) d, coordinateRestrictionGraded R n a = p
proof:
:=
  ⟨MvPolynomial.rename Fin.succ p, hp.rename_isHomogeneous,
    coordinateRestriction_rename R n p⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateRestriction_irrelevant_le
statement:
theorem coordinateRestriction_irrelevant_le :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading R n) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading R (n + 1))).map
        (coordinateRestrictionGraded R n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le]
  intro d hd p hp
  obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := coordinateRestriction_degree_surjective R n d p hp
  exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (coordinateRestrictionGraded R n)
    (HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem (grading R (n + 1)) hd ha)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateRestriction_away_surjective
statement:
theorem coordinateRestriction_away_surjective {d : ℕ} (s : Polynomial R (n + 1))
    (hs : s ∈ grading R (n + 1) d) :
    Function.Surjective (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map
      (coordinateRestrictionGraded R n) s)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨m, p, hp, rfl⟩ := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_surjective
    (grading R n) ((coordinateRestrictionGraded R n).map_mem hs) z
  obtain ⟨a, ha, h⟩ := coordinateRestriction_degree_surjective R n _ p hp
  subst p
  refine ⟨HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading R (n + 1)) hs m a ha, ?_⟩
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map_mk]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateHyperplane_isPullback_away
statement:
theorem coordinateHyperplane_isPullback_away {d : ℕ} (s : Polynomial R (n + 1))
    (hs : s ∈ grading R (n + 1) d) (hd : 0 < d) :
    IsPullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map (coordinateRestrictionGraded R n) s)))
      (Proj.awayι (grading R n) (coordinateRestrictionGraded R n s)
        ((coordinateRestrictionGraded R n).map_mem hs) hd)
      (Proj.awayι (grading R (n + 1)) s hs hd)
      (coordinateHyperplaneι R n)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsOpenImmersion.isPullback
  · exact Proj.awayι_comp_map (coordinateRestrictionGraded R n)
      (coordinateRestriction_irrelevant_le R n) hd s hs
  · simpa only [Proj.opensRange_awayι, coordinateHyperplaneι] using
      (Proj.map_preimage_basicOpen (coordinateRestrictionGraded R n)
        (coordinateRestriction_irrelevant_le R n) s)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateRestriction_surjective
statement: theorem coordinateRestriction_surjective : Function.Surjective (coordinateRestrictionGraded R n)
proof:
:=
  fun p => ⟨MvPolynomial.rename Fin.succ p, coordinateRestriction_rename R n p⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateRestriction_sub_rename_mem
proof:
:= by
  let I : Ideal (Polynomial R (n + 1)) := Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.X 0}
  change _ ∈ I
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C r => simp
  | add p q hp hq =>
      simpa only [map_add, add_sub_add_comm] using I.add_mem hp hq
  | mul_X p i hp =>
      induction i using Fin.cases with
      | zero =>
          simp only [map_mul, coordinateRestriction_X_zero, mul_zero, map_zero, sub_zero]
          exact I.mul_mem_left p (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton _))
      | succ j =>
          simp only [map_mul, coordinateRestriction_X_succ, MvPolynomial.rename_X]
          rw [← sub_mul]
          exact I.mul_mem_right _ hp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateRestriction_ker
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro p hp
    have h := coordinateRestriction_sub_rename_mem R n p
    have hz : coordinateRestriction R n p = 0 := hp
    simpa only [hz, map_zero, sub_zero] using h
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro p (rfl : p = MvPolynomial.X 0)
    exact coordinateRestriction_X_zero R n

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.mem_range_coordinateHyperplane_iff
statement:
theorem mem_range_coordinateHyperplane_iff (x : space R (n + 1)) :
    x ∈ Set.range (coordinateHyperplaneι R n) ↔
      MvPolynomial.X (R := R) (0 : Fin (n + 2)) ∈ x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal
proof:
:= by
  let q := coordinateRestrictionGraded R n
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    change q (MvPolynomial.X 0) ∈ y.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal
    change coordinateRestriction R n (MvPolynomial.X 0) ∈ _
    rw [coordinateRestriction_X_zero]
    exact Ideal.zero_mem _
  · intro hx
    have hker : RingHom.ker q ≤ x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal := by
      rw [coordinateRestriction_ker, Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
      exact hx
    have hcmap : (x.asHomogeneousIdeal.map q).toIdeal.comap q =
        x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal := by
      rw [HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_map,
        Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ (coordinateRestriction_surjective R n),
        ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, sup_eq_left.mpr hker]
    let y : space R n :=
      { asHomogeneousIdeal := x.asHomogeneousIdeal.map q
        isPrime := Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective (coordinateRestriction_surjective R n) hker
        not_irrelevant_le := by
          intro hirr
          apply x.not_irrelevant_le
          rw [HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le]
          intro d hd a ha
          have hqa : q a ∈ HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading R n) :=
            HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem (grading R n) hd (q.map_mem ha)
          have hqmap : q a ∈ (x.asHomogeneousIdeal.map q).toIdeal := hirr hqa
          change a ∈ x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal
          rw [← hcmap]
          exact hqmap }
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    apply ProjectiveSpectrum.ext
    exact HomogeneousIdeal.ext hcmap

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.blowup_in_class
statement:
theorem blowup_in_class (hI : BlowupIntegral.{u}) (hR : BlowupRees k) (B : Scheme.{u})
    (π : B ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) [IsIntegral B]
    (hB : ∃ (N : ℕ) (j : B ⟶ space k N), IsClosedImmersion j ∧ j ≫ toSpec k N = π)
    (I : B.IdealSheafData) (hne : I ≠ ⊥) :
    IsIntegral (GlobalBlowup.blowup B I) ∧
      ∃ (N : ℕ) (j : GlobalBlowup.blowup B I ⟶ space k N), IsClosedImmersion j ∧
        j ≫ toSpec k N = GlobalBlowup.toBase B I ≫ π
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, φ, hφ, hφf⟩ := hR B π hB I hne
  obtain ⟨M, s, hs, hsk⟩ := exists_closedImmersion_prod_over π hB m
  haveI := hφ
  haveI := hs
  refine ⟨hI B I hne, M, φ ≫ s, inferInstance, ?_⟩
  rw [Category.assoc, hsk, ← Category.assoc, hφf]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_rankOne_generator_not_mem
statement:
theorem rankTwo_rankOne_generator_not_mem (x : space R R) :
    symGen R ∉ x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal
proof:
:= by
  intro hx
  apply x.not_irrelevant_le
  intro a ha
  apply (Ideal.span_le.mpr (by
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact hx) : Ideal.span (Set.range fun _ : Unit ↦ symGen R) ≤ x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal)
  exact irrelevant_le_span_symGen R ha

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_localSection_closed

theorem rankTwo_localSection_closed (φ : M →ₗ[R] R)
    (hφ : Submodule.span R (Set.range φ) = ⊤) : IsClosedImmersion (localSection φ hφ)
proof:
:= by
  let p := Proj.toSpecZero (symGrading R M) ≫
    Spec.map (degreeZeroAlgEquiv (R := R) (M := M)).symm.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.hom

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_projection_images_disjoint
statement:
theorem rankTwo_projection_images_disjoint (φ ψ : M →ₗ[R] R)
    (hφ : Submodule.span R (Set.range φ) = ⊤)
    (hψ : Submodule.span R (Set.range ψ) = ⊤)
    (m : M) (hφm : φ m = 1) (hψm : ψ m = 0) :
    Disjoint (Set.range (symmetricProjMap φ hφ)) (Set.range (symmetricProjMap ψ hψ))
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩
  have hx : SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M m ∉ (symmetricProjMap φ hφ x).asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal := by
    change symmetricAlgebraMap φ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M m) ∉ x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal
    rw [symmetricAlgebraMap_ι, hφm]
    exact rankTwo_rankOne_generator_not_mem R x
  apply hx
  rw [← hy]
  change symmetricAlgebraMap ψ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M m) ∈ y.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal
  rw [symmetricAlgebraMap_ι, hψm, map_zero]
  exact y.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal.zero_mem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_globalSections_disjoint
statement:
theorem rankTwo_globalSections_disjoint :
    Disjoint (Set.range (rankTwo_globalLeftSection C))
      (Set.range (rankTwo_globalRightSection C))
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩
  have hxy : y = x := by
    have h := congrArg C.toBase hy
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply,
      rankTwo_globalLeftSection_toBase, rankTwo_globalRightSection_toBase] at h
    exact h
  subst y
  obtain ⟨i, z, hz⟩ := C.baseCover.exists_eq x
  subst x
  let q : tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X := biprod.fst
  let r : tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X := biprod.snd
  let hq := surjective_app_of_split q biprod.inl biprod.inl_fst
  let hr := surjective_app_of_split r biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd
  let φ := AffineFrameCover.quotientSectionMap q (C.U i)
  let ψ := AffineFrameCover.quotientSectionMap r (C.U i)
  let m := (biprod.inl : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.app
    (op (C.U i)) (1 : Γ(X, C.U i))
  have hmφ : φ m = 1 := by
    change ((biprod.inl ≫ biprod.fst : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.app
      (op (C.U i))) (1 : Γ(X, C.U i)) = (1 : Γ(X, C.U i))
    rw [biprod.inl_fst]
    rfl
  have hmψ : ψ m = 0 := by
    change ((biprod.inl ≫ biprod.snd : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.app
      (op (C.U i))) (1 : Γ(X, C.U i)) = 0
    rw [biprod.inl_snd]
    rfl
  have hdis := rankTwo_projection_images_disjoint φ ψ
    (AffineFrameCover.quotientSectionMap_spans q hq _) (AffineFrameCover.quotientSectionMap_spans r hr _) m hmφ hmψ
  have hqz := congrArg (fun f : (C.U i).toScheme ⟶ C.scheme ↦ f z)
    (C.baseCover_quotientSection q hq i)
  have hrz := congrArg (fun f : (C.U i).toScheme ⟶ C.scheme ↦ f z)
    (C.baseCover_quotientSection r hr i)
  have heq := (C.chartι i).isOpenEmbedding.injective (hqz.symm.trans (hy.symm.trans hrz))
  have hqmem : C.chartSection q hq i z ∈ Set.range
      (symmetricProjMap φ (AffineFrameCover.quotientSectionMap_spans q hq _)) :=
    ⟨inv (rankOneToSpec Γ(X, C.U i)) ((C.isAffine i).isoSpec.hom z), rfl⟩
  have hrmem : C.chartSection q hq i z ∈ Set.range
      (symmetricProjMap ψ (AffineFrameCover.quotientSectionMap_spans r hr _)) :=
    ⟨inv (rankOneToSpec Γ(X, C.U i)) ((C.isAffine i).isoSpec.hom z), heq.symm⟩
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdis hqmem hrmem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_fst_symmetric_kernel
proof:
:= by
  let I : Ideal (SymmetricAlgebra R (R × R)) := Ideal.span {SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (R × R) (0, 1)}
  let π := Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I
  let f : SymmetricAlgebra R (R × R) →ₐ[R] SymmetricAlgebra R R :=
    SymmetricAlgebra.lift (symmetricGeneratorLinearMap (S := R) (LinearMap.fst R R R))
  let j : R →ₗ[R] SymmetricAlgebra R (R × R) :=
    (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (R × R)).comp (LinearMap.inl R R R)
  let h : SymmetricAlgebra R R →ₐ[R] (SymmetricAlgebra R (R × R)) ⧸ I :=
    SymmetricAlgebra.lift (π.toLinearMap.comp j)
  have hk : π (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (R × R) (0, 1)) = 0 :=
    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton _))
  have he : π = h.comp f := by
    apply SymmetricAlgebra.algHom_ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    rcases x with ⟨a, b⟩
    change π (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (R × R) (a, b)) =
      h (f (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (R × R) (a, b)))
    have hv : SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (R × R) (a, b) =
        SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (R × R) (a, 0) + b • SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (R × R) (0, 1) := by
      rw [← map_smul, ← map_add]
      congr 1
      ext <;> simp
    conv_lhs => rw [hv, map_add, map_smul, hk, smul_zero, add_zero]
    have hfgen : f (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (R × R) (a, b)) =
        SymmetricAlgebra.ι R R a := SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply _ _
    have hhgen : h (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R R a) =
        π (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (R × R) (a, 0)) := SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply _ _
    rw [hfgen, hhgen]
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro a ha
    change f a = 0 at ha
    change a ∈ I
    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp
    change π a = 0
    rw [he, AlgHom.comp_apply, ha, map_zero]
  · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    rintro a rfl
    change f (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (R × R) (0, 1)) = 0
    rw [SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply]
    change SymmetricAlgebra.ι R R 0 = 0
    exact map_zero _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_snd_symmetric_kernel
proof:
:= by
  let I : Ideal (SymmetricAlgebra R (R × R)) := Ideal.span {SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (R × R) (1, 0)}
  let π := Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I
  let f : SymmetricAlgebra R (R × R) →ₐ[R] SymmetricAlgebra R R :=
    SymmetricAlgebra.lift (symmetricGeneratorLinearMap (S := R) (LinearMap.snd R R R))
  let j : R →ₗ[R] SymmetricAlgebra R (R × R) :=
    (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (R × R)).comp (LinearMap.inr R R R)
  let h : SymmetricAlgebra R R →ₐ[R] (SymmetricAlgebra R (R × R)) ⧸ I :=
    SymmetricAlgebra.lift (π.toLinearMap.comp j)
  have hk : π (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (R × R) (1, 0)) = 0 :=
    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton _))
  have he : π = h.comp f := by
    apply SymmetricAlgebra.algHom_ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    rcases x with ⟨a, b⟩
    change π (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (R × R) (a, b)) =
      h (f (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (R × R) (a, b)))
    have hv : SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (R × R) (a, b) =
        SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (R × R) (0, b) + a • SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (R × R) (1, 0) := by
      rw [← map_smul, ← map_add]
      congr 1
      ext <;> simp
    conv_lhs => rw [hv, map_add, map_smul, hk, smul_zero, add_zero]
    have hfgen : f (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (R × R) (a, b)) =
        SymmetricAlgebra.ι R R b := SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply _ _
    have hhgen : h (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R R b) =
        π (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (R × R) (0, b)) := SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply _ _
    rw [hfgen, hhgen]
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro a ha
    change f a = 0 at ha
    change a ∈ I
    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp
    change π a = 0
    rw [he, AlgHom.comp_apply, ha, map_zero]
  · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    rintro a rfl
    change f (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (R × R) (1, 0)) = 0
    rw [SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply]
    change SymmetricAlgebra.ι R R 0 = 0
    exact map_zero _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D35.prodMap_fst
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem prodMap_fst (j : X ⟶ Z) (a : Z ⟶ Y) (b : W ⟶ Y) :
    prodMap j a b ≫ pullback.fst _ _ = pullback.fst _ _ ≫ j
proof:
:= by
  unfold prodMap pullback.map
  simp only [Category.comp_id]
  exact pullback.lift_fst _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D35.prodMap_snd
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem prodMap_snd (j : X ⟶ Z) (a : Z ⟶ Y) (b : W ⟶ Y) :
    prodMap j a b ≫ pullback.snd _ _ = pullback.snd _ _
proof:
:= by
  unfold prodMap pullback.map

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D35.prodMap_isPullback
statement:
theorem prodMap_isPullback (j : X ⟶ Z) (a : Z ⟶ Y) (b : W ⟶ Y) :
    IsPullback (prodMap j a b) (pullback.fst _ _) (pullback.fst _ _) j
proof:
:= by
  have hR : IsPullback (pullback.snd a b) (pullback.fst a b) b a :=
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback a b).flip
  refine (IsPullback.paste_horiz_iff hR (prodMap_fst j a b)).mp ?_
  rw [prodMap_snd]
  exact (IsPullback.of_hasPullback (j ≫ a) b).flip

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D35.exists_closedImmersion_X_prod
statement:
theorem exists_closedImmersion_X_prod {n : ℕ} (eJ : J ≃ Fin (n + 1)) (g : X ⟶ Yk k)
    {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E) (C' : AffineFrameCover X (FreeM X J))
    (f : C.scheme ⟶ C'.scheme) [IsClosedImmersion f] (hf : f ≫ C'.toBase = C.toBase) :
    ∃ ι : C.scheme ⟶ pullback g (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k n),
      IsClosedImmersion ι ∧ ι ≫ pullback.fst _ _ = C.toBase
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨f ≫ (freeBundleIso eJ g C').hom, ?_, ?_⟩
  · haveI : IsIso (freeBundleIso eJ g C').hom := inferInstance
    infer_instance
  · rw [Category.assoc, freeBundleIso_hom_fst, hf]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D35.exists_closedImmersion_proj_prod
statement:
theorem exists_closedImmersion_proj_prod {N n : ℕ} (eJ : J ≃ Fin (n + 1))
    (j : X ⟶ SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k N) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E) (C' : AffineFrameCover X (FreeM X J))
    (f : C.scheme ⟶ C'.scheme) [IsClosedImmersion f] (hf : f ≫ C'.toBase = C.toBase) :
    ∃ ι : C.scheme ⟶ pullback (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k N)
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k n),
      IsClosedImmersion ι ∧ ι ≫ pullback.fst _ _ = C.toBase ≫ j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ι, hι, h⟩ := exists_closedImmersion_X_prod eJ (j ≫ SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k N) C
      C' f hf
  refine ⟨ι ≫ prodMap j (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k N) (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k n),
    ?_, ?_⟩
  · haveI := hι
    infer_instance
  · rw [Category.assoc, prodMap_fst, ← Category.assoc, h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D35.exists_closedImmersion_twist_into_product
statement:
theorem exists_closedImmersion_twist_into_product {k : Type u} [CommRing k] [IsNoetherianRing k]
    (N : ℕ) {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (j : X ⟶ space k N) [IsClosedImmersion j] (E : X.Modules) (r : ℕ)
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    ∃ (D : ℕ) (J : Type u) (_ : Fintype J)
      (C : AffineFrameCover X
        (tensorSheaf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (D : ℤ))) E)),
      Nonempty J → ∃ (n : ℕ) (ι : C.scheme ⟶ pullback (toSpec k N) (toSpec k n)),
        IsClosedImmersion ι ∧ ι ≫ pullback.fst _ _ = C.toBase ≫ j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, J, hJ, C, C', f, hf1, hf2⟩ := D31.exists_closedImmersion_twist_into_free N j E r hE
  refine ⟨D, J, hJ, C, fun hne => ?_⟩
  have hpos : 0 < Fintype.card J := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr hne
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, Fintype.card J = n + 1 := ⟨Fintype.card J - 1, by omega⟩
  exact ⟨n, exists_closedImmersion_proj_prod (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq hn) j C C' f hf2⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.surjectiveWordModuleDifferential_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem surjectiveWordModuleDifferential_apply
    (m p : ℕ) (c : surjectiveWordModuleCochain A m p)
    (a : {a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin m // Function.Surjective a}) :
    surjectiveWordModuleDifferential R A m p c a =
      ∑ r : Fin (p + 2), (-1 : R) ^ r.val •
        if h : Function.Surjective (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove) then
          c ⟨a.1 ∘ r.succAbove, h⟩
        else 0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.squareZero_negOnePow_mul_inr
proof:
:= by
  have hpow :
      (-1 : squareZeroRing R A) ^ r =
        TrivSqZeroExt.inl ((-1 : R) ^ r) := by
    rw [← TrivSqZeroExt.inl_one A, ← TrivSqZeroExt.inl_neg,
      TrivSqZeroExt.inl_pow]
  rw [hpow, TrivSqZeroExt.inl_mul_inr]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.squareZero_snd_negOnePow_mul
statement:
private theorem squareZero_snd_negOnePow_mul (r : ℕ)
    (x : squareZeroRing R A) :
    TrivSqZeroExt.snd ((-1 : squareZeroRing R A) ^ r * x) =
      (-1 : R) ^ r • TrivSqZeroExt.snd x
proof:
:= by
  have hpow :
      (-1 : squareZeroRing R A) ^ r =
        TrivSqZeroExt.inl ((-1 : R) ^ r) := by
    rw [← TrivSqZeroExt.inl_one A, ← TrivSqZeroExt.inl_neg,
      TrivSqZeroExt.inl_pow]
  rw [hpow]
  simp [TrivSqZeroExt.snd_mul]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.surjectiveWordModuleDifferential_inr
statement:
private theorem surjectiveWordModuleDifferential_inr
    (m p : ℕ) (c : surjectiveWordModuleCochain A m p) :
    surjectiveWordDifferential (squareZeroRing R A) m p
        (surjectiveWordModuleInr R A m p c) =
      surjectiveWordModuleInr R A m (p + 1)
        (surjectiveWordModuleDifferential R A m p c)
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  rw [surjectiveWordDifferential_apply]
  change
    (∑ r : Fin (p + 2), (-1 : squareZeroRing R A) ^ r.val *
      if h : Function.Surjective (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove) then
        TrivSqZeroExt.inr (c ⟨a.1 ∘ r.succAbove, h⟩)
      else 0) =
    TrivSqZeroExt.inr
      (surjectiveWordModuleDifferential R A m p c a)
  rw [surjectiveWordModuleDifferential_apply]
  rw [show TrivSqZeroExt.inr
      (∑ r : Fin (p + 2), (-1 : R) ^ r.val •
        if h : Function.Surjective (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove) then
          c ⟨a.1 ∘ r.succAbove, h⟩
        else 0) =
      ∑ r : Fin (p + 2), TrivSqZeroExt.inr
        ((-1 : R) ^ r.val •
          if h : Function.Surjective (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove) then
            c ⟨a.1 ∘ r.succAbove, h⟩
          else 0) by
        exact TrivSqZeroExt.inr_sum R Finset.univ _]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  by_cases h : Function.Surjective (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove)
  · simp only [h, dif_pos]
    exact squareZero_negOnePow_mul_inr R A r.val _
  · simp [h]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.surjectiveWordModuleDifferential_snd
statement:
private theorem surjectiveWordModuleDifferential_snd
    (m p : ℕ) (c : surjectiveWordCochain (squareZeroRing R A) m p) :
    surjectiveWordModuleDifferential R A m p
        (surjectiveWordModuleSnd R A m p c) =
      surjectiveWordModuleSnd R A m (p + 1)
        (surjectiveWordDifferential (squareZeroRing R A) m p c)
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  rw [surjectiveWordModuleDifferential_apply]
  change
    (∑ r : Fin (p + 2), (-1 : R) ^ r.val •
      if h : Function.Surjective (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove) then
        TrivSqZeroExt.snd (c ⟨a.1 ∘ r.succAbove, h⟩)
      else 0) =
    TrivSqZeroExt.snd
      (surjectiveWordDifferential (squareZeroRing R A) m p c a)
  rw [surjectiveWordDifferential_apply]
  change
    (∑ r : Fin (p + 2), (-1 : R) ^ r.val •
      if h : Function.Surjective (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove) then
        TrivSqZeroExt.snd (c ⟨a.1 ∘ r.succAbove, h⟩)
      else 0) =
    (TrivSqZeroExt.sndHom R A)
      (∑ r : Fin (p + 2), (-1 : squareZeroRing R A) ^ r.val *
        if h : Function.Surjective (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove) then
          c ⟨a.1 ∘ r.succAbove, h⟩
        else 0)
  rw [_root_.map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  by_cases h : Function.Surjective (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove)
  · simp only [h, dif_pos, TrivSqZeroExt.sndHom_apply]
    exact (squareZero_snd_negOnePow_mul R A r.val _).symm
  · simp [h]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.surjectiveWordModule_cocycle_is_boundary
statement:
theorem surjectiveWordModule_cocycle_is_boundary
    (m p : ℕ) (hmp : m ≤ p + 1)
    (c : surjectiveWordModuleCochain A m (p + 1))
    (hc : surjectiveWordModuleDifferential R A m (p + 1) c = 0) :
    ∃ b : surjectiveWordModuleCochain A m p,
      surjectiveWordModuleDifferential R A m p b = c
proof:
:= by
  let T := squareZeroRing R A
  letI : Module.Finite R T := by
    change Module.Finite R (R × A)
    infer_instance
  letI : IsNoetherianRing T := IsNoetherianRing.of_finite R T
  let cT : surjectiveWordCochain T m (p + 1) :=
    surjectiveWordModuleInr R A m (p + 1) c
  have hcT : surjectiveWordDifferential T m (p + 1) cT = 0 := by
    dsimp only [cT]
    rw [surjectiveWordModuleDifferential_inr, hc]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨bT, hbT⟩ :=
    surjectiveWord_cocycle_is_boundary T m p hmp cT hcT
  let b : surjectiveWordModuleCochain A m p :=
    surjectiveWordModuleSnd R A m p bT
  refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
  dsimp only [b]
  rw [surjectiveWordModuleDifferential_snd, hbT]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.surjectiveWordAddCommGroup_cocycle_is_boundary
statement:
theorem surjectiveWordAddCommGroup_cocycle_is_boundary
    (m p : ℕ) (hmp : m ≤ p + 1)
    (c : surjectiveWordModuleCochain B m (p + 1))
    (hc : surjectiveWordModuleDifferential ℤ B m (p + 1) c = 0) :
    ∃ b : surjectiveWordModuleCochain B m p,
      surjectiveWordModuleDifferential ℤ B m p b = c
proof:
:= by
  let S : Submodule ℤ B := Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range c)
  letI : Module.Finite ℤ S :=
    Module.Finite.span_of_finite ℤ (Set.finite_range c)
  let cS : surjectiveWordModuleCochain S m (p + 1) :=
    fun a ↦ ⟨c a, Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self a)⟩
  have hcS :
      surjectiveWordModuleDifferential ℤ S m (p + 1) cS = 0 := by
    funext a
    apply Subtype.ext
    have ha := congrFun hc a
    rw [surjectiveWordModuleDifferential_apply]
    simp only [Submodule.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply, Submodule.coe_sum,
      Submodule.coe_smul_of_tower]
    rw [surjectiveWordModuleDifferential_apply] at ha
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at ha
    convert ha using 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro r _
    by_cases h : Function.Surjective (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove) <;>
      simp [h, cS]
  obtain ⟨bS, hbS⟩ :=
    surjectiveWordModule_cocycle_is_boundary ℤ S m p hmp cS hcS
  let b : surjectiveWordModuleCochain B m p :=
    fun a ↦ (bS a).1
  refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
  funext a
  have ha := congrArg Subtype.val (congrFun hbS a)
  rw [surjectiveWordModuleDifferential_apply]
  rw [surjectiveWordModuleDifferential_apply] at ha
  simp only [Submodule.coe_sum, Submodule.coe_smul_of_tower] at ha
  convert ha using 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  by_cases h : Function.Surjective (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove) <;>
    simp [h, b]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K7.segreClosedImmersionStatement
statement:
theorem segreClosedImmersionStatement (k : Type u) [Field k] :

proof:
:= by
  intro N n
  have h : (N + 1) * (n + 1) = ((N + 1) * (n + 1) - 1) + 1 := by
    have : 0 < (N + 1) * (n + 1) := Nat.mul_pos (Nat.succ_pos _) (Nat.succ_pos _)

  let e : Fin (N + 1) × Fin (n + 1) ≃ Fin (((N + 1) * (n + 1) - 1) + 1) :=
    finProdFinEquiv.trans (finCongr h)
  exact ⟨(N + 1) * (n + 1) - 1, SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.segreHom (k := k) e,
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD38.segreHom_isClosedImmersion e⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.affineZeroStructureRingIso_restriction
statement:
theorem affineZeroStructureRingIso_restriction (I : X.IdealSheafData)
    (h : IsCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ I) (U V : X.affineOpens) (hVU : V.1 ≤ U.1) :
    I.subscheme.presheaf.map ((TopologicalSpace.Opens.map I.subschemeι.base).map (homOfLE hVU)).op ≫
        (affineZeroStructureRingIso X E σ I h V).hom =
      (affineZeroStructureRingIso X E σ I h U).hom ≫
        CommRingCat.ofHom (affineCosectionZeroRingRestriction X E σ I h U V hVU)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Epi (I.subschemeι.app U) :=
    ConcreteCategory.epi_of_surjective _ (I.subschemeι_app_surjective U)
  apply (cancel_epi (I.subschemeι.app U)).mp
  have hn := I.subschemeι.naturality (homOfLE hVU).op
  calc
    _ = (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op ≫ I.subschemeι.app V) ≫
        (affineZeroStructureRingIso X E σ I h V).hom :=
      (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
        (congrArg (fun k => k ≫ (affineZeroStructureRingIso X E σ I h V).hom) hn.symm)
    _ = X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op ≫
        CommRingCat.ofHom (cosectionZeroQuotient (affineCosection X E σ V)) :=
      (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
        (congrArg (fun k => X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op ≫ k)
          (affineZeroStructureRingIso_projection X E σ I h V))
    _ = CommRingCat.ofHom (cosectionZeroQuotient (affineCosection X E σ U)) ≫
        CommRingCat.ofHom (affineCosectionZeroRingRestriction X E σ I h U V hVU) :=
      (congrArg CommRingCat.ofHom
        (affineCosectionZeroRingRestriction_projection X E σ I h U V hVU)).symm
    _ = _ := (congrArg (fun k => k ≫
      CommRingCat.ofHom (affineCosectionZeroRingRestriction X E σ I h U V hVU))
        (affineZeroStructureRingIso_projection X E σ I h U).symm).trans
          (Category.assoc _ _ _)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistComparison_canonicalTransition
statement:
theorem transportTwistComparison_canonicalTransition (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (i j : C'.I) :
    let C
proof:
:= transport e C'
    let D := C.twistingSheafDescentData 1 (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1)
    (twistRecoveryAssembly_alongRecoveryIso C 1 i (D.left (i,j))).hom ≫
      (D.transition (i,j)).hom =
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (D.fac (i,j))).app
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)).hom ≫
      (twistRecoveryAssembly_alongRecoveryIso C 1 j (D.right (i,j))).hom := by

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistComparison_precomp
statement:
theorem transportTwistComparison_precomp (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (i j : C'.I) :
    let C
proof:
:= transport e C'
    let D := C.twistingSheafDescentData 1 (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1)
    let M := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (transportSchemeIso e C').hom).obj
      (C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    let N := C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1
    let p₁ := twistRecoveryAssembly_alongRecoveryIso C 1 i (D.left (i,j))
    let p₂ := twistRecoveryAssembly_alongRecoveryIso C 1 j (D.right (i,j))
    let α₂ := transportTwistComparisonAlongIso e C' j (D.right (i,j))
    let δA := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (D.fac (i,j))).app M
    let δB := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (D.fac (i,j))).app N
    (δA.hom ≫ α₂.hom ≫ δB.inv) ≫ (p₁.hom ≫ (D.transition (i,j)).hom) =
    (δA.hom ≫ α₂.hom ≫ δB.inv) ≫ (δB.hom ≫ p₂.hom) := by
  let C := transport e C'
  let D := C.twistingSheafDescentData 1 (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1)
  let M := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (transportSchemeIso e C').hom).obj
      (C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
  let N := C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1
  let α₂ := transportTwistComparisonAlongIso e C' j (D.right (i,j))
  let δA := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (D.fac (i,j))).app M
  let δB := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (D.fac (i,j))).app N
  exact congrArg (fun t => (δA.hom ≫ α₂.hom ≫ δB.inv) ≫ t)
    (transportTwistComparison_canonicalTransition e C' i j)

:= transport e C'
    let D := C.twistingSheafDescentData 1 (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1)
    (transportTwistComparisonFieldRecoveryIso e C' i (D.left (i,j))).hom ≫
      (D.transition (i,j)).hom =
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (D.fac (i,j))).app
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)).hom ≫
      (transportTwistComparisonFieldRecoveryIso e C' j (D.right (i,j))).hom := by
  exact transportTwistComparison_canonicalTransition e C' i j

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistComparison_fieldPrecomp
statement:
theorem transportTwistComparison_fieldPrecomp (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (i j : C'.I) :
    let C
proof:
:= transport e C'
    let D := C.twistingSheafDescentData 1 (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1)
    let M := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (transportSchemeIso e C').hom).obj
      (C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    let N := C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1
    let p₁ := transportTwistComparisonFieldRecoveryIso e C' i (D.left (i,j))
    let p₂ := transportTwistComparisonFieldRecoveryIso e C' j (D.right (i,j))
    let α₂ := transportTwistComparisonFieldAlongIso e C' j (D.right (i,j))
    let δA := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (D.fac (i,j))).app M
    let δB := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (D.fac (i,j))).app N
    (δA.hom ≫ α₂.hom ≫ δB.inv) ≫ (p₁.hom ≫ (D.transition (i,j)).hom) =
    (δA.hom ≫ α₂.hom ≫ δB.inv) ≫ (δB.hom ≫ p₂.hom) := by
  let C := transport e C'
  let D := C.twistingSheafDescentData 1 (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1)
  let M := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (transportSchemeIso e C').hom).obj
      (C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
  let N := C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1
  let α₂ := transportTwistComparisonFieldAlongIso e C' j (D.right (i,j))
  let δA := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (D.fac (i,j))).app M
  let δB := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (D.fac (i,j))).app N
  exact congrArg (fun t => (δA.hom ≫ α₂.hom ≫ δB.inv) ≫ t)
    (transportTwistComparison_fieldCanonicalTransition e C' i j)

    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (h : TransportTwistOverlapCompat e C') (i j : C'.I) :

proof:

      (D.transition (i,j)).hom =
