name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistComparisonField_transition
statement:
theorem transportTwistComparisonField_transition (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (h : TransportTwistOverlapCompat e C') (i j : C'.I) :
    let C
proof:
:= transport e C'
    let D := C.twistingSheafDescentData 1 (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1)
    let M := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (transportSchemeIso e C').hom).obj
      (C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    let N := C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1
    (transportTwistComparisonFieldAlongIso e C' i (D.left (i,j))).hom =
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (D.fac (i,j))).app M).hom ≫
      (transportTwistComparisonFieldAlongIso e C' j (D.right (i,j))).hom ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (D.fac (i,j))).app N).inv := by
  let C := transport e C'
  let D := C.twistingSheafDescentData 1 (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1)
  let p₁ := transportTwistComparisonFieldRecoveryIso e C' i (D.left (i,j))
  apply (cancel_mono (p₁.hom ≫ (D.transition (i,j)).hom)).1
  have hl := (transportTwistComparison_leftAssoc e C' i j).trans
    ((transportTwistComparison_leftPost e C' i j).trans
      (transportTwistComparison_recoveryTransition e C' h i j))
  have hr := (transportTwistComparison_fieldPrecomp e C' i j).trans
    ((transportTwistComparison_suffixAssoc e C' i j).trans
      ((transportTwistComparison_outerInverse e C' i j).trans
        (transportTwistComparison_outerRecovery e C' i j)))
  exact hl.trans hr.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistComparisonFieldAlong_hom
statement:
theorem transportTwistComparisonFieldAlong_hom (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (i : C'.I) {V : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : V ⟶ ((transport e C').twistingSheafDescentData 1
      ((transport e C').canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1)).chart i) :
    let M
proof:
:= (Scheme.Modules.pullback (transportSchemeIso e C').hom).obj
      (C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    let N := (transport e C').canonicalTwistingSheaf 1
    (transportTwistComparisonFieldAlongIso e C' i g).hom =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g ((transport e C').chartι i)).inv.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback ((transport e C').chartι i)).inv.app M ≫
          (transportTwistChartIso e C' i).hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback ((transport e C').chartι i)).hom.app N) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g ((transport e C').chartι i)).hom.app N := by
  let M := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (transportSchemeIso e C').hom).obj
      (C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
  let N := (transport e C').canonicalTwistingSheaf 1
  simp only [transportTwistComparisonFieldAlongIso, transportTwistComparisonAlongIso,
    Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.app_inv, Iso.app_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom]
  exact congrArg (fun t =>
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g ((transport e C').chartι i)).inv.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map t ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g ((transport e C').chartι i)).hom.app N)
    (transportTwistRecoveryAssembly_chartComparison_hom e C' i)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tensorOverlap_tr_pullback_normalized
statement:
theorem tensorOverlap_tr_pullback_normalized {Y Z W : Scheme.{u}}
    (s : W ⟶ Y) (q : Z ⟶ Y) (r : W ⟶ Z)
    [IsOpenImmersion s] [IsOpenImmersion q] [IsOpenImmersion r]
    (h : r ≫ q = s) {M N : Y.Modules}
    (φ : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj M ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj N) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback s).inv.app M ≫
      tensorOverlap_tr s q r h φ ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback s).hom.app N =
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr h.symm).app M).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp r q).inv.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback r).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).inv.app M ≫ φ ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).hom.app N) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp r q).hom.app N ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr h.symm).app N).inv
proof:
:= by
  have hc := tensorOverlap_tr_pullback_conjugation s q r h φ
  rw [twistRecoveryAssembly_prefixIso s q r h M,
    twistRecoveryAssembly_prefixIso s q r h N] at hc
  simpa only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.trans_inv, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.symm_inv,
    Iso.app_inv, Iso.app_hom, Category.assoc] using hc

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tensorOverlap_tr_pullback_normalized_refl
statement:
theorem tensorOverlap_tr_pullback_normalized_refl {Y Z W : Scheme.{u}}
    (q : Z ⟶ Y) (r : W ⟶ Z)
    [IsOpenImmersion q] [IsOpenImmersion r] {M N : Y.Modules}
    (φ : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj M ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj N) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (r ≫ q)).inv.app M ≫
      tensorOverlap_tr (r ≫ q) q r rfl φ ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (r ≫ q)).hom.app N =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp r q).inv.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback r).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).inv.app M ≫ φ ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).hom.app N) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp r q).hom.app N
proof:
:= by
  have hc := tensorOverlap_tr_pullback_normalized (r ≫ q) q r rfl φ
  have hm : ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (rfl : r ≫ q = r ≫ q)).app M).hom = 𝟙 _ := rfl
  have hn : ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (rfl : r ≫ q = r ≫ q)).app N).inv = 𝟙 _ := rfl
  simpa only [hm, hn, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id] using hc

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistComparison_leftRestriction
statement:
theorem transportTwistComparison_leftRestriction (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (i j : C'.I) :
    let C
proof:
:= transport e C'
    let D := C.twistingSheafDescentData 1 (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1)
    let M := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (transportSchemeIso e C').hom).obj
      (C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    let N := C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1
    let s := C.overlapToChart i j ≫ C.chartι i
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback s).inv.app M ≫
      tensorOverlap_tr s (C.chartι i) (C.overlapToChart i j) rfl
        (transportTwistChartIso e C' i).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback s).hom.app N =
    (transportTwistComparisonFieldAlongIso e C' i (D.left (i,j))).hom := by
  let C := transport e C'
  let D := C.twistingSheafDescentData 1 (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1)
  let M := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (transportSchemeIso e C').hom).obj
      (C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
  let N := C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1
  let s := C.overlapToChart i j ≫ C.chartι i
  have hc := tensorOverlap_tr_pullback_normalized_refl (C.chartι i)
    (C.overlapToChart i j) (transportTwistChartIso e C' i).hom
  exact hc.trans (transportTwistComparisonFieldAlong_hom e C' i (D.left (i,j))).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackCanonicalTwistingSheafOneHom_unique
statement:
theorem pullbackCanonicalTwistingSheafOneHom_unique
    (φ : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g)).obj
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) ⟶ (C.pullbackFrameCover g).canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    (hφ : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g)).map

      (pullbackComparisonSquareIso (C.pullbackFrameCover g).toBase g
        (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) C.toBase (C.pullbackProjectiveMap_toBase g).symm E).inv ≫
        (C.pullbackFrameCover g).tautologicalQuotient) :
    φ = C.pullbackCanonicalTwistingSheafOneHom g
proof:
:= by

    C.tautologicalQuotient)).mp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackCanonicalTwistingSheafOneIso_hom_quotient
statement:

    (pullbackComparisonSquareIso (C.pullbackFrameCover g).toBase g
      (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) C.toBase (C.pullbackProjectiveMap_toBase g).symm E).hom ≫

name: KSpecialization.affine_H_isZero
statement:
theorem affine_H_isZero (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine Y] [IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y, ⊤)]
    (M : Y.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] (q : ℕ) :
    IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb Y).obj M) (q + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  apply AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.module_H_isZero_of_pullback_inverse_iso Y.isoSpec M (q + 1)
  letI : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback Y.isoSpec.inv).obj M).IsQuasicoherent :=
    pullback_isQuasicoherent_of_isAffine _ _
  exact AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.quasicoherent_H_isZero _ q

name: KSpecialization.higher_section_isZero
statement:
theorem higher_section_isZero [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (s : X ⟶ C.scheme) [IsClosedImmersion s]
    (hs : s ≫ C.toBase = 𝟙 X) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (q : ℕ) :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification C.toBase
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward s).obj F) (q + 1))
proof:
:= by
  refine affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_isZero_of_isBasis _ _ _
    X.isBasis_affineOpens ?_
  intro U hU
  let W := C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ U
  change Subsingleton (Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb W.toScheme).obj
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward s).obj F))) (q + 1))
  let G := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (s ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj F
  have hpre : s ⁻¹ᵁ W = U := by
    simp only [W, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, hs, Scheme.Hom.id_preimage]
  have hUaff : IsAffineOpen (s ⁻¹ᵁ W) := hpre ▸ hU
  haveI : IsAffine (s ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme := hUaff
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ((s ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme, ⊤) :=
    IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩
  haveI : G.IsQuasicoherent := Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_restrictFunctor _ _
  have hz := affine_H_isZero _ G q
  haveI hG : Subsingleton (Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb _).obj G) (q + 1)) :=
    AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero hz
  have h1 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb W.toScheme).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (s ∣_ W)).obj G)) (q + 1)) :=
    @Equiv.subsingleton _ _
      (ClosedImmersionCohomology.closedImmersion_H_addEquiv (s ∣_ W) G (q + 1)).symm.toEquiv hG
  let e := restrictPushforwardIso s W F
  let E' := (Sheaf.functorH _ (q + 1)).mapIso ((Modules.toSheafAb W.toScheme).mapIso e)
  exact @Equiv.subsingleton _ _ E'.addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv.toEquiv h1

name: KSpecialization.derivedPushforward_comp_section
statement:
theorem derivedPushforward_comp_section [IsNoetherian X] {N : ℕ} (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N)
    (s : X ⟶ C.scheme) [IsClosedImmersion s] (hs : s ≫ C.toBase = 𝟙 X) :
    haveI
proof:
:= C.isNoetherian_scheme
    (projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank).comp (finitePushforward s) =
      AddMonoidHom.id (G0 X) := by
  haveI := C.isNoetherian_scheme
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _
  intro F
  have hF : ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ F = g0ClassOf X F.1 F.2 := rfl
  haveI : F.1.IsFinitePresentation := F.2
  rw [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, hF, finitePushforward_classOf,
    projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward_classOf, AddMonoidHom.id_apply]
  rw [alternatingSum, Finset.sum_range_succ', Finset.sum_eq_zero]
  · rw [zero_add, pow_zero, one_smul]
    let e : affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification C.toBase
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward s).obj F.1) 0 ≅ F.1 :=
      affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationZeroIso _ _ ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp s C.toBase).app F.1 ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr hs).app F.1 ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardId X).app F.1
    exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso _ _ _ _
      (show IsCoherentLike X (0 : X.Modules) from inferInstanceAs
        (0 : X.Modules).IsFinitePresentation) (isZero_zero _) e
  · intro q _
    have hz' : ∀ (M : X.Modules) (hM : IsCoherentLike X M), IsZero M → g0ClassOf X M hM = 0 :=
      fun M hM h => ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_isZero _ _ hM h
    rw [hz' _ _ (higher_section_isZero s hs F.1 q), smul_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.geometricChernAssign_whitney_left_zero
statement:
theorem geometricChernAssign_whitney_left_zero {A B D : X.Modules}
    (a : A ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ D) (w : a ≫ b = 0)
    (h : (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact) (hA : HasConstantRank X A 0) (n : ℕ) :
    geometricChernAssign ops cp X B n = ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n,
      geometricChernAssign ops cp X A p.1 ∘ₗ geometricChernAssign ops cp X D p.2
proof:
:= by
  letI := whitney_isIso_right_of_rank_zero a b w h hA
  have hi := geometricChernAssign_iso ops cp B (asIso b)
  rw [hi]
  simp_rw [whitney_chern_zero ops cp A hA]
  exact (whitney_delta_left (geometricChernAssign ops cp X D) n).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.geometricChernAssign_whitney_right_zero
statement:
theorem geometricChernAssign_whitney_right_zero {A B D : X.Modules}
    (a : A ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ D) (w : a ≫ b = 0)
    (h : (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact) (hD : HasConstantRank X D 0) (n : ℕ) :
    geometricChernAssign ops cp X B n = ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n,
      geometricChernAssign ops cp X A p.1 ∘ₗ geometricChernAssign ops cp X D p.2
proof:
:= by
  letI := whitney_isIso_left_of_rank_zero a b w h hD
  have hi := geometricChernAssign_iso ops cp A (asIso a)
  rw [← hi]
  simp_rw [whitney_chern_zero ops cp D hD]
  exact (whitney_delta_right (geometricChernAssign ops cp X A) n).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.whitney_rankOpen_le
statement:
theorem whitney_rankOpen_le {A B D : X.Modules}
    (a : A ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ D) (w : a ≫ b = 0)
    (h : (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact)
    (hA : IsFiniteLocallyFree X A) (hB : IsFiniteLocallyFree X B)
    (hD : IsFiniteLocallyFree X D) (r s : ℕ) :
    characteristicRankOpen A hA r ⊓ characteristicRankOpen D hD s ≤
      characteristicRankOpen B hB (r + s)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  change rankAt x B = r + s
  exact (rankAt_add x w h hA hD).trans (congrArg₂ (· + ·) hx.1 hx.2)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.whitney_commonOpen_middle_rank
statement:
theorem whitney_commonOpen_middle_rank {A B D : X.Modules}
    (a : A ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ D) (w : a ≫ b = 0)
    (h : (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact)
    (hA : IsFiniteLocallyFree X A) (hB : IsFiniteLocallyFree X B)
    (hD : IsFiniteLocallyFree X D) (r s : ℕ) :
    HasConstantRank ((characteristicRankOpen A hA r ⊓ characteristicRankOpen D hD s : X.Opens) : Scheme)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (characteristicRankOpen A hA r ⊓
        characteristicRankOpen D hD s).ι).obj B) (r + s)
proof:
:= by
  apply hasConstantRank_of_pointwise_rank
  · exact pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global _ B hB
  · intro x
    exact (rankAt_pullback _ B hB x).trans
      (whitney_rankOpen_le a b w h hA hB hD r s x.property)

name: SchemeKTheory.exists_quot_ses_E9
statement:
theorem exists_quot_ses_E9 {F A L B D : C}
    (f : F ⟶ A) (g : A ⟶ L) (wfg : f ≫ g = 0) (hfg : (ShortComplex.mk f g wfg).ShortExact)
    (a : A ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ D) (wab : a ≫ b = 0) (hab : (ShortComplex.mk a b wab).ShortExact) :
    ∃ (B' : C) (u : F ⟶ B) (v : B ⟶ B') (wuv : u ≫ v = 0) (L' D' : C) (p : L' ⟶ B')
      (q : B' ⟶ D') (wpq : p ≫ q = 0),
      (ShortComplex.mk u v wuv).ShortExact ∧ (ShortComplex.mk p q wpq).ShortExact ∧
        Nonempty (L' ≅ L) ∧ Nonempty (D' ≅ D)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Mono f := hfg.mono_f
  haveI : Mono a := hab.mono_f
  let S := kernelCokernelCompSequence.snakeInput f a
  refine ⟨cokernel (f ≫ a), f ≫ a, cokernel.π (f ≫ a), cokernel.condition _,
    cokernel f, cokernel a, S.L₃.f, S.L₃.g, S.L₃.zero, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk' (ShortComplex.exact_of_g_is_cokernel _ (cokernelIsCokernel _))
      inferInstance inferInstance
  · have hz : IsZero S.L₀.X₃ := isZero_kernel_of_mono a
    have hδ : S.δ = 0 := hz.eq_of_src _ _
    have hm : Mono S.L₃.f := S.L₂'_exact.mono_g hδ
    have h2 : Epi S.L₂.g := by
      change Epi (biprod.snd : A ⊞ B ⟶ B)
      infer_instance
    have h3 : Epi S.L₃.g := S.epi_L₃_g
    exact ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk' S.L₃_exact hm h3
  · exact ⟨IsColimit.coconePointUniqueUpToIso (colimit.isColimit _) hfg.gIsCokernel⟩
  · exact ⟨IsColimit.coconePointUniqueUpToIso (colimit.isColimit _) hab.gIsCokernel⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.exists_restrict_biprod_iso_E9
statement:
theorem exists_restrict_biprod_iso_E9 {M N : X.Modules}
    (q₁ : M.LocalGeneratorsData) [q₁.IsLocallyFreeData] [q₁.IsFiniteType]
    (q₃ : N.LocalGeneratorsData) [q₃.IsLocallyFreeData] [q₃.IsFiniteType] (x : X) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (V : X.Opens), x ∈ V ∧
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj (M ⊞ N) ≅
        ⨁ fun _ : Fin m => unitModule V)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcover₁ : IsOpenCover q₁.X :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff X q₁.X).mp q₁.coversTop
  have hcover₃ : IsOpenCover q₃.X :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff X q₃.X).mp q₃.coversTop
  have hxUnion₁ : x ∈ ⋃ i, (q₁.X i : Set X) := by
    rw [hcover₁.iSup_set_eq_univ]
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  have hxUnion₃ : x ∈ ⋃ i, (q₃.X i : Set X) := by
    rw [hcover₃.iSup_set_eq_univ]
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hxUnion₁ hxUnion₃
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := hxUnion₁
  obtain ⟨j, hxj⟩ := hxUnion₃
  let I := (q₁.generators i).I
  let J := (q₃.generators j).I
  letI : (q₁.generators i).IsFiniteType :=
    SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType i
  letI : (q₃.generators j).IsFiniteType :=
    SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType j
  letI : Finite I := by
    dsimp only [I]
    infer_instance
  letI : Finite J := by
    dsimp only [J]
    infer_instance
  let U := q₁.X i ⊓ q₃.X j
  have hxU : x ∈ U := ⟨hxi, hxj⟩
  let eS := biprodFrameIso_E9 U I J (frameOverLE_E9 q₁ i U inf_le_left)
    (frameOverLE_E9 q₃ j U inf_le_right)
  haveI : Finite (I ⊕ J) := inferInstance
  exact ⟨Nat.card (I ⊕ J), U, hxU, ⟨restrictFrameIso (M ⊞ N) U (I ⊕ J) (Finite.equivFin _) eS⟩⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.isFiniteLocallyFree_biprod_E9
statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_biprod_E9 {M N : X.Modules} (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree X M)
    (hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree X N) : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (M ⊞ N)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q₁, hq₁, hq₁fin⟩ := hM.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  obtain ⟨q₃, hq₃, hq₃fin⟩ := hN.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  letI : q₁.IsLocallyFreeData := hq₁
  letI : q₁.IsFiniteType := hq₁fin
  letI : q₃.IsLocallyFreeData := hq₃
  letI : q₃.IsFiniteType := hq₃fin
  apply isFiniteLocallyFree_of_restrict_opens_E5
  intro x
  obtain ⟨m, V, hxV, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_restrict_biprod_iso_E9 q₁ q₃ x
  exact ⟨V, hxV, isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso _ e.symm
    (isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso _ (freeIsoBiprod V (ULift.{u} (Fin m)) Equiv.ulift)
      (free_isFiniteLocallyFree V (ULift.{u} (Fin m))))⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.isFiniteLocallyFree_middle_E9
statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_middle_E9 (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (h₁ : IsFiniteLocallyFree X S.X₁) (h₃ : IsFiniteLocallyFree X S.X₃) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree X S.X₂
proof:
:= by
  apply isFiniteLocallyFree_of_restrict_opens_E5
  intro x
  obtain ⟨V, hxV, ⟨s⟩⟩ := Scheme.Modules.exists_open_splitting_of_shortExact_finiteLocallyFree_right X S hS h₃ x
  let sR := restrictSplittingOfOverSplitting_E5 S V s
  have hA := restrict_isFiniteLocallyFree_E5 V.ι S.X₁ h₁
  have hD := restrict_isFiniteLocallyFree_E5 V.ι S.X₃ h₃
  exact ⟨V, hxV, isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso _ sR.isoBinaryBiproduct.symm (isFiniteLocallyFree_biprod_E9 hA hD)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.whitneyConv_of_rankOpens_E9
statement:
theorem whitneyConv_of_rankOpens_E9 {φ : CharAssign k} {lv : LineVal k}
    (hφ : IsNaturalChar ops φ lv) {A B D : X.Modules} (hA : IsFiniteLocallyFree X A)
    (hB : IsFiniteLocallyFree X B) (hD : IsFiniteLocallyFree X D)
    (h : ∀ r ∈ rankAssembly_ranks A hA,
      WhitneyConv (X := (characteristicRankOpen A hA r : Scheme)) φ
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (characteristicRankOpen A hA r).ι).obj A)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (characteristicRankOpen A hA r).ι).obj B)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (characteristicRankOpen A hA r).ι).obj D)) :
    WhitneyConv (X := X) φ A B D
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro α
  apply rankAssembly_total_joint_injective A hA ops
  intro r hr
  have hd := pureRelDim_openImmersion k (characteristicRankOpen A hA r).ι
  have h1 := LinearMap.congr_fun (hφ.natural (characteristicRankOpen A hA r).ι 0 hd B hB n) α
  have h2 := LinearMap.congr_fun
    (whitneyConv_pull_convolution ops hφ (characteristicRankOpen A hA r).ι 0 hd hA hD n) α
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at h1 h2
  rw [h1, h2, h r hr n]
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.whitney_flag_of_lineSub_E9
statement:
theorem whitney_flag_of_lineSub_E9 (H : LineSubWhitney ops cp) {E : X.Modules} {e : ℕ}
    (S : ChowSplitting ops E e) :
    ∀ i, i ≤ e → ∀ {B D : S.Y.Modules} (a : S.F i ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ D) (w : a ≫ b = 0),
      (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact → IsFiniteLocallyFree S.Y B → IsFiniteLocallyFree S.Y D →
      WhitneyConv (X := S.Y) (geometricChernAssign ops cp) (S.F i) B D
proof:
:= by
  have hnat := geometricChernAssign_isNatural ops cp
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    intro _ B D a b w h hB hD
    obtain ⟨e0⟩ := S.base
    exact H a b w h (hasConstantRank_of_iso e0.symm (S.L_line 0)) hB hD
  | succ i ih =>
    intro hi B D a b w h hB hD
    obtain ⟨f, g, wfg, hfg⟩ := S.step i (Nat.lt_of_succ_le hi)
    obtain ⟨B', u, v, wuv, L', D', p, q, wpq, h1, h2, ⟨eL⟩, ⟨eD⟩⟩ :=
      exists_quot_ses_E9 f g wfg hfg a b w h
    have hL' : HasConstantRank S.Y L' 1 := hasConstantRank_of_iso eL.symm (S.L_line (i + 1))
    have hD' : IsFiniteLocallyFree S.Y D' := isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso _ eD.symm hD
    have hB' : IsFiniteLocallyFree S.Y B' :=
      isFiniteLocallyFree_middle_E9 (ShortComplex.mk p q wpq) h2 hL'.isFiniteLocallyFree hD'
    have w1 := ih (Nat.le_of_succ_le hi) u v wuv h1 hB hB'
    have w2 := ih (Nat.le_of_succ_le hi) f g wfg hfg (S.F_vb (i + 1))
      (S.L_line (i + 1)).isFiniteLocallyFree
    have w3 := whitneyConv_of_iso_E9 ops hnat eL (Iso.refl B') eD (H p q wpq h2 hL' hB' hD')
    intro n
    exact convolution_step_E5 (fun n ↦ geometricChernAssign ops cp S.Y B n)
      (fun n ↦ geometricChernAssign ops cp S.Y (S.F i) n)
      (fun n ↦ geometricChernAssign ops cp S.Y B' n)
      (fun n ↦ geometricChernAssign ops cp S.Y (S.F (i + 1)) n)
      (fun n ↦ geometricChernAssign ops cp S.Y (S.L (i + 1)) n)
      (fun n ↦ geometricChernAssign ops cp S.Y D n) w1 w3 w2 n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.whitney_posRank_of_lineSub_E9
statement:
theorem whitney_posRank_of_lineSub_E9 (H : LineSubWhitney ops cp) {A B D : X.Modules} {e : ℕ}
    (hAr : HasConstantRank X A (e + 1)) (a : A ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ D) (w : a ≫ b = 0)
    (h : (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact)
    (hB : IsFiniteLocallyFree X B) (hD : IsFiniteLocallyFree X D) :
    WhitneyConv (X := X) (geometricChernAssign ops cp) A B D
proof:
:= by
  have hnat := geometricChernAssign_isNatural ops cp
  have hA := hAr.isFiniteLocallyFree
  obtain ⟨S⟩ := exists_chowSplitting ops cp A e hAr
  refine whitneyConv_descent_splitting ops hnat S hA hB hD ?_
  haveI : IsFiniteLocallyFree X A := hA
  haveI : IsFiniteLocallyFree X B := hB
  haveI : IsFiniteLocallyFree X D := hD
  have hT := pullback_map_shortExact_global S.q (ShortComplex.mk a b w) h
  obtain ⟨φt⟩ := S.top
  have hT' : (ShortComplex.mk (φt.hom ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).map a)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).map b) (by
        rw [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, w, Functor.map_zero, Limits.comp_zero])).ShortExact :=
    by
      refine ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso ?_ hT
      exact ShortComplex.isoMk φt.symm (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _)
        (by exact (φt.inv_hom_id_assoc _).trans (Category.comp_id _).symm)
        (by exact (Category.id_comp _).trans (Category.comp_id _).symm)
  have hqB := pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global S.q B hB
  have hqD := pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global S.q D hD
  have hF := whitney_flag_of_lineSub_E9 ops cp H S e le_rfl _ _ _ hT' hqB hqD
  exact whitneyConv_of_iso_E9 ops hnat φt (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) hF

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.whitney_of_lineSubWhitney
statement:
theorem whitney_of_lineSubWhitney (H : LineSubWhitney ops cp) {A B D : X.Modules}
    (a : A ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ D) (w : a ≫ b = 0) (h : (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact)
    (hA : IsFiniteLocallyFree X A) (hB : IsFiniteLocallyFree X B) (hD : IsFiniteLocallyFree X D) :
    WhitneyConv (X := X) (geometricChernAssign ops cp) A B D
proof:
:= by
  refine whitneyConv_of_rankOpens_E9 ops (geometricChernAssign_isNatural ops cp) hA hB hD ?_
  intro r _
  let ι := (characteristicRankOpen A hA r).ι
  have hAr := characteristicRankOpen_hasConstantRank A hA r
  haveI : IsFiniteLocallyFree X A := hA
  haveI : IsFiniteLocallyFree X B := hB
  haveI : IsFiniteLocallyFree X D := hD
  have hT := pullback_map_shortExact_global ι (ShortComplex.mk a b w) h
  have hqB := pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global ι B hB
  have hqD := pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global ι D hD
  have hT' : (ShortComplex.mk ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).map a)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).map b) (by
        rw [← Functor.map_comp, w, Functor.map_zero])).ShortExact := hT
  cases r with
  | zero =>
    intro n
    exact geometricChernAssign_whitney_left_zero ops cp _ _ _ hT' hAr n
  | succ e => exact whitney_posRank_of_lineSub_E9 ops cp H hAr _ _ _ hT' hqB hqD

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_restriction_recovery_smul
statement:
theorem rankTwo_restriction_recovery_smul {Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (q : Z ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion q] (N : Y.Modules) (T : Z.Modules)
    (ρ : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj N ⟶ T)
    (U : Y.Opens) (W : Z.Opens) (h : q ''ᵁ W ≤ U)
    (a : Γ(Y, U)) (x : Γ(N, U)) :
    ρ.app W (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (a • x)) =
      (q.appIso W).hom (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op a) •
        ρ.app W (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul]
  refine (congrArg (fun z => ρ.app W z)
    (Scheme.Modules.smul_restrictAppIso_inv_apply q N W
      (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op a) (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x))).trans ?_
  exact Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul ρ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_originalChart_scalar
statement:
theorem rankTwo_originalChart_scalar (i : C.I) (a : Γ(X, C.U i)) :
    (C.chartι i ≫ C.toBase).appLE (C.U i) ⊤
      (by rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, C.pullbackTwistQuotient_chart_global_top i]) a =
      tautChart_scal Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) a
proof:
:= by
  have hc : C.chartι i ≫ C.toBase =
      intrinsicToSpec (R := Γ(X, C.U i)) (M := E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) ≫
        (C.isAffine i).fromSpec := by
    rw [C.chartι_toBase]
    rfl
  have hl : ⊤ ≤ (intrinsicToSpec (R := Γ(X, C.U i))
      (M := E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) ≫ (C.isAffine i).fromSpec) ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i := by
    exact (le_of_eq (C.pullbackTwistQuotient_chart_global_top i).symm).trans
      (le_of_eq (congrArg (fun f : C.chart i ⟶ X => f ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i) hc))
  refine (tautQuotient_appLE_congr hc _ _ _ hl a).trans ?_
  refine (tautQuotient_comp_appLE_apply _ _ _ _ hl a).trans ?_
  erw [IsAffineOpen.fromSpec_app_self_apply]
  exact tautQuotient_map_appLE_apply _ _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_originalChart_restrictedScalar
statement:
theorem rankTwo_originalChart_restrictedScalar (i : C.I) (a : Γ(X, C.U i)) :
    let h
proof:
:= (tautQuotient_chartι_image_top C i).le
    ((C.chartι i).appIso ⊤).hom (C.scheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op
      (C.toBase.app (C.U i) a)) =
      tautChart_scal Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) a := by
  dsimp only
  rw [Scheme.Hom.appIso_hom', tautQuotient_map_appLE_apply]
  exact (tautQuotient_comp_appLE_apply (C.chartι i) C.toBase _ _ _ a).symm.trans
    (rankTwo_originalChart_scalar C i a)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_originalChart_pushforwardExpansion
statement:
theorem rankTwo_originalChart_pushforwardExpansion (i : C.I)
    (m : E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) :
    letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i)
proof:
:= C.basisIndex_finite i
    letI : Fintype (C.basisIndex i) := Fintype.ofFinite (C.basisIndex i)
    let h := (tautQuotient_chartι_image_top C i).le
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 i).hom.app ⊤
      ((C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op
        ((C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.val.app (op (C.U i))).hom m)) =
      ∑ k, (show Γ(C.chart i, ⊤) from
        tautChart_scal Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))
          ((C.sectionBasis i).repr m k)) • tautQuotient_chartTaut C i k := by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  letI : Fintype (C.basisIndex i) := Fintype.ofFinite (C.basisIndex i)
  dsimp only
  erw [rankTwo_originalTautological_basisExpansion C i m]
  erw [map_sum, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  change (C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 i).hom.app ⊤
    ((C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map _
      (C.toBase.app (C.U i) ((C.sectionBasis i).repr m k) •
        (show Γ(C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1, C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i) from tautQuotient_t C i k))) = _
  refine (rankTwo_restriction_recovery_smul (C.chartι i)
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (C.chartTwistingSheaf 1 i)
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 i).hom _ ⊤
    (tautQuotient_chartι_image_top C i).le
    (C.toBase.app (C.U i) ((C.sectionBasis i).repr m k))
    (tautQuotient_t C i k)).trans ?_
  apply congrArg₂ (fun a x => a • x)
  · exact rankTwo_originalChart_restrictedScalar C i ((C.sectionBasis i).repr m k)
  · have hb := C.pullbackTwistQuotient_recovery_t i k ⊤
      (tautQuotient_chartι_image_top C i).le
    exact hb.trans (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      ((C.chartTwistingSheaf 1 i).presheaf.map_id (op ⊤)) (tautQuotient_chartTaut C i k))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_tautHom_basisExpansion
statement:
theorem rankTwo_tautHom_basisExpansion
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M] {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι]
    (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (m : M) :
    (tautChart_tautHom R M b m).app ⊤ (1 : Γ(space R M, ⊤)) =
      ∑ k, tautChart_scal R M (b.repr m k) •
        (tautChart_tautHom R M b (b k)).app ⊤ (1 : Γ(space R M, ⊤))
proof:
:= by
  have hm : m = (b.repr m).sum (fun k a => a • b k) := by
    rw [← Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, b.linearCombination_repr]
  conv_lhs => rw [hm]
  rw [tautChart_tautHom_app_sum]
  rw [Finsupp.sum_fintype _ _ (fun k => by simp only [tautChart_scal, map_zero, zero_smul])]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  exact congrArg (fun a => a • (tautChart_tautHom R M b (b k)).app ⊤
    (1 : Γ(space R M, ⊤)))
      (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom ((space R M).presheaf.map_id (op ⊤))
        (tautChart_scal R M (b.repr m k)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_originalChart_tautRecovery
statement:
theorem rankTwo_originalChart_tautRecovery (i : C.I)
    (m : E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) :
    letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i)
proof:
:= C.basisIndex_finite i
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 i).hom.app ⊤
      ((C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (tautQuotient_chartι_image_top C i).le).op
        ((C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.val.app (op (C.U i))).hom m)) =
      (tautChart_tautHom Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))
        (C.sectionBasis i) m).app ⊤ (1 : Γ(C.chart i, ⊤)) := by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  letI : Fintype (C.basisIndex i) := Fintype.ofFinite (C.basisIndex i)
  exact (rankTwo_originalChart_pushforwardExpansion C i m).trans
    (rankTwo_tautHom_basisExpansion Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))
      (C.sectionBasis i) m).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_restrict_unit_top
statement:
theorem rankTwo_restrict_unit_top {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (q : Z ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion q] (N : Y.Modules) (U : Y.Opens)
    (ht : ⊤ ≤ q ⁻¹ᵁ U) (h : q ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ U) (x : Γ(N, U)) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj N).presheaf.map (homOfLE ht).op
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).unit.app N).app U x) =
      N.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Modules.restrict_map, Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app]
  erw [← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp_apply]
  congr 1

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.affineChartSectionsIso_restriction
statement:
theorem affineChartSectionsIso_restriction (r : Γ(X,U))
    (x : Γ(affineChartModule X E U,⊤)) :
    (affineChartBasicSectionsIso X E U r).hom (affineChartBasicRestriction X E U r x) =
      E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le r)).op ((affineChartTopSectionsIso X E U).hom x)
proof:
:= by
  let i : (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r : (Spec Γ(X,U)).Opens) ⟶ ⊤ := homOfLE le_top
  have h := Scheme.Modules.map_restrictAppIso_hom (f := U.2.fromSpec) E i.op
  have hh := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom h x
  change E.presheaf.map (eqToHom (U.2.fromSpec_image_basicOpen r).symm).op
      ((E.restrictAppIso U.2.fromSpec (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r)).hom
        ((affineChartModule X E U).presheaf.map i.op x)) = _
  change (E.restrictAppIso U.2.fromSpec (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r)).hom
      ((affineChartModule X E U).presheaf.map i.op x) =
    E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (Scheme.Hom.image_mono U.2.fromSpec (leOfHom i))).op
      ((E.restrictAppIso U.2.fromSpec ⊤).hom x) at hh
  calc
    _ = E.presheaf.map (eqToHom (U.2.fromSpec_image_basicOpen r).symm).op
      (E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (Scheme.Hom.image_mono U.2.fromSpec (leOfHom i))).op
        ((E.restrictAppIso U.2.fromSpec ⊤).hom x)) :=
      congrArg (fun z => E.presheaf.map (eqToHom (U.2.fromSpec_image_basicOpen r).symm).op z) hh
    _ = _ := by
      change (E.presheaf.map _ ≫ E.presheaf.map _) _ =
        (E.presheaf.map _ ≫ E.presheaf.map _) _
      exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
        ((E.presheaf.map_comp _ _).symm.trans
          ((congrArg E.presheaf.map (Subsingleton.elim _ _)).trans (E.presheaf.map_comp _ _))) _

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.affineChartTopRingMap_eq
statement: theorem affineChartTopRingMap_eq : affineChartTopRingMap X U = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X,U)).inv
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [affineChartTopRingMap, Scheme.Hom.appLE]
  rw [U.2.fromSpec_app_self, Category.assoc, ← (Spec Γ(X,U)).presheaf.map_comp]
  have h : (eqToHom U.2.fromSpec_preimage_self).op ≫
      (homOfLE (by rw [U.2.fromSpec_preimage_self])).op = 𝟙 (op ⊤) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [h]
  exact (congrArg (fun k => (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X,U)).inv ≫ k)
    ((Spec Γ(X,U)).presheaf.map_id (op ⊤))).trans (Category.comp_id _)

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.affineChartTopRingBack_comp
statement:
theorem affineChartTopRingBack_comp :
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X,U)).inv ≫ affineChartTopRingBack X U = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  have h := Scheme.Hom.appLE_appIso_inv U.2.fromSpec
    (show (⊤ : (Spec Γ(X,U)).Opens) ≤ U.2.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 from
      by rw [U.2.fromSpec_preimage_self])
  have hn : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X,U)).inv ≫ (U.2.fromSpec.appIso ⊤).inv =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (by rw [affineChart_image_top X U])).op :=
    (congrArg (fun k => k ≫ (U.2.fromSpec.appIso ⊤).inv)
      (affineChartTopRingMap_eq X U).symm).trans h
  calc
    _ = ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X,U)).inv ≫ (U.2.fromSpec.appIso ⊤).inv) ≫
        X.presheaf.map (eqToHom (affineChart_image_top X U).symm).op :=
      (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (by rw [affineChart_image_top X U])).op ≫
        X.presheaf.map (eqToHom (affineChart_image_top X U).symm).op :=
      congrArg (fun k => k ≫ X.presheaf.map (eqToHom (affineChart_image_top X U).symm).op) hn
    _ = 𝟙 _ := (X.presheaf.map_comp _ _).symm.trans
      ((congrArg X.presheaf.map (Subsingleton.elim _ (𝟙 (op U.1)))).trans
        (X.presheaf.map_id _))

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.affineChartTopRingBack_eq
statement:
theorem affineChartTopRingBack_eq :
    affineChartTopRingBack X U = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X,U)).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X,U)).inv).mp
  exact (affineChartTopRingBack_comp X U).trans (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X,U)).inv_hom_id.symm

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.specTop_smul_def
statement:
theorem specTop_smul_def (A : CommRingCat.{u}) (M : (Spec A).Modules)
    (r : A) (x : Γ(M,⊤)) : r • x = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).inv r • x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Modules.smul_Spec_def]
  have hm : (Spec A).presheaf.map (homOfLE (show (⊤ : (Spec A).Opens) ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op =
      𝟙 Γ(Spec A,⊤) := (Spec A).presheaf.map_id (op ⊤)
  exact congrArg (fun a => a • x) (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hm ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).inv r))

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.affineChartModule_isQuasicoherent

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.affineChartFromOriginalRestriction_isLocalized
statement:
theorem affineChartFromOriginalRestriction_isLocalized [E.IsQuasicoherent]
    (r : Γ(X,U)) : IsLocalizedModule.Away r
      (affineChartFromOriginalRestriction X E U r)
proof:
:= by
  letI := affineChartModule_isQuasicoherent X E U
  letI := specBasicRestriction_isLocalized Γ(X,U) (affineChartModule X E U) r
  exact IsLocalizedModule.of_linearEquiv_right
    (Submonoid.powers r)
    (specBasicRestriction Γ(X,U) (affineChartModule X E U) r)
    (affineChartTopSectionsLinearEquiv X E U).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.affineChartFromOriginalRestriction_comparison
statement:
theorem affineChartFromOriginalRestriction_comparison (r : Γ(X,U)) (x : Γ(E,U.1)) :
    (affineChartBasicSectionsIso X E U r).hom
      (affineChartFromOriginalRestriction X E U r x) =
    E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le r)).op x
proof:
:= by
  have h := affineChartSectionsIso_restriction X E U r
    ((affineChartTopSectionsLinearEquiv X E U).symm x)
  change (affineChartBasicSectionsIso X E U r).hom
      (affineChartFromOriginalRestriction X E U r x) = _ at h
  exact h.trans (congrArg (E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le r)).op)
    ((affineChartTopSectionsLinearEquiv X E U).apply_symm_apply x))

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.affineChartFromOriginalRestriction_denominator
statement:
theorem affineChartFromOriginalRestriction_denominator [E.IsQuasicoherent]
    (r : Γ(X,U)) (y : Γ(affineChartModule X E U,PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r)) :
    ∃ q : Γ(E,U.1) × Submonoid.powers r,
      (q.2 : Γ(X,U)) • y = affineChartFromOriginalRestriction X E U r q.1
proof:
:= by
  letI := affineChartFromOriginalRestriction_isLocalized X E U r
  exact IsLocalizedModule.surj (Submonoid.powers r)
    (affineChartFromOriginalRestriction X E U r) y

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.affineChartBasicSection_denominator
statement:
theorem affineChartBasicSection_denominator [E.IsQuasicoherent]
    (r : Γ(X,U)) (y : Γ(E,X.basicOpen r)) :
    ∃ q : Γ(E,U.1) × Submonoid.powers r,
      (affineChartBasicSectionsIso X E U r).hom
        ((q.2 : Γ(X,U)) • (affineChartBasicSectionsIso X E U r).inv y) =
      E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le r)).op q.1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q,hq⟩ := affineChartFromOriginalRestriction_denominator X E U r
    ((affineChartBasicSectionsIso X E U r).inv y)
  exact ⟨q, (congrArg (affineChartBasicSectionsIso X E U r).hom hq).trans
    (affineChartFromOriginalRestriction_comparison X E U r q.1)⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullHom_isIso
statement:
theorem pullHom_isIso
    {A B Y D : Scheme.{u}} {M : A.Modules} {N : B.Modules}
    (f₁ : Y ⟶ A) (f₂ : Y ⟶ B)
    (φ : (Scheme.Modules.pullback f₁).obj M ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback f₂).obj N)
    [IsIso φ]
    (g : D ⟶ Y) (gf₁ : D ⟶ A) (gf₂ : D ⟶ B)
    (hgf₁ : g ≫ f₁ = gf₁) (hgf₂ : g ≫ f₂ = gf₂) :
    IsIso
      (Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
        (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
        φ g gf₁ gf₂ hgf₁ hgf₂)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
  infer_instance

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistPullHom_self_of_chosenTripleComp
statement:
theorem twistPullHom_self_of_chosenTripleComp
    {d : ℤ} (T : C.TwistTransitionSystem d)
    (hT : C.TwistChosenTripleComp T) (i : C.I) :
    C.twistPullHom T (C.chartι i) (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _)
        (by simp) (by simp) =
      𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  let a :=
    C.twistPullHom T (C.chartι i) (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _)
      (by simp) (by simp)
  have ha : a ≫ a = a :=
    twistPullHom_comp_of_chosenTripleComp C T hT
      (C.chartι i) (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _)
      (by simp) (by simp) (by simp)
  haveI : IsIso a := by
    haveI : IsIso (C.twistTransitionHom T i i) := by
      dsimp only [twistTransitionHom]
      infer_instance
    dsimp only [a, twistPullHom]
    unfold Pseudofunctor.DescentData'.pullHom'
    apply pullHom_isIso
  apply (cancel_epi a).1
  simpa only [Category.comp_id] using ha

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistTransitionLaws_of_chosenTripleComp
statement:
theorem twistTransitionLaws_of_chosenTripleComp
    {d : ℤ} (T : C.TwistTransitionSystem d)
    (hT : C.TwistChosenTripleComp T) :
    C.TwistTransitionLaws T where
  self
proof:
:= twistPullHom_self_of_chosenTripleComp C T hT
  comp := twistPullHom_comp_of_chosenTripleComp C T hT

name: Finsupp.finite_setOf_degree_eq
statement:
theorem finite_setOf_degree_eq (σ : Type u) [Finite σ] (d : ℕ) :
    Finite {m : σ →₀ ℕ // m.degree = d}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Finite.of_injective
    (fun m : {m : σ →₀ ℕ // m.degree = d} =>
      (fun i : σ => (⟨min (m.1 i) d, Nat.lt_succ_of_le (min_le_right _ _)⟩ : Fin (d + 1)))) ?_
  intro a b hab
  refine Subtype.ext (Finsupp.ext fun i => ?_)
  have ha : a.1 i ≤ d := le_of_le_of_eq (Finsupp.le_degree i a.1) a.2
  have hb : b.1 i ≤ d := le_of_le_of_eq (Finsupp.le_degree i b.1) b.2
  have h : min (a.1 i) d = min (b.1 i) d := by
    simpa using congrFun hab i
  omega

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial_apply
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M)
    (p : SchemeProjectiveSpace.Polynomial R n) :
    intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b p =
      (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm p
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial_naturality
statement:
theorem intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial_naturality
    (φ : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (bM : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M)
    (bN : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) S N)
    (hb : ∀ i, φ (bM i) = bN i) :
    (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ).comp
        (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial bM) =
      (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial bN).comp
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.gradedMap (algebraMap R S) n)
proof:
:= by
  let left : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R →+* SymmetricAlgebra S N :=
    (symmetricAlgebraMap φ).comp
      (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial bM).symm.toRingHom
  let right : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R →+* SymmetricAlgebra S N :=
    (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial bN).symm.toRingHom.comp
      (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap R S))
  have hring : left = right := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro r
      dsimp only [left, right, RingHom.comp_apply]
      have hM :
          (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial bM).symm.toRingHom
              (MvPolynomial.C r) =
            algebraMap R (SymmetricAlgebra R M) r := by
        simpa using
          (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial bM).symm.commutes r
      have hN :
          (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial bN).symm.toRingHom
              (MvPolynomial.C (algebraMap R S r)) =
            algebraMap S (SymmetricAlgebra S N) (algebraMap R S r) := by
        simpa using
          (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial bN).symm.commutes
            (algebraMap R S r)
      rw [hM, MvPolynomial.map_C, hN]
      exact symmetricAlgebraMap_algebraMap φ r
    · intro i
      simp [left, right, hb]
  apply GradedRingHom.ext
  intro p
  exact RingHom.congr_fun hring p

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.irrelevant_le_map_intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial
statement:
theorem irrelevant_le_map_intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M) :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (symGrading R M) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading R n)).map
          (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b)
proof:
:= by
  refine (HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_irrelevant_le (symGrading R M)).2 ?_
  intro d hd x hx
  have hx' : SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b x ∈
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading R n d := by
    rw [symGrading_eq_gradingOfBasis b] at hx
    exact (mem_gradingOfBasis_iff b).mp hx
  have hxpoly :
      SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b x ∈
        (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading R n)).toIdeal :=
    HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading R n) hd hx'
  have :
      x = intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b
        (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b x) := by
    simp
  rw [this]
  exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b) hxpoly

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.irrelevant_le_map_intrinsicGradedToPolynomial
statement:
theorem irrelevant_le_map_intrinsicGradedToPolynomial
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M) :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading R n) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (symGrading R M)).map
        (intrinsicGradedToPolynomial b)
proof:
:= by
  refine (HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_irrelevant_le
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading R n)).2 ?_
  intro d hd p hp
  have hpSym :
      (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm p ∈ symGrading R M d := by
    rw [symGrading_eq_gradingOfBasis b]
    exact ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  have :
      p = intrinsicGradedToPolynomial b
        ((SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm p) := by
    simp
  rw [this]
  exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (intrinsicGradedToPolynomial b)
    (HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem (symGrading R M) hd hpSym)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.intrinsicToStandard_comp_fromStandard
statement:
theorem intrinsicToStandard_comp_fromStandard
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M) :
    intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b ≫
        intrinsicFromStandardProjectiveSpace b =
      𝟙 (space R M)
proof:
:= by
  unfold intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace
    intrinsicFromStandardProjectiveSpace space
  calc
    Proj.map (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b)
        (irrelevant_le_map_intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b) ≫
        Proj.map (intrinsicGradedToPolynomial b)
          (irrelevant_le_map_intrinsicGradedToPolynomial b) =
      Proj.map
        ((intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b).comp
          (intrinsicGradedToPolynomial b))
        (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp
          (irrelevant_le_map_intrinsicGradedToPolynomial b)
          (irrelevant_le_map_intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b)) := by
      exact (Proj.map_comp
        (intrinsicGradedToPolynomial b)
        (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b)
        (irrelevant_le_map_intrinsicGradedToPolynomial b)
        (irrelevant_le_map_intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b)).symm
    _ = 𝟙 (Proj (symGrading R M)) := by
      convert Proj.map_id
      exact intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial_comp_toPolynomial b

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.intrinsicFromStandard_comp_toStandard
statement:
theorem intrinsicFromStandard_comp_toStandard
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M) :
    intrinsicFromStandardProjectiveSpace b ≫
        intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b =
      𝟙 (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space R n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace
    intrinsicFromStandardProjectiveSpace SchemeProjectiveSpace.space
  calc
    Proj.map (intrinsicGradedToPolynomial b)
        (irrelevant_le_map_intrinsicGradedToPolynomial b) ≫
        Proj.map (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b)
          (irrelevant_le_map_intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b) =
      Proj.map
        ((intrinsicGradedToPolynomial b).comp
          (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b))
        (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp
          (irrelevant_le_map_intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b)
          (irrelevant_le_map_intrinsicGradedToPolynomial b)) := by
      exact (Proj.map_comp
        (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b)
        (intrinsicGradedToPolynomial b)
        (irrelevant_le_map_intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b)
        (irrelevant_le_map_intrinsicGradedToPolynomial b)).symm
    _ = 𝟙 (Proj (SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading R n)) := by
      convert Proj.map_id
      exact intrinsicGradedToPolynomial_comp_fromPolynomial b

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace_comp_toSpec
statement:
theorem intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace_comp_toSpec
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M) :
    intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b ≫
        SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec R n =
      intrinsicToSpec (R := R) (M := M)
proof:
:= by
  unfold intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace intrinsicToSpec
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpecZero
  rw [← Category.assoc,
    Proj.map_toSpecZero
      (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b)
      (irrelevant_le_map_intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial b),
    Category.assoc]
  apply congrArg (fun g ↦ Proj.toSpecZero (symGrading R M) ≫ g)
  rw [← Spec.map_comp]
  apply congrArg Spec.map
  apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro r
  apply Subtype.ext
  change
    (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm (MvPolynomial.C r) =
      ((degreeZeroAlgEquiv
        (R := R) (M := M)).symm r : SymmetricAlgebra R M)
  rw [show
      (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm (MvPolynomial.C r) =
        algebraMap R (SymmetricAlgebra R M) r by
    simpa using (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm.commutes r]
  exact (congrArg Subtype.val (by
    simpa using
      (degreeZeroAlgEquiv (R := R) (M := M)).symm.commutes r)).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.symmetricProjMap_comp_intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace
statement:
theorem symmetricProjMap_comp_intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    (φ : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hspan : Submodule.span S (Set.range φ) = ⊤)
    (bM : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M)
    (bN : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) S N)
    (hb : ∀ i, φ (bM i) = bN i) :
    symmetricProjMap φ hspan ≫
        intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace bM =
      intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace bN ≫
        SchemeProjectiveSpace.map (algebraMap R S) n
proof:
:= by
  unfold symmetricProjMap intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.map
  calc
    Proj.map (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ)
        (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ hspan) ≫
        Proj.map (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial bM)
          (irrelevant_le_map_intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial bM) =
      Proj.map
        ((gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ).comp
          (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial bM))
        (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp
          (irrelevant_le_map_intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial bM)
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ hspan)) := by
      exact (Proj.map_comp
        (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial bM)
        (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ)
        (irrelevant_le_map_intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial bM)
        (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ hspan)).symm
    _ = Proj.map
        ((intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial bN).comp
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.gradedMap (algebraMap R S) n))
        (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.irrelevant_le_map_gradedMap
            (algebraMap R S) n)
          (irrelevant_le_map_intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial bN)) := by
      congr 1
      exact intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial_naturality φ bM bN hb
    _ = Proj.map (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial bN)
          (irrelevant_le_map_intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial bN) ≫
        Proj.map
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.gradedMap (algebraMap R S) n)
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.irrelevant_le_map_gradedMap
            (algebraMap R S) n) := by
      exact Proj.map_comp
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.gradedMap (algebraMap R S) n)
        (intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial bN)
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.irrelevant_le_map_gradedMap
          (algebraMap R S) n)
        (irrelevant_le_map_intrinsicGradedFromPolynomial bN)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.isPullback_symmetricProjMap_toSpec_of_bases
statement:
theorem isPullback_symmetricProjMap_toSpec_of_bases
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    (φ : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hspan : Submodule.span S (Set.range φ) = ⊤)
    (bM : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M)
    (bN : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) S N)
    (hb : ∀ i, φ (bM i) = bN i) :
    IsPullback
      (symmetricProjMap φ hspan)
      (intrinsicToSpec (R := S) (M := N))
      (intrinsicToSpec (R := R) (M := M))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))
proof:
:= by
  refine
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.isPullback_map_toSpec
      (algebraMap R S) n).of_iso'
      (asIso (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace bN))
      (asIso (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace bM))
      (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · exact
      (symmetricProjMap_comp_intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace
        φ hspan bM bN hb).symm
  · exact intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace_comp_toSpec bN
  · exact intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace_comp_toSpec bM
  · simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.isEmpty_space_of_isEmpty_basis
statement:
theorem isEmpty_space_of_isEmpty_basis
    {ι : Type u} [IsEmpty ι]
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    (b : Module.Basis ι R M) :
    IsEmpty (space R M)
proof:
:= by
  have hM (m : M) : m = 0 := by
    apply b.repr.injective
    ext i
    exact isEmptyElim i
  have hι :
      LinearMap.range
          (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M :
            M →ₗ[R] SymmetricAlgebra R M) =
        ⊥ := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · rintro x ⟨m, rfl⟩
      rw [hM m]
      simp
    · exact bot_le
  have hpiece (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) :
      symGrading R M d = ⊥ := by
    rw [symGrading_apply, hι]
    exact Submodule.bot_pow (Nat.ne_of_gt hd)
  constructor
  intro x
  exact x.not_irrelevant_le <|
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le (symGrading R M)).2 fun d hd ↦ by
      rw [hpiece d hd]
      exact bot_le

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.isPullback_symmetricProjMap_toSpec_of_isEmpty_bases
statement:
theorem isPullback_symmetricProjMap_toSpec_of_isEmpty_bases
    {ι : Type u} [IsEmpty ι]
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    (φ : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hspan : Submodule.span S (Set.range φ) = ⊤)
    (bM : Module.Basis ι R M)
    (bN : Module.Basis ι S N) :
    IsPullback
      (symmetricProjMap φ hspan)
      (intrinsicToSpec (R := S) (M := N))
      (intrinsicToSpec (R := R) (M := M))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsEmpty (space R M) :=
    isEmpty_space_of_isEmpty_basis bM
  letI : IsEmpty (space S N) :=
    isEmpty_space_of_isEmpty_basis bN
  let f := intrinsicToSpec (R := R) (M := M)
  let g := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))
  have hdisj : Disjoint (Set.range f) (Set.range g) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro z hz _
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hz
    exact isEmptyElim x
  letI : IsEmpty ↑(Limits.pullback f g) :=
    Scheme.isEmpty_pullback f g hdisj
  let hP : IsInitial (space S N) := isInitialOfIsEmpty
  let hPB : IsInitial (Limits.pullback f g) := isInitialOfIsEmpty
  exact IsPullback.of_iso_pullback
    ⟨symmetricProjMap_toSpec φ hspan⟩
    (hP.uniqueUpToIso hPB)
    (hP.hom_ext _ _)
    (hP.hom_ext _ _)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.isPullback_symmetricProjMap_toSpec_of_isBaseChange_basis
statement:
theorem isPullback_symmetricProjMap_toSpec_of_isBaseChange_basis
    {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι]
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    (φ : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hspan : Submodule.span S (Set.range φ) = ⊤)
    (hφ : IsBaseChange S φ)
    (bM : Module.Basis ι R M) :
    IsPullback
      (symmetricProjMap φ hspan)
      (intrinsicToSpec (R := S) (M := N))
      (intrinsicToSpec (R := R) (M := M))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι with hι | hι
  · letI : IsEmpty ι := hι
    exact isPullback_symmetricProjMap_toSpec_of_isEmpty_bases
      φ hspan bM (hφ.basis bM)
  · letI : Nonempty ι := hι
    let n := Fintype.card ι - 1
    have hn : Fintype.card ι = n + 1 := by
      dsimp only [n]
      have hcard : 0 < Fintype.card ι := Fintype.card_pos
      omega
    let e : ι ≃ Fin (n + 1) :=
      (Fintype.equivFin ι).trans (finCongr hn)
    let bM' : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M :=
      bM.reindex e
    let bN' : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) S N :=
      (hφ.basis bM).reindex e
    apply isPullback_symmetricProjMap_toSpec_of_bases
      φ hspan bM' bN'
    intro j
    simpa only [bM', bN', Module.Basis.reindex_apply] using
      (hφ.basis_apply bM (e.symm j)).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.isPullback_symmetricProjMap_toSpec_of_isBaseChange
statement:
theorem isPullback_symmetricProjMap_toSpec_of_isBaseChange
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    (φ : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hspan : Submodule.span S (Set.range φ) = ⊤)
    (hφ : IsBaseChange S φ) :
    IsPullback
      (symmetricProjMap φ hspan)
      (intrinsicToSpec (R := S) (M := N))
      (intrinsicToSpec (R := R) (M := M))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))
proof:
:=
  isPullback_symmetricProjMap_toSpec_of_isBaseChange_basis
    φ hspan hφ (Module.Free.chooseBasis R M)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.isPullback_semilinearSymmetricProjMap_toSpec_of_isBaseChange
statement:
theorem isPullback_semilinearSymmetricProjMap_toSpec_of_isBaseChange
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    (f : R →+* S) (φ : M →ₛₗ[f] N)
    (hspan : Submodule.span S (Set.range φ) = ⊤)
    (hφ :
      letI : Algebra R S := f.toAlgebra
      letI : Module R N := Module.compHom N f
      letI : IsScalarTower R S N :=
        ⟨fun r s n ↦ by
          change (f r * s) • n = f r • s • n
          rw [mul_smul]⟩
      IsBaseChange S (semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f φ)) :
    IsPullback
      (semilinearSymmetricProjMap f φ hspan)
      (intrinsicToSpec (R := S) (M := N))
      (intrinsicToSpec (R := R) (M := M))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f))
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra R S := f.toAlgebra
  letI : Module R N := Module.compHom N f
  letI : IsScalarTower R S N :=
    ⟨fun r s n ↦ by
      change (f r * s) • n = f r • s • n
      rw [mul_smul]⟩
  change IsPullback
    (symmetricProjMap
      (semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f φ) hspan)
    (intrinsicToSpec (R := S) (M := N))
    (intrinsicToSpec (R := R) (M := M))
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f))
  exact isPullback_symmetricProjMap_toSpec_of_isBaseChange
    (semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f φ) hspan hφ

name: KSpecialization.pullback_tMul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem pullback_tMul_eq_zero (E : Y.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (zeroι t)).map (tMul t E) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let adj := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (zeroι t)
  apply (adj.homEquiv _ _).injective
  simp only [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, Functor.map_zero]
  have h0 : tMul t ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (zeroι t)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (zeroι t)).obj E)) = 0 :=
    tMul_pushforward_eq_zero t (zeroι t) (zeroι_appTop t) _
  have hnat : tMul t E ≫ adj.unit.app E = adj.unit.app E ≫
      tMul t ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (zeroι t)).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (zeroι t)).obj E)) := ((tNatTrans t).naturality (adj.unit.app E)).symm
  have hn : tMul t E ≫ adj.unit.app E = adj.unit.app E ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (zeroι t)).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (zeroι t)).map (tMul t E)) := adj.unit.naturality (tMul t E)
  rw [h0] at hnat
  exact hn.symm.trans (hnat.trans comp_zero) |>.trans comp_zero.symm

name: KSpecialization.isIso_map_cokernel_π_of_map_eq_zero
proof:
:= by

name: KSpecialization.isIso_pullback_cokernel_π
statement:
theorem isIso_pullback_cokernel_π (E : Y.Modules) :
    IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (zeroι t)).map (cokernel.π (tMul t E)))
proof:

    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (zeroι t)).leftAdjoint_preservesColimits

name: KSpecialization.zeroGysin_classOf_of_mono
statement:
theorem zeroGysin_classOf_of_mono (E : Y.Modules) (hE : IsCoherentLike Y E)
    [Mono (tMul t E)] :
    zeroGysin t (g0ClassOf Y E hE) =
      g0ClassOf (zeroScheme t) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (zeroι t)).obj E) (by
        letI : E.IsFinitePresentation := hE
        exact pullback_isFinitePresentation_global (zeroι t) E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [zeroGysin_classOf]
  have hker := ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_isZero (Scheme.Modules (zeroScheme t))
    (IsCoherentLike (zeroScheme t)) (fibrePullObject t ⟨kernel (tMul t E),
      killed_kernel _ kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike hE⟩).2
    (Functor.map_isZero _ (isZero_kernel_of_mono (tMul t E)))
  unfold ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf at hker
  rw [hker, sub_zero]
  haveI := isIso_pullback_cokernel_π t E
  exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso _ _ _ _
    (inferInstanceAs (0 : (zeroScheme t).Modules).IsFinitePresentation) (isZero_zero _)
    (asIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (zeroι t)).map (cokernel.π (tMul t E)))).symm

name: KSpecialization.schemeGysin_finitePushforward_of_mono
statement:
theorem schemeGysin_finitePushforward_of_mono (V : W.Modules) (hV : IsCoherentLike W V)
    [Mono (tMul (F.appTop t) V)] :
    schemeGysin t (finitePushforward F (g0ClassOf W V hV)) =
      ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf M.Modules (Killed (IsCoherentLike M) (tNatTrans t))
        (pushCokernelObject F t V hV).1 (pushCokernelObject F t V hV).2
proof:
:= by
  letI : V.IsFinitePresentation := hV
  set s := F.appTop t with hs
  have hC : (cokernel (tMul s V)).IsFinitePresentation := cokernel_isFinitePresentation _
  
  let S : ShortComplex W.Modules := ShortComplex.mk (tMul s V) (cokernel.π (tMul s V))
    (cokernel.condition _)
  have hS : S.ShortExact := { exact := ShortComplex.exact_cokernel _ }
  have hS' := finite_pushforward_map_shortExact F S hS
  have hτ : tMul t ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj V) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).map (tMul s V) := tMul_pushforward F t V
  haveI : Mono ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).map (tMul s V)) := hS'.mono_f
  haveI : Mono (ExactGrothendieck.PrincipalGysin.ap (tNatTrans t)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj V)) := by
    change Mono (tMul t ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj V))
    rw [hτ]; infer_instance
  rw [finitePushforward_classOf]
  change ExactGrothendieck.PrincipalGysin.gysin (tNatTrans t) kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike _ = _
  refine (ExactGrothendieck.PrincipalGysin.gysin_classOf_of_mono (tNatTrans t)
    kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike _ _).trans ?_
  have hcok : IsColimit (CokernelCofork.ofπ ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).map
      (cokernel.π (tMul s V))) (show (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).map (tMul s V) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).map (cokernel.π (tMul s V)) = 0 from by
        rw [← Functor.map_comp, cokernel.condition, Functor.map_zero])) := hS'.gIsCokernel
  let e : cokernel (ExactGrothendieck.PrincipalGysin.ap (tNatTrans t)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj V)) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj (cokernel (tMul s V)) :=
    cokernelIsoOfEq hτ ≪≫ (colimit.isoColimitCocone ⟨_, hcok⟩)
  exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso _ _ _ _ (killed_zero t) (isZero_zero _) e

    (z : ⋀[R]^(n + 1) (F × R)) :
    (scalarConeComponentIso σ d e r (n + 1)).hom z =

statement:
theorem scalarConeComponentIso_succ_symm (σ : F →ₗ[R] R)
    (d : AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution R P)
    (e : koszulChainComplex σ ≅ d.resolution.complex) (r : R) (n : ℕ)
    (x : ⋀[R]^(n + 1) F) (y : ⋀[R]^n F) :
    (scalarConeComponentIso σ d e r (n + 1)).hom ((coneExteriorEquiv n).symm (x, y)) =
    ((HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoApp e (n + 1)).hom x,
      (HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoApp e n).hom y)

:= by

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.chainIso_koszul_differential
statement:
theorem chainIso_koszul_differential (σ : F →ₗ[R] R)
    (d : AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution R P)
    (e : koszulChainComplex σ ≅ d.resolution.complex) (n : ℕ) (x : ⋀[R]^(n + 1) F) :
    d.resolution.complex.d (n + 1) n ((HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoApp e (n + 1)).hom x) =
      (HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoApp e n).hom (koszulDiff σ n x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (e.hom.comm (n + 1) n) x
  change d.resolution.complex.d (n + 1) n (e.hom.f (n + 1) x) =
    e.hom.f n ((koszulChainComplex σ).d (n + 1) n x) at h
  have hd : (koszulChainComplex σ).d (n + 1) n = ModuleCat.ofHom (koszulDiff σ n) :=
    by dsimp [koszulChainComplex]; rw [ChainComplex.of_d]
  rw [hd] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.scalarConeComponentIso_differential
statement:
theorem scalarConeComponentIso_differential (σ : F →ₗ[R] R)
    (d : AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution R P)
    (e : koszulChainComplex σ ≅ d.resolution.complex) (r : R) (n : ℕ) :
    (scalarConeComponentIso σ d e r (n + 1)).hom ≫ d.coneD r n =
    ModuleCat.ofHom (koszulDiff (coneCosection σ r) n) ≫
      (scalarConeComponentIso σ d e r n).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    obtain ⟨⟨x, y⟩, rfl⟩ := (coneExteriorEquiv (R := R) (F := F) 0).symm.surjective z
    change d.coneDZero r ((scalarConeComponentIso σ d e r 1).hom
      ((coneExteriorEquiv 0).symm (x, y))) =
      (scalarConeComponentIso σ d e r 0).hom
      (koszulDiff (coneCosection σ r) 0 ((coneExteriorEquiv 0).symm (x, y)))
    rw [scalarConeComponentIso_succ_symm, scalarConeComponentIso_zero_hom,
      coneExterior_differential_zero_coordinates]
    change d.resolution.complex.d 1 0 ((HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoApp e 1).hom x) +
      r • (HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoApp e 0).hom y =
      (HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoApp e 0).hom (koszulDiff σ 0 x + r • y)
    rw [chainIso_koszul_differential]
    change chainIsoExteriorLinear σ d e 0 (koszulDiff σ 0 x) + r • chainIsoExteriorLinear σ d e 0 y =
      chainIsoExteriorLinear σ d e 0 (koszulDiff σ 0 x + r • y)
    rw [map_add, map_smul]
  | succ n =>
    obtain ⟨⟨x, y⟩, rfl⟩ := (coneExteriorEquiv (R := R) (F := F) (n + 1)).symm.surjective z
    change d.coneDSucc r n ((scalarConeComponentIso σ d e r (n + 2)).hom
      ((coneExteriorEquiv (n + 1)).symm (x, y))) =
      (scalarConeComponentIso σ d e r (n + 1)).hom
      (koszulDiff (coneCosection σ r) (n + 1) ((coneExteriorEquiv (n + 1)).symm (x, y)))
    rw [scalarConeComponentIso_succ_symm, coneExterior_differential_decomposition,
      scalarConeComponentIso_succ_symm]
    change (d.resolution.complex.d (n + 2) (n + 1)
      ((HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoApp e (n + 2)).hom x) +
      r • (HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoApp e (n + 1)).hom y,
      -(d.resolution.complex.d (n + 1) n ((HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoApp e (n + 1)).hom y))) =
      ((HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoApp e (n + 1)).hom (koszulDiff σ (n + 1) x + r • y),
        (HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoApp e n).hom (-(koszulDiff σ n y)))
    rw [chainIso_koszul_differential, chainIso_koszul_differential]
    apply Prod.ext
    · change chainIsoExteriorLinear σ d e (n + 1) (koszulDiff σ (n + 1) x) +
        r • chainIsoExteriorLinear σ d e (n + 1) y =
        chainIsoExteriorLinear σ d e (n + 1) (koszulDiff σ (n + 1) x + r • y)
      rw [map_add, map_smul]
    · change -chainIsoExteriorLinear σ d e n (koszulDiff σ n y) =
        chainIsoExteriorLinear σ d e n (-(koszulDiff σ n y))
      exact (map_neg (chainIsoExteriorLinear σ d e n) _).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.koszulAcyclic_of_resolution_chainIso
statement:
theorem koszulAcyclic_of_resolution_chainIso (σ : F →ₗ[R] R)
    (d : AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution R P)
    (e : koszulChainComplex σ ≅ d.resolution.complex) : KoszulAcyclic σ
proof:
:= by
  intro n x hx
  let q := chainIsoExteriorEquiv σ d e (n + 1)
  have hcycle : d.resolution.complex.d (n + 1) n (q x) = 0 := by
    have h := chainIso_koszul_differential σ d e n x
    change d.resolution.complex.d (n + 1) n (q x) =
      chainIsoExteriorLinear σ d e n (koszulDiff σ n x) at h
    exact h.trans ((congrArg (chainIsoExteriorLinear σ d e n) hx).trans (map_zero _))
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := d.resolution_exact_lift n (q x) hcycle
  let t := chainIsoExteriorEquiv σ d e (n + 2)
  refine ⟨t.symm z, q.injective ?_⟩
  have h := chainIso_koszul_differential σ d e (n + 1) (t.symm z)
  change d.resolution.complex.d (n + 2) (n + 1) (t (t.symm z)) =
    q (koszulDiff σ (n + 1) (t.symm z)) at h
  rw [t.apply_symm_apply] at h
  exact h.symm.trans hz

proof:

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.k0_relation_koszul
statement:
theorem k0_relation_koszul (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (r + 1),
        (-1 : K0 C.scheme) ^ k *
          C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos (lambdaClass X E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree k) *
          C.tautologicalK0Class ^ (r - k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI : Flat C.toBase := C.toBase_flat hpos
  have h := koszul_relation C.scheme hr (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase E r hE)
    (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) C.tautologicalQuotient
  convert h using 3 with k hk
  · congr 1
    change flatPullbackK0RingHom C.toBase _ = _
    rw [flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply, flatPullbackK0_lambdaClass]
  · rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.k0_relation
statement:
theorem k0_relation (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    letI
proof:
:= C.projectiveBundleK0Algebra hpos
    Polynomial.aeval C.tautologicalK0Class
      (projectiveBundleRelationPolynomial (K0 X) r
        (chernRelationCoefficients (K0 X) r (lambdaChernCoeffs hE))) = 0 := by
  letI := C.projectiveBundleK0Algebra hpos
  have hk := C.k0_relation_koszul hpos hr hE
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ', pow_zero, one_mul, lambdaClass_zero, map_one, one_mul,
    Nat.sub_zero, Finset.sum_range, ← Equiv.sum_comp Fin.revPerm] at hk
  simp only [projectiveBundleRelationPolynomial, projectiveBundleRelationLower, map_add,
    Polynomial.aeval_X_pow, map_sum, Polynomial.aeval_mul, Polynomial.aeval_C]
  refine Eq.trans ?_ hk
  rw [add_comm]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
  have hi : r - (((Fin.rev i : Fin r) : ℕ) + 1) = i := by
    simp only [Fin.val_rev]
    omega
  simp only [Fin.revPerm_apply, chernRelationCoefficients, lambdaChernCoeffs,
    RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, map_one, hi]
