name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7s_mem_of_prime
statement:
theorem m7s_mem_of_prime {m : ℕ} (M : Submodule ℚ (RationalDimChow W m)) (S : Set W)
    (hprime : ∀ (v : W) (hv : height v = m), v ∈ S →
      (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v m hv) : DimChow W m) ∈ M)
    (D : dimensionCycles W m) (hD : D.1.support ⊆ S) :
    (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow W m) ∈ M
proof:
:= by
  have hfin : (D.1.support).Finite := by
    simpa using D.1.locallyFiniteSupport.finite_inter_support_of_isCompact
      (isCompact_univ (X := W))
  suffices h : ∀ s : Finset W, ∀ D : dimensionCycles W m, D.1.support ⊆ S →
      D.1.support ⊆ s → (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow W m) ∈ M from
    h hfin.toFinset D hD (by simp)
  intro s
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    intro D _ hDs
    have hD0 : D = 0 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      ext y
      by_contra hy
      exact absurd (hDs hy) (by simp)
    rw [hD0, QuotientAddGroup.mk_zero, TensorProduct.tmul_zero]
    exact M.zero_mem
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    intro D hDS hDs
    by_cases hDa : D.1 a = 0
    · refine ih D hDS ?_
      intro y hy
      have hy' := hDs hy
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hy' with rfl | h
      · exact absurd hDa hy
      · exact h
    · have haS : a ∈ S := hDS hDa
      have hah : height a = m := D.2 hDa
      set P := dimPrimeCycle a m hah with hP
      have hPa : ∀ y, P.1 y = if y = a then 1 else 0 := by
        intro y
        change Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single a 1 y = _
        rw [Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single_apply]
      set R : dimensionCycles W m := D - D.1 a • P with hR
      have hRval : ∀ y, R.1 y = D.1 y - D.1 a * P.1 y := by
        intro y
        rfl
      have hDR : D = R + D.1 a • P := by rw [hR]; abel
      have hRs : R.1.support ⊆ s := by
        intro y hy
        change R.1 y ≠ 0 at hy
        rw [hRval, hPa] at hy
        by_cases hya : y = a
        · subst hya; simp at hy
        · rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp (hDs (by simpa [hya] using hy)) with h | h
          · exact absurd h hya
          · exact h
      have hRS : R.1.support ⊆ S := by
        intro y hy
        change R.1 y ≠ 0 at hy
        rw [hRval, hPa] at hy
        by_cases hya : y = a
        · subst hya; exact haS
        · exact hDS (by simpa [hya] using hy)
      rw [hDR, QuotientAddGroup.mk_add, TensorProduct.tmul_add, QuotientAddGroup.mk_zsmul,
        TensorProduct.tmul_smul]
      exact M.add_mem (ih R hRS hRs) (zsmul_mem (hprime a hah haS) _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7s_cap_mem
proof:
:= by
  change c ∈ (m7sSuppSpan S m).comap (ops.cap L hL m)
  refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_ hc
  rintro _ ⟨D, hDS, rfl⟩
  refine m7s_mem_of_prime ((m7sSuppSpan S m).comap (ops.cap L hL m)) S ?_ D hDS
  intro v hv hvS
  have hrV := genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one L hL v
  have hfl := isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL v
  obtain ⟨b⟩ := Scheme.Modules.exists_lineBundleLocalDataAt (pointClosureScheme v)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj L) hfl hrV (pointClosureGenericPoint v)
  set Wd := Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hfl hrV b with hWd
  have hsupp : (properPushforward (pointClosureι v) Wd.1).support ⊆
      (pointClosureι v) '' {y | coheight y = 1} := by
    rw [properPushforward, pushforward_support_closedImmersion (pointClosureι v) Wd.1
      (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl)]
    exact Set.image_mono Wd.2
  have hgen : genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v) = pointClosureGenericPoint v :=
    ((pointClosureGenericPoint_isGeneric v).eq (genericPoint_spec _)).symm
  have hmem : properPushforward (pointClosureι v) Wd.1 ∈ dimensionCycles W m := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hsupp hx
    have h := dimensionCatenary_of_finiteType k (X := W) (pointClosureScheme v)
      (pointClosureι v) y hy
    rw [hgen, pointClosureι_genericPoint, hv] at h
    exact ENat_add_one_cancel (by simpa using h)
  change ops.cap L hL m _ ∈ m7sSuppSpan S m
  rw [ops.cap_mk L hL m v hv hrV b ⟨_, hmem⟩ rfl]
  refine m7s_mem_suppSpan _ ?_
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨y, -, rfl⟩ := hsupp hx
  have hy : pointClosureι v y ∈ closure {v} := by
    rw [← range_pointClosureι]; exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
  exact hS v _ hvS (specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr hy)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7s_pushWeil_mem
statement:
theorem m7s_pushWeil_mem (L : W.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank W L 1) (m : ℕ) (v : W)
    (hv : height v = m + 1) {b₀ : pointClosureScheme v}
    (b : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme v)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj L) b₀) :
    properPushforward (pointClosureι v) (Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame
      (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL v)
      (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one L hL v) b).1 ∈ dimensionCycles W m
proof:
:= by
  set Wd := Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame
    (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL v) (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one L hL v) b
  have hsupp : (properPushforward (pointClosureι v) Wd.1).support ⊆
      (pointClosureι v) '' {y | coheight y = 1} := by
    rw [properPushforward, pushforward_support_closedImmersion (pointClosureι v) Wd.1
      (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl)]
    exact Set.image_mono Wd.2
  have hgen : genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v) = pointClosureGenericPoint v :=
    ((pointClosureGenericPoint_isGeneric v).eq (genericPoint_spec _)).symm
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hsupp hx
  have h := dimensionCatenary_of_finiteType k (X := W) (pointClosureScheme v)
    (pointClosureι v) y hy
  rw [hgen, pointClosureι_genericPoint, hv] at h
  exact ENat_add_one_cancel (by simpa using h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7s_push_eq_zero'
statement:
theorem m7s_push_eq_zero' (f : W ⟶ V) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsProper f] (m : ℕ) (S : Set W)
    (hS : ∀ x ∈ S, height (f x) < m)
    {c : RationalDimChow W m} (hc : c ∈ m7sSuppSpan S m) :
    ops.push f m c = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hf : HeightCompatible f := heightCompatible_of_finiteType k f
  change c ∈ LinearMap.ker (ops.push f m)
  refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_ hc
  rintro _ ⟨D, hDS, rfl⟩
  change ops.push f m _ = 0
  have h0 : ((0 : dimensionCycles V m) : AlgebraicCycle V ℤ) = properPushforward f D.1 := by
    ext y
    change (0 : ℤ) = _
    rw [properPushforward_apply]
    symm
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨-, hDx⟩ := (mem_preimageSupportFinite_toFinset_iff f D.1 y x).mp hx
    have hxm : height x = m := D.2 hDx
    have hfx : height (f x) < m := hS x (hDS hDx)
    have hdeg : f.degree x = 0 := by
      by_contra hd
      have := hf x hd
      rw [hxm] at this
      rw [this] at hfx
      exact lt_irrefl _ hfx
    simp [hdeg]
  rw [ops.push_mk f m D 0 h0, QuotientAddGroup.mk_zero, TensorProduct.tmul_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F4.extendCycle_apply
statement:
theorem extendCycle_apply (j : U ⟶ X) (hj : Function.Injective j) (D' : AlgebraicCycle U ℤ)
    (u : U) : extendCycle j hj D' (j u) = D' u
proof:
:= by
  change Function.extend j D' 0 (j u) = D' u
  exact hj.extend_apply _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F4.extendCycle_apply_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem extendCycle_apply_of_not_mem (j : U ⟶ X) (hj : Function.Injective j)
    (D' : AlgebraicCycle U ℤ) (x : X) (hx : ∀ u, j u ≠ x) : extendCycle j hj D' x = 0
proof:
:= by
  change Function.extend j D' 0 x = 0
  rw [Function.extend_apply' _ _ _ (by simpa using hx)]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F4.exists_extend_dimensionCycle
proof:
:= by
  have hj : Function.Injective j := j.isOpenEmbedding.injective
  refine ⟨⟨extendCycle j hj D'.1, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    by_cases hr : ∃ u, j u = x
    · obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hr
      show height (j u) = (n : ℕ∞)
      rw [m6pb_height_openImmersion k j u]
      refine D'.2 ?_
      intro h
      apply hx
      change extendCycle j hj D'.1 (j u) = 0
      rw [extendCycle_apply]
      exact h
    · exact absurd (extendCycle_apply_of_not_mem j hj D'.1 x (by simpa using hr)) hx
  · intro u
    change extendCycle j hj D'.1 (j u) * _ = _
    rw [extendCycle_apply, flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion]
    simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F4.pull_openImmersion_surjective
statement:
theorem pull_openImmersion_surjective (j : U ⟶ X) [j.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (ops.pull j 0 (pureRelDim_openImmersion k j) n)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ D' : dimensionCycles U n,
      (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D' : DimChow U n) ∈
        LinearMap.range (ops.pull j 0 (pureRelDim_openImmersion k j) n) := by
    intro D'
    obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := exists_extend_dimensionCycle (k := k) j D'
    refine ⟨(1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X n), ?_⟩
    exact ops.pull_mk j 0 (pureRelDim_openImmersion k j) n D D' (fun u ↦ (hD u).symm)
  intro z
  change z ∈ LinearMap.range (ops.pull j 0 (pureRelDim_openImmersion k j) n)
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | tmul q a =>
    obtain ⟨D', rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective a
    change q ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (D' : dimensionCycles U n) : DimChow U n) ∈ _
    have : q ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (D' : dimensionCycles U n) : DimChow U n) =
        q • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (D' : dimensionCycles U n) : DimChow U n)) := by
      rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    rw [this]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ q (key D')
  | add y z hy hz => exact Submodule.add_mem _ hy hz

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.hasConstantRank_twist
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_twist (N : ℕ) (d : ℤ) :
    HasConstantRank (space k N) (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N d) 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨projectiveTwistingLocalGeneratorsData k N d, inferInstance, inferInstance, fun _ ↦ by
    change Nat.card PUnit = 1
    exact Nat.card_unique⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.range_comp_iso
statement:
theorem range_comp_iso {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (e : X ≅ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    Set.range (e.hom ≫ g) = Set.range g
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨e.hom x, by rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨e.inv y, ?_⟩
    rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply e.inv e.hom, e.inv_hom_id]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.range_fst_of_isPullback
statement:
theorem range_fst_of_isPullback {P X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} {fst : P ⟶ X} {snd : P ⟶ Y} {f : X ⟶ Z}
    {g : Y ⟶ Z} (H : IsPullback fst snd f g) : Set.range fst = f ⁻¹' Set.range g
proof:
:= by
  rw [← H.isoPullback_hom_fst, range_comp_iso]
  exact Scheme.Pullback.range_fst f g

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.range_snd_of_isPullback
statement:
theorem range_snd_of_isPullback {P X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} {fst : P ⟶ X} {snd : P ⟶ Y} {f : X ⟶ Z}
    {g : Y ⟶ Z} (H : IsPullback fst snd f g) : Set.range snd = g ⁻¹' Set.range f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← H.isoPullback_hom_snd, range_comp_iso]
  exact Scheme.Pullback.range_snd f g

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.jU_toBase_mem
statement:
theorem jU_toBase_mem (y : blowup (J.ideal U)) :
    totalGlobalToBase Y J (jU Y J U y) ∈ (U.1 : Set Y)
proof:
:= by
  have h : jU Y J U ≫ totalGlobalToBase Y J =
      (blowupι (J.ideal U) ≫ totalAffineToOpen Y J U) ≫ U.1.ι := by
    rw [Category.assoc, totalAffineι_toBase, Category.assoc]
  have := congrArg (fun q => q y) h
  simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at this
  change totalGlobalToBase Y J (totalAffineι Y J U (blowupι (J.ideal U) y)) ∈ _
  rw [this]
  rw [← Scheme.Opens.range_ι U.1]
  exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.preimage_jU_eq
statement:
theorem preimage_jU_eq :
    componentToTotal Y J ⁻¹ᵁ (jU Y J U).opensRange = (exceptionalToComponent Y J U).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hx
    have h1 : totalGlobalToBase Y J (componentToTotal Y J x) ∈ (U.1 : Set Y) := by
      rw [← hy]; exact jU_toBase_mem Y J U y
    have h2 : J.subschemeι (componentToCentre Y J x) ∈ (U.1 : Set Y) := by
      have := congrArg (fun q => q x) (componentToTotal_toBase Y J)
      simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at this
      rw [← this]; exact h1
    have h3 : componentToCentre Y J x ∈ Set.range (J.subschemeCover.f U) := by
      have := (J.opensRange_subschemeCover_map U)
      have h4 : componentToCentre Y J x ∈ (J.subschemeCover.f U).opensRange := by
        rw [this]; exact h2
      exact h4
    have hr := range_fst_of_isPullback (exceptionalToComponent_isPullback Y J U)
    have h5 : x ∈ Set.range (exceptionalToComponent Y J U) := by
      rw [hr]; exact h3
    exact h5
  · rintro ⟨e, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨exceptionalι (centreIdeal (J.ideal U)) e, ?_⟩
    have := congrArg (fun q => q e) (exceptionalToComponent_toTotal Y J U)
    simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at this
    exact this.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.isPullback_exceptional_jU
statement:
theorem isPullback_exceptional_jU :
    IsPullback (exceptionalι (centreIdeal (J.ideal U))) (exceptionalToComponent Y J U)
      (jU Y J U) (componentToTotal Y J)
proof:
:=
  IsOpenImmersion.isPullback _ _ _ _ (by simpa using exceptionalToComponent_toTotal Y J U)
    (preimage_jU_eq Y J U)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.isPullback_exceptional_chart_aff
statement:
theorem isPullback_exceptional_chart_aff {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (r : I) :
    ∃ g : Spec (.of (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grade I) (generator I r) ⧸
        I.map (baseRingHom I r))) ⟶ exceptional I,
      IsPullback g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (baseRingHom I r)))))
        (exceptionalι I) (chartMap I r)
proof:
:= by
  have hq := ExceptionalDivisor.isPullback_quotient (baseRingHom I r) I
  rw [← chartMap_projection] at hq
  exact ⟨_, IsPullback.of_right' hq (exceptional_isPullback I).flip⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.ker_specMap_top
statement:
theorem ker_specMap_top {R S : CommRingCat.{u}} (φ : R ⟶ S) :
    (Spec.map φ).ker.ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩ =
      (RingHom.ker φ.hom).comap (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).hom.hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.ker_apply]
  ext x
  have h := Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality φ
  have h2 := congrArg (fun q => q.hom x) h
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply] at h2
  simp only [RingHom.mem_ker, Ideal.mem_comap]
  change (Scheme.Hom.appTop (Spec.map φ)).hom x = 0 ↔ _
  rw [← map_eq_zero_iff (Scheme.ΓSpecIso S).hom.hom
    (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _).1, h2]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.ker_mk_hom
statement:
theorem ker_mk_hom {S : Type u} [CommRing S] (I : Ideal S) :
    RingHom.ker (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).hom = I
proof: := Ideal.mk_ker

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.exists_gen_congr
proof:
:= by
  subst h; exact hU

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.principal_exceptional_chart
statement:
theorem principal_exceptional_chart (r : centreIdeal (J.ideal U)) :
    ∃ b : Γ(totalGlobal Y J, (chartMap (centreIdeal (J.ideal U)) r ≫ jU Y J U).opensRange),
      (componentToTotal Y J).ker.ideal
        ⟨(chartMap (centreIdeal (J.ideal U)) r ≫ jU Y J U).opensRange,
          isAffineOpen_opensRange _⟩ = Ideal.span {b}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := isPullback_exceptional_chart_aff (centreIdeal (J.ideal U)) r
  have H := (hg.paste_horiz (isPullback_exceptional_jU Y J U).flip).flip
  have h1 := Scheme.ker_ideal_of_isPullback_of_isOpenImmersion
    (f := componentToTotal Y J)
    (f' := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk
      ((centreIdeal (J.ideal U)).map (baseRingHom (centreIdeal (J.ideal U)) r)))))
    (iU := g ≫ exceptionalToComponent Y J U)
    (iV := chartMap (centreIdeal (J.ideal U)) r ≫ jU Y J U) H ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩
  have hk := ker_specMap_top (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk
      ((centreIdeal (J.ideal U)).map (baseRingHom (centreIdeal (J.ideal U)) r))))
  have h1' := h1.symm.trans hk
  have hmk := ker_mk_hom ((centreIdeal (J.ideal U)).map (baseRingHom (centreIdeal (J.ideal U)) r))
  have h1'' := h1'.trans (congrArg (fun I => I.comap (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of
    (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grade (centreIdeal (J.ideal U)))
      (generator (centreIdeal (J.ideal U)) r)))).hom.hom) hmk)
  have hsp := congrArg (fun I => I.comap (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of
    (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grade (centreIdeal (J.ideal U)))
      (generator (centreIdeal (J.ideal U)) r)))).hom.hom)
    (map_baseRingHom_eq_span_baseElement (centreIdeal (J.ideal U)) r)
  have h3 := h1''.trans hsp
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (exists_eq_span_comap_equiv_iff
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (HomogeneousLocalization.Away
      (grade (centreIdeal (J.ideal U))) (generator (centreIdeal (J.ideal U)) r)))).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
    (Ideal.span {baseElement (centreIdeal (J.ideal U)) r r.1})).2 ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := (exists_eq_span_comap_equiv_iff
    ((chartMap (centreIdeal (J.ideal U)) r ≫ jU Y J U).appIso ⊤).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
    ((componentToTotal Y J).ker.ideal ⟨(chartMap (centreIdeal (J.ideal U)) r ≫ jU Y J U) ''ᵁ ⊤,
      (isAffineOpen_top _).image_of_isOpenImmersion _⟩)).1 ⟨a, h3.trans ha⟩
  exact exists_gen_congr (componentToTotal Y J).ker
    (U := ⟨(chartMap (centreIdeal (J.ideal U)) r ≫ jU Y J U) ''ᵁ ⊤,
      (isAffineOpen_top _).image_of_isOpenImmersion _⟩)
    (V := ⟨(chartMap (centreIdeal (J.ideal U)) r ≫ jU Y J U).opensRange,
      isAffineOpen_opensRange _⟩)
    (Subtype.ext (Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange _)) ⟨b, hb⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.ideal_eq_top_of_disjoint_support
statement:
theorem ideal_eq_top_of_disjoint_support {X : Scheme.{u}} (I : X.IdealSheafData) (V : X.affineOpens)
    (h : ∀ z ∈ V.1, z ∉ I.support) : I.ideal V = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have := (V.2.fromSpec_image_zeroLocus (I.ideal V)).trans_subset
    (show X.zeroLocus (U := V.1) (I.ideal V) ∩ V ⊆ ∅ from fun z hz =>
      h z hz.2 (I.zeroLocus_inter_subset_supportSet V hz))
  simp only [Set.subset_empty_iff, Set.image_eq_empty] at this
  exact PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_empty_iff_eq_top.mp this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.locallyPrincipal_ker_of_closedImmersion
statement:
theorem locallyPrincipal_ker_of_closedImmersion {Z X : Scheme.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion f]
    (h : ∀ p ∈ Set.range f, ∃ V : X.affineOpens, p ∈ V.1 ∧
      ∃ b : Γ(X, V.1), f.ker.ideal V = Ideal.span {b}) :
    IdealSheafIsLocallyPrincipal f.ker
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  by_cases hp : p ∈ Set.range f
  · obtain ⟨V, hV, b, hb⟩ := h p hp
    exact ⟨V, hV, b, hb⟩
  · have hsupp : p ∉ (f.ker.support : Set X) := by
      rw [Scheme.Hom.support_ker]
      rwa [f.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range.closure_eq]
    have hopen : IsOpen (f.ker.support : Set X)ᶜ := f.ker.support.isClosed.isOpen_compl
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨V, hV, rfl⟩, hxV, hVs⟩ :=
      X.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open hsupp hopen
    refine ⟨⟨V, hV⟩, hxV, 1, ?_⟩
    rw [ideal_eq_top_of_disjoint_support _ ⟨V, hV⟩ (fun z hz hzs => hVs hz hzs)]
    simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.locallyPrincipal_ker_componentToTotal
statement:
theorem locallyPrincipal_ker_componentToTotal :
    IdealSheafIsLocallyPrincipal (componentToTotal Y J).ker
proof:
:= by
  refine locallyPrincipal_ker_of_closedImmersion _ ?_
  rintro p ⟨x, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨U, e, rfl⟩ := exceptionalCharts_jointly_surjective Y J x
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := (generatorAffineOpenCover (centreIdeal (J.ideal U))).covers
    (exceptionalι (centreIdeal (J.ideal U)) e)
  refine ⟨⟨(chartMap (centreIdeal (J.ideal U))
      ((generatorAffineOpenCover (centreIdeal (J.ideal U))).idx
        (exceptionalι (centreIdeal (J.ideal U)) e)) ≫ jU Y J U).opensRange,
    isAffineOpen_opensRange _⟩, ?_, principal_exceptional_chart Y J U _⟩
  refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
  have h1 : chartMap (centreIdeal (J.ideal U))
      ((generatorAffineOpenCover (centreIdeal (J.ideal U))).idx
        (exceptionalι (centreIdeal (J.ideal U)) e)) q =
      exceptionalι (centreIdeal (J.ideal U)) e := hq
  have h2 := congrArg (fun z => z e) (exceptionalToComponent_toTotal Y J U)
  simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at h2
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, h1]
  exact h2.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.pointAt_zero_not_mem_chart_zero
statement:
theorem pointAt_zero_not_mem_chart_zero {k : Type u} [CommRing k] (x : Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :
    pointAt k 0 x ∉ (chart k 0).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h1 : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (evalRingHom (0 : k)))) x ∈
      (chart k 1 ⁻¹ᵁ (chart k 0).opensRange : Set _) := h
  rw [chart_one_preimage] at h1
  have h2 : (Polynomial.X : k[X]) ∈ (PrimeSpectrum.comap (evalRingHom (0 : k)) x).asIdeal := by
    rw [PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal, Ideal.mem_comap]
    simp
  exact h1 h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.componentToTotal_ker_ne_bot
statement:
theorem componentToTotal_ker_ne_bot [IsIntegral Y] (k : Type u) [CommRing k] (φk : k →+* Γ(Y, ⊤)) :
    (componentToTotal Y J).ker ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  haveI : IsIso (componentToTotal Y J) := IsClosedImmersion.isIso_iff_ker_eq_bot.mpr h
  obtain ⟨y⟩ : Nonempty Y := inferInstance
  set q := fibreιGlobal Y J k φk 0 y with hq
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x, componentToTotal Y J x = q :=
    ⟨inv (componentToTotal Y J) q, by
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, IsIso.inv_hom_id]; rfl⟩
  have h1 : q ∈ Set.range (blowupGlobalι Y J) := by
    obtain ⟨U, e, rfl⟩ := exceptionalCharts_jointly_surjective Y J x
    have h2 := congrArg (fun z => z e) (exceptionalToComponent_toTotal Y J U)
    simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at h2
    have h3 := congrArg (fun z => z (exceptionalι (centreIdeal (J.ideal U)) e))
      (blowupι_totalAffineι Y J U)
    simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at h3
    rw [← hx, h2, h3]
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := h1
  have h2 : toP1Global Y J k φk q ∈ (chart k 0).opensRange := by
    have h4 : q ∈ (blowupGlobalι Y J).opensRange := ⟨z, hz⟩
    rw [← GlobalCompletion.preimage_opensRange_chart_zero Y J k φk] at h4
    exact h4
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k),
      s ≫ pointAt k 0 = fibreιGlobal Y J k φk 0 ≫ toP1Global Y J k φk :=
    ⟨_, (fibre_isPullback_P1Global Y J k φk 0).w⟩
  have h5 := congrArg (fun z => z y) hs
  simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at h5
  rw [← hq] at h5
  rw [← h5] at h2
  exact pointAt_zero_not_mem_chart_zero _ h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.exists_cartierData_exceptional
statement:
theorem exists_cartierData_exceptional [IsIntegral Y] (k : Type u) [CommRing k]
    (φk : k →+* Γ(Y, ⊤)) :
    ∃ (L : (totalGlobal Y J).Modules)
      (_ : SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank (totalGlobal Y J) L 1)
      (σ : SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf (totalGlobal Y J) ⟶ L),
      SectionIsRegular σ ∧ sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = (componentToTotal Y J).ker
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isIntegral_totalGlobal Y J
  exact exists_cartierLineSection _ (componentToTotal_ker_ne_bot Y J k φk)
    (locallyPrincipal_ker_componentToTotal Y J)

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulChartAlgebra.mem_ofList_X_take
statement:
theorem mem_ofList_X_take {n : ℕ} (i : ℕ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) :
    p ∈ Ideal.ofList ((List.ofFn (fun j : Fin n => (X j : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R))).take i) ↔
      ∀ m ∈ p.support, ∃ j : Fin n, (j : ℕ) < i ∧ m j ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : { r | r ∈ (List.ofFn (fun j : Fin n => (X j : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R))).take i } =
      (X '' {j : Fin n | (j : ℕ) < i} : Set (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)) := by
    ext r
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_image]
    constructor
    · intro hr
      obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hr
      simp only [List.getElem_take, List.getElem_ofFn] at *
      refine ⟨⟨k, by simp at hk; omega⟩, ?_, rfl⟩
      simp at hk; exact lt_of_lt_of_le hk.1 le_rfl
    · rintro ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
      refine List.mem_iff_getElem.mpr ⟨j, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp; omega
      · simp
  rw [Ideal.ofList, h, mem_ideal_span_X_image]
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulChartAlgebra.isWeaklyRegular_X_ofFn
statement:
theorem isWeaklyRegular_X_ofFn (n : ℕ) :
    RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)
      (List.ofFn (fun j : Fin n => (X j : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [RingTheory.Sequence.isWeaklyRegular_iff_Fin]
  intro i
  have hi : (i : ℕ) < n := by simpa using i.2
  set k : Fin n := ⟨i, hi⟩ with hk
  have hget : (List.ofFn (fun j : Fin n => (X j : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)))[i] = X k := by
    simp [hk]
  set I := Ideal.ofList ((List.ofFn (fun j : Fin n => (X j : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R))).take i)
    with hI
  have hsm : (I • (⊤ : Submodule (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R))) = I := by
    simp
  rw [hget]
  intro a b hab
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ a
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ b
  have hab' : (Submodule.Quotient.mk ((X k : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) • p) :
      MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ (I • (⊤ : Submodule (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)))) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk ((X k : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) • q) := by
    rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul]
    exact hab
  have h1 := (Submodule.Quotient.eq _).mp hab'
  rw [hsm, ← smul_sub, smul_eq_mul, hI, mem_ofList_X_take] at h1
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.eq, hsm, hI, mem_ofList_X_take]
  intro m hm
  have hm' : m + Finsupp.single k 1 ∈ (X k * (p - q)).support := by
    rw [mul_comm, MvPolynomial.support_mul_X]
    exact Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hmj⟩ := h1 _ hm'
  refine ⟨j, hj, ?_⟩
  have hne : j ≠ k := by
    intro h; rw [h] at hj; simp [hk] at hj
  simpa [Finsupp.single_apply, hne.symm] using hmj

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulChartAlgebra.ker_constantCoeff_eq_span_X
statement:
theorem ker_constantCoeff_eq_span_X (n : ℕ) :
    RingHom.ker (MvPolynomial.constantCoeff : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R →+* R) =
      Ideal.span (Set.range (fun j : Fin n => (X j : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)))
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker]
  have h : Set.range (fun j : Fin n => (X j : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)) =
      (X '' (Set.univ : Set (Fin n)) : Set (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)) := by
    ext r; simp
  rw [h, mem_ideal_span_X_image]
  constructor
  · intro h0 m hm
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    have : m = 0 := by
      ext i; simpa using hcon i trivial
    subst this
    apply (mem_support_iff.mp hm)
    simpa [constantCoeff_eq] using h0
  · intro h
    by_contra h0
    have hm : (0 : Fin n →₀ ℕ) ∈ p.support := by
      rw [mem_support_iff]; simpa [constantCoeff_eq] using h0
    obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ := h _ hm
    simp at hi

theorem rankTwo_fstGradedQuotientMap_inverse_apply (a : SymmetricAlgebra R R) :
    rankTwo_fstGradedQuotientMap R (rankTwo_fstGradedQuotientInverse R a) = a
proof:
:= by
  change symmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) (LinearMap.fst R R R)
    (symmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) (LinearMap.inl R R R) a) = a
  let j : SymmetricAlgebra R R →ₐ[R] SymmetricAlgebra R (R × R) :=
    SymmetricAlgebra.lift (symmetricGeneratorLinearMap (S := R) (LinearMap.inl R R R))
  let f : SymmetricAlgebra R (R × R) →ₐ[R] SymmetricAlgebra R R :=
    SymmetricAlgebra.lift (symmetricGeneratorLinearMap (S := R) (LinearMap.fst R R R))
  have h : f.comp j = AlgHom.id R (SymmetricAlgebra R R) := by
    apply SymmetricAlgebra.algHom_ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro b
    change f (j (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R R b)) = SymmetricAlgebra.ι R R b
    rw [SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply]
    change symmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) (LinearMap.fst R R R)
      (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (R × R) (b, 0)) = _
    rw [symmetricAlgebraMap_ι]
    rfl
  exact congrArg (fun h : SymmetricAlgebra R R →ₐ[R] SymmetricAlgebra R R ↦ h a) h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_awayEquation_isRegular
statement:
theorem rankTwo_awayEquation_isRegular
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → Submodule R A) [GradedAlgebra 𝒜]
    (s f : A) (hs : s ∈ 𝒜 1) (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 1) (hr : IsRegular s) :
    IsRegular (GradedIdealQuotient.awayEquation 𝒜 s f hs hf)
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : ∀ z : HomogeneousLocalization.Away 𝒜 f,
      GradedIdealQuotient.awayEquation 𝒜 s f hs hf * z = 0 → z = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨m, a, ha, rfl⟩ := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_surjective 𝒜 hf z
    have hv := congrArg HomogeneousLocalization.val hz
    simp only [GradedIdealQuotient.awayEquation, HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul,
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, Localization.mk_mul,
      HomogeneousLocalization.val_zero] at hv
    rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk'] at hv
    obtain ⟨⟨_, r, rfl⟩, he⟩ := (IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff _ _).mp hv
    have he' : s * (f ^ r * a) = s * 0 := by
      rw [mul_zero]
      calc
        s * (f ^ r * a) = f ^ r * (s * a) := by ring
        _ = 0 := he
    have ha0 : f ^ r * a = 0 :=
      (Commute.isRegular_iff (Commute.all s)).mp hr he'
    apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
    simp only [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.val_zero]
    rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk', IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff]
    exact ⟨⟨_, r, rfl⟩, ha0⟩
  apply (Commute.isRegular_iff (Commute.all _)).mpr
  intro x y hxy
  change GradedIdealQuotient.awayEquation 𝒜 s f hs hf * x =
    GradedIdealQuotient.awayEquation 𝒜 s f hs hf * y at hxy
  have h : GradedIdealQuotient.awayEquation 𝒜 s f hs hf * (x - y) = 0 := by
    rw [mul_sub, hxy, sub_self]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hzero (x - y) h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_symmetric_basis_coordinate_isRegular

    {ι M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]

proof:

  let e := SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b

  intro a c h
  apply e.injective
  have he := congrArg e h
  simp only [e, map_mul, SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial_ι_apply] at he
  exact MvPolynomial.X_mul_cancel_left_iff.mp he

proof:
:= by
  let U := linearAffineOpenCover R (R × R) (rankTwo_splitBasis R)
  refine ⟨U.idx x, ?_, rankTwo_sndPrincipalChart_isRegular R _ _⟩
  exact U.covers x

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.gradedMap_coordinateOverlapEquation
statement:
theorem gradedMap_coordinateOverlapEquation (φ : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    gradedMap φ n (coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j) = coordinateOverlapEquation S n i j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coordinateOverlapEquation, map_mul, gradedMap_coordinate]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.awayCast_mk_two
statement:
private theorem awayCast_mk_two {T : Type u} [CommRing T] (n m : ℕ)
    {p q : Polynomial T n} (h : p = q)
    (hp : p ∈ grading T n 2) (r : Polynomial T n) (hr : r ∈ grading T n (m • 2)) :
    (RingEquiv.cast
        (R := fun x : Polynomial T n ↦
          HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading T n) x) h).toRingHom
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading T n) hp m r hr) =
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading T n) (h ▸ hp) m r hr
proof:
:= by
  subst q
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapMapNormalized_ratio
statement:
theorem coordinateOverlapMapNormalized_ratio (φ : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateOverlapMapNormalized φ n i j (coordinateOverlapRatio R n i j) =
      coordinateOverlapRatio S n i j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coordinateOverlapMapNormalized, RingHom.comp_apply, coordinateOverlapRatio,
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map_mk, map_pow, gradedMap_coordinate]
  exact awayCast_mk_two n 1 (gradedMap_coordinateOverlapEquation φ n i j) _
    (coordinate S n j ^ 2) _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapMapNormalized_ratioUnit
statement:
theorem coordinateOverlapMapNormalized_ratioUnit (φ : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Units.map (coordinateOverlapMapNormalized φ n i j : _ →* _)
        (coordinateOverlapRatioUnit R n i j) =
      coordinateOverlapRatioUnit S n i j
proof:
:= by
  exact Units.ext (coordinateOverlapMapNormalized_ratio φ n i j)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapMapNormalized_twistTransitionUnit
statement:
theorem coordinateOverlapMapNormalized_twistTransitionUnit
    (φ : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Units.map (coordinateOverlapMapNormalized φ n i j : _ →* _)
        (twistTransitionUnit R n d i j) =
      twistTransitionUnit S n d i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [twistTransitionUnit, twistTransitionUnit, map_zpow,
    coordinateOverlapMapNormalized_ratioUnit]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.awayι_eq_of_eq_two
statement:
theorem awayι_eq_of_eq_two {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (n : ℕ)
    {p q : Polynomial R n} (h : p = q) (hp : p ∈ grading R n 2) :
    Proj.awayι (grading R n) q (h ▸ hp) (by omega) =
      Spec.map (RingEquiv.cast
          (R := fun x : Polynomial R n ↦
            HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading R n) x) h).toCommRingCatIso.hom ≫
        Proj.awayι (grading R n) p hp (by omega)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  have he :
      RingEquiv.cast
          (R := fun x : Polynomial R n ↦
            HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading R n) x) (Eq.refl p) =
        RingEquiv.refl _ :=
    rfl
  simp [he, Spec.map_id]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapAwayι_eq_targetEquiv_comp
statement:
theorem coordinateOverlapAwayι_eq_targetEquiv_comp
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Proj.awayι (grading S n) (coordinateOverlapEquation S n i j)
        (coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two S n i j) (by omega) =
      Spec.map (RingEquiv.cast
        (R := fun x : Polynomial S n ↦
          HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading S n) x)
        (gradedMap_coordinateOverlapEquation f n i j)).toCommRingCatIso.hom ≫
        Proj.awayι (grading S n)
          (gradedMap f n (coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j))
          ((gradedMap f n).map_mem
            (coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two R n i j)) (by omega)
proof:
:=
  awayι_eq_of_eq_two n
    (gradedMap_coordinateOverlapEquation f n i j)
    ((gradedMap f n).map_mem
      (coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two R n i j))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Spec_map_coordinateOverlapMapNormalized
statement:
theorem Spec_map_coordinateOverlapMapNormalized
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (coordinateOverlapMapNormalized f n i j)) =
      Spec.map (RingEquiv.cast
        (R := fun x : Polynomial S n ↦
          HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading S n) x)
        (gradedMap_coordinateOverlapEquation f n i j)).toCommRingCatIso.hom ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map (gradedMap f n)
            (coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j)))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coordinateOverlapMapNormalized, CommRingCat.ofHom_comp,
    Spec.map_comp, RingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso_hom]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapAwayι_comp_map_normalized
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem coordinateOverlapAwayι_comp_map_normalized
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Proj.awayι (grading S n) (coordinateOverlapEquation S n i j)
        (coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two S n i j) (by omega) ≫
        map f n =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (coordinateOverlapMapNormalized f n i j)) ≫
        Proj.awayι (grading R n) (coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j)
          (coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two R n i j) (by omega)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateOverlapAwayι_eq_targetEquiv_comp
    (R := R) (S := S) f n i j]
  dsimp only [space, map]
  rw [Category.assoc, Proj.awayι_comp_map
    (gradedMap f n) (irrelevant_le_map_gradedMap f n) (by omega)
    (coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j)
    (coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two R n i j)]
  rw [← Category.assoc,
    ← Spec_map_coordinateOverlapMapNormalized (R := R) (S := S) f n i j]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.awayToSection_cast_heq
statement:
private theorem awayToSection_cast_heq
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (n : ℕ)
    {p q : Polynomial R n} (h : p = q)
    (x : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading R n) p) :
    HEq (Proj.awayToSection (grading R n) p x)
      (Proj.awayToSection (grading R n) q
        ((RingEquiv.cast
          (R := fun z : Polynomial R n ↦
            HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading R n) z) h) x))
proof:
:= by
  subst q
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapAwayToSection_map_heq
statement:
private theorem coordinateOverlapAwayToSection_map_heq
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) (i j : Fin (n + 1))
    (x : CoordinateOverlapRing R n i j) :
    HEq
      (Proj.awayToSection (grading S n)
        (gradedMap f n (coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j))
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map (gradedMap f n)
          (coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j) x))
      (Proj.awayToSection (grading S n)
        (coordinateOverlapEquation S n i j)
        (coordinateOverlapMapNormalized f n i j x))
proof:
:= by
  exact awayToSection_cast_heq n
    (gradedMap_coordinateOverlapEquation f n i j)
    (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map (gradedMap f n)
      (coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j) x)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapAwayToSection_comp_appLE_raw
statement:
private theorem coordinateOverlapAwayToSection_comp_appLE_raw
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Proj.awayToSection (grading R n)
        (coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j) ≫
      (map f n).appLE (coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j)
        (Proj.basicOpen (grading S n)
          (gradedMap f n (coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j)))
        (by
          have hpre :
              map f n ⁻¹ᵁ coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j =
                Proj.basicOpen (grading S n)
                  (gradedMap f n (coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j)) := by
            simpa only [coordinateOverlapOpen, map] using
              Proj.map_preimage_basicOpen (gradedMap f n)
                (irrelevant_le_map_gradedMap f n)
                (coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j)
          exact hpre.ge) =
      CommRingCat.ofHom
          (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map (gradedMap f n)
            (coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j)) ≫
        Proj.awayToSection (grading S n)
          (gradedMap f n (coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j))
proof:
:= by
  exact Proj.awayToSection_comp_appLE (gradedMap f n)
    (irrelevant_le_map_gradedMap f n)
    (coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two R n i j)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapSectionMapRaw_twistTransitionSectionUnit_heq
statement:
theorem coordinateOverlapSectionMapRaw_twistTransitionSectionUnit_heq
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    HEq
      (coordinateOverlapSectionMapRaw f n i j
        (twistTransitionSectionUnit R n d i j).1)
      (twistTransitionSectionUnit S n d i j).1
proof:
:= by
  have hcomm := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (coordinateOverlapAwayToSection_comp_appLE_raw f n i j)
    (twistTransitionUnit R n d i j).1
  change
    coordinateOverlapSectionMapRaw f n i j
        (Proj.awayToSection (grading R n)
          (coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j)
          (twistTransitionUnit R n d i j).1) =
      Proj.awayToSection (grading S n)
        (gradedMap f n (coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j))
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map (gradedMap f n)
          (coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j)
          (twistTransitionUnit R n d i j).1) at hcomm
  have hraw :
      coordinateOverlapSectionMapRaw f n i j
          (twistTransitionSectionUnit R n d i j).1 =
        Proj.awayToSection (grading S n)
          (gradedMap f n (coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j))
          (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map (gradedMap f n)
            (coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j)
            (twistTransitionUnit R n d i j).1) := by
    simpa [coordinateOverlapSectionMapRaw,
      twistTransitionSectionUnit, Proj.basicOpenIsoAway_hom,
      ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] using hcomm
  have hcast := coordinateOverlapAwayToSection_map_heq f n i j
    (twistTransitionUnit R n d i j).1
  have hunit :
      coordinateOverlapMapNormalized f n i j
          (twistTransitionUnit R n d i j).1 =
        (twistTransitionUnit S n d i j).1 :=
    congrArg Units.val
      (coordinateOverlapMapNormalized_twistTransitionUnit
        f n d i j)
  have hcanonical :
      Proj.awayToSection (grading S n)
          (coordinateOverlapEquation S n i j)
          (coordinateOverlapMapNormalized f n i j
            (twistTransitionUnit R n d i j).1) =
        (twistTransitionSectionUnit S n d i j).1 := by
    rw [hunit]
    rfl
  exact (heq_of_eq hraw).trans (hcast.trans (heq_of_eq hcanonical))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.appLE_eq_app_heq
statement:
private theorem appLE_eq_app_heq
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (U : Y.Opens) (V : X.Opens)
    (h : f ⁻¹ᵁ U = V) (x : Γ(Y, U)) :
    HEq (f.appLE U V h.ge x) (f.app U x)
proof:
:= by
  subst V
  simp [Scheme.Hom.appLE]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.map_app_twistTransitionSectionUnit_heq
statement:
theorem map_app_twistTransitionSectionUnit_heq
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    HEq
      ((map f n).app (coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j)
        (twistTransitionSectionUnit R n d i j).1)
      (twistTransitionSectionUnit S n d i j).1
proof:
:= by
  let Vraw := Proj.basicOpen (grading S n)
    (gradedMap f n (coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j))
  have hpre :
      map f n ⁻¹ᵁ coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j = Vraw := by
    simpa only [coordinateOverlapOpen, map] using
      Proj.map_preimage_basicOpen (gradedMap f n)
        (irrelevant_le_map_gradedMap f n)
        (coordinateOverlapEquation R n i j)
  have happ := appLE_eq_app_heq (map f n)
    (coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j) Vraw hpre
    (twistTransitionSectionUnit R n d i j).1
  have hraw :=
    coordinateOverlapSectionMapRaw_twistTransitionSectionUnit_heq
      f n d i j
  exact happ.symm.trans hraw

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit_sections_eq
statement:
theorem pushedUnit_sections_eq {X : Scheme.{u}} (U W : X.Opens) :
    Γ(pushedUnit X U, W) =
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat ⋙ forget₂ RingCat Ab).obj
        Γ(X, U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Opens.ι_image_preimage_inf
statement:
theorem ι_image_preimage_inf (V U : X.Opens) (W : V.toScheme.Opens) :
    V.ι ''ᵁ ((V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U) ⊓ W) = U ⊓ (V.ι ''ᵁ W)
