name: SchemeKTheory.locMap_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
lemma locMap_algebraMap {Z W : Scheme.{u}} (f : K0 Z →+* K0 W) (x : K0 Z) :
    locMap (j := j) f (algebraMap _ _ x) = algebraMap _ _ (f x)
proof:
:=
  IsLocalization.map_eq _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.locMap_injective
statement:
lemma locMap_injective {Z W : Scheme.{u}} (f : K0 Z →+* K0 W) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Function.Injective (locMap (j := j) f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨a, m, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.mk'_surjective (Submonoid.powers ((j : ℕ) : K0 Z)) z
  rw [locMap, IsLocalization.map_mk', IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff] at hz
  obtain ⟨⟨_, k, rfl⟩, hk⟩ := hz
  rw [IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff]
  refine ⟨⟨_, k, rfl⟩, hf ?_⟩
  simpa using hk

name: SchemeKTheory.lambdaMinusOne_eq_sum
statement:
lemma lambdaMinusOne_eq_sum {X : Scheme.{u}} (V : X.Modules) {r : ℕ}
    (hV : HasConstantRank X V r) :
    lambdaMinusOne V hV =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), (-1 : K0 X) ^ n * lambdaClass X V hV.isFiniteLocallyFree n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lambdaMinusOne, lambdaPolynomial, eval_finsetSum, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_pow, eval_X]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => mul_comm _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.pull_lambdaMinusOne_flagTower
statement:
theorem pull_lambdaMinusOne_flagTower {X : Scheme.{u}} {V : X.Modules} {r : ℕ}
    (T : FlagTower V r) (hV : HasConstantRank X V r) :
    flatPullbackK0RingHom T.q (lambdaMinusOne V hV) =
      ∏ i, (1 - k0ClassOf T.Y (T.L i) (T.rankOne i).isFiniteLocallyFree)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lambdaMinusOne, ← eval_map_apply, T.map_lambdaPolynomial hV, map_neg, map_one, eval_prod]
  simp [sub_eq_add_neg]

name: SchemeKTheory.adams_lambdaMinusOne
statement:
theorem adams_lambdaMinusOne {j : ℕ} (H : AdamsBottFamily.{u} j) {X : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian X] (V : X.Modules) {r : ℕ} (hV : HasConstantRank X V r) :
    algebraMap (K0 X) (KLoc j X) (H.adams X (lambdaMinusOne V hV)) =
      ((H.bott X (Multiplicative.ofAdd (k0ClassOf X V hV.isFiniteLocallyFree)) : (KLoc j X)ˣ) :
        KLoc j X) * algebraMap (K0 X) (KLoc j X) (lambdaMinusOne V hV)
proof:
:= by
  let T := flagTower r V hV
  have hinj : Function.Injective (flatPullbackK0RingHom T.q) := by
    have h := splitting_injective pbInjectiveHyp hV
    intro a b hab
    apply h
    simpa using hab
  apply locMap_injective (j := j) _ hinj
  rw [map_mul, locMap_algebraMap, locMap_algebraMap, H.bott_pull, H.adams_pull,
    pull_lambdaMinusOne_flagTower T hV, flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply, T.pullback_class_eq_sum,
    ofAdd_sum, map_prod (H.bott T.Y), Units.coe_prod]
  rw [Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => H.bott_line T.Y (T.L i) (T.rankOne i)]
  rw [← map_prod (algebraMap (K0 T.Y) (KLoc j T.Y)), ← map_mul]
  have h := ARR.adams_prod_one_sub Finset.univ
    (H.adams T.Y) j (fun i => k0ClassOf T.Y (T.L i) (T.rankOne i).isFiniteLocallyFree)
    fun i _ => H.adams_line T.Y (T.L i) (T.rankOne i)
  simp only [sub_eq_add_neg] at h ⊢
  exact congrArg (algebraMap (K0 T.Y) (KLoc j T.Y)) h

name: SchemeKTheory.adams_push_zeroSection
statement:
theorem adams_push_zeroSection {j : ℕ} (H : AdamsBottFamily.{u} j) {Z P : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian P] (p : P ⟶ Z) [Flat p] (sPull : K0 P →+* K0 Z)
    (hsp : ∀ x, sPull (flatPullbackK0RingHom p x) = x)
    (push : K0 Z →+ K0 P) (pushLoc : KLoc j Z →+ KLoc j P)
    (hpushLoc : ∀ x, pushLoc (algebraMap _ _ x) = algebraMap _ _ (push x))
    (proj : ∀ y x, pushLoc (locMap sPull y * x) = y * pushLoc x)
    (Q : P.Modules) {d : ℕ} (hQ : HasConstantRank P Q d)
    (koszul : push 1 = lambdaMinusOne Q hQ)
    (N : K0 Z)
    (hθ : locMap sPull ((H.bott P (Multiplicative.ofAdd (k0ClassOf P Q hQ.isFiniteLocallyFree)) :
      (KLoc j P)ˣ) : KLoc j P) = ((H.bott Z (Multiplicative.ofAdd N) : (KLoc j Z)ˣ) : KLoc j Z))
    (x : K0 Z) :
    algebraMap (K0 P) (KLoc j P) (H.adams P (push x)) =
      pushLoc (algebraMap _ _ (H.adams Z x) *
        ((H.bott Z (Multiplicative.ofAdd N) : (KLoc j Z)ˣ) : KLoc j Z))
proof:
:= by
  
  let ψZ : KLoc j Z →+* KLoc j Z := locMap (H.adams Z)
  let ψP : KLoc j P →+* KLoc j P := locMap (H.adams P)
  let pL : KLoc j Z →+* KLoc j P := locMap (flatPullbackK0RingHom p)
  let sL : KLoc j P →+* KLoc j Z := locMap sPull
  have hsL : ∀ z, sL (pL z) = z := by
    intro z
    have : sL.comp pL = RingHom.id _ := by
      apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers ((j : ℕ) : K0 Z))
      ext a
      simp only [RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, sL, pL, locMap_algebraMap, hsp,
        RingHom.id_apply]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun this z
  have hψp : ∀ z, ψP (pL z) = pL (ψZ z) := by
    intro z
    have : ψP.comp pL = pL.comp ψZ := by
      apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers ((j : ℕ) : K0 Z))
      ext a
      simp only [RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, ψP, pL, ψZ, locMap_algebraMap,
        H.adams_pull]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun this z
  have key := ARR.adams_push_of_koszul ψZ ψP pL sL hsL hψp pushLoc proj
    (algebraMap _ _ (lambdaMinusOne Q hQ))
    ((H.bott P (Multiplicative.ofAdd (k0ClassOf P Q hQ.isFiniteLocallyFree)) : (KLoc j P)ˣ) :
      KLoc j P)
    ((H.bott Z (Multiplicative.ofAdd N) : (KLoc j Z)ˣ) : KLoc j Z)
    (by rw [← map_one (algebraMap (K0 Z) (KLoc j Z)), hpushLoc, koszul])
    (by simp only [ψP, locMap_algebraMap]; exact adams_lambdaMinusOne H Q hQ) hθ
    (algebraMap _ _ x)
  simp only [ψP, ψZ, hpushLoc, locMap_algebraMap] at key
  exact key

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerK0.k0ClassOf_of_isZero
statement:
theorem k0ClassOf_of_isZero {A : X.Modules} (hA : IsFiniteLocallyFree X A) (h : IsZero A) :
    k0ClassOf X A hA = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [k0ClassOf_iso X hA (zero_isFiniteLocallyFree X) h.isoZero, k0ClassOf_zero]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerK0.k0ClassOf_biprod
statement:
theorem k0ClassOf_biprod {A B : X.Modules} (hA : IsFiniteLocallyFree X A)
    (hB : IsFiniteLocallyFree X B) (hAB : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (A ⊞ B)) :
    k0ClassOf X (A ⊞ B) hAB = k0ClassOf X A hA + k0ClassOf X B hB
proof:
:=
  k0ClassOf_eq_add_of_shortExact X hA hAB hB (f := biprod.inl) (g := biprod.snd) (by simp)
    ⟨(ShortComplex.Splitting.ofHasBinaryBiproduct A B).exact⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerK0.TwFree.isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem TwFree.isFiniteLocallyFree {N Y : X.Modules} (hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree X N)
    (h : TwFree N Y) : IsFiniteLocallyFree X Y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, _, ⟨e⟩⟩ := h
  exact isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso X e.symm
    (tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree X _ N (free_isFiniteLocallyFree X I) hN)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerK0.TwFree.of_isZero
statement: theorem TwFree.of_isZero (N : X.Modules) {Y : X.Modules} (hY : IsZero Y) : TwFree N Y
proof:
:=
  ⟨ULift.{u} Empty, inferInstance, ⟨hY.iso ((tensorSheafRightFunctor X N).map_isZero
    ((isZero_zero _).of_iso (SheafOfModules.freeEmptyIsoZero (R := X.ringCatSheaf))))⟩⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerK0.TwFree.biprod
statement:
theorem TwFree.biprod {N A B : X.Modules} (hA : TwFree N A) (hB : TwFree N B) :
    TwFree N (A ⊞ B)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, _, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hA
  obtain ⟨J, _, ⟨e'⟩⟩ := hB
  haveI : PreservesBinaryBiproducts (tensorSheafRightFunctor X N) :=
    preservesBinaryBiproducts_of_preservesBiproducts _
  exact ⟨I ⊕ J, inferInstance, ⟨biprod.mapIso e e' ≪≫
    ((tensorSheafRightFunctor X N).mapBiprod _ _).symm ≪≫
    (tensorSheafRightFunctor X N).mapIso (freeBinaryIso X I J)⟩⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerK0.TwFree.self
statement: theorem TwFree.self (N : X.Modules) : TwFree N N
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨PUnit.{u + 1}, inferInstance, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  have e1 : (tensorSheafRightFunctor X N).obj (tensorUnitSheaf X) ≅
      tensorSheaf X (tensorUnitSheaf X) N := Iso.refl _
  have e2 : (tensorSheafRightFunctor X N).obj
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit.{u + 1}) ≅
      (tensorSheafRightFunctor X N).obj (tensorUnitSheaf X) :=
    (tensorSheafRightFunctor X N).mapIso (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf))
  exact (e2 ≪≫ e1 ≪≫ tensorSheafLeftUnitor X N).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerK0.kos_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem kos_isFiniteLocallyFree (m : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (k : ℕ) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) (((kos R n m).K d).X k)
proof:
:=
  TwFree.isFiniteLocallyFree (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n (d + m - k))
    (Koszul.KData.kos_good _ _ _ m d k _ rfl _ (fun _ h ↦ TwFree.of_isZero _ h)
      (fun _ _ h h' ↦ h.biprod h') (TwFree.self _))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.EulerK0.kos_classOf
statement:
theorem kos_classOf (m : ℕ) : ∀ (d : ℤ) (k : ℕ),
    k0ClassOf _ (((kos R n m).K d).X k) (kos_isFiniteLocallyFree R n m d k) =
      (m.choose k : K0 (space R n)) * projectiveTwistingK0Class R n (d + m - k)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro d k
    cases k with
    | zero =>
      obtain ⟨e⟩ := Koszul.KData.kos_X0 (fun d ↦ projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d) (Koszul.x R n)
        (Koszul.x_comm R n) 0 d
      rw [k0ClassOf_iso _ _ (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n _) e]
      simp [projectiveTwistingK0Class]
    | succ k =>
      rw [k0ClassOf_of_isZero _ (Koszul.KData.kos_isZero _ _ _ 0 d (k + 1) (by omega)),
        Nat.choose_zero_succ, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul]
  | succ m ih =>
    intro d k
    cases k with
    | zero =>
      refine (k0ClassOf_biprod (kos_isFiniteLocallyFree R n m (d + 1) 0)
        (zero_isFiniteLocallyFree _ :
          IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) (Koszul.sh ((kos R n m).K d) 0)) _).trans ?_
      rw [ih (d + 1) 0, k0ClassOf_zero, add_zero, Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.choose_zero_right]
      congr 2
      push_cast
      ring
    | succ k =>
      refine (k0ClassOf_biprod (kos_isFiniteLocallyFree R n m (d + 1) (k + 1))
        (kos_isFiniteLocallyFree R n m d k) _).trans ?_
      rw [ih (d + 1) (k + 1), ih d k]
      have e1 : d + 1 + ((m : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) =
          d + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by push_cast; ring
      have e2 : d + ((m : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((k : ℕ) : ℤ) =
          d + ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [e1, e2, Nat.choose_succ_succ']
      push_cast
      ring

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.euler_shortExact
statement:
theorem euler_shortExact :
    (ShortComplex.mk (kernel.ι (eulerMap R n)) (eulerMap R n) (kernel.condition _)).ShortExact where
  exact
proof:
:= ShortComplex.exact_kernel _
  mono_f := inferInstance
  epi_g := inferInstance

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.eulerKernel_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement: theorem eulerKernel_isFiniteLocallyFree : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) (eulerKernel R n)
proof:
:=
  isFiniteLocallyFree_kernel _ (kos_isFiniteLocallyFree R n (n + 1) _ 1)
    (kos_isFiniteLocallyFree R n (n + 1) _ 0) (eulerMap R n)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.eulerKoszul_one_classOf
statement:
theorem eulerKoszul_one_classOf :
    k0ClassOf _ ((eulerKoszul R n).X 1) (kos_isFiniteLocallyFree R n (n + 1) _ 1) =
      ((n + 1 : ℕ) : K0 (space R n)) * projectiveTwistingK0Class R n (-1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [kos_classOf, Nat.choose_one_right]
  congr 2
  push_cast
  ring

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.eulerKoszul_zero_classOf
statement:
theorem eulerKoszul_zero_classOf :
    k0ClassOf _ ((eulerKoszul R n).X 0) (kos_isFiniteLocallyFree R n (n + 1) _ 0) = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine (kos_classOf R n (n + 1) (-((n : ℤ) + 1)) 0).trans ?_
  rw [Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.cast_one, one_mul, ← projectiveTwistingK0Class_zero R n]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  ring

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.eulerKernel_classOf_add_one
statement:
theorem eulerKernel_classOf_add_one :
    k0ClassOf _ (eulerKernel R n) (eulerKernel_isFiniteLocallyFree R n) + 1 =
      (n + 1) • projectiveTwistingK0Class R n (-1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := k0ClassOf_eq_add_of_shortExact (space R n) (eulerKernel_isFiniteLocallyFree R n)
    (kos_isFiniteLocallyFree R n (n + 1) _ 1) (kos_isFiniteLocallyFree R n (n + 1) _ 0)
    _ (euler_shortExact R n)
  rw [eulerKoszul_one_classOf, eulerKoszul_zero_classOf] at h
  rw [← h, nsmul_eq_mul]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.eulerKernel_classOf
statement:
theorem eulerKernel_classOf :
    k0ClassOf _ (eulerKernel R n) (eulerKernel_isFiniteLocallyFree R n) =
      (n + 1) • projectiveTwistingK0Class R n (-1) - 1
proof:
:=
  eq_sub_of_add_eq (eulerKernel_classOf_add_one R n)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.cotangent_classOf_of_iso
statement:
theorem cotangent_classOf_of_iso
    (e : Cotangent.relativeSheaf (toSpec R n) ≅ eulerKernel R n) :
    k0ClassOf _ (Cotangent.relativeSheaf (toSpec R n))
        (Cotangent.relativeSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (toSpec R n) n) =
      (n + 1) • projectiveTwistingK0Class R n (-1) - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [k0ClassOf_iso _ _ (eulerKernel_isFiniteLocallyFree R n) e]
  exact eulerKernel_classOf R n

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateAwayι_mem_coordinateOpen
statement:
theorem coordinateAwayι_mem_coordinateOpen (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (u : Spec (.of (HomogeneousLocalization.Away
      (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)))) :
    coordinateAwayι k n i u ∈ coordinateOpen k n i
proof:
:= by
  change (Proj.awayι (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) Nat.zero_lt_one u) ∈
    Proj.basicOpen (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)
  exact ((Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)
    (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) Nat.zero_lt_one).inv u).2

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.genericPoint_eq_genericProjPoint
statement:
theorem genericPoint_eq_genericProjPoint :
    genericPoint (space k n) = genericProjPoint k n
proof:
:= by
  apply (genericPoint_spec (space k n)).eq
  rw [isGenericPoint_iff_specializes]
  intro x
  simp only [Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
  rw [specializes_iff_forall_open]
  intro U hU hxU
  exact genericProjPoint_mem_of_isOpen k n hU ⟨x, hxU⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.genericPoint_mem_coordinateOpen
statement:
theorem genericPoint_mem_coordinateOpen (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    genericPoint (space k n) ∈ coordinateOpen k n i
proof:
:= by
  rw [genericPoint_eq_genericProjPoint k n]
  exact genericProjPoint_mem_basicOpen k n (MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero i)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.stalkCongr_sectionStalkElement
statement:
theorem stalkCongr_sectionStalkElement (s : grading k n 1) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    {x y : space k n} (hxy : x = y)
    (hx : x ∈ coordinateOpen k n i) (hy : y ∈ coordinateOpen k n i) :
    ((space k n).presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hxy)).hom
        (sectionStalkElement k n s i x hx) =
      sectionStalkElement k n s i y hy
proof:
:= by
  subst y
  simp [sectionStalkElement]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.basicOpenIsoSpec_stalkMap_affineStalkElement
statement:
private theorem basicOpenIsoSpec_stalkMap_affineStalkElement
    (s : grading k n 1) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (x : coordinateOpen k n i) :
    let e
proof:
:= Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) Nat.zero_lt_one
    (e.hom.stalkMap x).hom
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.affineStalkElement (sectionAway k n s i) (e.hom x)) =
      ((coordinateOpen k n i).ι.stalkMap x).hom
        (sectionStalkElement k n s i x.1 x.2) := by
  dsimp only
  let e : (coordinateOpen k n i).toScheme ≅
      Spec (.of (HomogeneousLocalization.Away
        (grading k n) (coordinate k n i))) :=
    Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) Nat.zero_lt_one
  have haffine (p : Spec (.of (HomogeneousLocalization.Away
      (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)))) :
      AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.affineStalkElement (sectionAway k n s i) p =
        (StructureSheaf.toStalk
          (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading k n) (coordinate k n i))
          p).hom (sectionAway k n s i) := by
    change (Spec.stalkIso (.of (HomogeneousLocalization.Away
        (grading k n) (coordinate k n i))) p).inv.hom
          ((CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap
            (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading k n) (coordinate k n i))
            (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))).hom (sectionAway k n s i)) =
      (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (HomogeneousLocalization.Away
          (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)))).inv ≫
        (Spec (.of (HomogeneousLocalization.Away
          (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)))).presheaf.germ ⊤ p trivial).hom
            (sectionAway k n s i))
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom
      (Spec.algebraMap_stalkIso_inv
        (R := .of (HomogeneousLocalization.Away
          (grading k n) (coordinate k n i))) (x := p)))
      (sectionAway k n s i)
  have hspec :
      (ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.specStalkEquiv (grading k n) (coordinate k n i) x
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) Nat.zero_lt_one).hom.hom
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.affineStalkElement
            (sectionAway k n s i)
              ((ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.toSpec (grading k n)
                (coordinate k n i)).base x)) =
        HomogeneousLocalization.mapId (grading k n)
          (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr x.2) (sectionAway k n s i) := by
    rw [haffine]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom
      (ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.toStalk_specStalkEquiv
        (grading k n) (coordinate k n i) x
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) Nat.zero_lt_one)) (sectionAway k n s i)
  have htoSpec : Scheme.forgetToLocallyRingedSpace.map
      (Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) Nat.zero_lt_one).hom =
        ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.toSpec (grading k n) (coordinate k n i) := by
    rw [Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec_hom]
    refine Eq.trans ?_
      (ΓSpec.locallyRingedSpaceAdjunction.homEquiv_apply _ _ _).symm
    dsimp [Proj.basicOpenToSpec, Scheme.Opens.toSpecΓ]
    simp only [Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp]
    rfl
  change ((Scheme.forgetToLocallyRingedSpace.map
      (Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) Nat.zero_lt_one).hom).stalkMap x).hom
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.affineStalkElement (sectionAway k n s i)
        ((Scheme.forgetToLocallyRingedSpace.map
          (Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)
            (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) Nat.zero_lt_one).hom).base x)) = _
  rw [htoSpec]
  calc
    _ = (((ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.specStalkEquiv (grading k n)
          (coordinate k n i) x (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i)
            Nat.zero_lt_one).hom ≫
        (Proj.stalkIso' (grading k n) x.1).toCommRingCatIso.inv ≫
        ((Proj.toLocallyRingedSpace (grading k n)).restrictStalkIso
          (Opens.isOpenEmbedding _) x).inv).hom
            (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.affineStalkElement
              (sectionAway k n s i)
              ((ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.toSpec (grading k n)
                (coordinate k n i)).base x))) :=
      ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
        (ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.stalkMap_toSpec (grading k n)
          (coordinate k n i) x (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) Nat.zero_lt_one) _
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply]
      rw [hspec]
      rw [← Scheme.Opens.stalkIso_inv]
      congr 1
      apply (Proj.stalkIso' (grading k n) x.1).injective
      change (Proj.stalkIso' (grading k n) x.1)
          ((Proj.stalkIso' (grading k n) x.1).symm
            (HomogeneousLocalization.mapId (grading k n)
              (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr x.2) (sectionAway k n s i))) =
        (Proj.stalkIso' (grading k n) x.1)
          (sectionStalkElement k n s i x.1 x.2)
      rw [(Proj.stalkIso' (grading k n) x.1).apply_symm_apply]
      change HomogeneousLocalization.mapId (grading k n)
          (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr x.2) (sectionAway k n s i) =
        Proj.stalkIso' (grading k n) x.1
          ((ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.structureSheaf (grading k n)).presheaf.germ
            (coordinateOpen k n i) x.1 x.2 (sectionOnCoordinateOpen k n s i))
      rw [Proj.stalkIso'_germ]
      rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateAwayι_stalkMap_sectionStalkElement
statement:
theorem coordinateAwayι_stalkMap_sectionStalkElement
    (s : grading k n 1) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (u : Spec (.of (HomogeneousLocalization.Away
      (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)))) :
    ((coordinateAwayι k n i).stalkMap u).hom
        (sectionStalkElement k n s i (coordinateAwayι k n i u)
          (coordinateAwayι_mem_coordinateOpen k n i u)) =
      AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.affineStalkElement (sectionAway k n s i) u
proof:
:= by
  let e : (coordinateOpen k n i).toScheme ≅
      Spec (.of (HomogeneousLocalization.Away
        (grading k n) (coordinate k n i))) :=
    Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) Nat.zero_lt_one
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x, e.hom x = u := (Scheme.homeoOfIso e).surjective u
  subst u
  change ((e.inv ≫ (coordinateOpen k n i).ι).stalkMap (e.hom x)).hom
      (sectionStalkElement k n s i
        ((e.inv ≫ (coordinateOpen k n i).ι) (e.hom x)) _) = _
  apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (e.hom.stalkMap x)).1
  change (((e.inv ≫ (coordinateOpen k n i).ι).stalkMap (e.hom x) ≫
      e.hom.stalkMap x).hom
        (sectionStalkElement k n s i
          ((e.inv ≫ (coordinateOpen k n i).ι) (e.hom x)) _)) = _
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp]
  have hbasic : (e.hom.stalkMap x).hom
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.affineStalkElement
        (sectionAway k n s i) (e.hom x)) =
    ((coordinateOpen k n i).ι.stalkMap x).hom
      (sectionStalkElement k n s i x.1 x.2) := by
    exact basicOpenIsoSpec_stalkMap_affineStalkElement k n s i x
  rw [hbasic]
  have hcomp : e.hom ≫ e.inv ≫ (coordinateOpen k n i).ι =
      (coordinateOpen k n i).ι := by simp
  rw [Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_congr_hom _ _ hcomp]
  have hpoint : (e.inv ≫ (coordinateOpen k n i).ι) (e.hom x) = x.1 := by
    change (e.hom ≫ e.inv ≫ (coordinateOpen k n i).ι) x =
      (coordinateOpen k n i).ι x
    rw [hcomp]
  have hpMem : (e.inv ≫ (coordinateOpen k n i).ι) (e.hom x) ∈
      coordinateOpen k n i := hpoint.symm ▸ x.2
  change ((((space k n).presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hpoint)).hom ≫
      (coordinateOpen k n i).ι.stalkMap x).hom
        (sectionStalkElement k n s i
          ((e.inv ≫ (coordinateOpen k n i).ι) (e.hom x)) hpMem)) = _
  rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
    stalkCongr_sectionStalkElement k n s i hpoint hpMem x.2]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.hyperplaneChart_stalkElement_eq_sectionStalkElement
statement:
theorem hyperplaneChart_stalkElement_eq_sectionStalkElement
    (s : grading k n 1) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (w : (pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) (hyperplaneι k n s)
      (coordinateAwayι k n i) : Scheme.{u}))
    (hx : hyperplaneι k n s
      (pullback.fst (hyperplaneι k n s) (coordinateAwayι k n i) w) ∈
        coordinateOpen k n i) :
    (hyperplaneChart k n s i).stalkElement w =
      sectionStalkElement k n s i
        (hyperplaneι k n s
          (pullback.fst (hyperplaneι k n s) (coordinateAwayι k n i) w)) hx
proof:
:= by
  let c := hyperplaneChart k n s i
  let E := AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.targetStalkIsoOfIsIsoSquare
    (hyperplaneι k n s)
    (pullback.snd (hyperplaneι k n s) (coordinateAwayι k n i))
    (pullback.fst (hyperplaneι k n s) (coordinateAwayι k n i))
    (coordinateAwayι k n i) pullback.condition w
  apply E.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.injective
  change E.hom.hom (E.inv.hom (c.localStalkElement w)) = _
  rw [E.inv_hom_id_apply]
  rw [hyperplaneChart_localStalkElement k n s i w]
  have hpoint : hyperplaneι k n s
      (pullback.fst (hyperplaneι k n s) (coordinateAwayι k n i) w) =
    coordinateAwayι k n i
      (pullback.snd (hyperplaneι k n s) (coordinateAwayι k n i) w) := by
    change (pullback.fst (hyperplaneι k n s) (coordinateAwayι k n i) ≫
      hyperplaneι k n s) w =
      (pullback.snd (hyperplaneι k n s) (coordinateAwayι k n i) ≫
        coordinateAwayι k n i) w
    rw [pullback.condition]
  change AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.affineStalkElement
      (sectionAway k n s i)
      (pullback.snd (hyperplaneι k n s) (coordinateAwayι k n i) w) =
    (((space k n).presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hpoint)).hom ≫
      (coordinateAwayι k n i).stalkMap
        (pullback.snd (hyperplaneι k n s) (coordinateAwayι k n i) w)).hom
          (sectionStalkElement k n s i _ hx)
  rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
    stalkCongr_sectionStalkElement k n s i hpoint hx
      (coordinateAwayι_mem_coordinateOpen k n i _),
    coordinateAwayι_stalkMap_sectionStalkElement]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.hyperplaneChartAt_stalkElement_eq_sectionStalkElement
statement:
theorem hyperplaneChartAt_stalkElement_eq_sectionStalkElement
    (s : grading k n 1) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (z : hyperplane k n s)
    (a : (hyperplaneChart k n s i).At z)
    (hx : hyperplaneι k n s z ∈ coordinateOpen k n i) :
    a.stalkElement =
      sectionStalkElement k n s i (hyperplaneι k n s z) hx
proof:
:= by
  rcases a with ⟨w, hw⟩
  dsimp only at hw ⊢
  subst z
  simpa [AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.At.stalkElement] using
    hyperplaneChart_stalkElement_eq_sectionStalkElement k n s i w hx

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.ker_hyperplaneι_stalkMap_eq_span_sectionStalkElement
statement:
theorem ker_hyperplaneι_stalkMap_eq_span_sectionStalkElement
    (s : grading k n 1) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (z : hyperplane k n s)
    (hx : hyperplaneι k n s z ∈ coordinateOpen k n i) :
    RingHom.ker ((hyperplaneι k n s).stalkMap z).hom =
      Ideal.span {sectionStalkElement k n s i (hyperplaneι k n s z) hx}
proof:
:= by
  have hrange : hyperplaneι k n s z ∈ (coordinateAwayι k n i).opensRange := by
    change hyperplaneι k n s z ∈
      Proj.basicOpen (grading k n) (coordinate k n i) at hx
    change hyperplaneι k n s z ∈
      (Proj.awayι (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) Nat.zero_lt_one).opensRange
    rw [Proj.opensRange_awayι]
    exact hx
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange.mp hrange
  let a :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.At.ofPoint
      (hyperplaneChart k n s i) z u hu.symm
  rw [a.ker_stalkMap,
    hyperplaneChartAt_stalkElement_eq_sectionStalkElement k n s i z a hx]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.hyperplaneCycle_apply_hyperplaneι_eq_length_sectionStalkElement
statement:
theorem hyperplaneCycle_apply_hyperplaneι_eq_length_sectionStalkElement
    (s : grading k n 1) (hs : s ≠ 0) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (z : hyperplane k n s)
    (hx : hyperplaneι k n s z ∈ coordinateOpen k n i)
    (hz : coheight (hyperplaneι k n s z) = 1) :
    (hyperplaneCycle k n s hs).1 (hyperplaneι k n s z) =
      ((Module.length ((space k n).presheaf.stalk (hyperplaneι k n s z))
        (((space k n).presheaf.stalk (hyperplaneι k n s z)) ⧸
          Ideal.span {sectionStalkElement k n s i
            (hyperplaneι k n s z) hx})).toNat : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hyperplaneCycle_apply_hyperplaneι k n s hs z hz]
  unfold AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.genericMultiplicity
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.selfLocalLength_eq_morphismLocalLength_closedImmersion
    (hyperplaneι k n s) z]
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.morphismLocalLength_eq_length_principalQuotient
    (hyperplaneι k n s) z
    (sectionStalkElement k n s i (hyperplaneι k n s z) hx)
    (ker_hyperplaneι_stalkMap_eq_span_sectionStalkElement k n s i z hx)]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.algebraMap_sectionStalkElement
statement:
@[simp]
theorem algebraMap_sectionStalkElement (s : grading k n 1) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (x : space k n) (hx : x ∈ coordinateOpen k n i) :
    algebraMap ((space k n).presheaf.stalk x) (space k n).functionField
      (sectionStalkElement k n s i x hx) = sectionFunction k n s i
proof:
:= by
  exact Scheme.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField hx
    (sectionOnCoordinateOpen k n s i)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.stalkIso_sectionStalkElement
statement:
theorem stalkIso_sectionStalkElement (s : grading k n 1) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (x : space k n) (hx : x ∈ coordinateOpen k n i) :
    Proj.stalkIso' (grading k n) x (sectionStalkElement k n s i x hx) =
      HomogeneousLocalization.mapId (grading k n) (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr hx)
        (sectionAway k n s i)
proof:
:= by
  change Proj.stalkIso' (grading k n) x
      ((ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.structureSheaf (grading k n)).presheaf.germ
        (coordinateOpen k n i) x hx (sectionOnCoordinateOpen k n s i)) = _
  rw [Proj.stalkIso'_germ]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.stalkIso_generic_sectionFunction
statement:
theorem stalkIso_generic_sectionFunction (s : grading k n 1) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Proj.stalkIso' (grading k n) (genericPoint (space k n))
        (sectionFunction k n s i) =
      genericSectionFraction k n s i
proof:
:= by
  rw [sectionFunction, Scheme.germToFunctionField]
  change Proj.stalkIso' (grading k n) (genericPoint (space k n))
      ((ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.structureSheaf (grading k n)).presheaf.germ
        (coordinateOpen k n i) (genericPoint (space k n)) _
          (sectionOnCoordinateOpen k n s i)) = _
  rw [Proj.stalkIso'_germ]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.genericSectionFraction_cross_mul
statement:
theorem genericSectionFraction_cross_mul (s t : grading k n 1)
    (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    genericSectionFraction k n s i * genericSectionFraction k n t j =
      genericSectionFraction k n s j * genericSectionFraction k n t i
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp only [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul, genericSectionFraction, sectionAway,
    hyperplaneChartEquation, GradedIdealQuotient.awayEquation,
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk, HomogeneousLocalization.map_mk,
    HomogeneousLocalization.val_mk, Localization.mk_mul]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact mul_comm _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.sectionFunction_cross_mul
statement:
theorem sectionFunction_cross_mul (s t : grading k n 1)
    (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    sectionFunction k n s i * sectionFunction k n t j =
      sectionFunction k n s j * sectionFunction k n t i
proof:
:= by
  apply (Proj.stalkIso' (grading k n)
    (genericPoint (space k n))).injective
  change Proj.stalkIso' (grading k n) (genericPoint (space k n))
      ((show (space k n).presheaf.stalk (genericPoint (space k n)) from
          sectionFunction k n s i) *
        (show (space k n).presheaf.stalk (genericPoint (space k n)) from
          sectionFunction k n t j)) =
    Proj.stalkIso' (grading k n) (genericPoint (space k n))
      ((show (space k n).presheaf.stalk (genericPoint (space k n)) from
          sectionFunction k n s j) *
        (show (space k n).presheaf.stalk (genericPoint (space k n)) from
          sectionFunction k n t i))
  let e := Proj.stalkIso' (grading k n) (genericPoint (space k n))
  calc
    e (sectionFunction k n s i * sectionFunction k n t j) =
        e (sectionFunction k n s i) * e (sectionFunction k n t j) :=
      e.map_mul _ _
    _ = e (sectionFunction k n s j) * e (sectionFunction k n t i) := by
      calc
        _ = genericSectionFraction k n s i * genericSectionFraction k n t j :=
          congrArg₂ (fun a b => a * b)
            (stalkIso_generic_sectionFunction k n s i)
            (stalkIso_generic_sectionFunction k n t j)
        _ = genericSectionFraction k n s j * genericSectionFraction k n t i :=
          genericSectionFraction_cross_mul k n s t i j
        _ = _ := congrArg₂ (fun a b => a * b)
          (stalkIso_generic_sectionFunction k n s j).symm
          (stalkIso_generic_sectionFunction k n t i).symm
    _ = e (sectionFunction k n s j * sectionFunction k n t i) :=
      (e.map_mul _ _).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.sectionFunction_ne_zero
statement:
theorem sectionFunction_ne_zero (s : grading k n 1) (hs : s ≠ 0)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) : sectionFunction k n s i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have hfrac : genericSectionFraction k n s i = 0 := by
    rw [← stalkIso_generic_sectionFunction k n s i, hzero]
    exact map_zero _
  have hv := congrArg HomogeneousLocalization.val hfrac
  simp only [genericSectionFraction, sectionAway, hyperplaneChartEquation,
    GradedIdealQuotient.awayEquation, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk,
    HomogeneousLocalization.map_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.val_mk,
    HomogeneousLocalization.val_zero] at hv
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk'] at hv
  obtain ⟨⟨c, hc⟩, hcs⟩ := (IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff _ _).mp hv
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hc (h0 ▸ Ideal.zero_mem _)
  have hs0 : (s : Polynomial k n) ≠ 0 := fun h => hs (Subtype.ext h)
  exact hs0 ((mul_eq_zero.mp hcs).resolve_left hc0)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.sectionStalkElement_ne_zero
statement:
theorem sectionStalkElement_ne_zero (s : grading k n 1) (hs : s ≠ 0)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (x : space k n) (hx : x ∈ coordinateOpen k n i) :
    sectionStalkElement k n s i x hx ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have h := algebraMap_sectionStalkElement k n s i x hx
  rw [hzero, map_zero] at h
  exact sectionFunction_ne_zero k n s hs i h.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.sectionStalkElement_isUnit_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem sectionStalkElement_isUnit_of_not_mem
    (s : grading k n 1) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (x : space k n) (hx : x ∈ coordinateOpen k n i)
    (hsx : (s : Polynomial k n) ∉ x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) :
    IsUnit (sectionStalkElement k n s i x hx)
proof:
:= by
  let e := Proj.stalkIso' (grading k n) x
  have hu : IsUnit (e (sectionStalkElement k n s i x hx)) := by
    rw [stalkIso_sectionStalkElement k n s i x hx]
    rw [← HomogeneousLocalization.isUnit_iff_isUnit_val]
    simp only [sectionAway, hyperplaneChartEquation,
      GradedIdealQuotient.awayEquation, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk,
      HomogeneousLocalization.map_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.val_mk]
    rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk', IsLocalization.AtPrime.isUnit_mk'_iff]
    exact hsx
  have hu' := hu.map e.symm.toMonoidHom
  change IsUnit (e.symm (e (sectionStalkElement k n s i x hx))) at hu'
  rw [e.symm_apply_apply] at hu'
  exact hu'

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.hyperplaneCycle_apply_eq_length_sectionStalkElement
statement:
theorem hyperplaneCycle_apply_eq_length_sectionStalkElement
    (s : grading k n 1) (hs : s ≠ 0) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (x : space k n) (hx : x ∈ coordinateOpen k n i)
    (_hcodim : coheight x = 1) :
    (hyperplaneCycle k n s hs).1 x =
      ((Module.length ((space k n).presheaf.stalk x)
        (((space k n).presheaf.stalk x) ⧸
          Ideal.span {sectionStalkElement k n s i x hx})).toNat : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hrange : x ∈ Set.range (hyperplaneι k n s)
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hrange
    exact hyperplaneCycle_apply_hyperplaneι_eq_length_sectionStalkElement
      k n s hs i z hx _hcodim
  · have hsx : (s : Polynomial k n) ∉ x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal :=
      (mem_range_hyperplaneι_iff k n s x).not.mp hrange
    have hunit : IsUnit (sectionStalkElement k n s i x hx) :=
      sectionStalkElement_isUnit_of_not_mem k n s i x hx hsx
    have htop : Ideal.span {sectionStalkElement k n s i x hx} = ⊤ :=
      Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top.mpr hunit
    change (AlgebraicCycle.pushforward (hyperplaneι k n s)
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.fundamentalCycle (hyperplane k n s))
      (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℕ∞)) coheight) x = _
    rw [AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range
      (hyperplaneι k n s)
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.fundamentalCycle (hyperplane k n s))
      (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℕ∞)) coheight x hrange, htop]
    simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.sectionRatio_eq_chart
statement:
theorem sectionRatio_eq_chart (s t : grading k n 1) (_hs : s ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    sectionRatio k n s t = sectionFunction k n s i / sectionFunction k n t i
proof:
:= by
  rw [sectionRatio, div_eq_div_iff
    (sectionFunction_ne_zero k n t ht ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos n⟩)
    (sectionFunction_ne_zero k n t ht i)]
  exact sectionFunction_cross_mul k n s t ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos n⟩ i

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.sectionRatio_ne_zero
statement:
theorem sectionRatio_ne_zero (s t : grading k n 1) (hs : s ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    sectionRatio k n s t ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  div_ne_zero (sectionFunction_ne_zero k n s hs ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos n⟩)
    (sectionFunction_ne_zero k n t ht ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos n⟩)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.sectionRatio_eq_algebraMap_sectionStalkElement
statement:
theorem sectionRatio_eq_algebraMap_sectionStalkElement
    (s t : grading k n 1) (hs : s ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (x : space k n) (hx : x ∈ coordinateOpen k n i) :
    sectionRatio k n s t =
      algebraMap ((space k n).presheaf.stalk x) (space k n).functionField
          (sectionStalkElement k n s i x hx) /
        algebraMap ((space k n).presheaf.stalk x) (space k n).functionField
          (sectionStalkElement k n t i x hx)
proof:
:= by
  rw [algebraMap_sectionStalkElement, algebraMap_sectionStalkElement]
  exact sectionRatio_eq_chart k n s t hs ht i

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.div_sectionRatio_apply_eq_hyperplaneCycle_sub
statement:
theorem div_sectionRatio_apply_eq_hyperplaneCycle_sub
    (s t : grading k n 1) (hs : s ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (x : space k n)
    (hx : x ∈ coordinateOpen k n i) (hcodim : coheight x = 1) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.div (sectionRatio k n s t) x =
      (hyperplaneCycle k n s hs).1 x - (hyperplaneCycle k n t ht).1 x
proof:
:= by
  rw [sectionRatio_eq_algebraMap_sectionStalkElement k n s t hs ht i x hx]
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.div_div_algebraMap_eq_length_sub hcodim
    (sectionStalkElement k n s i x hx)
    (sectionStalkElement k n t i x hx)
    (sectionStalkElement_ne_zero k n s hs i x hx)
    (sectionStalkElement_ne_zero k n t ht i x hx)]
  rw [← hyperplaneCycle_apply_eq_length_sectionStalkElement
      k n s hs i x hx hcodim,
    ← hyperplaneCycle_apply_eq_length_sectionStalkElement
      k n t ht i x hx hcodim]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.hyperplaneCycle_sub_eq_principalWeilDivisor
statement:
theorem hyperplaneCycle_sub_eq_principalWeilDivisor
    (s t : grading k n 1) (hs : s ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    hyperplaneCycle k n s hs - hyperplaneCycle k n t ht =
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.principalWeilDivisor (space k n)
        (sectionRatio k n s t) :
          AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CodimensionCycles (space k n) ℤ 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext x
  by_cases hcodim : coheight x = 1
  · have hx : x ∈ ⨆ i : Fin (n + 1), coordinateOpen k n i := by
      rw [coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top]
      exact Set.mem_univ x
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp hx
    exact (div_sectionRatio_apply_eq_hyperplaneCycle_sub
      k n s t hs ht i x hi hcodim).symm
  · have hs0 : (hyperplaneCycle k n s hs).1 x = 0 := by
      by_contra h
      exact hcodim ((hyperplaneCycle k n s hs).2 h)
    have ht0 : (hyperplaneCycle k n t ht).1 x = 0 := by
      by_contra h
      exact hcodim ((hyperplaneCycle k n t ht).2 h)
    change (hyperplaneCycle k n s hs).1 x -
        (hyperplaneCycle k n t ht).1 x =
      AlgebraicGeometry.div (sectionRatio k n s t) x
    rw [hs0, ht0, zero_sub, neg_zero, AlgebraicGeometry.div_eq_ord,
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one
        hcodim (sectionRatio k n s t)]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.gradedClassOf_hyperplaneCycle_eq
statement:
theorem gradedClassOf_hyperplaneCycle_eq
    (s t : grading k n 1) (hs : s ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.gradedClassOf (space k n) 1
        (hyperplaneCycle k n s hs) =
      AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.gradedClassOf (space k n) 1
        (hyperplaneCycle k n t ht)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.gradedClassMap (space k n) 1)
    (hyperplaneCycle_sub_eq_principalWeilDivisor k n s t hs ht)
  rw [map_sub] at h
  change AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.gradedClassOf (space k n) 1
      (hyperplaneCycle k n s hs) -
      AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.gradedClassOf (space k n) 1
        (hyperplaneCycle k n t ht) =
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.gradedClassOf (space k n) 1
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.principalWeilDivisor (space k n)
        (sectionRatio k n s t)) at h
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.gradedClassOf_principalWeilDivisor
    (sectionRatio k n s t) (sectionRatio_ne_zero k n s t hs ht)] at h
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD38.fa_coordinate
statement:
theorem fa_coordinate (a' : Fin (N + 1)) (b' : Fin (n + 1)) :
    fa e a (coordinate k M (e (a', b'))) =
      MvPolynomial.C (xi k N a a') * coordinate (Aff k N a) n b'
proof:
:= by
  show segreRingHom e (coefficientToCoordinateAway k N a) (xi k N a)
      (coordinate k M (e (a', b'))) = _
  rw [segreRingHom_coordinate]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD38.fa_zm
statement: theorem fa_zm : fa e a (coordinate k M (e (a, b))) = coordinate (Aff k N a) n b
proof:
:= by
  rw [fa_coordinate, xi_self]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD38.awayCast_mk
statement:
theorem awayCast_mk {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (n d : ℕ)
    {p q : Polynomial R n} (h : p = q)
    (hp : p ∈ grading R n 1) (r : Polynomial R n)
    (hr : r ∈ grading R n d) :
    (RingEquiv.cast
        (R := fun x : Polynomial R n ↦
          HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading R n) x) h).toRingHom
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading R n) hp d r
          (by simpa using hr)) =
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading R n) (h ▸ hp) d r
        (by simpa using hr)
proof:
:= by
  subst q
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD38.psi_mk
statement:
theorem psi_mk (d : ℕ) (p : Polynomial k M) (hp : p ∈ grading k M d) :
    psi e a b (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading k M)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one k M (e (a, b))) d p (by simpa using hp)) =
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading (Aff k N a) n)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one (Aff k N a) n b) d (fa e a p)
        (by simpa using (fa e a).map_mem hp)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [psi, RingHom.comp_apply, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map_mk]
  exact awayCast_mk n d (fa_zm e a b) ((fa e a).map_mem (coordinate_mem_degree_one k M (e (a, b))))
    (fa e a p) ((fa e a).map_mem hp)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD38.coefficientToCoordinateAway_eq_mk
statement:
theorem coefficientToCoordinateAway_eq_mk (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (a : R) :
    coefficientToCoordinateAway R n i a =
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading R n)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i) 0 (MvPolynomial.C a)
        (by simpa using (MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_C (σ := Fin (n + 1)) a))
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective _
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD38.psi_coefficient
statement:
theorem psi_coefficient (c : k) :
    psi e a b (coefficientToCoordinateAway k M (e (a, b)) c) =
      coefficientToCoordinateAway (Aff k N a) n b (coefficientToCoordinateAway k N a c)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (MvPolynomial.C c : Polynomial k M) ∈ grading k M 0 := by
    simpa using (MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_C (σ := Fin (M + 1)) c)
  rw [coefficientToCoordinateAway_eq_mk, psi_mk e a b 0 _ hc,
    coefficientToCoordinateAway_eq_mk]
  simp [fa, segreRingHom_C]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD38.coordinateRatio_mem_range
statement:
theorem coordinateRatio_mem_range (j : AffineChartIndex n b) :
    coordinateRatio (Aff k N a) n b j ∈ (psi (k := k) e a b).range
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading k M)
    (coordinate_mem_degree_one k M (e (a, b))) 1 (coordinate k M (e (a, j.1)))
    (by simpa using coordinate_mem_degree_one k M (e (a, j.1))), ?_⟩
  rw [psi_mk e a b 1 _ (coordinate_mem_degree_one k M (e (a, j.1)))]
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp only [coordinateRatio, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk]
  rw [fa_coordinate, xi_self]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD38.xi_mem_range
statement:
theorem xi_mem_range (a' : Fin (N + 1)) :
    coefficientToCoordinateAway (Aff k N a) n b (xi k N a a') ∈ (psi (k := k) e a b).range
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading k M)
    (coordinate_mem_degree_one k M (e (a, b))) 1 (coordinate k M (e (a', b)))
    (by simpa using coordinate_mem_degree_one k M (e (a', b))), ?_⟩
  rw [psi_mk e a b 1 _ (coordinate_mem_degree_one k M (e (a', b))),
    coefficientToCoordinateAway_eq_mk]
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp only [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk]
  rw [fa_coordinate]
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  simp [coordinate, mul_comm]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD38.coefficient_mem_range
statement:
theorem coefficient_mem_range (r : Aff k N a) :
    coefficientToCoordinateAway (Aff k N a) n b r ∈ (psi (k := k) e a b).range
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, rfl⟩ := awayCoordinateHom_surjective k N a r
  induction Q using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C c =>
      have := psi_coefficient e a b c
      exact ⟨coefficientToCoordinateAway k M (e (a, b)) c, by simpa [awayCoordinateHom] using this⟩
  | add p q hp hq =>
      rw [map_add, map_add]
      exact add_mem hp hq
  | mul_X p j hp =>
      rw [map_mul, map_mul]
      refine mul_mem hp ?_
      have := xi_mem_range (k := k) e a b j.1
      simpa [awayCoordinateHom, coordinateRatio, xi] using this

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD38.psi_surjective
statement: theorem psi_surjective : Function.Surjective (psi (k := k) e a b)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨P, rfl⟩ := awayCoordinateHom_surjective (Aff k N a) n b y
  show _ ∈ (psi (k := k) e a b).range
  induction P using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C r =>
      simpa [awayCoordinateHom] using coefficient_mem_range e a b r
  | add p q hp hq =>
      rw [map_add]
      exact add_mem hp hq
  | mul_X p j hp =>
      rw [map_mul]
      exact mul_mem hp (by simpa [awayCoordinateHom] using coordinateRatio_mem_range e a b j)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD38.basicOpen_C_mul_X_le
statement:
theorem basicOpen_C_mul_X_le (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) (b : Fin (n + 1)) (r : R) :
    Proj.basicOpen (grading R n) (MvPolynomial.C r * coordinate R n b) ≤
      toSpec R n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  have hq := coordinate_mem_degree_one R n b
  have hg : (MvPolynomial.C r * coordinate R n b : Polynomial R n) ∈ grading R n 1 := by
    simpa using (MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_C (σ := Fin (n + 1)) r).mul
      (show MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous (coordinate R n b) 1 from hq)
  have hy' : y ∈ Proj.basicOpen (grading R n) (coordinate R n b) := by
    rw [Proj.basicOpen_mul] at hy
    exact hy.2
  rw [← Proj.opensRange_awayι (grading R n) (coordinate R n b) hq Nat.zero_lt_one] at hy'
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hy'
  have hu : u ∈ Proj.awayι (grading R n) (coordinate R n b) hq Nat.zero_lt_one ⁻¹ᵁ
      Proj.basicOpen (grading R n) (MvPolynomial.C r * coordinate R n b) := hy
  rw [Proj.awayι_preimage_basicOpen (𝒜 := grading R n) hq Nat.zero_lt_one hg
    Nat.zero_lt_one] at hu
  show u ∈ (Proj.awayι (grading R n) (coordinate R n b) hq Nat.zero_lt_one ≫ toSpec R n) ⁻¹ᵁ
    PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r
  rw [coordinateAwayι_comp_toSpec, SpecMap_preimage_basicOpen]
  have hel : HomogeneousLocalization.Away.isLocalizationElem (𝒜 := grading R n) hq hg =
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (coefficientToCoordinateAway R n b)) r := by
    apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
    show Localization.mk _ _ = (coefficientToCoordinateAway R n b r).val
    rw [coefficientToCoordinateAway_eq_mk]
    simp only [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk]
    rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    simp [coordinate, mul_comm]
  rw [← hel]
  exact hu

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD38.jChart_preimage_segreHom
statement:
theorem jChart_preimage_segreHom (i a : Fin (N + 1)) (b : Fin (n + 1)) :
    jChart k N n i ⁻¹ᵁ (segreHom e ⁻¹ᵁ
        Proj.basicOpen (grading k M) (coordinate k M (e (a, b)))) =
      Proj.basicOpen (grading (Aff k N i) n)
        (MvPolynomial.C (xi k N i a) * coordinate (Aff k N i) n b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, jChart_segreHom]
  change Proj.map _ _ ⁻¹ᵁ _ = _
  rw [Proj.map_preimage_basicOpen]
  congr 1
  exact (segreRingHom_coordinate e (coefficientToCoordinateAway k N i) (xi k N i) a b).trans rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD38.segreHom_preimage_le
statement:
theorem segreHom_preimage_le (a : Fin (N + 1)) (b : Fin (n + 1)) :
    segreHom e ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen (grading k M) (coordinate k M (e (a, b))) ≤
      pullback.fst (toSpec k N) (toSpec k n) ⁻¹ᵁ
        Proj.basicOpen (grading k N) (coordinate k N a)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨i, y, hy⟩ : ∃ i y, (jChart k N n i).base y = x :=
    ⟨_, (segreCover k N n).covers x⟩
  have h1 : y ∈ jChart k N n i ⁻¹ᵁ (segreHom e ⁻¹ᵁ
      Proj.basicOpen (grading k M) (coordinate k M (e (a, b)))) := by
    have : (jChart k N n i).base y ∈ (segreHom e ⁻¹ᵁ
        Proj.basicOpen (grading k M) (coordinate k M (e (a, b))) :
        (segreSource k N n).Opens) := hy ▸ hx
    exact this
  rw [jChart_preimage_segreHom e] at h1
  have h2 := basicOpen_C_mul_X_le (Aff k N i) n b (xi k N i a) h1
  rw [← hy]
  show y ∈ jChart k N n i ⁻¹ᵁ (pullback.fst (toSpec k N) (toSpec k n) ⁻¹ᵁ
    Proj.basicOpen (grading k N) (coordinate k N a))
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, jChart_fst, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage]
  have key : awayChart k N i ⁻¹ᵁ (Proj.basicOpen (grading k N) (coordinate k N a) :
      (space k N).Opens) = PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (xi k N i a) := by
    have hel : HomogeneousLocalization.Away.isLocalizationElem (𝒜 := grading k N)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one k N i) (coordinate_mem_degree_one k N a) = xi k N i a := by
      apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
      simp [xi]
    rw [← hel]
    exact Proj.awayι_preimage_basicOpen (𝒜 := grading k N) (coordinate_mem_degree_one k N i)
      Nat.zero_lt_one (coordinate_mem_degree_one k N a) Nat.zero_lt_one
  rw [key]
  exact h2

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD38.away_map_surjective
statement:
theorem away_map_surjective (a : Fin (N + 1)) (b : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Function.Surjective (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map (fa (k := k) e a)
      (coordinate k M (e (a, b))))
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := psi_surjective (k := k) e a b
    ((RingEquiv.cast
      (R := fun x : Polynomial (Aff k N a) n ↦
        HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading (Aff k N a) n) x) (fa_zm e a b)) y)
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  apply (RingEquiv.cast
      (R := fun x : Polynomial (Aff k N a) n ↦
        HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading (Aff k N a) n) x) (fa_zm e a b)).injective
  exact hx

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD38.opensRange_awayChart
statement:
theorem opensRange_awayChart (i : Fin (N + 1)) :
    (awayChart k N i).opensRange =
      (Proj.basicOpen (grading k N) (coordinate k N i) : (space k N).Opens)
proof:
:=

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD38.chart_isClosedImmersion
statement:
theorem chart_isClosedImmersion (a : Fin (N + 1)) (b : Fin (n + 1)) :
    IsClosedImmersion (pullback.snd (segreHom (k := k) e) (awayChart k M (e (a, b))))
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : (fa e a) (coordinate k M (e (a, b))) ∈ grading (Aff k N a) n 1 :=
    (fa e a).map_mem (coordinate_mem_degree_one k M (e (a, b)))
  have hV : (Proj.awayι (grading (Aff k N a) n) ((fa e a) (coordinate k M (e (a, b)))) hmem
      Nat.zero_lt_one).opensRange = Proj.basicOpen (grading (Aff k N a) n)
        ((fa e a) (coordinate k M (e (a, b)))) := Proj.opensRange_awayι _ _ _ _
  let awayV : Spec (CommRingCat.of (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading (Aff k N a) n)
      ((fa e a) (coordinate k M (e (a, b)))))) ⟶ space (Aff k N a) n :=
    Proj.awayι (grading (Aff k N a) n) ((fa e a) (coordinate k M (e (a, b)))) hmem
      Nat.zero_lt_one
  haveI : IsOpenImmersion awayV := Proj.instIsOpenImmersionAwayι _ _ _ _
  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (awayV ≫ jChart k N n a) := inferInstance
  let t := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map (fa e a)
    (coordinate k M (e (a, b)))))
  have H : (awayV ≫ jChart k N n a) ≫ segreHom e = t ≫ awayChart k M (e (a, b)) := by
    rw [Category.assoc, jChart_segreHom]
    exact Proj.awayι_comp_map (fa e a) _ Nat.zero_lt_one _
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k M (e (a, b)))
  have H' : segreHom e ⁻¹ᵁ (awayChart k M (e (a, b))).opensRange =
      (awayV ≫ jChart k N n a).opensRange := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      have hx' : x ∈ segreHom e ⁻¹ᵁ
          Proj.basicOpen (grading k M) (coordinate k M (e (a, b))) := by
        rw [opensRange_awayChart] at hx
        exact hx
      have h1 := segreHom_preimage_le e a b hx'
      have h2 : (pullback.fst (toSpec k N) (toSpec k n)).base x ∈
          Set.range (awayChart k N a).base := by
        have : (pullback.fst (toSpec k N) (toSpec k n)).base x ∈
            (awayChart k N a).opensRange := by
          rw [opensRange_awayChart]
          exact h1
        exact this
      have h3 : x ∈ Set.range (jChart k N n a).base := by
        rw [range_jChart]
        exact h2
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := h3
      have h4 : y ∈ jChart k N n a ⁻¹ᵁ (segreHom e ⁻¹ᵁ
          Proj.basicOpen (grading k M) (coordinate k M (e (a, b))) :
          (segreSource k N n).Opens) := hx'
      rw [jChart_preimage_segreHom e a a b] at h4
      have h5 : y ∈ awayV.opensRange := by
        show y ∈ (Proj.awayι (grading (Aff k N a) n) ((fa e a) (coordinate k M (e (a, b)))) hmem
          Nat.zero_lt_one).opensRange
        rw [hV, fa_coordinate]
        exact h4
      obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := h5
      exact ⟨u, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨u, rfl⟩
      show (segreHom e).base ((awayV ≫ jChart k N n a).base u) ∈
        (awayChart k M (e (a, b))).opensRange
      have : (segreHom e).base ((awayV ≫ jChart k N n a).base u) =
          (awayChart k M (e (a, b))).base (t.base u) := by
        rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, H]
      rw [this]
      exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hP := (IsOpenImmersion.isPullback t (awayV ≫ jChart k N n a)
    (awayChart k M (e (a, b))) (segreHom e) H H').flip
  have ht : IsClosedImmersion t :=
    IsClosedImmersion.spec_of_surjective _ (away_map_surjective e a b)
  have : pullback.snd (segreHom e) (awayChart k M (e (a, b))) =
      hP.isoPullback.inv ≫ t := by
    rw [← cancel_epi hP.isoPullback.hom, hP.isoPullback_hom_snd, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  rw [this]
  infer_instance

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD38.segreHom_isClosedImmersion
statement: theorem segreHom_isClosedImmersion : IsClosedImmersion (segreHom (k := k) e)
proof:
:= by
  refine IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.of_openCover (P := @IsClosedImmersion)
    (coordinateAffineOpenCover k M).openCover fun m ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨⟨a, b⟩, rfl⟩ := e.surjective m
  exact chart_isClosedImmersion e a b

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.esymm_cons_succ
statement:
theorem esymm_cons_succ {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K] (a : K) (s : Multiset K) (n : ℕ) :
    (a ::ₘ s).esymm (n + 1) = s.esymm (n + 1) + a * s.esymm n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Multiset.esymm, Multiset.esymm, Multiset.esymm, Multiset.powersetCard_cons,
    Multiset.map_add, Multiset.sum_add, Multiset.map_map]
  congr 1
  rw [← Multiset.sum_map_mul_left]
  refine congrArg Multiset.sum (Multiset.map_congr rfl fun t _ => ?_)
  simp [Function.comp_apply, Multiset.prod_cons]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.esymm_zero_right
statement: theorem esymm_zero_right {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K] (s : Multiset K) : s.esymm 0 = 1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.esymm_zero_multiset
statement:
theorem esymm_zero_multiset {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K] (n : ℕ) :
    (0 : Multiset K).esymm n = if n = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => simp [esymm_zero_right]
  | succ n => simp [Multiset.esymm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.esymm_cons_zero

theorem esymm_cons_zero {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K] (a : K) (s : Multiset K) :

proof: := esymm_zero_right _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.esymm_eq_zero_of_card_lt
statement:
theorem esymm_eq_zero_of_card_lt {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K] (s : Multiset K) {n : ℕ}
    (h : Multiset.card s < n) : s.esymm n = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [Multiset.esymm, Multiset.powersetCard_eq_empty n h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.sum_antidiagonal_line
statement:
theorem sum_antidiagonal_line {R : Type*} [Ring R] (f : ℕ → R) (x : R) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n,
        f p.1 * (if p.2 = 0 then (1 : R) else if p.2 = 1 then x else 0) =
      f n + (match n with | 0 => 0 | n + 1 => f n * x)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n =>
    rw [Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_succ']
    simp only [Nat.add_eq_zero_iff, one_ne_zero, and_false, if_false]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (n, 0)]
    · simp
    · intro p hp hne
      have hp2 : p.2 ≠ 0 := fun h2 => hne (by
        have : p.1 = n := by
          have := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp
          omega
        exact Prod.ext this h2)
      simp [hp2]
    · intro hn
      exact absurd (Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mpr (by simp)) hn

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.whitneyUnitSummand_of_lineSub
proof:
:= by
  have hU := hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf (Y := X)
  have hB : HasConstantRank X (tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ M) (1 + r) :=
    hasConstantRank_biprod_E13 hU hM
  have hS := (ShortComplex.Splitting.ofHasBinaryBiproduct (tensorUnitSheaf X) M).shortExact
  have W := H (biprod.inl : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ M) biprod.snd (by simp) hS hU
    hB.isFiniteLocallyFree hM.isFiniteLocallyFree
  intro n
  have e1 : constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X (M ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X) n =
      constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X (tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ M) n :=
    congrFun (constRankChernAssignOn'_iso ops cp hP (biprod.braiding M (tensorUnitSheaf X))) n
  have hc1 : ∀ i, constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X (tensorUnitSheaf X) i =
      if i = 0 then 1 else 0 := fun i => by
    rw [constRankChernAssignOn'_eq ops cp hP _ 1 hU, chernOpOn'_unit ops cp hP hU]
  rw [e1, W n]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (0, n), Finset.sum_eq_single (n, 0)]
  · simp [hc1, Module.End.one_eq_id]
  · intro p hp hne
    have hp2 : p.2 ≠ 0 := fun h2 => hne (by
      have : p.1 = n := by
        have := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp
        omega
      exact Prod.ext this h2)
    simp [hc1, hp2]
  · intro hn
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mpr (by simp)) hn
  · intro p hp hne
    have hp1 : p.1 ≠ 0 := fun h1 => hne (by
      have : p.2 = n := by
        have := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp
        omega
      exact Prod.ext h1 this)
    simp [hc1, hp1]
  · intro hn
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mpr (by simp)) hn

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.mem_of_segreInvR
statement:
theorem mem_of_segreInvR {R : Type*} [Ring R] (P : R → Prop) (h0 : P 0) (hsub : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x - y))
    (hadd : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y)) (hmul : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x * y))
    {r : ℕ} {e s : ℕ → R} (hs : SegreInvR r e s) (he : ∀ a, P (e a)) (h1 : P 1)
    (he0 : e 0 = 1) : ∀ m, P (s m)
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ m ih =>
    have h := hs.2 m
    have hm : s m = (if m = 0 then 1 else 0) -
        ∑ a ∈ Finset.range m, e (a + 1) * s (m - (a + 1)) := by
      rw [← h, Finset.sum_range_succ', he0, one_mul, Nat.sub_zero]
      abel
    rw [hm]
    refine hsub _ _ ?_ (Finset.sum_induction _ P hadd h0 fun a ha => ?_)
    · split_ifs
      exacts [h1, h0]
    · have ha' := Finset.mem_range.mp ha
      exact hmul _ _ (he _) (ih _ (by omega))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.exists_preimage_of_segreInvR
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_of_segreInvR (fun T => ∃ y, φ y = T) ⟨0, map_zero _⟩ ?_ ?_ ?_ hs he ⟨1, map_one _⟩ he0
  · rintro x y ⟨a, rfl⟩ ⟨b, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a - b, map_sub _ _ _⟩
  · rintro x y ⟨a, rfl⟩ ⟨b, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a + b, map_add _ _ _⟩
  · rintro x y ⟨a, rfl⟩ ⟨b, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a * b, map_mul _ _ _⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.rootOp_comm
statement: theorem rootOp_comm (i j : ℕ) : rootOp ops S i * rootOp ops S j = rootOp ops S j * rootOp ops S i
proof:
:=
  cp.cap_comm _ _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.exists_flagLift
statement: theorem exists_flagLift : Nonempty (FlagLift ops S)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ∀ a ∈ (Algebra.adjoin ℚ (Set.range (rootOp ops S)) : Set (Module.End ℚ (TotalChow S.Y))),
      ∀ b ∈ (Algebra.adjoin ℚ (Set.range (rootOp ops S)) : Set (Module.End ℚ (TotalChow S.Y))),
      a * b = b * a := by
    intro a ha b hb
    have h1 : ∀ z ∈ Set.range (rootOp ops S), Commute z b := fun z hz =>
      Algebra.commute_of_mem_adjoin_of_forall_mem_commute hb fun w hw => by
        obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hz
        obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hw
        exact rootOp_comm ops cp S i j
    have h2 : Commute b a :=
      Algebra.commute_of_mem_adjoin_of_forall_mem_commute ha fun z hz => (h1 z hz).symm
    exact h2.symm.eq
  obtain ⟨K, _, _, φ, hinj, hl⟩ := M7ASM.exists_comm_lift (R := Module.End ℚ (TotalChow S.Y)) _ hs
  choose root hroot using fun i => hl (rootOp ops S i) (Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  exact ⟨⟨K, φ, hinj, root, hroot⟩⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.card_rts
statement: theorem card_rts (F : FlagLift ops S) (i : ℕ) : Multiset.card (rts F i) = i + 1

:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.rts_succ
statement: theorem rts_succ (F : FlagLift ops S) (i : ℕ) : rts F (i + 1) = F.root (i + 1) ::ₘ rts F i
proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.rts_zero
statement: theorem rts_zero (F : FlagLift ops S) : rts F 0 = F.root 0 ::ₘ 0
