name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.esymm_cons_eq_line
statement:
theorem esymm_cons_eq_line {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (a : K) (s : Multiset K) (n : ℕ) :
    (a ::ₘ s).esymm n = ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n,
      s.esymm p.1 * (if p.2 = 0 then (1 : K) else if p.2 = 1 then a else 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_antidiagonal_line]
  cases n with
  | zero => simp [esymm_zero_right]
  | succ n => simp [esymm_cons_succ, mul_comm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.isNaturalChar
statement: theorem isNaturalChar : IsNaturalCharOn ops (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP)
proof:
:=
  ⟨hnat, by
    intro X _ _ _ _ _ E E' h
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := h
    exact constRankChernAssignOn'_iso ops cp hP e⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.chern_line_flag
statement:
theorem chern_line_flag (j n : ℕ) :
    constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP S.Y (S.L j) n =
      if n = 0 then 1 else if n = 1 then rootOp ops S j else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [constRankChernAssignOn'_eq ops cp hP (S.L j) 1 (S.L_line j),
    chernOpOn'_line_series ops cp hP (S.L j) (S.L_line j)]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.chern_flag_esymm
statement:
theorem chern_flag_esymm : ∀ i, i ≤ e → ∀ n,
    constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP S.Y (S.F i) n = F.φ ((rts F i).esymm n)
proof:
:= by
  have hφ := isNaturalChar cp hP hnat
  have hlineφ : ∀ (j k : ℕ), F.φ (if k = 0 then (1 : F.K) else if k = 1 then F.root j else 0) =
      if k = 0 then 1 else if k = 1 then rootOp ops S j else 0 := by
    intro j k
    split_ifs
    · exact map_one _
    · exact F.root_spec j
    · exact map_zero _
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    intro _ n
    obtain ⟨e0⟩ := S.base
    rw [constRankChernAssignOn'_iso ops cp hP e0, chern_line_flag cp hP, rts_zero]
    rcases n with _ | n
    · rw [esymm_cons_zero, map_one]
      simp
    · rw [esymm_cons_succ, esymm_zero_multiset, esymm_zero_multiset]
      rcases n with _ | n
      · simp [← F.root_spec 0]
      · simp
  | succ i ih =>
    intro hi n
    obtain ⟨a, b, w, h⟩ := S.step i (Nat.lt_of_succ_le hi)
    have W := whitneyOn_flag_of_lineSubOn ops hφ H S i (Nat.le_of_succ_le hi) a b w h
      (S.F_vb (i + 1)) (S.L_line (i + 1)).isFiniteLocallyFree n
    rw [W, rts_succ, esymm_cons_eq_line, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => ?_
    rw [ih (Nat.le_of_succ_le hi) p.1, chern_line_flag cp hP, map_mul, hlineφ]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.chern_pullback_esymm
statement:
theorem chern_pullback_esymm (n : ℕ) :
    constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP S.Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj E) n =
      F.φ ((rts F e).esymm n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t⟩ := S.top
  rw [constRankChernAssignOn'_iso ops cp hP t.symm]
  exact chern_flag_esymm cp hP hnat H F e le_rfl n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.chern_pullback_eq_zero_of_gt
statement:
theorem chern_pullback_eq_zero_of_gt {n : ℕ} (hn : e + 1 < n) :
    constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP S.Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj E) n = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [chern_pullback_esymm cp hP hnat H F n,
    esymm_eq_zero_of_card_lt _ (by rw [card_rts]; exact hn), map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.chernOpOn'_eq_zero_of_gt
statement:
theorem chernOpOn'_eq_zero_of_gt {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) {j : ℕ}
    (hj : r < j) : chernOpOn' ops cp hP E r hE j = 0
proof:
:= by
  cases r with
  | zero =>
    have : j ≠ 0 := by omega
    simp [chernOpOn', this]
  | succ e =>
    obtain ⟨S⟩ := exists_chowSplittingOn ops cp hP e E hE
    obtain ⟨F⟩ := exists_flagLift ops cp S
    have hEq := hasConstantRank_pullback S.Y S.q E (e + 1) hE
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro α
    apply S.injective
    have h1 := chernOpOn'_pull_flat S.q ops cp S.d S.hd hP E (e + 1) hE j
    have e1 := LinearMap.congr_fun h1 α
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at e1
    have h0 := chern_pullback_eq_zero_of_gt cp hP hnat H F (n := j) hj
    rw [constRankChernAssignOn'_eq ops cp hP _ (e + 1) hEq] at h0
    rw [e1, h0]
    simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.segreInvR_unit_summand_of_lineSub
statement:
theorem segreInvR_unit_summand_of_lineSub {M : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hM : HasConstantRank X M r)
    (C : AffineFrameCover X (M ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X)) [Fact (Cl C.scheme)]
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = r + 1) :
    SegreInvR r (fun a => ((-1 : ℚ) ^ a) • chernOpOn' ops cp hP M r hM a)
      (segreOn ops C cp hC)
proof:
:=
  segreInvR_unit_summand ops cp hP hM (whitneyUnitSummand_of_lineSub ops cp hP H hM)
    (fun _ hj => chernOpOn'_eq_zero_of_gt ops cp hP hnat H hM hj) C hC

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.neg_one_pow_mul_eq_smul
statement:
theorem neg_one_pow_mul_eq_smul {R : Type*} [Ring R] [Algebra ℚ R] (a : ℕ) (x : R) :
    (-1 : R) ^ a * x = ((-1 : ℚ) ^ a) • x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.smul_def]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.phi_eq_sum
statement:
theorem phi_eq_sum {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (r : ℕ) (s : ℕ → K) (g : K[X]) :
    ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.phi r s g =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (g.natDegree + 1),
        g.coeff k * (if r ≤ k then s (k - r) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [g.as_sum_range' (g.natDegree + 1) (Nat.lt_succ_self _)]
  rw [map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  rw [ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.phi_monomial]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.card_nroots
statement: theorem card_nroots : Multiset.card (nroots F) = e + 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [nroots, card_rts]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.phi_esymm_nroots
statement:
theorem phi_esymm_nroots (a : ℕ) :
    F.φ ((nroots F).esymm a) = ((-1 : ℚ) ^ a) • F.φ ((rts F e).esymm a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [nroots, Multiset.esymm_neg, map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, map_one]
  exact neg_one_pow_mul_eq_smul (R := Module.End ℚ (TotalChow S.Y)) a _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.exists_segreLift
statement:
theorem exists_segreLift (hE : HasConstantRank X E (e + 1))
    (C : AffineFrameCover S.Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj E ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf S.Y))
    [Fact (Cl C.scheme)] (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = (e + 1) + 1) :
    ∃ s' : ℕ → F.K, (∀ j, F.φ (s' j) = segreOn ops C cp hC j) ∧
      ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.SegreInv (e + 1) (fun a => (nroots F).esymm a) s'
proof:
:= by
  have hGq := hasConstantRank_pullback S.Y S.q E (e + 1) hE
  have hSeg := segreInvR_unit_summand_of_lineSub ops cp hP hnat H hGq C hC
  have hc : ∀ a, chernOpOn' ops cp hP ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj E) (e + 1) hGq a =
      F.φ ((rts F e).esymm a) := fun a => by
    have := congrFun (constRankChernAssignOn'_eq ops cp hP _ (e + 1) hGq) a
    rw [← this]
    exact chern_pullback_esymm cp hP hnat H F a
  have he' : ∀ a, ((-1 : ℚ) ^ a) •
      chernOpOn' ops cp hP ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj E) (e + 1) hGq a =
      F.φ ((nroots F).esymm a) := fun a => by
    rw [hc, phi_esymm_nroots]
  have hSeg' : SegreInvR (e + 1) (fun a => F.φ ((nroots F).esymm a)) (segreOn ops C cp hC) := by
    refine ⟨fun j hj => ?_, fun m => ?_⟩
    · have h := hSeg.1 j hj
      simp only at h ⊢
      rwa [he'] at h
    · have h := hSeg.2 m
      simp only [he'] at h ⊢
      exact h
  have he0 : F.φ ((nroots F).esymm 0) = 1 := by rw [esymm_zero_right, map_one]
  have hmem := exists_preimage_of_segreInvR F.φ hSeg' (fun a => ⟨_, rfl⟩) he0
  choose s' hs' using hmem
  have hSegK : ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.SegreInv (e + 1) (fun a => (nroots F).esymm a) s' := by
    have h : SegreInvR (e + 1) (fun a => F.φ ((nroots F).esymm a)) (fun a => F.φ (s' a)) := by
      have e2 : (fun a => F.φ (s' a)) = segreOn ops C cp hC := funext hs'
      rw [e2]
      exact hSeg'
    exact SegreInvR.of_injective (R' := F.K) (R := Module.End ℚ (TotalChow S.Y))
      F.φ.toRingHom F.inj (r := e + 1) (e := fun a => (nroots F).esymm a) (s := s') h
  exact ⟨s', hs', hSegK⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.flag_zscore
statement:
theorem flag_zscore (hE : HasConstantRank X E (e + 1))
    (C : AffineFrameCover S.Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj E ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf S.Y))
    [Fact (Cl C.scheme)] (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = (e + 1) + 1) (D : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range ((gPoly F D).natDegree + 1),
        F.φ ((gPoly F D).coeff j) * sandwichOn ops C cp hC j =
      F.φ (((nroots F).map fun n => ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.uT D n).prod)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s', hs', hSegK⟩ := exists_segreLift cp hP hnat H F hE C hC
  have hz := ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.zscore_roots (nroots F) s'
    (by rw [card_nroots]; exact hSegK) D
  rw [card_nroots] at hz
  have hz2 := congrArg F.φ hz
  change F.φ (ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.phi (e + 1) s' (gPoly F D)) = _ at hz2
  rw [phi_eq_sum, map_sum] at hz2
  rw [← hz2]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  rw [map_mul, sandwichOn_eq_phi ops cp C hC j]
  congr 1
  split_ifs
  · exact (hs' _).symm
  · exact (map_zero _).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveCoordinateChart_smul_eq
statement:
theorem projectiveCoordinateChart_smul_eq (i : Fin (n + 1)) (c : k)
    (x : CoordinateChartRing k n i) :
    c • x = projectiveCoordinateChartScalarRingHom k n i c * x
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp only [HomogeneousLocalization.val_smul, HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul]
  rw [Algebra.smul_def]
  congr 1

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveCoordinateOpen_toSpec
statement:
theorem projectiveCoordinateOpen_toSpec (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) Nat.zero_lt_one).inv ≫
      (coordinateOpen k n i).ι ≫ toSpec k n =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (projectiveCoordinateChartScalarRingHom k n i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  change Proj.awayι (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) Nat.zero_lt_one ≫ toSpec k n = _
  unfold toSpec toSpecZero
  change Proj.awayι (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) Nat.zero_lt_one ≫
        Proj.toSpecZero (grading k n) ≫
          Spec.map (degreeZeroEquiv k n).symm.toCommRingCatIso.hom = _
  rw [← Category.assoc, Proj.awayι_toSpecZero, ← Spec.map_comp]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveStructureRingHom_coordinateOpen_topIso
statement:
theorem projectiveStructureRingHom_coordinateOpen_topIso (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    CommRingCat.ofHom
        (structureRingHom (X := space k n) (R := CommRingCat.of k)
          (coordinateOpen k n i)) ≫
      (coordinateOpen k n i).topIso.inv =
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv ≫
          ((coordinateOpen k n i).ι ≫ toSpec k n).appTop
proof:
:= by
  unfold structureRingHom globalSec
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop]
  change (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv ≫
      (toSpec k n).appTop ≫
        (space k n).presheaf.map
          (coordinateOpen k n i).leTop.op ≫
            (coordinateOpen k n i).topIso.inv =
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv ≫
      (toSpec k n).appTop ≫ (coordinateOpen k n i).ι.appTop
  rw [show (space k n).presheaf.map
        (coordinateOpen k n i).leTop.op ≫
          (coordinateOpen k n i).topIso.inv =
      (coordinateOpen k n i).ι.appTop by
    ext x
    rfl]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveCoordinateOpen_ι_toSpec
statement:
theorem projectiveCoordinateOpen_ι_toSpec (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (coordinateOpen k n i).ι ≫ toSpec k n =
      (Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)
          (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) Nat.zero_lt_one).hom ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (projectiveCoordinateChartScalarRingHom k n i))
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi (Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)
    (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) Nat.zero_lt_one).inv).1
  simpa only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc] using
    projectiveCoordinateOpen_toSpec k n i

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveCoordinateChartScalarRingHom_awayToSection
statement:
theorem projectiveCoordinateChartScalarRingHom_awayToSection (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    CommRingCat.ofHom (projectiveCoordinateChartScalarRingHom k n i) ≫
        (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)
          (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) Nat.zero_lt_one).hom =
      CommRingCat.ofHom
        (structureRingHom (X := space k n) (R := CommRingCat.of k)
          (coordinateOpen k n i))
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (coordinateOpen k n i).topIso.inv).1
  calc
    _ = CommRingCat.ofHom (projectiveCoordinateChartScalarRingHom k n i) ≫
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso
          (CommRingCat.of (CoordinateChartRing k n i))).inv ≫
        (Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)
          (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) Nat.zero_lt_one).hom.appTop := by
      have happ := Proj.basicOpenToSpec_app_top
        (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)
      change (Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)
          (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) Nat.zero_lt_one).hom.appTop =
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso
          (CommRingCat.of (CoordinateChartRing k n i))).hom ≫
          (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)
            (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) Nat.zero_lt_one).hom ≫
            (coordinateOpen k n i).topIso.inv at happ
      rw [happ]
      simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
    _ = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv ≫
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (projectiveCoordinateChartScalarRingHom k n i))).appTop ≫
        (Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)
          (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) Nat.zero_lt_one).hom.appTop := by
      let φ : CommRingCat.of k ⟶
          CommRingCat.of (CoordinateChartRing k n i) :=
        CommRingCat.ofHom (projectiveCoordinateChartScalarRingHom k n i)
      let e := Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) Nat.zero_lt_one
      have hnat : φ ≫
          (Scheme.ΓSpecIso
            (CommRingCat.of (CoordinateChartRing k n i))).inv =
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv ≫
          (Spec.map φ).appTop :=
        Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality φ
      change φ ≫
          (Scheme.ΓSpecIso
            (CommRingCat.of (CoordinateChartRing k n i))).inv ≫ e.hom.appTop =
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv ≫
          (Spec.map φ).appTop ≫ e.hom.appTop
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ e.hom.appTop) hnat
    _ = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv ≫
        ((coordinateOpen k n i).ι ≫ toSpec k n).appTop := by
      let φ : CommRingCat.of k ⟶
          CommRingCat.of (CoordinateChartRing k n i) :=
        CommRingCat.ofHom (projectiveCoordinateChartScalarRingHom k n i)
      let e := Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) Nat.zero_lt_one
      have hU := projectiveCoordinateOpen_ι_toSpec k n i
      have hApp : ((coordinateOpen k n i).ι ≫ toSpec k n).appTop =
          (Spec.map φ).appTop ≫ e.hom.appTop := by
        rw [hU, Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop]
      change (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv ≫
          (Spec.map φ).appTop ≫ e.hom.appTop =
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv ≫
          ((coordinateOpen k n i).ι ≫ toSpec k n).appTop
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg
        (fun q ↦ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv ≫ q) hApp.symm
    _ = CommRingCat.ofHom
          (structureRingHom (X := space k n) (R := CommRingCat.of k)
            (coordinateOpen k n i)) ≫
        (coordinateOpen k n i).topIso.inv :=
      (projectiveStructureRingHom_coordinateOpen_topIso k n i).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.degreePieceCoefficients_injective
statement:
theorem degreePieceCoefficients_injective :
    Function.Injective (degreePieceCoefficients k n d)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q h
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext e
  by_cases he : Finsupp.degree e = d
  · let ee : DegreeExponent n d := ⟨e, he⟩
    exact congrFun h ee
  · have hp : MvPolynomial.coeff e p.1 = 0 := by
      by_contra hp
      exact he (by
        simpa [Finsupp.weight_apply, Finsupp.degree_eq_sum, Finsupp.sum_fintype] using p.2 hp)
    have hq : MvPolynomial.coeff e q.1 = 0 := by
      by_contra hq
      exact he (by
        simpa [Finsupp.weight_apply, Finsupp.degree_eq_sum, Finsupp.sum_fintype] using q.2 hq)
    rw [hp, hq]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingSheafHZeroEquivSections_smul
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingSheafHZeroEquivSections_smul (d : ℤ) (c : k)
    (x : Scheme.Modules.H (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) 0) :
    projectiveTwistingSheafHZeroEquivSections k n d (c • x) =
      c • projectiveTwistingSheafHZeroEquivSections k n d x
proof:
:= by
  let F : (space k n).Modules := projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d
  let F' := (SheafOfModules.toSheaf (space k n).ringCatSheaf).obj F
  letI : Module Γ(space k n, ⊤) ↑(F'.obj.obj (op ⊤)) := by
    change Module Γ(space k n, ⊤) Γ(F, ⊤)
    infer_instance
  letI : Module k ↑(F'.obj.obj (op ⊤)) :=
    Module.compHom _
      (structureRingHom (X := space k n) (R := CommRingCat.of k) ⊤)
  let e₀ : F'.H 0 ≃+ ↑(F'.obj.obj (op ⊤)) :=
    Sheaf.H.equiv₀ F' Limits.isTerminalTop
  change e₀ (c • x) = c • e₀ x
  rw [show c • x = Sheaf.H.map
      (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of k) F c) 0 x from
    (@smul_eq_H_map (space k n) (CommRingCat.of k)
      (projectiveSpaceOverSpec k n) F c 0 x).symm]
  rw [show e₀ (Sheaf.H.map (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of k) F c) 0 x) =
      (smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of k) F c).hom.app (op ⊤) (e₀ x) from
    (Sheaf.H.equiv₀_naturality (hT := Limits.isTerminalTop)
      (f := smulEnd (R := CommRingCat.of k) F c) x).symm]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.degreePieceChartRegularSection_smul
statement:
theorem degreePieceChartRegularSection_smul (d : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (c : k) (p : degreePiece k n d) :
    degreePieceChartRegularSection k n d i (c • p) =
      (structureRingHom (X := space k n) (R := CommRingCat.of k)
        (coordinateOpen k n i) c) •
        degreePieceChartRegularSection k n d i p
proof:
:= by
  change (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) Nat.zero_lt_one).hom
      (degreePieceChartFractionLinear k n d i (c • p)) = _
  rw [(degreePieceChartFractionLinear k n d i).map_smul]
  rw [projectiveCoordinateChart_smul_eq k n i c]
  rw [map_mul]
  rw [show (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) Nat.zero_lt_one).hom
        (projectiveCoordinateChartScalarRingHom k n i c) =
      structureRingHom (X := space k n) (R := CommRingCat.of k)
        (coordinateOpen k n i) c from
    ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (projectiveCoordinateChartScalarRingHom_awayToSection k n i) c]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.degreePiecePushedChartSection_smul
statement:
theorem degreePiecePushedChartSection_smul (d : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (c : k) (p : degreePiece k n d) :
    degreePiecePushedChartSection k n d i (c • p) =
      (structureRingHom (X := space k n) (R := CommRingCat.of k) ⊤ c) •
        degreePiecePushedChartSection k n d i p
proof:
:= by
  let U := coordinateOpen k n i
  change U.topIso.inv (degreePieceChartRegularSection k n d i (c • p)) = _
  rw [degreePieceChartRegularSection_smul k n d i c p]
  change U.topIso.inv
      (structureRingHom (X := space k n) (R := CommRingCat.of k) U c *
        degreePieceChartRegularSection k n d i p) = _
  rw [map_mul]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.degreePieceChartTuple_smul
statement:
theorem degreePieceChartTuple_smul (d : ℕ) (c : k)
    (p : degreePiece k n d) :
    degreePieceChartTuple k n d (c • p) =
      (structureRingHom (X := space k n) (R := CommRingCat.of k) ⊤ c) •
        degreePieceChartTuple k n d p
proof:
:= by
  let X := space k n
  let E := SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op (⊤ : X.Opens))
  let f := fun i : Fin (n + 1) ↦ pushedUnit X (coordinateOpen k n i)
  let e : E.obj (coordinateChartCochains k n) ≅
      ModuleCat.of Γ(X, ⊤) (∀ i, ↑(E.obj (f i))) :=
    PreservesProduct.iso E f ≪≫ ModuleCat.piIsoPi _
  letI : Module Γ(X, ⊤) ↑(E.obj (coordinateChartCochains k n)) := by
    change Module Γ(space k n, ⊤) Γ(coordinateChartCochains k n, ⊤)
    infer_instance
  let r := structureRingHom (X := space k n) (R := CommRingCat.of k) ⊤ c
  change e.inv (fun i ↦ degreePiecePushedChartSection k n d i (c • p)) =
    r • e.inv (fun i ↦ degreePiecePushedChartSection k n d i p)
  calc
    _ = e.inv (fun i ↦ r • degreePiecePushedChartSection k n d i p) := by
      congr 1
      funext i
      exact degreePiecePushedChartSection_smul k n d i c p
    _ = e.inv (r • (fun i ↦ degreePiecePushedChartSection k n d i p)) := rfl
    _ = _ := e.inv.hom.map_smul r _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.degreePieceCechKernelMap_smul
statement:
theorem degreePieceCechKernelMap_smul (d : ℕ) (c : k)
    (p : degreePiece k n d) :
    degreePieceCechKernelMap k n d (c • p) =
      c • degreePieceCechKernelMap k n d p
proof:
:= by
  change degreePieceCechKernelMap k n d (c • p) =
    (structureRingHom (X := space k n) (R := CommRingCat.of k) ⊤ c) •
      degreePieceCechKernelMap k n d p
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [degreePieceCechKernelMap_val]
  change degreePieceChartTuple k n d (c • p) =
    (structureRingHom (X := space k n) (R := CommRingCat.of k) ⊤ c) •
      (degreePieceCechKernelMap k n d p).1
  rw [degreePieceCechKernelMap_val]
  exact degreePieceChartTuple_smul k n d c p

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingGlobalSectionsCechKernelEquiv_smul
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingGlobalSectionsCechKernelEquiv_smul
    (d : ℤ) (c : k) (s : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d, ⊤)) :
    projectiveTwistingGlobalSectionsCechKernelEquiv k n d (c • s) =
      c • projectiveTwistingGlobalSectionsCechKernelEquiv k n d s
proof:
:= by
  change projectiveTwistingGlobalSectionsCechKernelEquiv k n d
      ((structureRingHom (X := space k n) (R := CommRingCat.of k) ⊤ c) • s) =
    (structureRingHom (X := space k n) (R := CommRingCat.of k) ⊤ c) •
      projectiveTwistingGlobalSectionsCechKernelEquiv k n d s
  exact (projectiveTwistingGlobalSectionsCechKernelEquiv k n d).map_smul
    (structureRingHom (X := space k n) (R := CommRingCat.of k) ⊤ c) s

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingSheaf_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_nat
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingSheaf_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_nat (d : ℕ) :
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n (d : ℤ)).HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k where
  finite q
proof:
:= by
    cases q with
    | zero => exact projectiveTwistingSheaf_H_zero_finite k n d
    | succ p => exact projectiveTwistingSheaf_H_finite k n (d : ℤ) p
  vanishing := by
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    intro q hq
    cases q with
    | zero => omega
    | succ p =>
        exact AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf_H_isZero k n (d : ℤ) (by omega) p)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit_add
statement:
theorem linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit_add
    (d e : ℤ) (x y : M) :
    linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit R M (d + e) x y =
      linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit R M d x y *
        linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit R M e x y
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit]
  rw [linearTwistTransitionUnit_add]
  exact map_mul _ _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearOverlapTransitionIso_add
statement:
theorem linearOverlapTransitionIso_add
    (d e : ℤ) (x y : M) :
    linearOverlapTransitionIso R M (d + e) x y =
      linearOverlapTransitionIso R M e x y ≪≫
        linearOverlapTransitionIso R M d x y
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [linearOverlapTransitionIso]
  rw [linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit_add, map_mul]
  exact SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso_mul _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedLinearOverlapTransition_add
statement:
theorem pushedLinearOverlapTransition_add
    (d e : ℤ) (x y : M) :
    pushedLinearOverlapTransition R M (d + e) x y =
      pushedLinearOverlapTransition R M e x y ≫
        pushedLinearOverlapTransition R M d x y
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [pushedLinearOverlapTransition]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  exact congrArg
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (linearOverlapOpen R M x y).ι).map
    (congrArg Iso.hom (linearOverlapTransitionIso_add d e x y))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.chartTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem chartTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree
    (i : C.I) [Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)] (d : ℤ) :
    SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree (C.chart i)
      (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)
proof:
:= by
  let n := C.positiveRankDimension i
  let r := C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i
  let b := C.reindexedSectionBasis i r
  let f := intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b
  let D := SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingSheaf
    Γ(X, C.U i) n d
  have hD : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.ProjectiveTwistSpace Γ(X, C.U i) n) D :=
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree
      Γ(X, C.U i) n d
  have hpull : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree (C.chart i)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj D) :=
    SchemeKTheory.pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global f D hD
  exact SchemeKTheory.isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso (C.chart i)
    (C.chartGeometricTwistingSheafIsoChartTwistingSheaf i r d) hpull

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.chartTwistingSheafK0Class_mul
statement:
theorem chartTwistingSheafK0Class_mul
    (i : C.I) [Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)] (d e : ℤ) :
    C.chartTwistingSheafK0Class i d *
        C.chartTwistingSheafK0Class i e =
      C.chartTwistingSheafK0Class i (d + e)
proof:
:= by
  let D : {M : (C.chart i).Modules //
      SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree (C.chart i) M} :=
    ⟨C.chartTwistingSheaf d i,
      C.chartTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree i d⟩
  let E' : {M : (C.chart i).Modules //
      SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree (C.chart i) M} :=
    ⟨C.chartTwistingSheaf e i,
      C.chartTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree i e⟩
  let hDE := SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree
    (C.chart i) D.1 E'.1 D.2 E'.2
  change
    SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf (C.chart i) D.1 D.2 *
        SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf (C.chart i) E'.1 E'.2 =
      SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf (C.chart i)
        (C.chartTwistingSheaf (d + e) i)
        (C.chartTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree i (d + e))
  calc
    _ = SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf (C.chart i)
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf (C.chart i) D.1 E'.1) hDE := by
      exact SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf_mul (C.chart i) D E'
    _ = _ := SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf_iso (C.chart i) hDE
      (C.chartTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree i (d + e))
      (C.chartTwistingSheafTensorIso i d e)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.chartTwistingSheafK0Class_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chartTwistingSheafK0Class_zero
    (i : C.I) [Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)] :
    C.chartTwistingSheafK0Class i 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  let h0 := C.chartTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree i 0
  let hOne := SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (C.chart i)
  change SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf (C.chart i)
      (C.chartTwistingSheaf 0 i) h0 = 1
  calc
    _ = SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf (C.chart i)
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf (C.chart i)) hOne :=
      SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf_iso (C.chart i) h0 hOne
        (C.chartTwistingSheafZeroIso i)
    _ = 1 := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.chartTwistingSheafK0ClassUnit_add
statement:
theorem chartTwistingSheafK0ClassUnit_add
    (i : C.I) [Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)] (d e : ℤ) :
    C.chartTwistingSheafK0ClassUnit i (d + e) =
      C.chartTwistingSheafK0ClassUnit i d *
        C.chartTwistingSheafK0ClassUnit i e
proof:
:= by
  apply Units.ext
  exact (C.chartTwistingSheafK0Class_mul i d e).symm

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.TripleRangeData.cocycle_first_second_toBase
statement:
theorem cocycle_first_second_toBase (U V W : X.affineOpens)
    (k : (r.cocycleRefinementCover U V W).I₀) :
    r.cocycleToFirstLocal U V W k ≫ (a.cover U V).f k.1.1 ≫
        overlapToChart I U V ≫ chartToBase I U =
      r.cocycleToSecondLocal U V W k ≫ (a.cover V W).f k.1.2 ≫
        overlapToChart I V W ≫ chartToBase I V
proof:
:= by
  rw [r.cocycleToFirstLocal_fac_assoc, r.cocycleToSecondLocal_fac_assoc]
  simp only [Category.assoc, transitionTriple_fst_assoc, firstLeg_toChart_assoc,
    PairwiseAtlas.tripleToChart]
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, ← a.transition_toBase U V]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.TripleRangeData.cocycle_second_third_toBase
statement:
theorem cocycle_second_third_toBase (U V W : X.affineOpens)
    (k : (r.cocycleRefinementCover U V W).I₀) :
    r.cocycleToSecondLocal U V W k ≫ (a.cover V W).f k.1.2 ≫
        overlapToChart I V W ≫ chartToBase I V =
      r.cocycleToThirdLocal U V W k ≫ (a.cover W U).f k.2 ≫
        overlapToChart I W U ≫ chartToBase I W
proof:
:= by
  rw [r.cocycleToSecondLocal_fac_assoc, r.cocycleToThirdLocal_fac_assoc]
  simp only [Category.assoc, transitionTriple_fst_assoc, firstLeg_toChart_assoc,
    PairwiseAtlas.tripleToChart]
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, ← a.transition_toBase V W]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [r.firstLeg_toChart_assoc]
  rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIFZ.chK0_lof_decomp
statement:
theorem chK0_lof_decomp (w : K0 W) (N : ℕ) (y : RationalDimChow W N) :
    chK0 k hP hCh w (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow W n) N y) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), lowPart (M := fun n ↦ RationalDimChow W n) j
        (chK0 k hP hCh w) (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow W n) N y)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : _root_.Nonempty W := CHEXACT.nonempty_of_fact k (W := W)
  have hW : WhitneyConstRankOn (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) hP := whitney_projectiveIntegral hP
  let D : Module.End ℚ (TotalChow W) →+ TotalChow W :=
    { toFun := fun T => T (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow W n) N y) -
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), lowPart (M := fun n ↦ RationalDimChow W n) j T
          (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow W n) N y)
      map_zero' := by simp [lowPart_zero]
      map_add' := by
        intro T S
        simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, lowPart_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        abel }
  have key : ∀ (E : W.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree W E),
      D (chK0 k hP hCh (k0ClassOf W E hE)) = 0 := by
    intro E hE
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := CHEXACT.exists_rank k hE
    have hG := gser_ch (ops := opsV4 k) (cp := cpV4 k) (hP := hP) hW hr
    show chK0 k hP hCh (k0ClassOf W E hE) _ - _ = 0
    rw [chK0_classOf_eq_chTot hP hCh E hE, chTot_eq_tot, sub_eq_zero, tot_lof]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => ?_
    rw [lowPart_tot hG m, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
  have hfg : D.comp (chK0 k hP hCh) = (0 : K0 W →+ TotalChow W) := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    intro x
    exact key x.1 x.2
  have := DFunLike.congr_fun hfg w
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp this

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIFZ.zxOp_eq_zxLow
statement:
theorem zxOp_eq_zxLow (C : AffineFrameCover X BX) [Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k C.scheme)] {r : ℕ}
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = r + 1) (w : K0 C.scheme) (m : ℕ) :
    zxOp k (hPk k) (GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.chExact_projectiveIntegral (k := k)) C hC w m =
      zxLow (k := k) C hC w (r + m)
proof: := rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIFZ.pull_zxLow
statement:
theorem pull_zxLow (w : K0 CX.scheme) (j : ℕ) :
    letI
proof:
:= AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.pullbackProjectiveMap_flat CX q
    totalPullOn (opsV4 k) q d hd ∘ₗ zxLow (k := k) CX hC w j =
      zxLow (k := k) (CX.pullbackFrameCover q) (CX.pullbackFrameCover_card q hC)
          (flatPullbackK0 (CX.pullbackProjectiveMap q) w) j ∘ₗ totalPullOn (opsV4 k) q d hd := by
  letI := pullbackProjectiveMap_isOver (k := k) CX q
  letI := AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.pullbackProjectiveMap_flat CX q
  letI := CX.toBase_flat (CX.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos r))
  let D := CX.pullbackFrameCover q
  let hD := CX.pullbackFrameCover_card q hC
  letI := D.toBase_flat (D.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hD (Nat.succ_pos r))
  let PG := totalPullOn (opsV4 k) q d hd
  let hdF := CX.pullbackProjectiveMap_pureRelDim k q d hd
  let PF := totalPullOn (opsV4 k) (CX.pullbackProjectiveMap q) d hdF
  let PC := totalPullOn (opsV4 k) CX.toBase r ((cpV4 k).projBundle_relDim CX hC)
  let PD := totalPullOn (opsV4 k) D.toBase r ((cpV4 k).projBundle_relDim D hD)
  have hb : PG ∘ₗ totalPushOn (opsV4 k) CX.toBase = totalPushOn (opsV4 k) D.toBase ∘ₗ PF :=
    (cpV4 k).base_change CX.toBase q D.toBase (CX.pullbackProjectiveMap q) d hd hdF
      (CX.isPullback_pullbackProjectiveMap q)
  have hc : PF ∘ₗ PC = PD ∘ₗ PG := projection_totalPullOn_flat CX q (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) d hd hC
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro v
  unfold zxLow
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  have hb' : ∀ z, PG (totalPushOn (opsV4 k) CX.toBase z) =
      totalPushOn (opsV4 k) D.toBase (PF z) := fun z => LinearMap.congr_fun hb z
  have hc' : PF (PC v) = PD (PG v) := LinearMap.congr_fun hc v
  have hl : PF (lowPart (M := fun n => RationalDimChow CX.scheme n) j
      (chK0 k (hPk k) (GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.chExact_projectiveIntegral (k := k)) w) (PC v)) =
      lowPart (M := fun n => RationalDimChow D.scheme n) j
        (chK0 k (hPk k) (GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.chExact_projectiveIntegral (k := k))
          (flatPullbackK0 (CX.pullbackProjectiveMap q) w)) (PF (PC v)) :=
    lowPart_pull_flat (CX.pullbackProjectiveMap q) hdF w j (PC v)
  rw [hb', hl, hc']

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIFZ.zxLow_koszul_zero
statement:
theorem zxLow_koszul_zero (F : FlagLift (opsV4 k) S) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < e + 1) :
    zxLow (k := k) C hC (lamProd S C (e + 1)) j = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, c1, c2, φ, hinj, ⟨z, hz⟩, ⟨x, hx⟩⟩ := exists_coverLift S C hC
  haveI := flat_toBaseG S C hC
  have hch : chK0 k (hPk k) (GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.chExact_projectiveIntegral (k := k))
      (lamProd S C (e + 1)) = tot (kSer S C (e + 1)) := (chK_koszul S C hC (e + 1)).2
  unfold zxLow
  rw [hch, lowPart_tot (gSer_kSer S C (e + 1)), coeff_kSer_expansion S C φ z x hz hx j]
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro v
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply, map_sum, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun jj _ => ?_
  split_ifs with hjj
  · have ht := LinearMap.congr_fun
      (term_eq S C hC F φ z hz x hx (cUniv e j (j - jj) jj) jj) v
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Module.End.mul_apply] at ht
    rw [sandwichOn_eq_zero_of_lt (opsV4 k) C (cpV4 k) hC (by omega)] at ht
    simpa using ht
  · simp

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIFZ.zxLow_kosClassX_zero
statement:
theorem zxLow_kosClassX_zero (j : ℕ) (hj : j < e + 1) :
    zxLow (k := k) CX hCX (kosClassX CX hE) j = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S⟩ := exists_chowSplittingOn (chowOpsOn_projectiveIntegral k)
    (chowCompatOn_projectiveIntegral k) (hP k) e E hE
  obtain ⟨F⟩ := exists_flagLift (chowOpsOn_projectiveIntegral k)
    (chowCompatOn_projectiveIntegral k) S
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k (CX.pullbackFrameCover S.q).scheme) :=
    ⟨hP k _ (CX.pullbackFrameCover_card S.q hCX)⟩
  have hCF := CX.pullbackFrameCover_card S.q hCX
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro α
  apply S.injective
  have h1 := LinearMap.congr_fun (pull_zxLow (k := k) CX S.q S.hd hCX (kosClassX CX hE) j) α
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at h1
  rw [h1, flatPullbackK0_kosClassX S CX hCX hE,
    zxLow_koszul_zero S (CX.pullbackFrameCover S.q) hCF F j hj]
  simp

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIFZ.tdInvDualTot_coeff
statement:
theorem tdInvDualTot_coeff (m : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff m (PowerSeries.invOfUnit
      (PowerSeries.mk (tdG (dualChernOf (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) (hPk k) E))) 1) =
      tdNinvOp (chernOpOn' (chowOpsOn_projectiveIntegral k) (chowCompatOn_projectiveIntegral k)
        (hP k) E (e + 1) hE) m
proof:
:= by
  unfold tdNinvOp dualChernOf Alg.dualChern
  rw [constRankChernAssignOn'_eq (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) (hPk k) E (e + 1) hE]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIFZ.zxTot_core
statement:
theorem zxTot_core (v : TotalChow X) :
    haveI : Flat CX.toBase
proof:
:=
      CX.toBase_flat (CX.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hCX (Nat.succ_pos (e + 1)))
    totalPushOn (opsV4 k) CX.toBase
      (chK0 k (hPk k) (GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.chExact_projectiveIntegral (k := k))
        (kosClassX CX hE)
        (totalPullOn (opsV4 k) CX.toBase (e + 1) ((cpV4 k).projBundle_relDim CX hCX) v)) =
      tdInvDualTot (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) (hPk k) E v := by
  haveI : Flat CX.toBase :=
    CX.toBase_flat (CX.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hCX (Nat.succ_pos (e + 1)))
  have hlin : totalPushOn (opsV4 k) CX.toBase ∘ₗ
      (chK0 k (hPk k) (GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.chExact_projectiveIntegral (k := k))
        (kosClassX CX hE)) ∘ₗ
      totalPullOn (opsV4 k) CX.toBase (e + 1) ((cpV4 k).projBundle_relDim CX hCX) =
      tdInvDualTot (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) (hPk k) E := by
    refine DirectSum.linearMap_ext ℚ fun n => ?_
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro z
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
    have h1 : totalPullOn (opsV4 k) CX.toBase (e + 1) ((cpV4 k).projBundle_relDim CX hCX)
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun i ↦ RationalDimChow X i) n z) =
        DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun i ↦ RationalDimChow CX.scheme i) (n + (e + 1))
          ((opsV4 k).pull CX.toBase (e + 1) ((cpV4 k).projBundle_relDim CX hCX) n z) := by
      simp [totalPullOn]
    have hdec := chK0_lof_decomp (hPk k)
      (GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.chExact_projectiveIntegral (k := k)) (kosClassX CX hE) (n + (e + 1))
      ((opsV4 k).pull CX.toBase (e + 1) ((cpV4 k).projBundle_relDim CX hCX) n z)
    rw [← h1] at hdec
    rw [hdec, map_sum]
    have hsplit : n + (e + 1) + 1 = (e + 1) + (n + 1) := by omega
    rw [hsplit, Finset.sum_range_add]
    have hz : ∀ j, totalPushOn (opsV4 k) CX.toBase
        (lowPart (M := fun i ↦ RationalDimChow CX.scheme i) j
          (chK0 k (hPk k) (GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.chExact_projectiveIntegral (k := k))
            (kosClassX CX hE))
          (totalPullOn (opsV4 k) CX.toBase (e + 1) ((cpV4 k).projBundle_relDim CX hCX)
            (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun i ↦ RationalDimChow X i) n z))) =
        zxLow (k := k) CX hCX (kosClassX CX hE) j
          (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun i ↦ RationalDimChow X i) n z) := fun j => rfl
    simp only [hz]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun j hj => by
      rw [zxLow_kosClassX_zero CX hCX hE j (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)]; rfl), zero_add]
    unfold tdInvDualTot
    rw [tot_lof]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => ?_
    rw [tdInvDualTot_coeff hE m, ← zx_eq_tdNinvOp_final CX hCX hE m]
    rfl
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun hlin v

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIFZ.zxTot_of_model
statement:
theorem zxTot_of_model (h : ChExact k (closedPosV4 k)) :
    haveI
proof:
:= M.flat
    ∀ v : TotalChow X, totalPushOn (opsV4 k) (RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).toBase
      (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h (kosClassX M.CX M.hN)
        (totalPullOn (opsV4 k) (RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).toBase (e + 1)
          ((cpV4 k).projBundle_relDim (RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN) M.hC) v)) =
      tdInvN k (closedPosV4 k) i v := by
  haveI : Nonempty X := CHEXACT.nonempty_of_fact k (W := X)
  intro v
  rw [tdInvN_eq_tdInvDualTot (closedPosV4 k) i M.hN]
  exact zxTot_core M.CX M.hC M.hN v

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIFZ.zsChowGates_of_chMul
statement:
theorem zsChowGates_of_chMul (h : ChExact k (closedPosV4 k))
    (chMul : ∀ a b : K0 (RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).scheme,
      chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h (a * b) =
        chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h a * chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h b) :
    GRRBlueprintV4.CIIASM.ZSChowGates M h

:=
  ⟨chMul, fundPush_of_model M, fundPull_of_model M, zxTot_of_model M h⟩

name: ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.phi_monomial
statement:
theorem phi_monomial (r : ℕ) (s : ℕ → R) (k : ℕ) (a : R) :
    phi r s (monomial k a) = a * (if r ≤ k then s (k - r) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [phi, Polynomial.lsum_apply]
  rw [Polynomial.sum_monomial_index]
  · split_ifs <;> simp [mul_comm]
  · simp

name: ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.phi_C_mul_X_pow
statement:
theorem phi_C_mul_X_pow (r : ℕ) (s : ℕ → R) (k : ℕ) (a : R) :
    phi r s (C a * X ^ k) = a * (if r ≤ k then s (k - r) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, phi_monomial]

name: ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.phi_chernPoly_mul_X_pow
statement:
theorem phi_chernPoly_mul_X_pow {r : ℕ} {e s : ℕ → R} (h : SegreInv r e s) (i : ℕ) :
    phi r s (chernPoly r e * X ^ i) = if i = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hz, hs⟩ := h
  have step : phi r s (chernPoly r e * X ^ i) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), (if j ≤ i then e j * s (i - j) else 0) := by
    simp only [chernPoly, Finset.sum_mul, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
    have hjr : j ≤ r := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)
    rw [mul_assoc, ← pow_add, phi_C_mul_X_pow]
    by_cases hji : j ≤ i
    · have h1 : r ≤ r - j + i := by omega
      have h2 : r - j + i - r = i - j := by omega
      simp [hji, h1, h2]
    · have h1 : ¬ r ≤ r - j + i := by omega
      simp [hji, h1]
  rw [step, ← hs i, ← Finset.sum_filter]
  refine Finset.sum_subset ?_ ?_
  · intro a ha
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at ha ⊢
    omega
  · intro a ha hna
    simp only [Finset.mem_range] at ha
    have : ¬ a < r + 1 := by
      intro hlt
      exact hna (by simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]; omega)
    rw [hz a (by omega), zero_mul]

name: ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.phi_chernPoly_mul
statement:
theorem phi_chernPoly_mul {r : ℕ} {e s : ℕ → R} (h : SegreInv r e s) (U : R[X]) :
    phi r s (chernPoly r e * U) = U.coeff 0
proof:
:= by
  induction U using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => rw [mul_add, map_add, hp, hq, coeff_add]
  | monomial i a =>
    have : chernPoly r e * monomial i a = a • (chernPoly r e * X ^ i) := by
      rw [← C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, smul_eq_C_mul]; ring
    rw [this, map_smul, phi_chernPoly_mul_X_pow h, coeff_monomial, smul_eq_mul]
    by_cases hi : i = 0 <;> simp [hi]

name: ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.one_sub_expT_neg
statement:
theorem one_sub_expT_neg {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [Algebra ℚ A] (D : ℕ) (z : A) :
    1 - expT D (-z) = z * uT D z
proof:
:= by
  induction D with
  | zero => simp [expT, uT]
  | succ D ih =>
    simp only [expT, uT, Finset.sum_range_succ] at ih ⊢
    have h0 : (algebraMap ℚ A) (1 / ((0 : ℕ).factorial : ℚ)) = 1 := by simp
    rw [mul_add, ← ih]
    have : (-z) ^ (D + 1) = (-1) ^ (D + 1) * z ^ (D + 1) := by rw [neg_eq_neg_one_mul, mul_pow]
    rw [this]
    have h3 : (-1 : A) ^ (D + 1) = - (-1) ^ D := by rw [pow_succ]; ring
    rw [h3]
    ring

name: ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.eval_zero_uT
statement: theorem eval_zero_uT (D : ℕ) (n : R) : (uT D (X + C n)).eval 0 = uT D n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [uT, eval_finsetSum, eval_mul, eval_pow, eval_add, eval_X, eval_C, zero_add,
    eval_neg, eval_one, Polynomial.algebraMap_apply]

name: ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.zscore_roots
statement:
theorem zscore_roots (m : Multiset R) (s : ℕ → R)
    (hs : SegreInv (Multiset.card m) (fun j => m.esymm j) s) (D : ℕ) :
    phi (Multiset.card m) s
        ((m.map fun n => 1 - expT D (-(X + C n))).prod) =
      (m.map fun n => uT D n).prod
proof:
:= by
  have hP : (m.map fun n => X + C n).prod = chernPoly (Multiset.card m) (fun j => m.esymm j) := by
    rw [Multiset.prod_X_add_C_eq_sum_esymm]; rfl
  have hg : (m.map fun n => 1 - expT D (-(X + C n))).prod =
      chernPoly (Multiset.card m) (fun j => m.esymm j) *
        (m.map fun n => uT D (X + C n)).prod := by
    rw [← hP, ← Multiset.prod_map_mul]
    exact congrArg Multiset.prod (Multiset.map_congr rfl fun n _ => one_sub_expT_neg D _)
  rw [hg, phi_chernPoly_mul hs]
  have : ((m.map fun n => uT D (X + C n)).prod).coeff 0 =
      Polynomial.eval 0 ((m.map fun n => uT D (X + C n)).prod) := by
    rw [coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero]
  rw [this, Polynomial.eval_multiset_prod, Multiset.map_map]
  exact congrArg Multiset.prod (Multiset.map_congr rfl fun n _ => eval_zero_uT D n)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.capOn_prime_support
statement:
theorem capOn_prime_support (N : P.Modules) (hN : HasConstantRank P N 1) (U : P.Opens)
    (e : (tensorUnitSheaf P).over U ≅ N.over U) (m : ℕ) (v : P) (hv : height v = m + 1) :
    ∃ D : dimensionCycles P m,
      D.1.support ⊆ (U : Set P)ᶜ ∩ Set.range (pointClosureι v) ∧
      ops.cap N hN m ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v (m + 1) hv) : DimChow P (m + 1))) =
        (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow P m)
proof:
:= by
  have hfl := isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure N hN v
  have hrV := m7s_genericRank_pointClosure N hN v
  have hgen : genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v) = pointClosureGenericPoint v :=
    ((pointClosureGenericPoint_isGeneric v).eq (genericPoint_spec _)).symm
  
  have key : ∀ {b₀ : pointClosureScheme v}
      (b : LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme v)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj N) b₀),
      ∃ D : dimensionCycles P m,
        D.1 = properPushforward (pointClosureι v) (lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hfl hrV b).1 ∧
        D.1.support ⊆ pointClosureι v '' {z | lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame hfl hrV b z ≠ 0} ∧
        ops.cap N hN m ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
          (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v (m + 1) hv) : DimChow P (m + 1))) =
          (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow P m) := by
    intro b₀ b
    have hmem := m7s_pushWeil_mem (k := k) N hN m v hv b
    refine ⟨⟨_, hmem⟩, rfl, ?_, ops.cap_mk N hN m v hv hrV b ⟨_, hmem⟩ rfl⟩
    change (properPushforward (pointClosureι v)
      (lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hfl hrV b).1).support ⊆ _
    rw [properPushforward, AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_support_closedImmersion (pointClosureι v) _
      (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl)]
    exact Set.image_mono (fun z hz ↦ hz)
  by_cases hvU : v ∈ U
  · have hy : pointClosureι v (pointClosureGenericPoint v) ∈ U := by
      rw [pointClosureι_genericPoint]; exact hvU
    let b := pullbackFrameOfOverIso (pointClosureι v) U e (pointClosureGenericPoint v) hy
    obtain ⟨D, -, hsupp, hcap⟩ := key b
    refine ⟨D, ?_, hcap⟩
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := hsupp hx
    refine ⟨?_, z, rfl⟩
    intro hzU
    apply hz
    exact coeff_eq_zero_of_mem hfl hrV b z hzU
  · obtain ⟨b⟩ := Scheme.Modules.exists_lineBundleLocalDataAt (pointClosureScheme v)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj N) hfl hrV (pointClosureGenericPoint v)
    obtain ⟨D, -, hsupp, hcap⟩ := key b
    refine ⟨D, ?_, hcap⟩
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨z, -, rfl⟩ := hsupp hx
    refine ⟨?_, z, rfl⟩
    intro hzU
    have hsp : v ⤳ pointClosureι v z := C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι v z
    exact hvU (((hsp.mem_open U.isOpen hzU)) |> fun h ↦ h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.capOn_prime_eq_zero_of_range_subset
statement:
theorem capOn_prime_eq_zero_of_range_subset (N : P.Modules) (hN : HasConstantRank P N 1)
    (U : P.Opens) (e : (tensorUnitSheaf P).over U ≅ N.over U) (m : ℕ) (w : P)
    (hw : height w = m + 1) (hr : Set.range (pointClosureι w) ⊆ U) :
    ops.cap N hN m ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
      (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle w (m + 1) hw) : DimChow P (m + 1))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hcap⟩ := capOn_prime_support ops N hN U e m w hw
  have h0 : D = 0 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    ext x
    by_contra hx
    obtain ⟨hxU, y, rfl⟩ := hD (show x ∈ D.1.support from hx)
    exact hxU (hr ⟨y, rfl⟩)
  rw [hcap, h0, QuotientAddGroup.mk_zero, TensorProduct.tmul_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.capOn_cap_eq_zero_component
statement:
theorem capOn_cap_eq_zero_component (N₁ N₂ : P.Modules) (hN₁ : HasConstantRank P N₁ 1)
    (hN₂ : HasConstantRank P N₂ 1) (U₁ U₂ : P.Opens) (hcov : ∀ x : P, x ∈ U₁ ∨ x ∈ U₂)
    (e₁ : (tensorUnitSheaf P).over U₁ ≅ N₁.over U₁)
    (e₂ : (tensorUnitSheaf P).over U₂ ≅ N₂.over U₂) (m : ℕ) :
    ops.cap N₁ hN₁ m ∘ₗ ops.cap N₂ hN₂ (m + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply e4_linearMap_ext_of_prime
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hcap⟩ := capOn_prime_support ops N₂ hN₂ U₂ e₂ (m + 1) v hv
  change ops.cap N₁ hN₁ m (ops.cap N₂ hN₂ (m + 1) _) = 0
  rw [hcap]
  have hmem := m7s_mem_of_prime (LinearMap.ker (ops.cap N₁ hN₁ m)) ((U₂ : Set P)ᶜ)
    (fun w hw hwS ↦ by
      change ops.cap N₁ hN₁ m _ = 0
      refine capOn_prime_eq_zero_of_range_subset ops N₁ hN₁ U₁ e₁ m w hw ?_
      intro y hy
      have hy' := range_pointClosureι_subset_of_isClosed
        (S := (U₂ : Set P)ᶜ) U₂.isOpen.isClosed_compl w hwS hy
      exact (hcov y).resolve_right hy')
    D (fun x hx ↦ (hD hx).1)
  exact hmem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.totalCapOn_mul_eq_zero_of_cover
statement:
theorem totalCapOn_mul_eq_zero_of_cover (N₁ N₂ : P.Modules) (hN₁ : HasConstantRank P N₁ 1)
    (hN₂ : HasConstantRank P N₂ 1) (U₁ U₂ : P.Opens) (hcov : ∀ x : P, x ∈ U₁ ∨ x ∈ U₂)
    (e₁ : (tensorUnitSheaf P).over U₁ ≅ N₁.over U₁)
    (e₂ : (tensorUnitSheaf P).over U₂ ≅ N₂.over U₂) :
    totalCapOn ops N₁ hN₁ ∘ₗ totalCapOn ops N₂ hN₂ = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro c
  cases n with
  | zero => simp [totalCapOn, capComponentOn]
  | succ m =>
    cases m with
    | zero => simp [totalCapOn, capComponentOn]
    | succ m =>
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, totalCapOn, DirectSum.toModule_lof, capComponentOn,
        LinearMap.zero_apply]
      have := LinearMap.congr_fun (capOn_cap_eq_zero_component ops N₁ N₂ hN₁ hN₂ U₁ U₂ hcov e₁ e₂ m) c
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply] at this
      rw [this, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.capOn_tensorUnit_eq_zero
statement:
theorem capOn_tensorUnit_eq_zero (m : ℕ) :
    ops.cap (tensorUnitSheaf P) (hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf (Y := P)) m = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply e4_linearMap_ext_of_prime
  intro v hv
  rw [LinearMap.zero_apply]
  exact capOn_prime_eq_zero_of_range_subset ops _ _ ⊤ (Iso.refl _) m v hv (fun _ _ ↦ trivial)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.totalCapOn_tensorUnit
statement:
theorem totalCapOn_tensorUnit : totalCapOn ops (tensorUnitSheaf P)
    (hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf (Y := P)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro c
  cases n with
  | zero => simp [totalCapOn, capComponentOn]
  | succ m => simp [totalCapOn, capComponentOn, capOn_tensorUnit_eq_zero ops m]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.totalCapOn_add_dual
statement:
theorem totalCapOn_add_dual {B : P.Modules} (hB : HasConstantRank P B 1) :
    totalCapOn ops B hB + totalCapOn ops (lineBundleDual P B) (lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank B hB)
      = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hD := lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank B hB
  have hT : HasConstantRank P (tensorSheaf P B (lineBundleDual P B)) 1 := by
    have h := hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hB hD
    rwa [Nat.one_mul] at h
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := exists_tensorDual_iso hB
  have h := totalCapOn_tensor (ops := ops) B (lineBundleDual P B) hB hD hT
  rw [cap_isoOn ops hT hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf ⟨e⟩, totalCapOn_tensorUnit] at h
  exact h.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.totalCapOn_tensor_dual
statement:
theorem totalCapOn_tensor_dual {A B : P.Modules} (hA : HasConstantRank P A 1)
    (hB : HasConstantRank P B 1)
    (hN : HasConstantRank P (tensorSheaf P A (lineBundleDual P B)) 1) :
    totalCapOn ops (tensorSheaf P A (lineBundleDual P B)) hN =
      totalCapOn ops A hA - totalCapOn ops B hB
proof:
:= by
  have hD := lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank B hB
  rw [totalCapOn_tensor (ops := ops) A (lineBundleDual P B) hA hD hN]
  have h := totalCapOn_add_dual ops hB
  have hd : totalCapOn ops (lineBundleDual P B) hD = -totalCapOn ops B hB := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro c
    have h1 := LinearMap.congr_fun h c
    rw [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply] at h1
    rw [LinearMap.neg_apply]
    exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right h1
  rw [hd]
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro c
  simp [sub_eq_add_neg]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.totalCapOn_sub_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem totalCapOn_sub_mul_eq_zero {A B₁ B₂ : P.Modules} (hA : HasConstantRank P A 1)
    (hB₁ : HasConstantRank P B₁ 1) (hB₂ : HasConstantRank P B₂ 1)
    (φ₁ : B₁ ⟶ A) (φ₂ : B₂ ⟶ A) (U₁ U₂ : P.Opens) [IsIso (φ₁.over U₁)] [IsIso (φ₂.over U₂)]
    (hcov : ∀ x : P, x ∈ U₁ ∨ x ∈ U₂) :
    (totalCapOn ops A hA - totalCapOn ops B₁ hB₁) ∘ₗ (totalCapOn ops A hA - totalCapOn ops B₂ hB₂) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hN : ∀ B : P.Modules, HasConstantRank P B 1 →
      HasConstantRank P (tensorSheaf P A (lineBundleDual P B)) 1 := fun B hB ↦ by
    have h := hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hA (lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank B hB)
    rwa [Nat.one_mul] at h
  have h := totalCapOn_mul_eq_zero_of_cover ops (tensorSheaf P A (lineBundleDual P B₁))
    (tensorSheaf P A (lineBundleDual P B₂)) (hN B₁ hB₁) (hN B₂ hB₂) U₁ U₂ hcov
    (trivOfIso hB₁ φ₁ U₁) (trivOfIso hB₂ φ₂ U₂)
  rwa [totalCapOn_tensor_dual ops hA hB₁ (hN B₁ hB₁), totalCapOn_tensor_dual ops hA hB₂ (hN B₂ hB₂)]
    at h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.xiRelationOn
statement:
theorem xiRelationOn (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1) :
    (xiCapOn ops C - totalCapOn ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase L 1 hL)) ∘ₗ
      (xiCapOn ops C - totalCapOn ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj M)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase M 1 hM)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U₁, U₂, h₁, h₂, hcov⟩ := exists_cover_isIso (E7.tautFst C) (E7.tautSnd C)
    (fun u v h1 h2 ↦ tautCoord_jointly_epi C u v h1 h2)
    (isLocalLineFrame_of_hasConstantRank (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase L 1 hL))
    (isLocalLineFrame_of_hasConstantRank (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase M 1 hM))
    (isLocalLineFrame_of_hasConstantRank (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))
  haveI := h₁
  haveI := h₂
  exact totalCapOn_sub_mul_eq_zero ops (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase L 1 hL)
    (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase M 1 hM) (E7.tautFst C) (E7.tautSnd C) U₁ U₂ hcov

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K3.push_eq_pushD9On
statement:
theorem push_eq_pushD9On (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsProper f] (n : ℕ) :
    ops.push f n = D9.pushD9 (k := k) f n
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a y =>
    induction y using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H D =>
      have h1 : a ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X n) =
          a • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X n)) := by
        rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      rw [h1, map_smul, map_smul]
      congr 1
      rw [D9.pushD9_mk0 (k := k) f n D]
      exact ops.push_mk f n D _ rfl
  | add x y hx hy => simp [map_add, hx, hy]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K3.totalPushOn_comp
statement:
theorem totalPushOn_comp (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) [f.IsOver (Spk k)]
    [g.IsOver (Spk k)] [(f ≫ g).IsOver (Spk k)] [IsProper f] [IsProper g] [IsProper (f ≫ g)] :
    totalPushOn ops (f ≫ g) = totalPushOn ops g ∘ₗ totalPushOn ops f
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a y =>
    induction y using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H D =>
      have h1 : a ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X n) =
          a • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X n)) := by
        rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      rw [h1]
      simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.comp_apply]
      congr 1
      simp only [totalPushOn, DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply,
        push_eq_pushD9On]
      rw [D9.pushD9_comp_mk]
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K3.pull_eq_pullD2On
statement:
theorem pull_eq_pullD2On (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat f] (d : ℕ)
    (hd : PureRelDim f d) (n : ℕ) : ops.pull f d hd n = D2.pullD2 (k := k) f d hd n
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a y =>
    induction y using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H D =>
      have h1 : a ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow Y n) =
          a • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow Y n)) := by
        rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      rw [h1, map_smul, map_smul]
      congr 1
      rw [D2.pullD2_mk (k := k)]
      exact ops.pull_mk f d hd n D _ (fun x ↦ rfl)
  | add x y hx hy => simp [map_add, hx, hy]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K3.totalPullOn_comp
statement:
theorem totalPullOn_comp (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) [f.IsOver (Spk k)]
    [g.IsOver (Spk k)] [(f ≫ g).IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat f] [Flat g] [Flat (f ≫ g)] (df dg : ℕ)
    (hf : PureRelDim f df) (hg : PureRelDim g dg) (hfg : PureRelDim (f ≫ g) (dg + df)) :
    totalPullOn ops (f ≫ g) (dg + df) hfg =
      totalPullOn ops f df hf ∘ₗ totalPullOn ops g dg hg
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a y =>
    induction y using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H D =>
      have h1 : a ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow Z n) =
          a • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow Z n)) := by
        rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      rw [h1]
      simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.comp_apply]
      congr 1
      simp only [totalPullOn, DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply,
        pull_eq_pullD2On, D2.pullD2_mk (k := k)]
      exact D2.lof_heq (Nat.add_assoc n dg df).symm _ _
        (D2.heq_mk_of_eq (Nat.add_assoc n dg df).symm _ _ (flatPullback_comp f g D.1))
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K3.totalBaseChangeOn
statement:
theorem totalBaseChangeOn (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (f' : X' ⟶ Y')
    (g' : X' ⟶ X) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [g.IsOver (Spk k)] [f'.IsOver (Spk k)]
    [g'.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsProper f] [IsProper f'] [Flat g] [Flat g'] (d : ℕ)
    (hg : PureRelDim g d) (hg' : PureRelDim g' d) (hsq : IsPullback g' f' f g) :
    totalPullOn ops g d hg ∘ₗ totalPushOn ops f =
      totalPushOn ops f' ∘ₗ totalPullOn ops g' d hg'
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a y =>
    induction y using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H D =>
      have h1 : a ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X n) =
          a • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X n)) := by
        rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      rw [h1]
      simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.comp_apply]
      congr 1
      simp only [totalPushOn, totalPullOn, DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply,
        push_eq_pushD9On, pull_eq_pullD2On, D9.pushD9_mk0, D2.pullD2_mk (k := k)]
      have key : ∀ (E E' : dimensionCycles Y' (n + d)), E.1 = E'.1 →
          DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow Y' n) (n + d)
            ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk E : DimChow Y' (n + d))) =
          DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow Y' n) (n + d)
            ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk E' : DimChow Y' (n + d))) := by
        intro E E' h
        rw [Subtype.ext h]
      exact key _ _ (flatPullback_properPushforward f g f' g' hsq D.1)
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K3.cap_prime_anchorOn
statement:
theorem cap_prime_anchorOn (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (n : ℕ) (v : X)
    (hv : height v = n + 1) :
    ops.cap L hL n ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv) : DimChow X (n + 1))) =
      (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (D5.primeCap (k := k) L hL n v hv)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b⟩ := Scheme.Modules.exists_lineBundleLocalDataAt (pointClosureScheme v)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj L)
    (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL v)
    (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one L hL v) (pointClosureGenericPoint v)
  rw [ops.cap_mk L hL n v hv (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one L hL v) b
      (D5.primeCycleOfFrame (k := k) L hL n v hv b) rfl,
    D5.primeCap_eq (k := k) L hL n v hv b]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K3.cap_anchorOn
statement:
theorem cap_anchorOn (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (n : ℕ)
    (D : dimensionCycles X (n + 1)) :
    ops.cap L hL n ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X (n + 1))) =
      (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (D5.capCycles (k := k) L hL n D)
proof:
:= by
  let φ1 : dimensionCycles X (n + 1) →+ RationalDimChow X n :=
    (ops.cap L hL n).toAddMonoidHom.comp ((D13.tmul1 X (n + 1)).comp (D13.mkHom X (n + 1)))
  let φ2 : dimensionCycles X (n + 1) →+ RationalDimChow X n :=
    (D13.tmul1 X n).comp (D5.capCycles (k := k) L hL n)
  have key : D ∈ AddMonoidHom.eqLocus φ1 φ2 := by
    refine D13.dimCycle_mem_of_prime _ (fun v hv ↦ ?_) D
    change φ1 _ = φ2 _
    change ops.cap L hL n ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv) : DimChow X (n + 1))) =
      (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (D5.capCycles (k := k) L hL n (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv))
    rw [D5.capCycles_dimPrimeCycle (k := k) L hL n v hv]
    exact cap_prime_anchorOn ops L hL n v hv
  exact key

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K3.cap_iso_componentOn
statement:
theorem cap_iso_componentOn {L L' : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hL' : HasConstantRank X L' 1) (e : L ≅ L') (n : ℕ) :
    ops.cap L hL n = ops.cap L' hL' n
proof:
:= by
  apply D13.ratLinear_ext
  intro D
  rw [cap_anchorOn ops L hL n D, cap_anchorOn ops L' hL' n D,
    D13.capCycles_iso (k := k) hL hL' e n D]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K3.cap_isoOn
statement:
theorem cap_isoOn {L L' : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hL' : HasConstantRank X L' 1) (h : Nonempty (L ≅ L')) :
    totalCapOn ops L hL = totalCapOn ops L' hL'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := h
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  cases n with
  | zero => apply LinearMap.ext; intro c; simp [totalCapOn, capComponentOn]
  | succ m =>
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro c
    simp only [totalCapOn, LinearMap.comp_apply, DirectSum.toModule_lof, capComponentOn,
      cap_iso_componentOn ops hL hL' e m]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K3.totalCapOn_lof_zero_of_eq
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  simp [totalCapOn, capComponentOn]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K3.totalCapOn_lof_succ_of_eq
statement:
theorem totalCapOn_lof_succ_of_eq (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) {i m : ℕ}
    (h : i = m + 1) (z : RationalDimChow X i)
    (z' : RationalDimChow X (m + 1)) (hz : HEq z z') :
    totalCapOn ops L hL (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) i z) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) m (ops.cap L hL m z')
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  cases hz
  simp [totalCapOn, capComponentOn]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K3.cap_pull_of_gateOn
statement:
theorem cap_pull_of_gateOn (G : D13.CapPullGate (k := k) f hd L hL) :
    totalPullOn ops f d hd ∘ₗ totalCapOn ops L hL =
      totalCapOn ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) ∘ₗ totalPullOn ops f d hd
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro i
  apply D13.ratLinear_ext
  intro D
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  cases i with
  | zero =>
    have h1 : totalCapOn ops L hL (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow Y n) 0
        ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow Y 0))) = 0 :=
      totalCapOn_lof_zero_of_eq ops L hL rfl _
    rw [h1, map_zero]
    have h2 : totalPullOn ops f d hd (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow Y n) 0
        ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow Y 0))) =
        DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) (0 + d)
          ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk
            (⟨flatPullback f D.1, flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles f hd D.2⟩ :
              dimensionCycles X (0 + d)) : DimChow X (0 + d))) := by
      simp only [totalPullOn, DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply,
        pull_eq_pullD2On, D2.pullD2_mk (k := k)]
    rw [h2]
    rcases d with _ | e
    · exact (totalCapOn_lof_zero_of_eq ops _ (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL)
        (by omega) _).symm
    · rw [totalCapOn_lof_succ_of_eq ops _ (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL)
        (i := 0 + (e + 1)) (m := e) (by omega) _
        ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (D13.pc0Hom f hd rfl D) : DimChow X (e + 1)))
        (D2.heq_mk_of_eq (by omega) _ (D13.pc0Hom f hd rfl D) rfl),
        cap_anchorOn ops _ (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) e (D13.pc0Hom f hd rfl D),
        D13.pull_cap_cycles_zero (k := k) f hd L hL G rfl D]
      simp
  | succ n =>
    have h1 : totalCapOn ops L hL (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow Y n) (n + 1)
        ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow Y (n + 1)))) =
        DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow Y n) n
          ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (D5.capCycles (k := k) L hL n D)) := by
      rw [totalCapOn_lof_succ_of_eq ops L hL (m := n) rfl _ _ HEq.rfl,
        cap_anchorOn ops L hL n D]
    have h2 : totalPullOn ops f d hd (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow Y n) (n + 1)
        ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow Y (n + 1)))) =
        DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) (n + 1 + d)
          ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk
            (⟨flatPullback f D.1, flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles f hd D.2⟩ :
              dimensionCycles X (n + 1 + d)) : DimChow X (n + 1 + d))) := by
      simp only [totalPullOn, DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply,
        pull_eq_pullD2On, D2.pullD2_mk (k := k)]
    rw [h1, h2]
    rw [totalCapOn_lof_succ_of_eq ops _ (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL)
      (i := n + 1 + d) (m := n + d) (by omega) _
      ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (D13.pcHom f hd n D) : DimChow X (n + d + 1)))
      (D2.heq_mk_of_eq (by omega) _ (D13.pcHom f hd n D) rfl),
      cap_anchorOn ops _ (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) (n + d) (D13.pcHom f hd n D)]
    simp only [totalPullOn, DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply, pull_eq_pullD2On,
      D13.pullD2_one_tmul (k := k), D13.pull_cap_cycles_succ (k := k) f hd L hL G n D]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K3.cap_pullOn
statement:
theorem cap_pullOn :
    totalPullOn ops f d hd ∘ₗ totalCapOn ops L hL =
      totalCapOn ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) ∘ₗ totalPullOn ops f d hd
proof:
:=
  cap_pull_of_gateOn ops f hd L hL (D15.capPullGate_of_flat (k := k) f hd L hL)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K3.cap_push_of_gateOn
statement:
theorem cap_push_of_gateOn (G : D13.CapPushGate (k := k) f L hL) :
    totalPushOn ops f ∘ₗ
        totalCapOn ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
          (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) =
      totalCapOn ops L hL ∘ₗ totalPushOn ops f
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro i
  apply D13.ratLinear_ext
  intro D
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  have hpush : ∀ (m : ℕ) (c : RationalDimChow X m),
      totalPushOn ops f (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) m c) =
        DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow Y n) m (D9.pushD9 (k := k) f m c) := by
    intro m c
    simp only [totalPushOn, DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply, push_eq_pushD9On]
  cases i with
  | zero =>
    rw [totalCapOn_lof_zero_of_eq ops _ (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) rfl, map_zero,
      hpush, totalCapOn_lof_zero_of_eq ops L hL rfl]
  | succ n =>
    rw [totalCapOn_lof_succ_of_eq ops _ (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) (m := n) rfl _ _
      HEq.rfl, cap_anchorOn ops _ (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) n D,
      hpush, hpush, D9.pushD9_mk0,
      totalCapOn_lof_succ_of_eq ops L hL (m := n) rfl _ _ HEq.rfl]
    erw [cap_anchorOn ops L hL n (D13.pfHom (k := k) f (n + 1) D)]
    rw [D13.pushD9_one_tmul (k := k), D13.push_cap_cycles (k := k) f L hL G n D]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K3.cap_pushOn
statement:
theorem cap_pushOn :
    totalPushOn ops f ∘ₗ
        totalCapOn ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
          (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) =
      totalCapOn ops L hL ∘ₗ totalPushOn ops f
proof:
:=
  cap_push_of_gateOn ops f L hL (D16.capPushGate (k := k) f L hL)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K3.capCommuteOn_of_gate
statement: theorem capCommuteOn_of_gate (G : CapCommGateOn ops L M hL hM) : CapCommuteOn ops L M hL hM
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  cases n with
  | zero => apply LinearMap.ext; intro c; simp [totalCapOn, capComponentOn]
  | succ n =>
    cases n with
    | zero => apply LinearMap.ext; intro c; simp [totalCapOn, capComponentOn]
    | succ m =>
      have key : (ops.cap L hL m).comp (ops.cap M hM (m + 1)) =
          (ops.cap M hM m).comp (ops.cap L hL (m + 1)) :=
        e4_linearMap_ext_of_prime (m + 2) _ _ (fun v hv ↦ G m v hv)
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro c
      have := LinearMap.congr_fun key c
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at this
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, totalCapOn, DirectSum.toModule_lof, capComponentOn, this]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K3.capCommGateOn_of_commute
statement:
theorem capCommGateOn_of_commute (h : CapCommuteOn ops L M hL hM) :
    CapCommGateOn ops L M hL hM
proof:
:= by
  intro m v hv
  have := LinearMap.congr_fun h (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) (m + 2)
    ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v (m + 2) hv) : DimChow X (m + 2))))
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, totalCapOn, DirectSum.toModule_lof, capComponentOn] at this
  simp only [DirectSum.lof_eq_of] at this
  exact DirectSum.of_injective (β := fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) m this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K3.capCommuteOn_of_sub
statement:
theorem capCommuteOn_of_sub {A B C D : X.Modules} {hA : HasConstantRank X A 1}
    {hB : HasConstantRank X B 1} {hC : HasConstantRank X C 1} {hD : HasConstantRank X D 1}
    (hLe : totalCapOn ops L hL = totalCapOn ops A hA - totalCapOn ops B hB)
    (hMe : totalCapOn ops M hM = totalCapOn ops C hC - totalCapOn ops D hD)
    (hAC : CapCommuteOn ops A C hA hC) (hAD : CapCommuteOn ops A D hA hD)
    (hBC : CapCommuteOn ops B C hB hC) (hBD : CapCommuteOn ops B D hB hD) :
    CapCommuteOn ops L M hL hM
proof:
:= by
  unfold CapCommuteOn at *
  rw [hLe, hMe, LinearMap.sub_comp, LinearMap.comp_sub, LinearMap.comp_sub,
    LinearMap.sub_comp, LinearMap.comp_sub, LinearMap.comp_sub, hAC, hAD, hBC, hBD]
  abel

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K3.cap_tensor_componentOn
statement:
theorem cap_tensor_componentOn (L M : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1) (hLM : HasConstantRank X (tensorSheaf X L M) 1) (m : ℕ) :
    ops.cap (tensorSheaf X L M) hLM m = ops.cap L hL m + ops.cap M hM m
proof:
:= by
  apply e4_linearMap_ext_of_prime
  intro v hv
  let P := pointClosureι v
  have hfL := isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL v
  have hfM := isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure M hM v
  have hfLM := isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure (tensorSheaf X L M) hLM v
  have hrL := genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one L hL v
  have hrM := genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one M hM v
  have hrLM := genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one (tensorSheaf X L M) hLM v
  obtain ⟨b⟩ := Scheme.Modules.exists_lineBundleLocalDataAt (pointClosureScheme v)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P).obj L) hfL hrL (pointClosureGenericPoint v)
  obtain ⟨c⟩ := Scheme.Modules.exists_lineBundleLocalDataAt (pointClosureScheme v)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P).obj M) hfM hrM (pointClosureGenericPoint v)
  haveI : IsIso (pullbackTensorSheafHom P L M) :=
    pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_isFiniteLocallyFree P L M hL.isFiniteLocallyFree
      hM.isFiniteLocallyFree
  let e := asIso (pullbackTensorSheafHom P L M)
  have hT : IsFiniteLocallyFree (pointClosureScheme v)
      (tensorSheaf (pointClosureScheme v) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P).obj L)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P).obj M)) :=
    isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso _ e hfLM
  have hrT : SingularCurve.genericRank (pointClosureScheme v)
      (tensorSheaf (pointClosureScheme v) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P).obj L)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P).obj M)) = 1 :=
    (SingularCurve.genericRank_iso (pointClosureScheme v) e).symm.trans hrLM
  let bLM := (b.tensor c).mapIso e.symm
  have hdiv : Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hfLM hrLM bLM =
      Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hfL hrL b +
        Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hfM hrM c := by
    rw [e4_weilDivisor_mapIso hT hfLM hrT hrLM (b.tensor c) e.symm,
      Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame_tensor hfL hfM hT hrL hrM hrT b c]
  have hmL := m7s_pushWeil_mem (k := k) L hL m v hv b
  have hmM := m7s_pushWeil_mem (k := k) M hM m v hv c
  have hmLM := m7s_pushWeil_mem (k := k) (tensorSheaf X L M) hLM m v hv bLM
  have hsum : properPushforward P
      (Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hfLM hrLM bLM).1 =
      properPushforward P (Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hfL hrL b).1 +
        properPushforward P (Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hfM hrM c).1 := by
    rw [hdiv, ← properPushforward_add]
    rfl
  rw [LinearMap.add_apply,
    ops.cap_mk (tensorSheaf X L M) hLM m v hv hrLM bLM ⟨_, hmLM⟩ rfl,
    ops.cap_mk L hL m v hv hrL b ⟨_, hmL⟩ rfl,
    ops.cap_mk M hM m v hv hrM c ⟨_, hmM⟩ rfl,
    ← TensorProduct.tmul_add, ← QuotientAddGroup.mk_add]
  congr 2
  exact Subtype.ext hsum

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K3.totalCapOn_tensor
statement:
theorem totalCapOn_tensor (L M : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1) (hLM : HasConstantRank X (tensorSheaf X L M) 1) :
    totalCapOn ops (tensorSheaf X L M) hLM = totalCapOn ops L hL + totalCapOn ops M hM
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro c
  simp only [totalCapOn, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, DirectSum.toModule_lof]
  cases n with
  | zero => simp [capComponentOn]
  | succ m =>
    simp only [capComponentOn, LinearMap.comp_apply, cap_tensor_componentOn L M hL hM hLM m,
      LinearMap.add_apply, map_add]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K3.ChowCompatOn.ofGates'
statement:
theorem ChowCompatOn.ofGates' {P : SchemeClass k} (ops : ChowOpsOn P)
    (hcomm : AllCapCommGateOn ops) : ChowCompatOn ops where
  push_comp
proof:
:= by intros; exact totalPushOn_comp ops _ _
  pull_comp := by intros; exact totalPullOn_comp ops _ _ _ _ _ _ _
  base_change := by intros; exact totalBaseChangeOn ops _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ‹_›
  cap_pull := by intros; exact cap_pullOn ops _ _ _ _
  cap_push := by intros; exact cap_pushOn ops _ _ _
  cap_comm := by
    intro X _ _ _ _ L M hL hM
    exact capCommuteOn_of_gate (hcomm L M hL hM)
  cap_iso := by intros; exact cap_isoOn ops _ _ ‹_›
  projBundle_relDim := by
    intro X _ _ _ E C e hC
    exact D11.projBundle_relDim (k := k) C hC

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K3.capDescendsOn_of_ample
statement:
theorem capDescendsOn_of_ample [Infinite k] {P : SchemeClass k} (hP : IsAmpleIntegral P) :
    CapDescendsOn P
proof:
:= by
  intro X _ _ _ hX L hL n
  obtain ⟨hI, hA⟩ := hP hX.out
  haveI := hI
  exact D19.capDescends_of_hasAmpleGenerators (k := k) L hL (hA L hL) n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K3.capComm_prime_of_repOn
statement:
theorem capComm_prime_of_repOn {L M : X.Modules} {hL : HasConstantRank X L 1}
    {hM : HasConstantRank X M 1} (m : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = m + 2)
    (a b : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (d : D20.GateData' k L M hL hM m v a b) :
    ops.cap L hL m (ops.cap M hM (m + 1) ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v (m + 2) hv) : DimChow X (m + 2)))) =
      ops.cap M hM m (ops.cap L hL (m + 1) ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v (m + 2) hv) : DimChow X (m + 2))))
proof:
:= by
  have cc : ∀ (L M : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1)
      (a b : C1Cap.LocalEquations X)
      (hMv : D20.Rep (k := k) M hM (m + 1) v b)
      (hLw : ∀ w : X, height w = m + 1 → C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff b v w ≠ 0 →
        D20.Rep (k := k) L hL m w a),
      ∃ C : dimensionCycles X m,
        ops.cap L hL m (ops.cap M hM (m + 1) ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
          (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v (m + 2) hv) : DimChow X (m + 2)))) =
          (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk C : DimChow X m) ∧
        ∀ y, C.1 y = ∑ᶠ w : X, C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff b v w * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a w y := by
    intro L M hL hM a b hMv hLw
    obtain ⟨R, hR1, hR2⟩ := hMv
    have hv' : height v = ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) + 1 := hv
    have hpc : D5.primeCap (k := k) M hM (m + 1) v hv' =
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk R : DimChow X (m + 1)) := by
      rw [← hR1]
      simp only [D5.primeCapOrZero]
      rw [dif_pos hv']
    have h1 : ops.cap M hM (m + 1) ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v (m + 2) hv) : DimChow X (m + 2))) =
        (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk R : DimChow X (m + 1)) := by
      refine (cap_prime_anchorOn ops M hM (m + 1) v hv').trans ?_
      rw [hpc]
    obtain ⟨C, hC1, hC2⟩ := D20.capCycles_eq_mk' (k := k) L hL m R a (fun w hw hne ↦
      hLw w hw (by rwa [← hR2 w]))
    refine ⟨C, ?_, fun y ↦ ?_⟩
    · rw [h1, cap_anchorOn ops L hL m R, hC1]
    · rw [hC2 y]
      unfold C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff
      simp only [hR2]
  obtain ⟨C₁, h₁, c₁⟩ := cc L M hL hM a b d.repM_v d.repL_w
  obtain ⟨C₂, h₂, c₂⟩ := cc M L hM hL b a d.repL_v d.repM_w
  rw [h₁, h₂]
  congr 2
  ext y
  rw [c₁ y, c₂ y]
  exact D18.coeff_symm_X (k := k) m v hv a b d.meets y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K3.capCommGateOn_of_generated
statement:
theorem capCommGateOn_of_generated [Infinite k] (L M : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1)
    (hgL : ∀ p : X, ∃ s : Γ(L, ⊤), ∃ d : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData X L p,
      IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ d.U p d.mem (D10.sectionCoordSec d s)))
    (hgM : ∀ p : X, ∃ s : Γ(M, ⊤), ∃ d : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData X M p,
      IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ d.U p d.mem (D10.sectionCoordSec d s))) :
    CapCommGateOn ops L M hL hM
proof:
:= by
  intro m v hv
  obtain ⟨a, b, d⟩ := D20.gateData_of_generated (k := k) L M hL hM hgL hgM m v hv
  exact capComm_prime_of_repOn ops m v hv a b d

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K3.capCommuteOn_of_hasAmpleGenerators
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hBg, hAg⟩ := hLa
  obtain ⟨B', hB', hB'g, hCg⟩ := hMa
  have hA : HasConstantRank X (tensorSheaf X L B) 1 := by
    have h := hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hL hB
    rwa [Nat.one_mul] at h
  have hC : HasConstantRank X (tensorSheaf X M B') 1 := by
    have h := hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hM hB'
    rwa [Nat.one_mul] at h
  have hLe : totalCapOn ops L hL =
      totalCapOn ops (tensorSheaf X L B) hA - totalCapOn ops B hB := by
    rw [totalCapOn_tensor (ops := ops) L B hL hB hA]; abel
  have hMe : totalCapOn ops M hM =
      totalCapOn ops (tensorSheaf X M B') hC - totalCapOn ops B' hB' := by
    rw [totalCapOn_tensor (ops := ops) M B' hM hB' hC]; abel
  have g := fun {A C : X.Modules} (hA : HasConstantRank X A 1) (hC : HasConstantRank X C 1)
      (gA : D19.IsPointwiseGenerated A) (gC : D19.IsPointwiseGenerated C) ↦
    capCommuteOn_of_gate (ops := ops) (capCommGateOn_of_generated ops A C hA hC gA gC)
  exact capCommuteOn_of_sub hLe hMe (g hA hC hAg hCg) (g hA hB' hAg hB'g)
    (g hB hC hBg hCg) (g hB hB' hBg hB'g)

  obtain ⟨hI, hA⟩ := hP hX.out

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso_hom_app_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem unitMulSheafIso_hom_app_apply {X : Scheme.{u}} (a : Γ(X, ⊤)ˣ)
    (U : X.Opens) (x : Γ(X, U)) :
