name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.restrictedCoordinateOverlapRestriction_isIso
statement:
theorem restrictedCoordinateOverlapRestriction_isIso
    (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen k n i).ι).map
      (pushedUnitRestriction
        ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_right)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.isIso_iff_isIso_app]
  intro W
  rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
  let X := ProjectiveTwistSpace k n
  let A := coordinateOpen k n i
  let U := coordinateOpen k n j
  let V := coordinateOverlapOpen k n i j
  let hVU : V ≤ U :=
    (coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_right
  let β := (homOfLE (pushedUnitRestrictionOpen hVU (A.ι ''ᵁ W))).op
  have hEq : U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (A.ι ''ᵁ W)) =
      V.ι ''ᵁ (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (A.ι ''ᵁ W)) := by
    dsimp only [V, U, A]
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf,
      Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf,
      Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι,
      coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
    have hW : (coordinateOpen k n i).ι ''ᵁ W ≤ coordinateOpen k n i := by
      simpa only [Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι] using
        (coordinateOpen k n i).ι.image_le_opensRange W
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact le_inf (le_inf (inf_le_right.trans hW) inf_le_left) inf_le_right
    · exact le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right) inf_le_right
  haveI : IsIso β := by
    let e : op (U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (A.ι ''ᵁ W))) ≅
        op (V.ι ''ᵁ (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (A.ι ''ᵁ W))) :=
      eqToIso (congrArg op hEq)
    have hβ : β = e.hom := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [hβ]
    infer_instance
  change Function.Bijective (X.presheaf.map β)
  exact ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (X.presheaf.map β)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateDescentLeft_π
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateDescentLeft_π (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateDescentLeft k n ≫
        Pi.π (fun ij : Fin (n + 1) × Fin (n + 1) ↦
          pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n)
            (coordinateOverlapOpen k n ij.1 ij.2)) (i, j) =
      Pi.π (fun a : Fin (n + 1) ↦
          pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n a)) i ≫
        pushedUnitRestriction
          ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_left)
proof:

  simp only [coordinateDescentLeft, Pi.lift_π]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateDescentRight_π
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateDescentRight_π (d : ℤ) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :

      Pi.π (fun a : Fin (n + 1) ↦
          pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n a)) j ≫
        pushedUnitRestriction
          ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_right) ≫

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapRatio_self

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localFrameTransition_cocycle
statement:
theorem localFrameTransition_cocycle (d : ℤ) (i a b : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Units.map (coordinateOverlapToTripleIJ k n i a b).toMonoidHom
        (twistTransitionUnit k n (-d) i a) =
      Units.map (coordinateOverlapToTripleJL k n i a b).toMonoidHom
          (twistTransitionUnit k n d a b) *
        Units.map (coordinateOverlapToTripleIL k n i a b).toMonoidHom
          (twistTransitionUnit k n (-d) i b)
proof:
:= by
  let A := Units.map (coordinateOverlapToTripleIJ k n i a b).toMonoidHom
    (twistTransitionUnit k n d i a)
  let B := Units.map (coordinateOverlapToTripleJL k n i a b).toMonoidHom
    (twistTransitionUnit k n d a b)
  let C := Units.map (coordinateOverlapToTripleIL k n i a b).toMonoidHom
    (twistTransitionUnit k n d i b)
  have h : A * B = C := twistTransitionUnit_cocycle k n d i a b
  simp only [twistTransitionUnit_neg]
  change A⁻¹ = B * C⁻¹
  rw [← h]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateTripleOpen_eq_inf
statement:
theorem coordinateTripleOpen_eq_inf (i a b : Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateTripleOpen k n i a b =
      (coordinateOpen k n i ⊓ coordinateOpen k n a) ⊓ coordinateOpen k n b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
  change Proj.basicOpen (grading k n)
      ((coordinate k n i * coordinate k n a) * coordinate k n b) =
    Proj.basicOpen (grading k n) (coordinate k n i * coordinate k n a) ⊓
      Proj.basicOpen (grading k n) (coordinate k n b)
  exact Proj.basicOpen_mul (grading k n)
    (coordinate k n i * coordinate k n a) (coordinate k n b)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateTripleOpen_le_overlapIJ
statement:

    coordinateTripleOpen k n i a b ≤ coordinateOverlapOpen k n i a
proof:
:= by

    (coordinateOverlapEquation k n i a) (coordinateTripleEquation k n i a b)
    ⟨coordinate k n b, by
      simp only [coordinateTripleEquation, coordinateOverlapEquation]⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localFrameTransitionSectionIJ_eq
statement:
theorem localFrameTransitionSectionIJ_eq (d : ℤ) (i a b : Fin (n + 1)) :
    localFrameTransitionSectionIJ k n d i a b =
      Units.map (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (grading k n)
        (coordinateTripleEquation k n i a b)
        (coordinateTripleEquation_mem_degree_three k n i a b) (by omega)).hom.hom.toMonoidHom
        (Units.map (coordinateOverlapToTripleIJ k n i a b).toMonoidHom
          (twistTransitionUnit k n d i a))
proof:
:= by
  apply Units.ext
  change ((Proj (grading k n)).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (coordinateTripleOpen_le_overlapIJ k n i a b)).op)
        ((Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (grading k n)
          (coordinateOverlapEquation k n i a)
          (coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two k n i a) (by omega)).hom
            (twistTransitionUnit k n d i a : CoordinateOverlapRing k n i a)) = _
  change (Proj.awayToSection (grading k n) (coordinateOverlapEquation k n i a) ≫
      (Proj (grading k n)).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (coordinateTripleOpen_le_overlapIJ k n i a b)).op)
      (twistTransitionUnit k n d i a : CoordinateOverlapRing k n i a) =
    Proj.awayToSection (grading k n) (coordinateTripleEquation k n i a b)
      ((CommRingCat.ofHom (coordinateOverlapToTripleIJ k n i a b))
        (twistTransitionUnit k n d i a : CoordinateOverlapRing k n i a))
  simpa only [coordinateTripleOpen, coordinateOverlapToTripleIJ,
      ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] using
    (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (Proj.awayMap_awayToSection (grading k n)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n b) (by
          simp only [coordinateTripleEquation, coordinateOverlapEquation]))
      (twistTransitionUnit k n d i a : CoordinateOverlapRing k n i a)).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localFrameTransitionSectionJL_eq
statement:
theorem localFrameTransitionSectionJL_eq (d : ℤ) (i a b : Fin (n + 1)) :
    localFrameTransitionSectionJL k n d i a b =
      Units.map (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (grading k n)
        (coordinateTripleEquation k n i a b)
        (coordinateTripleEquation_mem_degree_three k n i a b) (by omega)).hom.hom.toMonoidHom
        (Units.map (coordinateOverlapToTripleJL k n i a b).toMonoidHom
          (twistTransitionUnit k n d a b))
proof:
:= by
  apply Units.ext
  change (Proj.awayToSection (grading k n) (coordinateOverlapEquation k n a b) ≫
      (Proj (grading k n)).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (coordinateTripleOpen_le_overlapJL k n i a b)).op)
      (twistTransitionUnit k n d a b : CoordinateOverlapRing k n a b) =
    Proj.awayToSection (grading k n) (coordinateTripleEquation k n i a b)
      ((CommRingCat.ofHom (coordinateOverlapToTripleJL k n i a b))
        (twistTransitionUnit k n d a b : CoordinateOverlapRing k n a b))
  simpa only [coordinateTripleOpen, coordinateOverlapToTripleJL,
      ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] using
    (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (Proj.awayMap_awayToSection (grading k n)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) (by
          simp only [coordinateTripleEquation, coordinateOverlapEquation]
          ring))
      (twistTransitionUnit k n d a b : CoordinateOverlapRing k n a b)).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localFrameTransitionSectionIL_eq
statement:
theorem localFrameTransitionSectionIL_eq (d : ℤ) (i a b : Fin (n + 1)) :
    localFrameTransitionSectionIL k n d i a b =
      Units.map (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (grading k n)
        (coordinateTripleEquation k n i a b)
        (coordinateTripleEquation_mem_degree_three k n i a b) (by omega)).hom.hom.toMonoidHom
        (Units.map (coordinateOverlapToTripleIL k n i a b).toMonoidHom

proof:
:= by
  apply Units.ext
  change (Proj.awayToSection (grading k n) (coordinateOverlapEquation k n i b) ≫
      (Proj (grading k n)).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (coordinateTripleOpen_le_overlapIL k n i a b)).op)
      (twistTransitionUnit k n d i b : CoordinateOverlapRing k n i b) =
    Proj.awayToSection (grading k n) (coordinateTripleEquation k n i a b)
      ((CommRingCat.ofHom (coordinateOverlapToTripleIL k n i a b))
        (twistTransitionUnit k n d i b : CoordinateOverlapRing k n i b))
  simpa only [coordinateTripleOpen, coordinateOverlapToTripleIL,
      ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] using
    (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (Proj.awayMap_awayToSection (grading k n)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n a) (by
          simp only [coordinateTripleEquation, coordinateOverlapEquation]
          ring))
      (twistTransitionUnit k n d i b : CoordinateOverlapRing k n i b)).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localFrameTransitionSection_cocycle
statement:
theorem localFrameTransitionSection_cocycle (d : ℤ) (i a b : Fin (n + 1)) :
    localFrameTransitionSectionIJ k n (-d) i a b =
      localFrameTransitionSectionJL k n d i a b *
        localFrameTransitionSectionIL k n (-d) i a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [localFrameTransitionSectionIJ_eq, localFrameTransitionSectionJL_eq,
    localFrameTransitionSectionIL_eq]
  let F := (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (grading k n)
    (coordinateTripleEquation k n i a b)
    (coordinateTripleEquation_mem_degree_three k n i a b) (by omega)).hom.hom.toMonoidHom
  have h := congrArg (Units.map F) (localFrameTransition_cocycle k n d i a b)
  simpa only [map_mul] using h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localFrameTuple_component
statement:
@[simp]
theorem localFrameTuple_component (d : ℤ) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (Pi.π (fun a : Fin (n + 1) ↦
      pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n a)) j).app
        (coordinateOpen k n i) (localFrameTuple k n d i) =
      localFrameComponent k n d i j
proof:
:= by
  change ((SheafOfModules.evaluation
      (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n).ringCatSheaf (op (coordinateOpen k n i))).map
    (Pi.π (fun a : Fin (n + 1) ↦
      pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n a)) j))
        (localFrameTuple k n d i) = _
  let E := SheafOfModules.evaluation
    (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n).ringCatSheaf (op (coordinateOpen k n i))
  let f := fun a : Fin (n + 1) ↦
    pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n a)
  have hIso : (PreservesProduct.iso E f).inv = inv (piComparison E f) := by
    apply (cancel_mono (PreservesProduct.iso E f).hom).1
    rw [Iso.inv_hom_id, PreservesProduct.iso_hom, IsIso.inv_hom_id]
  have h₁ : (PreservesProduct.iso E f).inv ≫ E.map (Pi.π f j) =
      Pi.π (fun a ↦ E.obj (f a)) j := by
    rw [hIso]
    exact inv_piComparison_comp_map_π E f j
  have hc : ((PreservesProduct.iso E f ≪≫
        ModuleCat.piIsoPi (fun a ↦ E.obj (f a))).inv ≫ E.map (Pi.π f j)) =
      (ModuleCat.piIsoPi (fun a ↦ E.obj (f a))).inv ≫
        Pi.π (fun a ↦ E.obj (f a)) j := by
    simp only [Iso.trans_inv, Category.assoc, h₁]
  change (E.map (Pi.π f j))
      ((PreservesProduct.iso E f ≪≫
        ModuleCat.piIsoPi (fun a ↦ E.obj (f a))).inv
          (fun a ↦ localFrameComponent k n d i a)) = _
  calc
    _ = (Pi.π (fun a ↦ E.obj (f a)) j)
          ((ModuleCat.piIsoPi (fun a ↦ E.obj (f a))).inv
            (fun a ↦ localFrameComponent k n d i a)) := by
      simpa only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] using
        ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hc
          (fun a ↦ localFrameComponent k n d i a)
    _ = _ := ModuleCat.piIsoPi_inv_kernel_ι_apply
      (fun a ↦ E.obj (f a)) j _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localFrameTuple_compatibility
statement:
theorem localFrameTuple_compatibility (d : ℤ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (coordinateDescentLeft k n).app (coordinateOpen k n i)
        (localFrameTuple k n d i) =
      (coordinateDescentRight k n d).app (coordinateOpen k n i)
        (localFrameTuple k n d i)
proof:
:= by
  let X := ProjectiveTwistSpace k n
  let U := coordinateOpen k n i
  let E := SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op U)
  let f := fun ij : Fin (n + 1) × Fin (n + 1) ↦
    pushedUnit X (coordinateOverlapOpen k n ij.1 ij.2)
  let e : E.obj (coordinateOverlapCochains k n) ≅
      ModuleCat.of Γ(X, U) (∀ ij, ↑(E.obj (f ij))) :=
    PreservesProduct.iso E f ≪≫ ModuleCat.piIsoPi _
  let x : ↑(E.obj (coordinateOverlapCochains k n)) :=
    E.map (coordinateDescentLeft k n) (localFrameTuple k n d i)
  let y : ↑(E.obj (coordinateOverlapCochains k n)) :=
    E.map (coordinateDescentRight k n d) (localFrameTuple k n d i)
  change x = y
  suffices h : e.hom x = e.hom y by
    calc
      x = e.inv (e.hom x) := by simp
      _ = e.inv (e.hom y) := congrArg e.inv h
      _ = y := by simp
  funext ij
  let p := ModuleCat.ofHom
    (LinearMap.proj ij : (∀ ij, ↑(E.obj (f ij))) →ₗ[Γ(X, U)] ↑(E.obj (f ij)))
  have hc : e.hom ≫ p = E.map (Pi.π f ij) := by
    dsimp [e, p]
    simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc,
      ModuleCat.piIsoPi_hom_ker_subtype, PreservesProduct.iso_hom,
      piComparison_comp_π]
  change p (e.hom x) = p (e.hom y)
  change (e.hom ≫ p) x = (e.hom ≫ p) y
  rw [hc]
  change ((coordinateDescentLeft k n ≫ Pi.π f ij).app U)
      (localFrameTuple k n d i) =
    ((coordinateDescentRight k n d ≫ Pi.π f ij).app U)
      (localFrameTuple k n d i)
  dsimp only [f]
  simp only [coordinateDescentLeft, coordinateDescentRight,
    Pi.lift_π]
  change (pushedUnitRestriction
        ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n ij.1 ij.2).le.trans inf_le_left)).app U
      ((Pi.π (fun a : Fin (n + 1) ↦
        pushedUnit X (coordinateOpen k n a)) ij.1).app U
          (localFrameTuple k n d i)) =
    (pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition k n d ij.1 ij.2).app U
      ((pushedUnitRestriction
        ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n ij.1 ij.2).le.trans inf_le_right)).app U
        ((Pi.π (fun a : Fin (n + 1) ↦
          pushedUnit X (coordinateOpen k n a)) ij.2).app U
            (localFrameTuple k n d i)))
  rw [localFrameTuple_component, localFrameTuple_component]
  let W := coordinateOverlapOpen k n ij.1 ij.2
  let P := W.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U
  let eW := W.ι.appIso P
  have q : W.ι ''ᵁ P = coordinateTripleOpen k n i ij.1 ij.2 := by
    dsimp only [W, P, U]
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι,
      coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf, coordinateTripleOpen_eq_inf]
    ac_rfl
  let qIso := X.presheaf.mapIso (eqToIso q).op
  let sL : Γ(unitModules W.toScheme, P) :=
    (pushedUnitRestriction
      ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n ij.1 ij.2).le.trans inf_le_left)).app U
        (localFrameComponent k n d i ij.1)
  let sR : Γ(unitModules W.toScheme, P) :=
    (pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition k n d ij.1 ij.2).app U
      ((pushedUnitRestriction
        ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n ij.1 ij.2).le.trans inf_le_right)).app U
          (localFrameComponent k n d i ij.2))
  change sL = sR
  let T : Γ(unitModules W.toScheme, P) →
      Γ(X, coordinateTripleOpen k n i ij.1 ij.2) :=
    fun z ↦ qIso.inv (eW.inv z)
  suffices hT : T sL = T sR by
    calc
      sL = eW.hom (qIso.hom (T sL)) := by simp [T]
      _ = eW.hom (qIso.hom (T sR)) := congrArg (fun z ↦ eW.hom (qIso.hom z)) hT
      _ = sR := by simp [T]
  dsimp only [T, sL, sR]
  simp only [pushedUnitRestriction_app_apply,
    pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition, Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app,
    coordinateOverlapTransitionIso]
  simp [unitMulSheafIso_hom_app_apply, localFrameComponent, restrictTopUnit,
    Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso]
  dsimp only [eW, qIso]
  simp only [Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso, Iso.refl_inv]
  change (localFrameTransitionSectionIJ k n (-d) i ij.1 ij.2).1 =
    (localFrameTransitionSectionJL k n d i ij.1 ij.2).1 *
      (localFrameTransitionSectionIL k n (-d) i ij.1 ij.2).1
  exact congrArg Units.val (localFrameTransitionSection_cocycle k n d i ij.1 ij.2)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localFrameHom_compatibility
statement:
theorem localFrameHom_compatibility (d : ℤ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    localFrameHom k n d i ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen k n i).ι).map
          (coordinateDescentLeft k n) =
      localFrameHom k n d i ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen k n i).ι).map
          (coordinateDescentRight k n d)
proof:
:= by
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen k n i).ι
  apply ((G.obj (coordinateOverlapCochains k n)).unitHomEquiv).injective
  rw [SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv_comp_apply,
    SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv_comp_apply]
  apply PresheafOfModules.sections_ext
  intro V
  rw [localFrameHom, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  change ((G.map (coordinateDescentLeft k n)).val.app V)
      (((G.obj (coordinateChartCochains k n)).val.map
        (homOfLE le_top).op) (localFrameTopSection k n d i)) =
    ((G.map (coordinateDescentRight k n d)).val.app V)
      (((G.obj (coordinateChartCochains k n)).val.map
        (homOfLE le_top).op) (localFrameTopSection k n d i))
  let a : (op (⊤ : (coordinateOpen k n i).toScheme.Opens)) ⟶ V :=
    (homOfLE le_top).op
  have hL := (G.map (coordinateDescentLeft k n)).val.naturality a
  have hR := (G.map (coordinateDescentRight k n d)).val.naturality a
  have htop :
      ((G.map (coordinateDescentLeft k n)).val.app (op ⊤))
          (localFrameTopSection k n d i) =
        ((G.map (coordinateDescentRight k n d)).val.app (op ⊤))
          (localFrameTopSection k n d i) := by
    let U := coordinateOpen k n i
    let left := coordinateDescentLeft k n
    let right := coordinateDescentRight k n d
    let chart := coordinateChartCochains k n
    let overlap := coordinateOverlapCochains k n
    let tuple := localFrameTuple k n d i
    change left.app (U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens))
        (chart.presheaf.map (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op tuple) =
      right.app (U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens))
        (chart.presheaf.map (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op tuple)
    have hf := congrArg (fun q ↦ q tuple)
      (left.val.naturality (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op)
    have hg := congrArg (fun q ↦ q tuple)
      (right.val.naturality (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op)
    change left.app (U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens))
        (chart.presheaf.map (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op tuple) =
      overlap.presheaf.map (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op (left.app U tuple) at hf
    change right.app (U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens))
        (chart.presheaf.map (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op tuple) =
      overlap.presheaf.map (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op (right.app U tuple) at hg
    rw [hf, hg, localFrameTuple_compatibility]
  calc
    _ = ((G.obj (coordinateOverlapCochains k n)).val.map a)
        (((G.map (coordinateDescentLeft k n)).val.app (op ⊤))
          (localFrameTopSection k n d i)) := by
      exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hL (localFrameTopSection k n d i)
    _ = ((G.obj (coordinateOverlapCochains k n)).val.map a)
        (((G.map (coordinateDescentRight k n d)).val.app (op ⊤))
          (localFrameTopSection k n d i)) := congrArg _ htop
    _ = _ := (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hR
      (localFrameTopSection k n d i)).symm

          ((coordinateOpen k n i).ι ''ᵁ V)
          ((kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)).app
            ((coordinateOpen k n i).ι ''ᵁ V) x))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localFrameHom_project
statement:
theorem localFrameHom_project (d : ℤ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    localFrameHom k n d i ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen k n i).ι).map
          (Pi.π (fun j : Fin (n + 1) ↦
            pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n j)) i) =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso
        (coordinateOpen k n i).ι).inv.app
          (unitModules (coordinateOpen k n i).toScheme)
proof:
:= by
  apply unitModulesHom_ext_top
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  change ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
      (coordinateOpen k n i).ι).map
        (Pi.π (fun j : Fin (n + 1) ↦
          pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n j)) i)).app ⊤
      ((localFrameHom k n d i).app ⊤
        (1 : (coordinateOpen k n i).toScheme.presheaf.obj (op ⊤))) =
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso
      (coordinateOpen k n i).ι).inv.app
        (unitModules (coordinateOpen k n i).toScheme)).app ⊤
      (1 : (coordinateOpen k n i).toScheme.presheaf.obj (op ⊤))
  have hsec :
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen k n i).ι).obj
        (coordinateChartCochains k n)).unitHomEquiv)
          (localFrameHom k n d i) =
        sectionsOfTop _ (localFrameTopSection k n d i) := by
    rw [localFrameHom, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have hframe : (localFrameHom k n d i).app ⊤
      (1 : (coordinateOpen k n i).toScheme.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) =
        localFrameTopSection k n d i := by
    have htop := congrArg (fun s ↦ s.val (op (⊤ :
        (coordinateOpen k n i).toScheme.Opens))) hsec
    change (localFrameHom k n d i).app ⊤
        (1 : (coordinateOpen k n i).toScheme.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) =
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen k n i).ι).obj
        (coordinateChartCochains k n)).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE le_top).op) (localFrameTopSection k n d i) at htop
    have q : (homOfLE (le_top : (⊤ :
        (coordinateOpen k n i).toScheme.Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op = 𝟙 (op ⊤) :=
      Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [q, Functor.map_id_apply] at htop
    exact htop
  rw [hframe]
  let U := coordinateOpen k n i
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι
  let πi := Pi.π (fun j : Fin (n + 1) ↦
    pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n j)) i
  let s := (coordinateChartCochains k n).presheaf.map
    (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op (localFrameTuple k n d i)
  have hπ : (G.map πi).app (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens)
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso U.ι
          (coordinateChartCochains k n) ⊤).inv s) =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso U.ι
        (pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) U) ⊤).inv
          (πi.app (U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens)) s) := by
    rfl
  change (G.map πi).app (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens)
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso U.ι
        (coordinateChartCochains k n) ⊤).inv s) = _
  rw [hπ]
  have hnat := congrArg (fun q ↦ q (localFrameTuple k n d i))
    (πi.val.naturality (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op)
  change πi.app (U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens)) s =
    (pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) U).presheaf.map
      (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op
        (πi.app U (localFrameTuple k n d i)) at hnat
  rw [hnat]
  change (Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso U.ι
      (pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) U) ⊤).inv
        ((pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) U).presheaf.map
          (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op
            ((Pi.π (fun j : Fin (n + 1) ↦
              pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n j)) i).app U
                (localFrameTuple k n d i))) = _
  rw [localFrameTuple_component]
  simp [localFrameComponent, Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateDescentKernel_restrictFunctor_component_compatibility
statement:
theorem coordinateDescentKernel_restrictFunctor_component_compatibility (d : ℤ)
    (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen k n i).ι).map
        (kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen k n i).ι).map
        (Pi.π (fun t : Fin (n + 1) ↦
          pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n t)) i) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen k n i).ι).map
        (pushedUnitRestriction
          ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_left)) =
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen k n i).ι).map
        (kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen k n i).ι).map
        (Pi.π (fun t : Fin (n + 1) ↦
          pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n t)) j) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen k n i).ι).map
        (pushedUnitRestriction
          ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_right)) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen k n i).ι).map
        (pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition k n d i j)
proof:
:= by
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen k n i).ι
  let charts := fun t : Fin (n + 1) ↦
    pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n t)
  let overlaps := fun ij : Fin (n + 1) × Fin (n + 1) ↦
    pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n)
      (coordinateOverlapOpen k n ij.1 ij.2)
  let qij := Pi.π overlaps (i, j)
  let rL := pushedUnitRestriction
    ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_left)
  let rR := pushedUnitRestriction
    ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_right)
  let t := pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition k n d i j
  have hK :
      G.map (kernel.ι
          (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)) ≫
          G.map (coordinateDescentLeft k n) =
        G.map (kernel.ι
          (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)) ≫
          G.map (coordinateDescentRight k n d) := by
    simpa only [Functor.map_comp] using congrArg G.map
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf_overlap_compatibility k n d)
  show G.map (kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)) ≫
      G.map (Pi.π charts i) ≫ G.map rL =
    G.map (kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)) ≫
      G.map (Pi.π charts j) ≫ G.map rR ≫ G.map t
  calc
    _ = (G.map (kernel.ι
            (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)) ≫
          G.map (coordinateDescentLeft k n)) ≫ G.map qij := by
        simp only [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp,
          coordinateDescentLeft_π, qij, overlaps, rL, charts]
    _ = (G.map (kernel.ι
            (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)) ≫
          G.map (coordinateDescentRight k n d)) ≫ G.map qij :=
        congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ G.map qij) hK
    _ = _ := by
        simp only [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp,
          coordinateDescentRight_π, qij, overlaps, rR, t, charts]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.restrictedKernel_generated_byFrame
statement:
theorem restrictedKernel_generated_byFrame (d : ℤ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen k n i).ι).map
        (kernel.ι
          (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)) =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen k n i).ι).map
          (kernel.ι
            (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen k n i).ι).map
          (Pi.π (fun j : Fin (n + 1) ↦
            pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n j)) i) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso
          (coordinateOpen k n i).ι).hom.app
            (unitModules (coordinateOpen k n i).toScheme) ≫
        localFrameHom k n d i
proof:
:= by
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen k n i).ι
  let charts := fun j : Fin (n + 1) ↦
    pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n j)
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits G := restrictFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits _
  apply (cancel_mono (PreservesProduct.iso G charts).hom).1
  apply (limit.isLimit (Discrete.functor (fun j ↦ G.obj (charts j)))).hom_ext
  rintro ⟨j⟩
  simp only [PreservesProduct.iso_hom]
  change _ ≫ piComparison G charts ≫
      Pi.π (fun j ↦ G.obj (charts j)) j =
    _ ≫ piComparison G charts ≫ Pi.π (fun j ↦ G.obj (charts j)) j
  simp only [Category.assoc, piComparison_comp_π]
  let overlaps := fun ij : Fin (n + 1) × Fin (n + 1) ↦
    pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n)
      (coordinateOverlapOpen k n ij.1 ij.2)
  let qij := Pi.π overlaps (i, j)
  let rL := pushedUnitRestriction
    ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_left)
  let rR := pushedUnitRestriction
    ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_right)
  let t := pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition k n d i j
  let hIsoR : IsIso (G.map rR) :=
    restrictedCoordinateOverlapRestriction_isIso k n i j
  letI : IsIso (G.map rR) := hIsoR
  letI : Mono (G.map rR) :=
    @IsIso.mono_of_iso _ _ _ _ _ hIsoR
  let hIsoT : IsIso t := by
    dsimp only [t, pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition]
    infer_instance
  letI : IsIso t := hIsoT
  let hIsoGT : IsIso (G.map t) := Functor.map_isIso G t
  letI : IsIso (G.map t) := hIsoGT
  letI : Mono (G.map t) :=
    @IsIso.mono_of_iso _ _ _ _ _ hIsoGT
  let ε := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso
    (coordinateOpen k n i).ι).hom.app
      (unitModules (coordinateOpen k n i).toScheme)
  have hK :
      G.map (kernel.ι
          (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)) ≫
          G.map (coordinateDescentLeft k n) =
        G.map (kernel.ι
          (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)) ≫
          G.map (coordinateDescentRight k n d) := by
    simpa only [Functor.map_comp] using congrArg G.map
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf_overlap_compatibility k n d)
  have hKij :
      G.map (kernel.ι
          (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)) ≫
          G.map (Pi.π charts i) ≫ G.map rL =
        G.map (kernel.ι
          (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)) ≫
          G.map (Pi.π charts j) ≫ G.map rR ≫ G.map t := by
    calc
      _ = (G.map (kernel.ι
              (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)) ≫
            G.map (coordinateDescentLeft k n)) ≫ G.map qij := by
          simp only [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp,
            coordinateDescentLeft_π, qij, overlaps, rL, charts]
      _ = (G.map (kernel.ι
              (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)) ≫
            G.map (coordinateDescentRight k n d)) ≫ G.map qij :=
          congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ G.map qij) hK
      _ = _ := by
          simp only [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp,
            coordinateDescentRight_π, qij, overlaps, rR, t, charts]
  have hFij :
      localFrameHom k n d i ≫ G.map (Pi.π charts i) ≫ G.map rL =
        localFrameHom k n d i ≫ G.map (Pi.π charts j) ≫ G.map rR ≫ G.map t := by
    calc
      _ = (localFrameHom k n d i ≫ G.map (coordinateDescentLeft k n)) ≫
          G.map qij := by
            simp only [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp,
              coordinateDescentLeft_π, qij, overlaps, rL, charts]
      _ = (localFrameHom k n d i ≫
          G.map (coordinateDescentRight k n d)) ≫ G.map qij :=
        congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ G.map qij)
          (localFrameHom_compatibility k n d i)
      _ = _ := by
          simp only [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp,
            coordinateDescentRight_π, qij, overlaps, rR, t, charts]
  have hεF : ε ≫ localFrameHom k n d i ≫ G.map (Pi.π charts i) = 𝟙 _ := by
    dsimp only [ε, G, charts]
    rw [localFrameHom_project]
    exact Iso.hom_inv_id_app _ _
  have hεFij :
      G.map rL = ε ≫ localFrameHom k n d i ≫
        G.map (Pi.π charts j) ≫ G.map rR ≫ G.map t := by
    calc
      _ = (ε ≫ localFrameHom k n d i ≫ G.map (Pi.π charts i)) ≫
          G.map rL := by rw [hεF, Category.id_comp]
      _ = ε ≫ (localFrameHom k n d i ≫ G.map (Pi.π charts i) ≫
          G.map rL) := by simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = ε ≫ (localFrameHom k n d i ≫ G.map (Pi.π charts j) ≫
          G.map rR ≫ G.map t) := congrArg (fun q ↦ ε ≫ q) hFij
      _ = _ := by rfl
  apply (cancel_mono (G.map rR)).1
  apply (cancel_mono (G.map t)).1
  calc
    _ = G.map (kernel.ι
          (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)) ≫
        G.map (Pi.π charts i) ≫ G.map rL := by
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using hKij.symm
    _ = G.map (kernel.ι
          (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)) ≫
        G.map (Pi.π charts i) ≫
          (ε ≫ localFrameHom k n d i ≫ G.map (Pi.π charts j) ≫
            G.map rR ≫ G.map t) := by rw [hεFij]
    _ = _ := by
      dsimp only [ε, G, charts]
      simp only [Category.assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.localFrameProjection_kernelLift
statement:
theorem localFrameProjection_kernelLift (d : ℤ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    localFrameProjection k n d i ≫ localFrameKernelLift k n d i =
      𝟙 ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen k n i).ι).obj
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d))
proof:
:= by
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen k n i).ι
  let φ := coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits G := restrictFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits _
  apply (cancel_mono (G.map (kernel.ι φ))).1
  rw [Category.assoc, localFrameKernelLift_ι]
  dsimp only [localFrameProjection]
  rw [Category.id_comp]
  exact (restrictedKernel_generated_byFrame k n d i).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.symmetricAlgebraOfBaseChange_tmul_ι
statement:
@[simp]
theorem symmetricAlgebraOfBaseChange_tmul_ι
    (φ : M →ₗ[R] N) (s : S) (m : M) :
    symmetricAlgebraOfBaseChange φ
        (s ⊗ₜ[R] SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M m) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.ι S N (s • φ m)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.symmetricAlgebraToBaseChange_ι_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem symmetricAlgebraToBaseChange_ι_apply
    (φ : M →ₗ[R] N) (hφ : IsBaseChange S φ) (m : M) :
    symmetricAlgebraToBaseChange φ hφ
        (SymmetricAlgebra.ι S N (φ m)) =
      1 ⊗ₜ[R] SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M m
proof:
:= by
  simp [symmetricAlgebraToBaseChange, hφ.lift_eq]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.symmetricAlgebraOfBaseChange_comp_toBaseChange
statement:
theorem symmetricAlgebraOfBaseChange_comp_toBaseChange

      AlgHom.id S (SymmetricAlgebra S N)
proof:

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restriction_isBaseChange
statement:
theorem restriction_isBaseChange (i : C.I) (V : X.Opens)
    (hVU : V ≤ C.U i) :
    let f
proof:
:= (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op).hom
    letI : Algebra Γ(X, C.U i) Γ(X, V) := f.toAlgebra
    letI : Module Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op V)) :=
      Module.compHom (E.val.obj (op V)) f
    letI : IsScalarTower Γ(X, C.U i) Γ(X, V)
        (E.val.obj (op V)) :=
      ⟨fun r s n ↦ by
        change (f r * s) • n = f r • s • n
        rw [mul_smul]⟩
    IsBaseChange Γ(X, V)
      (semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f
        (E.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE hVU).op)) := by
  dsimp only
  let f := (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op).hom
  letI : Algebra Γ(X, C.U i) Γ(X, V) := f.toAlgebra
  letI : Module Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op V)) :=
    Module.compHom (E.val.obj (op V)) f
  letI : IsScalarTower Γ(X, C.U i) Γ(X, V)
      (E.val.obj (op V)) :=
    ⟨fun r s n ↦ by
      change (f r * s) • n = f r • s • n
      rw [mul_smul]⟩
  let bU := C.sectionBasis i
  let bV := C.restrictedSectionBasis i V hVU
  let φ := semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f
    (E.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE hVU).op)
  have hfree :
      IsBaseChange Γ(X, V)
        (Finsupp.linearCombination Γ(X, C.U i) bV) :=
    IsBaseChange.of_basis Γ(X, C.U i) bV
  have hcomp :
      IsBaseChange Γ(X, V)
        ((Finsupp.linearCombination Γ(X, C.U i) bV).comp
          bU.repr.toLinearMap) :=
    IsBaseChange.comp_equiv bU.repr
      (Finsupp.linearCombination Γ(X, C.U i) bV) hfree
  have heq :
      (Finsupp.linearCombination Γ(X, C.U i) bV).comp
          bU.repr.toLinearMap = φ := by
    apply bU.ext
    intro k
    simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
      Function.comp_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self,
      Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul]
    dsimp only [bU, bV, φ]
    change C.restrictedSectionBasis i V hVU k =
      E.val.map (homOfLE hVU).op (C.sectionBasis i k)
    exact (C.restrictedSectionBasis_eq_restrict i V hVU k).symm
  change IsBaseChange Γ(X, V) φ
  rw [← heq]
  exact hcomp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.lineFilt_cover
statement:
theorem lineFilt_cover :
    ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.LineFilt C.scheme
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj E))
      (pullClasses S C)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := flat_toBase S C hC
  have h := (lineFilt_of_splitting ops S).pullback C.toBase
  have e1 : (ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.stepClasses S.L S.L_line e).map
      (flatPullbackK0 C.toBase) = pullClasses S C := by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.isFiniteLocallyFree_twisted
statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_twisted
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E (e + 1)) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme (ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.twistBy (twistNeg S C)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj E)))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := flat_toBase S C hC
  have h1 := hasConstantRank_pullback S.Y S.q E (e + 1) hE
  have h2 := hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase _ (e + 1) h1
  exact (ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.hasConstantRank_twistBy (twistNeg S C)
    (hasConstantRank_twistNeg S C) h2).isFiniteLocallyFree

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.koszul_cover
statement:
theorem koszul_cover (hE : HasConstantRank X E (e + 1)) :
    ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.lamMinus C.scheme
        (ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.twistBy (twistNeg S C)
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj E)))
        (isFiniteLocallyFree_twisted S C hC hE) (e + 1) =
      ((pullClasses S C).map fun x =>
        1 - x * k0ClassOf C.scheme (twistNeg S C)
          (hasConstantRank_twistNeg S C).isFiniteLocallyFree).prod
proof:
:=
  ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.koszulProd_twist (twistNeg S C) (hasConstantRank_twistNeg S C)
    (lineFilt_cover S C hC) (isFiniteLocallyFree_twisted S C hC hE) (card_pullClasses S C)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.map_koszul_cover
statement:
theorem map_koszul_cover {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (Φ : K0 C.scheme →+* R)
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E (e + 1)) :
    Φ (ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.lamMinus C.scheme
        (ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.twistBy (twistNeg S C)
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj E)))
        (isFiniteLocallyFree_twisted S C hC hE) (e + 1)) =
      ((pullClasses S C).map fun x =>
        1 - Φ x * Φ (k0ClassOf C.scheme (twistNeg S C)
          (hasConstantRank_twistNeg S C).isFiniteLocallyFree)).prod
proof:
:=
  ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.map_koszulProd_twist (twistNeg S C)
    (hasConstantRank_twistNeg S C) Φ (lineFilt_cover S C hC)
    (isFiniteLocallyFree_twisted S C hC hE) (card_pullClasses S C)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.xiCapOn_add_twistNeg
statement:
theorem xiCapOn_add_twistNeg [Fact (Cl C.scheme)] :
    xiCapOn ops C + totalCapOn ops (twistNeg S C) (hasConstantRank_twistNeg S C) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i) := fun i => by
    have := C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos (e + 1))
    exact this i
  have hT : HasConstantRank C.scheme (tensorSheaf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1))) 1 := by
    have h := hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
      (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1))
    rwa [Nat.one_mul] at h
  have h := totalCapOn_tensor (ops := ops) (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1)) (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1)) hT
  have e1 : tensorSheaf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1)) ≅
      C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 0 :=
    AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.twistingTensorIso C hpos 1 (-1) ≪≫
      eqToIso (by norm_num)
  rw [cap_isoOn ops hT hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf ⟨e1 ≪≫ C.canonicalTwistingSheafZeroIso⟩,
    totalCapOn_tensorUnit] at h
  exact h.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.m7sOn_cap_mem
proof:
:= by
  change c ∈ (m7sSuppSpan S m).comap (ops.cap L hL m)
  refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_ hc
  rintro _ ⟨D, hDS, rfl⟩
  refine m7s_mem_of_prime ((m7sSuppSpan S m).comap (ops.cap L hL m)) S ?_ D hDS
  intro v hv hvS
  have hrV := m7s_genericRank_pointClosure L hL v
  have hfl := isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL v
  obtain ⟨b⟩ := Scheme.Modules.exists_lineBundleLocalDataAt (pointClosureScheme v)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj L) hfl hrV (pointClosureGenericPoint v)
  set Wd := Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hfl hrV b with hWd
  have hsupp : (properPushforward (pointClosureι v) Wd.1).support ⊆
      (pointClosureι v) '' {y | coheight y = 1} := by
    rw [properPushforward, pushforward_support_closedImmersion (pointClosureι v) Wd.1
      (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl)]
    exact Set.image_mono Wd.2
  have hgen : genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v) = pointClosureGenericPoint v :=
    ((pointClosureGenericPoint_isGeneric v).eq (genericPoint_spec _)).symm
  have hmem : properPushforward (pointClosureι v) Wd.1 ∈ dimensionCycles W m := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hsupp hx
    have h := dimensionCatenary_of_finiteType k (X := W) (pointClosureScheme v)
      (pointClosureι v) y hy
    rw [hgen, pointClosureι_genericPoint, hv] at h
    exact ENat_add_one_cancel (by simpa using h)
  change ops.cap L hL m _ ∈ m7sSuppSpan S m
  rw [ops.cap_mk L hL m v hv hrV b ⟨_, hmem⟩ rfl]
  refine m7s_mem_suppSpan _ ?_
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨y, -, rfl⟩ := hsupp hx
  have hy : pointClosureι v y ∈ closure {v} := by
    rw [← range_pointClosureι]; exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
  exact hS v _ hvS (specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr hy)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.m7sOn_push_eq_zero'
statement:
theorem m7sOn_push_eq_zero' (f : W ⟶ V) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsProper f] (m : ℕ) (S : Set W)
    (hS : ∀ x ∈ S, height (f x) < m)
    {c : RationalDimChow W m} (hc : c ∈ m7sSuppSpan S m) :
    ops.push f m c = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hf : HeightCompatible f := heightCompatible_of_finiteType k f
  change c ∈ LinearMap.ker (ops.push f m)
  refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_ hc
  rintro _ ⟨D, hDS, rfl⟩
  change ops.push f m _ = 0
  have h0 : ((0 : dimensionCycles V m) : AlgebraicCycle V ℤ) = properPushforward f D.1 := by
    ext y
    change (0 : ℤ) = _
    rw [properPushforward_apply]
    symm
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨-, hDx⟩ := (mem_preimageSupportFinite_toFinset_iff f D.1 y x).mp hx
    have hxm : height x = m := D.2 hDx
    have hfx : height (f x) < m := hS x (hDS hDx)
    have hdeg : f.degree x = 0 := by
      by_contra hd
      have := hf x hd
      rw [hxm] at this
      rw [this] at hfx
      exact lt_irrefl _ hfx
    simp [hdeg]
  rw [ops.push_mk f m D 0 h0, QuotientAddGroup.mk_zero, TensorProduct.tmul_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.m7sOn_xi_mem_totG
statement:
theorem m7sOn_xi_mem_totG {S : Set C.scheme} (hS : ∀ x y : C.scheme, x ∈ S → x ⤳ y → y ∈ S)
    {n t : ℕ} {x : TotalChow C.scheme} (hx : x ∈ m7sTotG C S n (t + 1)) :
    xiCapOn ops C x ∈ m7sTotG C S n t
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : m7sTotG C S n (t + 1) ≤ (m7sTotG C S n t).comap (xiCapOn ops C) from h hx
  refine iSup_le fun m ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := m
  rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro c hc
  obtain ⟨m', rfl⟩ : ∃ m', m = m' + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
  simp only [Submodule.mem_comap]
  have hcap : xiCapOn ops C (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow C.scheme m) (m' + 1) c) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow C.scheme m) m'
        (ops.cap (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) m' c) := by
    rw [xiCapOn, totalCapOn, DirectSum.toModule_lof]
    rfl
  rw [hcap]
  exact m7s_lof_mem_totG C (by omega) (m7sOn_cap_mem ops _ _ m' _ hS hc)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.m7sOn_push_totG_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : m7sTotG C S n 0 ≤ LinearMap.ker (totalPushOn ops C.toBase) from h hx
  refine iSup_le fun m ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := m
  rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro c hc
  simp only [Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.mem_ker]
  rw [totalPushOn, DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    m7sOn_push_eq_zero' ops C.toBase m S (fun x hx ↦ (hS x hx).trans_le (by exact_mod_cast hm)) hc,
    map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.m7sOn_cap_step
statement:
theorem m7sOn_cap_step {e n : ℕ} {v : X} (hv : height v = n) (F : M7sFlag C e v) {t s : ℕ}
    (hts : t + 1 + s = e) (h : height (F.w t) = ((n + s + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
    (h' : height (F.w (t + 1)) = ((n + s : ℕ) : ℕ∞)) :
    ops.cap (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (n + s)
        ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (F.w t) (n + s + 1) h) :
          DimChow C.scheme (n + s + 1))) -
      (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (F.w (t + 1)) (n + s) h') :
          DimChow C.scheme (n + s)) ∈
      m7sSuppSpan {x : C.scheme | height (C.toBase x) < n} (n + s)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b₀, b, hb⟩ := F.frame t (by omega)
  set Wd := Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame
    (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure _ (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (F.w t))
    (m7s_genericRank_pointClosure _ (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (F.w t)) b with hWd
  have hmem := m7s_pushWeil_mem (k := k) _ (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (n + s) (F.w t) h b
  rw [ops.cap_mk _ (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (n + s) (F.w t) h (m7s_genericRank_pointClosure _ (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (F.w t)) b
    ⟨_, hmem⟩ rfl, ← TensorProduct.tmul_sub, ← QuotientAddGroup.mk_sub]
  refine m7s_mem_suppSpan _ ?_
  intro x hx
  change (properPushforward (pointClosureι (F.w t)) Wd.1) x -
    (dimPrimeCycle (F.w (t + 1)) (n + s) h').1 x ≠ 0 at hx
  rw [m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply] at hx
  obtain ⟨z0, hz0, hιz0⟩ := F.step t (by omega)
  by_cases hxr : x ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι (F.w t))
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hxr
    have hD : properPushforward (pointClosureι (F.w t)) Wd.1 (pointClosureι (F.w t) z) =
        Wd.1 z :=
      pushforward_apply_closedImmersion (pointClosureι (F.w t)) Wd.1 (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ())
        (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) z
    rw [hD] at hx
    have hspec : v ⤳ C.toBase (pointClosureι (F.w t) z) := by
      have h1 : F.w t ⤳ pointClosureι (F.w t) z := by
        rw [specializes_iff_mem_closure, ← range_pointClosureι]
        exact ⟨z, rfl⟩
      simpa [F.base t] using h1.map C.toBase.continuous
    by_cases hpv : C.toBase (pointClosureι (F.w t) z) = v
    · exfalso
      apply hx
      by_cases hcz : coheight z = 1
      · rw [hWd, Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame_apply, hb z hcz hpv, sub_self]
      · have hW0 : Wd.1 z = 0 := by
          by_contra h0
          exact hcz (Wd.2 h0)
        have hne : pointClosureι (F.w t) z ≠ F.w (t + 1) := by
          intro heq
          rw [← hιz0] at heq
          exact hcz ((pointClosureι (F.w t)).isEmbedding.injective heq ▸ hz0)
        rw [hW0, if_neg hne, sub_zero]
    · have hlt : C.toBase (pointClosureι (F.w t) z) < v :=
        lt_of_le_not_ge (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr hspec)
          (fun hge ↦ hpv (hspec.antisymm (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hge)).eq.symm)
      change height (C.toBase (pointClosureι (F.w t) z)) < n
      rw [← hv]
      exact Order.height_strictMono hlt
        ((Order.height_mono hlt.le).trans_lt (by rw [hv]; exact ENat.coe_lt_top n))
  · exfalso
    apply hx
    have hne : x ≠ F.w (t + 1) := fun heq ↦ hxr ⟨z0, hιz0.trans heq.symm⟩
    rw [properPushforward, pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range _ _ _ _ x hxr,
      if_neg hne, sub_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.m7sOn_main
statement:
theorem m7sOn_main {e n : ℕ} {v : X} (hv : height v = n) (F : M7sFlag C e v)
    (h0 : height (F.w 0) = ((n + e : ℕ) : ℕ∞)) :
    ∀ t s, t + s = e → ∃ h : height (F.w t) = ((n + s : ℕ) : ℕ∞),
      ((xiCapOn ops C) ^ t) (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow C.scheme m) (n + e)
          ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (F.w 0) (n + e) h0) :
            DimChow C.scheme (n + e)))) -
        DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow C.scheme m) (n + s)
          ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (F.w t) (n + s) h) :
            DimChow C.scheme (n + s))) ∈
        m7sTotG C {x | height (C.toBase x) < n} n s
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | zero =>
    intro s hs
    obtain rfl : s = e := by omega
    refine ⟨h0, ?_⟩
    rw [pow_zero, Module.End.one_apply, sub_self]
    exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | succ t ih =>
    intro s hs
    obtain ⟨h, hmem⟩ := ih (s + 1) (by omega)
    obtain ⟨z0, hz0, hιz0⟩ := F.step t (by omega)
    have hgen : genericPoint (pointClosureScheme (F.w t)) = pointClosureGenericPoint (F.w t) :=
      ((pointClosureGenericPoint_isGeneric (F.w t)).eq (genericPoint_spec _)).symm
    have h' : height (F.w (t + 1)) = ((n + s : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
      have hc := dimensionCatenary_of_finiteType k (X := C.scheme)
        (pointClosureScheme (F.w t)) (pointClosureι (F.w t)) z0 hz0
      rw [hgen, pointClosureι_genericPoint, h, hιz0] at hc
      exact ENat_add_one_cancel (by rw [hc]; push_cast; ring)
    refine ⟨h', ?_⟩
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]
    set A := ((xiCapOn ops C) ^ t) (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow C.scheme m) (n + e)
          ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (F.w 0) (n + e) h0) :
            DimChow C.scheme (n + e))))
    set B := DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow C.scheme m) (n + (s + 1))
          ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (F.w t) (n + (s + 1)) h) :
            DimChow C.scheme (n + (s + 1))))
    have hxiB : xiCapOn ops C B = DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow C.scheme m) (n + s)
        (ops.cap (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (n + s)
          ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (F.w t) (n + (s + 1)) h) :
            DimChow C.scheme (n + (s + 1))))) := by
      rw [xiCapOn, totalCapOn, DirectSum.toModule_lof]
      rfl
    have hsplit : xiCapOn ops C A - DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow C.scheme m) (n + s)
          ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (F.w (t + 1)) (n + s) h') :
            DimChow C.scheme (n + s))) =
        xiCapOn ops C (A - B) + DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow C.scheme m) (n + s)
          (ops.cap (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (n + s)
            ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (F.w t) (n + (s + 1)) h) :
              DimChow C.scheme (n + (s + 1)))) -
            (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (F.w (t + 1)) (n + s) h') :
              DimChow C.scheme (n + s))) := by
      rw [map_sub, hxiB, map_sub]
      abel
    rw [hsplit]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ (m7sOn_xi_mem_totG ops C (m7s_specClosed_lt C n) hmem)
      (m7s_lof_mem_totG C le_rfl (m7sOn_cap_step ops C hv F (by omega) h h'))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.segreOn_zero
statement:
theorem segreOn_zero (cp : ChowCompatOn ops) {e : ℕ} (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = e + 1) :
    segreOn ops C cp hC 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Flat C.toBase := C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos e))
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  let M : Submodule ℚ (RationalDimChow X n) :=
    LinearMap.ker ((segreOn ops C cp hC 0).comp (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) n) -
      (1 : Module.End ℚ (TotalChow X)).comp (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) n))
  suffices hM : ∀ c, c ∈ M by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro c
    have := hM c
    rwa [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.sub_apply, sub_eq_zero] at this
  intro c
  induction c using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => exact M.zero_mem
  | add a b ha hb => exact M.add_mem ha hb
  | tmul q a =>
    have hq : q ⊗ₜ[ℤ] a = q • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] a) := by
      rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    rw [hq]
    refine M.smul_mem q ?_
    induction a using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H D =>
    refine m7s_mem_of_prime M Set.univ ?_ D (Set.subset_univ _)
    intro v hv _
    obtain ⟨F⟩ := m7geo_flag_exists C hC v
    have hd := cp.projBundle_relDim C hC
    have h0 : height (F.w 0) = ((n + e : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
      rw [hd (F.w 0) (by rw [F.coeff_zero]; exact one_ne_zero), F.base 0, hv]
      push_cast; rfl
    
    have hpull : ops.pull C.toBase e hd n ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v n hv) : DimChow X n)) =
        (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (F.w 0) (n + e) h0) :
          DimChow C.scheme (n + e)) := by
      refine ops.pull_mk C.toBase e hd n _ _ ?_
      intro x
      rw [m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply, m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply]
      by_cases hx : x = F.w 0
      · subst hx
        rw [if_pos rfl, if_pos (F.base 0), F.coeff_zero]
        simp
      · rw [if_neg hx]
        by_cases hpx : C.toBase x = v
        · rw [if_pos hpx, one_mul]
          by_contra hc
          exact hx (F.coeff_unique x hpx (by exact_mod_cast Ne.symm hc))
        · rw [if_neg hpx, zero_mul]
    
    have hwe : height (F.w e) = ((n + 0 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) :=
      (m7sOn_main ops C hv F h0 e 0 (by omega)).1
    have hv0 : height v = ((n + 0 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := hv
    have hpush : ops.push C.toBase (n + 0) ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (F.w e) (n + 0) hwe) : DimChow C.scheme (n + 0))) =
        (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 0) hv0) : DimChow X (n + 0)) := by
      refine ops.push_mk C.toBase n _ _ ?_
      ext y
      rw [properPushforward_apply_eq_sum_of_subset C.toBase _ y {F.w e} (by
        intro x _ hx
        rw [m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply] at hx
        by_contra hxe
        exact hx (if_neg (by simpa using hxe)))]
      rw [m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply]
      by_cases hy : y = v
      · subst hy
        rw [if_pos rfl, Finset.filter_singleton, if_pos (F.base e), Finset.sum_singleton,
          m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply, if_pos rfl, F.degree]
        simp
      · rw [if_neg hy, Finset.filter_singleton, if_neg (by rw [F.base e]; exact Ne.symm hy),
          Finset.sum_empty]
    obtain ⟨hwe', hmain⟩ := m7sOn_main ops C hv F h0 e 0 (by omega)
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.sub_apply, sub_eq_zero]
    change totalPushOn ops C.toBase (((xiCapOn ops C) ^ (e + 0))
      (totalPullOn ops C.toBase e (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC)
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) n _))) = _
    rw [totalPullOn, DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply, hpull, Nat.add_zero,
      ← sub_add_cancel (((xiCapOn ops C) ^ e) _) _, map_add,
      m7sOn_push_totG_eq_zero ops C (fun x hx ↦ hx) hmain, zero_add, totalPushOn,
      DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply, hpush]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.m7sOn_pull_mem
statement:
theorem m7sOn_pull_mem (f : W ⟶ V) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat f] (d : ℕ) (hd : PureRelDim f d)
    (n : ℕ) (c : RationalDimChow V n) :
    ops.pull f d hd n c ∈ m7sSuppSpan {x | height (f x) ≤ n} (n + d)
proof:
:= by
  induction c using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ ha hb
  | tmul q a =>
    have hq : q ⊗ₜ[ℤ] a = q • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] a) := by
      rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    rw [hq, map_smul]
    refine Submodule.smul_mem _ q ?_
    induction a using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H D =>
    let D' : dimensionCycles W (n + d) :=
      ⟨flatPullback f D.1, flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles f hd D.2⟩
    rw [ops.pull_mk f d hd n D D' (fun x ↦ rfl)]
    refine m7s_mem_suppSpan _ ?_
    intro x hx
    change D.1 (f x) * (flatPullbackCoeff f x : ℤ) ≠ 0 at hx
    change height (f x) ≤ n
    rw [D.2 (left_ne_zero_of_mul hx)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.m7sOn_xi_mem_tot
statement:
theorem m7sOn_xi_mem_tot {n t : ℕ} {x : TotalChow C.scheme} (hx : x ∈ m7sTot C n (t + 1)) :
    xiCapOn ops C x ∈ m7sTot C n t
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : m7sTot C n (t + 1) ≤ (m7sTot C n t).comap (xiCapOn ops C) from h hx
  refine iSup_le fun m ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := m
  rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro c hc
  obtain ⟨m', rfl⟩ : ∃ m', m = m' + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
  simp only [Submodule.mem_comap]
  have hcap : xiCapOn ops C (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow C.scheme m) (m' + 1) c) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow C.scheme m) m'
        (ops.cap (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) m' c) := by
    rw [xiCapOn, totalCapOn, DirectSum.toModule_lof]
    rfl
  rw [hcap]
  exact m7s_lof_mem_tot C (by omega)
    (m7sOn_cap_mem ops _ _ m' _ (m7s_specClosed C n) hc)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.m7sOn_xi_pow_mem_tot
statement:
theorem m7sOn_xi_pow_mem_tot {n : ℕ} : ∀ (i t : ℕ) {x : TotalChow C.scheme},
    x ∈ m7sTot C n (t + i) → ((xiCapOn ops C) ^ i) x ∈ m7sTot C n t
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero => intro t x hx; simpa using hx
  | succ i ih =>
    intro t x hx
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]
    exact m7sOn_xi_mem_tot ops C (ih (t + 1) (by rwa [show t + 1 + i = t + (i + 1) by omega]))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.m7sOn_push_tot_eq_zero
statement:
theorem m7sOn_push_tot_eq_zero {n : ℕ} {x : TotalChow C.scheme} (hx : x ∈ m7sTot C n 1) :
    totalPushOn ops C.toBase x = 0
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : m7sTot C n 1 ≤ LinearMap.ker (totalPushOn ops C.toBase) from h hx
  refine iSup_le fun m ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := m
  rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro c hc
  simp only [Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.mem_ker]
  rw [totalPushOn, DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    m7sOn_push_eq_zero' ops C.toBase m _ (fun x hx => hx.trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast hm)) hc, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.sandwichOn_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem sandwichOn_eq_zero_of_lt (cp : ChowCompatOn ops) {e : ℕ} (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = e + 1) {j : ℕ}
    (hj : j < e) : sandwichOn ops C cp hC j = 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Flat C.toBase := C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos e))
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro c
  rw [LinearMap.zero_comp, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  change totalPushOn ops C.toBase (((xiCapOn ops C) ^ j)
    (totalPullOn ops C.toBase e (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC)
      (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) n c))) = 0
  have h1 : totalPullOn ops C.toBase e (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC)
      (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) n c) ∈ m7sTot C n ((e - j) + j) := by
    rw [totalPullOn, DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply]
    exact m7s_lof_mem_tot C (by omega) (m7sOn_pull_mem ops C.toBase e _ n c)
  exact m7sOn_push_tot_eq_zero ops C
    (m7s_tot_mono C (by omega) (m7sOn_xi_pow_mem_tot ops C j (e - j) h1))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.X_mul_uLine
statement: theorem X_mul_uLine : (PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries A) * uLine A = 1 - rescale (-1 : A) (exp A)
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rcases n with _ | n
  · rw [map_sub, coeff_one, coeff_rescale, coeff_exp]
    simp
  · rw [coeff_succ_X_mul, map_sub, coeff_one, coeff_rescale, coeff_exp]
    simp only [uLine, coeff_mk, Nat.succ_ne_zero, if_false, zero_sub]
    rw [pow_succ]
    ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.toddLine_mul_uLine
statement: theorem toddLine_mul_uLine : CharacteristicClasses.toddLine A * uLine A = 1
proof:
:= by
  set E := exp A with hE
  set Em := rescale (-1 : A) E with hEm
  set T := CharacteristicClasses.toddLine A
  set U := uLine A
  have h1 : T * (E - 1) = PowerSeries.X * E := bernoulli'PowerSeries_mul_exp_sub_one A
  have hEEm : E * Em = 1 := exp_mul_exp_neg_eq_one
  have hX : PowerSeries.X * U = 1 - Em := X_mul_uLine A
  have h2 : E - 1 = E * (PowerSeries.X * U) := by
    rw [hX]
    linear_combination hEEm
  have h3 : PowerSeries.X * (E * (T * U)) = PowerSeries.X * (E * 1) := by
    linear_combination h1 - T * h2
  have h4 : E * (T * U) = E * 1 := X_mul_cancel h3
  linear_combination Em * h4 - (T * U - 1) * hEEm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.toddRoot_mul_uRoot
statement:
theorem toddRoot_mul_uRoot (x : A) :
    CharacteristicClasses.toddRoot A x * uRoot A x = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [CharacteristicClasses.toddRoot, uRoot, ← map_mul, toddLine_mul_uLine, map_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.tdG_lineSeq
statement:
theorem tdG_lineSeq (x : K) (m : ℕ) :
    tdG (lineSeq x) m = (PowerSeries.coeff m (CharacteristicClasses.toddLine ℚ)) • x ^ m
proof:
:= by
  apply Algebra.lmul_injective (R := ℚ) (A := K)
  have h := tdG_map (Algebra.lmul ℚ K) (lineSeq x) (by simp [lineSeq]) m
  rw [h]
  have e : (fun i => (Algebra.lmul ℚ K) (lineSeq x i)) =
      fun i => if i = 0 then (1 : Module.End ℚ K) else if i = 1 then Algebra.lmul ℚ K x else 0 := by
    funext i
    simp only [lineSeq]
    split_ifs
    · exact map_one _
    · rfl
    · exact map_zero _
  rw [e, ← tdOfChern_eq_tdG, tdOfChern_line, map_smul, map_pow]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.tdSeries_line
statement:
theorem tdSeries_line (x : K) :
    PowerSeries.mk (tdG (lineSeq x)) = CharacteristicClasses.toddRoot K x
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  rw [coeff_mk, tdG_lineSeq, CharacteristicClasses.coeff_toddRoot, Algebra.smul_def,
    CharacteristicClasses.coeff_toddLine, mul_comm]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.tdSeries_esymm
statement:
theorem tdSeries_esymm (s : Multiset K) :
    PowerSeries.mk (tdG (fun a => s.esymm a)) = (s.map (CharacteristicClasses.toddRoot K)).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    have : (fun a => (0 : Multiset K).esymm a) = lineSeq (0 : K) := by
      funext a
      rw [esymm_zero_multiset]
      simp only [lineSeq]
      split_ifs <;> simp_all
    rw [this, tdSeries_line, CharacteristicClasses.toddRoot_zero]
    simp
  | cons a s ih =>
    have hB : ∀ n, (a ::ₘ s).esymm n =
        ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, s.esymm p.1 * lineSeq a p.2 := fun n => esymm_cons_eq_line a s n
    have hconv := tdG_conv_comm (fun i => s.esymm i) (lineSeq a) (fun i => (a ::ₘ s).esymm i)
      (esymm_zero_right s) (by simp [lineSeq]) hB
    rw [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons, mul_comm, ← ih, ← tdSeries_line a]
    ext m
    rw [coeff_mk, hconv m, coeff_mul]
    simp only [coeff_mk]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.tdSeries_mul_uSeries
statement:
theorem tdSeries_mul_uSeries (s : Multiset K) :
    PowerSeries.mk (tdG (fun a => s.esymm a)) * (s.map (uRoot K)).prod = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [tdSeries_esymm, ← Multiset.prod_map_mul]
  have : (s.map fun x => CharacteristicClasses.toddRoot K x * uRoot K x) = s.map fun _ => 1 :=
    Multiset.map_congr rfl fun x _ => toddRoot_mul_uRoot K x
  rw [this]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.tdNinvOp_inter
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∀ a, Inter u (((-1 : ℚ) ^ a) • c a) (((-1 : ℚ) ^ a) • c' a) := fun a => (hc a).smul _
  exact ISer.inv (fun i => tdG_inter h1 i) m

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.tdG_zero_coeff
statement: theorem tdG_zero_coeff {R : Type*} [Ring R] [Algebra ℚ R] (c : ℕ → R) : tdG c 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [tdG]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.invOfUnit_eq_of_mul_eq_one
statement:
theorem invOfUnit_eq_of_mul_eq_one {R : Type*} [Ring R] (f g : PowerSeries R)
    (hf : PowerSeries.constantCoeff f = 1) (h : f * g = 1) : PowerSeries.invOfUnit f 1 = g
proof:
:= by
  have hf' : PowerSeries.constantCoeff f = ((1 : Rˣ) : R) := by simpa using hf
  have h1 := PowerSeries.invOfUnit_mul f 1 hf'
  calc PowerSeries.invOfUnit f 1 = PowerSeries.invOfUnit f 1 * (f * g) := by rw [h, mul_one]
    _ = (PowerSeries.invOfUnit f 1 * f) * g := by rw [mul_assoc]
    _ = g := by rw [h1, one_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.tdNinvOp_of_map
statement:
theorem tdNinvOp_of_map {K : Type*} [CommRing K] [Algebra ℚ K] {R : Type*} [Ring R]
    [Algebra ℚ R] (φ : K →ₐ[ℚ] R) (n : Multiset K) (c : ℕ → R)
    (hc : ∀ a, ((-1 : ℚ) ^ a) • c a = φ (n.esymm a)) (m : ℕ) :
    tdNinvOp c m = φ (PowerSeries.coeff m (n.map (uRoot K)).prod)
proof:
:= by
  have hN : (fun a => ((-1 : ℚ) ^ a) • c a) = fun a => φ (n.esymm a) := funext hc
  unfold tdNinvOp
  rw [hN]
  have hT := tdSeries_mul_uSeries n
  have hmap : PowerSeries.mk (tdG fun a => φ (n.esymm a)) =
      PowerSeries.map φ.toRingHom (PowerSeries.mk (tdG fun a => n.esymm a)) := by
    refine PowerSeries.ext fun j => ?_
    rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_map, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
    exact (tdG_map φ (fun a => n.esymm a) (esymm_zero_right _) j).symm
  have h0 : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (PowerSeries.mk (tdG fun a => φ (n.esymm a))) = 1 := by
    rw [← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, tdG_zero_coeff]
  have hmul : PowerSeries.mk (tdG fun a => φ (n.esymm a)) *
      PowerSeries.map φ.toRingHom (n.map (uRoot K)).prod = 1 := by
    rw [hmap, ← (PowerSeries.map φ.toRingHom).map_mul, hT]
    exact map_one _
  have hinv := invOfUnit_eq_of_mul_eq_one _ _ h0 hmul
  rw [hinv, PowerSeries.coeff_map]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.esymm_map_ringHom
statement:
theorem esymm_map_ringHom {A B : Type*} [CommSemiring A] [CommSemiring B] (f : A →+* B)
    (s : Multiset A) (n : ℕ) : (s.map f).esymm n = f (s.esymm n)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Multiset.esymm, Multiset.powersetCard_map, Multiset.map_map, map_multiset_sum]
  congr 1
  refine Multiset.map_congr rfl fun t _ => ?_
  simp [Function.comp_apply, map_multiset_prod]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.esymm_tw
statement:
theorem esymm_tw (s : Multiset K) (a : ℕ) :
    (s.map tw).esymm a = PowerSeries.C (s.esymm a) * PowerSeries.X ^ a
proof:
:= by
  have h := Multiset.pow_smul_esymm (PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries K) a (s.map (PowerSeries.C : K →+* PowerSeries K))
  rw [esymm_map_ringHom, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] at h
  rw [h, Multiset.map_map]
  congr 1
  refine Multiset.map_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
  simp [tw, mul_comm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.card_map_tw
statement: theorem card_map_tw (s : Multiset K) : Multiset.card (s.map tw) = Multiset.card s
proof: := by simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.segreInv_tw
statement:
theorem segreInv_tw (s : Multiset K) (t : ℕ → K)
    (h : ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.SegreInv (Multiset.card s) (fun a => s.esymm a) t) :
    ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.SegreInv (Multiset.card (s.map tw)) (fun a => (s.map tw).esymm a)
      (fun j => PowerSeries.C (t j) * PowerSeries.X ^ j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hz, hs⟩ := h
  rw [card_map_tw]
  refine ⟨fun j hj => ?_, fun m => ?_⟩
  · simp only [esymm_tw, hz j hj, map_zero, zero_mul]
  · simp only [esymm_tw]
    have : ∀ a ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
        PowerSeries.C (s.esymm a) * PowerSeries.X ^ a *
          (PowerSeries.C (t (m - a)) * PowerSeries.X ^ (m - a)) =
        PowerSeries.C (s.esymm a * t (m - a)) * PowerSeries.X ^ m := by
      intro a ha
      have ha' : a ≤ m := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp ha)
      have : (PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries K) ^ m = PowerSeries.X ^ a * PowerSeries.X ^ (m - a) := by
        rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' ha']
      rw [this, map_mul]
      ring
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl this, ← Finset.sum_mul, ← map_sum, hs m]
    by_cases hm : m = 0
    · subst hm; simp
    · simp [hm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.X_pow_dvd_sub_iff
statement:
theorem X_pow_dvd_sub_iff {D : ℕ} {f g : PowerSeries K} :
    (PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries K) ^ D ∣ f - g ↔ ∀ m < D, PowerSeries.coeff m f = PowerSeries.coeff m g
proof:
:= by
  rw [PowerSeries.X_pow_dvd_iff]
  refine forall_congr' fun m => forall_congr' fun _ => ?_
  rw [map_sub, sub_eq_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.prod_dvd_sub
statement:
theorem prod_dvd_sub {D : ℕ} {ι : Type*} (s : Multiset ι) (f g : ι → PowerSeries K)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ s, (PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries K) ^ D ∣ f x - g x) :
    (PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries K) ^ D ∣ (s.map f).prod - (s.map g).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | cons a s ih =>
    rw [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons, Multiset.prod_cons]
    have h1 := h a (Multiset.mem_cons_self a s)
    have h2 := ih fun x hx => h x (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hx)
    have : f a * (s.map f).prod - g a * (s.map g).prod =
        f a * ((s.map f).prod - (s.map g).prod) + (f a - g a) * (s.map g).prod := by ring
    rw [this]
    exact (h2.mul_left _).add (h1.mul_right _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.uT_term
statement:
theorem uT_term (q : ℚ) (j : ℕ) (a : K) :
    algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries K) q * ((-1) ^ j * (tw a) ^ j) =
      PowerSeries.C (algebraMap ℚ K q * ((-1) ^ j * a ^ j)) * PowerSeries.X ^ j
proof:
:= by
  rw [PowerSeries.algebraMap_apply]
  simp only [tw, mul_pow, map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, map_one]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.uT_tw_agree
statement:
theorem uT_tw_agree (D : ℕ) (a : K) :
    ∀ m < D, PowerSeries.coeff m (ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.uT D (tw a)) = PowerSeries.coeff m (uRoot K a)
proof:
:= by
  intro m hm
  simp only [ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.uT, uT_term, map_sum, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul,
    PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq (Finset.range D) m, if_pos (Finset.mem_range.mpr hm)]
  rw [uRoot, PowerSeries.coeff_rescale]
  simp only [uLine, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.coeff_phi_tw
statement:
theorem coeff_phi_tw (r : ℕ) (t : ℕ → K) (g : Polynomial (PowerSeries K)) (m : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff m (ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.phi r
        (fun j => PowerSeries.C (t j) * PowerSeries.X ^ j) g) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (g.natDegree + 1), gradedTerm r t g m k
proof:
:= by
  rw [phi_eq_sum, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  by_cases hk : r ≤ k
  · by_cases hkm : k - r ≤ m
    · rw [if_pos hk, gradedTerm, if_pos ⟨hk, hkm⟩, ← mul_assoc, PowerSeries.coeff_mul_X_pow',
        if_pos hkm, PowerSeries.coeff_mul_C]
    · rw [if_pos hk, gradedTerm, if_neg (by tauto), ← mul_assoc, PowerSeries.coeff_mul_X_pow',
        if_neg hkm]
  · rw [if_neg hk, gradedTerm, if_neg (by tauto), mul_zero, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.zscore_graded
statement:
theorem zscore_graded (s : Multiset K) (t : ℕ → K)
    (h : ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.SegreInv (Multiset.card s) (fun a => s.esymm a) t) (D m : ℕ)
    (hm : m < D) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range ((Gt s D).natDegree + 1), gradedTerm (Multiset.card s) t (Gt s D) m k =
      PowerSeries.coeff m (s.map (uRoot K)).prod
proof:
:= by
  have hz := ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.zscore_roots (s.map tw)
    (fun j => PowerSeries.C (t j) * PowerSeries.X ^ j) (segreInv_tw s t h) D
  rw [card_map_tw] at hz
  have h2 := congrArg (PowerSeries.coeff m) hz
  rw [coeff_phi_tw] at h2
  have hd := X_pow_dvd_sub_iff.mp
    (prod_dvd_sub s (fun a => ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.uT D (tw a)) (uRoot K)
      (fun a _ => X_pow_dvd_sub_iff.mpr (uT_tw_agree D a))) m hm
  have e : ((s.map tw).map fun z => ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.uT D z) =
      s.map fun a => ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.uT D (tw a) := Multiset.map_map _ _ _
  rw [e] at h2
  rw [← hd]
  exact h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.neg_chernOpOn'_pullback
statement:
theorem neg_chernOpOn'_pullback (hE : HasConstantRank X E (e + 1)) (a : ℕ) :
    ((-1 : ℚ) ^ a) • chernOpOn' ops cp hP ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj E) (e + 1)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback S.Y S.q E (e + 1) hE) a =
      F.φ ((nroots F).esymm a)
proof:
:= by
  have hGq := hasConstantRank_pullback S.Y S.q E (e + 1) hE
  have hc : chernOpOn' ops cp hP ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj E) (e + 1) hGq a =
      F.φ ((rts F e).esymm a) := by
    have := congrFun (constRankChernAssignOn'_eq ops cp hP _ (e + 1) hGq) a
    rw [← this]
    exact chern_pullback_esymm cp hP hnat H F a
  rw [hc, phi_esymm_nroots]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1C.tdNinvOp_flag
statement:
theorem tdNinvOp_flag (hE : HasConstantRank X E (e + 1)) (m : ℕ) :

        (hasConstantRank_pullback S.Y S.q E (e + 1) hE)) m =
      F.φ (PowerSeries.coeff m ((nroots F).map (uRoot F.K)).prod)

statement:

    [(i ≫ toSpec k n).IsOver (Spk k)] [(toSpec k n).IsOver (Spk k)] [IsNoetherian (space k n)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.over_isIso_of_restrictFunctor_map_isIso
statement:
theorem over_isIso_of_restrictFunctor_map_isIso
    {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    {M N : Z.Modules} (a : M ⟶ N)
    [IsIso ((restrictFunctor f).map a)] : IsIso (a.over f.opensRange)
proof:
:= by
  let e : restrictFunctor f.opensRange.ι ≅
      restrictFunctor f ⋙ restrictFunctor f.isoOpensRange.inv :=
    restrictFunctorCongr f.isoOpensRange_inv_comp.symm ≪≫
      restrictFunctorComp f.isoOpensRange.inv f
  haveI : IsIso (e.hom.app M) := inferInstance
  haveI : IsIso ((restrictFunctor f.isoOpensRange.inv).map ((restrictFunctor f).map a)) := inferInstance
  have hn := e.hom.naturality a
  haveI : IsIso ((restrictFunctor f.opensRange.ι).map a ≫ e.hom.app N) := by
    rw [hn]
    simp only [Functor.comp_map]
    infer_instance
  haveI : IsIso ((restrictFunctor f.opensRange.ι).map a) :=
    IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right _ (e.hom.app N)
  exact (SchemeKTheory.over_isIso_iff_restrictFunctor_map_isIso f.opensRange a).2
    inferInstance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_restrictFunctor_cover
statement:
theorem isIso_of_restrictFunctor_cover
    {Z : Scheme.{u}} {I : Type v} (Y : I → Scheme.{u})
    (f : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ Z) [∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (f i)]
    (hcover : (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z).CoversTop (fun i => (f i).opensRange))
    {M N : Z.Modules} (a : M ⟶ N)
    (h : ∀ i, IsIso ((restrictFunctor (f i)).map a)) : IsIso a
proof:
:= by
  apply SchemeKTheory.moduleHom_isIso_of_over_cover a (fun i => (f i).opensRange) hcover
  intro i
  haveI := h i
  exact over_isIso_of_restrictFunctor_map_isIso (f i) a

      (fun i : C.I => ((C.union C').chartι (Sum.inl i)).opensRange)

    (fun i : C.I => ((C.union C').chartι (Sum.inl i)).opensRange)).2

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.unionTwistToPushedInl_restrictionProjection
statement:
theorem unionTwistToPushedInl_restrictionProjection
    (C C' : AffineFrameCover X E) (d : ℤ) (i : C.I) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ((C.union C').chartι (Sum.inl i))).map
        (C.unionTwistToPushedInl C' d) ≫
      (C.unionInl_restrictPushedIso C' i (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf d)).hom ≫
        C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionProjection d i =
      (C.union C').canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionProjection d (Sum.inl i)
proof:
:= by
  let D := (C.union C').twistingSheafDescentData d
    ((C.union C').canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d)
  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (D.toAmbient (Sum.inl i)) := by
    change IsOpenImmersion ((C.union C').chartι (Sum.inl i))
    infer_instance
  haveI : IsOpenImmersion ((D.reindex Sum.inl).toAmbient i) := by
    change IsOpenImmersion ((C.union C').chartι (Sum.inl i))
    infer_instance
  unfold unionTwistToPushedInl
  rw [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc,
    C.unionDescentInl_restrictionProjection_square C' d i]
  exact D.descendedToReindex_restrictionProjection Sum.inl i

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.a11Theta_linearForm_basis
statement:
theorem a11Theta_linearForm_basis (l : ι) :

proof:
:= by
