name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.a11Lift_algebraMap
statement:
theorem a11Lift_algebraMap (y : SymmetricAlgebra R M) :
    a11Lift R M b k (algebraMap (SymmetricAlgebra R M)
      (Localization.Away (linearForm R M (b k))) y) = a11Theta R M b k y
proof:
:=
  IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq (linearForm R M (b k)) (a11Theta_unit R M b k) y

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.a11Lift_val_ratio
statement:
theorem a11Lift_val_ratio (m : M) :
    a11Lift R M b k (HomogeneousLocalization.val (tautChart_ratio R M (b k) m)) =
      a11Theta R M b k (linearForm R M m)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : HomogeneousLocalization.val (tautChart_ratio R M (b k) m) *
      algebraMap (SymmetricAlgebra R M) (Localization.Away (linearForm R M (b k)))
        (linearForm R M (b k)) =
      algebraMap (SymmetricAlgebra R M) (Localization.Away (linearForm R M (b k)))
        (linearForm R M m) := by
    simp only [tautChart_ratio, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk]
    rw [← Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap, ← Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap,
      Localization.mk_mul, Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    simp [mul_comm]
  have h2 := congrArg (a11Lift R M b k) h1
  rw [map_mul] at h2
  have hl : ∀ y, a11Lift R M b k (algebraMap (SymmetricAlgebra R M)
      (Localization.Away (linearForm R M (b k))) y) = a11Theta R M b k y := fun y =>
    IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq (linearForm R M (b k)) (a11Theta_unit R M b k) y
  have hk := a11Theta_linearForm_basis R M b k k
  simp only [if_true] at hk
  rw [hl, hl, hk, mul_one] at h2
  exact h2

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.a11Lift_val_scalar
statement:
theorem a11Lift_val_scalar (a : R) :
    a11Lift R M b k (HomogeneousLocalization.val (tautChart_scalarHom R M (b k) a)) =
      MvPolynomial.C a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tautChart_scalarHom, RingHom.comp_apply]
  change a11Lift R M b k (HomogeneousLocalization.val (HomogeneousLocalization.mk
    ⟨0, ((degreeZeroAlgEquiv (R := R) (M := M)).symm a : symGrading R M 0), 1, one_mem _⟩)) = _
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mk, tautChart_degreeZero_symm_val]
  have : (Localization.mk (algebraMap R (SymmetricAlgebra R M) a)
      (⟨1, one_mem _⟩ : Submonoid.powers (linearForm R M (b k)))) =
      algebraMap (SymmetricAlgebra R M) (Localization.Away (linearForm R M (b k)))
        (algebraMap R (SymmetricAlgebra R M) a) := by
    rw [← Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap]; rfl
  refine (congrArg (a11Lift R M b k) this).trans ?_
  rw [a11Lift_algebraMap, a11Theta_algebraMap]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.a11F_mul_term
statement:
theorem a11F_mul_term (a : R) (i : ι) :
    a11F R M b k (tautChart_scalarHom R M (b k) a * tautChart_ratio R M (b k) (b i)) =
      MvPolynomial.C a * (if i = k then (1 : MvPolynomial ι R) else MvPolynomial.X i)
proof:
:= by
  change a11Lift R M b k (HomogeneousLocalization.val
    (tautChart_scalarHom R M (b k) a * tautChart_ratio R M (b k) (b i))) = _
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul, map_mul, a11Lift_val_scalar, a11Lift_val_ratio,
    a11Theta_linearForm_basis]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.a11_coeff_term
statement:
theorem a11_coeff_term (a : R) (i : ι) (m : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    MvPolynomial.coeff m (MvPolynomial.C a *
      (if i = k then (1 : MvPolynomial ι R) else MvPolynomial.X i)) =
      if i = k then (if m = 0 then a else 0) else (if Finsupp.single i 1 = m then a else 0)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i = k
  · simp only [hi, if_true, MvPolynomial.coeff_C_mul, MvPolynomial.coeff_one]
    by_cases hm : m = 0
    · simp [hm]
    · simp [hm, Ne.symm hm]
  · simp only [hi, if_false, MvPolynomial.coeff_C_mul, MvPolynomial.coeff_X]
    by_cases hm : Finsupp.single i 1 = m <;> simp [hm]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.a11_ratio_independent
statement:
theorem a11_ratio_independent (l : ι →₀ R)
    (h : l.sum (fun i a => tautChart_scalarHom R M (b k) a *
      tautChart_ratio R M (b k) (b i)) = 0) : l = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := congrArg (a11F R M b k) h
  rw [map_zero, map_finsuppSum] at h1
  simp only [a11F_mul_term] at h1
  ext j
  rw [Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
  have h2 := congrArg (MvPolynomial.coeff (if j = k then (0 : ι →₀ ℕ) else Finsupp.single j 1)) h1
  rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_zero, Finsupp.sum, MvPolynomial.coeff_sum] at h2
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j] at h2
  · rw [a11_coeff_term] at h2
    by_cases hj : j = k
    · simpa [hj] using h2
    · simpa [hj] using h2
  · intro i _ hij
    rw [a11_coeff_term]
    by_cases hj : j = k
    · subst hj
      by_cases hik : i = j
      · exact absurd hik hij
      · simp [hik, Finsupp.single_eq_zero]
    · by_cases hik : i = k
      · simp [hik, hj, Finsupp.single_eq_zero]
      · simp [hik, hj, Finsupp.single_left_inj, hij]
  · intro hnot
    simp [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hnot]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_kernel_arrow_equiv
statement:
theorem rankTwo_kernel_arrow_equiv {R S A B : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (f : R →+* S) (g : A →+* B) (e : A ≃+* R) (h : B ≃+* S)
    (comm : ∀ a, f (e a) = h (g a)) :
    RingHom.ker f = (RingHom.ker g).map e.toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (RingHom.ker f).comap e.toRingHom = RingHom.ker g := by
    ext a
    change f (e a) = 0 ↔ g a = 0
    rw [comm]
    exact h.map_eq_zero_iff
  rw [← hc]
  exact (Ideal.map_comap_eq_self_of_equiv e (RingHom.ker f)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_regular_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem rankTwo_regular_ringEquiv {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (e : R ≃+* S) {a : R} (ha : IsRegular a) : IsRegular (e a)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x y h
    apply e.symm.injective
    apply ha.left
    simpa only [map_mul, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using congrArg e.symm h
  · intro x y h
    apply e.symm.injective
    apply ha.right
    simpa only [map_mul, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using congrArg e.symm h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_principalChart_ringSquare
statement:
theorem rankTwo_principalChart_ringSquare :
    (rankTwo_principalChart_targetRingIso c).hom ≫ (pullback.snd f t).appTop =
      CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {c.equation})) ≫
        (rankTwo_principalChart_sourceRingIso c).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hc := congrArg (fun a => Scheme.Hom.appTop a) c.commutes
  simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop] at hc
  dsimp only [rankTwo_principalChart_targetRingIso, rankTwo_principalChart_sourceRingIso,
    Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.op_hom]
  change (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of c.R)).inv ≫ c.targetIso.hom.appTop ≫
    (pullback.snd f t).appTop = _
  rw [← hc]
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality]
  exact Category.assoc _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_principalChart_appTop_kernel
statement:
theorem rankTwo_principalChart_appTop_kernel :
    RingHom.ker (pullback.snd f t).appTop.hom =
      (Ideal.span {c.equation}).map
        (rankTwo_principalChart_targetRingIso c).hom.hom
proof:
:= by
  have hsq := rankTwo_principalChart_ringSquare c
  have hk := rankTwo_kernel_arrow_equiv
    (pullback.snd f t).appTop.hom
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {c.equation}))
    (rankTwo_principalChart_targetRingIso c).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
    (rankTwo_principalChart_sourceRingIso c).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
    (fun a => congrArg (fun h : CommRingCat.of c.R ⟶ Γ(pullback f t, ⊤) => h.hom a) hsq)
  rw [Ideal.mk_ker] at hk
  exact hk

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_principalChart_appTop_kernel_span
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankTwo_principalChart_appTop_kernel c, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_principalChart_kernel_ideal_top
statement:
theorem rankTwo_principalChart_kernel_ideal_top [QuasiCompact f] :
    letI : IsAffine U
proof:
:= IsAffine.of_isIso c.targetIso.hom
    (pullback.snd f t).ker.ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top U⟩ =
      Ideal.span {(rankTwo_principalChart_targetRingIso c).hom.hom c.equation} := by
  letI : IsAffine U := IsAffine.of_isIso c.targetIso.hom
  haveI : QuasiCompact (pullback.snd f t) := inferInstance
  rw [Scheme.Hom.ker_apply]
  exact rankTwo_principalChart_appTop_kernel_span c

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_principalChart_global_kernel_principal
statement:
theorem rankTwo_principalChart_global_kernel_principal [QuasiCompact f] :
    letI : IsAffine U
proof:
:= IsAffine.of_isIso c.targetIso.hom
    ∃ a : Γ(X, t ''ᵁ (⊤ : U.Opens)),
      f.ker.ideal ⟨t ''ᵁ (⊤ : U.Opens), (isAffineOpen_top U).image_of_isOpenImmersion t⟩ =
        Ideal.span {a} := by
  letI : IsAffine U := IsAffine.of_isIso c.targetIso.hom
  let W : U.affineOpens := ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top U⟩
  have h := Scheme.ker_ideal_of_isPullback_of_isOpenImmersion
    f (pullback.snd f t) (pullback.fst f t) t (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f t).flip W
  have hc := rankTwo_principalChart_kernel_ideal_top c
  have hspan : (f.ker.ideal ⟨t ''ᵁ W, W.2.image_of_isOpenImmersion t⟩).comap
      (t.appIso W).inv.hom =
      Ideal.span {(rankTwo_principalChart_targetRingIso c).hom.hom c.equation} := h.symm.trans hc
  have hm := congrArg (Ideal.map (t.appIso W).inv.hom) hspan
  have hcancel : Ideal.map (t.appIso W).inv.hom
      ((f.ker.ideal ⟨t ''ᵁ W, W.2.image_of_isOpenImmersion t⟩).comap
        (t.appIso W).inv.hom) = f.ker.ideal ⟨t ''ᵁ W, W.2.image_of_isOpenImmersion t⟩ :=
    Ideal.map_comap_eq_self_of_equiv (t.appIso W).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv _
  rw [hcancel, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton] at hm
  exact ⟨_, hm⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_principalChart_global_kernel_regular
statement:
theorem rankTwo_principalChart_global_kernel_regular [QuasiCompact f] (hr : IsRegular c.equation) :
    letI : IsAffine U
proof:
:= IsAffine.of_isIso c.targetIso.hom
    ∃ a : Γ(X, t ''ᵁ (⊤ : U.Opens)),
      f.ker.ideal ⟨t ''ᵁ (⊤ : U.Opens), (isAffineOpen_top U).image_of_isOpenImmersion t⟩ =
        Ideal.span {a} ∧ IsRegular a := by
  letI : IsAffine U := IsAffine.of_isIso c.targetIso.hom
  let W : U.affineOpens := ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top U⟩
  have h := Scheme.ker_ideal_of_isPullback_of_isOpenImmersion
    f (pullback.snd f t) (pullback.fst f t) t (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f t).flip W
  have hc := rankTwo_principalChart_kernel_ideal_top c
  have hspan : (f.ker.ideal ⟨t ''ᵁ W, W.2.image_of_isOpenImmersion t⟩).comap
      (t.appIso W).inv.hom =
      Ideal.span {(rankTwo_principalChart_targetRingIso c).hom.hom c.equation} := h.symm.trans hc
  have hm := congrArg (Ideal.map (t.appIso W).inv.hom) hspan
  have hcancel : Ideal.map (t.appIso W).inv.hom
      ((f.ker.ideal ⟨t ''ᵁ W, W.2.image_of_isOpenImmersion t⟩).comap
        (t.appIso W).inv.hom) = f.ker.ideal ⟨t ''ᵁ W, W.2.image_of_isOpenImmersion t⟩ :=
    Ideal.map_comap_eq_self_of_equiv (t.appIso W).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv _
  rw [hcancel, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton] at hm
  refine ⟨_, hm, ?_⟩
  exact rankTwo_regular_ringEquiv (t.appIso W).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
    (rankTwo_regular_ringEquiv (rankTwo_principalChart_targetRingIso c).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv hr)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D16.pf_apply_congr
statement:
theorem pf_apply_congr (g : V ⟶ W) [QuasiCompact g] (D E : AlgebraicCycle V ℤ) (y : W)
    (h : ∀ x, g x = y → D x = E x) : properPushforward g D y = properPushforward g E y
proof:
:= by
  set T := (g.preimageSupportFinite D y).toFinset ∪ (g.preimageSupportFinite E y).toFinset
  have hT : ∀ F : AlgebraicCycle V ℤ, (∀ x, g x = y → F x ≠ 0 → D x ≠ 0) →
      ∀ x, g x = y → F x ≠ 0 → x ∈ T := by
    intro F hF x hx hFx
    exact Finset.mem_union_left _
      ((mem_preimageSupportFinite_toFinset_iff g D y x).mpr ⟨hx, hF x hx hFx⟩)
  rw [properPushforward_apply_eq_sum_of_subset g D y T (hT D (fun x _ hx ↦ hx)),
    properPushforward_apply_eq_sum_of_subset g E y T (hT E (fun x hx hFx ↦ by
      rw [h x hx]; exact hFx))]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x hx
  rw [h x (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D16.ord_pow_eq'
statement:
theorem ord_pow_eq' {y : W} (hy : coheight y = 1) {f : W.functionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    Scheme.ord (f ^ n) y = n * Scheme.ord f y
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [Scheme.ord_eq_iff hy one_ne_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, Scheme.ord_mul hy (pow_ne_zero _ hf) hf, ih]
    push_cast
    ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D16.pf_div_ffHom_ne
statement:
theorem pf_div_ffHom_ne (hdeg : g.degree (genericPoint V) ≠ 0) (u : W.functionField)
    (hu : u ≠ 0) :
    properPushforward g (div ((ffHom g).hom u)) = (g.degree (genericPoint V) : ℤ) • div u
proof:
:= by
  letI := ffAlgebra g
  haveI := finiteDimensional_of_degree g hdeg
  have hr : (ffHom g).hom u ≠ 0 := (map_ne_zero _).mpr hu
  have hcodim : ∀ w : V, coheight w = 1 → g.degree w ≠ 0 → coheight (g w) = 1 :=
    fun w hw hwd ↦ coheight_map_eq_one_of_finiteType (k := k) g hdeg w hw hwd
  rw [properPushforward_div_eq_div_norm g _ hr hdeg hcodim]
  ext y
  have hN : Algebra.norm W.functionField ((ffHom g).hom u) = u ^ g.degree (genericPoint V) := by
    have := Algebra.norm_algebraMap (R := W.functionField) (S := V.functionField) u
    rw [finrank_functionField_eq_degree g] at this
    exact this
  by_cases hy : coheight y = 1
  · change AlgebraicGeometry.div (Algebra.norm W.functionField ((ffHom g).hom u)) y =
      (g.degree (genericPoint V) : ℤ) * div u y
    rw [hN, div_eq_ord, div_eq_ord, ord_pow_eq' hy hu]
  · change AlgebraicGeometry.div (Algebra.norm W.functionField ((ffHom g).hom u)) y =
      (g.degree (genericPoint V) : ℤ) * div u y
    rw [div_eq_ord, div_eq_ord, Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hy,
      Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hy, mul_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D16.pf_div_ffHom_zero
statement:
theorem pf_div_ffHom_zero (hdeg : g.degree (genericPoint V) = 0) (u : W.functionField)
    (hu : u ≠ 0) : properPushforward g (div ((ffHom g).hom u)) = 0
proof:
:=
  properPushforward_div_eq_zero_of_degree_eq_zero k g _ ((map_ne_zero _).mpr hu) hdeg
    (D7.genericFibreDegreeZero_of_proper g _ ((map_ne_zero _).mpr hu))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D16.transition_pullback_eq
statement:
theorem transition_pullback_eq {w1 : W} (d : LineBundleLocalData W M w1) (z : V) (hz : g z ∈ d.U) :
    ((pullbackFrame g c v0 hv0).regularTransitionFunction (pullbackFrame g d z hz)) =
      (ffHom g).hom (c.regularTransitionFunction d)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty ↥(c.U ⊓ d.U) := ⟨⟨genericPoint W, c.genericPoint_mem, d.genericPoint_mem⟩⟩
  haveI inst2 : Nonempty ↥(g ⁻¹ᵁ (c.U ⊓ d.U)) := ⟨⟨genericPoint V, by
    change g (genericPoint V) ∈ c.U ⊓ d.U
    rw [map_genericPoint g]; exact ⟨c.genericPoint_mem, d.genericPoint_mem⟩⟩⟩
  change algebraMap _ V.functionField _ = (ffHom g).hom (W.germToFunctionField _ _)
  rw [transitionSection_pullbackFrame g c d v0 z hv0 hz,
    @ffHom_germ V W g _ _ _ (c.U ⊓ d.U) _ (g ⁻¹ᵁ (c.U ⊓ d.U)) inst2 le_rfl,
    Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D16.weil_coeff_fibre
statement:
theorem weil_coeff_fibre (y : W) (z : V) (hz : g z = y) :
    (lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hN hrN ((pullbackFrame g c v0 hv0).mapIso e)).1 z =
      div ((ffHom g).hom (c.regularTransitionFunction
        (lineBundleLocalDataAt W M hM hrM y))) z
proof:
:= by
  set d := lineBundleLocalDataAt W M hM hrM y with hd
  have hzd : g z ∈ d.U := hz ▸ d.mem
  rw [lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame_apply,
    lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame_eq_on_localData hN hrN _
      ((pullbackFrame g d z hzd).mapIso e) z hzd,
    LineBundleLocalData.regularTransitionFunction_mapIso, transition_pullback_eq g c hv0 d z hzd,
    div_eq_ord]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D16.weil_coeff_W
statement:
theorem weil_coeff_W (y : W) :
    (lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hM hrM c).1 y =
      div (c.regularTransitionFunction (lineBundleLocalDataAt W M hM hrM y)) y
proof:
:= by
  rw [lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame_apply,
    lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame_eq_on_localData hM hrM c
      (lineBundleLocalDataAt W M hM hrM y) y (lineBundleLocalDataAt W M hM hrM y).mem,
    div_eq_ord]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D16.pf_weil_pullbackFrame_ne
statement:
theorem pf_weil_pullbackFrame_ne (hdeg : g.degree (genericPoint V) ≠ 0) :
    properPushforward g (lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hN hrN
        ((pullbackFrame g c v0 hv0).mapIso e)).1 =
      (g.degree (genericPoint V) : ℤ) • (lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hM hrM c).1
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  have hu : c.regularTransitionFunction (lineBundleLocalDataAt W M hM hrM y) ≠ 0 :=
    c.regularTransitionFunction_ne_zero _
  rw [pf_apply_congr g _ (div ((ffHom g).hom (c.regularTransitionFunction
      (lineBundleLocalDataAt W M hM hrM y)))) y
      (fun z hz ↦ weil_coeff_fibre g hM hrM c e hN hrN hv0 y z hz)]
  have h1 := congrArg (fun D : AlgebraicCycle W ℤ ↦ D y)
    (pf_div_ffHom_ne k g hdeg _ hu)
  refine h1.trans ?_
  change (g.degree (genericPoint V) : ℤ) * div _ y = (g.degree (genericPoint V) : ℤ) * _
  rw [weil_coeff_W hM hrM c y]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D16.pf_weil_pullbackFrame_zero
statement:
theorem pf_weil_pullbackFrame_zero (hdeg : g.degree (genericPoint V) = 0) :
    properPushforward g (lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hN hrN
        ((pullbackFrame g c v0 hv0).mapIso e)).1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  have hu : c.regularTransitionFunction (lineBundleLocalDataAt W M hM hrM y) ≠ 0 :=
    c.regularTransitionFunction_ne_zero _
  rw [pf_apply_congr g _ (div ((ffHom g).hom (c.regularTransitionFunction
      (lineBundleLocalDataAt W M hM hrM y)))) y
      (fun z hz ↦ weil_coeff_fibre g hM hrM c e hN hrN hv0 y z hz)]
  exact congrArg (fun D : AlgebraicCycle W ℤ ↦ D y) (pf_div_ffHom_zero k g hdeg _ hu)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D16.exists_factor
statement:
theorem exists_factor (f : X ⟶ Y) (v : X) :
    ∃ g : pointClosureScheme v ⟶ pointClosureScheme (f v),
      g ≫ pointClosureι (f v) = pointClosureι v ≫ f
proof:
:= by
  have H : pointClosureIdeal (f v) ≤ (pointClosureIdeal v).map f := by
    unfold pointClosureIdeal pointClosure
    rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.map_vanishingIdeal]
    apply Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal_antimono
    rw [TopologicalSpace.Closeds.closure_le]
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hx
    have : f y ∈ closure {f v} := by
      have := image_closure_subset_closure_image f.continuous (s := {v}) ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      simpa using this
    exact this
  exact ⟨Scheme.IdealSheafData.subschemeMap _ _ f H,
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.subschemeMap_subschemeι _ _ f H⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D16.pf_prime_apply
statement:
theorem pf_prime_apply (m : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = m) (y : Y) :
    properPushforward f (dimPrimeCycle v m hv).1 y =
      if f v = y then (f.degree v : ℤ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [properPushforward_apply_eq_sum_of_subset f _ y {v} (fun x hx hne ↦ by
    rw [m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply] at hne
    by_cases hxv : x = v
    · simp [hxv]
    · exact absurd (if_neg hxv) hne)]
  rw [Finset.filter_singleton]
  by_cases hy : f v = y
  · simp [hy, m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply]
  · simp [hy]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D16.capPushGate
statement: theorem capPushGate : CapPushGate (k := k) f L hL
proof:
:= by
  intro n v hv D' hD'
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := exists_factor f v
  letI : (pointClosureScheme v).Over (Spk k) := ⟨pointClosureι v ≫ X ↘ Spk k⟩
  letI : (pointClosureScheme (f v)).Over (Spk k) := ⟨pointClosureι (f v) ≫ Y ↘ Spk k⟩
  haveI : (pointClosureι v).IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨rfl⟩
  haveI : (pointClosureι (f v)).IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨rfl⟩
  haveI : g.IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨by
    change g ≫ pointClosureι (f v) ≫ Y ↘ Spk k = pointClosureι v ≫ X ↘ Spk k
    rw [← Category.assoc, hg, Category.assoc, CategoryTheory.comp_over (f := f) (S := Spk k)]⟩
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType ((pointClosureScheme v) ↘ Spk k) := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (pointClosureι v ≫ X ↘ Spk k)
    infer_instance
  haveI : IsProper (g ≫ pointClosureι (f v)) := by rw [hg]; infer_instance
  haveI : IsProper g := IsProper.of_comp g (pointClosureι (f v))
  have hηv : pointClosureι v (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v)) = v := by
    rw [← pointClosureGenericPoint_eq_genericPoint, pointClosureι_genericPoint]
  have hηw : pointClosureι (f v) (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme (f v))) = f v := by
    rw [← pointClosureGenericPoint_eq_genericPoint, pointClosureι_genericPoint]
  have hgen : g (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v)) = genericPoint (pointClosureScheme (f v)) := by
    apply (pointClosureι (f v)).isClosedEmbedding.injective
    rw [hηw, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hg, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hηv]
  haveI : IsDominant g := isDominant_of_map_genericPoint g hgen
  
  have hM := isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL (f v)
  have hrM := genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one L hL (f v)
  let c := Classical.choice (Scheme.Modules.exists_lineBundleLocalDataAt
    (pointClosureScheme (f v)) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι (f v))).obj L) hM hrM
    (pointClosureGenericPoint (f v)))
  have hc0 : g (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v)) ∈ c.U := by
    rw [hgen, ← pointClosureGenericPoint_eq_genericPoint]; exact c.mem
  have hL' := hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL
  have hN := isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L) hL' v
  have hrN := genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L) hL' v
  let e : (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι (f v))).obj L) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L) :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g (pointClosureι (f v))).app L ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr hg).app L ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (pointClosureι v) f).app L).symm
  let b := (pullbackFrame g c (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v)) hc0).mapIso e
  have hcyc : properPushforward f (D5.primeCycleOfFrame (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
      hL' n v hv b).1 = properPushforward (pointClosureι (f v))
        (properPushforward g (lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hN hrN b).1) := by
    change properPushforward f (properPushforward (pointClosureι v) _) = _
    rw [← properPushforward_comp, properPushforward_congr hg.symm, properPushforward_comp]
  have hdegf : f.degree v = g.degree (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v)) := by
    have h1 := hom_degree_comp (pointClosureι v) f (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v))
    have h2 := hom_degree_comp g (pointClosureι (f v)) (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v))
    rw [hg] at h2
    rw [hηv, Scheme.Hom.degree_eq_one_of_isClosedImmersion (pointClosureι v), one_mul] at h1
    rw [Scheme.Hom.degree_eq_one_of_isClosedImmersion (pointClosureι (f v)), mul_one] at h2
    exact h1.symm.trans h2
  rw [D5.primeCap_eq (k := k) _ hL' n v hv b, D9.properPushforwardDimChowD9_mk]
  by_cases hdeg : g.degree (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v)) = 0
  · have hz : D' = 0 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [hD']
      ext y
      rw [pf_prime_apply]
      have : f.degree v = 0 := hdegf.trans hdeg
      simp [this]
    rw [hz, map_zero]
    have h0 : (⟨properPushforward f (D5.primeCycleOfFrame (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
        hL' n v hv b).1, properPushforward_mem_dimensionCycles f
          (heightCompatible_of_finiteType k f) (D5.primeCycleOfFrame (k := k)
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L) hL' n v hv b).2⟩ : dimensionCycles Y n) = 0 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change properPushforward f _ = 0
      rw [hcyc, pf_weil_pullbackFrame_zero k g hM hrM c e hN hrN hc0 hdeg, properPushforward_zero]
    rw [h0]
    rfl
  · have hdf : f.degree v ≠ 0 := by rw [hdegf]; exact hdeg
    have hw : height (f v) = n + 1 := by
      rw [heightCompatible_of_finiteType k f v hdf, hv]
    have hP : D5.primeCap (k := k) L hL n (f v) hw =
        QuotientAddGroup.mk (D5.primeCycleOfFrame (k := k) L hL n (f v) hw c) :=
      D5.primeCap_eq (k := k) L hL n (f v) hw c
    have hcyc2 : (⟨properPushforward f (D5.primeCycleOfFrame (k := k)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L) hL' n v hv b).1, properPushforward_mem_dimensionCycles f
          (heightCompatible_of_finiteType k f) (D5.primeCycleOfFrame (k := k)
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L) hL' n v hv b).2⟩ : dimensionCycles Y n) =
        ((g.degree (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v)) : ℕ) : ℤ) •
          D5.primeCycleOfFrame (k := k) L hL n (f v) hw c := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change properPushforward f _ = ((g.degree (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v)) : ℕ) : ℤ) •
        properPushforward (pointClosureι (f v)) _
      rw [hcyc, pf_weil_pullbackFrame_ne k g hM hrM c e hN hrN hc0 hdeg]
      exact map_zsmul (properPushforwardHom (pointClosureι (f v))) _ _
    have hD'2 : D' = ((g.degree (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v)) : ℕ) : ℤ) •
        dimPrimeCycle (f v) (n + 1) hw := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [hD']
      ext y
      rw [pf_prime_apply]
      change _ = ((g.degree (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v)) : ℕ) : ℤ) *
        (dimPrimeCycle (f v) (n + 1) hw).1 y
      rw [m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply, hdegf]
      by_cases hy : f v = y
      · subst hy; simp
      · rw [if_neg hy, if_neg (Ne.symm hy)]; simp
    rw [hcyc2, hD'2, map_zsmul, D5.capCycles_dimPrimeCycle, hP]
    exact map_zsmul (QuotientAddGroup.mk' _) _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D16.cap_push_D16
statement:
theorem cap_push_D16 :
    totalPush ops f ∘ₗ
        totalCap ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
          (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) =
      totalCap ops L hL ∘ₗ totalPush ops f
proof:
:=
  cap_push_of_gate (k := k) f L hL ops (capPushGate (k := k) f L hL)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.gradedAlgebra_ext
statement:
theorem gradedAlgebra_ext
    {S A : Type u} [CommRing S] [CommRing A] [Algebra S A]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → Submodule S A) (x y : GradedAlgebra 𝒜) :
    x = y
proof:
:= by
  cases x
  cases y
  congr
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.mem_gradingOfBasisIndex_iff
statement:
theorem mem_gradingOfBasisIndex_iff (b : Module.Basis ι R M) {d : ℕ}
    {x : SymmetricAlgebra R M} :
    x ∈ gradingOfBasisIndex b d ↔
      SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b x ∈
        MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule ι R d
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    simpa using hp
  · intro hp
    refine ⟨SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b x, hp, ?_⟩
    exact (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm_apply_apply x

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem symGrading_apply (d : ℕ) :
    symGrading R M d =
      LinearMap.range
        (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M : M →ₗ[R] SymmetricAlgebra R M) ^ d
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.gradingOfBasisIndex_eq_symGrading
statement:
theorem gradingOfBasisIndex_eq_symGrading (b : Module.Basis ι R M) :
    gradingOfBasisIndex b = symGrading R M
proof:
:= by
  funext d
  rw [gradingOfBasisIndex]
  change Submodule.map (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm.toLinearMap
      (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule ι R d) = _
  rw [← MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule_one_pow]
  calc
    Submodule.map (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm.toLinearMap
        (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule ι R 1 ^ d) =
      (Submodule.map (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm.toLinearMap
        (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule ι R 1)) ^ d :=
          Submodule.map_pow
            (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule ι R 1)
            (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm.toAlgHom d
    _ = LinearMap.range
        (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M : M →ₗ[R] SymmetricAlgebra R M) ^ d := by
      rw [MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule_one_eq_span_X,
        Submodule.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
      change Submodule.span R (Set.range fun i : ι ↦
          (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm (MvPolynomial.X i)) ^ d = _
      rw [show (fun i : ι ↦
          (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm (MvPolynomial.X i)) =
            fun i ↦ SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M (b i) by
          funext i
          exact SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial_symm_X b i]
      calc
        Submodule.span R (Set.range fun i ↦ SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M (b i)) ^ d =
            ((Submodule.span R (Set.range b)).map
              (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M)) ^ d := by
          rw [Submodule.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
          simp only [Function.comp_def]
        _ = ((⊤ : Submodule R M).map (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M)) ^ d := by
          rw [b.span_eq]
        _ = LinearMap.range
            (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M : M →ₗ[R] SymmetricAlgebra R M) ^ d := by
          rw [LinearMap.range_eq_map]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.componentEquivIndex_symm_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem componentEquivIndex_symm_apply_coe
    (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (d : ℕ)
    (y : MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule ι R d) :
    ((componentEquivIndex b d).symm y : SymmetricAlgebra R M) =
      (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm y
proof:
:=

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.componentEquivIndexLmap_comp_symm
statement:
theorem componentEquivIndexLmap_comp_symm (b : Module.Basis ι R M) :
    componentEquivIndexLmap b ∘ₗ componentEquivIndexSymmLmap b =
      LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  ext d y
  simp [componentEquivIndexLmap, componentEquivIndexSymmLmap,
    DirectSum.lmap_lof]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.componentEquivIndexSymmLmap_comp
statement:
theorem componentEquivIndexSymmLmap_comp (b : Module.Basis ι R M) :
    componentEquivIndexSymmLmap b ∘ₗ componentEquivIndexLmap b =

proof:
:= by

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.coeLinearMap_comp_componentEquivIndexSymmLmap
statement:
theorem coeLinearMap_comp_componentEquivIndexSymmLmap
    (b : Module.Basis ι R M) :
    DirectSum.coeLinearMap (gradingOfBasisIndex b) ∘ₗ
        componentEquivIndexSymmLmap b =
      (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        DirectSum.coeLinearMap (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule ι R)
proof:
:= by
  ext d y
  simp [componentEquivIndexSymmLmap, DirectSum.lmap_lof]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.coeLinearMap_comp_decomposeOfBasisIndex
statement:
theorem coeLinearMap_comp_decomposeOfBasisIndex (b : Module.Basis ι R M) :
    DirectSum.coeLinearMap (gradingOfBasisIndex b) ∘ₗ
        decomposeOfBasisIndex b = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  rw [decomposeOfBasisIndex, ← LinearMap.comp_assoc, ← LinearMap.comp_assoc,
    coeLinearMap_comp_componentEquivIndexSymmLmap]
  ext x
  change (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm
      (DirectSum.coeLinearMap (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule ι R)
        ((DirectSum.decomposeLinearEquiv
          (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule ι R))
          ((SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b) x))) = x
  trans (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm
    ((SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b) x)
  · congr 1
    exact (DirectSum.decomposeLinearEquiv
      (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule ι R)).left_inv
      ((SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b) x)
  · exact (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm_apply_apply x

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.decomposeOfBasisIndex_comp_coeLinearMap
statement:
theorem decomposeOfBasisIndex_comp_coeLinearMap (b : Module.Basis ι R M) :
    decomposeOfBasisIndex b ∘ₗ
        DirectSum.coeLinearMap (gradingOfBasisIndex b) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  ext d x : 2
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply,
    DirectSum.coeLinearMap_lof, decomposeOfBasisIndex,
    componentEquivIndexSymmLmap]
  rw [show (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).toLinearMap
      (x : SymmetricAlgebra R M) = (componentEquivIndex b d x).1 from rfl]
  simp only [LinearEquiv.coe_toLinearMap]
  rw [DirectSum.decomposeLinearEquiv_apply_coe
    (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule ι R) d
    (componentEquivIndex b d x)]
  simp [DirectSum.lmap_lof]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.algebraMap_mem_gradingOfBasisIndex_zero
statement:
theorem algebraMap_mem_gradingOfBasisIndex_zero
    (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (r : R) :
    algebraMap R (SymmetricAlgebra R M) r ∈ gradingOfBasisIndex b 0
proof:
:= by
  refine (mem_gradingOfBasisIndex_iff b).mpr ?_
  rw [(SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).commutes r]
  exact MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_C (σ := ι) r

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.degreeZeroRingEquivOfBasisIndex_commutes
statement:
theorem degreeZeroRingEquivOfBasisIndex_commutes
    (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (r : R) :
    degreeZeroRingEquivOfBasisIndex b
        (algebraMap R (gradingOfBasisIndex b 0) r) =
      algebraMap R (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule ι R 0) r
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b
      (algebraMap R (SymmetricAlgebra R M) r) = MvPolynomial.C r
  exact (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).commutes r

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.intrinsicAffineData_scheme
statement:
@[simp]
theorem intrinsicAffineData_scheme

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGrading_eq_gradingOfBasis
statement:
theorem symGrading_eq_gradingOfBasis
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M) :
    symGrading R M = gradingOfBasis b
proof:
:= by
  funext d
  exact (gradingOfBasis_eq_range_ι_pow b d).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.Proj_eq_of_grading_eq
statement:
theorem Proj_eq_of_grading_eq
    (𝒜 ℬ : ℕ → Submodule R (SymmetricAlgebra R M))
    [g𝒜 : GradedAlgebra 𝒜] [gℬ : GradedAlgebra ℬ]
    (h : 𝒜 = ℬ) :
    Proj 𝒜 = Proj ℬ
proof:
:= by
  subst ℬ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoI_comp_appIso_restrict
statement:
theorem m7geoI_comp_appIso_restrict {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion f] [IsOpenImmersion g]
    (U : Z.Opens) (hU : U ≤ (f ≫ g) ''ᵁ ⊤)
    (hV : g ⁻¹ᵁ U ≤ f ''ᵁ ⊤) (s : Γ(X, ⊤)) :
    (g.appLE U (g ⁻¹ᵁ U) le_rfl).hom
      ((Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE hU).op).hom
        (((f ≫ g).appIso ⊤).inv s)) =
      (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op).hom ((f.appIso ⊤).inv s)
proof:
:= by
  have hI : U ≤ g ''ᵁ f ''ᵁ ⊤ := by
    simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_image] using hU
  have hmap (α : op (g ''ᵁ f ''ᵁ ⊤) ⟶ op U) :
      Z.presheaf.map α = Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE hI).op := by
    congr 1
  simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_appIso, Iso.trans_inv, Functor.mapIso_inv,
    Iso.op_inv, eqToIso.inv]
  simp only [Category.assoc, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  rw [hmap]
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.map_appLE]
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.appIso_inv_appLE]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.m7geoI_component_overlap_heq
statement:
theorem m7geoI_component_overlap_heq {R M : Type u} [CommRing R]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoI_chartι_ratio_transition_heq
statement:
theorem m7geoI_chartι_ratio_transition_heq {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (i : C.I) (c l : C.basisIndex i) :
    HEq
      ((C.chartι i).app (m7geoF_W C i c ⊓ m7geoF_W C i l)
        (m7geoF_ratio C i c l))
      (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit Γ(X, C.U i)
        (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) 1
        (C.sectionBasis i l) (C.sectionBasis i c)).1
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) :=
    C.sectionModule_free i
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) :=
    C.sectionModule_finite i
  have h := m7geoI_chartι_ratio_restrict C i c l
  change HEq
    ((C.chartι i).appLE (m7geoF_W C i c ⊓ m7geoF_W C i l)
      (C.chartι i ⁻¹ᵁ (m7geoF_W C i c ⊓ m7geoF_W C i l)) le_rfl
      (m7geoF_ratio C i c l)) _
  rw [h]
  have hpre : C.chartι i ⁻¹ᵁ (m7geoF_W C i c ⊓ m7geoF_W C i l) =
      linearOverlapOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))
        (C.sectionBasis i l) (C.sectionBasis i c) := by
    rw [m7geoG_chartι_preimage_linear_overlap C i c l]
    rw [linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf, linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
    exact inf_comm _ _
  have hcast := m7geoI_restrict_heq_of_opens_eq (C.chart i) hpre
    (show C.chartι i ⁻¹ᵁ (m7geoF_W C i c ⊓ m7geoF_W C i l) ≤
        (C.literalLinearOpen ⟨i, l⟩).ι ''ᵁ ⊤ by
      rw [m7geoG_chartι_preimage_overlap C i c l,
        Scheme.Opens.ι_image_top]
      exact inf_le_right)
    (show linearOverlapOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))
        (C.sectionBasis i l) (C.sectionBasis i c) ≤
          (C.literalLinearOpen ⟨i, l⟩).ι ''ᵁ ⊤ by
      rw [Scheme.Opens.ι_image_top, linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
      exact inf_le_left)
    (((C.literalLinearOpen ⟨i, l⟩).ι.appIso ⊤).inv
      (show Γ((C.literalLinearOpen ⟨i, l⟩).toScheme, ⊤) from
        tautChart_component Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))
          (C.sectionBasis i l) (C.sectionBasis i c)))
  exact hcast.trans (m7geoI_component_overlap_heq
    (R := Γ(X, C.U i)) (M := E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))
    (C.sectionBasis i l) (C.sectionBasis i c))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoI_chartι_ratio_standard_heq
statement:
theorem m7geoI_chartι_ratio_standard_heq {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (i : C.I) [Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)]
    (a : Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1)) :
    HEq
      ((C.chartι i).app
        (m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a) ⊓
          m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0))
        (m7geoF_ratio C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a)
          ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0)))
      ((intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace (m7g_b C i)).app
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapOpen Γ(X, C.U i)
          (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0 a)
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.twistTransitionSectionUnit Γ(X, C.U i)
          (C.positiveRankDimension i) 1 0 a).1)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := m7geoI_chartι_ratio_transition_heq C i
    ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a)
    ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0)
  have h2 := intrinsicToStandard_app_transitionSectionUnit_heq
    (m7g_b C i) 1 0 a
  rw [m7geoG_basis_reindex C i 0,
    m7geoG_basis_reindex C i a] at h2
  exact h1.trans h2.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoI_chartι_ratio_standard_restricted_heq
statement:
theorem m7geoI_chartι_ratio_standard_restricted_heq {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (i : C.I) [Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)]
    {a : Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1)} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    HEq
      ((C.chartι i).app
        (m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a) ⊓
          m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0))
        (m7geoF_ratio C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a)
          ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0)))
      ((intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace (m7g_b C i)).app
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapOpen Γ(X, C.U i)
          (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0 a)
        ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.space Γ(X, C.U i)
          (C.positiveRankDimension i)).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (Proj.basicOpen_mono
            (𝒜 := SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading Γ(X, C.U i)
              (C.positiveRankDimension i))
            (f := SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinate Γ(X, C.U i)
              (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0)
            (g := SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapEquation Γ(X, C.U i)
              (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0 a)
            ⟨SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinate Γ(X, C.U i)
              (C.positiveRankDimension i) a, rfl⟩)).op
          (Proj.awayToSection
            (SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading Γ(X, C.U i)
              (C.positiveRankDimension i))
            (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinate Γ(X, C.U i)
              (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0)
            (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateRatio Γ(X, C.U i)
              (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0 ⟨a, ha⟩))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [SchemeProjectiveSpace.m7geoT_standard_ratio_in_space
    Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) ha]
  exact m7geoI_chartι_ratio_standard_heq C i a

theorem restrictionSpecMap_toBase (i : C.I) (W : X.affineOpens)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.isPullback_directRestrictionChartMap
statement:
theorem isPullback_directRestrictionChartMap (s i : C.I) (W : X.affineOpens)
    (hs : W.1 ≤ C.U s) (hi : W.1 ≤ C.U i) :
    IsPullback (CommonBasicOpen.directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) s W hs i hi)
      (C.restrictionChartToBase s W hs) (C.chartToBase i) (X.homOfLE hi)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1)) :=
    Module.Free.of_basis (C.restrictedSectionBasis s W.1 hs)
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1)) := by
    letI : Finite (C.basisIndex s) := C.basisIndex_finite s
    exact Module.Finite.of_basis (C.restrictedSectionBasis s W.1 hs)
  have hSpec := isPullback_semilinearSymmetricProjMap_toSpec_of_isBaseChange
    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hi).op).hom
    (E.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE hi).op) (C.restriction_spans i W.1 hi)
    (C.restriction_isBaseChange i W.1 hi)
  refine hSpec.of_iso (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) W.2.isoSpec.symm
    (C.isAffine i).isoSpec.symm ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · exact C.restrictionSpecMap_toBase i W hi

      ((C.commonPullbackRefinementBaseCover g a b).pullbackHom

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictedFrameRestriction_isBaseChange
statement:
theorem restrictedFrameRestriction_isBaseChange (i : C.I) (U V : X.Opens)
    (hUi : U ≤ C.U i) (hVU : V ≤ U) :
    let f
proof:
:= (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op).hom
    letI : Algebra Γ(X, U) Γ(X, V) := f.toAlgebra
    letI : Module Γ(X, U) (E.val.obj (op V)) :=
      Module.compHom (E.val.obj (op V)) f
    letI : IsScalarTower Γ(X, U) Γ(X, V)
        (E.val.obj (op V)) :=
      ⟨fun r s n ↦ by
        change (f r * s) • n = f r • s • n
        rw [mul_smul]⟩
    IsBaseChange Γ(X, V)
      (semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f
        (E.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE hVU).op)) := by
  dsimp only
  let f := (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op).hom
  letI : Algebra Γ(X, U) Γ(X, V) := f.toAlgebra
  letI : Module Γ(X, U) (E.val.obj (op V)) :=
    Module.compHom (E.val.obj (op V)) f
  letI : IsScalarTower Γ(X, U) Γ(X, V)
      (E.val.obj (op V)) :=
    ⟨fun r s n ↦ by
      change (f r * s) • n = f r • s • n
      rw [mul_smul]⟩
  let bU := C.restrictedSectionBasis i U hUi
  let bV := C.restrictedSectionBasis i V (hVU.trans hUi)
  let φ := semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f
    (E.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE hVU).op)
  have hfree :
      IsBaseChange Γ(X, V)
        (Finsupp.linearCombination Γ(X, U) bV) :=
    IsBaseChange.of_basis Γ(X, U) bV
  have hcomp :
      IsBaseChange Γ(X, V)
        ((Finsupp.linearCombination Γ(X, U) bV).comp
          bU.repr.toLinearMap) :=
    IsBaseChange.comp_equiv bU.repr
      (Finsupp.linearCombination Γ(X, U) bV) hfree
  have heq :
      (Finsupp.linearCombination Γ(X, U) bV).comp
          bU.repr.toLinearMap = φ := by
    apply bU.ext
    intro k
    simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
      Function.comp_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self,
      Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul]
    dsimp only [bU, bV, φ]
    change C.restrictedSectionBasis i V (hVU.trans hUi) k =
      E.val.map (homOfLE hVU).op (C.restrictedSectionBasis i U hUi k)
    exact (C.restrictedSectionBasis_trans i U V hUi hVU k).symm
  change IsBaseChange Γ(X, V) φ
  rw [← heq]
  exact hcomp

  apply Submodule.span_le.2

    C.restrictedSectionBasis_trans i U V hUi hVU k⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.affineRestrictionSpecMap_toBase
statement:

        U.2.isoSpec.inv = W.2.isoSpec.inv ≫ X.homOfLE h

:= by
  have hf : CommRingCat.ofHom (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op := by apply CommRingCat.hom_ext; rfl
  rw [hf]
  apply (cancel_epi W.2.isoSpec.hom).1
  simp only [Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  rw [IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_hom, Scheme.Opens.toSpecΓ_SpecMap_presheaf_map_assoc,
    ← U.2.isoSpec_hom]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.isPullback_restrictionChartRefinementMap
statement:
theorem isPullback_restrictionChartRefinementMap (i : C.I) (U V : X.affineOpens)
    (hUi : U.1 ≤ C.U i) (hVU : V.1 ≤ U.1) :
    IsPullback (C.restrictionChartRefinementMap i U V hUi hVU)
      (C.restrictionChartToBase i V (hVU.trans hUi))
      (C.restrictionChartToBase i U hUi) (X.homOfLE hVU)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, U.1) (E.val.obj (op U.1)) :=
    Module.Free.of_basis (C.restrictedSectionBasis i U.1 hUi)
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, U.1) (E.val.obj (op U.1)) := by
    letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
    exact Module.Finite.of_basis (C.restrictedSectionBasis i U.1 hUi)
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, V.1) (E.val.obj (op V.1)) :=
    Module.Free.of_basis (C.restrictedSectionBasis i V.1 (hVU.trans hUi))
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, V.1) (E.val.obj (op V.1)) := by
    letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
    exact Module.Finite.of_basis (C.restrictedSectionBasis i V.1 (hVU.trans hUi))
  have hp := isPullback_semilinearSymmetricProjMap_toSpec_of_isBaseChange
    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op).hom
    (E.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE hVU).op) (C.restrictedFrameRestriction_spans i U.1 V.1 hUi hVU)
    (C.restrictedFrameRestriction_isBaseChange i U.1 V.1 hUi hVU)
  refine hp.of_iso (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) V.2.isoSpec.symm U.2.isoSpec.symm ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · exact affineRestrictionSpecMap_toBase U V hVU

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictionCommonRefinementOpen_covers
statement:
theorem restrictionCommonRefinementOpen_covers (a b : C.I) (W : X.affineOpens)
    (ha : W.1 ≤ C.U a) (hb : W.1 ≤ C.U b) :
    IsOpenCover (C.restrictionCommonRefinementOpen a b W)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsOpenCover.mk
  refine top_le_iff.mp fun x _ => ?_
  obtain ⟨f, e, hfe, hxf⟩ := exists_basicOpen_le_affine_inter
    (C.isAffine a) (C.isAffine b) x.1 ⟨ha x.2, hb x.2⟩
  let c : C.CommonBasicOpen a b := ⟨f, e, hfe⟩
  let O : X.Opens := W.1 ⊓ c.affineOpen.1
  have hxO : x.1 ∈ O := ⟨x.2, hxf⟩
  obtain ⟨κ, hsub, heq⟩ := Opens.isBasis_iff_cover.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens O
  rw [heq] at hxO
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV⟩ := Opens.mem_sSup.mp hxO
  have hVO : V ≤ O := heq.symm ▸ le_sSup hV
  let r : C.restrictionCommonRefinementIndex a b W :=
    ⟨c, ⟨⟨V, hsub hV⟩, hVO.trans inf_le_left, hVO.trans inf_le_right⟩⟩
  exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨r, hxV⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictionCommonRefinementBaseIso_hom_cover
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem restrictionCommonRefinementBaseIso_hom_cover (a b : C.I) (W : X.affineOpens)
    (ha : W.1 ≤ C.U a) (hb : W.1 ≤ C.U b)
    (r : C.restrictionCommonRefinementIndex a b W) :
    (C.restrictionCommonRefinementBaseIso a b W ha hb r).hom ≫
      (C.restrictionCommonRefinementBaseCover a b W ha hb).f r = X.homOfLE r.2.2.1
proof:
:=
  IsOpenImmersion.isoOfRangeEq_hom_fac _ _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.isPullback_restrictionCommonRefinementChart
statement:
theorem isPullback_restrictionCommonRefinementChart (a b : C.I) (W : X.affineOpens)
    (ha : W.1 ≤ C.U a) (hb : W.1 ≤ C.U b)
    (r : C.restrictionCommonRefinementIndex a b W) :
    IsPullback (C.restrictionChartRefinementMap a W r.2.1 ha r.2.2.1)
      (C.restrictionChartToBase a r.2.1 (r.2.2.1.trans ha) ≫
        (C.restrictionCommonRefinementBaseIso a b W ha hb r).hom)
      (C.restrictionChartToBase a W ha)
      ((C.restrictionCommonRefinementBaseCover a b W ha hb).f r)
proof:
:= by
  have hp := C.isPullback_restrictionChartRefinementMap a W r.2.1 ha r.2.2.1
  refine hp.of_iso (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _)
    (C.restrictionCommonRefinementBaseIso a b W ha hb r) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rfl
  · exact (Category.id_comp _).symm
  · exact (Category.comp_id _).trans (Category.id_comp _).symm
  · exact (C.restrictionCommonRefinementBaseIso_hom_cover a b W ha hb r).symm.trans
      (Category.comp_id _).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictionCommonRefinementChartIso_hom_map
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem restrictionCommonRefinementChartIso_hom_map (a b : C.I) (W : X.affineOpens)
    (ha : W.1 ≤ C.U a) (hb : W.1 ≤ C.U b)
    (r : C.restrictionCommonRefinementIndex a b W) :
    (C.restrictionCommonRefinementChartIso a b W ha hb r).hom ≫
      C.restrictionChartRefinementMap a W r.2.1 ha r.2.2.1 =
      (C.restrictionCommonRefinementProjectiveCover a b W ha hb).f r
proof:
:=
  (IsPullback.of_hasPullback (C.restrictionChartToBase a W ha)
    ((C.restrictionCommonRefinementBaseCover a b W ha hb).f r)).isoIsPullback_hom_fst _ _
    (C.isPullback_restrictionCommonRefinementChart a b W ha hb r)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictionRingHom_comp
statement:
theorem restrictionRingHom_comp (U V T : X.Opens) (hVU : V ≤ U) (hUT : U ≤ T) :
    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op).hom.comp
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUT).op).hom =
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hVU.trans hUT)).op).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro r
  change X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUT).op r) =
    X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hVU.trans hUT)).op r
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← X.presheaf.map_comp]
  congr 2

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictionSemilinear_comp_heq
statement:
theorem restrictionSemilinear_comp_heq (U V T : X.Opens) (hVU : V ≤ U) (hUT : U ≤ T) :
    HEq (semilinearMapComp (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUT).op).hom
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op).hom
        (E.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE hUT).op) (E.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE hVU).op))
      (E.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE (hVU.trans hUT)).op)
proof:
:= by
  apply semilinearMap_heq_of_ringHom_eq (restrictionRingHom_comp U V T hVU hUT)
  intro m
  change E.val.map (homOfLE hVU).op (E.val.map (homOfLE hUT).op m) =
    E.val.map (homOfLE (hVU.trans hUT)).op m
  rw [← PresheafOfModules.map_comp_apply]
  congr 2

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictionSemilinear_comp_spans
statement:
theorem restrictionSemilinear_comp_spans (t : C.I) (U V : X.Opens)
    (hVU : V ≤ U) (hUt : U ≤ C.U t) :
    Submodule.span Γ(X, V) (Set.range
      (semilinearMapComp (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUt).op).hom
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op).hom
        (E.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE hUt).op) (E.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE hVU).op))) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hr : Set.range
      (semilinearMapComp (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUt).op).hom
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op).hom
        (E.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE hUt).op) (E.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE hVU).op)) =
      Set.range (E.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE (hVU.trans hUt)).op) := by
    ext n
    constructor <;> rintro ⟨m, rfl⟩ <;> refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
    · change E.val.map (homOfLE (hVU.trans hUt)).op m =
        E.val.map (homOfLE hVU).op (E.val.map (homOfLE hUt).op m)
      rw [← PresheafOfModules.map_comp_apply]
      congr 2
    · change E.val.map (homOfLE hVU).op (E.val.map (homOfLE hUt).op m) =
        E.val.map (homOfLE (hVU.trans hUt)).op m
      rw [← PresheafOfModules.map_comp_apply]
      congr 2
  rw [hr]
  exact C.restriction_spans t V (hVU.trans hUt)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictionChartRefinementMap_comp_direct
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem restrictionChartRefinementMap_comp_direct (s t : C.I) (U V : X.affineOpens)
    (hUs : U.1 ≤ C.U s) (hUt : U.1 ≤ C.U t) (hVU : V.1 ≤ U.1) :
    C.restrictionChartRefinementMap s U V hUs hVU ≫
      CommonBasicOpen.directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) s U hUs t hUt =
      CommonBasicOpen.directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) s V (hVU.trans hUs) t (hVU.trans hUt)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, U.1) (E.val.obj (op U.1)) :=
    Module.Free.of_basis (C.restrictedSectionBasis s U.1 hUs)
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, U.1) (E.val.obj (op U.1)) := by
    letI : Finite (C.basisIndex s) := C.basisIndex_finite s
    exact Module.Finite.of_basis (C.restrictedSectionBasis s U.1 hUs)
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, V.1) (E.val.obj (op V.1)) :=
    Module.Free.of_basis (C.restrictedSectionBasis s V.1 (hVU.trans hUs))
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, V.1) (E.val.obj (op V.1)) := by
    letI : Finite (C.basisIndex s) := C.basisIndex_finite s
    exact Module.Finite.of_basis (C.restrictedSectionBasis s V.1 (hVU.trans hUs))
  unfold restrictionChartRefinementMap CommonBasicOpen.directRestrictionChartMap
  refine (semilinearSymmetricProjMap_comp
    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUt).op).hom (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op).hom
    (E.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE hUt).op) (E.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE hVU).op)
    (C.restriction_spans t U.1 hUt) (C.restrictedFrameRestriction_spans s U.1 V.1 hUs hVU)
    (C.restrictionSemilinear_comp_spans t U.1 V.1 hVU hUt)).trans ?_
  exact semilinearSymmetricProjMap_congr (restrictionRingHom_comp U.1 V.1 (C.U t) hVU hUt)
    _ _ (restrictionSemilinear_comp_heq U.1 V.1 (C.U t) hVU hUt)
    (C.restrictionSemilinear_comp_spans t U.1 V.1 hVU hUt)
    (C.restriction_spans t V.1 (hVU.trans hUt))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.directRestrictionChartMap_chartι
statement:
theorem directRestrictionChartMap_chartι (a b : C.I) (W : X.affineOpens)
    (ha : W.1 ≤ C.U a) (hb : W.1 ≤ C.U b) :
    CommonBasicOpen.directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) a W ha a ha ≫ C.chartι a =
      CommonBasicOpen.directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) a W ha b hb ≫ C.chartι b
proof:
:= by
  apply (C.restrictionCommonRefinementProjectiveCover a b W ha hb).hom_ext
  intro (r : C.restrictionCommonRefinementIndex a b W)
  rw [← C.restrictionCommonRefinementChartIso_hom_map a b W ha hb r]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [C.restrictionChartRefinementMap_comp_direct_assoc,
    C.restrictionChartRefinementMap_comp_direct_assoc]
  exact congrArg (fun f => (C.restrictionCommonRefinementChartIso a b W ha hb r).hom ≫ f)
    (C.directRestrictionChartMap_chartι_common a b a r.1 r.2.1
      (r.2.2.1.trans ha) r.2.2.2)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.commonPullbackRefinementChartIso_hom_right
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem commonPullbackRefinementChartIso_hom_right (a b : C.pullbackFrameIndex g)
    (r : C.commonPullbackRefinementIndex g a b) :
    (C.commonPullbackRefinementChartIso g a b r).hom ≫
      C.pullbackProjectiveRefinementMap g b r.2.1 r.2.2.2.1 =
      (C.commonPullbackRefinementProjectiveCover g a b).f r ≫
        (C.pullbackFrameCover g).transition a b ≫
        (C.pullbackFrameCover g).overlapToChart b a
proof:
:= by
  let D := C.pullbackFrameCover g
  apply (cancel_mono (D.chartι b)).1
  have hc := D.directRestrictionChartMap_chartι a b r.2.1 r.2.2.1 r.2.2.2.1
  have hglue := (D.glueData.glue_condition a b).symm
  change D.overlapToChart a b ≫ D.chartι a =
    (D.transition a b ≫ D.overlapToChart b a) ≫ D.chartι b at hglue
  change C.pullbackProjectiveRefinementMap g a r.2.1 r.2.2.1 ≫ D.chartι a =
    C.pullbackProjectiveRefinementMap g b r.2.1 r.2.2.2.1 ≫ D.chartι b at hc
  calc
    _ = (C.commonPullbackRefinementChartIso g a b r).hom ≫
        C.pullbackProjectiveRefinementMap g a r.2.1 r.2.2.1 ≫ D.chartι a := by
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg
        (fun f => (C.commonPullbackRefinementChartIso g a b r).hom ≫ f) hc.symm
    _ = (C.commonPullbackRefinementProjectiveCover g a b).f r ≫
        D.overlapToChart a b ≫ D.chartι a := by
      rw [← Category.assoc, C.commonPullbackRefinementChartIso_hom_left]
      exact Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = _ := by
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg
        (fun f => (C.commonPullbackRefinementProjectiveCover g a b).f r ≫ f)
        hglue

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackProjectiveChartMap_overlap
statement:
theorem pullbackProjectiveChartMap_overlap (a b : C.pullbackFrameIndex g) :
    (C.pullbackFrameCover g).overlapToChart a b ≫
        C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a ≫ C.chartι a.1 =
      (C.pullbackFrameCover g).transition a b ≫
        (C.pullbackFrameCover g).overlapToChart b a ≫
        C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g b ≫ C.chartι b.1
proof:
:= by
  apply (C.commonPullbackRefinementProjectiveCover g a b).hom_ext
  intro r
  rw [← C.commonPullbackRefinementChartIso_hom_left_assoc g a b r,
    ← C.commonPullbackRefinementChartIso_hom_right_assoc g a b r]
  simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg
    (fun f => (C.commonPullbackRefinementChartIso g a b r).hom ≫ f)
    (C.commonPullbackRefinementChartι_compatible g a b r)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackProjectiveMap_chartι
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem pullbackProjectiveMap_chartι (a : C.pullbackFrameIndex g) :
    (C.pullbackFrameCover g).chartι a ≫ C.pullbackProjectiveMap g =

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackProjectiveChartMap_toBase
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem pullbackProjectiveChartMap_toBase (a : C.pullbackFrameIndex g) :
    C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a ≫ C.chartToAmbient a.1 =
      (C.pullbackFrameCover g).chartToAmbient a ≫ g
proof:
:= by

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackProjectiveMap_toBase
statement:
theorem pullbackProjectiveMap_toBase :
    C.pullbackProjectiveMap g ≫ C.toBase = (C.pullbackFrameCover g).toBase ≫ g
proof:
:= by
  apply (C.pullbackFrameCover g).cover.hom_ext
  intro a
  change (C.pullbackFrameCover g).chartι a ≫ (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g ≫ C.toBase) =
    (C.pullbackFrameCover g).chartι a ≫ ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).toBase ≫ g)
  rw [← Category.assoc, C.pullbackProjectiveMap_chartι]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [C.chartι_toBase, (C.pullbackFrameCover g).chartι_toBase_assoc a g]
  exact C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap_toBase g a

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackProjectiveChart_coefficient_toBase
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem pullbackProjectiveChart_coefficient_toBase (a : C.pullbackFrameIndex g) :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (g.appLE (C.U a.1) (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a) a.2.2).hom) ≫
      (C.isAffine a.1).isoSpec.inv =
      ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).isAffine a).isoSpec.inv ≫ C.pullbackFrameMap g a
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (C.U a.1).ι).1
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (g.appLE (C.U a.1) (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a) a.2.2).hom) ≫
      (C.isAffine a.1).fromSpec =
      ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).isAffine a).isoSpec.inv ≫ C.pullbackFrameMap g a ≫ (C.U a.1).ι
  rw [C.pullbackFrameMap_comp_ι]
  exact C.pullbackProjectiveChart_coefficient_fromSpec g a

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.isPullback_pullbackProjectiveChartMap_toBase
statement:
theorem isPullback_pullbackProjectiveChartMap_toBase (a : C.pullbackFrameIndex g) :
    IsPullback (C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a)
      ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).chartToBase a) (C.chartToBase a.1)
      (C.pullbackFrameMap g a)
proof:
:= by
  have hp := C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap_isPullback g a
  refine hp.of_iso (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _)
    ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).isAffine a).isoSpec.symm
    (C.isAffine a.1).isoSpec.symm ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · exact C.pullbackProjectiveChart_coefficient_toBase g a

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.isPullback_pullbackProjectiveChartMap_global
statement:
theorem isPullback_pullbackProjectiveChartMap_global (a : C.pullbackFrameIndex g) :
    IsPullback (C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a ≫ C.chartι a.1)
      ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).chartToBase a) C.toBase
      ((C.pullbackFrameOpen g a).ι ≫ g)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [pullbackFrameMap_comp_ι] using
    (C.isPullback_pullbackProjectiveChartMap_toBase g a).paste_horiz
      (C.isPullback_chartι_toBase a.1)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.isPullback_pullbackProjectiveMap
statement:
theorem isPullback_pullbackProjectiveMap :
    IsPullback (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) (C.pullbackFrameCover g).toBase C.toBase g
proof:
:= by
  let D := C.pullbackFrameCover g
  apply IsPullback.flip
  apply Scheme.isPullback_of_openCover D.toBase (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) g C.toBase D.baseCover
  intro (a : C.pullbackFrameIndex g)
  change IsPullback (pullback.snd D.toBase (D.U a).ι)
    (pullback.fst D.toBase (D.U a).ι ≫ C.pullbackProjectiveMap g)
    ((D.U a).ι ≫ g) C.toBase
  have hchart := D.isPullback_chartι_toBase a
  have hp := (C.isPullback_pullbackProjectiveChartMap_global g a).flip
  refine hp.of_iso hchart.isoPullback (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · exact (Category.comp_id _).trans hchart.isoPullback_hom_snd.symm
  · exact (Category.comp_id _).trans
      ((C.pullbackProjectiveMap_chartι g a).symm.trans
        (hchart.isoPullback_hom_fst_assoc (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g)).symm)
  · exact (Category.comp_id _).trans (Category.id_comp _).symm
  · exact (Category.comp_id _).trans (Category.id_comp _).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackProjectiveIso_hom_fst
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem pullbackProjectiveIso_hom_fst :
    (C.pullbackProjectiveIso g).hom ≫ pullback.fst C.toBase g = C.pullbackProjectiveMap g

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackProjectiveIso_hom_snd
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem pullbackProjectiveIso_hom_snd :

name: GRRBlueprintV4.RT2.exists_factorisation_pos
statement:
theorem exists_factorisation_pos (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (i : X ⟶ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme), IsClosedImmersion i ∧
      i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase = f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n0, i0, hi0, hi0f⟩ := RT.exists_factorisation hX hY f hf
  haveI := hi0
  refine ⟨n0, i0 ≫ (coverIso (Y ↘ Spk k) n0).inv ≫
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F25.hypIm (Equiv.ulift : J.{u} n0 ≃ Fin (n0 + 1))
      (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) n0) (Equiv.ulift : J.{u} (n0 + 1) ≃ Fin (n0 + 1 + 1))
      (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n0 + 1)), ?_, ?_⟩
  · infer_instance
  · rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F25.hypIm_toBase,
      coverIso_inv_toBase, hi0f]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.RT2.grrOn_of_closedImmersion
statement:
theorem grrOn_of_closedImmersion (hreg : RegStalks Y) (hXreg : RegStalks X)
    (i : X ⟶ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme) [IsClosedImmersion i] :
    GRROn k hY i
proof:
:= by
  unfold GRROn
  haveI := factY k hY
  haveI := factCover (n := n + 1) k hY
  intro _ _ x w hw
  exact RG7.grr_relative_unconditional k hY hreg (Nat.succ_pos n) i hXreg x w hw

name: GRRBlueprintV4.RT2.grr_top
statement:
theorem grr_top (hX : ProjectiveIntegralK k X) (hXreg : RegStalks X)
    (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y) (hYreg : RegStalks Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spk k) = X ↘ Spk k) :
    haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X)
proof:
:= ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_K hX⟩
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (i : X ⟶ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).scheme) (_ : IsClosedImmersion i),
      i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) (n + 1)).toBase = f ∧ GRROn k hY i := by
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X) := ⟨projectiveIntegral_of_K hX⟩
  obtain ⟨n, i, hi, hif⟩ := exists_factorisation_pos k hX hY f hf
  haveI := hi
  exact ⟨n, i, hi, hif, grrOn_of_closedImmersion k hY hYreg hXreg i⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.inIntersection_mul
statement:
theorem inIntersection_mul (c d : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (c.mul d).inIntersection = c.inIntersection ⊓ d.inIntersection
proof:
:= by
  change (C.U i ⊓ C.U j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ X.basicOpen (c.left * d.left) =
    (C.U i ⊓ C.U j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ X.basicOpen c.left ⊓
      (C.U i ⊓ C.U j).ι ⁻¹ᵁ X.basicOpen d.left
  rw [Scheme.basicOpen_mul, Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.basicOpenOverlapCover_mul_opensRange
statement:
theorem basicOpenOverlapCover_mul_opensRange
    (i j : C.I) (c d : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f (c.mul d)).opensRange =
      ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c).opensRange ⊓
        ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f d).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  change (pullback.fst (C.overlapToIntersection i j)
      ((CommonBasicOpen.baseCover C i j).f (c.mul d))).opensRange =
    (pullback.fst (C.overlapToIntersection i j)
      ((CommonBasicOpen.baseCover C i j).f c)).opensRange ⊓
    (pullback.fst (C.overlapToIntersection i j)
      ((CommonBasicOpen.baseCover C i j).f d)).opensRange
  rw [Scheme.Hom.opensRange_pullbackFst, Scheme.Hom.opensRange_pullbackFst,

    Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictedSectionBasis_trans
statement:
theorem restrictedSectionBasis_trans
    (i : C.I) (V W : X.Opens)
    (hVU : V ≤ C.U i) (hWV : W ≤ V) (k : C.basisIndex i) :
    E.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE hWV).op
        (C.restrictedSectionBasis i V hVU k) =
      C.restrictedSectionBasis i W (hWV.trans hVU) k
proof:
:= by
  change E.val.map (homOfLE hWV).op
      (C.restrictedSectionBasis i V hVU k) =
    C.restrictedSectionBasis i W (hWV.trans hVU) k
  rw [← C.restrictedSectionBasis_eq_restrict,
    ← C.restrictedSectionBasis_eq_restrict]
  rw [← PresheafOfModules.map_comp_apply]
  congr 2

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.mulRestrictionFirst_spans
statement:
theorem mulRestrictionFirst_spans (c d : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
      Submodule.span Γ(X, (c.mul d).affineOpen.1)
        (Set.range (c.mulRestrictionFirst d)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply top_unique
  rw [← (c.mul d).leftSectionBasis.span_eq]
  apply Submodule.span_le.2
  rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
  apply Submodule.subset_span
  refine ⟨c.leftSectionBasis k, ?_⟩
  change E.val.map (homOfLE (c.mul_affineOpen_le_first d)).op
      (C.restrictedSectionBasis i c.affineOpen.1
        c.affineOpen_le_left k) =
    C.restrictedSectionBasis i (c.mul d).affineOpen.1
      (c.mul d).affineOpen_le_left k
  exact C.restrictedSectionBasis_trans i c.affineOpen.1
    (c.mul d).affineOpen.1 c.affineOpen_le_left
    (c.mul_affineOpen_le_first d) k

    (X.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (c.mul_affineOpen_le_second d)).op).hom.comp
      (X.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE d.affineOpen_le_left).op).hom =
    (X.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (c.mul d).affineOpen_le_left).op).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro r
  change X.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (c.mul_affineOpen_le_second d)).op
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE d.affineOpen_le_left).op r) =
    X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (c.mul d).affineOpen_le_left).op r
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← X.presheaf.map_comp]
  congr 2

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.mulRestrictionSecond_comp_left_heq
statement:
theorem mulRestrictionSecond_comp_left_heq
    (c d : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    HEq
      (semilinearMapComp
        (X.presheaf.map
          (homOfLE d.affineOpen_le_left).op).hom
        (X.presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (c.mul_affineOpen_le_second d)).op).hom
        d.leftRestriction (c.mulRestrictionSecond d))
      (c.mul d).leftRestriction
proof:
:= by
  apply semilinearMap_heq_of_ringHom_eq
    (c.mulRestrictionSecond_ringHom_comp_left d)
  intro m
  change E.val.map
      (homOfLE (c.mul_affineOpen_le_second d)).op
        (E.val.map (homOfLE d.affineOpen_le_left).op m) =
    E.val.map (homOfLE (c.mul d).affineOpen_le_left).op m
  rw [← PresheafOfModules.map_comp_apply]
  congr 2

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.mulRestrictionSecond_comp_left_spans
statement:
theorem mulRestrictionSecond_comp_left_spans
    (c d : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    Submodule.span Γ(X, (c.mul d).affineOpen.1)
      (Set.range
        (semilinearMapComp
          (X.presheaf.map
            (homOfLE d.affineOpen_le_left).op).hom
          (X.presheaf.map
            (homOfLE (c.mul_affineOpen_le_second d)).op).hom
          d.leftRestriction (c.mulRestrictionSecond d))) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hrange :
      Set.range
          (semilinearMapComp
            (X.presheaf.map
              (homOfLE d.affineOpen_le_left).op).hom
            (X.presheaf.map
              (homOfLE (c.mul_affineOpen_le_second d)).op).hom
            d.leftRestriction (c.mulRestrictionSecond d)) =
        Set.range (c.mul d).leftRestriction := by
    ext n
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨m, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
      change E.val.map (homOfLE (c.mul d).affineOpen_le_left).op m =
        E.val.map
          (homOfLE (c.mul_affineOpen_le_second d)).op
            (E.val.map (homOfLE d.affineOpen_le_left).op m)
      rw [← PresheafOfModules.map_comp_apply]
      congr 2
    · rintro ⟨m, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
      change E.val.map
          (homOfLE (c.mul_affineOpen_le_second d)).op
            (E.val.map (homOfLE d.affineOpen_le_left).op m) =
        E.val.map (homOfLE (c.mul d).affineOpen_le_left).op m
      rw [← PresheafOfModules.map_comp_apply]
      congr 2
  rw [hrange]
  exact (c.mul d).leftRestriction_spans

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.mulChartToSecond_comp_chartToLeft
statement:
theorem mulChartToSecond_comp_chartToLeft
    (c d : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    c.mulChartToSecond d ≫ d.chartToLeft =
      (c.mul d).chartToLeft
proof:
:= by
  unfold mulChartToSecond chartToLeft
  refine Eq.trans
    (semilinearSymmetricProjMap_comp
      (X.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE d.affineOpen_le_left).op).hom
      (X.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (c.mul_affineOpen_le_second d)).op).hom
      d.leftRestriction (c.mulRestrictionSecond d)
      d.leftRestriction_spans (c.mulRestrictionSecond_spans d)
      (c.mulRestrictionSecond_comp_left_spans d)) ?_
  exact semilinearSymmetricProjMap_congr
    (c.mulRestrictionSecond_ringHom_comp_left d)
    (semilinearMapComp
      (X.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE d.affineOpen_le_left).op).hom
      (X.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (c.mul_affineOpen_le_second d)).op).hom
      d.leftRestriction (c.mulRestrictionSecond d))
    (c.mul d).leftRestriction
    (c.mulRestrictionSecond_comp_left_heq d)
    (c.mulRestrictionSecond_comp_left_spans d)
    (c.mul d).leftRestriction_spans

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback_hom_fst_chartIso
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback_hom_fst_chartIso
    (i j : C.I) (c d : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (C.basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback i j c d).hom ≫
        pullback.fst ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c)
          ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f d) ≫
        (C.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j c).hom =
        (C.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j (c.mul d)).hom ≫
      c.mulChartToFirst d
proof:
:= by
  have hIso :
      (C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f (c.mul d) ≫ C.overlapToChart i j =
        (C.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j (c.mul d)).hom ≫
          (c.mul d).chartToLeft :=
    (C.commonBasicOpenChartIso_hom_chartToLeft i j (c.mul d)).symm
  apply (cancel_mono c.chartToLeft).1
  have hLeft :
    ((C.basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback i j c d).hom ≫
          pullback.fst ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c)
            ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f d) ≫
          (C.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j c).hom) ≫ c.chartToLeft =
      (C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f (c.mul d) ≫ C.overlapToChart i j := by
   calc
    ((C.basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback i j c d).hom ≫
          pullback.fst ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c)
            ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f d) ≫
          (C.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j c).hom) ≫ c.chartToLeft =
      ((C.basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback i j c d).hom ≫
          pullback.fst ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c)
            ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f d)) ≫
        ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j c).hom ≫
          c.chartToLeft) := by simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = ((C.basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback i j c d).hom ≫
          pullback.fst ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c)
            ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f d)) ≫
        ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c ≫
          C.overlapToChart i j) := by
      rw [C.commonBasicOpenChartIso_hom_chartToLeft i j c]
      rfl
    _ = (((C.basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback i j c d).hom ≫
          pullback.fst ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c)
            ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f d)) ≫
        (C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c) ≫
          C.overlapToChart i j := by simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = (C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f (c.mul d) ≫
          C.overlapToChart i j := by
      exact congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ C.overlapToChart i j)
        (C.basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback_hom_fac i j c d)
  have hRight :
      (C.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j (c.mul d)).hom ≫
          (c.mul d).chartToLeft =
        ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j (c.mul d)).hom ≫
          c.mulChartToFirst d) ≫ c.chartToLeft := by
    rw [Category.assoc, CommonBasicOpen.mulChartToFirst_comp_chartToLeft]
  exact hLeft.trans hIso |>.trans hRight

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback_hom_snd_chartIso
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback_hom_snd_chartIso

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.localTransition_compatible_toChart
statement:
theorem localTransition_compatible_toChart
    (i j : C.I) (c d : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    pullback.fst ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c)
          ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f d) ≫
        C.localTransition i j c ≫ C.overlapToChart j i =
      pullback.snd ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c)
          ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f d) ≫
        C.localTransition i j d ≫ C.overlapToChart j i
proof:
:= by
  have hLast :
      (((C.basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback i j c d).hom ≫
        pullback.snd ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c)
          ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f d)) ≫
        (C.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j d).hom) ≫ d.chartToRight =
      (((C.basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback i j c d).hom ≫
        pullback.snd ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c)
          ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f d)) ≫
        C.localTransition i j d) ≫ C.overlapToChart j i := by
    calc
      _ = ((C.basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback i j c d).hom ≫
          pullback.snd ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c)
            ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f d)) ≫
          ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j d).hom ≫ d.chartToRight) :=
        Category.assoc _ _ _
      _ = ((C.basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback i j c d).hom ≫
          pullback.snd ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c)
            ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f d)) ≫
          (C.localTransition i j d ≫ C.overlapToChart j i) :=
        congrArg (fun f ↦
          ((C.basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback i j c d).hom ≫
            pullback.snd ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c)
              ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f d)) ≫ f)
          (C.localTransition_toChart i j d).symm
      _ = _ := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
  apply (cancel_epi
    (C.basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback i j c d).hom).1
  have hBefore :
      ((C.basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback i j c d).hom ≫
          pullback.fst ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c)
            ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f d) ≫
          C.localTransition i j c) ≫ C.overlapToChart j i =
        (((C.basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback i j c d).hom ≫
          pullback.snd ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c)
            ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f d)) ≫
          (C.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j d).hom) ≫ d.chartToRight := by
   calc
    ((C.basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback i j c d).hom ≫
          pullback.fst ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c)
            ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f d) ≫
          C.localTransition i j c) ≫ C.overlapToChart j i =
      ((C.basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback i j c d).hom ≫
          pullback.fst ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c)
            ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f d)) ≫
        (C.localTransition i j c ≫
          C.overlapToChart j i) := by simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = ((C.basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback i j c d).hom ≫
          pullback.fst ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c)
            ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f d)) ≫
        ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j c).hom ≫
          c.chartToRight) := by
      rw [C.localTransition_toChart i j c]
      rfl
    _ = (((C.basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback i j c d).hom ≫
          pullback.fst ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c)
            ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f d)) ≫
        (C.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j c).hom) ≫
          c.chartToRight := by simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j (c.mul d)).hom ≫
          c.mulChartToFirst d) ≫ c.chartToRight := by
      exact congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ c.chartToRight)
        (C.basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback_hom_fst_chartIso
          i j c d)
    _ = (C.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j (c.mul d)).hom ≫
          (c.mul d).chartToRight := by
      rw [Category.assoc,
        CommonBasicOpen.mulChartToFirst_comp_chartToRight]
    _ = ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j (c.mul d)).hom ≫
          c.mulChartToSecond d) ≫ d.chartToRight := by
      rw [Category.assoc,
        CommonBasicOpen.mulChartToSecond_comp_chartToRight]
    _ = (((C.basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback i j c d).hom ≫
          pullback.snd ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c)
            ((C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f d)) ≫
        (C.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j d).hom) ≫
          d.chartToRight := by
      exact congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ d.chartToRight)
        (C.basicOpenOverlapCoverMulIsoPullback_hom_snd_chartIso
          i j c d).symm
  exact hBefore.trans hLast
