name: GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.gsum_lof
statement:
theorem gsum_lof (a : ℕ → Op M) (n : ℕ) (y : M n) :
    gsum a (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M n y) =
      (∑ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a m) (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M n y)
proof:
:= by
  simp [gsum]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.gexp_lof
statement:
theorem gexp_lof (L : Op M) (n : ℕ) (y : M n) :
    gexp L (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M n y) =
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((j.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) • L ^ j) (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M n y)
proof:
:= by
  simp [gexp]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Interw.one
statement: theorem Interw.one : Interw F 1 1
proof: := fun _ ↦ rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Interw.zero
statement: theorem Interw.zero : Interw F 0 0
proof: := fun _ ↦ by simp

name: GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Interw.add
statement:
theorem Interw.add {A B : Op M} {A' B' : Op M'} (hA : Interw F A A') (hB : Interw F B B') :
    Interw F (A + B) (A' + B')
proof: := fun v ↦ by simp [hA v, hB v]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Interw.neg
statement: theorem Interw.neg {A : Op M} {A' : Op M'} (hA : Interw F A A') : Interw F (-A) (-A')
proof:
:=
  fun v ↦ by simp [hA v]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Interw.smul
statement:
theorem Interw.smul (q : ℚ) {A : Op M} {A' : Op M'} (hA : Interw F A A') :
    Interw F (q • A) (q • A')
proof: := fun v ↦ by simp [hA v]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Interw.mul
statement:
theorem Interw.mul {A B : Op M} {A' B' : Op M'} (hA : Interw F A A') (hB : Interw F B B') :
    Interw F (A * B) (A' * B')
proof:
:= fun v ↦ by
  rw [Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, hA, hB]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Interw.pow
statement:
theorem Interw.pow {A : Op M} {A' : Op M'} (hA : Interw F A A') (j : ℕ) :
    Interw F (A ^ j) (A' ^ j)
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simpa using (Interw.one (F := F))
  | succ j ih => rw [pow_succ, pow_succ]; exact ih.mul hA

name: GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Interw.sum
statement:
theorem Interw.sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) {A : ι → Op M} {A' : ι → Op M'}
    (h : ∀ a ∈ s, Interw F (A a) (A' a)) : Interw F (∑ a ∈ s, A a) (∑ a ∈ s, A' a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using (Interw.zero (F := F))
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha]
    exact (h a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)).add (ih fun b hb ↦ h b (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hb))

name: GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Interw.gsum
statement:
theorem Interw.gsum (hF : DegPres F) {a : ℕ → Op M} {a' : ℕ → Op M'}
    (ha : ∀ m, Interw F (a m) (a' m)) : Interw F (Alg.gsum a) (Alg.gsum a')
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  induction v using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of n y =>
    rw [← DirectSum.lof_eq_of ℚ]
    obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := hF n y
    rw [Alg.gsum_lof a n y, hy', Alg.gsum_lof a' n y', ← hy']
    exact Interw.sum (F := F) (Finset.range (n + 1)) (fun m _ ↦ ha m) _
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Interw.gexp
statement:
theorem Interw.gexp (hF : DegPres F) {L : Op M} {L' : Op M'} (hL : Interw F L L') :
    Interw F (Alg.gexp L) (Alg.gexp L')
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  induction v using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of n y =>
    rw [← DirectSum.lof_eq_of ℚ]
    obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := hF n y
    rw [Alg.gexp_lof L n y, hy', Alg.gexp_lof L' n y', ← hy']
    exact Interw.sum (F := F) (Finset.range (n + 1))
      (fun j _ ↦ (hL.pow j).smul _) _
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Interw.powerSum
statement:
theorem Interw.powerSum {c : ℕ → Op M} {c' : ℕ → Op M'} (hc : ∀ j, Interw F (c j) (c' j))
    (m : ℕ) : Interw F (Alg.powerSum c m) (Alg.powerSum c' m)
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ m ih =>
    cases m with
    | zero => simpa [Alg.powerSum] using (Interw.zero (F := F))
    | succ m =>
      rw [Alg.powerSum, Alg.powerSum]
      refine Interw.add (Interw.sum _ fun i _ ↦ ?_) (Interw.smul _ (hc _))
      exact Interw.smul _ ((hc _).mul (ih _ (by omega)))

name: GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Interw.logTd
statement:
theorem Interw.logTd (hF : DegPres F) {c : ℕ → Op M} {c' : ℕ → Op M'}
    (hc : ∀ j, Interw F (c j) (c' j)) : Interw F (Alg.logTd c) (Alg.logTd c')
proof:
:= by
  refine Interw.gsum hF fun m ↦ ?_
  by_cases hm : m = 0
  · simpa [hm] using (Interw.zero (F := F))
  · simpa [hm] using Interw.smul _ (Interw.powerSum hc m)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Interw.tdFromChern
proof:
:=
  Interw.gexp hF (Interw.logTd hF hc)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.powerSum_line
statement:
theorem Alg.powerSum_line {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℚ A] (u : A) (c : ℕ → A) (h1 : c 1 = u)
    (h2 : ∀ j, 2 ≤ j → c j = 0) : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → Alg.powerSum c m = u ^ m
proof:
:= by
  intro m hm
  induction m with
  | zero => omega
  | succ m ih =>
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hpos
    · simp [Alg.powerSum, h1]
    · rw [Alg.powerSum, Finset.sum_eq_single (⟨0, hpos⟩ : Fin m)]
      · rw [h2 (m + 1) (by omega), smul_zero, add_zero]
        simp [h1, ih hpos, pow_succ']
      · intro b _ hb
        have hb' : (b : ℕ) ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hb (Fin.ext h)
        rw [h2 ((b : ℕ) + 1) (by omega)]
        simp
      · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h

name: GRRBlueprintV4.coeff_toddLine_one
statement: theorem coeff_toddLine_one : PowerSeries.coeff 1 (CharacteristicClasses.toddLine ℚ) = 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [CharacteristicClasses.toddLine, bernoulli'PowerSeries]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.surjectiveWordDifferential_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem surjectiveWordDifferential_apply
    (m p : ℕ) (c : surjectiveWordCochain k m p)
    (a : {a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin m // Function.Surjective a}) :
    surjectiveWordDifferential k m p c a =
      ∑ r : Fin (p + 2), (-1 : k) ^ r.val *
        if h : Function.Surjective (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove) then
          c ⟨a.1 ∘ r.succAbove, h⟩
        else 0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.almostSurjectiveWordDifferential_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem almostSurjectiveWordDifferential_apply
    (m p : ℕ) (c : almostSurjectiveWordCochain k m p)
    (a : {a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (m + 1) // CoversOldVertices a}) :
    almostSurjectiveWordDifferential k m p c a =
      ∑ r : Fin (p + 2), (-1 : k) ^ r.val *
        if h : CoversOldVertices (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove) then
          c ⟨a.1 ∘ r.succAbove, h⟩
        else 0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coversOldVertices_cons_last_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h i
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := h i
    have hjne : j ≠ 0 := by
      intro hjzero
      subst j
      simp only [Fin.cons_zero] at hj
      exact (Fin.ne_of_lt i.castSucc_lt_last) hj.symm
    obtain ⟨j', rfl⟩ := Fin.eq_succ_of_ne_zero hjne
    exact ⟨j', by simpa using hj⟩
  · intro h i
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := h i
    exact ⟨Fin.succ j, by simpa using hj⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.almostSurjectiveWordDifferential_contraction
statement:
theorem almostSurjectiveWordDifferential_contraction
    (m p : ℕ) (c : almostSurjectiveWordCochain k m (p + 1)) :
    almostSurjectiveWordDifferential k m p
          (almostSurjectiveWordContraction k m p c) +
        almostSurjectiveWordContraction k m (p + 1)
          (almostSurjectiveWordDifferential k m (p + 1) c) =
      c
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  let c' := almostSurjectiveWordExtend k m (p + 1) c
  have hfirst :
      almostSurjectiveWordDifferential k m p
          (almostSurjectiveWordContraction k m p c) a =
        ∑ r : Fin (p + 2), (-1 : k) ^ r.val *
          c' (Fin.cons (Fin.last m) (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove)) := by
    rw [almostSurjectiveWordDifferential_apply]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro r _
    by_cases h : CoversOldVertices (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove)
    · simp only [h, dif_pos]
      rw [show c' (Fin.cons (Fin.last m) (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove)) =
          c ⟨Fin.cons (Fin.last m) (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove),
            (coversOldVertices_cons_last_iff _).2 h⟩ by
        simp [c', almostSurjectiveWordExtend,
          (coversOldVertices_cons_last_iff _).2 h]]
      rfl
    · have hcons :
          ¬CoversOldVertices (Fin.cons (Fin.last m) (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove)) :=
        fun h' ↦ h ((coversOldVertices_cons_last_iff _).1 h')
      simp [h, c', almostSurjectiveWordExtend, hcons]
  have hsecond :
      almostSurjectiveWordContraction k m (p + 1)
          (almostSurjectiveWordDifferential k m (p + 1) c) a =
        ∑ s : Fin (p + 3), (-1 : k) ^ s.val *
          c' (Fin.cons (Fin.last m) a.1 ∘ s.succAbove) := by
    change
      (∑ s : Fin (p + 3), (-1 : k) ^ s.val *
        if h : CoversOldVertices
            (Fin.cons (Fin.last m) a.1 ∘ s.succAbove) then
          c ⟨Fin.cons (Fin.last m) a.1 ∘ s.succAbove, h⟩
        else 0) =
      ∑ s : Fin (p + 3), (-1 : k) ^ s.val *
        c' (Fin.cons (Fin.last m) a.1 ∘ s.succAbove)
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro s _
    by_cases h :
        CoversOldVertices (Fin.cons (Fin.last m) a.1 ∘ s.succAbove)
    · simp [h, c', almostSurjectiveWordExtend]
    · simp [h, c', almostSurjectiveWordExtend]
  rw [Pi.add_apply, hfirst, hsecond]
  simpa [c', almostSurjectiveWordExtend, a.2] using
    alternating_prepend_identity k m p (Fin.last m) c' a.1

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coversOldVertices_of_surjective
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  exact ha i.castSucc

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.surjective_of_comp_succAbove_surjective
statement:
theorem surjective_of_comp_succAbove_surjective {m p : ℕ}
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin m) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (h : Function.Surjective (a ∘ r.succAbove)) :
    Function.Surjective a
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := h i
  exact ⟨r.succAbove j, hj⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.surjectiveWordToAlmost_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem surjectiveWordToAlmost_apply
    (m p : ℕ) (c : surjectiveWordCochain k (m + 1) p)
    (a : {a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (m + 1) // CoversOldVertices a}) :
    surjectiveWordToAlmost k m p c a =
      if h : Function.Surjective a.1 then c ⟨a.1, h⟩ else 0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.almostSurjectiveWordDifferential_toAlmost
statement:
theorem almostSurjectiveWordDifferential_toAlmost
    (m p : ℕ) (c : surjectiveWordCochain k (m + 1) p) :
    almostSurjectiveWordDifferential k m p
        (surjectiveWordToAlmost k m p c) =
      surjectiveWordToAlmost k m (p + 1)
        (surjectiveWordDifferential k (m + 1) p c)
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  rw [almostSurjectiveWordDifferential_apply,
    surjectiveWordToAlmost_apply]
  by_cases ha : Function.Surjective a.1
  · rw [dif_pos ha, surjectiveWordDifferential_apply]
    change
      (∑ r : Fin (p + 2), (-1 : k) ^ r.val *
        if hOld : CoversOldVertices (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove) then
          (if h : Function.Surjective (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove) then
            c ⟨a.1 ∘ r.succAbove, h⟩
          else 0)
        else 0) =
      ∑ r : Fin (p + 2), (-1 : k) ^ r.val *
        if h : Function.Surjective (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove) then
          c ⟨a.1 ∘ r.succAbove, h⟩
        else 0
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro r _
    by_cases h : Function.Surjective (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove)
    · simp [h, coversOldVertices_of_surjective _ h]
    · simp [h]
  · rw [dif_neg ha]
    change
      (∑ r : Fin (p + 2), (-1 : k) ^ r.val *
        if hOld : CoversOldVertices (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove) then
          (if h : Function.Surjective (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove) then
            c ⟨a.1 ∘ r.succAbove, h⟩
          else 0)
        else 0) = 0
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro r _
    have hnot : ¬Function.Surjective (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove) :=
      fun h ↦ ha (surjective_of_comp_succAbove_surjective a.1 r h)
    by_cases hOld : CoversOldVertices (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove) <;>
      simp [hOld, hnot]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.surjectiveWordToAlmost_injective
statement:
theorem surjectiveWordToAlmost_injective (m p : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (surjectiveWordToAlmost k m p)
proof:
:= by
  intro c₁ c₂ h
  funext a
  have haOld : CoversOldVertices a.1 :=
    coversOldVertices_of_surjective a.1 a.2
  have hvalue := congrFun h ⟨a.1, haOld⟩
  simpa [surjectiveWordToAlmost_apply, a.2] using hvalue

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coversOldVertices_castSucc_iff_surjective
statement:
theorem coversOldVertices_castSucc_iff_surjective {m p : ℕ}
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin m) :
    CoversOldVertices (fun j ↦ (a j).castSucc) ↔
      Function.Surjective a
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h i
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := h i
    exact ⟨j, Fin.castSucc_inj.mp hj⟩
  · intro h i
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := h i
    exact ⟨j, by simpa using congrArg Fin.castSucc hj⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.almostSurjectiveWordRestriction_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem almostSurjectiveWordRestriction_apply
    (m p : ℕ) (c : almostSurjectiveWordCochain k m p)
    (a : {a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin m // Function.Surjective a}) :
    almostSurjectiveWordRestriction k m p c a =
      c ⟨fun j ↦ (a.1 j).castSucc,
        (coversOldVertices_castSucc_iff_surjective a.1).2 a.2⟩
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.surjectiveWordDifferential_restriction
statement:
theorem surjectiveWordDifferential_restriction
    (m p : ℕ) (c : almostSurjectiveWordCochain k m p) :
    surjectiveWordDifferential k m p
        (almostSurjectiveWordRestriction k m p c) =
      almostSurjectiveWordRestriction k m (p + 1)
        (almostSurjectiveWordDifferential k m p c)
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  change
    (∑ r : Fin (p + 2), (-1 : k) ^ r.val *
      if h : Function.Surjective (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove) then
        c ⟨fun j ↦ ((a.1 ∘ r.succAbove) j).castSucc,
          (coversOldVertices_castSucc_iff_surjective _).2 h⟩
      else 0) =
    ∑ r : Fin (p + 2), (-1 : k) ^ r.val *
      if h : CoversOldVertices
          (fun j ↦ ((a.1 ∘ r.succAbove) j).castSucc) then
        c ⟨fun j ↦ ((a.1 ∘ r.succAbove) j).castSucc, h⟩
      else 0
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  have hiff :
      CoversOldVertices
          (fun j ↦ ((a.1 ∘ r.succAbove) j).castSucc) ↔
        Function.Surjective (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove) := by
    exact coversOldVertices_castSucc_iff_surjective
      (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove)
  by_cases h : Function.Surjective (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove)
  · have hOld :
        CoversOldVertices
          (fun j ↦ ((a.1 ∘ r.succAbove) j).castSucc) :=
      hiff.2 h
    rw [dif_pos h, dif_pos hOld]
  · have hOld :
        ¬CoversOldVertices
          (fun j ↦ ((a.1 ∘ r.succAbove) j).castSucc) :=
      fun h' ↦ h (hiff.1 h')
    rw [dif_neg h, dif_neg hOld]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.not_surjective_castSucc_word
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := h (Fin.last m)
  exact (Fin.ne_of_lt (a j).castSucc_lt_last) hj

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.almostSurjectiveWordRestriction_toAlmost
statement:
theorem almostSurjectiveWordRestriction_toAlmost
    (m p : ℕ) (c : surjectiveWordCochain k (m + 1) p) :
    almostSurjectiveWordRestriction k m p
        (surjectiveWordToAlmost k m p c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  change
    (if h : Function.Surjective (fun j ↦ (a.1 j).castSucc) then
      c ⟨fun j ↦ (a.1 j).castSucc, h⟩
    else 0) = 0
  rw [dif_neg (not_surjective_castSucc_word a.1)]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.lowerOldVertexWord_castSucc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lowerOldVertexWord_castSucc {m p : ℕ}
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (m + 1)) (ha : AvoidsLastVertex a)
    (j : Fin (p + 1)) :
    (lowerOldVertexWord a ha j).castSucc = a j
proof:
:= by
  exact Fin.castSucc_castLT _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.lowerOldVertexWord_surjective
statement:
theorem lowerOldVertexWord_surjective {m p : ℕ}
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (m + 1))
    (hOld : CoversOldVertices a) (ha : AvoidsLastVertex a) :
    Function.Surjective (lowerOldVertexWord a ha)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hOld i
  refine ⟨j, ?_⟩
  apply Fin.castSucc_inj.mp
  simpa using hj

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.avoidsLastVertex_of_not_surjective
statement:
theorem avoidsLastVertex_of_not_surjective {m p : ℕ}
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (m + 1))
    (hOld : CoversOldVertices a) (ha : ¬Function.Surjective a) :
    AvoidsLastVertex a
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  apply ha
  intro v
  by_cases hv : v = Fin.last m
  · exact ⟨j, hj.trans hv.symm⟩
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (Fin.exists_castSucc_eq).2 hv
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hOld i
    exact ⟨q, hq.trans hi⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.almostSurjectiveWordLift_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem almostSurjectiveWordLift_apply
    (m p : ℕ) (c : surjectiveWordCochain k m p)
    (a : {a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (m + 1) // CoversOldVertices a}) :
    almostSurjectiveWordLift k m p c a =
      if ha : AvoidsLastVertex a.1 then
        c ⟨lowerOldVertexWord a.1 ha,
          lowerOldVertexWord_surjective a.1 a.2 ha⟩
      else 0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.almostSurjectiveWordRestriction_lift
statement:
theorem almostSurjectiveWordRestriction_lift
    (m p : ℕ) (c : surjectiveWordCochain k m p) :
    almostSurjectiveWordRestriction k m p
        (almostSurjectiveWordLift k m p c) = c
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  let aCast : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (m + 1) :=
    fun j ↦ (a.1 j).castSucc
  have haAvoid : AvoidsLastVertex aCast := by
    intro j
    exact Fin.ne_of_lt (a.1 j).castSucc_lt_last
  have hword :
      (⟨lowerOldVertexWord aCast haAvoid,
          lowerOldVertexWord_surjective aCast
            ((coversOldVertices_castSucc_iff_surjective a.1).2 a.2)
            haAvoid⟩ :
        {b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin m // Function.Surjective b}) = a := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext j
    apply Fin.castSucc_inj.mp
    exact lowerOldVertexWord_castSucc aCast haAvoid j
  change
    (if h : AvoidsLastVertex aCast then
      c ⟨lowerOldVertexWord aCast h,
        lowerOldVertexWord_surjective aCast
          ((coversOldVertices_castSucc_iff_surjective a.1).2 a.2) h⟩
    else 0) = c a
  rw [dif_pos haAvoid]
  simp only [hword]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.almostSurjectiveWord_eq_zero_of_not_surjective_of_restriction_eq_zero
statement:
theorem almostSurjectiveWord_eq_zero_of_not_surjective_of_restriction_eq_zero
    (m p : ℕ) (c : almostSurjectiveWordCochain k m p)
    (hres : almostSurjectiveWordRestriction k m p c = 0)
    (a : {a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (m + 1) // CoversOldVertices a})
    (ha : ¬Function.Surjective a.1) :
    c a = 0
proof:
:= by
  let hAvoid : AvoidsLastVertex a.1 :=
    avoidsLastVertex_of_not_surjective a.1 a.2 ha
  let b : {b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin m // Function.Surjective b} :=
    ⟨lowerOldVertexWord a.1 hAvoid,
      lowerOldVertexWord_surjective a.1 a.2 hAvoid⟩
  have hvalue := congrFun hres b
  have hcast :
      (⟨fun j ↦ (b.1 j).castSucc,
          (coversOldVertices_castSucc_iff_surjective b.1).2 b.2⟩ :
        {a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (m + 1) // CoversOldVertices a}) = a := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext j
    exact lowerOldVertexWord_castSucc a.1 hAvoid j
  change
    c ⟨fun j ↦ (b.1 j).castSucc,
      (coversOldVertices_castSucc_iff_surjective b.1).2 b.2⟩ = 0 at hvalue
  simpa only [hcast] using hvalue

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentHigherTermOfCoefficient_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateLaurentHigherTermOfCoefficient_apply
    (n : ℕ) (e : CoordinateLaurentExponent n) (p : ℕ)
    (c : coordinateLaurentCoefficientCochain k n e p)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    ((coordinateLaurentHigherTermOfCoefficient k n e p c a).1 e) =
      c.1 a
proof:
:= by
  simp [coordinateLaurentHigherTermOfCoefficient]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentHigherTermCoefficient_ofCoefficient
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentHigherTermCoefficient_ofCoefficient
    (n : ℕ) (e : CoordinateLaurentExponent n) (p : ℕ)
    (c : coordinateLaurentCoefficientCochain k n e p) :
    coordinateLaurentHigherTermCoefficient k n
        (coordinateLaurentTotalDegree n e) e p
        (coordinateLaurentHigherTermOfCoefficient k n e p c) =
      c
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext a
  exact coordinateLaurentHigherTermOfCoefficient_apply k n e p c a

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentHigherTermCoefficient_differential
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentHigherTermCoefficient_differential
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (e : CoordinateLaurentExponent n) (p : ℕ)
    (x : coordinateLaurentHigherTerm k n d p) :
    coordinateLaurentHigherTermCoefficient k n d e (p + 1)
        (coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d p x) =
      coordinateLaurentCoefficientDifferential k n e p
        (coordinateLaurentHigherTermCoefficient k n d e p x)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext a
  exact coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_apply_coeff k n d p x a e

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentCoefficientDifferential_comp_self
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentCoefficientDifferential_comp_self
    (n : ℕ) (e : CoordinateLaurentExponent n) (p : ℕ)
    (c : coordinateLaurentCoefficientCochain k n e p) :
    coordinateLaurentCoefficientDifferential k n e (p + 1)
        (coordinateLaurentCoefficientDifferential k n e p c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let x := coordinateLaurentHigherTermOfCoefficient k n e p c
  have hdd :=
    coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_comp_self k n
      (coordinateLaurentTotalDegree n e) p x
  have hcoeff := congrArg
    (coordinateLaurentHigherTermCoefficient k n
      (coordinateLaurentTotalDegree n e) e (p + 2)) hdd
  rw [coordinateLaurentHigherTermCoefficient_differential,
    coordinateLaurentHigherTermCoefficient_differential,
    coordinateLaurentHigherTermCoefficient_ofCoefficient,
    map_zero] at hcoeff
  exact hcoeff

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.oldVertexNegativeExponent_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem oldVertexNegativeExponent_apply (m : ℕ) (i : Fin (m + 1)) :
    oldVertexNegativeExponent m i =
      if i = Fin.last m then 0 else -1
proof:
:= by
  simp [oldVertexNegativeExponent]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.oldVertexNegativeExponent_allowedOn_iff_coversOldVertices
statement:
theorem oldVertexNegativeExponent_allowedOn_iff_coversOldVertices
    {m p : ℕ} (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (m + 1)) :
    (oldVertexNegativeExponent m).AllowedOn m a ↔
      CoversOldVertices a
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h i
    have hi : i.castSucc ≠ Fin.last m :=
      Fin.ne_of_lt i.castSucc_lt_last
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := h i.castSucc (by
      rw [oldVertexNegativeExponent_apply, if_neg hi]
      omega)
    exact ⟨j, hj⟩
  · intro h i hi
    have hine : i ≠ Fin.last m := by
      intro hilast
      subst i
      rw [oldVertexNegativeExponent_apply, if_pos rfl] at hi
      omega
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := (Fin.exists_castSucc_eq).2 hine
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := h j
    exact ⟨q, hq.trans hj⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.almostSurjectiveWordToCoefficient_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem almostSurjectiveWordToCoefficient_apply
    (m p : ℕ) (c : almostSurjectiveWordCochain k m p)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (m + 1)) :
    (almostSurjectiveWordToCoefficient k m p c).1 a =
      if h : CoversOldVertices a then c ⟨a, h⟩ else 0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.almostSurjectiveWordToCoefficient_injective
statement:
theorem almostSurjectiveWordToCoefficient_injective (m p : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective
      (almostSurjectiveWordToCoefficient k m p)
proof:
:= by
  intro c₁ c₂ h
  funext a
  have hvalue := congrArg
    (fun z : coordinateLaurentCoefficientCochain k m
      (oldVertexNegativeExponent m) p ↦ z.1 a.1) h
  simpa [almostSurjectiveWordToCoefficient_apply, a.2] using hvalue

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.almostSurjectiveWordToCoefficient_zero
statement:
theorem almostSurjectiveWordToCoefficient_zero (m p : ℕ) :
    almostSurjectiveWordToCoefficient k m p
        (0 : almostSurjectiveWordCochain k m p) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext a
  by_cases h : CoversOldVertices a <;>
    simp [almostSurjectiveWordToCoefficient_apply, h]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coversOldVertices_of_comp_succAbove
statement:
theorem coversOldVertices_of_comp_succAbove {m p : ℕ}
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (m + 1)) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (h : CoversOldVertices (a ∘ r.succAbove)) :
    CoversOldVertices a
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := h i
  exact ⟨r.succAbove j, hj⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentCoefficientDifferential_almostSurjectiveWord
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentCoefficientDifferential_almostSurjectiveWord
    (m p : ℕ) (c : almostSurjectiveWordCochain k m p) :
    coordinateLaurentCoefficientDifferential k m
        (oldVertexNegativeExponent m) p
        (almostSurjectiveWordToCoefficient k m p c) =
      almostSurjectiveWordToCoefficient k m (p + 1)
        (almostSurjectiveWordDifferential k m p c)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext a
  change
    (∑ r : Fin (p + 2), (-1 : k) ^ r.val *
      almostSurjectiveWordExtend k m p c
        (a ∘ r.succAbove)) =
    almostSurjectiveWordExtend k m (p + 1)
      (almostSurjectiveWordDifferential k m p c) a
  simp only [almostSurjectiveWordExtend]
  by_cases hOld : CoversOldVertices a
  · rw [dif_pos hOld]
    exact almostSurjectiveWordDifferential_apply k m p c ⟨a, hOld⟩
  · rw [dif_neg hOld]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro r _
    have hDelete : ¬CoversOldVertices (a ∘ r.succAbove) :=
      fun h ↦ hOld (coversOldVertices_of_comp_succAbove a r h)
    simp [hDelete]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.almostSurjectiveWordDifferential_comp_self
statement:
theorem almostSurjectiveWordDifferential_comp_self
    (m p : ℕ) (c : almostSurjectiveWordCochain k m p) :
    almostSurjectiveWordDifferential k m (p + 1)
        (almostSurjectiveWordDifferential k m p c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h :=
    coordinateLaurentCoefficientDifferential_comp_self k m
      (oldVertexNegativeExponent m) p
      (almostSurjectiveWordToCoefficient k m p c)
  rw [coordinateLaurentCoefficientDifferential_almostSurjectiveWord,
    coordinateLaurentCoefficientDifferential_almostSurjectiveWord] at h
  apply almostSurjectiveWordToCoefficient_injective k m (p + 2)
  rw [almostSurjectiveWordToCoefficient_zero]
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.surjectiveWord_boundary_of_almost_preimage
statement:
theorem surjectiveWord_boundary_of_almost_preimage
    (m p : ℕ) (c : surjectiveWordCochain k (m + 1) (p + 1))
    (y : almostSurjectiveWordCochain k m p)
    (hy :
      almostSurjectiveWordDifferential k m p y =
        surjectiveWordToAlmost k m (p + 1) c)
    (hres : almostSurjectiveWordRestriction k m p y = 0) :
    ∃ b : surjectiveWordCochain k (m + 1) p,
      surjectiveWordDifferential k (m + 1) p b = c
proof:
:= by
  let b : surjectiveWordCochain k (m + 1) p :=
    fun a ↦ y ⟨a.1, coversOldVertices_of_surjective a.1 a.2⟩
  have hinclude :
      surjectiveWordToAlmost k m p b = y := by
    funext a
    rw [surjectiveWordToAlmost_apply]
    by_cases ha : Function.Surjective a.1
    · rw [dif_pos ha]
    · rw [dif_neg ha]
      exact
        (almostSurjectiveWord_eq_zero_of_not_surjective_of_restriction_eq_zero
          k m p y hres a ha).symm
  refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
  apply surjectiveWordToAlmost_injective k m (p + 1)
  calc
    surjectiveWordToAlmost k m (p + 1)
        (surjectiveWordDifferential k (m + 1) p b) =
      almostSurjectiveWordDifferential k m p
        (surjectiveWordToAlmost k m p b) :=
        (almostSurjectiveWordDifferential_toAlmost k m p b).symm
    _ = almostSurjectiveWordDifferential k m p y := by rw [hinclude]
    _ = surjectiveWordToAlmost k m (p + 1) c := hy

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.surjectiveWord_cocycle_is_boundary
statement:
theorem surjectiveWord_cocycle_is_boundary
    (m p : ℕ) (hmp : m ≤ p + 1)
    (c : surjectiveWordCochain k m (p + 1))
    (hc : surjectiveWordDifferential k m (p + 1) c = 0) :
    ∃ b : surjectiveWordCochain k m p,
      surjectiveWordDifferential k m p b = c
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing p with
  | zero =>
      refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      funext a
      exact Fin.elim0 (a.1 0)
  | succ m ih =>
      let x : almostSurjectiveWordCochain k m (p + 1) :=
        surjectiveWordToAlmost k m (p + 1) c
      have hx :
          almostSurjectiveWordDifferential k m (p + 1) x = 0 := by
        dsimp only [x]
        rw [almostSurjectiveWordDifferential_toAlmost, hc, map_zero]
      let y₀ : almostSurjectiveWordCochain k m p :=
        almostSurjectiveWordContraction k m p x
      have hy₀ :
          almostSurjectiveWordDifferential k m p y₀ = x := by
        have hcontr :=
          almostSurjectiveWordDifferential_contraction k m p x
        simpa only [hx, map_zero, add_zero] using hcontr
      let z : surjectiveWordCochain k m p :=
        almostSurjectiveWordRestriction k m p y₀
      cases p with
      | zero =>
          have hm : m = 0 := by omega
          subst m
          have hz :
              almostSurjectiveWordRestriction k 0 0 y₀ = 0 := by
            funext a
            exact Fin.elim0 (a.1 0)
          exact surjectiveWord_boundary_of_almost_preimage
            k 0 0 c y₀ hy₀ hz
      | succ p =>
          have hzcycle :
              surjectiveWordDifferential k m (p + 1) z = 0 := by
            calc
              surjectiveWordDifferential k m (p + 1) z =
                  almostSurjectiveWordRestriction k m (p + 2)
                    (almostSurjectiveWordDifferential k m (p + 1) y₀) := by
                    exact surjectiveWordDifferential_restriction
                      k m (p + 1) y₀
              _ = almostSurjectiveWordRestriction k m (p + 2) x := by
                    rw [hy₀]
              _ = 0 := almostSurjectiveWordRestriction_toAlmost
                    k m (p + 2) c
          obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := ih p (by omega) z hzcycle
          let u : almostSurjectiveWordCochain k m p :=
            almostSurjectiveWordLift k m p w
          let y : almostSurjectiveWordCochain k m (p + 1) :=
            y₀ - almostSurjectiveWordDifferential k m p u
          have hy :
              almostSurjectiveWordDifferential k m (p + 1) y = x := by
            calc
              almostSurjectiveWordDifferential k m (p + 1) y =
                  almostSurjectiveWordDifferential k m (p + 1) y₀ -
                    almostSurjectiveWordDifferential k m (p + 1)
                      (almostSurjectiveWordDifferential k m p u) := by
                        exact map_sub
                          (almostSurjectiveWordDifferential k m (p + 1))
                          y₀ (almostSurjectiveWordDifferential k m p u)
              _ = x - 0 := by
                    rw [hy₀,
                      almostSurjectiveWordDifferential_comp_self]
              _ = x := sub_zero x
          have hyres :
              almostSurjectiveWordRestriction k m (p + 1) y = 0 := by
            calc
              almostSurjectiveWordRestriction k m (p + 1) y =
                  almostSurjectiveWordRestriction k m (p + 1) y₀ -
                    almostSurjectiveWordRestriction k m (p + 1)
                      (almostSurjectiveWordDifferential k m p u) := by
                        exact map_sub
                          (almostSurjectiveWordRestriction k m (p + 1))
                          y₀ (almostSurjectiveWordDifferential k m p u)
              _ = z - surjectiveWordDifferential k m p
                    (almostSurjectiveWordRestriction k m p u) := by
                      rw [surjectiveWordDifferential_restriction]
              _ = z - surjectiveWordDifferential k m p w := by
                      rw [almostSurjectiveWordRestriction_lift]
              _ = 0 := by rw [hw, sub_self]
          exact surjectiveWord_boundary_of_almost_preimage
            k m (p + 1) c y hy hyres

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentSurjectiveWord_cocycle_is_boundary
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentSurjectiveWord_cocycle_is_boundary
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (hnp : n + 1 ≤ p + 1)
    (c : coordinateLaurentAllNegativeSurjectiveCoefficientSpace
      k n d (p + 1))
    (hc :
      coordinateLaurentSurjectiveWordDifferential k n d (p + 1) c = 0) :
    ∃ b : coordinateLaurentAllNegativeSurjectiveCoefficientSpace k n d p,
      coordinateLaurentSurjectiveWordDifferential k n d p b = c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hexact (e : coordinateLaurentAllNegativeDegreeExponent n d) :
      ∃ b : surjectiveWordCochain k (n + 1) p,
        surjectiveWordDifferential k (n + 1) p b =
          (fun a ↦ c a e) := by
    apply surjectiveWord_cocycle_is_boundary k (n + 1) p hnp
    funext a
    have hvalue := congrFun (congrFun hc a) e
    simpa only [coordinateLaurentSurjectiveWordDifferential_apply,
      surjectiveWordDifferential_apply, Pi.zero_apply] using hvalue
  choose b hb using hexact
  refine ⟨fun a e ↦ b e a, ?_⟩
  funext a e
  have hvalue := congrFun (hb e) a
  simpa only [coordinateLaurentSurjectiveWordDifferential_apply,
    surjectiveWordDifferential_apply] using hvalue

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRange_cocycle_is_boundary
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRange_cocycle_is_boundary
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (hnp : n + 1 ≤ p + 1)
    (x :
      (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjectionLinear
        k n d (p + 1)).range)
    (hx :
      coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeDifferential k n d (p + 1) x = 0) :
    ∃ y :
        (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjectionLinear k n d p).range,
      coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeDifferential k n d p y = x
proof:
:= by
  let E (q : ℕ) :=
    coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficientsLinearEquiv
      k n d q
  let c :
      coordinateLaurentAllNegativeSurjectiveCoefficientSpace
        k n d (p + 1) :=
    E (p + 1) x
  have hc :
      coordinateLaurentSurjectiveWordDifferential k n d (p + 1) c = 0 := by
    have h :=
      coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients_differential
        k n d (p + 1) x
    rw [hx, map_zero] at h
    exact h.symm
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ :=
    coordinateLaurentSurjectiveWord_cocycle_is_boundary
      k n d p hnp c hc
  let y :
      (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjectionLinear k n d p).range :=
    (E p).symm b
  refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
  apply (E (p + 1)).injective
  calc
    E (p + 1)
        (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeDifferential k n d p y) =
      coordinateLaurentSurjectiveWordDifferential k n d p (E p y) :=
        coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients_differential
          k n d p y
    _ = coordinateLaurentSurjectiveWordDifferential k n d p b := by
          rw [(E p).apply_symm_apply]
    _ = c := hb
    _ = E (p + 1) x := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentHigher_cocycle_is_boundary_of_dimension_lt
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentHigher_cocycle_is_boundary_of_dimension_lt
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (hnp : n + 1 ≤ p + 1)
    (x : coordinateLaurentHigherTerm k n d (p + 1))
    (hx : coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d (p + 1) x = 0) :
    ∃ y : coordinateLaurentHigherTerm k n d p,
      coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d p y = x
proof:
:= by
  let px :
      (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjectionLinear
        k n d (p + 1)).range :=
    ⟨coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjectionLinear k n d (p + 1) x,
      ⟨x, rfl⟩⟩
  have hpx :
      coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeDifferential k n d (p + 1) px = 0 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change
      coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d (p + 1)
          (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjection k n d (p + 1) x) = 0
    rw [coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_allNegativeProjection, hx]
    exact map_zero _
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ :=
    coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRange_cocycle_is_boundary
      k n d p hnp px hpx
  have hzval :
      coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d p z.1 =
        coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjection k n d (p + 1) x := by
    have h := congrArg Subtype.val hz
    exact h
  refine
    ⟨coordinateLaurentObstructionContraction k n d p x + z.1, ?_⟩
  have hhom :=
    coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_obstructionContraction
      k n d p x
  rw [hx, map_zero, add_zero] at hhom
  calc
    coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d p
        (coordinateLaurentObstructionContraction k n d p x + z.1) =
      coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d p
          (coordinateLaurentObstructionContraction k n d p x) +
        coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d p z.1 := by
          exact map_add _ _ _
    _ = (x -
          coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjection k n d (p + 1) x) +
        coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjection k n d (p + 1) x := by
          rw [hhom, hzval]
    _ = x := sub_add_cancel _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentPositiveCohomology_subsingleton_of_dimension_lt
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentPositiveCohomology_subsingleton_of_dimension_lt
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (hnp : n + 1 ≤ p + 1) :
    Subsingleton (coordinateLaurentPositiveCohomology k n d p)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro z w
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ :=
    (coordinateLaurentPositiveBoundaries k n d p).mkQ_surjective z
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ :=
    (coordinateLaurentPositiveBoundaries k n d p).mkQ_surjective w
  apply (Submodule.Quotient.eq
    (coordinateLaurentPositiveBoundaries k n d p)).2
  change x.1 - y.1 ∈
    (coordinateLaurentHigherDifferentialLinear k n d p).range
  have hx' :
      coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d (p + 1) x.1 = 0 :=
    x.2
  have hy' :
      coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d (p + 1) y.1 = 0 :=
    y.2
  have hcycle :
      coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d (p + 1)
          (x.1 - y.1) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, hx', hy', sub_self]
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ :=
    coordinateLaurentHigher_cocycle_is_boundary_of_dimension_lt
      k n d p hnp (x.1 - y.1) hcycle
  exact ⟨b, hb⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingSheaf_H_isZero_of_dimension_lt
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingSheaf_H_isZero_of_dimension_lt
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (hnp : n + 1 ≤ p + 1) :
    IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (space k n).ringCatSheaf).obj
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d)) (p + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  letI : Subsingleton (coordinateLaurentPositiveCohomology k n d p) :=
    coordinateLaurentPositiveCohomology_subsingleton_of_dimension_lt
      k n d p hnp
  let eL :=
    coordinateLaurentPositiveCohomologyCechHomologyAddEquiv k n d p
  letI : Subsingleton
      ↑((projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex k n d).homology (p + 1)) :=
    ⟨fun x y ↦ eL.symm.injective (Subsingleton.elim _ _)⟩
  let eH :=
    projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechSheafHPositiveAddEquiv k n d p
  letI : Subsingleton
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (space k n).ringCatSheaf).obj
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d)) (p + 1)) :=
    ⟨fun x y ↦ eH.symm.injective (Subsingleton.elim _ _)⟩
  exact AddCommGrpCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E18.isIso_of_epi_of_rankOne
statement:
theorem isIso_of_epi_of_rankOne {M N : W.Modules} (hM : HasConstantRank W M 1)
    (hN : HasConstantRank W N 1) (f : M ⟶ N) [Epi f] : IsIso f
proof:
:= by

    isZero_of_hasConstantRank_zero _ (hasConstantRank_kernel W hM hN f)
  haveI : Mono f := Preadditive.mono_of_kernel_zero (hK.eq_of_src _ _)
  exact isIso_of_mono_of_epi f

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E18.kernel_ι_comp_of_le
statement:
theorem kernel_ι_comp_of_le (u : A ⟶ C) (v : A ⟶ Q)
    (h : kernelSubobject v ≤ kernelSubobject u) : kernel.ι v ≫ u = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : kernel.ι v = (kernelSubobjectIso v).inv ≫ (kernelSubobject v).arrow := by
    exact (Iso.eq_inv_comp _).2 (kernelSubobject_arrow v)
  rw [h1, ← Subobject.ofLE_arrow h, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, kernelSubobject_arrow_comp]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E18.exists_desc_of_kernelSubobject_le
statement:
theorem exists_desc_of_kernelSubobject_le (u : A ⟶ C) (v : A ⟶ Q) [Epi v]

proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Abelian.epiDesc v u (kernel_ι_comp_of_le u v h), Abelian.comp_epiDesc _ _ _, ?_⟩
  exact epi_of_epi_fac (Abelian.comp_epiDesc v u (kernel_ι_comp_of_le u v h))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E18.twistIso_of_kernel_le
statement:
theorem twistIso_of_kernel_le
    (hker : kernelSubobject (vMap CD b) ≤ kernelSubobject (uMap CB CD j comm)) :
    Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj (CB.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) ≅
      CD.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := epi_uMap CB CD j comm
  haveI := epi_vMap CD b
  obtain ⟨w, -, hw⟩ := exists_desc_of_kernelSubobject_le (uMap CB CD j comm) (vMap CD b) hker
  haveI := hw
  have h1 : HasConstantRank CD.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj
      (CB.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)) 1 :=
    hasConstantRank_pullback CD.scheme j _ 1 (CB.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
  haveI := isIso_of_epi_of_rankOne (CD.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) h1 w
  exact ⟨(asIso w).symm⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.FRI.surjective_of_generic_mem_range
statement:
theorem surjective_of_generic_mem_range {Z X : Scheme.{u}} [IrreducibleSpace X]
    [IsIntegral X] (ι : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι]
    (h : genericPoint X ∈ Set.range ι) : Function.Surjective ι
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  have hx : x ∈ closure ({genericPoint X} : Set X) := by
    rw [(genericPoint_spec X).def]; trivial
  exact closure_minimal (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr h) ι.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.FRI.fibre_not_surjective
statement: theorem fibre_not_surjective : ¬ Function.Surjective (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk c)
proof:
:= by
  intro hs
  obtain ⟨y⟩ : Nonempty Y := inferInstance
  have hne : c ≠ c + 1 := by
    intro h'
    simp at h'
  set z := fibreιGlobal Y J k φk (c + 1) y with hz
  obtain ⟨y', hy'z⟩ := hs z
  obtain ⟨s1, hs1⟩ := fibre_comm Y J k φk c
  obtain ⟨s2, hs2⟩ := fibre_comm Y J k φk (c + 1)
  have e1 := congrArg (fun q => q y') hs1
  have e2 := congrArg (fun q => q y) hs2
  simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at e1 e2
  rw [hy'z] at e1
  exact hne (pointAt_inj k c (c + 1) _ _ (e1.trans e2.symm))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.FRI.fibre_generic_ne

theorem fibre_generic_ne :
    haveI
proof:
:= SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_totalGlobal
      Y J

  haveI := SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_totalGlobal
    Y J

    (surjective_of_generic_mem_range _ ⟨genericPoint Y, h⟩)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.FRI.component_not_surjective
statement: theorem component_not_surjective : ¬ Function.Surjective (componentToTotal Y J)
proof:
:= by
  intro hs
  obtain ⟨y⟩ : Nonempty Y := inferInstance
  set q := fibreιGlobal Y J k φk 0 y with hq
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hs q
  have h1 : q ∈ Set.range (blowupGlobalι Y J) := by
    obtain ⟨U, e, rfl⟩ := exceptionalCharts_jointly_surjective Y J x
    have h2 := congrArg (fun z => z e) (exceptionalToComponent_toTotal Y J U)
    simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at h2
    have h3 := congrArg (fun z => z (exceptionalι (centreIdeal (J.ideal U)) e))
      (blowupι_totalAffineι Y J U)
    simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at h3
    rw [← hx, h2, h3]
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := h1
  have h2 : toP1Global Y J k φk q ∈ (chart k 0).opensRange := by
    have h4 : q ∈ (blowupGlobalι Y J).opensRange := ⟨z, hz⟩
    rw [← GlobalCompletion.preimage_opensRange_chart_zero Y J k φk] at h4
    exact h4
  obtain ⟨s, hs'⟩ : ∃ s : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k),
      s ≫ pointAt k 0 = fibreιGlobal Y J k φk 0 ≫ toP1Global Y J k φk :=
    ⟨_, (fibre_isPullback_P1Global Y J k φk 0).w⟩
  have h5 := congrArg (fun z => z y) hs'
  simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at h5
  rw [← hq] at h5
  rw [← h5] at h2
  exact pointAt_zero_not_mem_chart_zero _ h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.FRI.component_generic_ne
statement:
theorem component_generic_ne [IsIntegral (component Y J)] :
    haveI
proof:
:= SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_totalGlobal
      Y J
    componentToTotal Y J (genericPoint (component Y J)) ≠ genericPoint (totalGlobal Y J) := by
  haveI := SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_totalGlobal
    Y J

    (surjective_of_generic_mem_range _ ⟨genericPoint (component Y J), h⟩)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.FRI.fibreRel_totalGlobal_of_height
statement:
theorem fibreRel_totalGlobal_of_height {k : Type u} [Field k] [Infinite k] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (J : Y.IdealSheafData) (φk : k →+* Γ(Y, ⊤)) (c : k)
    [IsIntegral Y] [IsIntegral (totalGlobal Y J)]
    [(totalGlobal Y J).Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (totalGlobal Y J ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian (totalGlobal Y J)] [Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k (totalGlobal Y J))]
    [Y.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian Y]
    [Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k Y)]
    [(component Y J).Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (component Y J ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian (component Y J)] [Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k (component Y J))]
    [IsIntegral (component Y J)]
    [(fibreιGlobal Y J k φk c).IsOver (Spk k)] [(componentToTotal Y J).IsOver (Spk k)]
    {n : ℕ} (hZ₁ : height (genericPoint Y) = (n : ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ (L N : (totalGlobal Y J).Modules)
      (hL : SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank (totalGlobal Y J) L 1)
      (hN : SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank (totalGlobal Y J) N 1),
      totalPushOn (GRRBlueprintV4.opsV4 k) (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk c)
          (GRRBlueprintV4.fundClass k (W := Y)) =
        totalCapOn (GRRBlueprintV4.opsV4 k) (LPof L N) (hasConstantRank_LPof hL hN)
            (GRRBlueprintV4.fundClass k (W := totalGlobal Y J)) +
          totalPushOn (GRRBlueprintV4.opsV4 k) (componentToTotal Y J)
            (GRRBlueprintV4.fundClass k (W := component Y J))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L₁, hL₁, σ₁, -, hid₁⟩ := exists_cartierData_fibre Y J k φk c
  obtain ⟨N, hN, σE, -, hidE⟩ := exists_cartierData_exceptional Y J k φk
  have hX : height (genericPoint (totalGlobal Y J)) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [height_generic_eq_succ k hL₁ σ₁ (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk c) hid₁
      (fibre_generic_ne Y J φk c), hZ₁]
    push_cast; rfl
  have hE : height (genericPoint (component Y J)) = (n : ℕ∞) := by
    have h := height_generic_eq_succ k hN σE (componentToTotal Y J) hidE
      (component_generic_ne Y J φk)
    rw [hX] at h
    have h' : height (genericPoint (component Y J)) + 1 = (n : ℕ∞) + 1 := by
      rw [← h]; push_cast; rfl
    exact ENat_add_one_cancel h'
  exact fibreRel_totalGlobal Y J φk c hX hZ₁ hE

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenChartMapMulTo_comp
statement:
theorem basicOpenChartMapMulTo_comp (U : X.affineOpens) (f g : Γ(X, U.1)) :
    basicOpenChartMapMulTo I U f g ≫ basicOpenChartMap I U f =
      basicOpenChartMap I U (f * g)
proof:
:= by
  unfold basicOpenChartMapMulTo
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [eqToHom_comp_of_heq _ _ _ (basicOpenChartMap_mul_cocycle I U f g)]
  simp only [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  rfl

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.eqToHom_comp_basicOpenChartMap_of_eq
statement:
theorem eqToHom_comp_basicOpenChartMap_of_eq (U : X.affineOpens) {f₁ f₂ : Γ(X, U.1)}
    (h : f₁ = f₂) :
    eqToHom (congrArg (fun f ↦ chart I (X.affineBasicOpen f)) h) ≫ basicOpenChartMap I U f₂ =
      basicOpenChartMap I U f₁
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  simp

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.CommonBasicOpen.mulToLeft_comp
statement:
theorem mulToLeft_comp (c d : CommonBasicOpen U V) :
    mulToLeft I c d ≫ basicOpenChartMap I U c.left = basicOpenChartMap I U (c.mul d).left
proof:
:=
  basicOpenChartMapMulTo_comp I U c.left d.left

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.CommonBasicOpen.mulRightAffineOpen_eq
statement:
theorem mulRightAffineOpen_eq (c d : CommonBasicOpen U V) :
    (c.mul d).affineOpen = X.affineBasicOpen (d.right * c.right)
proof:
:=
  (c.mul d).swap_affineOpen.symm.trans (congrArg X.affineBasicOpen (mul_comm c.right d.right))

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.CommonBasicOpen.mulToRight_comp
statement:
theorem mulToRight_comp (c d : CommonBasicOpen U V) :
    mulToRight I c d ≫ rightChartMap I d = rightChartMap I (c.mul d)
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit : eqToHom (congrArg (chart I) (mulRightAffineOpen_eq c d)) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (chart I) (c.mul d).swap_affineOpen)).inv ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg (fun f ↦ chart I (X.affineBasicOpen f)) (mul_comm c.right d.right)) :=
    (eqToHom_trans (congrArg (chart I) (c.mul d).swap_affineOpen).symm
      (congrArg (fun f ↦ chart I (X.affineBasicOpen f)) (mul_comm c.right d.right))).symm
  unfold mulToRight rightChartMap
  rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, hsplit, Category.assoc]
  rw [show (eqToIso (congrArg (chart I) d.swap_affineOpen)).hom ≫
      (eqToIso (congrArg (chart I) d.swap_affineOpen)).inv ≫ basicOpenChartMap I V d.right =
      basicOpenChartMap I V d.right by
    rw [← Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.id_comp]]
  rw [basicOpenChartMapMulTo_comp,
    eqToHom_comp_basicOpenChartMap_of_eq I V (mul_comm c.right d.right)]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistOverlapNaturalityLeft_over_component
statement:
theorem twistOverlapNaturalityLeft_over_component
    (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    (i j : C'.I) (c : (transport e C').CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (twistOverlapNaturalityLeft e C' i j).over
        ((transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j c) =
      ((transport e C').twistOverlapLocalIso 1 i j c).hom ≫
        ((twistOverlapTargetTransportIso e C' i j).hom).over
          ((transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j c)
proof:
:= by
  unfold twistOverlapNaturalityLeft
  simpa only [SheafOfModules.Hom.over, Functor.map_comp] using
    congrArg (fun q => q ≫
      ((twistOverlapTargetTransportIso e C' i j).hom).over
        ((transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j c))
      ((transport e C').canonicalTwistTransitionSystem_over_eq_twistOverlapLocalIso
        1 i j c)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistOverlapNaturalityRight_over_component
statement:
theorem twistOverlapNaturalityRight_over_component
    (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    (i j : C'.I) (c : (transport e C').CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (twistOverlapNaturalityRight e C' i j).over
        ((transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j c) =
      ((twistOverlapSourceTransportIso e C' i j).hom).over
          ((transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j c) ≫
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullback (overlapIso e C' i j).hom).map
          ((C'.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1).iso i j).hom)).over
            ((transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j c)
proof:
:= by
  unfold twistOverlapNaturalityRight
  simp only [SheafOfModules.Hom.over, Functor.map_comp]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistOverlapCompat_of_original_components
statement:
theorem transportTwistOverlapCompat_of_original_components
    (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    (h : ∀ (i j : C'.I) (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j),
      (twistOverlapNaturalityLeft e C' i j).over
          ((transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j (c.transport e C')) =
        (twistOverlapNaturalityRight e C' i j).over
          ((transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j (c.transport e C'))) :
    TransportTwistOverlapCompat e C'
proof:
:= by
  apply (transportTwistOverlapCompat_iff_components e C').2
  intro i j d
  have hd := h i j (d.untransport e C')
  rw [CommonBasicOpen.transport_untransport e C' d] at hd
  exact hd

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistOverlapCompat_iff_local_square
statement:
theorem transportTwistOverlapCompat_iff_local_square
    (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') :
    TransportTwistOverlapCompat e C' ↔
      TransportTwistComponentSquare e C'
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h i j c
    have hc := (transportTwistOverlapCompat_iff_components e C').1 h
      i j (c.transport e C')
    rw [twistOverlapNaturalityLeft_over_component,
      twistOverlapNaturalityRight_over_component] at hc
    exact hc
  · intro h
    apply transportTwistOverlapCompat_of_original_components e C'
    intro i j c
    rw [twistOverlapNaturalityLeft_over_component,
      twistOverlapNaturalityRight_over_component]
    exact h i j c

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.over_eq_iff_restrictFunctor_map_eq
statement:
theorem over_eq_iff_restrictFunctor_map_eq
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {M N : Y.Modules} (U : Y.Opens)
    (f g : M ⟶ N) :
    f.over U = g.over U ↔
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map f =
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map g
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply (cancel_epi ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.app M)).1
    calc
      (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.app M ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map f =
        (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map (f.over U) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.app N := by
            exact ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.naturality f).symm
      _ = (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map (g.over U) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.app N := by rw [h]
      _ = (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.app M ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map g := by
            exact (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.naturality g
  · intro h
    apply (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map_injective
    change
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf U ⋙
        (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor).map f =
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf U ⋙
        (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor).map g
    apply (cancel_mono ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.app N)).1
    rw [(Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.naturality f,
      (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.naturality g, h]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistOverlapCompat_iff_restrict_components
statement:
theorem transportTwistOverlapCompat_iff_restrict_components
    (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') :
    TransportTwistOverlapCompat e C' ↔
      ∀ (i j : C'.I) (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j),
        let U
proof:
:= (transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j (c.transport e C')
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map
            (twistOverlapNaturalityLeft e C' i j) =
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map
            (twistOverlapNaturalityRight e C' i j) := by
  constructor
  · intro h i j c
    exact (over_eq_iff_restrictFunctor_map_eq
      ((transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j (c.transport e C'))
      (twistOverlapNaturalityLeft e C' i j)
      (twistOverlapNaturalityRight e C' i j)).1
        ((transportTwistOverlapCompat_iff_components e C').1 h
          i j (c.transport e C'))
  · intro h
    apply transportTwistOverlapCompat_of_original_components e C'
    intro i j c
    exact (over_eq_iff_restrictFunctor_map_eq
      ((transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j (c.transport e C'))
      (twistOverlapNaturalityLeft e C' i j)
      (twistOverlapNaturalityRight e C' i j)).2 (h i j c)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackSquareRestrictionIso_naturality
statement:
theorem pullbackSquareRestrictionIso_naturality
    {A B D Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (r : D ⟶ B) (q : B ⟶ A) (a : D ⟶ Z) (v : Z ⟶ A)
    [IsOpenImmersion r] [IsOpenImmersion q]
    [IsOpenImmersion a] [IsOpenImmersion v]
    [IsOpenImmersion (a ≫ v)] [IsOpenImmersion (r ≫ q)]
    (h : a ≫ v = r ≫ q) {M N : A.Modules} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor r).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map f) ≫
      (pullbackSquareRestrictionIso r q a v h N).hom =
    (pullbackSquareRestrictionIso r q a v h M).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback a).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback v).map f)
proof:
:= by
  let η := Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (Scheme.Modules.pullback q)
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback r) ≪≫
    Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp r q ≪≫
    Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr h.symm ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp a v).symm
  have hn := η.hom.naturality f
  simpa only [pullbackSquareRestrictionIso_eq_pullbackComp,
    η, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.app_hom, Iso.symm_hom,
    NatTrans.comp_app, Functor.isoWhiskerLeft_hom,
    Functor.whiskerLeft, ← Iso.app_inv, Functor.comp_map, Category.assoc] using hn

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistComparisonOpenPullbackRestrictionIso_naturality
statement:
theorem twistComparisonOpenPullbackRestrictionIso_naturality
    (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    {i j : C'.I} (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    {M N : (C'.overlap i j).Modules} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
      ((transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j (c.transport e C')).ι).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (overlapIso e C' i j).hom).map f) ≫
      (twistComparisonOpenPullbackRestrictionIso e C' c N).hom =
    (twistComparisonOpenPullbackRestrictionIso e C' c M).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (twistComparisonOpenIso e C' c).hom).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
          (C'.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι).map f)
proof:
:= by
  let U := (transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j (c.transport e C')
  let V := C'.twistComparisonOpen i j c
  let q := (overlapIso e C' i j).hom
  let a := (twistComparisonOpenIso e C' c).hom
  letI : IsOpenImmersion q := by infer_instance
  letI : IsOpenImmersion a := by infer_instance
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (a ≫ V.ι) := by infer_instance
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (U.ι ≫ q) := by infer_instance
  have hn := pullbackSquareRestrictionIso_naturality U.ι q a V.ι
    (twistComparisonOpenIso_hom_ι e C' c) f
  have hv := congrArg (fun z => (Scheme.Modules.pullback a).map z)
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback V.ι).inv.naturality f)
  simp only [Functor.map_comp] at hv
  unfold twistComparisonOpenPullbackRestrictionIso
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [← Category.assoc, hn, Category.assoc]
  simpa only [← Iso.app_inv, Category.assoc] using
    congrArg (fun z => (pullbackSquareRestrictionIso U.ι q a V.ι
      (twistComparisonOpenIso_hom_ι e C' c) M).hom ≫ z) hv

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem_restrict_eq_twistOverlapLocalSchemeIso
statement:
theorem canonicalTwistTransitionSystem_restrict_eq_twistOverlapLocalSchemeIso
    {F : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X F)
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι).map
      ((C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d).iso i j).hom =
      (C.twistOverlapLocalSchemeIso d i j c).hom
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.transition i j) := C.transition_isOpenImmersion' i j
  have h := congrArg Iso.hom
    (C.canonicalTwistTransitionLocalSchemeIso_eq_overlapLocalSchemeIso d i j c)
  simpa only [canonicalTwistTransitionLocalSchemeIso,
    Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom,
    ← C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem_restrict d i j c] using h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistOverlapNaturalityRight_restrict_component
statement:
theorem twistOverlapNaturalityRight_restrict_component
    (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    (i j : C'.I) (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    let U
proof:
:= (transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j (c.transport e C')
    let M := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (C'.overlapToChart i j)).obj
      (C'.chartTwistingSheaf 1 i)
    let N := (Scheme.Modules.pullback
      (C'.transition i j ≫ C'.overlapToChart j i)).obj
      (C'.chartTwistingSheaf 1 j)
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map
      (twistOverlapNaturalityRight e C' i j) ≫
        (twistComparisonOpenPullbackRestrictionIso e C' c N).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map
        (twistOverlapSourceTransportIso e C' i j).hom ≫
      (twistComparisonOpenPullbackRestrictionIso e C' c M).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (twistComparisonOpenIso e C' c).hom).map
          (C'.twistOverlapLocalSchemeIso 1 i j c).hom := by
  dsimp only
  unfold twistOverlapNaturalityRight
  rw [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc,
    twistComparisonOpenPullbackRestrictionIso_naturality]
  rw [canonicalTwistTransitionSystem_restrict_eq_twistOverlapLocalSchemeIso]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistOverlapNaturalityLeft_restrict_component
statement:
theorem twistOverlapNaturalityLeft_restrict_component
    (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    (i j : C'.I) (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    let U
proof:
:= (transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j (c.transport e C')
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map
      (twistOverlapNaturalityLeft e C' i j) =
      ((transport e C').twistOverlapLocalSchemeIso 1 i j (c.transport e C')).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map
          (twistOverlapTargetTransportIso e C' i j).hom := by
  dsimp only
  unfold twistOverlapNaturalityLeft
  rw [Functor.map_comp,
    canonicalTwistTransitionSystem_restrict_eq_twistOverlapLocalSchemeIso]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistOverlapCompat_iff_restriction_local_square
statement:
theorem transportTwistOverlapCompat_iff_restriction_local_square
    (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') :
    TransportTwistOverlapCompat e C' ↔
      TransportTwistRestrictionLocalSquare e C'
proof:
:= by
  rw [transportTwistOverlapCompat_iff_restrict_components]
  constructor
  · intro h i j c
    have hc := congrArg (fun z => z ≫
      (twistComparisonOpenPullbackRestrictionIso e C' c
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
          (C'.transition i j ≫ C'.overlapToChart j i)).obj
            (C'.chartTwistingSheaf 1 j))).hom) (h i j c)
    rw [twistOverlapNaturalityRight_restrict_component,
      twistOverlapNaturalityLeft_restrict_component, Category.assoc] at hc
    dsimp only
    convert hc using 0
  · intro h i j c
    apply (cancel_mono (twistComparisonOpenPullbackRestrictionIso e C' c
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
        (C'.transition i j ≫ C'.overlapToChart j i)).obj
          (C'.chartTwistingSheaf 1 j))).hom).1
    rw [twistOverlapNaturalityRight_restrict_component,
      twistOverlapNaturalityLeft_restrict_component, Category.assoc]
    have hh := h i j c
    dsimp only at hh
    convert hh using 0

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.pullbackProjectiveMap_isOver
statement: theorem pullbackProjectiveMap_isOver : (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g).IsOver (Spk k)

    (C.pullbackFrameCover g).toBase ≫ X ↘ Spk k

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.xiCap_pullbackFrameCover
statement:
theorem xiCap_pullbackFrameCover :
    xiCap ops (C.pullbackFrameCover g) =
      totalCap ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g)).obj
        (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))
        (hasConstantRank_pullback _ _ _ 1 (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))
proof:
:=
  cp.cap_iso ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    (hasConstantRank_pullback _ _ _ 1 (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))
    ⟨C.pullbackCanonicalTwistingSheafOneIso g⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.segreOp_line_series
statement:
theorem segreOp_line_series (L : Y.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1) :
    segreOp ops cp L 1 hL = fun i => totalCap ops L hL ^ i
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  exact segre_of_rankOne ops cp hL
    (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hL).choose
    (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hL).choose_spec i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.segreOp_pull_rankOne
statement:
theorem segreOp_pull_rankOne [Flat g] (d : ℕ) (hd : PureRelDim g d)
    (L : Y.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1) (i : ℕ) :
    totalPull ops g d hd ∘ₗ segreOp ops cp L 1 hL i =
      segreOp ops cp ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj L) 1
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X g L 1 hL) i ∘ₗ totalPull ops g d hd
proof:
:= by
  rw [segreOp_line_series, segreOp_line_series]
  have h := cp.cap_pull g d hd L hL
  exact (Module.End.commute_pow_left_of_commute h.symm i).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.segreOp_pull_rankZero
statement:
theorem segreOp_pull_rankZero [Flat g] (d : ℕ) (hd : PureRelDim g d)
    (L : Y.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 0) (i : ℕ) :
    totalPull ops g d hd ∘ₗ segreOp ops cp L 0 hL i =
      segreOp ops cp ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj L) 0
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X g L 0 hL) i ∘ₗ totalPull ops g d hd
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : i = 0
  · subst i; simp only [segreOp]; rfl
  · simp only [segreOp, if_neg h, LinearMap.comp_zero, LinearMap.zero_comp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.xiCap_pow_pullbackProjectiveMap_open
statement:
theorem xiCap_pow_pullbackProjectiveMap_open [IsOpenImmersion g] (j : ℕ) :
    letI
proof:
:= pullbackProjectiveMap_isOver (k := k) C g
    letI := pullbackProjectiveMap_flat C g
    totalPull ops (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) 0 (pullbackProjectiveMap_pureRelDim_open (k := k) C g) ∘ₗ
      ((xiCap ops C) ^ j) =
    ((xiCap ops (C.pullbackFrameCover g)) ^ j) ∘ₗ
      totalPull ops (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) 0 (pullbackProjectiveMap_pureRelDim_open (k := k) C g) := by
  letI := pullbackProjectiveMap_isOver (k := k) C g
  letI := pullbackProjectiveMap_flat C g
  have h := cp.cap_pull (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) 0
    (pullbackProjectiveMap_pureRelDim_open (k := k) C g)
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
  rw [← xiCap_pullbackFrameCover C g ops cp] at h
  exact (Module.End.commute_pow_left_of_commute h.symm j).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.projection_totalPull_open
proof:

    letI := pullbackProjectiveMap_flat C g
    letI := C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos r))
    let D := C.pullbackFrameCover g
    let hD := C.pullbackFrameCover_card g hC
    letI := D.toBase_flat (D.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hD (Nat.succ_pos r))
    totalPull ops (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) 0 (pullbackProjectiveMap_pureRelDim_open (k := k) C g) ∘ₗ
      totalPull ops C.toBase r (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC) =
    totalPull ops D.toBase r (cp.projBundle_relDim D hD) ∘ₗ
      totalPull ops g 0 (pureRelDim_openImmersion k g) := by
  letI := pullbackProjectiveMap_isOver (k := k) C g
  letI := pullbackProjectiveMap_flat C g
  letI := C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos r))
  let D := C.pullbackFrameCover g
  let hD := C.pullbackFrameCover_card g hC
  letI := D.toBase_flat (D.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hD (Nat.succ_pos r))
  have hleft := cp.pull_comp (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) C.toBase 0 r
    (pullbackProjectiveMap_pureRelDim_open (k := k) C g) (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC)
    (PureRelDim.comp (pullbackProjectiveMap_pureRelDim_open (k := k) C g) (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC))
  have hright := cp.pull_comp D.toBase g r 0 (cp.projBundle_relDim D hD)
    (pureRelDim_openImmersion k g)
    (PureRelDim.comp (cp.projBundle_relDim D hD) (pureRelDim_openImmersion k g))
  simp only [Nat.add_zero, Nat.zero_add] at hleft hright
  exact hleft.symm.trans ((totalPull_congr ops (C.pullbackProjectiveMap_toBase g) r _ _).trans hright)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.sandwich_pull_open
statement:
theorem sandwich_pull_open [IsOpenImmersion g] {r : ℕ}
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = r + 1) (j : ℕ) :
    totalPull ops g 0 (pureRelDim_openImmersion k g) ∘ₗ sandwich ops C cp hC j =
      sandwich ops (C.pullbackFrameCover g) cp (C.pullbackFrameCover_card g hC) j ∘ₗ
        totalPull ops g 0 (pureRelDim_openImmersion k g)
proof:
:= by
  letI := pullbackProjectiveMap_isOver (k := k) C g
  letI := pullbackProjectiveMap_flat C g
  letI := C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos r))
  let D := C.pullbackFrameCover g
  let hD := C.pullbackFrameCover_card g hC
  letI := D.toBase_flat (D.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hD (Nat.succ_pos r))
  let PG := totalPull ops g 0 (pureRelDim_openImmersion k g)
  let PF := totalPull ops (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) 0 (pullbackProjectiveMap_pureRelDim_open (k := k) C g)
  let PC := totalPull ops C.toBase r (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC)
  let PD := totalPull ops D.toBase r (cp.projBundle_relDim D hD)
  have hb : PG ∘ₗ totalPush ops C.toBase = totalPush ops D.toBase ∘ₗ PF :=
    cp.base_change C.toBase g D.toBase (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) 0
      (pureRelDim_openImmersion k g) (pullbackProjectiveMap_pureRelDim_open (k := k) C g)
      (C.isPullback_pullbackProjectiveMap g)
  have hp : PF ∘ₗ ((xiCap ops C) ^ j) = ((xiCap ops D) ^ j) ∘ₗ PF :=
    xiCap_pow_pullbackProjectiveMap_open C g ops cp j
  have hc : PF ∘ₗ PC = PD ∘ₗ PG := projection_totalPull_open C g ops cp hC
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro α
  change PG (totalPush ops C.toBase ((((xiCap ops C) ^ j)) (PC α))) =
    totalPush ops D.toBase ((((xiCap ops D) ^ j)) (PD (PG α)))
  calc
    _ = totalPush ops D.toBase (PF ((((xiCap ops C) ^ j)) (PC α))) :=
      LinearMap.congr_fun hb _
    _ = totalPush ops D.toBase ((((xiCap ops D) ^ j)) (PF (PC α))) :=
      congrArg (totalPush ops D.toBase) (LinearMap.congr_fun hp (PC α))
    _ = _ := congrArg (fun z => totalPush ops D.toBase ((((xiCap ops D) ^ j)) z))
      (LinearMap.congr_fun hc α)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.segre_pull_open
statement:
theorem segre_pull_open [IsOpenImmersion g] {r : ℕ}
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = r + 1) (i : ℕ) :
    totalPull ops g 0 (pureRelDim_openImmersion k g) ∘ₗ segre ops C cp hC i =
      segre ops (C.pullbackFrameCover g) cp (C.pullbackFrameCover_card g hC) i ∘ₗ
        totalPull ops g 0 (pureRelDim_openImmersion k g)
proof:
:=
  sandwich_pull_open C g ops cp hC (r + i)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.segreOp_pull_open
statement:
theorem segreOp_pull_open [IsOpenImmersion g] (L : Y.Modules) (r : ℕ)
    (hL : HasConstantRank Y L r) (i : ℕ) :
    totalPull ops g 0 (pureRelDim_openImmersion k g) ∘ₗ segreOp ops cp L r hL i =
      segreOp ops cp ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj L) r
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X g L r hL) i ∘ₗ
        totalPull ops g 0 (pureRelDim_openImmersion k g)
proof:
:= by
  cases r with
  | zero => exact segreOp_pull_rankZero g ops cp 0 (pureRelDim_openImmersion k g) L hL i
  | succ r =>
    let C := (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hL).choose
    have hC := (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hL).choose_spec
    rw [segreOp_eq_segre ops cp C hL hC,
      segreOp_eq_segre ops cp (C.pullbackFrameCover g)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X g L (r + 1) hL) (C.pullbackFrameCover_card g hC)]
    exact segre_pull_open C g ops cp hC i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.pushedUnitMul_app_apply
statement:
theorem pushedUnitMul_app_apply {Y : Scheme.{u}} (V : Y.Opens) (b : Γ(Y, V)ˣ) (W : Y.Opens)
    (x : Γ(pushedUnit Y V, W)) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward V.ι).map
        (unitMulSheafIso (Units.map V.topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom b)).hom).app W x =
      (show Γ(pushedUnit Y V, W) from
        (restrictTopUnit (Units.map V.topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom b) (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)).1 *
          (show Γ(V.toScheme, V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W) from x))
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.restrictTopUnit_topIso_inv'
statement:
theorem restrictTopUnit_topIso_inv' {Y : Scheme.{u}} (V : Y.Opens) (a : Γ(Y, V)ˣ)
    (W : V.toScheme.Opens) :
    (restrictTopUnit (Units.map V.topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom a) W).1 =
      (show Γ(V.toScheme, W) from
        Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (V.ι_image_le W)).op a.1)
proof:
:= by
  change Y.presheaf.map _ (Y.presheaf.map _ a.1) =
    Y.presheaf.map _ a.1
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  congr 2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.pushedUnitPushforwardSectionIso_hom_restrict_app'
statement:
theorem pushedUnitPushforwardSectionIso_hom_restrict_app' (W : X.Opens) (x : Γ(X, U)) :
    (pushedUnitPushforwardSectionIso e U W).hom
      (X'.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE ((e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι_image_le
          ((e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ W)))).op
        (e.hom.app U x)) =
      X.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (U.ι_image_le (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W))).op x
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [pushedUnitPushforwardSectionIso,
    Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom]
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  let A := (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ
    ((e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ W))
  let B := U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)
  let hEq : e.hom ''ᵁ A = B := by
    dsimp only [A, B]
    rw [Scheme.Opens.ι_image_ι_preimage,
      Scheme.Opens.ι_image_ι_preimage,
      ← Scheme.Hom.preimage_inf,
      Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf,
      Scheme.Hom.opensRange_of_isIso, top_inf_eq]
  let α : op (e.hom ''ᵁ A) ⟶ op B :=
    (eqToIso hEq).symm.op.hom
  let i : op (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U) ⟶ op A :=
    (homOfLE ((e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι_image_le
      ((e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ W)))).op
  let j : op U ⟶ op B :=
    (homOfLE (U.ι_image_le (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W))).op
  change X.presheaf.map α
      ((e.hom.appIso A).inv
        (X'.presheaf.map i (e.hom.app U x))) =
    X.presheaf.map j x
  have hAU : A ≤ e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U := by
    exact (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι_image_le _
  have hi : i = (homOfLE hAU).op := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [hi]
  change X.presheaf.map α
      ((e.hom.appIso A).inv
        ((e.hom.appLE U A hAU) x)) =
    X.presheaf.map j x
  have happ := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (Scheme.Hom.appLE_appIso_inv e.hom hAU) x
  rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at happ
  rw [happ]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  congr 2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.pushedUnitPushforwardSectionIso_hom_mul
statement:
theorem pushedUnitPushforwardSectionIso_hom_mul (W : X.Opens)
    (x y : Γ(X', (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ ((e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ W)))) :
    (pushedUnitPushforwardSectionIso e U W).hom (x * y) =
      (show Γ(X, U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)) from (pushedUnitPushforwardSectionIso e U W).hom x) *
      (show Γ(X, U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)) from (pushedUnitPushforwardSectionIso e U W).hom y)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [pushedUnitPushforwardSectionIso]
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, Functor.mapIso_hom]
  let A := (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ ((e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ W))
  change X.presheaf.map _ ((e.hom.appIso A).inv (x * y)) =
    X.presheaf.map _ ((e.hom.appIso A).inv x) * X.presheaf.map _ ((e.hom.appIso A).inv y)
  rw [map_mul, map_mul]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.pushedUnitMul_pushforward_naturality
statement:
theorem pushedUnitMul_pushforward_naturality (a : Γ(X, U)ˣ) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward e.hom).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).map
          (unitMulSheafIso (Units.map (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom
            (Units.map (e.hom.app U).hom.toMonoidHom a))).hom) ≫
        (pushedUnitPushforwardIso e U).hom =
      (pushedUnitPushforwardIso e U).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).map
          (unitMulSheafIso (Units.map U.topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom a)).hom
proof:
:= by
  ext W x
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  change (pushedUnitPushforwardSectionIso e U W).hom
      (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).map
        (unitMulSheafIso (Units.map (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom
          (Units.map (e.hom.app U).hom.toMonoidHom a))).hom).app (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ W) x) =
    (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).map
      (unitMulSheafIso (Units.map U.topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom a)).hom).app W
        ((pushedUnitPushforwardSectionIso e U W).hom x))
  refine (congrArg (pushedUnitPushforwardSectionIso e U W).hom
    (pushedUnitMul_app_apply (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U) _ (e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ W) x)).trans ?_
  refine Eq.trans (pushedUnitPushforwardSectionIso_hom_mul e U W _ _) ?_
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (pushedUnitMul_app_apply U _ W _).symm
  congr 1
  rw [restrictTopUnit_topIso_inv', restrictTopUnit_topIso_inv']
  exact pushedUnitPushforwardSectionIso_hom_restrict_app' e U W a.1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.pushedUnitRestriction_pushforwardIsoOf_naturality
statement:
theorem pushedUnitRestriction_pushforwardIsoOf_naturality {V V' : X'.Opens} {U U' : X.Opens}
    (hV : V' ≤ V) (hU : U' ≤ U) (h : V = e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U) (h' : V' = e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U') :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward e.hom).map (pushedUnitRestriction hV) ≫
        (pushedUnitPushforwardIsoOf e h').hom =
      (pushedUnitPushforwardIsoOf e h).hom ≫ pushedUnitRestriction hU
proof:
:= by
  subst h h'
  simp only [pushedUnitPushforwardIsoOf, eqToIso_refl, Functor.mapIso_refl, Iso.refl_trans]
  exact pushedUnitPushforwardIso_naturality e hU

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.pushedUnitMul_pushforwardIsoOf_naturality
statement:
theorem pushedUnitMul_pushforwardIsoOf_naturality {V : X'.Opens} {U : X.Opens}
    (h : V = e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U) (a : Γ(X, U)ˣ) (b : Γ(X', V)ˣ)
    (hab : HEq (e.hom.app U a.1) b.1) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward e.hom).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward V.ι).map
          (unitMulSheafIso (Units.map V.topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom b)).hom) ≫
        (pushedUnitPushforwardIsoOf e h).hom =
      (pushedUnitPushforwardIsoOf e h).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).map
          (unitMulSheafIso (Units.map U.topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom a)).hom
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  have hb : b = Units.map (e.hom.app U).hom.toMonoidHom a := Units.ext (eq_of_heq hab).symm
  subst hb
  simp only [pushedUnitPushforwardIsoOf, eqToIso_refl, Functor.mapIso_refl, Iso.refl_trans]
  exact pushedUnitMul_pushforward_naturality e U a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.tg_preimage_coordinateOpen
statement:
theorem tg_preimage_coordinateOpen (i : Fin (n + 1)) :

:=

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.tg_preimage_coordinateOverlapOpen
statement:
theorem tg_preimage_coordinateOverlapOpen (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :

:=
