name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.tg_descentLeft_naturality
statement:
theorem tg_descentLeft_naturality :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (tg ε n).hom).map (coordinateDescentLeft S n) ≫
        (tgOverlapCochainsIso ε n).hom =
      (tgChartCochainsIso ε n).hom ≫ coordinateDescentLeft R n
proof:
:= by
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  rintro ⟨i, j⟩
  simp only [tgOverlapCochainsIso, tgChartCochainsIso, Iso.trans_hom, PreservesProduct.iso_hom,
    Category.assoc, coordinateDescentLeft_π]
  rw [Pi.mapIso_hom_π]
  rw [piComparison_comp_π_assoc, Pi.mapIso_hom_π_assoc, piComparison_comp_π_assoc]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc, coordinateDescentLeft_π, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  congr 1
  exact pushedUnitRestriction_pushforwardIsoOf_naturality (tg ε n) _ _
    (tg_preimage_coordinateOpen ε n i) (tg_preimage_coordinateOverlapOpen ε n i j)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.tg_restriction_naturality
statement:
theorem tg_restriction_naturality (i j l : Fin (n + 1))
    (hV : coordinateOverlapOpen S n i j ≤ coordinateOpen S n l)
    (hU : coordinateOverlapOpen R n i j ≤ coordinateOpen R n l) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (tg ε n).hom).map (pushedUnitRestriction hV) ≫
        (tgOverlapIso ε n i j).hom =
      (tgChartIso ε n l).hom ≫ pushedUnitRestriction hU
proof:
:=
  pushedUnitRestriction_pushforwardIsoOf_naturality (tg ε n) hV hU
    (tg_preimage_coordinateOpen ε n l) (tg_preimage_coordinateOverlapOpen ε n i j)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.tg_transition_naturality
statement:
theorem tg_transition_naturality (d : ℤ) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (tg ε n).hom).map (pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition S n d i j) ≫
        (tgOverlapIso ε n i j).hom =
      (tgOverlapIso ε n i j).hom ≫ pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition R n d i j
proof:
:=
  pushedUnitMul_pushforwardIsoOf_naturality (tg ε n) (tg_preimage_coordinateOverlapOpen ε n i j)
    (twistTransitionSectionUnit R n d i j) (twistTransitionSectionUnit S n d i j)
    (map_app_twistTransitionSectionUnit_heq ε.toRingHom n d i j)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.tg_descentRight_naturality
statement:
theorem tg_descentRight_naturality (d : ℤ) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (tg ε n).hom).map (coordinateDescentRight S n d) ≫
        (tgOverlapCochainsIso ε n).hom =
      (tgChartCochainsIso ε n).hom ≫ coordinateDescentRight R n d
proof:
:= by
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  rintro ⟨i, j⟩
  simp only [tgOverlapCochainsIso, tgChartCochainsIso, Iso.trans_hom, PreservesProduct.iso_hom,
    Category.assoc, coordinateDescentRight_π]
  rw [Pi.mapIso_hom_π]
  rw [piComparison_comp_π_assoc, Pi.mapIso_hom_π_assoc, piComparison_comp_π_assoc]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc, coordinateDescentRight_π, Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_comp,
    Category.assoc, Category.assoc]
  congr 1
  dsimp only
  rw [tg_transition_naturality, ← Category.assoc]
  rw [tg_restriction_naturality, Category.assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.tg_descent_naturality
statement:
theorem tg_descent_naturality (d : ℤ) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (tg ε n).hom).map
          (coordinateDescentLeft S n - coordinateDescentRight S n d) ≫
        (tgOverlapCochainsIso ε n).hom =
      (tgChartCochainsIso ε n).hom ≫
        (coordinateDescentLeft R n - coordinateDescentRight R n d)
proof:
:= by
  let P := Scheme.Modules.pushforward (tg ε n).hom
  letI : P.Additive := by
    constructor
    intro M N f h
    rfl
  change P.map (coordinateDescentLeft S n - coordinateDescentRight S n d) ≫
      (tgOverlapCochainsIso ε n).hom =
    (tgChartCochainsIso ε n).hom ≫ (coordinateDescentLeft R n - coordinateDescentRight R n d)
  rw [Functor.map_sub, Preadditive.sub_comp, Preadditive.comp_sub, tg_descentLeft_naturality,
    tg_descentRight_naturality]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.caseISpaceIso_hom_toBase
statement:
theorem caseISpaceIso_hom_toBase :
    (caseISpaceIso k n).hom ≫ (caseICover k n).toBase = toSpec k n
proof:
:= by
  have h := AffineFrameCover.standardChartEmb_toBase (caseICover k n) PUnit.unit (caseIEquiv k n)
  have h1 : (isAffineOpen_top (Spk k)).fromSpec =
      Spec.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv := by
    rw [IsAffineOpen.fromSpec_top]
    simp
  have h2 : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv ≫
      CommRingCat.ofHom (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.toRingHom =
      𝟙 _ := (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv_hom_id
  have h3 := SchemeProjectiveSpace.map_toSpec
    (RingEquiv.toRingHom (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv) n
  have e1 : (caseISpaceIso k n).hom ≫ (caseICover k n).toBase =
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.map
          (RingEquiv.toRingHom (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv) n ≫
        (AffineFrameCover.standardChartEmb (caseICover k n) PUnit.unit (caseIEquiv k n) ≫
          (caseICover k n).toBase) := by
    simp only [caseISpaceIso, Iso.trans_hom, asIso_hom, Category.assoc]
    rfl
  refine e1.trans ((congrArg (fun t => SchemeProjectiveSpace.map _ n ≫ t) h).trans ?_)
  refine (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans ?_
  refine (congrArg (fun t => t ≫ _) h3).trans ?_
  refine (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans ?_
  refine (congrArg (fun t => toSpec k n ≫ t) ?_).trans (Category.comp_id _)
  refine (congrArg (fun t => Spec.map _ ≫ t) h1).trans ?_
  refine (Spec.map_comp _ _).symm.trans ?_
  exact (congrArg Spec.map h2).trans (Spec.map_id _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E27.weilGate_of_hCD
proof:
:= by
  intro σ hreg hid m v hv w hw q hq hB hD
  refine ⟨weilGate_mem_range P m v hv w hw q hq hB hD, ?_⟩
  have hN := E16.hasConstantRank_twistedLine P.toB hL
  haveI : (E16.twistedLine P.toB L).IsLocallyFree := hN.isFiniteLocallyFree.isLocallyFree
  haveI : (E16.twistedLine P.toB L).IsFinitePresentation :=
    IsFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation P.toB.scheme hN.isFiniteLocallyFree
  haveI : Flat P.toD.toBase := E28.flat_toD P hCD
  have hnotw := hnot_of_regular P hL hCD σ hreg hid m v hv w hw hB
  let z₀ : pointClosureScheme w := pointClosureGenericPoint w
  have hsupp : pointClosureι w z₀ ∉ (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).support := by
    rw [hid, pointClosureι_genericPoint]
    exact E26.notMem_support_ker P.jHom w hnotw
  have hu := E26.wCoord_isUnit_of_notMem_support σ (pointClosureι w z₀) hsupp
    (wFrameAt (E16.twistedLine P.toB L) hN (pointClosureι w z₀))
  have hM := isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure _ hN w
  have hrank := m7s_genericRank_pointClosure _ hN w
  obtain ⟨bf, hb⟩ := E26.exists_refFrame (hL := hN) w (E26.sectionOfHom σ) z₀ hu
  refine ⟨z₀, bf, fun z => ?_⟩
  refine E28.coeff_eq_ite_of_parts (k := k) P v hv w hw q hq hB hD
    (fun z => Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame hM hrank bf z)

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionSpecTildeNativeTensorMap_comparison
statement:
theorem cosectionSpecTildeNativeTensorMap_comparison (φ : R →+* S) (M : ModuleCat R) :
    cosectionSpecTildeNativeTensorMap φ M ≫
      (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of S)).map ((tildePullbackSpecMapIso φ).app M).hom =
    (tildeAffineGlobalSectionsAdjunction (.of S)).unit.app
      ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φ).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  apply ((ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj φ).homEquiv _ _).injective
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
  simp only [cosectionSpecTildeNativeTensorMap, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact cosectionTildePullback_unit_expanded φ M

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionSpecTildeNativeTensorMap_isIso
statement:
theorem cosectionSpecTildeNativeTensorMap_isIso (φ : R →+* S) (M : ModuleCat R) :
    IsIso (cosectionSpecTildeNativeTensorMap φ M)
proof:
:= by
  have h := cosectionSpecTildeNativeTensorMap_comparison φ M
  have hu : (tildeAffineGlobalSectionsAdjunction (.of S)).unit.app
      ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φ).obj M) =
      (tilde.isoTop (R := .of S) ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φ).obj M)).hom := by
    with_unfolding_all rfl
  have hm : cosectionSpecTildeNativeTensorMap φ M =
      (tilde.isoTop (R := .of S) ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φ).obj M)).hom ≫
      (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of S)).map ((tildePullbackSpecMapIso φ).app M).inv := by
    have hp := congrArg (fun f => f ≫
      (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of S)).map ((tildePullbackSpecMapIso φ).app M).inv) h
    rw [hu] at hp
    rw [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp] at hp
    erw [Iso.hom_inv_id] at hp
    have hid := (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of S)).map_id
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).obj
        ((tilde.functor (.of R)).obj M))
    have hc := congrArg (fun f => cosectionSpecTildeNativeTensorMap φ M ≫ f) hid
    simp only [Category.comp_id] at hc
    with_unfolding_all exact hc.symm.trans hp
  rw [hm]
  have hi : IsIso ((tilde.isoTop (R := .of S) ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φ).obj M)) ≪≫
      ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of S)).mapIso
        ((tildePullbackSpecMapIso φ).app M)).symm).hom := inferInstance
  with_unfolding_all exact hi

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionSpecNativeSectionMap_naturality
statement:
theorem cosectionSpecNativeSectionMap_naturality (φ : R →+* S)
    {E F : (Spec (.of R)).Modules} (f : E ⟶ F) :
    (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R)).map f ≫ cosectionSpecNativeSectionMap φ F =
      cosectionSpecNativeSectionMap φ E ≫ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).map
        ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of S)).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).map f))
proof:
:= by
  let η := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).unit
  have hn := η.naturality f
  have hg := congrArg ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R)).map) hn
  have hd := (moduleSpecΓPushforwardNatIso (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)).hom.naturality
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).map f)
  simp only [Functor.map_comp, Functor.id_map, Functor.comp_map] at hg hd
  have hp := congrArg (fun k => k ≫
    (moduleSpecΓPushforwardNatIso (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)).hom.app
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).obj F)) hg
  have hq := congrArg (fun k => (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R)).map (η.app E) ≫ k) hd
  dsimp only [cosectionSpecNativeSectionMap]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  with_unfolding_all exact hp.trans hq

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionSpecSectionCounit_triangle
statement:
theorem cosectionSpecSectionCounit_triangle (E : (Spec (.of R)).Modules) :
    (tildeAffineGlobalSectionsAdjunction (.of R)).unit.app
      ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R)).obj E) ≫
    (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R)).map (Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓ (R := .of R) E) = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  exact (tildeAffineGlobalSectionsAdjunction (.of R)).right_triangle_components E

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionSpecNativeTensorMap_counit
statement:
theorem cosectionSpecNativeTensorMap_counit (φ : R →+* S) (E : (Spec (.of R)).Modules) :
    cosectionSpecTildeNativeTensorMap φ ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R)).obj E) ≫
      (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of S)).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).map
          (Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓ (R := .of R) E)) =
      cosectionSpecNativeTensorMap φ E
proof:
:= by
  apply ((ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj φ).homEquiv _ _).injective
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
  simp only [cosectionSpecTildeNativeTensorMap, cosectionSpecNativeTensorMap,
    Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have hn := cosectionSpecNativeSectionMap_naturality φ
    (Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓ (R := .of R) E)
  have hp := congrArg (fun f =>
    (tildeAffineGlobalSectionsAdjunction (.of R)).unit.app
      ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R)).obj E) ≫ f) hn.symm
  have hq := congrArg (fun f => f ≫ cosectionSpecNativeSectionMap φ E)
    (cosectionSpecSectionCounit_triangle E)
  simp only [Category.assoc] at hq
  have hr := hp.trans hq
  dsimp only [cosectionSpecNativeSectionMap] at hr
  simp only [Category.assoc] at hr ⊢
  with_unfolding_all exact hr

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionSpecNativeTensorMap_isIso
statement:
theorem cosectionSpecNativeTensorMap_isIso (φ : R →+* S)
    (E : (Spec (.of R)).Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent] :
    IsIso (cosectionSpecNativeTensorMap φ E)
proof:
:= by
  have h := cosectionSpecNativeTensorMap_counit φ E
  have he : (Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓ (R := .of R) E) =
      (cosectionAffineCounitIso E).hom := by
    with_unfolding_all rfl
  rw [he] at h
  letI := cosectionSpecTildeNativeTensorMap_isIso φ
    ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R)).obj E)
  have hi : IsIso ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of S)).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).map
        (cosectionAffineCounitIso E).hom)) := by
    have hi' : IsIso ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of S)).mapIso
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).mapIso
        (cosectionAffineCounitIso E))).hom := inferInstance
    with_unfolding_all exact hi'
  letI := hi
  rw [← h]
  infer_instance

statement:
theorem cosectionAffineChartTop_unit (E : Y.Modules) (W : Y.Opens) (hVW : V.1 ≤ W) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exists_lineBundleLocalDataAt
statement:
theorem exists_lineBundleLocalDataAt
    (M : X.Modules) (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree X M)
    (hrank : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X M = 1) (x : X) :
    Nonempty (LineBundleLocalData X M x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin⟩ := hM.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := hqfin
  have hcover : IsOpenCover q.X :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff X q.X).mp q.coversTop
  have hxUnion : x ∈ ⋃ i, (q.X i : Set X) := by
    rw [hcover.iSup_set_eq_univ]
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hxUnion
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := hxUnion
  let I := (q.generators i).I
  letI : (q.generators i).IsFiniteType :=
    SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType i
  letI : Finite I := by
    dsimp only [I]
    infer_instance
  letI : Fintype I := Fintype.ofFinite I
  have hηi : genericPoint X ∈ q.X i := by
    let hspec : Specializes (genericPoint X) x :=
      (genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial
    exact hspec.mem_open (q.X i).isOpen hxi
  have hcard : Fintype.card I = 1 := by
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
    rw [← AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank_eq_natCard_localGenerators
      X M q i hηi]
    exact hrank
  letI : Unique I :=
    (Fintype.card_eq_one_iff_nonempty_unique.mp hcard).some
  let eI : PUnit ≃ I := Equiv.ofUnique PUnit I
  let eFree : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over (q.X i)) PUnit ≅
      SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over (q.X i)) I :=
    (SheafOfModules.freeFunctor (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over (q.X i))).mapIso eI.toIso
  exact ⟨
    { U := q.X i
      mem := hxi
      frame := eFree ≪≫ asIso (q.generators i).π }⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleLocalDataAt_coversTop
statement:
theorem lineBundleLocalDataAt_coversTop
    (M : X.Modules) (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree X M)
    (hrank : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X M = 1) :
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop
      (fun x : X ↦ (lineBundleLocalDataAt X M hM hrank x).U)
proof:
:= by

  apply top_unique
  intro x hx
  change x ∈ ((⨆ y : X,
    (lineBundleLocalDataAt X M hM hrank y).U : X.Opens) : Set X)
  rw [Opens.coe_iSup]
  exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
    ⟨x, (lineBundleLocalDataAt X M hM hrank x).mem⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.restrictUnitHom_app_one
statement:
lemma restrictUnitHom_app_one {U V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (f : (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).over U ⟶
      (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).over U) :
    X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op
        (((SheafOfModules.evaluation (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)
          (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))).map f) (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op U))) =
      ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (X.ringCatSheaf.over V)
        (op (Over.mk (𝟙 V)))).map (restrictHomOverLE X hVU f))
          (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op V))
proof:
:= by
  change X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op
      (f.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op U))) =
    f.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hVU))) (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op V))
  let g : Over.mk (homOfLE hVU) ⟶ Over.mk (𝟙 U) :=
    Over.homMk (homOfLE hVU) (by rfl)
  have h := f.val.naturality g.op
  have h' := congrArg (fun q => q (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op U))) h
  change f.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hVU)))
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op 1) =
    X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op
      (f.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op U))) at h'
  rw [map_one] at h'
  exact h'.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.unitOverHom_ext
statement:
lemma unitOverHom_ext {U : X.Opens}
    {f g : SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over U) ⟶
      SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)}
    (h : ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)
          (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))).map f) (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op U)) =
      ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)
          (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))).map g) (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op U))) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply (SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv _).injective
  apply PresheafOfModules.sections_ext
  intro W
  let q : W.unop ⟶ Over.mk (𝟙 U) := Over.homMk W.unop.hom (by rfl)
  rw [← PresheafOfModules.sections_property
      (SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv _ f) q.op,
    ← PresheafOfModules.sections_property
      (SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv _ g) q.op]
  exact congrArg (fun s ↦
    (SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).val.map q.op s) h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.globalUnitOverHom_ext
statement:
lemma globalUnitOverHom_ext {U : X.Opens}
    {f g : (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).over U ⟶
      (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).over U}
    (h : ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)
          (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))).map f) (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op U)) =
      ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)
          (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))).map g) (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op U))) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  let e := globalUnitOverIso (X := X) U
  have hlocal :
      ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)
          (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))).map (e.inv ≫ f ≫ e.hom))
          (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op U)) =
        ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)
          (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))).map (e.inv ≫ g ≫ e.hom))
          (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op U)) := by
    let E := SheafOfModules.evaluation (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)
      (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))
    let R := (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj.obj (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))
    let oneLocal : E.obj (SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)) :=
      (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op U))
    let a : R := E.map e.inv oneLocal
    let oneGlobal : E.obj ((SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).over U) :=
      (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op U))
    simp only [Functor.map_comp, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
    change E.map e.hom (E.map f a) = E.map e.hom (E.map g a)
    apply congrArg (fun z ↦ E.map e.hom z)
    have hf := (E.map f).hom.map_smul a oneGlobal
    have hg := (E.map g).hom.map_smul a oneGlobal
    have ha : a • oneGlobal = a := by
      change a * 1 = a
      exact mul_one a
    rw [ha] at hf hg
    have hfg : E.map f oneGlobal = E.map g oneGlobal := by
      simpa only [oneGlobal] using h
    rw [hf, hg, hfg]
  have heq : e.inv ≫ f ≫ e.hom = e.inv ≫ g ≫ e.hom :=
    unitOverHom_ext hlocal
  apply (cancel_epi e.inv).1
  apply (cancel_mono e.hom).1
  simpa only [Category.assoc] using heq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.globalFrameOverLE_eq_frameOverLE
statement:
theorem globalFrameOverLE_eq_frameOverLE (d : LineBundleLocalData X M x)
    (V : X.Opens) (hVU : V ≤ d.U) :
    d.globalFrameOverLE V hVU =
      (freeOverIso X V PUnit).symm ≪≫ d.frameOverLE V hVU
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  apply (cancel_epi (freeOverIso X V PUnit).hom).1
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  rw [globalFrameOverLE_hom]
  change (freeOverIso X V PUnit).hom ≫
      restrictHomOverLE X hVU
        ((freeOverIso X d.U PUnit).inv ≫ d.frame.hom) = _
  change _ = (freeOverMapIso X d.U V hVU PUnit).hom ≫
    (SheafOfModules.overMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)).map d.frame.hom ≫
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)).hom.app M
  apply (M.over V).freeHomEquiv.injective
  funext i
  simp only [SheafOfModules.freeHomEquiv_comp_apply]
  unfold restrictHomOverLE
  rw [SheafOfModules.sectionsMap_comp, SheafOfModules.sectionsMap_comp,
    SheafOfModules.sectionsMap_comp]
  rw [SheafOfModules.freeHomEquiv_apply]
  rw [sectionsMap_freeOverIso_hom_freeSection]
  have hbasis :
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit).val.map
          (homOfLE hVU).op
          ((SheafOfModules.freeSection i).eval (op d.U)) =
        (SheafOfModules.freeSection i).eval (op V) := by
    exact PresheafOfModules.sections_property
      (SheafOfModules.freeSection i) (homOfLE hVU).op
  rw [← hbasis]
  rw [sectionsMap_overFunctorMap_inv_overSectionOfElement]
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  erw [SheafOfModules.sectionsMap_comp]
  rw [← sectionsMap_freeOverIso_hom_freeSection X d.U PUnit i]
  rw [sectionsMap_overMapSection]
  rw [← SheafOfModules.sectionsMap_comp]
  simp only [Iso.hom_inv_id, SheafOfModules.sectionsMap_id]
  rw [sectionsMap_overMapSection]
  rw [SheafOfModules.freeHomEquiv_apply]
  rw [sectionsMap_freeOverMapIso_hom_freeSection]
  rw [sectionsMap_overMapSection]
  rfl

theorem restrictIsoOverLE_globalFreeFrame {U V : X.Opens}

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.frameOverLE_trans
proof:
:= SheafOfModules.overMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hWV)
    let c := SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hWV)
    freeOverMapIso X V W hWV PUnit ≪≫
        F.mapIso (d.frameOverLE V hVU) ≪≫ c.app M =
      d.frameOverLE W (hWV.trans hVU) := by
  dsimp only
  let q := freeOverMapIso X V W hWV PUnit ≪≫
    (SheafOfModules.overMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hWV)).mapIso
      (d.frameOverLE V hVU) ≪≫
    (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hWV)).app M
  let b := freeOverIso X W PUnit
  have hq := restrictIsoOverLE_globalFreeFrame hWV
    (d.frameOverLE V hVU)
  have hV := globalFrameOverLE_eq_frameOverLE d V hVU
  have hW := globalFrameOverLE_eq_frameOverLE d W (hWV.trans hVU)
  have htrans := restrictIsoOverLE_trans hWV hVU d.globalFrame
  have hpre : b.symm ≪≫ q =
      b.symm ≪≫ d.frameOverLE W (hWV.trans hVU) := by
    calc
      b.symm ≪≫ q = restrictIsoOverLE hWV
          ((freeOverIso X V PUnit).symm ≪≫ d.frameOverLE V hVU) := hq.symm
      _ = restrictIsoOverLE hWV (d.globalFrameOverLE V hVU) :=
        congrArg (restrictIsoOverLE hWV) hV.symm
      _ = d.globalFrameOverLE W (hWV.trans hVU) := htrans
      _ = b.symm ≪≫ d.frameOverLE W (hWV.trans hVU) := hW
  have h := congrArg (fun z ↦ b ≪≫ z) hpre
  simpa [b, q] using h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFreePUnitFrameOver_naturality
statement:
theorem tensorFreePUnitFrameOver_naturality (V : X.Opens)
    (a b : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V) PUnit ≅
      SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V) PUnit) :
    tensorFreePUnitFrameOver (X := X) V ≪≫
        tensorSheafOverMapIso X V a b ≪≫
          (tensorFreePUnitFrameOver (X := X) V).symm =
      b ≪≫ a
proof:
:= by
  let u := SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V)
  let au : SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over V) ≅
      SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over V) := u.symm ≪≫ a ≪≫ u
  let bu : SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over V) ≅
      SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over V) := u.symm ≪≫ b ≪≫ u
  have hmap :
      tensorSheafOverMapIso X V u.symm u.symm ≪≫
          tensorSheafOverMapIso X V a b ≪≫
            (tensorSheafOverMapIso X V u.symm u.symm).symm =
        tensorSheafOverMapIso X V au bu := by
    apply Iso.ext
    simp [tensorSheafOverMapIso, au, bu]
    let F := SheafOfModules.identitySheafificationOver
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.ringCatSheaf V
    letI : MonoidalCategory
        (_root_.PresheafOfModules.{u} (X.ringCatSheaf.over V).obj) :=
      inferInstanceAs (MonoidalCategory (_root_.PresheafOfModules.{u}
        (((Over.forget V).op ⋙ X.presheaf) ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)))
    change F.map (u.inv.val ⊗ₘ u.inv.val) ≫
        F.map (a.hom.val ⊗ₘ b.hom.val) ≫
          F.map (u.hom.val ⊗ₘ u.hom.val) =
      F.map ((u.inv.val ≫ a.hom.val ≫ u.hom.val) ⊗ₘ
        (u.inv.val ≫ b.hom.val ≫ u.hom.val))
    rw [← F.map_comp, MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_comp_tensorHom]
    rw [← F.map_comp, MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_comp_tensorHom]
  have hunit := tensorSheafOverLeftUnitor_unit_naturality X V au bu
  let L := tensorSheafOverLeftUnitor X V
    (SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over V))
  let T := tensorSheafOverMapIso X V u.symm u.symm
  let A := tensorSheafOverMapIso X V a b
  have hmap_whiskered :
      u ≪≫ L.symm ≪≫ T ≪≫ A ≪≫ T.symm ≪≫ L ≪≫ u.symm =
        u ≪≫ L.symm ≪≫ tensorSheafOverMapIso X V au bu ≪≫
          L ≪≫ u.symm := by
    simpa only [L, T, A, Iso.trans_assoc] using
      congrArg (fun q ↦ u ≪≫ L.symm ≪≫ q ≪≫ L ≪≫ u.symm) hmap
  have hunit_whiskered :
      u ≪≫ L.symm ≪≫ tensorSheafOverMapIso X V au bu ≪≫
          L ≪≫ u.symm =
        u ≪≫ (bu ≪≫ au) ≪≫ u.symm := by
    simpa only [L, Iso.trans_assoc] using
      congrArg (fun q ↦ u ≪≫ q ≪≫ u.symm) hunit
  unfold tensorFreePUnitFrameOver
  change u ≪≫ L.symm ≪≫ T ≪≫ A ≪≫ T.symm ≪≫ L ≪≫ u.symm =
    b ≪≫ a
  calc
    _ = u ≪≫ L.symm ≪≫ tensorSheafOverMapIso X V au bu ≪≫
        L ≪≫ u.symm := hmap_whiskered
    _ = u ≪≫ (bu ≪≫ au) ≪≫ u.symm := hunit_whiskered
    _ = b ≪≫ a := by simp [au, bu]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.freePUnitIsoUnit_overMap_naturality
proof:
:= SheafOfModules.overMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)
    let η := SheafOfModules.overMapUnitIso
      (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (homOfLE hVU)
    (freeOverMapIso X U V hVU PUnit).inv ≫
        (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
          (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V)).hom =
      F.map (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
          (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).hom ≫ η.hom := by
  dsimp only
  let F := SheafOfModules.overMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)
  let q := freeOverMapIso X U V hVU PUnit
  apply (cancel_epi q.hom).1
  change q.hom ≫ q.inv ≫
      (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
        (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V)).hom =
    q.hom ≫ F.map (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
      (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).hom ≫
        (SheafOfModules.overMapUnitIso
          (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (homOfLE hVU)).hom
  rw [q.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  apply (SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over V)).freeHomEquiv.injective
  funext i
  apply (SheafOfModules.unit
    (X.ringCatSheaf.over V)).unitHomEquiv.symm.injective
  rw [SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv_symm_freeHomEquiv_apply,
    SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv_symm_freeHomEquiv_apply]
  simp only [q, freeOverMapIso, SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit]
  rw [SheafOfModules.ιFree_mapFreeIso_hom_assoc]
  change SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V) i ≫
      (coproductUniqueIso fun _ : PUnit ↦
        SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over V)).hom =
    F.map (SheafOfModules.ιFree
      (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) i) ≫
      F.map ((coproductUniqueIso fun _ : PUnit ↦
        SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).hom)
  rw [← F.map_comp]
  obtain rfl : i = default := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  change
    (coproductUniqueIso fun _ : PUnit ↦
      SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over V)).inv ≫
        (coproductUniqueIso fun _ : PUnit ↦
          SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over V)).hom =
      F.map
        ((coproductUniqueIso fun _ : PUnit ↦
          SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).inv ≫
        (coproductUniqueIso fun _ : PUnit ↦
          SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).hom)
  simp
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.freeOverIso_overMap_naturality
proof:
:= SheafOfModules.overMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)
    let c := SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)
    (freeOverMapIso X U V hVU PUnit).hom ≫
        F.map (freeOverIso X U PUnit).hom ≫
          c.hom.app (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit) =
      (freeOverIso X V PUnit).hom := by
  dsimp only
  let p : U := Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty U)
  let L := SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit
  let d₀ : LineBundleLocalData X L p.1 :=
    { U := U
      mem := p.2
      frame := freeOverIso X U PUnit }
  let c := SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)
  have h := globalFrameOverLE_eq_frameOverLE d₀ V hVU
  have hglobal : d₀.globalFrame = Iso.refl _ := by
    dsimp only [d₀, globalFrame]
    simp
  have hleft : d₀.globalFrameOverLE V hVU = Iso.refl _ := by
    change restrictIsoOverLE hVU d₀.globalFrame = Iso.refl _
    rw [hglobal]
    dsimp only [restrictIsoOverLE]
    change (c.app L).symm ≪≫ Iso.refl _ ≪≫ c.app L = Iso.refl _
    simp
  rw [hleft] at h
  have hframe : d₀.frameOverLE V hVU = freeOverIso X V PUnit := by
    have h' := congrArg (fun z ↦ (freeOverIso X V PUnit) ≪≫ z) h
    simpa using h'.symm
  have hh := congrArg Iso.hom hframe
  dsimp only [L] at hh
  dsimp only [d₀, frameOverLE, Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom] at hh
  change (freeOverMapIso X U V hVU PUnit).hom ≫
      (SheafOfModules.overMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)).map
        (freeOverIso X U PUnit).hom ≫
      ((SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf
        (homOfLE hVU)).app
          (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit)).hom =
    (freeOverIso X V PUnit).hom
  exact hh

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.unitToGlobalFree_overMap_naturality
proof:
:= SheafOfModules.overMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)
    let c := SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)
    let η := SheafOfModules.overMapUnitIso
      (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (homOfLE hVU)
    let uU := SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
      (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U)
    let uV := SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
      (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V)
    uV.inv ≫ (freeOverIso X V PUnit).hom =
      η.inv ≫ F.map (uU.inv ≫ (freeOverIso X U PUnit).hom) ≫
        c.hom.app (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit) := by
  dsimp only
  let F := SheafOfModules.overMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)
  let c := SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)
  let η := SheafOfModules.overMapUnitIso
    (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (homOfLE hVU)
  let q := freeOverMapIso X U V hVU PUnit
  let uU := SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
    (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U)
  let uV := SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
    (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V)
  have huIso : q.symm ≪≫ uV = F.mapIso uU ≪≫ η := by
    apply Iso.ext
    exact freePUnitIsoUnit_overMap_naturality hVU
  have huInv := congrArg Iso.inv huIso
  have hu : uV.inv ≫ q.hom = η.inv ≫ F.map uU.inv := by
    simpa only [Iso.trans_inv, Iso.symm_inv, Functor.mapIso_inv] using huInv
  have hf := freeOverIso_overMap_naturality hVU
  rw [← hf]
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  rw [hu]
  change η.inv ≫ F.map uU.inv ≫
      F.map (freeOverIso X U PUnit).hom ≫
        c.hom.app (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit) =
    η.inv ≫ F.map (uU.inv ≫ (freeOverIso X U PUnit).hom) ≫
      c.hom.app (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit)
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  exact congrArg (fun z ↦ η.inv ≫ z ≫
    c.hom.app (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit))
      (F.map_comp uU.inv (freeOverIso X U PUnit).hom).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameAdjunct_overMap_app
statement:
theorem tensorFrameAdjunct_overMap_app {N : X.Modules}
    {U V : X.Opens} [Nonempty U] (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (d : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) PUnit ≅ M.over U)
    (e : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) PUnit ≅ N.over U)
    (W : (Over V)ᵒᵖ) :
    let F
proof:
:= SheafOfModules.overMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)
    let c := SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)
    let dV := freeOverMapIso X U V hVU PUnit ≪≫ F.mapIso d ≪≫ c.app M
    let eV := freeOverMapIso X U V hVU PUnit ≪≫ F.mapIso e ≪≫ c.app N
    (tensorFrameAdjunct U d e).app ((Over.map (homOfLE hVU)).op.obj W) =
      (tensorFrameAdjunct V dV eV).app W := by
  dsimp only
  let F := SheafOfModules.overMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)
  let c := SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)
  let q := freeOverMapIso X U V hVU PUnit
  let dV := q ≪≫ F.mapIso d ≪≫ c.app M
  let eV := q ≪≫ F.mapIso e ≪≫ c.app N
  let uU := SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
    (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U)
  let uV := SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
    (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V)
  let μU := Functor.Monoidal.μIso
    (PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀OfCommRingCat
      (Over.forget U) X.presheaf) M.val N.val
  let μV := Functor.Monoidal.μIso
    (PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀OfCommRingCat
      (Over.forget V) X.presheaf) M.val N.val
  letI : MonoidalCategory
      (_root_.PresheafOfModules.{u} (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj) :=
    inferInstanceAs (MonoidalCategory (_root_.PresheafOfModules.{u}
      ((((Over.forget U).op ⋙ X.presheaf) ⋙
        forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))))
  letI : MonoidalCategory
      (_root_.PresheafOfModules.{u} (X.ringCatSheaf.over V).obj) :=
    inferInstanceAs (MonoidalCategory (_root_.PresheafOfModules.{u}
      ((((Over.forget V).op ⋙ X.presheaf) ⋙
        forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))))
  let kU := (d.inv.val ⊗ₘ e.inv.val) ≫
    (uU.hom.val ⊗ₘ uU.hom.val) ≫
    (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor
      (SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).val).hom ≫
    (SheafOfModules.forget (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).map
      (uU.inv ≫ (freeOverIso X U PUnit).hom)
  let kV := (dV.inv.val ⊗ₘ eV.inv.val) ≫
    (uV.hom.val ⊗ₘ uV.hom.val) ≫
    (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor
      (SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over V)).val).hom ≫
    (SheafOfModules.forget (X.ringCatSheaf.over V)).map
      (uV.inv ≫ (freeOverIso X V PUnit).hom)
  unfold tensorFrameAdjunct
  dsimp only
  change (μU.inv ≫ kU).app ((Over.map (homOfLE hVU)).op.obj W) =
    (μV.inv ≫ kV).app W
  apply (cancel_epi (μU.hom.app
    ((Over.map (homOfLE hVU)).op.obj W))).1
  calc
    _ = kU.app ((Over.map (homOfLE hVU)).op.obj W) := by
      change (μU.hom ≫ μU.inv ≫ kU).app
        ((Over.map (homOfLE hVU)).op.obj W) = _
      rw [μU.hom_inv_id_assoc]
    _ = kV.app W := by
      apply ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.tensor_ext
      intro m n
      dsimp only [kU, kV]
      let Z := (Over.map (homOfLE hVU)).op.obj W
      let tU := uU.inv ≫ (freeOverIso X U PUnit).hom
      let tV := uV.inv ≫ (freeOverIso X V PUnit).hom
      have hunit := freePUnitIsoUnit_overMap_naturality hVU
      have hunitVal := congrArg (fun z ↦ z.val.app W) hunit
      change q.inv.val.app W ≫ uV.hom.val.app W =
        uU.hom.val.app Z at hunitVal
      have htail := unitToGlobalFree_overMap_naturality hVU
      have htailVal := congrArg (fun z ↦ z.val.app W) htail
      change tV.val.app W = tU.val.app Z at htailVal
      have hdV : dV.inv.val.app W =
          d.inv.val.app Z ≫ q.inv.val.app W := rfl
      have heV : eV.inv.val.app W =
          e.inv.val.app Z ≫ q.inv.val.app W := rfl
      have hunitApply (a) :
          uV.hom.val.app W (q.inv.val.app W a) =
            uU.hom.val.app Z a := by
        have h := congrArg (fun f ↦ f a) hunitVal
        exact h
      have hd (a) : uV.hom.val.app W (dV.inv.val.app W a) =
          uU.hom.val.app Z (d.inv.val.app Z a) := by
        rw [hdV]
        exact hunitApply _
      have he (a) : uV.hom.val.app W (eV.inv.val.app W a) =
          uU.hom.val.app Z (e.inv.val.app Z a) := by
        rw [heV]
        exact hunitApply _
      let R := X.presheaf.obj (op W.unop.left)
      have hlU (a b : R) :
          (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor
            (SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).val).hom.app Z
              (a ⊗ₜ b) = a * b := by
        change ((MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor (ModuleCat.of R R)).hom)
          (a ⊗ₜ[R] b) = a * b
        rw [ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor_hom_apply]
        rfl
      have hlV (a b : R) :
          (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor
            (SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over V)).val).hom.app W
              (a ⊗ₜ b) = a * b := by
        change ((MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor (ModuleCat.of R R)).hom)
          (a ⊗ₜ[R] b) = a * b
        rw [ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor_hom_apply]
        rfl
      change tU.val.app Z
          ((MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor
            (SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).val).hom.app Z
            (uU.hom.val.app Z (d.inv.val.app Z m) ⊗ₜ
              uU.hom.val.app Z (e.inv.val.app Z n))) =
        tV.val.app W
          ((MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor
            (SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over V)).val).hom.app W
            (uV.hom.val.app W (dV.inv.val.app W m) ⊗ₜ
              uV.hom.val.app W (eV.inv.val.app W n)))
      rw [hlU, hlV, hd, he, htailVal]
      rfl
    _ = _ := by
      rw [show μU.hom.app ((Over.map (homOfLE hVU)).op.obj W) =
        μV.hom.app W from rfl]
      change kV.app W = (μV.hom ≫ μV.inv ≫ kV).app W
      rw [μV.hom_inv_id_assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.moduleSheafificationOverHomEquiv_tensorFrame_inv
proof:
:=
      tensorUnderlyingPresheaf M N
    let G := (freeOverIso X U PUnit).symm ≪≫ tensorFrameOver U d e
    moduleSheafificationOverHomEquiv X U P
        ((SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit).over U) G.inv =
      tensorFrameAdjunct U d e := by
  dsimp only
  let P : _root_.PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat) :=
    tensorUnderlyingPresheaf M N
  let R' := (((Over.forget U).op ⋙ X.presheaf) ⋙
    forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
  letI : MonoidalCategory (_root_.PresheafOfModules.{u} R') := inferInstance
  let A := SheafOfModules.identitySheafificationOver
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.ringCatSheaf U
  let F := PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀OfCommRingCat
    (Over.forget U) X.presheaf
  let u := SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U)
  let Md : _root_.PresheafOfModules.{u} R' := (M.over U).val
  let Nd : _root_.PresheafOfModules.{u} R' := (N.over U).val
  let Ld : _root_.PresheafOfModules.{u} R' :=
    (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) PUnit).val
  let Sd : _root_.PresheafOfModules.{u} R' :=
    (SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).val
  let dInv : Md ⟶ Ld := d.inv.val
  let eInv : Nd ⟶ Ld := e.inv.val
  let uHom : Ld ⟶ Sd := u.hom.val
  let G := (freeOverIso X U PUnit).symm ≪≫ tensorFrameOver U d e
  let adj := PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
    (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)
  let μ := Functor.Monoidal.μIso F M.val N.val
  let l := MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor Sd
  let k := u.inv ≫ (freeOverIso X U PUnit).hom
  let de := dInv ⊗ₘ eInv
  let uu := uHom ⊗ₘ uHom
  let eP := moduleSheafificationOverIso X U (M.val ⊗ N.val)
  let S := SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)
  let q := A.map μ.inv ≫ A.map de ≫ A.map uu ≫ A.map l.hom ≫
    adj.counit.app S ≫ k
  unfold tensorFrameAdjunct
  dsimp only
  change adj.homEquiv _ _ (eP.hom ≫ G.inv) =
    μ.inv ≫ de ≫ uu ≫ l.hom ≫
      (SheafOfModules.forget (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).map k
  have hG : G.inv = eP.inv ≫ q := by
    dsimp only [G, eP, q]
    unfold tensorFrameOver tensorFreePUnitFrameOver
    unfold tensorSheafOverIso tensorSheafOverMapIso tensorSheafOverLeftUnitor
    dsimp only [P, tensorUnderlyingPresheaf, underlyingCommPresheaf]
    simp only [Iso.trans_inv, Iso.symm_inv, Functor.mapIso_inv,
      tensorIso_inv, Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Category.assoc]
    dsimp only [A, F, u, de, uu, dInv, eInv, uHom, Md, Nd, Ld, Sd,
      μ, l, S, k, adj]
    have hd : (SheafOfModules.forget (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).map d.inv =
        d.inv.val := rfl
    have he : (SheafOfModules.forget (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).map e.inv =
        e.inv.val := rfl
    have hu : (SheafOfModules.forget (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).map u.hom =
        u.hom.val := rfl
    have hμ : (Functor.Monoidal.μIso
        (PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀OfCommRingCat
          (Over.forget U) X.presheaf) M.val N.val).inv = μ.inv := rfl
    have hc : ((asIso (PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
        (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)).counit).app
          (SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over U))).hom =
        adj.counit.app S := rfl
    rw [hd, he, hu, hμ, hc]
    dsimp only [u, adj, S]
    rfl
  rw [hG]
  calc
    _ = adj.homEquiv _ _ q := congrArg (adj.homEquiv _ _)
      (eP.hom_inv_id_assoc q)
    _ = _ := by
      dsimp only [q]
      calc
        adj.homEquiv _ _ (A.map μ.inv ≫ A.map de ≫ A.map uu ≫
            A.map l.hom ≫ adj.counit.app S ≫ k) =
          μ.inv ≫ adj.homEquiv _ _ (A.map de ≫ A.map uu ≫
            A.map l.hom ≫ adj.counit.app S ≫ k) := by
            change adj.homEquiv _ _
              ((PresheafOfModules.sheafification
                (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)).map μ.inv ≫ _) = _
            exact adj.homEquiv_naturality_left μ.inv _
        _ = μ.inv ≫ de ≫ adj.homEquiv _ _ (A.map uu ≫
            A.map l.hom ≫ adj.counit.app S ≫ k) := by
          have h := adj.homEquiv_naturality_left de
            (A.map uu ≫ A.map l.hom ≫ adj.counit.app S ≫ k)
          exact congrArg (fun z ↦ μ.inv ≫ z) h
        _ = μ.inv ≫ de ≫ uu ≫ adj.homEquiv _ _
            (A.map l.hom ≫ adj.counit.app S ≫ k) := by
          have h := adj.homEquiv_naturality_left uu
            (A.map l.hom ≫ adj.counit.app S ≫ k)
          exact congrArg (fun z ↦ μ.inv ≫ de ≫ z) h
        _ = _ := by
          have hl := adj.homEquiv_naturality_left l.hom
            (adj.counit.app S ≫ k)
          have hk := adj.homEquiv_naturality_right
            (adj.counit.app S) k
          have hc : adj.homEquiv Sd S (adj.counit.app S) = 𝟙 Sd := by
            rw [← adj.homEquiv_symm_id S]
            exact Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _
          have hlast : adj.homEquiv _ _
              (A.map l.hom ≫ adj.counit.app S ≫ k) =
              l.hom ≫
                (SheafOfModules.forget (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).map k := by
            calc
              _ = l.hom ≫ adj.homEquiv _ _ (adj.counit.app S ≫ k) := hl
              _ = l.hom ≫ (adj.homEquiv _ _ (adj.counit.app S) ≫
                  (SheafOfModules.forget (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).map k) :=
                congrArg (fun z ↦ l.hom ≫ z) hk
              _ = _ := by
                have htail : adj.homEquiv Sd S (adj.counit.app S) ≫
                    (SheafOfModules.forget (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).map k =
                    (SheafOfModules.forget (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).map k := by
                  calc
                    _ = 𝟙 Sd ≫
                        (SheafOfModules.forget
                          (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).map k :=
                      congrArg (fun z ↦ z ≫
                        (SheafOfModules.forget
                          (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).map k) hc
                    _ = _ := Category.id_comp _
                exact congrArg (fun z ↦ l.hom ≫ z) htail
          exact congrArg (fun z ↦ μ.inv ≫ de ≫ uu ≫ z) hlast

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.restrictIsoOverLE_tensorFrame
statement:
theorem restrictIsoOverLE_tensorFrame {N : X.Modules}
    {U V : X.Opens} [Nonempty U] (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (d : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) PUnit ≅ M.over U)
    (e : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) PUnit ≅ N.over U) :
    let F
proof:
:= SheafOfModules.overMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)
    let c := SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)
    let dV := freeOverMapIso X U V hVU PUnit ≪≫ F.mapIso d ≪≫ c.app M
    let eV := freeOverMapIso X U V hVU PUnit ≪≫ F.mapIso e ≪≫ c.app N
    restrictIsoOverLE hVU
        ((freeOverIso X U PUnit).symm ≪≫ tensorFrameOver U d e) =
      (freeOverIso X V PUnit).symm ≪≫ tensorFrameOver V dV eV := by
  dsimp only
  let P : _root_.PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat) :=
    tensorUnderlyingPresheaf M N
  let F := SheafOfModules.overMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)
  let c := SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)
  let dV := freeOverMapIso X U V hVU PUnit ≪≫ F.mapIso d ≪≫ c.app M
  let eV := freeOverMapIso X U V hVU PUnit ≪≫ F.mapIso e ≪≫ c.app N
  let GU := (freeOverIso X U PUnit).symm ≪≫ tensorFrameOver U d e
  let GV := (freeOverIso X V PUnit).symm ≪≫ tensorFrameOver V dV eV
  have hinv : restrictHomOverLE X hVU GU.inv = GV.inv := by
    apply (moduleSheafificationOverHomEquiv X V P
      ((SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit).over V)).injective
    apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
    intro W
    erw [moduleSheafificationOverHomEquiv_restrict_app X hVU P
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit) GU.inv W]
    rw [moduleSheafificationOverHomEquiv_tensorFrame_inv,
      moduleSheafificationOverHomEquiv_tensorFrame_inv]
    exact tensorFrameAdjunct_overMap_app hVU d e W
  change restrictIsoOverLE hVU GU = GV
  let A := restrictIsoOverLE hVU GU
  have hA : A.inv = GV.inv := by
    dsimp only [A]
    rw [restrictIsoOverLE_inv]
    exact hinv
  change A = GV
  apply Iso.ext
  apply (cancel_mono GV.inv).1
  calc
    A.hom ≫ GV.inv = A.hom ≫ A.inv := by rw [hA]
    _ = 𝟙 _ := A.hom_inv_id
    _ = GV.hom ≫ GV.inv := GV.hom_inv_id.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver_relative
statement:
theorem tensorFrameOver_relative {N : X.Modules} (V : X.Opens)
    (d f : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V) PUnit ≅ M.over V)
    (e g : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V) PUnit ≅ N.over V) :
    tensorFrameOver V d e ≪≫ (tensorFrameOver V f g).symm =
      tensorFreePUnitFrameOver V ≪≫
        tensorSheafOverMapIso X V (d ≪≫ f.symm) (e ≪≫ g.symm) ≪≫
          (tensorFreePUnitFrameOver V).symm
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  simp [tensorFrameOver, tensorSheafOverMapIso]
  simp only [← Category.assoc]
  apply (cancel_mono (tensorFreePUnitFrameOver V).inv).2
  let F := SheafOfModules.identitySheafificationOver
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.ringCatSheaf V
  let R' := (((Over.forget V).op ⋙ X.presheaf) ⋙
    forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
  letI : MonoidalCategory
      (_root_.PresheafOfModules.{u} (X.ringCatSheaf.over V).obj) :=
    inferInstanceAs (MonoidalCategory (_root_.PresheafOfModules.{u}
      (((Over.forget V).op ⋙ X.presheaf) ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)))
  change F.map (d.hom.val ⊗ₘ e.hom.val) ≫
      F.map (f.inv.val ⊗ₘ g.inv.val) =
    F.map ((d.hom.val ≫ f.inv.val) ⊗ₘ (e.hom.val ≫ g.inv.val))
  rw [← F.map_comp, MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_comp_tensorHom]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver_relative_comp
statement:
theorem tensorFrameOver_relative_comp {N : X.Modules} (V : X.Opens)
    (d f : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V) PUnit ≅ M.over V)
    (e g : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V) PUnit ≅ N.over V) :
    tensorFrameOver V d e ≪≫ (tensorFrameOver V f g).symm =
      (e ≪≫ g.symm) ≪≫ (d ≪≫ f.symm)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorFrameOver_relative]
  exact tensorFreePUnitFrameOver_naturality V (d ≪≫ f.symm) (e ≪≫ g.symm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensor_frameOverLE
statement:
theorem tensor_frameOverLE {N : X.Modules}
    (d : LineBundleLocalData X M x) (e : LineBundleLocalData X N x)
    (V : X.Opens) (hVd : V ≤ d.U) (hVe : V ≤ e.U) :
    (d.tensor e).frameOverLE V (le_inf hVd hVe) =
      tensorFrameOver V (d.frameOverLE V hVd) (e.frameOverLE V hVe)
proof:
:= by
  let U := d.U ⊓ e.U
  let hVU : V ≤ U := le_inf hVd hVe
  letI : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨x, ⟨d.mem, e.mem⟩⟩⟩
  let F := SheafOfModules.overMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)
  let c := SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)
  let dU := d.frameOverLE U inf_le_left
  let eU := e.frameOverLE U inf_le_right
  let dV := freeOverMapIso X U V hVU PUnit ≪≫ F.mapIso dU ≪≫ c.app M
  let eV := freeOverMapIso X U V hVU PUnit ≪≫ F.mapIso eU ≪≫ c.app N
  let b := freeOverIso X V PUnit
  have hdV : dV = d.frameOverLE V hVd := by
    dsimp only [dV, F, c, dU]
    simpa only [U, hVU] using
      frameOverLE_trans d (V := U) (W := V) inf_le_left hVU
  have heV : eV = e.frameOverLE V hVe := by
    dsimp only [eV, F, c, eU]
    simpa only [U, hVU] using
      frameOverLE_trans e (V := U) (W := V) inf_le_right hVU
  have htensor := restrictIsoOverLE_tensorFrame hVU dU eU
  have hglobal := globalFrameOverLE_eq_frameOverLE
    (d.tensor e) V (le_inf hVd hVe)
  have hpre : b.symm ≪≫
        (d.tensor e).frameOverLE V (le_inf hVd hVe) =
      b.symm ≪≫ tensorFrameOver V dV eV := by
    calc
      b.symm ≪≫ (d.tensor e).frameOverLE V (le_inf hVd hVe) =
          (d.tensor e).globalFrameOverLE V (le_inf hVd hVe) := hglobal.symm
      _ = restrictIsoOverLE hVU
          ((freeOverIso X U PUnit).symm ≪≫ tensorFrameOver U dU eU) := by
            rfl
      _ = b.symm ≪≫ tensorFrameOver V dV eV := htensor
  have h := congrArg (fun z ↦ b ≪≫ z) hpre
  have hframes : (d.tensor e).frameOverLE V (le_inf hVd hVe) =
      tensorFrameOver V dV eV := by
    simpa [b] using h
  simpa only [hdV, heV] using hframes

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.comparisonHom_eq_of_transitionIsoOver_eq
statement:
lemma comparisonHom_eq_of_transitionIsoOver_eq {N : X.Modules} {z w : X}
    (d : LineBundleLocalData X M x) (e : LineBundleLocalData X M y)
    (f : LineBundleLocalData X N z) (g : LineBundleLocalData X N w)
    (V : X.Opens) (hVd : V ≤ d.U) (hVe : V ≤ e.U)
    (hVf : V ≤ f.U) (hVg : V ≤ g.U)
    (h : d.transitionIsoOver e V hVd hVe =
      f.transitionIsoOver g V hVf hVg) :
    (d.globalFrameOverLE V hVd).inv ≫
        (f.globalFrameOverLE V hVf).hom =
      (e.globalFrameOverLE V hVe).inv ≫
        (g.globalFrameOverLE V hVg).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi (d.globalFrameOverLE V hVd).hom).1
  rw [Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  have hh := congrArg Iso.hom h
  change
    (d.globalFrameOverLE V hVd).hom ≫
        (e.globalFrameOverLE V hVe).inv =
      (f.globalFrameOverLE V hVf).hom ≫
        (g.globalFrameOverLE V hVg).inv at hh
  rw [← Category.assoc, hh, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id,
    Category.comp_id]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensor_transitionIsoOver
statement:
theorem tensor_transitionIsoOver {N : X.Modules}
    (d : LineBundleLocalData X M x) (f : LineBundleLocalData X M y)
    (e : LineBundleLocalData X N x) (g : LineBundleLocalData X N y)
    (V : X.Opens) (hVd : V ≤ d.U) (hVf : V ≤ f.U)
    (hVe : V ≤ e.U) (hVg : V ≤ g.U) :
    (d.tensor e).transitionIsoOver (f.tensor g) V
        (le_inf hVd hVe) (le_inf hVf hVg) =
      e.transitionIsoOver g V hVe hVg ≪≫
        d.transitionIsoOver f V hVd hVf
proof:
:= by
  unfold transitionIsoOver
  rw [globalFrameOverLE_eq_frameOverLE,
    globalFrameOverLE_eq_frameOverLE,
    globalFrameOverLE_eq_frameOverLE,
    globalFrameOverLE_eq_frameOverLE,
    globalFrameOverLE_eq_frameOverLE,
    globalFrameOverLE_eq_frameOverLE]
  rw [tensor_frameOverLE, tensor_frameOverLE]
  let b := freeOverIso X V PUnit
  let dV := d.frameOverLE V hVd
  let fV := f.frameOverLE V hVf
  let eV := e.frameOverLE V hVe
  let gV := g.frameOverLE V hVg
  change (b.symm ≪≫ tensorFrameOver V dV eV) ≪≫
      (b.symm ≪≫ tensorFrameOver V fV gV).symm =
    ((b.symm ≪≫ eV) ≪≫ (b.symm ≪≫ gV).symm) ≪≫
      (b.symm ≪≫ dV) ≪≫ (b.symm ≪≫ fV).symm
  have hrel := tensorFrameOver_relative_comp V dV fV eV gV
  calc
    _ = b.symm ≪≫
        (tensorFrameOver V dV eV ≪≫
          (tensorFrameOver V fV gV).symm) ≪≫ b := by simp
    _ = b.symm ≪≫ ((eV ≪≫ gV.symm) ≪≫ (dV ≪≫ fV.symm)) ≪≫ b :=
      congrArg (fun z ↦ b.symm ≪≫ z ≪≫ b) hrel
    _ = _ := by simp

    (d : LineBundleLocalData X M x) (f : LineBundleLocalData X M y) (e : M ≅ N)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.transitionIsoOver_eq_of_transitionUnitIsoOver_eq
statement:
lemma transitionIsoOver_eq_of_transitionUnitIsoOver_eq {N : X.Modules} {z w : X}
    (d : LineBundleLocalData X M x) (e : LineBundleLocalData X M y)

    (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.transitionUnitIsoOver_eq_of_transitionSectionOver_eq
statement:
lemma transitionUnitIsoOver_eq_of_transitionSectionOver_eq
    {N : X.Modules} {z w : X}
    (d : LineBundleLocalData X M x) (e : LineBundleLocalData X M y)
    (f : LineBundleLocalData X N z) (g : LineBundleLocalData X N w)
    (V : X.Opens) (hVd : V ≤ d.U) (hVe : V ≤ e.U)

    (h : d.transitionSectionOver e V hVd hVe =
      f.transitionSectionOver g V hVf hVg) :
    d.transitionUnitIsoOver e V hVd hVe =
      f.transitionUnitIsoOver g V hVf hVg
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  apply globalUnitOverHom_ext
  change
    ((d.transitionAppIsoOver e V hVd hVe).hom)
        (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op V)) =
      ((f.transitionAppIsoOver g V hVf hVg).hom)
        (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op V))
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensor_transitionSectionOver
statement:
theorem tensor_transitionSectionOver {N : X.Modules}
    (d : LineBundleLocalData X M x) (f : LineBundleLocalData X M y)
    (e : LineBundleLocalData X N x) (g : LineBundleLocalData X N y)
    (V : X.Opens) (hVd : V ≤ d.U) (hVf : V ≤ f.U)
    (hVe : V ≤ e.U) (hVg : V ≤ g.U) :
    (d.tensor e).transitionSectionOver (f.tensor g) V
        (le_inf hVd hVe) (le_inf hVf hVg) =
      d.transitionSectionOver f V hVd hVf *
        e.transitionSectionOver g V hVe hVg
proof:
:= by
  let A := e.transitionAppIsoOver g V hVe hVg
  let B := d.transitionAppIsoOver f V hVd hVf
  let C := (d.tensor e).transitionAppIsoOver (f.tensor g) V
    (le_inf hVd hVe) (le_inf hVf hVg)
  have hC : C = A ≪≫ B :=
    tensor_transitionAppIsoOver d f e g V hVd hVf hVe hVg
  change C.hom 1 = B.hom 1 * A.hom 1
  rw [hC]
  change B.hom (A.hom 1) = B.hom 1 * A.hom 1
  have hlinear := B.hom.hom.map_smul (A.hom 1) 1
  change B.hom (A.hom 1 * 1) = A.hom 1 * B.hom 1 at hlinear
  calc
    _ = A.hom 1 * B.hom 1 := by simpa only [mul_one] using hlinear
    _ = B.hom 1 * A.hom 1 := mul_comm _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.transitionIsoOver_trans
statement:
theorem transitionIsoOver_trans (d : LineBundleLocalData X M x)
    (e : LineBundleLocalData X M y) (f : LineBundleLocalData X M z)
    (V : X.Opens) (hVd : V ≤ d.U) (hVe : V ≤ e.U) (hVf : V ≤ f.U) :
    d.transitionIsoOver e V hVd hVe ≪≫
      e.transitionIsoOver f V hVe hVf =
        d.transitionIsoOver f V hVd hVf
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  simp [transitionIsoOver, Category.assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.transitionUnitIsoOver_trans
statement:
theorem transitionUnitIsoOver_trans (d : LineBundleLocalData X M x)
    (e : LineBundleLocalData X M y) (f : LineBundleLocalData X M z)
    (V : X.Opens) (hVd : V ≤ d.U) (hVe : V ≤ e.U) (hVf : V ≤ f.U) :
    d.transitionUnitIsoOver e V hVd hVe ≪≫
      e.transitionUnitIsoOver f V hVe hVf =

proof:
:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.transitionSectionOver_cocycle
statement:
theorem transitionSectionOver_cocycle (d : LineBundleLocalData X M x)
    (e : LineBundleLocalData X M y) (f : LineBundleLocalData X M z)
    (V : X.Opens) (hVd : V ≤ d.U) (hVe : V ≤ e.U) (hVf : V ≤ f.U) :
    d.transitionSectionOver f V hVd hVf =
      d.transitionSectionOver e V hVd hVe *
        e.transitionSectionOver f V hVe hVf
proof:
:= by
  let A := d.transitionAppIsoOver e V hVd hVe
  let B := e.transitionAppIsoOver f V hVe hVf
  let C := d.transitionAppIsoOver f V hVd hVf
  have hABC : A ≪≫ B = C := by
    apply Iso.ext
    change
      (SheafOfModules.evaluation (X.ringCatSheaf.over V)
          (op (Over.mk (𝟙 V)))).map
          ((d.transitionUnitIsoOver e V hVd hVe).hom ≫
            (e.transitionUnitIsoOver f V hVe hVf).hom) =
        (SheafOfModules.evaluation (X.ringCatSheaf.over V)
          (op (Over.mk (𝟙 V)))).map
          (d.transitionUnitIsoOver f V hVd hVf).hom
    apply congrArg
    exact congrArg Iso.hom
      (transitionUnitIsoOver_trans d e f V hVd hVe hVf)
  change C.hom 1 = A.hom 1 * B.hom 1
  rw [← hABC]
  change B.hom (A.hom 1) = A.hom 1 * B.hom 1
  have hlinear := B.hom.hom.map_smul (A.hom 1) 1
  change B.hom (A.hom 1 * 1) = A.hom 1 * B.hom 1 at hlinear
  simpa only [mul_one] using hlinear

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.globalFrame_transitionSection
statement:
theorem globalFrame_transitionSection
    (d : LineBundleLocalData X M x) (e : LineBundleLocalData X M y) :
    let V
proof:
:= d.U ⊓ e.U
    let E := SheafOfModules.evaluation (X.ringCatSheaf.over V)
      (op (Over.mk (𝟙 V)))
    let u := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf V).mapIso
      (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf))
    E.map (e.globalFrameOverLE V inf_le_right).hom
        (E.map u.inv (d.transitionSection e)) =
      E.map (d.globalFrameOverLE V inf_le_left).hom
        (E.map u.inv (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op V))) := by
  dsimp only
  let V := d.U ⊓ e.U
  let E := SheafOfModules.evaluation (X.ringCatSheaf.over V)
    (op (Over.mk (𝟙 V)))
  let u := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf V).mapIso
    (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf))
  have hsection :
      E.map (d.transitionUnitIso e).hom (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op V)) =
        d.transitionSection e := by
    rfl
  change E.map (e.globalFrameOverLE V inf_le_right).hom
      (E.map u.inv (d.transitionSection e)) = _
  rw [← hsection]
  let dg := d.globalFrameOverLE V inf_le_left
  let eg := e.globalFrameOverLE V inf_le_right
  change E.map eg.hom
      (E.map u.inv
        (E.map (u.symm ≪≫ dg ≪≫ eg.symm ≪≫ u).hom
          (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op V)))) =
    E.map dg.hom (E.map u.inv (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op V)))
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Functor.map_comp,
    ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  let q := E.map eg.inv (E.map dg.hom
    (E.map u.inv (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op V))))
  have hu : E.map u.inv (E.map u.hom q) = q := by
    change (E.mapIso u).inv ((E.mapIso u).hom q) = q
    exact (E.mapIso u).hom_inv_id_apply q
  rw [hu]
  have he : E.map eg.hom (E.map eg.inv
      (E.map dg.hom (E.map u.inv
        (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op V))))) =
      E.map dg.hom (E.map u.inv
        (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op V))) := by
    change (E.mapIso eg).hom ((E.mapIso eg).inv _) = _
    exact (E.mapIso eg).inv_hom_id_apply _
  exact he

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.restrict_transitionUnitIsoOver_hom
statement:
lemma restrict_transitionUnitIsoOver_hom (d : LineBundleLocalData X M x)
    (e : LineBundleLocalData X M y) {W V : X.Opens}
    (hWd : W ≤ d.U) (hWe : W ≤ e.U) (hVW : V ≤ W) :
    restrictHomOverLE X hVW (d.transitionUnitIsoOver e W hWd hWe).hom =
      (d.transitionUnitIsoOver e V (hVW.trans hWd) (hVW.trans hWe)).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [transitionUnitIsoOver, transitionIsoOver, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom,
    Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.mapIso_inv, globalFrameOverLE_hom,
    globalFrameOverLE_inv]
  rw [restrictHomOverLE_comp, restrictHomOverLE_comp, restrictHomOverLE_comp]
  rw [restrictHomOverLE_over, restrictHomOverLE_over]
  rw [restrictHomOverLE_trans, restrictHomOverLE_trans]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.transitionSection_restrict
statement:
theorem transitionSection_restrict (d : LineBundleLocalData X M x)
    (e : LineBundleLocalData X M y) (V : X.Opens)
    (hVd : V ≤ d.U) (hVe : V ≤ e.U) :
    X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_inf hVd hVe)).op (d.transitionSection e) =
      d.transitionSectionOver e V hVd hVe
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_inf hVd hVe)).op
      ((d.transitionAppIsoOver e (d.U ⊓ e.U) inf_le_left inf_le_right).hom 1) = _
  simp only [transitionSectionOver, transitionAppIsoOver, Functor.mapIso_hom]
  rw [← restrict_transitionUnitIsoOver_hom d e inf_le_left inf_le_right
    (le_inf hVd hVe)]
  exact restrictUnitHom_app_one (le_inf hVd hVe)
    (d.transitionUnitIsoOver e (d.U ⊓ e.U) inf_le_left inf_le_right).hom

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isUnit_apply_one_of_isIso
statement:
lemma isUnit_apply_one_of_isIso {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    (f : ModuleCat.of R R ⟶ ModuleCat.of R R) [IsIso f] : IsUnit (f 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isUnit_iff_exists_inv]
  refine ⟨(inv f) 1, ?_⟩
  have hcomp : (inv f) (f 1) = 1 := by
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
    rw [IsIso.hom_inv_id]
    rfl
  have hlinear := (inv f).hom.map_smul (f 1) 1
  change (inv f) (f 1 * 1) = f 1 * (inv f) 1 at hlinear
  calc
    f 1 * (inv f) 1 = (inv f) (f 1) := by
      simpa only [mul_one] using hlinear.symm
    _ = 1 := hcomp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.conjugate_tensor_apply_one
statement:
lemma conjugate_tensor_apply_one {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    (c : ModuleCat.of R R ≅ ModuleCat.of R R ⊗ ModuleCat.of R R)
    (a b : ModuleCat.of R R ≅ ModuleCat.of R R) :
    (c.hom ≫ (a.hom ⊗ₘ b.hom) ≫ c.inv) (1 : R) = a.hom 1 * b.hom 1
proof:
:= by
  have ha (r : R) : a.hom r = r * a.hom 1 := by
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using a.hom.hom.map_smul r 1
  have hb (r : R) : b.hom r = r * b.hom 1 := by
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using b.hom.hom.map_smul r 1
  have ht (z : (ModuleCat.of R R ⊗ ModuleCat.of R R : ModuleCat R)) :
      (a.hom ⊗ₘ b.hom) z = (a.hom 1 * b.hom 1) • z := by
    induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | add x y hx hy => simpa only [map_add, smul_add] using congrArg₂ (· + ·) hx hy
    | tmul r s =>
        rw [ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_tmul, ha, hb]
        apply (TensorProduct.lid R R).injective
        simp [mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]
  change c.inv ((a.hom ⊗ₘ b.hom) (c.hom 1)) = _
  rw [ht, c.inv.hom.map_smul]
  have hc : c.inv (c.hom (1 : R)) = 1 := by
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, c.hom_inv_id]
    rfl
  rw [hc, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.transitionSection_isUnit
statement:
theorem transitionSection_isUnit (d : LineBundleLocalData X M x)
    (e : LineBundleLocalData X M y) : IsUnit (d.transitionSection e)
proof:
:= by
  exact isUnit_apply_one_of_isIso (d.transitionAppIso e).hom

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.algebraMap_functionField_restrict
statement:
lemma algebraMap_functionField_restrict {U V : X.Opens} [Nonempty U] [Nonempty V]
    (hVU : V ≤ U) (s : X.presheaf.obj (op U)) :
    algebraMap (X.presheaf.obj (op U)) X.functionField s =
      algebraMap (X.presheaf.obj (op V)) X.functionField
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op s)
proof:
:= by
  have hηV : genericPoint X ∈ V :=
    ((genericPoint_spec X).mem_open_set_iff V.isOpen).mpr (by simpa using ‹Nonempty V›)
  change X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) _ s =
    X.presheaf.germ V (genericPoint X) _
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op s)
  exact (X.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE hVU) (genericPoint X) hηV s).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.transitionSectionOver_eq_of_regularTransitionFunction_eq
statement:
lemma transitionSectionOver_eq_of_regularTransitionFunction_eq
    {N : X.Modules} {z w : X}
    (d : LineBundleLocalData X M x) (e : LineBundleLocalData X M y)
    (f : LineBundleLocalData X N z) (g : LineBundleLocalData X N w)
    (V : X.Opens) [Nonempty V]
    (hVd : V ≤ d.U) (hVe : V ≤ e.U)
    (hVf : V ≤ f.U) (hVg : V ≤ g.U)
    (h : d.regularTransitionFunction e = f.regularTransitionFunction g) :
    d.transitionSectionOver e V hVd hVe =
      f.transitionSectionOver g V hVf hVg
proof:
:= by
  apply germToFunctionField_injective X V
  rw [← d.transitionSection_restrict e V hVd hVe,
    ← f.transitionSection_restrict g V hVf hVg]
  change
    algebraMap (X.presheaf.obj (op V)) X.functionField
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_inf hVd hVe)).op
          (d.transitionSection e)) =
      algebraMap (X.presheaf.obj (op V)) X.functionField
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_inf hVf hVg)).op
          (f.transitionSection g))
  rw [← algebraMap_functionField_restrict (X := X)
      (le_inf hVd hVe) (d.transitionSection e),
    ← algebraMap_functionField_restrict (X := X)
      (le_inf hVf hVg) (f.transitionSection g)]
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.transitionUnitIsoOver_eq_of_regularTransitionFunction_eq
statement:
lemma transitionUnitIsoOver_eq_of_regularTransitionFunction_eq
    {N : X.Modules} {z w : X}
    (d : LineBundleLocalData X M x) (e : LineBundleLocalData X M y)
    (f : LineBundleLocalData X N z) (g : LineBundleLocalData X N w)
    (V : X.Opens) [Nonempty V]
    (hVd : V ≤ d.U) (hVe : V ≤ e.U)
    (hVf : V ≤ f.U) (hVg : V ≤ g.U)
    (h : d.regularTransitionFunction e = f.regularTransitionFunction g) :
    d.transitionUnitIsoOver e V hVd hVe =
      f.transitionUnitIsoOver g V hVf hVg
proof:
:=
  transitionUnitIsoOver_eq_of_transitionSectionOver_eq d e f g V
    hVd hVe hVf hVg
      (transitionSectionOver_eq_of_regularTransitionFunction_eq
        d e f g V hVd hVe hVf hVg h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.transitionIsoOver_eq_of_regularTransitionFunction_eq
statement:
lemma transitionIsoOver_eq_of_regularTransitionFunction_eq
    {N : X.Modules} {z w : X}
    (d : LineBundleLocalData X M x) (e : LineBundleLocalData X M y)
    (f : LineBundleLocalData X N z) (g : LineBundleLocalData X N w)
    (V : X.Opens) [Nonempty V]
    (hVd : V ≤ d.U) (hVe : V ≤ e.U)
    (hVf : V ≤ f.U) (hVg : V ≤ g.U)
    (h : d.regularTransitionFunction e = f.regularTransitionFunction g) :
    d.transitionIsoOver e V hVd hVe =
      f.transitionIsoOver g V hVf hVg
proof:
:=
  transitionIsoOver_eq_of_transitionUnitIsoOver_eq d e f g V
    hVd hVe hVf hVg
      (transitionUnitIsoOver_eq_of_regularTransitionFunction_eq
        d e f g V hVd hVe hVf hVg h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.regularTransitionFunction_mapIso
statement:
theorem regularTransitionFunction_mapIso {N : X.Modules}
    (d : LineBundleLocalData X M x) (f : LineBundleLocalData X M y) (e : M ≅ N) :
    (d.mapIso e).regularTransitionFunction (f.mapIso e) =
      d.regularTransitionFunction f
proof:
:= by
  rw [regularTransitionFunction, regularTransitionFunction]
  congr 1
  unfold transitionSection transitionSectionOver transitionAppIsoOver
  unfold transitionUnitIsoOver
  rw [transitionIsoOver_mapIso]
  simp [mapIso]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensor_regularTransitionFunction
statement:
theorem tensor_regularTransitionFunction {N : X.Modules}
    (d : LineBundleLocalData X M x) (f : LineBundleLocalData X M y)
    (e : LineBundleLocalData X N x) (g : LineBundleLocalData X N y) :
    (d.tensor e).regularTransitionFunction (f.tensor g) =
      d.regularTransitionFunction f * e.regularTransitionFunction g
proof:
:= by
  let V : X.Opens := (d.U ⊓ e.U) ⊓ (f.U ⊓ g.U)
  have hVd : V ≤ d.U := inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left
  have hVe : V ≤ e.U := inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right
  have hVf : V ≤ f.U := inf_le_right.trans inf_le_left
  have hVg : V ≤ g.U := inf_le_right.trans inf_le_right
  letI : Nonempty V := ⟨⟨genericPoint X,
    ⟨⟨d.genericPoint_mem, e.genericPoint_mem⟩,
      ⟨f.genericPoint_mem, g.genericPoint_mem⟩⟩⟩⟩
  rw [regularTransitionFunction, regularTransitionFunction,
    regularTransitionFunction]
  rw [algebraMap_functionField_restrict (le_inf hVd hVf),
    algebraMap_functionField_restrict (le_inf hVe hVg)]
  rw [d.transitionSection_restrict f V hVd hVf,
    e.transitionSection_restrict g V hVe hVg]
  change algebraMap (X.presheaf.obj (op V)) X.functionField
      ((d.tensor e).transitionSectionOver (f.tensor g) V
        (le_inf hVd hVe) (le_inf hVf hVg)) = _
  rw [tensor_transitionSectionOver, map_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.regularTransitionFunction_ne_zero
statement:
theorem regularTransitionFunction_ne_zero (d : LineBundleLocalData X M x)
    (e : LineBundleLocalData X M y) : d.regularTransitionFunction e ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  change X.germToFunctionField (d.U ⊓ e.U) (d.transitionSection e) ≠ 0
  exact (map_ne_zero_iff _ (germToFunctionField_injective X (d.U ⊓ e.U))).mpr
    (d.transitionSection_isUnit e).ne_zero

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.regularTransitionFunction_cocycle
statement:
theorem regularTransitionFunction_cocycle (d : LineBundleLocalData X M x)
    (e : LineBundleLocalData X M y) (f : LineBundleLocalData X M z) :
    d.regularTransitionFunction f =
      d.regularTransitionFunction e * e.regularTransitionFunction f
proof:
:= by
  let V : X.Opens := (d.U ⊓ e.U) ⊓ f.U
  have hVd : V ≤ d.U := inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left
  have hVe : V ≤ e.U := inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right
  have hVf : V ≤ f.U := inf_le_right
  letI : Nonempty V := ⟨⟨genericPoint X,
    ⟨⟨d.genericPoint_mem, e.genericPoint_mem⟩, f.genericPoint_mem⟩⟩⟩
  rw [regularTransitionFunction, regularTransitionFunction,
    regularTransitionFunction]
  rw [algebraMap_functionField_restrict (le_inf hVd hVf),
    algebraMap_functionField_restrict (le_inf hVd hVe),
    algebraMap_functionField_restrict (le_inf hVe hVf)]
  rw [d.transitionSection_restrict f V hVd hVf,
    d.transitionSection_restrict e V hVd hVe,
    e.transitionSection_restrict f V hVe hVf,
    d.transitionSectionOver_cocycle e f V hVd hVe hVf, map_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.transitionFunction_ne_zero
statement:
theorem transitionFunction_ne_zero (d : LineBundleLocalData X M x)
    (e : LineBundleLocalData X M y) : d.transitionFunction e ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply e.genericTrivialization.symm.map_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  apply d.genericTrivialization.map_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  exact one_ne_zero

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.transitionFunction_cocycle
statement:
theorem transitionFunction_cocycle (d : LineBundleLocalData X M x)
    (e : LineBundleLocalData X M y) (f : LineBundleLocalData X M z) :
    d.transitionFunction f = d.transitionFunction e * e.transitionFunction f
proof:
:= by
  change f.genericTrivialization.symm (d.genericTrivialization 1) =
    e.genericTrivialization.symm (d.genericTrivialization 1) *
      f.genericTrivialization.symm (e.genericTrivialization 1)
  apply f.genericTrivialization.injective
  have hmap (q : X.functionField ≃ₗ[X.functionField]
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericStalkFunctor X).obj M))
      (a : X.functionField) : q a = a • q 1 := by
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using q.map_smul a 1
  rw [f.genericTrivialization.apply_symm_apply,
    hmap f.genericTrivialization, mul_smul]
  have hb : f.genericTrivialization.symm (e.genericTrivialization 1) •
      f.genericTrivialization 1 =
      e.genericTrivialization 1 := by
    rw [← hmap f.genericTrivialization]
    exact f.genericTrivialization.apply_symm_apply _
  have ha : e.genericTrivialization.symm (d.genericTrivialization 1) •
      e.genericTrivialization 1 =
      d.genericTrivialization 1 := by
    rw [← hmap e.genericTrivialization]
    exact e.genericTrivialization.apply_symm_apply _
  rw [hb, ha]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame_eq_on_localData
statement:
theorem lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame_eq_on_localData
    (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree X M)
    (hrank : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X M = 1)
    (b : LineBundleLocalData X M bpoint) {z : X}
    (d : LineBundleLocalData X M z) (p : X) (hp : p ∈ d.U) :
    lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame hM hrank b p =
      X.ord (b.regularTransitionFunction d) p
proof:
:= by
  let e := lineBundleLocalDataAt X M hM hrank p
  by_cases hpcoh : coheight p = 1
  · rw [lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame,
      b.regularTransitionFunction_cocycle d e,
      X.ord_mul hpcoh (b.regularTransitionFunction_ne_zero d)
        (d.regularTransitionFunction_ne_zero e)]
    have hunit : X.ord (d.regularTransitionFunction e) p = 0 := by
      change X.ord (X.germToFunctionField (d.U ⊓ e.U) (d.transitionSection e)) p = 0
      exact X.ord_of_isUnit (d.transitionSection_isUnit e) hpcoh ⟨hp, e.mem⟩
    rw [hunit, add_zero]
  · rw [lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame,
      ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hpcoh,
      ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hpcoh]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame_eq_on
statement:
theorem lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame_eq_on
    (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree X M)
    (hrank : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X M = 1)
    (b : LineBundleLocalData X M bpoint) (z p : X)
    (hp : p ∈ (lineBundleLocalDataAt X M hM hrank z).U) :
    lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame hM hrank b p =
      X.ord (b.regularTransitionFunction
        (lineBundleLocalDataAt X M hM hrank z)) p
proof:
:=
  lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame_eq_on_localData hM hrank b
    (lineBundleLocalDataAt X M hM hrank z) p hp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCycleWithFrame_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lineBundleDivisorCycleWithFrame_apply
    (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree X M)
    (hrank : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X M = 1)
    (b : LineBundleLocalData X M bpoint) (p : X) :
    lineBundleDivisorCycleWithFrame hM hrank b p =
      lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame hM hrank b p
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCycleWithFrame_support
statement:
theorem lineBundleDivisorCycleWithFrame_support
    (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree X M)
    (hrank : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X M = 1)
    (b : LineBundleLocalData X M bpoint) :
    (lineBundleDivisorCycleWithFrame hM hrank b).support ⊆
      {p : X | coheight p = 1}
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  change lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame hM hrank b p ≠ 0 at hp
  by_contra hpcoh
  apply hp
  exact ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hpcoh _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame_apply
    (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree X M)
    (hrank : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X M = 1)
    (b : LineBundleLocalData X M bpoint) (p : X) :
    (lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hM hrank b).1 p =
      lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame hM hrank b p
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame_tensor
statement:
theorem lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame_tensor {N : X.Modules}
    (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree X M) (hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree X N)
    (hMN : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (tensorSheaf X M N))
    (hrankM : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X M = 1)
    (hrankN : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X N = 1)
    (hrankMN : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X
      (tensorSheaf X M N) = 1)
    (b : LineBundleLocalData X M bpoint) (c : LineBundleLocalData X N bpoint) :
    lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hMN hrankMN (b.tensor c) =
      lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hM hrankM b +
        lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hN hrankN c
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext p
  let d := lineBundleLocalDataAt X M hM hrankM p
  let e := lineBundleLocalDataAt X N hN hrankN p
  change lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame hMN hrankMN (b.tensor c) p =
    lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame hM hrankM b p +
      lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame hN hrankN c p
  rw [lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame_eq_on_localData hMN hrankMN
      (b.tensor c) (d.tensor e) p ⟨d.mem, e.mem⟩,
    lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame_eq_on_localData hM hrankM b d p d.mem,
    lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame_eq_on_localData hN hrankN c e p e.mem,
    LineBundleLocalData.tensor_regularTransitionFunction]
  by_cases hp : coheight p = 1
  · rw [X.ord_mul hp (b.regularTransitionFunction_ne_zero d)
      (c.regularTransitionFunction_ne_zero e)]
  · rw [ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hp,
      ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hp,
      ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hp, zero_add]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCycleWithFrame_change
statement:
theorem lineBundleDivisorCycleWithFrame_change
    (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree X M)
    (hrank : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X M = 1)
    (b : LineBundleLocalData X M bpoint) (c : LineBundleLocalData X M cpoint) :
    lineBundleDivisorCycleWithFrame hM hrank b =
      AlgebraicGeometry.div (b.regularTransitionFunction c) +
        lineBundleDivisorCycleWithFrame hM hrank c
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  let d := lineBundleLocalDataAt X M hM hrank p
  change X.ord (b.regularTransitionFunction d) p =
    X.ord (b.regularTransitionFunction c) p +
      X.ord (c.regularTransitionFunction d) p
  by_cases hp : coheight p = 1
  · rw [b.regularTransitionFunction_cocycle c d,
      X.ord_mul hp (b.regularTransitionFunction_ne_zero c)
        (c.regularTransitionFunction_ne_zero d)]
  · rw [ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hp,
      ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hp,
      ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hp, zero_add]

statement:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorClass_tensor
statement:
theorem lineBundleDivisorClass_tensor {N : X.Modules}
    (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree X M) (hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree X N)
    (hMN : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (tensorSheaf X M N))
    (hrankM : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X M = 1)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorClass_iso
statement:
theorem lineBundleDivisorClass_iso {N : X.Modules}
    (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree X M)
    (hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree X N)
    (hrankM : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X M = 1)
    (hrankN : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X N = 1)
    (e : M ≅ N) :
    lineBundleDivisorClass hM hrankM = lineBundleDivisorClass hN hrankN
proof:
:= by
  let b := lineBundleReferenceFrame hM hrankM
  rw [lineBundleDivisorClass_eq_withFrame hM hrankM b,
    lineBundleDivisorClass_eq_withFrame hN hrankN (b.mapIso e)]
  unfold lineBundleDivisorClassWithFrame
  apply congrArg (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.classOf X)
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext p
  let d := lineBundleLocalDataAt X M hM hrankM p
  rw [lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame_apply, lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame_apply,
    lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame_eq_on_localData hM hrankM b d p d.mem,
    lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame_eq_on_localData hN hrankN (b.mapIso e)
      (d.mapIso e) p d.mem,
    LineBundleLocalData.regularTransitionFunction_mapIso]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorClass_unit
statement:
theorem lineBundleDivisorClass_unit :
    lineBundleDivisorClass (unit_isFiniteLocallyFree X)
      (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank_unit X) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [lineBundleDivisorClass_eq_withFrame (unit_isFiniteLocallyFree X)
    (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank_unit X)
    (LineBundleLocalData.unit X (genericPoint X))]
  unfold lineBundleDivisorClassWithFrame
  rw [show lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame (unit_isFiniteLocallyFree X)
      (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank_unit X)
      (LineBundleLocalData.unit X (genericPoint X)) = 0 by
    apply Subtype.ext
    ext p
    let d := lineBundleLocalDataAt X (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)
      (unit_isFiniteLocallyFree X)
      (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank_unit X) p
    rw [lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame_apply,
      lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame_eq_on_localData
        (unit_isFiniteLocallyFree X)
        (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank_unit X)
        (LineBundleLocalData.unit X (genericPoint X)) d p d.mem]
    by_cases hp : coheight p = 1
    · exact X.ord_of_isUnit
        ((LineBundleLocalData.unit X (genericPoint X)).transitionSection_isUnit d)
        hp ⟨trivial, d.mem⟩
    · exact ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hp _,
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.classOf_zero]
