name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E27.false_of_flat_quotient_regular
statement:
theorem false_of_flat_quotient_regular {A R : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing R] [Algebra A R]
    (I : Ideal A) (g : R) (hg : g ∈ I.map (algebraMap A R)) (hreg : IsSMulRegular R g)
    (hI : I.map (algebraMap A R) ≠ ⊤) (hflat : Module.Flat A (R ⧸ Ideal.span {g})) : False
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hg' : g ∈ Submodule.span R ((algebraMap A R) '' (I : Set A)) := by
    rw [Ideal.map] at hg
    exact hg
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hlg⟩ := (Finsupp.mem_span_image_iff_linearCombination R
    (v := algebraMap A R) (s := (I : Set A))).mp hg'
  set ι := l.support with hι
  let f : ι → A := fun i => (i : A)
  let x : ι → R ⧸ Ideal.span {g} := fun i => Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (l i)
  have hsum : ∑ i, f i • x i = 0 := by
    have h1 : ∑ i : ι, f i • x i = Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g}) (∑ i : ι, l i * algebraMap A R i) := by
      rw [map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      simp only [f, x, Algebra.smul_def, map_mul]
      rw [mul_comm]
      rfl
    rw [h1]
    have h2 : ∑ i : ι, l i * algebraMap A R i = g := by
      rw [← hlg, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum]
      simp only [smul_eq_mul]
      exact Finset.sum_coe_sort l.support (fun a => l a * algebraMap A R a)
    rw [h2]
    exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self g)
  obtain ⟨k, a, y, hx, ha⟩ := (by haveI := hflat; exact Module.Flat.isTrivialRelation_of_sum_smul_eq_zero (R := A) hsum)
  
  choose ŷ hŷ using fun j => Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (y j)
  
  have hc : ∀ i : ι, ∃ c : R, l i = ∑ j, algebraMap A R (a i j) * ŷ j + c * g := by
    intro i
    have h1 : Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g}) (l i - ∑ j, algebraMap A R (a i j) * ŷ j) = 0 := by
      rw [map_sub, map_sum]
      have := hx i
      simp only [x] at this
      rw [this]
      rw [sub_eq_zero]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      rw [Algebra.smul_def, ← hŷ j, map_mul]
      rfl
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp h1)
    exact ⟨c, by rw [hc]; ring⟩
  choose c hc using hc
  
  set t : R := ∑ i : ι, algebraMap A R (f i) * c i with ht
  have htI : t ∈ I.map (algebraMap A R) := by
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ => ?_
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (hl i.2))
  have hgt : g = t * g := by
    have e1 : g = ∑ i : ι, l i * algebraMap A R (f i) := by
      rw [← hlg, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum]
      simp only [smul_eq_mul, f]
      exact (Finset.sum_coe_sort l.support (fun a => l a * algebraMap A R a)).symm
    have e2 : ∑ i : ι, l i * algebraMap A R (f i) =
        ∑ i : ι, ∑ j, algebraMap A R (f i * a i j) * ŷ j + t * g := by
      have : ∀ i : ι, l i * algebraMap A R (f i) =
          ∑ j, algebraMap A R (f i * a i j) * ŷ j + (algebraMap A R (f i) * c i) * g := by
        intro i
        rw [hc i, add_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
        congr 1
        · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
          rw [map_mul]; ring
        · ring
      simp only [this, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      rw [ht, Finset.sum_mul]
    have e3 : ∑ i : ι, ∑ j, algebraMap A R (f i * a i j) * ŷ j = 0 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j _ => ?_
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← map_sum, ha j, map_zero, zero_mul]
    exact e1.trans (e2.trans (by rw [e3, zero_add]))
  have h1t : (1 - t) * g = 0 := by rw [sub_mul, one_mul, ← hgt, sub_self]
  have h1 : 1 - t = 0 := hreg (by simpa [mul_comm, smul_eq_mul] using h1t.trans (mul_zero g).symm)
  have : (1 : R) = t := sub_eq_zero.mp h1
  exact hI ((Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).mpr (this ▸ htI))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential_eq_alternatingCofaces
statement:
theorem coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential_eq_alternatingCofaces (p : ℕ) :
    coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p =
      ∑ r : Fin (p + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
        coordinateCechNativeHigherCoface k n M p r
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential,
    coordinateCechNativeHigherCoface]
  change (((CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor (coordinateCechCover k n)).obj
    M.presheaf).d p (p + 1)) = _
  simp only [CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor,
    Limits.FormalCoproduct.cochainComplexFunctor_obj_d, CochainComplex.of_d]
  change (AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.objD
    (coordinateCechCosimplicialObject k n M) p) = _
  simp only [AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.objD]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOrderedCechCoface_eq_native
statement:
theorem coordinateOrderedCechCoface_eq_native (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2)) :
    coordinateOrderedToCech k n M p ≫
        coordinateCechNativeHigherCoface k n M p r ≫
          coordinateCechToOrdered k n M (p + 1) =
      coordinateOrderedCechCoface k n M p r
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [coordinateCechToOrdered, coordinateOrderedCechCoface,
    coordinateCechNativeHigherCoface]
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro a
  simp only [Category.assoc, Pi.lift_π]
  rw [coordinateCechHigherCoface_component k n M p r a.1]
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  dsimp only [coordinateOrderedToCech]
  rw [Pi.lift_π]
  rw [dif_pos (a.2.comp (Fin.strictMono_succAbove r))]
  congr 1

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOrderedCechDifferential_eq_native
statement:
theorem coordinateOrderedCechDifferential_eq_native (p : ℕ) :
    coordinateOrderedToCech k n M p ≫
        coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p ≫
          coordinateCechToOrdered k n M (p + 1) =
      coordinateOrderedCechDifferential k n M p
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential_eq_alternatingCofaces]
  simp only [Preadditive.comp_sum, Preadditive.sum_comp, Preadditive.comp_zsmul,
    Preadditive.zsmul_comp, coordinateOrderedCechDifferential]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  rw [← coordinateOrderedCechCoface_eq_native]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechStrictProjection_comp_π
statement:
theorem coordinateCechStrictProjection_comp_π (p : ℕ)
    (a : CoordinateOrderedCechWord n p) :
    coordinateCechStrictProjection k n M p ≫
        Pi.π
          (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
            M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b)))
          a.1 =
      Pi.π
        (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
          M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b)))
        a.1
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [coordinateCechStrictProjection, coordinateCechToOrdered,
    coordinateOrderedToCech]
  rw [Category.assoc, Pi.lift_π]
  rw [dif_pos a.2]
  rw [Pi.lift_π]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechStrictProjection_coface_toOrdered
statement:
theorem coordinateCechStrictProjection_coface_toOrdered
    (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2)) :
    coordinateCechStrictProjection k n M p ≫
        coordinateCechNativeHigherCoface k n M p r ≫
          coordinateCechToOrdered k n M (p + 1) =
      coordinateCechNativeHigherCoface k n M p r ≫
        coordinateCechToOrdered k n M (p + 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro a
  dsimp only [coordinateCechToOrdered]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Pi.lift_π]
  dsimp only [coordinateCechNativeHigherCoface]
  rw [coordinateCechHigherCoface_component k n M p r a.1]
  have hπ :
      coordinateCechStrictProjection k n M p ≫
          Pi.π
            (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b)))
            (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove) =
        Pi.π
          (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
            M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b)))
          (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove) := by
    simpa only [CoordinateOrderedCechWord.delete_val] using
      coordinateCechStrictProjection_comp_π k n M p
        (CoordinateOrderedCechWord.delete (n := n) a r)
  rw [← Category.assoc, hπ]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechStrictProjection_differential_toOrdered
statement:
theorem coordinateCechStrictProjection_differential_toOrdered (p : ℕ) :
    coordinateCechStrictProjection k n M p ≫
        coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p ≫
          coordinateCechToOrdered k n M (p + 1) =
      coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p ≫
        coordinateCechToOrdered k n M (p + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential_eq_alternatingCofaces]
  simp only [Preadditive.comp_sum, Preadditive.sum_comp, Preadditive.comp_zsmul,
    Preadditive.zsmul_comp]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  rw [coordinateCechStrictProjection_coface_toOrdered]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOrderedCechDifferential_comp_self
statement:
theorem coordinateOrderedCechDifferential_comp_self (p : ℕ) :
    coordinateOrderedCechDifferential k n M p ≫
        coordinateOrderedCechDifferential k n M (p + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coordinateOrderedCechDifferential_eq_native,
    ← coordinateOrderedCechDifferential_eq_native]
  calc
    (coordinateOrderedToCech k n M p ≫
          coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p ≫
            coordinateCechToOrdered k n M (p + 1)) ≫
        (coordinateOrderedToCech k n M (p + 1) ≫
          coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M (p + 1) ≫
            coordinateCechToOrdered k n M (p + 2)) =
      coordinateOrderedToCech k n M p ≫
        coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p ≫
          (coordinateCechStrictProjection k n M (p + 1) ≫
            coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M (p + 1) ≫
              coordinateCechToOrdered k n M (p + 2)) := by
        simp only [coordinateCechStrictProjection, Category.assoc]
    _ = coordinateOrderedToCech k n M p ≫
        coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p ≫
          (coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M (p + 1) ≫
            coordinateCechToOrdered k n M (p + 2)) := by
      rw [coordinateCechStrictProjection_differential_toOrdered]
    _ = coordinateOrderedToCech k n M p ≫
        (coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p ≫
          coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M (p + 1)) ≫
            coordinateCechToOrdered k n M (p + 2) := by
      simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = 0 := by
      rw [show coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p ≫
          coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M (p + 1) = 0 by
        exact ((coordinateCechComplexFunctor k n).obj M).d_comp_d
          p (p + 1) (p + 2)]
      simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOrderedCechComplex_X_isZero
statement:
theorem coordinateOrderedCechComplex_X_isZero {p : ℕ} (hnp : n < p) :

  coordinateOrderedCechHigherTerm_isZero k n M hnp

proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank_iso
statement:
theorem genericRank_iso {M N : X.Modules} (e : M ≅ N) :
    genericRank X M = genericRank X N
proof:
:= by
  exact ((genericStalkFunctor X).mapIso e).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem genericRank_zero : genericRank X (0 : X.Modules) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change Module.finrank X.functionField
    ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj (0 : X.Modules)) = 0
  letI : Subsingleton (0 : ModuleCat.{u} X.functionField) :=
    ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero (isZero_zero _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericStalk_unit_finite
statement:
theorem genericStalk_unit_finite :
    Module.Finite X.functionField
      ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf))
proof:
:= by
  exact (Module.Finite.equiv_iff
    (PresheafOfModules.unitStalkLinearEquiv X (genericPoint X))).mpr
      inferInstance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericStalk_free_finite
statement:
theorem genericStalk_free_finite (I : Type u) [Finite I] :
    Module.Finite X.functionField
      ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI (i : I) : Module.Finite X.functionField
      ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)) :=
    genericStalk_unit_finite X
  change Module.Finite X.functionField
    ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj
      (∐ fun _ : I ↦ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf))
  apply (Module.Finite.equiv_iff
    (PreservesCoproduct.iso (genericStalkFunctor X)
      (fun _ : I ↦ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).toLinearEquiv).mpr
  exact (Module.Finite.equiv_iff
    (ModuleCat.coprodIsoDirectSum
      (fun _ : I ↦ (genericStalkFunctor X).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf))).toLinearEquiv).mpr inferInstance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank_unit
statement:
@[simp]
theorem genericRank_unit :
    genericRank X (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) = 1
proof:
:= by
  let e : ↑((genericStalkFunctor X).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)) ≃ₗ[X.functionField]
      X.functionField :=
    PresheafOfModules.unitStalkLinearEquiv X (genericPoint X)
  exact e.finrank_eq.trans (Module.finrank_self X.functionField)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank_free
statement:
theorem genericRank_free (I : Type u) [Fintype I] :
    genericRank X (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I) = Fintype.card I
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change Module.finrank X.functionField
      ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I)) = Fintype.card I
  change Module.finrank X.functionField
      ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj
        (∐ fun _ : I ↦ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)) = Fintype.card I
  let e₁ : (genericStalkFunctor X).obj
        (∐ fun _ : I ↦ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) ≅
      ∐ fun _ : I ↦ (genericStalkFunctor X).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) :=
    PreservesCoproduct.iso (genericStalkFunctor X)
      (fun _ : I ↦ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)
  let e₂ : (∐ fun _ : I ↦ (genericStalkFunctor X).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)) ≅
      ModuleCat.of X.functionField
        (⨁ (i : I), (genericStalkFunctor X).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)) :=
    ModuleCat.coprodIsoDirectSum
      (fun _ : I ↦ (genericStalkFunctor X).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf))
  let e := e₁.trans e₂
  letI (i : I) : Module.Finite X.functionField
      ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)) :=
    genericStalk_unit_finite X
  calc
    _ = Module.finrank X.functionField
        (⨁ (i : I), (genericStalkFunctor X).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)) := e.toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq
    _ = Fintype.card I := by
      have hunit := genericRank_unit X
      change Module.finrank X.functionField
        ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)) = 1 at hunit
      rw [Module.finrank_directSum]
      simp [hunit]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank_eq_natCard_localGenerators
statement:
theorem genericRank_eq_natCard_localGenerators (M : X.Modules)
    (q : M.LocalGeneratorsData) [q.IsLocallyFreeData] [q.IsFiniteType]
    (i : q.I) (hηi : genericPoint X ∈ q.X i) :
    genericRank X M = Nat.card (q.generators i).I
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let I := (q.generators i).I
  letI : (q.generators i).IsFiniteType :=
    SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType i
  letI : Finite I := by
    dsimp only [I]
    infer_instance
  letI : Fintype I := Fintype.ofFinite I
  let e := genericStalkFreeLinearEquivOfLocalGenerators X M q i hηi
  have he : genericRank X
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I) = genericRank X M := by
    exact e.finrank_eq
  calc
    genericRank X M = genericRank X
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I) := he.symm
    _ = Fintype.card I := genericRank_free X I
    _ = Nat.card (q.generators i).I := by
      simpa only [I, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.tensorLocalGeneratorsData_generators_I
statement:
theorem tensorLocalGeneratorsData_generators_I (M N : X.Modules)
    (qM : M.LocalGeneratorsData) (qN : N.LocalGeneratorsData)
    [qM.IsLocallyFreeData] [qN.IsLocallyFreeData] (i : qM.I) (j : qN.I) :
    ((SchemeKTheory.tensorLocalGeneratorsData X qM qN).generators (i, j)).I =
      Σ _ : (qM.generators i).I, (qN.generators j).I
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank_tensorSheaf
statement:
theorem genericRank_tensorSheaf (M N : X.Modules)
    (hM : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X M)
    (hN : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X N) :
    genericRank X (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X M N) =
      genericRank X M * genericRank X N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨qM, hqM, hqMfin⟩ := hM.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  obtain ⟨qN, hqN, hqNfin⟩ := hN.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  letI : qM.IsLocallyFreeData := hqM
  letI : qN.IsLocallyFreeData := hqN
  letI : qM.IsFiniteType := hqMfin
  letI : qN.IsFiniteType := hqNfin
  have hcoverM : IsOpenCover qM.X :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff X qM.X).mp qM.coversTop
  have hcoverN : IsOpenCover qN.X :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff X qN.X).mp qN.coversTop
  have hηM : genericPoint X ∈ ⋃ i, (qM.X i : Set X) := by
    rw [hcoverM.iSup_set_eq_univ]
    exact Set.mem_univ _
  have hηN : genericPoint X ∈ ⋃ i, (qN.X i : Set X) := by
    rw [hcoverN.iSup_set_eq_univ]
    exact Set.mem_univ _
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hηM hηN
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hηM
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hηN
  let qT := SchemeKTheory.tensorLocalGeneratorsData X qM qN
  have hT := genericRank_eq_natCard_localGenerators X
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X M N) qT (i, j) ⟨hi, hj⟩
  have hm := genericRank_eq_natCard_localGenerators X M qM i hi
  have hn := genericRank_eq_natCard_localGenerators X N qN j hj
  rw [hT, hm, hn]
  rw [tensorLocalGeneratorsData_generators_I X M N qM qN i j,
    Nat.card_congr (Equiv.sigmaEquivProd _ _), Nat.card_prod]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericStalk_finite_of_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem genericStalk_finite_of_isFiniteLocallyFree (M : X.Modules)
    (hM : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X M) :
    Module.Finite X.functionField ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin⟩ := hM.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := hqfin
  let hcover : IsOpenCover q.X :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff X q.X).mp q.coversTop
  have hηUnion : genericPoint X ∈ ⋃ i, (q.X i : Set X) := by
    rw [hcover.iSup_set_eq_univ]
    exact Set.mem_univ (genericPoint X)
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hηUnion
  obtain ⟨i, hηi⟩ := hηUnion
  let U := q.X i
  let S : Scheme.{u} := U
  let y : S := ⟨genericPoint X, hηi⟩
  let f : S ⟶ X := Scheme.Opens.ι U
  let I := (q.generators i).I
  letI : (q.generators i).IsFiniteType :=
    SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType i
  letI : Finite I := by
    dsimp only [I]
    infer_instance
  let F : X.Modules := SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I
  let eOver : F.over U ≅ M.over U :=
    (SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X U I).symm ≪≫ asIso (q.generators i).π
  let eRestr : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj F ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj M :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app F).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.mapIso eOver ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app M
  let eLocal :
      ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk
          (show PresheafOfModules.{u}
              (S.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat) from
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj F).val).presheaf y) ≃ₗ[
        ↑(S.presheaf.stalk y)]
      ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk
          (show PresheafOfModules.{u}
              (S.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat) from
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj M).val).presheaf y) :=
    ((PresheafOfModules.stalkFunctorLinear (R := S.presheaf) y).mapIso
      ((SheafOfModules.forget S.ringCatSheaf).mapIso eRestr)).toLinearEquiv
  letI := Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkModule f y F
  letI := Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkModule f y M
  let eK :
      ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk
          (show PresheafOfModules.{u}
              (S.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat) from
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj F).val).presheaf y) ≃ₗ[
        ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (f y))]
      ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk
          (show PresheafOfModules.{u}
              (S.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat) from
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj M).val).presheaf y) :=
    { __ := eLocal.toAddEquiv
      map_smul' := by
        intro r m
        change eLocal (f.stalkMap y r • m) = f.stalkMap y r • eLocal m
        exact eLocal.map_smul _ _ }
  let eGlobal :
      ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk
          (show PresheafOfModules.{u}
              (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat) from F.val).presheaf
            (f y)) ≃ₗ[↑(X.presheaf.stalk (f y))]
        ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk
          (show PresheafOfModules.{u}
              (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat) from M.val).presheaf
            (f y)) :=
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkLinearEquiv f y F).symm.trans <|
      eK.trans (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkLinearEquiv f y M)
  have hfy : f y = genericPoint X := by rfl
  rw [hfy] at eGlobal
  let eAdd :
      ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk
          (show PresheafOfModules.{u}
              (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat) from F.val).presheaf
            (genericPoint X)) ≃+
        ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk
          (show PresheafOfModules.{u}
              (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat) from M.val).presheaf
            (genericPoint X)) :=
    eGlobal.toAddEquiv
  let eGeneric :
      ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk
          (show PresheafOfModules.{u}
              (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat) from F.val).presheaf
            (genericPoint X)) ≃ₗ[X.functionField]
        ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk
          (show PresheafOfModules.{u}
              (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat) from M.val).presheaf
            (genericPoint X)) := by
    refine
      { __ := eAdd
        map_smul' := ?_ }
    intro r m
    change eGlobal (r • m) = r • eGlobal m
    exact eGlobal.map_smul r m
  exact (Module.Finite.equiv_iff eGeneric).mp (genericStalk_free_finite X I)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank_add_of_shortExact
statement:
theorem genericRank_add_of_shortExact {E F G : X.Modules} {f : E ⟶ F} {g : F ⟶ G}
    (zero : f ≫ g = 0) (h : (ShortComplex.mk f g zero).ShortExact)
    [Module.Finite X.functionField ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj E)]
    [Module.Finite X.functionField ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj G)] :
    genericRank X F = genericRank X E + genericRank X G
proof:
:= by
  let S := ShortComplex.mk f g zero
  have hS : (S.map (genericStalkFunctor X)).ShortExact :=
    ShortComplex.ShortExact.map_of_exact h (genericStalkFunctor X)
  letI : Module.Finite X.functionField ((S.map (genericStalkFunctor X)).X₁) := by
    change Module.Finite X.functionField ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj E)
    infer_instance
  letI : Module.Finite X.functionField ((S.map (genericStalkFunctor X)).X₃) := by
    change Module.Finite X.functionField ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj G)
    infer_instance
  exact ModuleCat.free_shortExact_finrank_add hS rfl rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank_add_of_shortExact_of_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem genericRank_add_of_shortExact_of_isFiniteLocallyFree
    {E F G : X.Modules} {f : E ⟶ F} {g : F ⟶ G}
    (zero : f ≫ g = 0) (h : (ShortComplex.mk f g zero).ShortExact)
    (hE : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X E)
    (hG : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X G) :
    genericRank X F = genericRank X E + genericRank X G
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Finite X.functionField ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj E) :=
    genericStalk_finite_of_isFiniteLocallyFree X E hE
  letI : Module.Finite X.functionField ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj G) :=
    genericStalk_finite_of_isFiniteLocallyFree X G hG
  exact genericRank_add_of_shortExact X zero h

name: KSpecialization.AR4.smul_eq_zero_of_local
statement:
theorem smul_eq_zero_of_local {E : Y.Modules} (hE : IdealKills I E) {U : Y.Opens}
    (r : Γ(Y, U))
    (hr : ∀ W : Y.affineOpens, ∀ h : (W : Y.Opens) ≤ U,
      Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op r ∈ I.ideal W) (m : Γ(E, U)) : r • m = 0
proof:
:= by
  let ι := {W : Y.affineOpens // (W : Y.Opens) ≤ U}
  have hcov : U ≤ ⨆ A : ι, (A.1 : Y.Opens) := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨W, hW, rfl⟩, hxW, hWU⟩ :=
      Y.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open hy U.isOpen
    exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨⟨W, hW⟩, hWU⟩, hxW⟩
  refine TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' (⟨E.presheaf, E.isSheaf⟩ : TopCat.Sheaf Ab Y)
    (fun A : ι ↦ (A.1 : Y.Opens)) U (fun A ↦ homOfLE A.2) hcov _ _ fun A ↦ ?_
  change E.presheaf.map (homOfLE A.2).op (r • m) = E.presheaf.map (homOfLE A.2).op 0
  rw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul, hE A.1 _ (hr A.1 A.2), map_zero]

name: KSpecialization.AR4.ideal_transport
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U2, hU2⟩ := U2
  obtain ⟨U1, hU1⟩ := U1
  simp only at h
  subst h
  simpa using ha

name: KSpecialization.AR4.ker_restrict_appTop
statement:
theorem ker_restrict_appTop (W : Y.affineOpens) (a : Γ(Y, (W : Y.Opens)))
    (ha : I.ideal W = Ideal.span {a}) :
    RingHom.ker ((I.subschemeι ∣_ (W : Y.Opens)).appTop.hom) =
      Ideal.span {localGen (W : Y.Opens) a}
proof:
:= by
  let V : Y.Opens := W
  haveI : IsAffine V := W.2
  let U' : Y.Opens := V.ι ''ᵁ ⊤
  have hU' : IsAffineOpen U' := (isAffineOpen_top V).image_of_isOpenImmersion V.ι
  have hinj : Function.Injective (I.subscheme.presheaf.map
      (eqToHom (image_morphismRestrict_preimage I.subschemeι V ⊤)).op).hom :=
    (I.subscheme.presheaf.mapIso
      (eqToIso (image_morphismRestrict_preimage I.subschemeι V ⊤)).op
      ).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.injective
  rw [morphismRestrict_appTop]
  erw [CommRingCat.hom_comp]
  refine (RingHom.ker_comp_of_injective _ hinj).trans ?_
  refine (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_subschemeι_app (I := I) ⟨U', hU'⟩).trans ?_
  have := ideal_transport (I := I) (U1 := W) (U2 := ⟨U', hU'⟩)
    (Scheme.Opens.ι_image_top V).symm a ha
  exact this

name: KSpecialization.AR4.pm_comp_eq
statement:
theorem pm_comp_eq {A B C : Y.Opens} (f : op B ⟶ op A) (g : op A ⟶ op C)
    (h : op B ⟶ op C) (x : Γ(Y, B)) :
    Y.presheaf.map g (Y.presheaf.map f x) = Y.presheaf.map h x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  congr 2

name: KSpecialization.AR4.appIso_top_hom
statement:
theorem appIso_top_hom (W : Y.Opens) (z : Γ(Y, W.ι ''ᵁ ⊤)) :
    ((W.ι.appIso ⊤).hom z : Γ(W, ⊤)) = z
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.appIso_hom, CommRingCat.comp_apply, Scheme.Opens.ι_app]
  exact (pm_comp_eq _ _ (𝟙 _) z).trans (by simp)

name: KSpecialization.AR4.image_le_self
statement: theorem image_le_self (W : Y.Opens) (U : W.toScheme.Opens) : W.ι ''ᵁ U ≤ W
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨y, _, rfl⟩ := hx
  exact y.2

name: KSpecialization.AR4.appIso_inv_localGen
statement:
theorem appIso_inv_localGen (W : Y.Opens) (a : Γ(Y, W)) (U : W.toScheme.Opens) :
    (W.ι.appIso U).inv (W.toScheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op (localGen W a)) =
      Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (image_le_self W U)).op a
proof:
:= by
  have h : (W.ι.appIso U).inv (W.toScheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op
        (localGen W a)) =
      Y.presheaf.map (W.ι.opensFunctor.op.map (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op)
        ((W.ι.appIso ⊤).inv (localGen W a)) :=
    ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (Scheme.Hom.appIso_inv_naturality W.ι (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op) (localGen W a)
  rw [h]
  have h2 : (W.ι.appIso ⊤).inv (localGen W a) =
      Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_of_eq (Scheme.Opens.ι_image_top W))).op a := by
    have e := appIso_top_hom W (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_of_eq (Scheme.Opens.ι_image_top W))).op a)
    exact (congrArg (fun x => (W.ι.appIso ⊤).inv x) e).symm.trans (Iso.hom_inv_id_apply _ _)
  rw [h2]
  exact pm_comp_eq _ _ _ a

name: KSpecialization.AR4.res_mem_ideal
statement:
theorem res_mem_ideal {W W' : Y.affineOpens} (hle : (W' : Y.Opens) ≤ W) {a : Γ(Y, (W : Y.Opens))}
    (ha : a ∈ I.ideal W) : Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op a ∈ I.ideal W'
proof:
:= by
  have := I.ideal_le_comap_ideal hle ha
  rwa [Ideal.mem_comap] at this

name: KSpecialization.AR4.res_res_mem_ideal
statement:
theorem res_res_mem_ideal {W : Y.affineOpens} {U : Y.Opens} (hU : U ≤ (W : Y.Opens))
    {a : Γ(Y, (W : Y.Opens))} (ha : a ∈ I.ideal W) {W' : Y.affineOpens} (hW' : (W' : Y.Opens) ≤ U) :
    Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW').op (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hU).op a) ∈ I.ideal W'
proof:
:= by
  have hle : (W' : Y.Opens) ≤ (W : Y.Opens) := le_trans hW' hU
  rw [pm_comp_eq _ _ (homOfLE hle).op]
  exact res_mem_ideal hle ha

name: KSpecialization.AR4.smul_gen_eq_zero
statement:
theorem smul_gen_eq_zero {E : Y.Modules} (hE : IdealKills I E) {W : Y.affineOpens}
    {a : Γ(Y, (W : Y.Opens))} (ha : I.ideal W = Ideal.span {a}) (U : (W : Y.Opens).toScheme.Opens)
    (m : Γ(E, (W : Y.Opens).ι ''ᵁ U)) :
    Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (image_le_self (W : Y.Opens) U)).op a • m = 0
proof:
:= by
  have ha' : a ∈ I.ideal W := by rw [ha]; exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
  refine smul_eq_zero_of_local (E := E) hE (U := (W : Y.Opens).ι ''ᵁ U) _
    (fun W' hW' => ?_) m
  exact res_res_mem_ideal (image_le_self (W : Y.Opens) U) ha' hW'

name: KSpecialization.AR4.tMul_localGen_restrict
statement:
theorem tMul_localGen_restrict (E : Y.Modules) (hE : IdealKills I E) (W : Y.affineOpens)
    (a : Γ(Y, (W : Y.Opens))) (ha : I.ideal W = Ideal.span {a}) :
    tMul (localGen (W : Y.Opens) a)
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (W : Y.Opens).ι).obj E) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro U
  ext m
  have key : ∀ (r : Γ((W : Y.Opens), U.unop))
      (m : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (W : Y.Opens).ι).obj E, U.unop)),
      r • m = (((W : Y.Opens).ι.appIso U.unop).inv r • (@id Γ(E, (W : Y.Opens).ι ''ᵁ U.unop) m) :
        Γ(E, (W : Y.Opens).ι ''ᵁ U.unop)) := fun _ _ => rfl
  have hr : ((W : Y.Opens).ι.appIso U.unop).inv (tRes (localGen (W : Y.Opens) a) U) =
      Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (image_le_self W U.unop)).op a := appIso_inv_localGen _ a U.unop
  change tRes (localGen (W : Y.Opens) a) U • m = 0
  refine (key _ m).trans ?_
  rw [hr]
  exact smul_gen_eq_zero hE ha U.unop _

name: KSpecialization.AR4.isIso_adjUnit_of_killed
statement:
theorem isIso_adjUnit_of_killed (hI : LocallyPrincipal I) (E : Y.Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hE : IdealKills I E) : IsIso (ProjectionFormula.adjUnit I.subschemeι E)
proof:
:= by
  let i := I.subschemeι
  let ι := {W : Y.affineOpens // ∃ a : Γ(Y, (W : Y.Opens)), I.ideal W = Ideal.span {a}}
  let U : ι → Y.Opens := fun W ↦ (W.1 : Y.Opens)
  have hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y).CoversTop U := by
    refine (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := Y) U).2 ?_
    refine eq_top_iff.2 fun y _ ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨W, hyW, ha⟩ := hI y
    exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨W, ha⟩, hyW⟩
  refine moduleHom_isIso_of_over_cover _ U hU fun W ↦ ?_
  rw [over_isIso_iff_restrictFunctor_map_isIso, restrictFunctor_map_isIso_iff_pullback_map_isIso]
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := W.2
  haveI : IsAffine (W.1 : Y.Opens) := W.1.2
  obtain ⟨F, ⟨e⟩⟩ := affine_essImage (i ∣_ (W.1 : Y.Opens))
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (W.1 : Y.Opens).ι).obj E) (localGen (W.1 : Y.Opens) a)
    (ker_restrict_appTop W.1 a ha) (tMul_localGen_restrict E hE W.1 a ha)
  have hu : IsIso (ProjectionFormula.adjUnit (i ∣_ (W.1 : Y.Opens))
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (W.1 : Y.Opens).ι).obj E)) := by
    change IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (i ∣_ (W.1 : Y.Opens))).unit.app _)
    exact (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (i ∣_ (W.1 : Y.Opens))).isIso_unit_app_of_iso
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (W.1 : Y.Opens).ι).app E).symm ≪≫ e.symm)
  have hres := ProjectionFormula.adjUnit_restrict i (W.1 : Y.Opens) E
  have : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (W.1 : Y.Opens).ι).map (ProjectionFormula.adjUnit i E) ≫
      (pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso i (W.1 : Y.Opens)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj E)).hom) := by
    rw [hres]
    have h2 : IsIso ((pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict i (W.1 : Y.Opens)).hom.app E) :=
      ((pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict i (W.1 : Y.Opens)).app E).isIso_hom
    exact @IsIso.comp_isIso _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hu (@Functor.map_isIso _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ h2)
  exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right _ (pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso i (W.1 : Y.Opens)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj E)).hom

name: KSpecialization.AR4.idealKills_pushforward
statement:
theorem idealKills_pushforward (F : I.subscheme.Modules) :
    IdealKills I ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward I.subschemeι).obj F)
proof:
:= by
  intro W r hr m
  have key : ∀ (r : Γ(Y, (W : Y.Opens)))
      (m : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward I.subschemeι).obj F, (W : Y.Opens))),
      r • m = (I.subschemeι.app (W : Y.Opens) r •
        (@id Γ(F, I.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ (W : Y.Opens)) m) : Γ(F, I.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ (W : Y.Opens))) :=
    fun _ _ => rfl
  have h0 : I.subschemeι.app (W : Y.Opens) r = 0 := by
    rw [← Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_subschemeι_app] at hr
    exact hr
  refine (key r m).trans ?_
  rw [h0]
  exact zero_smul (Γ(I.subscheme, I.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ (W : Y.Opens))) (@id Γ(F, I.subschemeι ⁻¹ᵁ (W : Y.Opens)) m)

name: KSpecialization.AR4.idealKills_zero
statement: theorem idealKills_zero (I : Y.IdealSheafData) : IdealKills I (0 : Y.Modules)
proof:
:= by
  intro W r hr m
  have h2 := ((isZero_zero Y.Modules).isTerminal).isTerminalObj
    (SheafOfModules.evaluation Y.ringCatSheaf (op (W : Y.Opens)))
  let f : ModuleCat.of Γ(Y, (W : Y.Opens)) Γ(Y, (W : Y.Opens)) ⟶
      ((SheafOfModules.evaluation Y.ringCatSheaf (op (W : Y.Opens))).obj (0 : Y.Modules)) :=
    ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton Γ(Y, (W : Y.Opens)) _ m)
  have := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (h2.hom_ext f 0) (1 : Γ(Y, (W : Y.Opens)))
  have h3 : (1 : Γ(Y, (W : Y.Opens))) • m = 0 := this
  have hm : m = 0 := by simpa using h3
  rw [hm, smul_zero]

name: KSpecialization.AR4.pullback_ι_shortExact
statement:
theorem pullback_ι_shortExact (hI : LocallyPrincipal I) (T : ShortComplex Y.Modules)
    (hT : T.ShortExact) [T.X₁.IsQuasicoherent] [T.X₂.IsQuasicoherent]
    (h₁ : IdealKills I T.X₁) (h₂ : IdealKills I T.X₂) :
    (T.map (Scheme.Modules.pullback I.subschemeι)).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  let i := I.subschemeι
  haveI := hT.mono_f
  haveI := hT.epi_g
  have ex : (T.map (Scheme.Modules.pullback i)).Exact :=
    hT.exact.map_of_epi_of_preservesCokernel _ inferInstance inferInstance
  haveI := isIso_adjUnit_of_killed hI T.X₁ h₁
  haveI := isIso_adjUnit_of_killed hI T.X₂ h₂
  have hn := ProjectionFormula.adjUnit_naturality i T.f
  have heq : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).map T.f) =
      inv (ProjectionFormula.adjUnit i T.X₁) ≫ T.f ≫ ProjectionFormula.adjUnit i T.X₂ := by
    rw [hn, IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  have hm : Mono ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).map T.f)) := by
    rw [heq]; infer_instance
  haveI : Mono ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).map T.f) :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).mono_of_mono_map hm
  exact { exact := ex, mono_f := this,
          epi_g := inferInstanceAs (Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).map T.g)) }

name: KSpecialization.AR4.pullFibre_classOf
statement:
theorem pullFibre_classOf (hI : LocallyPrincipal I) (E : {M : Y.Modules // KilledI I M}) :
    pullFibre hI (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ E) =
      ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ (fibrePullObject I E)
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.map_classOf _ _ E

name: KSpecialization.AR4.killedI_zero
statement: theorem killedI_zero : KilledI I (0 : Y.Modules)
proof:
:=
  ⟨inferInstanceAs (0 : Y.Modules).IsFinitePresentation, idealKills_zero I⟩

name: KSpecialization.AR4.pushZero_classOf
statement:
theorem pushZero_classOf (F : {M : I.subscheme.Modules // IsCoherentLike I.subscheme M}) :
    pushZero (I := I) (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ F) =
      ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ (fibrePushObject F)
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.map_classOf _ _ F

name: KSpecialization.AR4.pullFibre_comp_pushZero
statement:
theorem pullFibre_comp_pushZero (hI : LocallyPrincipal I) :
    (pullFibre hI).comp pushZero = AddMonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  refine ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _ fun F => ?_
  rw [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, pushZero_classOf, pullFibre_classOf, AddMonoidHom.id_apply]
  haveI : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward I.subschemeι).Full :=
    (pushforwardFullyFaithful I.subschemeι).full
  haveI : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward I.subschemeι).Faithful :=
    (pushforwardFullyFaithful I.subschemeι).faithful
  haveI : IsIso (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction I.subschemeι).counit :=
    Adjunction.counit_isIso_of_R_fully_faithful _
  have hc : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction I.subschemeι).counit.app F.1) :=
    NatIso.isIso_app_of_isIso _ _
  exact subcategoryClassOf_iso _ (IsCoherentLike I.subscheme) _ _
    (inferInstanceAs (0 : I.subscheme.Modules).IsFinitePresentation) (isZero_zero _)
    (@asIso _ _ _ _ ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction I.subschemeι).counit.app F.1) hc)

name: KSpecialization.AR4.pushZero_comp_pullFibre
statement:
theorem pushZero_comp_pullFibre (hI : LocallyPrincipal I) :
    (pushZero (I := I)).comp (pullFibre hI) = AddMonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  refine ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _ fun E => ?_
  rw [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, pullFibre_classOf, pushZero_classOf, AddMonoidHom.id_apply]
  letI : E.1.IsFinitePresentation := E.2.1
  haveI := isIso_adjUnit_of_killed hI E.1 E.2.2
  exact subcategoryClassOf_iso _ (KilledI I) _ _
    killedI_zero (isZero_zero _) (asIso (ProjectionFormula.adjUnit I.subschemeι E.1)).symm

name: KSpecialization.AR4.exists_pushforward_iso_of_killedI
statement:
theorem exists_pushforward_iso_of_killedI (hI : LocallyPrincipal I) (E : Y.Modules)
    [E.IsFinitePresentation] (hE : IdealKills I E) :
    ∃ F : I.subscheme.Modules, IsCoherentLike I.subscheme F ∧
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward I.subschemeι).obj F ≅ E)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isIso_adjUnit_of_killed hI E hE
  exact ⟨_, pullback_isFinitePresentation_global I.subschemeι E,
    ⟨(asIso (ProjectionFormula.adjUnit I.subschemeι E)).symm⟩⟩

name: KSpecialization.AR4.zeroIdeal_ideal_eq
statement:
theorem zeroIdeal_ideal_eq (W : Y.affineOpens) :
    (zeroIdeal t).ideal W = Ideal.span {tRes t (op (W : Y.Opens))}
proof:
:= by
  change (Ideal.span {t}).map (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op).hom = _
  rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
  rfl

name: KSpecialization.AR4.locallyPrincipal_zeroIdeal
statement: theorem locallyPrincipal_zeroIdeal : LocallyPrincipal (zeroIdeal t)
proof:
:= fun y => by
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨W, hW, rfl⟩, hyW, -⟩ :=
    Y.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open (Set.mem_univ y) isOpen_univ
  exact ⟨⟨W, hW⟩, hyW, _, zeroIdeal_ideal_eq t ⟨W, hW⟩⟩

name: KSpecialization.AR4.idealKills_zeroIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem idealKills_zeroIdeal_iff (E : Y.Modules) :
    IdealKills (zeroIdeal t) E ↔ tMul t E = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
    apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
    intro U
    ext m
    change tRes t U • m = 0
    refine smul_eq_zero_of_local h _ (fun W hW => ?_) m
    have : Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op (tRes t U) = tRes t (op (W : Y.Opens)) := by
      change Y.presheaf.map _ (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op t) = _
      exact pm_comp_eq _ _ _ t
    rw [this, zeroIdeal_ideal_eq]
    exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
  · intro h W r hr m
    rw [zeroIdeal_ideal_eq] at hr
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hr
    have := smul_eq_zero_of_tMul t E h (W : Y.Opens) m
    exact (mul_smul c (show Γ(Y, (W : Y.Opens)) from tRes t (op (W : Y.Opens))) m).trans
      (by rw [this, smul_zero])

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.hbcE_pencil
statement:
theorem hbcE_pencil (Y : Scheme.{u}) (J : Y.IdealSheafData) (k : Type u) [CommRing k]
    (φk : k →+* Γ(Y, ⊤)) [IsIntegral J.subscheme] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] [IsLocallyNoetherian (totalGlobal Y J)]
    {L : (totalGlobal Y J).Modules} [L.IsQuasicoherent] [L.IsFinitePresentation]
    (σ : tensorUnitSheaf (totalGlobal Y J) ⟶ L)
    (hL : HasConstantRank (totalGlobal Y J) L 1) (hreg : SectionIsRegular σ)
    (hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = (componentToTotal Y J).ker)
    (hres : Function.Bijective (k0ToG0 (totalGlobal Y J)))
    (x : K0 J.subscheme) (y : K0 (totalGlobal Y J))
    (hy : k0ToG0 (totalGlobal Y J) y = finitePushforward (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)
      (flatPullbackG0 (totalToClosedBase Y J) (k0ToG0 J.subscheme x))) :
    haveI : IsIso (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)
        (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι ≫ totalToClosedBase Y J)
proof:
:=
      haveI := isIso_fst_comp_totalToClosedBase Y J
      isIso_fst_comp_of_ker_eq (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (totalToClosedBase Y J)
        (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι (componentToTotal Y J)
        (by rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_subschemeι]; exact hid)
    k0ToG0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme
        (pullbackK0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι y) =
      finitePushforward
        (inv (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)
          (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι ≫ totalToClosedBase Y J) ≫
          pullback.snd (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι)
        (k0ToG0 J.subscheme x) := by
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (subschemeTotalGlobal Y J) :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian J.subscheme := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian J.subschemeι
  haveI := isIso_fst_comp_totalToClosedBase Y J
  haveI : IsIso (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)
      (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι ≫ totalToClosedBase Y J) :=
    isIso_fst_comp_of_ker_eq (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (totalToClosedBase Y J)
      (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι (componentToTotal Y J)
      (by rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_subschemeι]; exact hid)
  exact hbcE_pencil_fibre σ (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (totalToClosedBase Y J) hL hreg
    (KSpecialization.ARRHS.mono_pullbackSection_exceptional Y J σ k φk hL hreg hid) hres x y hy

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleHDI.opensRange_eq
statement:
theorem BundleHDI.opensRange_eq (D : (Spec Γ(X, C.U i)).Opens) :
    ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n ⁻¹ᵁ D).ι ≫
        standardChartEmb C i e).opensRange = C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ ((C.isAffine i).fromSpec ''ᵁ D)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp := standardChartEmb_toBase C i e
  have hpt : ∀ w, C.toBase (standardChartEmb C i e w) =
      (C.isAffine i).fromSpec (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n w) := fun w ↦ by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hcomp, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  have htop := standardChartEmb_opensRange_top C i e
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, rfl⟩
    change C.toBase ((_ ≫ standardChartEmb C i e) w) ∈ (C.isAffine i).fromSpec ''ᵁ D
    rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hpt, ← SetLike.mem_coe, Scheme.Hom.coe_image]
    exact ⟨_, w.2, rfl⟩
  · intro hx
    change C.toBase x ∈ (C.isAffine i).fromSpec ''ᵁ D at hx
    rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, Scheme.Hom.coe_image] at hx
    obtain ⟨y, hyD, hy⟩ := hx
    have hxU : x ∈ C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i := by
      change C.toBase x ∈ C.U i
      rw [← hy, ← SetLike.mem_coe, ← IsAffineOpen.range_fromSpec (C.isAffine i)]
      exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
    rw [← htop] at hxU
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hxU
    have hw' : standardChartEmb C i e w.1 = x := hw
    have hmem : SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n w.1 ∈ D := by
      have h1 : (C.isAffine i).fromSpec (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n w.1) =
          (C.isAffine i).fromSpec y := by
        rw [← hpt, hw', hy]
      rw [(C.isAffine i).fromSpec.isOpenEmbedding.injective h1]
      exact hyD
    exact ⟨⟨w.1, hmem⟩, hw'⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleHDI.lift_isIso
statement:
theorem BundleHDI.lift_isIso (D : (Spec Γ(X, C.U i)).Opens) :
    IsIso (BundleHDI.lift C i e D)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isIso_iff_isOpenImmersion_and_surjective]
  refine ⟨inferInstance, ⟨fun z ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  have hz : (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ ((C.isAffine i).fromSpec ''ᵁ D)).ι z ∈
      ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n ⁻¹ᵁ D).ι ≫
        standardChartEmb C i e).opensRange := by
    rw [BundleHDI.opensRange_eq]
    exact z.2
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hz
  refine ⟨w, (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ ((C.isAffine i).fromSpec ''ᵁ D)).ι.isOpenEmbedding.injective ?_⟩
  rw [← hw, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, BundleHDI.lift, BundleRegularity.lift_fac]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleHDI.H_map_iso_bijective
statement:
theorem BundleHDI.H_map_iso_bijective {Z : Scheme.{u}} {A B : Z.Modules} (φ : A ≅ B) (k : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective
      (Sheaf.H.map ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf Z.ringCatSheaf).map φ.hom) k)
proof:
:= by
  refine Function.bijective_iff_has_inverse.2
    ⟨Sheaf.H.map ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf Z.ringCatSheaf).map φ.inv) k, fun y ↦ ?_, fun y ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [← Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp, φ.hom_inv_id,
      CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
    exact Sheaf.H.map_id_apply _
  · rw [← Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp, φ.inv_hom_id,
      CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
    exact Sheaf.H.map_id_apply _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleHDI.T_bijective
statement:
theorem BundleHDI.T_bijective (F : C.scheme.Modules) (k : ℕ) (D : (Spec Γ(X, C.U i)).Opens) :
    Function.Bijective (BundleHDI.T C i e F k D)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := BundleHDI.lift_isIso C i e D
  have h1 := openRestrictionHAddHom_bijective_of_iso (asIso (BundleHDI.lift C i e D))
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ ((C.isAffine i).fromSpec ''ᵁ D)).ι).obj F) k
  have h2 := BundleHDI.H_map_iso_bijective
    (BundleRegularity.isoR (BundleHDI.lift C i e D)
      (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ ((C.isAffine i).fromSpec ''ᵁ D)).ι _
      (BundleRegularity.lift_fac C i e _ D (BundleHDI.opensRange_eq C i e D)) F) k
  have h3 := BundleHDI.H_map_iso_bijective
    (BundleRegularity.isoR (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n ⁻¹ᵁ D).ι
      (standardChartEmb C i e) _ rfl F).symm k
  exact h3.comp (h2.comp h1)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleHDI.appLE_congr
statement:
theorem BundleHDI.appLE_congr {A B : Scheme.{u}} {f g : A ⟶ B} (h : f = g) (U : B.Opens)
    (V : A.Opens) (hVU : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U) :
    f.appLE U V hVU = g.appLE U V (h ▸ hVU)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleHDI.app_square
statement:
theorem BundleHDI.app_square (D : (Spec Γ(X, C.U i)).Opens) :
    C.toBase.app ((C.isAffine i).fromSpec ''ᵁ D) ≫
        (standardChartEmb C i e).appLE (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ ((C.isAffine i).fromSpec ''ᵁ D))
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n ⁻¹ᵁ D) (by
            intro w hw
            change C.toBase (standardChartEmb C i e w) ∈ (C.isAffine i).fromSpec ''ᵁ D
            rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, standardChartEmb_toBase, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply,
              ← SetLike.mem_coe, Scheme.Hom.coe_image]
            exact ⟨_, hw, rfl⟩) =
      ((C.isAffine i).fromSpec.appIso D).hom ≫
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n).app D
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_appLE, Scheme.Hom.appIso_hom', Scheme.Hom.app_eq_appLE,
    Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE]
  exact BundleHDI.appLE_congr (standardChartEmb_toBase C i e) _ _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleHDI.lift_preimageToSpec
statement:
theorem BundleHDI.lift_preimageToSpec (D : (Spec Γ(X, C.U i)).Opens) :
    BundleHDI.lift C i e D ≫
        preimageToSpec C.toBase ((C.isAffine i).fromSpec ''ᵁ D) =
      preimageToSpec (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n) D ≫
        Spec.map ((C.isAffine i).fromSpec.appIso D).hom
proof:
:= by
  let V := (C.isAffine i).fromSpec ''ᵁ D
  let W := C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ V
  let π := SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n
  let ψ := standardChartEmb C i e
  have hle : π ⁻¹ᵁ D ≤ ψ ⁻¹ᵁ W := by
    intro w hw
    change C.toBase (standardChartEmb C i e w) ∈ (C.isAffine i).fromSpec ''ᵁ D
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, standardChartEmb_toBase, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply,
      ← SetLike.mem_coe, Scheme.Hom.coe_image]
    exact ⟨_, hw, rfl⟩
  have hlift : BundleHDI.lift C i e D = ψ.resLE W (π ⁻¹ᵁ D) hle := by
    rw [← cancel_mono W.ι, Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι]
    exact BundleRegularity.lift_fac C i e _ D (BundleHDI.opensRange_eq C i e D)
  simp only [preimageToSpec]
  rw [← Scheme.Opens.toSpecΓ_naturality, ← Scheme.Opens.toSpecΓ_naturality, hlift]
  rw [← Scheme.Opens.toSpecΓ_SpecMap_appLE_assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, Category.assoc,
    ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 2
  exact BundleHDI.app_square C i e D

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleHDI.globalSec_lift
statement:
theorem BundleHDI.globalSec_lift (D : (Spec Γ(X, C.U i)).Opens)
    (r : Γ(Spec Γ(X, C.U i), D)) :
    (BundleHDI.lift C i e D).appTop
        (globalSec (X := (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ ((C.isAffine i).fromSpec ''ᵁ D)).toScheme)
          (R := Γ(X, (C.isAffine i).fromSpec ''ᵁ D))
          (((C.isAffine i).fromSpec.appIso D).inv r)) =
      globalSec (X := (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n ⁻¹ᵁ D).toScheme)
        (R := Γ(Spec Γ(X, C.U i), D)) r
proof:
:= by
  let φ := (C.isAffine i).fromSpec.appIso D
  have hsq := BundleHDI.lift_preimageToSpec C i e D
  have happ := congrArg Scheme.Hom.appTop hsq
  simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop] at happ
  have hnat := Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality φ.hom
  change ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso _).inv ≫
      (preimageToSpec C.toBase ((C.isAffine i).fromSpec ''ᵁ D)).appTop ≫
        (BundleHDI.lift C i e D).appTop).hom (φ.inv r) =
    ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso _).inv ≫
      (preimageToSpec (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n) D).appTop).hom r
  rw [happ, ← Category.assoc, ← hnat, Category.assoc]
  change ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso _).inv ≫
      (preimageToSpec (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n) D).appTop).hom
        (φ.hom (φ.inv r)) = _
  rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_apply]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleHDI.structureRingHom_lift
statement:
theorem BundleHDI.structureRingHom_lift (D : (Spec Γ(X, C.U i)).Opens)
    (U : (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n ⁻¹ᵁ D).toScheme.Opens)
    (r : Γ(Spec Γ(X, C.U i), D)) :
    ((BundleHDI.lift C i e D).appIso U).inv
        (structureRingHom (X := (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n ⁻¹ᵁ D).toScheme)
          (R := Γ(Spec Γ(X, C.U i), D)) U r) =
      structureRingHom (X := (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ ((C.isAffine i).fromSpec ''ᵁ D)).toScheme)
        (R := Γ(X, (C.isAffine i).fromSpec ''ᵁ D)) (BundleHDI.lift C i e D ''ᵁ U)
        (((C.isAffine i).fromSpec.appIso D).inv r)
proof:
:= by
  let W := (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ ((C.isAffine i).fromSpec ''ᵁ D))
  let s := ((C.isAffine i).fromSpec.appIso D).inv r
  rw [structureRingHom_apply, structureRingHom_apply, ← BundleHDI.globalSec_lift C i e D r]
  change ((BundleHDI.lift C i e D).appIso U).inv
      ((BundleHDI.lift C i e D).appLE (⊤ : W.toScheme.Opens) U le_top
        (globalSec (X := W.toScheme) (R := Γ(X, (C.isAffine i).fromSpec ''ᵁ D)) s)) =
    W.toScheme.presheaf.map (BundleHDI.lift C i e D ''ᵁ U).leTop.op
      (globalSec (X := W.toScheme) (R := Γ(X, (C.isAffine i).fromSpec ''ᵁ D)) s)
  have hg := Scheme.Hom.appLE_appIso_inv (BundleHDI.lift C i e D)
    (U := (⊤ : W.toScheme.Opens)) (V := U) le_top
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, hg]
  congr 1

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleHDI.sheafPullback_map_smulEnd
statement:
theorem BundleHDI.sheafPullback_map_smulEnd (F : C.scheme.Modules)
    (D : (Spec Γ(X, C.U i)).Opens) (r : Γ(Spec Γ(X, C.U i), D)) :
    ((BundleHDI.lift C i e D).isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map
        (smulEnd (R := Γ(X, (C.isAffine i).fromSpec ''ᵁ D))
          (restrictToPreimage C.toBase F ((C.isAffine i).fromSpec ''ᵁ D))
          (((C.isAffine i).fromSpec.appIso D).inv r)) =
      smulEnd (R := Γ(Spec Γ(X, C.U i), D))
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (BundleHDI.lift C i e D)).obj
          (restrictToPreimage C.toBase F ((C.isAffine i).fromSpec ''ᵁ D))) r
proof:
:= by
  let W := (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ ((C.isAffine i).fromSpec ''ᵁ D))
  let N := restrictToPreimage C.toBase F ((C.isAffine i).fromSpec ''ᵁ D)
  apply Sheaf.hom_ext
  ext U x
  change (N.smul
      (structureRingHom (X := W.toScheme) (R := Γ(X, (C.isAffine i).fromSpec ''ᵁ D))
        (BundleHDI.lift C i e D ''ᵁ U.unop) (((C.isAffine i).fromSpec.appIso D).inv r))).hom x =
    (N.smul (((BundleHDI.lift C i e D).appIso U.unop).inv
      (structureRingHom (X := (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n ⁻¹ᵁ D).toScheme)
        (R := Γ(Spec Γ(X, C.U i), D)) U.unop r))).hom x
  rw [BundleHDI.structureRingHom_lift]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleHDI.H_map_smul
statement:
theorem BundleHDI.H_map_smul {Z : Scheme.{u}} {R : CommRingCat.{u}} [Z.Over (Spec R)]
    {A B : Z.Modules} (φ : A ⟶ B) (k : ℕ) (r : R)
    (y : ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf Z.ringCatSheaf).obj A).H k) :
    Sheaf.H.map ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf Z.ringCatSheaf).map φ) k (r • y) =
      r • Sheaf.H.map ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf Z.ringCatSheaf).map φ) k y
proof:
:=
  (HMapₗ (R := R) φ k).map_smul r y

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleHDI.comp₃_smul
statement:
theorem BundleHDI.comp₃_smul {R₁ R₂ : Type*} {M₁ M₂ M₃ M₄ : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup M₁] [AddCommGroup M₂] [AddCommGroup M₃] [AddCommGroup M₄]
    [SMul R₁ M₁] [SMul R₂ M₂] [SMul R₂ M₃] [SMul R₂ M₄]
    (f : M₃ →+ M₄) (g : M₂ →+ M₃) (h : M₁ →+ M₂) (a : R₁) (b : R₂) (x : M₁)
    (hh : h (a • x) = b • h x) (hg : ∀ y, g (b • y) = b • g y)
    (hf : ∀ y, f (b • y) = b • f y) :
    (f.comp (g.comp h)) (a • x) = b • (f.comp (g.comp h)) x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, hh, hg, hf]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleHDI.T_smul
statement:
theorem BundleHDI.T_smul (F : C.scheme.Modules) (k : ℕ) (D : (Spec Γ(X, C.U i)).Opens)
    (r : Γ(Spec Γ(X, C.U i), D))
    (x : (restrictToPreimage C.toBase F ((C.isAffine i).fromSpec ''ᵁ D)).H k) :
    BundleHDI.T C i e F k D (((C.isAffine i).fromSpec.appIso D).inv r • x) =
      r • BundleHDI.T C i e F k D x
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := openRestrictionHAddHom_smul_of_map_smulEnd (BundleHDI.lift C i e D)
    (restrictToPreimage C.toBase F ((C.isAffine i).fromSpec ''ᵁ D)) k
    (((C.isAffine i).fromSpec.appIso D).inv r) r
    (BundleHDI.sheafPullback_map_smulEnd C i e F D r) x
  exact BundleHDI.comp₃_smul _ _ _ _ r x h1 (BundleHDI.H_map_smul _ k r)
    (BundleHDI.H_map_smul _ k r)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleHDI.chart_isFinitePresentation
statement:
theorem BundleHDI.chart_isFinitePresentation [IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, C.U i)] (hn : 0 < n)
    (e : C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1))
    (F : C.scheme.Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] (k : ℕ) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.isAffine i).fromSpec).obj
      (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification C.toBase F k)).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  letI : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e)).obj F).IsFinitePresentation :=
    isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor _ F
  have h : (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n)
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e)).obj F) k).IsFinitePresentation :=
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveHigherDirectImage_isCoherentLike Γ(X, C.U i) n hn
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e)).obj F) k
  exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation (Spec Γ(X, C.U i)).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
    (BundleHDI.chartIso C i e F k).symm h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientBasis_tau_basis
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotientBasis_tau_basis
    {R S M N I : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N] [Finite I]
    (b : Module.Basis I R M) (c : Module.Basis I S N)
    (q : space S N ⟶ space R M) (f : M → N)
    (H : (Scheme.Modules.pullback q).obj (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b 1) ⟶
      twistingSheafOfBasisIndex S N c 1)
    (hn : ∀ m, (Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map (tautChart_tautHom R M b m) ≫ H =
      (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso q).hom ≫ tautChart_tautHom S N c (f m))
    (hb : ∀ i, f (b i) = c i) (i : I) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map
        (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := (space R M).ringCatSheaf) i ≫ tautChart_tau R M b) ≫ H =
      (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso q).hom ≫
        SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := (space S N).ringCatSheaf) i ≫ tautChart_tau S N c
proof:
:= by
  erw [tautChart_ιFree_tau, tautChart_ιFree_tau, hn, hb]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientBasis_free_square_of_basis
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotientBasis_free_square_of_basis
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ Y) (I : Type u) (A : Y.Modules) (B : X.Modules)
    (t : SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I ⟶ A)
    (s : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I ⟶ B)
    (H : (Scheme.Modules.pullback q).obj A ⟶ B)
    (hb : ∀ i, (Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map
      (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) i ≫ t) ≫ H =
        (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso q).hom ≫
          SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i ≫ s) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map t ≫ H =
      (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso q I).hom ≫ s
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso q I).inv).1
  simp only [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  apply Cofan.IsColimit.hom_ext
    (SheafOfModules.isColimitFreeCofan (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I)
  intro i
  change (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i ≫
      (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso q I).inv) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map t ≫ H =
    SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i ≫ s
  rw [SchemeKTheory.ιFree_comp_pullbackObjFreeIso_inv]
  erw [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp_assoc, hb]
  erw [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientBasis_chart_taut_basis
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotientBasis_chart_taut_basis (a : C.pullbackFrameIndex g)
    (k : C.basisIndex a.1) :
    type_of% ((C.pullbackFrameSectionMap_basis g a k) ▸
      C.pullbackChartTwistHom_tautHom g a (C.sectionBasis a.1 k))
proof:
:=
  (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap_basis g a k) ▸
    C.pullbackChartTwistHom_tautHom g a (C.sectionBasis a.1 k)

name: RiemannRoch.KNFB.adaptBasis_inr
statement: theorem adaptBasis_inr : adaptBasis b j₀ (Sum.inr PUnit.unit) = b j₀
proof:
:= by
  simp [adaptBasis, adaptEquiv]

name: RiemannRoch.KNFB.adaptBasis_inl
statement: theorem adaptBasis_inl (k : {k : ι // k ≠ j₀}) : adaptBasis b j₀ (Sum.inl k) = b k.1
proof:
:= by
  simp [adaptBasis, adaptEquiv]

name: RiemannRoch.KNFB.adapt_h0
statement:
theorem adapt_h0 (h0 : ∀ k, k ≠ j₀ → φ (b k) = 0) (k : {k : ι // k ≠ j₀}) :
    φ (adaptBasis b j₀ (Sum.inl k)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [adaptBasis_inl]; exact h0 k.1 k.2

name: RiemannRoch.KNFB.adapt_h1
statement: theorem adapt_h1 (h1 : φ (b j₀) = 1) : φ (adaptBasis b j₀ (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [adaptBasis_inr]; exact h1

name: RiemannRoch.KNFB.ker_chart_ideal
statement:
theorem ker_chart_ideal (h1 : φ (b j₀) = 1) (h0 : ∀ k, k ≠ j₀ → φ (b k) = 0) :
    (symmetricProjMap (S := R) φ hspan).ker.ideal
      ⟨linearOpen R M (b j₀),
        Proj.isAffineOpen_basicOpen _ _ (linearForm_mem_degree_one _ _ _) Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun k : {k : ι // k ≠ j₀} =>
        tautChart_ratioSection R M (b j₀) (b k.1))
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (x : M) (g : {k : ι // k ≠ j₀} → M),
      adaptBasis b j₀ (Sum.inr PUnit.unit) = x → (∀ k, adaptBasis b j₀ (Sum.inl k) = g k) →
      (symmetricProjMap (S := R) φ hspan).ker.ideal
        ⟨linearOpen R M x,
          Proj.isAffineOpen_basicOpen _ _ (linearForm_mem_degree_one _ _ _) Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ =
        Ideal.span (Set.range fun k : {k : ι // k ≠ j₀} => tautChart_ratioSection R M x (g k)) := by
    intro x g hx hg
    subst hx
    obtain rfl : g = fun k => adaptBasis b j₀ (Sum.inl k) := funext fun k => (hg k).symm
    exact RiemannRoch.KNFA.chart_kernel_ideal_adapted (adaptBasis b j₀) φ
      (adapt_h0 b φ j₀ h0) (adapt_h1 b φ j₀ h1)
  exact key (b j₀) (fun k => b k.1) (adaptBasis_inr b j₀) (adaptBasis_inl b j₀)

name: RiemannRoch.KNFB.ker_chart_ideal_other
statement:
theorem ker_chart_ideal_other (h1 : φ (b j₀) = 1) (h0 : ∀ k, k ≠ j₀ → φ (b k) = 0)
    (k₀ : ι) (hk : k₀ ≠ j₀) :
    (1 : Γ(space R M, linearOpen R M (b k₀))) ∈ (symmetricProjMap (S := R) φ hspan).ker.ideal
      ⟨linearOpen R M (b k₀),
        Proj.isAffineOpen_basicOpen _ _ (linearForm_mem_degree_one _ _ _) Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (x : M), adaptBasis b j₀ (Sum.inl ⟨k₀, hk⟩) = x →
      (1 : Γ(space R M, linearOpen R M x)) ∈ (symmetricProjMap (S := R) φ hspan).ker.ideal
        ⟨linearOpen R M x,
          Proj.isAffineOpen_basicOpen _ _ (linearForm_mem_degree_one _ _ _) Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ := by
    intro x hx
    subst hx
    haveI : IsClosedImmersion (symmetricProjMap (S := R) φ hspan) :=
      SchemeProjectiveBundle.E14.isClosedImmersion_symmetricProjMap_of_surjective
        (surjective_of_adapted (adaptBasis b j₀) φ (adapt_h1 b φ j₀ h1))
    haveI : QuasiCompact (Proj.map (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) φ)
        (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) φ hspan)) :=
      inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact (symmetricProjMap (S := R) φ hspan))
    have hI := proj_kernel_basicOpen_of_generators (symGrading R M) (symGrading R R)
      (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) φ)
      (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) φ hspan)
      (fun j => linearForm R M (adaptBasis b j₀ (Sum.inl j)))
      (linearForm R M (adaptBasis b j₀ (Sum.inl ⟨k₀, hk⟩)))
      (fun _ => linearForm_mem_degree_one R M _) (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M _)
      (ker_symmetricAlgebraMap_of_adapted (adaptBasis b j₀) φ (adapt_h0 b φ j₀ h0)
        (adapt_h1 b φ j₀ h1))
    refine Eq.mpr (congrArg (fun I : Ideal _ => (1 : Γ(space R M, linearOpen R M
      (adaptBasis b j₀ (Sum.inl ⟨k₀, hk⟩)))) ∈ I) hI) ?_
    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨⟨k₀, hk⟩,
      tautChart_ratioSection_self R M (adaptBasis b j₀ (Sum.inl ⟨k₀, hk⟩))⟩
  exact key (b k₀) (adaptBasis_inl b j₀ ⟨k₀, hk⟩)

name: RiemannRoch.KNFB.chart_polyEquiv
statement:
theorem chart_polyEquiv {n : ℕ} (e : Fin n ≃ {k : ι // k ≠ j₀}) :
    ∃ Ψ : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ≃+* Γ(space R M, linearOpen R M (b j₀)),
      ∀ i, Ψ (X i) = tautChart_ratioSection R M (b j₀) (b (e i).1)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (x : M) (g : {k : ι // k ≠ j₀} → M),
      adaptBasis b j₀ (Sum.inr PUnit.unit) = x → (∀ k, adaptBasis b j₀ (Sum.inl k) = g k) →
      ∃ Ψ : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ≃+* Γ(space R M, linearOpen R M x),
        ∀ i, Ψ (X i) = tautChart_ratioSection R M x (g (e i)) := by
    intro x g hx hg
    subst hx
    obtain rfl : g = fun k => adaptBasis b j₀ (Sum.inl k) := funext fun k => (hg k).symm
    let E : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ≃+* LinearChartRing R M (adaptBasis b j₀ (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) :=
      (MvPolynomial.renameEquiv R e).toRingEquiv.trans (awayPolyEquiv R M (adaptBasis b j₀))
    let A : LinearChartRing R M (adaptBasis b j₀ (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) ≃+*
        Γ(space R M, linearOpen R M (adaptBasis b j₀ (Sum.inr PUnit.unit))) :=
      (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (symGrading R M)
        (linearForm R M (adaptBasis b j₀ (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)))
        (linearForm_mem_degree_one _ _ _) Nat.zero_lt_one).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
    refine ⟨E.trans A, fun i => ?_⟩
    have hE : E (X i) = tautChart_ratio R M (adaptBasis b j₀ (Sum.inr PUnit.unit))
        (adaptBasis b j₀ (Sum.inl (e i))) := by
      simp [E]
    change A (E (X i)) = _
    rw [hE]
    rfl
  exact key (b j₀) (fun k => b k.1) (adaptBasis_inr b j₀) (adaptBasis_inl b j₀)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.RG7.exists_height_generic
statement:
theorem exists_height_generic [IsIntegral A] (hA : ProjectiveIntegralK k A) :
    ∃ d : ℕ, Order.height (genericPoint A) = (d : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, N, j, hj, -⟩ := hA
  haveI := hj
  have h1 : Order.height (j (genericPoint A)) = Order.height (genericPoint A) :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion j _
  have h2 : Order.height (j (genericPoint A)) ≤ Order.height (genericPoint (space k N)) :=
    Order.height_mono (genericPoint_specializes _)
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.height_genericPoint_space, h1] at h2
  refine ⟨(Order.height (genericPoint A)).toNat, ?_⟩
  exact (ENat.coe_toNat (ne_top_of_le_ne_top (ENat.coe_ne_top N) h2)).symm

name: GRRBlueprintV4.RG7.ker_iotaSigma
statement: theorem ker_iotaSigma : (iotaSigma J φk).ker = (componentToTotal A J).ker
proof:
:= by
  rw [iotaSigma, Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_subschemeι]
  exact (ARRKG2A.oeGate A φk J).hid

name: GRRBlueprintV4.RG7.psiSigma_fac
statement: theorem psiSigma_fac : psiSigma J φk ≫ componentToTotal A J = iotaSigma J φk
proof:
:=
  IsClosedImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _

name: GRRBlueprintV4.RG7.zeroE_comp_total
statement:
theorem zeroE_comp_total : zeroE J φk ≫ componentToTotal A J =
    zeroSigma J φk ≫ iotaSigma J φk
proof:
:= by
  rw [zeroE, Category.assoc, psiSigma_fac]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.RG7.zeroE_comp_centre
statement: theorem zeroE_comp_centre : zeroE J φk ≫ componentToCentre A J = 𝟙 J.subscheme
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Mono J.subschemeι := inferInstance
  have key : pullback.snd (subschemeTotalGlobalι A J) (iotaSigma J φk) ≫
      iotaSigma J φk ≫ totalGlobalToBase A J =
      (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι A J) (iotaSigma J φk) ≫
        totalToClosedBase A J) ≫ J.subschemeι := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← pullback.condition, Category.assoc,
      ← totalToClosedBase_subschemeι, ← Category.assoc]
  rw [← cancel_mono J.subschemeι, Category.assoc, ← componentToTotal_toBase,
    ← Category.assoc, zeroE_comp_total, Category.id_comp, Category.assoc, zeroSigma,
    Category.assoc, key, IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.awayCast_mk
statement:
private theorem awayCast_mk
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (n d : ℕ)
    {p q : Polynomial R n} (h : p = q)
    (hp : p ∈ grading R n 1) (r : Polynomial R n)
    (hr : r ∈ grading R n d) :
    (RingEquiv.cast
        (R := fun x : Polynomial R n ↦
          HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading R n) x) h).toRingHom
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading R n) hp d r
          (by simpa using hr)) =
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading R n) (h ▸ hp) d r
        (by simpa using hr)
proof:
:= by
  subst q
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coefficientToCoordinateAway_eq_mk
statement:
private theorem coefficientToCoordinateAway_eq_mk
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (a : R) :
    coefficientToCoordinateAway R n i a =
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading R n)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i) 0 (MvPolynomial.C a)
        (by simpa using
          (MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_C (σ := Fin (n + 1)) a))
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective _
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateAwayMapNormalized_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateAwayMapNormalized_mk
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (d : ℕ)
    (p : Polynomial R n) (hp : p ∈ grading R n d) :
    coordinateAwayMapNormalized f n i
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading R n)
          (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i) d p (by simpa using hp)) =
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading S n)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one S n i) d (MvPolynomial.map f p)
        (by simpa using (MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous.map hp f))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coordinateAwayMapNormalized, RingHom.comp_apply, coordinateAwayMap,
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map_mk]
  simpa only [coordinateAwayTargetEquiv, gradedMap_apply] using
    awayCast_mk n d (gradedMap_coordinate f n i)
      ((gradedMap f n).map_mem (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i))
      (gradedMap f n p) ((gradedMap f n).map_mem hp)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateAwayMapNormalized_coefficient
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateAwayMapNormalized_coefficient
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (a : R) :
    coordinateAwayMapNormalized f n i
        (coefficientToCoordinateAway R n i a) =
      coefficientToCoordinateAway S n i (f a)
proof:
:= by
  have ha : MvPolynomial.C a ∈ grading R n 0 := by
    simpa using (MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_C (σ := Fin (n + 1)) a)
  rw [coefficientToCoordinateAway_eq_mk]
  rw [coordinateAwayMapNormalized_mk f n i 0 (MvPolynomial.C a) ha]
  rw [coefficientToCoordinateAway_eq_mk]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateAwayMapNormalized_coordinateRatio
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateAwayMapNormalized_coordinateRatio
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (j : AffineChartIndex n i) :
    coordinateAwayMapNormalized f n i (coordinateRatio R n i j) =
      coordinateRatio S n i j
proof:
:= by
  simpa [coordinateRatio, coordinate] using
    coordinateAwayMapNormalized_mk f n i 1 (coordinate R n j.1)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n j.1)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateAwayMapNormalized_comp_awayCoordinateHom
statement:
theorem coordinateAwayMapNormalized_comp_awayCoordinateHom
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (coordinateAwayMapNormalized f n i).comp (awayCoordinateHom R n i) =
      (awayCoordinateHom S n i).comp (MvPolynomial.map f)
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro a
    simp [awayCoordinateHom]
  · intro j
    simp [awayCoordinateHom]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.isPushout_affinePolynomialMap
statement:
theorem isPushout_affinePolynomialMap
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    IsPushout
      (CommRingCat.ofHom f)
      (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (MvPolynomial.C :
          R →+* MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) R))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (MvPolynomial.C :
          S →+* MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) S))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (MvPolynomial.map f :
          MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) R →+*
            MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) S))
proof:
:= by
  algebraize [f]
  letI : Algebra
      (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) R)
      (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) S) :=
    MvPolynomial.algebraMvPolynomial
  exact CommRingCat.isPushout_of_isPushout
    R S
    (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) R)
    (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) S)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.isPullback_affinePolynomialMap
statement:
theorem isPullback_affinePolynomialMap
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    IsPullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (MvPolynomial.C :
          S →+* MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) S)))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (MvPolynomial.map f :
          MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) R →+*
            MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) S)))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (MvPolynomial.C :
          R →+* MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) R)))
proof:
:=
  isPullback_SpecMap_of_isPushout _ _ _ _
    (isPushout_affinePolynomialMap f n i)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.isPushout_coordinateAwayMapNormalized
statement:
theorem isPushout_coordinateAwayMapNormalized
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    IsPushout
      (CommRingCat.ofHom f)
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (coefficientToCoordinateAway R n i))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (coefficientToCoordinateAway S n i))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (coordinateAwayMapNormalized f n i))
proof:
:= by
  refine (isPushout_affinePolynomialMap f n i).of_iso
    (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _)
    (awayCoordinateEquiv R n i).symm.toCommRingCatIso
    (awayCoordinateEquiv S n i).symm.toCommRingCatIso
    (by simp) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · ext a
    simp [awayCoordinateEquiv, awayCoordinateHom]
  · ext a
    simp [awayCoordinateEquiv, awayCoordinateHom]
  · apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro p
    change awayCoordinateHom S n i (MvPolynomial.map f p) =
      coordinateAwayMapNormalized f n i (awayCoordinateHom R n i p)
    exact RingHom.congr_fun
      (coordinateAwayMapNormalized_comp_awayCoordinateHom f n i).symm p

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.isPullback_coordinateAwayMapNormalized
statement:
theorem isPullback_coordinateAwayMapNormalized
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    IsPullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (coefficientToCoordinateAway S n i)))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (coordinateAwayMapNormalized f n i)))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (coefficientToCoordinateAway R n i)))
proof:
:=
  isPullback_SpecMap_of_isPushout _ _ _ _
    (isPushout_coordinateAwayMapNormalized f n i)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.awayι_eq_of_eq
statement:
theorem awayι_eq_of_eq {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (n : ℕ)
    {p q : Polynomial R n} (h : p = q) (hp : p ∈ grading R n 1) :
    Proj.awayι (grading R n) q (h ▸ hp) Nat.zero_lt_one =
      Spec.map (RingEquiv.cast
          (R := fun x : Polynomial R n ↦
            HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading R n) x) h).toCommRingCatIso.hom ≫
        Proj.awayι (grading R n) p hp Nat.zero_lt_one
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  change _ = Spec.map _ ≫ _
  have he :
      RingEquiv.cast
          (R := fun x : Polynomial R n ↦
            HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading R n) x) (Eq.refl p) =
        RingEquiv.refl _ :=
    rfl
  simp [he, Spec.map_id]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateAwayι_eq_targetEquiv_comp
statement:
theorem coordinateAwayι_eq_targetEquiv_comp
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Proj.awayι (grading S n) (coordinate S n i)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one S n i) Nat.zero_lt_one =
      Spec.map (coordinateAwayTargetEquiv f n i).toCommRingCatIso.hom ≫
        Proj.awayι (grading S n) (gradedMap f n (coordinate R n i))
          ((gradedMap f n).map_mem (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i)) Nat.zero_lt_one
proof:
:=
  awayι_eq_of_eq n (gradedMap_coordinate f n i)
    ((gradedMap f n).map_mem (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.Spec_map_coordinateAwayMapNormalized
statement:
theorem Spec_map_coordinateAwayMapNormalized
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (coordinateAwayMapNormalized f n i)) =
      Spec.map (coordinateAwayTargetEquiv f n i).toCommRingCatIso.hom ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (coordinateAwayMap f n i))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coordinateAwayMapNormalized, CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, Spec.map_comp,
    RingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso_hom]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateAwayι_comp_toSpec
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem coordinateAwayι_comp_toSpec (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Proj.awayι (grading R n) (coordinate R n i)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i) Nat.zero_lt_one ≫ toSpec R n =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (coefficientToCoordinateAway R n i))
proof:
:= by
  change Proj.awayι (grading R n) (coordinate R n i)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i) Nat.zero_lt_one ≫
      Proj.toSpecZero (grading R n) ≫
        Spec.map (degreeZeroEquiv R n).symm.toCommRingCatIso.hom =
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (coefficientToCoordinateAway R n i))
  rw [Proj.awayι_toSpecZero_assoc]
  rw [← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.isPullback_coordinateAwayι
statement:
theorem isPullback_coordinateAwayι
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    IsPullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (coordinateAwayMap f n i)))
      (Proj.awayι (grading S n) (gradedMap f n (coordinate R n i))
        ((gradedMap f n).map_mem (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i)) Nat.zero_lt_one)
      (Proj.awayι (grading R n) (coordinate R n i)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i) Nat.zero_lt_one)
      (map f n)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsOpenImmersion.isPullback
  · exact coordinateAwayι_comp_map f n i
  · simpa only [Proj.opensRange_awayι, map] using
      (Proj.map_preimage_basicOpen (gradedMap f n) (irrelevant_le_map_gradedMap f n)
        (coordinate R n i))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateAwayι_comp_map_normalized
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem coordinateAwayι_comp_map_normalized
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Proj.awayι (grading S n) (coordinate S n i)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one S n i) Nat.zero_lt_one ≫ map f n =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (coordinateAwayMapNormalized f n i)) ≫
        Proj.awayι (grading R n) (coordinate R n i)
          (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i) Nat.zero_lt_one
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateAwayι_eq_targetEquiv_comp (R := R) (S := S) f n i]
  rw [Category.assoc, coordinateAwayι_comp_map (R := R) (S := S) f n i]
  dsimp only [space]
  rw [← Category.assoc,
    ← Spec_map_coordinateAwayMapNormalized (R := R) (S := S) f n i]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.isPullback_coordinateAwayι_normalized
statement:
theorem isPullback_coordinateAwayι_normalized
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    IsPullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (coordinateAwayMapNormalized f n i)))
      (Proj.awayι (grading S n) (coordinate S n i)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one S n i) Nat.zero_lt_one)
      (Proj.awayι (grading R n) (coordinate R n i)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n i) Nat.zero_lt_one)
      (map f n)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsOpenImmersion.isPullback
  · exact coordinateAwayι_comp_map_normalized f n i
  · simpa only [Proj.opensRange_awayι, coordinateOpen, space] using
      preimage_coordinateOpen f n i

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.isPullback_map_toSpec
statement:
theorem isPullback_map_toSpec
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) :
    IsPullback
      (map f n)
      (toSpec S n)
      (toSpec R n)
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f))
proof:
:= by
  refine Scheme.isPullback_of_openCover
    (map f n) (toSpec S n) (toSpec R n)
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f))
    (coordinateAffineOpenCover R n).openCover fun i ↦ ?_
  let hchart := isPullback_coordinateAwayι_normalized f n i
  let e :
      Spec (.of (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading S n) (coordinate S n i))) ≅
        (((coordinateAffineOpenCover R n).openCover.pullback₁ (map f n)).X i) :=
    hchart.flip.isoPullback
  refine ((isPullback_coordinateAwayMapNormalized f n i).flip).of_iso
    e (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · exact hchart.flip.isoPullback_hom_snd.symm
  · rw [← coordinateAwayι_comp_toSpec S n i, ← Category.assoc]
    exact congrArg (fun k ↦ k ≫ toSpec S n)
      hchart.flip.isoPullback_hom_fst.symm
  · simp [coordinateAffineOpenCover, coordinateAwayι_comp_toSpec]
  · simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.isPullback_map_localization
statement:
theorem isPullback_map_localization
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (g : R) (n : ℕ) :
    IsPullback
      (map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n)
      (toSpec (Localization.Away g) n)
      (toSpec R n)
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g))))
proof:
:=
  isPullback_map_toSpec (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.totalPush_congr
statement:
theorem totalPush_congr {f g : X ⟶ Y} [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsProper f] [g.IsOver (Spk k)]
    [IsProper g] (h : f = g) : totalPush ops f = totalPush ops g
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.totalPull_congr
statement:
theorem totalPull_congr {f g : X ⟶ Y} [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat f] [g.IsOver (Spk k)]
    [Flat g] (h : f = g) (d : ℕ) (hf : PureRelDim f d) (hg : PureRelDim g d) :
    totalPull ops f d hf = totalPull ops g d hg
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rfl
