name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rationalDimChow_hom_ext
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun x ↦ ?_
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul q m =>
    induction m using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H D =>
      have hq : q ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X n) =
          q • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X n)) := by
        rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      rw [hq, map_smul, map_smul, h D]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.pureRelDim_id
statement: theorem pureRelDim_id : PureRelDim (𝟙 X) 0
proof: := fun x _ ↦ by simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.height_hom_of_iso
statement: theorem height_hom_of_iso (φ : X ≅ Y) (x : X) : height (φ.hom x) = height x
proof:
:= by
  let o : X ≃o Y :=
    { toEquiv := (Scheme.homeoOfIso φ).toEquiv
      map_rel_iff' := by
        intro a b
        change (Scheme.homeoOfIso φ) b ⤳ (Scheme.homeoOfIso φ) a ↔ b ⤳ a
        exact (Scheme.homeoOfIso φ).isInducing.specializes_iff }
  have := Order.height_orderIso o x
  rwa [show o x = φ.hom x from Scheme.homeoOfIso_apply φ x] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.pureRelDim_of_iso
statement: theorem pureRelDim_of_iso (φ : X ≅ Y) : PureRelDim φ.hom 0
proof:
:= fun x _ ↦ by
  rw [height_hom_of_iso φ x]; simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.totalPush_id
statement: theorem totalPush_id : totalPush ops (𝟙 X) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.linearMap_ext ℚ fun n ↦ ?_
  apply rationalDimChow_hom_ext
  intro D
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, totalPush, DirectSum.toModule_lof]
  rw [ops.push_mk (𝟙 X) n D D (properPushforward_id D.1).symm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.totalPull_id
statement: theorem totalPull_id (h : PureRelDim (𝟙 X) 0) : totalPull ops (𝟙 X) 0 h = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.linearMap_ext ℚ fun n ↦ ?_
  apply rationalDimChow_hom_ext
  intro D
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, totalPull, DirectSum.toModule_lof]
  rw [ops.pull_mk (𝟙 X) 0 h n D D (fun x ↦ by
    rw [flatPullbackCoeff_eq_one_of_isIso (𝟙 X) x]; simp)]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.totalPush_comp_totalPull_of_iso
statement:
theorem totalPush_comp_totalPull_of_iso (cp : ChowCompat ops) (φ : X ≅ Y)
    [φ.hom.IsOver (Spk k)] :
    totalPush ops φ.hom ∘ₗ totalPull ops φ.hom 0 (pureRelDim_of_iso φ) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  haveI : φ.inv.IsOver (Spk k) :=
    ⟨by rw [← comp_over φ.hom (Spk k), Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]⟩
  have hB : totalPush ops φ.hom ∘ₗ totalPush ops φ.inv = LinearMap.id := by
    rw [← cp.push_comp, totalPush_congr ops (Iso.inv_hom_id φ), totalPush_id]
  have hC : totalPull ops φ.hom 0 (pureRelDim_of_iso φ) ∘ₗ totalPush ops φ.hom =
      LinearMap.id := by
    rw [cp.base_change φ.hom φ.hom (𝟙 X) (𝟙 X) 0 (pureRelDim_of_iso φ) pureRelDim_id
      (IsKernelPair.id_of_mono φ.hom), totalPush_id, totalPull_id, LinearMap.id_comp]
  have hpull : totalPull ops φ.hom 0 (pureRelDim_of_iso φ) = totalPush ops φ.inv := by
    rw [← LinearMap.comp_id (totalPull ops φ.hom 0 (pureRelDim_of_iso φ)), ← hB,
      ← LinearMap.comp_assoc, hC, LinearMap.id_comp]
  rw [hpull, hB]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.sandwich_eq_of_iso
statement:
theorem sandwich_eq_of_iso {E E' : X.Modules} {e : ℕ} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = e + 1)
    (hC' : ∀ i, Nat.card (C'.basisIndex i) = e + 1) (φ : C.scheme ≅ C'.scheme)
    (hφ : φ.hom ≫ C'.toBase = C.toBase)
    (hO : Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback φ.hom).obj (C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) ≅
      C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)) (j : ℕ) :
    sandwich ops C cp hC j = sandwich ops C' cp hC' j
proof:
:= by
  haveI : φ.hom.IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨by
    change φ.hom ≫ (C'.toBase ≫ X ↘ Spk k) = C.toBase ≫ X ↘ Spk k
    rw [← Category.assoc, hφ]⟩
  haveI : Flat C.toBase := C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos e))
  haveI : Flat C'.toBase := C'.toBase_flat (C'.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC' (Nat.succ_pos e))
  have h := cp.projBundle_relDim C hC
  have h' := cp.projBundle_relDim C' hC'
  have hfg : PureRelDim (φ.hom ≫ C'.toBase) (e + 0) := by rw [hφ]; exact h
  have hpush : totalPush ops C.toBase = totalPush ops C'.toBase ∘ₗ totalPush ops φ.hom := by
    rw [← cp.push_comp]; exact totalPush_congr ops hφ.symm
  have hpull : totalPull ops C.toBase e h =
      totalPull ops φ.hom 0 (pureRelDim_of_iso φ) ∘ₗ totalPull ops C'.toBase e h' :=
    (totalPull_congr ops hφ.symm e h hfg).trans
      (cp.pull_comp φ.hom C'.toBase 0 e (pureRelDim_of_iso φ) h' hfg)
  have hxi : totalPush ops φ.hom ∘ₗ xiCap ops C = xiCap ops C' ∘ₗ totalPush ops φ.hom := by
    unfold xiCap
    rw [cp.cap_iso (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
      (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme φ.hom _ 1 (C'.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))
      (hO.map Iso.symm)]
    exact cp.cap_push φ.hom _ _
  have hxij : totalPush ops φ.hom ∘ₗ ((xiCap ops C) ^ j) =
      ((xiCap ops C') ^ j) ∘ₗ totalPush ops φ.hom :=
    (Module.End.commute_pow_left_of_commute hxi.symm j).symm
  change totalPush ops C.toBase ∘ₗ ((xiCap ops C) ^ j) ∘ₗ totalPull ops C.toBase e h =
    totalPush ops C'.toBase ∘ₗ ((xiCap ops C') ^ j) ∘ₗ totalPull ops C'.toBase e h'
  rw [hpush, hpull]
  calc _ = totalPush ops C'.toBase ∘ₗ ((totalPush ops φ.hom ∘ₗ ((xiCap ops C) ^ j)) ∘ₗ
        totalPull ops φ.hom 0 (pureRelDim_of_iso φ)) ∘ₗ totalPull ops C'.toBase e h' := by
        simp only [LinearMap.comp_assoc]
    _ = totalPush ops C'.toBase ∘ₗ (((xiCap ops C') ^ j) ∘ₗ (totalPush ops φ.hom ∘ₗ
        totalPull ops φ.hom 0 (pureRelDim_of_iso φ))) ∘ₗ totalPull ops C'.toBase e h' := by
        rw [hxij]; simp only [LinearMap.comp_assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [totalPush_comp_totalPull_of_iso ops cp φ, LinearMap.comp_id]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.segre_indep
statement:
theorem segre_indep {E : X.Modules} {e : ℕ} (C C' : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = e + 1)
    (hC' : ∀ i, Nat.card (C'.basisIndex i) = e + 1) (i : ℕ) :
    segre ops C cp hC i = segre ops C' cp hC' i
proof:
:=
  sandwich_eq_of_iso ops cp C C' hC hC' (C.isoOfCovers C')
    (C.isoOfCovers_toBase C') (C.isoOfCovers_twist_unconditional C') (e + i)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.segreSeries_indep
statement:
theorem segreSeries_indep {E : X.Modules} {e : ℕ} (C C' : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = e + 1)
    (hC' : ∀ i, Nat.card (C'.basisIndex i) = e + 1) :
    segreSeries ops C cp hC = segreSeries ops C' cp hC'
proof:
:= by
  unfold segreSeries
  exact congrArg PowerSeries.mk (funext (segre_indep ops cp C C' hC hC'))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.chernOfCover_indep
statement:
theorem chernOfCover_indep {E : X.Modules} {e : ℕ} (C C' : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = e + 1)
    (hC' : ∀ i, Nat.card (C'.basisIndex i) = e + 1) :
    chernOfCover ops C cp hC = chernOfCover ops C' cp hC'
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  unfold chernOfCover
  rw [segreSeries_indep ops cp C C' hC hC']

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D29.movingFrames_of_localAvoidance
statement:
theorem movingFrames_of_localAvoidance (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (n : ℕ)
    (h : LocalAvoidance L) : MovingFrames L n
proof:
:=
  fun g ↦ by
  haveI : NoetherianSpace g.Y := g.i.isClosedEmbedding.isInducing.noetherianSpace
  obtain ⟨F0, hFc, hFη, hF⟩ := exists_closed_not_isUnitAt g.f g.hf
  have hfin : {w : g.Y | coheight w = 1 ∧ ¬ IsUnitAt g.f w}.Finite :=
    (finite_coheight_one_of_isClosed hFc hFη).subset fun w ⟨h1, h2⟩ ↦
      ⟨by_contra fun hw ↦ h2 (hF w hw), h1⟩
  have hP : ({g.i (genericPoint g.Y)} ∪
      g.i '' {w : g.Y | coheight w = 1 ∧ ¬ IsUnitAt g.f w} : Set X).Finite :=
    (Set.finite_singleton _).union (hfin.image _)
  obtain ⟨B, A, hB, ⟨ψ⟩, ⟨sA, hsA⟩, ⟨sB, hsB⟩⟩ := h _ hP
  let F : ∀ y : X, LineBundleLocalData X L y :=
    fun y ↦ Scheme.Modules.lineBundleLocalDataAt X L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree
      (genericRank_eq_one_of_hasConstantRank hL) y
  let G : ∀ y : X, LineBundleLocalData X B y :=
    fun y ↦ Scheme.Modules.lineBundleLocalDataAt X B hB.isFiniteLocallyFree
      (genericRank_eq_one_of_hasConstantRank hB) y
  have h₁ : IsProperForD g (diffEq₁ ψ F G sA) :=
    isProperForD_of_frames g (diffE₁ ψ F G sA)
      (hsA _ (Or.inl rfl) (diffFrame ψ (F _) (G _)))
      (fun w hw1 hw ↦ hsA _ (Or.inr ⟨w, ⟨hw1, hw⟩, rfl⟩) (diffFrame ψ (F _) (G _)))
  have h₂ : IsProperForD g (diffEq₂ G sB) :=
    isProperForD_of_frames g (diffE₂ G sB)
      (hsB _ (Or.inl rfl) (G _))
      (fun w hw1 hw ↦ hsB _ (Or.inr ⟨w, ⟨hw1, hw⟩, rfl⟩) (G _))
  refine ⟨_, _, h₁, h₂, fun x hx hne ↦ ?_⟩
  exact ⟨closureFramesDiff ψ F G sA sB x
    (fun z ↦ notMem_stalkPrime_of_proper g _ h₁ hne z)
    (fun z ↦ notMem_stalkPrime_of_proper g _ h₂ hne z)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D29.capDescends_of_localAvoidance
statement:
theorem capDescends_of_localAvoidance (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (n : ℕ)
    (h : LocalAvoidance L) : D5.CapDescends (k := k) L hL n
proof:
:=
  capDescends_of_movingFrames (k := k) L hL n (movingFrames_of_localAvoidance (k := k) L hL n h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D29.localAvoidance_of_eventual
statement:
theorem localAvoidance_of_eventual {L : X.Modules} {Bf : ℕ → X.Modules}
    (h : EventualAvoidance L Bf) : LocalAvoidance L
proof:
:= fun P hP ↦ by
  obtain ⟨m0, hm0⟩ := h.2 P hP
  exact ⟨Bf m0, _, h.1 m0, ⟨Iso.refl _⟩, (hm0 m0 le_rfl).1, (hm0 m0 le_rfl).2⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D29.capDescends_of_eventualAvoidance
statement:
theorem capDescends_of_eventualAvoidance (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (Bf : ℕ → X.Modules) (h : EventualAvoidance L Bf) (n : ℕ) :
    D5.CapDescends (k := k) L hL n
proof:
:=
  capDescends_of_localAvoidance (k := k) L hL n (localAvoidance_of_eventual h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D29.localAvoidance_of_generated
statement:
theorem localAvoidance_of_generated [Infinite k] (L B : X.Modules) (hB : HasConstantRank X B 1)
    (hBg : IsPointwiseGenerated B) (hAg : IsPointwiseGenerated (tensorSheaf X L B)) :
    LocalAvoidance L
proof:
:= fun P hP ↦
  ⟨B, _, hB, ⟨Iso.refl _⟩, sectionsAvoidFinite_of_generated (k := k) _ hAg P hP,
    sectionsAvoidFinite_of_generated (k := k) _ hBg P hP⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.homogeneousMonomialBasis_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homogeneousMonomialBasis_apply_coe (d : ℕ)
    (a : {a : ι →₀ ℕ // a.degree = d}) :
    ((homogeneousMonomialBasis (R := R) d a :
      MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule ι R d) :
        MvPolynomial ι R) =
      MvPolynomial.monomial a 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [homogeneousMonomialBasis, Module.Basis.coe_ofRepr]
  simp only [LinearEquiv.trans_symm, LinearEquiv.trans_apply,
    LinearEquiv.ofEq_symm, LinearEquiv.coe_ofEq_apply]
  change
    (↑((Finsupp.supportedEquivFinsupp
      (M := R) (R := R) {a : ι →₀ ℕ | a.degree = d}).symm
        (Finsupp.single a 1)) : (ι →₀ ℕ) →₀ R) =
      Finsupp.single (a : ι →₀ ℕ) (1 : R)
  exact Finsupp.supportedEquivFinsupp_symm_single
    (M := R) (R := R) {a : ι →₀ ℕ | a.degree = d} a (1 : R)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.symmetricDegreeBasis_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem symmetricDegreeBasis_apply_coe
    (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (d : ℕ)
    (a : {a : ι →₀ ℕ // a.degree = d}) :
    ((symmetricDegreeBasis b d a : symGrading R M d) :
        SymmetricAlgebra R M) =
      (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm
        (MvPolynomial.monomial a 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [symmetricDegreeBasis, Module.Basis.map_apply]
  change
    ((componentEquivIndex b d).symm
        (homogeneousMonomialBasis (R := R) d a) :
      SymmetricAlgebra R M) =
        (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm
          (MvPolynomial.monomial a 1)
  rw [componentEquivIndex_symm_apply_coe,
    homogeneousMonomialBasis_apply_coe]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.symmetricAlgebraMap_equivMvPolynomial_symm
statement:
theorem symmetricAlgebraMap_equivMvPolynomial_symm
    (φ : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (bM : Module.Basis ι R M) (bN : Module.Basis ι S N)
    (hb : ∀ i, φ (bM i) = bN i)
    (p : MvPolynomial ι R) :
    symmetricAlgebraMap
        (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N) φ
        ((SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial bM).symm p) =
      (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial bN).symm
        (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap R S) p)
proof:
:= by
  let left : MvPolynomial ι R →+* SymmetricAlgebra S N :=
    (symmetricAlgebraMap
      (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N) φ).comp
        (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial bM).symm.toRingHom
  let right : MvPolynomial ι R →+* SymmetricAlgebra S N :=
    (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial bN).symm.toRingHom.comp
      (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap R S))
  have hring : left = right := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro r
      dsimp only [left, right, RingHom.comp_apply]
      have hM :
          (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial bM).symm.toRingHom
              (MvPolynomial.C r) =
            algebraMap R (SymmetricAlgebra R M) r := by
        simpa using
          (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial bM).symm.commutes r
      have hN :
          (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial bN).symm.toRingHom
              (MvPolynomial.C (algebraMap R S r)) =
            algebraMap S (SymmetricAlgebra S N) (algebraMap R S r) := by
        simpa using
          (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial bN).symm.commutes
            (algebraMap R S r)
      rw [hM, MvPolynomial.map_C, hN]
      exact symmetricAlgebraMap_algebraMap
        (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N) φ r
    · intro i
      simp [left, right, hb]
  exact RingHom.congr_fun hring p

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.symmetricDegreeMap_basis
statement:
@[simp]
theorem symmetricDegreeMap_basis
    (φ : M →ₗ[R] N) (hφ : IsBaseChange S φ)
    (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (d : ℕ)
    (a : {a : ι →₀ ℕ // a.degree = d}) :
    symmetricDegreeMap φ d (symmetricDegreeBasis b d a) =
      symmetricDegreeBasis (hφ.basis b) d a
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change
    symmetricAlgebraMap
        (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N) φ
        ((symmetricDegreeBasis b d a : symGrading R M d) :
          SymmetricAlgebra R M) =
      ((symmetricDegreeBasis (hφ.basis b) d a : symGrading S N d) :
        SymmetricAlgebra S N)
  rw [symmetricDegreeBasis_apply_coe, symmetricDegreeBasis_apply_coe,
    symmetricAlgebraMap_equivMvPolynomial_symm φ b (hφ.basis b)
      (fun i ↦ (hφ.basis_apply b i).symm)]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.symmetricDegreeBaseChangeEquiv_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem symmetricDegreeBaseChangeEquiv_tmul
    (φ : M →ₗ[R] N) (hφ : IsBaseChange S φ)
    (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (d : ℕ)
    (s : S) (x : symGrading R M d) :
    symmetricDegreeBaseChangeEquiv φ hφ b d (s ⊗ₜ[R] x) =
      s • symmetricDegreeMap
        (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N) φ d x
proof:
:= by
  let e := symmetricDegreeBaseChangeEquiv φ hφ b d
  letI degreeModule : Module R (symGrading S N d) :=
    Module.compHom (symGrading S N d) (algebraMap R S)
  let degreeTower : IsScalarTower R S (symGrading S N d) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_compHom R S (symGrading S N d)
  let lhs : symGrading R M d →ₗ[R] symGrading S N d :=
    @tensorOneLinearMap R S _ _ _
      (symGrading R M d) (symGrading S N d)
      _ _ _ _ degreeModule degreeTower e
  have heq : lhs =
      symmetricDegreeMap
        (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N) φ d := by
    apply (symmetricDegreeBasis b d).ext
    intro a
    dsimp only [lhs]
    change e (1 ⊗ₜ[R] symmetricDegreeBasis b d a) =
      symmetricDegreeMap
        (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N) φ d
          (symmetricDegreeBasis b d a)
    dsimp only [e, symmetricDegreeBaseChangeEquiv]
    rw [← Algebra.TensorProduct.basis_apply
        (A := S) (symmetricDegreeBasis b d) a,
      Module.Basis.equiv_apply, Equiv.refl_apply]
    exact (symmetricDegreeMap_basis φ hφ b d a).symm
  calc
    e (s ⊗ₜ[R] x) = e (s • (1 ⊗ₜ[R] x)) := by
      congr 1
      change s ⊗ₜ[R] x = (s • (1 : S)) ⊗ₜ[R] x
      rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    _ = s • e (1 ⊗ₜ[R] x) := e.map_smul s _
    _ = s • symmetricDegreeMap
        (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N) φ d x := by
      have hx : e (1 ⊗ₜ[R] x) =
          symmetricDegreeMap
            (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N) φ d x := by
        calc
          e (1 ⊗ₜ[R] x) = lhs x := rfl
          _ = symmetricDegreeMap
              (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N) φ d x :=
            LinearMap.congr_fun heq x
      exact congrArg (fun y ↦ s • y) hx

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.gradedMap_comp
statement:
theorem gradedMap_comp {R S T : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
    (f : R →+* S) (g : S →+* T) (n : ℕ) :
    gradedMap (g.comp f) n = (gradedMap g n).comp (gradedMap f n)
proof:
:=
  GradedRingHom.ext fun p ↦ (MvPolynomial.map_map f g p).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.gradedMap_id
statement:
theorem gradedMap_id (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) :
    gradedMap (RingHom.id R) n = GradedRingHom.id (grading R n)
proof:
:=
  GradedRingHom.ext fun p ↦ MvPolynomial.map_id p

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.spaceProjMap_congr
statement:
theorem spaceProjMap_congr {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (n : ℕ)
    {φ ψ : grading R n →+*ᵍ grading S n} (h : φ = ψ)
    (hφ : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading S n) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading R n)).map φ)
    (hψ : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading S n) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading R n)).map ψ) :
    Proj.map φ hφ = Proj.map ψ hψ
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.map_comp
statement:
theorem map_comp {R S T : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
    (f : R →+* S) (g : S →+* T) (n : ℕ) :
    map (g.comp f) n = map g n ≫ map f n
proof:
:=
  (spaceProjMap_congr n (gradedMap_comp f g n) _ _).trans
    (Proj.map_comp (gradedMap f n) (gradedMap g n) (irrelevant_le_map_gradedMap f n)
      (irrelevant_le_map_gradedMap g n))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.map_id
statement:
theorem map_id (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) :
    map (RingHom.id R) n = 𝟙 _
proof:
:=
  (spaceProjMap_congr n (gradedMap_id R n) _ _).trans (Proj.map_id (𝒜 := grading R n))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.standardChartIso_hom_toSpec
statement:
theorem standardChartIso_hom_toSpec (i : C.I) {n : ℕ} (e : C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1)) :
    (standardChartIso C i e).hom ≫ SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n =
      (C.affineData i).toSpecBase
proof:
:= by
  letI := C.sectionModule_free i
  letI := C.sectionModule_finite i
  simp only [standardChartIso, asIso_hom]
  exact SchemeProjectiveBundle.intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace_comp_toSpec _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.standardChartEmb_toBase
statement:
theorem standardChartEmb_toBase (i : C.I) {n : ℕ} (e : C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1)) :
    standardChartEmb C i e ≫ C.toBase =
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n ≫ (C.isAffine i).fromSpec
proof:
:= by
  have key := standardChartIso_hom_toSpec C i e
  rw [standardChartEmb, Category.assoc, C.chartι_toBase, Iso.inv_comp_eq, ← Category.assoc, key,
    ← C.chartToBase_comp_openImmersion]
  change ((C.affineData i).toSpecBase ≫ (C.isAffine i).isoSpec.inv) ≫ (C.U i).ι =
    (C.affineData i).toSpecBase ≫ (C.isAffine i).isoSpec.inv ≫ (C.U i).ι
  rw [Category.assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.isIso_standardChartEmb_of_subsingleton
proof:
:= by
  rw [isIso_iff_isOpenImmersion_and_surjective]
  refine ⟨inferInstance, ⟨fun x ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨j, y, rfl⟩ := C.glueData.ι_jointly_surjective x
  obtain rfl : j = i := Subsingleton.elim (α := C.I) j i
  refine ⟨(standardChartIso C j e).hom y, ?_⟩
  change ((standardChartIso C j e).hom ≫ standardChartEmb C j e) y = _
  simp [standardChartEmb]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1.caseICover_card

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5FR.totalCap_generic_eq_totalPush
statement:
theorem totalCap_generic_eq_totalPush {L : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (ι : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι] [ι.IsOver (Spk k)]
    (hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = ι.ker) {n : ℕ}
    (hX : height (genericPoint X) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
    (hZ : height (genericPoint Z) = (n : ℕ∞)) :
    totalCapOn ops L hL
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow X m) (n + 1)
          ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
            (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint X) (n + 1) hX) :
              DimChow X (n + 1)))) =
      totalPushOn ops ι
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow Z m) n
          ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
            (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint Z) n hZ) : DimChow Z n)))
proof:
:= by
  have h := cap_generic_eq_push ops hL σ ι hid hX hZ
  simp only [totalCapOn, totalPushOn, DirectSum.toModule_lof, capComponentOn,
    LinearMap.comp_apply]
  rw [h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5FR.cartierClass_fundClass
statement:
theorem cartierClass_fundClass {L : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (ι : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι] [ι.IsOver (Spk k)]
    (hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = ι.ker) {n : ℕ}
    (hX : height (genericPoint X) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
    (hZ : height (genericPoint Z) = (n : ℕ∞)) :
    totalCapOn (opsV4 k) L hL (fundClass k (W := X)) =
      totalPushOn (opsV4 k) ι (fundClass k (W := Z))
proof:
:= by
  rw [fundClass_eq k (n + 1) hX, fundClass_eq k n hZ]
  exact totalCap_generic_eq_totalPush (opsV4 k) hL σ ι hid hX hZ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5FR.hasConstantRank_LPof
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_LPof {L N : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hN : HasConstantRank X N 1) : HasConstantRank X (LPof L N) 1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5FR.fibreRel_cheap
statement:
theorem fibreRel_cheap {Z₁ E : Scheme.{u}}
    [Z₁.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Z₁ ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian Z₁]
    [Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k Z₁)] [IsIntegral Z₁]
    [E.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (E ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian E]
    [Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k E)] [IsIntegral E]
    {L N : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (hN : HasConstantRank X N 1)
    (σ₁ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (ι₁ : Z₁ ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι₁] [ι₁.IsOver (Spk k)]
    (hid₁ : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ₁ = ι₁.ker)
    (σE : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ N) (ιE : E ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ιE] [ιE.IsOver (Spk k)]
    (hidE : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σE = ιE.ker) {n : ℕ}
    (hX : height (genericPoint X) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
    (hZ₁ : height (genericPoint Z₁) = (n : ℕ∞)) (hE : height (genericPoint E) = (n : ℕ∞)) :
    totalPushOn (opsV4 k) ι₁ (fundClass k (W := Z₁)) =
      totalCapOn (opsV4 k) (LPof L N) (hasConstantRank_LPof hL hN) (fundClass k (W := X)) +
        totalPushOn (opsV4 k) ιE (fundClass k (W := E))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cartierClass_fundClass hL σ₁ ι₁ hid₁ hX hZ₁,
    ← cartierClass_fundClass hN σE ιE hidE hX hE,
    totalCapOn_tensor_dual (opsV4 k) hL hN (hasConstantRank_LPof hL hN)]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechIntersectionSpecModuleOf_isQuasicoherent
statement:
theorem coordinateCechIntersectionSpecModuleOf_isQuasicoherent
    (M : (space k n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (coordinateCechIntersectionSpecModuleOf k n M p a).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsAffine (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).toScheme :=
    coordinateCechIntersection_isAffine k n p a
  letI : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
      (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).ι).obj M).IsQuasicoherent :=
    Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_restrictFunctor _ _
  exact pullback_isQuasicoherent_of_isAffine
    (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).toScheme.isoSpec.inv _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechIntersectionSpecModuleOf_H_isZero
statement:
theorem coordinateCechIntersectionSpecModuleOf_H_isZero
    (M : (space k n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) (q : ℕ) :
    IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (Sheaf.H
        ((Modules.toSheafAb
          (Spec Γ((coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).toScheme, ⊤))).obj
            (coordinateCechIntersectionSpecModuleOf k n M p a))
        (q + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsNoetherianRing
      Γ((coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).toScheme, ⊤) :=
    coordinateCechIntersection_isNoetherianRing k n p a
  letI : (coordinateCechIntersectionSpecModuleOf k n M p a).IsQuasicoherent :=
    coordinateCechIntersectionSpecModuleOf_isQuasicoherent k n M p a
  exact AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.quasicoherent_H_isZero
    (coordinateCechIntersectionSpecModuleOf k n M p a) q

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechIntersection_module_H_isZero
statement:
theorem coordinateCechIntersection_module_H_isZero
    (M : (space k n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) (q : ℕ) :
    IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (Sheaf.H
        ((Modules.toSheafAb (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).toScheme).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
            (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).ι).obj M))
        (q + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsAffine (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).toScheme :=
    coordinateCechIntersection_isAffine k n p a
  apply AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.module_H_isZero_of_pullback_inverse_iso
    (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).toScheme.isoSpec
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
      (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).ι).obj M) (q + 1)
  exact coordinateCechIntersectionSpecModuleOf_H_isZero k n M p a q

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.quasicoherent_coordinateCechAcyclic
statement:
theorem quasicoherent_coordinateCechAcyclic
    (M : (space k n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] :
    CoordinateCechAcyclic k n ((Modules.toSheafAb (space k n)).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  intro p a q
  change IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
    (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
      ((Modules.toSheafAb (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).toScheme).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
          (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).ι).obj M)) (q + 1)))
  exact coordinateCechIntersection_module_H_isZero k n M p a q

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K6.xiCapOn_pullbackFrameCover
statement:
theorem xiCapOn_pullbackFrameCover [Fact (Cl C.scheme)]
    [Fact (Cl (C.pullbackFrameCover g).scheme)] :
    xiCapOn ops (C.pullbackFrameCover g) =
      totalCapOn ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g)).obj
        (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))
        (hasConstantRank_pullback _ _ _ 1 (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))
proof:
:=
  cp.cap_iso ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    (hasConstantRank_pullback _ _ _ 1 (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))
    ⟨C.pullbackCanonicalTwistingSheafOneIso g⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K6.xiCapOn_pow_pullbackProjectiveMap_flat
statement:
theorem xiCapOn_pow_pullbackProjectiveMap_flat [Fact (Cl C.scheme)]
    [Fact (Cl (C.pullbackFrameCover g).scheme)] [Flat g] (j : ℕ) :
    letI
proof:
:= pullbackProjectiveMap_isOver (k := k) C g
    letI := pullbackProjectiveMap_flat C g
    totalPullOn ops (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) d (C.pullbackProjectiveMap_pureRelDim k g d hd) ∘ₗ
      ((xiCapOn ops C) ^ j) =
    ((xiCapOn ops (C.pullbackFrameCover g)) ^ j) ∘ₗ
      totalPullOn ops (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) d
        (C.pullbackProjectiveMap_pureRelDim k g d hd) := by
  letI := pullbackProjectiveMap_isOver (k := k) C g
  letI := pullbackProjectiveMap_flat C g
  have h := cp.cap_pull (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) d
    (C.pullbackProjectiveMap_pureRelDim k g d hd)
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
  rw [← xiCapOn_pullbackFrameCover C g ops cp] at h
  exact (Module.End.commute_pow_left_of_commute h.symm j).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K6.projection_totalPullOn_flat
statement:
theorem projection_totalPullOn_flat [Fact (Cl C.scheme)]
    [Fact (Cl (C.pullbackFrameCover g).scheme)] [Flat g] {r : ℕ}
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = r + 1) :
    letI
proof:
:= pullbackProjectiveMap_isOver (k := k) C g
    letI := pullbackProjectiveMap_flat C g
    letI := C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos r))
    let D := C.pullbackFrameCover g
    let hD := C.pullbackFrameCover_card g hC
    letI := D.toBase_flat (D.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hD (Nat.succ_pos r))
    totalPullOn ops (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) d (C.pullbackProjectiveMap_pureRelDim k g d hd) ∘ₗ
      totalPullOn ops C.toBase r (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC) =
    totalPullOn ops D.toBase r (cp.projBundle_relDim D hD) ∘ₗ
      totalPullOn ops g d hd := by
  letI := pullbackProjectiveMap_isOver (k := k) C g
  letI := pullbackProjectiveMap_flat C g
  letI := C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos r))
  let D := C.pullbackFrameCover g
  let hD := C.pullbackFrameCover_card g hC
  letI := D.toBase_flat (D.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hD (Nat.succ_pos r))
  have hleft := cp.pull_comp (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) C.toBase d r
    (C.pullbackProjectiveMap_pureRelDim k g d hd) (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC)
    (PureRelDim.comp (C.pullbackProjectiveMap_pureRelDim k g d hd) (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC))
  have hright := cp.pull_comp D.toBase g r d (cp.projBundle_relDim D hD)
    hd
    (PureRelDim.comp (cp.projBundle_relDim D hD) hd)
  simp only [Nat.add_comm d r] at hright
  exact hleft.symm.trans
    ((totalPullOn_congr ops (C.pullbackProjectiveMap_toBase g) (r + d) _ _).trans hright)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K6.sandwichOn_pull_flat
statement:
theorem sandwichOn_pull_flat [Fact (Cl C.scheme)]
    [Fact (Cl (C.pullbackFrameCover g).scheme)] [Flat g] {r : ℕ}
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = r + 1) (j : ℕ) :
    totalPullOn ops g d hd ∘ₗ sandwichOn ops C cp hC j =
      sandwichOn ops (C.pullbackFrameCover g) cp (C.pullbackFrameCover_card g hC) j ∘ₗ
        totalPullOn ops g d hd
proof:
:= by
  letI := pullbackProjectiveMap_isOver (k := k) C g
  letI := pullbackProjectiveMap_flat C g
  letI := C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos r))
  let D := C.pullbackFrameCover g
  let hD := C.pullbackFrameCover_card g hC
  letI := D.toBase_flat (D.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hD (Nat.succ_pos r))
  let PG := totalPullOn ops g d hd
  let PF := totalPullOn ops (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) d
    (C.pullbackProjectiveMap_pureRelDim k g d hd)
  let PC := totalPullOn ops C.toBase r (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC)
  let PD := totalPullOn ops D.toBase r (cp.projBundle_relDim D hD)
  have hb : PG ∘ₗ totalPushOn ops C.toBase = totalPushOn ops D.toBase ∘ₗ PF :=
    cp.base_change C.toBase g D.toBase (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) d hd
      (C.pullbackProjectiveMap_pureRelDim k g d hd) (C.isPullback_pullbackProjectiveMap g)
  have hp : PF ∘ₗ ((xiCapOn ops C) ^ j) = ((xiCapOn ops D) ^ j) ∘ₗ PF :=
    xiCapOn_pow_pullbackProjectiveMap_flat C g ops cp d hd j
  have hc : PF ∘ₗ PC = PD ∘ₗ PG := projection_totalPullOn_flat C g ops cp d hd hC
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro α
  change PG (totalPushOn ops C.toBase ((((xiCapOn ops C) ^ j)) (PC α))) =
    totalPushOn ops D.toBase ((((xiCapOn ops D) ^ j)) (PD (PG α)))
  calc
    _ = totalPushOn ops D.toBase (PF ((((xiCapOn ops C) ^ j)) (PC α))) :=
      LinearMap.congr_fun hb _
    _ = totalPushOn ops D.toBase ((((xiCapOn ops D) ^ j)) (PF (PC α))) :=
      congrArg (totalPushOn ops D.toBase) (LinearMap.congr_fun hp (PC α))
    _ = _ := congrArg (fun z => totalPushOn ops D.toBase ((((xiCapOn ops D) ^ j)) z))
      (LinearMap.congr_fun hc α)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K6.segreOn_pull_flat
statement:
theorem segreOn_pull_flat [Fact (Cl C.scheme)]
    [Fact (Cl (C.pullbackFrameCover g).scheme)] [Flat g] {r : ℕ}
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = r + 1) (i : ℕ) :
    totalPullOn ops g d hd ∘ₗ segreOn ops C cp hC i =
      segreOn ops (C.pullbackFrameCover g) cp (C.pullbackFrameCover_card g hC) i ∘ₗ
        totalPullOn ops g d hd
proof:
:=
  sandwichOn_pull_flat C g ops cp d hd hC (r + i)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K6.chernOfCoverOn_pull_flat
statement:
theorem chernOfCoverOn_pull_flat [Fact (Cl C.scheme)]
    [Fact (Cl (C.pullbackFrameCover g).scheme)] [Flat g] {r : ℕ}
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = r + 1) (i : ℕ) :
    totalPullOn ops g d hd ∘ₗ chernOfCoverOn ops C cp hC i =
      chernOfCoverOn ops (C.pullbackFrameCover g) cp (C.pullbackFrameCover_card g hC) i ∘ₗ
        totalPullOn ops g d hd
proof:
:= by
  have h := invOfUnit_coeff_intertwines (totalPullOn ops g d hd)
    (segreOn ops C cp hC)
    (segreOn ops (C.pullbackFrameCover g) cp (C.pullbackFrameCover_card g hC))
    (fun j ↦ segreOn_pull_flat C g ops cp d hd hC j) i
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro α
  simp only [chernOfCoverOn, segreSeriesOn, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul]
  exact congrArg (fun z ↦ ((-1 : ℚ) ^ i) • z) (LinearMap.congr_fun h α)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K6.chernOpOn'_pull_flat
statement:
theorem chernOpOn'_pull_flat (hP : ProjBundleClosedPos Cl) [Flat g]
    (L : Y.Modules) (r : ℕ) (hL : HasConstantRank Y L r) (i : ℕ) :
    totalPullOn ops g d hd ∘ₗ chernOpOn' ops cp hP L r hL i =
      chernOpOn' ops cp hP ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj L) r
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X g L r hL) i ∘ₗ totalPullOn ops g d hd
proof:
:= by
  cases r with
  | zero =>
    by_cases hi : i = 0
    · simp only [chernOpOn', if_pos hi]
      change totalPullOn ops g d hd ∘ₗ LinearMap.id = LinearMap.id ∘ₗ totalPullOn ops g d hd
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_id, LinearMap.id_comp]
    · simp only [chernOpOn', if_neg hi, LinearMap.comp_zero, LinearMap.zero_comp]
  | succ r =>
    let C := (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hL).choose
    have hC := (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hL).choose_spec
    haveI : Fact (Cl C.scheme) := ⟨hP C hC⟩
    haveI : Fact (Cl (C.pullbackFrameCover g).scheme) :=
      ⟨hP (C.pullbackFrameCover g) (C.pullbackFrameCover_card g hC)⟩
    rw [chernOpOn'_eq_chernOfCoverOn ops cp hP C hL hC,
      chernOpOn'_eq_chernOfCoverOn ops cp hP (C.pullbackFrameCover g)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X g L (r + 1) hL) (C.pullbackFrameCover_card g hC)]
    exact chernOfCoverOn_pull_flat C g ops cp d hd hC i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K6.flatNaturalConstRankOn_constRankChernAssignOn'
statement:
theorem flatNaturalConstRankOn_constRankChernAssignOn' (hP : ProjBundleClosedPos Cl) :
    FlatNaturalConstRankOn ops (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP)
proof:
:= by
  intro X Y _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ g _ _ d hd E r hr n
  rw [constRankChernAssignOn'_eq ops cp hP E r hr,
    constRankChernAssignOn'_eq ops cp hP _ r (hasConstantRank_pullback X g E r hr)]
  exact chernOpOn'_pull_flat g ops cp d hd hP E r hr n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K6.flatNaturalOn_constRankChernAssignOn'
statement:
theorem flatNaturalOn_constRankChernAssignOn' (hP : ProjBundleClosedPos Cl)
    (hconn : ∀ {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)]
      [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (Cl X)], PreconnectedSpace X) :
    FlatNaturalOn ops (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP)
proof:
:= by
  intro X Y _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ g _ _ d hd E hE n
  haveI : PreconnectedSpace Y := hconn
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hasConstantRank_of_isFiniteLocallyFree_of_preconnected hE
  exact flatNaturalConstRankOn_constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP g d hd E r hr n
    |>.trans rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.isUnit_germ_coord_tensor
statement:
theorem isUnit_germ_coord_tensor {M N : X.Modules} {p : X} (d : LineBundleLocalData X M p)
    (e : LineBundleLocalData X N p) (s : Γ(M, ⊤)) (t : Γ(N, ⊤))
    (hs : IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ d.U p d.mem (sectionCoordSec d s)))
    (ht : IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ e.U p e.mem (sectionCoordSec e t))) :
    IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ (d.tensor e).U p (d.tensor e).mem (sectionCoordSec (d.tensor e)
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.tensorSheafPureTensorSection M N ⊤ s t)))
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (X.presheaf.germ (d.U ⊓ e.U) p ⟨d.mem, e.mem⟩)
    (sectionCoordSec_tensor d e s t)
  have h1 := X.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE (inf_le_left : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ d.U)) p
    ⟨d.mem, e.mem⟩ (sectionCoordSec d s)
  have h2 := X.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE (inf_le_right : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ e.U)) p
    ⟨d.mem, e.mem⟩ (sectionCoordSec e t)
  rw [map_mul, h1, h2] at h
  change IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ (d.U ⊓ e.U) p ⟨d.mem, e.mem⟩ _)
  rw [h]
  exact hs.mul ht

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.avoidsAt_tensorPow
statement:
theorem avoidsAt_tensorPow {B : X.Modules} (A : X.Modules) (hA : ∀ p, GenAt A p)
    (ρ : k →+* Γ(X, ⊤)) (d : ∀ p, LineBundleLocalData X B p) (t : Fin (n + 1) → Γ(B, ⊤))
    (c : X → Fin (n + 1))
    (hc : ∀ p, IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ (d p).U p (d p).mem (sectionCoordSec (d p) (t (c p)))))
    (hsep : Separates ρ d t) (S : Finset X) :
    ∃ m0 : ℕ, ∀ m, m0 ≤ m → ∃ z : Γ(tensorSheaf X A (tensorPowSucc B m), ⊤), ∀ p ∈ S,
      ∀ e : LineBundleLocalData X (tensorSheaf X A (tensorPowSucc B m)) p,
        IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ e.U p e.mem (sectionCoordSec e z))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose sA fA hfA using hA
  let F := tensorChartFrames (n := n) (A := A) (B := B) ρ fA d t c hc
  have hφ : F.φ = evalAt ρ d t := by
    funext p
    unfold ChartFrames.φ evalAt
    congr 1
    funext i
    change ψ p ((fA p).U ⊓ (d p).U) ⟨(fA p).mem, (d p).mem⟩
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : (fA p).U ⊓ (d p).U ≤ (d p).U)).op
          (sectionCoordSec (d p) (t i))) =
      ψ p (d p).U (d p).mem (sectionCoordSec (d p) (t i))
    unfold ψ
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
    rw [X.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE (inf_le_right : (fA p).U ⊓ (d p).U ≤ (d p).U)) p
      ⟨(fA p).mem, (d p).mem⟩]
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (RiemannRoch.GradedAvoidD29.hker
      (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) k) F.φ) (S : Set X) := by
    rw [hφ]
    exact hsep S
  have hgen : ∀ p ∈ S, ∃ (m1 : ℕ) (z : Γ(tensorSheaf X A (tensorPowSucc B m1), ⊤)),
      IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ (F.U p) p (F.hU p) (F.coordU p m1 z)) := by
    intro p _
    refine ⟨0, SchemeProjectiveSpace.tensorSheafPureTensorSection A B ⊤ (sA p) (t (c p)), ?_⟩
    have := isUnit_germ_coord_tensor (fA p) (d p) (sA p) (t (c p)) (hfA p) (hc p)
    unfold ChartFrames.coordU
    rw [X.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE (F.hle p 0)) p (F.hU p)]
    exact this
  obtain ⟨m0, hm0⟩ := F.eventual_unit S hinj hgen
  refine ⟨m0, fun m hm => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hm0 m hm
  refine ⟨z, fun p hp e => ?_⟩
  have h1 := hz p hp
  unfold ChartFrames.coordU at h1
  rw [X.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE (F.hle p m)) p (F.hU p)] at h1
  exact isUnit_coord_of_isUnit_coord (F.e p m) e z p (F.e p m).mem e.mem h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.localAvoidance_of_chartData
statement:
theorem localAvoidance_of_chartData (L B B' : X.Modules)
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (hB : HasConstantRank X B 1) (hB' : HasConstantRank X B' 1)
    (hB'g : ∀ p, GenAt B' p) (hLg : ∀ p, GenAt (tensorSheaf X L B') p)
    (ρ : k →+* Γ(X, ⊤)) (d : ∀ p, LineBundleLocalData X B p) (t : Fin (n + 1) → Γ(B, ⊤))
    (c : X → Fin (n + 1))
    (hc : ∀ p, IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ (d p).U p (d p).mem (sectionCoordSec (d p) (t (c p)))))
    (hsep : Separates ρ d t) : LocalAvoidance L
proof:
:= by
  intro P hP
  obtain ⟨m1, h1⟩ := avoidsAt_tensorPow B' hB'g ρ d t c hc hsep hP.toFinset
  obtain ⟨m2, h2⟩ := avoidsAt_tensorPow (tensorSheaf X L B') hLg ρ d t c hc hsep hP.toFinset
  obtain ⟨z1, hz1⟩ := h1 (max m1 m2) (le_max_left _ _)
  obtain ⟨z2, hz2⟩ := h2 (max m1 m2) (le_max_right _ _)
  refine ⟨tensorSheaf X B' (tensorPowSucc B (max m1 m2)),
    tensorSheaf X (tensorSheaf X L B') (tensorPowSucc B (max m1 m2)), ?_, ?_, ⟨z2, ?_⟩, ⟨z1, ?_⟩⟩
  · have := hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hB' (hasConstantRank_tensorPowSucc hB (max m1 m2))
    rwa [one_mul] at this
  · exact ⟨(tensorSheafAssociator X L B' (tensorPowSucc B (max m1 m2))).symm⟩
  · intro p hp e
    exact hz2 p (by simpa using hp) e
  · intro p hp e
    exact hz1 p (by simpa using hp) e

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E27.maximalIdeal_eq_span_image
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_eq_span_image {R T : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing T] [IsLocalRing R]
    [IsLocalRing T] (φ : R →+* T) [IsLocalHom φ] (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) (g : R)
    (J : Ideal R) (hJ : J ≤ RingHom.ker φ)
    (hm : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span {g} ⊔ J) :
    IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal T = Ideal.span {φ g}
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal T).comap φ = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R :=
    IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal (Ideal.comap_isMaximal_of_surjective φ hφ
      (K := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal T))
  rw [← Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective φ hφ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal T), hc, hm,
    Ideal.map_sup, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton,
    (Ideal.map_eq_bot_iff_le_ker φ).mpr hJ, sup_bot_eq]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E27.maximalIdeal_image_eq_span
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_image_eq_span {W V S : Scheme.{u}} (πB : W ⟶ S) (j : V ⟶ W)
    [IsClosedImmersion j] (q : V) (y : W) (hy : j q = y)
    (hq : flatPullbackCoeff (j ≫ πB) q = 1) (w : W) (h : w ⤳ y) (hwf : πB w = πB y)
    {T : Type*} [CommRing T] [IsLocalRing T] (φ : W.presheaf.stalk y →+* T) [IsLocalHom φ]
    (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) (hker : RingHom.ker φ = Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h)
    (g : W.presheaf.stalk (j q)) (hg : RingHom.ker (j.stalkMap q).hom = Ideal.span {g}) :
    IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal T =
      Ideal.span {φ ((W.presheaf.stalkCongr (Inseparable.of_eq hy)).hom g)}
proof:
:= by
  subst hy
  have hm := E25.stalk_maximalIdeal_eq_ker_sup πB j q hq
  rw [hg] at hm
  have hJ := m6pb_ideal_le_prime πB h hwf
  rw [← hker] at hJ
  have := maximalIdeal_eq_span_image φ hφ g _ hJ hm
  simpa using this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E27.closure_maximalIdeal_eq_span
statement:
theorem closure_maximalIdeal_eq_span {W V S : Scheme.{u}} (πB : W ⟶ S) (j : V ⟶ W)
    [IsClosedImmersion j] (q : V) (hq : flatPullbackCoeff (j ≫ πB) q = 1) (w : W)
    (z : pointClosureScheme w) (hz : j q = pointClosureι w z)
    (hwf : πB w = πB (pointClosureι w z))
    (g : W.presheaf.stalk (j q)) (hg : RingHom.ker (j.stalkMap q).hom = Ideal.span {g}) :
    IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((pointClosureScheme w).presheaf.stalk z) =
      Ideal.span {((pointClosureι w).stalkMap z).hom
        ((W.presheaf.stalkCongr (Inseparable.of_eq hz)).hom g)}
proof:
:= by
  have h : w ⤳ pointClosureι w z := specializes_pointClosureι z
  have h' : (pointClosureι w) (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme w)) ⤳ pointClosureι w z := by
    rw [pointClosureι_genericPoint']; exact h
  have hker : RingHom.ker ((pointClosureι w).stalkMap z).hom =
      Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h := by
    rw [ker_stalkMap_eq_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (pointClosureι w) z h']
    exact stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_congr (pointClosureι_genericPoint' w) h' h
  exact maximalIdeal_image_eq_span πB j q _ hz hq w h hwf _
    ((pointClosureι w).stalkMap_surjective z) hker g hg

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E27.false_of_mem_range_of_regular_kernel
statement:
theorem false_of_mem_range_of_regular_kernel {W V S : Scheme.{u}} (πB : W ⟶ S) (j : V ⟶ W)
    [IsClosedImmersion j] [Flat (j ≫ πB)] (q : V) (hw : flatPullbackCoeff πB (j q) = 1)
    (g : W.presheaf.stalk (j q)) (hg : RingHom.ker (j.stalkMap q).hom = Ideal.span {g})
    (hreg : IsSMulRegular (W.presheaf.stalk (j q)) g) : False
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra (S.presheaf.stalk (πB (j q))) (W.presheaf.stalk (j q)) :=
    (πB.stalkMap (j q)).hom.toAlgebra
  have hm := E25.map_maximalIdeal_eq_of_flatPullbackCoeff_eq_one πB (j q) hw
  have hgm : g ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (W.presheaf.stalk (j q)) := by
    by_contra hnm
    have hu : IsUnit g := by
      simpa [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff] using hnm
    have hker : g ∈ RingHom.ker (j.stalkMap q).hom := by
      rw [hg]; exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self g
    have h0 : (j.stalkMap q).hom g = 0 := hker
    have := hu.map (j.stalkMap q).hom
    rw [h0] at this
    exact not_isUnit_zero this
  have hlocal : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (W.presheaf.stalk (j q))) ≠ ⊤ :=
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal _).ne_top
  refine false_of_flat_quotient_regular
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (S.presheaf.stalk (πB (j q)))) g ?_ hreg ?_ ?_
  · change g ∈ Ideal.map (πB.stalkMap (j q)).hom _
    rw [hm]; exact hgm
  · change Ideal.map (πB.stalkMap (j q)).hom _ ≠ ⊤
    rw [hm]; exact hlocal
  · 
    letI : Algebra (S.presheaf.stalk (πB (j q))) (V.presheaf.stalk q) :=
      ((j ≫ πB).stalkMap q).hom.toAlgebra
    have hflat : Module.Flat (S.presheaf.stalk (πB (j q))) (V.presheaf.stalk q) :=
      Flat.stalkMap (j ≫ πB) q
    let e : (W.presheaf.stalk (j q) ⧸ Ideal.span {g}) ≃+* V.presheaf.stalk q :=
      (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hg.symm).trans
        (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective (j.stalkMap_surjective q))
    let eA : (W.presheaf.stalk (j q) ⧸ Ideal.span {g}) ≃ₐ[S.presheaf.stalk (πB (j q))]
        V.presheaf.stalk q :=
      AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := e) (fun a => by
        change e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ ((πB.stalkMap (j q)).hom a)) = ((j ≫ πB).stalkMap q).hom a
        rw [Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp]
        rfl)
    exact Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv eA.toLinearEquiv

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E27.eq_of_stalkPrime_eq_maximal

proof:
:= by

        Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_isPrime h⟩ :=
        (Scheme.fromSpecStalk_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E27.coheight_eq_one_of_maximalIdeal_span
statement:
theorem coheight_eq_one_of_maximalIdeal_span {Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Z]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian Z] (z : Z) (a : Z.presheaf.stalk z) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hmax : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Z.presheaf.stalk z) = Ideal.span {a}) :
    coheight z = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hnu : ¬ IsUnit a := by
    have : a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Z.presheaf.stalk z) := by
      rw [hmax]; exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self a
    exact (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal a).mp this
  have h1 : (Ideal.span {a}).height = 1 :=
    Ideal.height_span_singleton_eq_one_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors
      (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero ha) hnu
  have h2 := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim (R := Z.presheaf.stalk z)
  rw [hmax, h1] at h2
  have h3 := ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight z
  rw [← h2] at h3
  exact_mod_cast h3.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E27.closure_image_ne_zero
statement:
theorem closure_image_ne_zero {W V S : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian W] (πB : W ⟶ S)
    (j : V ⟶ W) [IsClosedImmersion j] (q : V) (hq : flatPullbackCoeff (j ≫ πB) q = 1) (w : W)
    (z : pointClosureScheme w) (hz : j q = pointClosureι w z)
    (hwf : πB w = πB (pointClosureι w z)) (hne : w ≠ j q)
    (g : W.presheaf.stalk (j q)) (hg : RingHom.ker (j.stalkMap q).hom = Ideal.span {g}) :
    ((pointClosureι w).stalkMap z).hom ((W.presheaf.stalkCongr (Inseparable.of_eq hz)).hom g) ≠
      0
proof:
:= by
  have hmax := closure_maximalIdeal_eq_span πB j q hq w z hz hwf g hg
  intro h0
  rw [h0, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot.mpr rfl] at hmax
  have h : w ⤳ pointClosureι w z := specializes_pointClosureι z
  have h' : (pointClosureι w) (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme w)) ⤳ pointClosureι w z := by
    rw [pointClosureι_genericPoint']; exact h
  have hker : RingHom.ker ((pointClosureι w).stalkMap z).hom =
      Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h := by
    rw [ker_stalkMap_eq_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (pointClosureι w) z h']
    exact stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_congr (pointClosureι_genericPoint' w) h' h
  have hmax' : Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (W.presheaf.stalk (pointClosureι w z)) := by
    rw [← hker, RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, ← hmax, IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap]
  exact hne ((eq_of_stalkPrime_eq_maximal h hmax').trans hz.symm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E27.coheight_closure_eq_one
statement:
theorem coheight_closure_eq_one {W V S : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian W] (πB : W ⟶ S)
    (j : V ⟶ W) [IsClosedImmersion j] (q : V) (hq : flatPullbackCoeff (j ≫ πB) q = 1) (w : W)
    (z : pointClosureScheme w) (hz : j q = pointClosureι w z)
    (hwf : πB w = πB (pointClosureι w z)) (hne : w ≠ j q)
    (g : W.presheaf.stalk (j q)) (hg : RingHom.ker (j.stalkMap q).hom = Ideal.span {g}) :
    coheight z = 1
proof:
:=
  coheight_eq_one_of_maximalIdeal_span z _
    (closure_image_ne_zero πB j q hq w z hz hwf hne g hg)
    (closure_maximalIdeal_eq_span πB j q hq w z hz hwf g hg)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_unit_restriction_postcompose
statement:
theorem rankTwo_unit_restriction_postcompose
    {Y Z W V : Scheme.{u}} (g : Z ⟶ Y) (q : W ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (v : V ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion v] (h : W ⟶ V) (comm : q ≫ g = h ≫ v)
    (M : Y.Modules) (N : Z.Modules) (T : W.Modules)
    (f : (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj M ⟶ N)
    (ρ : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj N ⟶ T)
    (U : Y.Opens) (s : M.val.obj (op U)) :
    let e
proof:
:= AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso g q v h comm
    let F := e.inv.app M ≫ (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map f
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr comm.symm).hom.app T).app U
      ((F ≫ ρ).app (h ⁻¹ᵁ v ⁻¹ᵁ U)
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction h).unit.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).obj M)).app (v ⁻¹ᵁ U)
          (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction v).unit.app M).app U s))) =
    ρ.app (q ⁻¹ᵁ g ⁻¹ᵁ U)
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).unit.app N).app (g ⁻¹ᵁ U)
        (f.app (g ⁻¹ᵁ U)
          (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app M).app U s))) := by
  dsimp only
  let e := AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso g q v h comm
  let F := e.inv.app M ≫ (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map f
  let x := ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction h).unit.app
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).obj M)).app (v ⁻¹ᵁ U)
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction v).unit.app M).app U s)
  have h0 := pullbackTwistQuotient_openSquare_unit_hom_sections g q v h comm M N f U s
  dsimp only at h0
  have hn := congrArg (fun a => a.app U (F.app (h ⁻¹ᵁ v ⁻¹ᵁ U) x))
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr comm.symm).hom.naturality ρ)
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app,
    ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hn
  have H := hn.trans (congrArg (fun y => ρ.app (q ⁻¹ᵁ g ⁻¹ᵁ U) y) h0)
  have hq := congrArg (fun a => a.app (g ⁻¹ᵁ U)
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app M).app U s))
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).unit.naturality f)
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app,
    Functor.comp_map, Functor.id_map, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hq
  exact H.trans (congrArg (fun y => ρ.app (q ⁻¹ᵁ g ⁻¹ᵁ U) y) hq.symm)

name: KSpecialization.AR7R.killedTransport_killedMap_cokernel
statement:
theorem killedTransport_killedMap_cokernel
    [T.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits T] [PreservesFiniteColimits T]
    [T.PreservesMonomorphisms] [TW.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits TW]
    [PreservesFiniteColimits TW] [TW.PreservesMonomorphisms]
    (hI : LocallyPrincipal I) (hB : AR7Bridge I T σ)
    (c : PushCompat TW σW T σ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F))
    (hcW : Central TW σW) (hTW : ∀ E, IsCoherentLike W E → IsCoherentLike W (TW.obj E))
    (V : W.Modules) (hV : IsCoherentLike W V)
    {Wz : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian Wz] (η : Wz ⟶ W) (Fz : Wz ⟶ I.subscheme)
    [IsFinite Fz] (hsq : Fz ≫ I.subschemeι = η ≫ F)
    (G : Wz.Modules) (hG : IsCoherentLike Wz G)
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward η).obj G ≅ cokernel (ap TW σW V)) :
    g0KilledIEquiv hI (killedTransport hB
        (killedMap c (finitePush_obj F) (finitePush_exactOn F)
          (subcategoryClassOf W.Modules (Killed TW σW (IsCoherentLike W))
            (cokernel (ap TW σW V))
            (killed_cokernel hcW kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike hTW hV)))) =
      finitePushforward Fz (g0ClassOf Wz G hG)
proof:
:= by
  have hK := killed_cokernel hcW kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike hTW hV
  have m1 : killedMap c (finitePush_obj F) (finitePush_exactOn F)
      (subcategoryClassOf W.Modules (Killed TW σW (IsCoherentLike W)) (cokernel (ap TW σW V)) hK) =
      subcategoryClassOf Y.Modules (Killed T σ (IsCoherentLike Y))
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj (cokernel (ap TW σW V)))
        (c.killed (finitePush_obj F) _ hK) := mapOn_classOf _ _ _ _ _
  rw [m1, killedTransport_classOf]
  have h1 : subcategoryClassOf Y.Modules (KilledI I)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj (cokernel (ap TW σW V)))
      ⟨(c.killed (finitePush_obj F) _ hK).1, hB.idealKills_of_killed _ (c.killed (finitePush_obj F) _ hK).1
        (c.killed (finitePush_obj F) _ hK).2⟩ =
      KSpecialization.AR4.pushZero (I := I) (finitePushforward Fz (g0ClassOf Wz G hG)) := by
    rw [finitePushforward_classOf]
    change _ = KSpecialization.AR4.pushZero (I := I) (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _
      ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pushforward Fz).obj G, (finitePushObject Fz ⟨G, hG⟩).2⟩)
    rw [KSpecialization.AR4.pushZero_classOf]
    refine ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso _ _ _ _ KSpecialization.AR4.killedI_zero (isZero_zero _) ?_
    refine (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).mapIso e.symm ≪≫ ?_
    refine (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp η F).app G ≪≫ ?_
    refine (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr hsq.symm).app G ≪≫ ?_
    exact ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp Fz I.subschemeι).app G).symm
  rw [h1]
  have h2 := congrArg (fun f : G0 I.subscheme →+ G0 I.subscheme =>
    f (finitePushforward Fz (g0ClassOf Wz G hG))) (KSpecialization.AR4.pullFibre_comp_pushZero hI)
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.id_apply] at h2
  exact h2

name: KSpecialization.AR7R.locallyTrivial_of_hasConstantRank_one
statement: theorem locallyTrivial_of_hasConstantRank_one (h : HasConstantRank X M 1) : LocallyTrivial M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, -, hcard⟩ := h
  letI := hq
  intro x
  have hcov := (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := X) q.X).1 q.coversTop
  have hx : x ∈ ((⨆ i, q.X i : X.Opens) : Set X) := by rw [hcov]; trivial
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp hx
  exact ⟨q.X i, hxi, exists_triv M q hcard i⟩

name: KSpecialization.AR7R.isLocalLineFrame_of_hasConstantRank_one
statement:
theorem isLocalLineFrame_of_hasConstantRank_one (h : HasConstantRank X M 1) :

proof:
:= by

  have hx : x ∈ ((⨆ i, q.X i : X.Opens) : Set X) := by rw [hcov]; trivial
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp hx

name: KSpecialization.AR7R.hbc_cartier_AR7R
statement:
theorem hbc_cartier_AR7R (hL : SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank Y L 1)
    [IsLocallyNoetherian (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme]
    (hmono : ∀ E : Y.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFree Y E →
      Mono (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor Y (lineBundleDual Y L))
        (sigmaT (lineBundleDual Y L) (dualEval σ)) E))
    {W : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian W] (F : W ⟶ Y) [IsFinite F]
    (V : W.Modules) (hV : IsCoherentLike W V)
    [Mono (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)))
      (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) V)]
    (y : K0 Y) (hy : k0ToG0 Y y = finitePushforward F (g0ClassOf W V hV))
    {Wz : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian Wz] (η : Wz ⟶ W)
    (Fz : Wz ⟶ (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme) [IsFinite Fz]
    (hsq : Fz ≫ (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι = η ≫ F)
    (G : Wz.Modules) (hG : IsCoherentLike Wz G)
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward η).obj G ≅
      cokernel (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)))
        (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) V)) :
    k0ToG0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme
        (pullbackK0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι y) =
      finitePushforward Fz (g0ClassOf Wz G hG)
proof:
:= by
  have hline : IsLocalLineFrame L := isLocalLineFrame_of_hasConstantRank_one hL
  have hΛ1 : SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank Y (lineBundleDual Y L) 1 :=
    lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank L hL
  have hΛ : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y (lineBundleDual Y L) := hΛ1.isFiniteLocallyFree
  have hΛW1 := SchemeKTheory.hasConstantRank_pullback W F _ 1 hΛ1
  have hΛW : IsFiniteLocallyFree W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)) :=
    hΛW1.isFiniteLocallyFree
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits Y _ hΛ
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits Y _ hΛ
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits W _ hΛW
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits W _ hΛW
  have hT : ∀ E, IsCoherentLike Y E → IsCoherentLike Y
      ((tensorSheafLeftFunctor Y (lineBundleDual Y L)).obj E) := fun E hE =>
    tensorSheaf_isCoherentLike Y _ _ hΛ hE
  have hTW : ∀ E, IsCoherentLike W E → IsCoherentLike W
      ((tensorSheafLeftFunctor W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L))).obj E) :=
    fun E hE => tensorSheaf_isCoherentLike W _ _ hΛW hE
  have hcW := sigmaT_central (locallyTrivial_of_hasConstantRank_one hΛW1)
    (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))
  have hI := KSpecialization.AR4.locallyPrincipal_sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ hline
  have := hbc_cartier F hI (ar7Bridge σ hline) (central_twist σ hline) hT hmono
    (pushCompat F (dualEval σ) hΛ) hcW hTW
    (fun E _ => isIso_kernelComparison_pushforward F _)
    (fun E hE => isIso_cokernelComparison_pushforward F _ (hTW E hE) hE) V hV y hy
  rw [this]
  exact killedTransport_killedMap_cokernel F hI (ar7Bridge σ hline) (pushCompat F (dualEval σ) hΛ)
    hcW hTW V hV η Fz hsq G hG e

name: KSpecialization.AR8.killedTransport_classOf
statement:

name: KSpecialization.AR8.cartierGysin_eq_pullback
statement:
theorem cartierGysin_eq_pullback (hI : KSpecialization.AR4.LocallyPrincipal I)
    (hB : AR7Bridge I T σ) (hc : Central T σ)
    (hT : ∀ E, IsCoherentLike Y E → IsCoherentLike Y (T.obj E))
    (E : Y.Modules) (hE : IsCoherentLike Y E) [Mono (ap T σ E)] :
    KSpecialization.AR4.g0KilledIEquiv hI
        (killedTransport hB (cartierGysin hc kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike hT
          (subcategoryClassOf _ _ E hE))) =
      g0ClassOf I.subscheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback I.subschemeι).obj E) (by
        letI : E.IsFinitePresentation := hE
        exact pullback_isFinitePresentation_global I.subschemeι E)
proof:
:= by
  let adj := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction I.subschemeι
  haveI : PreservesColimitsOfSize.{0, 0} (Scheme.Modules.pullback I.subschemeι) :=
    adj.leftAdjoint_preservesColimits
  have hE' : IsCoherentLike I.subscheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback I.subschemeι).obj E) := by
    letI : E.IsFinitePresentation := hE
    exact pullback_isFinitePresentation_global I.subschemeι E
  refine pull_cartierGysin_classOf_of_mono hc kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike hT
    (G := Scheme.Modules.pullback I.subschemeι)
    (H := Scheme.Modules.pushforward I.subschemeι) adj
    (Q := IsCoherentLike I.subscheme)
    (inferInstanceAs (0 : I.subscheme.Modules).IsFinitePresentation)
    ((KSpecialization.AR4.pullFibre hI).comp (killedTransport hB)) ?_ E hE
    (hB.killed_of_idealKills _ (KSpecialization.AR4.idealKills_pushforward I _)) hE'
  intro K hK
  letI : K.IsFinitePresentation := hK.1
  refine ⟨(KSpecialization.AR4.fibrePullObject I
    ⟨K, hK.1, hB.idealKills_of_killed K hK.1 hK.2⟩).2, ?_⟩
  rw [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, killedTransport_classOf]
  exact KSpecialization.AR4.pullFibre_classOf hI ⟨K, hK.1, hB.idealKills_of_killed K hK.1 hK.2⟩

name: KSpecialization.AR8.cartierGysin_comp_finitePushforward
statement:
theorem cartierGysin_comp_finitePushforward
    (c : PushCompat TW σW TM σM (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F))
    (hcW : Central TW σW) (hTW : ∀ E, IsCoherentLike W E → IsCoherentLike W (TW.obj E))
    (hcM : Central TM σM) (hTM : ∀ E, IsCoherentLike M E → IsCoherentLike M (TM.obj E))
    (hker : ∀ E, IsCoherentLike W E →
      IsIso (kernelComparison (ap TW σW E) (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F)))
    (hcok : ∀ E, IsCoherentLike W E →
      IsIso (cokernelComparison (ap TW σW E) (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F))) :
    (cartierGysin hcM kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike hTM).comp
        (mapOn (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F) (finitePush_obj F) (finitePush_exactOn F)) =
      (killedMap c (finitePush_obj F) (finitePush_exactOn F)).comp
        (cartierGysin hcW kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike hTW)
proof:
:=
  cartierGysin_comp_map hcW kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike hTW hcM kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike
    hTM c (finitePush_obj F) (finitePush_exactOn F) hker hcok

name: RiemannRoch.KNFB.inl_frame_snd
statement:
theorem inl_frame_snd :
    SheafOfModules.freeMap (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) (Sum.inl : I → I ⊕ J) ≫
      (biprodFrameIsoE9 U I J e₁ e₃).hom ≫

proof:
:= by

      (SheafOfModules.freeSumIso (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) I J).inv = coprod.inl := by
    rw [← SheafOfModules.inl_freeSumIso_hom, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]

name: RiemannRoch.KNFB.snd_frame_section_inl
statement:
theorem snd_frame_section_inl (k : I) :
    ((biprod.snd : M ⊞ N' ⟶ N').val.app (op U)).hom
      (((biprodFrameIsoE9 U I J e₁ e₃).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))).hom
        ((SheafOfModules.freeSection (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) (Sum.inl k)).eval
          (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun f => (f.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))).hom
    ((SheafOfModules.freeSection (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) k).eval (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))))
    (inl_frame_snd U I J e₁ e₃ (M := M) (N' := N'))
  have e : ((SheafOfModules.freeMap (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) (Sum.inl : I → I ⊕ J)).val.app
      (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))).hom
      ((SheafOfModules.freeSection (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) k).eval (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))) =
      (SheafOfModules.freeSection (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) (Sum.inl k)).eval
        (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) := by
    have := congrArg (fun s => s.eval (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))))
      (SheafOfModules.sectionMap_freeMap_freeSection (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U)
        (Sum.inl : I → I ⊕ J) k)
    exact this
  rw [← e]
  refine Eq.trans ?_ h
  rfl

name: RiemannRoch.KNFB.snd_frame_section_inr
statement:
theorem snd_frame_section_inr (k : J) :
    ((biprod.snd : M ⊞ N' ⟶ N').val.app (op U)).hom
      (((biprodFrameIsoE9 U I J e₁ e₃).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))).hom
        ((SheafOfModules.freeSection (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) (Sum.inr k)).eval

          (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))))
proof:

    ((SheafOfModules.freeSection (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) k).eval (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))))
    (inr_frame_snd U I J e₁ e₃ (M := M) (N' := N'))
  have e : ((SheafOfModules.freeMap (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) (Sum.inr : J → I ⊕ J)).val.app
      (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))).hom
      ((SheafOfModules.freeSection (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) k).eval (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))) =
      (SheafOfModules.freeSection (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) (Sum.inr k)).eval
        (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) := by
    have := congrArg (fun s => s.eval (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))))
      (SheafOfModules.sectionMap_freeMap_freeSection (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U)

name: RiemannRoch.KNFB.freeOverIso_eval
statement:
theorem freeOverIso_eval (U : X.Opens) (I : Type u) (k : I) :
    ((SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X U I).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))).hom
        ((SheafOfModules.freeSection (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) k).eval
          (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))) =
      (SheafOfModules.freeSection (R := X.ringCatSheaf) k).eval (op U)
proof:
:= by
  let T : (Over U)ᵒᵖ := op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))
  have h := congrArg (fun s ↦ s.eval T)
    (Scheme.Modules.sectionsMap_freeOverIso_hom_freeSection X U I k)
  have h' := h.symm
  change
    ((SheafOfModules.free
      (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I).val.map
        (𝟙 U).op).hom
          ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op U)) =
      ((SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X U I).hom.val.app T).hom
          ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval T) at h'
  rw [show (𝟙 U).op = 𝟙 (op U) by rfl] at h'
  rw [(SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I).val.map_id] at h'
  exact h'.symm

name: RiemannRoch.KNFB.unitFrame_section
statement:
theorem unitFrame_section (U : X.Opens) :
    ((RiemannRoch.KNFA.unitFrame U).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))).hom
      ((SheafOfModules.freeSection (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) PUnit.unit).eval
        (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))) = (1 : X.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj (op U))
proof:
:= by
  unfold RiemannRoch.KNFA.unitFrame
  change (((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).hom.val.app (op U))).hom
      (((SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X U PUnit.{u + 1}).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))).hom
        ((SheafOfModules.freeSection (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) PUnit.unit).eval
          (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))))) = (1 : X.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj (op U))
  rw [freeOverIso_eval]
  have hg : SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit.unit ≫
      (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).hom = 𝟙 _ := by
    have := (coproductUniqueIso (fun _ : PUnit.{u + 1} =>
      SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).inv_hom_id
    rw [coproductUniqueIso_inv] at this
    exact this
  have := congrArg (fun f => (f.val.app (op U)).hom (1 : X.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj (op U))) hg
  exact this

name: RiemannRoch.KNFB.adaptedCover_snd_sectionBasis_inl

statement:
theorem weilGate_coeff_ite_of_parts [Flat P.toD.toBase]
    (σ : tensorUnitSheaf P.toB.scheme ⟶ E16.twistedLine P.toB L)
    (hσ : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = P.jHom.ker)
    (hB : flatPullback P.toB.toBase (dimPrimeCycle v m hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle w _ hw).1)
    (hD : flatPullback P.toD.toBase (dimPrimeCycle v m hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle q _ hq).1)
    {b₀ : pointClosureScheme w}
    (bf : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme w)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι w)).obj (E16.twistedLine P.toB L)) b₀)
    (hb : D10.sectionCoord bf (wPullbackSection (pointClosureι w) (sectionOfHom σ)) = 1)
    (hone : ∀ z : pointClosureScheme w, pointClosureι w z = P.jHom q →
      Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame
        (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure _
          (E16.hasConstantRank_twistedLine P.toB hL) w)
        (m7s_genericRank_pointClosure _ (E16.hasConstantRank_twistedLine P.toB hL) w) bf z = 1)
    (z : pointClosureScheme w) :
    Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame
        (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure _
          (E16.hasConstantRank_twistedLine P.toB hL) w)
        (m7s_genericRank_pointClosure _ (E16.hasConstantRank_twistedLine P.toB hL) w) bf z =
      if pointClosureι w z = P.jHom q then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  refine coeff_eq_ite_of_parts (k := k) P v hv w hw q hq hB hD _ (fun z hz ↦ ?_) (fun z _ hr ↦ ?_) hone z
  · exact E25.coeff_eq_zero_of_coheight_ne _ _ bf z hz
  · exact coeff_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range (E16.hasConstantRank_twistedLine P.toB hL) w _ _ σ
      P.jHom hσ bf hb z hr

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechBasicOpen_le_distinguishedCoordinateOpen
statement:
theorem coordinateCechBasicOpen_le_distinguishedCoordinateOpen (p : ℕ)

      coordinateOpen k n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a)
proof:

        coordinateCechBasicOpenInDistinguishedChart k n p a =

proof:

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurent_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurent_apply (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d, coordinateCechIntersection k n p a)) :
    coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurent k n d p a x =
      coordinateCechBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent k n p a

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurent_frameAssembly
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurent_frameAssembly (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (r : Γ(space k n, coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p a)) :
    coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurent k n d p a
        ((coordinateCechTwistingFrameEvaluation k n d p a).symm r) =
      coordinateCechBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent k n p a r *
        coordinateTwistingFrameLaurentMonomial k n d

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurent_basicOpenIsoAway_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurent_basicOpenIsoAway_hom (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (z : HomogeneousLocalization.Away
      (grading k n) (coordinateCechEquation k n p a)) :
    coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurent k n d p a
        ((coordinateCechTwistingFrameEvaluation k n d p a).symm
          ((coordinateCechBasicOpenIsoAway k n p a).hom z)) =
      coordinateCechAwayToLaurent k n p a z *
        coordinateTwistingFrameLaurentMonomial k n d
          (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a)

    coordinateCechBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent_basicOpenIsoAway_hom]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurent_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurent_mk (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) (q : ℕ) (f : Polynomial k n)
    (hf : f ∈ grading k n (q • (p + 1))) :
    coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurent k n d p a
        ((coordinateCechTwistingFrameEvaluation k n d p a).symm
          ((coordinateCechBasicOpenIsoAway k n p a).hom
            (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading k n)
              (coordinateCechEquation_mem_degree k n p a) q f hf))) =
      (polynomialToCoordinateLaurent k n f *
          coordinateCechEquationLaurentInverse k n p a ^ q) *
        coordinateTwistingFrameLaurentMonomial k n d
          (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurent_basicOpenIsoAway_hom,
    coordinateCechAwayToLaurent_mk]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionIdealChartSectionMap_value
statement:
theorem cosectionIdealChartSectionMap_value [E.IsQuasicoherent] (U : X.affineOpens)
    (x : Γ(affineChartModule X E U,⊤)) :
    (ConormalSheaf.chartSectionsEquiv (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ) U
      (cosectionIdealChartSectionMap X E σ U x) : Γ(X,U)) =
    affineCosection X E σ U (affineChartTopSectionsLinearEquiv X E U x)
proof:
:= by
  change ConormalSheaf.chartSectionsToRing (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ) U
    (cosectionIdealChartSectionMap X E σ U x) = _
  rw [ConormalSheaf.chartSectionsToRing_apply]
  have hi := cosectionIdealModuleMap_app_inclusion X E σ (U.2.fromSpec ''ᵁ ⊤) x
  change X.presheaf.map (eqToHom (affineChart_image_top X U).symm).op
    ((ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ)).app
      (U.2.fromSpec ''ᵁ ⊤) ((cosectionIdealModuleMap X E σ).app
        (U.2.fromSpec ''ᵁ ⊤) x)) = _
  calc
    _ = X.presheaf.map (eqToHom (affineChart_image_top X U).symm).op
        (σ.app (U.2.fromSpec ''ᵁ ⊤) x) :=
      congrArg (X.presheaf.map (eqToHom (affineChart_image_top X U).symm).op) hi
    _ = _ := (PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply σ.val
      (eqToHom (affineChart_image_top X U).symm).op x).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionIdealChartSectionMap_eq_rangeFactor
statement:
theorem cosectionIdealChartSectionMap_eq_rangeFactor [E.IsQuasicoherent] (U : X.affineOpens) :
    (ConormalSheaf.chartSectionsEquiv (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ) U).toLinearMap.comp
      (cosectionIdealChartSectionMap X E σ U) =
    (cosectionImageFactor (affineCosection X E σ U)).comp
      (affineChartTopSectionsLinearEquiv X E U).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact cosectionIdealChartSectionMap_value X E σ U x

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.quasicoherent_tildeCounit_inv_naturality
statement:
theorem quasicoherent_tildeCounit_inv_naturality (A : CommRingCat.{u})
    (M N : (Spec A).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] [N.IsQuasicoherent] (f : M ⟶ N) :
    f ≫ (asIso N.fromTildeΓ).inv =
      (asIso M.fromTildeΓ).inv ≫ (tilde.functor A).map (moduleSpecΓFunctor.map f)
proof:
:= by
  let eM := asIso M.fromTildeΓ
  let eN := asIso N.fromTildeΓ
  have hn : (tilde.functor A).map (moduleSpecΓFunctor.map f) ≫ eN.hom = eM.hom ≫ f :=
    Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓNatTrans.naturality f
  apply (cancel_mono eN.hom).mp
  calc
    _ = f := (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
      ((congrArg (fun k => f ≫ k) eN.inv_hom_id).trans (Category.comp_id f))
    _ = eM.inv ≫ (eM.hom ≫ f) :=
      ((Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
        ((congrArg (fun k => k ≫ f) eM.inv_hom_id).trans (Category.id_comp f))).symm
    _ = eM.inv ≫ ((tilde.functor A).map (moduleSpecΓFunctor.map f) ≫ eN.hom) :=
      congrArg (fun k => eM.inv ≫ k) hn.symm
    _ = _ := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionIdealChartMap_tilde
statement:
theorem cosectionIdealChartMap_tilde [E.IsQuasicoherent] (U : X.affineOpens) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.fromSpec).map (cosectionIdealModuleMap X E σ) ≫
      (ConormalSheaf.idealChartIsoTilde (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ) U).hom =
    (cosectionSourceChartIsoTilde X E U).hom ≫
      (tilde.functor Γ(X,U)).map (ModuleCat.ofHom (cosectionImageFactor (affineCosection X E σ U)))
proof:
:= by
  letI := affineChartModule_isQuasicoherent X E U
  letI : IsIso (affineChartModule X E U).fromTildeΓ :=
    Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent _
  letI : IsIso (ConormalSheaf.idealChart (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ) U).fromTildeΓ :=
    Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent _
  have hn := quasicoherent_tildeCounit_inv_naturality Γ(X,U)
    (affineChartModule X E U)
    (ConormalSheaf.idealChart (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ) U)
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.fromSpec).map (cosectionIdealModuleMap X E σ))
  have hs : moduleSpecΓFunctor.map
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.fromSpec).map (cosectionIdealModuleMap X E σ)) ≫
      (ConormalSheaf.chartSectionsEquiv (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ) U).toModuleIso.hom =
    (affineChartTopSectionsLinearEquiv X E U).toModuleIso.hom ≫
      ModuleCat.ofHom (cosectionImageFactor (affineCosection X E σ U)) := by
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    exact cosectionIdealChartSectionMap_eq_rangeFactor X E σ U
  let F := tilde.functor Γ(X,U)
  let c := (ConormalSheaf.chartSectionsEquiv (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ) U).toModuleIso.hom
  let t := (affineChartTopSectionsLinearEquiv X E U).toModuleIso.hom
  let g := moduleSpecΓFunctor.map
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.fromSpec).map (cosectionIdealModuleMap X E σ))
  let s := ModuleCat.ofHom (cosectionImageFactor (affineCosection X E σ U))
  let em := asIso (affineChartModule X E U).fromTildeΓ
  let en := asIso (ConormalSheaf.idealChart (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ) U).fromTildeΓ
  change _ ≫ (en.inv ≫ F.map c) = (em.inv ≫ F.map t) ≫ F.map s
  calc
    _ = (_ ≫ en.inv) ≫ F.map c := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = (em.inv ≫ F.map g) ≫ F.map c :=
      congrArg (fun k => k ≫ F.map c) hn
    _ = em.inv ≫ F.map (g ≫ c) :=
      (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg (fun k => em.inv ≫ k) (F.map_comp g c).symm)
    _ = em.inv ≫ F.map (t ≫ s) := congrArg (fun k => em.inv ≫ F.map k) hs
    _ = _ := (congrArg (fun k => em.inv ≫ k) (F.map_comp t s)).trans
      (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F16.tower_lft
statement:
