name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F16.properPushforward_mem_relC
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, hrel⟩ := mem_relC.mp hr
  have h1 := M7.D9.properPushforwardDimChowD9_mk (k := K) f n ⟨r, h⟩
  have h0 : (QuotientAddGroup.mk ⟨r, h⟩ : DimChow X n) = 0 :=
    (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff _).mpr hrel
  rw [h0, map_zero] at h1
  have hd := properPushforward_mem_dimensionCycles f (heightCompatible_of_finiteType K f) h
  exact mem_relC.mpr ⟨hd, (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff _).mp h1.symm⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F16.lineDimZero
statement: theorem lineDimZero : LineDimZero K
proof:
:=
  fun V _ _ _ _ D hD ↦ lineDimZero_of K V D hD

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F16.tower_negVanish
statement:
theorem tower_negVanish (hL : LineDimZero K) : ∀ (m : ℕ) (V : Scheme.{u})
    [V.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (V ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian V] [CompactSpace V] (n : ℕ), n < m →
      ∀ D ∈ dimensionCycles (T m V) n, ∃ N : ℕ, N ≠ 0 ∧ (N : ℤ) • D ∈ relC (T m V) n
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero => intro V _ _ _ _ n hn; exact absurd hn (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | succ m ih =>
    intro V _ _ _ _ n hn
    letI := lineOver K V
    haveI := lineOver_lft K V
    haveI : CompactSpace (Line V) := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace (lineProj V)
    rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hn with h | rfl
    · exact ih (Line V) n h
    · 
      change ∀ D ∈ dimensionCycles (T n (Line V)) n, ∃ N : ℕ, N ≠ 0 ∧
        (N : ℤ) • D ∈ relC (T n (Line V)) n
      intro D hD
      have hX := tower_dimCat K n (Line V)
      have hrd := towerPureRelDim K n (Line V)
      haveI : CompactSpace (T n (Line V)) := tower_compact n (Line V)
      have hD' : D ∈ dimensionCycles (T n (Line V)) (0 + n) := by
        rwa [Nat.zero_add]
      obtain ⟨N1, hN1, A, hA, hr⟩ := cycSurj_tower K n (Line V) 0 hX D hD'
      obtain ⟨N2, hN2, hAr⟩ := hL V A hA
      have hpull := flatPullback_mem_dimRationalEquivalence (towerProj n (Line V)) hX hrd
        ⟨(N2 : ℤ) • A, zsmul_mem hA _⟩ (mem_relC.mp hAr).2
      have hpull' : flatPullback (towerProj n (Line V)) ((N2 : ℤ) • A) ∈
          relC (T n (Line V)) (0 + n) :=
        mem_relC.mpr ⟨flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles _ hrd (zsmul_mem hA _), hpull⟩
      refine ⟨N2 * N1, mul_ne_zero hN2 hN1, ?_⟩
      have e : ((N2 * N1 : ℕ) : ℤ) • D = (N2 : ℤ) • ((N1 : ℤ) • D -
          flatPullback (towerProj n (Line V)) A) +
          flatPullback (towerProj n (Line V)) ((N2 : ℤ) • A) := by
        have h3 := map_zsmul (flatPullbackHom (towerProj n (Line V))) (N2 : ℤ) A
        change flatPullback (towerProj n (Line V)) ((N2 : ℤ) • A) =
          (N2 : ℤ) • flatPullback (towerProj n (Line V)) A at h3
        rw [h3, Nat.cast_mul, mul_smul, smul_sub]
        abel
      have hfin : ((N2 * N1 : ℕ) : ℤ) • D ∈ relC (T n (Line V)) (0 + n) := by
        rw [e]; exact add_mem (zsmul_mem hr _) hpull'
      rwa [Nat.zero_add] at hfin

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F16.genSet_le_dim
statement: theorem genSet_le_dim : ∀ (e m : ℕ), genSet B e m ≤ dimensionCycles (B.P e) m
proof:
:= by
  intro e
  induction e with
  | zero =>
    intro m
    rw [genSet, AddSubgroup.closure_le]
    rintro _ ⟨A, hA, rfl⟩
    have := flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles (B.π 0) (IsTower.relDim 0) hA
    simpa using this
  | succ e ih =>
    intro m
    rw [genSet, AddSubgroup.closure_le]
    rintro C (⟨C0, hC0, rfl⟩ | ⟨A, hA, hle, rfl⟩)
    · exact properPushforward_mem_dimensionCycles (B.ι e)
        (heightCompatible_of_finiteType K (B.ι e)) (ih m hC0)
    · have := flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles (B.π (e + 1)) (IsTower.relDim (e + 1)) hA
      rwa [Nat.sub_add_cancel hle] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F16.generation_zero
statement:
theorem generation_zero (m : ℕ) : ∀ D ∈ dimensionCycles (B.P 0) m,
    ∃ N : ℕ, N ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ C ∈ genSet B 0 m, (N : ℤ) • D - C ∈ relC (B.P 0) m
proof:
:= by
  intro D hD
  have hj0 : PureRelDim (inv (B.π 0)) 0 := pureRelDim_openImmersion K (inv (B.π 0))
  have hA := flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles (inv (B.π 0)) hj0 hD
  have hC : flatPullback (B.π 0) (flatPullback (inv (B.π 0)) D) = D := by
    rw [← flatPullback_comp, IsIso.hom_inv_id, flatPullback_id]
  refine ⟨1, one_ne_zero, flatPullback (B.π 0) (flatPullback (inv (B.π 0)) D),
    AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨_, by simpa using hA, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [hC, Nat.cast_one, one_smul, sub_self]
  exact zero_mem _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F16.generation
statement:
theorem generation : ∀ (e m : ℕ), ∀ D ∈ dimensionCycles (B.P e) m,
    ∃ N : ℕ, N ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ C ∈ genSet B e m, (N : ℤ) • D - C ∈ relC (B.P e) m
proof:
:= by
  intro e
  induction e with
  | zero => exact fun m ↦ generation_zero B K m
  | succ e ih =>
    intro m D hD
    haveI : CompactSpace (T (e + 1) U) := tower_compact (e + 1) U
    haveI := tower_lft K (e + 1) U
    letI := towerOver K (e + 1) U
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (T (e + 1) U) :=
      LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (towerProj (e + 1) U)
    haveI : IsNoetherian (T (e + 1) U) := {}
    refine (fun ⟨N, hN, C, hC, _, hr⟩ ↦ ⟨N, hN, C, hC, hr⟩) (exists_mem_of_open_closed K
      (B.j e) (B.ι e) (IsTower.range_eq e) (genSet B (e + 1) m) ?_ ?_ D hD)
    · intro D' hD'
      by_cases h : e + 1 ≤ m
      · obtain ⟨n', rfl⟩ : ∃ n', m = n' + (e + 1) := ⟨m - (e + 1), by omega⟩
        obtain ⟨N, hN, A, hA, hr⟩ :=
          cycSurj_tower K (e + 1) U n' (tower_dimCat K (e + 1) U) D' hD'
        have hAU : A ∈ dimensionCycles U (n' + (e + 1) - (e + 1)) := by
          rwa [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
        have hCmem : flatPullback (B.π (e + 1)) A ∈ genSet B (e + 1) (n' + (e + 1)) :=
          AddSubgroup.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨A, hAU, h, rfl⟩)
        refine ⟨N, hN, _, hCmem, genSet_le_dim B K _ _ hCmem, ?_⟩
        rw [← flatPullback_comp, IsTower.j_π]
        exact hr
      · obtain ⟨N, hN, hrel⟩ := tower_negVanish K (lineDimZero K) (e + 1) U m (by omega) D' hD'
        refine ⟨N, hN, 0, zero_mem _, zero_mem _, ?_⟩
        have h0 : flatPullback (B.j e) (0 : AlgebraicCycle (B.P (e + 1)) ℤ) = 0 :=
          (flatPullbackHom (B.j e)).map_zero
        rw [h0, sub_zero]
        exact hrel
    · intro B' hB'
      obtain ⟨N, hN, C0, hC0, hr⟩ := ih m B' hB'
      refine ⟨N, hN, properPushforward (B.ι e) C0,
        AddSubgroup.subset_closure (Or.inl ⟨C0, hC0, rfl⟩),
        properPushforward_mem_dimensionCycles (B.ι e)
          (heightCompatible_of_finiteType K (B.ι e)) (genSet_le_dim B K e m hC0), ?_⟩
      have h1 := properPushforward_mem_relC (K := K) (B.ι e) hr
      have e1 : properPushforward (B.ι e) ((N : ℤ) • B' - C0) =
          (N : ℤ) • properPushforward (B.ι e) B' - properPushforward (B.ι e) C0 := by
        have h2 := map_zsmul (properPushforwardHom (B.ι e)) (N : ℤ) B'
        have h3 := map_sub (properPushforwardHom (B.ι e)) ((N : ℤ) • B') C0
        change properPushforward (B.ι e) ((N : ℤ) • B' - C0) =
          properPushforward (B.ι e) ((N : ℤ) • B') - properPushforward (B.ι e) C0 at h3
        change properPushforward (B.ι e) ((N : ℤ) • B') =
          (N : ℤ) • properPushforward (B.ι e) B' at h2
        rw [h3, h2]
      rwa [e1] at h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1N23.regStalks_of_openImmersion
statement:
theorem regStalks_of_openImmersion {V X : Scheme.{u}} (j : V ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (h : RegStalks X) : RegStalks V
proof:
:= fun v => by
  haveI := h (j v)
  exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv (asIso (j.stalkMap v)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1N23.regAt_of_openImmersion
statement:
theorem regAt_of_openImmersion {V X : Scheme.{u}} (j : V ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (v : V)
    (h : IsRegularLocalRing (V.presheaf.stalk v)) : IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk (j v))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIso (j.stalkMap v) := inferInstance
  exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv (asIso (j.stalkMap v)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1N23.regStalks_spec
statement:
theorem regStalks_spec (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsRegularRing R] :
    RegStalks (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  haveI : IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime x.asIdeal) :=
    IsRegularRing.isRegularLocalRing_localization _
  exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv (StructureSheaf.stalkIso R x).toRingEquiv

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1N23.isRegularRing_of_regStalks_spec
statement:
theorem isRegularRing_of_regStalks_spec {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [IsNoetherianRing C]
    (h : RegStalks (Spec (CommRingCat.of C))) : IsRegularRing C
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun q _ => ?_⟩
  haveI : IsRegularLocalRing
      ((structurePresheafInCommRingCat C).stalk (⟨q, inferInstance⟩ : PrimeSpectrum C)) :=
    h ⟨q, inferInstance⟩
  exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv
    (StructureSheaf.stalkIso C ⟨q, inferInstance⟩).toRingEquiv.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1N23.isRegularRing_sections
statement:
theorem isRegularRing_sections (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] (hY : RegStalks Y)
    (U : Y.affineOpens) : IsRegularRing Γ(Y, U.1)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y, U.1) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian U
  exact isRegularRing_of_regStalks_spec (C := Γ(Y, U.1))
    (regStalks_of_openImmersion U.2.fromSpec hY)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1N23.isRegularRing_mvPolynomial_fin_of_regular
statement:
theorem isRegularRing_mvPolynomial_fin_of_regular (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsRegularRing R]
    (n : ℕ) : IsRegularRing (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact IsRegularRing.of_ringEquiv (MvPolynomial.isEmptyRingEquiv R (Fin 0)).symm
  | succ n ih =>
    haveI := ih
    haveI : IsRegularRing (Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)) :=
      SchemeKTheory.F14.isRegularRing_polynomial _
    exact IsRegularRing.of_ringEquiv (MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv R n).toRingEquiv.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1N23.isRegularRing_mvPolynomial_of_regular
statement:
theorem isRegularRing_mvPolynomial_of_regular (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsRegularRing R]
    (σ : Type) [Finite σ] : IsRegularRing (MvPolynomial σ R)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isRegularRing_mvPolynomial_fin_of_regular R (Nat.card σ)
  exact IsRegularRing.of_ringEquiv
    (MvPolynomial.renameEquiv R (Finite.equivFin σ).symm).toRingEquiv

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1N23.projectiveSpace_regStalks
statement:
theorem projectiveSpace_regStalks (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsRegularRing R] (n : ℕ) :
    RegStalks (space R n)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, x ∈ coordinateOpen R n i := by
    have : x ∈ (⨆ i : Fin (n + 1), coordinateOpen R n i) := by
      rw [coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top]; trivial
    simpa [TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup] using this
  have hU := coordinateOpen_isAffine R n i
  let U := coordinateOpen R n i
  letI : Algebra Γ(space R n, U) ((space R n).presheaf.stalk x) :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.algebra_section_stalk (space R n).presheaf ⟨x, hi⟩
  haveI := hU.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hi⟩
  haveI : IsRegularRing Γ(space R n, U) := by
    haveI := isRegularRing_mvPolynomial_of_regular R (AffineChartIndex n i)
    exact IsRegularRing.of_ringEquiv (coordinateOpenSectionsEquivR R n i).symm
  haveI : IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hi⟩).asIdeal) :=
    IsRegularRing.isRegularLocalRing_localization _
  exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_ringEquiv
    (IsLocalization.algEquiv (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hi⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl
      (Localization.AtPrime (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hi⟩).asIdeal)
      ((space R n).presheaf.stalk x)).toRingEquiv

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1N23.chart_regStalks
statement:
theorem chart_regStalks [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (hX : RegStalks X) {n : ℕ}
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = n + 1) (i : C.I) : RegStalks (C.chart i)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsRegularRing Γ(X, C.U i) := isRegularRing_sections X hX (C.affineOpen i)
  haveI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  let e : C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1) := (Finite.equivFin (C.basisIndex i)).trans (finCongr (hC i))
  let b := (C.sectionBasis i).reindex e
  have h1 : RegStalks (space Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (Opposite.op (C.U i)))) :=
    regStalks_of_openImmersion (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b)
      (projectiveSpace_regStalks Γ(X, C.U i) n)
  exact h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1N23.scheme_regStalks
statement:
theorem scheme_regStalks [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (hX : RegStalks X) {n : ℕ}
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = n + 1) : RegStalks C.scheme
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨i, w, hw⟩ := C.cover.exists_eq z
  have h := regAt_of_openImmersion (C.chartι i) w (chart_regStalks C hX hC i w)
  have hz : C.chartι i w = z := hw
  rw [hz] at h
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1N23.pullback_regStalks
statement:
theorem pullback_regStalks {k : Type u} [CommRing k] {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (hY : RegStalks Y) (n : ℕ) :
    RegStalks (pullback g (toSpec k n))
proof:
:= by
  let J : Type u := ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1))
  let eJ : J ≃ Fin (n + 1) := Equiv.ulift
  let C : AffineFrameCover Y (D22.FreeM Y J) := D35.pulledCover g
  have hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = n + 1 := fun i ↦ by
    change Nat.card J = n + 1
    rw [Nat.card_congr eJ]
    simp
  have hs := scheme_regStalks C hY hC
  let e := D35.freeBundleIso eJ g C
  intro z
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ : ∃ w, e.hom w = z := ⟨e.inv z, by simp⟩
  exact regAt_of_openImmersion e.hom w (hs w)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1N23.prod_regStalks
statement:
theorem prod_regStalks {k : Type u} [CommRing k] {Y : Scheme.{u}} [Y.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian Y] (hY : RegStalks Y) (n : ℕ) :
    RegStalks (pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n))
proof:
:=
  pullback_regStalks (Y ↘ Spk k) hY n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1N23.k0ToG0_bijective_of_projectiveIntegralK
statement:
theorem k0ToG0_bijective_of_projectiveIntegralK {Z : Scheme.{u}} [Z.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Z ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian Z] (hZ : ProjectiveIntegralK k Z)
    (hreg : RegStalks Z) : Function.Bijective (SchemeKTheory.k0ToG0 Z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, N, j, hj, -⟩ := hZ
  haveI := hj
  exact ResolutionRegularClosedF15.k0ToG0_bijective_of_regular_closed k N j hreg

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.T1N23.k0ToG0_bijective_prod
statement:
theorem k0ToG0_bijective_prod {Y : Scheme.{u}} [Y.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian Y] (hY : ProjectiveIntegralK k Y)
    (hreg : RegStalks Y) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective (SchemeKTheory.k0ToG0 (pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n)))
proof:
:= by
  letI := T1CL.prodOver (k := k) Y n
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (pullback (Y ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n) ↘ Spk k) :=
    T1CL.prod_lft (k := k) n
  haveI := T1CL.prod_isNoetherian (k := k) (Y := Y) n
  exact k0ToG0_bijective_of_projectiveIntegralK (T1CL.projectiveIntegralK_prod_proj hY n)
    (prod_regStalks hreg n)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.sectionEvaluationIdeal_eq_span_of_equiv
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro y ⟨φ, rfl⟩
    change φ m ∈ Ideal.span {e m}
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
    refine ⟨φ (e.symm 1), ?_⟩
    have hm : m = e m • e.symm 1 := by
      apply e.injective
      simp
    conv_rhs => rw [hm]
    simp [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    intro y hy
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
    subst y
    exact ⟨e.toLinearMap, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.sectionEvaluationIdeal_semilinearEquiv
statement:
theorem sectionEvaluationIdeal_semilinearEquiv {R S M N : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] (e : R ≃+* S)
    : letI
proof:
:= RingHomInvPair.of_ringEquiv e
      letI := RingHomInvPair.of_ringEquiv_symm e
      ∀ (f : M ≃ₛₗ[(e : R →+* S)] N) (m : M),
        (sectionEvaluationIdeal (R := R) m).map (e : R →+* S) =
          sectionEvaluationIdeal (R := S) (f m) := by
  letI := RingHomInvPair.of_ringEquiv e
  letI := RingHomInvPair.of_ringEquiv_symm e
  intro f m
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    rintro y ⟨φ, rfl⟩
    let ψ : N →ₗ[S] S :=
      { toFun := fun n => e (φ (f.symm n))
        map_add' := fun n n' => by simp
        map_smul' := fun a n => by
          rw [f.symm.map_smulₛₗ, φ.map_smul]
          simp [smul_eq_mul] }
    refine ⟨ψ, ?_⟩
    simp [ψ, Module.Dual.eval_apply]
  · rintro y ⟨ψ, rfl⟩
    let φ : M →ₗ[R] R :=
      { toFun := fun m => e.symm (ψ (f m))
        map_add' := fun m m' => by simp
        map_smul' := fun a m => by
          rw [f.map_smulₛₗ, ψ.map_smul]
          simp [smul_eq_mul] }
    have h : φ m ∈ sectionEvaluationIdeal m := ⟨φ, rfl⟩
    have h' := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (e : R →+* S) h
    simpa [φ, Module.Dual.eval_apply] using h'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.sectionEvaluationIdeal_localization
statement:
theorem sectionEvaluationIdeal_localization {R A M N : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module R N] [Module A N] [IsScalarTower R A N]
    (S : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization S A]
    (f : M →ₗ[R] N) [IsLocalizedModule S f]
    [Module.FinitePresentation R M] (m : M) :
    (sectionEvaluationIdeal m).map (algebraMap R A) = sectionEvaluationIdeal (f m)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    rintro y ⟨φ, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨IsLocalizedModule.mapExtendScalars S f (Algebra.linearMap R A) A φ, ?_⟩
    simp [Module.Dual.eval_apply, IsLocalizedModule.map_apply]
  · rintro y ⟨φ, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨h, s, hs⟩ := Module.FinitePresentation.exists_lift_of_isLocalizedModule
      S (Algebra.linearMap R A) ((φ.restrictScalars R).comp f)
    have hh : algebraMap R A (h m) ∈ (sectionEvaluationIdeal m).map (algebraMap R A) :=
      Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ⟨h, rfl⟩
    have he : algebraMap R A (h m) = algebraMap R A (s : R) * φ (f m) := by
      have he := LinearMap.congr_fun hs m
      simpa [Submonoid.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def] using he
    rw [he] at hh
    exact (Ideal.unit_mul_mem_iff_mem _ (IsLocalization.map_units A s)).mp hh

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_le_affine
proof:
:=
  Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_ofIdeals_le _ U

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.sectionAffineEvaluationIdeal_of_iso
proof:
:= by
  let eU : (L.val.obj (op U.1)) ≃ₗ[Γ(X,U)] Γ(X,U) :=
    ((SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op U.1)).mapIso e).toLinearEquiv
  exact sectionEvaluationIdeal_eq_span_of_equiv eU
    (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ U (1 : Γ(X,U)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.sectionEvaluationIdeal_linearEquiv
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro y ⟨φ, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨φ.comp e.toLinearMap, rfl⟩
  · rintro y ⟨φ, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨φ.comp e.symm.toLinearMap, ?_⟩
    simp [Module.Dual.eval_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.sectionAffineEvaluationIdeal_iso
proof:
:= by
  let eU : (L.val.obj (op U.1)) ≃ₗ[Γ(X,U)] (N.val.obj (op U.1)) :=
    ((SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op U.1)).mapIso e).toLinearEquiv
  exact sectionEvaluationIdeal_linearEquiv eU
    (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ U (1 : Γ(X,U)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.sectionEvaluationIdeal_unit_map
statement:
theorem sectionEvaluationIdeal_unit_map {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (σ : R →ₗ[R] R) :
    LinearMap.range σ = sectionEvaluationIdeal (σ 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sectionEvaluationIdeal_eq_span_of_equiv (LinearEquiv.refl R R)]
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro y ⟨a, rfl⟩
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
    refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
    have h := σ.map_smul a (1 : R)
    simpa [smul_eq_mul] using h.symm
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    intro y hy
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
    subst y
    exact ⟨1, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_of_iso
statement:
theorem sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_of_iso {X : Scheme.{u}} {L : X.Modules}
    (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (e : L ≅ tensorUnitSheaf X) :
    sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ =
      KoszulComplexSheaf.quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X (tensorUnitSheaf X) (σ ≫ e.hom)
proof:
:= by
  let I := KoszulComplexSheaf.quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal
    X (tensorUnitSheaf X) (σ ≫ e.hom)
  have h : sectionAffineEvaluationIdeal σ = I.ideal := by
    funext U
    rw [← sectionAffineEvaluationIdeal_iso σ e U]
    exact (sectionEvaluationIdeal_unit_map
      (KoszulComplexSheaf.affineCosection X (tensorUnitSheaf X) (σ ≫ e.hom) U)).symm
  change Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdeals (sectionAffineEvaluationIdeal σ) = I
  rw [h, Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdeals_ideal]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.sectionEvaluationIdeal_overIso
proof:
:= by
  let eU : (L.val.obj (op U)) ≃ₗ[Γ(X,U)] Γ(X,U) :=
    ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)
      (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))).mapIso e).toLinearEquiv
  exact sectionEvaluationIdeal_eq_span_of_equiv eU
    (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ U (1 : Γ(X,U)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.specSectionEvaluationIdeal_basicOpen
statement:
theorem specSectionEvaluationIdeal_basicOpen (A : CommRingCat.{u})
    (L : (Spec A).Modules) [L.IsQuasicoherent] [L.IsFinitePresentation]
    (σ : tensorUnitSheaf (Spec A) ⟶ L) (r : A) :
    (sectionEvaluationIdeal (R := A)
      (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ ⊤ (1 : Γ(Spec A,⊤)))).map
      (algebraMap A Γ(Spec A,PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r)) =
    sectionEvaluationIdeal (R := Γ(Spec A,PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r))
      (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r)
        (1 : Γ(Spec A,PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r)))
proof:
:= by
  let f := KoszulComplexSheaf.specBasicRestriction A L r
  letI := KoszulComplexSheaf.specBasicRestriction_isLocalized A L r
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation A (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj L) :=
    moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation L
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation A ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj L).presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) :=
    Module.FinitePresentation.of_equiv (topSectionsLinearEquivModuleSpecΓ L).symm
  let eTop : (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj L) ≃ₗ[A] Γ(L,⊤) :=
    { toFun := fun x => x
      invFun := fun x => x
      left_inv := fun _ => rfl
      right_inv := fun _ => rfl
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation A Γ(L,⊤) := Module.FinitePresentation.of_equiv eTop
  have h := sectionEvaluationIdeal_localization
    (A := Γ(Spec A,PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r)) (Submonoid.powers r) f
    (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ ⊤ (1 : Γ(Spec A,⊤)))
  have hn : f (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ ⊤ (1 : Γ(Spec A,⊤))) =
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r)
        (1 : Γ(Spec A,PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r)) := by
    change f ((σ.val.app (op ⊤)).hom (1 : Γ(Spec A,⊤))) =
      (σ.val.app (op (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r))).hom
        (1 : Γ(Spec A,PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r))
    have hn := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply σ.val
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r).leTop.op (1 : Γ(Spec A,⊤))
    change (σ.val.app (op (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r))).hom
      ((Spec A).presheaf.map (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r).leTop.op (1 : Γ(Spec A,⊤))) =
      f ((σ.val.app (op ⊤)).hom (1 : Γ(Spec A,⊤))) at hn
    rw [map_one] at hn
    exact hn.symm
  rw [hn] at h
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.sectionAffineEvaluationIdeal_basicOpen
statement:
theorem sectionAffineEvaluationIdeal_basicOpen {X : Scheme.{u}} {L : X.Modules}
    [L.IsQuasicoherent] [L.IsFinitePresentation]
    (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (U : X.affineOpens) (r : Γ(X,U)) :
    (sectionAffineEvaluationIdeal σ U).map
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le r)).op).hom =
    sectionAffineEvaluationIdeal σ (X.affineBasicOpen r)
proof:
:= by
  let R := Γ(X,U)
  let A := Γ(X,X.basicOpen r)
  let φ : R →+* A := (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le r)).op).hom
  letI : Algebra R A := φ.toAlgebra
  letI : Module R Γ(L,X.basicOpen r) := Module.compHom _ φ
  letI : IsScalarTower R A Γ(L,X.basicOpen r) := IsScalarTower.of_compHom R A _
  letI : IsLocalization.Away r A := U.2.isLocalization_basicOpen r
  let B := KoszulComplexSheaf.affineChartModule X L U
  letI : B.IsQuasicoherent := KoszulComplexSheaf.affineChartModule_isQuasicoherent X L U
  letI : B.IsFinitePresentation := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor U.2.fromSpec L
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj B) := moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation B
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj B).presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) :=
    Module.FinitePresentation.of_equiv (topSectionsLinearEquivModuleSpecΓ B).symm
  let eTop : (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj B) ≃ₗ[R] Γ(B,⊤) :=
    { toFun := fun x => x
      invFun := fun x => x
      left_inv := fun _ => rfl
      right_inv := fun _ => rfl
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R Γ(B,⊤) := Module.FinitePresentation.of_equiv eTop
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R Γ(L,U.1) :=
    Module.FinitePresentation.of_equiv (KoszulComplexSheaf.affineChartTopSectionsLinearEquiv X L U)
  let e : Γ(B,PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r) ≃ₗ[R] Γ(L,X.basicOpen r) :=
    { toFun := (KoszulComplexSheaf.affineChartBasicSectionsIso X L U r).hom
      invFun := (KoszulComplexSheaf.affineChartBasicSectionsIso X L U r).inv
      left_inv := fun x => ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
        (KoszulComplexSheaf.affineChartBasicSectionsIso X L U r).hom_inv_id x
      right_inv := fun x => ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
        (KoszulComplexSheaf.affineChartBasicSectionsIso X L U r).inv_hom_id x
      map_add' := map_add _
      map_smul' := fun a x => KoszulComplexSheaf.affineChartBasicSectionsIso_smul X L U r a x }
  let l := KoszulComplexSheaf.affineChartFromOriginalRestriction X L U r
  letI := KoszulComplexSheaf.affineChartFromOriginalRestriction_isLocalized X L U r
  let f : Γ(L,U.1) →ₗ[R] Γ(L,X.basicOpen r) := e.toLinearMap.comp l
  letI : IsLocalizedModule.Away r f := IsLocalizedModule.of_linearEquiv (Submonoid.powers r) l e
  have hf (x : Γ(L,U.1)) : f x = L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le r)).op x :=
    KoszulComplexSheaf.affineChartFromOriginalRestriction_comparison X L U r x
  have hn : f (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ U (1 : Γ(X,U))) =
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ (X.basicOpen r) (1 : A) := by
    rw [hf]
    have h := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply σ.val
      (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le r)).op (1 : Γ(X,U))
    change (σ.val.app (op (X.basicOpen r))).hom
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le r)).op (1 : Γ(X,U))) =
      L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le r)).op
        ((σ.val.app (op U.1)).hom (1 : Γ(X,U))) at h
    rw [map_one] at h
    exact h.symm
  have h := sectionEvaluationIdeal_localization (A := A) (Submonoid.powers r) f
    (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ U (1 : Γ(X,U)))
  rw [hn] at h
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isFinitePresentation_of_restrict_fromSpec_cover
statement:
theorem isFinitePresentation_of_restrict_fromSpec_cover {ι : Type u} (U : ι → Y.Opens)
    (hU : TopologicalSpace.IsOpenCover U) (hA : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (U i)) (M : Y.Modules)
    (h : ∀ i, ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (hA i).fromSpec).obj M).IsFinitePresentation) :
    M.IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  have hcov : (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y).CoversTop U :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := Y) U).2 hU
  letI : ∀ i, (M.over (U i)).IsFinitePresentation := fun i ↦ by
    let L := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U i).ι).obj M
    have hcomp : (hA i).isoSpec.hom ≫ (hA i).fromSpec = (U i).ι := by
      rw [← IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_inv_ι, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
    letI : L.IsFinitePresentation := by
      letI := h i
      have h1 : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (hA i).isoSpec.hom).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (hA i).fromSpec).obj M)).IsFinitePresentation :=
        isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor _ _
      let c : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (hA i).isoSpec.hom).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (hA i).fromSpec).obj M) ≅ L :=
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp (hA i).isoSpec.hom (hA i).fromSpec).app M).symm ≪≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr hcomp).app M
      exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation (U i).toScheme.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso c h1
    let P := (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).inverse.obj L
    letI : P.IsFinitePresentation :=
      isFinitePresentation_overEquiv_inverse (U i) L
    let e : M.over (U i) ≅ P :=
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).unitIso.app (M.over (U i)) ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (U i)).inverse.mapIso
          ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv (U i)).app M)
    exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation
      (Y.ringCatSheaf.over (U i))).prop_of_iso e.symm inferInstance
  exact SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation_of_over_cover M U hcov

name: AlgebraicGeometry.abelianImage_isFinitePresentation_of_isLocallyNoetherian
statement:
theorem abelianImage_isFinitePresentation_of_isLocallyNoetherian [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    {A B : Y.Modules} [A.IsFinitePresentation] [B.IsFinitePresentation] (f : A ⟶ B) :
    (Abelian.image f).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  refine isFinitePresentation_of_restrict_fromSpec_cover (fun V : Y.affineOpens ↦ (V : Y.Opens))
    (iSup_affineOpens_eq_top Y) (fun V ↦ V.2) _ fun V ↦ ?_
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y, (V : Y.Opens)) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian V
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.2.fromSpec
  letI : (G.obj A).IsFinitePresentation := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor _ A
  letI : (G.obj B).IsFinitePresentation := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor _ B
  letI : (G.obj A).IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  have h := abelianImage_isFinitePresentation_of_noetherian (G.map f)
  exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation
    (Spec Γ(Y, (V : Y.Opens))).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso (Abelian.PreservesImage.iso G f).symm h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.higherDirectImage_isFinitePresentation
statement:
theorem higherDirectImage_isFinitePresentation [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N) (F : C.scheme.Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] (q : ℕ) :
    (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification C.toBase F q).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  refine isFinitePresentation_of_restrict_fromSpec_cover C.U C.covers C.isAffine _ fun i ↦ ?_
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, C.U i) :=
    IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨C.U i, C.isAffine i⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hn, -, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hrank i
  exact BundleHDI.chart_isFinitePresentation C i hn e F q

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.higherDirectImage_isZero_of_lt
statement:
theorem higherDirectImage_isZero_of_lt [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N) (F : C.scheme.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (q : ℕ)
    (hq : N < q) :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification C.toBase F q)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q', rfl⟩ : ∃ q', q = q' + 1 := ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩
  let B : Set X.Opens := {V | ∃ i, ∃ g : Γ(X, C.U i), X.basicOpen g = V}
  have hB : TopologicalSpace.Opens.IsBasis B := by
    rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd]
    intro W x hx
    have hx' : x ∈ (⨆ i, C.U i : X.Opens) := by
      rw [C.covers]
      trivial
    obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.1 hx'
    obtain ⟨g, hgW, hxg⟩ := (C.isAffine i).exists_basicOpen_le ⟨x, hx⟩ hxi
    exact ⟨X.basicOpen g, ⟨i, g, rfl⟩, hxg, hgW⟩
  refine affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_isZero_of_isBasis _ _ _ hB ?_
  rintro V ⟨i, g, rfl⟩
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, C.U i) :=
    IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨C.U i, C.isAffine i⟩
  obtain ⟨n, -, hnN, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hrank i
  let ψ := standardChartEmb C i e
  let M := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ψ).obj F
  haveI : M.IsQuasicoherent := Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_restrictFunctor _ _
  have h0 := SchemeProjectiveSpace.quasicoherent_basicOpen_cohomology_subsingleton_of_dimension_lt
    Γ(X, C.U i) n M q' (by omega) g
  let W := SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g
  refine BundleRegularity.H_transfer C.toBase (X.basicOpen g) (W.ι ≫ ψ)
    (standardChartEmb_opensRange C i e g) F (q' + 1) ?_
  let c : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (W.ι ≫ ψ)).obj F ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj M :=
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp W.ι ψ).app F
  let E' := (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.functorH _ (q' + 1)).mapIso
    ((Modules.toSheafAb W.toScheme).mapIso c)
  exact @Equiv.subsingleton _ _ E'.addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv.toEquiv h0

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward_classOf [IsLocallyNoetherian X]

    projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank (SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf C.scheme M hM) =
      GrothendieckRiemannRoch.alternatingSum N
        (fun q ↦ SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf X
          (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification C.toBase M q)
          ((projectiveBundleHigherDirectImageLongExactSystem hrank).higher_mem ⟨M, hM⟩ q))
proof:
:=
  SchemeGrothendieckRiemannRoch.derivedPushforwardOfLongExactSystem_classOf
    (projectiveBundleHigherDirectImageLongExactSystem hrank) M hM

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.cocycle_first_transition

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D9.properPushforwardDimChowD9_mk

      QuotientAddGroup.mk ⟨properPushforward f D.1,
        properPushforward_mem_dimensionCycles f (heightCompatible_of_finiteType k f) D.2⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D9.properPushforwardDimChowD9_comp

theorem properPushforwardDimChowD9_comp (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) [IsProper f] [IsProper g]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] [IsLocallyNoetherian Z] [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [g.IsOver (Spk k)]
    (n : ℕ) (x : DimChow X n) :
    properPushforwardDimChowD9 (k := k) (f ≫ g) n x =
      properPushforwardDimChowD9 (k := k) g n (properPushforwardDimChowD9 (k := k) f n x)

    [f.IsOver (Spk k)] (n : ℕ) (a : ℚ) (D : DimChow X n) :
    properPushforwardRationalDimChowD9 (k := k) f n (a ⊗ₜ[ℤ] D) =
      a ⊗ₜ[ℤ] properPushforwardDimChowD9 (k := k) f n D

:=
  properPushforwardRationalDimChow_tmul k (D7.genericFibreVanishing k) f n a D

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D9.pushD9_mk
statement:
theorem pushD9_mk (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsProper f] (n : ℕ)
    (D : dimensionCycles X n) (D' : dimensionCycles Y n)
    (h : D'.1 = properPushforward f D.1) :
    pushD9 (k := k) f n ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X n)) =
      (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D' : DimChow Y n)
proof:
:= by
  have : D' = ⟨properPushforward f D.1,
      properPushforward_mem_dimensionCycles f (heightCompatible_of_finiteType k f) D.2⟩ :=
    Subtype.ext h
  subst this
  change properPushforwardRationalDimChowD9 (k := k) f n _ = _
  rw [properPushforwardRationalDimChowD9_tmul, properPushforwardDimChowD9_mk]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D9.pushD9_mk0
statement:
theorem pushD9_mk0 (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsProper f] (n : ℕ)
    (D : dimensionCycles X n) :
    pushD9 (k := k) f n ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X n)) =
      (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk
        (⟨properPushforward f D.1,
          properPushforward_mem_dimensionCycles f (heightCompatible_of_finiteType k f) D.2⟩ :
            dimensionCycles Y n) : DimChow Y n)
proof:
:=
  pushD9_mk (k := k) f n D _ rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D9.pushD9_comp_mk
statement:
theorem pushD9_comp_mk (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [g.IsOver (Spk k)]
    [(f ≫ g).IsOver (Spk k)] [IsProper f] [IsProper g] [IsProper (f ≫ g)] (n : ℕ)
    (D : dimensionCycles X n) :
    pushD9 (k := k) (f ≫ g) n ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X n)) =
      pushD9 (k := k) g n (pushD9 (k := k) f n
        ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X n)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [pushD9_mk0, pushD9_mk0, pushD9_mk0]
  exact congrArg (fun E : dimensionCycles Z n ↦
    (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk E : DimChow Z n))
    (Subtype.ext (properPushforward_comp f g D.1))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D9.push_eq_pushD9
statement:
theorem push_eq_pushD9 (ops : ChowOps k) (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsProper f] (n : ℕ) :
    ops.push f n = pushD9 (k := k) f n
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a y =>
    induction y using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H D =>
      have h1 : a ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X n) =
          a • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X n)) := by
        rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      rw [h1, map_smul, map_smul]
      congr 1
      rw [pushD9_mk0 (k := k) f n D]
      exact ops.push_mk f n D _ rfl
  | add x y hx hy => simp [map_add, hx, hy]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D9.totalPush_comp
statement:
theorem totalPush_comp (ops : ChowOps k) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) [f.IsOver (Spk k)]
    [g.IsOver (Spk k)] [(f ≫ g).IsOver (Spk k)] [IsProper f] [IsProper g] [IsProper (f ≫ g)] :
    totalPush ops (f ≫ g) = totalPush ops g ∘ₗ totalPush ops f
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a y =>
    induction y using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H D =>
      have h1 : a ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X n) =
          a • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X n)) := by
        rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      rw [h1]
      simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.comp_apply]
      congr 1
      simp only [totalPush, DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply,
        push_eq_pushD9]
      rw [pushD9_comp_mk]
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionZeroIdeal_chart_isPullback

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionNativeZeroIdeal_affine_le_comap
statement:

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionNativeZeroCentreChartMap_native
statement:
theorem cosectionNativeZeroCentreChartMap_native :
    (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
      (pulledCosection g σ)).subschemeCover.f V ≫ pulledCosection_zeroCentreMap g E σ =
    cosectionNativeZeroCentreChartMap g U V h E σ ≫
      (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ).subschemeCover.f U
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ).subschemeι).mp
  have hn := congrArg (fun f =>
    (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
      (pulledCosection g σ)).subschemeCover.f V ≫ f)
    (pulledCosection_zeroCentreMap_projection g E σ)
  have hv := congrArg (fun f => f ≫ g)
    (SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.subschemeCover_f_comp
      (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
        (pulledCosection g σ)) V)
  have hg := congrArg (fun f =>
    SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.chartQuotient
      (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
        (pulledCosection g σ)) V ≫ f)
    (cosectionAffineChart_scheme_square g U V h).symm
  have hq := congrArg (fun f => f ≫ U.2.fromSpec)
    (cosectionNativeZeroCentreChartMap_ambient g U V h E σ).symm
  have hu := congrArg (fun f => cosectionNativeZeroCentreChartMap g U V h E σ ≫ f)
    (SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSheaf.subschemeCover_f_comp
      (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ) U).symm
  simp only [Category.assoc] at hn hv hg hq hu ⊢
  with_unfolding_all exact hn.trans (hv.trans (hg.trans (hq.trans hu)))

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.eta_app_res_F_app
statement:
theorem eta_app_res_F_app (V : W.Opens) (dU : Y.Opens) (a : Γ(Y, dU))
    (ha : (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι.app dU a = 0) (hV : V ≤ F ⁻¹ᵁ dU) :
    (pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι).app V
      (W.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op (F.app dU a)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι).app (F ⁻¹ᵁ dU)
      (F.app dU a) = 0 := by
    have h2 : ((pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι ≫ F).app dU) a = 0 := by
      rw [pullback.condition, Scheme.Hom.comp_app]
      erw [CommRingCat.comp_apply]
      rw [ha, map_zero]
    rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_app] at h2
    erw [CommRingCat.comp_apply] at h2
    exact h2
  have h3 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (Scheme.Hom.naturality (pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι)
      (homOfLE hV).op) (F.app dU a)
  erw [CommRingCat.comp_apply] at h3
  refine h3.trans ?_
  change ((pullback F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι).presheaf.map _).hom
    ((pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι).app (F ⁻¹ᵁ dU) (F.app dU a)) = 0
  rw [h1]
  exact map_zero _

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.eta_app_pullbackSection_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eta_app_pullbackSection_eq_zero (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1) (U : W.Opens)
    (l : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L), U)) :
    (pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι).app U
      ((pullbackSection F (dualEval σ)).app U l) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hΛ1 : HasConstantRank Y (lineBundleDual Y L) 1 := lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank L hL
  let d : ∀ w : W, WFrame (lineBundleDual Y L) (F w) := fun w => (exists_wFrame hΛ1 (F w)).some
  let V : U → W.Opens := fun w => (F ⁻¹ᵁ (d w.1).U) ⊓ U
  refine TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' (pullback F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι).sheaf
    (fun w : U => (pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι) ⁻¹ᵁ (V w))
    ((pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι) ⁻¹ᵁ U)
    (fun w => homOfLE (Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono _ inf_le_right)) ?_ _ _ ?_
  · intro z hz
    have hw : (pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι) z ∈ U := hz
    refine Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨(pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι) z, hw⟩, ?_⟩
    exact ⟨(d _).mem, hw⟩
  · intro w
    have hVU : V w ≤ U := inf_le_right
    have hVe : V w ≤ (WFrame.ofData (pullbackWFrame F (d w.1) w.1 (d w.1).mem)).U := inf_le_left
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (WFrame.ofData (pullbackWFrame F (d w.1) w.1 (d w.1).mem)).exists_coord
      (V w) hVe (((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE hVU).op l)
    have h1 : (pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι).app (V w)
        (W.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op ((pullbackSection F (dualEval σ)).app U l)) = 0 := by
      have h2 : W.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op ((pullbackSection F (dualEval σ)).app U l) =
          (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ)).app (V w)
            (((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)).presheaf.map
              (homOfLE hVU).op l) :=
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.app_presheaf_map (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ)) (homOfLE hVU) l).symm
      rw [h2, ← hc, KSpecialization.ARRHS.pullbackSection_wFrameSec σ F (d w.1) w.1 (d w.1).mem (V w) hVe c, map_mul]
      erw [eta_app_res_F_app σ F (V w) (d w.1).U _ (ι_app_dualEval σ _ _) hVe]
      exact mul_zero _
    have h3 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (Scheme.Hom.naturality (pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι)
        (homOfLE hVU).op) ((pullbackSection F (dualEval σ)).app U l)
    erw [CommRingCat.comp_apply] at h3
    refine Eq.trans ?_ (map_zero _).symm
    exact h3.symm.trans h1

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.ap_pushforward_fst_eq_zero
statement:
theorem ap_pushforward_fst_eq_zero (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1)
    (N : (pullback F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι).Modules) :
    ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)))
      (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ)))
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι)).obj
        N) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine (sigmaT_app_eq_zero_iff (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ)) _).2 ?_
  intro U l m
  have key : ∀ (r : Γ(W, U))
      (m : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
        (pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι)).obj N, U)),
      r • m = ((pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι).app U r •
        (@id Γ(N, (pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι) ⁻¹ᵁ U) m) :
          Γ(N, (pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι) ⁻¹ᵁ U)) :=
    fun _ _ => rfl
  refine (key _ m).trans ?_
  have h0 := eta_app_pullbackSection_eq_zero σ F hL U l
  have h0' : (pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι).app U
      ((pullbackSection F (dualEval σ)).val.app (op U) l) = 0 := h0
  erw [h0']
  exact zero_smul Γ(pullback F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι,
    (pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι) ⁻¹ᵁ U)
    (@id Γ(N, (pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι) ⁻¹ᵁ U) m)

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.pullback_fst_ap_eq_zero
statement:
theorem pullback_fst_ap_eq_zero (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1) (V : W.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι)).map
      (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)))
        (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) V) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let adj := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
    (pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι)
  apply (adj.homEquiv _ _).injective
  simp only [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, Functor.map_zero]
  have hn := (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))).naturality (adj.unit.app V)
  have h0 := ap_pushforward_fst_eq_zero σ F hL
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι)).obj V)
  have hu := Adjunction.unit_naturality adj
    (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)))
      (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) V)
  refine hu.trans ?_
  refine Eq.trans ?_ comp_zero.symm
  refine hn.symm.trans ?_
  exact (congrArg (fun z => (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj
    (lineBundleDual Y L))).map (adj.unit.app V) ≫ z) h0).trans comp_zero

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.hbcE_pencil_fibre_bundle
statement:
theorem hbcE_pencil_fibre_bundle (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1) (hreg : SectionIsRegular σ)
    (hs : Mono (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ)))
    [IsIso (ηΣ ≫ pr)]
    (E0 : Z.Modules) (hE0 : IsFiniteLocallyFree Z E0) (y : K0 Y)
    (hy : k0ToG0 Y y = finitePushforward F (flatPullbackG0 pr
      (g0ClassOf Z E0 hE0.isFinitePresentation))) :
    k0ToG0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme (pullbackK0 ιΣ y) =
      finitePushforward (inv (ηΣ ≫ pr) ≫ FzΣ) (g0ClassOf Z E0 hE0.isFinitePresentation)
proof:
:= by
  have hEc : IsCoherentLike Z E0 := hE0.isFinitePresentation
  letI : E0.IsFinitePresentation := hEc
  have hV₀ : IsCoherentLike W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E0) :=
    pullback_isFinitePresentation_global pr E0
  letI : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E0).IsFinitePresentation := hV₀
  have hVfl : IsFiniteLocallyFree W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E0) :=
    pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global pr E0 hE0
  have hy' : k0ToG0 Y y = finitePushforward F
      (g0ClassOf W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E0) hV₀) := by
    rw [hy, flatPullbackG0_classOf]
  haveI : Mono (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)))
      (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E0)) :=
    hMono_of_mono_pullbackSection σ F pr E0 hE0
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (pullback F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι) :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian ηΣ
  have hT := tensorSheaf_isCoherentLike W _ _
    (SchemeKTheory.hasConstantRank_pullback W F _ 1
      (lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank L hL)).isFiniteLocallyFree hV₀
  have hC : IsCoherentLike W (cokernel (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)))
        (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E0))) :=
    (kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike (Y := W)).cokernel _ hT hV₀
  letI : (cokernel (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)))
        (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E0))).IsFinitePresentation := hC
  have hunit := KSpecialization.ARRHU.hunit_ARRHU σ hL F ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E0) hV₀
  have hG0 : IsCoherentLike (pullback F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ηΣ).obj (cokernel (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)))
        (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E0)))) :=
    pullback_isFinitePresentation_global ηΣ _
  have hG' := (finitePushObject FzΣ ⟨_, hG0⟩).2
  let e : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward ιΣ).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward FzΣ).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ηΣ).obj (cokernel (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)))
        (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E0))))) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj (cokernel (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)))
        (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E0))) :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp FzΣ ιΣ).app _ ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr pullback.condition.symm).app _ ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp ηΣ F).app _).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).mapIso (asIso (SchemeKTheory.ProjectionFormula.adjUnit ηΣ _)).symm
  have h := hbc_cartier_closed σ hL hreg F _ hV₀ y hy' _ hG' e
  rw [h]
  haveI := isIso_pullback_fst_cokernel_π σ F hL ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E0)
  have hV₂ : IsCoherentLike (pullback F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ηΣ).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E0)) :=
    pullback_isFinitePresentation_global ηΣ _
  have hcls : g0ClassOf (pullback F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι) _ hG0 =
      finitePushforward (inv (ηΣ ≫ pr)) (g0ClassOf Z E0 hEc) := by
    have h1 : g0ClassOf (pullback F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι) _ hG0 =
        g0ClassOf (pullback F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι) _ hV₂ :=
      g0ClassOf_iso _ _ _ (asIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ηΣ).map (cokernel.π _))).symm
    have hflat : g0ClassOf (pullback F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι) _ hV₂ =
        flatPullbackG0 (ηΣ ≫ pr) (g0ClassOf Z E0 hEc) := by
      rw [flatPullbackG0_classOf]
      exact g0ClassOf_iso _ _ _ ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp ηΣ pr).app E0)
    have hiso := flatPullbackG0_iso_eq_finitePushforward_inv (asIso (ηΣ ≫ pr))
    have h3 : flatPullbackG0 (ηΣ ≫ pr) = finitePushforward (inv (ηΣ ≫ pr)) := hiso
    rw [h1, hflat, h3]
  have hcls' := (finitePushforward_classOf FzΣ _ hG0).symm
  refine hcls'.trans ?_
  rw [hcls]
  exact (congrArg (fun f : _ →+ _ => f (g0ClassOf Z E0 hEc))
    (finitePushforward_comp (inv (ηΣ ≫ pr)) FzΣ)).symm

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.hbcE_pencil_fibre
statement:
theorem hbcE_pencil_fibre (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1) (hreg : SectionIsRegular σ)
    (hs : Mono (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ)))
    [IsIso (ηΣ ≫ pr)]
    (hres : Function.Bijective (k0ToG0 Y)) (x : K0 Z) (y : K0 Y)
    (hy : k0ToG0 Y y = finitePushforward F (flatPullbackG0 pr (k0ToG0 Z x))) :
    k0ToG0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme (pullbackK0 ιΣ y) =
      finitePushforward (inv (ηΣ ≫ pr) ≫ FzΣ) (k0ToG0 Z x)
proof:
:= by
  let Ψ : G0 Y ≃+ K0 Y := (AddEquiv.ofBijective (k0ToG0 Y) hres).symm
  have hΨ : ∀ g, k0ToG0 Y (Ψ g) = g := fun g =>
    (AddEquiv.ofBijective (k0ToG0 Y) hres).apply_symm_apply g
  let L' : K0 Z →+ G0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme :=
    (k0ToG0 _).comp ((pullbackK0 ιΣ).comp (Ψ.toAddMonoidHom.comp ((finitePushforward F).comp
      ((flatPullbackG0 pr).comp (k0ToG0 Z)))))
  let R : K0 Z →+ G0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme :=
    (finitePushforward (inv (ηΣ ≫ pr) ≫ FzΣ)).comp (k0ToG0 Z)
  have hLR : L' = R := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    intro E
    change k0ToG0 _ (pullbackK0 ιΣ
        (Ψ (finitePushforward F (flatPullbackG0 pr (k0ToG0 Z (k0ClassOf Z E.1 E.2)))))) =
      finitePushforward (inv (ηΣ ≫ pr) ≫ FzΣ) (k0ToG0 Z (k0ClassOf Z E.1 E.2))
    rw [k0ToG0_classOf]
    exact hbcE_pencil_fibre_bundle σ F pr hL hreg hs E.1 E.2 _ (by rw [hΨ])
  have hyΨ : y = Ψ (finitePushforward F (flatPullbackG0 pr (k0ToG0 Z x))) := by
    rw [← hy]; exact ((AddEquiv.ofBijective (k0ToG0 Y) hres).symm_apply_apply y).symm
  have := DFunLike.congr_fun hLR x
  change k0ToG0 _ (pullbackK0 ιΣ
      (Ψ (finitePushforward F (flatPullbackG0 pr (k0ToG0 Z x))))) =
    finitePushforward (inv (ηΣ ≫ pr) ≫ FzΣ) (k0ToG0 Z x) at this
  rw [hyΨ]; exact this

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.hbcE_pencil_fibre_integral
statement:
theorem hbcE_pencil_fibre_integral (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1) (hreg : SectionIsRegular σ)
    [IsIntegral W]
    (hη : F (genericPoint W) ∉ Set.range (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι)
    [IsIso (pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι ≫ pr)]
    (hres : Function.Bijective (k0ToG0 Y)) (x : K0 Z) (y : K0 Y)
    (hy : k0ToG0 Y y = finitePushforward F (flatPullbackG0 pr (k0ToG0 Z x))) :
    k0ToG0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme
        (pullbackK0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι y) =
      finitePushforward (inv (pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι ≫ pr) ≫
        pullback.snd F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι) (k0ToG0 Z x)
proof:
:=
  hbcE_pencil_fibre σ F pr hL hreg
    (KSpecialization.ARRHS.mono_pullbackSection_of_generic σ hL hreg F hη) hres x y hy

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.ptLine_appTop_aLine
statement: theorem ptLine_appTop_aLine : (ptLine c).appTop (aLine c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom c)))
    (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C c)
  have h0 : (Polynomial.evalRingHom c) (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C c) = 0 := by simp
  have h1 : (ConcreteCategory.hom (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom c) ≫
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv)) (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C c) = 0 := by
    rw [CommRingCat.comp_apply]
    change ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv).hom ((Polynomial.evalRingHom c) (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C c)) = 0
    rw [h0]
    exact map_zero _
  exact h.symm.trans h1

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.ker_ptLine_appTop
statement:
theorem ker_ptLine_appTop :
    RingHom.ker (ptLine c).appTop.hom = Ideal.span {aLine c}
proof:
:= by
  let e := (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k[X])).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  have hnat := Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom c))
  have key : ∀ x : Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of k[X]), ⊤),
      (ptLine c).appTop.hom x = 0 ↔ Polynomial.eval c (e x) = 0 := by
    intro x
    have h1 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hnat x
    change ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).hom).hom ((ptLine c).appTop.hom x) =
      (Polynomial.evalRingHom c) (e x) at h1
    constructor
    · intro h
      have h3 : (Polynomial.evalRingHom c) (e x) = 0 := by
        rw [← h1, h, map_zero]
      exact h3
    · intro h
      have h3 : (Polynomial.evalRingHom c) (e x) = 0 := h
      apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).hom).1
      rw [h1, h3, map_zero]
  ext x
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker, key, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h2 : e x ∈ RingHom.ker (Polynomial.evalRingHom c) := h
    rw [Polynomial.ker_evalRingHom, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at h2
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := h2
    refine ⟨e.symm q, ?_⟩
    calc x = e.symm (e x) := (e.symm_apply_apply x).symm
      _ = e.symm ((Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C c) * q) := by rw [hq]
      _ = e.symm (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C c) * e.symm q := map_mul _ _ _
      _ = aLine c * e.symm q := rfl
  · rintro ⟨q, rfl⟩
    have hA : e (aLine c) = Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C c := e.apply_symm_apply _
    rw [map_mul, hA]
    simp

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.ker_ptLine
statement: theorem ker_ptLine : (ptLine c).ker = zeroIdeal (aLine c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.ker_of_isAffine, ker_ptLine_appTop]
  rfl

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.zeroScheme_fibre
statement:
theorem zeroScheme_fibre :
    ∃ e : Q ≅ zeroScheme (f.appTop (aLine c)), e.hom ≫ zeroι _ = qι
proof:
:= by
  have ha : qι.appTop (f.appTop (aLine c)) = 0 := by
    have h1 : (qι ≫ f).appTop (aLine c) = 0 := by
      rw [sq.w, Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop]
      simp [ptLine_appTop_aLine]
    rwa [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop] at h1
  let φ : Q ⟶ zeroScheme (f.appTop (aLine c)) := zeroLift _ qι ha
  have hφ : φ ≫ zeroι _ = qι := zeroLift_zeroι _ _ _
  have hb : (zeroι (f.appTop (aLine c)) ≫ f).appTop (aLine c) = 0 := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop]
    exact zeroι_appTop (f.appTop (aLine c))
  let g : zeroScheme (f.appTop (aLine c)) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k) :=
    IsClosedImmersion.lift (ptLine c) (zeroι _ ≫ f) (by
      rw [ker_ptLine]
      exact zeroIdeal_le_ker _ _ hb)
  have hg : g ≫ ptLine c = zeroι _ ≫ f := IsClosedImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _
  let ψ : zeroScheme (f.appTop (aLine c)) ⟶ Q := sq.lift (zeroι _) g hg.symm
  have hψ1 : ψ ≫ qι = zeroι _ := sq.lift_fst _ _ _
  refine ⟨⟨φ, ψ, ?_, ?_⟩, hφ⟩
  · rw [← cancel_mono qι, Category.assoc, hψ1, hφ, Category.id_comp]
  · rw [← cancel_mono (zeroι (f.appTop (aLine c))), Category.assoc, hφ, hψ1, Category.id_comp]

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.map_ringEquiv_refl
statement:
theorem map_ringEquiv_refl (I : Ideal R) :
    I.map (RingEquiv.refl R).toRingHom = I
proof:
:= by

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.map_ringEquiv_trans
statement:
theorem map_ringEquiv_trans (e : R ≃+* S) (f : S ≃+* T) (I : Ideal R) :
    (I.map e.toRingHom).map f.toRingHom =
      I.map (e.trans f).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  rw [RingEquiv.toRingHom_trans, Ideal.map_map]

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.coe_ringEquivCast_reesAlgebra
statement:
theorem coe_ringEquivCast_reesAlgebra {I J : Ideal R} (h : I = J)
    (p : reesAlgebra I) :
    (((RingEquiv.cast (R := fun K : Ideal R ↦ reesAlgebra K) h) p :
        reesAlgebra J) : R[X]) = (p : R[X])
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  rfl

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv_refl_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv_refl_apply
    (I : Ideal R) (p : reesAlgebra I) :
    (((reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv (RingEquiv.refl R) I p :
        reesAlgebra (I.map (RingEquiv.refl R).toRingHom)) : R[X])) =
      (p : R[X])
proof:
:= by
  change Polynomial.map (RingEquiv.refl R).toRingHom (p : R[X]) =
    (p : R[X])
  rw [RingEquiv.toRingHom_refl, Polynomial.map_id]

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv_trans_apply
statement:
theorem reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv_trans_apply
    (e : R ≃+* S) (f : S ≃+* T) (I : Ideal R) (p : reesAlgebra I) :
    ((((reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv e I).trans
          (reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv f (I.map e.toRingHom))) p :
        reesAlgebra ((I.map e.toRingHom).map f.toRingHom)) : T[X]) =
      ((reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv (e.trans f) I p :
        reesAlgebra (I.map (e.trans f).toRingHom)) : T[X])
proof:
:= by
  change Polynomial.map f.toRingHom
      (Polynomial.map e.toRingHom (p : R[X])) =
    Polynomial.map (e.trans f).toRingHom (p : R[X])
  rw [RingEquiv.toRingHom_trans, Polynomial.map_map]

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv_refl
statement:
theorem reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv_refl
    (I : Ideal R) (h : I.map (RingEquiv.refl R).toRingHom = I) :
    (reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv (RingEquiv.refl R) I).trans
        (RingEquiv.cast (R := fun J : Ideal R ↦ reesAlgebra J) h) =
      RingEquiv.refl (reesAlgebra I)
proof:
:= by
  apply RingEquiv.ext
  intro p
  apply Subtype.ext
  change
    (((RingEquiv.cast (R := fun J : Ideal R ↦ reesAlgebra J) h)
        (reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv (RingEquiv.refl R) I p) :
      reesAlgebra I) : R[X]) = (p : R[X])
  calc
    _ = ((reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv (RingEquiv.refl R) I p :
          reesAlgebra (I.map (RingEquiv.refl R).toRingHom)) : R[X]) :=
      coe_ringEquivCast_reesAlgebra h _
    _ = _ := reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv_refl_apply I p

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv_trans
statement:
theorem reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv_trans
    (e : R ≃+* S) (f : S ≃+* T) (I : Ideal R)
    (h : (I.map e.toRingHom).map f.toRingHom =
      I.map (e.trans f).toRingHom) :
    ((reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv e I).trans
        (reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv f (I.map e.toRingHom))).trans
          (RingEquiv.cast (R := fun J : Ideal T ↦ reesAlgebra J) h) =
      reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv (e.trans f) I
proof:
:= by
  apply RingEquiv.ext
  intro p
  apply Subtype.ext
  change
    (((RingEquiv.cast (R := fun J : Ideal T ↦ reesAlgebra J) h)
        (((reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv e I).trans
          (reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv f (I.map e.toRingHom))) p) :
      reesAlgebra (I.map (e.trans f).toRingHom)) : T[X]) =
    ((reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv (e.trans f) I p :
      reesAlgebra (I.map (e.trans f).toRingHom)) : T[X])
  calc
    _ = ((((reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv e I).trans
          (reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv f (I.map e.toRingHom))) p :
        reesAlgebra ((I.map e.toRingHom).map f.toRingHom)) : T[X]) :=
      coe_ringEquivCast_reesAlgebra h _
    _ = _ := reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv_trans_apply e f I p

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.coe_gradedReesCast
statement:
theorem coe_gradedReesCast {I J : Ideal R} (h : I = J) (p : reesAlgebra I) :
    ((gradedReesCast h p : reesAlgebra J) : R[X]) = (p : R[X])
proof:
:= by
  subst J
  rfl

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesCast
statement:
theorem irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesCast {I J : Ideal R} (h : I = J) :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading J) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading I)).map (gradedReesCast h)
proof:
:= by
  subst J
  simp [gradedReesCast]

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesProjMapOfIdealEq_eqToHom
statement:
theorem reesProjMapOfIdealEq_eqToHom {I J : Ideal R} (h : I = J) :
    reesProjMapOfIdealEq h =
      eqToHom (congrArg
        (fun K : Ideal R ↦ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading K)) h.symm)
proof:
:= by
  subst J
  simpa [reesProjMapOfIdealEq, gradedReesCast] using
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map_id (A := reesAlgebra I) (𝒜 := grading I))

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesProjMapOfRingEquiv_refl
statement:
theorem reesProjMapOfRingEquiv_refl
    (I : Ideal R) (h : I.map (RingEquiv.refl R).toRingHom = I) :
    reesProjMapOfRingEquiv (RingEquiv.refl R) I =
      eqToHom (congrArg
        (fun J : Ideal R ↦ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading J)) h)
proof:
:= by
  have hgraded :
      gradedReesEquivHom (RingEquiv.refl R) I =
        gradedReesCast h.symm := by
    apply DFunLike.ext _ _
    intro p
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [coe_gradedReesCast]
    exact reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv_refl_apply I p
  let P := { g : grading I →+*ᵍ
      grading (I.map (RingEquiv.refl R).toRingHom) //
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant
        (grading (I.map (RingEquiv.refl R).toRingHom)) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading I)).map g }
  let p : P := ⟨gradedReesEquivHom (RingEquiv.refl R) I,
    irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivHom (RingEquiv.refl R) I⟩
  let q : P := ⟨gradedReesCast h.symm,
    irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesCast h.symm⟩
  have hpq : p = q := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hgraded
  change AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map p.1 p.2 = _
  calc
    _ = AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map q.1 q.2 :=
      congrArg (fun t : P ↦ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map t.1 t.2) hpq
    _ = reesProjMapOfIdealEq h.symm := rfl
    _ = eqToHom (congrArg
        (fun J : Ideal R ↦ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading J)) h.symm.symm) :=
      reesProjMapOfIdealEq_eqToHom h.symm
    _ = _ := by congr

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesProjMapOfRingEquiv_trans
statement:
theorem reesProjMapOfRingEquiv_trans
    (e : R ≃+* S) (f : S ≃+* T) (I : Ideal R)
    (h : (I.map e.toRingHom).map f.toRingHom =
      I.map (e.trans f).toRingHom) :
    eqToHom (congrArg
        (fun J : Ideal T ↦ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading J)) h) ≫
        reesProjMapOfRingEquiv (e.trans f) I =
      reesProjMapOfRingEquiv f (I.map e.toRingHom) ≫
        reesProjMapOfRingEquiv e I
proof:
:= by
  have htransport :
      reesProjMapOfIdealEq h.symm =
        eqToHom (congrArg
          (fun J : Ideal T ↦ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading J)) h) := by
    calc
      _ = eqToHom (congrArg
          (fun J : Ideal T ↦ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading J))
            h.symm.symm) :=
        reesProjMapOfIdealEq_eqToHom h.symm
      _ = _ := by congr
  have hgraded :
      (gradedReesCast h.symm).comp
          (gradedReesEquivHom (e.trans f) I) =
        (gradedReesEquivHom f (I.map e.toRingHom)).comp
          (gradedReesEquivHom e I) := by
    apply DFunLike.ext _ _
    intro p
    apply Subtype.ext
    change
      ((gradedReesCast h.symm
        (gradedReesEquivHom (e.trans f) I p) :
          reesAlgebra ((I.map e.toRingHom).map f.toRingHom)) : T[X]) =
        ((gradedReesEquivHom f (I.map e.toRingHom)
          (gradedReesEquivHom e I p) :
            reesAlgebra ((I.map e.toRingHom).map f.toRingHom)) : T[X])
    calc
      _ = ((gradedReesEquivHom (e.trans f) I p :
          reesAlgebra (I.map (e.trans f).toRingHom)) : T[X]) :=
        coe_gradedReesCast h.symm _
      _ = _ := (reesAlgebraEquivOfRingEquiv_trans_apply e f I p).symm
  rw [← htransport]
  unfold reesProjMapOfIdealEq reesProjMapOfRingEquiv
  rw [← AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map_comp,
    ← AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesProjIsoOfRingEquiv_refl
statement:
theorem reesProjIsoOfRingEquiv_refl
    (I : Ideal R) (h : I.map (RingEquiv.refl R).toRingHom = I) :
    reesProjIsoOfRingEquiv (RingEquiv.refl R) I =
      eqToIso (congrArg
        (fun J : Ideal R ↦ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading J)) h)
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  change reesProjMapOfRingEquiv (RingEquiv.refl R) I =
    eqToHom (congrArg
      (fun J : Ideal R ↦ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading J)) h)
  exact reesProjMapOfRingEquiv_refl I h

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesProjIsoOfRingEquiv_trans
statement:
theorem reesProjIsoOfRingEquiv_trans
    (e : R ≃+* S) (f : S ≃+* T) (I : Ideal R)
    (h : (I.map e.toRingHom).map f.toRingHom =
      I.map (e.trans f).toRingHom) :
    (eqToIso (congrArg
        (fun J : Ideal T ↦ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading J)) h)).trans
          (reesProjIsoOfRingEquiv (e.trans f) I) =
      (reesProjIsoOfRingEquiv f (I.map e.toRingHom)).trans
        (reesProjIsoOfRingEquiv e I)
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  change
    eqToHom (congrArg
        (fun J : Ideal T ↦ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading J)) h) ≫
        reesProjMapOfRingEquiv (e.trans f) I =
      reesProjMapOfRingEquiv f (I.map e.toRingHom) ≫
        reesProjMapOfRingEquiv e I
  exact reesProjMapOfRingEquiv_trans e f I h

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.AffineOverlapComparison.refl_sectionsEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem refl_sectionsEquiv (I : Ideal R) :

:=

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.AffineOverlapComparison.trans_sectionsEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem trans_sectionsEquiv (c₀₁ : AffineOverlapComparison I J)
    (c₁₂ : AffineOverlapComparison J K) :
    (c₀₁.trans c₁₂).sectionsEquiv =
      c₀₁.sectionsEquiv.trans c₁₂.sectionsEquiv
proof:
:=

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.AffineOverlapComparison.projIso_eq_transport_trans
statement:
theorem projIso_eq_transport_trans
    (c : AffineOverlapComparison I J) :
    c.projIso =
      (eqToIso (congrArg
        (fun L : Ideal S ↦ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading L))
          c.map_ideal.symm)).trans
        (reesProjIsoOfRingEquiv c.sectionsEquiv I)
proof:
:= by
  rcases c with ⟨e, h⟩
  subst J
  simp [AffineOverlapComparison.projIso]

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.AffineOverlapComparison.projIso_refl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem projIso_refl (I : Ideal R) :
    (refl I).projIso = Iso.refl (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading I))
proof:
:= by
  rw [projIso_eq_transport_trans]
  apply Iso.ext
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, eqToIso.hom, Iso.refl_hom]
  dsimp only [refl]
  change
    eqToHom (congrArg
        (fun J : Ideal R ↦ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading J))
          (map_ringEquiv_refl I).symm) ≫
        reesProjMapOfRingEquiv (RingEquiv.refl R) I =
      𝟙 (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading I))
  rw [reesProjMapOfRingEquiv_refl I (map_ringEquiv_refl I)]
  simp

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.AffineOverlapComparison.projIso_cocycle
statement:
theorem projIso_cocycle
    (c₀₁ : AffineOverlapComparison I J)
    (c₁₂ : AffineOverlapComparison J K) :
    (c₀₁.trans c₁₂).projIso =
      c₁₂.projIso.trans c₀₁.projIso
proof:
:= by
  rcases c₀₁ with ⟨e, h₀₁⟩
  rcases c₁₂ with ⟨f, h₁₂⟩
  subst J
  subst K
  rw [projIso_eq_transport_trans, projIso_eq_transport_trans,
    projIso_eq_transport_trans]
  simp only [eqToIso_refl, Iso.refl_trans]
  exact reesProjIsoOfRingEquiv_trans e f I (map_ringEquiv_trans e f I)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E26.restrictHomOverLE_refl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E26.scaleFrame_globalFrame
statement:
theorem scaleFrame_globalFrame (d : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData S M x) (V : S.Opens)
    (hV : V ≤ d.U) (x' : S) (hx' : x' ∈ V) (a : Γ(S, V)ˣ) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E26.scaleFrame_globalFrameOverLE
statement:

    (hV : V ≤ d.U) (x' : S) (hx' : x' ∈ V) (a : Γ(S, V)ˣ) :
    (scaleFrame d V hV x' hx' a).globalFrameOverLE V le_rfl =

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E26.scaleFrame_transitionIsoOver
statement:
theorem scaleFrame_transitionIsoOver (d : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData S M x) (V : S.Opens)
    (hV : V ≤ d.U) (x' : S) (hx' : x' ∈ V) (a : Γ(S, V)ˣ) :
    d.transitionIsoOver (scaleFrame d V hV x' hx' a) V hV le_rfl = twistIso V a

  rw [scaleFrame_globalFrameOverLE]
