  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E26.scaleFrame_transitionSectionOver
statement:
theorem scaleFrame_transitionSectionOver (d : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData S M x)
    (V : S.Opens) (hV : V ≤ d.U) (x' : S) (hx' : x' ∈ V) (a : Γ(S, V)ˣ) :
    d.transitionSectionOver (scaleFrame d V hV x' hx' a) V hV le_rfl = ((a : Γ(S, V)ˣ) : Γ(S, V))
proof:
:= by
  unfold Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.transitionSectionOver
    Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.transitionAppIsoOver
    Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.transitionUnitIsoOver
  rw [scaleFrame_transitionIsoOver]
  have h : (uIso V).symm ≪≫ twistIso V a ≪≫ uIso V = mulIsoOfUnit V a := by
    unfold twistIso
    apply Iso.ext
    simp
  change (ConcreteCategory.hom ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (S.ringCatSheaf.over V)
    (op (Over.mk (𝟙 V)))).mapIso ((uIso V).symm ≪≫ twistIso V a ≪≫ uIso V)).hom) (1 : S.presheaf.obj (op V)) = _
  rw [h]
  change (SheafOfModules.evaluation (S.ringCatSheaf.over V) (op (Over.mk (𝟙 V)))).map
    (LineBundleDual.mulSectionHom S V a.1) (1 : S.presheaf.obj (op V)) = _
  change S.presheaf.map (𝟙 V).op a.1 * (1 : S.presheaf.obj (op V)) = a.1
  rw [mul_one]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E26.scaleFrame_regularTransitionFunction
statement:
theorem scaleFrame_regularTransitionFunction (d : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData S M x)
    (V : S.Opens) [Nonempty V] (hV : V ≤ d.U) (x' : S) (hx' : x' ∈ V) (a : Γ(S, V)ˣ) :
    d.regularTransitionFunction (scaleFrame d V hV x' hx' a) =
      algebraMap (S.presheaf.obj (op V)) S.functionField a.1
proof:
:= by
  have hle : V ≤ d.U ⊓ (scaleFrame d V hV x' hx' a).U := le_inf hV le_rfl
  unfold Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.regularTransitionFunction
  rw [Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.algebraMap_functionField_restrict
    (X := S) hle (d.transitionSection (scaleFrame d V hV x' hx' a))]
  have h1 := d.transitionSection_restrict (scaleFrame d V hV x' hx' a) V hV le_rfl
  rw [scaleFrame_transitionSectionOver] at h1
  rw [h1]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E26.scaleFrame_sectionCoord
statement:
theorem scaleFrame_sectionCoord (d : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData S M x)
    (s : Γ(M, ⊤)) (V : S.Opens) (hV : V ≤ d.U) (x' : S) (hx' : x' ∈ V) (a : Γ(S, V)ˣ)
    (ha : a.1 * S.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op (D10.sectionCoordSec d s) = 1) :
    D10.sectionCoord (scaleFrame d V hV x' hx' a) s = 1
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty V := ⟨⟨x', hx'⟩⟩
  rw [D10.sectionCoord_compat d (scaleFrame d V hV x' hx' a) s,
    scaleFrame_regularTransitionFunction]
  unfold D10.sectionCoord
  rw [Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.algebraMap_functionField_restrict
    (X := S) hV (D10.sectionCoordSec d s), ← map_mul, mul_comm, ha, map_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E26.exists_frame_sectionCoord_one
statement:
theorem exists_frame_sectionCoord_one (d : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData S M x)
    (s : Γ(M, ⊤)) (z : S) (hz : z ∈ d.U)
    (hu : IsUnit (S.presheaf.germ d.U z hz (D10.sectionCoordSec d s))) :
    ∃ bf : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData S M z, D10.sectionCoord bf s = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, i, hzV, hV⟩ := AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpace.isUnit_res_of_isUnit_germ
    S.toRingedSpace d.U (D10.sectionCoordSec d s) z hz hu
  have hVU : V ≤ d.U := leOfHom i
  refine ⟨scaleFrame d V hVU z hzV (hV.unit⁻¹), scaleFrame_sectionCoord d s V hVU z hzV _ ?_⟩
  have : S.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op (D10.sectionCoordSec d s) = hV.unit.1 := rfl
  rw [this]
  exact Units.inv_mul hV.unit

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E26.closure_coord_isUnit
statement:
theorem closure_coord_isUnit (w : X) (s : Γ(L, ⊤)) (z : pointClosureScheme w)
    (hu : IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z)).U (pointClosureι w z)
      (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z)).mem (wCoord (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z)) s))) :
    IsUnit ((pointClosureScheme w).presheaf.germ (closureFrame (hL := hL) w z).U z
      (closureFrame (hL := hL) w z).mem
      (D10.sectionCoordSec (closureFrame (hL := hL) w z) (wPullbackSection (pointClosureι w) s)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold closureFrame
  rw [sectionCoordSec_pullbackWFrame (pointClosureι w) (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z)) s _
    (wCoord_spec _ s) z (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z)).mem]
  have h := Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply (pointClosureι w) (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z)).U z
    (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z)).mem (wCoord (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z)) s)
  have h' := hu.map (Scheme.Hom.stalkMap (pointClosureι w) z).hom
  exact (congrArg IsUnit h).mp h'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E26.exists_refFrame
statement:
theorem exists_refFrame (w : X) (s : Γ(L, ⊤)) (z : pointClosureScheme w)
    (hu : IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z)).U (pointClosureι w z)
      (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z)).mem (wCoord (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z)) s))) :
    ∃ bf : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme w)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι w)).obj L) z,
      D10.sectionCoord bf (wPullbackSection (pointClosureι w) s) = 1
proof:
:=
  exists_frame_sectionCoord_one _ _ z _ (closure_coord_isUnit (hL := hL) w s z hu)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E26.refFrame_coeff
statement:
theorem refFrame_coeff (w : X) (s : Γ(L, ⊤)) (z₀ : pointClosureScheme w)
    (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree (pointClosureScheme w)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι w)).obj L))
    (hrank : SingularCurve.genericRank (pointClosureScheme w)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι w)).obj L) = 1)
    (hu : IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z₀)).U (pointClosureι w z₀)
      (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z₀)).mem (wCoord (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι w z₀)) s))) :
    ∃ bf : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme w)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι w)).obj L) z₀,
      ∀ z : pointClosureScheme w,
        Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame hM hrank bf z =
          (pointClosureScheme w).ord
            (D10.sectionCoord (closureFrame (hL := hL) w z) (wPullbackSection (pointClosureι w) s)) z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨bf, hb⟩ := exists_refFrame (hL := hL) w s z₀ hu
  exact ⟨bf, fun z ↦ E25.coeff_eq_ord_sectionCoord hM hrank bf _ hb (closureFrame (hL := hL) w z) z
    (closureFrame (hL := hL) w z).mem⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E26.wCoord_isUnit_of_notMem_support
statement:
theorem wCoord_isUnit_of_notMem_support {X : Scheme.{u}} {L : X.Modules} [L.IsQuasicoherent]
    [L.IsFinitePresentation] (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (w : X)
    (hw : w ∉ (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).support) (d : WFrame L w) :
    IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ d.U w d.mem
      (wCoord d (sectionOfHom σ)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hwV, hVd⟩ := (Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens) d.mem
  let Va : X.affineOpens := ⟨V, hV⟩
  have h1 : w ∉ X.zeroLocus (U := V) ((sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).ideal Va : Set Γ(X, V)) := by
    intro hz
    exact hw ((Scheme.IdealSheafData.mem_supportSet_iff_of_mem (U := Va) hwV).mpr hz)
  rw [Scheme.mem_zeroLocus_iff] at h1
  push Not at h1
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfw⟩ := h1
  have hfu := (Scheme.mem_basicOpen X f w hwV).mp hfw
  rw [sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_affine σ Va] at hf
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := hf
  set s : Γ(L, ⊤) := sectionOfHom σ with hs
  set c := wCoord d s with hcdef
  have hc := wCoord_spec d s
  rw [wFrameSec_smul, wFrameSec_one] at hc
  have h2 := congrArg (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVd).op) hc
  rw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul] at h2
  have h3 : L.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVd).op (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : d.U ≤ ⊤)).op s) =
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ V (1 : Γ(X, V)) := by
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← L.presheaf.map_comp]
    exact section_app_one_restrict σ (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)
  rw [h3] at h2
  have h4 : f = X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVd).op c * φ
      (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVd).op (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_refl d.U)).op (wFrameGen d))) := by
    rw [← hφ]
    change φ (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ V (1 : Γ(X, V))) = _
    rw [← h2, φ.map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  have h5 : IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ V w hwV (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVd).op c)) := by
    rw [h4] at hfu
    rw [map_mul] at hfu
    exact isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left hfu
  rw [X.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE hVd) w hwV c] at h5
  exact h5

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E26.notMem_support_ker
statement:
theorem notMem_support_ker {V W : Scheme.{u}} (j : V ⟶ W) [IsClosedImmersion j] (w : W)
    (hw : w ∉ Set.range j) : w ∉ j.ker.support
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h' : w ∈ (j.ker.support : Set W) := h
  rw [Scheme.Hom.support_ker, j.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range.closure_eq] at h'
  exact hw h'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E26.weilGate_of_ord
statement:
theorem weilGate_of_ord {B D : X.Modules} {b : B ⟶ D} (P : PairCover b) {L : X.Modules}
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (e : ℕ)
    (hnot : ∀ σ : tensorUnitSheaf P.toB.scheme ⟶ E16.twistedLine P.toB L,
      SectionIsRegular σ → sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = P.jHom.ker →
      ∀ (m : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = m)
        (w : P.toB.scheme) (hw : height w = ((m + e + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
        (q : P.toD.scheme) (hq : height q = ((m + e : ℕ) : ℕ∞)),
        flatPullback P.toB.toBase (dimPrimeCycle v m hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle w _ hw).1 →
        flatPullback P.toD.toBase (dimPrimeCycle v m hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle q _ hq).1 →
        w ∉ Set.range P.jHom)
    (hjq : ∀ σ : tensorUnitSheaf P.toB.scheme ⟶ E16.twistedLine P.toB L,
      SectionIsRegular σ → sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = P.jHom.ker →
      ∀ (m : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = m)
        (w : P.toB.scheme) (hw : height w = ((m + e + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
        (q : P.toD.scheme) (hq : height q = ((m + e : ℕ) : ℕ∞)),
        flatPullback P.toB.toBase (dimPrimeCycle v m hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle w _ hw).1 →
        flatPullback P.toD.toBase (dimPrimeCycle v m hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle q _ hq).1 →
        P.jHom q ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι w))
    (hord : ∀ σ : tensorUnitSheaf P.toB.scheme ⟶ E16.twistedLine P.toB L,
      SectionIsRegular σ → sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = P.jHom.ker →
      ∀ (m : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = m)
        (w : P.toB.scheme) (hw : height w = ((m + e + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
        (q : P.toD.scheme) (hq : height q = ((m + e : ℕ) : ℕ∞)),
        flatPullback P.toB.toBase (dimPrimeCycle v m hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle w _ hw).1 →
        flatPullback P.toD.toBase (dimPrimeCycle v m hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle q _ hq).1 →
        ∀ z : pointClosureScheme w,
          (pointClosureScheme w).ord
            (D10.sectionCoord (closureFrame (L := E16.twistedLine P.toB L)
              (hL := E16.hasConstantRank_twistedLine P.toB hL) w z)
              (wPullbackSection (pointClosureι w) (sectionOfHom σ))) z =
          if pointClosureι w z = P.jHom q then 1 else 0) :
    E21.WeilGate P hL e
proof:
:= by
  intro σ hreg hid m v hv w hw q hq hB hD
  have hz := hord σ hreg hid m v hv w hw q hq hB hD
  refine ⟨hjq σ hreg hid m v hv w hw q hq hB hD, ?_⟩
  have hN := E16.hasConstantRank_twistedLine P.toB hL
  haveI : (E16.twistedLine P.toB L).IsLocallyFree := hN.isFiniteLocallyFree.isLocallyFree
  haveI : (E16.twistedLine P.toB L).IsFinitePresentation :=
    IsFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation P.toB.scheme hN.isFiniteLocallyFree
  let z₀ : pointClosureScheme w := pointClosureGenericPoint w
  have hnotw := hnot σ hreg hid m v hv w hw q hq hB hD
  have hsupp : pointClosureι w z₀ ∉ (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).support := by
    rw [hid, pointClosureι_genericPoint]
    exact notMem_support_ker P.jHom w hnotw
  have hu := wCoord_isUnit_of_notMem_support σ (pointClosureι w z₀) hsupp
    (wFrameAt (E16.twistedLine P.toB L) hN (pointClosureι w z₀))
  obtain ⟨bf, hbf⟩ := refFrame_coeff (hL := hN) w (sectionOfHom σ) z₀
    (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure _ hN w)
    (m7s_genericRank_pointClosure _ hN w) hu
  exact ⟨z₀, bf, fun z ↦ (hbf z).trans (hz z)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.SPECK.spk_k0ClassOf_eq_rank
statement:
theorem spk_k0ClassOf_eq_rank (E : (Spk k).Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree (Spk k) E) :
    k0ClassOf (Spk k) E hE =
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank (Spk k) E : ℕ) : K0 (Spk k))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := spk_exists_intCast k (k0ClassOf (Spk k) E hE)
  have h := congrArg (k0RankRingHom (Spk k)) hn
  rw [map_intCast] at h
  have h' : k0RankRingHom (Spk k) (k0ClassOf (Spk k) E hE) =
      (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank (Spk k) E : ℤ) :=
    k0Rank_classOf (Spk k) E hE
  rw [h'] at h
  have h2 : n = ((AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank (Spk k) E : ℕ) : ℤ) := h.symm
  rw [hn, h2]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.SPECK.evalChow_injective

proof:
:= by

  intro z hz
  induction z using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
  | H D =>
    rw [evalChow_mk] at hz
    have : D = 0 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply DFunLike.ext
      intro y
      rw [Subsingleton.elim y (pt0 k)]
      exact hz
    rw [this]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.SPECK.evalQ_tmul

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.SPECK.evalQ_cycle

theorem evalQ_cycle (D : dimensionCycles (Spk k) 0) :
    evalQ k ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow (Spk k) 0)) =
      ((D.1 (pt0 k) : ℤ) : ℚ)
proof:
:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.SPECK.exists_smul_ptClass
statement:
theorem exists_smul_ptClass (z : RationalDimChow (Spk k) 0) :
    ∃ q : ℚ, z = q • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] ptClass k)
proof:
:= by
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | tmul a x =>
    have hx : x = (evalChow k x) • ptClass k :=
      evalChow_injective k (by rw [map_zsmul, evalChow_ptClass, smul_eq_mul, mul_one])
    refine ⟨a * (evalChow k x : ℚ), ?_⟩
    generalize evalChow k x = n at hx ⊢
    subst hx
    rw [TensorProduct.tmul_smul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul', TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
    congr 1
    simp [zsmul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨a + b, (add_smul _ _ _).symm⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.SPECK.evalQ_ptClass
statement: theorem evalQ_ptClass : evalQ k ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] ptClass k) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [evalQ_tmul, evalChow_ptClass]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.SPECK.evalQ_injective
statement: theorem evalQ_injective : Function.Injective (evalQ k)
proof:
:= by
  intro z w h
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := exists_smul_ptClass k z
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := exists_smul_ptClass k w
  simp only [map_smul, evalQ_ptClass, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at h
  rw [h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.SPECK.evalQ_surjective
statement: theorem evalQ_surjective : Function.Surjective (evalQ k)
proof:
:= fun q ↦
  ⟨q • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] ptClass k), by simp [evalQ_ptClass]⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.SPECK.evalQ_bijective
statement: theorem evalQ_bijective : Function.Bijective (evalQ k)
proof:
:=
  ⟨evalQ_injective k, evalQ_surjective k⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.SPECK.rationalDimChow_spk_succ
statement: theorem rationalDimChow_spk_succ (n : ℕ) (z : RationalDimChow (Spk k) (n + 1)) : z = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hD : ∀ D : dimensionCycles (Spk k) (n + 1), D = 0 := by
    intro D
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply DFunLike.ext
    intro y
    by_contra hne
    have := D.2 (Function.mem_support.mpr hne)
    rw [Subsingleton.elim y (pt0 k), Set.mem_setOf_eq, height_pt0] at this
    have h' : (0 : ℕ) = n + 1 := by exact_mod_cast this
    omega
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => rfl
  | tmul a x =>
    induction x using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H D =>
      rw [hD D]
      simp
  | add x y hx hy => rw [hx, hy, add_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.SPECK.degTotalSpk_lof_zero

proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.SPECK.degTotalSpk_bijective
statement: theorem degTotalSpk_bijective : Function.Bijective (degTotalSpk k)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x y h
    rw [totalChow_spk_eq_lof k x, totalChow_spk_eq_lof k y] at h ⊢
    rw [degTotalSpk_lof_zero, degTotalSpk_lof_zero] at h
    rw [evalQ_injective k h]
  · intro q
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := evalQ_surjective k q
    exact ⟨DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow (Spk k) n) 0 z, by
      rw [degTotalSpk_lof_zero, hz]⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.SPECK.properPushforward_pt0
statement:
theorem properPushforward_pt0 (D : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) :
    properPushforward (X ↘ Spk k) D (pt0 k) = AlgebraicCycle.degree k D
proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.SPECK.evalQ_properPushforward
statement:
theorem evalQ_properPushforward (z : RationalDimChow X 0) :
    evalQ k (properPushforwardRationalDimChowD9 (k := k) (X ↘ Spk k) 0 z) = degQ k X z
proof:
:= by
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a x =>
    rw [properPushforwardRationalDimChowD9_tmul, evalQ_tmul, degQ_tmul]
    rfl
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.SPECK.evalQ_ops_push
statement:
theorem evalQ_ops_push {P : SchemeClass k} (ops : ChowOpsOn P) [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (P X)]
    [Fact (P (Spk k))] (z : RationalDimChow X 0) :
    evalQ k (ops.push (X ↘ Spk k) 0 z) = degQ k X z
proof:
:= by
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a x =>
    induction x using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H D =>
      have hD' : properPushforward (X ↘ Spk k) D.1 ∈ dimensionCycles (Spk k) 0 := by
        intro y hy
        rw [Subsingleton.elim y (pt0 k), Set.mem_setOf_eq, Nat.cast_zero]
        exact height_pt0 k
      have h1 := ops.push_mk (X ↘ Spk k) 0 D ⟨properPushforward (X ↘ Spk k) D.1, hD'⟩ rfl
      have h2 : a ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X 0) =
          a • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X 0)) := by
        rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      rw [h2, map_smul, h1, map_smul, evalQ_cycle, map_smul, degQ_tmul, degChow_mk]
      simp [properPushforward_pt0]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.SPECK.vanish_of_krullDimLE
statement:
theorem vanish_of_krullDimLE (n : ℕ) [Order.KrullDimLE n X]
    {CH : Type*} [AddCommGroup CH] (cycleClass : ∀ p, RationalCodimensionChow X p →+ CH) :
    ∀ p, n < p → ∀ z, cycleClass p z = 0
proof:
:= fun p hp z ↦ by
  rw [rationalCodimensionChow_eq_zero_of_krullDimLE X n p hp z, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.SPECK.dimensionCycles_eq_zero_of_krullDimLE
statement:
theorem dimensionCycles_eq_zero_of_krullDimLE (d n : ℕ) [Order.KrullDimLE d X] (hdn : d < n)
    (D : dimensionCycles X n) : D = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply DFunLike.ext
  intro y
  by_contra hne
  have hy : height y = n := D.2 (Function.mem_support.mpr hne)
  have h1 : ((height y : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ krullDim X := Order.height_le_krullDim y
  have h2 : krullDim X ≤ d := by
    rw [← Order.krullDimLE_iff]
    infer_instance
  rw [hy] at h1
  have h3 : ((n : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ((d : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := h1.trans h2
  have h4 : n ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast h3
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.SPECK.rationalDimChow_eq_zero_of_krullDimLE
statement:
theorem rationalDimChow_eq_zero_of_krullDimLE (d n : ℕ) [Order.KrullDimLE d X] (hdn : d < n)
    (z : RationalDimChow X n) : z = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => rfl
  | tmul a x =>
    induction x using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H D =>
      rw [dimensionCycles_eq_zero_of_krullDimLE X d n hdn D]
      simp
  | add x y hx hy => rw [hx, hy, add_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.SPECK.vanish_dim_of_krullDimLE
statement:
theorem vanish_dim_of_krullDimLE (d : ℕ) [Order.KrullDimLE d X]
    {CH : Type*} [AddCommGroup CH] (cls : ∀ n, RationalDimChow X n →+ CH) :
    ∀ n, d < n → ∀ z, cls n z = 0
proof:
:= fun n hn z ↦ by
  rw [rationalDimChow_eq_zero_of_krullDimLE X d n hn z, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.SPECK.exists_dimBound_vanish
statement:
theorem exists_dimBound_vanish [IsIntegral X] [CompactSpace X] (g : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType g] {CH : Type*} [AddCommGroup CH]
    (cycleClass : ∀ p, RationalCodimensionChow X p →+ CH) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ p, n < p → ∀ z, cycleClass p z = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := FiniteTypeCodimension.exists_krullDimLE k g
  exact ⟨n, vanish_of_krullDimLE X n cycleClass⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.SPECK.vanish_projectiveSpace
statement:
theorem vanish_projectiveSpace (n : ℕ) {CH : Type*} [AddCommGroup CH]
    (cycleClass : ∀ p, RationalCodimensionChow (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n) p →+ CH) :
    ∀ p, n < p → ∀ z, cycleClass p z = 0
proof:
:=
  vanish_of_krullDimLE _ n cycleClass

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.SPECK.vanish_spk
statement:
theorem vanish_spk {CH : Type*} [AddCommGroup CH]
    (cycleClass : ∀ p, RationalCodimensionChow (Spk k) p →+ CH) :
    ∀ p, 0 < p → ∀ z, cycleClass p z = 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Order.KrullDimLE 0 (Spk k) := by
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    rw [Order.krullDim_eq_iSup_coheight]
    refine iSup_le fun y ↦ ?_
    rw [coheight_spec_field k y]
    simp
  exact vanish_of_krullDimLE (Spk k) 0 cycleClass

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.SPECK.hcodim_closedImmersion
statement:
theorem hcodim_closedImmersion (i : Z ⟶ SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (p : ℕ) (x : Z) (hx : coheight x = p) :
    coheight (i x) = p + closedImmersionCodim k i
proof:
:= by
  have h := FiniteTypeCodimension.coheight_closedImmersion k
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k n) i x
  have hne := FiniteTypeCodimension.coheight_ne_top k
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k n) (i (genericPoint Z))
  rw [h, hx, closedImmersionCodim, ENat.coe_toNat hne]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.SPECK.pushforwardCodimensionCompatible_comp_toSpec
statement:
theorem pushforwardCodimensionCompatible_comp_toSpec (i : Z ⟶ SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (p : ℕ) :
    PushforwardCodimensionCompatible (i ≫ SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k n) p
      (p + closedImmersionCodim k i - n)
proof:
:= by
  intro x _ hx
  have hle : coheight (i x) ≤ n := by
    have h1 := Order.coheight_le_krullDim (i x)
    have h2 : krullDim (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n) ≤ n := by
      rw [← Order.krullDimLE_iff]
      infer_instance
    exact_mod_cast h1.trans h2
  rw [hcodim_closedImmersion k i p x hx] at hle
  have hpn : p + closedImmersionCodim k i - n = 0 :=
    Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le (by exact_mod_cast hle)
  rw [hpn, coheight_spec_field k]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosection_apply_basis_expand
statement:
theorem cosection_apply_basis_expand {W : P.Opens} (hW : IsAffineOpen W) {n : ℕ}
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin n) (P.presheaf.obj (op W)) ((underlyingCommPresheaf P K).obj (op W)))
    (q : (underlyingCommPresheaf P K).obj (op W)) :
    (show P.presheaf.obj (op W) from (σ.val.app (op W)).hom q) =
      ∑ i, b.repr q i * (show P.presheaf.obj (op W) from (σ.val.app (op W)).hom (b i))
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (affineCosection P K σ ⟨W, hW⟩) (b.sum_repr q)
  rw [map_sum] at h
  simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at h
  exact h.symm

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.ZeroSectionNF.knf
statement: theorem ZeroSectionNF.knf (h : ZeroSectionNF s σ) : ZeroSectionKNF s σ
proof:
:= by
  intro V x hx
  obtain ⟨W, hWV, hxW, hWa, n, b, hreg, hzero, hker⟩ := h V x hx
  refine ⟨W, hWV, hxW, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact koszulAcyclic_of_finiteBasis_weaklyRegular b (affineCosection P K σ ⟨W, hWa⟩) hreg
  · intro q
    rw [cosection_apply_basis_expand σ hWa b q, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
    rw [map_mul, hzero i, mul_zero]
  · intro a ha
    have hmem := hker a ha
    have hmem' : a ∈ cosectionImageIdeal (affineCosection P K σ ⟨W, hWa⟩) := by
      rw [cosectionImageIdeal_eq_span b]
      exact hmem
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hmem'
    exact ⟨q, hq⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.ZeroSectionNF.frames
statement: theorem ZeroSectionNF.frames (h : ZeroSectionNF s σ) : LocallyFiniteWeaklyRegularFrames P K σ
proof:
:= by
  intro V x hx
  obtain ⟨W, hWV, hxW, hWa, n, b, hreg, -, -⟩ := h V x hx
  exact ⟨W, hWV, hxW, hWa, n, b, hreg⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.moduleHom_app_eq_zero_of_locally
statement:
theorem moduleHom_app_eq_zero_of_locally {A B : P.Modules} (φ : A ⟶ B) (V : P.Opens)
    (q : A.val.obj (op V))
    (h : ∀ x ∈ V, ∃ W : P.Opens, W ≤ V ∧ x ∈ W ∧
      ∀ q' : A.val.obj (op W), (φ.val.app (op W)).hom q' = 0) :
    (φ.val.app (op V)).hom q = 0
proof:
:= by
  let T : TopCat.Sheaf Ab P := ⟨B.presheaf, B.isSheaf⟩
  choose! W hWV hxW hW using h
  apply T.eq_of_locally_eq' (fun x : V => W x.1) V (fun x => homOfLE (hWV x.1 x.2))
  · intro x hx
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hxW x hx⟩
  · intro x
    have e1 := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply φ.val (homOfLE (hWV x.1 x.2)).op q
    have e2 := hW x.1 x.2 (A.val.map (homOfLE (hWV x.1 x.2)).op q)
    exact e1.symm.trans (e2.trans (map_zero _).symm)

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.structureMapOf_cosection_zero
statement:
theorem structureMapOf_cosection_zero (hnf : ZeroSectionKNF s σ) :
    σ ≫ structureMapOf s = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro V
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro q
  refine moduleHom_app_eq_zero_of_locally (σ ≫ structureMapOf s) V.unop q ?_
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨W, hWV, hxW, -, hzero, -⟩ := hnf V.unop x hx
  exact ⟨W, hWV, hxW, fun q' => hzero q'⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.structureMapOf_epi
statement: theorem structureMapOf_epi [IsClosedImmersion s] : Epi (structureMapOf s)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro N f g hfg
  apply moduleHom_eq_of_affine_app_eq P
  intro U
  letI : Epi (structureMapOfApp s U.1) :=
    (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mpr (Scheme.Hom.app_surjective s U.1 U.2)
  apply (cancel_epi (structureMapOfApp s U.1)).mp
  exact congrArg (fun k => k.val.app (op U.1)) hfg

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.structureMapOf_exact
statement:
theorem structureMapOf_exact (hnf : ZeroSectionKNF s σ) :
    (ShortComplex.mk σ (structureMapOf s) (structureMapOf_cosection_zero s σ hnf)).Exact
proof:
:= by
  let S := ShortComplex.mk σ (structureMapOf s) (structureMapOf_cosection_zero s σ hnf)
  let F := underlyingCommPresheafFunctor P
  let sh := moduleSheafification P
  have hex : ((S.map F).map sh).Exact := by
    apply exact_moduleSheafification_map_of_locally_exact
    intro V x hx
    obtain ⟨W, hWV, hxW, -, -, hker⟩ := hnf V x hx
    refine ⟨W, hWV, hxW, ?_⟩
    intro c hc
    have hk : (s.app W).hom (show P.presheaf.obj (op W) from c) = 0 := hc
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hker c hk
    exact ⟨q, hq⟩
  let c := asIso (PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (structurePresheafId P)).counit
  let e : ((S.map F).map sh) ≅ S := ShortComplex.isoMk
    (c.app K) (c.app (tensorUnitSheaf P))
    (c.app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward s).obj (tensorUnitSheaf X)))
    ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction P).counit.naturality σ).symm
    ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction P).counit.naturality (structureMapOf s)).symm
  exact ShortComplex.exact_of_iso e hex

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.finitePushforward_unit_eq_lambdaMinusOne_of_knf
statement:
theorem finitePushforward_unit_eq_lambdaMinusOne_of_knf [IsLocallyNoetherian P]
    [IsClosedImmersion s] [IsFinite s] {d : ℕ} (hK : HasConstantRank P K d)
    (hnf : ZeroSectionKNF s σ) :
    finitePushforward s (k0ToG0 X 1) = k0ToG0 P (lambdaMinusOne K hK)
proof:
:= by
  rw [k0ToG0_one, finitePushforward_classOf]
  have hreg : IsLocallyKoszulRegular P K σ := fun V x hx => by
    obtain ⟨W, hWV, hxW, hac, -, -⟩ := hnf V x hx
    exact ⟨W, hWV, hxW, hac⟩
  calc
    _ = g0ClassOf P (cokernel σ)
        (cokernel_isCoherentLike P hK.isFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation
          (tensorUnitSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree P).isFinitePresentation σ) :=
      g0ClassOf_iso P _ _ (cokernelIsoOfKNF s σ hnf).symm
    _ = _ := g0ClassOf_cokernelCosection P K hK σ hreg

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.finitePushforward_unit_eq_lambdaMinusOne_of_nf
statement:
theorem finitePushforward_unit_eq_lambdaMinusOne_of_nf [IsLocallyNoetherian P]
    [IsClosedImmersion s] [IsFinite s] {d : ℕ} (hK : HasConstantRank P K d)
    (hnf : ZeroSectionNF s σ) :
    finitePushforward s (k0ToG0 X 1) = k0ToG0 P (lambdaMinusOne K hK)
proof:
:=
  finitePushforward_unit_eq_lambdaMinusOne_of_knf s σ hK hnf.knf

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.degreePieceChartFraction_raise_comm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degreePieceChartFraction_raise_comm (m r : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (p : degreePiece k n m) :
    degreePieceChartFraction k n (r + m) i
        (degreePieceChartFractionRaiseComm k n m r i p) =
      degreePieceChartFraction k n m i p
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp only [degreePieceChartFraction, degreePieceChartFractionRaiseComm,
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk]
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul]
  ring

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.mem_degree_of_coordinate_pow_mul_of_mem_degree
statement:
theorem mem_degree_of_coordinate_pow_mul_of_mem_degree
    (d r : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) {q : Polynomial k n}
    (hq : coordinate k n i ^ r * q ∈ grading k n (d + r)) :
    q ∈ grading k n d
proof:
:= by
  change (coordinate k n i ^ r * q).IsHomogeneous (d + r) at hq
  change q.IsHomogeneous d
  intro m hm
  have hm' :
      MvPolynomial.coeff (Finsupp.single i r + m)
          (coordinate k n i ^ r * q) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [coordinate, MvPolynomial.X_pow_eq_monomial,
      MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial_mul, one_mul] using hm
  have hd := hq hm'
  
  
  have hsum :
      (Finsupp.weight 1) (Finsupp.single i r + m) =
        r + (Finsupp.weight 1) m := by
    rw [map_add, Finsupp.weight_single, Pi.one_apply, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    
    norm_cast
  change (Finsupp.weight 1) m = d
  have hd' : r + (Finsupp.weight 1) m = r + d := by
    rw [← hsum, hd, Nat.add_comm]
  exact Nat.add_left_cancel hd'

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.exists_degreePieceChartFraction_of_coordinate_pow_dvd
statement:
theorem exists_degreePieceChartFraction_of_coordinate_pow_dvd
    (d r : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (p : degreePiece k n (d + r))
    (hdiv : coordinate k n i ^ r ∣ p.1) :
    ∃ q : degreePiece k n d,
      degreePieceChartFraction k n d i q =
        degreePieceChartFraction k n (d + r) i p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hdiv
  have hqdeg : q ∈ grading k n d := by
    apply mem_degree_of_coordinate_pow_mul_of_mem_degree k n d r i
    simpa only [hq] using p.2
  let q' : degreePiece k n d := ⟨q, hqdeg⟩
  have hp : degreePieceChartFractionRaise k n d r i q' = p := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change coordinate k n i ^ r * q = p.1
    exact hq.symm
  refine ⟨q', ?_⟩
  calc
    degreePieceChartFraction k n d i q' =
        degreePieceChartFraction k n (d + r) i
          (degreePieceChartFractionRaise k n d r i q') :=
      (degreePieceChartFraction_raise k n d r i q').symm
    _ = degreePieceChartFraction k n (d + r) i p := by rw [hp]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.degreePiece_eq_of_chart_overlap
statement:
theorem degreePiece_eq_of_chart_overlap (d : ℕ) (i j : Fin (n + 1))
    (p q : degreePiece k n d)
    (h : coordinateChartToOverlapLeft k n i j
          (degreePieceChartFraction k n d i p) =
        (twistTransitionUnit k n (d : ℤ) i j : CoordinateOverlapRing k n i j) *
          coordinateChartToOverlapRight k n i j
            (degreePieceChartFraction k n d j q)) :
    p = q
proof:
:= by
  have hrel := polynomial_relation_of_degreePieceChartFraction_overlap
    k n d d d i j p q h
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hnzd : coordinate k n i ^ d * coordinate k n j ^ d ∈
      nonZeroDivisors (Polynomial k n) :=
    MvPolynomial.X_pow_mul_X_pow_mem_nonZeroDivisors i j d d
  exact (mul_cancel_left_mem_nonZeroDivisors hnzd).mp hrel

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.exists_degreePieceChartFraction_fin_zero
statement:
theorem exists_degreePieceChartFraction_fin_zero (d : ℕ) (i : Fin 1)
    (x : CoordinateChartRing k 0 i) :
    ∃ p : degreePiece k 0 d, degreePieceChartFraction k 0 d i p = x
proof:
:= by
  
  
  letI : Subsingleton (Fin (0 + 1)) :=
    (Fin.subsingleton_one : Subsingleton (Fin 1))
  letI : IsEmpty (AffineChartIndex 0 i) :=
    ⟨fun j ↦ j.2 (Subsingleton.elim j.1 i)⟩
  let a : k := MvPolynomial.coeff 0 ((awayCoordinateEquiv k 0 i) x)
  let p : degreePiece k 0 d :=
    ⟨MvPolynomial.C a * coordinate k 0 i ^ d, by
      change (MvPolynomial.C a * MvPolynomial.X i ^ d).IsHomogeneous d
      exact MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_C_mul_X_pow a i d⟩
  have ha : (awayCoordinateEquiv k 0 i) x = MvPolynomial.C a :=
    MvPolynomial.eq_C_of_isEmpty _
  have haway : awayCoordinateHom k 0 i (MvPolynomial.C a) = x := by
    change (awayCoordinateEquiv k 0 i).symm (MvPolynomial.C a) = x
    rw [← ha]
    exact (awayCoordinateEquiv k 0 i).symm_apply_apply x
  have hpdehom : dehomogenizeHom k 0 i p.1 = MvPolynomial.C a := by
    dsimp only [p]
    simp [dehomogenizeHom, coordinate]
  refine ⟨p, ?_⟩
  calc
    degreePieceChartFraction k 0 d i p =
        awayCoordinateHom k 0 i (dehomogenizeHom k 0 i p.1) := by
      simpa only [degreePieceChartFraction] using
        (awayCoordinateHom_dehomogenizeHom_mk k 0 i d p.1 p.2).symm
    _ = awayCoordinateHom k 0 i (MvPolynomial.C a) := by rw [hpdehom]
    _ = x := haway

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.exists_degreePiece_of_coordinateChart_compatible
statement:
theorem exists_degreePiece_of_coordinateChart_compatible
    (d : ℕ) (x : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), CoordinateChartRing k n i)
    (hcompat : ∀ i j,
      coordinateChartToOverlapLeft k n i j (x i) =
        (twistTransitionUnit k n (d : ℤ) i j : CoordinateOverlapRing k n i j) *
          coordinateChartToOverlapRight k n i j (x j)) :
    ∃ p : degreePiece k n d, ∀ i,
      degreePieceChartFraction k n d i p = x i
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      letI : Subsingleton (Fin (0 + 1)) :=
        (Fin.subsingleton_one : Subsingleton (Fin 1))
      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ :=
        exists_degreePieceChartFraction_fin_zero k d (0 : Fin 1) (x 0)
      refine ⟨p, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
      have hi : i = (0 : Fin 1) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      subst i
      exact hp
  | succ n =>
      
      obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ :=
        exists_common_degreePieceChartFraction k (n + 1) x
      choose p hp using hD
      let p' : ∀ i, degreePiece k (n + 1) (d + D) := fun i ↦
        degreePieceChartFractionRaiseComm k (n + 1) D d i (p i)
      have hp' (i) :
          degreePieceChartFraction k (n + 1) (d + D) i (p' i) = x i := by
        exact (degreePieceChartFraction_raise_comm
          k (n + 1) D d i (p i)).trans (hp i)
      have hdiv (i) : coordinate k (n + 1) i ^ D ∣ (p' i).1 := by
        obtain ⟨j, hji⟩ := exists_ne i
        apply coordinate_pow_dvd_degreePieceChartFraction_numerator_of_overlap
          k (n + 1) hji.symm d D (d + D) (p' i) (p' j)
        simpa only [hp' i, hp' j] using hcompat i j
      choose q hq using fun i ↦
        exists_degreePieceChartFraction_of_coordinate_pow_dvd
          k (n + 1) d D i (p' i) (hdiv i)
      have hqx (i) :
          degreePieceChartFraction k (n + 1) d i (q i) = x i :=
        (hq i).trans (hp' i)
      let i₀ : Fin ((n + 1) + 1) := 0
      have hqi (i) : q i₀ = q i := by
        apply degreePiece_eq_of_chart_overlap k (n + 1) d i₀ i
        simpa only [hqx i₀, hqx i] using hcompat i₀ i
      refine ⟨q i₀, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
      rw [hqi i]
      exact hqx i

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTopCochainChart_encode
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateCechTopCochainChart_encode
    (x : coordinateCechTopCochains k n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (coordinateOpen k n i).topIso.inv
        (coordinateChartRegularSection k n i
          (coordinateCechTopCochainChart k n x i)) =
      (Pi.π (fun j : Fin (n + 1) ↦
        pushedUnit (space k n) (coordinateOpen k n j)) i).app ⊤ x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coordinateCechTopCochainChart, coordinateChartRegularSection,
    Iso.hom_inv_id_apply, Iso.inv_hom_id_apply]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechKernel_chart_compatibility
statement:
theorem coordinateCechKernel_chart_compatibility (d : ℕ)
    (z : coordinateCechKernel (k := k) (n := n) (d : ℤ)) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateChartToOverlapLeft k n i j
        (coordinateCechTopCochainChart k n z.1 i) =
      (twistTransitionUnit k n (d : ℤ) i j : CoordinateOverlapRing k n i j) *
        coordinateChartToOverlapRight k n i j
          (coordinateCechTopCochainChart k n z.1 j)
proof:
:= by
  have hz :
      (coordinateDescentLeft k n).app ⊤ z.1 =
        (coordinateDescentRight k n (d : ℤ)).app ⊤ z.1 := by
    have hz₀ := z.2
    change (coordinateDescentLeft k n).app ⊤ z.1 -
        (coordinateDescentRight k n (d : ℤ)).app ⊤ z.1 = 0 at hz₀
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hz₀
  let f := fun ab : Fin (n + 1) × Fin (n + 1) ↦
    pushedUnit (space k n) (coordinateOverlapOpen k n ab.1 ab.2)
  have hij := congrArg
    (fun y ↦ (Pi.π f (i, j)).app ⊤ y) hz
  change ((coordinateDescentLeft k n ≫ Pi.π f (i, j)).app ⊤) z.1 =
    ((coordinateDescentRight k n (d : ℤ) ≫ Pi.π f (i, j)).app ⊤) z.1 at hij
  dsimp only [f] at hij
  simp only [coordinateDescentLeft, coordinateDescentRight, Pi.lift_π] at hij
  change (pushedUnitRestriction
        ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_left)).app ⊤
      ((Pi.π (fun a : Fin (n + 1) ↦
        pushedUnit (space k n) (coordinateOpen k n a)) i).app ⊤ z.1) =
    (pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition k n (d : ℤ) i j).app ⊤
      ((pushedUnitRestriction
        ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_right)).app ⊤
        ((Pi.π (fun a : Fin (n + 1) ↦
          pushedUnit (space k n) (coordinateOpen k n a)) j).app ⊤ z.1)) at hij
  rw [← coordinateCechTopCochainChart_encode k n z.1 i,
    ← coordinateCechTopCochainChart_encode k n z.1 j] at hij
  let W := coordinateOverlapOpen k n i j
  let P := W.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (space k n).Opens)
  let eW := W.ι.appIso P
  have qW : W.ι ''ᵁ P = W := by
    dsimp only [W, P]
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf,
      Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
    simp
  let qIso := (space k n).presheaf.mapIso (eqToIso qW).op
  let sL : Γ(unitModules W.toScheme, P) :=
    (pushedUnitRestriction
      ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_left)).app ⊤
        ((coordinateOpen k n i).topIso.inv
          (coordinateChartRegularSection k n i
            (coordinateCechTopCochainChart k n z.1 i)))
  let sR : Γ(unitModules W.toScheme, P) :=
    (pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition k n (d : ℤ) i j).app ⊤
      ((pushedUnitRestriction
        ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_right)).app ⊤
          ((coordinateOpen k n j).topIso.inv
            (coordinateChartRegularSection k n j
              (coordinateCechTopCochainChart k n z.1 j))))
  change sL = sR at hij
  let T : Γ(unitModules W.toScheme, P) → Γ(space k n, W) :=
    fun y ↦ qIso.inv (eW.inv y)
  have hT : T sL = T sR := congrArg T hij
  dsimp only [T, sL, sR] at hT
  simp only [pushedUnitRestriction_app_apply,
    pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition, Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app,
    coordinateOverlapTransitionIso] at hT
  simp [unitMulSheafIso_hom_app_apply, restrictTopUnit,
    Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso] at hT
  dsimp only [eW, qIso] at hT
  simp only [Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso, Iso.refl_inv] at hT
  change (space k n).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_left)).op
        (coordinateChartRegularSection k n i
          (coordinateCechTopCochainChart k n z.1 i)) =
    (twistTransitionSectionUnit k n (d : ℤ) i j).1 *
      (space k n).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_right)).op
          (coordinateChartRegularSection k n j
            (coordinateCechTopCochainChart k n z.1 j)) at hT
  rw [coordinateChartRegularSection_overlap_left,
    coordinateChartRegularSection_overlap_right] at hT
  unfold twistTransitionSectionUnit at hT
  change (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (grading k n)
        (coordinateOverlapEquation k n i j)
        (coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two k n i j) (by omega)).hom
      (coordinateChartToOverlapLeft k n i j
        (coordinateCechTopCochainChart k n z.1 i)) =
    (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (grading k n)
        (coordinateOverlapEquation k n i j)
        (coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two k n i j) (by omega)).hom
      (twistTransitionUnit k n (d : ℤ) i j : CoordinateOverlapRing k n i j) *
      (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (grading k n)
        (coordinateOverlapEquation k n i j)
        (coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two k n i j) (by omega)).hom
      (coordinateChartToOverlapRight k n i j
        (coordinateCechTopCochainChart k n z.1 j)) at hT
  rw [← map_mul] at hT
  exact ((ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective
    (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (grading k n)
      (coordinateOverlapEquation k n i j)
      (coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two k n i j) (by omega)).hom).mp
        inferInstance).injective hT

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.degreePieceChartTuple_eq_of_decoded_charts
statement:
theorem degreePieceChartTuple_eq_of_decoded_charts (d : ℕ)
    (p : degreePiece k n d) (x : coordinateCechTopCochains k n)
    (h : ∀ i, degreePieceChartFraction k n d i p =
      coordinateCechTopCochainChart k n x i) :
    degreePieceChartTuple k n d p = x
proof:
:= by
  let X := space k n
  let E := SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf
    (op (⊤ : X.Opens))
  let f := fun i : Fin (n + 1) ↦ pushedUnit X (coordinateOpen k n i)
  let e : E.obj (coordinateChartCochains k n) ≅
      ModuleCat.of Γ(X, ⊤) (∀ i, ↑(E.obj (f i))) :=
    PreservesProduct.iso E f ≪≫ ModuleCat.piIsoPi _
  apply ((ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective e.hom).mp inferInstance).injective
  funext i
  let q := ModuleCat.ofHom
    (LinearMap.proj i : (∀ i, ↑(E.obj (f i))) →ₗ[Γ(X, ⊤)] ↑(E.obj (f i)))
  have hc : e.hom ≫ q = E.map (Pi.π f i) := by
    dsimp [e, q]
    simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc,
      ModuleCat.piIsoPi_hom_ker_subtype, PreservesProduct.iso_hom,
      piComparison_comp_π]
  change q (e.hom (degreePieceChartTuple k n d p)) = q (e.hom x)
  change (e.hom ≫ q) (degreePieceChartTuple k n d p) =
    (e.hom ≫ q) x
  rw [hc]
  change (Pi.π (fun j : Fin (n + 1) ↦
      pushedUnit (space k n) (coordinateOpen k n j)) i).app ⊤
        (degreePieceChartTuple k n d p) =
    (Pi.π (fun j : Fin (n + 1) ↦
      pushedUnit (space k n) (coordinateOpen k n j)) i).app ⊤ x
  rw [degreePieceChartTuple_component,
    ← coordinateCechTopCochainChart_encode k n x i]
  unfold degreePiecePushedChartSection degreePieceChartRegularSection
  rw [h i]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.degreePieceCechKernelMap_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degreePieceCechKernelMap_val (d : ℕ) (p : degreePiece k n d) :

proof:

    projectiveTwistingGlobalSectionsCechKernelEquiv_apply_val,

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.degreePieceCechKernelMap_surjective
statement:
theorem degreePieceCechKernelMap_surjective (d : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (degreePieceCechKernelMap k n d)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := exists_degreePiece_of_coordinateChart_compatible k n d
    (fun i ↦ coordinateCechTopCochainChart k n z.1 i)
    (fun i j ↦ coordinateCechKernel_chart_compatibility k n d z i j)
  refine ⟨p, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
  rw [degreePieceCechKernelMap_val]
  exact degreePieceChartTuple_eq_of_decoded_charts k n d p z.1 hp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.degreePieceCechKernelMap_injective
statement:

proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpq
  apply degreePieceGlobalSection_injective k n d
  apply (projectiveTwistingGlobalSectionsCechKernelEquiv k n (d : ℤ)).injective
  exact hpq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.a4_originalLocalSection_comp
statement:
theorem a4_originalLocalSection_comp (i : C.I) (k : C.basisIndex i)
    (m : E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) :
    letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i)
proof:
:= C.basisIndex_finite i
    a4OriginalLocalSection C i k m ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
        (linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i k)).ι).map
        (C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 i).hom =
    tautChartLocalSection Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i) k m := by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  unfold a4OriginalLocalSection tautChartLocalSection
  rw [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp]
  exact congrArg (fun g => tautChart_restrictOne Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))
      (linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i k)) ≫
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
      (linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i k)).ι).map g)
    (by erw [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id]; exact Category.comp_id _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.a4_originalLocalSection_evaluationIdeal
statement:
theorem a4_originalLocalSection_evaluationIdeal (i : C.I) (k : C.basisIndex i)
    (m : E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) :
    letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i)
proof:
:= C.basisIndex_finite i
    sectionEvaluationIdeal
        (R := (linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i k)).toScheme.presheaf.obj
          (op ⊤))
        ((a4OriginalLocalSection C i k m).app ⊤
          (1 : (linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i k)).toScheme.presheaf.obj
            (op ⊤))) =
      Ideal.span {tautChartLocalFrameCoefficient Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))
        (C.sectionBasis i) k m} := by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  let eρ : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i k)).ι).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι i)).obj (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))).val.obj
          (op ⊤) ≃ₗ[(linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i k)).toScheme.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)]
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i k)).ι).obj
        (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i) 1)).val.obj
          (op ⊤) :=
    ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i k)).toScheme.ringCatSheaf (op ⊤)).mapIso
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i k)).ι).mapIso
        (C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 i))).toLinearEquiv
  have h1 := sectionEvaluationIdeal_linearEquiv eρ ((a4OriginalLocalSection C i k m).app ⊤
          (1 : (linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i k)).toScheme.presheaf.obj
            (op ⊤)))
  have h2 : eρ ((a4OriginalLocalSection C i k m).app ⊤
          (1 : (linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i k)).toScheme.presheaf.obj
            (op ⊤))) =
      (tautChartLocalSection Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i) k m).app ⊤
        (1 : (linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i k)).toScheme.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) :=
    congrArg (fun f => f.app ⊤ (1 : (linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i k)).toScheme.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)))
      (a4_originalLocalSection_comp C i k m)
  exact (h1.symm.trans (congrArg (fun x => sectionEvaluationIdeal (R := _) x) h2)).trans
    (tautChart_localFrame_evaluationIdeal _ _ _ k m)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.a4_originalLocalSection_evaluationIdeal_self
statement:
theorem a4_originalLocalSection_evaluationIdeal_self (i : C.I) (k : C.basisIndex i) :
    letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i)
proof:
:= C.basisIndex_finite i
    sectionEvaluationIdeal
        (R := (linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i k)).toScheme.presheaf.obj
          (op ⊤))
        ((a4OriginalLocalSection C i k (C.sectionBasis i k)).app ⊤
          (1 : (linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i k)).toScheme.presheaf.obj
            (op ⊤))) = ⊤ := by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  exact (a4_originalLocalSection_evaluationIdeal C i k (C.sectionBasis i k)).trans
    ((congrArg (fun x => Ideal.span {x})
      (tautChart_localFrameCoefficient_self _ _ _ k)).trans Ideal.span_singleton_one)
