name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionTensorCotangentMap_eq_basisEquiv
statement:
theorem cosectionTensorCotangentMap_eq_basisEquiv {n : ℕ} (b : Module.Basis (Fin n) R M)
    (s : M →ₗ[R] R)
    (h : RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular R (List.ofFn (fun i => s (b i)))) :
    cosectionTensorCotangentMap s =
      ((b.baseChange (R ⧸ cosectionImageIdeal s)).repr.trans
        (cosectionRegularGenerators b s h).toQuasiregular.conormalBasis.repr.symm).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  apply (b.baseChange (R ⧸ cosectionImageIdeal s)).ext
  intro i
  let B := b.baseChange (R ⧸ cosectionImageIdeal s)
  let C := (cosectionRegularGenerators b s h).toQuasiregular.conormalBasis
  change cosectionTensorCotangentMap s (B i) = C.repr.symm (B.repr (B i))
  rw [B.repr_self]
  change cosectionTensorCotangentMap s (B i) = C i
  exact cosectionTensorCotangentMap_basis b s h i

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionTensorCotangentMap_bijective
statement:
theorem cosectionTensorCotangentMap_bijective {n : ℕ} (b : Module.Basis (Fin n) R M)
    (s : M →ₗ[R] R)
    (h : RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular R (List.ofFn (fun i => s (b i)))) :
    Function.Bijective (cosectionTensorCotangentMap s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cosectionTensorCotangentMap_eq_basisEquiv b s h]
  exact ((b.baseChange (R ⧸ cosectionImageIdeal s)).repr.trans
    (cosectionRegularGenerators b s h).toQuasiregular.conormalBasis.repr.symm).bijective

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F21.exists_nat_smul_eq_one_tmul
statement:
theorem exists_nat_smul_eq_one_tmul {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] (x : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] M) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, N ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ a : M, (N : ℚ) • x = (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] a
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => exact ⟨1, one_ne_zero, 0, by simp⟩
  | tmul q m =>
    refine ⟨q.den, q.den_nz, q.num • m, ?_⟩
    rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', TensorProduct.tmul_smul]
    rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm, Rat.mul_den_eq_num, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
    simp
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨N1, h1, a1, e1⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨N2, h2, a2, e2⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨N1 * N2, mul_ne_zero h1 h2, N2 • a1 + N1 • a2, ?_⟩
    have : ((N1 * N2 : ℕ) : ℚ) • (x + y) =
        (N2 : ℚ) • ((N1 : ℚ) • x) + (N1 : ℚ) • ((N2 : ℚ) • y) := by
      rw [smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul]; push_cast; rw [mul_comm (N2 : ℚ) (N1 : ℚ)]
    rw [this, e1, e2]
    simp [TensorProduct.tmul_add, TensorProduct.tmul_smul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F21.exists_nat_smul_eq_zero_of_tmul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_nat_smul_eq_zero_of_tmul_eq_zero {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] (a : M)
    (h : (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] a = 0) : ∃ N : ℕ, N ≠ 0 ∧ (N : ℤ) • a = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := (IsLocalizedModule.eq_zero_iff (nonZeroDivisors ℤ)
    (TensorProduct.mk ℤ ℚ M 1) (m := a)).mp (by simpa using h)
  obtain ⟨⟨s, hs⟩, hsa⟩ := this
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hs
  refine ⟨s.natAbs, Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr hs0, ?_⟩
  rcases Int.natAbs_eq s with h' | h'
  · have : (s.natAbs : ℤ) = s := by omega
    rw [this]; simpa using hsa
  · have : (s.natAbs : ℤ) = -s := by omega
    rw [this, neg_smul, neg_eq_zero]; simpa using hsa

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F21.totalPull_ll
statement:
theorem totalPull_ll (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat f] (d : ℕ) (hd : PureRelDim f d)
    (n : ℕ) (a : RationalDimChow Y n) :
    totalPull ops f d hd (ll Y n a) = ll X (n + d) (ops.pull f d hd n a)
proof:
:= by
  simp [totalPull, ll]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F21.totalPush_ll
statement:
theorem totalPush_ll (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsProper f] (n : ℕ)
    (a : RationalDimChow X n) :
    totalPush ops f (ll X n a) = ll Y n (ops.push f n a)
proof:
:= by
  simp [totalPush, ll]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F21.totalCap_ll_succ
statement:
theorem totalCap_ll_succ (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (m : ℕ)
    (a : RationalDimChow X (m + 1)) :
    totalCap ops L hL (ll X (m + 1) a) = ll X m (ops.cap L hL m a)
proof:
:= by
  simp [totalCap, capComponent, ll]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F21.totalCap_ll_zero
statement:
theorem totalCap_ll_zero (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (a : RationalDimChow X 0) : totalCap ops L hL (ll X 0 a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [totalCap, capComponent, ll]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F21.totalPull_congr
statement:
theorem totalPull_congr {f f' : X ⟶ Y} [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [f'.IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat f] [Flat f']
    {d d' : ℕ} (hd : PureRelDim f d) (hd' : PureRelDim f' d') (h : f = f') (h2 : d = d') :
    totalPull ops f d hd = totalPull ops f' d' hd'
proof:
:= by
  subst h; subst h2; rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F21.cap_pow_ll_homog
statement:
theorem cap_pow_ll_homog (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (t : ℕ) :
    ∀ (d : ℕ) (a : RationalDimChow X d), ∃ (d' : ℕ) (b : RationalDimChow X d'),
      ((totalCap ops L hL) ^ t) (ll X d a) = ll X d' b
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => intro d a; exact ⟨d, a, by simp⟩
  | succ t ih =>
    intro d a
    have hs : ((totalCap ops L hL) ^ (t + 1)) (ll X d a) =
        ((totalCap ops L hL) ^ t) (totalCap ops L hL (ll X d a)) := by
      rw [pow_succ]; rfl
    rw [hs]
    cases d with
    | zero =>
      rw [totalCap_ll_zero]
      exact ⟨0, 0, by simp⟩
    | succ m =>
      rw [totalCap_ll_succ]
      exact ih m _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F21.genSpan_homog
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem g hg =>
    obtain ⟨i, hi, n, a, rfl⟩ := hg
    rw [totalPull_ll] at *
    obtain ⟨d', b, hb⟩ := cap_pow_ll_homog ops L hL i (n + e) (ops.pull π e hπ n a)
    rw [hb]
    by_cases hm : m = d'
    · subst hm
      have : (ll P m b) m = b := by simp [ll, DirectSum.lof_eq_of]
      rw [this, ← hb]
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, hi, n, a, by rw [totalPull_ll]⟩
    · have : (ll P d' b) m = 0 := by
        simp only [ll, DirectSum.lof_eq_of]
        exact DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (Ne.symm (by exact fun h => hm h.symm))
      rw [this]; simp
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
    have : ll P m ((x + y) m) = ll P m (x m) + ll P m (y m) := by simp
    rw [this]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  | smul r x _ hx =>
    have : ll P m ((r • x) m) = r • ll P m (x m) := by
      rw [DirectSum.smul_apply]; exact map_smul _ _ _
    rw [this]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F21.ratHom_apply
statement:
theorem ratHom_apply (m : ℕ) (D : dimensionCycles X m) :
    ratHom X m D = ll X m ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X m))
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F21.mem_cycSub
statement:
theorem mem_cycSub {G : Submodule ℚ (TotalChow X)} {m : ℕ} {C : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ} :
    C ∈ cycSub G m ↔ ∃ h : C ∈ dimensionCycles X m, ratHom X m ⟨C, h⟩ ∈ G
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨D', hD', rfl⟩
    exact ⟨D'.2, hD'⟩
  · rintro ⟨h, hD⟩
    exact ⟨⟨C, h⟩, hD, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F21.ll_mem_of_cycle_gen
statement:
theorem ll_mem_of_cycle_gen (G : Submodule ℚ (TotalChow X)) (m : ℕ)
    (hcyc : ∀ D ∈ dimensionCycles X m, ∃ N : ℕ, N ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ C ∈ cycSub G m,
      (N : ℤ) • D - C ∈ F8.relC X m) (x : RationalDimChow X m) : ll X m x ∈ G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N0, h0, a, ha⟩ := exists_nat_smul_eq_one_tmul x
  obtain ⟨D, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective a
  obtain ⟨N, hN, C, hC, hrel⟩ := hcyc D.1 D.2
  obtain ⟨hCd, hCG⟩ := mem_cycSub.mp hC
  obtain ⟨hd, hrel'⟩ := F8.mem_relC.mp hrel
  have hz : ratHom X m ⟨(N : ℤ) • D.1 - C, hd⟩ = 0 := by
    rw [ratHom_apply, (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff _).mpr hrel']
    simp
  have e1 : (⟨(N : ℤ) • D.1 - C, hd⟩ : dimensionCycles X m) = (N : ℤ) • D - ⟨C, hCd⟩ := rfl
  rw [e1, map_sub, map_zsmul, sub_eq_zero] at hz
  have hz' : (N : ℚ) • ratHom X m D ∈ G := by
    have : (N : ℚ) • ratHom X m D = (N : ℤ) • ratHom X m D := by
      rw [← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul ℚ]; simp
    rw [this, hz]; exact hCG
  have hD : ratHom X m D = (N0 : ℚ) • ll X m x := by
    rw [ratHom_apply, ← map_smul, ha]
  rw [hD, smul_smul] at hz'
  have hne : ((N : ℚ) * (N0 : ℚ)) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast hN) (by exact_mod_cast h0)
  have := G.smul_mem (((N : ℚ) * (N0 : ℚ))⁻¹) hz'
  rwa [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hne, one_smul] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F21.pull_total_surj
statement:
theorem pull_total_surj (j : V ⟶ U) [j.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsOpenImmersion j] :
    Function.Surjective (totalPull ops j 0 (pureRelDim_openImmersion k j))
proof:
:= by
  intro b
  induction b using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, map_zero _⟩
  | of n a =>
    obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := F4.pull_openImmersion_surjective ops j n a
    refine ⟨ll U n a', ?_⟩
    rw [totalPull_ll, ha']
    rfl
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨x', rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨y', rfl⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨x' + y', map_add _ _ _⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F21.cap_pull_pow
statement:
theorem cap_pull_pow {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [Y.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y] (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat f] (d : ℕ)
    (hd : PureRelDim f d) (L : Y.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1) (i : ℕ)
    (v : TotalChow Y) :
    totalPull ops f d hd (((totalCap ops L hL) ^ i) v) =
      ((totalCap ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL)) ^ i) (totalPull ops f d hd v)
proof:
:= by
  induction i generalizing v with
  | zero => simp
  | succ i ih =>
    have h1 : ((totalCap ops L hL) ^ (i + 1)) v = ((totalCap ops L hL) ^ i) (totalCap ops L hL v) := by
      rw [pow_succ]; rfl
    have h2 : ((totalCap ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL)) ^ (i + 1)) (totalPull ops f d hd v) =
        ((totalCap ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL)) ^ i)
          (totalCap ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
            (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) (totalPull ops f d hd v)) := by
      rw [pow_succ]; rfl
    rw [h1, h2, ih]
    have := LinearMap.congr_fun (cp.cap_pull f d hd L hL) v
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at this
    rw [this]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F21.cap_push_pow
statement:
theorem cap_push_pow {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [Y.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y] (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsProper f]
    (L : Y.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1) (i : ℕ) (v : TotalChow X) :
    totalPush ops f (((totalCap ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL)) ^ i) v) =
      ((totalCap ops L hL) ^ i) (totalPush ops f v)
proof:
:= by
  induction i generalizing v with
  | zero => simp
  | succ i ih =>
    have h1 : ((totalCap ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL)) ^ (i + 1)) v =
        ((totalCap ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL)) ^ i)
          (totalCap ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
            (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) v) := by
      rw [pow_succ]; rfl
    have h2 : ((totalCap ops L hL) ^ (i + 1)) (totalPush ops f v) =
        ((totalCap ops L hL) ^ i) (totalCap ops L hL (totalPush ops f v)) := by
      rw [pow_succ]; rfl
    rw [h1, h2, ih]
    have := LinearMap.congr_fun (cp.cap_push f L hL) v
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at this
    rw [this]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F21.cap_pow_pull_mem
statement:
theorem cap_pow_pull_mem (π : P ⟶ U) [π.IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat π] {e : ℕ} (hπ : PureRelDim π e)
    (L : P.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank P L 1) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ e) (b : TotalChow U) :
    ((totalCap ops L hL) ^ i) (totalPull ops π e hπ b) ∈ genSpan ops π hπ L hL
proof:
:= by
  induction b using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of n a => exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, hi, n, a, rfl⟩
  | add x y hx hy =>
    rw [map_add, map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F21.genSpan_le_map_open
statement:
theorem genSpan_le_map_open (j : V ⟶ U) [j.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (π : P ⟶ U) [π.IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat π] (πV : Q ⟶ V) [πV.IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat πV]
    (jh : Q ⟶ P) [jh.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsOpenImmersion jh] (hw : jh ≫ π = πV ≫ j) {e : ℕ}
    (hπ : PureRelDim π e) (hV : PureRelDim πV e) (L : P.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank P L 1) :
    genSpan ops πV hV ((Scheme.Modules.pullback jh).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback Q jh L 1 hL) ≤
      (genSpan ops π hπ L hL).map (totalPull ops jh 0 (pureRelDim_openImmersion k jh))
proof:
:= by
  rw [genSpan, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro g ⟨i, hi, n, a, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := pull_total_surj ops j (ll V n a)
  refine ⟨((totalCap ops L hL) ^ i) (totalPull ops π e hπ b),
    cap_pow_pull_mem ops π hπ L hL i hi b, ?_⟩
  have c1 := cp.pull_comp jh π 0 e (pureRelDim_openImmersion k jh) hπ
    ((pureRelDim_openImmersion k jh).comp hπ)
  have c2 := cp.pull_comp πV j e 0 hV (pureRelDim_openImmersion k j)
    (hV.comp (pureRelDim_openImmersion k j))
  have c3 := totalPull_congr ops ((pureRelDim_openImmersion k jh).comp hπ)
    (hV.comp (pureRelDim_openImmersion k j)) hw (by omega)
  have key : totalPull ops jh 0 (pureRelDim_openImmersion k jh) (totalPull ops π e hπ b) =
      totalPull ops πV e hV (totalPull ops j 0 (pureRelDim_openImmersion k j) b) := by
    have e1 := LinearMap.congr_fun c1 b
    have e2 := LinearMap.congr_fun c2 b
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at e1 e2
    rw [← e1, ← e2, c3]
  show totalPull ops jh 0 (pureRelDim_openImmersion k jh) _ = _
  rw [cap_pull_pow ops cp jh 0 (pureRelDim_openImmersion k jh) L hL i, key, hb]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F21.map_push_genSpan_le
statement:
theorem map_push_genSpan_le (i : Z ⟶ U) [i.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (π : P ⟶ U) [π.IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat π] (πZ : R ⟶ Z) [πZ.IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat πZ]
    (ih : R ⟶ P) [ih.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsClosedImmersion ih] (hsq : IsPullback ih πZ π i)
    {e : ℕ} (hπ : PureRelDim π e) (hZ : PureRelDim πZ e) (L : P.Modules)
    (hL : HasConstantRank P L 1) :
    (genSpan ops πZ hZ ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ih).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback R ih L 1 hL)).map (totalPush ops ih) ≤
      genSpan ops π hπ L hL
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap, genSpan, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro g ⟨t, ht, n, a, rfl⟩
  simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_comap]
  rw [cap_push_pow ops cp ih L hL t]
  have bc := cp.base_change i π ih πZ e hπ hZ hsq.flip
  have e1 := LinearMap.congr_fun bc (ll Z n a)
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at e1
  rw [← e1, totalPush_ll]
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨t, ht, n, _, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F21.totalPull_component
statement:
theorem totalPull_component {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [Y.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y] (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat f] (d : ℕ)
    (hd : PureRelDim f d) (y : TotalChow Y) (n : ℕ) :
    (totalPull ops f d hd y) (n + d) = ops.pull f d hd n (y n)
proof:
:= by
  induction y using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of n0 a =>
    have e1 : totalPull ops f d hd (DirectSum.of (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow Y n) n0 a) =
        DirectSum.of (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) (n0 + d) (ops.pull f d hd n0 a) :=
      totalPull_ll ops f d hd n0 a
    rw [e1]
    by_cases h : n0 = n
    · subst h
      rw [DirectSum.of_eq_same, DirectSum.of_eq_same]
    · have h0 : (DirectSum.of (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow Y n) n0 a) n = 0 :=
        DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (fun e => h e.symm)
      rw [DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne _ _ _ (by omega), h0, map_zero]
  | add x y hx hy => simp [hx, hy]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F21.ll_apply_same
statement: theorem ll_apply_same {X : Scheme.{u}} (m : ℕ) (c : RationalDimChow X m) : (ll X m c) m = c
proof:
:= by
  simp [ll, DirectSum.lof_eq_of]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F21.range_fst_of_isPullback
statement:
theorem range_fst_of_isPullback {T X Y S : Scheme.{u}} {fst : T ⟶ X} {snd : T ⟶ Y} {f : X ⟶ S}
    {g : Y ⟶ S} (h : IsPullback fst snd f g) : Set.range fst = f ⁻¹' Set.range g
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h.isoPullback_hom_fst, m6pb_range_iso_comp, Scheme.Pullback.range_fst]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F21.genAll_glue
statement:
theorem genAll_glue (j : V ⟶ U) [j.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (i : Z ⟶ U) [i.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hrange : Set.range i = (Set.range j)ᶜ)
    (π : P ⟶ U) [π.IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat π] (πV : Q ⟶ V) [πV.IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat πV]
    (πZ : R ⟶ Z) [πZ.IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat πZ]
    (jh : Q ⟶ P) [jh.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsOpenImmersion jh]
    (ih : R ⟶ P) [ih.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsClosedImmersion ih]
    (hsqV : IsPullback jh πV π j) (hsqZ : IsPullback ih πZ π i)
    {e : ℕ} (hπ : PureRelDim π e) (hV : PureRelDim πV e) (hZ : PureRelDim πZ e)
    (L : P.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank P L 1)
    (hGV : GenAll ops πV hV ((Scheme.Modules.pullback jh).obj L)
      (hasConstantRank_pullback Q jh L 1 hL))
    (hGZ : GenAll ops πZ hZ ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ih).obj L)
      (hasConstantRank_pullback R ih L 1 hL)) :
    GenAll ops π hπ L hL
proof:
:= by
  intro m x
  refine ll_mem_of_cycle_gen (genSpan ops π hπ L hL) m ?_ x
  intro D hD
  have hrangeP : Set.range ih = (Set.range jh)ᶜ := by
    rw [range_fst_of_isPullback hsqZ, range_fst_of_isPullback hsqV, hrange, Set.preimage_compl]
  have hj0 := pureRelDim_openImmersion k jh
  have hW : ∀ D' ∈ dimensionCycles Q m, ∃ N : ℕ, N ≠ 0 ∧
      ∃ C ∈ cycSub (genSpan ops π hπ L hL) m, C ∈ dimensionCycles P m ∧
        (N : ℤ) • D' - flatPullback jh C ∈ F8.relC Q m := by
    intro D' hD'
    have h1 := hGV m ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk ⟨D', hD'⟩ : DimChow Q m))
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyeq⟩ := genSpan_le_map_open ops cp j π πV jh hsqV.w hπ hV L hL h1
    have hx := genSpan_homog ops π hπ L hL hy m
    have hpx : ops.pull jh 0 hj0 m (y m) =
        (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk ⟨D', hD'⟩ : DimChow Q m) := by
      have := totalPull_component ops jh 0 hj0 y m
      rw [hyeq] at this
      exact ((ll_apply_same m _).symm.trans this).symm
    obtain ⟨N0, h0, a, ha⟩ := exists_nat_smul_eq_one_tmul (y m)
    obtain ⟨D0, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective a
    have hD0G : ratHom P m D0 ∈ genSpan ops π hπ L hL := by
      rw [ratHom_apply, ← ha, map_smul]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx
    have hfp : flatPullback jh D0.1 ∈ dimensionCycles Q m := flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles jh hj0 D0.2
    have hΔd : (N0 : ℤ) • D' - flatPullback jh D0.1 ∈ dimensionCycles Q m :=
      sub_mem (zsmul_mem hD' _) hfp
    have hpk := ops.pull_mk jh 0 hj0 m D0 ⟨flatPullback jh D0.1, hfp⟩ (fun x ↦ rfl)
    have hz : (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk ⟨(N0 : ℤ) • D' - flatPullback jh D0.1, hΔd⟩ :
        DimChow Q m) = 0 := by
      have e1 : (⟨(N0 : ℤ) • D' - flatPullback jh D0.1, hΔd⟩ : dimensionCycles Q m) =
          (N0 : ℤ) • (⟨D', hD'⟩ : dimensionCycles Q m) - ⟨flatPullback jh D0.1, hfp⟩ := rfl
      have hpk' : ops.pull jh 0 hj0 m ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D0 : DimChow P m)) =
          (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk ⟨flatPullback jh D0.1, hfp⟩ : DimChow Q m) := hpk
      rw [e1, QuotientAddGroup.mk_sub, QuotientAddGroup.mk_zsmul, TensorProduct.tmul_sub,
        TensorProduct.tmul_smul, ← hpk', ← ha, map_smul, hpx, sub_eq_zero,
        ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul ℚ]
      simp
    obtain ⟨M, hM, hMz⟩ := exists_nat_smul_eq_zero_of_tmul_eq_zero _ hz
    have hMr : (M : ℤ) • ((N0 : ℤ) • D' - flatPullback jh D0.1) ∈ F8.relC Q m := by
      refine F8.mem_relC.mpr ⟨zsmul_mem hΔd _, ?_⟩
      have : (⟨(M : ℤ) • ((N0 : ℤ) • D' - flatPullback jh D0.1), zsmul_mem hΔd _⟩ :
          dimensionCycles Q m) = (M : ℤ) • ⟨(N0 : ℤ) • D' - flatPullback jh D0.1, hΔd⟩ := rfl
      rw [this, ← QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff]
      rw [QuotientAddGroup.mk_zsmul]
      exact hMz
    refine ⟨M * N0, mul_ne_zero hM h0, (M : ℤ) • D0.1, ?_, zsmul_mem D0.2 _, ?_⟩
    · exact zsmul_mem (mem_cycSub.mpr ⟨D0.2, hD0G⟩) _
    · have h3 := map_zsmul (flatPullbackHom jh) (M : ℤ) D0.1
      change flatPullback jh ((M : ℤ) • D0.1) = (M : ℤ) • flatPullback jh D0.1 at h3
      have e : (((M * N0 : ℕ) : ℤ) • D' - flatPullback jh ((M : ℤ) • D0.1)) =
          (M : ℤ) • ((N0 : ℤ) • D' - flatPullback jh D0.1) := by
        rw [h3, smul_sub, Nat.cast_mul, mul_smul]
      rw [e]; exact hMr
  have hZ' : ∀ B ∈ dimensionCycles R m, ∃ N : ℕ, N ≠ 0 ∧
      ∃ C ∈ cycSub (genSpan ops π hπ L hL) m, C ∈ dimensionCycles P m ∧
        (N : ℤ) • properPushforward ih B - C ∈ F8.relC P m := by
    intro B hB
    have hC : properPushforward ih B ∈ dimensionCycles P m :=
      properPushforward_mem_dimensionCycles ih (heightCompatible_of_finiteType k ih) hB
    refine ⟨1, one_ne_zero, properPushforward ih B, mem_cycSub.mpr ⟨hC, ?_⟩, hC, ?_⟩
    · have hpk := ops.push_mk ih m ⟨B, hB⟩ ⟨properPushforward ih B, hC⟩ rfl
      rw [ratHom_apply, ← hpk, ← totalPush_ll]
      refine map_push_genSpan_le ops cp i π πZ ih hsqZ hπ hZ L hL ?_
      exact ⟨_, hGZ m _, rfl⟩
    · rw [Nat.cast_one, one_smul, sub_self]; exact zero_mem _
  obtain ⟨N, hN, C, hC, _, hr⟩ := F13.exists_mem_of_open_closed k jh ih hrangeP
    (cycSub (genSpan ops π hπ L hL) m) hW hZ' D hD
  exact ⟨N, hN, C, hC, hr⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F21.ratHom_flatPullback
statement:
theorem ratHom_flatPullback {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [Y.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y] (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat f] {d : ℕ}
    (hd : PureRelDim f d) {n : ℕ} (A : AlgebraicCycle Y ℤ) (hA : A ∈ dimensionCycles Y n)
    (hfp : flatPullback f A ∈ dimensionCycles X (n + d)) :
    ratHom X (n + d) ⟨flatPullback f A, hfp⟩ = totalPull ops f d hd (ratHom Y n ⟨A, hA⟩)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ratHom_apply, ratHom_apply, totalPull_ll]
  have := ops.pull_mk f d hd n ⟨A, hA⟩ ⟨flatPullback f A, hfp⟩ (fun x ↦ rfl)
  rw [this]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F21.genAll_tower
statement:
theorem genAll_tower (L : ∀ e, (B.P e).Modules) (hL : ∀ e, HasConstantRank (B.P e) (L e) 1)
    (hι : ∀ e, Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (B.ι e)).obj (L (e + 1)) ≅ L e))
    (hstep : ∀ (e : ℕ) (b : TotalChow U),
      totalCap ops (L (e + 1)) (hL (e + 1))
          (totalPull ops (B.π (e + 1)) (e + 1) (IsTower.relDim (e + 1)) b) =
        totalPush ops (B.ι e) (totalPull ops (B.π e) e (IsTower.relDim e) b)) :
    ∀ e, GenAll ops (B.π e) (IsTower.relDim e) (L e) (hL e)
proof:
:= by
  have hpush : ∀ e, (genSpan ops (B.π e) (IsTower.relDim e) (L e) (hL e)).map
      (totalPush ops (B.ι e)) ≤
      genSpan ops (B.π (e + 1)) (IsTower.relDim (e + 1)) (L (e + 1)) (hL (e + 1)) := by
    intro e
    rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap, genSpan, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro g ⟨i, hi, n, a, rfl⟩
    simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_comap]
    obtain ⟨φ⟩ := hι e
    have hcap : totalCap ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (B.ι e)).obj (L (e + 1)))
        (hasConstantRank_pullback _ (B.ι e) (L (e + 1)) 1 (hL (e + 1))) =
        totalCap ops (L e) (hL e) := cp.cap_iso _ _ ⟨φ⟩
    rw [← hcap, cap_push_pow ops cp (B.ι e) (L (e + 1)) (hL (e + 1)) i,
      ← hstep e (ll U n a)]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨i + 1, by omega, n, a, by rw [pow_succ]; rfl⟩
  have hsub : ∀ e m, genSet B e m ≤
      cycSub (genSpan ops (B.π e) (IsTower.relDim e) (L e) (hL e)) m := by
    intro e
    induction e with
    | zero =>
      intro m
      rw [genSet, AddSubgroup.closure_le]
      rintro _ ⟨A, hA, rfl⟩
      have hfp := flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles (B.π 0) (IsTower.relDim 0) hA
      refine mem_cycSub.mpr ⟨hfp, ?_⟩
      show ratHom (B.P 0) (m + 0) ⟨flatPullback (B.π 0) A, hfp⟩ ∈ _
      rw [ratHom_flatPullback ops (B.π 0) (IsTower.relDim 0) A hA hfp]
      have := cap_pow_pull_mem ops (B.π 0) (IsTower.relDim 0) (L 0) (hL 0) 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
        (ratHom U m ⟨A, hA⟩)
      simpa using this
    | succ e ih =>
      intro m
      rw [genSet, AddSubgroup.closure_le]
      rintro C (⟨C0, hC0, rfl⟩ | ⟨A, hA, hle, rfl⟩)
      · obtain ⟨hd0, hr0⟩ := mem_cycSub.mp (ih m hC0)
        have hC : properPushforward (B.ι e) C0 ∈ dimensionCycles (B.P (e + 1)) m :=
          properPushforward_mem_dimensionCycles (B.ι e)
            (heightCompatible_of_finiteType k (B.ι e)) hd0
        refine mem_cycSub.mpr ⟨hC, ?_⟩
        have hpk := ops.push_mk (B.ι e) m ⟨C0, hd0⟩ ⟨properPushforward (B.ι e) C0, hC⟩ rfl
        rw [ratHom_apply, ← hpk, ← totalPush_ll, ← ratHom_apply]
        exact hpush e ⟨_, hr0, rfl⟩
      · obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, m = n + (e + 1) := ⟨m - (e + 1), by omega⟩
        have hA' : A ∈ dimensionCycles U n := by rwa [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hA
        have hfp := flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles (B.π (e + 1)) (IsTower.relDim (e + 1)) hA'
        refine mem_cycSub.mpr ⟨hfp, ?_⟩
        rw [ratHom_flatPullback ops (B.π (e + 1)) (IsTower.relDim (e + 1)) A hA' hfp]
        have := cap_pow_pull_mem ops (B.π (e + 1)) (IsTower.relDim (e + 1)) (L (e + 1))
          (hL (e + 1)) 0 (Nat.zero_le _) (ratHom U n ⟨A, hA'⟩)
        simpa using this
  intro e m x
  refine ll_mem_of_cycle_gen _ m ?_ x
  intro D hD
  obtain ⟨N, hN, C, hC, hr⟩ := generation B k e m D hD
  exact ⟨N, hN, C, hsub e m hC, hr⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F21.genAll_trivialProjective
statement:
theorem genAll_trivialProjective
    (L : ∀ e, ((F17.trivialProjective U).P e).Modules)
    (hL : ∀ e, HasConstantRank ((F17.trivialProjective U).P e) (L e) 1) :
    letI
proof:
:= F17.isTower_trivialProjective k U
    haveI : IsNoetherian U := {}
    (∀ e, Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ((F17.trivialProjective U).ι e)).obj (L (e + 1)) ≅
        L e)) →
    (∀ (e : ℕ) (b : TotalChow U),
      totalCap ops (L (e + 1)) (hL (e + 1))
          (totalPull ops ((F17.trivialProjective U).π (e + 1)) (e + 1)
            (IsTower.relDim (e + 1)) b) =
        totalPush ops ((F17.trivialProjective U).ι e)
          (totalPull ops ((F17.trivialProjective U).π e) e (IsTower.relDim e) b)) →
    ∀ e, GenAll ops ((F17.trivialProjective U).π e) (IsTower.relDim e) (L e) (hL e) := by
  letI := F17.isTower_trivialProjective k U
  haveI : IsNoetherian U := {}
  intro hι hstep
  exact genAll_tower ops cp (F17.trivialProjective U) L hL hι hstep

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D39.wFrameSec_add
statement:
theorem wFrameSec_add (d : WFrame M x) (V : S.Opens) (hV : V ≤ d.U) (c c' : Γ(S, V)) :
    wFrameSec d V hV (c + c') = wFrameSec d V hV c + wFrameSec d V hV c'
proof:
:= by
  unfold wFrameSec
  have h1 := ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op V)).hom.map_add
    c c'
  have h2 := (d.globalFrame.hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV)))).hom.map_add
    ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op V) c)
    ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op V) c')
  exact (congrArg (d.globalFrame.hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV)))) h1).trans h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D39.wFrameSec_injective
statement:
theorem wFrameSec_injective (d : WFrame M x) (V : S.Opens) (hV : V ≤ d.U) :
    Function.Injective (wFrameSec d V hV)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  unfold wFrameSec at hab
  have h1 := congrArg (d.globalFrame.inv.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV)))) hab
  have hi : ∀ m, d.globalFrame.inv.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV)))
      (d.globalFrame.hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV))) m) = m := fun m ↦
    congrArg (fun ψ ↦ ψ.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV))) m) d.globalFrame.hom_inv_id
  rw [hi, hi] at h1
  have h2 := congrArg ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)).hom.val.app (op V))
    h1
  have hj : ∀ c : Γ(S, V), (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)).hom.val.app
      (op V) ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op V) c) = c :=
    fun c ↦ C1Cap.iso_hom_inv_app (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)) V c
  rwa [hj, hj] at h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D39.wFrameSec_restrict
statement:
theorem wFrameSec_restrict (d : WFrame M x) (V W : S.Opens) (hV : V ≤ d.U)
    (hWV : W ≤ V) (c : Γ(S, V)) :
    wFrameSec d W (hWV.trans hV) (S.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op c) =
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op (wFrameSec d V hV c)
proof:
:= by
  unfold wFrameSec
  have hn := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (d.globalFrame.hom.val.naturality
    (Over.homMk (homOfLE hWV) :
      Over.mk (homOfLE (hWV.trans hV)) ⟶ Over.mk (homOfLE hV)).op)
    ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op V) c)
  refine Eq.trans (congrArg (fun z ↦ (d.globalFrame.hom.val.app
    (op (Over.mk (homOfLE (hWV.trans hV))))) z) ?_) hn
  exact C1Cap.app_presheaf_map (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)).inv
    (homOfLE hWV) c

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D39.notMem_stalkPrime_of_pullback_ne_zero
statement:
theorem notMem_stalkPrime_of_pullback_ne_zero (a : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (x : X)
    (z : pointClosureScheme x) (h : a.pullback (pointClosureι x) z ≠ 0) :
    a (pointClosureι x z) ∉
      Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι x z)
proof:
:= by
  intro h'
  rw [← C1Cap.ker_stalkMap_pointClosureι, RingHom.mem_ker] at h'
  exact h h'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D39.isProperForD_closureW
statement:
theorem isProperForD_closureW {L : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (s : Γ(L, ⊤))
    (n : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = n + 1) (hη : IsUnit (eqOfSection L hL s v)) :
    IsProperForD (D18.closureGen (k := k) n v hv) (eqOfSection L hL s)
proof:
:= by
  have hgv : pointClosureι v (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v)) = v := by
    rw [← C1Cap.pointClosureGenericPoint_eq_genericPoint, pointClosureι_genericPoint]
  refine isProperForD_of_pullbackFrames (D18.closureGen (k := k) n v hv) (eqOfSection L hL s)
    (fun y ↦ pullbackWFrame (pointClosureι v) (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι v y)) y
      (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι v y)).mem)
    (wPullbackSection (pointClosureι v) s) (eqOfSection_pullback (pointClosureι v) s)
    ((D14.pullback_isUnit_iff (D18.closureGen (k := k) n v hv) _).mpr (by
      change IsUnit (eqOfSection L hL s (pointClosureι v (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v))))
      rw [hgv]; exact hη))
    (fun w _ hw ↦ absurd ⟨1, isUnit_one, map_one _⟩ hw)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D39.repCapW_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem repCapW_of_isUnit {L : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (s : Γ(L, ⊤)) (n : ℕ)
    (w : X) (hw : IsUnit (eqOfSection L hL s w)) :
    D18.RepCap (k := k) L hL n (eqOfSection L hL s) w
proof:
:= by
  intro hh
  have hP := isProperForD_closureW (k := k) hL s n w hh hw
  obtain ⟨bp, b, c₀, hc⟩ :=
    (closureFramesOfNonvanishing (hL := hL) w s (fun z ↦ hP.ne_zero z)).frameCompare
  let G : DimRelationGenerator X n :=
    ⟨pointClosureScheme w, pointClosureι w, c₀, hc.1,
      fun y hy ↦ D5.height_pointClosure_of_coheight_one (k := k) n w hh y hy⟩
  refine ⟨D5.primeCycleOfFrame (k := k) L hL n w hh b + G.cycle, ?_, fun y ↦ ?_⟩
  · have hG : (QuotientAddGroup.mk G.cycle : DimChow X n) = 0 :=
      (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff _).mpr (AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨G, rfl⟩)
    rw [D5.primeCap_eq (k := k) L hL n w hh b, QuotientAddGroup.mk_add, hG, add_zero]
  · have := D10.coeff_eq_of_frameCompare (k := k) L hL w (eqOfSection L hL s) (fun _ ↦ 1) b c₀
      hc y
    rw [D8.c1CapPrimeCoeff_one, sub_zero] at this
    exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D39.repW_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem repW_of_isUnit {L : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (s : Γ(L, ⊤)) (n : ℕ)
    (w : X) (hh : height w = n + 1) (hw : IsUnit (eqOfSection L hL s w)) :
    D20.Rep (k := k) L hL n w (eqOfSection L hL s)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, h1, h2⟩ := repCapW_of_isUnit (k := k) hL s n w hw hh
  refine ⟨R, ?_, h2⟩
  rw [D5.primeCapOrZero, dif_pos hh]
  exact h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D39.exists_of_coeff_ne_zeroW
statement:
theorem exists_of_coeff_ne_zeroW (b : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (v w : X)
    (h : C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff b v w ≠ 0) :
    ∃ x : pointClosureScheme v, pointClosureι v x = w ∧ coheight x = 1 ∧
      b.pullback (pointClosureι v) x ∈
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalk x)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : v ⤳ w := by
    by_contra hh
    exact h (C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_not_specializes b hh)
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := C1Cap.exists_pointClosureι_eq hs
  rw [D18.c1CapPrimeCoeff_pointClosureι_eq] at h
  unfold D18.cbW at h
  by_cases hx : coheight x = 1
  · rw [if_pos hx] at h
    refine ⟨x, rfl, hx, ?_⟩
    by_contra hnm
    apply h
    have hu : IsUnit (b.pullback (pointClosureι v) x) := IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal.mp hnm
    rw [Ring.ord_of_isUnit hu]
    simp
  · rw [if_neg hx] at h
    exact absurd rfl h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D39.gateData'_of_wgenerated
statement:
theorem gateData'_of_wgenerated [Infinite k] {L M : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1) (hLg : WGenerated L) (hMg : WGenerated M)
    (m : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = m + 2) :
    ∃ a b : C1Cap.LocalEquations X, D20.GateData' k L M hL hM m v a b
proof:
:= by
  have hv' : height v = ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) + 1 := hv
  have hgv : pointClosureι v (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v)) = v := by
    rw [← C1Cap.pointClosureGenericPoint_eq_genericPoint, pointClosureι_genericPoint]
  let g := D18.closureGen (k := k) (m + 1) v hv
  obtain ⟨sL, hsL⟩ := exists_section_units (k := k) L hL hLg g {genericPoint g.Y}
    (Set.finite_singleton _)
  have hLv : IsUnit (eqOfSection L hL sL v) := by
    have h1 := hsL _ rfl
    rw [D14.pullback_isUnit_iff g] at h1
    rw [← hgv]
    exact h1
  have hPa : IsProperForD g (eqOfSection L hL sL) :=
    isProperForD_closureW (k := k) hL sL (m + 1) v hv hLv
  have hfin := hPa.finite
  obtain ⟨sM, hsM⟩ := exists_section_units (k := k) M hM hMg g
    ({genericPoint g.Y} ∪ {w : g.Y | coheight w = 1 ∧
      (eqOfSection L hL sL).pullback (pointClosureι v) w ∈
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalk w)})
    ((Set.finite_singleton _).union hfin)
  have hMv : IsUnit (eqOfSection M hM sM v) := by
    have h1 := hsM _ (Or.inl rfl)
    rw [D14.pullback_isUnit_iff g] at h1
    rw [← hgv]
    exact h1
  have hPb : IsProperForD g (eqOfSection M hM sM) :=
    isProperForD_closureW (k := k) hM sM (m + 1) v hv hMv
  have hU1 : ∀ x : pointClosureScheme v, coheight x = 1 →
      (eqOfSection L hL sL).pullback (pointClosureι v) x ∈
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalk x) →
      IsUnit (eqOfSection M hM sM (pointClosureι v x)) := fun x hx1 hax ↦
    (D14.pullback_isUnit_iff g x).mp (hsM x (Or.inr ⟨hx1, hax⟩))
  have hjoint : ∀ z : pointClosureScheme v, coheight z ≤ 2 →
      ∀ q : Ideal ((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalk z), q.IsPrime →
        (eqOfSection L hL sL).pullback (pointClosureι v) z ∈ q →
        (eqOfSection M hM sM).pullback (pointClosureι v) z ∈ q →
        q = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalk z) := by
    intro z hz q hq haq hbq
    by_contra hqm
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxq⟩ := Scheme.exists_specializes_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_eq z q
    subst hxq
    have hxz : x ≠ z := by
      rintro rfl
      exact hqm (SchemeLocalOrdSymmetry.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_self hx)
    have hx1 : coheight x = 1 :=
      C1Cap.coheight_eq_one_of_mem_stalkPrime hx hxz hz (hPb.ne_zero z) hbq
    have hax := (mem_maximalIdeal_iff_of_associated (hPa.associated hx)).mp haq
    have hbx := (mem_maximalIdeal_iff_of_associated (hPb.associated hx)).mp hbq
    have hbu := hU1 x hx1 hax
    exact ((IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).mp hbx) (hbu.map _)
  refine ⟨eqOfSection L hL sL, eqOfSection M hM sM, ⟨⟨hPa.ne_zero, hPb.ne_zero, hPa.associated,
    hPb.associated, hjoint⟩, repW_of_isUnit (k := k) hM sM (m + 1) v hv' hMv,
    repW_of_isUnit (k := k) hL sL (m + 1) v hv' hLv, fun w hw hne ↦ ?_, fun w hw hne ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨x, rfl, hx1, hbx⟩ := exists_of_coeff_ne_zeroW (eqOfSection M hM sM) v w hne
    apply repW_of_isUnit (k := k) hL sL m _ hw
    by_contra hna
    have hax : (eqOfSection L hL sL).pullback (pointClosureι v) x ∈
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalk x) := by
      rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff]
      intro hu
      exact hna ((D14.pullback_isUnit_iff g x).mp hu)
    have hbu := hU1 x hx1 hax
    exact ((IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).mp hbx) (hbu.map _)
  · obtain ⟨x, rfl, hx1, hax⟩ := exists_of_coeff_ne_zeroW (eqOfSection L hL sL) v w hne
    exact repW_of_isUnit (k := k) hM sM m _ hw (hU1 x hx1 hax)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D39.wGenerated_of_epi_free
statement:
theorem wGenerated_of_epi_free {X : Scheme.{u}} (I : Type u) [Fintype I] {M : X.Modules}
    (hL : HasConstantRank X M 1) (φ : FreeM X I ⟶ M) [Epi φ] : WGenerated M
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  let d : WFrame M p := (exists_wFrame hL p).some
  let m : Γ(M, d.U) := wFrameGen d
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hpV, t, ht⟩ := exists_local_preimage_of_epi φ d.U m p d.mem
  let sI : I → Γ(M, ⊤) := fun i => Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (inFree I i ≫ φ) ⊤ (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))
  choose c hc using fun i => d.exists_coord d.U le_rfl
    (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : d.U ≤ ⊤)).op (sI i))
  let a : I → Γ(X, V) := fun i => (show Γ(X, V) from Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (prFree I i) V t)
  have hdec := free_app_decomp I φ V t
  have hsum : wFrameSec d V hV (∑ i, a i * X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op (c i)) =
      wFrameSec d V hV 1 := by
    let fs : Γ(X, V) →+ Γ(M, V) := AddMonoidHom.mk' (wFrameSec d V hV) (wFrameSec_add d V hV)
    have hfs : ∀ x, wFrameSec d V hV x = fs x := fun x => rfl
    have hterm : ∀ i, wFrameSec d V hV (a i * X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op (c i)) =
        a i • M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op (sI i) := by
      intro i
      have e1 : wFrameSec d V hV (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op (c i)) =
          M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op (sI i) := by
        have l1 := wFrameSec_restrict d d.U V le_rfl hV (c i)
        rw [l1, hc i, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← M.presheaf.map_comp]
        rfl
      rw [wFrameSec_smul d V hV (a i * _), mul_smul,
        ← wFrameSec_smul d V hV (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op (c i)), e1]
    rw [hfs, map_sum]
    simp only [← hfs]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hterm i), ← hdec, ht, wFrameSec_one]
  have h1 : ∑ i, a i * X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op (c i) = 1 :=
    wFrameSec_injective d V hV hsum
  by_contra hne
  have hmem : ∀ i, X.presheaf.germ d.U p d.mem (c i) ∈
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk p) := by
    intro i
    rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal]
    exact fun hu => hne ⟨sI i, d, c i, hc i, hu⟩
  have h2 := congrArg (X.presheaf.germ V p hpV) h1
  rw [map_sum, map_one] at h2
  have h3 : (1 : X.presheaf.stalk p) ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk p) := by
    rw [← h2]
    refine Ideal.sum_mem _ (fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [map_mul, X.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE hV) p hpV (c i)]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (hmem i)
  rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal] at h3
  exact h3 isUnit_one

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D39.hasAmpleGeneratorsW_of_closedImmersion
statement:
theorem hasAmpleGeneratorsW_of_closedImmersion {k : Type u} [Field k] (N : ℕ) {X : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X]
    (j : X ⟶ space k N) [IsClosedImmersion j] (L : X.Modules)
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) : HasAmpleGeneratorsW L
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI hLfp : L.IsFinitePresentation :=
    IsFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation X hL.isFiniteLocallyFree
  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj L).IsFinitePresentation :=
    isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_isFinite j L
  obtain ⟨D, G, hG⟩ := serre_generation k N ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj L)
  letI := hG
  let B : X.Modules := twistPullbackNatW (k := k) N j D
  have hB : HasConstantRank X B 1 := hasConstantRank_twistPullbackNatW N j D
  refine ⟨B, hB, twistPullbackNatW_generated N j D, ?_⟩
  let V := projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (D : ℤ)
  let L' : X.Modules := tensorSheaf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj V) L
  have hL' : HasConstantRank X (tensorSheaf X L B) 1 := by
    have h := hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hL hB
    rwa [Nat.one_mul] at h
  let e : tensorSheaf (space k N) V ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj L) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj L' :=
    projectionFormulaIso j V (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree k N _) L
  haveI : Finite G.I := hG.finite
  letI : Fintype G.I := Fintype.ofFinite G.I
  let e1 : FreeM (space k N) G.I ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj L' := G.π ≫ e.hom
  haveI : Epi e1 := epi_comp' G.epi inferInstance
  haveI hP : Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).map e1) := inferInstance
  haveI hC := ClosedImmersionCoverF11.counit_epi j L'
  let φ : FreeM X G.I ⟶ L' :=
    (pullbackFreeIso j G.I).inv ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback j).map e1 ≫ ClosedImmersionCoverF11.counitHom j L'
  haveI : Epi (φ) := epi_comp' (inferInstance : Epi (pullbackFreeIso j G.I).inv) (epi_comp' hP hC)
  let φ' : FreeM X G.I ⟶ tensorSheaf X L B := φ ≫ (tensorSheafSymmetry X _ _).hom
  haveI : Epi φ' := epi_comp' inferInstance inferInstance
  exact wGenerated_of_epi_free G.I hL' φ'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D39.capComm_prime_of_repOnW
statement:
theorem capComm_prime_of_repOnW {L M : X.Modules} {hL : HasConstantRank X L 1}
    {hM : HasConstantRank X M 1} (m : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = m + 2)
    (a b : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (d : D20.GateData' k L M hL hM m v a b) :
    ops.cap L hL m (ops.cap M hM (m + 1) ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v (m + 2) hv) : DimChow X (m + 2)))) =
      ops.cap M hM m (ops.cap L hL (m + 1) ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v (m + 2) hv) : DimChow X (m + 2))))
proof:
:= by
  have cc : ∀ (L M : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1)
      (a b : C1Cap.LocalEquations X)
      (hMv : D20.Rep (k := k) M hM (m + 1) v b)
      (hLw : ∀ w : X, height w = m + 1 → C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff b v w ≠ 0 →
        D20.Rep (k := k) L hL m w a),
      ∃ C : dimensionCycles X m,
        ops.cap L hL m (ops.cap M hM (m + 1) ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
          (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v (m + 2) hv) : DimChow X (m + 2)))) =
          (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk C : DimChow X m) ∧
        ∀ y, C.1 y = ∑ᶠ w : X, C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff b v w * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a w y := by
    intro L M hL hM a b hMv hLw
    obtain ⟨R, hR1, hR2⟩ := hMv
    have hv' : height v = ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) + 1 := hv
    have hpc : D5.primeCap (k := k) M hM (m + 1) v hv' =
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk R : DimChow X (m + 1)) := by
      rw [← hR1]
      simp only [D5.primeCapOrZero]
      rw [dif_pos hv']
    have h1 : ops.cap M hM (m + 1) ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v (m + 2) hv) : DimChow X (m + 2))) =
        (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk R : DimChow X (m + 1)) := by
      refine (cap_prime_anchorOn ops M hM (m + 1) v hv').trans ?_
      rw [hpc]
    obtain ⟨C, hC1, hC2⟩ := D20.capCycles_eq_mk' (k := k) L hL m R a (fun w hw hne ↦
      hLw w hw (by rwa [← hR2 w]))
    refine ⟨C, ?_, fun y ↦ ?_⟩
    · rw [h1, cap_anchorOn ops L hL m R, hC1]
    · rw [hC2 y]
      unfold C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff
      simp only [hR2]
  obtain ⟨C₁, h₁, c₁⟩ := cc L M hL hM a b d.repM_v d.repL_w
  obtain ⟨C₂, h₂, c₂⟩ := cc M L hM hL b a d.repL_v d.repM_w
  rw [h₁, h₂]
  congr 2
  ext y
  rw [c₁ y, c₂ y]
  exact D18.coeff_symm_X (k := k) m v hv a b d.meets y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D39.capCommuteOn_of_hasAmpleGeneratorsW
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hBg, hAg⟩ := hLa
  obtain ⟨B', hB', hB'g, hCg⟩ := hMa
  have hA : HasConstantRank X (tensorSheaf X L B) 1 := by
    have h := hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hL hB
    rwa [Nat.one_mul] at h
  have hC : HasConstantRank X (tensorSheaf X M B') 1 := by
    have h := hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hM hB'
    rwa [Nat.one_mul] at h
  have hLe : totalCapOn ops L hL =
      totalCapOn ops (tensorSheaf X L B) hA - totalCapOn ops B hB := by
    rw [totalCapOn_tensor (ops := ops) L B hL hB hA]; abel
  have hMe : totalCapOn ops M hM =
      totalCapOn ops (tensorSheaf X M B') hC - totalCapOn ops B' hB' := by
    rw [totalCapOn_tensor (ops := ops) M B' hM hB' hC]; abel
  have g := fun {A C : X.Modules} (hA : HasConstantRank X A 1) (hC : HasConstantRank X C 1)
      (gA : WGenerated A) (gC : WGenerated C) ↦
    capCommuteOn_of_gate (ops := ops) (capCommGateOn_of_wgenerated ops (hL := hA) (hM := hC) gA gC)
  exact capCommuteOn_of_sub hLe hMe (g hA hC hAg hCg) (g hA hB' hAg hB'g)
    (g hB hC hBg hCg) (g hB hB' hBg hB'g)

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.awayMulEquivOfIsLocalization_comp_algebraMap
statement:
theorem awayMulEquivOfIsLocalization_comp_algebraMap {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (f g : R) [IsLocalization.Away f S] :
    (awayMulEquivOfIsLocalization (S := S) f g).toRingHom.comp
        (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (f * g))) =
      (algebraMap S (Localization.Away (algebraMap R S g))).comp (algebraMap R S)
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro r
  show (awayMulEquivOfIsLocalization (S := S) f g)
    (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (f * g)) r) = _
  change (IsLocalization.algEquiv (Submonoid.powers (f * g)) (Localization.Away (f * g))
      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R S g))) (algebraMap R _ r) = _
  rw [AlgEquiv.commutes]
  exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R S _ r

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.map_awayMulEquivOfIsLocalization
statement:
theorem map_awayMulEquivOfIsLocalization {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (K : Ideal R) (f g : R) [IsLocalization.Away f S] :
    (K.map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (f * g)))).map
        (awayMulEquivOfIsLocalization (S := S) f g).toRingHom =
      (K.map (algebraMap R S)).map (algebraMap S (Localization.Away (algebraMap R S g)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.map_map, Ideal.map_map, awayMulEquivOfIsLocalization_comp_algebraMap]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.a11_projection_taut
statement:
theorem a11_projection_taut (k : ι) (m : M) :
    (linearLocalFrameProjection R M b 1 k).app ⊤
      ((twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b 1).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_top : (linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ ⊤)).op
          ((tautChart_tautHom R M b m).app ⊤ (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ⊤)))) =
      (show Γ((linearOpen R M (b k)).toScheme, ⊤) from tautChart_component R M (b k) m)
proof:
:= by
  have e : (tautChart_tautHom R M b m).app ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤)
      (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤))) =
      (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b 1).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_top : (linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ ⊤)).op
          ((tautChart_tautHom R M b m).app ⊤ (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ⊤))) := by
    rw [← tautChart_app_map]
    congr 1
  rw [← e, linearLocalFrameProjection_app_eq]
  have h1 : (Pi.π (fun j ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) (linearOpen R M (b j))) k).app
      ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤)
      ((kernel.ι (linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b 1)).app
        ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤)
        ((tautChart_tautHom R M b m).app ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤)
          (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤))))) =
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) (linearOpen R M (b k))).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE le_top).op (tautChart_component R M (b k) m) := by
    exact (tautChart_app3 _ _ _ _ _).trans ((congrArg
      (fun f : SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules (space R M) ⟶
          SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) (linearOpen R M (b k)) ↦
        f.app ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤)
          (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤))))
      (tautChart_tautHom_kernel_π R M b m k)).trans
      (tautChart_unitHomEquiv_symm_sectionsOfTop_app' _ _ _))
  erw [h1]
  simp only [tautChart_component]
  change (space R M).presheaf.map _ ((space R M).presheaf.map _ ((space R M).presheaf.map _
    (tautChart_ratioSection R M (b k) m))) = (space R M).presheaf.map _
      (tautChart_ratioSection R M (b k) m)
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  congr 2

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.a11_awayToSection_injective
statement:
theorem a11_awayToSection_injective (x : M) :
    Function.Injective (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M) (linearForm R M x)).hom
proof:
:= by
  have e := Proj.basicOpenIsoAway_hom (symGrading R M) (linearForm R M x)
    (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M x) Nat.zero_lt_one
  haveI : IsIso (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M) (linearForm R M x)) := by
    rw [← e]; infer_instance
  exact (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M)
    (linearForm R M x))).1

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.a11_ratio_eq_zero_of_component
statement:
theorem a11_ratio_eq_zero_of_component (x m : M)
    (h : tautChart_component R M x m = 0) : tautChart_ratio R M x m = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply a11_awayToSection_injective R M x
  rw [map_zero]
  have h2 := congrArg ((space R M).presheaf.map
    (eqToHom (tautChart_image_preimage_top R M (linearOpen R M x)).symm).op) h
  rw [tautChart_component, ← Functor.map_comp_apply, ← op_comp, eqToHom_trans, eqToHom_refl,
    op_id, Functor.map_id_apply] at h2
  erw [map_zero] at h2
  exact h2

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.a11_ratio_repr
statement:
theorem a11_ratio_repr (k : ι) (m : M) :
    tautChart_ratio R M (b k) m = (b.repr m).sum (fun i a =>
      tautChart_scalarHom R M (b k) a * tautChart_ratio R M (b k) (b i))
proof:
:= by
  let Rt : M →+ LinearChartRing R M (b k) :=
    AddMonoidHom.mk' (tautChart_ratio R M (b k)) (tautChart_ratio_add R M (b k))
  have hm : m = (b.repr m).sum (fun i a => a • b i) := by
    rw [← Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, b.linearCombination_repr]
  have h1 : Rt m = (b.repr m).sum (fun i a => Rt (a • b i)) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hm]
    exact map_finsuppSum Rt _ _
  refine h1.trans (Finsupp.sum_congr fun i _ => ?_)
  exact tautChart_ratio_smul R M (b k) (b i) _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.a11_tautHom_injective
statement:
theorem a11_tautHom_injective (m : M)
    (h : (tautChart_tautHom R M b m).app ⊤ (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) = 0) :
    m = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hι : IsEmpty ι
  · have : b.repr m = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    simpa using this
  · obtain ⟨k⟩ := not_isEmpty_iff.mp hι
    classical
    have h1 := a11_projection_taut R M b k m
    rw [h] at h1
    erw [map_zero, map_zero] at h1
    have h3 := a11_ratio_eq_zero_of_component R M (b k) m h1.symm
    rw [a11_ratio_repr R M b k m] at h3
    have h4 := a11_ratio_independent R M b k _ h3
    exact (b.repr).map_eq_zero_iff.mp h4

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushforwardCongr_inv_hom_of_equalities
statement:
theorem pushforwardCongr_inv_hom_of_equalities
    {W Y : Scheme.{u}} {f g s : W ⟶ Y}
    (hf : f = s) (hg : g = s) (hfg : f = g) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr hg).inv ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr hfg.symm).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr hf).inv
proof:
:= by
  subst g
  subst s
  cases hfg
  ext M U x
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.map_iso_transition_of_functor_triangle
statement:
theorem map_iso_transition_of_functor_triangle
    {A B : Type*} [Category A] [Category B]
    {F G H : A ⥤ B}
    (eG : G ≅ F) (eH : H ≅ F) (eGH : G ≅ H)
    (hc : eG.inv ≫ eGH.hom = eH.inv)
    {P Q R : A} (t : P ≅ Q) (s : P ≅ R) :
    F.map t.hom ≫ eG.inv.app Q ≫ eGH.hom.app Q ≫
          H.map (t.inv ≫ s.hom) =
      F.map s.hom ≫ eH.inv.app R
proof:
:= by
  rw [eG.inv.naturality_assoc, eGH.hom.naturality_assoc]
  rw [← H.map_comp]
  simp only [Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  have hcP := congrArg (fun k ↦ k.app P) hc
  change eG.inv.app P ≫ eGH.hom.app P = eH.inv.app P at hcP
  rw [← Category.assoc, hcP]
  exact eH.inv.naturality s.hom |>.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartCochain_π
statement:

          (C.pushforwardInducedSymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem
            hpos d).descentData.chartTerm i =

proof:

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartTerm_overlapSource
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartTerm_overlapSource
    (hpos : ∀ k : C.I, Nonempty (C.basisIndex k))
    (i j : C.I) (d : ℕ) :
    C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartTerm hpos i d ≫
        Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit
          (C.U i).ι
          (X.homOfLE
            (inf_le_left : C.U i ⊓ C.U j ≤ C.U i))
          (C.chartSymmetricDegreeSheaf i d) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
        (C.U i ⊓ C.U j).ι).unit.app
          (C.canonicalTwistingSheafPushforward d) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.U i ⊓ C.U j).ι).map
          (C.canonicalPushforwardPullbackToSymmetricDegreeOverlapSourceIso
            hpos i j d).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr
          (X.homOfLE_ι
            (inf_le_left : C.U i ⊓ C.U j ≤ C.U i))).inv.app
              ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
                (X.homOfLE
                  (inf_le_left : C.U i ⊓ C.U j ≤ C.U i))).obj
                    (C.chartSymmetricDegreeSheaf i d))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartTerm,
    canonicalPushforwardPullbackToSymmetricDegreeOverlapSourceIso,
    Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.map_comp, Functor.id_obj,
    Category.assoc] using
      pullbackCompositeToIteratedAdjunctionIso_unit_map
        (C.U i ⊓ C.U j).ι (C.U i).ι
        (X.homOfLE
          (inf_le_left : C.U i ⊓ C.U j ≤ C.U i))
        (X.homOfLE_ι
          (inf_le_left : C.U i ⊓ C.U j ≤ C.U i))
        (C.canonicalTwistingSheafPushforward d)
        (C.canonicalPushforwardPullbackToChartSymmetricDegreeIso
          hpos i d).hom

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartTerm_overlapTarget
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartTerm_overlapTarget
    (hpos : ∀ k : C.I, Nonempty (C.basisIndex k))
    (i j : C.I) (d : ℕ) :
    C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartTerm hpos j d ≫
        Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit
          (C.U j).ι
          (X.homOfLE
            (inf_le_right : C.U i ⊓ C.U j ≤ C.U j))

      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
        (C.U i ⊓ C.U j).ι).unit.app
          (C.canonicalTwistingSheafPushforward d) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.U i ⊓ C.U j).ι).map
          (C.canonicalPushforwardPullbackToSymmetricDegreeOverlapTargetIso
            hpos i j d).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr
          (X.homOfLE_ι
            (inf_le_right : C.U i ⊓ C.U j ≤ C.U j))).inv.app
              ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
                (X.homOfLE
                  (inf_le_right : C.U i ⊓ C.U j ≤ C.U j))).obj
                    (C.chartSymmetricDegreeSheaf j d))
proof:

    canonicalPushforwardPullbackToSymmetricDegreeOverlapTargetIso,
    Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.map_comp, Functor.id_obj,

      pullbackCompositeToIteratedAdjunctionIso_unit_map
        (C.U i ⊓ C.U j).ι (C.U j).ι
        (X.homOfLE
          (inf_le_right : C.U i ⊓ C.U j ≤ C.U j))
        (X.homOfLE_ι
          (inf_le_right : C.U i ⊓ C.U j ≤ C.U j))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartTerm_overlapTransition
statement:
theorem canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartTerm_overlapTransition
    (hpos : ∀ k : C.I, Nonempty (C.basisIndex k))
    (i j : C.I) (d : ℕ) :
    let T
proof:
:= C.pushforwardInducedSymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem hpos d
    let D := T.descentData
    C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartTerm hpos j d ≫
          Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit
            (D.toAmbient j) (D.right (i, j)) (D.module j) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr
            (D.fac (i, j)).symm).hom.app
              ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (D.right (i, j))).obj
                (D.module j)) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward
            (D.left (i, j) ≫ D.toAmbient i)).map
              (D.transition (i, j)).inv =
      C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartTerm hpos i d ≫
        Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit
          (D.toAmbient i) (D.left (i, j)) (D.module i) := by
  dsimp only
  dsimp only [SymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem.descentData]
  rw [canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartTerm_overlapTarget_assoc,
    canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartTerm_overlapSource]
  dsimp only [pushforwardInducedSymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem]
  simp only [Iso.trans_inv, Iso.symm_inv, Iso.app_hom, Iso.app_inv,
    Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  simp only [← Functor.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc,
    Iso.inv_hom_id_app, Category.comp_id]
  let s0 : (C.U i ⊓ C.U j).toScheme ⟶ X :=
    (C.U i ⊓ C.U j).ι
  let pL : (C.U i ⊓ C.U j).toScheme ⟶ X :=
    X.homOfLE
      (inf_le_left : C.U i ⊓ C.U j ≤ C.U i) ≫
        (C.U i).ι
  let pR : (C.U i ⊓ C.U j).toScheme ⟶ X :=
    X.homOfLE
      (inf_le_right : C.U i ⊓ C.U j ≤ C.U j) ≫
        (C.U j).ι
  let hL : pL = s0 :=
    X.homOfLE_ι
      (inf_le_left : C.U i ⊓ C.U j ≤ C.U i)
  let hR : pR = s0 :=
    X.homOfLE_ι
      (inf_le_right : C.U i ⊓ C.U j ≤ C.U j)
  let hLR : pL = pR := hL.trans hR.symm
  let t :=
    C.canonicalPushforwardPullbackToSymmetricDegreeOverlapTargetIso
      hpos i j d
  let s :=
    C.canonicalPushforwardPullbackToSymmetricDegreeOverlapSourceIso
      hpos i j d
  have ht := map_iso_transition_of_functor_triangle
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr hR)
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr hL)
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr hLR.symm)
    (pushforwardCongr_inv_hom_of_equalities hL hR hLR) t s
  have hη := congrArg
    (fun k ↦
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction s0).unit.app
        (C.canonicalTwistingSheafPushforward d) ≫ k) ht
  simpa only [s0, pL, pR, hL, hR, hLR, t, s, Category.assoc] using hη

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartCochain_compatible
statement:
theorem canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartCochain_compatible
    (hpos : ∀ k : C.I, Nonempty (C.basisIndex k))
    (d : ℕ) :
    C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartCochain hpos d ≫
        (C.pushforwardInducedSymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem
          hpos d).descentData.descentLeft =
      C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartCochain hpos d ≫
        (C.pushforwardInducedSymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem
          hpos d).descentData.descentRight
proof:
:= by
  let T := C.pushforwardInducedSymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem hpos d
  let D := T.descentData
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  rintro ⟨i, j⟩
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [D.descentLeft_π, D.descentRight_π]
  slice_lhs 1 2 =>
    change C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartCochain hpos d ≫
      Pi.π
        (C.pushforwardInducedSymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem
          hpos d).descentData.chartTerm i
    rw [C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartCochain_π hpos i d]
  slice_rhs 1 2 =>
    change C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartCochain hpos d ≫
      Pi.π
        (C.pushforwardInducedSymmetricDegreeTransitionSystem
          hpos d).descentData.chartTerm j
    rw [C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartCochain_π hpos j d]
  have h := (C.canonicalPushforwardToSymmetricDegreeChartTerm_overlapTransition
      hpos i j d).symm
  dsimp only at h ⊢
  simp only [Category.assoc] at h ⊢
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.FRI.height_generic_eq_succ
statement:
theorem height_generic_eq_succ {L : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (ι : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion ι]
    (hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = ι.ker)
    (hne : ι (genericPoint Z) ≠ genericPoint X) :
    height (genericPoint X) = height (genericPoint Z) + 1
proof:
:= by
  haveI : L.IsLocallyFree := hL.isFiniteLocallyFree.isLocallyFree
  haveI : L.IsFinitePresentation :=
    IsFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation X hL.isFiniteLocallyFree
  set q : X := ι (genericPoint Z) with hq
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : X.presheaf.stalk q,
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk q) = Ideal.span {g} :=
    ⟨_, (A5FR.maximalIdeal_eq_ker_stalkMap_generic ι).trans
      (E27.ker_stalkMap_eq_span_germ_wCoord σ ι hid (genericPoint Z) (wFrameAt L hL q))⟩
  have hg0 : g ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot.mpr rfl] at hg
    have hfield : IsField (X.presheaf.stalk q) :=
      IsLocalRing.isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq.mpr hg
    have h1 := ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight q
    rw [ringKrullDim_eq_zero_of_isField hfield] at h1
    have h2 : coheight q = 0 := by exact_mod_cast h1.symm
    have hmax : IsMax q := coheight_eq_zero.mp h2
    have hle : q ≤ genericPoint X := (genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial
    have hge : genericPoint X ≤ q := hmax hle
    exact hne (((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hge).antisymm
      (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hle)).eq)
  have hcoh : coheight q = 1 :=
    E27.coheight_eq_one_of_maximalIdeal_span q g hg0 hg
  have hcat := dimensionCatenary_of_finiteType k (X := X) X (𝟙 X) q hcoh
  change height q + 1 = height (genericPoint X) at hcat
  rw [← hcat, hq, height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion ι]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.powerSum_map
statement:
theorem powerSum_map (φ : A →ₐ[ℚ] B) (c : ℕ → A) :
    ∀ m, φ (Alg.powerSum c m) = Alg.powerSum (fun i ↦ φ (c i)) m
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ m ih =>
    cases m with
    | zero => simp [Alg.powerSum]
    | succ m =>
      rw [Alg.powerSum, Alg.powerSum, map_add, map_sum]
      congr 1
      · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
        rw [map_smul, map_mul, ih (m - i) (by omega)]
      · rw [map_smul]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.neg_one_pow_mul_self
statement: theorem neg_one_pow_mul_self (a : ℕ) : ((-1 : ℚ) ^ a) * ((-1 : ℚ) ^ a) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.neg_one_pow_sub
statement:
theorem neg_one_pow_sub (a d : ℕ) :
    ((-1 : ℚ) ^ d) = -(((-1 : ℚ) ^ (a + 1 + d)) * ((-1 : ℚ) ^ a))
proof:
:= by
  have h := neg_one_pow_mul_self a
  have e : (-1 : ℚ) ^ (a + 1 + d) = (-1) ^ a * (-1) * (-1) ^ d := by rw [pow_add, pow_succ]
  rw [e]
  linear_combination (-(-1 : ℚ) ^ d) * h

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.coeff_logDer
statement:
theorem coeff_logDer (c : ℕ → K) (j : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff j (PowerSeries.derivative K (PowerSeries.mk c) *
        PowerSeries.invOfUnit (PowerSeries.mk c) 1) = ((-1 : ℚ) ^ j) • psumG c (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [psumG_succ_comm, smul_smul, neg_one_pow_mul_self, one_smul]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.deriv_coeff_eq
statement:
theorem deriv_coeff_eq (c : ℕ → K) (h0 : c 0 = 1) (m : ℕ) :
    ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) • c (m + 1) =
      ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal m,
        PowerSeries.coeff p.1 (PowerSeries.derivative K (PowerSeries.mk c) *
          PowerSeries.invOfUnit (PowerSeries.mk c) 1) * c p.2
proof:
:= by
  have hC0 : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (PowerSeries.mk c) = ((1 : Kˣ) : K) := by
    rw [constantCoeff_mk', h0]; simp
  have hinv := PowerSeries.invOfUnit_mul (PowerSeries.mk c) 1 hC0
  have hQ : PowerSeries.derivative K (PowerSeries.mk c) *
        PowerSeries.invOfUnit (PowerSeries.mk c) 1 * PowerSeries.mk c =
      PowerSeries.derivative K (PowerSeries.mk c) := by
    rw [mul_assoc, hinv, mul_one]
  have := congrArg (PowerSeries.coeff m) hQ
  have hD : PowerSeries.coeff m (PowerSeries.derivative K (PowerSeries.mk c)) =
      ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) • c (m + 1) := by
    rw [← mk_succ_smul_eq_derivative, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul, hD] at this
  simp only [PowerSeries.coeff_mk] at this
  exact this.symm

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.powerSum_eq_psumG_comm
statement:
theorem powerSum_eq_psumG_comm (c : ℕ → K) (h0 : c 0 = 1) :
    ∀ m, Alg.powerSum c m = psumG c m
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ m ih =>
    cases m with
    | zero => simp [Alg.powerSum, psumG]
    | succ m =>
      have E := deriv_coeff_eq c h0 m
      rw [Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk, Finset.sum_range_succ] at E
      simp only [Nat.sub_self, h0, mul_one] at E
      simp only [coeff_logDer] at E
      
      rw [Alg.powerSum]
      have hsum : ∑ i : Fin m, ((-1 : ℚ) ^ (i : ℕ)) • (c ((i : ℕ) + 1) * Alg.powerSum c (m - (i : ℕ))) =
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, ((-1 : ℚ) ^ i) • (c (i + 1) * psumG c (m - i)) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_range (fun i ↦ ((-1 : ℚ) ^ i) • (c (i + 1) * psumG c (m - i)))]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
        rw [ih (m - i) (by omega)]
      rw [hsum, ← Finset.sum_range_reflect]
      have hterm : ∀ a ∈ Finset.range m,
          ((-1 : ℚ) ^ (m - 1 - a)) • (c (m - 1 - a + 1) * psumG c (m - (m - 1 - a))) =
            -(((-1 : ℚ) ^ m) • (((-1 : ℚ) ^ a • psumG c (a + 1)) * c (m - a))) := by
        intro a ha
        have ha' := Finset.mem_range.mp ha
        obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ : ∃ d, m = a + 1 + d := ⟨m - a - 1, by omega⟩
        have e1 : a + 1 + d - 1 - a = d := by omega
        have e2 : a + 1 + d - a = d + 1 := by omega
        have e3 : a + 1 + d - d = a + 1 := by omega
        rw [e1, e2, e3, neg_one_pow_sub a d, smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul,
          mul_comm (psumG c (a + 1)) (c (d + 1)), neg_smul]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      
      have hE : ((-1 : ℚ) ^ m) • psumG c (m + 1) =
          ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) • c (m + 1) -
            ∑ a ∈ Finset.range m, ((-1 : ℚ) ^ a • psumG c (a + 1)) * c (m - a) := by
        rw [E]; abel
      have hp : psumG c (m + 1) =
          ((-1 : ℚ) ^ m) • (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) • c (m + 1) -
            ∑ a ∈ Finset.range m, ((-1 : ℚ) ^ a • psumG c (a + 1)) * c (m - a)) := by
        rw [← hE, smul_smul, neg_one_pow_mul_self, one_smul]
      rw [hp, smul_sub, smul_smul, Finset.smul_sum]
      push_cast
      abel

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.powerSum_eq_psumG
statement:
theorem powerSum_eq_psumG (c : ℕ → R) (h0 : c 0 = 1) (hc : ∀ i j, c i * c j = c j * c i) (m : ℕ) :
    Alg.powerSum c m = psumG c m
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ∀ x ∈ Set.range c, ∀ y ∈ Set.range c, x * y = y * x := by
    rintro x ⟨i, rfl⟩ y ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact hc i j
  obtain ⟨K, _, _, φ, hinj, hl⟩ := exists_comm_lift (Set.range c) hs
  choose a ha using fun i ↦ hl (c i) ⟨i, rfl⟩
  have a0 : a 0 = 1 := by apply hinj; rw [ha, h0, map_one]
  have e1 := powerSum_map φ a m
  have e2 := psumG_map φ a a0 m
  have hfun : (fun i ↦ φ (a i)) = c := funext ha
  rw [hfun] at e1 e2
  rw [← e1, ← e2, powerSum_eq_psumG_comm a a0 m]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.powerSum_conv
statement:
theorem powerSum_conv {cA cD cB : ℕ → R} (h : ConvData cA cD cB) (m : ℕ) :
    Alg.powerSum cB m = Alg.powerSum cA m + Alg.powerSum cD m
proof:
:= by
  have hB : ∀ i j, cB i * cB j = cB j * cB i := by
    intro i j
    obtain ⟨K, _, _, φ, a, d, b, hinj, ha, hd, hb, a0, d0, hconv⟩ := h.lift
    rw [← hb i, ← hb j, ← map_mul, ← map_mul, mul_comm (b i)]
  have hB0 : cB 0 = 1 := by rw [h.conv 0]; simp [h.A0, h.D0]
  rw [powerSum_eq_psumG cB hB0 hB m, powerSum_eq_psumG cA h.A0 h.AA m,
    powerSum_eq_psumG cD h.D0 h.DD m, h.psum m]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.gsum_add
statement: theorem gsum_add (a b : ℕ → Alg.Op M) : Alg.gsum (a + b) = Alg.gsum a + Alg.gsum b
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro y
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, Alg.gsum, DirectSum.toModule_lof,
    Pi.add_apply, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.chFromChern_conv
statement:
theorem chFromChern_conv {cA cD cB : ℕ → Alg.Op M} (h : ConvData cA cD cB) (rA rD : ℕ) :
    Alg.chFromChern (rA + rD) cB = Alg.chFromChern rA cA + Alg.chFromChern rD cD
proof:
:= by
  unfold Alg.chFromChern
  have : (fun m ↦ if m = 0 then (0 : Alg.Op M) else
      (PowerSeries.coeff m (CharacteristicClasses.chLine ℚ)) • Alg.powerSum cB m) =
      (fun m ↦ if m = 0 then (0 : Alg.Op M) else
        (PowerSeries.coeff m (CharacteristicClasses.chLine ℚ)) • Alg.powerSum cA m) +
      (fun m ↦ if m = 0 then (0 : Alg.Op M) else
        (PowerSeries.coeff m (CharacteristicClasses.chLine ℚ)) • Alg.powerSum cD m) := by
    funext m
    by_cases hm : m = 0
    · simp [hm]
    · simp only [hm, if_false, Pi.add_apply, powerSum_conv h m, smul_add]
  rw [this, gsum_add, Nat.cast_add, add_smul]
  abel

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.coframe_sum_sheafifyUnitApp
statement:
theorem coframe_sum_sheafifyUnitApp (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (hx : ∀ g : Γ(X, U), Function.Bijective (frameMap P x (X.basicOpen g) (X.basicOpen_le g)))
    (c : I → Γ(X, U)) (i : I) :
    (∑ k, c k • coframe _ (overIsoFree x hU hx) k).val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))
      (sheafifyUnitApp U (x i)) = c i
proof:
:= by
  rw [overIsoFree_frame_apply x hU hx, ← Category.assoc]
  change coef (frameSec _ (overIsoFree x hU hx) i ≫ _) = c i
  rw [Preadditive.comp_sum]
  simp only [comp_smul', frameSec_coframe]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · rw [if_pos rfl, coef_smul]
  · intro j _ hj
    rw [if_neg (Ne.symm hj), smul_zero]
  · intro h
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ i) h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.chartRingEquiv_symm_X
statement:
theorem chartRingEquiv_symm_X (a : Fin (n + 1)) (k : AffineChartIndex n a) :
    (chartRingEquiv R n a).symm (MvPolynomial.X k) = Koszul.ratio R n a k.1
proof:
:= by
  change (Proj.awayToSection (grading R n) (coordinate R n a)).hom
    ((awayCoordinateEquiv R n a).symm (MvPolynomial.X k)) = _
  rw [awayCoordinateEquiv, RingEquiv.symm_symm, RingEquiv.ofBijective_apply, awayCoordinateHom,
    MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X']
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.chartRingEquiv_symm_C
statement:
theorem chartRingEquiv_symm_C (a : Fin (n + 1)) (r : R) :
    (chartRingEquiv R n a).symm (MvPolynomial.C r) =
      structureRingHom (X := space R n) (R := CommRingCat.of R) (coordinateOpen R n a) r
proof:
:= by
  change (Proj.awayToSection (grading R n) (coordinate R n a)).hom
    ((awayCoordinateEquiv R n a).symm (MvPolynomial.C r)) = _
  rw [awayCoordinateEquiv, RingEquiv.symm_symm, RingEquiv.ofBijective_apply, awayCoordinateHom,
    MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C]
  have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (projectiveCoordinateChartScalarRingHom_awayToSection R n a) r
  have hc : coefficientToCoordinateAway R n a r = projectiveCoordinateChartScalarRingHom R n a r := by
    rfl
  rw [hc]
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.chartScalar_apply
statement:
theorem chartScalar_apply (a : Fin (n + 1)) (b : Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), ⊤)) :
    chartScalar R n a b =
      structureRingHom (X := space R n) (R := CommRingCat.of R) (coordinateOpen R n a)
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).hom b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [structureRingHom_apply, globalSec]
  change _ = (space R n).presheaf.map _ ((toSpec R n).appTop
    ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).hom b)))
  rw [Iso.hom_inv_id_apply]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.chart_aeval_bijective
statement:
theorem chart_aeval_bijective (a : Fin (n + 1)) :
    letI
proof:
:= (chartScalar R n a).toAlgebra
    Function.Bijective (MvPolynomial.aeval (R := Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), ⊤))
      (fun k : AffineChartIndex n a ↦ Koszul.ratio R n a k.1)) := by
  letI := (chartScalar R n a).toAlgebra
  let eB : Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), ⊤) ≃+* R :=
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  have key : (MvPolynomial.aeval (R := Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), ⊤))
      (fun k : AffineChartIndex n a ↦ Koszul.ratio R n a k.1)).toRingHom =
      (chartRingEquiv R n a).symm.toRingHom.comp
        (MvPolynomial.mapEquiv (AffineChartIndex n a) eB).toRingHom := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro b
      simp only [AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe, MvPolynomial.aeval_C,
        RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe,
        MvPolynomial.mapEquiv_apply, MvPolynomial.map_C]
      rw [chartRingEquiv_symm_C]
      exact chartScalar_apply R n a b
    · intro k
      simp only [AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe, MvPolynomial.aeval_X,
        RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe,
        MvPolynomial.mapEquiv_apply, MvPolynomial.map_X]
      rw [chartRingEquiv_symm_X]
  have hb : Function.Bijective ((chartRingEquiv R n a).symm.toRingHom.comp
      (MvPolynomial.mapEquiv (AffineChartIndex n a) eB).toRingHom) :=
    ((MvPolynomial.mapEquiv (AffineChartIndex n a) eB).trans (chartRingEquiv R n a).symm).bijective
  rw [← key] at hb
  exact hb

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.chartKaehlerBasis_apply
statement:
theorem chartKaehlerBasis_apply (a : Fin (n + 1)) (k : AffineChartIndex n a) :
    letI
proof:
:= (chartScalar R n a).toAlgebra
    chartKaehlerBasis R n a k =
      KaehlerDifferential.D Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), ⊤) Γ(space R n, coordinateOpen R n a)
        (Koszul.ratio R n a k.1) := by
  letI := (chartScalar R n a).toAlgebra
  rw [chartKaehlerBasis, Algebra.SubmersivePresentation.basisKaehlerOfIsCompl_apply]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.cotangentChartFrame_bijective
statement:
theorem cotangentChartFrame_bijective (a : Fin (n + 1))
    (g : Γ(space R n, coordinateOpen R n a)) :
    Function.Bijective (frameMap (relativePresheaf (toSpec R n)) (cotangentChartFrame R n a)
      ((space R n).basicOpen g) ((space R n).basicOpen_le g))
proof:
:= by
  letI := (chartScalar R n a).toAlgebra
  have := relative_frameMap_bijective (toSpec R n) (V₀ := ⊤) (isAffineOpen_top _)
    (coordinateOpen_isAffine R n a) le_top
    ((chartKaehlerBasis R n a).reindex Equiv.ulift.symm) g
  convert this using 3
  funext k
  simp [cotangentChartFrame]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.eulerChartMap_frame
statement:
theorem eulerChartMap_frame (a j : Fin (n + 1)) (k : ULift.{u} (AffineChartIndex n a)) :
    (eulerChartMap R n a j).val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 (coordinateOpen R n a))))
      (sheafifyUnitApp (coordinateOpen R n a) (cotangentChartFrame R n a k)) =
      eulerChartCoeff R n a j k
proof:
:=
  coframe_sum_sheafifyUnitApp (cotangentChartFrame R n a) (coordinateOpen_isAffine R n a)
    (cotangentChartFrame_bijective R n a) _ k

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.eulerChartCoeff_sum
statement:
theorem eulerChartCoeff_sum (a : Fin (n + 1)) (k : ULift.{u} (AffineChartIndex n a)) :
    ∑ j, Koszul.ratio R n a j * eulerChartCoeff R n a j k = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [eulerChartCoeff, mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero,
    Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true, Koszul.ratio_self, one_mul,
    sub_self]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree
