name: GRRBlueprintV4.powerSum_one
statement: theorem powerSum_one : Alg.powerSum c 1 = c 1
proof: := by simp [Alg.powerSum]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.powerSum_two
statement: theorem powerSum_two : Alg.powerSum c 2 = c 1 * c 1 - (2 : ℚ) • c 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Alg.powerSum]
  simp [powerSum_one]
  module

name: GRRBlueprintV4.powerSum_three
statement:
theorem powerSum_three :
    Alg.powerSum c 3 = c 1 * (c 1 * c 1 - (2 : ℚ) • c 2) - c 2 * c 1 + (3 : ℚ) • c 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [Alg.powerSum]
  simp [Fin.sum_univ_succ, powerSum_one, powerSum_two]
  module

name: GRRBlueprintV4.logCoeff_todd_two
statement:
theorem logCoeff_todd_two :
    Alg.logCoeff (fun j ↦ if j = 0 then 1 else if j = 1 then 1 / 2 else if j = 2 then 1 / 12 else 0) 2
      = -1 / 24
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Alg.logCoeff
      (fun j ↦ if j = 0 then 1 else if j = 1 then 1 / 2 else if j = 2 then 1 / 12 else (0 : ℚ)) 1
      = 1 / 2 := by
    rw [Alg.logCoeff]; simp
  rw [Alg.logCoeff]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Finset.univ_eq_empty, Finset.sum_empty, add_zero, Fin.val_zero,
    zero_add, h1]
  norm_num

name: GRRBlueprintV4.coeff_toddLine_two
statement: theorem coeff_toddLine_two : PowerSeries.coeff 2 (CharacteristicClasses.toddLine ℚ) = 1 / 12
proof:
:= by
  simp [CharacteristicClasses.toddLine, bernoulli'PowerSeries]
  norm_num

name: GRRBlueprintV4.hyperChi_plane
statement: theorem hyperChi_plane (d m : ℚ) : hyperChi 2 d m = d * m + 1 - (d - 1) * (d - 2) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : coeff 0 tdSer = 1 := by rw [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, constantCoeff_tdSer]
  have h1 := coeff_tdSer_one
  simp [hyperChi, pow_succ, coeff_mul, Finset.Nat.antidiagonal_succ, coeff_rescale, coeff_exp,
    eSer, h0, h1]
  ring

name: GRRBlueprintV4.hyperChi_line
statement: theorem hyperChi_line (m : ℚ) : hyperChi 2 1 m = m + 1
proof: := by rw [hyperChi_plane]; ring

name: GRRBlueprintV4.hyperChi_conic
statement: theorem hyperChi_conic (m : ℚ) : hyperChi 2 2 m = 2 * m + 1
proof: := by rw [hyperChi_plane]; ring

name: GRRBlueprintV4.hyperChi_cubic
statement: theorem hyperChi_cubic : hyperChi 2 3 0 = 0
proof: := by rw [hyperChi_plane]; ring

name: GRRBlueprintV4.hyperChi_quadric
statement: theorem hyperChi_quadric : hyperChi 3 2 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : coeff 0 tdSer = 1 := by rw [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, constantCoeff_tdSer]
  have h1 := coeff_tdSer_one
  have h2 := coeff_tdSer_two
  simp [hyperChi, pow_succ, coeff_mul, Finset.Nat.antidiagonal_succ, coeff_rescale,
    eSer, h0, h1, h2]
  norm_num [Nat.factorial]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.projSpace_chi
statement:
theorem projSpace_chi (n : ℕ) (m : ℤ) :
    coeff n (rescale (m : ℚ) (exp ℚ) * tdSer ^ (n + 1)) = Ring.choose ((m : ℚ) + n) n
proof:
:=
  hrrNum_int n m

name: GRRBlueprintV4.projLine_chi_neg
statement: theorem projLine_chi_neg : hrrNum ((-1 : ℤ) : ℚ) 1 = 0 ∧ hrrNum ((-2 : ℤ) : ℚ) 1 = -1
proof:
:= by
  rw [hrrNum_one, hrrNum_one]; norm_num

name: GRRBlueprintV4.point_chi
statement: theorem point_chi (m : ℚ) : hrrNum m 0 = 1
proof: := hrrNum_zero_right m

name: GRRBlueprintV4.normal_sign
statement:
theorem normal_sign : coeff 1 (rescale (1 : ℚ) eSer) = -1 / 2 ∧
    coeff 1 (rescale (-1 : ℚ) eSer) = 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [coeff_rescale, eSer]
  norm_num

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.toddLine_eq_tdSer
statement: theorem toddLine_eq_tdSer : CharacteristicClasses.toddLine ℚ = tdSer
proof:
:= by
  set E : ℚ⟦X⟧ := exp ℚ with hE
  set T := CharacteristicClasses.toddLine ℚ with hT
  have h1 : T * (E - 1) = X * E := CharacteristicClasses.toddLine_mul_exp_sub_one ℚ
  have hEEm : E * rescale (-1 : ℚ) E = 1 := exp_mul_exp_neg_eq_one
  have hX : (X : ℚ⟦X⟧) * eSer = 1 - rescale (-1 : ℚ) E := X_mul_eSer
  have h2 : E - 1 = E * (X * eSer) := by
    rw [hX]; linear_combination hEEm
  have h3 : X * (E * (T * eSer)) = X * (E * 1) := by
    linear_combination h1 - T * h2
  have h4 : E * (T * eSer) = E * 1 := PowerSeries.X_mul_cancel h3
  have h5 : T * eSer = 1 := by
    linear_combination (rescale (-1 : ℚ) E) * h4 - (T * eSer - 1) * hEEm
  exact (PowerSeries.eq_inv_iff_mul_eq_one (by simp [constantCoeff_eSer])).mpr h5

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.coeff_Lser
statement: theorem coeff_Lser (m : ℕ) : coeff m Lser = GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.logCoeff qf m
proof:
:= by
  simp [Lser]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.coeff_zero_Lser
statement: theorem coeff_zero_Lser : coeff 0 Lser = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_Lser, GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.logCoeff]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.constantCoeff_Lser
statement: theorem constantCoeff_Lser : constantCoeff Lser = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, coeff_zero_Lser]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.qf_zero
statement: theorem qf_zero : qf 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [qf, coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, constantCoeff_tdSer]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.derivative_tdSer
statement: theorem derivative_tdSer : d⁄dX ℚ tdSer = d⁄dX ℚ Lser * tdSer
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  rw [coeff_derivative, coeff_mul]
  simp only [coeff_derivative, coeff_Lser]
  rw [Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ
    (fun a b ↦ GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.logCoeff qf (a + 1) * ((a : ℚ) + 1) * coeff b tdSer) m,
    Finset.sum_range_succ]
  have hrec : GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.logCoeff qf (m + 1) =
      qf (m + 1) - (1 / ((m : ℚ) + 1)) * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m,
        (((j : ℕ) : ℚ) + 1) * GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.logCoeff qf ((j : ℕ) + 1) * qf (m - (j : ℕ)) := by
    rw [GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.logCoeff, Finset.sum_range]
  have hs : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m,
      GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.logCoeff qf (k + 1) * ((k : ℚ) + 1) * coeff (m - k) tdSer =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m,
        (((j : ℕ) : ℚ) + 1) * GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.logCoeff qf ((j : ℕ) + 1) * qf (m - (j : ℕ)) := by
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
    simp only [qf]; ring
  rw [hs]
  have h0 : coeff (m - m) tdSer = 1 := by
    rw [Nat.sub_self]; exact qf_zero
  rw [h0]
  have hne : ((m : ℚ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  set s := ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m,
        (((j : ℕ) : ℚ) + 1) * GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.logCoeff qf ((j : ℕ) + 1) * qf (m - (j : ℕ))
  rw [hrec]
  field_simp
  ring

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.ode_unique
statement:
theorem ode_unique {L G Q : ℚ⟦X⟧} (hG : d⁄dX ℚ G = d⁄dX ℚ L * G)
    (hQ : d⁄dX ℚ Q = d⁄dX ℚ L * Q) (h0 : constantCoeff G = constantCoeff Q) : G = Q
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ m ih =>
    cases m with
    | zero => simpa [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply] using h0
    | succ m =>
      have h1 := congrArg (coeff m) hG
      have h2 := congrArg (coeff m) hQ
      rw [coeff_derivative, coeff_mul] at h1 h2
      have h3 : ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal m, coeff p.1 (d⁄dX ℚ L) * coeff p.2 G =
          ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal m, coeff p.1 (d⁄dX ℚ L) * coeff p.2 Q := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp ↦ ?_
        have hp' : p.2 < m + 1 := by
          have := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp
          omega
        rw [ih p.2 hp']
      have hne : ((m : ℚ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have := h1.trans (h3.trans h2.symm)
      exact mul_right_cancel₀ hne this

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.hasSubst_Lser
statement: theorem hasSubst_Lser : HasSubst Lser
proof: := HasSubst.of_constantCoeff_zero' constantCoeff_Lser

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.derivative_Gser
statement: theorem derivative_Gser : d⁄dX ℚ Gser = d⁄dX ℚ Lser * Gser
proof:
:= by
  unfold Gser
  rw [derivative_subst ℚ hasSubst_Lser, derivative_exp, mul_comm]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.coeff_Lser_pow_eq_zero
statement: theorem coeff_Lser_pow_eq_zero {d m : ℕ} (h : m < d) : coeff m (Lser ^ d) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hX : (X : ℚ⟦X⟧) ∣ Lser := (PowerSeries.X_dvd_iff).mpr constantCoeff_Lser
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hX
  rw [hp, mul_pow, coeff_X_pow_mul', if_neg (by omega)]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.coeff_Gser
statement:
theorem coeff_Gser (m : ℕ) (j : ℕ) (hmj : m ≤ j) :
    coeff m Gser = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), ((i.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) * coeff m (Lser ^ i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Gser
  rw [coeff_subst' hasSubst_Lser]
  rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset (s := Finset.range (j + 1))]
  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
    rw [coeff_exp, smul_eq_mul]
    simp
  · intro d hd
    rw [Function.mem_support] at hd
    by_contra hnot
    apply hd
    have : m < d := by
      simp only [Finset.coe_range, Set.mem_Iio, not_lt] at hnot
      omega
    rw [coeff_Lser_pow_eq_zero this, smul_zero]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.constantCoeff_Gser
statement: theorem constantCoeff_Gser : constantCoeff Gser = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, coeff_Gser 0 0 le_rfl]
  simp [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.Gser_eq_tdSer
statement: theorem Gser_eq_tdSer : Gser = tdSer
proof:
:= by
  refine ode_unique (L := Lser) derivative_Gser derivative_tdSer ?_
  rw [constantCoeff_Gser, constantCoeff_tdSer]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.coeff_Fser_eq_tdSer
statement: theorem coeff_Fser_eq_tdSer (j m : ℕ) (hmj : m ≤ j) : coeff m (Fser j) = coeff m tdSer
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Gser_eq_tdSer, coeff_Gser m j hmj, Fser, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
  rw [coeff_smul, smul_eq_mul]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.evTrunc_eq_sum
statement:
theorem evTrunc_eq_sum (n : ℕ) (H : Module.End ℚ M) (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) :
    evTrunc n H f = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), coeff i f • H ^ i
proof:
:= by
  unfold evTrunc
  rw [Polynomial.aeval_eq_sum_range' (natDegree_trunc_lt f n)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi ↦ ?_
  rw [coeff_trunc, if_pos (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.evTrunc_congr
statement:
theorem evTrunc_congr (n : ℕ) (H : Module.End ℚ M) {f g : ℚ⟦X⟧}
    (h : ∀ i ≤ n, coeff i f = coeff i g) : evTrunc n H f = evTrunc n H g
proof:
:= by
  rw [evTrunc_eq_sum, evTrunc_eq_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi ↦ ?_
  rw [h i (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi))]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.pow_apply_eq_zero_of_le
statement:
theorem pow_apply_eq_zero_of_le (H : Module.End ℚ M) (v : M) (j : ℕ) (hv : (H ^ (j + 1)) v = 0)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : j + 1 ≤ i) : (H ^ i) v = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hi
  rw [add_comm, pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply, hv, map_zero]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.evTrunc_level
statement:
theorem evTrunc_level (H : Module.End ℚ M) (v : M) (j n : ℕ) (hjn : j ≤ n)
    (hv : (H ^ (j + 1)) v = 0) (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) : evTrunc n H f v = evTrunc j H f v
proof:
:= by
  rw [evTrunc_eq_sum, evTrunc_eq_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  symm
  refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_subset_range.mpr (by omega)) fun i hi hi' ↦ ?_
  have : j + 1 ≤ i := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hi'
    exact hi'
  rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, pow_apply_eq_zero_of_le H v j hv i this, smul_zero]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.evTrunc_sum_smul
statement:
theorem evTrunc_sum_smul (n : ℕ) (H : Module.End ℚ M) {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (c : ι → ℚ)
    (f : ι → ℚ⟦X⟧) :
    evTrunc n H (∑ i ∈ s, c i • f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, c i • evTrunc n H (f i)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ∀ a, coeff a (∑ i ∈ s, c i • f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, c i * coeff a (f i) := fun a ↦ by
    rw [map_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ by rw [coeff_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [evTrunc_eq_sum]
  simp only [hc, evTrunc_eq_sum, Finset.smul_sum, Finset.sum_smul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ ↦ ?_
  rw [mul_smul]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.evTrunc_comm
statement:
theorem evTrunc_comm (n : ℕ) (H : Module.End ℚ M) (f g : ℚ⟦X⟧) :
    evTrunc n H f * evTrunc n H g = evTrunc n H g * evTrunc n H f
proof:
:= by
  unfold evTrunc
  rw [← map_mul (Polynomial.aeval H), ← map_mul (Polynomial.aeval H), mul_comm]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.LowersDeg.pow_vanish
statement:
theorem LowersDeg.pow_vanish (hu : LowersDeg u) :
    ∀ (j : ℕ) (y : M j), (u ^ (j + 1)) (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M j y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero => intro y; rw [zero_add, pow_one]; exact hu.zero y
  | succ j ih =>
    intro y
    obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := hu.succ j y
    rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, hy']
    exact ih y'

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.lof_mem_S
statement: theorem lof_mem_S {n j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ n) (y : M j) : DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M j y ∈ S M n
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨j, hj, y, rfl⟩

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.LowersDeg.mem_S
statement:
theorem LowersDeg.mem_S (hu : LowersDeg u) {n : ℕ} {w : DirectSum ℕ M} (hw : w ∈ S M n) :
    u w ∈ S M n
proof:
:= by
  induction hw using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem w hw =>
    obtain ⟨j, hj, y, rfl⟩ := hw
    cases j with
    | zero => rw [hu.zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    | succ j =>
      obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := hu.succ j y
      rw [hy']
      exact lof_mem_S (by omega) y'
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hx

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.LowersDeg.pow_mem_S
statement:
theorem LowersDeg.pow_mem_S (hu : LowersDeg u) {n : ℕ} {w : DirectSum ℕ M} (hw : w ∈ S M n)
    (i : ℕ) : (u ^ i) w ∈ S M n
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => simpa using hw
  | succ i ih => rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]; exact hu.mem_S ih

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.LowersDeg.evTrunc_mem_S
statement:
theorem LowersDeg.evTrunc_mem_S (hu : LowersDeg u) {n m : ℕ} {w : DirectSum ℕ M}
    (hw : w ∈ S M n) (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) : evTrunc m u f w ∈ S M n
proof:
:= by
  rw [evTrunc_eq_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ ?_
  rw [LinearMap.smul_apply]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hu.pow_mem_S hw i)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.LowersDeg.pow_apply_lof_zero
statement:
theorem LowersDeg.pow_apply_lof_zero (hu : LowersDeg u) (j : ℕ) (y : M j) (i : ℕ)
    (hi : j + 1 ≤ i) : (u ^ i) (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M j y) = 0
proof:
:=
  pow_apply_eq_zero_of_le u _ j (hu.pow_vanish j y) i hi

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.logTd_line
statement:
theorem logTd_line (u : GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Op M) (c : ℕ → GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Op M)
    (h1 : c 1 = u) (h2 : ∀ j, 2 ≤ j → c j = 0) :
    GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.logTd c =
      GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.gsum fun m ↦ coeff m Lser • u ^ m
proof:
:= by
  unfold GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.logTd
  congr 1
  funext m
  by_cases hm : m = 0
  · subst hm; simp [coeff_zero_Lser]
  · rw [if_neg hm, GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.powerSum_line u c h1 h2 m (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hm),
      coeff_Lser, toddLine_eq_tdSer]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.gsum_eq_evTrunc
statement:
theorem gsum_eq_evTrunc (hu : LowersDeg u) (n : ℕ) {w : DirectSum ℕ M} (hw : w ∈ S M n) :
    GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.gsum (fun m ↦ coeff m Lser • u ^ m) w = evTrunc n u Lser w
proof:
:= by
  induction hw using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem w hw =>
    obtain ⟨j, hj, y, rfl⟩ := hw
    rw [GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.gsum_lof, evTrunc_eq_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_subset_range.mpr (by omega)) fun i hi hi' ↦ ?_
    have : j + 1 ≤ i := by
      simp only [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hi'
      exact hi'
    rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, hu.pow_apply_lof_zero j y i this, smul_zero]
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
  | smul c x _ hx => simp only [map_smul, hx]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.gsum_pow_lof
statement:
theorem gsum_pow_lof (hu : LowersDeg u) (j : ℕ) (y : M j) (i : ℕ) :
    (GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.gsum (fun m ↦ coeff m Lser • u ^ m) ^ i) (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M j y) =
      (evTrunc j u Lser ^ i) (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M j y)
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => simp
  | succ i ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, ih]
    have hmem : (evTrunc j u Lser ^ i) (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M j y) ∈ S M j := by
      clear ih
      induction i with
      | zero => simpa using lof_mem_S le_rfl y
      | succ i ih' =>
        rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]
        exact hu.evTrunc_mem_S ih' Lser
    exact gsum_eq_evTrunc hu j hmem

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.gexp_logTd_lof
statement:
theorem gexp_logTd_lof (hu : LowersDeg u) (c : ℕ → GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Op M) (h1 : c 1 = u)
    (h2 : ∀ j, 2 ≤ j → c j = 0) (j n : ℕ) (hjn : j ≤ n) (y : M j) :
    GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.tdFromChern c (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M j y) =
      evTrunc n u tdSer (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M j y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [evTrunc_level u _ j n hjn (hu.pow_vanish j y)]
  unfold GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.tdFromChern
  rw [logTd_line u c h1 h2, GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.gexp_lof]
  simp only [LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply]
  have hE : ∀ i, (GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.gsum (fun m ↦ coeff m Lser • u ^ m) ^ i)
      (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M j y) = evTrunc j u (Lser ^ i) (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M j y) := fun i ↦ by
    rw [gsum_pow_lof hu j y i, evTrunc_pow_apply j u _ (hu.pow_vanish j y) Lser i]
  simp only [hE]
  have := evTrunc_sum_smul j u (Finset.range (j + 1)) (fun i ↦ ((i.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹))
    (fun i ↦ Lser ^ i)
  have h3 : evTrunc j u (Fser j) = evTrunc j u tdSer :=
    evTrunc_congr j u fun i hi ↦ coeff_Fser_eq_tdSer j i hi
  rw [← h3, Fser, this, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.tdFromChern_line
statement:
theorem tdFromChern_line (hu : LowersDeg u) (c : ℕ → GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Op M) (h1 : c 1 = u)
    (h2 : ∀ j, 2 ≤ j → c j = 0) (n : ℕ) {w : DirectSum ℕ M} (hw : w ∈ S M n) :
    GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.tdFromChern c w = evTrunc n u tdSer w
proof:
:= by
  induction hw using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem w hw =>
    obtain ⟨j, hj, y, rfl⟩ := hw
    exact gexp_logTd_lof hu c h1 h2 j n hj y
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
  | smul a x _ hx => simp only [map_smul, hx]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.chFromChern_line
statement:
theorem chFromChern_line (u : GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Op M) (c : ℕ → GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Op M)
    (h1 : c 1 = u) (h2 : ∀ j, 2 ≤ j → c j = 0) :
    GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.chFromChern 1 c =
      1 + GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.gsum fun m ↦ if m = 0 then 0 else
        ((m.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) • u ^ m
proof:
:= by
  unfold GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.chFromChern
  congr 1
  · simp
  · congr 1
    funext m
    by_cases hm : m = 0
    · simp [hm]
    · rw [if_neg hm, if_neg hm,
        GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.powerSum_line u c h1 h2 m (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hm)]
      simp [CharacteristicClasses.chLine, coeff_exp]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CASE1C.chFromChern_line_eq
statement:
theorem chFromChern_line_eq (hu : LowersDeg u) (c : ℕ → GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Op M) (h1 : c 1 = u)
    (h2 : ∀ j, 2 ≤ j → c j = 0) (n : ℕ) {w : DirectSum ℕ M} (hw : w ∈ S M n) :
    GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.chFromChern 1 c w = evTrunc n u (exp ℚ) w
proof:
:= by
  induction hw using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem w hw =>
    obtain ⟨j, hj, y, rfl⟩ := hw
    rw [chFromChern_line u c h1 h2, evTrunc_level u _ j n hj (hu.pow_vanish j y),
      evTrunc_eq_sum, LinearMap.add_apply, GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.gsum_lof]
    rw [LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply, Finset.sum_range_succ', Finset.sum_range_succ']
    simp [coeff_exp]
    exact add_comm _ _
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
  | smul a x _ hx => simp only [map_smul, hx]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistingSheafTensorChartCompatibility_of_restrictionIndependence
statement:
theorem canonicalTwistingSheafTensorChartCompatibility_of_restrictionIndependence
    (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    (d e : ℤ)
    (h : C.CanonicalTwistingSheafTensorChartRestrictionIndependence
      hpos d e) :
    C.CanonicalTwistingSheafTensorChartCompatibility hpos d e
proof:
:= by
  intro V i j f g
  have hVi : V ≤ (C.chartι i).opensRange := f.le
  have hVj : V ≤ (C.chartι j).opensRange := g.le
  rw [show f = homOfLE hVi from Subsingleton.elim _ _,
    show g = homOfLE hVj from Subsingleton.elim _ _,
    Scheme.Modules.sheafHom_map_localHomSection,
    Scheme.Modules.sheafHom_map_localHomSection]
  exact congrArg
    (SheafOfModules.toSheaf (C.scheme.ringCatSheaf.over V)).map
    (h i j hVi hVj)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.chartOpens_coversTop
statement:
theorem chartOpens_coversTop :
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology C.scheme).CoversTop
      (fun i : C.I ↦ (C.chartι i).opensRange)
proof:
:=
  (Opens.coversTop_iff
    (T := C.scheme) (fun i : C.I ↦ (C.chartι i).opensRange)).2
      C.cover.isOpenCover_opensRange

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistingSheafTensorHom_over
statement:
theorem canonicalTwistingSheafTensorHom_over
    (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    (d e : ℤ)
    (h : C.CanonicalTwistingSheafTensorChartCompatibility hpos d e)
    (i : C.I) :
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheafTensorHom hpos d e h).over
        (C.chartι i).opensRange =
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheafTensorChartOverIso hpos d e i).hom
proof:
:=
  Scheme.Modules.glueHom_over C.scheme
    (fun j : C.I ↦ (C.chartι j).opensRange)
    C.chartOpens_coversTop
    (fun j : C.I ↦
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheafTensorChartOverIso hpos d e j).hom)
    h i

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistingSheafTensorHom_isIso
statement:
theorem canonicalTwistingSheafTensorHom_isIso
    (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    (d e : ℤ)
    (h : C.CanonicalTwistingSheafTensorChartCompatibility hpos d e) :
    IsIso (C.canonicalTwistingSheafTensorHom hpos d e h)
proof:
:=
  Scheme.Modules.glueHom_isIso C.scheme
    (fun i : C.I ↦ (C.chartι i).opensRange)
    C.chartOpens_coversTop
    (fun i : C.I ↦
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheafTensorChartOverIso hpos d e i).hom)
    h (fun _ ↦ inferInstance)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_mul_of_compatibility
statement:
theorem canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_mul_of_compatibility
    (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    (d e : ℤ)
    (h : C.CanonicalTwistingSheafTensorChartCompatibility hpos d e) :
    C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class d *
        C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class e =
      C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (d + e)
proof:
:= by
  let D : {M : C.scheme.Modules //
      SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme M} :=
    ⟨C.canonicalTwistingSheaf d,
      C.canonicalTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree d⟩
  let E' : {M : C.scheme.Modules //
      SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme M} :=
    ⟨C.canonicalTwistingSheaf e,
      C.canonicalTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree e⟩
  let hDE := SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree
    C.scheme D.1 E'.1 D.2 E'.2
  change
    SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf C.scheme D.1 D.2 *
        SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf C.scheme E'.1 E'.2 =
      SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf C.scheme
        (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (d + e))
        (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (d + e))
  calc
    _ = SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf C.scheme
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf C.scheme D.1 E'.1) hDE := by
      exact SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf_mul C.scheme D E'
    _ = _ := SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf_iso C.scheme hDE
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (d + e))
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheafTensorIso hpos d e h)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.mem_span_range_X_of_mem_grading
statement:
theorem mem_span_range_X_of_mem_grading {d : ℕ} (hd : d ≠ 0)
    {p : Polynomial k n} (hp : p ∈ grading k n d) :
    p ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range (MvPolynomial.X (R := k) (σ := Fin (n + 1))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [show Set.range (MvPolynomial.X (R := k)) =
      MvPolynomial.X '' (Set.univ : Set (Fin (n + 1))) by simp]
  rw [MvPolynomial.mem_ideal_span_X_image]
  intro m hm
  have hdeg : m.degree = d := by
    rw [Finsupp.degree_eq_weight_one]
    exact hp (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hm)
  have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by
    intro hm0
    subst m
    simp at hdeg
    omega
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Finsupp.ne_iff.mp hm0
  exact ⟨i, Set.mem_univ _, hi⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.mem_vanishingSubspace_iff
statement:
theorem mem_vanishingSubspace_iff (x : space k n) (s : grading k n 1) :
    s ∈ vanishingSubspace k n x ↔
      (s : Polynomial k n) ∈ x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.exists_not_mem_vanishingSubspace
statement:
theorem exists_not_mem_vanishingSubspace (x : space k n) :
    ∃ s : grading k n 1, (s : Polynomial k n) ∉ x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  simp only [not_exists, not_not] at h
  have hle : (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading k n)).toIdeal ≤
      x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal := by
    rw [HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_irrelevant_le]
    intro d hd p hp
    have hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range (MvPolynomial.X (R := k) (σ := Fin (n + 1)))) ≤
        x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal := by
      rw [Ideal.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact h ⟨coordinate k n i, coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i⟩
    exact hspan (mem_span_range_X_of_mem_grading k n hd.ne' hp)
  exact x.not_irrelevant_le (fun y hy ↦ hle hy)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.exists_pointEvaluation
statement:
theorem exists_pointEvaluation (x : space k n) :
    ∃ φ : Module.Dual k (grading k n 1),
      (∀ s : grading k n 1,
        (s : Polynomial k n) ∈ x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal → φ s = 0) ∧
      ∃ s : grading k n 1, φ s ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_not_mem_vanishingSubspace k n x
  have hwq : (vanishingSubspace k n x).mkQ w ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Submodule.mkQ_apply, ne_eq, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    exact hw
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := Module.Projective.exists_dual_ne_zero k hwq
  refine ⟨ψ ∘ₗ (vanishingSubspace k n x).mkQ, ?_, ⟨w, ?_⟩⟩
  · intro s hs
    have hs0 : (vanishingSubspace k n x).mkQ s = 0 := by
      rw [Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
      exact hs
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, hs0, map_zero]
  · simpa using hψ

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.pointEvaluation_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
theorem pointEvaluation_eq_zero_of_mem (x : space k n) (s : grading k n 1)
    (hs : (s : Polynomial k n) ∈ x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) :
    pointEvaluation k n x s = 0
proof:
:=
  (exists_pointEvaluation k n x).choose_spec.1 s hs

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.exists_pointEvaluation_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_pointEvaluation_ne_zero (x : space k n) :
    ∃ s : grading k n 1, pointEvaluation k n x s ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  (exists_pointEvaluation k n x).choose_spec.2

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.not_mem_of_pointEvaluation_ne_zero
statement:
theorem not_mem_of_pointEvaluation_ne_zero (x : space k n) (s : grading k n 1)
    (h : pointEvaluation k n x s ≠ 0) :
    (s : Polynomial k n) ∉ x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal
proof:
:=
  fun hs ↦ h (pointEvaluation_eq_zero_of_mem k n x s hs)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.mem_basicOpen_of_pointEvaluation_ne_zero
statement:
theorem mem_basicOpen_of_pointEvaluation_ne_zero (x : space k n) (s : grading k n 1)
    (h : pointEvaluation k n x s ≠ 0) :
    x ∈ Proj.basicOpen (grading k n) (s : Polynomial k n)
proof:
:=
  (Proj.mem_basicOpen (𝒜 := grading k n) (f := (s : Polynomial k n)) x).mpr
    (not_mem_of_pointEvaluation_ne_zero k n x s h)

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.chartToOpen_eqToHom
statement:
theorem chartToOpen_eqToHom {E E' : X.affineOpens} (h : E = E') :
    chartToOpen I E ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg (fun U : X.affineOpens ↦ U.1.toScheme) h) =
      eqToHom (congrArg (chart I) h) ≫ chartToOpen I E'

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.homOfLE_eqToHom

theorem homOfLE_eqToHom {E E' : X.affineOpens} (h : E = E')

    X.homOfLE hEZ =
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun U : X.affineOpens ↦ U.1.toScheme) h) ≫
        X.homOfLE hE'Z

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.CommonBasicOpen.isPullback_rightChartMap
statement:
theorem isPullback_rightChartMap (e : CommonBasicOpen A B) :
    IsPullback
      (e.rightChartMap I)
      (chartToOpen I e.affineOpen)
      (chartToOpen I B)
      (X.homOfLE e.affineOpen_le_right)
proof:
:= by
  let iP : chart I (X.affineBasicOpen e.right) ≅ chart I e.affineOpen :=
    eqToIso (congrArg (chart I) e.swap_affineOpen)
  let iQ : (X.affineBasicOpen e.right).1.toScheme ≅
      e.affineOpen.1.toScheme :=
    eqToIso (congrArg (fun U : X.affineOpens ↦ U.1.toScheme)
      e.swap_affineOpen)
  refine (isPullback_basicOpenChartMap I B e.right).of_iso
    iP (Iso.refl _) iQ (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp [iP, rightChartMap]
  · exact chartToOpen_eqToHom I e.swap_affineOpen
  · simp
  · exact homOfLE_eqToHom e.swap_affineOpen
      (X.affineBasicOpen_le e.right) e.affineOpen_le_right

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.TripleCommonBasicOpen.isPullback_toA
statement:
theorem isPullback_toA (e : TripleCommonBasicOpen A B C) :
    IsPullback
      (e.toA I)
      (chartToOpen I e.affineOpen)
      (chartToOpen I A)
      (X.homOfLE e.affineOpen_le_A)
proof:
:= by
  change IsPullback
    (basicOpenChartMap I e.first.affineOpen e.thirdLeft ≫
      basicOpenChartMap I A e.first.left)
    (chartToOpen I (X.affineBasicOpen e.thirdLeft))
    (chartToOpen I A)
    (X.homOfLE ((X.affineBasicOpen_le e.thirdLeft).trans
      (X.affineBasicOpen_le e.first.left)))
  have h :=
    (isPullback_basicOpenChartMap I e.first.affineOpen e.thirdLeft).paste_horiz
      (isPullback_basicOpenChartMap I A e.first.left)
  rw [X.homOfLE_homOfLE] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.TripleCommonBasicOpen.isPullback_toB
statement:

    IsPullback
      (e.toB I)

      (chartToOpen I B)
      (X.homOfLE e.affineOpen_le_B)
proof:
:= by
  change IsPullback
    (basicOpenChartMap I e.first.affineOpen e.thirdLeft ≫
      e.first.rightChartMap I)
    (chartToOpen I (X.affineBasicOpen e.thirdLeft))
    (chartToOpen I B)
    (X.homOfLE ((X.affineBasicOpen_le e.thirdLeft).trans
      e.first.affineOpen_le_right))
  have h :=
    (isPullback_basicOpenChartMap I e.first.affineOpen e.thirdLeft).paste_horiz
      (e.first.isPullback_rightChartMap I)
  rw [X.homOfLE_homOfLE] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenTripleCocycleToFinalBase_toFirst
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem basicOpenTripleCocycleToFinalBase_toFirst
    (U V W : X.affineOpens)
    (l : (basicOpenTripleCocycleCover I U V W).I₀) :
    basicOpenTripleCocycleToFinalBase I U V W l ≫
        X.homOfLE l.2.affineOpen_le_A =
      basicOpenTripleCocycleToRefinement I U V W l ≫
        basicOpenCocycleFirstBase I U V W l.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [show X.homOfLE l.2.affineOpen_le_A =
      X.homOfLE l.2.affineOpen_le_intersection ≫
        X.homOfLE ((inf_le_left :
          (l.1.1.1.affineOpen.1 ⊓ l.1.1.2.affineOpen.1) ⊓
            l.1.2.affineOpen.1 ≤
              l.1.1.1.affineOpen.1 ⊓ l.1.1.2.affineOpen.1).trans
          (inf_le_left : l.1.1.1.affineOpen.1 ⊓
            l.1.1.2.affineOpen.1 ≤ l.1.1.1.affineOpen.1)) by
    rw [X.homOfLE_homOfLE]]
  rw [← Category.assoc,
    basicOpenTripleCocycleToFinalBase_toIntersection,
    Category.assoc]
  unfold basicOpenCocycleToTripleBase
  rw [show X.homOfLE ((inf_le_left :
      (l.1.1.1.affineOpen.1 ⊓ l.1.1.2.affineOpen.1) ⊓
        l.1.2.affineOpen.1 ≤
          l.1.1.1.affineOpen.1 ⊓ l.1.1.2.affineOpen.1).trans
      (inf_le_left : l.1.1.1.affineOpen.1 ⊓
        l.1.1.2.affineOpen.1 ≤ l.1.1.1.affineOpen.1)) =
      X.homOfLE (inf_le_left :
        (l.1.1.1.affineOpen.1 ⊓ l.1.1.2.affineOpen.1) ⊓
          l.1.2.affineOpen.1 ≤
            l.1.1.1.affineOpen.1 ⊓ l.1.1.2.affineOpen.1) ≫
      X.homOfLE (inf_le_left : l.1.1.1.affineOpen.1 ⊓
        l.1.1.2.affineOpen.1 ≤ l.1.1.1.affineOpen.1) by
    rw [X.homOfLE_homOfLE]]
  have hA := tripleOpenLift_toA
    l.1.1.1.affineOpen.1 l.1.1.2.affineOpen.1 l.1.2.affineOpen.1
    (basicOpenCocycleFirstBase I U V W l.1)
    (basicOpenCocycleSecondBase I U V W l.1)
    (basicOpenCocycleThirdBase I U V W l.1)
    (basicOpenCocycleFirstSecondBase I U V W l.1)
    (basicOpenCocycleFirstThirdBase I U V W l.1)
  simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg
    (fun q ↦ basicOpenTripleCocycleToRefinement I U V W l ≫ q) hA

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenTripleCocycleToFinalBase_toSecond
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem basicOpenTripleCocycleToFinalBase_toSecond
    (U V W : X.affineOpens)
    (l : (basicOpenTripleCocycleCover I U V W).I₀) :

        X.homOfLE l.2.affineOpen_le_B =
      basicOpenTripleCocycleToRefinement I U V W l ≫
        basicOpenCocycleSecondBase I U V W l.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [show X.homOfLE l.2.affineOpen_le_B =
      X.homOfLE l.2.affineOpen_le_intersection ≫
        X.homOfLE ((inf_le_left :
          (l.1.1.1.affineOpen.1 ⊓ l.1.1.2.affineOpen.1) ⊓
            l.1.2.affineOpen.1 ≤
              l.1.1.1.affineOpen.1 ⊓ l.1.1.2.affineOpen.1).trans
          (inf_le_right : l.1.1.1.affineOpen.1 ⊓
            l.1.1.2.affineOpen.1 ≤ l.1.1.2.affineOpen.1)) by
    rw [X.homOfLE_homOfLE]]
  rw [← Category.assoc,
    basicOpenTripleCocycleToFinalBase_toIntersection,
    Category.assoc]
  unfold basicOpenCocycleToTripleBase
  rw [show X.homOfLE ((inf_le_left :
      (l.1.1.1.affineOpen.1 ⊓ l.1.1.2.affineOpen.1) ⊓
        l.1.2.affineOpen.1 ≤
          l.1.1.1.affineOpen.1 ⊓ l.1.1.2.affineOpen.1).trans
      (inf_le_right : l.1.1.1.affineOpen.1 ⊓
        l.1.1.2.affineOpen.1 ≤ l.1.1.2.affineOpen.1)) =
      X.homOfLE (inf_le_left :
        (l.1.1.1.affineOpen.1 ⊓ l.1.1.2.affineOpen.1) ⊓
          l.1.2.affineOpen.1 ≤
            l.1.1.1.affineOpen.1 ⊓ l.1.1.2.affineOpen.1) ≫

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenTripleCocycleToFinalBase_toThird
statement:

theorem basicOpenTripleCocycleToFinalBase_toThird

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenTripleCocycleFirstChart_rightChartMap
statement:
theorem basicOpenTripleCocycleFirstChart_rightChartMap
    (U V W : X.affineOpens)
    (l : (basicOpenTripleCocycleCover I U V W).I₀) :
    basicOpenTripleCocycleFirstChart I U V W l ≫
        l.1.1.1.rightChartMap I =
      (basicOpenTripleCocycleCover I U V W).f l ≫
        (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple U V W ≫
        pullback.snd (overlapToChart I V W) (overlapToChart I V U) ≫
        overlapToChart I V U
proof:
:= by
  calc
    basicOpenTripleCocycleFirstChart I U V W l ≫
          l.1.1.1.rightChartMap I =
        basicOpenTripleCocycleToRefinement I U V W l ≫
          ((basicOpenCocycleRange I).cocycleToFirstLocal U V W l.1 ≫
            ((basicOpenPairwiseAtlas I).localModel U V l.1.1.1).map) ≫
          overlapToChart I V U := by
      simp only [basicOpenTripleCocycleFirstChart, Category.assoc]
      rw [basicOpenPairwiseAtlas_localModel_overlapToChart]
    _ = basicOpenTripleCocycleToRefinement I U V W l ≫
          (((basicOpenCocycleRange I).cocycleRefinementCover U V W).f l.1 ≫
            pullback.fst (overlapToChart I U V) (overlapToChart I U W) ≫
            (basicOpenPairwiseAtlas I).transition U V) ≫
          overlapToChart I V U := by
      rw [← (basicOpenCocycleRange I).cocycle_first_transition]
    _ = (basicOpenTripleCocycleCover I U V W).f l ≫
          pullback.fst (overlapToChart I U V) (overlapToChart I U W) ≫
          (basicOpenPairwiseAtlas I).transition U V ≫
          overlapToChart I V U := by
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg
        (fun q ↦ q ≫
          pullback.fst (overlapToChart I U V) (overlapToChart I U W) ≫
          (basicOpenPairwiseAtlas I).transition U V ≫
          overlapToChart I V U)
        (basicOpenTripleCocycleToRefinement_fac I U V W l)
    _ = (basicOpenTripleCocycleCover I U V W).f l ≫
          (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple U V W ≫
          pullback.snd (overlapToChart I V W) (overlapToChart I V U) ≫
          overlapToChart I V U := by
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg
        (fun q ↦ (basicOpenTripleCocycleCover I U V W).f l ≫ q ≫
          overlapToChart I V U)
        ((basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple_fac U V W).symm

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenTripleCocycleSecondChart_leftChartMap
statement:
theorem basicOpenTripleCocycleSecondChart_leftChartMap
    (U V W : X.affineOpens)
    (l : (basicOpenTripleCocycleCover I U V W).I₀) :
    basicOpenTripleCocycleSecondChart I U V W l ≫
        basicOpenChartMap I V l.1.1.2.left =
      (basicOpenTripleCocycleCover I U V W).f l ≫
        (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple U V W ≫
        pullback.fst (overlapToChart I V W) (overlapToChart I V U) ≫
        overlapToChart I V W
proof:
:= by
  calc
    basicOpenTripleCocycleSecondChart I U V W l ≫
          basicOpenChartMap I V l.1.1.2.left =
        basicOpenTripleCocycleToRefinement I U V W l ≫
          ((basicOpenCocycleRange I).cocycleToSecondLocal U V W l.1 ≫
            ((basicOpenPairwiseAtlas I).cover V W).f l.1.1.2) ≫
          overlapToChart I V W := by
      simp only [basicOpenTripleCocycleSecondChart, Category.assoc]
      rw [commonBasicOpenChartIso_hom_chartMap]
      rfl
    _ = basicOpenTripleCocycleToRefinement I U V W l ≫
          (((basicOpenCocycleRange I).cocycleRefinementCover U V W).f l.1 ≫
            (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple U V W ≫
            pullback.fst (overlapToChart I V W) (overlapToChart I V U)) ≫
          overlapToChart I V W := by
      rw [(basicOpenCocycleRange I).cocycleToSecondLocal_fac]
    _ = (basicOpenTripleCocycleCover I U V W).f l ≫
          (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple U V W ≫
          pullback.fst (overlapToChart I V W) (overlapToChart I V U) ≫
          overlapToChart I V W := by
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg
        (fun q ↦ q ≫ (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple U V W ≫
          pullback.fst (overlapToChart I V W) (overlapToChart I V U) ≫
          overlapToChart I V W)
        (basicOpenTripleCocycleToRefinement_fac I U V W l)

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenTripleCocycleSecondChart_rightChartMap
statement:
theorem basicOpenTripleCocycleSecondChart_rightChartMap
    (U V W : X.affineOpens)
    (l : (basicOpenTripleCocycleCover I U V W).I₀) :
    basicOpenTripleCocycleSecondChart I U V W l ≫
        l.1.1.2.rightChartMap I =
      (basicOpenTripleCocycleCover I U V W).f l ≫
        (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple U V W ≫
        (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple V W U ≫
        pullback.snd (overlapToChart I W U) (overlapToChart I W V) ≫
        overlapToChart I W V
proof:
:= by
  calc
    basicOpenTripleCocycleSecondChart I U V W l ≫
          l.1.1.2.rightChartMap I =
        basicOpenTripleCocycleToRefinement I U V W l ≫
          ((basicOpenCocycleRange I).cocycleToSecondLocal U V W l.1 ≫
            ((basicOpenPairwiseAtlas I).localModel V W l.1.1.2).map) ≫
          overlapToChart I W V := by
      simp only [basicOpenTripleCocycleSecondChart, Category.assoc]
      rw [basicOpenPairwiseAtlas_localModel_overlapToChart]
    _ = basicOpenTripleCocycleToRefinement I U V W l ≫
          (((basicOpenCocycleRange I).cocycleRefinementCover U V W).f l.1 ≫
            (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple U V W ≫
            pullback.fst (overlapToChart I V W) (overlapToChart I V U) ≫
            (basicOpenPairwiseAtlas I).transition V W) ≫
          overlapToChart I W V := by
      rw [← (basicOpenCocycleRange I).cocycle_second_transition]
    _ = (basicOpenTripleCocycleCover I U V W).f l ≫
          (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple U V W ≫
          pullback.fst (overlapToChart I V W) (overlapToChart I V U) ≫
          (basicOpenPairwiseAtlas I).transition V W ≫
          overlapToChart I W V := by
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg
        (fun q ↦ q ≫ (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple U V W ≫
          pullback.fst (overlapToChart I V W) (overlapToChart I V U) ≫
          (basicOpenPairwiseAtlas I).transition V W ≫
          overlapToChart I W V)
        (basicOpenTripleCocycleToRefinement_fac I U V W l)
    _ = (basicOpenTripleCocycleCover I U V W).f l ≫
          (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple U V W ≫
          (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple V W U ≫
          pullback.snd (overlapToChart I W U) (overlapToChart I W V) ≫
          overlapToChart I W V := by
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg
        (fun q ↦ (basicOpenTripleCocycleCover I U V W).f l ≫
          (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple U V W ≫ q ≫
          overlapToChart I W V)
        ((basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple_fac V W U).symm

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenTripleCocycleThirdChart_leftChartMap
statement:
theorem basicOpenTripleCocycleThirdChart_leftChartMap
    (U V W : X.affineOpens)
    (l : (basicOpenTripleCocycleCover I U V W).I₀) :
    basicOpenTripleCocycleThirdChart I U V W l ≫
        basicOpenChartMap I W l.1.2.left =
      (basicOpenTripleCocycleCover I U V W).f l ≫
        (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple U V W ≫
        (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple V W U ≫
        pullback.fst (overlapToChart I W U) (overlapToChart I W V) ≫
        overlapToChart I W U
proof:
:= by
  calc
    basicOpenTripleCocycleThirdChart I U V W l ≫
          basicOpenChartMap I W l.1.2.left =
        basicOpenTripleCocycleToRefinement I U V W l ≫
          ((basicOpenCocycleRange I).cocycleToThirdLocal U V W l.1 ≫
            ((basicOpenPairwiseAtlas I).cover W U).f l.1.2) ≫
          overlapToChart I W U := by
      simp only [basicOpenTripleCocycleThirdChart, Category.assoc]
      rw [commonBasicOpenChartIso_hom_chartMap]
      rfl
    _ = basicOpenTripleCocycleToRefinement I U V W l ≫
          (((basicOpenCocycleRange I).cocycleRefinementCover U V W).f l.1 ≫
            (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple U V W ≫
            (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple V W U ≫
            pullback.fst (overlapToChart I W U) (overlapToChart I W V)) ≫
          overlapToChart I W U := by
      rw [(basicOpenCocycleRange I).cocycleToThirdLocal_fac]
    _ = (basicOpenTripleCocycleCover I U V W).f l ≫
          (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple U V W ≫
          (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple V W U ≫
          pullback.fst (overlapToChart I W U) (overlapToChart I W V) ≫
          overlapToChart I W U := by
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg
        (fun q ↦ q ≫ (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple U V W ≫
          (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple V W U ≫
          pullback.fst (overlapToChart I W U) (overlapToChart I W V) ≫
          overlapToChart I W U)
        (basicOpenTripleCocycleToRefinement_fac I U V W l)

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenTripleCocycleFirstChart_leftChartMap
statement:
theorem basicOpenTripleCocycleFirstChart_leftChartMap
    (U V W : X.affineOpens)

        overlapToChart I U V
proof:
:= by
  calc
    basicOpenTripleCocycleFirstChart I U V W l ≫
          basicOpenChartMap I U l.1.1.1.left =
        basicOpenTripleCocycleToRefinement I U V W l ≫
          ((basicOpenCocycleRange I).cocycleToFirstLocal U V W l.1 ≫
            ((basicOpenPairwiseAtlas I).cover U V).f l.1.1.1) ≫
          overlapToChart I U V := by
      simp only [basicOpenTripleCocycleFirstChart, Category.assoc]
      rw [commonBasicOpenChartIso_hom_chartMap]
      rfl
    _ = basicOpenTripleCocycleToRefinement I U V W l ≫
          (((basicOpenCocycleRange I).cocycleRefinementCover U V W).f l.1 ≫
            pullback.fst (overlapToChart I U V) (overlapToChart I U W)) ≫
          overlapToChart I U V := by
      rw [(basicOpenCocycleRange I).cocycleToFirstLocal_fac]

          pullback.fst (overlapToChart I U V) (overlapToChart I U W) ≫

      simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenTripleCocycleThirdChart_rightChartMap
statement:
theorem basicOpenTripleCocycleThirdChart_rightChartMap
    (U V W : X.affineOpens)
    (l : (basicOpenTripleCocycleCover I U V W).I₀) :
    basicOpenTripleCocycleThirdChart I U V W l ≫
        l.1.2.rightChartMap I =
      (basicOpenTripleCocycleCover I U V W).f l ≫
        (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple U V W ≫
        (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple V W U ≫
        (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple W U V ≫
        pullback.fst (overlapToChart I U V) (overlapToChart I U W) ≫
        overlapToChart I U V
proof:
:= by
  have hthird :
      (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple W U V ≫
          pullback.fst (overlapToChart I U V) (overlapToChart I U W) ≫
          overlapToChart I U V =
        pullback.fst (overlapToChart I W U) (overlapToChart I W V) ≫
          (basicOpenPairwiseAtlas I).transition W U ≫
          overlapToChart I U W := by
    rw [← Category.assoc,
      (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple_fst,
      (basicOpenCocycleRange I).firstLeg_toChart]
    rfl
  calc
    basicOpenTripleCocycleThirdChart I U V W l ≫
          l.1.2.rightChartMap I =
        basicOpenTripleCocycleToRefinement I U V W l ≫
          ((basicOpenCocycleRange I).cocycleToThirdLocal U V W l.1 ≫
            ((basicOpenPairwiseAtlas I).localModel W U l.1.2).map) ≫
          overlapToChart I U W := by
      simp only [basicOpenTripleCocycleThirdChart, Category.assoc]
      rw [basicOpenPairwiseAtlas_localModel_overlapToChart]
    _ = basicOpenTripleCocycleToRefinement I U V W l ≫
          (((basicOpenCocycleRange I).cocycleRefinementCover U V W).f l.1 ≫
            (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple U V W ≫
            (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple V W U ≫
            pullback.fst (overlapToChart I W U) (overlapToChart I W V) ≫
            (basicOpenPairwiseAtlas I).transition W U) ≫
          overlapToChart I U W := by
      rw [← (basicOpenCocycleRange I).cocycle_third_transition]
    _ = (basicOpenTripleCocycleCover I U V W).f l ≫
          (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple U V W ≫
          (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple V W U ≫
          pullback.fst (overlapToChart I W U) (overlapToChart I W V) ≫
          (basicOpenPairwiseAtlas I).transition W U ≫
          overlapToChart I U W := by
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg
        (fun q ↦ q ≫ (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple U V W ≫
          (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple V W U ≫
          pullback.fst (overlapToChart I W U) (overlapToChart I W V) ≫
          (basicOpenPairwiseAtlas I).transition W U ≫
          overlapToChart I U W)
        (basicOpenTripleCocycleToRefinement_fac I U V W l)
    _ = (basicOpenTripleCocycleCover I U V W).f l ≫
          (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple U V W ≫
          (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple V W U ≫
          (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple W U V ≫
          pullback.fst (overlapToChart I U V) (overlapToChart I U W) ≫
          overlapToChart I U V := by
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg
        (fun q ↦ (basicOpenTripleCocycleCover I U V W).f l ≫
          (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple U V W ≫
          (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple V W U ≫ q)
        hthird.symm

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenTripleCocycleToFinalChart_toB
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem basicOpenTripleCocycleToFinalChart_toB
    (U V W : X.affineOpens)
    (l : (basicOpenTripleCocycleCover I U V W).I₀) :
    basicOpenTripleCocycleToFinalChart I U V W l ≫ l.2.toB I =
      basicOpenTripleCocycleSecondChart I U V W l
proof:
:= by
  have hpath :
      l.2.toA I ≫ l.1.1.1.rightChartMap I =
        l.2.toB I ≫ basicOpenChartMap I V l.1.1.2.left := by
    rw [CommonBasicOpen.rightChartMap_eq_affineRestrictionMap,
      basicOpenChartMap_eq_affineRestrictionMap]
    exact l.2.toA_affineRestrictionMap_eq_toB_affineRestrictionMap I
      l.1.1.1.affineOpen_le_right
      (X.affineBasicOpen_le l.1.1.2.left)
  letI : Mono (basicOpenChartMap I V l.1.1.2.left) :=
    (isPullback_basicOpenChartMap I V l.1.1.2.left).mono_fst_of_mono
  refine (cancel_mono (basicOpenChartMap I V l.1.1.2.left)).mp ?_
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← hpath, ← Category.assoc,
    basicOpenTripleCocycleToFinalChart_toA,
    basicOpenTripleCocycleFirstSecondChart]

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenTripleCocycleToFinalChart_toC
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem basicOpenTripleCocycleToFinalChart_toC
    (U V W : X.affineOpens)

proof:

        l.2.toC I ≫ basicOpenChartMap I W l.1.2.left := by
    rw [CommonBasicOpen.rightChartMap_eq_affineRestrictionMap,
      basicOpenChartMap_eq_affineRestrictionMap]
    exact l.2.toB_affineRestrictionMap_eq_toC_affineRestrictionMap I
      l.1.1.2.affineOpen_le_right
      (X.affineBasicOpen_le l.1.2.left)
  letI : Mono (basicOpenChartMap I W l.1.2.left) :=
    (isPullback_basicOpenChartMap I W l.1.2.left).mono_fst_of_mono
  refine (cancel_mono (basicOpenChartMap I W l.1.2.left)).mp ?_

    basicOpenTripleCocycleToFinalChart_toB,

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenTripleCocycle_local_cocycle
statement:
theorem basicOpenTripleCocycle_local_cocycle
    (U V W : X.affineOpens)
    (l : (basicOpenTripleCocycleCover I U V W).I₀) :
    (basicOpenTripleCocycleCover I U V W).f l ≫
          (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple U V W ≫
          (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple V W U ≫
          (basicOpenCocycleRange I).transitionTriple W U V =
      (basicOpenTripleCocycleCover I U V W).f l
proof:
:= by
  have hpath :
      l.2.toC I ≫ l.1.2.rightChartMap I =
        l.2.toA I ≫ basicOpenChartMap I U l.1.1.1.left := by
    rw [CommonBasicOpen.rightChartMap_eq_affineRestrictionMap,
      basicOpenChartMap_eq_affineRestrictionMap]
    exact l.2.toC_affineRestrictionMap_eq_toA_affineRestrictionMap I
      l.1.2.affineOpen_le_right
      (X.affineBasicOpen_le l.1.1.1.left)
  letI : Mono (overlapToChart I U V) :=
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback
      (chartToOpen I U)
      (X.homOfLE (inf_le_left : U.1 ⊓ V.1 ≤ U.1))).mono_fst_of_mono
  letI : Mono (overlapToChart I U W) :=
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback
      (chartToOpen I U)
      (X.homOfLE (inf_le_left : U.1 ⊓ W.1 ≤ U.1))).mono_fst_of_mono
  letI : Mono
      (pullback.fst (overlapToChart I U V) (overlapToChart I U W)) :=
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback
      (overlapToChart I U V)
      (overlapToChart I U W)).mono_fst_of_mono
  refine (cancel_mono
    (pullback.fst (overlapToChart I U V) (overlapToChart I U W))).mp ?_
  refine (cancel_mono (overlapToChart I U V)).mp ?_
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← basicOpenTripleCocycleThirdChart_rightChartMap,
    ← basicOpenTripleCocycleFirstChart_leftChartMap,
    ← basicOpenTripleCocycleToFinalChart_toC_assoc,
    ← basicOpenTripleCocycleToFinalChart_toA_assoc]
  exact congrArg
    (fun q ↦ basicOpenTripleCocycleToFinalChart I U V W l ≫ q) hpath

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.WGASM.ord_eq_one_at_jq'
statement:
theorem ord_eq_one_at_jq' {B D : X.Modules} {b : B ⟶ D} (P : PairCover b) {L : X.Modules}
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) {e : ℕ}
    (σ : tensorUnitSheaf P.toB.scheme ⟶ E16.twistedLine P.toB L)
    (hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = P.jHom.ker)
    (m : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = m)
    (w : P.toB.scheme) (hw : height w = ((m + e + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
    (q : P.toD.scheme) (hq : height q = ((m + e : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
    (hB : flatPullback P.toB.toBase (dimPrimeCycle v m hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle w _ hw).1)
    (hD : flatPullback P.toD.toBase (dimPrimeCycle v m hv).1 = (dimPrimeCycle q _ hq).1)
    (hnotw : w ∉ Set.range P.jHom)
    (z : pointClosureScheme w) (hz : pointClosureι w z = P.jHom q) :
    (pointClosureScheme w).ord
      (D10.sectionCoord (closureFrame (L := E16.twistedLine P.toB L)
        (hL := E16.hasConstantRank_twistedLine P.toB hL) w z)
        (wPullbackSection (pointClosureι w) (E26.sectionOfHom σ))) z = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hN := E16.hasConstantRank_twistedLine P.toB hL
  haveI : (E16.twistedLine P.toB L).IsLocallyFree := hN.isFiniteLocallyFree.isLocallyFree
  haveI : (E16.twistedLine P.toB L).IsFinitePresentation :=
    IsFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation P.toB.scheme hN.isFiniteLocallyFree
  obtain ⟨hqv, hq1⟩ := E27.coeff_eq_one_of_flatPullback_prime P.toD.toBase v hv q hq hD
  obtain ⟨hwv, -⟩ := E27.coeff_eq_one_of_flatPullback_prime P.toB.toBase v hv w hw hB
  have hq1' : flatPullbackCoeff (P.jHom ≫ P.toB.toBase) q = 1 := by
    rw [P.jHom_toBase]; exact hq1
  have hwf : P.toB.toBase w = P.toB.toBase (pointClosureι w z) := by
    rw [hz, hwv, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, P.jHom_toBase, hqv]
  have hne : w ≠ P.jHom q := fun h => hnotw ⟨q, h.symm⟩
  let d := wFrameAt (E16.twistedLine P.toB L) hN (pointClosureι w z)
  let d' : WFrame (E16.twistedLine P.toB L) (P.jHom q) := ⟨d.U, hz ▸ d.mem, d.frame⟩
  have hcoord : wCoord d' (E26.sectionOfHom σ) = wCoord d (E26.sectionOfHom σ) := rfl
  have hker := E27.ker_stalkMap_eq_span_germ_wCoord σ P.jHom hid q d'
  have hmax := E27.closure_maximalIdeal_eq_span P.toB.toBase P.jHom q hq1' w z hz.symm hwf _ hker
  have hne0 := E27.closure_image_ne_zero P.toB.toBase P.jHom q hq1' w z hz.symm hwf hne _ hker
  have hcoh := E27.coheight_closure_eq_one P.toB.toBase P.jHom q hq1' w z hz.symm hwf hne _ hker
  have hg : (P.toB.scheme.presheaf.stalkCongr (Inseparable.of_eq hz.symm)).hom
      (P.toB.scheme.presheaf.germ d'.U (P.jHom q) d'.mem (wCoord d' (E26.sectionOfHom σ))) =
      P.toB.scheme.presheaf.germ d.U (pointClosureι w z) d.mem
        (wCoord d (E26.sectionOfHom σ)) := by
    rw [hcoord]
    exact E27.germ_stalkCongr_apply hz.symm d.U _ _ _
  rw [hg] at hmax hne0
  rw [E25.sectionCoord_eq_algebraMap_germ _ _ z (closureFrame (hL := hN) w z).mem,
    E27.germ_sectionCoordSec_closureFrame hN w _ z]
  exact Scheme.ord_algebraMap_eq_one_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal hcoh hne0 hmax.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.WGASM.weilGate_proved
statement:
theorem weilGate_proved {B D : X.Modules} {b : B ⟶ D} (P : PairCover b) {L : X.Modules}
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (e : ℕ) : E21.WeilGate P hL e
proof:
:= by
  intro σ hreg hid m v hv w hw q hq hB hD
  refine ⟨E27.weilGate_mem_range P m v hv w hw q hq hB hD, ?_⟩
  have hN := E16.hasConstantRank_twistedLine P.toB hL
  haveI : (E16.twistedLine P.toB L).IsLocallyFree := hN.isFiniteLocallyFree.isLocallyFree
  haveI : (E16.twistedLine P.toB L).IsFinitePresentation :=
    IsFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation P.toB.scheme hN.isFiniteLocallyFree
  haveI : Flat P.toD.toBase := E30.toBase_flat' P.toD
  have hnotw := E30.weilGate_hnot P hL e σ hreg hid m v hv w hw q hq hB hD
  let z₀ : pointClosureScheme w := pointClosureGenericPoint w
  have hsupp : pointClosureι w z₀ ∉ (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).support := by
    rw [hid, pointClosureι_genericPoint]
    exact E26.notMem_support_ker P.jHom w hnotw
  have hu := E26.wCoord_isUnit_of_notMem_support σ (pointClosureι w z₀) hsupp
    (wFrameAt (E16.twistedLine P.toB L) hN (pointClosureι w z₀))
  have hM := isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure _ hN w
  have hrank := m7s_genericRank_pointClosure _ hN w
  obtain ⟨bf, hb⟩ := E26.exists_refFrame (hL := hN) w (E26.sectionOfHom σ) z₀ hu
  refine ⟨z₀, bf, fun z => ?_⟩
  refine E28.coeff_eq_ite_of_parts (k := k) P v hv w hw q hq hB hD
    (fun z => Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame hM hrank bf z)
    (fun z hz => E25.coeff_eq_zero_of_coheight_ne hM hrank bf z hz)
    (fun z _ hr => E28.coeff_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range hN w hM hrank σ P.jHom hid bf hb z hr)
    (fun z hz => ?_) z
  rw [E25.coeff_eq_ord_sectionCoord hM hrank bf _ hb (closureFrame (hL := hN) w z) z
    (closureFrame (hL := hN) w z).mem]
  exact ord_eq_one_at_jq' P hL σ hid m v hv w hw q hq hB hD hnotw z hz

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentTotalDegreeAddHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateLaurentTotalDegreeAddHom_apply (e : CoordinateLaurentExponent n) :
    coordinateLaurentTotalDegreeAddHom n e = coordinateLaurentTotalDegree n e
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateExponentToLaurent_injective
statement:
theorem coordinateExponentToLaurent_injective :
    Function.Injective (coordinateExponentToLaurent n)
proof:
:= by
  intro e f h
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro i
  have hi := congrArg (fun z : CoordinateLaurentExponent n ↦ z i) h
  simpa [coordinateExponentToLaurent] using hi

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateExponentToLaurent_totalDegree
statement:
theorem coordinateExponentToLaurent_totalDegree (e : Fin (n + 1) →₀ ℕ) :
    coordinateLaurentTotalDegree n (coordinateExponentToLaurent n e) =
      (e.degree : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  change Finsupp.degree (coordinateExponentToLaurent n e) = (e.degree : ℤ)
  simp only [Finsupp.degree_eq_sum]
  simp [coordinateExponentToLaurent]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.polynomialToCoordinateLaurent_support
statement:
theorem polynomialToCoordinateLaurent_support (f : Polynomial k n) :
    (polynomialToCoordinateLaurent k n f).support =
      f.support.image (coordinateExponentToLaurent n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (AddMonoidAlgebra.mapDomain (coordinateExponentToLaurent n) f).support = _
  exact Finsupp.mapDomain_support_of_injective
    (coordinateExponentToLaurent_injective n) f

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.polynomial_mem_grading_support_degree
statement:
theorem polynomial_mem_grading_support_degree (m : ℕ) (f : Polynomial k n)
    (hf : f ∈ grading k n m) (e : Fin (n + 1) →₀ ℕ) (he : e ∈ f.support) :
    e.degree = m
proof:
:= by
  change f.IsHomogeneous m at hf
  rw [Finsupp.degree_apply]
  exact (hf.degree_eq_sum_deg_support he).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateExponentToLaurent_totalDegree_of_mem_grading_support
statement:
theorem coordinateExponentToLaurent_totalDegree_of_mem_grading_support
    (m : ℕ) (f : Polynomial k n) (hf : f ∈ grading k n m)
    (e : Fin (n + 1) →₀ ℕ) (he : e ∈ f.support) :
    coordinateLaurentTotalDegree n (coordinateExponentToLaurent n e) = (m : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateExponentToLaurent_totalDegree]
  exact_mod_cast polynomial_mem_grading_support_degree k n m f hf e he

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentBasisExponent_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateLaurentBasisExponent_apply (j i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateLaurentBasisExponent n j i = if j = i then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [coordinateLaurentBasisExponent, coordinateExponentToLaurent,
    Finsupp.single_apply]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentBasisExponent_totalDegree
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateLaurentBasisExponent_totalDegree (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateLaurentTotalDegree n (coordinateLaurentBasisExponent n i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateLaurentBasisExponent, coordinateExponentToLaurent_totalDegree]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechDenominatorLaurentExponent_totalDegree
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateCechDenominatorLaurentExponent_totalDegree (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateLaurentTotalDegree n
        (coordinateCechDenominatorLaurentExponent n p a) = (p + 1 : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  change coordinateLaurentTotalDegreeAddHom n
      (coordinateCechDenominatorLaurentExponent n p a) = (p + 1 : ℕ)
  rw [coordinateCechDenominatorLaurentExponent, map_sum]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechDenominatorLaurentExponent_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range
statement:
theorem coordinateCechDenominatorLaurentExponent_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range
    (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (hi : i ∉ Set.range a) :
    coordinateCechDenominatorLaurentExponent n p a i = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hti : ∀ t, a t ≠ i := fun t h ↦ hi ⟨t, h⟩
  simp [coordinateCechDenominatorLaurentExponent,
    coordinateLaurentBasisExponent_apply, hti]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurent_prod_single_one
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurent_prod_single_one {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (e : ι → CoordinateLaurentExponent n) :
    ∏ i ∈ s, (AddMonoidAlgebra.single (e i) 1 : CoordinateLaurentPolynomial k n) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (∑ i ∈ s, e i) 1
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => rfl
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
      rw [Finset.prod_insert hi, Finset.sum_insert hi, ih,
        AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, one_mul]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechEquationLaurentUnit_eq_monomialUnit
statement:
theorem coordinateCechEquationLaurentUnit_eq_monomialUnit (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateCechEquationLaurentUnit k n p a =
      coordinateLaurentMonomialUnit k n
        (coordinateCechDenominatorLaurentExponent n p a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Units.ext
  change (↑(∏ t, coordinateLaurentMonomialUnit k n
      (coordinateLaurentBasisExponent n (a t))) : CoordinateLaurentPolynomial k n) =
    AddMonoidAlgebra.single (coordinateCechDenominatorLaurentExponent n p a) 1
  rw [Units.coe_prod]
  change (∏ t, (AddMonoidAlgebra.single
      (coordinateLaurentBasisExponent n (a t)) 1 : CoordinateLaurentPolynomial k n)) = _
  simpa only [coordinateCechDenominatorLaurentExponent] using
    (coordinateLaurent_prod_single_one k n
      (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (p + 1)))
      (fun t ↦ coordinateLaurentBasisExponent n (a t)))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechEquationLaurentInverse_eq_single
statement:
theorem coordinateCechEquationLaurentInverse_eq_single (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateCechEquationLaurentInverse k n p a =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single
        (-coordinateCechDenominatorLaurentExponent n p a) 1
proof:
:= by
  change ↑((coordinateCechEquationLaurentUnit k n p a).inv) = _
  rw [coordinateCechEquationLaurentUnit_eq_monomialUnit]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechEquationLaurentInverse_pow_eq_single
statement:
theorem coordinateCechEquationLaurentInverse_pow_eq_single (p q : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateCechEquationLaurentInverse k n p a ^ q =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single
        (q • (-coordinateCechDenominatorLaurentExponent n p a)) 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateCechEquationLaurentInverse_eq_single,
    AddMonoidAlgebra.single_pow]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistShiftExponent_totalDegree
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistShiftExponent_totalDegree (d : ℤ) (q p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateLaurentTotalDegree n (coordinateCechTwistShiftExponent n d q p a) =
      -((q * (p + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) + d
proof:
:= by
  change coordinateLaurentTotalDegreeAddHom n
      (coordinateCechTwistShiftExponent n d q p a) = _
  rw [coordinateCechTwistShiftExponent, map_add, map_nsmul, map_neg, map_zsmul,
    coordinateLaurentTotalDegreeAddHom_apply,
    coordinateCechDenominatorLaurentExponent_totalDegree,
    coordinateLaurentTotalDegreeAddHom_apply,
    coordinateLaurentBasisExponent_totalDegree]
  push_cast
  simp only [nsmul_eq_mul, zsmul_eq_mul]
  simp only [Int.cast_id]
  ring

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistShiftExponent_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistShiftExponent_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range
    (d : ℤ) (q p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (hi : i ∉ Set.range a) :
    coordinateCechTwistShiftExponent n d q p a i = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hfirst : coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a ≠ i := by
    intro h
    exact hi ⟨0, h⟩
  simp [coordinateCechTwistShiftExponent,
    coordinateCechDenominatorLaurentExponent_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range n p a i hi,
    coordinateLaurentBasisExponent_apply, hfirst]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechEquationInversePow_mul_frame_eq_single
statement:
theorem coordinateCechEquationInversePow_mul_frame_eq_single (d : ℤ) (q p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateCechEquationLaurentInverse k n p a ^ q *
        coordinateTwistingFrameLaurentMonomial k n d
          (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a) =
      AddMonoidAlgebra.single (coordinateCechTwistShiftExponent n d q p a) 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateCechEquationLaurentInverse_pow_eq_single]
  simp only [coordinateTwistingFrameLaurentMonomial,
    AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, one_mul, coordinateCechTwistShiftExponent]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechLaurentNormalForm_eq_mul_single
statement:
theorem coordinateCechLaurentNormalForm_eq_mul_single (d : ℤ) (q p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) (f : Polynomial k n) :
    (polynomialToCoordinateLaurent k n f *
        coordinateCechEquationLaurentInverse k n p a ^ q) *
        coordinateTwistingFrameLaurentMonomial k n d
          (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a) =
      polynomialToCoordinateLaurent k n f *
        AddMonoidAlgebra.single (coordinateCechTwistShiftExponent n d q p a) 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_assoc, coordinateCechEquationInversePow_mul_frame_eq_single]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechLaurentNormalForm_mem_piece
statement:
theorem coordinateCechLaurentNormalForm_mem_piece (d : ℤ) (q p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) (f : Polynomial k n)
    (hf : f ∈ grading k n (q • (p + 1))) :
    (polynomialToCoordinateLaurent k n f *
          coordinateCechEquationLaurentInverse k n p a ^ q) *
        coordinateTwistingFrameLaurentMonomial k n d
          (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a) ∈
      coordinateLaurentPiece k n d p a
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  have hcoeff : polynomialToCoordinateLaurent k n f
      (e - coordinateCechTwistShiftExponent n d q p a) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [coordinateCechLaurentNormalForm_eq_mul_single,
      AddMonoidAlgebra.mul_single_apply] at he
    simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg, mul_one] using he
  have hsupp : e - coordinateCechTwistShiftExponent n d q p a ∈
      (polynomialToCoordinateLaurent k n f).support :=
    Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr hcoeff
  rw [polynomialToCoordinateLaurent_support] at hsupp
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hmap⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hsupp
  have heq : e = coordinateExponentToLaurent n m +
      coordinateCechTwistShiftExponent n d q p a := by
    rw [hmap]
    abel
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [heq]
    change coordinateLaurentTotalDegreeAddHom n
        (coordinateExponentToLaurent n m +
          coordinateCechTwistShiftExponent n d q p a) = d
    rw [map_add, coordinateLaurentTotalDegreeAddHom_apply,
      coordinateExponentToLaurent_totalDegree_of_mem_grading_support k n
        (q • (p + 1)) f hf m hm,
      coordinateLaurentTotalDegreeAddHom_apply,
      coordinateCechTwistShiftExponent_totalDegree]
    push_cast
    simp only [nsmul_eq_mul]
    try norm_num at ⊢
  · intro i hi
    by_contra hirange
    have hshift :=
      coordinateCechTwistShiftExponent_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range n d q p a i hirange
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ coordinateExponentToLaurent n m i := by
      simp [coordinateExponentToLaurent]
    rw [heq, Finsupp.add_apply, hshift, add_zero] at hi
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hnonneg) hi

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurent_mem_piece
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurent_mem_piece (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d, coordinateCechIntersection k n p a)) :
    coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurent k n d p a x ∈
      coordinateLaurentPiece k n d p a
proof:
:= by
  let E := coordinateCechTwistingFrameEvaluation k n d p a
  let r : Γ(space k n, coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p a) := E x
  let z : HomogeneousLocalization.Away
      (grading k n) (coordinateCechEquation k n p a) :=
    (coordinateCechBasicOpenIsoAway k n p a).inv r
  obtain ⟨q, f, hf, hz⟩ := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_surjective
    (grading k n) (coordinateCechEquation_mem_degree k n p a) z
  have hsection : E.symm
      ((coordinateCechBasicOpenIsoAway k n p a).hom
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading k n)
          (coordinateCechEquation_mem_degree k n p a) q f hf)) = x := by
    rw [hz]
    change E.symm
      ((coordinateCechBasicOpenIsoAway k n p a).hom
        ((coordinateCechBasicOpenIsoAway k n p a).inv (E x))) = x
    rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_apply]
    exact E.symm_apply_apply x
  rw [← hsection, coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurent_mk]
  exact coordinateCechLaurentNormalForm_mem_piece k n d q p a f hf

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurentPiece_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurentPiece_coe (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d, coordinateCechIntersection k n p a)) :
    ((coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurentPiece k n d p a x :
      coordinateLaurentPiece k n d p a) : CoordinateLaurentPolynomial k n) =
        coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurent k n d p a x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.epi_kernel_map_of_epi
statement:
theorem epi_kernel_map_of_epi {W F M : Y.Modules} (ρ : W ⟶ F) [Epi ρ] (σ : F ⟶ M) [Epi σ] :
    Epi (kernel.lift σ (kernel.ι (ρ ≫ σ) ≫ ρ) (by simp))
proof:
:= by
  rw [epi_iff_surjective_up_to_refinements]
  intro T y
  obtain ⟨T', π', hπ', w, hw⟩ :=
    surjective_up_to_refinements_of_epi ρ (y ≫ kernel.ι σ)
  have h0 : w ≫ (ρ ≫ σ) = 0 := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← hw]
    simp
  refine ⟨T', π', hπ', kernel.lift (ρ ≫ σ) w h0, ?_⟩
  rw [← cancel_mono (kernel.ι σ)]
  simp [hw]

name: SchemeKTheory.exists_epi_free_tensor_kernel
statement:
theorem exists_epi_free_tensor_kernel {J : Type u} [Finite J] [LinearOrder J] {W F M : Y.Modules}
    (hM : HasConstantRank Y M 1) (e : W ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J)
    (ρ : W ⟶ F) [Epi ρ] (σ : F ⟶ M) [Epi σ] :
    ∃ (J' : Type u) (_ : Finite J') (V : Y.Modules)
      (_ : V ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J')
      (φ : V ⟶ tensorSheaf Y (kernel σ) M), Epi φ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI hτ : Epi (ρ ≫ σ) := epi_comp' ‹_› ‹_›
  have hS : (ShortComplex.mk (kernel.ι (ρ ≫ σ)) (ρ ≫ σ) (kernel.condition _)).ShortExact :=
    { exact := ShortComplex.exact_kernel _
      mono_f := inferInstance
      epi_g := hτ }
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := exists_epi_exteriorPowerSheaf_succ_tensor Y hM (kernel.ι (ρ ≫ σ)) (ρ ≫ σ)
    (kernel.condition _) hS 1
  let a := exteriorPowerSheafMapIso Y e 2 ≪≫ exteriorPowerSheafFreeIso Y J 2
  let b := tensorSheafMapIso Y (exteriorPowerSheafOneIso Y (kernel (ρ ≫ σ))) (Iso.refl M)
  let k : kernel (ρ ≫ σ) ⟶ kernel σ := kernel.lift σ (kernel.ι (ρ ≫ σ) ≫ ρ) (by simp)
  haveI hk : Epi k := epi_kernel_map_of_epi ρ σ
  haveI := tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits Y M hM.isFiniteLocallyFree
  haveI : (tensorSheafRightFunctor Y M).PreservesEpimorphisms :=
    preservesEpimorphisms_of_preservesColimitsOfShape _
  have hT : Epi (tensorSheafMap Y k (𝟙 M)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Epi ((tensorSheafRightFunctor Y M).map k))
  exact ⟨_, inferInstance, exteriorPowerSheaf Y W 2,
    exteriorPowerSheafMapIso Y e 2 ≪≫ exteriorPowerSheafFreeIso Y J 2,
    ψ ≫ b.hom ≫ tensorSheafMap Y k (𝟙 M),
    epi_comp' hψ (epi_comp' inferInstance hT)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.a6_originalSection_comp
statement:
theorem a6_originalSection_comp (i : C.I) (k : PUnit.{u+1} ⊕ PUnit.{u+1})
    (m : (tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U i))) :
    a6OriginalSection C i k m ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
        (linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) ((tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U i)))
          (rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis X (C.U i) k)).ι).map
        (rankTwo_canonicalChartSplitBasisIso C i 1).hom =
    tautChartLocalSection Γ(X, C.U i)
      ((tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U i)))
      (rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis X (C.U i)) k m
proof:
:= by
  unfold a6OriginalSection tautChartLocalSection
  rw [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, rankTwo_canonicalChartSplitBasis_tautHom]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.a6_originalSection_evaluationIdeal
statement:
theorem a6_originalSection_evaluationIdeal (i : C.I) (k : PUnit.{u+1} ⊕ PUnit.{u+1})
    (m : (tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U i))) :
    sectionEvaluationIdeal
        (R := (a6W C i k).toScheme.presheaf.obj (op ⊤))
        ((a6OriginalSection C i k m).app ⊤ (1 : (a6W C i k).toScheme.presheaf.obj (op ⊤))) =
      Ideal.span {tautChartLocalFrameCoefficient Γ(X, C.U i)
        ((tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U i)))
        (rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis X (C.U i)) k m}
proof:
:= by
  let eρ : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (a6W C i k).ι).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι i)).obj (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))).val.obj
          (op ⊤) ≃ₗ[(a6W C i k).toScheme.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)]
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (a6W C i k).ι).obj
        (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex Γ(X, C.U i)
          ((tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U i)))
          (rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis X (C.U i)) 1)).val.obj (op ⊤) :=
    ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (a6W C i k).toScheme.ringCatSheaf (op ⊤)).mapIso
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (a6W C i k).ι).mapIso
        (rankTwo_canonicalChartSplitBasisIso C i 1))).toLinearEquiv
  have h1 := sectionEvaluationIdeal_linearEquiv eρ ((a6OriginalSection C i k m).app ⊤
    (1 : (a6W C i k).toScheme.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)))
  have h2 : eρ ((a6OriginalSection C i k m).app ⊤
      (1 : (a6W C i k).toScheme.presheaf.obj (op ⊤))) =
      (tautChartLocalSection Γ(X, C.U i)
        ((tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U i)))
        (rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis X (C.U i)) k m).app ⊤
        (1 : (a6W C i k).toScheme.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) :=
    congrArg (fun f => f.app ⊤ (1 : (a6W C i k).toScheme.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)))
      (a6_originalSection_comp C i k m)
  exact (h1.symm.trans (congrArg (fun x => sectionEvaluationIdeal (R := _) x) h2)).trans
    (tautChart_localFrame_evaluationIdeal _ _ _ k m)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.a6RingIso_appIso_inv
statement:
theorem a6RingIso_appIso_inv (i : C.I) (k : PUnit.{u+1} ⊕ PUnit.{u+1})
    (a : Γ(C.chart i, a6W C i k)) :
    (a6RingIso C i k).hom (((C.chartι i).appIso (a6Waff C i k)).inv.hom a) =
      (a6W C i k).topIso.inv.hom a
proof:
:= by
  unfold a6RingIso
  have h := congrArg (fun f : Γ(C.chart i, a6W C i k) ⟶ Γ(C.chart i, a6W C i k) => f.hom a)
    ((C.chartι i).appIso (a6Waff C i k)).inv_hom_id
  exact congrArg (a6W C i k).topIso.inv.hom h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.a6_frameCoefficient_eq_ratio
statement:
theorem a6_frameCoefficient_eq_ratio (i : C.I) (k : PUnit.{u+1} ⊕ PUnit.{u+1})
    (m : (tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U i))) :
    tautChartLocalFrameCoefficient Γ(X, C.U i)
        ((tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U i)))
        (rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis X (C.U i)) k m =
      (a6W C i k).topIso.inv
        (tautChart_ratioSection Γ(X, C.U i)
          ((tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U i)))
          (rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis X (C.U i) k) m)
proof:
:= by
  unfold tautChartLocalFrameCoefficient
  rw [← rankTwo_tautComponent_back _ _ _ m]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.a6_map_span_aux
statement:
theorem a6_map_span_aux (i : C.I) (k : PUnit.{u+1} ⊕ PUnit.{u+1})
    (I : Ideal Γ(C.scheme, C.chartι i ''ᵁ a6W C i k)) (e a : Γ(C.chart i, a6W C i k))
    (hea : e = a)
    (hI : I = Ideal.span {((C.chartι i).appIso (a6Waff C i k)).inv.hom e}) :
    Ideal.map (a6RingIso C i k).hom I = Ideal.span {(a6W C i k).topIso.inv.hom a}
proof:
:= by
  subst hea
  exact (congrArg (Ideal.map (a6RingIso C i k).hom) hI).trans
    ((Ideal.map_span _ _).trans (congrArg Ideal.span
      (Set.image_singleton.trans (congrArg (fun x => ({x} : Set _))
        (a6RingIso_appIso_inv C i k e)))))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.a6_left_kernel_eq_evaluationIdeal
statement:
theorem a6_left_kernel_eq_evaluationIdeal (i : C.I) (k : PUnit.{u+1} ⊕ PUnit.{u+1}) :
    Ideal.map (a6RingIso C i k).hom
        ((rankTwo_globalLeftSection C).ker.ideal
          ⟨C.chartι i ''ᵁ a6W C i k, (a6Waff C i k).2.image_of_isOpenImmersion _⟩) =
      sectionEvaluationIdeal
        (R := (a6W C i k).toScheme.presheaf.obj (op ⊤))
        ((a6OriginalSection C i k
            (rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis X (C.U i) (Sum.inr PUnit.unit))).app ⊤
          (1 : (a6W C i k).toScheme.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)))
proof:
:=
  (a6_map_span_aux C i k _ _ _ (rankTwo_originalGlobal_inr_coefficientBack C i k)
    (rankTwo_originalGlobalLeft_coordinateZeroIdeal C i k)).trans
    ((((a6_originalSection_evaluationIdeal C i k _).trans
      (congrArg (fun x => Ideal.span {x}) (a6_frameCoefficient_eq_ratio C i k _))).symm))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.a6_right_kernel_eq_evaluationIdeal

        ((rankTwo_globalRightSection C).ker.ideal
          ⟨C.chartι i ''ᵁ a6W C i k, (a6Waff C i k).2.image_of_isOpenImmersion _⟩) =
      sectionEvaluationIdeal

            (rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis X (C.U i) (Sum.inl PUnit.unit))).app ⊤
          (1 : (a6W C i k).toScheme.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)))
proof:
:=

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.eval₂Hom_mul_of_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem eval₂Hom_mul_of_isHomogeneous {ι R S : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S]
    (f : R →+* S) (g : ι → S) (z : S) {p : MvPolynomial ι R} {d : ℕ}
    (hp : p.IsHomogeneous d) :
    MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom f (fun j ↦ g j * z) p =
      MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom f g p * z ^ d
proof:
:= by
  rw [← p.support_sum_monomial_coeff, map_sum, map_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro m hm
  rw [MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_monomial, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_monomial,
    Finsupp.prod, Finsupp.prod]
  simp_rw [mul_pow]
  rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum,
    ← hp.degree_eq_sum_deg_support hm]
  ac_rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateRatio_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateRatio_val (i : Fin (n + 1)) (j : AffineChartIndex n i) :
    algebraMap (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading k n) (coordinate k n i))
        (Localization.Away (coordinate k n i)) (coordinateRatio k n i j) =
      algebraMap (Polynomial k n) (Localization.Away (coordinate k n i))
          (coordinate k n j.1) *
        IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (S := Localization.Away (coordinate k n i))
          (coordinate k n i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateRatio, HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply,
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, Localization.mk_eq_mk',
    IsLocalization.mk'_eq_mul_mk'_one]
  simp [IsLocalization.Away.invSelf]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coefficientToCoordinateAway_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coefficientToCoordinateAway_val (i : Fin (n + 1)) (a : k) :

        (Localization.Away (coordinate k n i)) (coefficientToCoordinateAway k n i a) =
      algebraMap (Polynomial k n) (Localization.Away (coordinate k n i))
        (MvPolynomial.C a)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coefficientToCoordinateAway, HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_eq,
    HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom, degreeZeroEquiv, RingHom.comp_apply,
    HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply]
  rw [← Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap]
  congr

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.dehomogenizeHom_coordinate_same
statement:
@[simp]

proof:
:= by

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.dehomogenizeHom_coordinate_ne
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dehomogenizeHom_coordinate_ne (i : Fin (n + 1)) (j : AffineChartIndex n i) :

proof:
:= by
