name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.awayCoordinateHom_comp_dehomogenizeHom_val
statement:
theorem awayCoordinateHom_comp_dehomogenizeHom_val (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    ((algebraMap (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading k n) (coordinate k n i))
        (Localization.Away (coordinate k n i))).comp (awayCoordinateHom k n i)).comp
        (dehomogenizeHom k n i) =
      MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom
        ((algebraMap (Polynomial k n) (Localization.Away (coordinate k n i))).comp
          MvPolynomial.C)
        (fun j ↦ algebraMap (Polynomial k n) (Localization.Away (coordinate k n i))
            (coordinate k n j) *
          IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (S := Localization.Away (coordinate k n i))
            (coordinate k n i))
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro a
    rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.comp_apply, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C]
    change algebraMap
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading k n) (coordinate k n i))
        (Localization.Away (coordinate k n i))
        (awayCoordinateHom k n i
          (dehomogenizeHom k n i (MvPolynomial.C a))) =
      algebraMap (Polynomial k n) (Localization.Away (coordinate k n i))
        (MvPolynomial.C a)
    rw [show dehomogenizeHom k n i (MvPolynomial.C a) = MvPolynomial.C a by
      simp [dehomogenizeHom]]
    simpa only [awayCoordinateHom, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C,
      HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply] using
        coefficientToCoordinateAway_val k n i a
  · intro j
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst j
      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.comp_apply, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X']
      change algebraMap
          (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading k n) (coordinate k n i))
          (Localization.Away (coordinate k n i))
          (awayCoordinateHom k n i
            (dehomogenizeHom k n i (coordinate k n i))) =
        algebraMap (Polynomial k n) (Localization.Away (coordinate k n i))
            (coordinate k n i) *
          IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (S := Localization.Away (coordinate k n i))
            (coordinate k n i)
      rw [dehomogenizeHom_coordinate_same]
      simpa only [map_one] using
          (IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf
            (S := Localization.Away (coordinate k n i)) (coordinate k n i)).symm
    · let j' : AffineChartIndex n i := ⟨j, hj⟩
      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.comp_apply, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X']
      change algebraMap
          (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading k n) (coordinate k n i))
          (Localization.Away (coordinate k n i))
          (awayCoordinateHom k n i
            (dehomogenizeHom k n i (MvPolynomial.X j))) =
        algebraMap (Polynomial k n) (Localization.Away (coordinate k n i))
            (coordinate k n j) *
          IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (S := Localization.Away (coordinate k n i))
            (coordinate k n i)
      rw [show dehomogenizeHom k n i (MvPolynomial.X j) = MvPolynomial.X j' by
        simp [dehomogenizeHom, j', hj]]
      rw [awayCoordinateHom, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X']
      simpa only [coordinate] using coordinateRatio_val k n i j'

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.awayCoordinateHom_dehomogenizeHom_val_of_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem awayCoordinateHom_dehomogenizeHom_val_of_isHomogeneous
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) {p : Polynomial k n} {d : ℕ} (hp : p.IsHomogeneous d) :
    algebraMap (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading k n) (coordinate k n i))
        (Localization.Away (coordinate k n i))
        (awayCoordinateHom k n i (dehomogenizeHom k n i p)) =
      algebraMap (Polynomial k n) (Localization.Away (coordinate k n i)) p *
        IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (S := Localization.Away (coordinate k n i))
          (coordinate k n i) ^ d
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp := RingHom.congr_fun
    (awayCoordinateHom_comp_dehomogenizeHom_val k n i) p
  rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.comp_apply] at hcomp
  have heval :
      MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom
          ((algebraMap (Polynomial k n) (Localization.Away (coordinate k n i))).comp
            MvPolynomial.C)
          (fun j ↦ algebraMap (Polynomial k n) (Localization.Away (coordinate k n i))
            (coordinate k n j)) =
        algebraMap (Polynomial k n) (Localization.Away (coordinate k n i)) := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro a
      simp
    · intro j
      rw [MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X']
      rfl
  calc
    _ = MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom
          ((algebraMap (Polynomial k n) (Localization.Away (coordinate k n i))).comp
            MvPolynomial.C)
          (fun j ↦ algebraMap (Polynomial k n) (Localization.Away (coordinate k n i))
              (coordinate k n j) *
            IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (S := Localization.Away (coordinate k n i))
              (coordinate k n i)) p := hcomp
    _ = MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom
          ((algebraMap (Polynomial k n) (Localization.Away (coordinate k n i))).comp
            MvPolynomial.C)
          (fun j ↦ algebraMap (Polynomial k n) (Localization.Away (coordinate k n i))
            (coordinate k n j)) p *
          IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (S := Localization.Away (coordinate k n i))
            (coordinate k n i) ^ d :=
      eval₂Hom_mul_of_isHomogeneous
        ((algebraMap (Polynomial k n) (Localization.Away (coordinate k n i))).comp
          MvPolynomial.C)
        (fun j ↦ algebraMap (Polynomial k n) (Localization.Away (coordinate k n i))
          (coordinate k n j))
        (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (S := Localization.Away (coordinate k n i))
          (coordinate k n i)) hp
    _ = _ := by rw [heval]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.awayMk_val_eq_mul_invSelf_pow
statement:
theorem awayMk_val_eq_mul_invSelf_pow (i : Fin (n + 1)) (d : ℕ)
    (p : Polynomial k n) (hp : p ∈ grading k n d) :
    algebraMap (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading k n) (coordinate k n i))
        (Localization.Away (coordinate k n i))
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading k n)
          (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) d p (by simpa using hp)) =
      algebraMap (Polynomial k n) (Localization.Away (coordinate k n i)) p *
        IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (S := Localization.Away (coordinate k n i))
          (coordinate k n i) ^ d
proof:
:= by
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk,
    Localization.mk_eq_mk', IsLocalization.mk'_eq_mul_mk'_one]
  congr 1
  unfold IsLocalization.Away.invSelf
  rw [← IsLocalization.mk'_pow]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.awayDehomogenizeHom_coefficient
statement:
@[simp]
theorem awayDehomogenizeHom_coefficient (i : Fin (n + 1)) (a : k) :
    awayDehomogenizeHom k n i (coefficientToCoordinateAway k n i a) =
      MvPolynomial.C a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [awayDehomogenizeHom, coefficientToCoordinateAway,
    localizationDehomogenizeHom, HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_eq,
    HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom, degreeZeroEquiv, RingHom.comp_apply,
    HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply]
  simpa [localizationDehomogenizeHom, dehomogenizeHom] using
    (Localization.awayLift_mk (dehomogenizeHom k n i) (coordinate k n i)
      (MvPolynomial.C a) 1 (by simp) 0)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.awayDehomogenizeHom_coordinateRatio
statement:
@[simp]
theorem awayDehomogenizeHom_coordinateRatio
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (j : AffineChartIndex n i) :

proof:

    HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk]

    (Localization.awayLift_mk (dehomogenizeHom k n i) (coordinate k n i)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.awayDehomogenizeHom_comp_awayCoordinateHom
statement:
theorem awayDehomogenizeHom_comp_awayCoordinateHom (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (awayDehomogenizeHom k n i).comp (awayCoordinateHom k n i) =
      RingHom.id (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) k)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.awayCoordinateHom_injective
statement:

    Function.Injective (awayCoordinateHom k n i)
proof:
:=
  Function.LeftInverse.injective (g := awayDehomogenizeHom k n i) fun p ↦ by
    exact RingHom.congr_fun (awayDehomogenizeHom_comp_awayCoordinateHom k n i) p

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.awayCoordinateHom_dehomogenizeHom_mk
statement:
theorem awayCoordinateHom_dehomogenizeHom_mk (i : Fin (n + 1)) (d : ℕ)
    (p : Polynomial k n) (hp : p ∈ grading k n d) :
    awayCoordinateHom k n i (dehomogenizeHom k n i p) =
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading k n)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) d p (by simpa using hp)
proof:
:= by
  apply (show Function.Injective
      (algebraMap (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading k n) (coordinate k n i))
        (Localization.Away (coordinate k n i))) from
    HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective _)
  rw [awayCoordinateHom_dehomogenizeHom_val_of_isHomogeneous k n i hp,
    awayMk_val_eq_mul_invSelf_pow k n i d p hp]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.awayCoordinateHom_surjective
statement:
theorem awayCoordinateHom_surjective (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Function.Surjective (awayCoordinateHom k n i)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨d, p, hp, rfl⟩ :=
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_surjective (grading k n)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) x
  refine ⟨dehomogenizeHom k n i p, ?_⟩
  simpa using awayCoordinateHom_dehomogenizeHom_mk k n i d p (by simpa using hp)

name: Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback_map_exact
statement:
theorem sheafPullback_map_exact {X Y : TopCat.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : IsOpenEmbedding f)
    (S : ShortComplex (Y.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u})) (hS : S.Exact) :
    (S.map (hf.sheafPullback (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u}))).Exact
proof:
:= by
  rw [TopCat.Sheaf.exact_iff_stalkFunctor_map_exact]
  intro x
  have h := (TopCat.Sheaf.exact_iff_stalkFunctor_map_exact S).1 hS (f x)
  change (S.map (hf.sheafPullback (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u}) ⋙
    TopCat.Sheaf.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u} X ⋙
      TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x)).Exact
  exact ShortComplex.exact_of_iso
    (S.mapNatIso (sheafPullbackStalkNatIso f hf x)).symm h

name: Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback_map_shortExact
statement:
theorem sheafPullback_map_shortExact {X Y : TopCat.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : IsOpenEmbedding f)
    (S : ShortComplex (Y.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u})) (hS : S.ShortExact) :
    (S.map (hf.sheafPullback (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u}))).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  have := hS.mono_f
  have := hS.epi_g
  apply ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk' (sheafPullback_map_exact f hf S hS.exact)
  · change Mono ((hf.sheafPullback (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u})).map S.f)
    infer_instance
  · change Epi ((hf.sheafPullback (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u})).map S.g)
    infer_instance

name: TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque.sheafPullback_isFlasque
statement:
theorem sheafPullback_isFlasque {X Y : TopCat.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : IsOpenEmbedding f) (F : Y.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u}) [F.IsFlasque] :
    (hf.sheafPullback (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u})).obj F |>.IsFlasque where
  epi {U V} i
proof:
:= by
    change Epi (F.obj.map ((hf.functor.map i.unop).op))
    infer_instance

name: TopCat.Sheaf.H_isZero_X3_of_shortExact
statement:
theorem H_isZero_X3_of_shortExact {X : TopCat.{u}}
    (S : ShortComplex (X.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u})) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (q : ℕ)
    (h₂ : IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H S.X₂ (q + 1))))
    (h₁ : IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H S.X₁ (q + 2)))) :
    IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H S.X₃ (q + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  letI : Subsingleton (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H S.X₃ (q + 1)) :=
    ⟨fun x y => by
      suffices ∀ z : CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H S.X₃ (q + 1), z = 0 by
        rw [this x, this y]
      intro z
      have hzδ : z.comp hS.extClass (by omega : (q + 1) + 1 = q + 2) = 0 :=
        (AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero h₁).elim _ _
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₃ _ hS z
        (by omega : (q + 1) + 1 = q + 2) hzδ
      have hw₀ : w = 0 := (AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero h₂).elim _ _
      calc
        z = w.comp (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ S.g) (add_zero (q + 1)) := hw.symm
        _ = 0 := by rw [hw₀]; simp⟩
  exact AddCommGrpCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.CoordinateCechAcyclic.X3_of_shortExact
statement:
theorem CoordinateCechAcyclic.X3_of_shortExact
    (S : ShortComplex
      (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space k n).toPresheafedSpace))
    (hS : S.ShortExact) (h₁ : CoordinateCechAcyclic k n S.X₁)
    [S.X₂.IsFlasque] : CoordinateCechAcyclic k n S.X₃
proof:
:= by
  intro p a q
  let j := (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).ι
  let P := j.isOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u})
  let T := S.map P
  have hT : T.ShortExact :=
    Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.sheafPullback_map_shortExact _ j.isOpenEmbedding S hS
  letI : T.X₂.IsFlasque :=
    TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque.sheafPullback_isFlasque _ j.isOpenEmbedding S.X₂
  apply TopCat.Sheaf.H_isZero_X3_of_shortExact T hT q
  · exact TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque.H_isZero T.X₂ q
  · change IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H (P.obj S.X₁) (q + 2)))
    have h := h₁ p a (q + 1)
    change IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H (P.obj S.X₁) ((q + 1) + 1))) at h
    convert h using 1

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateCechAcyclic
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateCechAcyclic (d : ℤ) :
    CoordinateCechAcyclic k n
      ((Modules.toSheafAb (space k n)).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d))
proof:
:= by
  intro p a q
  change IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
    (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
      ((Modules.toSheafAb (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).toScheme).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
          (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a).ι).obj
            (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d))) (q + 1)))
  exact projectiveTwistingCechIntersection_H_isZero k n d p a q

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.chart_toSpec
statement:
theorem chart_toSpec (i : Fin 2) :
    chart k i ≫ SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k 1 =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k[X]))
proof:
:= by
  unfold chart SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpecZero
  have key := Proj.awayι_toSpecZero (SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading k 1)
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinate k 1 i)
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinate_mem_degree_one k 1 i) Nat.zero_lt_one
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  erw [reassoc_of% key]
  rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  refine CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext fun a => ?_)
  have h1 : (HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom (SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading k 1)
      (Submonoid.powers (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinate k 1 i)))
      ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.degreeZeroEquiv k 1).symm a) =
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.awayCoordinateHom k 1 i (MvPolynomial.C a) := by
    rw [SchemeProjectiveSpace.awayCoordinateHom, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C]
    simp [SchemeProjectiveSpace.coefficientToCoordinateAway, HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_eq]
  change chartEquiv k i (HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom (SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading k 1)
      (Submonoid.powers (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinate k 1 i))
      ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.degreeZeroEquiv k 1).symm a)) = algebraMap k k[X] a
  rw [h1, chartEquiv_awayCoordinateHom]
  simp

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.pointAt_toSpec
statement:

proof:
:= by
  unfold pointAt
  rw [Category.assoc, chart_toSpec, ← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_id]
  congr 1
  refine CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext fun a => ?_)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.range_pointAt_subset
statement: theorem range_pointAt_subset (c : k) : Set.range (pointAt k c) ⊆ Set.range (chart k 1)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.pointAt_eq_lift

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.ker_specMap_eval_top
statement:
theorem ker_specMap_eval_top (c : k) :
    ∃ a : Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of k[X]), ⊤),
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom c))).ker.ideal
        ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩ = Ideal.span {a}
proof:
:= by
  set φ := CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom c) with hφ
  have hker : (Spec.map φ).ker.ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩ =
      (RingHom.ker φ.hom).comap
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k[X])).hom.hom := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.ker_apply]
    ext x
    have h := Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality φ
    have h2 := congrArg (fun q => q.hom x) h
    simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply] at h2
    simp only [RingHom.mem_ker, Ideal.mem_comap]
    change (Scheme.Hom.appTop (Spec.map φ)).hom x = 0 ↔ _
    rw [← map_eq_zero_iff (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).hom.hom
      (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _).1, h2]
  rw [hker]
  refine (exists_eq_span_comap_equiv_iff
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k[X])).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv _).2 ?_
  refine ⟨Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C c, ?_⟩
  exact Polynomial.ker_evalRingHom c

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.exists_gen_congr
proof:
:= by
  subst h; exact hU

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.ker_pointAt_principal_chart
statement:
theorem ker_pointAt_principal_chart (c : k) :
    ∃ b : Γ(P1 k, (chart k 1).opensRange),
      (pointAt k c).ker.ideal ⟨(chart k 1).opensRange, isAffineOpen_opensRange _⟩ =
        Ideal.span {b}
proof:
:= by
  have H := IsOpenImmersion.isPullback_lift_id (pointAt k c) (chart k 1)
    (range_pointAt_subset k c)
  rw [pointAt_eq_lift] at H
  have h1 := Scheme.ker_ideal_of_isPullback_of_isOpenImmersion
    (pointAt k c) _ (𝟙 _) (chart k 1) H ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := ker_specMap_eval_top k c
  rw [ha] at h1
  have h2 := (exists_eq_span_comap_equiv_iff
    ((chart k 1).appIso ⊤).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
    ((pointAt k c).ker.ideal ⟨(chart k 1) ''ᵁ ⊤, (isAffineOpen_top _).image_of_isOpenImmersion _⟩)).1
    ⟨a, h1.symm⟩
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := h2
  exact exists_gen_congr (pointAt k c).ker
    (U := ⟨(chart k 1) ''ᵁ ⊤, (isAffineOpen_top _).image_of_isOpenImmersion _⟩)
    (V := ⟨(chart k 1).opensRange, isAffineOpen_opensRange _⟩)
    (Subtype.ext (Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange _)) ⟨b, hb⟩

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.ideal_eq_top_of_disjoint_support
statement:
theorem ideal_eq_top_of_disjoint_support {X : Scheme.{u}} (I : X.IdealSheafData) (V : X.affineOpens)
    (h : ∀ z ∈ V.1, z ∉ I.support) : I.ideal V = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have := (V.2.fromSpec_image_zeroLocus (I.ideal V)).trans_subset
    (show X.zeroLocus (U := V.1) (I.ideal V) ∩ V ⊆ ∅ from fun z hz =>
      h z hz.2 (I.zeroLocus_inter_subset_supportSet V hz))
  simp only [Set.subset_empty_iff, Set.image_eq_empty] at this
  exact PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_empty_iff_eq_top.mp this

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveLine.locallyPrincipal_ker_pointAt
statement:
theorem locallyPrincipal_ker_pointAt (c : k) :
    IdealSheafIsLocallyPrincipal (pointAt k c).ker
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ (chart k 1).opensRange
  · obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := ker_pointAt_principal_chart k c
    exact ⟨⟨_, isAffineOpen_opensRange _⟩, hx, b, hb⟩
  · have hxr : x ∉ Set.range (pointAt k c) := fun h => hx (range_pointAt_subset k c h)
    have hsupp : x ∉ ((pointAt k c).ker.support : Set (P1 k)) := by
      rw [Scheme.Hom.support_ker]
      rwa [(pointAt k c).isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range.closure_eq]
    have hopen : IsOpen ((pointAt k c).ker.support : Set (P1 k))ᶜ :=
      (pointAt k c).ker.support.isClosed.isOpen_compl
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨V, hV, rfl⟩, hxV, hVs⟩ :=
      (P1 k).isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open hsupp hopen
    refine ⟨⟨V, hV⟩, hxV, 1, ?_⟩
    rw [ideal_eq_top_of_disjoint_support _ ⟨V, hV⟩ (fun z hz hzs => hVs hz hzs)]
    simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentPieceFinsuppLinearEquiv_apply

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentHigherTermFinsuppLinearEquiv_apply

theorem coordinateLaurentHigherTermFinsuppLinearEquiv_apply

    (x : coordinateLaurentHigherTerm R n d p)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentHigherTermFinsuppLinearEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateLaurentHigherTermFinsuppLinearEquiv_symm_apply
    (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (x : coordinateLaurentHigherTermBasisIndex n d p →₀ R)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (e : coordinateLaurentAllowedDegreeExponent n d p a) :
    (((coordinateLaurentHigherTermFinsuppLinearEquiv R n d p).symm x) a).1 e.1 =

proof:

    ((coordinateLaurentHigherTermFinsuppLinearEquiv R n d p).apply_symm_apply x)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentHigherTermBaseChangeLinearEquiv_tmul_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateLaurentHigherTermBaseChangeLinearEquiv_tmul_apply
    (φ : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (s : S) (x : coordinateLaurentHigherTerm R n d p)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (e : coordinateLaurentAllowedDegreeExponent n d p a) :
    ((coordinateLaurentHigherTermBaseChangeLinearEquiv
      S φ n d p (s ⊗ₜ[R,φ] x)) a).1 e.1 =
        s * φ ((x a).1 e.1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI := φ.toAlgebra
  simp only [coordinateLaurentHigherTermBaseChangeLinearEquiv,
    LinearEquiv.trans_apply, Iso.toLinearEquiv_apply]
  rw [coordinateLaurentHigherTermFinsuppLinearEquiv_symm_apply]
  erw [ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.map_tmul]
  erw [TensorProduct.finsuppScalarRight_apply_tmul_apply]
  let ae : coordinateLaurentHigherTermBasisIndex n d p := ⟨a, e⟩
  change
    coordinateLaurentHigherTermFinsuppLinearEquiv R n d p x ae • s =
      s * φ ((x a).1 e.1)
  rw [coordinateLaurentHigherTermFinsuppLinearEquiv_apply]
  change φ ((x a).1 e.1) * s = s * φ ((x a).1 e.1)
  rw [mul_comm]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentHigherTermBaseChangeLinearEquiv_tmul_apply'
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentHigherTermBaseChangeLinearEquiv_tmul_apply'
    (φ : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (s : S) (x : coordinateLaurentHigherTerm R n d p)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (e : CoordinateLaurentExponent n) :
    ((coordinateLaurentHigherTermBaseChangeLinearEquiv
      S φ n d p (s ⊗ₜ[R,φ] x)) a).1 e =
        s * φ ((x a).1 e)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases he :
      coordinateLaurentTotalDegree n e = d ∧ e.AllowedOn n a
  · exact coordinateLaurentHigherTermBaseChangeLinearEquiv_tmul_apply
      S φ n d p s x a ⟨e, he⟩
  · have hx : (x a).1 e = 0 := by
      by_contra hxe
      exact he ((x a).2 e hxe)
    have hy :
        ((coordinateLaurentHigherTermBaseChangeLinearEquiv
          S φ n d p (s ⊗ₜ[R,φ] x)) a).1 e = 0 := by
      by_contra hye
      exact he
        (((coordinateLaurentHigherTermBaseChangeLinearEquiv
          S φ n d p (s ⊗ₜ[R,φ] x)) a).2 e hye)
    rw [hx, hy, map_zero, mul_zero]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentHigherTermBaseChangeIso_differential
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentHigherTermBaseChangeIso_differential
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing S]
    (φ : R →+* S) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    (ModuleCat.extendScalars φ).map
          (ModuleCat.ofHom
            (coordinateLaurentHigherDifferentialLinear R n d p)) ≫
        (coordinateLaurentHigherTermBaseChangeIso S φ n d (p + 1)).hom =
      (coordinateLaurentHigherTermBaseChangeIso S φ n d p).hom ≫
        ModuleCat.ofHom
          (coordinateLaurentHigherDifferentialLinear S n d p)
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.hom_ext
  intro x
  let x' : coordinateLaurentHigherTerm R n d p := x
  change
    coordinateLaurentHigherTermBaseChangeLinearEquiv S φ n d (p + 1)
        ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φ).map
          (ModuleCat.ofHom
            (coordinateLaurentHigherDifferentialLinear R n d p))
          ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R,φ] x')) =
      coordinateLaurentHigherDifferentialLinear S n d p
        (coordinateLaurentHigherTermBaseChangeLinearEquiv S φ n d p
          ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R,φ] x'))
  funext a
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro e
  erw [ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.map_tmul]
  erw [coordinateLaurentHigherTermBaseChangeLinearEquiv_tmul_apply']
  change
    1 * φ ((coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential R n d p x' a).1 e) =
      (coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential S n d p
        (coordinateLaurentHigherTermBaseChangeLinearEquiv S φ n d p
          ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R,φ] x')) a).1 e
  rw [coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_apply_coeff]
  rw [coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_apply_coeff]
  rw [one_mul, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  rw [map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, map_one]
  rw [coordinateLaurentHigherTermBaseChangeLinearEquiv_tmul_apply'
    S φ n d p (1 : S) x' (a ∘ r.succAbove) e]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentHigherDifferentialLinear_comp
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentHigherDifferentialLinear_comp
    [IsNoetherianRing R] (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    (coordinateLaurentHigherDifferentialLinear R n d (p + 1)).comp
        (coordinateLaurentHigherDifferentialLinear R n d p) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  let e₀ := coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv R n d p
  let e₁ := coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv R n d (p + 1)
  let e₂ := coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv R n d (p + 2)
  let y := e₀.symm x
  have h₀ :
      e₁ (coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential R n d p y) =
        coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential R n d p x := by
    rw [coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential_eq_transported_unconditional]
    simpa [e₀, e₁, y] using
      coordinateCechTwistingTransportedHigherDifferential_toLaurent R n d p y
  have h₁ :
      e₂ (coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential R n d (p + 1)
          (coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential R n d p y)) =
        coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential R n d (p + 1)
          (coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential R n d p x) := by
    rw [coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential_eq_transported_unconditional]
    rw [coordinateCechTwistingTransportedHigherDifferential_toLaurent]
    rw [h₀]
  have hdd :
      coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential R n d (p + 1)
          (coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential R n d p y) = 0 := by
    let K := projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex R n d
    have h := K.d_comp_d p (p + 1) (p + 2)
    change
      ((K.d p (p + 1) ≫ K.d (p + 1) (p + 2)).hom : _ →+ _) y = 0
    rw [h]
    rfl
  change
    coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential R n d (p + 1)
        (coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential R n d p x) = 0
  rw [← h₁, hdd, map_zero]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentHigherComplex_d
statement:

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentHigherComplex_sc'_g

theorem coordinateLaurentHigherComplex_sc'_g

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentHigherComplex_sc'_f
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateLaurentHigherComplex_sc'_f
    [IsNoetherianRing R] (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    ((coordinateLaurentHigherComplex (R := R) n d).sc'
      p (p + 1) (p + 2)).f =

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentPositiveBoundaries_map_cycleEquiv
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentPositiveBoundaries_map_cycleEquiv
    [IsNoetherianRing R] (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    (coordinateLaurentPositiveBoundaries R n d p).map
        (coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesComplexKerLinearEquiv
          (R := R) n d p).toLinearMap =
      LinearMap.range
        ((coordinateLaurentHigherComplex (R := R) n d).sc'
          p (p + 1) (p + 2)).moduleCatToCycles
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    change z.1 ∈
      LinearMap.range
        (coordinateLaurentHigherDifferentialLinear R n d p) at hz
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hz
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    change
      (((coordinateLaurentHigherComplex (R := R) n d).sc'
        p (p + 1) (p + 2)).f.hom) y = z.1
    rw [coordinateLaurentHigherComplex_sc'_f]
    exact hy
  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    let e := coordinateLaurentPositiveCyclesComplexKerLinearEquiv
      (R := R) n d p
    refine ⟨e.symm x, ?_, e.apply_symm_apply x⟩
    change (e.symm x).1 ∈
      LinearMap.range
        (coordinateLaurentHigherDifferentialLinear R n d p)
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hy
    change
      (((coordinateLaurentHigherComplex (R := R) n d).sc'
        p (p + 1) (p + 2)).f.hom) y = x.1 at hval
    rw [coordinateLaurentHigherComplex_sc'_f] at hval
    exact hval

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.coeff_expLine
statement:
theorem coeff_expLine (c : Alg.Op M) (m : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff m (expLine c) = ((m.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) • c ^ m
proof:
:= by
  simp [expLine]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.gexp_eq_tot_expLine
statement: theorem gexp_eq_tot_expLine (c : Alg.Op M) : Alg.gexp c = tot (expLine c)
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro y
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, Alg.gexp_lof, tot_lof]
  simp only [LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, coeff_expLine]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.pow_mem_lowSub
statement: theorem pow_mem_lowSub {c : Alg.Op M} (hc : c ∈ lowSub M 1) (m : ℕ) : c ^ m ∈ lowSub M m
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero]; exact (lowFam M).one_mem
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [pow_succ]
    exact (lowFam M).mul_mem ih hc

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.gSer_expLine
statement: theorem gSer_expLine {c : Alg.Op M} (hc : c ∈ lowSub M 1) : GSer (lowFam M) (expLine c)
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  rw [coeff_expLine]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (pow_mem_lowSub hc m)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.expLine_add
statement:
theorem expLine_add {c d : Alg.Op M} (h : Commute c d) :
    expLine (c + d) = expLine c * expLine d
proof:
:= by
  refine PowerSeries.ext fun m => ?_
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul, coeff_expLine, h.add_pow,
    Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk, Finset.smul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp => ?_
  have hp' : p ≤ m := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hp)
  simp only [coeff_expLine]
  have hc : ((m.choose p : ℕ) : Alg.Op M) = ((m.choose p : ℚ)) • (1 : Alg.Op M) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]
    simp
  have key : ((m.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) * (m.choose p : ℚ) =
      ((p.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) * (((m - p).factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) := by
    have h1 := Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial hp'
    have h2 : (m.choose p : ℚ) * (p.factorial : ℚ) * ((m - p).factorial : ℚ) = (m.factorial : ℚ) := by
      exact_mod_cast h1
    have h3 : (p.factorial : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have h4 : ((m - p).factorial : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have h5 : (m.factorial : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp
    linear_combination h2
  rw [hc, mul_smul_comm, mul_one, smul_smul, smul_mul_smul_comm, key]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.gexp_add
statement:
theorem gexp_add {c d : Alg.Op M} (hc : c ∈ lowSub M 1) (hd : d ∈ lowSub M 1) (h : Commute c d) :
    Alg.gexp (c + d) = Alg.gexp c * Alg.gexp d
proof:
:= by
  rw [gexp_eq_tot_expLine, gexp_eq_tot_expLine, gexp_eq_tot_expLine, expLine_add h,
    tot_mul (gSer_expLine hc) (gSer_expLine hd)]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.chK_classOf

theorem chK_classOf (E : W.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree W E) :
    chK k W (k0ClassOf W E hE) = chBundle k (hPk k) E
proof:
:=
  chK0_classOf (k := k) (hP := hPk k) (h := _) E hE

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.chK_line

theorem chK_line (L : W.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank W L 1) :
    chK k W (k0ClassOf W L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree) = Alg.gexp (totalCapOn (opsV4 k) L hL)
proof:
:= by

  exact GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.chBundle_line (hPk k) L hL

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.totalCapOn_mem_lowSub
statement:
theorem totalCapOn_mem_lowSub (L : W.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank W L 1) :
    totalCapOn (opsV4 k) L hL ∈ lowSub (fun n => RationalDimChow W n) 1
proof:
:=
  totalCapOn_mem_lowering (opsV4 k) L hL

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.totalCapOn_commute
statement:
theorem totalCapOn_commute (L L' : W.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank W L 1)
    (hL' : HasConstantRank W L' 1) :
    Commute (totalCapOn (opsV4 k) L hL) (totalCapOn (opsV4 k) L' hL')
proof:
:=
  (cpV4 k).cap_comm L L' hL hL'

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.chK_tensor_line
statement:
theorem chK_tensor_line (L L' : W.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank W L 1)
    (hL' : HasConstantRank W L' 1) (hT : HasConstantRank W (tensorSheaf W L' L) 1) :
    chK k W (k0ClassOf W (tensorSheaf W L' L) hT.isFiniteLocallyFree) =
      chK k W (k0ClassOf W L' hL'.isFiniteLocallyFree) *
        chK k W (k0ClassOf W L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chK_line _ hT, chK_line _ hL', chK_line _ hL,
    totalCapOn_tensor (ops := opsV4 k) L' L hL' hL hT]
  exact gexp_add (totalCapOn_mem_lowSub L' hL') (totalCapOn_mem_lowSub L hL)
    (totalCapOn_commute L' L hL' hL)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.hasConstantRank_tensor_line
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_tensor_line {L L' : W.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank W L 1)
    (hL' : HasConstantRank W L' 1) : HasConstantRank W (tensorSheaf W L' L) 1
proof:
:= by
  have := hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hL' hL
  rwa [Nat.mul_one] at this

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.k0ClassOf_mul_line
statement:
theorem k0ClassOf_mul_line {L L' : W.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank W L 1)
    (hL' : HasConstantRank W L' 1) :
    k0ClassOf W L' hL'.isFiniteLocallyFree * k0ClassOf W L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree =
      k0ClassOf W (tensorSheaf W L' L) (hasConstantRank_tensor_line hL hL').isFiniteLocallyFree
proof:
:=
  (ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.k0ClassOf_twistBy L hL hL'.isFiniteLocallyFree
    (hasConstantRank_tensor_line hL hL').isFiniteLocallyFree).symm

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.isLineClass_mul
statement:
theorem isLineClass_mul {x y : K0 W} (hx : IsLineKClass W x) (hy : IsLineKClass W y) :
    IsLineKClass W (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L', hL', rfl⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨L, hL, rfl⟩ := hy
  exact ⟨tensorSheaf W L' L, hasConstantRank_tensor_line hL hL', k0ClassOf_mul_line hL hL'⟩

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.isLineClass_one
statement: theorem isLineClass_one : IsLineKClass W (1 : K0 W)
proof:
:=
  ⟨tensorUnitSheaf W, hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf, rfl⟩

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.lineSpan_mul_line
statement:
theorem lineSpan_mul_line {ℓ : K0 W} (hℓ : IsLineKClass W ℓ) {y : K0 W} (hy : y ∈ lineSpan W) :
    y * ℓ ∈ lineSpan W
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx => exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure (isLineClass_mul hx hℓ)
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | neg x _ hx => rw [neg_mul]; exact neg_mem hx

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.one_mem_lineSpan
statement: theorem one_mem_lineSpan : (1 : K0 W) ∈ lineSpan W
proof: := AddSubgroup.subset_closure isLineClass_one

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.chK_mul_line
statement:
theorem chK_mul_line {ℓ : K0 W} (hℓ : IsLineKClass W ℓ) {y : K0 W} (hy : y ∈ lineSpan W) :
    chK k W (y * ℓ) = chK k W y * chK k W ℓ
proof:
:= by
  induction hy using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨L', hL', rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨L, hL, rfl⟩ := hℓ
    rw [k0ClassOf_mul_line hL hL']
    exact chK_tensor_line L L' hL hL' (hasConstantRank_tensor_line hL hL')
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [add_mul, map_add, map_add, hx, hy, add_mul]
  | neg x _ hx => rw [neg_mul, map_neg, map_neg, hx]; exact LinearMap.ext fun v => by simp

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.chK_one
statement: theorem chK_one : chK k W (1 : K0 W) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : (1 : K0 W) = k0ClassOf W (tensorUnitSheaf W)
      (hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf (Y := W)).isFiniteLocallyFree := rfl
  rw [h, chK_line _ (hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf (Y := W)), totalCapOn_tensorUnit (ops := opsV4 k)]
  exact Alg.gexp_zero

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearOverlapAwayCast_mk
statement:
private theorem linearOverlapAwayCast_mk
    {p q : SymmetricAlgebra S N} (h : p = q)
    (hp : p ∈ symGrading S N 2) (r : SymmetricAlgebra S N)
    (hr : r ∈ symGrading S N 2) :
    (RingEquiv.cast
        (R := fun a : SymmetricAlgebra S N ↦
          HomogeneousLocalization.Away (symGrading S N) a) h).toRingHom
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (symGrading S N) hp 1 r
          (by simpa using hr)) =
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (symGrading S N) (h ▸ hp) 1 r
        (by simpa using hr)
proof:
:= by
  subst q
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearOverlapAwayMapNormalized_ratio
statement:
@[simp]
theorem linearOverlapAwayMapNormalized_ratio
    (φ : M →ₗ[R] N) (x y : M) :
    linearOverlapAwayMapNormalized φ x y (linearOverlapRatio R M x y) =
      linearOverlapRatio S N (φ x) (φ y)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [linearOverlapAwayMapNormalized, RingHom.comp_apply,
    linearOverlapAwayMap, linearOverlapAwayTargetEquiv, linearOverlapRatio,
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map_mk]
  simpa only [map_pow, gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap_linearForm] using
    linearOverlapAwayCast_mk (S := S) (N := N)
      (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap_linearOverlapEquation
        (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N) φ x y)
      ((gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap
          (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N) φ).map_mem
        (linearOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two R M x y))
      (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap
        (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N) φ (linearForm R M y ^ 2))
      ((gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap
          (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N) φ).map_mem
        (SetLike.pow_mem_graded 2 (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M y)))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearOverlapAwayMapNormalized_ratioUnit

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearOverlapAwayMapNormalized_transitionUnit

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.symmetricProjMap_preimage_linearOpen
statement:
theorem symmetricProjMap_preimage_linearOpen
    (φ : M →ₗ[R] N) (hspan : Submodule.span S (Set.range φ) = ⊤) (m : M) :
    symmetricProjMap φ hspan ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M m =
      linearOpen S N (φ m)
proof:
:= by
  change
    Proj.map (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ)
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ hspan) ⁻¹ᵁ
        Proj.basicOpen (symGrading R M) (linearForm R M m) =
      Proj.basicOpen (symGrading S N) (linearForm S N (φ m))
  rw [Proj.map_preimage_basicOpen]
  congr 1
  exact gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap_linearForm φ m

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.symmetricProjMap_preimage_linearOverlapOpen
statement:
theorem symmetricProjMap_preimage_linearOverlapOpen
    (φ : M →ₗ[R] N) (hspan : Submodule.span S (Set.range φ) = ⊤) (x y : M) :
    symmetricProjMap φ hspan ⁻¹ᵁ linearOverlapOpen R M x y =
      linearOverlapOpen S N (φ x) (φ y)
proof:
:= by
  change
    Proj.map (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ)
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ hspan) ⁻¹ᵁ
        Proj.basicOpen (symGrading R M) (linearOverlapEquation R M x y) =
      Proj.basicOpen (symGrading S N)
        (linearOverlapEquation S N (φ x) (φ y))
  rw [Proj.map_preimage_basicOpen]
  congr 1
  exact gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap_linearOverlapEquation φ x y

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.semilinearLinearOverlapAwayMapNormalized_ratio
statement:
@[simp]
theorem semilinearLinearOverlapAwayMapNormalized_ratio
    (f : R →+* S) (φ : M →ₛₗ[f] N) (x y : M) :
    semilinearLinearOverlapAwayMapNormalized f φ x y
        (linearOverlapRatio R M x y) =
      linearOverlapRatio S N (φ x) (φ y)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra R S := f.toAlgebra
  letI : Module R N := Module.compHom N f
  letI : IsScalarTower R S N :=
    ⟨fun r s n ↦ by
      change (f r * s) • n = f r • s • n
      rw [mul_smul]⟩
  change
    linearOverlapAwayMapNormalized
        (semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f φ) x y
        (linearOverlapRatio R M x y) =
      linearOverlapRatio S N
        (semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f φ x)
        (semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f φ y)
  exact linearOverlapAwayMapNormalized_ratio
    (semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f φ) x y

        (linearTwistTransitionUnit R M d x y) =

proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra R S := f.toAlgebra
  letI : Module R N := Module.compHom N f
  letI : IsScalarTower R S N :=
    ⟨fun r s n ↦ by

      rw [mul_smul]⟩
  change
    Units.map
        (linearOverlapAwayMapNormalized
          (semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f φ) x y).toMonoidHom
        (linearTwistTransitionUnit R M d x y) =
      linearTwistTransitionUnit S N d
        (semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f φ x)
        (semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f φ y)
  exact linearOverlapAwayMapNormalized_transitionUnit
    (semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f φ) d x y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E24.unit_free_of_generator
statement:
theorem unit_free_of_generator {Y S : Scheme.{u}} (j : S ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (F : Y.Modules)
    (φ : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).obj F ≅ SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf)
    {T : Y.Opens} (hT : j.opensRange ≤ T) (t : Γ(F, T))
    (ht : φ.hom.app ⊤ (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE ((j.image_le_opensRange ⊤).trans hT)).op t) =
      (1 : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (V0 : S.Opens) (w : Γ(S, V0))
    (h : (j.appIso V0).inv w • F.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE ((j.image_le_opensRange V0).trans hT)).op t = 0) : w = 0
proof:
:= by
  let x : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).obj F, V0) :=
    F.presheaf.map (homOfLE ((j.image_le_opensRange V0).trans hT)).op t
  have hx : φ.hom.app V0 x = (1 : Γ(S, V0)) := by
    have e : x = ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).obj F).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_top : V0 ≤ ⊤)).op
        (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE ((j.image_le_opensRange ⊤).trans hT)).op t) := by
      change _ = F.presheaf.map _ (F.presheaf.map _ t)
      rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
      rfl
    rw [e, tautChart_app_map, ht]
    exact map_one (S.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V0 ≤ ⊤)).op).hom
  have h' : w • x = 0 := h
  have h2 := congrArg (φ.hom.app V0) h'
  rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul, hx] at h2
  have h3 : φ.hom.app V0 (0 : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).obj F, V0)) = 0 :=
    map_zero (φ.hom.app V0).hom
  rw [h3] at h2
  have h4 : w • (1 : Γ(S, V0)) = w := by
    change w * 1 = w
    rw [mul_one]
  exact h4.symm.trans h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E24.litU_le
statement: theorem litU_le (ij : Σ i : C.I, C.basisIndex i) : litU C ij ≤ C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U ij.1
proof:
:=
  ((litJ C ij).image_le_opensRange ⊤).trans (tautQuotient_toBase_range_le C ij.1 ij.2)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E24.litU_cover

:= by
  have h := C.literalLinearOpenCover.iSup_opensRange

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E24.litG_generates
statement:
theorem litG_generates (ij : Σ i : C.I, C.basisIndex i)
    (s : Γ(C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1, litU C ij)) : ∃ a : Γ(C.scheme, litU C ij),
      s = a • litG C ij
proof:
:=
  tautQuotient_generating_of_unitIso (litJ C ij) (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheafLiteralLinearOpenIso 1 ij)
    (tautQuotient_toBase_range_le C ij.1 ij.2) (tautQuotient_t C ij.1 ij.2)
    (tautQuotient_literal_t C ij.1 ij.2) ⊤ s

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E24.litG_free
statement:
theorem litG_free (ij : Σ i : C.I, C.basisIndex i) (V : C.scheme.Opens)
    (hV : V ≤ litU C ij) (r : Γ(C.scheme, V))
    (h : r • (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op (litG C ij) = 0) :
    r = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V0, rfl⟩ : ∃ V0 : (C.literalLinearOpen ij).toScheme.Opens, V = litJ C ij ''ᵁ V0 :=
    ⟨litJ C ij ⁻¹ᵁ V, by
      rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, ← Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange]
      exact (inf_eq_right.2 hV).symm⟩
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ : ∃ w : Γ((C.literalLinearOpen ij).toScheme, V0),
      r = ((litJ C ij).appIso V0).inv w :=
    ⟨((litJ C ij).appIso V0).hom r, (Iso.hom_inv_id_apply _ _).symm⟩
  have hw := unit_free_of_generator (litJ C ij) (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheafLiteralLinearOpenIso 1 ij)
    (tautQuotient_toBase_range_le C ij.1 ij.2) (tautQuotient_t C ij.1 ij.2)
    (tautQuotient_literal_t C ij.1 ij.2) V0 w (by
      rw [← h, litG, ← Functor.map_comp_apply]
      rfl)
  rw [hw, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E24.taut_app_eq_quotient_unit
statement:
theorem taut_app_eq_quotient_unit (U : S.Opens) (e : Γ(D, U)) :
    C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.app U e =
      C.tautologicalQuotient.app (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ U)
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction C.toBase).unit.app D).app U e)
proof:
:= by
  let adj := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction C.toBase
  have hα : C.tautologicalPushforwardHom =
      adj.unit.app D ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.toBase).map C.tautologicalQuotient :=
    ((adj.homEquiv _ _).apply_symm_apply C.tautologicalPushforwardHom).symm.trans
      (Adjunction.homEquiv_unit _ _ _ _)
  rw [hα]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two
statement:
theorem coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateOverlapEquation k n i j ∈ grading k n 2
proof:
:= by
  simpa [coordinateOverlapEquation] using
    SetLike.mul_mem_graded (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n j)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapRatio_mul_inv
statement:
theorem coordinateOverlapRatio_mul_inv (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateOverlapRatio k n i j * coordinateOverlapRatioInv k n i j = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp only [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul, coordinateOverlapRatio,
    coordinateOverlapRatioInv, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk,
    HomogeneousLocalization.val_one, Localization.mk_mul]
  rw [← Localization.mk_one]
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, Submonoid.coe_mul, mul_one, pow_one]
  change coordinate k n j ^ 2 * coordinate k n i ^ 2 =
    (coordinate k n i * coordinate k n j) *
      (coordinate k n i * coordinate k n j)
  ring

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapRatio_inv_mul
statement:
theorem coordinateOverlapRatio_inv_mul (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateOverlapRatioInv k n i j * coordinateOverlapRatio k n i j = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm]
  exact coordinateOverlapRatio_mul_inv k n i j

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateTripleEquation_mem_degree_three
statement:
theorem coordinateTripleEquation_mem_degree_three (i j l : Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateTripleEquation k n i j l ∈ grading k n 3
proof:
:= by
  simpa [coordinateTripleEquation] using
    SetLike.mul_mem_graded
      (SetLike.mul_mem_graded (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n j))
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n l)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateTripleRatio_cocycle
statement:
theorem coordinateTripleRatio_cocycle (i j l : Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateTripleRatioIJ k n i j l * coordinateTripleRatioJL k n i j l =
      coordinateTripleRatioIL k n i j l
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp only [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul, coordinateTripleRatioIJ,
    coordinateTripleRatioJL, coordinateTripleRatioIL,
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, Localization.mk_mul]
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, Submonoid.coe_mul, pow_one]
  change
    coordinateTripleEquation k n i j l *
        ((coordinate k n j ^ 2 * coordinate k n l) *
          (coordinate k n l ^ 2 * coordinate k n i)) =
      (coordinateTripleEquation k n i j l *
          coordinateTripleEquation k n i j l) *
        (coordinate k n l ^ 2 * coordinate k n j)
  simp only [coordinateTripleEquation]
  ring

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapToTripleIJ_ratio
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateOverlapToTripleIJ_ratio (i j l : Fin (n + 1)) :

proof:

  unfold coordinateOverlapToTripleIJ coordinateOverlapRatio coordinateTripleRatioIJ
  unfold HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk

  simp only [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mk, pow_one]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapToTripleJL_ratio

theorem coordinateOverlapToTripleJL_ratio (i j l : Fin (n + 1)) :

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapRatio_cocycle
statement:
theorem coordinateOverlapRatio_cocycle (i j l : Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateOverlapToTripleIJ k n i j l (coordinateOverlapRatio k n i j) *
        coordinateOverlapToTripleJL k n i j l (coordinateOverlapRatio k n j l) =
      coordinateOverlapToTripleIL k n i j l (coordinateOverlapRatio k n i l)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateOverlapToTripleIJ_ratio, coordinateOverlapToTripleJL_ratio,

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapRatioTripleUnit_cocycle

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.twistTransitionUnit_cocycle
statement:
theorem twistTransitionUnit_cocycle (d : ℤ) (i j l : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Units.map (coordinateOverlapToTripleIJ k n i j l).toMonoidHom
          (twistTransitionUnit k n d i j) *
        Units.map (coordinateOverlapToTripleJL k n i j l).toMonoidHom
          (twistTransitionUnit k n d j l) =
      Units.map (coordinateOverlapToTripleIL k n i j l).toMonoidHom
        (twistTransitionUnit k n d i l)
proof:
:= by
  rw [twistTransitionUnit, twistTransitionUnit, twistTransitionUnit,
    map_zpow, map_zpow, map_zpow, ← mul_zpow]
  change (coordinateOverlapRatioTripleUnitIJ k n i j l *
      coordinateOverlapRatioTripleUnitJL k n i j l) ^ d =
    coordinateOverlapRatioTripleUnitIL k n i j l ^ d
  rw [coordinateOverlapRatioTripleUnit_cocycle]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.unionInlOverlapBaseMap_eq
statement:
private theorem unionInlOverlapBaseMap_eq (C C' : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (i j : C.I) :
    unionInlOverlapBaseMap C C' i j =
      inlOverlapBaseMap C i j ≫ (C.isoUnionLeft C').hom
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = C.overlapToChart i j ≫ (C.union C').chartι (Sum.inl i) := rfl
    _ = C.overlapToChart i j ≫ (C.chartι i ≫ (C.isoUnionLeft C').hom) :=
      congrArg (fun q => C.overlapToChart i j ≫ q)
        (C.chartι_isoUnionLeft_hom C' i).symm
    _ = (C.overlapToChart i j ≫ C.chartι i) ≫ (C.isoUnionLeft C').hom :=
      (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = _ := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.unionInrOverlapBaseMap_eq
statement:
private theorem unionInrOverlapBaseMap_eq (C C' : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (i j : C'.I) :
    unionInrOverlapBaseMap C C' i j =
      inrOverlapBaseMap C' i j ≫ (C.isoUnionRight C').hom
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = C'.overlapToChart i j ≫ (C.union C').chartι (Sum.inr i) := rfl
    _ = C'.overlapToChart i j ≫ (C'.chartι i ≫ (C.isoUnionRight C').hom) :=
      congrArg (fun q => C'.overlapToChart i j ≫ q)
        (C.chartι_isoUnionRight_hom C' i).symm
    _ = (C'.overlapToChart i j ≫ C'.chartι i) ≫ (C.isoUnionRight C').hom :=
      (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = _ := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushforwardPiIso_hom_π
statement:
private theorem pushforwardPiIso_hom_π {Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : Y ⟶ Z) {I : Type u} (F : I → Y.Modules) (i : I) :
    (pushforwardPiIso f F).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map (Pi.π F i) =
        Pi.π (fun j : I => (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj (F j)) i
proof:
:= by
  let H := Scheme.Modules.pushforward f
  have hIso : (PreservesProduct.iso H F).inv = inv (piComparison H F) := by
    apply (cancel_mono (PreservesProduct.iso H F).hom).1
    rw [Iso.inv_hom_id, PreservesProduct.iso_hom, IsIso.inv_hom_id]
  change (PreservesProduct.iso H F).inv ≫ H.map (Pi.π F i) = _
  rw [hIso]
  exact inv_piComparison_comp_map_π H F i

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.unionDescentInl_chartCochainsIso_hom_π
statement:
theorem unionDescentInl_chartCochainsIso_hom_π (C C' : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (d : ℤ) (i : C.I) :
    (C.unionDescentInl_chartCochainsIso C' d).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.isoUnionLeft C').hom).map
        (Pi.π (C.twistingSheafDescentData d
          (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d)).chartTerm i) =
      Pi.π (C.unionDescentInl C' d).chartTerm i ≫
        (C.unionDescentInl_chartTermIso C' d i).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [unionDescentInl_chartCochainsIso, Iso.trans_hom,
    Category.assoc, pushforwardPiIso_hom_π]
  exact Pi.mapIso_hom_π _ i

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.unionDescentInl_overlapCochainsIso_hom_π
statement:

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.mem_coordinateCechWordSupport_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_coordinateCechWordSupport_iff {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (a : ι → Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    i ∈ coordinateCechWordSupport n a ↔ ∃ j, a j = i
proof:
:= by
  simp [coordinateCechWordSupport]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechWordSupport_comp_succAbove_subset
statement:
theorem coordinateCechWordSupport_comp_succAbove_subset {p : ℕ}
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) (r : Fin (p + 2)) :
    coordinateCechWordSupport n (a ∘ r.succAbove) ⊆
      coordinateCechWordSupport n a
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  rw [mem_coordinateCechWordSupport_iff] at hi ⊢
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hi
  exact ⟨r.succAbove j, rfl⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechWordSupport_card_comp_succAbove_le
statement:
theorem coordinateCechWordSupport_card_comp_succAbove_le {p : ℕ}
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) (r : Fin (p + 2)) :
    (coordinateCechWordSupport n (a ∘ r.succAbove)).card ≤
      (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card
proof:
:=
  Finset.card_le_card
    (coordinateCechWordSupport_comp_succAbove_subset n a r)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechWordSupport_comp_eq_of_surjective
statement:
theorem coordinateCechWordSupport_comp_eq_of_surjective
    {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (a : κ → Fin (n + 1)) (f : ι → κ) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    coordinateCechWordSupport n (a ∘ f) =
      coordinateCechWordSupport n a
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.ext
  intro i
  simp only [mem_coordinateCechWordSupport_iff, Function.comp_apply]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨f j, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hf j
    exact ⟨t, rfl⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechWordSupport_card_comp_lt_of_injective_of_not_surjective
statement:
theorem coordinateCechWordSupport_card_comp_lt_of_injective_of_not_surjective
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {m : ℕ}
    (e : Fin m → Fin (n + 1)) (he : Function.Injective e)
    (w : ι → Fin m) (hw : ¬Function.Surjective w) :
    (coordinateCechWordSupport n (e ∘ w)).card < m
proof:
:= by
  have hproper : Finset.univ.image w ⊂ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)) := by
    rw [Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne]
    refine ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, ?_⟩
    intro hEq
    apply hw
    intro i
    have hi : i ∈ Finset.univ.image w := by
      rw [hEq]
      exact Finset.mem_univ i
    simpa only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] using hi
  rw [coordinateCechWordSupport, ← Finset.image_image,
    Finset.card_image_of_injective _ he]
  simpa only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using
    Finset.card_lt_card hproper

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechSupportProjection_comp_π
statement:
theorem coordinateCechSupportProjection_comp_π (s p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateCechSupportProjection (k := k) n M s p ≫
        Pi.π
          (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
            M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b)))
          a =
      if s ≤ (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card then
        Pi.π
          (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
            M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b)))
          a
      else 0
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [coordinateCechSupportProjection]
  rw [Pi.lift_π]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechSupportProjection_coface
statement:
theorem coordinateCechSupportProjection_coface
    (s p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2)) :
    coordinateCechSupportProjection (k := k) n M s p ≫
        coordinateCechNativeHigherCoface k n M p r ≫
          coordinateCechSupportProjection (k := k) n M s (p + 1) =
      coordinateCechSupportProjection (k := k) n M s p ≫
        coordinateCechNativeHigherCoface k n M p r
proof:
:= by
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro a
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [coordinateCechSupportProjection_comp_π]
  by_cases ha : s ≤ (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card
  · rw [if_pos ha]
  · simp only [if_neg ha, comp_zero]
    dsimp only [coordinateCechNativeHigherCoface]
    rw [coordinateCechHigherCoface_component k n M p r a]
    rw [← Category.assoc, coordinateCechSupportProjection_comp_π]
    have hdelete :
        ¬s ≤ (coordinateCechWordSupport n (a ∘ r.succAbove)).card := by
      intro h
      exact ha (h.trans
        (coordinateCechWordSupport_card_comp_succAbove_le n a r))
    rw [if_neg hdelete, zero_comp]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechSupportProjection_differential
statement:
theorem coordinateCechSupportProjection_differential (s p : ℕ) :
    coordinateCechSupportProjection (k := k) n M s p ≫
        coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p ≫
          coordinateCechSupportProjection (k := k) n M s (p + 1) =
      coordinateCechSupportProjection (k := k) n M s p ≫
        coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential_eq_alternatingCofaces]
  simp only [Preadditive.comp_sum, Preadditive.sum_comp,
    Preadditive.comp_zsmul, Preadditive.zsmul_comp]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  rw [coordinateCechSupportProjection_coface]

name: SchemeKTheory.logDeriv_mul
statement: lemma logDeriv_mul (u w : (PowerSeries A)ˣ) : logDeriv (u * w) = logDeriv u + logDeriv w
proof:
:= by
  have hu : (u : PowerSeries A) * ((u⁻¹ : (PowerSeries A)ˣ) : PowerSeries A) = 1 := u.mul_inv
  have hw : (w : PowerSeries A) * ((w⁻¹ : (PowerSeries A)ˣ) : PowerSeries A) = 1 := w.mul_inv
  simp only [logDeriv, Units.val_mul, mul_inv_rev, Derivation.leibniz, smul_eq_mul]
  linear_combination (X * d⁄dX A (w : PowerSeries A) * ((w⁻¹ : (PowerSeries A)ˣ) : PowerSeries A)) *
    hu + (X * d⁄dX A (u : PowerSeries A) * ((u⁻¹ : (PowerSeries A)ˣ) : PowerSeries A)) * hw

name: SchemeKTheory.logDeriv_one
statement: lemma logDeriv_one : logDeriv (1 : (PowerSeries A)ˣ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [logDeriv]

name: SchemeKTheory.logDeriv_mul_self
statement:
lemma logDeriv_mul_self (u : (PowerSeries A)ˣ) :
    logDeriv u * (u : PowerSeries A) = X * d⁄dX A (u : PowerSeries A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [logDeriv, mul_assoc, Units.inv_mul, mul_one]

name: SchemeKTheory.coeff_one_logDeriv
statement:
lemma coeff_one_logDeriv (u : (PowerSeries A)ˣ) (hu : constantCoeff (u : PowerSeries A) = 1) :
    coeff 1 (logDeriv u) = coeff 1 (u : PowerSeries A)
proof:
:= by
  have hinv : constantCoeff ((u⁻¹ : (PowerSeries A)ˣ) : PowerSeries A) = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg constantCoeff u.mul_inv
    rw [map_mul, hu, one_mul, map_one] at h
    exact h
  rw [logDeriv, mul_assoc, coeff_succ_X_mul, coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, map_mul, hinv,
    mul_one, ← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, coeff_derivative]
  simp

name: SchemeKTheory.coeff_succ_logDeriv_of_eq
statement:
lemma coeff_succ_logDeriv_of_eq (c : A) (u : (PowerSeries A)ˣ)
    (hu : (u : PowerSeries A) = 1 + C c * X) (k : ℕ) :
    coeff (k + 1) (logDeriv u) = (-1) ^ k * c ^ (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : d⁄dX A (u : PowerSeries A) = C c := by
    rw [hu, map_add, Derivation.leibniz, derivative_C, derivative_X, smul_eq_mul, smul_zero,
      add_zero, mul_one]
    simp
  have key := logDeriv_mul_self u
  rw [hd, hu] at key
  set S := logDeriv u
  have hrec : ∀ n, coeff (n + 1) S + c * coeff n S = coeff (n + 1) (X * C c) := by
    intro n
    rw [← key, mul_add, mul_one, map_add, ← mul_assoc, coeff_succ_mul_X, mul_comm S (C c),
      coeff_C_mul]
  have h0 : coeff 0 S = 0 := by
    simp only [S, logDeriv, mul_assoc, coeff_zero_X_mul]
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      have h := hrec 0
      rw [h0, mul_zero, add_zero, coeff_succ_X_mul, coeff_zero_C] at h
      rw [h]
      ring
  | succ k ih =>
      have h := hrec (k + 1)
      rw [coeff_succ_X_mul, coeff_succ_C, ih] at h
      linear_combination h

name: SchemeKTheory.coeff_lambdaSeries
statement:
lemma coeff_lambdaSeries (M : Y.Modules) (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y M) (n : ℕ) :
    coeff n (lambdaSeries Y M hM) = lambdaClass Y M hM n
proof:
:=
  coeff_mk _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.constantCoeff_lambdaSeries
statement:
lemma constantCoeff_lambdaSeries (M : Y.Modules) (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y M) :
    constantCoeff (lambdaSeries Y M hM) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, coeff_lambdaSeries, lambdaClass_zero]

name: SchemeKTheory.coe_lambdaSeriesUnit
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coe_lambdaSeriesUnit (M : Y.Modules) (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y M) :
    (lambdaSeriesUnit Y M hM : PowerSeries (K0 Y)) = lambdaSeries Y M hM
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.lambdaSeries_shortExact
statement:
theorem lambdaSeries_shortExact {K F Q : Y.Modules} (hK : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y K)
    (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y F) (hQ : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y Q) (f : K ⟶ F) (g : F ⟶ Q)
    (zero : f ≫ g = 0) (hS : (ShortComplex.mk f g zero).ShortExact) :
    lambdaSeries Y F hF = lambdaSeries Y K hK * lambdaSeries Y Q hQ
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [coeff_mul, coeff_lambdaSeries, lambdaClass_shortExact hK hF hQ f g zero hS n]
  simp only [coeff_lambdaSeries]

name: SchemeKTheory.lambdaT_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
lemma lambdaT_classOf (M : Y.Modules) (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y M) :
    lambdaT Y (k0ClassOf Y M hM) = Additive.ofMul (lambdaSeriesUnit Y M hM)
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.lift_classOf _ _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.constantCoeff_lambdaT
statement:
lemma constantCoeff_lambdaT (x : K0 Y) :
    constantCoeff ((Additive.toMul (lambdaT Y x) : (PowerSeries (K0 Y))ˣ) : PowerSeries (K0 Y)) =
      1
proof:
:= by
  let φ : K0 Y →+ Additive (K0 Y)ˣ :=
    (MonoidHom.toAdditive (Units.map (constantCoeff (R := K0 Y)).toMonoidHom)).comp (lambdaT Y)
  have hφ : φ = 0 := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    intro E
    change Additive.ofMul (Units.map (constantCoeff (R := K0 Y)).toMonoidHom
      (Additive.toMul (lambdaT Y (k0ClassOf Y E.1 E.2)))) = Additive.ofMul 1
    rw [lambdaT_classOf]
    congr 1
    apply Units.ext
    simp only [toMul_ofMul, Units.coe_map, coe_lambdaSeriesUnit, Units.val_one]
    exact constantCoeff_lambdaSeries Y E.1 E.2
  have h := congrArg (fun ψ : K0 Y →+ Additive (K0 Y)ˣ => ((Additive.toMul (ψ x) : (K0 Y)ˣ) :
    K0 Y)) hφ
  simpa [φ] using h

name: SchemeKTheory.lambdaOp_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
lemma lambdaOp_classOf (n : ℕ) (M : Y.Modules) (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y M) :
    lambdaOp Y n (k0ClassOf Y M hM) = lambdaClass Y M hM n
proof:
:= by
  rw [lambdaOp, lambdaT_classOf, toMul_ofMul, coe_lambdaSeriesUnit, coeff_lambdaSeries]

name: SchemeKTheory.lambdaOp_zero
statement: lemma lambdaOp_zero (x : K0 Y) : lambdaOp Y 0 x = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [lambdaOp, coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, constantCoeff_lambdaT]

name: SchemeKTheory.lambdaOp_add
statement:
lemma lambdaOp_add (n : ℕ) (x y : K0 Y) :
    lambdaOp Y n (x + y) = ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, lambdaOp Y p.1 x * lambdaOp Y p.2 y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lambdaOp, map_add, toMul_add, Units.val_mul, coeff_mul]

name: SchemeKTheory.lambdaOp_one
statement: lemma lambdaOp_one (x : K0 Y) : lambdaOp Y 1 x = x
proof:
:= by
  let ℓ : K0 Y →+ K0 Y := AddMonoidHom.mk' (lambdaOp Y 1) (fun a b => by
    rw [lambdaOp_add, Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_succ, Finset.Nat.antidiagonal_zero,
      Finset.sum_singleton, lambdaOp_zero, lambdaOp_zero, one_mul, mul_one, add_comm])
  have hℓ : ℓ = AddMonoidHom.id (K0 Y) := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    intro E
    change lambdaOp Y 1 (k0ClassOf Y E.1 E.2) = k0ClassOf Y E.1 E.2
    rw [lambdaOp_classOf, lambdaClass_one]
  exact congrArg (fun ψ : K0 Y →+ K0 Y => ψ x) hℓ

name: SchemeKTheory.adamsSeries_mul_lambda
statement:
theorem adamsSeries_mul_lambda (x : K0 Y) :
    adamsSeries Y x * ((Additive.toMul (lambdaT Y x) : (PowerSeries (K0 Y))ˣ) :
      PowerSeries (K0 Y)) =
      X * d⁄dX (K0 Y) ((Additive.toMul (lambdaT Y x) : (PowerSeries (K0 Y))ˣ) :
        PowerSeries (K0 Y))
proof:
:=
  logDeriv_mul_self _

name: SchemeKTheory.adams_apply
statement:
lemma adams_apply (k : ℕ) (x : K0 Y) :
    adams Y k x = (-1 : K0 Y) ^ (k + 1) * coeff k (adamsSeries Y x)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.adams_one
statement: theorem adams_one (x : K0 Y) : adams Y 1 x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [adams_apply]
  change (-1 : K0 Y) ^ (1 + 1) * coeff 1 (logDeriv (Additive.toMul (lambdaT Y x))) = x
  rw [coeff_one_logDeriv _ (constantCoeff_lambdaT Y x)]
  change (-1 : K0 Y) ^ (1 + 1) * lambdaOp Y 1 x = x
  rw [lambdaOp_one]
  ring

name: SchemeKTheory.neg_one_pow_mul_neg_one_pow
statement:
lemma neg_one_pow_mul_neg_one_pow {A : Type v} [CommRing A] (k : ℕ) (c : A) :
    (-1 : A) ^ (k + 1 + 1) * ((-1) ^ k * c) = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← pow_add, show k + 1 + 1 + k = 2 * (k + 1) by ring, pow_mul]
  norm_num

name: SchemeKTheory.lambdaSeries_rankOne
statement:
lemma lambdaSeries_rankOne (L : Y.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1) :
    lambdaSeries Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree = 1 + C (k0ClassOf Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree) * X
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [coeff_lambdaSeries, map_add, coeff_one, coeff_C_mul, coeff_X]
  rcases n with _ | _ | n
  · simp [lambdaClass_zero]
  · simp [lambdaClass_one]
  · rw [lambdaClass_eq_zero_of_rank_lt Y L 1 hL (n + 2) (by omega)]
    simp

name: SchemeKTheory.adams_classOf_rankOne
statement:
theorem adams_classOf_rankOne (L : Y.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1) (k : ℕ) :
    adams Y (k + 1) (k0ClassOf Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree) =
      k0ClassOf Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree ^ (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [adams_apply]
  change (-1 : K0 Y) ^ (k + 1 + 1) * coeff (k + 1) (logDeriv (Additive.toMul
    (lambdaT Y (k0ClassOf Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree)))) = _
  rw [coeff_succ_logDeriv_of_eq (k0ClassOf Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree) _ (by
    rw [lambdaT_classOf, toMul_ofMul, coe_lambdaSeriesUnit, lambdaSeries_rankOne Y L hL]) k]
  exact neg_one_pow_mul_neg_one_pow k _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.span_range_equiv
statement:
private theorem span_range_equiv (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) :
    Submodule.span R (Set.range (e : M →ₗ[R] N)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have h : Set.range (e : M →ₗ[R] N) = Set.univ :=
    Set.range_eq_univ.mpr e.surjective
  rw [h, Submodule.span_univ]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.span_range_id
statement:
private theorem span_range_id :
    Submodule.span R (Set.range (LinearMap.id : M →ₗ[R] M)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have h : Set.range (LinearMap.id : M →ₗ[R] M) = Set.univ :=
    Set.range_eq_univ.mpr (fun m ↦ ⟨m, rfl⟩)
  rw [h, Submodule.span_univ]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap_id
proof:
:= by
  apply GradedRingHom.ext
  intro x
  change symmetricAlgebraMap (LinearMap.id : M →ₗ[R] M) x = x
  let F : SymmetricAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] SymmetricAlgebra R M :=
    { toRingHom := symmetricAlgebraMap (LinearMap.id : M →ₗ[R] M)
      commutes' := by
        intro r
        exact symmetricAlgebraMap_algebraMap
          (LinearMap.id : M →ₗ[R] M) r }
  have hF : F = AlgHom.id R (SymmetricAlgebra R M) := by
    apply SymmetricAlgebra.algHom_ext
    ext m
    simp [F]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hF x

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.symmetricProjMap_id
proof:
:= by
  unfold symmetricProjMap
  convert Proj.map_id
  exact gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap_id

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.chartIsoOfLinearEquiv_toSpec
statement:
theorem chartIsoOfLinearEquiv_toSpec (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) :
    (chartIsoOfLinearEquiv e).hom ≫ intrinsicToSpec (R := R) (M := N) =
      intrinsicToSpec (R := R) (M := M)
proof:
:= by
  have h := symmetricProjMap_toSpec (e.symm : N →ₗ[R] M)
    (span_range_equiv e.symm)
  change symmetricProjMap (e.symm : N →ₗ[R] M) (span_range_equiv e.symm) ≫
    intrinsicToSpec (R := R) (M := N) = _
  simpa [intrinsicToSpec] using h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.sectionIso_naturality
statement:
theorem sectionIso_naturality (e : E ≅ E') {U V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (s : Γ(E, U)) :
    e.hom.app V (E.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op s) =
      E'.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op (e.hom.app U s)
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun q ↦ q s) (e.hom.val.naturality (homOfLE hVU).op)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.chartIso_hom_toBase
statement:
theorem chartIso_hom_toBase (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    (i : C'.I) :
    (chartIso e C' i).hom ≫ C'.chartToBase i =
      (transport e C').chartToBase i
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C'.U i) (E'.val.obj (op (C'.U i))) :=
    C'.sectionModule_free i
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C'.U i) (E'.val.obj (op (C'.U i))) :=
    C'.sectionModule_finite i
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C'.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C'.U i))) :=
    (transport e C').sectionModule_free i
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C'.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C'.U i))) :=
    (transport e C').sectionModule_finite i
  change (chartIsoOfLinearEquiv (sectionLinearEquivOfIso e (C'.U i))).hom ≫
    intrinsicToSpec (R := Γ(X, C'.U i))
      (M := E'.val.obj (op (C'.U i))) ≫ (C'.isAffine i).isoSpec.inv =
    intrinsicToSpec (R := Γ(X, C'.U i))
      (M := E.val.obj (op (C'.U i))) ≫ (C'.isAffine i).isoSpec.inv
  rw [← Category.assoc, chartIsoOfLinearEquiv_toSpec]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.chartIso_hom_toAmbient
statement:
theorem chartIso_hom_toAmbient (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    (i : C'.I) :
    (chartIso e C' i).hom ≫ C'.chartToAmbient i =
      (transport e C').chartToAmbient i
proof:
:= by
  change (chartIso e C' i).hom ≫
      (C'.chartToBase i ≫ (C'.U i).ι) =
    (transport e C').chartToBase i ≫ (C'.U i).ι
  rw [← Category.assoc, chartIso_hom_toBase]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.a11_top_le
statement: theorem a11_top_le (i : C.I) : (⊤ : (C.chart i).Opens) ≤ (C.chartι i ≫ C.toBase) ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i
proof:
:= by
  intro x _
  change (C.chartι i ≫ C.toBase) x ∈ C.U i
  rw [C.chartι_toBase, ← C.chartToBase_comp_openImmersion, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  exact (C.chartToBase i x).2

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.a11_scal_eq
statement:
theorem a11_scal_eq (a : Γ(X, C.U i)) :
    ((C.chartι i).appIso ⊤).hom (C.scheme.presheaf.map
      (eqToHom (tautQuotient_chartι_image_top C i)).op (C.toBase.app (C.U i) a)) =
      tautChart_scal Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) a
proof:
:= by
  have hL : ((C.chartι i).appIso ⊤).hom (C.scheme.presheaf.map
      (eqToHom (tautQuotient_chartι_image_top C i)).op (C.toBase.app (C.U i) a)) =
      (C.chartι i ≫ C.toBase).appLE (C.U i) ⊤ (a11_top_le C i) a := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.appIso_hom', tautQuotient_map_appLE_apply]
    exact (tautQuotient_comp_appLE_apply (C.chartι i) C.toBase _ _ _ a).symm
  have e1 : C.chartι i ≫ C.toBase = intrinsicToSpec (R := Γ(X, C.U i))
      (M := E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) ≫ (C.isAffine i).fromSpec := by
    rw [C.chartι_toBase]
    rfl
  rw [hL, tautQuotient_appLE_congr e1 _ _ _ (by rw [← e1]; exact a11_top_le C i)]
  refine (tautQuotient_comp_appLE_apply _ _ _ _ _ _).trans ?_
  refine (congrArg (fun z ↦ (intrinsicToSpec (R := Γ(X, C.U i))
      (M := E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))).appLE _ ⊤ (by simp) z)
      (IsAffineOpen.fromSpec_app_self_apply (C.isAffine i) a)).trans ?_
  refine (tautQuotient_map_appLE_apply _ _ _ _).trans ?_
  rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.RGFIN.codim_eq_conormalRk
statement:
theorem codim_eq_conormalRk :
    ARRASM.codim k n i.ker = conormalRk k n i
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIntegral i.ker.subscheme := CIIZSM.integralZ k n i
  have hg : (CIIASM.phiX k n i).hom (genericPoint X) = genericPoint i.ker.subscheme := by
    have h1 := (genericPoint_spec X).image (CIIASM.phiX k n i).hom.continuous
    have h2 : closure ((CIIASM.phiX k n i).hom '' (Set.univ : Set X)) = Set.univ := by
      rw [Set.image_univ_of_surjective (CIIASM.phiX k n i).hom.surjective, closure_univ]
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1.eq (genericPoint_spec _)
  have hi : i (genericPoint X) =
      i.ker.subschemeι ((CIIASM.phiX k n i).hom (genericPoint X)) := by
    calc i (genericPoint X) = ((CIIASM.phiX k n i).hom ≫ i.ker.subschemeι) (genericPoint X) := by
          rw [CIIASM.phiX_comp]
      _ = _ := Scheme.Hom.comp_apply _ _ _
  unfold ARRASM.codim conormalRk ARRASM.iZ
  rw [hi, hg]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.RGFIN.hrr_regular_closed_in_projective_of_kdGate
statement:
theorem hrr_regular_closed_in_projective_of_kdGate
    [(i ≫ toSpec k n).IsOver (Spk k)] [(toSpec k n).IsOver (Spk k)] [IsNoetherian (space k n)]
    (hK : conormalRk k n i ≠ 0 → CIIKD.KDGate k n i hX φk) (x : K0 X) :
    ((g0Euler k (ClosedImmersionCohomology.projectiveClosedImmersion_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic
        k n hn i (comp_over i (Spk k)).symm) (k0ToG0 X x) : ℤ) : ℚ) =
      degT k (Spk k) (totalPushOn (opsV4 k) (i ≫ toSpec k n)
        (((tdLine k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n 1))
          (hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1
            (AdamsRRFinal.hasConstantRank_projectiveTwistingSheaf k n 1))) ^ (n + 1))
          (tauX k (closedPosV4 k) (CASE1C.chExact_closedPosV4 k) i x)))
proof:
:=
  hrr_regular_closed_in_projective_of_remaining k n hn i hX φk
    (fun h0 => remainingOfKDGate k n i hX φk h0 (hK h0)) x

name: G2C1.isoE0C_toCentre
statement:
theorem isoE0C_toCentre (CN : AffineFrameCover (Zs A J) (Nsh J)) :
    (isoE0C C CN).hom ≫ componentToCentre A J = (Cov CN).toBase
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := isoUnionLeft_toBase (Cov CN) (localFrameCover A J C)
  have h2 := isoUnionRight_toBase (Cov CN) (localFrameCover A J C)
  have h3 := localFrameComponentIso_toCentre A J C
  simp only [isoE0C, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc]
  have h5 := (Iso.inv_comp_eq _).mpr h2.symm
  exact ((congrArg (fun t => ((Cov CN).isoUnionLeft (localFrameCover A J C)).hom ≫
      ((Cov CN).isoUnionRight (localFrameCover A J C)).inv ≫ t) h3).trans
    ((congrArg (fun t => ((Cov CN).isoUnionLeft (localFrameCover A J C)).hom ≫ t)
      h5).trans h1))

name: G2C1.zeroSection_isoE0C
statement:
theorem zeroSection_isoE0C (CN : AffineFrameCover (Zs A J) (Nsh J)) :
    (Cov CN).zeroSection ≫ (isoE0C C CN).hom =
      (localFrameCover A J C).zeroSection ≫ (localFrameComponentIso A J C).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hL := quotientSection_isoUnionLeft (Cov CN)
    (localFrameCover A J C) biprod.snd
    (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd)
  have hR := quotientSection_isoUnionRight (Cov CN)
    (localFrameCover A J C) biprod.snd
    (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd)
  have e : ((Cov CN).zeroSection ≫
        (AffineFrameCover.isoUnionLeft (Cov CN) (localFrameCover A J C)).hom) ≫
        (AffineFrameCover.isoUnionRight (Cov CN) (localFrameCover A J C)).inv =
      (localFrameCover A J C).zeroSection := by
    refine (congrArg (fun g => g ≫ _) hL).trans ?_
    refine (congrArg (fun g => g ≫ _) hR.symm).trans ?_
    rw [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
    rfl
  have hiso : (isoE0C C CN).hom =
      (AffineFrameCover.isoUnionLeft (Cov CN) (localFrameCover A J C)).hom ≫
        (AffineFrameCover.isoUnionRight (Cov CN) (localFrameCover A J C)).inv ≫
        (localFrameComponentIso A J C).hom := by
    simp only [isoE0C, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [hiso, ← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc]
  exact congrArg (fun g => g ≫ (localFrameComponentIso A J C).hom) e

name: G2C1.rangeGateC

:= by
  intro i x

name: G2C1.hzs_of_chartC
statement:
theorem hzs_of_chartC (CN : AffineFrameCover (Zs A J) (Nsh J)) (hc : ChartGateC C) :
    (Cov CN).zeroSection ≫ EιOfIsoC C CN = secInf A J ≫ subschemeTotalGlobalι A J
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : EιOfIsoC C CN = (isoE0C C CN).hom ≫ componentToTotal A J := rfl
  rw [h1, ← Category.assoc, zeroSection_isoE0C C CN, Category.assoc]
  refine (localFrameCover A J C).baseCover.hom_ext _ _ fun (i : C.J) ↦ ?_
  have h2 := (localFrameCover A J C).baseCover_quotientSection biprod.snd
    (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd) i
  have h3 : (localFrameCover A J C).baseCover.f i ≫
      (localFrameCover A J C).zeroSection ≫
        (localFrameComponentIso A J C).hom ≫ componentToTotal A J =
      (localFrameCover A J C).chartSection biprod.snd
        (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd) i ≫
        localFrameToTotal A J C i := by
    have e3 : (localFrameCover A J C).chartι i ≫
        (localFrameComponentIso A J C).hom ≫ componentToTotal A J =
        localFrameToTotal A J C i :=
      (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
        ((congrArg (fun g => g ≫ componentToTotal A J)
          (localFrameComponentIso_chart A J C i)).trans
          (localFrameToTotal_recovery A J C i).symm)
    refine ((Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
      (congrArg (fun g => g ≫ (localFrameComponentIso A J C).hom ≫
        componentToTotal A J) h2)).trans ?_
    exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg (fun g => _ ≫ g) e3)
  exact h3.trans (hc i)

name: G2C1.chartGate_of_rangeC
statement: theorem chartGate_of_rangeC [IsIntegral (Zs A J)] (hr : RangeGateC C) : ChartGateC C
proof:
:= by
  unfold ChartGateC
  intro (i : (localFrameCover A J C).I)
  haveI : IsReduced (Zs A J) := inferInstance
  haveI : IsReduced ((localFrameCover A J C).U i).toScheme := inferInstance
  haveI := KSpecialization.CIIL3B.isIso_fst_comp_totalToClosedBase A J
  let C' := localFrameCover A J C
  let cs := C'.chartSection biprod.snd (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd) i
  let F := subschemeTotalGlobalι A J
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := KSpecialization.ARRHBCP.exists_factor_of_range F
    (cs ≫ localFrameToTotal A J C i) (hr i)
  let e := cs ≫ localFrameToComponent A J C i
  have hAe : cs ≫ localFrameToTotal A J C i = e ≫ componentToTotal A J := by
    rw [localFrameToTotal_recovery]
    exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
  have hcond : h ≫ F = e ≫ componentToTotal A J := hh.trans hAe
  have hbase : e ≫ componentToCentre A J = C'.baseCover.f i :=
    (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
      ((congrArg (fun g => cs ≫ g) (localFrameToComponent_toCentre A J C i)).trans
        (C'.chartSection_chartToAmbient biprod.snd
          (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd) i))
  have hh2 : h ≫ totalToClosedBase A J = C'.baseCover.f i := by
    rw [← cancel_mono (iZ A J)]
    have h3 := totalToClosedBase_subschemeι A J
    have h4 := componentToTotal_toBase A J
    calc (h ≫ totalToClosedBase A J) ≫ iZ A J
        = h ≫ F ≫ totalGlobalToBase A J := by
          rw [Category.assoc]; exact congrArg (fun g => h ≫ g) h3
      _ = (e ≫ componentToTotal A J) ≫ totalGlobalToBase A J := by
          rw [← Category.assoc, hcond]
      _ = e ≫ componentToCentre A J ≫ iZ A J := by
          rw [Category.assoc]; exact congrArg (fun g => e ≫ g) h4
      _ = C'.baseCover.f i ≫ iZ A J :=
          (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans (congrArg (fun g => g ≫ iZ A J) hbase)
  let ρ := pullback.fst F (componentToTotal A J) ≫ totalToClosedBase A J
  have hlift : pullback.lift h e hcond ≫ ρ = C'.baseCover.f i := by
    simp only [ρ, ← Category.assoc, pullback.lift_fst]
    exact hh2
  have hL : pullback.lift h e hcond = C'.baseCover.f i ≫ inv ρ := by
    exact (Category.comp_id _).symm.trans ((congrArg (fun g => pullback.lift h e hcond ≫ g)
      (IsIso.hom_inv_id ρ).symm).trans ((Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
        (congrArg (fun g => g ≫ inv ρ) hlift)))
  have hsec' : inv ρ ≫ pullback.fst F (componentToTotal A J) = secInf A J :=
    KSpecialization.ARRHBCP.inv_comp_fst_eq_secInf A J (componentToTotal A J) rfl
  calc cs ≫ localFrameToTotal A J C i = h ≫ F := hh.symm
    _ = (pullback.lift h e hcond ≫ pullback.fst F (componentToTotal A J)) ≫ F := by
        rw [pullback.lift_fst]
    _ = C'.baseCover.f i ≫ secInf A J ≫ F := by
        rw [hL]
        exact (congrArg (fun g => (g ≫ pullback.fst F (componentToTotal A J)) ≫ F) rfl).trans
          (((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg (fun g => (C'.baseCover.f i ≫ inv ρ) ≫ g)
            (rfl : pullback.fst F (componentToTotal A J) ≫ F =
              pullback.fst F (componentToTotal A J) ≫ F))).trans
            (((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg (fun g => C'.baseCover.f i ≫ g)
              ((Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans (congrArg (fun g => g ≫ F) hsec')))).trans rfl))

name: G2C1.hzsC
statement:
theorem hzsC [IsIntegral (Zs A J)] (CN : AffineFrameCover (Zs A J) (Nsh J)) :

name: G2C1.zeroSection_isoE0C_eq_zeroE
statement:
theorem zeroSection_isoE0C_eq_zeroE (CN : AffineFrameCover (Zs A J) (Nsh J)) :
