name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.exists_eq_add_mul_of_rank_two
statement:
theorem exists_eq_add_mul_of_rank_two [IsNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E 2) (w : K0 C.scheme) :
    ∃ a b : K0 X, w = C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos a +
      C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos b * C.tautologicalK0Class
proof:
:= by
  letI := C.projectiveBundleK0Algebra hpos
  have h := C.span_eq_top hpos (by norm_num) hE (Submodule.mem_top (x := w))
  rw [Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun] at h
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h
  refine ⟨c 0, c 1, ?_⟩
  rw [← hc, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  simp [Algebra.smul_def, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.fibre_restrictions_eq_of_rank_two
statement:
theorem fibre_restrictions_eq_of_rank_two [IsNoetherian X]
    (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) (hE : HasConstantRank X E 2)
    (r₀ r₁ : K0 C.scheme →+* K0 X)
    (h₀ : ∀ a, r₀ (C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos a) = a)
    (h₁ : ∀ a, r₁ (C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos a) = a)
    (hh₀ : r₀ C.tautologicalK0Class = 1) (hh₁ : r₁ C.tautologicalK0Class = 1) : r₀ = r₁
proof:
:=
  KSpecialization.fibre_restrictions_eq _ _ (C.exists_eq_add_mul_of_rank_two hpos hE) r₀ r₁
    h₀ h₁ hh₀ hh₁

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.exists_projectiveLine_k0_span
statement:
theorem SchemeProjectiveBundle.exists_projectiveLine_k0_span (Z : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Z] :
    ∃ (C : AffineFrameCover Z (SheafOfModules.free (R := Z.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin 2))))
      (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)), ∀ w : K0 C.scheme,
      ∃ a b : K0 Z, w = C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos a +
        C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos b * C.tautologicalK0Class
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank (hasConstantRank_free Z 2)
  have hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i) := fun i ↦ by
    have h := hC i
    letI := C.basisIndex_finite i
    exact (Nat.card_pos_iff.mp (by omega)).1
  exact ⟨C, hpos, C.exists_eq_add_mul_of_rank_two hpos (hasConstantRank_free Z 2)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D22.exists_local_preimage_of_epi
statement:
theorem exists_local_preimage_of_epi {X : Scheme.{u}} {P M : X.Modules} (φ : P ⟶ M) [Epi φ]
    (U : X.Opens) (m : Γ(M, U)) (x : X) (hx : x ∈ U) :
    ∃ (V : X.Opens) (hV : V ≤ U), x ∈ V ∧ ∃ t : Γ(P, V),
      φ.app V t = M.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op m
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Epi ((toAddCommGrpSheaf X).map φ) := by
    haveI : (toAddCommGrpSheaf X).PreservesEpimorphisms :=
      preservesEpimorphisms_of_preservesColimitsOfShape _
    exact Functor.map_epi _ φ
  have h := (TopCat.Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi ((toAddCommGrpSheaf X).map φ)).2 this
  have h2 := (TopCat.Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff _).1 h
  obtain ⟨V, hV, ⟨t, ht⟩, hxV⟩ := h2 U m x hx
  exact ⟨V, hV, hxV, t, ht⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D22.app_sum
statement:
theorem app_sum {M N : X.Modules} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → (M ⟶ N)) (U : X.Opens)
    (x : Γ(M, U)) : (∑ i ∈ s, f i).app U x = ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).app U x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha, Hom.add_app]
    simp [ih]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D22.sum_prFree
statement: theorem sum_prFree : ∑ i, prFree (X := X) I i ≫ inFree I i = 𝟙 (FreeM X I)
proof:
:= by
  refine Sigma.hom_ext _ _ (fun j => ?_)
  rw [Preadditive.comp_sum]
  simp only [prFree, Sigma.ι_desc_assoc, Category.comp_id]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro b _ hb
    simp [Ne.symm hb]
  · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ j) h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D22.app_unit_eq
statement:
theorem app_unit_eq {M : X.Modules} (g : UnitM X ⟶ M)
    (V : X.Opens) (a : Γ(X, V)) :
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app g V a = a • M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op
      (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app g ⊤ (1 : Γ(X, ⊤)))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (g.mapPresheaf.naturality (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op) (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at h1
  have hone : (UnitM X).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op
      (1 : Γ(X, ⊤)) = (1 : Γ(X, V)) := by
    change (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op).hom 1 = 1
    exact map_one _
  change Hom.app g V ((UnitM X).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op
      (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))) = M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op
      (Hom.app g ⊤ (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))) at h1
  rw [hone] at h1
  rw [← h1, ← Hom.app_smul]
  congr 1
  exact ((smul_eq_mul a 1).trans (mul_one a)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D22.free_app_decomp
statement:
theorem free_app_decomp {M : X.Modules} (φ : FreeM X I ⟶ M)
    (V : X.Opens) (t : Γ(FreeM X I, V)) :
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app φ V t =
      ∑ i, (show Γ(X, V) from Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (prFree I i) V t) •
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op
        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (inFree I i ≫ φ) ⊤ (1 : Γ(X, ⊤)))
proof:
:= by
  have e := congrArg (fun f : FreeM X I ⟶ FreeM X I => Scheme.Modules.Hom.app f V t)
    (sum_prFree (X := X) I)
  have h : Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (∑ i, prFree (X := X) I i ≫ inFree I i) V t = t := e
  conv_lhs => rw [← h]
  rw [app_sum]
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app]
  rw [map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
  have := app_unit_eq (inFree I i ≫ φ) V (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (prFree I i) V t)
  simpa using this

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistPullHomAux_restrictFunctor_iso_hom_faithful
statement:
theorem twistPullHomAux_restrictFunctor_iso_hom_faithful
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (e : X ≅ Y) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor e.hom).Faithful
proof:
:= by
  exact Functor.Faithful.of_comp_iso
    (F := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor e.hom)
    (G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor e.inv)
    (H := 𝟭 Y.Modules)
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp e.inv e.hom).symm ≪≫
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr e.inv_hom_id ≪≫
        Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorId)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistPullHomAux_modulesHom_ext_of_pullback_openCover
statement:
theorem twistPullHomAux_modulesHom_ext_of_pullback_openCover
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (𝒰 : Y.OpenCover.{u})
    {M N : Y.Modules} {φ ψ : M ⟶ N}
    (h : ∀ i, (Scheme.Modules.pullback (𝒰.f i)).map φ =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (𝒰.f i)).map ψ) :
    φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext_of_over_coversTop Y
    (fun i ↦ (𝒰.f i).opensRange)
    ((Opens.coversTop_iff
      (T := Y) (fun i ↦ (𝒰.f i).opensRange)).2
        𝒰.isOpenCover_opensRange)
  intro i
  let f := 𝒰.f i
  let U := f.opensRange
  let e := f.isoOpensRange
  have hf : e.hom ≫ U.ι = f := f.isoOpensRange_hom_ι
  let E :
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f ≅
        Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι ⋙
          Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor e.hom :=
    Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr hf.symm ≪≫
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp e.hom U.ι
  have hRestrictF :
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).map φ =
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).map ψ := by
    rw [functor_map_eq_iso_conj
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback f) φ,
      functor_map_eq_iso_conj
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback f) ψ,
      h i]
  have hComp :
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor e.hom).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map φ) =
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor e.hom).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map ψ) := by
    rw [functor_map_eq_iso_conj E φ,
      functor_map_eq_iso_conj E ψ] at hRestrictF
    apply (cancel_epi (E.hom.app M)).1
    apply (cancel_mono (E.inv.app N)).1
    exact hRestrictF
  letI : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor e.hom).Faithful :=
    twistPullHomAux_restrictFunctor_iso_hom_faithful e
  have hRestrict :
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map φ =
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map ψ :=
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor e.hom).map_injective hComp
  apply (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map_injective
  change
    ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf U ⋙
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor).map φ) =
      ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf U ⋙
        (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor).map ψ)
  rw [functor_map_eq_iso_conj
      (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U) φ,
    functor_map_eq_iso_conj
      (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U) ψ,
    hRestrict]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistPullHomAux_map_eq_of_pullHom_eq
statement:
theorem twistPullHomAux_map_eq_of_pullHom_eq
    {A B Y D : Scheme.{u}} {M : A.Modules} {N : B.Modules}
    (f₁ : Y ⟶ A) (f₂ : Y ⟶ B)
    (φ ψ : (Scheme.Modules.pullback f₁).obj M ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback f₂).obj N)
    (g : D ⟶ Y) (gf₁ : D ⟶ A) (gf₂ : D ⟶ B)
    (hgf₁ : g ≫ f₁ = gf₁) (hgf₂ : g ≫ f₂ = gf₂)
    (h :
      Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
          (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
          φ g gf₁ gf₂ hgf₁ hgf₂ =
        Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
          (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
          ψ g gf₁ gf₂ hgf₁ hgf₂) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor.map
        g.op.toLoc).toFunctor.map φ) =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor.map
        g.op.toLoc).toFunctor.map ψ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.map_eq_pullHom
      (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
      φ g gf₁ gf₂ hgf₁ hgf₂,
    Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.map_eq_pullHom
      (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
      ψ g gf₁ gf₂ hgf₁ hgf₂,
    h]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistPullHomAux_twistChosenTriplePullHom_comp
statement:
theorem twistPullHomAux_twistChosenTriplePullHom_comp
    (d : ℤ) (i j k : C.I) :
    C.twistChosenTriplePullHomIJ
          (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d) i j k ≫
        C.twistChosenTriplePullHomJK
          (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d) i j k =
      C.twistChosenTriplePullHomIK
        (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d) i j k
proof:
:= by
  let 𝒰 := C.twistChosenTripleCocycleCover i j k
  apply twistPullHomAux_modulesHom_ext_of_pullback_openCover 𝒰
  intro l
  let g := 𝒰.f l
  let fI := C.twistChosenTripleLocalToChartI i j k l
  let fK := C.twistChosenTripleLocalToChartK i j k l
  have hgI :
      g ≫ (C.twistChosenPullback₃ i j k).p₁ = fI :=
    (C.twistChosenTripleLocalToChartI_eq i j k l).symm
  have hgK :
      g ≫ (C.twistChosenPullback₃ i j k).p₃ = fK :=
    (C.twistChosenTripleLocalToChartK_eq i j k l).symm
  have hPull' :
      Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
          (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
          (C.twistChosenTriplePullHomIJ
              (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d) i j k ≫
            C.twistChosenTriplePullHomJK
              (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d) i j k)
          g fI fK hgI hgK =
        Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
          (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
          (C.twistChosenTriplePullHomIK
            (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d) i j k)
          g fI fK hgI hgK := by
    exact twistPullHomAux_twistChosenTriplePullHom_comp_pullHom C d i j k l
  change
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor.map
      g.op.toLoc).toFunctor.map
        (C.twistChosenTriplePullHomIJ
            (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d) i j k ≫
          C.twistChosenTriplePullHomJK
            (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d) i j k)) =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor.map
        g.op.toLoc).toFunctor.map
          (C.twistChosenTriplePullHomIK
            (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d) i j k))
  exact twistPullHomAux_map_eq_of_pullHom_eq
    (C.twistChosenPullback₃ i j k).p₁
    (C.twistChosenPullback₃ i j k).p₃
    (C.twistChosenTriplePullHomIJ
        (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d) i j k ≫
      C.twistChosenTriplePullHomJK
        (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d) i j k)
    (C.twistChosenTriplePullHomIK
      (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d) i j k)
    g fI fK hgI hgK hPull'

theorem descentLeft_π (ij : I × I) :

      Pi.π D.chartTerm ij.1 ≫

:=
  kernel.condition _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.DescentData.descended_compatibility
statement:
theorem descended_compatibility :
    kernel.ι (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight) ≫ D.descentLeft =
      kernel.ι (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight) ≫ D.descentRight
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Preadditive.comp_sub, sub_eq_zero] using D.descended_condition

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.DescentData.component_compatibility
statement:
theorem component_compatibility (ij : I × I) :
    D.component ij.1 ≫
        pushforwardPullbackUnit
          (D.toAmbient ij.1) (D.left ij) (D.module ij.1) =
      D.component ij.2 ≫
        pushforwardPullbackUnit
          (D.toAmbient ij.2) (D.right ij) (D.module ij.2) ≫
        (pushforwardCongr (D.fac ij).symm).hom.app
          ((pullback (D.right ij)).obj (D.module ij.2)) ≫
        (pushforward (D.left ij ≫ D.toAmbient ij.1)).map
          (D.transition ij).inv
proof:
:= by
  let qij := Pi.π (fun kl : I × I ↦ D.overlapTerm kl) ij
  calc
    _ = (kernel.ι (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight) ≫
          D.descentLeft) ≫ qij := by
      simp only [Category.assoc, component, descentLeft_π, qij]
      rfl
    _ = (kernel.ι (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight) ≫
          D.descentRight) ≫ qij :=
      congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ qij) D.descended_compatibility
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [Category.assoc, component, descentRight_π, qij]
      rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.DescentData.lift_ι
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem lift_ι {N : X.Modules}
    (f : N ⟶ D.chartCochains)
    (hf : f ≫ D.descentLeft = f ≫ D.descentRight) :
    D.lift f hf ≫
        kernel.ι (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight) = f
proof:
:=
  kernel.lift_ι _ _ _

statement:

proof:

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistRightRestriction_declared_conjugation
statement:
theorem twistRightRestriction_declared_conjugation (C : AffineFrameCover X E) (i j : C.I) (M N : C.scheme.Modules)
    (φ : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι j)).obj M ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι j)).obj N) :
    letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.transition i j)
proof:
:= C.transition_isOpenImmersion' i j
    let s := twistRightRestriction_ambientHom C i j
    let r := twistRightRestriction_rightHom C i j
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback s).inv.app M ≫
      tensorOverlap_tr s (C.chartι j) r (twistRightRestriction_declared_fac C i j).symm
        φ ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback s).hom.app N =
    (pullbackRestrictionCompIso s (C.chartι j) r
      (twistRightRestriction_declared_fac C i j).symm M).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback r).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (C.chartι j)).inv.app M ≫ φ ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (C.chartι j)).hom.app N) ≫
      (pullbackRestrictionCompIso s (C.chartι j) r
        (twistRightRestriction_declared_fac C i j).symm N).inv := by
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.transition i j) := C.transition_isOpenImmersion' i j
  exact tensorOverlap_tr_pullback_conjugation (M := M) (N := N)
    (twistRightRestriction_ambientHom C i j) (C.chartι j)
    (twistRightRestriction_rightHom C i j)
    (twistRightRestriction_declared_fac C i j).symm
    φ

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistRightRestriction_prefixIso
statement:
theorem twistRightRestriction_prefixIso (C : AffineFrameCover X E) (i j : C.I)
    (M : C.scheme.Modules) :
    pullbackRestrictionCompIso (twistRightRestriction_ambientHom C i j) (C.chartι j)
      (twistRightRestriction_rightHom C i j) (twistRightRestriction_declared_fac C i j).symm M =
    twistRightRestriction_congrIso C i j M ≪≫ twistRightRestriction_compIso C i j M
proof:
:= by
  exact twistRecoveryAssembly_prefixIso (twistRightRestriction_ambientHom C i j)
    (C.chartι j) (twistRightRestriction_rightHom C i j)
    (twistRightRestriction_declared_fac C i j).symm M

statement:

proof:
:= C.twistingSheafDescentData d T

      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (D.fac (i,j))).app M ≪≫

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistRightRestriction_field_conjugation
statement:
theorem twistRightRestriction_field_conjugation (C : AffineFrameCover X E) (d : ℤ)
    (T : C.TwistTransitionSystem d) (i j : C.I) (M N : C.scheme.Modules)
    (φ : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι j)).obj M ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι j)).obj N) :
    let D
proof:
:= C.twistingSheafDescentData d T
    letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.transition i j) := C.transition_isOpenImmersion' i j
    let s := twistRightRestriction_ambientHom C i j
    let r := twistRightRestriction_rightHom C i j
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback s).inv.app M ≫
      tensorOverlap_tr s (C.chartι j) r (twistRightRestriction_declared_fac C i j).symm
        φ ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback s).hom.app N =
    (twistRightRestriction_fieldPrefixIso C d T i j M).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (D.right (i,j))).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (C.chartι j)).inv.app M ≫ φ ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (C.chartι j)).hom.app N) ≫
      (twistRightRestriction_fieldPrefixIso C d T i j N).inv := by
  exact twistRightRestriction_declared_conjugation C i j M N φ

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistRightRestriction_fieldPrefix_hom
statement:
theorem twistRightRestriction_fieldPrefix_hom (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (d : ℤ) (T : C.TwistTransitionSystem d) (i j : C.I) (M : C.scheme.Modules) :
    let D
proof:
:= C.twistingSheafDescentData d T
    (twistRightRestriction_fieldPrefixIso C d T i j M).hom =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (D.fac (i,j))).app M).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (D.right (i,j)) (C.chartι j)).inv.app M := by

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistRightRestriction_fieldPrefix_inv
statement:
theorem twistRightRestriction_fieldPrefix_inv (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (d : ℤ) (T : C.TwistTransitionSystem d) (i j : C.I) (M : C.scheme.Modules) :

proof:
:= C.twistingSheafDescentData d T

      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (D.right (i,j)) (C.chartι j)).hom.app M ≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (D.fac (i,j))).app M).inv := by

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistRightRestriction_field_normalized
statement:
theorem twistRightRestriction_field_normalized (C : AffineFrameCover X E) (d : ℤ)
    (T : C.TwistTransitionSystem d) (i j : C.I) (M N : C.scheme.Modules)
    (φ : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι j)).obj M ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι j)).obj N) :
    let D
proof:
:= C.twistingSheafDescentData d T
    letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.transition i j) := C.transition_isOpenImmersion' i j
    let s := twistRightRestriction_ambientHom C i j
    let r := twistRightRestriction_rightHom C i j
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback s).inv.app M ≫
      tensorOverlap_tr s (C.chartι j) r (twistRightRestriction_declared_fac C i j).symm
        φ ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback s).hom.app N =
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (D.fac (i,j))).app M).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (D.right (i,j)) (C.chartι j)).inv.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (D.right (i,j))).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (C.chartι j)).inv.app M ≫
          φ ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (C.chartι j)).hom.app N) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (D.right (i,j)) (C.chartι j)).hom.app N ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (D.fac (i,j))).app N).inv := by
  have hc := twistRightRestriction_field_conjugation C d T i j M N φ
  rw [twistRightRestriction_fieldPrefix_hom C d T i j M,
    twistRightRestriction_fieldPrefix_inv C d T i j N] at hc
  simpa only [Category.assoc] using hc

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistComparison_rightRestrictionPrefix
statement:
theorem transportTwistComparison_rightRestrictionPrefix (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (i j : C'.I) :
    let C
proof:
:= transport e C'
    let D := C.twistingSheafDescentData 1 (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1)
    let M := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (transportSchemeIso e C').hom).obj
      (C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    let N := C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1
    letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.transition i j) := C.transition_isOpenImmersion' i j
    let s := C.overlapToChart i j ≫ C.chartι i
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback s).inv.app M ≫
      tensorOverlap_tr s (C.chartι j) (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i)
        (by rw [Category.assoc]; exact (C.overlapToChart_chartι_eq i j).symm)
        (transportTwistChartIso e C' j).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback s).hom.app N =
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (D.fac (i,j))).app M).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (D.right (i,j)) (C.chartι j)).inv.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (D.right (i,j))).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (C.chartι j)).inv.app M ≫
          (transportTwistChartIso e C' j).hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (C.chartι j)).hom.app N) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (D.right (i,j)) (C.chartι j)).hom.app N ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (D.fac (i,j))).app N).inv := by
  let C := transport e C'
  let M := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (transportSchemeIso e C').hom).obj
      (C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
  let N := C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1
  exact twistRightRestriction_field_normalized C 1 (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1)
    i j M N (transportTwistChartIso e C' j).hom

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistRightRestriction_alongPost
statement:
theorem transportTwistRightRestriction_alongPost (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (i : C'.I) {V : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : V ⟶ ((transport e C').twistingSheafDescentData 1
      ((transport e C').canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1)).chart i)
    (Q : V.Modules)
    (v : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (g ≫ ((transport e C').twistingSheafDescentData 1
      ((transport e C').canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1)).toAmbient i)).obj
      ((transport e C').canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) ⟶ Q) :
    let M
proof:
:= (Scheme.Modules.pullback (transportSchemeIso e C').hom).obj
      (C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    let N := (transport e C').canonicalTwistingSheaf 1
    (transportTwistComparisonFieldAlongIso e C' i g).hom ≫ v =
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g ((transport e C').chartι i)).inv.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback ((transport e C').chartι i)).inv.app M ≫
          (transportTwistChartIso e C' i).hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback ((transport e C').chartι i)).hom.app N) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g ((transport e C').chartι i)).hom.app N) ≫ v := by
  exact congrArg (fun t => t ≫ v) (transportTwistComparisonFieldAlong_hom e C' i g)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistRightRestriction_comparisonPost
statement:
theorem transportTwistRightRestriction_comparisonPost (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (i j : C'.I) :
    let C
proof:
:= transport e C'
    let D := C.twistingSheafDescentData 1 (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1)
    let M := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (transportSchemeIso e C').hom).obj
      (C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    let N := C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1
    (transportTwistComparisonFieldAlongIso e C' j (D.right (i,j))).hom ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (D.fac (i,j))).app N).inv =
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (D.right (i,j)) (C.chartι j)).inv.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (D.right (i,j))).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (C.chartι j)).inv.app M ≫
          (transportTwistChartIso e C' j).hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (C.chartι j)).hom.app N) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (D.right (i,j)) (C.chartι j)).hom.app N) ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (D.fac (i,j))).app N).inv := by
  let C := transport e C'
  let D := C.twistingSheafDescentData 1 (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1)
  let N := C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1
  exact transportTwistRightRestriction_alongPost e C' j (D.right (i,j))
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (D.left (i,j) ≫ D.toAmbient i)).obj N)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistRightRestriction_alongPrePost
statement:
theorem transportTwistRightRestriction_alongPrePost (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (i : C'.I) {V : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : V ⟶ ((transport e C').twistingSheafDescentData 1
      ((transport e C').canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1)).chart i)
    (P Q : V.Modules)
    (u : P ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (g ≫ ((transport e C').twistingSheafDescentData 1
      ((transport e C').canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1)).toAmbient i)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (transportSchemeIso e C').hom).obj
        (C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)))
    (v : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (g ≫ ((transport e C').twistingSheafDescentData 1
      ((transport e C').canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1)).toAmbient i)).obj
      ((transport e C').canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) ⟶ Q) :
    let M
proof:
:= (Scheme.Modules.pullback (transportSchemeIso e C').hom).obj
      (C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    let N := (transport e C').canonicalTwistingSheaf 1
    u ≫ ((transportTwistComparisonFieldAlongIso e C' i g).hom ≫ v) =
    u ≫ (
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g ((transport e C').chartι i)).inv.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback ((transport e C').chartι i)).inv.app M ≫
          (transportTwistChartIso e C' i).hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback ((transport e C').chartι i)).hom.app N) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g ((transport e C').chartι i)).hom.app N) ≫ v) := by
  exact congrArg (fun t => u ≫ t) (transportTwistRightRestriction_alongPost e C' i g Q v)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistRightRestriction_comparisonPrePost
statement:
theorem transportTwistRightRestriction_comparisonPrePost (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (i j : C'.I) :

proof:
:= transport e C'

      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (D.fac (i,j))).app N).inv) =
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (D.fac (i,j))).app M).hom ≫

  let C := transport e C'

  let M := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (transportSchemeIso e C').hom).obj

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistComparison_rightRestriction
statement:
theorem transportTwistComparison_rightRestriction (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (i j : C'.I) :
    let C
proof:
:= transport e C'
    let D := C.twistingSheafDescentData 1 (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1)
    let M := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (transportSchemeIso e C').hom).obj
      (C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    let N := C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1
    letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.transition i j) := C.transition_isOpenImmersion' i j
    let s := C.overlapToChart i j ≫ C.chartι i
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback s).inv.app M ≫
      tensorOverlap_tr s (C.chartι j) (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i)
        (by rw [Category.assoc]; exact (C.overlapToChart_chartι_eq i j).symm)
        (transportTwistChartIso e C' j).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback s).hom.app N =
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (D.fac (i,j))).app M).hom ≫
      (transportTwistComparisonFieldAlongIso e C' j (D.right (i,j))).hom ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (D.fac (i,j))).app N).inv := by
  exact (transportTwistComparison_rightRestrictionPrefix e C' i j).trans
    (transportTwistRightRestriction_comparisonPrefix e C' i j).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistOverlapRestrictionEquality_of_overlapCompat
statement:
theorem transportTwistOverlapRestrictionEquality_of_overlapCompat (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (h : TransportTwistOverlapCompat e C') :
    TransportTwistOverlapRestrictionEquality e C'
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  let C := transport e C'
  let M := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (transportSchemeIso e C').hom).obj
      (C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
  let N := C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.transition i j) := C.transition_isOpenImmersion' i j
  let s := C.overlapToChart i j ≫ C.chartι i
  apply (cancel_mono ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback s).hom.app N)).1
  apply (cancel_epi ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback s).inv.app M)).1
  exact (transportTwistComparison_leftRestriction e C' i j).trans
    ((transportTwistComparisonField_transition e C' h i j).trans
      (transportTwistComparison_rightRestriction e C' i j).symm)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistOverlapRestrictionEquality
statement:

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistCompat_of_overlapCompat
statement:
theorem transportTwistCompat_of_overlapCompat (e : E ≅ E')

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportStatement_of_actualTwistDescent

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackRestrictionCompIso_refl_eq_trans
statement:
theorem pullbackRestrictionCompIso_refl_eq_trans
    {A B D : Scheme.{u}} (q : B ⟶ A) (r : D ⟶ B)
    [IsOpenImmersion q] [IsOpenImmersion r] (M : A.Modules) :
    pullbackRestrictionCompIso (r ≫ q) q r rfl M =
      pullbackTransIso r q M
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  rw [CommonBasicOpen.twistPullHomAux_pullbackRestrictionCompIso_hom_eq]
  simp [Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr, pullbackTransIso]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.iso_square_route_eq
statement:
theorem iso_square_route_eq
    {T : Type u} [Category T] {P Q R S : T}
    (a : P ≅ Q) (d : Q ≅ S) (b : P ≅ R) (r : R ≅ S)
    (h : (a ≪≫ d).hom = (b ≪≫ r).hom) :
    r ≪≫ d.symm = b.symm ≪≫ a
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  have hc := congrArg (fun f => b.inv ≫ f ≫ d.inv) h
  simpa only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc,
    Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id] using hc.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.commonChartTwistLeftTransportIso_eq_route
statement:
theorem commonChartTwistLeftTransportIso_eq_route
    (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    {i j : C'.I} (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    commonChartTwistLeftTransportIso e C' c =
      commonChartTwistLeftTransportRoute e C' c
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (C'.basisIndex i) := C'.basisIndex_finite i
  letI : Finite ((transport e C').basisIndex i) :=
    (transport e C').basisIndex_finite i
  letI hz : IsOpenImmersion (chartIso e C' i).hom := by infer_instance
  letI hk : IsOpenImmersion (commonChartIso e C' c).hom := by infer_instance
  letI hl : IsOpenImmersion c.chartToLeft :=
    CommonBasicOpen.chartToLeft_isOpenImmersion c
  letI ht : IsOpenImmersion (c.transport e C').chartToLeft :=
    CommonBasicOpen.chartToLeft_isOpenImmersion (c.transport e C')
  have h := chartTwist_left_pullback_naturality e C' c
  unfold commonChartTwistLeftTransportIso commonChartTwistLeftTransportRoute
  simp only [← Iso.trans_assoc]
  conv_rhs => simp only [Iso.trans_assoc]
  apply iso_square_route_eq
  simpa only [Iso.trans_assoc] using h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.commonChartTwistRightTransportIso_eq_route
statement:
theorem commonChartTwistRightTransportIso_eq_route
    (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    {i j : C'.I} (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    commonChartTwistRightTransportIso e C' c =
      commonChartTwistRightTransportRoute e C' c
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (C'.basisIndex j) := C'.basisIndex_finite j
  letI : Finite ((transport e C').basisIndex j) :=
    (transport e C').basisIndex_finite j
  letI hz : IsOpenImmersion (chartIso e C' j).hom := by infer_instance
  letI hk : IsOpenImmersion (commonChartIso e C' c).hom := by infer_instance
  letI hl : IsOpenImmersion c.chartToRight :=
    CommonBasicOpen.chartToRight_isOpenImmersion c
  letI ht : IsOpenImmersion (c.transport e C').chartToRight :=
    CommonBasicOpen.chartToRight_isOpenImmersion (c.transport e C')
  have h := chartTwist_right_pullback_naturality e C' c
  unfold commonChartTwistRightTransportIso commonChartTwistRightTransportRoute
  simp only [← Iso.trans_assoc]
  conv_rhs => simp only [Iso.trans_assoc]
  apply iso_square_route_eq
  simpa only [Iso.trans_assoc] using h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso_transport_route_naturality
statement:
theorem transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso_transport_route_naturality
    (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    {i j : C'.I} (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (commonChartIso e C' c).hom).mapIso
        (C'.transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso 1 i j c) ≪≫
      commonChartTwistRightTransportRoute e C' c).hom =
    (commonChartTwistLeftTransportRoute e C' c ≪≫
      (transport e C').transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso 1 i j
        (c.transport e C')).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [← commonChartTwistLeftTransportIso_eq_route,
    ← commonChartTwistRightTransportIso_eq_route]
  exact transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso_transport_naturality e C' c

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.commonOpenChartTransportIso_naturality
statement:
theorem commonOpenChartTransportIso_naturality
    (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    {i j : C'.I} (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    {M N : c.chart.Modules} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (twistComparisonOpenIso e C' c).hom).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (C'.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom).map f) ≫
      (commonOpenChartTransportIso e C' c N).hom =
    (commonOpenChartTransportIso e C' c M).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback ((transport e C').commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j
        (c.transport e C')).hom).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (commonChartIso e C' c).hom).map f)
proof:
:= by
  let η := Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (twistComparisonOpenIso e C' c).hom
      (C'.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ≪≫
    Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (twistComparisonOpenIso_commonChart e C' c) ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp
      ((transport e C').commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j (c.transport e C')).hom
        (commonChartIso e C' c).hom).symm
  have h := η.hom.naturality f
  simpa only [commonOpenChartTransportIso, η, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.app_hom,
    Iso.symm_hom, ← Iso.app_inv, NatTrans.comp_app, Functor.comp_map,
    Category.assoc] using h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.commonOpenTwistTransport_transition_naturality
statement:
theorem commonOpenTwistTransport_transition_naturality
    (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    {i j : C'.I} (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (twistComparisonOpenIso e C' c).hom).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (C'.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom).map
        (C'.transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso 1 i j c).hom) ≫
      (commonOpenTwistRightTransportIso e C' c).hom =
    (commonOpenTwistLeftTransportIso e C' c).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback ((transport e C').commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j
        (c.transport e C')).hom).map
        ((transport e C').transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso 1 i j
          (c.transport e C')).hom
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun f =>
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback ((transport e C').commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j
      (c.transport e C')).hom).map f)
    (transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso_transport_route_naturality e C' c)
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.map_comp] at h
  unfold commonOpenTwistLeftTransportIso commonOpenTwistRightTransportIso
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [← Category.assoc, commonOpenChartTransportIso_naturality, Category.assoc, h]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.iso_square_inv_naturality
statement:
theorem iso_square_inv_naturality
    {T : Type u} [Category T] {P Q R S : T}
    (a : P ≅ Q) (b : R ≅ S) (f : Q ⟶ S) (g : P ⟶ R)
    (h : g ≫ b.hom = a.hom ≫ f) :
    f ≫ b.inv = a.inv ≫ g
proof:
:= by
  have hc := congrArg (fun z => a.inv ≫ z ≫ b.inv) h
  simpa only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc,
    Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id] using hc.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistRestrictionRoute_transition_naturality
statement:
theorem twistRestrictionRoute_transition_naturality
    (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    {i j : C'.I} (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    ((transport e C').twistOverlapLocalSchemeIso 1 i j (c.transport e C')).hom ≫
        (twistRestrictionTargetRouteIso e C' c).hom =
      (twistRestrictionSourceRouteIso e C' c).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (twistComparisonOpenIso e C' c).hom).map
          (C'.twistOverlapLocalSchemeIso 1 i j c).hom
proof:
:= by
  have h := iso_square_inv_naturality
    (commonOpenTwistLeftTransportIso e C' c)
    (commonOpenTwistRightTransportIso e C' c)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ((transport e C').commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j
      (c.transport e C')).hom).map
        ((transport e C').transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso 1 i j
          (c.transport e C')).hom)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (twistComparisonOpenIso e C' c).hom).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (C'.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom).map
        (C'.transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso 1 i j c).hom))
    (commonOpenTwistTransport_transition_naturality e C' c)
  unfold twistRestrictionSourceRouteIso twistRestrictionTargetRouteIso
    twistOverlapLocalSchemeIso
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom,
    Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc,
    Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  slice_lhs 2 3 => exact h
  simp only [← Functor.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, Category.assoc]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.CIIB2.generator_ne_zero
statement: theorem generator_ne_zero (I : Ideal A) (r : I) (hr : r.1 ≠ 0) : generator I r ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h' : ((generator I r : reesAlgebra I) : A[X]) = 0 := by rw [h]; rfl
  change monomial 1 r.1 = 0 at h'
  exact hr (by simpa using h')

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.CIIB2.away_algebraMap_injective
statement:
theorem away_algebraMap_injective (I : Ideal A) (r : I) :
    Function.Injective (algebraMap (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grade I) (generator I r))
      (Localization.Away (generator I r)))
proof:
:=
  HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.CIIB2.isReduced_away
statement:
theorem isReduced_away [IsReduced A] (I : Ideal A) (r : I) :
    IsReduced (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grade I) (generator I r))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsReduced A[X] := (isReduced_iff _).2 fun p hp =>
    Polynomial.ext fun i => by
      simpa using (Polynomial.isNilpotent_iff.mp hp i).eq_zero
  haveI : IsReduced (reesAlgebra I) :=
    isReduced_of_injective (reesAlgebra I).val Subtype.val_injective
  haveI : IsReduced (Localization.Away (generator I r)) := inferInstance
  exact isReduced_of_injective (algebraMap _ (Localization.Away (generator I r)))
    (away_algebraMap_injective I r)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.CIIB2.isDomain_away
statement:
theorem isDomain_away [IsDomain A] (I : Ideal A) (r : I) (hr : r.1 ≠ 0) :
    IsDomain (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grade I) (generator I r))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsDomain (reesAlgebra I) := inferInstance
  haveI : IsDomain (Localization.Away (generator I r)) :=
    IsLocalization.isDomain_localization
      (powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors (generator_ne_zero I r hr))
  exact (away_algebraMap_injective I r).isDomain _

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.CIIB2.baseElement_val
statement:
theorem baseElement_val (I : Ideal A) (r : I) (a : A) :
    (baseElement I r a).val = algebraMap (reesAlgebra I) (Localization.Away (generator I r))
      (algebraMap A (reesAlgebra I) a)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [baseElement, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk]
  rw [← Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap]
  congr 1

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.CIIB2.baseRingHom_injective
statement:
theorem baseRingHom_injective [IsDomain A] (I : Ideal A) (r : I) (hr : r.1 ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective (baseRingHom I r)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  rw [baseRingHom_apply, baseRingHom_apply] at hab
  have h := congrArg HomogeneousLocalization.val hab
  rw [baseElement_val, baseElement_val] at h
  have h2 := IsLocalization.injective (Localization.Away (generator I r))
    (powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors (generator_ne_zero I r hr)) h
  have h3 := congrArg Subtype.val h2
  simpa using h3

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ReesBlowup.CIIB2.false_of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem false_of_subsingleton {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Subsingleton R] (z : PrimeSpectrum R) :
    False
proof:
:=
  z.isPrime.ne_top ((Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).2 (by
    rw [Subsingleton.elim (1 : R) 0]
    exact zero_mem _))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.fromSpec_notMem_support
statement:
theorem fromSpec_notMem_support (U : X.affineOpens)
    (r : Γ(X, U.1)) (hr : r ∈ I.ideal U) (p : Spec Γ(X, U.1)) (hp : r ∉ p.asIdeal) :
    (isAffineOpen X U).fromSpec p ∉ (I.support : Set X)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hmem : (isAffineOpen X U).fromSpec p ∈ (U.1 : Set X) := by
    rw [← IsAffineOpen.range_fromSpec (isAffineOpen X U)]; exact ⟨p, rfl⟩
  have hz := (I.mem_support_iff_of_mem hmem).mp h
  have hz' : p ∈ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I.ideal U : Set Γ(X, U.1)) := by
    rw [← IsAffineOpen.fromSpec_preimage_zeroLocus]; exact hz
  exact hp (hz' hr)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.isReduced_blowup
statement: theorem isReduced_blowup [IsReduced X] : IsReduced (blowup X I)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : ∀ j, IsReduced ((chartCover X I).X j) := fun j => by
    change IsReduced (Spec (.of (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grade (I.ideal j.1))
      (generator (I.ideal j.1) j.2))))
    haveI := CIIB2.isReduced_away (I.ideal j.1) j.2
    infer_instance
  exact IsReduced.of_openCover (blowup X I) (chartCover X I)

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.centreComplement_nonempty
statement:
theorem centreComplement_nonempty [IsIntegral X] (hI : I ≠ ⊥) :
    (centreComplement X I : Set X).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∃ (U : X.affineOpens) (r : Γ(X, U.1)), r ∈ I.ideal U ∧ r ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    apply hI
    apply Scheme.IdealSheafData.ext
    funext U
    exact eq_bot_iff.2 fun r hr => by simpa using h U r hr
  obtain ⟨U, r, hr, hr0⟩ := h1
  have hb : X.basicOpen r ≠ ⊥ := fun h => hr0 ((basicOpen_eq_bot_iff r).1 h)
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (TopologicalSpace.Opens.ne_bot_iff_nonempty _).1 hb
  have hxU : x ∈ U.1 := X.basicOpen_le r hx
  refine ⟨x, fun hs => ?_⟩
  have := (I.mem_support_iff_of_mem hxU).1 hs
  rw [Scheme.mem_zeroLocus_iff] at this
  exact this r hr hx

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.chartHom_comp_toBase
statement:
theorem chartHom_comp_toBase (j : ChartIdx X I) : chartHom X I j ≫ toBase X I =
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (baseRingHom (I.ideal j.1) j.2)) ≫
      (isAffineOpen X j.1).isoSpec.inv ≫ j.1.1.ι
proof:
:= by
  have hw : (ReesBlowup.projection (I.ideal j.1) ≫ (isAffineOpen X j.1).isoSpec.inv) ≫
      j.1.1.ι = affineι X I j.1 ≫ toBase X I := (isPullback_affine X I j.1).w
  have h2 := chartMap_projection (I.ideal j.1) j.2
  calc chartHom X I j ≫ toBase X I
      = chartMap (I.ideal j.1) j.2 ≫ (affineι X I j.1 ≫ toBase X I) := Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = chartMap (I.ideal j.1) j.2 ≫ ((ReesBlowup.projection (I.ideal j.1) ≫
          (isAffineOpen X j.1).isoSpec.inv) ≫ j.1.1.ι) := by rw [hw]
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [Category.assoc]
      rw [reassoc_of% h2]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.toBase_chartHom_apply
statement:
theorem toBase_chartHom_apply (j : ChartIdx X I) (z : ReesBlowup.chart (I.ideal j.1) j.2) :
    toBase X I (chartHom X I j z) = (isAffineOpen X j.1).fromSpec
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (baseRingHom (I.ideal j.1) j.2)) z)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := congrArg (fun f => f z) (chartHom_comp_toBase X I j)
  refine h1.trans ?_
  exact congrArg (fun f => f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (baseRingHom (I.ideal j.1) j.2)) z))
    (IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_inv_ι (isAffineOpen X j.1))

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.chart_r_ne_zero
statement:
theorem chart_r_ne_zero (j : ChartIdx X I) (z : ReesBlowup.chart (I.ideal j.1) j.2) :
    j.2.1 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  have hg : generator (I.ideal j.1) j.2 = 0 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change monomial 1 j.2.1 = 0
    rw [h0]; simp
  haveI := HomogeneousLocalization.subsingleton (grade (I.ideal j.1))
    (x := Submonoid.powers (generator (I.ideal j.1) j.2)) ⟨1, by simp [hg]⟩
  let z' : PrimeSpectrum (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grade (I.ideal j.1))
      (generator (I.ideal j.1) j.2)) := z
  exact CIIB2.false_of_subsingleton z'

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.chart_mem_closure
statement:
theorem chart_mem_closure [IsIntegral X] (j : ChartIdx X I)
    (z : ReesBlowup.chart (I.ideal j.1) j.2) :
    z ∈ closure (chartHom X I j ⁻¹'
      ((toBase X I ⁻¹ᵁ centreComplement X I : (blowup X I).Opens) : Set (blowup X I)))
proof:
:= by
  have hr := chart_r_ne_zero X I j z
  haveI : Nonempty j.1.1 := ⟨(isAffineOpen X j.1).isoSpec.inv
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (baseRingHom (I.ideal j.1) j.2)) z)⟩
  haveI : IsDomain Γ(X, j.1.1) := inferInstance
  haveI := CIIB2.isDomain_away (I.ideal j.1) j.2 hr
  set φ := baseRingHom (I.ideal j.1) j.2 with hφ
  have hf : φ j.2.1 ≠ 0 :=
    fun h => hr (CIIB2.baseRingHom_injective _ _ hr (h.trans (map_zero φ).symm))
  have hopen : IsOpen (chartHom X I j ⁻¹'
      ((toBase X I ⁻¹ᵁ centreComplement X I : (blowup X I).Opens) : Set (blowup X I))) :=
    (chartHom X I j).continuous.isOpen_preimage _ (toBase X I ⁻¹ᵁ centreComplement X I).isOpen
  have hsub : ∀ z' : PrimeSpectrum (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grade (I.ideal j.1))
      (generator (I.ideal j.1) j.2)), φ j.2.1 ∉ z'.asIdeal →
      z' ∈ chartHom X I j ⁻¹'
        ((toBase X I ⁻¹ᵁ centreComplement X I : (blowup X I).Opens) : Set (blowup X I)) := by
    intro z' hz
    show toBase X I (chartHom X I j z') ∈ centreComplement X I
    rw [toBase_chartHom_apply]
    exact fromSpec_notMem_support X I j.1 j.2.1 j.2.2 _ (fun h => hz h)
  have hne : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (φ j.2.1) ≠ ⊥ := by
    rw [Ne, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_eq_bot_iff, isNilpotent_iff_eq_zero]; exact hf
  obtain ⟨z0, hz0⟩ := (TopologicalSpace.Opens.ne_bot_iff_nonempty _).1 hne
  exact (hopen.dense ⟨z0, hsub z0 hz0⟩) z

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.dense_W
statement:
theorem dense_W [IsIntegral X] :
    Dense ((toBase X I ⁻¹ᵁ centreComplement X I : (blowup X I).Opens) : Set (blowup X I))
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨j, y, hy⟩ := (chartCover X I).exists_eq x
  have h := chart_mem_closure X I j y
  have h2 := map_mem_closure (chartHom X I j).continuous h
    (t := ((toBase X I ⁻¹ᵁ centreComplement X I : (blowup X I).Opens) : Set (blowup X I)))
    (fun z hz => hz)
  rw [← hy]
  exact h2

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.isIrreducible_W
statement:
theorem isIrreducible_W [IsIntegral X] (hne : (centreComplement X I : Set X).Nonempty) :
    IsIrreducible ((toBase X I ⁻¹ᵁ centreComplement X I : (blowup X I).Opens) :
      Set (blowup X I))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty (centreComplement X I).toScheme := hne.to_subtype
  haveI : IsIntegral (centreComplement X I).toScheme :=
    isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion (centreComplement X I).ι
  haveI := toBase_restrict_isIso X I
  haveI : Nonempty (toBase X I ⁻¹ᵁ centreComplement X I).toScheme :=
    ⟨inv (toBase X I ∣_ centreComplement X I) (Classical.arbitrary _)⟩
  haveI : IsIntegral (toBase X I ⁻¹ᵁ centreComplement X I).toScheme :=
    isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion (toBase X I ∣_ centreComplement X I)
  have := (IrreducibleSpace.isIrreducible_univ
    (toBase X I ⁻¹ᵁ centreComplement X I).toScheme).image _
    (toBase X I ⁻¹ᵁ centreComplement X I).ι.continuous.continuousOn
  have h2 : (toBase X I ⁻¹ᵁ centreComplement X I).ι '' Set.univ =
      ((toBase X I ⁻¹ᵁ centreComplement X I : (blowup X I).Opens) : Set (blowup X I)) := by
    rw [Set.image_univ]; exact Scheme.Opens.range_ι _
  rwa [h2] at this

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalBlowup.isIntegral_blowup
statement: theorem isIntegral_blowup [IsIntegral X] (hI : I ≠ ⊥) : IsIntegral (blowup X I)
proof:
:= by
  have hne := centreComplement_nonempty X I hI
  haveI := isReduced_blowup X I
  have hW := isIrreducible_W X I hne
  haveI : IrreducibleSpace (blowup X I) := by
    rw [irreducibleSpace_def]
    have := hW.closure
    rwa [(dense_W X I).closure_eq] at this
  exact isIntegral_of_irreducibleSpace_of_isReduced _

statement:
theorem cosectionAffinePulledBasis_weaklyRegular [Flat g]
    (σ : E ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) {n : ℕ}
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin n) Γ(X,U) Γ(E,U.1))
    (hb : RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular Γ(X,U)
      (List.ofFn (fun i => affineCosection X E σ U (b i)))) :
    RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular Γ(Y,V)
      (List.ofFn (fun i => affineCosection Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
        (pulledCosection g σ) V (cosectionAffinePulledBasis g U V h E b i)))
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra Γ(X,U) Γ(Y,V) := (g.appLE U.1 V.1 h).hom.toAlgebra
  letI := cosectionAffineScalar_flat g U V h
  have hs := weaklyRegular_scalarExtension (S := Γ(Y,V)) _ hb
  simp only [List.map_ofFn] at hs
  have he : (List.ofFn (fun i => affineCosection Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
      (pulledCosection g σ) V (cosectionAffinePulledBasis g U V h E b i))) =
      List.ofFn (fun i => (g.appLE U.1 V.1 h).hom (affineCosection X E σ U (b i))) := by
    congr 1
    funext i
    exact cosectionAffinePulledBasis_coefficient g U V h E σ b i
  rw [he]
  with_unfolding_all exact hs

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.pulledCosection_locallyFiniteWeaklyRegularFrames
statement:
theorem pulledCosection_locallyFiniteWeaklyRegularFrames [Flat g]
    (hX : LocallyFiniteWeaklyRegularFrames X E σ) :
    LocallyFiniteWeaklyRegularFrames Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E) (pulledCosection g σ)
proof:
:= by
  intro O y hy
  obtain ⟨A, _, hgy, hA, n, b, hb⟩ := hX ⊤ (g y) (by trivial)
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨B,hB,rfl⟩,hyB,hBO⟩ := Y.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open
    (show y ∈ O ⊓ g ⁻¹ᵁ A from ⟨hy,hgy⟩) (O ⊓ g ⁻¹ᵁ A).isOpen
  let A' : X.affineOpens := ⟨A,hA⟩
  let B' : Y.affineOpens := ⟨B,hB⟩
  have hBA : B ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ A := fun z hz => (hBO hz).2
  have hb' : RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular Γ(X,A')
    (List.ofFn (fun i => affineCosection X E σ A' (b i))) := hb
  refine ⟨B,(fun z hz => (hBO hz).1),hyB,hB,n,cosectionAffinePulledBasis g A' B' hBA E b,?_⟩
  have hs := cosectionAffinePulledBasis_weaklyRegular g A' B' hBA E σ b hb'
  with_unfolding_all exact hs

theorem pointInfKDGc_not_mem_range_chart_one (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (s : Spec (.of R)) :
    pointInfKDGc R s ∉ Set.range (chart R 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hmem : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : R)))) s ∈
      chart R 0 ⁻¹ᵁ (chart R 1).opensRange := h
  rw [chart_zero_preimage] at hmem
  have hmem' : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : R)))) s ∈
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (Polynomial.X : R[X]) : Set (PrimeSpectrum R[X])) := hmem
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, PrimeSpectrum.mem_basicOpen] at hmem'
  apply hmem'
  show (Polynomial.X : R[X]) ∈
    (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : R)) (show PrimeSpectrum R from s)).asIdeal
  simp [PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal, Ideal.mem_comap]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.KDGc.isPushout_zeroPoint
statement:
theorem isPushout_zeroPoint {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S) :
    IsPushout (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.mapRingHom f))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : R)))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : S))) (CommRingCat.ofHom f)
proof:
:= by
  have w : CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.mapRingHom f) ≫
      CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : S)) =
      CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : R)) ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom f := by
    refine CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext fun p => ?_)
    simp [Polynomial.eval_zero_map]
  refine IsPushout.of_isColimit' ⟨w⟩ (PushoutCocone.IsColimit.mk _
    (fun s => CommRingCat.ofHom (s.inl.hom.comp (Polynomial.C : S →+* S[X]))) ?_ ?_ ?_)
  · intro s
    refine CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext fun p => ?_)
    have hX : s.inl.hom (Polynomial.X : S[X]) = 0 := by
      have h := congrArg (fun q => q.hom (Polynomial.X : R[X])) s.condition
      simpa using h
    have hp := Polynomial.divX_mul_X_add p
    change s.inl.hom (Polynomial.C (Polynomial.eval 0 p)) = s.inl.hom p
    conv_rhs => rw [← hp]
    rw [map_add, map_mul, hX, mul_zero, zero_add, Polynomial.coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero]
  · intro s
    refine CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext fun r => ?_)
    have h := congrArg (fun q => q.hom (Polynomial.C r : R[X])) s.condition
    simpa using h
  · intro s m h1 _
    refine CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext fun x => ?_)
    have h2 := congrArg (fun q => q.hom (Polynomial.C x : S[X])) h1
    simp at h2
    simpa using h2

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.KDGc.ker_pointInf_comap_chart
statement:
theorem ker_pointInf_comap_chart (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsClosedImmersion (pointInfKDGc R)] :
    (pointInfKDGc R).ker.comap (chart R 0) =
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : R)))).ker
proof:
:= by
  have h : IsPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : R))))
      (𝟙 (Spec (.of R))) (chart R 0) (pointInfKDGc R) := by
    refine IsPullback.of_isLimit' ⟨by simp [pointInfKDGc]⟩ (PullbackCone.isLimitAux _
      (fun s => s.snd) ?_ (fun s => Category.comp_id _) (fun s m h => by
        have h' := h WalkingCospan.right
        exact (Category.comp_id m).symm.trans h'))
    intro s
    rw [← cancel_mono (chart R 0), s.condition]
    simp [pointInfKDGc]
  exact (InfinityOtherStrictTransform.closedImmersion_ker_of_isPullback h).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.KDGc.ker_zero_comap_map
statement:
theorem ker_zero_comap_map {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S) :
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : R)))).ker.comap
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.mapRingHom f))) =

    ⟨Polynomial.C r, by simp⟩
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : R)))) :=
    IsClosedImmersion.spec_of_surjective _ hsurj
  have h := isPullback_SpecMap_of_isPushout _ _ _ _ (isPushout_zeroPoint f)
  exact (InfinityOtherStrictTransform.closedImmersion_ker_of_isPullback h).symm

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.KDGc.ideal_eq_of_two_charts
statement:
theorem ideal_eq_of_two_charts (Y : Scheme.{u}) (J : Y.IdealSheafData)
    (K L : (totalGlobal Y J).IdealSheafData)
    (h1 : K.comap (blowupGlobalι Y J) = L.comap (blowupGlobalι Y J))
    (h2 : K.comap (lineTι Y J) = L.comap (lineTι Y J)) : K = L
proof:
:= by
  let c1 := (blowupGlobal Y J).affineOpenCover
  let c2 := (DeformationSpace.line Y).affineOpenCover
  let F : c1.I₀ ⊕ c2.I₀ → (totalGlobal Y J).affineOpens := Sum.elim
    (fun j ↦ ⟨(c1.f j ≫ blowupGlobalι Y J).opensRange, isAffineOpen_opensRange _⟩)
    (fun j ↦ ⟨(c2.f j ≫ lineTι Y J).opensRange, isAffineOpen_opensRange _⟩)
  have hcov : ⨆ i, (F i).1 = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro x _
    rcases exists_blowupGlobal_or_line Y J x with ⟨b, rfl⟩ | ⟨l, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨j, y, hy⟩ := c1.openCover.exists_eq b
      refine Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨Sum.inl j, ⟨y, ?_⟩⟩
      rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
      exact congrArg _ hy
    · obtain ⟨j, y, hy⟩ := c2.openCover.exists_eq l
      refine Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨Sum.inr j, ⟨y, ?_⟩⟩
      rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
      exact congrArg _ hy
  apply Scheme.IdealSheafData.ext_of_iSup_eq_top F hcov
  rintro (j | j)
  · refine ideal_eq_at_range _ _ _ ?_
    rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp, Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp, h1]
  · refine ideal_eq_at_range _ _ _ ?_
    rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp, Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp, h2]

        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.mapRingHom (integerMap k))) =
      InfinityGlobal.blowupToIntegerLine Y J
proof:
:= by
  refine colimit.hom_ext fun U => ?_
  change blowupAffineι Y J U ≫ _ = blowupAffineι Y J U ≫ _
  rw [← Category.assoc, blowupAffineι_toLineOver, InfinityGlobal.blowupAffineι_toIntegerLine]
  unfold blToLineOverU InfinityGlobal.blowupToIntegerLineU

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.KDGc.toLineOver_comp_map
statement:
theorem toLineOver_comp_map :
    DeformationSpace.toLineOver Y ⊥ k φk ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.mapRingHom (integerMap k))) =
      InfinityGlobal.deformationToIntegerLine Y ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine RelativeSpec.hom_ext fun U => ?_
  change DeformationSpace.affineι Y ⊥ U ≫ _ = DeformationSpace.affineι Y ⊥ U ≫ _
  rw [← Category.assoc, DeformationSpace.affineι_toLineOver Y ⊥ k φk U,
    InfinityGlobal.deformationAffineι_toIntegerLine]
  unfold InfinityGlobal.deformationToIntegerLineU AffineDeformationSpace.toLine
  rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  congr 2
  refine RingHom.ext fun p => ?_
  simp only [DeformationSpace.lineHom, RingHom.comp_apply]
  rw [show (Polynomial.mapRingHom (DeformationSpace.kAlg Y k φk U))
      ((Polynomial.mapRingHom (integerMap k)) p) =
      (Polynomial.mapRingHom (integerMap Γ(Y, U.1))) p from
    RingHom.congr_fun (mapRingHom_kAlg_comp Y k φk U) p]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.KDGc.toP1Global_comp_map
statement:
theorem toP1Global_comp_map :
    toP1Global Y J k φk ≫ SchemeProjectiveSpace.map (integerMap k) 1 =
      InfinityGlobal.totalToIntegerP1 Y J
proof:
:= by
  apply pushout.hom_ext
  · change blowupGlobalι Y J ≫ _ = blowupGlobalι Y J ≫ _
    rw [← Category.assoc, blowupGlobalι_toP1, Category.assoc,
      SubschemeProductGlobal.projectiveLineChart_map (integerMap k) 0, ← Category.assoc,
      blowupToLineOver_comp_map, InfinityGlobal.blowupGlobalι_totalToIntegerP1]
  · change lineTι Y J ≫ _ = lineTι Y J ≫ _
    rw [← Category.assoc, lineTι_toP1, Category.assoc,
      SubschemeProductGlobal.projectiveLineChart_map (integerMap k) 1, ← Category.assoc,
      toLineOver_comp_map, InfinityGlobal.lineTι_totalToIntegerP1]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.KDGc.ker_infinityFibreι
statement:
theorem ker_infinityFibreι :

:=
