name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.KDGc.kdgc_C1
statement:
theorem kdgc_C1 :
    (infinityFibreι Y J).ker =
      (pullback.fst (toP1Global Y J k φk) (pointInfKDGc k)).ker
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_fst_of_isClosedImmersion (pointInfKDGc k) (toP1Global Y J k φk)]
  refine ideal_eq_of_two_charts Y J _ _ ?_ ?_
  · rw [ker_infinityFibreι, ← Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp,
      InfinityGlobal.blowupGlobalι_totalToIntegerP1, Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp,
      ker_pointInf_comap_chart, ← blowupToLineOver_comp_map Y J k φk,
      Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp, ker_zero_comap_map,
      ← Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp, blowupGlobalι_toP1, Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp,
      ker_pointInf_comap_chart]
  · rw [ker_comap_eq_top_of_disjoint _ _ (disjoint_range_infinityFibreι_lineTι Y J),
      ← Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp, lineTι_toP1, Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp,
      ker_comap_eq_top_of_disjoint (pointInfKDGc k) (chart k 1) ?_, Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_top]
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro _ ⟨s, rfl⟩ h
    exact pointInfKDGc_not_mem_range_chart_one k s h

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.KDGc.kdgc_C2
statement:
theorem kdgc_C2 :
    (componentToTotal Y J).ker.comap (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) =
      (infinityFibreι Y J).ker.comap (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := otherToTotal_isClosedImmersion Y J
  let U : (totalGlobal Y J).Opens :=
    ⟨(Set.range (otherToTotal Y J))ᶜ,
      (otherToTotal Y J).isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range.isOpen_compl⟩
  have hU : Disjoint (Set.range (otherToTotal Y J)) (Set.range U.ι) := by
    rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
    exact disjoint_compl_right
  have hrange : Set.range (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) ⊆ Set.range U.ι := by
    rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩ ⟨c, hc⟩
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (disjoint_range_otherToTotal_subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)
      ⟨c, hc⟩ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  have hF : IsOpenImmersion.lift U.ι (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) hrange ≫ U.ι =
      subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J := IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _
  rw [← hF, Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp, Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp,
    ← total_branch_product, comap_mul_of_openImmersion,
    ker_comap_eq_top_of_disjoint _ _ hU, Scheme.IdealSheafData.top_mul]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.KDGc.kdgc_C3a
statement:
theorem kdgc_C3a :
    (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk 1).ker.comap (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) =
      (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J ≫ toP1Global Y J k φk)
        (DeformationSpace.pointAt k 1)).ker
proof:
:= by
  have hj : (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk 1).ker =
      (DeformationSpace.pointAt k 1).ker.comap (toP1Global Y J k φk) :=
    closedImmersion_ker_of_isPullback (fibre_isPullback_P1Global Y J k φk 1).flip
  rw [hj, ← Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp,
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_fst_of_isClosedImmersion]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.KDGc.kdgc_C3b
statement:
theorem kdgc_C3b :
    (componentToTotal Y J).ker.comap (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) =
      (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J ≫ toP1Global Y J k φk) (pointInfKDGc k)).ker
proof:
:= by
  rw [kdgc_C2, kdgc_C1 Y J k φk,
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_fst_of_isClosedImmersion (pointInfKDGc k) (toP1Global Y J k φk),
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_fst_of_isClosedImmersion (pointInfKDGc k)
      (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J ≫ toP1Global Y J k φk),
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.comap_comp]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.KDGc.kdgc_ne_bot
statement:
theorem kdgc_ne_bot [Nonempty J.subscheme] (p : Spec (.of k) ⟶ P1 k) [IsClosedImmersion p] :
    (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J ≫ toP1Global Y J k φk) p).ker ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  intro hb
  haveI : IsIso (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J ≫ toP1Global Y J k φk) p) :=
    IsClosedImmersion.isIso_iff_ker_eq_bot.mpr hb
  obtain ⟨x⟩ := ‹Nonempty J.subscheme›
  have SqW := isPullback_totalIntegerP1 Y J
  let s1 : J.subscheme ⟶ subschemeTotalGlobal Y J :=
    SqW.lift (𝟙 _) (closedBaseToInteger Y J ≫ InfinityGlobal.infinityPoint) (by
      rw [Category.assoc, InfinityGlobal.infinityPoint_toSpec, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp])
  let s2 : J.subscheme ⟶ subschemeTotalGlobal Y J :=
    SqW.lift (𝟙 _) (closedBaseToInteger Y J ≫ pointOneKDGc integerRing) (by
      rw [Category.assoc, pointOneKDGc_toSpec, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp])
  have hs1 : s1 ≫ SubschemeProductGlobal.totalToIntegerP1 Y J =
      closedBaseToInteger Y J ≫ InfinityGlobal.infinityPoint := SqW.lift_snd _ _ _
  have hs2 : s2 ≫ SubschemeProductGlobal.totalToIntegerP1 Y J =
      closedBaseToInteger Y J ≫ pointOneKDGc integerRing := SqW.lift_snd _ _ _
  have hkey : ∀ w, SchemeProjectiveSpace.map (integerMap k) 1
      (toP1Global Y J k φk (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J w)) =
      SubschemeProductGlobal.totalToIntegerP1 Y J w := by
    intro w
    have h := congrArg (fun q => q w)
      (show (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J ≫ toP1Global Y J k φk) ≫
          SchemeProjectiveSpace.map (integerMap k) 1 =
        SubschemeProductGlobal.totalToIntegerP1 Y J by
        rw [Category.assoc, toP1Global_comp_map, KSpecialization.CIIL3B.subschemeTotalGlobalι_totalToIntegerP1])
    simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using h
  have hne : SubschemeProductGlobal.totalToIntegerP1 Y J (s1 x) ≠
      SubschemeProductGlobal.totalToIntegerP1 Y J (s2 x) := by
    have e1 := congrArg (fun q => q x) hs1
    have e2 := congrArg (fun q => q x) hs2
    simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at e1 e2
    rw [e1, e2]
    intro h
    exact pointInfKDGc_not_mem_range_chart_one integerRing _
      (h ▸ pointOneKDGc_mem_range_chart_one integerRing _)
  have hconst : ∀ w : subschemeTotalGlobal Y J,
      ∃ z : Spec (.of k), (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J ≫ toP1Global Y J k φk) w = p z := by
    intro w
    refine ⟨(pullback.snd (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J ≫ toP1Global Y J k φk) p)
      (inv (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J ≫ toP1Global Y J k φk) p) w), ?_⟩
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← pullback.condition]
    rw [IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  obtain ⟨z1, hz1⟩ := hconst (s1 x)
  obtain ⟨z2, hz2⟩ := hconst (s2 x)
  have hz : z1 = z2 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  apply hne
  rw [← hkey, ← hkey]
  change SchemeProjectiveSpace.map (integerMap k) 1 ((subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J ≫ toP1Global Y J k φk) (s1 x)) =
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.map (integerMap k) 1 ((subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J ≫ toP1Global Y J k φk) (s2 x))
  rw [hz1, hz2, hz]

name: SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.KDGc.kdgc_ideals
statement:
theorem kdgc_ideals [Nonempty J.subscheme] : KDGcIdeals Y J k φk where
  j_eq
proof:
:= kdgc_C3a Y J k φk
  e_eq := kdgc_C3b Y J k φk
  j_ne := by rw [kdgc_C3a Y J k φk]; exact kdgc_ne_bot Y J k φk _
  e_ne := by rw [kdgc_C3b Y J k φk]; exact kdgc_ne_bot Y J k φk _

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4.functional_evTrunc'
statement:
theorem functional_evTrunc' {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module ℚ N] (D n : ℕ) (hnD : n ≤ D)
    (H : Module.End ℚ M) (v : M) (Ψ : M →ₗ[ℚ] N) (w : N)
    (hΨ : ∀ p ≤ D, Ψ ((H ^ p) v) = if p = n then w else 0) (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) :
    Ψ (evTrunc D H f v) = coeff n f • w
proof:
:= by
  rw [evTrunc_eq_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply, map_sum]
  have : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (D + 1),
      Ψ ((coeff i f • H ^ i) v) = if i = n then coeff n f • w else 0 := by
    intro i hi
    have hi' : i ≤ D := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
    rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul, hΨ i hi']
    by_cases h : i = n
    · subst h; simp
    · simp [h]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl this, Finset.sum_ite_eq' (Finset.range (D + 1)) n
    (fun _ ↦ coeff n f • w)]
  rw [if_pos (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hnD))]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4.chiOp_int'
statement:
theorem chiOp_int' {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module ℚ N] (D n : ℕ) (hnD : n ≤ D)
    (H : Module.End ℚ M) (v : M) (hv : (H ^ (D + 1)) v = 0) (Ψ : M →ₗ[ℚ] N) (w : N)
    (hΨ : ∀ p ≤ D, Ψ ((H ^ p) v) = if p = n then w else 0) (m : ℤ) :
    Ψ (evTrunc D H (rescale (m : ℚ) (exp ℚ)) (((evTrunc D H tdSer) ^ (n + 1)) v)) =
      Ring.choose ((m : ℚ) + n) n • w
proof:
:= by
  rw [evTrunc_pow_apply D H v hv, ← evTrunc_mul_apply D H v hv,
    functional_evTrunc' D n hnD H v Ψ w hΨ]
  rw [← hrrNum_int n m]
  rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4.S_mono
statement: theorem S_mono {d d' : ℕ} (h : d ≤ d') : S M d ≤ S M d'
proof:
:=
  Submodule.span_mono fun w ⟨j, hj, y, hy⟩ ↦ ⟨j, hj.trans h, y, hy⟩

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4.exists_mem_S
statement: theorem exists_mem_S (β : DirectSum ℕ M) : ∃ d, β ∈ S M d
proof:
:= by
  induction β using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, Submodule.zero_mem _⟩
  | of j y => exact ⟨j, by simpa [DirectSum.lof_eq_of] using lof_mem_S (le_refl j) y⟩
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨max a b, Submodule.add_mem _ (S_mono (le_max_left a b) ha)
      (S_mono (le_max_right a b) hb)⟩

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4.segre_push
statement:
theorem segre_push (β : TotalChow Y) (p : ℕ) :
    totalPushOn (opsV4 k) C.toBase ((xiCapOn (opsV4 k) C ^ p) (pullZ k C hC β)) =
      if p = n then β else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ∀ j, sandwichOn (opsV4 k) C (cpV4 k) hC j β =
      totalPushOn (opsV4 k) C.toBase ((xiCapOn (opsV4 k) C ^ j) (pullZ k C hC β)) :=
    fun j ↦ rfl
  rcases lt_trichotomy p n with h | h | h
  · rw [← hs, sandwichOn_eq_zero_of_lt (opsV4 k) C (cpV4 k) hC h, if_neg (Nat.ne_of_lt h)]
    rfl
  · subst h
    rw [if_pos rfl, ← hs]
    have := congrArg (fun f ↦ f β) (segreOn_zero (opsV4 k) C (cpV4 k) hC)
    simpa [segreOn] using this
  · rw [← hs, sandwichOn_free_eq_zero k C hC h, if_neg (Nat.ne_of_gt h)]
    rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4.pullZ_mem_S
proof:
:= by
  induction h using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem w hw =>
    obtain ⟨j, hj, y, rfl⟩ := hw
    haveI : Flat C.toBase := C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos n))
    have : pullZ k C hC (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow Y m) j y) =
        DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow C.scheme m) (j + n)
          ((opsV4 k).pull C.toBase n ((cpV4 k).projBundle_relDim C hC) j y) := by
      unfold pullZ totalPullOn
      rw [DirectSum.toModule_lof]
      rfl
    rw [this]
    exact lof_mem_S (by omega) _
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hx

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4.xi_pow_vanish
proof:
:= by
  induction hv using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem w hw =>
    obtain ⟨j, hj, y, rfl⟩ := hw
    exact (lowersDeg_totalCapOn k (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
      (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)).pow_apply_lof_zero j y (D + 1) (by omega)
  | zero => rw [map_zero]
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [map_smul, hx, smul_zero]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4.eval_twist
statement:
theorem eval_twist (m : ℤ) (L : C.scheme.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank C.scheme L 1)
    (hcap : totalCapOn (opsV4 k) L hL = (m : ℚ) • xiCapOn (opsV4 k) C) (β : TotalChow Y) :
    totalPushOn (opsV4 k) C.toBase
        (((tdLine k (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)) ^
            (n + 1)) (chBundle k (closedPosV4 k) L (pullZ k C hC β))) =
      Ring.choose ((m : ℚ) + n) n • β
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := exists_mem_S β
  have hv := pullZ_mem_S k C hC hd
  have hH : xiCapOn (opsV4 k) C = totalCapOn (opsV4 k) (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
      (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) := rfl
  have h1 : chBundle k (closedPosV4 k) L (pullZ k C hC β) =
      evTrunc (d + n) (xiCapOn (opsV4 k) C) (rescale (m : ℚ) (exp ℚ)) (pullZ k C hC β) := by
    rw [chBundle_line k (closedPosV4 k) L hL hv, hcap, evTrunc_smul_op]
  have hmem : evTrunc (d + n) (xiCapOn (opsV4 k) C) (rescale (m : ℚ) (exp ℚ)) (pullZ k C hC β) ∈
      S (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow C.scheme m) (d + n) :=
    (lowersDeg_totalCapOn k (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
      (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)).evTrunc_mem_S hv _
  rw [h1, tdLine_pow_apply k _ (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) hmem (n + 1), ← hH]
  have hc : Commute ((evTrunc (d + n) (xiCapOn (opsV4 k) C) tdSer) ^ (n + 1))
      (evTrunc (d + n) (xiCapOn (opsV4 k) C) (rescale (m : ℚ) (exp ℚ))) :=
    Commute.pow_left (evTrunc_comm (d + n) _ _ _) (n + 1)
  rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, hc.eq, Module.End.mul_apply]
  exact chiOp_int' (d + n) n (by omega) (xiCapOn (opsV4 k) C) (pullZ k C hC β)
    (xi_pow_vanish k C hv) (totalPushOn (opsV4 k) C.toBase) β
    (fun p _ ↦ segre_push k C hC β p) m

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D25.freeOverIso_unit
statement:
theorem freeOverIso_unit (W : X.Opens) :
    (freeOverIso X W PUnit).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 W)))
      ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over W)).inv.val.app
        (op (Over.mk (𝟙 W))) (1 : Γ(X, W))) =
    (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op W) (1 : Γ(X, W))
proof:
:= by
  have h : (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over W) PUnit.unit ≫
      (freeOverIso X W PUnit).hom) =
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf W).map (SheafOfModules.ιFree PUnit.unit) := by
    unfold freeOverIso
    rw [SheafOfModules.ιFree_mapFreeIso_hom]
    exact Category.id_comp _
  have h3 := congrArg (fun φ => φ.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 W)))) h
  have h2 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom h3 (1 : Γ(X, W))
  exact h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D25.tensorFrame_inv_pure
statement:
theorem tensorFrame_inv_pure (W : X.Opens)
    (dW : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over W) PUnit ≅ M.over W)
    (eW : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over W) PUnit ≅ N.over W)
    (m : Γ(M, W)) (z : Γ(N, W))
    (hm : dW.inv.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 W))) m =
      (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over W)).inv.val.app
        (op (Over.mk (𝟙 W))) (1 : Γ(X, W)))
    (hz : eW.inv.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 W))) z =
      (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over W)).inv.val.app
        (op (Over.mk (𝟙 W))) (1 : Γ(X, W))) :
    ((freeOverIso X W PUnit).symm ≪≫ LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver W dW eW).inv.val.app
        (op (Over.mk (𝟙 W)))
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.tensorSheafPureTensorSection M N W m z) =
    (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op W) (1 : Γ(X, W))
proof:
:= by
  have h := LineBundleLocalData.moduleSheafificationOverHomEquiv_tensorFrame_inv W dW eW
  dsimp only at h
  rw [moduleSheafificationOverHomEquiv_apply] at h
  have h3 := congrArg (fun α => α.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 W)))) h
  have h2 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom h3 (m ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, W)] z)
  refine Eq.trans h2 ?_
  unfold LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameAdjunct
  dsimp only
  let Y0 : (Over W)ᵒᵖ := op (Over.mk (𝟙 W))
  let u := SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over W)
  let a := (u.hom.val.app Y0).hom ((dW.inv.val.app Y0).hom m)
  let b := (u.hom.val.app Y0).hom ((eW.inv.val.app Y0).hom z)
  refine Eq.trans (?_ : _ = ((SheafOfModules.forget (X.ringCatSheaf.over W)).map
      (u.inv ≫ (freeOverIso X W PUnit).hom)).app Y0 (a • b)) ?_
  · exact rfl
  · let one : ↑((SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over W)).val.obj Y0) := (1 : Γ(X, W))
    have ha : a = one := by
      change (u.hom.val.app Y0).hom ((dW.inv.val.app Y0).hom m) = (1 : Γ(X, W))
      have : (dW.inv.val.app Y0).hom m = (u.inv.val.app Y0).hom (1 : Γ(X, W)) := hm
      rw [this]
      exact Iso.inv_hom_id_apply ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (X.ringCatSheaf.over W) Y0).mapIso u) (1 : Γ(X, W))
    have hb : b = one := by
      change (u.hom.val.app Y0).hom ((eW.inv.val.app Y0).hom z) = (1 : Γ(X, W))
      have : (eW.inv.val.app Y0).hom z = (u.inv.val.app Y0).hom (1 : Γ(X, W)) := hz
      rw [this]
      exact Iso.inv_hom_id_apply ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (X.ringCatSheaf.over W) Y0).mapIso u) (1 : Γ(X, W))
    have hab : a • b = one := by
      rw [ha, hb]
      exact mul_one (1 : Γ(X, W))
    exact Eq.trans (congrArg (ConcreteCategory.hom (((SheafOfModules.forget (X.ringCatSheaf.over W)).map
      (u.inv ≫ (freeOverIso X W PUnit).hom)).app Y0)) hab) (freeOverIso_unit W)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D25.frameGen_restrict_inv
statement:
theorem frameGen_restrict_inv (d : LineBundleLocalData X M x) (V : X.Opens) (hV : V ≤ d.U) :
    (d.frameOverLE V hV).inv.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 V)))
      (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.frameGen d)) =
    (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V)).inv.val.app
        (op (Over.mk (𝟙 V))) (1 : Γ(X, V))
proof:
:= by
  let Y0 : (Over V)ᵒᵖ := op (Over.mk (𝟙 V))
  have h1 : M.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.frameGen d) =
      (d.globalFrameOverLE V hV).hom.val.app Y0
        ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op V) (1 : Γ(X, V))) := by
    rw [← AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.frameSec_one d V hV]
    rfl
  rw [h1, LineBundleLocalData.globalFrameOverLE_eq_frameOverLE d V hV]
  have hfo : (freeOverIso X V PUnit).inv.val.app Y0
      ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op V) (1 : Γ(X, V))) =
      (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V)).inv.val.app Y0 (1 : Γ(X, V)) := by
    rw [← freeOverIso_unit V]
    exact Iso.hom_inv_id_apply ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (X.ringCatSheaf.over V) Y0).mapIso
      (freeOverIso X V PUnit)) _
  have hdd := Iso.hom_inv_id_apply ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (X.ringCatSheaf.over V) Y0).mapIso
      (d.frameOverLE V hV))
    ((freeOverIso X V PUnit).inv.val.app Y0
      ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op V) (1 : Γ(X, V))))
  exact hdd.trans hfo

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D25.frameGen_tensor
statement:
theorem frameGen_tensor (d : LineBundleLocalData X M x) (e : LineBundleLocalData X N x) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.frameGen (d.tensor e) =
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.tensorSheafPureTensorSection M N (d.U ⊓ e.U)
        (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ d.U)).op
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.frameGen d))
        (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ e.U)).op
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.frameGen e))
proof:
:= by
  have key := tensorFrame_inv_pure (d.U ⊓ e.U) (d.frameOverLE (d.U ⊓ e.U) inf_le_left)
    (e.frameOverLE (d.U ⊓ e.U) inf_le_right) _ _
    (frameGen_restrict_inv d _ inf_le_left) (frameGen_restrict_inv e _ inf_le_right)
  let W := d.U ⊓ e.U
  let Y0 : (Over W)ᵒᵖ := op (Over.mk (𝟙 W))
  let G := (freeOverIso X W PUnit).symm ≪≫ LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver W
    (d.frameOverLE W inf_le_left) (e.frameOverLE W inf_le_right)
  let P := SchemeProjectiveSpace.tensorSheafPureTensorSection M N W
    (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ d.U)).op
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.frameGen d))
    (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ e.U)).op
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.frameGen e))
  have hG := Iso.inv_hom_id_apply ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (X.ringCatSheaf.over W) Y0).mapIso G) P
  refine Eq.trans (?_ : _ = G.hom.val.app Y0
    ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op W) (1 : Γ(X, W)))) ?_
  · exact rfl
  · rw [← key]
    exact hG

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D25.pure_smul_smul
statement:
theorem pure_smul_smul (W : X.Opens) (c c' : Γ(X, W)) (m : Γ(M, W)) (z : Γ(N, W)) :
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.tensorSheafPureTensorSection M N W (c • m) (c' • z) =
      (c * c') • SchemeProjectiveSpace.tensorSheafPureTensorSection M N W m z
proof:
:= by
  unfold SchemeProjectiveSpace.tensorSheafPureTensorSection
  dsimp only
  have h1 : (c • m) ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, W)] (c' • z) = (c * c') • (m ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, W)] z) := by
    exact TensorProduct.smul_tmul_smul c c' m z
  exact (congrArg (((SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app _ |>.app (op W)).hom) h1).trans
    (map_smul ((SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app _ |>.app (op W)).hom (c * c') _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D25.sectionCoordSec_tensor
statement:
theorem sectionCoordSec_tensor (d : LineBundleLocalData X M x) (e : LineBundleLocalData X N x)
    (s : Γ(M, ⊤)) (t : Γ(N, ⊤)) :
    sectionCoordSec (d.tensor e)
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.tensorSheafPureTensorSection M N ⊤ s t) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ d.U)).op (sectionCoordSec d s) *
        X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ e.U)).op (sectionCoordSec e t)
proof:
:= by
  let W := d.U ⊓ e.U
  let a : Γ(X, W) := X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ d.U)).op (sectionCoordSec d s)
  let b : Γ(X, W) := X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ e.U)).op (sectionCoordSec e t)
  have hda : C1Cap.frameSec d W inf_le_left a =
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op s := by
    have := frameSec_restrict d d.U W le_rfl inf_le_left (sectionCoordSec d s)
    refine this.trans ?_
    rw [sectionCoordSec_spec]
    exact (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (M.presheaf.map_comp _ _) s).symm
  have heb : C1Cap.frameSec e W inf_le_right b =
      N.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op t := by
    have := frameSec_restrict e e.U W le_rfl inf_le_right (sectionCoordSec e t)
    refine this.trans ?_
    rw [sectionCoordSec_spec]
    exact (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (N.presheaf.map_comp _ _) t).symm
  apply C1Cap.frameSec_injective (d.tensor e) (d.U ⊓ e.U) le_rfl
  refine (sectionCoordSec_spec (d.tensor e) _).trans ?_
  have h1 : C1Cap.frameSec (d.tensor e) (d.U ⊓ e.U) le_rfl 1 =
      C1Cap.frameGen (d.tensor e) := rfl
  have h2 : ∀ (c : Γ(X, d.U ⊓ e.U)), c • M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ d.U)).op
      (C1Cap.frameGen d) = C1Cap.frameSec d (d.U ⊓ e.U) inf_le_left c := by
    intro c
    rw [C1Cap.frameSec_smul d (d.U ⊓ e.U) inf_le_left, C1Cap.frameSec_one]
  have h3 : ∀ (c : Γ(X, d.U ⊓ e.U)), c • N.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ e.U)).op
      (C1Cap.frameGen e) = C1Cap.frameSec e (d.U ⊓ e.U) inf_le_right c := by
    intro c
    rw [C1Cap.frameSec_smul e (d.U ⊓ e.U) inf_le_right, C1Cap.frameSec_one]
  have hres := SchemeProjectiveSpace.tensorSheafPureTensorSection_res M N
    (le_top : W ≤ ⊤) s t
  have step1 : SchemeProjectiveSpace.tensorSheafPureTensorSection M N W
        (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op s) (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op t) =
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.tensorSheafPureTensorSection M N W
        (a • M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ d.U)).op (C1Cap.frameGen d))
        (b • N.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ e.U)).op (C1Cap.frameGen e)) := by
    rw [h2 a, h3 b, hda, heb]
  have step2 := pure_smul_smul W a b
    (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ d.U)).op (C1Cap.frameGen d))
    (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ e.U)).op (C1Cap.frameGen e))
  have h1' : C1Cap.frameSec (d.tensor e) (d.U ⊓ e.U) le_rfl 1 =
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.tensorSheafPureTensorSection M N W
        (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ d.U)).op (C1Cap.frameGen d))
        (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ e.U)).op (C1Cap.frameGen e)) :=
    h1.trans (frameGen_tensor d e)
  have step3 : (a * b) • C1Cap.frameSec (d.tensor e) (d.U ⊓ e.U) le_rfl 1 =
      C1Cap.frameSec (d.tensor e) (d.U ⊓ e.U) le_rfl (a * b) :=
    (C1Cap.frameSec_smul (d.tensor e) (d.U ⊓ e.U) le_rfl (a * b)).symm
  exact hres.trans (step1.trans (step2.trans ((congrArg (fun q => (a * b) • q) h1'.symm).trans step3)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D25.frameSec_mapIso
statement:
theorem frameSec_mapIso {Q : X.Modules} (d : LineBundleLocalData X M p) (φ : M ≅ Q) (V : X.Opens)
    (hV : V ≤ d.U) (c : Γ(X, V)) :
    C1Cap.frameSec (d.mapIso φ) V hV c = φ.hom.val.app (op V) (C1Cap.frameSec d V hV c)
proof:
:= by
  unfold C1Cap.frameSec
  rw [LineBundleLocalData.globalFrame_mapIso]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D25.sectionCoordSec_mapIso
statement:
theorem sectionCoordSec_mapIso {Q : X.Modules} (d : LineBundleLocalData X M p) (φ : M ≅ Q)
    (s : Γ(M, ⊤)) :
    sectionCoordSec (d.mapIso φ) (φ.hom.val.app (op ⊤) s) = sectionCoordSec d s
proof:
:= by
  apply C1Cap.frameSec_injective (d.mapIso φ) d.U le_rfl
  refine (sectionCoordSec_spec (d.mapIso φ) _).trans ?_
  rw [frameSec_mapIso, sectionCoordSec_spec]
  exact (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (φ.hom.val.naturality (homOfLE (le_top : d.U ≤ ⊤)).op) s).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D25.isPointwiseGenerated_iff
statement:
theorem isPointwiseGenerated_iff (M : X.Modules) :
    IsPointwiseGenerated M ↔ ∀ p : X, GenAt M p
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D25.GenAt.of_iso
statement: theorem GenAt.of_iso {Q : X.Modules} (φ : M ≅ Q) (h : GenAt M p) : GenAt Q p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, d, hd⟩ := h
  exact ⟨φ.hom.val.app (op ⊤) s, d.mapIso φ, by
    have := sectionCoordSec_mapIso d φ s
    change IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ d.U p d.mem
      (sectionCoordSec (d.mapIso φ) (φ.hom.val.app (op ⊤) s)))
    rw [this]
    exact hd⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D25.GenAt.tensor
statement: theorem GenAt.tensor (hM : GenAt M p) (hN : GenAt N p) : GenAt (tensorSheaf X M N) p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, d, hd⟩ := hM
  obtain ⟨t, e, he⟩ := hN
  refine ⟨SchemeProjectiveSpace.tensorSheafPureTensorSection M N ⊤ s t, d.tensor e, ?_⟩
  have h := congrArg (X.presheaf.germ (d.U ⊓ e.U) p ⟨d.mem, e.mem⟩) (sectionCoordSec_tensor d e s t)
  have h1 := X.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE (inf_le_left : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ d.U)) p
    ⟨d.mem, e.mem⟩ (sectionCoordSec d s)
  have h2 := X.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE (inf_le_right : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ e.U)) p
    ⟨d.mem, e.mem⟩ (sectionCoordSec e t)
  rw [map_mul, h1, h2] at h
  change IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ (d.U ⊓ e.U) p ⟨d.mem, e.mem⟩ _)
  rw [h]
  exact hd.mul he

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D25.tensorPowSucc_zero

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D25.hasConstantRank_tensorPowSucc
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_tensorPowSucc {B : X.Modules} (hB : HasConstantRank X B 1) (n : ℕ) :
    HasConstantRank X (tensorPowSucc B n) 1
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hB
  | succ n ih =>
    have := hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf ih hB
    rwa [one_mul] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D25.hasConstantRank_tensorPow
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_tensorPow {B : X.Modules} (hB : HasConstantRank X B 1) (n : ℕ) :

proof:
:= by

  | zero => exact hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf
  | succ n => exact hasConstantRank_tensorPowSucc hB n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D25.germ_powSec_coord
statement:
theorem germ_powSec_coord (d : LineBundleLocalData X B p) (s : Γ(B, ⊤)) (n : ℕ) :
    X.presheaf.germ (powFrame d n).U p (powFrame d n).mem
        (sectionCoordSec (powFrame d n) (powSec s n)) =
      X.presheaf.germ d.U p d.mem (sectionCoordSec d s) ^ (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact (pow_one _).symm
  | succ n ih =>
    have h := congrArg (X.presheaf.germ ((powFrame d n).U ⊓ d.U) p ⟨(powFrame d n).mem, d.mem⟩)
      (sectionCoordSec_tensor (powFrame d n) d (powSec s n) s)
    have h1 := X.presheaf.germ_res_apply
      (homOfLE (inf_le_left : (powFrame d n).U ⊓ d.U ≤ (powFrame d n).U)) p
      ⟨(powFrame d n).mem, d.mem⟩ (sectionCoordSec (powFrame d n) (powSec s n))
    have h2 := X.presheaf.germ_res_apply
      (homOfLE (inf_le_right : (powFrame d n).U ⊓ d.U ≤ d.U)) p
      ⟨(powFrame d n).mem, d.mem⟩ (sectionCoordSec d s)
    rw [map_mul, h1, h2, ih] at h
    change X.presheaf.germ ((powFrame d n).U ⊓ d.U) p ⟨(powFrame d n).mem, d.mem⟩ _ = _
    exact h.trans (pow_succ _ _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D25.genAt_tensorPowSucc
statement: theorem genAt_tensorPowSucc (h : GenAt B p) (n : ℕ) : GenAt (tensorPowSucc B n) p

:= by

  exact ⟨powSec s n, powFrame d n, by rw [germ_powSec_coord]; exact hd.pow _⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D25.hasAmpleGenerators_of_tensorPowSucc
statement:
theorem hasAmpleGenerators_of_tensorPowSucc (L : X.Modules) (hB : HasConstantRank X B 1)
    (hBg : ∀ p : X, GenAt B p) {c : ℕ} (hc : ∀ p : X, GenAt (tensorSheaf X L (tensorPowSucc B c)) p)
    {m : ℕ} (hm : c ≤ m) : HasAmpleGenerators L
proof:
:=
  ⟨tensorPowSucc B m, hasConstantRank_tensorPowSucc hB m,
    fun p ↦ genAt_tensorPowSucc (hBg p) m,
    fun p ↦ GenAt.tensor_tensorPowSucc_of_le (hc p) (hBg p) hm⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D25.capDescends_of_tensorPowSucc
statement:
theorem capDescends_of_tensorPowSucc [Infinite k] (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hB : HasConstantRank X B 1) (hBg : ∀ p : X, GenAt B p) {c : ℕ}
    (hc : ∀ p : X, GenAt (tensorSheaf X L (tensorPowSucc B c)) p) (n : ℕ) :
    CapDescends (k := k) L hL n
proof:
:=
  capDescends_of_hasAmpleGenerators (k := k) L hL
    (hasAmpleGenerators_of_tensorPowSucc L hB hBg hc le_rfl) n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.ChowCompat.ofGates'
statement:
theorem _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.ChowCompat.ofGates' (ops : ChowOps k)
    (hcomm : AllCapCommGate k ops) : ChowCompat ops where
  push_comp
proof:
:= by intros; exact D9.totalPush_comp ops _ _
  pull_comp := by intros; exact D2.totalPull_comp ops _ _ _ _ _ _ _
  base_change := by intros; exact D11.totalBaseChange ops _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ‹_›
  cap_pull := by intros; exact D15.cap_pull_D15 (k := k) _ _ _ _ ops
  cap_push := by intros; exact D16.cap_push_D16 (k := k) _ _ _ ops
  cap_comm := by
    intros; exact D17.cap_comm_of_gate (fun L M hL hM ↦ hcomm L M hL hM) _ _ _ _
  cap_iso := by intros; exact D13.cap_iso_D13 (k := k) ops _ _ ‹_›
  projBundle_relDim := by
    intro X _ _ _ E C e hC
    exact D11.projBundle_relDim (k := k) C hC

    CapDescendsOnClass k

        ∃ d : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData X L p,
          IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ d.U p d.mem (D10.sectionCoordSec d s)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_pullback_coordinate_unit
statement:
theorem rankTwo_pullback_coordinate_unit {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    (E : Y.Modules) (N : Z.Modules)
    (s : SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf ⟶ E)
    (f : (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E ⟶ N) (U : Y.Opens) :
    ((C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso g).inv ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map s ≫ f).app
        (g ⁻¹ᵁ U) (1 : Γ(Z, g ⁻¹ᵁ U)) =
      f.app (g ⁻¹ᵁ U)
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app E).app U
          (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app s U (1 : Γ(Y, U))))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  rw [C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso_inv_one]
  have h := congrArg (fun a => a.app U (1 : Γ(Y, U)))
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.naturality s)
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app,
    Functor.id_map, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at h
  exact congrArg (fun x => f.app (g ⁻¹ᵁ U) x) h.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_originalGlobal_coordinate_eval
statement:
theorem rankTwo_originalGlobal_coordinate_eval (s : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ E)
    (U : X.Opens) :
    ((C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso C.toBase).inv ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).map s ≫ C.tautologicalQuotient).app
        (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ U) (1 : Γ(C.scheme, C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ U)) =
      (C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.val.app (op U)).hom (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app s U (1 : Γ(X, U)))
proof:
:= by
  exact (rankTwo_pullback_coordinate_unit C.toBase E (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    s C.tautologicalQuotient U).trans
      (rankTwo_originalCanonicalQuotient_unit C U (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app s U (1 : Γ(X, U))))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_section_iso_comparison
statement:
theorem rankTwo_section_iso_comparison {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (A B D : Y.Modules) (e : A ≅ B) (j : A ≅ D)
    (f : SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf ⟶ B) (x : Γ(A, ⊤))
    (hx : e.hom.app ⊤ x = Scheme.Modules.Hom.app f ⊤ (1 : Γ(Y, ⊤))) :
    j.hom.app ⊤ x = Scheme.Modules.Hom.app ((f ≫ e.inv) ≫ j.hom) ⊤ (1 : Γ(Y, ⊤))
proof:
:= by
  have he := congrArg (fun a : A ⟶ A => a.app ⊤ x) e.hom_inv_id
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.id_app, ConcreteCategory.id_apply] at he
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  exact (congrArg (fun z => j.hom.app ⊤ z) he.symm).trans
    (congrArg (fun z => j.hom.app ⊤ (e.inv.app ⊤ z)) hx)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_restricted_coordinate_eval
statement:
theorem rankTwo_restricted_coordinate_eval {Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (q : Z ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion q] (N : Y.Modules) (T : Z.Modules)
    (φ : SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf ⟶ N)
    (j : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj N ⟶ T)
    (U : Y.Opens) (h : q ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ U) :
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).inv ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map φ ≫ j) ⊤ (1 : Γ(Z, ⊤)) =
      j.app ⊤ (N.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op
        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app φ U (1 : Γ(Y, U))))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  rw [C1Cap.restrictUnitIso_inv_one]
  change j.app ⊤ (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app φ (q ''ᵁ ⊤) (1 : Γ(Y, q ''ᵁ ⊤))) = _
  have hp := tautChart_app_map φ (homOfLE h) (1 : Γ(Y, U))
  have h1 := congrArg (fun x => Scheme.Modules.Hom.app φ (q ''ᵁ ⊤) x)
    (C1Cap.unit_presheaf_map_one (homOfLE h))
  exact congrArg (fun x => j.app ⊤ x) (h1.symm.trans hp)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_unit_morphism_ext
statement:
theorem rankTwo_unit_morphism_ext {Y : Scheme.{u}} (T : Y.Modules)
    (f g : SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf ⟶ T)
    (h : Scheme.Modules.Hom.app f ⊤ (1 : Γ(Y, ⊤)) =
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.app g ⊤ (1 : Γ(Y, ⊤))) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  exact (tautSection_unitHom_eq f).symm.trans
    ((congrArg (fun x => T.unitHomEquiv.symm (SchemeProjectiveSpace.sectionsOfTop T x)) h).trans
      (tautSection_unitHom_eq g))

name: GradedIdealQuotient.decomposeToQuotient_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
theorem decomposeToQuotient_eq_zero_of_mem (I : HomogeneousIdeal 𝒜) {x : A}
    (hx : x ∈ I.toIdeal) : decomposeToQuotient 𝒜 I x = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.ext
  intro i
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [decomposeToQuotient, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    DirectSum.lmap_apply, componentMap]
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk I.toIdeal (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 x i : A) = 0
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  exact (I.isHomogeneous.mem_iff.mp hx) i

name: GradedIdealQuotient.decompose_mk
statement:
theorem decompose_mk (I : HomogeneousIdeal 𝒜) (x : A) :
    decompose 𝒜 I (Ideal.Quotient.mk I.toIdeal x) = decomposeToQuotient 𝒜 I x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: GradedIdealQuotient.decompose_coeLinearMap
statement:
theorem decompose_coeLinearMap (I : HomogeneousIdeal 𝒜) :
    (decompose 𝒜 I).comp (DirectSum.coeLinearMap (grading 𝒜 I)) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  ext i x : 2
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hax⟩ := x.2
  have hx : x = componentMap 𝒜 I i ⟨a, ha⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hax.symm
  subst x
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, DirectSum.coeLinearMap_lof, LinearMap.id_apply]
  change decompose 𝒜 I (Ideal.Quotient.mk I.toIdeal a) =
    DirectSum.lof R ι (fun i ↦ grading 𝒜 I i) i (componentMap 𝒜 I i ⟨a, ha⟩)
  rw [decompose_mk]
  rw [decomposeToQuotient, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  change DirectSum.lmap (componentMap 𝒜 I)
      (DirectSum.decomposeLinearEquiv 𝒜 (⟨a, ha⟩ : 𝒜 i)) = _
  rw [DirectSum.decomposeLinearEquiv_apply_coe, DirectSum.lmap_lof]

name: GradedIdealQuotient.coeLinearMap_decompose
statement:
theorem coeLinearMap_decompose (I : HomogeneousIdeal 𝒜) :
    (DirectSum.coeLinearMap (grading 𝒜 I)).comp (decompose 𝒜 I) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  induction x using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
  | _ x =>
      change DirectSum.coeLinearMap (grading 𝒜 I) (decomposeToQuotient 𝒜 I x) = _
      rw [decomposeToQuotient]
      rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply]
      rw [← LinearMap.comp_assoc]
      rw [show DirectSum.coeLinearMap (grading 𝒜 I) ∘ₗ DirectSum.lmap (componentMap 𝒜 I) =
          (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal).toLinearMap ∘ₗ DirectSum.coeLinearMap 𝒜 by
        ext i y : 2
        rfl]
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply]
      change Ideal.Quotient.mk I.toIdeal
          ((DirectSum.decomposeLinearEquiv 𝒜).symm
            ((DirectSum.decomposeLinearEquiv 𝒜) x)) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk I.toIdeal x
      rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: GradedIdealQuotient.isInternal
statement: theorem isInternal (I : HomogeneousIdeal 𝒜) : DirectSum.IsInternal (grading 𝒜 I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [DirectSum.IsInternal]
  change Function.Bijective (DirectSum.coeLinearMap (grading 𝒜 I))
  exact ⟨
    (show Function.LeftInverse (decompose 𝒜 I)
        (DirectSum.coeLinearMap (grading 𝒜 I)) from fun x ↦
      LinearMap.congr_fun (decompose_coeLinearMap 𝒜 I) x).injective,
    (show Function.RightInverse (decompose 𝒜 I)
        (DirectSum.coeLinearMap (grading 𝒜 I)) from fun x ↦
      LinearMap.congr_fun (coeLinearMap_decompose 𝒜 I) x).surjective⟩

name: GradedIdealQuotient.quotientMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientMap_apply (I : HomogeneousIdeal 𝒜) (x : A) :
    quotientMap 𝒜 I x = Ideal.Quotient.mk I.toIdeal x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: GradedIdealQuotient.quotientMap_surjective
statement:
theorem quotientMap_surjective (I : HomogeneousIdeal 𝒜) :
    Function.Surjective (quotientMap 𝒜 I)
proof:
:=
  Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective

name: GradedIdealQuotient.awayMap_surjective
statement:
theorem awayMap_surjective (I : HomogeneousIdeal 𝒜) {d : ι} (s : A) (hs : s ∈ 𝒜 d) :
    Function.Surjective (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map (quotientMap 𝒜 I) s)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨m, x, hx, rfl⟩ := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_surjective
    (grading 𝒜 I) ((quotientMap 𝒜 I).map_mem hs) z
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hax⟩ := hx
  subst x
  refine ⟨HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk 𝒜 hs m a ha, ?_⟩
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map_mk]
  rfl

name: GradedIdealQuotient.irrelevant_le_map
statement:
theorem irrelevant_le_map (I : HomogeneousIdeal 𝒜) :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading 𝒜 I) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map (quotientMap 𝒜 I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le]
  intro i hi
  rintro x ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
  exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (quotientMap 𝒜 I)
    (HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem 𝒜 hi ha)

name: GradedIdealQuotient.mem_range_projMap_iff
statement:
theorem mem_range_projMap_iff (I : HomogeneousIdeal 𝒜) (x : Proj 𝒜) :
    x ∈ Set.range (projMap 𝒜 I) ↔ I.toIdeal ≤ x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal
proof:
:= by
  let q := quotientMap 𝒜 I
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩ a ha
    change q a ∈ y.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal
    have hqa : q a = 0 := by
      rw [quotientMap_apply, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
      exact ha
    rw [hqa]
    exact Ideal.zero_mem _
  · intro hIx
    have hker : RingHom.ker q ≤ x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal := by
      rw [show RingHom.ker q = I.toIdeal from Ideal.mk_ker]
      exact hIx
    have hcmap :
        (x.asHomogeneousIdeal.map q).toIdeal.comap q =
          x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal := by
      rw [HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_map,
        Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ (quotientMap_surjective 𝒜 I),
        ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot,
        sup_eq_left.mpr hker]
    let y : Proj (grading 𝒜 I) :=
      { asHomogeneousIdeal := x.asHomogeneousIdeal.map q
        isPrime := Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective
          (quotientMap_surjective 𝒜 I) hker
        not_irrelevant_le := by
          intro hirr
          apply x.not_irrelevant_le
          rw [HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le]
          intro d hd a ha
          have hqa : q a ∈ HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading 𝒜 I) :=
            HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem (grading 𝒜 I) hd (q.map_mem ha)
          have hqmap : q a ∈ (x.asHomogeneousIdeal.map q).toIdeal := hirr hqa
          change a ∈ x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal
          rw [← hcmap]
          exact hqmap }
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    apply ProjectiveSpectrum.ext
    exact HomogeneousIdeal.ext hcmap

name: GradedIdealQuotient.isPullback_away
statement:
theorem isPullback_away (I : HomogeneousIdeal 𝒜) {d : ℕ} (s : A) (hs : s ∈ 𝒜 d)
    (hd : 0 < d) :
    IsPullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map (quotientMap 𝒜 I) s)))
      (Proj.awayι (grading 𝒜 I) (quotientMap 𝒜 I s)
        ((quotientMap 𝒜 I).map_mem hs) hd)
      (Proj.awayι 𝒜 s hs hd)
      (projMap 𝒜 I)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsOpenImmersion.isPullback
  · exact Proj.awayι_comp_map (quotientMap 𝒜 I) (irrelevant_le_map 𝒜 I) hd s hs
  · simpa only [Proj.opensRange_awayι, projMap] using
      (Proj.map_preimage_basicOpen (quotientMap 𝒜 I) (irrelevant_le_map 𝒜 I) s)

name: GradedIdealQuotient.isClosedImmersion_projMap
statement:
theorem isClosedImmersion_projMap (I : HomogeneousIdeal 𝒜) :
    IsClosedImmersion (projMap 𝒜 I)
proof:
:= by
  let 𝒰 := Proj.affineOpenCover 𝒜
  apply IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.of_openCover (𝒰 := 𝒰.openCover)
  intro s
  have hsq := isPullback_away 𝒜 I (s.2 : A) s.2.2 s.1.2
  change IsClosedImmersion (pullback.snd (projMap 𝒜 I)
    (Proj.awayι 𝒜 (s.2 : A) s.2.2 s.1.2))
  rw [← MorphismProperty.cancel_left_of_respectsIso @IsClosedImmersion
      hsq.flip.isoPullback.hom,
    hsq.flip.isoPullback_hom_snd]
  exact IsClosedImmersion.spec_of_surjective _
    (awayMap_surjective 𝒜 I (s.2 : A) s.2.2)

name: SchemeKTheory.genericRankInt_exact
statement:
theorem genericRankInt_exact
    (E F G : {M : X.Modules // IsFiniteLocallyFree X M})
    (h : ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn X.Modules (IsFiniteLocallyFree X) E F G) :
    genericRankInt X F = genericRankInt X E + genericRankInt X G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, g, zero, hS⟩ := h
  change ((AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X F.1 : ℕ) : ℤ) =
    ((AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X E.1 : ℕ) : ℤ) +
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X G.1 : ℕ) : ℤ)
  rw [← Nat.cast_add]
  exact congrArg (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℤ))
    (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank_add_of_shortExact_of_isFiniteLocallyFree
      X zero hS E.2 G.2)

name: SchemeKTheory.genericRankInt_tensor
statement:
theorem genericRankInt_tensor
    (E F : {M : X.Modules // IsFiniteLocallyFree X M}) :
    genericRankInt X (k0TensorObject X E F) =
      genericRankInt X E * genericRankInt X F
proof:
:= by
  change ((AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X
      (tensorSheaf X E.1 F.1) : ℕ) : ℤ) =
    ((AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X E.1 : ℕ) : ℤ) *
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X F.1 : ℕ) : ℤ)
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank_tensorSheaf X E.1 F.1 E.2 F.2,
    Nat.cast_mul]

name: SchemeKTheory.genericRankInt_unit
statement:
theorem genericRankInt_unit :
    genericRankInt X (tensorUnitObject X) = 1
proof:
:= by
  change ((AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X
      (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) : ℕ) : ℤ) = 1
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank_unit]
  norm_num

name: SchemeKTheory.k0Rank_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem k0Rank_classOf (E : X.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) :
    k0Rank X (k0ClassOf X E hE) =
      (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X E : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  change k0Rank X (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ ⟨E, hE⟩) = _
  exact ExactGrothendieck.lift_classOf (genericRankInt X) (genericRankInt_exact X) ⟨E, hE⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.k0RankRingHom_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem k0RankRingHom_classOf
    (E : {M : X.Modules // IsFiniteLocallyFree X M}) :
    k0RankRingHom X (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ E) = genericRankInt X E
proof:
:=
  k0RingLift_classOf X (genericRankInt X) (genericRankInt_exact X)
    (genericRankInt_tensor X) (genericRankInt_unit X) E

name: SchemeKTheory.k0RankRingHom_toAddMonoidHom
statement:
theorem k0RankRingHom_toAddMonoidHom :
    (k0RankRingHom X).toAddMonoidHom = k0Rank X

:=

name: SchemeKTheory.k0RankRat_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem k0RankRat_classOf (E : X.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) :

      (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X E : ℚ)

name: SchemeKTheory.k0RankRatRingHom_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem k0RankRatRingHom_classOf

statement:
theorem k0RankRatRingHom_toAddMonoidHom :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.coeff_expR
statement:
theorem coeff_expR (w : A) (m : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff m (expR w) = algebraMap ℚ A (1 / (m.factorial : ℚ)) * w ^ m
proof:
:= by
  rw [expR, PowerSeries.coeff_rescale, PowerSeries.coeff_exp, mul_comm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.map_expR
statement:
theorem map_expR {B : Type*} [CommRing B] [Algebra ℚ B] (f : A →+* B) (w : A) :
    PowerSeries.map f (expR w) = expR (f w)
proof:
:= by
  refine PowerSeries.ext fun m => ?_
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_map, coeff_expR, coeff_expR, map_mul, map_pow]
  congr 1
  have := RingHom.ext_rat (f.comp (algebraMap ℚ A)) (algebraMap ℚ B)
  exact congrArg (fun g : ℚ →+* B => g (1 / (m.factorial : ℚ))) this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.expT_map
statement:
theorem expT_map {B : Type*} [CommRing B] [Algebra ℚ B] (f : A →+* B) (D : ℕ) (z : A) :
    f (ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.expT D z) = ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.expT D (f z)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.expT, map_sum, map_mul, map_pow]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  congr 1
  have := RingHom.ext_rat (f.comp (algebraMap ℚ A)) (algebraMap ℚ B)
  exact congrArg (fun g : ℚ →+* B => g (1 / (j.factorial : ℚ))) this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.map_tw
statement:
theorem map_tw {B : Type*} [CommRing B] [Algebra ℚ B] (f : A →+* B) (a : A) :
    PowerSeries.map f (tw a) = tw (f a)
proof:
:= by
  simp [tw]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.Gt_map
statement:
theorem Gt_map {B : Type*} [CommRing B] [Algebra ℚ B] (f : A →+* B) (s : Multiset A) (D : ℕ) :
    Gt (s.map f) D = (Gt s D).map (PowerSeries.map f)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Gt
  rw [Polynomial.map_multiset_prod, Multiset.map_map, Multiset.map_map, Multiset.map_map,
    Multiset.map_map]
  refine congrArg Multiset.prod (Multiset.map_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_)
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  have hE := expT_map (Polynomial.mapRingHom (PowerSeries.map f)) D
    (-(Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C (tw a)))
  rw [Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom] at hE
  rw [Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_one, hE]
  congr 2
  simp [map_tw]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.coeff_evXt
statement:
theorem coeff_evXt (g : Polynomial (PowerSeries A)) (x : A) (N : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff N (evXt x g) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (g.natDegree + 1),
        if k ≤ N then PowerSeries.coeff (N - k) (g.coeff k) * x ^ k else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold evXt
  rw [Polynomial.coe_eval₂RingHom, Polynomial.eval₂_eq_sum_range, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  simp only [RingHom.id_apply]
  rw [mul_pow, ← map_pow, ← mul_assoc, PowerSeries.coeff_mul_X_pow', PowerSeries.coeff_mul_C]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.evXt_Gt
statement:
theorem evXt_Gt (s : Multiset A) (x : A) (D : ℕ) :
    evXt x (Gt s D) = (s.map fun n => 1 - ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.expT D
      (-(PowerSeries.C x * PowerSeries.X + tw n))).prod
proof:
:= by
  unfold Gt
  rw [map_multiset_prod, Multiset.map_map, Multiset.map_map]
  refine congrArg Multiset.prod (Multiset.map_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_)
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  rw [map_sub, map_one, expT_map (evXt x) D]
  congr 3
  simp [evXt]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.coeff_expT_agree
statement:
theorem coeff_expT_agree (D : ℕ) (c : A) (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ D) :
    PowerSeries.coeff m (ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.expT D (-(PowerSeries.C c * PowerSeries.X))) =
      PowerSeries.coeff m (expR (-c))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.expT, map_sum, coeff_expR]
  have : ∀ j : ℕ, (algebraMap ℚ (PowerSeries A)) (1 / (j.factorial : ℚ)) *
      (-(PowerSeries.C c * PowerSeries.X)) ^ j =
      PowerSeries.C (algebraMap ℚ A (1 / (j.factorial : ℚ)) * (-c) ^ j) * PowerSeries.X ^ j := by
    intro j
    rw [PowerSeries.algebraMap_apply]
    have h1 : (-(PowerSeries.C c * PowerSeries.X) : PowerSeries A) =
        PowerSeries.C (-c) * PowerSeries.X := by simp
    rw [h1, mul_pow, ← map_pow, map_mul]
    simp only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
    ring
  simp only [this, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq (Finset.range (D + 1)) m, if_pos (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1E.coeff_prod_expR
statement:
theorem coeff_prod_expR (s : Multiset A) (x : A) (D N : ℕ) (hN : N ≤ D) :
    PowerSeries.coeff N ((s.map fun n => 1 - expR (-(n + x))).prod) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range ((Gt s D).natDegree + 1),
        if k ≤ N then PowerSeries.coeff (N - k) ((Gt s D).coeff k) * x ^ k else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeff_evXt, evXt_Gt]
  have hd := prod_dvd_sub (D := D + 1) s
    (fun n => 1 - ChowZeroSectionCIIL1.expT D (-(PowerSeries.C x * PowerSeries.X + tw n)))
    (fun n => 1 - expR (-(n + x))) (fun a _ => by
      refine X_pow_dvd_sub_iff.mpr fun m hm => ?_
      rw [map_sub, map_sub]
      congr 1
      have e1 : (-(PowerSeries.C x * PowerSeries.X + tw a) : PowerSeries A) =
          -(PowerSeries.C (a + x) * PowerSeries.X) := by
        simp only [tw]; rw [map_add]; ring
      rw [e1, coeff_expT_agree D (a + x) m (by omega)])
  have := (X_pow_dvd_sub_iff.mp hd) N (by omega)
  exact this.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.unionInl_transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonRestrictIso
statement:
theorem unionInl_transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonRestrictIso
    (C C' : AffineFrameCover X E) (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I)
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (C.union C').transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonRestrictIso d

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.coord_restrict_eq
statement:
theorem coord_restrict_eq (d : LineBundleLocalData S M x) (e : LineBundleLocalData S M y)
    (s : Γ(M, ⊤)) :
    S.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ e.U)).op (sectionCoordSec e s) =
      S.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ d.U)).op (sectionCoordSec d s) *
        d.transitionSection e
proof:
:= by
  apply C1Cap.frameSec_injective e (d.U ⊓ e.U) inf_le_right
  have l1 := frameSec_restrict e e.U (d.U ⊓ e.U) le_rfl inf_le_right (sectionCoordSec e s)
  have l2 := frameSec_restrict d d.U (d.U ⊓ e.U) le_rfl inf_le_left (sectionCoordSec d s)
  have e1 := sectionCoordSec_spec e s
  have e2 := sectionCoordSec_spec d s
  have pmm : ∀ {V W : S.Opens} (h : W ≤ V) (h' : V ≤ ⊤),
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h').op s) =
        M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h.trans h')).op s := by
    intro V W h h'
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← M.presheaf.map_comp]
    rfl
  have L : C1Cap.frameSec e (d.U ⊓ e.U) inf_le_right
      (S.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ e.U)).op (sectionCoordSec e s)) =
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ ⊤)).op s := by
    rw [l1, e1, pmm]
  have R : C1Cap.frameSec e (d.U ⊓ e.U) inf_le_right
      (S.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ d.U)).op (sectionCoordSec d s) *
        d.transitionSection e) =
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ ⊤)).op s := by
    rw [C1Cap.frameSec_smul e (d.U ⊓ e.U) inf_le_right
      (S.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ d.U)).op (sectionCoordSec d s) *
        d.transitionSection e), mul_smul,
      ← C1Cap.frameSec_smul e (d.U ⊓ e.U) inf_le_right (d.transitionSection e),
      C1Cap.frameSec_transitionSection d e,
      ← C1Cap.frameSec_smul d (d.U ⊓ e.U) inf_le_left, l2, e2, pmm]
  exact L.trans R.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.isUnit_coord_of_isUnit_coord
statement:
theorem isUnit_coord_of_isUnit_coord (d : LineBundleLocalData S M x)
    (e : LineBundleLocalData S M y) (s : Γ(M, ⊤)) (p : S) (hpd : p ∈ d.U) (hpe : p ∈ e.U)
    (h : IsUnit (S.presheaf.germ d.U p hpd (sectionCoordSec d s))) :
    IsUnit (S.presheaf.germ e.U p hpe (sectionCoordSec e s))
proof:
:= by
  have hW : p ∈ d.U ⊓ e.U := ⟨hpd, hpe⟩
  have h1 := congrArg (S.presheaf.germ (d.U ⊓ e.U) p hW) (coord_restrict_eq d e s)
  rw [map_mul, S.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE (inf_le_right : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ e.U)) p hW,
    S.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE (inf_le_left : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ d.U)) p hW] at h1
  rw [h1]
  exact h.mul ((LineBundleLocalData.transitionSection_isUnit d e).map _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.ChartFrames.frameSec_coordU
statement:
theorem ChartFrames.frameSec_coordU (p : X) (m : ℕ) (s : Γ(M m, ⊤)) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.ChartFrames.mem_V
statement:
theorem ChartFrames.mem_V (m : ℕ) (v : ∀ p : X, Kap X p) :
    v ∈ F.V m ↔ ∃ s : Γ(M m, ⊤), ∀ p, v p = F.val p m s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨s, fun p => rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨s, hs⟩
    exact ⟨s, funext fun p => (hs p).symm⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.ChartFrames.V_T
statement:
theorem ChartFrames.V_T (i : Fin (n + 1)) (m : ℕ) (v : ∀ p : X, Kap X p) (hv : v ∈ F.V m) :
    (fun p => ψ p (F.U p) (F.hU p) (F.ξ p i) * v p) ∈ F.V (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (F.mem_V m v).1 hv
  refine (F.mem_V (m + 1) _).2 ⟨F.τ i m s, fun p => ?_⟩
  change _ = ψ p (F.U p) (F.hU p) (F.coordU p (m + 1) _)
  rw [F.coordU_τ, map_mul, hs p]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.ChartFrames.V_const
statement:
theorem ChartFrames.V_const (c : k) (m : ℕ) (v : ∀ p : X, Kap X p) (hv : v ∈ F.V m) :
    (fun p => F.kap p c * v p) ∈ F.V m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (F.mem_V m v).1 hv
  refine (F.mem_V m _).2 ⟨F.ρ c • s, fun p => ?_⟩
  change _ = ψ p (F.U p) (F.hU p) (F.coordU p m _)
  rw [F.coordU_smul, map_mul, hs p]
  have : ψ p (F.U p) (F.hU p) (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : F.U p ≤ ⊤)).op (F.ρ c)) =
      F.kap p c := by
    unfold ψ ChartFrames.kap
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
    rw [X.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE (le_top : F.U p ≤ ⊤)) p (F.hU p)]
    rfl
  rw [this]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.ChartFrames.V_single
statement:
theorem ChartFrames.V_single (i : Fin (n + 1)) (e : ℕ) (m : ℕ) (v : ∀ p : X, Kap X p)
    (hv : v ∈ F.V m) :
    (fun p => ψ p (F.U p) (F.hU p) (F.ξ p i) ^ e * v p) ∈ F.V (m + e)
proof:
:= by
  induction e with
  | zero => simpa using hv
  | succ e ih =>
    have := F.V_T i (m + e) _ ih
    have hf : (fun p => ψ p (F.U p) (F.hU p) (F.ξ p i) ^ (e + 1) * v p) =
        fun p => ψ p (F.U p) (F.hU p) (F.ξ p i) *
          (ψ p (F.U p) (F.hU p) (F.ξ p i) ^ e * v p) := by
      funext p
      rw [pow_succ]
      ring
    rw [hf]
    exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.ChartFrames.V_monomial
statement:
theorem ChartFrames.V_monomial (α : Fin (n + 1) →₀ ℕ) (m : ℕ) (v : ∀ p : X, Kap X p)
    (hv : v ∈ F.V m) :
    (fun p => (α.prod fun i e => ψ p (F.U p) (F.hU p) (F.ξ p i) ^ e) * v p) ∈
      F.V (m + α.degree)
proof:
:= by
  induction α using Finsupp.induction generalizing v m with
  | zero => simpa using hv
  | single_add a b f ha hb ih =>
    have h1 := ih m v hv
    have h2 := F.V_single a b (m + f.degree) _ h1
    have hd : m + (Finsupp.single a b + f).degree = m + f.degree + b := by
      rw [map_add, Finsupp.degree_single]; omega
    rw [hd]
    have hf : (fun p => (((Finsupp.single a b + f).prod fun i e =>
          ψ p (F.U p) (F.hU p) (F.ξ p i) ^ e)) * v p) =
        fun p => ψ p (F.U p) (F.hU p) (F.ξ p a) ^ b *
          ((f.prod fun i e => ψ p (F.U p) (F.hU p) (F.ξ p i) ^ e) * v p) := by
      funext p
      have h3 : ((Finsupp.single a b).prod fun i e => ψ p (F.U p) (F.hU p) (F.ξ p i) ^ e) =
          ψ p (F.U p) (F.hU p) (F.ξ p a) ^ b := Finsupp.prod_single_index (pow_zero _)
      rw [Finsupp.prod_add_index' (fun _ => pow_zero _) (fun _ _ _ => pow_add _ _ _)]
      erw [h3]
      ring
    rw [hf]
    exact h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.ψ_ne_zero_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem ψ_ne_zero_of_isUnit (p : X) (V : X.Opens) (hp : p ∈ V) (x : Γ(X, V))
    (h : IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ V p hp x)) : ψ p V hp x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  have h1 : X.presheaf.germ V p hp x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk p) :=
    (IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff _).1 h0
  exact (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).1 h1 h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.isUnit_of_ψ_ne_zero
statement:
theorem isUnit_of_ψ_ne_zero (p : X) (V : X.Opens) (hp : p ∈ V) (x : Γ(X, V))
    (h : ψ p V hp x ≠ 0) : IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ V p hp x)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hu
  exact h ((IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff _).2
    ((IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).2 hu))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.ChartFrames.hact
statement:
theorem ChartFrames.hact (d : ℕ) (a : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) k)
    (ha : a ∈ MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) k d) (m : ℕ)
    (v : ∀ p : X, Kap X p) (hv : v ∈ F.V m) :
    ∃ w ∈ F.V (m + d), ∀ p, w p = F.φ p a * v p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [MvPolynomial.mem_homogeneousSubmodule] at ha
  have key : ∀ S : Finset (Fin (n + 1) →₀ ℕ), (∀ α ∈ S, α.degree = d) →
      ∃ w ∈ F.V (m + d), ∀ p, w p =
        F.φ p (∑ α ∈ S, MvPolynomial.monomial α (a.coeff α)) * v p := by
    intro S
    induction S using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty =>
      intro _
      exact ⟨0, zero_mem _, fun p => by simp⟩
    | insert α S hα ih =>
      intro hS
      obtain ⟨w, hw, hwp⟩ := ih (fun β hβ => hS β (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hβ))
      have h1 := F.V_monomial α m v hv
      have h2 := F.V_const (a.coeff α) (m + α.degree) _ h1
      rw [hS α (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)] at h2
      refine ⟨_, add_mem h2 hw, fun p => ?_⟩
      rw [Finset.sum_insert hα, map_add, add_mul, ← hwp p]
      simp only [Pi.add_apply]
      congr 1
      unfold ChartFrames.φ
      rw [MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_monomial, mul_assoc]
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hwp⟩ := key a.support (fun α hα => by
    rw [Finsupp.degree_eq_weight_one]
    exact ha (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hα))
  refine ⟨w, hw, fun p => ?_⟩
  rw [hwp p, ← MvPolynomial.as_sum]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.ChartFrames.eventual_unit
statement:
theorem ChartFrames.eventual_unit (S : Finset X)
    (hinj : Set.InjOn (RiemannRoch.GradedAvoidD29.hker
      (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) k) F.φ) (S : Set X))
    (hgen : ∀ p ∈ S, ∃ (m1 : ℕ) (t : Γ(M m1, ⊤)),
      IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ (F.U p) p (F.hU p) (F.coordU p m1 t))) :
    ∃ m0 : ℕ, ∀ m, m0 ≤ m → ∃ t : Γ(M m, ⊤), ∀ p ∈ S,
      IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ (F.U p) p (F.hU p) (F.coordU p m t))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hgen' : ∀ p ∈ S, ∃ N, ∀ d, N ≤ d → ∃ v ∈ F.V d, v p ≠ 0 := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨m1, t, ht⟩ := hgen p hp
    have hc0 : F.φ p (MvPolynomial.X (F.c p)) ≠ 0 := by
      unfold ChartFrames.φ
      rw [MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X']
      exact ψ_ne_zero_of_isUnit p _ _ _ (F.ξ_c p)
    have hv0 : F.val p m1 t ≠ 0 := ψ_ne_zero_of_isUnit p _ _ _ ht
    refine ⟨m1, fun d hd => ?_⟩
    have hX : (MvPolynomial.X (F.c p) : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) k) ∈
        MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) k 1 := by
      rw [MvPolynomial.mem_homogeneousSubmodule]
      exact MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_X k (F.c p)
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hwp⟩ := F.hact (d - m1) (MvPolynomial.X (F.c p) ^ (d - m1)) (by
      simpa using SetLike.pow_mem_graded (d - m1) hX) m1 (fun q => F.val q m1 t)
      ((F.mem_V m1 _).2 ⟨t, fun _ => rfl⟩)
    rw [show m1 + (d - m1) = d by omega] at hw
    refine ⟨w, hw, ?_⟩
    rw [hwp, map_pow]
    exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hc0) hv0
  obtain ⟨m0, hm0⟩ := RiemannRoch.GradedAvoidD29.graded_module_avoidance
    (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) k) F.φ F.V
    (fun d a ha m v hv => F.hact d a ha m v hv) S hinj hgen'
  refine ⟨m0, fun m hm => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvS⟩ := hm0 m hm
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := (F.mem_V m v).1 hv
  refine ⟨t, fun p hp => isUnit_of_ψ_ne_zero p _ _ _ ?_⟩
  have := hvS p hp
  rwa [ht p] at this

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechHigherCoface_component
statement:
theorem coordinateCechHigherCoface_component
    (M : (space k n).Modules) (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (coordinateCechCosimplicialObject k n M).δ r ≫
          Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
            M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) b))) a =
      Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
          M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b)))
          (a ∘ r.succAbove) ≫
        M.presheaf.map
          (Pi.lift
            (P := coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) a)
            (fun t : Fin (p + 1) ↦
              Pi.π
                (fun s : Fin (p + 2) ↦ coordinateCechCover k n (a s))
                (r.succAbove t))).op
proof:
:= by
  have hcech :
      (((Functor.rightOp
        (Limits.FormalCoproduct.mk _ (coordinateCechCover k n)).cech).map
          (SimplexCategory.δ r)).unop) =
        (Limits.FormalCoproduct.mk _ (coordinateCechCover k n)).mapPower
          r.succAbove := by
    rfl
  change (Pi.lift _ ≫ Pi.π _ a) = _
  rw [Pi.lift_π]
  rw [hcech]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechAugmentation_d_zero
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechAugmentation_d_zero
    (d : ℤ) :
    projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechAugmentation k n d ≫
        (projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex k n d).d 0 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  let M := projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d
  let e₀ := coordinateCechZeroTermIso k n M
  let e₁ := coordinateCechOneTermIso k n M
  let r := coordinateCechSectionRightRes k n M
  let l := coordinateCechSectionLeftRes k n M
  apply (cancel_mono e₁.hom).1
  calc
    (projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechAugmentation k n d ≫
          (projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex k n d).d 0 1) ≫ e₁.hom =
        projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechAugmentation k n d ≫
          ((projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex k n d).d 0 1 ≫ e₁.hom) :=
      Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechAugmentation k n d ≫
          (e₀.hom ≫ (r - l)) :=
      congrArg (fun f ↦ projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechAugmentation k n d ≫ f)
        (projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex_d_zero_conjugates k n d)
    _ = (coordinateCechSectionRes k n M ≫ e₀.inv) ≫
          (e₀.hom ≫ (r - l)) := rfl
    _ = coordinateCechSectionRes k n M ≫ (r - l) := by
      simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
    _ = 0 := sub_eq_zero.mpr (coordinateCechSectionFork k n M).condition
    _ = 0 ≫ e₁.hom := by simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.m7geoT_standard_ratio_in_space
statement:
theorem m7geoT_standard_ratio_in_space (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ)
    {c : Fin (n + 1)} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    (space R n).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (Proj.basicOpen_mono (𝒜 := grading R n)
        (f := coordinate R n 0) (g := coordinateOverlapEquation R n 0 c)
        ⟨coordinate R n c, rfl⟩)).op
      (Proj.awayToSection (grading R n) (coordinate R n 0)
        (coordinateRatio R n 0 ⟨c, hc⟩)) =
      (twistTransitionSectionUnit R n 1 0 c).1
proof:
:= by
  exact (m7geoR_standard_ratio_restrict R n hc).trans
    (m7geoR_transition_eq_awayToSection R n c).symm

      (homOfLE (Proj.basicOpen_mono (𝒜 := symGrading R M)
        (f := linearForm R M x) (g := linearOverlapEquation R M x y)
        ⟨linearForm R M y, rfl⟩)).op

      (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit R M 1 x y).1

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.m7geoT_intrinsic_standard_ratio_heq
statement:
theorem m7geoT_intrinsic_standard_ratio_heq {R M : Type u} [CommRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    {n : ℕ} (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M)
    {c : Fin (n + 1)} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    HEq
      ((intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b).app
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapOpen R n 0 c)
        ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.space R n).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (Proj.basicOpen_mono (𝒜 := SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading R n)
            (f := SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinate R n 0)
            (g := SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapEquation R n 0 c)
            ⟨SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinate R n c, rfl⟩)).op
          (Proj.awayToSection (SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading R n)
            (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinate R n 0)
            (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateRatio R n 0 ⟨c, hc⟩))))
      (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit R M 1 (b 0) (b c)).1
proof:
:= by
  rw [SchemeProjectiveSpace.m7geoT_standard_ratio_in_space R n hc]
  exact intrinsicToStandard_app_transitionSectionUnit_heq b 1 0 c

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.m7geoT_ratio_transport_heq
statement:
theorem m7geoT_ratio_transport_heq {R M : Type u} [CommRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    {n : ℕ} (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M)
    {c : Fin (n + 1)} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    HEq
      ((intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b).app
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapOpen R n 0 c)
        ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.space R n).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (Proj.basicOpen_mono (𝒜 := SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading R n)
            (f := SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinate R n 0)
            (g := SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOverlapEquation R n 0 c)
            ⟨SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinate R n c, rfl⟩)).op
          (Proj.awayToSection (SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading R n)
            (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinate R n 0)
            (SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateRatio R n 0 ⟨c, hc⟩))))
      ((space R M).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (Proj.basicOpen_mono (𝒜 := symGrading R M)
          (f := linearForm R M (b 0))
          (g := linearOverlapEquation R M (b 0) (b c))
          ⟨linearForm R M (b c), rfl⟩)).op
        (tautChart_ratioSection R M (b 0) (b c)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [m7geoT_linear_ratio_in_space (b 0) (b c)]
  exact m7geoT_intrinsic_standard_ratio_heq b hc

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.m7geoR_awayMap_coordinateRatio
statement:
theorem m7geoR_awayMap_coordinateRatio (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ)
    {c : Fin (n + 1)} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap (grading R n)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n c)
      (show coordinateOverlapEquation R n 0 c =
        coordinate R n 0 * coordinate R n c from rfl)
      (coordinateRatio R n 0 ⟨c, hc⟩) =
        coordinateOverlapRatio R n 0 c
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateRatio, HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap_mk]
  simp [coordinateOverlapRatio, coordinateOverlapEquation, pow_two]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.m7geoR_standard_ratio_restrict
statement:
theorem m7geoR_standard_ratio_restrict (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ)
    {c : Fin (n + 1)} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    (Proj (grading R n)).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (Proj.basicOpen_mono (𝒜 := grading R n)
        (f := coordinate R n 0) (g := coordinateOverlapEquation R n 0 c)
        ⟨coordinate R n c, rfl⟩)).op
      (Proj.awayToSection (grading R n) (coordinate R n 0)
        (coordinateRatio R n 0 ⟨c, hc⟩)) =
      Proj.awayToSection (grading R n) (coordinateOverlapEquation R n 0 c)
        (coordinateOverlapRatio R n 0 c)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomm := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (Proj.awayMap_awayToSection (grading R n)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n c)
      (show coordinateOverlapEquation R n 0 c =
        coordinate R n 0 * coordinate R n c from rfl))
    (coordinateRatio R n 0 ⟨c, hc⟩)
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom] at hcomm
  rw [m7geoR_awayMap_coordinateRatio R n hc] at hcomm
  exact hcomm.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.m7geoR_linear_awayMap_ratio
statement:
theorem m7geoR_linear_awayMap_ratio (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M] (x y : M) :
    HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap (symGrading R M)
      (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M y)

      (tautChart_ratio R M x y) = linearOverlapRatio R M x y

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.m7geoR_linear_ratio_restrict
statement:
theorem m7geoR_linear_ratio_restrict (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M] (x y : M) :
    (Proj (symGrading R M)).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (Proj.basicOpen_mono (𝒜 := symGrading R M)
        (f := linearForm R M x) (g := linearOverlapEquation R M x y)
        ⟨linearForm R M y, rfl⟩)).op
      (tautChart_ratioSection R M x y) =
      (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit R M 1 x y).1
proof:
:= by
  have hcomm := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (Proj.awayMap_awayToSection (symGrading R M)
      (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M y)
      (show linearOverlapEquation R M x y =
        linearForm R M x * linearForm R M y from rfl))
    (tautChart_ratio R M x y)
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom] at hcomm
  rw [m7geoR_linear_awayMap_ratio R M x y] at hcomm
  simpa [tautChart_ratioSection, linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit,
    linearTwistTransitionUnit, linearOverlapRatioUnit,
    Proj.basicOpenIsoAway_hom] using hcomm.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor_map_app
statement:
theorem restrictFunctor_map_app {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion f] {M N : Y.Modules} (a : M ⟶ N) (U : X.Opens) :

proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictPushforwardAlongIso_naturality
statement:
theorem restrictPushforwardAlongIso_naturality (f : T ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    (k : Y ≅ Z) {M N : Y.Modules} (a : M ⟶ N) :
    (restrictFunctor (f ≫ k.hom)).map ((pushforward k.hom).map a) ≫
      (restrictPushforwardAlongIso f k N).hom =
    (restrictPushforwardAlongIso f k M).hom ≫
      (restrictFunctor f).map a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [restrictPushforwardAlongIso, Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom]
  have hc := (restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso k.hom).hom.naturality a
  have hc' := congrArg (fun b => (restrictFunctor f).map b) hc
  simp only [Functor.comp_map, Functor.id_map, Functor.map_comp] at hc'
  cat_disch

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.unionInl_restrictPushedIso_naturality
statement:
theorem unionInl_restrictPushedIso_naturality
    (C C' : AffineFrameCover X E) (i : C.I)
    {M N : C.scheme.Modules} (a : M ⟶ N) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ((C.union C').chartι (Sum.inl i))).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.isoUnionLeft C').hom).map a) ≫
      (C.unionInl_restrictPushedIso C' i N).hom =
    (C.unionInl_restrictPushedIso C' i M).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι i)).map a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [unionInl_restrictPushedIso, Iso.trans_hom]
  have hc := Scheme.Modules.restrictPushforwardAlongIso_naturality
    (C.chartι i) (C.isoUnionLeft C') a
  let hchart : IsOpenImmersion ((C.union C').chartι (Sum.inl i)) :=
    (C.union C').chartι_isOpenImmersion (Sum.inl i)
  let hcomp : IsOpenImmersion (C.chartι i ≫ (C.isoUnionLeft C').hom) :=
    (C.chartι_isoUnionLeft_hom C' i).symm ▸
      (C.union C').chartι_isOpenImmersion (Sum.inl i)
  have hg := (@Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr _ _ _ _
    (C.chartι_isoUnionLeft_hom C' i).symm hchart hcomp).hom.naturality
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.isoUnionLeft C').hom).map a)
  cat_disch

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.unionInr_restrictPushedIso_naturality
statement:
theorem unionInr_restrictPushedIso_naturality
    (C C' : AffineFrameCover X E) (i : C'.I)
    {M N : C'.scheme.Modules} (a : M ⟶ N) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ((C.union C').chartι (Sum.inr i))).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.isoUnionRight C').hom).map a) ≫
      (C.unionInr_restrictPushedIso C' i N).hom =
    (C.unionInr_restrictPushedIso C' i M).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C'.chartι i)).map a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [unionInr_restrictPushedIso, Iso.trans_hom]
  have hc := Scheme.Modules.restrictPushforwardAlongIso_naturality
    (C'.chartι i) (C.isoUnionRight C') a
  let hchart : IsOpenImmersion ((C.union C').chartι (Sum.inr i)) :=
    (C.union C').chartι_isOpenImmersion (Sum.inr i)
  let hcomp : IsOpenImmersion (C'.chartι i ≫ (C.isoUnionRight C').hom) :=
    (C.chartι_isoUnionRight_hom C' i).symm ▸
      (C.union C').chartι_isOpenImmersion (Sum.inr i)
  have hg := (@Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr _ _ _ _
    (C.chartι_isoUnionRight_hom C' i).symm hchart hcomp).hom.naturality
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.isoUnionRight C').hom).map a)
  cat_disch

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulChartAlgebra.shiftAlgEquiv_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem shiftAlgEquiv_X {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n → R) (j : Fin n) :
    shiftAlgEquiv R a (X j) = X j - C (a j)
proof:
:= by
  simp [shiftAlgEquiv]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulChartAlgebra.isWeaklyRegular_X_sub_C_ofFn
statement:
theorem isWeaklyRegular_X_sub_C_ofFn {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n → R) :
    IsWeaklyRegular (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)
      (List.ofFn fun j => (X j - C (a j) : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R))
proof:
:= by
  have hmap :
      (List.ofFn fun j => (X j - C (a j) : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R))
        = (List.ofFn fun j => (X j : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)).map (shiftAlgEquiv R a) := by
    rw [List.map_ofFn]
    congr 1
    funext j
    simp
  rw [hmap]
  refine ((shiftAlgEquiv R a).toRingEquiv.toAddEquiv.isWeaklyRegular_congr
    (List.forall₂_map_right_iff.mpr (List.forall₂_same.mpr (fun r _ x => ?_)))).mp
    (isWeaklyRegular_X_ofFn R n)
  show (shiftAlgEquiv R a) (r • x) = (shiftAlgEquiv R a r) • (shiftAlgEquiv R a) x
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  exact map_mul (shiftAlgEquiv R a) r x

name: RiemannRoch.CIIL1DC2.subsingleton_quotSMulTop_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem subsingleton_quotSMulTop_of_isUnit {r : R} (hr : IsUnit r) :
    Subsingleton (QuotSMulTop r M)
proof:
:= by
  have htop : r • (⊤ : Submodule R M) = ⊤ := by
    obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hr
    refine top_le_iff.mp fun x _ => ?_
    rw [Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists]
    exact ⟨(↑u⁻¹ : R) • x, trivial, by rw [smul_smul]; simp⟩
  exact Submodule.Quotient.subsingleton_iff.mpr htop

name: RiemannRoch.CIIL1DC2.isWeaklyRegular_of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem isWeaklyRegular_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton M] (rs : List R) :
    IsWeaklyRegular M rs
proof:
:= by
  induction rs generalizing M with
  | nil => exact IsWeaklyRegular.nil R M
  | cons r rs ih =>
    refine IsWeaklyRegular.cons (fun a b _ => Subsingleton.elim a b) ?_
    haveI : Subsingleton (QuotSMulTop r M) :=
      Function.Surjective.subsingleton (Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _)
    exact ih

name: RiemannRoch.CIIL1DC2.isWeaklyRegular_cons_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem isWeaklyRegular_cons_of_isUnit {r : R} (hr : IsUnit r) (rs : List R) :
    IsWeaklyRegular M (r :: rs)
proof:
:= by
  refine IsWeaklyRegular.cons (hr.isSMulRegular (M := M)) ?_
  haveI := subsingleton_quotSMulTop_of_isUnit (M := M) hr
  exact isWeaklyRegular_of_subsingleton rs

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.AffineOverlapComparison.projIso_hom_comp_reesProjMap
statement:
theorem AffineOverlapComparison.projIso_hom_comp_reesProjMap
    (K : Ideal R) (f : R) {L : Ideal S}
    (c : AffineOverlapComparison (localizedIdeal K f) L) :
    c.projIso.hom ≫ reesProjMap K f =
      c.map_ideal ▸
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map
          ((gradedReesEquivHom c.sectionsEquiv (localizedIdeal K f)).comp
            (gradedLocalizationMap K f))
          (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp
            (irrelevant_le_map_gradedLocalizationMap K f)
            (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivHom c.sectionsEquiv (localizedIdeal K f))) :
          AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading ((localizedIdeal K f).map c.sectionsEquiv.toRingHom)) ⟶
            AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading K))
proof:
:= by
  rcases c with ⟨e, he⟩
  subst he
  unfold AffineOverlapComparison.projIso reesProjIsoOfRingEquiv reesProjMapOfRingEquiv reesProjMap
  rw [asIso_hom]
  exact (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map_comp (gradedLocalizationMap K f)
    (gradedReesEquivHom e (localizedIdeal K f))
    (irrelevant_le_map_gradedLocalizationMap K f)
    (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivHom e (localizedIdeal K f))).symm

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.Proj_map_eq_of_pointwise_eq
statement:
theorem Proj_map_eq_of_pointwise_eq {K : Ideal R} {J₁ J₂ : Ideal S} (hJ : J₁ = J₂)
    (φ₁ : grading K →+*ᵍ grading J₁) (φ₂ : grading K →+*ᵍ grading J₂)
    (hval : ∀ p : reesAlgebra K,
      ((φ₁ p : reesAlgebra J₁) : Polynomial S) = ((φ₂ p : reesAlgebra J₂) : Polynomial S))
    (proof1 : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading J₁) ≤
      HomogeneousIdeal.map φ₁ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading K)))
    (proof2 : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading J₂) ≤
      HomogeneousIdeal.map φ₂ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading K))) :
    hJ ▸ (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map φ₁ proof1) = AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map φ₂ proof2
proof:
:= by
  subst hJ
  have hφ : φ₁ = φ₂ := DFunLike.ext _ _ (fun p => Subtype.ext (hval p))
  subst hφ
  rfl

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenGeneratorComparison_projIso_hom_reesProjMap
statement:
theorem basicOpenGeneratorComparison_projIso_hom_reesProjMap (f g : Γ(X, U.1))
    (h : X.basicOpen f = X.basicOpen g) :
    (basicOpenGeneratorComparison (I := I) (U := U) f g h).projIso.hom ≫
        reesProjMap (I.ideal U) f =
      reesProjMap (I.ideal U) g
proof:
:= by
  have step1 := AffineOverlapComparison.projIso_hom_comp_reesProjMap (I.ideal U) f
    (basicOpenGeneratorComparison (I := I) (U := U) f g h)
  rw [step1]
  have halg := basicOpenGeneratorRingEquiv_comp_algebraMap U f g h
  refine Proj_map_eq_of_pointwise_eq
    (localizedIdeal_map_basicOpenGeneratorRingEquiv (I := I) (U := U) f g h) _ _ ?_ _ _
  intro p
  show Polynomial.map (basicOpenGeneratorRingEquiv U f g h).toRingHom
      (Polynomial.map (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) (Localization.Away f))
        (p : Polynomial Γ(X, U.1))) =
    Polynomial.map (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) (Localization.Away g)) (p : Polynomial Γ(X, U.1))
  rw [Polynomial.map_map, halg]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveCoordinateChartScalarRingHom_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension
statement:
theorem projectiveCoordinateChartScalarRingHom_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (projectiveCoordinateChartScalarRingHom R n i).IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension n
proof:
:= by
  let f := projectiveCoordinateChartScalarRingHom R n i
  let e := awayCoordinateEquiv R n i
  apply (RingHom.isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_respectsIso (n := n)).cancel_right_isIso
    (CommRingCat.ofHom f) e.toCommRingCatIso.hom |>.mp
  change (e.toRingHom.comp f).IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension n
  have hcomp :
      e.toRingHom.comp f =
        MvPolynomial.C (R := R) (σ := AffineChartIndex n i) := by
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro a
    apply e.symm.injective
    simp [e, f, awayCoordinateEquiv, awayCoordinateHom,
      projectiveCoordinateChartScalarRingHom,
      coefficientToCoordinateAway,
      HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_eq]
  rw [hcomp]
  change (algebraMap R (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n i) R)).IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension n
  rw [RingHom.isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_algebraMap]
  have hcard : Nat.card (AffineChartIndex n i) = n := by
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype_compl, Fintype.card_fin,
      Fintype.card_unique]
    simp
  have := Algebra.isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_mvPolynomial R (AffineChartIndex n i)
  rwa [hcard] at this

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec_smoothOfRelativeDimension
statement: theorem toSpec_smoothOfRelativeDimension : SmoothOfRelativeDimension n (toSpec R n)
proof:
:= by
  refine (IsZariskiLocalAtSource.iff_of_openCover
    (coordinateOpenCover R n)).mpr ?_
  intro (i : Fin (n + 1))
  change SmoothOfRelativeDimension n ((coordinateOpen R n i).ι ≫ toSpec R n)
  rw [projectiveCoordinateOpen_ι_toSpec]
  refine (MorphismProperty.cancel_left_of_respectsIso (@SmoothOfRelativeDimension n) _ _).mpr ?_
  refine (HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @SmoothOfRelativeDimension n)).mpr ?_
  exact RingHom.locally_of RingHom.isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_respectsIso _
    (projectiveCoordinateChartScalarRingHom_isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension R n i)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB5.blowupOver_hom_core
statement:
theorem blowupOver_hom_core (I : B.IdealSheafData) :
    letI
proof:
:= blowupOver (k := k) I
