name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB5.blowup_data
statement:
theorem blowup_data [LocallyOfFiniteType (B ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian B]
    (hB : ProjectiveIntegralK k B) (I : B.IdealSheafData) (hne : I ≠ ⊥) :
    IsIntegral (GlobalBlowup.blowup B I) ∧
      ∃ (N : ℕ) (j : GlobalBlowup.blowup B I ⟶ space k N), IsClosedImmersion j ∧
        j ≫ toSpec k N = GlobalBlowup.toBase B I ≫ B ↘ Spk k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hI, hex⟩ := hB
  haveI := hI
  exact CIIB1.blowup_in_class k B (B ↘ Spk k) hex I hne

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB5.blowup_isNoetherian
statement:
theorem blowup_isNoetherian [LocallyOfFiniteType (B ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian B]
    (hB : ProjectiveIntegralK k B) (I : B.IdealSheafData) (hne : I ≠ ⊥) :
    IsNoetherian (GlobalBlowup.blowup B I)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, N, j, hj, -⟩ := blowup_data hB I hne
  haveI := hj
  haveI : IsNoetherian (space k N) := SchemeProjectiveSpace.isNoetherian k N
  exact
    { __ := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian j
      __ := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace j }

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB5.blowup_locallyOfFiniteType
statement:
theorem blowup_locallyOfFiniteType [LocallyOfFiniteType (B ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian B]
    (hB : ProjectiveIntegralK k B) (I : B.IdealSheafData) (hne : I ≠ ⊥) :
    letI
proof:
:= blowupOver (k := k) I
    LocallyOfFiniteType ((GlobalBlowup.blowup B I) ↘ Spk k) := by
  letI := blowupOver (k := k) I
  obtain ⟨-, N, j, hj, hjk⟩ := blowup_data hB I hne
  haveI := hj
  change LocallyOfFiniteType (GlobalBlowup.toBase B I ≫ B ↘ Spk k)
  rw [← hjk]
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB5.projectiveIntegralK_blowup
statement:
theorem projectiveIntegralK_blowup [LocallyOfFiniteType (B ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian B]
    (hB : ProjectiveIntegralK k B) (I : B.IdealSheafData) (hne : I ≠ ⊥) :
    letI
proof:
:= blowupOver (k := k) I
    haveI := blowup_locallyOfFiniteType hB I hne
    haveI := blowup_isNoetherian hB I hne
    ProjectiveIntegralK k (GlobalBlowup.blowup B I) := by
  obtain ⟨hI, N, j, hj, hjk⟩ := blowup_data hB I hne
  exact ⟨hI, N, j, hj, hjk⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB5.projectiveIntegralK_blowup_prod
statement:
theorem projectiveIntegralK_blowup_prod {A : Scheme.{u}} [A.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (A ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian A] (hA : ProjectiveIntegralK k A) (n : ℕ)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} [Y.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (e : Y ≅ pullback (A ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n))
    (he : e.hom ≫ pullback.fst _ _ ≫ A ↘ Spk k = Y ↘ Spk k)
    (I : Y.IdealSheafData) (hne : I ≠ ⊥) :
    letI
proof:
:= blowupOver (k := k) I
    haveI := blowup_locallyOfFiniteType (projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod hA n e he) I hne
    haveI := blowup_isNoetherian (projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod hA n e he) I hne
    ProjectiveIntegralK k (GlobalBlowup.blowup Y I) :=
  projectiveIntegralK_blowup (projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod hA n e he) I hne

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.symmetricDegreeOverlapLocalRestrictionIndependence_of_mul
statement:
theorem symmetricDegreeOverlapLocalRestrictionIndependence_of_mul
    (d : ℕ) (i j : C.I)
    (h : C.SymmetricDegreeOverlapMulRestrictionCompatibility d i j) :
    C.SymmetricDegreeOverlapLocalRestrictionIndependence d i j
proof:
:= by
  intro c e V hVc hVe
  let W := (c.mul e).inIntersection
  have hWc : W ≤ c.inIntersection := by
    dsimp only [W]
    rw [c.inIntersection_mul e]
    exact inf_le_left
  have hWe : W ≤ e.inIntersection := by
    dsimp only [W]
    rw [c.inIntersection_mul e]
    exact inf_le_right
  have hVW : V ≤ W := by
    dsimp only [W]
    rw [c.inIntersection_mul e]
    exact le_inf hVc hVe
  have hc := (h c e).1
  have he := (h c e).2
  calc
    Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE ((C.U i ⊓ C.U j).toScheme) hVc
        (c.symmetricDegreeOverlapLocalIso d).hom =
      Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE ((C.U i ⊓ C.U j).toScheme) hVW
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE ((C.U i ⊓ C.U j).toScheme) hWc
          (c.symmetricDegreeOverlapLocalIso d).hom) := by
            rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_trans]
    _ = Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE ((C.U i ⊓ C.U j).toScheme) hVW
        ((c.mul e).symmetricDegreeOverlapLocalIso d).hom :=
      congrArg
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE ((C.U i ⊓ C.U j).toScheme) hVW) hc
    _ = Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE ((C.U i ⊓ C.U j).toScheme) hVW
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE ((C.U i ⊓ C.U j).toScheme) hWe
          (e.symmetricDegreeOverlapLocalIso d).hom) :=
      congrArg
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE ((C.U i ⊓ C.U j).toScheme) hVW) he.symm
    _ = Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE ((C.U i ⊓ C.U j).toScheme) hVe
        (e.symmetricDegreeOverlapLocalIso d).hom := by
            rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_trans]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.symmetricDegreeOverlapLocalHom_compatible
statement:
theorem symmetricDegreeOverlapLocalHom_compatible
    (d : ℕ) (i j : C.I)
    (h : C.SymmetricDegreeOverlapLocalRestrictionIndependence d i j) :
    Presheaf.FamilyOfElementsOnObjects.IsCompatible
      (fun c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j ↦
        Scheme.Modules.localHomSection ((C.U i ⊓ C.U j).toScheme)
          c.inIntersection (c.symmetricDegreeOverlapLocalIso d).hom)
proof:
:= by
  intro V c e f g
  have hVc : V ≤ c.inIntersection := f.le
  have hVe : V ≤ e.inIntersection := g.le
  rw [show f = homOfLE hVc from Subsingleton.elim _ _,
    show g = homOfLE hVe from Subsingleton.elim _ _,
    Scheme.Modules.sheafHom_map_localHomSection,
    Scheme.Modules.sheafHom_map_localHomSection]
  change (SheafOfModules.toSheaf
      (((C.U i ⊓ C.U j).toScheme).ringCatSheaf.over V)).map
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE ((C.U i ⊓ C.U j).toScheme) hVc
          (c.symmetricDegreeOverlapLocalIso d).hom) =
    (SheafOfModules.toSheaf
      (((C.U i ⊓ C.U j).toScheme).ringCatSheaf.over V)).map
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE ((C.U i ⊓ C.U j).toScheme) hVe
          (e.symmetricDegreeOverlapLocalIso d).hom)
  exact congrArg
    (SheafOfModules.toSheaf
      (((C.U i ⊓ C.U j).toScheme).ringCatSheaf.over V)).map
    (h c e hVc hVe)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.symmetricDegreeOverlapHomOfLocalCompatibility_over
statement:
theorem symmetricDegreeOverlapHomOfLocalCompatibility_over
    (d : ℕ) (i j : C.I)
    (h : C.SymmetricDegreeOverlapLocalRestrictionIndependence d i j)
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (C.symmetricDegreeOverlapHomOfLocalCompatibility d i j h).over
        c.inIntersection =
      (c.symmetricDegreeOverlapLocalIso d).hom
proof:
:=
  Scheme.Modules.glueHom_over ((C.U i ⊓ C.U j).toScheme)
    (fun e : C.CommonBasicOpen i j ↦ e.inIntersection)
    ((Opens.coversTop_iff
      (T := (C.U i ⊓ C.U j).toScheme)
      (fun e : C.CommonBasicOpen i j ↦ e.inIntersection)).2
        (CommonBasicOpen.isOpenCover C i j))
    (fun e : C.CommonBasicOpen i j ↦
      (e.symmetricDegreeOverlapLocalIso d).hom)
    (C.symmetricDegreeOverlapLocalHom_compatible d i j h) c

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.symmetricDegreeOverlapHomOfLocalCompatibility_isIso
statement:
theorem symmetricDegreeOverlapHomOfLocalCompatibility_isIso
    (d : ℕ) (i j : C.I)
    (h : C.SymmetricDegreeOverlapLocalRestrictionIndependence d i j) :
    IsIso (C.symmetricDegreeOverlapHomOfLocalCompatibility d i j h)
proof:
:=
  Scheme.Modules.glueHom_isIso ((C.U i ⊓ C.U j).toScheme)
    (fun c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j ↦ c.inIntersection)
    ((Opens.coversTop_iff
      (T := (C.U i ⊓ C.U j).toScheme)
      (fun c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j ↦ c.inIntersection)).2
        (CommonBasicOpen.isOpenCover C i j))
    (fun c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j ↦
      (c.symmetricDegreeOverlapLocalIso d).hom)
    (C.symmetricDegreeOverlapLocalHom_compatible d i j h)
    (fun _ ↦ inferInstance)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackCompositeToIteratedAdjunctionIso_unit
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem pullbackCompositeToIteratedAdjunctionIso_unit
    {A B D : Scheme.{u}} (s : D ⟶ A) (q : B ⟶ A) (r : D ⟶ B)
    (h : r ≫ q = s) (M : A.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction s).unit.app M ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward s).map
          (pullbackCompositeToIteratedAdjunctionIso s q r h M).hom =
      pullbackCompositeIteratedUnit s q r h M
proof:
:= by
  let adjComp :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q).comp
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction r)
  let ePush :
      Scheme.Modules.pushforward r ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward q ≅
        Scheme.Modules.pushforward s :=
    Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp r q ≪≫
      Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr h
  let adjComp' := adjComp.ofNatIsoRight ePush
  let adjS := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction s
  let e := adjComp'.leftAdjointUniq adjS
  have hu :
      adjComp'.unit ≫ Functor.whiskerRight e.hom
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward s) =
        adjS.unit :=
    Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom adjComp' adjS
  have hn :
      adjS.unit ≫ Functor.whiskerRight e.inv
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward s) =
        adjComp'.unit := by
    calc
      adjS.unit ≫ Functor.whiskerRight e.inv
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward s) =
        (adjComp'.unit ≫ Functor.whiskerRight e.hom
            (Scheme.Modules.pushforward s)) ≫
          Functor.whiskerRight e.inv
            (Scheme.Modules.pushforward s) :=
        congrArg (fun k ↦ k ≫ Functor.whiskerRight e.inv
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward s)) hu.symm
      _ = adjComp'.unit := by
        rw [Category.assoc, ← Functor.whiskerRight_comp]
        simp
  exact congrArg (fun k ↦ k.app M) hn

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackCompositeToIteratedAdjunctionIso_unit_map
statement:
theorem pullbackCompositeToIteratedAdjunctionIso_unit_map
    {A B D : Scheme.{u}} (s : D ⟶ A) (q : B ⟶ A) (r : D ⟶ B)
    (h : r ≫ q = s) (M : A.Modules) {N : B.Modules}
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.pullback q).obj M ⟶ N) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q).unit.app M ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map e ≫
        Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit q r N =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction s).unit.app M ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward s).map
          ((pullbackCompositeToIteratedAdjunctionIso s q r h M).hom ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pullback r).map e) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr h).inv.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback r).obj N)
proof:
:= by
  let adjComp :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q).comp
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction r)
  let ePush :
      Scheme.Modules.pushforward r ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward q ≅
        Scheme.Modules.pushforward s :=
    Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp r q ≪≫
      Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr h
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  let tail :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward s).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback r).map e) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr h).inv.app
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback r).obj N)
  have hn :
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction r).unit.app
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).obj M) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward r).map
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback r).map e) =
        e ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction r).unit.app N := by
    simpa only [Functor.id_map, Functor.comp_map] using
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction r).unit.naturality e).symm
  calc
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q).unit.app M ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map e ≫
          Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit q r N =
        pullbackCompositeIteratedUnit s q r h M ≫ tail := by
      change
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q).unit.app M ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).map e ≫
            Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit q r N =
          (adjComp.ofNatIsoRight ePush).unit.app M ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pushforward s).map
              ((Scheme.Modules.pullback r).map e) ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr h).inv.app
              ((Scheme.Modules.pullback r).obj N)
      simp only [Adjunction.ofNatIsoRight, NatTrans.comp_app,
        Functor.whiskerLeft_app]
      simp only [Category.assoc]
      rw [← ePush.hom.naturality_assoc]
      dsimp only [ePush]
      simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.trans_hom, NatTrans.comp_app,
        Iso.hom_inv_id_app]
      rw [Adjunction.comp_unit_app]
      simp only [Functor.comp_map, Category.assoc]
      rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc, hn]
      simp only [Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit,
        Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc, Category.comp_id]
    _ =
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction s).unit.app M ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward s).map
            (pullbackCompositeToIteratedAdjunctionIso s q r h M).hom) ≫
          tail :=
      (pullbackCompositeToIteratedAdjunctionIso_unit_assoc
        s q r h M tail).symm
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [tail, Category.assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.totalPullOn_comp_totalPushOn_of_iso
statement:
theorem totalPullOn_comp_totalPushOn_of_iso (cp : ChowCompatOn ops) (φ : X ≅ Y)
    [φ.hom.IsOver (Spk k)] :
    totalPullOn ops φ.hom 0 (pureRelDim_of_iso φ) ∘ₗ totalPushOn ops φ.hom =
      LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  rw [cp.base_change φ.hom φ.hom (𝟙 X) (𝟙 X) 0 (pureRelDim_of_iso φ) pureRelDim_id
    (IsKernelPair.id_of_mono φ.hom), totalPushOn_id, totalPullOn_id, LinearMap.id_comp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.totalPushOn_injective_of_iso
statement:
theorem totalPushOn_injective_of_iso (cp : ChowCompatOn ops) (φ : X ≅ Y)
    [φ.hom.IsOver (Spk k)] : Function.Injective (totalPushOn ops φ.hom)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  have := totalPullOn_comp_totalPushOn_of_iso ops cp φ
  have h2 := congrArg (totalPullOn ops φ.hom 0 (pureRelDim_of_iso φ)) h
  have ha := LinearMap.congr_fun this a
  have hb := LinearMap.congr_fun this b
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply] at ha hb
  rw [← ha, ← hb, h2]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.totalPushOn_comp_totalCapOn_of_iso
statement:
theorem totalPushOn_comp_totalCapOn_of_iso (cp : ChowCompatOn ops) (φ : X ≅ Y)
    [φ.hom.IsOver (Spk k)] (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (L' : Y.Modules) (hL' : HasConstantRank Y L' 1)
    (hO : Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback φ.hom).obj L' ≅ L)) :
    totalPushOn ops φ.hom ∘ₗ totalCapOn ops L hL =
      totalCapOn ops L' hL' ∘ₗ totalPushOn ops φ.hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [cp.cap_iso hL (hasConstantRank_pullback X φ.hom L' 1 hL') (hO.map Iso.symm)]
  exact cp.cap_push φ.hom L' hL'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.pow_comp_eq_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem pow_comp_eq_of_comp_eq (A : Module.End ℚ N) (B : Module.End ℚ M) (F : M →ₗ[ℚ] N)
    (h : A ∘ₗ F = F ∘ₗ B) (j : ℕ) : (A ^ j) ∘ₗ F = F ∘ₗ (B ^ j)
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => simp [Module.End.one_eq_id]
  | succ j ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, pow_succ]
    rw [Module.End.mul_eq_comp, Module.End.mul_eq_comp, LinearMap.comp_assoc, h,
      ← LinearMap.comp_assoc, ih, LinearMap.comp_assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.evTrunc_comp_eq_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem evTrunc_comp_eq_of_comp_eq (n : ℕ) (A : Module.End ℚ N) (B : Module.End ℚ M)
    (F : M →ₗ[ℚ] N) (h : A ∘ₗ F = F ∘ₗ B) (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) :
    evTrunc n A f ∘ₗ F = F ∘ₗ evTrunc n B f
proof:
:= by
  unfold evTrunc
  rw [Polynomial.aeval_eq_sum_range, Polynomial.aeval_eq_sum_range]
  ext v
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply, map_sum, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply (A ^ i) F, pow_comp_eq_of_comp_eq A B F h, LinearMap.comp_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.push_toSpec_eq
statement:
theorem push_toSpec_eq : totalPushOn (opsK k) (toSpec k n) =
    totalPushOn (opsK k) (caseICover k n).toBase ∘ₗ totalPushOn (opsK k) (φK k n).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (cpK k).push_comp]
  exact totalPushOn_congr (opsK k) (caseISpaceIso_hom_toBase k n).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.push_spaceFundClass
statement:
theorem push_spaceFundClass :
    totalPushOn (opsK k) (φK k n).hom (spaceFundClass k n) = caseIFundClass k n
proof:
:= by
  haveI := caseI_flat k n
  have hφ : (φK k n).hom ≫ (caseICover k n).toBase = toSpec k n := caseISpaceIso_hom_toBase k n
  have hrel := (cpK k).projBundle_relDim (caseICover k n) (caseICover_card k n)
  have hfg : PureRelDim ((φK k n).hom ≫ (caseICover k n).toBase) (n + 0) := by
    rw [hφ]
    exact pureRelDim_projectiveSpace_toSpec k n
  have hpull : totalPullOn (opsK k) (toSpec k n) n (pureRelDim_projectiveSpace_toSpec k n) =
      totalPullOn (opsK k) (φK k n).hom 0 (pureRelDim_of_iso (φK k n)) ∘ₗ
        totalPullOn (opsK k) (caseICover k n).toBase n hrel :=
    (totalPullOn_congr (opsK k) hφ.symm n _ hfg).trans
      ((cpK k).pull_comp (φK k n).hom (caseICover k n).toBase 0 n (pureRelDim_of_iso (φK k n))
        hrel hfg)
  have h1 : spaceFundClass k n = totalPullOn (opsK k) (φK k n).hom 0 (pureRelDim_of_iso (φK k n))
      (caseIFundClass k n) :=
    LinearMap.congr_fun hpull _
  rw [h1]
  have := LinearMap.congr_fun
    (totalPushOn_comp_totalPullOn_of_iso (opsK k) (cpK k) (φK k n)) (caseIFundClass k n)
  simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply] using this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.push_spaceH
statement:
theorem push_spaceH (hg : CaseITwistGate k n) :
    caseIH k n ∘ₗ totalPushOn (opsK k) (φK k n).hom =
      totalPushOn (opsK k) (φK k n).hom ∘ₗ spaceH k n
proof:
:= by
  have hg1 : Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (φK k n).hom).obj
      ((caseICover k n).canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) ≅ projectiveTwistingSheaf k n 1) := hg 1
  unfold spaceH caseIH xiCapOn
  have := totalPushOn_comp_totalCapOn_of_iso (opsK k) (cpK k) (φK k n)
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n 1) (AdamsRRFinal.hasConstantRank_projectiveTwistingSheaf k n 1)
    ((caseICover k n).canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    ((caseICover k n).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) hg1
  exact this.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.push_evTrunc
statement:
theorem push_evTrunc (hg : CaseITwistGate k n) (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) :
    evTrunc n (caseIH k n) f ∘ₗ totalPushOn (opsK k) (φK k n).hom =
      totalPushOn (opsK k) (φK k n).hom ∘ₗ evTrunc n (spaceH k n) f
proof:
:=
  evTrunc_comp_eq_of_comp_eq n (caseIH k n) (spaceH k n) (totalPushOn (opsK k) (φK k n).hom)
    (push_spaceH k n hg) f

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.push_evTrunc_pow
statement:
theorem push_evTrunc_pow (hg : CaseITwistGate k n) (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) (j : ℕ) :
    (evTrunc n (caseIH k n) f ^ j) ∘ₗ totalPushOn (opsK k) (φK k n).hom =
      totalPushOn (opsK k) (φK k n).hom ∘ₗ (evTrunc n (spaceH k n) f ^ j)
proof:
:=
  pow_comp_eq_of_comp_eq (evTrunc n (caseIH k n) f) (evTrunc n (spaceH k n) f)
    (totalPushOn (opsK k) (φK k n).hom) (push_evTrunc k n hg f) j

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.push_evChain
statement:
theorem push_evChain (hg : CaseITwistGate k n) (f g : ℚ⟦X⟧) :
    totalPushOn (opsK k) (φK k n).hom
        (evTrunc n (spaceH k n) f (((evTrunc n (spaceH k n) g) ^ (n + 1)) (spaceFundClass k n))) =
      evTrunc n (caseIH k n) f (((evTrunc n (caseIH k n) g) ^ (n + 1)) (caseIFundClass k n))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : evTrunc n (caseIH k n) f (totalPushOn (opsK k) (φK k n).hom
        (((evTrunc n (spaceH k n) g) ^ (n + 1)) (spaceFundClass k n))) =
      totalPushOn (opsK k) (φK k n).hom (evTrunc n (spaceH k n) f
        (((evTrunc n (spaceH k n) g) ^ (n + 1)) (spaceFundClass k n))) :=
    LinearMap.congr_fun (push_evTrunc k n hg f)
      (((evTrunc n (spaceH k n) g) ^ (n + 1)) (spaceFundClass k n))
  have h2 : ((evTrunc n (caseIH k n) g) ^ (n + 1)) (totalPushOn (opsK k) (φK k n).hom
        (spaceFundClass k n)) =
      totalPushOn (opsK k) (φK k n).hom (((evTrunc n (spaceH k n) g) ^ (n + 1))
        (spaceFundClass k n)) :=
    LinearMap.congr_fun (push_evTrunc_pow k n hg g (n + 1)) (spaceFundClass k n)
  have h3 : totalPushOn (opsK k) (φK k n).hom (((evTrunc n (spaceH k n) g) ^ (n + 1))
        (spaceFundClass k n)) =
      ((evTrunc n (caseIH k n) g) ^ (n + 1)) (caseIFundClass k n) :=
    h2.symm.trans (congrArg ((evTrunc n (caseIH k n) g) ^ (n + 1)) (push_spaceFundClass k n))
  exact h1.symm.trans (congrArg (evTrunc n (caseIH k n) f) h3)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.spaceRHS_eq_caseIRHS
statement:
theorem spaceRHS_eq_caseIRHS (hg : CaseITwistGate k n) (m : ℤ) :
    spaceRHS k n m = caseIRHS k n m
proof:
:= by
  haveI := caseI_flat k n
  have := push_evChain k n hg (rescale (m : ℚ) (exp ℚ)) tdSer
  unfold spaceRHS caseIRHS
  rw [push_toSpec_eq, LinearMap.comp_apply, this]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.caseI_spaceKn_class
statement:
theorem caseI_spaceKn_class (m : ℤ) :
    totalPushOn (opsK k) (toSpec k n)
        (evTrunc n (spaceH k n) (rescale (m : ℚ) (exp ℚ))
          (((evTrunc n (spaceH k n) tdSer) ^ (n + 1)) (spaceFundClass k n))) =
      Ring.choose ((m : ℚ) + n) n •
        DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow (Spk k) n) 0 ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] ptClass k)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := caseI_flat k n
  have h := caseI_frameCover (opsK k) (caseICover k n) (cpK k) (caseICover_card k n)
    ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] ptClass k) m
  have h1 := push_evChain k n (caseITwistGate k n) (rescale (m : ℚ) (exp ℚ)) tdSer
  rw [push_toSpec_eq, LinearMap.comp_apply, h1]
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.caseI_spaceKn
statement:
theorem caseI_spaceKn (m : ℤ) :
    spaceRHS k n m = Ring.choose ((m : ℚ) + n) n
proof:
:=
  (spaceRHS_eq_caseIRHS k n (caseITwistGate k n) m).trans (caseI_spk k n m)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.caseI_spaceKn_chi
statement:
theorem caseI_spaceKn_chi (m : ℕ) :
    spaceRHS k n (m : ℤ) = (((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n (m : ℤ)).eulerChar k : ℤ) : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [caseI_spaceKn, eulerChar_projectiveTwistingSheaf_nat]
  have : (((m : ℤ) : ℚ) + (n : ℚ)) = ((m + n : ℕ) : ℚ) := by push_cast; ring
  rw [this, Ring.choose_natCast]
  push_cast
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientSquare_tau_square_of_taut_basis
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotientSquare_tau_square_of_taut_basis
    {R S M N I : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N] [Finite I]
    (b : Module.Basis I R M) (c : Module.Basis I S N)
    (q : space S N ⟶ space R M)
    (H : (Scheme.Modules.pullback q).obj (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b 1) ⟶
      twistingSheafOfBasisIndex S N c 1)
    (hb : ∀ i, (Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map (tautChart_tautHom R M b (b i)) ≫ H =
      (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso q).hom ≫ tautChart_tautHom S N c (c i)) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map (tautChart_tau R M b) ≫ H =
      (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso q I).hom ≫ tautChart_tau S N c
proof:
:= by
  apply pullbackTwistQuotientBasis_free_square_of_basis
  intro i
  erw [tautChart_ιFree_tau, tautChart_ιFree_tau]
  exact hb i

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientSquare_replace_quotients
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotientSquare_replace_quotients
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ Y) (I : Type u) {A : Y.Modules} {B : X.Modules}
    (t t' : SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I ⟶ A)
    (s s' : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I ⟶ B)
    (H : (Scheme.Modules.pullback q).obj A ⟶ B) (ht : t = t') (hs : s = s')
    (h : (Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map t' ≫ H = (pullbackFreeIso q I).hom ≫ s') :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map t ≫ H = (pullbackFreeIso q I).hom ≫ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [ht, hs]
  exact h

        ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).pullbackTwistOverlap_chartCanonicalFreeQuotient a)

    (C.pullbackFrameCover g).pullbackTwistQuotient_chartFreeQuotient_ιFree a k]

    SchemeProjectiveBundle.space, id] at native ⊢

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientSquare_chart_tau_square_proof
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotientSquare_chart_tau_square_proof (a : C.pullbackFrameIndex g) :
    @CategoryStruct.comp _ _ _ _ (@twistingSheafOfBasisIndex Γ(X, C.pullbackFrameOpen g a) inferInstance
          (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.obj (op (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)))
          inferInstance (C.pullbackTwistOverlap_source_module g a)
          (C.pullbackTwistOverlap_source_free g a)
          (C.pullbackTwistOverlap_source_moduleFinite g a)
          (C.basisIndex a.1) ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionBasis a) 1)
        ((@Scheme.Modules.pullback (@space Γ(X, C.pullbackFrameOpen g a) inferInstance
          (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.obj (op (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)))
          inferInstance (C.pullbackTwistOverlap_source_module g a)
          (C.pullbackTwistOverlap_source_free g a)
          (C.pullbackTwistOverlap_source_moduleFinite g a)) (@space Γ(Y, C.U a.1) inferInstance (E.val.obj (op (C.U a.1)))
          inferInstance inferInstance (C.sectionModule_free a.1) (C.sectionModule_finite a.1)) (C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a)).map (@tautChart_tau Γ(Y, C.U a.1) inferInstance (E.val.obj (op (C.U a.1)))
          inferInstance inferInstance (C.sectionModule_free a.1) (C.sectionModule_finite a.1)
          (C.basisIndex a.1) (C.basisIndex_finite a.1) (C.sectionBasis a.1)))
        (C.pullbackChartTwistHom g a 1) =
      (@pullbackFreeIso (@space Γ(X, C.pullbackFrameOpen g a) inferInstance
          (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.obj (op (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)))
          inferInstance (C.pullbackTwistOverlap_source_module g a)
          (C.pullbackTwistOverlap_source_free g a)
          (C.pullbackTwistOverlap_source_moduleFinite g a)) (@space Γ(Y, C.U a.1) inferInstance (E.val.obj (op (C.U a.1)))
          inferInstance inferInstance (C.sectionModule_free a.1) (C.sectionModule_finite a.1)) (C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a) (C.basisIndex a.1)).hom ≫ (@tautChart_tau Γ(X, C.pullbackFrameOpen g a) inferInstance
          (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.obj (op (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)))
          inferInstance (C.pullbackTwistOverlap_source_module g a)
          (C.pullbackTwistOverlap_source_free g a)
          (C.pullbackTwistOverlap_source_moduleFinite g a)
          (C.basisIndex a.1) (C.basisIndex_finite a.1) ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionBasis a))
proof:
:=
  (congrArg (fun t => (@Scheme.Modules.pullback (@space Γ(X, C.pullbackFrameOpen g a) inferInstance
          (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.obj (op (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)))
          inferInstance (C.pullbackTwistOverlap_source_module g a)
          (C.pullbackTwistOverlap_source_free g a)
          (C.pullbackTwistOverlap_source_moduleFinite g a)) (@space Γ(Y, C.U a.1) inferInstance (E.val.obj (op (C.U a.1)))
          inferInstance inferInstance (C.sectionModule_free a.1) (C.sectionModule_finite a.1)) (C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a)).map t ≫ C.pullbackChartTwistHom g a 1)
      (C.pullbackTwistQuotientSquare_targetTau_eq_canonical g a)).trans
    ((C.pullbackTwistQuotientSquare_chart_canonical_square_proof g a).trans
      (congrArg (fun s => (@pullbackFreeIso (@space Γ(X, C.pullbackFrameOpen g a) inferInstance
          (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.obj (op (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)))
          inferInstance (C.pullbackTwistOverlap_source_module g a)
          (C.pullbackTwistOverlap_source_free g a)
          (C.pullbackTwistOverlap_source_moduleFinite g a)) (@space Γ(Y, C.U a.1) inferInstance (E.val.obj (op (C.U a.1)))
          inferInstance inferInstance (C.sectionModule_free a.1) (C.sectionModule_finite a.1)) (C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a) (C.basisIndex a.1)).hom ≫ s)
        (C.pullbackTwistQuotientSquareSourceTau_eq_canonical g a)).symm)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.isMumfordRegular_twist_iff
statement:
theorem isMumfordRegular_twist_iff (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    (F : C.scheme.Modules) (m : ℤ) :
    IsMumfordRegular C F m ↔ IsMumfordRegular C (twist C F m) 0
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ q : ℕ,
      SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification C.toBase
          (twist C (twist C F m) (0 - q)) q ≅
        SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification C.toBase
          (twist C F (m - q)) q := fun q ↦
    BundleRegularity.higherDirectImageIso C (twistTwistIso C hpos F m (0 - q) (m - q) (by ring)) q
  constructor
  · intro h q hq
    exact (h q hq).of_iso (key q)
  · intro h q hq
    exact (h q hq).of_iso (key q).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.H_map_map_eq
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.H_map_map_eq {Z : Scheme.{u}} {A₁ B₁ B₂ C₁ : Z.Modules}
    (f₁ : A₁ ⟶ B₁) (g₁ : B₁ ⟶ C₁) (f₂ : A₁ ⟶ B₂) (g₂ : B₂ ⟶ C₁)
    (h : f₁ ≫ g₁ = f₂ ≫ g₂) (k : ℕ) (z : A₁.H k) :
    Sheaf.H.map ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf Z.ringCatSheaf).map g₁) k
        (Sheaf.H.map ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf Z.ringCatSheaf).map f₁) k z) =
      Sheaf.H.map ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf Z.ringCatSheaf).map g₂) k
        (Sheaf.H.map ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf Z.ringCatSheaf).map f₂) k z)
proof:
:= by
  have h' : (SheafOfModules.toSheaf Z.ringCatSheaf).map f₁ ≫
      (SheafOfModules.toSheaf Z.ringCatSheaf).map g₁ =
      (SheafOfModules.toSheaf Z.ringCatSheaf).map f₂ ≫
      (SheafOfModules.toSheaf Z.ringCatSheaf).map g₂ := by
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp, h]
  rw [← Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply, ← Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply, h']

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.map_eq_rho
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.map_eq_rho {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : S ⟶ Y) (M : S.Modules) (k : ℕ)
    {V W : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ W) (x : (restrictToPreimage f M W).H k) :
    affineLocalCohomologyModule_map f M k h x =
      BundleRegularity.rho (preimageHomOfLE f h) (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι
        (by rw [preimageHomOfLE, Scheme.homOfLE_ι]) M k x
