name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.rho_congr
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.rho_congr {A B : Scheme.{u}} {c c' : A ⟶ B} (b : B ⟶ S) (a : A ⟶ S)
    [IsOpenImmersion c] [IsOpenImmersion c'] [IsOpenImmersion b] [IsOpenImmersion a]
    (h : c ≫ b = a) (h' : c' ≫ b = a) (F : S.Modules) (k : ℕ) (x) :
    BundleRegularity.rho c b a h F k x = BundleRegularity.rho c' b a h' F k x
proof:
:= by
  have hc : c = c' := by rw [← cancel_mono b, h, h']
  subst hc
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.isoR_comp_aux
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.isoR_comp_aux {A B D : Scheme.{u}} (c : A ⟶ B) (d : B ⟶ D) (b : B ⟶ S)
    (a : A ⟶ S) (e : D ⟶ S)
    [IsOpenImmersion c] [IsOpenImmersion d] [IsOpenImmersion b] [IsOpenImmersion a]
    [IsOpenImmersion e]
    (hb : d ≫ e = b) (ha : c ≫ b = a) (hcd : (c ≫ d) ≫ e = a) (F : S.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor c).map (BundleRegularity.isoR d e b hb F).hom ≫
        (BundleRegularity.isoR c b a ha F).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp c d).inv.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor e).obj F) ≫
        (BundleRegularity.isoR (c ≫ d) e a hcd F).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext
  intro T
  simp only [BundleRegularity.isoR, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.app_hom,
    Functor.map_comp, Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, Category.assoc,
    restrictFunctor_map_app]
  simp_rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp_inv_app_app,
    Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr_hom_app_app]
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.restrict_map, ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp]
  congr 2

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.rho_comp
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.rho_comp {A B D : Scheme.{u}} (c : A ⟶ B) (d : B ⟶ D) (b : B ⟶ S)
    (a : A ⟶ S) (e : D ⟶ S)
    [IsOpenImmersion c] [IsOpenImmersion d] [IsOpenImmersion b] [IsOpenImmersion a]
    [IsOpenImmersion e]
    (hb : d ≫ e = b) (ha : c ≫ b = a) (F : S.Modules) (k : ℕ) (x) :
    BundleRegularity.rho c b a ha F k (BundleRegularity.rho d e b hb F k x) =
      BundleRegularity.rho (c ≫ d) e a (by rw [Category.assoc, hb, ha]) F k x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [BundleRegularity.rho, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
  rw [← openRestrictionHAddHom_comp c d ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor e).obj F) k x]
  rw [← openRestrictionHAddHom_naturality c (BundleRegularity.isoR d e b hb F).hom k]
  exact BundleRegularity.H_map_map_eq _ _ _ _ (BundleRegularity.isoR_comp_aux c d b a e hb ha _ F) k _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.isoR_chart_aux
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.isoR_chart_aux {P A B : Scheme.{u}} (ψ : P ⟶ S) (c : A ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ P)
    (a : A ⟶ P)
    [IsOpenImmersion ψ] [IsOpenImmersion c] [IsOpenImmersion b] [IsOpenImmersion a]
    (h : c ≫ b = a) (h' : c ≫ (b ≫ ψ) = a ≫ ψ) (F : S.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor c).map (BundleRegularity.isoR b ψ (b ≫ ψ) rfl F).inv ≫
        (BundleRegularity.isoR c b a h ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ψ).obj F)).hom =
      (BundleRegularity.isoR c (b ≫ ψ) (a ≫ ψ) h' F).hom ≫
        (BundleRegularity.isoR a ψ (a ≫ ψ) rfl F).inv
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext
  intro T
  simp only [BundleRegularity.isoR, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.trans_inv, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.symm_inv,
    Iso.app_hom, Iso.app_inv,
    Functor.map_comp, Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, Category.assoc,
    restrictFunctor_map_app]
  simp_rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp_inv_app_app,
    Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp_hom_app_app,
    Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr_hom_app_app,
    Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr_inv_app_app]
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.restrict_map, ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp]
  congr 2

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.rho_chart
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.rho_chart {P A B : Scheme.{u}} (ψ : P ⟶ S) (c : A ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ P)
    (a : A ⟶ P)
    [IsOpenImmersion ψ] [IsOpenImmersion c] [IsOpenImmersion b] [IsOpenImmersion a]
    (h : c ≫ b = a) (F : S.Modules) (k : ℕ) (y) :
    BundleRegularity.rho c b a h ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ψ).obj F) k
        (Sheaf.H.map ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf B.ringCatSheaf).map
          (BundleRegularity.isoR b ψ (b ≫ ψ) rfl F).inv) k y) =
      Sheaf.H.map ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf A.ringCatSheaf).map
          (BundleRegularity.isoR a ψ (a ≫ ψ) rfl F).inv) k
        (BundleRegularity.rho c (b ≫ ψ) (a ≫ ψ) (by rw [← h, Category.assoc]) F k y)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [BundleRegularity.rho, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
  rw [← openRestrictionHAddHom_naturality c (BundleRegularity.isoR b ψ (b ≫ ψ) rfl F).inv k]
  exact BundleRegularity.H_map_map_eq _ _ _ _ (BundleRegularity.isoR_chart_aux ψ c b a h _ F) k _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.locallyZero
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.locallyZero {S Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : S ⟶ Y) (M : S.Modules) (k : ℕ)
    (h : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f M k)) (U : Y.Opens)
    (x : (restrictToPreimage f M U).H k) (y : Y) (hy : y ∈ U) :
    ∃ W : Y.Opens, ∃ hW : W ≤ U, y ∈ W ∧ affineLocalCohomologyModule_map f M k hW x = 0
proof:
:= by
  let P := affineLocalCohomologyHAddPresheaf f M k
  have h1 : IsZero ((presheafToSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj P) := by
    rw [← affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_toSheaf]
    exact Functor.map_isZero _ h
  rw [TopCat.Sheaf.isZero_iff_stalkFunctor_obj_isZero] at h1
  haveI := TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_unit_toSheafify_isIso y AddCommGrpCat.{u} P
  have h2 : IsZero ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} y).obj P) :=
    (h1 y).of_iso (asIso ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} y).map
      (CategoryTheory.toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) P)))
  rw [AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton] at h2
  obtain ⟨W, hyW, iU, iV, hW⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.germ_eq P y hy hy x 0 (@Subsingleton.elim _ h2 _ _)
  refine ⟨W, leOfHom iU, hyW, ?_⟩
  have h4 : P.map iU.op x = 0 := by rw [hW, map_zero]
  exact h4

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.standardChartEmb_opensRange
statement:
theorem standardChartEmb_opensRange (i : C.I) {n : ℕ} (e : C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1))
    (g : Γ(X, C.U i)) :
    ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g).ι ≫
        standardChartEmb C i e).opensRange = C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ X.basicOpen g
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp := standardChartEmb_toBase C i e
  have hpt : ∀ w, C.toBase (standardChartEmb C i e w) =
      (C.isAffine i).fromSpec (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n w) := fun w ↦ by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hcomp, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  have himg := (C.isAffine i).fromSpec_image_basicOpen g
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, rfl⟩
    change C.toBase ((_ ≫ standardChartEmb C i e) w) ∈ X.basicOpen g
    rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hpt, ← himg, ← SetLike.mem_coe, Scheme.Hom.coe_image]
    exact ⟨_, w.2, rfl⟩
  · intro hx
    change C.toBase x ∈ X.basicOpen g at hx
    have hxU : C.toBase x ∈ Set.range (C.U i).ι := by
      rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
      exact X.basicOpen_le g hx
    have hr := Scheme.Pullback.range_fst C.toBase (C.U i).ι
    have hx2 : x ∈ Set.range (pullback.fst C.toBase (C.U i).ι) := by
      rw [hr]
      exact hxU
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hx2
    let h := C.isPullback_chartι_toBase i
    let c := h.isoPullback.inv y
    have hc : C.chartι i c = x := by
      rw [← hy, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, h.isoPullback_inv_fst]
    let w0 := (standardChartIso C i e).hom c
    have hw0 : standardChartEmb C i e w0 = x := by
      rw [← hc]
      simp only [w0, standardChartEmb]
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.id_comp]
    have hmem : SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n w0 ∈ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g := by
      have h1 : (C.isAffine i).fromSpec (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n w0) ∈
          (X.basicOpen g : Set X) := by
        rw [← hpt, hw0]
        exact hx
      rw [← himg, Scheme.Hom.coe_image] at h1
      obtain ⟨s, hs, hs'⟩ := h1
      rwa [← (C.isAffine i).fromSpec.isOpenEmbedding.injective hs']
    exact ⟨⟨w0, hmem⟩, hw0⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.standardChartEmb_opensRange_top
statement:
theorem standardChartEmb_opensRange_top (i : C.I) {n : ℕ} (e : C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1)) :
    ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤).ι ≫
        standardChartEmb C i e).opensRange = C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i
proof:
:= by
  have h := standardChartEmb_opensRange C i e 1
  rwa [PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_one, Scheme.basicOpen_one] at h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.standardChart_isPullback
statement:
theorem standardChart_isPullback (i : C.I) {n : ℕ} (e : C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1)) :
    IsPullback (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n) (standardChartEmb C i e)
      (C.isAffine i).fromSpec C.toBase
proof:
:= by
  refine (C.isPullback_chartι_toBase i).flip.of_iso (standardChartIso C i e)
    (C.isAffine i).isoSpec (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [standardChartIso_hom_toSpec]
    change ((C.affineData i).toSpecBase ≫ (C.isAffine i).isoSpec.inv) ≫ _ = _
    rw [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  · simp [standardChartEmb]
  · rw [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, ← IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_inv_ι, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  · simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.preimageHomOfLE_ι
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.preimageHomOfLE_ι {S Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : S ⟶ Y) {V W : Y.Opens}
    (h : V ≤ W) : preimageHomOfLE f h ≫ (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι = (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι
proof:
:= by
  rw [preimageHomOfLE, Scheme.homOfLE_ι]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.lift_fac
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.lift_fac (i : C.I) {n : ℕ} (e : C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1))
    (V : X.Opens) (D : (Spec Γ(X, C.U i)).Opens)
    (hVD : ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n ⁻¹ᵁ D).ι ≫
      standardChartEmb C i e).opensRange = C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ V) :
    BundleRegularity.lift C i e V D hVD ≫ (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι =
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n ⁻¹ᵁ D).ι ≫ standardChartEmb C i e
proof:
:=
  IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.T_natural
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.T_natural (i : C.I) {n : ℕ} (e : C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1))
    (F : C.scheme.Modules) (k : ℕ) (V V' : X.Opens) (D D' : (Spec Γ(X, C.U i)).Opens)
    (hV : V' ≤ V) (hD : D' ≤ D)
    (hVD : ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n ⁻¹ᵁ D).ι ≫
      standardChartEmb C i e).opensRange = C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    (hVD' : ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n ⁻¹ᵁ D').ι ≫
      standardChartEmb C i e).opensRange = C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ V')
    (x : (restrictToPreimage C.toBase F V).H k) :
    BundleRegularity.T C i e F k V' D' hVD' (affineLocalCohomologyModule_map C.toBase F k hV x) =
      affineLocalCohomologyModule_map (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n)
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e)).obj F) k hD
        (BundleRegularity.T C i e F k V D hVD x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [BundleRegularity.map_eq_rho, BundleRegularity.map_eq_rho]
  simp only [BundleRegularity.T]
  have h1 : (BundleRegularity.lift C i e V' D' hVD' ≫ preimageHomOfLE C.toBase hV) ≫
      (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι =
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n ⁻¹ᵁ D').ι ≫ standardChartEmb C i e := by
    rw [Category.assoc, BundleRegularity.preimageHomOfLE_ι, BundleRegularity.lift_fac]
  have h2 : (preimageHomOfLE (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n) hD ≫
      BundleRegularity.lift C i e V D hVD) ≫ (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι =
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n ⁻¹ᵁ D').ι ≫ standardChartEmb C i e := by
    rw [Category.assoc, BundleRegularity.lift_fac, ← Category.assoc, BundleRegularity.preimageHomOfLE_ι]
  have h3 : preimageHomOfLE (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n) hD ≫
      ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n ⁻¹ᵁ D).ι ≫ standardChartEmb C i e) =
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n ⁻¹ᵁ D').ι ≫ standardChartEmb C i e := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, BundleRegularity.preimageHomOfLE_ι]
  have e1 := BundleRegularity.rho_congr (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι _ h1 h2 F k x
  have eC := BundleRegularity.rho_comp (BundleRegularity.lift C i e V' D' hVD') (preimageHomOfLE C.toBase hV)
    (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ V').ι _ (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι (BundleRegularity.preimageHomOfLE_ι C.toBase hV)
    (BundleRegularity.lift_fac C i e V' D' hVD') F k x
  have eB := BundleRegularity.rho_comp (preimageHomOfLE (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n) hD)
    (BundleRegularity.lift C i e V D hVD) _ _ (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι
    (BundleRegularity.lift_fac C i e V D hVD) h3 F k x
  have eA := BundleRegularity.rho_chart (standardChartEmb C i e)
    (preimageHomOfLE (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n) hD)
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n ⁻¹ᵁ D).ι
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n ⁻¹ᵁ D').ι
    (BundleRegularity.preimageHomOfLE_ι _ hD) F k
    (BundleRegularity.rho (BundleRegularity.lift C i e V D hVD) (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι _
      (BundleRegularity.lift_fac C i e V D hVD) F k x)
  exact (congrArg (Sheaf.H.map ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n ⁻¹ᵁ D').toScheme.ringCatSheaf).map
    (BundleRegularity.isoR (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n ⁻¹ᵁ D').ι
      (standardChartEmb C i e) _ rfl F).inv) k) ((eC.trans e1).trans eB.symm)).trans eA.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.H_map_iso_surjective
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.H_map_iso_surjective {Z : Scheme.{u}} {A B : Z.Modules} (φ : A ≅ B) (k : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective
      (Sheaf.H.map ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf Z.ringCatSheaf).map φ.hom) k)
proof:
:= fun y ↦
  ⟨Sheaf.H.map ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf Z.ringCatSheaf).map φ.inv) k y, by
    rw [← Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp, φ.inv_hom_id,
      CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
    exact Sheaf.H.map_id_apply _⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.H_map_iso_inv_surjective
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.H_map_iso_inv_surjective {Z : Scheme.{u}} {A B : Z.Modules} (φ : A ≅ B)
    (k : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective
      (Sheaf.H.map ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf Z.ringCatSheaf).map φ.inv) k)
proof:
:=
  BundleRegularity.H_map_iso_surjective φ.symm k

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.H_subsingleton_of_top
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.H_subsingleton_of_top {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ Y) (M : Z.Modules) (k : ℕ)
    (h : Subsingleton ((restrictToPreimage f M ⊤).H k)) : Subsingleton (M.H k)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤).ι := by
    rw [isIso_iff_isOpenImmersion_and_surjective]
    exact ⟨inferInstance, ⟨fun z ↦ ⟨⟨z, by simp⟩, rfl⟩⟩⟩
  refine ⟨fun a b ↦ (openRestrictionHAddHom_bijective_of_iso (asIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤).ι) M k).1 ?_⟩
  exact @Subsingleton.elim _ h _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.lift_top_isIso
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.lift_top_isIso (i : C.I) {n : ℕ} (e : C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1)) :
    IsIso (BundleRegularity.lift C i e (C.U i) ⊤ (standardChartEmb_opensRange_top C i e))
proof:
:= by
  rw [isIso_iff_isOpenImmersion_and_surjective]
  refine ⟨inferInstance, ⟨fun z ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  have hz : (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i).ι z ∈
      ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤).ι ≫
        standardChartEmb C i e).opensRange := by
    rw [standardChartEmb_opensRange_top]
    exact z.2
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hz
  refine ⟨w, (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i).ι.isOpenEmbedding.injective ?_⟩
  rw [← hw, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, BundleRegularity.lift_fac]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.T_top_surjective
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.T_top_surjective (i : C.I) {n : ℕ} (e : C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1))
    (F : C.scheme.Modules) (k : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective
      (BundleRegularity.T C i e F k (C.U i) ⊤ (standardChartEmb_opensRange_top C i e))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := BundleRegularity.lift_top_isIso C i e
  have h1 := (openRestrictionHAddHom_bijective_of_iso
    (asIso (BundleRegularity.lift C i e (C.U i) ⊤ (standardChartEmb_opensRange_top C i e)))
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i).ι).obj F) k).2
  exact (BundleRegularity.H_map_iso_inv_surjective _ k).comp
    ((BundleRegularity.H_map_iso_surjective _ k).comp h1)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.chart_topH_subsingleton
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.chart_topH_subsingleton (i : C.I) {n : ℕ} (e : C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1))
    [IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, C.U i)]
    (F : C.scheme.Modules) [((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e)).obj
      F).IsQuasicoherent] (k : ℕ)
    (hR : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification C.toBase F k)) :
    Subsingleton ((restrictToPreimage (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n)
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e)).obj F) ⊤).H k)
proof:
:= by
  let R := Γ(X, C.U i)
  let M := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e)).obj F
  let hVD := standardChartEmb_opensRange_top C i e
  suffices hy : ∀ y : (restrictToPreimage (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec R n) M ⊤).H k, y = 0 by
    exact ⟨fun a b ↦ by rw [hy a, hy b]⟩
  intro y
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := BundleRegularity.T_top_surjective C i e F k y
  let s : Set R := {g | affineLocalCohomologyModule_map C.toBase F k (X.basicOpen_le g) x = 0}
  have hs : Ideal.span s = ⊤ := by
    rw [← (C.isAffine i).iSup_basicOpen_eq_self_iff]
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact iSup_le fun g ↦ X.basicOpen_le g.1
    · intro u hu
      obtain ⟨W, hW, huW, hx⟩ := BundleRegularity.locallyZero C.toBase F k hR (C.U i) x u hu
      obtain ⟨g, hgW, hug⟩ := (C.isAffine i).exists_basicOpen_le ⟨u, huW⟩ hu
      have hg : g ∈ s := by
        have h := affineLocalCohomologyModule_map_comp C.toBase F k hgW hW x
        rw [hx, map_zero] at h
        exact h.symm
      exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨⟨g, hg⟩, hug⟩
  have hres : ∀ g ∈ s, affineLocalCohomologyModule_map (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec R n) M k
      (show SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g ≤ ⊤ from le_top)
      (BundleRegularity.T C i e F k (C.U i) ⊤ hVD x) = 0 := by
    intro g hg
    have h := BundleRegularity.T_natural C i e F k (C.U i) (X.basicOpen g) ⊤
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g) (X.basicOpen_le g) le_top hVD
      (standardChartEmb_opensRange C i e g) x
    have hg' : affineLocalCohomologyModule_map C.toBase F k (X.basicOpen_le g) x = 0 := hg
    rw [hg', map_zero] at h
    exact h.symm
  let φ : R →+* Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), ⊤) := (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv.hom
  let y := BundleRegularity.T C i e F k (C.U i) ⊤ hVD x
  let J : Ideal Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), ⊤) :=
    LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), ⊤)
      ((restrictToPreimage (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec R n) M ⊤).H k) y)
  have hsub : s ⊆ (J.comap φ).radical := by
    intro g hg
    let T := Submonoid.powers (SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveBaseTopElement R g)
    haveI := SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveModule_projectivePrincipalCohomologyBaseChange
      R n M g k
    haveI hL : IsLocalizedModule T (affineLocalCohomologyModule_restrictLinear
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec R n) M k
        (show SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).hom :=
      AffineLocalCohomologyRestrictionIsLocalization.of_baseChangeMap_isIso T
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec R n) M k _
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveBaseBasicOpenIsLocalizationFromTop R g)
    obtain ⟨⟨m, hm⟩, hmy⟩ := (IsLocalizedModule.eq_zero_iff T (f := (affineLocalCohomologyModule_restrictLinear
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec R n) M k
        (show SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).hom)
        (m := y)).1 (hres g hg)
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Submonoid.mem_powers_iff _ _ |>.1 hm
    refine ⟨j, ?_⟩
    change φ (g ^ j) ∈ J
    rw [map_pow]
    change (SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveBaseTopElement R g ^ j) • y = 0
    exact hmy
  have htop : (J.comap φ).radical = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff, ← hs]
    exact Ideal.span_le.2 hsub
  rw [Ideal.radical_eq_top] at htop
  have h1 : φ 1 ∈ J := (Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).1 htop
  rw [map_one] at h1
  have h2 : (1 : Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), ⊤)) • y = 0 := h1
  rwa [one_smul] at h2

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.chartThm
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.chartThm (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (n : ℕ)
    (M : (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space R n).Modules)
    (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space R n) M)
    (hH : ∀ q : ℕ, Subsingleton (M.H (q + 1))) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec R n)).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hM
  haveI : M.IsFinitePresentation := hM.isFinitePresentation
  haveI : M.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  obtain ⟨hfin, hproj⟩ := SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.chart R n M (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushforward_isFinitePresentation R n M)
    (fun p a ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.sec_flat_of_chartFlat R n M p a (SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.hsec R n M hM p a))
    (fun q ↦ @AddCommGrpCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _ (hH q))
  haveI := SchemeProjectiveSpace.isQuasicoherent_pushforward_toSpec R n M
  haveI : Module.Finite R ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec R n)).obj M)) :=
    Module.Finite.equiv (SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.globalSectionsEquiv R n M)
  haveI : Module.Projective R ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec R n)).obj M)) :=
    Module.Projective.of_equiv (SchemeProjectiveSpace.PushforwardFree.globalSectionsEquiv R n M)
  exact SchemeProjectiveSpace.isFiniteLocallyFree_of_globalSections_projective _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.restrict_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.restrict_isFiniteLocallyFree {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion f] (F : Y.Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y F) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree Z ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj F)
proof:
:=
  isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso _ ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback f).app F).symm
    (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global f F hF)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.chart_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.chart_isFiniteLocallyFree [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (i : C.I) {n : ℕ}
    (e : C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1))
    (F : C.scheme.Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme F)
    (hR : ∀ q : ℕ, IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification C.toBase F (q + 1))) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree (Spec Γ(X, C.U i))
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.isAffine i).fromSpec).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.toBase).obj F))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, C.U i) :=
    IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨C.U i, C.isAffine i⟩
  let M := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e)).obj F
  have hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree _ M := BundleRegularity.restrict_isFiniteLocallyFree _ F hF
  haveI : M.IsFinitePresentation := hM.isFinitePresentation
  haveI : M.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  refine isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso _ (pushforwardRestrictIso C i e F).symm ?_
  exact BundleRegularity.chartThm Γ(X, C.U i) n M hM fun q ↦
    BundleRegularity.H_subsingleton_of_top _ M _
      (BundleRegularity.chart_topH_subsingleton C i e F (q + 1) (hR q))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushforward_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem pushforward_isFiniteLocallyFree [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    (F : C.scheme.Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme F)
    (hR : ∀ q : ℕ, IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification C.toBase F (q + 1))) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree X ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.toBase).obj F)
proof:
:= by
  have hrank : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1)) := fun i ↦ by
    haveI := C.basisIndex_finite i
    obtain ⟨k, ⟨e⟩⟩ := Finite.exists_equiv_fin (C.basisIndex i)
    obtain ⟨a⟩ := hpos i
    have hk : 0 < k := Fin.pos (e a)
    exact ⟨k - 1, ⟨e.trans (finCongr (by omega))⟩⟩
  choose nr er using hrank
  have hchart := fun i ↦ BundleRegularity.chart_isFiniteLocallyFree C i (er i).some F hF hR
  choose q hq hqfin using fun i ↦ (hchart i).exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  haveI hoi : ∀ (i : C.I) (j : (localGeneratorsOpenCover (q i)).I₀),
      IsOpenImmersion ((localGeneratorsOpenCover (q i)).f j) := fun i j ↦
    (localGeneratorsOpenCover (q i)).map_prop j
  have hcov : ∀ x : X, ∃ a : (Σ i : C.I, (localGeneratorsOpenCover (q i)).I₀),
      ∃ y, ((localGeneratorsOpenCover (q a.1)).f a.2 ≫ (C.isAffine a.1).fromSpec) y = x := by
    intro x
    have hx : x ∈ (⨆ i, C.U i : X.Opens) := by
      rw [C.covers]
      trivial
    rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup] at hx
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hx
    have hx' : x ∈ Set.range (C.isAffine i).fromSpec := by
      rw [IsAffineOpen.range_fromSpec]
      exact hi
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx'
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (localGeneratorsOpenCover (q i)).covers y
    exact ⟨⟨i, _⟩, z, (Scheme.Hom.comp_apply _ _ z).trans (congrArg (C.isAffine i).fromSpec hz)⟩
  let 𝒰 : X.OpenCover := Scheme.Cover.mkOfCovers (Σ i : C.I, (localGeneratorsOpenCover (q i)).I₀)
    (fun a ↦ (localGeneratorsOpenCover (q a.1)).X a.2)
    (fun a ↦ (localGeneratorsOpenCover (q a.1)).f a.2 ≫ (C.isAffine a.1).fromSpec) hcov
  letI : ∀ i, (q i).IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  letI : ∀ i, (q i).IsFiniteType := hqfin
  haveI hfin : ∀ a : (Σ i : C.I, (localGeneratorsOpenCover (q i)).I₀),
      Finite ((q a.1).generators a.2).I := fun a ↦ by
    letI : ((q a.1).generators a.2).IsFiniteType :=
      SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType a.2
    infer_instance
  exact isFiniteLocallyFree_of_openCover_freeTrivializations 𝒰 _
    (fun (a : Σ i : C.I, (localGeneratorsOpenCover (q i)).I₀) ↦ ((q a.1).generators a.2).I)
    (fun (a : Σ i : C.I, (localGeneratorsOpenCover (q i)).I₀) ↦
      (@Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp _ _ _ ((localGeneratorsOpenCover (q a.1)).f a.2)
        (C.isAffine a.1).fromSpec (hoi a.1 a.2) _).app _ ≪≫
      localGeneratorsOpenCoverIso (q a.1) a.2)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.H_transfer
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.H_transfer {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ Y) (V : Y.Opens) (j : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] (hj : j.opensRange = p ⁻¹ᵁ V) (G : X.Modules) (i : ℕ)
    (h : Subsingleton (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
      ((Modules.toSheafAb Z).obj ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).obj G)) i)) :
    Subsingleton ((SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyHAddPresheaf p G i).obj
      (op V))
proof:
:= by
  change Subsingleton (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H ((Modules.toSheafAb (p ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme).obj
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (p ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).obj G)) i)
  rw [← hj]
  let e := j.isoOpensRange
  let A := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j.opensRange.ι).obj G
  have hbij := SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.openRestrictionHAddHom_bijective_of_iso e A i
  let c : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor e.hom).obj A ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).obj G :=
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp e.hom j.opensRange.ι).symm.app G ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr (Scheme.Hom.isoOpensRange_hom_ι j)).app G
  let E := (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.functorH _ i).mapIso ((Modules.toSheafAb Z).mapIso c)
  haveI : Subsingleton (((Modules.toSheafAb Z).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor e.hom).obj A)).H i) :=
    @Equiv.subsingleton _ _ E.addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv.toEquiv h
  exact hbij.1.subsingleton

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.chart_vanishing_on_basicOpen
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.chart_vanishing_on_basicOpen (i : C.I) {n : ℕ}
    (e : C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1)) [IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, C.U i)]
    (hgen : ∀ (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace Γ(X, C.U i) n).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation],
      IsProjectiveTwistGenerated Γ(X, C.U i) n M)
    (F : C.scheme.Modules) [F.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ m₀ : ℤ, ∀ m : ℤ, m₀ ≤ m → ∀ (q' : ℕ) (g : Γ(X, C.U i)),
      Subsingleton ((SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyHAddPresheaf C.toBase
        (twist C F (m - ((q' + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) (q' + 1)).obj (op (X.basicOpen g)))
proof:
:= by
  letI : (BundleRegularity.chartCoeff C i e F).IsFinitePresentation :=
    isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e) F
  obtain ⟨m₀, h⟩ := SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.chart_regular_basicOpen Γ(X, C.U i) n hgen (BundleRegularity.chartCoeff C i e F)
  refine ⟨m₀, fun m hm q' g ↦ ?_⟩
  let W := SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g
  refine BundleRegularity.H_transfer C.toBase (X.basicOpen g) (W.ι ≫ standardChartEmb C i e)
    (standardChartEmb_opensRange C i e g) _ _ ?_
  have h0 := h m hm q' g
  let c : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (W.ι ≫ standardChartEmb C i e)).obj
      (twist C F (m - ((q' + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.Regularity.tw Γ(X, C.U i) n (m - ((q' + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (BundleRegularity.chartCoeff C i e F)) :=
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp W.ι (standardChartEmb C i e)).app _ ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).mapIso (standardChartEmbTensorIso C i e F _)
  let E := (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.functorH _ (q' + 1)).mapIso
    ((Modules.toSheafAb W.toScheme).mapIso c)
  exact @Equiv.subsingleton _ _ E.addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv.toEquiv h0

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.exists_isMumfordRegular_of_generation
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.exists_isMumfordRegular_of_generation [IsNoetherian X]
    (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    (hgen : ∀ (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (n : ℕ)
      (M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace R n).Modules) [M.IsFinitePresentation],
      IsProjectiveTwistGenerated R n M)
    (F : C.scheme.Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme F) :
    ∃ m : ℤ, IsMumfordRegular C F m
proof:
:= by
  haveI : F.IsFinitePresentation := hF.isFinitePresentation
  have hrank : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1)) := fun i ↦ by
    haveI := C.basisIndex_finite i
    obtain ⟨k, ⟨e⟩⟩ := Finite.exists_equiv_fin (C.basisIndex i)
    obtain ⟨a⟩ := hpos i
    have hk : 0 < k := Fin.pos (e a)
    exact ⟨k - 1, ⟨e.trans (finCongr (by omega))⟩⟩
  choose nr er using hrank
  have hloc : ∀ i, ∃ m₀ : ℤ, ∀ m : ℤ, m₀ ≤ m → ∀ (q' : ℕ) (g : Γ(X, C.U i)),
      Subsingleton ((SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalCohomologyHAddPresheaf C.toBase
        (twist C F (m - ((q' + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) (q' + 1)).obj (op (X.basicOpen g))) := fun i ↦ by
    haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, C.U i) :=
      IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨C.U i, C.isAffine i⟩
    exact BundleRegularity.chart_vanishing_on_basicOpen C i (er i).some (hgen _ _) F
  choose m₀ hm₀ using hloc
  have hcov : (Set.univ : Set X) ⊆ ⋃ i, (C.U i : Set X) := fun x _ ↦ by
    have hx : x ∈ (⨆ i, C.U i : X.Opens) := by
      rw [C.covers]
      trivial
    rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup] at hx
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 hx
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := isCompact_univ.elim_finite_subcover (fun i ↦ (C.U i : Set X))
    (fun i ↦ (C.U i).isOpen) hcov
  refine ⟨∑ i ∈ s, |m₀ i|, fun q hq ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨q', rfl⟩ : ∃ q', q = q' + 1 := ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩
  let B : Set X.Opens := {V | ∃ i ∈ s, ∃ g : Γ(X, C.U i), X.basicOpen g = V}
  have hB : TopologicalSpace.Opens.IsBasis B := by
    rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd]
    intro W x hx
    have hxs := hs (Set.mem_univ x)
    rw [Set.mem_iUnion₂] at hxs
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩ := hxs
    obtain ⟨g, hgW, hxg⟩ := (C.isAffine i).exists_basicOpen_le ⟨x, hx⟩ hxi
    exact ⟨X.basicOpen g, ⟨i, hi, g, rfl⟩, hxg, hgW⟩
  refine SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_isZero_of_isBasis
    _ _ _ hB ?_
  rintro V ⟨i, hi, g, rfl⟩
  exact hm₀ i _ (le_trans (le_abs_self _)
    (Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ ↦ abs_nonneg (m₀ j)) hi)) q' g

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.exists_isMumfordRegular
statement:
theorem exists_isMumfordRegular [IsNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    (F : C.scheme.Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme F) :
    ∃ m : ℤ, IsMumfordRegular C F m
proof:
:=
  BundleRegularity.exists_isMumfordRegular_of_generation C hpos
    (fun R _ _ n M _ ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistGenerated R n M) F hF

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.RegularityChart.isRegular_iso
statement:
theorem RegularityChart.isRegular_iso {M M' : (space R n).Modules} (φ : M ≅ M') (m : ℤ)
    (h : IsMumfordRegular R n M m) : IsMumfordRegular R n M' m
proof:
:= fun q hq ↦
  Quillen.R_iso R n (tensorSheafMapIso (space R n) φ (Iso.refl _)) q (h q hq)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.RegularityChart.basicOpenH_of_topH
statement:
theorem RegularityChart.basicOpenH_of_topH (M : (space R n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] (k : ℕ)
    (h : Subsingleton ((restrictToPreimage (toSpec R n) M ⊤).H k)) (g : R) :
    Subsingleton ((restrictToPreimage (toSpec R n) M (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)).H k)
proof:
:= by
  let T := Submonoid.powers (projectiveBaseTopElement R g)
  haveI := projectiveModule_projectivePrincipalCohomologyBaseChange R n M g k
  haveI hL : IsLocalizedModule T (affineLocalCohomologyModule_restrictLinear
      (toSpec R n) M k
      (show projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).hom :=
    AffineLocalCohomologyRestrictionIsLocalization.of_baseChangeMap_isIso T
      (toSpec R n) M k _
      (projectiveBaseBasicOpenIsLocalizationFromTop R g)
  suffices hz : ∀ z : (restrictToPreimage (toSpec R n) M (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)).H k,
      z = 0 by
    exact ⟨fun a b ↦ by rw [hz a, hz b]⟩
  intro z
  obtain ⟨⟨x, s⟩, hx⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.mk'_surjective T (affineLocalCohomologyModule_restrictLinear
      (toSpec R n) M k (show projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).hom z
  rw [← hx, Function.uncurry_apply_pair, @Subsingleton.elim _ h x 0, IsLocalizedModule.mk'_zero]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.RegularityChart.isZero_of_topH
statement:
theorem RegularityChart.isZero_of_topH (M : (space R n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] (k : ℕ)
    (h : Subsingleton ((restrictToPreimage (toSpec R n) M ⊤).H k)) :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) M k)
proof:
:= by
  refine affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_isZero_of_isBasis _ _ _
    PrimeSpectrum.isBasis_basic_opens ?_
  rintro U ⟨g, rfl⟩
  exact RegularityChart.basicOpenH_of_topH R n M k h g

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.RegularityChart.topH_of_isZero
statement:
theorem RegularityChart.topH_of_isZero (M : (space R n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] (k : ℕ)
    (h : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) M k)) :
    Subsingleton ((restrictToPreimage (toSpec R n) M ⊤).H k)
proof:
:= by
  suffices hy : ∀ y : (restrictToPreimage (toSpec R n) M ⊤).H k, y = 0 by
    exact ⟨fun a b ↦ by rw [hy a, hy b]⟩
  intro y
  let s : Set R := {g | affineLocalCohomologyModule_map (toSpec R n) M k
    (show projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g ≤ ⊤ from le_top) y = 0}
  have hs : Ideal.span s = ⊤ := by
    rw [← PrimeSpectrum.iSup_basicOpen_eq_top_iff']
    refine eq_top_iff.2 fun u _ ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨W, hW, huW, hx⟩ := SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.locallyZero (toSpec R n) M k h ⊤ y u trivial
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨g, rfl⟩, hug, hgW⟩ :=
      (TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.1 PrimeSpectrum.isBasis_basic_opens) huW
    have hg : g ∈ s := by
      have h' := affineLocalCohomologyModule_map_comp (toSpec R n) M k
        (show projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g ≤ W from hgW) hW y
      rw [hx, map_zero] at h'
      exact h'.symm
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨g, TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨hg, hug⟩⟩
  let φ : R →+* Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), ⊤) := (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv.hom
  let J : Ideal Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), ⊤) :=
    LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), ⊤)
      ((restrictToPreimage (toSpec R n) M ⊤).H k) y)
  have hsub : s ⊆ (J.comap φ).radical := by
    intro g hg
    let T := Submonoid.powers (projectiveBaseTopElement R g)
    haveI := projectiveModule_projectivePrincipalCohomologyBaseChange R n M g k
    haveI hL : IsLocalizedModule T (affineLocalCohomologyModule_restrictLinear
        (toSpec R n) M k
        (show projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).hom :=
      AffineLocalCohomologyRestrictionIsLocalization.of_baseChangeMap_isIso T
        (toSpec R n) M k _
        (projectiveBaseBasicOpenIsLocalizationFromTop R g)
    obtain ⟨⟨m, hm⟩, hmy⟩ := (IsLocalizedModule.eq_zero_iff T
        (f := (affineLocalCohomologyModule_restrictLinear
        (toSpec R n) M k
        (show projectiveBaseBasicOpen R g ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).hom)
        (m := y)).1 hg
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Submonoid.mem_powers_iff _ _ |>.1 hm
    refine ⟨j, ?_⟩
    change φ (g ^ j) ∈ J
    rw [map_pow]
    change (projectiveBaseTopElement R g ^ j) • y = 0
    exact hmy
  have htop : (J.comap φ).radical = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff, ← hs]
    exact Ideal.span_le.2 hsub
  rw [Ideal.radical_eq_top] at htop
  have h1 : φ 1 ∈ J := (Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).1 htop
  rw [map_one] at h1
  have h2 : (1 : Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), ⊤)) • y = 0 := h1
  rwa [one_smul] at h2

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.RegularityChart.basicOpenH_of_isZero
statement:
theorem RegularityChart.basicOpenH_of_isZero (M : (space R n).Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] (k : ℕ)
    (h : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) M k)) (g : R) :
    Subsingleton ((restrictToPreimage (toSpec R n) M (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)).H k)
proof:
:=
  RegularityChart.basicOpenH_of_topH R n M k (RegularityChart.topH_of_isZero R n M k h) g

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.RegularityChart.chart_kernel_vanishing
statement:
theorem RegularityChart.chart_kernel_vanishing (S : ShortComplex (space R n).Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) S.X₃) (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n S.X₃ 0)
    (eP : S.X₂ ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj S.X₃))
    (hR0 : Epi ((affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor (toSpec R n) 0).map S.g))
    (i : ℕ) :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n)
      (moduleTwist R n S.X₁ (-(i : ℤ))) (i + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rcases i with _ | k
  · have hw : (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor (toSpec R n) 0).map S.g ≫
        affineLocalConnectingSheafificationMap (toSpec R n) S hS 0 = 0 :=
      (affineLocalLongExactSheafification₂ (toSpec R n) S hS 0).zero
    have hδ : affineLocalConnectingSheafificationMap (toSpec R n) S hS 0 = 0 := by
      exact hR0.left_cancellation _ _ (hw.trans comp_zero.symm)
    have hP1 : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) S.X₂ (0 + 1)) :=
      Quillen.R_iso R n (Quillen.twistZeroIso R n _ ≪≫ eP.symm) (0 + 1)
        (Quillen.pullback_vanishing R n S.X₃ hF hreg 0 0 (Or.inl (by omega)))
    have h1 : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) S.X₁ (0 + 1)) :=
      (affineLocalLongExactSheafification₃_exact (toSpec R n) S hS 0).isZero_of_both_zeros
        hδ (hP1.eq_of_tgt _ _)
    rw [Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero]
    exact Quillen.R_iso R n (Quillen.twistZeroIso R n _).symm _ h1
  · let N := projectiveTwistingSheaf R n (-((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))
    have hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) N := projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n _
    haveI := tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits (space R n) N hN
    haveI := tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits (space R n) N hN
    let S' := S.map (tensorSheafRightFunctor (space R n) N)
    have hS' : S'.ShortExact := hS.map_of_exact _
    have h1 := hreg (k + 1) (by omega)
    rw [zero_sub] at h1
    have h1' : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) S'.X₃ (k + 1)) :=
      h1
    have h3 : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) S'.X₂
        (k + 1 + 1)) :=
      Quillen.R_iso R n (tensorSheafMapIso (space R n) eP.symm (Iso.refl N)) (k + 1 + 1)
        (Quillen.pullback_vanishing R n S.X₃ hF hreg (k + 1) (-((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (by omega))
    exact (affineLocalLongExactSheafification₃_exact (toSpec R n) S' hS' (k + 1)).isZero_of_both_zeros
      (h1'.eq_of_src _ _) (h3.eq_of_tgt _ _)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.epi_of_restrict
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.epi_of_restrict {Y : Scheme.{u}} {A B : Y.Modules} (f : A ⟶ B) {ι : Type*}
    (Z : ι → Scheme.{u}) (j : ∀ k, Z k ⟶ Y) [∀ k, IsOpenImmersion (j k)]
    (hcov : ∀ y : Y, ∃ k, ∃ z : Z k, j k z = y)
    (hf : ∀ k, Epi ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (j k)).map f)) : Epi f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro T g h hcomp
  have hloc : ∀ k, (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (j k)).map g =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (j k)).map h := by
    intro k
    haveI := hf k
    rw [← cancel_epi ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (j k)).map f), ← Functor.map_comp,
      ← Functor.map_comp, hcomp]
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro V
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro b
  let U : ι → Y.Opens := fun k ↦ j k ''ᵁ (j k ⁻¹ᵁ V.unop)
  have hcover : V.unop ≤ ⨆ k, U k := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨k, z, rfl⟩ := hcov y
    refine TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨k, ?_⟩
    change j k z ∈ ((j k ''ᵁ (j k ⁻¹ᵁ V.unop) : Y.Opens) : Set Y)
    rw [Scheme.Hom.coe_image]
    exact ⟨z, hy, rfl⟩
  apply TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq'
    (⟨T.presheaf, T.isSheaf⟩ : TopCat.Sheaf Ab Y)
    U V.unop (fun k => homOfLE ((j k).image_preimage_le V.unop)) hcover
  intro k
  change
    T.val.map (homOfLE ((j k).image_preimage_le V.unop)).op (g.val.app V b) =
      T.val.map (homOfLE ((j k).image_preimage_le V.unop)).op (h.val.app V b)
  rw [← PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply g.val]
  rw [← PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply h.val]
  have hi := congrArg (fun q => q.val.app (op (j k ⁻¹ᵁ V.unop))) (hloc k)
  exact CategoryTheory.congr_fun hi
    (B.presheaf.map (homOfLE ((j k).image_preimage_le V.unop)).op b)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.counit_fac
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.counit_fac {Lp : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒴} {Rp : 𝒴 ⥤ 𝒳} (adjp : Lp ⊣ Rp)
    {Lπ : 𝒜 ⥤ ℬ} {Rπ : ℬ ⥤ 𝒜} (adjπ : Lπ ⊣ Rπ)
    (A : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒜) (Ψ : 𝒴 ⥤ ℬ) (BC : Rp ⋙ A ≅ Ψ ⋙ Rπ) (F : 𝒴) :
    (adjπ.homEquiv (A.obj (Rp.obj F)) (Ψ.obj (Lp.obj (Rp.obj F)))).symm
        (A.map (adjp.unit.app (Rp.obj F)) ≫ BC.hom.app (Lp.obj (Rp.obj F))) ≫
        Ψ.map (adjp.counit.app F) =
      Lπ.map (BC.hom.app F) ≫ adjπ.counit.app (Ψ.obj F)
proof:
:= by
  have hnat : A.map (Rp.map (adjp.counit.app F)) ≫ BC.hom.app F =
      BC.hom.app (Lp.obj (Rp.obj F)) ≫ Rπ.map (Ψ.map (adjp.counit.app F)) :=
    BC.hom.naturality (adjp.counit.app F)
  have htri : adjp.unit.app (Rp.obj F) ≫ Rp.map (adjp.counit.app F) = 𝟙 (Rp.obj F) :=
    adjp.right_triangle_components F
  have key : (A.map (adjp.unit.app (Rp.obj F)) ≫ BC.hom.app (Lp.obj (Rp.obj F))) ≫
      Rπ.map (Ψ.map (adjp.counit.app F)) = BC.hom.app F := by
    rw [Category.assoc, ← hnat, ← Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, htri]
    exact (congrArg (· ≫ BC.hom.app F) (A.map_id (Rp.obj F))).trans (Category.id_comp _)
  have h1 := adjπ.homEquiv_naturality_right_symm
    (A.map (adjp.unit.app (Rp.obj F)) ≫ BC.hom.app (Lp.obj (Rp.obj F)))
    (Ψ.map (adjp.counit.app F))
  have h2 := adjπ.homEquiv_counit (g := BC.hom.app F)
  exact h1.symm.trans ((congrArg (adjπ.homEquiv _ _).symm key).trans h2)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.epi_of_counit_fac
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.epi_of_counit_fac {Lp : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒴} {Rp : 𝒴 ⥤ 𝒳} (adjp : Lp ⊣ Rp)
    {Lπ : 𝒜 ⥤ ℬ} {Rπ : ℬ ⥤ 𝒜} (adjπ : Lπ ⊣ Rπ)
    (A : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒜) (Ψ : 𝒴 ⥤ ℬ) (BC : Rp ⋙ A ≅ Ψ ⋙ Rπ) (F : 𝒴)
    (h : Epi (adjπ.counit.app (Ψ.obj F))) : Epi (Ψ.map (adjp.counit.app F))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIso (BC.hom.app F) := (BC.app F).isIso_hom
  have hE : Epi (Lπ.map (BC.hom.app F) ≫ adjπ.counit.app (Ψ.obj F)) :=
    @epi_comp _ _ _ _ _ (Lπ.map (BC.hom.app F)) inferInstance (adjπ.counit.app (Ψ.obj F)) h
  exact @epi_of_epi_fac _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hE (BundleRegularity.counit_fac adjp adjπ A Ψ BC F)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.pushforward_restrict_counit_epi
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.pushforward_restrict_counit_epi {Lp : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒴} {Rp : 𝒴 ⥤ 𝒳} (adjp : Lp ⊣ Rp)
    {Rπ : ℬ ⥤ 𝒜} (A : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒜) (Ψ : 𝒴 ⥤ ℬ) (BC : Rp ⋙ A ≅ Ψ ⋙ Rπ) (F : 𝒴) :
    Epi (Rπ.map (Ψ.map (adjp.counit.app F)))
proof:
:= by
  have hnat : A.map (Rp.map (adjp.counit.app F)) ≫ BC.hom.app F =
      BC.hom.app (Lp.obj (Rp.obj F)) ≫ Rπ.map (Ψ.map (adjp.counit.app F)) :=
    BC.hom.naturality (adjp.counit.app F)
  have htri : adjp.unit.app (Rp.obj F) ≫ Rp.map (adjp.counit.app F) = 𝟙 (Rp.obj F) :=
    adjp.right_triangle_components F
  have hs : A.map (adjp.unit.app (Rp.obj F)) ≫ A.map (Rp.map (adjp.counit.app F)) =
      𝟙 (A.obj (Rp.obj F)) := by
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, htri]
    exact A.map_id _
  have hA : Epi (A.map (Rp.map (adjp.counit.app F))) :=
    @epi_of_epi_fac _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (IsIso.epi_of_iso (𝟙 (A.obj (Rp.obj F)))) hs
  haveI : IsIso (BC.hom.app F) := (BC.app F).isIso_hom
  have hE : Epi (A.map (Rp.map (adjp.counit.app F)) ≫ BC.hom.app F) :=
    @epi_comp _ _ _ _ _ _ hA _ inferInstance
  exact @epi_of_epi_fac _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hE hnat.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twist_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem twist_isFiniteLocallyFree (G : C.scheme.Modules)
    (hG : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme G) (d : ℤ) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme (twist C G d)
proof:
:=
  tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme G _ hG (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree d)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.hrank
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.hrank (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) (i : C.I) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := C.basisIndex_finite i
  obtain ⟨k, ⟨e⟩⟩ := Finite.exists_equiv_fin (C.basisIndex i)
  obtain ⟨a⟩ := hpos i
  have hk : 0 < k := Fin.pos (e a)
  exact ⟨k - 1, ⟨e.trans (finCongr (by omega))⟩⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.chart_isZero
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.chart_isZero [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (i : C.I) {n : ℕ}
    (e : C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1)) (G : C.scheme.Modules)
    (hG : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme G) (k : ℕ)
    (h : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification C.toBase G k)) :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n)
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e)).obj G) k)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, C.U i) :=
    IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨C.U i, C.isAffine i⟩
  have hM := BundleRegularity.restrict_isFiniteLocallyFree (standardChartEmb C i e) G hG
  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e)).obj
    G).IsFinitePresentation := hM.isFinitePresentation
  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e)).obj
    G).IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  exact SchemeProjectiveSpace.RegularityChart.isZero_of_topH _ n _ k (BundleRegularity.chart_topH_subsingleton C i e G k h)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.isZero_of_chart
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.isZero_of_chart [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    (G : C.scheme.Modules) (hG : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme G) (k : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ (i : C.I) (n : ℕ) (e : C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1)),
      IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n)
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e)).obj G) k)) :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification C.toBase G k)
proof:
:= by
  choose nr er using BundleRegularity.hrank C hpos
  let B : Set X.Opens := {V | ∃ i, ∃ g : Γ(X, C.U i), X.basicOpen g = V}
  have hB : TopologicalSpace.Opens.IsBasis B := by
    rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd]
    intro W x hx
    have hx' : x ∈ (⨆ i, C.U i : X.Opens) := by
      rw [C.covers]
      trivial
    obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.1 hx'
    obtain ⟨g, hgW, hxg⟩ := (C.isAffine i).exists_basicOpen_le ⟨x, hx⟩ hxi
    exact ⟨X.basicOpen g, ⟨i, g, rfl⟩, hxg, hgW⟩
  refine affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_isZero_of_isBasis _ _ _ hB ?_
  rintro V ⟨i, g, rfl⟩
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, C.U i) :=
    IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨C.U i, C.isAffine i⟩
  let e := (er i).some
  let ψ := standardChartEmb C i e
  let M := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ψ).obj G
  have hM := BundleRegularity.restrict_isFiniteLocallyFree ψ G hG
  haveI : M.IsFinitePresentation := hM.isFinitePresentation
  haveI : M.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  have h0 := SchemeProjectiveSpace.RegularityChart.basicOpenH_of_isZero Γ(X, C.U i) (nr i) M k (h i (nr i) e) g
  let W := SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) (nr i) ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g
  refine BundleRegularity.H_transfer C.toBase (X.basicOpen g) (W.ι ≫ ψ)
    (standardChartEmb_opensRange C i e g) G k ?_
  let c : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (W.ι ≫ ψ)).obj G ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj M :=
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp W.ι ψ).app G
  let E' := (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.functorH _ k).mapIso
    ((Modules.toSheafAb W.toScheme).mapIso c)
  exact @Equiv.subsingleton _ _ E'.addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv.toEquiv h0

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.chartRegular
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.chartRegular [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (i : C.I) {n : ℕ}
    (e : C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1)) (F : C.scheme.Modules)
    (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme F) (m : ℤ) (hreg : IsMumfordRegular C F m) :
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.IsMumfordRegular Γ(X, C.U i) n
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e)).obj F) m
proof:
:= fun q hq ↦
  SchemeProjectiveSpace.Quillen.R_iso _ n (BundleRegularity.twistIso C i e F (m - q)) q
    (BundleRegularity.chart_isZero C i e _ (twist_isFiniteLocallyFree C F hF _) q (hreg q hq))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.regular_of_chart
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.regular_of_chart [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    (F : C.scheme.Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme F) (m : ℤ)
    (h : ∀ (i : C.I) (n : ℕ) (e : C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1)),
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.IsMumfordRegular Γ(X, C.U i) n
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e)).obj F) m) :
    IsMumfordRegular C F m
proof:
:= fun q hq ↦
  BundleRegularity.isZero_of_chart C hpos _ (twist_isFiniteLocallyFree C F hF _) q
    (fun i n e ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.Quillen.R_iso _ n (BundleRegularity.twistIso C i e F (m - q)).symm q (h i n e q hq))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.isMumfordRegular_succ
statement:
theorem isMumfordRegular_succ [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) (F : C.scheme.Modules)
    (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme F) (m : ℤ) (hreg : IsMumfordRegular C F m) :
    IsMumfordRegular C F (m + 1)
proof:
:=
  BundleRegularity.regular_of_chart C hpos F hF (m + 1) fun i n e ↦
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.isMumfordRegular_succ _ n _ (BundleRegularity.restrict_isFiniteLocallyFree _ F hF) m
      (BundleRegularity.chartRegular C i e F hF m hreg)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.restrict_counit_epi
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.restrict_counit_epi [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (i : C.I) {n : ℕ}
    (e : C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1)) (F : C.scheme.Modules)
    (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme F) (hreg : IsMumfordRegular C F 0) :
    Epi ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e)).map (quillenCounit C F))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, C.U i) :=
    IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨C.U i, C.isAffine i⟩
  exact BundleRegularity.epi_of_counit_fac (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction C.toBase)
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n))
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.isAffine i).fromSpec)
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e)) (BundleRegularity.BC C i e) F
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.epi_counit_of_isMumfordRegular Γ(X, C.U i) n _ (BundleRegularity.restrict_isFiniteLocallyFree _ F hF)
      (BundleRegularity.chartRegular C i e F hF 0 hreg))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.epi_counit_of_isMumfordRegular
statement:
theorem epi_counit_of_isMumfordRegular [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    (F : C.scheme.Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme F)
    (hreg : IsMumfordRegular C F 0) :
    Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction C.toBase).counit.app F)
proof:
:= by
  choose nr er using BundleRegularity.hrank C hpos
  refine BundleRegularity.epi_of_restrict _ (fun i ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.space Γ(X, C.U i) (nr i))
    (fun i ↦ standardChartEmb C i (er i).some) ?_
    (fun i ↦ BundleRegularity.restrict_counit_epi C i (er i).some F hF hreg)
  intro x
  have hx : C.toBase x ∈ (⨆ i, C.U i : X.Opens) := by
    rw [C.covers]
    trivial
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.1 hx
  have hx' : x ∈ ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) (nr i) ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤).ι ≫
      standardChartEmb C i (er i).some).opensRange := by
    rw [standardChartEmb_opensRange_top]
    exact hi
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hx'
  exact ⟨i, (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) (nr i) ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤).ι w,
    by rw [← hw, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.higherDirectImage_isZero_of_isMumfordRegular
statement:
theorem higherDirectImage_isZero_of_isMumfordRegular [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    (F : C.scheme.Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme F)
    (hreg : IsMumfordRegular C F 0) (q : ℕ) :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification C.toBase F (q + 1))
proof:
:=
  BundleRegularity.isZero_of_chart C hpos F hF (q + 1) fun i n e ↦
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.higherDirectImage_isZero_of_isMumfordRegular _ n _ (BundleRegularity.restrict_isFiniteLocallyFree _ F hF)
      (BundleRegularity.chartRegular C i e F hF 0 hreg) q

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.chart_kernel_isRegular
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.chart_kernel_isRegular [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (i : C.I) {n : ℕ}
    (e : C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1)) (F : C.scheme.Modules)
    (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme F) (hreg : IsMumfordRegular C F 0)
    (hS : (quillenCounitSeq C F).ShortExact) :
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.IsMumfordRegular Γ(X, C.U i) n
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.moduleTwist Γ(X, C.U i) n ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e)).obj
        (kernel (quillenCounit C F))) 1) 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, C.U i) :=
    IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨C.U i, C.isAffine i⟩
  let Si := (quillenCounitSeq C F).map (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e))
  have hSi : Si.ShortExact := hS.map_of_exact _
  have hR0 : Epi ((affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n) 0).map Si.g) :=
    (SchemeRelativeRiemannRoch.epi_affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor_zero_map_iff _ Si.g).2
      (BundleRegularity.pushforward_restrict_counit_epi (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction C.toBase)
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.isAffine i).fromSpec)
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e)) (BundleRegularity.BC C i e) F)
  have hvan := SchemeProjectiveSpace.RegularityChart.chart_kernel_vanishing Γ(X, C.U i) n Si hSi
    (BundleRegularity.restrict_isFiniteLocallyFree _ F hF) (BundleRegularity.chartRegular C i e F hF 0 hreg)
    (BundleRegularity.pullbackPushforwardChartIso C i e F) hR0
  intro q hq
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, q = j + 1 := ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩
  have e' := SchemeProjectiveSpace.moduleTwistTwistIso Γ(X, C.U i) n Si.X₁ 1 (0 - ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))
    (-(j : ℤ)) (by push_cast; ring)
  exact SchemeProjectiveSpace.Quillen.R_iso _ n e'.symm (j + 1) (hvan j)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.quillenCounit_kernel_spec
statement:
theorem quillenCounit_kernel_spec [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    (F : C.scheme.Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme F)
    (hreg : IsMumfordRegular C F 0) :
    (quillenCounitSeq C F).ShortExact ∧
      IsFiniteLocallyFree X ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.toBase).obj F) ∧
      IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.toBase).obj F)) ∧
      IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme (kernel (quillenCounit C F)) ∧
      IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme (twist C (kernel (quillenCounit C F)) 1) ∧
      IsMumfordRegular C (twist C (kernel (quillenCounit C F)) 1) 0
proof:
:= by
  have hε : Epi (quillenCounit C F) := epi_counit_of_isMumfordRegular C hpos F hF hreg
  have hS : (quillenCounitSeq C F).ShortExact := by
    haveI := hε
    exact { exact := ShortComplex.exact_kernel _ }
  have hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree X ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.toBase).obj F) :=
    pushforward_isFiniteLocallyFree C hpos F hF (higherDirectImage_isZero_of_isMumfordRegular C hpos F hF hreg)
  have hP : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.toBase).obj F)) :=
    pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global C.toBase _ hV
  have hZ : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme (kernel (quillenCounit C F)) := by
    haveI := hε
    exact SchemeKTheory.isFiniteLocallyFree_kernel _ hP hF _
  have hZ1 := twist_isFiniteLocallyFree C _ hZ 1
  refine ⟨hS, hV, hP, hZ, hZ1, ?_⟩
  refine BundleRegularity.regular_of_chart C hpos _ hZ1 0 fun i n e ↦ ?_
  exact SchemeProjectiveSpace.RegularityChart.isRegular_iso _ n (BundleRegularity.twistIso C i e _ 1).symm 0
    (BundleRegularity.chart_kernel_isRegular C i e F hF hreg hS)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.resolutionTerm_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.resolutionTerm_isFiniteLocallyFree (T : X.Modules) (hT : IsFiniteLocallyFree X T)
    (d : ℤ) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme
      (tensorSheaf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj T)
        (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf d))
proof:
:=
  tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme _ _ (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global _ T hT)
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree d)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.classOf_resolutionTerm
statement:
theorem BundleRegularity.classOf_resolutionTerm [Flat C.toBase] (T : X.Modules)
    (hT : IsFiniteLocallyFree X T) (d : ℤ) :
    k0ClassOf C.scheme
        (tensorSheaf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj T)
          (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf d))
        (BundleRegularity.resolutionTerm_isFiniteLocallyFree C T hT d) =
      flatPullbackK0RingHom C.toBase (k0ClassOf X T hT) * C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class d
proof:
:= by
  have hpb : flatPullbackK0RingHom C.toBase (k0ClassOf X T hT) =
      k0ClassOf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj T)
        (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global _ T hT) := by
    rw [flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply, flatPullbackK0_classOf]
  rw [hpb]
  exact (k0ClassOf_mul C.scheme ⟨_, pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global _ T hT⟩
    ⟨C.canonicalTwistingSheaf d, C.canonicalTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree d⟩).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.classOf_eq_sum_of_resolution
statement:
theorem classOf_eq_sum_of_resolution (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) (r : ℕ)
    (F : C.scheme.Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme F)
    (T : ℕ → X.Modules) (hT : ∀ i, IsFiniteLocallyFree X (T i))
    (Z : ℕ → C.scheme.Modules) (hZ : ∀ i, IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme (Z i))
    (hS : ∀ i, i < r → ∃ (f : Z (i + 1) ⟶
        tensorSheaf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj (T i))
          (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (-(i : ℤ))))
      (g : tensorSheaf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj (T i))
          (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (-(i : ℤ))) ⟶ Z i)
      (w : f ≫ g = 0), (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact)
    (e0 : Z 0 ≅ F) (hZr : IsZero (Z r)) :
    letI : Flat C.toBase
proof:
:= C.toBase_flat hpos
    k0ClassOf C.scheme F hF =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range r, (-1 : K0 C.scheme) ^ i *
        (flatPullbackK0RingHom C.toBase (k0ClassOf X (T i) (hT i)) *
          C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-(i : ℤ))) := by
  letI : Flat C.toBase := C.toBase_flat hpos
  rw [← k0ClassOf_iso C.scheme (hZ 0) hF e0,
    SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf_eq_alternating_sum C.scheme _ Z
      (fun i ↦ BundleRegularity.resolutionTerm_isFiniteLocallyFree C (T i) (hT i) (-(i : ℤ))) hZ r hS hZr]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
  rw [BundleRegularity.classOf_resolutionTerm C]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.classOf_mem_span_of_resolution
statement:
theorem classOf_mem_span_of_resolution (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) (r : ℕ)
    (F : C.scheme.Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme F)
    (T : ℕ → X.Modules) (hT : ∀ i, IsFiniteLocallyFree X (T i))
    (Z : ℕ → C.scheme.Modules) (hZ : ∀ i, IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme (Z i))
    (hS : ∀ i, i < r → ∃ (f : Z (i + 1) ⟶
        tensorSheaf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj (T i))
          (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (-(i : ℤ))))
      (g : tensorSheaf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj (T i))
          (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (-(i : ℤ))) ⟶ Z i)
      (w : f ≫ g = 0), (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact)
    (e0 : Z 0 ≅ F) (hZr : IsZero (Z r)) :
    letI : Flat C.toBase
proof:
:= C.toBase_flat hpos
    letI := (flatPullbackK0RingHom C.toBase).toAlgebra
    k0ClassOf C.scheme F hF ∈ Submodule.span (K0 X)
      (Set.range fun i : Fin r ↦ C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-(i : ℤ))) := by
  letI : Flat C.toBase := C.toBase_flat hpos
  letI := (flatPullbackK0RingHom C.toBase).toAlgebra
  rw [classOf_eq_sum_of_resolution C hpos r F hF T hT Z hZ hS e0 hZr, Finset.sum_range]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ ?_
  have hmem := Submodule.smul_mem (Submodule.span (K0 X)
      (Set.range fun i : Fin r ↦ C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-(i : ℤ))))
    ((-1 : K0 X) ^ (i : ℕ) * k0ClassOf X (T i) (hT i))
    (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  rw [Algebra.smul_def, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, map_one,
    mul_assoc] at hmem
  exact hmem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.sectionOverTrivializationCoefficient_isRegular
statement:
theorem sectionOverTrivializationCoefficient_isRegular {X : Scheme.{u}} {L : X.Modules}
    (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (hσ : SectionIsRegular σ) (U : X.affineOpens)
    (e : L.over U.1 ≅ (tensorUnitSheaf X).over U.1) :
    IsRegular (sectionOverTrivializationCoefficient σ U.1 e)
proof:
:= by
  let eU : (L.val.obj (op U.1)) ≃ₗ[Γ(X,U)] Γ(X,U) :=
    ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (X.ringCatSheaf.over U.1)
      (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U.1)))).mapIso e).toLinearEquiv
  have hc : sectionOverTrivializationCoefficient σ U.1 e =
      eU (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ U (1 : Γ(X,U))) := rfl
  have key : ∀ r : Γ(X,U), r * sectionOverTrivializationCoefficient σ U.1 e = 0 → r = 0 := by
    intro r hr
    apply hσ U r
    apply eU.injective
    refine (eU.map_smul r _).trans (hr.trans (map_zero eU).symm)
  constructor
  · intro a b h
    have h' : (a - b) * sectionOverTrivializationCoefficient σ U.1 e = 0 := by
      rw [sub_mul]; exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (by simpa [mul_comm] using h)
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (key _ h')
  · intro a b h
    have h' : (a - b) * sectionOverTrivializationCoefficient σ U.1 e = 0 := by
      rw [sub_mul]; exact sub_eq_zero.mpr h
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (key _ h')

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.map_invOfUnit
statement:
theorem map_invOfUnit (φ : A →+* B) (f : PowerSeries A) (hf : PowerSeries.constantCoeff f = 1) :
    PowerSeries.map φ (PowerSeries.invOfUnit f 1) =
      PowerSeries.invOfUnit (PowerSeries.map φ f) 1
proof:
:= by
  have hf' : PowerSeries.constantCoeff f = ((1 : Aˣ) : A) := by simpa using hf
  have h1 : PowerSeries.invOfUnit f 1 * f = 1 := PowerSeries.invOfUnit_mul f 1 hf'
  have hmf : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (PowerSeries.map φ f) = ((1 : Bˣ) : B) := by
    rw [← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, PowerSeries.coeff_map,
      PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, hf]
    simp
  have h2 := PowerSeries.mul_invOfUnit (PowerSeries.map φ f) 1 hmf
  calc PowerSeries.map φ (PowerSeries.invOfUnit f 1)
      = PowerSeries.map φ (PowerSeries.invOfUnit f 1) *
          (PowerSeries.map φ f * PowerSeries.invOfUnit (PowerSeries.map φ f) 1) := by
        rw [h2, mul_one]
    _ = (PowerSeries.map φ (PowerSeries.invOfUnit f 1) * PowerSeries.map φ f) *
          PowerSeries.invOfUnit (PowerSeries.map φ f) 1 := by rw [mul_assoc]
    _ = PowerSeries.invOfUnit (PowerSeries.map φ f) 1 := by
        rw [← map_mul, h1, map_one, one_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.psumG_map
statement:
theorem psumG_map (φ : A →ₐ[ℚ] B) (c : ℕ → A) (hc : c 0 = 1) (n : ℕ) :
    φ (psumG c n) = psumG (fun i ↦ φ (c i)) n
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => simp [psumG]
  | succ m =>
    have hc0 : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (PowerSeries.mk c) = 1 := by
      rw [← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, hc]
    have hmk : PowerSeries.map (φ : A →+* B) (PowerSeries.mk c) =
        PowerSeries.mk (fun i ↦ φ (c i)) := by
      ext i; simp
    have hdk : PowerSeries.map (φ : A →+* B)
        (PowerSeries.mk (fun n ↦ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) • c (n + 1))) =
        PowerSeries.mk (fun n ↦ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) • φ (c (n + 1))) := by
      ext i; simp
    have hinv := map_invOfUnit (φ : A →+* B) (PowerSeries.mk c) hc0
    rw [hmk] at hinv
    simp only [psumG, map_smul]
    congr 1
    have := congrArg (PowerSeries.coeff m)
      (map_mul (PowerSeries.map (φ : A →+* B))
        (PowerSeries.mk (fun n ↦ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) • c (n + 1)))
        (PowerSeries.invOfUnit (PowerSeries.mk c) 1))
    rw [PowerSeries.coeff_map, hdk, hinv] at this
    exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.chG_map
statement:
theorem chG_map (φ : A →ₐ[ℚ] B) (r : ℕ) (c : ℕ → A) (hc : c 0 = 1) (n : ℕ) :
    φ (chG r c n) = chG r (fun i ↦ φ (c i)) n
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => simp [chG]
  | succ m => simp only [chG, map_smul, psumG_map φ c hc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.tdG_map
statement:
theorem tdG_map (φ : A →ₐ[ℚ] B) (c : ℕ → A) (hc : c 0 = 1) (m : ℕ) :
    φ (tdG c m) = tdG (fun i ↦ φ (c i)) m
proof:
:= by
  have hser : PowerSeries.map (φ : A →+* B) (PowerSeries.mk fun n ↦ toddLogCoeff n • psumG c n) =
      PowerSeries.mk fun n ↦ toddLogCoeff n • psumG (fun i ↦ φ (c i)) n := by
    ext i; simp [psumG_map φ c hc]
  unfold tdG
  rw [map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
  rw [map_smul]
  congr 1
  rw [← hser, ← map_pow, PowerSeries.coeff_map]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.natCast_succ_mul_inv
statement:
theorem natCast_succ_mul_inv (n : ℕ) :
    ((n : K) + 1) * algebraMap ℚ K (1 / ((n : ℚ) + 1)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : ((n : ℚ) + 1) * (1 / ((n : ℚ) + 1)) = 1 := by field_simp
  have h2 := congrArg (algebraMap ℚ K) h
  rw [map_mul, map_add, map_natCast, map_one] at h2
  exact h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.mk_succ_smul_eq_derivative

theorem mk_succ_smul_eq_derivative (c : ℕ → K) :
    PowerSeries.mk (fun n ↦ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) • c (n + 1)) =
      PowerSeries.derivative K (PowerSeries.mk c)
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_derivative, PowerSeries.coeff_mk,
    Algebra.smul_def, map_natCast]
