  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.psumG_succ_comm
statement:
theorem psumG_succ_comm (c : ℕ → K) (m : ℕ) :
    psumG c (m + 1) = ((-1 : ℚ) ^ m) • PowerSeries.coeff m
      (PowerSeries.derivative K (PowerSeries.mk c) *
        PowerSeries.invOfUnit (PowerSeries.mk c) 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [psumG, mk_succ_smul_eq_derivative]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.invOfUnit_mul_series
statement:
theorem invOfUnit_mul_series (f g : PowerSeries K) (hf : PowerSeries.constantCoeff f = 1)
    (hg : PowerSeries.constantCoeff g = 1) :
    PowerSeries.invOfUnit (f * g) 1 =
      PowerSeries.invOfUnit f 1 * PowerSeries.invOfUnit g 1
proof:
:= by
  have hfg : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (f * g) = ((1 : Kˣ) : K) := by simp [hf, hg]
  have hf' : PowerSeries.constantCoeff f = ((1 : Kˣ) : K) := by simpa using hf
  have hg' : PowerSeries.constantCoeff g = ((1 : Kˣ) : K) := by simpa using hg
  have h1 := PowerSeries.mul_invOfUnit (f * g) 1 hfg
  have h2 := PowerSeries.mul_invOfUnit f 1 hf'
  have h3 := PowerSeries.mul_invOfUnit g 1 hg'
  calc PowerSeries.invOfUnit (f * g) 1
      = PowerSeries.invOfUnit (f * g) 1 *
          ((f * g) * (PowerSeries.invOfUnit f 1 * PowerSeries.invOfUnit g 1)) := by
        have : (f * g) * (PowerSeries.invOfUnit f 1 * PowerSeries.invOfUnit g 1) = 1 := by
          calc (f * g) * (PowerSeries.invOfUnit f 1 * PowerSeries.invOfUnit g 1)
              = (f * PowerSeries.invOfUnit f 1) * (g * PowerSeries.invOfUnit g 1) := by ring
            _ = 1 := by rw [h2, h3, mul_one]
        rw [this, mul_one]
    _ = ((f * g) * PowerSeries.invOfUnit (f * g) 1) *
          (PowerSeries.invOfUnit f 1 * PowerSeries.invOfUnit g 1) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [h1, one_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.logDer_mul
statement:
theorem logDer_mul (f g : PowerSeries K) (hf : PowerSeries.constantCoeff f = 1)
    (hg : PowerSeries.constantCoeff g = 1) :
    PowerSeries.derivative K (f * g) * PowerSeries.invOfUnit (f * g) 1 =
      PowerSeries.derivative K f * PowerSeries.invOfUnit f 1 +
        PowerSeries.derivative K g * PowerSeries.invOfUnit g 1
proof:
:= by
  have hf' : PowerSeries.constantCoeff f = ((1 : Kˣ) : K) := by simpa using hf
  have hg' : PowerSeries.constantCoeff g = ((1 : Kˣ) : K) := by simpa using hg
  have h2 := PowerSeries.mul_invOfUnit f 1 hf'
  have h3 := PowerSeries.mul_invOfUnit g 1 hg'
  rw [invOfUnit_mul_series f g hf hg, Derivation.leibniz]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  linear_combination (PowerSeries.derivative K f * PowerSeries.invOfUnit f 1) * h3 +
    (PowerSeries.derivative K g * PowerSeries.invOfUnit g 1) * h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.mk_conv
statement:
theorem mk_conv (cA cD cB : ℕ → K)
    (hB : ∀ n, cB n = ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, cA p.1 * cD p.2) :
    PowerSeries.mk cB = PowerSeries.mk cA * PowerSeries.mk cD
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_mul, hB n]
  simp [PowerSeries.coeff_mk]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.constantCoeff_mk'
statement: theorem constantCoeff_mk' (c : ℕ → K) : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (PowerSeries.mk c) = c 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.psumG_conv_comm
statement:
theorem psumG_conv_comm (cA cD cB : ℕ → K) (hA0 : cA 0 = 1) (hD0 : cD 0 = 1)
    (hB : ∀ n, cB n = ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, cA p.1 * cD p.2) (n : ℕ) :
    psumG cB n = psumG cA n + psumG cD n
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => simp [psumG]
  | succ m =>
    have hf : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (PowerSeries.mk cA) = 1 := by
      rw [constantCoeff_mk', hA0]
    have hg : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (PowerSeries.mk cD) = 1 := by
      rw [constantCoeff_mk', hD0]
    rw [psumG_succ_comm, psumG_succ_comm, psumG_succ_comm, mk_conv cA cD cB hB,
      logDer_mul _ _ hf hg, map_add, smul_add]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.chG_conv_comm
statement:
theorem chG_conv_comm (rA rD : ℕ) (cA cD cB : ℕ → K) (hA0 : cA 0 = 1) (hD0 : cD 0 = 1)
    (hB : ∀ n, cB n = ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, cA p.1 * cD p.2) (n : ℕ) :
    chG (rA + rD) cB n = chG rA cA n + chG rD cD n
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => simp [chG, add_smul]
  | succ m => simp only [chG, psumG_conv_comm cA cD cB hA0 hD0 hB, smul_add]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.hasSubst_of_const_zero
statement:
theorem hasSubst_of_const_zero (L : PowerSeries K) (hL : PowerSeries.constantCoeff L = 0) :
    PowerSeries.HasSubst L
proof:
:=
  PowerSeries.HasSubst.of_constantCoeff_zero' hL

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.coeff_pow_of_lt_of_const_zero
statement:
theorem coeff_pow_of_lt_of_const_zero (L : PowerSeries K) (hL : PowerSeries.constantCoeff L = 0)
    {m d : ℕ} (h : m < d) : PowerSeries.coeff m (L ^ d) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L₁, hL₁⟩ := PowerSeries.X_dvd_iff.mpr hL
  rw [hL₁, mul_pow, PowerSeries.coeff_X_pow_mul', if_neg (by omega)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.coeff_exp_subst
statement:
theorem coeff_exp_subst (L : PowerSeries K) (hL : PowerSeries.constantCoeff L = 0) (m : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff m ((PowerSeries.exp K).subst L) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (1 / (j.factorial : ℚ)) • PowerSeries.coeff m (L ^ j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_subst' (hasSubst_of_const_zero L hL)]
  rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ (s := Finset.range (m + 1))]
  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
    rw [PowerSeries.coeff_exp, smul_eq_mul, Algebra.smul_def]
  · intro d hd
    simp only [Function.mem_support, ne_eq] at hd
    simp only [Finset.coe_range, Set.mem_Iio]
    by_contra hlt
    exact hd (by rw [coeff_pow_of_lt_of_const_zero L hL (by omega), smul_zero])

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.constantCoeff_exp_subst
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_exp_subst (L : PowerSeries K) (hL : PowerSeries.constantCoeff L = 0) :
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff ((PowerSeries.exp K).subst L) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, coeff_exp_subst L hL]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.derivative_exp_subst
statement:
theorem derivative_exp_subst (L : PowerSeries K) (hL : PowerSeries.constantCoeff L = 0) :
    PowerSeries.derivative K ((PowerSeries.exp K).subst L) =
      (PowerSeries.exp K).subst L * PowerSeries.derivative K L
proof:
:= by
  rw [PowerSeries.derivative_subst K (hasSubst_of_const_zero L hL), PowerSeries.derivative_exp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.ode_unique
statement:
theorem ode_unique (U V M : PowerSeries K)
    (hU : PowerSeries.derivative K U = U * M) (hV : PowerSeries.derivative K V = V * M)
    (h0 : PowerSeries.constantCoeff U = PowerSeries.constantCoeff V) : U = V
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      simpa [PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply] using h0
    | succ n =>
      have e1 := congrArg (PowerSeries.coeff n) hU
      have e2 := congrArg (PowerSeries.coeff n) hV
      rw [PowerSeries.coeff_derivative, PowerSeries.coeff_mul] at e1 e2
      have hs : ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, PowerSeries.coeff p.1 U * PowerSeries.coeff p.2 M =
          ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, PowerSeries.coeff p.1 V * PowerSeries.coeff p.2 M := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp ↦ ?_
        rw [Finset.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
        rw [ih p.1 (by omega)]
      have h3 : PowerSeries.coeff (n + 1) U * ((n : K) + 1) =
          PowerSeries.coeff (n + 1) V * ((n : K) + 1) := by
        rw [e1, e2, hs]
      have hinv := natCast_succ_mul_inv (K := K) n
      calc PowerSeries.coeff (n + 1) U
          = PowerSeries.coeff (n + 1) U * (((n : K) + 1) * algebraMap ℚ K (1 / ((n : ℚ) + 1))) := by
            rw [hinv, mul_one]
        _ = (PowerSeries.coeff (n + 1) U * ((n : K) + 1)) * algebraMap ℚ K (1 / ((n : ℚ) + 1)) := by
            ring
        _ = (PowerSeries.coeff (n + 1) V * ((n : K) + 1)) * algebraMap ℚ K (1 / ((n : ℚ) + 1)) := by
            rw [h3]
        _ = PowerSeries.coeff (n + 1) V := by
            rw [mul_assoc, hinv, mul_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.exp_subst_add
statement:
theorem exp_subst_add (L₁ L₂ : PowerSeries K) (h₁ : PowerSeries.constantCoeff L₁ = 0)
    (h₂ : PowerSeries.constantCoeff L₂ = 0) :
    (PowerSeries.exp K).subst (L₁ + L₂) =
      (PowerSeries.exp K).subst L₁ * (PowerSeries.exp K).subst L₂
proof:
:= by
  have h12 : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (L₁ + L₂) = 0 := by simp [h₁, h₂]
  refine ode_unique _ _ (PowerSeries.derivative K L₁ + PowerSeries.derivative K L₂) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [derivative_exp_subst _ h12, map_add]
  · rw [Derivation.leibniz, derivative_exp_subst _ h₁, derivative_exp_subst _ h₂]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  · rw [constantCoeff_exp_subst _ h12, map_mul, constantCoeff_exp_subst _ h₁,
      constantCoeff_exp_subst _ h₂, mul_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.constantCoeff_toddLogSer
statement: theorem constantCoeff_toddLogSer (c : ℕ → K) : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (toddLogSer c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, toddLogSer, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
  simp [toddLogCoeff, psumG]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.tdG_eq_coeff_exp
statement:
theorem tdG_eq_coeff_exp (c : ℕ → K) (m : ℕ) :
    tdG c m = PowerSeries.coeff m ((PowerSeries.exp K).subst (toddLogSer c))
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_exp_subst _ (constantCoeff_toddLogSer c)]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.tdG_conv_comm
statement:
theorem tdG_conv_comm (cA cD cB : ℕ → K) (hA0 : cA 0 = 1) (hD0 : cD 0 = 1)
    (hB : ∀ n, cB n = ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, cA p.1 * cD p.2) (m : ℕ) :
    tdG cB m = ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal m, tdG cA p.1 * tdG cD p.2
proof:
:= by
  have hL : toddLogSer cB = toddLogSer cA + toddLogSer cD := by
    ext n
    simp only [toddLogSer, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, map_add, psumG_conv_comm cA cD cB hA0 hD0 hB,
      smul_add]
  have := exp_subst_add (toddLogSer cA) (toddLogSer cD) (constantCoeff_toddLogSer cA)
    (constantCoeff_toddLogSer cD)
  rw [tdG_eq_coeff_exp, hL, this, PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ ↦ ?_
  rw [tdG_eq_coeff_exp, tdG_eq_coeff_exp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.exists_comm_lift
statement:
theorem exists_comm_lift (s : Set R) (hs : ∀ a ∈ s, ∀ b ∈ s, a * b = b * a) :
    ∃ (K : Type u) (_ : CommRing K) (_ : Algebra ℚ K) (φ : K →ₐ[ℚ] R),
      Function.Injective φ ∧ ∀ a ∈ s, ∃ a', φ a' = a
proof:
:= by
  haveI := Algebra.isMulCommutative_adjoin ℚ hs
  exact ⟨Algebra.adjoin ℚ s, inferInstance, inferInstance, (Algebra.adjoin ℚ s).val,
    Subtype.val_injective, fun a ha ↦ ⟨⟨a, Algebra.subset_adjoin ha⟩, rfl⟩⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.ConvData.lift
statement:
theorem ConvData.lift {cA cD cB : ℕ → R} (h : ConvData cA cD cB) :
    ∃ (K : Type u) (_ : CommRing K) (_ : Algebra ℚ K) (φ : K →ₐ[ℚ] R) (a d b : ℕ → K),
      Function.Injective φ ∧ (∀ i, φ (a i) = cA i) ∧ (∀ i, φ (d i) = cD i) ∧ (∀ i, φ (b i) = cB i) ∧
      a 0 = 1 ∧ d 0 = 1 ∧ (∀ n, b n = ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, a p.1 * d p.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ∀ x ∈ Set.range cA ∪ Set.range cD, ∀ y ∈ Set.range cA ∪ Set.range cD,
      x * y = y * x := by
    rintro x (⟨i, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, rfl⟩) y (⟨j, rfl⟩ | ⟨j, rfl⟩)
    · exact h.AA i j
    · exact h.AD i j
    · exact (h.AD j i).symm
    · exact h.DD i j
  obtain ⟨K, _, _, φ, hinj, hl⟩ := exists_comm_lift _ hs
  choose a ha using fun i ↦ hl (cA i) (Or.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  choose d hd using fun i ↦ hl (cD i) (Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  refine ⟨K, inferInstance, inferInstance, φ, a, d,
    fun n ↦ ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, a p.1 * d p.2, hinj, ha, hd, ?_, ?_, ?_, fun n ↦ rfl⟩
  · intro n
    rw [map_sum, h.conv n]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ ↦ ?_
    rw [map_mul, ha, hd]
  · apply hinj
    rw [ha, h.A0, map_one]
  · apply hinj
    rw [hd, h.D0, map_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.ConvData.lift_apply
statement:
theorem ConvData.lift_apply (h : ConvData cA cD cB) (n : ℕ) :
    psumG cB n = psumG cA n + psumG cD n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, _, _, φ, a, d, b, hinj, ha, hd, hb, a0, d0, hconv⟩ := h.lift
  have b0 : b 0 = 1 := by simp [hconv 0, a0, d0]
  have e : ∀ (c : ℕ → K) (c' : ℕ → R), (∀ i, φ (c i) = c' i) → c 0 = 1 →
      ∀ n, φ (psumG c n) = psumG c' n := by
    intro c c' hc h0 n
    rw [psumG_map φ c h0]
    have : (fun i ↦ φ (c i)) = c' := funext hc
    rw [this]
  rw [← e b cB hb b0 n, ← e a cA ha a0 n, ← e d cD hd d0 n, ← map_add,
    psumG_conv_comm a d b a0 d0 hconv n]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.ConvData.psum
statement:
theorem ConvData.psum (h : ConvData cA cD cB) (n : ℕ) :
    psumG cB n = psumG cA n + psumG cD n
proof: := h.lift_apply n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.ConvData.ch
statement:
theorem ConvData.ch (h : ConvData cA cD cB) (rA rD : ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    chG (rA + rD) cB n = chG rA cA n + chG rD cD n
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => simp [chG, add_smul]
  | succ m => simp only [chG, h.psum, smul_add]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.ConvData.td
statement:
theorem ConvData.td (h : ConvData cA cD cB) (m : ℕ) :
    tdG cB m = ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal m, tdG cA p.1 * tdG cD p.2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, _, _, φ, a, d, b, hinj, ha, hd, hb, a0, d0, hconv⟩ := h.lift
  have b0 : b 0 = 1 := by simp [hconv 0, a0, d0]
  have e : ∀ (c : ℕ → K) (c' : ℕ → R), (∀ i, φ (c i) = c' i) → c 0 = 1 →
      ∀ n, φ (tdG c n) = tdG c' n := by
    intro c c' hc h0 n
    rw [tdG_map φ c h0]
    have : (fun i ↦ φ (c i)) = c' := funext hc
    rw [this]
  rw [← e b cB hb b0 m, tdG_conv_comm a d b a0 d0 hconv m, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ ↦ ?_
  rw [map_mul, e a cA ha a0, e d cD hd d0]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.GSer.mul
statement: theorem GSer.mul {F H : PowerSeries R} (hF : GSer 𝒢 F) (hH : GSer 𝒢 H) : GSer 𝒢 (F * H)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun p hp ↦ ?_
  have := 𝒢.mul_mem (hF p.1) (hH p.2)
  rwa [Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.GSer.one
statement: theorem GSer.one : GSer 𝒢 (1 : PowerSeries R)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_one]
  split_ifs with h
  · subst h; exact 𝒢.one_mem
  · exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.GSer.pow
statement: theorem GSer.pow {F : PowerSeries R} (hF : GSer 𝒢 F) (j : ℕ) : GSer 𝒢 (F ^ j)
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero]; exact GSer.one
  | succ j ih => rw [pow_succ]; exact ih.mul hF

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.gSer_mk
statement: theorem gSer_mk {c : ℕ → R} (hc : ∀ i, c i ∈ 𝒢.G i) : GSer 𝒢 (PowerSeries.mk c)
proof:
:= by
  intro n; rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mk]; exact hc n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.GSer.inv
statement:
theorem GSer.inv {c : ℕ → R} (hc : ∀ i, c i ∈ 𝒢.G i) :
    GSer 𝒢 (PowerSeries.invOfUnit (PowerSeries.mk c) 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    rw [PowerSeries.coeff_invOfUnit]
    split_ifs with h0
    · subst h0; simpa using 𝒢.one_mem
    · simp only [inv_one, Units.val_one, neg_mul, one_mul]
      refine Submodule.neg_mem _ (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun x hx ↦ ?_)
      split_ifs with hlt
      · have := 𝒢.mul_mem (hc x.1) (ih x.2 hlt)
        rw [Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hx] at this
        simpa only [PowerSeries.coeff_mk] using this
      · exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.coeff_mul_mem_shift
statement:
theorem coeff_mul_mem_shift {F H : PowerSeries R} (hF : ∀ n, PowerSeries.coeff n F ∈ 𝒢.G (n + 1))
    (hH : GSer 𝒢 H) (m : ℕ) : PowerSeries.coeff m (F * H) ∈ 𝒢.G (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun p hp ↦ ?_
  have := 𝒢.mul_mem (hF p.1) (hH p.2)
  have h2 : p.1 + 1 + p.2 = m + 1 := by
    have := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp
    omega
  rwa [h2] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.psumG_mem
statement: theorem psumG_mem {c : ℕ → R} (hc : ∀ i, c i ∈ 𝒢.G i) (n : ℕ) : psumG c n ∈ 𝒢.G n
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | succ m =>
    simp only [psumG]
    refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (coeff_mul_mem_shift (F := PowerSeries.mk fun n ↦
      ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) • c (n + 1)) ?_ (GSer.inv hc) m)
    intro n
    rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hc (n + 1))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.chG_mem
statement: theorem chG_mem {c : ℕ → R} (hc : ∀ i, c i ∈ 𝒢.G i) (r n : ℕ) : chG r c n ∈ 𝒢.G n
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    simp only [chG]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ 𝒢.one_mem
  | succ m => exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (psumG_mem hc _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.tdG_mem
statement: theorem tdG_mem {c : ℕ → R} (hc : ∀ i, c i ∈ 𝒢.G i) (m : ℕ) : tdG c m ∈ 𝒢.G m
proof:
:= by
  unfold tdG
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j _ ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
  refine (GSer.pow (F := PowerSeries.mk fun n ↦ toddLogCoeff n • psumG c n) ?_ j) m
  intro n
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (psumG_mem hc n)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.mem_centralizer_of_commute
statement:
theorem mem_centralizer_of_commute (hT : ∀ i, T * c i = c i * T) (i : ℕ) :
    c i ∈ (GradedFam.const (Subalgebra.centralizer ℚ {T})).G i
proof:
:= by
  show _ ∈ Subalgebra.centralizer ℚ {T}
  rw [Subalgebra.mem_centralizer_iff]
  intro z hz
  rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
  subst hz
  exact hT i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.psumG_commute
statement:
theorem psumG_commute (hT : ∀ i, T * c i = c i * T) (n : ℕ) :
    T * psumG c n = psumG c n * T
proof:
:= by
  have : psumG c n ∈ Subalgebra.centralizer ℚ {T} :=
    psumG_mem (𝒢 := GradedFam.const (Subalgebra.centralizer ℚ {T})) (mem_centralizer_of_commute c T hT) n
  rw [Subalgebra.mem_centralizer_iff] at this
  exact this T (Set.mem_singleton _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.chG_commute
statement:
theorem chG_commute (hT : ∀ i, T * c i = c i * T) (r n : ℕ) :
    T * chG r c n = chG r c n * T
proof:
:= by
  have : chG r c n ∈ Subalgebra.centralizer ℚ {T} :=
    chG_mem (𝒢 := GradedFam.const (Subalgebra.centralizer ℚ {T})) (mem_centralizer_of_commute c T hT) r n
  rw [Subalgebra.mem_centralizer_iff] at this
  exact this T (Set.mem_singleton _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.tdG_commute
statement:
theorem tdG_commute (hT : ∀ i, T * c i = c i * T) (n : ℕ) :
    T * tdG c n = tdG c n * T
proof:
:= by
  have : tdG c n ∈ Subalgebra.centralizer ℚ {T} :=
    tdG_mem (𝒢 := GradedFam.const (Subalgebra.centralizer ℚ {T})) (mem_centralizer_of_commute c T hT) n
  rw [Subalgebra.mem_centralizer_iff] at this
  exact this T (Set.mem_singleton _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.invOfUnit_mul_ring
statement:
theorem invOfUnit_mul_ring (f g : PowerSeries R) (hf : PowerSeries.constantCoeff f = 1)
    (hg : PowerSeries.constantCoeff g = 1) :
    PowerSeries.invOfUnit (f * g) 1 = PowerSeries.invOfUnit g 1 * PowerSeries.invOfUnit f 1
proof:
:= by
  have hfg : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (f * g) = ((1 : Rˣ) : R) := by simp [hf, hg]
  have hf' : PowerSeries.constantCoeff f = ((1 : Rˣ) : R) := by simpa using hf
  have hg' : PowerSeries.constantCoeff g = ((1 : Rˣ) : R) := by simpa using hg
  have h1 := PowerSeries.invOfUnit_mul (f * g) 1 hfg
  have h2 := PowerSeries.mul_invOfUnit f 1 hf'
  have h3 := PowerSeries.mul_invOfUnit g 1 hg'
  have h4 : (f * g) * (PowerSeries.invOfUnit g 1 * PowerSeries.invOfUnit f 1) = 1 := by
    rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc g, h3, one_mul, h2]
  calc PowerSeries.invOfUnit (f * g) 1
      = PowerSeries.invOfUnit (f * g) 1 *
          ((f * g) * (PowerSeries.invOfUnit g 1 * PowerSeries.invOfUnit f 1)) := by rw [h4, mul_one]
    _ = (PowerSeries.invOfUnit (f * g) 1 * (f * g)) *
          (PowerSeries.invOfUnit g 1 * PowerSeries.invOfUnit f 1) := (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = _ := by rw [h1, one_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.Inter.zero
statement: theorem Inter.zero : Inter u 0 0
proof: := by simp [Inter]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.Inter.one
statement: theorem Inter.one : Inter u 1 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [Inter, Module.End.one_eq_id]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.Inter.add
statement:
theorem Inter.add {S₁ S₂ : Module.End ℚ M} {S₁' S₂' : Module.End ℚ N}
    (h₁ : Inter u S₁ S₁') (h₂ : Inter u S₂ S₂') : Inter u (S₁ + S₂) (S₁' + S₂')
proof:
:= by
  unfold Inter at *
  rw [LinearMap.comp_add, LinearMap.add_comp, h₁, h₂]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.Inter.smul
statement:
theorem Inter.smul (q : ℚ) {S : Module.End ℚ M} {S' : Module.End ℚ N} (h : Inter u S S') :
    Inter u (q • S) (q • S')
proof:
:= by
  unfold Inter at *
  rw [LinearMap.comp_smul, LinearMap.smul_comp, h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.Inter.neg
statement:
theorem Inter.neg {S : Module.End ℚ M} {S' : Module.End ℚ N} (h : Inter u S S') :
    Inter u (-S) (-S')
proof:
:= by
  have := h.smul (-1)
  simpa using this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.Inter.mul
statement:
theorem Inter.mul {S₁ S₂ : Module.End ℚ M} {S₁' S₂' : Module.End ℚ N}
    (h₁ : Inter u S₁ S₁') (h₂ : Inter u S₂ S₂') : Inter u (S₁ * S₂) (S₁' * S₂')
proof:
:= by
  unfold Inter at *
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  have e1 := LinearMap.congr_fun h₁ (S₂ x)
  have e2 := LinearMap.congr_fun h₂ x
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Module.End.mul_apply] at e1 e2 ⊢
  rw [e1, e2]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.Inter.sum
statement:
theorem Inter.sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) {S : ι → Module.End ℚ M} {S' : ι → Module.End ℚ N}
    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, Inter u (S i) (S' i)) : Inter u (∑ i ∈ s, S i) (∑ i ∈ s, S' i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using Inter.zero
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha]
    exact (h a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)).add
      (ih fun i hi ↦ h i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.ISer.mul
statement:
theorem ISer.mul {F H : PowerSeries (Module.End ℚ M)} {F' H' : PowerSeries (Module.End ℚ N)}
    (hF : ISer u F F') (hH : ISer u H H') : ISer u (F * H) (F' * H')
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
  exact Inter.sum _ fun p _ ↦ (hF p.1).mul (hH p.2)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.ISer.one
statement: theorem ISer.one : ISer u (1 : PowerSeries (Module.End ℚ M)) (1 : PowerSeries (Module.End ℚ N))
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_one, PowerSeries.coeff_one]
  split_ifs
  · exact Inter.one
  · exact Inter.zero

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.ISer.pow
statement:
theorem ISer.pow {F : PowerSeries (Module.End ℚ M)} {F' : PowerSeries (Module.End ℚ N)}
    (hF : ISer u F F') (j : ℕ) : ISer u (F ^ j) (F' ^ j)
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, pow_zero]; exact ISer.one
  | succ j ih => rw [pow_succ, pow_succ]; exact ih.mul hF

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.iSer_mk
statement:
theorem iSer_mk {c : ℕ → Module.End ℚ M} {c' : ℕ → Module.End ℚ N}
    (hc : ∀ i, Inter u (c i) (c' i)) : ISer u (PowerSeries.mk c) (PowerSeries.mk c')
proof:
:= by
  intro n; simpa using hc n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.ISer.inv
statement:
theorem ISer.inv {c : ℕ → Module.End ℚ M} {c' : ℕ → Module.End ℚ N}
    (hc : ∀ i, Inter u (c i) (c' i)) :
    ISer u (PowerSeries.invOfUnit (PowerSeries.mk c) 1)
      (PowerSeries.invOfUnit (PowerSeries.mk c') 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    rw [PowerSeries.coeff_invOfUnit, PowerSeries.coeff_invOfUnit]
    split_ifs with h0
    · simpa using Inter.one
    · simp only [inv_one, Units.val_one, neg_mul, one_mul]
      refine Inter.neg (Inter.sum _ fun x hx ↦ ?_)
      split_ifs with hlt
      · simpa using (hc x.1).mul (ih x.2 hlt)
      · exact Inter.zero

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.psumG_inter
statement:
theorem psumG_inter {c : ℕ → Module.End ℚ M} {c' : ℕ → Module.End ℚ N}
    (hc : ∀ i, Inter u (c i) (c' i)) (n : ℕ) : Inter u (psumG c n) (psumG c' n)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact Inter.zero
  | succ m =>
    simp only [psumG]
    refine Inter.smul _ ?_
    have hd : ISer u (PowerSeries.mk (fun n ↦ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) • c (n + 1)))
        (PowerSeries.mk (fun n ↦ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) • c' (n + 1))) :=
      iSer_mk fun n ↦ (hc (n + 1)).smul _
    exact (hd.mul (ISer.inv hc)) m

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.chG_inter
statement:
theorem chG_inter {c : ℕ → Module.End ℚ M} {c' : ℕ → Module.End ℚ N}
    (hc : ∀ i, Inter u (c i) (c' i)) (r n : ℕ) : Inter u (chG r c n) (chG r c' n)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact Inter.one.smul _
  | succ m => exact (psumG_inter hc _).smul _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.tdG_inter
statement:
theorem tdG_inter {c : ℕ → Module.End ℚ M} {c' : ℕ → Module.End ℚ N}
    (hc : ∀ i, Inter u (c i) (c' i)) (m : ℕ) : Inter u (tdG c m) (tdG c' m)
proof:
:= by
  unfold tdG
  refine Inter.sum _ fun j _ ↦ Inter.smul _ ?_
  have hL : ISer u (PowerSeries.mk fun n ↦ toddLogCoeff n • psumG c n)
      (PowerSeries.mk fun n ↦ toddLogCoeff n • psumG c' n) :=
    iSer_mk fun n ↦ (psumG_inter hc n).smul _
  exact (hL.pow j) m

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D21.capCommute_of_hasAmpleGenerators
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hBg, hAg⟩ := hLa
  obtain ⟨B', hB', hB'g, hCg⟩ := hMa
  have hA : HasConstantRank X (tensorSheaf X L B) 1 := by
    have h := hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hL hB
    rwa [Nat.one_mul] at h
  have hC : HasConstantRank X (tensorSheaf X M B') 1 := by
    have h := hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hM hB'
    rwa [Nat.one_mul] at h
  have hLe : totalCap ops L hL = totalCap ops (tensorSheaf X L B) hA - totalCap ops B hB := by
    rw [totalCap_tensor ops L B hL hB hA]; abel
  have hMe : totalCap ops M hM = totalCap ops (tensorSheaf X M B') hC - totalCap ops B' hB' := by
    rw [totalCap_tensor ops M B' hM hB' hC]; abel
  exact D17.capCommute_of_sub hLe hMe
    (D18.capCommute_of_generated (k := k) ops hAg hCg)
    (D18.capCommute_of_generated (k := k) ops hAg hB'g)
    (D18.capCommute_of_generated (k := k) ops hBg hCg)
    (D18.capCommute_of_generated (k := k) ops hBg hB'g)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D21.capCommGate_of_hasAmpleGenerators
proof:
:=
  D17.capCommute_iff_gate.mp (capCommute_of_hasAmpleGenerators (k := k) ops hLa hMa)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D21.cap_comm_of_ampleScheme
statement:
theorem cap_comm_of_ampleScheme [Infinite k] (ops : ChowOps k)
    (hX : ∀ (L : X.Modules), HasConstantRank X L 1 → D19.HasAmpleGenerators L)
    (L M : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1) :
    totalCap ops L hL ∘ₗ totalCap ops M hM = totalCap ops M hM ∘ₗ totalCap ops L hL
proof:
:=
  capCommute_of_hasAmpleGenerators (k := k) ops (hX L hL) (hX M hM)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D21.allCapDescends_of_ampleClass
statement:
theorem allCapDescends_of_ampleClass [Infinite k] (h : AllAmpleIntegral k) :
    K1.AllCapDescends k
proof:
:= by
  intro X _ _ _ L hL n
  obtain ⟨hI, hA⟩ := h (X := X)
  exact D19.capDescends_of_hasAmpleGenerators (k := k) L hL (hA L hL) n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D21.allCapCommGate_of_ampleClass
statement:
theorem allCapCommGate_of_ampleClass [Infinite k] (ops : ChowOps k) (h : AllAmpleIntegral k) :
    K1.AllCapCommGate k ops
proof:
:= by
  intro X _ _ _ L M hL hM
  obtain ⟨hI, hA⟩ := h (X := X)
  exact capCommGate_of_hasAmpleGenerators (k := k) ops (hA L hL) (hA M hM)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D21.chowCompat_of_commGate
statement:
theorem chowCompat_of_commGate (ops : ChowOps k) (hcomm : K1.AllCapCommGate k ops) :
    ChowCompat ops where
  push_comp
proof:
:= by intros; exact D9.totalPush_comp ops _ _
  pull_comp := by intros; exact D2.totalPull_comp ops _ _ _ _ _ _ _
  base_change := by intros; exact D11.totalBaseChange ops _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ‹_›
  cap_pull := by intros; exact D15.cap_pull_D15 (k := k) _ _ _ _ ops
  cap_push := by intros; exact D16.cap_push_D16 (k := k) _ _ _ ops
  cap_comm := by
    intros; exact D17.cap_comm_of_gate (fun L M hL hM ↦ hcomm L M hL hM) _ _ _ _
  cap_iso := by intros; exact D13.cap_iso_D13 (k := k) ops _ _ ‹_›
  projBundle_relDim := by
    intro X _ _ _ E C e hC
    exact D11.projBundle_relDim (k := k) C hC

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D21.chowCompat_of_ampleClass
statement:
theorem chowCompat_of_ampleClass [Infinite k] (h : AllAmpleIntegral k) :
    ChowCompat (ChowOps.ofCapDescends k (allCapDescends_of_ampleClass k h))
proof:
:=
  chowCompat_of_commGate k _ (allCapCommGate_of_ampleClass k _ h)

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenChartMap_comp_chartToBase
statement:
theorem basicOpenChartMap_comp_chartToBase (U : X.affineOpens) (f : Γ(X, U.1)) :
    basicOpenChartMap I U f ≫ chartToBase I U =
      chartToBase I (X.affineBasicOpen f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← chartToOpen_comp_ι, ← chartToOpen_comp_ι, ← Category.assoc,
    (isPullback_basicOpenChartMap I U f).w, Category.assoc, Scheme.homOfLE_ι]

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.heq_chartToBase
statement:
theorem heq_chartToBase {W₁ W₂ : X.affineOpens} (hW : W₁ = W₂) :
    HEq (chartToBase I W₁) (chartToBase I W₂)
proof:
:= by
  subst hW
  rfl

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.chartIdentifications_localTransition_toBase
statement:
theorem chartIdentifications_localTransition_toBase (U V : X.affineOpens)
    (c : CommonBasicOpen U V) :
    (basicOpenOverlapCover I U V).f c ≫ overlapToChart I U V ≫ chartToBase I U =
      (chartIdentifications I).localTransition U V c ≫ overlapToChart I V U ≫ chartToBase I V
proof:
:= by
  rw [ChartIdentifications.localTransition_eq]
  unfold ChartIdentifications.targetMap ChartIdentifications.targetIso chartIdentifications
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.trans_inv, ← commonBasicOpenChartIso_hom_chartMap_assoc,
    basicOpenChartMap_comp_chartToBase, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  congr 1
  exact (eqToHom_comp_of_heq (congrArg (chart I) c.swap_affineOpen).symm
    (chartToBase I c.affineOpen) (chartToBase I c.swap.affineOpen)
    (heq_chartToBase I c.swap_affineOpen.symm)).symm

name: KSpecialization.ARRHS.lineTι_not_mem_range_infinityFibreι
statement:
theorem lineTι_not_mem_range_infinityFibreι (y : DeformationSpace.line Y) :
    lineTι Y J y ∉ Set.range (infinityFibreι Y J)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
  have h1 : totalToIntegerP1 Y J (lineTι Y J y) = totalToIntegerP1 Y J (infinityFibreι Y J c) :=
    congrArg _ hc.symm
  have h2 : totalToIntegerP1 Y J (infinityFibreι Y J c) =
      infinityPoint (infinityToInteger Y J c) := by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, (infinity_isPullback Y J).w, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  rw [h2, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, lineTι_totalToIntegerP1, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at h1
  set s := infinityToInteger Y J c with hs
  have hmem : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : integerRing)))) s ∈
      ProjectiveLine.chart integerRing 0 ⁻¹ᵁ (ProjectiveLine.chart integerRing 1).opensRange := by
    show ProjectiveLine.chart integerRing 0
      ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : integerRing)))) s) ∈
        (ProjectiveLine.chart integerRing 1).opensRange
    exact ⟨_, h1⟩
  rw [ProjectiveLine.chart_zero_preimage] at hmem
  have hmem' : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : integerRing)))) s ∈
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (Polynomial.X : integerRing[X]) : Set (PrimeSpectrum integerRing[X])) :=
    hmem
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, PrimeSpectrum.mem_basicOpen] at hmem'
  apply hmem'
  show (Polynomial.X : integerRing[X]) ∈
    (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Polynomial.evalRingHom (0 : integerRing)) (show PrimeSpectrum integerRing from s)).asIdeal
  simp [PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal, Ideal.mem_comap]

name: KSpecialization.ARRHS.generic_not_mem_range_componentToTotal
statement:
theorem generic_not_mem_range_componentToTotal (k : Type u) [CommRing k] (φ : k →+* Γ(Y, ⊤))
    [IsIntegral J.subscheme] :
    haveI
proof:
:= IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_subschemeTotalGlobal Y J
    subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J (genericPoint (subschemeTotalGlobal Y J)) ∉
      Set.range (componentToTotal Y J) := by
  haveI := IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_subschemeTotalGlobal Y J
  intro h
  obtain ⟨z0⟩ : Nonempty J.subscheme := inferInstance
  let x0 : subschemeTotalGlobal Y J :=
    subschemeTιGlobal Y J (KSpecialization.ARRG45.subS Y J k φ z0)
  have hspec : subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J (genericPoint (subschemeTotalGlobal Y J)) ⤳
      subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J x0 :=
    (genericPoint_specializes x0).map (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J).continuous
  have hE : subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J x0 ∈ Set.range (componentToTotal Y J) :=
    hspec.mem_closed (componentToTotal Y J).isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range h
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hE
  have hinf : subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J x0 ∈ Set.range (infinityFibreι Y J) :=
    ⟨componentι Y J e, by rw [← he]; rfl⟩
  have hx0 : subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J x0 =
      lineTι Y J (subschemeToLineGlobal Y J (KSpecialization.ARRG45.subS Y J k φ z0)) := by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, subschemeTιGlobal_totalGlobalι, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  rw [hx0] at hinf
  exact lineTι_not_mem_range_infinityFibreι Y J _ hinf

name: KSpecialization.ARRHS.generic_not_mem_range_otherToTotal
statement:
theorem generic_not_mem_range_otherToTotal [IsIntegral J.subscheme] :
    haveI
proof:
:= IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_subschemeTotalGlobal Y J
    subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J (genericPoint (subschemeTotalGlobal Y J)) ∉
      Set.range (otherToTotal Y J) := fun h =>
  Set.disjoint_left.mp (disjoint_range_otherToTotal_subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) h ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: KSpecialization.ARRHS.mono_pullbackSection_exceptional
statement:
theorem mono_pullbackSection_exceptional (k : Type u) [CommRing k] (φ : k →+* Γ(Y, ⊤))
    (hL : SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank (totalGlobal Y J) L 1) (hreg : SectionIsRegular σ)
    (hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = (componentToTotal Y J).ker) :
    haveI
proof:
:= IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_subschemeTotalGlobal Y J
    Mono (KSpecialization.AR7R.pullbackSection (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)
      (dualEval σ)) := by
  haveI := IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_subschemeTotalGlobal Y J
  exact mono_pullbackSection_of_ker σ (componentToTotal Y J) hL hreg hid
    (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (generic_not_mem_range_componentToTotal Y J k φ)

name: KSpecialization.ARRHS.mono_pullbackSection_strictTransform
statement:
theorem mono_pullbackSection_strictTransform
    (hL : SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank (totalGlobal Y J) L 1) (hreg : SectionIsRegular σ)
    (hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = (otherToTotal Y J).ker) :
    haveI
proof:
:= IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_subschemeTotalGlobal Y J
    Mono (KSpecialization.AR7R.pullbackSection (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)
      (dualEval σ)) := by
  haveI := IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_subschemeTotalGlobal Y J
  haveI := InfinityOtherClosedImmersion.otherToTotal_isClosedImmersion Y J
  exact mono_pullbackSection_of_ker σ (otherToTotal Y J) hL hreg hid
    (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (generic_not_mem_range_otherToTotal Y J)

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionNormalBundlePlusLineIso_fst

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionPulledBundlePlusLine_hasConstantRank
statement:

    (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) (h : LocallyFiniteWeaklyRegularFrames X E σ) :
    HasConstantRank (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ).subscheme
      (cosectionPulledBundlePlusLine X E σ) (r+1)

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionNormalCompletionIso_toCentre
statement:
theorem cosectionNormalCompletionIso_toCentre :
    (cosectionNormalCompletionIso X E σ hE h).hom ≫
      (cosectionPulledCompletionCover X E σ hE h).toBase =
    InfinityNormalBundleCover.intrinsicNormalBundleCompletionToCentre X
      (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ)
      (cosectionZeroSchemeQuasiregularCover X E σ hE h)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cosectionNormalCompletionIso, Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc,
    AffineFrameCover.transportSchemeIso_toBase, AffineFrameCover.isoOfCovers_toBase]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionNormalCompletionTwistIso_hom
statement:
theorem cosectionNormalCompletionTwistIso_hom :
    let A
proof:
:= cosectionIntrinsicCompletionCover X E σ hE h
    let B := cosectionPulledCompletionCover X E σ hE h
    let e := cosectionNormalBundlePlusLineIso X E σ h
    let D := AffineFrameCover.transport e B
    let a := AffineFrameCover.isoOfCovers A D
    let b := AffineFrameCover.transportSchemeIso e B
    (cosectionNormalCompletionTwistIso X E σ hE h).hom =
      (AffineFrameCover.pullbackTransIso a.hom b.hom (B.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback a.hom).map
          (Classical.choice (AffineFrameCover.transportTwistGlobalCompat e B)).hom ≫
        (Classical.choice (AffineFrameCover.isoOfCovers_twist_unconditional A D)).hom := rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionNormalCompletionIso_chart
statement:
theorem cosectionNormalCompletionIso_chart
    (i : (cosectionPulledCompletionCover X E σ hE h).I) :
    ((cosectionIntrinsicCompletionCover X E σ hE h).union
      (AffineFrameCover.transport (cosectionNormalBundlePlusLineIso X E σ h)
        (cosectionPulledCompletionCover X E σ hE h))).chartι (Sum.inr i) ≫
      (AffineFrameCover.isoUnionLeft (cosectionIntrinsicCompletionCover X E σ hE h)
        (AffineFrameCover.transport (cosectionNormalBundlePlusLineIso X E σ h)
          (cosectionPulledCompletionCover X E σ hE h))).inv ≫
      (cosectionNormalCompletionIso X E σ hE h).hom =
    (AffineFrameCover.chartIso (cosectionNormalBundlePlusLineIso X E σ h)
      (cosectionPulledCompletionCover X E σ hE h) i).hom ≫
      (cosectionPulledCompletionCover X E σ hE h).chartι i
proof:
:= by
  let A := cosectionIntrinsicCompletionCover X E σ hE h
  let B := cosectionPulledCompletionCover X E σ hE h
  let e := cosectionNormalBundlePlusLineIso X E σ h
  let D := AffineFrameCover.transport e B
  change (A.union D).chartι (Sum.inr i) ≫ (AffineFrameCover.isoUnionLeft A D).inv ≫
    ((AffineFrameCover.isoOfCovers A D) ≪≫ AffineFrameCover.transportSchemeIso e B).hom = _
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, AffineFrameCover.isoOfCovers, Category.assoc,
    Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, Iso.symm_hom]
  rw [← AffineFrameCover.chartι_isoUnionRight_hom A D i]
  erw [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  with_unfolding_all exact AffineFrameCover.chartι_transportSchemeHom e B i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.isAffineOpen_imgTop
statement: theorem isAffineOpen_imgTop : IsAffineOpen (ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Opens))
proof:
:=
  (isAffineOpen_top (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))).image_of_isOpenImmersion ι

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.eRing_bijective
statement: theorem eRing_bijective : Function.Bijective (eRing ι)
proof:
:= by
  have h := ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso ((ι.appIso ⊤).hom ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).hom)
  rw [Scheme.Hom.appIso_hom'] at h
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.specMap_eRing_fromSpec
statement:
theorem specMap_eRing_fromSpec :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (eRing ι)) ≫ (imgOpen ι).2.fromSpec = ι
proof:
:= by
  have h := IsAffineOpen.SpecMap_appLE_fromSpec ι (imgOpen ι).2 (isAffineOpen_top (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))
    (V := ⊤) (U := ι ''ᵁ ⊤) (by simp)
  rw [IsAffineOpen.fromSpec_top] at h
  have e1 : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (eRing ι)) = Spec.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).hom ≫
      Spec.map (Scheme.Hom.appLE ι (ι ''ᵁ ⊤) ⊤ (by simp)) := by
    rw [← Spec.map_comp]
    rfl
  rw [e1, Category.assoc, h, SpecMap_ΓSpecIso_hom]
  simp [Scheme.isoSpec]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.imgOpen_le
statement:
theorem imgOpen_le {R' : Type u} [CommRing R'] (ι' : Spec (CommRingCat.of R') ⟶ B) [IsOpenImmersion ι']
    (g : R' →+* R) (h : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom g) ≫ ι' = ι) :
    imgOpen ι ≤ imgOpen ι'
proof:
:= by
  show ι ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ ι' ''ᵁ ⊤
  rintro _ ⟨y, -, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom g) y, trivial, ?_⟩
  rw [← h]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.eRing_natural
statement:
theorem eRing_natural {R' : Type u} [CommRing R'] (ι' : Spec (CommRingCat.of R') ⟶ B)
    [IsOpenImmersion ι'] (g : R' →+* R) (h : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom g) ≫ ι' = ι) :
    (eRing ι).comp (res B (imgOpen_le ι ι' g h)) = g.comp (eRing ι')
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  have hle := imgOpen_le (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom g) ≫ ι') ι' g rfl
  have hsub : ⊤ ≤ (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom g) ≫ ι') ⁻¹ᵁ (ι' ''ᵁ ⊤) := by
    simp
  have key : B.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op ≫
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom g) ≫ ι').appLE ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom g) ≫ ι') ''ᵁ ⊤) ⊤
        (Scheme.Hom.preimage_image_eq _ _).ge ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).hom =
      ι'.appLE (ι' ''ᵁ ⊤) ⊤ (by simp) ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R')).hom ≫
        CommRingCat.ofHom g := by
    have h1 : B.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op ≫
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom g) ≫ ι').appLE ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom g) ≫ ι') ''ᵁ ⊤) ⊤
          (Scheme.Hom.preimage_image_eq _ _).ge =
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom g) ≫ ι').appLE (ι' ''ᵁ ⊤) ⊤ hsub := Scheme.Hom.map_appLE _ _ _
    rw [← Category.assoc, h1]
    have e1 : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom g) ≫ ι').appLE (ι' ''ᵁ ⊤) ⊤ hsub =
        ι'.appLE (ι' ''ᵁ ⊤) ⊤ (by simp) ≫ (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom g)).appLE ⊤ ⊤ (by simp) :=
      (Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE _ _ _ _ _ _ _).symm
    rw [e1, Category.assoc]
    congr 1
    exact Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality (CommRingCat.ofHom g)
  exact congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom key

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.isPullback_gamma
statement:
theorem isPullback_gamma :
    IsPullback (projection K) (gammaMap ι I K hK) ι (toBase B I)
proof:
:= by
  have S2 := (isPullback_affine B I (imgOpen ι)).flip
  letI : Algebra Γ(B, (imgOpen ι).1) R := (eRing ι).toAlgebra
  haveI : Module.Flat Γ(B, (imgOpen ι).1) R :=
    Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv (M := Γ(B, (imgOpen ι).1))
      (LinearEquiv.ofBijective (Algebra.linearMap Γ(B, (imgOpen ι).1) R) (eRing_bijective ι)).symm
  have S1 := isPullback_schemeMapOfEq (I.ideal (imgOpen ι)) K hK
  have S1' : IsPullback (schemeMapOfEq (I.ideal (imgOpen ι)) (eRing ι) K hK) (projection K)
      (projection (I.ideal (imgOpen ι)) ≫ (imgOpen ι).2.isoSpec.inv)
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (eRing ι)) ≫ (imgOpen ι).2.isoSpec.inv) :=
    S1.of_iso (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (imgOpen ι).2.isoSpec.symm
      (by simp; rfl) (by simp) (by simp [IsAffineOpen.isoSpec]) (by simp; rfl)
  have := S1'.paste_horiz S2
  have e : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (eRing ι)) ≫ (imgOpen ι).2.isoSpec.inv ≫ (imgOpen ι).1.ι = ι :=
    specMap_eRing_fromSpec ι
  rw [Category.assoc, e] at this
  exact this.flip

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.gammaMap_natural
statement:
theorem gammaMap_natural {R' : Type u} [CommRing R'] (ι' : Spec (CommRingCat.of R') ⟶ B)
    [IsOpenImmersion ι'] (g : R' →+* R) (h : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom g) ≫ ι' = ι)
    (K' : Ideal R') (hK' : (I.ideal (imgOpen ι')).map (eRing ι') = K')
    (hKg : K'.map g = K) :
    gammaMap ι I K hK = schemeMapOfEq K' g K hKg ≫ gammaMap ι' I K' hK'
proof:
:= by
  have hle := imgOpen_le ι ι' g h
  have hres : (I.ideal (imgOpen ι')).map (res B hle) = I.ideal (imgOpen ι) := I.map_ideal hle
  have hw : (gluingFunctor B I).map (homOfLE hle) ≫ affineι B I (imgOpen ι') =
      affineι B I (imgOpen ι) :=
    colimit.w (gluingData B I).functor (homOfLE hle)
  unfold gammaMap
  rw [← hw, ← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, gluingFunctor_map]
  rw [schemeMapOfEq_comp (I.ideal (imgOpen ι')) (res B hle) (I.ideal (imgOpen ι)) hres (eRing ι) K hK]
  rw [schemeMapOfEq_comp (I.ideal (imgOpen ι')) (eRing ι') K' hK' g K hKg]
  rw [schemeMapOfEq_congr _ (eRing_natural ι ι' g h)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.ideal_imgOpen_map
statement:
theorem ideal_imgOpen_map (I : B.IdealSheafData) :
    (I.ideal (imgOpen ι)).map (eRing ι) =
      ((I.comap ι).ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩).map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).hom.hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_comap_of_isOpenImmersion I ι ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩]
  set e : Γ(B, ι ''ᵁ ⊤) ≃+* Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of R), ⊤) := (ι.appIso ⊤).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv with he
  have h1 : (eRing ι) = ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).hom.hom).comp (e : Γ(B, ι ''ᵁ ⊤) →+* _) := by
    have := Scheme.Hom.appIso_hom' ι ⊤
    ext x
    rw [eRing, he]
    change (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).hom.hom ((ι.appLE (ι ''ᵁ ⊤) ⊤ _).hom x) = _
    rw [← this]
    rfl
  have h2 : (ι.appIso ⊤).inv.hom = (e.symm : _ →+* _) := rfl
  rw [h1, ← Ideal.map_map, h2]
  congr 1
  exact Ideal.map_comap_of_equiv e

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.comap_ideal_top_affine
statement:
theorem comap_ideal_top_affine {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] [IsAffine Y] (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (K : Y.IdealSheafData) :
    (K.comap f).ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top X⟩ = (K.ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top Y⟩).map f.appTop.hom
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · have h : K.comap f ≤ Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop ((K.ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top Y⟩).map f.appTop.hom) := by
      rw [← Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_map_iff_comap_le]
      refine Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_of_isAffine ?_
      rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_map_of_isAffineHom]
      intro x hx
      simp only [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop_ideal, Ideal.mem_comap]
      have h1 := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem f.appTop.hom hx
      have hr : ∀ y : Γ(X, ⊤), (CommRingCat.Hom.hom (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : f ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤ ≤ ⊤)).op)) y = y := by
        intro y
        have : (homOfLE (le_top : f ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤ ≤ ⊤)) = 𝟙 _ := Subsingleton.elim _ _
        rw [this]
        simp
      have h2 := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (f := CommRingCat.Hom.hom (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : f ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤ ≤ ⊤)).op)) h1
      rw [hr] at h2
      exact h2
    have h3 := h ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top X⟩
    simpa using h3
  · have h4 : K ≤ (K.comap f).map f := (Scheme.IdealSheafData.map_gc f).le_u_l K
    have h5 := h4 ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top Y⟩
    rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ideal_map_of_isAffineHom] at h5
    rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    exact h5

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.eRing_fromSpec_comp
statement:
theorem eRing_fromSpec_comp {A : Scheme.{u}} (U : A.affineOpens)
    (hle : imgOpen U.2.fromSpec ≤ U) :
    (eRing U.2.fromSpec).comp (res A hle) = RingHom.id Γ(A, U.1)
proof:
:= by
  have key : A.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op ≫
      U.2.fromSpec.appLE (U.2.fromSpec ''ᵁ ⊤) ⊤ (by simp) ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(A, U.1)).hom = 𝟙 _ := by
    have h1 : A.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op ≫
        U.2.fromSpec.appLE (U.2.fromSpec ''ᵁ ⊤) ⊤ (by simp) =
        U.2.fromSpec.appLE U.1 ⊤ (by simp) := Scheme.Hom.map_appLE _ _ _
    rw [← Category.assoc, h1]
    have hG := IsAffineOpen.ΓSpecIso_hom_fromSpec_app U.2
    rw [← cancel_epi (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(A, U.1)).hom]
    rw [Scheme.Hom.appLE]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [← Category.assoc _ (U.2.fromSpec.app U.1), hG]
    simp only [Category.comp_id, Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp_assoc]
    have hid : ∀ f : (Opposite.op (⊤ : (Spec Γ(A, U.1)).Opens) ⟶ Opposite.op (⊤ : (Spec Γ(A, U.1)).Opens)),
        (Spec Γ(A, U.1)).presheaf.map f = 𝟙 _ := fun f => by
      rw [Subsingleton.elim f (𝟙 _)]
      exact CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id _ _
    rw [hid, Category.id_comp]
  have := congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom key
  exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.ideal_comap_fromSpec
statement:
theorem ideal_comap_fromSpec {A : Scheme.{u}} (J : A.IdealSheafData) (U : A.affineOpens) :
    ((J.comap U.2.fromSpec).ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩).map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(A, U.1)).hom.hom =
      J.ideal U
proof:
:= by
  have h := ideal_imgOpen_map U.2.fromSpec J
  rw [← h]
  have hle : imgOpen U.2.fromSpec ≤ U := by
    show U.2.fromSpec ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ U.1
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange, IsAffineOpen.opensRange_fromSpec]
  have h2 := J.map_ideal hle
  rw [← h2, Ideal.map_map, eRing_fromSpec_comp U hle, Ideal.map_id]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.zeroSchemeChartPullbackIso_naturality
statement:
theorem zeroSchemeChartPullbackIso_naturality (U : X.affineOpens) {M N : X.Modules} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (I.subschemeCover.f U)).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback I.subschemeι).map f) ≫ (zeroSchemeChartPullbackIso X I U).hom.app N =
    (zeroSchemeChartPullbackIso X I U).hom.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (ConormalSheaf.chartQuotient I U)).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.fromSpec).map f)
proof:
:=
  (zeroSchemeChartPullbackIso X I U).hom.naturality f

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.conormal_four_squares
statement:
theorem conormal_four_squares {C : Type*} [Category C]
    {A B C₁ D E₁ F G H : C}
    (f : A ⟶ B) (a : B ⟶ C₁) (b : C₁ ⟶ D) (c : D ⟶ E₁) (d : E₁ ⟶ F)
    (u : A ⟶ G) (v : G ⟶ H) (w : H ⟶ F)
    (p : G ⟶ C₁) (q : H ⟶ D) (t : H ⟶ E₁)
    (h₁ : f ≫ a = u ≫ p) (h₂ : p ≫ b = v ≫ q)
    (h₃ : q ≫ c = t) (h₄ : t ≫ d = w) :
    f ≫ a ≫ b ≫ c ≫ d = u ≫ v ≫ w
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc f a, h₁, Category.assoc,
    ← Category.assoc p b, h₂, Category.assoc,
    ← Category.assoc q c, h₃, h₄]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionTensorCotangentModuleMap_eq
statement:
theorem cosectionTensorCotangentModuleMap_eq {R M : Type u} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (s : M →ₗ[R] R) :
    cosectionTensorCotangentModuleMap s = ModuleCat.ofHom (cosectionTensorCotangentMap s)
proof:
:=
  cosectionTensorCotangentMap_extendScalars s

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionConormalMap_chart
statement:
theorem cosectionConormalMap_chart [E.IsQuasicoherent] (U : X.affineOpens) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ((quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ).subschemeCover.f U)).map
      (cosectionConormalMap X E σ) ≫ (cosectionPullbackConormalChartIso X E σ U).hom =
    (cosectionPullbackSourceChartIso X E σ U).hom ≫
      (tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of (Γ(X,U) ⧸
        (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ).ideal U))).map
          (cosectionTensorCotangentModuleMap (affineCosection X E σ U))
proof:
:= by
  let J := quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ
  let P := Scheme.Modules.pullback (ConormalSheaf.chartQuotient J U)
  let T := tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of (Γ(X,U) ⧸ J.ideal U))
  let s := ModuleCat.ofHom (cosectionImageFactor (affineCosection X E σ U))
  let m := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.fromSpec).map (cosectionIdealModuleMap X E σ)
  let a := (zeroSchemeChartPullbackIso X J U).hom.app (ConormalSheaf.idealModule J)
  let u := (zeroSchemeChartPullbackIso X J U).hom.app E
  let b := P.map (ConormalSheaf.idealChartIsoTilde J U).hom
  let v := P.map (cosectionSourceChartIsoTilde X E U).hom
  let q := P.map ((tilde.functor Γ(X,U)).map s)
  let e := tildePullbackSpecMapIso (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U))
  let c := (e.app (ModuleCat.of Γ(X,U) (J.ideal U))).hom
  let eM := (e.app (ModuleCat.of Γ(X,U) Γ(E,U.1))).hom
  let d := T.map (AffineNormalCone.extendCotangentIso (J.ideal U)).hom
  let t := eM ≫ T.map ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U))).map s)
  have h₁ := zeroSchemeChartPullbackIso_naturality X J U (cosectionIdealModuleMap X E σ)
  have h₂ : P.map m ≫ b = v ≫ q :=
    (P.map_comp _ _).symm.trans
      ((congrArg P.map (cosectionIdealChartMap_tilde X E σ U)).trans (P.map_comp _ _))
  have h₃ : q ≫ c = t := e.hom.naturality s
  have h₄ : t ≫ d = eM ≫ T.map (cosectionTensorCotangentModuleMap
      (affineCosection X E σ U)) :=
    (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
      (congrArg (fun k => eM ≫ k) ((T.map_comp _ _).symm.trans
        (congrArg T.map ((show (ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U))).map s ≫
          (AffineNormalCone.extendCotangentIso (J.ideal U)).hom =
          cosectionTensorCotangentModuleMap (affineCosection X E σ U) from rfl)))))
  have hp := conormal_four_squares
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (J.subschemeCover.f U)).map (cosectionConormalMap X E σ))
    a b c d u v (eM ≫ T.map (cosectionTensorCotangentModuleMap
      (affineCosection X E σ U))) (P.map m) q t h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄
  simp only [cosectionPullbackConormalChartIso, cosectionPullbackSourceChartIso,
    Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.app_hom, Category.assoc,
    J, P, T, a, b, c, d, u, v, eM, e] at hp ⊢
  with_unfolding_all exact hp

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionTensorCotangentModuleMap_isIso
statement:
theorem cosectionTensorCotangentModuleMap_isIso {R M : Type u} [CommRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {n : ℕ} (b : Module.Basis (Fin n) R M)
    (s : M →ₗ[R] R)
    (h : RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular R (List.ofFn (fun i => s (b i)))) :
    IsIso (cosectionTensorCotangentModuleMap s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cosectionTensorCotangentModuleMap_eq, ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
  exact cosectionTensorCotangentMap_bijective b s h

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionTensorCotangentTildeMap_isIso
statement:
theorem cosectionTensorCotangentTildeMap_isIso {R M : Type u} [CommRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {n : ℕ} (b : Module.Basis (Fin n) R M)
    (s : M →ₗ[R] R)
    (h : RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular R (List.ofFn (fun i => s (b i)))) :
    IsIso ((tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of (R ⧸ cosectionImageIdeal s))).map
      (cosectionTensorCotangentModuleMap s))
proof:
:= by
  letI := cosectionTensorCotangentModuleMap_isIso b s h
  infer_instance

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.conormal_isoHom_comp_isIso
statement:
theorem conormal_isoHom_comp_isIso {C : Type*} [Category C] {A B D : C}
    (e : A ≅ B) (f : B ⟶ D) (hf : IsIso f) : IsIso (e.hom ≫ f)
proof:
:= by
  letI := hf
  infer_instance

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionConormalMap_chart_isIso
statement:
theorem cosectionConormalMap_chart_isIso [E.IsQuasicoherent] (U : X.affineOpens)
    {n : ℕ} (b : Module.Basis (Fin n) Γ(X,U) Γ(E,U.1))
    (h : RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular Γ(X,U)
      (List.ofFn (fun i => affineCosection X E σ U (b i)))) :
    IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
      ((quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ).subschemeCover.f U)).map
        (cosectionConormalMap X E σ))
proof:
:= by
  letI := cosectionTensorCotangentModuleMap_isIso b (affineCosection X E σ U) h
  have hi : IsIso ((tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of (Γ(X,U) ⧸
      (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ).ideal U))).map
        (cosectionTensorCotangentModuleMap (affineCosection X E σ U))) := by
    with_unfolding_all exact cosectionTensorCotangentTildeMap_isIso b (affineCosection X E σ U) h
  let a := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
    ((quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ).subschemeCover.f U)).map (cosectionConormalMap X E σ)
  let e := cosectionPullbackConormalChartIso X E σ U
  haveI : IsIso (a ≫ e.hom) := by
    rw [cosectionConormalMap_chart]
    with_unfolding_all exact (conormal_isoHom_comp_isIso
      (C := (Spec (CommRingCat.of (Γ(X,U) ⧸ (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ).ideal U))).Modules)
      (cosectionPullbackSourceChartIso X E σ U) _ hi)
  exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right a e.hom

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionConormalMap_isIso
statement:
theorem cosectionConormalMap_isIso [E.IsQuasicoherent]
    (h : LocallyFiniteWeaklyRegularFrames X E σ) : IsIso (cosectionConormalMap X E σ)
proof:
:= by
  let C := cosectionZeroSchemeRegularChartCover X E σ h
  apply Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_restrictFunctor_cover
    (fun x : X => Spec (C.X x)) C.f
    ((Opens.coversTop_iff _ _).2 C.openCover.isOpenCover_opensRange)
    (cosectionConormalMap X E σ)
  intro x
  exact cosectionConormalMap_chart_isIso X E σ
    (cosectionRegularNeighborhood X E σ h x).U
    (cosectionRegularNeighborhood X E σ h x).basis
    (cosectionRegularNeighborhood X E σ h x).regular

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionNativeConormalIso_inv
statement:
theorem cosectionNativeConormalIso_inv [E.IsQuasicoherent]
    (h : LocallyFiniteWeaklyRegularFrames X E σ) :
    (cosectionNativeConormalIso X E σ h).inv = cosectionConormalMap X E σ
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionNativeConormalIso_inv_inclusion
statement:
theorem cosectionNativeConormalIso_inv_inclusion [E.IsQuasicoherent]

      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ).subschemeι).map
        (ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ)) =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ).subschemeι).map σ
