name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionTensorCotangentModuleMap_one_tmul
statement:
theorem cosectionTensorCotangentModuleMap_one_tmul {R M : Type u} [CommRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (s : M →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) :
    (cosectionTensorCotangentModuleMap s).hom (TensorProduct.tmul R
      (1 : R ⧸ cosectionImageIdeal s) m) =
    (cosectionImageIdeal s).toCotangent (cosectionImageFactor s m)
proof:
:=
  cosectionTensorCotangentMap_one_tmul s m

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionTensorCotangentModuleMap_basis
statement:
theorem cosectionTensorCotangentModuleMap_basis {R M : Type u} [CommRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {n : ℕ} (b : Module.Basis (Fin n) R M)
    (s : M →ₗ[R] R)
    (h : RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular R (List.ofFn (fun i => s (b i)))) (i : Fin n) :
    (cosectionTensorCotangentModuleMap s).hom ((b.baseChange (R ⧸ cosectionImageIdeal s)) i) =
      (cosectionRegularGenerators b s h).toQuasiregular.conormalBasis i
proof:
:=
  cosectionTensorCotangentMap_basis b s h i

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.coefficientToReesAway_eq_mk_zero
statement:
theorem coefficientToReesAway_eq_mk_zero
    (I : Ideal R) {d : ℕ} (s : reesAlgebra I) (hs : s ∈ grading I d) (r : R) :
    coefficientToReesAway I s r =
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading I) hs 0
        (algebraMap R (reesAlgebra I) r)
        (by simpa using SetLike.algebraMap_mem_graded (grading I) r)
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  rfl

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesAwayMap_denominator_mul_inverse
statement:
theorem reesAwayMap_denominator_mul_inverse
    (I : Ideal R) (g : R) (s : reesAlgebra I) :
    reesAwayMap I g s (coefficientToReesAway I s g) *
        reesAwayDenominatorInverse I g s = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← RingHom.comp_apply, reesAwayMap_comp_coefficientToReesAway]
  change
    coefficientToReesAway (localizedIdeal I g) (gradedLocalizationMap I g s)
          (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g) g) *
        coefficientToReesAway (localizedIdeal I g) (gradedLocalizationMap I g s)
          (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (S := Localization.Away g) g) = 1
  rw [← map_mul, IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf, map_one]

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesAwayMap_denominator_isUnit
statement:
theorem reesAwayMap_denominator_isUnit
    (I : Ideal R) (g : R) (s : reesAlgebra I) :
    IsUnit (reesAwayMap I g s (coefficientToReesAway I s g))
proof:
:=
  ⟨{ val := reesAwayMap I g s (coefficientToReesAway I s g)
     inv := reesAwayDenominatorInverse I g s
     val_inv := reesAwayMap_denominator_mul_inverse I g s
     inv_val := by
       calc
         reesAwayDenominatorInverse I g s *
               reesAwayMap I g s (coefficientToReesAway I s g) =
             reesAwayMap I g s (coefficientToReesAway I s g) *
               reesAwayDenominatorInverse I g s :=
           mul_comm
             (G := HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading (localizedIdeal I g))
               (gradedLocalizationMap I g s)) _ _
         _ = 1 := reesAwayMap_denominator_mul_inverse I g s },
    rfl⟩

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesAwayLocalizationMap_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reesAwayLocalizationMap_comp (I : Ideal R) (g : R) (s : reesAlgebra I) :
    (reesAwayLocalizationMap I g s).comp
        (algebraMap
          (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading I) s)
          (Localization.Away (coefficientToReesAway I s g))) =
      reesAwayMap I g s
proof:
:= by
  exact IsLocalization.Away.lift_comp (coefficientToReesAway I s g)
    (reesAwayMap_denominator_isUnit I g s)

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesAwayLocalizationMap_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reesAwayLocalizationMap_algebraMap
    (I : Ideal R) (g : R) (s : reesAlgebra I)
    (x : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading I) s) :
    reesAwayLocalizationMap I g s
        ((algebraMap
          (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading I) s)
          (Localization.Away (coefficientToReesAway I s g)) :
            HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading I) s →+*
              Localization.Away (coefficientToReesAway I s g)) x) =
      reesAwayMap I g s x
proof:
:= by
  exact RingHom.congr_fun (reesAwayLocalizationMap_comp I g s) x

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.exists_reesAwayMap_mul_denominator
statement:
theorem exists_reesAwayMap_mul_denominator
    (I : Ideal R) (g : R) {d : ℕ} (s : reesAlgebra I)
    (hs : s ∈ grading I d)
    (z : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading (localizedIdeal I g))
      (gradedLocalizationMap I g s)) :
    ∃ (x : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading I) s) (n : ℕ),
      z * (reesAwayMap I g s (coefficientToReesAway I s g)) ^ n =
        reesAwayMap I g s x
proof:
:= by
  have hs_target :
      gradedLocalizationMap I g s ∈ grading (localizedIdeal I g) d :=
    (gradedLocalizationMap I g).map_mem hs
  obtain ⟨k, q, hq, rfl⟩ := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_surjective
    (grading (localizedIdeal I g)) hs_target z
  obtain ⟨p, n, hpn⟩ := exists_reesLocalizationMap_mul_denominator I g q
  have hden_source : reesDenominator I g ∈ grading I 0 := by
    exact SetLike.algebraMap_mem_graded (grading I) g
  have hden_target :
      gradedLocalizationMap I g (reesDenominator I g) ∈
        grading (localizedIdeal I g) 0 :=
    (gradedLocalizationMap I g).map_mem hden_source
  have hden_target_zero_mul :
      gradedLocalizationMap I g (reesDenominator I g) ∈
        grading (localizedIdeal I g) (0 • d) := by
    simpa using hden_target
  have hcoefficient :
      coefficientToReesAway (localizedIdeal I g) (gradedLocalizationMap I g s)
          (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g) g) =
        HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading (localizedIdeal I g))
          hs_target 0 (gradedLocalizationMap I g (reesDenominator I g))
          hden_target_zero_mul := by
    rw [coefficientToReesAway_eq_mk_zero (localizedIdeal I g)
      (gradedLocalizationMap I g s) hs_target
      (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g) g)]
    congr 1
    simpa only [reesDenominator, gradedLocalizationMap_apply] using
      (reesLocalizationMap_algebraMap I g g).symm
  have hproduct :
      q * (gradedLocalizationMap I g (reesDenominator I g)) ^ n ∈
        grading (localizedIdeal I g) (k • d) := by
    simpa using SetLike.mul_mem_graded hq
      (SetLike.pow_mem_graded n hden_target)
  let p_kd : grading I (k • d) := DirectSum.decompose (grading I) p (k • d)
  have hmap_p_kd :
      gradedLocalizationMap I g (p_kd : reesAlgebra I) =
        gradedLocalizationMap I g p := by
    calc
      gradedLocalizationMap I g (p_kd : reesAlgebra I) =
          (DirectSum.decompose (grading (localizedIdeal I g))
            (gradedLocalizationMap I g p) (k • d) :
              reesAlgebra (localizedIdeal I g)) := by
            dsimp only [p_kd]
            exact (gradedLocalizationMap I g).map_directSumDecompose
      _ = gradedLocalizationMap I g p := by
        rw [← show
          q * (gradedLocalizationMap I g (reesDenominator I g)) ^ n =
            gradedLocalizationMap I g p by
              simpa only [gradedLocalizationMap_apply] using hpn]
        exact DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_same _ hproduct
  have hmapcoefficient :=
    RingHom.congr_fun (reesAwayMap_comp_coefficientToReesAway I g s) g
  change
    reesAwayMap I g s (coefficientToReesAway I s g) =
      coefficientToReesAway (localizedIdeal I g) (gradedLocalizationMap I g s)
        (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g) g) at hmapcoefficient
  refine ⟨HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading I) hs k
    (p_kd : reesAlgebra I) p_kd.2, n, ?_⟩
  rw [reesAwayMap_mk]
  rw [hmapcoefficient]
  rw [hcoefficient]
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp only [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul, HomogeneousLocalization.val_pow,
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, Localization.mk_pow,
    Localization.mk_mul, one_pow, mul_one]
  congr 1
  · change
      q * (gradedLocalizationMap I g (reesDenominator I g)) ^ n =
        gradedLocalizationMap I g (p_kd : reesAlgebra I)
    rw [hmap_p_kd]
    simpa only [gradedLocalizationMap_apply] using hpn
  · apply Subtype.ext
    change
      (reesLocalizationMap I g s) ^ k * 1 ^ n =
        (reesLocalizationMap I g s) ^ k
    simp

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesAwayLocalizationMap_surjective
statement:
theorem reesAwayLocalizationMap_surjective
    (I : Ideal R) (g : R) {d : ℕ} (s : reesAlgebra I)
    (hs : s ∈ grading I d) :
    Function.Surjective (reesAwayLocalizationMap I g s)
proof:
:= by
  unfold reesAwayLocalizationMap IsLocalization.Away.lift
  rw [IsLocalization.lift_surjective_iff]
  intro z
  obtain ⟨x, n, h⟩ := exists_reesAwayMap_mul_denominator I g s hs z
  refine ⟨⟨x, ⟨(coefficientToReesAway I s g) ^ n, n, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
  change
    z * reesAwayMap I g s ((coefficientToReesAway I s g) ^ n) =
      reesAwayMap I g s x
  have hpow :
      reesAwayMap I g s ((coefficientToReesAway I s g) ^ n) =
        (reesAwayMap I g s (coefficientToReesAway I s g)) ^ n :=
    map_pow (reesAwayMap I g s) _ n
  rw [hpow]
  exact h

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesAwayLocalizationMap_injective
statement:
theorem reesAwayLocalizationMap_injective
    (I : Ideal R) (g : R) {d : ℕ} (s : reesAlgebra I)
    (hs : s ∈ grading I d) :
    Function.Injective (reesAwayLocalizationMap I g s)
proof:
:= by
  unfold reesAwayLocalizationMap IsLocalization.Away.lift
  rw [IsLocalization.lift_injective_iff]
  intro x y
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h' := congrArg (reesAwayLocalizationMap I g s) h
    simpa only [reesAwayLocalizationMap_algebraMap] using h'
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨kx, p, hp, rfl⟩ :=
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_surjective (grading I) hs x
    obtain ⟨ky, q, hq, rfl⟩ :=
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_surjective (grading I) hs y
    simp only [reesAwayMap_mk] at h
    have hval := congrArg HomogeneousLocalization.val h
    simp only [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk,
      Localization.mk_eq_mk'] at hval
    rw [IsLocalization.mk'_eq_iff_eq] at hval
    obtain ⟨⟨_, ⟨j, rfl⟩⟩, hj⟩ :=
      (IsLocalization.eq_iff_exists
        (S := Localization.Away (gradedLocalizationMap I g s))
        (Submonoid.powers (gradedLocalizationMap I g s))).mp hval
    change
      (gradedLocalizationMap I g s) ^ j *
          ((gradedLocalizationMap I g s) ^ ky * gradedLocalizationMap I g p) =
        (gradedLocalizationMap I g s) ^ j *
          ((gradedLocalizationMap I g s) ^ kx * gradedLocalizationMap I g q) at hj
    let a : reesAlgebra I := s ^ j * (s ^ ky * p)
    let b : reesAlgebra I := s ^ j * (s ^ kx * q)
    have hab_target : gradedLocalizationMap I g a = gradedLocalizationMap I g b := by
      dsimp only [a, b]
      simpa only [map_mul, map_pow] using hj
    have hab_polynomial :
        Polynomial.map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) (a : R[X]) =
          Polynomial.map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) (b : R[X]) := by
      simpa only [gradedLocalizationMap_apply, reesLocalizationMap_apply] using
        congrArg
          (fun z : reesAlgebra (localizedIdeal I g) ↦
            (z : (Localization.Away g)[X])) hab_target
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ :=
      (polynomial_map_eq_iff_exists_pow_mul_eq g (a : R[X]) (b : R[X])).mp
        hab_polynomial
    have hab_source :
        reesDenominator I g ^ n * a = reesDenominator I g ^ n * b := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simpa [reesDenominator] using hn
    apply (IsLocalization.eq_iff_exists
      (S := Localization.Away (coefficientToReesAway I s g))
      (Submonoid.powers (coefficientToReesAway I s g))).mpr
    refine ⟨⟨(coefficientToReesAway I s g) ^ n, n, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
    rw [coefficientToReesAway_eq_mk_zero I s hs g]
    simp only [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul, HomogeneousLocalization.val_pow,
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, Localization.mk_pow,
      Localization.mk_mul, one_pow, mul_one, Localization.mk_eq_mk']
    rw [← IsLocalization.mk'_pow]
    conv_lhs => rw [← IsLocalization.mk'_mul]
    conv_rhs => rw [← IsLocalization.mk'_mul]
    apply (IsLocalization.eq
      (M := Submonoid.powers s)).mpr
    refine ⟨⟨s ^ j, j, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    dsimp only [a, b] at hab_source
    simpa [reesDenominator, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using hab_source

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.isLocalization_reesAwayMap_of_injective
statement:
theorem isLocalization_reesAwayMap_of_injective
    (I : Ideal R) (g : R) {d : ℕ} (s : reesAlgebra I)
    (hs : s ∈ grading I d)
    (hinj : Function.Injective (reesAwayLocalizationMap I g s)) :
    letI : Algebra
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading I) s)
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading (localizedIdeal I g))
          (gradedLocalizationMap I g s))
proof:
:=
      (reesAwayMap I g s).toAlgebra
    IsLocalization.Away (coefficientToReesAway I s g)
      (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading (localizedIdeal I g))
        (gradedLocalizationMap I g s)) := by
  letI : Algebra
      (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading I) s)
      (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading (localizedIdeal I g))
        (gradedLocalizationMap I g s)) :=
    (reesAwayMap I g s).toAlgebra
  let F :
      Localization.Away (coefficientToReesAway I s g) →ₐ[
        HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading I) s]
        HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading (localizedIdeal I g))
          (gradedLocalizationMap I g s) :=
    ⟨reesAwayLocalizationMap I g s,
      reesAwayLocalizationMap_algebraMap I g s⟩
  let e :
      Localization.Away (coefficientToReesAway I s g) ≃ₐ[
        HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading I) s]
        HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading (localizedIdeal I g))
          (gradedLocalizationMap I g s) :=
    AlgEquiv.ofBijective F
      ⟨hinj, reesAwayLocalizationMap_surjective I g s hs⟩
  exact IsLocalization.isLocalization_of_algEquiv
    (Submonoid.powers (coefficientToReesAway I s g)) e

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.isLocalization_reesAwayMap
statement:
theorem isLocalization_reesAwayMap
    (I : Ideal R) (g : R) {d : ℕ} (s : reesAlgebra I)
    (hs : s ∈ grading I d) :
    letI : Algebra
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading I) s)
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading (localizedIdeal I g))
          (gradedLocalizationMap I g s))
proof:
:=
      (reesAwayMap I g s).toAlgebra
    IsLocalization.Away (coefficientToReesAway I s g)
      (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading (localizedIdeal I g))
        (gradedLocalizationMap I g s)) :=
  isLocalization_reesAwayMap_of_injective I g s hs
    (reesAwayLocalizationMap_injective I g s hs)

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.isPushout_coefficientToReesAway_of_injective
statement:
theorem isPushout_coefficientToReesAway_of_injective
    (I : Ideal R) (g : R) {d : ℕ} (s : reesAlgebra I)
    (hs : s ∈ grading I d)
    (hinj : Function.Injective (reesAwayLocalizationMap I g s)) :
    IsPushout
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (coefficientToReesAway I s))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (coefficientToReesAway (localizedIdeal I g)
          (gradedLocalizationMap I g s)))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (reesAwayMap I g s))
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra
      (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading I) s)
      (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading (localizedIdeal I g))
        (gradedLocalizationMap I g s)) :=
    (reesAwayMap I g s).toAlgebra
  haveI : IsLocalization.Away (coefficientToReesAway I s g)
      (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading (localizedIdeal I g))
        (gradedLocalizationMap I g s)) :=
    isLocalization_reesAwayMap_of_injective I g s hs hinj
  haveI : IsLocalization
      ((Submonoid.powers g).map (coefficientToReesAway I s))
      (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading (localizedIdeal I g))
        (gradedLocalizationMap I g s)) := by
    rw [Submonoid.map_powers]
    infer_instance
  refine (CommRingCat.isPushout_of_isLocalization
    (coefficientToReesAway I s)
    (coefficientToReesAway (localizedIdeal I g)
      (gradedLocalizationMap I g s)) ?_ (Submonoid.powers g)).flip
  change
    (coefficientToReesAway (localizedIdeal I g)
        (gradedLocalizationMap I g s)).comp
          (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)) =
      (reesAwayMap I g s).comp (coefficientToReesAway I s)
  exact (reesAwayMap_comp_coefficientToReesAway I g s).symm

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.isPushout_coefficientToReesAway
statement:
theorem isPushout_coefficientToReesAway
    (I : Ideal R) (g : R) {d : ℕ} (s : reesAlgebra I)
    (hs : s ∈ grading I d) :
    IsPushout
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g)))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (coefficientToReesAway I s))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (coefficientToReesAway (localizedIdeal I g)
          (gradedLocalizationMap I g s)))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (reesAwayMap I g s))
proof:
:=
  isPushout_coefficientToReesAway_of_injective I g s hs
    (reesAwayLocalizationMap_injective I g s hs)

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.isPullback_reesAwaySpecMap_toBase_of_injective
statement:
theorem isPullback_reesAwaySpecMap_toBase_of_injective
    (I : Ideal R) (g : R) {d : ℕ} (s : reesAlgebra I)
    (hs : s ∈ grading I d)
    (hinj : Function.Injective (reesAwayLocalizationMap I g s)) :
    IsPullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (coefficientToReesAway (localizedIdeal I g)
          (gradedLocalizationMap I g s))))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (reesAwayMap I g s)))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g))))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (coefficientToReesAway I s)))
proof:
:= by
  exact isPullback_SpecMap_of_isPushout _ _ _ _
    (isPushout_coefficientToReesAway_of_injective I g s hs hinj)

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.isPullback_reesAwaySpecMap_toBase
statement:
theorem isPullback_reesAwaySpecMap_toBase
    (I : Ideal R) (g : R) {d : ℕ} (s : reesAlgebra I)
    (hs : s ∈ grading I d) :
    IsPullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (coefficientToReesAway (localizedIdeal I g)
          (gradedLocalizationMap I g s))))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (reesAwayMap I g s)))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g))))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (coefficientToReesAway I s)))
proof:
:=
  isPullback_reesAwaySpecMap_toBase_of_injective I g s hs
    (reesAwayLocalizationMap_injective I g s hs)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.E14.span_range_of_surjective
statement:
theorem span_range_of_surjective {φ : M →ₗ[R] M'} (h : Function.Surjective φ) :
    Submodule.span R (Set.range φ) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.range_eq]
  exact Submodule.span_univ

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.E14.isClosedImmersion_symmetricProjMap_of_surjective
proof:
:= by
  let N : Submodule R M := LinearMap.ker φ
  let e : (M ⧸ N) ≃ₗ[R] M' := LinearMap.quotKerEquivOfSurjective φ h
  haveI : Module.Free R (M ⧸ N) := Module.Free.of_equiv e.symm
  haveI : Module.Finite R (M ⧸ N) := Module.Finite.equiv e.symm
  have hcomp : (e : (M ⧸ N) →ₗ[R] M').restrictScalars R ∘ₗ N.mkQ = φ := by
    ext m
    simp [e, N]
  have hspan : Submodule.span R
      (Set.range ((e : (M ⧸ N) →ₗ[R] M').restrictScalars R ∘ₗ N.mkQ)) = ⊤ := by
    rw [hcomp]; exact span_range_of_surjective h
  have h1 := symmetricProjMap_comp (S := R) (T := R) N.mkQ (e : (M ⧸ N) →ₗ[R] M')
    (E12.mkQ_spans N) (span_range_of_surjective e.surjective) hspan
  have h2 : symmetricProjMap (S := R) φ (span_range_of_surjective h) =
      symmetricProjMap (S := R) (e : (M ⧸ N) →ₗ[R] M')
        (span_range_of_surjective e.surjective) ≫
        symmetricProjMap (S := R) N.mkQ (E12.mkQ_spans N) := by
    rw [h1]
    exact symmetricProjMap_congr hcomp.symm _ _
  haveI : IsIso (symmetricProjMap (S := R) (e : (M ⧸ N) →ₗ[R] M')
      (span_range_of_surjective e.surjective)) :=
    (chartIsoOfLinearEquiv e).isIso_inv
  rw [h2]
  haveI := E12.isClosedImmersion_symmetricProjMap_mkQ_E12 (R := R) (M := M) N
  infer_instance

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.E14.secMap_restrict
statement:
theorem secMap_restrict {U V : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) (m : B.val.obj (op U)) :
    secMap b V (B.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE h).op m) =
      D.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE h).op (secMap b U m)
proof:
:=
  PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply b.val (homOfLE h).op m

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.E14.PairCover.secMap_span
statement:
theorem secMap_span (i : P.I) (V : X.Opens) (hV : V ≤ P.U i) :
    Submodule.span Γ(X, V) (Set.range (secMap b V)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff, ← P.toD.restriction_spans i V hV]
  refine Submodule.span_mono ?_
  rintro _ ⟨d, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := P.surj i d
  exact ⟨B.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE hV).op m, secMap_restrict b hV m⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.E14.PairCover.chartToLeft_chartMap
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem chartToLeft_chartMap {i j : P.I} (c : P.toD.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    c.chartToLeft ≫ P.chartMap i = P.commonMap c ≫ (P.cB c).chartToLeft
proof:
:= by
  have hcompL : Submodule.span Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (Set.range (semilinearMapComp (RingHom.id Γ(X, P.U i))
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_left).op).hom
        (secMap b (P.U i)) c.leftRestriction)) = ⊤ := by
    have : Set.range (semilinearMapComp (RingHom.id Γ(X, P.U i))
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_left).op).hom
        (secMap b (P.U i)) c.leftRestriction) = Set.range c.leftRestriction := by
      ext y
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨m, rfl⟩; exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨d, rfl⟩
        obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := P.surj i d
        exact ⟨m, rfl⟩
    rw [this]; exact c.leftRestriction_spans
  have hfun : ∀ m : B.val.obj (op (P.U i)),
      secMap b c.affineOpen.1 (B.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_left).op m) =
        c.leftRestriction (secMap b (P.U i) m) :=
    fun m => secMap_restrict b c.affineOpen_le_left m
  have hcompR : Submodule.span Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (Set.range (semilinearMapComp
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_left).op).hom (RingHom.id Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1))
        (B.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_left).op) (secMap b c.affineOpen.1))) = ⊤ := by
    have : Set.range (semilinearMapComp
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_left).op).hom (RingHom.id Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1))
        (B.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_left).op) (secMap b c.affineOpen.1)) =
            Set.range c.leftRestriction := by
      ext y
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨m, rfl⟩; exact ⟨secMap b (P.U i) m, (hfun m).symm⟩
      · rintro ⟨d, rfl⟩
        obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := P.surj i d
        exact ⟨m, hfun m⟩
    rw [this]; exact c.leftRestriction_spans
  refine (semilinearSymmetricProjMap_comp (RingHom.id Γ(X, P.U i))
    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_left).op).hom (secMap b (P.U i)) c.leftRestriction
    (span_range_of_surjective (P.surj i)) c.leftRestriction_spans hcompL).trans
    (Eq.trans ?_ (semilinearSymmetricProjMap_comp
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_left).op).hom (RingHom.id Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1))
      (B.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_left).op) (secMap b c.affineOpen.1)
          (P.toB.restriction_spans i _ c.affineOpen_le_left)
      (P.secMap_span i _ c.affineOpen_le_left) hcompR).symm)
  exact semilinearSymmetricProjMap_congr (RingHom.ext fun _ => rfl) _ _
    (semilinearMap_heq_of_ringHom_eq (RingHom.ext fun _ => rfl) _ _ fun m => (hfun m).symm) _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.E14.PairCover.chartToRight_chartMap
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem chartToRight_chartMap {i j : P.I} (c : P.toD.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    c.chartToRight ≫ P.chartMap j = P.commonMap c ≫ (P.cB c).chartToRight
proof:
:= by
  have hcompL : Submodule.span Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (Set.range (semilinearMapComp (RingHom.id Γ(X, P.U j))
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_right).op).hom
        (secMap b (P.U j)) c.rightRestriction)) = ⊤ := by
    have : Set.range (semilinearMapComp (RingHom.id Γ(X, P.U j))
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_right).op).hom
        (secMap b (P.U j)) c.rightRestriction) = Set.range c.rightRestriction := by
      ext y
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨m, rfl⟩; exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨d, rfl⟩
        obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := P.surj j d
        exact ⟨m, rfl⟩
    rw [this]; exact c.rightRestriction_spans
  have hfun : ∀ m : B.val.obj (op (P.U j)),
      secMap b c.affineOpen.1 (B.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_right).op m) =
        c.rightRestriction (secMap b (P.U j) m) :=
    fun m => secMap_restrict b c.affineOpen_le_right m
  have hcompR : Submodule.span Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (Set.range (semilinearMapComp
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_right).op).hom (RingHom.id Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1))
        (B.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_right).op) (secMap b c.affineOpen.1))) = ⊤ := by
    have : Set.range (semilinearMapComp
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_right).op).hom (RingHom.id Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1))
        (B.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_right).op) (secMap b c.affineOpen.1)) =
            Set.range c.rightRestriction := by
      ext y
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨m, rfl⟩; exact ⟨secMap b (P.U j) m, (hfun m).symm⟩
      · rintro ⟨d, rfl⟩
        obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := P.surj j d
        exact ⟨m, hfun m⟩
    rw [this]; exact c.rightRestriction_spans
  refine (semilinearSymmetricProjMap_comp (RingHom.id Γ(X, P.U j))
    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_right).op).hom (secMap b (P.U j)) c.rightRestriction
    (span_range_of_surjective (P.surj j)) c.rightRestriction_spans hcompL).trans
    (Eq.trans ?_ (semilinearSymmetricProjMap_comp
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_right).op).hom (RingHom.id Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1))
      (B.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_right).op) (secMap b c.affineOpen.1)
          (P.toB.restriction_spans j _ c.affineOpen_le_right)
      (P.secMap_span i _ c.affineOpen_le_left) hcompR).symm)
  exact semilinearSymmetricProjMap_congr (RingHom.ext fun _ => rfl) _ _
    (semilinearMap_heq_of_ringHom_eq (RingHom.ext fun _ => rfl) _ _ fun m => (hfun m).symm) _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.E14.PairCover.chartι_jHom
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem chartι_jHom (i : P.I) : P.toD.chartι i ≫ P.jHom = P.chartMap i ≫ P.toB.chartι i
proof:
:=
  Multicoequalizer.π_desc _ _ _ _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.E14.PairCover.chartMap_comp_chartToBase
statement:
theorem chartMap_comp_chartToBase (i : P.I) :
    P.chartMap i ≫ P.toB.chartToBase i = P.toD.chartToBase i
proof:
:= by
  change symmetricProjMap (S := Γ(X, P.U i)) (secMap b (P.U i))
      (span_range_of_surjective (P.surj i)) ≫
    ((Proj.toSpecZero (symGrading Γ(X, P.U i) (B.val.obj (op (P.U i)))) ≫
      Spec.map (degreeZeroAlgEquiv (R := Γ(X, P.U i))
        (M := B.val.obj (op (P.U i)))).symm.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.hom) ≫
      (P.isAffine i).isoSpec.inv) =
    ((Proj.toSpecZero (symGrading Γ(X, P.U i) (D.val.obj (op (P.U i)))) ≫
      Spec.map (degreeZeroAlgEquiv (R := Γ(X, P.U i))
        (M := D.val.obj (op (P.U i)))).symm.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.hom) ≫
      (P.isAffine i).isoSpec.inv)
  rw [← Category.assoc, symmetricProjMap_toSpec]
  have h1 : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Γ(X, P.U i) Γ(X, P.U i))) = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [← Spec.map_id]; rfl
  rw [h1]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Category.comp_id]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.E14.PairCover.jHom_toBase
statement: theorem jHom_toBase : P.jHom ≫ P.toB.toBase = P.toD.toBase
proof:
:= by
  refine Scheme.Cover.hom_ext P.toD.cover _ _ fun i => ?_
  change P.toD.chartι i ≫ P.jHom ≫ P.toB.toBase = P.toD.chartι i ≫ P.toD.toBase
  rw [chartι_jHom_assoc, AffineFrameCover.chartι_toBase, AffineFrameCover.chartι_toBase]
  change _ ≫ P.toB.chartToBase i ≫ (P.U i).ι = P.toD.chartToBase i ≫ (P.U i).ι
  rw [← Category.assoc, chartMap_comp_chartToBase]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.E14.PairCover.isPullback_chart
statement:
theorem isPullback_chart (i : P.I) :
    IsPullback (P.chartMap i) (P.toD.chartι i) (P.toB.chartι i) P.jHom
proof:
:= by
  have s : IsPullback (P.chartMap i ≫ P.toB.chartToBase i) (P.toD.chartι i) (P.U i).ι
      (P.jHom ≫ P.toB.toBase) := by
    rw [chartMap_comp_chartToBase, jHom_toBase]
    exact (P.toD.isPullback_chartι_toBase i).flip
  exact IsPullback.of_right s (by simp) (P.toB.isPullback_chartι_toBase i).flip

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.E14.exists_mem_of_cover
statement:
theorem exists_mem_of_cover {ι : Type u} {U : ι → X.Opens} (h : IsOpenCover U) (x : X) :
    ∃ i, x ∈ U i
proof:
:= by
  have h' : (⨆ i, U i : X.Opens) = ⊤ := h
  have : x ∈ (⨆ i, U i : X.Opens) := by rw [h']; trivial
  exact Opens.mem_iSup.mp this

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.E14.exists_pairCover
statement:
theorem exists_pairCover [Epi b] (hB : IsFiniteLocallyFree X B) (hD : IsFiniteLocallyFree X D) :
    Nonempty (PairCover b)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨CB⟩ := exists_affineFrameCover X B hB
  obtain ⟨CD⟩ := exists_affineFrameCover X D hD
  have key : ∀ x : X, ∃ (iB : CB.I) (iD : CD.I) (W : X.Opens), x ∈ W ∧ IsAffineOpen W ∧
      ∃ (hWB : W ≤ CB.U iB) (hWD : W ≤ CD.U iD), Function.Surjective (secMap b W) := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨iB, hiB⟩ := exists_mem_of_cover CB.covers x
    obtain ⟨iD, hiD⟩ := exists_mem_of_cover CD.covers x
    haveI : Fintype (CD.basisIndex iD) := @Fintype.ofFinite _ (CD.basisIndex_finite iD)
    obtain ⟨V, hVU, hxV, t, ht⟩ := Scheme.Modules.exists_open_lifts_of_finite_elements X b
      (CD.basisIndex iD) (CB.U iB ⊓ CD.U iD)
      (fun k => D.val.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : CB.U iB ⊓ CD.U iD ≤ CD.U iD)).op
        (CD.sectionBasis iD k)) x ⟨hiB, hiD⟩
    obtain ⟨W, hW, hxW, hWV⟩ := (Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens) hxV
    have hWB : W ≤ CB.U iB := hWV.trans (hVU.trans inf_le_left)
    have hWD : W ≤ CD.U iD := hWV.trans (hVU.trans inf_le_right)
    refine ⟨iB, iD, W, hxW, hW, hWB, hWD, ?_⟩
    have hle : Submodule.span Γ(X, W) (Set.range (CD.restrictedSectionBasis iD W hWD)) ≤
        LinearMap.range (secMap b W) := by
      rw [Submodule.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨B.val.map (homOfLE hWV).op (t k), ?_⟩
      have h1 := secMap_restrict b hWV (t k)
      have h2 : secMap b V (t k) = b.val.app (op V) (t k) := rfl
      have h3 := ht k
      change secMap b W (B.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE hWV).op (t k)) = _
      rw [h1, h2, h3]
      rw [← CD.restrictedSectionBasis_eq_restrict iD W hWD k]
      change D.val.map (homOfLE hWV).op (D.val.map (homOfLE hVU).op
        (D.val.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : CB.U iB ⊓ CD.U iD ≤ CD.U iD)).op
          (CD.sectionBasis iD k))) =
        D.val.map (homOfLE hWD).op (CD.sectionBasis iD k)
      rw [← PresheafOfModules.map_comp_apply, ← PresheafOfModules.map_comp_apply]
      rfl
    intro d
    have hd : d ∈ Submodule.span Γ(X, W) (Set.range (CD.restrictedSectionBasis iD W hWD)) := by
      rw [(CD.restrictedSectionBasis iD W hWD).span_eq]; trivial
    exact LinearMap.mem_range.mp (hle hd)
  choose iB iD W hxW hWaff hex using key
  choose hWB hWD hsurj using hex
  refine ⟨{
    I := X
    U := W
    covers := ?_
    isAffine := hWaff
    basisB := fun x => CB.basisIndex (iB x)
    basisD := fun x => CD.basisIndex (iD x)
    finB := fun x => CB.basisIndex_finite (iB x)
    finD := fun x => CD.basisIndex_finite (iD x)
    frameB := fun x => CB.restrictedFrame (iB x) (W x) (hWB x)
    frameD := fun x => CD.restrictedFrame (iD x) (W x) (hWD x)
    surj := hsurj }⟩
  show (⨆ x, W x : X.Opens) = ⊤
  exact eq_top_iff.mpr fun x _ => Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨x, hxW x⟩

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC2.isIso_pullback_cokernel_π
statement:
theorem isIso_pullback_cokernel_π (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1) (N : Y.Modules) :
    IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ιΣ).map (cokernel.π (ap TΣ sΣ N)))
proof:
:= by
  have hline : IsLocalLineFrame L := isLocalLineFrame_of_hasConstantRank_one hL
  have hΛ1 : HasConstantRank Y (lineBundleDual Y L) 1 := lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank L hL
  have hΛ : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y (lineBundleDual Y L) := hΛ1.isFiniteLocallyFree
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits Y _ hΛ
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits Y _ hΛ
  have hB := ar7Bridge σ hline
  let adj := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction ιΣ
  haveI : PreservesColimitsOfSize.{0, 0} (Scheme.Modules.pullback ιΣ) :=
    adj.leftAdjoint_preservesColimits
  exact ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR8.isIso_map_cokernel_π_of_map_eq_zero _ _
    (map_ap_eq_zero_of_adj adj N (hB.killed_of_idealKills _ (idealKills_pushforward _ _)))

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC2.mono_ap_pushforward
statement:
theorem mono_ap_pushforward (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1)
    [Mono (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))] (E0 : Z.Modules) (hE0 : IsFiniteLocallyFree Z E0) :
    Mono (ap TΣ sΣ ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E0)))
proof:
:= by
  have hΛ1 : HasConstantRank Y (lineBundleDual Y L) 1 := lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank L hL
  have hΛ : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y (lineBundleDual Y L) := hΛ1.isFiniteLocallyFree
  have hΛW1 := SchemeKTheory.hasConstantRank_pullback W F _ 1 hΛ1
  have hΛW : IsFiniteLocallyFree W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)) :=
    hΛW1.isFiniteLocallyFree
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits Y _ hΛ
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits Y _ hΛ
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits W _ hΛW
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits W _ hΛW
  haveI := CIIL3B.hMono_of_mono_pullbackSection σ F pr E0 hE0
  haveI : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).IsRightAdjoint :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction F).isRightAdjoint
  rw [(pushCompat F (dualEval σ) hΛ).ap_eq]
  infer_instance

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC2.pdLE_restrictPush
statement:
theorem pdLE_restrictPush (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1) (hreg : SectionIsRegular σ)
    [Mono (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))] [IsIso (ηΣ ≫ pr)]
    (E0 : Z.Modules) (hE0 : IsFiniteLocallyFree Z E0) {d : ℕ}
    (hN : IsCoherentLike Y ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E0)))
    (hd : PerfectRepG2.Sch.PdLE hY d
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E0))) :
    PerfectRepG2.Sch.PdLE hD d ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (inv (ηΣ ≫ pr) ≫ FzΣ)).obj E0)
proof:
:=
  PerfectRepG2.Sch.pdLE_iso hD (restrictPushIso σ F pr hL E0 hE0.isFinitePresentation)
    (PerfectRepRestrictBG2.Sch.pdLE_pullback_cartier σ hY hD hL
      (fun E hE => CIIL3B.hmono_of_sectionIsRegular σ (isLocalLineFrame_of_hasConstantRank_one hL)
        hreg E hE) hN (mono_ap_pushforward σ F pr hL E0 hE0) hd)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC2.pullbackK0_repK0_restrictPush
statement:
theorem pullbackK0_repK0_restrictPush (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1) (hreg : SectionIsRegular σ)
    [Mono (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))] [IsIso (ηΣ ≫ pr)]
    (E0 : Z.Modules) (hE0 : IsFiniteLocallyFree Z E0) {d d' : ℕ}
    (hN : IsCoherentLike Y ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E0)))
    (hd : PerfectRepG2.Sch.PdLE hY d
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback pr).obj E0)))
    (hS : IsCoherentLike (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (inv (ηΣ ≫ pr) ≫ FzΣ)).obj E0))
    (hd' : PerfectRepG2.Sch.PdLE hD d' ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (inv (ηΣ ≫ pr) ≫ FzΣ)).obj E0)) :
    pullbackK0 ιΣ (PerfectRepG2.Sch.repK0 hY _ hN hd) = PerfectRepG2.Sch.repK0 hD _ hS hd'
proof:
:= by
  have hbund : ∀ E, IsFiniteLocallyFree Y E → Mono (ap TΣ sΣ E) := fun E hE =>
    CIIL3B.hmono_of_sectionIsRegular σ (isLocalLineFrame_of_hasConstantRank_one hL) hreg E hE
  have hm := mono_ap_pushforward σ F pr hL E0 hE0
  rw [PerfectRepRestrictBG2.Sch.pullbackK0_repK0_cartier_of_regular σ hY hD hL hreg _ hN hm hd
    (PerfectRepRestrictBG2.Sch.isCoherentLike_pullback ιΣ hN)
    (PerfectRepRestrictBG2.Sch.pdLE_pullback_cartier σ hY hD hL hbund hN hm hd)]
  exact PerfectRepG2.Sch.repK0_iso hD (restrictPushIso σ F pr hL E0 hE0.isFinitePresentation) _ _ _ _

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC2.ext_k0
statement:
theorem ext_k0 {Z : Scheme.{u}} {B : Type*} [AddCommGroup B] (f g : K0 Z →+ B)
    (h : ∀ (E : Z.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree Z E), f (k0ClassOf Z E hE) = g (k0ClassOf Z E hE))
    (x : K0 Z) : f x = g x
proof:
:= by
  have hfg : f = g := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    intro E
    obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := E
    exact h E hE
  rw [hfg]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC2.hbcA_pencil_bundle_total
statement:
theorem hbcA_pencil_bundle_total (Y : Scheme.{u}) (J : Y.IdealSheafData) (k : Type u) [CommRing k]
    (φk : k →+* Γ(Y, ⊤)) [IsIntegral Y] [IsIntegral J.subscheme] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian (totalGlobal Y J)] (E0 : J.subscheme.Modules)
    (hE0 : IsFiniteLocallyFree J.subscheme E0) (y : K0 (totalGlobal Y J))
    (hy : k0ToG0 (totalGlobal Y J) y = finitePushforward (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)
      (flatPullbackG0 (totalToClosedBase Y J) (g0ClassOf J.subscheme E0 hE0.isFinitePresentation))) :
    k0ToG0 Y (pullbackK0 (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk 1) y) =
      finitePushforward J.subschemeι (g0ClassOf J.subscheme E0 hE0.isFinitePresentation)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_fibre_iso Y J k φk 1
  obtain ⟨e₀, he₀⟩ := exists_fibre_iso Y J k φk 0
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (subschemeTotalGlobal Y J) :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (DeformationSpace.line Y) :=
    isLocallyNoetherian_of_isOpenImmersion (lineTι Y J)
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (subschemeUGlobal Y J) :=
    isLocallyNoetherian_of_isOpenImmersion (subschemeTιGlobal Y J)
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian J.subscheme := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian J.subschemeι
  haveI : IsIntegral (DeformationSpace.line Y) := IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_line Y
  haveI : IsIntegral (subschemeTotalGlobal Y J) := IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_subschemeTotalGlobal Y J
  have hσ0 := sigma_toBase Y J k φk 0 e₀ he₀
  haveI : Nonempty (subschemeUGlobal Y J) := by
    let sW : J.subscheme ⟶ subschemeUGlobal Y J :=
      (isPullback_subschemeLine Y J).lift (J.subschemeι ≫ e₀.hom ≫ zeroι _) (𝟙 _) (by
        rw [Category.assoc, hσ0]; simp)
    obtain ⟨z⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty J.subscheme)
    exact ⟨sW z⟩
  haveI : IsIntegral (subschemeUGlobal Y J) := isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion (subschemeTιGlobal Y J)
  have hmono : ∀ E : (DeformationSpace.line Y).Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFree _ E →
      Mono (tMul (lineFn Y k φk 1) E) := fun E hE =>
    mono_tMul_of_isIntegral _ (lineFn_one_ne_zero Y k φk) E hE
  have hmonoW : ∀ E : J.subscheme.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFree _ E →
      Mono (tMul ((subschemeToLineGlobal Y J).appTop (lineFn Y k φk 1))
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (subschemeTιGlobal Y J)).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (totalToClosedBase Y J)).obj E))) := fun E hE =>
    mono_tMul_of_isIntegral _ (lineFn_one_pullback_ne_zero Y J k φk) _
      (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global _ _ (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global _ _ hE))
  have hσ := sigma_toBase Y J k φk 1 e he
  have hsq' : IsPullback (subschemeToLineGlobal Y J) (subschemeTιGlobal Y J ≫ totalToClosedBase Y J)
      (DeformationSpace.toBase Y ⊥) J.subschemeι := by
    rw [subschemeTι_totalToClosedBase]; exact isPullback_subschemeLine Y J
  obtain ⟨hiso, hsi⟩ := fibre_of_section (DeformationSpace.toBase Y ⊥) (e.hom ≫ zeroι _) hσ
    (lineFn Y k φk 1) e rfl (subschemeToLineGlobal Y J) _ J.subschemeι hsq'
  haveI := hiso
  exact hbcA_pencil_bundle (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (lineTι Y J) (subschemeTιGlobal Y J)
    (subschemeToLineGlobal Y J) (isPullback_lineTι_subschemeTotal Y J) (lineFn Y k φk 1)
    (totalToClosedBase Y J) J.subschemeι (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk 1) e he hmono hmonoW hsi E0 hE0 y hy

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC2.hbcE_pencil_bundle_total
statement:
theorem hbcE_pencil_bundle_total (Y : Scheme.{u}) (J : Y.IdealSheafData) (k : Type u) [CommRing k]
    (φk : k →+* Γ(Y, ⊤)) [IsIntegral J.subscheme] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian (totalGlobal Y J)]
    {L : (totalGlobal Y J).Modules} [L.IsQuasicoherent] [L.IsFinitePresentation]
    (σ : tensorUnitSheaf (totalGlobal Y J) ⟶ L)
    (hL : HasConstantRank (totalGlobal Y J) L 1) (hreg : SectionIsRegular σ)
    (hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = (componentToTotal Y J).ker)
    (E0 : J.subscheme.Modules) (hE0 : IsFiniteLocallyFree J.subscheme E0) (y : K0 (totalGlobal Y J))
    (hy : k0ToG0 (totalGlobal Y J) y = finitePushforward (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)
      (flatPullbackG0 (totalToClosedBase Y J) (g0ClassOf J.subscheme E0 hE0.isFinitePresentation))) :
    haveI : IsIso (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)
        (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι ≫ totalToClosedBase Y J)
proof:
:=
      haveI := isIso_fst_comp_totalToClosedBase Y J
      isIso_fst_comp_of_ker_eq (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (totalToClosedBase Y J)
        (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι (componentToTotal Y J)
        (by rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_subschemeι]; exact hid)
    k0ToG0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme
        (pullbackK0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι y) =
      finitePushforward
        (inv (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)
          (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι ≫ totalToClosedBase Y J) ≫
          pullback.snd (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι)
        (g0ClassOf J.subscheme E0 hE0.isFinitePresentation) := by
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (subschemeTotalGlobal Y J) :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian J.subscheme := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian J.subschemeι
  haveI := isIso_fst_comp_totalToClosedBase Y J
  haveI : IsIso (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)
      (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι ≫ totalToClosedBase Y J) :=
    isIso_fst_comp_of_ker_eq (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (totalToClosedBase Y J)
      (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι (componentToTotal Y J)
      (by rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_subschemeι]; exact hid)
  exact hbcE_pencil_fibre_bundle σ (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (totalToClosedBase Y J) hL hreg
    (KSpecialization.ARRHS.mono_pullbackSection_exceptional Y J σ k φk hL hreg hid) E0 hE0 y hy

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC2.liftZ_k0ClassOf
statement:
theorem liftZ_k0ClassOf (E0 : J.subscheme.Modules) (hE0 : IsFiniteLocallyFree J.subscheme E0) :
    haveI
proof:
:= BundleCoversProjBundleG2.isLocallyNoetherian_total J hA
    liftZ J hA C (k0ClassOf _ E0 hE0) =
      PerfectRepG2.Sch.repK0 (BundleCoversProjBundleG2.hasBundleCovers_total J hA)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (subschemeTotalGlobalι A J)).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (totalToClosedBase A J)).obj E0))
        (finitePushObject (subschemeTotalGlobalι A J)
          ⟨_, (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global _ E0 hE0).isFinitePresentation⟩).2
        (DeformationRegularWSheafLCI.pdLE_pushforward_of_regularCover _ C _
          (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global _ E0 hE0)) := by
  haveI := BundleCoversProjBundleG2.isLocallyNoetherian_total J hA
  change DeformationRegularWSheafLCI.regPushOfRegularCover _ C
    (pullbackK0 (totalToClosedBase A J) (k0ClassOf _ E0 hE0)) = _
  rw [pullbackK0_classOf]
  exact DeformationRegularWSheafLCI.regPushOfRegularCover_k0ClassOf _ C _ _

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC2.k0ToG0_liftZ
statement:
theorem k0ToG0_liftZ (x : K0 J.subscheme) :
    haveI
proof:
:= BundleCoversProjBundleG2.isLocallyNoetherian_total J hA
    k0ToG0 (totalGlobal A J) (liftZ J hA C x) =
      finitePushforward (subschemeTotalGlobalι A J)
        (flatPullbackG0 (totalToClosedBase A J) (k0ToG0 J.subscheme x)) := by
  haveI := BundleCoversProjBundleG2.isLocallyNoetherian_total J hA
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (subschemeTotalGlobal A J) :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (subschemeTotalGlobalι A J)
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian J.subscheme := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian J.subschemeι
  change k0ToG0 _ (DeformationRegularWSheafLCI.regPushOfRegularCover _ C
    (pullbackK0 (totalToClosedBase A J) x)) = _
  rw [DeformationRegularWSheafLCI.k0ToG0_regPushOfRegularCover, ARRG45C.k0ToG0_pullbackK0]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC2.hbcA_liftZ
statement:
theorem hbcA_liftZ (x : K0 J.subscheme) :
    k0ToG0 A (pullbackK0 (fibreιGlobal A J k φk 1) (liftZ J hA C x)) =
      finitePushforward J.subschemeι (k0ToG0 J.subscheme x)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := BundleCoversProjBundleG2.isLocallyNoetherian_total J hA
  refine ext_k0 ((k0ToG0 A).comp ((pullbackK0 (fibreιGlobal A J k φk 1)).comp (liftZ J hA C)))
    ((finitePushforward J.subschemeι).comp (k0ToG0 J.subscheme)) (fun E0 hE0 => ?_) x
  change k0ToG0 A (pullbackK0 (fibreιGlobal A J k φk 1) (liftZ J hA C (k0ClassOf _ E0 hE0))) =
    finitePushforward J.subschemeι (k0ToG0 J.subscheme (k0ClassOf _ E0 hE0))
  rw [k0ToG0_classOf]
  refine hbcA_pencil_bundle_total A J k φk E0 hE0 _ ?_
  rw [k0ToG0_liftZ, k0ToG0_classOf]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC2.isLocallyNoetherian_sigma

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC2.pdLE_zeroSigma
statement:
theorem pdLE_zeroSigma (V : J.subscheme.Modules) (hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree J.subscheme V) :
    haveI
proof:
:= isLocallyNoetherian_sigma J hA φk
    PerfectRepG2.Sch.PdLE (hasBundleCovers_sigma J hA φk) r
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (zeroSigma J φk)).obj V) := by
  haveI := BundleCoversProjBundleG2.isLocallyNoetherian_total J hA
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (subschemeTotalGlobal A J) :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (subschemeTotalGlobalι A J)
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian J.subscheme := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian J.subschemeι
  haveI := (ARRKG2A.oeGate A φk J).qc
  haveI := (ARRKG2A.oeGate A φk J).fp
  haveI := KSpecialization.ARRHS.mono_pullbackSection_exceptional A J (ARRKG2A.oeGate A φk J).σ k φk
    (ARRKG2A.oeGate A φk J).hL (ARRKG2A.oeGate A φk J).hreg (ARRKG2A.oeGate A φk J).hid
  exact pdLE_restrictPush (ARRKG2A.oeGate A φk J).σ (subschemeTotalGlobalι A J)
    (totalToClosedBase A J) (BundleCoversProjBundleG2.hasBundleCovers_total J hA)
    (hasBundleCovers_sigma J hA φk) (ARRKG2A.oeGate A φk J).hL (ARRKG2A.oeGate A φk J).hreg V hV
    (finitePushObject (subschemeTotalGlobalι A J)
      ⟨_, (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global _ V hV).isFinitePresentation⟩).2
    (DeformationRegularWSheafLCI.pdLE_pushforward_of_regularCover _ C _
      (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global _ V hV))

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC2.k0ToG0_zsSigma
statement:

    haveI
proof:
:= isLocallyNoetherian_sigma J hA φk
    k0ToG0 _ (zsSigma J hA C φk x) = finitePushforward (zeroSigma J φk) (k0ToG0 _ x) :=

  ZeroSectionPushK0LCI.k0ToG0_liftPush_apply _ _ _ _ x

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC2.hbcSigma_K0
statement:
theorem hbcSigma_K0 (x : K0 J.subscheme) :
    pullbackK0 (iotaSigma J φk) (liftZ J hA C x) = zsSigma J hA C φk x
proof:
:= by
  haveI := BundleCoversProjBundleG2.isLocallyNoetherian_total J hA
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (subschemeTotalGlobal A J) :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (subschemeTotalGlobalι A J)
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian J.subscheme := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian J.subschemeι
  haveI := (ARRKG2A.oeGate A φk J).qc
  haveI := (ARRKG2A.oeGate A φk J).fp
  haveI := KSpecialization.ARRHS.mono_pullbackSection_exceptional A J (ARRKG2A.oeGate A φk J).σ k φk
    (ARRKG2A.oeGate A φk J).hL (ARRKG2A.oeGate A φk J).hreg (ARRKG2A.oeGate A φk J).hid
  refine ext_k0 ((pullbackK0 (iotaSigma J φk)).comp (liftZ J hA C)) (zsSigma J hA C φk)
    (fun E0 hE0 => ?_) x
  change pullbackK0 (iotaSigma J φk) (liftZ J hA C (k0ClassOf _ E0 hE0)) =
    zsSigma J hA C φk (k0ClassOf _ E0 hE0)
  rw [liftZ_k0ClassOf, zsSigma, ZeroSectionPushK0LCI.liftPush_k0ClassOf]
  exact pullbackK0_repK0_restrictPush (ARRKG2A.oeGate A φk J).σ (subschemeTotalGlobalι A J)
    (totalToClosedBase A J) (BundleCoversProjBundleG2.hasBundleCovers_total J hA)
    (hasBundleCovers_sigma J hA φk) (ARRKG2A.oeGate A φk J).hL (ARRKG2A.oeGate A φk J).hreg
    E0 hE0 _ _ _ _

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC2.hbcE_sigma_liftZ
statement:
theorem hbcE_sigma_liftZ (x : K0 J.subscheme) :
    haveI
proof:
:= isLocallyNoetherian_sigma J hA φk
    k0ToG0 (Ssigma J φk) (pullbackK0 (iotaSigma J φk) (liftZ J hA C x)) =
      finitePushforward (zeroSigma J φk) (k0ToG0 J.subscheme x) := by
  rw [hbcSigma_K0, k0ToG0_zsSigma]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC2.zsSigma_eq
statement:
theorem zsSigma_eq (z : K0 J.subscheme) :
    zsSigma J hA C φk z =
      pullbackK0 (psiSigma J φk ≫ componentToCentre A J) z * zsSigma J hA C φk 1
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isLocallyNoetherian_sigma J hA φk
  have h := ZeroSectionPushK0LCI.liftPush_projection (zeroSigma J φk) (hasBundleCovers_sigma J hA φk)
    r (pdLE_zeroSigma J hA C φk) (pullbackK0 (psiSigma J φk ≫ componentToCentre A J) z) 1
  have hz : zeroSigma J φk ≫ psiSigma J φk ≫ componentToCentre A J = 𝟙 J.subscheme := by
    rw [← Category.assoc]; exact zeroE_comp_centre J φk
  rw [mul_one, pullbackK0RingHom_apply, pullbackK0_comp_apply, hz, pullbackK0_id] at h
  exact h

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC2.hbcE_K0_Z
statement:
theorem hbcE_K0_Z (z : K0 J.subscheme) :
    pullbackK0 (componentToTotal A J) (liftZ J hA C z) =
      pullbackK0 (componentToCentre A J) z * kosEZ J hA C φk
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : pullbackK0 (componentToTotal A J) (liftZ J hA C z) =
      pullbackK0 (inv (psiSigma J φk)) (pullbackK0 (iotaSigma J φk) (liftZ J hA C z)) := by
    rw [pullbackK0_comp_apply, ← psiSigma_fac J φk, IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  rw [h1, hbcSigma_K0, zsSigma_eq, kosEZ, ← pullbackK0RingHom_apply, map_mul,
    pullbackK0RingHom_apply, pullbackK0RingHom_apply, pullbackK0_comp_apply,
    IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC2.hbcE_component_liftZ
statement:
theorem hbcE_component_liftZ (x : K0 J.subscheme) :
    haveI
proof:
:= BundleCoversProjBundleG2.isLocallyNoetherian_total J hA
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (component A J) :=
      LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (componentToTotal A J)
    k0ToG0 (component A J) (pullbackK0 (componentToTotal A J) (liftZ J hA C x)) =
      finitePushforward (zeroE J φk) (k0ToG0 J.subscheme x) := by
  haveI := BundleCoversProjBundleG2.isLocallyNoetherian_total J hA
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (component A J) :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (componentToTotal A J)
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian J.subscheme := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian J.subschemeι
  have hbc := hbcE_sigma_liftZ J hA C φk x
  set ε := pullbackK0 (componentToTotal A J) (liftZ J hA C x) with hε
  have h1 : pullbackK0 (iotaSigma J φk) (liftZ J hA C x) = pullbackK0 (psiSigma J φk) ε := by
    rw [hε, pullbackK0_comp_apply, psiSigma_fac]
  have h2 : k0ToG0 (Ssigma J φk) (pullbackK0 (psiSigma J φk) ε) =
      finitePushforward (inv (psiSigma J φk)) (k0ToG0 (component A J) ε) := by
    rw [ARRG45C.k0ToG0_pullbackK0]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun
      (ARRG45C.flatPullbackG0_iso_eq_finitePushforward_inv (asIso (psiSigma J φk))) _
  rw [h1, h2] at hbc
  have h3 := congrArg (finitePushforward (psiSigma J φk)) hbc
  rw [CIIASM.finitePushforward_inv_cancel] at h3
  rw [h3]
  unfold zeroE
  rw [ARRG45C.finitePushforward_comp]
  rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC2.fibreRel_cover
statement:
theorem fibreRel_cover (c : k) :
    letI
proof:
:= KG2B.zOver (k := k) J
    haveI := z_lft (k := k) J
    haveI := z_noeth J
    letI := totalOver (k := k) J
    haveI := total_lft (k := k) J hA
    haveI := total_isNoetherian (k := k) J hA
    haveI := SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_totalGlobal
      A J
    haveI : Fact (D28.ProjectiveIntegral k (totalGlobal A J)) :=
      ⟨CIICLASS.projectiveIntegral_of_K (projectiveIntegralK_total (k := k) J hA)⟩
    letI := componentOver (k := k) J
    haveI := component_lft J Cq (KG2B.projectiveIntegralK_Z J hA)
    haveI := component_isNoetherian J Cq (KG2B.projectiveIntegralK_Z J hA)
    haveI : Fact (D28.ProjectiveIntegral k (component A J)) :=
      ⟨CIICLASS.projectiveIntegral_of_K (G2C1.projectiveIntegralK_EC J Cq hA)⟩
    haveI : Fact (D28.ProjectiveIntegral k A) := ⟨CIICLASS.projectiveIntegral_of_K hA⟩
    haveI := fibre_isOver' (k := k) J φk c
    haveI := component_isOver' (k := k) J
    ∃ (L N : (totalGlobal A J).Modules)
      (hL : SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank (totalGlobal A J) L 1)
      (hN : SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank (totalGlobal A J) N 1),
      totalPushOn (GRRBlueprintV4.opsV4 k) (fibreιGlobal A J k φk c)
          (GRRBlueprintV4.fundClass k (W := A)) =
        totalCapOn (GRRBlueprintV4.opsV4 k) (A5FR.LPof L N) (A5FR.hasConstantRank_LPof hL hN)
            (GRRBlueprintV4.fundClass k (W := totalGlobal A J)) +
          totalPushOn (GRRBlueprintV4.opsV4 k) (componentToTotal A J)
            (GRRBlueprintV4.fundClass k (W := component A J)) := by
  letI := KG2B.zOver (k := k) J
  haveI := z_lft (k := k) J
  haveI := z_noeth J
  letI := totalOver (k := k) J
  haveI := total_lft (k := k) J hA
  haveI := total_isNoetherian (k := k) J hA
  haveI := SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_totalGlobal
    A J
  haveI : Fact (D28.ProjectiveIntegral k (totalGlobal A J)) :=
    ⟨CIICLASS.projectiveIntegral_of_K (projectiveIntegralK_total (k := k) J hA)⟩
  letI := componentOver (k := k) J
  haveI := component_lft J Cq (KG2B.projectiveIntegralK_Z J hA)
  haveI := component_isNoetherian J Cq (KG2B.projectiveIntegralK_Z J hA)
  haveI : Fact (D28.ProjectiveIntegral k (component A J)) :=
    ⟨CIICLASS.projectiveIntegral_of_K (G2C1.projectiveIntegralK_EC J Cq hA)⟩
  haveI : Fact (D28.ProjectiveIntegral k A) := ⟨CIICLASS.projectiveIntegral_of_K hA⟩
  haveI := fibre_isOver' (k := k) J φk c
  haveI := component_isOver' (k := k) J
  haveI := isIntegral_component J Cq (KG2B.projectiveIntegralK_Z J hA)
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := exists_height_generic hA
  exact FRI.fibreRel_totalGlobal_of_height A J φk c (n := d) hd

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC2.liftLci_apply
statement:
theorem liftLci_apply (x : K0 X) :
    liftLci i hA C x = liftZ i.ker hA C (pullbackK0 (phiXA i).inv x)
proof: := rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC2.k0ToG0_liftLci
statement:
theorem k0ToG0_liftLci (x : K0 X) :
    haveI
proof:
:= BundleCoversProjBundleG2.isLocallyNoetherian_total i.ker hA
    k0ToG0 (totalGlobal A i.ker) (liftLci i hA C x) =
      finitePushforward (subschemeTotalGlobalι A i.ker)
        (flatPullbackG0 (totalToClosedBase A i.ker)
          (k0ToG0 i.ker.subscheme (pullbackK0 (phiXA i).inv x))) :=
  k0ToG0_liftZ i.ker hA C _

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC2.hbcA_lci
statement:
theorem hbcA_lci [IsIntegral X] (x : K0 X) :
    k0ToG0 A (pullbackK0 (fibreιGlobal A i.ker k φk 1) (liftLci i hA C x)) =
      finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X x)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian i.ker.subscheme :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian i.ker.subschemeι
  rw [liftLci_apply, hbcA_liftZ i.ker hA C φk, k0ToG0_phiXA]
  calc finitePushforward i.ker.subschemeι (finitePushforward (phiXA i).hom (k0ToG0 X x))
      = finitePushforward ((phiXA i).hom ≫ i.ker.subschemeι) (k0ToG0 X x) := by
        rw [ARRG45C.finitePushforward_comp]; rfl
    _ = finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X x) := by
        rw [ARRG45C.finitePushforward_congr (phiXA_comp i)]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC2.hbcE_lci
statement:
theorem hbcE_lci [IsIntegral X] (x : K0 X) :
    haveI
proof:
:= BundleCoversProjBundleG2.isLocallyNoetherian_total i.ker hA
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (component A i.ker) :=
      LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (componentToTotal A i.ker)
    k0ToG0 (component A i.ker) (pullbackK0 (componentToTotal A i.ker) (liftLci i hA C x)) =
      finitePushforward ((phiXA i).hom ≫ RG7.zeroE i.ker φk) (k0ToG0 X x) := by
  haveI := BundleCoversProjBundleG2.isLocallyNoetherian_total i.ker hA
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (component A i.ker) :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (componentToTotal A i.ker)
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian i.ker.subscheme :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian i.ker.subschemeι
  rw [liftLci_apply, hbcE_component_liftZ i.ker hA C φk, k0ToG0_phiXA,
    ARRG45C.finitePushforward_comp]
  rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC2.concretePencilK_lci_lift
statement:
theorem concretePencilK_lci_lift (hAreg : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme A) :
