name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC2.hbcE_K0
statement:
theorem hbcE_K0 (x : K0 X) :
    pullbackK0 (componentToTotal A i.ker) (liftLci i hA C x) =
      pullbackK0 (componentToCentre A i.ker ≫ (phiXA i).inv) x * kosE_lci i hA C φk
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIntegral X := (Fact.out : D28.ProjectiveIntegral k X).1
  rw [liftLci_apply, hbcE_K0_Z i.ker hA C φk, pullbackK0_comp_apply]
  rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC2.hbcE_K0_pencil
statement:
theorem hbcE_K0_pencil (hAreg : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme A) (x : K0 X) :
    pullbackK0 (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).e ((concretePencilK_lci i hA C φk hAreg).lift x) =
      pullbackK0 (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).π x *
        (show K0 (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).E from kosE_lci i hA C φk)
proof:
:=
  hbcE_K0 i hA C φk x

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC2.liftPush_pullback_iso
statement:
theorem liftPush_pullback_iso {d₁ d₂ : ℕ}
    (hpd₁ : ∀ V : S₁.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFree S₁ V →
      PerfectRepG2.Sch.PdLE h₁ d₁ ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι₁).obj V))
    (hpd₂ : ∀ V : S₂.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFree S₂ V →
      PerfectRepG2.Sch.PdLE h₂ d₂ ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι₂).obj V))
    (w : ι₁ ≫ θ = α ≫ ι₂) (x : K0 S₂) :
    ZeroSectionPushK0LCI.liftPush ι₁ h₁ d₁ hpd₁ (pullbackK0 α x) =
      pullbackK0 θ (ZeroSectionPushK0LCI.liftPush ι₂ h₂ d₂ hpd₂ x)
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_k0 ((ZeroSectionPushK0LCI.liftPush ι₁ h₁ d₁ hpd₁).comp (pullbackK0 α))
    ((pullbackK0 θ).comp (ZeroSectionPushK0LCI.liftPush ι₂ h₂ d₂ hpd₂)) (fun V hV => ?_) x
  change ZeroSectionPushK0LCI.liftPush ι₁ h₁ d₁ hpd₁ (pullbackK0 α (k0ClassOf S₂ V hV)) =
    pullbackK0 θ (ZeroSectionPushK0LCI.liftPush ι₂ h₂ d₂ hpd₂ (k0ClassOf S₂ V hV))
  rw [pullbackK0_classOf, ZeroSectionPushK0LCI.liftPush_k0ClassOf,
    ZeroSectionPushK0LCI.liftPush_k0ClassOf]
  have hc : IsCoherentLike T₂ ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward ι₂).obj V) :=
    (finitePushObject ι₂ ⟨V, hV.isFinitePresentation⟩).2
  rw [PerfectRepRestrictBG2.Sch.pullbackK0_repK0_of_flat h₁ h₂ θ _ hc (hpd₂ V hV)
    (PerfectRepRestrictBG2.Sch.isCoherentLike_pullback θ hc)
    (PerfectRepRestrictBG2.Sch.pdLE_pullback_of_flat h₁ h₂ θ hc (hpd₂ V hV))]
  exact (PerfectRepG2.Sch.repK0_iso h₁ (pushIsoTransport ι₁ ι₂ θ α w V) _ _ _ _).symm

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC2.kosE_lci_eq_lambda
statement:
theorem kosE_lci_eq_lambda [IsIntegral X] {e : ℕ}
    (M : ZSModel (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).i (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).π
      (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).s e) :
    (show K0 (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).E from kosE_lci i hA C φk) =
      pullbackK0 M.φ.hom (lambdaMinusOne (RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).tautologicalKernel
        ((RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).hasConstantRank_tautologicalKernel M.hE))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherian (RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).scheme :=
    (RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).isNoetherian_scheme
  have hP' : PerfectRepG2.Sch.HasBundleCovers (RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).scheme :=
    BundleCoversProjBundleG2.hasBundleCovers_of_projEmb
      (AR11.ProjEmb.of_closedImmersion M.φ.inv (G2C1.projEmb_EC i.ker C.toQuasiregular hA))
  haveI := isLocallyNoetherian_sigma i.ker hA φk
  have hs : ((phiXA i).hom ≫ RG7.zeroE i.ker φk) ≫ M.φ.hom =
      (RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).zeroSection := M.hφs
  have w : RG7.zeroSigma i.ker φk ≫ (RG7.psiSigma i.ker φk ≫ M.φ.hom) =
      (phiXA i).inv ≫ (RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).zeroSection := by
    rw [← hs, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, RG7.zeroE, Category.assoc]
  have key := liftPush_pullback_iso (RG7.zeroSigma i.ker φk)
    (RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).zeroSection (hasBundleCovers_sigma i.ker hA φk) hP'
    (RG7.psiSigma i.ker φk ≫ M.φ.hom) (phiXA i).inv (pdLE_zeroSigma i.ker hA C φk)
    (ZeroSectionPushK0LCI.pdLE_zeroSection M.CN hP' M.hE) w 1
  rw [pullbackK0_one] at key
  have hz : ZeroSectionPushK0LCI.liftPush (RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).zeroSection hP'
      ((e + 1) + 1) (ZeroSectionPushK0LCI.pdLE_zeroSection M.CN hP' M.hE) 1 =
      lambdaMinusOne (RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).tautologicalKernel
        ((RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).hasConstantRank_tautologicalKernel M.hE) :=
    ZeroSectionPushK0LCI.zsPush_one M.CN hP' M.hE
  rw [hz] at key
  change pullbackK0 (inv (RG7.psiSigma i.ker φk)) (zsSigma i.ker hA C φk 1) = _
  have hk : zsSigma i.ker hA C φk 1 = ZeroSectionPushK0LCI.liftPush (RG7.zeroSigma i.ker φk)
      (hasBundleCovers_sigma i.ker hA φk) r (pdLE_zeroSigma i.ker hA C φk) 1 := rfl
  rw [hk, key, pullbackK0_comp_apply, IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.G2CC2.hbcE_K0_kosE
statement:
theorem hbcE_K0_kosE [IsIntegral X] (hAreg : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme A) {e : ℕ}
    (M : ZSModel (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).i (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).π
      (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).s e)
    (bridge : lambdaMinusOne (RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).tautologicalKernel
      ((RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).hasConstantRank_tautologicalKernel M.hE) =
      GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.kosClassX M.CX M.hN) (x : K0 X) :
    pullbackK0 (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).e ((concretePencilK_lci i hA C φk hAreg).lift x) =
      pullbackK0 (concreteGeomXA_lci i hA C φk).π x * M.kosE
proof:
:= by
  rw [hbcE_K0_pencil, kosE_lci_eq_lambda i hA C φk M, bridge]
  rfl

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.isAffineOpen_litU
statement: theorem isAffineOpen_litU : IsAffineOpen (litU C ij)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : IsAffineOpen (C.literalLinearOpen ij) := by
    unfold AffineFrameCover.literalLinearOpen
    exact Proj.isAffineOpen_basicOpen _ _ (linearForm_mem_degree_one _ _ _) Nat.zero_lt_one
  haveI : IsAffine (C.literalLinearOpen ij).toScheme := h1
  exact isAffineOpen_opensRange (litJ C ij) |> fun h => by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange] at h
    exact h

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.litG_generates_on
statement:
theorem litG_generates_on (W : C.scheme.Opens) (hW : W ≤ litU C ij)
    (s : Γ(C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1, W)) :
    ∃ a : Γ(C.scheme, W), s = a • (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op
      (litG C ij)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V0, rfl⟩ : ∃ V0 : (C.literalLinearOpen ij).toScheme.Opens, W = litJ C ij ''ᵁ V0 :=
    ⟨litJ C ij ⁻¹ᵁ W, by
      rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, ← Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange]
      exact (inf_eq_right.2 hW).symm⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := tautQuotient_generating_of_unitIso (litJ C ij) (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheafLiteralLinearOpenIso 1 ij)
    (tautQuotient_toBase_range_le C ij.1 ij.2) (tautQuotient_t C ij.1 ij.2)
    (tautQuotient_literal_t C ij.1 ij.2) V0 s
  refine ⟨a, ha.trans ?_⟩
  congr 1
  change _ = (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map _ ((C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map _ _)
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  rfl

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.gW_free
statement: theorem gW_free (r : Γ(C.scheme, W)) (h : r • gW C ij hle = 0) : r = 0
proof:
:=
  litG_free C ij W hle r h

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.Fbasis_apply
statement:
theorem Fbasis_apply (k : C.basisIndex ij.1) :
    Fbasis C ij hW hle k =
      PullbackFrameSections.sectionMap C.toBase E (C.U ij.1) W (hle.trans (litU_le C ij))
        (C.sectionBasis ij.1 k)
proof:
:=
  (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap_basis C.toBase ⟨ij.1, ⟨⟨W, hW⟩, hle.trans (litU_le C ij)⟩⟩ k).symm

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.qW_Fbasis
statement:
theorem qW_Fbasis (k : C.basisIndex ij.1) :
    qW C W (Fbasis C ij hW hle k) =
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map (homOfLE (hle.trans (litU_le C ij))).op
        (tautQuotient_t C ij.1 k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fbasis_apply]
  change C.tautologicalQuotient.app W
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj E).presheaf.map (homOfLE (hle.trans (litU_le C ij))).op
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction C.toBase).unit.app E).app (C.U ij.1)
        (C.sectionBasis ij.1 k))) = _
  rw [tautChart_app_map, ← taut_app_eq_quotient_unit, tautologicalPushforwardHom_app]

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.qW_Fbasis_self
statement: theorem qW_Fbasis_self : qW C W (Fbasis C ij hW hle ij.2) = gW C ij hle
proof:
:= by
  rw [qW_Fbasis]
  change _ = (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map _ ((C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map _ _)
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  rfl

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.qW_Fbasis_eq
statement:
theorem qW_Fbasis_eq (k : C.basisIndex ij.1) :
    qW C W (Fbasis C ij hW hle k) = zc C ij hW hle k • gW C ij hle
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (litG_generates_on C ij W hle (qW C W (Fbasis C ij hW hle k)))

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.zc_self
statement: theorem zc_self : zc C ij hW hle ij.2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := qW_Fbasis_eq C ij hW hle ij.2
  rw [qW_Fbasis_self] at h
  have h2 : (zc C ij hW hle ij.2 - 1) • gW C ij hle = 0 := by
    rw [sub_smul, one_smul, ← h, sub_self]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (gW_free C ij hle _ h2)

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.zc_restrict
statement:
theorem zc_restrict {W' : C.scheme.Opens} (hW' : IsAffineOpen W') (hle' : W' ≤ litU C ij)
    (hWW : W' ≤ W) (k : C.basisIndex ij.1) :
    zc C ij hW' hle' k = C.scheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWW).op (zc C ij hW hle k)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := qW_Fbasis_eq C ij hW' hle' k
  have h2 := qW_Fbasis_eq C ij hW hle k
  rw [qW_Fbasis] at h1 h2
  have h3 : (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map (homOfLE hWW).op
      ((C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map (homOfLE (hle.trans (litU_le C ij))).op
        (tautQuotient_t C ij.1 k)) = zc C ij hW' hle' k • gW C ij hle' := by
    rw [← h1, ← Functor.map_comp_apply]
    rfl
  rw [h2] at h3
  have h4 : (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map (homOfLE hWW).op (zc C ij hW hle k • gW C ij hle)
      = C.scheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWW).op (zc C ij hW hle k) • gW C ij hle' := by
    rw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul]
    congr 1
    unfold gW
    rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
    rfl
  have h5 : (zc C ij hW' hle' k - C.scheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWW).op (zc C ij hW hle k)) •
      gW C ij hle' = 0 := by
    rw [sub_smul, ← h4, ← h3, sub_self]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (gW_free C ij hle' _ h5)

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.exists_kernelBasisW
statement:
theorem exists_kernelBasisW :
    ∃ e : Module.Basis {m : C.basisIndex ij.1 // m ≠ ij.2} Γ(C.scheme, W)
        (C.tautologicalKernel.val.obj (op W)),
      ∀ m, (C.tautologicalKernelι.val.app (op W)).hom (e m) =
        Fbasis C ij hW hle m - zc C ij hW hle m • Fbasis C ij hW hle ij.2
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fintype (C.basisIndex ij.1) := @Fintype.ofFinite _ (C.basisIndex_finite ij.1)
  classical
  obtain ⟨hinj, hex, hzero⟩ := SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerShortExact.sections_leftExact C.scheme
    C.tautologicalKernelι C.tautologicalQuotient C.tautologicalKernelι_comp
    C.tautologicalKernel_shortExact (op W)
  exact RiemannRoch.KNFS.exists_kernelBasis (Fbasis C ij hW hle) (qW C W) (gW C ij hle)
    (zc C ij hW hle) ij.2 (zc_self C ij hW hle) (qW_Fbasis_eq C ij hW hle) (gW_free C ij hle)
    (C.tautologicalKernelι.val.app (op W)).hom hinj hex hzero

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.pullbackUnitIso_sectionMap
statement:
theorem pullbackUnitIso_sectionMap (g : Z ⟶ Y) (U : Y.Opens) (V : Z.Opens) (h : V ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U)
    (c : Γ(Y, U)) :
    ((C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso g).hom.val.app (op V)).hom
      (PullbackFrameSections.sectionMap g (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf) U V h c) =
      PullbackFrameSections.coefficientMap g U V h c
proof:
:= by
  let σ := PullbackFrameSections.sectionMap g (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf) U V h
  have e1 : σ c = PullbackFrameSections.coefficientMap g U V h c • σ (1 : Γ(Y, U)) := by
    have := σ.map_smulₛₗ c (1 : Γ(Y, U))
    have h1 : c • (1 : Γ(Y, U)) = c := by rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    exact (congrArg σ h1).symm.trans this
  have hone : ((C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso g).hom.val.app (op V)).hom (σ (1 : Γ(Y, U))) =
      (1 : Γ(Z, V)) := by
    have h2 := C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso_hom_unit_one g U
    have h3 := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply (C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso g).hom.val (homOfLE h).op
      ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)).val.app (op U)).hom (1 : Γ(Y, U)))
    exact h3.trans ((congrArg (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom h2).trans (map_one _))
  rw [e1, map_smul, hone]
  exact mul_one (PullbackFrameSections.coefficientMap g U V h c : Γ(Z, V))

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.epsW_Fbasis
statement:
theorem epsW_Fbasis (a : E ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) (k : C.basisIndex ij.1) :
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).map a ≫ (C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso C.toBase).hom).val.app
      (op W)).hom (Fbasis C ij hW hle k) = cc C ij hle a k
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fbasis_apply]
  change ((C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso C.toBase).hom.val.app (op W)).hom
    ((((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).map a).val.app (op W)).hom
      (PullbackFrameSections.sectionMap C.toBase E (C.U ij.1) W (hle.trans (litU_le C ij))
        (C.sectionBasis ij.1 k))) = _
  rw [PullbackFrameSections.sectionMap_naturality]
  exact pullbackUnitIso_sectionMap C.toBase (C.U ij.1) W (hle.trans (litU_le C ij)) _

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.exists_kernelBasis_theta
statement:
theorem exists_kernelBasis_theta :
    ∃ e : Module.Basis {m : C.basisIndex ij.1 // m ≠ ij.2} Γ(C.scheme, W)
        (C.tautologicalKernel.val.obj (op W)),
      ∀ m, ((zeroCosection C).val.app (op W)).hom (e m) = theta C ij hW hle m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_kernelBasisW C ij hW hle
  refine ⟨e, fun m => ?_⟩
  have h1 : ((zeroCosection C).val.app (op W)).hom (e m) =
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).map (biprod.snd : N ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) ≫
        (C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso C.toBase).hom).val.app (op W)).hom
        ((C.tautologicalKernelι.val.app (op W)).hom (e m)) := rfl
  rw [h1, he, map_sub, map_smul, epsW_Fbasis, epsW_Fbasis]
  rfl

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.cc_restrict
statement:
theorem cc_restrict {E' : X.Modules} (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (ij' : Σ i : C'.I, C'.basisIndex i)
    {W W' : C'.scheme.Opens} (hle : W ≤ litU C' ij') (hle' : W' ≤ litU C' ij') (hWW : W' ≤ W)
    (a : E' ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) (k : C'.basisIndex ij'.1) :
    cc C' ij' hle' a k = C'.scheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWW).op (cc C' ij' hle a k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold cc PullbackFrameSections.coefficientMap
  change _ = (C'.scheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWW).op).hom
    ((C'.scheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hle.trans (litU_le C' ij'))).op).hom _)
  rw [← CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.theta_restrict
statement:
theorem theta_restrict {W' : C.scheme.Opens} (hW' : IsAffineOpen W') (hle' : W' ≤ litU C ij)
    (hWW : W' ≤ W) (m : C.basisIndex ij.1) :
    theta C ij hW' hle' m = C.scheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWW).op (theta C ij hW hle m)
proof:
:= by
  unfold theta
  rw [map_sub, map_mul, zc_restrict C ij hW hle hW' hle' hWW, cc_restrict C ij hle hle' hWW,
    cc_restrict C ij hle hle' hWW]

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.zeroSectionKNF_of_local
statement:
theorem zeroSectionKNF_of_local
    (h : ∀ (V : P.Opens) (x : P), x ∈ V → ∃ W : P.Opens, W ≤ V ∧ x ∈ W ∧ KNFAt s σ W) :
    ZeroSectionKNF s σ
proof:
:= by
  intro V x hx
  obtain ⟨W, hWV, hxW, h1, h2, h3⟩ := h V x hx
  exact ⟨W, hWV, hxW, h1, h2, h3⟩

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.knfAt_of_basis
statement:
theorem knfAt_of_basis {W : P.Opens} (hW : IsAffineOpen W) {n : ℕ}
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin n) (P.presheaf.obj (op W)) ((underlyingCommPresheaf P K).obj (op W)))
    (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular (P.presheaf.obj (op W))
      (List.ofFn (fun i => (show P.presheaf.obj (op W) from (σ.val.app (op W)).hom (b i)))))
    (hzero : ∀ i, (s.app W).hom (show P.presheaf.obj (op W) from (σ.val.app (op W)).hom (b i)) = 0)
    (hker : ∀ a : P.presheaf.obj (op W), (s.app W).hom a = 0 →
      a ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range fun i =>
        (show P.presheaf.obj (op W) from (σ.val.app (op W)).hom (b i)))) :
    KNFAt s σ W
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact koszulAcyclic_of_finiteBasis_weaklyRegular b (affineCosection P K σ ⟨W, hW⟩) hreg
  · intro q
    rw [cosection_apply_basis_expand σ hW b q, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
    rw [map_mul, hzero i, mul_zero]
  · intro a ha
    have hmem := hker a ha
    have hmem' : a ∈ cosectionImageIdeal (affineCosection P K σ ⟨W, hW⟩) := by
      rw [cosectionImageIdeal_eq_span b]
      exact hmem
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hmem'
    exact ⟨q, hq⟩

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.knfAt_of_unit
statement:
theorem knfAt_of_unit {W : P.Opens} (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
    (q₀ : (underlyingCommPresheaf P K).obj (op W))
    (hq : (show P.presheaf.obj (op W) from (σ.val.app (op W)).hom q₀) = 1)
    (hvan : ∀ q : (underlyingCommPresheaf P K).obj (op W),
      (s.app W).hom (show P.presheaf.obj (op W) from (σ.val.app (op W)).hom q) = 0) :
    KNFAt s σ W
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨koszulAcyclicAt_of_unit σ ⟨W, hW⟩ q₀ hq, hvan, fun a _ => ⟨a • q₀, ?_⟩⟩
  have := map_smul (σ.val.app (op W)).hom a q₀
  have h2 : a • (show P.presheaf.obj (op W) from (σ.val.app (op W)).hom q₀) = a := by
    rw [hq]
    exact mul_one a
  exact this.trans h2

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.presheaf_map_eqToHom_injective
statement:
theorem presheaf_map_eqToHom_injective {Y : Scheme.{u}} {U V : Y.Opens} (e : U = V) :
    Function.Injective (Y.presheaf.map (eqToHom e).op).hom
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  simp only [eqToHom_refl, op_id, Y.presheaf.map_id]
  exact fun a b h => h

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.presheaf_map_eqToHom_eq_zero
statement:
theorem presheaf_map_eqToHom_eq_zero {Y : Scheme.{u}} {U V : Y.Opens} (e : U = V)
    (x : Γ(Y, V)) (h : (Y.presheaf.map (eqToHom e).op).hom x = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:=
  presheaf_map_eqToHom_injective e (h.trans (map_zero _).symm)

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.ZeroSectionVanishes.apply
statement:
theorem ZeroSectionVanishes.apply (hv : ZeroSectionVanishes C) (W : C.scheme.Opens)
    (q : (underlyingCommPresheaf C.scheme C.tautologicalKernel).obj (op W)) :
    (C.zeroSection.app W).hom
      (show C.scheme.presheaf.obj (op W) from ((zeroCosection C).val.app (op W)).hom q) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (fun f : C.tautologicalKernel ⟶ _ => (f.val.app (op W)).hom q) hv
  exact this

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.coneOpen_le
statement: theorem coneOpen_le : coneOpen C ij ≤ litU C ij
proof: := Scheme.basicOpen_le _ _

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.isAffineOpen_coneOpen
statement: theorem isAffineOpen_coneOpen : IsAffineOpen (coneOpen C ij)
proof:
:=
  (isAffineOpen_litU C ij).basicOpen _

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.subsingleton_of_eq_bot
statement:
theorem subsingleton_of_eq_bot {P : Scheme.{u}} {U : P.Opens} (h : U = ⊥) :
    Subsingleton Γ(P, U)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  infer_instance

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.coneKernelFactsAt_of_c0_zero
statement:
theorem coneKernelFactsAt_of_c0_zero
    (h0 : c0 C ij (biprod.snd : N ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) ij.2 = 0) :
    ConeKernelFactsAt C ij
proof:
:= by
  have hcc : cc C ij (le_refl (litU C ij))
      (biprod.snd : N ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) ij.2 = 0 := by
    unfold cc
    rw [h0, map_zero]
  have hbot : coneOpen C ij = ⊥ := by
    unfold coneOpen
    rw [hcc]
    exact Scheme.basicOpen_zero _ _
  haveI := subsingleton_of_eq_bot hbot
  haveI : Finite {m : C.basisIndex ij.1 // m ≠ ij.2} := by
    haveI := C.basisIndex_finite ij.1
    infer_instance
  obtain ⟨n, ⟨en⟩⟩ := Finite.exists_equiv_fin {m : C.basisIndex ij.1 // m ≠ ij.2}
  exact ⟨n, en.symm, RiemannRoch.CIIL1DC2.isWeaklyRegular_of_subsingleton _,
    fun a _ => by rw [Subsingleton.elim a 0]; exact Ideal.zero_mem _⟩

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.knfAt_caseB
statement:
theorem knfAt_caseB (hv : ZeroSectionVanishes C) {W : C.scheme.Opens} (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
    (hle : W ≤ litU C ij) (m : C.basisIndex ij.1) (hm : m ≠ ij.2)
    (hu : IsUnit (theta C ij hW hle m)) :
    KNFAt C.zeroSection (zeroCosection C) W
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_kernelBasis_theta C ij hW hle
  obtain ⟨u, hu'⟩ := hu
  have h1 := map_smul ((zeroCosection C).val.app (op W)).hom ((u⁻¹ : Units _) : Γ(C.scheme, W))
    (e ⟨m, hm⟩)
  have h2 : ((zeroCosection C).val.app (op W)).hom (e ⟨m, hm⟩) = theta C ij hW hle m :=
    he ⟨m, hm⟩
  have h3 : (((u⁻¹ : Units _) : Γ(C.scheme, W))) * theta C ij hW hle m = 1 := by
    rw [← hu']
    exact u.inv_mul
  refine knfAt_of_unit C.zeroSection (zeroCosection C) hW
    (((u⁻¹ : Units _) : Γ(C.scheme, W)) • e ⟨m, hm⟩) ?_ (hv.apply C W)
  refine h1.trans ?_
  rw [h2]
  exact h3

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.knfAt_caseA
statement:
theorem knfAt_caseA (hv : ZeroSectionVanishes C) (hf : ConeKernelFacts C)
    (h : Γ(C.scheme, coneOpen C ij)) :
    KNFAt C.zeroSection (zeroCosection C) (C.scheme.basicOpen h)
proof:
:= by
  have hW₁ := isAffineOpen_coneOpen C ij
  have hWW : C.scheme.basicOpen h ≤ coneOpen C ij := Scheme.basicOpen_le _ _
  have hW : IsAffineOpen (C.scheme.basicOpen h) := hW₁.basicOpen h
  have hle : C.scheme.basicOpen h ≤ litU C ij := hWW.trans (coneOpen_le C ij)
  obtain ⟨n, en, hreg, hker⟩ := hf ij
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_kernelBasis_theta C ij hW hle
  let b := e.reindex en.symm
  have hb : ∀ t, ((zeroCosection C).val.app (op (C.scheme.basicOpen h))).hom (b t) =
      theta C ij hW hle (en t).1 := by
    intro t
    have : b t = e (en t) := by simp [b]
    rw [this]
    exact he _
  have hθ : ∀ m, theta C ij hW hle m =
      C.scheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWW).op
        (theta C ij hW₁ (coneOpen_le C ij) m) := fun m =>
    theta_restrict C ij hW₁ (coneOpen_le C ij) hW hle hWW m
  haveI hloc : IsLocalization.Away h Γ(C.scheme, C.scheme.basicOpen h) :=
    hW₁.isLocalization_basicOpen h
  refine knfAt_of_basis C.zeroSection (zeroCosection C) hW b ?_ ?_ ?_
  · have := RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular.of_isLocalization
      Γ(C.scheme, C.scheme.basicOpen h) (Submonoid.powers h) hreg
    convert this using 1
    rw [List.map_ofFn]
    congr 1
    funext t
    exact (hb t).trans (hθ _)
  · intro t
    exact hv.apply C _ (b t)
  · intro a ha
    haveI : IsAffineHom C.zeroSection := inferInstance
    have hY : IsAffineOpen (C.zeroSection ⁻¹ᵁ coneOpen C ij) := hW₁.preimage C.zeroSection
    haveI hlocY := hY.isLocalization_basicOpen (C.zeroSection.app (coneOpen C ij) h)
    let f := (C.zeroSection.app (coneOpen C ij)).hom
    let f' := IsLocalization.Away.map Γ(C.scheme, C.scheme.basicOpen h)
      Γ(X, X.basicOpen (f h)) f h
    have hcomm : ∀ a, f' (algebraMap Γ(C.scheme, coneOpen C ij) Γ(C.scheme, C.scheme.basicOpen h) a) =
        algebraMap Γ(X, C.zeroSection ⁻¹ᵁ coneOpen C ij) Γ(X, X.basicOpen (f h)) (f a) :=
      fun a => IsLocalization.map_eq _ a
    have hker1 : RingHom.ker f ≤ Ideal.span (Set.range fun m : {m : C.basisIndex ij.1 // m ≠ ij.2} =>
        theta C ij hW₁ (coneOpen_le C ij) m.1) := fun a ha => hker a ha
    have h2 := ker_le_span_of_localization h f f' hcomm _ hker1
    have hs := IsAffineOpen.app_basicOpen_eq_away_map C.zeroSection hW₁ hY h
    have hka : a ∈ RingHom.ker f' := by
      rw [RingHom.mem_ker]
      rw [hs] at ha
      simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom, RingHom.coe_comp,
        Function.comp_apply] at ha
      exact presheaf_map_eqToHom_eq_zero _ _ ha
    have h3 := h2 hka
    have hrange : Set.range (fun i : Fin n =>
        (show Γ(C.scheme, C.scheme.basicOpen h) from
          ((zeroCosection C).val.app (op (C.scheme.basicOpen h))).hom (b i))) =
        Set.range (fun m : {m : C.basisIndex ij.1 // m ≠ ij.2} =>
          algebraMap Γ(C.scheme, coneOpen C ij) Γ(C.scheme, C.scheme.basicOpen h)
            (theta C ij hW₁ (coneOpen_le C ij) m.1)) := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨en i, (hθ (en i).1).symm.trans (hb i).symm⟩
      · rintro ⟨m, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨en.symm m, (hb (en.symm m)).trans ?_⟩
        rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
        exact hθ _
    exact Ideal.span_mono hrange.symm.subset h3

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.exists_isUnit_of_sum_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_isUnit_of_sum_eq_one {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] {ι : Type u}
    [Fintype ι] (a c : ι → R) (h : ∑ k, a k * c k = 1) : ∃ k, IsUnit (c k)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  have hcon' : ∀ k, ¬ IsUnit (c k) := fun k hk => hcon ⟨k, hk⟩
  have : (1 : R) ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R := by
    rw [← h]
    refine Ideal.sum_mem _ fun k _ => Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ ?_
    exact (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).mpr (hcon' k)
  exact (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top ((Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).mpr this)

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.exists_mem_litU
statement: theorem exists_mem_litU (x : C.scheme) : ∃ ij : Σ i : C.I, C.basisIndex i, x ∈ litU C ij
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ∈ (⊤ : C.scheme.Opens) := trivial
  rw [← litU_cover C] at hx
  exact (TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup).mp hx

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.exists_base_identity
statement:
theorem exists_base_identity :
    ∃ a : C.basisIndex ij.1 → Γ(X, C.U ij.1),
      letI : Fintype (C.basisIndex ij.1)
proof:
:= @Fintype.ofFinite _ (C.basisIndex_finite ij.1)
      ∑ k, a k * c0 C ij (biprod.snd : N ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) k = 1 := by
  letI : Fintype (C.basisIndex ij.1) := @Fintype.ofFinite _ (C.basisIndex_finite ij.1)
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := SchemeProjectiveBundle.surjective_app_of_split
    (biprod.snd : N ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd (C.U ij.1)
    (1 : Γ(X, C.U ij.1))
  refine ⟨fun k => (C.sectionBasis ij.1).repr n k, ?_⟩
  have h1 := (C.sectionBasis ij.1).sum_repr n
  have h2 := congrArg (((biprod.snd : N ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.app
    (op (C.U ij.1))).hom) h1
  rw [map_sum] at h2
  have h3 : ∀ k, ((biprod.snd : N ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.app
      (op (C.U ij.1))).hom ((C.sectionBasis ij.1).repr n k • C.sectionBasis ij.1 k) =
      (C.sectionBasis ij.1).repr n k * c0 C ij (biprod.snd : N ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) k := by
    intro k
    rw [map_smul]
    rfl
  simp only [h3] at h2
  exact h2.trans hn

name: RiemannRoch.KNFS.zeroSectionKNF_of_gates
statement:
theorem zeroSectionKNF_of_gates (hv : ZeroSectionVanishes C) (hf : ConeKernelFacts C) :
    ZeroSectionKNF C.zeroSection (zeroCosection C)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : ∀ i : C.I, Fintype (C.basisIndex i) := fun i => @Fintype.ofFinite _ (C.basisIndex_finite i)
  apply zeroSectionKNF_of_local
  intro V x hxV
  obtain ⟨ij, hxij⟩ := exists_mem_litU C x
  obtain ⟨W₀, hW₀aff, hxW₀, hW₀le⟩ :=
    (TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp C.scheme.isBasis_affineOpens)
      (show x ∈ V ⊓ litU C ij from ⟨hxV, hxij⟩)
  have hW₀ : IsAffineOpen W₀ := hW₀aff
  have hW₀V : W₀ ≤ V := hW₀le.trans inf_le_left
  have hle0 : W₀ ≤ litU C ij := hW₀le.trans inf_le_right
  by_cases hx1 : x ∈ coneOpen C ij
  · obtain ⟨f, g, hfg, hxf⟩ := exists_basicOpen_le_affine_inter (isAffineOpen_coneOpen C ij) hW₀
      x ⟨hx1, hxW₀⟩
    refine ⟨C.scheme.basicOpen f, ?_, hxf, knfAt_caseA C ij hv hf f⟩
    rw [hfg]
    exact (Scheme.basicOpen_le _ _).trans hW₀V
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_base_identity C ij
    let snd : N ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X := biprod.snd
    let germ := C.scheme.presheaf.germ W₀ x hxW₀
    have hid : ∑ k, PullbackFrameSections.coefficientMap C.toBase (C.U ij.1) W₀
        (hle0.trans (litU_le C ij)) (a k) * cc C ij hle0 snd k = 1 := by
      have := congrArg (PullbackFrameSections.coefficientMap C.toBase (C.U ij.1) W₀
        (hle0.trans (litU_le C ij))) ha
      rw [map_sum, map_one] at this
      simp only [map_mul] at this
      exact this
    have hid' : ∑ k, germ.hom (PullbackFrameSections.coefficientMap C.toBase (C.U ij.1) W₀
        (hle0.trans (litU_le C ij)) (a k)) * germ.hom (cc C ij hle0 snd k) = 1 := by
      have := congrArg germ.hom hid
      rw [map_sum, map_one] at this
      simpa only [map_mul] using this
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_isUnit_of_sum_eq_one _ _ hid'
    
    have hj : ¬ IsUnit (germ.hom (cc C ij hle0 snd ij.2)) := by
      intro hu
      apply hx1
      have hxU : x ∈ litU C ij := hxij
      have := (Scheme.mem_basicOpen C.scheme (cc C ij (le_refl (litU C ij)) snd ij.2) x hxU).mpr
      apply this
      have e : germ.hom (cc C ij hle0 snd ij.2) =
          (C.scheme.presheaf.germ (litU C ij) x hxU).hom
            (cc C ij (le_refl (litU C ij)) snd ij.2) := by
        rw [cc_restrict C ij (le_refl (litU C ij)) hle0 hle0 snd ij.2]
        exact TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ (homOfLE hle0) x hxW₀ _
      rw [← e]
      exact hu
    have hmj : m ≠ ij.2 := fun h => hj (h ▸ hm)
    have hθ : IsUnit (germ.hom (theta C ij hW₀ hle0 m)) := by
      by_contra hnu
      refine (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).mp ?_ hm
      have e : germ.hom (cc C ij hle0 snd m) = germ.hom (theta C ij hW₀ hle0 m) +
          germ.hom (zc C ij hW₀ hle0 m) * germ.hom (cc C ij hle0 snd ij.2) := by
        unfold theta
        simp only [map_sub, map_mul]
        ring
      change germ.hom (cc C ij hle0 snd m) ∈ _
      rw [e]
      exact add_mem ((IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).mpr hnu)
        (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ ((IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).mpr hj))
    have hxb : x ∈ C.scheme.basicOpen (theta C ij hW₀ hle0 m) :=
      (Scheme.mem_basicOpen C.scheme _ x hxW₀).mpr hθ
    have hW : IsAffineOpen (C.scheme.basicOpen (theta C ij hW₀ hle0 m)) := hW₀.basicOpen _
    have hWW0 : C.scheme.basicOpen (theta C ij hW₀ hle0 m) ≤ W₀ := Scheme.basicOpen_le _ _
    have hleW := hWW0.trans hle0
    have hunit : IsUnit (theta C ij hW hleW m) := by
      rw [theta_restrict C ij hW₀ hle0 hW hleW hWW0 m]
      exact C.scheme.toRingedSpace.isUnit_res_basicOpen _
    exact ⟨_, hWW0.trans hW₀V, hxb, knfAt_caseB C ij hv hW hleW m hmj hunit⟩

theorem zeroSectionKNFStatement_of_gates (h : ZeroSectionChartGates C) :

  koszulProd_of_knf C hE (zeroSectionKNFStatement_of_gates C h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D18.stalkPrime_image_eq_comap
statement:
theorem stalkPrime_image_eq_comap {x z : V} (h : x ⤳ z) :
    Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (h.map j.continuous) =
      (Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h).comap (j.stalkMap z).hom
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  simp only [Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes, Ideal.mem_comap, IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal,
    mem_nonunits_iff]
  have hsq := j.stalkSpecializes_stalkMap_apply x z h a
  rw [← hsq]
  constructor
  · intro ha hu
    exact ha (IsLocalHom.map_nonunit _ hu)
  · intro ha hu
    exact ha (hu.map _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D18.quotientStalkEquiv_mk
statement:
theorem quotientStalkEquiv_mk {x z : V} (h : x ⤳ z) (a : X.presheaf.stalk (j z)) :
    quotientStalkEquiv j h (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ ((j.stalkMap z).hom a)
proof:
:=

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D18.localMultiplicity_image

theorem localMultiplicity_image {x z : V} (h : x ⤳ z) (a : X.presheaf.stalk (j z)) :
    CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity a (h.map j.continuous) =
      CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity ((j.stalkMap z).hom a) h
proof:
:= by
  unfold CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D18.specializes_image_iff
statement: theorem specializes_image_iff {x z : V} : j x ⤳ j z ↔ x ⤳ z

:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ (j.isEmbedding.isInducing.specializes_iff).mp h, fun h ↦ h.map j.continuous⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D18.c1CapPrimeCoeff_image
statement:
theorem c1CapPrimeCoeff_image (a : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (x z : V) :
    C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a (j x) (j z) =
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (a.pullback j) x z
proof:
:= by
  unfold C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff
  by_cases h : x ⤳ z
  · rw [dif_pos (h.map j.continuous), dif_pos h]
    rw [ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (quotientStalkEquiv j h)]
    split_ifs with hd
    · rw [localMultiplicity_image j h]
      rfl
    · rfl
  · rw [dif_neg (fun h' ↦ h ((specializes_image_iff j).mp h')), dif_neg h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D18.term_eq
statement:
theorem term_eq {z : W} (hz : coheight z ≤ 2) (a b : C1Cap.LocalEquations W) (hb0 : b z ≠ 0)
    (hbassoc : ∀ (x : W) (h : x ⤳ z),
      Associated ((W.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom (b z)) (b x))
    (x : {x : W // x ⤳ z}) :
    cbW b x.1 * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a x.1 z = (natWeight (b z) (a z) x : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hxz : x.1 = z
  · have h0 : natWeight (b z) (a z) x = 0 := by
      unfold natWeight
      rw [if_neg fun h ↦ h.1 hxz]
    rw [h0]
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := x
    simp only at hxz
    subst hxz
    unfold C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff
    rw [dif_pos hx, if_neg (by rw [ringKrullDim_quotient_self]; exact zero_ne_one)]
    simp
  · rw [natWeight_of_ne _ _ x hxz]
    have hunit0 : ∀ c : W.presheaf.stalk z, c ∉ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes x.2 →
        Ring.ord (W.presheaf.stalk x.1) ((W.presheaf.stalkSpecializes x.2).hom c) = 0 := by
      intro c hc
      apply Ring.ord_of_isUnit
      rw [← IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal]
      exact hc
    have hord := ord_eq_of_associated (hbassoc x.1 x.2)
    by_cases hx1 : coheight x.1 = 1
    · unfold cbW
      rw [if_pos hx1, ← hord]
      by_cases hmem : b z ∈ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes x.2
      · have hpm : Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes x.2 ≠ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _ :=
          ((SchemeLocalOrdSymmetry.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_lt_maximalIdeal_iff x.2).mpr hxz).ne
        have hdim := ringKrullDim_quotient_eq_one (ringKrullDim_stalk_le_two hz) _ hpm hmem hb0
        unfold C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff
        rw [dif_pos x.2, if_pos hdim]
        push_cast
        ring
      · rw [hunit0 (b z) hmem]
        simp
    · have hs : b z ∉ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes x.2 := fun h ↦
        hx1 (C1Cap.coheight_eq_one_of_mem_stalkPrime x.2 hxz hz hb0 h)
      unfold cbW
      rw [if_neg hx1, hunit0 (b z) hs]
      simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D18.coeff_symm_W
statement:
theorem coeff_symm_W {z : W} (hz : coheight z ≤ 2) (a b : C1Cap.LocalEquations W)
    (ha0 : a z ≠ 0) (hb0 : b z ≠ 0)
    (hassa : ∀ (x : W) (h : x ⤳ z),
      Associated ((W.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom (a z)) (a x))
    (hassb : ∀ (x : W) (h : x ⤳ z),
      Associated ((W.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom (b z)) (b x))
    (hgood : ∀ q : Ideal (W.presheaf.stalk z), q.IsPrime → a z ∈ q → b z ∈ q →
      q = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (W.presheaf.stalk z)) :
    ∑ᶠ x : W, cbW b x * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a x z =
      ∑ᶠ x : W, cbW a x * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff b x z
proof:
:= by
  have key := finsum_natWeight_symm hz ha0 hb0 hgood
  have hsupp : ∀ (a b : C1Cap.LocalEquations W) (x : W),
      cbW b x * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a x z ≠ 0 → x ⤳ z := by
    intro a b x hx
    by_contra h
    apply hx
    rw [C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_not_specializes a h, mul_zero]
  rw [finsum_eq_finsum_subtype _ _ (hsupp a b), finsum_eq_finsum_subtype _ _ (hsupp b a),
    finsum_congr (term_eq hz a b hb0 hassb), finsum_congr (term_eq hz b a ha0 hassa),
    ← coe_finsum_natWeight hz hb0 (a z), ← coe_finsum_natWeight hz ha0 (b z)]
  exact_mod_cast key

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D18.c1CapPrimeCoeff_pointClosureι_eq
statement:
theorem c1CapPrimeCoeff_pointClosureι_eq (b : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (v : X)
    (x : pointClosureScheme v) :
    C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff b v (pointClosureι v x) = cbW (b.pullback (pointClosureι v)) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_pointClosureι]
  unfold cbW
  by_cases hx : coheight x = 1
  · rw [if_pos hx, if_pos hx, C1Cap.localMultiplicity_eq_ord_stalkMap]
    rfl
  · rw [if_neg hx, if_neg hx]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D18.cbW_mul_eq_zero_of_not_le
statement:
theorem cbW_mul_eq_zero_of_not_le (n : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = n + 1 + 1)
    (a b : C1Cap.LocalEquations (pointClosureScheme v)) (z : pointClosureScheme v)
    (hz : ¬ coheight z ≤ 2) (x : pointClosureScheme v) :
    cbW b x * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a x z = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  have h1 : cbW b x ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul hne
  have h2 : C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a x z ≠ 0 := right_ne_zero_of_mul hne
  have hx : coheight x = 1 := by
    by_contra h
    exact h1 (by unfold cbW; rw [if_neg h])
  by_cases hs : x ⤳ z
  · have hd : ringKrullDim ((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalk z ⧸
        Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hs) = 1 := by
      by_contra h
      apply h2
      unfold C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff
      rw [dif_pos hs, if_neg h]
    exact hz (D6.coheight_le_two_source (k := k) (closureGen (k := k) (n + 1) v hv) hs hx hd)
  · exact h2 (C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_not_specializes a hs)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D18.finsum_reindex_range
statement:
theorem finsum_reindex_range {α β : Type*} (g : α → β) (hg : Function.Injective g) (F : β → ℤ)
    (hF : ∀ w, F w ≠ 0 → w ∈ Set.range g) : ∑ᶠ w, F w = ∑ᶠ x, F (g x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← finsum_mem_range hg, ← finsum_mem_univ F]
  have : Set.range g ∩ Function.support F = Set.univ ∩ Function.support F := by
    ext w
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_univ, true_and]
    exact ⟨fun h ↦ h.2, fun h ↦ ⟨hF w h, h⟩⟩
  rw [← finsum_mem_inter_support F Set.univ, ← finsum_mem_inter_support F (Set.range g), this]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D18.coeff_symm_X
statement:
theorem coeff_symm_X (n : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = n + 1 + 1) (a b : C1Cap.LocalEquations X)
    (hm : MeetsProperly v a b) (y : X) :
    ∑ᶠ w : X, C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff b v w * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a w y =
      ∑ᶠ w : X, C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a v w * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff b w y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hy : y ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι v)
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hy
    have hsupp : ∀ (a b : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (w : X),
        C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff b v w * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a w (pointClosureι v z) ≠ 0 →
          w ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι v) := by
      intro a b w hw
      have h1 : v ⤳ w := by
        by_contra h
        exact left_ne_zero_of_mul hw (C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_not_specializes b h)
      exact C1Cap.exists_pointClosureι_eq h1
    rw [finsum_reindex_range _ (pointClosureι v).isEmbedding.injective _ (hsupp a b),
      finsum_reindex_range _ (pointClosureι v).isEmbedding.injective _ (hsupp b a)]
    have hred : ∀ (a b : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (x : pointClosureScheme v),
        C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff b v (pointClosureι v x) *
            C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a (pointClosureι v x) (pointClosureι v z) =
          cbW (b.pullback (pointClosureι v)) x *
            C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff (a.pullback (pointClosureι v)) x z := by
      intro a b x
      rw [c1CapPrimeCoeff_pointClosureι_eq, c1CapPrimeCoeff_image]
    simp only [hred]
    by_cases hz : coheight z ≤ 2
    · exact coeff_symm_W hz _ _ (hm.ne_a z) (hm.ne_b z) (fun x h ↦ hm.assoc_a h)
        (fun x h ↦ hm.assoc_b h) (hm.joint z hz)
    · simp only [cbW_mul_eq_zero_of_not_le (k := k) n v hv _ _ z hz, finsum_zero]
  · have h0 : ∀ (a b : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (w : X),
        C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff b v w * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a w y = 0 := by
      intro a b w
      by_contra hw
      have h1 : v ⤳ w := by
        by_contra h
        exact left_ne_zero_of_mul hw (C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_not_specializes b h)
      have h2 : w ⤳ y := by
        by_contra h
        exact right_ne_zero_of_mul hw (C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_not_specializes a h)
      exact hy (C1Cap.exists_pointClosureι_eq (h1.trans h2))
    simp only [h0, finsum_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D18.repCap_of_frame
statement:
theorem repCap_of_frame (a : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (w : X) {bp : pointClosureScheme w}
    (f : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme w)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι w)).obj L) bp)
    (hf : D8.LocalEqOfFrame L w a f) : RepCap (k := k) L hL n a w
proof:
:= fun hw ↦
  ⟨D5.primeCycleOfFrame (k := k) L hL n w hw f, D5.primeCap_eq (k := k) L hL n w hw f,
    fun y ↦ congrFun (D8.properPushforward_weil_eq_coeff (k := k) L hL w f a hf) y⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D18.capCycles_eq_mk
statement:
theorem capCycles_eq_mk (D : dimensionCycles X (n + 1)) (a : C1Cap.LocalEquations X)
    (hloc : ∀ w : X, D.1 w ≠ 0 → RepCap (k := k) L hL n a w) :
    ∃ C : dimensionCycles X n, D5.capCycles (k := k) L hL n D = (QuotientAddGroup.mk C) ∧
      ∀ y, C.1 y = C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff a D.1 y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set fs := compactCycleFinsupp D.1 with hfs
  have hcod : ∀ v, D.1 v ≠ 0 → height v = n + 1 := fun v hv ↦ D.2 hv
  have hsupp : ∀ v, v ∈ fs.support ↔ D.1 v ≠ 0 := fun v ↦ by
    rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, hfs, compactCycleFinsupp_apply]
  let Rep : X → dimensionCycles X n := fun w ↦
    if h : height w = n + 1 ∧ D.1 w ≠ 0 then (hloc w h.2 h.1).choose else 0
  have hRep : ∀ w ∈ fs.support, ∀ hc : height w = n + 1,
      D5.primeCapOrZero (k := k) L hL n w = (QuotientAddGroup.mk (Rep w) : DimChow X n) := by
    intro w hw hc
    have hw' := (hsupp w).mp hw
    rw [D5.primeCapOrZero, dif_pos hc]
    simp only [Rep, dif_pos (And.intro hc hw')]
    exact (hloc w hw' hc).choose_spec.1
  have hRepv : ∀ w ∈ fs.support, ∀ y, (Rep w).1 y = C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a w y := by
    intro w hw y
    have hw' := (hsupp w).mp hw
    have hc := hcod w hw'
    simp only [Rep, dif_pos (And.intro hc hw')]
    exact (hloc w hw' hc).choose_spec.2 y
  refine ⟨fs.sum fun w m ↦ m • Rep w, ?_, fun y ↦ ?_⟩
  · change fs.sum (fun v m ↦ m • D5.primeCapOrZero (k := k) L hL n v) = _
    rw [Finsupp.sum_congr (g2 := fun v m ↦ m • (QuotientAddGroup.mk (Rep v) : DimChow X n))
      fun v hv ↦ by rw [hRep v hv (hcod v ((hsupp v).mp hv))]]
    have := map_finsuppSum (QuotientAddGroup.mk' (dimRationalEquivalence X n)) fs
      (fun v m ↦ m • Rep v)
    simp only [map_zsmul, QuotientAddGroup.mk'_apply] at this
    exact this.symm
  · change evalHomD X n y (fs.sum fun w m ↦ m • Rep w) = _
    rw [map_finsuppSum]
    simp only [map_zsmul, smul_eq_mul]
    change ∑ w ∈ fs.support, fs w * (Rep w).1 y = _
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun w hw ↦ by rw [hRepv w hw y]]
    unfold C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff
    have hsub : Function.support (fun v ↦ D.1 v * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a v y) ⊆
        ↑fs.support := by
      intro v hv
      rw [Finset.mem_coe, hsupp]
      exact left_ne_zero_of_mul hv
    rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ hsub]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun v _ ↦ ?_
    rw [hfs, compactCycleFinsupp_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D18.cap_cap_prime
statement:
theorem cap_cap_prime (L M : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1) (m : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = m + 2)
    (a b : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (hMv : RepCap (k := k) M hM (m + 1) b v)
    (hLw : ∀ w : X, C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff b v w ≠ 0 → RepCap (k := k) L hL m a w) :
    ∃ C : dimensionCycles X m,
      ops.cap L hL m (ops.cap M hM (m + 1) ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v (m + 2) hv) : DimChow X (m + 2)))) =
        (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk C : DimChow X m) ∧
      ∀ y, C.1 y = ∑ᶠ w : X, C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff b v w * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a w y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR1, hRc⟩ := hMv hv
  have h1 : ops.cap M hM (m + 1) ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
      (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v (m + 2) hv) : DimChow X (m + 2))) =
      (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk R : DimChow X (m + 1)) := by
    rw [D13.cap_prime_anchor (k := k) ops M hM (m + 1) v hv, hR1]
  obtain ⟨C, hC1, hC2⟩ := capCycles_eq_mk (k := k) L hL m R a (fun w hne ↦
    hLw w (by rwa [← hRc w]))
  refine ⟨C, ?_, fun y ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [h1, D13.cap_anchor (k := k) ops L hL m R, hC1]
  · rw [hC2 y]
    unfold C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff
    simp only [hRc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D18.capComm_prime_of_properMeeting
statement:
theorem capComm_prime_of_properMeeting {L M : X.Modules} {hL : HasConstantRank X L 1}
    {hM : HasConstantRank X M 1} (m : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = m + 2)
    (a b : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (d : GateData (k := k) L M hL hM m v a b) :
    ops.cap L hL m (ops.cap M hM (m + 1) ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v (m + 2) hv) : DimChow X (m + 2)))) =
      ops.cap M hM m (ops.cap L hL (m + 1) ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v (m + 2) hv) : DimChow X (m + 2))))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C₁, h₁, c₁⟩ := cap_cap_prime (k := k) ops L M hL hM m v hv a b d.frameM_v d.frameL_w
  obtain ⟨C₂, h₂, c₂⟩ := cap_cap_prime (k := k) ops M L hM hL m v hv b a d.frameL_v d.frameM_w
  rw [h₁, h₂]
  congr 2
  ext y
  rw [c₁ y, c₂ y]
  exact coeff_symm_X (k := k) m v hv a b d.meets y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D18.capCommGate_of_properMeeting
proof:
:= by
  intro m v hv
  obtain ⟨a, b, d⟩ := H m v hv
  exact capComm_prime_of_properMeeting (k := k) ops m v hv a b d

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D18.capCommute_of_properMeeting
proof:
:=
  D17.capCommute_of_gate (capCommGate_of_properMeeting (k := k) ops H)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.hyperplanePair_codimension_plane
statement:
theorem hyperplanePair_codimension_plane
    (s t : grading k 2 1) (hs : s ≠ 0)
    (hts : (t : Polynomial k 2) ∉ Ideal.span {(s : Polynomial k 2)})
    (z : pullback (C := Scheme.{u})
      (hyperplaneι k 2 s) (hyperplaneι k 2 t)) :
    coheight ((pullback.fst (hyperplaneι k 2 s) (hyperplaneι k 2 t) ≫
      hyperplaneι k 2 s) z) = 2
proof:
:= by
  let y : space k 2 :=
    (pullback.fst (hyperplaneι k 2 s) (hyperplaneι k 2 t) ≫
      hyperplaneι k 2 s) z
  let η : hyperplane k 2 s := genericHyperplanePoint k 2 s hs (by omega)
  let m : space k 2 := hyperplaneι k 2 s η
  have hys : (s : Polynomial k 2) ∈ y.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal :=
    (mem_range_hyperplaneι_iff k 2 s y).mp (by
      refine ⟨pullback.fst (hyperplaneι k 2 s) (hyperplaneι k 2 t) z, ?_⟩
      rfl)
  have hyt : (t : Polynomial k 2) ∈ y.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal :=
    (mem_range_hyperplaneι_iff k 2 t y).mp (by
      refine ⟨pullback.snd (hyperplaneι k 2 s) (hyperplaneι k 2 t) z, ?_⟩
      change (pullback.snd (hyperplaneι k 2 s) (hyperplaneι k 2 t) ≫
        hyperplaneι k 2 t) z = _
      rw [← pullback.condition])
  have hmIdeal : m.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal = Ideal.span {(s : Polynomial k 2)} := by
    rw [show m = hyperplaneι k 2 s (genericHyperplanePoint k 2 s hs (by omega)) from rfl,
      asHomogeneousIdeal_hyperplaneι_genericHyperplanePoint,
      GradedIdealQuotient.principalIdeal_toIdeal]
  have hm_lt_y : m.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal < y.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal := by
    rw [hmIdeal]
    refine lt_of_le_not_ge (Ideal.span_le.mpr (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hys)) ?_
    intro hy_le
    exact hts (hy_le hyt)
  have hm_lt_y_raw :
      (show ProjectiveSpectrum (grading k 2) from m) <
        (show ProjectiveSpectrum (grading k 2) from y) := by
    change m.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal < y.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal
    exact hm_lt_y
  have hmySpec : Specializes m y := by
    rw [specializes_iff_mem_closure]
    exact (ProjectiveSpectrum.le_iff_mem_closure (grading k 2) m y).mp hm_lt_y_raw.le
  have hy_le_m : y ≤ m := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr hmySpec
  have hy_ne_m : y ≠ m := by
    intro h
    have h' : (show ProjectiveSpectrum (grading k 2) from m) =
        (show ProjectiveSpectrum (grading k 2) from y) :=
      congrArg (fun x : space k 2 ↦
        (show ProjectiveSpectrum (grading k 2) from x)) h.symm
    exact hm_lt_y_raw.ne h'
  have hy_lt_m : y < m := lt_of_le_not_ge hy_le_m fun hge ↦
    hy_ne_m (((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hge).antisymm
      (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hy_le_m)).eq)
  have hmCoheight : coheight m = 1 :=
    coheight_hyperplaneι_eq_one k 2 s hs η
      (genericHyperplanePoint_mem_genericPoints k 2 s hs (by omega))
  have hlower : 2 ≤ coheight y := by
    have h := Order.coheight_add_one_le hy_lt_m
    rw [hmCoheight] at h
    norm_num at h ⊢
    exact h
  have hupper : coheight y ≤ 2 := by
    have h := (Order.coheight_le_krullDim y).trans
      (Order.KrullDimLE.krullDim_le (n := 2) (α := space k 2))
    have h' : (↑(coheight y) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ↑(2 : ℕ∞) := by
      simpa using h
    exact WithBot.coe_le_coe.mp h'
  exact le_antisymm hupper hlower

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.hyperplanePairGlobalData_isTorIndependent
statement:
theorem hyperplanePairGlobalData_isTorIndependent
    (s t : grading k n 1) (hs : s ≠ 0) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (codim : ∀ z : pullback (C := Scheme.{u})
        (hyperplaneι k n s) (hyperplaneι k n t),
      z ∈ genericPoints (pullback (C := Scheme.{u})
        (hyperplaneι k n s) (hyperplaneι k n t)) →
        coheight ((pullback.fst (hyperplaneι k n s) (hyperplaneι k n t) ≫
          hyperplaneι k n s) z) = 2) :
    (hyperplanePairGlobalData k n s t hs hn codim).IsTorIndependent
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsIntegral (hyperplane k n s) := isIntegral_hyperplane k n s hs hn
  letI : IsIntegral
      (hyperplanePairExpectedCodimensionData k n s t codim).D := by
    change IsIntegral (hyperplane k n s)
    infer_instance
  exact ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.GlobalData.isTorIndependent_ofCommonPrincipalCharts
      (hyperplanePairExpectedCodimensionData k n s t codim) le_rfl
      (ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.hasCommonPrincipalCharts_ofClosedImmersions
        (hyperplanePairExpectedCodimensionData k n s t codim)
        (isLocallyPrincipalClosedImmersion_hyperplane k n s)
        (isLocallyPrincipalClosedImmersion_hyperplane k n t))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.hyperplanePairGlobalData_cycle_eq
statement:
theorem hyperplanePairGlobalData_cycle_eq
    (s t : grading k n 1) (hs : s ≠ 0) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (codim : ∀ z : pullback (C := Scheme.{u})
        (hyperplaneι k n s) (hyperplaneι k n t),
      z ∈ genericPoints (pullback (C := Scheme.{u})
        (hyperplaneι k n s) (hyperplaneι k n t)) →
        coheight ((pullback.fst (hyperplaneι k n s) (hyperplaneι k n t) ≫
          hyperplaneι k n s) z) = 2) :
    (hyperplanePairGlobalData k n s t hs hn codim).cycle =
      (hyperplanePairExpectedCodimensionData k n s t codim).cycle
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsIntegral (hyperplane k n s) := isIntegral_hyperplane k n s hs hn
  letI : IsIntegral
      (hyperplanePairExpectedCodimensionData k n s t codim).D := by
    change IsIntegral (hyperplane k n s)
    infer_instance
  exact ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.GlobalData.cycle_ofLocallyPrincipalClosedImmersions_eq
      (hyperplanePairExpectedCodimensionData k n s t codim)
      (isLocallyPrincipalClosedImmersion_hyperplane k n s)
      (isLocallyPrincipalClosedImmersion_hyperplane k n t) le_rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.hyperplanePairGlobalDataPlane_isTorIndependent
statement:
theorem hyperplanePairGlobalDataPlane_isTorIndependent
    (s t : grading k 2 1) (hs : s ≠ 0)

    (hyperplanePairGlobalDataPlane k s t hs hts).IsTorIndependent

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.hyperplanePairGlobalDataPlane_cycle_eq
statement:
theorem hyperplanePairGlobalDataPlane_cycle_eq

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistPullHomAux_canonicalFinalComparisonHom_comp
statement:
theorem twistPullHomAux_canonicalFinalComparisonHom_comp
    (d : ℤ) (i j k : C.I)
    (l : (C.twistChosenTripleCocycleCover i j k).I₀) :
    let q
proof:
:= C.twistChosenTripleCocycleIndex i j k l
    let cIJ := q.1.1.1
    let cJK := q.1.1.2
    let cIK := q.1.2.swap
    let W := q.2.affineOpen
    let hWi := q.2.affineOpen_le_A.trans cIJ.affineOpen_le_left
    let hWIK : W.1 ≤ cIK.affineOpen.1 := by
      simpa only [cIK, CommonBasicOpen.swap_affineOpen] using
        q.2.affineOpen_le_D
    let _ : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
    let _ : Finite (C.basisIndex j) := C.basisIndex_finite j
    let _ : Finite (C.basisIndex k) := C.basisIndex_finite k
    let _ : Module.Free Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1)) :=
      Module.Free.of_basis (C.restrictedSectionBasis i W.1 hWi)
    let _ : Module.Finite Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1)) :=
      Module.Finite.of_basis (C.restrictedSectionBasis i W.1 hWi)
    (cIJ.canonicalTwistComparisonFinalPullbackIso
        i W hWi q.2.affineOpen_le_A
        (cIJ.restrictionChartTo_isOpenImmersion
          i W hWi q.2.affineOpen_le_A)
        (cIJ.directRestrictionChartMap_left_isOpenImmersion
          i W hWi q.2.affineOpen_le_A)
        (cIJ.directRestrictionChartMap_right_isOpenImmersion
          i W hWi q.2.affineOpen_le_A) d).hom ≫
      (cJK.canonicalTwistComparisonFinalPullbackIso
        i W hWi q.2.affineOpen_le_B
        (cJK.restrictionChartTo_isOpenImmersion
          i W hWi q.2.affineOpen_le_B)
        (cJK.directRestrictionChartMap_left_isOpenImmersion
          i W hWi q.2.affineOpen_le_B)
        (cJK.directRestrictionChartMap_right_isOpenImmersion
          i W hWi q.2.affineOpen_le_B) d).hom =
      (cIK.canonicalTwistComparisonFinalPullbackIso
        i W hWi hWIK
        (cIK.restrictionChartTo_isOpenImmersion i W hWi hWIK)
        (cIK.directRestrictionChartMap_left_isOpenImmersion
          i W hWi hWIK)
        (cIK.directRestrictionChartMap_right_isOpenImmersion
          i W hWi hWIK) d).hom := by
  dsimp only
  let q := C.twistChosenTripleCocycleIndex i j k l
  let cIJ := q.1.1.1
  let cJK := q.1.1.2
  let cIK := q.1.2.swap
  let W := q.2.affineOpen
  let hWi := q.2.affineOpen_le_A.trans cIJ.affineOpen_le_left
  let hWIK : W.1 ≤ cIK.affineOpen.1 := by
    simpa only [cIK, CommonBasicOpen.swap_affineOpen] using
      q.2.affineOpen_le_D
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex j) := C.basisIndex_finite j
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex k) := C.basisIndex_finite k
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1)) :=
    Module.Free.of_basis (C.restrictedSectionBasis i W.1 hWi)
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1)) :=
    Module.Finite.of_basis (C.restrictedSectionBasis i W.1 hWi)
  rw [
    cIJ.canonicalTwistComparisonFinalPullbackIso_hom_eq
      i W hWi q.2.affineOpen_le_A
      (cIJ.restrictionChartTo_isOpenImmersion
        i W hWi q.2.affineOpen_le_A)
      (cIJ.directRestrictionChartMap_left_isOpenImmersion
        i W hWi q.2.affineOpen_le_A)
      (cIJ.directRestrictionChartMap_right_isOpenImmersion
        i W hWi q.2.affineOpen_le_A) d,
    cJK.canonicalTwistComparisonFinalPullbackIso_hom_eq
      i W hWi q.2.affineOpen_le_B
      (cJK.restrictionChartTo_isOpenImmersion
        i W hWi q.2.affineOpen_le_B)
      (cJK.directRestrictionChartMap_left_isOpenImmersion
        i W hWi q.2.affineOpen_le_B)
      (cJK.directRestrictionChartMap_right_isOpenImmersion
        i W hWi q.2.affineOpen_le_B) d,
    cIK.canonicalTwistComparisonFinalPullbackIso_hom_eq
      i W hWi hWIK
      (cIK.restrictionChartTo_isOpenImmersion i W hWi hWIK)
      (cIK.directRestrictionChartMap_left_isOpenImmersion
        i W hWi hWIK)
      (cIK.directRestrictionChartMap_right_isOpenImmersion
        i W hWi hWIK) d]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  simpa only [Category.assoc] using
    congrArg
      (fun z ↦
        (CommonBasicOpen.directTwistPullbackIso (C := C)
            i i W hWi
            (q.2.affineOpen_le_A.trans cIJ.affineOpen_le_left)
            (cIJ.directRestrictionChartMap_left_isOpenImmersion
              i W hWi q.2.affineOpen_le_A) d).hom ≫
          z ≫
        (CommonBasicOpen.directTwistPullbackIso (C := C)
            i k W hWi (hWIK.trans cIK.affineOpen_le_right)
            (cIK.directRestrictionChartMap_right_isOpenImmersion
              i W hWi hWIK) d).inv)
      (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_comp
        Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))
        (C.restrictedSectionBasis i W.1 hWi)
        (C.restrictedSectionBasis j W.1
          (q.2.affineOpen_le_A.trans cIJ.affineOpen_le_right))
        (C.restrictedSectionBasis k W.1
          (q.2.affineOpen_le_B.trans cJK.affineOpen_le_right))
        d)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistPullHomAux_pullHom_comp
statement:
theorem twistPullHomAux_pullHom_comp
    {A B K Y D : Scheme.{u}}
    {M : A.Modules} {N : B.Modules} {P : K.Modules}
    (f₁ : Y ⟶ A) (f₂ : Y ⟶ B) (f₃ : Y ⟶ K)
    (φ : (Scheme.Modules.pullback f₁).obj M ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback f₂).obj N)
    (ψ : (Scheme.Modules.pullback f₂).obj N ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback f₃).obj P)
    (g : D ⟶ Y) (gf₁ : D ⟶ A) (gf₂ : D ⟶ B) (gf₃ : D ⟶ K)
    (hgf₁ : g ≫ f₁ = gf₁) (hgf₂ : g ≫ f₂ = gf₂)
    (hgf₃ : g ≫ f₃ = gf₃) :
    Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
        (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
        φ g gf₁ gf₂ hgf₁ hgf₂ ≫
      Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
        (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
        ψ g gf₂ gf₃ hgf₂ hgf₃ =
      Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
        (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
        (φ ≫ ψ) g gf₁ gf₃ hgf₁ hgf₃
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom]
  simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistPullHomAux_twistChosenTripleLocalPullHom_comp
statement:
theorem twistPullHomAux_twistChosenTripleLocalPullHom_comp
    (d : ℤ) (i j k : C.I)
    (l : (C.twistChosenTripleCocycleCover i j k).I₀) :
    C.twistChosenTripleLocalPullHomIJ
          (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d) i j k l ≫
        C.twistChosenTripleLocalPullHomJK
          (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d) i j k l =
      C.twistChosenTripleLocalPullHomIK
        (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d) i j k l
proof:
:= by
  rw [twistPullHomAux_twistChosenTripleLocalPullHomIJ_eq_final C d i j k l,
    twistPullHomAux_twistChosenTripleLocalPullHomJK_eq_final C d i j k l,
    twistPullHomAux_twistChosenTripleLocalPullHomIK_eq_final C d i j k l]
  rw [twistPullHomAux_pullHom_comp]
  rw [twistPullHomAux_canonicalFinalComparisonHom_comp C d i j k l]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.chernOfCoverOn_transport_bundleIso
statement:
theorem chernOfCoverOn_transport_bundleIso (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    [Fact (Cl C'.scheme)] [Fact (Cl (AffineFrameCover.transport e C').scheme)]
    {r : ℕ} (hC' : ∀ i, Nat.card (C'.basisIndex i) = r + 1) :
    chernOfCoverOn ops (AffineFrameCover.transport e C') cp hC' =
      chernOfCoverOn ops C' cp hC'
proof:
:= by
  have hs : segreSeriesOn ops (AffineFrameCover.transport e C') cp hC' =
      segreSeriesOn ops C' cp hC' := by
    unfold segreSeriesOn
    refine congrArg PowerSeries.mk (funext fun i ↦ ?_)
    exact sandwichOn_eq_of_iso ops cp (AffineFrameCover.transport e C') C' hC' hC'
      (AffineFrameCover.transportSchemeIso e C')
      (AffineFrameCover.transportSchemeIso_toBase e C')
      (AffineFrameCover.transportTwistGlobalCompat e C') (r + i)
  funext i
  unfold chernOfCoverOn
  rw [hs]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.chernOpOn'_bundleIso
statement:
theorem chernOpOn'_bundleIso (e : E ≅ E') (r : ℕ)
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) (hE' : HasConstantRank X E' r) :
    chernOpOn' ops cp hP E r hE = chernOpOn' ops cp hP E' r hE'
proof:
:= by
  cases r with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ r =>
    let C' := (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hE').choose
    have hC' := (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hE').choose_spec
    haveI : Fact (Cl C'.scheme) := ⟨hP C' hC'⟩
    haveI : Fact (Cl (AffineFrameCover.transport e C').scheme) :=
      ⟨hP (AffineFrameCover.transport e C') (transportFrame_constantCard e C' hC')⟩
    rw [chernOpOn'_eq_chernOfCoverOn ops cp hP (AffineFrameCover.transport e C') hE
        (transportFrame_constantCard e C' hC'),
      chernOpOn'_eq_chernOfCoverOn ops cp hP C' hE' hC']
    exact chernOfCoverOn_transport_bundleIso ops cp e C' hC'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.constRankChernAssignOn'_iso
statement:
theorem constRankChernAssignOn'_iso [Nonempty X] (e : E ≅ E') :
    constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X E = constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X E'
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : ∃ r, Nonempty (HasConstantRank X E r)
  · obtain ⟨r, ⟨hE⟩⟩ := h
    have hE' := hasConstantRank_of_iso e hE
    rw [constRankChernAssignOn'_eq ops cp hP E r hE, constRankChernAssignOn'_eq ops cp hP E' r hE']
    exact chernOpOn'_bundleIso ops cp hP e r hE hE'
  · have h' : ¬ ∃ r, Nonempty (HasConstantRank X E' r) := fun ⟨r, ⟨hE'⟩⟩ ↦
      h ⟨r, ⟨hasConstantRank_of_iso e.symm hE'⟩⟩
    unfold constRankChernAssignOn'
    rw [dif_neg h, dif_neg h']

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.projBundle_pull_injectiveOn
statement:
theorem projBundle_pull_injectiveOn {e : ℕ} (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = e + 1) :
    haveI : Flat C.toBase
proof:
:= C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos e))
    Function.Injective (totalPullOn ops C.toBase e (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC)) := by
  haveI : Flat C.toBase := C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos e))
  intro α β h
  have h0 := segreOn_zero ops C cp hC
  have hα : segreOn ops C cp hC 0 α = α := by rw [h0]; rfl
  have hβ : segreOn ops C cp hC 0 β = β := by rw [h0]; rfl
  rw [← hα, ← hβ]
  change (totalPushOn ops C.toBase ∘ₗ ((xiCapOn ops C) ^ (e + 0)))
      (totalPullOn ops C.toBase e (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC) α) =
    (totalPushOn ops C.toBase ∘ₗ ((xiCapOn ops C) ^ (e + 0)))
      (totalPullOn ops C.toBase e (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC) β)
  rw [h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.exists_chowSplittingOn
statement:
theorem exists_chowSplittingOn (cp : ChowCompatOn ops) (hP : ProjBundleClosedPos Cl) (e : ℕ) :
    ∀ {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)]
      [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (Cl X)] [Nonempty X] (E : X.Modules),
      HasConstantRank X E (e + 1) → Nonempty (ChowSplittingOn ops E e)
proof:
:= by
  induction e with
  | zero =>
    intro X _ _ _ _ _ E hE
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hE
    haveI : Flat C.toBase := C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos 0))
    haveI : Fact (Cl C.scheme) := ⟨hP C hC⟩
    haveI : Nonempty C.scheme := by
      obtain ⟨x⟩ := ‹Nonempty X›
      obtain ⟨p, -⟩ := C.toBase_surjective_of_nonempty_basis
        (fun i _ ↦ C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos 0) i) x
      exact ⟨p⟩
    have hP' := hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase E 1 hE
    have hd0 := cp.projBundle_relDim C hC
    have hinj0 := projBundle_pull_injectiveOn ops C cp hC
    exact ⟨{
      Y := C.scheme, q := C.toBase, d := 0, hd := hd0, injective := hinj0,
      F := fun _ ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj E,
      L := fun _ ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj E,
      F_vb := fun _ ↦ hP'.isFiniteLocallyFree, L_line := fun _ ↦ hP', base := ⟨Iso.refl _⟩,
      step := fun i hi ↦ absurd hi (Nat.not_lt_zero i), top := ⟨Iso.refl _⟩ }⟩
  | succ e ih =>
    intro X _ _ _ _ _ E hE
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hE
    haveI : Flat C.toBase := C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos _))
    haveI : Fact (Cl C.scheme) := ⟨hP C hC⟩
    haveI : Nonempty C.scheme := by
      obtain ⟨x⟩ := ‹Nonempty X›
      obtain ⟨p, -⟩ := C.toBase_surjective_of_nonempty_basis
        (fun i _ ↦ C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos _) i) x
      exact ⟨p⟩
    have hK := C.hasConstantRank_tautologicalKernel hE
    obtain ⟨S⟩ := ih C.tautologicalKernel hK
    have hpE := hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase E (e + 1 + 1) hE
    have hO := C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1
    have hd : PureRelDim (S.q ≫ C.toBase) ((e + 1) + S.d) :=
      PureRelDim.comp S.hd (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC)
    have hinjq : Function.Injective (totalPullOn ops (S.q ≫ C.toBase) ((e + 1) + S.d) hd) := by
      rw [cp.pull_comp S.q C.toBase S.d (e + 1) S.hd (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC) hd,
        LinearMap.coe_comp]
      exact S.injective.comp (projBundle_pull_injectiveOn ops C cp hC)
    have hne : ∀ {i : ℕ}, i ≤ e → i ≠ e + 1 := fun h h' ↦ by omega
    refine ⟨{
      Y := S.Y, q := S.q ≫ C.toBase, d := (e + 1) + S.d, hd := hd,
      injective := hinjq,
      F := Function.update S.F (e + 1)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj E)),
      L := Function.update S.L (e + 1)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)),
      F_vb := ?_, L_line := ?_, base := ?_, step := ?_, top := ?_ }⟩
    · intro i
      rcases eq_or_ne i (e + 1) with rfl | hi
      · rw [Function.update_self]
        exact pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global _ _ hpE.isFiniteLocallyFree
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne hi]
        exact S.F_vb i
    · intro i
      rcases eq_or_ne i (e + 1) with rfl | hi
      · rw [Function.update_self]
        exact hasConstantRank_pullback _ S.q _ 1 hO
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne hi]
        exact S.L_line i
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne (hne (Nat.zero_le e)), Function.update_of_ne (hne (Nat.zero_le e))]
      exact S.base
    · intro i hi
      rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hi with hi | rfl
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne (hne hi.le), Function.update_of_ne (hne (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi)),
          Function.update_of_ne (hne (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi))]
        exact S.step i hi
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne (hne le_rfl), Function.update_self, Function.update_self]
        obtain ⟨φ⟩ := S.top
        haveI : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme C.tautologicalKernel := hK.isFiniteLocallyFree
        haveI : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj E) :=
          hpE.isFiniteLocallyFree
        haveI : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) := hO.isFiniteLocallyFree
        let T := ShortComplex.mk C.tautologicalKernelι C.tautologicalQuotient
          C.tautologicalKernelι_comp
        have hT := pullback_map_shortExact_global S.q T C.tautologicalKernel_shortExact
        refine ⟨φ.hom ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).map C.tautologicalKernelι,
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).map C.tautologicalQuotient, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, C.tautologicalKernelι_comp, Functor.map_zero,
            Limits.comp_zero]
        · refine ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso ?_ hT
          exact ShortComplex.isoMk φ.symm (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _)
            (by exact (φ.inv_hom_id_assoc _).trans (Category.comp_id _).symm)
            (by exact (Category.id_comp _).trans (Category.comp_id _).symm)
    · rw [Function.update_self]
      exact ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp S.q C.toBase).app E⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.whitneyConvOn_of_iso
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  rw [← hφ.iso ⟨eB⟩, ← hφ.iso ⟨eA⟩, ← hφ.iso ⟨eD⟩]
  exact h n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.whitneyConvOn_pull_convolution
statement:
theorem whitneyConvOn_pull_convolution (hφ : IsNaturalCharOn ops φ) [Nonempty X]
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} [Y.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian Y]
    [Fact (Cl Y)] [Nonempty Y] (g : Y ⟶ X) [g.IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat g]
    (d : ℕ) (hd : PureRelDim g d) {A D : X.Modules}
    (hA : IsFiniteLocallyFree X A) (hD : IsFiniteLocallyFree X D) (n : ℕ) :
    totalPullOn ops g d hd ∘ₗ (∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, φ X A p.1 ∘ₗ φ X D p.2) =
      ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n,
        φ Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj A) p.1 ∘ₗ
          φ Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj D) p.2 ∘ₗ totalPullOn ops g d hd
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro α
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ ↦ ?_
  have a := LinearMap.congr_fun (hφ.natural g d hd A hA p.1) (φ X D p.2 α)
  have b := LinearMap.congr_fun (hφ.natural g d hd D hD p.2) α
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at a b
  rw [a, b]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.whitneyConvOn_descent_splitting
statement:
theorem whitneyConvOn_descent_splitting (hφ : IsNaturalCharOn ops φ) [Nonempty X]
    {E : X.Modules} {e : ℕ} (S : ChowSplittingOn ops E e)
    {A B D : X.Modules} (hA : IsFiniteLocallyFree X A) (hB : IsFiniteLocallyFree X B)
    (hD : IsFiniteLocallyFree X D)
    (h : WhitneyConvOn (X := S.Y) φ ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj A)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj B) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj D)) :
    WhitneyConvOn (X := X) φ A B D
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro α
  apply S.injective
  have h1 := LinearMap.congr_fun (hφ.natural S.q S.d S.hd B hB n) α
  have h2 := LinearMap.congr_fun (whitneyConvOn_pull_convolution ops hφ S.q S.d S.hd hA hD n) α
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at h1 h2
  rw [h1, h2, h n]
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.whitneyOn_flag_of_lineSubOn
statement:
theorem whitneyOn_flag_of_lineSubOn (hφ : IsNaturalCharOn ops φ) (H : LineSubWhitneyOn φ)
    [Nonempty X] {E : X.Modules} {e : ℕ} (S : ChowSplittingOn ops E e) :
    ∀ i, i ≤ e → ∀ {B D : S.Y.Modules} (a : S.F i ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ D) (w : a ≫ b = 0),
      (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact → IsFiniteLocallyFree S.Y B → IsFiniteLocallyFree S.Y D →
      WhitneyConvOn (X := S.Y) φ (S.F i) B D
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    intro _ B D a b w h hB hD
    obtain ⟨e0⟩ := S.base
    exact H a b w h (hasConstantRank_of_iso e0.symm (S.L_line 0)) hB hD
  | succ i ih =>
    intro hi B D a b w h hB hD
    obtain ⟨f, g, wfg, hfg⟩ := S.step i (Nat.lt_of_succ_le hi)
    obtain ⟨B', u, v, wuv, L', D', p, q, wpq, h1, h2, ⟨eL⟩, ⟨eD⟩⟩ :=
      exists_quot_ses_E9 f g wfg hfg a b w h
    have hL' : HasConstantRank S.Y L' 1 := hasConstantRank_of_iso eL.symm (S.L_line (i + 1))
    have hD' : IsFiniteLocallyFree S.Y D' := isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso _ eD.symm hD
    have hB' : IsFiniteLocallyFree S.Y B' :=
      isFiniteLocallyFree_middle_E9 (ShortComplex.mk p q wpq) h2 hL'.isFiniteLocallyFree hD'
    have w1 := ih (Nat.le_of_succ_le hi) u v wuv h1 hB hB'
    have w2 := ih (Nat.le_of_succ_le hi) f g wfg hfg (S.F_vb (i + 1))
      (S.L_line (i + 1)).isFiniteLocallyFree
    have w3 := whitneyConvOn_of_iso ops hφ eL (Iso.refl B') eD (H p q wpq h2 hL' hB' hD')
    intro n
    exact convolution_step_E5 (fun n ↦ φ S.Y B n) (fun n ↦ φ S.Y (S.F i) n)
      (fun n ↦ φ S.Y B' n) (fun n ↦ φ S.Y (S.F (i + 1)) n) (fun n ↦ φ S.Y (S.L (i + 1)) n)
      (fun n ↦ φ S.Y D n) w1 w3 w2 n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.whitneyOn_posRank_of_lineSubOn
statement:
theorem whitneyOn_posRank_of_lineSubOn (cp : ChowCompatOn ops) (hP : ProjBundleClosedPos Cl)
    (hφ : IsNaturalCharOn ops φ) (H : LineSubWhitneyOn φ) [Nonempty X]
    {A B D : X.Modules} {e : ℕ}
    (hAr : HasConstantRank X A (e + 1)) (a : A ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ D) (w : a ≫ b = 0)
    (h : (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact)
    (hB : IsFiniteLocallyFree X B) (hD : IsFiniteLocallyFree X D) :
    WhitneyConvOn (X := X) φ A B D
proof:
:= by
  have hA := hAr.isFiniteLocallyFree
  obtain ⟨S⟩ := exists_chowSplittingOn ops cp hP e A hAr
  refine whitneyConvOn_descent_splitting ops hφ S hA hB hD ?_
  haveI : IsFiniteLocallyFree X A := hA
  haveI : IsFiniteLocallyFree X B := hB
  haveI : IsFiniteLocallyFree X D := hD
  have hT := pullback_map_shortExact_global S.q (ShortComplex.mk a b w) h
  obtain ⟨φt⟩ := S.top
  have hT' : (ShortComplex.mk (φt.hom ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).map a)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).map b) (by
        rw [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, w, Functor.map_zero, Limits.comp_zero])).ShortExact :=
    by
      refine ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso ?_ hT
      exact ShortComplex.isoMk φt.symm (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _)
        (by exact (φt.inv_hom_id_assoc _).trans (Category.comp_id _).symm)
        (by exact (Category.id_comp _).trans (Category.comp_id _).symm)
  have hqB := pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global S.q B hB
  have hqD := pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global S.q D hD
  have hF := whitneyOn_flag_of_lineSubOn ops hφ H S e le_rfl _ _ _ hT' hqB hqD
  exact whitneyConvOn_of_iso ops hφ φt (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) hF

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.hasConstantRank_of_isFiniteLocallyFree_of_preconnected
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_of_isFiniteLocallyFree_of_preconnected [PreconnectedSpace X]

proof:
:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.whitneyOn_of_lineSubWhitneyOn
statement:
theorem whitneyOn_of_lineSubWhitneyOn (cp : ChowCompatOn ops) (hP : ProjBundleClosedPos Cl)
    (hnat : FlatNaturalOn ops (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP))
    (H : LineSubWhitneyOn (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP)) [IsIntegral X]
    {A B D : X.Modules} (a : A ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ D) (w : a ≫ b = 0)
    (h : (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact) (hA : IsFiniteLocallyFree X A)
    (hB : IsFiniteLocallyFree X B) (hD : IsFiniteLocallyFree X D) :
    WhitneyConvOn (X := X) (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP) A B D
proof:
:= by
  have hφ : IsNaturalCharOn ops (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP) :=
    ⟨hnat, by
      intro X _ _ _ _ _ E E' h
      obtain ⟨e⟩ := h
      exact constRankChernAssignOn'_iso ops cp hP e⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hAr⟩ := hasConstantRank_of_isFiniteLocallyFree_of_preconnected hA
  cases r with
  | zero =>
    intro n
    letI := whitney_isIso_right_of_rank_zero a b w h hAr
    have hi := hφ.iso (X := X) ⟨asIso b⟩
    have hz : ∀ i, constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X A i = if i = 0 then 1 else 0 := by
      intro i
      rw [constRankChernAssignOn'_eq ops cp hP A 0 hAr]
      rfl
    rw [hi]
    simp only [hz]
    exact (whitney_delta_left (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X D) n).symm
  | succ e =>
    exact whitneyOn_posRank_of_lineSubOn ops cp hP hφ H hAr a b w h hB hD

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.whitneyOn_of_lineSubWhitneyOn_projectiveIntegral
statement:
theorem whitneyOn_of_lineSubWhitneyOn_projectiveIntegral [Infinite k]
    (hD31 : ∀ {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)]
      [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X)] {E : X.Modules}
      (C : AffineFrameCover X E), ∃ (N : ℕ) (j : C.scheme ⟶ space k N), IsClosedImmersion j)
    (hnat : FlatNaturalOn (chowOpsOn_projectiveIntegral k) (constRankChernAssignOn'
      (chowOpsOn_projectiveIntegral k) (chowCompatOn_projectiveIntegral k)
      (projBundleClosedPos_of_closedImmersion hD31)))
    (H : LineSubWhitneyOn (constRankChernAssignOn' (chowOpsOn_projectiveIntegral k)
      (chowCompatOn_projectiveIntegral k) (projBundleClosedPos_of_closedImmersion hD31)))
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X]
    [Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X)] {A B D : X.Modules} (a : A ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ D)
    (w : a ≫ b = 0) (h : (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact) (hA : IsFiniteLocallyFree X A)
    (hB : IsFiniteLocallyFree X B) (hD : IsFiniteLocallyFree X D) :
    WhitneyConvOn (constRankChernAssignOn' (chowOpsOn_projectiveIntegral k)
      (chowCompatOn_projectiveIntegral k) (projBundleClosedPos_of_closedImmersion hD31)) A B D
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIntegral X := (Fact.out : ProjectiveIntegral k X).1
  exact whitneyOn_of_lineSubWhitneyOn _ _ _ hnat H a b w h hA hB hD

theorem coordinate_pow_dvd_of_dvd_mul_coordinate_pow

    (h : coordinate k n i ^ r ∣ a * coordinate k n j ^ m) :

:=
