name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.exists_degreePieceChartFraction
statement:
theorem exists_degreePieceChartFraction (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (x : CoordinateChartRing k n i) :
    ∃ d, ∃ p : degreePiece k n d, degreePieceChartFraction k n d i p = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, p, hp, hpx⟩ := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_surjective
    (grading k n) (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) x
  refine ⟨d, ⟨p, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · simpa using hp
  · simpa only [degreePieceChartFraction] using hpx

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.degreePieceChartFraction_raise
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degreePieceChartFraction_raise (d r : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (p : degreePiece k n d) :
    degreePieceChartFraction k n (d + r) i
        (degreePieceChartFractionRaise k n d r i p) =
      degreePieceChartFraction k n d i p
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp only [degreePieceChartFraction, degreePieceChartFractionRaise,
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk]
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, Submonoid.coe_mul, pow_one]
  ring

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.exists_common_degreePieceChartFraction
statement:
theorem exists_common_degreePieceChartFraction
    (x : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), CoordinateChartRing k n i) :
    ∃ D, ∀ i, ∃ p : degreePiece k n D,
      degreePieceChartFraction k n D i p = x i
proof:
:= by
  choose d p hp using fun i ↦ exists_degreePieceChartFraction k n i (x i)
  let D := Finset.univ.sum d
  refine ⟨D, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  have hle : d i ≤ D := by
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ ↦ Nat.zero_le (d j)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hdeg : d i + (D - d i) = D := Nat.add_sub_of_le hle
  rw [← hdeg]
  refine ⟨degreePieceChartFractionRaise k n (d i) (D - d i) i (p i), ?_⟩
  rw [degreePieceChartFraction_raise]
  exact hp i

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.polynomial_relation_of_degreePieceChartFraction_overlap
statement:
theorem polynomial_relation_of_degreePieceChartFraction_overlap
    (d mi mj : ℕ) (i j : Fin (n + 1))
    (p : degreePiece k n mi) (q : degreePiece k n mj)
    (h : coordinateChartToOverlapLeft k n i j
          (degreePieceChartFraction k n mi i p) =
        (twistTransitionUnit k n (d : ℤ) i j : CoordinateOverlapRing k n i j) *
          coordinateChartToOverlapRight k n i j
            (degreePieceChartFraction k n mj j q)) :
    coordinate k n i ^ d * coordinate k n j ^ mj * p.1 =
      coordinate k n i ^ mi * coordinate k n j ^ d * q.1
proof:
:= by
  have hv := congrArg HomogeneousLocalization.val h
  unfold coordinateChartToOverlapLeft coordinateChartToOverlapRight
    degreePieceChartFraction HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk at hv
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_awayMap_mk] at hv
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul] at hv
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_awayMap_mk] at hv
  simp only [twistTransitionUnit, zpow_natCast] at hv
  change Localization.mk (p.1 * coordinate k n j ^ mi) _ =
    HomogeneousLocalization.val (coordinateOverlapRatio k n i j ^ d) *
      Localization.mk (q.1 * coordinate k n i ^ mj) _ at hv
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_pow] at hv
  unfold coordinateOverlapRatio HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk at hv
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mk] at hv
  rw [Localization.mk_pow, Localization.mk_mul] at hv
  have hM : Submonoid.powers (coordinateOverlapEquation k n i j) ≤
      nonZeroDivisors (Polynomial k n) :=
    MvPolynomial.powers_X_mul_X_le_nonZeroDivisors i j
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff,
    Localization.r_iff_of_le_nonZeroDivisors hM] at hv
  simp only [Submonoid.coe_mul, SubmonoidClass.coe_pow, pow_one] at hv
  change (p.1 * coordinate k n j ^ mi) *
      (coordinateOverlapEquation k n i j ^ d *
        coordinateOverlapEquation k n i j ^ mj) =
    coordinateOverlapEquation k n i j ^ mi *
      ((coordinate k n j ^ 2) ^ d * (q.1 * coordinate k n i ^ mj)) at hv
  have hc : coordinate k n i ^ mj * coordinate k n j ^ (d + mi) ∈
      nonZeroDivisors (Polynomial k n) :=
    MvPolynomial.X_pow_mul_X_pow_mem_nonZeroDivisors i j mj (d + mi)
  rw [← mul_cancel_left_mem_nonZeroDivisors hc]
  calc
    (coordinate k n i ^ mj * coordinate k n j ^ (d + mi)) *
        (coordinate k n i ^ d * coordinate k n j ^ mj * p.1) =
      (p.1 * coordinate k n j ^ mi) *
        (coordinateOverlapEquation k n i j ^ d *
          coordinateOverlapEquation k n i j ^ mj) := by
            simp only [coordinateOverlapEquation, pow_add]
            ring
    _ = coordinateOverlapEquation k n i j ^ mi *
        ((coordinate k n j ^ 2) ^ d *
          (q.1 * coordinate k n i ^ mj)) := hv
    _ = (coordinate k n i ^ mj * coordinate k n j ^ (d + mi)) *
        (coordinate k n i ^ mi * coordinate k n j ^ d * q.1) := by
          simp only [coordinateOverlapEquation, pow_add]
          ring

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinate_pow_dvd_degreePieceChartFraction_numerator_of_overlap
statement:
theorem coordinate_pow_dvd_degreePieceChartFraction_numerator_of_overlap
    {i j : Fin (n + 1)} (hij : i ≠ j) (d r mj : ℕ)
    (p : degreePiece k n (d + r)) (q : degreePiece k n mj)
    (h : coordinateChartToOverlapLeft k n i j
          (degreePieceChartFraction k n (d + r) i p) =
        (twistTransitionUnit k n (d : ℤ) i j : CoordinateOverlapRing k n i j) *
          coordinateChartToOverlapRight k n i j
            (degreePieceChartFraction k n mj j q)) :
    coordinate k n i ^ r ∣ p.1
proof:
:= by
  have hrel := polynomial_relation_of_degreePieceChartFraction_overlap
    k n d (d + r) mj i j p q h
  have hd : coordinate k n i ^ d ∈ nonZeroDivisors (Polynomial k n) :=
    MvPolynomial.X_pow_mem_nonZeroDivisors i d
  have hcancel : coordinate k n j ^ mj * p.1 =
      coordinate k n i ^ r * (coordinate k n j ^ d * q.1) := by
    rw [← mul_cancel_left_mem_nonZeroDivisors hd]
    convert hrel using 1 <;> ring
  apply coordinate_pow_dvd_of_dvd_mul_coordinate_pow k n hij r mj
  refine ⟨coordinate k n j ^ d * q.1, ?_⟩
  calc
    p.1 * coordinate k n j ^ mj = coordinate k n j ^ mj * p.1 := by ring
    _ = coordinate k n i ^ r * (coordinate k n j ^ d * q.1) := hcancel

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.degreePieceChartFractionLinear_injective
statement:
theorem degreePieceChartFractionLinear_injective (d : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Function.Injective (degreePieceChartFractionLinear k n d i)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpq
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hv := congrArg HomogeneousLocalization.val hpq
  simp only [degreePieceChartFractionLinear, degreePieceChartFraction,
    LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk] at hv
  have hM : Submonoid.powers (coordinate k n i) ≤
      nonZeroDivisors (Polynomial k n) :=
    MvPolynomial.powers_X_le_nonZeroDivisors i
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff,
    Localization.r_iff_of_le_nonZeroDivisors hM] at hv
  change p.1 * coordinate k n i ^ d = coordinate k n i ^ d * q.1 at hv
  have hd : coordinate k n i ^ d ∈ nonZeroDivisors (Polynomial k n) :=
    MvPolynomial.X_pow_mem_nonZeroDivisors i d
  rw [← mul_cancel_left_mem_nonZeroDivisors hd]
  simpa only [mul_comm] using hv

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.degreePieceChartFraction_overlap
statement:
theorem degreePieceChartFraction_overlap (d : ℕ) (i j : Fin (n + 1))
    (p : degreePiece k n d) :
    coordinateChartToOverlapLeft k n i j (degreePieceChartFraction k n d i p) =
      (twistTransitionUnit k n (d : ℤ) i j : CoordinateOverlapRing k n i j) *
        coordinateChartToOverlapRight k n i j (degreePieceChartFraction k n d j p)
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  unfold coordinateChartToOverlapLeft coordinateChartToOverlapRight
    degreePieceChartFraction HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_awayMap_mk]
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul]
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_awayMap_mk]
  simp only [twistTransitionUnit, zpow_natCast]
  change Localization.mk (p.1 * coordinate k n j ^ d) _ =
    HomogeneousLocalization.val (coordinateOverlapRatio k n i j ^ d) *
      Localization.mk (p.1 * coordinate k n i ^ d) _
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_pow]
  unfold coordinateOverlapRatio HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mk]
  rw [Localization.mk_pow, Localization.mk_mul]
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, Submonoid.coe_mul, pow_one]
  change coordinateOverlapEquation k n i j ^ d *
      coordinateOverlapEquation k n i j ^ d *
        (p.1 * coordinate k n j ^ d) =
    coordinateOverlapEquation k n i j ^ d *
      ((coordinate k n j ^ 2) ^ d * (p.1 * coordinate k n i ^ d))
  simp only [coordinateOverlapEquation]
  ring

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.degreePieceChartTuple_component
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degreePieceChartTuple_component (d : ℕ) (p : degreePiece k n d)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (Pi.π (fun j : Fin (n + 1) ↦
      pushedUnit (space k n) (coordinateOpen k n j)) i).app ⊤
        (degreePieceChartTuple k n d p) =
      degreePiecePushedChartSection k n d i p
proof:
:= by
  change ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (space k n).ringCatSheaf (op ⊤)).map
    (Pi.π (fun j : Fin (n + 1) ↦
      pushedUnit (space k n) (coordinateOpen k n j)) i))
        (degreePieceChartTuple k n d p) = _
  let E := SheafOfModules.evaluation (space k n).ringCatSheaf
    (op (⊤ : (space k n).Opens))
  let f := fun j : Fin (n + 1) ↦
    pushedUnit (space k n) (coordinateOpen k n j)
  have hIso : (PreservesProduct.iso E f).inv = inv (piComparison E f) := by
    apply (cancel_mono (PreservesProduct.iso E f).hom).1
    rw [Iso.inv_hom_id, PreservesProduct.iso_hom, IsIso.inv_hom_id]
  have h₁ : (PreservesProduct.iso E f).inv ≫ E.map (Pi.π f i) =
      Pi.π (fun j ↦ E.obj (f j)) i := by
    rw [hIso]
    exact inv_piComparison_comp_map_π E f i
  change (E.map (Pi.π f i))
      ((PreservesProduct.iso E f).inv
        ((ModuleCat.piIsoPi (fun j ↦ E.obj (f j))).inv
          (fun j ↦ degreePiecePushedChartSection k n d j p))) = _
  calc
    _ = (Pi.π (fun j ↦ E.obj (f j)) i)
        ((ModuleCat.piIsoPi (fun j ↦ E.obj (f j))).inv
          (fun j ↦ degreePiecePushedChartSection k n d j p)) := by
      exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom h₁
        ((ModuleCat.piIsoPi (fun j ↦ E.obj (f j))).inv
          (fun j ↦ degreePiecePushedChartSection k n d j p))
    _ = _ := ModuleCat.piIsoPi_inv_kernel_ι_apply
      (fun j ↦ E.obj (f j)) i _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateChartRegularSection_overlap_left
statement:
theorem coordinateChartRegularSection_overlap_left (i j : Fin (n + 1))
    (x : CoordinateChartRing k n i) :
    (space k n).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_left)).op
        (coordinateChartRegularSection k n i x) =
      (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (grading k n)
        (coordinateOverlapEquation k n i j)
        (coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two k n i j) (by omega)).hom
        (coordinateChartToOverlapLeft k n i j x)
proof:
:= by
  change (Proj.awayToSection (grading k n) (coordinate k n i) ≫
      (space k n).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_left)).op)
      x =
    Proj.awayToSection (grading k n) (coordinateOverlapEquation k n i j)
      ((CommRingCat.ofHom (coordinateChartToOverlapLeft k n i j)) x)
  simpa only [space, coordinateOverlapOpen, coordinateChartToOverlapLeft,
      ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] using
    (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (Proj.awayMap_awayToSection (grading k n)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n j)
        (show coordinateOverlapEquation k n i j =
          coordinate k n i * coordinate k n j by rfl))
      x).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateChartRegularSection_overlap_right
statement:
theorem coordinateChartRegularSection_overlap_right (i j : Fin (n + 1))
    (x : CoordinateChartRing k n j) :
    (space k n).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_right)).op
        (coordinateChartRegularSection k n j x) =
      (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (grading k n)
        (coordinateOverlapEquation k n i j)
        (coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two k n i j) (by omega)).hom
        (coordinateChartToOverlapRight k n i j x)
proof:
:= by
  change (Proj.awayToSection (grading k n) (coordinate k n j) ≫
      (space k n).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_right)).op)
      x =
    Proj.awayToSection (grading k n) (coordinateOverlapEquation k n i j)
      ((CommRingCat.ofHom (coordinateChartToOverlapRight k n i j)) x)
  simpa only [space, coordinateOverlapOpen, coordinateChartToOverlapRight,
      ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] using
    (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (Proj.awayMap_awayToSection (grading k n)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i)
        (show coordinateOverlapEquation k n i j =
          coordinate k n j * coordinate k n i by
            simp only [coordinateOverlapEquation]
            ring))
      x).symm

statement:
theorem degreePieceChartRegularSection_overlap_left (d : ℕ)
    (i j : Fin (n + 1)) (p : degreePiece k n d) :

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.degreePieceChartTuple_compatibility
statement:
theorem degreePieceChartTuple_compatibility (d : ℕ)
    (p : degreePiece k n d) :
    (coordinateDescentLeft k n).app ⊤ (degreePieceChartTuple k n d p) =
      (coordinateDescentRight k n (d : ℤ)).app ⊤
        (degreePieceChartTuple k n d p)
proof:
:= by
  let X := space k n
  let U : X.Opens := ⊤
  let E := SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op U)
  let f := fun ij : Fin (n + 1) × Fin (n + 1) ↦
    pushedUnit X (coordinateOverlapOpen k n ij.1 ij.2)
  let e : E.obj (coordinateOverlapCochains k n) ≅
      ModuleCat.of Γ(X, U) (∀ ij, ↑(E.obj (f ij))) :=
    PreservesProduct.iso E f ≪≫ ModuleCat.piIsoPi _
  let x : ↑(E.obj (coordinateOverlapCochains k n)) :=
    E.map (coordinateDescentLeft k n) (degreePieceChartTuple k n d p)
  let y : ↑(E.obj (coordinateOverlapCochains k n)) :=
    E.map (coordinateDescentRight k n (d : ℤ)) (degreePieceChartTuple k n d p)
  change x = y
  suffices h : e.hom x = e.hom y by
    calc
      x = e.inv (e.hom x) := by simp
      _ = e.inv (e.hom y) := congrArg e.inv h
      _ = y := by simp
  funext ij
  let q := ModuleCat.ofHom
    (LinearMap.proj ij : (∀ ij, ↑(E.obj (f ij))) →ₗ[Γ(X, U)] ↑(E.obj (f ij)))
  have hc : e.hom ≫ q = E.map (Pi.π f ij) := by
    dsimp [e, q]
    simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc,
      ModuleCat.piIsoPi_hom_ker_subtype, PreservesProduct.iso_hom,
      piComparison_comp_π]
  change q (e.hom x) = q (e.hom y)
  change (e.hom ≫ q) x = (e.hom ≫ q) y
  rw [hc]
  change ((coordinateDescentLeft k n ≫ Pi.π f ij).app U)
      (degreePieceChartTuple k n d p) =
    ((coordinateDescentRight k n (d : ℤ) ≫ Pi.π f ij).app U)
      (degreePieceChartTuple k n d p)
  dsimp only [f]
  simp only [coordinateDescentLeft, coordinateDescentRight, Pi.lift_π]
  change (pushedUnitRestriction
        ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n ij.1 ij.2).le.trans inf_le_left)).app U
      ((Pi.π (fun a : Fin (n + 1) ↦
        pushedUnit X (coordinateOpen k n a)) ij.1).app U
          (degreePieceChartTuple k n d p)) =
    (pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition k n (d : ℤ) ij.1 ij.2).app U
      ((pushedUnitRestriction
        ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n ij.1 ij.2).le.trans inf_le_right)).app U
        ((Pi.π (fun a : Fin (n + 1) ↦
          pushedUnit X (coordinateOpen k n a)) ij.2).app U
            (degreePieceChartTuple k n d p)))
  rw [degreePieceChartTuple_component, degreePieceChartTuple_component]
  let W := coordinateOverlapOpen k n ij.1 ij.2
  let P := W.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U
  let eW := W.ι.appIso P
  have qW : W.ι ''ᵁ P = W := by
    dsimp only [W, P, U]
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf,
      Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
    simp
  let qIso := X.presheaf.mapIso (eqToIso qW).op
  let sL : Γ(unitModules W.toScheme, P) :=
    (pushedUnitRestriction
      ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n ij.1 ij.2).le.trans inf_le_left)).app U
        (degreePiecePushedChartSection k n d ij.1 p)
  let sR : Γ(unitModules W.toScheme, P) :=
    (pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition k n (d : ℤ) ij.1 ij.2).app U
      ((pushedUnitRestriction
        ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n ij.1 ij.2).le.trans inf_le_right)).app U
          (degreePiecePushedChartSection k n d ij.2 p))
  change sL = sR
  let T : Γ(unitModules W.toScheme, P) → Γ(X, W) :=
    fun z ↦ qIso.inv (eW.inv z)
  suffices hT : T sL = T sR by
    calc
      sL = eW.hom (qIso.hom (T sL)) := by simp [T]
      _ = eW.hom (qIso.hom (T sR)) :=
        congrArg (fun z ↦ eW.hom (qIso.hom z)) hT
      _ = sR := by simp [T]
  dsimp only [T, sL, sR]
  simp only [pushedUnitRestriction_app_apply,
    pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition, Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app,
    coordinateOverlapTransitionIso]
  simp [unitMulSheafIso_hom_app_apply, degreePiecePushedChartSection,
    restrictTopUnit, Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso]
  dsimp only [eW, qIso]
  simp only [Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso, Iso.refl_inv]
  change (space k n).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n ij.1 ij.2).le.trans
        inf_le_left)).op
        (degreePieceChartRegularSection k n d ij.1 p) =
    (twistTransitionSectionUnit k n (d : ℤ) ij.1 ij.2).1 *
      (space k n).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n ij.1 ij.2).le.trans
          inf_le_right)).op
          (degreePieceChartRegularSection k n d ij.2 p)
  rw [degreePieceChartRegularSection_overlap_left,
    degreePieceChartRegularSection_overlap_right]
  unfold twistTransitionSectionUnit
  change (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (grading k n)
        (coordinateOverlapEquation k n ij.1 ij.2)
        (coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two k n ij.1 ij.2) (by omega)).hom
      (coordinateChartToOverlapLeft k n ij.1 ij.2
        (degreePieceChartFraction k n d ij.1 p)) =
    (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (grading k n)
        (coordinateOverlapEquation k n ij.1 ij.2)
        (coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two k n ij.1 ij.2) (by omega)).hom
      (twistTransitionUnit k n (d : ℤ) ij.1 ij.2 :
        CoordinateOverlapRing k n ij.1 ij.2) *
      (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (grading k n)
        (coordinateOverlapEquation k n ij.1 ij.2)
        (coordinateOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two k n ij.1 ij.2) (by omega)).hom
      (coordinateChartToOverlapRight k n ij.1 ij.2
        (degreePieceChartFraction k n d ij.2 p))
  rw [← map_mul]
  rw [degreePieceChartFraction_overlap]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.degreePieceChartRegularSection_add
statement:
theorem degreePieceChartRegularSection_add (d : ℕ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (p q : degreePiece k n d) :
    degreePieceChartRegularSection k n d i (p + q) =
      degreePieceChartRegularSection k n d i p +
        degreePieceChartRegularSection k n d i q
proof:
:= by
  change (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) Nat.zero_lt_one).hom
      (degreePieceChartFraction k n d i (p + q)) = _
  rw [show degreePieceChartFraction k n d i (p + q) =
      degreePieceChartFraction k n d i p + degreePieceChartFraction k n d i q by
    exact (degreePieceChartFractionLinear k n d i).map_add p q]
  exact map_add (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)
    (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) Nat.zero_lt_one).hom.hom
      (degreePieceChartFraction k n d i p)
      (degreePieceChartFraction k n d i q)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.degreePiecePushedChartSection_add
statement:
theorem degreePiecePushedChartSection_add (d : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (p q : degreePiece k n d) :
    degreePiecePushedChartSection k n d i (p + q) =
      degreePiecePushedChartSection k n d i p +
        degreePiecePushedChartSection k n d i q
proof:
:= by
  let U := coordinateOpen k n i
  change U.topIso.inv (degreePieceChartRegularSection k n d i (p + q)) =
    U.topIso.inv (degreePieceChartRegularSection k n d i p) +
      U.topIso.inv (degreePieceChartRegularSection k n d i q)
  rw [degreePieceChartRegularSection_add, map_add]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.degreePiecePushedChartSection_injective
statement:
theorem degreePiecePushedChartSection_injective (d : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Function.Injective (degreePiecePushedChartSection k n d i)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpq
  change (coordinateOpen k n i).topIso.inv
      (degreePieceChartRegularSection k n d i p) =
    (coordinateOpen k n i).topIso.inv
      (degreePieceChartRegularSection k n d i q) at hpq
  have hreg := ((ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective
    (coordinateOpen k n i).topIso.inv).mp inferInstance).injective hpq
  change (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) Nat.zero_lt_one).hom
      (degreePieceChartFraction k n d i p) =
    (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) Nat.zero_lt_one).hom
      (degreePieceChartFraction k n d i q) at hreg
  have hfrac := ((ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective
    (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (grading k n) (coordinate k n i)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n i) Nat.zero_lt_one).hom).mp
        inferInstance).injective hreg
  exact degreePieceChartFractionLinear_injective k n d i hfrac

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.degreePieceChartTuple_add
statement:
theorem degreePieceChartTuple_add (d : ℕ) (p q : degreePiece k n d) :
    degreePieceChartTuple k n d (p + q) =
      degreePieceChartTuple k n d p + degreePieceChartTuple k n d q
proof:
:= by
  let X := space k n
  let E := SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op (⊤ : X.Opens))
  let f := fun i : Fin (n + 1) ↦ pushedUnit X (coordinateOpen k n i)
  let e : E.obj (coordinateChartCochains k n) ≅
      ModuleCat.of Γ(X, ⊤) (∀ i, ↑(E.obj (f i))) :=
    PreservesProduct.iso E f ≪≫ ModuleCat.piIsoPi _
  change e.inv (fun i ↦ degreePiecePushedChartSection k n d i (p + q)) =
    e.inv (fun i ↦ degreePiecePushedChartSection k n d i p) +
      e.inv (fun i ↦ degreePiecePushedChartSection k n d i q)
  calc
    _ = e.inv ((fun i ↦ degreePiecePushedChartSection k n d i p) +
        (fun i ↦ degreePiecePushedChartSection k n d i q)) := by
      congr 1
      funext i
      exact degreePiecePushedChartSection_add k n d i p q
    _ = _ := e.inv.hom.map_add _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.degreePieceGlobalSection_kernel_ι
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degreePieceGlobalSection_kernel_ι (d : ℕ) (p : degreePiece k n d) :
    (kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n -
      coordinateDescentRight k n (d : ℤ))).app ⊤
        (degreePieceGlobalSection k n d p) =
      degreePieceChartTuple k n d p
proof:
:= by
  let X := space k n
  let E := SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op (⊤ : X.Opens))
  let φ := coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n (d : ℤ)
  change E.map (kernel.ι φ) (degreePieceGlobalSection k n d p) = _
  let hp : E.map φ (degreePieceChartTuple k n d p) = 0 := by
    change (coordinateDescentLeft k n).app ⊤
          (degreePieceChartTuple k n d p) -
        (coordinateDescentRight k n (d : ℤ)).app ⊤
          (degreePieceChartTuple k n d p) = 0
    rw [degreePieceChartTuple_compatibility]
    simp
  let z : ↑(kernel (E.map φ)) :=
    (ModuleCat.kernelIsoKer (E.map φ)).inv
      ⟨degreePieceChartTuple k n d p, hp⟩
  change E.map (kernel.ι φ)
      ((PreservesKernel.iso E φ).inv z) = _
  calc
    _ = (kernel.ι (E.map φ)) z := by
      exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (PreservesKernel.iso_inv_ι E φ) z
    _ = degreePieceChartTuple k n d p := by
      dsimp only [z]
      change (kernel.ι (E.map φ))
          ((ModuleCat.kernelIsoKer (E.map φ)).inv
            ⟨degreePieceChartTuple k n d p, hp⟩) =
        (E.map φ).hom.ker.subtype
          ⟨degreePieceChartTuple k n d p, hp⟩
      exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
        (ModuleCat.kernelIsoKer_inv_kernel_ι (E.map φ))
        ⟨degreePieceChartTuple k n d p, hp⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.degreePieceGlobalSection_injective
statement:
theorem degreePieceGlobalSection_injective (d : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (degreePieceGlobalSection k n d)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpq
  have ht := congrArg
    (fun s ↦ (kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n -
      coordinateDescentRight k n (d : ℤ))).app ⊤ s) hpq
  rw [degreePieceGlobalSection_kernel_ι,
    degreePieceGlobalSection_kernel_ι] at ht
  let i : Fin (n + 1) := ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ n⟩
  have hi := congrArg
    (fun s ↦ (Pi.π (fun j : Fin (n + 1) ↦
      pushedUnit (space k n) (coordinateOpen k n j)) i).app ⊤ s) ht
  rw [degreePieceChartTuple_component, degreePieceChartTuple_component] at hi
  exact degreePiecePushedChartSection_injective k n d i hi

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingGlobalSectionsCechKernelEquiv_apply_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem projectiveTwistingGlobalSectionsCechKernelEquiv_apply_val (d : ℤ)
    (s : projectiveTwistingTopSections k n d) :
    (projectiveTwistingGlobalSectionsCechKernelEquiv k n d s).1 =
      (kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)).app ⊤ s
proof:
:= by
  let X := space k n
  let E := SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op (⊤ : X.Opens))
  let φ := coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d
  unfold projectiveTwistingGlobalSectionsCechKernelEquiv
  change (kernel.ι (E.map φ)) ((PreservesKernel.iso E φ).hom s) =
    E.map (kernel.ι φ) s
  have h : (PreservesKernel.iso E φ).hom ≫ kernel.ι (E.map φ) =
      E.map (kernel.ι φ) := by
    apply (cancel_epi (PreservesKernel.iso E φ).inv).1
    rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
    exact (PreservesKernel.iso_inv_ι E φ).symm
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom h s

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotient_global_unit_basis
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotient_global_unit_basis (i : C.I) (k : C.basisIndex i) :
    C.tautologicalQuotient.app (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i)
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction C.toBase).unit.app E).app
        (C.U i) (C.sectionBasis i k)) = tautQuotient_t C i k
proof:
:= by
  have h : ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction C.toBase).homEquiv E
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)) C.tautologicalQuotient =
        C.tautologicalPushforwardHom := by
    unfold tautologicalQuotient
    exact Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _
  change ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction C.toBase).unit.app E ≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.toBase).map C.tautologicalQuotient).app
      (C.U i) (C.sectionBasis i k) = _
  erw [← Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, h]
  exact C.tautologicalPushforwardHom_app i k

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotient_openSquare_unit_hom_sections
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotient_openSquare_unit_hom_sections
    {X Y W V : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) (q : W ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (v : V ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion v] (h : W ⟶ V) (comm : q ≫ g = h ≫ v)
    (M : Y.Modules) (N : X.Modules) (f : (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj M ⟶ N)
    (U : Y.Opens) (s : M.val.obj (op U)) :
    let e
proof:
:= AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso g q v h comm
    let F := e.inv.app M ≫ (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map f
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr comm.symm).hom.app
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj N)).app U
      (F.app (h ⁻¹ᵁ v ⁻¹ᵁ U)
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction h).unit.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).obj M)).app (v ⁻¹ᵁ U)
          (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction v).unit.app M).app U s))) =
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map f).app (q ⁻¹ᵁ g ⁻¹ᵁ U)
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).unit.app
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj M)).app (g ⁻¹ᵁ U)
          (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app M).app U s)) := by
  dsimp only
  let e := AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso g q v h comm
  let F := e.inv.app M ≫ (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map f
  let x := ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction h).unit.app
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).obj M)).app (v ⁻¹ᵁ U)
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction v).unit.app M).app U s)
  have hn := congrArg (fun a => a.app U x)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr comm.symm).hom.naturality F)
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app,
    ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hn
  erw [hn]
  erw [Scheme.Modules.pullbackRestrictSquare_unit_sections g q v h comm M U s]
  have hc : e.hom.app M ≫ F = (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map f := by
    dsimp only [F]
    exact Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc e M _
  exact congrArg (fun a => a.app (q ⁻¹ᵁ g ⁻¹ᵁ U)
    (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).unit.app
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj M)).app (g ⁻¹ᵁ U)
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app M).app U s))) hc

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotient_chart_unit_basis_aux
statement:
private theorem pullbackTwistQuotient_chart_unit_basis_aux (i : C.I) (k : C.basisIndex i) [IsOpenImmersion (C.chartι i)] :
    let v
proof:
:= (C.U i).ι
    let p := C.chartToBase i
    let q := C.chartι i
    let comm := C.pullbackTwistOverlap_chartBase_comm i
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr comm.symm).hom.app
        (C.chartTwistingSheaf 1 i)).app (C.U i)
      ((C.pullbackTwistOverlap_chartCanonicalQuotient i).app (p ⁻¹ᵁ v ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i)
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p).unit.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).obj E)).app (v ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i)
          (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction v).unit.app E).app (C.U i)
            (C.sectionBasis i k)))) =
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 i).hom.app (q ⁻¹ᵁ C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i)
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).unit.app (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)).app
        (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i) (tautQuotient_t C i k)) := by
  dsimp only
  let q := C.chartι i
  let v := (C.U i).ι
  let p := C.chartToBase i
  let comm := C.pullbackTwistOverlap_chartBase_comm i
  let ρ := (C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 i).hom
  let e := AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso C.toBase q v p comm
  let x := ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p).unit.app
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor v).obj E)).app (v ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i)
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction v).unit.app E).app (C.U i)
        (C.sectionBasis i k))
  have h0 := pullbackTwistQuotient_openSquare_unit_hom_sections C.toBase q v p comm E
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) C.tautologicalQuotient (C.U i) (C.sectionBasis i k)
  dsimp only at h0
  have hn := congrArg (fun a => a.app (C.U i)
      ((e.inv.app E ≫ (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map C.tautologicalQuotient).app
        (p ⁻¹ᵁ v ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i) x))
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr comm.symm).hom.naturality ρ)
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app,
    ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hn
  have H := hn.trans (congrArg (fun y => ρ.app (q ⁻¹ᵁ C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i) y) h0)
  have hq := congrArg (fun a => a.app (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i)
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction C.toBase).unit.app E).app
        (C.U i) (C.sectionBasis i k)))
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).unit.naturality C.tautologicalQuotient)
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app,
    Functor.comp_map, Functor.id_map, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hq
  erw [← hq, C.pullbackTwistQuotient_global_unit_basis i k] at H
  simp only [pullbackTwistOverlap_chartCanonicalQuotient,
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  simp only [e, x, ρ, q, v, p, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage] at H
  convert H using 1
  congr 1

statement:

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotient_recovery_t_aux
statement:
private theorem pullbackTwistQuotient_recovery_t_aux (i : C.I) (k : C.basisIndex i)
    (W : (C.chart i).Opens) [IsOpenImmersion (C.chartι i)] (hW : C.chartι i ''ᵁ W ≤ C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i) :
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 i).hom.app W
      ((C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op
        (tautQuotient_t C i k)) =
    (C.chartTwistingSheaf 1 i).presheaf.map (homOfLE (show W ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op
      (tautQuotient_chartTaut C i k)
proof:
:= by
  erw [tautQuotient_t, tautQuotient_chartSection, ← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  have hψ : (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map
      ((eqToHom (tautQuotient_chartι_image_top C i).symm).op ≫ (homOfLE hW).op) =
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι i)).obj
        (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)).presheaf.map (homOfLE (show W ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op := by
    rw [Scheme.Modules.restrict_map]
    congr 1
  erw [hψ]
  refine (tautChart_app_map (C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 i).hom _ _).trans ?_
  congr 1
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, Iso.inv_hom_id]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotient_freeIso_inv_basis
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotient_freeIso_inv_basis {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (I : Type u) (k : I) (U : Y.Opens) :
    (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f I).inv.app (f ⁻¹ᵁ U)
      ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op (f ⁻¹ᵁ U))) =
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I)).app U
        ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op U))
proof:
:= by
  have h := SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerPullback.adjUnit_pullbackFreeIso_apply f I k (op U)
  change (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso f I).hom.app (f ⁻¹ᵁ U)
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I)).app U
        ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op U))) =
      (SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op (f ⁻¹ᵁ U)) at h
  erw [← h, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app,
    Iso.hom_inv_id]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotient_frameRestrict_inv_basis
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotient_frameRestrict_inv_basis (i : C.I) (k : C.basisIndex i) :
    (C.frameRestrictIso i).inv.app ((C.U i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i)
      ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op ((C.U i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i))) =
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction (C.U i).ι).unit.app E).app (C.U i)
      (C.sectionBasis i k)
proof:
:= by
  erw [← C.frameRestrictIso_unit_basis i k, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
    ← Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, Iso.hom_inv_id]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotient_freeFrame_basis
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotient_freeFrame_basis (i : C.I) (k : C.basisIndex i) :
    ((AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackFreeIso (C.chartToBase i) (C.basisIndex i)).inv ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (C.chartToBase i)).map (C.frameRestrictIso i).inv).app
        (C.chartToBase i ⁻¹ᵁ (C.U i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i)
      ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval
        (op (C.chartToBase i ⁻¹ᵁ (C.U i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i))) =
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (C.chartToBase i)).unit.app
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.U i).ι).obj E)).app ((C.U i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i)
        (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction (C.U i).ι).unit.app E).app (C.U i)
          (C.sectionBasis i k))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  erw [pullbackTwistQuotient_freeIso_inv_basis]
  have h := congrArg (fun a => a.app ((C.U i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i)
      ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op ((C.U i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i))))
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (C.chartToBase i)).unit.naturality
      (C.frameRestrictIso i).inv)
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app,
    Functor.comp_map, Functor.id_map, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at h
  erw [← h, C.pullbackTwistQuotient_frameRestrict_inv_basis i k]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotient_freeQuotient_basis_cast
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotient_freeQuotient_basis_cast (i : C.I) (k : C.basisIndex i) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (C.pullbackTwistOverlap_chartBase_comm i).symm).hom.app
      (C.chartTwistingSheaf 1 i)).app (C.U i)
      ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (X := C.chart i)
        (C.pullbackTwistOverlap_chartCanonicalFreeQuotient i))
        (C.chartToBase i ⁻¹ᵁ (C.U i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i)
        ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval
          (op (C.chartToBase i ⁻¹ᵁ (C.U i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i)))) =
    (C.chartTwistingSheaf 1 i).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (show C.chartι i ⁻¹ᵁ C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op
      (tautQuotient_chartTaut C i k)
proof:
:= by
  have h := C.pullbackTwistQuotient_chart_unit_basis i k
  dsimp only at h
  have ht := C.pullbackTwistQuotient_recovery_t i k
    (C.chartι i ⁻¹ᵁ C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i)
    ((C.chartι i).image_preimage_le (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i))
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app] at h
  have hRecovered := h.trans ht
  let T : (C.chart i).Modules := C.chartTwistingSheaf 1 i
  let Q : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (C.chartToBase i)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.U i).ι).obj E) ⟶ T :=
    C.pullbackTwistOverlap_chartCanonicalQuotient i
  have hf := congrArg (fun x =>
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (C.pullbackTwistOverlap_chartBase_comm i).symm).hom.app
      (C.chartTwistingSheaf 1 i)).app (C.U i)
      (Q.app (C.chartToBase i ⁻¹ᵁ (C.U i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i) x))
    (C.pullbackTwistQuotient_freeFrame_basis i k)
  have H := hf.trans hRecovered
  convert H using 1
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotient_basis_cast_normalize
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotient_basis_cast_normalize {S : Scheme.{u}}
    (F G : S.Modules) (f : F ⟶ G) (s : F.sections) (t : Γ(G, ⊤))
    (U V : S.Opens) (hU : U = ⊤) (hV : V = ⊤) (ψ : op U ⟶ op V)
    (h : G.presheaf.map ψ (f.app U (s.eval (op U))) =
      G.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show V ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op t) :
    f.app ⊤ (s.eval (op ⊤)) = t
proof:
:= by
  subst U
  subst V
  rw [Subsingleton.elim ψ (𝟙 _)] at h
  simpa only [homOfLE_refl, op_id, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id,
    ConcreteCategory.id_apply] using h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotient_freeQuotient_basis_top
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotient_freeQuotient_basis_top (i : C.I) (k : C.basisIndex i) :
    (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (X := C.chart i)
      (C.pullbackTwistOverlap_chartCanonicalFreeQuotient i)) ⊤
      ((SheafOfModules.freeSection k).eval (op ⊤)) = tautQuotient_chartTaut C i k
proof:
:= by
  have h := C.pullbackTwistQuotient_freeQuotient_basis_cast i k
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr_hom_app_app] at h
  exact pullbackTwistQuotient_basis_cast_normalize
    (SheafOfModules.free (R := (C.chart i).ringCatSheaf) (C.basisIndex i))
    (C.chartTwistingSheaf 1 i) (C.pullbackTwistOverlap_chartCanonicalFreeQuotient i)
    (SheafOfModules.freeSection k) (tautQuotient_chartTaut C i k)
    (C.chartToBase i ⁻¹ᵁ (C.U i).ι ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i)
    (C.chartι i ⁻¹ᵁ C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i)
    (C.pullbackTwistQuotient_chart_local_top i) (C.pullbackTwistQuotient_chart_global_top i)
    _ h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotient_tau_eq_of_basis
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotient_tau_eq_of_basis
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M] {ι : Type u} [Finite ι]

      (tautChart_tautHom R M b (b k)).app ⊤

:= by
