name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.symIdeal_span_single
statement:
theorem symIdeal_span_single (n : M) :
    E12.symIdeal (R ∙ n) = Ideal.span {SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M n}
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [E12.symIdeal, Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hm
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, map_smul, Algebra.smul_def]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.subset_span rfl)
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ rfl
    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨n, Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.ker_symmetricAlgebraMap_of_surjective
proof:
:= by
  let N : Submodule R M := R ∙ n
  let e1 : (M ⧸ N) ≃ₗ[R] M' :=
    (Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ hker.symm).trans (LinearMap.quotKerEquivOfSurjective φ hφ)
  have hcomp : (e1 : (M ⧸ N) →ₗ[R] M').restrictScalars R ∘ₗ N.mkQ = φ := by
    ext m; simp [e1, N]
  have key : ∀ x, symmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) φ x =
      symmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) e1.toLinearMap (symmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) N.mkQ x) := by
    intro x
    have h := congrArg (fun F => F x)
      (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap_comp (R := R) (S := R) (T := R) N.mkQ
        (e1 : (M ⧸ N) →ₗ[R] M'))
    rw [hcomp] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hinj : Function.Injective (symmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) e1.toLinearMap) :=
    (rankTwo_symmetricAlgebraEquiv R e1).injective
  rw [← symIdeal_span_single, ← E12.ker_symmetricAlgebraMap_mkQ_E12]
  ext x
  simp only [RingHom.mem_ker, key]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact hinj (h.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  · intro h
    rw [h, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.isRegular_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem isRegular_ringEquiv {A B : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (e : A ≃+* B) {a : A}
    (h : IsRegular a) : IsRegular (e a)
proof:
:= by
  apply (Commute.isRegular_iff (Commute.all _)).mpr
  intro x y hxy
  have h1 : a * e.symm x = a * e.symm y := by
    have := congrArg e.symm hxy
    simpa using this
  have h2 := h.left h1
  exact e.symm.injective h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.isRegular_of_span_eq
statement:
theorem isRegular_of_span_eq {A : Type*} [CommRing A] {c c' : A}
    (h : Ideal.span {c} = Ideal.span {c'}) (hc' : IsRegular c') : IsRegular c
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : c ∈ Ideal.span {c'} := h ▸ Ideal.subset_span rfl
  have h2 : c' ∈ Ideal.span {c} := h ▸ Ideal.subset_span rfl
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp h1   
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp h2   
  have hab : b * a = 1 := by
    have : (b * a - 1) * c' = 0 := by
      calc (b * a - 1) * c' = b * (a * c') - c' := by ring
        _ = b * c - c' := by rw [ha]
        _ = 0 := by rw [hb]; ring
    have h3 := hc'.right (show (b * a - 1) * c' = 0 * c' by rw [this]; ring)
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp h3
  have hunit : IsUnit a := IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one b (by rw [mul_comm]; exact hab)
  rw [← ha]
  exact IsRegular.mul hunit.isRegular hc'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.isRegular_algebraMap_of_isLocalization
statement:
theorem isRegular_algebraMap_of_isLocalization {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra R S] (M : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization M S] {c : R} (hc : IsRegular c) :
    IsRegular (algebraMap R S c)
proof:
:= by
  apply (Commute.isRegular_iff (Commute.all _)).mpr
  intro x y hxy
  have hxy' : algebraMap R S c * x = algebraMap R S c * y := hxy
  have hz : algebraMap R S c * (x - y) = 0 := by rw [mul_sub, hxy', sub_self]
  obtain ⟨⟨a, m⟩, hm⟩ := IsLocalization.surj M (x - y)
  have h1 : algebraMap R S (c * a) = 0 := by
    rw [map_mul]
    have : (x - y) * algebraMap R S (m : R) = algebraMap R S a := hm
    rw [← this]
    calc algebraMap R S c * ((x - y) * algebraMap R S m) =
        (algebraMap R S c * (x - y)) * algebraMap R S m := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [hz, zero_mul]
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := (IsLocalization.map_eq_zero_iff M S _).mp h1
  have h2 : c * ((t : R) * a) = c * 0 := by
    calc c * ((t : R) * a) = (t : R) * (c * a) := by ring
      _ = 0 := ht
      _ = c * 0 := by ring
  have h3 : (t : R) * a = 0 := hc.left h2
  have h4 : algebraMap R S a = 0 := by
    have := (IsLocalization.map_eq_zero_iff M S a).mpr ⟨t, h3⟩
    exact this
  have h5 : (x - y) * algebraMap R S (m : R) = 0 := by
    have : (x - y) * algebraMap R S (m : R) = algebraMap R S a := hm
    rw [this, h4]
  have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap R S (m : R)) := IsLocalization.map_units S m
  have h6 : x - y = 0 := by
    obtain ⟨u, hu'⟩ := hu
    have : (x - y) * (u : S) = 0 := by rw [hu']; exact h5
    calc x - y = (x - y) * (u : S) * (↑u⁻¹ : S) := by simp
      _ = 0 := by rw [this, zero_mul]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp h6

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.chart_kernel_ideal
statement:
theorem chart_kernel_ideal (φ : M →ₗ[R] M') (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (n : M) (hker : LinearMap.ker φ = R ∙ n) (x : M) :
    (symmetricProjMap (S := R) φ (span_range_of_surjective hφ)).ker.ideal
      ⟨linearOpen R M x, Proj.isAffineOpen_basicOpen _ _
        (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M x) Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ =
      Ideal.span {tautChart_ratioSection R M x n}
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion (symmetricProjMap (S := R) φ (span_range_of_surjective hφ)) :=
    isClosedImmersion_symmetricProjMap_of_surjective hφ
  haveI : QuasiCompact (Proj.map (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) φ)
      (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ (span_range_of_surjective hφ))) :=
    inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact (symmetricProjMap (S := R) φ (span_range_of_surjective hφ)))
  have hk : RingHom.ker (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) φ).toRingHom =
      Ideal.span {linearForm R M n} := ker_symmetricAlgebraMap_of_surjective φ hφ n hker
  exact rankTwo_proj_kernel_basicOpen (symGrading R M) (symGrading R M')
    (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) φ)
    (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ (span_range_of_surjective hφ))
    (linearForm R M n) (linearForm R M x) (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M n)
    (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M x) hk

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.ratio_isRegular
statement:
theorem ratio_isRegular (φ : M →ₗ[R] M') (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (n : M) (hker : LinearMap.ker φ = R ∙ n) (hinj : Function.Injective fun r : R => r • n)
    (x : M) : IsRegular (tautChart_ratio R M x n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_adapted_basis φ hφ n hker hinj
  have hs : IsRegular (linearForm R M n) := by
    have := rankTwo_symmetric_basis_coordinate_isRegular R b (Sum.inl PUnit.unit)
    rw [hb] at this
    exact this
  exact rankTwo_awayEquation_isRegular R (symGrading R M) (linearForm R M n) (linearForm R M x)
    (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M n) (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M x) hs

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.ratioSection_isRegular
statement:
theorem ratioSection_isRegular (φ : M →ₗ[R] M') (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (n : M) (hker : LinearMap.ker φ = R ∙ n) (hinj : Function.Injective fun r : R => r • n)
    (x : M) : IsRegular (tautChart_ratioSection R M x n)
proof:
:= by
  have h := ratio_isRegular φ hφ n hker hinj x
  let e := (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (symGrading R M) (linearForm R M x)
    (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M x) Nat.zero_lt_one).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  exact isRegular_ringEquiv e h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.jHom_ker_ideal_chart
statement:
theorem jHom_ker_ideal_chart (i : P.I) (n x : B.val.obj (op (P.U i)))
    (hker : LinearMap.ker (secMap b (P.U i)) = Γ(X, P.U i) ∙ n) :
    P.jHom.ker.ideal (chartImage P i x) =
      Ideal.span {((P.toB.chartι i).appIso
        (linearOpen Γ(X, P.U i) (B.val.obj (op (P.U i))) x)).inv.hom
          (tautChart_ratioSection Γ(X, P.U i) (B.val.obj (op (P.U i))) x n)}
proof:
:= by
  let R := Γ(X, P.U i)
  let M := B.val.obj (op (P.U i))
  let W : (P.toB.chart i).affineOpens :=
    ⟨linearOpen R M x, Proj.isAffineOpen_basicOpen _ _
      (linearForm_mem_degree_one _ _ x) Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (P.toB.chartι i) := AffineFrameCover.chartι_isOpenImmersion P.toB i
  have h := Scheme.ker_ideal_of_isPullback_of_isOpenImmersion
    P.jHom (P.chartMap i) (P.toD.chartι i) (P.toB.chartι i) (P.isPullback_chart i) W
  have hspan := h.symm.trans (chart_kernel_ideal (secMap b (P.U i)) (P.surj i) n hker x)
  have hm := congrArg (Ideal.map ((P.toB.chartι i).appIso W).inv.hom) hspan
  have hcancel : Ideal.map ((P.toB.chartι i).appIso W).inv.hom
      ((P.jHom.ker.ideal
        ⟨P.toB.chartι i ''ᵁ W, W.2.image_of_isOpenImmersion _⟩).comap
          ((P.toB.chartι i).appIso W).inv.hom) =
      P.jHom.ker.ideal ⟨P.toB.chartι i ''ᵁ W, W.2.image_of_isOpenImmersion _⟩ :=
    Ideal.map_comap_eq_self_of_equiv ((P.toB.chartι i).appIso W).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv _
  rw [hcancel] at hm
  refine hm.trans ?_
  exact (Ideal.map_span _ _).trans (congrArg Ideal.span Set.image_singleton)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.chartImage_cover
statement:
theorem chartImage_cover :
    ⨆ ik : (Σ i : P.I, P.basisB i),
      (chartImage P ik.1 ((P.toB.sectionBasis ik.1) ik.2)).1 = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro x _
  let i := P.toB.cover.idx x
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := P.toB.cover.covers x
  have htop : z ∈ ⨆ k : P.basisB i,
      linearOpen Γ(X, P.U i) (B.val.obj (op (P.U i))) ((P.toB.sectionBasis i) k) := by
    letI : Finite (P.basisB i) := P.finB i
    rw [linearOpen_iSup_eq_top]
    trivial
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp htop
  exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨i, k⟩, z, hk, hz⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.unit_W
statement:
theorem unit_W (P : PresheafOfModules.{u} (Y.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)) :
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y).W
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map
        ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).unit.app P))
proof:
:= by
  let adj := PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (structurePresheafId Y)
  change ((Opens.grothendieckTopology Y).W.inverseImage (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _))
    (adj.unit.app P)
  rw [PresheafOfModules.inverseImage_W_toPresheaf_eq_inverseImage_isomorphisms
    (structurePresheafId Y)]
  change IsIso ((PresheafOfModules.sheafification (structurePresheafId Y)).map (adj.unit.app P))
  exact isIso_of_comp_hom_eq_id (adj.counit.app ((PresheafOfModules.sheafification
    (structurePresheafId Y)).obj P)) (adj.left_triangle_components P)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.phiPre_psiPre
statement:
theorem phiPre_psiPre {V : Y.Opens} (e : N.over V ≅ (unitMod Y).over V)
    (x : (underlyingCommPresheaf Y Q).obj (op V)) :
    (phiPreHom e).hom (psiPre e x) = x
proof:
:= by
  change (evalAt N V (localGen e) e.hom : Γ(Y, V)) • x = x
  rw [evalAt_localGen, one_smul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.psiPre_add
statement:
theorem psiPre_add {V : Y.Opens} (e : N.over V ≅ (unitMod Y).over V)
    (x y : (underlyingCommPresheaf Y Q).obj (op V)) :
    psiPre e (x + y) = psiPre e x + psiPre e y
proof: := TensorProduct.add_tmul _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.psiPre_zero
statement:
theorem psiPre_zero {V : Y.Opens} (e : N.over V ≅ (unitMod Y).over V) :
    psiPre (Q := Q) e 0 = 0
proof: := TensorProduct.zero_tmul _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.psiPre_phiPre
statement:
theorem psiPre_phiPre {V : Y.Opens} (e : N.over V ≅ (unitMod Y).over V)
    (t : (PQ N Q).obj (op V)) : psiPre e ((phiPreHom e).hom t) = t
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    exact (congrArg (psiPre e) (map_zero _)).trans (psiPre_zero e)
  | add x y hx hy =>
    exact (congrArg (psiPre e) (map_add _ _ _)).trans
      ((psiPre_add e _ _).trans (congrArg₂ (· + ·) hx hy))
  | tmul m f =>
    change psiPre e ((evalAt N V (localGen e) f : Γ(Y, V)) • m) = TensorProduct.tmul _ m f
    have hf := hom_eq_smul e f
    let c' : (Y.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).obj (op V) := evalAt N V (localGen e) f
    change TensorProduct.tmul _ (c' • m) (show (underlyingCommPresheaf Y (lineBundleDual Y N)).obj (op V) from e.hom) = _
    rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul]
    refine congrArg (TensorProduct.tmul _ m) ?_
    exact hf.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.psiPre_restrict
statement:
theorem psiPre_restrict {V W : Y.Opens} (h : W ≤ V) (e : N.over V ≅ (unitMod Y).over V)
    (x : (underlyingCommPresheaf Y Q).obj (op V)) :
    (PQ N Q).map (homOfLE h).op (psiPre e x) =
      psiPre (resIso h e) ((underlyingCommPresheaf Y Q).map (homOfLE h).op x)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.psi_restrict
statement:
theorem psi_restrict {V W : Y.Opens} (h : W ≤ V) (e : N.over V ≅ (unitMod Y).over V)
    (x : Q.val.obj (op V)) :
    (tensorSheaf Y Q (lineBundleDual Y N)).val.map (homOfLE h).op (psi e x) =
      psi (resIso h e) (Q.val.map (homOfLE h).op x)
proof:
:=
  (PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply
    ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).unit.app (PQ N Q)) (homOfLE h).op (psiPre e x)).symm.trans
    (congrArg (fun t => (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).unit.app (PQ N Q)).app (op W)).hom t)
      (psiPre_restrict h e x))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.psi_eq_zero
statement:
theorem psi_eq_zero {V : Y.Opens} (e : N.over V ≅ (unitMod Y).over V)
    (x : Q.val.obj (op V)) (h : psi e x = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  let η := (moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).unit.app (PQ N Q)
  let φ := (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map η
  haveI := (unit_W (PQ N Q)).isLocallyInjective
  have hmem := Presheaf.equalizerSieve_mem (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) φ
    (show (PQ N Q).obj (op V) from psiPre e x) (0 : (PQ N Q).obj (op V))
    (by
      have h0 : (η.app (op V)).hom (0 : (PQ N Q).obj (op V)) = 0 := map_zero _
      exact h.trans h0.symm)
  rw [Opens.mem_grothendieckTopology] at hmem
  choose W f hf hp using fun p : V => hmem p.1 p.2
  let T : TopCat.Sheaf Ab Y := ⟨Q.presheaf, Q.isSheaf⟩
  refine T.eq_of_locally_eq' W V f ?_ x 0 ?_
  · intro y hy
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hp ⟨y, hy⟩⟩
  · intro p
    have hf' := hf p
    have hfe : f p = homOfLE (f p).le := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [hfe] at hf' ⊢
    change (PQ N Q).map (homOfLE (f p).le).op (psiPre e x) =
      (PQ N Q).map (homOfLE (f p).le).op 0 at hf'
    rw [psiPre_restrict] at hf'
    have h2 := congrArg (fun t => (phiPreHom (resIso (f p).le e)).hom t) hf'
    simp only [] at h2
    rw [phiPre_psiPre] at h2
    refine h2.trans ?_
    exact (congrArg (fun t => (phiPreHom (resIso (f p).le e)).hom t) (map_zero _)).trans
      ((map_zero _).trans (map_zero _).symm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.resIso_resIso
statement:
theorem resIso_resIso {U V W : Y.Opens} (h1 : V ≤ U) (h2 : W ≤ V)
    (e : N.over U ≅ (unitMod Y).over U) :
    resIso h2 (resIso h1 e) = resIso (h2.trans h1) e
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  exact Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_trans Y h2 h1 e.hom

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.psi_add
statement:
theorem psi_add {V : Y.Opens} (e : N.over V ≅ (unitMod Y).over V)
    (x y : Q.val.obj (op V)) : psi e (x + y) = psi e x + psi e y
proof:
:= by
  unfold psi
  exact (congrArg _ (psiPre_add e x y)).trans (map_add _ _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.psi_zero
statement:
theorem psi_zero {V : Y.Opens} (e : N.over V ≅ (unitMod Y).over V) :
    psi (Q := Q) e 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold psi
  exact (congrArg _ (psiPre_zero e)).trans (map_zero _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.psi_sub
statement:
theorem psi_sub {V : Y.Opens} (e : N.over V ≅ (unitMod Y).over V)
    (x y : Q.val.obj (op V)) : psi e (x - y) = psi e x - psi e y
proof:
:= by
  have h : psi e (x - y) + psi e y = psi e x := by
    rw [← psi_add, sub_add_cancel]
  exact eq_sub_of_add_eq h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.psi_injective
statement:
theorem psi_injective {V : Y.Opens} (e : N.over V ≅ (unitMod Y).over V) :
    Function.Injective (psi (Q := Q) e)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  have : psi e (x - y) = 0 := by rw [psi_sub, h, sub_self]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (psi_eq_zero e _ this)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.psi_res_res
statement:
theorem psi_res_res {V W O : Y.Opens} (h1 : W ≤ V) (h2 : O ≤ W)
    (e : N.over V ≅ (unitMod Y).over V) (x : Q.val.obj (op W)) :
    psi (resIso (h2.trans h1) e) (Q.val.map (homOfLE h2).op x) =
      (tensorSheaf Y Q (lineBundleDual Y N)).val.map (homOfLE h2).op (psi (resIso h1 e) x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [psi_restrict h2 (resIso h1 e) x, resIso_resIso]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.psi_surjective
statement:
theorem psi_surjective {V : Y.Opens} (e : N.over V ≅ (unitMod Y).over V) :
    Function.Surjective (psi (Q := Q) e)
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  let η := (moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).unit.app (PQ N Q)
  let φ := (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map η
  haveI := (unit_W (PQ N Q)).isLocallySurjective
  have hmem := Presheaf.imageSieve_mem (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) φ
    (show (tensorSheaf Y Q (lineBundleDual Y N)).val.obj (op V) from m)
  rw [Opens.mem_grothendieckTopology] at hmem
  choose W f hf hp using fun p : V => hmem p.1 p.2
  choose t ht using hf
  have hle : ∀ p : V, W p ≤ V := fun p => (f p).le
  let x : ∀ p : V, Q.val.obj (op (W p)) := fun p => (phiPreHom (resIso (hle p) e)).hom (t p)
  have hfe : ∀ p : V, f p = homOfLE (hle p) := fun p => Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hx : ∀ p : V, psi (resIso (hle p) e) (x p) =
      (tensorSheaf Y Q (lineBundleDual Y N)).val.map (homOfLE (hle p)).op m := by
    intro p
    have h1 := ht p
    rw [hfe p] at h1
    exact (congrArg (fun z => (η.app (op (W p))).hom z)
      (psiPre_phiPre (resIso (hle p) e) (t p))).trans h1
  have hcov : V ≤ ⨆ p : V, W p := by
    intro y hy
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hp ⟨y, hy⟩⟩
  let T : TopCat.Sheaf Ab Y := ⟨Q.presheaf, Q.isSheaf⟩
  have hcomp : TopCat.Presheaf.IsCompatible T.1 W x := by
    intro p q
    have hO : W p ⊓ W q ≤ V := inf_le_left.trans (hle p)
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    apply psi_eq_zero (resIso hO e)
    have hz : psi (resIso hO e) (Q.val.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : W p ⊓ W q ≤ W p)).op (x p)) =
        psi (resIso hO e) (Q.val.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : W p ⊓ W q ≤ W q)).op (x q)) := by
      have e1 := psi_res_res (hle p) (inf_le_left : W p ⊓ W q ≤ W p) e (x p)
      have e2 := psi_res_res (hle q) (inf_le_right : W p ⊓ W q ≤ W q) e (x q)
      rw [hx p] at e1
      rw [hx q] at e2
      refine e1.trans (Eq.trans ?_ e2.symm)
      rw [← PresheafOfModules.map_comp_apply, ← PresheafOfModules.map_comp_apply]
      rfl
    exact (psi_sub (resIso hO e) _ _).trans (sub_eq_zero.mpr hz)
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := T.existsUnique_gluing' W V (fun p => homOfLE (hle p)) hcov x hcomp
  refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
  let S : TopCat.Sheaf Ab Y :=
    ⟨(tensorSheaf Y Q (lineBundleDual Y N)).presheaf, (tensorSheaf Y Q (lineBundleDual Y N)).isSheaf⟩
  refine S.eq_of_locally_eq' W V (fun p => homOfLE (hle p)) hcov _ _ ?_
  intro p
  have h1 := psi_restrict (hle p) e y
  have h2 : Q.val.map (homOfLE (hle p)).op y = x p := hy p
  change (tensorSheaf Y Q (lineBundleDual Y N)).val.map (homOfLE (hle p)).op (psi e y) =
    (tensorSheaf Y Q (lineBundleDual Y N)).val.map (homOfLE (hle p)).op m
  rw [h1, h2, hx p]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.psi_smul
statement:
theorem psi_smul {V : Y.Opens} (e : N.over V ≅ (unitMod Y).over V) (r : Γ(Y, V))
    (x : Q.val.obj (op V)) : psi e (r • x) = r • psi e x
proof:
:= by
  let r' : (Y.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).obj (op V) := r
  let x' : (underlyingCommPresheaf Y Q).obj (op V) := x
  have h1 : psiPre e (r' • x') = r' • psiPre e x' := by
    unfold psiPre
    exact (TensorProduct.smul_tmul' r' x' _).symm
  unfold psi
  have h2 := map_smul (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).unit.app (PQ N Q)).app (op V)).hom r'
    (psiPre e x')
  exact (congrArg _ h1).trans h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.homEquiv_symm_unit_app
statement:
theorem homEquiv_symm_unit_app {P : PresheafOfModules.{u} (Y.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)}
    {Z : Y.Modules} (g : P ⟶ (underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).obj Z) (W : (Y.Opens)ᵒᵖ)
    (t : P.obj W) :
    (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).homEquiv P Z).symm g).val.app W
      ((((moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).unit.app P).app W).hom t) = (g.app W).hom t
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun F : P ⟶ (underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).obj Z => (F.app W).hom t)
    ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).homEquiv_unit (f := ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).homEquiv P Z).symm g))
  simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
  exact h.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.tensorLineBundleDualIso_hom_eq
statement:
theorem tensorLineBundleDualIso_hom_eq {ι : Type u} (U : ι → Y.Opens)
    (hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y).CoversTop U)
    (e' : ∀ i, N.over (U i) ≅ (unitMod Y).over (U i)) :
    (tensorLineBundleDualIso N U hU e').hom =
      ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).homEquiv _ _).symm (evPre N)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.T_hom_psi_localGen
statement:
theorem T_hom_psi_localGen (T : tensorSheaf Y N (lineBundleDual Y N) ≅ tensorUnitSheaf Y)
    (hT : T.hom = ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).homEquiv _ _).symm (evPre N))
    {V : Y.Opens} (e : N.over V ≅ (unitMod Y).over V) :
    T.hom.val.app (op V) (psi (Q := N) e (localGen e)) = (1 : Γ(Y, V))
proof:
:= by
  have h := homEquiv_symm_unit_app (Z := tensorUnitSheaf Y) (evPre N) (op V) (psiPre e (localGen e))
  have h2 : ((evPre N).app (op V)).hom (psiPre e (localGen e)) = (1 : Γ(Y, V)) :=
    evalAt_localGen e
  exact (congrArg (fun F => F.val.app (op V) (psi (Q := N) e (localGen e))) hT).trans (h.trans h2)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.T_inv_one
statement:
theorem T_inv_one (T : tensorSheaf Y N (lineBundleDual Y N) ≅ tensorUnitSheaf Y)
    (hT : T.hom = ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).homEquiv _ _).symm (evPre N))
    {V : Y.Opens} (e : N.over V ≅ (unitMod Y).over V) :
    T.inv.val.app (op V) (1 : Γ(Y, V)) = psi (Q := N) e (localGen e)
proof:
:= by
  have h := T_hom_psi_localGen T hT e
  have h2 := Chow.C1Cap.iso_inv_hom_app T V (psi (Q := N) e (localGen e))
  exact (congrArg (fun z => T.inv.app V z) h.symm).trans h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.S_map_unit_app
statement:
theorem S_map_unit_app {P P' : PresheafOfModules.{u} (Y.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)}
    (F : P ⟶ P') (W : (Y.Opens)ᵒᵖ) (t : P.obj W) :
    ((moduleSheafification Y).map F).val.app W
      ((((moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).unit.app P).app W).hom t) =
    (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).unit.app P').app W).hom ((F.app W).hom t)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun G : P ⟶ (underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).obj ((moduleSheafification Y).obj P') =>
    (G.app W).hom t) ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).unit.naturality F)
  exact h.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.tensorSheafMap_psi
statement:
theorem tensorSheafMap_psi {V : Y.Opens} (s₀ : N ⟶ Q) (e : N.over V ≅ (unitMod Y).over V)
    (x : N.val.obj (op V)) :
    (tensorSheafMap Y s₀ (𝟙 (lineBundleDual Y N))).val.app (op V) (psi (Q := N) e x) =
      psi (Q := Q) e ((s₀.val.app (op V)).hom x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold tensorSheafMap psi
  refine (S_map_unit_app _ (op V) _).trans ?_
  exact congrArg _ rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.sigmaOf_one
statement:
theorem sigmaOf_one (T : tensorSheaf Y N (lineBundleDual Y N) ≅ tensorUnitSheaf Y)
    (hT : T.hom = ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).homEquiv _ _).symm (evPre N))
    (s₀ : N ⟶ Q) {V : Y.Opens} (e : N.over V ≅ (unitMod Y).over V) :
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (sigmaOf T s₀) V (1 : Γ(Y, V)) =
      psi (Q := Q) e (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app s₀ V (localGen e))
proof:
:= by
  unfold sigmaOf
  have h1 := T_inv_one T hT e
  have h2 := tensorSheafMap_psi s₀ e (localGen e)
  exact (congrArg (fun z => (tensorSheafMap Y s₀ (𝟙 (lineBundleDual Y N))).val.app (op V) z) h1).trans h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.sigmaOf_evalIdeal
statement:
theorem sigmaOf_evalIdeal (T : tensorSheaf Y N (lineBundleDual Y N) ≅ tensorUnitSheaf Y)
    (hT : T.hom = ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).homEquiv _ _).symm (evPre N))
    (s₀ : N ⟶ Q) {V : Y.Opens} (e : N.over V ≅ (unitMod Y).over V) :
    sectionEvaluationIdeal (R := Γ(Y, V))
        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (sigmaOf T s₀) V (1 : Γ(Y, V))) =
      sectionEvaluationIdeal (R := Γ(Y, V)) (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app s₀ V (localGen e))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sigmaOf_one T hT s₀ e]
  exact sectionEvaluationIdeal_linearEquiv (psiEquiv e) _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.evalIdeal_restrict_elem
statement:
theorem evalIdeal_restrict_elem {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (j : Z ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j] (A : Y.Modules)
    (W : Z.Opens) (x : Γ(A, j ''ᵁ W)) :
    (sectionEvaluationIdeal (R := Γ(Y, j ''ᵁ W)) x).map (j.appIso W).hom.hom =
      sectionEvaluationIdeal (R := Γ(Z, W))
        (show Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).obj A, W) from x)
proof:
:= by
  let e : Γ(Y, j ''ᵁ W) ≃+* Γ(Z, W) := (j.appIso W).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  letI := RingHomInvPair.of_ringEquiv e
  letI := RingHomInvPair.of_ringEquiv_symm e
  let f : Γ(A, j ''ᵁ W) ≃ₛₗ[(e : Γ(Y, j ''ᵁ W) →+* Γ(Z, W))]
      Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).obj A, W) :=
    { toFun := fun x => x
      invFun := fun x => x
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun r x => by
        exact Scheme.Modules.smul_restrictAppIso_inv_apply j A W r x
      left_inv := fun _ => rfl
      right_inv := fun _ => rfl }
  exact sectionEvaluationIdeal_semilinearEquiv e f x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.chartImage_le_preimage
statement:
theorem chartImage_le_preimage (i : C.I) (U : (C.chart i).Opens) :
    (C.chartι i) ''ᵁ U ≤ C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i
proof:
:= by
  refine ((C.chartι i).image_le_opensRange U).trans ?_
  rw [tautQuotient_chartι_opensRange]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.chart_evalIdeal
statement:
theorem chart_evalIdeal (i : C.I) (m : E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (k : C.basisIndex i) :
    letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i)
proof:
:= C.basisIndex_finite i
    sectionEvaluationIdeal
      (R := Γ(C.scheme, (C.chartι i) ''ᵁ linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))
        (C.sectionBasis i k)))
      ((C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (chartImage_le_preimage C i (linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))
          (C.sectionBasis i k)))).op
        ((C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.val.app (op (C.U i))).hom m)) =
    Ideal.span {((C.chartι i).appIso (linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))
        (C.sectionBasis i k))).inv.hom
      (tautChart_ratioSection Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i k) m)} := by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  let j := C.chartι i
  let b := C.sectionBasis i
  let lo := linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (b k)
  let Q := C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1
  let z := Q.presheaf.map (homOfLE (chartImage_le_preimage C i lo)).op
    ((C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.val.app (op (C.U i))).hom m)
  have h1 := evalIdeal_restrict_elem j Q lo z
  let Θ := C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 i
  let eΘ : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).obj Q, lo) ≃ₗ[Γ(C.chart i, lo)]
      Γ(C.chartTwistingSheaf 1 i, lo) :=
    ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (C.chart i).ringCatSheaf (op lo)).mapIso Θ).toLinearEquiv
  have h2 := sectionEvaluationIdeal_linearEquiv eΘ (show Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).obj Q, lo) from z)
  let G0 := tautChart_tautHom Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) b m
  let X_n := (C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.val.app (op (C.U i))).hom m
  let zTop : Γ(Q, j ''ᵁ ⊤) := Q.presheaf.map (homOfLE (tautQuotient_chartι_image_top C i).le).op X_n
  have hrec := rankTwo_originalChart_tautRecovery C i m
  have hnat := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply Θ.hom.val (homOfLE (le_top : lo ≤ ⊤)).op zTop
  have hzz : z = ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).obj Q).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (le_top : lo ≤ ⊤)).op zTop := by
    change z = Q.presheaf.map (j.opensFunctor.map (homOfLE (le_top : lo ≤ ⊤))).op zTop
    change _ = Q.presheaf.map (j.opensFunctor.map (homOfLE (le_top : lo ≤ ⊤))).op
      (Q.presheaf.map (homOfLE (tautQuotient_chartι_image_top C i).le).op X_n)
    erw [← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp_apply]
    rfl
  have hz : (Θ.hom.val.app (op lo)).hom z = (G0.val.app (op lo)).hom (1 : Γ(C.chart i, lo)) := by
    rw [hzz]
    have h4 : (Θ.hom.val.app (op ⊤)).hom zTop = (G0.val.app (op ⊤)).hom (1 : Γ(C.chart i, ⊤)) :=
      hrec
    refine hnat.trans ((congrArg (fun t => ((C.chartTwistingSheaf 1 i).val.map
      (homOfLE (le_top : lo ≤ ⊤)).op).hom t) h4).trans ?_)
    have hG := Chow.C1Cap.app_presheaf_map G0 (homOfLE (le_top : lo ≤ ⊤)) (1 : Γ(C.chart i, ⊤))
    have hu := Chow.C1Cap.unit_presheaf_map_one (S := space Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))) (homOfLE (le_top : lo ≤ ⊤))
    exact ((congrArg (fun t => (Hom.app G0 lo).hom t) hu.symm).trans hG).symm
  have h3 : sectionEvaluationIdeal (R := Γ(C.chart i, lo))
      (eΘ (show Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).obj Q, lo) from z)) =
      sectionEvaluationIdeal (R := Γ(C.chart i, lo))
        (show Γ(C.chartTwistingSheaf 1 i, lo) from Hom.app G0 lo (1 : Γ(C.chart i, lo))) :=
    congrArg (fun t => sectionEvaluationIdeal (R := Γ(C.chart i, lo)) t) hz
  have hiso : IsIso (SheafOfModules.Hom.over (twistingSheafBasisComponent Γ(X, C.U i)
      (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) b 1 k) lo) :=
    twistingSheafBasisComponent_over_isIso_of_le _ _ _ 1 k le_rfl
  have hZ := @intrinsicZI_sectionEvaluationIdeal_pushedUnit_frame (C.chart i) lo _ _
    (Iso.refl (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) b 1))
    (twistingSheafBasisComponent Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) b 1 k) hiso G0
  have hc : G0 ≫ (Iso.refl (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) b 1)).hom ≫
      twistingSheafBasisComponent Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) b 1 k = tautChart_componentHom Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (b k) m := by
    simpa using tautChart_tautHom_component Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) b m k
  have hcomp : Hom.app (G0 ≫ (Iso.refl (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) b 1)).hom ≫
      twistingSheafBasisComponent Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) b 1 k) ⊤ (1 : Γ(C.chart i, ⊤)) =
      tautChart_component Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (b k) m := by
    rw [hc]
    exact tautChart_unitHomEquiv_symm_sectionsOfTop_app _ _
  have hback := rankTwo_tautComponent_back Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (b k) m
  have hI : sectionEvaluationIdeal (R := Γ(C.chart i, lo))
      (show Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).obj Q, lo) from z) =
      Ideal.span {tautChart_ratioSection Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (b k) m} := by
    refine h2.symm.trans (h3.trans (hZ.trans ?_))
    exact congrArg (fun t => Ideal.span {t})
      ((congrArg (fun t => ((C.chart i).presheaf.map
        (eqToHom (intrinsicZI_image_preimage_top lo).symm).op).hom t) hcomp).trans hback)
  have hm := congrArg (Ideal.map (j.appIso lo).inv.hom) (h1.trans hI)
  rw [Ideal.map_map] at hm
  have hid : ((j.appIso lo).inv.hom.comp (j.appIso lo).hom.hom) = RingHom.id _ := by
    ext x
    exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (j.appIso lo).hom_inv_id x
  rw [hid, Ideal.map_id] at hm
  exact hm.trans ((Ideal.map_span _ _).trans (congrArg Ideal.span Set.image_singleton))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.frame_smul_injective
statement:
theorem frame_smul_injective {U : X.Opens} (e : L.over U ≅ (unitMod X).over U) :
    Function.Injective (fun r : Γ(X, U) => r • (localGen e : L.val.obj (op U)))
proof:
:= by
  intro r r' h
  have h2 := congrArg (fun m : L.val.obj (op U) => evalAt L U m e.hom) h
  simp only [] at h2
  rw [evalAt_smul_left, evalAt_smul_left, evalAt_localGen, mul_one, mul_one] at h2
  exact h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.frame_smul_surjective
statement:
theorem frame_smul_surjective {U : X.Opens} (e : L.over U ≅ (unitMod X).over U) :
    Function.Surjective (fun r : Γ(X, U) => r • (localGen e : L.val.obj (op U)))
proof:
:=
  fun m => ⟨evalAt L U m e.hom, (section_eq_smul_localGen e m).symm⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.secMap_ker_eq
statement:
theorem secMap_ker_eq {a : L ⟶ B} {b : B ⟶ D} (w : a ≫ b = 0)
    (hS : (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact) {U : X.Opens}
    (e : L.over U ≅ (unitMod X).over U) :
    LinearMap.ker (secMap b U) =
      Γ(X, U) ∙ ((a.val.app (op U)).hom (localGen e : L.val.obj (op U)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hinj, hex, hzero⟩ :=
    SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerShortExact.sections_leftExact X a b w hS (op U)
  ext m
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, Submodule.mem_span_singleton]
  constructor
  · intro hm
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hex m hm
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := frame_smul_surjective e k
    refine ⟨r, ?_⟩
    have h1 := map_smul (a.val.app (op U)).hom r (localGen e : L.val.obj (op U))
    exact h1.symm.trans hk
  · rintro ⟨r, rfl⟩
    have h1 := map_smul (b.val.app (op U)).hom r
      ((a.val.app (op U)).hom (localGen e : L.val.obj (op U)))
    have h2 := hzero (localGen e : L.val.obj (op U))
    exact h1.trans (by
      change r • ((b.val.app (op U)).hom ((a.val.app (op U)).hom (localGen e))) = 0
      rw [show (b.val.app (op U)).hom ((a.val.app (op U)).hom (localGen e)) = 0 from h2, smul_zero])

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.secMap_inj_of_frame
statement:
theorem secMap_inj_of_frame {a : L ⟶ B} {b : B ⟶ D} (w : a ≫ b = 0)
    (hS : (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact) {U : X.Opens}
    (e : L.over U ≅ (unitMod X).over U) :
    Function.Injective fun r : Γ(X, U) =>
      r • ((a.val.app (op U)).hom (localGen e : L.val.obj (op U)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hinj, -, -⟩ :=
    SchemeKTheory.ExteriorPowerShortExact.sections_leftExact X a b w hS (op U)
  intro r r' h
  have h1 := map_smul (a.val.app (op U)).hom r (localGen e : L.val.obj (op U))
  have h2 := map_smul (a.val.app (op U)).hom r' (localGen e : L.val.obj (op U))
  have h3 : (a.val.app (op U)).hom (r • (localGen e : L.val.obj (op U))) =
      (a.val.app (op U)).hom (r' • (localGen e : L.val.obj (op U))) := by
    exact h1.trans (h.trans h2.symm)
  exact frame_smul_injective e (hinj h3)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.restrictHomOverLE_app_map
statement:
theorem restrictHomOverLE_app_map {M N : X.Modules} {U W : X.Opens} (h : W ≤ U)
    (f : M.over U ⟶ N.over U) (m : M.val.obj (op U)) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X h f).val.app (topOver W) (M.val.map (homOfLE h).op m) =
      N.val.map (homOfLE h).op (f.val.app (topOver U) m)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.localGen_resIso
statement:
theorem localGen_resIso {U W : X.Opens} (h : W ≤ U) (e : L.over U ≅ (unitMod X).over U) :
    localGen (resIso h e) = L.val.map (homOfLE h).op (localGen e)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := restrictHomOverLE_app_map h e.inv (1 : Γ(X, U))
  have h2 : (unitMod X).val.map (homOfLE h).op (1 : Γ(X, U)) = (1 : Γ(X, W)) := by
    change (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom (1 : Γ(X, U)) = 1
    exact map_one _
  rw [h2] at h1
  exact h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.localGen_frameIsoW
statement:
theorem localGen_frameIsoW {x : X} (d : WFrame L x) :
    localGen (frameIsoW d) = wFrameGen d
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.FrameData.iso_eq
statement:
theorem FrameData.iso_eq {U : X.Opens} (F : FrameData L U) {x : X} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    F.iso = frameIsoW (F.toW hx)
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.exists_pullback_frame
statement:
theorem exists_pullback_frame {Y : Scheme.{u}} (π : Y ⟶ X) {U : X.Opens} (F : FrameData L U)
    (y : Y) (hy : π y ∈ U) :
    ∃ e : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).obj L).over (π ⁻¹ᵁ U) ≅
        (unitMod Y).over (π ⁻¹ᵁ U),
      localGen e = ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction π).unit.app L).app U
        (localGen F.iso)
proof:
:= by
  let d := F.toW hy
  refine ⟨frameIsoW (WFrame.ofData (pullbackWFrame π d y hy)), ?_⟩
  rw [F.iso_eq hy]
  exact (localGen_frameIsoW _).trans ((wFrameGen_pullbackWFrame π d y hy).trans
    (congrArg (fun z => ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction π).unit.app L).app U z)
      (localGen_frameIsoW d).symm))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.s0_unit
statement:
theorem s0_unit (a : L ⟶ B) (U : X.Opens) (x : Γ(L, U)) :
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (s0 P a) (P.toB.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ U)
        (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction P.toB.toBase).unit.app L).app U x) =
      (P.toB.tautologicalPushforwardHom.val.app (op U)).hom (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app a U x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun t => t.app U x)
    ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction P.toB.toBase).unit.naturality a)
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, Functor.id_map, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at h
  unfold s0
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  rw [← rankTwo_originalCanonicalQuotient_unit P.toB U (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app a U x)]
  exact congrArg (fun z => P.toB.tautologicalQuotient.app (P.toB.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ U) z) h.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.chart_ideal_eq
statement:
theorem chart_ideal_eq {a : L ⟶ B} (w : a ≫ b = 0)
    (hS : (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact)
    (T : tensorSheaf P.toB.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P.toB.toBase).obj L)
      (lineBundleDual P.toB.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P.toB.toBase).obj L)) ≅
        tensorUnitSheaf P.toB.scheme)
    (hT : T.hom = ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction P.toB.scheme).homEquiv _ _).symm
      (evPre ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P.toB.toBase).obj L)))
    (F : ∀ i, FrameData L (P.U i)) (i : P.I) (k : P.basisB i) :
    sectionAffineEvaluationIdeal (sigmaOf T (s0 P a)) (chartImage P i ((P.toB.sectionBasis i) k)) =
      P.jHom.ker.ideal (chartImage P i ((P.toB.sectionBasis i) k))
proof:
:= by
  let x := (P.toB.sectionBasis i) k
  let V : P.toB.scheme.Opens := (chartImage P i x).1
  have hVW : V ≤ P.toB.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ P.U i := chartImage_le_preimage P.toB i _
  let ℓ : Γ(L, P.U i) := localGen (F i).iso
  let n : B.val.obj (op (P.U i)) := Scheme.Modules.Hom.app a (P.U i) ℓ
  have hker : LinearMap.ker (secMap b (P.U i)) = Γ(X, P.U i) ∙ n :=
    secMap_ker_eq w hS (F i).iso
  rw [jHom_ker_ideal_chart P i n x hker]
  by_cases hV : (V : Set P.toB.scheme).Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hV
    obtain ⟨eN, heN⟩ := exists_pullback_frame P.toB.toBase (F i) y (hVW hy)
    let e := resIso hVW eN
    have hG := sigmaOf_evalIdeal T hT (s0 P a) e
    have h1 : Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (s0 P a) V (localGen e) =
        (P.toB.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVW).op
          ((P.toB.tautologicalPushforwardHom.val.app (op (P.U i))).hom n) := by
      have h2 : localGen e = ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P.toB.toBase).obj L).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE hVW).op (localGen eN) := localGen_resIso hVW eN
      rw [h2, heN]
      exact (Chow.C1Cap.app_presheaf_map (s0 P a) (homOfLE hVW) _).trans
        (congrArg _ (s0_unit P a (P.U i) ℓ))
    change sectionEvaluationIdeal (R := Γ(P.toB.scheme, V))
      (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (sigmaOf T (s0 P a)) V (1 : Γ(P.toB.scheme, V))) = _
    refine hG.trans ?_
    rw [h1]
    exact chart_evalIdeal P.toB i n k
  · have hV0 : V = ⊥ := by
      ext z
      exact ⟨fun hz => (hV ⟨z, hz⟩).elim, fun hz => by simp at hz⟩
    haveI : Subsingleton Γ(P.toB.scheme, V) := by
      rw [hV0]
      infer_instance
    ext z
    have hz : z = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    subst hz
    exact ⟨fun _ => Ideal.zero_mem _, fun _ => Ideal.zero_mem _⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.sheafIdeal_eq
statement:
theorem sheafIdeal_eq {a : L ⟶ B} (w : a ≫ b = 0)
    (hS : (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (T : tensorSheaf P.toB.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P.toB.toBase).obj L)
      (lineBundleDual P.toB.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P.toB.toBase).obj L)) ≅
        tensorUnitSheaf P.toB.scheme)
    (hT : T.hom = ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction P.toB.scheme).homEquiv _ _).symm
      (evPre ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P.toB.toBase).obj L)))
    (F : ∀ i, FrameData L (P.U i)) :
    sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf (sigmaOf T (s0 P a)) = P.jHom.ker
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsFiniteLocallyFree P.toB.scheme (E16.twistedLine P.toB L) :=
    (E16.hasConstantRank_twistedLine P.toB hL).isFiniteLocallyFree
  refine Scheme.IdealSheafData.ext_of_iSup_eq_top
    (fun ik : (Σ i : P.I, P.basisB i) => chartImage P ik.1 ((P.toB.sectionBasis ik.1) ik.2))
    (chartImage_cover P) ?_
  rintro ⟨i, k⟩
  have h1 := sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_affine (L := E16.twistedLine P.toB L)
    (sigmaOf T (s0 P a)) (chartImage P i ((P.toB.sectionBasis i) k))
  exact h1.trans (chart_ideal_eq P w hS T hT F i k)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.chart_ideal_span
statement:
theorem chart_ideal_span {a : L ⟶ B} (w : a ≫ b = 0)
    (hS : (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact)
    (T : tensorSheaf P.toB.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P.toB.toBase).obj L)
      (lineBundleDual P.toB.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P.toB.toBase).obj L)) ≅
        tensorUnitSheaf P.toB.scheme)
    (hT : T.hom = ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction P.toB.scheme).homEquiv _ _).symm
      (evPre ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P.toB.toBase).obj L)))
    (F : ∀ i, FrameData L (P.U i)) (i : P.I) (k : P.basisB i) :
    ∃ c : Γ(P.toB.scheme, (chartImage P i ((P.toB.sectionBasis i) k)).1), IsRegular c ∧
      sectionAffineEvaluationIdeal (sigmaOf T (s0 P a)) (chartImage P i ((P.toB.sectionBasis i) k)) =
        Ideal.span {c}
proof:
:= by
  let x := (P.toB.sectionBasis i) k
  let ℓ : Γ(L, P.U i) := localGen (F i).iso
  let n : B.val.obj (op (P.U i)) := Scheme.Modules.Hom.app a (P.U i) ℓ
  have hker : LinearMap.ker (secMap b (P.U i)) = Γ(X, P.U i) ∙ n :=
    secMap_ker_eq w hS (F i).iso
  have hinj : Function.Injective fun r : Γ(X, P.U i) => r • n := secMap_inj_of_frame w hS (F i).iso
  refine ⟨((P.toB.chartι i).appIso (linearOpen Γ(X, P.U i) (B.val.obj (op (P.U i))) x)).inv.hom
    (tautChart_ratioSection Γ(X, P.U i) (B.val.obj (op (P.U i))) x n), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact isRegular_ringEquiv
      ((P.toB.chartι i).appIso (linearOpen Γ(X, P.U i) (B.val.obj (op (P.U i))) x)).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
      (ratioSection_isRegular (secMap b (P.U i)) (P.surj i) n hker hinj x)
  · exact (chart_ideal_eq P w hS T hT F i k).trans (jHom_ker_ideal_chart P i n x hker)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.sigma_regular
statement:
theorem sigma_regular {a : L ⟶ B} (w : a ≫ b = 0)
    (hS : (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (T : tensorSheaf P.toB.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P.toB.toBase).obj L)
      (lineBundleDual P.toB.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P.toB.toBase).obj L)) ≅
        tensorUnitSheaf P.toB.scheme)
    (hT : T.hom = ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction P.toB.scheme).homEquiv _ _).symm
      (evPre ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P.toB.toBase).obj L)))
    (F : ∀ i, FrameData L (P.U i)) :
    SectionIsRegular (sigmaOf T (s0 P a))
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsFiniteLocallyFree P.toB.scheme (E16.twistedLine P.toB L) :=
    (E16.hasConstantRank_twistedLine P.toB hL).isFiniteLocallyFree
  have hM : IsLocalLineFrame (E16.twistedLine P.toB L) :=
    isLocalLineFrame_of_hasConstantRank (E16.hasConstantRank_twistedLine P.toB hL)
  let σ := sigmaOf T (s0 P a)
  intro U r hr
  have key : ∀ y : P.toB.scheme, y ∈ U.1 → ∃ D : P.toB.scheme.Opens, y ∈ D ∧ ∃ hDU : D ≤ U.1,
      P.toB.scheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op r = 0 := by
    intro y hyU
    have hyc : y ∈ (⨆ ik : (Σ i : P.I, P.basisB i),
        (chartImage P ik.1 ((P.toB.sectionBasis ik.1) ik.2)).1) := by
      rw [chartImage_cover P]; trivial
    obtain ⟨⟨i, k⟩, hyV⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp hyc
    let V := chartImage P i ((P.toB.sectionBasis i) k)
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hVc⟩ := chart_ideal_span P w hS T hT F i k
    obtain ⟨Fy, hyF, ⟨eM⟩⟩ := hM y
    obtain ⟨s, hsle, hys⟩ := V.2.exists_basicOpen_le (V := Fy.1 ⊓ U.1) ⟨y, hyF, hyU⟩ hyV
    have hDF : P.toB.scheme.basicOpen s ≤ Fy.1 := hsle.trans inf_le_left
    have hDU' : P.toB.scheme.basicOpen s ≤ U.1 := hsle.trans inf_le_right
    refine ⟨P.toB.scheme.basicOpen s, hys, hDU', ?_⟩
    have hloc := sectionAffineEvaluationIdeal_basicOpen (L := E16.twistedLine P.toB L) σ V s
    have hI_D : sectionAffineEvaluationIdeal σ (P.toB.scheme.affineBasicOpen s) =
        Ideal.span {(P.toB.scheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE (P.toB.scheme.basicOpen_le s)).op).hom c} := by
      exact hloc.symm.trans ((congrArg (Ideal.map _) hVc).trans
        ((Ideal.map_span _ _).trans (congrArg Ideal.span Set.image_singleton)))
    have hreg_c : IsRegular
        ((P.toB.scheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE (P.toB.scheme.basicOpen_le s)).op).hom c) := by
      letI : Algebra Γ(P.toB.scheme, V.1) Γ(P.toB.scheme, P.toB.scheme.basicOpen s) :=
        (P.toB.scheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE (P.toB.scheme.basicOpen_le s)).op).hom.toAlgebra
      haveI : IsLocalization.Away s Γ(P.toB.scheme, P.toB.scheme.basicOpen s) :=
        V.2.isLocalization_basicOpen s
      exact isRegular_algebraMap_of_isLocalization (Submonoid.powers s) hc
    let eD := resIso hDF eM
    have hcoefI : sectionEvaluationIdeal (R := Γ(P.toB.scheme, P.toB.scheme.basicOpen s))
        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ (P.toB.scheme.basicOpen s) (1 : Γ(P.toB.scheme, P.toB.scheme.basicOpen s))) =
        Ideal.span {sectionOverTrivializationCoefficient σ (P.toB.scheme.basicOpen s) eD} :=
      sectionEvaluationIdeal_overIso σ (P.toB.scheme.basicOpen s) eD
    have hcoefReg : IsRegular (sectionOverTrivializationCoefficient σ (P.toB.scheme.basicOpen s) eD) :=
      isRegular_of_span_eq (hcoefI.symm.trans hI_D) hreg_c
    have h1 : P.toB.scheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU').op r •
        Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ (P.toB.scheme.basicOpen s) (1 : Γ(P.toB.scheme, P.toB.scheme.basicOpen s)) = 0 := by
      rw [← section_app_one_restrict σ hDU', ← Scheme.Modules.map_smul, hr, map_zero]
    have h3 := (overFrameLinearEquiv (P.toB.scheme.basicOpen s) eD).map_smul
      (P.toB.scheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU').op r)
      (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ (P.toB.scheme.basicOpen s) (1 : Γ(P.toB.scheme, P.toB.scheme.basicOpen s)))
    have h4 : overFrameLinearEquiv (P.toB.scheme.basicOpen s) eD
        (P.toB.scheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU').op r •
          Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ (P.toB.scheme.basicOpen s)
            (1 : Γ(P.toB.scheme, P.toB.scheme.basicOpen s))) = 0 := by
      rw [h1]; exact map_zero _
    have h5 : P.toB.scheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU').op r *
        sectionOverTrivializationCoefficient σ (P.toB.scheme.basicOpen s) eD = 0 :=
      h3.symm.trans h4
    exact hcoefReg.right (show _ * _ = 0 * _ by rw [h5, zero_mul])
  choose D hyD hDU hD0 using fun y : U.1 => key y.1 y.2
  let S : TopCat.Sheaf Ab P.toB.scheme :=
    ⟨(unitMod P.toB.scheme).presheaf, (unitMod P.toB.scheme).isSheaf⟩
  refine S.eq_of_locally_eq' D U.1 (fun y => homOfLE (hDU y)) ?_ r 0 ?_
  · intro y hy
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hyD ⟨y, hy⟩⟩
  · intro y
    refine (hD0 y).trans ?_
    exact (map_zero (S.1.map (homOfLE (hDU y)).op).hom).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.zeroSectionLink_of_frames
statement:
theorem zeroSectionLink_of_frames {a : L ⟶ B} (w : a ≫ b = 0)
    (hS : (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (F : ∀ i, FrameData L (P.U i)) : E16.ZeroSectionLink P L
proof:
:= by
  have hN : HasConstantRank P.toB.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P.toB.toBase).obj L) 1 :=
    hasConstantRank_pullback P.toB.scheme P.toB.toBase L 1 hL
  obtain ⟨q, hq, -, hcard⟩ := hN
  letI := hq
  let e := fun i ↦ (SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.exists_triv
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P.toB.toBase).obj L) q hcard i).some
  let T := tensorLineBundleDualIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P.toB.toBase).obj L) q.X q.coversTop e
  have hT : T.hom = ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction P.toB.scheme).homEquiv _ _).symm
      (evPre ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P.toB.toBase).obj L)) :=
    tensorLineBundleDualIso_hom_eq q.X q.coversTop e
  exact ⟨sigmaOf T (s0 P a), sigma_regular P w hS hL T hT F, sheafIdeal_eq P w hS hL T hT F⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.exists_pairCover_card_frames
statement:
theorem exists_pairCover_card_frames [Epi b] {r s : ℕ} (hB : HasConstantRank X B r)
    (hD : HasConstantRank X D s) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) :
    ∃ P : PairCover b, (∀ i, Nat.card (P.basisB i) = r) ∧ (∀ i, Nat.card (P.basisD i) = s) ∧
      ∀ i, Nonempty (FrameData L (P.U i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨CB, hCB⟩ := exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hB
  obtain ⟨CD, hCD⟩ := exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hD
  have hline := isLocalLineFrame_of_hasConstantRank hL
  have key : ∀ x : X, ∃ (iB : CB.I) (iD : CD.I) (W : X.Opens), x ∈ W ∧ IsAffineOpen W ∧
      ∃ (hWB : W ≤ CB.U iB) (hWD : W ≤ CD.U iD), Function.Surjective (secMap b W) ∧
        Nonempty (FrameData L W) := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨iB, hiB⟩ := exists_mem_of_cover CB.covers x
    obtain ⟨iD, hiD⟩ := exists_mem_of_cover CD.covers x
    obtain ⟨Fx, hxF, ⟨eL⟩⟩ := hline x
    haveI : Fintype (CD.basisIndex iD) := @Fintype.ofFinite _ (CD.basisIndex_finite iD)
    obtain ⟨V, hVU, hxV, t, ht⟩ := Scheme.Modules.exists_open_lifts_of_finite_elements X b
      (CD.basisIndex iD) (CB.U iB ⊓ CD.U iD)
      (fun k => D.val.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : CB.U iB ⊓ CD.U iD ≤ CD.U iD)).op
        (CD.sectionBasis iD k)) x ⟨hiB, hiD⟩
    obtain ⟨W, hW, hxW, hWV⟩ := (Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens)
      (show x ∈ V ⊓ Fx.1 from ⟨hxV, hxF⟩)
    have hWV' : W ≤ V := hWV.trans inf_le_left
    have hWF : W ≤ Fx.1 := hWV.trans inf_le_right
    have hWB : W ≤ CB.U iB := hWV'.trans (hVU.trans inf_le_left)
    have hWD : W ≤ CD.U iD := hWV'.trans (hVU.trans inf_le_right)
    refine ⟨iB, iD, W, hxW, hW, hWB, hWD, ?_, ⟨FrameData.ofIso (resIso hWF eL)⟩⟩
    have hle : Submodule.span Γ(X, W) (Set.range (CD.restrictedSectionBasis iD W hWD)) ≤
        LinearMap.range (secMap b W) := by
      rw [Submodule.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨B.val.map (homOfLE hWV').op (t k), ?_⟩
      have h1 := secMap_restrict b hWV' (t k)
      have h2 : secMap b V (t k) = b.val.app (op V) (t k) := rfl
      have h3 := ht k
      change secMap b W (B.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE hWV').op (t k)) = _
      rw [h1, h2, h3]
      rw [← CD.restrictedSectionBasis_eq_restrict iD W hWD k]
      change D.val.map (homOfLE hWV').op (D.val.map (homOfLE hVU).op
        (D.val.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : CB.U iB ⊓ CD.U iD ≤ CD.U iD)).op
          (CD.sectionBasis iD k))) =
        D.val.map (homOfLE hWD).op (CD.sectionBasis iD k)
      rw [← PresheafOfModules.map_comp_apply, ← PresheafOfModules.map_comp_apply]
      rfl
    intro d
    have hd : d ∈ Submodule.span Γ(X, W) (Set.range (CD.restrictedSectionBasis iD W hWD)) := by
      rw [(CD.restrictedSectionBasis iD W hWD).span_eq]; trivial
    exact LinearMap.mem_range.mp (hle hd)
  choose iB iD W hxW hWaff hex using key
  choose hWB hWD hsurj hfr using hex
  refine ⟨{
    I := X
    U := W
    covers := ?_
    isAffine := hWaff
    basisB := fun x => CB.basisIndex (iB x)
    basisD := fun x => CD.basisIndex (iD x)
    finB := fun x => CB.basisIndex_finite (iB x)
    finD := fun x => CD.basisIndex_finite (iD x)
    frameB := fun x => CB.restrictedFrame (iB x) (W x) (hWB x)
    frameD := fun x => CD.restrictedFrame (iD x) (W x) (hWD x)
    surj := hsurj }, fun x => hCB (iB x), fun x => hCD (iD x), hfr⟩
  show (⨆ x, W x : X.Opens) = ⊤
  exact eq_top_iff.mpr fun x _ => Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨x, hxW x⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E20.projDivisorGate_of_twistCartierGates
statement:
theorem projDivisorGate_of_twistCartierGates (ops : ChowOps k) (cp : ChowCompat ops)
    (hG : TwistCartierGates ops cp) : E15.ProjDivisorGate ops cp
proof:
:= by
  intro X _ _ _ L B D a b w hex hL e hB hD
  haveI : Epi b := hex.epi_g
  obtain ⟨P, hCB, hCD, hfr⟩ := exists_pairCover_card_frames b hB hD hL
  obtain ⟨hT, hK⟩ := hG a b w hex hL e hB hD P hCB hCD hfr
  have hZ : E16.ZeroSectionLink P L :=
    zeroSectionLink_of_frames P w hex hL (fun i => (hfr i).some)
  exact ⟨E16.projDivisorData_of_gates ops cp P hL hCB hCD hT
    (E16.capDivisorGate_of_gates ops cp P hL hCB hCD hZ hK)⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.componentIso_hom_toOverlap
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem componentIso_hom_toOverlap (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    {i j : C'.I} (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (componentIso e C' c).hom ≫ (C'.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c =
      ((transport e C').basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f (c.transport e C') ≫
        (overlapIso e C' i j).hom
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [componentIso, pullback.map, basicOpenOverlapCover]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.componentIso_hom_toCommonBase
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem componentIso_hom_toCommonBase (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    {i j : C'.I} (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (componentIso e C' c).hom ≫
        (CommonBasicOpen.baseCover C' i j).pullbackHom
          (C'.overlapToIntersection i j) c =
      (CommonBasicOpen.baseCover (transport e C') i j).pullbackHom
        ((transport e C').overlapToIntersection i j) (c.transport e C')
proof:
:= by

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.componentIso_commonChartIso
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem componentIso_commonChartIso (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    {i j : C'.I} (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (componentIso e C' c).hom ≫ (C'.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j c).hom =
      ((transport e C').commonBasicOpenChartIso i j (c.transport e C')).hom ≫
        (commonChartIso e C' c).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono c.chartToLeft).1
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [C'.commonBasicOpenChartIso_hom_chartToLeft]
  rw [componentIso_hom_toOverlap_assoc]
  rw [overlapIso_hom_toChart]
  simp only [← Category.assoc]
  rw [← (transport e C').commonBasicOpenChartIso_hom_chartToLeft_assoc]
  rw [chartIso_leftRestriction]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.componentIso_localTransition
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem componentIso_localTransition (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    {i j : C'.I} (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (componentIso e C' c).hom ≫ C'.localTransition i j c =
      (transport e C').localTransition i j (c.transport e C') ≫
        (overlapIso e C' j i).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (C'.overlapToChart j i)).1
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [C'.localTransition_toChart]
  rw [componentIso_commonChartIso_assoc]
  rw [← chartIso_rightRestriction]
  simp only [← Category.assoc]
  rw [← (transport e C').localTransition_toChart]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← overlapIso_hom_toChart]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.transport_untransport
statement:
theorem CommonBasicOpen.transport_untransport (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') {i j : C'.I}
    (d : (AffineFrameCover.transport e C').CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (d.untransport e C').transport e C' = d
proof:
:= by
  cases d
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.overlapIso_transition
statement:
theorem overlapIso_transition (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    (i j : C'.I) :
    (overlapIso e C' i j).hom ≫ C'.transition i j =
      (transport e C').transition i j ≫ (overlapIso e C' j i).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.Cover.hom_ext ((transport e C').basicOpenOverlapCover i j)
  intro d
  let c := d.untransport e C'
  have hd : c.transport e C' = d := d.transport_untransport e C'
  rw [← hd]
  rw [← componentIso_hom_toOverlap_assoc]
  rw [C'.basicOpenOverlapCover_transition]
  rw [componentIso_localTransition]
  rw [← (transport e C').basicOpenOverlapCover_transition]
  exact Category.assoc _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F13.CycSurj.comp
statement:
theorem CycSurj.comp (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) [Flat f] [Flat g] [QuasiCompact f]
    (hX : DimensionCatenary X) {d1 d2 : ℕ} (hf : PureRelDim f d1) (n : ℕ)
    (h1 : CycSurj f d1 (n + d2)) (h2 : CycSurj g d2 n) : CycSurj (f ≫ g) (d2 + d1) n
proof:
:= by
  intro D hD
  have hD' : D ∈ dimensionCycles X ((n + d2) + d1) := by rwa [Nat.add_assoc]
  obtain ⟨N1, hN1, A1, hA1, hr1⟩ := h1 D hD'
  obtain ⟨N2, hN2, A2, hA2, hr2⟩ := h2 A1 hA1
  refine ⟨N2 * N1, mul_ne_zero hN2 hN1, A2, hA2, ?_⟩
  have hpull := flatPullback_mem_dimRationalEquivalence f hX hf
    ⟨(N2 : ℤ) • A1 - flatPullback g A2, (mem_relC.mp hr2).1⟩ (mem_relC.mp hr2).2
  have hr1' : (N1 : ℤ) • D - flatPullback f A1 ∈ relC X (n + (d2 + d1)) := by
    rwa [← Nat.add_assoc]
  have hpull' : flatPullback f ((N2 : ℤ) • A1 - flatPullback g A2) ∈
      relC X (n + (d2 + d1)) := by
    rw [← Nat.add_assoc]
    exact mem_relC.mpr ⟨(flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles f hf (mem_relC.mp hr2).1), hpull⟩
  have e : ((N2 * N1 : ℕ) : ℤ) • D - flatPullback (f ≫ g) A2 =
      (N2 : ℤ) • ((N1 : ℤ) • D - flatPullback f A1) +
        flatPullback f ((N2 : ℤ) • A1 - flatPullback g A2) := by
    have e1 : flatPullback f ((N2 : ℤ) • A1 - flatPullback g A2) =
        (N2 : ℤ) • flatPullback f A1 - flatPullback f (flatPullback g A2) := by
      have := map_sub (flatPullbackHom f) ((N2 : ℤ) • A1) (flatPullback g A2)
      have h3 := map_zsmul (flatPullbackHom f) (N2 : ℤ) A1
      change flatPullback f ((N2 : ℤ) • A1 - flatPullback g A2) =
        flatPullback f ((N2 : ℤ) • A1) - flatPullback f (flatPullback g A2) at this
      change flatPullback f ((N2 : ℤ) • A1) = (N2 : ℤ) • flatPullback f A1 at h3
      rw [this, h3]
    rw [e1, flatPullback_comp f g, smul_sub, Nat.cast_mul, mul_smul]
    abel
  rw [e]
  exact add_mem (zsmul_mem hr1' _) hpull'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F13.exists_nsmul_mem_range_of_cycSurj
statement:
theorem exists_nsmul_mem_range_of_cycSurj (f : E ⟶ U) [Flat f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (hX : DimensionCatenary E) {d n : ℕ} (hf : PureRelDim f d) (hs : CycSurj f d n)
    (z : DimChow E (n + d)) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, N ≠ 0 ∧ N • z ∈ (flatPullbackChow f hX hf n).range
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective z
  obtain ⟨N, hN, A, hA, hr⟩ := hs D.1 D.2
  refine ⟨N, hN, ⟨QuotientAddGroup.mk ⟨A, hA⟩, ?_⟩⟩
  rw [flatPullbackChow_mk, ← QuotientAddGroup.mk_nsmul, QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem]
  obtain ⟨hmem, hrel⟩ := mem_relC.mp hr
  have : (⟨flatPullback f A, flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles f hf hA⟩ - N • D :
      dimensionCycles E (n + d)) = -⟨(N : ℤ) • D.1 - flatPullback f A, hmem⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp
  change (⟨flatPullback f A, flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles f hf hA⟩ - N • D :
      dimensionCycles E (n + d)) ∈ _
  rw [this]
  exact neg_mem hrel

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F13.flatPullbackRationalChow_surjective_of_cycSurj
statement:
theorem flatPullbackRationalChow_surjective_of_cycSurj (f : E ⟶ U) [Flat f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (hX : DimensionCatenary E) {d n : ℕ} (hf : PureRelDim f d) (hs : CycSurj f d n) :
    Function.Surjective (flatPullbackRationalChow f hX hf n)
proof:
:= by
  intro w
  induction w using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, map_zero _⟩
  | tmul q z =>
    obtain ⟨N, hN, a, ha⟩ := exists_nsmul_mem_range_of_cycSurj f hX hf hs z
    refine ⟨(q / N) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] a, ?_⟩
    unfold flatPullbackRationalChow
    rw [rationalizeAddHom_tmul, ha, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul]
    congr 1
    rw [nsmul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨a + b, map_add _ _ _⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F13.cycSurj_line
statement:
theorem cycSurj_line (U : Scheme.{u}) [U.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (U ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsLocallyNoetherian U]
    [CompactSpace U] (n : ℕ) : CycSurj (lineProj U) 1 n
proof:
:= by
  letI := lineOver K U
  haveI := lineOver_lft K U
  haveI : CompactSpace (Line U) := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace (lineProj U)
  intro D hD
  obtain ⟨N, hN, A, hA, hr⟩ := exists_nat_of_mem_Tset
    (cycle_mem_Tset (line_pureRelDim K U) (line_generic_unique U) (line_core K U n) D hD)
  exact ⟨N, hN, A, hA, hr⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F13.towerPureRelDim
statement:
theorem towerPureRelDim : ∀ (m : ℕ) (V : Scheme.{u}) [V.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (V ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsLocallyNoetherian V],
      PureRelDim (towerProj m V) m
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro V _ _ _
    show PureRelDim (𝟙 V) 0
    intro x _
    simp
  | succ m ih =>
    intro V _ _ _
    letI := lineOver K V
    haveI := lineOver_lft K V
    have := PureRelDim.comp (ih (Line V)) (line_pureRelDim K V)
    rw [Nat.add_comm 1 m] at this
    exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F13.cycSurj_tower
statement:
theorem cycSurj_tower : ∀ (m : ℕ) (V : Scheme.{u}) [V.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (V ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsLocallyNoetherian V]
    [CompactSpace V] (n : ℕ), DimensionCatenary (T m V) →
      CycSurj (towerProj m V) m n
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro V _ _ _ _ n hX
    show CycSurj (𝟙 V) 0 n
    intro D hD
    refine ⟨1, one_ne_zero, D, hD, ?_⟩
    rw [flatPullback_id]
    simp only [Nat.cast_one, one_smul, sub_self]
    exact zero_mem _
  | succ m ih =>
    intro V _ _ _ _ n hX
    letI := lineOver K V
    haveI := lineOver_lft K V
    haveI : CompactSpace (Line V) := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace (lineProj V)
    have h1 : CycSurj (towerProj m (Line V)) m (n + 1) := ih (Line V) (n + 1) hX
    have h2 := cycSurj_line K V n
    have hrd := towerPureRelDim K m (Line V)
    have := CycSurj.comp (towerProj m (Line V)) (lineProj V) hX hrd n h1 h2
    rw [Nat.add_comm 1 m] at this
    exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F13.flatPullbackRationalChow_tower_surjective
statement:
theorem flatPullbackRationalChow_tower_surjective (m : ℕ) (V : Scheme.{u})
    [V.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (V ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian V] [CompactSpace V] (n : ℕ) (hX : DimensionCatenary (T m V)) :
    Function.Surjective (flatPullbackRationalChow (towerProj m V) hX
      (towerPureRelDim K m V) n)
proof:
:=
  flatPullbackRationalChow_surjective_of_cycSurj _ hX _ (cycSurj_tower K m V n hX)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.cOpPI_comm
statement:
theorem cOpPI_comm {E F : X.Modules} {r s : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r)
    (hF : HasConstantRank X F s) (i j : ℕ) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.invOfUnit_geometric
statement:
theorem invOfUnit_geometric {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℚ M]
    (x : Module.End ℚ M) :
    PowerSeries.invOfUnit (PowerSeries.mk (fun n => x ^ n)) 1 =
      PowerSeries.mk (fun i => if i = 0 then 1 else if i = 1 then -x else 0)
proof:
:= by
  let φ := PowerSeries.mk (fun i => if i = 0 then 1 else if i = 1 then -x else 0)
  let ψ := PowerSeries.mk (fun n => x ^ n)
  have hφ : PowerSeries.constantCoeff φ = (1 : (Module.End ℚ M)ˣ) := by simp [φ]
  have hψ : PowerSeries.constantCoeff ψ = (1 : (Module.End ℚ M)ˣ) := by simp [ψ]
  have hinv : PowerSeries.invOfUnit φ 1 = ψ := by
    simpa only [neg_neg] using invOfUnit_line (-x)
  have hmul : φ * ψ = 1 := by rw [← hinv]; exact PowerSeries.mul_invOfUnit φ 1 hφ
  change PowerSeries.invOfUnit ψ 1 = φ
  calc
    PowerSeries.invOfUnit ψ 1 = (φ * ψ) * PowerSeries.invOfUnit ψ 1 := by rw [hmul, one_mul]
    _ = φ := by rw [mul_assoc, PowerSeries.mul_invOfUnit ψ 1 hψ, mul_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.segre_of_rankOne
statement:
theorem segre_of_rankOne {L : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (C : AffineFrameCover X L) (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = 0 + 1) (i : ℕ) :
    segre ops C cp hC i = totalCap ops L hL ^ i
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Flat C.toBase := C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos 0))
  haveI := isIso_tautologicalQuotient_of_rankOne C hL
  have hxi : xiCap ops C = totalCap ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj L)
      (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase L 1 hL) :=
    cp.cap_iso _ _ ⟨(asIso C.tautologicalQuotient).symm⟩
  have hc : totalPush ops C.toBase ∘ₗ xiCap ops C =
      totalCap ops L hL ∘ₗ totalPush ops C.toBase := by
    rw [hxi]
    exact cp.cap_push C.toBase L hL
  have hpow := (Module.End.commute_pow_left_of_commute hc.symm i).symm
  have h0 : totalPush ops C.toBase ∘ₗ totalPull ops C.toBase 0
      (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC) = 1 := by
    have h := segre_zero ops C cp hC
    change totalPush ops C.toBase ∘ₗ ((xiCap ops C) ^ (0 + 0)) ∘ₗ
      totalPull ops C.toBase 0 (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC) = 1 at h
    rw [pow_zero] at h
    change totalPush ops C.toBase ∘ₗ LinearMap.id ∘ₗ totalPull ops C.toBase 0
      (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC) = 1 at h
    rwa [LinearMap.id_comp] at h
  change totalPush ops C.toBase ∘ₗ ((xiCap ops C) ^ (0 + i)) ∘ₗ
      totalPull ops C.toBase 0 (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC) = _
  rw [zero_add, ← LinearMap.comp_assoc, hpow, LinearMap.comp_assoc, h0]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.chernOfCover_of_rankOne
statement:
theorem chernOfCover_of_rankOne {L : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (C : AffineFrameCover X L) (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = 0 + 1) :
    chernOfCover ops C cp hC =
      fun i => if i = 0 then 1 else if i = 1 then totalCap ops L hL else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hs : segreSeries ops C cp hC = PowerSeries.mk (fun n => totalCap ops L hL ^ n) := by
    unfold segreSeries
    exact congrArg PowerSeries.mk (funext (segre_of_rankOne ops cp hL C hC))
  funext i
  unfold chernOfCover
  rw [hs, invOfUnit_geometric, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
  by_cases h0 : i = 0
  · subst i; simp
  · by_cases h1 : i = 1
    · subst i
      change (-1 : ℚ) • (-totalCap ops L hL) = totalCap ops L hL
      exact (neg_one_smul ℚ (-totalCap ops L hL)).trans
        (neg_neg (totalCap ops L hL))
    · simp [h0, h1]

statement:

    chernOp ops cp L 1 hL =
      fun i => if i = 0 then 1 else if i = 1 then totalCap ops L hL else 0
proof:
:=
  chernOfCover_of_rankOne ops cp hL _ (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hL).choose_spec

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.chOfChern_chernOp_line
statement:
theorem chOfChern_chernOp_line (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (m : ℕ) :
    chOfChern 1 (chernOp ops cp L 1 hL) m =

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.TripleCommonBasicOpen.isOpenCover
statement:
theorem isOpenCover (A B C : X.affineOpens) :
    IsOpenCover (fun e : TripleCommonBasicOpen A B C ↦ e.inIntersection)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsOpenCover.mk
  refine top_le_iff.mp fun x _ ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨f, g, hfg, hxf⟩ :=
    exists_basicOpen_le_affine_inter A.2 B.2 x.1 ⟨x.2.1.1, x.2.1.2⟩
  let c : CommonBasicOpen A B := ⟨f, g, hfg⟩
  obtain ⟨p, q, hpq, hxp⟩ :=
    exists_basicOpen_le_affine_inter c.affineOpen.2 C.2 x.1 ⟨hxf, x.2.2⟩
  apply Opens.mem_iSup.mpr
  refine ⟨⟨c, p, q, hpq⟩, ?_⟩
  change (x.1 : X) ∈ X.basicOpen p
  exact hxp

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.affineZeroStructureModuleIso_projection
statement:
theorem affineZeroStructureModuleIso_projection (h : IsCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ I)
    (U : X.affineOpens) :
    zeroStructureMapApp X I U.1 ≫ (affineZeroStructureModuleIso X I E σ h U).hom =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (cosectionImageIdeal (affineCosection X E σ U)).mkQ
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module (X.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj (op U.1))
      (cosectionZeroRing (affineCosection X E σ U)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Module Γ(X,U) (cosectionZeroRing (affineCosection X E σ U)))
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro r
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (affineZeroStructureRingIso_projection X E σ I h U) r

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.affineZeroCokernelModuleIso_projection
statement:
theorem affineZeroCokernelModuleIso_projection (h : IsCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ I)
    (U : X.affineOpens) :
    cokernel.π (ModuleCat.ofHom (affineCosection X E σ U)) ≫
      (affineZeroCokernelModuleIso X I E σ h U).hom = zeroStructureMapApp X I U.1
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module (X.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj (op U.1))
      (cosectionZeroRing (affineCosection X E σ U)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Module Γ(X,U) (cosectionZeroRing (affineCosection X E σ U)))
  apply (cancel_mono (affineZeroStructureModuleIso X I E σ h U).hom).mp
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro r
  change (affineZeroStructureModuleIso X I E σ h U).hom
      ((affineZeroStructureModuleIso X I E σ h U).inv
        ((cosectionCokernelZeroRingIso (affineCosection X E σ U)).hom
          (cokernel.π (ModuleCat.ofHom (affineCosection X E σ U)) r))) = _
  calc
    _ = (cosectionCokernelZeroRingIso (affineCosection X E σ U)).hom
        (cokernel.π (ModuleCat.ofHom (affineCosection X E σ U)) r) :=
      ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (affineZeroStructureModuleIso X I E σ h U).inv_hom_id _
    _ = (cosectionImageIdeal (affineCosection X E σ U)).mkQ r :=
      ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (cosectionCokernelZeroRingIso_projection
        (affineCosection X E σ U)) r
    _ = _ := (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (affineZeroStructureModuleIso_projection X I E σ h U) r).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.zeroStructureMap_affine_cosection_zero

theorem zeroStructureMap_affine_cosection_zero (h : IsCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ I)
    (U : X.affineOpens) :
    (σ.val.app (op U.1)) ≫ (zeroStructureMap X I).val.app (op U.1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module (X.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj (op U.1))
      (cosectionZeroRing (affineCosection X E σ U)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Module Γ(X,U) (cosectionZeroRing (affineCosection X E σ U)))
  apply (cancel_mono (affineZeroStructureModuleIso X I E σ h U).hom).mp
  rw [Category.assoc]
  change (σ.val.app (op U.1)) ≫
      (zeroStructureMapApp X I U.1 ≫ (affineZeroStructureModuleIso X I E σ h U).hom) = _
  rw [affineZeroStructureModuleIso_projection]
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  exact (cosectionZeroQuotient_cosection (affineCosection X E σ U) x).trans
    (map_zero (affineZeroStructureModuleIso X I E σ h U).hom.hom).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D2.pullD2_mk
statement:
theorem pullD2_mk (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat f] (d : ℕ) (hd : PureRelDim f d) (n : ℕ)
    (D : dimensionCycles Y n) :
    pullD2 (k := k) f d hd n ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow Y n)) =
      (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk
        (⟨flatPullback f D.1, flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles f hd D.2⟩ :
          dimensionCycles X (n + d)) : DimChow X (n + d))
proof:
:= by
  simp [pullD2, flatPullbackChowOfFiniteType, flatPullbackChow]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D2.pull_eq_pullD2
statement:
theorem pull_eq_pullD2 (ops : ChowOps k) (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat f] (d : ℕ)
    (hd : PureRelDim f d) (n : ℕ) : ops.pull f d hd n = pullD2 (k := k) f d hd n
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a y =>
    induction y using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H D =>
      have h1 : a ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow Y n) =
          a • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow Y n)) := by
        rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      rw [h1, map_smul, map_smul]
      congr 1
      rw [pullD2_mk (k := k)]
      exact ops.pull_mk f d hd n D _ (fun x ↦ rfl)
  | add x y hx hy => simp [map_add, hx, hy]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D2.lof_heq

lemma lof_heq {X : Scheme.{u}} {i j : ℕ} (h : i = j) (x : RationalDimChow X i)
    (y : RationalDimChow X j) (hxy : HEq x y) :
    DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) i x =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) j y
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rw [eq_of_heq hxy]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D2.heq_mk_of_eq
statement:
lemma heq_mk_of_eq {X : Scheme.{u}} {i j : ℕ} (h : i = j) (D : dimensionCycles X i)
    (E : dimensionCycles X j) (hDE : D.1 = E.1) :
    HEq ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X i))
      ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk E : DimChow X j))
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  have : D = E := Subtype.ext hDE
  subst this
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D2.totalPull_comp
statement:
theorem totalPull_comp (ops : ChowOps k) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) [f.IsOver (Spk k)]
    [g.IsOver (Spk k)] [(f ≫ g).IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat f] [Flat g] [Flat (f ≫ g)] (df dg : ℕ)
    (hf : PureRelDim f df) (hg : PureRelDim g dg) (hfg : PureRelDim (f ≫ g) (dg + df)) :
    totalPull ops (f ≫ g) (dg + df) hfg = totalPull ops f df hf ∘ₗ totalPull ops g dg hg
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a y =>
    induction y using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H D =>
      have h1 : a ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow Z n) =
          a • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow Z n)) := by
        rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      rw [h1]
      simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.comp_apply]
      congr 1
      simp only [totalPull, DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply,
        pull_eq_pullD2, pullD2_mk (k := k)]
      exact lof_heq (Nat.add_assoc n dg df).symm _ _
        (heq_mk_of_eq (Nat.add_assoc n dg df).symm _ _ (flatPullback_comp f g D.1))
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.SPECK.basicOpen_coordinate_zero_eq_top
statement:
theorem basicOpen_coordinate_zero_eq_top :
    Proj.basicOpen (grading k 0) (coordinate k 0 0) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine top_unique ((coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top k 0).symm.le.trans (iSup_le fun i ↦ ?_))
  have h : i = 0 := Fin.ext (by have := i.isLt; simp at this ⊢; try omega)
  rw [h]
  exact le_rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.SPECK.eq_C_mul_X_pow
statement:
theorem eq_C_mul_X_pow {n : ℕ} {a : Polynomial k 0} (ha : a ∈ grading k 0 n) :
    a = MvPolynomial.C (MvPolynomial.coeff (Finsupp.single 0 n) a) *
      MvPolynomial.X (0 : Fin 1) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  rw [MvPolynomial.X_pow_eq_monomial, MvPolynomial.coeff_C_mul, MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial]
  by_cases hm : Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 1) n = m
  · subst hm
    simp
  · rw [if_neg hm, mul_zero]
    by_contra hne
    have hdeg := ha hne
    apply hm
    refine Finsupp.ext fun i ↦ ?_
    have hi : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    subst hi
    have hm0 : m 0 = n := by
      simpa [Finsupp.weight_apply, Finsupp.sum_fintype] using hdeg
    simp [hm0]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.SPECK.fromZeroRingHom_coordinate_bijective
statement:
theorem fromZeroRingHom_coordinate_bijective :
    Function.Bijective (HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom (grading k 0)
      (Submonoid.powers (coordinate k 0 0)))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro y hy
    have hv := congrArg HomogeneousLocalization.val hy
    change Localization.mk y.1 1 = Localization.mk 0 1 at hv
    rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists] at hv
    obtain ⟨⟨c, m, rfl⟩, hc⟩ := hv
    simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, mul_zero] at hc
    apply Subtype.ext
    change y.1 = 0
    ext s
    have h2 := congrArg (MvPolynomial.coeff (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 1) m + s)) hc
    change MvPolynomial.coeff _ (MvPolynomial.X (0 : Fin 1) ^ m * y.1) = _ at h2
    rw [MvPolynomial.X_pow_eq_monomial, MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial_mul] at h2
    simpa using h2
  · intro z
    obtain ⟨n, a, ha, rfl⟩ := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_surjective
      (grading k 0) (coordinate_mem_degree_one k 0 0) z
    have ha' : a ∈ grading k 0 n := by simpa using ha
    refine ⟨⟨MvPolynomial.C (MvPolynomial.coeff (Finsupp.single 0 n) a),
      MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_C (σ := Fin 1) _⟩, ?_⟩
    apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
    rw [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk]
    change Localization.mk _ 1 = _
    rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul]
    conv_rhs => rw [eq_C_mul_X_pow k ha']
    rw [mul_comm]
    rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction_app_of_le
statement:
theorem pushedUnitRestriction_app_of_le {X : Scheme.{u}} {U V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (W : X.Opens) (hW : W ≤ V) :
    homOfLE (pushedUnitRestrictionOpen hVU W) =
      (eqToIso (by
        rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
        exact inf_eq_right.mpr hW :
          V.ι ''ᵁ (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W) = W)).hom ≫
      (eqToIso (by
        rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
        exact inf_eq_right.mpr (hW.trans hVU) :
          U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W) = W)).inv
proof:
:=
  Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction_app_of_le_apply
statement:
theorem pushedUnitRestriction_app_of_le_apply {X : Scheme.{u}} {U V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (W : X.Opens) (hW : W ≤ V) (s : Γ(pushedUnit X U, W)) :
    (pushedUnitRestriction hVU).app W s =
      X.presheaf.map (eqToIso (by
        rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
        exact inf_eq_right.mpr hW :
          V.ι ''ᵁ (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W) = W)).hom.op
        (X.presheaf.map (eqToIso (by
          rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
          exact inf_eq_right.mpr (hW.trans hVU) :
            U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W) = W)).inv.op s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pushedUnitRestriction_app_apply, pushedUnitRestriction_app_of_le hVU W hW]
  simp only [op_comp, Functor.map_comp, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction_app_of_le_heq
statement:
theorem pushedUnitRestriction_app_of_le_heq {X : Scheme.{u}} {U V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (W : X.Opens) (hW : W ≤ V) (s : Γ(pushedUnit X U, W)) :
    HEq ((pushedUnitRestriction hVU).app W s) s
proof:
:= by
  rw [pushedUnitRestriction_app_of_le_apply hVU W hW s]
  set inner := X.presheaf.map (eqToIso (by
      rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
      exact inf_eq_right.mpr (hW.trans hVU) :
        U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W) = W)).inv.op s with hinner
  have step1 : HEq (X.presheaf.map (eqToIso (by
      rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
      exact inf_eq_right.mpr hW :
        V.ι ''ᵁ (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W) = W)).hom.op inner) inner :=
    heq_presheaf_map_eqToIso_hom_op (X := X) _ inner
  have step2 : HEq inner s := heq_presheaf_map_eqToIso_inv_op (X := X) _ s
  exact step1.trans step2

theorem projectiveTwistingSheafLift_ι {M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n).Modules} (d : ℤ)
    (f : M ⟶ coordinateChartCochains k n)
    (hf : f ≫ coordinateDescentLeft k n = f ≫ coordinateDescentRight k n d) :
    projectiveTwistingSheafLift k n d f hf ≫
        kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d) = f
proof:
:=
  kernel.lift_ι _ _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingSheafLift_unique
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingSheafLift_unique {M : (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n).Modules} (d : ℤ)
    (f : M ⟶ coordinateChartCochains k n)
    (hf : f ≫ coordinateDescentLeft k n = f ≫ coordinateDescentRight k n d)
    (g : M ⟶ projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d)
    (hg : g ≫ kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d) = f) :
    g = projectiveTwistingSheafLift k n d f hf
proof:
:= by
  change M ⟶ kernel (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d) at g
  change g ≫ kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d) = f at hg
  change g = kernel.lift _ f _
  apply (cancel_mono
    (kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d))).1
  rw [hg, kernel.lift_ι]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top
statement:
theorem coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) :
    ⨆ i : Fin (n + 1), coordinateOpen R n i = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply Proj.iSup_basicOpen_eq_top (grading R n) (coordinate R n)
  rw [HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_irrelevant_le]
  intro d hd p hp
  change p ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range (MvPolynomial.X (R := R)))
  rw [show Set.range (MvPolynomial.X (R := R)) =
      MvPolynomial.X '' (Set.univ : Set (Fin (n + 1))) by simp]
  rw [MvPolynomial.mem_ideal_span_X_image]
  intro m hm
  have hdeg : m.degree = d := by
    rw [Finsupp.degree_eq_weight_one]
    exact hp (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hm)
  have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by
    intro hm0
    subst m
    simp at hdeg
    omega
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Finsupp.ne_iff.mp hm0
  exact ⟨i, Set.mem_univ _, hi⟩

    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback s).hom.app M ≫
