name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackSquareRestrictionIso_eq_pullbackComp
statement:
theorem pullbackSquareRestrictionIso_eq_pullbackComp
    {A B D Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (r : D ⟶ B) (q : B ⟶ A) (e : D ⟶ Z) (c : Z ⟶ A)
    [IsOpenImmersion r] [IsOpenImmersion q]
    [IsOpenImmersion e] [IsOpenImmersion c]
    [IsOpenImmersion (e ≫ c)] [IsOpenImmersion (r ≫ q)]
    (h : e ≫ c = r ≫ q) (M : A.Modules) :
    pullbackSquareRestrictionIso r q e c h M =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback r).app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).obj M) ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp r q).app M ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr h.symm).app M ≪≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp e c).app M).symm
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  simpa only [pullbackSquareRestrictionIso, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom,
    Iso.app_hom, Iso.app_inv, Category.assoc] using
    congrArg (fun z =>
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback r).app
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).obj M)).hom ≫ z)
      (pullbackSquareRestrictionIso_eq_comp r q e c h M).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictFunctor_map_eq_pullback_map_conj
statement:
theorem restrictFunctor_map_eq_pullback_map_conj
    {Y D : Scheme.{u}} (g : D ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion g]
    {M N : Y.Modules} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor g).map f =
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback g).app M).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map f ≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback g).app N).inv
proof:
:= by
  have h := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback g).hom.naturality f
  have h' := congrArg (fun z => z ≫
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback g).app N).inv) h
  simpa only [← Iso.app_hom, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id,
    Category.comp_id] using h'

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.iso_square_conj
statement:
theorem iso_square_conj
    {T : Type v} [Category T]
    {P Q R S : T} (a : P ≅ Q) (b : R ≅ S)
    {V W : T} (c : P ≅ V) (d : R ≅ W)
    (f : Q ⟶ S) (g : V ⟶ W)
    (h : a.hom ≫ f ≫ b.inv = c.hom ≫ g ≫ d.inv) :
    f = a.inv ≫ c.hom ≫ g ≫ d.inv ≫ b.hom
proof:
:= by
  have h' := congrArg (fun z => a.inv ≫ z ≫ b.hom) h
  simpa only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc,
    Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id] using h'

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistOverlapSourceSquareRestrictionIso_eq_local
statement:
theorem twistOverlapSourceSquareRestrictionIso_eq_local
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    C.twistOverlapSourceSquareRestrictionIso d i j c =
      C.twistOverlapSourceLocalSchemeIso d i j c
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.overlapToChart i j) :=
    C.overlapToChart_isOpenImmersion i j
  letI : IsOpenImmersion c.chartToLeft :=
    CommonBasicOpen.chartToLeft_isOpenImmersion c
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom := by
    infer_instance
  letI : IsOpenImmersion
      ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ≫ c.chartToLeft) := by
    exact @IsOpenImmersion.comp _ _ _
      (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom c.chartToLeft
      (by infer_instance) (CommonBasicOpen.chartToLeft_isOpenImmersion c)
  letI : IsOpenImmersion
      ((C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι ≫ C.overlapToChart i j) := by
    infer_instance
  unfold twistOverlapSourceSquareRestrictionIso
  change pullbackSquareRestrictionIso
      (C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι (C.overlapToChart i j)
      (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom c.chartToLeft
      (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver_hom_chartToLeft i j c)
      (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i) =
    C.twistOverlapSourceLocalSchemeIso d i j c
  rw [pullbackSquareRestrictionIso_eq_pullbackComp]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistOverlapTargetSquareRestrictionIso_eq_local
statement:
theorem twistOverlapTargetSquareRestrictionIso_eq_local
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    C.twistOverlapTargetSquareRestrictionIso d i j c =
      C.twistOverlapTargetLocalSchemeIso d i j c
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.transition i j) :=
    C.transition_isOpenImmersion' i j
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i) :=
    @IsOpenImmersion.comp _ _ _ (C.transition i j) (C.overlapToChart j i)
      (C.transition_isOpenImmersion' i j)
      (C.overlapToChart_isOpenImmersion j i)
  letI : IsOpenImmersion c.chartToRight :=
    CommonBasicOpen.chartToRight_isOpenImmersion c
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom := by
    infer_instance
  letI : IsOpenImmersion
      ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ≫ c.chartToRight) :=
    @IsOpenImmersion.comp _ _ _
      (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom c.chartToRight
      (by infer_instance) (CommonBasicOpen.chartToRight_isOpenImmersion c)
  letI : IsOpenImmersion
      ((C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι ≫
        (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i)) := by
    infer_instance
  unfold twistOverlapTargetSquareRestrictionIso
  change pullbackSquareRestrictionIso
      (C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι
      (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i)
      (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom c.chartToRight
      (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver_hom_chartToRight i j c)
      (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j) =
    C.twistOverlapTargetLocalSchemeIso d i j c
  rw [pullbackSquareRestrictionIso_eq_pullbackComp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.component_minimalPrime_map_of_surjective
statement:
theorem component_minimalPrime_map_of_surjective
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) {q : Ideal R} (hq : q ∈ minimalPrimes R)
    (hker : RingHom.ker f ≤ q) : q.map f ∈ minimalPrimes S
proof:
:= by
  have hq' : q ∈ (RingHom.ker f).minimalPrimes :=
    ⟨⟨hq.1.1, hker⟩, fun _ h hle ↦ hq.2 ⟨h.1, bot_le⟩ hle⟩
  have h := Ideal.minimalPrimes_map_of_surjective hf (⊥ : Ideal R)
  rw [Ideal.map_bot, sup_of_le_right bot_le] at h
  change q.map f ∈ (⊥ : Ideal S).minimalPrimes
  rw [h]
  exact ⟨q, hq', rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.component_quotient_trdeg_of_surjective
statement:
theorem component_quotient_trdeg_of_surjective
    {K R S : Type u} [CommRing K] [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra K R] [Algebra K S] (f : R →ₐ[K] S)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) (q : Ideal R) (hker : RingHom.ker f.toRingHom ≤ q) :
    Algebra.trdeg K (R ⧸ q) = Algebra.trdeg K (S ⧸ q.map f.toRingHom)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (q.map f.toRingHom).comap f.toRingHom = q := by
    rw [Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective f.toRingHom hf, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot,
      sup_eq_left.mpr hker]
  let ψ : R ⧸ q →ₐ[K] S ⧸ q.map f.toRingHom :=
    Ideal.quotientMapₐ (q.map f.toRingHom) f Ideal.le_comap_map
  have hi : Function.Injective ψ := Ideal.quotientMap_injective' (H := Ideal.le_comap_map) hc.le
  have hs : Function.Surjective ψ := Ideal.quotientMap_surjective (H := Ideal.le_comap_map) hf
  exact (AlgEquiv.ofBijective ψ ⟨hi, hs⟩).trdeg_eq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.tensorComponentQuotientMap_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tensorComponentQuotientMap_tmul (p : Ideal A) (l : L) (a : A) :
    tensorComponentQuotientMap p (l ⊗ₜ[K] a) = l ⊗ₜ[K] Ideal.Quotient.mk p a
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.tensorComponentQuotientMap_factor
statement:
theorem tensorComponentQuotientMap_factor (p : Ideal A) :
    tensorComponentQuotientMap (K := K) (L := L) p =
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.tensorQuotientEquiv (R := K) L A L p).symm.toAlgHom.comp
        (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ L (p.map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := K) (A := L))))
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  change (1 : L) ⊗ₜ[K] Ideal.Quotient.mk p a =
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.tensorQuotientEquiv (R := K) L A L p).symm
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ ((1 : L) ⊗ₜ[K] a))
  exact (Algebra.TensorProduct.tensorQuotientEquiv_symm_apply_tmul
    (R := K) L A L p 1 a).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.tensorComponentQuotientMap_surjective
statement:
theorem tensorComponentQuotientMap_surjective (p : Ideal A) :
    Function.Surjective (tensorComponentQuotientMap (K := K) (L := L) p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorComponentQuotientMap_factor]
  exact (Algebra.TensorProduct.tensorQuotientEquiv (R := K) L A L p).symm.surjective.comp
    Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.tensorComponentQuotientMap_ker
statement:
theorem tensorComponentQuotientMap_ker (p : Ideal A) :
    RingHom.ker (tensorComponentQuotientMap (K := K) (L := L) p).toRingHom =
      p.map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := K) (A := L))
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorComponentQuotientMap_factor]
  ext x
  change (Algebra.TensorProduct.tensorQuotientEquiv (R := K) L A L p).symm
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ x) = 0 ↔ _
  rw [← map_zero (Algebra.TensorProduct.tensorQuotientEquiv (R := K) L A L p).symm,
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.tensorQuotientEquiv (R := K) L A L p).symm.injective.eq_iff,
    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.fibreFieldTensor_component_trdeg
statement:
theorem fibreFieldTensor_component_trdeg
    {K L A : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [CommRing A]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra K A]
    {q : Ideal (L ⊗[K] A)} (hq : q ∈ minimalPrimes (L ⊗[K] A)) :
    Algebra.trdeg L ((L ⊗[K] A) ⧸ q) =
      Algebra.trdeg K (A ⧸ q.comap
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := K) (A := L)).toRingHom)
proof:
:= by
  let T := L ⊗[K] A
  let i : A →+* T := Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom
  let p : Ideal A := q.comap i
  letI : q.IsPrime := hq.1.1
  letI : p.IsPrime := Ideal.IsPrime.comap i
  let U := L ⊗[K] (A ⧸ p)
  letI : CommRing U := inferInstance
  let φ : T →ₐ[L] U := tensorComponentQuotientMap (K := K) (L := L) p
  have hs : Function.Surjective φ := tensorComponentQuotientMap_surjective p
  have hker : RingHom.ker φ.toRingHom ≤ q := by
    rw [tensorComponentQuotientMap_ker]
    exact Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr le_rfl
  have hq' : q.map φ.toRingHom ∈ minimalPrimes U :=
    component_minimalPrime_map_of_surjective φ.toRingHom hs hq hker
  calc
    Algebra.trdeg L (T ⧸ q) = Algebra.trdeg L (U ⧸ q.map φ.toRingHom) :=
      component_quotient_trdeg_of_surjective φ hs q hker
    _ = Algebra.trdeg K (A ⧸ p) := domainFieldTensor_trdeg_quotient hq'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.fibreFieldTensor_component_contraction_minimal
statement:
theorem fibreFieldTensor_component_contraction_minimal
    {K L A : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [CommRing A]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra K A]
    {q : Ideal (L ⊗[K] A)} (hq : q ∈ minimalPrimes (L ⊗[K] A)) :
    q.comap (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := K) (A := L)).toRingHom
      ∈ minimalPrimes A
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra A (L ⊗[K] A) := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  letI : Module.Free K L := Module.Free.of_divisionRing K L
  letI : Module.Flat A (L ⊗[K] A) := Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.commRight K A L).toLinearEquiv.symm
  exact minimalPrime_under_of_flat (R := A) hq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.fibreFieldTensor_component_residueField_trdeg
statement:
theorem fibreFieldTensor_component_residueField_trdeg
    {K L A : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [CommRing A]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra K A]
    {q : Ideal (L ⊗[K] A)} (hq : q ∈ minimalPrimes (L ⊗[K] A)) :
    letI : q.IsPrime
proof:
:= hq.1.1
    let p := q.comap (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := K) (A := L)).toRingHom
    letI : p.IsPrime := Ideal.IsPrime.comap _
    Algebra.trdeg L q.ResidueField = Algebra.trdeg K p.ResidueField := by
  letI : q.IsPrime := hq.1.1
  let p := q.comap (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := K) (A := L)).toRingHom
  letI : p.IsPrime := Ideal.IsPrime.comap _
  haveI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic ((L ⊗[K] A) ⧸ q) q.ResidueField :=
    SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.isAlgebraic_of_isFractionRing' _ _
  haveI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (A ⧸ p) p.ResidueField :=
    SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.isAlgebraic_of_isFractionRing' _ _
  calc
    Algebra.trdeg L q.ResidueField = Algebra.trdeg L ((L ⊗[K] A) ⧸ q) :=
      SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.trdeg_eq_of_isAlgebraic L _ _
    _ = Algebra.trdeg K (A ⧸ p) := fibreFieldTensor_component_trdeg hq
    _ = Algebra.trdeg K p.ResidueField :=
      (SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.trdeg_eq_of_isAlgebraic K _ _).symm

name: SchemeCurveCharacteristicClasses.CurveAdditiveChernData.chernCharacter_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chernCharacter_classOf (d : CurveAdditiveChernData X)
    (E : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X M}) :
    d.chernCharacter (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ E) = d.value E
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.lift_classOf

name: SchemeCurveCharacteristicClasses.CurveChernData.chernCharacter_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chernCharacter_classOf (d : CurveChernData X)
    (E : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X M}) :
    d.chernCharacter (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ E) = d.value E
proof:
:= by
  exact SchemeKTheory.k0RingLift_classOf X d.value
    (fun A B C h ↦ by
      change (d.rank B, d.firstChern B) =
        (d.rank A + d.rank C, d.firstChern A + d.firstChern C)
      rw [d.rank_exact A B C h, d.firstChern_exact A B C h])
    (fun A B ↦ by
      change (d.rank (SchemeKTheory.k0TensorObject X A B),
          d.firstChern (SchemeKTheory.k0TensorObject X A B)) =
        (d.rank A * d.rank B,
          d.rank A •> d.firstChern B + d.firstChern A <• d.rank B)
      simp only [op_smul_eq_smul]
      rw [d.rank_tensor A B, d.firstChern_tensor A B])
    (by
      change (d.rank (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitObject X),
          d.firstChern (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitObject X)) = (1, 0)
      rw [d.rank_unit, d.firstChern_unit]) E

name: SchemeCurveCharacteristicClasses.integral_additiveChernCharacter_mul_toddClass
statement:
theorem integral_additiveChernCharacter_mul_toddClass
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (d : CurveAdditiveChernData X) (x : SchemeKTheory.K0 X)
    (tangentFirstChern : AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalCodimensionChow X 1)
    (degree : AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalCodimensionChow X 1 →+ ℚ) :
    integral degree (d.chernCharacter x * toddClass tangentFirstChern) =
      degree ((d.chernCharacter x).1 •
        (((1 : ℚ) / 2) • tangentFirstChern) + (d.chernCharacter x).2)
proof:
:= by
  change degree ((d.chernCharacter x).1 •
      (((1 : ℚ) / 2) • tangentFirstChern) +
    (d.chernCharacter x).2 <• (1 : ℚ)) = _
  simp only [op_smul_eq_smul, one_smul]

name: SchemeCurveCharacteristicClasses.formula_of_vectorBundle_rank_firstChern_additive
statement:
theorem formula_of_vectorBundle_rank_firstChern_additive
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (d : CurveAdditiveChernData X)
    (tangentFirstChern : AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalCodimensionChow X 1)
    (degree : AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalCodimensionChow X 1 →+ ℚ)
    (hfinite : ∀ (E : X.Modules), SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X E →
      E.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (hbundle : ∀ E : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X M},
      (E.1.eulerChar k : ℚ) = degree
        (d.rank E • (((1 : ℚ) / 2) • tangentFirstChern) + d.firstChern E))
    (z : SchemeKTheory.K0 X) :
    (SchemeKTheory.k0Euler k hfinite z : ℚ) =
      degree ((d.chernCharacter z).1 •
        (((1 : ℚ) / 2) • tangentFirstChern) + (d.chernCharacter z).2)
proof:
:= by
  have h := SchemeHirzebruchRiemannRoch.formula_of_vectorBundle_classes
    k hfinite d.chernCharacter (toddClass tangentFirstChern) (integral degree)
    (fun E ↦ by
      rw [integral_additiveChernCharacter_mul_toddClass d,
        d.chernCharacter_classOf]
      exact hbundle E) z
  rw [integral_additiveChernCharacter_mul_toddClass d] at h
  exact h

        (d.chernCharacter.toAddMonoidHom x * toddClass tangentFirstChern) =
      degree ((d.chernCharacter x).1 •
        (((1 : ℚ) / 2) • tangentFirstChern) + (d.chernCharacter x).2)
proof:
:= by

      (((1 : ℚ) / 2) • tangentFirstChern) +
    (d.chernCharacter x).2 <• (1 : ℚ)) = _

name: SchemeCurveCharacteristicClasses.formula_of_vectorBundle_rank_firstChern
statement:
theorem formula_of_vectorBundle_rank_firstChern
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (d : CurveChernData X)
    (tangentFirstChern : AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalCodimensionChow X 1)
    (degree : AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalCodimensionChow X 1 →+ ℚ)
    (hfinite : ∀ (E : X.Modules), SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X E →
      E.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (hbundle : ∀ E : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X M},
      (E.1.eulerChar k : ℚ) = degree
        (d.rank E • (((1 : ℚ) / 2) • tangentFirstChern) + d.firstChern E))
    (z : SchemeKTheory.K0 X) :
    (SchemeKTheory.k0Euler k hfinite z : ℚ) =
      degree ((d.chernCharacter z).1 •
        (((1 : ℚ) / 2) • tangentFirstChern) + (d.chernCharacter z).2)
proof:
:= by
  have h := SchemeHirzebruchRiemannRoch.formula_of_vectorBundle_classes
    k hfinite d.chernCharacter.toAddMonoidHom (toddClass tangentFirstChern) (integral degree)
    (fun E ↦ by
      rw [integral_chernCharacter_mul_toddClass d, d.chernCharacter_classOf]
      exact hbundle E) z
  rw [integral_chernCharacter_mul_toddClass d] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeCurveCharacteristicClasses.eulerChar_eq_integral_rank_firstChern_of_cartierWalk_additive
statement:
theorem eulerChar_eq_integral_rank_firstChern_of_cartierWalk_additive
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (d : CurveAdditiveChernData X)
    (E : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X M})
    (n : ℤ)
    (walk : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.CartierWalk k
      (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.structureModule X) E.1 n)
    (tangentFirstChern : AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalCodimensionChow X 1)
    (degree : AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalCodimensionChow X 1 →+ ℚ)
    (hrank : d.rank E = 1)
    (hfirstChern : degree (d.firstChern E) = (n : ℚ))
    (htangent : degree (((1 : ℚ) / 2) • tangentFirstChern) =
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.structureModule X).eulerChar k : ℚ)) :
    (E.1.eulerChar k : ℚ) =
      degree (d.firstChern E +
        d.rank E • (((1 : ℚ) / 2) • tangentFirstChern))
proof:
:= by
  have hw := walk.riemann_roch
  calc
    (E.1.eulerChar k : ℚ) =
        ((n + (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.structureModule X).eulerChar k : ℤ) : ℚ) :=
      congrArg Int.cast hw
    _ = (n : ℚ) +
        ((AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.structureModule X).eulerChar k : ℚ) := by
      rw [Int.cast_add]
    _ = degree (d.firstChern E) +
        degree (((1 : ℚ) / 2) • tangentFirstChern) := by
      rw [hfirstChern, htangent]
    _ = degree (d.firstChern E +
        (((1 : ℚ) / 2) • tangentFirstChern)) := (map_add degree _ _).symm
    _ = degree (d.firstChern E +
        d.rank E • (((1 : ℚ) / 2) • tangentFirstChern)) := by
      rw [hrank, one_smul]

name: SchemeCurveCharacteristicClasses.eulerChar_eq_integral_rank_firstChern_of_freeCartierWalk_additive
statement:
theorem eulerChar_eq_integral_rank_firstChern_of_freeCartierWalk_additive
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (d : CurveAdditiveChernData X)
    (hfinite : ∀ (F : X.Modules), SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X F →
      F.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k)
    (E : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X M})
    (r : ℕ) (n : ℤ)
    (walk : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.CartierWalk k
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r))) E.1 n)
    (tangentFirstChern : AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalCodimensionChow X 1)
    (degree : AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalCodimensionChow X 1 →+ ℚ)
    (hrank : d.rank E = (r : ℚ))
    (hfirstChern : degree (d.firstChern E) = (n : ℚ))
    (htangent : degree (((1 : ℚ) / 2) • tangentFirstChern) =
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.structureModule X).eulerChar k : ℚ)) :
    (E.1.eulerChar k : ℚ) =
      degree (d.firstChern E +
        d.rank E • (((1 : ℚ) / 2) • tangentFirstChern))
proof:
:= by
  have hw := walk.eulerChar_eq
  have hfree := SchemeKTheory.eulerChar_free_fin k hfinite r
  have htangentUnit : degree (((1 : ℚ) / 2) • tangentFirstChern) =
      (Scheme.Modules.eulerChar k (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) : ℚ) :=
    htangent
  calc
    (E.1.eulerChar k : ℚ) =
        ((n + Scheme.Modules.eulerChar k
          (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf)
            (ULift.{u} (Fin r))) : ℤ) : ℚ) :=
      congrArg Int.cast hw
    _ = (n : ℚ) +
        (Scheme.Modules.eulerChar k
          (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf)
            (ULift.{u} (Fin r))) : ℚ) := by
      rw [Int.cast_add]
    _ = (n : ℚ) + (r : ℚ) *
        (Scheme.Modules.eulerChar k (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) : ℚ) := by
      rw [hfree]
      simp only [nsmul_eq_mul]
      norm_cast
    _ = degree (d.firstChern E) + (r : ℚ) *
        degree (((1 : ℚ) / 2) • tangentFirstChern) := by
      rw [hfirstChern, htangentUnit]
    _ = degree (d.firstChern E) +
        degree ((r : ℚ) • (((1 : ℚ) / 2) • tangentFirstChern)) := by
      rw [Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul, map_nsmul, nsmul_eq_mul]
    _ = degree (d.firstChern E +
        (r : ℚ) • (((1 : ℚ) / 2) • tangentFirstChern)) :=
      (map_add degree _ _).symm
    _ = degree (d.firstChern E +
        d.rank E • (((1 : ℚ) / 2) • tangentFirstChern)) := by
      rw [hrank]

name: SchemeCurveCharacteristicClasses.CurveFreeCartierPresentation.targetFinite
statement:
theorem targetFinite (p : CurveFreeCartierPresentation k d degreeMap E) :
    E.1.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k
proof:
:=
  p.walk.targetFinite p.sourceFinite

name: SchemeCurveCharacteristicClasses.formula_of_freeCartierPresentations_additive
statement:
theorem formula_of_freeCartierPresentations_additive
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (d : CurveAdditiveChernData X)
    (tangentFirstChern : AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalCodimensionChow X 1)
    (degreeMap : AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalCodimensionChow X 1 →+ ℚ)
    (hpresentation : ∀ E :
      {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X M},
      CurveFreeCartierPresentation k d degreeMap E)
    (htangent : degreeMap (((1 : ℚ) / 2) • tangentFirstChern) =
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.structureModule X).eulerChar k : ℚ))
    (z : SchemeKTheory.K0 X) :
    (SchemeKTheory.k0Euler k
        (fun E hE ↦ (hpresentation ⟨E, hE⟩).targetFinite) z : ℚ) =
      degreeMap ((d.chernCharacter z).1 •
        (((1 : ℚ) / 2) • tangentFirstChern) + (d.chernCharacter z).2)
proof:
:= by
  let hfinite : ∀ (F : X.Modules), SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X F →
      F.HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic k :=
    fun F hF ↦ (hpresentation ⟨F, hF⟩).targetFinite
  apply formula_of_vectorBundle_rank_firstChern_additive k d tangentFirstChern
    degreeMap hfinite
  intro E
  let p := hpresentation E
  simpa only [add_comm] using
    (eulerChar_eq_integral_rank_firstChern_of_freeCartierWalk_additive
      k d hfinite E p.rank p.degree p.walk tangentFirstChern degreeMap
        p.rank_eq p.firstChern_degree htangent)

name: SchemeCurveCharacteristicClasses.eulerChar_eq_integral_rank_firstChern_of_cartierWalk
statement:
theorem eulerChar_eq_integral_rank_firstChern_of_cartierWalk
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (d : CurveChernData X)
    (E : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X M})
    (n : ℤ)
    (walk : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.CartierWalk k
      (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.structureModule X) E.1 n)
    (tangentFirstChern : AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalCodimensionChow X 1)
    (degree : AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalCodimensionChow X 1 →+ ℚ)
    (hrank : d.rank E = 1)
    (hfirstChern : degree (d.firstChern E) = (n : ℚ))
    (htangent : degree (((1 : ℚ) / 2) • tangentFirstChern) =
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.structureModule X).eulerChar k : ℚ)) :
    (E.1.eulerChar k : ℚ) =
      degree (d.firstChern E +
        d.rank E • (((1 : ℚ) / 2) • tangentFirstChern))
proof:
:=
  eulerChar_eq_integral_rank_firstChern_of_cartierWalk_additive
    k d.toAdditive E n walk tangentFirstChern degree hrank hfirstChern htangent

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistPulledRecovery_postTarget_prefix
statement:
theorem transportTwistPulledRecovery_postTarget_prefix (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (h : TransportTwistOverlapCompat e C') (i j : C'.I) :
    let D
proof:
:= C'.twistingSheafDescentData 1 (C'.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1)
    let Dn := (transport e C').twistingSheafDescentData 1
      ((transport e C').canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1)
    (transportTwistPulledRecoveryAlong e C' i (Dn.left (i,j)) ≫
      (Dn.transition (i,j)).hom) ≫ (twistOverlapTargetTransportIso e C' i j).hom =
    (transportTwistOverlapLeftAmbientIso e C' i j).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (overlapIso e C' i j).hom).map
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackRecoveryAlong D i (D.left (i,j))) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (overlapIso e C' i j).hom).map (D.transition (i,j)).hom := by
  let D := C'.twistingSheafDescentData 1 (C'.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1)
  let Dn := (transport e C').twistingSheafDescentData 1
      ((transport e C').canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1)
  let a := transportTwistPulledRecoveryAlong e C' i (Dn.left (i,j))
  let u := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (overlapIso e C' i j).hom).map
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackRecoveryAlong D i (D.left (i,j)))
  have hT : (Dn.transition (i,j)).hom ≫
      (twistOverlapTargetTransportIso e C' i j).hom =
    (twistOverlapSourceTransportIso e C' i j).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (overlapIso e C' i j).hom).map (D.transition (i,j)).hom := h i j
  have h₁ := transportTwistRecoveryAssembly_left e C' i j
  calc
    (a ≫ (Dn.transition (i,j)).hom) ≫ (twistOverlapTargetTransportIso e C' i j).hom =
        a ≫ (twistOverlapSourceTransportIso e C' i j).hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback (overlapIso e C' i j).hom).map (D.transition (i,j)).hom := by
      rw [Category.assoc, hT]
    _ = (transportTwistOverlapLeftAmbientIso e C' i j).hom ≫ u ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback (overlapIso e C' i j).hom).map (D.transition (i,j)).hom := by
      simpa only [Category.assoc, a, u, D, Dn] using
        congrArg (fun t => t ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (overlapIso e C' i j).hom).map
          (D.transition (i,j)).hom) h₁

statement:

    F.map ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (D.fac (i,j))).hom.app D.descended) ≫
      F.map (Scheme.Modules.pullbackRecoveryAlong D j (D.right (i,j))) := by
  let D := C'.twistingSheafDescentData 1 (C'.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1)
  let F := Scheme.Modules.pullback (overlapIso e C' i j).hom
  exact (F.map_comp _ _).symm.trans
    ((congrArg (fun a => F.map a)
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackRecoveryAlong_transition D (i,j))).trans (F.map_comp _ _))

    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (h : TransportTwistOverlapCompat e C') (i j : C'.I) :
    let Dn
proof:
:= (transport e C').twistingSheafDescentData 1
      ((transport e C').canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1)
    transportTwistPulledRecoveryFieldAlong e C' i (Dn.left (i,j)) ≫
      (Dn.transition (i,j)).hom =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (Dn.fac (i,j))).hom.app
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (transportSchemeIso e C').hom).obj
        (C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)) ≫
      transportTwistPulledRecoveryFieldAlong e C' j (Dn.right (i,j)) := by
  apply (cancel_mono (transportTwistTargetFieldIso' e C' i j).hom).1
  have hp := transportTwistPulledRecovery_postTarget_fieldPrefix' e C' h i j
  have hm := transportTwistRecovery_fieldMapped_whisker e C' i j
  have ha := transportTwistRecovery_fieldAmbient_postRecovery e C' i j
  have hr := (transportTwistRecovery_right_assoc e C' i j).trans
    (transportTwistRecovery_right_precomp e C' i j)
  exact hp.trans (hm.trans (ha.trans hr.symm))

        ((transport e C').canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) ≫

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.isPullback_reesAwayι
statement:
theorem isPullback_reesAwayι
    (I : Ideal R) (g : R) {d : ℕ} (s : reesAlgebra I)
    (hs : s ∈ grading I d) (hd : 0 < d) :
    IsPullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (reesAwayMap I g s)))
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.awayι (grading (localizedIdeal I g))
        (gradedLocalizationMap I g s) ((gradedLocalizationMap I g).map_mem hs) hd)
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.awayι (grading I) s hs hd)
      (reesProjMap I g)
proof:

  apply IsOpenImmersion.isPullback
  · exact reesAwayι_comp_reesProjMap I g s hs hd
  · simpa only [AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.opensRange_awayι] using

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.freeAbSheafHomAddEquiv_naturality_target
statement:
theorem freeAbSheafHomAddEquiv_naturality_target
    (X : TopCat.{u}) (U : Opens X)
    (F G : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} X)
    (g : TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque.freeAbSheaf U ⟶ F) (f : F ⟶ G) :
    freeAbSheafHomAddEquiv X U G (g ≫ f) =
      f.1.app (op U) (freeAbSheafHomAddEquiv X U F g)
proof:
:= by
  change TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque.freeAbSheafHomEquiv U G (g ≫ f) =
    f.1.app (op U)
      (TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque.freeAbSheafHomEquiv U F g)
  simp only [TopCat.Sheaf.IsFlasque.freeAbSheafHomEquiv, Equiv.trans_apply]
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
  erw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.formalFreeAbSheafHomSectionsIso_naturality_target
statement:
theorem formalFreeAbSheafHomSectionsIso_naturality_target
    (X : TopCat.{u})
    (F G : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} X)
    (Y : FormalCoproduct.{0} (Opens X)) (f : F ⟶ G) :
    (preadditiveYoneda.map f).app
        (op ((formalFreeAbSheafFunctor X).obj Y)) ≫
      (formalFreeAbSheafHomSectionsIso X G Y).hom =
    (formalFreeAbSheafHomSectionsIso X F Y).hom ≫
      CategoryTheory.Limits.Pi.map
        (fun i : Y.I ↦ f.1.app (op (Y.obj i)))
proof:
:= by
  apply CategoryTheory.Limits.Pi.hom_ext
  intro i
  change ((preadditiveYoneda.map f).app
      (op ((formalFreeAbSheafFunctor X).obj Y)) ≫
        (formalFreeAbSheafHomSectionsIso X G Y).hom) ≫
      CategoryTheory.Limits.Pi.π
        (fun j : Y.I ↦ G.1.obj (op (Y.obj j))) i =
    ((formalFreeAbSheafHomSectionsIso X F Y).hom ≫
      CategoryTheory.Limits.Pi.map
        (fun j : Y.I ↦ f.1.app (op (Y.obj j)))) ≫
      CategoryTheory.Limits.Pi.π
        (fun j : Y.I ↦ G.1.obj (op (Y.obj j))) i
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  apply AddCommGrpCat.ext
  intro g
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  rw [show ((preadditiveYoneda.map f).app
      (op ((formalFreeAbSheafFunctor X).obj Y))).hom g = g ≫ f by rfl]
  rw [formalFreeAbSheafHomSectionsIso_hom_apply]
  calc
    _ = (freeAbSheafHomAddEquiv X (Y.obj i) G)
        (Sigma.ι (fun j : Y.I ↦ (freeAbSheafFunctor X).obj (Y.obj j)) i ≫
          (g ≫ f)) :=
      formalFreeAbSheafHomSectionsAddEquiv_apply_π X G Y (g ≫ f) i
    _ = f.1.app (op (Y.obj i))
        ((freeAbSheafHomAddEquiv X (Y.obj i) F)
          (Sigma.ι (fun j : Y.I ↦ (freeAbSheafFunctor X).obj (Y.obj j)) i ≫ g)) :=
      freeAbSheafHomAddEquiv_naturality_target X (Y.obj i) F G
        (Sigma.ι (fun j : Y.I ↦ (freeAbSheafFunctor X).obj (Y.obj j)) i ≫ g) f
    _ = _ := by
      let s := (formalFreeAbSheafHomSectionsIso X F Y).hom.hom g
      calc
        _ = f.1.app (op (Y.obj i))
            ((CategoryTheory.Limits.Pi.π
              (fun j : Y.I ↦ F.1.obj (op (Y.obj j))) i).hom s) :=
          congrArg (fun z ↦ f.1.app (op (Y.obj i)) z)
            (formalFreeAbSheafHomSectionsAddEquiv_apply_π X F Y g i).symm
        _ = (CategoryTheory.Limits.Pi.π
              (fun j : Y.I ↦ F.1.obj (op (Y.obj j))) i ≫
            f.1.app (op (Y.obj i))).hom s := rfl
        _ = (CategoryTheory.Limits.Pi.map
              (fun j : Y.I ↦ f.1.app (op (Y.obj j))) ≫
            CategoryTheory.Limits.Pi.π
              (fun j : Y.I ↦ G.1.obj (op (Y.obj j))) i).hom s :=
          ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
            (CategoryTheory.Limits.Pi.map_π
              (fun j : Y.I ↦ f.1.app (op (Y.obj j))) i).symm s
        _ = _ := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationHomCyclesIso_naturality
statement:
theorem coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationHomCyclesIso_naturality
    {F G : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space k n).toPresheafedSpace}
    (f : F ⟶ G) :
    (coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationHomShortComplexMap k n f).τ₁ ≫
      (coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationHomCyclesIso k n G).hom =
    (coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationHomCyclesIso k n F).hom ≫
      HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap
        ((coordinateCechFreeAbMappedOpComplexFunctor k n).map f) 0
proof:
:= by
  let RF := coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationHomShortComplex k n F
  let RG := coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationHomShortComplex k n G
  let KF := (coordinateCechFreeAbMappedOpComplexFunctor k n).obj F
  let KG := (coordinateCechFreeAbMappedOpComplexFunctor k n).obj G
  let φR := coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationHomShortComplexMap k n f
  let φK := (coordinateCechFreeAbMappedOpComplexFunctor k n).map f
  apply (cancel_mono
    ((coordinateCechFreeAbMappedOpComplex k n G).iCycles 0)).1
  calc
    _ = φR.τ₁ ≫ RG.f := by
      rw [Category.assoc,
        coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationHomCyclesIso_hom_iCycles]
    _ = RF.f ≫ φR.τ₂ := φR.comm₁₂
    _ = ((coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationHomCyclesIso k n F).hom ≫
          KF.iCycles 0) ≫ φK.f 0 := by
      rw [coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationHomCyclesIso_hom_iCycles]
      rw [coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationHomShortComplexMap_τ₂]
    _ = (coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationHomCyclesIso k n F).hom ≫
        (KF.iCycles 0 ≫ φK.f 0) := Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = (coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationHomCyclesIso k n F).hom ≫
        (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap φK 0 ≫ KG.iCycles 0) := by
      rw [HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap_i]
    _ = _ := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechH0_map_epi_of_shortExact_of_acyclic
statement:
theorem coordinateCechH0_map_epi_of_shortExact_of_acyclic
    (S : ShortComplex
      (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space k n).toPresheafedSpace))
    (hS : S.ShortExact) (h₁ : CoordinateCechAcyclic k n S.X₁)
    (hc₁ : IsZero ((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor k n 1).obj S.X₁)) :
    Epi ((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor k n 0).map S.g)
proof:
:= by
  let T := S.map (coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor k n)
  have hT : T.ShortExact :=
    coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_shortExact_of_acyclic k n S hS h₁
  change IsZero (T.X₁.homology 1) at hc₁
  change Epi (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap T.g 0)
  exact (hT.homology_exact₃ 0 1 rfl).epi_f (hc₁.eq_of_tgt _ _)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.sheafH0_map_epi_of_coordinateCech_acyclic
statement:
theorem sheafH0_map_epi_of_coordinateCech_acyclic
    (S : ShortComplex
      (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space k n).toPresheafedSpace))
    (hS : S.ShortExact) (h₁ : CoordinateCechAcyclic k n S.X₁)
    (hc₁ : IsZero ((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor k n 1).obj S.X₁)) :
    Epi ((TopCat.Sheaf.H0Functor (space k n).toPresheafedSpace).map S.g)
proof:
:= by
  let e := coordinateCechH0SheafH0NatIso k n
  haveI : Epi ((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor k n 0).map S.g) :=
    coordinateCechH0_map_epi_of_shortExact_of_acyclic k n S hS h₁ hc₁
  haveI : Epi
      ((coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor k n 0).map S.g ≫ e.hom.app S.X₃) :=
    inferInstance
  haveI : Epi
      (e.hom.app S.X₂ ≫
        (TopCat.Sheaf.H0Functor (space k n).toPresheafedSpace).map S.g) := by
    rw [← e.hom.naturality S.g]
    infer_instance
  exact epi_of_epi (e.hom.app S.X₂)
    ((TopCat.Sheaf.H0Functor (space k n).toPresheafedSpace).map S.g)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.CoordinateCechCohomologyAcyclic.X3_of_shortExact
statement:
theorem CoordinateCechCohomologyAcyclic.X3_of_shortExact
    (S : ShortComplex
      (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space k n).toPresheafedSpace))
    (hS : S.ShortExact) (h₁ : CoordinateCechAcyclic k n S.X₁)
    (hc₁ : CoordinateCechCohomologyAcyclic k n S.X₁) [Injective S.X₂] :
    CoordinateCechCohomologyAcyclic k n S.X₃
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  let T := S.map (coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor k n)
  have hT : T.ShortExact :=
    coordinateCechSheafComplexFunctor_map_shortExact_of_acyclic k n S hS h₁
  have hIᵢ := coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor_obj_isZero_of_injective
    k n S.X₂ i hi
  have hIᵢ₁ := coordinateCechCohomologyFunctor_obj_isZero_of_injective
    k n S.X₂ (i + 1) (Nat.succ_ne_zero i)
  have hFᵢ₁ := hc₁ (i + 1) (Nat.succ_ne_zero i)
  change IsZero (T.X₃.homology i)
  change IsZero (T.X₂.homology i) at hIᵢ
  change IsZero (T.X₂.homology (i + 1)) at hIᵢ₁
  change IsZero (T.X₁.homology (i + 1)) at hFᵢ₁
  exact hFᵢ₁.of_iso
    (hT.δIso i (i + 1) (rfl : i + 1 = i + 1) hIᵢ hIᵢ₁)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.sheafH_isZero_of_coordinateCechAcyclic
statement:
theorem sheafH_isZero_of_coordinateCechAcyclic
    (F : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space k n).toPresheafedSpace)
    (hlocal : CoordinateCechAcyclic k n F)
    (hcech : CoordinateCechCohomologyAcyclic k n F) (q : ℕ) :
    IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H F (q + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  induction q generalizing F with
  | zero =>
      obtain ⟨I, _, f, hf⟩ := EnoughInjectives.presentation F
      let S := ShortComplex.mk f (cokernel.π f) (by cat_disch)
      have hS : S.ShortExact :=
        ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk (ShortComplex.exact_cokernel f)
      have hLS := CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.longSequence_exact hS 0 1 rfl
      refine ShortComplex.Exact.isZero_of_both_zeros (hLS.exact 2) ?_
        (zero_of_target_iso_zero _
          (IsZero.isoZero (sheafH_isZero_of_injective k n I 0)))
      rw [← ShortComplex.Exact.epi_f_iff (hLS.exact 1)]
      change Epi
        ((TopCat.Sheaf.H0Functor (space k n).toPresheafedSpace).map S.g)
      exact sheafH0_map_epi_of_coordinateCech_acyclic k n S hS hlocal
        (hcech 1 (by omega))
  | succ q hq =>
      obtain ⟨I, _, f, hf⟩ := EnoughInjectives.presentation F
      let S := ShortComplex.mk f (cokernel.π f) (by cat_disch)
      have hS : S.ShortExact :=
        ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk (ShortComplex.exact_cokernel f)
      have hlocal₃ : CoordinateCechAcyclic k n S.X₃ :=
        hlocal.X3_of_shortExact k n S hS
      have hcech₃ : CoordinateCechCohomologyAcyclic k n S.X₃ :=
        hcech.X3_of_shortExact k n S hS hlocal
      exact ShortComplex.Exact.isZero_of_both_isZero
        ((CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H.longSequence_exact hS
          (q + 1) (q + 2) rfl).exact 2)
        (hq S.X₃ hlocal₃ hcech₃)
        (sheafH_isZero_of_injective k n I (q + 1))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateCechCohomologyAcyclic
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateCechCohomologyAcyclic
    (d : ℤ) (hd : -(n : ℤ) ≤ d) :
    CoordinateCechCohomologyAcyclic k n
      ((Modules.toSheafAb (space k n)).obj
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d))
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  obtain rfl | p := i
  · exact (hi rfl).elim
  have hA :=
    projectiveTwistingAugmentedCoordinateCechComplex_exactAt_add_two_unconditional
      k n d hd p
  have hK :
      (projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex k n d).ExactAt (p + 1) := by
    rw [HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff'
      (projectiveTwistingAugmentedCoordinateCechComplex k n d)
      (p + 1) (p + 2) (p + 3) (by simp) (by simp)] at hA
    rw [HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff'
      (projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex k n d)
      p (p + 1) (p + 2) (by simp) (by simp)]
    change (HomologicalComplex.sc'
      (projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex k n d)
      p (p + 1) (p + 2)).Exact at hA
    exact hA
  change IsZero
    ((projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex k n d).homology (p + 1))
  exact hK.isZero_homology

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingSheaf_H_isZero
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingSheaf_H_isZero
    (d : ℤ) (hd : -(n : ℤ) ≤ d) (q : ℕ) :
    IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of
      (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H
        ((Modules.toSheafAb (space k n)).obj
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d)) (q + 1)))
proof:
:=
  sheafH_isZero_of_coordinateCechAcyclic k n
    ((Modules.toSheafAb (space k n)).obj
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d))
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateCechAcyclic k n d)
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateCechCohomologyAcyclic k n d hd) q

name: RiemannRoch.KNFB.mem_span_equiv
statement:
theorem mem_span_equiv {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (e : A ≃+* B) (S : Set A)

proof:
:= by

  · rintro ⟨x, hx, hxa⟩
    exact (e.injective hxa) ▸ hx
  · intro h
    exact ⟨a, h, rfl⟩

name: RiemannRoch.KNFB.zeroSection_ker_litU
statement:
theorem zeroSection_ker_litU (hA : AdaptedAt C ij)
    (a : Γ(C.scheme, litU C ij)) :
    (C.zeroSection.app (litU C ij)).hom a = 0 ↔
      a ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range fun k : {k : C.basisIndex ij.1 // k ≠ ij.2} =>
        zU C ij k.1)
proof:
:= by
  let a' := (Xi C ij).symm a
  have ha : a = Xi C ij a' := ((Xi C ij).apply_symm_apply a).symm
  let W : (C.chart ij.1).affineOpens := ⟨C.literalLinearOpen ij, isAffineOpen_literal C ij⟩
  have hspan := quotientSectionMap_spans (sndM (N := N) (X := X))
    (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd) (C.U ij.1)
  have h1 := zeroSection_app_eq_zero_iff C (sndM (N := N) (X := X))
    (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd) ij.1 W a'
  have hker := ker_chart_ideal (C.sectionBasis ij.1)
    (quotientSectionMap (sndM (N := N) (X := X)) (C.U ij.1)) ij.2 hspan hA.1 hA.2
  have hXi : Xi C ij a' = (C.scheme.presheaf.map (eqToHom (litU_eq C ij)).op).hom
      (((C.chartι ij.1).appIso (C.literalLinearOpen ij)).inv.hom a') :=
    kappa_inv_epsilon C ij a'
  have h2 : (C.zeroSection.app (litU C ij)).hom (Xi C ij a') = 0 ↔
      (C.zeroSection.app (C.chartι ij.1 ''ᵁ C.literalLinearOpen ij)).hom
        (((C.chartι ij.1).appIso (C.literalLinearOpen ij)).inv.hom a') = 0 := by
    rw [hXi]
    exact app_eq_zero_iff_of_eq C.zeroSection (litU_eq C ij) _
  have himg : Xi C ij '' (Set.range fun k : {k : C.basisIndex ij.1 // k ≠ ij.2} =>
      tautChart_ratioSection Γ(X, C.U ij.1) ((N ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U ij.1)))
        (C.sectionBasis ij.1 ij.2) (C.sectionBasis ij.1 k.1)) =
      Set.range fun k : {k : C.basisIndex ij.1 // k ≠ ij.2} => zU C ij k.1 := by
    rw [← Set.range_comp]
    exact congrArg Set.range (funext fun k => Xi_ratio C ij k.1)
  rw [ha, h2]
  refine h1.trans ((Iff.of_eq (congrArg
    (fun I : Ideal Γ(C.chart ij.1, C.literalLinearOpen ij) => a' ∈ I) hker)).trans ?_)
  rw [← himg]
  exact (mem_span_equiv (Xi C ij) _ a').symm

name: RiemannRoch.KNFB.coneFactsOn_litU
statement:
theorem coneFactsOn_litU (hA : AdaptedAt C ij) (hV : IsAffineOpen (litU C ij))
    (hle : litU C ij ≤ litU C ij) : ConeFactsOn C ij (litU C ij) hV hle
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Finite {m : C.basisIndex ij.1 // m ≠ ij.2} := by
    haveI := C.basisIndex_finite ij.1
    infer_instance
  obtain ⟨n, ⟨en⟩⟩ := Finite.exists_equiv_fin {m : C.basisIndex ij.1 // m ≠ ij.2}
  obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨ⟩ := chart_polyEquiv (C.sectionBasis ij.1) ij.2 en.symm
  let Θ : MvPolynomial (Fin n) (Γ(X, C.U ij.1) : Type u) ≃+* Γ(C.scheme, litU C ij) :=
    (negVars (Fin n) (Γ(X, C.U ij.1) : Type u)).trans (Ψ.trans (Xi C ij))
  have hΘ : ∀ t : Fin n, Θ (MvPolynomial.X t) = theta C ij hV hle (en.symm t).1 := by
    intro t
    have h1 : Θ (MvPolynomial.X t) = Xi C ij (Ψ (- MvPolynomial.X t)) := by
      change Xi C ij (Ψ (negVars (Fin n) (Γ(X, C.U ij.1) : Type u) (MvPolynomial.X t))) = _
      rw [negVars_X]
    rw [h1, map_neg, map_neg, hΨ t, Xi_ratio, theta_adapted C ij hA hV hle _ (en.symm t).2]
  refine ⟨n, en.symm, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hmap : (List.ofFn fun t : Fin n => theta C ij hV hle (en.symm t).1) =
        (List.ofFn fun t : Fin n => (MvPolynomial.X t : MvPolynomial (Fin n) (Γ(X, C.U ij.1) : Type u))).map Θ := by
      rw [List.map_ofFn]
      congr 1
      funext t
      exact (hΘ t).symm
    rw [hmap]
    refine (Θ.toAddEquiv.isWeaklyRegular_congr
      (List.forall₂_map_right_iff.mpr (List.forall₂_same.mpr (fun r _ x => ?_)))).mp
      (SchemeKTheory.KoszulChartAlgebra.isWeaklyRegular_X_ofFn Γ(X, C.U ij.1) n)
    show Θ (r • x) = Θ r • Θ x
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    exact map_mul Θ r x
  · intro a ha
    have h1 := (zeroSection_ker_litU C ij hA a).mp ha
    refine (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_) h1
    rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
    have h2 : zU C ij k.1 = - theta C ij hV hle k.1 := by
      rw [theta_adapted C ij hA hV hle k.1 k.2, neg_neg]
    show zU C ij k.1 ∈ _
    rw [h2]
    have h3 : theta C ij hV hle k.1 ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range fun m : {m : C.basisIndex ij.1 //
        m ≠ ij.2} => theta C ij hV hle m.1) := Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self k)
    exact neg_mem h3

name: RiemannRoch.KNFB.coneKernelFactsAt_of_adapted
statement: theorem coneKernelFactsAt_of_adapted (hA : AdaptedAt C ij) : ConeKernelFactsAt C ij
proof:
:= by
  have hcc : cc C ij (le_refl (litU C ij)) sndM ij.2 = 1 := cc_eq_one C ij _ ij.2 hA.1
  have hcone : coneOpen C ij = litU C ij := by
    unfold coneOpen
    rw [hcc]
    exact Scheme.basicOpen_of_isUnit _ isUnit_one
  have key : ∀ (V : C.scheme.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (hle : V ≤ litU C ij)
      (_ : V = litU C ij), ConeFactsOn C ij V hV hle := by
    intro V hV hle hVe
    subst hVe
    exact coneFactsOn_litU C ij hA hV hle
  exact key _ (isAffineOpen_coneOpen C ij) (coneOpen_le C ij) hcone

name: RiemannRoch.KNFB.coneKernelFacts_of_adaptedFrame
statement: theorem coneKernelFacts_of_adaptedFrame (h : AdaptedFrame C) : ConeKernelFacts C
proof:
:= by
  intro ij
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := h ij.1
  by_cases hij : ij.2 = j
  · obtain ⟨i, k⟩ := ij
    simp only at hij
    subst hij
    exact coneKernelFactsAt_of_adapted C _ hj
  · exact coneKernelFactsAt_of_c0_zero C ij (hj.2 ij.2 hij)

name: RiemannRoch.KNFB.zeroSection_app_one_litU
statement:
theorem zeroSection_app_one_litU (j₀ : C.basisIndex ij.1) (hj : AdaptedAt C ⟨ij.1, j₀⟩)
    (hne : ij.2 ≠ j₀) : (C.zeroSection.app (litU C ij)).hom 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  let W : (C.chart ij.1).affineOpens := ⟨C.literalLinearOpen ij, isAffineOpen_literal C ij⟩
  have hspan := quotientSectionMap_spans (sndM (N := N) (X := X))
    (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd) (C.U ij.1)
  have h1 := zeroSection_app_eq_zero_iff C (sndM (N := N) (X := X))
    (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd) ij.1 W 1
  have hmem := ker_chart_ideal_other (C.sectionBasis ij.1)
    (quotientSectionMap (sndM (N := N) (X := X)) (C.U ij.1)) j₀ hspan hj.1 hj.2 ij.2 hne
  have h2 := h1.mpr hmem
  rw [map_one] at h2
  have h3 := (app_eq_zero_iff_of_eq C.zeroSection (litU_eq C ij) 1).mpr h2
  rw [map_one] at h3
  exact h3

name: RiemannRoch.KNFB.theta_vanish
statement:
theorem theta_vanish (h : AdaptedFrame C) {W : C.scheme.Opens} (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
    (hle : W ≤ litU C ij) (m : C.basisIndex ij.1) (hm : m ≠ ij.2) :
    (C.zeroSection.app W).hom (theta C ij hW hle m) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j₀, hj⟩ := h ij.1
  by_cases hij : ij.2 = j₀
  · subst hij
    have hA : AdaptedAt C ij := hj
    have e2 : zc C ij hW hle m = C.scheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op (zU C ij m) :=
      zc_restrict C ij (isAffineOpen_litU C ij) (le_refl (litU C ij)) hW hle hle m
    have e3 : (C.zeroSection.app (litU C ij)).hom (zU C ij m) = 0 :=
      (zeroSection_ker_litU C ij hA _).mpr (Ideal.subset_span ⟨⟨m, hm⟩, rfl⟩)
    have e4 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (C.zeroSection.naturality (homOfLE hle).op) (zU C ij m)
    rw [theta_adapted C ij hA hW hle m hm, map_neg, e2]
    have e5 : (C.zeroSection.app W).hom ((C.scheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op).hom (zU C ij m)) =
        0 := by
      refine Eq.trans e4 ?_
      change (X.presheaf.map _).hom ((C.zeroSection.app (litU C ij)).hom (zU C ij m)) = 0
      rw [e3, map_zero]
    rw [e5, neg_zero]
  · have h1 : (C.zeroSection.app (litU C ij)).hom 1 = 0 :=
      zeroSection_app_one_litU C ij j₀ hj hij
    have e4 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (C.zeroSection.naturality (homOfLE hle).op) (1 : Γ(C.scheme, litU C ij))
    have e5 : (C.zeroSection.app W).hom 1 = 0 := by
      have : (C.zeroSection.app W).hom ((C.scheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op).hom 1) = 0 := by
        refine Eq.trans e4 ?_
        change (X.presheaf.map _).hom ((C.zeroSection.app (litU C ij)).hom 1) = 0
        rw [h1, map_zero]
      rwa [map_one] at this
    have h6 : (C.zeroSection.app W).hom (theta C ij hW hle m * 1) =
        (C.zeroSection.app W).hom (theta C ij hW hle m) := congrArg _ (mul_one _)
    rw [map_mul, e5, mul_zero] at h6
    exact h6.symm

name: RiemannRoch.KNFB.sigma_vanish_local
statement:
theorem sigma_vanish_local (h : AdaptedFrame C) {W : C.scheme.Opens} (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
    (hle : W ≤ litU C ij)
    (q : (underlyingCommPresheaf C.scheme C.tautologicalKernel).obj (op W)) :
    (C.zeroSection.app W).hom
      (show C.scheme.presheaf.obj (op W) from ((zeroCosection C).val.app (op W)).hom q) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_kernelBasis_theta C ij hW hle
  haveI : Finite {m : C.basisIndex ij.1 // m ≠ ij.2} := by
    haveI := C.basisIndex_finite ij.1
    infer_instance
  letI : Fintype {m : C.basisIndex ij.1 // m ≠ ij.2} := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have hq := e.sum_repr q
  have h2 : (show Γ(C.scheme, W) from ((zeroCosection C).val.app (op W)).hom q) =
      ∑ m, e.repr q m * theta C ij hW hle m.1 := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hq]
    change ((zeroCosection C).val.app (op W)).hom (∑ m, e.repr q m • e m) = _
    rw [map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => ?_
    rw [map_smul, he m]
    rfl
  change (C.zeroSection.app W).hom (show Γ(C.scheme, W) from
    ((zeroCosection C).val.app (op W)).hom q) = 0
  rw [h2, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun m _ => ?_
  rw [map_mul, theta_vanish C ij h hW hle m.1 m.2, mul_zero]

name: RiemannRoch.KNFB.eq_zero_of_local
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_local {Y : Scheme.{u}} (V : Y.Opens) (y : Γ(Y, V))
    (h : ∀ x ∈ V, ∃ (V' : Y.Opens) (hV' : V' ≤ V), x ∈ V' ∧
      (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV').op).hom y = 0) : y = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose V' hV' hx h' using h
  refine TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' Y.sheaf (fun x : V => V' x.1 x.2) V
    (fun x => homOfLE (hV' x.1 x.2)) ?_ y 0 ?_
  · intro x hx0
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨x, hx0⟩, hx x hx0⟩
  · intro x
    change (Y.presheaf.map _).hom y = (Y.presheaf.map _).hom 0
    rw [h' x.1 x.2, map_zero]

name: RiemannRoch.KNFB.zeroSectionVanishes_apply_of_local
statement:
theorem zeroSectionVanishes_apply_of_local (h : AdaptedFrame C) (W : C.scheme.Opens)
    (q : (underlyingCommPresheaf C.scheme C.tautologicalKernel).obj (op W)) :
    (C.zeroSection.app W).hom
      (show C.scheme.presheaf.obj (op W) from ((zeroCosection C).val.app (op W)).hom q) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_zero_of_local (C.zeroSection ⁻¹ᵁ W) _ ?_
  intro x hx
  have hxW : C.zeroSection x ∈ W := hx
  obtain ⟨ij, hij⟩ := exists_mem_litU C (C.zeroSection x)
  obtain ⟨W', hW'aff, hxW', hW'le⟩ :=
    (TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp C.scheme.isBasis_affineOpens)
      (show C.zeroSection x ∈ W ⊓ litU C ij from ⟨hxW, hij⟩)
  have hW' : IsAffineOpen W' := hW'aff
  have hWW : W' ≤ W := hW'le.trans inf_le_left
  have hlit : W' ≤ litU C ij := hW'le.trans inf_le_right
  refine ⟨C.zeroSection ⁻¹ᵁ W', Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono _ hWW, hxW', ?_⟩
  have e4 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (C.zeroSection.naturality (homOfLE hWW).op)
    (show C.scheme.presheaf.obj (op W) from ((zeroCosection C).val.app (op W)).hom q)
  have e5 := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply (zeroCosection C).val (homOfLE hWW).op q
  have e6 := sigma_vanish_local C ij h hW' hlit
    ((underlyingCommPresheaf C.scheme C.tautologicalKernel).map (homOfLE hWW).op q)
  refine Eq.trans e4.symm ?_
  exact (congrArg (C.zeroSection.app W').hom e5.symm).trans e6

name: RiemannRoch.KNFB.zeroSectionVanishes_of_adaptedFrame
statement: theorem zeroSectionVanishes_of_adaptedFrame (h : AdaptedFrame C) : ZeroSectionVanishes C
proof:
:= by
  unfold ZeroSectionVanishes
  apply SheafOfModules.Hom.ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.Hom.ext
  funext W
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro q
  rcases W with ⟨W0⟩
  exact (zeroSectionVanishes_apply_of_local C h W0 q).trans rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoJ_openι_appLE_eq_topIso_inv
