name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.m7geoJ_basicOpenIsoSpec_inv_awayToSection
statement:
theorem m7geoJ_basicOpenIsoSpec_inv_awayToSection (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (n : ℕ) (a : Fin (n + 1))
    (q : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading R n) (coordinate R n a)) :
    (Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading R n) (coordinate R n a)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n a) Nat.zero_lt_one).inv.appTop
      ((coordinateOpen R n a).topIso.inv
        (Proj.awayToSection (grading R n) (coordinate R n a) q)) =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading R n) (coordinate R n a)))).inv q
proof:
:= by
  let e := Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading R n) (coordinate R n a)
    (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n a) Nat.zero_lt_one
  have happ := Proj.basicOpenToSpec_app_top (grading R n) (coordinate R n a)
  change e.hom.appTop =
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of
      (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading R n) (coordinate R n a)))).hom ≫
      Proj.awayToSection (grading R n) (coordinate R n a) ≫
      (coordinateOpen R n a).topIso.inv at happ
  have hCancel : e.hom.appTop ≫ e.inv.appTop = 𝟙 _ := by
    change (e.inv ≫ e.hom).appTop = Scheme.Hom.appTop (𝟙 _)
    rw [Iso.inv_hom_id]
  have hMorph :
      Proj.awayToSection (grading R n) (coordinate R n a) ≫
        (coordinateOpen R n a).topIso.inv ≫ e.inv.appTop =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading R n) (coordinate R n a)))).inv := by
    calc
      _ = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of
            (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading R n) (coordinate R n a)))).inv ≫
          e.hom.appTop ≫ e.inv.appTop := by
            rw [happ]
            simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
      _ = _ := by simp only [hCancel, Category.comp_id]
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hMorph q

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.m7geoJ_stdChart_awayToSection
statement:
theorem m7geoJ_stdChart_awayToSection (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (n : ℕ) (a : Fin (n + 1))
    (q : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading R n) (coordinate R n a)) :
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of
      (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n a) R))).hom
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_stdChart R n a).appLE
        (coordinateOpen R n a) ⊤
        (show (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of
          (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n a) R))).Opens) ≤
            AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_stdChart R n a ⁻¹ᵁ
              coordinateOpen R n a by
          intro x _
          change AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_stdChart R n a x ∈
            (coordinateOpen R n a : Set _)
          rw [← AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_range_stdChart]
          exact ⟨x, rfl⟩)
        (Proj.awayToSection (grading R n) (coordinate R n a) q)) =
      awayCoordinateEquiv R n a q
proof:
:= by
  have hOpen : (coordinateOpen R n a).ι ⁻¹ᵁ coordinateOpen R n a = ⊤ := by
    ext x
    simp
  let U := coordinateOpen R n a
  let e := Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading R n) (coordinate R n a)
    (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n a) Nat.zero_lt_one
  have hPull : (e.inv ≫ U.ι) ⁻¹ᵁ U = ⊤ := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro _; trivial
    · intro _; exact (e.inv x).2
  have hTop : e.inv.appLE ⊤ ⊤ (by simp) = e.inv.appTop := by
    simp [Scheme.Hom.appLE]
  have h1 : (e.inv ≫ U.ι).appLE U ⊤ (by rw [hPull]) =
      U.ι.appLE U ⊤ (by intro x hx; exact x.2) ≫ e.inv.appTop := by
    have hh := Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE e.inv U.ι U ⊤ ⊤
      (by intro x hx; exact x.2) (by simp)
    rw [hTop] at hh
    simpa only using hh.symm
  let E := awayCoordinateEquiv R n a
  have hSpecTop : (Spec.map E.toCommRingCatIso.hom).appLE ⊤ ⊤
      (by simp) = (Spec.map E.toCommRingCatIso.hom).appTop := by
    rfl
  have hAll : (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_stdChart R n a).appLE U ⊤
      (by intro x _; change (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_stdChart R n a x) ∈
          (coordinateOpen R n a : Set _)
          rw [← AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_range_stdChart]; exact ⟨x, rfl⟩) =
      (e.inv ≫ U.ι).appLE U ⊤ (by rw [hPull]) ≫
        (Spec.map E.toCommRingCatIso.hom).appTop := by
    have hh := Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE
      (Spec.map E.toCommRingCatIso.hom) (e.inv ≫ U.ι) U ⊤ ⊤
      (by rw [hPull]) (by simp)
    rw [hSpecTop] at hh
    simpa only [AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_stdChart, ← Category.assoc,
      E, e, U, coordinateOpen] using hh.symm
  rw [hAll, h1, AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoJ_openι_appLE_eq_topIso_inv]
  simp only [CommRingCat.comp_apply]
  have hAway := m7geoJ_basicOpenIsoSpec_inv_awayToSection R n a q
  change e.inv.appTop (U.topIso.inv
    (Proj.awayToSection (grading R n) (coordinate R n a) q)) =
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of
      (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading R n) (coordinate R n a)))).inv q at hAway
  have hNat :
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading R n) (coordinate R n a)))).inv ≫
        (Spec.map E.toCommRingCatIso.hom).appTop ≫
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of
          (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n a) R))).hom =
      E.toCommRingCatIso.hom := by
    rw [Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality]
    simp only [← Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.id_comp]
  calc
    _ = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of
          (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n a) R))).hom
        ((Spec.map E.toCommRingCatIso.hom).appTop
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of
            (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading R n) (coordinate R n a)))).inv q)) := by
          exact congrArg (fun x =>
            (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of
              (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n a) R))).hom
              ((Spec.map E.toCommRingCatIso.hom).appTop x)) hAway
    _ = E q := by
      simpa only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, RingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso_hom,
        CommRingCat.hom_ofHom, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe] using
        ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hNat q

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.m7geoJ_stdChart_coordinateRatio
statement:
theorem m7geoJ_stdChart_coordinateRatio (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ)
    {c : Fin (n + 1)} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of
      (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n 0) R))).hom
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_stdChart R n 0).appLE
        (coordinateOpen R n 0) ⊤
        (show (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of
          (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n 0) R))).Opens) ≤
            AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_stdChart R n 0 ⁻¹ᵁ
              coordinateOpen R n 0 by
          intro x _
          change AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_stdChart R n 0 x ∈
            (coordinateOpen R n 0 : Set _)
          rw [← AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_range_stdChart]
          exact ⟨x, rfl⟩)
        (Proj.awayToSection (grading R n) (coordinate R n 0)
          (coordinateRatio R n 0 ⟨c, hc⟩))) =
      MvPolynomial.X ⟨c, hc⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [m7geoJ_stdChart_awayToSection]
  unfold awayCoordinateEquiv
  rw [RingEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
  change coordinateRatio R n 0 ⟨c, hc⟩ =
    awayCoordinateHom R n 0 (MvPolynomial.X ⟨c, hc⟩)
  simp [awayCoordinateHom]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTopNegativeCyclesToWordCycles_bijective
statement:
theorem projectiveTopNegativeCyclesToWordCycles_bijective (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) :
    Function.Bijective (projectiveTopNegativeCyclesToWordCycles n d)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x y h
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients_injective ℤ (n + 1) d (n + 1)
    exact congrArg Subtype.val h
  · intro z
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients_surjective
      ℤ (n + 1) d (n + 1) z.1
    have hc : coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients ℤ (n + 1) d (n + 2)
        (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeDifferential ℤ (n + 1) d (n + 1) y) = 0 := by
      rw [coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients_differential, hy]
      exact z.2
    have hz : coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeDifferential ℤ (n + 1) d (n + 1) y = 0 :=
      coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients_injective ℤ (n + 1) d (n + 2)
        (by simpa only [map_zero] using hc)
    have hcycle : y.1 ∈ coordinateLaurentPositiveCycles ℤ (n + 1) d n :=
      congrArg Subtype.val hz
    refine ⟨⟨y, hcycle⟩, ?_⟩
    exact Subtype.ext hy

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTopBoundary_negative_coeff_zero
statement:
theorem projectiveTopBoundary_negative_coeff_zero (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ)
    (x : coordinateLaurentHigherTerm ℤ (n + 1) d n)
    (a : Fin (n + 2) → Fin (n + 2))
    (e : coordinateLaurentAllNegativeDegreeExponent (n + 1) d) :
    (coordinateLaurentHigherDifferentialLinear ℤ (n + 1) d n x a).1 e.1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  change (coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential ℤ (n + 1) d n x a).1 e.1 = 0
  rw [coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_apply_coeff]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro r _
  rw [coordinateLaurentHigherTerm_coeff_eq_zero_of_allNegative_of_not_surjective
    ℤ (n + 1) d n x (a ∘ r.succAbove) e.1 e.2.2
    (topWord_not_surjective (n + 1) n (by omega) (a ∘ r.succAbove)), mul_zero]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTopNegativeCycle_class_eq_zero
statement:
theorem projectiveTopNegativeCycle_class_eq_zero (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ)
    (x : coordinateLaurentAllNegativePositiveCycles ℤ (n + 1) d n)
    (hx : coordinateLaurentAllNegativePositiveCyclesToCohomology ℤ (n + 1) d n x = 0) :
    x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hm : coordinateLaurentAllNegativePositiveCyclesToCycles ℤ (n + 1) d n x ∈
      coordinateLaurentPositiveBoundaries ℤ (n + 1) d n :=
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mp hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hm
  change coordinateLaurentHigherDifferentialLinear ℤ (n + 1) d n y = x.1.1 at hy
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients_injective ℤ (n + 1) d (n + 1)
  funext a e
  change (x.1.1 a.1).1 e.1 = 0
  rw [← hy]
  exact projectiveTopBoundary_negative_coeff_zero n d y a.1 e

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveSpace_integer_H_top_free
statement:
theorem projectiveSpace_integer_H_top_free (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) :
    Module.Free ℤ (Scheme.Modules.H (projectiveTwistingSheaf ℤ (n + 1) d) (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeDegreeExponent (n + 1) d)
  exact Module.Free.of_equiv (projectiveSpaceIntegerHTopNegativeExponentEquiv n d).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveSpace_integer_H_top_finite
statement:
theorem projectiveSpace_integer_H_top_finite (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) :
    Module.Finite ℤ (Scheme.Modules.H (projectiveTwistingSheaf ℤ (n + 1) d) (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeDegreeExponent (n + 1) d)
  exact Module.Finite.equiv (projectiveSpaceIntegerHTopNegativeExponentEquiv n d).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveLaurent_below_top_subsingleton
statement:
theorem projectiveLaurent_below_top_subsingleton (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (hp : p < n) :
    Subsingleton (coordinateLaurentPositiveCohomology ℤ (n + 1) d p)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Subsingleton
      (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjectionLinear ℤ (n + 1) d (p + 1)).range :=
    ⟨by
      intro x y
      apply coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients_injective ℤ (n + 1) d (p + 1)
      funext a e
      exact (topWord_not_surjective (n + 1) (p + 1) (by omega) a.1 a.2).elim⟩
  letI : Subsingleton (coordinateLaurentAllNegativePositiveCycles ℤ (n + 1) d p) :=
    inferInstance
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  intro x y
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := coordinateLaurentAllNegativePositiveCyclesToCohomology_surjective ℤ (n + 1) d p x
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := coordinateLaurentAllNegativePositiveCyclesToCohomology_surjective ℤ (n + 1) d p y
  rw [Subsingleton.elim a b]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveSpace_integer_H_below_top_vanishes
statement:
theorem projectiveSpace_integer_H_below_top_vanishes (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (hp : p < n) :
    Subsingleton (Scheme.Modules.H (projectiveTwistingSheaf ℤ (n + 1) d) (p + 1))
proof:
:= by
  letI := projectiveLaurent_below_top_subsingleton n d p hp
  let e := (coordinateLaurentPositiveCohomologyCechHomologyAddEquiv ℤ (n + 1) d p).trans
    (projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechSheafHPositiveAddEquiv ℤ (n + 1) d p)
  refine ⟨fun x y => ?_⟩
  apply e.symm.injective
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.negativeLaurentExponentVector_degree
statement:
theorem negativeLaurentExponentVector_degree (n : ℕ) (a : Fin (n + 1) →₀ ℕ) :
    coordinateLaurentTotalDegree n (negativeLaurentExponentVector n a) =
      -(a.degree : ℤ) - (n + 1 : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  change (negativeLaurentExponentVector n a).degree = _
  rw [Finsupp.degree_eq_sum]
  simp only [negativeLaurentExponentVector, Finsupp.coe_equivFunOnFinite_symm]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  rw [← Nat.cast_sum, ← Finsupp.degree_eq_sum]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.negativeLaurentMonomialVector_degree
statement:
theorem negativeLaurentMonomialVector_degree (n : ℕ) (e : CoordinateLaurentExponent n)
    (he : e.AllNegative n) :
    ((negativeLaurentMonomialVector n e).degree : ℤ) =
      -coordinateLaurentTotalDegree n e - (n + 1 : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finsupp.degree_eq_sum, Nat.cast_sum]
  simp only [negativeLaurentMonomialVector, Finsupp.coe_equivFunOnFinite_symm]
  calc
    _ = ∑ i : Fin (n + 1), (-e i - 1) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      have hi := he i
      omega
    _ = -coordinateLaurentTotalDegree n e - (n + 1 : ℕ) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      change -(∑ i : Fin (n + 1), e i) - (∑ _i : Fin (n + 1), (1 : ℤ)) = _
      change -(∑ i : Fin (n + 1), e i) - (∑ _i : Fin (n + 1), (1 : ℤ)) =
        -e.degree - (n + 1 : ℕ)
      rw [Finsupp.degree_eq_sum]
      simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.mem_relC
statement:
theorem mem_relC {X : Scheme.{u}} {k : ℕ} {D : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ} :
    D ∈ relC X k ↔ ∃ h : D ∈ dimensionCycles X k, (⟨D, h⟩ : dimensionCycles X k) ∈
      dimRationalEquivalence X k
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨D', hD', rfl⟩
    exact ⟨D'.2, hD'⟩
  · rintro ⟨h, hD⟩
    exact ⟨⟨D, h⟩, hD, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.relC_le_Tset
statement: theorem relC_le_Tset : relC E (n + 1) ≤ Tset f n
proof:
:= by
  intro D hD
  refine ⟨1, one_ne_zero, 0, zero_mem _, ?_⟩
  have e : flatPullback f (0 : AlgebraicCycle U ℤ) = 0 := (flatPullbackHom f).map_zero
  rw [e, sub_zero, one_smul]
  exact hD

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.mem_Tset_of_zsmul
statement:
theorem mem_Tset_of_zsmul {D : AlgebraicCycle E ℤ} {m : ℤ} (hm : m ≠ 0)
    (h : m • D ∈ Tset f n) : D ∈ Tset f n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, A, hA, hr⟩ := h
  exact ⟨N * m, mul_ne_zero hN hm, A, hA, by rwa [mul_smul]⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.eq_sum_single
statement:
theorem eq_sum_single [CompactSpace E] (D : AlgebraicCycle E ℤ) :
    ∃ S : Finset E, (∀ x, D x ≠ 0 ↔ x ∈ S) ∧
      D = ∑ x ∈ S, D x • (Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single x (1 : ℤ) : AlgebraicCycle E ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hfin : (Function.support D).Finite := by
    simpa using D.locallyFiniteSupport.finite_inter_support_of_isCompact
      (isCompact_univ : IsCompact (Set.univ : Set E))
  refine ⟨hfin.toFinset, fun x ↦ by simp, ?_⟩
  ext z
  simp only [Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_zsmul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single_apply]
  by_cases hz : D z = 0
  · rw [hz]
    symm
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun x _ ↦ ?_
    by_cases hxz : x = z
    · subst hxz; simp [hz]
    · simp [Ne.symm hxz]
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single z]
    · simp
    · intro x _ hxz
      simp [Ne.symm hxz]
    · intro hzS
      exact absurd (by simpa using hz) hzS

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.height_base_of_coeff
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := hf x hx
  rw [hh] at h1
  push_cast at h1
  exact ENat_add_one_cancel h1.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.single_mem_Tset_of_coeff
proof:
:= by
  have hu := height_base_of_coeff hf hx hh
  refine ⟨(flatPullbackCoeff f x : ℤ), by exact_mod_cast hx,
    Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single (f x) (1 : ℤ), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro u hu'
    have : u = f x := by
      by_contra hne
      exact hu' (by simp [Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single_apply, hne])
    rw [this]
    exact hu
  · have : (flatPullbackCoeff f x : ℤ) •
        (Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single x (1 : ℤ) : AlgebraicCycle E ℤ) -
        flatPullback f (Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single (f x) (1 : ℤ)) = 0 := by
      ext z
      simp only [Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_sub, Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_zsmul,
        Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, flatPullback_apply,
        Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single_apply, Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_zero,
        Pi.zero_apply]
      by_cases hzx : z = x
      · subst hzx; simp
      · by_cases hfz : f x = f z
        · have : flatPullbackCoeff f z = 0 := by
            by_contra hc
            exact hzx (hirr z x hfz.symm hc hx)
          simp [hzx, this]
        · simp [hzx, Ne.symm hfz]
    rw [this]
    exact zero_mem _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.single_mem_Tset
statement:
theorem single_mem_Tset [CompactSpace E] (hf : PureRelDim f 1)
    (hirr : FibreGenericUnique f) (hG : FibreClosedPointCycle f n)
    (v : E) (hv : height v = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)) :
    (Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single v (1 : ℤ) : AlgebraicCycle E ℤ) ∈ Tset f n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξv, hfξ, hcξ⟩ := f17_exists_max_generization f v
  by_cases hne : ξ = v
  · subst hne
    exact single_mem_Tset_of_coeff hf hirr hcξ hv
  obtain ⟨C, hCrel, hCv, hfw, hCx⟩ := hG ξ v hv hcξ hfξ hξv hne
  have hCdim : C ∈ dimensionCycles E (n + 1) := (mem_relC.mp hCrel).1
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hCsum⟩ := eq_sum_single C
  have hvS : v ∈ S := (hS v).mp hCv
  
  have hother : ∀ x ∈ S.erase v,
      (Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single x (1 : ℤ) : AlgebraicCycle E ℤ) ∈ Tset f n := by
    intro x hxS
    have hxv : x ≠ v := Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hxS
    have hCx' : C x ≠ 0 := (hS x).mpr (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hxS)
    obtain ⟨hspec, hfne⟩ := hCx x hxv hCx'
    have hxh : height x = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := hCdim hCx'
    have hfspec : f ξ ⤳ f x := hspec.map f.continuous
    have hlt : f x < f ξ := f17_lt_of_specializes hfspec (fun h ↦ hfne (h.symm.trans hfξ))
    have hle : height (f x) < ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (height_strictMono hlt
        (lt_of_le_of_lt (height_mono hlt.le) (lt_of_le_of_lt hfw (ENat.coe_lt_top _)))) hfw
    have hle' : height (f x) ≤ (n : ℕ∞) := by
      have : height (f x) < (n : ℕ∞) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hle
      exact (ENat.lt_add_one_iff (ENat.coe_ne_top n)).mp this
    obtain ⟨x', hx'x, hfx', hcx'⟩ := f17_exists_max_generization f x
    have hx'h : height x' ≤ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
      rw [hf x' hcx', hfx']
      push_cast
      gcongr
    have heq : x' = x := by
      by_contra hne'
      have hlt' : x < x' := f17_lt_of_specializes hx'x hne'
      have := height_strictMono hlt' (by rw [hxh]; exact ENat.coe_lt_top _)
      rw [hxh] at this
      exact absurd (lt_of_lt_of_le this hx'h) (lt_irrefl _)
    rw [heq] at hcx'
    exact single_mem_Tset_of_coeff hf hirr hcx' hxh
  have hsum : C v • (Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single v (1 : ℤ) : AlgebraicCycle E ℤ) =
      C - ∑ x ∈ S.erase v, C x • (Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single x (1 : ℤ) :
        AlgebraicCycle E ℤ) := by
    have := Finset.add_sum_erase S (fun x ↦ C x • (Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single x (1 : ℤ) :
      AlgebraicCycle E ℤ)) hvS
    rw [← hCsum] at this
    exact eq_sub_of_add_eq this
  refine mem_Tset_of_zsmul (m := C v) hCv ?_
  rw [hsum]
  exact sub_mem (relC_le_Tset hCrel)
    (AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun x hx ↦ zsmul_mem (hother x hx) _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.cycle_mem_Tset
statement:
theorem cycle_mem_Tset [CompactSpace E] [Flat f]
    (hf : PureRelDim f 1) (hirr : FibreGenericUnique f) (hG : FibreClosedPointCycle f n)
    (D : AlgebraicCycle E ℤ) (hD : D ∈ dimensionCycles E (n + 1)) : D ∈ Tset f n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hsum⟩ := eq_sum_single D
  rw [hsum]
  refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun x hx ↦ zsmul_mem (single_mem_Tset hf hirr hG x ?_) _
  exact hD (show D x ≠ 0 from (hS x).mpr hx)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.exists_nat_of_mem_Tset
statement:
theorem exists_nat_of_mem_Tset {D : AlgebraicCycle E ℤ} (h : D ∈ Tset f n) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, N ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ A : AlgebraicCycle U ℤ, A ∈ dimensionCycles U n ∧
      (N : ℤ) • D - flatPullback f A ∈ relC E (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, A, hA, hr⟩ := h
  rcases Int.natAbs_eq N with h | h
  · refine ⟨N.natAbs, Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr hN, A, hA, ?_⟩
    rw [← h]; exact hr
  · refine ⟨N.natAbs, Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr hN, -A, neg_mem hA, ?_⟩
    have e := (flatPullbackHom f).map_neg A
    change flatPullback f (-A) = -flatPullback f A at e
    have : ((N.natAbs : ℕ) : ℤ) • D - flatPullback f (-A) = -(N • D - flatPullback f A) := by
      have h2 : N • D = (-((N.natAbs : ℕ) : ℤ)) • D := by rw [← h]
      rw [e, h2, neg_smul]; abel
    rw [this]
    exact neg_mem hr

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.exists_nsmul_mem_range
statement:
theorem exists_nsmul_mem_range [CompactSpace E] [Flat f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (hX : DimensionCatenary E) (hf : PureRelDim f 1) (hirr : FibreGenericUnique f)
    (hG : FibreClosedPointCycle f n) (z : DimChow E (n + 1)) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, N ≠ 0 ∧ N • z ∈ (flatPullbackChow f hX hf n).range
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective z
  obtain ⟨N, hN, A, hA, hr⟩ := exists_nat_of_mem_Tset
    (cycle_mem_Tset hf hirr hG D.1 D.2)
  refine ⟨N, hN, ⟨QuotientAddGroup.mk ⟨A, hA⟩, ?_⟩⟩
  rw [flatPullbackChow_mk, ← QuotientAddGroup.mk_nsmul, QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem]
  obtain ⟨hmem, hrel⟩ := mem_relC.mp hr
  have : (⟨flatPullback f A, flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles f hf hA⟩ - N • D :
      dimensionCycles E (n + 1)) = -⟨(N : ℤ) • D.1 - flatPullback f A, hmem⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp
  change (⟨flatPullback f A, flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles f hf hA⟩ - N • D :
      dimensionCycles E (n + 1)) ∈ _
  rw [this]
  exact neg_mem hrel

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F8.flatPullbackRationalChow_surjective
statement:
theorem flatPullbackRationalChow_surjective [CompactSpace E] [Flat f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (hX : DimensionCatenary E) (hf : PureRelDim f 1) (hirr : FibreGenericUnique f)
    (hG : FibreClosedPointCycle f n) :
    Function.Surjective (flatPullbackRationalChow f hX hf n)
proof:
:= by
  intro w
  induction w using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, map_zero _⟩
  | tmul q z =>
    obtain ⟨N, hN, a, ha⟩ := exists_nsmul_mem_range hX hf hirr hG z
    refine ⟨(q / N) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] a, ?_⟩
    unfold flatPullbackRationalChow
    rw [rationalizeAddHom_tmul, ha, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul]
    congr 1
    rw [nsmul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨a + b, map_add _ _ _⟩

name: KSpecialization.tRes_map
statement:
theorem tRes_map {U V : X.Opensᵒᵖ} (f : U ⟶ V) :
    X.ringCatSheaf.obj.map f (tRes t U) = tRes t V
proof:
:= by
  change (X.presheaf.map f) (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op t) =
    X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op t
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

name: KSpecialization.kernel_isFinitePresentation_of_noetherian
statement:
theorem kernel_isFinitePresentation_of_noetherian
    {A B : (Spec R).Modules} [A.IsFinitePresentation] [B.IsFinitePresentation]
    (f : A ⟶ B) : (kernel f).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  let GA :=
    (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj A).presheaf.obj (.op (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens))
  let GB :=
    (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj B).presheaf.obj (.op (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens))
  let l : GA ⟶ GB := (modulesSpecToSheaf.map f).1.app (.op ⊤)
  let I : ModuleCat R := kernel l
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R
      ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R)).obj A) :=
    moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation A
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R GA :=
    (topSectionsLinearEquivModuleSpecΓ A).finitePresentation_iff.mpr
      inferInstance
  letI : Module.Finite R GA := inferInstance
  letI : Module.Finite R I :=
    Module.Finite.of_injective (kernel.ι l : I ⟶ GA).hom
      ((ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp inferInstance)
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R I :=
    Module.finitePresentation_of_finite R _
  have htilde :
      ((tilde.functor R).obj I).IsFinitePresentation :=
    tilde_isFinitePresentation I
  letI : (tilde.functor R).PreservesHomology :=
    Functor.preservesHomology_of_map_exact _ fun T hT =>
      tilde_map_exact T hT
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits (tilde.functor R) :=
    Functor.preservesFiniteLimits_of_preservesHomology _
  letI : IsIso A.fromTildeΓ :=
    Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent A
  letI : IsIso B.fromTildeΓ :=
    Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent B
  let eA : (tilde.functor R).obj GA ≅ A := asIso A.fromTildeΓ
  let eB : (tilde.functor R).obj GB ≅ B := asIso B.fromTildeΓ
  let e : (tilde.functor R).obj I ≅ kernel f :=
    PreservesKernel.iso (tilde.functor R) l ≪≫
      kernel.mapIso _ f eA eB (by
        dsimp only [eA, eB, GA, GB, l]
        exact (tilde.adjunction (R := R)).counit.naturality f)
  exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation (Spec R).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
    e htilde

name: KSpecialization.cokernel_isFinitePresentation_of_noetherian
statement:
theorem cokernel_isFinitePresentation_of_noetherian
    {A B : (Spec R).Modules} [A.IsFinitePresentation] [B.IsFinitePresentation]
    (f : A ⟶ B) : (cokernel f).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  let GA :=
    (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj A).presheaf.obj (.op (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens))
  let GB :=
    (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj B).presheaf.obj (.op (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens))
  let l : GA ⟶ GB := (modulesSpecToSheaf.map f).1.app (.op ⊤)
  let I : ModuleCat R := cokernel l
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R
      ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R)).obj B) :=
    moduleSpecΓ_isFinitePresentation B
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R GB :=
    (topSectionsLinearEquivModuleSpecΓ B).finitePresentation_iff.mpr
      inferInstance
  letI : Module.Finite R GB := inferInstance
  letI : Module.Finite R I :=
    Module.Finite.of_surjective (cokernel.π l : GB ⟶ I).hom
      ((ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mp inferInstance)
  letI : Module.FinitePresentation R I :=
    Module.finitePresentation_of_finite R _
  have htilde :
      ((tilde.functor R).obj I).IsFinitePresentation :=
    tilde_isFinitePresentation I
  letI : (tilde.functor R).PreservesHomology :=
    Functor.preservesHomology_of_map_exact _ fun T hT =>
      tilde_map_exact T hT
  letI : PreservesFiniteColimits (tilde.functor R) :=
    Functor.preservesFiniteColimits_of_preservesHomology _
  letI : IsIso A.fromTildeΓ :=
    Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent A
  letI : IsIso B.fromTildeΓ :=
    Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent B
  let eA : (tilde.functor R).obj GA ≅ A := asIso A.fromTildeΓ
  let eB : (tilde.functor R).obj GB ≅ B := asIso B.fromTildeΓ
  let e : (tilde.functor R).obj I ≅ cokernel f :=
    PreservesCokernel.iso (tilde.functor R) l ≪≫
      cokernel.mapIso _ f eA eB (by
        dsimp only [eA, eB, GA, GB, l]
        exact (tilde.adjunction (R := R)).counit.naturality f)
  exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation (Spec R).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
    e htilde

name: KSpecialization.kernel_isFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  refine isFinitePresentation_of_restrict_fromSpec_cover (fun V : Y.affineOpens ↦ (V : Y.Opens))
    (iSup_affineOpens_eq_top Y) (fun V ↦ V.2) _ fun V ↦ ?_
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y, (V : Y.Opens)) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian V
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.2.fromSpec
  letI : (G.obj A).IsFinitePresentation := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor _ A
  letI : (G.obj B).IsFinitePresentation := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor _ B

  exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation
    (Spec Γ(Y, (V : Y.Opens))).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso (PreservesKernel.iso G f).symm h

name: KSpecialization.cokernel_isFinitePresentation
proof:

name: KSpecialization.kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike
statement:

    KerCokerClosed (IsCoherentLike Y) where

proof:
:= inferInstanceAs (0 : Y.Modules).IsFinitePresentation
  kernel := fun {A B} f hA hB => by
    haveI : A.IsFinitePresentation := hA

    exact kernel_isFinitePresentation f
  cokernel := fun {A B} f hA hB => by

    exact cokernel_isFinitePresentation f

      subcategoryClassOf Y.Modules (Killed (IsCoherentLike Y) (tNatTrans t))

        subcategoryClassOf Y.Modules (Killed (IsCoherentLike Y) (tNatTrans t))

name: KSpecialization.tMul_pushforward_eq_zero
statement:
theorem tMul_pushforward_eq_zero (F : Z.Modules) :
    tMul t ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj F) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro U
  ext m
  change tRes t U • m = 0
  have h0 : i.app U.unop (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op t) = 0 := by
    rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, i.naturality, CommRingCat.comp_apply]
    change (Z.presheaf.map _) (i.appTop t) = 0
    rw [ht, map_zero]
  have key : ∀ (r : Γ(Y, U.unop)) (m : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj F, U.unop)),
      r • m = (i.app U.unop r • (@id Γ(F, i ⁻¹ᵁ U.unop) m) : Γ(F, i ⁻¹ᵁ U.unop)) :=
    fun _ _ => rfl
  refine (key (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op t) m).trans ?_
  rw [h0]
  exact zero_smul (Γ(Z, i ⁻¹ᵁ U.unop)) (@id Γ(F, i ⁻¹ᵁ U.unop) m)

name: CategoryTheory.conjugateEquiv_leftAdjointUniq_hom
statement:
theorem conjugateEquiv_leftAdjointUniq_hom {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D]
    {F F' : C ⥤ D} {G : D ⥤ C} (a : F ⊣ G) (b : F' ⊣ G) :
    conjugateEquiv b a (a.leftAdjointUniq b).hom = 𝟙 G
proof:
:= by
  simp [Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq, conjugateIsoEquiv]

name: CategoryTheory.conjugateEquiv_leftAdjointUniq_inv
statement:
theorem conjugateEquiv_leftAdjointUniq_inv {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D]
    {F F' : C ⥤ D} {G : D ⥤ C} (a : F ⊣ G) (b : F' ⊣ G) :
    conjugateEquiv a b (a.leftAdjointUniq b).inv = 𝟙 G
proof:
:= by
  simp [Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq, conjugateIsoEquiv]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp_unit_coherence
statement:
theorem pullbackComp_unit_coherence (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (M : Z.Modules) :
    (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app M ≫
      (pushforward g).map ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app ((pullback g).obj M)) ≫
      (pushforwardComp f g).hom.app ((pullback f).obj ((pullback g).obj M)) =
    (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (f ≫ g)).unit.app M ≫
      (pushforward (f ≫ g)).map ((pullbackComp f g).inv.app M)
proof:
:= by
  have h := unit_conjugateEquiv
    ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).comp (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f))
    (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (f ≫ g)) (pullbackComp f g).inv M
  rw [conjugateEquiv_pullbackComp_inv] at h
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback_unit_coherence
statement:
theorem restrictFunctorIsoPullback_unit_coherence (q : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (M : Y.Modules) :
    (restrictAdjunction q).unit.app M ≫
      (pushforward q).map ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).hom.app M) =
    (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q).unit.app M
proof:
:=
  Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app (restrictAdjunction q)
    (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q) M

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback_inv_unit_coherence
statement:
theorem restrictFunctorIsoPullback_inv_unit_coherence (q : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (M : Y.Modules) :
    (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q).unit.app M ≫
      (pushforward q).map ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).inv.app M) =
    (restrictAdjunction q).unit.app M
proof:
:= by
  rw [← restrictFunctorIsoPullback_unit_coherence q M, Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp]
  simp
  exact Category.comp_id _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.conjugateEquiv_pullbackComp_hom
statement:
theorem conjugateEquiv_pullbackComp_hom (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    conjugateEquiv (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (f ≫ g))
      ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).comp (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f))
      (pullbackComp f g).hom = (pushforwardComp f g).inv
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (pushforwardComp f g).hom).1
  rw [← conjugateEquiv_pullbackComp_inv f g]
  rw [conjugateEquiv_comp]
  simp [conjugateEquiv_pullbackComp_inv]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.conjugateEquiv_pullbackCongr_hom_symm
statement:
theorem conjugateEquiv_pullbackCongr_hom_symm {f g : X ⟶ Y} (h : f = g) :
    conjugateEquiv (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g) (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f)
      (pullbackCongr h).hom = (pushforwardCongr h.symm).hom
proof:
:= by
  subst g
  simp only [pullbackCongr, eqToIso_refl, Iso.refl_hom, conjugateEquiv_id]
  ext M U x
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.conjugateEquiv_pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso
statement:
theorem conjugateEquiv_pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso
    {W V : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) (q : W ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (v : V ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion v] (h : W ⟶ V) (comm : q ≫ g = h ≫ v) :
    conjugateEquiv ((restrictAdjunction v).comp (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction h))
      ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).comp (restrictAdjunction q))
      (pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso g q v h comm).hom =
    (pushforwardComp h v).hom ≫ (pushforwardCongr comm.symm).hom ≫
      (pushforwardComp q g).inv
proof:
:= by
  let a0 := (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).comp (restrictAdjunction q)
  let a1 := (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).comp (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q)
  let a2 := pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (q ≫ g)
  let a3 := pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (h ≫ v)
  let a4 := (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction v).comp (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction h)
  let a5 := (restrictAdjunction v).comp (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction h)
  let t1 := Functor.whiskerLeft (pullback g) (restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).hom
  let t2 := (pullbackComp q g).hom
  let t3 := (pullbackCongr comm).hom
  let t4 := (pullbackComp h v).inv
  let t5 := Functor.whiskerRight (restrictFunctorIsoPullback v).inv (pullback h)
  have ht1 : conjugateEquiv a1 a0 t1 = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [conjugateEquiv_whiskerLeft]
    simp [restrictFunctorIsoPullback, CategoryTheory.conjugateEquiv_leftAdjointUniq_hom]
  have ht5 : conjugateEquiv a5 a4 t5 = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [conjugateEquiv_whiskerRight]
    simp [restrictFunctorIsoPullback, CategoryTheory.conjugateEquiv_leftAdjointUniq_inv]
  change conjugateEquiv a5 a0 ((((t1 ≫ t2) ≫ t3) ≫ t4) ≫ t5) = _
  rw [← conjugateEquiv_comp a5 a4 a0 t5 (((t1 ≫ t2) ≫ t3) ≫ t4),
    ← conjugateEquiv_comp a4 a3 a0 t4 ((t1 ≫ t2) ≫ t3),
    ← conjugateEquiv_comp a3 a2 a0 t3 (t1 ≫ t2),
    ← conjugateEquiv_comp a2 a1 a0 t2 t1]
  rw [ht1, ht5, conjugateEquiv_pullbackComp_hom,
    conjugateEquiv_pullbackCongr_hom_symm, conjugateEquiv_pullbackComp_inv]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullbackRestrictSquare_unit_coherence
statement:
theorem pullbackRestrictSquare_unit_coherence
    {W V : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) (q : W ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (v : V ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion v] (h : W ⟶ V) (comm : q ≫ g = h ≫ v)
    (M : Y.Modules) :
    (restrictAdjunction v).unit.app M ≫
      (pushforward v).map ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction h).unit.app ((restrictFunctor v).obj M)) ≫
      (pushforwardComp h v).hom.app ((restrictFunctor v ⋙ pullback h).obj M) ≫
      (pushforwardCongr comm.symm).hom.app ((restrictFunctor v ⋙ pullback h).obj M) ≫
      (pushforwardComp q g).inv.app ((restrictFunctor v ⋙ pullback h).obj M) =
    (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app M ≫
      (pushforward g).map ((restrictAdjunction q).unit.app ((pullback g).obj M)) ≫
      (pushforward q ⋙ pushforward g).map ((pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso g q v h comm).hom.app M)
proof:
:= by
  have hu := unit_conjugateEquiv
    ((restrictAdjunction v).comp (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction h))
    ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).comp (restrictAdjunction q))
    (pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso g q v h comm).hom M
  rw [conjugateEquiv_pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso] at hu
  simpa only [Adjunction.comp_unit_app, NatTrans.comp_app, Category.assoc] using hu

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tripleCocycleToFinalBase_toFirst
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem tripleCocycleToFinalBase_toFirst
    (i j k : C.I) (l : (C.tripleCocycleCover i j k).I₀) :
    C.tripleCocycleToFinalBase i j k l ≫

          (inf_le_left : l.1.1.1.affineOpen.1 ⊓
            l.1.1.2.affineOpen.1 ≤ l.1.1.1.affineOpen.1)) by

  rw [← Category.assoc, C.tripleCocycleToFinalBase_toIntersection,
    Category.assoc]
  unfold cocycleToTripleBase
  rw [show X.homOfLE ((inf_le_left :
      (l.1.1.1.affineOpen.1 ⊓ l.1.1.2.affineOpen.1) ⊓

    (C.cocycleFirstBase i j k l.1)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tripleCocycleFirstChart_right
statement:
theorem tripleCocycleFirstChart_right
    (i j k : C.I) (l : (C.tripleCocycleCover i j k).I₀) :
    C.tripleCocycleFirstChart i j k l ≫ l.1.1.1.chartToRight =
      (C.tripleCocycleCover i j k).f l ≫
        C.transitionTriple i j k ≫
        pullback.snd (C.overlapToChart j k) (C.overlapToChart j i) ≫
        C.overlapToChart j i
proof:
:= by
  calc
    C.tripleCocycleFirstChart i j k l ≫ l.1.1.1.chartToRight =
        C.tripleCocycleToRefinement i j k l ≫
          (C.cocycleToFirstLocal i j k l.1 ≫
            C.localTransition i j l.1.1.1) ≫
          C.overlapToChart j i := by
      simp only [tripleCocycleFirstChart, Category.assoc]
      rw [C.localTransition_toChart]
    _ = C.tripleCocycleToRefinement i j k l ≫
          ((C.cocycleRefinementCover i j k).f l.1 ≫
            pullback.fst (C.overlapToChart i j)
              (C.overlapToChart i k) ≫ C.transition i j) ≫
          C.overlapToChart j i := by
      rw [← C.cocycle_first_transition]
    _ = (C.tripleCocycleCover i j k).f l ≫
          pullback.fst (C.overlapToChart i j)
            (C.overlapToChart i k) ≫
          C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i := by
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg
        (fun q ↦ q ≫ pullback.fst (C.overlapToChart i j)
          (C.overlapToChart i k) ≫ C.transition i j ≫
          C.overlapToChart j i)
        (C.tripleCocycleToRefinement_fac i j k l)
    _ = (C.tripleCocycleCover i j k).f l ≫
          C.transitionTriple i j k ≫
          pullback.snd (C.overlapToChart j k)
            (C.overlapToChart j i) ≫
          C.overlapToChart j i := by
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg
        (fun q ↦ (C.tripleCocycleCover i j k).f l ≫ q ≫
          C.overlapToChart j i)
        (C.transitionTriple_fac i j k).symm

statement:

      (C.tripleCocycleCover i j k).f l ≫

        C.transitionTriple k i j ≫
        pullback.fst (C.overlapToChart i j) (C.overlapToChart i k) ≫
        C.overlapToChart i j
proof:
:= by
  have hthird :
      C.transitionTriple k i j ≫
          pullback.fst (C.overlapToChart i j) (C.overlapToChart i k) ≫
          C.overlapToChart i j =
        pullback.fst (C.overlapToChart k i) (C.overlapToChart k j) ≫
          C.transition k i ≫ C.overlapToChart i k := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, C.transitionTriple_fst,
      C.tripleFirstLeg_toChart]
    rfl
  calc
    C.tripleCocycleThirdChart i j k l ≫ l.1.2.chartToRight =
        C.tripleCocycleToRefinement i j k l ≫
          (C.cocycleToThirdLocal i j k l.1 ≫
            C.localTransition k i l.1.2) ≫

          ((C.cocycleRefinementCover i j k).f l.1 ≫
            C.transitionTriple i j k ≫ C.transitionTriple j k i ≫
            pullback.fst (C.overlapToChart k i)
              (C.overlapToChart k j) ≫ C.transition k i) ≫
          C.overlapToChart i k := by
      rw [← C.cocycle_third_transition]
    _ = (C.tripleCocycleCover i j k).f l ≫
          C.transitionTriple i j k ≫ C.transitionTriple j k i ≫
          pullback.fst (C.overlapToChart k i)
            (C.overlapToChart k j) ≫
          C.transition k i ≫ C.overlapToChart i k := by
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg
        (fun q ↦ q ≫ C.transitionTriple i j k ≫
          C.transitionTriple j k i ≫
          pullback.fst (C.overlapToChart k i)
            (C.overlapToChart k j) ≫ C.transition k i ≫
          C.overlapToChart i k)
        (C.tripleCocycleToRefinement_fac i j k l)
    _ = (C.tripleCocycleCover i j k).f l ≫
          C.transitionTriple i j k ≫ C.transitionTriple j k i ≫
          C.transitionTriple k i j ≫
          pullback.fst (C.overlapToChart i j)
            (C.overlapToChart i k) ≫ C.overlapToChart i j := by
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg
        (fun q ↦ (C.tripleCocycleCover i j k).f l ≫
          C.transitionTriple i j k ≫ C.transitionTriple j k i ≫ q)
        hthird.symm

      C.tripleCocycleSecondChart i j k l
proof:
:= by
  have hpath :
      l.1.1.1.restrictionChartTo i l.2.affineOpen
          (l.2.affineOpen_le_A.trans l.1.1.1.affineOpen_le_left)
          l.2.affineOpen_le_A ≫ l.1.1.1.chartToRight =
        l.1.1.2.restrictionChartTo i l.2.affineOpen
          (l.2.affineOpen_le_A.trans l.1.1.1.affineOpen_le_left)
          l.2.affineOpen_le_B ≫ l.1.1.2.chartToLeft := by
    rw [CommonBasicOpen.restrictionChartTo_comp_right,
      CommonBasicOpen.restrictionChartTo_comp_left]
  refine (cancel_mono l.1.1.2.chartToLeft).mp ?_
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← hpath, ← Category.assoc,
    C.tripleCocycleToFinalChart_toFirst,
    C.tripleCocycleFirstSecondChart]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tripleCocycleToFinalChart_toThird
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem tripleCocycleToFinalChart_toThird
    (i j k : C.I) (l : (C.tripleCocycleCover i j k).I₀) :
    C.tripleCocycleToFinalChart i j k l ≫
        l.1.2.restrictionChartTo i l.2.affineOpen
          (l.2.affineOpen_le_A.trans l.1.1.1.affineOpen_le_left)
          l.2.affineOpen_le_D =
      C.tripleCocycleThirdChart i j k l
proof:
:= by
  have hpath :
      l.1.1.2.restrictionChartTo i l.2.affineOpen
          (l.2.affineOpen_le_A.trans l.1.1.1.affineOpen_le_left)
          l.2.affineOpen_le_B ≫ l.1.1.2.chartToRight =
        l.1.2.restrictionChartTo i l.2.affineOpen
          (l.2.affineOpen_le_A.trans l.1.1.1.affineOpen_le_left)
          l.2.affineOpen_le_D ≫ l.1.2.chartToLeft := by
    rw [CommonBasicOpen.restrictionChartTo_comp_right,
      CommonBasicOpen.restrictionChartTo_comp_left]
  refine (cancel_mono l.1.2.chartToLeft).mp ?_
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← hpath, ← Category.assoc,
    C.tripleCocycleToFinalChart_toSecond,
    C.tripleCocycleSecondThirdChart]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tripleCocycle_local
statement:
theorem tripleCocycle_local
    (i j k : C.I) (l : (C.tripleCocycleCover i j k).I₀) :
    (C.tripleCocycleCover i j k).f l ≫
          C.transitionTriple i j k ≫
          C.transitionTriple j k i ≫
          C.transitionTriple k i j =
      (C.tripleCocycleCover i j k).f l
proof:
:= by
  have hpath :
      l.1.2.restrictionChartTo i l.2.affineOpen
          (l.2.affineOpen_le_A.trans l.1.1.1.affineOpen_le_left)
          l.2.affineOpen_le_D ≫ l.1.2.chartToRight =
        l.1.1.1.restrictionChartTo i l.2.affineOpen
          (l.2.affineOpen_le_A.trans l.1.1.1.affineOpen_le_left)
          l.2.affineOpen_le_A ≫ l.1.1.1.chartToLeft := by
    rw [CommonBasicOpen.restrictionChartTo_comp_right,
      CommonBasicOpen.restrictionChartTo_comp_left]
  refine (cancel_mono
    (pullback.fst (C.overlapToChart i j)
      (C.overlapToChart i k))).mp ?_
  refine (cancel_mono (C.overlapToChart i j)).mp ?_
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← C.tripleCocycleThirdChart_right,
    ← C.tripleCocycleFirstChart_left,
    ← C.tripleCocycleToFinalChart_toThird_assoc,
    ← C.tripleCocycleToFinalChart_toFirst_assoc]
  exact congrArg
    (fun q ↦ C.tripleCocycleToFinalChart i j k l ≫ q) hpath

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transitionTriple_cocycle
statement:
theorem transitionTriple_cocycle (i j k : C.I) :
    C.transitionTriple i j k ≫
        C.transitionTriple j k i ≫
        C.transitionTriple k i j =
      𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.Cover.hom_ext (C.tripleCocycleCover i j k)
  intro l
  simpa only [Category.assoc, Category.comp_id] using
    C.tripleCocycle_local i j k l

name: TowerAR6.epi_tensorSheafMap_id_right
statement:
theorem epi_tensorSheafMap_id_right {Z : Scheme.{u}} {A B : Z.Modules} (ε : A ⟶ B) [Epi ε]
    (N : Z.Modules) (hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree Z N) : Epi (tensorSheafMap Z ε (𝟙 N))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits Z N hN
  haveI : (tensorSheafRightFunctor Z N).PreservesEpimorphisms :=
    preservesEpimorphisms_of_preservesColimitsOfShape _
  exact inferInstanceAs (Epi ((tensorSheafRightFunctor Z N).map ε))

name: TowerAR6.epi_tensorSheafMap_id_left
statement:
theorem epi_tensorSheafMap_id_left {Z : Scheme.{u}} {A B : Z.Modules} (ε : A ⟶ B) [Epi ε]
    (N : Z.Modules) (hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree Z N) : Epi (tensorSheafMap Z (𝟙 N) ε)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits Z N hN
  haveI : (tensorSheafLeftFunctor Z N).PreservesEpimorphisms :=
    preservesEpimorphisms_of_preservesColimitsOfShape _
  exact inferInstanceAs (Epi ((tensorSheafLeftFunctor Z N).map ε))

name: TowerAR6.isGG_of_epi'
statement:
theorem isGG_of_epi' {Z : Scheme.{u}} {E F : Z.Modules} (h : IsGG E) (g : E ⟶ F) [Epi g] :
    IsGG F
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, V, he, p, hp⟩ := h
  exact ⟨N, V, he, p ≫ g, epi_comp _ _⟩

name: TowerAR6.isGG_of_iso'
statement: theorem isGG_of_iso' {Z : Scheme.{u}} {E F : Z.Modules} (h : IsGG E) (g : E ≅ F) : IsGG F
proof:
:=
  isGG_of_epi' h g.hom

name: TowerAR6.isGG_pullback'
statement:
theorem isGG_pullback' {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : X ⟶ Y) {E : Y.Modules} (h : IsGG E) :
    IsGG ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj E)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, V, ⟨e⟩, g, hg⟩ := h
  haveI : (Scheme.Modules.pullback i).PreservesEpimorphisms :=
    Functor.preservesEpimorphisms_of_adjunction (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction _)
  haveI : Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).map g) := Functor.map_epi _ g
  exact ⟨N, (Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj V,
    ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pullback i).mapIso e ≪≫ pullbackFreeIso i _⟩, (Scheme.Modules.pullback i).map g,
    inferInstance⟩

name: TowerAR6.exists_free_epi
statement:
theorem exists_free_epi {Z : Scheme.{u}} {A : Z.Modules} (h : IsGG A) :
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (g : SheafOfModules.free (R := Z.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin N)) ⟶ A), Epi g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, V, ⟨e⟩, g, hg⟩ := h
  exact ⟨N, e.inv ≫ g, epi_comp' inferInstance hg⟩

name: TowerAR6.isGG_tensor
statement:
theorem isGG_tensor {Z : Scheme.{u}} {A B : Z.Modules} (hA : IsGG A) (hB : IsGG B)
    (hBl : IsFiniteLocallyFree Z B) : IsGG (tensorSheaf Z A B)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, g, hg⟩ := exists_free_epi hA
  obtain ⟨M, h, hh⟩ := exists_free_epi hB
  let FN := SheafOfModules.free (R := Z.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin N))
  let FM := SheafOfModules.free (R := Z.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin M))
  have hFN : IsFiniteLocallyFree Z FN := free_isFiniteLocallyFree Z (ULift.{u} (Fin N))
  haveI : Epi (tensorSheafMap Z (𝟙 FN) h) := @epi_tensorSheafMap_id_left Z _ _ h hh FN hFN
  haveI : Epi (tensorSheafMap Z g (𝟙 B)) := @epi_tensorSheafMap_id_right Z _ _ g hg B hBl
  haveI : Epi (tensorSheafMap Z (𝟙 FN) h ≫ tensorSheafMap Z g (𝟙 B)) := epi_comp _ _
  exact isGG_of_finite (Σ _ : ULift.{u} (Fin N), ULift.{u} (Fin M))
    (tensorSheafFreeIso Z (ULift.{u} (Fin N)) (ULift.{u} (Fin M)))
    (tensorSheafMap Z (𝟙 FN) h ≫ tensorSheafMap Z g (𝟙 B))

name: TowerAR6.isGG_twisting
statement:
theorem isGG_twisting (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) (n : ℕ) :
    IsGG (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf ((n : ℤ) + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : IsGG (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) := by
    haveI : Epi ((pullbackFreeIso C.toBase (ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 1)))).inv ≫
        C.tautologicalQuotient) := epi_comp _ _
    exact isGG_of_finite (ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 1))) (Iso.refl _)
      ((pullbackFreeIso C.toBase (ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 1)))).inv ≫ C.tautologicalQuotient)
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using h1
  | succ n ih =>
    have e := BundleRegularity.twistingTensorIso C hpos ((n : ℤ) + 1) 1
    have hs : ((n : ℤ) + 1) + 1 = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1 := by push_cast; ring
    rw [hs] at e
    exact isGG_of_iso' (isGG_tensor ih h1 (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree 1)) e

name: TowerAR6.exists_epi_counit_twist_pos
statement:
theorem exists_epi_counit_twist_pos [IsNoetherian B] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    {N : ℕ} (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N)
    (G : C.scheme.Modules) [G.IsFinitePresentation] :
    ∃ n : ℕ, Epi (quillenCounit C (twist C G ((n : ℤ) + 1))) ∧
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.toBase).obj (twist C G ((n : ℤ) + 1))).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m₀, h⟩ := BundleRegularity.exists_uniform_higherDirectImage_isZero C hpos G
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, max m₀ 1 = (n : ℤ) + 1 := ⟨(max m₀ 1 - 1).toNat, by omega⟩
  have hreg : IsMumfordRegular C G ((n : ℤ) + 1) := by
    rw [← hn]
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨q', rfl⟩ : ∃ q', q = q' + 1 := ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩
    exact h _ (le_max_left _ _) q'
  haveI := ProjectiveBundleAR3.twist_isFinitePresentation C G ((n : ℤ) + 1)
  refine ⟨n, ProjectiveBundleAR3.epi_counit_of_isMumfordRegular_coh C hpos _
    ((isMumfordRegular_twist_iff C hpos G _).1 hreg), ?_⟩
  exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation B.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
    (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationZeroIso C.toBase (twist C G ((n : ℤ) + 1)))
    (higherDirectImage_isFinitePresentation hrank (twist C G ((n : ℤ) + 1)) 0)

name: TowerAR6.ampleGG_projectiveBundle
statement:
theorem ampleGG_projectiveBundle [IsNoetherian B] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    {N : ℕ} (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N) (hcov : HasCovers B) (hag : AmpleGG B) :
    AmpleGG C.scheme
proof:
:= by
  intro V hV
  haveI := hV.isFinitePresentation
  obtain ⟨n, hε, hfp⟩ := exists_epi_counit_twist_pos C hpos hrank V
  obtain ⟨T, hT, g, hg⟩ := hcov _ hfp
  haveI := hg
  haveI := hε
  obtain ⟨LB, hLB, hgLB, hgLBT⟩ := hag T hT
  let O := C.canonicalTwistingSheaf ((n : ℤ) + 1)
  have hO : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme O := C.canonicalTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree _
  have hOgg : IsGG O := isGG_twisting C hpos n
  let PL := (Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj LB
  have hPL : HasConstantRank C.scheme PL 1 := hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase LB 1 hLB
  refine ⟨tensorSheaf C.scheme PL O, ?_, isGG_tensor (isGG_pullback' C.toBase hgLB) hOgg hO, ?_⟩
  · simpa using hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hPL (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf _)
  · haveI : IsIso (pullbackTensorSheafHom C.toBase LB T) :=
      pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_isFiniteLocallyFree C.toBase LB T hLB.isFiniteLocallyFree hT
    have h1 : IsGG (tensorSheaf C.scheme PL ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj T)) :=
      isGG_of_epi' (isGG_pullback' C.toBase hgLBT) (pullbackTensorSheafHom C.toBase LB T)
    let ε' := (Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).map g ≫
      quillenCounit C (twist C V ((n : ℤ) + 1))
    haveI : Epi ε' := epi_comp _ _
    haveI : Epi (tensorSheafMap C.scheme (𝟙 PL) ε') :=
      epi_tensorSheafMap_id_left ε' PL hPL.isFiniteLocallyFree
    have h2 : IsGG (tensorSheaf C.scheme PL (twist C V ((n : ℤ) + 1))) :=
      isGG_of_epi' h1 (tensorSheafMap C.scheme (𝟙 PL) ε')
    let e : tensorSheaf C.scheme PL (tensorSheaf C.scheme V O) ≅
        tensorSheaf C.scheme (tensorSheaf C.scheme PL O) V :=
      tensorSheafMapIso C.scheme (Iso.refl PL) (tensorSheafSymmetry C.scheme V O) ≪≫
        (tensorSheafAssociator C.scheme PL O V).symm
    exact isGG_of_iso' h2 e

name: TowerAR6.good_step
statement:
theorem good_step {B : Scheme.{u}} {d : ℕ} (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (hB : Good B d) :
    ∃ C : SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover B (FreeE B r), Good C.scheme (d + r)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hN, hcov, ⟨ι, U, hc, ha, hd⟩, hag⟩ := hB
  haveI := hN
  let C := freeFrameCover r U hc ha
  have hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i) := fun _ ↦ ⟨ULift.up 0⟩
  have hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd r := fun _ ↦ ⟨r, hr, le_rfl, ⟨Equiv.ulift⟩⟩
  exact ⟨C, C.isNoetherian_scheme, ProjectiveBundleAR3.hasCovers_projectiveBundle C hpos hrank hcov,
    ProjectiveBundleAR3.finiteDimAffineCover_projectiveBundle C hpos hrank hd,
    ampleGG_projectiveBundle C hpos hrank hcov hag⟩

name: TowerAR6.good_tower
statement:
theorem good_tower (rs : List ℕ) (hrs : ∀ r ∈ rs, 0 < r) :
    ∀ {B : Scheme.{u}} {d : ℕ}, Good B d → ∃ P : Scheme.{u}, Good P (d + rs.sum)
proof:
:= by
  induction rs with
  | nil => intro B d h; exact ⟨B, by simpa using h⟩
  | cons r rs ih =>
    intro B d h
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := good_step r (hrs r (by simp)) h
    obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := ih (fun s hs ↦ hrs s (by simp [hs])) hC
    exact ⟨P, by rw [List.sum_cons, ← Nat.add_assoc]; exact hP⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.nativeIdeal_section_zero
statement:
theorem nativeIdeal_section_zero {X Y Z W : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : Y ⟶ X) (i : Z ⟶ X) (j : W ⟶ Y) (f : W ⟶ Z)
    (h : j ≫ g = f ≫ i) (U : X.Opens) (a : Γ(X,U))
    (ha : i.app U a = 0) : j.app (g ⁻¹ᵁ U) (g.app U a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hc := Scheme.Hom.congr_app h U
  have hv := congrArg (fun q => q.hom a) hc
  change j.app (g ⁻¹ᵁ U) (g.app U a) =
    (W.presheaf.map _).hom (f.app _ (i.app U a)) at hv
  rw [ha, map_zero, map_zero] at hv
  exact hv

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.nativeIdeal_unit_structure_zero
statement:
theorem nativeIdeal_unit_structure_zero :
    ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ) ≫
      SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit g.toRingCatSheafHom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).map (ConormalSheaf.structureMap
        (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
          (pulledCosection g σ))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext U x
  apply nativeIdeal_section_zero g _ _ (pulledCosection_zeroCentreMap g E σ)
    (pulledCosection_zeroCentreMap_projection g E σ).symm U
  have hz := congrArg (fun q => q.app U x)
    (kernel.condition (ConormalSheaf.structureMap (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ)))
  exact hz

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.nativeIdeal_pullback_structure_zero
statement:
theorem nativeIdeal_pullback_structure_zero :
    pulledCosection g (ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ)) ≫
      ConormalSheaf.structureMap
        (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
          (pulledCosection g σ)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let A := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g
  apply (A.homEquiv _ _).injective
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
  have hu := pulledCosection_unit_structure g
    (ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ))
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
  have hp := congrArg (fun t => t ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).map
    (ConormalSheaf.structureMap (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal Y
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E) (pulledCosection g σ)))) hu
  have hz := nativeIdeal_unit_structure_zero g E σ
  have hh := hp.trans hz
  have hzero : A.homEquiv
      (ConormalSheaf.idealModule (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ))
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal Y
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E) (pulledCosection g σ)).subschemeι).obj
        (tensorUnitSheaf _)) 0 = 0 := by
    rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
    simp only [Functor.map_zero]
    with_unfolding_all exact comp_zero
  with_unfolding_all exact hh.trans hzero.symm

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.nativeIdealBaseChangeMap_inclusion
statement:
theorem nativeIdealBaseChangeMap_inclusion :
    nativeIdealBaseChangeMap g E σ ≫ ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι
      (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
        (pulledCosection g σ)) =
    pulledCosection g (ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι
      (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ))
proof: := kernel.lift_ι _ _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.nativeIdealBaseChangeMap_cosection
statement:
theorem nativeIdealBaseChangeMap_cosection :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map (cosectionIdealModuleMap X E σ) ≫
      nativeIdealBaseChangeMap g E σ =
    cosectionIdealModuleMap Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E) (pulledCosection g σ)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Mono (ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι
    (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
      (pulledCosection g σ))) := inferInstanceAs (Mono (kernel.ι _))
  apply (cancel_mono (ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι
    (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
      (pulledCosection g σ)))).mp
  have hi := congrArg (fun t => (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map
    (cosectionIdealModuleMap X E σ) ≫ t) (nativeIdealBaseChangeMap_inclusion g E σ)
  have hf := (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map_comp (cosectionIdealModuleMap X E σ)
    (ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ))
  have hs := congrArg (fun t => (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map t)
    (cosectionIdealModuleMap_inclusion X E σ)
  have ht := cosectionIdealModuleMap_inclusion Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
    (pulledCosection g σ)
  simp only [pulledCosection, ← Category.assoc] at hi
  have he := congrArg (fun t => t ≫ (Chow.C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso g).hom)
    (hf.symm.trans hs)
  with_unfolding_all exact hi.trans (he.trans ht.symm)

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.conormalFunctorIso_naturality_comp
statement:
theorem conormalFunctorIso_naturality_comp {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D]
    (F G : C ⥤ D) (e : F ≅ G) {A B : C} {T : D}
    (m : A ⟶ B) (q : G.obj B ⟶ T) (r : G.obj A ⟶ T)
    (h : G.map m ≫ q = r) : F.map m ≫ e.hom.app B ≫ q = e.hom.app A ≫ r
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc, e.hom.naturality, Category.assoc, h]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.nativeIdealBaseChangeMap_cosection_pullback
statement:
theorem nativeIdealBaseChangeMap_cosection_pullback :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal Y
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E) (pulledCosection g σ)).subschemeι).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map (cosectionIdealModuleMap X E σ)) ≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal Y
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E) (pulledCosection g σ)).subschemeι).map
      (nativeIdealBaseChangeMap g E σ) =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal Y
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E) (pulledCosection g σ)).subschemeι).map
      (cosectionIdealModuleMap Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E) (pulledCosection g σ))
proof:
:= by
  have hc := congrArg (fun t =>
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal Y
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E) (pulledCosection g σ)).subschemeι).map t)
    (nativeIdealBaseChangeMap_cosection g E σ)
  exact ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal Y
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E) (pulledCosection g σ)).subschemeι).map_comp _ _).symm.trans hc

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.nativeConormalBaseChangeMap_cosection
statement:
theorem nativeConormalBaseChangeMap_cosection :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pulledCosection_zeroCentreMap g E σ)).map
      (cosectionConormalMap X E σ) ≫ nativeConormalBaseChangeMap g E σ =
    (nativeZeroCentrePullbackCompIso g E σ).hom.app E ≫
      cosectionConormalMap Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E) (pulledCosection g σ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := conormalFunctorIso_naturality_comp _ _
    (nativeZeroCentrePullbackCompIso g E σ) (cosectionIdealModuleMap X E σ)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal Y
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E) (pulledCosection g σ)).subschemeι).map
      (nativeIdealBaseChangeMap g E σ))
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal Y
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E) (pulledCosection g σ)).subschemeι).map
      (cosectionIdealModuleMap Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E) (pulledCosection g σ)))
    (nativeIdealBaseChangeMap_cosection_pullback g E σ)
  with_unfolding_all exact h

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.nativeConormalBaseChangeMap_isIso
statement:
theorem nativeConormalBaseChangeMap_isIso
    (hX : LocallyFiniteWeaklyRegularFrames X E σ)
    (hY : LocallyFiniteWeaklyRegularFrames Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
      (pulledCosection g σ)) : IsIso (nativeConormalBaseChangeMap g E σ)
proof:
:= by

  letI := cosectionConormalMap_isIso Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
    (pulledCosection g σ) hY
  haveI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pulledCosection_zeroCentreMap g E σ)).map
    (cosectionConormalMap X E σ) ≫ nativeConormalBaseChangeMap g E σ) := by
    rw [nativeConormalBaseChangeMap_cosection]
    with_unfolding_all exact (conormal_isoHom_comp_isIso
      (C := (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
        (pulledCosection g σ)).subscheme.Modules)
      ((nativeZeroCentrePullbackCompIso g E σ).app E) _
      (cosectionConormalMap_isIso Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E) (pulledCosection g σ) hY))
  exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_left
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pulledCosection_zeroCentreMap g E σ)).map (cosectionConormalMap X E σ))
    (nativeConormalBaseChangeMap g E σ)

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.nativeIdealBaseChangeMap_unit_app
statement:
theorem nativeIdealBaseChangeMap_unit_app (U : X.Opens)
    (x : Γ(ConormalSheaf.idealModule (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ),U)) :
    (ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal Y
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E) (pulledCosection g σ))).app (g ⁻¹ᵁ U)
      ((nativeIdealBaseChangeMap g E σ).app (g ⁻¹ᵁ U)
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app
          (ConormalSheaf.idealModule (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ))).app U x)) =
    g.app U ((ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ)).app U x)
proof:

    (ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι (quasicoherentCosectionZeroIdeal X E σ)) U x
