name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.formalFreeAbSheafStalkIso_map_ι
statement:
theorem formalFreeAbSheafStalkIso_map_ι
    (x : (space k n).toPresheafedSpace)
    (W : FormalCoproduct (Opens (space k n).toPresheafedSpace)) [Fintype W.I]
    (i : W.I) :
    (coordinateCechSheafStalkFunctor k n x).map
        (show (freeAbSheafFunctor (space k n).toPresheafedSpace).obj (W.obj i) ⟶
            (formalFreeAbSheafFunctor (space k n).toPresheafedSpace).obj W from
          Sigma.ι ((freeAbSheafFunctor (space k n).toPresheafedSpace).obj ∘ W.obj) i) ≫
        (formalFreeAbSheafStalkIso k n x W).hom =
      (show (coordinateCechStalkFunctor k n x).obj (W.obj i) ⟶
          ((FormalCoproduct.eval.{0}
            (Opens (space k n).toPresheafedSpace) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
              (coordinateCechStalkFunctor k n x)).obj W from
        Sigma.ι ((coordinateCechStalkFunctor k n x).obj ∘ W.obj) i)
proof:
:= by
  let S := coordinateCechSheafStalkFunctor k n x
  let f := (freeAbSheafFunctor (space k n).toPresheafedSpace).obj ∘ W.obj
  let e := PreservesCoproduct.iso S f
  have hinv : inv (sigmaComparison S f) = e.hom := by
    apply IsIso.inv_eq_of_hom_inv_id
    change e.inv ≫ e.hom = 𝟙 _
    exact e.inv_hom_id
  change S.map (Sigma.ι f i) ≫ e.hom = Sigma.ι (fun j ↦ S.obj (f j)) i
  rw [← hinv]
  exact map_ι_comp_inv_sigmaComparison S f i

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.formalFreeAbSheafStalkIso_naturality
statement:
theorem formalFreeAbSheafStalkIso_naturality
    (x : (space k n).toPresheafedSpace)
    {W Z : FormalCoproduct (Opens (space k n).toPresheafedSpace)}
    [Fintype W.I] [Fintype Z.I] (f : W ⟶ Z) :
    (coordinateCechSheafStalkFunctor k n x).map
        ((formalFreeAbSheafFunctor (space k n).toPresheafedSpace).map f) ≫
        (formalFreeAbSheafStalkIso k n x Z).hom =
      (formalFreeAbSheafStalkIso k n x W).hom ≫
        ((FormalCoproduct.eval.{0}
          (Opens (space k n).toPresheafedSpace) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
            (coordinateCechStalkFunctor k n x)).map f
proof:
:= by
  apply (isColimitOfHasCoproductOfPreservesColimit
    (coordinateCechSheafStalkFunctor k n x)
    ((freeAbSheafFunctor (space k n).toPresheafedSpace).obj ∘ W.obj)).hom_ext
  rintro ⟨i⟩
  simp [FormalCoproduct.eval_obj_map, formalFreeAbSheafFunctor,
    coordinateCechStalkFunctor]
  conv_lhs =>
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, Sigma.ι_desc, Functor.map_comp,
      Category.assoc]
    rw [formalFreeAbSheafStalkIso_map_ι k n x Z (f.f i)]
  conv_rhs =>
    rw [← Category.assoc]
    rw [formalFreeAbSheafStalkIso_map_ι k n x W i]
    rw [Sigma.ι_desc]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechStalkedFreeAbAugmentationShortComplex_exact
statement:
theorem coordinateCechStalkedFreeAbAugmentationShortComplex_exact
    (x : (space k n).toPresheafedSpace) :
    (coordinateCechStalkedFreeAbAugmentationShortComplex k n x).Exact
proof:
:= by
  rw [ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff]
  dsimp only [coordinateCechStalkedFreeAbAugmentationShortComplex]
  intro y hy
  let A := coordinateCechStalkedFreeAbAugmented k n x
  let K := (SimplicialObject.Augmented.drop ⋙
    AlgebraicTopology.alternatingFaceMapComplex AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj A
  let ed := coordinateCechStalkedFreeAbExtraDegeneracyAt k n x
  let y₀ : (coordinateCechStalkedFreeAbAugmented k n x).left.obj
      (Opposite.op (SimplexCategory.mk 0)) := y
  have hy₀ : (coordinateCechStalkedFreeAbAugmented k n x).hom.app
      (Opposite.op (SimplexCategory.mk 0)) y₀ = 0 := by
    exact hy
  let t : (coordinateCechStalkedFreeAbAugmented k n x).left.obj
        (Opposite.op (SimplexCategory.mk 0)) ⟶
      (coordinateCechStalkedFreeAbAugmented k n x).left.obj
        (Opposite.op (SimplexCategory.mk 0)) :=
    (coordinateCechStalkedFreeAbAugmented k n x).hom.app
      (Opposite.op (SimplexCategory.mk 0)) ≫ ed.s'
  refine ⟨ed.s 0 y₀, ?_⟩
  have h₀ : ed.s 0 ≫
        (coordinateCechStalkedFreeAbAugmented k n x).left.δ 0 =
      𝟙 ((coordinateCechStalkedFreeAbAugmented k n x).left.obj
        (Opposite.op (SimplexCategory.mk 0))) := by
    exact ed.s_comp_δ₀ 0
  have h₁ : ed.s 0 ≫
        (coordinateCechStalkedFreeAbAugmented k n x).left.δ 1 =
      t := by
    exact ed.s₀_comp_δ₁
  have hcontract : ed.s 0 ≫ K.d 1 0 =
      𝟙 ((coordinateCechStalkedFreeAbAugmented k n x).left.obj
          (Opposite.op (SimplexCategory.mk 0))) + -t := by
    change ed.s 0 ≫
      AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingFaceMapComplex.objD A.left 0 = _
    rw [AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingFaceMapComplex.objD,
      Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, one_smul,
      Fin.val_one, pow_one, neg_smul, one_smul,
      Preadditive.comp_add, Preadditive.comp_neg, h₀, h₁]
  have happ := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hcontract y₀
  change K.d 1 0 (ed.s 0 y₀) = y₀ +
    -(ed.s' ((coordinateCechStalkedFreeAbAugmented k n x).hom.app
      (Opposite.op (SimplexCategory.mk 0)) y₀)) at happ
  have happ' : K.d 1 0 (ed.s 0 y₀) = y₀ := by
    simpa only [hy₀, map_zero, neg_zero, add_zero] using happ
  simpa only [y₀] using happ'

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationPointShortComplex_exact
statement:
theorem coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationPointShortComplex_exact :
    (coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationPointShortComplex k n).Exact
proof:
:= by
  rw [TopCat.Sheaf.exact_iff_stalkFunctor_map_exact]
  intro x
  let S := coordinateCechSheafStalkFunctor k n x
  let A := coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentedSimplicialObject k n
  let K := (SimplicialObject.Augmented.drop ⋙
    AlgebraicTopology.alternatingFaceMapComplex
      (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} (space k n).toPresheafedSpace)).obj A
  have hmap :
      (S.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.down ℕ)).obj K =
        AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingFaceMapComplex.obj
          (coordinateCechStalkedFreeAbAugmented k n x).left := by
    exact Functor.congr_obj
      (AlgebraicTopology.map_alternatingFaceMapComplex S)
        (SimplicialObject.Augmented.drop.obj A)
  let T := (coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationPointShortComplex k n).map S
  let U := coordinateCechStalkedFreeAbAugmentationShortComplex k n x
  let eK : (S.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.down ℕ)).obj K ≅
      AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingFaceMapComplex.obj
        (coordinateCechStalkedFreeAbAugmented k n x).left :=
    eqToIso hmap
  let e : T ≅ U := ShortComplex.isoMk
    (HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoApp eK 1)
    (HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoApp eK 0) (Iso.refl _)
    (by exact eK.hom.comm 1 0)
    (by
      dsimp only [eK]
      simp
      rfl)
  change T.Exact
  exact (ShortComplex.exact_iff_of_iso e).mpr
    (coordinateCechStalkedFreeAbAugmentationShortComplex_exact k n x)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationShortComplex_exact
statement:
theorem coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationShortComplex_exact :
    (coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationShortComplex k n).Exact
proof:
:= by
  let e : coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationPointShortComplex k n ≅
      coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationShortComplex k n :=
    ShortComplex.isoMk (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _)
      (coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationPointIso k n)
      (by rfl)
      (by rfl)
  exact ShortComplex.exact_of_iso e
    (coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationPointShortComplex_exact k n)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechStalkedFreeAbChainComplex_exactAt
statement:
theorem coordinateCechStalkedFreeAbChainComplex_exactAt
    (x : (space k n).toPresheafedSpace) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≠ 0) :
    (AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingFaceMapComplex.obj
      (SimplicialObject.Augmented.drop.obj
        (coordinateCechStalkedFreeAbAugmented k n x))).ExactAt i
proof:
:= by
  let ed := coordinateCechStalkedFreeAbExtraDegeneracyAt k n x
  let e := ed.homotopyEquiv
  rw [exactAt_iff_of_quasiIsoAt e.hom i]
  exact HomologicalComplex.exactAt_single_obj (ComplexShape.down ℕ) 0
    (SimplicialObject.Augmented.point.obj
      (coordinateCechStalkedFreeAbAugmented k n x)) i hi

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechFreeAbChainComplex_exactAt
statement:
theorem coordinateCechFreeAbChainComplex_exactAt
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≠ 0) :
    (coordinateCechFreeAbChainComplex k n).ExactAt i
proof:
:= by
  change ((coordinateCechFreeAbChainComplex k n).sc i).Exact
  rw [TopCat.Sheaf.exact_iff_stalkFunctor_map_exact]
  intro x
  let S := coordinateCechSheafStalkFunctor k n x
  let A := coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentedSimplicialObject k n
  have hmap :
      (S.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.down ℕ)).obj
          (AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingFaceMapComplex.obj
            (SimplicialObject.Augmented.drop.obj A)) =
        AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingFaceMapComplex.obj
          (SimplicialObject.Augmented.drop.obj
            (coordinateCechStalkedFreeAbAugmented k n x)) := by
    exact Functor.congr_obj
      (AlgebraicTopology.map_alternatingFaceMapComplex S)
        (SimplicialObject.Augmented.drop.obj A)
  change (((S.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.down ℕ)).obj
    (coordinateCechFreeAbChainComplex k n)).sc i).Exact
  rw [hmap]
  exact coordinateCechStalkedFreeAbChainComplex_exactAt k n x i hi

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechFreeAbResolutionComplex_exactAt
statement:
theorem coordinateCechFreeAbResolutionComplex_exactAt (i : ℕ) :
    (coordinateCechFreeAbResolutionComplex k n).ExactAt i
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [coordinateCechFreeAbResolutionComplex]
  cases i with
  | zero =>
      rw [HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff' _ 1 0 0 (by simp) (by simp)]
      dsimp only [HomologicalComplex.sc', HomologicalComplex.shortComplexFunctor']
      rw [ShortComplex.exact_iff_epi _ (by simp)]
      simpa only [ChainComplex.augment_d_one_zero] using
        (inferInstance : Epi ((coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentation k n).f 0))
  | succ i =>
      cases i with
      | zero =>
          rw [HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff' _ 2 1 0 (by simp) (by simp)]
          dsimp only [HomologicalComplex.sc', HomologicalComplex.shortComplexFunctor']
          simpa only [ChainComplex.augment_X_zero, ChainComplex.augment_X_succ,
            ChainComplex.augment_d_one_zero, ChainComplex.augment_d_succ_succ,
            coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationShortComplex]
            using coordinateCechFreeAbAugmentationShortComplex_exact k n
      | succ i =>
          have h := coordinateCechFreeAbChainComplex_exactAt k n (i + 1)
            (Nat.succ_ne_zero i)
          rw [HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff' _ (i + 2) (i + 1) i
            (by simp) (by simp)] at h
          rw [HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff' _ (i + 3) (i + 2) (i + 1)
            (by simp) (by simp)]
          dsimp only [HomologicalComplex.sc', HomologicalComplex.shortComplexFunctor'] at h ⊢
          simpa only [ChainComplex.augment_X_succ,
            ChainComplex.augment_d_succ_succ] using h

name: SchemeCurveCharacteristicClasses.genericRankFreeDeterminant_hcoeff_of_localFrames
statement:
theorem genericRankFreeDeterminant_hcoeff_of_localFrames
    (E : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X M})
    (q : E.1.LocalGeneratorsData) [q.IsLocallyFreeData] [q.IsFiniteType]
    (hframe : ∀ (i : q.I) {x : X} (hxi : x ∈ q.X i),
      (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.determinantLocalFrameData
        X E.1 q i hxi).genericTrivialization =
        (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.determinantStalkBasisRationalTrivialization
          X E.1 E.2 x
            (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.determinantLocalGeneratorsStalkBasis
              X E.1 q i hxi)).equiv) :
    ∀ (x : X), coheight x = 1 →
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithTrivialization
        (SchemeKTheory.determinant_isFiniteLocallyFree X E.1 E.2)
        (SchemeKTheory.determinant_genericRank X E.1 E.2)
        (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRankFreeDeterminantRationalTrivialization
          X E.1 E.2)).1 x =
      ((Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj
          (genericRankFreeCommonRightQuotient E))).toNat : ℤ) -
      ((Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj
          (genericRankFreeCommonLeftQuotient E))).toNat : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x hx
  letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    IsRegularInCodimensionOne.stalk_dvr x hx
  let F : X.Modules :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRankFreeSheaf X E.1
  let hF : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X F :=
    SchemeKTheory.free_isFiniteLocallyFree X
      (ULift.{u} (Fin (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X E.1)))
  let e : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericStalkSheaf X F ≅
      AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericStalkSheaf X E.1 :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRankFreeStalkSheafIso X E.1 E.2
  let t : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.RationalTrivialization X
      (SchemeKTheory.determinant X E.1) :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRankFreeDeterminantRationalTrivialization
      X E.1 E.2
  let P : X.Modules :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericCommonLattice X F E.1 e
  let left : P ⟶ F :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericCommonLatticeToLeft X F E.1 e
  let right : P ⟶ E.1 :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericCommonLatticeToRight X F E.1 e
  let hcover : IsOpenCover q.X :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff X q.X).mp q.coversTop
  have hxUnion : x ∈ ⋃ i, (q.X i : Set X) := by
    rw [hcover.iSup_set_eq_univ]
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hxUnion
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := hxUnion
  let cF := AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRankFreeStalkBasis X E.1 x
  let cE := AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.determinantLocalGeneratorsStalkBasis
    X E.1 q i hxi
  let d := AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.determinantLocalFrameData X E.1 q i hxi
  obtain ⟨cP, hinjLeft, hinjRight, hleft, hright, hdetLeft, hdetRight⟩ :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.exists_genericCommonLatticeStalkBasisData
      (X := X) F E.1 e hF E.2 x cF cE
  have hframe_x : d.genericTrivialization =
      (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.determinantStalkBasisRationalTrivialization
        X E.1 E.2 x cE).equiv := by
    simpa only [d, cE] using hframe i hxi
  have hcommon :
      (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericCommonLatticeStalkDeterminantRationalTrivialization
        X F E.1 e hF E.2 x cF).equiv
          (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField
            (cF.det
              (((AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map left) ∘
                cP))) =
        d.genericTrivialization
          (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField
            (cE.det
              (((AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map right) ∘
                cP))) := by
    exact
      AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericCommonLattice_determinantRational_stalk_hcommon_of_stalkBases
        X F E.1 e hF E.2 (x := x) d cP cF cE hinjRight hframe_x
  have ht :
      AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericCommonLatticeStalkDeterminantRationalTrivialization
        X F E.1 e hF E.2 x cF = t := by
    exact
      AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericCommonLatticeStalkDeterminantRationalTrivialization_genericRankFree
        X E.1 E.2 x
  have hcommon_t :
      t.equiv
          (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField
            (cF.det
              (((AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map left) ∘
                cP))) =
        d.genericTrivialization
          (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField
            (cE.det
              (((AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).map right) ∘
                cP))) := by
    rw [← ht]
    exact hcommon
  have hlocal :
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithTrivialization X
          (SchemeKTheory.determinant_isFiniteLocallyFree X E.1 E.2)
          (SchemeKTheory.determinant_genericRank X E.1 E.2) t x =
        ((Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
          ((AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj
            (cokernel right))).toNat : ℤ) -
        ((Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
          ((AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj
            (cokernel left))).toNat : ℤ) := by
    exact
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithTrivialization_eq_cokernel_stalk_length_sub_of_commonBasis
        X (D := SchemeKTheory.determinant X E.1)
        (SchemeKTheory.determinant_isFiniteLocallyFree X E.1 E.2)
        (SchemeKTheory.determinant_genericRank X E.1 E.2) t (x := x) d hx
        (P := P) (M := F) (N := E.1) left right
        (I := Fin (AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X E.1))
        cP cF cE hinjLeft hinjRight hleft hright hdetLeft hdetRight hcommon_t
  rw [
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithTrivialization_apply]
  change
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithTrivialization X
        (SchemeKTheory.determinant_isFiniteLocallyFree X E.1 E.2)
        (SchemeKTheory.determinant_genericRank X E.1 E.2) t x =
      ((Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj
          (cokernel right))).toNat : ℤ) -
      ((Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj
          (cokernel left))).toNat : ℤ)
  exact hlocal

name: AlgebraicGeometry.cokernel_isQuasicoherent_spec
statement:
theorem cokernel_isQuasicoherent_spec {R : CommRingCat.{u}} {A B : (Spec R).Modules}
    [A.IsQuasicoherent] [B.IsQuasicoherent] (f : A ⟶ B) : (cokernel f).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIso A.fromTildeΓ := (isQuasicoherent_iff_isIso_fromTildeΓ A).mp inferInstance
  haveI : IsIso B.fromTildeΓ := (isQuasicoherent_iff_isIso_fromTildeΓ B).mp inferInstance
  let T := tilde.functor R
  let g := moduleSpecΓFunctor.map f
  have hnat : T.map g ≫ B.fromTildeΓ = A.fromTildeΓ ≫ f :=
    (tilde.adjunction (R := R)).counit.naturality f
  let e : cokernel (T.map g) ≅ cokernel f :=
    cokernel.mapIso (T.map g) f (asIso A.fromTildeΓ) (asIso B.fromTildeΓ) hnat
  exact (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent (Spec R).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
    ((PreservesCokernel.iso T g) ≪≫ e)
    (show ((tilde.functor R).obj (cokernel g)).IsQuasicoherent from inferInstance)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.cokernel_isFinitePresentation_spec
statement:
theorem cokernel_isFinitePresentation_spec {R : CommRingCat.{u}} [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {A B : (Spec R).Modules} [A.IsFinitePresentation] [B.IsFinitePresentation] (f : A ⟶ B) :
    (cokernel f).IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  haveI := cokernel_isQuasicoherent_spec f
  let T : ShortComplex (Spec R).Modules := ShortComplex.mk (cokernel.π f) (0 : cokernel f ⟶ 0) comp_zero
  haveI : T.X₃.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstanceAs (0 : (Spec R).Modules).IsQuasicoherent
  haveI : T.X₃.IsFinitePresentation := inferInstanceAs (0 : (Spec R).Modules).IsFinitePresentation
  haveI : T.X₁.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstanceAs B.IsQuasicoherent
  haveI : T.X₁.IsFinitePresentation := inferInstanceAs B.IsFinitePresentation
  haveI : T.X₂.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstanceAs (cokernel f).IsQuasicoherent
  exact exact_middle_isFinitePresentation_of_noetherian T
    ((ShortComplex.exact_iff_epi T rfl).mpr (inferInstanceAs (Epi (cokernel.π f))))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.cokernel_isFinitePresentation_of_isLocallyNoetherian
proof:
:= by
  refine isFinitePresentation_of_restrict_fromSpec_cover (fun V : Y.affineOpens ↦ (V : Y.Opens))
    (iSup_affineOpens_eq_top Y) (fun V ↦ V.2) _ fun V ↦ ?_
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y, (V : Y.Opens)) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian V
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.2.fromSpec
  letI : (G.obj A).IsFinitePresentation := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor _ A
  letI : (G.obj B).IsFinitePresentation := isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor _ B
  have h := cokernel_isFinitePresentation_spec (G.map f)
  exact (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation
    (Spec Γ(Y, (V : Y.Opens))).ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso (PreservesCokernel.iso G f).symm h

name: SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf_quotient_eq_one_sub_smul
statement:
theorem g0ClassOf_quotient_eq_one_sub_smul {L F Q : X.Modules} (hL : IsFiniteLocallyFree X L)
    (hF : IsCoherentLike X F) (hQ : IsCoherentLike X Q)
    {f : tensorSheaf X L F ⟶ F} {g : F ⟶ Q} (zero : f ≫ g = 0)
    (hS : (ShortComplex.mk f g zero).ShortExact) :
    g0ClassOf X Q hQ = (1 - k0ClassOf X L hL) • g0ClassOf X F hF
proof:
:= by
  have h := ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_middle X.Modules (IsCoherentLike X)
    (tensorSheaf_isCoherentLike X L F hL hF) hF hQ zero hS
  change g0ClassOf X F hF = g0ClassOf X _ _ + g0ClassOf X Q hQ at h
  have e : (1 - k0ClassOf X L hL : K0 X) =
      @HSub.hSub (K0 X) (K0 X) (K0 X) (@instHSub (K0 X) Ring.toSub) 1 (k0ClassOf X L hL) := by
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
    rfl
  rw [e, sub_smul, one_smul, k0ClassOf_smul_g0ClassOf, h, add_sub_cancel_left]

name: SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf_koszulChain
statement:
theorem g0ClassOf_koszulChain (L : ℕ → X.Modules) (hL : ∀ k, IsFiniteLocallyFree X (L k))
    (F : ℕ → X.Modules) (f : ∀ k, tensorSheaf X (L k) (F k) ⟶ F k) (g : ∀ k, F k ⟶ F (k + 1))
    (zero : ∀ k, f k ≫ g k = 0) (d : ℕ) (hF : ∀ k ≤ d, IsCoherentLike X (F k))
    (hS : ∀ k < d, (ShortComplex.mk (f k) (g k) (zero k)).ShortExact) :
    g0ClassOf X (F d) (hF d le_rfl) =
      (∏ k ∈ Finset.range d, (1 - k0ClassOf X (L k) (hL k))) •
        g0ClassOf X (F 0) (hF 0 (Nat.zero_le d))
proof:
:= by
  induction d with
  | zero => simp
  | succ d ih =>
    rw [g0ClassOf_quotient_eq_one_sub_smul X (hL d) (hF d (Nat.le_succ d)) (hF (d + 1) le_rfl)
      (zero d) (hS d (Nat.lt_succ_self d)),
      ih (fun k hk => hF k (Nat.le_succ_of_le hk)) (fun k hk => hS k (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hk)),
      Finset.prod_range_succ, smul_smul, mul_comm]

name: SchemeKTheory.lambdaMinusOne_of_shortExact_rankOne
statement:
theorem lambdaMinusOne_of_shortExact_rankOne {K F L : X.Modules} {r : ℕ}
    (hK : HasConstantRank X K r) (hF : HasConstantRank X F (r + 1)) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (f : K ⟶ F) (g : F ⟶ L) (zero : f ≫ g = 0) (hS : (ShortComplex.mk f g zero).ShortExact) :
    lambdaMinusOne F hF =
      lambdaMinusOne K hK * (1 - k0ClassOf X L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree)
proof:
:= by
  set l := k0ClassOf X L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree
  set b : ℕ → K0 X := fun n => (-1 : K0 X) ^ n * lambdaClass X K hK.isFiniteLocallyFree n
  have hstep : ∀ n, (-1 : K0 X) ^ (n + 1) * lambdaClass X F hF.isFiniteLocallyFree (n + 1) =
      b (n + 1) + b n * (-l) := by
    intro n
    rw [lambdaClass_succ_of_shortExact_rankOne X hK.isFiniteLocallyFree hF.isFiniteLocallyFree
      hL f g zero hS n]
    simp only [b, pow_succ]
    ring
  have htop : b (r + 1) = 0 := by
    simp only [b, lambdaClass_eq_zero_of_rank_lt X K r hK (r + 1) (Nat.lt_succ_self r), mul_zero]
  rw [lambdaMinusOne_eq_sum, lambdaMinusOne_eq_sum, Finset.sum_range_succ']
  simp only [hstep, Finset.sum_add_distrib, pow_zero, one_mul,
    lambdaClass_zero]
  have h1 : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), b (n + 1) + 1 =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), b n := by
    have := Finset.sum_range_succ' b (r + 1)
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, htop, add_zero] at this
    rw [this]
    simp [b, lambdaClass_zero]
  simp only [sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul, add_right_comm, h1]
  simp only [b]
  ring

name: SchemeKTheory.lambdaMinusOne_rank_zero
statement:
theorem lambdaMinusOne_rank_zero {V : X.Modules} (hV : HasConstantRank X V 0) :
    lambdaMinusOne V hV = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [lambdaMinusOne_eq_sum]
  simp [lambdaClass_zero]

name: SchemeKTheory.lambdaMinusOne_of_lineFiltration
statement:
theorem lambdaMinusOne_of_lineFiltration (V : ℕ → X.Modules) (hV : ∀ k, HasConstantRank X (V k) k)
    (L : ℕ → X.Modules) (hL : ∀ k, HasConstantRank X (L k) 1)
    (ι : ∀ k, V k ⟶ V (k + 1)) (π : ∀ k, V (k + 1) ⟶ L k) (w : ∀ k, ι k ≫ π k = 0) (d : ℕ)
    (hS : ∀ k < d, (ShortComplex.mk (ι k) (π k) (w k)).ShortExact) :
    lambdaMinusOne (V d) (hV d) =
      ∏ k ∈ Finset.range d, (1 - k0ClassOf X (L k) (hL k).isFiniteLocallyFree)
proof:
:= by
  induction d with
  | zero => simpa using lambdaMinusOne_rank_zero (hV 0)
  | succ d ih =>
    rw [lambdaMinusOne_of_shortExact_rankOne (hV d) (hV (d + 1)) (hL d) (ι d) (π d) (w d)
      (hS d (Nat.lt_succ_self d)), ih (fun k hk => hS k (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hk)),
      Finset.prod_range_succ]

name: SchemeKTheory.k0ToG0_one
statement:
theorem k0ToG0_one : k0ToG0 X 1 = g0ClassOf X (tensorUnitSheaf X)
    (tensorUnitSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree X).isFinitePresentation
proof:
:=
  k0ToG0_classOf X (tensorUnitSheaf X) (tensorUnitSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree X)

name: SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf_koszulChain_eq_lambdaMinusOne
statement:
theorem g0ClassOf_koszulChain_eq_lambdaMinusOne
    (V : ℕ → X.Modules) (hV : ∀ k, HasConstantRank X (V k) k)
    (L : ℕ → X.Modules) (hL : ∀ k, HasConstantRank X (L k) 1)
    (ι : ∀ k, V k ⟶ V (k + 1)) (π : ∀ k, V (k + 1) ⟶ L k) (w : ∀ k, ι k ≫ π k = 0) (d : ℕ)
    (hVS : ∀ k < d, (ShortComplex.mk (ι k) (π k) (w k)).ShortExact)
    (F : ℕ → X.Modules) (f : ∀ k, tensorSheaf X (L k) (F k) ⟶ F k) (g : ∀ k, F k ⟶ F (k + 1))
    (zero : ∀ k, f k ≫ g k = 0) (hF : ∀ k ≤ d, IsCoherentLike X (F k))
    (hS : ∀ k < d, (ShortComplex.mk (f k) (g k) (zero k)).ShortExact)
    (e0 : F 0 ≅ tensorUnitSheaf X) :
    g0ClassOf X (F d) (hF d le_rfl) = k0ToG0 X (lambdaMinusOne (V d) (hV d))
proof:
:= by
  rw [g0ClassOf_koszulChain X L (fun k => (hL k).isFiniteLocallyFree) F f g zero d hF hS,
    lambdaMinusOne_of_lineFiltration V hV L hL ι π w d hVS]
  set P := ∏ k ∈ Finset.range d, (1 - k0ClassOf X (L k) (hL k).isFiniteLocallyFree)
  rw [show k0ToG0 X P = P • k0ToG0 X 1 by rw [← k0ToG0_mul, mul_one], k0ToG0_one,
    g0ClassOf_iso X _ _ e0]

name: SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf_koszulQuotient
statement:
theorem g0ClassOf_koszulQuotient
    (L : ℕ → X.Modules) (hL : ∀ k, HasConstantRank X (L k) 1)
    (s : ∀ k, L k ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X)
    (V : ℕ → X.Modules) (hV : ∀ k, HasConstantRank X (V k) k)
    (ι : ∀ k, V k ⟶ V (k + 1)) (π : ∀ k, V (k + 1) ⟶ L k) (w : ∀ k, ι k ≫ π k = 0) (d : ℕ)
    (hVS : ∀ k < d, (ShortComplex.mk (ι k) (π k) (w k)).ShortExact)
    (hF : ∀ k ≤ d, IsCoherentLike X (koszulQuotient X L s k))
    (hreg : ∀ k < d, Mono (koszulStepMap X (L k) (s k) (koszulQuotient X L s k))) :
    g0ClassOf X (koszulQuotient X L s d) (hF d le_rfl) =
      k0ToG0 X (lambdaMinusOne (V d) (hV d))
proof:
:= by
  refine g0ClassOf_koszulChain_eq_lambdaMinusOne X V hV L hL ι π w d hVS
    (koszulQuotient X L s) (fun k => koszulStepMap X (L k) (s k) (koszulQuotient X L s k))
    (fun k => cokernel.π _) (fun k => cokernel.condition _) hF (fun k hk => ?_) (Iso.refl _)
  exact { exact := ShortComplex.exact_of_g_is_cokernel _ (cokernelIsCokernel _)
          mono_f := hreg k hk
          epi_g := (inferInstance : Epi (cokernel.π _)) }

name: SchemeKTheory.koszulQuotient_isCoherentLike
statement:
theorem koszulQuotient_isCoherentLike [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (L : ℕ → X.Modules)
    (hL : ∀ k, IsFiniteLocallyFree X (L k)) (s : ∀ k, L k ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) :
    ∀ k, IsCoherentLike X (koszulQuotient X L s k)
  | 0 => (tensorUnitSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree X).isFinitePresentation
  | k + 1 => by
    have hk
proof:
:= koszulQuotient_isCoherentLike L hL s k
    letI : (koszulQuotient X L s k).IsFinitePresentation := hk
    letI : (tensorSheaf X (L k) (koszulQuotient X L s k)).IsFinitePresentation :=
      tensorSheaf_isCoherentLike X _ _ (hL k) hk
    exact cokernel_isFinitePresentation_of_isLocallyNoetherian _

name: SchemeKTheory.g0ClassOf_koszulQuotient_of_isLocallyNoetherian
statement:
theorem g0ClassOf_koszulQuotient_of_isLocallyNoetherian [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (L : ℕ → X.Modules) (hL : ∀ k, HasConstantRank X (L k) 1)
    (s : ∀ k, L k ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X)
    (V : ℕ → X.Modules) (hV : ∀ k, HasConstantRank X (V k) k)
    (ι : ∀ k, V k ⟶ V (k + 1)) (π : ∀ k, V (k + 1) ⟶ L k) (w : ∀ k, ι k ≫ π k = 0) (d : ℕ)
    (hVS : ∀ k < d, (ShortComplex.mk (ι k) (π k) (w k)).ShortExact)
    (hreg : ∀ k < d, Mono (koszulStepMap X (L k) (s k) (koszulQuotient X L s k))) :
    g0ClassOf X (koszulQuotient X L s d)
        (koszulQuotient_isCoherentLike X L (fun k => (hL k).isFiniteLocallyFree) s d) =
      k0ToG0 X (lambdaMinusOne (V d) (hV d))
proof:
:=
  g0ClassOf_koszulQuotient X L hL s V hV ι π w d hVS
    (fun k _ => koszulQuotient_isCoherentLike X L (fun k => (hL k).isFiniteLocallyFree) s k) hreg

name: SchemeKTheory.finitePushforward_one_eq_lambdaMinusOne
statement:
theorem finitePushforward_one_eq_lambdaMinusOne {Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsFinite i]
    (L : ℕ → X.Modules) (hL : ∀ k, HasConstantRank X (L k) 1)
    (s : ∀ k, L k ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X)
    (V : ℕ → X.Modules) (hV : ∀ k, HasConstantRank X (V k) k)
    (ι : ∀ k, V k ⟶ V (k + 1)) (π : ∀ k, V (k + 1) ⟶ L k) (w : ∀ k, ι k ≫ π k = 0) (d : ℕ)
    (hVS : ∀ k < d, (ShortComplex.mk (ι k) (π k) (w k)).ShortExact)
    (hreg : ∀ k < d, Mono (koszulStepMap X (L k) (s k) (koszulQuotient X L s k)))
    (eZ : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (tensorUnitSheaf Z) ≅ koszulQuotient X L s d) :
    finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 Z 1) = k0ToG0 X (lambdaMinusOne (V d) (hV d))
proof:
:= by
  rw [k0ToG0_one, finitePushforward_classOf, ← g0ClassOf_koszulQuotient_of_isLocallyNoetherian
    X L hL s V hV ι π w d hVS hreg]
  exact g0ClassOf_iso X _ _ eZ

name: SchemeKTheory.push_pullback_of_koszul
statement:
theorem push_pullback_of_koszul {Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsFinite i]
    (res : G0 X →+ K0 X) (hres : ∀ a, res (k0ToG0 X a) = a)
    (V : X.Modules) {d : ℕ} (hV : HasConstantRank X V d)
    (koszul : finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 Z 1) = k0ToG0 X (lambdaMinusOne V hV)) (y : K0 X) :
    res (finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 Z (pullbackK0RingHom i y))) = y * lambdaMinusOne V hV
proof:
:= by
  rw [← one_mul (pullbackK0RingHom i y), finitePushforward_k0ToG0_mul_pullback, koszul,
    ← k0ToG0_mul, hres]

name: SchemeKTheory.adams_push_pullback_of_koszul
statement:
theorem adams_push_pullback_of_koszul {j : ℕ} (H : AdamsBottFamily.{u} j) {Z : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian X] (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsFinite i]
    (res : G0 X →+ K0 X) (hres : ∀ a, res (k0ToG0 X a) = a)
    (V : X.Modules) {d : ℕ} (hV : HasConstantRank X V d)
    (koszul : finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 Z 1) = k0ToG0 X (lambdaMinusOne V hV))
    (hψ : ∀ y, H.adams Z (pullbackK0RingHom i y) = pullbackK0RingHom i (H.adams X y))
    (y : K0 X) :
    algebraMap (K0 X) (KLoc j X)
        (H.adams X (res (finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 Z (pullbackK0RingHom i y))))) =
      algebraMap (K0 X) (KLoc j X)
          (res (finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 Z (H.adams Z (pullbackK0RingHom i y))))) *
        ((H.bott X (Multiplicative.ofAdd (k0ClassOf X V hV.isFiniteLocallyFree)) : (KLoc j X)ˣ) :
          KLoc j X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hψ, push_pullback_of_koszul i res hres V hV koszul,
    push_pullback_of_koszul i res hres V hV koszul, map_mul, map_mul, map_mul,
    adams_lambdaMinusOne H V hV]
  ring

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.mem_gradingOfBasis_iff
statement:
theorem mem_gradingOfBasis_iff (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M) {d : ℕ}
    {x : SymmetricAlgebra R M} :
    x ∈ gradingOfBasis b d ↔
      SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b x ∈ SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading R n d
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    simpa using hp
  · intro hp
    refine ⟨SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b x, hp, ?_⟩
    exact (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm_apply_apply x

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.gradingOfBasis_one_eq_range_ι
statement:
theorem gradingOfBasis_one_eq_range_ι (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M) :
    gradingOfBasis b 1 =
      LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M : M →ₗ[R] SymmetricAlgebra R M)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gradingOfBasis]
  change Submodule.map (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm.toLinearMap
      (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) R 1) = _
  rw [MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule_one_eq_span_X,
    Submodule.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
  change Submodule.span R (Set.range fun i : Fin (n + 1) ↦
      (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm (MvPolynomial.X i)) = _
  rw [show (fun i : Fin (n + 1) ↦
      (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm (MvPolynomial.X i)) =
        fun i ↦ SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M (b i) by
      funext i
      exact SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial_symm_X b i]
  calc
    Submodule.span R (Set.range fun i ↦ SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M (b i)) =
        (Submodule.span R (Set.range b)).map (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M) := by
      rw [Submodule.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
      simp only [Function.comp_def]
    _ = (⊤ : Submodule R M).map (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M) := by rw [b.span_eq]
    _ = LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M) :=
      (LinearMap.range_eq_map (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M)).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.gradingOfBasis_eq_range_ι_pow
statement:
theorem gradingOfBasis_eq_range_ι_pow (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M) (d : ℕ) :
    gradingOfBasis b d =
      LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M : M →ₗ[R] SymmetricAlgebra R M) ^ d
proof:
:= by
  rw [gradingOfBasis]
  change Submodule.map (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm.toLinearMap
      (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) R d) = _
  rw [← MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule_one_pow]
  calc
    Submodule.map (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm.toLinearMap
        (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) R 1 ^ d) =
      (Submodule.map (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm.toLinearMap
        (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) R 1)) ^ d :=
          Submodule.map_pow
            (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) R 1)
            (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm.toAlgHom d
    _ = LinearMap.range
        (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M : M →ₗ[R] SymmetricAlgebra R M) ^ d := by
      rw [show Submodule.map (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm.toLinearMap
          (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) R 1) =
            gradingOfBasis b 1 from rfl,
        gradingOfBasis_one_eq_range_ι]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.gradingOfBasis_eq_gradingOfBasis
statement:
theorem gradingOfBasis_eq_gradingOfBasis
    (b b' : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M) :
    gradingOfBasis b = gradingOfBasis b'
proof:
:= by
  funext d
  rw [gradingOfBasis_eq_range_ι_pow, gradingOfBasis_eq_range_ι_pow]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.componentEquiv_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem componentEquiv_apply_coe (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M) (d : ℕ)
    (x : gradingOfBasis b d) :
    (componentEquiv b d x : SchemeProjectiveSpace.Polynomial R n) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.componentEquiv_symm_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem componentEquiv_symm_apply_coe (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M) (d : ℕ)
    (y : SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading R n d) :
    ((componentEquiv b d).symm y : SymmetricAlgebra R M) =
      (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm y
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.componentEquivLmap_comp_symm
statement:
theorem componentEquivLmap_comp_symm (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M) :
    componentEquivLmap b ∘ₗ componentEquivSymmLmap b = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  ext d y
  simp [componentEquivLmap, componentEquivSymmLmap, DirectSum.lmap_lof]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.componentEquivSymmLmap_comp
statement:
theorem componentEquivSymmLmap_comp (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M) :
    componentEquivSymmLmap b ∘ₗ componentEquivLmap b = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  ext d x
  simp [componentEquivLmap, componentEquivSymmLmap, DirectSum.lmap_lof]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.coeLinearMap_comp_componentEquivSymmLmap
statement:
theorem coeLinearMap_comp_componentEquivSymmLmap (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M) :
    DirectSum.coeLinearMap (gradingOfBasis b) ∘ₗ componentEquivSymmLmap b =
      (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        DirectSum.coeLinearMap (SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading R n)
proof:
:= by
  ext d y
  simp [componentEquivSymmLmap, DirectSum.lmap_lof]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.componentEquivLmap_comp_coeLinearMap
statement:
theorem componentEquivLmap_comp_coeLinearMap (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M) :
    DirectSum.coeLinearMap (SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading R n) ∘ₗ componentEquivLmap b =
      (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        DirectSum.coeLinearMap (gradingOfBasis b)
proof:
:= by
  ext d x
  simp [componentEquivLmap, DirectSum.lmap_lof]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.coeLinearMap_comp_decomposeOfBasis
statement:
theorem coeLinearMap_comp_decomposeOfBasis (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M) :
    DirectSum.coeLinearMap (gradingOfBasis b) ∘ₗ decomposeOfBasis b = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  rw [decomposeOfBasis, ← LinearMap.comp_assoc, ← LinearMap.comp_assoc,
    coeLinearMap_comp_componentEquivSymmLmap]
  ext x
  change (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm
      (DirectSum.coeLinearMap (SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading R n)
        ((DirectSum.decomposeLinearEquiv (SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading R n))
          ((SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b) x))) = x
  trans (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm ((SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b) x)
  · congr 1
    exact (DirectSum.decomposeLinearEquiv (SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading R n)).left_inv
      ((SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b) x)
  · exact (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm_apply_apply x

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.decomposeOfBasis_comp_coeLinearMap
statement:
theorem decomposeOfBasis_comp_coeLinearMap (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M) :
    decomposeOfBasis b ∘ₗ DirectSum.coeLinearMap (gradingOfBasis b) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  ext d x : 2
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, DirectSum.coeLinearMap_lof, decomposeOfBasis,
    componentEquivSymmLmap, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply]
  rw [show (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).toLinearMap (x : SymmetricAlgebra R M) =
      (componentEquiv b d x).1 from rfl]
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_coe, LinearEquiv.coe_toLinearMap]
  rw [DirectSum.decomposeLinearEquiv_apply_coe (SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading R n) d
    (componentEquiv b d x)]
  simp [componentEquivSymmLmap, DirectSum.lmap_lof]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.irrelevant_le_map_gradedFromPolynomial
statement:
theorem irrelevant_le_map_gradedFromPolynomial (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M) :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (gradingOfBasis b) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading R n)).map
        (gradedFromPolynomial b)
proof:
:= by
  refine (HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_irrelevant_le (gradingOfBasis b)).2 ?_
  intro d hd x hx
  have hx' : SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b x ∈
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading R n d :=
    (mem_gradingOfBasis_iff b).mp hx
  have hxpoly :
      SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b x ∈
        (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading R n)).toIdeal :=
    HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading R n) hd hx'
  have :
      x = gradedFromPolynomial b (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b x) := by
    simp
  rw [this]
  exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (gradedFromPolynomial b) hxpoly

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.irrelevant_le_map_gradedToPolynomial
statement:
theorem irrelevant_le_map_gradedToPolynomial (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M) :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading R n) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (gradingOfBasis b)).map (gradedToPolynomial b)
proof:
:= by
  refine (HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_irrelevant_le
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading R n)).2 ?_
  intro d hd p hp
  have hpSym : (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm p ∈ gradingOfBasis b d :=
    ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  have :
      p = gradedToPolynomial b ((SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).symm p) := by
    simp
  rw [this]
  exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (gradedToPolynomial b)
    (HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem (gradingOfBasis b) hd hpSym)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.toStandardProjectiveSpace_comp_fromStandardProjectiveSpace
statement:
theorem toStandardProjectiveSpace_comp_fromStandardProjectiveSpace
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M) :
    toStandardProjectiveSpace b ≫ fromStandardProjectiveSpace b = 𝟙 (spaceOfBasis b)
proof:
:= by
  unfold toStandardProjectiveSpace fromStandardProjectiveSpace spaceOfBasis SchemeProjectiveSpace.space
  calc
    Proj.map (gradedFromPolynomial b) (irrelevant_le_map_gradedFromPolynomial b) ≫
        Proj.map (gradedToPolynomial b) (irrelevant_le_map_gradedToPolynomial b) =
      Proj.map ((gradedFromPolynomial b).comp (gradedToPolynomial b))
        (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp (irrelevant_le_map_gradedToPolynomial b)
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedFromPolynomial b)) := by
      exact (Proj.map_comp (gradedToPolynomial b) (gradedFromPolynomial b)
        (irrelevant_le_map_gradedToPolynomial b) (irrelevant_le_map_gradedFromPolynomial b)).symm
    _ = 𝟙 (Proj (gradingOfBasis b)) := by
      convert Proj.map_id
      rw [gradedFromPolynomial_comp_gradedToPolynomial b]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.fromStandardProjectiveSpace_comp_toStandardProjectiveSpace
statement:
theorem fromStandardProjectiveSpace_comp_toStandardProjectiveSpace
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M) :
    fromStandardProjectiveSpace b ≫ toStandardProjectiveSpace b =
      𝟙 (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space R n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold toStandardProjectiveSpace fromStandardProjectiveSpace SchemeProjectiveSpace.space
  calc
    Proj.map (gradedToPolynomial b) (irrelevant_le_map_gradedToPolynomial b) ≫
        Proj.map (gradedFromPolynomial b) (irrelevant_le_map_gradedFromPolynomial b) =
      Proj.map ((gradedToPolynomial b).comp (gradedFromPolynomial b))
        (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp (irrelevant_le_map_gradedFromPolynomial b)
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedToPolynomial b)) := by
      exact (Proj.map_comp (gradedFromPolynomial b) (gradedToPolynomial b)
        (irrelevant_le_map_gradedFromPolynomial b) (irrelevant_le_map_gradedToPolynomial b)).symm
    _ = 𝟙 (Proj (SchemeProjectiveSpace.grading R n)) := by
      convert Proj.map_id
      rw [gradedToPolynomial_comp_gradedFromPolynomial b]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.toStandardProjectiveSpace_comp_toSpec
statement:
theorem toStandardProjectiveSpace_comp_toSpec (b : Module.Basis (Fin (n + 1)) R M) :
    toStandardProjectiveSpace b ≫ SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec R n =
      Proj.toSpecZero (gradingOfBasis b) ≫
        Spec.map (degreeZeroAlgEquivOfBasis b).symm.toCommRingCatIso.hom
proof:
:= by
  unfold toStandardProjectiveSpace SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpecZero

  rw [← Spec.map_comp]
  apply congrArg Spec.map
  ext r
  simp [degreeZeroAlgEquivOfBasis, degreeZeroRingEquiv, gradedFromPolynomial,
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.degreeZeroAlgEquiv, SchemeProjectiveSpace.degreeZeroEquiv,

  let A := C.pullbackFrameCover f
  let D := nativePulledNormalCompletionCover g E σ hE hX
  let e := (nativeNormalBundlePlusLineBaseChangeIso g E σ hX).symm
  with_unfolding_all exact nativeNormalIndependentTransport_toBase e D A

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.nativeNormalCompletionAdaptedIso_chart
statement:
theorem nativeNormalCompletionAdaptedIso_chart :
    letI
proof:
:= cosectionPullback_isQuasicoherent g E
    let C := cosectionIntrinsicCompletionCover X E σ hE hX
    let f := pulledCosection_zeroCentreMap g E σ
    let A := C.pullbackFrameCover f
    let D := nativePulledNormalCompletionCover g E σ hE hX
    let e := (nativeNormalBundlePlusLineBaseChangeIso g E σ hX).symm
    let T := AffineFrameCover.transport e A
    ∀ j : A.I, (D.union T).chartι (Sum.inr j) ≫
      (AffineFrameCover.isoUnionLeft D T).inv ≫
      (nativeNormalCompletionAdaptedIso g E σ hE hX).hom =
      (AffineFrameCover.chartIso e A j).hom ≫ A.chartι j := by
  letI := cosectionPullback_isQuasicoherent g E
  let C := cosectionIntrinsicCompletionCover X E σ hE hX
  let f := pulledCosection_zeroCentreMap g E σ
  let A := C.pullbackFrameCover f
  let D := nativePulledNormalCompletionCover g E σ hE hX
  let e := (nativeNormalBundlePlusLineBaseChangeIso g E σ hX).symm
  let T := AffineFrameCover.transport e A
  dsimp only
  intro j
  change (D.union T).chartι (Sum.inr j) ≫ (AffineFrameCover.isoUnionLeft D T).inv ≫
    ((AffineFrameCover.isoOfCovers D T) ≪≫ AffineFrameCover.transportSchemeIso e A).hom = _
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, AffineFrameCover.isoOfCovers, Category.assoc,
    Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, Iso.symm_hom]
  rw [← AffineFrameCover.chartι_isoUnionRight_hom D T j]
  erw [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  with_unfolding_all exact AffineFrameCover.chartι_transportSchemeHom e A j

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.nativeNormalCompletionBaseChangeMap_chart
statement:
theorem nativeNormalCompletionBaseChangeMap_chart :
    letI
proof:
:= cosectionPullback_isQuasicoherent g E
    let C := cosectionIntrinsicCompletionCover X E σ hE hX
    let f := pulledCosection_zeroCentreMap g E σ
    let A := C.pullbackFrameCover f
    let D := nativePulledNormalCompletionCover g E σ hE hX
    let e := (nativeNormalBundlePlusLineBaseChangeIso g E σ hX).symm
    let T := AffineFrameCover.transport e A
    ∀ j : A.I, (D.union T).chartι (Sum.inr j) ≫
      (AffineFrameCover.isoUnionLeft D T).inv ≫
      nativeNormalCompletionBaseChangeMap g E σ hE hX =
      (AffineFrameCover.chartIso e A j).hom ≫ C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap f j ≫
        C.chartι j.1 := by
  letI := cosectionPullback_isQuasicoherent g E
  let C := cosectionIntrinsicCompletionCover X E σ hE hX
  let f := pulledCosection_zeroCentreMap g E σ
  let A := C.pullbackFrameCover f
  let D := nativePulledNormalCompletionCover g E σ hE hX
  let e := (nativeNormalBundlePlusLineBaseChangeIso g E σ hX).symm
  let T := AffineFrameCover.transport e A
  dsimp only
  intro j
  with_unfolding_all exact nativeNormalIndependentTransport_chart C f e D j

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.nativeNormalCompletionBaseChangeMap_toCentre
statement:
theorem nativeNormalCompletionBaseChangeMap_toCentre :
    letI
proof:
:= cosectionPullback_isQuasicoherent g E
    nativeNormalCompletionBaseChangeMap g E σ hE hX ≫
      (cosectionIntrinsicCompletionCover X E σ hE hX).toBase =
      (nativePulledNormalCompletionCover g E σ hE hX).toBase ≫
        pulledCosection_zeroCentreMap g E σ := by
  letI := cosectionPullback_isQuasicoherent g E
  rw [nativeNormalCompletionBaseChangeMap, Category.assoc,
    AffineFrameCover.pullbackProjectiveMap_toBase, ← Category.assoc,
    nativeNormalCompletionAdaptedIso_toCentre]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.nativeNormalCompletionBaseChangeIso_fst
statement:
theorem nativeNormalCompletionBaseChangeIso_fst :
    letI
proof:
:= cosectionPullback_isQuasicoherent g E
    (nativeNormalCompletionBaseChangeIso g E σ hE hX).hom ≫ pullback.fst _ _ =
      nativeNormalCompletionBaseChangeMap g E σ hE hX := by
  letI := cosectionPullback_isQuasicoherent g E
  simp only [nativeNormalCompletionBaseChangeIso, Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc,
    AffineFrameCover.pullbackProjectiveIso_hom_fst, nativeNormalCompletionBaseChangeMap]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.nativeNormalCompletionBaseChangeIso_snd
statement:
theorem nativeNormalCompletionBaseChangeIso_snd :
    letI
proof:
:= cosectionPullback_isQuasicoherent g E
    (nativeNormalCompletionBaseChangeIso g E σ hE hX).hom ≫ pullback.snd _ _ =
      (nativePulledNormalCompletionCover g E σ hE hX).toBase := by
  letI := cosectionPullback_isQuasicoherent g E
  simp only [nativeNormalCompletionBaseChangeIso, Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc,
    AffineFrameCover.pullbackProjectiveIso_hom_snd, nativeNormalCompletionAdaptedIso_toCentre]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.nativeNormalCompletionBaseChangeMap_isPullback
statement:
theorem nativeNormalCompletionBaseChangeMap_isPullback :
    letI
proof:
:= cosectionPullback_isQuasicoherent g E
    IsPullback (nativeNormalCompletionBaseChangeMap g E σ hE hX)
      (nativePulledNormalCompletionCover g E σ hE hX).toBase
      (cosectionIntrinsicCompletionCover X E σ hE hX).toBase
      (pulledCosection_zeroCentreMap g E σ) := by
  letI := cosectionPullback_isQuasicoherent g E
  exact IsPullback.of_iso_pullback
    ⟨nativeNormalCompletionBaseChangeMap_toCentre g E σ hE hX⟩
    (nativeNormalCompletionBaseChangeIso g E σ hE hX)
    (nativeNormalCompletionBaseChangeIso_fst g E σ hE hX)
    (nativeNormalCompletionBaseChangeIso_snd g E σ hE hX)

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.nativeNormalCompletionBaseChangeTwistIso_hom
statement:
theorem nativeNormalCompletionBaseChangeTwistIso_hom :
    letI
proof:
:= cosectionPullback_isQuasicoherent g E
    let C := cosectionIntrinsicCompletionCover X E σ hE hX
    let f := pulledCosection_zeroCentreMap g E σ
    let δ := nativeNormalCompletionAdaptedIso g E σ hE hX
    (nativeNormalCompletionBaseChangeTwistIso g E σ hE hX).hom =
      (AffineFrameCover.pullbackTransIso δ.hom (C.pullbackProjectiveMap f)
        (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback δ.hom).map (C.pullbackCanonicalTwistingSheafOneIso f).inv ≫
      (nativeNormalCompletionAdaptedTwistIso g E σ hE hX).hom := rfl

name: RingEquiv.awayMap_comp_algebraMap
statement:
theorem _root_.RingEquiv.awayMap_comp_algebraMap (e : R ≃+* S) (a : R) :
    (e.awayMap a).toRingHom.comp (algebraMap R (Localization.Away a)) =
      (algebraMap S (Localization.Away (e a))).comp e.toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro r
  show (e.awayMap a) (algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) r) = _
  unfold _root_.RingEquiv.awayMap
  rw [IsLocalization.ringEquivOfRingEquiv_apply]
  exact IsLocalization.map_eq _ r

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.localizedIdeal_map_awayMap
statement:

      (localizedIdeal I a).map (e.awayMap a).toRingHom
proof:

  rw [Ideal.map_map, Ideal.map_map, e.awayMap_comp_algebraMap]

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesProjMap_comp_reesProjMapOfRingEquiv
statement:
theorem reesProjMap_comp_reesProjMapOfRingEquiv (e : R ≃+* S) (I : Ideal R) (a : R) :
    reesProjMap (I.map e.toRingHom) (e a) ≫ reesProjMapOfRingEquiv e I =
      AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map
        ((gradedLocalizationMap (I.map e.toRingHom) (e a)).comp (gradedReesEquivHom e I))
        (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivHom e I)
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedLocalizationMap (I.map e.toRingHom) (e a)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold reesProjMap reesProjMapOfRingEquiv
  exact (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map_comp
    (gradedReesEquivHom e I)
    (gradedLocalizationMap (I.map e.toRingHom) (e a))
    (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivHom e I)
    (irrelevant_le_map_gradedLocalizationMap (I.map e.toRingHom) (e a))).symm

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesProjMapOfRingEquiv_comp_reesProjMap
statement:
theorem reesProjMapOfRingEquiv_comp_reesProjMap (e : R ≃+* S) (I : Ideal R) (a : R) :
    reesProjMapOfRingEquiv (e.awayMap a) (localizedIdeal I a) ≫ reesProjMap I a =
      AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map
        ((gradedReesEquivHom (e.awayMap a) (localizedIdeal I a)).comp (gradedLocalizationMap I a))
        (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedLocalizationMap I a)
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivHom (e.awayMap a) (localizedIdeal I a)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold reesProjMap reesProjMapOfRingEquiv
  exact (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map_comp
    (gradedLocalizationMap I a)
    (gradedReesEquivHom (e.awayMap a) (localizedIdeal I a))
    (irrelevant_le_map_gradedLocalizationMap I a)
    (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivHom (e.awayMap a) (localizedIdeal I a))).symm

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesProjMap_naturality
statement:
theorem reesProjMap_naturality (e : R ≃+* S) (I : Ideal R) (a : R) :
    reesProjMap (I.map e.toRingHom) (e a) ≫ reesProjMapOfRingEquiv e I =
      (localizedIdeal_map_awayMap I e a) ▸
        (reesProjMapOfRingEquiv (e.awayMap a) (localizedIdeal I a) ≫ reesProjMap I a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [reesProjMap_comp_reesProjMapOfRingEquiv, reesProjMapOfRingEquiv_comp_reesProjMap]
  refine (Proj_map_eq_of_pointwise_eq (localizedIdeal_map_awayMap I e a).symm
    ((gradedReesEquivHom (e.awayMap a) (localizedIdeal I a)).comp (gradedLocalizationMap I a))
    ((gradedLocalizationMap (I.map e.toRingHom) (e a)).comp (gradedReesEquivHom e I))
    ?_ _ _).symm
  intro p
  show Polynomial.map (e.awayMap a).toRingHom
      (Polynomial.map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away a)) (p : Polynomial R)) =
    Polynomial.map (algebraMap S (Localization.Away (e a)))
      (Polynomial.map e.toRingHom (p : Polynomial R))
  rw [Polynomial.map_map, Polynomial.map_map, e.awayMap_comp_algebraMap]

name: SchemeKTheory.characteristic_rankAt_locallyConstant
statement:
theorem characteristic_rankAt_locallyConstant (E : X.Modules)
    (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) : IsLocallyConstant (fun x : X ↦ rankAt x E)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin⟩ := hE.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := hqfin
  rw [IsLocallyConstant.iff_exists_open]
  intro x
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_mem_localGenerators q x
  exact ⟨q.X i, (q.X i).isOpen, hi, fun x' hx' ↦
    (rankAt_eq_card_of_mem q i hx').trans (rankAt_eq_card_of_mem q i hi).symm⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.characteristicRankOpen_isClosed
statement:
theorem characteristicRankOpen_isClosed (E : X.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) (r : ℕ) :

proof:
:=
  (characteristic_rankAt_locallyConstant E hE).isClosed_fiber r

name: SchemeKTheory.characteristicRankOpen_covers
statement:
theorem characteristicRankOpen_covers (E : X.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) :
    IsOpenCover (characteristicRankOpen E hE)
proof:
:= by
  refine IsOpenCover.mk (eq_top_iff.2 fun x _ ↦ ?_)
  exact Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨rankAt x E, rfl⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.characteristicRankOpen_disjoint
statement:
theorem characteristicRankOpen_disjoint (E : X.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E)
    {r s : ℕ} (hrs : r ≠ s) :
    Disjoint (characteristicRankOpen E hE r) (characteristicRankOpen E hE s)
proof:
:= by
  apply disjoint_iff.mpr
  ext x
  simp only [characteristicRankOpen]
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ hrs (h.1.symm.trans h.2), False.elim⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.hasConstantRank_of_pointwise_rank
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_of_pointwise_rank (E : X.Modules)
    (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) (r : ℕ) (hr : ∀ x : X, rankAt x E = r) :
    HasConstantRank X E r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin⟩ := hE.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := hqfin
  have hcov : IsOpenCover (fun i : {i : q.I // ∃ x, x ∈ q.X i} ↦ q.X i.1) := by
    refine IsOpenCover.mk (eq_top_iff.2 fun x _ ↦ ?_)
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_mem_localGenerators q x
    exact Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨⟨i, x, hi⟩, hi⟩
  let q' : E.LocalGeneratorsData :=
    { I := {i : q.I // ∃ x, x ∈ q.X i}
      X := fun i ↦ q.X i.1
      coversTop := (Opens.coversTop_iff X _).2 hcov
      generators := fun i ↦ q.generators i.1 }
  have h1 : q'.IsLocallyFreeData :=
    SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsLocallyFreeData.mk (q := q') fun i ↦
      SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsLocallyFreeData.isIso (q := q) i.1
  have h2 : q'.IsFiniteType :=
    SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.mk (p := q') fun i ↦
      SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType (p := q) i.1
  refine ⟨q', h1, h2, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := i.2
  exact (rankAt_eq_card_of_mem q i.1 hx).symm.trans (hr x)

name: SchemeKTheory.characteristicRankOpen_hasConstantRank
statement:
theorem characteristicRankOpen_hasConstantRank (E : X.Modules)
    (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) (r : ℕ) :
    HasConstantRank (characteristicRankOpen E hE r : Scheme)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι).obj E) r
proof:
:= by
  apply hasConstantRank_of_pointwise_rank
  · exact pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global _ E hE
  · intro x
    exact (rankAt_pullback (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι E hE x).trans x.property

name: SchemeKTheory.characteristicRankOpen_preimage
statement:
theorem characteristicRankOpen_preimage {Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ X)
    (E : X.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) (r : ℕ) :
    f ⁻¹ᵁ characteristicRankOpen E hE r =
      characteristicRankOpen ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E)
        (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global f E hE) r
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  change (rankAt (f z) E = r) ↔
    (rankAt z ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E) = r)
  rw [rankAt_pullback f E hE z]

name: SchemeKTheory.characteristic_rankAt_range_finite
statement:
theorem characteristic_rankAt_range_finite [CompactSpace X] (E : X.Modules)

proof:

name: SchemeKTheory.characteristicRankOpen_composite_hasConstantRank
statement:
theorem characteristicRankOpen_composite_hasConstantRank {Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (E : X.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) (r : ℕ)
    (g : Z ⟶ (characteristicRankOpen E hE r : Scheme)) :
    HasConstantRank Z ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (g ≫ (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι)).obj E) r
proof:
:=
  hasConstantRank_of_iso ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι).app E)
    (hasConstantRank_pullback Z g _ r (characteristicRankOpen_hasConstantRank E hE r))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.chernOp_rankOpen_pull_flat
statement:

    totalPull ops g d hd ∘ₗ
      chernOp ops cp ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι).obj E) r
        (characteristicRankOpen_hasConstantRank E hE r) i =
      chernOp ops cp ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (g ≫ (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι)).obj E) r
        (characteristicRankOpen_composite_hasConstantRank E hE r g) i ∘ₗ totalPull ops g d hd
proof:
:= by

    (characteristicRankOpen_hasConstantRank E hE r) i
  have hi := chernOp_bundleIso ops cp
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι).app E) r
    (hasConstantRank_pullback Z g _ r (characteristicRankOpen_hasConstantRank E hE r))
    (characteristicRankOpen_composite_hasConstantRank E hE r g)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoL_inv_preimage_preimage
statement:
theorem m7geoL_inv_preimage_preimage {A B : Scheme.{u}} (f : A ⟶ B)
    [IsIso f] (U : B.Opens) :
    inv f ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) = U
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change f (inv f x) ∈ U ↔ x ∈ U
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, IsIso.inv_hom_id]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoL_inv_app_app_heq
statement:
theorem m7geoL_inv_app_app_heq {A B : Scheme.{u}} (f : A ⟶ B)
    [IsIso f] (U : B.Opens) (s : Γ(B, U)) :
    HEq ((inv f).app (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) (f.app U s)) s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_app]
  have happ := Scheme.Hom.congr_app (IsIso.inv_hom_id f) U
  have hs := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom happ s
  simp only [Scheme.Hom.id_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hs
  exact (heq_of_eq hs).trans (m7geoH_map_eqToHom_heq B _ s)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoL_inv_transport_heq
statement:
theorem m7geoL_inv_transport_heq {A B : Scheme.{u}} (f : A ⟶ B)
    [IsIso f] (U : B.Opens) {V : A.Opens} (hV : V = f ⁻¹ᵁ U)
    (x : Γ(A, V)) (s : Γ(B, U)) (hx : HEq x (f.app U s)) :
    HEq ((inv f).app (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) (hV ▸ x)) s
proof:
:= by
  cases hV
  have hx' : x = f.app U s := eq_of_heq hx
  exact (heq_of_eq (congrArg ((inv f).app (f ⁻¹ᵁ U)) hx')).trans
    (m7geoL_inv_app_app_heq f U s)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoL_app_heq_of_opens_eq
statement:
theorem m7geoL_app_heq_of_opens_eq {A B : Scheme.{u}} (g : B ⟶ A)
    {U V : A.Opens} (hUV : U = V) (x : Γ(A, U)) (s : Γ(A, V))
    (hxs : HEq x s) : HEq (g.app U x) (g.app V s)
proof:
:= by
  cases hUV
  have h : x = s := eq_of_heq hxs
  subst h
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoL_comp_app_cast_heq
statement:
theorem m7geoL_comp_app_cast_heq {A B C : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C) (U : C.Opens)
    {V : B.Opens} (hV : V = g ⁻¹ᵁ U) (s : Γ(C, U)) :
    HEq ((f ≫ g).app U s) (f.app V (hV ▸ g.app U s))
proof:
:= by
  cases hV
  simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_app]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoL_triple_app_cast_heq
statement:
theorem m7geoL_triple_app_cast_heq {A B C D : Scheme.{u}}
    (F : A ⟶ B) (G : B ⟶ C) (H : C ⟶ D) (U : D.Opens)
    {V : C.Opens} (hV : H ⁻¹ᵁ U = V) (s : Γ(D, U)) :
    HEq (((F ≫ G) ≫ H).app U s)
      (F.app (G ⁻¹ᵁ V) (G.app V (hV ▸ H.app U s)))
proof:
:= by
  cases hV
  simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_app]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoL_J0_preimage_global_overlap
statement:
theorem m7geoL_J0_preimage_global_overlap {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (i : C.I) [Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)]
    (a : Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1)) :
    m7g_J C i 0 ⁻¹ᵁ
        (m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a) ⊓
          m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0)) =
      m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0 ⁻¹ᵁ
        coordinateOverlapOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0 a
proof:
:= by
  ext Q
  change m7g_J C i 0 Q ∈
      (m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a) ⊓
        m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0)) ↔
      m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0 Q ∈
        coordinateOverlapOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0 a
  rw [coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
  exact and_congr (m7geo_J_mem_W_iff C i 0 a Q)
    (m7geo_J_mem_W_iff C i 0 0 Q) |>.trans and_comm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoL_chartι_preimage_global_overlap
statement:
theorem m7geoL_chartι_preimage_global_overlap {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (i : C.I) [Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)]
    (a : Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1)) :

        (m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a) ⊓
          m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0)) =

proof:
:= by

  rw [← m7geoG_basis_reindex C i a, ← m7geoG_basis_reindex C i 0]
  rw [linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf, inf_comm, ← linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoL_inv_chartι_preimage_global_overlap
statement:
theorem m7geoL_inv_chartι_preimage_global_overlap {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (i : C.I) [Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)]
    (a : Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1)) :
    let f
proof:
:= intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace (m7g_b C i)
    (inv f ≫ C.chartι i) ⁻¹ᵁ
        (m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a) ⊓
          m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0)) =
      coordinateOverlapOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0 a := by
  let f := intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace (m7g_b C i)
  let D := coordinateOverlapOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0 a
  let U := m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a) ⊓
    m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0)
  have hpre : C.chartι i ⁻¹ᵁ U = f ⁻¹ᵁ D :=
    m7geoL_chartι_preimage_global_overlap C i a
  change (inv f ≫ C.chartι i) ⁻¹ᵁ U = D
  calc
    _ = inv f ⁻¹ᵁ (C.chartι i ⁻¹ᵁ U) := rfl
    _ = inv f ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ D) := congrArg (fun V => inv f ⁻¹ᵁ V) hpre
    _ = D := m7geoL_inv_preimage_preimage f D

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoL_inverse_ratio_standard_heq
statement:
theorem m7geoL_inverse_ratio_standard_heq {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (i : C.I) [Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)]
    {a : Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1)} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    let f
proof:
:= intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace (m7g_b C i)
    let D := coordinateOverlapOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0 a
    let U := m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a) ⊓
      m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0)
    HEq
      ((inv f).app (f ⁻¹ᵁ D)
        ((m7geoL_chartι_preimage_global_overlap C i a) ▸
          ((C.chartι i).app U
            (m7geoF_ratio C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a)
              ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0)))))
      ((space Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i)).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (Proj.basicOpen_mono
          (𝒜 := grading Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i))
          (f := coordinate Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0)
          (g := coordinateOverlapEquation Γ(X, C.U i)
            (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0 a)
          ⟨coordinate Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a, rfl⟩)).op
        (Proj.awayToSection
          (grading Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i))
          (coordinate Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0)
          (coordinateRatio Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0
            ⟨a, ha⟩))) := by
  let f := intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace (m7g_b C i)
  let D := coordinateOverlapOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0 a
  let U := m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a) ⊓
    m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0)
  let s := (space Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i)).presheaf.map
    (homOfLE (Proj.basicOpen_mono
      (𝒜 := grading Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i))
      (f := coordinate Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0)
      (g := coordinateOverlapEquation Γ(X, C.U i)
        (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0 a)
      ⟨coordinate Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a, rfl⟩)).op
    (Proj.awayToSection
      (grading Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i))
      (coordinate Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0)
      (coordinateRatio Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0
        ⟨a, ha⟩))
  exact m7geoL_inv_transport_heq f D
    (m7geoL_chartι_preimage_global_overlap C i a)
    ((C.chartι i).app U
      (m7geoF_ratio C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a)
        ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0))) s
    (m7geoI_chartι_ratio_standard_restricted_heq C i ha)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoL_global_ratio_affine_variable_heq
statement:
theorem m7geoL_global_ratio_affine_variable_heq {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (i : C.I) [Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)]
    {a : Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1)} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    let f
proof:
:= intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace (m7g_b C i)
    let G := m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0
    let D := coordinateOverlapOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0 a
    let U := m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a) ⊓
      m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0)
    let hV := m7geoL_chartι_preimage_global_overlap C i a
    HEq
      (G.app (inv f ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ D))
        ((inv f).app (f ⁻¹ᵁ D)
          (hV ▸ ((C.chartι i).app U
            (m7geoF_ratio C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a)
              ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0))))))
      ((Spec (CommRingCat.of (MvPolynomial
        (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0) Γ(X, C.U i)))).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (le_top : G ⁻¹ᵁ D ≤ ⊤)).op
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (MvPolynomial
            (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0) Γ(X, C.U i)))).inv
            (MvPolynomial.X ⟨a, ha⟩))) := by
  let f := intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace (m7g_b C i)
  let G := m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0
  let D := coordinateOverlapOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0 a
  let U := m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a) ⊓
    m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0)
  let hV := m7geoL_chartι_preimage_global_overlap C i a
  let s := (space Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i)).presheaf.map
    (homOfLE (Proj.basicOpen_mono
      (𝒜 := grading Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i))
      (f := coordinate Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0)
      (g := coordinateOverlapEquation Γ(X, C.U i)
        (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0 a)
      ⟨coordinate Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a, rfl⟩)).op
    (Proj.awayToSection
      (grading Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i))
      (coordinate Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0)
      (coordinateRatio Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0
        ⟨a, ha⟩))
  have hI : HEq
      ((inv f).app (f ⁻¹ᵁ D)
        (hV ▸ ((C.chartι i).app U
          (m7geoF_ratio C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a)
            ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0))))) s := by
    simpa only [f, D, U, hV, s] using
      (m7geoL_inverse_ratio_standard_heq C i ha)
  have hMap := m7geoL_app_heq_of_opens_eq G
    (m7geoL_inv_preimage_preimage f D)
    ((inv f).app (f ⁻¹ᵁ D)
      (hV ▸ ((C.chartι i).app U
        (m7geoF_ratio C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a)
          ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm 0))))) s hI
  have hK := m7geoK_stdChart_coordinateRatio_restricted
    Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) ha
  simp only [Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app] at hK
  exact hMap.trans (heq_of_eq hK)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoL_J0_global_ratio_affine_variable_heq
statement:
theorem m7geoL_J0_global_ratio_affine_variable_heq {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)

      ((m7g_J C i 0).app U
        (m7geoF_ratio C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm a)

            (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0) Γ(X, C.U i)))).inv
            (MvPolynomial.X ⟨a, ha⟩))) := by

name: SchemeKTheory.k0_twist_inv
statement:
theorem k0_twist_inv {Y : Scheme.{u}} {B : Y.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover Y B)
    (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) :
    k0ClassOf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
        (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).isFiniteLocallyFree *
      k0ClassOf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1))
        (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1)).isFiniteLocallyFree = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf_mul_line (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1))
    (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)]
  have e1 : tensorSheaf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (-1)) ≅
      tensorUnitSheaf C.scheme :=
    AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.twistingTensorIso C hpos 1 (-1) ≪≫ eqToIso (by norm_num) ≪≫
      C.canonicalTwistingSheafZeroIso
  have h1 : (1 : K0 C.scheme) = k0ClassOf C.scheme (tensorUnitSheaf C.scheme)
      (hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf (Y := C.scheme)).isFiniteLocallyFree := rfl
  rw [h1]
  exact k0ClassOf_iso _ _ _ e1

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.zeroIdeal_le_ker
statement:
theorem zeroIdeal_le_ker {Y' : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (hg : g.appTop t = 0) :
    zeroIdeal t ≤ g.ker
proof:
:= by
  refine Scheme.IdealSheafData.le_ofIdeals_iff.2 fun U => ?_
  change (Ideal.span {t}).map (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op).hom ≤ _
  rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, Ideal.span_le]
  intro a ha
  rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at ha
  subst ha
  change _ ∈ RingHom.ker _
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker]
  have h0 := congrArg (Y'.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : g ⁻¹ᵁ (U : Y.Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op).hom hg
  rw [map_zero] at h0
  rw [← h0]
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← CommRingCat.comp_apply]
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (g.naturality (homOfLE (le_top : (U : Y.Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op) t
