name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.hbc_principal_canonical
statement:
theorem hbc_principal_canonical
    (hmono : ∀ (E : Y.Modules), IsFiniteLocallyFree Y E → Mono (tMul t E))
    (V : W.Modules) (hV : IsCoherentLike W V) [Mono (tMul (F.appTop t) V)]
    (y : K0 Y) (hy : k0ToG0 Y y = finitePushforward F (g0ClassOf W V hV)) :
    k0ToG0 (zeroScheme t) (pullbackK0 (zeroι t) y) =
      haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (zeroScheme t)
proof:
:= isLocallyNoetherian_subscheme _
      finitePushforward (zeroMap t F) (g0ClassOf (zeroScheme (F.appTop t))
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (zeroι (F.appTop t))).obj V) (by
          letI : V.IsFinitePresentation := hV
          exact pullback_isFinitePresentation_global (zeroι (F.appTop t)) V)) := by
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (zeroScheme t) := isLocallyNoetherian_subscheme _
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (zeroScheme (F.appTop t)) := isLocallyNoetherian_subscheme _
  have hG : IsCoherentLike (zeroScheme (F.appTop t))
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (zeroι (F.appTop t))).obj V) := by
    letI : V.IsFinitePresentation := hV
    exact pullback_isFinitePresentation_global (zeroι (F.appTop t)) V
  rw [finitePushforward_classOf]
  refine hbc_principal_iso t F hmono V hV _ (finitePushObject (zeroMap t F) ⟨_, hG⟩).2 ?_ y hy
  refine (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (zeroMap t F) (zeroι t)).app _ ≪≫ ?_
  refine (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (zeroMap_zeroι t F)).app _ ≪≫ ?_
  refine (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (zeroι (F.appTop t)) F).symm.app _ ≪≫ ?_
  exact (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).mapIso (cokernelIsoPushPull (F.appTop t) V hV)

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.tensorSheafLeftFunctor_map_tMul
statement:
theorem tensorSheafLeftFunctor_map_tMul (E N : X.Modules) :
    (tensorSheafLeftFunctor X E).map (tMul t N) = tMul t ((tensorSheafLeftFunctor X E).obj N)
proof:
:= by
  let adj := moduleSheafificationAdjunction X
  let P := (tensorLeft E.val).obj ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).obj N)
  apply (adj.homEquiv _ _).injective
  simp only [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
  have h1 : (tensorSheafLeftFunctor X E).map (tMul t N) =
      (moduleSheafification X).map ((tensorLeft E.val).map
        ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map (tMul t N))) := rfl
  rw [h1]
  refine (adj.unit_naturality _).trans ?_
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro W
  apply ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.tensor_ext
  intro m n
  let r : ((X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).obj W) := tRes t W
  have hu := ((adj.unit.app P).app W).hom.map_smul r (m ⊗ₜ[_] n)
  have e : m ⊗ₜ[↑((X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).obj W)] (r • n) =
      r • (m ⊗ₜ[↑((X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).obj W)] n) :=
    TensorProduct.tmul_smul _ _ _
  have hl : (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (((tensorLeft E.val).map ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map
      (tMul t N))).app W)) (m ⊗ₜ[↑((X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).obj W)] n) =
      m ⊗ₜ[↑((X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).obj W)] (r • n) := rfl
  have hr : (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map
      (tMul t ((tensorSheafLeftFunctor X E).obj N))).app W))
      ((ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((adj.unit.app P).app W))
        (m ⊗ₜ[↑((X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).obj W)] n)) =
      r • (ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((adj.unit.app P).app W))
        (m ⊗ₜ[↑((X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).obj W)] n) := rfl
  change ((adj.unit.app P).app W).hom ((ModuleCat.Hom.hom (((tensorLeft E.val).map
      ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map (tMul t N))).app W))
        (m ⊗ₜ[↑((X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).obj W)] n)) =
    (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map
      (tMul t ((tensorSheafLeftFunctor X E).obj N))).app W))
      ((ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((adj.unit.app P).app W))
        (m ⊗ₜ[↑((X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).obj W)] n))
  rw [hl, hr, e]
  exact hu

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.mono_tMul_of_unit
statement:
theorem mono_tMul_of_unit (hunit : Mono (tMul t (tensorUnitSheaf X)))
    (E : X.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) : Mono (tMul t E)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits X E hE
  have h1 : Mono ((tensorSheafLeftFunctor X E).map (tMul t (tensorUnitSheaf X))) := inferInstance
  rw [tensorSheafLeftFunctor_map_tMul] at h1
  let u : (tensorSheafLeftFunctor X E).obj (tensorUnitSheaf X) ≅ E :=
    (KSpecialization.AR7R.thetaIso E).app (tensorUnitSheaf X) ≪≫ ρ_ E
  have n := (tNatTrans t).naturality u.hom
  have key : tMul t E = inv u.hom ≫ tMul t ((tensorSheafLeftFunctor X E).obj (tensorUnitSheaf X)) ≫
      u.hom := by
    rw [IsIso.eq_inv_comp]
    exact n
  rw [key]
  infer_instance

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.mono_tMul_unit
statement: theorem mono_tMul_unit (hnz : IsNZDEverywhere t) : Mono (tMul t (tensorUnitSheaf X))
proof:
:= by
  apply moduleHom_mono_of_app_injective
  intro W a b h
  have h2 : X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op t * (show Γ(X, W) from a) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op t * (show Γ(X, W) from b) := h
  have h' : X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op t * ((show Γ(X, W) from a) - (show Γ(X, W) from b))
      = 0 := by rw [mul_sub, h2, sub_self]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hnz W _ h')

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.isNZDEverywhere_of_isIntegral
statement: theorem isNZDEverywhere_of_isIntegral [IsIntegral X] (ht : t ≠ 0) : IsNZDEverywhere t
proof:
:= by
  intro W r hr
  by_cases hW : Nonempty W
  · have hne : X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op t ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      exact ht (map_injective_of_isIntegral X (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)) (h0.trans (map_zero _).symm))
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hr).resolve_left hne
  · have hWb : W = ⊥ := by
      refine le_antisymm (fun x hx => absurd ⟨⟨x, hx⟩⟩ hW) bot_le
    subst hWb
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.flatPullbackG0_iso_eq_finitePushforward_inv
statement:
theorem flatPullbackG0_iso_eq_finitePushforward_inv [IsLocallyNoetherian C] (e : C ≅ B) :
    flatPullbackG0 e.hom = finitePushforward e.inv
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
  intro E
  change flatPullbackG0 e.hom (g0ClassOf B E.1 E.2) = finitePushforward e.inv (g0ClassOf B E.1 E.2)
  rw [flatPullbackG0_classOf, finitePushforward_classOf]
  exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso C.Modules (IsCoherentLike C) _ _
    (show IsCoherentLike C (0 : C.Modules) from
      inferInstanceAs (0 : C.Modules).IsFinitePresentation)
    (isZero_zero _) ((pullbackHomIsoPushforwardInv e).app E.1)

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.finitePushforward_comp
statement:
theorem finitePushforward_comp (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ W) [IsFinite f] [IsFinite g] :
    finitePushforward (f ≫ g) = (finitePushforward g).comp (finitePushforward f)
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
  intro x
  change finitePushforward (f ≫ g) (g0ClassOf X x.1 x.2) =
    finitePushforward g (finitePushforward f (g0ClassOf X x.1 x.2))
  rw [finitePushforward_classOf, finitePushforward_classOf, finitePushforward_classOf]
  exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso W.Modules (IsCoherentLike W) _ _
    (show IsCoherentLike W (0 : W.Modules) from
      inferInstanceAs (0 : W.Modules).IsFinitePresentation)
    (isZero_zero _) ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f g).app x.1).symm

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.finitePushforward_congr
statement:
theorem finitePushforward_congr {f g : X ⟶ Y} (h : f = g) [IsFinite f] [IsFinite g] :
    finitePushforward f = finitePushforward g
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.flatPullbackG0_finitePushforward_opens
statement:
theorem flatPullbackG0_finitePushforward_opens (F : W ⟶ M) [IsFinite F] (U : M.Opens)
    (x : G0 W) :
    flatPullbackG0 U.ι (finitePushforward F x) =
      finitePushforward (F ∣_ U) (flatPullbackG0 (F ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι x)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (flatPullbackG0 U.ι).comp (finitePushforward F) =
      (finitePushforward (F ∣_ U)).comp (flatPullbackG0 (F ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι) := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    intro E
    change flatPullbackG0 U.ι (finitePushforward F (g0ClassOf W E.1 E.2)) =
      finitePushforward (F ∣_ U) (flatPullbackG0 (F ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι (g0ClassOf W E.1 E.2))
    rw [finitePushforward_classOf, flatPullbackG0_classOf, flatPullbackG0_classOf,
      finitePushforward_classOf]
    exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso _ (IsCoherentLike _) _ _
      (show IsCoherentLike U (0 : U.toScheme.Modules) from
        inferInstanceAs (0 : U.toScheme.Modules).IsFinitePresentation)
      (isZero_zero _) (pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso F U E.1)
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h x

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.flatPullbackG0_finitePushforward_openSquare
statement:
theorem flatPullbackG0_finitePushforward_openSquare (F : W ⟶ M) [IsFinite F]
    (c : U ⟶ M) [IsOpenImmersion c] (c' : W' ⟶ W) [IsOpenImmersion c'] (F' : W' ⟶ U)
    [IsFinite F'] (sq : IsPullback c' F' F c) (x : G0 W) :
    flatPullbackG0 c (finitePushforward F x) = finitePushforward F' (flatPullbackG0 c' x)
proof:
:= by
  let U₀ : M.Opens := c.opensRange
  let e : U ≅ (U₀ : Scheme.{u}) := c.isoOpensRange
  have he : e.hom ≫ U₀.ι = c := Scheme.Hom.isoOpensRange_hom_ι c
  have sq₀ : IsPullback (F ⁻¹ᵁ U₀).ι (F ∣_ U₀) F U₀.ι := (isPullback_morphismRestrict F U₀).flip
  have sq' : IsPullback c' (F' ≫ e.hom) F U₀.ι :=
    IsPullback.of_iso sq (Iso.refl W') (Iso.refl W) e (Iso.refl M) (by simp) (by simp)
      (by simp) (by simpa using he.symm)
  let k : W' ≅ ((F ⁻¹ᵁ U₀ : W.Opens) : Scheme.{u}) := sq'.isoIsPullback _ _ sq₀
  have hk1 : k.hom ≫ (F ⁻¹ᵁ U₀).ι = c' := sq'.isoIsPullback_hom_fst _ _ sq₀
  have hk2 : k.hom ≫ (F ∣_ U₀) = F' ≫ e.hom := sq'.isoIsPullback_hom_snd _ _ sq₀
  have hF : k.inv ≫ F' = (F ∣_ U₀) ≫ e.inv := by
    rw [Iso.inv_comp_eq, ← Category.assoc, hk2, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian ((U₀ : M.Opens) : Scheme.{u}) := inferInstance
  have h1 : flatPullbackG0 c = (flatPullbackG0 e.hom).comp (flatPullbackG0 U₀.ι) := by
    exact (GLocalisationSpec.flatPullbackG0_congr he.symm).trans (GLocalisationSpec.flatPullbackG0_comp e.hom U₀.ι)
  have h2 : flatPullbackG0 c' = (flatPullbackG0 k.hom).comp (flatPullbackG0 (F ⁻¹ᵁ U₀).ι) := by
    exact (GLocalisationSpec.flatPullbackG0_congr hk1.symm).trans (GLocalisationSpec.flatPullbackG0_comp k.hom (F ⁻¹ᵁ U₀).ι)
  rw [h1, h2, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply,
    flatPullbackG0_finitePushforward_opens, flatPullbackG0_iso_eq_finitePushforward_inv e,
    flatPullbackG0_iso_eq_finitePushforward_inv k]
  have h3 := congrArg (fun f : G0 ((F ⁻¹ᵁ U₀ : W.Opens) : Scheme.{u}) →+ G0 U => f (flatPullbackG0 (F ⁻¹ᵁ U₀).ι x))
    (finitePushforward_comp (F ∣_ U₀) e.inv)
  have h4 := congrArg (fun f : G0 ((F ⁻¹ᵁ U₀ : W.Opens) : Scheme.{u}) →+ G0 U => f (flatPullbackG0 (F ⁻¹ᵁ U₀).ι x))
    (finitePushforward_comp k.inv F')
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply] at h3 h4
  rw [← h3, ← h4]
  exact congrArg (fun f : G0 ((F ⁻¹ᵁ U₀ : W.Opens) : Scheme.{u}) →+ G0 U => f (flatPullbackG0 (F ⁻¹ᵁ U₀).ι x)) (finitePushforward_congr hF.symm)

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.k0ToG0_pullbackK0
statement:
theorem k0ToG0_pullbackK0 {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [Flat f] (y : K0 Y) :
    k0ToG0 X (pullbackK0 f y) = flatPullbackG0 f (k0ToG0 Y y)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (k0ToG0 X).comp (pullbackK0 f) = (flatPullbackG0 f).comp (k0ToG0 Y) := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    intro E
    change k0ToG0 X (pullbackK0 f (k0ClassOf Y E.1 E.2)) =
      flatPullbackG0 f (k0ToG0 Y (k0ClassOf Y E.1 E.2))
    rw [pullbackK0_classOf, k0ToG0_classOf, k0ToG0_classOf, flatPullbackG0_classOf]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h y

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.mono_tMul_of_isIntegral
statement:
theorem mono_tMul_of_isIntegral [IsIntegral X] (ht : t ≠ 0) (E : X.Modules)
    (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) : Mono (tMul t E)
proof:
:=
  mono_tMul_of_unit t (mono_tMul_unit t (isNZDEverywhere_of_isIntegral t ht)) E hE

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.hbc_chart
statement:
theorem hbc_chart
    (hmono : ∀ E : U.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFree U E → Mono (tMul t E))
    (V₀ : W.Modules) (hV₀ : IsCoherentLike W V₀)
    [Mono (tMul (F'.appTop t) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback c').obj V₀))]
    (y : K0 M) (hy : k0ToG0 M y = finitePushforward F (g0ClassOf W V₀ hV₀)) :
    k0ToG0 (zeroScheme t) (pullbackK0 (zeroι t) (pullbackK0 c y)) =
      haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (zeroScheme t)
proof:
:= isLocallyNoetherian_subscheme _
      finitePushforward (zeroMap t F') (g0ClassOf (zeroScheme (F'.appTop t))
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (zeroι (F'.appTop t))).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback c').obj V₀)) (by
          letI : V₀.IsFinitePresentation := hV₀
          letI : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback c').obj V₀).IsFinitePresentation :=
            pullback_isFinitePresentation_global c' V₀
          exact pullback_isFinitePresentation_global (zeroι (F'.appTop t)) _)) := by
  have hV' : IsCoherentLike W' ((Scheme.Modules.pullback c').obj V₀) := by
    letI : V₀.IsFinitePresentation := hV₀
    exact pullback_isFinitePresentation_global c' V₀
  have hy' : k0ToG0 U (pullbackK0 c y) =
      finitePushforward F' (g0ClassOf W' ((Scheme.Modules.pullback c').obj V₀) hV') := by
    rw [k0ToG0_pullbackK0, hy, flatPullbackG0_finitePushforward_openSquare F c c' F' sq,
      flatPullbackG0_classOf]
  exact hbc_principal_canonical t F' hmono ((Scheme.Modules.pullback c').obj V₀) hV' _ hy'

name: GRRBlueprintV4.RG7.hbcE_sigma
statement:
theorem hbcE_sigma (x : K0 J.subscheme) (y : K0 (totalGlobal A J))
    (hy : k0ToG0 (totalGlobal A J) y = finitePushforward (subschemeTotalGlobalι A J)
      (flatPullbackG0 (totalToClosedBase A J) (k0ToG0 J.subscheme x))) :
    k0ToG0 (Ssigma J φk) (pullbackK0 (iotaSigma J φk) y) =
      finitePushforward (zeroSigma J φk) (k0ToG0 J.subscheme x)
proof:
:= by

  haveI := (ARRKG2A.oeGate A φk J).qc
  haveI := (ARRKG2A.oeGate A φk J).fp
  exact KSpecialization.CIIL3B.hbcE_pencil A J k φk (ARRKG2A.oeGate A φk J).σ
    (ARRKG2A.oeGate A φk J).hL (ARRKG2A.oeGate A φk J).hreg (ARRKG2A.oeGate A φk J).hid
    (bijective_total J hA hAreg hZ) x y hy

:=

statement:
theorem liftK'_spec (x : K0 J.subscheme) :
    k0ToG0 (totalGlobal A J) (liftK' J hA hAreg hZ x) =
      finitePushforward (subschemeTotalGlobalι A J)
        (flatPullbackG0 (totalToClosedBase A J) (k0ToG0 J.subscheme x))

:=

name: GRRBlueprintV4.RG7.hbcE_concrete'
statement:
theorem hbcE_concrete' (x : K0 J.subscheme) :
    k0ToG0 (component A J)
        (pullbackK0 (componentToTotal A J) (liftK' J hA hAreg hZ x)) =
      finitePushforward (zeroE J φk) (k0ToG0 J.subscheme x)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := z_noeth J
  have hbc : k0ToG0 (Ssigma J φk) (pullbackK0 (iotaSigma J φk) (liftK' J hA hAreg hZ x)) =
      finitePushforward (zeroSigma J φk) (k0ToG0 J.subscheme x) :=
    hbcE_sigma J hA hAreg hZ φk x (liftK' J hA hAreg hZ x) (liftK'_spec J hA hAreg hZ x)
  set ε := pullbackK0 (componentToTotal A J) (liftK' J hA hAreg hZ x) with hε
  have h1 : pullbackK0 (iotaSigma J φk) (liftK' J hA hAreg hZ x) =
      pullbackK0 (psiSigma J φk) ε := by
    rw [hε, pullbackK0_comp_apply, psiSigma_fac]
  have h2 : k0ToG0 (Ssigma J φk) (pullbackK0 (psiSigma J φk) ε) =
      finitePushforward (inv (psiSigma J φk)) (k0ToG0 (component A J) ε) := by
    rw [ARRG45C.k0ToG0_pullbackK0]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun
      (ARRG45C.flatPullbackG0_iso_eq_finitePushforward_inv (asIso (psiSigma J φk))) _
  rw [h1, h2] at hbc
  have h3 := congrArg (finitePushforward (psiSigma J φk)) hbc
  rw [finitePushforward_inv_cancel] at h3
  rw [h3]
  unfold zeroE
  rw [ARRG45C.finitePushforward_comp]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.mem_coordinateLaurentNonnegativeVertices
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_coordinateLaurentNonnegativeVertices
    (e : CoordinateLaurentExponent n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    i ∈ coordinateLaurentNonnegativeVertices n e ↔ 0 ≤ e i
proof:
:= by
  simp [coordinateLaurentNonnegativeVertices]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentContractionVertex_nonnegative
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentContractionVertex_nonnegative
    (e : CoordinateLaurentExponent n)
    (h : (coordinateLaurentNonnegativeVertices n e).Nonempty) :
    0 ≤ e (coordinateLaurentContractionVertex n e h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_coordinateLaurentNonnegativeVertices]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.CoordinateLaurentExponent.allowedOn_cons_iff
statement:
theorem CoordinateLaurentExponent.allowedOn_cons_iff
    (e : CoordinateLaurentExponent n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (hi : 0 ≤ e i)
    (p : ℕ) (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    e.AllowedOn n (Fin.cons i a) ↔ e.AllowedOn n a
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h j hj
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := h j hj
    rcases t with ⟨t, htlt⟩
    cases t with
    | zero =>
        change i = j at ht
        subst j
        omega
    | succ t =>
        let q : Fin (p + 1) := ⟨t, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ htlt⟩
        change a q = j at ht
        exact ⟨q, ht⟩
  · intro h j hj
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := h j hj
    exact ⟨Fin.succ t, by simpa using ht⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentHigherTermCoefficient_coface
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateLaurentHigherTermCoefficient_coface (d : ℤ)

    (x : coordinateLaurentHigherTerm k n d p)
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (coordinateLaurentHigherTermCoefficient k n d e (p + 1)
        (coordinateLaurentHigherCoface k n d p r x)).1 a =
      (coordinateLaurentHigherTermCoefficient k n d e p x).1
        (a ∘ r.succAbove)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.prepend_delete_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prepend_delete_zero (p : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    Fin.cons i a ∘ (0 : Fin (p + 2)).succAbove = a
proof:
:= by
  funext t
  simp [Function.comp_apply]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.prepend_delete_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prepend_delete_succ (p : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) (r : Fin (p + 1)) :
    Fin.cons i a ∘ (Fin.succ r).succAbove =
      Fin.cons i (a ∘ r.succAbove)
proof:
:= by
  funext t
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun q ↦ ?_) t <;> simp [Function.comp_apply]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.alternating_prepend_identity
statement:
theorem alternating_prepend_identity (p : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (x : (Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) → k)
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (∑ r : Fin (p + 2), (-1 : k) ^ r.val *
        x (Fin.cons i (a ∘ r.succAbove))) +
      (∑ s : Fin (p + 3), (-1 : k) ^ s.val *
        x (Fin.cons i a ∘ s.succAbove)) = x a
proof:
:= by
  let A := ∑ r : Fin (p + 2), (-1 : k) ^ r.val *
    x (Fin.cons i (a ∘ r.succAbove))
  change A + (∑ s : Fin (p + 3), (-1 : k) ^ s.val *
    x (Fin.cons i a ∘ s.succAbove)) = x a
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  rw [prepend_delete_zero]
  simp only [Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, one_mul]
  have htail :
      (∑ r : Fin (p + 2), (-1 : k) ^ (Fin.succ r).val *
        x (Fin.cons i a ∘ (Fin.succ r).succAbove)) = -A := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro r _
    rw [prepend_delete_succ]
    simp only [Fin.val_succ, pow_succ]
    ring
  rw [htail]
  abel

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentCoefficientDifferential_contraction
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentCoefficientDifferential_contraction
    (e : CoordinateLaurentExponent n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (hi : 0 ≤ e i)
    (p : ℕ) (x : coordinateLaurentCoefficientCochain k n e (p + 1)) :
    coordinateLaurentCoefficientDifferential k n e p
          (coordinateLaurentCoefficientContraction k n e i hi p x) +
        coordinateLaurentCoefficientContraction k n e i hi (p + 1)
          (coordinateLaurentCoefficientDifferential k n e (p + 1) x) =
      x
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext a
  change
    (∑ r : Fin (p + 2), (-1 : k) ^ r.val *
        x.1 (Fin.cons i (a ∘ r.succAbove))) +
      (∑ s : Fin (p + 3), (-1 : k) ^ s.val *
        x.1 (Fin.cons i a ∘ s.succAbove)) = x.1 a
  exact alternating_prepend_identity k n p i x.1 a

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentCoefficientMinimalContraction_identity
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentCoefficientMinimalContraction_identity
    (e : CoordinateLaurentExponent n)
    (h : (coordinateLaurentNonnegativeVertices n e).Nonempty)
    (p : ℕ) (x : coordinateLaurentCoefficientCochain k n e (p + 1)) :
    coordinateLaurentCoefficientDifferential k n e p
          (coordinateLaurentCoefficientMinimalContraction k n e h p x) +
        coordinateLaurentCoefficientMinimalContraction k n e h (p + 1)
          (coordinateLaurentCoefficientDifferential k n e (p + 1) x) =
      x
proof:
:=
  coordinateLaurentCoefficientDifferential_contraction k n e
    (coordinateLaurentContractionVertex n e h)
    (coordinateLaurentContractionVertex_nonnegative n e h) p x

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.ι_mem_map_irrelevant_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap
statement:
theorem ι_mem_map_irrelevant_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    (φ : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hspan : Submodule.span S (Set.range φ) = ⊤) (n : N) :
    SymmetricAlgebra.ι S N n ∈
      ((HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (symGrading R M)).map
        (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ)).toIdeal
proof:
:= by
  have hn : n ∈ Submodule.span S (Set.range φ) := by
    rw [hspan]
    exact Submodule.mem_top
  induction hn using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem n hn =>
      obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hn
      have hmdegree :
          SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M m ∈ symGrading R M 1 := by
        change SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M m ∈
          LinearMap.range
              (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M :
                M →ₗ[R] SymmetricAlgebra R M) ^ 1
        rw [pow_one]
        exact LinearMap.mem_range_self _ m
      have hmirrelevant :
          SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M m ∈
            HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (symGrading R M) :=
        HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem
          (symGrading R M) Nat.zero_lt_one hmdegree
      have hmap := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem
        (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap
          (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N) φ) hmirrelevant
      change SymmetricAlgebra.ι S N (φ m) ∈
        (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (symGrading R M)).toIdeal.map
          (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap
            (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N) φ)
      simpa only [gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap_apply,
        symmetricAlgebraMap_ι] using hmap
  | zero =>
      simpa only [map_zero] using
        ((HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (symGrading R M)).map
          (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ)).toIdeal.zero_mem
  | add x y hx hy ihx ihy =>
      simpa only [map_add] using
        ((HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (symGrading R M)).map
          (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ)).toIdeal.add_mem ihx ihy
  | smul s x hx ihx =>
      have hmul :=
        ((HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (symGrading R M)).map
          (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap
            (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N) φ)).toIdeal.mul_mem_left
            (algebraMap S (SymmetricAlgebra S N) s) ihx
      rw [map_smul]
      change algebraMap S (SymmetricAlgebra S N) s *
        SymmetricAlgebra.ι S N x ∈
          ((HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (symGrading R M)).map
            (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap
              (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N) φ)).toIdeal
      exact hmul

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.irrelevant_le_map_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap
statement:
theorem irrelevant_le_map_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    (φ : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hspan : Submodule.span S (Set.range φ) = ⊤) :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (symGrading S N) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (symGrading R M)).map
        (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ)
proof:
:= by
  refine (HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_irrelevant_le (symGrading S N)).2 ?_
  intro d hd q hq
  change q ∈
    LinearMap.range
        (SymmetricAlgebra.ι S N :
          N →ₗ[S] SymmetricAlgebra S N) ^ d at hq
  let J :=
    ((HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (symGrading R M)).map
      (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap
        (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N) φ)).toIdeal
  refine Submodule.pow_induction_on_left'
    (M := LinearMap.range
      (SymmetricAlgebra.ι S N :
        N →ₗ[S] SymmetricAlgebra S N))
    (C := fun e y _ ↦ 0 < e → y ∈ J)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ hq hd
  · intro s hs
    omega
  · intro x y e hx hy hx' hy' he
    exact J.add_mem (hx' he) (hy' he)
  · intro y hy e z hz hz' he
    by_cases he0 : e = 0
    · subst e
      rw [pow_zero] at hz
      obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_one.mp hz
      obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hy
      have hι :
          SymmetricAlgebra.ι S N n ∈ J :=
        ι_mem_map_irrelevant_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ hspan n
      exact J.mul_mem_right (algebraMap S (SymmetricAlgebra S N) s) hι
    · exact J.mul_mem_left y (hz' (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero he0))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.degreeZeroMap_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap_comp_degreeZeroAlgEquiv_symm
statement:
theorem degreeZeroMap_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap_comp_degreeZeroAlgEquiv_symm
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    (φ : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.degreeZeroMap
        (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ)).comp
        (degreeZeroAlgEquiv (R := R) (M := M)).symm.toRingHom =
      (degreeZeroAlgEquiv (R := S) (M := N)).symm.toRingHom.comp
        (algebraMap R S)
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro r
  apply (degreeZeroAlgEquiv (R := S) (M := N)).injective
  change
    degreeZeroAlgEquiv
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.degreeZeroMap
          (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ)
          ((degreeZeroAlgEquiv (R := R) (M := M)).symm r)) =
      degreeZeroAlgEquiv
        ((degreeZeroAlgEquiv (R := S) (M := N)).symm
          (algebraMap R S r))
  rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [show
      (degreeZeroAlgEquiv (R := R) (M := M)).symm r =
        algebraMap R (symGrading R M 0) r by
      exact (degreeZeroAlgEquiv (R := R) (M := M)).symm.commutes r]
  have hmap :
      AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.degreeZeroMap
          (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ)
          (algebraMap R (symGrading R M 0) r) =
        algebraMap S (symGrading S N 0) (algebraMap R S r) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact symmetricAlgebraMap_algebraMap φ r
  rw [hmap]
  exact (degreeZeroAlgEquiv (R := S) (M := N)).commutes
    (algebraMap R S r)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.symmetricProjMap_toSpec
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem symmetricProjMap_toSpec
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    (φ : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hspan : Submodule.span S (Set.range φ) = ⊤) :
    symmetricProjMap φ hspan ≫
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.toSpecZero (symGrading R M) ≫
          Spec.map
            (degreeZeroAlgEquiv
              (R := R) (M := M)).symm.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.hom) =
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.toSpecZero (symGrading S N) ≫
          Spec.map
            (degreeZeroAlgEquiv
              (R := S) (M := N)).symm.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.hom) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))
proof:
:= by
  unfold symmetricProjMap
  rw [← Category.assoc, AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map_toSpecZero]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  apply congrArg (fun k ↦
    AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.toSpecZero (symGrading S N) ≫ k)
  rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
  exact
    degreeZeroMap_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap_comp_degreeZeroAlgEquiv_symm φ

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.semilinearSymmetricProjMap_toSpec
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem semilinearSymmetricProjMap_toSpec
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    (f : R →+* S) (φ : M →ₛₗ[f] N)
    (hspan : Submodule.span S (Set.range φ) = ⊤) :
    semilinearSymmetricProjMap f φ hspan ≫
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.toSpecZero (symGrading R M) ≫
          Spec.map
            (degreeZeroAlgEquiv
              (R := R) (M := M)).symm.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.hom) =
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.toSpecZero (symGrading S N) ≫
          Spec.map
            (degreeZeroAlgEquiv
              (R := S) (M := N)).symm.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.hom) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra R S := f.toAlgebra
  letI : Module R N := Module.compHom N f
  letI : IsScalarTower R S N :=
    ⟨fun r s n ↦ by
      change (f r * s) • n = f r • s • n
      rw [mul_smul]⟩
  change symmetricProjMap
      (semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f φ) hspan ≫ _ = _
  exact symmetricProjMap_toSpec
    (semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f φ) hspan

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.restrictMap_isIso_of_le
statement:
theorem restrictMap_isIso_of_le {X : Scheme.{u}} {P Q : X.Modules}
    (f : P ⟶ Q) {U V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map f)] :
    IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).map f)
proof:
:= by
  let e := restrictFunctorThroughOpenIso hVU
  let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι ⋙
    Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (X.homOfLE hVU)
  letI : IsIso (H.map f) := by
    change IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (X.homOfLE hVU)).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map f))
    infer_instance
  have h :
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).map f =
        e.hom.app P ≫
          H.map f ≫
          e.inv.app Q := by
    calc
      _ = (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).map f ≫
          e.hom.app Q ≫ e.inv.app Q := by simp
      _ = ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).map f ≫
          e.hom.app Q) ≫ e.inv.app Q := rfl
      _ = (e.hom.app P ≫ H.map f) ≫ e.inv.app Q :=
        congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ e.inv.app Q) (e.hom.naturality f)
      _ = e.hom.app P ≫ H.map f ≫ e.inv.app Q := rfl
  rw [h]
  infer_instance

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.overMap_isIso_of_restrictMap
statement:
theorem overMap_isIso_of_restrictMap {X : Scheme.{u}} {P Q : X.Modules}
    (f : P ⟶ Q) (U : X.Opens)
    [IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map f)] :
    IsIso (f.over U)
proof:
:= by
  let E := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U
  let e := Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U
  have h :
      E.functor.map (f.over U) =
        (e.app P).hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map f ≫
          (e.app Q).inv := by
    dsimp only [E]
    change
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U ⋙
        (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor).map f =
        (e.app P).hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map f ≫
          (e.app Q).inv
    apply (cancel_mono (e.app Q).hom).1
    calc
      _ = (e.app P).hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map f :=
        e.hom.naturality f
      _ = ((e.app P).hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map f) ≫ 𝟙 _ :=
        (Category.comp_id _).symm
      _ = ((e.app P).hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map f) ≫
            ((e.app Q).inv ≫ (e.app Q).hom) := by
        exact congrArg
          (fun q ↦ ((e.app P).hom ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map f) ≫ q)
          (e.app Q).inv_hom_id.symm
      _ = _ := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
  haveI : IsIso (E.functor.map (f.over U)) := by
    rw [h]
    change IsIso ((e.app P).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map f ≫ (e.app Q).inv)
    infer_instance
  exact isIso_of_reflects_iso (f.over U) E.functor

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.restrictHomOverLE_inv_over
statement:
theorem restrictHomOverLE_inv_over {X : Scheme.{u}} {P Q : X.Modules}
    (f : P ⟶ Q) {U V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U)
    [IsIso (f.over U)] [IsIso (f.over V)] :
    Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X hVU (inv (f.over U)) =
      inv (f.over V)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsIso.eq_inv_of_hom_inv_id
  calc
    f.over V ≫
        Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X hVU (inv (f.over U)) =
      Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X hVU (f.over U) ≫
        Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X hVU (inv (f.over U)) := by
          rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_over]
    _ = Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X hVU
        (f.over U ≫ inv (f.over U)) :=
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_comp X hVU _ _).symm
    _ = Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X hVU (𝟙 _) := by
      rw [IsIso.hom_inv_id]
    _ = 𝟙 _ := by rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit_neg
statement:
theorem linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit_neg
    (d : ℤ) (x y : M) :

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearOverlapTransitionIso_hom_comp_neg
statement:
theorem linearOverlapTransitionIso_hom_comp_neg
    (d : ℤ) (x y : M) :
    (linearOverlapTransitionIso R M d x y).hom ≫
        (linearOverlapTransitionIso R M (-d) x y).hom =
      𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro U
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro s
  dsimp only [linearOverlapTransitionIso]
  change
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso
          (Units.map (linearOverlapOpen R M x y).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom
            (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit R M (-d) x y))).hom U.unop
        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso
            (Units.map (linearOverlapOpen R M x y).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom
              (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit R M d x y))).hom U.unop s) =
      s
  erw [SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso_hom_app_apply,
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso_hom_app_apply]
  rw [linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit_neg]
  rw [show
    Units.map (linearOverlapOpen R M x y).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom
        (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit R M d x y)⁻¹ =
      (Units.map (linearOverlapOpen R M x y).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom
        (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit R M d x y))⁻¹ by
      exact map_inv _ _]
  let a : Γ((linearOverlapOpen R M x y).toScheme, ⊤)ˣ :=
    Units.map (linearOverlapOpen R M x y).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom
      (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit R M d x y)
  have ha : SchemeProjectiveSpace.restrictTopUnit a⁻¹ U.unop =
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.restrictTopUnit a U.unop)⁻¹ :=
    map_inv _ _
  have hval := congrArg Units.val ha
  rw [show
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.restrictTopUnit
      ((Units.map (linearOverlapOpen R M x y).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom
        (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit R M d x y))⁻¹) U.unop).1 =
      ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.restrictTopUnit
        (Units.map (linearOverlapOpen R M x y).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom
          (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit R M d x y)) U.unop)⁻¹).1 by
      simpa only [a] using hval]
  simp

        pushedLinearOverlapTransition R M (-d) x y =

proof:

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedLinearOverlapTransition_over_comp_neg
statement:
theorem pushedLinearOverlapTransition_over_comp_neg
    (d : ℤ) (x y : M) (V : (space R M).Opens) :
    (pushedLinearOverlapTransition R M d x y).over V ≫
        (pushedLinearOverlapTransition R M (-d) x y).over V =
      𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  let G := SheafOfModules.overFunctor (space R M).ringCatSheaf V
  calc
    _ = G.map (pushedLinearOverlapTransition R M d x y ≫
        pushedLinearOverlapTransition R M (-d) x y) :=
      (G.map_comp _ _).symm
    _ = G.map (𝟙 _) :=
      congrArg G.map
        (pushedLinearOverlapTransition_comp_neg R M d x y)
    _ = 𝟙 _ := G.map_id _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitRestriction_over_isIso_of_le
statement:
theorem pushedUnitRestriction_over_isIso_of_le
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {U W V : X.Opens}
    (hWU : W ≤ U) (hVW : V ≤ W) :
    IsIso ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction hWU).over V)
proof:
:= by
  let f := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction hWU
  letI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).map f) := by
    exact restrictedPushedUnitRestriction_isIso W U W
      (inf_eq_left.mpr hWU).symm
  letI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).map f) :=
    restrictMap_isIso_of_le f hVW
  exact overMap_isIso_of_restrictMap f V

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitRestriction_comp
statement:
theorem pushedUnitRestriction_comp
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {U V W : X.Opens}
    (hVU : V ≤ U) (hWV : W ≤ V) :
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction hVU ≫
        SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction hWV =
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction (hWV.trans hVU)
proof:
:= by
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro A
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro s
  change
    X.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestrictionOpen hWV A.unop)).op
        (X.presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestrictionOpen hVU A.unop)).op s) =
      X.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestrictionOpen
          (hWV.trans hVU) A.unop)).op s
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  congr 2

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitRestriction_over_comp
statement:
theorem pushedUnitRestriction_over_comp
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {U V W A : X.Opens}
    (hVU : V ≤ U) (hWV : W ≤ V) :
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction hVU).over A ≫
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction hWV).over A =
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction (hWV.trans hVU)).over A
proof:
:= by
  let G := SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf A
  calc
    _ = G.map (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction hVU ≫
        SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction hWV) :=
      (G.map_comp _ _).symm
    _ = G.map (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction (hWV.trans hVU)) :=
      congrArg G.map (pushedUnitRestriction_comp hVU hWV)
    _ = _ := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitRestrictionOverIso_trans
statement:
theorem pushedUnitRestrictionOverIso_trans
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {U W V : X.Opens}
    (hWU : W ≤ U) (hVW : V ≤ W) :
    pushedUnitRestrictionOverIso hWU hVW ≪≫
        pushedUnitToOpenOverIso hVW =
      pushedUnitToOpenOverIso (hVW.trans hWU)
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  dsimp only [pushedUnitRestrictionOverIso,
    pushedUnitToOpenOverIso]
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, asIso_hom]
  exact pushedUnitRestriction_over_comp hWU hVW

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.topIso_homOfLE
statement:
theorem topIso_homOfLE
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {U V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U) :
    U.topIso.inv ≫ (X.homOfLE hVU).appTop =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op ≫ V.topIso.inv
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono V.topIso.hom).mp
  have hn := X.restrictFunctorΓ.hom.naturality (homOfLE hVU).op
  change (X.homOfLE hVU).appTop ≫ V.topIso.hom =
    U.topIso.hom ≫ X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op at hn
  slice_lhs 2 3 => rw [hn]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.restrictOpenUnit_map_topIso
statement:
theorem restrictOpenUnit_map_topIso
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {U V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U) (a : Γ(X, U)ˣ) :
    restrictOpenUnit hVU (Units.map U.topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom a) =
      Units.map V.topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom
        (Units.map (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op).hom.toMonoidHom a)
proof:
:= by
  apply Units.ext
  simp only [restrictOpenUnit, Units.coe_map]
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (topIso_homOfLE hVU) a.1

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.restrictOpenUnit_mul
statement:
theorem restrictOpenUnit_mul
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {U V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (a b : Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤)ˣ) :
    restrictOpenUnit hVU (a * b) =
      restrictOpenUnit hVU a * restrictOpenUnit hVU b
proof:
:=
  map_mul _ _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.restrictOpenUnit_trans
statement:
theorem restrictOpenUnit_trans
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {U V W : X.Opens}
    (hVU : V ≤ U) (hWV : W ≤ V) (a : Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤)ˣ) :
    restrictOpenUnit hWV (restrictOpenUnit hVU a) =
      restrictOpenUnit (hWV.trans hVU) a
proof:
:= by
  apply Units.ext
  simp only [restrictOpenUnit, Units.coe_map]
  change (X.homOfLE hWV).appTop ((X.homOfLE hVU).appTop a.1) =
    (X.homOfLE (hWV.trans hVU)).appTop a.1
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, X.homOfLE_homOfLE]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitMul_naturality
statement:
theorem pushedUnitMul_naturality {X : Scheme.{u}} {U V : X.Opens}
    (hVU : V ≤ U) (a : Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤)ˣ) :
    pushedUnitMul U a ≫
        SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction hVU =
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction hVU ≫
        pushedUnitMul V (restrictOpenUnit hVU a)
proof:
:= by
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro W
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro s
  change
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction hVU) W.unop
        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).map
            (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso a).hom) W.unop s) =
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward V.ι).map
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso
            (restrictOpenUnit hVU a)).hom) W.unop
        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction hVU) W.unop s)
  rw [SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction_app_apply,
    Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app,
    Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app,
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction_app_apply]
  erw [SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso_hom_app_apply,
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso_hom_app_apply]
  erw [map_mul]
  congr 1
  simp only [SchemeProjectiveSpace.restrictTopUnit, restrictOpenUnit,
    Units.coe_map, Scheme.Opens.toScheme_presheaf_map,
    Scheme.homOfLE_appTop]
  change X.presheaf.map _ (X.presheaf.map _ a.1) =
    X.presheaf.map _ (X.presheaf.map _ a.1)
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  congr 2

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitMul_over_naturality
statement:
theorem pushedUnitMul_over_naturality
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {U V : X.Opens}
    (hVU : V ≤ U) (a : Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤)ˣ) :
    (pushedUnitMul U a).over V ≫
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction hVU).over V =
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction hVU).over V ≫
        (pushedUnitMul V (restrictOpenUnit hVU a)).over V
proof:
:= by
  let G := SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf V
  calc
    _ = G.map (pushedUnitMul U a ≫
        SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction hVU) :=
      (G.map_comp _ _).symm
    _ = G.map (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction hVU ≫
        pushedUnitMul V (restrictOpenUnit hVU a)) :=
      congrArg G.map (pushedUnitMul_naturality hVU a)
    _ = _ := G.map_comp _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitMul_over_isIso
statement:
theorem pushedUnitMul_over_isIso
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.Opens) (a : Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤)ˣ)
    (V : X.Opens) :
    IsIso ((pushedUnitMul U a).over V)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [pushedUnitMul]
  infer_instance

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.unitMulSheafIso_hom_comp
statement:
theorem unitMulSheafIso_hom_comp
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (a b : Γ(X, ⊤)ˣ) :
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso a).hom ≫
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso b).hom =
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso (a * b)).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro U
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro s
  change
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso b).hom U.unop
        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso a).hom U.unop s) =
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso (a * b)).hom U.unop s
  erw [SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso_hom_app_apply,
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso_hom_app_apply,
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso_hom_app_apply]
  dsimp only [SchemeProjectiveSpace.restrictTopUnit]
  rw [map_mul, Units.val_mul]
  ring_nf

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.pushedUnitMul_comp
statement:
theorem pushedUnitMul_comp
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.Opens) (a b : Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤)ˣ) :
    pushedUnitMul U a ≫ pushedUnitMul U b =
      pushedUnitMul U (a * b)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [pushedUnitMul]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  congr 1
  exact unitMulSheafIso_hom_comp a b

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.restrict_linearTransitionTopUnit
statement:
theorem restrict_linearTransitionTopUnit
    (d : ℤ) (x y : M) (V : (space R M).Opens)
    (hV : V ≤ linearOverlapOpen R M x y) :
    restrictOpenUnit hV (linearTransitionTopUnit R M d x y) =
      linearTransitionUnitOnOpen R M d x y V hV
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [linearTransitionTopUnit,
      linearTransitionUnitOnOpen] using
    (restrictOpenUnit_map_topIso hV
      (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit R M d x y))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearTransitionUnitOnOpen_restrict
statement:
theorem linearTransitionUnitOnOpen_restrict
    (d : ℤ) (x y : M) {V W : (space R M).Opens}
    (hVW : V ≤ W) (hW : W ≤ linearOverlapOpen R M x y) :
    restrictOpenUnit hVW
        (linearTransitionUnitOnOpen R M d x y W hW) =
      linearTransitionUnitOnOpen R M d x y V (hVW.trans hW)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← restrict_linearTransitionTopUnit R M d x y W hW,
    restrictOpenUnit_trans,
    restrict_linearTransitionTopUnit]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearLocalFrameTransitionSection_trans
statement:
theorem linearLocalFrameTransitionSection_trans
    (d : ℤ) (x y z : M) :
    linearLocalFrameTransitionSectionXY R M d x y z *
        linearLocalFrameTransitionSectionYZ R M d x y z =
      linearLocalFrameTransitionSectionXZ R M d x y z
proof:
:= by
  rw [linearLocalFrameTransitionSectionXY_eq,
    linearLocalFrameTransitionSectionYZ_eq,
    linearLocalFrameTransitionSectionXZ_eq]
  let F := (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (symGrading R M)
    (linearTripleEquation R M x y z)
    (linearTripleEquation_mem_degree_three R M x y z)
      (by omega)).hom.hom.toMonoidHom
  have h := congrArg (Units.map F)
    (linearTwistTransitionUnit_cocycle R M d x y z)
  simpa only [map_mul] using h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearTransitionUnitOnTriple_trans
statement:
theorem linearTransitionUnitOnTriple_trans
    (d : ℤ) (x y z : M) :
    linearTransitionUnitOnOpen R M d x y
          (linearTripleOpen R M x y z)
          (linearTripleOpen_le_overlapXY R M x y z) *
        linearTransitionUnitOnOpen R M d y z
          (linearTripleOpen R M x y z)
          (linearTripleOpen_le_overlapYZ R M x y z) =
      linearTransitionUnitOnOpen R M d x z
        (linearTripleOpen R M x y z)
        (linearTripleOpen_le_overlapXZ R M x y z)
proof:
:= by
  change
    Units.map (linearTripleOpen R M x y z).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom
        (linearLocalFrameTransitionSectionXY R M d x y z) *
      Units.map (linearTripleOpen R M x y z).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom
        (linearLocalFrameTransitionSectionYZ R M d x y z) =
    Units.map (linearTripleOpen R M x y z).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom
      (linearLocalFrameTransitionSectionXZ R M d x y z)
  simpa only [map_mul] using congrArg
    (Units.map (linearTripleOpen R M x y z).topIso.inv.hom.toMonoidHom)
    (linearLocalFrameTransitionSection_trans R M d x y z)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearTransitionUnitOnOpen_trans
statement:
theorem linearTransitionUnitOnOpen_trans
    (d : ℤ) (x y z : M) (V : (space R M).Opens)
    (hVx : V ≤ linearOpen R M x) (hVy : V ≤ linearOpen R M y)
    (hVz : V ≤ linearOpen R M z) :
    linearTransitionUnitOnOpen R M d x y V (by
          rw [linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
          exact le_inf hVx hVy) *
        linearTransitionUnitOnOpen R M d y z V (by
          rw [linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
          exact le_inf hVy hVz) =
      linearTransitionUnitOnOpen R M d x z V (by
        rw [linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
        exact le_inf hVx hVz)
proof:
:= by
  have hVT : V ≤ linearTripleOpen R M x y z := by
    rw [linearTripleOpen_eq_inf]
    exact le_inf (le_inf hVx hVy) hVz
  have h := congrArg (restrictOpenUnit hVT)
    (linearTransitionUnitOnTriple_trans R M d x y z)
  rw [restrictOpenUnit_mul] at h
  simpa only [linearTransitionUnitOnOpen_restrict] using h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearTransitionOverIso_hom
statement:
theorem linearTransitionOverIso_hom
    (d : ℤ) (x y : M) (V : (space R M).Opens)
    (hVx : V ≤ linearOpen R M x) (hVy : V ≤ linearOpen R M y) :
    (linearTransitionOverIso R M d x y V hVx hVy).hom =
      (pushedUnitMulOverIso V
        (linearTransitionUnitOnOpen R M d x y V (by
          rw [linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
          exact le_inf hVx hVy)) V).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hVO : V ≤ linearOverlapOpen R M x y := by
    rw [linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
    exact le_inf hVx hVy
  let a := linearTransitionTopUnit R M d x y
  let r := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction hVO
  let t := pushedUnitMul (linearOverlapOpen R M x y) a
  let l := pushedUnitMul V (restrictOpenUnit hVO a)
  letI : IsIso (r.over V) :=
    pushedUnitRestriction_over_isIso_of_le hVO le_rfl
  letI : IsIso (t.over V) :=
    pushedUnitMul_over_isIso _ _ _
  letI : IsIso (l.over V) :=
    pushedUnitMul_over_isIso _ _ _
  have hn : t.over V ≫ r.over V = r.over V ≫ l.over V :=
    pushedUnitMul_over_naturality hVO a
  rw [← restrict_linearTransitionTopUnit R M d x y V hVO]
  dsimp only [linearTransitionOverIso, pushedUnitToOpenOverIso,
    pushedLinearOverlapTransition, linearOverlapTransitionIso,
    linearTransitionTopUnit, pushedUnitMulOverIso] at *
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, asIso_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom]
  change (asIso (r.over V)).inv ≫ t.over V ≫ r.over V = l.over V
  rw [hn]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearTransitionOverIso_trans
statement:
theorem linearTransitionOverIso_trans
    (d : ℤ) (x y z : M) (V : (space R M).Opens)
    (hVx : V ≤ linearOpen R M x) (hVy : V ≤ linearOpen R M y)
    (hVz : V ≤ linearOpen R M z) :
    linearTransitionOverIso R M d x y V hVx hVy ≪≫
        linearTransitionOverIso R M d y z V hVy hVz =
      linearTransitionOverIso R M d x z V hVx hVz
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  rw [Iso.trans_hom,
    linearTransitionOverIso_hom R M d x y V hVx hVy,
    linearTransitionOverIso_hom R M d y z V hVy hVz,
    linearTransitionOverIso_hom R M d x z V hVx hVz]
  let G := SheafOfModules.overFunctor (space R M).ringCatSheaf V
  let a := linearTransitionUnitOnOpen R M d x y V (by
    rw [linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
    exact le_inf hVx hVy)
  let b := linearTransitionUnitOnOpen R M d y z V (by
    rw [linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
    exact le_inf hVy hVz)
  let c := linearTransitionUnitOnOpen R M d x z V (by
    rw [linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
    exact le_inf hVx hVz)
  change G.map (pushedUnitMul V a) ≫
      G.map (pushedUnitMul V b) =
    G.map (pushedUnitMul V c)
  rw [← G.map_comp]
  apply congrArg G.map
  calc
    pushedUnitMul V a ≫ pushedUnitMul V b =
        pushedUnitMul V (a * b) :=
      pushedUnitMul_comp V a b
    _ = pushedUnitMul V c := congrArg (pushedUnitMul V)
      (linearTransitionUnitOnOpen_trans
        R M d x y z V hVx hVy hVz)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearFrameChangeOverIso_normalize
statement:
theorem linearFrameChangeOverIso_normalize
    (d : ℤ) (x y : M) (V : (space R M).Opens)
    (hVx : V ≤ linearOpen R M x) (hVy : V ≤ linearOpen R M y) :
    linearFrameChangeOverIso R M d x y V hVx hVy =
      pushedUnitToOpenOverIso hVx ≪≫
        linearTransitionOverIso R M d x y V hVx hVy ≪≫
        (pushedUnitToOpenOverIso hVy).symm
proof:
:= by
  let hVO : V ≤ linearOverlapOpen R M x y := by
    rw [linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
    exact le_inf hVx hVy
  let hOx : linearOverlapOpen R M x y ≤ linearOpen R M x :=
    (linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M x y).le.trans inf_le_left
  let hOy : linearOverlapOpen R M x y ≤ linearOpen R M y :=
    (linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M x y).le.trans inf_le_right
  let ax := pushedUnitRestrictionOverIso hOx hVO
  let ay := pushedUnitRestrictionOverIso hOy hVO
  let q := pushedUnitToOpenOverIso hVO
  let t := by
    letI : IsIso ((pushedLinearOverlapTransition R M d x y).over V) := by
      letI : IsIso (pushedLinearOverlapTransition R M d x y) :=
        pushedLinearOverlapTransition_isIso R M d x y
      change IsIso ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor
        (space R M).ringCatSheaf V).map
          (pushedLinearOverlapTransition R M d x y))
      exact @Functor.map_isIso _ _ _ _ _ _
        (SheafOfModules.overFunctor (space R M).ringCatSheaf V)
        (pushedLinearOverlapTransition R M d x y)
        (pushedLinearOverlapTransition_isIso R M d x y)
    exact asIso ((pushedLinearOverlapTransition R M d x y).over V)
  change ax ≪≫ t ≪≫ ay.symm =
    pushedUnitToOpenOverIso hVx ≪≫
      (q.symm ≪≫ t ≪≫ q) ≪≫
      (pushedUnitToOpenOverIso hVy).symm
  rw [← pushedUnitRestrictionOverIso_trans hOx hVO,
    ← pushedUnitRestrictionOverIso_trans hOy hVO]
  dsimp only [ax, ay, q]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearFrameChangeOverIso_trans
statement:
theorem linearFrameChangeOverIso_trans
    (d : ℤ) (x y z : M) (V : (space R M).Opens)
    (hVx : V ≤ linearOpen R M x) (hVy : V ≤ linearOpen R M y)
    (hVz : V ≤ linearOpen R M z) :
    linearFrameChangeOverIso R M d x y V hVx hVy ≪≫
        linearFrameChangeOverIso R M d y z V hVy hVz =
      linearFrameChangeOverIso R M d x z V hVx hVz
proof:
:= by
  rw [linearFrameChangeOverIso_normalize R M d x y V hVx hVy,
    linearFrameChangeOverIso_normalize R M d y z V hVy hVz,
    linearFrameChangeOverIso_normalize R M d x z V hVx hVz]
  apply Iso.ext
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc,
    Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  have h := congrArg Iso.hom
    (linearTransitionOverIso_trans R M d x y z V hVx hVy hVz)
  simpa only [Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc] using congrArg
    (fun q => (pushedUnitToOpenOverIso hVx).hom ≫ q ≫
      (pushedUnitToOpenOverIso hVz).inv) h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.basisChangeOpen_iSup_eq_top
statement:
theorem basisChangeOpen_iSup_eq_top :
    ⨆ ij : ι × κ, basisChangeOpen R M b c ij.1 ij.2 = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm le_top
  intro x hx
  have hb : x ∈ ⨆ i, linearOpen R M (b i) := by
    rw [linearOpen_iSup_eq_top R M b]
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  have hc : x ∈ ⨆ j, linearOpen R M (c j) := by
    rw [linearOpen_iSup_eq_top R M c]
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hb
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hc
  apply Opens.mem_iSup.mpr
  refine ⟨(i, j), ?_⟩
  rw [basisChangeOpen, linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
  exact ⟨hi, hj⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.basisChangeOpen_coversTop
statement:
theorem basisChangeOpen_coversTop :
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology (space R M)).CoversTop
      (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ basisChangeOpen R M b c ij.1 ij.2)
proof:
:=
  (Opens.coversTop_iff
    (T := space R M)
    (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ basisChangeOpen R M b c ij.1 ij.2)).2
      (basisChangeOpen_iSup_eq_top R M b c)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.twistingSheafBasisComponent_compatibility
statement:
theorem twistingSheafBasisComponent_compatibility
    (d : ℤ) (i j : ι) :
    twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b d i ≫
        SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
          ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (b j)).le.trans inf_le_left) =
      twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b d j ≫
        SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
          ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (b j)).le.trans inf_le_right) ≫
        pushedLinearOverlapTransition R M d (b i) (b j)
proof:
:= by
  let overlaps := fun ij : ι × ι ↦
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M)
      (linearOverlapOpen R M (b ij.1) (b ij.2))
  let qij := Pi.π overlaps (i, j)
  calc
    _ = (kernel.ι
            (linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b d) ≫
          linearDescentLeft R M b) ≫ qij := by
        simp only [Category.assoc, twistingSheafBasisComponent,
          linearDescentLeft_π, qij, overlaps]
        rfl
    _ = (kernel.ι
            (linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b d) ≫
          linearDescentRight R M b d) ≫ qij :=
      congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ qij)
        (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex_overlap_compatibility R M b d)
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [Category.assoc, twistingSheafBasisComponent,
        linearDescentRight_π, qij, overlaps]
      rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.twistingSheafBasisComponent_restrict_isIso
statement:
theorem twistingSheafBasisComponent_restrict_isIso (d : ℤ) (i : ι) :
    IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι).map
      (twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b d i))
proof:
:= by
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι
  let q := twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b d i
  let eε :
      G.obj (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M)
          (linearOpen R M (b i))) ≅
        SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules
          (linearOpen R M (b i)).toScheme :=
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso
      (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι).app
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules
          (linearOpen R M (b i)).toScheme)
  let ε := eε.hom
  have hq :
      G.map q ≫ ε = linearLocalFrameProjection R M b d i := rfl
  let e := (twistingSheafOfBasisIndexLinearOpenIso R M b d i).symm ≪≫
    eε.symm
  have he : G.map q = e.hom := by
    calc
      G.map q = (G.map q ≫ eε.hom) ≫ eε.inv := by
        rw [Category.assoc, eε.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
      _ = linearLocalFrameProjection R M b d i ≫ eε.inv := by rw [hq]
      _ = e.hom := by
        dsimp only [e]
        rw [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.symm_hom]
        rfl
  rw [he]
  infer_instance

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.twistingSheafBasisComponent_basisChange_isIso
statement:
theorem twistingSheafBasisComponent_basisChange_isIso
    (d : ℤ) (i : ι) (j : κ) :
    IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
      (basisChangeOpen R M b c i j).ι).map
        (twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b d i))
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
      (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι).map
        (twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b d i)) :=
    twistingSheafBasisComponent_restrict_isIso R M b d i
  exact restrictMap_isIso_of_le
    (twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b d i)
      ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (c j)).le.trans inf_le_left)

    exact inf_comm _ _
  letI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map f) := by
    exact restrictedPushedUnitRestriction_isIso U
