name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso_restrict_hom
statement:
theorem twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso_restrict_hom
    (d : ℤ) (i : ι) (j : κ) {V : (space R M).Opens}
    (hV : V ≤ basisChangeOpen R M b c i j) :
    Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (space R M) hV
        (twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso R M b c d i j).hom =
      (twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso R M b d i
        (hV.trans ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (c j)).le.trans
          inf_le_left))).hom ≫
        (linearFrameChangeOverIso R M (-d) (b i) (c j) V
          (hV.trans ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (c j)).le.trans
            inf_le_left))
          (hV.trans ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (c j)).le.trans
            inf_le_right))).hom ≫
        (twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso R M c d j
          (hV.trans ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (c j)).le.trans
            inf_le_right))).inv
proof:
:= by
  let W := basisChangeOpen R M b c i j
  let qb := twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b d i
  let qc := twistingSheafBasisComponent R M c d j
  let rb := basisChangeLeftRestriction R M b c i j
  let rc := basisChangeRightRestriction R M b c i j
  let t := pushedLinearOverlapTransition R M (-d) (b i) (c j)
  have hWb : W ≤ linearOpen R M (b i) :=
    (linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (c j)).le.trans inf_le_left
  have hWc : W ≤ linearOpen R M (c j) :=
    (linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (c j)).le.trans inf_le_right
  have hVb : V ≤ linearOpen R M (b i) := hV.trans hWb
  have hVc : V ≤ linearOpen R M (c j) := hV.trans hWc
  letI : IsIso (qb.over W) :=
    twistingSheafBasisComponent_over_isIso_of_le R M b d i hWb
  letI : IsIso (qb.over V) :=
    twistingSheafBasisComponent_over_isIso_of_le R M b d i hVb
  letI : IsIso (qc.over W) :=
    twistingSheafBasisComponent_over_isIso_of_le R M c d j hWc
  letI : IsIso (qc.over V) :=
    twistingSheafBasisComponent_over_isIso_of_le R M c d j hVc
  letI : IsIso (rb.over W) :=
    basisChangeLeftRestriction_over_isIso_of_le R M b c i j le_rfl
  letI : IsIso (rb.over V) :=
    basisChangeLeftRestriction_over_isIso_of_le R M b c i j hV
  letI : IsIso (rc.over W) :=
    basisChangeRightRestriction_over_isIso_of_le R M b c i j le_rfl
  letI : IsIso (rc.over V) :=
    basisChangeRightRestriction_over_isIso_of_le R M b c i j hV
  letI : IsIso t :=
    pushedLinearOverlapTransition_isIso R M (-d) (b i) (c j)
  letI : IsIso (t.over W) := by
    change IsIso ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor
      (space R M).ringCatSheaf W).map t)
    exact @Functor.map_isIso _ _ _ _ _ _
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctor (space R M).ringCatSheaf W) t
      (pushedLinearOverlapTransition_isIso R M (-d) (b i) (c j))
  letI : IsIso (t.over V) := by
    change IsIso ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor
      (space R M).ringCatSheaf V).map t)
    exact @Functor.map_isIso _ _ _ _ _ _
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctor (space R M).ringCatSheaf V) t
      (pushedLinearOverlapTransition_isIso R M (-d) (b i) (c j))
  let ircW := inv (rc.over W)
  let ircV := inv (rc.over V)
  let iqcW := inv (qc.over W)
  let iqcV := inv (qc.over V)
  have ht :
      Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (space R M) hV (t.over W) =
        t.over V := by
    dsimp only [W]
    exact Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_over (space R M) hV t
  have hrc :
      Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (space R M) hV ircW = ircV := by
    dsimp only [ircW, ircV]
    exact restrictHomOverLE_inv_over rc hV
  have hqc :
      Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (space R M) hV iqcW = iqcV := by
    dsimp only [iqcW, iqcV]
    exact restrictHomOverLE_inv_over qc hV
  dsimp only [twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso,
    twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso]
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, asIso_hom, asIso_inv]
  rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_comp,
    Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_comp,
    Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_comp,
    Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_comp,
    Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_over,
    Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_over]
  change qb.over V ≫ rb.over V ≫
      Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (space R M) hV (t.over W) ≫
        Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (space R M) hV ircW ≫
          Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (space R M) hV iqcW =
    qb.over V ≫
      (linearFrameChangeOverIso R M (-d) (b i) (c j) V hVb hVc).hom ≫
        iqcV
  erw [ht, hrc, hqc]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.twistingSheafBasisComponent_linearFrameChange
statement:
theorem twistingSheafBasisComponent_linearFrameChange
    (d : ℤ) (i a : ι) (V : (space R M).Opens)
    (hVi : V ≤ linearOpen R M (b i))
    (hVa : V ≤ linearOpen R M (b a)) :
    (twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso R M b d i hVi).hom ≫
        (linearFrameChangeOverIso R M (-d) (b i) (b a) V hVi hVa).hom =
      (twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso R M b d a hVa).hom
proof:
:= by
  let qi := twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b d i
  let qa := twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b d a
  let O := linearOverlapOpen R M (b i) (b a)
  have hVO : V ≤ O := by
    dsimp only [O]
    rw [linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
    exact le_inf hVi hVa
  let ri := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
    ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (b a)).le.trans inf_le_left)
  let ra := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
    ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (b a)).le.trans inf_le_right)
  let td := pushedLinearOverlapTransition R M d (b i) (b a)
  let tn := pushedLinearOverlapTransition R M (-d) (b i) (b a)
  letI : IsIso (qi.over V) :=
    twistingSheafBasisComponent_over_isIso_of_le R M b d i hVi
  letI : IsIso (qa.over V) :=
    twistingSheafBasisComponent_over_isIso_of_le R M b d a hVa
  letI : IsIso (ri.over V) :=
    pushedUnitRestriction_over_isIso_of_le
      ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (b a)).le.trans inf_le_left) hVO
  letI : IsIso (ra.over V) :=
    pushedUnitRestriction_over_isIso_of_le
      ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (b a)).le.trans inf_le_right) hVO
  letI : IsIso td :=
    pushedLinearOverlapTransition_isIso R M d (b i) (b a)
  letI : IsIso tn :=
    pushedLinearOverlapTransition_isIso R M (-d) (b i) (b a)
  letI : IsIso (td.over V) := by
    change IsIso ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor
      (space R M).ringCatSheaf V).map td)
    exact @Functor.map_isIso _ _ _ _ _ _
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctor (space R M).ringCatSheaf V) td
      (pushedLinearOverlapTransition_isIso R M d (b i) (b a))
  letI : IsIso (tn.over V) := by
    change IsIso ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor
      (space R M).ringCatSheaf V).map tn)
    exact @Functor.map_isIso _ _ _ _ _ _
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctor (space R M).ringCatSheaf V) tn
      (pushedLinearOverlapTransition_isIso R M (-d) (b i) (b a))
  let G := SheafOfModules.overFunctor (space R M).ringCatSheaf V
  have hcomp : qi.over V ≫ ri.over V =
      qa.over V ≫ ra.over V ≫ td.over V := by
    calc
      qi.over V ≫ ri.over V = G.map (qi ≫ ri) :=
        (G.map_comp qi ri).symm
      _ = G.map (qa ≫ ra ≫ td) := by
        apply congrArg G.map
        dsimp only [qi, qa, ri, ra, td, O]
        exact twistingSheafBasisComponent_compatibility R M b d i a
      _ = qa.over V ≫ ra.over V ≫ td.over V := by
        rw [G.map_comp, G.map_comp]
  have htrans : td.over V ≫ tn.over V = 𝟙 _ :=
    pushedLinearOverlapTransition_over_comp_neg R M d (b i) (b a) V
  dsimp only [twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso, asIso_hom,
    linearFrameChangeOverIso, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom]
  change qi.over V ≫ ri.over V ≫ tn.over V ≫ inv (ra.over V) =
    qa.over V
  calc
    qi.over V ≫ ri.over V ≫ tn.over V ≫ inv (ra.over V) =
        (qi.over V ≫ ri.over V) ≫ tn.over V ≫ inv (ra.over V) := rfl
    _ = (qa.over V ≫ ra.over V ≫ td.over V) ≫
        tn.over V ≫ inv (ra.over V) :=
      congrArg (fun q => q ≫ tn.over V ≫ inv (ra.over V)) hcomp
    _ = qa.over V := by
      slice_lhs 3 4 => rw [htrans]
      slice_lhs 3 4 => rw [Category.id_comp]
      rw [IsIso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso_restrict_hom_independent
statement:
theorem twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso_restrict_hom_independent
    (d : ℤ) (i : ι) (j : κ) (a : ι) (k : κ)
    {V : (space R M).Opens}
    (hVij : V ≤ basisChangeOpen R M b c i j)
    (hVak : V ≤ basisChangeOpen R M b c a k) :
    Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (space R M) hVij
        (twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso R M b c d i j).hom =
      Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (space R M) hVak
        (twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso R M b c d a k).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hVbi : V ≤ linearOpen R M (b i) :=
    hVij.trans ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (c j)).le.trans inf_le_left)
  have hVcj : V ≤ linearOpen R M (c j) :=
    hVij.trans ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (c j)).le.trans inf_le_right)
  have hVba : V ≤ linearOpen R M (b a) :=
    hVak.trans ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b a) (c k)).le.trans inf_le_left)
  have hVck : V ≤ linearOpen R M (c k) :=
    hVak.trans ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b a) (c k)).le.trans inf_le_right)
  let ebi := twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso R M b d i hVbi
  let eba := twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso R M b d a hVba
  let ecj := twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso R M c d j hVcj
  let eck := twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso R M c d k hVck
  let Fij := linearFrameChangeOverIso R M (-d) (b i) (c j) V hVbi hVcj
  let Fak := linearFrameChangeOverIso R M (-d) (b a) (c k) V hVba hVck
  let Fia := linearFrameChangeOverIso R M (-d) (b i) (b a) V hVbi hVba
  let Fjk := linearFrameChangeOverIso R M (-d) (c j) (c k) V hVcj hVck
  let Fik := linearFrameChangeOverIso R M (-d) (b i) (c k) V hVbi hVck
  have hb : ebi.hom ≫ Fia.hom = eba.hom := by
    exact twistingSheafBasisComponent_linearFrameChange
      R M b d i a V hVbi hVba
  have hc : ecj.hom ≫ Fjk.hom = eck.hom := by
    exact twistingSheafBasisComponent_linearFrameChange
      R M c d j k V hVcj hVck
  have hFij : Fij.hom ≫ Fjk.hom = Fik.hom := by
    simpa only [Iso.trans_hom] using congrArg Iso.hom
      (linearFrameChangeOverIso_trans R M (-d)
        (b i) (c j) (c k) V hVbi hVcj hVck)
  have hFia : Fia.hom ≫ Fak.hom = Fik.hom := by
    simpa only [Iso.trans_hom] using congrArg Iso.hom
      (linearFrameChangeOverIso_trans R M (-d)
        (b i) (b a) (c k) V hVbi hVba hVck)
  have hcInv : ecj.inv ≫ eck.hom = Fjk.hom := by
    rw [← hc, ← Category.assoc, ecj.inv_hom_id, Category.id_comp]
  rw [twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso_restrict_hom
      R M b c d i j hVij,
    twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso_restrict_hom
      R M b c d a k hVak]
  change ebi.hom ≫ Fij.hom ≫ ecj.inv =
    eba.hom ≫ Fak.hom ≫ eck.inv
  apply (cancel_mono eck.hom).1
  calc
    (ebi.hom ≫ Fij.hom ≫ ecj.inv) ≫ eck.hom =
        ebi.hom ≫ Fij.hom ≫ Fjk.hom := by
      simp only [Category.assoc, hcInv]
    _ = ebi.hom ≫ Fik.hom := by
      rw [hFij]
    _ = ebi.hom ≫ Fia.hom ≫ Fak.hom := by
      rw [← hFia]
    _ = eba.hom ≫ Fak.hom := by
      rw [← Category.assoc, hb]
    _ = (eba.hom ≫ Fak.hom ≫ eck.inv) ≫ eck.hom := by
      simp only [Category.assoc, eck.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalHom_compatible
statement:
theorem twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalHom_compatible (d : ℤ) :
    Presheaf.FamilyOfElementsOnObjects.IsCompatible
      (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ Scheme.Modules.localHomSection (space R M)
        (basisChangeOpen R M b c ij.1 ij.2)
        (twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso
          R M b c d ij.1 ij.2).hom)
proof:
:= by
  intro V ij ak f g
  have hVij : V ≤ basisChangeOpen R M b c ij.1 ij.2 := f.le
  have hVak : V ≤ basisChangeOpen R M b c ak.1 ak.2 := g.le
  rw [show f = homOfLE hVij from Subsingleton.elim _ _,
    show g = homOfLE hVak from Subsingleton.elim _ _,
    Scheme.Modules.sheafHom_map_localHomSection,
    Scheme.Modules.sheafHom_map_localHomSection]
  change (SheafOfModules.toSheaf
      ((space R M).ringCatSheaf.over V)).map
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (space R M) hVij
          (twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso
            R M b c d ij.1 ij.2).hom) =
    (SheafOfModules.toSheaf
      ((space R M).ringCatSheaf.over V)).map
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE (space R M) hVak
          (twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso
            R M b c d ak.1 ak.2).hom)
  apply congrArg
    (SheafOfModules.toSheaf ((space R M).ringCatSheaf.over V)).map
  exact twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso_restrict_hom_independent
    R M b c d ij.1 ij.2 ak.1 ak.2 hVij hVak

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_over
statement:
theorem twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_over
    (d : ℤ) (i : ι) (j : κ) :
    (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M b c d).over
        (basisChangeOpen R M b c i j) =
      (twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso R M b c d i j).hom
proof:
:= by
  exact Scheme.Modules.glueHom_over (space R M)
    (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ basisChangeOpen R M b c ij.1 ij.2)
    (basisChangeOpen_coversTop R M b c)
    (fun ij : ι × κ ↦
      (twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso
        R M b c d ij.1 ij.2).hom)
    (twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalHom_compatible R M b c d) (i, j)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_isIso
statement:
theorem twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_isIso (d : ℤ) :
    IsIso (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom R M b c d)
proof:
:= by
  exact Scheme.Modules.glueHom_isIso (space R M)
    (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ basisChangeOpen R M b c ij.1 ij.2)
    (basisChangeOpen_coversTop R M b c)
    (fun ij : ι × κ ↦
      (twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso
        R M b c d ij.1 ij.2).hom)
    (twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalHom_compatible R M b c d)
    (fun ij => by infer_instance)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4.capTwist_add
statement:
theorem capTwist_add (a b c : ℤ) (h : a + b = c) :
    totalCapOn (opsV4 k) (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf c) (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf c) =
      totalCapOn (opsV4 k) (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf a)
          (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf a) +
        totalCapOn (opsV4 k) (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf b)
          (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf b)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  have hT : HasConstantRank C.scheme (tensorSheaf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf a)
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf b)) 1 := by
    have h := hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf a)
      (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf b)
    rwa [Nat.one_mul] at h
  rw [← cap_isoOn (opsV4 k) hT (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf (a + b))
    ⟨AffineFrameCover.BundleRegularity.twistingTensorIso C hpos a b⟩]
  exact totalCapOn_tensor (ops := opsV4 k) _ _ _ _ hT

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4.capTwist
statement:
theorem capTwist (m : ℤ) :
    totalCapOn (opsV4 k) (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf m) (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf m) =
      (m : ℚ) • xiCapOn (opsV4 k) C
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Int.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    rw [cap_isoOn (opsV4 k) (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 0)
      hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf ⟨C.canonicalTwistingSheafZeroIso⟩, totalCapOn_tensorUnit]
    simp
  | succ i ih =>
    rw [capTwist_add k C hpos (i : ℤ) 1 ((i : ℤ) + 1) rfl, ih]
    push_cast
    rw [add_smul, one_smul]
    rfl
  | pred i ih =>
    have h := capTwist_add k C hpos (-(i : ℤ) - 1) 1 (-(i : ℤ)) (by ring)
    rw [ih] at h
    have key : ∀ {A : Type _} [AddCommGroup A] (a c H : A), a = c + H → c = a - H :=
      fun a c H h ↦ by rw [h]; abel
    push_cast at h ⊢
    refine (key _ _ _ h).trans ?_
    refine LinearMap.ext fun v ↦ ?_
    simp [sub_smul, xiCapOn]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4.k0_span_neg
statement:
theorem k0_span_neg (y : K0 C.scheme) :
    ∃ c : Fin (n + 1) → K0 Y, y = ∑ i : Fin (n + 1),
      C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos (c i) *
        C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-(n : ℤ) + ((i : ℕ) : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  letI := C.projectiveBundleK0Algebra hpos
  have hspan := C.span_eq_top hpos (Nat.succ_pos n) hE
  have hy : C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (n : ℤ) * y ∈
      Submodule.span (K0 Y) (Set.range fun i : Fin (n + 1) ↦ C.tautologicalK0Class ^ (i : ℕ)) :=
    hspan Submodule.mem_top
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun (K0 Y)).mp hy
  refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
  have hinv : C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-(n : ℤ)) *
      C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (n : ℤ) = 1 := by
    rw [C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_mul hpos, neg_add_cancel,
      C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_zero]
  calc y = C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-(n : ℤ)) *
        (C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (n : ℤ) * y) := by rw [← mul_assoc, hinv, one_mul]
    _ = C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-(n : ℤ)) *
        ∑ i : Fin (n + 1), c i • C.tautologicalK0Class ^ (i : ℕ) := by rw [hc]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
      rw [Algebra.smul_def, mul_left_comm, K0Basis.z_pow C hpos, C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_mul hpos]
      rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4.piShriek_gen
statement:
theorem piShriek_gen (e : K0 Y) (t : ℤ) (ht0 : -(n : ℤ) ≤ t) (ht : t ≤ 0) :
    projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank
        (k0ToG0 C.scheme (C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos e *
          C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class t)) =
      k0ToG0 Y (if t = 0 then e else 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [derivedPushforward_projectionFormula_K0 C hpos (Nat.succ_pos n) hE hrank e]
  have hO := C.canonicalTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree t
  have hacyc := canonical_acyclic C hpos hE t (by omega)
  have h1 : projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank
      (k0ToG0 C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class t)) =
      k0ToG0 Y (K0Basis.pushClass C (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf t)) := by
    have := derivedPushforward_acyclic C hpos hrank (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf t) hO hacyc
    change projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank
      (k0ToG0 C.scheme (k0ClassOf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf t) hO)) = _
    rw [k0ToG0_classOf]
    exact this
  rw [h1]
  by_cases h0 : t = 0
  · subst h0
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    have : K0Basis.pushClass C (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 0) = 1 := K0Basis.hilbertTwist_zero C hpos
    rw [this, ← k0ToG0_mul, mul_one]
  · rw [if_neg h0]
    have hneg : K0Basis.pushClass C (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf t) = 0 :=
      K0Basis.pushClass_of_isZero C
        (K0Basis.pushforward_canonical_isZero_of_neg C hpos hE t (by omega)
          (lt_of_le_of_ne ht h0))
    rw [hneg, map_zero, smul_zero]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4.hposOf
statement: theorem hposOf : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)
proof:
:=
  C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos n)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4.choose_twist
statement:
theorem choose_twist (t : ℤ) (h0 : -(n : ℤ) ≤ t) (h1 : t ≤ 0) :
    Ring.choose ((t : ℚ) + n) n = if t = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : t = 0
  · subst ht
    simp [Ring.choose_natCast]
  · rw [if_neg ht]
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j : ℕ, t + n = j := ⟨(t + n).toNat, by omega⟩
    have hjn : j < n := by omega
    have hq : ((t : ℚ) + (n : ℚ)) = ((j : ℕ) : ℚ) := by
      have : ((t + n : ℤ) : ℚ) = ((j : ℤ) : ℚ) := by rw [hj]
      push_cast at this
      exact this
    rw [hq, Ring.choose_natCast, Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt hjn]
    simp

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4.rhs_gen
statement:
theorem rhs_gen (hCh : ChExact k (closedPosV4 k)) (e : K0 Y) (t : ℤ) (ht0 : -(n : ℤ) ≤ t)
    (ht : t ≤ 0) :
    rhsHom k C n hCh (C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 (hposOf C hC) e *
        C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class t) =
      if t = 0 then chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) hCh e (fundClass k (W := Y)) else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := hposOf C hC
  refine k0_induction Y (fun e ↦ rhsHom k C n hCh (C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos e *
        C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class t) =
      if t = 0 then chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) hCh e (fundClass k (W := Y)) else 0) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ e
  · simp
  · intro a b ha hb
    rw [map_add, add_mul, map_add, ha, hb]
    by_cases h0 : t = 0 <;> simp [h0, map_add]
  · intro a ha
    rw [map_neg, neg_mul, map_neg, ha]
    by_cases h0 : t = 0 <;> simp [h0, map_neg]
  · intro V hV
    have hOt := C.canonicalTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree t
    have hmul := K0Basis.pb_mul_classOf C hpos V hV (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf t) hOt
    have hcls : C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class t =
        k0ClassOf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf t) hOt := rfl
    rw [hcls, hmul]
    have hPV := pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global C.toBase V hV
    have hL1 := C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf t
    have hF := tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme _ _ hPV hOt
    change totalPushOn (opsV4 k) C.toBase
        (((tdLine k (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)) ^
          (n + 1)) (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) hCh _ (fundClass k (W := C.scheme)))) = _
    rw [chK0_classOf k (closedPosV4 k) hCh _ hF, chBundle_tensor_line k _ _ hPV hL1,
      Module.End.mul_apply]
    have hZ : fundClass k (W := C.scheme) = pullZ k C hC (fundClass k (W := Y)) :=
      fundClass_scheme_eq_pull k C hC
    have hD : chBundle k (closedPosV4 k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj V)
        (pullZ k C hC (fundClass k (W := Y))) =
        pullZ k C hC (chBundle k (closedPosV4 k) V (fundClass k (W := Y))) := by
      haveI : Flat C.toBase := C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos n))
      exact (chBundle_pull_flat k C.toBase ((cpV4 k).projBundle_relDim C hC) V hV _).symm
    rw [hZ, hD, eval_twist k C hC t _ hL1 (capTwist k C hpos t), choose_twist t ht0 ht,
      chK0_classOf k (closedPosV4 k) hCh V hV]
    by_cases h0 : t = 0 <;> simp [h0]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4.caseI_cover
statement:
theorem caseI_cover (hCh : ChExact k (closedPosV4 k)) (hinj : Function.Injective (k0ToG0 Y)) :
    CaseI k (closedPosV4 k) hCh C.toBase (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
      (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (n + 1)
      (projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank)
proof:
:= by
  intro y w hw
  have hpos := hposOf C hC
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := k0_span_neg C hpos hE y
  have hb : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), -(n : ℤ) ≤ -(n : ℤ) + ((i : ℕ) : ℤ) ∧
      -(n : ℤ) + ((i : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ 0 := fun i ↦ by
    have := i.isLt
    omega
  have h1 : projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward hrank (k0ToG0 C.scheme
      (∑ i : Fin (n + 1), C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos (c i) *
        C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-(n : ℤ) + ((i : ℕ) : ℤ)))) =
      k0ToG0 Y (∑ i : Fin (n + 1), if -(n : ℤ) + ((i : ℕ) : ℤ) = 0 then c i else 0) := by
    rw [map_sum, map_sum, map_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦
      piShriek_gen C hpos hE hrank (c i) _ (hb i).1 (hb i).2
  rw [h1] at hw
  have hw' := hinj hw
  rw [hw']
  change _ = rhsHom k C n hCh _
  rw [map_sum (rhsHom k C n hCh), map_sum (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) hCh), LinearMap.sum_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
  rw [rhs_gen k C hC hCh (c i) _ (hb i).1 (hb i).2]
  by_cases h0 : -(n : ℤ) + ((i : ℕ) : ℤ) = 0 <;> simp [h0]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex_d_zero_component
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex_d_zero_component
    (d : ℤ) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex k n d).d 0 1 ≫
          (coordinateCechOneTermIso k n (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d)).hom ≫
          Pi.π (fun ij : Fin (n + 1) × Fin (n + 1) ↦
            (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.obj
              (op (coordinateOverlapOpen k n ij.1 ij.2))) (i, j) =
      (coordinateCechZeroTermIso k n (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d)).hom ≫
            Pi.π (fun a : Fin (n + 1) ↦
              (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.obj
                (op (coordinateCechCover k n a))) j ≫
            (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
              (homOfLE
                ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_right)).op -
        (coordinateCechZeroTermIso k n (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d)).hom ≫
            Pi.π (fun a : Fin (n + 1) ↦
              (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.obj
                (op (coordinateCechCover k n a))) i ≫
            (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
              (homOfLE
                ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_left)).op
proof:
:= by
  rw [projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex_d_zero]
  rw [Preadditive.sub_comp]
  rw [coordinateCechCoface_zero_component,
    coordinateCechCoface_one_component]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechSectionLeftRes_π
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem coordinateCechSectionLeftRes_π
    (M : (space k n).Modules) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateCechSectionLeftRes k n M ≫
        Pi.π (fun ij : Fin (n + 1) × Fin (n + 1) ↦
          M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateOverlapOpen k n ij.1 ij.2))) (i, j) =
      Pi.π (fun a : Fin (n + 1) ↦
          M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateCechCover k n a))) i ≫
        M.presheaf.map
          (homOfLE
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_left)).op
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coordinateCechSectionLeftRes, Pi.lift_π]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechSectionRightRes_π
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem coordinateCechSectionRightRes_π
    (M : (space k n).Modules) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateCechSectionRightRes k n M ≫
        Pi.π (fun ij : Fin (n + 1) × Fin (n + 1) ↦
          M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateOverlapOpen k n ij.1 ij.2))) (i, j) =
      Pi.π (fun a : Fin (n + 1) ↦
          M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateCechCover k n a))) j ≫
        M.presheaf.map
          (homOfLE
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_right)).op
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coordinateCechSectionRightRes, Pi.lift_π]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex_d_zero_conjugates
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex_d_zero_conjugates
    (d : ℤ) :
    (projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex k n d).d 0 1 ≫
        (coordinateCechOneTermIso k n (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d)).hom =
      (coordinateCechZeroTermIso k n (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d)).hom ≫
        (coordinateCechSectionRightRes k n (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) -
          coordinateCechSectionLeftRes k n (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d))
proof:
:= by
  apply Pi.hom_ext _ _
  rintro ⟨i, j⟩
  rw [Category.assoc,
    projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex_d_zero_component]
  simp only [coordinateCechSectionRightRes, coordinateCechSectionLeftRes,
    Preadditive.comp_sub, Preadditive.sub_comp, Category.assoc, Pi.lift_π]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechSectionRes_π
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem coordinateCechSectionRes_π
    (M : (space k n).Modules) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateCechSectionRes k n M ≫
        Pi.π (fun a : Fin (n + 1) ↦
          M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateCechCover k n a))) i =
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coordinateCechSectionRes, Pi.lift_π]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechSectionFork_ι_π
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem coordinateCechSectionFork_ι_π
    (M : (space k n).Modules) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (coordinateCechSectionFork k n M).ι ≫
        Pi.π (fun a : Fin (n + 1) ↦
          M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateCechCover k n a))) i =
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op
proof:
:= by
  change coordinateCechSectionRes k n M ≫
      Pi.π (fun a : Fin (n + 1) ↦
        M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateCechCover k n a))) i = _
  exact coordinateCechSectionRes_π k n M i

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45A.germ_nzd_of_chart
statement:
theorem germ_nzd_of_chart {R : CommRingCat.{u}} (e : Spec R ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion e]
    (y : Spec R)
    (h : ∀ r : R, (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).hom ((e.appTop) t) * r = 0 → r = 0)
    (b : X.presheaf.stalk (e y)) :
    X.presheaf.germ ⊤ (e y) trivial t * b = 0 → b = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hb
  let U : X.Opens := e ''ᵁ ⊤
  have hU : IsAffineOpen U := by
    have : U = e.opensRange := Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange e
    rw [this]
    exact isAffineOpen_opensRange e
  have hx : e y ∈ U := ⟨y, trivial, rfl⟩
  
  have hsec : ∀ r : Γ(X, U), X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op t * r = 0 → r = 0 := by
    intro r hr
    let φ : Γ(X, U) ≅ Γ(Spec R, ⊤) := e.appIso ⊤
    have hφt : φ.hom (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op t) = e.appTop t := by
      change (e.appIso ⊤).hom _ = _
      rw [Scheme.Hom.appIso_hom', ← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.map_appLE,
        Scheme.Hom.appTop, Scheme.Hom.app_eq_appLE]
      rfl
    let ψ : Γ(X, U) ≃+* R :=
      (Iso.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv φ).trans (Iso.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R))
    have hψt : ψ (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op t) =
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).hom (e.appTop t) := by
      simp only [ψ, RingEquiv.trans_apply]
      exact congrArg (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).hom hφt
    have := h (ψ r) (by rw [← hψt, ← map_mul, hr, map_zero])
    exact ψ.injective (by rw [this, map_zero])
  letI := X.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk ⟨e y, hx⟩
  have := hU.isLocalization_stalk ⟨e y, hx⟩
  have hgerm : X.presheaf.germ ⊤ (e y) trivial t =
      algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk (e y)) (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op t) := by
    change _ = (X.presheaf.germ U (e y) hx).hom _
    rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res]
  rw [hgerm] at hb
  obtain ⟨⟨a, s⟩, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.mk'_surjective
    (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨e y, hx⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl b
  have h1 : algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk (e y))
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op t * a) = 0 := by
    have := congrArg (· * algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk (e y)) (s : Γ(X, U))) hb
    simp only [zero_mul] at this
    rw [mul_assoc, IsLocalization.mk'_spec] at this
    simpa [map_mul] using this
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (IsLocalization.map_eq_zero_iff
    (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨e y, hx⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl _ _).mp h1
  have h2 := hsec ((c : Γ(X, U)) * a) (by rw [← hc]; ring)
  exact (IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff _ _).mpr ⟨c, h2⟩

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45A.res_nzd_of_chartNZD
statement:
theorem res_nzd_of_chartNZD
    (hchart : ∀ x : X, ∃ (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (e : Spec R ⟶ X), IsOpenImmersion e ∧
        x ∈ Set.range e ∧
        ∀ r : R, (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).hom ((e.appTop) t) * r = 0 → r = 0)
    (V : X.Opens) (r : Γ(X, V))
    (hr : X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op t * r = 0) : r = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply TopCat.Presheaf.section_ext X.sheaf V r 0
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨R, e, he, ⟨y, rfl⟩, h⟩ := hchart x
  rw [map_zero]
  apply germ_nzd_of_chart t e y h
  have h2 := congrArg (X.presheaf.germ V (e y) hx) hr
  rw [map_mul, map_zero] at h2
  have h3 : X.presheaf.germ V (e y) hx (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op t) =
      X.presheaf.germ ⊤ (e y) trivial t := by
    rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res]
  rw [h3] at h2
  exact h2

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45A.scal_naturality
statement:
theorem scal_naturality {N N' : SheafOfModules.{u} S} (φ : N ⟶ N') :
    scal s hs hc N ≫ φ = φ ≫ scal s hs hc N'
proof:
:= by
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro U
  ext m
  change φ.val.app U (s U • m) = s U • φ.val.app U m
  exact (φ.val.app U).hom.map_smul _ _

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45A.mono_scal_of_injective
statement:
theorem mono_scal_of_injective (N : SheafOfModules.{u} S)
    (hinj : ∀ (W : Cᵒᵖ) (m : N.val.obj W), s W • m = 0 → m = 0) :
    Mono (scal s hs hc N)
proof:
:= by
  apply (SheafOfModules.toSheaf S).mono_of_mono_map
  have : Mono ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf S).map (scal s hs hc N)).hom := by
    refine @NatTrans.mono_of_mono_app _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ?_
    intro W
    rw [AddCommGrpCat.mono_iff_injective]
    intro a b hab
    let a' : N.val.obj W := a
    let b' : N.val.obj W := b
    have hab' : s W • a' = s W • b' := hab
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hinj W (a' - b') (by rw [smul_sub, hab', sub_self]))
  exact Sheaf.Hom.mono_of_presheaf_mono J _ _

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45A.mono_scal_free
statement:
theorem mono_scal_free (I : Type u) [Finite I]
    (hu : Mono (scal s hs hc (SheafOfModules.unit S))) :
    Mono (scal s hs hc (SheafOfModules.free (R := S) I))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Fintype I := Fintype.ofFinite I
  have heq : scal s hs hc (SheafOfModules.free (R := S) I) =
      CategoryTheory.Limits.Sigma.map (fun _ : I => scal s hs hc (SheafOfModules.unit S)) := by
    apply Sigma.hom_ext
    intro i
    exact (scal_naturality s hs hc (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := S) i)).symm.trans
      (CategoryTheory.Limits.Sigma.ι_map (f := fun _ : I => SheafOfModules.unit S)
        (g := fun _ : I => SheafOfModules.unit S)
        (fun _ => scal s hs hc (SheafOfModules.unit S)) i).symm
  rw [heq]
  haveI : ∀ _ : I, Mono (scal s hs hc (SheafOfModules.unit S)) := fun _ => hu
  haveI h3 : HasFiniteBiproducts (SheafOfModules.{u} S) :=
    HasFiniteBiproducts.of_hasFiniteProducts
  have h4 : HasBiproductsOfShape I (SheafOfModules.{u} S) := inferInstance
  have h2 : HasBiproduct (fun _ : I => SheafOfModules.unit S) := inferInstance
  exact CategoryTheory.Limits.Sigma.map_mono (fun _ : I => scal s hs hc (SheafOfModules.unit S))

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45A.mono_scal_of_iso
statement:
theorem mono_scal_of_iso {N N' : SheafOfModules.{u} S} (e : N ≅ N')
    (h : Mono (scal s hs hc N)) : Mono (scal s hs hc N')
proof:
:= by
  have : scal s hs hc N' = e.inv ≫ scal s hs hc N ≫ e.hom := by
    rw [scal_naturality s hs hc e.hom, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  rw [this]
  infer_instance

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45A.tOver_map
statement:
theorem tOver_map {W W' : (Over U)ᵒᵖ} (f : W ⟶ W') :
    (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj.map f (tOver t U W) = tOver t U W'
proof:
:=
  tRes_map t (f.unop.left.op)

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45A.tOver_central
statement:
theorem tOver_central (W : (Over U)ᵒᵖ) (r : (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj.obj W) :
    tOver t U W * r = r * tOver t U W
proof:
:=
  mul_comm (G := Γ(X, W.unop.left)) _ _

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45A.restrict_tMul
statement:
theorem restrict_tMul (M : X.Modules) :
    (overRestrictionFunctor X U).map (tMul t M) =
      scal (tOver t U) (fun f => tOver_map t U f) (tOver_central t U)
        ((overRestrictionFunctor X U).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45A.mono_of_over_cover
proof:
:= by
  have hpoint : ∀ x : X, Mono ((Scheme.Modules.stalkFunctor X x).map f) := by
    intro x
    let hcover : IsOpenCover U :=
      (Opens.coversTop_iff X U).mp hU
    have hxUnion : x ∈ ⋃ i, (U i : Set X) := by
      rw [hcover.iSup_set_eq_univ]
      exact Set.mem_univ x
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hxUnion
    obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := hxUnion
    haveI := h i
    have hi := Functor.map_mono (Scheme.Modules.overStalkFunctor X (U i) x hxi)
      ((overRestrictionFunctor X (U i)).map f)
    have hnat := (Scheme.Modules.overStalkNatIso X (U i) x hxi).hom.naturality f
    simp only [Functor.comp_map] at hnat
    have hN : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.overStalkNatIso X (U i) x hxi).hom.app N) :=
      ((Scheme.Modules.overStalkNatIso X (U i) x hxi).app N).isIso_hom
    have hMi : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.overStalkNatIso X (U i) x hxi).hom.app M) :=
      ((Scheme.Modules.overStalkNatIso X (U i) x hxi).app M).isIso_hom
    have hm : Mono ((Scheme.Modules.overStalkNatIso X (U i) x hxi).hom.app M ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.stalkFunctor X x).map f) := by
      rw [← hnat]
      exact @mono_comp _ _ _ _ _ _ hi _ (@IsIso.mono_of_iso _ _ _ _ _ hN)
    have heq : (Scheme.Modules.stalkFunctor X x).map f =
        inv ((Scheme.Modules.overStalkNatIso X (U i) x hxi).hom.app M) ≫
          ((Scheme.Modules.overStalkNatIso X (U i) x hxi).hom.app M ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.stalkFunctor X x).map f) := by
      simp
    rw [heq]
    infer_instance
  apply (Scheme.Modules.toAddCommGrpSheaf X).mono_of_mono_map
  rw [TopCat.Presheaf.mono_iff_stalk_mono]
  intro x
  exact hpoint x

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45A.tMul_mono_of_chartNZD
statement:
theorem tMul_mono_of_chartNZD {X : Scheme.{u}} (t : Γ(X, ⊤))
    (hchart : ∀ x : X, ∃ (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (e : Spec R ⟶ X), IsOpenImmersion e ∧
        x ∈ Set.range e ∧
        ∀ r : R, (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).hom ((e.appTop) t) * r = 0 → r = 0)
    (E : X.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) : Mono (KSpecialization.tMul t E)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq1, hq2⟩ := hE.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  refine mono_of_over_cover X (KSpecialization.tMul t E) q.X q.coversTop (fun i => ?_)
  rw [restrict_tMul]
  have hunit : Mono (scal (tOver t (q.X i)) (fun f => tOver_map t (q.X i) f)
      (tOver_central t (q.X i)) (SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over (q.X i)))) := by
    apply mono_scal_of_injective
    intro W m hm
    exact res_nzd_of_chartNZD t hchart W.unop.left m hm
  haveI : Finite (q.generators i).I := (hq2.isFiniteType i).finite
  haveI h1 : HasWeakSheafify ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over (q.X i)) AddCommGrpCat.{u} :=
    inferInstance
  haveI h2 : ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over (q.X i)).WEqualsLocallyBijective
      AddCommGrpCat.{u} := inferInstance
  have hfree := mono_scal_free (tOver t (q.X i)) (fun f => tOver_map t (q.X i) f)
    (tOver_central t (q.X i)) (q.generators i).I hunit
  have hiso : IsIso (q.generators i).π := hq1.isIso i
  exact mono_scal_of_iso _ _ _ (@asIso _ _ _ _ (q.generators i).π hiso) hfree

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameRoutes_restriction_pullback
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameRoutes_restriction_pullback
    {Z V W : Scheme.{u}} (s : W ⟶ Z) (q : V ⟶ Z) (r : W ⟶ V)
    [IsOpenImmersion s] [IsOpenImmersion q] [IsOpenImmersion r]
    (h : r ≫ q = s) {M N : Z.Modules} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    let e
proof:
:= Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr h.symm ≪≫
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp r q ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q) (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback r)
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback r).map ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map f) =
      e.inv.app M ≫ (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor s).map f ≫ e.hom.app N := by
  dsimp only
  exact (pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameRecovery_natural_conjugation
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr h.symm ≪≫
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp r q ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q) (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback r)).symm f).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameRoutes_replace_tail_two
proof:
:=
  h.trans (congrArg (fun z => k ≫ l ≫ z) hs)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameRoutes_target_route
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameRoutes_target_route
    {Z U V W : Scheme.{u}} (l : W ⟶ U) (r : W ⟶ V) (p : U ⟶ Z) (q : V ⟶ Z)
    (h : l ≫ p = r ≫ q) {M N : Z.Modules} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    let e
proof:
:= Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp l p ≪≫ Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr h ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp r q).symm
    e.hom.app M ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback r).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map f) ≫
      e.inv.app N = (Scheme.Modules.pullback l).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p).map f) :=
  pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameRecovery_natural_conjugation
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp l p ≪≫ Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr h ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp r q).symm) f

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameRoutes_chart_quotient_recovery
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameRoutes_chart_quotient_recovery (i : D.I) :
    D.pullbackTwistOverlap_chartCanonicalQuotient i ≫
      (D.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 i).inv =
    (pullbackRestrictSquareNatIso D.toBase (D.chartι i) (D.U i).ι
      (D.chartToBase i) (D.pullbackTwistOverlap_chartBase_comm i)).inv.app M ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (D.chartι i)).map D.tautologicalQuotient
proof:
:= by

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameRoutes_target_common_comm
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotientCrossFrameRoutes_target_common_comm
    (a b : C.pullbackFrameIndex g) (c : (C.pullbackFrameCover g).CommonBasicOpen a b) :
    (c.chartToLeft ≫ C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a) ≫ C.chartι a.1 =
      (c.chartToRight ≫ C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g b) ≫ C.chartι b.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Category.assoc, ← C.pullbackProjectiveMap_chartι g a,
    ← Category.assoc, (C.pullbackFrameCover g).chartToLeft_chartι c,
    Category.assoc, C.pullbackProjectiveMap_chartι g b, ← Category.assoc]

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.mulSectionHom_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mulSectionHom_app (U : X.Opens) (r : Γ(X, U)) (W : (Over U)ᵒᵖ)
    (m : Γ(X, W.unop.left)) :
    (mulSectionHom X U r).val.app W m = X.presheaf.map W.unop.hom.op r * m
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.overHom_ext
statement:
theorem overHom_ext {U : X.Opens} {M N : SheafOfModules.{u} (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)}
    {f g : M ⟶ N} (h : ∀ W m, f.val.app W m = g.val.app W m) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro W
  ext m
  exact h W m

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.mulSectionHom_one
statement: theorem mulSectionHom_one (U : X.Opens) : mulSectionHom X U 1 = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply overHom_ext
  intro W m
  change Γ(X, W.unop.left) at m
  change X.presheaf.map W.unop.hom.op 1 * m = m
  rw [map_one, one_mul]

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.mulSectionHom_mul
statement:
theorem mulSectionHom_mul (U : X.Opens) (r s : Γ(X, U)) :
    mulSectionHom X U (r * s) = mulSectionHom X U s ≫ mulSectionHom X U r
proof:
:= by
  apply overHom_ext
  intro W m
  change Γ(X, W.unop.left) at m
  change X.presheaf.map W.unop.hom.op (r * s) * m =
    X.presheaf.map W.unop.hom.op r * (X.presheaf.map W.unop.hom.op s * m)
  rw [map_mul, mul_assoc]

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.mulSectionHom_add
statement:
theorem mulSectionHom_add (U : X.Opens) (r s : Γ(X, U)) :
    mulSectionHom X U (r + s) = mulSectionHom X U r + mulSectionHom X U s
proof:
:= by
  apply overHom_ext
  intro W m
  change Γ(X, W.unop.left) at m
  change X.presheaf.map W.unop.hom.op (r + s) * m =
    X.presheaf.map W.unop.hom.op r * m + X.presheaf.map W.unop.hom.op s * m
  rw [map_add, add_mul]

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.mulSectionHom_zero
statement: theorem mulSectionHom_zero (U : X.Opens) : mulSectionHom X U 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply overHom_ext
  intro W m
  change Γ(X, W.unop.left) at m
  change X.presheaf.map W.unop.hom.op 0 * m = 0
  rw [map_zero, zero_mul]

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.smul_def
statement:
theorem smul_def {U : X.Opens} {M : SheafOfModules.{u} (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)}
    (r : Γ(X, U)) (f : M ⟶ (unitMod X).over U) : r • f = f ≫ mulSectionHom X U r
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.res_mulSectionHom
statement:
theorem res_mulSectionHom {U V : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) (r : Γ(X, U)) :
    Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X h (mulSectionHom X U r) =
      mulSectionHom X V (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op r)
proof:
:= by
  apply overHom_ext
  intro W m
  change Γ(X, W.unop.left) at m
  change X.presheaf.map (W.unop.hom ≫ homOfLE h).op r * m =
    X.presheaf.map W.unop.hom.op (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op r) * m
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.isSheaf_of_injective
statement:
theorem isSheaf_of_injective.{w} {C : Type*} [Category C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    {P Q : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type w} (ι : P ⟶ Q) (hinj : ∀ U, Function.Injective (ι.app U))
    (hQ : Presieve.IsSheaf J Q)
    (hclosed : ∀ (U : C) (S : Sieve U), S ∈ J U → ∀ q : Q.obj (op U),
      (∀ (V : C) (f : V ⟶ U), S f → ∃ p, ι.app (op V) p = Q.map f.op q) →
        ∃ p, ι.app (op U) p = q) :
    Presieve.IsSheaf J P
proof:
:= by
  intro U S hS x hx
  have hy := Presieve.FamilyOfElements.Compatible.map ι hx
  let q := (hQ S hS).amalgamate _ hy
  have hq := (hQ S hS).isAmalgamation hy
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hclosed U S hS q (fun V f hf ↦ ⟨x f hf, (hq f hf).symm⟩)
  refine ⟨p, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro V f hf
    apply hinj
    rw [NatTrans.naturality_apply, hp]
    exact hq f hf
  · intro p' hp'
    apply hinj
    rw [hp]
    exact (hQ S hS).isSeparatedFor _ _ _ (hp'.map ι) hq

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.toSheafHom_injective
statement: theorem toSheafHom_injective (U : (X.Opens)ᵒᵖ) : Function.Injective ((toSheafHom X L).app U)
proof:
:= by
  intro f g h
  exact (SheafOfModules.toSheaf (X.ringCatSheaf.over U.unop)).map_injective h

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.exists_of_locally
statement:
theorem exists_of_locally (U : X.Opens) (S : Sieve U) (hS : S ∈ Opens.grothendieckTopology X U)
    (q : (sheafHom (toAbSheaf X L) (toAbSheaf X (unitMod X))).obj.obj (op U))
    (h : ∀ (V : X.Opens) (f : V ⟶ U), S f → ∃ p,
      (toSheafHom X L).app (op V) p =
        (sheafHom (toAbSheaf X L) (toAbSheaf X (unitMod X))).obj.map f.op q) :
    ∃ p, (toSheafHom X L).app (op U) p = q
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (Z : Over U) (_ : S Z.hom)
      (s : (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj.obj (op Z)) (y : (L.over U).val.obj (op Z)),
      q.hom.app (op Z) (s • y) =
        s • @id (((unitMod X).over U).val.obj (op Z)) (q.hom.app (op Z) y) := by
    intro Z hZ s y
    obtain ⟨p', hp'⟩ := h Z.left Z.hom hZ
    have hZq : ∀ y' : (L.over U).val.obj (op Z),
        q.hom.app (op Z) y' = p'.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 Z.left))) y' := by
      intro y'
      exact (congrArg (fun t ↦ t.hom.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 Z.left))) y') hp').symm
    rw [hZq, hZq]
    dsimp only [id]
    exact (p'.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 Z.left)))).hom.map_smul s y
  refine ⟨⟨PresheafOfModules.homMk q.hom ?_⟩, rfl⟩
  intro W r m
  apply (unitMod X).isSheaf.isSeparated W.unop.left (S.pullback W.unop.hom)
    ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).pullback_stable W.unop.hom hS)
  intro Z g hg
  let Z' : Over U := Over.mk (g ≫ W.unop.hom)
  let φ : Z' ⟶ W.unop := Over.homMk g
  have nat : ∀ y : (L.over U).val.obj W,
      ((unitMod X).over U).val.map φ.op (q.hom.app W y) =
        q.hom.app (op Z') ((L.over U).val.map φ.op y) := by
    intro y
    exact (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (q.hom.naturality φ.op) y).symm
  change ((unitMod X).over U).val.map φ.op (q.hom.app W (r • m)) =
    ((unitMod X).over U).val.map φ.op
      (r • @id (((unitMod X).over U).val.obj W) (q.hom.app W m))
  rw [nat, PresheafOfModules.map_smul, PresheafOfModules.map_smul]
  refine (key Z' hg _ _).trans ?_
  dsimp only [id]
  rw [nat]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.dualAb_isSheaf
statement:
theorem dualAb_isSheaf :
    Presheaf.IsSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (dualAb X L)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget (s := forget AddCommGrpCat.{u}),
    isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_of_type]
  exact isSheaf_of_injective (toSheafHom X L) (toSheafHom_injective X L)
    ((isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_of_type _ _).1
      (sheafHom (toAbSheaf X L) (toAbSheaf X (unitMod X))).property)
    (fun U S hS q h ↦ exists_of_locally X L U S hS q h)

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.evalAt_smul_right
statement:
theorem evalAt_smul_right (U : X.Opens) (m : L.val.obj (op U)) (r : Γ(X, U))
    (f : L.over U ⟶ (unitMod X).over U) :
    evalAt L U m (r • f) = r * evalAt L U m f
proof:
:= by
  change X.presheaf.map (𝟙 U).op r * _ = _
  rw [op_id, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.evalAt_smul_left
statement:
theorem evalAt_smul_left (U : X.Opens) (m : L.val.obj (op U)) (r : Γ(X, U))
    (f : L.over U ⟶ (unitMod X).over U) :
    evalAt L U (r • m) f = r * evalAt L U m f
proof:
:=
  (f.val.app (topOver U)).hom.map_smul r m

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.unitMod_hom_ext
statement:
theorem unitMod_hom_ext {V : X.Opens} {N : SheafOfModules.{u} (X.ringCatSheaf.over V)}
    (t t' : (unitMod X).over V ⟶ N)
    (h : t.val.app (topOver V) (1 : Γ(X, V)) = t'.val.app (topOver V) (1 : Γ(X, V))) :
    t = t'
proof:
:= by
  apply overHom_ext
  intro W a
  let φ : W.unop ⟶ Over.mk (𝟙 V) := Over.homMk W.unop.hom
  let a' : (X.ringCatSheaf.over V).obj.obj W := a
  have ha : a = a' • ((unitMod X).over V).val.map φ.op (1 : Γ(X, V)) := by
    have h1 : X.presheaf.map W.unop.hom.op (1 : Γ(X, V)) = 1 := map_one _
    let a0 : Γ(X, W.unop.left) := a
    exact (mul_one a0).symm.trans (congrArg (fun z : Γ(X, W.unop.left) ↦ a0 * z) h1.symm)
  rw [ha]
  refine ((t.val.app W).hom.map_smul a' _).trans ?_
  refine Eq.trans ?_ ((t'.val.app W).hom.map_smul a' _).symm
  refine congrArg (fun z ↦ a' • z) ?_
  refine (PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply t.val φ.op _).trans ?_
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply t'.val φ.op _).symm
  exact congrArg _ h

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.evalAt_localGen
statement: theorem evalAt_localGen : evalAt L V (localGen e) e.hom = 1
proof:
:= by
  change (e.inv ≫ e.hom).val.app (topOver V) (1 : Γ(X, V)) = (1 : Γ(X, V))
  rw [e.inv_hom_id]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.section_eq_smul_localGen
statement:
theorem section_eq_smul_localGen (m : L.val.obj (op V)) :
    m = (evalAt L V m e.hom) • localGen e
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : e.inv.val.app (topOver V) (e.hom.val.app (topOver V) m) = m := by
    change (e.hom ≫ e.inv).val.app (topOver V) m = m
    rw [e.hom_inv_id]
    rfl
  let c : (X.ringCatSheaf.over V).obj.obj (topOver V) := evalAt L V m e.hom
  let one : ((unitMod X).over V).val.obj (topOver V) := (1 : Γ(X, V))
  have h2 : e.hom.val.app (topOver V) m = c • one :=
    (mul_one (M := Γ(X, V)) _).symm
  conv_lhs => rw [← h1, h2]
  exact (e.inv.val.app (topOver V)).hom.map_smul c one

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.hom_eq_smul
statement:
theorem hom_eq_smul (f : L.over V ⟶ (unitMod X).over V) :
    f = (evalAt L V (localGen e) f) • e.hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_epi e.inv]
  apply unitMod_hom_ext
  change evalAt L V (localGen e) f =
    X.presheaf.map (𝟙 V).op (evalAt L V (localGen e) f) * evalAt L V (localGen e) e.hom
  rw [evalAt_localGen, op_id, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, mul_one]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.evInv_add
statement:
theorem evInv_add (a b : Γ(X, V)) :
    evInv e (a + b) = evInv e a + evInv e b
proof:
:= by
  unfold evInv
  rw [add_smul]
  exact TensorProduct.tmul_add _ _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.evInv_ev
statement:
theorem evInv_ev (t : (underlyingCommPresheaf X L ⊗
    underlyingCommPresheaf X (lineBundleDual X L)).obj (op V)) :
    evInv e ((evPre L).app (op V) t) = t
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    refine (congrArg (evInv e) (map_zero _)).trans ?_
    unfold evInv
    rw [zero_smul]
    exact TensorProduct.tmul_zero _ _
  | add x y hx hy =>
    exact (congrArg (evInv e) (map_add _ x y)).trans
      ((evInv_add e _ _).trans (congrArg₂ (· + ·) hx hy))
  | tmul m f =>
    change evInv e (evalAt L V m f) = TensorProduct.tmul _ m f
    have hm := section_eq_smul_localGen e m
    have hf := hom_eq_smul e f
    have hev : evalAt L V m f = evalAt L V m e.hom * evalAt L V (localGen e) f := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hm]
      exact evalAt_smul_left L V _ _ f
    rw [hev]
    unfold evInv
    rw [mul_smul, ← hf]
    conv_rhs => rw [hm]
    let c' : (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).obj (op V) := evalAt L V m e.hom
    let T := TensorProduct.mk ((X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).obj (op V))
      ((underlyingCommPresheaf X L).obj (op V))
      ((underlyingCommPresheaf X (lineBundleDual X L)).obj (op V))
    have h1 := congrArg (fun F ↦ F f) (T.map_smul c' (localGen e))
    have h2 := (T (localGen e)).map_smul c' f
    exact h2.trans h1.symm

theorem restrictHomOverLE_id {M : X.Modules} {U W : X.Opens} (h : W ≤ U) :

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.evPre_mem_moduleLocalEquivalences
statement:
theorem evPre_mem_moduleLocalEquivalences {ι : Type u} (U : ι → X.Opens)
    (hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop U)
    (e : ∀ i, L.over (U i) ≅ (unitMod X).over (U i)) :
    moduleLocalEquivalences X (evPre L)
proof:
:= by
  have hcov : ∀ p : X, ∃ i, p ∈ U i := by
    intro p
    have h := hU
    rw [Opens.coversTop_iff] at h
    have hp : p ∈ (⨆ i, U i : X.Opens) := by rw [h]; trivial
    exact (TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup).1 hp
  change (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).W
    ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map (evPre L))
  rw [GrothendieckTopology.W_iff_isLocallyBijective]
  constructor
  · constructor
    intro W x y hxy p hp
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcov p
    refine ⟨W.unop ⊓ U i, homOfLE inf_le_left, ?_, ⟨hp, hi⟩⟩
    show _ = _
    apply evPre_injective L
      (resIso (L := L) (inf_le_right : W.unop ⊓ U i ≤ U i) (e i))
    refine (PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply (evPre L)
      (homOfLE (inf_le_left : W.unop ⊓ U i ≤ W.unop)).op x).trans ?_
    refine Eq.trans ?_ (PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply (evPre L)
      (homOfLE (inf_le_left : W.unop ⊓ U i ≤ W.unop)).op y).symm
    exact congrArg _ hxy
  · constructor
    intro W s p hp
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcov p
    refine ⟨W ⊓ U i, homOfLE inf_le_left, ?_, ⟨hp, hi⟩⟩
    let e' := resIso (L := L) (inf_le_right : W ⊓ U i ≤ U i) (e i)
    let a : Γ(X, W ⊓ U i) := X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : W ⊓ U i ≤ W)).op s
    refine ⟨evInv e' a, ?_⟩
    exact evPre_evInv e' a

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.isIso_of_bijective
statement:
theorem isIso_of_bijective {U : X.Opens} {M N : SheafOfModules.{u} (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)}
    (f : M ⟶ N) (h : ∀ W, Function.Bijective (f.val.app W)) : IsIso f
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : IsIso ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).map f).hom := by
    have : ∀ W, IsIso (((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).map f).hom.app W) := fun W ↦
      (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective _).2 (h W)
    exact NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app _
  have h2 : IsIso ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).map f) := by
    have : IsIso ((sheafToPresheaf _ _).map ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).map f)) := h1
    exact isIso_of_reflects_iso _ (sheafToPresheaf _ _)
  exact isIso_of_reflects_iso f (SheafOfModules.toSheaf _)

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.dualTriv_isIso
statement:
theorem dualTriv_isIso {U : X.Opens} (e : L.over U ≅ (unitMod X).over U) :
    IsIso (dualTriv e)
proof:
:= by
  apply isIso_of_bijective
  intro W
  let e' := resIso (L := L) (leOfHom W.unop.hom) e
  constructor
  · intro a b hab
    change Γ(X, W.unop.left) at a b
    have h := congrArg (evalAt L W.unop.left (localGen e')) hab
    change evalAt L W.unop.left (localGen e') (a • e'.hom) =
      evalAt L W.unop.left (localGen e') (b • e'.hom) at h
    rwa [evalAt_smul_right, evalAt_smul_right, evalAt_localGen, mul_one, mul_one] at h
  · intro f
    exact ⟨_, (hom_eq_smul e' f).symm⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.exists_triv
statement:
theorem exists_triv (q : SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.{u} L) [q.IsLocallyFreeData]
    (hcard : ∀ i, Nat.card (q.generators i).I = 1) (i : q.I) :
    Nonempty (L.over (q.X i) ≅ (unitMod X).over (q.X i))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hs, hn⟩ := Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.mp (hcard i)
  haveI := hs
  haveI : Inhabited (q.generators i).I := Classical.inhabited_of_nonempty hn
  haveI : Unique (q.generators i).I := Unique.mk' _
  let i1 : L.over (q.X i) ≅ SheafOfModules.free (q.generators i).I :=
    (asIso (q.generators i).π).symm
  let i2 : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over (q.X i)) (q.generators i).I ≅
      SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over (q.X i)) PUnit.{u + 1} :=
    (SheafOfModules.freeFunctor (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over (q.X i))).mapIso
      (Equiv.ofUnique (q.generators i).I PUnit.{u + 1}).toIso
  exact ⟨i1 ≪≫ i2 ≪≫ freePUnitIsoUnitOver (q.X i)⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank
statement:
theorem _root_.SchemeKTheory.lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) :
    HasConstantRank X (lineBundleDual X L) 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, -, hcard⟩ := hL
  letI := hq
  let e := fun i ↦ (LineBundleDual.exists_triv L q hcard i).some
  let iso : ∀ i, SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over (q.X i)) PUnit.{u + 1} ≅
      (lineBundleDual X L).over (q.X i) := fun i ↦
    SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit ≪≫
      @asIso _ _ _ _ (LineBundleDual.dualTriv (e i)) (LineBundleDual.dualTriv_isIso (e i))
  refine ⟨{ I := q.I, X := q.X, coversTop := q.coversTop
            generators := fun i ↦ SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.equivOfIso (iso i)
              (SheafOfModules.free.generatingSections PUnit.{u + 1}) }, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · constructor
    intro i
    infer_instance
  · constructor
    intro i
    constructor
    change Finite PUnit.{u + 1}
    infer_instance
  · intro i
    change Nat.card PUnit.{u + 1} = 1
    exact Nat.card_unique

name: SchemeKTheory.isUnit_k0ClassOf_of_rankOne
statement:
theorem isUnit_k0ClassOf_of_rankOne (Y : Scheme.{u}) (L : Y.Modules)
    (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1) :
    IsUnit (k0ClassOf Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree)
proof:
:= by
  have hD := (lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank L hL).isFiniteLocallyFree
  obtain ⟨q, hq, -, hcard⟩ := id hL
  letI := hq
  let e := fun i ↦ (exists_triv L q hcard i).some
  let T := tensorLineBundleDualIso L q.X q.coversTop e
  have hLD := tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree Y L (lineBundleDual Y L)
    hL.isFiniteLocallyFree hD
  have key : k0ClassOf Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree * k0ClassOf Y (lineBundleDual Y L) hD = 1 := by
    have hmul := k0ClassOf_mul Y ⟨L, hL.isFiniteLocallyFree⟩ ⟨lineBundleDual Y L, hD⟩
    change k0ClassOf Y L _ * k0ClassOf Y (lineBundleDual Y L) hD =
      k0ClassOf Y (tensorSheaf Y L (lineBundleDual Y L)) hLD at hmul
    rw [hmul]
    exact k0ClassOf_iso Y hLD (tensorUnitSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree Y) T
  exact ⟨⟨_, _, key, (mul_comm _ _).trans key⟩, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_away_kernel_of_principal
statement:
theorem rankTwo_away_kernel_of_principal
    (q : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (s f : A) (hs : s ∈ 𝒜 1) (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 1)
    (hker : RingHom.ker q.toRingHom = Ideal.span {s}) :
    RingHom.ker (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map q f) =
      Ideal.span {GradedIdealQuotient.awayEquation 𝒜 s f hs hf}
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨m, a, ha, rfl⟩ := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_surjective 𝒜 hf z
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker] at hz
    have hzval := congrArg HomogeneousLocalization.val hz
    simp only [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map_mk,
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.val_zero] at hzval
    rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk'] at hzval
    obtain ⟨⟨_, r, rfl⟩, hr⟩ := (IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff _ _).mp hzval
    have hmem : f ^ r * a ∈ Ideal.span {s} := by
      rw [← hker, RingHom.mem_ker]
      change q (f ^ r * a) = 0
      rw [map_mul, map_pow]
      exact hr
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hmem
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hmem
    let b' : 𝒜 (r + m) := DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 (b * f) (r + m)
    have hb' : (b' : A) * s = f ^ (r + 1) * a := by
      have hmul : (b * f) * s = f ^ (r + 1) * a := by
        calc
          (b * f) * s = f * (b * s) := by ring
          _ = f * (f ^ r * a) := by rw [hb]
          _ = f ^ (r + 1) * a := by ring
      calc
        (b' : A) * s =
            (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 ((b * f) * s) ((r + m) + 1) : A) := by
          exact (DirectSum.coe_decompose_mul_add_of_right_mem 𝒜 hs).symm
        _ = (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 (f ^ (r + 1) * a) ((r + m) + 1) : A) := by
          rw [hmul]
        _ = f ^ (r + 1) * a := by
          apply DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_same
          convert SetLike.mul_mem_graded (SetLike.pow_mem_graded (r + 1) hf) ha using 1
          simp [add_assoc, add_comm]
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
    refine ⟨HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk 𝒜 hf (r + m) b' (by simpa using b'.2), ?_⟩
    apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
    simp only [GradedIdealQuotient.awayEquation, HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul,
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, Localization.mk_mul]
    rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, Submonoid.coe_mul]
    rw [hb']
    ring
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    intro z hz
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
    subst z
    change HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map
      q f (GradedIdealQuotient.awayEquation 𝒜 s f hs hf) = 0
    rw [GradedIdealQuotient.awayEquation, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map_mk]
    apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
    simp only [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.val_zero]
    rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk', IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff]
    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul]
    change q.toRingHom s = 0
    rw [← RingHom.mem_ker, hker]
    exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton s)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_proj_kernel_basicOpen
statement:
theorem rankTwo_proj_kernel_basicOpen
    (q : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (hrel : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map q)
    [QuasiCompact (Proj.map q hrel)] (s f : A) (hs : s ∈ 𝒜 1) (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 1)
    (hker : RingHom.ker q.toRingHom = Ideal.span {s}) :
    (Proj.map q hrel).ker.ideal
      ⟨Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 f, Proj.isAffineOpen_basicOpen 𝒜 f hf Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ =
      Ideal.span {Proj.awayToSection 𝒜 f (GradedIdealQuotient.awayEquation 𝒜 s f hs hf)}
proof:
:= by
  let U : (Proj 𝒜).affineOpens :=
    ⟨Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 f, Proj.isAffineOpen_basicOpen 𝒜 f hf Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
  rw [Scheme.Hom.ker_apply]
  let eA := (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway 𝒜 f hf Nat.zero_lt_one).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  let eB := (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway ℬ (q f) (q.map_mem hf) Nat.zero_lt_one).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  have hcomm := Proj.awayToSection_comp_appLE q hrel hf
  have hcommRing : ((Proj.map q hrel).app U).hom.comp eA.toRingHom =
      eB.toRingHom.comp (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map q f) := by
    ext x
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom hcomm) x
  have hk : (RingHom.ker ((Proj.map q hrel).app U).hom).comap eA.toRingHom =
      Ideal.span {GradedIdealQuotient.awayEquation 𝒜 s f hs hf} := by
    rw [RingHom.comap_ker, hcommRing]
    exact (RingHom.ker_comp_of_injective _ eB.injective).trans
      (rankTwo_away_kernel_of_principal 𝒜 ℬ q s f hs hf hker)
  have hm := congrArg (Ideal.map eA.toRingHom) hk
  have hcancel : Ideal.map eA.toRingHom
      ((RingHom.ker ((Proj.map q hrel).app U).hom).comap eA.toRingHom) =
      RingHom.ker ((Proj.map q hrel).app U).hom :=
    Ideal.map_comap_eq_self_of_equiv eA _
  rw [hcancel, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton] at hm
  exact hm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_originalFst_uniformAway_kernel
statement:
theorem rankTwo_originalFst_uniformAway_kernel (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    (k : PUnit.{u+1} ⊕ PUnit.{u+1}) :
    letI
proof:
:= Module.Free.of_basis (rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis X U)
    letI := Module.Finite.of_basis (rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis X U)
    RingHom.ker (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map
      (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap (S := Γ(X, U))
        (quotientSectionMap
          (biprod.fst : tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) U))
      (linearForm Γ(X, U) ((tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op U))
        (rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis X U k))) =
      Ideal.span {tautChart_ratio Γ(X, U)
        ((tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op U))
        (rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis X U k)
        (rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis X U (Sum.inr PUnit.unit))} := by
  letI := Module.Free.of_basis (rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis X U)
  letI := Module.Finite.of_basis (rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis X U)
  let R := Γ(X,U)
  let M := (tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op U)
  let b := rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis X U
  let q := gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap (S := R)
    (quotientSectionMap (biprod.fst : tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) U)
  have hk : RingHom.ker q.toRingHom = Ideal.span {linearForm R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit))} := by
    rw [rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis_right X U]
    exact rankTwo_unitPair_fst_principal_kernel X U
  exact rankTwo_away_kernel_of_principal (symGrading R M) (symGrading R R) q
    (linearForm R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit))) (linearForm R M (b k))
    (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M _) (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M _) hk

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_snd_kernel_transport_native
statement:
theorem rankTwo_snd_kernel_transport_native (e : M ≃ₗ[R] (R × R)) :
    RingHom.ker (symmetricAlgebraMap (S := R)
      ((LinearMap.snd R R R).comp e.toLinearMap)) =
    Ideal.comap (rankTwo_symmetricAlgebraEquiv R e).toRingHom
      (Ideal.span {SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (R × R) (1, 0)})
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rankTwo_snd_symmetric_kernel R]
  ext a
  change symmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) ((LinearMap.snd R R R).comp e.toLinearMap) a = 0 ↔
    symmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) (LinearMap.snd R R R)
      (rankTwo_symmetricAlgebraEquiv R e a) = 0
  have h := congrArg (fun F => F a)
    (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap_comp (R := R) (S := R) (T := R)
      e.toLinearMap (LinearMap.snd R R R))
  exact iff_of_eq (congrArg (fun v => v = 0) h.symm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_snd_kernel_principal_native
statement:
theorem rankTwo_snd_kernel_principal_native (e : M ≃ₗ[R] (R × R)) :
    RingHom.ker (symmetricAlgebraMap (S := R)
      ((LinearMap.snd R R R).comp e.toLinearMap)) =
      Ideal.span {SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M (e.symm (1, 0))}
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankTwo_snd_kernel_transport_native R e]
  let E := rankTwo_symmetricAlgebraEquiv R e
  change Ideal.comap E.toRingEquiv.toRingHom
    (Ideal.span {SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (R × R) (1, 0)}) = _
  have hmap : Ideal.comap E.toRingEquiv.toRingHom
      (Ideal.span {SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (R × R) (1, 0)}) =
      Ideal.map E.symm.toRingEquiv.toRingHom
        (Ideal.span {SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (R × R) (1, 0)}) :=
    (Ideal.map_symm E.toRingEquiv).symm
  rw [hmap, Ideal.map_span]
  have h : E.symm.toRingEquiv.toRingHom (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (R × R) (1, 0)) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M (e.symm (1, 0)) :=
    SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply _ _
  simp only [Set.image_singleton, h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_originalSnd_sections_kernel
statement:
theorem rankTwo_originalSnd_sections_kernel (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens) :
    RingHom.ker (symmetricAlgebraMap (S := Γ(X,U))
      (quotientSectionMap
        (biprod.snd : tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) U)) =
      Ideal.span {linearForm Γ(X,U)
        ((tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op U))
        (rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis X U (Sum.inl PUnit.unit))}
proof:
:= by
  have h := rankTwo_snd_kernel_principal_native Γ(X,U) (rankTwo_unitPairSectionsEquiv X U)
  have he : (rankTwo_unitPairSectionsEquiv X U).symm (1, 0) =
      ((biprod.inl : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.app (op U))
        (1 : Γ(X,U)) := by
    change _ + ((biprod.inr : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.app (op U)).hom
      (0 : Γ(X,U)) = _
    have hz : ((biprod.inr : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.app (op U)).hom
        (0 : Γ(X,U)) = 0 := map_zero _
    rw [hz, add_zero]
  rw [he] at h
  rw [rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis_left X U]
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_tautComponent_back
statement:
theorem rankTwo_tautComponent_back (x m : M) :
    (space R M).presheaf.map
      (eqToHom (tautChart_image_preimage_top R M (linearOpen R M x)).symm).op
      (tautChart_component R M x m) = tautChart_ratioSection R M x m
proof:
:= by
  rw [tautChart_component, ← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  have he : (eqToHom (tautChart_image_preimage_top R M (linearOpen R M x))).op ≫
      (eqToHom (tautChart_image_preimage_top R M (linearOpen R M x)).symm).op =
      𝟙 (op (linearOpen R M x)) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [he, Functor.map_id_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_originalLeftChart_uniformKernel
statement:
theorem rankTwo_originalLeftChart_uniformKernel (i : C.I) (k : PUnit.{u+1} ⊕ PUnit.{u+1}) :
    (C.chartSection biprod.fst (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inl biprod.inl_fst) i).ker.ideal
      ⟨linearOpen Γ(X,C.U i) ((tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U i)))
        (rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis X (C.U i) k),
        Proj.isAffineOpen_basicOpen _ _ (linearForm_mem_degree_one _ _ _) Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ =
      Ideal.span {tautChart_ratioSection Γ(X,C.U i)
        ((tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U i)))
        (rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis X (C.U i) k)
        (rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis X (C.U i) (Sum.inr PUnit.unit))}
proof:
:= by
  let R := Γ(X,C.U i)
  let M := (tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U i))
  let b := rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis X (C.U i)
  let φ := quotientSectionMap
    (biprod.fst : tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) (C.U i)
  let hφ := quotientSectionMap_spans
    (biprod.fst : tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X)
    (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inl biprod.inl_fst) (C.U i)
  let P := symmetricProjMap (S := R) φ hφ
  let e := (C.isAffine i).isoSpec ≪≫ (asIso (rankOneToSpec R)).symm
  have he : e.hom ≫ P =
      C.chartSection biprod.fst (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inl biprod.inl_fst) i := by
    rw [chartSection, rankTwo_localSection_originalProjMap]
    exact Category.assoc _ _ _
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion
      (C.chartSection biprod.fst (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inl biprod.inl_fst) i) :=
    MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (rankTwo_originalLeftChart_isPullback C i).flip inferInstance
  haveI : QuasiCompact P := by
    have hc : QuasiCompact (C.chartSection biprod.fst
        (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inl biprod.inl_fst) i) := inferInstance
    haveI : QuasiCompact (e.hom ≫ P) := he.symm ▸ hc
    have h : e.inv ≫ (e.hom ≫ P) = P := by simp
    exact h ▸ inferInstance
  have hk : RingHom.ker (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) φ).toRingHom =
      Ideal.span {linearForm R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit))} := by
    rw [rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis_right X (C.U i)]
    exact rankTwo_unitPair_fst_principal_kernel X (C.U i)
  have hI : (C.chartSection biprod.fst
      (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inl biprod.inl_fst) i).ker = P.ker :=
    (congrArg Scheme.Hom.ker he.symm).trans (Scheme.Hom.ker_comp_of_isIso e.hom P)
  haveI : QuasiCompact (Proj.map (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) φ)
      (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ hφ)) := ‹QuasiCompact P›
  have hactual := rankTwo_proj_kernel_basicOpen (symGrading R M) (symGrading R R)
    (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) φ)
    (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ hφ)
    (linearForm R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit))) (linearForm R M (b k))
    (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M _) (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M _) hk
  exact (congrArg (fun I : (C.chart i).IdealSheafData => I.ideal
    ⟨linearOpen R M (b k), Proj.isAffineOpen_basicOpen _ _
      (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M _) Nat.zero_lt_one⟩) hI).trans hactual

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_originalRightChart_uniformKernel
statement:
theorem rankTwo_originalRightChart_uniformKernel (i : C.I) (k : PUnit.{u+1} ⊕ PUnit.{u+1}) :

  have he : e.hom ≫ P =
      C.chartSection biprod.snd (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd) i := by
    rw [chartSection, rankTwo_localSection_originalProjMap]

  haveI : IsClosedImmersion
      (C.chartSection biprod.snd (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd) i) :=
    MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (rankTwo_originalRightChart_isPullback C i).flip inferInstance
  haveI : QuasiCompact P := by

    exact h ▸ inferInstance
  have hk : RingHom.ker (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) φ).toRingHom =
      Ideal.span {linearForm R M (b (Sum.inl PUnit.unit))} := by

  have hI : (C.chartSection biprod.snd
      (surjective_app_of_split _ biprod.inr biprod.inr_snd) i).ker = P.ker :=
    (congrArg Scheme.Hom.ker he.symm).trans (Scheme.Hom.ker_comp_of_isIso e.hom P)
  haveI : QuasiCompact (Proj.map (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) φ)
      (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ hφ)) := ‹QuasiCompact P›
  have hactual := rankTwo_proj_kernel_basicOpen (symGrading R M) (symGrading R R)
    (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) φ)
    (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ hφ)
    (linearForm R M (b (Sum.inl PUnit.unit))) (linearForm R M (b k))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_originalGlobal_inr_uniformComponent
statement:
theorem rankTwo_originalGlobal_inr_uniformComponent (i : C.I)
    (k : PUnit.{u+1} ⊕ PUnit.{u+1}) :

:= Γ(X,C.U i)
    let M := (tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U i))

theorem rankTwo_originalUniformLinearOpen_covers (x : C.scheme) :

        ((tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U i)))
        (rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis X (C.U i) k)
proof:
:= by

proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.wFrameSec_pullbackWFrame
statement:
theorem wFrameSec_pullbackWFrame {Y : Scheme.{u}} (j : Y ⟶ X)
    (d : WFrame L x) (t : Γ(L, ⊤)) (c : Γ(X, d.U))
    (hc : wFrameSec d d.U le_rfl c = L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : d.U ≤ ⊤)).op t)
    (p : Y) (hp : j p ∈ d.U) :
    wFrameSec (WFrame.ofData (pullbackWFrame j d p hp)) (WFrame.ofData (pullbackWFrame j d p hp)).U
        le_rfl (j.app d.U c) =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj L).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_top : (WFrame.ofData (pullbackWFrame j d p hp)).U ≤ ⊤)).op
        (wPullbackSection j t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [wFrameSec_smul (WFrame.ofData (pullbackWFrame j d p hp))
    (WFrame.ofData (pullbackWFrame j d p hp)).U le_rfl, wFrameSec_one, wFrameGen_pullbackWFrame]
  have e1 := hc
  rw [wFrameSec_smul d d.U le_rfl, wFrameSec_one] at e1
  have h1 := congrArg (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j).unit.app L).app d.U) e1
  have h2 := C1Cap.app_presheaf_map ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j).unit.app L)
    (homOfLE (le_top : d.U ≤ ⊤)) t
  have h3 := Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j).unit.app L)
    c (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_refl d.U)).op (wFrameGen d))
  have h4 := C1Cap.app_presheaf_map ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j).unit.app L)
    (homOfLE (le_refl d.U)) (wFrameGen d)
  exact (h2.symm.trans (h1.symm.trans (h3.trans (congrArg (fun z ↦ c • z) h4)))).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.sectionCoordSec_pullbackWFrame
statement:
theorem sectionCoordSec_pullbackWFrame {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Y] (j : Y ⟶ X)
    (d : WFrame L x) (t : Γ(L, ⊤)) (c : Γ(X, d.U))
    (hc : wFrameSec d d.U le_rfl c = L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : d.U ≤ ⊤)).op t)
    (p : Y) (hp : j p ∈ d.U) :
    sectionCoordSec (pullbackWFrame j d p hp) (wPullbackSection j t) = j.app d.U c
proof:
:= by
  apply C1Cap.frameSec_injective (pullbackWFrame j d p hp) _ le_rfl
  rw [sectionCoordSec_spec, frameSec_eq_wFrameSec]
  exact (wFrameSec_pullbackWFrame j d t c hc p hp).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.eqOfSection_pullback
statement:
theorem eqOfSection_pullback {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Y] (j : Y ⟶ X) (s : Γ(L, ⊤)) (y : Y) :
    (eqOfSection L hL s).pullback j y =
      Y.presheaf.germ (pullbackWFrame j (wFrameAt L hL (j y)) y (wFrameAt L hL (j y)).mem).U y
        (pullbackWFrame j (wFrameAt L hL (j y)) y (wFrameAt L hL (j y)).mem).mem
        (sectionCoordSec (pullbackWFrame j (wFrameAt L hL (j y)) y (wFrameAt L hL (j y)).mem)
          (wPullbackSection j s))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sectionCoordSec_pullbackWFrame j (wFrameAt L hL (j y)) s _ (wCoord_spec _ s) y]
  exact Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply j _ y _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.isProperForD_of_pullbackFrames
statement:
theorem isProperForD_of_pullbackFrames {n : ℕ} (g : DimRelationGenerator X n)
    (a : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) {M : g.Y.Modules}
    (F : ∀ y : g.Y, Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData g.Y M y) (s' : Γ(M, ⊤))
    (hpull : ∀ y, a.pullback g.i y =
      g.Y.presheaf.germ (F y).U y (F y).mem (sectionCoordSec (F y) s'))
    (hη : IsUnit (a.pullback g.i (genericPoint g.Y)))
    (hf : ∀ w : g.Y, coheight w = 1 → ¬ IsUnitAt g.f w → IsUnit (a.pullback g.i w)) :
    IsProperForD g a
proof:
:= by
  haveI : NoetherianSpace g.Y := g.i.isClosedEmbedding.isInducing.noetherianSpace
  have hassoc : ∀ ⦃x y : g.Y⦄ (h : x ⤳ y),
      Associated ((g.Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom (a.pullback g.i y)) (a.pullback g.i x) := by
    intro x y h
    have hx' : x ∈ (F y).U := h.mem_open (F y).U.isOpen (F y).mem
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := germ_sectionCoordSec_eq_mul_unit (F x) (F y) s' x (F x).mem hx'
    rw [hpull y, hpull x, g.Y.presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes_apply (F y).mem h, hu]
    exact (associated_mul_isUnit_left_iff u.isUnit).mpr (Associated.refl _)
  have hopen : IsOpen {y : g.Y | IsUnit (a.pullback g.i y)} := by
    rw [isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open]
    intro w hw
    refine ⟨(g.Y.basicOpen (sectionCoordSec (F w) s') : Set g.Y), fun w' hw' ↦ ?_,
      (g.Y.basicOpen _).isOpen, ?_⟩
    · have hU : w' ∈ (F w).U := g.Y.basicOpen_le _ hw'
      have h1 := (g.Y.mem_basicOpen (sectionCoordSec (F w) s') w' hU).mp hw'
      obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := germ_sectionCoordSec_eq_mul_unit (F w') (F w) s' w' (F w').mem hU
      rw [hu] at h1
      show IsUnit (a.pullback g.i w')
      rw [hpull w']
      exact isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left h1
    · refine (g.Y.mem_basicOpen (sectionCoordSec (F w) s') w (F w).mem).mpr ?_
      rw [← hpull w]
      exact hw
  have hcl : IsClosed {y : g.Y | IsUnit (a.pullback g.i y)}ᶜ := hopen.isClosed_compl
  have hηF : genericPoint g.Y ∉ {y : g.Y | IsUnit (a.pullback g.i y)}ᶜ := fun h ↦ h hη
  refine ⟨fun y ↦ ?_, hassoc, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h0
    have h1 := hassoc (genericPoint_specializes y)
    rw [h0, map_zero] at h1
    exact hη.ne_zero ((associated_zero_iff_eq_zero _).mp h1.symm)
  · refine (finite_coheight_one_of_isClosed hcl hηF).subset ?_
    rintro w ⟨hw1, hw⟩
    exact ⟨fun hu ↦ ((IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).mp hw) hu, hw1⟩
  · intro w hw1 hw
    by_contra hnu
    exact ((IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).mp hw) (hf w hw1 hnu)

statement:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.restrictedEq_eq_sectionCoord
statement:
theorem restrictedEq_eq_sectionCoord (x : X) (s : Γ(L, ⊤)) (z : pointClosureScheme x) :
    restrictedEq x (eqOfSection L hL s) z =
      sectionCoord (closureFrame (hL := hL) x z) (wPullbackSection (pointClosureι x) s)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty (pointClosureι x ⁻¹ᵁ (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι x z)).U) :=
    ⟨⟨z, (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι x z)).mem⟩⟩
  unfold restrictedEq sectionCoord closureFrame
  rw [sectionCoordSec_pullbackWFrame (pointClosureι x) (wFrameAt L hL (pointClosureι x z)) s _
    (wCoord_spec _ s) z]
  unfold eqOfSection
  erw [Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply]
  rw [Scheme.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField]
  rfl
