name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.exists_section_units
statement:
theorem exists_section_units [Infinite k] (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hG : WGenerated L) {n : ℕ} (g : DimRelationGenerator X n) (P : Set g.Y) (hP : P.Finite) :
    ∃ s : Γ(L, ⊤), ∀ w ∈ P, IsUnit ((eqOfSection L hL s).pullback g.i w)
proof:
:= by
  choose s0 d0 c0 hc0 using fun w : g.Y ↦ hG (g.i w)
  haveI : Finite P := hP.to_subtype
  letI : Module k Γ(L, ⊤) := Module.compHom _ (scalarHomW (k := k) (X := X))
  letI : ∀ w : P, Module k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (g.Y.presheaf.stalk (w : g.Y))) :=
    fun w ↦ Module.compHom _ (residueScalarHomW (k := k) g.i (w : g.Y))
  let F0 : ∀ w : g.Y, Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData g.Y
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g.i).obj L) w :=
    fun w ↦ pullbackWFrame g.i (d0 w) w (d0 w).mem
  have hφ : ∀ w : P, coordResidueLinearW (k := k) L g.i (w : g.Y) (F0 w) ≠ 0 := by
    intro w h0
    have := LinearMap.congr_fun h0 (s0 w)
    change IsLocalRing.residue _ _ = 0 at this
    rw [IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff] at this
    apply (IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal (R := g.Y.presheaf.stalk (w : g.Y))).mpr ?_ this
    have hs := sectionCoordSec_pullbackWFrame g.i (d0 w) (s0 w) (c0 w) (hc0 w).1 w (d0 w).mem
    change IsUnit (g.Y.presheaf.germ (F0 w).U w (F0 w).mem
      (sectionCoordSec (F0 w) (wPullbackSection g.i (s0 w))))
    rw [hs]
    have hu := (hc0 w).2.map (g.i.stalkMap w).hom
    rw [Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply] at hu
    exact hu
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_forall_ne_zero_of_infinite (K := k)
    (fun w : P ↦ coordResidueLinearW (k := k) L g.i (w : g.Y) (F0 w)) hφ
  refine ⟨s, fun w hw ↦ ?_⟩
  have h1 := hs ⟨w, hw⟩
  change IsLocalRing.residue _ _ ≠ 0 at h1
  rw [Ne, IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff] at h1
  have hu0 := IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal.mp h1
  rw [eqOfSection_pullback g.i s w]
  exact (isUnit_germ_sectionCoordSec_iff (F0 w)
    (pullbackWFrame g.i (wFrameAt L hL (g.i w)) w (wFrameAt L hL (g.i w)).mem)
    (wPullbackSection g.i s) w (F0 w).mem
    (pullbackWFrame g.i (wFrameAt L hL (g.i w)) w (wFrameAt L hL (g.i w)).mem).mem).mpr hu0

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.movingFrames_of_wgenerated
statement:
theorem movingFrames_of_wgenerated [Infinite k] (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (n : ℕ) (hG : WGenerated L) : MovingFrames L n
proof:
:= fun g ↦ by
  haveI : NoetherianSpace g.Y := g.i.isClosedEmbedding.isInducing.noetherianSpace
  obtain ⟨F0, hFc, hFη, hF⟩ := exists_closed_not_isUnitAt g.f g.hf
  have hfin : {w : g.Y | coheight w = 1 ∧ ¬ IsUnitAt g.f w}.Finite :=
    (finite_coheight_one_of_isClosed hFc hFη).subset fun w ⟨h1, h2⟩ ↦
      ⟨by_contra fun hw ↦ h2 (hF w hw), h1⟩
  have hP : ({genericPoint g.Y} ∪ {w : g.Y | coheight w = 1 ∧ ¬ IsUnitAt g.f w} : Set g.Y).Finite :=
    (Set.finite_singleton _).union hfin
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_section_units (k := k) L hL hG g _ hP
  have h₁ : IsProperForD g (eqOfSection L hL s) :=
    isProperForD_of_pullbackFrames g (eqOfSection L hL s)
      (fun y ↦ pullbackWFrame g.i (wFrameAt L hL (g.i y)) y (wFrameAt L hL (g.i y)).mem)
      (wPullbackSection g.i s) (eqOfSection_pullback g.i s)
      (hs _ (Or.inl rfl)) (fun w hw1 hw ↦ hs _ (Or.inr ⟨hw1, hw⟩))
  exact ⟨_, fun _ ↦ 1, h₁, isProperForD_one g, fun x hx hne ↦
    ⟨closureFramesOfSection g s h₁ hne⟩⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.capDescends_of_generated_nonintegral
statement:
theorem capDescends_of_generated_nonintegral [Infinite k] (L : X.Modules)
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (n : ℕ) (hG : WGenerated L) :
    CapDescends (k := k) L hL n
proof:
:=
  capDescends_of_movingFrames (k := k) L hL n (movingFrames_of_wgenerated (k := k) L hL n hG)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.primeCap_tensor
statement:
theorem primeCap_tensor (L B : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hB : HasConstantRank X B 1) (hT : HasConstantRank X (tensorSheaf X L B) 1) (n : ℕ) (v : X)
    (hv : height v = n + 1) :
    primeCap (k := k) (tensorSheaf X L B) hT n v hv =
      primeCap (k := k) L hL n v hv + primeCap (k := k) B hB n v hv
proof:
:= by
  let P := pointClosureι v
  have hfL := isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL v
  have hfM := isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure B hB v
  have hfLM := isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure (tensorSheaf X L B) hT v
  have hrL := genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one L hL v
  have hrM := genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one B hB v
  have hrLM := genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one (tensorSheaf X L B) hT v
  obtain ⟨b⟩ := Scheme.Modules.exists_lineBundleLocalDataAt (pointClosureScheme v)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P).obj L) hfL hrL (pointClosureGenericPoint v)
  obtain ⟨c⟩ := Scheme.Modules.exists_lineBundleLocalDataAt (pointClosureScheme v)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P).obj B) hfM hrM (pointClosureGenericPoint v)
  haveI : IsIso (pullbackTensorSheafHom P L B) :=
    pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_isFiniteLocallyFree P L B hL.isFiniteLocallyFree
      hB.isFiniteLocallyFree
  let e := asIso (pullbackTensorSheafHom P L B)
  have hTT : IsFiniteLocallyFree (pointClosureScheme v)
      (tensorSheaf (pointClosureScheme v) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P).obj L)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P).obj B)) :=
    isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso _ e hfLM
  have hrT : SingularCurve.genericRank (pointClosureScheme v)
      (tensorSheaf (pointClosureScheme v) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P).obj L)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P).obj B)) = 1 :=
    (SingularCurve.genericRank_iso (pointClosureScheme v) e).symm.trans hrLM
  let bLM := (b.tensor c).mapIso e.symm
  have hdiv : Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hfLM hrLM bLM =
      Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hfL hrL b +
        Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hfM hrM c := by
    rw [e4_weilDivisor_mapIso hTT hfLM hrT hrLM (b.tensor c) e.symm,
      Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame_tensor hfL hfM hTT hrL hrM hrT b c]
  have hsum : properPushforward P
      (Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hfLM hrLM bLM).1 =
      properPushforward P (Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hfL hrL b).1 +
        properPushforward P (Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hfM hrM c).1 := by
    rw [hdiv, ← properPushforward_add]
    rfl
  rw [primeCap_eq (k := k) _ hT n v hv bLM, primeCap_eq (k := k) L hL n v hv b,
    primeCap_eq (k := k) B hB n v hv c, ← QuotientAddGroup.mk_add]
  congr 1
  exact Subtype.ext hsum

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.primeCap_iso
statement:
theorem primeCap_iso (A T : X.Modules) (hA : HasConstantRank X A 1)
    (hT : HasConstantRank X T 1) (e : A ≅ T) (n : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = n + 1) :
    primeCap (k := k) A hA n v hv = primeCap (k := k) T hT n v hv
proof:
:= by
  let P := pointClosureι v
  have hfA := isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure A hA v
  have hfT := isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure T hT v
  have hrA := genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one A hA v
  have hrT := genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one T hT v
  obtain ⟨b⟩ := Scheme.Modules.exists_lineBundleLocalDataAt (pointClosureScheme v)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P).obj T) hfT hrT (pointClosureGenericPoint v)
  let e' : (Scheme.Modules.pullback P).obj A ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback P).obj T :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback P).mapIso e
  let bA := b.mapIso e'.symm
  have hdiv : Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hfA hrA bA =
      Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hfT hrT b :=
    e4_weilDivisor_mapIso hfT hfA hrT hrA b e'.symm
  rw [primeCap_eq (k := k) A hA n v hv bA, primeCap_eq (k := k) T hT n v hv b]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  change properPushforward P _ = properPushforward P _
  rw [hdiv]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.primeCapOrZero_tensor
statement:
theorem primeCapOrZero_tensor (L B : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hB : HasConstantRank X B 1) (hT : HasConstantRank X (tensorSheaf X L B) 1) (n : ℕ) (v : X) :
    primeCapOrZero (k := k) (tensorSheaf X L B) hT n v =
      primeCapOrZero (k := k) L hL n v + primeCapOrZero (k := k) B hB n v
proof:
:= by
  unfold primeCapOrZero
  by_cases hv : height v = n + 1
  · rw [dif_pos hv, dif_pos hv, dif_pos hv]
    exact primeCap_tensor (k := k) L B hL hB hT n v hv
  · rw [dif_neg hv, dif_neg hv, dif_neg hv, add_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.capCycles_tensor
statement:
theorem capCycles_tensor (L B : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hB : HasConstantRank X B 1) (hT : HasConstantRank X (tensorSheaf X L B) 1) (n : ℕ)
    (D : dimensionCycles X (n + 1)) :
    capCycles (k := k) (tensorSheaf X L B) hT n D =
      capCycles (k := k) L hL n D + capCycles (k := k) B hB n D
proof:
:= by
  change (compactCycleFinsupp D.1).sum
      (fun v m ↦ m • primeCapOrZero (k := k) (tensorSheaf X L B) hT n v) =
    (compactCycleFinsupp D.1).sum (fun v m ↦ m • primeCapOrZero (k := k) L hL n v) +
      (compactCycleFinsupp D.1).sum (fun v m ↦ m • primeCapOrZero (k := k) B hB n v)
  rw [← Finsupp.sum_add]
  refine Finsupp.sum_congr fun v _ ↦ ?_
  rw [primeCapOrZero_tensor (k := k) L B hL hB hT n v]
  exact zsmul_add _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.capCycles_iso
statement:
theorem capCycles_iso (A T : X.Modules) (hA : HasConstantRank X A 1)
    (hT : HasConstantRank X T 1) (e : A ≅ T) (n : ℕ) (D : dimensionCycles X (n + 1)) :
    capCycles (k := k) A hA n D = capCycles (k := k) T hT n D
proof:
:= by
  change (compactCycleFinsupp D.1).sum (fun v m ↦ m • primeCapOrZero (k := k) A hA n v) =
    (compactCycleFinsupp D.1).sum (fun v m ↦ m • primeCapOrZero (k := k) T hT n v)
  refine Finsupp.sum_congr fun v _ ↦ ?_
  unfold primeCapOrZero
  by_cases hv : height v = n + 1
  · rw [dif_pos hv, dif_pos hv, primeCap_iso (k := k) A T hA hT e n v hv]
  · rw [dif_neg hv, dif_neg hv]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.capDescends_of_tensor
statement:
theorem capDescends_of_tensor (L B : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hB : HasConstantRank X B 1) (hT : HasConstantRank X (tensorSheaf X L B) 1) (n : ℕ)
    (hTd : CapDescends (k := k) (tensorSheaf X L B) hT n) (hBd : CapDescends (k := k) B hB n) :
    CapDescends (k := k) L hL n
proof:
:= fun g ↦ by
  have h := capCycles_tensor (k := k) L B hL hB hT n g.cycle
  rw [hTd g, hBd g, add_zero] at h
  exact h.symm

proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.wGenerated_pullback
statement:
theorem wGenerated_pullback {P : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral P] (j : X ⟶ P) {M : P.Modules}
    (h : ∀ q : P, ∃ t : Γ(M, ⊤), ∃ d : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData P M q,
      IsUnit (P.presheaf.germ d.U q d.mem (sectionCoordSec d t))) :
    WGenerated ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj M)
proof:
:= fun p ↦ by
  obtain ⟨t, d, hu⟩ := h (j p)
  have hc : wFrameSec (WFrame.ofData d) d.U le_rfl (sectionCoordSec d t) =
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : d.U ≤ ⊤)).op t :=
    (frameSec_eq_wFrameSec d _ _ _).symm.trans (sectionCoordSec_spec d t)
  refine ⟨wPullbackSection j t, WFrame.ofData (pullbackWFrame j (WFrame.ofData d) p d.mem),
    j.app d.U (sectionCoordSec d t),
    wFrameSec_pullbackWFrame j (WFrame.ofData d) t _ hc p d.mem, ?_⟩
  have := hu.map (j.stalkMap p).hom
  rw [Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply] at this
  exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.capDescends_of_generatedDifference_nonintegral
statement:
theorem capDescends_of_generatedDifference_nonintegral [Infinite k] (L B A : X.Modules)
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (hB : HasConstantRank X B 1) (ψ : tensorSheaf X L B ≅ A)
    (hA : WGenerated A) (hBg : WGenerated B) (n : ℕ) : CapDescends (k := k) L hL n
proof:
:= by
  have hT : HasConstantRank X (tensorSheaf X L B) 1 := by
    have h := hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hL hB
    rwa [Nat.one_mul] at h
  have hA' : HasConstantRank X A 1 := hasConstantRank_of_iso ψ hT
  have hAd := capDescends_of_generated_nonintegral (k := k) A hA' n hA
  have hBd := capDescends_of_generated_nonintegral (k := k) B hB n hBg
  refine capDescends_of_tensor (k := k) L B hL hB hT n (fun g ↦ ?_) hBd
  rw [capCycles_iso (k := k) _ A hT hA' ψ n g.cycle]
  exact hAd g

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D23.capDescends_of_hasAmpleGenerators_nonintegral
statement:

    CapDescends (k := k) L hL n
proof:

  exact capDescends_of_generatedDifference_nonintegral (k := k) L B (tensorSheaf X L B) hL hB
    (Iso.refl _) hAg hBg n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.xiCap_pow_pullbackProjectiveMap_flat
statement:
theorem xiCap_pow_pullbackProjectiveMap_flat [Flat g] (j : ℕ) :
    letI
proof:
:= pullbackProjectiveMap_isOver (k := k) C g
    letI := pullbackProjectiveMap_flat C g
    totalPull ops (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) d (C.pullbackProjectiveMap_pureRelDim k g d hd) ∘ₗ
      ((xiCap ops C) ^ j) =
    ((xiCap ops (C.pullbackFrameCover g)) ^ j) ∘ₗ
      totalPull ops (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) d (C.pullbackProjectiveMap_pureRelDim k g d hd) := by
  letI := pullbackProjectiveMap_isOver (k := k) C g
  letI := pullbackProjectiveMap_flat C g
  have h := cp.cap_pull (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) d
    (C.pullbackProjectiveMap_pureRelDim k g d hd)
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
  rw [← xiCap_pullbackFrameCover C g ops cp] at h
  exact (Module.End.commute_pow_left_of_commute h.symm j).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.projection_totalPull_flat
proof:
:= pullbackProjectiveMap_isOver (k := k) C g
    letI := pullbackProjectiveMap_flat C g
    letI := C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos r))
    let D := C.pullbackFrameCover g
    let hD := C.pullbackFrameCover_card g hC
    letI := D.toBase_flat (D.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hD (Nat.succ_pos r))
    totalPull ops (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) d (C.pullbackProjectiveMap_pureRelDim k g d hd) ∘ₗ
      totalPull ops C.toBase r (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC) =
    totalPull ops D.toBase r (cp.projBundle_relDim D hD) ∘ₗ
      totalPull ops g d hd := by
  letI := pullbackProjectiveMap_isOver (k := k) C g
  letI := pullbackProjectiveMap_flat C g
  letI := C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos r))
  let D := C.pullbackFrameCover g
  let hD := C.pullbackFrameCover_card g hC
  letI := D.toBase_flat (D.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hD (Nat.succ_pos r))
  have hleft := cp.pull_comp (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) C.toBase d r
    (C.pullbackProjectiveMap_pureRelDim k g d hd) (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC)
    (PureRelDim.comp (C.pullbackProjectiveMap_pureRelDim k g d hd) (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC))
  have hright := cp.pull_comp D.toBase g r d (cp.projBundle_relDim D hD)
    hd
    (PureRelDim.comp (cp.projBundle_relDim D hD) hd)
  simp only [Nat.add_comm d r] at hright
  exact hleft.symm.trans ((totalPull_congr ops (C.pullbackProjectiveMap_toBase g) (r + d) _ _).trans hright)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.projection_push_pull_flat
statement:
theorem projection_push_pull_flat [Flat g] :
    letI
proof:
:= pullbackProjectiveMap_isOver (k := k) C g
    letI := pullbackProjectiveMap_flat C g
    totalPull ops g d hd ∘ₗ totalPush ops C.toBase =
      totalPush ops (C.pullbackFrameCover g).toBase ∘ₗ
        totalPull ops (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) d
          (C.pullbackProjectiveMap_pureRelDim k g d hd) := by
  letI := pullbackProjectiveMap_isOver (k := k) C g
  letI := pullbackProjectiveMap_flat C g
  exact cp.base_change C.toBase g (C.pullbackFrameCover g).toBase
    (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) d hd (C.pullbackProjectiveMap_pureRelDim k g d hd)
    (C.isPullback_pullbackProjectiveMap g)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.sandwich_pull_flat
statement:
theorem sandwich_pull_flat [Flat g] {r : ℕ}
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = r + 1) (j : ℕ) :
    totalPull ops g d hd ∘ₗ sandwich ops C cp hC j =
      sandwich ops (C.pullbackFrameCover g) cp (C.pullbackFrameCover_card g hC) j ∘ₗ
        totalPull ops g d hd
proof:
:= by
  letI := pullbackProjectiveMap_isOver (k := k) C g
  letI := pullbackProjectiveMap_flat C g
  letI := C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos r))
  let D := C.pullbackFrameCover g
  let hD := C.pullbackFrameCover_card g hC
  letI := D.toBase_flat (D.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hD (Nat.succ_pos r))
  let PG := totalPull ops g d hd
  let PF := totalPull ops (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) d (C.pullbackProjectiveMap_pureRelDim k g d hd)
  let PC := totalPull ops C.toBase r (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC)
  let PD := totalPull ops D.toBase r (cp.projBundle_relDim D hD)
  have hb : PG ∘ₗ totalPush ops C.toBase = totalPush ops D.toBase ∘ₗ PF :=
    projection_push_pull_flat C g ops cp d hd
  have hp : PF ∘ₗ ((xiCap ops C) ^ j) = ((xiCap ops D) ^ j) ∘ₗ PF :=
    xiCap_pow_pullbackProjectiveMap_flat C g ops cp d hd j
  have hc : PF ∘ₗ PC = PD ∘ₗ PG := projection_totalPull_flat C g ops cp d hd hC
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro α
  change PG (totalPush ops C.toBase ((((xiCap ops C) ^ j)) (PC α))) =
    totalPush ops D.toBase ((((xiCap ops D) ^ j)) (PD (PG α)))
  calc
    _ = totalPush ops D.toBase (PF ((((xiCap ops C) ^ j)) (PC α))) :=
      LinearMap.congr_fun hb _
    _ = totalPush ops D.toBase ((((xiCap ops D) ^ j)) (PF (PC α))) :=
      congrArg (totalPush ops D.toBase) (LinearMap.congr_fun hp (PC α))
    _ = _ := congrArg (fun z => totalPush ops D.toBase ((((xiCap ops D) ^ j)) z))
      (LinearMap.congr_fun hc α)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.segre_pull_flat
statement:
theorem segre_pull_flat [Flat g] {r : ℕ}
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = r + 1) (i : ℕ) :
    totalPull ops g d hd ∘ₗ segre ops C cp hC i =
      segre ops (C.pullbackFrameCover g) cp (C.pullbackFrameCover_card g hC) i ∘ₗ
        totalPull ops g d hd
proof:
:=
  sandwich_pull_flat C g ops cp d hd hC (r + i)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.segreOp_pull_flat
statement:
theorem segreOp_pull_flat [Flat g] (L : Y.Modules) (r : ℕ)
    (hL : HasConstantRank Y L r) (i : ℕ) :
    totalPull ops g d hd ∘ₗ segreOp ops cp L r hL i =
      segreOp ops cp ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj L) r
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X g L r hL) i ∘ₗ
        totalPull ops g d hd
proof:
:= by
  cases r with
  | zero => exact segreOp_pull_rankZero g ops cp d hd L hL i
  | succ r =>
    let C := (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hL).choose
    have hC := (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hL).choose_spec
    rw [segreOp_eq_segre ops cp C hL hC,
      segreOp_eq_segre ops cp (C.pullbackFrameCover g)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X g L (r + 1) hL) (C.pullbackFrameCover_card g hC)]
    exact segre_pull_flat C g ops cp d hd hC i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictPushforwardBaseChangeIso_hom_app
statement:
theorem restrictPushforwardBaseChangeIso_hom_app
    (i : X ⟶ Z) (j : Y ⟶ Z) (f : W ⟶ X) (g : W ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion i] [IsOpenImmersion g]
    (hp : IsPullback f g i j) (M : Y.Modules)
    (U : X.Opens) :
    ((restrictPushforwardBaseChangeIso i j f g hp).hom.app M).app U =
      M.presheaf.map
        (eqToHom
          (IsOpenImmersion.image_preimage_eq_preimage_image_of_isPullback
            hp U)).op
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  exact restrictPushforwardBaseChangeIso_hom_app_apply
    i j f g hp M U x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullbackUnit_restrictFunctorIsoPullback_inv
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem pullbackUnit_restrictFunctorIsoPullback_inv
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    (M : Y.Modules) :
    (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app M ≫
        (pushforward f).map
          ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback f).inv.app M) =
      (restrictAdjunction f).unit.app M
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app
    (restrictAdjunction f)
    (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f) M]
  unfold restrictFunctorIsoPullback
  slice_lhs 2 3 =>
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, Iso.hom_inv_id_app]
    exact (pushforward f).map_id _
  exact Category.comp_id _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullbackUnit_restrictFunctorIsoPullback_inv_app_apply
statement:
theorem pullbackUnit_restrictFunctorIsoPullback_inv_app_apply
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    (M : Y.Modules) (U : Y.Opens) (x : Γ(M, U)) :
    ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback f).inv.app M).app (f ⁻¹ᵁ U)
        (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app M).app U x) =
      ((restrictAdjunction f).unit.app M).app U x
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ.app U)
    (pullbackUnit_restrictFunctorIsoPullback_inv f M)
  rw [Hom.comp_app] at h
  change
    Hom.app ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app M) U ≫
        Hom.app ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback f).inv.app M) (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) =
      Hom.app ((restrictAdjunction f).unit.app M) U at h
  exact congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ.hom x) h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictUnit_restrictFunctorIsoPullback_hom
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem restrictUnit_restrictFunctorIsoPullback_hom
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    (M : Y.Modules) :
    (restrictAdjunction f).unit.app M ≫
        (pushforward f).map
          ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback f).hom.app M) =
      (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app M
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pullbackUnit_restrictFunctorIsoPullback_inv f M]
  rw [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id_app]
  exact Category.comp_id _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.presheaf_map_comp_eq
statement:
theorem presheaf_map_comp_eq
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (M : X.Modules)
    {U V W : X.Opens} (f : U ⟶ V) (g : V ⟶ W)
    (h : U ⟶ W) :
    M.presheaf.map g.op ≫ M.presheaf.map f.op =
      M.presheaf.map h.op
proof:
:= by
  calc
    M.presheaf.map g.op ≫ M.presheaf.map f.op =
        M.presheaf.map (g.op ≫ f.op) :=
      (M.presheaf.map_comp g.op f.op).symm
    _ = M.presheaf.map h.op :=
      congrArg M.presheaf.map (Subsingleton.elim _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.presheaf_map_eq
statement:
theorem presheaf_map_eq
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (M : X.Modules)
    {U V : X.Opens} (f g : U ⟶ V) :
    M.presheaf.map f.op = M.presheaf.map g.op
proof:
:=
  congrArg M.presheaf.map (congrArg Quiver.Hom.op
    (Subsingleton.elim f g))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.presheaf_map_comp_eq_op
statement:
theorem presheaf_map_comp_eq_op
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (M : X.Modules)
    {U V W : X.Opensᵒᵖ} (f : U ⟶ V) (g : V ⟶ W)
    (h : U ⟶ W) :
    M.presheaf.map f ≫ M.presheaf.map g =
      M.presheaf.map h
proof:
:= by
  calc
    M.presheaf.map f ≫ M.presheaf.map g =
        M.presheaf.map (f ≫ g) :=
      (M.presheaf.map_comp f g).symm
    _ = M.presheaf.map h :=
      congrArg M.presheaf.map (Subsingleton.elim _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.presheaf_map_eq_op
statement:
theorem presheaf_map_eq_op
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (M : X.Modules)
    {U V : X.Opensᵒᵖ} (f g : U ⟶ V) :
    M.presheaf.map f = M.presheaf.map g
proof:
:=
  congrArg M.presheaf.map (Subsingleton.elim f g)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.presheaf_map_comp₃_eq_op
statement:
theorem presheaf_map_comp₃_eq_op
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (M : X.Modules)
    {U V W Z : X.Opensᵒᵖ}
    (f : U ⟶ V) (g : V ⟶ W) (k : W ⟶ Z)
    (h : U ⟶ Z) :
    (M.presheaf.map f ≫ M.presheaf.map g) ≫
        M.presheaf.map k =
      M.presheaf.map h
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (M.presheaf.map f ≫ M.presheaf.map g) ≫
        M.presheaf.map k =
        M.presheaf.map ((f ≫ g) ≫ k) := by
      rw [M.presheaf.map_comp, M.presheaf.map_comp]
    _ = M.presheaf.map h :=
      congrArg M.presheaf.map (Subsingleton.elim _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.preimage_image_eq_image_of_comp_of_open
statement:
theorem preimage_image_eq_image_of_comp_of_open
    {W X Y : Scheme.{u}} (a : W ⟶ X) (e : X ⟶ Y)
    (b : W ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion a] [IsOpenImmersion e]
    [IsOpenImmersion b] (h : a ≫ e = b) (U : W.Opens) :
    e ⁻¹ᵁ (b ''ᵁ U) = a ''ᵁ U
proof:
:= by
  apply Opens.ext
  ext x
  change
    (∃ y, y ∈ U ∧ b y = e x) ↔
      ∃ y, y ∈ U ∧ a y = x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
    refine ⟨y, hy, ?_⟩
    apply e.isOpenEmbedding.injective
    calc
      e (a y) = b y := by
        simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using
          congrArg (fun f ↦ f y) h
      _ = e x := hxy
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
    refine ⟨y, hy, ?_⟩
    calc
      b y = e (a y) := by
        simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using
          (congrArg (fun f ↦ f y) h).symm
      _ = e x := congrArg _ hxy

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.image_image_eq_image_of_comp_of_open
statement:
theorem image_image_eq_image_of_comp_of_open
    {W X Y : Scheme.{u}} (a : W ⟶ X) (e : X ⟶ Y)
    (b : W ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion a] [IsOpenImmersion e]
    [IsOpenImmersion b] (h : a ≫ e = b) (U : W.Opens) :
    e ''ᵁ (a ''ᵁ U) = b ''ᵁ U
proof:
:= by
  apply Opens.ext
  ext x
  change
    (∃ z, (∃ y, y ∈ U ∧ a y = z) ∧ e z = x) ↔
      ∃ y, y ∈ U ∧ b y = x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, hzx⟩
    refine ⟨y, hy, ?_⟩
    calc
      b y = e (a y) := by
        simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using
          (congrArg (fun f ↦ f y) h).symm
      _ = x := hzx
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
    refine ⟨a y, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    calc
      e (a y) = b y := by
        simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using
          congrArg (fun f ↦ f y) h
      _ = x := hxy

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistLocalChartLeft_normalization
statement:
theorem twistLocalChartLeft_normalization
    {d : ℤ} (T : C.TwistTransitionSystem d) (i j k : C.I) :
    let H
proof:
:= C.twistChosenPullback₃ i j k
    ((@Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction _ _ H.p₁
        (C.twistRecovery_triple_p₁_isOpenImmersion i j k)).homEquiv
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)
          ((@Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor _ _ H.p₂₃
              (C.twistRecovery_triple_p₂₃_isOpenImmersion i j k)).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (C.overlapToChart j k)).obj
              (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j)))).symm
        ((C.twistLocalChartComponent T i j ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι i)).map
              (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit
                ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).toAmbient j)
                ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).left (j, k))
                ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).module j))) ≫
          (C.twistTripleOverlapTargetBaseChangeIso T i j k).hom) ≫
      (C.twistTripleMiddleRestrictIso i j k).hom =
        (C.twistTripleRestrictTransitionIJ T i j k).hom := by
  dsimp only
  let H := C.twistChosenPullback₃ i j k
  letI : IsOpenImmersion H.p₁ :=
    C.twistRecovery_triple_p₁_isOpenImmersion i j k
  letI : IsOpenImmersion H.p₂₃ :=
    C.twistRecovery_triple_p₂₃_isOpenImmersion i j k
  letI : IsOpenImmersion H.p₁₂ :=
    C.twistRecovery_triple_p₁₂_isOpenImmersion i j k
  letI : IsOpenImmersion H.p₂ :=
    C.twistRecovery_triple_p₂_isOpenImmersion i j k
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.overlapToChart j k) :=
    C.overlapToChart_isOpenImmersion j k
  letI : IsOpenImmersion
      (C.twistChosenPullback j k).p₁ := by
    change IsOpenImmersion (C.overlapToChart j k)
    infer_instance
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.transition i j) :=
    C.transition_isOpenImmersion' i j
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.overlapToChart j i) :=
    C.overlapToChart_isOpenImmersion j i
  letI : IsOpenImmersion
      (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i) :=
    IsOpenImmersion.comp _ _
  letI : IsOpenImmersion
      (C.glueData.chosenPullback i j).p₂ := by
    change IsOpenImmersion
      (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i)
    infer_instance
  simp [twistLocalChartComponent,
    twistTripleOverlapTargetBaseChangeIso,
    twistTripleMiddleRestrictIso,
    Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit]
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_symm_apply]
  ext U : 1
  have hOpen :
      C.overlapToChart j k ⁻¹ᵁ
          (C.chartι j ⁻¹ᵁ
            (C.chartι i ''ᵁ (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U))) =
        H.p₂₃ ''ᵁ U := by
    have hbc :=
      IsOpenImmersion.image_preimage_eq_preimage_image_of_isPullback
        (C.twistChosenPullback₃_isPullback_over_overlap23 i j k)
        (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U)
    rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_image_eq H.p₁ U] at hbc
    exact hbc.symm
  have hIJ :
      C.overlapToChart i j ⁻¹ᵁ (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U) =
        H.p₁₂ ''ᵁ U := by
    apply Opens.ext
    ext x
    change
      (∃ y, y ∈ U ∧ H.p₁ y = C.overlapToChart i j x) ↔
        ∃ y, y ∈ U ∧ H.p₁₂ y = x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
      refine ⟨y, hy, ?_⟩
      apply (C.overlapToChart i j).isOpenEmbedding.injective
      calc
        C.overlapToChart i j (H.p₁₂ y) =
            (C.twistChosenPullback i j).p₁ (H.p₁₂ y) := by
          rfl
        _ = H.p₁ y := by
          simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using
            congrArg (fun f ↦ f y) H.p₁₂_p₁
        _ = C.overlapToChart i j x := hxy
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
      refine ⟨y, hy, ?_⟩
      calc
        H.p₁ y =
            (C.twistChosenPullback i j).p₁ (H.p₁₂ y) := by
          simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using
            (congrArg (fun f ↦ f y) H.p₁₂_p₁).symm
        _ = C.overlapToChart i j (H.p₁₂ y) := by
          rfl
        _ = C.overlapToChart i j x := congrArg _ hxy
  have hJK :
      C.overlapToChart j k ⁻¹ᵁ (H.p₂ ''ᵁ U) =
        H.p₂₃ ''ᵁ U := by
    apply Opens.ext
    ext x
    change
      (∃ y, y ∈ U ∧ H.p₂ y = C.overlapToChart j k x) ↔
        ∃ y, y ∈ U ∧ H.p₂₃ y = x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
      refine ⟨y, hy, ?_⟩
      apply (C.overlapToChart j k).isOpenEmbedding.injective
      calc
        C.overlapToChart j k (H.p₂₃ y) =
            (C.twistChosenPullback j k).p₁ (H.p₂₃ y) := by
          rfl
        _ = H.p₂ y := by
          simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using
            congrArg (fun f ↦ f y) H.p₂₃_p₂
        _ = C.overlapToChart j k x := hxy
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
      refine ⟨y, hy, ?_⟩
      calc
        H.p₂ y =
            (C.twistChosenPullback j k).p₁ (H.p₂₃ y) := by
          simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using
            (congrArg (fun f ↦ f y) H.p₂₃_p₂).symm
        _ = C.overlapToChart j k (H.p₂₃ y) := by
          rfl
        _ = C.overlapToChart j k x := congrArg _ hxy
  have hMiddle :
      C.chartι j ⁻¹ᵁ
          (C.chartι i ''ᵁ (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U)) =
        H.p₂ ''ᵁ U := by
    calc
      C.chartι j ⁻¹ᵁ
          (C.chartι i ''ᵁ (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U)) =
          (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i) ''ᵁ
            (C.overlapToChart i j ⁻¹ᵁ
              (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U)) :=
        (IsOpenImmersion.image_preimage_eq_preimage_image_of_isPullback
          (C.glueData.chosenPullback i j).isPullback
          (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U)).symm
      _ = (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i) ''ᵁ
          (H.p₁₂ ''ᵁ U) :=
        congrArg
          (fun V ↦
            (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i) ''ᵁ V)
          hIJ
      _ = H.p₂ ''ᵁ U := by
        apply Opens.ext
        ext x
        change
          (∃ z, z ∈ (H.p₁₂ ''ᵁ U) ∧
            (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i)
              z = x) ↔
            ∃ y, y ∈ U ∧ H.p₂ y = x
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨z, hz, hzx⟩
          change ∃ y, y ∈ U ∧ H.p₁₂ y = z at hz
          obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hz
          refine ⟨y, hy, ?_⟩
          calc
            H.p₂ y =
                (C.twistChosenPullback i j).p₂ (H.p₁₂ y) := by
              simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using
                (congrArg (fun f ↦ f y) H.p₁₂_p₂).symm
            _ =
                (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i)
                  (H.p₁₂ y) := by
              rfl
            _ = x := hzx
        · rintro ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
          refine ⟨H.p₁₂ y, ?_, ?_⟩
          · change ∃ y', y' ∈ U ∧ H.p₁₂ y' = H.p₁₂ y
            exact ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
          calc
            (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i)
                (H.p₁₂ y) =
                (C.twistChosenPullback i j).p₂ (H.p₁₂ y) := by
              rfl
            _ = H.p₂ y := by
              simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using
                congrArg (fun f ↦ f y) H.p₁₂_p₂
            _ = x := hxy
  have hPairTarget :
      (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i) ''ᵁ
          (H.p₁₂ ''ᵁ U) =
        H.p₂ ''ᵁ U := by
    calc
      (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i) ''ᵁ
          (H.p₁₂ ''ᵁ U) =
          (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i) ''ᵁ
            (C.overlapToChart i j ⁻¹ᵁ
              (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U)) :=
        congrArg
          (fun V ↦
            (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i) ''ᵁ V)
          hIJ.symm
      _ = C.chartι j ⁻¹ᵁ
          (C.chartι i ''ᵁ (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U)) :=
        IsOpenImmersion.image_preimage_eq_preimage_image_of_isPullback
          (C.glueData.chosenPullback i j).isPullback
          (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U)
      _ = H.p₂ ''ᵁ U := hMiddle
  have hBeforeEta :
      (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i) ''ᵁ
          (H.p₁₂ ''ᵁ U) =
        C.chartι j ⁻¹ᵁ
          (C.chartι i ''ᵁ (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U)) :=
    hPairTarget.trans hMiddle.symm
  simp
  simp_rw [CommonBasicOpen.twistPullHomAux_restrictFunctor_map_app]
  simp_rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictPushforwardBaseChangeIso_inv_app]
  simp_rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictPushforwardBaseChangeIso_hom_app]
  simp_rw [Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app]
  simp_rw [Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp_hom_app_app]
  simp_rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app]
  simp [twistTripleRestrictTransitionIJ,
    twistRestrictTransitionAlongIso]
  have hR :=
    (C.twistRestrictTransitionIso T i j).hom.mapPresheaf.naturality
      (eqToHom hIJ).op
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.mapPresheaf_app,
    Opposite.unop_op] at hR
  have hη :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
      (C.overlapToChart j k)).unit.app
        (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j)).mapPresheaf.naturality
      (eqToHom hMiddle).op
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.mapPresheaf_app,
    Opposite.unop_op] at hη
  have hηBefore :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
      (C.overlapToChart j k)).unit.app
        (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j)).mapPresheaf.naturality
      (eqToHom hBeforeEta.symm).op
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.mapPresheaf_app,
    Opposite.unop_op] at hηBefore
  have hBeforeEtaD :
      (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i) ''ᵁ
          (H.p₁₂ ''ᵁ U) =
        (C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).toAmbient j ⁻¹ᵁ
          (C.chartι i ''ᵁ (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U)) := by
    change
      (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i) ''ᵁ
          (H.p₁₂ ''ᵁ U) =
        C.chartι j ⁻¹ᵁ
          (C.chartι i ''ᵁ (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U))
    exact hBeforeEta
  have hηBeforeD :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
      ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).left (j, k))).unit.app
        ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).module j)).mapPresheaf.naturality
      (eqToHom hBeforeEtaD.symm).op
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.mapPresheaf_app,
    Opposite.unop_op] at hηBeforeD
  change
    (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j).presheaf.map
        (eqToHom hBeforeEtaD.symm).op ≫ _ = _ at hηBeforeD
  dsimp only [H] at hηBeforeD
  have hPBOpen :
      (C.twistChosenPullback j k).p₁ ⁻¹ᵁ
          ((C.transition i j ≫
            C.overlapToChart j i) ''ᵁ (H.p₁₂ ''ᵁ U)) =
        H.p₂₃ ''ᵁ U := by
    change
      C.overlapToChart j k ⁻¹ᵁ
          ((C.transition i j ≫
            C.overlapToChart j i) ''ᵁ (H.p₁₂ ''ᵁ U)) =
        H.p₂₃ ''ᵁ U
    exact
      (congrArg
        (fun V ↦ C.overlapToChart j k ⁻¹ᵁ V)
        hPairTarget).trans hJK
  have hPB :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback
      (C.twistChosenPullback j k).p₁).inv.app
        (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j)).mapPresheaf.naturality
      (eqToHom hPBOpen.symm).op
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.mapPresheaf_app,
    Opposite.unop_op] at hPB
  have hUnitPB :=
    congrArg
      (fun φ ↦ φ.app
        ((C.transition i j ≫
          C.overlapToChart j i) ''ᵁ (H.p₁₂ ''ᵁ U)))
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackUnit_restrictFunctorIsoPullback_inv
        (C.twistChosenPullback j k).p₁
        (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j))
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app,
    Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app] at hUnitPB
  dsimp only [H] at hUnitPB
  change
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
          ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).left (j, k))).unit.app
            ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).module j))
        ((C.transition i j ≫
          C.overlapToChart j i) ''ᵁ
            ((C.twistChosenPullback₃ i j k).p₁₂ ''ᵁ U)) ≫
      _ = _ at hUnitPB
  let fPre :
      C.overlapToChart i j ''ᵁ (H.p₁₂ ''ᵁ U) ⟶
        H.p₁ ''ᵁ U :=
    homOfLE (by
      rw [← hIJ]
      exact (C.overlapToChart i j).image_preimage_le _)
  let fLeft :
      C.overlapToChart i j ''ᵁ
          (C.overlapToChart i j ⁻¹ᵁ (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U)) ⟶
        H.p₁ ''ᵁ U :=
    homOfLE ((C.overlapToChart i j).image_preimage_le _)
  have hSource :
      (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i).presheaf.map fPre.op ≫
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
            (C.overlapToChart i j)).obj
              (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)).presheaf.map
                (eqToHom hIJ).op =
        (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i).presheaf.map fLeft.op := by
    change
      (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i).presheaf.map fPre.op ≫
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i).presheaf.map
            ((C.overlapToChart i j).opensFunctor.map
              (eqToHom hIJ)).op =
        (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i).presheaf.map fLeft.op
    exact Scheme.Modules.presheaf_map_comp_eq
      (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)
      ((C.overlapToChart i j).opensFunctor.map
        (eqToHom hIJ)) fPre fLeft
  rw [← hSource]
  rw [Category.assoc]
  slice_lhs 2 3 =>
    rw [hR]
  simp_rw [CommonBasicOpen.twistPullHomAux_restrictFunctor_map_app]
  slice_lhs 3 4 =>
    unfold twistingSheafDescentData
    unfold Scheme.Modules.DescentData.ofGlueData
    change
      (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j).presheaf.map
          (((C.transition i j ≫
            C.overlapToChart j i).opensFunctor.map
              (eqToHom hIJ)).op) ≫
        (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j).presheaf.map _
    rw [Scheme.Modules.presheaf_map_comp_eq_op
      (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j)
      (h := eqToHom (congrArg Opposite.op hBeforeEta))]
  slice_lhs 3 3 =>
    rw [Scheme.Modules.presheaf_map_eq_op
      (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j)
      (g := (eqToHom hBeforeEtaD.symm).op)]
  slice_lhs 3 4 =>
    rw [hηBeforeD]
  slice_lhs 4 5 =>
    erw [Category.comp_id]
  slice_lhs 4 6 =>
    change
      ((((Scheme.Modules.pullback
          (C.twistChosenPullback j k).p₁).obj
            (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j)).presheaf.map _ ≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
          (C.twistChosenPullback j k).p₁).obj
            (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j)).presheaf.map _) ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
        (C.twistChosenPullback j k).p₁).obj
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j)).presheaf.map _)
    rw [Scheme.Modules.presheaf_map_comp₃_eq_op
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
        (C.twistChosenPullback j k).p₁).obj
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j))
      (h := (eqToHom hPBOpen.symm).op)]
  slice_lhs 4 5 =>
    rw [hPB]
  slice_lhs 3 4 =>
    rw [hUnitPB]
  simp_rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app]
  slice_lhs 3 5 =>
    change
      (((C.chartTwistingSheaf d j).presheaf.map _ ≫
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j).presheaf.map _) ≫
        (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j).presheaf.map _)
    rw [Scheme.Modules.presheaf_map_comp₃_eq_op
      (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j)
      (h := (eqToHom hPairTarget.symm).op)]
  slice_rhs 1 2 =>
    erw [(C.chartTwistingSheaf d i).presheaf.map_id]
    erw [Category.id_comp]
  slice_rhs 3 4 =>
