      (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j).presheaf.map _ ≫
        (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j).presheaf.map _
    rw [Scheme.Modules.presheaf_map_comp_eq_op
      (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j)
      (h := (eqToHom hPairTarget.symm).op)]
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc]
  congr 1

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistLocalChartRight_normalization
statement:
theorem twistLocalChartRight_normalization
    {d : ℤ} (T : C.TwistTransitionSystem d) (i j k : C.I) :
    let H
proof:
:= C.twistChosenPullback₃ i j k
    ((@Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction _ _ H.p₁
        (C.twistRecovery_triple_p₁_isOpenImmersion i j k)).homEquiv
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)
          ((@Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor _ _ H.p₂₃
              (C.twistRecovery_triple_p₂₃_isOpenImmersion i j k)).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (C.overlapToChart j k)).obj
              (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j)))).symm
        (((C.twistLocalChartComponent T i k ≫
              (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι i)).map
                (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit
                  ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).toAmbient k)
                  ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).right (j, k))
                  ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).module k))) ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι i)).map
              ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr
                ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).fac
                  (j, k)).symm).hom.app
                    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
                      ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).right
                        (j, k))).obj
                          ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).module k))) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι i)).map
            ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
              ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).left (j, k) ≫
                (C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).toAmbient j)).map
              ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).transition
                (j, k)).inv)) ≫
          (C.twistTripleOverlapTargetBaseChangeIso T i j k).hom) ≫
      (C.twistTripleMiddleRestrictIso i j k).hom =
      (C.twistTripleRestrictTransitionIK T i j k).hom ≫
        (C.twistTripleRestrictTransitionJK T i j k).inv := by
  dsimp only
  let H := C.twistChosenPullback₃ i j k
  letI : IsOpenImmersion H.p₁ :=
    C.twistRecovery_triple_p₁_isOpenImmersion i j k
  letI : IsOpenImmersion H.p₂₃ :=
    C.twistRecovery_triple_p₂₃_isOpenImmersion i j k
  letI : IsOpenImmersion H.p₂ :=
    C.twistRecovery_triple_p₂_isOpenImmersion i j k
  letI : IsOpenImmersion H.p₁₂ :=
    C.twistRecovery_triple_p₁₂_isOpenImmersion i j k
  letI : IsOpenImmersion H.p₁₃ :=
    C.twistRecovery_triple_p₁₃_isOpenImmersion i j k
  letI : IsOpenImmersion H.p₃ :=
    C.twistRecovery_triple_p₃_isOpenImmersion i j k
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.overlapToChart j k) :=
    C.overlapToChart_isOpenImmersion j k
  letI : IsOpenImmersion
      ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).left (j, k)) := by
    change IsOpenImmersion (C.overlapToChart j k)
    infer_instance
  letI : IsOpenImmersion
      (C.twistChosenPullback j k).p₁ := by
    change IsOpenImmersion (C.overlapToChart j k)
    infer_instance
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.transition j k) :=
    C.transition_isOpenImmersion' j k
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.overlapToChart k j) :=
    C.overlapToChart_isOpenImmersion k j
  letI : IsOpenImmersion
      (C.transition j k ≫ C.overlapToChart k j) :=
    IsOpenImmersion.comp _ _
  letI : IsOpenImmersion
      ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).right (j, k)) := by
    change IsOpenImmersion
      (C.transition j k ≫ C.overlapToChart k j)
    infer_instance
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.overlapToChart i k) :=
    C.overlapToChart_isOpenImmersion i k
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.transition i k) :=
    C.transition_isOpenImmersion' i k
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.overlapToChart k i) :=
    C.overlapToChart_isOpenImmersion k i
  letI : IsOpenImmersion
      (C.transition i k ≫ C.overlapToChart k i) :=
    IsOpenImmersion.comp _ _
  letI : IsOpenImmersion
      (C.glueData.chosenPullback i k).p₂ := by
    change IsOpenImmersion
      (C.transition i k ≫ C.overlapToChart k i)
    infer_instance
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.overlapToChart i j) :=
    C.overlapToChart_isOpenImmersion i j
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.transition i j) :=
    C.transition_isOpenImmersion' i j
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.overlapToChart j i) :=
    C.overlapToChart_isOpenImmersion j i
  letI : IsOpenImmersion
      (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i) :=
    IsOpenImmersion.comp _ _
  letI : IsOpenImmersion
      (C.glueData.chosenPullback i j).p₂ := by
    change IsOpenImmersion
      (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i)
    infer_instance
  simp [twistLocalChartComponent,
    twistTripleOverlapTargetBaseChangeIso,
    twistTripleMiddleRestrictIso,
    Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit]
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_symm_apply]
  ext U : 1
  have hOpen :
      C.overlapToChart j k ⁻¹ᵁ
          (C.chartι j ⁻¹ᵁ
            (C.chartι i ''ᵁ (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U))) =
        H.p₂₃ ''ᵁ U := by
    have hbc :=
      IsOpenImmersion.image_preimage_eq_preimage_image_of_isPullback
        (C.twistChosenPullback₃_isPullback_over_overlap23 i j k)
        (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U)
    rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_image_eq H.p₁ U] at hbc
    exact hbc.symm
  have hIK :
      C.overlapToChart i k ⁻¹ᵁ (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U) =
        H.p₁₃ ''ᵁ U :=
    Scheme.Modules.preimage_image_eq_image_of_comp_of_open
      H.p₁₃ (C.overlapToChart i k) H.p₁
        H.p₁₃_p₁ U
  have hIKTarget :
      (C.transition i k ≫ C.overlapToChart k i) ''ᵁ
          (H.p₁₃ ''ᵁ U) =
        H.p₃ ''ᵁ U :=
    Scheme.Modules.image_image_eq_image_of_comp_of_open
      H.p₁₃
      (C.transition i k ≫ C.overlapToChart k i)
      H.p₃ H.p₁₃_p₃ U
  have hAmbientK :
      C.chartι k ⁻¹ᵁ
          (C.chartι i ''ᵁ (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U)) =
        H.p₃ ''ᵁ U := by
    calc
      C.chartι k ⁻¹ᵁ
          (C.chartι i ''ᵁ (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U)) =
          (C.transition i k ≫ C.overlapToChart k i) ''ᵁ
            (C.overlapToChart i k ⁻¹ᵁ
              (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U)) :=
        (IsOpenImmersion.image_preimage_eq_preimage_image_of_isPullback
          (C.glueData.chosenPullback i k).isPullback
          (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U)).symm
      _ = (C.transition i k ≫ C.overlapToChart k i) ''ᵁ
          (H.p₁₃ ''ᵁ U) :=
        congrArg
          (fun V ↦
            (C.transition i k ≫ C.overlapToChart k i) ''ᵁ V)
          hIK
      _ = H.p₃ ''ᵁ U := hIKTarget
  have hBeforeEtaK :
      (C.transition i k ≫ C.overlapToChart k i) ''ᵁ
          (H.p₁₃ ''ᵁ U) =
        C.chartι k ⁻¹ᵁ
          (C.chartι i ''ᵁ (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U)) :=
    hIKTarget.trans hAmbientK.symm
  have hBeforeEtaKD :
      (C.transition i k ≫ C.overlapToChart k i) ''ᵁ
          (H.p₁₃ ''ᵁ U) =
        (C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).toAmbient k ⁻¹ᵁ
          (C.chartι i ''ᵁ (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U)) := by
    change
      (C.transition i k ≫ C.overlapToChart k i) ''ᵁ
          (H.p₁₃ ''ᵁ U) =
        C.chartι k ⁻¹ᵁ
          (C.chartι i ''ᵁ (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U))
    exact hBeforeEtaK
  have hRightPre :
      (C.transition j k ≫ C.overlapToChart k j) ⁻¹ᵁ
          (H.p₃ ''ᵁ U) =
        H.p₂₃ ''ᵁ U :=
    Scheme.Modules.preimage_image_eq_image_of_comp_of_open
      H.p₂₃
      (C.transition j k ≫ C.overlapToChart k j)
      H.p₃ H.p₂₃_p₃ U
  have hRightPreBefore :
      (C.transition j k ≫ C.overlapToChart k j) ⁻¹ᵁ
          ((C.transition i k ≫ C.overlapToChart k i) ''ᵁ
            (H.p₁₃ ''ᵁ U)) =
        H.p₂₃ ''ᵁ U :=
    (congrArg
      (fun V ↦
        (C.transition j k ≫ C.overlapToChart k j) ⁻¹ᵁ V)
      hIKTarget).trans hRightPre
  have hRightImage :
      (C.transition j k ≫ C.overlapToChart k j) ''ᵁ
          (H.p₂₃ ''ᵁ U) =
        H.p₃ ''ᵁ U :=
    Scheme.Modules.image_image_eq_image_of_comp_of_open
      H.p₂₃
      (C.transition j k ≫ C.overlapToChart k j)
      H.p₃ H.p₂₃_p₃ U
  have hKTarget :
      (C.transition j k ≫ C.overlapToChart k j) ''ᵁ
          (H.p₂₃ ''ᵁ U) =
        (C.transition i k ≫ C.overlapToChart k i) ''ᵁ
          (H.p₁₃ ''ᵁ U) :=
    hRightImage.trans hIKTarget.symm
  have hOpenD :
      (C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).left (j, k) ⁻¹ᵁ
          ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).toAmbient j ⁻¹ᵁ
            (C.chartι i ''ᵁ (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U))) =
        H.p₂₃ ''ᵁ U := by
    change
      C.overlapToChart j k ⁻¹ᵁ
          (C.chartι j ⁻¹ᵁ
            (C.chartι i ''ᵁ (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U))) =
        H.p₂₃ ''ᵁ U
    exact hOpen
  have hRightPreBeforeD :
      (C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).right (j, k) ⁻¹ᵁ
          ((C.transition i k ≫ C.overlapToChart k i) ''ᵁ
            (H.p₁₃ ''ᵁ U)) =
        H.p₂₃ ''ᵁ U := by
    change
      (C.transition j k ≫ C.overlapToChart k j) ⁻¹ᵁ
          ((C.transition i k ≫ C.overlapToChart k i) ''ᵁ
            (H.p₁₃ ''ᵁ U)) =
        H.p₂₃ ''ᵁ U
    exact hRightPreBefore
  have hPreTransportD :
      (C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).left (j, k) ⁻¹ᵁ
          ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).toAmbient j ⁻¹ᵁ
            (C.chartι i ''ᵁ (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U))) =
        (C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).right (j, k) ⁻¹ᵁ
          ((C.transition i k ≫ C.overlapToChart k i) ''ᵁ
            (H.p₁₃ ''ᵁ U)) :=
    hOpenD.trans hRightPreBeforeD.symm
  have hIJ :
      C.overlapToChart i j ⁻¹ᵁ (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U) =
        H.p₁₂ ''ᵁ U :=
    Scheme.Modules.preimage_image_eq_image_of_comp_of_open
      H.p₁₂ (C.overlapToChart i j) H.p₁
        H.p₁₂_p₁ U
  have hPairTarget :
      (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i) ''ᵁ
          (H.p₁₂ ''ᵁ U) =
        H.p₂ ''ᵁ U :=
    Scheme.Modules.image_image_eq_image_of_comp_of_open
      H.p₁₂
      (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i)
      H.p₂ H.p₁₂_p₂ U
  have hMiddle :
      C.chartι j ⁻¹ᵁ
          (C.chartι i ''ᵁ (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U)) =
        H.p₂ ''ᵁ U := by
    calc
      C.chartι j ⁻¹ᵁ
          (C.chartι i ''ᵁ (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U)) =
          (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i) ''ᵁ
            (C.overlapToChart i j ⁻¹ᵁ
              (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U)) :=
        (IsOpenImmersion.image_preimage_eq_preimage_image_of_isPullback
          (C.glueData.chosenPullback i j).isPullback
          (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U)).symm
      _ = (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i) ''ᵁ
          (H.p₁₂ ''ᵁ U) :=
        congrArg
          (fun V ↦
            (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i) ''ᵁ V)
          hIJ
      _ = H.p₂ ''ᵁ U := hPairTarget
  simp
  simp_rw [CommonBasicOpen.twistPullHomAux_restrictFunctor_map_app]
  simp_rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictPushforwardBaseChangeIso_inv_app]
  simp_rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictPushforwardBaseChangeIso_hom_app]
  simp_rw [Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app]
  simp_rw [Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp_hom_app_app]
  simp_rw [Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr_hom_app_app]
  simp_rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app]
  simp [twistTripleRestrictTransitionIK,
    twistTripleRestrictTransitionJK,
    twistRestrictTransitionAlongIso]
  have hRIK :=
    (C.twistRestrictTransitionIso T i k).hom.mapPresheaf.naturality
      (eqToHom hIK).op
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.mapPresheaf_app,
    Opposite.unop_op] at hRIK
  have hRJKOpen :=
    (C.twistRestrictTransitionIso T j k).inv.mapPresheaf.naturality
      (eqToHom hOpenD.symm).op
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.mapPresheaf_app,
    Opposite.unop_op] at hRJKOpen
  change
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
          ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).right (j, k))).obj
            ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).module k)).presheaf.map
        (eqToHom hOpenD.symm).op ≫
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
        (C.twistRestrictTransitionIso T j k).inv
        (H.p₂₃ ''ᵁ U) =
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
        (C.twistRestrictTransitionIso T j k).inv
        ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).left (j, k) ⁻¹ᵁ
          ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).toAmbient j ⁻¹ᵁ
            (C.chartι i ''ᵁ (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U)))) ≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
          ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).left (j, k))).obj
            ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).module j)).presheaf.map
          (eqToHom hOpenD.symm).op at hRJKOpen
  have hηBeforeKD :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
      ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).right (j, k))).unit.app
        ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).module k)).mapPresheaf.naturality
      (eqToHom hBeforeEtaKD.symm).op
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.mapPresheaf_app,
    Opposite.unop_op] at hηBeforeKD
  change
    (C.chartTwistingSheaf d k).presheaf.map
        (eqToHom hBeforeEtaKD.symm).op ≫ _ = _ at hηBeforeKD
  have hUnitRightBefore :=
    congrArg
      (fun φ ↦ φ.app
        ((C.transition i k ≫ C.overlapToChart k i) ''ᵁ
          (H.p₁₃ ''ᵁ U)))
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnit_restrictFunctorIsoPullback_hom
        ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).right (j, k))
        ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).module k))
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app,
    Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app] at hUnitRightBefore
  let hConvRight :=
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback
      ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).right
        (j, k))).hom.app
          ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).module k)
  have hConvRightNat :=
    hConvRight.mapPresheaf.naturality
      (eqToHom hPreTransportD).op
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.mapPresheaf_app,
    Opposite.unop_op] at hConvRightNat
  dsimp only [hConvRight] at hConvRightNat
  let hConvLeft :=
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback
      ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).left
        (j, k))).inv.app
          ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).module j)
  have hConvLeftNat :=
    hConvLeft.mapPresheaf.naturality
      (eqToHom hOpenD.symm).op
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.mapPresheaf_app,
    Opposite.unop_op] at hConvLeftNat
  dsimp only [hConvLeft] at hConvLeftNat
  let fPre :
      C.overlapToChart i k ''ᵁ (H.p₁₃ ''ᵁ U) ⟶
        H.p₁ ''ᵁ U :=
    homOfLE (by
      rw [← hIK]
      exact (C.overlapToChart i k).image_preimage_le _)
  let fLeft :
      C.overlapToChart i k ''ᵁ
          (C.overlapToChart i k ⁻¹ᵁ (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U)) ⟶
        H.p₁ ''ᵁ U :=
    homOfLE ((C.overlapToChart i k).image_preimage_le _)
  have hSource :
      (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i).presheaf.map fPre.op ≫
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
            (C.overlapToChart i k)).obj
              (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)).presheaf.map
                (eqToHom hIK).op =
        (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i).presheaf.map fLeft.op := by
    change
      (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i).presheaf.map fPre.op ≫
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i).presheaf.map
            ((C.overlapToChart i k).opensFunctor.map
              (eqToHom hIK)).op =
        (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i).presheaf.map fLeft.op
    exact Scheme.Modules.presheaf_map_comp_eq
      (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)
      ((C.overlapToChart i k).opensFunctor.map
        (eqToHom hIK)) fPre fLeft
  rw [← hSource]
  rw [Category.assoc]
  slice_lhs 2 3 =>
    rw [hRIK]
  simp_rw [CommonBasicOpen.twistPullHomAux_restrictFunctor_map_app]
  slice_lhs 3 4 =>
    unfold twistingSheafDescentData
    unfold Scheme.Modules.DescentData.ofGlueData
    change
      (C.chartTwistingSheaf d k).presheaf.map
          (((C.transition i k ≫
            C.overlapToChart k i).opensFunctor.map
              (eqToHom hIK)).op) ≫
        (C.chartTwistingSheaf d k).presheaf.map _
    rw [Scheme.Modules.presheaf_map_comp_eq_op
      (C.chartTwistingSheaf d k)
      (h := eqToHom (congrArg Opposite.op hBeforeEtaK))]
  slice_lhs 3 3 =>
    rw [Scheme.Modules.presheaf_map_eq_op
      (C.chartTwistingSheaf d k)
      (g := (eqToHom hBeforeEtaKD.symm).op)]
  slice_lhs 3 4 =>
    rw [hηBeforeKD]
  slice_lhs 3 3 =>
    rw [← hUnitRightBefore]
  simp_rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app]
  slice_lhs 5 6 =>
    erw [Category.comp_id]
  slice_lhs 5 6 =>
    change
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
          ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).right (j, k))).obj
            ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).module k)).presheaf.map _ ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
        ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).right (j, k))).obj
          ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).module k)).presheaf.map _
    rw [Scheme.Modules.presheaf_map_comp_eq_op
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
        ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).right (j, k))).obj
          ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).module k))
      (h := (eqToHom hPreTransportD).op)]
  slice_lhs 4 5 =>
    rw [← hConvRightNat]
  slice_lhs 7 8 =>
    change
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
          ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).left (j, k))).obj
            ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).module j)).presheaf.map _ ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
        ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).left (j, k))).obj
          ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).module j)).presheaf.map _
    rw [Scheme.Modules.presheaf_map_comp_eq_op
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
        ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).left (j, k))).obj
          ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).module j))
      (h := (eqToHom hOpenD.symm).op)]
  slice_lhs 7 8 =>
    change
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
          ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).left (j, k))).obj
            ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).module j)).presheaf.map _ ≫
        Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback
            ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).left
              (j, k))).inv.app
                ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).module j))
          (H.p₂₃ ''ᵁ U)
    rw [hConvLeftNat]
  slice_lhs 5 7 =>
    change
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
        (C.twistRestrictTransitionIso T j k).inv
        ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).left (j, k) ⁻¹ᵁ
          ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).toAmbient j ⁻¹ᵁ
            (C.chartι i ''ᵁ (H.p₁ ''ᵁ U))))
  slice_lhs 5 6 =>
    erw [← hRJKOpen]
  slice_lhs 3 5 =>
    change
      (((C.chartTwistingSheaf d k).presheaf.map _ ≫
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d k).presheaf.map _) ≫
        (C.chartTwistingSheaf d k).presheaf.map _)
    rw [Scheme.Modules.presheaf_map_comp₃_eq_op
      (C.chartTwistingSheaf d k)
      (h := (eqToHom hKTarget).op)]
  slice_rhs 4 5 =>
    erw [(C.chartTwistingSheaf d k).presheaf.map_id]
    erw [Category.id_comp]
  slice_rhs 3 4 =>
    change
      (C.chartTwistingSheaf d k).presheaf.map _ ≫
        (C.chartTwistingSheaf d k).presheaf.map _
    rw [Scheme.Modules.presheaf_map_comp_eq_op
      (C.chartTwistingSheaf d k)
      (h := (eqToHom hKTarget).op)]
  simp only [← Category.assoc]
  congr 1

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistLocalChartComponent_compatibility
statement:
theorem twistLocalChartComponent_compatibility
    {d : ℤ} (T : C.TwistTransitionSystem d)
    (hT : C.TwistTransitionLaws T) (i j k : C.I) :
    C.twistLocalChartComponent T i j ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι i)).map
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit
            ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).toAmbient j)
            ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).left (j, k))
            ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).module j)) =
      ((C.twistLocalChartComponent T i k ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι i)).map
            (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit
              ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).toAmbient k)
              ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).right (j, k))
              ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).module k))) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι i)).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr
            ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).fac
              (j, k)).symm).hom.app
                ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
                  ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).right
                    (j, k))).obj
                      ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).module k))) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι i)).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
          ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).left (j, k) ≫
            (C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).toAmbient j)).map
          ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).transition
            (j, k)).inv))
proof:
:= by
  let H := C.twistChosenPullback₃ i j k
  letI : IsOpenImmersion H.p₁ :=
    C.twistRecovery_triple_p₁_isOpenImmersion i j k
  letI : IsOpenImmersion H.p₂₃ :=
    C.twistRecovery_triple_p₂₃_isOpenImmersion i j k
  apply (cancel_mono
    (C.twistTripleOverlapTargetBaseChangeIso T i j k).hom).1
  apply
    (((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction H.p₁).homEquiv
      (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor H.p₂₃).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
          (C.overlapToChart j k)).obj
            (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j)))).symm).injective
  apply (cancel_mono
    (C.twistTripleMiddleRestrictIso i j k).hom).1
  rw [C.twistLocalChartLeft_normalization T i j k,
    C.twistLocalChartRight_normalization T i j k]
  apply (cancel_mono
    (C.twistTripleRestrictTransitionJK T i j k).hom).1
  rw [C.twistTripleRestrictTransition_comp T hT i j k,
    Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistLocalChartCochain_compatibility
statement:
theorem twistLocalChartCochain_compatibility
    {d : ℤ} (T : C.TwistTransitionSystem d)
    (hT : C.TwistTransitionLaws T) (i : C.I) :
    C.twistLocalChartCochain T i ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι i)).map
          (C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).descentLeft =
      C.twistLocalChartCochain T i ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι i)).map
          (C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).descentRight
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictPiIso
      (C.chartι i)
      (C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).overlapTerm).hom).1
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  rintro ⟨j, k⟩
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  slice_lhs 3 4 =>
    rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictPiIso_hom_π]
  slice_rhs 3 4 =>
    rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictPiIso_hom_π]
  slice_lhs 2 3 =>
    rw [← Functor.map_comp,
      (C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).descentLeft_π,
      Functor.map_comp]
  slice_rhs 2 3 =>
    rw [← Functor.map_comp,
      (C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).descentRight_π,
      Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_comp,
      Functor.map_comp]
  slice_lhs 1 2 =>
    rw [C.twistLocalChartCochain_π T i j]
  slice_rhs 1 2 =>
    rw [C.twistLocalChartCochain_π T i k]
  exact C.twistLocalChartComponent_compatibility T hT i j k

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherCoface_component
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherCoface_component (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (x : coordinateCechHigherTerm k n (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) p)
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (Limits.Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.obj
        (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) b))) a).hom
        (coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherCoface k n d p r x) =
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.map
        (Pi.lift
          (P := coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) a)
          (fun t : Fin (p + 1) ↦
            Pi.π
              (fun s : Fin (p + 2) ↦ coordinateCechCover k n (a s))
              (r.succAbove t))).op
        ((Limits.Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.obj
            (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b)))
          (a ∘ r.succAbove)).hom x)
proof:
:= by
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (coordinateCechHigherCoface_component k n
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) p r a) x

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherCoface_eq_transported
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherCoface_eq_transported (d : ℤ)
    (hcompat : ProjectiveTwistingCechLaurentNativeCofaceCompatible k n d)
    (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2)) :
    coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherCoface k n d p r =
      coordinateCechTwistingTransportedHigherCoface k n d p r
proof:
:= by
  apply AddMonoidHom.ext
  intro x
  apply (coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv k n d (p + 1)).injective
  rw [coordinateCechTwistingTransportedHigherCoface_toLaurent]
  funext a
  rw [coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv_apply,
    coordinateLaurentHigherCoface_apply,
    coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv_apply]
  rw [coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherCoface_component]
  exact hcompat p r a
    ((Limits.Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.obj
        (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b)))
      (a ∘ r.succAbove)).hom x)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.negOnePow_zsmul_eq_mul
statement:
theorem negOnePow_zsmul_eq_mul (m : ℕ) (z : k) :
    ((-1 : ℤ) ^ m) • z = (-1 : k) ^ m * z
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing z with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
      rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, mul_zsmul, neg_one_zsmul, ih]
      ring

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_eq_alternatingCofaces
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_eq_alternatingCofaces (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d p =
      ∑ r : Fin (p + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
        (coordinateLaurentHigherCoface k n d p r).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply AddMonoidHom.ext
  intro x
  funext a
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro e
  rw [coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_apply_coeff]
  let coeff : coordinateLaurentHigherTerm k n d (p + 1) →+ k :=
    { toFun := fun z ↦ (z a).1 e
      map_zero' := rfl
      map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl }
  let ev :
      (coordinateLaurentHigherTerm k n d p →+
        coordinateLaurentHigherTerm k n d (p + 1)) →+
          coordinateLaurentHigherTerm k n d (p + 1) :=
    { toFun := fun f ↦ f x
      map_zero' := rfl
      map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl }
  have hsum :
      ((∑ r : Fin (p + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
          (coordinateLaurentHigherCoface k n d p r).hom) x) =
        ∑ r : Fin (p + 2),
          (((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
            (coordinateLaurentHigherCoface k n d p r).hom) x := by
    change ev (∑ r : Fin (p + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
      (coordinateLaurentHigherCoface k n d p r).hom) = _
    exact map_sum ev _ Finset.univ
  change
    (∑ r : Fin (p + 2), (-1 : k) ^ r.val * (x (a ∘ r.succAbove)).1 e) =
      coeff ((∑ r : Fin (p + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
        (coordinateLaurentHigherCoface k n d p r).hom) x)
  rw [hsum, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  rw [AddMonoidHom.zsmul_apply, map_zsmul]
  change (-1 : k) ^ r.val * (x (a ∘ r.succAbove)).1 e =
    ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) • (x (a ∘ r.succAbove)).1 e
  exact (negOnePow_zsmul_eq_mul k r.val _).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential_eq_alternatingCofaces
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential_eq_alternatingCofaces
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential k n d p =
      ∑ r : Fin (p + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
        coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherCoface k n d p r
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential,
    coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherCoface]
  change (((CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor (coordinateCechCover k n)).obj
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf).d p (p + 1)).hom = _
  simp only [CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor,
    Limits.FormalCoproduct.cochainComplexFunctor_obj_d, CochainComplex.of_d]
  change (AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.objD
    (coordinateCechCosimplicialObject k n (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d)) p).hom = _
  simp only [AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingCofaceMapComplex.objD]
  let f := fun r : Fin (p + 2) ↦ ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
    (coordinateCechCosimplicialObject k n (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d)).δ r
  have hhom_sum (s : Finset (Fin (p + 2))) :
      (∑ r ∈ s, f r).hom = ∑ r ∈ s, (f r).hom := by
    classical
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => rfl
    | @insert r s hr ih =>
        rw [Finset.sum_insert hr, Finset.sum_insert hr,
          AddCommGrpCat.hom_add, ih]
  rw [show (∑ r : Fin (p + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
      (coordinateCechCosimplicialObject k n (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d)).δ r) =
      ∑ r, f r by rfl]
  rw [hhom_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  exact AddCommGrpCat.hom_zsmul _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential_eq_transported
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential_eq_transported (d : ℤ)
    (hcompat : ProjectiveTwistingCechLaurentNativeCofaceCompatible k n d)
    (p : ℕ) :
    coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential k n d p =
      coordinateCechTwistingTransportedHigherDifferential k n d p
proof:
:= by
  apply AddMonoidHom.ext
  intro x
  apply (coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv k n d (p + 1)).injective
  rw [coordinateCechTwistingTransportedHigherDifferential_toLaurent]
  rw [coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential_eq_alternatingCofaces]
  let ev :
      (coordinateCechHigherTerm k n (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) p →+
        coordinateCechHigherTerm k n (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) (p + 1)) →+
          coordinateCechHigherTerm k n (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) (p + 1) :=
    { toFun := fun f ↦ f x
      map_zero' := rfl
      map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl }
  have hsum :
      ((∑ r : Fin (p + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
          coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherCoface k n d p r) x) =
        ∑ r : Fin (p + 2), (((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
          coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherCoface k n d p r) x := by
    change ev (∑ r : Fin (p + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
      coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherCoface k n d p r) = _
    exact map_sum ev _ Finset.univ
  rw [hsum, map_sum]
  simp_rw [AddMonoidHom.zsmul_apply]
  simp_rw [coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherCoface_eq_transported k n d hcompat]
  simp_rw [map_zsmul]
  simp_rw [coordinateCechTwistingTransportedHigherCoface_toLaurent]
  let evLaurent :
      (coordinateLaurentHigherTerm k n d p →+
        coordinateLaurentHigherTerm k n d (p + 1)) →+
          coordinateLaurentHigherTerm k n d (p + 1) :=
    { toFun := fun f ↦ f
        (coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv k n d p x)
      map_zero' := rfl
      map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl }
  have hsumLaurent :
      ((∑ r : Fin (p + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
          (coordinateLaurentHigherCoface k n d p r).hom)
        (coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv k n d p x)) =
        ∑ r : Fin (p + 2), (((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
          (coordinateLaurentHigherCoface k n d p r).hom)
            (coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv k n d p x) := by
    change evLaurent (∑ r : Fin (p + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
      (coordinateLaurentHigherCoface k n d p r).hom) = _
    exact map_sum evLaurent _ Finset.univ
  calc
    _ = ((∑ r : Fin (p + 2), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val) •
          (coordinateLaurentHigherCoface k n d p r).hom)
        (coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv k n d p x)) := by
      simpa only [AddMonoidHom.zsmul_apply] using hsumLaurent.symm
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_eq_alternatingCofaces]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential_contraction
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential_contraction (d : ℤ)
    (hcompat : ProjectiveTwistingCechLaurentNativeCofaceCompatible k n d)
    (hd : -(n : ℤ) ≤ d) (p : ℕ)
    (x : coordinateCechHigherTerm k n (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) (p + 1)) :
    coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential k n d p
          (coordinateCechTwistingTransportedHigherContraction k n d hd p x) +
        coordinateCechTwistingTransportedHigherContraction k n d hd (p + 1)
          (coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential k n d (p + 1) x) =
      x
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential_eq_transported k n d hcompat p,
    coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential_eq_transported k n d hcompat (p + 1)]
  exact coordinateCechTwistingTransportedHigherDifferential_contraction k n d hd p x

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential_preimage_of_map_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential_preimage_of_map_eq_zero
    (d : ℤ) (hcompat : ProjectiveTwistingCechLaurentNativeCofaceCompatible k n d)
    (hd : -(n : ℤ) ≤ d) (p : ℕ)
    (x : coordinateCechHigherTerm k n (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) (p + 1))
    (hx : coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential k n d (p + 1) x = 0) :
    ∃ y : coordinateCechHigherTerm k n (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) p,
      coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential k n d p y = x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨coordinateCechTwistingTransportedHigherContraction k n d hd p x, ?_⟩
  have h := coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential_contraction
    k n d hcompat hd p x
  rw [hx, map_zero, add_zero] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentNonnegativeVertices_nonempty_of_totalDegree
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentNonnegativeVertices_nonempty_of_totalDegree
    (e : CoordinateLaurentExponent n) (d : ℤ)
    (hdegree : coordinateLaurentTotalDegree n e = d)
    (hd : -(n : ℤ) ≤ d) :
    (coordinateLaurentNonnegativeVertices n e).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hnonempty
  have hall : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), e i < 0 := by
    intro i
    have hi : i ∉ coordinateLaurentNonnegativeVertices n e := by
      intro hi
      exact hnonempty ⟨i, hi⟩
    have hi' : ¬0 ≤ e i := by
      intro hei
      exact hi ((mem_coordinateLaurentNonnegativeVertices n e i).2 hei)
    omega
  have hsum : coordinateLaurentTotalDegree n e ≤ -((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
    change Finsupp.degree e ≤ -((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)
    rw [Finsupp.degree_eq_sum]
    calc
      ∑ i : Fin (n + 1), e i ≤ ∑ _i : Fin (n + 1), (-1 : ℤ) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        have hi := hall i
        omega
      _ = -((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by simp
  omega

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentDefaultContractionVertex_nonnegative
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentDefaultContractionVertex_nonnegative
    (e : CoordinateLaurentExponent n)
    (h : (coordinateLaurentNonnegativeVertices n e).Nonempty) :
    0 ≤ e (coordinateLaurentDefaultContractionVertex n e)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateLaurentDefaultContractionVertex, dif_pos h]
  exact coordinateLaurentContractionVertex_nonnegative n e h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentDefaultContractionVertex_nonnegative_of_totalDegree
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentDefaultContractionVertex_nonnegative_of_totalDegree
    (e : CoordinateLaurentExponent n) (d : ℤ)
    (hdegree : coordinateLaurentTotalDegree n e = d)
    (hd : -(n : ℤ) ≤ d) :
    0 ≤ e (coordinateLaurentDefaultContractionVertex n e)
proof:
:=
  coordinateLaurentDefaultContractionVertex_nonnegative n e
    (coordinateLaurentNonnegativeVertices_nonempty_of_totalDegree n e d hdegree hd)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentContractionPolynomial_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateLaurentContractionPolynomial_apply (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (x : coordinateLaurentHigherTerm k n d (p + 1))
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) (e : CoordinateLaurentExponent n) :
    coordinateLaurentContractionPolynomial k n d p x a e =
      (x (Fin.cons (coordinateLaurentDefaultContractionVertex n e) a)).1 e
proof:
:= by
  simp [coordinateLaurentContractionPolynomial, Finsupp.onFinset_apply]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentContractionPolynomial_mem_piece
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentContractionPolynomial_mem_piece (d : ℤ)
    (hd : -(n : ℤ) ≤ d) (p : ℕ)
    (x : coordinateLaurentHigherTerm k n d (p + 1))
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateLaurentContractionPolynomial k n d p x a ∈
      coordinateLaurentPiece k n d p a
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  rw [coordinateLaurentContractionPolynomial_apply] at he
  let i := coordinateLaurentDefaultContractionVertex n e
  have hsource := (x (Fin.cons i a)).2 e he
  obtain ⟨hdegree, hallowed⟩ := hsource
  have hi : 0 ≤ e i :=
    coordinateLaurentDefaultContractionVertex_nonnegative_of_totalDegree n e d hdegree hd
  exact ⟨hdegree, (e.allowedOn_cons_iff n i hi p a).mp hallowed⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentHigherContraction_apply_coeff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateLaurentHigherContraction_apply_coeff (d : ℤ)
    (hd : -(n : ℤ) ≤ d) (p : ℕ)
    (x : coordinateLaurentHigherTerm k n d (p + 1))
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) (e : CoordinateLaurentExponent n) :
    ((coordinateLaurentHigherContraction k n d hd p x a).1 e) =
      (x (Fin.cons (coordinateLaurentDefaultContractionVertex n e) a)).1 e
proof:
:= by
  exact coordinateLaurentContractionPolynomial_apply k n d p x a e

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentPieceScalar_apply_coeff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateLaurentPieceScalar_apply_coeff (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) (c : k)
    (x : coordinateLaurentPiece k n d p a) (e : CoordinateLaurentExponent n) :
    (coordinateLaurentPieceScalar k n d p a c x).1 e = c * x.1 e
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_apply_coeff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_apply_coeff (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (x : coordinateLaurentHigherTerm k n d p)
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) (e : CoordinateLaurentExponent n) :
    (coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d p x a).1 e =
      ∑ r : Fin (p + 2), (-1 : k) ^ r.val * (x (a ∘ r.succAbove)).1 e
proof:
:= by
  rw [show coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d p x a =
      ∑ r : Fin (p + 2),
        coordinateLaurentPieceScalar k n d (p + 1) a ((-1 : k) ^ r.val)
          (coordinateLaurentHigherCoface k n d p r x a) from rfl]
  let coeff : coordinateLaurentPiece k n d (p + 1) a →+ k :=
    { toFun := fun z ↦ z.1 e
      map_zero' := rfl
      map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl }
  change coeff (∑ r : Fin (p + 2),
    coordinateLaurentPieceScalar k n d (p + 1) a ((-1 : k) ^ r.val)
      (coordinateLaurentHigherCoface k n d p r x a)) = _
  rw [map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  change
    (coordinateLaurentPieceScalar k n d (p + 1) a ((-1 : k) ^ r.val)
      (coordinateLaurentCoface k n d p r a (x (a ∘ r.succAbove)))).1 e = _
  rw [coordinateLaurentPieceScalar_apply_coeff]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_contraction
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_contraction (d : ℤ)
    (hd : -(n : ℤ) ≤ d) (p : ℕ)
    (x : coordinateLaurentHigherTerm k n d (p + 1)) :
    coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d p
          (coordinateLaurentHigherContraction k n d hd p x) +
        coordinateLaurentHigherContraction k n d hd (p + 1)
          (coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d (p + 1) x) =
      x
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro e
  change
    (coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d p
          (coordinateLaurentHigherContraction k n d hd p x) a).1 e +
        (coordinateLaurentHigherContraction k n d hd (p + 1)
          (coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d (p + 1) x) a).1 e =
      (x a).1 e
  simp only [
    coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_apply_coeff,
    coordinateLaurentHigherContraction_apply_coeff]
  exact alternating_prepend_identity k n p
    (coordinateLaurentDefaultContractionVertex n e) (fun b ↦ (x b).1 e) a

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.affineRestrictionMap_comp
statement:
theorem affineRestrictionMap_comp {F E C : X.affineOpens}
    (hFE : F.1 ≤ E.1) (hEC : E.1 ≤ C.1) :
    affineRestrictionMap I hFE ≫ affineRestrictionMap I hEC =
      affineRestrictionMap I (hFE.trans hEC)
proof:
:= by
  unfold affineRestrictionMap
  rw [reesProjMapOfRingHomTo_comp]
  have hφ :
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hFE).op).hom.comp
          (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hEC).op).hom =
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hFE.trans hEC)).op).hom := by
    change (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hEC).op ≫
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hFE).op).hom =
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hFE.trans hEC)).op).hom
    rw [← Functor.map_comp]
    rfl
  exact reesProjMapOfRingHomTo_congr hφ (I.ideal C) (I.ideal F) _ _

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenComparison_comp_algebraMap
statement:
theorem basicOpenComparison_comp_algebraMap
    (U : X.affineOpens) (f : Γ(X, U.1)) :
    (basicOpenComparison I U f).sectionsEquiv.toRingHom.comp
        (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) (Localization.Away f)) =
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op).hom
proof:
:= by
  letI := U.2.isLocalization_basicOpen f
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro r
  exact (IsLocalization.algEquiv (Submonoid.powers f)
    (Localization.Away f) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f)).commutes r

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenChartMap_eq_affineRestrictionMap
statement:
theorem basicOpenChartMap_eq_affineRestrictionMap
    (U : X.affineOpens) (f : Γ(X, U.1)) :
    basicOpenChartMap I U f =
      affineRestrictionMap I (X.basicOpen_le f)
proof:
:= by
  let c := basicOpenComparison I U f
  have hbasic :=
    AffineOverlapComparison.heq_projIso_hom_comp_reesProjMap
      (I.ideal U) f c
  have hJ :
      (localizedIdeal (I.ideal U) f).map
          c.sectionsEquiv.toRingHom =
        (I.ideal U).map
          (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op).hom :=
    c.map_ideal.trans (I.map_ideal (X.basicOpen_le f)).symm
  have hval : ∀ p : reesAlgebra (I.ideal U),
      (((gradedReesEquivHom c.sectionsEquiv
          (localizedIdeal (I.ideal U) f)).comp
        (gradedLocalizationMap (I.ideal U) f)) p :
          reesAlgebra ((localizedIdeal (I.ideal U) f).map
            c.sectionsEquiv.toRingHom)).1 =
      (gradedReesMap
          (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op).hom
          (I.ideal U) p :
        reesAlgebra ((I.ideal U).map
          (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op).hom)).1 := by
    intro p
    change Polynomial.map c.sectionsEquiv.toRingHom
        (Polynomial.map (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) (Localization.Away f))
          (p : Polynomial Γ(X, U.1))) =
      Polynomial.map
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op).hom
        (p : Polynomial Γ(X, U.1))
    rw [Polynomial.map_map, basicOpenComparison_comp_algebraMap]
  have hraw := Proj_map_heq_of_pointwise_eq hJ
    ((gradedReesEquivHom c.sectionsEquiv
      (localizedIdeal (I.ideal U) f)).comp
        (gradedLocalizationMap (I.ideal U) f))
    (gradedReesMap
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op).hom
      (I.ideal U))
    hval
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp
      (irrelevant_le_map_gradedLocalizationMap (I.ideal U) f)
      (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivHom c.sectionsEquiv
        (localizedIdeal (I.ideal U) f)))
    (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesMap
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op).hom
      (I.ideal U))
  have hdirect := reesProjMapOfRingHomTo_heq
    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op).hom
    (I.ideal U) (I.ideal (X.affineBasicOpen f))
    (I.map_ideal (U := X.affineBasicOpen f) (V := U)
      (X.affineBasicOpen_le f))
  exact eq_of_heq (hbasic.trans (hraw.trans hdirect.symm))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.restrictedPushedUnitRestriction_isIso
statement:
theorem restrictedPushedUnitRestriction_isIso {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (A U V : X.Opens) (hV : V = A ⊓ U) :
    IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor A.ι).map
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
        (show V ≤ U by rw [hV]; exact inf_le_right)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.isIso_iff_isIso_app]
  intro W
  rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
  let hVU : V ≤ U := by rw [hV]; exact inf_le_right
  let β := (homOfLE
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestrictionOpen hVU (A.ι ''ᵁ W))).op
  have hEq : U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (A.ι ''ᵁ W)) =
      V.ι ''ᵁ (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (A.ι ''ᵁ W)) := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf,
      Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf,
      Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι,
      hV]
    have hW : A.ι ''ᵁ W ≤ A := by
      simpa only [Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι] using
        A.ι.image_le_opensRange W
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact le_inf (le_inf (inf_le_right.trans hW) inf_le_left) inf_le_right
    · exact le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right) inf_le_right
  haveI : IsIso β := by
    let e : op (U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (A.ι ''ᵁ W))) ≅
        op (V.ι ''ᵁ (V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (A.ι ''ᵁ W))) :=
      eqToIso (congrArg op hEq)
    have hβ : β = e.hom := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [hβ]
    infer_instance
  change Function.Bijective (X.presheaf.map β)
  exact ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (X.presheaf.map β)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.restrictedLinearOverlapRestriction_isIso
statement:

    IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (linearOpen R M x).ι).map
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
        ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M x y).le.trans inf_le_right)))
proof:
:= by
  exact restrictedPushedUnitRestriction_isIso
    (linearOpen R M x) (linearOpen R M y)
      (linearOverlapOpen R M x y) (linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M x y)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearLocalFrameTransition_cocycle
statement:
theorem linearLocalFrameTransition_cocycle (d : ℤ) (i a c : ι) :
    Units.map (linearOverlapToTripleXY R M (b i) (b a) (b c)).toMonoidHom
        (linearTwistTransitionUnit R M (-d) (b i) (b a)) =
      Units.map (linearOverlapToTripleYZ R M (b i) (b a) (b c)).toMonoidHom
          (linearTwistTransitionUnit R M d (b a) (b c)) *
        Units.map (linearOverlapToTripleXZ R M (b i) (b a) (b c)).toMonoidHom
          (linearTwistTransitionUnit R M (-d) (b i) (b c))
proof:
:= by
  let A := Units.map
    (linearOverlapToTripleXY R M (b i) (b a) (b c)).toMonoidHom
      (linearTwistTransitionUnit R M d (b i) (b a))
  let B := Units.map
    (linearOverlapToTripleYZ R M (b i) (b a) (b c)).toMonoidHom
      (linearTwistTransitionUnit R M d (b a) (b c))
  let C := Units.map
    (linearOverlapToTripleXZ R M (b i) (b a) (b c)).toMonoidHom
      (linearTwistTransitionUnit R M d (b i) (b c))
  have h : A * B = C :=
    linearTwistTransitionUnit_cocycle R M d (b i) (b a) (b c)
  simp only [linearTwistTransitionUnit_neg]
  change A⁻¹ = B * C⁻¹
  rw [← h]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearTripleOpen_eq_inf
statement:
theorem linearTripleOpen_eq_inf (x y z : M) :
    linearTripleOpen R M x y z =
      (linearOpen R M x ⊓ linearOpen R M y) ⊓ linearOpen R M z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
  change Proj.basicOpen (symGrading R M)
      ((linearForm R M x * linearForm R M y) * linearForm R M z) =
    Proj.basicOpen (symGrading R M) (linearForm R M x * linearForm R M y) ⊓
      Proj.basicOpen (symGrading R M) (linearForm R M z)
  exact Proj.basicOpen_mul (symGrading R M)
    (linearForm R M x * linearForm R M y) (linearForm R M z)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearLocalFrameTransitionSectionXY_eq
statement:
theorem linearLocalFrameTransitionSectionXY_eq (d : ℤ) (x y z : M) :
    linearLocalFrameTransitionSectionXY R M d x y z =
      Units.map (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (symGrading R M)
        (linearTripleEquation R M x y z)
        (linearTripleEquation_mem_degree_three R M x y z) (by omega)).hom.hom.toMonoidHom
        (Units.map (linearOverlapToTripleXY R M x y z).toMonoidHom
          (linearTwistTransitionUnit R M d x y))
proof:
:= by
  apply Units.ext
  change ((Proj (symGrading R M)).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (linearTripleOpen_le_overlapXY R M x y z)).op)
        ((Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (symGrading R M)
          (linearOverlapEquation R M x y)
          (linearOverlapEquation_mem_degree_two R M x y) (by omega)).hom
            (linearTwistTransitionUnit R M d x y : LinearOverlapRing R M x y)) = _
  change (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M) (linearOverlapEquation R M x y) ≫
      (Proj (symGrading R M)).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (linearTripleOpen_le_overlapXY R M x y z)).op)
      (linearTwistTransitionUnit R M d x y : LinearOverlapRing R M x y) =
    Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M) (linearTripleEquation R M x y z)
      ((CommRingCat.ofHom (linearOverlapToTripleXY R M x y z))
        (linearTwistTransitionUnit R M d x y : LinearOverlapRing R M x y))
  simpa only [linearTripleOpen, linearOverlapToTripleXY,
      ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] using
    (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (Proj.awayMap_awayToSection (symGrading R M)
        (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M z) (by
          simp only [linearTripleEquation, linearOverlapEquation]))
      (linearTwistTransitionUnit R M d x y : LinearOverlapRing R M x y)).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearLocalFrameTransitionSection_cocycle
statement:
theorem linearLocalFrameTransitionSection_cocycle (d : ℤ) (i a c : ι) :
    linearLocalFrameTransitionSectionXY R M (-d) (b i) (b a) (b c) =
      linearLocalFrameTransitionSectionYZ R M d (b i) (b a) (b c) *
        linearLocalFrameTransitionSectionXZ R M (-d) (b i) (b a) (b c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [linearLocalFrameTransitionSectionXY_eq,
    linearLocalFrameTransitionSectionYZ_eq,
    linearLocalFrameTransitionSectionXZ_eq]
  let F := (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway (symGrading R M)
    (linearTripleEquation R M (b i) (b a) (b c))
    (linearTripleEquation_mem_degree_three R M (b i) (b a) (b c))
      (by omega)).hom.hom.toMonoidHom
  have h := congrArg (Units.map F)
    (linearLocalFrameTransition_cocycle R M b d i a c)
  simpa only [map_mul] using h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearLocalFrameTuple_component
statement:
@[simp]
theorem linearLocalFrameTuple_component (d : ℤ) (i j : ι) :
    (Pi.π (fun a : ι ↦
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) (linearOpen R M (b a))) j).app
        (linearOpen R M (b i)) (linearLocalFrameTuple R M b d i) =
      linearLocalFrameComponent R M b d i j
proof:
:= by
  change ((SheafOfModules.evaluation
      (space R M).ringCatSheaf (op (linearOpen R M (b i)))).map
    (Pi.π (fun a : ι ↦
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M)
        (linearOpen R M (b a))) j))
        (linearLocalFrameTuple R M b d i) = _
  let E := SheafOfModules.evaluation
    (space R M).ringCatSheaf (op (linearOpen R M (b i)))
  let f := fun a : ι ↦
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) (linearOpen R M (b a))
  have hIso : (PreservesProduct.iso E f).inv = inv (piComparison E f) := by
    apply (cancel_mono (PreservesProduct.iso E f).hom).1
    rw [Iso.inv_hom_id, PreservesProduct.iso_hom, IsIso.inv_hom_id]
  have h₁ : (PreservesProduct.iso E f).inv ≫ E.map (Pi.π f j) =
      Pi.π (fun a ↦ E.obj (f a)) j := by
    rw [hIso]
    exact inv_piComparison_comp_map_π E f j
  have hc : ((PreservesProduct.iso E f ≪≫
        ModuleCat.piIsoPi (fun a ↦ E.obj (f a))).inv ≫ E.map (Pi.π f j)) =
      (ModuleCat.piIsoPi (fun a ↦ E.obj (f a))).inv ≫
        Pi.π (fun a ↦ E.obj (f a)) j := by
    simp only [Iso.trans_inv, Category.assoc, h₁]
  change (E.map (Pi.π f j))
      ((PreservesProduct.iso E f ≪≫
        ModuleCat.piIsoPi (fun a ↦ E.obj (f a))).inv
          (fun a ↦ linearLocalFrameComponent R M b d i a)) = _
  calc
    _ = (Pi.π (fun a ↦ E.obj (f a)) j)
          ((ModuleCat.piIsoPi (fun a ↦ E.obj (f a))).inv
            (fun a ↦ linearLocalFrameComponent R M b d i a)) := by
      simpa only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] using
        ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hc
          (fun a ↦ linearLocalFrameComponent R M b d i a)
    _ = _ := ModuleCat.piIsoPi_inv_kernel_ι_apply
      (fun a ↦ E.obj (f a)) j _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearLocalFrameTuple_compatibility
statement:
theorem linearLocalFrameTuple_compatibility (d : ℤ) (i : ι) :
    (linearDescentLeft R M b).app (linearOpen R M (b i))
        (linearLocalFrameTuple R M b d i) =
      (linearDescentRight R M b d).app (linearOpen R M (b i))
        (linearLocalFrameTuple R M b d i)
proof:
:= by
  let X := space R M
  let U := linearOpen R M (b i)
  let E := SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op U)
  let f := fun ij : ι × ι ↦
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X
      (linearOverlapOpen R M (b ij.1) (b ij.2))
  let e : E.obj (linearOverlapCochains R M b) ≅
      ModuleCat.of Γ(X, U) (∀ ij, ↑(E.obj (f ij))) :=
    PreservesProduct.iso E f ≪≫ ModuleCat.piIsoPi _
  let x : ↑(E.obj (linearOverlapCochains R M b)) :=
    E.map (linearDescentLeft R M b) (linearLocalFrameTuple R M b d i)
  let y : ↑(E.obj (linearOverlapCochains R M b)) :=
    E.map (linearDescentRight R M b d) (linearLocalFrameTuple R M b d i)
  change x = y
  suffices h : e.hom x = e.hom y by
    calc
      x = e.inv (e.hom x) := by simp
      _ = e.inv (e.hom y) := congrArg e.inv h
      _ = y := by simp
  funext ij
  let p := ModuleCat.ofHom
    (LinearMap.proj ij :
      (∀ ij, ↑(E.obj (f ij))) →ₗ[Γ(X, U)] ↑(E.obj (f ij)))
  have hc : e.hom ≫ p = E.map (Pi.π f ij) := by
    dsimp [e, p]
    simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc,
      ModuleCat.piIsoPi_hom_ker_subtype, PreservesProduct.iso_hom,
      piComparison_comp_π]
  change p (e.hom x) = p (e.hom y)
  change (e.hom ≫ p) x = (e.hom ≫ p) y
  rw [hc]
  change ((linearDescentLeft R M b ≫ Pi.π f ij).app U)
      (linearLocalFrameTuple R M b d i) =
    ((linearDescentRight R M b d ≫ Pi.π f ij).app U)
      (linearLocalFrameTuple R M b d i)
  dsimp only [f]
  simp only [linearDescentLeft, linearDescentRight, Pi.lift_π]
  change (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
        ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b ij.1) (b ij.2)).le.trans
          inf_le_left)).app U
      ((Pi.π (fun a : ι ↦
        SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X (linearOpen R M (b a))) ij.1).app U
          (linearLocalFrameTuple R M b d i)) =
    (pushedLinearOverlapTransition R M d (b ij.1) (b ij.2)).app U
      ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
        ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b ij.1) (b ij.2)).le.trans
          inf_le_right)).app U
        ((Pi.π (fun a : ι ↦
          SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X
            (linearOpen R M (b a))) ij.2).app U
            (linearLocalFrameTuple R M b d i)))
  rw [linearLocalFrameTuple_component, linearLocalFrameTuple_component]
  let W := linearOverlapOpen R M (b ij.1) (b ij.2)
  let P := W.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U
  let eW := W.ι.appIso P
  have q : W.ι ''ᵁ P =
      linearTripleOpen R M (b i) (b ij.1) (b ij.2) := by
    dsimp only [W, P, U]
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι,
      linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf, linearTripleOpen_eq_inf]
    ac_rfl
  let qIso := X.presheaf.mapIso (eqToIso q).op
  let sL : Γ(SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules W.toScheme, P) :=
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
      ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b ij.1) (b ij.2)).le.trans
        inf_le_left)).app U
        (linearLocalFrameComponent R M b d i ij.1)
  let sR : Γ(SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules W.toScheme, P) :=
    (pushedLinearOverlapTransition R M d (b ij.1) (b ij.2)).app U
      ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
        ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b ij.1) (b ij.2)).le.trans
          inf_le_right)).app U
          (linearLocalFrameComponent R M b d i ij.2))
  change sL = sR
  let T : Γ(SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules W.toScheme, P) →
      Γ(X, linearTripleOpen R M (b i) (b ij.1) (b ij.2)) :=
    fun z ↦ qIso.inv (eW.inv z)
  suffices hT : T sL = T sR by
    calc
      sL = eW.hom (qIso.hom (T sL)) := by simp [T]
      _ = eW.hom (qIso.hom (T sR)) :=
        congrArg (fun z ↦ eW.hom (qIso.hom z)) hT
      _ = sR := by simp [T]
  dsimp only [T, sL, sR]
  simp only [SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction_app_apply,
    pushedLinearOverlapTransition, Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app,
    linearOverlapTransitionIso]
  simp [SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso_hom_app_apply,
    linearLocalFrameComponent, SchemeProjectiveSpace.restrictTopUnit,
    Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso]
  dsimp only [eW, qIso]
  simp only [Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso, Iso.refl_inv]
  change
    (linearLocalFrameTransitionSectionXY R M (-d)
      (b i) (b ij.1) (b ij.2)).1 =
      (linearLocalFrameTransitionSectionYZ R M d
        (b i) (b ij.1) (b ij.2)).1 *
        (linearLocalFrameTransitionSectionXZ R M (-d)
          (b i) (b ij.1) (b ij.2)).1
  exact congrArg Units.val
    (linearLocalFrameTransitionSection_cocycle R M b d i ij.1 ij.2)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearLocalFrameHom_compatibility
statement:
theorem linearLocalFrameHom_compatibility (d : ℤ) (i : ι) :
    linearLocalFrameHom R M b d i ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι).map
          (linearDescentLeft R M b) =
      linearLocalFrameHom R M b d i ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι).map
          (linearDescentRight R M b d)
proof:
:= by
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι
  apply ((G.obj (linearOverlapCochains R M b)).unitHomEquiv).injective
  rw [SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv_comp_apply,
    SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv_comp_apply]
  apply PresheafOfModules.sections_ext
  intro V
  rw [linearLocalFrameHom, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  change ((G.map (linearDescentLeft R M b)).val.app V)
      (((G.obj (linearChartCochains R M b)).val.map
        (homOfLE le_top).op) (linearLocalFrameTopSection R M b d i)) =
    ((G.map (linearDescentRight R M b d)).val.app V)
      (((G.obj (linearChartCochains R M b)).val.map
        (homOfLE le_top).op) (linearLocalFrameTopSection R M b d i))
  let a : (op (⊤ : (linearOpen R M (b i)).toScheme.Opens)) ⟶ V :=
    (homOfLE le_top).op
  have hL := (G.map (linearDescentLeft R M b)).val.naturality a
  have hR := (G.map (linearDescentRight R M b d)).val.naturality a
  have htop :
      ((G.map (linearDescentLeft R M b)).val.app (op ⊤))
          (linearLocalFrameTopSection R M b d i) =
        ((G.map (linearDescentRight R M b d)).val.app (op ⊤))
          (linearLocalFrameTopSection R M b d i) := by
    let U := linearOpen R M (b i)
    let left := linearDescentLeft R M b
    let right := linearDescentRight R M b d
    let chart := linearChartCochains R M b
    let overlap := linearOverlapCochains R M b
    let tuple := linearLocalFrameTuple R M b d i
    change left.app (U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens))
        (chart.presheaf.map (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op tuple) =
      right.app (U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens))
        (chart.presheaf.map (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op tuple)
    have hf := congrArg (fun q ↦ q tuple)
      (left.val.naturality (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op)
    have hg := congrArg (fun q ↦ q tuple)
      (right.val.naturality (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op)
    change left.app (U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens))
        (chart.presheaf.map (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op tuple) =
      overlap.presheaf.map (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op
        (left.app U tuple) at hf
    change right.app (U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens))
        (chart.presheaf.map (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op tuple) =
      overlap.presheaf.map (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op
        (right.app U tuple) at hg
    rw [hf, hg, linearLocalFrameTuple_compatibility]
  calc
    _ = ((G.obj (linearOverlapCochains R M b)).val.map a)
        (((G.map (linearDescentLeft R M b)).val.app (op ⊤))
          (linearLocalFrameTopSection R M b d i)) := by
      exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hL
        (linearLocalFrameTopSection R M b d i)
    _ = ((G.obj (linearOverlapCochains R M b)).val.map a)
        (((G.map (linearDescentRight R M b d)).val.app (op ⊤))
          (linearLocalFrameTopSection R M b d i)) := congrArg _ htop
    _ = _ := (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hR
      (linearLocalFrameTopSection R M b d i)).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearLocalFrameProjection_app_eq
statement:
theorem linearLocalFrameProjection_app_eq (d : ℤ) (i : ι)
    (V : (linearOpen R M (b i)).toScheme.Opens)
    (x : Γ((twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d).restrict
      (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι, V)) :
    (linearLocalFrameProjection R M b d i).app V x =
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules
        (linearOpen R M (b i)).toScheme).presheaf.map
          (eqToHom ((linearOpen R M (b i)).ι.preimage_image_eq V).symm).op
        ((Pi.π (fun j : ι ↦
            SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M)
              (linearOpen R M (b j))) i).app
          ((linearOpen R M (b i)).ι ''ᵁ V)
          ((kernel.ι
            (linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b d)).app
              ((linearOpen R M (b i)).ι ''ᵁ V) x))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearLocalFrameKernelLift_ι
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem linearLocalFrameKernelLift_ι (d : ℤ) (i : ι) :
    linearLocalFrameKernelLift R M b d i ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι).map
          (kernel.ι
            (linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b d)) =
      linearLocalFrameHom R M b d i
proof:
:= by
  unfold twistingSheafOfBasisIndex at *

  simp only [Category.assoc, PreservesKernel.iso_inv_ι, kernel.lift_ι]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearLocalFrameHom_project
statement:
theorem linearLocalFrameHom_project (d : ℤ) (i : ι) :
    linearLocalFrameHom R M b d i ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι).map
          (Pi.π (fun j : ι ↦
            SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M)
              (linearOpen R M (b j))) i) =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso
        (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι).inv.app
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules
            (linearOpen R M (b i)).toScheme)
proof:
:= by
  apply SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModulesHom_ext_top
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  change ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
      (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι).map
        (Pi.π (fun j : ι ↦
          SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M)
            (linearOpen R M (b j))) i)).app ⊤
      ((linearLocalFrameHom R M b d i).app ⊤
        (1 : (linearOpen R M (b i)).toScheme.presheaf.obj (op ⊤))) =
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso
      (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι).inv.app
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules
          (linearOpen R M (b i)).toScheme)).app ⊤
      (1 : (linearOpen R M (b i)).toScheme.presheaf.obj (op ⊤))
  have hsec :
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι).obj
        (linearChartCochains R M b)).unitHomEquiv)
          (linearLocalFrameHom R M b d i) =
        SchemeProjectiveSpace.sectionsOfTop _
          (linearLocalFrameTopSection R M b d i) := by
    rw [linearLocalFrameHom, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have hframe : (linearLocalFrameHom R M b d i).app ⊤
      (1 : (linearOpen R M (b i)).toScheme.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) =
        linearLocalFrameTopSection R M b d i := by
    have htop := congrArg (fun s ↦ s.val (op (⊤ :
        (linearOpen R M (b i)).toScheme.Opens))) hsec
    change (linearLocalFrameHom R M b d i).app ⊤
        (1 : (linearOpen R M (b i)).toScheme.presheaf.obj (op ⊤)) =
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι).obj
        (linearChartCochains R M b)).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE le_top).op)
            (linearLocalFrameTopSection R M b d i) at htop
    have q : (homOfLE (le_top : (⊤ :
        (linearOpen R M (b i)).toScheme.Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op = 𝟙 (op ⊤) :=
      Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [q, Functor.map_id_apply] at htop
    exact htop
  rw [hframe]
  let U := linearOpen R M (b i)
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι
  let πi := Pi.π (fun j : ι ↦
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) (linearOpen R M (b j))) i
  let s := (linearChartCochains R M b).presheaf.map
    (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op (linearLocalFrameTuple R M b d i)
  have hπ : (G.map πi).app (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens)
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso U.ι
          (linearChartCochains R M b) ⊤).inv s) =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso U.ι
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) U) ⊤).inv
          (πi.app (U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens)) s) := by
    rfl
  change (G.map πi).app (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens)
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso U.ι
        (linearChartCochains R M b) ⊤).inv s) = _
  rw [hπ]
  have hnat := congrArg (fun q ↦ q (linearLocalFrameTuple R M b d i))
    (πi.val.naturality (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op)
  change πi.app (U.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens)) s =
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) U).presheaf.map
      (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op
        (πi.app U (linearLocalFrameTuple R M b d i)) at hnat
  rw [hnat]
  change (Scheme.Modules.restrictAppIso U.ι
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) U) ⊤).inv
        ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) U).presheaf.map
          (eqToHom U.ι_image_top).op
            ((Pi.π (fun j : ι ↦
              SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M)
                (linearOpen R M (b j))) i).app U
                (linearLocalFrameTuple R M b d i))) = _
  rw [linearLocalFrameTuple_component]
  simp [linearLocalFrameComponent, Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearLocalFrameKernelLift_projection
statement:
theorem linearLocalFrameKernelLift_projection (d : ℤ) (i : ι) :
    linearLocalFrameKernelLift R M b d i ≫
        linearLocalFrameProjection R M b d i =
      𝟙 (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules
        (linearOpen R M (b i)).toScheme)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [linearLocalFrameProjection]
  rw [linearLocalFrameKernelLift_ι_assoc, ← Category.assoc,
    linearLocalFrameHom_project]
