name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearDescentKernel_restrictFunctor_component_compatibility
statement:
theorem linearDescentKernel_restrictFunctor_component_compatibility
    (d : ℤ) (i j : ι) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι).map
        (kernel.ι (linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b d)) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι).map
        (Pi.π (fun t : ι ↦
          SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M)
            (linearOpen R M (b t))) i) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι).map
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
          ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (b j)).le.trans inf_le_left)) =
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι).map
        (kernel.ι (linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b d)) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι).map
        (Pi.π (fun t : ι ↦
          SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M)
            (linearOpen R M (b t))) j) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι).map
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
          ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (b j)).le.trans inf_le_right)) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι).map
        (pushedLinearOverlapTransition R M d (b i) (b j))
proof:
:= by
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι
  let charts := fun t : ι ↦
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) (linearOpen R M (b t))
  let overlaps := fun ij : ι × ι ↦
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M)
      (linearOverlapOpen R M (b ij.1) (b ij.2))
  let qij := Pi.π overlaps (i, j)
  let rL := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
    ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (b j)).le.trans inf_le_left)
  let rR := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
    ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (b j)).le.trans inf_le_right)
  let t := pushedLinearOverlapTransition R M d (b i) (b j)
  have hK :
      G.map (kernel.ι
          (linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b d)) ≫
          G.map (linearDescentLeft R M b) =
        G.map (kernel.ι
          (linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b d)) ≫
          G.map (linearDescentRight R M b d) := by
    simpa only [Functor.map_comp] using congrArg G.map
      (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex_overlap_compatibility R M b d)
  show G.map
      (kernel.ι (linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b d)) ≫
        G.map (Pi.π charts i) ≫ G.map rL =
    G.map
      (kernel.ι (linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b d)) ≫
        G.map (Pi.π charts j) ≫ G.map rR ≫ G.map t
  calc
    _ = (G.map (kernel.ι
            (linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b d)) ≫
          G.map (linearDescentLeft R M b)) ≫ G.map qij := by
        simp only [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp,
          linearDescentLeft_π, qij, overlaps, rL, charts]
    _ = (G.map (kernel.ι
            (linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b d)) ≫
          G.map (linearDescentRight R M b d)) ≫ G.map qij :=
        congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ G.map qij) hK
    _ = _ := by
        simp only [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp,
          linearDescentRight_π, qij, overlaps, rR, t, charts]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearRestrictedKernel_generatedByFrame
statement:
theorem linearRestrictedKernel_generatedByFrame (d : ℤ) (i : ι) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι).map
        (kernel.ι
          (linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b d)) =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι).map
          (kernel.ι
            (linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b d)) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι).map
          (Pi.π (fun j : ι ↦
            SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M)
              (linearOpen R M (b j))) i) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso
          (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι).hom.app
            (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules
              (linearOpen R M (b i)).toScheme) ≫
        linearLocalFrameHom R M b d i
proof:
:= by
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι
  let charts := fun j : ι ↦
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) (linearOpen R M (b j))
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits G :=
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.restrictFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits _
  apply (cancel_mono (PreservesProduct.iso G charts).hom).1
  apply (limit.isLimit (Discrete.functor (fun j ↦ G.obj (charts j)))).hom_ext
  rintro ⟨j⟩
  simp only [PreservesProduct.iso_hom]
  change _ ≫ piComparison G charts ≫
      Pi.π (fun j ↦ G.obj (charts j)) j =
    _ ≫ piComparison G charts ≫ Pi.π (fun j ↦ G.obj (charts j)) j
  simp only [Category.assoc, piComparison_comp_π]
  let rL := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
    ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (b j)).le.trans inf_le_left)
  let rR := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction
    ((linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (b j)).le.trans inf_le_right)
  let t := pushedLinearOverlapTransition R M d (b i) (b j)
  let hIsoR : IsIso (G.map rR) :=
    restrictedLinearOverlapRestriction_isIso R M (b i) (b j)
  letI : IsIso (G.map rR) := hIsoR
  letI : Mono (G.map rR) :=
    @IsIso.mono_of_iso _ _ _ _ _ hIsoR
  let hIsoT : IsIso t := by
    dsimp only [t, pushedLinearOverlapTransition]
    infer_instance
  letI : IsIso t := hIsoT
  let hIsoGT : IsIso (G.map t) := Functor.map_isIso G t
  letI : IsIso (G.map t) := hIsoGT
  letI : Mono (G.map t) :=
    @IsIso.mono_of_iso _ _ _ _ _ hIsoGT
  let ε := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso
    (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι).hom.app
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules
        (linearOpen R M (b i)).toScheme)
  have hKij := linearDescentKernel_restrictFunctor_component_compatibility
    R M b d i j
  have hFij :
      linearLocalFrameHom R M b d i ≫ G.map (Pi.π charts i) ≫ G.map rL =
        linearLocalFrameHom R M b d i ≫
          G.map (Pi.π charts j) ≫ G.map rR ≫ G.map t := by
    let overlaps := fun ij : ι × ι ↦
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M)
        (linearOverlapOpen R M (b ij.1) (b ij.2))
    let qij := Pi.π overlaps (i, j)
    calc
      _ = (linearLocalFrameHom R M b d i ≫
          G.map (linearDescentLeft R M b)) ≫ G.map qij := by
            simp only [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp,
              linearDescentLeft_π, qij, overlaps, rL, charts]
      _ = (linearLocalFrameHom R M b d i ≫
          G.map (linearDescentRight R M b d)) ≫ G.map qij :=
        congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ G.map qij)
          (linearLocalFrameHom_compatibility R M b d i)
      _ = _ := by
          simp only [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp,
            linearDescentRight_π, qij, overlaps, rR, t, charts]
  have hεF :
      ε ≫ linearLocalFrameHom R M b d i ≫ G.map (Pi.π charts i) =
        𝟙 _ := by
    dsimp only [ε, G, charts]
    rw [linearLocalFrameHom_project]
    exact Iso.hom_inv_id_app _ _
  have hεFij :
      G.map rL =
        ε ≫ linearLocalFrameHom R M b d i ≫
          G.map (Pi.π charts j) ≫ G.map rR ≫ G.map t := by
    calc
      _ = (ε ≫ linearLocalFrameHom R M b d i ≫
          G.map (Pi.π charts i)) ≫ G.map rL := by
        rw [hεF, Category.id_comp]
      _ = ε ≫ (linearLocalFrameHom R M b d i ≫
          G.map (Pi.π charts i) ≫ G.map rL) := by
        simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = ε ≫ (linearLocalFrameHom R M b d i ≫
          G.map (Pi.π charts j) ≫ G.map rR ≫ G.map t) :=
        congrArg (fun q ↦ ε ≫ q) hFij
      _ = _ := by rfl
  apply (cancel_mono (G.map rR)).1
  apply (cancel_mono (G.map t)).1
  calc
    _ = G.map (kernel.ι
          (linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b d)) ≫
        G.map (Pi.π charts i) ≫ G.map rL := by
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using hKij.symm
    _ = G.map (kernel.ι
          (linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b d)) ≫
        G.map (Pi.π charts i) ≫
          (ε ≫ linearLocalFrameHom R M b d i ≫
            G.map (Pi.π charts j) ≫ G.map rR ≫ G.map t) := by
      rw [hεFij]
    _ = _ := by
      dsimp only [ε, G, charts]
      simp only [Category.assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.linearLocalFrameProjection_kernelLift
statement:
theorem linearLocalFrameProjection_kernelLift (d : ℤ) (i : ι) :
    linearLocalFrameProjection R M b d i ≫
        linearLocalFrameKernelLift R M b d i =
      𝟙 ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
        (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι).obj
          (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d))
proof:
:= by
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (linearOpen R M (b i)).ι
  let φ := linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b d
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits G :=
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.restrictFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits _
  apply (cancel_mono (G.map (kernel.ι φ))).1
  rw [Category.assoc, linearLocalFrameKernelLift_ι]
  dsimp only [linearLocalFrameProjection]
  rw [Category.id_comp]
  exact (linearRestrictedKernel_generatedByFrame R M b d i).symm

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.awayMulEquiv_comp_algebraMap
statement:
theorem awayMulEquiv_comp_algebraMap (f g : R) :
    (awayMulEquiv f g).toRingHom.comp (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (f * g))) =
      (algebraMap (Localization.Away f)
          (Localization.Away (algebraMap R (Localization.Away f) g))).comp
        (algebraMap R (Localization.Away f))
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro r
  rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.comp_apply]
  show (awayMulEquiv f g) (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (f * g)) r) = _
  change (IsLocalization.algEquiv (Submonoid.powers (f * g)) (Localization.Away (f * g))
      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R (Localization.Away f) g))) (algebraMap R _ r) = _
  rw [AlgEquiv.commutes]
  exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R (Localization.Away f) _ r

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.localizedIdeal_awayMulEquiv
statement:
theorem localizedIdeal_awayMulEquiv (I : Ideal R) (f g : R) :
    (localizedIdeal I (f * g)).map (awayMulEquiv f g).toRingHom =
      localizedIdeal (localizedIdeal I f) (algebraMap R (Localization.Away f) g)
proof:
:= by
  unfold localizedIdeal
  rw [Ideal.map_map, awayMulEquiv_comp_algebraMap, ← Ideal.map_map]

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesProjMap_localizedIdeal_comp_reesProjMap
statement:
theorem reesProjMap_localizedIdeal_comp_reesProjMap (I : Ideal R) (f g : R) :
    reesProjMap (localizedIdeal I f) (algebraMap R (Localization.Away f) g) ≫ reesProjMap I f =
      AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map
        ((gradedLocalizationMap (localizedIdeal I f) (algebraMap R (Localization.Away f) g)).comp
          (gradedLocalizationMap I f))
        (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedLocalizationMap I f)
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedLocalizationMap (localizedIdeal I f)
            (algebraMap R (Localization.Away f) g)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold reesProjMap
  exact (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map_comp
    (gradedLocalizationMap I f)
    (gradedLocalizationMap (localizedIdeal I f) (algebraMap R (Localization.Away f) g))
    (irrelevant_le_map_gradedLocalizationMap I f)
    (irrelevant_le_map_gradedLocalizationMap (localizedIdeal I f)
      (algebraMap R (Localization.Away f) g))).symm

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.awayMulComparison_projIso_hom_comp_reesProjMap
statement:
theorem awayMulComparison_projIso_hom_comp_reesProjMap (I : Ideal R) (f g : R) :
    (awayMulComparison I f g).projIso.hom ≫ reesProjMap I (f * g) =
      reesProjMap (localizedIdeal I f) (algebraMap R (Localization.Away f) g) ≫ reesProjMap I f
proof:
:= by
  rw [AffineOverlapComparison.projIso_hom_comp_reesProjMap I (f * g) (awayMulComparison I f g),
    reesProjMap_localizedIdeal_comp_reesProjMap]
  refine Proj_map_eq_of_pointwise_eq (localizedIdeal_awayMulEquiv I f g) _ _ ?_ _ _
  intro p
  show Polynomial.map (awayMulEquiv f g).toRingHom
      (Polynomial.map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (f * g))) (p : Polynomial R)) =
    Polynomial.map (algebraMap (Localization.Away f)
        (Localization.Away (algebraMap R (Localization.Away f) g)))
      (Polynomial.map (algebraMap R (Localization.Away f)) (p : Polynomial R))
  rw [Polynomial.map_map, Polynomial.map_map, awayMulEquiv_comp_algebraMap]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistChart_factorization_eq
statement:
theorem transportTwistChart_factorization_eq
    (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    (h : TransportTwistOverlapRestrictionEquality e C') (i j : C'.I)
    {W : Scheme.{u}} (v : W ⟶ (transport e C').scheme) [IsOpenImmersion v]
    (gi : W ⟶ (transport e C').chart i) (gj : W ⟶ (transport e C').chart j)
    [IsOpenImmersion gi] [IsOpenImmersion gj]
    (hi : gi ≫ (transport e C').chartι i = v)
    (hj : gj ≫ (transport e C').chartι j = v) :
    tensorOverlap_tr v ((transport e C').chartι i) gi hi
        (transportTwistChartIso e C' i).hom =
      tensorOverlap_tr v ((transport e C').chartι j) gj hj
        (transportTwistChartIso e C' j).hom
proof:
:= by
  let C := transport e C'
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.transition i j) := C.transition_isOpenImmersion' i j
  let s := C.overlapToChart i j ≫ C.chartι i
  have hs : s.opensRange = (C.chartι i).opensRange ⊓ (C.chartι j).opensRange :=
    overlapToAmbient_opensRange C i j
  have hrange : Set.range v.base ⊆ Set.range s.base := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    change v x ∈ s.opensRange
    rw [hs]
    constructor
    · change v x ∈ Set.range (C.chartι i)
      exact ⟨gi x, by rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hi]⟩
    · change v x ∈ Set.range (C.chartι j)
      exact ⟨gj x, by rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hj]⟩
  let k := IsOpenImmersion.lift s v hrange
  have hk : k ≫ s = v := IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _
  haveI : IsOpenImmersion k := by
    have : IsOpenImmersion (k ≫ s) := by rw [hk]; infer_instance
    exact IsOpenImmersion.of_comp k s
  have hki : k ≫ C.overlapToChart i j = gi := by
    apply (cancel_mono (C.chartι i)).1
    rw [Category.assoc, hi]
    exact hk
  have hkj : k ≫ (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i) = gj := by
    apply (cancel_mono (C.chartι j)).1
    rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, ← C.overlapToChart_chartι_eq i j, hj]
    exact hk
  have hkey := congrArg (fun f => (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor k).map f) (h i j)
  rw [tensorOverlap_tr_restrict s (C.chartι i) (C.overlapToChart i j) k rfl,
    tensorOverlap_tr_restrict s (C.chartι j)
      (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i) k
      (by rw [Category.assoc]; exact (C.overlapToChart_chartι_eq i j).symm)] at hkey
  simp only [Iso.cancel_iso_inv_left, Iso.cancel_iso_hom_right] at hkey
  have hCi := tensorOverlap_tr_congr (C.chartι i) hk hki
    (by rw [Category.assoc]) hi (transportTwistChartIso e C' i).hom
  have hCj := tensorOverlap_tr_congr (C.chartι j) hk hkj
    (by rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, ← C.overlapToChart_chartι_eq i j])
    hj (transportTwistChartIso e C' j).hom
  rw [hCi, hCj, hkey]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistChartRestrictionIndependence_of_overlapRestrictionEquality
statement:
theorem transportTwistChartRestrictionIndependence_of_overlapRestrictionEquality
    (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    (h : TransportTwistOverlapRestrictionEquality e C') :
    TransportTwistChartRestrictionIndependence e C'
proof:
:= by
  intro i j V hVi hVj
  rw [transportTwistChartOverIso, transportTwistChartOverIso,
    tensorOverlap_OI_eq, tensorOverlap_OI_eq,
    tensorOverlap_restrict_overIso, tensorOverlap_restrict_overIso]
  congr 2
  apply Iso.ext
  rw [tensorOverlap_openRange_tr, tensorOverlap_openRange_tr]
  exact transportTwistChart_factorization_eq e C' h i j V.ι _ _ _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistChartOverlapEquality_of_overlapRestrictionEquality
statement:
theorem transportTwistChartOverlapEquality_of_overlapRestrictionEquality
    (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')

    TransportTwistChartOverlapEquality e C'

  (transportTwistChartRestrictionIndependence_iff_overlapEquality e C').mp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistCompat_of_overlapRestrictionEquality
statement:
theorem transportTwistCompat_of_overlapRestrictionEquality

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.toddLine_mul_eSer
statement: theorem toddLine_mul_eSer : CharacteristicClasses.toddLine ℚ * eSer = 1
proof:
:= by
  have f1 : (X : ℚ⟦X⟧) * eSer - 1 + rescale (-1 : ℚ) (exp ℚ) = 0 := by rw [X_mul_eSer]; ring
  have f2 : CharacteristicClasses.toddLine ℚ * exp ℚ - CharacteristicClasses.toddLine ℚ
      - X * exp ℚ = 0 := by
    have := bernoulli'PowerSeries_mul_exp_sub_one ℚ
    unfold CharacteristicClasses.toddLine
    linear_combination this
  have f3 : exp ℚ * rescale (-1 : ℚ) (exp ℚ) - 1 = 0 := by
    have h := exp_mul_exp_eq_exp_add (A := ℚ) 1 (-1)
    rw [rescale_one, RingHom.id_apply, show (1 : ℚ) + -1 = 0 by norm_num,
      rescale_zero_apply] at h
    rw [h]
    simp
  have hX : (X : ℚ⟦X⟧) * (CharacteristicClasses.toddLine ℚ * eSer) = X * 1 := by
    linear_combination (CharacteristicClasses.toddLine ℚ) * f1 + rescale (-1 : ℚ) (exp ℚ) * f2
      + (X - CharacteristicClasses.toddLine ℚ) * f3
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ PowerSeries.X_ne_zero hX

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.toddLine_eq_tdSer
statement: theorem toddLine_eq_tdSer : CharacteristicClasses.toddLine ℚ = tdSer
proof:
:= by
  calc CharacteristicClasses.toddLine ℚ
      = CharacteristicClasses.toddLine ℚ * (eSer * tdSer) := by rw [eSer_mul_tdSer, mul_one]
    _ = (CharacteristicClasses.toddLine ℚ * eSer) * tdSer := by ring
    _ = tdSer := by rw [toddLine_mul_eSer, one_mul]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.expTrunc_deriv
statement:
theorem expTrunc_deriv (Ls : ℚ⟦X⟧) (N : ℕ) :
    (X : ℚ⟦X⟧) * d⁄dX ℚ (expTrunc Ls (N + 1)) =
      expTrunc Ls N * ((X : ℚ⟦X⟧) * d⁄dX ℚ Ls)
proof:
:= by
  unfold expTrunc
  rw [map_sum, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_range_succ' _ (N + 1)]
  have h0 : (X : ℚ⟦X⟧) * d⁄dX ℚ (((Nat.factorial 0 : ℚ)⁻¹) • Ls ^ 0) = 0 := by simp
  rw [h0, add_zero]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  have hq : (((j + 1).factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) = (j.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹ := by
    rw [Nat.factorial_succ]; push_cast; field_simp
  have hc : (algebraMap ℚ ℚ⟦X⟧ (((j + 1).factorial : ℚ)⁻¹)) * (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ⟦X⟧)) =
      algebraMap ℚ ℚ⟦X⟧ ((j.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) := by
    rw [← hq, map_mul, map_natCast]
  rw [Derivation.map_smul, derivative_pow, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  simp only [Algebra.smul_def]
  linear_combination ((X : ℚ⟦X⟧) * Ls ^ j * d⁄dX ℚ Ls) * hc

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.coeff_X_mul_deriv
statement:
theorem coeff_X_mul_deriv (F : ℚ⟦X⟧) (m : ℕ) :
    coeff m ((X : ℚ⟦X⟧) * d⁄dX ℚ F) = (m : ℚ) * coeff m F
proof:
:= by
  rcases m with _ | m
  · simp
  · rw [coeff_succ_X_mul, coeff_derivative]
    push_cast; ring

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.coeff_expTrunc
statement:
theorem coeff_expTrunc (Ls F : ℚ⟦X⟧) (hL0 : constantCoeff Ls = 0) (hF0 : constantCoeff F = 1)
    (hF : (X : ℚ⟦X⟧) * d⁄dX ℚ F = ((X : ℚ⟦X⟧) * d⁄dX ℚ Ls) * F) :
    ∀ m N, m ≤ N → coeff m (expTrunc Ls N) = coeff m F
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ m ih =>
    intro N hmN
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm
    · rw [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, hF0]
      unfold expTrunc
      simp [map_sum, hL0, Finset.sum_range_succ']
    · obtain ⟨N', rfl⟩ : ∃ N', N = N' + 1 := ⟨N - 1, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨m', rfl⟩ : ∃ m', m = m' + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
      have h1 := congrArg (coeff (m' + 1)) (expTrunc_deriv Ls N')
      have h2 := congrArg (coeff (m' + 1)) hF
      rw [coeff_succ_X_mul, coeff_derivative] at h1 h2
      have hD : coeff (m' + 1) (expTrunc Ls N' * ((X : ℚ⟦X⟧) * d⁄dX ℚ Ls)) =
          coeff (m' + 1) (((X : ℚ⟦X⟧) * d⁄dX ℚ Ls) * F) := by
        rw [mul_comm (expTrunc Ls N'), coeff_mul, coeff_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp => ?_
        rw [Finset.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos p.1 with h | h
        · have : coeff p.1 ((X : ℚ⟦X⟧) * d⁄dX ℚ Ls) = 0 := by
            rw [coeff_X_mul_deriv, h]; simp
          rw [this, zero_mul, zero_mul]
        · rw [ih p.2 (by omega) N' (by omega)]
      have h3 : coeff (m' + 1) (expTrunc Ls (N' + 1)) * ((m' : ℚ) + 1) =
          coeff (m' + 1) F * ((m' : ℚ) + 1) := by
        rw [h1, hD, ← h2]
      exact mul_right_cancel₀ (Nat.cast_add_one_ne_zero m') h3

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.constantCoeff_lser
statement: theorem constantCoeff_lser : constantCoeff lser = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, lser, coeff_mk, Alg.logCoeff]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.logCoeff_succ
statement:
theorem logCoeff_succ (q : ℕ → ℚ) (m : ℕ) :
    Alg.logCoeff q (m + 1) = q (m + 1) - (1 / ((m : ℚ) + 1)) *
      ∑ j : Fin m, (((j : ℕ) : ℚ) + 1) * Alg.logCoeff q ((j : ℕ) + 1) * q (m - (j : ℕ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Alg.logCoeff]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.tdSer_ode
statement: theorem tdSer_ode : (X : ℚ⟦X⟧) * d⁄dX ℚ tdSer = ((X : ℚ⟦X⟧) * d⁄dX ℚ lser) * tdSer
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : coeff 0 tdSer = 1 := by rw [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, constantCoeff_tdSer]
  ext m
  rcases m with _ | m
  · simp
  · rw [coeff_succ_X_mul, coeff_derivative, coeff_mul,
      Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ
        (fun i j => coeff i ((X : ℚ⟦X⟧) * d⁄dX ℚ lser) * coeff j tdSer) (m + 1)]
    simp only [coeff_X_mul_deriv, lser, coeff_mk]
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ' _ m]
    have hlog := logCoeff_succ (fun j ↦ coeff j tdSer) m
    have hs : ∑ j : Fin m, (((j : ℕ) : ℚ) + 1) *
        Alg.logCoeff (fun j ↦ coeff j tdSer) ((j : ℕ) + 1) * coeff (m - (j : ℕ)) tdSer =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, (((j : ℕ) : ℚ) + 1) *
        Alg.logCoeff (fun j ↦ coeff j tdSer) (j + 1) * coeff (m - j) tdSer :=
      Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j => (((j : ℕ) : ℚ) + 1) *
        Alg.logCoeff (fun j ↦ coeff j tdSer) (j + 1) * coeff (m - j) tdSer) m
    rw [hs] at hlog
    have e1 : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range m,
        (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ)) * Alg.logCoeff (fun j ↦ coeff j tdSer) (j + 1) *
          coeff (m + 1 - (j + 1)) tdSer =
        (((j : ℕ) : ℚ) + 1) * Alg.logCoeff (fun j ↦ coeff j tdSer) (j + 1) *
          coeff (m - j) tdSer := by
      intro j _
      rw [Nat.add_sub_add_right]; push_cast; ring
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl e1]
    simp only [Nat.sub_self, hq0, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, add_zero, mul_one]
    push_cast at hlog ⊢
    have hm : ((m : ℚ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have : ((m : ℚ) + 1) * Alg.logCoeff (fun j ↦ coeff j tdSer) (m + 1) =
        ((m : ℚ) + 1) * coeff (m + 1) tdSer - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m,
          (((j : ℕ) : ℚ) + 1) * Alg.logCoeff (fun j ↦ coeff j tdSer) (j + 1) *
            coeff (m - j) tdSer := by
      rw [show Alg.logCoeff (fun j ↦ coeff j tdSer) (m + 1) = _ from hlog]
      field_simp
    linarith

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.eSer_ode
statement: theorem eSer_ode : (X : ℚ⟦X⟧) * d⁄dX ℚ eSer = ((X : ℚ⟦X⟧) * d⁄dX ℚ (-lser)) * eSer
proof:
:= by
  have h2 := eSer_mul_tdSer
  have h5 : eSer * d⁄dX ℚ tdSer + tdSer * d⁄dX ℚ eSer = 0 := by
    have := congrArg (d⁄dX ℚ) h2
    rw [Derivation.leibniz, Derivation.map_one_eq_zero] at this
    simp only [smul_eq_mul] at this
    linear_combination this
  have h4 := tdSer_ode
  rw [map_neg]
  linear_combination (-((X : ℚ⟦X⟧) * d⁄dX ℚ eSer) - eSer * (X : ℚ⟦X⟧) * d⁄dX ℚ lser) * h2
    + ((X : ℚ⟦X⟧) * eSer) * h5 - eSer ^ 2 * h4

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.mem_DimLe
statement: theorem mem_DimLe {n : ℕ} {w : DirectSum ℕ M} : w ∈ DimLe M n ↔ ∀ j, n < j → w j = 0
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.lof_mem_DimLe
statement: theorem lof_mem_DimLe {d n : ℕ} (h : d ≤ n) (z : M d) : DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M d z ∈ DimLe M n
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  rw [DirectSum.lof_eq_of]
  exact DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne d j z (by omega)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.DimLe_mono
statement: theorem DimLe_mono {n n' : ℕ} (h : n ≤ n') : DimLe M n ≤ DimLe M n'
proof:
:=
  fun _ hw j hj => hw j (by omega)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.map_eq_of_DimLe
statement:
theorem map_eq_of_DimLe {n : ℕ} {w : DirectSum ℕ M} (hw : w ∈ DimLe M n) (F G : Alg.Op M)
    (h : ∀ d ≤ n, ∀ z : M d, F (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M d z) = G (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M d z)) :
    F w = G w
proof:
:= by
  rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_of w, map_sum, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
  have hin : i ≤ n := by
    by_contra hc
    exact (DFinsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hi) (hw i (by omega))
  rw [← DirectSum.lof_eq_of ℚ]
  exact h i hin _

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.Low.kill
statement:
theorem Low.kill {a : ℕ} {T : Alg.Op M} (hT : Low a T) {m : ℕ} (h : m < a) (z : M m) :
    T (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M m z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply DFinsupp.ext
  intro j
  exact hT m z j (by omega)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.Low.maps
statement:
theorem Low.maps {a : ℕ} {T : Alg.Op M} (hT : Low a T) {n : ℕ} {w : DirectSum ℕ M}
    (hw : w ∈ DimLe M n) : T w ∈ DimLe M (n - a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_of w, map_sum]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i hi => ?_
  have hin : i ≤ n := by
    by_contra hc
    exact (DFinsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hi) (hw i (by omega))
  intro j hj
  rw [← DirectSum.lof_eq_of ℚ]
  exact hT i (w i) j (by omega)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.Low.apply_support
statement:
theorem Low.apply_support {a b : ℕ} {T : Alg.Op M} (hT : Low a T) (m : ℕ)
    (v : DirectSum ℕ M) (hv : ∀ j', j' + b ≠ m → v j' = 0) (j : ℕ) (hj : j + (a + b) ≠ m) :
    T v j = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_of v, map_sum]
  change (DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ M j)
      (∑ i ∈ DFinsupp.support v, T (DirectSum.of M i (v i))) = 0
  rw [map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i hi ↦ ?_
  have hi' : v i ≠ 0 := DFinsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hi
  have hib : i + b = m := by
    by_contra hc
    exact hi' (hv i hc)
  exact hT i (v i) j (by omega)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.Low.mul
statement:
theorem Low.mul {a b : ℕ} {S T : Alg.Op M} (hS : Low a S) (hT : Low b T) :
    Low (a + b) (S * T)
proof:
:= by
  intro m z j hj
  rw [Module.End.mul_apply]
  exact hS.apply_support m _ (fun j' h => hT m z j' h) j hj

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.Low.one
statement: theorem Low.one : Low 0 (1 : Alg.Op M)
proof:
:= by
  intro m z j h
  rw [Module.End.one_apply]
  exact DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne m j z (by omega)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.Low.zero
statement: theorem Low.zero {a : ℕ} : Low a (0 : Alg.Op M)
proof:
:= by
  intro m z j h; simp

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.Low.add
statement: theorem Low.add {a : ℕ} {S T : Alg.Op M} (hS : Low a S) (hT : Low a T) : Low a (S + T)
proof:
:= by
  intro m z j h
  rw [LinearMap.add_apply, DirectSum.add_apply, hS m z j h, hT m z j h, add_zero]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.Low.smul
statement: theorem Low.smul {a : ℕ} {T : Alg.Op M} (q : ℚ) (hT : Low a T) : Low a (q • T)
proof:
:= by
  intro m z j h
  rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, DirectSum.smul_apply, hT m z j h, smul_zero]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.Low.neg
statement: theorem Low.neg {a : ℕ} {T : Alg.Op M} (hT : Low a T) : Low a (-T)
proof:
:= by
  have e : -T = (-(1 : ℚ)) • T := by ext x; simp
  rw [e]
  exact hT.smul _

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.Low.congr
statement: theorem Low.congr {a b : ℕ} {T : Alg.Op M} (h : a = b) (hT : Low a T) : Low b T
proof: := h ▸ hT

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.Low.sum
statement:
theorem Low.sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) {a : ℕ} {T : ι → Alg.Op M}
    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, Low a (T i)) : Low a (∑ i ∈ s, T i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using (Low.zero (M := M) (a := a))
  | insert i s hi ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hi]
    exact (h i (Finset.mem_insert_self i s)).add (ih fun j hj => h j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj))

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.Low.pow_one
statement: theorem Low.pow_one {H : Alg.Op M} (hH : Low 1 H) : ∀ j : ℕ, Low j (H ^ j)
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero => simpa using (Low.one (M := M))
  | succ j ih => rw [pow_succ]; exact ih.mul hH

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.powerSum_low
statement: theorem powerSum_low (c : ℕ → Alg.Op M) (hc : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → Low j (c j)) : ∀ m, Low m (Alg.powerSum c m)
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ m ih =>
    cases m with
    | zero => rw [Alg.powerSum]; exact Low.zero
    | succ m =>
      rw [Alg.powerSum]
      refine Low.add (Low.sum _ fun i _ => ?_) (Low.smul _ (hc _ (Nat.succ_pos _)))
      refine Low.smul _ (Low.congr (by omega) ((hc _ (Nat.succ_pos _)).mul (ih _ (by omega))))

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.gsum_apply_DimLe
statement:
theorem gsum_apply_DimLe {a : ℕ → Alg.Op M} (ha : ∀ m, Low m (a m)) {n : ℕ} {w : DirectSum ℕ M}
    (hw : w ∈ DimLe M n) : Alg.gsum a w = (∑ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), a m) w
proof:
:= by
  refine map_eq_of_DimLe hw _ _ fun d hd z => ?_
  rw [Alg.gsum_lof, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_subset_range.2 (by omega)) fun m _ hm => ?_
  exact (ha m).kill (by simpa using hm) z

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.pow_kill
statement:
theorem pow_kill {L : Alg.Op M} (hL0 : ∀ w ∈ DimLe M 0, L w = 0)
    (hL1 : ∀ p, ∀ w ∈ DimLe M (p + 1), L w ∈ DimLe M p) :
    ∀ j p, ∀ w ∈ DimLe M p, p < j → (L ^ j) w = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero => intro p w _ h; omega
  | succ j ih =>
    intro p w hw hp
    rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply]
    cases p with
    | zero => rw [hL0 w hw, map_zero]
    | succ p => exact ih p _ (hL1 p w hw) (by omega)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.evTrunc_eq_sum
statement:
theorem evTrunc_eq_sum {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module ℚ N] (n : ℕ) (H : Module.End ℚ N)
    (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) : evTrunc n H f = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (coeff m f) • H ^ m
proof:
:= by
  unfold evTrunc
  rw [Polynomial.aeval_eq_sum_range' (natDegree_trunc_lt f n)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
  rw [coeff_trunc, if_pos (Finset.mem_range.1 hi)]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.evTrunc_congr
statement:
theorem evTrunc_congr {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module ℚ N] (n : ℕ) (H : Module.End ℚ N)
    {f g : ℚ⟦X⟧} (h : ∀ i ≤ n, coeff i f = coeff i g) : evTrunc n H f = evTrunc n H g
proof:
:= by
  rw [evTrunc_eq_sum, evTrunc_eq_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => by rw [h i (by simpa [Nat.lt_succ_iff] using hi)]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.evTrunc_mem_DimLe
statement:
theorem evTrunc_mem_DimLe {H : Alg.Op M} (hH : Low 1 H) (n : ℕ) (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) {w : DirectSum ℕ M}
    (hw : w ∈ DimLe M n) : evTrunc n H f w ∈ DimLe M n
proof:
:= by
  rw [evTrunc_eq_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun m _ => ?_
  rw [LinearMap.smul_apply]
  refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
  exact DimLe_mono (Nat.sub_le n m) (((Low.pow_one hH m).maps hw))

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.gexp_eq_expTrunc
proof:
:= by
  have hv : (H ^ (n + 1)) w = 0 := by
    have := map_eq_of_DimLe hw (H ^ (n + 1)) 0 fun d hd z => by
      rw [(Low.pow_one hH (n + 1)).kill (by omega) z]; rfl
    simpa using this
  have hL0 : ∀ w ∈ DimLe M 0, L w = 0 := by
    intro w hw
    rw [hL 0 w hw, evTrunc_eq_sum]
    simp [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, h0]
  have hL1 : ∀ p, ∀ w ∈ DimLe M (p + 1), L w ∈ DimLe M p := by
    intro p w hw
    rw [hL (p + 1) w hw, evTrunc_eq_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun m _ => ?_
    rw [LinearMap.smul_apply]
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm
    · simp [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, h0]
    · exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _
        (DimLe_mono (by omega) ((Low.pow_one hH m).maps hw))
  have hk := pow_kill hL0 hL1
  have hP : ∀ j, (L ^ j) w = ((evTrunc n H Ls) ^ j) w ∧ ((evTrunc n H Ls) ^ j) w ∈ DimLe M n := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => exact ⟨rfl, by simpa using hw⟩
    | succ j ih =>
      rw [pow_succ', pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, ih.1]
      exact ⟨hL n _ ih.2, evTrunc_mem_DimLe hH n Ls ih.2⟩
  have e1 : Alg.gexp L w =
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((j.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) • L ^ j) w := by
    refine map_eq_of_DimLe hw _ _ fun d hd z => ?_
    rw [Alg.gexp_lof, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_subset_range.2 (by omega)) fun j _ hj => ?_
    rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, hk j d _ (lof_mem_DimLe le_rfl z) (by simpa using hj), smul_zero]
  rw [e1, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  have e2 : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      (((j.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) • L ^ j) w = ((j.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) • evTrunc n H (Ls ^ j) w := by
    intro j _
    rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, (hP j).1, evTrunc_pow_apply n H w hv Ls j]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl e2]
  simp only [expTrunc, evTrunc_eq_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_sum,
    map_smul, Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul, Finset.sum_smul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
  rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.gexp_gsum_apply_DimLe
statement:
theorem gexp_gsum_apply_DimLe {a : ℕ → Alg.Op M} (ha : ∀ m, Low m (a m)) (h0 : a 0 = 0) {n : ℕ}
    {w : DirectSum ℕ M} (hw : w ∈ DimLe M n) :
    Alg.gexp (Alg.gsum a) w =
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((j.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) • (Alg.gsum a) ^ j) w
proof:
:= by
  have hL0 : ∀ w ∈ DimLe M 0, Alg.gsum a w = 0 := by
    intro w hw
    rw [gsum_apply_DimLe ha hw]
    simp [h0]
  have hL1 : ∀ p, ∀ w ∈ DimLe M (p + 1), Alg.gsum a w ∈ DimLe M p := by
    intro p w hw
    rw [gsum_apply_DimLe ha hw, LinearMap.sum_apply]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun m _ => ?_
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm
    · simp [h0]
    · exact DimLe_mono (by omega) ((ha m).maps hw)
  have hk := pow_kill hL0 hL1
  refine map_eq_of_DimLe hw _ _ fun d hd z => ?_
  rw [Alg.gexp_lof, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_subset_range.2 (by omega)) fun j _ hj => ?_
  rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, hk j d _ (lof_mem_DimLe le_rfl z) (by simpa using hj), smul_zero]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.chFromChern_apply_DimLe
statement:
theorem chFromChern_apply_DimLe {c : ℕ → Alg.Op M} (hc : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → Low j (c j)) (r : ℕ) {n : ℕ}
    {w : DirectSum ℕ M} (hw : w ∈ DimLe M n) :
    Alg.chFromChern r c w = (r : ℚ) • w + (∑ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      (if m = 0 then (0 : Alg.Op M) else
        (PowerSeries.coeff m (CharacteristicClasses.chLine ℚ)) • Alg.powerSum c m)) w
proof:
:= by
  unfold Alg.chFromChern
  rw [LinearMap.add_apply, gsum_apply_DimLe _ hw]
  · simp
  · intro m
    by_cases hm : m = 0
    · simp only [hm, if_true]; exact Low.zero
    · simp only [hm, if_false]
      exact Low.smul _ (powerSum_low c hc m)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.logTd_low
statement:
theorem logTd_low {c : ℕ → Alg.Op M} (hc : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → Low j (c j)) (m : ℕ) :
    Low m (if m = 0 then (0 : Alg.Op M) else
      Alg.logCoeff (fun j ↦ PowerSeries.coeff j (CharacteristicClasses.toddLine ℚ)) m •
        Alg.powerSum c m)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hm : m = 0
  · simp only [hm, if_true]; exact Low.zero
  · simp only [hm, if_false]
    exact Low.smul _ (powerSum_low c hc m)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.evTrunc_neg
statement:
theorem evTrunc_neg {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module ℚ N] (n : ℕ) (H : Module.End ℚ N)
    (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) : evTrunc n H (-f) = -evTrunc n H f
proof:
:= by
  simp [evTrunc_eq_sum, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.logTd_line_apply
statement:
theorem logTd_line_apply {c : ℕ → Alg.Op M} {H : Alg.Op M} (hH : Low 1 H) (h1 : c 1 = H)
    (h2 : ∀ j, 2 ≤ j → c j = 0) (n : ℕ) (w : DirectSum ℕ M) (hw : w ∈ DimLe M n) :
    Alg.logTd c w = evTrunc n H lser w
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → Low j (c j) := by
    intro j hj
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j 2 with h | h
    · have : j = 1 := by omega
      subst this; rw [h1]; exact hH
    · rw [h2 j h]; exact Low.zero
  have hps : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → Alg.powerSum c m = H ^ m := Alg.powerSum_line H c h1 h2
  unfold Alg.logTd
  rw [gsum_apply_DimLe (logTd_low hc) hw, LinearMap.sum_apply, evTrunc_eq_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => ?_
  rw [LinearMap.smul_apply]
  by_cases hm : m = 0
  · subst hm
    have : coeff 0 lser = 0 := by rw [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, constantCoeff_lser]
    simp [this]
  · simp only [hm, if_false]
    rw [hps m (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 hm), toddLine_eq_tdSer, lser, coeff_mk]
    rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.tdFromChern_line_apply
statement:
theorem tdFromChern_line_apply {c : ℕ → Alg.Op M} {H : Alg.Op M} (hH : Low 1 H) (h1 : c 1 = H)
    (h2 : ∀ j, 2 ≤ j → c j = 0) {n : ℕ} {w : DirectSum ℕ M} (hw : w ∈ DimLe M n) :
    Alg.tdFromChern c w = evTrunc n H tdSer w
proof:
:= by
  unfold Alg.tdFromChern
  rw [gexp_eq_expTrunc hH constantCoeff_lser (fun n w hw => logTd_line_apply hH h1 h2 n w hw) hw]
  rw [evTrunc_congr n H (g := tdSer)]
  intro i hi
  exact coeff_expTrunc lser tdSer constantCoeff_lser constantCoeff_tdSer tdSer_ode i n hi

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.tdInvFromChern_line_apply
proof:
:= by
  unfold Alg.tdInvFromChern
  have h0 : constantCoeff (-lser) = 0 := by rw [map_neg, constantCoeff_lser, neg_zero]
  rw [gexp_eq_expTrunc hH h0 (fun n w hw => by
    rw [evTrunc_neg, LinearMap.neg_apply, logTd_line_apply hH h1 h2 n w hw]
    rfl) hw]
  rw [evTrunc_congr n H (g := eSer)]
  intro i hi
  exact coeff_expTrunc (-lser) eSer h0 constantCoeff_eSer eSer_ode i n hi

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.chernSeq_low
statement:
theorem chernSeq_low (hP : ProjBundleClosedPos (ProjectiveIntegral k)) {E : W.Modules} {r : ℕ}
    (hE : HasConstantRank W E r) (j : ℕ) : Low (M := Dim k W) j (chernSeq k hP E j)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.nonempty_of_projectiveIntegral k W
  exact AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.cOp_lowering
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.whitneyConstRankOn_projectiveIntegral hE j

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.powerSum_chernSeq_low
proof:
:=
  powerSum_low _ (fun j _ ↦ chernSeq_low k hP hE j) m

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.chBundle_apply_DimLe
statement:
theorem chBundle_apply_DimLe (hP : ProjBundleClosedPos (ProjectiveIntegral k)) {E : W.Modules}
    {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank W E r) {n : ℕ} {w : DirectSum ℕ (Dim k W)}
    (hw : w ∈ DimLe (Dim k W) n) :
    chBundle k hP E w = (rkOf E : ℚ) • w + (∑ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      (if m = 0 then (0 : Module.End ℚ (TotalChow W)) else
        (PowerSeries.coeff m (CharacteristicClasses.chLine ℚ)) •
          Alg.powerSum (chernSeq k hP E) m)) w
proof:
:= by
  unfold chBundle
  exact chFromChern_apply_DimLe (fun j _ ↦ chernSeq_low k hP hE j) _ hw

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.tdFromChern_chernSeq_apply_DimLe
statement:
theorem tdFromChern_chernSeq_apply_DimLe (hP : ProjBundleClosedPos (ProjectiveIntegral k))
    {E : W.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank W E r) {n : ℕ} {w : DirectSum ℕ (Dim k W)}
    (hw : w ∈ DimLe (Dim k W) n) :
    Alg.tdFromChern (chernSeq k hP E) w =
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ((j.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) • (Alg.logTd (chernSeq k hP E)) ^ j) w
proof:
:=
  gexp_gsum_apply_DimLe (fun m ↦ logTd_low (fun j _ ↦ chernSeq_low k hP hE j) m) (by simp) hw

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.lineChern_one
statement:
theorem lineChern_one (L : W.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank W L 1) :
    lineChern k L hL 1 = AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K3.totalCapOn (opsV4 k) L hL
proof:
:= by
  simp [lineChern, AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K7.chernLineValOn]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.lineChern_ge_two
statement:
theorem lineChern_ge_two (L : W.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank W L 1) (j : ℕ) (hj : 2 ≤ j) :
    lineChern k L hL j = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [lineChern, AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K7.chernLineValOn, show j ≠ 0 by omega,
    show j ≠ 1 by omega]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.lineChern_low
statement:
theorem lineChern_low (L : W.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank W L 1) :
    Low (M := Dim k W) 1 (lineChern k L hL 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lineChern_one]
  exact AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.totalCapOn_mem_lowering (opsV4 k) L hL

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.tdLine_apply_evTrunc
proof:
:=
  tdFromChern_line_apply (lineChern_low k L hL) rfl (lineChern_ge_two k L hL) hw

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.tdLine_apply_tdOpOn
statement:
theorem tdLine_apply_tdOpOn (L : W.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank W L 1) {n : ℕ}
    {w : DirectSum ℕ (Dim k W)} (hw : w ∈ DimLe (Dim k W) n) :
    tdLine k L hL w = (∑ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.tdOpOn (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) (closedPosV4 k) W L m) w
proof:
:= by
  haveI := AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.nonempty_of_projectiveIntegral k W
  rw [tdLine_apply_evTrunc k L hL hw, evTrunc_eq_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => ?_
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.tdOpOn_line L hL m, toddLine_eq_tdSer, lineChern_one]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.tdLine_eq_gsum_tdOpOn
statement:
theorem tdLine_eq_gsum_tdOpOn (L : W.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank W L 1) :
    tdLine k L hL = Alg.gsum
      (fun m ↦ AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.M7ASM.tdOpOn (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) (closedPosV4 k) W L m)
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.linearMap_ext ℚ fun n => ?_
  refine LinearMap.ext fun z => ?_
  have hw := lof_mem_DimLe (M := Dim k W) (le_refl n) z
  have h := tdLine_apply_tdOpOn k L hL hw
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  rw [Alg.gsum_lof]
  exact h

name: GRRBlueprintV4.V4R.tdInvN_line_apply
statement:
theorem tdInvN_line_apply (hP : ProjBundleClosedPos (ProjectiveIntegral k)) (i : X ⟶ Z)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (hr : HasConstantRank X (conormalSheaf i) 1) {n : ℕ}
    {w : DirectSum ℕ (Dim k X)} (hw : w ∈ DimLe (Dim k X) n) :
    tdInvN k hP i w = evTrunc n (-(lineChern k (conormalSheaf i) hr 1)) eSer w
proof:
:= by
  unfold tdInvN
  have hc : ∀ j, chernSeq k hP (conormalSheaf i) j = lineChern k (conormalSheaf i) hr j :=
    chernSeq_line k hP (conormalSheaf i) hr
  have h1 : Alg.dualChern (chernSeq k hP (conormalSheaf i)) 1 =
      -(lineChern k (conormalSheaf i) hr 1) := by
    simp only [Alg.dualChern, pow_one, hc]
    ext v
    simp
  have h2 : ∀ j, 2 ≤ j → Alg.dualChern (chernSeq k hP (conormalSheaf i)) j = 0 := by
    intro j hj
    simp [Alg.dualChern, hc, lineChern_ge_two k _ hr j hj]
  exact tdInvFromChern_line_apply (Low.neg (lineChern_low k _ hr)) h1 h2 hw

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.sectionCoordSec_pullbackFrame
statement:
theorem sectionCoordSec_pullbackFrame {q : P} (d : LineBundleLocalData P M q) (t : Γ(M, ⊤))
    (p : X) (hp : j p ∈ d.U) :
    sectionCoordSec (C1Cap.pullbackFrame j d p hp) (pullbackSection j t) =
      j.app d.U (sectionCoordSec d t)
proof:
:= by
  apply C1Cap.frameSec_injective (C1Cap.pullbackFrame j d p hp) _ le_rfl
  rw [sectionCoordSec_spec, C1Cap.frameSec_smul (C1Cap.pullbackFrame j d p hp) _ le_rfl,
    C1Cap.frameSec_one, C1Cap.frameGen_pullbackFrame]
  have e1 := sectionCoordSec_spec d t
  rw [C1Cap.frameSec_smul d d.U le_rfl, C1Cap.frameSec_one] at e1
  have h1 := congrArg (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j).unit.app M).app d.U) e1
  have h2 := C1Cap.app_presheaf_map ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j).unit.app M)
    (homOfLE (le_top : d.U ≤ ⊤)) t
  have h3 := Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j).unit.app M)
    (sectionCoordSec d t) (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_refl d.U)).op (C1Cap.frameGen d))
  have h4 := C1Cap.app_presheaf_map ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j).unit.app M)
    (homOfLE (le_refl d.U)) (C1Cap.frameGen d)
  exact h2.symm.trans (h1.symm.trans (h3.trans (congrArg (fun z ↦ sectionCoordSec d t • z) h4)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.generated_pullback
statement:
theorem generated_pullback
    (h : ∀ q : P, ∃ t : Γ(M, ⊤), ∃ d : LineBundleLocalData P M q,
      IsUnit (P.presheaf.germ d.U q d.mem (sectionCoordSec d t))) (p : X) :
    ∃ s : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj M, ⊤),
      ∃ d : LineBundleLocalData X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj M) p,
        IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ d.U p d.mem (sectionCoordSec d s))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, d, hu⟩ := h (j p)
  refine ⟨pullbackSection j t, C1Cap.pullbackFrame j d p d.mem, ?_⟩
  rw [sectionCoordSec_pullbackFrame]
  have := hu.map (j.stalkMap p).hom
  rw [Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply] at this
  exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.isUnit_germ_coord_of_surj
statement:
theorem isUnit_germ_coord_of_surj (t : Γ(M, ⊤)) (U : P.Opens)
    (hsurj : ∀ W : P.Opens, W ≤ U → ∀ m : Γ(M, W),
      ∃ u : Γ(P, W), u • M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op t = m)
    {q : P} (hq : q ∈ U) (d : LineBundleLocalData P M q) :
    IsUnit (P.presheaf.germ d.U q d.mem (sectionCoordSec d t))
proof:
:= by
  set W : P.Opens := d.U ⊓ U with hW
  have hqW : q ∈ W := ⟨d.mem, hq⟩
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hsurj W inf_le_right (C1Cap.frameSec d W inf_le_left 1)
  set c := sectionCoordSec d t with hc
  have e1 : C1Cap.frameSec d W inf_le_left (P.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : W ≤ d.U)).op c) =
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op t := by
    have l1 := frameSec_restrict d d.U W le_rfl inf_le_left c
    have e2 := sectionCoordSec_spec d t
    rw [hc, l1, e2, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← M.presheaf.map_comp]
    rfl
  have e3 : C1Cap.frameSec d W inf_le_left
      (u * P.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : W ≤ d.U)).op c) =
      C1Cap.frameSec d W inf_le_left 1 := by
    rw [C1Cap.frameSec_smul d W inf_le_left (u * _), mul_smul,
      ← C1Cap.frameSec_smul d W inf_le_left (P.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : W ≤ d.U)).op c),
      e1]
    exact hu
  have e4 := C1Cap.frameSec_injective d W inf_le_left e3
  have e5 := congrArg (P.presheaf.germ W q hqW) e4
  rw [map_mul, map_one, P.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE (inf_le_left : W ≤ d.U)) q hqW c] at e5
  exact isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_right (e5 ▸ isUnit_one)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.surj_of_isIso_restrict
statement:
theorem surj_of_isIso_restrict (φ : (SheafOfModules.unit P.ringCatSheaf : P.Modules) ⟶ M) (U : P.Opens)
    (hφ : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map φ)) (W : P.Opens) (hW : W ≤ U)
    (m : Γ(M, W)) :
    ∃ u : Γ(P, W), u • M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app φ ⊤ (1 : Γ(P, ⊤))) = m
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hφ
  have key : ∀ V : (U : Scheme.{u}).Opens, ∀ m : Γ(M, U.ι ''ᵁ V),
      ∃ u : Γ(P, U.ι ''ᵁ V), Scheme.Modules.Hom.app φ (U.ι ''ᵁ V) u = m := by
    intro V m
    let e := asIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map φ)
    exact ⟨e.inv.app V m, C1Cap.iso_hom_inv_app e V m⟩
  have hW' : U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W) = W := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι,
      inf_eq_right.mpr hW]
  have := key (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)
  rw [hW'] at this
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := this m
  refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
  have h1 := C1Cap.app_presheaf_map φ (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)) (1 : Γ(P, ⊤))
  rw [C1Cap.unit_presheaf_map_one] at h1
  have h2 := Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul φ u (1 : Γ(P, W))
  rw [← hu, ← h1]
  refine h2.symm.trans ?_
  congr 1
  exact (smul_eq_mul u 1).trans (mul_one u)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.projectiveTwisting_generated_aux
statement:
theorem projectiveTwisting_generated_aux (d' : ℤ) (hd : (0 : ℤ) + 1 = d')
    (hL : HasConstantRank (space k N) (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N d') 1) (q : space k N) :
    ∃ t : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k N d', ⊤),
      ∃ d : LineBundleLocalData (space k N) (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N d') q,
        IsUnit ((space k N).presheaf.germ d.U q d.mem (sectionCoordSec d t))
proof:
:= by
  subst hd
  have hq : q ∈ (⊤ : (space k N).Opens) := trivial
  rw [← coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top k N, TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup] at hq
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hq
  let φ : SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf (space k N) ⟶
      projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (0 + 1) :=
    (projectiveTwistingZeroIso k N).inv ≫ Koszul.X k N i 0
  haveI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen k N i).ι).map φ) := by
    have hmap : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen k N i).ι).map φ =
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen k N i).ι).map
          (projectiveTwistingZeroIso k N).inv ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen k N i).ι).map (Koszul.X k N i 0) :=
      Functor.map_comp _ _ _
    rw [hmap]
    haveI := Koszul.X_restrict_isIso k N i 0
    haveI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen k N i).ι).map
        (projectiveTwistingZeroIso k N).inv) := inferInstance
    exact IsIso.comp_isIso
  obtain ⟨d⟩ := Scheme.Modules.exists_lineBundleLocalDataAt (space k N) _
    hL.isFiniteLocallyFree (genericRank_eq_one_of_hasConstantRank hL) q
  exact ⟨_, d, isUnit_germ_coord_of_surj _ (coordinateOpen k N i)
    (fun W hW m ↦ surj_of_isIso_restrict φ _ this W hW m) hi d⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.projectiveTwisting_one_generated
statement:
theorem projectiveTwisting_one_generated
    (hL : HasConstantRank (space k N) (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N 1) 1) (q : space k N) :
    ∃ t : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k N 1, ⊤),
      ∃ d : LineBundleLocalData (space k N) (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N 1) q,
        IsUnit ((space k N).presheaf.germ d.U q d.mem (sectionCoordSec d t))
proof:
:=
  projectiveTwisting_generated_aux k N 1 (by norm_num) hL q

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.hasConstantRank_twistPullback
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_twistPullback (N : ℕ) (j : X ⟶ space k N) :
    HasConstantRank X (twistPullback (k := k) N j) 1
proof:
:=
  hasConstantRank_pullback X j _ 1 (hasConstantRank_twist N 1)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.twistPullback_generated
statement:
theorem twistPullback_generated (N : ℕ) (j : X ⟶ space k N) (p : X) :
    ∃ s : Γ(twistPullback (k := k) N j, ⊤),
      ∃ d : LineBundleLocalData X (twistPullback (k := k) N j) p,
        IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ d.U p d.mem (sectionCoordSec d s))

  generated_pullback j (fun q ↦ projectiveTwisting_one_generated k N (hasConstantRank_twist N 1) q) p

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.movingFrames_twistPullback

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.capDescends_twistPullback
statement:
theorem capDescends_twistPullback [Infinite k] (N : ℕ) (j : X ⟶ space k N) (n : ℕ) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E11.inv_segre_series
statement:
theorem inv_segre_series (ℓ μ : Module.End ℚ V) (s : ℕ → Module.End ℚ V)
    (h0 : s 0 = 1) (h1 : s 1 = ℓ + μ) (hrec : ∀ i, s (i + 2) = (ℓ + μ) * s (i + 1) - ℓ * μ * s i) :
    PowerSeries.invOfUnit (PowerSeries.mk s) 1 =
      PowerSeries.mk (fun i => if i = 0 then 1 else if i = 1 then -(ℓ + μ)
        else if i = 2 then ℓ * μ else 0)
proof:
:= by
  let φ : PowerSeries (Module.End ℚ V) := PowerSeries.mk (fun i => if i = 0 then 1
    else if i = 1 then -(ℓ + μ) else if i = 2 then ℓ * μ else 0)
  let ψ : PowerSeries (Module.End ℚ V) := PowerSeries.mk s
  have hψ : PowerSeries.constantCoeff ψ = (1 : (Module.End ℚ V)ˣ) := by simp [ψ, h0]
  have hmul : φ * ψ = 1 := by
    refine PowerSeries.ext fun n => ?_
    rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_one]
    rcases n with _ | _ | _ | n
    · simp [φ, ψ, h0]
    · simp [φ, ψ, h0, h1, Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_succ]
    · simp [φ, ψ, h0, h1, Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_succ, hrec 0]
      noncomm_ring
    · rw [Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_succ, Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_succ,
        Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_succ]
      have hz : ∀ x ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, (PowerSeries.coeff (x.1 + 1 + 1 + 1) φ) *
          PowerSeries.coeff x.2 ψ = 0 := by
        intro x _
        simp [φ]
      dsimp only
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero hz]
      simp [φ, ψ]
      rw [hrec (n + 1)]
      noncomm_ring
  change PowerSeries.invOfUnit ψ 1 = φ
  calc
    PowerSeries.invOfUnit ψ 1 = (φ * ψ) * PowerSeries.invOfUnit ψ 1 := by rw [hmul, one_mul]
    _ = φ := by rw [mul_assoc, PowerSeries.mul_invOfUnit ψ 1 hψ, mul_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E11.conv_lines
statement:
theorem conv_lines (ℓ μ : Module.End ℚ V) (n : ℕ) :
    (if n = 0 then (1 : Module.End ℚ V) else if n = 1 then ℓ + μ else if n = 2 then ℓ * μ
      else 0) =
    ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n,
      (if p.1 = 0 then (1 : Module.End ℚ V) else if p.1 = 1 then ℓ else 0) ∘ₗ
      (if p.2 = 0 then (1 : Module.End ℚ V) else if p.2 = 1 then μ else 0)
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with _ | _ | n
  · simp [Module.End.one_eq_id]
  · simp [Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_succ, Module.End.one_eq_id]
    rw [add_comm]
  · rw [Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_succ, Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_succ]
    have : ∀ x ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n,
        (if x.1 + 1 + 1 = 0 then (1 : Module.End ℚ V) else if x.1 + 1 + 1 = 1 then ℓ else 0) ∘ₗ
        (if x.2 = 0 then (1 : Module.End ℚ V) else if x.2 = 1 then μ else 0) = 0 := by
      intro x _
      simp
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero this]
    rcases n with _ | n
    · simp [Module.End.one_eq_id]
      rfl
    · simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E11.quad_alg
statement:
theorem quad_alg {R : Type*} [Ring R] (ξ a b : R) (h : (ξ - a) * (ξ - b) = 0)
    (hc : ξ * b = b * ξ) (m : ℕ) : ξ ^ (m + 2) = (a + b) * ξ ^ (m + 1) - a * b * ξ ^ m
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ξ * ξ = (a + b) * ξ - a * b := by
    have h2 : (ξ - a) * (ξ - b) = ξ * ξ - ξ * b - a * ξ + a * b := by noncomm_ring
    rw [h2, hc] at h
    rw [add_mul, ← sub_eq_zero, ← h]
    abel
  rw [show m + 2 = 2 + m by omega, pow_add, pow_two, h1, pow_succ' ξ m]
  noncomm_ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E11.sandwich_alg
statement:
theorem sandwich_alg {S T : Type*} [AddCommGroup S] [Module ℚ S] [AddCommGroup T] [Module ℚ T]
    (P : T →ₗ[ℚ] S) (Q : S →ₗ[ℚ] T) (ξ a b : Module.End ℚ T) (ℓ μ : Module.End ℚ S)
    (hrel : (ξ - a) * (ξ - b) = 0) (hξb : ξ * b = b * ξ)
    (pa : P ∘ₗ a = ℓ ∘ₗ P) (pb : P ∘ₗ b = μ ∘ₗ P) (m : ℕ) :
    P ∘ₗ ((ξ ^ (m + 2)) ∘ₗ Q) = (ℓ + μ) ∘ₗ (P ∘ₗ ((ξ ^ (m + 1)) ∘ₗ Q)) -
      ℓ ∘ₗ (μ ∘ₗ (P ∘ₗ ((ξ ^ m) ∘ₗ Q)))
proof:
:= by
  have hpow : ξ ^ (m + 2) = (a + b) * ξ ^ (m + 1) - a * b * ξ ^ m := quad_alg ξ a b hrel hξb m
  have pa' : ∀ (W : S →ₗ[ℚ] T), P ∘ₗ (a ∘ₗ W) = ℓ ∘ₗ (P ∘ₗ W) :=
    fun W ↦ by rw [← LinearMap.comp_assoc, pa, LinearMap.comp_assoc]
  have pb' : ∀ (W : S →ₗ[ℚ] T), P ∘ₗ (b ∘ₗ W) = μ ∘ₗ (P ∘ₗ W) :=
    fun W ↦ by rw [← LinearMap.comp_assoc, pb, LinearMap.comp_assoc]
  rw [hpow]
  simp only [Module.End.mul_eq_comp, LinearMap.sub_comp, LinearMap.comp_sub, LinearMap.add_comp,
    LinearMap.comp_add, LinearMap.comp_assoc]
  rw [pa', pa', pb', pb']

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E11.sandwich_rec
statement:
theorem sandwich_rec (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1)
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = 1 + 1) (m : ℕ) :
    sandwich ops C cp hC (m + 2) =
      (totalCap ops L hL + totalCap ops M hM) * sandwich ops C cp hC (m + 1) -
        totalCap ops L hL * totalCap ops M hM * sandwich ops C cp hC m
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Flat C.toBase := C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos 1))
  have hrel := E10.xi_relation ops C hL hM
  have hξb : xiCap ops C * totalCap ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj M)
      (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase M 1 hM) =
      totalCap ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj M)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase M 1 hM) * xiCap ops C :=
    cp.cap_comm (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj M)
      (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
      (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase M 1 hM)
  exact sandwich_alg (totalPush ops C.toBase)
    (totalPull ops C.toBase 1 (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC)) (xiCap ops C) _ _
    (totalCap ops L hL) (totalCap ops M hM) hrel hξb (cp.cap_push C.toBase L hL)
    (cp.cap_push C.toBase M hM) m

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E11.segre_rec
statement:
theorem segre_rec (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1)
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = 1 + 1) :
    segre ops C cp hC 0 = 1 ∧
    segre ops C cp hC 1 = totalCap ops L hL + totalCap ops M hM ∧
    ∀ i, segre ops C cp hC (i + 2) =
      (totalCap ops L hL + totalCap ops M hM) * segre ops C cp hC (i + 1) -
        totalCap ops L hL * totalCap ops M hM * segre ops C cp hC i
proof:
:= by
  have s0 := segre_zero ops C cp hC
  have z : sandwich ops C cp hC 0 = 0 := sandwich_eq_zero_of_lt ops C cp hC Nat.zero_lt_one
  refine ⟨s0, ?_, fun i => ?_⟩
  · have h := sandwich_rec ops cp C hL hM hC 0
    have s0' : sandwich ops C cp hC 1 = 1 := s0
    change sandwich ops C cp hC (0 + 2) = _
    rw [h, zero_add, s0', z]
    noncomm_ring
  · have h := sandwich_rec ops cp C hL hM hC (i + 1)
    change sandwich ops C cp hC (1 + (i + 2)) = _ * sandwich ops C cp hC (1 + (i + 1)) -
      _ * sandwich ops C cp hC (1 + i)
    rw [show 1 + (i + 2) = i + 1 + 2 by omega, show 1 + (i + 1) = i + 1 + 1 by omega,
      show 1 + i = i + 1 by omega]
    exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E11.chernOfCover_sum
statement:
theorem chernOfCover_sum (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1)
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = 1 + 1) (n : ℕ) :
    chernOfCover ops C cp hC n =
      if n = 0 then 1 else if n = 1 then totalCap ops L hL + totalCap ops M hM
        else if n = 2 then totalCap ops L hL * totalCap ops M hM else 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, hrec⟩ := segre_rec ops cp C hL hM hC
  have hs := inv_segre_series (totalCap ops L hL) (totalCap ops M hM) (segre ops C cp hC)
    h0 h1 hrec
  unfold chernOfCover
  unfold segreSeries
  rw [hs, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
  rcases n with _ | _ | _ | n
  · simp
  · have h := neg_one_smul ℚ (-(totalCap ops L hL + totalCap ops M hM))
    exact h.trans (neg_neg (totalCap ops L hL + totalCap ops M hM))
  · simp
  · simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E11.whitneyConv_lines
statement:
theorem whitneyConv_lines (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1)
    (hLM : HasConstantRank X (L ⊞ M) 2) :
    M7.WhitneyConv (X := X) (geometricChernAssign ops cp) L (L ⊞ M) M
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ : ∃ C : AffineFrameCover X (L ⊞ M), ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = 1 + 1 :=
    ⟨_, (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hLM).choose_spec⟩
  rw [geometricChernAssign_constantRank ops cp (L ⊞ M) 2 hLM,
    show chernOp ops cp (L ⊞ M) 2 hLM = chernOfCover ops C cp hC from
      chernOp_eq_chernOfCover ops cp C (r := 1) hLM hC,
    chernOfCover_sum ops cp C hL hM hC n,
    geometricChernAssign_line ops cp L hL, geometricChernAssign_line ops cp M hM]
  exact conv_lines _ _ n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E31.exists_pairCover_card_framed
statement:
theorem exists_pairCover_card_framed [Epi b] {r s : ℕ} (hB : HasConstantRank X B r)
    (hD : HasConstantRank X D s) {L : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) :
    ∃ P : PairCover b, (∀ i, Nat.card (P.basisB i) = r) ∧ (∀ i, Nat.card (P.basisD i) = s) ∧
      ∀ i, Nonempty (E20.FrameData L (P.U i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨CB, hCB⟩ := exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hB
  obtain ⟨CD, hCD⟩ := exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hD
  obtain ⟨CL, hCL⟩ := exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hL
  have key : ∀ x : X, ∃ (iB : CB.I) (iD : CD.I) (iL : CL.I) (W : X.Opens), x ∈ W ∧
      IsAffineOpen W ∧ ∃ (hWB : W ≤ CB.U iB) (hWD : W ≤ CD.U iD) (_ : W ≤ CL.U iL),
        Function.Surjective (secMap b W) := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨iB, hiB⟩ := exists_mem_of_cover CB.covers x
    obtain ⟨iD, hiD⟩ := exists_mem_of_cover CD.covers x
    obtain ⟨iL, hiL⟩ := exists_mem_of_cover CL.covers x
    haveI : Fintype (CD.basisIndex iD) := @Fintype.ofFinite _ (CD.basisIndex_finite iD)
    have hambD : CB.U iB ⊓ CD.U iD ⊓ CL.U iL ≤ CD.U iD := inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right
    obtain ⟨V, hVU, hxV, t, ht⟩ := Scheme.Modules.exists_open_lifts_of_finite_elements X b
      (CD.basisIndex iD) (CB.U iB ⊓ CD.U iD ⊓ CL.U iL)
      (fun k => D.val.map (homOfLE hambD).op (CD.sectionBasis iD k)) x ⟨⟨hiB, hiD⟩, hiL⟩
    obtain ⟨W, hW, hxW, hWV⟩ := (Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens) hxV
    have hWB : W ≤ CB.U iB := hWV.trans (hVU.trans (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left))
    have hWD : W ≤ CD.U iD := hWV.trans (hVU.trans hambD)
    have hWL : W ≤ CL.U iL := hWV.trans (hVU.trans inf_le_right)
    refine ⟨iB, iD, iL, W, hxW, hW, hWB, hWD, hWL, ?_⟩
    have hle : Submodule.span Γ(X, W) (Set.range (CD.restrictedSectionBasis iD W hWD)) ≤
        LinearMap.range (secMap b W) := by
      rw [Submodule.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨B.val.map (homOfLE hWV).op (t k), ?_⟩
      have h1 := secMap_restrict b hWV (t k)
      have h2 : secMap b V (t k) = b.val.app (op V) (t k) := rfl
      have h3 := ht k
      change secMap b W (B.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE hWV).op (t k)) = _
      rw [h1, h2, h3]
      rw [← CD.restrictedSectionBasis_eq_restrict iD W hWD k]
      change D.val.map (homOfLE hWV).op (D.val.map (homOfLE hVU).op
        (D.val.map (homOfLE hambD).op
          (CD.sectionBasis iD k))) =
        D.val.map (homOfLE hWD).op (CD.sectionBasis iD k)
      rw [← PresheafOfModules.map_comp_apply, ← PresheafOfModules.map_comp_apply]
      rfl
    intro d
    have hd : d ∈ Submodule.span Γ(X, W) (Set.range (CD.restrictedSectionBasis iD W hWD)) := by
      rw [(CD.restrictedSectionBasis iD W hWD).span_eq]; trivial
    exact LinearMap.mem_range.mp (hle hd)
  choose iB iD iL W hxW hWaff hex using key
  choose hWB hWD hWL hsurj using hex
  have hcov : (⨆ x, W x : X.Opens) = ⊤ :=
    eq_top_iff.mpr fun x _ => Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨x, hxW x⟩
  refine ⟨{
    I := X
    U := W
    covers := hcov
    isAffine := hWaff
    basisB := fun x => CB.basisIndex (iB x)
    basisD := fun x => CD.basisIndex (iD x)
    finB := fun x => CB.basisIndex_finite (iB x)
    finD := fun x => CD.basisIndex_finite (iD x)
    frameB := fun x => CB.restrictedFrame (iB x) (W x) (hWB x)
    frameD := fun x => CD.restrictedFrame (iD x) (W x) (hWD x)
    surj := hsurj }, fun x => hCB (iB x), fun x => hCD (iD x), fun x => ?_⟩
  have hc : Nat.card (CL.basisIndex (iL x)) = 1 := hCL (iL x)
  obtain ⟨hsub, hne⟩ := Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.mp hc
  letI : Unique (CL.basisIndex (iL x)) := @Unique.mk' _ ⟨hne.some⟩ hsub
  exact ⟨⟨((SheafOfModules.freeFunctor (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over (W x))).mapIso
      (Equiv.toIso (Equiv.equivPUnit (CL.basisIndex (iL x))).symm)) ≪≫
    CL.restrictedFrame (iL x) (W x) (hWL x)⟩⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E31.mul_eq_zero_of_mem_evalIdeal
statement:
theorem mul_eq_zero_of_mem_evalIdeal {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (m : M) (r : R) (h : r • m = 0) {z : R} (hz : z ∈ sectionEvaluationIdeal m) :
    r * z = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, rfl⟩ := hz
  change r * φ m = 0
  rw [← smul_eq_mul, ← φ.map_smul, h, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E31.sigma_regular_E31
statement:
theorem sigma_regular_E31 {a : L ⟶ B} (w : a ≫ b = 0)
    (hS : (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (T : tensorSheaf P.toB.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P.toB.toBase).obj L)
      (lineBundleDual P.toB.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P.toB.toBase).obj L)) ≅
        tensorUnitSheaf P.toB.scheme)
    (hT : T.hom = ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction P.toB.scheme).homEquiv _ _).symm
      (evPre ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P.toB.toBase).obj L)))
    (F : ∀ i, E20.FrameData L (P.U i)) :
    SectionIsRegular (E20.sigmaOf T (E20.s0 P a))
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsFiniteLocallyFree P.toB.scheme (E16.twistedLine P.toB L) :=
    (E16.hasConstantRank_twistedLine P.toB hL).isFiniteLocallyFree
  let σ : tensorUnitSheaf P.toB.scheme ⟶ E16.twistedLine P.toB L := E20.sigmaOf T (E20.s0 P a)
  intro U r hr
  have key : ∀ y : P.toB.scheme, y ∈ U.1 → ∃ D : P.toB.scheme.Opens, y ∈ D ∧
      ∃ hDU : D ≤ U.1, P.toB.scheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hDU).op r = 0 := by
    intro y hyU
    have hy : y ∈ (⨆ ik : (Σ i : P.I, P.basisB i),
        (E20.chartImage P ik.1 ((P.toB.sectionBasis ik.1) ik.2)).1 : P.toB.scheme.Opens) := by
      rw [E20.chartImage_cover P]; trivial
    obtain ⟨ik, hyV⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hy
    let Vv := E20.chartImage P ik.1 ((P.toB.sectionBasis ik.1) ik.2)
    obtain ⟨c, hcreg, hcspan⟩ := E20.chart_ideal_span P w hS T hT F ik.1 ik.2
    obtain ⟨f, hfU, hyf⟩ := Vv.2.exists_basicOpen_le (V := U.1) ⟨y, hyU⟩ hyV
    have hfV : P.toB.scheme.basicOpen f ≤ Vv.1 := P.toB.scheme.basicOpen_le f
    refine ⟨P.toB.scheme.basicOpen f, hyf, hfU, ?_⟩
    
    let R := Γ(P.toB.scheme, Vv.1)
    let A := Γ(P.toB.scheme, P.toB.scheme.basicOpen f)
    let φ : R →+* A := (P.toB.scheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hfV).op).hom
    letI : Algebra R A := φ.toAlgebra
    letI : IsLocalization.Away f A := Vv.2.isLocalization_basicOpen f
    have hcA : IsRegular (algebraMap R A c) :=
      E20.isRegular_algebraMap_of_isLocalization (Submonoid.powers f) hcreg
    
    have hloc := sectionAffineEvaluationIdeal_basicOpen (L := E16.twistedLine P.toB L) σ Vv f
    erw [hcspan] at hloc
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton] at hloc
    have hmem' : algebraMap R A c ∈
        sectionAffineEvaluationIdeal σ (P.toB.scheme.affineBasicOpen f) := by
      rw [← hloc]; exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
    have hmem : algebraMap R A c ∈ sectionEvaluationIdeal (R := A)
        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ (P.toB.scheme.basicOpen f)
          (1 : Γ(P.toB.scheme, P.toB.scheme.basicOpen f))) := hmem'
    
    have hsec := section_app_one_restrict (L := E16.twistedLine P.toB L) σ hfU
    have hkill : (P.toB.scheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hfU).op r) •
        Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ (P.toB.scheme.basicOpen f)
          (1 : Γ(P.toB.scheme, P.toB.scheme.basicOpen f)) = 0 := by
      have hr' : r • Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ U (1 : Γ(P.toB.scheme, U)) = 0 := hr
      rw [← hsec, ← Scheme.Modules.map_smul, hr', map_zero]
    have hz := mul_eq_zero_of_mem_evalIdeal _ _ hkill hmem
    exact hcA.right (by simpa using hz)
  choose D hyD hDU hD0 using fun y : U.1 => key y.1 y.2
  let S : TopCat.Sheaf Ab P.toB.scheme :=
    ⟨(unitMod P.toB.scheme).presheaf, (unitMod P.toB.scheme).isSheaf⟩
  refine S.eq_of_locally_eq' D U.1 (fun y => homOfLE (hDU y)) ?_ r 0 ?_
  · intro y hy
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hyD ⟨y, hy⟩⟩
  · intro y
    refine (hD0 y).trans ?_
    exact (map_zero (S.1.map (homOfLE (hDU y)).op).hom).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E25.regularTransition_eq_sectionCoord
statement:
theorem regularTransition_eq_sectionCoord {b₀ y : S} (bf : LineBundleLocalData S M b₀)
    (e : LineBundleLocalData S M y) (s : Γ(M, ⊤)) (hb : D10.sectionCoord bf s = 1) :
    bf.regularTransitionFunction e = D10.sectionCoord e s
proof:
:= by
  have h := D10.sectionCoord_compat bf e s
  rw [hb, one_mul] at h
  exact h.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E25.coeff_eq_ord_sectionCoord
statement:
theorem coeff_eq_ord_sectionCoord (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree S M)
    (hrank : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank S M = 1)
    {b₀ y : S} (bf : LineBundleLocalData S M b₀) (s : Γ(M, ⊤))
    (hb : D10.sectionCoord bf s = 1) (d : LineBundleLocalData S M y) (p : S) (hp : p ∈ d.U) :
    lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame hM hrank bf p = S.ord (D10.sectionCoord d s) p
proof:
:= by
  rw [lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame_eq_on_localData hM hrank bf d p hp,
    regularTransition_eq_sectionCoord bf d s hb]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E25.sectionCoord_eq_algebraMap_germ
statement:
theorem sectionCoord_eq_algebraMap_germ {y : S} (d : LineBundleLocalData S M y) (s : Γ(M, ⊤))
    (p : S) (hp : p ∈ d.U) :
    D10.sectionCoord d s =
      algebraMap (S.presheaf.stalk p) S.functionField
        (S.presheaf.germ d.U p hp (D10.sectionCoordSec d s))
proof:
:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E25.coeff_eq_one_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem coeff_eq_one_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree S M)
    (hrank : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank S M = 1)
    {b₀ y : S} (bf : LineBundleLocalData S M b₀) (s : Γ(M, ⊤))
    (hb : D10.sectionCoord bf s = 1) (d : LineBundleLocalData S M y) (p : S) (hp : p ∈ d.U)
    (hcoh : coheight p = 1)
    (hne : S.presheaf.germ d.U p hp (D10.sectionCoordSec d s) ≠ 0)
    (hmax : Ideal.span {S.presheaf.germ d.U p hp (D10.sectionCoordSec d s)} =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (S.presheaf.stalk p)) :
    lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame hM hrank bf p = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_eq_ord_sectionCoord hM hrank bf s hb d p hp,
    sectionCoord_eq_algebraMap_germ d s p hp]
  exact Scheme.ord_algebraMap_eq_one_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal hcoh hne hmax

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E25.coeff_eq_zero_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem coeff_eq_zero_of_isUnit (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree S M)
    (hrank : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank S M = 1)
    {b₀ y : S} (bf : LineBundleLocalData S M b₀) (s : Γ(M, ⊤))
    (hb : D10.sectionCoord bf s = 1) (d : LineBundleLocalData S M y) (p : S) (hp : p ∈ d.U)
    (hcoh : coheight p = 1)
    (hu : IsUnit (S.presheaf.germ d.U p hp (D10.sectionCoordSec d s))) :
    lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame hM hrank bf p = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_eq_ord_sectionCoord hM hrank bf s hb d p hp,
    sectionCoord_eq_algebraMap_germ d s p hp]
  exact Scheme.ord_algebraMap_eq_zero_of_isUnit hcoh hu

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E25.coeff_eq_zero_of_coheight_ne
statement:
theorem coeff_eq_zero_of_coheight_ne (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree S M)
