    lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame hM hrank bf p = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame, Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hcoh]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E25.map_maximalIdeal_eq_of_flatPullbackCoeff_eq_one
statement:
theorem map_maximalIdeal_eq_of_flatPullbackCoeff_eq_one {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : X)
    (h : flatPullbackCoeff f x = 1) :
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x))).map (f.stalkMap x).hom =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)
proof:
:= by
  set I := (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x))).map (f.stalkMap x).hom with hI
  have hlen : Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x) (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ I) = 1 := by
    unfold flatPullbackCoeff at h
    rw [← hI] at h
    have hne : Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x) (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ I) ≠ ⊤ := by
      intro htop
      rw [htop, ENat.toNat_top] at h
      exact absurd h (by norm_num)
    have h2 := ENat.coe_toNat hne
    rw [h] at h2
    simpa using h2.symm
  have hsimple : IsSimpleModule (X.presheaf.stalk x) (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ I) :=
    Module.length_eq_one_iff.mp hlen
  have hmax : I.IsMaximal :=
    Ideal.isMaximal_def.mpr (isSimpleModule_iff_isCoatom.mp hsimple)
  exact IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hmax

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E25.maximalIdeal_eq_ker_sup_map
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_eq_ker_sup_map {A R S : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing S] (φ : R →+* S) [IsLocalHom φ]
    (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) (α : A →+* R) (β : A →+* S) (hcomm : β = φ.comp α)
    (m : Ideal A) (hm : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S = m.map β) :
    IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R = RingHom.ker φ ⊔ m.map α
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S).comap φ = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R :=
    IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal (Ideal.comap_isMaximal_of_surjective φ hφ
      (K := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal S))
  rw [← hc, hm, hcomm, ← Ideal.map_map, Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective φ hφ,
    ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, sup_comm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E25.maximalIdeal_quotient_eq_span
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_quotient_eq_span {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] (g : R)
    (J 𝔭 : Ideal R) [𝔭.IsPrime] [IsLocalRing (R ⧸ 𝔭)] (hJ : J ≤ 𝔭)
    (hm : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span {g} ⊔ J) :
    Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝔭 g} = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (R ⧸ 𝔭)
proof:
:= by
  have hmq : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (R ⧸ 𝔭) = (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).map
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝔭) := by
    have hc : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (R ⧸ 𝔭)).comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝔭) =
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R :=
      IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal (Ideal.comap_isMaximal_of_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝔭)
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (K := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (R ⧸ 𝔭)))
    conv_lhs => rw [← Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (R ⧸ 𝔭)), hc]
  rw [hmq, hm, Ideal.map_sup, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
  have : J.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝔭) = ⊥ :=
    (Ideal.map_eq_bot_iff_le_ker _).mpr (by rwa [Ideal.mk_ker])
  rw [this, sup_bot_eq]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E25.stalk_maximalIdeal_eq_ker_sup
statement:
theorem stalk_maximalIdeal_eq_ker_sup {W V X : Scheme.{u}} (πB : W ⟶ X) (j : V ⟶ W)
    [IsClosedImmersion j] (q : V) (hq : flatPullbackCoeff (j ≫ πB) q = 1) :
    IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (W.presheaf.stalk (j q)) =
      RingHom.ker (j.stalkMap q).hom ⊔
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk (πB (j q)))).map (πB.stalkMap (j q)).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hm := map_maximalIdeal_eq_of_flatPullbackCoeff_eq_one (j ≫ πB) q hq
  refine maximalIdeal_eq_ker_sup_map (j.stalkMap q).hom (j.stalkMap_surjective q)
    (πB.stalkMap (j q)).hom ((j ≫ πB).stalkMap q).hom ?_
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk (πB (j q)))) hm.symm
  rw [Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp]
  rfl

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.subschemeToDeformation_toIntegerLine
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem subschemeToDeformation_toIntegerLine :
    subschemeToDeformation Y J ≫ deformationToIntegerLine Y J = polynomialToIntegerLine Y J
proof:
:= by
  apply RelativeSpec.hom_ext
  intro U
  unfold subschemeToDeformation
  rw [← Category.assoc, RelativeSpec.Hom.affineι_map, Category.assoc,
    show RelativeSpec.affineι Y (DeformationSpace.algebraData Y J) U ≫ deformationToIntegerLine Y J =
      deformationToIntegerLineU Y J U from deformationAffineι_toIntegerLine Y J U,
    affineι_polynomialToIntegerLine]
  unfold deformationToIntegerLineU polynomialChartToIntegerLine
  unfold AffineDeformationSpace.toLine
  rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  refine CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext fun p => ?_)
  have h := RingHom.congr_fun (subschemeHom_comp_structureMap Γ(Y, U.1) (J.ideal U))
    (p.map (integerMap Γ(Y, U.1)))
  have h2 : (Polynomial.mapRingHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U))) (p.map (integerMap Γ(Y, U.1))) =
      p.map (integerMap (Γ(Y, U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)) := by
    rw [Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_map, integerMap_comp]
  exact h.trans h2

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.subschemeToLine_toIntegerLine
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem subschemeToLine_toIntegerLine :
    subschemeToLineGlobal Y J ≫ deformationToIntegerLine Y ⊥ = polynomialToIntegerLine Y J
proof:
:= by
  apply RelativeSpec.hom_ext
  intro U
  unfold subschemeToLineGlobal
  rw [← Category.assoc, RelativeSpec.Hom.affineι_map, Category.assoc,
    show RelativeSpec.affineι Y (DeformationSpace.algebraData Y ⊥) U ≫
        deformationToIntegerLine Y ⊥ = deformationToIntegerLineU Y ⊥ U from
      deformationAffineι_toIntegerLine Y ⊥ U,
    affineι_polynomialToIntegerLine]
  unfold deformationToIntegerLineU polynomialChartToIntegerLine
  unfold AffineDeformationSpace.toLine
  rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  refine CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext fun p => ?_)
  have h := RingHom.congr_fun (toLineHom_comp_structureMap Y J U) (p.map (integerMap Γ(Y, U.1)))
  have h2 : (Polynomial.mapRingHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U))) (p.map (integerMap Γ(Y, U.1))) =
      p.map (integerMap (Γ(Y, U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)) := by
    rw [Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_map, integerMap_comp]
  exact h.trans h2

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.subschemeTotalGlobalι_totalToIntegerP1
statement:
theorem subschemeTotalGlobalι_totalToIntegerP1 :
    subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J ≫ InfinityGlobal.totalToIntegerP1 Y J =
      SubschemeProductGlobal.totalToIntegerP1 Y J
proof:
:= by
  apply pushout.hom_ext
  · change (subschemeUιGlobal Y J ≫ subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) ≫ InfinityGlobal.totalToIntegerP1 Y J =
      subschemeUιGlobal Y J ≫ SubschemeProductGlobal.totalToIntegerP1 Y J
    rw [subschemeUιGlobal_totalGlobalι, Category.assoc,
      InfinityGlobal.blowupGlobalι_totalToIntegerP1, subschemeUι_totalToIntegerP1]
    unfold subschemeToBlowupGlobal
    rw [Category.assoc, uChartGlobal_toIntegerLine_assoc, subschemeToDeformation_toIntegerLine_assoc]
  · change (subschemeTιGlobal Y J ≫ subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) ≫ InfinityGlobal.totalToIntegerP1 Y J =
      subschemeTιGlobal Y J ≫ SubschemeProductGlobal.totalToIntegerP1 Y J
    rw [subschemeTιGlobal_totalGlobalι, Category.assoc,
      InfinityGlobal.lineTι_totalToIntegerP1, subschemeTι_totalToIntegerP1,
      subschemeToLine_toIntegerLine_assoc]

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.isIso_fst_comp_totalToClosedBase
statement:
theorem isIso_fst_comp_totalToClosedBase :
    IsIso (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToTotal Y J) ≫
      totalToClosedBase Y J)
proof:
:= by
  have SqW := isPullback_totalIntegerP1 Y J
  have SqInf := infinity_isPullback Y J
  have SqComp := InfinityExceptionalGlobal.component_isPullback Y J
  have hcompat := subschemeTotalGlobalι_totalToIntegerP1 Y J
  have hpr_i := totalToClosedBase_subschemeι Y J
  let sInf : J.subscheme ⟶ subschemeTotalGlobal Y J :=
    SqW.lift (𝟙 _) (closedBaseToInteger Y J ≫ infinityPoint) (by
      rw [Category.assoc, infinityPoint_toSpec, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp])
  have hs1 : sInf ≫ totalToClosedBase Y J = 𝟙 _ := SqW.lift_fst _ _ _
  have hs2 : sInf ≫ SubschemeProductGlobal.totalToIntegerP1 Y J =
      closedBaseToInteger Y J ≫ infinityPoint := SqW.lift_snd _ _ _
  let g : J.subscheme ⟶ infinityFibre Y J :=
    SqInf.lift (sInf ≫ subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (closedBaseToInteger Y J) (by
      rw [Category.assoc, hcompat, hs2])
  have hg1 : g ≫ infinityFibreι Y J = sInf ≫ subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J := SqInf.lift_fst _ _ _
  have hg2 : g ≫ infinityToInteger Y J = closedBaseToInteger Y J := SqInf.lift_snd _ _ _
  let sE : J.subscheme ⟶ InfinityExceptionalGlobal.component Y J :=
    SqComp.lift g (𝟙 _) (by
      unfold InfinityExceptionalGlobal.infinityToBase
      rw [← Category.assoc, hg1, Category.assoc, ← hpr_i, ← Category.assoc, hs1])
  have hsE1 : sE ≫ InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentι Y J = g := SqComp.lift_fst _ _ _
  have hsE2 : sE ≫ InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToCentre Y J = 𝟙 _ := SqComp.lift_snd _ _ _
  have hsE : sE ≫ InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToTotal Y J = sInf ≫ subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J := by
    unfold InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToTotal
    rw [← Category.assoc, hsE1, hg1]
  let Φ : J.subscheme ⟶ pullback (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)
      (InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToTotal Y J) :=
    pullback.lift sInf sE hsE.symm
  have hΦ1 : Φ ≫ pullback.fst _ _ = sInf := pullback.lift_fst _ _ _
  have hΦ2 : Φ ≫ pullback.snd _ _ = sE := pullback.lift_snd _ _ _
  have hterm : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (a b : T ⟶ Spec (.of integerRing)), a = b :=
    fun a b => specULiftZIsTerminal.hom_ext _ _
  have hε : InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToTotal Y J ≫ InfinityGlobal.totalToIntegerP1 Y J =
      InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentι Y J ≫ infinityToInteger Y J ≫ infinityPoint := by
    unfold InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToTotal
    rw [Category.assoc, SqInf.w]
  have hp : pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)
        (InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToTotal Y J) =
      (pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToTotal Y J) ≫
        totalToClosedBase Y J) ≫ sInf := by
    apply SqW.hom_ext
    · rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, hs1, Category.comp_id]
    · rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, hs2, ← hcompat, ← Category.assoc, pullback.condition,
        Category.assoc, hε]
      have key : pullback.snd (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)
            (InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToTotal Y J) ≫
          InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentι Y J ≫ infinityToInteger Y J =
          pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)
            (InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToTotal Y J) ≫
          totalToClosedBase Y J ≫ closedBaseToInteger Y J := hterm _ _
      have := congrArg (fun f => f ≫ infinityPoint) key
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using this
  set p := pullback.fst (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToTotal Y J)
    with hpdef
  set q := pullback.snd (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) (InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToTotal Y J)
    with hqdef
  have hεcomp : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (a : T ⟶ InfinityExceptionalGlobal.component Y J),
      a ≫ InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToTotal Y J =
        (a ≫ InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentι Y J) ≫ infinityFibreι Y J :=
    fun a => (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
  have hεbase : InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToTotal Y J ≫ totalGlobalToBase Y J =
      InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentι Y J ≫ InfinityExceptionalGlobal.infinityToBase Y J :=
    Category.assoc _ _ _
  have hcond : p ≫ subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J =
      q ≫ InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToTotal Y J := pullback.condition
  have hq : (p ≫ totalToClosedBase Y J) ≫ sE = q := by
    apply SqComp.hom_ext
    · apply SqInf.hom_ext
      · calc (((p ≫ totalToClosedBase Y J) ≫ sE) ≫ InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentι Y J) ≫
              infinityFibreι Y J
            = (p ≫ totalToClosedBase Y J) ≫ (sE ≫ InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToTotal Y J) := by
              rw [hεcomp sE]; simp only [Category.assoc]
          _ = (p ≫ totalToClosedBase Y J) ≫ (sInf ≫ subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) := by rw [hsE]
          _ = p ≫ subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J := by rw [← Category.assoc, ← hp]
          _ = q ≫ InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToTotal Y J := hcond
          _ = (q ≫ InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentι Y J) ≫ infinityFibreι Y J := hεcomp q
      · exact hterm _ _
    · haveI : Mono J.subschemeι := inferInstance
      rw [← cancel_mono J.subschemeι]
      calc ((p ≫ totalToClosedBase Y J) ≫ sE ≫ InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToCentre Y J) ≫
              J.subschemeι
            = (p ≫ totalToClosedBase Y J) ≫ J.subschemeι := by
              rw [hsE2]; simp only [Category.comp_id]
          _ = p ≫ subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J ≫ totalGlobalToBase Y J := by
              rw [Category.assoc, hpr_i]
          _ = (p ≫ subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J) ≫ totalGlobalToBase Y J := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
          _ = (q ≫ InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToTotal Y J) ≫ totalGlobalToBase Y J := by
              rw [hcond]
          _ = q ≫ InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentι Y J ≫
              InfinityExceptionalGlobal.infinityToBase Y J := by
              rw [Category.assoc, hεbase]
          _ = q ≫ InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToCentre Y J ≫ J.subschemeι := by
              rw [InfinityExceptionalGlobal.component_square]
          _ = (q ≫ InfinityExceptionalGlobal.componentToCentre Y J) ≫ J.subschemeι :=
              (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
  refine ⟨⟨Φ, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · apply pullback.hom_ext
    · rw [Category.assoc, hΦ1, Category.id_comp]
      exact hp.symm
    · rw [Category.assoc, hΦ2, Category.id_comp]
      exact hq
  · rw [← Category.assoc, hΦ1]
    exact hs1

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.isIso_fst_comp_of_ker_eq
statement:
theorem isIso_fst_comp_of_ker_eq {M W Z A B : Scheme.{u}} (F : W ⟶ M) (pr : W ⟶ Z)
    (ι : A ⟶ M) (ε : B ⟶ M) [IsClosedImmersion ι] [IsClosedImmersion ε]
    (hker : ι.ker = ε.ker) [IsIso (pullback.fst F ε ≫ pr)] :
    IsIso (pullback.fst F ι ≫ pr)
proof:
:= by
  let ψ : A ⟶ B := IsClosedImmersion.lift ε ι hker.symm.le
  have hψ : ψ ≫ ε = ι := IsClosedImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _
  haveI : IsIso ψ := IsClosedImmersion.isIso_of_ker_eq ι ε ψ hψ hker
  let k : pullback F ι ⟶ pullback F ε :=
    pullback.map F ι F ε (𝟙 W) ψ (𝟙 M) (by simp) (by rw [hψ]; simp)
  haveI : IsIso k := by
    dsimp only [k]
    infer_instance
  have hk : k ≫ pullback.fst F ε = pullback.fst F ι := by
    simp [k]
  rw [← hk, Category.assoc]
  infer_instance

name: SchemeKTheory.restrict_isFiniteLocallyFree_E5
statement:
theorem restrict_isFiniteLocallyFree_E5 {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    (F : Y.Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y F) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree Z ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj F)
proof:
:=
  isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso _ ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback f).app F).symm
    (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global f F hF)

name: SchemeKTheory.isFiniteLocallyFree_of_restrict_opens_E5
statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_of_restrict_opens_E5 (M : X.Modules)
    (H : ∀ x : X, ∃ V : X.Opens, x ∈ V ∧
      IsFiniteLocallyFree V ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj M)) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree X M
proof:
:= by
  have H' : ∀ x : X, ∃ (m : ℕ) (Z : Scheme.{u}) (ι : Z ⟶ X) (_ : IsOpenImmersion ι),
      x ∈ ι.opensRange ∧
        Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ι).obj M ≅
          ⨁ fun _ : Fin m => unitModule Z) := fun x ↦ by
    obtain ⟨V, hxV, hV⟩ := H x
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin⟩ := hV.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
    letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
    letI : q.IsFiniteType := hqfin
    have hcover : IsOpenCover q.X :=
      (Opens.coversTop_iff (V : Scheme) q.X).mp q.coversTop
    have hxUnion : (⟨x, hxV⟩ : (V : Scheme)) ∈ ⋃ i, (q.X i : Set (V : Scheme)) := by
      rw [hcover.iSup_set_eq_univ]
      exact Set.mem_univ _
    obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hxUnion
    let C := localGeneratorsOpenCover q
    letI : (q.generators i).IsFiniteType :=
      SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType i
    letI : Finite (q.generators i).I := by infer_instance
    refine ⟨Nat.card (q.generators i).I, C.X i, C.f i ≫ V.ι, inferInstance, ?_, ⟨?_⟩⟩
    · have : (⟨x, hxV⟩ : (V : Scheme)) ∈ (C.f i).opensRange := ⟨⟨_, hxi⟩, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := this
      exact ⟨z, by simp [hz]⟩
    · exact (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp (C.f i) V.ι).app M ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.f i)).mapIso (Iso.refl _) ≪≫
          localGeneratorsOpenCoverIso q i ≪≫
            freeIsoBiprod (C.X i) (q.generators i).I (Finite.equivFin _)
  choose m Z ι hι hx he using H'
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin, -⟩ := exists_localGeneratorsData_of_local M m
    (fun x ↦ ⟨Z x, ι x, hι x, hx x, he x⟩)
  exact ⟨⟨q, hq, hqfin⟩⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.isFiniteLocallyFree_cokernel_of_locallySplit_E5
statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_cokernel_of_locallySplit_E5
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules)
    (h₁ : IsFiniteLocallyFree X S.X₁) (h₂ : IsFiniteLocallyFree X S.X₂)
    (hsplit : ∀ x : X, ∃ V : X.Opens, x ∈ V ∧
      Nonempty (S.map (overRestrictionFunctor X V)).Splitting) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree X S.X₃
proof:
:= by
  apply isFiniteLocallyFree_of_restrict_opens_E5
  intro x
  obtain ⟨V, hxV, ⟨s⟩⟩ := hsplit x
  refine ⟨V, hxV, ?_⟩
  let sR := restrictSplittingOfOverSplitting_E5 S V s
  have hF := restrict_isFiniteLocallyFree_E5 V.ι S.X₁ h₁
  have hB := restrict_isFiniteLocallyFree_E5 V.ι S.X₂ h₂
  haveI hsE : IsSplitEpi sR.r := IsSplitEpi.mk' { section_ := _, id := sR.f_r }
  haveI hE : Epi sR.r := hsE.epi
  exact isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso _ (kernelRetractionIsoE5 _ sR).symm
    (@isFiniteLocallyFree_kernel V _ _ hB hF sR.r hE)

name: SchemeKTheory.convolution_step_E5
statement:
theorem convolution_step_E5 {R : Type*} [Semiring R] (cB cL cB' cA cA' cD : ℕ → R)
    (hB : ∀ n, cB n = ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, cL p.1 * cB' p.2)
    (hB' : ∀ n, cB' n = ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, cA' p.1 * cD p.2)
    (hA : ∀ n, cA n = ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, cL p.1 * cA' p.2) (n : ℕ) :
    cB n = ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, cA p.1 * cD p.2
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : PowerSeries.mk cB = PowerSeries.mk cL * PowerSeries.mk cB' := by
    ext m; simp [PowerSeries.coeff_mul, hB m]
  have e2 : PowerSeries.mk cB' = PowerSeries.mk cA' * PowerSeries.mk cD := by
    ext m; simp [PowerSeries.coeff_mul, hB' m]
  have e3 : PowerSeries.mk cA = PowerSeries.mk cL * PowerSeries.mk cA' := by
    ext m; simp [PowerSeries.coeff_mul, hA m]
  have e : PowerSeries.mk cB = PowerSeries.mk cA * PowerSeries.mk cD := by
    rw [e1, e2, e3, mul_assoc]
  have := congrArg (PowerSeries.coeff n) e
  simpa [PowerSeries.coeff_mul] using this

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.ShiftMap.component_add
statement:
theorem ShiftMap.component_add (hu : ShiftMap d u) (w : DirectSum ℕ M) (i : ℕ) :
    u (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M i (DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ M i w)) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M' (i + d) (DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ M' (i + d) (u w))
proof:
:= by
  induction w using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of m z =>
    rw [← DirectSum.lof_eq_of ℚ]
    obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := hu m z
    by_cases h : m = i
    · subst h
      rw [DirectSum.component.lof_self, hy', DirectSum.component.lof_self]
    · have h1 : DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ M i (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M m z) = 0 := by
        rw [DirectSum.lof_eq_of]
        exact DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne m i z (Ne.symm (Ne.symm h) |>.symm)
      have h2 : DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ M' (i + d) (u (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M m z)) = 0 := by
        rw [hy', DirectSum.lof_eq_of]
        exact DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne (m + d) (i + d) y' (by omega)
      rw [h1, h2]
      simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.ShiftMap.component_lt
statement:
theorem ShiftMap.component_lt (hu : ShiftMap d u) (w : DirectSum ℕ M) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < d) :
    DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ M' i (u w) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction w using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of m z =>
    rw [← DirectSum.lof_eq_of ℚ]
    obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := hu m z
    rw [hy', DirectSum.lof_eq_of]
    exact DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne (m + d) i y' (by omega)
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.ShiftMap.lowPart_comm
proof:
:= by
  induction v using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy =>
    have ha : ∀ (S : Alg.Op M) (z w : DirectSum ℕ M), lowPart j S (z + w) = lowPart j S z + lowPart j S w :=
      fun S z w => map_add _ _ _
    have hb : ∀ (S : Alg.Op M') (z w : DirectSum ℕ M'), lowPart j S (z + w) = lowPart j S z + lowPart j S w :=
      fun S z w => map_add _ _ _
    rw [ha, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, hb]
  | of n y =>
    rw [← DirectSum.lof_eq_of ℚ]
    obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := hu n y
    rw [hy', lowPart_lof, lowPart_lof, ← hy', ← hT]
    by_cases hjn : j ≤ n
    · rw [if_pos hjn, if_pos (by omega)]
      have hh : n + d - j = n - j + d := by omega
      rw [hh]
      exact hu.component_add (T (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M n y)) (n - j)
    · rw [if_neg hjn, map_zero]
      by_cases hjd : j ≤ n + d
      · rw [if_pos hjd, hu.component_lt _ (n + d - j) (by omega), map_zero]
      · rw [if_neg hjd]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.gsum_shift
statement:
theorem gsum_shift (hu : ShiftMap d u) (a : ℕ → Alg.Op M) (a' : ℕ → Alg.Op M')
    (ha : ∀ m, a m ∈ lowSub M m) (hint : ∀ m v, u (a m v) = a' m (u v)) (v : DirectSum ℕ M) :
    u (Alg.gsum a v) = Alg.gsum a' (u v)
proof:
:= by
  induction v using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  | of n y =>
    rw [← DirectSum.lof_eq_of ℚ]
    obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := hu n y
    rw [hy', Alg.gsum_lof, Alg.gsum_lof, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply, map_sum]
    have h1 : ∀ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), u (a m (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M n y)) =
        a' m (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M' (n + d) y') := fun m _ => by
      rw [hint, hy']
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h1]
    apply Finset.sum_subset
    · intro m hm
      simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hm ⊢
      omega
    · intro m _ hm
      have hm' : n < m := by simpa using hm
      rw [← hy', ← hint, low_lof_lt (ha m) hm' y, map_zero]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.totalPullOn_shiftMap
statement: theorem totalPullOn_shiftMap : ShiftMap d (totalPullOn (opsV4 k) g d hd)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.chBundle_pull_flat
statement:
theorem chBundle_pull_flat (E : W.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree W E) (v : TotalChow W) :
    totalPullOn (opsV4 k) g d hd (chBundle k (hPk k) E v) =
      chBundle k (hPk k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E) (totalPullOn (opsV4 k) g d hd v)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : _root_.Nonempty W := CHEXACT.nonempty_of_fact k (W := W)
  haveI : _root_.Nonempty W' := CHEXACT.nonempty_of_fact k (W := W')
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := CHEXACT.exists_rank k hE
  rw [chBundle_eq_chTot (hPk k) hE,
    chBundle_eq_chTot (hPk k) (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global g E hE)]
  have hW : WhitneyConstRankOn (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) (hPk k) := whitney_projectiveIntegral (hPk k)
  unfold chTot
  exact gsum_shift (totalPullOn_shiftMap g hd) _ _
    (fun m => lowSub_of_loweringSub
      (chOpOn_lowering (ops := opsV4 k) (cp := cpV4 k) (hP := hPk k) hW hr m))
    (fun m v => LinearMap.congr_fun
      (chOpOn_flat (ops := opsV4 k) (cp := cpV4 k) (hP := hPk k) g d hd E hr m) v) v

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.chK_pull_flat
statement:
theorem chK_pull_flat (w : K0 W) :
    totalPullOn (opsV4 k) g d hd ∘ₗ chK k W w =
      chK k W' (flatPullbackK0 g w) ∘ₗ totalPullOn (opsV4 k) g d hd
proof:
:= by
  let f : K0 W →+ (TotalChow W →ₗ[ℚ] TotalChow W') :=
    AddMonoidHom.mk' (fun w => totalPullOn (opsV4 k) g d hd ∘ₗ chK k W w) (fun a b => by
      rw [map_add, LinearMap.comp_add])
  let h : K0 W →+ (TotalChow W →ₗ[ℚ] TotalChow W') :=
    AddMonoidHom.mk' (fun w => chK k W' (flatPullbackK0 g w) ∘ₗ totalPullOn (opsV4 k) g d hd)
      (fun a b => by rw [map_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_comp])
  have hfh : f = h := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    intro x
    change totalPullOn (opsV4 k) g d hd ∘ₗ chK k W (k0ClassOf W x.1 x.2) =
      chK k W' (flatPullbackK0 g (k0ClassOf W x.1 x.2)) ∘ₗ totalPullOn (opsV4 k) g d hd
    rw [flatPullbackK0_classOf, chK_classOf, chK_classOf]
    exact LinearMap.ext fun v => chBundle_pull_flat g hd x.1 x.2 v
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hfh w

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.lowPart_pull_flat
statement:
theorem lowPart_pull_flat (w : K0 W) (j : ℕ) (v : TotalChow W) :
    totalPullOn (opsV4 k) g d hd (lowPart (M := fun n => RationalDimChow W n) j (chK k W w) v) =
      lowPart (M := fun n => RationalDimChow W' n) j (chK k W' (flatPullbackK0 g w))
        (totalPullOn (opsV4 k) g d hd v)
proof:
:=
  (totalPullOn_shiftMap g hd).lowPart_comm
    (fun v => LinearMap.congr_fun (chK_pull_flat g hd w) v) j v

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.isLocalLineFrame_of_hasConstantRank
statement:
theorem isLocalLineFrame_of_hasConstantRank {X : Scheme.{u}} {L : X.Modules}
    (h : HasConstantRank X L 1) : IsLocalLineFrame L
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, -, hcard⟩ := h
  letI := hq
  intro x
  have hcover : IsOpenCover q.X := (Opens.coversTop_iff X q.X).mp q.coversTop
  have hxUnion : x ∈ ⋃ i, (q.X i : Set X) := by
    rw [hcover.iSup_set_eq_univ]; exact Set.mem_univ x
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hxUnion
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := hxUnion
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hxW, hWle⟩ := (Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens) hxi
  exact ⟨⟨W, hW⟩, hxW, ⟨restrictOverIsoLE hWle (lineFrameOfRankOne q i (hcard i))⟩⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.section_app_one_restrict
statement:
theorem section_app_one_restrict {X : Scheme.{u}} {L : X.Modules}
    (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) {U W : X.Opens} (hWU : W ≤ U) :
    L.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWU).op (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ U (1 : Γ(X,U))) =
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ W (1 : Γ(X,W))
proof:
:= by
  have h := σ.mapPresheaf.naturality (homOfLE hWU).op
  have h1 := congrArg (fun f => (ConcreteCategory.hom f) (1 : Γ(X,U))) h
  simp only [CategoryTheory.comp_apply, Scheme.Modules.mapPresheaf_app] at h1
  refine h1.symm.trans ?_
  exact congrArg (fun y => ConcreteCategory.hom (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ W) y)
    (map_one (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWU).op).hom)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.sectionIsRegular_of_integral
statement:
theorem sectionIsRegular_of_integral {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] {L : X.Modules}
    (hline : IsLocalLineFrame L) (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L)
    (hnz : ∀ U : X.affineOpens, Nonempty U.1 →
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ U (1 : Γ(X,U)) ≠ 0) :
    SectionIsRegular σ
proof:
:= by
  intro U r hr
  by_contra hr0
  have hne : (U.1 : Set X).Nonempty := by
    by_contra h
    rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at h
    have hU : U.1 = ⊥ := by ext x; simp [h]
    have : Subsingleton Γ(X, U.1) := by rw [hU]; infer_instance
    exact hr0 (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  obtain ⟨x, hxU⟩ := hne
  obtain ⟨V, hxV, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hline x
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hxW, hWle⟩ :=
    (Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens) (show x ∈ V.1 ⊓ U.1 from ⟨hxV, hxU⟩)
  have hWV : W ≤ V.1 := hWle.trans inf_le_left
  have hWU : W ≤ U.1 := hWle.trans inf_le_right
  let eW := restrictOverIsoLE hWV e
  let eL := overFrameLinearEquiv W eW
  haveI : Nonempty W := ⟨⟨x, hxW⟩⟩
  have hm := hnz ⟨W, hW⟩ ⟨⟨x, hxW⟩⟩
  have hrW : X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWU).op r = 0 := by
    have h1 : X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWU).op r •
        Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ W (1 : Γ(X,W)) = 0 := by
      rw [← section_app_one_restrict σ hWU, ← Scheme.Modules.map_smul, hr, map_zero]
    have h2 : X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWU).op r *
        eL (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ W (1 : Γ(X,W))) = 0 := by
      have h3 := congrArg eL h1
      erw [eL.map_smul, map_zero] at h3
      exact h3
    have hc : eL (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ W (1 : Γ(X,W))) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      exact hm (eL.injective (h0.trans (map_zero eL).symm))
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h2).resolve_right hc
  apply hr0
  apply germ_injective_of_isIntegral X x hxU
  have hg := X.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE hWU) x hxW r
  rw [map_zero, ← hg, hrW, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_originalCoordinateCartierRecovery_of_integral_ideal

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.eulerStep_d_one_fst

      biprod.fst ≫ (D.K (d + 1)).d 1 0 + biprod.snd ≫ (D.ψ m d).f 0

name: SchemeKTheory.adams_push_zeroSection_projBundle_zeroSection
statement:
theorem adams_push_zeroSection_projBundle_zeroSection {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) {Z : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian Z] {Nsh : Z.Modules} {d : ℕ}
    (hE : HasConstantRank Z (Nsh ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf Z) (d + 1))
    (C : AffineFrameCover Z (Nsh ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf Z))
    (hrankZ : ConstantRankGenerators Z) (hnilZ : LambdaNilpotent Z)
    (hrankP : ConstantRankGenerators C.scheme) (hnilP : LambdaNilpotent C.scheme) (N : K0 Z)
    (hEN : k0ClassOf Z (Nsh ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf Z) hE.isFiniteLocallyFree = N + 1)
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.pullback C.zeroSection).obj (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) ≅
      tensorUnitSheaf Z)
    (push : K0 Z →+ K0 C.scheme) (pushLoc : KLoc j Z →+ KLoc j C.scheme)
    (hpushLoc : ∀ x, pushLoc (algebraMap _ _ x) = algebraMap _ _ (push x))
    (proj : ∀ y x, pushLoc (locMap (pullbackK0RingHom C.zeroSection) y * x) = y * pushLoc x)
    (koszul : push 1 =
      lambdaMinusOne C.tautologicalKernel (C.hasConstantRank_tautologicalKernel hE))
    (x : K0 Z) :
    haveI
proof:
:= C.isNoetherian_scheme
    algebraMap (K0 C.scheme) (KLoc j C.scheme) (adamsRingHom hrankP j (push x)) =
      pushLoc (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom hrankZ j x) *
        ((bott j Z hrankZ hnilZ (Multiplicative.ofAdd N) : (KLoc j Z)ˣ) : KLoc j Z)) :=
  adams_push_zeroSection_projBundle hj hE C hrankZ hnilZ hrankP hnilP C.zeroSection
    C.zeroSection_toBase N hEN e push pushLoc hpushLoc proj koszul x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1.totalCapOn_pow_lof_eq_zero
statement:
theorem totalCapOn_pow_lof_eq_zero (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) :
    ∀ (j i : ℕ) (z : RationalDimChow X i), i < j →
      ((totalCapOn ops L hL) ^ j) (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) i z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero => intro i z hi; omega
  | succ j ih =>
    intro i z hi
    rw [pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply]
    cases i with
    | zero =>
      rw [totalCapOn_lof_zero_of_eq ops L hL rfl z, map_zero]
    | succ i' =>
      rw [totalCapOn_lof_succ_of_eq ops L hL rfl z z HEq.rfl]
      exact ih i' _ (by omega)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1.frameCover_push_xi_pow
proof:

statement:
theorem caseI_deg_pow (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≤ n) :
    haveI
proof:

    degTotalSpk k (totalPushOn (chowOpsOn_projectiveIntegral k) (caseICover k n).toBase
      (((caseIH k n) ^ p) (caseIFundClass k n))) = if p = n then 1 else 0 := by
  have h := frameCover_push_xi_pow (chowOpsOn_projectiveIntegral k) (caseICover k n)
    (chowCompatOn_projectiveIntegral k) (caseICover_card k n) ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] ptClass k) p hp
  have h2 := congrArg (degTotalSpk k) h
  refine h2.trans ?_
  by_cases hpn : p = n
  · rw [if_pos hpn, if_pos hpn, degTotalSpk_lof_zero, evalQ_ptClass]
  · rw [if_neg hpn, if_neg hpn, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1.caseI_spk_chi

    caseIRHS k n (m : ℤ) = (((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n (m : ℤ)).eulerChar k : ℤ) : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [caseI_spk, eulerChar_projectiveTwistingSheaf_nat]
  have : (((m : ℤ) : ℚ) + (n : ℚ)) = ((m + n : ℕ) : ℚ) := by push_cast; ring
  rw [this, Ring.choose_natCast]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1.caseI_spk_chi_neg
statement:
theorem caseI_spk_chi_neg (hn : 0 < n) (m : ℤ) (hm : -(n : ℤ) ≤ m) (hm0 : m < 0) :
    caseIRHS k n m = (((projectiveTwistingSheaf k n m).eulerChar k : ℤ) : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [caseI_spk, eulerChar_projectiveTwistingSheaf_of_neg k n hn m hm hm0]
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j : ℕ, m + n = j := ⟨(m + n).toNat, by omega⟩
  have hjn : j < n := by omega
  have : ((m : ℚ) + (n : ℚ)) = ((j : ℕ) : ℚ) := by
    have : ((m + n : ℤ) : ℚ) = ((j : ℤ) : ℚ) := by rw [hj]
    push_cast at this
    exact this
  rw [this, Ring.choose_natCast, Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt hjn]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1.caseI_spk_one
statement: theorem caseI_spk_one (m : ℤ) : caseIRHS k 1 m = (m : ℚ) + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [caseI_spk, Ring.choose_one_right]; simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1.caseI_spk_two
statement: theorem caseI_spk_two (m : ℤ) : caseIRHS k 2 m = ((m : ℚ) + 1) * ((m : ℚ) + 2) / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [caseI_spk, ringChoose_two]; push_cast; ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1.caseI_spk_two_chi
statement:
theorem caseI_spk_two_chi (d : ℤ) (hd : -2 ≤ d) :
    2 * caseIRHS k 2 d = 2 * (((projectiveTwistingSheaf k 2 d).eulerChar k : ℤ) : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := eulerChar_projectivePlane_twist k d hd
  have h' : (2 : ℚ) * (((projectiveTwistingSheaf k 2 d).eulerChar k : ℤ) : ℚ) =
      ((d : ℚ) + 1) * ((d : ℚ) + 2) := by exact_mod_cast h
  rw [h', caseI_spk_two]; ring

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.mem_grading_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_grading_iff (I : Ideal R) (n : ℕ) (x : reesAlgebra I) :
    x ∈ grading I n ↔
      Polynomial.toFinsuppIsoLinear R (x : R[X]) ∈ AddMonoidAlgebra.grade R n
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.componentInclusion_injective
statement:
theorem componentInclusion_injective (I : Ideal R) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (componentInclusion I n)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply (Polynomial.toFinsuppIsoLinear R).injective
  exact congrArg Subtype.val h

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.toPolynomialDirectSum_injective
statement:
theorem toPolynomialDirectSum_injective (I : Ideal R) :
    Function.Injective (toPolynomialDirectSum I)
proof:
:=
  (DirectSum.lmap_injective (componentInclusion I)).mpr
    (componentInclusion_injective I)

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.coeLinearMap_comp_toPolynomialDirectSum
statement:
theorem coeLinearMap_comp_toPolynomialDirectSum (I : Ideal R) :
    DirectSum.coeLinearMap (AddMonoidAlgebra.grade R) ∘ₗ toPolynomialDirectSum I =
      toFinsuppLinear I ∘ₗ DirectSum.coeLinearMap (grading I)
proof:
:= by
  ext n x
  simp [toPolynomialDirectSum, componentInclusion, toFinsuppLinear,
    DirectSum.lmap_lof]

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.isInternal
statement: theorem isInternal (I : Ideal R) : DirectSum.IsInternal (grading I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [DirectSum.IsInternal]
  constructor
  · intro x y hxy
    apply toPolynomialDirectSum_injective I
    apply (AddMonoidAlgebra.grade.isInternal (R := R)).injective
    change DirectSum.coeLinearMap (AddMonoidAlgebra.grade R)
        (toPolynomialDirectSum I x) =
      DirectSum.coeLinearMap (AddMonoidAlgebra.grade R) (toPolynomialDirectSum I y)
    have hval := congrArg (Polynomial.toFinsuppIsoLinear R)
      (congrArg (Subalgebra.val (reesAlgebra I)) hxy)
    have hcomp := coeLinearMap_comp_toPolynomialDirectSum I
    have hx := LinearMap.congr_fun hcomp x
    have hy := LinearMap.congr_fun hcomp y
    simpa only [toFinsuppLinear, LinearMap.comp_apply] using hx.trans (hval.trans hy.symm)
  · intro f
    let component (n : ℕ) : grading I n :=
      ⟨⟨monomial n ((f : R[X]).coeff n),
          reesAlgebra.monomial_mem.mpr (f.2 n)⟩,
        AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mem_grade n ((f : R[X]).coeff n)⟩
    refine ⟨∑ n ∈ (f : R[X]).support,
      DirectSum.lof R ℕ (fun n ↦ grading I n) n (component n), ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp only [map_sum, DirectSum.lof_eq_of, DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom_of]
    change (Subalgebra.val (reesAlgebra I))
      (∑ n ∈ (f : R[X]).support, (component n).1) = (f : R[X])
    rw [map_sum]
    change (∑ n ∈ (f : R[X]).support, monomial n ((f : R[X]).coeff n)) = (f : R[X])
    exact ((f : R[X]).as_sum_support).symm

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.affineData_scheme
statement:
@[simp]
theorem affineData_scheme (X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}) (U : X.affineOpens)
    (I : Ideal (Γ(X, U.1))) :
    (affineData X U I).scheme = AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading I)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.coe_wedgeProduct_tmul
statement:
lemma coe_wedgeProduct_tmul {R' : Type u} [CommRing R'] (M : ModuleCat.{u} R') (p q : ℕ)
    (x : ⋀[R']^p M) (y : ⋀[R']^q M) :
    ((ModuleCat.exteriorPower.wedgeProduct (M := M) p q).hom (x ⊗ₜ[R'] y)).1 = x.1 * y.1
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ∈ Submodule.span R' (Set.range (exteriorPower.ιMulti R' p (M := M))) := by
    rw [exteriorPower.ιMulti_span]; trivial
  have hy : y ∈ Submodule.span R' (Set.range (exteriorPower.ιMulti R' q (M := M))) := by
    rw [exteriorPower.ιMulti_span]; trivial
  induction hx, hy using Submodule.span_induction₂ with
  | mem_mem a b ha hb =>
      obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := ha
      obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hb
      have h := ModuleCat.exteriorPower.wedgeProduct_tmul_mk (M := M) p q v w
      change (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.wedgeProduct (M := M) p q
        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk v ⊗ₜ[R'] ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk w)).1 = _
      rw [h]
      exact (ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_mul_ιMulti v w).symm
  | zero_left b _ =>
      erw [TensorProduct.zero_tmul, map_zero]
      exact (zero_mul _).symm
  | zero_right a _ =>
      erw [TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero]
      exact (mul_zero _).symm
  | add_left a b c _ _ _ h1 h2 =>
      erw [TensorProduct.add_tmul, map_add]
      exact (congrArg₂ (· + ·) h1 h2).trans (add_mul _ _ _).symm
  | add_right a b c _ _ _ h1 h2 =>
      erw [TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add]
      exact (congrArg₂ (· + ·) h1 h2).trans (mul_add _ _ _).symm
  | smul_left c a b _ _ h =>
      erw [show (c • a) ⊗ₜ[R'] b = c • (a ⊗ₜ[R'] b) from (TensorProduct.smul_tmul' c a b).symm]
      erw [map_smul]
      exact (congrArg (c • ·) h).trans (smul_mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
  | smul_right c a b _ _ h =>
      erw [show a ⊗ₜ[R'] (c • b) = c • (a ⊗ₜ[R'] b) from TensorProduct.tmul_smul c a b]
      erw [map_smul]
      exact (congrArg (c • ·) h).trans (mul_smul_comm _ _ _).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.coe_exteriorPower_map_hom
statement:
lemma coe_exteriorPower_map_hom {R' : Type u} [CommRing R'] {M N : ModuleCat.{u} R'} (g : M ⟶ N)
    (n : ℕ) (x : M.exteriorPower n) :
    (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.map g n x).1 = ExteriorAlgebra.map g.hom x.1
proof:
:=
  coe_exteriorPower_map n g.hom x

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.coe_toRange_app
statement:
lemma coe_toRange_app {A M : ModulePresheaf Y} (φ : A ⟶ M) (W : (Y.Opens)ᵒᵖ) (a : A.obj W) :
    ((toRange φ).app W a).1 = φ.app W a
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.toRange_app_surjective
statement:
lemma toRange_app_surjective {A M : ModulePresheaf Y} (φ : A ⟶ M) (W : (Y.Opens)ᵒᵖ) :
    Function.Surjective ((toRange φ).app W)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨_, a, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨a, rfl⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.coe_wedgeMap_app
statement:
lemma coe_wedgeMap_app {Kp Fp : ModulePresheaf Y} (fp : Kp ⟶ Fp) (i j n : ℕ) (h : i + j = n)
    (W : (Y.Opens)ᵒᵖ) (a : (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower Kp i).obj W)
    (b : (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower Fp j).obj W) :
    ((wedgeMap fp i j n h).app W (a ⊗ₜ b)).1 = ExteriorAlgebra.map (fp.app W).hom a.1 * b.1
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  change ((ModuleCat.exteriorPower.wedgeProduct (M := Fp.obj W) i j).hom
    ((ModuleCat.exteriorPower.map (fp.app W) i a : ⋀[_]^i (Fp.obj W)) ⊗ₜ
      (b : ⋀[_]^j (Fp.obj W)))).1 = _
  rw [coe_wedgeProduct_tmul, coe_exteriorPower_map_hom]

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.wedgeMap_app_hom
statement:
lemma wedgeMap_app_hom {Kp Fp : ModulePresheaf Y} (fp : Kp ⟶ Fp) (i j n : ℕ) (h : i + j = n)
    (W : (Y.Opens)ᵒᵖ) :
    ((wedgeMap fp i j n h).app W).hom = wedgeLin (fp.app W).hom i j n h
proof:
:=
  TensorProduct.ext' fun a b => Subtype.ext (coe_wedgeMap_app fp i j n h W a b)

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.filt_obj
statement:
lemma filt_obj {Kp Fp : ModulePresheaf Y} (fp : Kp ⟶ Fp) (i j n : ℕ) (h : i + j = n)
    (W : (Y.Opens)ᵒᵖ) :
    (filt fp i j n h).obj W = LinearMap.range (wedgeLin (fp.app W).hom i j n h)
proof:
:=
  congrArg LinearMap.range (wedgeMap_app_hom fp i j n h W)

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.pow_succ_mul_le
statement:
lemma pow_succ_mul_le {R' E : Type u} [CommRing R'] [Ring E] [Algebra R' E]
    (A V : Submodule R' E) (hA : A ≤ V) (i j : ℕ) : A ^ (i + 1) * V ^ j ≤ A ^ i * V ^ (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_succ, pow_succ', mul_assoc]
  exact mul_le_mul' le_rfl (mul_le_mul' hA le_rfl)

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.filt_le
statement:
lemma filt_le {Kp Fp : ModulePresheaf Y} (fp : Kp ⟶ Fp) (i j n : ℕ) (h₁ : i + 1 + j = n)
    (h₂ : i + (j + 1) = n) : filt fp (i + 1) j n h₁ ≤ filt fp i (j + 1) n h₂
proof:
:= by
  intro W x hx
  rw [filt_obj] at hx ⊢
  have hA : LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι _ ∘ₗ (fp.app W).hom) ≤
      LinearMap.range (ExteriorAlgebra.ι _ (M := Fp.obj W)) := by
    rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  exact (mem_range_wedgeLin_iff _ i (j + 1) n h₂ x).2
    (pow_succ_mul_le _ _ hA i j ((mem_range_wedgeLin_iff _ (i + 1) j n h₁ x).1 hx))

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.filt_zero_eq_top
statement:
lemma filt_zero_eq_top {Kp Fp : ModulePresheaf Y} (fp : Kp ⟶ Fp) (n : ℕ) (h : 0 + n = n) :
    filt fp 0 n n h = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm le_top
  intro W x _
  rw [filt_obj]
  refine (mem_range_wedgeLin_iff _ 0 n n h x).2 ?_
  rw [pow_zero, Submodule.one_mul]
  exact x.2

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.stepK_app_hom
statement:
lemma stepK_app_hom (i j : ℕ) (W : (Y.Opens)ᵒᵖ) :
    ((stepK fp i j).app W).hom =
      LinearMap.lTensor _ (wedgeLin (fp.app W).hom 1 j (j + 1) (Nat.add_comm 1 j))
proof:
:=
  congrArg (LinearMap.lTensor _) (wedgeMap_app_hom fp 1 j (j + 1) _ W)

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.stepD_app_hom
statement:
lemma stepD_app_hom (i j : ℕ) (W : (Y.Opens)ᵒᵖ) :
    ((stepD (Kp := Kp) gp i j).app W).hom =
      LinearMap.lTensor _ (exteriorPower.map (j + 1) (gp.app W).hom)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.stepK_stepD
statement:
lemma stepK_stepD (hgf : ∀ W k, (gp.app W).hom ((fp.app W).hom k) = 0) (i j : ℕ) :
    stepK fp i j ≫ stepD gp i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro W
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change ((stepD gp i j).app W).hom (((stepK fp i j).app W).hom x) = 0
  have e2 := congrArg (fun φ => φ x) (stepK_app_hom fp i j W)
  refine (congrArg ((stepD gp i j).app W).hom e2).trans ?_
  exact lTensor_map_wedgeLin_eq_zero _ _ (hgf W) j _ x

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.stepK_stepC
statement:
lemma stepK_stepC (i j n : ℕ) (h₁ : i + 1 + j = n) (h₂ : i + (j + 1) = n) :
    stepK fp i j ≫ stepC fp i j n h₁ h₂ = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro W
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  have hmem : (wedgeMap fp i (j + 1) n h₂).app W ((stepK fp i j).app W x) ∈
      (filt fp (i + 1) j n h₁).obj W := by
    rw [filt_obj]
    have e1 := congrArg (fun φ => φ (((stepK fp i j).app W).hom x))
      (wedgeMap_app_hom fp i (j + 1) n h₂ W)
    have e2 := congrArg (fun φ => φ x) (stepK_app_hom fp i j W)
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := wedgeLin_lTensor_mem (fp.app W).hom i j n h₁ h₂ _ x
    exact ⟨y, hy.trans (e1.trans (congrArg _ e2)).symm⟩
  have e : (toRange (wedgeMap fp i (j + 1) n h₂)).app W ((stepK fp i j).app W x) =
      (PresheafOfModules.Submodule.homOfLE (filt_le fp i j n h₁ h₂)).app W ⟨_, hmem⟩ :=
    Subtype.ext rfl
  change (cokernel.π (PresheafOfModules.Submodule.homOfLE (filt_le fp i j n h₁ h₂))).app W
    ((toRange (wedgeMap fp i (j + 1) n h₂)).app W ((stepK fp i j).app W x)) = 0
  calc _ = (cokernel.π (PresheafOfModules.Submodule.homOfLE (filt_le fp i j n h₁ h₂))).app W
        ((PresheafOfModules.Submodule.homOfLE (filt_le fp i j n h₁ h₂)).app W ⟨_, hmem⟩) :=
          congrArg _ e
    _ = 0 := by
        rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← PresheafOfModules.comp_app, cokernel.condition]
        rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.stepD_desc_bijective
statement:
lemma stepD_desc_bijective (W : (Y.Opens)ᵒᵖ)
    (r : Fp.obj W →ₗ[(Y.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).obj W] Kp.obj W)
    (s : Qp.obj W →ₗ[(Y.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).obj W] Fp.obj W)
    (hdec : ∀ y, y = (fp.app W).hom (r y) + s ((gp.app W).hom y))
    (hgs : ∀ q, (gp.app W).hom (s q) = q) (i j : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective
      ((cokernel.desc (stepK fp i j) (stepD gp i j) (stepK_stepD fp gp hgf i j)).app W)
proof:
:= by
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (gp.app W).hom := fun q => ⟨s q, hgs q⟩
  have hsΛ := exteriorPower.map_surjective (n := j + 1) hsurj
  have hex := exact_lTensor_wedgeLin_one
    (⋀[(Y.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).obj W]^i (Kp.obj W))
    (fp.app W).hom r s (gp.app W).hom hdec hgs (hgf W) j (Nat.add_comm 1 j)
  apply cokernelDesc_app_bijective
  · exact LinearMap.lTensor_surjective _ hsΛ
  · intro e he
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := (hex e).1 he
    exact ⟨p, (congrArg (fun φ => φ p) (stepK_app_hom fp i j W)).trans hp⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.stepC_desc_bijective
statement:
lemma stepC_desc_bijective (W : (Y.Opens)ᵒᵖ)
    (r : Fp.obj W →ₗ[(Y.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).obj W] Kp.obj W)
    (s : Qp.obj W →ₗ[(Y.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).obj W] Fp.obj W)
    (hrf : ∀ k, r ((fp.app W).hom k) = k)
    (hdec : ∀ y, y = (fp.app W).hom (r y) + s ((gp.app W).hom y))
    (hgs : ∀ q, (gp.app W).hom (s q) = q) (i j n : ℕ) (h₁ : i + 1 + j = n)
    (h₂ : i + (j + 1) = n) :
    Function.Bijective
      ((cokernel.desc (stepK fp i j) (stepC fp i j n h₁ h₂)
        (stepK_stepC fp i j n h₁ h₂)).app W)
proof:
:= by
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (gp.app W).hom := fun q => ⟨s q, hgs q⟩
  have hsΛ := exteriorPower.map_surjective (n := j + 1) hsurj
  have hex := exact_lTensor_wedgeLin_one
    (⋀[(Y.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).obj W]^i (Kp.obj W))
    (fp.app W).hom r s (gp.app W).hom hdec hgs (hgf W) j (Nat.add_comm 1 j)
  have hπ : Function.Surjective ((cokernel.π
      (PresheafOfModules.Submodule.homOfLE (filt_le fp i j n h₁ h₂))).app W) := by
    have : Epi ((PresheafOfModules.evaluation _ W).map (cokernel.π
        (PresheafOfModules.Submodule.homOfLE (filt_le fp i j n h₁ h₂)))) := inferInstance
    exact (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).1 this
  apply cokernelDesc_app_bijective
  · intro c
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hπ c
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := toRange_app_surjective (wedgeMap fp i (j + 1) n h₂) W b
    exact ⟨a, rfl⟩
  · intro e he
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := exists_app_eq_of_cokernel_π_app_eq_zero
      (PresheafOfModules.Submodule.homOfLE (filt_le fp i j n h₁ h₂)) W _ he
    have hmem : (wedgeMap fp i (j + 1) n h₂).app W e ∈ (filt fp (i + 1) j n h₁).obj W := by
      have h1 : (wedgeMap fp i (j + 1) n h₂).app W e = p.1 := (congrArg Subtype.val hp).symm
      rw [h1]
      exact p.2
    rw [filt_obj] at hmem
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hmem
    have e1 := congrArg (fun φ => φ e) (wedgeMap_app_hom fp i (j + 1) n h₂ W)
    have hz := (mem_range_wedgeLin_iff (fp.app W).hom (i + 1) j n h₁ _).1 ⟨y, hy.trans e1⟩
    have h0 := rho_eq_zero_of_mem (fp.app W).hom r (gp.app W).hom hrf (hgf W) i (j + 1) j _ hz
    have h0' := (rho_wedgeLin (fp.app W).hom r (gp.app W).hom hrf (hgf W) i (j + 1) n h₂
      e).symm.trans h0
    obtain ⟨p', hp'⟩ := (hex e).1 h0'
    exact ⟨p', (congrArg (fun φ => φ p') (stepK_app_hom fp i j W)).trans hp'⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.toRange_top_injective
statement:
lemma toRange_top_injective (W : (Y.Opens)ᵒᵖ)
    (r : Fp.obj W →ₗ[(Y.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).obj W] Kp.obj W)
    (hrf : ∀ k, r ((fp.app W).hom k) = k) (n : ℕ) (h : n + 0 = n) :
    Function.Injective ((toRange (wedgeMap fp n 0 n h)).app W)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  have h1 : ((wedgeMap fp n 0 n h).app W).hom x = ((wedgeMap fp n 0 n h).app W).hom y :=
    congrArg Subtype.val hxy
  rw [wedgeMap_app_hom] at h1
  have h2 : rho n 0 r (gp.app W).hom (wedgeLin (fp.app W).hom n 0 n h x).1 =
      rho n 0 r (gp.app W).hom (wedgeLin (fp.app W).hom n 0 n h y).1 :=
    congrArg (fun z => rho n 0 r (gp.app W).hom z.1) h1
  rw [rho_wedgeLin (fp.app W).hom r (gp.app W).hom hrf (hgf W),
    rho_wedgeLin (fp.app W).hom r (gp.app W).hom hrf (hgf W)] at h2
  exact (lTensor_bijective_of_bijective _ (exteriorPower_map_zero_bijective _)).1 h2

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.topD_bijective
statement:
lemma topD_bijective (n : ℕ) (W : (Y.Opens)ᵒᵖ) :
    Function.Bijective ((PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower Kp n ◁
      PresheafOfModules.exteriorPowerMap gp 0).app W)
proof:
:=
  lTensor_bijective_of_bijective _ (exteriorPower_map_zero_bijective _)

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.filt_bottom_bijective
statement:
lemma filt_bottom_bijective (n : ℕ) (h : 0 + n = n) (W : (Y.Opens)ᵒᵖ) :
    Function.Bijective ((filt fp 0 n n h).ι.app W)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Subtype.val_injective, fun x => ?_⟩
  have hx : x ∈ (filt fp 0 n n h).obj W := by
    rw [filt_zero_eq_top]
    trivial
  exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.exists_local_section
statement:
theorem exists_local_section {K F Q : Y.Modules} (f : K ⟶ F) (g : F ⟶ Q) (zero : f ≫ g = 0)
    (hS : (ShortComplex.mk f g zero).ShortExact) (hQ : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y Q) (x : Y) :
    ∃ V : Y.Opens, x ∈ V ∧ ∀ W : Y.Opens, W ≤ V →
      ∃ s : ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).obj Q).obj (op W) ⟶
          ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).obj F).obj (op W),
        ∀ l, ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).map g).app (op W) (s l) = l
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin⟩ := hQ.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := hqfin
  have hcover : TopologicalSpace.IsOpenCover q.X := (Opens.coversTop_iff Y q.X).mp q.coversTop
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ : ∃ i, x ∈ q.X i := by
    have hxUnion : x ∈ ⋃ i, (q.X i : Set Y) := by
      rw [hcover.iSup_set_eq_univ]
      exact Set.mem_univ x
    simpa using hxUnion
  let I := (q.generators i).I
  letI : (q.generators i).IsFiniteType :=
    SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType i
  letI : Finite I := by
    dsimp only [I]
    infer_instance
  letI : Fintype I := Fintype.ofFinite I
  haveI : Epi g := hS.epi_g
  let π := asIso (q.generators i).π
  obtain ⟨V, hVU, hxV, s, hs⟩ :=
    Scheme.Modules.exists_open_section_of_epi_free_over Y I g (q.X i) π x hxi
  refine ⟨V, hxV, fun W hWV ↦ ?_⟩
  let W' : (Over V)ᵒᵖ := op (Over.mk (homOfLE hWV))
  refine ⟨s.val.app W', fun l ↦ ?_⟩
  have h := congrArg (fun h ↦ h.val.app W' l) hs
  exact h

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.exists_local_splitting
statement:
theorem exists_local_splitting {K F Q : Y.Modules} (f : K ⟶ F) (g : F ⟶ Q) (zero : f ≫ g = 0)
    (hS : (ShortComplex.mk f g zero).ShortExact) (hQ : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y Q) (x : Y) :
    ∃ V : Y.Opens, x ∈ V ∧ ∀ W : Y.Opens, W ≤ V →
      ∃ (r : ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).obj F).obj (op W) →ₗ[
          (Y.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).obj (op W)]
          ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).obj K).obj (op W))
        (s : ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).obj Q).obj (op W) →ₗ[
          (Y.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).obj (op W)]
          ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).obj F).obj (op W)),
        (∀ k, r (((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).map f).app (op W) k) = k) ∧
        (∀ y, y = ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).map f).app (op W) (r y) +
          s (((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).map g).app (op W) y)) ∧
        (∀ q, ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).map g).app (op W) (s q) = q)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hxV, hV⟩ := exists_local_section Y f g zero hS hQ x
  refine ⟨V, hxV, fun W hW ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hV W hW
  obtain ⟨hinj, hex, hgf⟩ := sections_leftExact Y f g zero hS (op W)
  obtain ⟨r, hrf, hdec⟩ := exists_retraction
    (((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).map f).app (op W)).hom
    (((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).map g).app (op W)).hom s.hom hinj hgf hex hs
  exact ⟨r, s.hom, hrf, hdec, hs⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.step_shortExact
statement:
theorem step_shortExact {Kp Fp : ModulePresheaf Y} (fp : Kp ⟶ Fp) (i j n : ℕ)
    (h₁ : i + 1 + j = n) (h₂ : i + (j + 1) = n) :
    (ShortComplex.mk
      ((moduleSheafification Y).map (PresheafOfModules.Submodule.homOfLE (filt_le fp i j n h₁ h₂)))
      ((moduleSheafification Y).map
        (cokernel.π (PresheafOfModules.Submodule.homOfLE (filt_le fp i j n h₁ h₂))))
      (by rw [← Functor.map_comp, cokernel.condition, Functor.map_zero])).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  letI : (moduleSheafification Y).IsLeftAdjoint := (moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).isLeftAdjoint
  have h0 : (ShortComplex.mk (PresheafOfModules.Submodule.homOfLE (filt_le fp i j n h₁ h₂))
      (cokernel.π (PresheafOfModules.Submodule.homOfLE (filt_le fp i j n h₁ h₂)))
      (cokernel.condition _)).ShortExact :=
    { exact := ShortComplex.exact_of_g_is_cokernel _ (cokernelIsCokernel _)
      mono_f := inferInstance
      epi_g := inferInstance }
  exact h0.map_of_exact (moduleSheafification Y)

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.hgf_sections
statement:
lemma hgf_sections (W : (Y.Opens)ᵒᵖ) (k : ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).obj K).obj W) :
    (((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).map g).app W).hom
      ((((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).map f).app W).hom k) = 0
proof:
:=
  (sections_leftExact Y f g zero hS W).2.2 k

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.nonempty_stepIso
statement:
theorem nonempty_stepIso (i j n : ℕ) (h₁ : i + 1 + j = n) (h₂ : i + (j + 1) = n) :
    Nonempty ((moduleSheafification Y).obj (cokernel (PresheafOfModules.Submodule.homOfLE
        (filt_le ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).map f) i j n h₁ h₂))) ≅
      tensorSheaf Y (exteriorPowerSheaf Y K i) (exteriorPowerSheaf Y Q (j + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  let Fu := underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y
  let sh := moduleSheafification Y
  let fp := Fu.map f
  let gp := Fu.map g
  have hgf : ∀ W k, (gp.app W).hom ((fp.app W).hom k) = 0 := hgf_sections f g zero hS
  have hloc := fun x : Y ↦ exists_local_splitting Y f g zero hS hQ x
  choose U hU hdata using hloc
  let uD := cokernel.desc (stepK fp i j) (stepD gp i j) (stepK_stepD fp gp hgf i j)
  let uC := cokernel.desc (stepK fp i j) (stepC fp i j n h₁ h₂) (stepK_stepC fp i j n h₁ h₂)
  have hWD : moduleLocalEquivalences Y uD := by
    refine moduleLocalEquivalences_of_bijective_on_cover uD U hU (fun x W hW ↦ ?_)
    obtain ⟨r, s, -, hdec, hgs⟩ := hdata x W hW
    exact stepD_desc_bijective fp gp hgf (op W) r s hdec hgs i j
  have hWC : moduleLocalEquivalences Y uC := by
    refine moduleLocalEquivalences_of_bijective_on_cover uC U hU (fun x W hW ↦ ?_)
    obtain ⟨r, s, hrf, hdec, hgs⟩ := hdata x W hW
    exact stepC_desc_bijective fp gp hgf (op W) r s hrf hdec hgs i j n h₁ h₂
  haveI : IsIso (sh.map uD) := Localization.inverts sh (moduleLocalEquivalences Y) uD hWD
  haveI : IsIso (sh.map uC) := Localization.inverts sh (moduleLocalEquivalences Y) uC hWC
  exact ⟨(asIso (sh.map uC)).symm ≪≫ asIso (sh.map uD) ≪≫
    (shTensorIso Y (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower (Fu.obj K) i)
      (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower (Fu.obj Q) (j + 1))).symm⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.nonempty_topIso
statement:
theorem nonempty_topIso (n : ℕ) (h : n + 0 = n) :
    Nonempty ((moduleSheafification Y).obj
        (filt ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).map f) n 0 n h).toPresheafOfModules ≅
      tensorSheaf Y (exteriorPowerSheaf Y K n) (exteriorPowerSheaf Y Q 0))
proof:
:= by
  let Fu := underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y
  let sh := moduleSheafification Y
  let fp := Fu.map f
  let gp := Fu.map g
  have hgf : ∀ W k, (gp.app W).hom ((fp.app W).hom k) = 0 := hgf_sections f g zero hS
  have hloc := fun x : Y ↦ exists_local_splitting Y f g zero hS hQ x
  choose U hU hdata using hloc
  let uR := toRange (wedgeMap fp n 0 n h)
  let uD := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower (Fu.obj K) n ◁ PresheafOfModules.exteriorPowerMap gp 0
  have hWR : moduleLocalEquivalences Y uR := by
    refine moduleLocalEquivalences_of_bijective_on_cover uR U hU (fun x W hW ↦ ?_)
    obtain ⟨r, s, hrf, -, -⟩ := hdata x W hW
    exact ⟨toRange_top_injective fp gp hgf (op W) r hrf n h,
      toRange_app_surjective _ (op W)⟩
  have hWD : moduleLocalEquivalences Y uD :=
    moduleLocalEquivalences_of_bijective_on_cover uD (fun _ ↦ ⊤) (fun _ ↦ trivial)
      (fun _ W _ ↦ topD_bijective gp n (op W))
  haveI : IsIso (sh.map uD) := Localization.inverts sh (moduleLocalEquivalences Y) uD hWD
  haveI : IsIso (sh.map uR) := Localization.inverts sh (moduleLocalEquivalences Y) uR hWR
  exact ⟨(asIso (sh.map uR)).symm ≪≫ asIso (sh.map uD) ≪≫
    (shTensorIso Y (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower (Fu.obj K) n)
      (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower (Fu.obj Q) 0)).symm⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.nonempty_bottomIso
statement:
theorem nonempty_bottomIso (n : ℕ) (h : 0 + n = n) :
    Nonempty ((moduleSheafification Y).obj
        (filt ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).map f) 0 n n h).toPresheafOfModules ≅
      exteriorPowerSheaf Y F n)
proof:
:= by
  let fp := (underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).map f
  let sh := moduleSheafification Y
  let uI := (filt fp 0 n n h).ι
  have hWI : moduleLocalEquivalences Y uI :=
    moduleLocalEquivalences_of_bijective_on_cover uI (fun _ ↦ ⊤) (fun _ ↦ trivial)
      (fun _ W _ ↦ filt_bottom_bijective fp n h (op W))
  haveI hI : IsIso (sh.map uI) := Localization.inverts sh (moduleLocalEquivalences Y) uI hWI
  exact ⟨@asIso _ _ _ _ (sh.map uI) hI⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.isFiniteLocallyFree_filt
statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_filt (n : ℕ) : ∀ i j (h : i + j = n),
    IsFiniteLocallyFree Y ((moduleSheafification Y).obj
      (filt ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).map f) i j n h).toPresheafOfModules)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero =>
      intro j h
      have hj : j = n := by omega
      subst hj
      obtain ⟨e⟩ := nonempty_bottomIso f j h
      exact isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso Y e.symm (exteriorPowerSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree Y F hF j)
  | succ i ih =>
      intro j h
      have h₂ : i + (j + 1) = n := by omega
      have hM := ih (j + 1) h₂
      obtain ⟨eC⟩ := nonempty_stepIso f g zero hS hQ i j n h h₂
      have hC := isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso Y eC.symm
        (tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree Y _ _ (exteriorPowerSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree Y K hK i)
          (exteriorPowerSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree Y Q hQ (j + 1)))
      have hSE := step_shortExact Y ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).map f) i j n h h₂
      haveI := hSE.epi_g
      haveI := hSE.mono_f
      have hker := isFiniteLocallyFree_kernel Y hM hC ((moduleSheafification Y).map
        (cokernel.π (PresheafOfModules.Submodule.homOfLE
          (filt_le ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).map f) i j n h h₂))))
      exact isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso Y
        (IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso (kernelIsKernel _) hSE.exact.fIsKernel) hker

name: SchemeKTheory.LambdaFiltration.k0ClassOf_filt
statement:
theorem k0ClassOf_filt (n : ℕ) : ∀ j i (h : i + j = n) (hP : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y
      ((moduleSheafification Y).obj
        (filt ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).map f) i j n h).toPresheafOfModules)),
    k0ClassOf Y _ hP = ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (j + 1),
      lambdaClass Y K hK (i + a) * lambdaClass Y Q hQ (j - a)
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero =>
      intro i h hP
      have hi : i = n := by omega
      subst hi
      obtain ⟨e⟩ := nonempty_topIso f g zero hS hQ i h
      have hT := tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree Y _ _
        (exteriorPowerSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree Y K hK i)
        (exteriorPowerSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree Y Q hQ 0)
      rw [k0ClassOf_iso Y hP hT e, Finset.sum_range_one, Nat.add_zero, Nat.sub_zero]
      exact (k0ClassOf_mul Y ⟨_, exteriorPowerSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree Y K hK i⟩
        ⟨_, exteriorPowerSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree Y Q hQ 0⟩).symm
  | succ j ih =>
      intro i h hP
      have h₁ : i + 1 + j = n := by omega
      have hP1 := isFiniteLocallyFree_filt hK hF hQ f g zero hS n (i + 1) j h₁
      have hIH := ih (i + 1) h₁ hP1
      obtain ⟨eC⟩ := nonempty_stepIso f g zero hS hQ i j n h₁ h
      have hT := tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree Y _ _
        (exteriorPowerSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree Y K hK i)
        (exteriorPowerSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree Y Q hQ (j + 1))
      have hC := isFiniteLocallyFree_of_iso Y eC.symm hT
      have hSE := step_shortExact Y ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).map f) i j n h₁ h
      have hrel := ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_middle Y.Modules (IsFiniteLocallyFree Y)
        hP1 hP hC _ hSE
      have hCcl : k0ClassOf Y _ hC = lambdaClass Y K hK i * lambdaClass Y Q hQ (j + 1) :=
        (k0ClassOf_iso Y hC hT eC).trans (k0ClassOf_mul Y
          ⟨_, exteriorPowerSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree Y K hK i⟩
          ⟨_, exteriorPowerSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree Y Q hQ (j + 1)⟩).symm
      change k0ClassOf Y _ hP = k0ClassOf Y _ hP1 + k0ClassOf Y _ hC at hrel
      rw [hrel, hIH, hCcl, Finset.sum_range_succ' _ (j + 1), Nat.add_zero, Nat.sub_zero]
      congr 1
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
      rw [show i + (a + 1) = i + 1 + a by omega, show j + 1 - (a + 1) = j - a by omega]

name: SchemeKTheory.lambdaClass_shortExact
statement:
theorem lambdaClass_shortExact (n : ℕ) :
    lambdaClass Y F hF n = ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n,
      lambdaClass Y K hK p.1 * lambdaClass Y Q hQ p.2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk]
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := nonempty_bottomIso f n (Nat.zero_add n)
  have hP := isFiniteLocallyFree_filt hK hF hQ f g zero hS n 0 n (Nat.zero_add n)
  have h1 := k0ClassOf_filt hK hF hQ f g zero hS n n 0 (Nat.zero_add n) hP
  have h2 : lambdaClass Y F hF n = k0ClassOf Y _ hP :=
    (k0ClassOf_iso Y hP (exteriorPowerSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree Y F hF n) e).symm
  rw [h2, h1]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
  rw [Nat.zero_add]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_pre_app'
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_pre_app' {Y Z W : Scheme.{u}} (s : W ⟶ Y) (q : Z ⟶ Y) (r : W ⟶ Z)
    [IsOpenImmersion s] [IsOpenImmersion q] [IsOpenImmersion r] (h : r ≫ q = s)
    (F : Y.Modules) (V : W.Opens) (x : Γ(F, s ''ᵁ V))
    (ψ : op (s ''ᵁ V) ⟶ op (q ''ᵁ (r ''ᵁ V))) :
    (restrictCompPrefixIso' s q r h F).hom.app V x = F.presheaf.map ψ x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := tensorOverlap_pre_app s q r h F (op V)
  rw [Subsingleton.elim ψ f]
  exact hf x

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_leg_app
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_leg_app {d : ℤ} {O : Xg.Modules}
    (ρ : 𝐑[ιg].obj O ≅ twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d)
    (D : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c d q) (x : Γ(twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d, ⊤))
    (ψ : op (ιg ''ᵁ ⊤) ⟶ op (p ''ᵁ ⊤)) (ψ' : op (⊤ : (space R M).Opens) ⟶ op (q ''ᵁ (κ ''ᵁ ⊤))) :
    (tensorOverlap_leg ιg p g κ hg hκ ρ D).hom.app ⊤ (O.presheaf.map ψ (ρ.inv.app ⊤ x)) =
      D.restrictIso.hom.app (κ ''ᵁ ⊤) ((twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d).presheaf.map ψ' x)
proof:
:= by
  have s1 : (restrictCompPrefixIso' p ιg g hg O).hom.app ⊤ (O.presheaf.map ψ (ρ.inv.app ⊤ x)) =
      (𝐑[ιg].obj O).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : g ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ ⊤)).op (ρ.inv.app ⊤ x) := by
    obtain ⟨f1, -⟩ := tensorOverlap_pre_app p ιg g hg O (op ⊤)
    rw [tautQuotient_pre_app' p ιg g hg O ⊤ _ f1, Scheme.Modules.restrict_map,
      ← Functor.map_comp_apply]
    rfl
  have s3 : ρ.hom.app (g ''ᵁ ⊤) ((𝐑[ιg].obj O).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : g ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ ⊤)).op
      (ρ.inv.app ⊤ x)) = (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_top : g ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ ⊤)).op x := by
    have hx : ρ.hom.app ⊤ (ρ.inv.app ⊤ x) = x := by
      have h := congrArg (fun f : twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d ⟶
        twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d ↦ f.app ⊤ x) ρ.inv_hom_id
      simpa only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
        Scheme.Modules.Hom.id_app, ConcreteCategory.id_apply] using h
    exact (tautChart_app_map _ _ _).trans (congrArg _ hx)
  have s4 : (restrictCompPrefixIso' g q κ hκ _).hom.app ⊤
      ((twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : g ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ ⊤)).op x) =
      (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d).presheaf.map ψ' x := by
    obtain ⟨f2, -⟩ := tensorOverlap_pre_app g q κ hκ (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d) (op ⊤)
    rw [tautQuotient_pre_app' g q κ hκ _ ⊤ _ f2, ← Functor.map_comp_apply]
    rfl
  unfold tensorOverlap_leg
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app,
    ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  rw [s1]
  change D.restrictIso.hom.app (κ ''ᵁ ⊤) ((restrictCompPrefixIso' g q κ hκ _).hom.app ⊤
    (ρ.hom.app (g ''ᵁ ⊤) _)) = _
  rw [s3, s4]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_chartι_image_top
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_chartι_image_top (i : C.I) :
    (C.chartι i) ''ᵁ ⊤ = C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i
proof:
:= by

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_overSectionOfElement_terminal
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_overSectionOfElement_terminal (M : X.Modules) (U : X.Opens)
    (s : (M.over U).sections) :
    Scheme.Modules.overSectionOfElement X M U (s.eval (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))) = s
proof:
:= by
  apply PresheafOfModules.sections_ext
  intro W
  let q : W.unop ⟶ Over.mk (𝟙 U) := Over.homMk W.unop.hom (by rfl)
  change M.val.map W.unop.hom.op (s.eval (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))) = s.eval W
  exact PresheafOfModules.sections_property s q.op

statement:
theorem tautQuotient_frame_freeSection (i : C.I) (k : C.basisIndex i) :
    SheafOfModules.sectionsMap (C.frame i).hom (SheafOfModules.freeSection k) =
      Scheme.Modules.overSectionOfElement X E (C.U i) (C.sectionBasis i k)
proof:
:= by
