  exact (tautQuotient_overSectionOfElement_terminal E (C.U i) _).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_alpha_frame
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_alpha_frame (i : C.I) (k : C.basisIndex i) :
    SheafOfModules.sectionsMap (tautQuotient_alpha C i)
        (Scheme.Modules.overSectionOfElement X E (C.U i) (C.sectionBasis i k)) =
      Scheme.Modules.overSectionOfElement X (tautQuotient_N C) (C.U i) (tautQuotient_t C i k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tautQuotient_frame_freeSection, ← SheafOfModules.sectionsMap_comp, tautQuotient_alpha,
    Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, SheafOfModules.sectionsMap_freeHomEquiv_symm_freeSection]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_alpha_compatible
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_alpha_compatible
    (h : ∀ (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j),
      Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X c.affineOpen_le_left (tautQuotient_alpha C i) =
        Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X c.affineOpen_le_right (tautQuotient_alpha C j)) :
    Presheaf.FamilyOfElementsOnObjects.IsCompatible
      (fun i ↦ Scheme.Modules.localHomSection X (C.U i) (tautQuotient_alpha C i))
proof:
:= by
  intro V i j f g
  let H := sheafHom ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj E)
    ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj (tautQuotient_N C))
  have hsep := ((isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_of_type _ H.obj).1 H.property).isSeparated
  let S : Sieve V := Sieve.ofObjects (fun c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j ↦ c.affineOpen.1) V
  have hS : S ∈ Opens.grothendieckTopology X V := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨a, b', hab, hxa⟩ := exists_basicOpen_le_affine_inter (C.isAffine i)
      (C.isAffine j) x ⟨f.le hx, g.le hx⟩
    let c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j := ⟨a, b', hab⟩
    exact ⟨V ⊓ c.affineOpen.1, homOfLE inf_le_left, ⟨c, ⟨homOfLE inf_le_right⟩⟩, ⟨hx, hxa⟩⟩
  refine (hsep S hS).ext ?_
  rintro Z e ⟨c, ⟨q⟩⟩
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  have e1 : f.op ≫ e.op = (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_left).op ≫ q.op := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have e2 : g.op ≫ e.op = (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_right).op ≫ q.op := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [e1, e2, Functor.map_comp_apply, Functor.map_comp_apply,
    Scheme.Modules.sheafHom_map_localHomSection, Scheme.Modules.sheafHom_map_localHomSection,
    h i j c]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_sectionsMap_overSection_eval
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_sectionsMap_overSection_eval {M N : X.Modules} {U : X.Opens}
    (φ : M.over U ⟶ N.over U) (e : M.val.obj (op U)) :
    (SheafOfModules.sectionsMap φ (Scheme.Modules.overSectionOfElement X M U e)).eval
        (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) = φ.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) e
proof:
:= by
  change φ.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) (M.val.map (𝟙 (op U)) e) = _
  rw [M.val.map_id]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_restrictHomOverLE_app
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_restrictHomOverLE_app {M N : X.Modules} {U V : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ U)
    (φ : M.over U ⟶ N.over U) (e : M.val.obj (op V)) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X h φ).val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 V))) e =
      φ.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE h))) e
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_over_naturality
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_over_naturality {M N : X.Modules} {U V : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ U)
    (φ : M.over U ⟶ N.over U) (e : M.val.obj (op U)) :
    φ.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE h))) (M.val.map (homOfLE h).op e) =
      N.val.map (homOfLE h).op (φ.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) e)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_alpha_app_frame
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_alpha_app_frame (i : C.I) (k : C.basisIndex i) :
    (tautQuotient_alpha C i).val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 (C.U i)))) (C.sectionBasis i k) =
      tautQuotient_t C i k
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tautQuotient_sectionsMap_overSection_eval, tautQuotient_alpha_frame,
    Scheme.Modules.overSectionOfElement_eval]
  change (tautQuotient_N C).val.map (𝟙 (op (C.U i))) (tautQuotient_t C i k) = _
  rw [(tautQuotient_N C).val.map_id]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_alpha_local
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_alpha_local (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    (hkey : ∀ k : C.basisIndex i,
      (tautQuotient_N C).presheaf.map (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_left).op (tautQuotient_t C i k) =
        (c.rightSectionBasis.repr (c.leftSectionBasis k)).sum
          (fun l a ↦ a • (tautQuotient_N C).presheaf.map (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_right).op
            (tautQuotient_t C j l))) :
    Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X c.affineOpen_le_left (tautQuotient_alpha C i) =
      Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X c.affineOpen_le_right (tautQuotient_alpha C j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_epi c.leftFrame.hom]
  apply (SheafOfModules.freeHomEquiv _).injective
  funext k
  rw [SheafOfModules.freeHomEquiv_comp_apply, SheafOfModules.freeHomEquiv_comp_apply,
    SheafOfModules.freeHomEquiv_apply]
  have hL : SheafOfModules.sectionsMap c.leftFrame.hom (SheafOfModules.freeSection k) =
      Scheme.Modules.overSectionOfElement X E c.affineOpen.1 (c.leftSectionBasis k) := by
    rw [show c.leftSectionBasis k = _ from
      SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictedSectionBasis_apply_overFrame C i
        c.affineOpen.1 c.affineOpen_le_left k]
    exact (tautQuotient_overSectionOfElement_terminal E _ _).symm
  rw [hL, ← tautQuotient_overSectionOfElement_terminal (tautQuotient_N C) c.affineOpen.1
      (SheafOfModules.sectionsMap _ _),
    ← tautQuotient_overSectionOfElement_terminal (tautQuotient_N C) c.affineOpen.1
      (SheafOfModules.sectionsMap
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X c.affineOpen_le_right (tautQuotient_alpha C j)) _),
    tautQuotient_sectionsMap_overSection_eval, tautQuotient_sectionsMap_overSection_eval,
    tautQuotient_restrictHomOverLE_app, tautQuotient_restrictHomOverLE_app]
  congr 1
  have hR : ∀ l, (tautQuotient_alpha C j).val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_right)))
      (c.rightSectionBasis l) = (tautQuotient_N C).presheaf.map (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_right).op
        (tautQuotient_t C j l) := by
    intro l
    rw [show c.rightSectionBasis l = _ from
      (SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictedSectionBasis_eq_restrict C j
        c.affineOpen.1 c.affineOpen_le_right l).symm, tautQuotient_over_naturality,
      tautQuotient_alpha_app_frame]
    rfl
  have hLk : (tautQuotient_alpha C i).val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_left)))
      (c.leftSectionBasis k) = (tautQuotient_N C).presheaf.map (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_left).op
        (tautQuotient_t C i k) := by
    rw [show c.leftSectionBasis k = _ from
      (SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictedSectionBasis_eq_restrict C i
        c.affineOpen.1 c.affineOpen_le_left k).symm, tautQuotient_over_naturality,
      tautQuotient_alpha_app_frame]
    rfl
  rw [hLk, hkey k]
  conv_rhs => rw [← c.rightSectionBasis.linearCombination_repr (c.leftSectionBasis k)]
  rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply]
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (map_finsuppSum
    ((tautQuotient_alpha C j).val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_right)))).hom
    (c.rightSectionBasis.repr (c.leftSectionBasis k))
    (fun l a ↦ a • c.rightSectionBasis l)).symm
  apply Finsupp.sum_congr
  intro l _
  erw [(((tautQuotient_alpha C j).val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_right)))).hom).map_smul]
  rw [hR l]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_generating_of_unitIso
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_generating_of_unitIso {Y S : Scheme.{u}} (j : S ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (F : Y.Modules)
    (φ : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).obj F ≅ SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf)
    {T : Y.Opens} (hT : j.opensRange ≤ T) (t : Γ(F, T))
    (ht : φ.hom.app ⊤ (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE ((j.image_le_opensRange ⊤).trans hT)).op t) =
      (1 : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (V : S.Opens) (s : Γ(F, j ''ᵁ V)) :
    ∃ a : Γ(Y, j ''ᵁ V), s = a • F.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE ((j.image_le_opensRange V).trans hT)).op t
proof:
:= by
  let x : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).obj F, V) :=
    F.presheaf.map (homOfLE ((j.image_le_opensRange V).trans hT)).op t
  have hx : φ.hom.app V x = (1 : Γ(S, V)) := by
    have e : x = ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).obj F).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op
        (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE ((j.image_le_opensRange ⊤).trans hT)).op t) := by
      change _ = F.presheaf.map _ (F.presheaf.map _ t)
      rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
      rfl
    rw [e, tautChart_app_map, ht]
    exact map_one (S.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op).hom
  let w : Γ(S, V) := φ.hom.app V s
  refine ⟨(j.appIso V).inv w, ?_⟩
  change s = w • x
  apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (φ.hom.app V)).1
  rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul, hx]
  change w = w * 1
  rw [mul_one]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_epi_of_generating
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_epi_of_generating {Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ X) (F : Y.Modules)
    (α : E ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).obj F)
    {ι : Type u} (S : ι → Scheme.{u}) (j : ∀ k, S k ⟶ Y) [∀ k, IsOpenImmersion (j k)]
    (hW : ⨆ k, (j k).opensRange = ⊤) (U : ι → X.Opens)
    (hWU : ∀ k, (j k).opensRange ≤ p ⁻¹ᵁ U k) (e : ∀ k, Γ(E, U k))
    (hgen : ∀ k (V : (S k).Opens) (s : Γ(F, j k ''ᵁ V)),
      ∃ a : Γ(Y, j k ''ᵁ V), s = a • F.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (((j k).image_le_opensRange V).trans (hWU k))).op (α.app (U k) (e k))) :
    Epi (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p).homEquiv _ _).symm α)
proof:
:= by
  let adj := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p
  let σ := (adj.homEquiv _ _).symm α
  have hα : α = adj.unit.app E ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).map σ := by
    exact ((adj.homEquiv _ _).apply_symm_apply α).symm.trans (Adjunction.homEquiv_unit _ _ _ _)
  suffices key : ∀ (Z : Y.Modules) (g h : F ⟶ Z), σ ≫ g = σ ≫ h → g = h from
    ⟨fun g h hc => key _ g h hc⟩
  intro Z g h hcomp
  have ht : ∀ k, g.app (p ⁻¹ᵁ U k) (α.app (U k) (e k)) =
      h.app (p ⁻¹ᵁ U k) (α.app (U k) (e k)) := by
    intro k
    have hαk : α.app (U k) (e k) =
        σ.app (p ⁻¹ᵁ U k) ((adj.unit.app E).app (U k) (e k)) := by
      rw [hα]
      rfl
    rw [hαk]
    have := congrArg (fun q => q.app (p ⁻¹ᵁ U k)) hcomp
    have h3 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom this ((adj.unit.app E).app (U k) (e k))
    simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at h3
    exact h3
  apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext
  intro V
  ext s
  let V' : ι → Y.Opens := fun k => j k ''ᵁ (j k ⁻¹ᵁ V)
  have hV' : ∀ k, V' k ≤ V := fun k => by
    dsimp only [V']
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf]
    exact inf_le_right
  have hcover : V ≤ ⨆ k, V' k := by
    dsimp only [V']
    simp only [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf]
    rw [← iSup_inf_eq, hW, top_inf_eq]
  apply TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq'
    (⟨Z.presheaf, Z.isSheaf⟩ : TopCat.Sheaf Ab Y)
    V' V (fun k => homOfLE (hV' k)) hcover
  intro k
  change Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hV' k)).op (g.app V s) =
    Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hV' k)).op (h.app V s)
  rw [← tautChart_app_map, ← tautChart_app_map]
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hgen k (j k ⁻¹ᵁ V) (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hV' k)).op s)
  rw [ha, Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul, Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul, tautChart_app_map,
    tautChart_app_map, ht k]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_toBase_range_le
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_toBase_range_le (i : C.I) (k : C.basisIndex i) :
    ((C.literalLinearOpen ⟨i, k⟩).ι ≫ C.chartι i).opensRange ≤ C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tautQuotient_chartι_image_top C i, Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange]
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_restrictionIso_taut
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_restrictionIso_taut (i : C.I) (k : C.basisIndex i) {B D : C.scheme.Opens}
    (x : Γ(C.chartTwistingSheaf 1 i, ⊤))
    (ψ1 : op (C.chartι i ''ᵁ ⊤) ⟶ op B) (ψ2 : op B ⟶ op D)
    (ψ3 : op D ⟶ op (C.chartι i ''ᵁ ((C.literalLinearOpen ⟨i, k⟩).ι ''ᵁ ⊤))) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.literalLinearOpen ⟨i, k⟩).ι).map
        (C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 i).hom).app ⊤
      ((C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map ψ3 ((C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map ψ2
        ((C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map ψ1
          ((C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 i).inv.app ⊤ x)))) =
      (C.chartTwistingSheaf 1 i).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_top : (C.literalLinearOpen ⟨i, k⟩).ι ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ ⊤)).op x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  have hψ : (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map (ψ1 ≫ ψ2 ≫ ψ3) =
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι i)).obj
        (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (le_top : (C.literalLinearOpen ⟨i, k⟩).ι ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ ⊤)).op := by
    rw [Scheme.Modules.restrict_map]
    congr 1
  rw [hψ]
  change (C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 i).hom.app
      ((C.literalLinearOpen ⟨i, k⟩).ι ''ᵁ ⊤) _ = _
  refine (tautChart_app_map (C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 i).hom _ _).trans ?_
  congr 1
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, Iso.inv_hom_id]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_literal_t
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_literal_t (i : C.I) (k : C.basisIndex i) :
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheafLiteralLinearOpenIso 1 ⟨i, k⟩).hom.app ⊤
      ((C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE ((((C.literalLinearOpen ⟨i, k⟩).ι ≫ C.chartι i).image_le_opensRange ⊤).trans
          (tautQuotient_toBase_range_le C i k))).op (tautQuotient_t C i k)) =
      (1 : Γ((C.literalLinearOpen ⟨i, k⟩).toScheme, ⊤))
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  simp only [SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistingSheafLiteralLinearOpenIso,
    id_eq]
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
    Iso.app_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp_hom_app_app]
  rw [tautQuotient_t, tautQuotient_chartSection]
  refine (congrArg (fun z => (SchemeProjectiveBundle.twistingSheafOfBasisIndexLinearOpenIso
    Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i) 1 k).inv.app ⊤ z)
      (tautQuotient_restrictionIso_taut C i k _ _ _ _)).trans ?_
  exact tautChart_projection_taut _ _ (C.sectionBasis i) k

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_alphaGlued_app
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_alphaGlued_app (hkey : tautQuotient_Key C) (i : C.I) (k : C.basisIndex i) :
    (tautQuotient_alphaGlued C hkey).app (C.U i) (C.sectionBasis i k) = tautQuotient_t C i k
proof:
:= by
  have h := Scheme.Modules.glueHom_over X C.U ((Opens.coversTop_iff (T := X) C.U).2 C.covers)
    (tautQuotient_alpha C)
    (tautQuotient_alpha_compatible C (fun i j c ↦ tautQuotient_alpha_local C i j c (hkey i j c))) i
  change ((tautQuotient_alphaGlued C hkey).over (C.U i)).val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 (C.U i))))
    (C.sectionBasis i k) = _
  rw [tautQuotient_alphaGlued, h, tautQuotient_alpha_app_frame]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_exists_tautologicalQuotient_of_key
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_exists_tautologicalQuotient_of_key (hkey : tautQuotient_Key C) :
    ∃ σ : (Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj E ⟶ C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1, Epi σ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨_, tautQuotient_epi_of_generating C.toBase (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    (tautQuotient_alphaGlued C hkey)
    (fun ij : Σ i : C.I, C.basisIndex i ↦ (C.literalLinearOpen ij).toScheme)
    (fun ij ↦ (C.literalLinearOpen ij).ι ≫ C.chartι ij.1)
    C.literalLinearOpenCover.iSup_opensRange (fun ij ↦ C.U ij.1)
    (fun ij ↦ tautQuotient_toBase_range_le C ij.1 ij.2) (fun ij ↦ C.sectionBasis ij.1 ij.2) ?_⟩
  intro ij V s
  rw [tautQuotient_alphaGlued_app]
  exact tautQuotient_generating_of_unitIso _ _ (C.canonicalTwistingSheafLiteralLinearOpenIso 1 ij)
    (tautQuotient_toBase_range_le C ij.1 ij.2) (tautQuotient_t C ij.1 ij.2) (tautQuotient_literal_t C ij.1 ij.2) V s

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_p_opensRange
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_p_opensRange (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (tensorOverlap_p C i j c).opensRange = C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ c.affineOpen.1
proof:
:= by
  have hbase : (C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c ≫ C.overlapToChart i j ≫ C.chartι i ≫
      C.toBase = pullback.snd _ _ ≫ c.inIntersection.ι ≫ (C.U i ⊓ C.U j).ι := by
    rw [C.chartι_toBase, ← C.chartToBase_comp_openImmersion]
    change pullback.fst _ _ ≫ pullback.fst _ _ ≫ C.chartToBase i ≫ (C.U i).ι = _
    rw [pullback.condition_assoc, pullback.condition_assoc, Scheme.homOfLE_ι]
    rfl
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := w.2
    change C.toBase (C.chartι i (C.overlapToChart i j w.1)) ∈ c.affineOpen.1
    rw [← hz]
    have h := congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ z) hbase
    simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] at h
    rw [h]
    exact ((pullback.snd (C.overlapToIntersection i j) c.inIntersection.ι) z).2
  · intro x hx
    have hxi : x ∈ (C.chartι i).opensRange := by
      rw [tautQuotient_chartι_opensRange]
      exact c.affineOpen_le_left hx
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hxi
    have hyU : C.toBase (C.chartι i y) ∈ C.U i ⊓ C.U j :=
      ⟨c.affineOpen_le_left hx, c.affineOpen_le_right hx⟩
    let q0 : (C.U i ⊓ C.U j : X.Opens) := ⟨C.toBase (C.chartι i y), hyU⟩
    have h0 : C.chartToBase i y = X.homOfLE (inf_le_left : C.U i ⊓ C.U j ≤ C.U i) q0 := by
      apply (C.U i).ι.isOpenEmbedding.injective
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, Scheme.homOfLE_ι,
        C.chartToBase_comp_openImmersion, ← C.chartι_toBase, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
      rfl
    obtain ⟨z0, hz0f, hz0s⟩ := Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback
      (f := C.chartToBase i) (g := X.homOfLE (inf_le_left : C.U i ⊓ C.U j ≤ C.U i)) y q0 h0
    let q1 : c.inIntersection := ⟨q0, hx⟩
    obtain ⟨z1, hz1f, -⟩ := Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback
      (f := C.overlapToIntersection i j) (g := c.inIntersection.ι) z0 q1 (by
        change (pullback.snd (C.chartToBase i)
          (X.homOfLE (inf_le_left : C.U i ⊓ C.U j ≤ C.U i))) z0 = _
        rw [hz0s]
        rfl)
    refine ⟨⟨(C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c z1, z1, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    change C.chartι i (C.overlapToChart i j
      ((pullback.fst (C.overlapToIntersection i j) c.inIntersection.ι) z1)) = C.chartι i y
    rw [hz1f]
    change C.chartι i ((pullback.fst (C.chartToBase i)
      (X.homOfLE (inf_le_left : C.U i ⊓ C.U j ≤ C.U i))) z0) = _
    rw [hz0f]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_p_image_top
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_p_image_top (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ c.affineOpen.1 = (tensorOverlap_p C i j c) ''ᵁ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange, tautQuotient_p_opensRange]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_thin3
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_thin3 {Y : Scheme.{u}} (F : Y.Modules) {A B D G : Y.Opens}
    (f1 : op A ⟶ op B) (f2 : op B ⟶ op D) (f3 : op D ⟶ op G) (g : op A ⟶ op G)
    (x : Γ(F, A)) :
    F.presheaf.map f3 (F.presheaf.map f2 (F.presheaf.map f1 x)) = F.presheaf.map g x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  congr 2

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_p_le_chart
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_p_le_chart (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (tensorOverlap_p C i j c) ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ (C.chartι i) ''ᵁ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tautQuotient_p_image_top, tautQuotient_chartι_image_top]
  exact Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono _ c.affineOpen_le_left

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_Phi_t
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_Phi_t (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) (k : C.basisIndex i) :
    tautQuotient_Phi C i j c ((tautQuotient_N C).presheaf.map (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_left).op (tautQuotient_t C i k)) =
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map (homOfLE (tautQuotient_p_le_chart C i j c)).op
        ((C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 i).inv.app ⊤ (tautQuotient_chartTaut C i k))
proof:
:=
  tautQuotient_thin3 (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) _ _ _ _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_Phi_t'
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_Phi_t' (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) (l : C.basisIndex j) :
    tautQuotient_Phi C i j c ((tautQuotient_N C).presheaf.map (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_right).op
        (tautQuotient_t C j l)) =
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map (homOfLE (by
          rw [← tautQuotient_p_image_top, tautQuotient_chartι_image_top]
          exact Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono _ c.affineOpen_le_right)).op
        ((C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 j).inv.app ⊤ (tautQuotient_chartTaut C j l))
proof:
:=
  tautQuotient_thin3 (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) _ _ _ _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_key_L
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_key_L (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) (k : C.basisIndex i)
    (hAL : letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
      (c.leftTwistRestrictionData 1).restrictIso.hom.app
          ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ''ᵁ ⊤)
          ((C.chartTwistingSheaf 1 i).presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op (tautQuotient_chartTaut C i k)) =
        (tautChart_tautHom Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) c.leftSectionBasis
          (c.leftSectionBasis k)).app ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ''ᵁ ⊤)
          (1 : Γ(c.chart, (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ''ᵁ ⊤))) :
    letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))
proof:
:= C.sectionModule_free i
    letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) := C.sectionModule_finite i
    letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
    letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C.U j) (E.val.obj (op (C.U j))) := C.sectionModule_free j
    letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C.U j) (E.val.obj (op (C.U j))) := C.sectionModule_finite j
    letI : Finite (C.basisIndex j) := C.basisIndex_finite j
    (tensorOverlap_leg (tensorOverlap_ιs C j) (tensorOverlap_p C i j c) (tensorOverlap_gR C i j c)
        (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom (tensorOverlap_hR C i j c) (tensorOverlap_hκR C i j c)
        (C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 j) (c.rightTwistRestrictionData 1)).hom.app ⊤
      (tautQuotient_Phi C i j c ((tautQuotient_N C).presheaf.map (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_left).op
        (tautQuotient_t C i k))) =
    (tautChart_tautHom Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) c.rightSectionBasis
          (c.leftSectionBasis k)).app ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ''ᵁ ⊤)
          (1 : Γ(c.chart, (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ''ᵁ ⊤)) := by
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) := C.sectionModule_free i
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) := C.sectionModule_finite i
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C.U j) (E.val.obj (op (C.U j))) := C.sectionModule_free j
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C.U j) (E.val.obj (op (C.U j))) := C.sectionModule_finite j
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex j) := C.basisIndex_finite j
  rw [tautQuotient_Phi_t]
  have hdesc := congrArg (fun f ↦ Scheme.Modules.Hom.app f ⊤
    ((C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map (homOfLE (tautQuotient_p_le_chart C i j c)).op
        ((C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 i).inv.app ⊤ (tautQuotient_chartTaut C i k))))
    (tensorOverlap_descent C 1 i j c)
  refine hdesc.symm.trans ?_
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  refine (congrArg (fun w ↦ Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom).map
      (c.twistingSheafBasisIso 1).hom) ⊤ w)
    (tautQuotient_leg_app _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (homOfLE le_top).op)).trans ?_
  refine (congrArg (fun w ↦ Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom).map
      (c.twistingSheafBasisIso 1).hom) ⊤ w) hAL).trans ?_
  exact congrArg (fun f : SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules c.chart ⟶ c.rightTwistingSheaf 1 ↦
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.app f ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ''ᵁ ⊤)
      (1 : Γ(c.chart, (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ''ᵁ ⊤)))
    (tautChart_tautHom_basisChange _ _ c.leftSectionBasis c.rightSectionBasis (c.leftSectionBasis k))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_key_R
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_key_R (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) (k : C.basisIndex i)
    (hAR : letI : Finite (C.basisIndex j) := C.basisIndex_finite j
      ∀ l : C.basisIndex j, (c.rightTwistRestrictionData 1).restrictIso.hom.app
          ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ''ᵁ ⊤)
          ((C.chartTwistingSheaf 1 j).presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op (tautQuotient_chartTaut C j l)) =
        (tautChart_tautHom Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) c.rightSectionBasis
          (c.rightSectionBasis l)).app ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ''ᵁ ⊤)
          (1 : Γ(c.chart, (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ''ᵁ ⊤)))
    (hlin : letI : Finite (C.basisIndex j) := C.basisIndex_finite j
      (tautChart_tautHom Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) c.rightSectionBasis
          (c.leftSectionBasis k)).app ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ''ᵁ ⊤)
          (1 : Γ(c.chart, (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ''ᵁ ⊤)) =
        (c.rightSectionBasis.repr (c.leftSectionBasis k)).sum (fun l a ↦
          tautQuotient_kscalar C i j c a •
            (tautChart_tautHom Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))
              c.rightSectionBasis (c.rightSectionBasis l)).app
              ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ''ᵁ ⊤)
              (1 : Γ(c.chart, (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ''ᵁ ⊤)))) :
    letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C.U j) (E.val.obj (op (C.U j)))
proof:
:= C.sectionModule_free j
    letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C.U j) (E.val.obj (op (C.U j))) := C.sectionModule_finite j
    letI : Finite (C.basisIndex j) := C.basisIndex_finite j
    (tensorOverlap_leg (tensorOverlap_ιs C j) (tensorOverlap_p C i j c) (tensorOverlap_gR C i j c)
        (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom (tensorOverlap_hR C i j c) (tensorOverlap_hκR C i j c)
        (C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 j) (c.rightTwistRestrictionData 1)).hom.app ⊤
      (tautQuotient_Phi C i j c ((c.rightSectionBasis.repr (c.leftSectionBasis k)).sum
          (fun l a ↦ a • (tautQuotient_N C).presheaf.map (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_right).op
            (tautQuotient_t C j l)))) =
    (tautChart_tautHom Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) c.rightSectionBasis
          (c.leftSectionBasis k)).app ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ''ᵁ ⊤)
          (1 : Γ(c.chart, (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ''ᵁ ⊤)) := by
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C.U j) (E.val.obj (op (C.U j))) := C.sectionModule_free j
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C.U j) (E.val.obj (op (C.U j))) := C.sectionModule_finite j
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex j) := C.basisIndex_finite j
  set legJ := tensorOverlap_leg (tensorOverlap_ιs C j) (tensorOverlap_p C i j c) (tensorOverlap_gR C i j c)
    (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom (tensorOverlap_hR C i j c) (tensorOverlap_hκR C i j c)
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 j) (c.rightTwistRestrictionData 1) with hlegJ
  rw [hlin]
  have hPhi_sum : ∀ (f : C.basisIndex j →₀ Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1))
      (g : C.basisIndex j → Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) → Γ(tautQuotient_N C, c.affineOpen.1)),
      tautQuotient_Phi C i j c (f.sum g) = f.sum (fun l a ↦ tautQuotient_Phi C i j c (g l a)) :=
    fun f g ↦ map_finsuppSum ((C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map
      (eqToHom (congrArg op (tautQuotient_p_image_top C i j c)))).hom f g
  rw [hPhi_sum]
  refine (map_finsuppSum (legJ.hom.app ⊤).hom _ _).trans ?_
  apply Finsupp.sum_congr
  intro l _
  have hsm : ∀ (a : Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)) (y : Γ(tautQuotient_N C, c.affineOpen.1)),
      tautQuotient_Phi C i j c (a • y) = ((tensorOverlap_p C i j c).appIso ⊤).hom
        (C.scheme.presheaf.map (eqToHom (congrArg op (tautQuotient_p_image_top C i j c)))
          (C.toBase.app c.affineOpen.1 a)) • tautQuotient_Phi C i j c y := by
    intro a y
    unfold tautQuotient_Phi
    have ee : (eqToHom (congrArg op (tautQuotient_p_image_top C i j c)) :
        op (C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ c.affineOpen.1) ⟶ op ((tensorOverlap_p C i j c) ''ᵁ ⊤)) =
        (homOfLE (tautQuotient_p_image_top C i j c).ge).op := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [ee]
    change (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map _
      ((C.toBase.app c.affineOpen.1 a) •
        (show Γ(C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1, C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ c.affineOpen.1) from y)) = _
    rw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul]
    change _ = (((tensorOverlap_p C i j c).appIso ⊤).inv (((tensorOverlap_p C i j c).appIso ⊤).hom
      (C.scheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE (tautQuotient_p_image_top C i j c).ge).op
        (C.toBase.app c.affineOpen.1 a)))) •
      (show Γ(C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1, (tensorOverlap_p C i j c) ''ᵁ ⊤) from
        (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map (homOfLE (tautQuotient_p_image_top C i j c).ge).op
          (show Γ(C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1, C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ c.affineOpen.1) from y))
    rw [Iso.hom_inv_id_apply]
  have hleg : ∀ (r : Γ((C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).toScheme, ⊤))
      (z : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (tensorOverlap_p C i j c)).obj
        (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1), ⊤)),
      legJ.hom.app ⊤ (r • z) =
        (((C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom.appIso ⊤).inv r) •
          (show Γ(c.rightTwistingSheaf 1, (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ''ᵁ ⊤) from
            legJ.hom.app ⊤ z) :=
    fun r z ↦ Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul _ _ _
  have hval : legJ.hom.app ⊤ (tautQuotient_Phi C i j c ((tautQuotient_N C).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_right).op (tautQuotient_t C j l))) =
      (tautChart_tautHom Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) c.rightSectionBasis
          (c.rightSectionBasis l)).app ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ''ᵁ ⊤)
          (1 : Γ(c.chart, (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ''ᵁ ⊤)) := by
    rw [tautQuotient_Phi_t']
    exact (tautQuotient_leg_app _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (homOfLE le_top).op).trans (hAR l)
  change legJ.hom.app ⊤ (tautQuotient_Phi C i j c (_ • _)) = _
  rw [hsm, hleg, hval]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_key_of_hyps
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_key_of_hyps (hAL : tautQuotient_HypAL C) (hAR : tautQuotient_HypAR C)
    (hlin : tautQuotient_HypLin C) : tautQuotient_Key C
proof:
:= by
  intro i j c k
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C.U j) (E.val.obj (op (C.U j))) := C.sectionModule_free j
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C.U j) (E.val.obj (op (C.U j))) := C.sectionModule_finite j
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex j) := C.basisIndex_finite j
  let legJ := tensorOverlap_leg (tensorOverlap_ιs C j) (tensorOverlap_p C i j c) (tensorOverlap_gR C i j c)
    (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom (tensorOverlap_hR C i j c) (tensorOverlap_hκR C i j c)
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 j) (c.rightTwistRestrictionData 1)
  have hΦ : Function.Injective (tautQuotient_Phi C i j c) :=
    (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso ((C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map
      (eqToHom (congrArg op (tautQuotient_p_image_top C i j c))))).1
  have hJ : Function.Injective (legJ.hom.app ⊤) := by
    intro a b h
    have h' := congrArg (legJ.inv.app ⊤) h
    have e : ∀ z, legJ.inv.app ⊤ (legJ.hom.app ⊤ z) = z := fun z ↦ by
      have := congrArg (fun f ↦ Scheme.Modules.Hom.app f ⊤ z) legJ.hom_inv_id
      simpa only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
        Scheme.Modules.Hom.id_app, ConcreteCategory.id_apply] using this
    rwa [e, e] at h'
  apply hΦ
  apply hJ
  exact (tautQuotient_key_L C i j c k (hAL i j c k)).trans
    (tautQuotient_key_R C i j c k (hAR i j c) (hlin i j c k)).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_exists_tautologicalQuotient_of_hyps
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_exists_tautologicalQuotient_of_hyps (hAL : tautQuotient_HypAL C) (hAR : tautQuotient_HypAR C)
    (hlin : tautQuotient_HypLin C) :
    ∃ σ : (Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj E ⟶ C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1, Epi σ
proof:
:=
  tautQuotient_exists_tautologicalQuotient_of_key C (tautQuotient_key_of_hyps C hAL hAR hlin)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_restrictUnitIso_one
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_restrictUnitIso_one {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    (V : Y.Opens) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso f).hom.app V (1 : Γ(Z, f ''ᵁ V)) = (1 : Γ(Y, V))
proof:
:= by
  change (f.appIso V).hom 1 = 1
  exact map_one _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_HypAL_of
statement: theorem tautQuotient_HypAL_of (h : tautQuotient_HypA_left C) : tautQuotient_HypAL C
proof:
:= by
  intro i j c k
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  let V := (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ''ᵁ ⊤
  have hm := congrArg (fun f : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor c.chartToLeft).obj
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules (space Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))))) ⟶
        twistingSheafOfBasisIndex Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))
          c.leftSectionBasis 1 ↦ Scheme.Modules.Hom.app f V
    (1 : Γ(space Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))), c.chartToLeft ''ᵁ V)))
    (h i j c (C.sectionBasis i k))
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hm
  rw [tautQuotient_restrictUnitIso_one, c.leftRestriction_sectionBasis] at hm
  refine Eq.trans ?_ hm
  congr 1
  rw [tautQuotient_chartTaut]
  refine (tautChart_app_map _ _ _).symm.trans ?_
  congr 1

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_HypAR_of
statement: theorem tautQuotient_HypAR_of (h : tautQuotient_HypA_right C) : tautQuotient_HypAR C
proof:
:= by
  intro i j c l
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex j) := C.basisIndex_finite j
  let V := (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ''ᵁ ⊤
  have hm := congrArg (fun f : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor c.chartToRight).obj
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules (space Γ(X, C.U j) (E.val.obj (op (C.U j))))) ⟶
        twistingSheafOfBasisIndex Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))
          c.rightSectionBasis 1 ↦ Scheme.Modules.Hom.app f V
    (1 : Γ(space Γ(X, C.U j) (E.val.obj (op (C.U j))), c.chartToRight ''ᵁ V)))
    (h i j c (C.sectionBasis j l))
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hm
  rw [tautQuotient_restrictUnitIso_one, c.rightRestriction_sectionBasis] at hm
  refine Eq.trans ?_ hm
  congr 1
  rw [tautQuotient_chartTaut]
  refine (tautChart_app_map _ _ _).symm.trans ?_
  congr 1

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_appLE_congr
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_appLE_congr {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} {f g : Y ⟶ Z} (hfg : f = g) (U : Z.Opens)
    (V : Y.Opens) (h : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U) (h' : V ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U) (x : Γ(Z, U)) :
    f.appLE U V h x = g.appLE U V h' x
proof:
:= by
  subst hfg
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_comp_appLE_apply
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_comp_appLE_apply {Y Z W : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ Z) (g : Z ⟶ W) (U : W.Opens)
    (V : Y.Opens) (e : V ≤ (f ≫ g) ⁻¹ᵁ U) (x : Γ(W, U)) :
    (f ≫ g).appLE U V e x = f.appLE (g ⁻¹ᵁ U) V e (g.app U x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_appLE]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_map_appLE_apply
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_map_appLE_apply {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ Z) {U U' : Z.Opens} {V : Y.Opens}
    (e : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U) (i : op U' ⟶ op U) (x : Γ(Z, U')) :
    f.appLE U V e (Z.presheaf.map i x) =
      f.appLE U' V (e.trans ((Opens.map f.base).map i.unop).le) x
proof:
:= by
  have := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (Scheme.Hom.map_appLE f e i) x
  simpa only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] using this

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_p_toBase
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_p_toBase (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    tensorOverlap_p C i j c ≫ C.toBase =
      (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ≫ c.chartToAmbient
proof:
:= by
  change (tensorOverlap_gL C i j c ≫ C.chartι i) ≫ C.toBase = _
  refine (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans ?_
  refine (congrArg (fun f ↦ tensorOverlap_gL C i j c ≫ f) (C.chartι_toBase i)).trans ?_
  refine (congrArg (fun f ↦ f ≫ C.chartToAmbient i) (tensorOverlap_hκL C i j c).symm).trans ?_
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
    (congrArg (fun f ↦ (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ≫ f)
      c.chartToLeft_comp_chartToAmbient)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_p_toBase_le
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_p_toBase_le (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (⊤ : (C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).toScheme.Opens) ≤
      (tensorOverlap_p C i j c ≫ C.toBase) ⁻¹ᵁ c.affineOpen.1
proof:
:= by
  intro x _
  have h : (tensorOverlap_p C i j c) x ∈ (tensorOverlap_p C i j c) ''ᵁ ⊤ := ⟨x, trivial, rfl⟩
  rw [← tautQuotient_p_image_top] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_kscalar_eq
statement:
theorem tautQuotient_kscalar_eq (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) (a : Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)) :
    tautQuotient_kscalar C i j c a = c.chart.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (le_top : (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ ⊤)).op
      (tautChart_scal Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) a)
proof:
:= by
  let κ := (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom
  let p := tensorOverlap_p C i j c
  have hL : (p.appIso ⊤).hom (C.scheme.presheaf.map
      (eqToHom (congrArg op (tautQuotient_p_image_top C i j c))) (C.toBase.app c.affineOpen.1 a)) =
      (p ≫ C.toBase).appLE c.affineOpen.1 ⊤ (tautQuotient_p_toBase_le C i j c) a := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.appIso_hom', tautQuotient_map_appLE_apply]
    exact (tautQuotient_comp_appLE_apply p C.toBase _ _ _ a).symm
  have hR : (κ.appIso ⊤).hom (c.chart.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (le_top : κ ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ ⊤)).op
      (tautChart_scal Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) a)) =
      (κ ≫ intrinsicToSpec (R := Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)) (M := E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))).appLE
        ⊤ ⊤ (by simp) ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1))).inv a) := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.appIso_hom', tautQuotient_map_appLE_apply, tautQuotient_comp_appLE_apply]
    rfl
  have hM : (p ≫ C.toBase).appLE c.affineOpen.1 ⊤ (tautQuotient_p_toBase_le C i j c) a =
      (κ ≫ intrinsicToSpec (R := Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)) (M := E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))).appLE
        ⊤ ⊤ (by simp) ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1))).inv a) := by
    have e1 : p ≫ C.toBase = (κ ≫ intrinsicToSpec (R := Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1))
        (M := E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))) ≫ c.affineOpen.2.fromSpec := by
      rw [tautQuotient_p_toBase, Category.assoc]
      rfl
    rw [tautQuotient_appLE_congr e1 _ _ _ (by rw [← e1]; exact tautQuotient_p_toBase_le C i j c),
      tautQuotient_comp_appLE_apply]
    refine (congrArg (fun z ↦ (κ ≫ intrinsicToSpec (R := Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1))
      (M := E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))).appLE _ ⊤ (by simp) z)
      (IsAffineOpen.fromSpec_app_self_apply c.affineOpen.2 a)).trans ?_
    exact tautQuotient_map_appLE_apply _ _ _ _
  unfold tautQuotient_kscalar
  rw [hL, hM, ← hR, Iso.hom_inv_id_apply]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_hypLin

proof:
:= by

      (fun l a ↦ a • c.rightSectionBasis l) := by
    rw [← Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, c.rightSectionBasis.linearCombination_repr]
  refine (congrArg (fun m ↦ (tautChart_tautHom Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1) (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))
      c.rightSectionBasis m).app ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ''ᵁ ⊤)
      (1 : Γ(c.chart, (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ''ᵁ ⊤))) hk).trans ?_
  refine (tautChart_tautHom_app_sum _ _ c.rightSectionBasis _ _ _).trans ?_
  apply Finsupp.sum_congr
  intro l _
  rw [tautQuotient_kscalar_eq]
  rfl

name: KSpecialization.ARRG67.mono_of_injective_sections
statement:
theorem mono_of_injective_sections {M N : X.Modules} (f : M ⟶ N)

proof:

name: KSpecialization.ARRG67.mono_ap_sigmaT
statement:
theorem mono_ap_sigmaT {Λ : X.Modules} (s : Λ ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) (hs : Mono s)
    (E : X.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) :
    Mono (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor X Λ) (sigmaT Λ s) E)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits X E hE
  have hm : Mono ((tensorSheafRightFunctor X E).map s) :=
    preserves_mono_of_preservesLimit (tensorSheafRightFunctor X E) s
  have h1 : ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor X Λ) (sigmaT Λ s) E =
      tensorSheafMap X s (𝟙 E) ≫ (tensorSheafLeftUnitor X E).hom :=
    sigmaT_app_eq s E
  rw [h1, ← SchemeKTheory.ProjectionFormula.rightFunctor_map]
  have hu : Mono (tensorSheafLeftUnitor X E).hom := inferInstance
  exact @mono_comp _ _ _ _ _ _ hm _ hu

name: KSpecialization.ARRG67.hbc_cartier_ARRG67
statement:
theorem hbc_cartier_ARRG67 (hL : SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank Y L 1) (hreg : SectionIsRegular σ)
    [IsLocallyNoetherian (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme]
    {W : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian W] (F : W ⟶ Y) [IsFinite F]
    (hs : Mono (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ)))
    (V : W.Modules) (hV : IsCoherentLike W V) (hVfl : IsFiniteLocallyFree W V)
    (y : K0 Y) (hy : k0ToG0 Y y = finitePushforward F (g0ClassOf W V hV))
    {Wz : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian Wz] (η : Wz ⟶ W)
    (Fz : Wz ⟶ (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme) [IsFinite Fz]
    (hsq : Fz ≫ (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι = η ≫ F)
    (G : Wz.Modules) (hG : IsCoherentLike Wz G)
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward η).obj G ≅
      cokernel (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)))
        (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) V)) :
    k0ToG0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme
        (pullbackK0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι y) =
      finitePushforward Fz (g0ClassOf Wz G hG)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := mono_ap_pullbackSection σ F hs V hVfl
  exact hbc_cartier_AR7R σ hL
    (hmono_of_regular σ (isLocalLineFrame_of_hasConstantRank_one hL) hreg)
    F V hV y hy η Fz hsq G hG e

name: KSpecialization.ARRG67.hbc_cartier_ARRG67_fibre
statement:
theorem hbc_cartier_ARRG67_fibre (hL : SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank Y L 1)
    (hreg : SectionIsRegular σ)
    [IsLocallyNoetherian (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme]
    {W : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian W] (F : W ⟶ Y) [IsFinite F]
    (hs : Mono (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ)))
    (V : W.Modules) (hV : IsCoherentLike W V) (hVfl : IsFiniteLocallyFree W V)
    (y : K0 Y) (hy : k0ToG0 Y y = finitePushforward F (g0ClassOf W V hV))
    (hunit : IsIso (adjUnit (pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι)
      (cokernel (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)))
        (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) V)))) :
    ∃ (G : (pullback F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι).Modules)
      (hG : IsCoherentLike _ G),
      k0ToG0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme
        (pullbackK0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι y) =
      finitePushforward (pullback.snd F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι)
        (g0ClassOf _ G hG)
proof:
:= by
  have hΛ1 : SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank Y (lineBundleDual Y L) 1 :=
    lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank L hL
  have hΛW1 := SchemeKTheory.hasConstantRank_pullback W F _ 1 hΛ1
  have hΛW : IsFiniteLocallyFree W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)) :=
    hΛW1.isFiniteLocallyFree
  have hTV : IsCoherentLike W ((tensorSheafLeftFunctor W
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L))).obj V) :=
    tensorSheaf_isCoherentLike W _ _ hΛW hV
  have hE : IsCoherentLike W (cokernel (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)))
        (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) V)) :=
    (kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike (Y := W)).cokernel _ hTV hV
  haveI : (cokernel (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)))
        (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) V)).IsFinitePresentation := hE
  have hG := pullback_isFinitePresentation_global
    (pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι)
    (cokernel (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)))
        (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) V))
  refine ⟨_, hG, ?_⟩
  exact hbc_cartier_ARRG67 σ hL hreg F hs V hV hVfl y hy
    (pullback.fst F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι)
    (pullback.snd F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι)
    pullback.condition.symm _ hG (@asIso _ _ _ _ _ hunit).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.intrinsicZI_restrict_sectionOne
statement:
theorem intrinsicZI_restrict_sectionOne {Y V : Scheme.{u}} (j : V ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j] (L : Y.Modules) (σ : tensorUnitSheaf Y ⟶ L) (W : V.Opens) :
   Scheme.Modules.Hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso j).inv ≫ (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).map σ) W (1 : Γ(V,W)) = Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ (j ''ᵁ W) (1 : Γ(Y, j ''ᵁ W))
proof:
:= by
  change (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).map σ) W) (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso j).inv W (1 : Γ(V,W))) = _
  have h : Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso j).inv W (1 : Γ(V,W)) = (1 : Γ(Y, j ''ᵁ W)) := by
    change (j.appIso W).inv.hom 1 = 1
    exact map_one _
  rw [h]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.intrinsicZI_sectionAffineEvaluationIdeal_restrict
statement:
theorem intrinsicZI_sectionAffineEvaluationIdeal_restrict {Y V : Scheme.{u}} (j : V ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j] {L : Y.Modules} (σ : tensorUnitSheaf Y ⟶ L) (W : V.affineOpens) :
    (sectionAffineEvaluationIdeal σ ⟨j ''ᵁ W, W.2.image_of_isOpenImmersion j⟩).map (j.appIso W).hom.hom =
      sectionEvaluationIdeal (R := Γ(V,W)) (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso j).inv ≫ (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).map σ) W (1 : Γ(V,W)))
proof:
:= by
  let e : Γ(Y, j ''ᵁ W) ≃+* Γ(V,W) := (j.appIso W).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  letI := RingHomInvPair.of_ringEquiv e
  letI := RingHomInvPair.of_ringEquiv_symm e
  let f : Γ(L, j ''ᵁ W) ≃ₛₗ[(e : Γ(Y, j ''ᵁ W) →+* Γ(V,W))] Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor j).obj L, W) :=
    { toFun := fun x => x
      invFun := fun x => x
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun r x => by
        exact Scheme.Modules.smul_restrictAppIso_inv_apply j L W.1 r x
      left_inv := fun _ => rfl
      right_inv := fun _ => rfl }
  have := sectionEvaluationIdeal_semilinearEquiv e f (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ (j ''ᵁ W) (1 : Γ(Y, j ''ᵁ W)))
  rw [intrinsicZI_restrict_sectionOne]
  exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.intrinsicZI_pushedUnit_self_smul
statement:
theorem intrinsicZI_pushedUnit_self_smul {V : Scheme.{u}} (lo : V.Opens) (r : Γ(V, lo))
    (y : Γ(V, lo.ι ''ᵁ (lo.ι ⁻¹ᵁ lo))) :
    V.presheaf.map (eqToHom (intrinsicZI_image_preimage_self lo).symm).op
        ((show Γ(V, lo) →+* Γ(V, lo.ι ''ᵁ (lo.ι ⁻¹ᵁ lo)) from (lo.ι.app lo).hom) r * y) =
      r * V.presheaf.map (eqToHom (intrinsicZI_image_preimage_self lo).symm).op y
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_mul]
  congr 1
  have : (show Γ(V, lo) →+* Γ(V, lo.ι ''ᵁ (lo.ι ⁻¹ᵁ lo)) from (lo.ι.app lo).hom) r =
    V.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_of_eq (intrinsicZI_image_preimage_self lo))).op r := rfl
  rw [this, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.intrinsicZI_sectionEvaluationIdeal_pushedUnit_frame
proof:
:= by
  let e1 : (T.val.obj (op lo)) ≃ₗ[Γ(V, lo)] (Tw.val.obj (op lo)) :=
    ((SheafOfModules.evaluation V.ringCatSheaf (op lo)).mapIso i2).toLinearEquiv
  let e2 : (Tw.val.obj (op lo)) ≃ₗ[Γ(V, lo)] Γ(SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit V lo, lo) :=
    ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (V.ringCatSheaf.over lo) (op (Over.mk (𝟙 lo)))).mapIso
      (asIso (SheafOfModules.Hom.over comp lo))).toLinearEquiv
  let Φ := e1.trans (e2.trans (intrinsicZIPushedUnitSelfSectionEquiv lo))
  have h1 := (sectionEvaluationIdeal_linearEquiv Φ (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app G0 lo (1 : Γ(V, lo)))).symm
  refine h1.trans ((sectionEvaluationIdeal_eq_span_of_equiv (LinearEquiv.refl _ _) _).trans ?_)
  congr 2

      (1 : Γ(V, lo)) := Chow.C1Cap.unit_presheaf_map_one _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_originalCoordinateIntrinsicZeroIdeal_uniformChartZI
statement:
theorem rankTwo_originalCoordinateIntrinsicZeroIdeal_uniformChartZI
    (s : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X) (i : C.I)
    (k : PUnit.{u+1} ⊕ PUnit.{u+1}) :
    (rankTwo_originalCoordinateIntrinsicZeroIdeal C s).ideal
      ⟨C.chartι i ''ᵁ (rankTwoUniformLinearAffineOpenZI C i k).1,
        (rankTwoUniformLinearAffineOpenZI C i k).2.image_of_isOpenImmersion _⟩ =
      Ideal.span {((C.chartι i).appIso (rankTwoUniformLinearAffineOpenZI C i k).1).inv.hom
        ((C.chart i).presheaf.map (eqToHom (intrinsicZI_image_preimage_top
          (rankTwoUniformLinearAffineOpenZI C i k).1).symm).op
          (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
            (((Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso (C.chartι i)).inv ≫
              (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι i)).map
                ((Chow.C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso C.toBase).inv ≫
                  (Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).map s ≫ C.tautologicalQuotient) ≫
              (rankTwo_canonicalChartSplitBasisIso C i 1).hom) ≫
              twistingSheafBasisComponent Γ(X,C.U i)
                ((tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U i)))
                (rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis X (C.U i)) 1 k) ⊤ (1 : Γ((C.chart i), ⊤))))}
proof:
:= by
  let σ := (Chow.C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso C.toBase).inv ≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).map s ≫ C.tautologicalQuotient
  let W := rankTwoUniformLinearAffineOpenZI C i k
  have hL1 := intrinsicZI_sectionAffineEvaluationIdeal_restrict (C.chartι i) σ W
  have hiso : IsIso (SheafOfModules.Hom.over (twistingSheafBasisComponent Γ(X,C.U i)
      ((tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U i)))
      (rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis X (C.U i)) 1 k) W.1) :=
    twistingSheafBasisComponent_over_isIso_of_le _ _ _ 1 k le_rfl
  have hL2 := @intrinsicZI_sectionEvaluationIdeal_pushedUnit_frame _ W.1 _ _ (rankTwo_canonicalChartSplitBasisIso C i 1)
    (twistingSheafBasisComponent Γ(X,C.U i)
      ((tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U i)))
      (rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis X (C.U i)) 1 k) hiso
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso (C.chartι i)).inv ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι i)).map σ)
  have hL := hL1.trans hL2
  have hm := congrArg (Ideal.map ((C.chartι i).appIso W.1).inv.hom) hL
  rw [Ideal.map_map] at hm
  have hid : (((C.chartι i).appIso W.1).inv.hom.comp ((C.chartι i).appIso W.1).hom.hom) =
      RingHom.id _ := by
    ext x
    exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom ((C.chartι i).appIso W.1).hom_inv_id x
  rw [hid, Ideal.map_id, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton] at hm
  have haff := rankTwo_originalCoordinateIntrinsicZeroIdeal_affine C s
    ⟨C.chartι i ''ᵁ W.1, W.2.image_of_isOpenImmersion _⟩
  refine haff.trans (hm.trans ?_)
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_originalUniformLinearAffine_coversZI
statement:
theorem rankTwo_originalUniformLinearAffine_coversZI :
    ⨆ ik : C.I × (PUnit.{u+1} ⊕ PUnit.{u+1}),
      (⟨C.chartι ik.1 ''ᵁ (rankTwoUniformLinearAffineOpenZI C ik.1 ik.2).1,
        (rankTwoUniformLinearAffineOpenZI C ik.1 ik.2).2.image_of_isOpenImmersion _⟩ :
          C.scheme.affineOpens).1 = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro x _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1D.sandwichOn_push
statement:
theorem sandwichOn_push [Fact (Cl C.scheme)]
    [Fact (Cl (C.pullbackFrameCover g).scheme)] [IsProper g] {r : ℕ}
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = r + 1) (j : ℕ) :
    totalPushOn ops g ∘ₗ
        sandwichOn ops (C.pullbackFrameCover g) cp (C.pullbackFrameCover_card g hC) j =
      sandwichOn ops C cp hC j ∘ₗ totalPushOn ops g
proof:
:= by
  letI := pullbackProjectiveMap_isOver (k := k) C g
  haveI : IsProper (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) := pullbackProjectiveMap_isProper C g
  letI := C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos r))
  let D := C.pullbackFrameCover g
  let hD := C.pullbackFrameCover_card g hC
  letI := D.toBase_flat (D.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hD (Nat.succ_pos r))
  let PG := totalPushOn ops g
  let PF := totalPushOn ops (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g)
  let qC := totalPushOn ops C.toBase
  let qD := totalPushOn ops D.toBase
  let pC := totalPullOn ops C.toBase r (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC)
  let pD := totalPullOn ops D.toBase r (cp.projBundle_relDim D hD)
  have hq : PG ∘ₗ qD = qC ∘ₗ PF := by
    have h1 := cp.push_comp D.toBase g
    have h2 := cp.push_comp (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) C.toBase
    exact h1.symm.trans
      ((totalPushOn_congr ops (C.pullbackProjectiveMap_toBase g).symm).trans h2)
  have hxi : PF ∘ₗ xiCapOn ops D = xiCapOn ops C ∘ₗ PF := by
    rw [xiCapOn_pullbackFrameCover C g ops cp]
    exact cp.cap_push (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
      (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
  have hp : PF ∘ₗ ((xiCapOn ops D) ^ j) = ((xiCapOn ops C) ^ j) ∘ₗ PF :=
    (Module.End.commute_pow_left_of_commute hxi.symm j).symm
  have hb : pC ∘ₗ PG = PF ∘ₗ pD :=
    cp.base_change g C.toBase (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) D.toBase r
      (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC) (cp.projBundle_relDim D hD)
      (C.isPullback_pullbackProjectiveMap g).flip
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro α
  change PG (qD (((xiCapOn ops D) ^ j) (pD α))) = qC (((xiCapOn ops C) ^ j) (pC (PG α)))
  calc
    _ = qC (PF (((xiCapOn ops D) ^ j) (pD α))) := LinearMap.congr_fun hq _
    _ = qC (((xiCapOn ops C) ^ j) (PF (pD α))) :=
      congrArg qC (LinearMap.congr_fun hp (pD α))
    _ = _ := congrArg (fun z => qC (((xiCapOn ops C) ^ j) z)) (LinearMap.congr_fun hb α).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1D.segreOn_push
statement:
theorem segreOn_push [Fact (Cl C.scheme)]
    [Fact (Cl (C.pullbackFrameCover g).scheme)] [IsProper g] {r : ℕ}
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = r + 1) (i : ℕ) :
    totalPushOn ops g ∘ₗ
        segreOn ops (C.pullbackFrameCover g) cp (C.pullbackFrameCover_card g hC) i =
      segreOn ops C cp hC i ∘ₗ totalPushOn ops g
proof:
:=
  sandwichOn_push C g ops cp hC (r + i)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1D.chernOfCoverOn_push
statement:
theorem chernOfCoverOn_push [Fact (Cl C.scheme)]
    [Fact (Cl (C.pullbackFrameCover g).scheme)] [IsProper g] {r : ℕ}
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = r + 1) (i : ℕ) :
    totalPushOn ops g ∘ₗ
        chernOfCoverOn ops (C.pullbackFrameCover g) cp (C.pullbackFrameCover_card g hC) i =
      chernOfCoverOn ops C cp hC i ∘ₗ totalPushOn ops g
proof:
:= by
  have h := invOfUnit_coeff_intertwines (totalPushOn ops g)
    (segreOn ops (C.pullbackFrameCover g) cp (C.pullbackFrameCover_card g hC))
    (segreOn ops C cp hC)
    (fun j ↦ segreOn_push C g ops cp hC j) i
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro α
  simp only [chernOfCoverOn, segreSeriesOn, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul]
  exact congrArg (fun z ↦ ((-1 : ℚ) ^ i) • z) (LinearMap.congr_fun h α)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1D.chernOpOn'_push
statement:
theorem chernOpOn'_push (hP : ProjBundleClosedPos Cl) [IsProper g]
    (L : Y.Modules) (r : ℕ) (hL : HasConstantRank Y L r) (i : ℕ) :
    totalPushOn ops g ∘ₗ
        chernOpOn' ops cp hP ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj L) r
          (hasConstantRank_pullback X g L r hL) i =
      chernOpOn' ops cp hP L r hL i ∘ₗ totalPushOn ops g
proof:
:= by
  cases r with
  | zero =>
    by_cases hi : i = 0
    · simp only [chernOpOn', if_pos hi]
      change totalPushOn ops g ∘ₗ LinearMap.id = LinearMap.id ∘ₗ totalPushOn ops g
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_id, LinearMap.id_comp]
    · simp only [chernOpOn', if_neg hi, LinearMap.comp_zero, LinearMap.zero_comp]
  | succ r =>
    let C := (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hL).choose
    have hC := (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hL).choose_spec
    haveI : Fact (Cl C.scheme) := ⟨hP C hC⟩
    haveI : Fact (Cl (C.pullbackFrameCover g).scheme) :=
      ⟨hP (C.pullbackFrameCover g) (C.pullbackFrameCover_card g hC)⟩
    rw [chernOpOn'_eq_chernOfCoverOn ops cp hP C hL hC,
      chernOpOn'_eq_chernOfCoverOn ops cp hP (C.pullbackFrameCover g)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X g L (r + 1) hL) (C.pullbackFrameCover_card g hC)]
    exact chernOfCoverOn_push C g ops cp hC i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1D.cOp_push
statement:
theorem cOp_push (hP : ProjBundleClosedPos Cl) [IsProper g] [Nonempty X] [Nonempty Y]
    (L : Y.Modules) {r : ℕ} (hL : HasConstantRank Y L r) (i : ℕ) :
    totalPushOn ops g ∘ₗ
        constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj L) i =
      constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP Y L i ∘ₗ totalPushOn ops g
proof:

    constRankChernAssignOn'_eq ops cp hP _ r (hasConstantRank_pullback X g L r hL)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1D.projFormulaPi_ch
statement:
theorem projFormulaPi_ch (hP : ProjBundleClosedPos Cl) [IsProper g]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIL1D.projFormulaPi_chTrunc
statement:
theorem projFormulaPi_chTrunc (hP : ProjBundleClosedPos Cl) [IsProper g]

          (hasConstantRank_pullback X g L r hL)) n γ) =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range D, chOfChern r (chernOpOn' ops cp hP L r hL) n (totalPushOn ops g γ)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D19.regularTransitionFunction_pullbackFrame
statement:
theorem regularTransitionFunction_pullbackFrame (d : LineBundleLocalData X M x)
    (e : LineBundleLocalData X M x') (y y' : Y) (hy : f y ∈ d.U) (hy' : f y' ∈ e.U)
    (V : X.Opens) (hVd : V ≤ d.U) (hVe : V ≤ e.U) [Nonempty (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)] :
    (C1Cap.pullbackFrame f d y hy).regularTransitionFunction
        (C1Cap.pullbackFrame f e y' hy') =
      algebraMap Γ(Y, f ⁻¹ᵁ V) Y.functionField
        (f.app V (d.transitionSectionOver e V hVd hVe))
proof:
:= by
  have hW : Nonempty ((C1Cap.pullbackFrame f d y hy).U ⊓
      (C1Cap.pullbackFrame f e y' hy').U : Y.Opens) :=
    LineBundleLocalData.overlapNonempty _ _
  unfold LineBundleLocalData.regularTransitionFunction
  rw [C1Cap.transitionSection_pullbackFrame f d e y y' hy hy']
  have hle : f ⁻¹ᵁ V ≤ (C1Cap.pullbackFrame f d y hy).U ⊓ (C1Cap.pullbackFrame f e y' hy').U :=
    le_inf (f.preimage_mono hVd) (f.preimage_mono hVe)
  rw [LineBundleLocalData.algebraMap_functionField_restrict hle]
  congr 1
  rw [← d.transitionSection_restrict e V hVd hVe]
  have := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (f.naturality (homOfLE (le_inf hVd hVe)).op)
    (d.transitionSection e)
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at this
  exact this.symm

statement:
theorem diffFrame_U (ψ : tensorSheaf X L B ≅ A) {y : X} (F : LineBundleLocalData X L y)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D19.regularTransitionFunction_diffFrame
statement:
theorem regularTransitionFunction_diffFrame (ψ : tensorSheaf X L B ≅ A) {y y' : X}
    (F : LineBundleLocalData X L y) (F' : LineBundleLocalData X L y')
    (G : LineBundleLocalData X B y) (G' : LineBundleLocalData X B y') :
    (diffFrame ψ F G).regularTransitionFunction (diffFrame ψ F' G') =
      F.regularTransitionFunction F' * G.regularTransitionFunction G'
proof:
:= by
  unfold diffFrame
  rw [LineBundleLocalData.regularTransitionFunction_mapIso,
    LineBundleLocalData.tensor_regularTransitionFunction]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D19.transitionSectionOver_diffFrame
statement:
theorem transitionSectionOver_diffFrame (ψ : tensorSheaf X L B ≅ A) {y y' : X}
    (F : LineBundleLocalData X L y) (F' : LineBundleLocalData X L y')
    (G : LineBundleLocalData X B y) (G' : LineBundleLocalData X B y')
    (V : X.Opens) [Nonempty V]
    (hVd : V ≤ (diffFrame ψ F G).U) (hVe : V ≤ (diffFrame ψ F' G').U) :
    (diffFrame ψ F G).transitionSectionOver (diffFrame ψ F' G') V hVd hVe =
      F.transitionSectionOver F' V (hVd.trans inf_le_left) (hVe.trans inf_le_left) *
        G.transitionSectionOver G' V (hVd.trans inf_le_right) (hVe.trans inf_le_right)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := LineBundleLocalData.transitionSectionOver_eq_of_regularTransitionFunction_eq
    (diffFrame ψ F G) (diffFrame ψ F' G') ((F.tensor G).mapIso ψ) ((F'.tensor G').mapIso ψ)
    V hVd hVe hVd hVe rfl
  have h2 := LineBundleLocalData.transitionSectionOver_eq_of_regularTransitionFunction_eq
    ((F.tensor G).mapIso ψ) ((F'.tensor G').mapIso ψ) (F.tensor G) (F'.tensor G') V hVd hVe
    hVd hVe (LineBundleLocalData.regularTransitionFunction_mapIso _ _ ψ)
  refine h1.trans (h2.trans ?_)
  exact LineBundleLocalData.tensor_transitionSectionOver F F' G G' V _ _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D19.regularTransitionFunction_pullback_diffFrame
statement:
theorem regularTransitionFunction_pullback_diffFrame (ψ : tensorSheaf X L B ≅ A) {y y' : X}
    (F : LineBundleLocalData X L y) (F' : LineBundleLocalData X L y')
    (G : LineBundleLocalData X B y) (G' : LineBundleLocalData X B y') (z z' : Y)
    (hz : ι z ∈ (diffFrame ψ F G).U) (hz' : ι z' ∈ (diffFrame ψ F' G').U) :
    (C1Cap.pullbackFrame ι (diffFrame ψ F G) z hz).regularTransitionFunction
        (C1Cap.pullbackFrame ι (diffFrame ψ F' G') z' hz') =
      (C1Cap.pullbackFrame ι F z (hz.1)).regularTransitionFunction
          (C1Cap.pullbackFrame ι F' z' (hz'.1)) *
        (C1Cap.pullbackFrame ι G z (hz.2)).regularTransitionFunction
          (C1Cap.pullbackFrame ι G' z' (hz'.2))
proof:
:= by
  set V : X.Opens := (diffFrame ψ F G).U ⊓ (diffFrame ψ F' G').U with hV
  have hVd : V ≤ (diffFrame ψ F G).U := inf_le_left
  have hVe : V ≤ (diffFrame ψ F' G').U := inf_le_right
  haveI hne : Nonempty (ι ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
    LineBundleLocalData.overlapNonempty (C1Cap.pullbackFrame ι (diffFrame ψ F G) z hz)
      (C1Cap.pullbackFrame ι (diffFrame ψ F' G') z' hz')
  haveI : Nonempty V := by
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hne
    exact ⟨⟨ι p, hp⟩⟩
  rw [regularTransitionFunction_pullbackFrame ι _ _ z z' hz hz' V hVd hVe,
    regularTransitionFunction_pullbackFrame ι F F' z z' hz.1 hz'.1 V (hVd.trans inf_le_left)
      (hVe.trans inf_le_left),
    regularTransitionFunction_pullbackFrame ι G G' z z' hz.2 hz'.2 V (hVd.trans inf_le_right)
      (hVe.trans inf_le_right),
    transitionSectionOver_diffFrame ψ F F' G G' V hVd hVe, map_mul, map_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D19.pointCoord_compat
statement:
theorem pointCoord_compat {M : X.Modules} {a : C1Cap.LocalEquations X}
    (E : C1Cap.LocalEquationFrames M a) (v : X) (z z' : pointClosureScheme v) :
    C1Cap.pointCoord E v z' =
      C1Cap.pointCoord E v z *
        (C1Cap.pointFrame E v z).regularTransitionFunction (C1Cap.pointFrame E v z')
proof:
:= by
  rw [C1Cap.pointCoord_eq E v z', C1Cap.pointCoord_eq E v z, mul_assoc,
    ← LineBundleLocalData.regularTransitionFunction_cocycle (C1Cap.refFrame E v)
      (C1Cap.pointFrame E v z) (C1Cap.pointFrame E v z')]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D19.movingFrames_of_avoidingDifference
statement:
theorem movingFrames_of_avoidingDifference (L B A : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hB : HasConstantRank X B 1) (ψ : tensorSheaf X L B ≅ A) (n : ℕ)
    (hA : SectionsAvoidFinite A) (hBs : SectionsAvoidFinite B) : MovingFrames L n
proof:
:=
  fun g ↦ by
  haveI : NoetherianSpace g.Y := g.i.isClosedEmbedding.isInducing.noetherianSpace
  let F : ∀ y : X, LineBundleLocalData X L y :=
    fun y ↦ Scheme.Modules.lineBundleLocalDataAt X L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree
      (genericRank_eq_one_of_hasConstantRank hL) y
  let G : ∀ y : X, LineBundleLocalData X B y :=
    fun y ↦ Scheme.Modules.lineBundleLocalDataAt X B hB.isFiniteLocallyFree
      (genericRank_eq_one_of_hasConstantRank hB) y
  obtain ⟨F0, hFc, hFη, hF⟩ := exists_closed_not_isUnitAt g.f g.hf
  have hfin : {w : g.Y | coheight w = 1 ∧ ¬ IsUnitAt g.f w}.Finite :=
    (finite_coheight_one_of_isClosed hFc hFη).subset fun w ⟨h1, h2⟩ ↦
      ⟨by_contra fun hw ↦ h2 (hF w hw), h1⟩
  have hP : ({g.i (genericPoint g.Y)} ∪
      g.i '' {w : g.Y | coheight w = 1 ∧ ¬ IsUnitAt g.f w} : Set X).Finite :=
    (Set.finite_singleton _).union (hfin.image _)
  obtain ⟨sA, hsA⟩ := hA _ hP
  obtain ⟨sB, hsB⟩ := hBs _ hP
  have h₁ : IsProperForD g (diffEq₁ ψ F G sA) :=
    isProperForD_of_frames g (diffE₁ ψ F G sA)
      (hsA _ (Or.inl rfl) (diffFrame ψ (F _) (G _)))
      (fun w hw1 hw ↦ hsA _ (Or.inr ⟨w, ⟨hw1, hw⟩, rfl⟩) (diffFrame ψ (F _) (G _)))
  have h₂ : IsProperForD g (diffEq₂ G sB) :=
    isProperForD_of_frames g (diffE₂ G sB)
      (hsB _ (Or.inl rfl) (G _))
      (fun w hw1 hw ↦ hsB _ (Or.inr ⟨w, ⟨hw1, hw⟩, rfl⟩) (G _))
  refine ⟨_, _, h₁, h₂, fun x hx hne ↦ ?_⟩
  exact ⟨closureFramesDiff ψ F G sA sB x
    (fun z ↦ notMem_stalkPrime_of_proper g _ h₁ hne z)
    (fun z ↦ notMem_stalkPrime_of_proper g _ h₂ hne z)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D19.capDescends_of_avoidingDifference
statement:
theorem capDescends_of_avoidingDifference (L B A : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)

    (hA : SectionsAvoidFinite A) (hBs : SectionsAvoidFinite B) :

proof:
:=

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D19.capDescends_of_generatedDifference

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D19.projectiveTwisting_generated_nonneg
statement:
theorem projectiveTwisting_generated_nonneg (k : Type u) [Field k] (N : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (hd : 0 ≤ d)
    (hL : HasConstantRank (space k N) (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N d) 1) (q : space k N) :
    ∃ t : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k N d, ⊤),
      ∃ e : LineBundleLocalData (space k N) (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N d) q,
        IsUnit ((space k N).presheaf.germ e.U q e.mem (sectionCoordSec e t))
proof:
:= by
  have hq : q ∈ (⊤ : (space k N).Opens) := trivial
  rw [← coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top k N, TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup] at hq
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hq
  have key : ∃ φ : SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf (space k N) ⟶ projectiveTwistingSheaf k N d,
      IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen k N i).ι).map φ) := by
    induction d, hd using Int.leInduction with
    | base =>
      refine ⟨(projectiveTwistingZeroIso k N).inv, ?_⟩
      exact inferInstance
    | succ d hd ih =>
      obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := ih (hasConstantRank_twist N d)
      refine ⟨φ ≫ Koszul.X k N i d, ?_⟩
      rw [Functor.map_comp]
      haveI := hφ
      haveI := Koszul.X_restrict_isIso k N i d
      exact IsIso.comp_isIso
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := key
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := Scheme.Modules.exists_lineBundleLocalDataAt (space k N) _
    hL.isFiniteLocallyFree (genericRank_eq_one_of_hasConstantRank hL) q
  exact ⟨_, e, isUnit_germ_coord_of_surj _ (coordinateOpen k N i)
    (fun W hW m ↦ surj_of_isIso_restrict φ _ hφ W hW m) hi e⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.eulerChartMap_nonpivot
statement:
theorem eulerChartMap_nonpivot (a : Fin (n + 1)) (j : AffineChartIndex n a) :
    eulerChartMap R n a j.1 =
      SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.coframe _ (cotangentChartIso R n a)
        (ULift.up j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Cotangent.overHom_ext_of_frame (cotangentChartFrame R n a)
    (coordinateOpen_isAffine R n a) (cotangentChartFrame_bijective R n a)
  intro k
  calc
    _ = eulerChartCoeff R n a j.1 k := eulerChartMap_frame R n a j.1 k
    _ = (if k = ULift.up j then (1 : Γ(space R n, coordinateOpen R n a)) else 0) := by
      have heq : k.down.1 = j.1 ↔ k = ULift.up j := by
        constructor
        · intro h
          cases k with
          | up k => exact congrArg ULift.up (Subtype.ext h)
        · intro h
          cases h
          rfl
      simp [eulerChartCoeff, j.2, heq]
    _ = _ := (Cotangent.coframe_sheafifyUnitApp (cotangentChartFrame R n a)
      (coordinateOpen_isAffine R n a) (cotangentChartFrame_bijective R n a) k (ULift.up j)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoK_appLE_restrict_top
statement:

    (s : Γ(Y, W)) :

      (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUW).op s) =
    X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op

proof:

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.m7geoK_stdChart_coordinateRatio_section
statement:
theorem m7geoK_stdChart_coordinateRatio_section (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (n : ℕ) {c : Fin (n + 1)} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_stdChart R n 0).appLE
      (coordinateOpen R n 0) ⊤
      (show (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of
        (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n 0) R))).Opens) ≤
          AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_stdChart R n 0 ⁻¹ᵁ
            coordinateOpen R n 0 by
        intro x _
        change AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_stdChart R n 0 x ∈
          (coordinateOpen R n 0 : Set _)
        rw [← AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_range_stdChart]
        exact ⟨x, rfl⟩)
      (Proj.awayToSection (grading R n) (coordinate R n 0)
        (coordinateRatio R n 0 ⟨c, hc⟩)) =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of
        (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n 0) R))).inv
        (MvPolynomial.X ⟨c, hc⟩)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of
      (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n 0) R))).inv
    (m7geoJ_stdChart_coordinateRatio R n hc)
  simpa only [Iso.hom_inv_id_apply] using h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.m7geoK_stdChart_coordinateRatio_restricted
statement:
theorem m7geoK_stdChart_coordinateRatio_restricted (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (n : ℕ) {c : Fin (n + 1)} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_stdChart R n 0).appLE
      (coordinateOverlapOpen R n 0 c)
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_stdChart R n 0 ⁻¹ᵁ
        coordinateOverlapOpen R n 0 c) le_rfl
      ((space R n).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (show coordinateOverlapOpen R n 0 c ≤
          coordinateOpen R n 0 by
          rw [coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
          exact inf_le_left)).op
        (Proj.awayToSection (grading R n) (coordinate R n 0)
          (coordinateRatio R n 0 ⟨c, hc⟩))) =
      (Spec (CommRingCat.of (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n 0) R))).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE le_top).op
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of
          (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n 0) R))).inv
          (MvPolynomial.X ⟨c, hc⟩))
proof:
:= by
  have hUW : coordinateOverlapOpen R n 0 c ≤ coordinateOpen R n 0 := by
    rw [coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf]
    exact inf_le_left
  have hW : (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of
      (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n 0) R))).Opens) ≤
        AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_stdChart R n 0 ⁻¹ᵁ
          coordinateOpen R n 0 := by
    intro x _
    change AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_stdChart R n 0 x ∈
      (coordinateOpen R n 0 : Set _)
    rw [← AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_range_stdChart]
    exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
  have h := AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoK_appLE_restrict_top
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_stdChart R n 0)
    (coordinateOpen R n 0) (coordinateOverlapOpen R n 0 c)
    hUW hW
    (Proj.awayToSection (grading R n) (coordinate R n 0)
      (coordinateRatio R n 0 ⟨c, hc⟩))
  rw [m7geoK_stdChart_coordinateRatio_section R n hc] at h
  exact h
