name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.AcyclicGeneration.downward
statement:
theorem downward {B M : Type*} [CommRing B] [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] (S : AddSubgroup M)
    (A : Set B) (hA : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ s ∈ S, a • s ∈ S) (ζ : Bˣ) (r : ℕ) (a : ℕ → B)
    (ha : ∀ k < r, a k ∈ A)
    (hrel : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range r, a k * (ζ : B) ^ (r - k) = 1) (x : M) (m₀ : ℤ)
    (hx : ∀ t : ℤ, m₀ ≤ t → ((ζ ^ t : Bˣ) : B) • x ∈ S) :
    ∀ t : ℤ, ((ζ ^ t : Bˣ) : B) • x ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  suffices H : ∀ d : ℕ, ∀ t : ℤ, m₀ - d ≤ t → ((ζ ^ t : Bˣ) : B) • x ∈ S by
    intro t
    exact H (m₀ - t).toNat t (by omega)
  intro d
  induction d with
  | zero => intro t ht; exact hx t (by simpa using ht)
  | succ d ih =>
    intro t ht
    by_cases h : m₀ - d ≤ t
    · exact ih t h
    have key : ((ζ ^ t : Bˣ) : B) • x =
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range r, a k • (((ζ ^ (t + ((r - k : ℕ) : ℤ)) : Bˣ) : B) • x) := by
      calc ((ζ ^ t : Bˣ) : B) • x = (1 : B) • (((ζ ^ t : Bˣ) : B) • x) := (one_smul _ _).symm
        _ = _ := by
          rw [← hrel, Finset.sum_smul]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ ?_
          rw [zpow_add, Units.val_mul, zpow_natCast, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val,
            mul_comm (((ζ ^ t : Bˣ) : B))]
          simp only [mul_smul]
    rw [key]
    refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun k hk ↦ ?_
    have hk' : k < r := Finset.mem_range.1 hk
    exact hA _ (ha k hk') _ (ih _ (by omega))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.AcyclicGeneration.rel_aux
statement:
theorem rel_aux {B : Type*} [CommRing B] (r : ℕ) (lam : ℕ → B) (z v : B)
    (hk : ∑ x ∈ Finset.range r, (-1 : B) ^ x * lam x * z ^ (r - x) + (-1) ^ r * lam r = 0)
    (huv : lam r * v = 1) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range r, -(-1 : B) ^ r * v * ((-1) ^ k * lam k) * z ^ (r - k) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : ((-1 : B) ^ r) * (-1) ^ r = 1 := by
    rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num
  have h1 : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range r, -(-1 : B) ^ r * v * ((-1) ^ k * lam k) * z ^ (r - k) =
      -(-1 : B) ^ r * v * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range r, (-1 : B) ^ k * lam k * z ^ (r - k) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ ↦ ?_
    ring
  rw [h1]
  linear_combination (-(-1 : B) ^ r * v) * hk + (v * lam r) * hsq + huv

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.AcyclicGeneration.pullback_mem_mulRing
statement:
theorem pullback_mem_mulRing (V : X.Modules) (hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree X V)
    (hLV : ∀ G : C.scheme.Modules, IsCoherentLike C.scheme G → IsPAcyclic C G →
      IsPAcyclic C (tensorSheaf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj V) G)) :
    k0ClassOf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj V)
      (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global C.toBase V hV) ∈ mulRing C
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  let b := k0ClassOf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj V)
      (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global C.toBase V hV)
  have hle : acycSub C ≤ (acycSub C).comap (k0ActG0 C.scheme b) := by
    rw [acycSub, AddSubgroup.closure_le]
    rintro _ ⟨G, hG, rfl⟩
    show b • g0ClassOf C.scheme G.1 G.2 ∈ acycSub C
    rw [k0ClassOf_smul_g0ClassOf]
    exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨⟨_, _⟩, hLV G.1 G.2 hG, rfl⟩
  exact hle hs

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.AcyclicGeneration.additive_free_isZero
statement:
theorem additive_free_isZero {Y : Scheme.{u}} {D : Type*} [Category D] [Preadditive D]
    (Φ : Y.Modules ⥤ D) [Φ.Additive]
    (hunit : IsZero (Φ.obj (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf))) (J : Type u) [Finite J] :
    IsZero (Φ.obj (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J))
proof:
:= by
  have hbin : ∀ A B : Y.Modules, IsZero (Φ.obj A) → IsZero (Φ.obj B) →
      IsZero (Φ.obj (A ⊞ B)) := by
    intro A B hA hB
    rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero, ← Φ.map_id, ← biprod.total, Φ.map_add, Φ.map_comp, Φ.map_comp,
      hA.eq_of_src (Φ.map biprod.inl) 0, hB.eq_of_src (Φ.map biprod.inr) 0, comp_zero, comp_zero,
      add_zero]
  have hiso : ∀ {α β : Type u}, α ≃ β →
      IsZero (Φ.obj (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) α)) →
      IsZero (Φ.obj (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) β)) := fun e h ↦
    h.of_iso (Φ.mapIso ((SheafOfModules.freeFunctor (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)).mapIso e.toIso)).symm
  have hpu : IsZero (Φ.obj (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) PUnit.{u + 1})) :=
    hunit.of_iso (Φ.mapIso (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit))
  refine Finite.induction_empty_option
    (P := fun α ↦ IsZero (Φ.obj (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) α))) ?_ ?_ ?_ J
  · intro α β e h
    exact hiso e h
  · exact hiso (Equiv.equivOfIsEmpty (ULift.{u} Empty) PEmpty)
      (Φ.map_isZero (SheafOfModules.freeEmptyIsZero (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)))
  · intro α _ h
    exact hiso (Equiv.optionEquivSumPUnit α).symm
      ((hbin _ _ h hpu).of_iso (Φ.mapIso (freeBinaryIso Y α PUnit.{u + 1})).symm)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.AcyclicGeneration.free_tensor_higher_isZero
statement:
theorem free_tensor_higher_isZero {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ Z) (q : ℕ) (G : Y.Modules)
    (hG : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f G q)) (J : Type u) [Finite J] :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f
      (tensorSheaf Y (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J) G) q)
proof:
:= by
  let Φ := tensorSheafRightFunctor Y G ⋙ affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor f q
  haveI : Φ.Additive := by dsimp only [Φ]; infer_instance
  show IsZero (Φ.obj (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) J))
  refine additive_free_isZero Φ ?_ J
  have e : Φ.obj (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf) ≅
      affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification f G q :=
    (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationFunctor f q).mapIso (tensorSheafLeftUnitor Y G)
  exact hG.of_iso e

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.AcyclicGeneration.pAcyclic_pullback_tensor
statement:
theorem pAcyclic_pullback_tensor {N : ℕ} (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N)
    (V : X.Modules)
    (hVfree : ∀ i, Nontrivial Γ(X, C.U i) → ∃ (J : Type u) (_ : Finite J),
      Nonempty (V.over (C.U i) ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over (C.U i)) J))
    (G : C.scheme.Modules) (hG : IsPAcyclic C G) :
    IsPAcyclic C (tensorSheaf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj V) G)
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq
  refine BundleQuillen.isZero_of_restrict _ (fun i : C.I ↦ Spec Γ(X, C.U i))
    (fun i ↦ (C.isAffine i).fromSpec) ?_ ?_
  · intro y
    have hy : y ∈ (⨆ i, C.U i : X.Opens) := by
      rw [C.covers]
      trivial
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.1 hy
    have hy' : y ∈ Set.range (C.isAffine i).fromSpec := by
      rw [(C.isAffine i).range_fromSpec]
      exact hi
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hy'
    exact ⟨i, z, hz⟩
  intro i
  obtain ⟨n, -, -, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hrank i
  refine IsZero.of_iso ?_ (BundleHDI.chartIso C i e _ q)
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial Γ(X, C.U i) with hsub | hnt
  · refine affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification_isZero_of_isBasis _ _ _
      (B := (∅ : Set (Spec Γ(X, C.U i)).Opens)) ?_ (by simp)
    rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd]
    intro U x _
    exfalso
    have hx : (x : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, C.U i)).asIdeal = ⊤ :=
      (Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).2 (by rw [Subsingleton.elim (1 : Γ(X, C.U i)) 0]; exact zero_mem _)
    exact (x : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, C.U i)).isPrime.ne_top hx
  · obtain ⟨J, hJ, ⟨eV⟩⟩ := hVfree i hnt
    let ψ := standardChartEmb C i e
    let π := SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n
    have hG' : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification π
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ψ).obj G) q) :=
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.isAffine i).fromSpec).map_isZero (hG q hq)).of_iso
        (BundleHDI.chartIso C i e G q).symm
    let iso : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ψ).obj
          (tensorSheaf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj V) G) ≅
        tensorSheaf _
          (SheafOfModules.free (R := (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space Γ(X, C.U i) n).ringCatSheaf) J)
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ψ).obj G) :=
      restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso ψ _ _ ≪≫
        tensorSheafMapIso _ (K0Basis.chartPullbackIso C i e V ≪≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback π).mapIso (restrictFromSpecFreeIso C i V J eV) ≪≫
          pullbackFreeIso π J) (Iso.refl _)
    exact SchemeProjectiveSpace.Quillen.R_iso _ n iso.symm q
      (free_tensor_higher_isZero π q _ hG' J)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.AcyclicGeneration.exteriorPower_over_free
statement:
theorem exteriorPower_over_free (i : C.I) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ (J : Type u) (_ : Finite J), Nonempty ((exteriorPowerSheaf X E k).over (C.U i) ≅
      SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over (C.U i)) J)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := C.basisIndex_finite i
  obtain ⟨m, ⟨e⟩⟩ := Finite.exists_equiv_fin (C.basisIndex i)
  letI : LinearOrder (C.basisIndex i) := LinearOrder.lift' e e.injective
  exact ⟨Set.powersetCard (C.basisIndex i) k, inferInstance,
    ⟨(exteriorPowerSheafOverIso X (C.U i) E k).symm ≪≫
      exteriorPowerSheafOverMapIso X (C.U i) (C.frame i).symm k ≪≫
      exteriorPowerSheafOverFreeIso X (C.U i) (C.basisIndex i) k⟩⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.AcyclicGeneration.det_over_unit
statement:
theorem det_over_unit {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) (i : C.I)
    (hnt : Nontrivial Γ(X, C.U i)) :
    Nonempty ((exteriorPowerSheaf X E r).over (C.U i) ≅
      (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).over (C.U i))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := C.basisIndex_finite i
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite (C.basisIndex i)
  obtain ⟨m, ⟨e⟩⟩ := Finite.exists_equiv_fin (C.basisIndex i)
  letI : LinearOrder (C.basisIndex i) := LinearOrder.lift' e e.injective
  obtain ⟨y⟩ : Nonempty (Spec Γ(X, C.U i)) := PrimeSpectrum.nonempty_iff_nontrivial.2 hnt
  have hx : (C.isAffine i).fromSpec y ∈ C.U i := by
    change (C.isAffine i).fromSpec y ∈ ((C.U i : X.Opens) : Set X)
    rw [← (C.isAffine i).range_fromSpec]
    exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
  have hcard := BundleQuillen.card_eq C hE i _ hx
  have hc : Fintype.card (C.basisIndex i) = r := by rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hcard]
  haveI : Unique (Set.powersetCard (C.basisIndex i) r) :=
    { default := ⟨Finset.univ, Set.powersetCard.mem_iff.2 (by rw [Finset.card_univ, hc])⟩
      uniq := fun t ↦ Subtype.ext
        (Finset.eq_univ_of_card _ (by rw [Set.powersetCard.mem_iff.1 t.2, hc])) }
  obtain ⟨J, hJ, ⟨eΛ⟩⟩ := exteriorPower_over_free C i r
  exact ⟨(exteriorPowerSheafOverIso X (C.U i) E r).symm ≪≫
      exteriorPowerSheafOverMapIso X (C.U i) (C.frame i).symm r ≪≫
      exteriorPowerSheafOverFreeIso X (C.U i) (C.basisIndex i) r ≪≫
      (SheafOfModules.freeFunctor (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over (C.U i))).mapIso
        (Equiv.ofUnique (Set.powersetCard (C.basisIndex i) r) PUnit.{u + 1}).toIso ≪≫
      SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over (C.U i))⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.AcyclicGeneration.dual_over_free
statement:
theorem dual_over_free {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) (i : C.I)
    (hnt : Nontrivial Γ(X, C.U i)) :
    ∃ (J : Type u) (_ : Finite J),
      Nonempty ((lineBundleDual X (exteriorPowerSheaf X E r)).over (C.U i) ≅
        SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over (C.U i)) J)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨eL⟩ := det_over_unit C hE i hnt
  haveI := LineBundleDual.dualTriv_isIso eL
  exact ⟨PUnit.{u + 1}, inferInstance, ⟨(asIso (LineBundleDual.dualTriv eL)).symm ≪≫
    (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over (C.U i))).symm⟩⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.AcyclicGeneration.k0ClassOf_mul_lineBundleDual
statement:
theorem k0ClassOf_mul_lineBundleDual (Y : Scheme.{u}) (L : Y.Modules)
    (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1)
    (hD : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y (lineBundleDual Y L)) :
    k0ClassOf Y L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree * k0ClassOf Y (lineBundleDual Y L) hD = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, -, hcard⟩ := id hL
  letI := hq
  let e := fun i ↦ (LineBundleDual.exists_triv L q hcard i).some
  let T := tensorLineBundleDualIso L q.X q.coversTop e
  have hLD := tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree Y L (lineBundleDual Y L)
    hL.isFiniteLocallyFree hD
  have hmul := k0ClassOf_mul Y ⟨L, hL.isFiniteLocallyFree⟩ ⟨lineBundleDual Y L, hD⟩
  change k0ClassOf Y L _ * k0ClassOf Y (lineBundleDual Y L) hD =
    k0ClassOf Y (tensorSheaf Y L (lineBundleDual Y L)) hLD at hmul
  rw [hmul]
  exact k0ClassOf_iso Y hLD (tensorUnitSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree Y) T

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.AcyclicGeneration.classOf_mem_acycSub
statement:
theorem classOf_mem_acycSub [IsNoetherian X] {N : ℕ} (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N) {r : ℕ}
    (hr : 0 < r) (hE : HasConstantRank X E r)
    (F : {M : C.scheme.Modules // IsCoherentLike C.scheme M}) :
    ExactGrothendieck.classOf _
      (ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn C.scheme.Modules (IsCoherentLike C.scheme)) F ∈
      acycSub C
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i) := fun i ↦ by
    obtain ⟨n, -, -, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hrank i
    exact ⟨e.symm 0⟩
  letI : Flat C.toBase := C.toBase_flat hpos
  have hEfl := hE.isFiniteLocallyFree
  have hpb : ∀ (V : X.Modules) (hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree X V),
      C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos (k0ClassOf X V hV) =
        k0ClassOf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj V)
          (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global C.toBase V hV) := by
    intro V hV
    change flatPullbackK0RingHom C.toBase (k0ClassOf X V hV) = _
    rw [flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply, flatPullbackK0_classOf]
  have hmemV : ∀ (V : X.Modules) (hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree X V),
      (∀ i, Nontrivial Γ(X, C.U i) → ∃ (J : Type u) (_ : Finite J),
        Nonempty (V.over (C.U i) ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over (C.U i)) J)) →
      C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos (k0ClassOf X V hV) ∈ mulRing C := by
    intro V hV hfree
    rw [hpb]
    exact pullback_mem_mulRing C V hV (fun G _ hG ↦ pAcyclic_pullback_tensor C hrank V hfree G hG)
  let lam : ℕ → K0 C.scheme := fun k ↦ C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos (lambdaClass X E hEfl k)
  have hlam : ∀ k, lam k ∈ mulRing C := fun k ↦
    hmemV _ _ (fun i _ ↦ exteriorPower_over_free C i k)
  have hL : HasConstantRank X (exteriorPowerSheaf X E r) 1 :=
    hasConstantRank_exteriorPowerSheaf_top X E r hE
  have hD : IsFiniteLocallyFree X (lineBundleDual X (exteriorPowerSheaf X E r)) :=
    (lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank _ hL).isFiniteLocallyFree
  let v := C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos (k0ClassOf X _ hD)
  have hv : v ∈ mulRing C := hmemV _ hD (fun i hnt ↦ dual_over_free C hE i hnt)
  have huv : lam r * v = 1 := by
    change C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos (lambdaClass X E hEfl r) *
      C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos (k0ClassOf X _ hD) = 1
    rw [← map_mul, ← map_one (C.projectiveBundlePullbackK0 hpos)]
    congr 1
    exact k0ClassOf_mul_lineBundleDual X _ hL hD
  let ζ := C.tautologicalK0Unit hpos
  have hk := C.k0_relation_koszul hpos hr hE
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, mul_one] at hk
  change ∑ x ∈ Finset.range r, (-1 : K0 C.scheme) ^ x * lam x * C.tautologicalK0Class ^ (r - x) +
    (-1) ^ r * lam r = 0 at hk
  let a : ℕ → K0 C.scheme := fun k ↦ -(-1 : K0 C.scheme) ^ r * v * ((-1) ^ k * lam k)
  have ha : ∀ k < r, a k ∈ (mulRing C : Set (K0 C.scheme)) := fun k _ ↦
    Subring.mul_mem _ (Subring.mul_mem _ (Subring.neg_mem _ (Subring.pow_mem _
      (Subring.neg_mem _ (Subring.one_mem _)) _)) hv)
      (Subring.mul_mem _ (Subring.pow_mem _ (Subring.neg_mem _ (Subring.one_mem _)) _) (hlam k))
  have hrel : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range r, a k * (ζ : K0 C.scheme) ^ (r - k) = 1 := by
    rw [tautologicalK0Unit_val]
    exact rel_aux r lam C.tautologicalK0Class v hk huv
  
  haveI : F.1.IsFinitePresentation := F.2
  obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀⟩ := exists_higherDirectImage_twist_isZero C hpos F.1
  have hFt : ∀ t : ℤ, IsCoherentLike C.scheme (twist C F.1 t) := fun t ↦
    (SheafOfModules.isFinitePresentation C.scheme.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
      (tensorSheafSymmetry C.scheme _ _)
      (tensorSheaf_isCoherentLike C.scheme _ F.1
        (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree t) F.2)
  have htw : ∀ t : ℤ, ((ζ ^ t : (K0 C.scheme)ˣ) : K0 C.scheme) • g0ClassOf C.scheme F.1 F.2 =
      g0ClassOf C.scheme (twist C F.1 t) (hFt t) := by
    intro t
    rw [← C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_eq_zpow hpos t]
    change k0ClassOf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf t)
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree t) • _ = _
    rw [k0ClassOf_smul_g0ClassOf]
    exact g0ClassOf_iso C.scheme _ _ (tensorSheafSymmetry C.scheme _ _)
  have hx : ∀ t : ℤ, m₀ ≤ t →
      ((ζ ^ t : (K0 C.scheme)ˣ) : K0 C.scheme) • g0ClassOf C.scheme F.1 F.2 ∈ acycSub C := by
    intro t ht
    rw [htw t]
    exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨⟨twist C F.1 t, hFt t⟩, hm₀ t ht, rfl⟩
  have H := downward (acycSub C) (mulRing C)
    (fun b hb s hs ↦ (hb : ∀ s ∈ acycSub C, b • s ∈ acycSub C) s hs) ζ r a ha hrel
    (g0ClassOf C.scheme F.1 F.2) m₀ hx 0
  rw [zpow_zero, Units.val_one, one_smul] at H
  exact H

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.AcyclicGeneration.classOf_mem_closure_acyclic
statement:
theorem classOf_mem_closure_acyclic [IsNoetherian X] {N : ℕ} (hrank : C.RankBetweenTwoAnd N)
    {r : ℕ}
    (hr : 0 < r) (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    ∀ F, ExactGrothendieck.classOf _
        (ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn C.scheme.Modules (IsCoherentLike C.scheme)) F ∈
      AddSubgroup.closure {z | ∃ G,
        (∀ i, 0 < i →
          IsZero ((projectiveBundleHigherDirectImageLongExactSystem hrank).higher G i)) ∧
        ExactGrothendieck.classOf _
          (ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn C.scheme.Modules (IsCoherentLike C.scheme)) G = z}
proof:
:=
  fun F ↦ classOf_mem_acycSub C hrank hr hE F

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackK0RingHom_adams
statement:
theorem pullbackK0RingHom_adams (k : ℕ) (x : K0 Z) :
    pullbackK0RingHom f (adams Z k x) = adams W k (pullbackK0RingHom f x)
proof:
:=
  adams_pullback f (pullbackK0RingHom f) (pullbackK0RingHom_classOf f) k x

name: SchemeKTheory.pullbackK0RingHom_bottBundle
statement:
theorem pullbackK0RingHom_bottBundle (j : ℕ) (E : Z.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree Z E)
    (r : ℕ) :
    pullbackK0RingHom f (bottBundle j E hE r) =
      bottBundle j ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E)
        (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global f E hE) r
proof:
:= by
  rw [bottBundle, bottBundle, ringHom_aeval]
  congr 2
  funext i
  exact lambdaClass_pullback_of f _ (pullbackK0RingHom_classOf f) E hE _

name: SchemeKTheory.bott_pullbackK0
statement:
theorem bott_pullbackK0 (j : ℕ) [IsNoetherian W] [IsNoetherian Z]
    (hrankW : ConstantRankGenerators W) (hnilW : LambdaNilpotent W)
    (hrankZ : ConstantRankGenerators Z) (hnilZ : LambdaNilpotent Z) (a : K0 Z) :
    locMap (j := j) (pullbackK0RingHom f)
        ((bott j Z hrankZ hnilZ (Multiplicative.ofAdd a) : (KLoc j Z)ˣ) : KLoc j Z) =
      ((bott j W hrankW hnilW (Multiplicative.ofAdd (pullbackK0RingHom f a)) :
        (KLoc j W)ˣ) : KLoc j W)
proof:
:=
  (bott_pull j f (pullbackK0RingHom f) (pullbackK0RingHom_classOf f) (locMap (pullbackK0RingHom f))
    (fun a ↦ locMap_algebraMap _ a) hrankW hnilW hrankZ hnilZ a).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.IsLineClass.one
statement: theorem IsLineClass.one : IsLineClass Y 1
proof: := ⟨_, hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf, rfl⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.IsLineClass.mul
statement:
theorem IsLineClass.mul {c d : K0 Y} (hc : IsLineClass Y c) (hd : IsLineClass Y d) :
    IsLineClass Y (c * d)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, hL, rfl⟩ := hc
  obtain ⟨M, hM, rfl⟩ := hd
  obtain ⟨h, he⟩ := classOf_mul_rankOne hL hM
  exact ⟨_, h, he⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.IsLineClass.adams
statement:
theorem IsLineClass.adams {c : K0 Y} (hc : IsLineClass Y c) (k : ℕ) :
    SchemeKTheory.adams Y (k + 1) c = c ^ (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, hL, rfl⟩ := hc
  exact adams_classOf_rankOne Y L hL k

name: SchemeKTheory.adams_mul_prod_one_sub
statement:
theorem adams_mul_prod_one_sub {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (ℓ : ι → K0 Y)
    (hℓ : ∀ i ∈ s, IsLineClass Y (ℓ i)) (k : ℕ) :
    ∀ c : K0 Y, IsLineClass Y c →
      adams Y (k + 1) (c * ∏ i ∈ s, (1 - ℓ i)) = c ^ (k + 1) * ∏ i ∈ s, (1 - ℓ i ^ (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    intro c hc
    simp only [Finset.prod_empty, mul_one]
    exact hc.adams k
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    intro c hc
    have ih' := ih (fun i hi ↦ hℓ i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))
    have hla := hℓ a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)
    rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.prod_insert ha]
    have e1 : c * ((1 - ℓ a) * ∏ i ∈ s, (1 - ℓ i)) =
        c * ∏ i ∈ s, (1 - ℓ i) + -((c * ℓ a) * ∏ i ∈ s, (1 - ℓ i)) := by
      simp only [sub_eq_add_neg]; ring
    rw [e1, map_add, map_neg, ih' c hc, ih' (c * ℓ a) (hc.mul hla)]
    simp only [sub_eq_add_neg]
    ring

name: SchemeKTheory.adams_lambdaMinusOne_bottBundle
statement:
theorem adams_lambdaMinusOne_bottBundle {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (V : X.Modules) {r : ℕ}
    (hV : HasConstantRank X V r) (k : ℕ) :
    adams X (k + 1) (lambdaMinusOne V hV) =
      bottBundle (k + 1) V hV.isFiniteLocallyFree r * lambdaMinusOne V hV
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let T := flagTower r V hV
  have hinj : Function.Injective (flatPullbackK0RingHom T.q) := by
    have h := splitting_injective pbInjectiveHyp hV
    intro a b hab
    apply h
    simpa using hab
  apply hinj
  have hL : ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin r)),
      IsLineClass T.Y (k0ClassOf T.Y (T.L i) (T.rankOne i).isFiniteLocallyFree) :=
    fun i _ ↦ ⟨_, T.rankOne i, rfl⟩
  have key := adams_mul_prod_one_sub Finset.univ _ hL k 1 IsLineClass.one
  rw [one_mul, one_pow, one_mul] at key
  rw [map_mul, pull_lambdaMinusOne_flagTower T hV, flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply,
    flatPullbackK0_adams, ← flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply, pull_lambdaMinusOne_flagTower T hV,
    flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply,
    flatPullbackK0_bottBundle (k + 1) T.q V hV.isFiniteLocallyFree _ (T.lambda_eq _), key,
    ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
  have h := ARR.one_sub_pow_eq_geom_mul (k0ClassOf T.Y (T.L i) (T.rankOne i).isFiniteLocallyFree)
    (k + 1)
  simp only [sub_eq_add_neg] at h ⊢
  exact h

name: SchemeKTheory.adams_lambdaMinusOne_lib
statement:
theorem adams_lambdaMinusOne_lib {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    (hrank : ConstantRankGenerators X) (hnil : LambdaNilpotent X) (V : X.Modules) {r : ℕ}
    (hV : HasConstantRank X V r) :
    algebraMap (K0 X) (KLoc j X) (adamsRingHom hrank j (lambdaMinusOne V hV)) =
      ((bott j X hrank hnil (Multiplicative.ofAdd (k0ClassOf X V hV.isFiniteLocallyFree)) :
        (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X) * algebraMap (K0 X) (KLoc j X) (lambdaMinusOne V hV)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, j = k + 1 := ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩
  rw [adamsRingHom_apply hrank hj, adams_lambdaMinusOne_bottBundle V hV k, map_mul,
    bott_classOf (k + 1) X hrank hnil V hV]

name: SchemeKTheory.adamsRingHom_pullbackK0
statement:
theorem adamsRingHom_pullbackK0 {W Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian W] [IsNoetherian Z]
    (f : W ⟶ Z) (hrankW : ConstantRankGenerators W) (hrankZ : ConstantRankGenerators Z)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) (x : K0 Z) :
    pullbackK0RingHom f (adamsRingHom hrankZ j x) =
      adamsRingHom hrankW j (pullbackK0RingHom f x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [adamsRingHom_apply hrankZ hj, adamsRingHom_apply hrankW hj, pullbackK0RingHom_adams]

name: SchemeKTheory.adams_push_zeroSection_lib
statement:
theorem adams_push_zeroSection_lib {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) {Z P : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian P]
    (hrankZ : ConstantRankGenerators Z) (hnilZ : LambdaNilpotent Z)
    (hrankP : ConstantRankGenerators P) (hnilP : LambdaNilpotent P)
    (p : P ⟶ Z) (s : Z ⟶ P) (hs : s ≫ p = 𝟙 Z)
    (push : K0 Z →+ K0 P) (pushLoc : KLoc j Z →+ KLoc j P)
    (hpushLoc : ∀ x, pushLoc (algebraMap _ _ x) = algebraMap _ _ (push x))
    (proj : ∀ y x, pushLoc (locMap (pullbackK0RingHom s) y * x) = y * pushLoc x)
    (Q : P.Modules) {d : ℕ} (hQ : HasConstantRank P Q d)
    (koszul : push 1 = lambdaMinusOne Q hQ)
    (N : K0 Z) (hN : pullbackK0RingHom s (k0ClassOf P Q hQ.isFiniteLocallyFree) = N)
    (x : K0 Z) :
    algebraMap (K0 P) (KLoc j P) (adamsRingHom hrankP j (push x)) =
      pushLoc (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom hrankZ j x) *
        ((bott j Z hrankZ hnilZ (Multiplicative.ofAdd N) : (KLoc j Z)ˣ) : KLoc j Z))
proof:
:= by
  let ψZ : KLoc j Z →+* KLoc j Z := locMap (adamsRingHom hrankZ j)
  let ψP : KLoc j P →+* KLoc j P := locMap (adamsRingHom hrankP j)
  let pL : KLoc j Z →+* KLoc j P := locMap (pullbackK0RingHom p)
  let sL : KLoc j P →+* KLoc j Z := locMap (pullbackK0RingHom s)
  have hsp : ∀ a, pullbackK0RingHom s (pullbackK0RingHom p a) = a := by
    intro a
    rw [← RingHom.comp_apply, pullbackK0RingHom_comp, hs, pullbackK0RingHom_id, RingHom.id_apply]
  have hsL : ∀ z, sL (pL z) = z := by
    intro z
    have : sL.comp pL = RingHom.id _ := by
      apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers ((j : ℕ) : K0 Z))
      ext a
      simp only [RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, sL, pL, locMap_algebraMap, hsp,
        RingHom.id_apply]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun this z
  have hψp : ∀ z, ψP (pL z) = pL (ψZ z) := by
    intro z
    have : ψP.comp pL = pL.comp ψZ := by
      apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers ((j : ℕ) : K0 Z))
      ext a
      simp only [RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, ψP, pL, ψZ, locMap_algebraMap,
        adamsRingHom_pullbackK0 p hrankP hrankZ hj]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun this z
  have hθ : sL ((bott j P hrankP hnilP (Multiplicative.ofAdd
      (k0ClassOf P Q hQ.isFiniteLocallyFree)) : (KLoc j P)ˣ) : KLoc j P) =
      ((bott j Z hrankZ hnilZ (Multiplicative.ofAdd N) : (KLoc j Z)ˣ) : KLoc j Z) := by
    rw [bott_pullbackK0 s j hrankZ hnilZ hrankP hnilP, hN]
  have key := ARR.adams_push_of_koszul ψZ ψP pL sL hsL hψp pushLoc proj
    (algebraMap _ _ (lambdaMinusOne Q hQ))
    ((bott j P hrankP hnilP (Multiplicative.ofAdd (k0ClassOf P Q hQ.isFiniteLocallyFree)) :
      (KLoc j P)ˣ) : KLoc j P)
    ((bott j Z hrankZ hnilZ (Multiplicative.ofAdd N) : (KLoc j Z)ˣ) : KLoc j Z)
    (by rw [← map_one (algebraMap (K0 Z) (KLoc j Z)), hpushLoc, koszul])
    (by simp only [ψP, locMap_algebraMap]; exact adams_lambdaMinusOne_lib hj hrankP hnilP Q hQ) hθ
    (algebraMap _ _ x)
  simp only [ψP, ψZ, hpushLoc, locMap_algebraMap] at key
  exact key

name: SchemeKTheory.adams_push_zeroSection_projBundle
statement:
theorem adams_push_zeroSection_projBundle {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) {Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z]
    {E : Z.Modules} {d : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank Z E (d + 1)) (C : AffineFrameCover Z E)
    (hrankZ : ConstantRankGenerators Z) (hnilZ : LambdaNilpotent Z)
    (hrankP : ConstantRankGenerators C.scheme) (hnilP : LambdaNilpotent C.scheme)
    (s : Z ⟶ C.scheme) (hs : s ≫ C.toBase = 𝟙 Z) (N : K0 Z)
    (hEN : k0ClassOf Z E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree = N + 1)
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.pullback s).obj (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) ≅ tensorUnitSheaf Z)
    (push : K0 Z →+ K0 C.scheme) (pushLoc : KLoc j Z →+ KLoc j C.scheme)
    (hpushLoc : ∀ x, pushLoc (algebraMap _ _ x) = algebraMap _ _ (push x))
    (proj : ∀ y x, pushLoc (locMap (pullbackK0RingHom s) y * x) = y * pushLoc x)
    (koszul : push 1 = lambdaMinusOne C.tautologicalKernel (C.hasConstantRank_tautologicalKernel hE))
    (x : K0 Z) :
    haveI
proof:
:= C.isNoetherian_scheme
    algebraMap (K0 C.scheme) (KLoc j C.scheme) (adamsRingHom hrankP j (push x)) =
      pushLoc (algebraMap _ _ (adamsRingHom hrankZ j x) *
        ((bott j Z hrankZ hnilZ (Multiplicative.ofAdd N) : (KLoc j Z)ˣ) : KLoc j Z)) := by
  haveI := C.isNoetherian_scheme
  exact adams_push_zeroSection_lib hj hrankZ hnilZ hrankP hnilP C.toBase s hs push pushLoc hpushLoc
    proj C.tautologicalKernel (C.hasConstantRank_tautologicalKernel hE) koszul N
    (C.pullback_classOf_tautologicalKernel_zeroSection s hs hE.isFiniteLocallyFree N hEN e) x

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.presheaf_map_apply
statement:
theorem presheaf_map_apply {U V : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) (ω : (presheaf X φ).obj (op U)) :
    letI : Algebra A Γ(X, U)
proof:
:= (sectionHom X φ U).hom.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra A Γ(X, V) := (sectionHom X φ V).hom.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra Γ(X, U) Γ(X, V) := (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom.toAlgebra
    haveI : IsScalarTower A Γ(X, U) Γ(X, V) := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
      change (sectionHom X φ V).hom =
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom.comp (sectionHom X φ U).hom
      rw [← CommRingCat.hom_comp, sectionHom, sectionHom, Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp]
      rfl)
    ((presheaf X φ).map (homOfLE h).op ω : Ω[Γ(X, V)⁄A]) =
      KaehlerDifferential.map A A Γ(X, U) Γ(X, V) ω :=
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.frameMap_bijective_of_basis
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra A Γ(X, U) := (sectionHom X φ U).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra A Γ(X, X.basicOpen g) := (sectionHom X φ (X.basicOpen g)).hom.toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower A Γ(X, U) Γ(X, X.basicOpen g) := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
    change (sectionHom X φ (X.basicOpen g)).hom =
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le g)).op).hom.comp (sectionHom X φ U).hom
    rw [← CommRingCat.hom_comp, sectionHom, sectionHom, Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp]
    rfl)
  haveI := hU.isLocalization_basicOpen g
  let b' : Module.Basis I Γ(X, X.basicOpen g) Ω[Γ(X, X.basicOpen g)⁄A] :=
    b.ofIsLocalizedModule Γ(X, X.basicOpen g) (Submonoid.powers g)
      (KaehlerDifferential.map A A Γ(X, U) Γ(X, X.basicOpen g))
  have hfam : (fun i ↦ (presheaf X φ).map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le g)).op (b i)) = ⇑b' := by
    funext i
    rw [Module.Basis.ofIsLocalizedModule_apply]
    exact presheaf_map_apply X φ (X.basicOpen_le g) (b i)
  have : ⇑(frameMap (presheaf X φ) (⇑b) (X.basicOpen g) (X.basicOpen_le g)) =
      ⇑(Finsupp.linearCombination Γ(X, X.basicOpen g) ⇑b') := by
    rw [frameMap, hfam]
    exact rfl
  rw [this, ← Module.Basis.coe_repr_symm]
  exact b'.repr.symm.bijective

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.exists_basis_of_smooth
statement:
theorem exists_basis_of_smooth {S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsAffine S] (n : ℕ)
    [hf : SmoothOfRelativeDimension n f] (y : X) :
    ∃ (U : X.Opens) (_ : IsAffineOpen U) (_ : y ∈ U),
      Nonempty (Module.Basis (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) Γ(X, U) ((presheaf X f.appTop).obj (op U)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hyV, -⟩ := exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (x := y) (U := ⊤) trivial
  have H := HasRingHomProperty.appLE (P := @SmoothOfRelativeDimension n) f hf
    ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top S⟩ ⟨V, hV⟩ (by simp)
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hloc⟩ := H
  have hcov := (hV.iSup_basicOpen_eq_self_iff (s := s)).mpr hs
  have hy : y ∈ ⨆ t : s, X.basicOpen (t : Γ(X, V)) := by rw [hcov]; exact hyV
  obtain ⟨⟨t, hts⟩, hyt⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp hy
  refine ⟨X.basicOpen t, hV.basicOpen t, hyt, ?_⟩
  haveI := hV.isLocalization_basicOpen t
  let e := IsLocalization.algEquiv (Submonoid.powers t) (Localization.Away t) Γ(X, X.basicOpen t)
  have h1 := (RingHom.isStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension_respectsIso (n := n)).left _
    e.toRingEquiv (hloc t hts)
  have h2 : e.toRingEquiv.toRingHom.comp ((algebraMap Γ(X, V) (Localization.Away t)).comp
      (f.appLE ⊤ V (by simp)).hom) = (sectionHom X f.appTop (X.basicOpen t)).hom := by
    rw [← RingHom.comp_assoc]
    have h3 : e.toRingEquiv.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap Γ(X, V) (Localization.Away t)) =
        algebraMap Γ(X, V) Γ(X, X.basicOpen t) := by
      ext a
      exact e.commutes a
    rw [h3]
    change ((f.appLE ⊤ V _) ≫ X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le t)).op).hom =
      (f.appTop ≫ X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op).hom
    rw [Scheme.Hom.appLE, Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp]
    rfl
  rw [h2] at h1
  letI : Algebra Γ(S, ⊤) Γ(X, X.basicOpen t) :=
    (sectionHom X f.appTop (X.basicOpen t)).hom.toAlgebra
  haveI : Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension n Γ(S, ⊤) Γ(X, X.basicOpen t) := h1
  haveI : Nonempty (X.basicOpen t) := ⟨⟨y, hyt⟩⟩
  have hrank := Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.rank_kaehlerDifferential
    (R := Γ(S, ⊤)) (S := Γ(X, X.basicOpen t)) n
  haveI : Algebra.IsStandardSmooth Γ(S, ⊤) Γ(X, X.basicOpen t) :=
    Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.isStandardSmooth n
  exact ⟨(Module.finBasisOfFinrankEq _ _ (Module.finrank_eq_of_rank_eq hrank)).reindex
    Equiv.ulift.symm⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.hasConstantRank_of_smooth
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_of_smooth {S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsAffine S] (n : ℕ)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension n f] :
    HasConstantRank X (ofHom X f) n
proof:
:= by
  apply hasConstantRank_of_localFrames
  intro y
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hyU, ⟨b⟩⟩ := exists_basis_of_smooth X f n y
  exact ⟨U, hU, hyU, ⇑b, frameMap_bijective_of_basis X f.appTop hU b⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.isFiniteLocallyFree_of_smooth
statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_of_smooth {S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsAffine S] (n : ℕ)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension n f] :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree X (ofHom X f)
proof:
:=
  (hasConstantRank_of_smooth X f n).isFiniteLocallyFree

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.val_kAway
statement:
theorem val_kAway (x : k) :
    (kAway k N c x).val = algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin (N + 1)) k) (L k N c) (MvPolynomial.C x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold kAway
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe]
  change (HomogeneousLocalization.mk _).val = _
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mk]
  exact Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.val_awayRatio
statement:
theorem val_awayRatio (i : Fin (N + 1)) :
    (Koszul.awayRatio k N c i).val * algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin (N + 1)) k) (L k N c) (coordinate k N c)
      = algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin (N + 1)) k) (L k N c) (coordinate k N i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Koszul.awayRatio
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, Localization.mk_eq_mk']
  have := IsLocalization.mk'_spec (L k N c) (coordinate k N i)
    (⟨coordinate k N c ^ 1, ⟨1, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers (coordinate k N c))
  simpa using this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.val_theta_monomial_mul
statement:
theorem val_theta_monomial_mul (d : ℕ) (α : Fin (N + 1) →₀ ℕ) (hd : α.degree = d) (c' : k) :
    (theta k N c (MvPolynomial.monomial α c')).val *
        algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin (N + 1)) k) (L k N c) (coordinate k N c ^ d) =
      algebraMap _ _ (MvPolynomial.monomial α c')
proof:
:= by
  unfold theta
  rw [MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_monomial, HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul, val_kAway,
    MvPolynomial.monomial_eq, map_mul, mul_assoc]
  congr 1
  have h1 : (algebraMap (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading k N) (coordinate k N c))
      (L k N c)) (α.prod fun i e => Koszul.awayRatio k N c i ^ e) =
      α.prod fun i e => ((Koszul.awayRatio k N c i).val) ^ e := by
    rw [map_finsuppProd]
    simp only [map_pow]
    rfl
  have h2 : algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin (N + 1)) k) (L k N c)
      (α.prod fun i e => (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial (Fin (N + 1)) k) ^ e) =
      α.prod fun i e => (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin (N + 1)) k) (L k N c) (coordinate k N i)) ^ e := by
    rw [map_finsuppProd]
    simp only [map_pow]
    rfl
  have h3 : algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin (N + 1)) k) (L k N c) (coordinate k N c ^ d) =
      α.prod fun _ e => (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin (N + 1)) k) (L k N c) (coordinate k N c)) ^ e := by
    rw [map_pow, ← hd]
    unfold Finsupp.prod
    rw [Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum]
    rfl
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply] at h1
  rw [h1, h2, h3, ← Finsupp.prod_mul]
  unfold Finsupp.prod
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
  beta_reduce
  rw [← mul_pow, val_awayRatio]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.val_theta_mul
statement:
theorem val_theta_mul (d : ℕ) (a : MvPolynomial (Fin (N + 1)) k)
    (ha : a ∈ grading k N d) :
    (theta k N c a).val * algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin (N + 1)) k) (L k N c) (coordinate k N c ^ d) =
      algebraMap _ _ a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have key : ∀ S : Finset (Fin (N + 1) →₀ ℕ), (∀ α ∈ S, α.degree = d) →
      (theta k N c (∑ α ∈ S, MvPolynomial.monomial α (a.coeff α))).val *
        algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin (N + 1)) k) (L k N c) (coordinate k N c ^ d) =
      algebraMap _ _ (∑ α ∈ S, MvPolynomial.monomial α (a.coeff α)) := by
    intro S
    induction S using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => intro _; simp
    | insert α S hα ih =>
      intro hS
      rw [Finset.sum_insert hα, map_add, HomogeneousLocalization.val_add, add_mul, ih (fun β hβ => hS β (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hβ)), map_add]
      congr 1
      have hd := hS α (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
      set c' := a.coeff α
      exact val_theta_monomial_mul k N c d α hd c'
  have := key a.support (fun α hα => by
    rw [Finsupp.degree_eq_weight_one]
    exact ha (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hα))
  rwa [← MvPolynomial.as_sum] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.theta_eq_mk
statement:
theorem theta_eq_mk (d : ℕ) (a : MvPolynomial (Fin (N + 1)) k) (ha : a ∈ grading k N d) :
    theta k N c a = HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading k N) (coordinate_mem_degree_one k N c) d a
      (by simpa using ha)
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, Localization.mk_eq_mk', IsLocalization.eq_mk'_iff_mul_eq]
  have := val_theta_mul k N c d a ha
  simpa using this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.isUnit_germ_awayToSection_mk_iff
statement:
theorem isUnit_germ_awayToSection_mk_iff (x : space k N) (hx : x ∈ coordinateOpen k N c) (d : ℕ)
    (a : MvPolynomial (Fin (N + 1)) k) (ha : a ∈ grading k N d) :
    IsUnit ((space k N).presheaf.germ (coordinateOpen k N c) x hx
      ((Proj.awayToSection (grading k N) (coordinate k N c)).hom
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading k N) (coordinate_mem_degree_one k N c) d a
          (by simpa using ha)))) ↔ a ∉ x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal
proof:
:= by
  have h := ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.awayToSection_germ (grading k N) (coordinate k N c) x hx
  have h2 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom h (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading k N)
    (coordinate_mem_degree_one k N c) d a (by simpa using ha))
  have hmem : coordinate k N c ∉ x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal :=
    (Proj.mem_basicOpen (grading k N) (coordinate k N c) x).1 hx
  have hle : Submonoid.powers (coordinate k N c) ≤ x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal.primeCompl :=
    Submonoid.powers_le.mpr hmem
  have hv : (HomogeneousLocalization.mapId (grading k N) hle
      (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading k N) (coordinate_mem_degree_one k N c) d a
        (by simpa using ha))).val =
      Localization.mk a (⟨coordinate k N c ^ d,
        fun h => hmem (Ideal.IsPrime.mem_of_pow_mem inferInstance d h)⟩ :
          x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal.primeCompl) := rfl
  have e : (space k N).presheaf.germ (coordinateOpen k N c) x hx
      ((Proj.awayToSection (grading k N) (coordinate k N c)).hom
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading k N) (coordinate_mem_degree_one k N c) d a
          (by simpa using ha))) =
      (Proj.stalkIso' (grading k N) x).symm (HomogeneousLocalization.mapId (grading k N) hle
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading k N) (coordinate_mem_degree_one k N c) d a
          (by simpa using ha))) := h2
  rw [e]
  refine Iff.trans (isUnit_map_iff (Proj.stalkIso' (grading k N) x).symm _) ?_
  refine Iff.trans (HomogeneousLocalization.isUnit_iff_isUnit_val (grading k N)
    x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal _).symm ?_
  rw [hv, Localization.mk_eq_mk']
  exact IsLocalization.AtPrime.isUnit_mk'_iff (Localization.AtPrime x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal)
    x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal a _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.res_rhoP
statement:
theorem res_rhoP (x : k) :
    (space k N).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : coordinateOpen k N c ≤ ⊤)).op (rhoP k N x) =
      (Proj.awayToSection (grading k N) (coordinate k N c)).hom (kAway k N c x)
proof:
:= by
  have H : (coordinateOpen k N c).ι ≫ Proj.toSpecZero (grading k N) =
      Proj.basicOpenToSpec (grading k N) (coordinate k N c) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom (grading k N)
          (Submonoid.powers (coordinate k N c)))) := by
    have h := Proj.awayι_toSpecZero (grading k N) (coordinate k N c) (coordinate_mem_degree_one k N c)
      Nat.zero_lt_one
    have h2 : (Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading k N) (coordinate k N c) (coordinate_mem_degree_one k N c)
        Nat.zero_lt_one).hom ≫ Proj.awayι (grading k N) (coordinate k N c)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one k N c) Nat.zero_lt_one ≫ Proj.toSpecZero (grading k N) =
        Proj.basicOpenToSpec (grading k N) (coordinate k N c) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom (grading k N)
          (Submonoid.powers (coordinate k N c)))) := by
      rw [h]
      rfl
    rw [← h2, Proj.awayι, Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc _ _ (Proj.toSpecZero _)]
    simp
    rfl
  have H' := congrArg Scheme.Hom.appTop H
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop] at H'
  have e := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom H'
    ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (grading k N 0))).inv ((degreeZeroEquiv k N).symm x))
  have e1 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality
    (CommRingCat.ofHom (HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom (grading k N)
      (Submonoid.powers (coordinate k N c))))) ((degreeZeroEquiv k N).symm x)
  have e2 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (Proj.basicOpenToSpec_app_top (grading k N) (coordinate k N c))
    ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading k N) (coordinate k N c)))).inv
      (kAway k N c x))
  have A : (Scheme.Hom.appTop (coordinateOpen k N c).ι).hom (rhoP k N x) =
      (Scheme.Hom.appTop (Proj.basicOpenToSpec (grading k N) (coordinate k N c))).hom
        ((Scheme.Hom.appTop (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom
          (grading k N) (Submonoid.powers (coordinate k N c)))))).hom
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (grading k N 0))).inv.hom
            ((degreeZeroEquiv k N).symm x))) := e
  have B : (Scheme.Hom.appTop (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom
          (grading k N) (Submonoid.powers (coordinate k N c)))))).hom
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (grading k N 0))).inv.hom
            ((degreeZeroEquiv k N).symm x)) =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading k N)
          (coordinate k N c)))).inv.hom (kAway k N c x) := e1.symm
  have C : (Scheme.Hom.appTop (Proj.basicOpenToSpec (grading k N) (coordinate k N c))).hom
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading k N)
          (coordinate k N c)))).inv.hom (kAway k N c x)) =
      (coordinateOpen k N c).topIso.inv.hom ((Proj.awayToSection (grading k N)
        (coordinate k N c)).hom (kAway k N c x)) := by
    refine e2.trans ?_
    have := Iso.inv_hom_id_apply (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (HomogeneousLocalization.Away
      (grading k N) (coordinate k N c)))) (kAway k N c x)
    change (coordinateOpen k N c).topIso.inv.hom ((Proj.awayToSection (grading k N)
        (coordinate k N c)).hom ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (HomogeneousLocalization.Away
      (grading k N) (coordinate k N c)))).hom.hom ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of
      (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading k N) (coordinate k N c)))).inv.hom
      (kAway k N c x)))) = _
    rw [this]
  have e3 : (Scheme.Hom.appTop (coordinateOpen k N c).ι).hom (rhoP k N x) =
      (coordinateOpen k N c).topIso.inv.hom ((Proj.awayToSection (grading k N)
        (coordinate k N c)).hom (kAway k N c x)) := by
    rw [A, B]
    exact C
  have e4 := congrArg (coordinateOpen k N c).topIso.hom.hom e3
  have e5 : (coordinateOpen k N c).topIso.hom.hom ((coordinateOpen k N c).topIso.inv.hom
      ((Proj.awayToSection (grading k N) (coordinate k N c)).hom (kAway k N c x))) =
      (Proj.awayToSection (grading k N) (coordinate k N c)).hom (kAway k N c x) :=
    Iso.inv_hom_id_apply _ _
  rw [e5] at e4
  rw [← e4, Scheme.Opens.ι_appTop, Scheme.Opens.topIso_hom]
  have key : ∀ {V W : (space k N).Opens} (h1 : V ⟶ ⊤) (h2 : W ⟶ V) (z : Γ(space k N, ⊤)),
      ((space k N).presheaf.map h2.op).hom (((space k N).presheaf.map h1.op).hom z) =
        ((space k N).presheaf.map (h2 ≫ h1).op).hom z := by
    intro V W h1 h2 z
    rw [op_comp, Functor.map_comp]
    rfl
  exact (key _ _ _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.pushedMul_app
statement:
theorem pushedMul_app {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.Opens) (a : Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤)) (W : X.Opens)
    (s : Γ(pushedUnit X U, W)) :
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (Koszul.pushedMul U a) W s =
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (Koszul.mulHom a) (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W) s
proof:
:= by
  unfold Koszul.pushedMul
  rw [Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.PiC_X
statement:
theorem PiC_X (i : Fin (N + 1)) (d : ℤ) :
    Koszul.X k N i d ≫ PiC k N c (d + 1) = PiC k N c d ≫ Koszul.chartMul k N i c
proof:
:= by
  unfold PiC
  rw [← Category.assoc, Koszul.X_ι, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, Koszul.mulPi_π]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.PiC_X_app
statement:
theorem PiC_X_app (i : Fin (N + 1)) (d : ℤ) (W : (space k N).Opens)
    (m : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k N d, W)) :
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (PiC k N c (d + 1)) W (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (Koszul.X k N i d) W m) =
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (Koszul.mulHom (Koszul.chartCoeff k N c i))
        ((coordinateOpen k N c).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W) (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (PiC k N c d) W m)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun f => Scheme.Modules.Hom.app f W m) (PiC_X k N c i d)
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app] at h
  have h' : Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (PiC k N c (d + 1)) W
      (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (Koszul.X k N i d) W m) =
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (Koszul.chartMul k N i c) W
        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (PiC k N c d) W m) := h
  refine h'.trans ?_
  unfold Koszul.chartMul
  exact pushedMul_app _ _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.bridge
statement:
theorem bridge (i : Fin (N + 1)) (W : (space k N).Opens) (hW : W ≤ coordinateOpen k N c) :
    (coordinateOpen k N c).toScheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : (coordinateOpen k N c).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W ≤ ⊤)).op
        (Koszul.chartCoeff k N c i) =
      Scheme.Hom.app (coordinateOpen k N c).ι W
        ((space k N).presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op (Koszul.ratio k N c i))
proof:
:= by
  unfold Koszul.chartCoeff
  simp
  have key2 : ∀ {A B C : (space k N).Opens} (h1 : op A ⟶ op B) (h2 : op B ⟶ op C) (z : Γ(space k N, A)),
      ((space k N).presheaf.map h2).hom (((space k N).presheaf.map h1).hom z) =
        ((space k N).presheaf.map (h1 ≫ h2)).hom z := by
    intro A B C h1 h2 z
    rw [Functor.map_comp]
    rfl
  exact (key2 _ _ _).trans (key2 _ _ _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.Pi_app_injective
statement:
theorem Pi_app_injective (d : ℤ) (V : (coordinateOpen k N c).toScheme.Opens)
    (m m' : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k N d, (coordinateOpen k N c).ι ''ᵁ V))
    (h : Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (PiC k N c d) ((coordinateOpen k N c).ι ''ᵁ V) m =
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (PiC k N c d) ((coordinateOpen k N c).ι ''ᵁ V) m') :
    m = m'
proof:
:= by
  let e := projectiveTwistingSheafCoordinateIso k N d c
  have h1 : (localFrameProjection k N d c).app V m = (localFrameProjection k N d c).app V m' := by
    rw [localFrameProjection_app_eq, localFrameProjection_app_eq]
    exact congrArg _ h
  have a := Chow.C1Cap.iso_hom_inv_app e V m
  have b := Chow.C1Cap.iso_hom_inv_app e V m'
  exact a.symm.trans ((congrArg (e.hom.app V) h1).trans b)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.tsec_rel
statement:
theorem tsec_rel (i : Fin (N + 1)) (W : (space k N).Opens) (hW : W ≤ coordinateOpen k N c) :
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (0 + 1)).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op (tsec k N i) =
      (space k N).presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op (Koszul.ratio k N c i) •
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (0 + 1)).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op (tsec k N c)
proof:
:= by
  have hW' : (coordinateOpen k N c).ι ''ᵁ ((coordinateOpen k N c).ι ⁻¹ᵁ W) = W := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι,
      inf_eq_right.mpr hW]
  obtain ⟨V, rfl⟩ : ∃ V : (coordinateOpen k N c).toScheme.Opens, (coordinateOpen k N c).ι ''ᵁ V = W :=
    ⟨_, hW'⟩
  apply Pi_app_injective k N c (0 + 1) V
  set W := (coordinateOpen k N c).ι ''ᵁ V with hWdef
  set m0 := (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N 0).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op
    (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (projectiveTwistingZeroIso k N).inv ⊤ (1 : Γ(space k N, ⊤))) with hm0
  have hres : ∀ j : Fin (N + 1), (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (0 + 1)).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op (tsec k N j) =
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (Koszul.X k N j 0) W m0 := by
    intro j
    unfold tsec
    exact (Chow.C1Cap.app_presheaf_map (Koszul.X k N j 0) (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤))
      (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (projectiveTwistingZeroIso k N).inv ⊤ (1 : Γ(space k N, ⊤)))).symm
  rw [hres i, hres c]
  rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul, PiC_X_app, PiC_X_app]
  have hcc : Koszul.chartCoeff k N c c = 1 := by
    unfold Koszul.chartCoeff
    rw [Koszul.ratio_self]
    exact map_one _
  rw [hcc, Koszul.mulHom_app_apply, Koszul.mulHom_app_apply, map_one]
  erw [one_mul]
  rw [bridge k N c i W hW]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.eval₂_scale
statement:
theorem eval₂_scale (f : R →+* S) (g : σ → S) (u : S) (n : ℕ) (a : MvPolynomial σ R)
    (ha : a.IsHomogeneous n) :
    MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom f (fun i => g i * u) a = u ^ n * MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom f g a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have key : ∀ T : Finset (σ →₀ ℕ), (∀ α ∈ T, α.degree = n) →
      MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom f (fun i => g i * u) (∑ α ∈ T, MvPolynomial.monomial α (a.coeff α)) =
        u ^ n * MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom f g (∑ α ∈ T, MvPolynomial.monomial α (a.coeff α)) := by
    intro T
    induction T using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => intro _; simp
    | insert α T hα ih =>
      intro hT
      rw [Finset.sum_insert hα, map_add, map_add, ih (fun β hβ => hT β (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hβ)),
        mul_add]
      congr 1
      rw [MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_monomial, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_monomial]
      have hd := hT α (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
      have : (α.prod fun i e => (g i * u) ^ e) =
          u ^ n * α.prod fun i e => g i ^ e := by
        simp only [mul_pow]
        rw [Finsupp.prod_mul]
        have h3 : (α.prod fun _ e => u ^ e) = u ^ n := by
          rw [← hd]
          unfold Finsupp.prod
          rw [Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum]
          rfl
        rw [h3, mul_comm]
      rw [this]
      ring
  have := key a.support (fun α hα => by
    rw [Finsupp.degree_eq_weight_one]
    exact ha (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hα))
  rwa [← MvPolynomial.as_sum] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.coord_rel
statement:
theorem coord_rel (d : LineBundleLocalData S M x) (s₁ s₂ : Γ(M, ⊤)) (W : S.Opens) (hW : W ≤ d.U)
    (r : Γ(S, W))
    (h : M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op s₁ =
      r • M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op s₂) :
    S.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op (sectionCoordSec d s₁) =
      r * S.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op (sectionCoordSec d s₂)
proof:
:= by
  apply C1Cap.frameSec_injective d W hW
  have l1 : ∀ s : Γ(M, ⊤), C1Cap.frameSec d W hW (S.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op (sectionCoordSec d s)) =
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op s := by
    intro s
    rw [frameSec_restrict d d.U W le_rfl hW, sectionCoordSec_spec,
      ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← M.presheaf.map_comp]
    rfl
  rw [l1 s₁, h, C1Cap.frameSec_smul d W hW (r * _), mul_smul, ← C1Cap.frameSec_smul d W hW _, l1]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.tsec_unit
statement:
theorem tsec_unit (q : space k N) (hq : q ∈ coordinateOpen k N c)
    (d' : LineBundleLocalData (space k N) (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (0 + 1)) q) :
    IsUnit ((space k N).presheaf.germ d'.U q d'.mem (sectionCoordSec d' (tsec k N c)))
proof:
:= by
  have hφ : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen k N c).ι).map
      ((projectiveTwistingZeroIso k N).inv ≫ Koszul.X k N c 0)) := by
    rw [Functor.map_comp]
    haveI := Koszul.X_restrict_isIso k N c 0
    haveI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (coordinateOpen k N c).ι).map
      (projectiveTwistingZeroIso k N).inv) := inferInstance
    exact IsIso.comp_isIso
  exact isUnit_germ_coord_of_surj (tsec k N c) (coordinateOpen k N c)
    (fun W hW m ↦ surj_of_isIso_restrict _ _ hφ W hW m) hq d'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.evalP0_eq
statement:
theorem evalP0_eq (q : space k N) (hq : q ∈ coordinateOpen k N c) :
    evalP0 k N c q hq =
      ((ψ q (coordinateOpen k N c) hq).comp
        (Proj.awayToSection (grading k N) (coordinate k N c)).hom).comp (theta k N c)
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro r
    unfold evalP0 theta
    rw [MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C]
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C]
    refine Eq.trans ?_ (congrArg (ψ q (coordinateOpen k N c) hq) (res_rhoP k N c r))
    unfold ψ
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
    exact congrArg (IsLocalRing.residue _)
      ((space k N).presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE (le_top : coordinateOpen k N c ≤ ⊤)) q hq
      (rhoP k N r)).symm
  · intro i
    unfold evalP0 theta
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X']
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.ψ_res
statement:
theorem ψ_res {X : Scheme.{u}} (p : X) {V W : X.Opens} (h : W ≤ V) (hp : p ∈ W) (x : Γ(X, V)) :
    ψ p W hp (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x) = ψ p V (h hp) x
proof:
:= by
  unfold ψ
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
  exact congrArg (IsLocalRing.residue _) (X.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE h) p hp x)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D33.evalP_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem evalP_eq_zero_iff (q : space k N) (hq : q ∈ coordinateOpen k N c)
    (d' : LineBundleLocalData (space k N) (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (0 + 1)) q)
    (n : ℕ) (a : MvPolynomial (Fin (N + 1)) k) (ha : a ∈ grading k N n) :
    evalP k N q d' a = 0 ↔ a ∈ q.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal
proof:
:= by
  set u := ψ q d'.U d'.mem (sectionCoordSec d' (tsec k N c)) with hudef
  have hu : u ≠ 0 := ψ_ne_zero_of_isUnit _ _ _ _ (tsec_unit k N c q hq d')
  have hratio : ∀ i, ψ q d'.U d'.mem (sectionCoordSec d' (tsec k N i)) =
      ψ q (coordinateOpen k N c) hq (Koszul.ratio k N c i) * u := by
    intro i
    have hqW : q ∈ d'.U ⊓ coordinateOpen k N c := ⟨d'.mem, hq⟩
    have h := coord_rel d' (tsec k N i) (tsec k N c) (d'.U ⊓ coordinateOpen k N c) inf_le_left
      ((space k N).presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : d'.U ⊓ coordinateOpen k N c ≤
        coordinateOpen k N c)).op (Koszul.ratio k N c i))
      (tsec_rel k N c i _ inf_le_right)
    have h2 := congrArg (ψ q (d'.U ⊓ coordinateOpen k N c) hqW) h
    rw [ψ_res, map_mul, ψ_res, ψ_res] at h2
    exact h2
  have hscale : evalP k N q d' a = u ^ n * evalP0 k N c q hq a := by
    have := eval₂_scale ((ψ q ⊤ trivial).comp (rhoP k N))
      (fun i => ψ q (coordinateOpen k N c) hq (Koszul.ratio k N c i)) u n a
      ((MvPolynomial.mem_homogeneousSubmodule n a).1 ha)
    have hfun : (fun i => ψ q d'.U d'.mem (sectionCoordSec d' (tsec k N i))) =
        (fun i => ψ q (coordinateOpen k N c) hq (Koszul.ratio k N c i) * u) := funext hratio
    unfold evalP evalP0
    rw [← this, hfun]
  rw [hscale, mul_eq_zero, or_iff_right (pow_ne_zero _ hu), evalP0_eq]
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
  rw [theta_eq_mk k N c n a ha]
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hmem
    exact ψ_ne_zero_of_isUnit q (coordinateOpen k N c) hq _
      ((isUnit_germ_awayToSection_mk_iff k N c q hq n a ha).2 hmem) h
  · intro h
    by_contra h0
    exact ((isUnit_germ_awayToSection_mk_iff k N c q hq n a ha).1
      (isUnit_of_ψ_ne_zero q (coordinateOpen k N c) hq _ h0)) h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F25.D35.isIso_top_ι
statement: theorem D35.isIso_top_ι (Z : Scheme.{u}) : IsIso (⊤ : Z.Opens).ι
proof:
:= by
  rw [isIso_iff_isOpenImmersion_and_surjective]
  refine ⟨inferInstance, ⟨fun x => ⟨⟨x, trivial⟩, rfl⟩⟩⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F25.isIso_chartι
statement: theorem isIso_chartι : IsIso ((singleCover (k := k) J).chartι PUnit.unit)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIso ((singleCover (k := k) J).U PUnit.unit).ι := D35.isIso_top_ι _
  exact ((singleCover (k := k) J).isPullback_chartι_toBase PUnit.unit).isIso_fst_of_isIso

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F25.rho0_toSpec
statement:
theorem rho0_toSpec {n : ℕ} (eJ : J ≃ Fin (n + 1)) :
    rho0 (k := k) eJ ≫ SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k n = (singleCover (k := k) J).toBase
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isIso_chartι (k := k) J
  rw [← cancel_epi ((singleCover (k := k) J).chartι PUnit.unit)]
  unfold rho0
  simp only [Category.assoc, IsIso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  have h0 := intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace_comp_toSpec (singleBasis (k := k) eJ)
  erw [SchemeProjectiveSpace.map_toSpec, ← Category.assoc, h0]
  rw [AffineFrameCover.chartι_toBase]
  change _ = ((singleCover (k := k) J).chartToBase PUnit.unit) ≫
    ((singleCover (k := k) J).U PUnit.unit).ι
  have h1 : (isAffineOpen_top (Yr k)).fromSpec =
      Spec.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv := by
    rw [IsAffineOpen.fromSpec_top]
    simp
  erw [show Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (RingEquiv.toRingHom (rΓ (k := k)))) =
    (isAffineOpen_top (Yr k)).fromSpec from h1.symm]
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F25.exists_isPullback_free
statement:
theorem exists_isPullback_free {n : ℕ} (eJ : J ≃ Fin (n + 1)) (g : X ⟶ Yr k)
    (C : AffineFrameCover X (FreeM X J)) :
    ∃ ρ : C.scheme ⟶ SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n,
      IsPullback ρ C.toBase (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k n) g
proof:
:= by
  let Cs := singleCover (k := k) J
  let D := Cs.pullbackFrameCover g
  let e : FreeM X J ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj (FreeM (Yr k) J) := (pullbackFreeIso g J).symm
  let T := AffineFrameCover.transport e D
  let i1 : T.scheme ≅ D.scheme := AffineFrameCover.transportSchemeIso e D
  let i2 : T.scheme ≅ C.scheme := AffineFrameCover.isoOfCovers T C
  have h1 : i1.hom ≫ D.toBase = T.toBase := AffineFrameCover.transportSchemeIso_toBase e D
  have h2 : i2.hom ≫ C.toBase = T.toBase := AffineFrameCover.isoOfCovers_toBase T C
  have hp0 : IsPullback (Cs.pullbackProjectiveMap g) D.toBase Cs.toBase g :=
    Cs.isPullback_pullbackProjectiveMap g
  haveI : IsIso (rho0 (k := k) eJ) := inferInstance
  have hp1 : IsPullback (Cs.pullbackProjectiveMap g ≫ rho0 eJ) D.toBase
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k n) g := by
    refine hp0.of_iso (Iso.refl _) (asIso (rho0 (k := k) eJ)) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · simp
    · simp
    · simp [rho0_toSpec]; rfl
    · simp
  let e₁ : D.scheme ≅ C.scheme := i1.symm ≪≫ i2
  refine ⟨e₁.inv ≫ (Cs.pullbackProjectiveMap g ≫ rho0 eJ), ?_⟩
  refine hp1.of_iso e₁ (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp
  · simp only [e₁, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc, h2]
    rw [← h1]; simp
  · simp
  · simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F25.isPullback_free
statement:
theorem isPullback_free {n : ℕ} (eJ : J ≃ Fin (n + 1)) (g : X ⟶ Yr k)
    (C : AffineFrameCover X (FreeM X J)) :
    IsPullback (freeProj eJ g C) C.toBase (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k n) g
proof:
:=
  (exists_isPullback_free eJ g C).choose_spec

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.asHomogeneousIdeal_genericProjPoint
statement:
@[simp]
theorem asHomogeneousIdeal_genericProjPoint :
    (show ProjectiveSpectrum (grading k n) from genericProjPoint k n).asHomogeneousIdeal =
      ⊥
proof:
:=
