name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.genericProjPoint_mem_basicOpen
statement:
theorem genericProjPoint_mem_basicOpen {f : Polynomial k n} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    genericProjPoint k n ∈ Proj.basicOpen (grading k n) f
proof:
:=
  (Proj.mem_basicOpen (𝒜 := grading k n) (f := f) _).mpr
    (fun hmem ↦ hf (Ideal.mem_bot.mp hmem))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.genericProjPoint_mem_of_isOpen
statement:
theorem genericProjPoint_mem_of_isOpen {u : Set (space k n)}
    (hu : IsOpen u) (hne : u.Nonempty) : genericProjPoint k n ∈ u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hne
  obtain ⟨U', hU', hyU', hle⟩ :=
    TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp
      (Proj.isBasis_basicOpen (grading k n)) (U := ⟨u, hu⟩) hy
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := hU'
  have hf : f ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    subst h0
    have := (Proj.mem_basicOpen (𝒜 := grading k n) (f := 0) y).mp hyU'
    exact this (Ideal.zero_mem _)
  exact hle (genericProjPoint_mem_basicOpen k n hf)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB7.localFrameCover_card
statement:
theorem localFrameCover_card (i : (localFrameCover Y J C).I) :
    Nat.card ((localFrameCover Y J C).basisIndex i) = r + 1
proof:
:= by
  change Nat.card (ULift.{u} (Fin (C.gens i).length) ⊕ PUnit.{u + 1}) = r + 1
  rw [Nat.card_sum, Nat.card_congr Equiv.ulift, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card (α := Fin _),
    Fintype.card_fin, C.length_eq i]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB7.componentFrameIso_toBase
statement:
theorem componentFrameIso_toBase :
    (componentFrameIso J C).hom ≫ (localFrameCover Y J C).toBase = componentToCentre Y J
proof:
:= by
  rw [componentFrameIso, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.inv_comp_eq]
  exact (localFrameComponentIso_toCentre Y J C).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB7.component_data
statement:
theorem component_data (hZ : ProjectiveIntegralK k J.subscheme) :
    IsIntegral (component Y J) ∧ ∃ (N : ℕ) (j : component Y J ⟶ space k N), IsClosedImmersion j ∧
      j ≫ toSpec k N = componentToCentre Y J ≫ J.subscheme ↘ Spk k
proof:
:= by
  have hF := CIIB5.projectiveIntegralK_frameCover hZ (localFrameCover Y J C)
    (e := r) (localFrameCover_card J C)
  obtain ⟨hI, N, j, hj, hjk⟩ := hF
  haveI := hI
  haveI := hj
  refine ⟨isIntegral_of_iso (componentFrameIso J C), N, (componentFrameIso J C).hom ≫ j,
    inferInstance, ?_⟩
  rw [Category.assoc]
  change _ = _ ≫ _ at hjk
  rw [hjk, ← Category.assoc, componentFrameIso_toBase]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB7.isIntegral_component
statement:
theorem isIntegral_component (hZ : ProjectiveIntegralK k J.subscheme) :
    IsIntegral (component Y J)
proof: := (component_data J C hZ).1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB7.component_lft
statement:
theorem component_lft (hZ : ProjectiveIntegralK k J.subscheme) :
    letI
proof:
:= componentOver (k := k) J
    LocallyOfFiniteType ((component Y J) ↘ Spk k) := by
  letI := componentOver (k := k) J
  obtain ⟨-, N, j, hj, hjk⟩ := component_data J C hZ
  haveI := hj
  change LocallyOfFiniteType (componentToCentre Y J ≫ J.subscheme ↘ Spk k)
  rw [← hjk]
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB7.component_isNoetherian
statement:
theorem component_isNoetherian (hZ : ProjectiveIntegralK k J.subscheme) :
    IsNoetherian (component Y J)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, N, j, hj, hjk⟩ := component_data J C hZ
  haveI := hj
  haveI : IsNoetherian (space k N) := SchemeProjectiveSpace.isNoetherian k N
  exact
    { __ := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian j
      __ := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace j }

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB7.projectiveIntegralK_component
statement:
theorem projectiveIntegralK_component [J.subscheme.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (J.subscheme ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian J.subscheme]
    (hZ : ProjectiveIntegralK k J.subscheme) :
    letI
proof:
:= componentOver (k := k) J
    haveI := component_lft J C hZ
    haveI := component_isNoetherian J C hZ
    ProjectiveIntegralK k (component Y J) := by
  obtain ⟨hI, N, j, hj, hjk⟩ := component_data J C hZ
  exact ⟨hI, N, j, hj, hjk⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB7.component_structure_eq_total
statement:
theorem component_structure_eq_total [Y.Over (Spk k)] [J.subscheme.Over (Spk k)]
    (hJ : J.subschemeι ≫ Y ↘ Spk k = J.subscheme ↘ Spk k) :
    componentToTotal Y J ≫ GlobalCompletion.totalGlobalToBase Y J ≫ Y ↘ Spk k =
      componentToCentre Y J ≫ J.subscheme ↘ Spk k
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc, componentToTotal_toBase, Category.assoc, hJ]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB7.kerOver_member
statement:
theorem kerOver_member [IsIntegral X] :
    letI
proof:
:= kerOver k n i
    haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (i.ker.subscheme ↘ Spk k) :=
      inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType (i.ker.subschemeι ≫ toSpec k n))
    haveI : IsNoetherian i.ker.subscheme := by
      haveI : IsNoetherian (space k n) := SchemeProjectiveSpace.isNoetherian k n
      exact
        { __ := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian i.ker.subschemeι
          __ := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace i.ker.subschemeι }
    ProjectiveIntegralK k i.ker.subscheme :=
  ⟨isIntegral_of_iso (asIso i.toImage).symm, n, i.ker.subschemeι, inferInstance, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB7.projectiveIntegralK_component_projective
statement:
theorem projectiveIntegralK_component_projective [IsIntegral X]
    (hP : ∀ y : space k n, IsRegularLocalRing ((space k n).presheaf.stalk y))
    (hX : ∀ z : X, IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk z)) :
    letI
proof:
:= kerOver k n i
    haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (i.ker.subscheme ↘ Spk k) :=
      inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType (i.ker.subschemeι ≫ toSpec k n))
    haveI : IsNoetherian i.ker.subscheme := by
      haveI : IsNoetherian (space k n) := SchemeProjectiveSpace.isNoetherian k n
      exact
        { __ := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian i.ker.subschemeι
          __ := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace i.ker.subschemeι }
    letI := componentOver (k := k) i.ker
    haveI := component_lft i.ker (SchemeKTheory.F14.quasiregularCover k n i hP hX)
      (kerOver_member k n i)
    haveI := component_isNoetherian i.ker (SchemeKTheory.F14.quasiregularCover k n i hP hX)
      (kerOver_member k n i)
    ProjectiveIntegralK k (component (space k n) i.ker) := by
  letI := kerOver k n i
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (i.ker.subscheme ↘ Spk k) :=
    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType (i.ker.subschemeι ≫ toSpec k n))
  haveI : IsNoetherian i.ker.subscheme := by
    haveI : IsNoetherian (space k n) := SchemeProjectiveSpace.isNoetherian k n
    exact
      { __ := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian i.ker.subschemeι
        __ := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace i.ker.subschemeι }
  exact projectiveIntegralK_component i.ker (SchemeKTheory.F14.quasiregularCover k n i hP hX)
    (kerOver_member k n i)

name: RiemannRoch.KNFA.ratioHom_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem ratioHom_X (j : κ) :
    ratioHom R M b (X j) = tautChart_ratio R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) (b (Sum.inl j))
proof:
:= by
  simp [ratioHom]

name: RiemannRoch.KNFA.ratioHom_C
statement:
@[simp] theorem ratioHom_C (a : R) :
    ratioHom R M b (C a) = tautChart_scalarHom R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) a
proof:
:= by
  simp [ratioHom]

name: RiemannRoch.KNFA.dehom_apply
statement:
theorem dehom_apply (y : LinearChartRing R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit))) :
    dehom R M b y = a11Lift R M b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit) (HomogeneousLocalization.val y)
proof: := rfl

name: RiemannRoch.KNFA.dehom_ratioHom
statement:
theorem dehom_ratioHom (P : MvPolynomial κ R) :
    dehom R M b (ratioHom R M b P) = rename Sum.inl P
proof:
:= by
  have : (dehom R M b).comp (ratioHom R M b) =
      (rename Sum.inl : MvPolynomial κ R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial (κ ⊕ PUnit.{u + 1}) R).toRingHom := by
    refine MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a => ?_) (fun j => ?_)
    · show dehom R M b (ratioHom R M b (C a)) = rename Sum.inl (C a)
      rw [ratioHom_C, rename_C, dehom_apply]
      exact a11Lift_val_scalar R M b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit) a
    · show dehom R M b (ratioHom R M b (X j)) = rename Sum.inl (X j)
      rw [ratioHom_X, rename_X, dehom_apply, a11Lift_val_ratio, a11Theta_linearForm_basis]
      simp
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun this P

name: RiemannRoch.KNFA.ratioHom_injective
statement: theorem ratioHom_injective : Function.Injective (ratioHom R M b)
proof:
:= by
  intro P Q h
  have h2 := congrArg (dehom R M b) h
  rw [dehom_ratioHom, dehom_ratioHom] at h2
  exact rename_injective _ Sum.inl_injective h2

name: RiemannRoch.KNFA.mk_zero_algebraMap
statement:
theorem mk_zero_algebraMap (x : M) (hf : linearForm R M x ∈ symGrading R M 1) (r : R)
    (h : algebraMap R (SymmetricAlgebra R M) r ∈ symGrading R M (0 • 1)) :
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (symGrading R M) hf 0 (algebraMap R (SymmetricAlgebra R M) r) h =
      tautChart_scalarHom R M x r
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp only [tautChart_scalarHom, RingHom.comp_apply]
  change _ = HomogeneousLocalization.val (HomogeneousLocalization.mk
    ⟨0, ((degreeZeroAlgEquiv (R := R) (M := M)).symm r : symGrading R M 0), 1, one_mem _⟩)
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mk, tautChart_degreeZero_symm_val,
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp

name: RiemannRoch.KNFA.ratio_mem_range
statement:
theorem ratio_mem_range (v : M) :
    tautChart_ratio R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) v ∈ (ratioHom R M b).range
proof:
:= by
  have hv : v ∈ Submodule.span R (Set.range b) := by rw [b.span_eq]; trivial
  refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun v _ =>
    tautChart_ratio R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) v ∈ (ratioHom R M b).range) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hv
  · rintro _ ⟨i | ⟨⟩, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨X i, by simp⟩
    · rw [tautChart_ratio_self]; exact (ratioHom R M b).range.one_mem
  · have h := tautChart_ratio_add R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) 0 0
    rw [add_zero] at h
    have h0 : tautChart_ratio R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) 0 = 0 := by
      have := congrArg (fun t => t - tautChart_ratio R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) 0) h
      simpa using this.symm
    rw [h0]; exact (ratioHom R M b).range.zero_mem
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy
    rw [tautChart_ratio_add]; exact (ratioHom R M b).range.add_mem hx hy
  · intro a x _ hx
    rw [tautChart_ratio_smul]
    exact (ratioHom R M b).range.mul_mem ⟨C a, by simp⟩ hx

name: RiemannRoch.KNFA.mk_mem_range
statement:
theorem mk_mem_range (n : ℕ) (a : SymmetricAlgebra R M) (ha : a ∈ symGrading R M n) :
    ∀ h : a ∈ symGrading R M (n • 1),
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (symGrading R M)
        (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit))) n a h ∈
        (ratioHom R M b).range
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.pow_induction_on_left'
    (M := LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M : M →ₗ[R] SymmetricAlgebra R M))
    (C := fun n a _ => ∀ h : a ∈ symGrading R M (n • 1),
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (symGrading R M)
        (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit))) n a h ∈
        (ratioHom R M b).range) ?_ ?_ ?_ ha
  · intro r h
    rw [mk_zero_algebraMap]
    exact ⟨C r, by simp⟩
  · intro x y i hx hy ihx ihy h
    have hx' : x ∈ symGrading R M (i • 1) := by simpa using hx
    have hy' : y ∈ symGrading R M (i • 1) := by simpa using hy
    have : HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (symGrading R M)
        (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit))) i (x + y) h =
        HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (symGrading R M)
          (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit))) i x hx' +
        HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (symGrading R M)
          (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit))) i y hy' := by
      apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
      simp only [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.val_add,
        Localization.add_mk_self]
    rw [this]
    exact (ratioHom R M b).range.add_mem (ihx hx') (ihy hy')
  · intro m hm i x hx ih h
    obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hm
    have hx' : x ∈ symGrading R M (i • 1) := by simpa using hx
    have : HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (symGrading R M)
        (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit))) i.succ
          (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M v * x) h =
        tautChart_ratio R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) v *
        HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (symGrading R M)
          (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit))) i x hx' := by
      apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
      simp only [tautChart_ratio, HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul,
        HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, Localization.mk_mul]
      rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
      refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
      simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, linearForm]
      change (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) ^ 1 *
          SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) ^ i) *
          (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M v * x) =
        SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) ^ i.succ * (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M v * x)
      rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_comm 1 i]
    rw [this]
    exact (ratioHom R M b).range.mul_mem (ratio_mem_range R M b v) (ih hx')

name: RiemannRoch.KNFA.ratioHom_surjective
statement: theorem ratioHom_surjective : Function.Surjective (ratioHom R M b)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨n, a, ha, rfl⟩ := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_surjective (symGrading R M)
    (linearForm_mem_degree_one R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit))) z
  exact mk_mem_range R M b n a (by simpa using ha) ha

name: RiemannRoch.KNFA.awayPolyEquiv_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem awayPolyEquiv_X (j : κ) :
    awayPolyEquiv R M b (X j) =
      tautChart_ratio R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) (b (Sum.inl j))
proof: := ratioHom_X R M b j

name: RiemannRoch.KNFA.awayPolyEquiv_C
statement:
@[simp] theorem awayPolyEquiv_C (a : R) :
    awayPolyEquiv R M b (C a) = tautChart_scalarHom R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) a
proof:
:=
  ratioHom_C R M b a

name: RiemannRoch.KNFA.isWeaklyRegular_ratios
statement:
theorem isWeaklyRegular_ratios {n : ℕ} (e : Fin n ≃ κ) :
    RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular (LinearChartRing R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)))
      (List.ofFn fun i : Fin n =>
        tautChart_ratio R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) (b (Sum.inl (e i))))
proof:
:= by
  let E : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ≃+* LinearChartRing R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) :=
    (MvPolynomial.renameEquiv R e).toRingEquiv.trans (awayPolyEquiv R M b)
  have hE : ∀ i : Fin n, E (X i) =
      tautChart_ratio R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) (b (Sum.inl (e i))) := by
    intro i
    simp [E]
  have hmap : (List.ofFn fun i : Fin n =>
        tautChart_ratio R M (b (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) (b (Sum.inl (e i)))) =
      (List.ofFn fun i : Fin n => (X i : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)).map E := by
    rw [List.map_ofFn]
    congr 1
    funext i
    simp [hE]
  rw [hmap]
  refine (E.toAddEquiv.isWeaklyRegular_congr
    (List.forall₂_map_right_iff.mpr (List.forall₂_same.mpr (fun r _ x => ?_)))).mp
    (SchemeKTheory.KoszulChartAlgebra.isWeaklyRegular_X_ofFn R n)
  show E (r • x) = E r • E x
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  exact map_mul E r x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K7.sandwichOn_rel
statement:
theorem sandwichOn_rel (P : ProjDivisorDataOn ops cp L B D hL e CB CD hCB hCD) (m : ℕ)
    (x : TotalChow X) :
    sandwichOn ops CD cp hCD m x =
      sandwichOn ops CB cp hCB (m + 1) x - sandwichOn ops CB cp hCB m (totalCapOn ops L hL x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨iso⟩ := P.twist
  haveI := P.isOver
  haveI := P.isClosedImmersion
  haveI : Flat CB.toBase :=
    CB.toBase_flat (CB.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hCB (Nat.succ_pos _))
  haveI : Flat CD.toBase :=
    CD.toBase_flat (CD.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hCD (Nat.succ_pos _))
  haveI : (P.j ≫ CB.toBase).IsOver (Spk k) := by rw [P.comm]; infer_instance
  haveI : IsProper (P.j ≫ CB.toBase) := by rw [P.comm]; infer_instance
  have hpush : totalPushOn ops CD.toBase = totalPushOn ops CB.toBase ∘ₗ totalPushOn ops P.j := by
    rw [← totalPushOn_congr ops P.comm]
    exact cp.push_comp P.j CB.toBase
  have hxi : ∀ y, totalPushOn ops P.j (xiCapOn ops CD y) =
      xiCapOn ops CB (totalPushOn ops P.j y) := by
    intro y
    have h1 := cp.cap_push P.j (CB.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
      (CB.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    have h2 := cp.cap_iso (hasConstantRank_pullback CD.scheme P.j _ 1
      (CB.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))
      (CD.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) ⟨iso⟩
    have h3 := LinearMap.congr_fun h1 y
    rw [h2] at h3
    exact h3
  have hxipow : ∀ (n : ℕ) y, totalPushOn ops P.j ((xiCapOn ops CD ^ n) y) =
      (xiCapOn ops CB ^ n) (totalPushOn ops P.j y) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => intro y; simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro y
      rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, ih, hxi]
  have hpull : ∀ z, pullProjOn ops cp CB hCB (totalCapOn ops L hL z) =
      capPullLineOn ops L hL CB (pullProjOn ops cp CB hCB z) := fun z =>
    LinearMap.congr_fun (cp.cap_pull CB.toBase _ (cp.projBundle_relDim CB hCB) L hL) z
  have e1 : sandwichOn ops CD cp hCD m x =
      totalPushOn ops CB.toBase (totalPushOn ops P.j
        ((xiCapOn ops CD ^ m) (pullProjOn ops cp CD hCD x))) := by
    change totalPushOn ops CD.toBase ((xiCapOn ops CD ^ m) (pullProjOn ops cp CD hCD x)) = _
    rw [hpush]
    rfl
  rw [e1, hxipow, P.push_eq x, LinearMap.sub_apply, map_sub, map_sub]
  have e2 : ∀ r, sandwichOn ops CB cp hCB r x =
      totalPushOn ops CB.toBase ((xiCapOn ops CB ^ r) (pullProjOn ops cp CB hCB x)) :=
    fun r => rfl
  have e3 : sandwichOn ops CB cp hCB m (totalCapOn ops L hL x) =
      totalPushOn ops CB.toBase ((xiCapOn ops CB ^ m)
        (capPullLineOn ops L hL CB (pullProjOn ops cp CB hCB x))) := by
    change totalPushOn ops CB.toBase ((xiCapOn ops CB ^ m)
      (pullProjOn ops cp CB hCB (totalCapOn ops L hL x))) = _
    rw [hpull]
  rw [e2, e3, pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K7.segreOn_rel
statement:
theorem segreOn_rel (P : ProjDivisorDataOn ops cp L B D hL e CB CD hCB hCD) :
    segreOn ops CD cp hCD 0 = segreOn ops CB cp hCB 0 ∧
    ∀ i, segreOn ops CD cp hCD (i + 1) =
      segreOn ops CB cp hCB (i + 1) - segreOn ops CB cp hCB i * totalCapOn ops L hL
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun i => ?_⟩
  · refine LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
    have h := sandwichOn_rel ops cp P e x
    have z : sandwichOn ops CB cp hCB e = 0 :=
      sandwichOn_eq_zero_of_lt ops CB cp hCB (Nat.lt_succ_self e)
    change sandwichOn ops CD cp hCD (e + 0) x = sandwichOn ops CB cp hCB (e + 1 + 0) x
    rw [add_zero, add_zero, h, z]
    simp
  · refine LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
    have h := sandwichOn_rel ops cp P (e + (i + 1)) x
    change sandwichOn ops CD cp hCD (e + (i + 1)) x =
      sandwichOn ops CB cp hCB (e + 1 + (i + 1)) x -
        (sandwichOn ops CB cp hCB (e + 1 + i) * totalCapOn ops L hL) x
    rw [h, Module.End.mul_apply, show e + 1 + i = e + (i + 1) by omega,
      show e + 1 + (i + 1) = e + (i + 1) + 1 by omega]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K7.constRankChernAssignOn'_line
statement:
theorem constRankChernAssignOn'_line [Nonempty X] (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (i : ℕ) :
    constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X L i =
      if i = 0 then 1 else if i = 1 then totalCapOn ops L hL else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [constRankChernAssignOn'_eq ops cp hP L 1 hL, chernOpOn'_line_series ops cp hP L hL]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K7.whitneyConvOn_of_projDivisorDataOn
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  letI : Module ℚ (Module.End ℚ (TotalChow X)) := inferInstance
  letI : DistribSMul ℚ (Module.End ℚ (TotalChow X)) := inferInstance
  obtain ⟨s0, srel⟩ := segreOn_rel ops cp P
  have hu0 : segreOn ops CB cp hCB 0 = 1 := segreOn_zero ops CB cp hCB
  have hv0 : segreOn ops CD cp hCD 0 = 1 := segreOn_zero ops CD cp hCD
  set u := segreSeriesOn ops CB cp hCB with hu
  set v := segreSeriesOn ops CD cp hCD with hv
  have hcu : PowerSeries.constantCoeff u = 1 := by
    simp [hu, segreSeriesOn, ← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, hu0]
  have hcv : PowerSeries.constantCoeff v = 1 := by
    simp [hv, segreSeriesOn, ← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, hv0]
  have hrel := E15.inv_series_rel (totalCapOn ops L hL) u v hcu hcv
    (by simp [hu, hv, segreSeriesOn, s0]) (fun n => by simp [hu, hv, segreSeriesOn, srel n])
  have hL1 := constRankChernAssignOn'_line ops cp hP L hL
  rw [constRankChernAssignOn'_eq ops cp hP B (e + 1 + 1) hB,
    chernOpOn'_eq_chernOfCoverOn ops cp hP CB hB hCB]
  simp_rw [constRankChernAssignOn'_eq ops cp hP D (e + 1) hD,
    chernOpOn'_eq_chernOfCoverOn ops cp hP CD hD hCD, hL1]
  rcases n with _ | n
  · rw [Finset.Nat.antidiagonal_zero, Finset.sum_singleton]
    simp only [chernOfCoverOn, pow_zero, one_smul, if_true, Module.End.one_eq_id,
      LinearMap.id_comp]
    exact (hrel 0).2
  · rw [E15.sum_pattern]
    obtain ⟨h1, -⟩ := hrel n
    simp only [chernOfCoverOn]
    rw [← hv, h1, smul_sub, pow_succ]
    simp only [mul_neg, mul_one, Module.End.mul_eq_comp, LinearMap.comp_smul]
    module

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K7.lineSubWhitneyOn_of_projDivisorGateOn
statement:
theorem lineSubWhitneyOn_of_projDivisorGateOn (hG : ProjDivisorGateOn ops cp hP)
    (hconn : ∀ {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)]
      [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (Cl X)], PreconnectedSpace X) :
    LineSubWhitneyOn (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP)
proof:
:= by
  intro Y _ _ _ _ _ L B D a b w hex hL hB hD
  haveI : PreconnectedSpace Y := hconn
  have hLf : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y L := hL.isFiniteLocallyFree
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hasConstantRank_of_isFiniteLocallyFree_of_preconnected hD
  cases r with
  | zero =>
    intro n
    letI := whitney_isIso_left_of_rank_zero a b w hex hr
    have hi := constRankChernAssignOn'_iso ops cp hP (X := Y) (asIso a)
    have hz : ∀ i, constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP Y D i = if i = 0 then 1 else 0 := by
      intro i
      rw [constRankChernAssignOn'_eq ops cp hP D 0 hr]
      rfl
    rw [← hi]
    simp only [hz]
    exact (whitney_delta_right (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP Y L) n).symm
  | succ e =>
    have hBr : HasConstantRank Y B (e + 1 + 1) :=
      hasConstantRank_of_pointwise_rank B hB _ (fun x => by
        rw [rankAt_add x w hex hLf hD, rankAt_of_hasConstantRank hL,
          rankAt_of_hasConstantRank hr]
        omega)
    obtain ⟨CB, CD, hCB, hCD, ⟨P⟩⟩ := hG a b w hex hL e hBr hr
    haveI : Fact (Cl CB.scheme) := ⟨hP CB hCB⟩
    haveI : Fact (Cl CD.scheme) := ⟨hP CD hCD⟩
    exact whitneyConvOn_of_projDivisorDataOn ops cp hP P hBr hr

theorem whitneyOn_projectiveIntegral_of_closedPos [Infinite k]

    (hB : IsFiniteLocallyFree X B) (hD : IsFiniteLocallyFree X D) :
