name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K7.chernAssignOn_isMultiplicative_projectiveIntegral
statement:
theorem chernAssignOn_isMultiplicative_projectiveIntegral [Infinite k]
    (hT : D37.TwistInvarianceStatement.{u}) (hS : D37.SegreClosedImmersionStatement k)
    (hG : ProjDivisorGateOn (chowOpsOn_projectiveIntegral k) (chowCompatOn_projectiveIntegral k)
      (D37.projBundleClosedPos_projectiveIntegral hT hS)) :
    IsMultiplicativeCharOn (chowOpsOn_projectiveIntegral k)
      (constRankChernAssignOn' (chowOpsOn_projectiveIntegral k)
        (chowCompatOn_projectiveIntegral k) (D37.projBundleClosedPos_projectiveIntegral hT hS))
      (chernLineValOn (chowOpsOn_projectiveIntegral k))
proof:
:= by
  have hP : ProjBundleClosedPos (ProjectiveIntegral k) :=
    D37.projBundleClosedPos_projectiveIntegral hT hS
  have H : LineSubWhitneyOn (constRankChernAssignOn' (chowOpsOn_projectiveIntegral k)
      (chowCompatOn_projectiveIntegral k) hP) :=
    lineSubWhitneyOn_of_projDivisorGateOn (chowOpsOn_projectiveIntegral k)
    (chowCompatOn_projectiveIntegral k) hP hG (by intro X _ _ _ _; exact preconnected_projectiveIntegral' k)
  exact
    { natural := flatNaturalOn_constRankChernAssignOn' _ _ hP (by intro X _ _ _ _; exact preconnected_projectiveIntegral' k)
      iso := fun {X} _ _ _ _ _ {E E'} h ↦ by
        obtain ⟨e⟩ := h
        exact constRankChernAssignOn'_iso _ _ hP e
      line := fun {X} _ _ _ _ _ L hL ↦ by
        funext i
        exact constRankChernAssignOn'_line _ _ hP L hL i
      mult := fun {X} _ _ _ _ _ {A B D} f g w h hA hB hD n ↦
        whitneyOn_projectiveIntegral_of_closedPos hP H f g w h hA hB hD n }

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp_assoc_obj
statement:
theorem pullbackComp_assoc_obj {W X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : W ⟶ X) (g : X ⟶ Y)
 (h : Y ⟶ Z) (M : Z.Modules) :
 (pullbackComp f (g ≫ h)).inv.app M ≫
 (pullback f).map ((pullbackComp g h).inv.app M) ≫
 (pullbackComp f g).hom.app ((pullback h).obj M) ≫
 (pullbackComp (f ≫ g) h).hom.app M = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  have ha := congrArg (fun a => a.app M) (pseudofunctor_associativity f g h)
  simpa using ha

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp_assoc_inv_obj
statement:
theorem pullbackComp_assoc_inv_obj {W X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : W ⟶ X)
    (g : X ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ Z) (M : Z.Modules) :
    (pullbackComp f (g ≫ h)).inv.app M ≫
      (pullback f).map ((pullbackComp g h).inv.app M) =
    (pullbackComp (f ≫ g) h).inv.app M ≫
      (pullbackComp f g).inv.app ((pullback h).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono ((pullbackComp f g).hom.app ((pullback h).obj M))).1
  apply (cancel_mono ((pullbackComp (f ≫ g) h).hom.app M)).1
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc]
  rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_app]
  exact pullbackComp_assoc_obj f g h M

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp_congr_second
statement:
theorem pullbackComp_congr_second {W X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : W ⟶ X)
    {g g' : X ⟶ Y} (hg : g = g') (M : Y.Modules) :
    (pullback f).map ((pullbackCongr hg).hom.app M) ≫
      (pullbackComp f g').hom.app M =
    (pullbackComp f g).hom.app M ≫
      (pullbackCongr (congrArg (fun k => f ≫ k) hg)).hom.app M
proof:
:= by
  cases hg
  simp [pullbackCongr]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp_congr_first
statement:
theorem pullbackComp_congr_first {W X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f f' : W ⟶ X}
    (hf : f = f') (g : X ⟶ Y) (M : Y.Modules) :
    (pullbackCongr hf).hom.app ((pullback g).obj M) ≫
      (pullbackComp f' g).hom.app M =
    (pullbackComp f g).hom.app M ≫
      (pullbackCongr (congrArg (fun k => k ≫ g) hf)).hom.app M
proof:
:= by
  cases hf
  simp [pullbackCongr]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp_assoc_hom_obj
statement:
theorem pullbackComp_assoc_hom_obj {W X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : W ⟶ X)
    (g : X ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ Z) (M : Z.Modules) :
    (pullback f).map ((pullbackComp g h).hom.app M) ≫
      (pullbackComp f (g ≫ h)).hom.app M =
    (pullbackComp f g).hom.app ((pullback h).obj M) ≫
      (pullbackComp (f ≫ g) h).hom.app M
proof:
:= by
  let L := (pullback f).mapIso ((pullbackComp g h).app M) ≪≫
    (pullbackComp f (g ≫ h)).app M
  let R := (pullbackComp f g).app ((pullback h).obj M) ≪≫
    (pullbackComp (f ≫ g) h).app M
  have hi : L.inv = R.inv := pullbackComp_assoc_inv_obj f g h M
  have he : L = R := Iso.ext (by
    apply (cancel_epi L.inv).1
    rw [L.inv_hom_id, hi, R.inv_hom_id]
    rfl)
  exact congrArg Iso.hom he

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp_congr_first_inv
statement:
theorem pullbackComp_congr_first_inv {W X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f f' : W ⟶ X}
    (hf : f = f') (g : X ⟶ Y) (M : Y.Modules) :
    (pullbackCongr (congrArg (fun k => k ≫ g) hf)).hom.app M ≫
      (pullbackComp f' g).inv.app M =
    (pullbackComp f g).inv.app M ≫
      (pullbackCongr hf).hom.app ((pullback g).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  cases hf
  simp [pullbackCongr]
  exact (Category.comp_id _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp_congr_second_inv
statement:
theorem pullbackComp_congr_second_inv {W X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : W ⟶ X)
    {g g' : X ⟶ Y} (hg : g = g') (M : Y.Modules) :
    (pullbackCongr (congrArg (fun k => f ≫ k) hg)).hom.app M ≫
      (pullbackComp f g').inv.app M =
    (pullbackComp f g).inv.app M ≫
      (pullback f).map ((pullbackCongr hg).hom.app M)
proof:
:= by
  cases hg
  simp [pullbackCongr]
  exact (Category.comp_id _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp_assoc_mixed_obj
statement:
theorem pullbackComp_assoc_mixed_obj {W X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : W ⟶ X)
    (g : X ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ Z) (M : Z.Modules) :
    (pullback f).map ((pullbackComp g h).inv.app M) ≫
      (pullbackComp f g).hom.app ((pullback h).obj M) =
    (pullbackComp f (g ≫ h)).hom.app M ≫
      (pullbackComp (f ≫ g) h).inv.app M
proof:
:= by
  have hh := congrArg (fun a => (pullbackComp f (g ≫ h)).hom.app M ≫
    a ≫ (pullbackComp f g).hom.app ((pullback h).obj M))
      (pullbackComp_assoc_inv_obj f g h M)
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_app] at hh
  exact hh.trans (congrArg (fun a => (pullbackComp f (g ≫ h)).hom.app M ≫ a)
    (Category.comp_id ((pullbackComp (f ≫ g) h).inv.app M)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback_transport_cube
statement:
theorem pullback_transport_cube
    {V W W' Y Y' Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (l : V ⟶ W) (f : W ⟶ Y) (k : Y ⟶ Z)
    (a : W ⟶ Y') (q : Y' ⟶ Z)
    (b : V ⟶ W') (r : W' ⟶ Y')
    (hc : f ≫ k = a ≫ q) (ho : b ≫ r = l ≫ a) (M : Z.Modules) :
    (pullback l).map ((pullbackComp f k).hom.app M ≫
      (pullbackCongr hc).hom.app M ≫ (pullbackComp a q).inv.app M) ≫
      (pullbackComp l a).hom.app ((pullback q).obj M) ≫
      (pullbackCongr ho.symm).hom.app ((pullback q).obj M) ≫
      (pullbackComp b r).inv.app ((pullback q).obj M) =
    (pullbackComp l f).hom.app ((pullback k).obj M) ≫
      (pullbackComp (l ≫ f) k).hom.app M ≫
      (pullbackCongr (show (l ≫ f) ≫ k = b ≫ (r ≫ q) from
        by rw [Category.assoc, hc, ← Category.assoc, ← ho, Category.assoc])).hom.app M ≫
      (pullbackComp b (r ≫ q)).inv.app M ≫
      (pullback b).map ((pullbackComp r q).inv.app M)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  rw [reassoc_of% pullbackComp_assoc_mixed_obj l a q M]
  rw [reassoc_of% pullbackComp_congr_second l hc M]
  rw [reassoc_of% pullbackComp_assoc_hom_obj l f k M]
  rw [← reassoc_of% pullbackComp_congr_first_inv ho.symm q M]
  rw [← pullbackComp_assoc_inv_obj b r q M]
  simp only [pullbackCongr, eqToIso.hom, eqToHom_app, eqToHom_trans_assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D12.exists_div_ne_zero_of_cycle_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_div_ne_zero_of_cycle_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (g : DimRelationGenerator X n) {x : X}
    (hx : g.cycle.1 x ≠ 0) : ∃ y : g.Y, g.i y = x ∧ div g.f y ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hx' : x ∈ (properPushforward g.i (div g.f)).support := hx
  rw [properPushforward, pushforward_support_closedImmersion g.i (div g.f) (fun _ ↦ ())
    (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl)] at hx'
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hx'
  exact ⟨y, rfl, hy⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D12.coheight_eq_one_of_div_ne_zero
statement:
theorem coheight_eq_one_of_div_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (g : DimRelationGenerator X n) {y : g.Y}
    (hy : div g.f y ≠ 0) : coheight y = 1
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  apply hy
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.div_eq_ord]
  exact Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one h _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D12.unit_of_proper
statement:
theorem unit_of_proper {n : ℕ} (g : DimRelationGenerator X n) (a : C1Cap.LocalEquations X)
    (ha : IsProperForD g a) {y : g.Y} (hy : div g.f y ≠ 0) :
    IsUnit (a.pullback g.i y)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := coheight_eq_one_of_div_ne_zero g hy
  rw [← IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal]
  intro hm
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hcf⟩ := ha.proper y h1 hm
  apply hy
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.div_eq_ord, ← hcf]
  exact Scheme.ord_algebraMap_eq_zero_of_isUnit h1 hc

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D12.notMem_stalkPrime_aux
statement:
theorem notMem_stalkPrime_aux {n : ℕ} (g : DimRelationGenerator X n) (a : C1Cap.LocalEquations X)
    (ha : IsProperForD g a) {y : g.Y} (hy : div g.f y ≠ 0) (w : X) (h : g.i y ⤳ w)
    (y' : g.Y) (hy' : g.i y' = w) :
    a w ∉ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h
proof:
:= by
  subst hy'
  have hsp : y ⤳ y' := (g.i.isEmbedding.isInducing.specializes_iff).mp h
  have hu := unit_of_proper g a ha hy
  have hassoc := ha.associated hsp
  have hu' : IsUnit ((g.Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes hsp).hom (a.pullback g.i y')) :=
    (hassoc.isUnit_iff).mpr hu
  intro hmem
  rw [Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes, Ideal.mem_comap] at hmem
  have h2 : IsUnit ((g.i.stalkMap y).hom ((X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom (a (g.i y')))) := by
    rw [g.i.stalkSpecializes_stalkMap_apply y y' hsp]
    exact hu'
  exact IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal.mpr (IsLocalHom.map_nonunit _ h2) hmem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D12.notMem_stalkPrime_of_proper
statement:
theorem notMem_stalkPrime_of_proper {n : ℕ} (g : DimRelationGenerator X n)
    (a : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (ha : IsProperForD g a) {x : X} (hx : g.cycle.1 x ≠ 0)
    (z : pointClosureScheme x) :
    a (pointClosureι x z) ∉
      Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι x z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl, hy⟩ := exists_div_ne_zero_of_cycle_ne_zero g hx
  have hz : pointClosureι (g.i y) z ∈ Set.range g.i := by
    have h1 : pointClosureι (g.i y) z ∈ closure {g.i y} := by
      rw [← range_pointClosureι]
      exact ⟨z, rfl⟩
    exact closure_minimal (show ({g.i y} : Set X) ⊆ Set.range g.i from
        Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr ⟨y, rfl⟩)
      g.i.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range h1
  obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := hz
  exact notMem_stalkPrime_aux g a ha hy _ (C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι (g.i y) z) y' hy'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D12.nonvanishing_of_proper
statement:
theorem nonvanishing_of_proper {n : ℕ} (g : DimRelationGenerator X n)
    (a₁ a₂ : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (h₁ : IsProperForD g a₁) (h₂ : IsProperForD g a₂)
    {x : X} (hx : g.cycle.1 x ≠ 0) (z : pointClosureScheme x) :
    a₁ (pointClosureι x z) ∉
      Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι x z) ∧
    a₂ (pointClosureι x z) ∉
      Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι x z)
proof:
:=
  ⟨notMem_stalkPrime_of_proper g a₁ h₁ hx z, notMem_stalkPrime_of_proper g a₂ h₂ hx z⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D12.exists_coheight_one_of_height_succ
statement:
theorem exists_coheight_one_of_height_succ {Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Z] {n : ℕ}
    (h : height (genericPoint Z) = n + 1) : ∃ z : Z, coheight z = 1
proof:
:= by
  set η := genericPoint Z with hη
  have hmax : IsMax η := fun w hw ↦ by
    exact genericPoint_specializes w
  obtain ⟨-, ⟨y, hyη, hy⟩, hall⟩ := height_eq_coe_add_one_iff.mp h
  by_contra hno
  have hcov : ∀ w, y ≤ w → w < η → ∃ w', y ≤ w' ∧ w' < η ∧ w < w' := by
    intro w hyw hwη
    by_contra hc
    push Not at hc
    apply hno
    refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
    have hab : ∀ v, w < v → v = η := fun v hv ↦ by
      by_contra hne
      exact hc v (hyw.trans hv.le) (lt_of_le_not_ge (show v ≤ η from genericPoint_specializes v) fun h' ↦ hne
          ((show v ⤳ η from h').antisymm (genericPoint_specializes v)).eq) hv
    have h0 : coheight η = 0 := hmax.coheight_eq_zero
    apply le_antisymm
    · have : coheight w ≤ ((1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
        rw [coheight_le_coe_iff]
        intro v hv
        rw [hab v hv, h0]
        exact_mod_cast Nat.one_pos
      simpa using this
    · have := coheight_add_one_le hwη
      rw [h0] at this
      simpa using this
  have key : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ w, y ≤ w ∧ w < η ∧ ((m : ℕ∞)) ≤ height w := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => exact ⟨y, le_rfl, hyη, by simp⟩
    | succ m ih =>
      obtain ⟨w, hyw, hwη, hm⟩ := ih
      obtain ⟨w', h1, h2, h3⟩ := hcov w hyw hwη
      refine ⟨w', h1, h2, ?_⟩
      have := height_add_one_le h3
      push_cast
      exact (add_le_add_left hm 1).trans this |>.trans' (by rw [add_comm])
  obtain ⟨w, -, hwη, hm⟩ := key (n + 1)
  have := hall w hwη
  have h2 := hm.trans this
  norm_cast at h2
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D12.exists_coheight_one_pointClosure
statement:
theorem exists_coheight_one_pointClosure {n : ℕ} (x : X) (hx : height x = n + 1) :
    ∃ z : pointClosureScheme x, coheight z = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply exists_coheight_one_of_height_succ (n := n)
  have hgen : genericPoint (pointClosureScheme x) = pointClosureGenericPoint x :=
    ((pointClosureGenericPoint_isGeneric x).eq (genericPoint_spec _)).symm
  have h := height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion (pointClosureι x) (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme x))
  rw [hgen, pointClosureι_genericPoint] at h
  rw [hgen]
  exact h.symm.trans hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D12.exists_forall_ne_zero_of_infinite
statement:
theorem exists_forall_ne_zero_of_infinite {K V : Type*} [Field K] [Infinite K]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] {W : ι → Type*}
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (W i)] [∀ i, Module K (W i)] (φ : ∀ i, V →ₗ[K] W i)
    (hφ : ∀ i, φ i ≠ 0) : ∃ v : V, ∀ i, φ i v ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  have hcov : ⋃ i, ((LinearMap.ker (φ i) : Subspace K V) : Set V) = Set.univ := by
    refine Set.eq_univ_of_forall fun v ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcon v
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, hi⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Subspace.exists_eq_top_of_iUnion_eq_univ hcov
  exact hφ i (LinearMap.ker_eq_top.mp hi)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D12.movingFrames_of_sections
statement:
theorem movingFrames_of_sections (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (n : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ g : DimRelationGenerator X (n + 1), ∃ a₁ a₂ : C1Cap.LocalEquations X,
      IsProperForD g a₁ ∧ IsProperForD g a₂ ∧
      ∀ x : X, height x = n + 1 → g.cycle.1 x ≠ 0 →
        ∃ s : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι x)).obj L, ⊤),
          ∀ z : pointClosureScheme x, coheight z = 1 →
            restrictedEq x a₁ z =
              sectionCoord (sectionFrame L hL x z) s * restrictedEq x a₂ z) :
    MovingFrames L n
proof:
:= fun g ↦ by
  obtain ⟨a₁, a₂, h₁, h₂, hs⟩ := h g
  refine ⟨a₁, a₂, h₁, h₂, fun x hx hne ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨s, hseq⟩ := hs x hx hne
  exact ⟨ClosureFrames.ofSectionProper L hL g a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂ hne
    (exists_coheight_one_pointClosure (k := k) x hx) s hseq⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D12.capDescends_of_sections
statement:
theorem capDescends_of_sections (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (n : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ g : DimRelationGenerator X (n + 1), ∃ a₁ a₂ : C1Cap.LocalEquations X,
      IsProperForD g a₁ ∧ IsProperForD g a₂ ∧
      ∀ x : X, height x = n + 1 → g.cycle.1 x ≠ 0 →
        ∃ s : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι x)).obj L, ⊤),
          ∀ z : pointClosureScheme x, coheight z = 1 →
            restrictedEq x a₁ z =
              sectionCoord (sectionFrame L hL x z) s * restrictedEq x a₂ z) :
    CapDescends (k := k) L hL n
proof:
:=
  capDescends_of_movingFrames (k := k) L hL n (movingFrames_of_sections (k := k) L hL n h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.localGen_resIso
statement:
theorem localGen_resIso {L : X.Modules} {U W : X.Opens} (h : W ≤ U)
    (e : L.over U ≅ (unitMod X).over U) :
    localGen (resIso h e) = L.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (localGen e)
proof:
:= by
  unfold localGen
  have hn := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply e.inv.val
    (Over.homMk (homOfLE h) : Over.mk (homOfLE h) ⟶ Over.mk (𝟙 U)).op (1 : Γ(X, U))
  have h1 : (ConcreteCategory.hom ((SheafOfModules.over (unitMod X) U).val.map
      (Over.homMk (homOfLE h) (Category.comp_id _) : Over.mk (homOfLE h) ⟶ Over.mk (𝟙 U)).op))
      (1 : Γ(X, U)) = (1 : Γ(X, W)) := map_one (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
  rw [h1] at hn
  exact hn

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.genSec_spec
statement:
theorem genSec_spec (U : X.affineOpens) (g : Γ(X, U.1)) (hg : I.ideal U = Ideal.span {g}) :
    (idealModuleι I).app U.1 (genSec I U g hg) = g
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (exists_gen_section I U g (hg ▸ Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self g))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.ι_localGen_resIso
statement:
theorem ι_localGen_resIso (U : X.affineOpens) (g : Γ(X, U.1)) (hg : I.ideal U = Ideal.span {g})
    (hg0 : g ≠ 0) {W : X.Opens} (h : W ≤ U.1) :
    (idealModuleι I).app W (localGen (resIso h (chartTriv I U g hg hg0))) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op g
proof:
:= by
  rw [localGen_resIso, chartTriv, localGen_idealTriv, ι_res, genSec_spec]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.dual_compat
statement:
theorem dual_compat (U0 U1 : X.affineOpens) (g0 g1 : Γ(X, _))
    (hg0 : I.ideal U0 = Ideal.span {g0}) (hg1 : I.ideal U1 = Ideal.span {g1})
    (hne0 : g0 ≠ 0) (hne1 : g1 ≠ 0) (a0 : Γ(X, U0.1)) (a1 : Γ(X, U1.1))
    {W : X.Opens} (h0 : W ≤ U0.1) (h1 : W ≤ U1.1)
    (hcomp : X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h0).op a0 * X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h1).op g1 =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h1).op a1 * X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h0).op g0) :
    X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h0).op a0 • (resIso h0 (chartTriv I U0 g0 hg0 hne0)).hom =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h1).op a1 • (resIso h1 (chartTriv I U1 g1 hg1 hne1)).hom
proof:
:= by
  set τ0 := resIso h0 (chartTriv I U0 g0 hg0 hne0) with hτ0
  set τ1 := resIso h1 (chartTriv I U1 g1 hg1 hne1) with hτ1
  have hw : τ0.hom = (evalAt (idealModule I) W (localGen τ1) τ0.hom) • τ1.hom :=
    hom_eq_smul τ1 τ0.hom
  set w := evalAt (idealModule I) W (localGen τ1) τ0.hom with hwdef
  have hσ : localGen τ1 = w • localGen τ0 := section_eq_smul_localGen τ0 (localGen τ1)
  have hg : X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h1).op g1 = w * X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h0).op g0 := by
    have := congrArg ((idealModuleι I).app W) hσ
    have h2 := ι_smul I w (localGen τ0)
    rw [ι_localGen_resIso] at this
    exact this.trans (h2.trans (congrArg (fun z => w • z)
      (ι_localGen_resIso I U0 g0 hg0 hne0 h0)))
  have hsc : X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h0).op a0 * w = X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h1).op a1 := by
    by_cases hW : Nonempty W
    · haveI := hW
      haveI : IsDomain Γ(X, W) := IsIntegral.component_integral W
      have hne := res_ne_zero h0 g0 hne0
      rw [hg] at hcomp
      refine mul_right_cancel₀ hne ?_
      rw [← hcomp]
      ring
    · haveI := subsingleton_sections_of_not_nonempty W hW
      exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [hw, smul_smul, hsc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.localDual_eq
statement:
theorem localDual_eq (U : X.affineOpens) (g : Γ(X, U.1)) (hg : I.ideal U = Ideal.span {g})
    (hg0 : g ≠ 0) (a : Γ(X, U.1)) :
    (localDual I U g hg hg0 a : (idealModule I).over U.1 ⟶ (unitMod X).over U.1) =
      a • (chartTriv I U g hg hg0).hom
proof:
:= by
  change a • (resIso (leOfHom (𝟙 U.1)) (chartTriv I U g hg hg0)).hom = _
  congr 1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.exists_glued_dual
statement:
theorem exists_glued_dual (U0 U1 : X.affineOpens) (hcov : U0.1 ⊔ U1.1 = ⊤)
    (g0 : Γ(X, U0.1)) (g1 : Γ(X, U1.1))
    (hg0 : I.ideal U0 = Ideal.span {g0}) (hg1 : I.ideal U1 = Ideal.span {g1})
    (hne0 : g0 ≠ 0) (hne1 : g1 ≠ 0) (a0 : Γ(X, U0.1)) (a1 : Γ(X, U1.1))
    (hcomp : X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U0.1 ⊓ U1.1 ≤ U0.1)).op a0 *
        X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U0.1 ⊓ U1.1 ≤ U1.1)).op g1 =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U0.1 ⊓ U1.1 ≤ U1.1)).op a1 *
        X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U0.1 ⊓ U1.1 ≤ U0.1)).op g0) :
    ∃ F : (lineBundleDual X (idealModule I)).val.obj (op ⊤),
      (lineBundleDual X (idealModule I)).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : U0.1 ≤ ⊤)).op F =
        localDual I U0 g0 hg0 hne0 a0 ∧
      (lineBundleDual X (idealModule I)).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : U1.1 ≤ ⊤)).op F =
        localDual I U1 g1 hg1 hne1 a1
proof:
:= by
  let T : TopCat.Sheaf Ab X := ⟨(lineBundleDual X (idealModule I)).presheaf,
    (lineBundleDual X (idealModule I)).isSheaf⟩
  let Uf : Bool → X.Opens := fun b => cond b U1.1 U0.1
  let sf : ∀ b, T.1.obj (op (Uf b)) := fun b => by
    cases b
    · exact localDual I U0 g0 hg0 hne0 a0
    · exact localDual I U1 g1 hg1 hne1 a1
  have keyW : ∀ (W : X.Opens) (h0 : W ≤ U0.1) (h1 : W ≤ U1.1),
      Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X h0
        (localDual I U0 g0 hg0 hne0 a0 : (idealModule I).over U0.1 ⟶ (unitMod X).over U0.1) =
      Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X h1
        (localDual I U1 g1 hg1 hne1 a1 : (idealModule I).over U1.1 ⟶ (unitMod X).over U1.1) := by
    intro W h0 h1
    have hW : W ≤ U0.1 ⊓ U1.1 := le_inf h0 h1
    have hcW := congrArg (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op) hcomp
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, presheaf_res_comp, presheaf_res_comp, presheaf_res_comp,
      presheaf_res_comp] at hcW
    have key := dual_compat I U0 U1 g0 g1 hg0 hg1 hne0 hne1 a0 a1 h0 h1 hcW
    have e0 : ∀ (U : X.affineOpens) (g : Γ(X, U.1)) (hg : I.ideal U = Ideal.span {g})
        (hne : g ≠ 0) (a : Γ(X, U.1)) (h : W ≤ U.1),
        Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X h
          (a • (chartTriv I U g hg hne).hom) =
        X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op a • (resIso h (chartTriv I U g hg hne)).hom := by
      intro U g hg hne a h
      rw [LineBundleDual.smul_def, LineBundleDual.smul_def, Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_comp, res_mulSectionHom]
      rfl
    rw [localDual_eq, localDual_eq, e0, e0]
    exact key
  have hc : TopCat.Presheaf.IsCompatible T.1 Uf sf := by
    intro i j
    cases i <;> cases j
    · rfl
    · exact keyW _ _ _
    · exact (keyW _ _ _).symm
    · rfl
  have hcover : (⊤ : X.Opens) ≤ ⨆ b, Uf b := by
    rw [iSup_bool_eq]
    show _ ≤ U1.1 ⊔ U0.1
    rw [sup_comm, hcov]
  obtain ⟨F, hF, -⟩ := T.existsUnique_gluing' Uf ⊤ (fun b => homOfLE le_top) hcover sf hc
  exact ⟨F, hF false, hF true⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.coeff_localDual
statement:
theorem coeff_localDual (U : X.affineOpens) (g : Γ(X, U.1)) (hg : I.ideal U = Ideal.span {g})
    (hg0 : g ≠ 0) (a : Γ(X, U.1)) (F : (lineBundleDual X (idealModule I)).val.obj (op ⊤))
    (hF : (lineBundleDual X (idealModule I)).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : U.1 ≤ ⊤)).op F =
      localDual I U g hg hg0 a) :
    sectionOverTrivializationCoefficient (secHomG (M := lineBundleDual X (idealModule I)) F) U.1 (dualFr I U g hg hg0) = a
proof:
:= by
  unfold sectionOverTrivializationCoefficient
  have h1 := secHomG_app_one (M := lineBundleDual X (idealModule I)) F U.1
  refine Eq.trans (congrArg (fun m => ((dualFr I U g hg hg0).hom.val.app (topOver U.1)).hom m)
    (h1.trans hF)) ?_
  haveI := dualTriv_isIso (chartTriv I U g hg hg0)
  have h := congrArg (fun q => (q.val.app (topOver U.1)).hom a)
    (IsIso.hom_inv_id (dualTriv (chartTriv I U g hg hg0)))
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.exists_two_sections_of_charts
statement:
theorem exists_two_sections_of_charts (J : X.IdealSheafData) (hI : I ≠ ⊥) (hJ : J ≠ ⊥)
    (U0 U1 : X.affineOpens) (hcov : U0.1 ⊔ U1.1 = ⊤)
    (g0 : Γ(X, U0.1)) (g1 : Γ(X, U1.1))
    (hg0 : I.ideal U0 = Ideal.span {g0}) (hg1 : I.ideal U1 = Ideal.span {g1})
    (hne0 : g0 ≠ 0) (hne1 : g1 ≠ 0) (a0 : Γ(X, U0.1)) (a1 : Γ(X, U1.1))
    (hJ0 : J.ideal U0 = Ideal.span {a0}) (hJ1 : J.ideal U1 = Ideal.span {a1})
    (hcomp : X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U0.1 ⊓ U1.1 ≤ U0.1)).op a0 *
        X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U0.1 ⊓ U1.1 ≤ U1.1)).op g1 =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U0.1 ⊓ U1.1 ≤ U1.1)).op a1 *
        X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U0.1 ⊓ U1.1 ≤ U0.1)).op g0) :
    ∃ (L : X.Modules) (_ : HasConstantRank X L 1) (σc σi : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L),
      SectionIsRegular σc ∧ SectionIsRegular σi ∧
        sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σc = I ∧ sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σi = J
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨F, hF0, hF1⟩ := exists_glued_dual I U0 U1 hcov g0 g1 hg0 hg1 hne0 hne1 a0 a1 hcomp
  let Uf : Bool → X.affineOpens := fun b => cond b U1 U0
  have hUf : ⨆ b, (Uf b).1 = ⊤ := by
    rw [iSup_bool_eq]
    show U1.1 ⊔ U0.1 = ⊤
    rw [sup_comm, hcov]
  
  have hex : ∀ x : X, ∃ V : X.Opens, x ∈ V ∧
      Nonempty ((idealModule I).over V ≅ (unitMod X).over V) := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ U0.1
    · exact ⟨U0.1, hx, ⟨chartTriv I U0 g0 hg0 hne0⟩⟩
    · have : x ∈ (U0.1 ⊔ U1.1 : X.Opens) := by rw [hcov]; trivial
      rcases this with h | h
      · exact absurd h hx
      · exact ⟨U1.1, h, ⟨chartTriv I U1 g1 hg1 hne1⟩⟩
  choose V hxV he using hex
  have hcovV : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop V := by
    apply (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := X) _).2
    ext x
    simp only [TopologicalSpace.Opens.coe_iSup, Set.mem_iUnion, TopologicalSpace.Opens.coe_top,
      Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
    exact ⟨x, hxV x⟩
  have hI1 : HasConstantRank X (ConormalSheaf.idealModule I) 1 :=
    hasConstantRank_one_of_triv V hcovV (fun x => (he x).some)
  have hL : HasConstantRank X (lineBundleDual X (ConormalSheaf.idealModule I)) 1 :=
    lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank _ hI1
  haveI : (lineBundleDual X (ConormalSheaf.idealModule I)).IsLocallyFree :=
    hL.isFiniteLocallyFree.isLocallyFree
  haveI : (lineBundleDual X (ConormalSheaf.idealModule I)).IsFinitePresentation :=
    IsFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation X hL.isFiniteLocallyFree
  have hline : IsLocalLineFrame (lineBundleDual X (ConormalSheaf.idealModule I)) := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ U0.1
    · exact ⟨U0, hx, ⟨dualFr I U0 g0 hg0 hne0⟩⟩
    · have : x ∈ (U0.1 ⊔ U1.1 : X.Opens) := by rw [hcov]; trivial
      rcases this with h | h
      · exact absurd h hx
      · exact ⟨U1, h, ⟨dualFr I U1 g1 hg1 hne1⟩⟩
  have hEqI : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf (canonSection I) = I := by
    refine Scheme.IdealSheafData.ext_of_iSup_eq_top Uf hUf (fun b => ?_)
    cases b
    · show (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf (canonSection I)).ideal U0 = I.ideal U0
      rw [sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_affine_overIso (canonSection I) U0
        (dualFr I U0 g0 hg0 hne0)]
      exact (congrArg (fun t => Ideal.span {t}) (coeff_canon I U0 g0 hg0 hne0 _
        (genSec_spec I U0 g0 hg0))).trans hg0.symm
    · show (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf (canonSection I)).ideal U1 = I.ideal U1
      rw [sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_affine_overIso (canonSection I) U1
        (dualFr I U1 g1 hg1 hne1)]
      exact (congrArg (fun t => Ideal.span {t}) (coeff_canon I U1 g1 hg1 hne1 _
        (genSec_spec I U1 g1 hg1))).trans hg1.symm
  have hEqJ : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf (secHomG (M := lineBundleDual X (idealModule I)) F) =
      J := by
    refine Scheme.IdealSheafData.ext_of_iSup_eq_top Uf hUf (fun b => ?_)
    cases b
    · show (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf (secHomG (M := lineBundleDual X (idealModule I)) F)).ideal
        U0 = J.ideal U0
      rw [sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_affine_overIso _ U0 (dualFr I U0 g0 hg0 hne0),
        coeff_localDual I U0 g0 hg0 hne0 a0 F hF0]
      exact hJ0.symm
    · show (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf (secHomG (M := lineBundleDual X (idealModule I)) F)).ideal
        U1 = J.ideal U1
      rw [sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_affine_overIso _ U1 (dualFr I U1 g1 hg1 hne1),
        coeff_localDual I U1 g1 hg1 hne1 a1 F hF1]
      exact hJ1.symm
  have hreg : ∀ (K : X.IdealSheafData), K ≠ ⊥ → ∀ (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶
      lineBundleDual X (idealModule I)), sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = K → SectionIsRegular σ := by
    intro K hK σ hσ
    refine sectionIsRegular_of_integral hline σ (fun V hV h0 => ?_)
    apply ideal_ne_bot_of_ne_bot hK V hV
    rw [← hσ, eq_bot_iff]
    refine (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_le_affine σ V).trans ?_
    change sectionEvaluationIdeal (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ V (1 : Γ(X, V))) ≤ ⊥
    exact ((congrArg sectionEvaluationIdeal h0).trans sectionEvaluationIdeal_zero).le
  exact ⟨_, hL, canonSection I, secHomG (M := lineBundleDual X (idealModule I)) F,
    hreg I hI _ hEqI, hreg J hJ _ hEqJ, hEqI, hEqJ⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.bottSymm_isSymmetric
statement: theorem bottSymm_isSymmetric (j N : ℕ) : (bottSymm j N).IsSymmetric
proof:
:= by
  intro e
  simp only [bottSymm, bottFactor, map_prod, map_sum, map_pow, MvPolynomial.rename_X]
  exact Fintype.prod_equiv e _ _ fun _ ↦ rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.exists_bottPoly
statement:
theorem exists_bottPoly (j N : ℕ) :
    ∃ g : MvPolynomial (Fin N) ℤ, MvPolynomial.esymmAlgHom (Fin N) ℤ N g =
      ⟨bottSymm j N, bottSymm_isSymmetric j N⟩
proof:
:=
  MvPolynomial.esymmAlgHom_surjective (σ := Fin N) ℤ (n := N) (by simp) _

name: SchemeKTheory.aeval_esymm_bottPoly
statement:
theorem aeval_esymm_bottPoly (j N : ℕ) :
    MvPolynomial.aeval (fun i : Fin N ↦ MvPolynomial.esymm (Fin N) ℤ (i + 1)) (bottPoly j N) =
      bottSymm j N
proof:
:=
  (MvPolynomial.esymmAlgHom_apply (σ := Fin N) (R := ℤ) (bottPoly j N)).symm.trans
    (congrArg Subtype.val (exists_bottPoly j N).choose_spec)

name: SchemeKTheory.aeval_bottPoly
statement:
theorem aeval_bottPoly (j N : ℕ) (x : Fin N → A) :
    MvPolynomial.aeval (fun i : Fin N ↦ (Finset.univ.val.map x).esymm (i + 1)) (bottPoly j N) =
      ∏ i, bottFactor j (x i)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (fun i : Fin N ↦ (Finset.univ.val.map x).esymm (i + 1)) =
      fun i : Fin N ↦ MvPolynomial.aeval x (MvPolynomial.esymm (Fin N) ℤ (i + 1)) := by
    funext i
    rw [MvPolynomial.aeval_esymm_eq_multiset_esymm]
  rw [h, ← MvPolynomial.aeval_bind₁, ← MvPolynomial.aeval_eq_bind₁, aeval_esymm_bottPoly]
  simp [bottSymm, bottFactor, map_prod, map_sum, map_pow, MvPolynomial.aeval_X]

name: SchemeKTheory.ringHom_aeval
statement:
theorem ringHom_aeval {B : Type v} [CommRing B] (φ : A →+* B) {N : ℕ} (x : Fin N → A)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin N) ℤ) :
    φ (MvPolynomial.aeval x p) = MvPolynomial.aeval (fun i ↦ φ (x i)) p
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (MvPolynomial.comp_aeval (R := ℤ) (f := x) φ.toIntAlgHom) p

name: SchemeKTheory.esymm_add
statement:
theorem esymm_add (s t : Multiset A) (n : ℕ) :
    (s + t).esymm n = ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, s.esymm p.1 * t.esymm p.2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← SchemeProjectiveBundle.coeff_prod_one_add_C_mul_X, Multiset.map_add, Multiset.prod_add,
    Polynomial.coeff_mul]
  simp only [SchemeProjectiveBundle.coeff_prod_one_add_C_mul_X]

name: SchemeKTheory.univ_val_map_append
statement:
theorem univ_val_map_append {α : Type*} {s t : ℕ} (a : Fin s → α) (b : Fin t → α) :
    Finset.univ.val.map (Fin.append a b) = Finset.univ.val.map a + Finset.univ.val.map b
proof:
:= by
  simp [Fin.univ_val_map, List.ofFn_fin_append]

name: SchemeKTheory.esymm_const_one
statement:
theorem esymm_const_one (r k : ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ.val.map fun _ : Fin r ↦ (1 : A)).esymm k = (r.choose k : A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← SchemeProjectiveBundle.coeff_prod_one_add_C_mul_X, Multiset.map_map]
  simp only [Function.comp_def, map_one, one_mul]
  rw [Multiset.map_const', Multiset.prod_replicate, Finset.card_val, Finset.card_univ,
    Fintype.card_fin, add_comm, Polynomial.coeff_X_add_one_pow]

name: SchemeKTheory.aeval_bottPoly_choose
statement:
theorem aeval_bottPoly_choose (j r : ℕ) :
    MvPolynomial.aeval (fun i : Fin r ↦ ((r.choose (i + 1) : ℕ) : A)) (bottPoly j r) =
      (j : A) ^ r
proof:
:= by
  have h : (fun i : Fin r ↦ ((r.choose (i + 1) : ℕ) : A)) =
      fun i : Fin r ↦ (Finset.univ.val.map fun _ : Fin r ↦ (1 : A)).esymm (i + 1) := by
    funext i
    rw [esymm_const_one]
  rw [h, aeval_bottPoly]
  simp [bottFactor]

name: SchemeKTheory.subsingleton_of_isUnit_zero
statement:
theorem subsingleton_of_isUnit_zero {R : Type v} [CommRing R] (h : IsUnit (0 : R)) :
    Subsingleton R
proof:
:=
  subsingleton_of_zero_eq_one (isUnit_zero_iff.mp h)

name: SchemeKTheory.rank_unique
statement:
theorem rank_unique {E : X.Modules} {r s : ℕ} (hr : HasConstantRank X E r)
    (hs : HasConstantRank X E s) : r = s ∨ Subsingleton (K0 X)
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy r s with h | h | h
  · right
    have h0 := lambdaClass_eq_zero_of_rank_lt X E r hr s h
    have hu := isUnit_lambdaClass_top X E s hs
    exact subsingleton_of_isUnit_zero (h0 ▸ hu)
  · exact Or.inl h
  · right
    have h0 := lambdaClass_eq_zero_of_rank_lt X E s hs r h
    have hu := isUnit_lambdaClass_top X E r hr
    exact subsingleton_of_isUnit_zero (h0 ▸ hu)

name: SchemeKTheory.rank_shortExact
statement:
theorem rank_shortExact {K F Q : X.Modules} {s r t : ℕ} (hK : HasConstantRank X K s)
    (hF : HasConstantRank X F r) (hQ : HasConstantRank X Q t) (f : K ⟶ F) (g : F ⟶ Q)
    (zero : f ≫ g = 0) (hS : (ShortComplex.mk f g zero).ShortExact) :
    r = s + t ∨ Subsingleton (K0 X)
proof:
:= by
  have hW := lambdaClass_shortExact hK.isFiniteLocallyFree hF.isFiniteLocallyFree
    hQ.isFiniteLocallyFree f g zero hS
  have hvan : ∀ p : ℕ × ℕ, (s < p.1 ∨ t < p.2) →
      lambdaClass X K hK.isFiniteLocallyFree p.1 * lambdaClass X Q hQ.isFiniteLocallyFree p.2 =
        0 := by
    rintro p (h | h)
    · rw [lambdaClass_eq_zero_of_rank_lt X K s hK p.1 h, zero_mul]
    · rw [lambdaClass_eq_zero_of_rank_lt X Q t hQ p.2 h, mul_zero]
  rcases lt_trichotomy r (s + t) with h | h | h
  · right
    have h0 := lambdaClass_eq_zero_of_rank_lt X F r hF (s + t) h
    rw [hW, Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem (s, t) (Finset.mem_antidiagonal.2 rfl)
      (fun p hp hne ↦ hvan p (by
        rw [Finset.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
        by_contra hc
        simp only [not_or, not_lt] at hc
        exact hne (Prod.ext (by omega) (by omega))))] at h0
    have hu := (isUnit_lambdaClass_top X K s hK).mul (isUnit_lambdaClass_top X Q t hQ)
    exact subsingleton_of_isUnit_zero (h0 ▸ hu)
  · exact Or.inl h
  · right
    have hu := isUnit_lambdaClass_top X F r hF
    rw [hW, Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun p hp ↦ hvan p (by
      rw [Finset.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
      by_contra hc
      simp only [not_or, not_lt] at hc
      omega))] at hu
    exact subsingleton_of_isUnit_zero hu

name: SchemeKTheory.bottBundle_rank_congr
statement:
theorem bottBundle_rank_congr {E : X.Modules} {r s : ℕ} (hr : HasConstantRank X E r)
    (hs : HasConstantRank X E s) :
    bottBundle j E hr.isFiniteLocallyFree r = bottBundle j E hs.isFiniteLocallyFree s
proof:
:= by
  rcases rank_unique hr hs with h | h
  · subst h; rfl
  · exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.flatPullbackK0_bottBundle
statement:
theorem flatPullbackK0_bottBundle {Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [Flat q] {r : ℕ} (E : X.Modules)
    (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) (ℓ : Fin r → K0 Y)
    (hlam : ∀ n, flatPullbackK0 q (lambdaClass X E hE n) = (Finset.univ.val.map ℓ).esymm n) :
    flatPullbackK0 q (bottBundle j E hE r) = ∏ i, bottFactor j (ℓ i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply, bottBundle, ringHom_aeval, ← aeval_bottPoly j r ℓ]
  congr 2
  funext i
  rw [flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply, hlam]

name: SchemeKTheory.bottBundle_rankOne
statement:
theorem bottBundle_rankOne (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) :
    bottBundle j L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree 1 = bottFactor j (k0ClassOf X L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (fun i : Fin 1 ↦ lambdaClass X L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree (i + 1)) =
      fun i : Fin 1 ↦ (Finset.univ.val.map
        fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ k0ClassOf X L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree).esymm (i + 1) := by
    funext i
    rw [Fin.fin_one_eq_zero i]
    simp [SchemeProjectiveBundle.esymm_one', lambdaClass_one]
  rw [bottBundle, h, aeval_bottPoly, Fin.prod_univ_one]

name: SchemeKTheory.bottBundle_shortExact
statement:
theorem bottBundle_shortExact {K F Q : X.Modules} {s r t : ℕ} (hK : HasConstantRank X K s)
    (hF : HasConstantRank X F r) (hQ : HasConstantRank X Q t) (f : K ⟶ F) (g : F ⟶ Q)
    (zero : f ≫ g = 0) (hS : (ShortComplex.mk f g zero).ShortExact) :
    bottBundle j F hF.isFiniteLocallyFree r =
      bottBundle j K hK.isFiniteLocallyFree s * bottBundle j Q hQ.isFiniteLocallyFree t
proof:
:= by
  rcases rank_shortExact hK hF hQ f g zero hS with hr | hsub
  · subst hr
    obtain ⟨Y, q, _, _, L, hL, M, hM, hinj, hlamK, hlamQ⟩ :=
      SchemeProjectiveBundle.splitting_principle_two SchemeProjectiveBundle.pbInjectiveHyp hK hQ
    let ℓ : Fin s → K0 Y := fun i ↦ k0ClassOf Y (L i) (hL i).isFiniteLocallyFree
    let μ : Fin t → K0 Y := fun i ↦ k0ClassOf Y (M i) (hM i).isFiniteLocallyFree
    have hlamF : ∀ n, flatPullbackK0 q (lambdaClass X F hF.isFiniteLocallyFree n) =
        (Finset.univ.val.map (Fin.append ℓ μ)).esymm n := by
      intro n
      rw [lambdaClass_shortExact hK.isFiniteLocallyFree hF.isFiniteLocallyFree
          hQ.isFiniteLocallyFree f g zero hS n, map_sum, univ_val_map_append, esymm_add]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ ↦ ?_
      rw [flatPullbackK0_mul, hlamK, hlamQ]
    apply hinj
    rw [flatPullbackK0_mul, flatPullbackK0_bottBundle j q F _ _ hlamF,
      flatPullbackK0_bottBundle j q K _ ℓ hlamK, flatPullbackK0_bottBundle j q Q _ μ hlamQ,
      Fin.prod_univ_add]
    simp only [Fin.append_left, Fin.append_right]
  · exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.mk_bottBundle
statement:
theorem mk_bottBundle (hnil : LambdaNilpotent X) {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ}
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    Ideal.Quotient.mk (nilradical (K0 X)) (bottBundle j E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree r) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (nilradical (K0 X)) ((j : K0 X) ^ r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bottBundle, ringHom_aeval, ← aeval_bottPoly_choose j r, ringHom_aeval]
  congr 2
  funext i
  exact hnil E r hE (i + 1)

name: SchemeKTheory.isUnit_bottBundle
statement:
theorem isUnit_bottBundle (hnil : LambdaNilpotent X) {E : X.Modules} {r : ℕ}
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    IsUnit (algebraMap (K0 X) (Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 X))
      (bottBundle j E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree r))
proof:
:= by
  have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap (K0 X) (Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 X)) ((j : K0 X) ^ r)) := by
    rw [map_pow]
    exact (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit _).pow r
  have hn := (mem_nilradical.1 (Ideal.Quotient.eq.1 (mk_bottBundle j hnil hE))).map
    (algebraMap (K0 X) (Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 X)))
  have := hn.isUnit_add_left_of_commute hu (Commute.all _ _)
  rw [← map_add] at this
  convert this using 2
  · rfl
  · ring

name: SchemeKTheory.coe_bottGen
statement:
theorem coe_bottGen (hrank : ConstantRankGenerators X) (hnil : LambdaNilpotent X)
    (E : {M : X.Modules // IsFiniteLocallyFree X M}) {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E.1 r) :
    (bottGen j X hrank hnil E : Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 X)) =
      algebraMap _ _ (bottBundle j E.1 hE.isFiniteLocallyFree r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bottGen, IsUnit.unit_spec, bottBundle_rank_congr j (hrank E.1 E.2).choose_spec hE]

name: SchemeKTheory.bott_classOf
statement:
theorem bott_classOf (hrank : ConstantRankGenerators X) (hnil : LambdaNilpotent X)
    (E : X.Modules) {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    ((bott j X hrank hnil (Multiplicative.ofAdd (k0ClassOf X E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree)) :
        (Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 X))ˣ) : Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 X)) =
      algebraMap _ _ (bottBundle j E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree r)
proof:
:= by
  change ((Additive.toMul (bottAdd j X hrank hnil (k0ClassOf X E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree)) :
    (Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 X))ˣ) : Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 X)) = _
  rw [bottAdd, k0ClassOf, ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf, ExactGrothendieck.lift_classOf,
    toMul_ofMul]
  exact coe_bottGen j X hrank hnil ⟨E, hE.isFiniteLocallyFree⟩ hE

name: SchemeKTheory.bott_line
statement:
theorem bott_line (hrank : ConstantRankGenerators X) (hnil : LambdaNilpotent X)
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) :
    ((bott j X hrank hnil (Multiplicative.ofAdd (k0ClassOf X L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree)) :
        (Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 X))ˣ) : Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 X)) =
      algebraMap (K0 X) (Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 X))
        (∑ a ∈ Finset.range j, k0ClassOf X L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree ^ a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bott_classOf j X hrank hnil L hL, bottBundle_rankOne j L hL]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.bott_pull
statement:
theorem bott_pull {W Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian W] [IsNoetherian Z] (f : W ⟶ Z)
    (φ : K0 Z →+* K0 W)
    (hφ : ∀ (E : Z.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree Z E),
      φ (k0ClassOf Z E hE) =
        k0ClassOf W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E) (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global f E hE))
    (pullLoc : Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 Z) →+* Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 W))
    (pullLoc_alg : ∀ a, pullLoc (algebraMap _ _ a) = algebraMap _ _ (φ a))
    (hrankW : ConstantRankGenerators W) (hnilW : LambdaNilpotent W)
    (hrankZ : ConstantRankGenerators Z) (hnilZ : LambdaNilpotent Z) (a : K0 Z) :
    ((bott j W hrankW hnilW (Multiplicative.ofAdd (φ a)) :
        (Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 W))ˣ) : Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 W)) =
      pullLoc (bott j Z hrankZ hnilZ (Multiplicative.ofAdd a))
proof:
:= by
  let lhs : K0 Z →+ Additive (Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 W))ˣ :=
    (bottAdd j W hrankW hnilW).comp φ.toAddMonoidHom
  let rhs : K0 Z →+ Additive (Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 W))ˣ :=
    (MonoidHom.toAdditive (Units.map pullLoc.toMonoidHom)).comp (bottAdd j Z hrankZ hnilZ)
  have h : lhs = rhs := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    intro E
    obtain ⟨r, hE⟩ := hrankZ E.1 E.2
    have hfE := hasConstantRank_pullback W f E.1 r hE
    change Additive.ofMul (bott j W hrankW hnilW (Multiplicative.ofAdd
        (φ (k0ClassOf Z E.1 hE.isFiniteLocallyFree)))) =
      Additive.ofMul (Units.map pullLoc.toMonoidHom
        (bott j Z hrankZ hnilZ (Multiplicative.ofAdd (k0ClassOf Z E.1 hE.isFiniteLocallyFree))))
    congr 1
    apply Units.ext
    rw [Units.coe_map, RingHom.toMonoidHom_eq_coe, MonoidHom.coe_coe, bott_classOf j Z _ _ E.1 hE,
      pullLoc_alg, hφ]
    rw [bott_classOf j W _ _ _ hfE, bottBundle, bottBundle, ringHom_aeval φ]
    refine congrArg _ (congrArg (fun x ↦ MvPolynomial.aeval x (bottPoly j r)) (funext fun i ↦ ?_))
    rw [lambdaClass_pullback_of f φ hφ]
  have h' := congrArg (fun ψ : K0 Z →+ Additive (Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 W))ˣ ↦
    ((Additive.toMul (ψ a) : (Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 W))ˣ) :
      Localization.Away ((j : ℕ) : K0 W))) h
  exact h'

name: KSpecialization.zeroι_app_res
statement:
theorem zeroι_app_res (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    (zeroι t).app U (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op t) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op t ∈ (zeroIdeal t).ideal U := by
    change _ ∈ (Ideal.span {t}).map (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op).hom
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (Ideal.subset_span rfl)
  rw [← Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_subschemeι_app] at h
  exact h

name: KSpecialization.zeroι_appTop
statement: theorem zeroι_appTop : (zeroι t).appTop t = 0
proof:
:= by
  let Z := zeroScheme t
  let i := zeroι t
  have hcov : (⊤ : Z.Opens) ≤ ⨆ U : Y.affineOpens, i ⁻¹ᵁ (U : Y.Opens) := by
    intro z _
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨V, hV, rfl⟩, hxV, -⟩ :=
      Y.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open (Set.mem_univ (i z)) isOpen_univ
    exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨V, hV⟩, hxV⟩
  refine TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' Z.sheaf (fun U : Y.affineOpens ↦ i ⁻¹ᵁ (U : Y.Opens)) ⊤
    (fun _ ↦ homOfLE le_top) hcov _ _ fun U ↦ ?_
  have h0 := zeroι_app_res t U
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, i.naturality, CommRingCat.comp_apply] at h0
  exact h0.trans (map_zero _).symm

name: KSpecialization.res_res
statement:
theorem res_res (M : X.Modules) {U V W : X.Opens} (h1 : U ≤ V) (h2 : V ≤ W) (x : Γ(M, W)) :
    M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h1).op (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h2).op x) =
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h1.trans h2)).op x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

name: KSpecialization.res_id
statement:
theorem res_id (M : X.Modules) {U : X.Opens} (x : Γ(M, U)) :
    M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_refl U)).op x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (homOfLE (le_refl U)) = 𝟙 U from rfl, op_id, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
  rfl

name: KSpecialization.restr_app
statement:
theorem restr_app {M N : X.Modules} (φ : M ⟶ N) {U V : X.Opens} (h : U ≤ V) (x : Γ(M, V)) :
    N.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (φ.app V x) = φ.app U (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x)
proof:
:= by
  have := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (φ.mapPresheaf.naturality (homOfLE h).op) x
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, Scheme.Modules.mapPresheaf_app] at this
  exact this.symm

name: KSpecialization.preimage_bigOpen
statement: theorem preimage_bigOpen (V : Z.Opens) : i ⁻¹ᵁ bigOpen i V = V
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  change i.base z ∈ (i.base '' (V : Set Z)ᶜ)ᶜ ↔ z ∈ V
  rw [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_image]
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hz
    exact h ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
  · rintro hz ⟨w, hw, hwz⟩
    exact hw (i.isClosedEmbedding.injective hwz ▸ hz)

name: KSpecialization.le_bigOpen_iff
statement: theorem le_bigOpen_iff (U : Y.Opens) (V : Z.Opens) : U ≤ bigOpen i V ↔ i ⁻¹ᵁ U ≤ V
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    calc i ⁻¹ᵁ U ≤ i ⁻¹ᵁ bigOpen i V := fun z hz ↦ h hz
      _ = V := preimage_bigOpen i V
  · intro h y hy
    change y ∈ (i.base '' (V : Set Z)ᶜ)ᶜ
    rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    exact hw (h hy)

name: KSpecialization.preimApp_res
statement:
theorem preimApp_res (U : Y.Opens) (V : Z.Opens) (h : i ⁻¹ᵁ U ≤ V) (x : Γ(F, V)) :
    G.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (preimApp i φ V x) =
      φ.app U (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x)
proof:
:= by
  have hUB : U ≤ bigOpen i V := (le_bigOpen_iff i U V).mpr h
  let y : Γ(F, i ⁻¹ᵁ bigOpen i V) := F.presheaf.map (homOfLE (preimage_bigOpen i V).le).op x
  calc G.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (preimApp i φ V x)
      = G.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op
          (G.presheaf.map (homOfLE (preimage_bigOpen i V).ge).op (φ.app (bigOpen i V) y)) := rfl
    _ = ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj G).presheaf.map (homOfLE hUB).op
          (φ.app (bigOpen i V) y) := res_res G _ _ _
    _ = φ.app U (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj F).presheaf.map (homOfLE hUB).op y) :=
          restr_app φ hUB y
    _ = φ.app U (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x) := by
          congr 1
          exact res_res F _ _ x

name: KSpecialization.preimApp_naturality
statement:
theorem preimApp_naturality {V' V : Z.Opens} (h : V' ≤ V) (x : Γ(F, V)) :
    preimApp i φ V' (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x) =
      G.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (preimApp i φ V x)
proof:
:= by
  have e' := preimage_bigOpen i V'
  have h1 : i ⁻¹ᵁ bigOpen i V' ≤ V := e'.le.trans h
  calc preimApp i φ V' (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x)
      = G.presheaf.map (homOfLE e'.ge).op
          (φ.app (bigOpen i V') (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE e'.le).op
            (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x))) := rfl
    _ = G.presheaf.map (homOfLE e'.ge).op
          (φ.app (bigOpen i V') (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE h1).op x)) := by
          rw [res_res F]
    _ = G.presheaf.map (homOfLE e'.ge).op
          (G.presheaf.map (homOfLE h1).op (preimApp i φ V x)) := by
          rw [preimApp_res i φ _ V h1]
    _ = G.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (preimApp i φ V x) := by
          rw [res_res G]

name: KSpecialization.preimApp_smul
statement:
theorem preimApp_smul (V : Z.Opens) (r : Γ(Z, V)) (x : Γ(F, V)) :
    preimApp i φ V (r • x) = r • preimApp i φ V x
proof:
:= by
  let ι := {A : Y.affineOpens // i ⁻¹ᵁ (A : Y.Opens) ≤ V}
  have hcov : V ≤ ⨆ A : ι, i ⁻¹ᵁ (A.1 : Y.Opens) := by
    intro z hz
    have hzB : i.base z ∈ bigOpen i V := by
      change z ∈ i ⁻¹ᵁ bigOpen i V
      rw [preimage_bigOpen]; exact hz
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨W, hW, rfl⟩, hxW, hWB⟩ :=
      Y.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open hzB (bigOpen i V).isOpen
    exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨⟨W, hW⟩, (le_bigOpen_iff i W V).mp hWB⟩, hxW⟩
  refine TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' (⟨G.presheaf, G.isSheaf⟩ : TopCat.Sheaf Ab Z)
    (fun A : ι ↦ i ⁻¹ᵁ (A.1 : Y.Opens)) V (fun A ↦ homOfLE A.2) hcov _ _ fun A ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := i.app_surjective (A.1 : Y.Opens) A.1.2
    (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE A.2).op r)
  change G.presheaf.map (homOfLE A.2).op (preimApp i φ V (r • x)) =
    G.presheaf.map (homOfLE A.2).op (r • preimApp i φ V x)
  rw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul, preimApp_res, Scheme.Modules.map_smul,
    preimApp_res, ← hs]
  exact Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul φ s (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE A.2).op x)

name: KSpecialization.preim_app
statement:
theorem preim_app (V : Z.Opens) (x : Γ(F, V)) :
    (preim i φ).app V x = preimApp i φ V x
proof: := rfl

name: KSpecialization.tMul_app_apply
statement:
theorem tMul_app_apply {X : Scheme.{u}} (s : Γ(X, ⊤)) (M : X.Modules) (U : X.Opens)
    (m : Γ(M, U)) : (tMul s M).app U m = (show Γ(X, U) from tRes s (op U)) • m
proof: := rfl

name: KSpecialization.smul_eq_zero_of_tMul
statement:
theorem smul_eq_zero_of_tMul {X : Scheme.{u}} (s : Γ(X, ⊤)) (M : X.Modules) (h : tMul s M = 0)
    (U : X.Opens) (m : Γ(M, U)) : (show Γ(X, U) from tRes s (op U)) • m = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tMul_app_apply, h]; rfl

name: KSpecialization.specMap_essImage_of_iso
statement:
theorem specMap_essImage_of_iso (φ : R →+* S) (E : (Spec (.of R)).Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent]
    (N : ModuleCat S)
    (lin : (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).obj N ≅
      (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj E).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤)) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).essImage E
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsIso (Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓ (R := .of R) E) :=
    Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent (R := .of R) E
  let i3 : (tilde.functor (.of R)).obj ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj E).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤)) ≅ E :=
    asIso (Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓ (R := .of R) E)
  exact ⟨(tilde.functor (.of S)).obj N, ⟨(tildePushforwardSpecMapIso φ N).symm ≪≫
    (tilde.functor (.of R)).mapIso lin ≪≫ i3⟩⟩

name: KSpecialization.specMap_essImage
statement:
theorem specMap_essImage (φ : R →+* S) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ)
    (E : (Spec (.of R)).Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent] (a : R)
    (hker : RingHom.ker φ = Ideal.span {a})
    (hE : tMul ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv a) E = 0) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).essImage E
proof:
:= by
  let M : ModuleCat (CommRingCat.of R) := (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj E).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤)
  have htors : Module.IsTorsionBySet R M (RingHom.ker φ : Set R) := by
    rintro m ⟨r, hr⟩
    change r • m = 0
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, hker] at hr
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hr
    rw [← hc, mul_smul]
    have : a • m = 0 := smul_eq_zero_of_tMul _ E hE ⊤ m
    rw [this, smul_zero]
  letI : Module (R ⧸ RingHom.ker φ) M := htors.module
  let e : S →+* R ⧸ RingHom.ker φ := (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective hφ).symm.toRingHom
  letI : Module S M := Module.compHom M e
  let N : ModuleCat S := ModuleCat.of S M
  let lin : M ≃ₗ[R] (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).obj N :=
    { AddEquiv.refl M with
      map_smul' := fun r m ↦ by
        change r • m = (e (φ r)) • m
        simp only [e, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe,
          RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective_symm_apply]
        exact (htors.mk_smul r m).symm }
  exact specMap_essImage_of_iso φ E N lin.toModuleIso.symm

name: KSpecialization.tMul_pushforward
statement:
theorem tMul_pushforward {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) (s : Γ(Y, ⊤)) (E : X.Modules) :
    tMul s ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).obj E) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).map (tMul (g.appTop s) E)
proof:
:= by
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro U
  ext m
  have h0 : g.app U.unop (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op s) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op (g.appTop s) := by
    rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, g.naturality, CommRingCat.comp_apply]
    rfl
  have key : ∀ (r : Γ(Y, U.unop)) (m : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).obj E, U.unop)),
      r • m = (g.app U.unop r • (@id Γ(E, g ⁻¹ᵁ U.unop) m) : Γ(E, g ⁻¹ᵁ U.unop)) :=
    fun _ _ => rfl
  refine (key (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op s) m).trans ?_
  rw [h0]
  rfl

name: KSpecialization.tMul_pushforward_eq_zero_of
statement:
theorem tMul_pushforward_eq_zero_of {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) (s : Γ(Y, ⊤))
    (s' : Γ(X, ⊤)) (hs : g.appTop s = s') (E : X.Modules) (hE : tMul s' E = 0) :
    tMul s ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).obj E) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [tMul_pushforward, hs, hE, Functor.map_zero]

name: KSpecialization.affine_essImage
statement:
theorem affine_essImage {X' Y' : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine Y'] (f : X' ⟶ Y') [IsClosedImmersion f]
    (E : Y'.Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent] (s : Γ(Y', ⊤))
    (hker : RingHom.ker f.appTop.hom = Ideal.span {s}) (hE : tMul s E = 0) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).essImage E
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsAffine X' := isAffine_of_isAffineHom f
  have hφ : Function.Surjective f.appTop.hom := f.app_surjective ⊤ (isAffineOpen_top Y')
  let E'' := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward Y'.isoSpec.hom).obj E
  haveI : E''.IsQuasicoherent := isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isAffine _ E
  have hE'' : tMul ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of Γ(Y', ⊤))).inv s) E'' = 0 :=
    tMul_pushforward_eq_zero_of _ _ s (by
      change Y'.isoSpec.hom.appTop ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(Y', ⊤)).inv s) = s
      simp [Scheme.isoSpec]) E hE
  obtain ⟨F0, ⟨e0⟩⟩ := specMap_essImage f.appTop.hom hφ E'' s hker hE''
  refine ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pushforward X'.isoSpec.inv).obj F0, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  have hcomm : X'.isoSpec.inv ≫ f =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f.appTop.hom) ≫ Y'.isoSpec.inv :=
    (Scheme.isoSpec_inv_naturality f).symm
  exact (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp X'.isoSpec.inv f).app F0 ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr hcomm).app F0 ≪≫
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp _ Y'.isoSpec.inv).app F0).symm ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward Y'.isoSpec.inv).mapIso e0 ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp Y'.isoSpec.hom Y'.isoSpec.inv).app E ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr Y'.isoSpec.hom_inv_id).app E ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardId Y').app E

name: KSpecialization.tMul_restrict
statement:
theorem tMul_restrict {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion f] (s : Γ(Y, ⊤))
    (E : Y.Modules) :
    tMul (f.appTop s) ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj E) =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).map (tMul s E)
proof:
:= by
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro U
  ext m
  have h1 : (f.appIso U.unop).hom (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op s) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op (f.appTop s) := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.appIso_hom, CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← CommRingCat.comp_apply _ (f.app _),
      f.naturality, CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
    rfl
  have key : ∀ (r : Γ(X, U.unop)) (m : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj E, U.unop)),
      r • m = ((f.appIso U.unop).inv r • (@id Γ(E, f ''ᵁ U.unop) m) : Γ(E, f ''ᵁ U.unop)) :=
    fun _ _ => rfl
  refine (key (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op (f.appTop s)) m).trans ?_
  rw [← h1, ← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Iso.hom_inv_id, CommRingCat.id_apply]
  rfl

name: KSpecialization.ker_zeroι_restrict_appTop
proof:
:= by
  let V : Y.Opens := W
  haveI : IsAffine V := W.2
  let U' : Y.Opens := V.ι ''ᵁ ⊤
  have hU' : IsAffineOpen U' := (isAffineOpen_top V).image_of_isOpenImmersion V.ι
  have hinj : Function.Injective ((zeroScheme t).presheaf.map
      (eqToHom (image_morphismRestrict_preimage (zeroι t) V ⊤)).op).hom :=
    ((zeroScheme t).presheaf.mapIso
      (eqToIso (image_morphismRestrict_preimage (zeroι t) V ⊤)).op
      ).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.injective
  rw [morphismRestrict_appTop]
  erw [CommRingCat.hom_comp]
  refine (RingHom.ker_comp_of_injective _ hinj).trans ?_
  refine (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_subschemeι_app (I := zeroIdeal t) ⟨U', hU'⟩).trans ?_
  change (Ideal.span {t}).map (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op).hom = _
  rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
  rfl

name: KSpecialization.zeroι_restrict_killed
statement:
theorem zeroι_restrict_killed (E : Y.Modules) (hE : tMul t E = 0) (W : Y.Opens) :
    tMul (W.ι.appTop t) ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj E) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [tMul_restrict, hE, Functor.map_zero]

name: KSpecialization.isIso_adjUnit_zeroι
statement:
theorem isIso_adjUnit_zeroι (E : Y.Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent] (hE : tMul t E = 0) :
    IsIso (ProjectionFormula.adjUnit (zeroι t) E)
proof:
:= by
  let i := zeroι t
  let U : Y.affineOpens → Y.Opens := fun W ↦ (W : Y.Opens)
  have hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y).CoversTop U :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := Y) U).2 (iSup_affineOpens_eq_top Y)
  refine moduleHom_isIso_of_over_cover _ U hU fun W ↦ ?_
  rw [over_isIso_iff_restrictFunctor_map_isIso, restrictFunctor_map_isIso_iff_pullback_map_isIso]
  haveI : IsAffine (W : Y.Opens) := W.2
  obtain ⟨F, ⟨e⟩⟩ := affine_essImage (i ∣_ (W : Y.Opens))
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (W : Y.Opens).ι).obj E) ((W : Y.Opens).ι.appTop t)
    (ker_zeroι_restrict_appTop t W) (zeroι_restrict_killed t E hE W)
  have hu : IsIso (ProjectionFormula.adjUnit (i ∣_ (W : Y.Opens))
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (W : Y.Opens).ι).obj E)) := by
    change IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (i ∣_ (W : Y.Opens))).unit.app _)
    exact (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (i ∣_ (W : Y.Opens))).isIso_unit_app_of_iso
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (W : Y.Opens).ι).app E).symm ≪≫ e.symm)
  have hres := ProjectionFormula.adjUnit_restrict i (W : Y.Opens) E
  have : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (W : Y.Opens).ι).map (ProjectionFormula.adjUnit i E) ≫
      (pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso i (W : Y.Opens)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj E)).hom) := by
    rw [hres]
    have h2 : IsIso ((pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict i (W : Y.Opens)).hom.app E) :=
      ((pullbackBaseChangeSquareMorphismRestrict i (W : Y.Opens)).app E).isIso_hom
    exact @IsIso.comp_isIso _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hu (@Functor.map_isIso _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ h2)
  exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right _ (pullbackRestrictPushforwardIso i (W : Y.Opens)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj E)).hom

name: KSpecialization.pullback_zeroι_shortExact
statement:
theorem pullback_zeroι_shortExact (T : ShortComplex Y.Modules) (hT : T.ShortExact)
    [T.X₁.IsQuasicoherent] [T.X₂.IsQuasicoherent]
    (h₁ : tMul t T.X₁ = 0) (h₂ : tMul t T.X₂ = 0) :
    (T.map (Scheme.Modules.pullback (zeroι t))).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  let i := zeroι t
  haveI := hT.mono_f
  haveI := hT.epi_g
  have ex : (T.map (Scheme.Modules.pullback i)).Exact :=
    hT.exact.map_of_epi_of_preservesCokernel _ inferInstance inferInstance
  haveI := isIso_adjUnit_zeroι t T.X₁ h₁
  haveI := isIso_adjUnit_zeroι t T.X₂ h₂
  have hn := ProjectionFormula.adjUnit_naturality i T.f
  have heq : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).map T.f) =
      inv (ProjectionFormula.adjUnit i T.X₁) ≫ T.f ≫ ProjectionFormula.adjUnit i T.X₂ := by
    rw [hn, IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  have hm : Mono ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).map T.f)) := by
    rw [heq]; infer_instance
  haveI : Mono ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).map T.f) :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).mono_of_mono_map hm
  exact { exact := ex, mono_f := this,
          epi_g := inferInstanceAs (Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).map T.g)) }

name: KSpecialization.pullFibre_classOf
statement:
theorem pullFibre_classOf (E : {M : Y.Modules // Killed (IsCoherentLike Y) (tNatTrans t) M}) :
    pullFibre t (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ E) =
      ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ (fibrePullObject t E)
proof:
:=
  ExactGrothendieck.map_classOf _ _ E

name: KSpecialization.killed_zero
statement: theorem killed_zero : Killed (IsCoherentLike Y) (tNatTrans t) (0 : Y.Modules)
proof:
:=
  ⟨inferInstanceAs (0 : Y.Modules).IsFinitePresentation, (isZero_zero _).eq_of_src _ _⟩

name: KSpecialization.pullFibre_comp_pushZero
statement: theorem pullFibre_comp_pushZero : (pullFibre t).comp (pushZero t) = AddMonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  refine ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _ fun F => ?_
  rw [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, pushFibre_classOf, pullFibre_classOf, AddMonoidHom.id_apply]
  haveI : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (zeroι t)).Full := (pushforwardFullyFaithful (zeroι t)).full
  haveI : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (zeroι t)).Faithful :=
    (pushforwardFullyFaithful (zeroι t)).faithful
  haveI : IsIso (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (zeroι t)).counit :=
    Adjunction.counit_isIso_of_R_fully_faithful _
  have hc : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (zeroι t)).counit.app F.1) :=
    NatIso.isIso_app_of_isIso _ _
  exact subcategoryClassOf_iso _ (IsCoherentLike (zeroScheme t)) _ _
    (inferInstanceAs (0 : (zeroScheme t).Modules).IsFinitePresentation) (isZero_zero _)
    (@asIso _ _ _ _ ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (zeroι t)).counit.app F.1) hc)

name: KSpecialization.pushZero_comp_pullFibre
statement: theorem pushZero_comp_pullFibre : (pushZero t).comp (pullFibre t) = AddMonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  refine ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _ fun E => ?_
  rw [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, pullFibre_classOf, pushFibre_classOf, AddMonoidHom.id_apply]
  letI : E.1.IsFinitePresentation := E.2.1
  haveI := isIso_adjUnit_zeroι t E.1 E.2.2
  exact subcategoryClassOf_iso _ (Killed (IsCoherentLike Y) (tNatTrans t)) _ _
    (killed_zero t) (isZero_zero _) (asIso (ProjectionFormula.adjUnit (zeroι t) E.1)).symm

name: KSpecialization.zeroGysin_classOf
statement:
theorem zeroGysin_classOf (E : Y.Modules) (hE : IsCoherentLike Y E) :
    zeroGysin t (g0ClassOf Y E hE) =
      ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ (fibrePullObject t ⟨cokernel (tMul t E),
          killed_cokernel _ kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike hE⟩) -
        ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ (fibrePullObject t ⟨kernel (tMul t E),
          killed_kernel _ kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike hE⟩)
proof:
:= by
  rw [zeroGysin, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, schemeGysin_classOf, map_sub]
  unfold subcategoryClassOf
  rw [pullFibre_classOf, pullFibre_classOf]

name: KSpecialization.exists_pushforward_iso_of_killed
statement:
theorem exists_pushforward_iso_of_killed (E : Y.Modules) [E.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hE : tMul t E = 0) :
    ∃ F : (zeroScheme t).Modules, IsCoherentLike (zeroScheme t) F ∧
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (zeroι t)).obj F ≅ E)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isIso_adjUnit_zeroι t E hE
  exact ⟨_, pullback_isFinitePresentation_global (zeroι t) E,
    ⟨(asIso (ProjectionFormula.adjUnit (zeroι t) E)).symm⟩⟩

name: KSpecialization.zeroGysin_comp_finitePushforward
statement:
theorem zeroGysin_comp_finitePushforward :
    (zeroGysin t).comp (finitePushforward (zeroι t)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [zeroGysin, AddMonoidHom.comp_assoc,
    schemeGysin_comp_finitePushforward t (zeroι t) (zeroι_appTop t), AddMonoidHom.comp_zero]

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45.specMap_coord
statement:
theorem specMap_coord {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (ρ : R[X] →+* S) :
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of S)).hom.hom
      ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ρ)).appTop.hom
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R[X])).inv.hom (Polynomial.X : R[X]))) = ρ Polynomial.X
proof:
:= by
  have h := Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality (CommRingCat.ofHom ρ)
  have h2 := congr(($h).hom (Polynomial.X : R[X]))
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom] at h2
  rw [← h2]
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Iso.inv_hom_id]
  rfl

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45.X_mul_eq_zero
statement: theorem X_mul_eq_zero {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (r : R[X]) (h : Polynomial.X * r = 0) : r = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  have := congr_arg (fun p : R[X] => p.coeff (n + 1)) h
  simpa using this

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45.lineAffine_toχ
statement:
theorem lineAffine_toχ (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    GlobalCompletion.lineAffineι Y U ≫ lineχ Y k φ =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.mapRingHom (kAlg Y k φ U)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold GlobalCompletion.lineAffineι
  rw [Category.assoc]
  change _ ≫ (RelativeSpec.affineι Y (algebraData Y ⊥) U ≫ toLineOver Y ⊥ k φ) = _
  rw [affineι_toLineOver']
  rw [Iso.inv_comp_eq]
  unfold GlobalCompletion.lineAffineIso
  rw [asIso_hom, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  rfl

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45.line_chart
statement:
theorem line_chart (x : line Y) :
    ∃ (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (e : Spec R ⟶ line Y), IsOpenImmersion e ∧ x ∈ Set.range e ∧
      ∀ r : R, (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).hom.hom ((e.appTop).hom (lineT Y k φ)) * r = 0 → r = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨V, hV, rfl⟩, hxV, -⟩ := Y.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open
    (Set.mem_univ (lineπ Y x)) isOpen_univ
  let U : Y.affineOpens := ⟨V, hV⟩
  refine ⟨.of Γ(Y, U.1)[X], GlobalCompletion.lineAffineι Y U, inferInstance, ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨z, -, hz⟩ := Scheme.exists_preimage_of_isPullback
      (GlobalCompletion.isPullback_lineAffine Y U) (⟨lineπ Y x, hxV⟩ : U.1) x rfl
    exact ⟨z, hz⟩
  · intro r hr
    have h1 : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of Γ(Y, U.1)[X])).hom.hom
        ((GlobalCompletion.lineAffineι Y U).appTop.hom (lineT Y k φ)) = Polynomial.X := by
      unfold lineT
      rw [coordOf_comp, lineAffine_toχ]
      unfold coordOf
      rw [specMap_coord]
      simp
    rw [h1] at hr
    exact X_mul_eq_zero r hr

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45.subAffine_toχ
statement:
theorem subAffine_toχ (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    RelativeSpec.affineι Y (quotientPolynomialData Y J) U ≫ subschemeToLineGlobal Y J ≫
        lineχ Y k φ =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (((toLineHom Y J).app U).toRingHom.comp
        (lineHom Y ⊥ k φ U)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  change (RelativeSpec.affineι Y (quotientPolynomialData Y J) U ≫ (toLineHom Y J).map) ≫ _ = _
  rw [RelativeSpec.Hom.affineι_map, Category.assoc]
  change _ ≫ (RelativeSpec.affineι Y (algebraData Y ⊥) U ≫ toLineOver Y ⊥ k φ) = _
  rw [affineι_toLineOver', ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45.sub_chart
statement:
theorem sub_chart (x : subschemeUGlobal Y J) :
    ∃ (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (e : Spec R ⟶ subschemeUGlobal Y J), IsOpenImmersion e ∧
      x ∈ Set.range e ∧
      ∀ r : R, (Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).hom.hom ((e.appTop).hom (subT Y J k φ)) * r = 0 → r = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨V, hV, rfl⟩, hxV, -⟩ := Y.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open
    (Set.mem_univ (RelativeSpec.toBase Y (quotientPolynomialData Y J) x)) isOpen_univ
  let U : Y.affineOpens := ⟨V, hV⟩
  refine ⟨_, RelativeSpec.affineι Y (quotientPolynomialData Y J) U, inferInstance, ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨z, -, hz⟩ := Scheme.exists_preimage_of_isPullback
      (RelativeSpec.isPullback_affine Y (quotientPolynomialData Y J) U)
      (⟨RelativeSpec.toBase Y (quotientPolynomialData Y J) x, hxV⟩ : U.1) x rfl
    exact ⟨z, hz⟩
  · intro r hr
    have h1 : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of ((quotientPolynomialData Y J).ring U))).hom.hom
        ((RelativeSpec.affineι Y (quotientPolynomialData Y J) U).appTop.hom (subT Y J k φ)) =
          (Polynomial.X : (Γ(Y, U.1) ⧸ J.ideal U)[X]) := by
      unfold subT lineT
      rw [← appTop_comp_apply, coordOf_comp, Category.assoc, subAffine_toχ]
      unfold coordOf
      rw [specMap_coord]
      have h := RingHom.congr_fun (toLineHom_comp_structureMap Y J U) (Polynomial.X)
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply] at h
      have h' : (mapRingHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.ideal U))) (Polynomial.X : Γ(Y, U.1)[X]) =
        Polynomial.X := by simp
      have h2 := h.trans h'
      have e : lineHom Y ⊥ k φ U Polynomial.X =
          (structureMap Γ(Y, U.1) (⊥ : Ideal Γ(Y, U.1))) Polynomial.X := by
        simp [lineHom]
      change ((toLineHom Y J).app U) (lineHom Y ⊥ k φ U Polynomial.X) = Polynomial.X
      rw [e]
      exact h2
    rw [h1] at hr
    exact X_mul_eq_zero r hr

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45.hbc_line
statement:
theorem hbc_line
    (hmonoL : ∀ E : (line Y).Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFree (line Y) E → Mono (tMul (lineT Y k φ) E))
    (V : (subschemeUGlobal Y J).Modules) (hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree (subschemeUGlobal Y J) V)
    (hmonoV : Mono (tMul (subT Y J k φ) V))
    (y : K0 (line Y))
    (hy : k0ToG0 (line Y) y = finitePushforward (subschemeToLineGlobal Y J)
      (g0ClassOf (subschemeUGlobal Y J) V hV.isFinitePresentation)) :
    k0ToG0 Y (pullbackK0 (lineS Y k φ) y) =
      finitePushforward J.subschemeι
        (k0ToG0 J.subscheme (pullbackK0 (subS Y J k φ) (k0ClassOf _ V hV)))
proof:
:= by
  set t := lineT Y k φ with ht
  set s := subT Y J k φ with hs
  set Ft := subschemeToLineGlobal Y J with hFt
  have hkill : (zeroι s ≫ Ft).appTop.hom t = 0 := by
    rw [appTop_comp_apply]; exact zeroι_appTop s
  let Fz : zeroScheme s ⟶ zeroScheme t := liftZero t (zeroι s ≫ Ft) hkill
  have hsq : Fz ≫ zeroι t = zeroι s ≫ Ft := liftZero_zeroι t _ hkill
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion Fz := by
    haveI : IsClosedImmersion (Fz ≫ zeroι t) := by rw [hsq]; infer_instance
    exact IsClosedImmersion.of_comp_isClosedImmersion Fz (zeroι t)
  haveI : Mono (tMul (Ft.appTop.hom t) V) := hmonoV
  letI : V.IsFinitePresentation := hV.isFinitePresentation
  let E := cokernel (tMul (Ft.appTop.hom t) V)
  haveI : E.IsFinitePresentation := cokernel_isFinitePresentation _
  have hE : tMul s E = 0 :=
    ExactGrothendieck.PrincipalGysin.app_cokernel_eq_zero (tNatTrans s) V
  haveI := isIso_adjUnit_zeroι s E hE
  let G : (zeroScheme s).Modules := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (zeroι s)).obj E
  have hG : IsCoherentLike (zeroScheme s) G := pullback_isFinitePresentation_global (zeroι s) E
  let e : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (zeroι s)).obj G ≅ E :=
    (asIso (ProjectionFormula.adjUnit (zeroι s) E)).symm
  have key := KSpecialization.CIIL3.hbc_principal t Ft hmonoL (zeroι s) Fz hsq V hV.isFinitePresentation G hG e y hy
  let eL := lineZeroIso Y k φ
  let eW := subZeroIso Y J k φ
  have hSL : eL.inv ≫ zeroι t = lineS Y k φ := zeroSchemeIso_inv_zeroι _ _ _ _ _ _
  have hSW : eW.inv ≫ zeroι s = subS Y J k φ := zeroSchemeIso_inv_zeroι _ _ _ _ _ _
  have hc : Fz ≫ eL.hom = eW.hom ≫ J.subschemeι := by
    change Fz ≫ zeroι t ≫ lineπ Y = (zeroι s ≫ polynomialToClosedBase Y J) ≫ J.subschemeι
    rw [← Category.assoc, hsq, Category.assoc, Category.assoc,
      (isPullback_subschemeLine Y J).w.symm]
  have h3 : flatPullbackG0 eL.inv = finitePushforward eL.hom :=
    ARRG45C.flatPullbackG0_iso_eq_finitePushforward_inv eL.symm
  have hL : k0ToG0 Y (pullbackK0 (lineS Y k φ) y) =
      finitePushforward (eW.hom ≫ J.subschemeι) (g0ClassOf _ G hG) := by
    calc k0ToG0 Y (pullbackK0 (lineS Y k φ) y)
        = k0ToG0 Y (pullbackK0 eL.inv (pullbackK0 (zeroι t) y)) := by
          rw [← hSL, pullbackK0_comp_apply]
      _ = flatPullbackG0 eL.inv (k0ToG0 _ (pullbackK0 (zeroι t) y)) :=
          ARRG45C.k0ToG0_pullbackK0 _ _
      _ = finitePushforward eL.hom (finitePushforward Fz (g0ClassOf _ G hG)) := by
          rw [key, h3]
      _ = finitePushforward (Fz ≫ eL.hom) (g0ClassOf _ G hG) := by
          rw [ARRG45C.finitePushforward_comp]; rfl
      _ = finitePushforward (eW.hom ≫ J.subschemeι) (g0ClassOf _ G hG) := by
          rw [ARRG45C.finitePushforward_congr hc]
  rw [hL, ARRG45C.finitePushforward_comp, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
  congr 1
  have h4 : finitePushforward eW.hom = flatPullbackG0 eW.inv :=
    (ARRG45C.flatPullbackG0_iso_eq_finitePushforward_inv eW.symm).symm
  rw [h4, ← hSW, ← pullbackK0_comp_apply, ARRG45C.k0ToG0_pullbackK0, pullbackK0_classOf,
    k0ToG0_classOf]
  congr 1
  have hiso := isIso_pullback_cokernel_π s V
  exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso (zeroScheme s).Modules
    (IsCoherentLike (zeroScheme s)) _ _
    (show IsCoherentLike (zeroScheme s) (0 : (zeroScheme s).Modules) from
      inferInstanceAs (0 : (zeroScheme s).Modules).IsFinitePresentation) (isZero_zero _)
    (asIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (zeroι s)).map (cokernel.π (tMul s V)))).symm

    (hmonoL : ∀ E : (line Y).Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFree (line Y) E → Mono (tMul (lineT Y k φ) E))
    (V : (subschemeTotalGlobal Y J).Modules) (hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree (subschemeTotalGlobal Y J) V)
    (hmonoV : Mono (tMul (subT Y J k φ) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (subschemeTιGlobal Y J)).obj V)))
    (m : K0 (GlobalCompletion.totalGlobal Y J))
    (hm : k0ToG0 _ m = finitePushforward (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)
      (g0ClassOf (subschemeTotalGlobal Y J) V hV.isFinitePresentation)) :
    k0ToG0 Y (pullbackK0 (lineS Y k φ ≫ GlobalCompletion.lineTι Y J) m) =
      finitePushforward J.subschemeι
        (k0ToG0 J.subscheme (pullbackK0 (subS Y J k φ ≫ subschemeTιGlobal Y J)
          (k0ClassOf _ V hV)))
proof:
:= by
  have hV' := pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global (subschemeTιGlobal Y J) V hV
  have hy : k0ToG0 (line Y) (pullbackK0 (GlobalCompletion.lineTι Y J) m) =
      finitePushforward (subschemeToLineGlobal Y J)
        (g0ClassOf (subschemeUGlobal Y J) _ hV'.isFinitePresentation) := by
    rw [ARRG45C.k0ToG0_pullbackK0, hm,
      ARRG45C.flatPullbackG0_finitePushforward_openSquare (isPullback_lineTι_subschemeTotal Y J),
      flatPullbackG0_classOf]
  have := hbc_line Y J k φ hmonoL _ hV' hmonoV _ hy
  rw [pullbackK0_comp_apply] at this
  rw [← pullbackK0_comp_apply (subS Y J k φ), pullbackK0_classOf]

name: KSpecialization.ARRG45.hbc0_K0
statement:
theorem hbc0_K0 [IsLocallyNoetherian (GlobalCompletion.totalGlobal Y J)]
    (resM : ResolutionRegularClosedF15.Resolution (GlobalCompletion.totalGlobal Y J))
    (resY : ResolutionRegularClosedF15.Resolution Y) (w : K0 (subschemeTotalGlobal Y J)) :
    pullbackK0 (lineS Y k φ ≫ GlobalCompletion.lineTι Y J)
        (resM.res (finitePushforward (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)
          (k0ToG0 (subschemeTotalGlobal Y J) w))) =
      resY.res (finitePushforward J.subschemeι
        (k0ToG0 J.subscheme (pullbackK0 (subS Y J k φ ≫ subschemeTιGlobal Y J) w)))
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (k0ToG0 Y) := fun a b h => by
    have := congrArg resY.res h
    simpa [← AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, resY.left] using this
  apply hinj
  rw [show k0ToG0 Y (resY.res _) = _ from DFunLike.congr_fun resY.right _]
  have key : (k0ToG0 Y).comp ((pullbackK0 (lineS Y k φ ≫ GlobalCompletion.lineTι Y J)).comp
      (resM.res.comp ((finitePushforward (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)).comp
        (k0ToG0 (subschemeTotalGlobal Y J))))) =
      (finitePushforward J.subschemeι).comp ((k0ToG0 J.subscheme).comp
        ((pullbackK0 (subS Y J k φ ≫ subschemeTιGlobal Y J)))) := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    rintro ⟨V, hV⟩
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
    change k0ToG0 Y (pullbackK0 _ (resM.res (finitePushforward _ (k0ToG0 _ (k0ClassOf _ V hV))))) =
      finitePushforward _ (k0ToG0 _ (pullbackK0 _ (k0ClassOf _ V hV)))
    refine hbc0_unconditional Y J k φ V hV _ ?_
    have h := DFunLike.congr_fun resM.right (finitePushforward (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)
      (k0ToG0 (subschemeTotalGlobal Y J) (k0ClassOf _ V hV)))
    rw [k0ToG0_classOf] at h
    rw [k0ToG0_classOf]
    exact h
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun key w
