name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4C.finite_of_frameCover
statement:
theorem finite_of_frameCover [Nonempty Y] {J : Type u} (C : AffineFrameCover Y (FreeM Y J))
    {r : ℕ} (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = r + 1) :
    Finite J ∧ Nat.card J = r + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hE : HasConstantRank Y (FreeM Y J) (r + 1) :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D37.hasConstantRank_of_frameCover C hC
  obtain ⟨x⟩ := ‹Nonempty Y›
  have hrk : rankAt x (FreeM Y J) = r + 1 := rankAt_of_hasConstantRank hE x
  have hfin : Finite J := by
    by_contra hinf
    rw [not_finite_iff_infinite] at hinf
    let f : ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 2)) → J := fun a => Infinite.natEmbedding J a.down.val
    have hf : Function.Injective f := by
      intro a b hab
      have h1 := (Infinite.natEmbedding J).injective hab
      exact ULift.ext _ _ (Fin.ext h1)
    let ι : FreeM Y (ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 2))) ⟶ FreeM Y J :=
      Sigma.desc fun a => Sigma.ι (fun _ : J => UnitM Y) (f a)
    let ρ : FreeM Y J ⟶ FreeM Y (ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 2))) :=
      Sigma.desc fun j =>
        if h : ∃ a, f a = j then Sigma.ι (fun _ : ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 2)) => UnitM Y) h.choose
        else 0
    have hιρ : ι ≫ ρ = 𝟙 _ := by
      apply Sigma.hom_ext
      intro a
      rw [Sigma.ι_desc_assoc, Sigma.ι_desc]
      have h : ∃ a', f a' = f a := ⟨a, rfl⟩
      rw [dif_pos h, hf h.choose_spec]
      simp
    let F := stalkLinearFunctor (Y := Y) x
    have hFF : F.map ι ≫ F.map ρ = 𝟙 _ := by
      rw [← F.map_comp, hιρ, F.map_id]
    have hinj : Function.Injective (F.map ι).hom := by
      intro a b hab
      have := congrArg (fun g => (F.map ρ).hom g) hab
      have h2 : ∀ z, (F.map ρ).hom ((F.map ι).hom z) = z := fun z => by
        have := congrArg (fun g => g.hom z) hFF
        simpa using this
      simpa [h2] using this
    haveI : Module.Finite (Y.presheaf.stalk x) ((stalkLinearFunctor x).obj (FreeM Y J)) :=
      (free_finite_stalk (FreeM Y J) hE.isFiniteLocallyFree x).2
    have hle : rankAt x (FreeM Y (ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 2)))) ≤ rankAt x (FreeM Y J) :=
      LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective hinj
    have h3 : rankAt x (FreeM Y (ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 2)))) = r + 2 :=
      (SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleQuillen.rankAt_free x
        (ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 2)))).trans (by simp)
    omega
  refine ⟨hfin, ?_⟩
  have h : rankAt x (FreeM Y J) = Nat.card J :=
    SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleQuillen.rankAt_free x J
  omega

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4C.chern_free
statement:
theorem chern_free :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (J : Type u) [Finite J], Nat.card J = n →
      ∀ (hr : HasConstantRank Y (FreeM Y J) n) (a : ℕ),
        chernOpOn' (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) (closedPosV4 k) (FreeM Y J) n hr a =
          if a = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIntegral Y := (Fact.out : ProjectiveIntegral k Y).1
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro J _ _ hr a; rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    intro J _ hJ hr a
    have hpos : 0 < Nat.card J := by omega
    obtain ⟨j0⟩ : Nonempty J := (Nat.card_pos_iff.mp hpos).1
    let J' := {j : J // j ≠ j0}
    let σ : Option J' ≃ J := Equiv.optionSubtypeNe j0
    haveI : Finite J' := inferInstance
    have hJ' : Nat.card J' = n := by
      have h1 : Nat.card (Option J') = Nat.card J' + 1 := by
        haveI := Fintype.ofFinite J'
        simp [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
      have h2 : Nat.card (Option J') = Nat.card J := Nat.card_congr σ
      omega
    have hrJ' : HasConstantRank Y (FreeM Y J') n := by
      have h := hasConstantRank_free_type Y J'
      rw [hJ'] at h
      exact h
    have hB : HasConstantRank Y (FreeM Y J' ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf Y) (n + 1) :=
      hasConstantRank_biprod_E13 hrJ' hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf
    let e : FreeM Y J ≅ FreeM Y J' ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf Y :=
      reindexIso σ.symm ≪≫ optionIso J'
    have h1 := congrFun (chernOpOn'_bundleIso (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) (closedPosV4 k) e (n + 1) hr hB) a
    rw [h1]
    rw [CIIL1B.chernOpOn'_unit_summand (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) (closedPosV4 k) hrJ'
      (CIIL1C.whitneyUnitSummand_projectiveIntegral (k := k) hrJ') a hB]
    exact ih J' hJ' hrJ' a

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4C.sandwichOn_free_eq_zero
statement:
theorem sandwichOn_free_eq_zero {j : ℕ} (hj : e < j) :
    sandwichOn (opsV4 k) C (cpV4 k) hC j = 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIntegral Y := (Fact.out : ProjectiveIntegral k Y).1
  obtain ⟨hfin, hcard⟩ := finite_of_frameCover C hC
  have hE : HasConstantRank Y (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D22.FreeM Y J) (e + 1) :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D37.hasConstantRank_of_frameCover C hC
  have hcher : ∀ a, chernOfCoverOn (opsV4 k) C (cpV4 k) hC a = if a = 0 then 1 else 0 := by
    intro a
    rw [← chernOpOn'_eq_chernOfCoverOn (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) (closedPosV4 k) C hE hC]
    exact chern_free k (e + 1) J hcard hE a
  have hs : segreOn (opsV4 k) C (cpV4 k) hC (j - e) = 0 := by
    have hm := CIIL1B.chernOfCoverOn_mul_segreOn (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) C hC (j - e)
    have hne : j - e ≠ 0 := by omega
    rw [if_neg hne, Finset.sum_eq_single 0] at hm
    · simpa [hcher] using hm
    · intro a _ ha
      simp [hcher, ha]
    · intro h
      exact absurd (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)) h
  rw [CIIL1B.sandwichOn_eq_phi (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) C hC j, if_pos hj.le]
  exact hs

    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (y : Y) (ξ : f.fiber y) :

      (Y.residueFieldCongr (by
        simpa only [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply] using
          congrArg (fun h ↦ h ξ) (f.fiber_fac y))).hom ≫
        (Y.fromSpecResidueField y).residueFieldMap
          (f.fiberToSpecResidueField y ξ) ≫
        (f.fiberToSpecResidueField y).residueFieldMap ξ
proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.nativeFiberBaseIso_scalar
statement:
theorem nativeFiberBaseIso_scalar {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (y : Y)
    (ξ : f.fiber y) :
    let K : Type u
proof:
:= Y.residueField y
    let F : Scheme := f.fiber y
    letI : F.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) := ⟨f.fiberToSpecResidueField y⟩
    (nativeFiberBaseIso f y ξ).hom ≫
      f.residueFieldMap (f.fiberι y ξ) ≫ (f.fiberι y).residueFieldMap ξ =
        CommRingCat.ofHom (kRes K F ξ) := by
  intro K F
  letI : F.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) := ⟨f.fiberToSpecResidueField y⟩
  letI : (f.fiberToSpecResidueField y).IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) := ⟨by
    change f.fiberToSpecResidueField y ≫ 𝟙 _ = f.fiberToSpecResidueField y
    exact Category.comp_id _⟩
  rw [nativeFiber_residueField_square]
  simp only [nativeFiberBaseIso, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, asIso_hom, asIso_inv,
    Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
  ext k
  exact residueFieldMap_kRes (f.fiberToSpecResidueField y) ξ k

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.nativeFiber_relative_trdeg
statement:
theorem nativeFiber_relative_trdeg {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (y : Y)
    (ξ : f.fiber y) :
    let K : Type u
proof:
:= Y.residueField y
    let F : Scheme := f.fiber y
    let x : X := f.fiberι y ξ
    letI : F.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) := ⟨f.fiberToSpecResidueField y⟩
    letI : Algebra K (F.residueField ξ) := (kRes K F ξ).toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra (Y.residueField (f x)) (X.residueField x) :=
      (f.residueFieldMap x).hom.toAlgebra
    Algebra.trdeg K (F.residueField ξ) =
      Algebra.trdeg (Y.residueField (f x)) (X.residueField x) := by
  intro K F x
  letI : F.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) := ⟨f.fiberToSpecResidueField y⟩
  letI : Algebra K (F.residueField ξ) := (kRes K F ξ).toAlgebra
  let B : Type u := Y.residueField (f x)
  let A : Type u := X.residueField x
  let e : CommRingCat.of K ≅ CommRingCat.of B := nativeFiberBaseIso f y ξ
  letI : Algebra K B := e.hom.hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra B A := (f.residueFieldMap x).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra K A := (e.hom ≫ f.residueFieldMap x).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : IsScalarTower K B A := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun _ ↦ rfl)
  have hzero : Algebra.trdeg K B = 0 := by
    let ea : K ≃ₐ[K] B := AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv
      (f := e.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv) (fun _ ↦ rfl)
    rw [← ea.trdeg_eq]
    exact trdeg_eq_zero
  have ht := trdeg_add_eq K B (A := A)
  rw [hzero, zero_add] at ht
  exact (nativeFiberResidueAlgEquiv f y ξ).trdeg_eq.symm.trans ht.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.relativeResidue_trdeg_eq_of_point_eq
statement:
theorem relativeResidue_trdeg_eq_of_point_eq {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    {x x' : X} (h : x = x') :

proof:
:=
      (f.residueFieldMap x).hom.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra (Y.residueField (f x')) (X.residueField x') :=
      (f.residueFieldMap x').hom.toAlgebra
    Algebra.trdeg (Y.residueField (f x)) (X.residueField x) =
      Algebra.trdeg (Y.residueField (f x')) (X.residueField x') := by
  subst x'
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackProjectiveFiber_original_relative_trdeg
statement:
theorem pullbackProjectiveFiber_original_relative_trdeg (t : C.scheme)
    (ξ : (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g).fiber t) :
    let f
proof:
:= C.pullbackProjectiveMap g
    let z := f.fiberι t ξ
    let η := C.pullbackProjectiveFiberMap g t ξ
    let x := g.fiberι (C.toBase t) η
    letI : Algebra (C.scheme.residueField (f z))
      ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).scheme.residueField z) := (f.residueFieldMap z).hom.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra (Y.residueField (g x)) (X.residueField x) :=
      (g.residueFieldMap x).hom.toAlgebra
    Chow.flatPullbackCoeff f z ≠ 0 →
      Algebra.trdeg (C.scheme.residueField (f z))
        ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).scheme.residueField z) =
      Algebra.trdeg (Y.residueField (g x)) (X.residueField x) := by
  intro f z η x hcoeff
  have hf := nativeFiber_relative_trdeg f t ξ
  have hg := nativeFiber_relative_trdeg g (C.toBase t) η
  have h := C.pullbackProjectiveFiberResidue_trdeg g t ξ hcoeff
  exact hf.symm.trans (h.trans hg)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackProjectiveMap_relative_residue_trdeg
statement:
theorem pullbackProjectiveMap_relative_residue_trdeg
    (z : (C.pullbackFrameCover g).scheme) :
    let f
proof:
:= C.pullbackProjectiveMap g
    let x := (C.pullbackFrameCover g).toBase z
    letI : Algebra (C.scheme.residueField (f z))
      ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).scheme.residueField z) := (f.residueFieldMap z).hom.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra (Y.residueField (g x)) (X.residueField x) :=
      (g.residueFieldMap x).hom.toAlgebra
    Chow.flatPullbackCoeff f z ≠ 0 →
      Algebra.trdeg (C.scheme.residueField (f z))
        ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).scheme.residueField z) =
      Algebra.trdeg (Y.residueField (g x)) (X.residueField x) := by
  intro f x hz
  let ξ := f.asFiber z
  have hc : Chow.flatPullbackCoeff f (f.fiberι (f z) ξ) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [ξ, Scheme.Hom.fiberι_asFiber] using hz
  have h := C.pullbackProjectiveFiber_original_relative_trdeg g (f z) ξ hc
  have hx := C.pullbackProjectiveFiberMap_fiberι_apply g (f z) ξ
  have hg := relativeResidue_trdeg_eq_of_point_eq g hx
  have hs := h.trans hg
  dsimp only [ξ, f] at hs
  rw [Scheme.Hom.fiberι_asFiber] at hs
  exact hs

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.chartToLeft_comp_chartToAmbient
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem chartToLeft_comp_chartToAmbient (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    c.chartToLeft ≫ C.chartToAmbient i = c.chartToAmbient
proof:
:= by
  calc
    c.chartToLeft ≫ C.chartToAmbient i =
        (c.chartToLeft ≫ C.chartToBase i) ≫ (C.U i).ι := rfl
    _ = (c.chartToBase ≫ X.homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_left) ≫
        (C.U i).ι :=
      congrArg (fun f ↦ f ≫ (C.U i).ι)
        (chartToLeft_comp_chartToBase c)
    _ = c.chartToBase ≫
        (X.homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_left ≫ (C.U i).ι) :=
      Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = c.chartToBase ≫ c.affineOpen.1.ι := by
      rw [Scheme.homOfLE_ι]
    _ = c.chartToAmbient := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.chartToRight_comp_chartToAmbient

proof:

    c.chartToRight ≫ C.chartToAmbient j =
        (c.chartToRight ≫ C.chartToBase j) ≫ (C.U j).ι := rfl
    _ = (c.chartToBase ≫ X.homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_right) ≫
        (C.U j).ι :=
      congrArg (fun f ↦ f ≫ (C.U j).ι)
        (chartToRight_comp_chartToBase c)
    _ = c.chartToBase ≫
        (X.homOfLE c.affineOpen_le_right ≫ (C.U j).ι) :=
      Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = c.chartToBase ≫ c.affineOpen.1.ι := by
      rw [Scheme.homOfLE_ι]
    _ = c.chartToAmbient := rfl

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.heq_iso_hom

proof:
:= by
  subst hA; subst hB

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.heq_iso_trans

    HEq (i.trans j) (i'.trans j')
proof:
:= by
  subst hA; subst hB; subst hC
  rw [eq_of_heq hi, eq_of_heq hj]

      AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading (J.map (hVW ▸ RingEquiv.refl Γ(X, V) :

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.fullComparison_sectionsEquiv_eq
statement:
theorem fullComparison_sectionsEquiv_eq (f g : Γ(X, U.1)) (h : X.basicOpen f = X.basicOpen g) :
    ((basicOpenGeneratorComparison (I := I) (U := U) f g h).trans
        (basicOpenComparison I U g)).sectionsEquiv =
      (basicOpenComparison I U f).sectionsEquiv.trans
        (h ▸ RingEquiv.refl Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) : Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) ≃+* Γ(X, X.basicOpen g))
proof:
:= by
  rw [AffineOverlapComparison.trans_sectionsEquiv]
  show (basicOpenGeneratorRingEquiv U f g h).trans (basicOpenSectionsEquiv U g) = _
  unfold basicOpenGeneratorRingEquiv
  ext x
  simp
  rfl

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenChartMap_step
statement:
theorem basicOpenChartMap_step (f g : Γ(X, U.1)) (h : X.basicOpen f = X.basicOpen g) :
    ((basicOpenGeneratorComparison (I := I) (U := U) f g h).trans
        (basicOpenComparison I U g)).projIso.hom ≫ reesProjMap (I.ideal U) f =
      basicOpenChartMap I U g
proof:
:= by
  rw [AffineOverlapComparison.projIso_cocycle, Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc,
    basicOpenGeneratorComparison_projIso_hom_reesProjMap]
  rfl

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenChartMap_heq_of_basicOpen_eq
statement:
theorem basicOpenChartMap_heq_of_basicOpen_eq (f g : Γ(X, U.1))
    (h : X.basicOpen f = X.basicOpen g) :
    HEq (basicOpenChartMap I U f) (basicOpenChartMap I U g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← basicOpenChartMap_step U I f g h]
  show HEq ((basicOpenComparison I U f).projIso.hom ≫ reesProjMap (I.ideal U) f)
    (((basicOpenGeneratorComparison (I := I) (U := U) f g h).trans
        (basicOpenComparison I U g)).projIso.hom ≫ reesProjMap (I.ideal U) f)
  set fc := (basicOpenGeneratorComparison (I := I) (U := U) f g h).trans
    (basicOpenComparison I U g) with hfc
  congr 1
  · exact congrArg (fun W : X.affineOpens ↦ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading (I.ideal W)))
      (Subtype.ext h)
  have hWA : AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading (I.ideal (X.affineBasicOpen f))) =
      AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading (I.ideal (X.affineBasicOpen g))) :=
    congrArg (fun W : X.affineOpens ↦ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading (I.ideal W)))
      (Subtype.ext h)
  refine heq_iso_hom hWA rfl _ _ ?_
  have eq1 := AffineOverlapComparison.projIso_eq_transport_trans (c := basicOpenComparison I U f)
  have eq2 := AffineOverlapComparison.projIso_eq_transport_trans (c := fc)
  refine HEq.trans (heq_of_eq eq1) (HEq.trans ?_ (heq_of_eq eq2.symm))
  have hfull : fc.sectionsEquiv =
      (basicOpenComparison I U f).sectionsEquiv.trans
        (h ▸ RingEquiv.refl Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) :
          Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) ≃+* Γ(X, X.basicOpen g)) :=
    fullComparison_sectionsEquiv_eq U I f g h
  have hcore := reesProjIsoOfRingEquiv_trans_opens_refl h
    (basicOpenComparison I U f).sectionsEquiv (localizedIdeal (I.ideal U) f)
  have hWC : AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading
        ((localizedIdeal (I.ideal U) f).map
          (basicOpenComparison I U f).sectionsEquiv.toRingHom)) =
      AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading
        ((localizedIdeal (I.ideal U) f).map fc.sectionsEquiv.toRingHom)) := by
    refine (proj_eq_of_map_transport_refl h
      ((localizedIdeal (I.ideal U) f).map
        (basicOpenComparison I U f).sectionsEquiv.toRingHom)).trans ?_
    refine (congrArg (fun J : Ideal Γ(X, X.basicOpen g) ↦ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading J))
      (map_ringEquiv_trans (basicOpenComparison I U f).sectionsEquiv
        (h ▸ RingEquiv.refl Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) :
          Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) ≃+* Γ(X, X.basicOpen g))
        (localizedIdeal (I.ideal U) f))).trans ?_
    refine congrArg (fun e : Localization.Away f ≃+* Γ(X, X.basicOpen g) ↦
      AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading ((localizedIdeal (I.ideal U) f).map e.toRingHom))) ?_
    exact hfull.symm
  refine heq_iso_trans hWA hWC rfl _ _ _ _
    (heq_eqToIso hWA hWC _ _) ?_
  rw [hfull]
  exact hcore.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D5.height_pointClosure_of_coheight_one
statement:
theorem height_pointClosure_of_coheight_one (n : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = n + 1)
    (y : pointClosureScheme v) (hy : coheight y = 1) : height (pointClosureι v y) = n
proof:
:= by
  have hgen : genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v) = pointClosureGenericPoint v :=
    ((pointClosureGenericPoint_isGeneric v).eq (genericPoint_spec _)).symm
  have h := dimensionCatenary_of_finiteType k (X := X) (pointClosureScheme v)
    (pointClosureι v) y hy
  rw [hgen, pointClosureι_genericPoint, hv] at h
  exact ENat_add_one_cancel (by simpa using h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D5.primeCycleOfFrame_change
statement:
theorem primeCycleOfFrame_change {b₀ c₀ : pointClosureScheme v}
    (b : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme v)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj L) b₀)
    (c : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme v)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj L) c₀) :
    ∃ g : DimRelationGenerator X n,
      primeCycleOfFrame (k := k) L hL n v hv b =
        g.cycle + primeCycleOfFrame (k := k) L hL n v hv c
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨pointClosureScheme v, pointClosureι v, b.regularTransitionFunction c,
    b.regularTransitionFunction_ne_zero c,
    fun y hy ↦ height_pointClosure_of_coheight_one (k := k) n v hv y hy⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  change properPushforward (pointClosureι v) _ = properPushforward (pointClosureι v) _ +
    properPushforward (pointClosureι v) _
  rw [Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame_change
      (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL v)
      (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one L hL v) b c, ← properPushforward_add]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D5.primeCap_frame_indep
statement:
theorem primeCap_frame_indep {b₀ c₀ : pointClosureScheme v}
    (b : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme v)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj L) b₀)
    (c : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme v)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj L) c₀) :
    (QuotientAddGroup.mk (primeCycleOfFrame (k := k) L hL n v hv b) : DimChow X n) =
      QuotientAddGroup.mk (primeCycleOfFrame (k := k) L hL n v hv c)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := primeCycleOfFrame_change (k := k) L hL n v hv b c
  rw [QuotientAddGroup.eq]
  have : -primeCycleOfFrame (k := k) L hL n v hv b + primeCycleOfFrame (k := k) L hL n v hv c =
      -g.cycle := by
    rw [hg]; abel
  rw [this]
  exact neg_mem (AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨g, rfl⟩)

theorem capCycles_dimPrimeCycle (v : X) (hv : height v = n + 1) :
    capCycles (k := k) L hL n (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv) =
      primeCap (k := k) L hL n v hv
proof:
:= by
  have hsingle : compactCycleFinsupp (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv).1 = Finsupp.single v 1 := by
    ext x
    rw [compactCycleFinsupp_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply]
    by_cases hx : x = v
    · simp [hx]
    · rw [if_neg hx, if_neg (Ne.symm hx)]
  show (compactCycleFinsupp (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv).1).sum
    (fun w m ↦ m • primeCapOrZero (k := k) L hL n w) = _
  rw [hsingle, Finsupp.sum_single_index (zero_zsmul _), one_zsmul, primeCapOrZero, dif_pos hv]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin, hcard⟩ := hE
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := hqfin
  choose κ hsub heq using
    fun i ↦ Opens.isBasis_iff_cover.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens (q.X i)
  let U : (Σ i : q.I, κ i) → X.Opens := fun j ↦ j.2
  refine ⟨
    { I := Σ i : q.I, κ i
      U := U
      covers := ?_
      isAffine := fun j ↦ hsub j.1 j.2.2
      basisIndex := fun j ↦ (q.generators j.1).I
      basisIndex_finite := fun j ↦ by
        letI : (q.generators j.1).IsFiniteType :=
          SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType j.1
        infer_instance
      frame := fun j ↦ ?_ }, fun j ↦ hcard j.1⟩
  · have hcover : IsOpenCover q.X :=
      (Opens.coversTop_iff X q.X).mp q.coversTop
    rw [IsOpenCover, iSup_sigma, ← hcover]
    refine iSup_congr fun i ↦ ?_
    rw [heq i, sSup_eq_iSup']
  · let F := SheafOfModules.overMap X.ringCatSheaf
      (homOfLE (show U j ≤ q.X j.1 by
        dsimp only [U]
        simp [heq, le_sSup]))
    exact
      Scheme.Modules.freeOverMapIso X (q.X j.1) (U j)
          (show U j ≤ q.X j.1 by
            dsimp only [U]
            simp [heq, le_sSup])
          (q.generators j.1).I ≪≫
        F.mapIso (asIso (q.generators j.1).π) ≪≫
          (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf
            (homOfLE (show U j ≤ q.X j.1 by
              dsimp only [U]
              simp [heq, le_sSup]))).app E

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesAwayι_comp_reesProjToSpec
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem reesAwayι_comp_reesProjToSpec
    (I : Ideal R) {d : ℕ} (s : reesAlgebra I)
    (hs : s ∈ grading I d) (hd : 0 < d) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.awayι (grading I) s hs hd ≫ reesProjToSpec I =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (coefficientToReesAway I s))
proof:
:= by

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.isPullback_reesProjMap_toCoefficientSpec
statement:
theorem isPullback_reesProjMap_toCoefficientSpec
    (I : Ideal R) (g : R) :
    IsPullback
      (reesProjMap I g)
      (reesProjToSpec (localizedIdeal I g))
      (reesProjToSpec I)
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g))))
proof:
:= by
  refine Scheme.isPullback_of_openCover
    (reesProjMap I g)
    (reesProjToSpec (localizedIdeal I g))
    (reesProjToSpec I)
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap R (Localization.Away g))))
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.affineOpenCover (grading I)).openCover fun i ↦ ?_
  let hchart := isPullback_reesAwayι I g (i.2 : reesAlgebra I) i.2.2 i.1.2
  let e :
      Spec (.of (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading (localizedIdeal I g))
        (gradedLocalizationMap I g (i.2 : reesAlgebra I)))) ≅
        (((AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.affineOpenCover (grading I)).openCover.pullback₁
          (reesProjMap I g)).X i) :=
    hchart.flip.isoPullback
  refine ((isPullback_reesAwaySpecMap_toBase I g
    (i.2 : reesAlgebra I) i.2.2).flip).of_iso
      e (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · exact hchart.flip.isoPullback_hom_snd.symm
  · rw [← reesAwayι_comp_reesProjToSpec
      (localizedIdeal I g)
      (gradedLocalizationMap I g (i.2 : reesAlgebra I))
      ((gradedLocalizationMap I g).map_mem i.2.2) i.1.2,
      ← Category.assoc]
    exact congrArg (fun k ↦ k ≫ reesProjToSpec (localizedIdeal I g))
      hchart.flip.isoPullback_hom_fst.symm
  · simpa only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp,
      AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.affineOpenCover,
      AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.affineOpenCoverOfIrrelevantLESpan,
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineOpenCover.openCover_f] using
      (reesAwayι_comp_reesProjToSpec I
        (i.2 : reesAlgebra I) i.2.2 i.1.2).symm
  · simp

name: GRRBlueprintV4.RG7.zeroSection_isoE0_eq_zeroE'
statement:
theorem zeroSection_isoE0_eq_zeroE' (CN : AffineFrameCover (ARRKG2A.Zs A J) (ARRKG2A.Nsh J)) :

proof:
:= by

  have h1 : ARRKG2A.EιOfIso D CN = (ARRKG2A.isoE0 D CN).hom ≫ componentToTotal A J := rfl
  rw [h1, ← Category.assoc] at hzs

name: GRRBlueprintV4.RG7.isoE0_toCentre'
statement:
theorem isoE0_toCentre' (CN : AffineFrameCover (ARRKG2A.Zs A J) (ARRKG2A.Nsh J)) :
    (ARRKG2A.isoE0 D CN).hom ≫ componentToCentre A J = (ARRKG2A.Cov CN).toBase
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := isoUnionLeft_toBase (ARRKG2A.Cov CN) (localFrameCover A J D.cover)
  have h2 := isoUnionRight_toBase (ARRKG2A.Cov CN) (localFrameCover A J D.cover)
  have h3 := localFrameComponentIso_toCentre A J D.cover
  simp only [ARRKG2A.isoE0, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc]
  have h5 := (Iso.inv_comp_eq _).mpr h2.symm
  exact ((congrArg (fun t => ((ARRKG2A.Cov CN).isoUnionLeft (localFrameCover A J D.cover)).hom ≫
      ((ARRKG2A.Cov CN).isoUnionRight (localFrameCover A J D.cover)).inv ≫ t) h3).trans
    ((congrArg (fun t => ((ARRKG2A.Cov CN).isoUnionLeft (localFrameCover A J D.cover)).hom ≫ t)
      h5).trans h1))

name: SchemeKTheory.adams_push_pullback_of_koszul_lib
statement:
theorem adams_push_pullback_of_koszul_lib {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) {X Z : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Z]
    (hrankX : ConstantRankGenerators X) (hnilX : LambdaNilpotent X)
    (hrankZ : ConstantRankGenerators Z) (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsFinite i]
    (res : G0 X →+ K0 X) (hres : ∀ a, res (k0ToG0 X a) = a)
    (V : X.Modules) {d : ℕ} (hV : HasConstantRank X V d)
    (koszul : finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 Z 1) = k0ToG0 X (lambdaMinusOne V hV)) (y : K0 X) :
    algebraMap (K0 X) (KLoc j X)
        (adamsRingHom hrankX j (res (finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 Z (pullbackK0RingHom i y))))) =
      algebraMap (K0 X) (KLoc j X)
          (res (finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 Z (adamsRingHom hrankZ j (pullbackK0RingHom i y))))) *
        ((bott j X hrankX hnilX (Multiplicative.ofAdd (k0ClassOf X V hV.isFiniteLocallyFree)) :
          (KLoc j X)ˣ) : KLoc j X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← adamsRingHom_pullbackK0 i hrankZ hrankX hj, push_pullback_of_koszul i res hres V hV koszul,
    push_pullback_of_koszul i res hres V hV koszul, map_mul, map_mul, map_mul,
    adams_lambdaMinusOne_lib hj hrankX hnilX V hV]
  ring

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.koszulAux_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma koszulAux_apply (σ : M →ₗ[R] R) (n : ℕ) (y : M) (v : Fin n → M) :
    koszulAux σ n y v = σ y • exteriorPower.ιMulti R n v

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.koszulDiff_ιMulti
statement:
lemma koszulDiff_ιMulti (σ : M →ₗ[R] R) (n : ℕ) (v : Fin (n + 1) → M) :
    koszulDiff σ n (exteriorPower.ιMulti R (n + 1) v) =
      ∑ i : Fin (n + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) •
        (σ (v i) • exteriorPower.ιMulti R n (i.removeNth v))
proof:
:= by
  rw [koszulDiff, exteriorPower.alternatingMapLinearEquiv_apply_ιMulti,
    AlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin_apply]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.koszulDiff_comp_koszulDiff
statement:
theorem koszulDiff_comp_koszulDiff (σ : M →ₗ[R] R) (n : ℕ) :
    koszulDiff σ n ∘ₗ koszulDiff σ (n + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let f : M →ₗ[R] M →ₗ[R] M [⋀^Fin n]→ₗ[R] ⋀[R]^n M :=
    LinearMap.mk₂ R (fun y z => σ y • σ z • exteriorPower.ιMulti R n)
      (fun a b c => by rw [map_add, add_smul])
      (fun c a b => by rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_smul])
      (fun a b c => by rw [map_add, add_smul, smul_add])
      (fun c a b => by rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_smul, smul_comm (σ a) c])
  have hsymm : ∀ x y, f x y = f y x := by
    intro x y
    simp only [f, LinearMap.mk₂_apply]
    rw [smul_comm]
  have h0 := AlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin_alternatizeUncurryFinLM_comp_of_symmetric hsymm
  apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext
  refine AlternatingMap.ext fun v => ?_
  have h1 := congrArg (fun φ => φ v) h0
  simp only [AlternatingMap.zero_apply] at h1
  simp only [LinearMap.compAlternatingMap_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  rw [← h1]
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, koszulDiff_ιMulti, map_sum, map_zsmul, map_smul,
    AlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin_apply, AlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFinLM_apply,
    f, LinearMap.mk₂_apply, AlternatingMap.smul_apply, Finset.smul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  rw [smul_comm (σ (v i)) ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ))]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.koszulDiffApp_mk
statement:
lemma koszulDiffApp_mk (P : PresheafOfModules.{u} (R ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))
    (σ : P ⟶ PresheafOfModules.unit _) (n : ℕ) (U : Cᵒᵖ) (v : Fin (n + 1) → P.obj U) :
    koszulDiffApp P σ n U (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk v) =
      ∑ i : Fin (n + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) •
        ((σ.app U).hom (v i) • ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (i.removeNth v))
proof:
:=
  koszulDiff_ιMulti _ n v

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.koszulDiffPresheaf_comp
statement:
theorem koszulDiffPresheaf_comp (P : PresheafOfModules.{u} (R ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))
    (σ : P ⟶ PresheafOfModules.unit _) (n : ℕ) :
    koszulDiffPresheaf P σ (n + 1) ≫ koszulDiffPresheaf P σ n = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro U
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  exact koszulDiff_comp_koszulDiff (σ.app U).hom n

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.koszulDiffSheaf_comp

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.g0ClassOf_cokernel_of_exact
statement:
theorem g0ClassOf_cokernel_of_exact [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (C : ℕ → X.Modules)
    (hC : ∀ k, IsCoherentLike X (C k)) (dd : ∀ k, C (k + 1) ⟶ C k)
    (w : ∀ k, dd (k + 1) ≫ dd k = 0)
    (hex : ∀ k, (ShortComplex.mk (dd (k + 1)) (dd k) (w k)).Exact) (N : ℕ) (hN : IsZero (C N)) :
    g0ClassOf X (cokernel (dd 0)) (cokernel_isCoherentLike X (hC 1) (hC 0) (dd 0)) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, (-1 : ℤ) ^ k • g0ClassOf X (C k) (hC k)
proof:
:= by
  have hQ : ∀ k, IsCoherentLike X (cokernel (dd k)) := fun k =>
    cokernel_isCoherentLike X (hC (k + 1)) (hC k) (dd k)
  have step : ∀ k, g0ClassOf X (cokernel (dd k)) (hQ k) =
      g0ClassOf X (C k) (hC k) - g0ClassOf X (cokernel (dd (k + 1))) (hQ (k + 1)) := by
    intro k
    have h := ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_middle X.Modules (IsCoherentLike X)
      (hQ (k + 1)) (hC k) (hQ k) _ (shortExact_cokernel_step X (dd (k + 1)) (dd k) (w k) (hex k))
    change g0ClassOf X (C k) (hC k) = g0ClassOf X _ (hQ (k + 1)) + g0ClassOf X _ (hQ k) at h
    rw [h, add_sub_cancel_left]
  have main : ∀ m, g0ClassOf X (cokernel (dd 0)) (hQ 0) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, (-1 : ℤ) ^ k • g0ClassOf X (C k) (hC k) +
        (-1 : ℤ) ^ m • g0ClassOf X (cokernel (dd m)) (hQ m) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => simp
    | succ m ih =>
      rw [ih, step m, Finset.sum_range_succ, pow_succ, zsmul_sub, mul_neg_one, neg_smul,
        sub_eq_add_neg]
      exact (add_assoc _ _ _).symm
  have hzero : IsZero (cokernel (dd N)) := IsZero.of_epi (cokernel.π (dd N)) hN
  have h0 : g0ClassOf X (cokernel (dd N)) (hQ N) = 0 :=
    ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_isZero X.Modules (IsCoherentLike X) (hQ N) hzero
  rw [main N, h0, smul_zero, add_zero]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.neg_one_pow_smul_g0
statement: theorem neg_one_pow_smul_g0 (k : ℕ) (g : G0 X) : ((-1 : K0 X) ^ k) • g = (-1 : ℤ) ^ k • g
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, mul_comm ((-1 : K0 X) ^ k), mul_smul, ih, neg_one_smul, mul_neg_one,
      neg_smul]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.moduleLocalEquivalences_of_locally_bijective
statement:
theorem moduleLocalEquivalences_of_locally_bijective {P Q : ModulePresheaf Y} (p : P ⟶ Q)
    (hp : ∀ (V : Y.Opens) (x : Y), x ∈ V →
      ∃ W : Y.Opens, W ≤ V ∧ x ∈ W ∧ Function.Bijective (p.app (op W))) :
    moduleLocalEquivalences Y p
proof:
:= by
  change (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y).W ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map p)
  rw [GrothendieckTopology.W_iff_isLocallyBijective]
  refine ⟨⟨?_⟩, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  · intro V a b hab x hx
    obtain ⟨W, hWV, hxW, hbij⟩ := hp V.unop x hx
    refine ⟨W, homOfLE hWV, ?_, hxW⟩
    apply hbij.1
    have hab' : p.app V a = p.app V b := hab
    have e1 := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply p (homOfLE hWV).op a
    have e2 := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply p (homOfLE hWV).op b
    exact e1.trans ((congrArg _ hab').trans e2.symm)
  · intro V s x hx
    obtain ⟨W, hWV, hxW, hbij⟩ := hp V x hx
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hbij.2 (Q.map (homOfLE hWV).op s)
    exact ⟨W, homOfLE hWV, ⟨t, ht⟩, hxW⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.isZero_moduleSheafification_of_locally_subsingleton
statement:
theorem isZero_moduleSheafification_of_locally_subsingleton (C : ModulePresheaf Y)
    (hC : ∀ (V : Y.Opens) (x : Y), x ∈ V →
      ∃ W : Y.Opens, W ≤ V ∧ x ∈ W ∧ Subsingleton (C.obj (op W))) :
    IsZero ((moduleSheafification Y).obj C)
proof:
:= by
  let sh := moduleSheafification Y
  have hW : moduleLocalEquivalences Y (0 : C ⟶ C) := by
    apply moduleLocalEquivalences_of_locally_bijective
    intro V x hx
    obtain ⟨W, hWV, hxW, hz⟩ := hC V x hx
    refine ⟨W, hWV, hxW, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro a b _
      exact Subsingleton.elim a b
    · intro b
      exact ⟨0, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
  have hiso : IsIso (sh.map (0 : C ⟶ C)) :=
    Localization.inverts sh (moduleLocalEquivalences Y) _ hW
  rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero]
  have h0 : sh.map (0 : C ⟶ C) = 0 := sh.map_zero _ _
  rw [h0] at hiso
  calc 𝟙 _ = inv (0 : sh.obj C ⟶ _) ≫ 0 := (IsIso.inv_hom_id _).symm
    _ = 0 := comp_zero

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.app_zero_apply'
statement:
theorem app_zero_apply' {P Q : ModulePresheaf Y} (W : (Y.Opens)ᵒᵖ) (x : P.obj W) :
    (0 : P ⟶ Q).app W x = 0
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.kernelLift_app_surjective
statement:
theorem kernelLift_app_surjective {A B D : ModulePresheaf Y} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ D)
    (w : f ≫ g = 0) (W : (Y.Opens)ᵒᵖ)
    (hex : ∀ b, g.app W b = 0 → ∃ a, f.app W a = b) :
    Function.Surjective ((kernel.lift g f w).app W)
proof:
:= by
  have hι : Function.Injective ((kernel.ι g).app W) := by
    have : Mono ((PresheafOfModules.evaluation _ W).map (kernel.ι g)) := inferInstance
    exact (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).1 this
  intro e
  have hge : g.app W ((kernel.ι g).app W e) = 0 := by
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← PresheafOfModules.comp_app, kernel.condition,
      app_zero_apply']
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hex _ hge
  refine ⟨a, hι ?_⟩
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← PresheafOfModules.comp_app, kernel.lift_ι]
  exact ha

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cokernel_app_subsingleton
statement:
theorem cokernel_app_subsingleton {P Q : ModulePresheaf Y} (p : P ⟶ Q) (W : (Y.Opens)ᵒᵖ)
    (hp : Function.Surjective (p.app W)) : Subsingleton ((cokernel p).obj W)
proof:
:= by
  have hπ : Function.Surjective ((cokernel.π p).app W) := by
    have : Epi ((PresheafOfModules.evaluation _ W).map (cokernel.π p)) := inferInstance
    exact (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).1 this
  have hz : ∀ q, (cokernel.π p).app W q = 0 := by
    intro q
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hp q
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← PresheafOfModules.comp_app, cokernel.condition,
      app_zero_apply']
  refine ⟨fun a b => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hπ a
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hπ b
  rw [hz a, hz b]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.exact_moduleSheafification_map_of_locally_exact
statement:
theorem exact_moduleSheafification_map_of_locally_exact {A B D : ModulePresheaf Y}
    (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ D) (w : f ≫ g = 0)
    (hS : ∀ (V : Y.Opens) (x : Y), x ∈ V → ∃ W : Y.Opens, W ≤ V ∧ x ∈ W ∧
      ∀ b, g.app (op W) b = 0 → ∃ a, f.app (op W) a = b) :
    ((ShortComplex.mk f g w).map (moduleSheafification Y)).Exact
proof:
:= by
  have hC : IsZero ((moduleSheafification Y).obj (cokernel (kernel.lift g f w))) := by
    refine isZero_moduleSheafification_of_locally_subsingleton
      (cokernel (kernel.lift g f w)) fun V x hx => ?_
    obtain ⟨W, hWV, hxW, hex⟩ := hS V x hx
    exact ⟨W, hWV, hxW, cokernel_app_subsingleton _ _ (kernelLift_app_surjective f g w _ hex)⟩
  have hepi : Epi ((moduleSheafification Y).map (kernel.lift g f w)) := by
    have hz : IsZero (cokernel ((moduleSheafification Y).map (kernel.lift g f w))) :=
      hC.of_iso (PreservesCokernel.iso (moduleSheafification Y) (kernel.lift g f w)).symm
    exact Preadditive.epi_of_cokernel_zero (hz.eq_of_tgt _ _)
  rw [ShortComplex.exact_iff_epi_kernel_lift]
  change Epi (kernel.lift ((moduleSheafification Y).map g) ((moduleSheafification Y).map f) _)
  rw [← map_lift_kernelComparison]
  exact epi_comp _ _

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.g0ClassOf_koszulCokernel
statement:
theorem g0ClassOf_koszulCokernel [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (M : X.Modules) {d : ℕ}
    (hM : HasConstantRank X M d) (σ : M ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X)
    (hex : ∀ k, (ShortComplex.mk (koszulDiffSheaf X M σ (k + 1)) (koszulDiffSheaf X M σ k)
      (koszulDiffSheaf_comp X M σ k)).Exact) :
    g0ClassOf X (cokernel (koszulDiffSheaf X M σ 0))
        (cokernel_isCoherentLike X
          (exteriorPowerSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree X M hM.isFiniteLocallyFree 1).isFinitePresentation
          (exteriorPowerSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree X M hM.isFiniteLocallyFree 0).isFinitePresentation
          _) =
      k0ToG0 X (lambdaMinusOne M hM)
proof:
:= by
  have hΛ : ∀ k, IsCoherentLike X (exteriorPowerSheaf X M k) := fun k =>
    (exteriorPowerSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree X M hM.isFiniteLocallyFree k).isFinitePresentation
  rw [g0ClassOf_cokernel_of_exact X (fun k => exteriorPowerSheaf X M k) hΛ
    (koszulDiffSheaf X M σ) (koszulDiffSheaf_comp X M σ) hex (d + 1)
    (isZero_exteriorPowerSheaf_of_rank_lt X M d hM (d + 1) (Nat.lt_succ_self d)),
    lambdaMinusOne_eq_sum, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  rw [k0ToG0_mul, neg_one_pow_smul_g0, lambdaClass, k0ToG0_classOf]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.koszulDiffSheaf_exact
statement:
theorem koszulDiffSheaf_exact (M : X.Modules) (σ : M ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X)
    (hσ : IsLocallyKoszulRegular X M σ) (k : ℕ) :
    (ShortComplex.mk (koszulDiffSheaf X M σ (k + 1)) (koszulDiffSheaf X M σ k)
      (koszulDiffSheaf_comp X M σ k)).Exact
proof:
:= by
  refine exact_moduleSheafification_map_of_locally_exact
    (koszulDiffPresheaf (underlyingCommPresheaf X M) σ.val (k + 1))
    (koszulDiffPresheaf (underlyingCommPresheaf X M) σ.val k)
    (koszulDiffPresheaf_comp _ σ.val k) fun V x hx => ?_
  obtain ⟨W, hWV, hxW, hW⟩ := hσ V x hx
  exact ⟨W, hWV, hxW, fun b hb => hW k b hb⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.g0ClassOf_koszulCokernel_of_isLocallyKoszulRegular
statement:
theorem g0ClassOf_koszulCokernel_of_isLocallyKoszulRegular [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (M : X.Modules) {d : ℕ} (hM : HasConstantRank X M d) (σ : M ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X)
    (hσ : IsLocallyKoszulRegular X M σ) :
    g0ClassOf X (cokernel (koszulDiffSheaf X M σ 0))
        (cokernel_isCoherentLike X
          (exteriorPowerSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree X M hM.isFiniteLocallyFree 1).isFinitePresentation
          (exteriorPowerSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree X M hM.isFiniteLocallyFree 0).isFinitePresentation
          _) =
      k0ToG0 X (lambdaMinusOne M hM)
proof:
:=
  g0ClassOf_koszulCokernel X M hM σ (koszulDiffSheaf_exact X M σ hσ)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.basicOpen_finsetProduct_eq_inf
statement:
private theorem basicOpen_finsetProduct_eq_inf {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Polynomial k n) :
    (Proj.basicOpen (grading k n) (s.prod f) : (space k n).Opens) =
      s.inf fun i ↦
        (Proj.basicOpen (grading k n) (f i) : (space k n).Opens)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert i s hi hs =>
      simp [hi, Proj.basicOpen_mul, hs]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechIntersection_eq_basicOpen
statement:
theorem coordinateCechIntersection_eq_basicOpen (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateCechIntersection k n p a =
      coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (∏ᶜ fun t : Fin (p + 1) ↦ coordinateCechCover k n (a t)) =
    coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p a
  calc
    (∏ᶜ fun t : Fin (p + 1) ↦ coordinateCechCover k n (a t)) =
        Finset.univ.inf (fun t : Fin (p + 1) ↦ coordinateCechCover k n (a t)) := by
      apply le_antisymm
      · exact Finset.le_inf fun t _ ↦
          (Pi.π (fun s : Fin (p + 1) ↦ coordinateCechCover k n (a s)) t).le
      · exact (Pi.lift
          (P := Finset.univ.inf
            (fun t : Fin (p + 1) ↦ coordinateCechCover k n (a t)))
          (fun t ↦ homOfLE (Finset.inf_le (Fintype.complete t)))).le
    _ = coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p a := by
      symm
      simp only [coordinateCechBasicOpen, coordinateCechEquation, coordinateCechCover,
        coordinateOpen, space]
      convert basicOpen_finsetProduct_eq_inf k n
        (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (p + 1)))
        (fun t ↦ coordinate k n (a t)) using 1 <;> rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechEquation_mem_degree
statement:
theorem coordinateCechEquation_mem_degree (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateCechEquation k n p a ∈ grading k n (p + 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simpa [coordinateCechEquation] using
    (SetLike.prod_mem_graded (grading k n)
      (fun _ : Fin (p + 1) ↦ (1 : ℕ))
      (fun t ↦ coordinate k n (a t))
      (F := Finset.univ)
      (fun t _ ↦ coordinate_mem_degree_one k n (a t)))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechIntersection_isAffine
statement:
theorem coordinateCechIntersection_isAffine (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    IsAffineOpen (coordinateCechIntersection k n p a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateCechIntersection_eq_basicOpen k n p a]
  exact Proj.isAffineOpen_basicOpen (grading k n) (coordinateCechEquation k n p a)
    (coordinateCechEquation_mem_degree k n p a) (by omega)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechHigherBasicOpenTermIso_hom_π
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem coordinateCechHigherBasicOpenTermIso_hom_π
    (M : (space k n).Modules) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (coordinateCechHigherBasicOpenTermIso k n M p).hom ≫
        Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
          M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p b))) a =
      Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
          M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b))) a ≫
        (coordinateCechIntersectionBasicOpenSectionIso k n M p a).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coordinateCechHigherBasicOpenTermIso, coordinateCechHigherTermIso,
    Iso.trans_hom, Iso.refl_hom]
  rw [Category.id_comp, Pi.mapIso_hom_π]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface_section_compare
statement:
theorem coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface_section_compare
    (M : (space k n).Modules) (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    M.presheaf.map
          (Pi.lift
            (P := coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) a)
            (fun t : Fin (p + 1) ↦
              Pi.π
                (fun s : Fin (p + 2) ↦ coordinateCechCover k n (a s))
                (r.succAbove t))).op ≫
        (coordinateCechIntersectionBasicOpenSectionIso k n M (p + 1) a).hom =
      (coordinateCechIntersectionBasicOpenSectionIso k n M p
          (a ∘ r.succAbove)).hom ≫
        M.presheaf.map (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p r a).op
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [coordinateCechIntersectionBasicOpenSectionIso,
    coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface, Iso.symm, Functor.mapIso]
  simp only [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechHigherCoface_basicOpen_component
statement:
theorem coordinateCechHigherCoface_basicOpen_component
    (M : (space k n).Modules) (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    (coordinateCechCosimplicialObject k n M).δ r ≫
          (coordinateCechHigherBasicOpenTermIso k n M (p + 1)).hom ≫
          Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
            M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n (p + 1) b))) a =
      (coordinateCechHigherBasicOpenTermIso k n M p).hom ≫
          Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
            M.presheaf.obj (op (coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p b)))
              (a ∘ r.succAbove) ≫
          M.presheaf.map (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p r a).op
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Category.assoc, coordinateCechHigherBasicOpenTermIso_hom_π]
  rw [← Category.assoc, coordinateCechHigherCoface_component]
  rw [Category.assoc, coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface_section_compare]
  rw [coordinateCechHigherBasicOpenTermIso_hom_π_assoc]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIKD.kdGate_general
statement:
theorem kdGate_general (Y : Scheme.{u}) (J : Y.IdealSheafData) (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (φk : k →+* Γ(Y, ⊤)) [IsIntegral Y] [IsIntegral J.subscheme] :
    ∃ (L N : (totalGlobal Y J).Modules) (_ : HasConstantRank (totalGlobal Y J) L 1)
      (_ : HasConstantRank (totalGlobal Y J) N 1)
      (σ₁ : tensorUnitSheaf (totalGlobal Y J) ⟶ L)
      (σE : tensorUnitSheaf (totalGlobal Y J) ⟶ N),
      sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ₁ = (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk 1).ker ∧
      sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σE = (componentToTotal Y J).ker ∧
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)).obj L ≅
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)).obj N)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, hL, σ₁, -, hid₁⟩ := exists_cartierData_fibre Y J k φk 1
  obtain ⟨N, hN, σE, -, hidE⟩ := exists_cartierData_exceptional Y J k φk
  obtain ⟨𝓛, h𝓛, σc, σi, -, -, hec, hei⟩ := exists_cartierData_P1_two_points k 1
  haveI hW : IsIntegral (subschemeTotalGlobal Y J) := isIntegral_subschemeTotalGlobal Y J
  have K := kdgc_ideals Y J k φk
  have hpt : pointInf k = pointInfKDGc k := rfl
  let F := subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J
  let g := F ≫ toP1Global Y J k φk
  have Hc : (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk 1).ker.comap F = (DeformationSpace.pointAt k 1).ker.comap g :=
    K.j_eq.trans (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_fst_of_isClosedImmersion _ _)
  have Hi : (componentToTotal Y J).ker.comap F = (pointInf k).ker.comap g := by
    rw [hpt]
    exact K.e_eq.trans (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_fst_of_isClosedImmersion _ _)
  have eL : Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj L ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj 𝓛) := by
    have e1 : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf (pullbackSec F σ₁) =
        (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk 1).ker.comap F := by
      rw [sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_pullbackSec hL σ₁ F, hid₁]
    have e2 : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf (pullbackSec g σc) =
        (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk 1).ker.comap F := by
      rw [sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_pullbackSec h𝓛 σc g, hec, Hc]
    exact nonempty_iso_of_evaluationIdeal_eq (hasConstantRank_pullback_one hL F)
      (hasConstantRank_pullback_one h𝓛 g) (pullbackSec F σ₁) (pullbackSec g σc)
      (sectionIsRegular_of_ne_bot (hasConstantRank_pullback_one hL F) _ (by rw [e1]; exact K.j_ne))
      (sectionIsRegular_of_ne_bot (hasConstantRank_pullback_one h𝓛 g) _ (by rw [e2]; exact K.j_ne)) (e1.trans e2.symm)
  have eN : Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj N ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj 𝓛) := by
    have e1 : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf (pullbackSec F σE) =
        (componentToTotal Y J).ker.comap F := by
      rw [sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_pullbackSec hN σE F, hidE]
    have e2 : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf (pullbackSec g σi) =
        (componentToTotal Y J).ker.comap F := by
      rw [sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_pullbackSec h𝓛 σi g, hei, Hi]
    exact nonempty_iso_of_evaluationIdeal_eq (hasConstantRank_pullback_one hN F)
      (hasConstantRank_pullback_one h𝓛 g) (pullbackSec F σE) (pullbackSec g σi)
      (sectionIsRegular_of_ne_bot (hasConstantRank_pullback_one hN F) _ (by rw [e1]; exact K.e_ne))
      (sectionIsRegular_of_ne_bot (hasConstantRank_pullback_one h𝓛 g) _ (by rw [e2]; exact K.e_ne)) (e1.trans e2.symm)
  exact ⟨L, N, hL, hN, σ₁, σE, hid₁, hidE, ⟨eL.some ≪≫ eN.some.symm⟩⟩

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIKD.kdGate_proved
statement: theorem kdGate_proved : KDGate k n i hX φk
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIntegral X := (Fact.out : D28.ProjectiveIntegral k X).1

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIKD.kdisj_proved

theorem kdisj_proved : ∀ x : K0 X,
    chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) ((concretePencilKX k n i hX φk).lift x)
      (totalCapOn (opsV4 k) (concretePencilKX k n i hX φk).LP (concretePencilKX k n i hX φk).hLP
        (fundClass k (W := (concreteGeomX k n i hX φk).M))) = 0

  kdisj_of_gate k n i hX φk (kdGate_proved k n i hX φk)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.RG7.kdisj_of_geoA
statement:
theorem kdisj_of_geoA (G : KDGeoA i hA hAreg hX φk) : ∀ x : K0 X,
    chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) ((concretePencilKXA i hA hAreg hX φk).lift x)
      (totalCapOn (opsV4 k) (concretePencilKXA i hA hAreg hX φk).LP
        (concretePencilKXA i hA hAreg hX φk).hLP
        (fundClass k (W := (concreteGeomXA i hA hAreg hX φk).M))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIntegral X := (Fact.out : D28.ProjectiveIntegral k X).1
  haveI : IsNoetherian (totalGlobal A i.ker) := total_isNoetherian (k := k) i.ker hA
  haveI := KG2B.isNoetherian_W i.ker hA
  obtain ⟨LP, hLP, hfr, htriv⟩ := G
  intro x
  have hcls : totalCapOn (opsV4 k) (concretePencilKXA i hA hAreg hX φk).LP
      (concretePencilKXA i hA hAreg hX φk).hLP
      (fundClass k (W := (concreteGeomXA i hA hAreg hX φk).M)) =
      totalCapOn (opsV4 k) LP hLP (fundClass k (W := (concreteGeomXA i hA hAreg hX φk).M)) :=
    add_right_cancel (b := totalPushOn (opsV4 k) (concreteGeomXA i hA hAreg hX φk).e
      (fundClass k (W := (concreteGeomXA i hA hAreg hX φk).E)))
      ((concretePencilKXA i hA hAreg hX φk).fibreRel.symm.trans hfr)
  rw [hcls]
  have hfix := fixed_of_trivial (subschemeTotalGlobalι A i.ker)
    (bijective_total i.ker hA hAreg (regularZA i hX)).1
    ((concretePencilKXA i hA hAreg hX φk).lift x) _ _
    (liftK'_spec i.ker hA hAreg (regularZA i hX) (pullbackK0 (phiXA i).inv x)) htriv
  exact chK0_cap_of_fix _ LP hLP _ hfix

name: GRRBlueprintV4.RG7.kdGateA_proved

name: GRRBlueprintV4.RG7.kdGeo_of_gateA
statement: theorem kdGeo_of_gateA (G : KDGateA i hA hAreg hX φk) : KDGeoA i hA hAreg hX φk
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, N, hL, hN, σ₁, σE, hid₁, hidE, ⟨e⟩⟩ := G
  haveI : IsIntegral X := (Fact.out : D28.ProjectiveIntegral k X).1
  haveI hZi : IsIntegral i.ker.subscheme := integralZA i
  have hZ := regularZA i hX
  haveI : IsNoetherian (totalGlobal A i.ker) := total_isNoetherian (k := k) i.ker hA
  haveI : IsIntegral (concreteGeomXA i hA hAreg hX φk).M :=
    SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_totalGlobal
      A i.ker
  haveI : IsIntegral (concreteGeomXA i hA hAreg hX φk).A := inferInstanceAs (IsIntegral A)
  letI := KG2B.zOver (k := k) i.ker
  haveI := z_lft (k := k) i.ker
  haveI := z_noeth i.ker
  haveI hEI : IsIntegral (component A i.ker) :=
    isIntegral_component i.ker (KG2B.coverJ i.ker hAreg hZ) (KG2B.projectiveIntegralK_Z i.ker hA)
  haveI : IsIntegral (concreteGeomXA i hA hAreg hX φk).E := hEI
  have hGne1 : (concreteGeomXA i hA hAreg hX φk).j (genericPoint (concreteGeomXA i hA hAreg hX φk).A) ≠
      genericPoint (concreteGeomXA i hA hAreg hX φk).M := fibre_generic_ne A i.ker φk 1
  have hGneE : (concreteGeomXA i hA hAreg hX φk).e (genericPoint (concreteGeomXA i hA hAreg hX φk).E) ≠
      genericPoint (concreteGeomXA i hA hAreg hX φk).M := component_generic_ne A i.ker φk
  obtain ⟨d, hZ₁⟩ := exists_height_generic hA
  have hXh : height (genericPoint (concreteGeomXA i hA hAreg hX φk).M) = ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [height_generic_eq_succ k hL σ₁ (concreteGeomXA i hA hAreg hX φk).j hid₁ hGne1]
    change height (genericPoint A) + 1 = _
    rw [hZ₁]
    push_cast; rfl
  have hE : height (genericPoint (concreteGeomXA i hA hAreg hX φk).E) = (d : ℕ∞) := by
    have h := height_generic_eq_succ k hN σE (concreteGeomXA i hA hAreg hX φk).e hidE hGneE
    rw [hXh] at h
    have h' : height (genericPoint (concreteGeomXA i hA hAreg hX φk).E) + 1 = (d : ℕ∞) + 1 := by
      rw [← h]; push_cast; rfl
    exact AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ENat_add_one_cancel h'
  refine ⟨LPof L N, hasConstantRank_LPof hL hN, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (A5FR.fibreRel_cheap (k := k) hL hN σ₁ (concreteGeomXA i hA hAreg hX φk).j hid₁ σE
      (concreteGeomXA i hA hAreg hX φk).e hidE hXh hZ₁ hE)
  · exact pullbackK0_LPof_eq_one _ L N hL hN e

name: GRRBlueprintV4.RG7.kdisj_proved_A
statement:
theorem kdisj_proved_A : ∀ x : K0 X,
    chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) ((concretePencilKXA i hA hAreg hX φk).lift x)
      (totalCapOn (opsV4 k) (concretePencilKXA i hA hAreg hX φk).LP
        (concretePencilKXA i hA hAreg hX φk).hLP
        (fundClass k (W := (concreteGeomXA i hA hAreg hX φk).M))) = 0
proof:
:=
  kdisj_of_geoA i hA hAreg hX φk (kdGeo_of_gateA i hA hAreg hX φk (kdGateA_proved i hA hAreg hX φk))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1.constantCoeff_eSer
statement: theorem constantCoeff_eSer : constantCoeff eSer = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [eSer, ← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1.constantCoeff_tdSer
statement: theorem constantCoeff_tdSer : constantCoeff tdSer = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [tdSer, constantCoeff_inv, constantCoeff_eSer]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1.eSer_mul_tdSer
statement: theorem eSer_mul_tdSer : eSer * tdSer = 1
proof:
:=
  PowerSeries.mul_inv_cancel _ (by simp [constantCoeff_eSer])

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1.X_mul_eSer
statement: theorem X_mul_eSer : (X : ℚ⟦X⟧) * eSer = 1 - rescale (-1 : ℚ) (exp ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  rcases j with _ | j
  · have h : constantCoeff (rescale (-1 : ℚ) (exp ℚ)) = 1 := by
      rw [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, coeff_rescale]
      simp [coeff_exp]
    simp [h]
  · rw [coeff_succ_X_mul, map_sub, coeff_one, coeff_rescale, coeff_exp]
    simp only [eSer, coeff_mk, Nat.succ_ne_zero, if_false, zero_sub, eq_ratCast, one_div]
    rw [pow_succ]
    simp only [Nat.factorial_succ]
    push_cast
    ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1.X_mul_derivative_eSer
statement:
theorem X_mul_derivative_eSer :
    (X : ℚ⟦X⟧) * d⁄dX ℚ eSer = 1 - eSer - X * eSer
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  rcases j with _ | j
  · simp [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, constantCoeff_eSer]
  · rw [coeff_succ_X_mul, coeff_derivative, map_sub, map_sub, coeff_one, coeff_succ_X_mul]
    simp only [eSer, coeff_mk, Nat.succ_ne_zero, if_false, zero_sub]
    simp only [pow_succ, Nat.factorial_succ]
    push_cast
    field_simp
    ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1.X_mul_derivative_tdSer
statement:
theorem X_mul_derivative_tdSer :
    (X : ℚ⟦X⟧) * d⁄dX ℚ tdSer = tdSer + X * tdSer - tdSer ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := eSer_mul_tdSer
  have h2 := X_mul_derivative_eSer
  have h3 : d⁄dX ℚ tdSer = -tdSer ^ 2 * d⁄dX ℚ eSer := by
    rw [tdSer, derivative_inv']
  rw [h3]
  linear_combination (-tdSer ^ 2) * h2 + (tdSer + X * tdSer) * h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1.coeff_tdSer_pow_self
statement: theorem coeff_tdSer_pow_self (n : ℕ) : coeff n (tdSer ^ (n + 1)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, constantCoeff_tdSer]
  | succ n ih =>
    set T := tdSer with hTdef
    have hT : (X : ℚ⟦X⟧) * d⁄dX ℚ T = T + X * T - T ^ 2 := X_mul_derivative_tdSer
    have hdG : d⁄dX ℚ (T ^ (n + 1)) = C ((n : ℚ) + 1) * T ^ n * d⁄dX ℚ T := by
      rw [derivative_pow]
      simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
      congr 2
      rw [← map_natCast (C (R := ℚ))]
      push_cast
      rfl
    have key : C ((n : ℚ) + 1) * T ^ (n + 2) =
        C ((n : ℚ) + 1) * T ^ (n + 1) + X * (C ((n : ℚ) + 1) * T ^ (n + 1)) -
          X * d⁄dX ℚ (T ^ (n + 1)) := by
      rw [hdG]
      linear_combination (C ((n : ℚ) + 1) * T ^ n) * hT
    have hc := congrArg (coeff (n + 1)) key
    rw [coeff_C_mul, map_sub, map_add, coeff_C_mul, coeff_succ_X_mul, coeff_C_mul,
      coeff_succ_X_mul, coeff_derivative, ih] at hc
    have hne : ((n : ℚ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have : ((n : ℚ) + 1) * coeff (n + 1) (T ^ (n + 1 + 1)) = ((n : ℚ) + 1) * 1 := by
      rw [hc]; ring
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ hne this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1.hrrNum_zero_right
statement: theorem hrrNum_zero_right (m : ℚ) : hrrNum m 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [hrrNum, coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, constantCoeff_tdSer]
  rw [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, coeff_rescale]
  simp [coeff_exp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1.hrrNum_zero_left
statement: theorem hrrNum_zero_left (n : ℕ) : hrrNum 0 n = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : rescale (0 : ℚ) (exp ℚ) = 1 := by
    rw [rescale_zero_apply]
    simp [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, coeff_exp]
  simpa [hrrNum, h] using coeff_tdSer_pow_self n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1.hrrNum_succ_succ
statement:
theorem hrrNum_succ_succ (m : ℚ) (n : ℕ) :
    hrrNum (m + 1) (n + 1) = hrrNum m (n + 1) + hrrNum (m + 1) n
proof:
:= by
  have hexp : rescale (m + 1) (exp ℚ) - rescale m (exp ℚ) =
      rescale (m + 1) (exp ℚ) * (X * eSer) := by
    rw [X_mul_eSer, mul_sub, mul_one, exp_mul_exp_eq_exp_add]
    ring_nf
  have h1 := eSer_mul_tdSer
  have hdiff : rescale (m + 1) (exp ℚ) * tdSer ^ (n + 1 + 1) - rescale m (exp ℚ) * tdSer ^ (n + 1 + 1)
      = X * (rescale (m + 1) (exp ℚ) * tdSer ^ (n + 1)) := by
    have : (rescale (m + 1) (exp ℚ) - rescale m (exp ℚ)) * tdSer ^ (n + 1 + 1) =
        X * (rescale (m + 1) (exp ℚ) * tdSer ^ (n + 1)) := by
      rw [hexp]
      linear_combination (X * rescale (m + 1) (exp ℚ) * tdSer ^ (n + 1)) * h1
    linear_combination this
  have := congrArg (coeff (n + 1)) hdiff
  rw [map_sub, coeff_succ_X_mul] at this
  unfold hrrNum
  linarith

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1.hrrNum_nat
statement: theorem hrrNum_nat (m n : ℕ) : hrrNum (m : ℚ) n = ((n + m).choose n : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing n with
  | zero => simp [hrrNum_zero_left]
  | succ m ih =>
    induction n with
    | zero => simp [hrrNum_zero_right]
    | succ n ihn =>
      push_cast at ihn ⊢
      rw [hrrNum_succ_succ, ih (n + 1), ihn]
      rw [show n + 1 + (m + 1) = (n + m + 1) + 1 by ring, Nat.choose_succ_succ,
        show n + (m + 1) = n + m + 1 by ring, show n + 1 + m = n + m + 1 by ring]
      push_cast
      ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1.hrrBinom_up
statement:
theorem hrrBinom_up (n : ℕ) (m : ℚ) (h1 : HrrBinom (n + 1) m) (h2 : HrrBinom n (m + 1)) :
    HrrBinom (n + 1) (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold HrrBinom at *
  have hP := Ring.choose_succ_succ (m + n + 1) n
  have e1 : m + 1 + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) = (m + n + 1) + 1 := by push_cast; ring
  have e2 : m + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) = m + n + 1 := by push_cast; ring
  have e3 : m + 1 + (n : ℚ) = m + n + 1 := by ring
  rw [e2] at h1
  rw [e3] at h2
  rw [hrrNum_succ_succ, e1, hP, h1, h2]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1.hrrBinom_down
statement:
theorem hrrBinom_down (n : ℕ) (m : ℚ) (h1 : HrrBinom (n + 1) (m + 1)) (h2 : HrrBinom n (m + 1)) :
    HrrBinom (n + 1) m
proof:
:= by
  unfold HrrBinom at *
  have hP := Ring.choose_succ_succ (m + n + 1) n
  have e1 : m + 1 + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) = (m + n + 1) + 1 := by push_cast; ring
  have e2 : m + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) = m + n + 1 := by push_cast; ring
  have e3 : m + 1 + (n : ℚ) = m + n + 1 := by ring
  rw [e1, hP] at h1
  rw [e3] at h2
  rw [e2]
  have := hrrNum_succ_succ m n
  rw [h1, h2] at this
  linarith

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1.hrrNum_int
statement: theorem hrrNum_int (n : ℕ) (m : ℤ) : hrrNum (m : ℚ) n = Ring.choose ((m : ℚ) + n) n
proof:
:= by
  suffices H : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ m : ℤ, HrrBinom n (m : ℚ) from H n m
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro m; simp [HrrBinom, hrrNum_zero_right]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro m
    induction m using Int.induction_on with
    | zero =>
      unfold HrrBinom
      have : (((0 : ℤ) : ℚ) + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ)) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [this, Ring.choose_natCast]
      simp [hrrNum_zero_left]
    | succ i hi =>
      have := hrrBinom_up n (i : ℚ) (by exact_mod_cast hi) (by exact_mod_cast ih ((i : ℤ) + 1))
      exact_mod_cast this
    | pred i hi =>
      have := hrrBinom_down n ((-(i : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) : ℚ) (by push_cast at hi ⊢; ring_nf at hi ⊢; exact hi)
        (by push_cast; ring_nf; have := ih (-(i : ℤ)); push_cast at this; ring_nf at this; exact this)
      exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1.aeval_apply_eq_of_dvd
statement:
theorem aeval_apply_eq_of_dvd (n : ℕ) (H : Module.End ℚ M) (v : M) (hv : (H ^ (n + 1)) v = 0)
    {p q : Polynomial ℚ} (h : (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℚ) ^ (n + 1) ∣ p - q) :
    Polynomial.aeval H p v = Polynomial.aeval H q v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := h
  have hp : p = q + r * (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℚ) ^ (n + 1) := by
    linear_combination hr
  rw [hp, map_add, map_mul, map_pow, Polynomial.aeval_X, LinearMap.add_apply, Module.End.mul_apply,
    hv, map_zero, add_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1.evTrunc_mul_apply
statement:
theorem evTrunc_mul_apply (n : ℕ) (H : Module.End ℚ M) (v : M) (hv : (H ^ (n + 1)) v = 0)
    (f g : ℚ⟦X⟧) :
    evTrunc n H (f * g) v = evTrunc n H f (evTrunc n H g v)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (f * g).trunc (n + 1) =
      ((f.trunc (n + 1) * g.trunc (n + 1) : Polynomial ℚ) : ℚ⟦X⟧).trunc (n + 1) := by
    rw [← trunc_trunc_mul_trunc]
    simp
  have hc : ∀ d < n + 1, coeff d (f * g) = (f.trunc (n + 1) * g.trunc (n + 1)).coeff d := by
    intro d hd
    have e : coeff d (f * g) = ((f * g).trunc (n + 1)).coeff d := by
      rw [coeff_trunc, if_pos hd]
    rw [e, h1, coeff_trunc, if_pos hd, Polynomial.coeff_coe]
  unfold evTrunc
  rw [h1, ← Module.End.mul_apply, ← map_mul (Polynomial.aeval H)]
  apply aeval_apply_eq_of_dvd n H v hv
  rw [Polynomial.X_pow_dvd_iff]
  intro d hd
  simp [coeff_trunc, hd, hc d hd]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1.evTrunc_one
statement: theorem evTrunc_one (n : ℕ) (H : Module.End ℚ M) : evTrunc n H 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [evTrunc, trunc_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1.evTrunc_pow_apply
statement:
theorem evTrunc_pow_apply (n : ℕ) (H : Module.End ℚ M) (v : M) (hv : (H ^ (n + 1)) v = 0)
    (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) (k : ℕ) : ((evTrunc n H f) ^ k) v = evTrunc n H (f ^ k) v
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [evTrunc_one]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih, pow_succ', evTrunc_mul_apply n H v hv]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1.functional_evTrunc
statement:
theorem functional_evTrunc {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module ℚ N] (n : ℕ)
    (H : Module.End ℚ M) (v : M) (Ψ : M →ₗ[ℚ] N) (w : N)
    (hΨ : ∀ p ≤ n, Ψ ((H ^ p) v) = if p = n then w else 0) (f : ℚ⟦X⟧) :
    Ψ (evTrunc n H f v) = coeff n f • w
proof:
:= by
  unfold evTrunc
  rw [Polynomial.aeval_eq_sum_range' (natDegree_trunc_lt f n), LinearMap.sum_apply, map_sum]
  have : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      Ψ (((f.trunc (n + 1)).coeff i • H ^ i) v) = if i = n then coeff n f • w else 0 := by
    intro i hi
    have hi' : i ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
    rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul, hΨ i hi', coeff_trunc, if_pos (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hi')]
    by_cases h : i = n
    · subst h; simp
    · simp [h]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl this]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1.chiOp_int
statement:
theorem chiOp_int {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module ℚ N] (n : ℕ) (H : Module.End ℚ M) (v : M)
    (hv : (H ^ (n + 1)) v = 0) (Ψ : M →ₗ[ℚ] N) (w : N)
    (hΨ : ∀ p ≤ n, Ψ ((H ^ p) v) = if p = n then w else 0) (m : ℤ) :
    Ψ (evTrunc n H (rescale (m : ℚ) (exp ℚ)) (((evTrunc n H tdSer) ^ (n + 1)) v)) =
      Ring.choose ((m : ℚ) + n) n • w
proof:
:= by
  rw [evTrunc_pow_apply n H v hv, ← evTrunc_mul_apply n H v hv, functional_evTrunc n H v Ψ w hΨ]
  rw [← hrrNum_int n m]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1.chiOp_nat
statement:
theorem chiOp_nat {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module ℚ N] (n : ℕ) (H : Module.End ℚ M) (v : M)
    (hv : (H ^ (n + 1)) v = 0) (Ψ : M →ₗ[ℚ] N) (w : N)
    (hΨ : ∀ p ≤ n, Ψ ((H ^ p) v) = if p = n then w else 0) (m : ℕ) :
    Ψ (evTrunc n H (rescale (m : ℚ) (exp ℚ)) (((evTrunc n H tdSer) ^ (n + 1)) v)) =
      ((n + m).choose n : ℚ) • w
proof:
:= by
  rw [evTrunc_pow_apply n H v hv, ← evTrunc_mul_apply n H v hv, functional_evTrunc n H v Ψ w hΨ]
  rw [← hrrNum_nat m n]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1.coeff_tdSer_one
statement: theorem coeff_tdSer_one : coeff 1 tdSer = 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (coeff 1) eSer_mul_tdSer
  rw [coeff_mul, Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_succ] at h
  simp [eSer, constantCoeff_tdSer, coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply] at h
  have h0 : coeff 0 tdSer = 1 := by rw [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, constantCoeff_tdSer]
  have h1 : coeff 0 eSer = 1 := by rw [coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, constantCoeff_eSer]
  linarith

name: AlgebraicGeometry.D38.exists_trivializing_cover
statement:
theorem exists_trivializing_cover (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (C : AffineFrameCover X E) :
    ∃ (C₀ : AffineFrameCover X E)
      (_θ : ∀ i : C₀.I,
        SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over (C₀.U i)) PUnit ≅ L.over (C₀.U i)),
      True
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin, hcard⟩ := hL
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  choose κ hsub heq using
    fun p : C.I × q.I ↦ Opens.isBasis_iff_cover.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens (C.U p.1 ⊓ q.X p.2)
  have hle : ∀ (j : Σ p : C.I × q.I, κ p), j.2.1 ≤ C.U j.1.1 ∧ j.2.1 ≤ q.X j.1.2 := by
    intro j
    have : j.2.1 ≤ C.U j.1.1 ⊓ q.X j.1.2 := by
      rw [heq j.1]
      exact le_sSup j.2.2
    exact le_inf_iff.mp this
  have hcov : IsOpenCover (fun j : (Σ p : C.I × q.I, κ p) ↦ j.2.1) := by
    have hq' : IsOpenCover q.X := (Opens.coversTop_iff X q.X).mp q.coversTop
    rw [IsOpenCover, iSup_sigma]
    have h1 : (⨆ p : C.I × q.I, C.U p.1 ⊓ q.X p.2) = ⊤ := by
      rw [← iSup_inf_iSup]
      have hC : (⨆ i, C.U i) = ⊤ := C.covers
      have hQ : (⨆ i, q.X i) = ⊤ := hq'
      rw [hC, hQ]; simp
    rw [← h1]
    refine iSup_congr fun p ↦ ?_
    rw [heq p, sSup_eq_iSup']
  refine ⟨
    { I := Σ p : C.I × q.I, κ p
      U := fun j ↦ j.2.1
      covers := hcov
      isAffine := fun j ↦ hsub j.1 j.2.2
      basisIndex := fun j ↦ C.basisIndex j.1.1
      basisIndex_finite := fun j ↦ C.basisIndex_finite j.1.1
      frame := fun j ↦ C.restrictedFrame j.1.1 j.2.1 (hle j).1 }, ?_, trivial⟩
  intro j
  have hVq : j.2.1 ≤ q.X j.1.2 := (hle j).2
  have hu : Nat.card (q.generators j.1.2).I = 1 := hcard j.1.2
  obtain ⟨hsing, hne⟩ := Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.mp hu
  let i0 := Classical.choice hne
  let e : PUnit.{u + 1} ≃ (q.generators j.1.2).I :=
    ⟨fun _ ↦ i0, fun _ ↦ PUnit.unit, fun _ ↦ rfl, fun x ↦ Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
  let F := SheafOfModules.overMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVq)
  exact
    (SheafOfModules.freeFunctor (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over j.2.1)).mapIso (Equiv.toIso e) ≪≫
      Scheme.Modules.freeOverMapIso X (q.X j.1.2) j.2.1 hVq (q.generators j.1.2).I ≪≫
        F.mapIso (asIso (q.generators j.1.2).π) ≪≫
          (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVq)).app L

name: AlgebraicGeometry.D38.twistInvariance
statement: theorem twistInvariance : AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D37.TwistInvarianceStatement.{u}
proof:
:= by
  intro X L E r hL hE C C'
  obtain ⟨C₀, θ, -⟩ := exists_trivializing_cover hL C
  let T := AlgebraicGeometry.D34.lineTwistData L C₀ θ
  refine ⟨isoOfCovers C C₀ ≪≫ T.schemeIso.symm ≪≫ isoOfCovers T.cover C', ?_⟩
  have h1 : T.schemeIso.inv ≫ T.cover.toBase = C₀.toBase := by
    rw [← T.schemeIso_toBase, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [isoOfCovers_toBase, h1, isoOfCovers_toBase]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis_left
statement:
theorem rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis_left :
    rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis X U (Sum.inl PUnit.unit) =
      ((biprod.inl : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.app (op U))
        (1 : Γ(X, U))
proof:
:= by
  have hb : rankTwo_splitBasis Γ(X, U) (Sum.inl PUnit.unit) = (1, 0) := by
    ext
    · exact (Module.Basis.prod_apply_inl_fst (Module.Basis.singleton PUnit Γ(X, U))
        (Module.Basis.singleton PUnit Γ(X, U)) PUnit.unit).trans
        (Module.Basis.singleton_apply _ _ _)
    · exact Module.Basis.prod_apply_inl_snd (Module.Basis.singleton PUnit Γ(X, U))
        (Module.Basis.singleton PUnit Γ(X, U)) PUnit.unit
  rw [rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis, Module.Basis.map_apply, hb]
  change _ + ((biprod.inr : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.app (op U)).hom
    (0 : Γ(X, U)) = _
  have hz : ((biprod.inr : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.app (op U)).hom
      (0 : Γ(X, U)) = 0 := map_zero _
  exact (congrArg (fun z ↦
    ((biprod.inl : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.app (op U))
      (1 : Γ(X, U)) + z) hz).trans (add_zero _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis_right
statement:
theorem rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis_right :
    rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis X U (Sum.inr PUnit.unit) =
      ((biprod.inr : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.app (op U))
        (1 : Γ(X, U))
proof:
:= by
  have hb : rankTwo_splitBasis Γ(X, U) (Sum.inr PUnit.unit) = (0, 1) := by
    ext
    · exact Module.Basis.prod_apply_inr_fst (Module.Basis.singleton PUnit Γ(X, U))
        (Module.Basis.singleton PUnit Γ(X, U)) PUnit.unit
    · exact (Module.Basis.prod_apply_inr_snd (Module.Basis.singleton PUnit Γ(X, U))
        (Module.Basis.singleton PUnit Γ(X, U)) PUnit.unit).trans
        (Module.Basis.singleton_apply _ _ _)
  rw [rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis, Module.Basis.map_apply, hb]
  change ((biprod.inl : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.app (op U)).hom
    (0 : Γ(X, U)) + _ = _
  have hz : ((biprod.inl : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.app (op U)).hom
      (0 : Γ(X, U)) = 0 := map_zero _
  exact (congrArg (fun z ↦ z +
    ((biprod.inr : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.app (op U))
      (1 : Γ(X, U))) hz).trans (zero_add _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis_restrict
statement:
theorem rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis_restrict {V : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ U)
    (k : PUnit.{u+1} ⊕ PUnit.{u+1}) :
    (tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE h).op
      (rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis X U k) = rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis X V k
proof:
:= by
  rcases k with k | k
  · rw [rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis_left, rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis_left]
    have hn := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply
      (biprod.inl : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val
      (homOfLE h).op (1 : Γ(X, U))
    change ((biprod.inl : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.app (op V))
      ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom 1) = _ at hn
    rw [map_one] at hn
    exact hn.symm
  · rw [rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis_right, rankTwo_unitPairSectionsBasis_right]
    have hn := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply
      (biprod.inr : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val
      (homOfLE h).op (1 : Γ(X, U))
    change ((biprod.inr : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.app (op V))
      ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom 1) = _ at hn
    rw [map_one] at hn
    exact hn.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_fst_kernel_transport
statement:
theorem rankTwo_fst_kernel_transport (e : M ≃ₗ[R] (R × R)) :
    RingHom.ker (symmetricAlgebraMap (S := R)
      ((LinearMap.fst R R R).comp e.toLinearMap)) =
    Ideal.comap (rankTwo_symmetricAlgebraEquiv R e).toRingHom
      (Ideal.span {SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (R × R) (0, 1)})
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rankTwo_fst_symmetric_kernel R]
  ext a
  change symmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) ((LinearMap.fst R R R).comp e.toLinearMap) a = 0 ↔
    symmetricAlgebraMap (S := R) (LinearMap.fst R R R)
      (rankTwo_symmetricAlgebraEquiv R e a) = 0
  have h := congrArg (fun F => F a)
    (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap_comp (R := R) (S := R) (T := R)
      e.toLinearMap (LinearMap.fst R R R))
  exact iff_of_eq (congrArg (fun v => v = 0) h.symm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankTwo_fst_kernel_principal
statement:
theorem rankTwo_fst_kernel_principal (e : M ≃ₗ[R] (R × R)) :
    RingHom.ker (symmetricAlgebraMap (S := R)
      ((LinearMap.fst R R R).comp e.toLinearMap)) =
      Ideal.span {SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M (e.symm (0, 1))}
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankTwo_fst_kernel_transport R e]
  let E := rankTwo_symmetricAlgebraEquiv R e
  change Ideal.comap E.toRingEquiv.toRingHom
    (Ideal.span {SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (R × R) (0, 1)}) = _
  have hmap : Ideal.comap E.toRingEquiv.toRingHom
      (Ideal.span {SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (R × R) (0, 1)}) =
      Ideal.map E.symm.toRingEquiv.toRingHom
        (Ideal.span {SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (R × R) (0, 1)}) :=
    (Ideal.map_symm E.toRingEquiv).symm
  rw [hmap, Ideal.map_span]
  have h : E.symm.toRingEquiv.toRingHom (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (R × R) (0, 1)) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M (e.symm (0, 1)) :=
    SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply _ _
  simp only [Set.image_singleton, h]

statement:
theorem rankTwo_unitPair_fst_principal_kernel (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens) :
    RingHom.ker (symmetricAlgebraMap (S := Γ(X, U))
      (quotientSectionMap
        (biprod.fst : tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) U)) =
