name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geo_flag_exists
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨m7g_flag_of_frame C hC v ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  letI := m7g_nonempty C hC (m7g_i C v)
  have ht' : t < C.positiveRankDimension (m7g_i C v) := by
    rw [m7g_dim C hC]
    exact ht
  exact m7geoP_flag_frame_field C (m7g_i C v) (m7g_i_mem C v) t ht'
    (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure _
      (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) _)
    (m7s_genericRank_pointClosure _ (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) _)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIKD.pullbackK0_mul'
statement:
theorem pullbackK0_mul' {W M : Scheme.{u}} (F : W ⟶ M) (a b : K0 M) :
    pullbackK0 F (a * b) = pullbackK0 F a * pullbackK0 F b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pullbackK0RingHom_toAddMonoidHom]
  exact map_mul (pullbackK0RingHom F) a b

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIKD.pullbackK0_LPof_eq_one
statement:
theorem pullbackK0_LPof_eq_one {W M : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian M] [IsIntegral M] (F : W ⟶ M) (L N : M.Modules)
    (hL : HasConstantRank M L 1) (hN : HasConstantRank M N 1)
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj L ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj N) :
    pullbackK0 F (k0ClassOf M (LPof L N) (hasConstantRank_LPof hL hN).isFiniteLocallyFree) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hD := (lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank N hN).isFiniteLocallyFree
  have h1 : k0ClassOf M (LPof L N) (hasConstantRank_LPof hL hN).isFiniteLocallyFree =
      k0ClassOf M L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree * k0ClassOf M (lineBundleDual M N) hD :=
    (k0ClassOf_mul M ⟨L, hL.isFiniteLocallyFree⟩ ⟨lineBundleDual M N, hD⟩).symm
  have h2 : pullbackK0 F (k0ClassOf M L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree) =
      pullbackK0 F (k0ClassOf M N hN.isFiniteLocallyFree) := by
    rw [pullbackK0_classOf, pullbackK0_classOf]
    exact k0ClassOf_iso W _ _ e
  have h3 := SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.AcyclicGeneration.k0ClassOf_mul_lineBundleDual
    M N hN hD
  rw [h1, pullbackK0_mul', h2, ← pullbackK0_mul', h3]
  exact pullbackK0_one F

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIKD.kdGeo_of_gate
statement: theorem kdGeo_of_gate (G : KDGate k n i hX φk) : KDGeo k n i hX φk
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, N, hL, hN, σ₁, σE, hid₁, hidE, ⟨e⟩⟩ := G
  haveI : IsIntegral X := (Fact.out : D28.ProjectiveIntegral k X).1
  haveI : IsIntegral (concreteGeomX k n i hX φk).M := isIntegral_total k n i
  haveI : IsIntegral (concreteGeomX k n i hX φk).A := isIntegral_space k n
  letI := kerOver k n i
  haveI := ker_lft k n i
  haveI := ker_noeth k n i
  haveI hEI : IsIntegral (SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.InfinityExceptionalGlobal.component (space k n) i.ker) :=
    isIntegral_component i.ker (SchemeKTheory.F14.quasiregularCover k n i
      (CIICLASS.T1N23.projectiveSpace_regStalks k n) hX) (kerOver_member k n i)
  haveI : IsIntegral (concreteGeomX k n i hX φk).E := hEI
  have hGne1 : (concreteGeomX k n i hX φk).j (genericPoint (concreteGeomX k n i hX φk).A) ≠
      genericPoint (concreteGeomX k n i hX φk).M := fibre_generic_ne (space k n) i.ker φk 1
  have hGneE : (concreteGeomX k n i hX φk).e (genericPoint (concreteGeomX k n i hX φk).E) ≠
      genericPoint (concreteGeomX k n i hX φk).M := component_generic_ne (space k n) i.ker φk
  have hZ₁ : height (genericPoint (concreteGeomX k n i hX φk).A) = (n : ℕ∞) :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.height_genericPoint_space k n
  have hXh : height (genericPoint (concreteGeomX k n i hX φk).M) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [height_generic_eq_succ k hL σ₁ (concreteGeomX k n i hX φk).j hid₁ hGne1, hZ₁]
    push_cast; rfl
  have hE : height (genericPoint (concreteGeomX k n i hX φk).E) = (n : ℕ∞) := by
    have h := height_generic_eq_succ k hN σE (concreteGeomX k n i hX φk).e hidE hGneE
    rw [hXh] at h
    have h' : height (genericPoint (concreteGeomX k n i hX φk).E) + 1 = (n : ℕ∞) + 1 := by
      rw [← h]; push_cast; rfl
    exact AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ENat_add_one_cancel h'
  refine ⟨LPof L N, hasConstantRank_LPof hL hN, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (A5FR.fibreRel_cheap (k := k) hL hN σ₁ (concreteGeomX k n i hX φk).j hid₁ σE
      (concreteGeomX k n i hX φk).e hidE hXh hZ₁ hE)
  · exact pullbackK0_LPof_eq_one _ L N hL hN e

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIKD.kdisj_of_gate
statement:
theorem kdisj_of_gate (G : KDGate k n i hX φk) : ∀ x : K0 X,
    chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) ((concretePencilKX k n i hX φk).lift x)
      (totalCapOn (opsV4 k) (concretePencilKX k n i hX φk).LP (concretePencilKX k n i hX φk).hLP
        (fundClass k (W := (concreteGeomX k n i hX φk).M))) = 0
proof:
:=
  kdisj_of_geo k n i hX φk (kdGeo_of_gate k n i hX φk G)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D13.dimCycle_mem_of_prime
statement:
theorem dimCycle_mem_of_prime {m : ℕ} (S : AddSubgroup (dimensionCycles W m))
    (hprime : ∀ (v : W) (hv : height v = m), dimPrimeCycle v m hv ∈ S)
    (D : dimensionCycles W m) : D ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  have hfin : (D.1.support).Finite := by
    simpa using D.1.locallyFiniteSupport.finite_inter_support_of_isCompact
      (isCompact_univ (X := W))
  suffices h : ∀ s : Finset W, ∀ D : dimensionCycles W m, D.1.support ⊆ s → D ∈ S from
    h hfin.toFinset D (by simp)
  intro s
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    intro D hDs
    have hD0 : D = 0 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      ext y
      by_contra hy
      exact absurd (hDs hy) (by simp)
    rw [hD0]
    exact S.zero_mem
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    intro D hDs
    by_cases hDa : D.1 a = 0
    · refine ih D ?_
      intro y hy
      have hy' := hDs hy
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hy' with rfl | h
      · exact absurd hDa hy
      · exact h
    · have hah : height a = m := D.2 hDa
      set P := dimPrimeCycle a m hah with hP
      have hPa : ∀ y, P.1 y = if y = a then 1 else 0 := by
        intro y
        change Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single a 1 y = _
        rw [Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single_apply]
      set R : dimensionCycles W m := D - D.1 a • P with hR
      have hRval : ∀ y, R.1 y = D.1 y - D.1 a * P.1 y := by
        intro y
        rfl
      have hDR : D = R + D.1 a • P := by rw [hR]; abel
      have hRs : R.1.support ⊆ s := by
        intro y hy
        change R.1 y ≠ 0 at hy
        rw [hRval, hPa] at hy
        by_cases hya : y = a
        · subst hya; simp at hy
        · rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp (hDs (by simpa [hya] using hy)) with h | h
          · exact absurd h hya
          · exact h
      rw [hDR]
      exact S.add_mem (ih R hRs) (S.zsmul_mem (hprime a hah) _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D13.ratLinear_ext
statement:
theorem ratLinear_ext {m : ℕ} {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module ℚ N]
    (f g : RationalDimChow W m →ₗ[ℚ] N)
    (h : ∀ D : dimensionCycles W m,
      f ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow W m)) =
        g ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow W m))) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro c
  induction c using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul q x =>
    induction x using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H D =>
      have h3 : q ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow W m) =
          q • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow W m)) := by
        rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      rw [h3, map_smul, map_smul, h D]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D13.tmul1_apply
statement: theorem tmul1_apply (m : ℕ) (c : DimChow W m) : tmul1 W m c = (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] c
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D13.cap_prime_anchor
statement:
theorem cap_prime_anchor (v : X) (hv : height v = n + 1) :
    ops.cap L hL n ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv) : DimChow X (n + 1))) =
      (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (D5.primeCap (k := k) L hL n v hv)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b⟩ := Scheme.Modules.exists_lineBundleLocalDataAt (pointClosureScheme v)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj L)
    (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL v)
    (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one L hL v) (pointClosureGenericPoint v)
  rw [ops.cap_mk L hL n v hv (genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one L hL v) b
      (D5.primeCycleOfFrame (k := k) L hL n v hv b) rfl,
    D5.primeCap_eq (k := k) L hL n v hv b]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D13.cap_anchor
statement:
theorem cap_anchor (D : dimensionCycles X (n + 1)) :
    ops.cap L hL n ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X (n + 1))) =
      (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (D5.capCycles (k := k) L hL n D)
proof:
:= by
  let φ1 : dimensionCycles X (n + 1) →+ RationalDimChow X n :=
    (ops.cap L hL n).toAddMonoidHom.comp ((tmul1 X (n + 1)).comp (mkHom X (n + 1)))
  let φ2 : dimensionCycles X (n + 1) →+ RationalDimChow X n :=
    (tmul1 X n).comp (D5.capCycles (k := k) L hL n)
  have key : D ∈ AddMonoidHom.eqLocus φ1 φ2 := by
    refine dimCycle_mem_of_prime _ (fun v hv ↦ ?_) D
    change φ1 _ = φ2 _
    change ops.cap L hL n ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv) : DimChow X (n + 1))) =
      (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (D5.capCycles (k := k) L hL n (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv))
    rw [D5.capCycles_dimPrimeCycle (k := k) L hL n v hv]
    exact cap_prime_anchor (k := k) ops L hL n v hv
  exact key

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D13.primeCap_iso
statement:
theorem primeCap_iso {L L' : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hL' : HasConstantRank X L' 1) (e : L ≅ L') (n : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = n + 1) :
    D5.primeCap (k := k) L hL n v hv = D5.primeCap (k := k) L' hL' n v hv
proof:
:= by
  have hfL := isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L hL v
  have hfM := isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosure L' hL' v
  have hrL := genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one L hL v
  have hrM := genericRank_pointClosure_of_constantRank_one L' hL' v
  obtain ⟨b⟩ := Scheme.Modules.exists_lineBundleLocalDataAt (pointClosureScheme v)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj L) hfL hrL (pointClosureGenericPoint v)
  let e' : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj L ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj L' :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).mapIso e
  have hdiv := e4_weilDivisor_mapIso hfL hfM hrL hrM b e'
  rw [D5.primeCap_eq (k := k) L hL n v hv b]
  exact (D5.primeCap_eq_mk (k := k) L' hL' n v hv (b.mapIso e')
    (D5.primeCycleOfFrame (k := k) L hL n v hv b) (by rw [hdiv]; rfl)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D13.capCycles_iso
statement:
theorem capCycles_iso {L L' : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hL' : HasConstantRank X L' 1) (e : L ≅ L') (n : ℕ) (D : dimensionCycles X (n + 1)) :
    D5.capCycles (k := k) L hL n D = D5.capCycles (k := k) L' hL' n D
proof:
:= by
  have key : D ∈ AddMonoidHom.eqLocus (D5.capCycles (k := k) L hL n)
      (D5.capCycles (k := k) L' hL' n) := by
    refine dimCycle_mem_of_prime _ (fun v hv ↦ ?_) D
    change D5.capCycles (k := k) L hL n _ = D5.capCycles (k := k) L' hL' n _
    rw [D5.capCycles_dimPrimeCycle, D5.capCycles_dimPrimeCycle]
    exact primeCap_iso (k := k) hL hL' e n v hv
  exact key

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D13.cap_iso_component_D13
statement:
theorem cap_iso_component_D13 {L L' : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hL' : HasConstantRank X L' 1) (e : L ≅ L') (n : ℕ) :
    ops.cap L hL n = ops.cap L' hL' n
proof:
:= by
  apply ratLinear_ext
  intro D
  rw [cap_anchor (k := k) ops L hL n D, cap_anchor (k := k) ops L' hL' n D,
    capCycles_iso (k := k) hL hL' e n D]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D13.cap_iso_D13
statement:
theorem cap_iso_D13 {L L' : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hL' : HasConstantRank X L' 1) (h : Nonempty (L ≅ L')) :
    totalCap ops L hL = totalCap ops L' hL'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := h
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  cases n with
  | zero => apply LinearMap.ext; intro c; simp [totalCap, capComponent]
  | succ m =>
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro c
    simp only [totalCap, LinearMap.comp_apply, DirectSum.toModule_lof, capComponent,
      cap_iso_component_D13 (k := k) ops hL hL' e m]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D13.totalCap_lof_zero_of_eq
statement:
theorem totalCap_lof_zero_of_eq {i : ℕ} (h : i = 0) (z : RationalDimChow X i) :
    totalCap ops L hL (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) i z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  simp [totalCap, capComponent]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D13.totalCap_lof_succ_of_eq
statement:
theorem totalCap_lof_succ_of_eq {i m : ℕ} (h : i = m + 1) (z : RationalDimChow X i)
    (z' : RationalDimChow X (m + 1)) (hz : HEq z z') :
    totalCap ops L hL (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) i z) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) m (ops.cap L hL m z')
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  cases hz
  simp [totalCap, capComponent]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D13.pull_cap_cycles_succ
statement:
theorem pull_cap_cycles_succ (G : CapPullGate (k := k) f hd L hL) (n : ℕ)
    (D : dimensionCycles Y (n + 1)) :
    flatPullbackChowOfFiniteType k f hd n (D5.capCycles (k := k) L hL n D) =
      D5.capCycles (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) (n + d) (pcHom f hd n D)
proof:
:= by
  have key : D ∈ AddMonoidHom.eqLocus
      ((flatPullbackChowOfFiniteType k f hd n).comp (D5.capCycles (k := k) L hL n))
      ((D5.capCycles (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) (n + d)).comp (pcHom f hd n)) := by
    refine dimCycle_mem_of_prime _ (fun v hv ↦ ?_) D
    change flatPullbackChowOfFiniteType k f hd n (D5.capCycles (k := k) L hL n _) =
      D5.capCycles (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) (n + d) (pcHom f hd n _)
    rw [D5.capCycles_dimPrimeCycle (k := k) L hL n v hv]
    exact G.1 n v hv (pcHom f hd n (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv)) rfl
  exact key

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D13.pull_cap_cycles_zero
statement:
theorem pull_cap_cycles_zero (G : CapPullGate (k := k) f hd L hL) {e : ℕ} (hde : d = e + 1)
    (D : dimensionCycles Y 0) :
    D5.capCycles (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
      (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) e (pc0Hom f hd hde D) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have key : D ∈ AddMonoidHom.eqLocus
      ((D5.capCycles (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) e).comp (pc0Hom f hd hde)) 0 := by
    refine dimCycle_mem_of_prime _ (fun v hv ↦ ?_) D
    change D5.capCycles (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) e (pc0Hom f hd hde _) = 0
    exact G.2 e hde v hv (pc0Hom f hd hde (dimPrimeCycle v 0 hv)) rfl
  exact key

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D13.pullD2_one_tmul
statement:
theorem pullD2_one_tmul (n : ℕ) (c : DimChow Y n) :
    D2.pullD2 (k := k) f d hd n ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] c) =
      (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] flatPullbackChowOfFiniteType k f hd n c
proof:
:= by
  induction c using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
  | H D =>
    rw [D2.pullD2_mk (k := k)]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D13.cap_pull_of_gate
statement:
theorem cap_pull_of_gate (G : CapPullGate (k := k) f hd L hL) :
    totalPull ops f d hd ∘ₗ totalCap ops L hL =
      totalCap ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) ∘ₗ totalPull ops f d hd
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro i
  apply ratLinear_ext
  intro D
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  cases i with
  | zero =>
    have h1 : totalCap ops L hL (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow Y n) 0
        ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow Y 0))) = 0 :=
      totalCap_lof_zero_of_eq ops L hL rfl _
    rw [h1, map_zero]
    have h2 : totalPull ops f d hd (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow Y n) 0
        ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow Y 0))) =
        DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) (0 + d)
          ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk
            (⟨flatPullback f D.1, flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles f hd D.2⟩ :
              dimensionCycles X (0 + d)) : DimChow X (0 + d))) := by
      simp only [totalPull, DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply,
        D2.pull_eq_pullD2, D2.pullD2_mk (k := k)]
    rw [h2]
    rcases d with _ | e
    · exact (totalCap_lof_zero_of_eq ops _ (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL)
        (by omega) _).symm
    · rw [totalCap_lof_succ_of_eq ops _ (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL)
        (i := 0 + (e + 1)) (m := e) (by omega) _
        ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (pc0Hom f hd rfl D) : DimChow X (e + 1)))
        (D2.heq_mk_of_eq (by omega) _ (pc0Hom f hd rfl D) rfl),
        cap_anchor (k := k) ops _ (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) e (pc0Hom f hd rfl D),
        pull_cap_cycles_zero (k := k) f hd L hL G rfl D]
      simp
  | succ n =>
    have h1 : totalCap ops L hL (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow Y n) (n + 1)
        ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow Y (n + 1)))) =
        DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow Y n) n
          ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (D5.capCycles (k := k) L hL n D)) := by
      rw [totalCap_lof_succ_of_eq ops L hL (m := n) rfl _ _ HEq.rfl,
        cap_anchor (k := k) ops L hL n D]
    have h2 : totalPull ops f d hd (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow Y n) (n + 1)
        ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow Y (n + 1)))) =
        DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) (n + 1 + d)
          ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk
            (⟨flatPullback f D.1, flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles f hd D.2⟩ :
              dimensionCycles X (n + 1 + d)) : DimChow X (n + 1 + d))) := by
      simp only [totalPull, DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply,
        D2.pull_eq_pullD2, D2.pullD2_mk (k := k)]
    rw [h1, h2]
    rw [totalCap_lof_succ_of_eq ops _ (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL)
      (i := n + 1 + d) (m := n + d) (by omega) _
      ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (pcHom f hd n D) : DimChow X (n + d + 1)))
      (D2.heq_mk_of_eq (by omega) _ (pcHom f hd n D) rfl),
      cap_anchor (k := k) ops _ (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) (n + d) (pcHom f hd n D)]
    simp only [totalPull, DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply, D2.pull_eq_pullD2,
      pullD2_one_tmul (k := k), pull_cap_cycles_succ (k := k) f hd L hL G n D]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D13.push_cap_cycles
statement:
theorem push_cap_cycles (G : CapPushGate (k := k) f L hL) (n : ℕ)
    (D : dimensionCycles X (n + 1)) :
    D9.properPushforwardDimChowD9 (k := k) f n
        (D5.capCycles (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
          (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) n D) =
      D5.capCycles (k := k) L hL n (pfHom (k := k) f (n + 1) D)
proof:
:= by
  have key : D ∈ AddMonoidHom.eqLocus
      ((D9.properPushforwardDimChowD9 (k := k) f n).comp
        (D5.capCycles (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
          (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) n))
      ((D5.capCycles (k := k) L hL n).comp (pfHom (k := k) f (n + 1))) := by
    refine dimCycle_mem_of_prime _ (fun v hv ↦ ?_) D
    change D9.properPushforwardDimChowD9 (k := k) f n
        (D5.capCycles (k := k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
          (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) n _) =
      D5.capCycles (k := k) L hL n (pfHom (k := k) f (n + 1) _)
    rw [D5.capCycles_dimPrimeCycle (k := k) _ _ n v hv]
    exact G n v hv (pfHom (k := k) f (n + 1) (dimPrimeCycle v (n + 1) hv)) rfl
  exact key

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D13.pushD9_one_tmul
statement:
theorem pushD9_one_tmul (n : ℕ) (c : DimChow X n) :
    D9.pushD9 (k := k) f n ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] c) =
      (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] D9.properPushforwardDimChowD9 (k := k) f n c
proof:
:= by
  change D9.properPushforwardRationalDimChowD9 (k := k) f n _ = _
  rw [D9.properPushforwardRationalDimChowD9_tmul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D13.cap_push_of_gate
statement:
theorem cap_push_of_gate (G : CapPushGate (k := k) f L hL) :
    totalPush ops f ∘ₗ
        totalCap ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
          (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) =
      totalCap ops L hL ∘ₗ totalPush ops f
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro i
  apply ratLinear_ext
  intro D
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  have hpush : ∀ (m : ℕ) (c : RationalDimChow X m),
      totalPush ops f (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) m c) =
        DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow Y n) m (D9.pushD9 (k := k) f m c) := by
    intro m c
    simp only [totalPush, DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply, D9.push_eq_pushD9]
  cases i with
  | zero =>
    rw [totalCap_lof_zero_of_eq ops _ (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) rfl, map_zero,
      hpush, totalCap_lof_zero_of_eq ops L hL rfl]
  | succ n =>
    rw [totalCap_lof_succ_of_eq ops _ (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) (m := n) rfl _ _
      HEq.rfl, cap_anchor (k := k) ops _ (hasConstantRank_pullback X f L 1 hL) n D,
      hpush, hpush, D9.pushD9_mk0,
      totalCap_lof_succ_of_eq ops L hL (m := n) rfl _ _ HEq.rfl]
    erw [cap_anchor (k := k) ops L hL n (pfHom (k := k) f (n + 1) D)]
    rw [pushD9_one_tmul (k := k), push_cap_cycles (k := k) f L hL G n D]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.removeNth_succ_cons
statement:
theorem removeNth_succ_cons {n : ℕ} (j : Fin (n + 1)) (a : M) (v : Fin (n + 1) → M) :
    Fin.removeNth j.succ (Fin.cons (α := fun _ => M) a v) =
      Fin.cons (α := fun _ => M) a (Fin.removeNth j v)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simp only [Fin.removeNth_apply]
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i' => ?_) i
  · rw [Fin.succ_succAbove_zero, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_zero]
  · rw [Fin.succ_succAbove_succ, Fin.cons_succ, Fin.cons_succ, Fin.removeNth_apply]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.koszulHtpy_ιMulti
statement:
@[simp]
theorem koszulHtpy_ιMulti (q₀ : M) (m : ℕ) (v : Fin m → M) :
    koszulHtpy q₀ m (exteriorPower.ιMulti R m v) =
      exteriorPower.ιMulti R (m + 1) (Fin.cons q₀ v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [koszulHtpy, exteriorPower.alternatingMapLinearEquiv_apply_ιMulti,
    AlternatingMap.curryLeft_apply_apply]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.neg_pow_succ_zsmul
statement:
private theorem neg_pow_succ_zsmul {N : Type u} [AddCommGroup N] (j : ℕ) (x : N) :
    ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (j + 1)) • x = -(((-1 : ℤ) ^ j) • x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_succ, mul_smul, neg_one_zsmul, smul_neg]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.koszulDiff_koszulHtpy
statement:
theorem koszulDiff_koszulHtpy (σ : M →ₗ[R] R) (q₀ : M) (k : ℕ) :
    koszulDiff σ (k + 1) ∘ₗ koszulHtpy q₀ (k + 1) +
        koszulHtpy q₀ k ∘ₗ koszulDiff σ k =
      σ q₀ • LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext
  apply AlternatingMap.ext
  intro v
  simp only [LinearMap.compAlternatingMap_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.id_coe, id_eq]
  
  rw [koszulHtpy_ιMulti, koszulDiff_ιMulti, koszulDiff_ιMulti, map_sum, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  
  simp only [Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, one_zsmul, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.removeNth_zero, Fin.tail_cons,
    Fin.val_succ, Fin.cons_succ, removeNth_succ_cons, map_zsmul, map_smul, koszulHtpy_ιMulti]
  
  rw [add_assoc, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun j _ => by rw [neg_pow_succ_zsmul, neg_add_cancel]), add_zero]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.koszulAcyclic_of_unit
statement:
theorem koszulAcyclic_of_unit {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module R M] (σ : M →ₗ[R] R) (q₀ : M) (hq : σ q₀ = 1) : KoszulAcyclic σ
proof:
:= by
  intro k b hb
  refine ⟨koszulHtpy q₀ (k + 1) b, ?_⟩
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (koszulDiff_koszulHtpy σ q₀ k) b
  simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    LinearMap.id_coe, id_eq] at h
  rw [hb, map_zero, add_zero, hq, one_smul] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.koszulAcyclicAt_of_unit
statement:
theorem koszulAcyclicAt_of_unit {P : Scheme.{u}} {K : P.Modules} (σ : K ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf P)
    (W : P.affineOpens) (q₀ : (underlyingCommPresheaf P K).obj (op W.1))
    (hq : affineCosection P K σ W q₀ = 1) :
    KoszulAcyclicAt (underlyingCommPresheaf P K) σ.val (op W.1)
proof:
:=
  koszulAcyclic_of_unit (affineCosection P K σ W) q₀ hq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.isIso_tautologicalQuotient_of_rankOne
statement:
theorem isIso_tautologicalQuotient_of_rankOne {L : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X L)
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) : IsIso C.tautologicalQuotient
proof:
:= by
  have hK : Limits.IsZero C.tautologicalKernel :=
    isZero_of_hasConstantRank_zero _ (C.hasConstantRank_tautologicalKernel (r := 0) hL)
  have hS := C.tautologicalKernel_shortExact
  haveI : Mono C.tautologicalQuotient := hS.exact.mono_g (hK.eq_of_src _ _)
  exact isIso_of_mono_of_epi _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.coeff_zero_invOfUnit_one
statement:
theorem coeff_zero_invOfUnit_one {R : Type*} [Ring R] (φ : PowerSeries R) :
    PowerSeries.coeff 0 (PowerSeries.invOfUnit φ 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, PowerSeries.constantCoeff_invOfUnit]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.neg_one_smul_coeff_one_invOfUnit
statement:
theorem neg_one_smul_coeff_one_invOfUnit {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℚ M]
    (φ : PowerSeries (Module.End ℚ M)) :
    ((-1 : ℚ) ^ 1) • PowerSeries.coeff 1 (PowerSeries.invOfUnit φ 1) = PowerSeries.coeff 1 φ
proof:
:= by
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_invOfUnit]
  simp [Finset.Nat.antidiagonal_succ, coeff_zero_invOfUnit_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.chernOfCover_one_of_rankOne_of_segre_zero
statement:
theorem chernOfCover_one_of_rankOne_of_segre_zero {L : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (C : AffineFrameCover X L) (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = 0 + 1)
    (hs0 : segre ops C cp hC 0 = 1) :
    chernOfCover ops C cp hC 1 = totalCap ops L hL
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Flat C.toBase := C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos 0))
  have h1 : chernOfCover ops C cp hC 1 = segre ops C cp hC 1 := by
    unfold chernOfCover segreSeries
    rw [neg_one_smul_coeff_one_invOfUnit, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
  haveI := isIso_tautologicalQuotient_of_rankOne C hL
  have hxi : xiCap ops C = totalCap ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj L)
      (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase L 1 hL) :=
    cp.cap_iso _ _ ⟨(asIso C.tautologicalQuotient).symm⟩
  rw [h1]
  change totalPush ops C.toBase ∘ₗ ((xiCap ops C) ^ (0 + 1)) ∘ₗ
      totalPull ops C.toBase 0 (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC) = _
  have hs0' : totalPush ops C.toBase ∘ₗ ((xiCap ops C) ^ (0 + 0)) ∘ₗ
      totalPull ops C.toBase 0 (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC) = 1 := hs0
  rw [pow_zero] at hs0'
  change totalPush ops C.toBase ∘ₗ LinearMap.id ∘ₗ
      totalPull ops C.toBase 0 (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC) = 1 at hs0'
  rw [LinearMap.id_comp] at hs0'
  rw [zero_add, pow_one, hxi, ← LinearMap.comp_assoc, cp.cap_push, LinearMap.comp_assoc, hs0']
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.chernOfCover_one_of_rankOne
statement:
theorem chernOfCover_one_of_rankOne {L : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (C : AffineFrameCover X L) (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = 0 + 1) :
    chernOfCover ops C cp hC 1 = totalCap ops L hL
proof:
:=
  chernOfCover_one_of_rankOne_of_segre_zero ops cp hL C hC (segre_zero ops C cp hC)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.chernOp_line
statement:
theorem chernOp_line (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) :
    chernOp ops cp L 1 hL 1 = totalCap ops L hL
proof:
:=
  chernOfCover_one_of_rankOne_of_segre_zero ops cp hL _
    (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hL).choose_spec (segre_zero ops _ cp _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.overFrameLinearEquiv_restrict
statement:
theorem overFrameLinearEquiv_restrict {X : Scheme.{u}} {L : X.Modules} {W V : X.Opens}
    (hVW : V ≤ W) (e : L.over W ≅ (tensorUnitSheaf X).over W) (g : L.val.obj (op W)) :
    overFrameLinearEquiv V (restrictOverIsoLE hVW e) (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVW).op g) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVW).op (overFrameLinearEquiv W e g)
proof:
:= by
  have h := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply e.hom.val
    (Over.homMk (homOfLE hVW) : Over.mk (homOfLE hVW) ⟶ Over.mk (𝟙 W)).op g
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.opens_inter_nonempty_of_irreducible
statement:
theorem opens_inter_nonempty_of_irreducible {X : Scheme.{u}} [IrreducibleSpace X]
    {U V : X.Opens} (hU : (U : Set X).Nonempty) (hV : (V : Set X).Nonempty) :
    ((U ⊓ V : X.Opens) : Set X).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  have h := (IrreducibleSpace.isIrreducible_univ X).isPreirreducible U.1 V.1 U.2 V.2
    (by simpa using hU) (by simpa using hV)
  obtain ⟨x, -, hxU, hxV⟩ := h
  exact ⟨x, hxU, hxV⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.unitSection_eq_zero_of_integral
statement:
theorem unitSection_eq_zero_of_integral {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] {L : X.Modules}
    (hline : IsLocalLineFrame L) (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (U0 : X.affineOpens)
    (hU0 : (U0.1 : Set X).Nonempty) (h0 : Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ U0 (1 : Γ(X,U0)) = 0) :
    σ = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  have key : ∀ (W' : X.affineOpens) (e : L.over W'.1 ≅ (tensorUnitSheaf X).over W'.1),
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ W' (1 : Γ(X,W')) = 0 := by
    intro W' e
    by_cases hW : (W'.1 : Set X).Nonempty
    · obtain ⟨x, hxW', hxU0⟩ := opens_inter_nonempty_of_irreducible hW hU0
      obtain ⟨W'', hW'', hxW'', hWle⟩ :=
        (Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens) (show x ∈ W'.1 ⊓ U0.1 from ⟨hxW', hxU0⟩)
      have hW''W' : W'' ≤ W'.1 := hWle.trans inf_le_left
      have hW''U : W'' ≤ U0.1 := hWle.trans inf_le_right
      have hz : Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ W'' (1 : Γ(X,W'')) = 0 := by
        rw [← section_app_one_restrict σ hW''U, h0, map_zero]
      have hcompat := overFrameLinearEquiv_restrict hW''W' e
        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ W' (1 : Γ(X,W')))
      rw [section_app_one_restrict σ hW''W', hz] at hcompat
      erw [LinearEquiv.map_zero] at hcompat
      
      have hgerm : X.presheaf.germ _ x hxW' (overFrameLinearEquiv W'.1 e
          (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ W' (1 : Γ(X,W')))) = 0 := by
        have hg := X.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE hW''W') x hxW''
          (overFrameLinearEquiv W'.1 e (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ W' (1 : Γ(X,W'))))
        rw [← hg, ← hcompat]
        exact map_zero _
      have hf0 : overFrameLinearEquiv W'.1 e (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ W' (1 : Γ(X,W'))) = 0 :=
        germ_injective_of_isIntegral X x hxW' (hgerm.trans (map_zero _).symm)
      exact (overFrameLinearEquiv W'.1 e).injective (hf0.trans (map_zero _).symm)
    · have hb : W'.1 = ⊥ := by ext y; simp [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hW]
      have : Subsingleton Γ(X, W'.1) := by rw [hb]; infer_instance
      exact (overFrameLinearEquiv W'.1 e).injective (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  
  have hall : ∀ W : X.affineOpens, Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ W (1 : Γ(X,W)) = 0 := by
    intro W
    let T : TopCat.Sheaf Ab X := ⟨L.presheaf, L.isSheaf⟩
    let ι := {W' : X.affineOpens // W'.1 ≤ W.1 ∧
      Nonempty (L.over W'.1 ≅ (tensorUnitSheaf X).over W'.1)}
    have hcov : W.1 ≤ ⨆ W' : ι, W'.1.1 := by
      intro y hy
      obtain ⟨V, hyV, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hline y
      obtain ⟨W', hW', hyW', hWle⟩ :=
        (Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens) (show y ∈ V.1 ⊓ W.1 from ⟨hyV, hy⟩)
      have hWV : W' ≤ V.1 := hWle.trans inf_le_left
      exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨⟨W', hW'⟩, hWle.trans inf_le_right,
        ⟨restrictOverIsoLE hWV e⟩⟩, hyW'⟩
    apply T.eq_of_locally_eq' (fun W' : ι => W'.1.1) W.1 (fun W' => homOfLE W'.2.1) hcov
    intro W'
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := W'.2.2
    change L.presheaf.map (homOfLE W'.2.1).op (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ W (1 : Γ(X,W))) =
      L.presheaf.map (homOfLE W'.2.1).op 0
    rw [section_app_one_restrict σ W'.2.1, key W'.1 e, map_zero]
  apply KoszulComplexSheaf.moduleHom_eq_of_affine_app_eq X
  intro W
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro r
  have hsm : ∀ r' : Γ(X, W.1), Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ W r' =
      r' • Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ W (1 : Γ(X,W)) := by
    intro r'
    have h := Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul σ r' (1 : Γ(X,W))
    erw [smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at h
    exact h
  rw [show (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (σ.val.app (op W.1))) r = Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ W r from rfl, hsm r, hall W]
  first | rfl | (simp; done) | (erw [smul_zero]; rfl)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.originalCoordinateSection_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem originalCoordinateSection_eq_zero_iff {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (C : AffineFrameCover X (tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X))
    (s : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X) :
    ((C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso C.toBase).inv ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).map s ≫ C.tautologicalQuotient = 0) ↔
      s ≫ C.tautologicalPushforwardHom = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hnat : (Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).map s ≫ C.tautologicalQuotient =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction C.toBase).homEquiv _ _).symm
        (s ≫ C.tautologicalPushforwardHom) := by
    rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left_symm]
    rfl
  have h0 : ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction C.toBase).homEquiv _ _).symm
      (0 : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.toBase).obj
        (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)) = 0 := by
    rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_counit]
    simp
  haveI : IsIso (C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso C.toBase).inv := inferInstance
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hX : (Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).map s ≫ C.tautologicalQuotient = 0 :=
      (cancel_epi (C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso C.toBase).inv).1 (h.trans comp_zero.symm)
    rw [hnat, ← h0] at hX
    exact ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction C.toBase).homEquiv _ _).symm.injective hX
  · intro h
    have hX : (Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).map s ≫ C.tautologicalQuotient = 0 := by
      rw [hnat, h, h0]
    erw [hX]
    exact comp_zero

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.originalCoordinate_nonvanishing
statement:
theorem originalCoordinate_nonvanishing {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (C : AffineFrameCover X (tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X))
    (s : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X)
    [IsIntegral C.scheme] [Mono C.tautologicalPushforwardHom] (hs : s ≠ 0) :
    ∀ U : C.scheme.affineOpens, Nonempty U.1 →
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
        ((C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso C.toBase).inv ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).map s ≫ C.tautologicalQuotient) U
        (1 : Γ(C.scheme,U)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro U hU h0
  apply hs
  have hline := isLocalLineFrame_of_hasConstantRank (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
  have hz := unitSection_eq_zero_of_integral hline _ U (by simpa using hU) h0
  have := (originalCoordinateSection_eq_zero_iff C s).1 hz
  exact (cancel_mono C.tautologicalPushforwardHom).1 (this.trans zero_comp.symm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.originalCoordinate_nonvanishing_of_coords
statement:
theorem originalCoordinate_nonvanishing_of_coords {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (C : AffineFrameCover X (tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X))
    (s : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X)
    [IsIntegral C.scheme] [Mono C.tautologicalPushforwardHom]
    (hab : ¬ (s ≫ biprod.fst = 0 ∧ s ≫ biprod.snd = 0)) :
    ∀ U : C.scheme.affineOpens, Nonempty U.1 →
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
        ((C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso C.toBase).inv ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).map s ≫ C.tautologicalQuotient) U
        (1 : Γ(C.scheme,U)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine originalCoordinate_nonvanishing C s ?_
  rintro rfl
  exact hab ⟨zero_comp, zero_comp⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.chartι_transportSchemeHom
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem chartι_transportSchemeHom (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    (i : C'.I) :
    (transport e C').chartι i ≫ transportSchemeHom e C' =
      (chartIso e C' i).hom ≫ C'.chartι i
proof:
:=
  Multicoequalizer.π_desc _ _ _ _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.overlapIso_inv_toChart
statement:
theorem overlapIso_inv_toChart (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    (i j : C'.I) :
    (overlapIso e C' i j).inv ≫ (transport e C').overlapToChart i j =
      C'.overlapToChart i j ≫ (chartIso e C' i).inv
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (chartIso e C' i).hom).1
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  calc
    (overlapIso e C' i j).inv ≫ (transport e C').overlapToChart i j ≫
        (chartIso e C' i).hom =
      (overlapIso e C' i j).inv ≫
        ((overlapIso e C' i j).hom ≫ C'.overlapToChart i j) := by
          simpa only [Category.assoc] using
            congrArg (fun f ↦ (overlapIso e C' i j).inv ≫ f)
              (overlapIso_hom_toChart e C' i j).symm
    _ = C'.overlapToChart i j := by
      rw [← Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.id_comp]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.overlapIso_inv_transition
statement:
theorem overlapIso_inv_transition (e : E ≅ E') (C' : AffineFrameCover X E')
    (i j : C'.I) :
    (overlapIso e C' i j).inv ≫ (transport e C').transition i j =
      C'.transition i j ≫ (overlapIso e C' j i).inv
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (overlapIso e C' j i).hom).1
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  calc
    (overlapIso e C' i j).inv ≫
        ((transport e C').transition i j ≫ (overlapIso e C' j i).hom) =
      (overlapIso e C' i j).inv ≫
        ((overlapIso e C' i j).hom ≫ C'.transition i j) := by
          rw [overlapIso_transition]
    _ = C'.transition i j := by simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportSchemeIso_toBase
statement:
theorem transportSchemeIso_toBase (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') :
    (transportSchemeIso e C').hom ≫ C'.toBase =
      (transport e C').toBase
proof:
:= by
  apply Multicoequalizer.hom_ext _ _ _
  intro i
  change C'.I at i
  change (transport e C').chartι i ≫
      (transportSchemeHom e C' ≫ C'.toBase) =
    (transport e C').chartι i ≫ (transport e C').toBase
  calc
    _ = (chartIso e C' i).hom ≫ (C'.chartι i ≫ C'.toBase) := by
          simpa only [Category.assoc] using
            congrArg (fun f ↦ f ≫ C'.toBase)
              (chartι_transportSchemeHom e C' i)
    _ = (chartIso e C' i).hom ≫ C'.chartToAmbient i := by
          exact congrArg (fun f ↦ (chartIso e C' i).hom ≫ f)
            (C'.chartι_toBase i)
    _ = (transport e C').chartToAmbient i := chartIso_hom_toAmbient e C' i
    _ = _ := ((transport e C').chartι_toBase i).symm

statement:
theorem pow_lof_eq_zero {u : Alg.Op M} (hu : u ∈ lowSub M 1) (n : ℕ) (z : M n) {m : ℕ}
    (hm : n < m) : (u ^ m) (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M n z) = 0

  low_lof_lt (GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.pow_mem_lowSub hu m) hm z

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIKD.exists_trunc
statement:
theorem exists_trunc {u : Alg.Op M} (hu : u ∈ lowSub M 1) (a : DirectSum ℕ M) :
    ∃ N, ∀ N' ≥ N, (u ^ N') a = 0 ∧
      Alg.gexp u a = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N', ((j.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) • (u ^ j) a
proof:
:= by
  induction a using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, fun N' _ => ⟨by simp, by simp⟩⟩
  | of n z =>
    refine ⟨n + 1, fun N' hN' => ⟨by
      rw [← DirectSum.lof_eq_of ℚ]; exact pow_lof_eq_zero hu n z (by omega), ?_⟩⟩
    rw [← DirectSum.lof_eq_of ℚ, Alg.gexp_lof]
    simp only [LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply]
    exact Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono hN') fun j _ hj =>
      by rw [pow_lof_eq_zero hu n z (by simpa using hj), smul_zero]
  | add a b ha hb =>
    obtain ⟨N1, h1⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨N2, h2⟩ := hb
    refine ⟨max N1 N2, fun N' hN' => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [map_add, (h1 N' (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hN')).1,
        (h2 N' (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hN')).1, add_zero]
    · rw [map_add, (h1 N' (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hN')).2,
        (h2 N' (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hN')).2, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by rw [map_add, smul_add]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIKD.nil_of_gexp_fix
statement:
theorem nil_of_gexp_fix {u : Alg.Op M} (hu : u ∈ lowSub M 1) (a : DirectSum ℕ M)
    (h : Alg.gexp u a = a) : u a = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_trunc hu a
  have hR : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, (((j + 1).factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) • (u ^ (j + 1)) a = 0 := by
    have h1 := (hN (N + 1) (Nat.le_succ N)).2
    rw [h, Finset.sum_range_succ'] at h1
    simp only [Nat.factorial_zero, Nat.cast_one, inv_one, pow_zero, Module.End.one_apply,
      one_smul] at h1
    refine add_right_cancel (b := a) ?_
    rw [zero_add]
    exact h1.symm
  have Q : ∀ d m, N ≤ m + d → (u ^ (m + 1)) a = 0 := by
    intro d
    induction d with
    | zero =>
      intro m hm
      have : u ^ (m + 1) = u ^ (m + 1 - N) * u ^ N := by
        rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
      rw [this, Module.End.mul_apply, (hN N le_rfl).1, map_zero]
    | succ d ih =>
      intro m hm
      by_cases hc : N ≤ m + d
      · exact ih m hc
      · have hR' := congrArg (u ^ m) hR
        simp only [map_zero, map_sum, map_smul, ← Module.End.mul_apply, ← pow_add] at hR'
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 0] at hR'
        · simpa [add_assoc] using hR'
        · intro j _ hj
          rw [show m + (j + 1) = (m + j) + 1 by omega, ih (m + j) (by omega), smul_zero]
        · intro h0
          exact absurd (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)) h0
  simpa using Q N 0 (by omega)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIKD.chK0_lineMul
statement:
theorem chK0_lineMul (hCh : ChExact k (closedPosV4 k)) (L : W.Modules)
    (hL : HasConstantRank W L 1) (y : K0 W) :
    chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) hCh (k0ClassOf W L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree * y) =
      chBundle k (closedPosV4 k) L * chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) hCh y
proof:
:= by
  let f : K0 W →+ Module.End ℚ (TotalChow W) :=
    (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) hCh).comp (AddMonoidHom.mulLeft (k0ClassOf W L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree))
  let g : K0 W →+ Module.End ℚ (TotalChow W) :=
    (AddMonoidHom.mulLeft (chBundle k (closedPosV4 k) L)).comp (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) hCh)
  have hfg : f = g := by
    refine ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext (A := Module.End ℚ (TotalChow W)) (f := f) (g := g) (Object := {E : W.Modules // IsFiniteLocallyFree W E})
      (Exact := ExactGrothendieck.shortExactIn W.Modules (IsFiniteLocallyFree W)) ?_
    intro x
    obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := x
    change chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) hCh (k0ClassOf W L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree * k0ClassOf W E hE) =
      chBundle k (closedPosV4 k) L * chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) hCh (k0ClassOf W E hE)
    rw [mul_comm]
    have hm : k0ClassOf W E hE * k0ClassOf W L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree =
        k0ClassOf W (tensorSheaf W E L) (tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree W E L hE
          hL.isFiniteLocallyFree) :=
      k0ClassOf_mul W ⟨E, hE⟩ ⟨L, hL.isFiniteLocallyFree⟩
    rw [hm, chK0_classOf, chK0_classOf, GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4A.chBundle_tensor_line k E L hE hL]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hfg y

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIKD.chK0_cap_of_fix
statement:
theorem chK0_cap_of_fix (hCh : ChExact k (closedPosV4 k)) (LP : W.Modules)
    (hLP : HasConstantRank W LP 1) (y : K0 W)
    (hfix : k0ClassOf W LP hLP.isFiniteLocallyFree * y = y) :
    chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) hCh y (totalCapOn (opsV4 k) LP hLP (fundClass k (W := W))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : chBundle k (closedPosV4 k) LP * chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) hCh y =
      chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) hCh y := by
    rw [← chK0_lineMul hCh LP hLP, hfix]
  rw [GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.chBundle_line (closedPosV4 k) LP hLP] at h1
  have hv : Alg.gexp (totalCapOn (opsV4 k) LP hLP)
      (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) hCh y (fundClass k (W := W))) =
      chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) hCh y (fundClass k (W := W)) :=
    LinearMap.congr_fun h1 _
  have h2 := nil_of_gexp_fix (GRRBlueprintV4.CIIL1E.totalCapOn_mem_lowSub LP hLP) _ hv
  have hc := LinearMap.congr_fun (GRRBlueprintV4.A12ZX.chK0_comm_cap k (closedPosV4 k) hCh LP hLP y)
    (fundClass k (W := W))
  simp only [Module.End.mul_apply] at hc
  rw [← hc]
  exact h2

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.formalFreeAbSheafHomSectionsAddEquiv_apply_π

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.formalSectionsEvalOp_map_apply_π
statement:
theorem formalSectionsEvalOp_map_apply_π
    (F : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} X)
    {Y Z : (FormalCoproduct.{0} (Opens X))ᵒᵖ} (f : Y ⟶ Z)
    (s : ((FormalCoproduct.evalOp.{0} (Opens X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj F.obj).obj Y)
    (i : Z.unop.I) :
    (Pi.π (fun j : Z.unop.I ↦ F.obj.obj (op (Z.unop.obj j))) i).hom
        ((((FormalCoproduct.evalOp.{0} (Opens X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj F.obj).map f).hom s) =
      F.obj.map (f.unop.φ i).op
        ((Pi.π (fun j : Y.unop.I ↦ F.obj.obj (op (Y.unop.obj j))) (f.unop.f i)).hom s)
proof:
:= by
  change (Pi.π (fun j : Z.unop.I ↦ F.obj.obj (op (Z.unop.obj j))) i).hom
      ((Pi.lift (fun i : Z.unop.I ↦
        Pi.π (fun j : Y.unop.I ↦ F.obj.obj (op (Y.unop.obj j))) (f.unop.f i) ≫
          F.obj.map (f.unop.φ i).op)).hom s) = _
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, Pi.lift_π]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.exists_affineFrameCover
statement:
theorem exists_affineFrameCover
    (hE : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) :
    Nonempty (AffineFrameCover X E)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin⟩ := hE.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := hqfin
  choose κ hsub heq using
    fun i ↦ Opens.isBasis_iff_cover.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens (q.X i)
  let U : (Σ i : q.I, κ i) → X.Opens := fun j ↦ j.2
  refine ⟨
    { I := Σ i : q.I, κ i
      U := U
      covers := ?_
      isAffine := fun j ↦ hsub j.1 j.2.2
      basisIndex := fun j ↦ (q.generators j.1).I
      basisIndex_finite := fun j ↦ by
        letI : (q.generators j.1).IsFiniteType :=
          SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType j.1
        infer_instance
      frame := fun j ↦ ?_ }⟩
  · have hcover : IsOpenCover q.X :=
      (Opens.coversTop_iff X q.X).mp q.coversTop
    rw [IsOpenCover, iSup_sigma, ← hcover]
    refine iSup_congr fun i ↦ ?_
    rw [heq i, sSup_eq_iSup']
  · let F := SheafOfModules.overMap X.ringCatSheaf
      (homOfLE (show U j ≤ q.X j.1 by
        dsimp only [U]
        simp [heq, le_sSup]))
    exact
      Scheme.Modules.freeOverMapIso X (q.X j.1) (U j)
          (show U j ≤ q.X j.1 by
            dsimp only [U]
            simp [heq, le_sSup])
          (q.generators j.1).I ≪≫
        F.mapIso (asIso (q.generators j.1).π) ≪≫
          (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf
            (homOfLE (show U j ≤ q.X j.1 by
              dsimp only [U]
              simp [heq, le_sSup]))).app E

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechEquation_succAbove
statement:
theorem coordinateCechEquation_succAbove (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateCechEquation k n (p + 1) a =
      coordinateCechEquation k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove) * coordinate k n (a r)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [coordinateCechEquation, Function.comp_apply, mul_comm] using
    (Fin.prod_univ_succAbove (fun t : Fin (p + 2) ↦ coordinate k n (a t)) r)

      coordinateCechDenominatorLaurentExponent n p (a ∘ r.succAbove) +
        coordinateLaurentBasisExponent n (a r)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [coordinateCechDenominatorLaurentExponent, Function.comp_apply, add_comm] using
    (Fin.sum_univ_succAbove
      (fun t : Fin (p + 2) ↦ coordinateLaurentBasisExponent n (a t)) r)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechEquationLaurent_coordinate_mul_inverse
statement:
theorem coordinateCechEquationLaurent_coordinate_mul_inverse (p : ℕ)
    (r : Fin (p + 2)) (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    polynomialToCoordinateLaurent k n (coordinate k n (a r)) *
        coordinateCechEquationLaurentInverse k n (p + 1) a =
      coordinateCechEquationLaurentInverse k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove)
proof:
:= by
  rw [polynomialToCoordinateLaurent_coordinate,
    coordinateCechEquationLaurentInverse_eq_single,
    coordinateCechEquationLaurentInverse_eq_single,
    coordinateCechDenominatorLaurentExponent_succAbove,
    AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, one_mul]
  congr 1
  abel

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechAwayToLaurent_coface
statement:
theorem coordinateCechAwayToLaurent_coface (p : ℕ) (r : Fin (p + 2))
    (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (z : HomogeneousLocalization.Away
      (grading k n) (coordinateCechEquation k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove))) :
    coordinateCechAwayToLaurent k n (p + 1) a
        (coordinateCechAwayCoface k n p r a z) =
      coordinateCechAwayToLaurent k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove) z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, f, hf, rfl⟩ := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_surjective
    (grading k n)
    (coordinateCechEquation_mem_degree k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove)) z
  rw [coordinateCechAwayCoface, HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap_mk,
    coordinateCechAwayToLaurent_mk, coordinateCechAwayToLaurent_mk,
    map_mul, map_pow]
  calc
    (polynomialToCoordinateLaurent k n f *
          polynomialToCoordinateLaurent k n (coordinate k n (a r)) ^ q) *
        coordinateCechEquationLaurentInverse k n (p + 1) a ^ q =
      polynomialToCoordinateLaurent k n f *
        (polynomialToCoordinateLaurent k n (coordinate k n (a r)) *
          coordinateCechEquationLaurentInverse k n (p + 1) a) ^ q := by
      ring
    _ = polynomialToCoordinateLaurent k n f *
        coordinateCechEquationLaurentInverse k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove) ^ q := by
      rw [coordinateCechEquationLaurent_coordinate_mul_inverse]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface_eq_algebraic
statement:
theorem coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface_eq_algebraic (p : ℕ)
    (r : Fin (p + 2)) (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1)) :

proof:
:=

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechBasicOpenIsoAway_coface_apply
statement:
theorem coordinateCechBasicOpenIsoAway_coface_apply (p : ℕ)
    (r : Fin (p + 2)) (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (z : HomogeneousLocalization.Away
      (grading k n) (coordinateCechEquation k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove))) :
    (space k n).presheaf.map (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p r a).op
        ((coordinateCechBasicOpenIsoAway k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove)).hom z) =
      (coordinateCechBasicOpenIsoAway k n (p + 1) a).hom
        (coordinateCechAwayCoface k n p r a z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface_eq_algebraic]
  change
    ((Proj (grading k n)).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (Proj.basicOpen_mono (grading k n)
        (coordinateCechEquation k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove))
        (coordinateCechEquation k n (p + 1) a)
        ⟨coordinate k n (a r), coordinateCechEquation_succAbove k n p r a⟩)).op)
      (Proj.awayToSection (grading k n)
        (coordinateCechEquation k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove)) z) =
    Proj.awayToSection (grading k n) (coordinateCechEquation k n (p + 1) a)
      (HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap (grading k n)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n (a r))
        (coordinateCechEquation_succAbove k n p r a) z)
  simpa only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, CommRingCat.ofHom_apply,
    ConcreteCategory.hom_ofHom] using
    (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (Proj.awayMap_awayToSection (grading k n)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one k n (a r))
        (coordinateCechEquation_succAbove k n p r a)) z).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent_coface
statement:
theorem coordinateCechBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent_coface (p : ℕ)
    (r : Fin (p + 2)) (a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1))
    (s : Γ(space k n, coordinateCechBasicOpen k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove))) :
    coordinateCechBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent k n (p + 1) a
        ((space k n).presheaf.map
          (coordinateCechBasicOpenCoface k n p r a).op s) =
      coordinateCechBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove) s
proof:
:= by
  let e := coordinateCechBasicOpenIsoAway k n p (a ∘ r.succAbove)
  let z := e.inv s
  have hs : e.hom z = s := e.inv_hom_id_apply s
  rw [← hs, coordinateCechBasicOpenIsoAway_coface_apply,
    coordinateCechBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent_basicOpenIsoAway_hom,
    coordinateCechBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent_basicOpenIsoAway_hom,
    coordinateCechAwayToLaurent_coface]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateTwistingTransitionLaurentMonomial_mul_frame
statement:
theorem coordinateTwistingTransitionLaurentMonomial_mul_frame (d : ℤ)
    (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateTwistingTransitionLaurentMonomial k n d i j *
        coordinateTwistingFrameLaurentMonomial k n d i =
      coordinateTwistingFrameLaurentMonomial k n d j
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateTwistingTransitionLaurentMonomial,
    coordinateTwistingFrameLaurentMonomial,
    coordinateTwistingFrameLaurentMonomial,
    AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, one_mul]
  congr 1
  rw [smul_sub]
  abel

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateComponent_compatibility
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateComponent_compatibility (d : ℤ)
    (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d) ≫
          Pi.π (fun t : Fin (n + 1) ↦
            pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n t)) i ≫
          pushedUnitRestriction
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_left) =
      kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d) ≫
          Pi.π (fun t : Fin (n + 1) ↦
            pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n t)) j ≫
          pushedUnitRestriction
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_right) ≫
          pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition k n d i j
proof:
:= by
  let overlaps := fun ij : Fin (n + 1) × Fin (n + 1) ↦
    pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n)
      (coordinateOverlapOpen k n ij.1 ij.2)
  let qij := Pi.π overlaps (i, j)
  calc
    _ = (kernel.ι
            (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d) ≫
          coordinateDescentLeft k n) ≫ qij := by
        simp only [Category.assoc, coordinateDescentLeft_π, qij, overlaps]
    _ = (kernel.ι
            (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d) ≫
          coordinateDescentRight k n d) ≫ qij :=
        congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ qij)
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf_overlap_compatibility k n d)
    _ = _ := by
        simp only [Category.assoc, coordinateDescentRight_π, qij, overlaps]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateComponent_compatibility_apply
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateComponent_compatibility_apply (d : ℤ)
    (i j : Fin (n + 1)) (W : (space k n).Opens)
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d, W)) :
    ((kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d) ≫
          Pi.π (fun t : Fin (n + 1) ↦
            pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n t)) i ≫
          pushedUnitRestriction
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_left)).app W) x =
      ((kernel.ι (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d) ≫
          Pi.π (fun t : Fin (n + 1) ↦
            pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n t)) j ≫
          pushedUnitRestriction
            ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_right) ≫
          pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition k n d i j).app W) x
proof:
:= by
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (congrArg (fun f ↦ f.app W)
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateComponent_compatibility k n d i j)) x

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateComponent_compatibility_apply_explicit
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateComponent_compatibility_apply_explicit
    (d : ℤ) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) (W : (space k n).Opens)
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d, W)) :
    (pushedUnitRestriction
        ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_left)).app W
      ((Pi.π (fun t : Fin (n + 1) ↦
          pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n t)) i).app W
        ((kernel.ι
          (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)).app W x)) =
      (pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition k n d i j).app W
        ((pushedUnitRestriction
          ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_right)).app W
          ((Pi.π (fun t : Fin (n + 1) ↦
              pushedUnit (ProjectiveTwistSpace k n) (coordinateOpen k n t)) j).app W
            ((kernel.ι
              (coordinateDescentLeft k n - coordinateDescentRight k n d)).app W x)))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] using
    projectiveTwistingSheaf_coordinateComponent_compatibility_apply k n d i j W x

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv_apply (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (x : coordinateCechHigherTerm k n (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) p)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv k n d p x a =
      coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv k n d p a
        ((Limits.Pi.π (fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.obj
            (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b))) a).hom x)
proof:
:= by
  let f := fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
    (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d).presheaf.obj
      (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n p b))
  let g := fun b : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
    AddCommGrpCat.of (coordinateLaurentPiece k n d p b)
  let e : ∀ b, f b ≅ g b := fun b ↦
    ((coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv k n d p b).toAddCommGrpIso :
      f b ≅ g b)
  let ePi := Limits.Pi.mapIso e
  let hPi := Limits.productIsProduct' (Discrete.functor g)
  let hRaw := (AddCommGrpCat.HasLimit.productLimitCone g).isLimit
  let eRaw := IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso hPi hRaw
  have hRawApply :
      ((eRaw.hom (ePi.hom x) : coordinateLaurentHigherTerm k n d p) a) =
        (Limits.Pi.π g a).hom (ePi.hom x) := by
    exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso_hom_comp hPi hRaw ⟨a⟩) (ePi.hom x)
  have hPiApply :
      (Limits.Pi.π g a).hom (ePi.hom x) =
        (e a).hom ((Limits.Pi.π f a).hom x) := by
    exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (Limits.Pi.mapIso_hom_π e a) x
  change ((eRaw.hom (ePi.hom x) : coordinateLaurentHigherTerm k n d p) a) =
    (e a).hom ((Limits.Pi.π f a).hom x)
  exact hRawApply.trans hPiApply

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E23.restrict_smul
statement:
theorem restrict_smul {Y : Scheme.{u}} (M : Y.Modules) (U : Y.Opens) (V : U.toScheme.Opens)
    (r : Γ(Y, U.ι ''ᵁ V)) (x : Γ(M, U.ι ''ᵁ V)) :
    (show Γ(U.toScheme, V) from r) • (show Γ(M.restrict U.ι, V) from x) =
      (show Γ(M.restrict U.ι, V) from r • x)
proof:
:= by
  change (M.smul ((U.ι.appIso V).inv r)).hom x = r • x
  rw [Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E23.proj_tautS
statement:
theorem proj_tautS (k : ι) (e : M) (V : (linearOpen R M (b k)).toScheme.Opens) :
    (linearLocalFrameProjection R M b 1 k).app V
      ((twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b 1).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_top : (linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ V ≤ ⊤)).op (tautS R M b e)) =
      (linearOpen R M (b k)).toScheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op
        (show Γ((linearOpen R M (b k)).toScheme, ⊤) from tautChart_component R M (b k) e)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := a11_projection_taut R M b k e
  have h2 := tautChart_app_map (linearLocalFrameProjection R M b 1 k) (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤))
    ((twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b 1).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_top : (linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ ⊤)).op (tautS R M b e))
  have h3 : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (linearOpen R M (b k)).ι).obj
      (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b 1)).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op
        ((twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b 1).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (le_top : (linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ ⊤)).op (tautS R M b e)) =
      (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b 1).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_top : (linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ V ≤ ⊤)).op (tautS R M b e) := by
    rw [Scheme.Modules.restrict_map]
    erw [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
    rfl
  rw [← h3, h2]
  exact congrArg _ h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E23.image_preimage_eq
statement:
theorem image_preimage_eq (x : M) (V : (space R M).Opens) :
    (linearOpen R M x).ι ''ᵁ ((linearOpen R M x).ι ⁻¹ᵁ V) = linearOpen R M x ⊓ V
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E23.ratio_cocycle
statement:
theorem ratio_cocycle (k : ι) (m e : M) {Q : (space R M).Opens}
    (hQ : Q ≤ linearOpen R M (b k) ⊓ linearOpen R M m) :
    (space R M).presheaf.map (homOfLE (hQ.trans inf_le_left)).op (tautChart_ratioSection R M (b k) e) =
      (space R M).presheaf.map (homOfLE (hQ.trans inf_le_right)).op (tautChart_ratioSection R M m e) *
      (space R M).presheaf.map (homOfLE (hQ.trans inf_le_left)).op (tautChart_ratioSection R M (b k) m)
proof:
:= by
  have hT : Q ≤ linearOverlapOpen R M (b k) m := hQ.trans (linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M _ _).ge
  have h1 := tautSection_key R M e (b k) m hT
  have h2 := tautSection_key R M m (b k) m hT
  have e4 : Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M) (linearForm R M m) (tautSection_ratio R M m m) =
      1 := tautChart_ratioSection_self R M m
  rw [e4] at h2
  erw [map_one, mul_one] at h2
  change _ = _ * _ at h1
  change (space R M).presheaf.map _ (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M) (linearForm R M (b k))
      (tautSection_ratio R M e (b k))) = (space R M).presheaf.map _ (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M)
        (linearForm R M m) (tautSection_ratio R M e m)) * (space R M).presheaf.map _
          (Proj.awayToSection (symGrading R M) (linearForm R M (b k)) (tautSection_ratio R M m (b k)))
  refine h1.trans ((mul_comm _ _).trans ?_)
  exact congrArg _ h2.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E23.tautS_rel
statement:
theorem tautS_rel (m e : M) :
    (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b 1).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_top : linearOpen R M m ≤ ⊤)).op (tautS R M b e) =
      (tautChart_ratioSection R M m e) •
        (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b 1).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (le_top : linearOpen R M m ≤ ⊤)).op (tautS R M b m)
proof:
:= by
  set T := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b 1 with hT
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  refine E22.sections_eq_zero_of_locally (fun k : ι => (linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ
    ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M m)) ?_ ?_ _ ?_
  · intro k
    rw [image_preimage_eq]
    exact inf_le_right
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp
      (show x ∈ (⨆ k, linearOpen R M (b k) : (space R M).Opens) by
        rw [linearOpen_iSup_eq_top R M b]; trivial)
    refine TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨k, ?_⟩
    rw [image_preimage_eq]
    exact ⟨hk, hx⟩
  · intro k
    set D := linearOpen R M (b k) with hD
    set Vk : D.toScheme.Opens := D.ι ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M m with hVk
    have hinj : ∀ x : Γ(T, D.ι ''ᵁ Vk),
        (linearLocalFrameProjection R M b 1 k).app Vk x = 0 → x = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      have h := congrArg (fun f => Scheme.Modules.Hom.app f Vk x)
        (linearLocalFrameProjection_kernelLift R M b 1 k)
      simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
        Scheme.Modules.Hom.id_app, ConcreteCategory.id_apply] at h
      refine h.symm.trans ?_
      erw [hx]
      exact map_zero _
    refine hinj _ ?_
    have hQ : D.ι ''ᵁ Vk = D ⊓ linearOpen R M m := image_preimage_eq R M (b k) _
    have hQV : D.ι ''ᵁ Vk ≤ linearOpen R M m := hQ.le.trans inf_le_right
    have e1 : (T.presheaf.map (homOfLE hQV).op)
        (T.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : linearOpen R M m ≤ ⊤)).op (tautS R M b e) -
          tautChart_ratioSection R M m e •
            T.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : linearOpen R M m ≤ ⊤)).op (tautS R M b m)) =
        T.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : D.ι ''ᵁ Vk ≤ ⊤)).op (tautS R M b e) -
          ((space R M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hQV).op (tautChart_ratioSection R M m e)) •
            T.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : D.ι ''ᵁ Vk ≤ ⊤)).op (tautS R M b m) := by
      rw [map_sub, Scheme.Modules.map_smul]
      erw [← Functor.map_comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp_apply]
      rfl
    erw [e1]
    have hc : ∀ x' : M, D.toScheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : Vk ≤ ⊤)).op
        (show Γ(D.toScheme, ⊤) from tautChart_component R M (b k) x') =
        (space R M).presheaf.map (homOfLE (hQ.le.trans inf_le_left)).op
          (tautChart_ratioSection R M (b k) x') := by
      intro x'
      simp only [tautChart_component]
      change (space R M).presheaf.map _ ((space R M).presheaf.map _ _) = _
      rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
      rfl
    let P := linearLocalFrameProjection R M b 1 k
    let A : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor D.ι).obj T, Vk) :=
      T.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : D.ι ''ᵁ Vk ≤ ⊤)).op (tautS R M b e)
    let B : Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor D.ι).obj T, Vk) :=
      T.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : D.ι ''ᵁ Vk ≤ ⊤)).op (tautS R M b m)
    let r : Γ(D.toScheme, Vk) := (space R M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hQV).op
      (tautChart_ratioSection R M m e)
    have pe : P.app Vk A = D.toScheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : Vk ≤ ⊤)).op
        (show Γ(D.toScheme, ⊤) from tautChart_component R M (b k) e) :=
      proj_tautS R M b k e Vk
    have pm : P.app Vk B = D.toScheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : Vk ≤ ⊤)).op
        (show Γ(D.toScheme, ⊤) from tautChart_component R M (b k) m) :=
      proj_tautS R M b k m Vk
    have key : P.app Vk (A - r • B) = 0 := by
      rw [map_sub, Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul, pe, pm, hc, hc]
      have hr := ratio_cocycle R M b k m e (Q := D.ι ''ᵁ Vk) hQ.le
      rw [sub_eq_zero]
      exact hr
    refine Eq.trans (congrArg (P.app Vk) (?_ : _ = A - r • B)) key
    have hsm := restrict_smul T D Vk ((space R M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hQV).op
      (tautChart_ratioSection R M m e))
      (T.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : D.ι ''ᵁ Vk ≤ ⊤)).op (tautS R M b m))
    exact congrArg _ hsm.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E23.presheaf_map_eq_of_heq
statement:
theorem presheaf_map_eq_of_heq {Z : Scheme.{u}} {U V : Z.Opens} (h : U = V) (a : Γ(Z, U))
    (c : Γ(Z, V)) (H : HEq a c) : Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE h.ge).op a = c
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  have : (homOfLE (le_refl U)).op = 𝟙 (op U) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [this]
  rw [Functor.map_id_apply]
  exact eq_of_heq H

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E23.map_ratio
statement:
theorem map_ratio (m e : M) :
    (space R N).presheaf.map (homOfLE (symmetricProjMap_preimage_linearOpen (S := R) φ hspan m).ge).op
      ((symmetricProjMap (S := R) φ hspan).app (linearOpen R M m) (tautChart_ratioSection R M m e)) =
      ratioN R M N φ e m
proof:
:=
  presheaf_map_eq_of_heq (symmetricProjMap_preimage_linearOpen (S := R) φ hspan m) _ _
    (tautSection_symmetricProjMap_app_ratio_heq (S := R) φ hspan e m)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E23.unit_tautS_rel
statement:
theorem unit_tautS_rel (m e : M) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (symmetricProjMap (S := R) φ hspan)).obj
        (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b 1)).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (le_top : linearOpen R N (φ m) ≤ symmetricProjMap (S := R) φ hspan ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤)).op
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (symmetricProjMap (S := R) φ hspan)).unit.app
        (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b 1)).app ⊤ (tautS R M b e)) =
    ratioN R M N φ e m •
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (symmetricProjMap (S := R) φ hspan)).obj
        (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b 1)).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (le_top : linearOpen R N (φ m) ≤ symmetricProjMap (S := R) φ hspan ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤)).op
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (symmetricProjMap (S := R) φ hspan)).unit.app
        (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b 1)).app ⊤ (tautS R M b m))
proof:
:= by
  set g := symmetricProjMap (S := R) φ hspan with hg
  set T := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b 1 with hT
  let G : (space R M).Modules := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).obj
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj T)
  let u : T ⟶ G := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app T
  have A1 : ∀ x : Γ(T, ⊤), u.app (linearOpen R M m) (T.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (le_top : linearOpen R M m ≤ ⊤)).op x) = G.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (le_top : linearOpen R M m ≤ ⊤)).op (u.app ⊤ x) :=
    fun x => tautChart_app_map u _ x
  have H1 := tautS_rel R M b m e
  have H3 : G.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : linearOpen R M m ≤ ⊤)).op (u.app ⊤ (tautS R M b e)) =
      tautChart_ratioSection R M m e • G.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_top : linearOpen R M m ≤ ⊤)).op (u.app ⊤ (tautS R M b m)) := by
    rw [← A1, ← A1, ← Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul]
    exact congrArg _ H1
  have hV : linearOpen R N (φ m) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M m :=
    (symmetricProjMap_preimage_linearOpen (S := R) φ hspan m).ge
  have H4 := congrArg (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj T).presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op) H3
  have H5 : ∀ (r : Γ(space R M, linearOpen R M m)) (y : Γ(G, linearOpen R M m)),
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj T).presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op (r • y) =
        (space R N).presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op (g.app (linearOpen R M m) r) •
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj T).presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op y :=
    fun r y => Scheme.Modules.map_smul ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj T) (homOfLE hV)
      (g.app (linearOpen R M m) r) y
  rw [H5, map_ratio R M N φ hspan m e] at H4
  have K : ∀ x : Γ(T, ⊤),
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj T).presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op
        (G.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : linearOpen R M m ≤ ⊤)).op (u.app ⊤ x)) =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj T).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_top : linearOpen R N (φ m) ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤)).op (u.app ⊤ x) := by
    intro x
    change ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj T).presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj T).presheaf.map (homOfLE _).op (u.app ⊤ x)) = _
    erw [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
    rfl
  rw [K, K] at H4
  exact H4

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E23.claim3
statement:
theorem claim3 {V O : Scheme.{u}} (g : V ⟶ O) {A T : O.Modules} (iso : A ≅ T)
    (O' : O.Opens) (hjO : ⊤ ≤ O') (a : Γ(A, O')) (Wo : V.Opens) (h2 : Wo ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ O') :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).mapIso iso).hom.app Wo
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj A).presheaf.map (homOfLE h2).op
          (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app A).app O' a)) =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj T).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : Wo ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤)).op
        (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app T).app ⊤
          (iso.hom.app ⊤ (A.presheaf.map (homOfLE hjO).op a)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Functor.mapIso_hom]
  rw [tautChart_app_map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map iso.hom) (homOfLE h2)]
  rw [C1Cap.pullback_map_unit g iso.hom O' a]
  have e1 : iso.hom.app ⊤ (A.presheaf.map (homOfLE hjO).op a) =
      T.presheaf.map (homOfLE hjO).op (iso.hom.app O' a) := tautChart_app_map iso.hom _ a
  rw [e1]
  have e2 : ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app T).app ⊤
      (T.presheaf.map (homOfLE hjO).op (iso.hom.app O' a)) =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj T).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (g.preimage_mono hjO : g ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤ ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ O')).op
        (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app T).app O' (iso.hom.app O' a)) :=
    tautChart_app_map ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app T) (homOfLE hjO) _
  rw [e2]
  symm
  erw [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E23.claim2
statement:
theorem claim2 {S Y O V : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ S) (j : O ⟶ S) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (e : V ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion e] (g : V ⟶ O) (w : g ≫ j = e ≫ f)
    {L : S.Modules} (O' : S.Opens) (Wo : V.Opens) (h1 : Wo ≤ e ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ O'))
    (s : Γ(L, O')) :
    ((restrictFunctor e).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)).presheaf.map (homOfLE h1).op
        (((restrictAdjunction e).unit.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)).app (f ⁻¹ᵁ O')
          (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app L).app O' s)) =
      (m7geoF_sqIso f j e g w L).hom.app Wo
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj ((restrictFunctor j).obj L)).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (h1.trans (m7geoF_sq_preimage_eq f j e g w O').le)).op
          (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app ((restrictFunctor j).obj L)).app (j ⁻¹ᵁ O')
            (((restrictAdjunction j).unit.app L).app O' s)))
proof:
:= by
  have hsq := m7geoF_sqIso_hom_unit f j e g w L O' s
  rw [← hsq]
  rw [tautChart_app_map (m7geoF_sqIso f j e g w L).hom]
  erw [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E23.square_rel
statement:
theorem square_rel {S Y O V : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ S) (j : O ⟶ S) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (e : V ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion e] (g : V ⟶ O) (w : g ≫ j = e ≫ f)
    {L : S.Modules} {T : O.Modules} (iso : (restrictFunctor j).obj L ≅ T)
    (O' : S.Opens) (hjO : ⊤ ≤ j ⁻¹ᵁ O') (Wo : V.Opens)
    (hW : e ''ᵁ Wo ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ O') (se sm : Γ(L, O')) (te tm : Γ(T, ⊤))
    (hte : iso.hom.app ⊤ (((restrictFunctor j).obj L).presheaf.map (homOfLE hjO).op
      (((restrictAdjunction j).unit.app L).app O' se)) = te)
    (htm : iso.hom.app ⊤ (((restrictFunctor j).obj L).presheaf.map (homOfLE hjO).op
      (((restrictAdjunction j).unit.app L).app O' sm)) = tm)
    (ρ : Γ(V, Wo))
    (hρ : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj T).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : Wo ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤)).op
        (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app T).app ⊤ te) =
      ρ • ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj T).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : Wo ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤)).op
        (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app T).app ⊤ tm)) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L).presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op
        (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app L).app O' se) =
      ((e.appIso Wo).inv ρ) • ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L).presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op
        (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app L).app O' sm)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Wo ≤ e ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ O') := (e.preimage_image_eq Wo).ge.trans
    (e.preimage_mono hW)
  have h2 : Wo ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ (j ⁻¹ᵁ O') := h1.trans (m7geoF_sq_preimage_eq f j e g w O').le
  let ψ := (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).mapIso iso
  let θ := m7geoF_sqIso f j e g w L
  
  have key : ∀ (s : Γ(L, O')) (t : Γ(T, ⊤)),
      iso.hom.app ⊤ (((restrictFunctor j).obj L).presheaf.map (homOfLE hjO).op
        (((restrictAdjunction j).unit.app L).app O' s)) = t →
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L).presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op
        (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app L).app O' s) =
      θ.hom.app Wo (ψ.inv.app Wo (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj T).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_top : Wo ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤)).op
        (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app T).app ⊤ t))) := by
    intro s t ht
    have c2 := claim2 f j e g w O' Wo h1 s (L := L)
    have c3 := claim3 g iso (j ⁻¹ᵁ O') hjO
      (((restrictAdjunction j).unit.app L).app O' s) Wo h2
    rw [ht] at c3
    have hR : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L).presheaf.map (homOfLE hW).op
        (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app L).app O' s) =
        ((restrictFunctor e).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE h1).op
        (((restrictAdjunction e).unit.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)).app (f ⁻¹ᵁ O')
          (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app L).app O' s)) := by
      rw [restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app, Scheme.Modules.restrict_map]
      erw [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
      rfl
    rw [hR, c2]
    refine congrArg (θ.hom.app Wo) ?_
    refine Eq.trans ?_ (congrArg (ψ.inv.app Wo) c3)
    exact (C1Cap.iso_inv_hom_app ψ Wo _).symm
  rw [key se te hte, key sm tm htm, hρ, Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul, Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E23.linOpenD_le
statement:
theorem linOpenD_le (i : P.I) (x : D.val.obj (op (P.U i))) :
    (P.toD.chartι i) ''ᵁ linOpenD P i x ≤ P.jHom ⁻¹ᵁ (P.toB.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ P.U i)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (P.toD.chartι i) ''ᵁ linOpenD P i x ≤ (P.toD.chartι i) ''ᵁ ⊤ :=
    (P.toD.chartι i).image_mono le_top
  refine h1.trans ?_
  rw [AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_chartι_image_top]
  have h : (P.jHom ≫ P.toB.toBase) ⁻¹ᵁ P.U i = P.jHom ⁻¹ᵁ (P.toB.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ P.U i) := rfl
  rw [← h, P.jHom_toBase]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E23.unit_rel
statement:
theorem unit_rel (i : P.I) (m e : B.val.obj (op (P.U i))) (x : D.val.obj (op (P.U i)))
    (hx : SchemeProjectiveBundle.E14.secMap b (P.U i) m = x) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P.jHom).obj (P.toB.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (linOpenD_le P i x)).op
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction P.jHom).unit.app
        (P.toB.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)).app (P.toB.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ P.U i)
        ((P.toB.tautologicalPushforwardHom.val.app (op (P.U i))).hom e)) =
      ((P.toD.chartι i).appIso (linOpenD P i x)).inv (ratioD P i e x) •
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P.jHom).obj (P.toB.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (linOpenD_le P i x)).op
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction P.jHom).unit.app
        (P.toB.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)).app (P.toB.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ P.U i)
        ((P.toB.tautologicalPushforwardHom.val.app (op (P.U i))).hom m))
proof:
:= by
  subst hx
  letI : Finite (P.toB.basisIndex i) := P.toB.basisIndex_finite i
  refine square_rel P.jHom (P.toB.chartι i) (P.toD.chartι i) (P.chartMap i)
    (P.chartι_jHom i).symm (P.toB.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 i)
    (P.toB.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ P.U i) (le_of_eq (P.toB.pullbackTwistQuotient_chart_global_top i).symm)
    (linOpenD P i (SchemeProjectiveBundle.E14.secMap b (P.U i) m)) (linOpenD_le P i _) _ _
    (tautS _ _ (P.toB.sectionBasis i) e) (tautS _ _ (P.toB.sectionBasis i) m) ?_ ?_ _ ?_
  · exact rankTwo_originalChart_unit_tautRecovery P.toB i e
  · exact rankTwo_originalChart_unit_tautRecovery P.toB i m
  · exact unit_tautS_rel _ _ _ (P.toB.sectionBasis i) (SchemeProjectiveBundle.E14.secMap b (P.U i)) _ m e

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E12.gradedQuotMap_comp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E12.ker_coordRestrict
statement: theorem ker_coordRestrict : LinearMap.ker (coordRestrict b l) = R ∙ b l
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, Submodule.mem_span_singleton]
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨b.repr m l, ?_⟩
    apply b.repr.injective
    ext k
    by_cases hk : k = l
    · subst hk; simp
    · have := congrArg (fun f => f ⟨k, hk⟩) h
      simpa [coordRestrict, hk] using this.symm
  · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
    ext ⟨k, hk⟩
    simp [coordRestrict]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E12.coordRestrict_surjective
statement: theorem coordRestrict_surjective : Function.Surjective (coordRestrict b l)
proof:
:= by
  intro f
  refine ⟨b.repr.symm (Finsupp.embDomain ⟨Subtype.val, Subtype.val_injective⟩ f), ?_⟩
  ext ⟨k, hk⟩
  simp only [coordRestrict, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, Finsupp.lcomapDomain_apply]
  rw [Finsupp.comapDomain_apply]
  exact Finsupp.embDomain_apply_self (⟨Subtype.val, Subtype.val_injective⟩ : {k // k ≠ l} ↪ ι) f ⟨k, hk⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E12.symIdeal_span_basis
statement: theorem symIdeal_span_basis : symIdeal (R ∙ b l) = Ideal.span {SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M (b l)}
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [symIdeal, Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hn
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, map_smul, Algebra.smul_def]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.subset_span rfl)
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ rfl
    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨b l, Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _, rfl⟩

theorem quotProjIso_of_eq (I : HomogeneousIdeal (symGrading R M)) (hI : symHomIdeal (R ∙ b l) = I)
    [Module.Free R (M ⧸ (R ∙ b l))] [Module.Finite R (M ⧸ (R ∙ b l))] :
    ∃ e : space R (M ⧸ (R ∙ b l)) ≅ Proj (GradedIdealQuotient.grading (symGrading R M) I),
      e.hom ≫ GradedIdealQuotient.projMap (symGrading R M) I =
        symmetricProjMap (S := R) (R ∙ b l).mkQ (mkQ_spans _)
proof:
:= by
  subst hI
