name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E12.coordinate_zero_scheme_E12
statement:
theorem coordinate_zero_scheme_E12 :
    haveI
proof:
:= quotCoord_free b l
    haveI := quotCoord_finite b l
    (∃ e : space R (M ⧸ (R ∙ b l)) ≅
        Proj (GradedIdealQuotient.grading (symGrading R M) (rankTwo_coordinateIdeal R b l)),
        e.hom ≫ rankTwo_coordinateQuotient R b l =
          symmetricProjMap (S := R) (R ∙ b l).mkQ (mkQ_spans _)) ∧
    IsClosedImmersion (symmetricProjMap (S := R) (R ∙ b l).mkQ (mkQ_spans _)) ∧
    ∀ k : ι, IsRegular (rankTwo_coordinatePrincipalChart R b k l).equation := by
  haveI := quotCoord_free b l
  haveI := quotCoord_finite b l
  exact ⟨quotProjIso_of_eq b l _ (symHomIdeal_span_basis b l), inferInstance,
    fun k => rankTwo_coordinatePrincipalChart_isRegular R b k l⟩

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIZSM.zeroE_comp_total_eq_secInf
statement:
theorem zeroE_comp_total_eq_secInf :
    zeroE k n i φk ≫ componentToTotal (space k n) i.ker =
      ARRASM.secInf k n i.ker ≫ subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k n) i.ker
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := KSpecialization.ARRHBCP.inv_comp_fst_eq_secInf (space k n) i.ker
    (iotaSigma k n i φk) (ker_iotaSigma k n i φk)
  have hc := pullback.condition (f := subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k n) i.ker)
    (g := iotaSigma k n i φk)
  rw [zeroE_comp_total, zeroSigma, Category.assoc, ← hc, ← Category.assoc]
  exact congrArg (fun t => t ≫ subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k n) i.ker) h1

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIZSM.zeroSection_isoE0_eq_zeroE
statement:
theorem zeroSection_isoE0_eq_zeroE [IsIntegral (Zs k n i.ker)]
    (hZ : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme (Zs k n i.ker))
    (CN : AffineFrameCover (Zs k n i.ker) (Nsh k n i.ker)) (hr : RangeGate k n i.ker hZ) :
    (Cov k n i.ker CN).zeroSection ≫ (isoE0 k n i.ker hZ CN).hom = zeroE k n i φk
proof:
:= by
  have hzs := hzs_of_chart k n i.ker hZ CN (chartGate_of_range k n i.ker hZ hr)
  have h1 : EιOfIso k n i.ker CN (isoE0 k n i.ker hZ CN) =
      (isoE0 k n i.ker hZ CN).hom ≫ componentToTotal (space k n) i.ker := rfl
  rw [h1, ← Category.assoc] at hzs
  rw [← cancel_mono (componentToTotal (space k n) i.ker), zeroE_comp_total_eq_secInf k n i φk]
  exact hzs

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIZSM.isoE0_toCentre
statement:
theorem isoE0_toCentre (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ) (J : (space k n).IdealSheafData)
    [IsIntegral (Zs k n J)] (hZ : BlowupRegularAR12.IsRegularScheme (Zs k n J))
    (CN : AffineFrameCover (Zs k n J) (Nsh k n J)) :
    (isoE0 k n J hZ CN).hom ≫ componentToCentre (space k n) J = (Cov k n J CN).toBase
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := isoUnionLeft_toBase (Cov k n J CN)
    (localFrameCover (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ))
  have h2 := isoUnionRight_toBase (Cov k n J CN)
    (localFrameCover (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ))
  have h3 := localFrameComponentIso_toCentre (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ)
  simp only [isoE0, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc]
  have h5 : ((Cov k n J CN).isoUnionRight (localFrameCover (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ))).inv ≫
      (localFrameCover (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ)).toBase =
      ((Cov k n J CN).union (localFrameCover (space k n) J (Cq k n J hZ))).toBase := by
    rw [Iso.inv_comp_eq, h2]
  rw [h3, h5, h1]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIZSM.exists_zsModelX
statement:
theorem exists_zsModelX [IsIntegral i.ker.subscheme] (hd : 0 < codim k n i.ker)

      (concreteGeomX k n i hX φk).s e)
proof:

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistLocalChartComponent_self_project
statement:
theorem twistLocalChartComponent_self_project
    {d : ℤ} (T : C.TwistTransitionSystem d)
    (hT : C.TwistTransitionLaws T) (i : C.I) :
    C.twistLocalChartComponent T i i ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso
          (C.chartι i)).hom.app
            (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i) =
      𝟙 (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsIso (C.overlapToChart i i) := by
    change IsIso (C.glueData.f i i)
    infer_instance
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.transition i i) :=
    C.transition_isOpenImmersion' i i
  letI : IsOpenImmersion
      (C.transition i i ≫ C.overlapToChart i i) :=
    IsOpenImmersion.comp _ _
  let g : C.chart i ⟶ C.overlap i i :=
    inv (C.overlapToChart i i)
  letI : IsOpenImmersion g := by
    dsimp only [g]
    infer_instance
  have hgf :
      g ≫ C.overlapToChart i i = 𝟙 _ := by
    dsimp only [g]
    simp
  have hgr :
      g ≫ (C.transition i i ≫ C.overlapToChart i i) =
        𝟙 _ := by
    rw [C.transition_self i, Category.id_comp]
    exact hgf
  have hAlong :=
    C.twistRestrictTransitionAlongIso_hom_eq T
      (C.chartι i) g (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _)
      (by simp) (by simp) hgf hgr
  rw [hT.self i] at hAlong
  have hAlongId :
      (C.twistRestrictTransitionAlongIso T g
        (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) hgf hgr).hom = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [hAlong]
    simp
  have hAlongConj :
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorId.inv.app
            (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i) ≫
          (C.twistRestrictTransitionAlongIso T g
            (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) hgf hgr).hom ≫
        Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorId.hom.app
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i) =
      𝟙 (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i) := by
    rw [hAlongId]
    simp
  unfold twistRestrictTransitionAlongIso at hAlongConj
  change
    C.twistLocalChartComponent T i i ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction
          (C.chartι i)).counit.app
            (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i) =
      𝟙 (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)
  ext U : 1
  unfold twistLocalChartComponent
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app]
  simp_rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app]
  simp_rw [Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app]
  simp_rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictPushforwardBaseChangeIso_inv_app]
  simp_rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction_counit_app_app]
  have hAlongApp := congrArg
    (fun φ ↦ φ.app U) hAlongConj
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app] at hAlongApp
  rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorId_inv_app_app] at hAlongApp
  have hCongrL :=
    Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr_hom_app_app
      (U := U) hgf.symm (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)
  change
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr hgf.symm).app
        (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)).hom U = _ at hCongrL
  rw [hCongrL] at hAlongApp
  have hCompL :=
    Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp_hom_app_app
      (U := U) g (C.overlapToChart i i)
        (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)
  change
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp g
        (C.overlapToChart i i)).app
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)).hom U = _ at hCompL
  rw [hCompL] at hAlongApp
  have hMap :=
    CommonBasicOpen.twistPullHomAux_restrictFunctor_map_app
      g (C.twistRestrictTransitionIso T i i).hom U
  change
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor g).mapIso
        (C.twistRestrictTransitionIso T i i)).hom U = _ at hMap
  rw [hMap] at hAlongApp
  have hCompR :=
    Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp_inv_app_app
      (U := U) g
        (C.transition i i ≫ C.overlapToChart i i)
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)
  change
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp g
        (C.transition i i ≫ C.overlapToChart i i)).app
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)).symm.hom U = _ at hCompR
  rw [hCompR] at hAlongApp
  have hCongrR :=
    Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr_inv_app_app
      (U := U) hgr.symm (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)
  change
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr hgr.symm).app
        (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)).symm.hom U = _ at hCongrR
  rw [hCongrR] at hAlongApp
  rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorId_hom_app_app] at hAlongApp
  have hOpenInv :
      g ''ᵁ U = C.overlapToChart i i ⁻¹ᵁ U := by
    have hfg :
        C.overlapToChart i i ≫ g = 𝟙 _ := by
      dsimp only [g]
      simp
    apply Opens.ext
    ext x
    change
      (∃ y, y ∈ U ∧ g y = x) ↔
        C.overlapToChart i i x ∈ U
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      have hyEq := congrArg (fun q ↦ q y) hgf
      change C.overlapToChart i i (g y) = y at hyEq
      rw [hyEq]
      exact hy
    · intro hx
      refine ⟨C.overlapToChart i i x, hx, ?_⟩
      have hxEq := congrArg (fun q ↦ q x) hfg
      change g (C.overlapToChart i i x) = x at hxEq
      exact hxEq
  have hLeftImage :
      C.overlapToChart i i ''ᵁ (g ''ᵁ U) = U := by
    simpa using
      Scheme.Modules.image_image_eq_image_of_comp_of_open
        g (C.overlapToChart i i) (𝟙 _) hgf U
  have hRightImage :
      (C.transition i i ≫ C.overlapToChart i i) ''ᵁ
          (g ''ᵁ U) = U := by
    simpa using
      Scheme.Modules.image_image_eq_image_of_comp_of_open
        g (C.transition i i ≫ C.overlapToChart i i)
          (𝟙 _) hgr U
  have hR :=
    (C.twistRestrictTransitionIso T i i).hom.mapPresheaf.naturality
      (eqToHom hOpenInv).op
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.mapPresheaf_app,
    Opposite.unop_op] at hR
  change
    (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i).presheaf.map _ ≫
        Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
          (C.twistRestrictTransitionIso T i i).hom
          (g ''ᵁ U) =
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
          (C.twistRestrictTransitionIso T i i).hom
          (C.overlapToChart i i ⁻¹ᵁ U) ≫
        (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i).presheaf.map _ at hR
  let a :=
    (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i).presheaf.map
      ((C.overlapToChart i i).opensFunctor.map
        (eqToHom hOpenInv)).op
  let b :=
    (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i).presheaf.map
      ((C.transition i i ≫
        C.overlapToChart i i).opensFunctor.map
          (eqToHom hOpenInv)).op
  change
    a ≫ Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
        (C.twistRestrictTransitionIso T i i).hom
          (g ''ᵁ U) =
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
          (C.twistRestrictTransitionIso T i i).hom
          (C.overlapToChart i i ⁻¹ᵁ U) ≫ b at hR
  letI : IsIso b := by
    dsimp only [b]
    infer_instance
  have hRMove :
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
          (C.twistRestrictTransitionIso T i i).hom
          (C.overlapToChart i i ⁻¹ᵁ U) =
        a ≫ Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
            (C.twistRestrictTransitionIso T i i).hom
            (g ''ᵁ U) ≫ inv b := by
    apply (cancel_mono b).1
    simpa only [Category.assoc, IsIso.inv_hom_id,
      Category.comp_id] using hR.symm
  have hAlongAppN :
      (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i).presheaf.map
            (eqToHom hLeftImage).op ≫
          Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
            (C.twistRestrictTransitionIso T i i).hom
              (g ''ᵁ U) ≫
        (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i).presheaf.map
            (eqToHom hRightImage.symm).op =
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
        (𝟙 (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)) U := by
    rw [← hAlongApp]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    slice_rhs 1 3 =>
      rw [← Category.assoc]
      rw [Scheme.Modules.presheaf_map_comp₃_eq_op
        (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)
        (h := (eqToHom hLeftImage).op)]
    slice_rhs 3 5 =>
      rw [← Category.assoc]
      rw [Scheme.Modules.presheaf_map_comp₃_eq_op
        (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)
        (h := (eqToHom hRightImage.symm).op)]
  slice_lhs 2 2 =>
    rw [hRMove]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  dsimp only [a, b]
  rw [← Functor.map_inv]
  slice_lhs 1 2 =>
    rw [Scheme.Modules.presheaf_map_comp_eq_op
      (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)
      (h := (eqToHom hLeftImage).op)]
  slice_lhs 3 5 =>
    rw [← Category.assoc]
    rw [Scheme.Modules.presheaf_map_comp₃_eq_op
      (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)
      (h := (eqToHom hRightImage.symm).op)]
  exact hAlongAppN

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistLocalChartCochain_project
statement:
theorem twistLocalChartCochain_project
    {d : ℤ} (T : C.TwistTransitionSystem d)
    (hT : C.TwistTransitionLaws T) (i : C.I) :
    C.twistLocalChartCochain T i ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι i)).map
          (Pi.π (C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).chartTerm i) =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso
        (C.chartι i)).inv.app (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)
proof:
:= by
  let ε := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso
    (C.chartι i)).app (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)
  apply (cancel_mono ε.hom).1
  calc
    _ = C.twistLocalChartComponent T i i ≫ ε.hom :=
      congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ ε.hom)
        (C.twistLocalChartCochain_π T i i)
    _ = 𝟙 _ := C.twistLocalChartComponent_self_project T hT i
    _ = ε.inv ≫ ε.hom := (Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc ε (𝟙 _)).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistLocalChartKernelLift_restrictionProjection
statement:
theorem twistLocalChartKernelLift_restrictionProjection
    {d : ℤ} (T : C.TwistTransitionSystem d)
    (hT : C.TwistTransitionLaws T) (i : C.I) :
    C.twistLocalChartKernelLift T hT i ≫
        (@Scheme.Modules.DescentData.restrictionProjection
          _ _ (C.twistingSheafDescentData d T) i
            (C.chartι_isOpenImmersion i)) =
      𝟙 (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)
proof:
:= by
  let D := C.twistingSheafDescentData d T
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι i)
  let ε := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso
    (C.chartι i)).app (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)
  change C.twistLocalChartKernelLift T hT i ≫
      G.map (D.component i) ≫ ε.hom = 𝟙 _
  rw [Scheme.Modules.DescentData.component, Functor.map_comp]
  calc
    (C.twistLocalChartKernelLift T hT i ≫
          G.map (kernel.ι
            (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight))) ≫
        G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm i) ≫ ε.hom =
      C.twistLocalChartCochain T i ≫
        G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm i) ≫ ε.hom := by
          rw [C.twistLocalChartKernelLift_ι T hT i]
    _ = ε.inv ≫ ε.hom :=
      congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ ε.hom)
        (C.twistLocalChartCochain_project T hT i)
    _ = 𝟙 _ := ε.inv_hom_id

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistRestrictedRightUnit_isIso
statement:
theorem twistRestrictedRightUnit_isIso
    {d : ℤ} (T : C.TwistTransitionSystem d) (i j : C.I) :
    IsIso
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι i)).map
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit
          ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).toAmbient j)
          ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).right (i, j))
          ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).module j)))
proof:
:= by
  let f := C.overlapToChart i j
  let g := C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i
  let Mi := C.chartTwistingSheaf d j
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.transition i j) :=
    C.transition_isOpenImmersion' i j
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.overlapToChart j i) :=
    C.overlapToChart_isOpenImmersion j i
  letI : IsOpenImmersion g := by
    dsimp only [g]
    exact IsOpenImmersion.comp _ _
  letI : IsOpenImmersion
      (C.glueData.chosenPullback i j).p₂ := by
    change IsOpenImmersion
      (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i)
    infer_instance
  rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.isIso_iff_isIso_app]
  intro U
  let V := C.chartι j ⁻¹ᵁ (C.chartι i ''ᵁ U)
  have hBC :
      g ''ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) = V := by
    dsimp only [f, g, V]
    exact
      IsOpenImmersion.image_preimage_eq_preimage_image_of_isPullback
        (C.glueData.chosenPullback i j).isPullback U
  have hV : g ''ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ V) = V := by
    rw [← hBC, Scheme.Hom.preimage_image_eq g]
  let η :=
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app Mi) V
  let c :=
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback g).inv.app Mi)
        (g ⁻¹ᵁ V)
  have hη :
      η ≫ c =
        Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction g).unit.app Mi) V := by
    have h := congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ.app V)
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackUnit_restrictFunctorIsoPullback_inv g Mi)
    simpa only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app,
      Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app] using h
  haveI hc : IsIso c := by
    dsimp only [c]
    infer_instance
  haveI hunit :
      IsIso
        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction g).unit.app Mi) V) := by
    rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app]
    change IsIso
      (Mi.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (g.image_preimage_le V)).op)
    let e : op V ≅ op (g ''ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ V)) :=
      eqToIso (congrArg op hV.symm)
    have he :
        (homOfLE (g.image_preimage_le V)).op = e.hom :=
      Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [he]
    infer_instance
  haveI hηc : IsIso (η ≫ c) := by
    rw [hη]
    infer_instance
  haveI hηiso : IsIso η :=
    IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right η c
  unfold Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit
  rw [Functor.map_comp, Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app]
  change IsIso
    (η ≫
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp g (C.chartι j)).hom.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj Mi))
          (C.chartι i ''ᵁ U))
  infer_instance

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistRestrictedRightLeg_isIso
statement:
theorem twistRestrictedRightLeg_isIso
    {d : ℤ} (T : C.TwistTransitionSystem d) (i j : C.I) :
    IsIso (C.twistRestrictedRightLeg T i j)
proof:
:= by
  letI := C.twistRestrictedRightUnit_isIso T i j
  dsimp only [twistRestrictedRightLeg]
  infer_instance

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistRestrictedKernel_generatedByLocalCochain
statement:
theorem twistRestrictedKernel_generatedByLocalCochain
    {d : ℤ} (T : C.TwistTransitionSystem d)
    (hT : C.TwistTransitionLaws T) (i : C.I) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι i)).map
        (kernel.ι
          ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).descentLeft -
            (C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).descentRight)) =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι i)).map
          (kernel.ι
            ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).descentLeft -
              (C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).descentRight)) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι i)).map
          (Pi.π (C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).chartTerm i) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso
          (C.chartι i)).hom.app (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i) ≫
        C.twistLocalChartCochain T i
proof:
:= by
  let D := C.twistingSheafDescentData d T
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι i)
  let ε := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso
    (C.chartι i)).app (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)
  apply (cancel_mono
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictPiIso (C.chartι i) D.chartTerm).hom).1
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro j
  slice_lhs 2 3 =>
    rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictPiIso_hom_π]
  slice_rhs 5 6 =>
    rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictPiIso_hom_π]
  let rL :=
    G.map
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardPullbackUnit
        (D.toAmbient i) (D.left (i, j)) (D.module i))
  let rR := C.twistRestrictedRightLeg T i j
  letI : IsIso rR := C.twistRestrictedRightLeg_isIso T i j
  have hKij :
      (G.map
          (kernel.ι (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight)) ≫
        G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm i)) ≫ rL =
      (G.map
          (kernel.ι (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight)) ≫
        G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm j)) ≫ rR := by
    have h := congrArg (fun q ↦ G.map q)
      (D.component_compatibility (i, j))
    simp only [Scheme.Modules.DescentData.component,
      Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc] at h
    simpa only [rL, rR, twistRestrictedRightLeg,
      Category.assoc] using h
  have hFij :
      (C.twistLocalChartCochain T i ≫
        G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm i)) ≫ rL =
      (C.twistLocalChartCochain T i ≫
        G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm j)) ≫ rR := by
    calc
      _ = C.twistLocalChartComponent T i i ≫ rL :=
        congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ rL)
          (C.twistLocalChartCochain_π T i i)
      _ = C.twistLocalChartComponent T i j ≫ rR := by
        simpa only [rL, rR, twistRestrictedRightLeg,
          Category.assoc] using
            C.twistLocalChartComponent_compatibility T hT i i j
      _ = _ :=
        congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ rR)
          (C.twistLocalChartCochain_π T i j).symm
  have hεF :
      ε.hom ≫ C.twistLocalChartCochain T i ≫
          G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm i) = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [← Category.assoc]
    calc
      ε.hom ≫
          (C.twistLocalChartCochain T i ≫
            G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm i)) =
        ε.hom ≫ ε.inv :=
          congrArg (fun q ↦ ε.hom ≫ q)
            (C.twistLocalChartCochain_project T hT i)
      _ = 𝟙 _ := ε.hom_inv_id
  have hεFij :
      rL =
        ε.hom ≫ C.twistLocalChartCochain T i ≫
          G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm j) ≫ rR := by
    calc
      rL =
          (ε.hom ≫ C.twistLocalChartCochain T i ≫
            G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm i)) ≫ rL := by
              rw [hεF, Category.id_comp]
      _ = ε.hom ≫
          ((C.twistLocalChartCochain T i ≫
            G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm i)) ≫ rL) := by
              simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = ε.hom ≫
          ((C.twistLocalChartCochain T i ≫
            G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm j)) ≫ rR) :=
              congrArg (fun q ↦ ε.hom ≫ q) hFij
      _ = _ := by simp only [Category.assoc]
  apply (cancel_mono rR).1
  calc
    (G.map
          (kernel.ι (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight)) ≫
        G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm j)) ≫ rR =
      (G.map
          (kernel.ι (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight)) ≫
        G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm i)) ≫ rL :=
          hKij.symm
    _ = (G.map
          (kernel.ι (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight)) ≫
        G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm i)) ≫
          (ε.hom ≫ C.twistLocalChartCochain T i ≫
            G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm j) ≫ rR) :=
              congrArg
                (fun q ↦
                  (G.map
                      (kernel.ι
                        (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight)) ≫
                    G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm i)) ≫ q)
                hεFij
    _ = (((G.map
          (kernel.ι (D.descentLeft - D.descentRight)) ≫
        G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm i)) ≫ ε.hom ≫
          C.twistLocalChartCochain T i) ≫
            G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm j)) ≫ rR := by
              simp only [Category.assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistRestrictionProjection_kernelLift
statement:
theorem twistRestrictionProjection_kernelLift
    {d : ℤ} (T : C.TwistTransitionSystem d)
    (hT : C.TwistTransitionLaws T) (i : C.I) :
    (@Scheme.Modules.DescentData.restrictionProjection
        _ _ (C.twistingSheafDescentData d T) i
          (C.chartι_isOpenImmersion i)) ≫
        C.twistLocalChartKernelLift T hT i =
      𝟙 ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι i)).obj
        (C.twistingSheafOfTransitions d T))
proof:
:= by
  let D := C.twistingSheafDescentData d T
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι i)
  let φ := D.descentLeft - D.descentRight
  letI : G.Additive := by
    constructor
    intro A B p q
    rfl
  letI : G.PreservesZeroMorphisms :=
    Functor.preservesZeroMorphisms_of_additive G
  letI : G.PreservesHomology :=
    Functor.preservesHomology_of_map_exact G
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor_map_exact (C.chartι i))
  letI : PreservesLimit (parallelPair φ 0) G :=
    Functor.PreservesHomology.preservesKernel G φ
  apply (cancel_mono (G.map (kernel.ι φ))).1
  calc
    ((@Scheme.Modules.DescentData.restrictionProjection
          _ _ D i (C.chartι_isOpenImmersion i)) ≫
        C.twistLocalChartKernelLift T hT i) ≫
          G.map (kernel.ι φ) =
      (@Scheme.Modules.DescentData.restrictionProjection
          _ _ D i (C.chartι_isOpenImmersion i)) ≫
        C.twistLocalChartCochain T i := by
          rw [Category.assoc,
            C.twistLocalChartKernelLift_ι T hT i]
    _ = (G.map (kernel.ι φ) ≫
          G.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm i)) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso
          (C.chartι i)).hom.app (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i) ≫
        C.twistLocalChartCochain T i := by
          dsimp only [Scheme.Modules.DescentData.restrictionProjection,
            Scheme.Modules.DescentData.component]
          rw [Functor.map_comp]
          dsimp only [D, G, φ]
          unfold twistingSheafDescentData
          unfold Scheme.Modules.DescentData.ofGlueData
          rfl
    _ = G.map (kernel.ι φ) :=
      (C.twistRestrictedKernel_generatedByLocalCochain T hT i).symm
    _ = 𝟙 _ ≫ G.map (kernel.ι φ) := by
      rw [Category.id_comp]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.koszulDiff_zero_compat
statement:
theorem koszulDiff_zero_compat (σ : M →ₗ[R] R) :
    (exteriorPower.zeroEquiv R M).toLinearMap.comp (koszulDiff σ 0) =
      σ.comp (exteriorPower.oneEquiv R M).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  apply exteriorPower.linearMap_ext
  apply AlternatingMap.ext
  intro v
  simp [LinearMap.comp_apply, koszulDiff_ιMulti]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.koszulDiffPresheaf_zero_compat
statement:
theorem koszulDiffPresheaf_zero_compat
    (σ : underlyingCommPresheaf X M ⟶
      PresheafOfModules.unit (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)) :
    koszulDiffPresheaf (underlyingCommPresheaf X M) σ 0 ≫
        (exteriorPowerPresheafZeroIso X (underlyingCommPresheaf X M)).hom =
      (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPowerOneIso (underlyingCommPresheaf X M)).hom ≫ σ
proof:
:= by
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro U
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  exact koszulDiff_zero_compat (σ.app U).hom

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.koszulDiffSheaf_zero_compat
statement:
theorem koszulDiffSheaf_zero_compat (σ : M ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) :
    koszulDiffSheaf X M σ 0 ≫ (exteriorPowerSheafZeroIso X M).hom =
      (exteriorPowerSheafOneIso X M).hom ≫ σ
proof:
:= by
  unfold koszulDiffSheaf exteriorPowerSheafZeroIso exteriorPowerSheafOneIso
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Category.assoc]
  let sh := moduleSheafification X
  let P := underlyingCommPresheaf X M
  let d := koszulDiffPresheaf P σ.val 0
  let e0 := (exteriorPowerPresheafZeroIso X P).hom
  let e1 := (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPowerOneIso P).hom
  let c := (asIso (PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
    (structurePresheafId X)).counit).app M
  have hmap0 : sh.map d ≫ sh.map e0 = sh.map (d ≫ e0) := (sh.map_comp d e0).symm
  have hpre : d ≫ e0 = e1 ≫ σ.val := koszulDiffPresheaf_zero_compat X M σ.val
  have hmap1 : sh.map (e1 ≫ σ.val) = sh.map e1 ≫ sh.map σ.val := sh.map_comp e1 σ.val
  have hobj : (underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).obj M = P := rfl
  have hmapσ : (underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map σ = σ.val := rfl
  have hnat : sh.map σ.val ≫ (moduleTensorUnitIso X).hom = c.hom ≫ σ := by
    have h := (moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).counit.naturality σ
    change (moduleSheafification X).map σ.val ≫
        (moduleTensorUnitIso X).hom = c.hom ≫ σ at h
    exact h
  calc
    sh.map d ≫ sh.map e0 ≫ (moduleTensorUnitIso X).hom =
        sh.map (d ≫ e0) ≫ (moduleTensorUnitIso X).hom := by
          exact congrArg (fun f => f ≫ (moduleTensorUnitIso X).hom) hmap0
    _ = sh.map (e1 ≫ σ.val) ≫ (moduleTensorUnitIso X).hom :=
      congrArg (fun f => sh.map f ≫ (moduleTensorUnitIso X).hom) hpre
    _ = sh.map e1 ≫ sh.map σ.val ≫ (moduleTensorUnitIso X).hom := by
      exact (congrArg (fun f => f ≫ (moduleTensorUnitIso X).hom) hmap1).trans
        (Category.assoc _ _ _)
    _ = sh.map e1 ≫ c.hom ≫ σ :=
      congrArg (fun f => sh.map e1 ≫ f) hnat

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.g0ClassOf_cokernelCosection
statement:
theorem g0ClassOf_cokernelCosection [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    {d : ℕ} (hM : HasConstantRank X M d) (σ : M ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X)
    (hσ : IsLocallyKoszulRegular X M σ) :
    g0ClassOf X (cokernel σ)
        (cokernel_isCoherentLike X hM.isFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation
          (tensorUnitSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree X).isFinitePresentation σ) =
      k0ToG0 X (lambdaMinusOne M hM)
proof:
:= by
  have hC : IsCoherentLike X (cokernel (koszulDiffSheaf X M σ 0)) :=
    cokernel_isCoherentLike X
      (exteriorPowerSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree X M hM.isFiniteLocallyFree 1).isFinitePresentation
      (exteriorPowerSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree X M hM.isFiniteLocallyFree 0).isFinitePresentation
      _
  calc
    _ = g0ClassOf X (cokernel (koszulDiffSheaf X M σ 0)) hC :=
      g0ClassOf_iso X _ _ (koszulCokernelIso X M σ).symm
    _ = _ := g0ClassOf_koszulCokernel_of_isLocallyKoszulRegular X M hM σ hσ

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.twistPullHomAux_leftAmbientPullbackIso_hom_eq
statement:
theorem twistPullHomAux_leftAmbientPullbackIso_hom_eq
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) (source : C.I)
    (W : X.affineOpens) (hWsource : W.1 ≤ C.U source)
    (hWc : W.1 ≤ c.affineOpen.1)
    [Module.Free Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))]
    [Module.Finite Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))]
    [Finite (C.basisIndex i)]
    (hOpenR : IsOpenImmersion
      (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc))
    (hOpenS : IsOpenImmersion
      (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource i
        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left)))
    (d : ℤ) :
    (twistPullHomAux_leftAmbientPullbackIso c source W hWsource hWc
      hOpenR hOpenS d).hom =
      (twistPullHomAux_directTwistPullbackIso source i W hWsource
        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left) hOpenS d).hom
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsOpenImmersion c.chartToLeft :=
    CommonBasicOpen.chartToLeft_isOpenImmersion c
  letI := hOpenR
  letI := hOpenS
  unfold twistPullHomAux_leftAmbientPullbackIso
    twistPullHomAux_directTwistPullbackIso
    twistPullHomAux_restrictionChartToLeftTwistPullbackIso
  change
    (pullbackRestrictionCompIso
          (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource i
            (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left))
          c.chartToLeft
          (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc)
          (c.restrictionChartTo_comp_left source W hWsource hWc)
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i) ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback
          (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc)).mapIso
            ((c.leftTwistRestrictionData d).pullbackIso) ≪≫
        (c.restrictionChartToLeftTwistRestrictionData
          W hWc hWsource hOpenR d).pullbackIso).hom =
      (directTwistRestrictionData source i W hWsource
        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left) hOpenS d).pullbackIso.hom
  dsimp only [AffineFrameCover.chartTwistingSheaf]
  simp only [id_eq]
  rw [pullbackRestrictionCompIso_twistingSheafRestriction_hom]
  have hrestrict :=
    twistingSheafRestrictionComp_congr_hom_eq
      c.chartToLeft_preimage_linearOpen
      (c.restrictionChartTo_preimage_leftLinearOpen
        W hWc hWsource)
      (directRestrictionChartMap_preimage_linearOpen
        source i W hWsource (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left))
      (c.restrictionChartTo_comp_left source W hWsource hWc)
      (c.leftTwistRestrictionData d)
      (c.restrictionChartToLeftTwistRestrictionData
        W hWc hWsource hOpenR d)
      (directTwistRestrictionData source i W hWsource
        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left) hOpenS d)
      (by rfl) (by rfl) (by rfl)
  simp only [TwistingSheafRestrictionData.pullbackIso,
    Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom]
  exact congrArg
    (fun z ↦
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback
        (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource i
          (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left))).app
            (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex
              Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))
                (C.sectionBasis i) d)).inv ≫ z)
    hrestrict

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.twistPullHomAux_rightAmbientPullbackIso_hom_eq
statement:
theorem twistPullHomAux_rightAmbientPullbackIso_hom_eq
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) (source : C.I)
    (W : X.affineOpens) (hWsource : W.1 ≤ C.U source)
    (hWc : W.1 ≤ c.affineOpen.1)
    [Module.Free Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))]
    [Module.Finite Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))]
    [Finite (C.basisIndex j)]
    (hOpenR : IsOpenImmersion
      (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc))
    (hOpenS : IsOpenImmersion
      (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource j
        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right)))
    (d : ℤ) :
    (twistPullHomAux_rightAmbientPullbackIso c source W hWsource hWc
      hOpenR hOpenS d).hom =
      (twistPullHomAux_directTwistPullbackIso source j W hWsource
        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right) hOpenS d).hom
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsOpenImmersion c.chartToRight :=
    CommonBasicOpen.chartToRight_isOpenImmersion c
  letI := hOpenR
  letI := hOpenS
  unfold twistPullHomAux_rightAmbientPullbackIso
    twistPullHomAux_directTwistPullbackIso
    twistPullHomAux_restrictionChartToRightTwistPullbackIso
  change
    (pullbackRestrictionCompIso
          (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource j
            (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right))
          c.chartToRight
          (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc)
          (c.restrictionChartTo_comp_right source W hWsource hWc)
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j) ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback
          (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc)).mapIso
            ((c.rightTwistRestrictionData d).pullbackIso) ≪≫
        (c.restrictionChartToRightTwistRestrictionData
          W hWc hWsource hOpenR d).pullbackIso).hom =
      (directTwistRestrictionData source j W hWsource
        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right) hOpenS d).pullbackIso.hom
  dsimp only [AffineFrameCover.chartTwistingSheaf]
  simp only [id_eq]
  rw [pullbackRestrictionCompIso_twistingSheafRestriction_hom]
  have hrestrict :=
    twistingSheafRestrictionComp_congr_hom_eq
      c.chartToRight_preimage_linearOpen
      (c.restrictionChartTo_preimage_rightLinearOpen
        W hWc hWsource)
      (directRestrictionChartMap_preimage_linearOpen
        source j W hWsource (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right))
      (c.restrictionChartTo_comp_right source W hWsource hWc)
      (c.rightTwistRestrictionData d)
      (c.restrictionChartToRightTwistRestrictionData
        W hWc hWsource hOpenR d)
      (directTwistRestrictionData source j W hWsource
        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right) hOpenS d)
      (by rfl) (by rfl) (by rfl)
  simp only [TwistingSheafRestrictionData.pullbackIso,
    Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom]
  exact congrArg
    (fun z ↦
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback
        (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource j
          (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right))).app
            (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex
              Γ(X, C.U j) (E.val.obj (op (C.U j)))
                (C.sectionBasis j) d)).inv ≫ z)
    hrestrict

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.twistPullHomAux_canonicalTwistComparisonFinalPullbackIso_hom_eq
statement:
theorem twistPullHomAux_canonicalTwistComparisonFinalPullbackIso_hom_eq
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) (source : C.I)
    (W : X.affineOpens) (hWsource : W.1 ≤ C.U source)
    (hWc : W.1 ≤ c.affineOpen.1)
    [Module.Free Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))]
    [Module.Finite Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))]
    [Finite (C.basisIndex i)] [Finite (C.basisIndex j)]
    (hOpenR : IsOpenImmersion
      (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc))
    (hOpenL : IsOpenImmersion
      (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource i
        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left)))
    (hOpenS : IsOpenImmersion
      (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource j
        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right)))
    (d : ℤ) :
    (twistPullHomAux_canonicalTwistComparisonFinalPullbackIso
      c source W hWsource hWc hOpenR hOpenL hOpenS d).hom =
      (twistPullHomAux_directTwistPullbackIso source i W hWsource
        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left) hOpenL d).hom ≫
        twistingSheafBasisChangeHom
          Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))
          (C.restrictedSectionBasis i W.1
            (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left))
          (C.restrictedSectionBasis j W.1
            (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right)) d ≫
        (twistPullHomAux_directTwistPullbackIso source j W hWsource
          (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right) hOpenS d).inv
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsOpenImmersion c.chartToLeft :=
    CommonBasicOpen.chartToLeft_isOpenImmersion c
  letI : IsOpenImmersion c.chartToRight :=
    CommonBasicOpen.chartToRight_isOpenImmersion c
  letI := hOpenR
  letI := hOpenL
  letI := hOpenS
  unfold twistPullHomAux_canonicalTwistComparisonFinalPullbackIso
  unfold transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso
  calc
    _ =
        (twistPullHomAux_leftAmbientPullbackIso
            c source W hWsource hWc hOpenR hOpenL d ≪≫
          (twistPullHomAux_restrictionChartToLeftTwistPullbackIso
            c source W hWsource hWc hOpenR d).symm ≪≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback
            (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc)).mapIso
              (c.twistingSheafBasisIso d) ≪≫
          twistPullHomAux_restrictionChartToRightTwistPullbackIso
            c source W hWsource hWc hOpenR d ≪≫
          (twistPullHomAux_rightAmbientPullbackIso
            c source W hWsource hWc hOpenR hOpenS d).symm).hom := by
      exact mapIso_threefold_factorization
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback
          (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc))
        ((c.leftTwistRestrictionData d).pullbackIso)
        (c.twistingSheafBasisIso d)
        ((c.rightTwistRestrictionData d).pullbackIso)
        (@pullbackRestrictionCompIso _ _ _
          (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource i
            (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left))
          c.chartToLeft
          (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc)
          hOpenL (CommonBasicOpen.chartToLeft_isOpenImmersion c) hOpenR
          (c.restrictionChartTo_comp_left source W hWsource hWc)
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i))
        (@pullbackRestrictionCompIso _ _ _
          (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource j
            (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right))
          c.chartToRight
          (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc)
          hOpenS (CommonBasicOpen.chartToRight_isOpenImmersion c) hOpenR
          (c.restrictionChartTo_comp_right source W hWsource hWc)
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j))
        (twistPullHomAux_restrictionChartToLeftTwistPullbackIso
          c source W hWsource hWc hOpenR d)
        (twistPullHomAux_restrictionChartToRightTwistPullbackIso
          c source W hWsource hWc hOpenR d)
    _ = _ := by
      have hmiddle :
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
              (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc)).mapIso
                (c.twistingSheafBasisIso d)).hom ≫
              (twistPullHomAux_restrictionChartToRightTwistPullbackIso
                c source W hWsource hWc hOpenR d).hom =
            (twistPullHomAux_restrictionChartToLeftTwistPullbackIso
                c source W hWsource hWc hOpenR d).hom ≫
              (twistingSheafBasisChangeIso
                Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))
                (C.restrictedSectionBasis i W.1
                  (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left))
                (C.restrictedSectionBasis j W.1
                  (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right)) d).hom := by
        change
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback
              (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc)).map
                (twistingSheafBasisChangeHom
                  Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
                  (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1))
                  c.leftSectionBasis c.rightSectionBasis d) ≫
              (c.restrictionChartToRightTwistRestrictionData
                W hWc hWsource hOpenR d).pullbackIso.hom =
            (c.restrictionChartToLeftTwistRestrictionData
                W hWc hWsource hOpenR d).pullbackIso.hom ≫
              twistingSheafBasisChangeHom
                Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))
                (C.restrictedSectionBasis i W.1
                  (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left))
                (C.restrictedSectionBasis j W.1
                  (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right)) d
        apply twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_pullback_naturality_of_restrict
        exact c.restrictionChartTo_twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_naturality
          W hWc hWsource hOpenR d
      convert
        fivefold_factorization_of_coherence
          (twistPullHomAux_leftAmbientPullbackIso
            c source W hWsource hWc hOpenR hOpenL d)
          (twistPullHomAux_directTwistPullbackIso source i W hWsource
            (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left) hOpenL d)
          (twistPullHomAux_restrictionChartToLeftTwistPullbackIso
            c source W hWsource hWc hOpenR d)
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
            (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc)).mapIso
              (c.twistingSheafBasisIso d))
          (twistPullHomAux_restrictionChartToRightTwistPullbackIso
            c source W hWsource hWc hOpenR d)
          (twistPullHomAux_rightAmbientPullbackIso
            c source W hWsource hWc hOpenR hOpenS d)
          (twistPullHomAux_directTwistPullbackIso source j W hWsource
            (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right) hOpenS d)
          (twistingSheafBasisChangeIso
            Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))
            (C.restrictedSectionBasis i W.1
              (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left))
            (C.restrictedSectionBasis j W.1
              (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right)) d)
          (twistPullHomAux_leftAmbientPullbackIso_hom_eq
            c source W hWsource hWc hOpenR hOpenL d)
          hmiddle
          (twistPullHomAux_rightAmbientPullbackIso_hom_eq
            c source W hWsource hWc hOpenR hOpenS d) using 1 <;>
              rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.twistPullHomAux_conjugate_restrictFunctorIsoPullback_hom
statement:
theorem twistPullHomAux_conjugate_restrictFunctorIsoPullback_hom
    {A B : Scheme.{u}} (f : B ⟶ A) [IsOpenImmersion f] :

        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f)
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction f)
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback f).hom =
      𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback,
    Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq, Iso.symm_hom,

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.twistPullHomAux_conjugate_restrictFunctorComp_hom
statement:
theorem twistPullHomAux_conjugate_restrictFunctorComp_hom
    {A B D : Scheme.{u}} (q : B ⟶ A) (r : D ⟶ B)
    [IsOpenImmersion q] [IsOpenImmersion r] :
    conjugateEquiv
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).comp
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction r))
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction (r ≫ q))
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp r q).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp r q).hom
proof:
:= by
  ext M U x
  rw [conjugateEquiv_apply_app]
  rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app]
  rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app]
  rw [Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app]
  rw [Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app]
  rw [Adjunction.comp_counit_app]
  rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app]
  rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app]

statement:
theorem twistPullHomAux_pullbackRestrictionCompFunctorIso_hom_eq
    {A B D : Scheme.{u}} (q : B ⟶ A) (r : D ⟶ B)
    [IsOpenImmersion q] [IsOpenImmersion r] :
    (twistPullHomAux_pullbackRestrictionCompFunctorIso q r).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp r q).inv
proof:
:= by
  apply
    (conjugateEquiv
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q).comp
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction r))
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (r ≫ q))).injective
  rw [Scheme.Modules.conjugateEquiv_pullbackComp_inv]
  unfold twistPullHomAux_pullbackRestrictionCompFunctorIso
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom]
  rw [← conjugateEquiv_comp
    (adj₁ :=
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q).comp
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction r))
    (adj₂ := Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction (r ≫ q))
    (adj₃ := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (r ≫ q))]
  rw [← conjugateEquiv_comp
    (adj₁ :=
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q).comp
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction r))
    (adj₂ :=
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).comp
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction r))
    (adj₃ := Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction (r ≫ q))]
  rw [← conjugateEquiv_comp
    (adj₁ :=
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q).comp
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction r))
    (adj₂ :=
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q).comp
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction r))
    (adj₃ :=
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction q).comp
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction r))]
  rw [twistPullHomAux_conjugate_restrictFunctorIsoPullback_hom_whiskerLeft,
    twistPullHomAux_conjugate_restrictFunctorIsoPullback_hom_whiskerRight,
    twistPullHomAux_conjugate_restrictFunctorComp_hom,
    twistPullHomAux_conjugate_restrictFunctorIsoPullback_inv]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.twistPullHomAux_pullbackRestrictionCompIso_hom_eq
statement:
theorem twistPullHomAux_pullbackRestrictionCompIso_hom_eq
    {A B D : Scheme.{u}} (s : D ⟶ A) (q : B ⟶ A) (r : D ⟶ B)
    [IsOpenImmersion s] [IsOpenImmersion q] [IsOpenImmersion r]
    (h : r ≫ q = s) (M : A.Modules) :
    (pullbackRestrictionCompIso s q r h M).hom =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr h.symm).app M ≪≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp r q).app M).symm).hom
proof:
:= by
  subst s
  simp only [pullbackRestrictionCompIso, Iso.trans_hom,
    Iso.symm_hom, Iso.app_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom]
  rw [restrictFunctorCongr_refl_hom_app]
  simp only [Category.id_comp]
  change
    (twistPullHomAux_pullbackRestrictionCompFunctorIso q r).hom.app M =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr rfl).app M ≪≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp r q).app M).symm).hom
  rw [twistPullHomAux_pullbackRestrictionCompFunctorIso_hom_eq]
  simp [Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.twistPullHomAux_pullHom_eq_pullbackRestrictionComp
statement:
theorem twistPullHomAux_pullHom_eq_pullbackRestrictionComp
    {A B Y D : Scheme.{u}}
    {M : A.Modules} {N : B.Modules}
    (f₁ : Y ⟶ A) (f₂ : Y ⟶ B) (φ :
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback f₁).obj M ⟶
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback f₂).obj N)
    (g : D ⟶ Y) (gf₁ : D ⟶ A) (gf₂ : D ⟶ B)
    [IsOpenImmersion f₁] [IsOpenImmersion f₂]
    [IsOpenImmersion g] [IsOpenImmersion gf₁] [IsOpenImmersion gf₂]
    (hgf₁ : g ≫ f₁ = gf₁) (hgf₂ : g ≫ f₂ = gf₂) :
    Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
        (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
        (f₁ := f₁) (f₂ := f₂)
        φ g gf₁ gf₂ hgf₁ hgf₂ =
      (pullbackRestrictionCompIso gf₁ f₁ g hgf₁ M).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map φ ≫
          (pullbackRestrictionCompIso gf₂ f₂ g hgf₂ N).inv
proof:
:= by
  unfold Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
  rw [twistPullHomAux_pullbackPseudofunctor_mapComp'_hom_app_eq_restriction,
    twistPullHomAux_pullbackPseudofunctor_mapComp'_inv_app_eq_restriction]
  all_goals try assumption
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.twistPullHomAux_pullHom_restrictConversion
statement:
theorem twistPullHomAux_pullHom_restrictConversion
    {A B Y D : Scheme.{u}}
    (M : A.Modules) (N : B.Modules)
    (f₁ : Y ⟶ A) (f₂ : Y ⟶ B)
    [IsOpenImmersion f₁] [IsOpenImmersion f₂]
    (H :
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f₁).obj M ⟶
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f₂).obj N)
    (g : D ⟶ Y) (gf₁ : D ⟶ A) (gf₂ : D ⟶ B)
    [IsOpenImmersion g] [IsOpenImmersion gf₁] [IsOpenImmersion gf₂]
    (hgf₁ : g ≫ f₁ = gf₁) (hgf₂ : g ≫ f₂ = gf₂) :
    Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
        (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
        (f₁ := f₁) (f₂ := f₂)
        (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback f₁).app M).inv ≫
          H ≫
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback f₂).app N).hom)
        g gf₁ gf₂ hgf₁ hgf₂ =
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback gf₁).app M).inv ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr hgf₁.symm).hom.app M ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp g f₁).hom.app M ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor g).map H ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp g f₂).inv.app N ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr hgf₂.symm).inv.app N ≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback gf₂).app N).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [twistPullHomAux_pullHom_eq_pullbackRestrictionComp]
  simp only [pullbackRestrictionCompIso, Iso.trans_hom,
    Iso.trans_inv, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.symm_inv,
    Iso.app_hom, Iso.app_inv,
    Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.mapIso_inv,
    Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  rw [← (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback g).hom.naturality_assoc]
  simp only [← Functor.map_comp_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app,
    Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp]
  rw [← (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback g).hom.naturality_assoc]
  simp only [Iso.hom_inv_id_app, Category.id_comp,
    ← Functor.map_comp_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc,
    Functor.map_id]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app, Category.comp_id]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.CommonBasicOpen.twistPullHomAux_pullHom_transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso_eq_final
statement:
theorem twistPullHomAux_pullHom_transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso_eq_final
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) (source : C.I)
    (W : X.affineOpens) (hWsource : W.1 ≤ C.U source)
    (hWc : W.1 ≤ c.affineOpen.1)
    [Module.Free Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))]
    [Module.Finite Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1))]
    [Finite (C.basisIndex i)] [Finite (C.basisIndex j)]
    (hOpenR : IsOpenImmersion
      (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc))
    (hOpenL : IsOpenImmersion
      (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource i
        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left)))
    (hOpenS : IsOpenImmersion
      (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource j
        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right)))
    (d : ℤ) :
    Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
        (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
        (f₁ := c.chartToLeft) (f₂ := c.chartToRight)
        (C.transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso d i j c).hom
        (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc)
        (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource i
          (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left))
        (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource j
          (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right))
        (c.restrictionChartTo_comp_left source W hWsource hWc)
        (c.restrictionChartTo_comp_right source W hWsource hWc) =
      (c.canonicalTwistComparisonFinalPullbackIso
        source W hWsource hWc hOpenR hOpenL hOpenS d).hom
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsOpenImmersion c.chartToLeft :=
    CommonBasicOpen.chartToLeft_isOpenImmersion c
  letI : IsOpenImmersion c.chartToRight :=
    CommonBasicOpen.chartToRight_isOpenImmersion c
  letI := hOpenR
  letI := hOpenL
  letI := hOpenS
  unfold canonicalTwistComparisonFinalPullbackIso
  exact
    twistPullHomAux_pullHom_eq_pullbackRestrictionComp
      c.chartToLeft c.chartToRight
      (C.transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso d i j c).hom
      (c.restrictionChartTo source W hWsource hWc)
      (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource i
        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_left))
      (directRestrictionChartMap (C := C) source W hWsource j
        (hWc.trans c.affineOpen_le_right))
      (c.restrictionChartTo_comp_left source W hWsource hWc)
      (c.restrictionChartTo_comp_right source W hWsource hWc)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistPullHomAux_canonicalTwistTransitionSystem_iso_hom
statement:
theorem twistPullHomAux_canonicalTwistTransitionSystem_iso_hom
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) [IsOpenImmersion (C.transition i j)] :

            d i j)) ≫

          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j)).hom

:= by
