name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIMB.chK_mul_lineSpan
statement:
theorem chK_mul_lineSpan {y z : K0 W} (hy : y ∈ lineSpan W) (hz : z ∈ lineSpan W) :
    chK k W (y * z) = chK k W y * chK k W z
proof:
:= by
  induction hz using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx => exact chK_mul_line hx hy
  | zero => simp
  | add x x' _ _ hx hx' => rw [mul_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hx', mul_add]
  | neg x _ hx =>
    rw [mul_neg, map_neg, map_neg, hx]
    exact LinearMap.ext fun v => by simp

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIMB.isLineKClass_pull
statement:
theorem isLineKClass_pull {Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) [Flat g] {x : K0 X}
    (hx : IsLineKClass X x) : IsLineKClass Y (flatPullbackK0 g x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, hL, rfl⟩ := hx
  exact ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj L, hasConstantRank_pullback Y g L 1 hL,
    flatPullbackK0_classOf g L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree⟩

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIMB.lineSpan_pull
statement:
theorem lineSpan_pull {Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) [Flat g] {x : K0 X}
    (hx : x ∈ lineSpan X) : flatPullbackK0 g x ∈ lineSpan Y
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx => exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure (isLineKClass_pull g hx)
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x x' _ _ hx hx' => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hx'
  | neg x _ hx => rw [map_neg]; exact neg_mem hx

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIMB.splitting_mem_lineSpan
statement:
theorem splitting_mem_lineSpan (S : ChowSplittingOn (opsV4 k) E e) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) :
    flatPullbackK0 S.q (k0ClassOf X E hE) ∈ lineSpan S.Y
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ i, i ≤ e → k0ClassOf S.Y (S.F i) (S.F_vb i) ∈ lineSpan S.Y := by
    intro i
    induction i with
    | zero =>
      intro _
      obtain ⟨φ⟩ := S.base
      rw [k0ClassOf_iso S.Y (S.F_vb 0) (S.L_line 0).isFiniteLocallyFree φ]
      exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨S.L 0, S.L_line 0, rfl⟩
    | succ i ih =>
      intro hi
      obtain ⟨a, b, w, h⟩ := S.step i (by omega)
      rw [k0ClassOf_eq_add_of_shortExact S.Y (S.F_vb i) (S.F_vb (i + 1))
        (S.L_line (i + 1)).isFiniteLocallyFree w h]
      exact add_mem (ih (by omega))
        (AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨S.L (i + 1), S.L_line (i + 1), rfl⟩)
  obtain ⟨φ⟩ := S.top
  rw [flatPullbackK0_classOf,
    ← k0ClassOf_iso S.Y (S.F_vb e) (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global S.q E hE) φ]
  exact key e le_rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIMB.exists_split_bundle
statement:
theorem exists_split_bundle (F : X.Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree X F) :
    (k0ClassOf X F hF = 0) ∨ ∃ (e : ℕ) (S : ChowSplittingOn (opsV4 k) F e),
      flatPullbackK0 S.q (k0ClassOf X F hF) ∈ lineSpan S.Y
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty X := CHEXACT.nonempty_of_fact k (W := X)
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := CHEXACT.exists_rank k hF
  cases r with
  | zero =>
    left
    exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_isZero X.Modules (IsFiniteLocallyFree X) _
      (isZero_of_hasConstantRank_zero F hr)
  | succ e =>
    right
    obtain ⟨S⟩ := exists_chowSplittingOn (chowOpsOn_projectiveIntegral k)
      (chowCompatOn_projectiveIntegral k) (hPk k) e F hr
    exact ⟨e, S, splitting_mem_lineSpan S hF⟩

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIMB.mul_of_pull
statement:
theorem mul_of_pull {Y : Scheme.{u}} [Y.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian Y] [Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k Y)] (g : Y ⟶ X) [g.IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat g]
    {d : ℕ} (hd : PureRelDim g d) (hinj : Function.Injective (totalPullOn (opsV4 k) g d hd))
    (a b : K0 X)
    (h : chK k Y (flatPullbackK0 g a * flatPullbackK0 g b) =
      chK k Y (flatPullbackK0 g a) * chK k Y (flatPullbackK0 g b)) :
    chK k X (a * b) = chK k X a * chK k X b
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro v
  apply hinj
  have hm : flatPullbackK0 g (a * b) = flatPullbackK0 g a * flatPullbackK0 g b := by
    have := (flatPullbackK0RingHom g).map_mul a b
    simpa only [flatPullbackK0RingHom_apply] using this
  have n1 := fun w v => LinearMap.congr_fun (chK_pull_flat (k := k) g hd w) v
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at n1
  rw [n1, hm, h, Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, n1, n1]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIMB.chK_mul_of_lineSpan
statement:
theorem chK_mul_of_lineSpan {a : K0 X} (ha : a ∈ lineSpan X) (b : K0 X) :
    chK k X (a * b) = chK k X a * chK k X b
proof:
:= by
  refine k0_induction X (fun b => chK k X (a * b) = chK k X a * chK k X b) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ b
  · simp
  · intro b b' hb hb'
    rw [mul_add, map_add, map_add, hb, hb', mul_add]
  · intro b hb
    rw [mul_neg, map_neg, map_neg, hb]
    exact LinearMap.ext fun v => by simp
  · intro F hF
    rcases exists_split_bundle (k := k) F hF with h0 | ⟨e, S, hS⟩
    · rw [h0]; simp
    · exact mul_of_pull S.q S.hd S.injective _ _
        (chK_mul_lineSpan (lineSpan_pull S.q ha) hS)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIMB.chK_mul
statement: theorem chK_mul (a b : K0 X) : chK k X (a * b) = chK k X a * chK k X b
proof:
:= by
  refine k0_induction X (fun a => chK k X (a * b) = chK k X a * chK k X b) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ a
  · simp
  · intro a a' ha ha'
    rw [add_mul, map_add, map_add, ha, ha', add_mul]
  · intro a ha
    rw [neg_mul, map_neg, map_neg, ha]
    exact LinearMap.ext fun v => by simp
  · intro F hF
    rcases exists_split_bundle (k := k) F hF with h0 | ⟨e, S, hS⟩
    · rw [h0]; simp
    · exact mul_of_pull S.q S.hd S.injective _ _ (chK_mul_of_lineSpan hS _)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIMB.chK_mul'
statement:
theorem chK_mul' (h : ChExact k (closedPosV4 k)) (a b : K0 X) :
    chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h (a * b) = chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h a * chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h b
proof:
:=
  chK_mul a b

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.totalPushOn_congr
statement:
theorem totalPushOn_congr {f g : X ⟶ Y} [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsProper f] [g.IsOver (Spk k)]
    [IsProper g] (h : f = g) : totalPushOn ops f = totalPushOn ops g
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.totalPullOn_congr
statement:
theorem totalPullOn_congr {f g : X ⟶ Y} [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat f] [g.IsOver (Spk k)]
    [Flat g] (h : f = g) (d : ℕ) (hf : PureRelDim f d) (hg : PureRelDim g d) :
    totalPullOn ops f d hf = totalPullOn ops g d hg
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.totalPushOn_id
statement: theorem totalPushOn_id : totalPushOn ops (𝟙 X) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.linearMap_ext ℚ fun n ↦ ?_
  apply rationalDimChow_hom_ext
  intro D
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, totalPushOn, DirectSum.toModule_lof]
  rw [ops.push_mk (𝟙 X) n D D (properPushforward_id D.1).symm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.totalPullOn_id
statement: theorem totalPullOn_id (h : PureRelDim (𝟙 X) 0) : totalPullOn ops (𝟙 X) 0 h = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.linearMap_ext ℚ fun n ↦ ?_
  apply rationalDimChow_hom_ext
  intro D
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, totalPullOn, DirectSum.toModule_lof]
  rw [ops.pull_mk (𝟙 X) 0 h n D D (fun x ↦ by
    rw [flatPullbackCoeff_eq_one_of_isIso (𝟙 X) x]; simp)]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.totalPushOn_comp_totalPullOn_of_iso
statement:
theorem totalPushOn_comp_totalPullOn_of_iso (cp : ChowCompatOn ops) (φ : X ≅ Y)
    [φ.hom.IsOver (Spk k)] :
    totalPushOn ops φ.hom ∘ₗ totalPullOn ops φ.hom 0 (pureRelDim_of_iso φ) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  haveI : φ.inv.IsOver (Spk k) :=
    ⟨by rw [← comp_over φ.hom (Spk k), Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]⟩
  have hB : totalPushOn ops φ.hom ∘ₗ totalPushOn ops φ.inv = LinearMap.id := by
    rw [← cp.push_comp, totalPushOn_congr ops (Iso.inv_hom_id φ), totalPushOn_id]
  have hC : totalPullOn ops φ.hom 0 (pureRelDim_of_iso φ) ∘ₗ totalPushOn ops φ.hom =
      LinearMap.id := by
    rw [cp.base_change φ.hom φ.hom (𝟙 X) (𝟙 X) 0 (pureRelDim_of_iso φ) pureRelDim_id
      (IsKernelPair.id_of_mono φ.hom), totalPushOn_id, totalPullOn_id, LinearMap.id_comp]
  have hpull : totalPullOn ops φ.hom 0 (pureRelDim_of_iso φ) = totalPushOn ops φ.inv := by
    rw [← LinearMap.comp_id (totalPullOn ops φ.hom 0 (pureRelDim_of_iso φ)), ← hB,
      ← LinearMap.comp_assoc, hC, LinearMap.id_comp]
  rw [hpull, hB]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.sandwichOn_eq_of_iso
statement:
theorem sandwichOn_eq_of_iso {E E' : X.Modules} {e : ℕ} (C : AffineFrameCover X E)
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') [Fact (Cl C.scheme)] [Fact (Cl C'.scheme)] (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = e + 1)
    (hC' : ∀ i, Nat.card (C'.basisIndex i) = e + 1) (φ : C.scheme ≅ C'.scheme)
    (hφ : φ.hom ≫ C'.toBase = C.toBase)
    (hO : Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback φ.hom).obj (C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) ≅
      C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)) (j : ℕ) :
    sandwichOn ops C cp hC j = sandwichOn ops C' cp hC' j
proof:
:= by
  haveI : φ.hom.IsOver (Spk k) := ⟨by
    change φ.hom ≫ (C'.toBase ≫ X ↘ Spk k) = C.toBase ≫ X ↘ Spk k
    rw [← Category.assoc, hφ]⟩
  haveI : Flat C.toBase := C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos e))
  haveI : Flat C'.toBase := C'.toBase_flat (C'.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC' (Nat.succ_pos e))
  have h := cp.projBundle_relDim C hC
  have h' := cp.projBundle_relDim C' hC'
  have hfg : PureRelDim (φ.hom ≫ C'.toBase) (e + 0) := by rw [hφ]; exact h
  have hpush : totalPushOn ops C.toBase = totalPushOn ops C'.toBase ∘ₗ totalPushOn ops φ.hom := by
    rw [← cp.push_comp]; exact totalPushOn_congr ops hφ.symm
  have hpull : totalPullOn ops C.toBase e h =
      totalPullOn ops φ.hom 0 (pureRelDim_of_iso φ) ∘ₗ totalPullOn ops C'.toBase e h' :=
    (totalPullOn_congr ops hφ.symm e h hfg).trans
      (cp.pull_comp φ.hom C'.toBase 0 e (pureRelDim_of_iso φ) h' hfg)
  have hxi : totalPushOn ops φ.hom ∘ₗ xiCapOn ops C = xiCapOn ops C' ∘ₗ totalPushOn ops φ.hom := by
    unfold xiCapOn
    rw [cp.cap_iso (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
      (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme φ.hom _ 1 (C'.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))
      (hO.map Iso.symm)]
    exact cp.cap_push φ.hom _ _
  have hxij : totalPushOn ops φ.hom ∘ₗ ((xiCapOn ops C) ^ j) =
      ((xiCapOn ops C') ^ j) ∘ₗ totalPushOn ops φ.hom :=
    (Module.End.commute_pow_left_of_commute hxi.symm j).symm
  change totalPushOn ops C.toBase ∘ₗ ((xiCapOn ops C) ^ j) ∘ₗ totalPullOn ops C.toBase e h =
    totalPushOn ops C'.toBase ∘ₗ ((xiCapOn ops C') ^ j) ∘ₗ totalPullOn ops C'.toBase e h'
  rw [hpush, hpull]
  calc _ = totalPushOn ops C'.toBase ∘ₗ ((totalPushOn ops φ.hom ∘ₗ ((xiCapOn ops C) ^ j)) ∘ₗ
        totalPullOn ops φ.hom 0 (pureRelDim_of_iso φ)) ∘ₗ totalPullOn ops C'.toBase e h' := by
        simp only [LinearMap.comp_assoc]
    _ = totalPushOn ops C'.toBase ∘ₗ (((xiCapOn ops C') ^ j) ∘ₗ (totalPushOn ops φ.hom ∘ₗ
        totalPullOn ops φ.hom 0 (pureRelDim_of_iso φ))) ∘ₗ totalPullOn ops C'.toBase e h' := by
        rw [hxij]; simp only [LinearMap.comp_assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [totalPushOn_comp_totalPullOn_of_iso ops cp φ, LinearMap.comp_id]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.segreOn_indep
statement:
theorem segreOn_indep {E : X.Modules} {e : ℕ} (C C' : AffineFrameCover X E) [Fact (Cl C.scheme)] [Fact (Cl C'.scheme)]
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = e + 1)
    (hC' : ∀ i, Nat.card (C'.basisIndex i) = e + 1) (i : ℕ) :
    segreOn ops C cp hC i = segreOn ops C' cp hC' i
proof:
:=
  sandwichOn_eq_of_iso ops cp C C' hC hC' (C.isoOfCovers C')
    (C.isoOfCovers_toBase C') (C.isoOfCovers_twist_unconditional C') (e + i)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.segreSeriesOn_indep
statement:
theorem segreSeriesOn_indep {E : X.Modules} {e : ℕ} (C C' : AffineFrameCover X E) [Fact (Cl C.scheme)] [Fact (Cl C'.scheme)]
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = e + 1)
    (hC' : ∀ i, Nat.card (C'.basisIndex i) = e + 1) :
    segreSeriesOn ops C cp hC = segreSeriesOn ops C' cp hC'
proof:
:= by
  unfold segreSeriesOn
  exact congrArg PowerSeries.mk (funext (segreOn_indep ops cp C C' hC hC'))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.chernOfCoverOn_indep
statement:
theorem chernOfCoverOn_indep {E : X.Modules} {e : ℕ} (C C' : AffineFrameCover X E) [Fact (Cl C.scheme)] [Fact (Cl C'.scheme)]
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = e + 1)
    (hC' : ∀ i, Nat.card (C'.basisIndex i) = e + 1) :
    chernOfCoverOn ops C cp hC = chernOfCoverOn ops C' cp hC'
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  unfold chernOfCoverOn
  rw [segreSeriesOn_indep ops cp C C' hC hC']

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.constRankChernAssignOn'_eq
statement:
theorem constRankChernAssignOn'_eq [Nonempty X] (E : X.Modules) (r : ℕ)
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) :
    constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X E = chernOpOn' ops cp hP E r hE
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∃ r, Nonempty (HasConstantRank X E r) := ⟨r, ⟨hE⟩⟩
  unfold constRankChernAssignOn'
  rw [dif_pos h]
  obtain ⟨x⟩ := ‹Nonempty X›
  have hr : h.choose = r :=
    (rankAt_of_hasConstantRank h.choose_spec.some x).symm.trans (rankAt_of_hasConstantRank hE x)
  subst hr
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.chernOpOn'_eq_chernOfCoverOn
statement:
theorem chernOpOn'_eq_chernOfCoverOn {E : X.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover X E) {r : ℕ}
    [Fact (Cl C.scheme)] (hE : HasConstantRank X E (r + 1))
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = r + 1) :
    chernOpOn' ops cp hP E (r + 1) hE = chernOfCoverOn ops C cp hC
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Fact (Cl (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hE).choose.scheme) :=
    ⟨hP (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hE).choose
      (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hE).choose_spec⟩
  change chernOfCoverOn ops (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hE).choose cp
    (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hE).choose_spec = _
  exact chernOfCoverOn_indep ops cp
    (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hE).choose C
    (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hE).choose_spec hC

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.segreOn_of_rankOne
statement:
theorem segreOn_of_rankOne {L : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (C : AffineFrameCover X L) [Fact (Cl C.scheme)] (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = 0 + 1) (i : ℕ) :
    segreOn ops C cp hC i = totalCapOn ops L hL ^ i
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Flat C.toBase := C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos 0))
  haveI := isIso_tautologicalQuotient_of_rankOne C hL
  have hxi : xiCapOn ops C = totalCapOn ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj L)
      (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase L 1 hL) :=
    cp.cap_iso _ _ ⟨(asIso C.tautologicalQuotient).symm⟩
  have hc : totalPushOn ops C.toBase ∘ₗ xiCapOn ops C =
      totalCapOn ops L hL ∘ₗ totalPushOn ops C.toBase := by
    rw [hxi]
    exact cp.cap_push C.toBase L hL
  have hpow := (Module.End.commute_pow_left_of_commute hc.symm i).symm
  have h0 : totalPushOn ops C.toBase ∘ₗ totalPullOn ops C.toBase 0
      (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC) = 1 := by
    have h := segreOn_zero ops C cp hC
    change totalPushOn ops C.toBase ∘ₗ ((xiCapOn ops C) ^ (0 + 0)) ∘ₗ
      totalPullOn ops C.toBase 0 (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC) = 1 at h
    rw [pow_zero] at h
    change totalPushOn ops C.toBase ∘ₗ LinearMap.id ∘ₗ totalPullOn ops C.toBase 0
      (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC) = 1 at h
    rwa [LinearMap.id_comp] at h
  change totalPushOn ops C.toBase ∘ₗ ((xiCapOn ops C) ^ (0 + i)) ∘ₗ
      totalPullOn ops C.toBase 0 (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC) = _
  rw [zero_add, ← LinearMap.comp_assoc, hpow, LinearMap.comp_assoc, h0]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.chernOfCoverOn_of_rankOne
statement:
theorem chernOfCoverOn_of_rankOne {L : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (C : AffineFrameCover X L) [Fact (Cl C.scheme)] (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = 0 + 1) :
    chernOfCoverOn ops C cp hC =
      fun i => if i = 0 then 1 else if i = 1 then totalCapOn ops L hL else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hs : segreSeriesOn ops C cp hC = PowerSeries.mk (fun n => totalCapOn ops L hL ^ n) := by
    unfold segreSeriesOn
    exact congrArg PowerSeries.mk (funext (segreOn_of_rankOne ops cp hL C hC))
  funext i
  unfold chernOfCoverOn
  rw [hs, invOfUnit_geometric, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
  by_cases h0 : i = 0
  · subst i; simp
  · by_cases h1 : i = 1
    · subst i
      change (-1 : ℚ) • (-totalCapOn ops L hL) = totalCapOn ops L hL
      exact (neg_one_smul ℚ (-totalCapOn ops L hL)).trans
        (neg_neg (totalCapOn ops L hL))
    · simp [h0, h1]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.chernOpOn'_line_series
statement:
theorem chernOpOn'_line_series (hP : ProjBundleClosedPos Cl) (L : X.Modules)
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) :
    chernOpOn' ops cp hP L 1 hL =
      fun i => if i = 0 then 1 else if i = 1 then totalCapOn ops L hL else 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Fact (Cl (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hL).choose.scheme) :=
    ⟨hP (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hL).choose
      (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hL).choose_spec⟩
  exact chernOfCoverOn_of_rankOne ops cp hL _
    (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hL).choose_spec

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.sandwichOn_rec
statement:
theorem sandwichOn_rec (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1)
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = 1 + 1) (m : ℕ) :
    sandwichOn ops C cp hC (m + 2) =
      (totalCapOn ops L hL + totalCapOn ops M hM) * sandwichOn ops C cp hC (m + 1) -
        totalCapOn ops L hL * totalCapOn ops M hM * sandwichOn ops C cp hC m
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Flat C.toBase := C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos 1))
  have hrel := xiRelationOn ops C hL hM
  have hξb : xiCapOn ops C * totalCapOn ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj M)
      (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase M 1 hM) =
      totalCapOn ops ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj M)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase M 1 hM) * xiCapOn ops C :=
    cp.cap_comm (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj M)
      (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
      (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase M 1 hM)
  exact E11.sandwich_alg (totalPushOn ops C.toBase)
    (totalPullOn ops C.toBase 1 (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC)) (xiCapOn ops C) _ _
    (totalCapOn ops L hL) (totalCapOn ops M hM) hrel hξb (cp.cap_push C.toBase L hL)
    (cp.cap_push C.toBase M hM) m

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.segreOn_rec
statement:
theorem segreOn_rec (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1)
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = 1 + 1) :
    segreOn ops C cp hC 0 = 1 ∧
    segreOn ops C cp hC 1 = totalCapOn ops L hL + totalCapOn ops M hM ∧
    ∀ i, segreOn ops C cp hC (i + 2) =
      (totalCapOn ops L hL + totalCapOn ops M hM) * segreOn ops C cp hC (i + 1) -
        totalCapOn ops L hL * totalCapOn ops M hM * segreOn ops C cp hC i
proof:
:= by
  have s0 := segreOn_zero ops C cp hC
  have z : sandwichOn ops C cp hC 0 = 0 := sandwichOn_eq_zero_of_lt ops C cp hC Nat.zero_lt_one
  refine ⟨s0, ?_, fun i => ?_⟩
  · have h := sandwichOn_rec ops cp C hL hM hC 0
    have s0' : sandwichOn ops C cp hC 1 = 1 := s0
    change sandwichOn ops C cp hC (0 + 2) = _
    rw [h, zero_add, s0', z]
    noncomm_ring
  · have h := sandwichOn_rec ops cp C hL hM hC (i + 1)
    change sandwichOn ops C cp hC (1 + (i + 2)) = _ * sandwichOn ops C cp hC (1 + (i + 1)) -
      _ * sandwichOn ops C cp hC (1 + i)
    rw [show 1 + (i + 2) = i + 1 + 2 by omega, show 1 + (i + 1) = i + 1 + 1 by omega,
      show 1 + i = i + 1 by omega]
    exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.chernOfCoverOn_sum
statement:
theorem chernOfCoverOn_sum (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1)
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = 1 + 1) (n : ℕ) :
    chernOfCoverOn ops C cp hC n =
      if n = 0 then 1 else if n = 1 then totalCapOn ops L hL + totalCapOn ops M hM
        else if n = 2 then totalCapOn ops L hL * totalCapOn ops M hM else 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, hrec⟩ := segreOn_rec ops cp C hL hM hC
  have hs := E11.inv_segre_series (totalCapOn ops L hL) (totalCapOn ops M hM)
    (segreOn ops C cp hC) h0 h1 hrec
  unfold chernOfCoverOn
  unfold segreSeriesOn
  rw [hs, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
  rcases n with _ | _ | _ | n
  · simp
  · have h := neg_one_smul ℚ (-(totalCapOn ops L hL + totalCapOn ops M hM))
    exact h.trans (neg_neg (totalCapOn ops L hL + totalCapOn ops M hM))
  · simp
  · simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.whitneyConvOn_lines
statement:
theorem whitneyConvOn_lines (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1)
    (hLM : HasConstantRank X (L ⊞ M) 2) :
    WhitneyConvOn (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP) L (L ⊞ M) M
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ : ∃ C : AffineFrameCover X (L ⊞ M), ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = 1 + 1 :=
    ⟨_, (exists_affineFrameCover_of_hasConstantRank hLM).choose_spec⟩
  haveI : Fact (Cl C.scheme) := ⟨hP C hC⟩
  rw [constRankChernAssignOn'_eq ops cp hP (L ⊞ M) 2 hLM,
    chernOpOn'_eq_chernOfCoverOn ops cp hP C (r := 1) hLM hC,
    chernOfCoverOn_sum ops cp C hL hM hC n,
    constRankChernAssignOn'_eq ops cp hP L 1 hL, constRankChernAssignOn'_eq ops cp hP M 1 hM,
    chernOpOn'_line_series ops cp hP L hL, chernOpOn'_line_series ops cp hP M hM]
  exact E11.conv_lines _ _ n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.K5.whitneyConvOn_lines_projectiveIntegral
statement:
theorem whitneyConvOn_lines_projectiveIntegral [Infinite k]
    (hD31 : ∀ {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)]
      [IsNoetherian X] [Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X)] {E : X.Modules}
      (C : AffineFrameCover X E), ∃ (N : ℕ) (j : C.scheme ⟶ space k N), IsClosedImmersion j)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian X]
    [Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k X)] {L M : X.Modules} (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1) (hLM : HasConstantRank X (L ⊞ M) 2) :
    WhitneyConvOn (constRankChernAssignOn' (chowOpsOn_projectiveIntegral k)
      (chowCompatOn_projectiveIntegral k) (projBundleClosedPos_of_closedImmersion hD31))
      L (L ⊞ M) M
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIntegral X := (Fact.out : ProjectiveIntegral k X).1
  exact whitneyConvOn_lines _ _ _ hL hM hLM

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionImageIdeal_map_of_localized
statement:
theorem cosectionImageIdeal_map_of_localized (r : R) [IsLocalization.Away r S]
    (f : M →ₗ[R] N) [IsLocalizedModule.Away r f]
    (σ : M →ₗ[R] R) (τ : N →ₗ[S] S)
    (h : ∀ x, τ (f x) = algebraMap R S (σ x)) :
    (cosectionImageIdeal σ).map (algebraMap R S) = cosectionImageIdeal τ
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨x,rfl⟩ := ha
    change algebraMap R S (σ x) ∈ cosectionImageIdeal τ
    rw [← h x]
    exact ⟨f x,rfl⟩
  · intro a ha
    obtain ⟨y,rfl⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨⟨x,s⟩, hs⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.surj (Submonoid.powers r) f y
    have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap R S (s : R)) := IsLocalization.map_units S s
    apply (Ideal.unit_mul_mem_iff_mem _ hu).mp
    have he : algebraMap R S (s : R) * τ y = algebraMap R S (σ x) := by
      calc
        _ = (s : R) • τ y := (Algebra.smul_def (s : R) (τ y)).symm
        _ = τ ((s : R) • y) := ((τ.restrictScalars R).map_smul (s : R) y).symm
        _ = τ (f x) := congrArg τ hs
        _ = _ := h x
    rw [he]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ⟨x,rfl⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.specBasicRestriction_isLocalized
statement:
theorem specBasicRestriction_isLocalized [E.IsQuasicoherent] (r : A) :
    IsLocalizedModule.Away r (specBasicRestriction A E r)
proof:
:= by
  change IsLocalizedModule.Away r
    ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj E).presheaf.map (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r).leTop.op).hom
  exact isLocalizedModule_moduleSpecΓ_basicOpenRestriction E r

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.specBasicRestriction_cosection
statement:
theorem specBasicRestriction_cosection (r : A) (x : Γ(E,⊤)) :
    specOpenCosection A E σ (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r) (specBasicRestriction A E r x) =
      algebraMap A Γ(Spec A,PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r) (specGlobalCosection A E σ x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply σ.val (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r).leTop.op x
  change specOpenCosection A E σ (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r) (specBasicRestriction A E r x) =
    (Spec A).presheaf.map (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r).leTop.op ((σ.val.app (op ⊤)).hom x) at h
  rw [h]
  change _ = ((Spec A).presheaf.map (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r).leTop.op)
    ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).inv ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso A).hom ((σ.val.app (op ⊤)).hom x)))
  simp

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.specCosectionImageIdeal_basicOpen
statement:
theorem specCosectionImageIdeal_basicOpen [E.IsQuasicoherent] (r : A) :
    (cosectionImageIdeal (specGlobalCosection A E σ)).map
        (algebraMap A Γ(Spec A,PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r)) =
      cosectionImageIdeal (specOpenCosection A E σ (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r))
proof:
:= by
  letI := specBasicRestriction_isLocalized A E r
  exact cosectionImageIdeal_map_of_localized r (specBasicRestriction A E r)
    (specGlobalCosection A E σ) (specOpenCosection A E σ (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r))
    (specBasicRestriction_cosection A E σ r)

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.specCosectionZeroRingRestriction_projection
statement:
theorem specCosectionZeroRingRestriction_projection [E.IsQuasicoherent] (r : A) :
    (specCosectionZeroRingRestriction A E σ r).comp
        (cosectionZeroQuotient (specGlobalCosection A E σ)) =
      (cosectionZeroQuotient (specOpenCosection A E σ (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r))).comp
        (algebraMap A Γ(Spec A,PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r))
proof: := Ideal.quotientMap_comp_mk _

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIKD.fixed_of_trivial
statement:
theorem fixed_of_trivial (F : W ⟶ M) [IsClosedImmersion F] [IsLocallyNoetherian M]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian W] (inj : Function.Injective (k0ToG0 M)) (y ℓ : K0 M) (G : G0 W)
    (hy : k0ToG0 M y = finitePushforward F G) (hℓ : pullbackK0 F ℓ = 1) : ℓ * y = y
proof:
:= by
  apply inj
  rw [k0ToG0_mul, hy, ← finitePushforward_projectionFormula F G ℓ, hℓ, one_smul]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIKD.kdisj_of_geo
statement:
theorem kdisj_of_geo (G : KDGeo k n i hX φk) : ∀ x : K0 X,
    chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) (chEx k) ((concretePencilKX k n i hX φk).lift x)
      (totalCapOn (opsV4 k) (concretePencilKX k n i hX φk).LP (concretePencilKX k n i hX φk).hLP
        (fundClass k (W := (concreteGeomX k n i hX φk).M))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIntegral X := (Fact.out : D28.ProjectiveIntegral k X).1
  obtain ⟨LP, hLP, hfr, htriv⟩ := G
  intro x
  have hcls : totalCapOn (opsV4 k) (concretePencilKX k n i hX φk).LP
      (concretePencilKX k n i hX φk).hLP (fundClass k (W := (concreteGeomX k n i hX φk).M)) =
      totalCapOn (opsV4 k) LP hLP (fundClass k (W := (concreteGeomX k n i hX φk).M)) :=
    add_right_cancel (b := totalPushOn (opsV4 k) (concreteGeomX k n i hX φk).e
      (fundClass k (W := (concreteGeomX k n i hX φk).E)))
      ((concretePencilKX k n i hX φk).fibreRel.symm.trans hfr)
  rw [hcls]
  have hfix := fixed_of_trivial (subschemeTotalGlobalι (space k n) i.ker) (bijective_k0ToG0_total k n i hX).1 ((concretePencilKX k n i hX φk).lift x) _ _
    (liftK_spec k n i hX (pullbackK0 (phiX k n i).inv x)) htriv
  exact chK0_cap_of_fix _ LP hLP _ hfix

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackCongr_hom_app_eq_symm_inv_app
statement:
theorem pullbackCongr_hom_app_eq_symm_inv_app
    {A B : Scheme.{u}} {f g : B ⟶ A}
    (h : f = g) (M : A.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr h).hom.app M =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr h.symm).inv.app M
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  simp [Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackSquareRestrictionIso_eq_comp
statement:
theorem pullbackSquareRestrictionIso_eq_comp
    {A B D Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (r : D ⟶ B) (q : B ⟶ A) (e : D ⟶ Z) (c : Z ⟶ A)
    [IsOpenImmersion r] [IsOpenImmersion q]
    [IsOpenImmersion e] [IsOpenImmersion c]
    [IsOpenImmersion (e ≫ c)] [IsOpenImmersion (r ≫ q)]
    (h : e ≫ c = r ≫ q) (M : A.Modules) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp r q).app M).hom ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr h.symm).app M).hom ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp e c).app M).inv =
    (pullbackRestrictionCompIso (e ≫ c) q r h.symm M).inv ≫
      (pullbackRestrictionCompIso (e ≫ c) c e rfl M).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hA : pullbackRestrictionCompIso (e ≫ c) q r h.symm M =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr h).app M ≪≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp r q).app M).symm := by
    apply Iso.ext
    exact CommonBasicOpen.twistPullHomAux_pullbackRestrictionCompIso_hom_eq
      (e ≫ c) q r h.symm M
  have hB : pullbackRestrictionCompIso (e ≫ c) c e rfl M =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (rfl : e ≫ c = e ≫ c)).app M ≪≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp e c).app M).symm := by
    apply Iso.ext
    exact CommonBasicOpen.twistPullHomAux_pullbackRestrictionCompIso_hom_eq
      (e ≫ c) c e rfl M
  rw [hA, hB]
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.trans_inv, Iso.symm_hom,
    Iso.symm_inv, Iso.app_hom, Iso.app_inv, Category.assoc]
  rw [pullbackCongr_hom_app_eq_symm_inv_app h.symm M]
  simp [Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D20.capCycles_eq_mk'
statement:
theorem capCycles_eq_mk' (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (n : ℕ)
    (D : dimensionCycles X (n + 1)) (a : C1Cap.LocalEquations X)
    (hrep : ∀ w : X, height w = n + 1 → D.1 w ≠ 0 → Rep (k := k) L hL n w a) :
    ∃ C : dimensionCycles X n, D5.capCycles (k := k) L hL n D = (QuotientAddGroup.mk C) ∧
      ∀ y, C.1 y = C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff a D.1 y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set fs := compactCycleFinsupp D.1 with hfs
  have hcod : ∀ v, D.1 v ≠ 0 → height v = n + 1 := fun v hv ↦ D.2 hv
  have hsupp : ∀ v, v ∈ fs.support ↔ D.1 v ≠ 0 := fun v ↦ by
    rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, hfs, compactCycleFinsupp_apply]
  let R' : X → dimensionCycles X n := fun w ↦
    if h : height w = n + 1 ∧ D.1 w ≠ 0 then (hrep w h.1 h.2).choose else 0
  have hRep : ∀ w ∈ fs.support,
      D5.primeCapOrZero (k := k) L hL n w = (QuotientAddGroup.mk (R' w) : DimChow X n) := by
    intro w hw
    have hw' := (hsupp w).mp hw
    have hc := hcod w hw'
    simp only [R', dif_pos (And.intro hc hw')]
    exact (hrep w hc hw').choose_spec.1
  have hRepv : ∀ w ∈ fs.support, ∀ y, (R' w).1 y = C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a w y := by
    intro w hw y
    have hw' := (hsupp w).mp hw
    have hc := hcod w hw'
    simp only [R', dif_pos (And.intro hc hw')]
    exact (hrep w hc hw').choose_spec.2 y
  refine ⟨fs.sum fun w m ↦ m • R' w, ?_, fun y ↦ ?_⟩
  · change fs.sum (fun v m ↦ m • D5.primeCapOrZero (k := k) L hL n v) = _
    rw [Finsupp.sum_congr (g2 := fun v m ↦ m • (QuotientAddGroup.mk (R' v) : DimChow X n))
      fun v hv ↦ by rw [hRep v hv]]
    have := map_finsuppSum (QuotientAddGroup.mk' (dimRationalEquivalence X n)) fs
      (fun v m ↦ m • R' v)
    simp only [map_zsmul, QuotientAddGroup.mk'_apply] at this
    exact this.symm
  · change evalHomD X n y (fs.sum fun w m ↦ m • R' w) = _
    rw [map_finsuppSum]
    simp only [map_zsmul, smul_eq_mul]
    change ∑ w ∈ fs.support, fs w * (R' w).1 y = _
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun w hw ↦ by rw [hRepv w hw y]]
    unfold C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff
    have hsub : Function.support (fun v ↦ D.1 v * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a v y) ⊆
        ↑fs.support := by
      intro v hv
      rw [Finset.mem_coe, hsupp]
      exact left_ne_zero_of_mul hv
    rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ hsub]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun v _ ↦ ?_
    rw [hfs, compactCycleFinsupp_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D20.cap_cap_prime'
statement:
theorem cap_cap_prime' (L M : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1) (m : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = m + 2)
    (a b : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (hMv : Rep (k := k) M hM (m + 1) v b)
    (hLw : ∀ w : X, height w = m + 1 → C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff b v w ≠ 0 →
      Rep (k := k) L hL m w a) :
    ∃ C : dimensionCycles X m,
      ops.cap L hL m (ops.cap M hM (m + 1) ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v (m + 2) hv) : DimChow X (m + 2)))) =
        (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk C : DimChow X m) ∧
      ∀ y, C.1 y = ∑ᶠ w : X, C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff b v w * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a w y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR1, hR2⟩ := hMv
  have hv' : height v = ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) + 1 := hv
  have hpc : D5.primeCap (k := k) M hM (m + 1) v hv' = (QuotientAddGroup.mk R : DimChow X (m + 1)) := by
    rw [← hR1]
    simp only [D5.primeCapOrZero]
    rw [dif_pos hv']
  have h1 : ops.cap M hM (m + 1) ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
      (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v (m + 2) hv) : DimChow X (m + 2))) =
      (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk R : DimChow X (m + 1)) := by
    refine (D13.cap_prime_anchor (k := k) ops M hM (m + 1) v hv').trans ?_
    rw [hpc]
  obtain ⟨C, hC1, hC2⟩ := capCycles_eq_mk' (k := k) L hL m R a (fun w hw hne ↦
    hLw w hw (by rwa [← hR2 w]))
  refine ⟨C, ?_, fun y ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [h1, D13.cap_anchor (k := k) ops L hL m R, hC1]
  · rw [hC2 y]
    unfold C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff
    simp only [hR2]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D20.capComm_prime_of_rep
statement:
theorem capComm_prime_of_rep {L M : X.Modules} {hL : HasConstantRank X L 1}
    {hM : HasConstantRank X M 1} (m : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = m + 2)
    (a b : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (d : GateData' k L M hL hM m v a b) :
    ops.cap L hL m (ops.cap M hM (m + 1) ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v (m + 2) hv) : DimChow X (m + 2)))) =
      ops.cap M hM m (ops.cap L hL (m + 1) ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v (m + 2) hv) : DimChow X (m + 2))))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C₁, h₁, c₁⟩ := cap_cap_prime' (k := k) ops L M hL hM m v hv a b d.repM_v d.repL_w
  obtain ⟨C₂, h₂, c₂⟩ := cap_cap_prime' (k := k) ops M L hM hL m v hv b a d.repL_v d.repM_w
  rw [h₁, h₂]
  congr 2
  ext y
  rw [c₁ y, c₂ y]
  exact coeff_symm_X (k := k) m v hv a b d.meets y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D20.isUnit_pullback_iff
statement:
theorem isUnit_pullback_iff (a : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (v : X) (y : pointClosureScheme v) :
    IsUnit (a.pullback (pointClosureι v) y) ↔ IsUnit (a (pointClosureι v y))
proof:
:=
  isUnit_map_iff ((pointClosureι v).stalkMap y).hom _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D20.assoc_pullback
statement:
theorem assoc_pullback (E : C1Cap.LocalEquationFrames L a) (v : X)
    ⦃x y : pointClosureScheme v⦄ (h : x ⤳ y) :
    Associated (((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom
      (a.pullback (pointClosureι v) y)) (a.pullback (pointClosureι v) x)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := associated_of_specializes E (h.map (pointClosureι v).continuous)
  have h2 := h1.map ((pointClosureι v).stalkMap x).hom
  have h3 := (pointClosureι v).stalkSpecializes_stalkMap_apply x y h (a (pointClosureι v y))
  change Associated (((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom
    (((pointClosureι v).stalkMap y).hom (a (pointClosureι v y))))
    (((pointClosureι v).stalkMap x).hom (a (pointClosureι v x)))
  rw [← h3]
  exact h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D20.isUnit_pullback_generic
statement:
theorem isUnit_pullback_generic (v : X) (hav : IsUnit (a v)) :
    IsUnit (a.pullback (pointClosureι v) (pointClosureGenericPoint v))
proof:
:= by
  rw [isUnit_pullback_iff]
  have key : ∀ w : X, w = v → IsUnit (a w) := by
    rintro w rfl
    exact hav
  exact key _ (pointClosureι_genericPoint v)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D20.pullback_ne_zero
statement:
theorem pullback_ne_zero (E : C1Cap.LocalEquationFrames L a) (v : X) (hav : IsUnit (a v))
    (z : pointClosureScheme v) : a.pullback (pointClosureι v) z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hη := isUnit_pullback_generic v hav
  have h1 := assoc_pullback E v
    ((pointClosureGenericPoint_isGeneric v).specializes (Set.mem_univ z))
  intro h0
  rw [h0, map_zero] at h1
  exact hη.ne_zero ((associated_zero_iff_eq_zero _).mp h1.symm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D20.finite_nonunit
statement:
theorem finite_nonunit (E : C1Cap.LocalEquationFrames L a) (v : X) (hav : IsUnit (a v)) :
    {x : pointClosureScheme v | coheight x = 1 ∧ ¬ IsUnit (a (pointClosureι v x))}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  haveI : TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace (pointClosureScheme v) :=
    (pointClosureι v).isClosedEmbedding.isInducing.noetherianSpace
  have hopen : IsOpen {y : pointClosureScheme v | IsUnit (a.pullback (pointClosureι v) y)} := by
    have : {y : pointClosureScheme v | IsUnit (a.pullback (pointClosureι v) y)} =
        (pointClosureι v) ⁻¹' {w : X | IsUnit (a w)} := by
      ext y
      exact isUnit_pullback_iff a v y
    rw [this]
    exact (isOpen_isUnit E).preimage (pointClosureι v).continuous
  have hcl := hopen.isClosed_compl
  have hgen : genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v) = pointClosureGenericPoint v :=
    ((pointClosureGenericPoint_isGeneric v).eq (genericPoint_spec _)).symm
  have hηF : genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v) ∉
      {y : pointClosureScheme v | IsUnit (a.pullback (pointClosureι v) y)}ᶜ := by
    rw [hgen]
    exact fun h ↦ h (isUnit_pullback_generic v hav)
  refine (finite_coheight_one_of_isClosed hcl hηF).subset ?_
  rintro x ⟨hx1, hx⟩
  exact ⟨fun hu ↦ hx ((isUnit_pullback_iff a v x).mp hu), hx1⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D20.meets_of_units
statement:
theorem meets_of_units (EL : C1Cap.LocalEquationFrames L a) (EM : C1Cap.LocalEquationFrames M b)
    (v : X) (hav : IsUnit (a v)) (hbv : IsUnit (b v))
    (hj : ∀ x : pointClosureScheme v, coheight x = 1 →
      IsUnit (a (pointClosureι v x)) ∨ IsUnit (b (pointClosureι v x))) :
    MeetsProperly v a b where
  ne_a z
proof:
:= pullback_ne_zero EL v hav z
  ne_b z := pullback_ne_zero EM v hbv z
  assoc_a := fun _ _ h ↦ assoc_pullback EL v h
  assoc_b := fun _ _ h ↦ assoc_pullback EM v h
  joint z hz q hq haq hbq := by
    by_contra hne
    haveI := hq
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxq⟩ := Scheme.exists_specializes_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_eq z q
    have hxz : x ≠ z := by
      rintro rfl
      exact hne (hxq.symm.trans (SchemeLocalOrdSymmetry.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_self hx))
    have hlt : z < x := lt_of_le_not_ge (show z ≤ x from hx) fun h' ↦
      hxz (hx.antisymm (show z ⤳ x from h')).eq
    have hh := Scheme.height_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hx
    rw [hxq] at hh
    have hq0 : q ≠ ⊥ := fun h0 ↦ pullback_ne_zero EL v hav z (by rw [h0] at haq; exact haq)
    have hne0 : coheight x ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      rw [h0] at hh
      exact hq0 (Ideal.height_eq_zero_iff_eq_bot.mp hh)
    have hle : coheight x ≤ 1 := by
      have h2 : coheight x + 1 ≤ 1 + 1 := by
        rw [one_add_one_eq_two]
        exact (coheight_add_one_le hlt).trans hz
      exact (ENat.add_le_add_iff_right ENat.one_ne_top).mp h2
    have hx1 : coheight x = 1 := le_antisymm hle (Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hne0)
    have hmem : ∀ c : (pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalk z, c ∈ q →
        ((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalkSpecializes hx).hom c ∈
          IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalk x) := by
      intro c hc
      rw [← hxq] at hc
      exact hc
    rcases hj x hx1 with hu | hu
    · have hu' := (isUnit_pullback_iff a v x).mpr hu
      have := hmem _ haq
      rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff] at this
      exact this (((assoc_pullback EL v hx).isUnit_iff).mpr hu')
    · have hu' := (isUnit_pullback_iff b v x).mpr hu
      have := hmem _ hbq
      rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff] at this
      exact this (((assoc_pullback EM v hx).isUnit_iff).mpr hu')

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D20.exists_of_coeff_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_of_coeff_ne_zero (b : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (v w : X)
    (hne : C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff b v w ≠ 0) :
    ∃ x : pointClosureScheme v, pointClosureι v x = w ∧ coheight x = 1 ∧
      ¬ IsUnit (b (pointClosureι v x))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : v ⤳ w := by
    by_contra h
    exact hne (C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_not_specializes b h)
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := C1Cap.exists_pointClosureι_eq h1
  rw [c1CapPrimeCoeff_pointClosureι_eq] at hne
  unfold cbW at hne
  by_cases hx : coheight x = 1
  · rw [if_pos hx] at hne
    refine ⟨x, rfl, hx, fun hu ↦ hne ?_⟩
    have hu' := (isUnit_pullback_iff b v x).mpr hu
    have h0 : Ring.ord ((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalk x)
        (b.pullback (pointClosureι v) x) = 0 := Ring.ord_of_isUnit hu'
    rw [h0]
    simp
  · rw [if_neg hx] at hne
    exact absurd rfl hne

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D20.rep_of_unit
statement:
theorem rep_of_unit (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (E : C1Cap.LocalEquationFrames L a) (n : ℕ)
    (w : X) (hw : height w = n + 1) (hu : IsUnit (a w)) : Rep (k := k) L hL n w a
proof:
:= by
  have hne : ∀ z : pointClosureScheme w, a (pointClosureι w z) ∉
      Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι w z) := by
    intro z h
    have hne0 : restrictedEq w a z ≠ 0 := by
      rw [restrictedEq_eq_pointCoord E w z, C1Cap.pointCoord_eq E w z]
      exact mul_ne_zero (C1Cap.refCoord_ne_zero E w hu)
        ((C1Cap.refFrame E w).regularTransitionFunction_ne_zero (C1Cap.pointFrame E w z))
    apply hne0
    rw [← C1Cap.ker_stalkMap_pointClosureι, RingHom.mem_ker] at h
    unfold restrictedEq
    rw [h, map_zero]
  obtain ⟨bp, b, c₀, hc⟩ := (ClosureFrames.ofLocalEquationFrames E w hne).frameCompare
  let G : DimRelationGenerator X n :=
    ⟨pointClosureScheme w, pointClosureι w, c₀, hc.1,
      fun y hy ↦ D5.height_pointClosure_of_coheight_one (k := k) n w hw y hy⟩
  refine ⟨D5.primeCycleOfFrame (k := k) L hL n w hw b + G.cycle, ?_, fun y ↦ ?_⟩
  · have hG : (QuotientAddGroup.mk G.cycle : DimChow X n) = 0 :=
      (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff _).mpr (AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨G, rfl⟩)
    rw [D5.primeCapOrZero, dif_pos hw, D5.primeCap_eq (k := k) L hL n w hw b,
      QuotientAddGroup.mk_add, hG, add_zero]
  · have := coeff_eq_of_frameCompare (k := k) L hL w a (fun _ ↦ 1) b c₀ hc y
    simp only [C1CapDescent.c1CapPrimeCoeff_one, sub_zero] at this
    exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D20.exists_frames
statement:
theorem exists_frames (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (s : Γ(L, ⊤)) :
    ∃ a : C1Cap.LocalEquations X, ∃ _ : C1Cap.LocalEquationFrames L a,
      ∀ p : X, (∀ d : LineBundleLocalData X L p,
        IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ d.U p d.mem (sectionCoordSec d s))) → IsUnit (a p)
proof:
:= by
  have hrk := genericRank_eq_one_of_hasConstantRank hL
  let frame : ∀ y : X, LineBundleLocalData X L y :=
    fun y ↦ Scheme.Modules.lineBundleLocalDataAt X L hL.isFiniteLocallyFree hrk y
  exact ⟨_, LocalEquationFrames.ofSection frame s, fun p h ↦ h (frame p)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D20.gateData_of_generated
statement:
theorem gateData_of_generated [Infinite k] (L M : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1)
    (hgL : ∀ p : X, ∃ s : Γ(L, ⊤), ∃ d : LineBundleLocalData X L p,
      IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ d.U p d.mem (sectionCoordSec d s)))
    (hgM : ∀ p : X, ∃ s : Γ(M, ⊤), ∃ d : LineBundleLocalData X M p,
      IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ d.U p d.mem (sectionCoordSec d s)))
    (m : ℕ) (v : X) (hv : height v = m + 2) :
    ∃ a b : C1Cap.LocalEquations X, GateData' k L M hL hM m v a b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨sL, hsL⟩ := sectionsAvoidFinite_of_generated (k := k) L hgL {v} (Set.finite_singleton v)
  obtain ⟨a, EL, haU⟩ := exists_frames L hL sL
  have hav : IsUnit (a v) := haU v (hsL v rfl)
  have hfin := finite_nonunit EL v hav
  obtain ⟨sM, hsM⟩ := sectionsAvoidFinite_of_generated (k := k) M hgM
    ({v} ∪ (pointClosureι v) '' {x : pointClosureScheme v |
      coheight x = 1 ∧ ¬ IsUnit (a (pointClosureι v x))})
    ((Set.finite_singleton v).union (hfin.image _))
  obtain ⟨b, EM, hbU⟩ := exists_frames M hM sM
  have hbv : IsUnit (b v) := hbU v (hsM v (Or.inl rfl))
  have hbZ : ∀ x : pointClosureScheme v, coheight x = 1 →
      ¬ IsUnit (a (pointClosureι v x)) → IsUnit (b (pointClosureι v x)) := fun x hx1 hx ↦
    hbU _ (hsM _ (Or.inr ⟨x, ⟨hx1, hx⟩, rfl⟩))
  have hv' : height v = ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) + 1 := hv
  refine ⟨a, b, ⟨meets_of_units EL EM v hav hbv fun x hx1 ↦ ?_,
    rep_of_unit (k := k) hM EM (m + 1) v hv' hbv,
    rep_of_unit (k := k) hL EL (m + 1) v hv' hav, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · by_cases hx : IsUnit (a (pointClosureι v x))
    · exact Or.inl hx
    · exact Or.inr (hbZ x hx1 hx)
  · intro w hw hne
    obtain ⟨x, rfl, hx1, hbn⟩ := exists_of_coeff_ne_zero b v w hne
    refine rep_of_unit (k := k) hL EL m _ hw ?_
    by_contra hanu
    exact hbn (hbZ x hx1 hanu)
  · intro w hw hne
    obtain ⟨x, rfl, hx1, han⟩ := exists_of_coeff_ne_zero a v w hne
    exact rep_of_unit (k := k) hM EM m _ hw (hbZ x hx1 han)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D20.capCommGate_of_generated
statement:
theorem capCommGate_of_generated [Infinite k] (ops : ChowOps k) (L M : X.Modules)
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1)
    (hgL : ∀ p : X, ∃ s : Γ(L, ⊤), ∃ d : LineBundleLocalData X L p,
      IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ d.U p d.mem (sectionCoordSec d s)))
    (hgM : ∀ p : X, ∃ s : Γ(M, ⊤), ∃ d : LineBundleLocalData X M p,
      IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ d.U p d.mem (sectionCoordSec d s))) :
    D17.CapCommGate ops L M hL hM
proof:
:= by
  intro m v hv
  obtain ⟨a, b, d⟩ := gateData_of_generated (k := k) L M hL hM hgL hgM m v hv
  exact capComm_prime_of_rep (k := k) ops m v hv a b d

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D20.capCommute_of_generated
statement:
theorem capCommute_of_generated [Infinite k] (ops : ChowOps k) (L M : X.Modules)
    (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1)
    (hgL : ∀ p : X, ∃ s : Γ(L, ⊤), ∃ d : LineBundleLocalData X L p,
      IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ d.U p d.mem (sectionCoordSec d s)))
    (hgM : ∀ p : X, ∃ s : Γ(M, ⊤), ∃ d : LineBundleLocalData X M p,
      IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ d.U p d.mem (sectionCoordSec d s))) :
    D17.CapCommute ops L M hL hM
proof:
:=
  D17.capCommute_of_gate (capCommGate_of_generated (k := k) ops L M hL hM hgL hgM)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D20.capCommute_of_generated_quotients
statement:
theorem capCommute_of_generated_quotients [Infinite k] (ops : ChowOps k) {L M A B C D : X.Modules}
    {hL : HasConstantRank X L 1} {hM : HasConstantRank X M 1} {hA : HasConstantRank X A 1}
    {hB : HasConstantRank X B 1} {hC : HasConstantRank X C 1} {hD : HasConstantRank X D 1}
    (eL : L ≅ tensorSheaf X A (lineBundleDual X B))
    (eM : M ≅ tensorSheaf X C (lineBundleDual X D))
    (gA : ∀ p : X, ∃ s : Γ(A, ⊤), ∃ d : LineBundleLocalData X A p,
      IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ d.U p d.mem (sectionCoordSec d s)))
    (gB : ∀ p : X, ∃ s : Γ(B, ⊤), ∃ d : LineBundleLocalData X B p,
      IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ d.U p d.mem (sectionCoordSec d s)))
    (gC : ∀ p : X, ∃ s : Γ(C, ⊤), ∃ d : LineBundleLocalData X C p,
      IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ d.U p d.mem (sectionCoordSec d s)))
    (gD : ∀ p : X, ∃ s : Γ(D, ⊤), ∃ d : LineBundleLocalData X D p,
      IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ d.U p d.mem (sectionCoordSec d s))) :
    D17.CapCommute ops L M hL hM
proof:
:=
  D17.capCommute_of_quotients eL eM
    (capCommute_of_generated (k := k) ops A C hA hC gA gC)
    (capCommute_of_generated (k := k) ops A D hA hD gA gD)
    (capCommute_of_generated (k := k) ops B C hB hC gB gC)
    (capCommute_of_generated (k := k) ops B D hB hD gB gD)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D20.capCommute_twistPullback
statement:
theorem capCommute_twistPullback [Infinite k] (ops : ChowOps k) (N N' : ℕ) (j : X ⟶ space k N)
    (j' : X ⟶ space k N') :
    D17.CapCommute ops (twistPullback (k := k) N j) (twistPullback (k := k) N' j')
      (hasConstantRank_twistPullback N j) (hasConstantRank_twistPullback N' j')
proof:
:=
  capCommute_of_generated (k := k) ops _ _ _ _ (twistPullback_generated N j)
    (twistPullback_generated N' j')

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosection_adj_comp_mate
statement:
theorem cosection_adj_comp_mate {C D K : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] [Category K]
    {F : C ⥤ D} {G : D ⥤ C} {H : D ⥤ K} {J : K ⥤ D}
    (a : F ⊣ G) (b : H ⊣ J) (x : C) (y : K) (f : H.obj (F.obj x) ⟶ y) :
    (a.comp b).homEquiv x y f = a.homEquiv x (J.obj y) (b.homEquiv (F.obj x) y f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Adjunction.comp_homEquiv]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosection_adj_counit_unitIso
statement:
theorem cosection_adj_counit_unitIso {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D]
    {F : C ⥤ D} {G : D ⥤ C} (a : F ⊣ G) (x : C) [IsIso (a.unit.app x)] :
    a.counit.app (F.obj x) = F.map (asIso (a.unit.app x)).inv
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi (F.map (a.unit.app x))).mp
  erw [a.left_triangle_components]
  erw [← F.map_comp]
  simp

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionTildePullback_unit
statement:
theorem cosectionTildePullback_unit (φ : R →+* S) (M : ModuleCat R) :
    (cosectionAffinePullAdjunction φ).unit.app M ≫
      (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of S) ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).map
        ((tildePullbackSpecMapIso φ).app M).hom =
    (cosectionAffineExtendAdjunction φ).unit.app M
proof:
:= by
  exact Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app
    (cosectionAffinePullAdjunction φ) (cosectionAffineExtendAdjunction φ) M

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionTildePullback_unit_expanded
statement:
theorem cosectionTildePullback_unit_expanded (φ : R →+* S) (M : ModuleCat R) :
    (tildeAffineGlobalSectionsAdjunction (.of R)).unit.app M ≫
      (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R)).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).unit.app
          ((tilde.functor (.of R)).obj M)) ≫
      (moduleSpecΓPushforwardNatIso (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)).hom.app
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).obj
          ((tilde.functor (.of R)).obj M)) ≫
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).map ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of S)).map
        ((tildePullbackSpecMapIso φ).app M).hom) =
    (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj φ).unit.app M ≫
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).map
        ((tildeAffineGlobalSectionsAdjunction (.of S)).unit.app
          ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φ).obj M))
proof:
:= by
  have h := cosectionTildePullback_unit φ M
  simp only [cosectionAffinePullAdjunction, cosectionAffineExtendAdjunction,
    Adjunction.ofNatIsoRight, NatTrans.comp_app, Functor.whiskerLeft_app, Adjunction.comp_unit_app,
    Functor.comp_map, Category.assoc] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionScalarUnitMap_one_tmul
statement:
theorem cosectionScalarUnitMap_one_tmul (r : R) :
    cosectionScalarUnitMap (R := R) (S := S) ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] r) = algebraMap R S r
proof:
:= by
  change cosectionScalarUnitMap (R := R) (S := S) ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] r) =
    cosectionScalarCoefficientMap (R := R) (S := S) r
  erw [← ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj_homEquiv_apply]
  exact congrArg (fun f => f r)
    (((ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj (algebraMap R S)).homEquiv _ _).apply_symm_apply
      (cosectionScalarCoefficientMap (R := R) (S := S)))

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionNativeUnit_mate
statement:
theorem cosectionNativeUnit_mate :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))).homEquiv _ _
      (Chow.C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))).hom =
    SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))).toRingCatSheafHom
proof:
:=
  SheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction_homEquiv_pullbackObjUnitToUnit _

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionCompositeNativeUnit_mate
statement:
theorem cosectionCompositeNativeUnit_mate :
    ((tildeAffineGlobalSectionsAdjunction (.of R)).comp
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))))).homEquiv _ _
      (Chow.C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))).hom =
    (tildeAffineGlobalSectionsAdjunction (.of R)).unit.app (ModuleCat.of R R) ≫
      (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R)).map
        (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))).toRingCatSheafHom)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cosection_adj_comp_mate]
  erw [cosectionNativeUnit_mate, Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionAffineNativeUnit_mate
statement:
theorem cosectionAffineNativeUnit_mate :
    (cosectionAffinePullAdjunction (algebraMap R S)).homEquiv _ _
      (Chow.C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))).hom =
    ((tildeAffineGlobalSectionsAdjunction (.of R)).unit.app (ModuleCat.of R R) ≫
      (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R)).map
        (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))).toRingCatSheafHom)) ≫
      (moduleSpecΓPushforwardNatIso (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))).hom.app
        (SheafOfModules.unit (Spec (.of S)).ringCatSheaf)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [cosectionAffinePullAdjunction]
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_ofNatIsoRight_apply, cosectionCompositeNativeUnit_mate]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionTildeUnit_one
statement:
theorem cosectionTildeUnit_one (A : CommRingCat.{u}) :
    ((tildeAffineGlobalSectionsAdjunction A).unit.app (ModuleCat.of A A)) (1 : A) =
      (1 : Γ(Spec A,⊤))
proof:
:= by
  change (StructureSheaf.toOpen A ⊤) 1 = 1
  exact map_one _

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionPushforwardUnit_one
statement:
theorem cosectionPushforwardUnit_one (φ : R →+* S) :
    ((moduleSpecΓPushforwardNatIso (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)).hom.app
      (SheafOfModules.unit (Spec (.of S)).ringCatSheaf))
      (1 : Γ(Spec (.of S), (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤)) =
      (1 : Γ(Spec (.of S),⊤))
proof:
:= by
  with_unfolding_all rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionAffineUnitCoefficient_square
statement:
theorem cosectionAffineUnitCoefficient_square :
    cosectionScalarCoefficientMap (R := R) (S := S) ≫
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap R S)).map
        ((tildeAffineGlobalSectionsAdjunction (.of S)).unit.app (ModuleCat.of S S)) =
    ((tildeAffineGlobalSectionsAdjunction (.of R)).unit.app (ModuleCat.of R R) ≫
      (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R)).map
        (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))).toRingCatSheafHom)) ≫
      (moduleSpecΓPushforwardNatIso (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))).hom.app
        (SheafOfModules.unit (Spec (.of S)).ringCatSheaf)
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  ext
  with_unfolding_all
    change ((tildeAffineGlobalSectionsAdjunction (.of S)).unit.app (ModuleCat.of S S))
      (algebraMap R S 1) =
      ((moduleSpecΓPushforwardNatIso (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))).hom.app
        (SheafOfModules.unit (Spec (.of S)).ringCatSheaf))
        ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))).app ⊤
          (((tildeAffineGlobalSectionsAdjunction (.of R)).unit.app (ModuleCat.of R R)) (1 : R)))
  rw [map_one, cosectionTildeUnit_one, cosectionTildeUnit_one, map_one]
  exact (cosectionPushforwardUnit_one (algebraMap R S)).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionAffineExtend_unit_map
statement:
theorem cosectionAffineExtend_unit_map (φ : R →+* S) (M : ModuleCat R) (N : ModuleCat S)
    (f : (ModuleCat.extendScalars φ).obj M ⟶ N) :
    (cosectionAffineExtendAdjunction φ).unit.app M ≫
      (affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of S) ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).map
        ((tilde.functor (.of S)).map f) =
    (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj φ).unit.app M ≫
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).map f ≫
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).map
        ((tildeAffineGlobalSectionsAdjunction (.of S)).unit.app N)
proof:
:= by
  have hn := (tildeAffineGlobalSectionsAdjunction (.of S)).unit.naturality f
  dsimp only [Functor.comp_map, Functor.id_map] at hn
  have hp := congrArg (fun q => (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj φ).unit.app M ≫
    (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).map q) hn.symm
  simp only [cosectionAffineExtendAdjunction, Adjunction.comp_unit_app,
    Functor.comp_map, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc] at hp ⊢
  with_unfolding_all exact hp

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionTildePullback_unitSheaf
statement:
theorem cosectionTildePullback_unitSheaf :
    ((tildePullbackSpecMapIso (algebraMap R S)).app (ModuleCat.of R R)).hom ≫
      (tilde.functor (.of S)).map (cosectionScalarUnitMap (R := R) (S := S)) =
    (Chow.C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply (cosectionAffinePullAdjunction (algebraMap R S)).homEquiv _ _ |>.injective
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
  rw [show (cosectionAffinePullAdjunction (algebraMap R S)).homEquiv _ _
    ((tildePullbackSpecMapIso (algebraMap R S)).app (ModuleCat.of R R)).hom =
      (cosectionAffineExtendAdjunction (algebraMap R S)).unit.app (ModuleCat.of R R) from
    Adjunction.homEquiv_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app _ _ _]
  erw [cosectionAffineExtend_unit_map (algebraMap R S) (ModuleCat.of R R) (ModuleCat.of S S)
    (cosectionScalarUnitMap (R := R) (S := S)), cosectionAffineNativeUnit_mate]
  have hm := ((ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj (algebraMap R S)).homEquiv _ _).apply_symm_apply
    (cosectionScalarCoefficientMap (R := R) (S := S))
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit] at hm
  have hc := cosectionAffineUnitCoefficient_square (R := R) (S := S)
  rw [Category.assoc] at hc
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  erw [hm]
  exact hc

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionAffineScalarModuleMap_one_tmul
statement:
theorem cosectionAffineScalarModuleMap_one_tmul (M : ModuleCat R)
    (s : M ⟶ ModuleCat.of R R) (x : M) :
    cosectionAffineScalarModuleMap (S := S) M s ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] x) =
      algebraMap R S (s x)
proof:
:= by
  change cosectionScalarUnitMap (R := R) (S := S)
    ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap R S)).map s ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] x)) = _
  erw [ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.map_tmul]
  exact cosectionScalarUnitMap_one_tmul (s x)

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionAffineScalarModuleMap_tmul
statement:
theorem cosectionAffineScalarModuleMap_tmul (M : ModuleCat R)
    (s : M ⟶ ModuleCat.of R R) (a : S) (x : M) :
    cosectionAffineScalarModuleMap (S := S) M s (a ⊗ₜ[R] x) =
      a * algebraMap R S (s x)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module S ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap R S)).obj M) :=
    ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap R S)).obj M).isModule
  have ht : (a ⊗ₜ[R] x : (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap R S)).obj M) =
      @SMul.smul S ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap R S)).obj M) inferInstance
        a ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] x) := by
    have hs := ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.smul_tmul (algebraMap R S) (M := M) a 1 x
    simp only [mul_one] at hs
    with_unfolding_all exact hs.symm
  with_unfolding_all
    erw [ht, map_smul, cosectionAffineScalarModuleMap_one_tmul]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionAffineScalarModuleMap_scalarExtended
statement:
theorem cosectionAffineScalarModuleMap_scalarExtended (M : ModuleCat R)
    (s : M ⟶ ModuleCat.of R R) :
    letI
proof:
:= (algebraMap R S).toAlgebra
    cosectionAffineScalarModuleMap (S := S) M s =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (scalarExtendedCosection (S := S) s.hom) := by
  letI := (algebraMap R S).toAlgebra
  apply ModuleCat.ExtendScalars.hom_ext
  intro x
  erw [cosectionAffineScalarModuleMap_one_tmul]
  change algebraMap R S (s x) = scalarExtendedCosection (S := S) s.hom ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] x)
  rw [scalarExtendedCosection_tmul, one_mul]

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionAffineScalarModuleMap_image
statement:
theorem cosectionAffineScalarModuleMap_image (M : ModuleCat R)
    (s : M ⟶ ModuleCat.of R R) :
    letI
proof:
:= (algebraMap R S).toAlgebra
    cosectionImageIdeal (cosectionAffineScalarModuleMap (S := S) M s).hom =
      (cosectionImageIdeal s.hom).map (algebraMap R S) := by
  letI := (algebraMap R S).toAlgebra
  have he := cosectionAffineScalarModuleMap_scalarExtended (S := S) M s
  have hm := congrArg (fun f : (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap R S)).obj M ⟶
      ModuleCat.of S S => cosectionImageIdeal f.hom) he
  have hi := scalarExtendedCosection_image (S := S) s.hom
  with_unfolding_all exact hm.trans hi

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionPulledTilde_chart
statement:
theorem cosectionPulledTilde_chart (M : ModuleCat R) (s : M ⟶ ModuleCat.of R R) :
    pulledCosection (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))
      ((tilde.functor (.of R)).map s) =
    ((tildePullbackSpecMapIso (algebraMap R S)).app M).hom ≫
      (tilde.functor (.of S)).map (cosectionAffineScalarModuleMap (S := S) M s)
proof:
:= by
  have hn := (tildePullbackSpecMapIso (algebraMap R S)).hom.naturality s
  have hp := congrArg (fun f => f ≫ (tilde.functor (.of S)).map
    (cosectionScalarUnitMap (R := R) (S := S))) hn
  simp only [Functor.comp_map, Category.assoc] at hp
  have hu := cosectionTildePullback_unitSheaf (R := R) (S := S)
  simp only [Iso.app_hom] at hu
  erw [Category.assoc, hu] at hp
  simp only [cosectionAffineScalarModuleMap, Functor.map_comp, pulledCosection,
    Category.assoc, Iso.app_hom] at hp ⊢
  with_unfolding_all exact hp

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionTildeUnit_counit
statement:
theorem cosectionTildeUnit_counit :
    Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓ (R := .of R) (tensorUnitSheaf (Spec (.of R))) =
      (tilde.functor (.of R)).map (cosectionAffineUnitSectionIso (R := R)).inv
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsIso ((tilde.adjunction (R := .of R)).unit.app (ModuleCat.of R R)) := by
    change IsIso (tilde.isoTop (R := .of R) (ModuleCat.of R R)).hom
    infer_instance
  have hc := cosection_adj_counit_unitIso (tilde.adjunction (R := .of R)) (ModuleCat.of R R)
  with_unfolding_all exact hc

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionAffine_counit_factorization
statement:
theorem cosectionAffine_counit_factorization (E : (Spec (.of R)).Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent]
    (σ : E ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf (Spec (.of R))) :
    σ = (cosectionAffineCounitIso E).inv ≫
      (tilde.functor (.of R)).map (cosectionAffineSectionModuleMap E σ)
proof:
:= by
  have hn := (tilde.adjunction (R := .of R)).counit.naturality σ
  have hp := congrArg (fun f => (cosectionAffineCounitIso E).inv ≫ f) hn
  simp only [Functor.comp_map, Functor.id_map, Category.assoc] at hp
  have hu := cosectionTildeUnit_counit (R := R)
  change (tilde.adjunction (R := .of R)).counit.app (tensorUnitSheaf (Spec (.of R))) = _ at hu
  erw [hu] at hp
  simp only [cosectionAffineSectionModuleMap, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc] at hp ⊢
  have he : (tilde.adjunction (R := .of R)).counit.app E =
      (cosectionAffineCounitIso E).hom := by
    with_unfolding_all rfl
  erw [he, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc] at hp
  with_unfolding_all exact hp.symm

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.cosectionPulledAffine_chart
statement:
theorem cosectionPulledAffine_chart (E : (Spec (.of R)).Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent]
    (σ : E ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf (Spec (.of R))) :
    pulledCosection (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))) σ =
      (cosectionAffinePullSourceIso (S := S) E).hom ≫
        (tilde.functor (.of S)).map (cosectionAffineScalarModuleMap (S := S)
          ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R)).obj E)
          (cosectionAffineSectionModuleMap E σ))
proof:
:= by
  have hf := cosectionAffine_counit_factorization E σ
  have hp := congrArg (fun f => pulledCosection
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S))) f) hf
  with_unfolding_all
    simp only [pulledCosection] at hp
    erw [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc] at hp
  have ht := cosectionPulledTilde_chart (S := S)
    ((affineGlobalSectionsFunctor (.of R)).obj E) (cosectionAffineSectionModuleMap E σ)
  simp only [pulledCosection] at ht
  with_unfolding_all
    erw [ht] at hp
    simp only [cosectionAffinePullSourceIso, Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom,
      Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc]
  with_unfolding_all exact hp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankAssembly_cycleRestrict_apply
statement:
theorem rankAssembly_cycleRestrict_apply (r : ℕ) (D : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ)
    (x : (characteristicRankOpen E hE r : Scheme)) :
    rankAssembly_cycleRestrict E hE r D x = D x.1
proof:
:= by
  simp [rankAssembly_cycleRestrict, flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankAssembly_cyclePushRestrict
statement:
theorem rankAssembly_cyclePushRestrict (r : ℕ) (D : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) :
    properPushforward (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι
      (rankAssembly_cycleRestrict E hE r D) =
    D.restrict (characteristicRankOpen E hE r : Set X)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ characteristicRankOpen E hE r
  · let y : (characteristicRankOpen E hE r : Scheme) := ⟨x, hx⟩
    have hy : (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι y = x := rfl
    rw [← hy]
    rw [properPushforward, pushforward_apply_closedImmersion _ _
      (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl)]
    rw [rankAssembly_cycleRestrict_apply]
    change D x = D.restrict (characteristicRankOpen E hE r : Set X) x
    exact (AlgebraicCycle.restrict_eq_of_mem D _ x hx).symm
  · rw [properPushforward, pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range,
      AlgebraicCycle.restrict_eq_zero_of_not_mem]
    · exact hx
    · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
      exact hx y.property

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankAssembly_mem_ranks
statement: theorem rankAssembly_mem_ranks (x : X) : rankAt x E ∈ rankAssembly_ranks E hE
proof:
:= by
  exact (characteristic_rankAt_range_finite E hE).mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankAssembly_cycle_reassembly
statement:
theorem rankAssembly_cycle_reassembly (D : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) :
    (∑ r ∈ rankAssembly_ranks E hE, properPushforward (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι
      (rankAssembly_cycleRestrict E hE r D)) = D
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, rankAssembly_cyclePushRestrict,
    AlgebraicCycle.restrict_apply]
  simp only [characteristicRankOpen]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (rankAt x E)]
  · simp
  · intro b hb hne
    exact if_neg (Ne.symm hne)
  · intro h
    exact (h (rankAssembly_mem_ranks E hE x)).elim

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankAssembly_dim_reassembly
statement:
theorem rankAssembly_dim_reassembly (n : ℕ) (D : dimensionCycles X n) :
    ∑ r ∈ rankAssembly_ranks E hE, rankAssembly_dimComponent (k := k) E hE r n D = D
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [AddSubgroup.val_finsetSum]
  exact rankAssembly_cycle_reassembly E hE D.1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankAssembly_chowProjector_mk
statement:
theorem rankAssembly_chowProjector_mk (r n : ℕ) (D : dimensionCycles X n) :
    rankAssembly_chowProjector E hE ops r n
      ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X n)) =
    (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (rankAssembly_dimComponent (k := k) E hE r n D) : DimChow X n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankAssembly_chowProjector, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    ops.pull_mk (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι 0 _ n D
      (rankAssembly_dimRestrict (k := k) E hE r n D) (fun x ↦ rfl)]
  exact ops.push_mk _ n _ _ rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankAssembly_chow_reassembly
statement:
theorem rankAssembly_chow_reassembly (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ r ∈ rankAssembly_ranks E hE, rankAssembly_chowProjector E hE ops r n =
      LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro c
  change (∑ r ∈ rankAssembly_ranks E hE, rankAssembly_chowProjector E hE ops r n) c = c
  induction c using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
  | tmul q a =>
    have hq : q ⊗ₜ[ℤ] a = q • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] a) := by
      rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    rw [hq, map_smul]
    congr 1
    induction a using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H D =>
      simp only [LinearMap.sum_apply, rankAssembly_chowProjector_mk]
      have h := congrArg (fun D : dimensionCycles X n ↦
        (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X n))
        (rankAssembly_dim_reassembly (k := k) E hE n D)
      change (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] ((QuotientAddGroup.mk' (dimRationalEquivalence X n))
        (∑ r ∈ rankAssembly_ranks E hE, rankAssembly_dimComponent (k := k) E hE r n D)) = _ at h
      rw [map_sum, TensorProduct.tmul_sum] at h
      exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankAssembly_chow_joint_injective
statement:
theorem rankAssembly_chow_joint_injective (n : ℕ) (a b : RationalDimChow X n)
    (h : ∀ r ∈ rankAssembly_ranks E hE,
      ops.pull (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι 0
        (pureRelDim_openImmersion k (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι) n a =
      ops.pull (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι 0
        (pureRelDim_openImmersion k (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι) n b) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  have ha := congrArg (fun f : Module.End ℚ (RationalDimChow X n) ↦ f a)
    (rankAssembly_chow_reassembly E hE ops n)
  have hb := congrArg (fun f : Module.End ℚ (RationalDimChow X n) ↦ f b)
    (rankAssembly_chow_reassembly E hE ops n)
  simp only [LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.id_apply] at ha hb
  rw [← ha, ← hb]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr ↦ congrArg (ops.push (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι n) (h r hr)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankAssembly_totalProjector_lof
statement:
theorem rankAssembly_totalProjector_lof (r n : ℕ) (c : RationalDimChow X n) :
    rankAssembly_totalProjector E hE ops r
      (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) n c) =
    DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) n
      (rankAssembly_chowProjector E hE ops r n c)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rankAssembly_totalProjector, LinearMap.comp_apply, totalPush, totalPull,
    DirectSum.toModule_lof, rankAssembly_chowProjector, Nat.add_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankAssembly_total_reassembly
statement:
theorem rankAssembly_total_reassembly :
    ∑ r ∈ rankAssembly_ranks E hE, rankAssembly_totalProjector E hE ops r = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro c
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.id_apply,
    rankAssembly_totalProjector_lof]
  rw [← map_sum]
  have h := congrArg (fun f : Module.End ℚ (RationalDimChow X n) ↦ f c)
    (rankAssembly_chow_reassembly E hE ops n)
  simp only [LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.id_apply] at h
  rw [h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankAssembly_total_joint_injective
statement:
theorem rankAssembly_total_joint_injective (a b : TotalChow X)
    (h : ∀ r ∈ rankAssembly_ranks E hE,
      totalPull ops (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι 0
        (pureRelDim_openImmersion k (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι) a =
      totalPull ops (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι 0
        (pureRelDim_openImmersion k (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι) b) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  have ha := congrArg (fun f : Module.End ℚ (TotalChow X) ↦ f a)
    (rankAssembly_total_reassembly E hE ops)
  have hb := congrArg (fun f : Module.End ℚ (TotalChow X) ↦ f b)
    (rankAssembly_total_reassembly E hE ops)
  simp only [LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.id_apply] at ha hb
  rw [← ha, ← hb]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r hr ↦
    congrArg (totalPush ops (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι) (h r hr)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankAssembly_cycle_pull_push_self
statement:
theorem rankAssembly_cycle_pull_push_self (r : ℕ)
    (D : AlgebraicCycle (characteristicRankOpen E hE r : Scheme) ℤ) :
    flatPullback (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι
      (properPushforward (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι D) = D
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [flatPullback_apply, flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion, Nat.cast_one, mul_one,
    properPushforward, pushforward_apply_closedImmersion _ _
      (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankAssembly_cycle_pull_push_other
statement:
theorem rankAssembly_cycle_pull_push_other (r s : ℕ) (hrs : r ≠ s)
    (D : AlgebraicCycle (characteristicRankOpen E hE s : Scheme) ℤ) :
    flatPullback (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι
      (properPushforward (characteristicRankOpen E hE s).ι D) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [flatPullback_apply, flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion, Nat.cast_one, mul_one,
    properPushforward, pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range]
  · rfl
  · rintro ⟨y, he⟩
    have hx : rankAt ((characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι x) E = r := x.property
    have hy : rankAt ((characteristicRankOpen E hE s).ι y) E = s := y.property
    rw [he] at hy
    exact hrs (hx.symm.trans hy)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankAssembly_chow_pull_push_self
statement:
theorem rankAssembly_chow_pull_push_self (r n : ℕ) :
    (ops.pull (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι 0
      (pureRelDim_openImmersion k (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι) n).comp
      (ops.push (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι n) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro c
  change ((ops.pull (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι 0 _ n).comp
    (ops.push (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι n)) c = c
  induction c using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
  | tmul q a =>
    have hq : q ⊗ₜ[ℤ] a = q • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] a) := by
      rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    rw [hq, map_smul]
    congr 1
    induction a using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H D =>
      let P : dimensionCycles X n :=
        ⟨properPushforward (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι D.1,
          properPushforward_mem_dimensionCycles _ (heightCompatible_of_isClosedImmersion _) D.2⟩
      let R : dimensionCycles (characteristicRankOpen E hE r : Scheme) n :=
        ⟨flatPullback (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι P.1,
          flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles _ (pureRelDim_openImmersion k _) P.2⟩
      rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, ops.push_mk _ n D P rfl,
        ops.pull_mk _ 0 _ n P R (fun _ ↦ rfl)]
      have hR : R = D := Subtype.ext (rankAssembly_cycle_pull_push_self E hE r D.1)
      rw [hR]
      rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankAssembly_chow_pull_push_other
statement:
theorem rankAssembly_chow_pull_push_other (r s n : ℕ) (hrs : r ≠ s) :
    (ops.pull (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι 0
      (pureRelDim_openImmersion k (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι) n).comp
      (ops.push (characteristicRankOpen E hE s).ι n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro c
  change ((ops.pull (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι 0 _ n).comp
    (ops.push (characteristicRankOpen E hE s).ι n)) c = 0
  induction c using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb, add_zero]
  | tmul q a =>
    have hq : q ⊗ₜ[ℤ] a = q • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] a) := by
      rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    rw [hq, map_smul]
    suffices h : ((ops.pull (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι 0 _ n).comp
      (ops.push (characteristicRankOpen E hE s).ι n)) ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] a) = 0 by
      rw [h, smul_zero]
    induction a using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H D =>
      let P : dimensionCycles X n :=
        ⟨properPushforward (characteristicRankOpen E hE s).ι D.1,
          properPushforward_mem_dimensionCycles _ (heightCompatible_of_isClosedImmersion _) D.2⟩
      let R : dimensionCycles (characteristicRankOpen E hE r : Scheme) n :=
        ⟨flatPullback (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι P.1,
          flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles _ (pureRelDim_openImmersion k _) P.2⟩
      rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, ops.push_mk _ n D P rfl,
        ops.pull_mk _ 0 _ n P R (fun _ ↦ rfl)]
      have hR : R = 0 := Subtype.ext (rankAssembly_cycle_pull_push_other E hE r s hrs D.1)
      simp [hR]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankAssembly_total_pull_push_self
statement:
theorem rankAssembly_total_pull_push_self (r : ℕ) :
    (totalPull ops (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι 0
      (pureRelDim_openImmersion k (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι)).comp
      (totalPush ops (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro c
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, totalPush, totalPull, DirectSum.toModule_lof,
    Nat.add_zero, LinearMap.id_apply]
  have h := congrArg (fun f : Module.End ℚ (RationalDimChow (characteristicRankOpen E hE r : Scheme) n) ↦ f c)
    (rankAssembly_chow_pull_push_self E hE ops r n)
  exact congrArg (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ _ n) h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.rankAssembly_total_pull_push_other
statement:
theorem rankAssembly_total_pull_push_other (r s : ℕ) (hrs : r ≠ s) :
    (totalPull ops (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι 0
      (pureRelDim_openImmersion k (characteristicRankOpen E hE r).ι)).comp
      (totalPush ops (characteristicRankOpen E hE s).ι) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro c
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, totalPush, totalPull, DirectSum.toModule_lof,
    Nat.add_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  have h := congrArg (fun f : RationalDimChow (characteristicRankOpen E hE s : Scheme) n →ₗ[ℚ]
      RationalDimChow (characteristicRankOpen E hE r : Scheme) n ↦ f c)
    (rankAssembly_chow_pull_push_other E hE ops r s n hrs)
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply] at h
  rw [h, map_zero]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.CoordinateOrderedCechWord.delete_val
statement:

theorem CoordinateOrderedCechWord.delete_val {p : ℕ}

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOrderedToCech_comp_coordinateCechToOrdered
statement:
theorem coordinateOrderedToCech_comp_coordinateCechToOrdered (p : ℕ) :
    coordinateOrderedToCech k n M p ≫ coordinateCechToOrdered k n M p =
      𝟙 (coordinateOrderedCechHigherTerm k n M p)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateOrderedCechHigherTerm_isZero

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistLocalChartKernelLift_ι
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem twistLocalChartKernelLift_ι

            ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d T).descentLeft -

proof:
