name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.affineChartBasicRingBack_restriction
statement:
theorem affineChartBasicRingBack_restriction (r : Γ(X,U)) :
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X,U)).inv ≫
      (Spec Γ(X,U)).presheaf.map (homOfLE (show
        (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r : (Spec Γ(X,U)).Opens) ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op ≫
      affineChartBasicRingBack X U r =
    X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le r)).op
proof:
:= by
  let i : (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r : (Spec Γ(X,U)).Opens) ⟶ ⊤ := homOfLE le_top
  have htop : U.2.fromSpec ''ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec Γ(X,U)).Opens) ≤ U.1 :=
    (affineChart_image_top X U).le
  have hn := U.2.fromSpec.appIso_inv_naturality i.op
  have ht : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X,U)).inv ≫ (U.2.fromSpec.appIso ⊤).inv =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE htop).op := by
    have h := Scheme.Hom.appLE_appIso_inv U.2.fromSpec
      (show (⊤ : (Spec Γ(X,U)).Opens) ≤ U.2.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 from
        by rw [U.2.fromSpec_preimage_self])
    exact (congrArg (fun k => k ≫ (U.2.fromSpec.appIso ⊤).inv)
      (affineChartTopRingMap_eq X U).symm).trans h
  change (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X,U)).inv ≫
    (Spec Γ(X,U)).presheaf.map i.op ≫ (U.2.fromSpec.appIso _).inv ≫
    X.presheaf.map (eqToHom (U.2.fromSpec_image_basicOpen r).symm).op = _
  calc
    _ = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X,U)).inv ≫
        ((Spec Γ(X,U)).presheaf.map i.op ≫ (U.2.fromSpec.appIso _).inv) ≫
        X.presheaf.map (eqToHom (U.2.fromSpec_image_basicOpen r).symm).op := by
      simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X,U)).inv ≫
        ((U.2.fromSpec.appIso ⊤).inv ≫ X.presheaf.map (U.2.fromSpec.opensFunctor.op.map i.op)) ≫
        X.presheaf.map (eqToHom (U.2.fromSpec_image_basicOpen r).symm).op :=
      congrArg (fun k => (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X,U)).inv ≫ k ≫
        X.presheaf.map (eqToHom (U.2.fromSpec_image_basicOpen r).symm).op) hn
    _ = ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X,U)).inv ≫ (U.2.fromSpec.appIso ⊤).inv) ≫
        X.presheaf.map (U.2.fromSpec.opensFunctor.op.map i.op) ≫
        X.presheaf.map (eqToHom (U.2.fromSpec_image_basicOpen r).symm).op := by
      simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = X.presheaf.map (homOfLE htop).op ≫
        X.presheaf.map (U.2.fromSpec.opensFunctor.op.map i.op) ≫
        X.presheaf.map (eqToHom (U.2.fromSpec_image_basicOpen r).symm).op :=
      congrArg (fun k => k ≫ X.presheaf.map (U.2.fromSpec.opensFunctor.op.map i.op) ≫
        X.presheaf.map (eqToHom (U.2.fromSpec_image_basicOpen r).symm).op) ht
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← X.presheaf.map_comp, ← X.presheaf.map_comp]
      exact congrArg X.presheaf.map (Subsingleton.elim _ _)

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.affineChartBasicSectionsIso_smul
statement:
theorem affineChartBasicSectionsIso_smul (r a : Γ(X,U))
    (x : Γ(affineChartModule X E U,PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r)) :
    (affineChartBasicSectionsIso X E U r).hom (a • x) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le r)).op a •
        (affineChartBasicSectionsIso X E U r).hom x
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module Γ(Spec Γ(X,U),PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r)
      Γ(affineChartModule X E U,PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r) :=
    (affineChartModule X E U).val.obj (op (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r)) |>.isModule
  rw [Scheme.Modules.smul_Spec_def]
  let i : (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r : (Spec Γ(X,U)).Opens) ⟶ ⊤ := homOfLE le_top
  let c : Γ(Spec Γ(X,U),PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r) :=
    (Spec Γ(X,U)).presheaf.map i.op ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X,U)).inv a)
  have hs := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (Scheme.Modules.smul_restrictAppIso_hom (f := U.2.fromSpec) E
      (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r)
      c) x
  change (E.restrictAppIso U.2.fromSpec (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r)).hom
      (c • x) =
    (U.2.fromSpec.appIso (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r)).inv
      c •
        (E.restrictAppIso U.2.fromSpec (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r)).hom x at hs
  change E.presheaf.map (eqToHom (U.2.fromSpec_image_basicOpen r).symm).op
    ((E.restrictAppIso U.2.fromSpec (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r)).hom
      (c • x)) = _
  calc
    _ = E.presheaf.map (eqToHom (U.2.fromSpec_image_basicOpen r).symm).op
      ((U.2.fromSpec.appIso (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r)).inv
        c •
          (E.restrictAppIso U.2.fromSpec (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r)).hom x) :=
      congrArg (E.presheaf.map (eqToHom (U.2.fromSpec_image_basicOpen r).symm).op) hs
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul]
      have hr := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (affineChartBasicRingBack_restriction X U r) a
      change X.presheaf.map (eqToHom (U.2.fromSpec_image_basicOpen r).symm).op
        ((U.2.fromSpec.appIso (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r)).inv
          c) =
        X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le r)).op a at hr
      rw [hr]
      rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.affineBasicSection_denominator
statement:
theorem affineBasicSection_denominator [E.IsQuasicoherent]
    (r : Γ(X,U)) (y : Γ(E,X.basicOpen r)) :
    ∃ q : Γ(E,U.1) × Submonoid.powers r,
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le r)).op (q.2 : Γ(X,U)) • y =
        E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le r)).op q.1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q,hq⟩ := affineChartBasicSection_denominator X E U r y
  refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
  have hs := affineChartBasicSectionsIso_smul X E U r (q.2 : Γ(X,U))
    ((affineChartBasicSectionsIso X E U r).inv y)
  have hy := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (affineChartBasicSectionsIso X E U r).inv_hom_id y
  exact (congrArg (fun z => X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le r)).op
    (q.2 : Γ(X,U)) • z) hy).symm.trans (hs.symm.trans hq)

name: SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.affineCosectionImageIdeal_basicOpen
statement:
theorem affineCosectionImageIdeal_basicOpen [E.IsQuasicoherent] (r : Γ(X,U)) :
    (cosectionImageIdeal (affineCosection X E σ U)).map
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le r)).op).hom =
    cosectionImageIdeal (affineCosection X E σ (X.affineBasicOpen r))
proof:
:= by
  let τ : Γ(E,X.basicOpen r) →ₗ[Γ(X,X.basicOpen r)] Γ(X,X.basicOpen r) :=
    affineCosection X E σ (X.affineBasicOpen r)
  let φ := (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le r)).op).hom
  letI := U.2.isLocalization_basicOpen r
  have hn (x : Γ(E,U.1)) :
      affineCosection X E σ (X.affineBasicOpen r)
        (E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le r)).op x) =
      φ (affineCosection X E σ U x) :=
    PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply σ.val (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le r)).op x
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨x,rfl⟩ := ha
    exact ⟨E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le r)).op x, hn x⟩
  · intro a ha
    change a ∈ cosectionImageIdeal τ at ha
    obtain ⟨y,rfl⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨q,hq⟩ := affineBasicSection_denominator X E U r y
    have hu : IsUnit (φ (q.2 : Γ(X,U))) :=
      IsLocalization.map_units Γ(X,X.basicOpen r) q.2
    apply (Ideal.unit_mul_mem_iff_mem _ hu).mp
    have he : φ (q.2 : Γ(X,U)) * τ y =
        φ (affineCosection X E σ U q.1) := by
      calc
        _ = τ
          (φ (q.2 : Γ(X,U)) • y) :=
          ((τ).map_smul _ y).symm
        _ = _ := (congrArg (τ) hq).trans (hn q.1)
    change φ (q.2 : Γ(X,U)) * τ y ∈
      (cosectionImageIdeal (affineCosection X E σ U)).map φ
    rw [he]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ⟨q.1,rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GlueData.ι_fromRestrict
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem ι_fromRestrict (i : J') :
    (D.restrict ι).ι i ≫ D.fromRestrict ι = D.ι (ι i)
proof:
:=
  Multicoequalizer.π_desc _ _ _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GlueData.fromRestrict_injective
statement: theorem fromRestrict_injective : Function.Injective (D.fromRestrict ι)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  obtain ⟨i, x, rfl⟩ := (D.restrict ι).ι_jointly_surjective x
  obtain ⟨j, y, rfl⟩ := (D.restrict ι).ι_jointly_surjective y
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at h
  simp_rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_base] at h
  rw [ι_fromRestrict, ι_fromRestrict] at h
  rw [(D.restrict ι).ι_eq_iff]
  exact (D.ι_eq_iff _ _ x y).1 h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GlueData.isOpenMap_fromRestrict
statement: theorem isOpenMap_fromRestrict : IsOpenMap (D.fromRestrict ι)
proof:
:= by
  intro U hU
  rw [(D.restrict ι).isOpen_iff] at hU
  have : D.fromRestrict ι '' U =
      ⋃ i, D.ι (ι i) '' ((D.restrict ι).ι i ⁻¹' U) := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨i, y, rfl⟩ := (D.restrict ι).ι_jointly_surjective x
      refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i, y, hx, ?_⟩
      rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_base, ι_fromRestrict]; rfl
    · intro hz
      obtain ⟨i, y, hy, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hz
      refine ⟨(D.restrict ι).ι i y, hy, ?_⟩
      rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_base, ι_fromRestrict]; rfl
  rw [this]
  exact isOpen_iUnion fun i ↦ (D.ι (ι i)).isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap _ (hU i)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GlueData.isOpenEmbedding_fromRestrict
statement: theorem isOpenEmbedding_fromRestrict : Topology.IsOpenEmbedding (D.fromRestrict ι)
proof:
:=
  .of_continuous_injective_isOpenMap (by fun_prop) (D.fromRestrict_injective ι)
    (D.isOpenMap_fromRestrict ι)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GlueData.fromRestrict_surjective
statement:
theorem fromRestrict_surjective
    (hι : ∀ x : D.glued, ∃ i, x ∈ Set.range (D.ι (ι i))) :
    Function.Surjective (D.fromRestrict ι)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨i, y, rfl⟩ := hι x
  refine ⟨(D.restrict ι).ι i y, ?_⟩
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_base, ι_fromRestrict]; rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GlueData.isIso_fromRestrict
statement:

    (hι : ∀ x : D.glued, ∃ i, x ∈ Set.range (D.ι (ι i))) :

proof:
:= by
  have : Epi (D.fromRestrict ι).base := by
    rw [TopCat.epi_iff_surjective]; exact D.fromRestrict_surjective ι hι
  exact IsOpenImmersion.isIso _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.exists_inl_of_union
statement:
theorem exists_inl_of_union (C C' : AffineFrameCover X E) (x : (C.union C').scheme) :
    ∃ i, x ∈ Set.range ((C.union C').glueData.ι (Sum.inl i))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, y, rfl⟩ := (C.union C').glueData.ι_jointly_surjective x
  have hb : (C.union C').chartToAmbient k y ∈ (⊤ : X.Opens) := trivial
  rw [← C.covers, Opens.mem_iSup] at hb
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hb
  have hy : y ∈ Set.range ((C.union C').overlapToChart k (Sum.inl i)) := by
    rw [IsOpenImmersion.range_pullbackFst, Scheme.opensRange_homOfLE]
    show ((C.union C').U k).ι ((C.union C').chartToBase k y) ∈
      (C.union C').U k ⊓ (C.union C').U (Sum.inl i)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact ((C.union C').chartToBase k y).2
    · rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_base,
        chartToBase_comp_openImmersion]
      exact hi
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hy
  refine ⟨i, ((C.union C').transition k (Sum.inl i) ≫
    (C.union C').overlapToChart (Sum.inl i) k) v, ?_⟩
  have := (C.union C').glueData.glue_condition k (Sum.inl i)
  exact congrArg (fun g : (C.union C').glueData.V (k, Sum.inl i) ⟶ (C.union C').glueData.glued ↦
    g.base v) this

proof:

  obtain ⟨k, y, rfl⟩ := (C.union C').glueData.ι_jointly_surjective x
  have hb : (C.union C').chartToAmbient k y ∈ (⊤ : X.Opens) := trivial
  rw [← C'.covers, Opens.mem_iSup] at hb
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hb
  have hy : y ∈ Set.range ((C.union C').overlapToChart k (Sum.inr i)) := by
    rw [IsOpenImmersion.range_pullbackFst, Scheme.opensRange_homOfLE]
    show ((C.union C').U k).ι ((C.union C').chartToBase k y) ∈
      (C.union C').U k ⊓ (C.union C').U (Sum.inr i)

    · exact ((C.union C').chartToBase k y).2
    · rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_base,
        chartToBase_comp_openImmersion]
      exact hi
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hy
  refine ⟨i, ((C.union C').transition k (Sum.inr i) ≫
    (C.union C').overlapToChart (Sum.inr i) k) v, ?_⟩
  have := (C.union C').glueData.glue_condition k (Sum.inr i)
  exact congrArg (fun g : (C.union C').glueData.V (k, Sum.inr i) ⟶ (C.union C').glueData.glued ↦
    g.base v) this

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.isoOfCovers_twist
statement:
theorem isoOfCovers_twist (C C' : AffineFrameCover X E) (h : UnionTwistCompat C C') :
    Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (isoOfCovers C C').hom).obj
      (C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) ≅ C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨hL⟩, ⟨hR⟩⟩ := h
  exact ⟨pullbackTransIso _ _ _ ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (isoUnionLeft C C').hom).mapIso
      (pullbackInvIso (isoUnionRight C C') hR) ≪≫ hL⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.projBundle_iso_of_iso_of
statement:
theorem projBundle_iso_of_iso_of
    (hb : ∀ {E : X.Modules} (C C' : AffineFrameCover X E), UnionTwistCompat C C')
    (hc : TransportStatement X)
    {E E' : X.Modules} (hEE' : Nonempty (E ≅ E'))
    (C : AffineFrameCover X E) (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') :
    ∃ φ : C.scheme ≅ C'.scheme, φ.hom ≫ C'.toBase = C.toBase ∧
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback φ.hom).obj (C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) ≅
        C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := hEE'
  obtain ⟨C'', φc, hφc, ⟨hOc⟩⟩ := hc e C'
  obtain ⟨hOa⟩ := isoOfCovers_twist C C'' (hb C C'')
  refine ⟨isoOfCovers C C'' ≪≫ φc, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc, hφc, isoOfCovers_toBase]
  · exact ⟨pullbackTransIso _ _ _ ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (isoOfCovers C C'').hom).mapIso hOc ≪≫ hOa⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F25.gZ_comp
statement: theorem gZ_comp (U : Scheme.{u}) : gZ U ≫ terminal.from (Yr RZ.{u}) = terminal.from U
proof:
:= by
  unfold gZ
  rw [Category.assoc, IsIso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F25.isPullback_Pj
statement:
theorem isPullback_Pj {e : ℕ} (eJ : J ≃ Fin (e + 1)) (C : AffineFrameCover U (FreeM U J)) :
    IsPullback (freeProj eJ (gZ U) C) C.toBase (terminal.from (space RZ.{u} e))
      (terminal.from U)
proof:
:= by
  have h := isPullback_free eJ (gZ U) C
  refine h.of_iso (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _)
    (asIso (terminal.from (Yr RZ.{u}))) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp
  · simp
  · simp only [asIso_hom, Iso.refl_hom, Category.id_comp]
    exact (terminal_from_space e).symm
  · simp only [asIso_hom, Iso.refl_hom, Category.id_comp]
    exact gZ_comp U

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F25.PjCoverIso_hom_π
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem PjCoverIso_hom_π {e : ℕ} (eJ : J ≃ Fin (e + 1)) (C : AffineFrameCover U (FreeM U J)) :
    (PjCoverIso eJ C).hom ≫ Pπ U e = C.toBase
proof:
:=
  (isPullback_Pj eJ C).flip.isoPullback_hom_fst

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F25.PjCoverIso_hom_σ
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem PjCoverIso_hom_σ {e : ℕ} (eJ : J ≃ Fin (e + 1)) (C : AffineFrameCover U (FreeM U J)) :
    (PjCoverIso eJ C).hom ≫ Pσ U e = freeProj eJ (gZ U) C
proof:
:=
  (isPullback_Pj eJ C).flip.isoPullback_hom_snd

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F25.PjCoverIso_inv_π
statement: theorem PjCoverIso_inv_π : (PjCoverIso eJ C).inv ≫ C.toBase = Pπ U e
proof:
:= by
  rw [← PjCoverIso_hom_π eJ C, ← Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.id_comp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F25.hasConstantRank_LPj
statement: theorem hasConstantRank_LPj : HasConstantRank (Pj U e) (LPj eJ C) 1
proof:
:=
  hasConstantRank_pullback _ _ _ 1 (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F25.totalCap_LPj_push_inv
statement:
theorem totalCap_LPj_push_inv :
    totalPush ops (PjCoverIso eJ C).inv ∘ₗ totalCap ops (LPj eJ C) (hasConstantRank_LPj eJ C) =
      xiCap ops C ∘ₗ totalPush ops (PjCoverIso eJ C).inv
proof:
:=
  cp.cap_push (PjCoverIso eJ C).inv _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F25.totalPush_hom_comp_inv
statement:
theorem totalPush_hom_comp_inv :
    totalPush ops (PjCoverIso eJ C).hom ∘ₗ totalPush ops (PjCoverIso eJ C).inv = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cp.push_comp, totalPush_congr ops (Iso.inv_hom_id (PjCoverIso eJ C)), totalPush_id]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F25.totalPush_inv_comp_hom
statement:
theorem totalPush_inv_comp_hom :
    totalPush ops (PjCoverIso eJ C).inv ∘ₗ totalPush ops (PjCoverIso eJ C).hom = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cp.push_comp, totalPush_congr ops (Iso.hom_inv_id (PjCoverIso eJ C)), totalPush_id]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F25.totalCap_LPj_eq
statement:
theorem totalCap_LPj_eq :
    totalCap ops (LPj eJ C) (hasConstantRank_LPj eJ C) =
      totalPush ops (PjCoverIso eJ C).hom ∘ₗ xiCap ops C ∘ₗ totalPush ops (PjCoverIso eJ C).inv
proof:
:= by
  calc totalCap ops (LPj eJ C) (hasConstantRank_LPj eJ C)
      = (totalPush ops (PjCoverIso eJ C).hom ∘ₗ totalPush ops (PjCoverIso eJ C).inv) ∘ₗ
          totalCap ops (LPj eJ C) (hasConstantRank_LPj eJ C) := by
        rw [totalPush_hom_comp_inv ops cp eJ C, LinearMap.id_comp]
    _ = _ := by
        rw [LinearMap.comp_assoc, totalCap_LPj_push_inv ops cp eJ C]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F25.totalPush_hom_pull
statement:
theorem totalPush_hom_pull [Flat C.toBase] (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = e + 1) (b : TotalChow U) :
    totalPush ops (PjCoverIso eJ C).hom
        (totalPull ops C.toBase e (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC) b) =
      totalPull ops (Pπ U e) e (Pπ_relDim k U e) b
proof:
:= by
  have hfg : PureRelDim ((PjCoverIso eJ C).hom ≫ Pπ U e) (e + 0) := by
    rw [PjCoverIso_hom_π]; exact cp.projBundle_relDim C hC
  have hpull : totalPull ops C.toBase e (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC) =
      totalPull ops (PjCoverIso eJ C).hom 0 (pureRelDim_of_iso (PjCoverIso eJ C)) ∘ₗ
        totalPull ops (Pπ U e) e (Pπ_relDim k U e) :=
    (totalPull_congr ops (PjCoverIso_hom_π eJ C).symm e (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC) hfg).trans
      (cp.pull_comp (PjCoverIso eJ C).hom (Pπ U e) 0 e (pureRelDim_of_iso (PjCoverIso eJ C))
        (Pπ_relDim k U e) hfg)
  rw [hpull, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun (totalPush_comp_totalPull_of_iso ops cp (PjCoverIso eJ C)) _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F25.hypIm_toBase
statement: theorem hypIm_toBase : hypIm eJ C eJ' C' ≫ C'.toBase = C.toBase
proof:
:= by
  unfold hypIm
  rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, PjCoverIso_inv_π, Pι_π, PjCoverIso_hom_π]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F25.hypIm_comp
statement: theorem hypIm_comp : (PjCoverIso eJ C).inv ≫ hypIm eJ C eJ' C' = Pι U e ≫ (PjCoverIso eJ' C').inv
proof:
:= by
  unfold hypIm
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F25.hstep_of_cover
statement:
theorem hstep_of_cover [Flat C.toBase] [Flat C'.toBase]
    (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = e + 1)
    (hC' : ∀ i, Nat.card (C'.basisIndex i) = e + 1 + 1)
    (hyp : ∀ b : TotalChow U,
      xiCap ops C' (totalPull ops C'.toBase (e + 1) (cp.projBundle_relDim C' hC') b) =
        totalPush ops (hypIm eJ C eJ' C')
          (totalPull ops C.toBase e (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC) b))
    (b : TotalChow U) :
    totalCap ops (LPj eJ' C') (hasConstantRank_LPj eJ' C')
        (totalPull ops (Pπ U (e + 1)) (e + 1) (Pπ_relDim k U (e + 1)) b) =
      totalPush ops (Pι U e) (totalPull ops (Pπ U e) e (Pπ_relDim k U e) b)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := totalPush_hom_pull ops cp eJ' C' hC' b
  have h2 := totalPush_hom_pull ops cp eJ C hC b
  have h3 : totalPush ops (PjCoverIso eJ' C').inv
      (totalPull ops (Pπ U (e + 1)) (e + 1) (Pπ_relDim k U (e + 1)) b) =
      totalPull ops C'.toBase (e + 1) (cp.projBundle_relDim C' hC') b := by
    rw [← h1]
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun (totalPush_inv_comp_hom ops cp eJ' C') _
  rw [totalCap_LPj_eq ops cp eJ' C', LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, h3, hyp b,
    ← LinearMap.comp_apply (totalPush ops (PjCoverIso eJ' C').hom) (totalPush ops (hypIm eJ C eJ' C')),
    ← cp.push_comp, ← h2, ← LinearMap.comp_apply (totalPush ops (Pι U e)),
    ← cp.push_comp]
  congr 1
  unfold hypIm
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F25.hι_of_twist
statement:
theorem hι_of_twist
    (hT : Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (hypIm eJ C eJ' C')).obj
      (C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) ≅ C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)) :
    Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Pι U e)).obj (LPj eJ' C') ≅ LPj eJ C)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ⟩ := hT
  let X' := C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1
  let i1 : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Pι U e)).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
      (PjCoverIso eJ' C').inv).obj X') ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Pι U e ≫ (PjCoverIso eJ' C').inv)).obj X' :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (Pι U e) (PjCoverIso eJ' C').inv).app X'
  let i2 : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Pι U e ≫ (PjCoverIso eJ' C').inv)).obj X' ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback ((PjCoverIso eJ C).inv ≫ hypIm eJ C eJ' C')).obj X' :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (hypIm_comp eJ C eJ' C').symm).app X'
  let i3 : (Scheme.Modules.pullback ((PjCoverIso eJ C).inv ≫ hypIm eJ C eJ' C')).obj X' ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (PjCoverIso eJ C).inv).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (hypIm eJ C eJ' C')).obj X') :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (PjCoverIso eJ C).inv (hypIm eJ C eJ' C')).app X').symm
  exact ⟨i1 ≪≫ i2 ≪≫ i3 ≪≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (PjCoverIso eJ C).inv).mapIso φ⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F25.m7s_pull_prime
statement:
theorem m7s_pull_prime {E : U.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover U E) {e n : ℕ} {v : U}
    (hv : height v = n) [Flat C.toBase] (hd : PureRelDim C.toBase e)
    (F : M7sFlag C e v) :
    ∃ h0 : height (F.w 0) = ((n + e : ℕ) : ℕ∞),
      ops.pull C.toBase e hd n ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v n hv) : DimChow U n)) =
        (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (F.w 0) (n + e) h0) :
          DimChow C.scheme (n + e))
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : height (F.w 0) = ((n + e : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [hd (F.w 0) (by rw [F.coeff_zero]; exact one_ne_zero), F.base 0, hv]
    push_cast; rfl
  refine ⟨h0, ?_⟩
  refine ops.pull_mk C.toBase e hd n _ _ ?_
  intro x
  rw [m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply, m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply]
  by_cases hx : x = F.w 0
  · subst hx
    rw [if_pos rfl, if_pos (F.base 0), F.coeff_zero]
    simp
  · rw [if_neg hx]
    by_cases hpx : C.toBase x = v
    · rw [if_pos hpx, one_mul]
      by_contra hc
      exact hx (F.coeff_unique x hpx (by exact_mod_cast Ne.symm hc))
    · rw [if_neg hpx, zero_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F25.isOver_of_toBase
statement: theorem isOver_of_toBase : j.IsOver (Spk k)
proof:
:=
  ⟨by
    change j ≫ C'.toBase ≫ U ↘ Spk k = C.toBase ≫ U ↘ Spk k
    rw [← Category.assoc, hj]⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.F25.hstep_mod_lower
statement:
theorem hstep_mod_lower {e n : ℕ} {v : U} (hv : height v = n)
    [Flat C.toBase] [Flat C'.toBase] (hd : PureRelDim C.toBase e)
    (hd' : PureRelDim C'.toBase (e + 1)) (F : M7sFlag C e v) (F' : M7sFlag C' (e + 1) v)
    (hw : F'.w 1 = j (F.w 0)) :
    letI
proof:
:= isOver_of_toBase (k := k) C C' j hj
    xiCap ops C' (totalPull ops C'.toBase (e + 1) hd'
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow U m) n ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
          (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v n hv) : DimChow U n)))) -
      totalPush ops j (totalPull ops C.toBase e hd
        (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow U m) n ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
          (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle v n hv) : DimChow U n)))) ∈
      m7sTotG C' {x | height (C'.toBase x) < n} n 0 := by
  letI := isOver_of_toBase (k := k) C C' j hj
  obtain ⟨h0, hp⟩ := m7s_pull_prime ops C hv hd F
  obtain ⟨h0', hp'⟩ := m7s_pull_prime ops C' hv hd' F'
  obtain ⟨h1', -⟩ := m7s_main ops C' hv F' h0' 1 e (by omega)
  have hcap := m7s_cap_step ops C' hv F' (t := 0) (s := e) (by omega) h0' h1'
  have hpush : ops.push j (n + e) ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
      (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (F.w 0) (n + e) h0) : DimChow C.scheme (n + e))) =
      (1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (F'.w 1) (n + e) h1') :
        DimChow C'.scheme (n + e)) := by
    refine ops.push_mk j (n + e) _ _ ?_
    ext y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ Set.range j
    · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hy
      have hD : properPushforward j (dimPrimeCycle (F.w 0) (n + e) h0).1 (j z) =
          (dimPrimeCycle (F.w 0) (n + e) h0).1 z :=
        pushforward_apply_closedImmersion j _ (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) z
      rw [hD, m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply, m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply, hw]
      simp only [j.isEmbedding.injective.eq_iff]
    · rw [properPushforward, pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range _ _ _ _ y hy,
        m7s_dimPrimeCycle_apply, if_neg]
      rintro rfl
      exact hy ⟨_, hw.symm⟩
  rw [totalPull, DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply, hp', totalPull,
    DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply, hp, totalPush, DirectSum.toModule_lof,
    LinearMap.comp_apply, hpush]
  have hxi : xiCap ops C' (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow C'.scheme m) (n + (e + 1))
      ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (F'.w 0) (n + (e + 1)) h0') :
        DimChow C'.scheme (n + (e + 1))))) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow C'.scheme m) (n + e)
        (ops.cap (C'.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (C'.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (n + e)
          ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk (dimPrimeCycle (F'.w 0) (n + (e + 1)) h0') :
            DimChow C'.scheme (n + (e + 1))))) := by
    rw [xiCap, totalCap, DirectSum.toModule_lof]
    rfl
  rw [hxi, ← map_sub]
  exact m7s_lof_mem_totG C' (by omega) hcap

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.asHomogeneousIdeal_lt_irrelevant
statement:
theorem asHomogeneousIdeal_lt_irrelevant (x : space k n) :
    x.asHomogeneousIdeal < HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading k n)
proof:
:= by
  refine lt_of_le_not_ge ?_ x.not_irrelevant_le
  intro p hp
  rw [HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_iff]
  have hp₀mem : (GradedRing.proj (grading k n) 0 p : Polynomial k n) ∈
      x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal :=
    (x.asHomogeneousIdeal.isHomogeneous.mem_iff.mp hp) 0
  by_contra hp₀
  let p₀ : grading k n 0 := DirectSum.decompose (grading k n) p 0
  have hp₀ne : p₀ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hp₀
    exact congrArg Subtype.val h
  let e := degreeZeroEquiv k n
  have he₀ : e p₀ ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hp₀ne (e.injective (h.trans e.map_zero.symm))
  have hunitC : IsUnit (MvPolynomial.C (e p₀) : Polynomial k n) :=
    (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr he₀).map MvPolynomial.C
  have hCp₀ : (MvPolynomial.C (e p₀) : Polynomial k n) = p₀ :=
    congrArg Subtype.val (e.left_inv p₀)
  have hp₀unit : IsUnit (p₀ : Polynomial k n) := hCp₀ ▸ hunitC
  exact x.isPrime.ne_top (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ hp₀mem hp₀unit)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.irrelevantIdeal_isPrime
statement:
theorem irrelevantIdeal_isPrime :
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading k n)).toIdeal.IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsDomain (grading k n 0) :=
    (degreeZeroEquiv k n).toMulEquiv.isDomain k
  have hker : RingHom.ker (GradedRing.projZeroRingHom (grading k n)) =
      RingHom.ker (GradedRing.projZeroRingHom' (grading k n)) := by
    ext p
    simp only [RingHom.mem_ker, GradedRing.projZeroRingHom_apply]
    exact ⟨fun h ↦ Subtype.ext h, fun h ↦ congrArg Subtype.val h⟩
  rw [HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_irrelevant, hker]
  exact RingHom.ker_isPrime _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.withBotToPrimeSpectrumDual_strictMono
statement:
theorem withBotToPrimeSpectrumDual_strictMono :
    StrictMono (withBotToPrimeSpectrumDual k n)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  induction a using WithBot.recBotCoe with
  | bot =>
      induction b using WithBot.recBotCoe with
      | bot => exact (lt_irrefl _ hab).elim
      | coe b =>
          change b.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal <
            (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading k n)).toIdeal
          exact asHomogeneousIdeal_lt_irrelevant k n b
  | coe a =>
      induction b using WithBot.recBotCoe with
      | bot => exact (not_lt_of_ge bot_le hab).elim
      | coe b =>
          change b.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal < a.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal
          have hab' : a < b := WithBot.coe_lt_coe.mp hab
          have hba : (show ProjectiveSpectrum (grading k n) from b) ≤
              (show ProjectiveSpectrum (grading k n) from a) :=
            (ProjectiveSpectrum.le_iff_mem_closure (grading k n) b a).mpr
              (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hab'.le).mem_closure
          exact (ProjectiveSpectrum.as_ideal_lt_as_ideal (grading k n) b a).mpr
            (lt_of_le_of_ne hba hab'.ne.symm)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.krullDimLE_space
statement: theorem krullDimLE_space : Order.KrullDimLE n (space k n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Order.krullDimLE_iff]
  have h := Order.krullDim_le_of_strictMono
    (withBotToPrimeSpectrumDual k n) (withBotToPrimeSpectrumDual_strictMono k n)
  rw [Order.krullDim_withBot, Order.krullDim_orderDual] at h
  rw [show Order.krullDim (PrimeSpectrum (Polynomial k n)) =
      ringKrullDim (Polynomial k n) by rfl,
    MvPolynomial.ringKrullDim_of_isNoetherianRing] at h
  rw [ringKrullDim_eq_zero_of_field] at h
  simpa only [zero_add, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one,
    ENat.WithBot.add_le_add_one_right_iff] using h

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.map_localizedIdeal_basicOpenSectionsEquiv
statement:
theorem map_localizedIdeal_basicOpenSectionsEquiv
    (U : X.affineOpens) (f : Γ(X, U.1)) :
    (localizedIdeal (I.ideal U) f).map
        (basicOpenSectionsEquiv U f).toRingHom =
      I.ideal (X.affineBasicOpen f)
proof:
:= by
  letI := U.2.isLocalization_basicOpen f
  rw [localizedIdeal, Ideal.map_map]
  have hring : (basicOpenSectionsEquiv U f).toRingHom.comp
      (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) (Localization.Away f)) =
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op).hom := by
    ext r
    exact (IsLocalization.algEquiv (Submonoid.powers f)
      (Localization.Away f) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f)).commutes r
  rw [hring]
  exact I.map_ideal_basicOpen U f

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.CommonBasicOpen.swap_affineOpen
statement:
theorem swap_affineOpen (c : CommonBasicOpen U V) :
    c.swap.affineOpen = c.affineOpen
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact c.basicOpen_eq.symm

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.CommonBasicOpen.isOpenCover
statement:
theorem isOpenCover (U V : X.affineOpens) :
    IsOpenCover (fun c : CommonBasicOpen U V ↦ c.inIntersection)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsOpenCover.mk
  refine top_le_iff.mp fun x _ ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨f, g, hfg, hxf⟩ :=
    exists_basicOpen_le_affine_inter U.2 V.2 x.1 x.2
  apply Opens.mem_iSup.mpr

  change (x.1 : X) ∈ X.basicOpen f

name: SchemeKTheory.TautKernelLambda.rec_of_series_eq
statement:
theorem rec_of_series_eq (d m : ℕ → A) (ℓ : A)
    (h : PowerSeries.mk d * (1 + C ℓ * X) = PowerSeries.mk m * (1 + X)) (a : ℕ) :
    d (a + 1) = m (a + 1) + m a - ℓ * d a
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : PowerSeries.mk d * (1 + C ℓ * X) =
      PowerSeries.mk d + C ℓ * (PowerSeries.mk d * X) := by ring
  have h2 : PowerSeries.mk m * (1 + X) = PowerSeries.mk m + PowerSeries.mk m * X := by ring
  rw [h1, h2] at h
  have := congrArg (PowerSeries.coeff (a + 1)) h
  simp only [map_add, coeff_C_mul, coeff_succ_mul_X, coeff_mk] at this
  linear_combination this

name: SchemeKTheory.TautKernelLambda.zero_of_series_eq
statement:
theorem zero_of_series_eq (d m : ℕ → A) (ℓ : A)
    (h : PowerSeries.mk d * (1 + C ℓ * X) = PowerSeries.mk m * (1 + X)) : d 0 = m 0
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (PowerSeries.coeff 0) h
  simpa [mul_add] using this

name: SchemeKTheory.TautKernelLambda.sum_alt_eq
statement:
theorem sum_alt_eq (d m : ℕ → A) (ℓ : A)
    (h : PowerSeries.mk d * (1 + C ℓ * X) = PowerSeries.mk m * (1 + X)) (r : ℕ) :
    ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), (-1 : A) ^ a * d a =
      ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), (-1 : A) ^ b * m b * ℓ ^ (r - b)
proof:
:= by
  have hrec := rec_of_series_eq d m ℓ h
  have h0 := zero_of_series_eq d m ℓ h
  set S : ℕ → A := fun r => ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), (-1 : A) ^ a * d a with hS
  have hSsucc : ∀ r, S (r + 1) = S r + (-1 : A) ^ (r + 1) * d (r + 1) := fun r =>
    Finset.sum_range_succ _ _
  have L1 : ∀ r, S (r + 1) = ℓ * S r + (-1 : A) ^ (r + 1) * m (r + 1) := by
    intro r
    induction r with
    | zero =>
      have h1 := hrec 0
      have e0 : S 0 = d 0 := by simp [hS]
      rw [hSsucc 0, e0, h1, h0]
      simp
      ring
    | succ r ih =>
      have e := hSsucc r
      rw [hSsucc (r + 1), hrec (r + 1), pow_succ (-1 : A) (r + 1)]
      linear_combination ih - ℓ * e
  have hF : ∀ r : ℕ, ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (r + 2), (-1 : A) ^ b * m b * ℓ ^ (r + 1 - b) =
      ℓ * ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), (-1 : A) ^ b * m b * ℓ ^ (r - b) +
        (-1 : A) ^ (r + 1) * m (r + 1) := by
    intro r
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.mul_sum]
    congr 1
    · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b hb => ?_
      have hb' : b ≤ r := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hb)
      rw [show r + 1 - b = (r - b) + 1 by omega, pow_succ]
      ring
    · simp
  induction r with
  | zero => simp [h0]
  | succ r ih =>
    rw [hF r, ← ih]
    exact L1 r

name: SchemeKTheory.TautKernelLambda.natDegree_prod_one_add_le'
statement:
theorem natDegree_prod_one_add_le' (m : Multiset A) :
    (m.map fun x => (1 + Polynomial.C x * Polynomial.X : Polynomial A)).prod.natDegree ≤ Multiset.card m
proof:
:= by
  refine (Polynomial.natDegree_multiset_prod_le _).trans ?_
  rw [Multiset.map_map]
  calc (m.map ((Polynomial.natDegree) ∘ fun x => (1 + Polynomial.C x * Polynomial.X : Polynomial A))).sum
      ≤ (m.map fun _ => 1).sum := by
        refine Multiset.sum_map_le_sum_map _ _ fun x _ => ?_
        simp only [Function.comp_apply]
        compute_degree
    _ = Multiset.card m := by simp

name: SchemeKTheory.TautKernelLambda.sum_alt_prod
statement:
theorem sum_alt_prod (s : Multiset A) (ℓ : A) :
    ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (Multiset.card s + 1),
        (-1 : A) ^ b * ((s.map fun x => (1 + Polynomial.C x * Polynomial.X : Polynomial A)).prod.coeff b) *
          ℓ ^ (Multiset.card s - b) = (s.map fun x => ℓ - x).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | cons a s ih =>
    set P : Polynomial A := (s.map fun x => (1 + Polynomial.C x * Polynomial.X : Polynomial A)).prod with hP
    have hdeg : P.natDegree ≤ Multiset.card s := natDegree_prod_one_add_le' s
    have hz : ∀ b, Multiset.card s < b → P.coeff b = 0 := fun b hb =>
      Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt hdeg hb)
    have hcons : ((a ::ₘ s).map fun x => (1 + Polynomial.C x * Polynomial.X : Polynomial A)).prod =
        P + Polynomial.C a * (Polynomial.X * P) := by
      rw [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons, hP]; ring
    rw [hcons, Multiset.card_cons, Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons, ← ih]
    set n := Multiset.card s with hn
    
    have hc0 : (P + Polynomial.C a * (Polynomial.X * P)).coeff 0 = P.coeff 0 := by simp
    have hcs : ∀ b, (P + Polynomial.C a * (Polynomial.X * P)).coeff (b + 1) = P.coeff (b + 1) + a * P.coeff b := by
      intro b; simp [Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, Polynomial.coeff_X_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ' _ (n + 1)]
    simp only [hcs, hc0]
    
    have hsplit : ∀ f : ℕ → A, ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), f b = ∑ b ∈ Finset.range n, f b + f n :=
      fun f => Finset.sum_range_succ f n
    have hT : ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (-1 : A) ^ b * P.coeff b * ℓ ^ (n - b) =
        ∑ b ∈ Finset.range n, (-1 : A) ^ (b + 1) * P.coeff (b + 1) * ℓ ^ (n - (b + 1)) +
          P.coeff 0 * ℓ ^ n := by
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ' _ n]
      simp
    have hsum1 : ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (-1 : A) ^ (b + 1) * (P.coeff (b + 1) + a * P.coeff b) * ℓ ^ (n + 1 - (b + 1)) =
        ℓ * ∑ b ∈ Finset.range n, (-1 : A) ^ (b + 1) * P.coeff (b + 1) * ℓ ^ (n - (b + 1)) +
          (-a) * ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (-1 : A) ^ b * P.coeff b * ℓ ^ (n - b) := by
      have e1 : ∀ b ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          (-1 : A) ^ (b + 1) * (P.coeff (b + 1) + a * P.coeff b) * ℓ ^ (n + 1 - (b + 1)) =
            (-1 : A) ^ (b + 1) * P.coeff (b + 1) * ℓ ^ (n - b) +
              (-a) * ((-1 : A) ^ b * P.coeff b * ℓ ^ (n - b)) := by
        intro b _
        rw [Nat.add_sub_add_right, pow_succ]
        ring
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl e1, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, hsplit]
      congr 1
      have hlast : (-1 : A) ^ (n + 1) * P.coeff (n + 1) * ℓ ^ (n - n) = 0 := by
        rw [hz (n + 1) (by omega)]; ring
      rw [hlast, add_zero, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b hb => ?_
      have hb' : b < n := Finset.mem_range.mp hb
      rw [show n - b = (n - (b + 1)) + 1 by omega, pow_succ]
      ring
    rw [hsum1]
    simp only [pow_zero, one_mul, Nat.sub_zero]
    linear_combination (-ℓ) * hT

name: SchemeKTheory.TautKernelLambda.taut_class_relation
statement:
theorem taut_class_relation :
    k0ClassOf C.scheme C.tautologicalKernel
        (C.hasConstantRank_tautologicalKernel hE).isFiniteLocallyFree +
      k0ClassOf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
        (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).isFiniteLocallyFree =
    k0ClassOf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj N)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase N r hN).isFiniteLocallyFree + 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := C.classOf_tautologicalKernel_add hE.isFiniteLocallyFree
  have hb : k0ClassOf X (N ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X) hE.isFiniteLocallyFree =
      k0ClassOf X N hN.isFiniteLocallyFree + 1 :=
    k0ClassOf_eq_add_of_shortExact X hN.isFiniteLocallyFree hE.isFiniteLocallyFree
      (hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf (Y := X)).isFiniteLocallyFree
      (f := biprod.inl) (g := biprod.snd) (by simp)
      ⟨(ShortComplex.Splitting.ofHasBinaryBiproduct N (tensorUnitSheaf X)).exact⟩
  rw [hb, map_add, map_one, pullbackK0RingHom_classOf] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeKTheory.TautKernelLambda.lambdaSeries_taut_mul
statement:
theorem lambdaSeries_taut_mul :
    lambdaSeries C.scheme C.tautologicalKernel
        (C.hasConstantRank_tautologicalKernel hE).isFiniteLocallyFree *
      (1 + PowerSeries.C (k0ClassOf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
        (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).isFiniteLocallyFree) * PowerSeries.X) =
    lambdaSeries C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj N)
        (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase N r hN).isFiniteLocallyFree *
      (1 + PowerSeries.X)
proof:
:= by
  have hrel := taut_class_relation C hN hE
  have h := congrArg (fun x : K0 C.scheme =>
    ((Additive.toMul (lambdaT C.scheme x) : (PowerSeries (K0 C.scheme))ˣ) :
      PowerSeries (K0 C.scheme))) hrel
  simp only [map_add, toMul_add, Units.val_mul] at h
  rw [one_eq_classOf_tensorUnitSheaf (Y := C.scheme)] at h
  simp only [lambdaT_classOf, toMul_ofMul, coe_lambdaSeriesUnit] at h
  rw [lambdaSeries_rankOne _ _ (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1),
    lambdaSeries_rankOne _ _ (hasConstantRank_tensorUnitSheaf (Y := C.scheme)),
    ← one_eq_classOf_tensorUnitSheaf (Y := C.scheme), map_one, one_mul] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeKTheory.TautKernelLambda.lambdaMinusOne_taut_eq
statement:
theorem lambdaMinusOne_taut_eq :
    lambdaMinusOne C.tautologicalKernel (C.hasConstantRank_tautologicalKernel hE) =
      ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (r + 1),
        (-1 : K0 C.scheme) ^ b *
          lambdaClass C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj N)
            (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase N r hN).isFiniteLocallyFree b *
          (k0ClassOf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
            (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).isFiniteLocallyFree) ^ (r - b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lambdaMinusOne_eq_sum]
  exact sum_alt_eq _ _ _ (lambdaSeries_taut_mul C hN hE) r

name: SchemeKTheory.TautKernelLambda.lambdaMinusOne_taut_of_lineFilt
statement:
theorem lambdaMinusOne_taut_of_lineFilt {m : Multiset (K0 C.scheme)}
    (hF : ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.LineFilt C.scheme
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj N) m) (hm : Multiset.card m = r) :
    lambdaMinusOne C.tautologicalKernel (C.hasConstantRank_tautologicalKernel hE) =
      (m.map fun x =>
        k0ClassOf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
          (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).isFiniteLocallyFree - x).prod
proof:
:= by
  rw [lambdaMinusOne_taut_eq C hN hE]
  set P : Polynomial (K0 C.scheme) :=
    (m.map fun x => (1 + Polynomial.C x * Polynomial.X : Polynomial (K0 C.scheme))).prod with hP
  have hser : lambdaSeries C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj N)
      (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase N r hN).isFiniteLocallyFree =
      (P : PowerSeries (K0 C.scheme)) := by
    rw [ChowZeroSectionKoszulCIIL1B.lambdaSeries_of_lineFilt hF, hP]
    have := map_multiset_prod (Polynomial.coeToPowerSeries.ringHom (R := K0 C.scheme))
      (m.map fun x => (1 + Polynomial.C x * Polynomial.X : Polynomial (K0 C.scheme)))
    rw [Multiset.map_map] at this
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, map_add, map_one, map_mul,
      Polynomial.coeToPowerSeries.ringHom_apply, Polynomial.coe_C, Polynomial.coe_X] at this
    exact this.symm
  have hcoeff : ∀ n, lambdaClass C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj N)
      (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase N r hN).isFiniteLocallyFree n = P.coeff n :=
    fun n => by rw [← coeff_lambdaSeries, hser, Polynomial.coeff_coe]
  have := sum_alt_prod m (k0ClassOf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).isFiniteLocallyFree)
  rw [hm] at this
  have h2 : ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (r + 1),
      (-1 : K0 C.scheme) ^ b *
        lambdaClass C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj N)
          (hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase N r hN).isFiniteLocallyFree b *
        (k0ClassOf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
          (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).isFiniteLocallyFree) ^ (r - b) =
      ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), (-1 : K0 C.scheme) ^ b * P.coeff b *
        (k0ClassOf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
          (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).isFiniteLocallyFree) ^ (r - b) :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => by rw [hcoeff]
  refine h2.trans ?_
  convert this using 1
  refine congrArg Multiset.prod (Multiset.map_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_)
  refine (sub_eq_add_neg (G := K0 C.scheme) _ _).trans ?_
  exact (@sub_eq_add_neg (K0 C.scheme)
    (instCommRingK0 C.scheme).toAddGroupWithOne.toAddGroup.toSubNegMonoid _ _).symm

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.bijective_k0ToG0_of_resolution
statement:
theorem bijective_k0ToG0_of_resolution {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (R : ResolutionRegularClosedF15.Resolution X) : Function.Bijective (k0ToG0 X)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro a b hab
    have h1 := DFunLike.congr_fun R.left a
    have h2 := DFunLike.congr_fun R.left b
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.id_apply] at h1 h2
    rw [← h1, ← h2, hab]
  · intro g
    refine ⟨R.res g, ?_⟩
    have h := DFunLike.congr_fun R.right g
    simpa only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.id_apply] using h

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.hbcA_pencil_of_resolution
statement:
theorem hbcA_pencil_of_resolution (Y : Scheme.{u}) (J : Y.IdealSheafData) (k : Type u) [CommRing k]
    (φk : k →+* Γ(Y, ⊤)) [IsIntegral Y] [IsIntegral J.subscheme] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian (totalGlobal Y J)]
    (R : ResolutionRegularClosedF15.Resolution (totalGlobal Y J))
    (x : K0 J.subscheme) (y : K0 (totalGlobal Y J))
    (hy : k0ToG0 (totalGlobal Y J) y = finitePushforward (subschemeTotalGlobalι Y J)
      (flatPullbackG0 (totalToClosedBase Y J) (k0ToG0 J.subscheme x))) :
    k0ToG0 Y (pullbackK0 (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk 1) y) =
      finitePushforward J.subschemeι (k0ToG0 J.subscheme x)
proof:
:=
  hbcA_pencil Y J k φk (bijective_k0ToG0_of_resolution R) x y hy

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4A.twist_shortExact

theorem twist_shortExact {A B D : X.Modules} (a : A ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ D) (w : a ≫ b = 0)
    (h : (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact) (M : X.Modules) (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree X M) :
    ∃ w' : (tensorSheafRightFunctor X M).map a ≫ (tensorSheafRightFunctor X M).map b = 0,

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4A.chOpOn_rankZero
statement:
theorem chOpOn_rankZero {E : X.Modules} (hE : HasConstantRank X E 0) (n : ℕ) :
    chOpOn ops cp hP X E n = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [chOpOn_eq hE, chOfChern_eq_chG]
  have hc : constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X E = fun i ↦ if i = 0 then 1 else 0 :=
    funext (cOp_rank_zero ops cp hP hE)
  rw [hc]
  cases n with
  | zero => simp [chG]
  | succ m =>
    have h0 : (PowerSeries.mk fun n : ℕ ↦
        ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) • (if n + 1 = 0 then (1 : Module.End ℚ (TotalChow X)) else 0)) = 0 := by
      ext n
      rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mk, if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero n), smul_zero, map_zero]
    simp only [chG, psumG, h0, zero_mul, map_zero, smul_zero]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4A.chTot_pull
statement:
theorem chTot_pull (hW : WhitneyConstRankOn ops cp hP) {Y : Scheme.{u}} [Y.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian Y] [Fact (Cl Y)] [Nonempty Y]
    (g : Y ⟶ X) [g.IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat g] (d : ℕ) (hd : PureRelDim g d) {E : X.Modules}
    {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) (v : TotalChow X) :
    totalPullOn ops g d hd (chTot ops cp hP E v) =
      chTot ops cp hP ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E) (totalPullOn ops g d hd v)
proof:
:= by
  have hE' := hasConstantRank_pullback Y g E r hE
  induction v using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of m z =>
    rw [← DirectSum.lof_eq_of ℚ]
    rw [chTot_lof_stable hW hE (N := m + d + 1) (by omega) z, map_sum,
      totalPullOn_lof, chTot_lof_stable hW hE' (N := m + d + 1) (by omega)]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ ↦ ?_
    have := LinearMap.congr_fun (chOpOn_flat (ops := ops) (cp := cp) (hP := hP) g d hd E hE n)
      (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun i ↦ RationalDimChow X i) m z)
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at this
    rw [this, totalPullOn_lof]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4A.chTot_tensor_lines
statement:
theorem chTot_tensor_lines {A M : X.Modules} (hA : HasConstantRank X A 1)
    (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1) :
    chTot ops cp hP (tensorSheaf X A M) = chTot ops cp hP M * chTot ops cp hP A
proof:
:= by
  have hAM := hasConstantRank_twist hA hM
  rw [chTot_line (ops := ops) (cp := cp) (hP := hP) _ hAM,
    chTot_line (ops := ops) (cp := cp) (hP := hP) _ hM,
    chTot_line (ops := ops) (cp := cp) (hP := hP) _ hA,
    totalCapOn_tensor (ops := ops) A M hA hM hAM, add_comm (totalCapOn ops A hA)]
  exact CIIL1E.gexp_add (lowSub_of_loweringSub (totalCapOn_mem_lowering ops M hM))
    (lowSub_of_loweringSub (totalCapOn_mem_lowering ops A hA)) (cp.cap_comm M A hM hA)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4A.hasConstantRank_tensorRight
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_tensorRight {W M : X.Modules} {r : ℕ} (hW : HasConstantRank X W r)
    (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1) :
    HasConstantRank X ((tensorSheafRightFunctor X M).obj W) r
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorRight_obj_eq]
  exact hasConstantRank_twist hW hM

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4A.chTot_tensor_lines'
statement:
theorem chTot_tensor_lines' {A M : X.Modules} (hA : HasConstantRank X A 1)
    (hM : HasConstantRank X M 1) :
    chTot ops cp hP ((tensorSheafRightFunctor X M).obj A) =
      chTot ops cp hP M * chTot ops cp hP A
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorRight_obj_eq]
  exact chTot_tensor_lines hA hM

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4A.chTot_twist_filt
statement:
theorem chTot_twist_filt (hW : WhitneyConstRankOn ops cp hP) {E : X.Modules} {e : ℕ}
    (S : ChowSplittingOn ops E e) (M : S.Y.Modules) (hM : HasConstantRank S.Y M 1) :
    ∀ i ≤ e, chTot ops cp hP ((tensorSheafRightFunctor S.Y M).obj (S.F i)) =
      chTot ops cp hP M * chTot ops cp hP (S.F i)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    intro _
    obtain ⟨e0⟩ := S.base
    rw [chTot_iso ((tensorSheafRightFunctor S.Y M).mapIso e0), chTot_iso e0]
    exact chTot_tensor_lines' (S.L_line 0) hM
  | succ i ih =>
    intro hi
    obtain ⟨a, b, w, h⟩ := S.step i (by omega)
    have hA := filtration_rank S i (by omega)
    have hD := S.L_line (i + 1)
    obtain ⟨w', h'⟩ := twist_shortExact a b w h M hM.isFiniteLocallyFree
    rw [chTot_additive hW _ _ w' h' (hasConstantRank_tensorRight hA hM)
        (hasConstantRank_tensorRight hD hM),
      chTot_additive hW a b w h hA hD, ih (by omega), chTot_tensor_lines' hD hM, mul_add]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4A.chTot_tensor_line
proof:
:= by
  have hEL := hasConstantRank_twist hE hL
  cases r with
  | zero => rw [chTot_rankZero hE, chTot_rankZero hEL, mul_zero]
  | succ e =>
    obtain ⟨S⟩ := exists_chowSplittingOn ops cp hP e E hE
    have hM := hasConstantRank_pullback S.Y S.q L 1 hL
    obtain ⟨φ⟩ := S.top
    have isoQ : (Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj (tensorSheaf X E L) ≅
        (tensorSheafRightFunctor S.Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj L)).obj (S.F e) := by
      haveI : IsIso (pullbackTensorSheafHom S.q E L) :=
        pullbackTensorSheafHom_isIso_of_isFiniteLocallyFree S.q E L hE.isFiniteLocallyFree
          hL.isFiniteLocallyFree
      exact asIso (pullbackTensorSheafHom S.q E L) ≪≫
        (tensorSheafRightFunctor S.Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback S.q).obj L)).mapIso φ.symm
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro α
    apply S.injective
    have h1 := chTot_pull (hP := hP) hW S.q S.d S.hd hEL α
    have h2 := chTot_pull (hP := hP) hW S.q S.d S.hd hL (chTot ops cp hP E α)
    have h3 := chTot_pull (hP := hP) hW S.q S.d S.hd hE α
    rw [h1, Module.End.mul_apply, h2, h3, chTot_iso isoQ,
      chTot_twist_filt hW S _ hM e le_rfl, chTot_iso φ]
    rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4A.chTot_commute
proof:
:= by
  rw [chTot_eq_tot, chTot_eq_tot,
    ← tot_mul (gser_ch (hP := hP) hW hE) (gser_ch (hP := hP) hW hF),
    ← tot_mul (gser_ch (hP := hP) hW hF) (gser_ch (hP := hP) hW hE)]
  congr 1
  refine PowerSeries.ext fun n ↦ ?_
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
  simp only [PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
  calc ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, chOpOn ops cp hP X E p.1 * chOpOn ops cp hP X F p.2
      = ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, chOpOn ops cp hP X F p.2 * chOpOn ops cp hP X E p.1 :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ ↦ chOpOn_comm hW hE hF p.1 p.2
    _ = ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, chOpOn ops cp hP X F p.1 * chOpOn ops cp hP X E p.2 :=
        Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_swap
          (f := fun p : ℕ × ℕ ↦ chOpOn ops cp hP X F p.1 * chOpOn ops cp hP X E p.2)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4A.chBundle_tensor_line
statement:
theorem chBundle_tensor_line (E L : W.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree W E)
    (hL : HasConstantRank W L 1) :
    chBundle k (closedPosV4 k) (tensorSheaf W E L) =
      chBundle k (closedPosV4 k) L * chBundle k (closedPosV4 k) E
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty W := CHEXACT.nonempty_of_fact k
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := CHEXACT.exists_rank k hE
  have hEL := hasConstantRank_twist hr hL
  rw [chBundle_eq_chTot (closedPosV4 k) hEL.isFiniteLocallyFree,
    chBundle_eq_chTot (closedPosV4 k) hL.isFiniteLocallyFree,
    chBundle_eq_chTot (closedPosV4 k) hE]
  exact chTot_tensor_line (whitney_projectiveIntegral (closedPosV4 k)) hr hL

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4A.chBundle_commute
statement:
theorem chBundle_commute (E F : W.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree W E)
    (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree W F) :
    Commute (chBundle k (closedPosV4 k) E) (chBundle k (closedPosV4 k) F)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty W := CHEXACT.nonempty_of_fact k
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := CHEXACT.exists_rank k hE
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := CHEXACT.exists_rank k hF
  rw [chBundle_eq_chTot (closedPosV4 k) hE, chBundle_eq_chTot (closedPosV4 k) hF]
  exact chTot_commute (whitney_projectiveIntegral (closedPosV4 k)) hr hs

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.aeval_coordinateLinearCombination
statement:
theorem aeval_coordinateLinearCombination {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {n : ℕ}
    (q : Fin (n + 1) → Polynomial R n) (v : CoordinateModule R n) :
    MvPolynomial.aeval q
        (Finsupp.linearCombination R (coordinate R n) v) =
      Finsupp.linearCombination R q v
proof:
:= by
  have h :
      (MvPolynomial.aeval q).toLinearMap.comp
          (Finsupp.linearCombination R (coordinate R n)) =
        Finsupp.linearCombination R q := by
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext'
    intro i
    apply LinearMap.ext_ring
    simp [coordinate]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h v

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.linearCombination_linearCoordinate
statement:
theorem linearCombination_linearCoordinate {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {n : ℕ}
    (g : CoordinateModule R n ≃ₗ[R] CoordinateModule R n) (v : CoordinateModule R n) :
    Finsupp.linearCombination R (linearCoordinate g) v =
      Finsupp.linearCombination R (coordinate R n) (g v)
proof:
:= by
  have h :
      Finsupp.linearCombination R (linearCoordinate g) =
        (Finsupp.linearCombination R (coordinate R n)).comp g.toLinearMap := by
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext'
    intro i
    apply LinearMap.ext_ring
    simp [linearCoordinate]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h v

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.linearCoordinate_refl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem linearCoordinate_refl {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    linearCoordinate (LinearEquiv.refl R (CoordinateModule R n)) i = coordinate R n i
proof:
:= by
  simp [linearCoordinate]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.linearCoordinate_trans
statement:
theorem linearCoordinate_trans {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {n : ℕ}
    (g h : CoordinateModule R n ≃ₗ[R] CoordinateModule R n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    MvPolynomial.aeval (linearCoordinate h) (linearCoordinate g i) =
      linearCoordinate (g.trans h) i
proof:
:= by
  change MvPolynomial.aeval (linearCoordinate h)
      (Finsupp.linearCombination R (coordinate R n) (g (Finsupp.single i 1))) =
    Finsupp.linearCombination R (coordinate R n)
      ((g.trans h) (Finsupp.single i 1))
  rw [aeval_coordinateLinearCombination, linearCombination_linearCoordinate]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.gradedLinearChange_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gradedLinearChange_apply {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {n : ℕ}
    (g : CoordinateModule R n ≃ₗ[R] CoordinateModule R n) (p : Polynomial R n) :
    gradedLinearChange g p = MvPolynomial.aeval (linearCoordinate g) p
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.gradedLinearChange_coordinate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gradedLinearChange_coordinate {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {n : ℕ}
    (g : CoordinateModule R n ≃ₗ[R] CoordinateModule R n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    gradedLinearChange g (coordinate R n i) = linearCoordinate g i
proof:
:= by
  simp [gradedLinearChange, coordinate]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.gradedLinearChange_comp
statement:
theorem gradedLinearChange_comp {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {n : ℕ}
    (g h : CoordinateModule R n ≃ₗ[R] CoordinateModule R n) :
    (gradedLinearChange h).comp (gradedLinearChange g) =
      gradedLinearChange (g.trans h)
proof:
:= by
  apply DFunLike.coe_injective
  funext p
  change MvPolynomial.aeval (linearCoordinate h)
      (MvPolynomial.aeval (linearCoordinate g) p) =
    MvPolynomial.aeval (linearCoordinate (g.trans h)) p
  rw [MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply]
  apply congr_arg (fun q : Fin (n + 1) → Polynomial R n => MvPolynomial.aeval q p)
  funext i
  exact linearCoordinate_trans g h i

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.gradedLinearChange_refl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gradedLinearChange_refl {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) :
    gradedLinearChange (LinearEquiv.refl R (CoordinateModule R n)) =
      GradedRingHom.id (grading R n)
proof:
:= by
  apply DFunLike.coe_injective
  funext p
  change MvPolynomial.aeval
      (linearCoordinate (LinearEquiv.refl R (CoordinateModule R n))) p = p
  have hcoord :
      linearCoordinate (LinearEquiv.refl R (CoordinateModule R n)) = coordinate R n := by
    funext i
    exact linearCoordinate_refl n i
  rw [hcoord]
  exact MvPolynomial.aeval_X_left_apply p

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.irrelevant_le_map_gradedLinearChange
statement:
theorem irrelevant_le_map_gradedLinearChange {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {n : ℕ}
    (g : CoordinateModule R n ≃ₗ[R] CoordinateModule R n) :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading R n) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading R n)).map (gradedLinearChange g)
proof:
:= by
  refine (HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_irrelevant_le (grading R n)).2 ?_
  intro d hd p hp
  have hpX : p ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range (MvPolynomial.X (R := R))) := by
    rw [show Set.range (MvPolynomial.X (R := R)) =
        MvPolynomial.X '' (Set.univ : Set (Fin (n + 1))) by simp]
    rw [MvPolynomial.mem_ideal_span_X_image]
    intro a ha
    have hdeg : a.degree = d := by
      rw [Finsupp.degree_eq_weight_one]
      exact hp (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp ha)
    have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
      intro ha0
      subst a
      simp at hdeg
      omega
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Finsupp.ne_iff.mp ha0
    exact ⟨i, Set.mem_univ _, hi⟩
  apply (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_) hpX
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  have himage :=
    Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (gradedLinearChange g)
      (HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem (grading R n) Nat.zero_lt_one
        (linearCoordinate_mem_degree_one g.symm i))
  have hcoordinate :
      gradedLinearChange g (linearCoordinate g.symm i) = coordinate R n i := by
    rw [gradedLinearChange_apply, linearCoordinate_trans,
      LinearEquiv.symm_trans_self, linearCoordinate_refl]
  rw [hcoordinate] at himage
  exact himage

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.preimage_coordinateOpen_linearChangeMap
statement:
theorem preimage_coordinateOpen_linearChangeMap {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {n : ℕ}
    (g : CoordinateModule R n ≃ₗ[R] CoordinateModule R n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    linearChangeMap g ⁻¹ᵁ coordinateOpen R n i =
      Proj.basicOpen (grading R n) (linearCoordinate g i)
proof:
:= by
  change Proj.map (gradedLinearChange g) (irrelevant_le_map_gradedLinearChange g) ⁻¹ᵁ
      Proj.basicOpen (grading R n) (coordinate R n i) =
    Proj.basicOpen (grading R n) (linearCoordinate g i)
  rw [Proj.map_preimage_basicOpen]
  congr 1
  exact gradedLinearChange_coordinate g i

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.linearChangeMap_comp
proof:

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.linearChangeMap_refl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem linearChangeMap_refl {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) :
    linearChangeMap (LinearEquiv.refl R (CoordinateModule R n)) = 𝟙 (space R n)
proof:
:= by
  let S := { f : grading R n →+*ᵍ grading R n //
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading R n) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading R n)).map f }
  let p : S := ⟨gradedLinearChange (LinearEquiv.refl R (CoordinateModule R n)),
    irrelevant_le_map_gradedLinearChange _⟩
  let q : S := ⟨GradedRingHom.id (grading R n), by simp⟩
  have hpq : p = q := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact gradedLinearChange_refl (R := R) n
  change Proj.map p.1 p.2 = 𝟙 (Proj (grading R n))
  calc
    _ = Proj.map q.1 q.2 := congrArg (fun t : S ↦ Proj.map t.1 t.2) hpq
    _ = _ := Proj.map_id

        (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) g)

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.AffineOverlapComparison.reesProjMap_comp_projIso_hom
statement:
theorem AffineOverlapComparison.reesProjMap_comp_projIso_hom
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] {K : Ideal R} {L : Ideal S}
    (c : AffineOverlapComparison K L) (a : S) :
    reesProjMap L a ≫ c.projIso.hom =
      (congrArg (localizedIdeal · a) c.map_ideal) ▸
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map
          ((gradedLocalizationMap (K.map c.sectionsEquiv.toRingHom) a).comp
            (gradedReesEquivHom c.sectionsEquiv K))
          (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp
            (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivHom c.sectionsEquiv K)
            (irrelevant_le_map_gradedLocalizationMap (K.map c.sectionsEquiv.toRingHom) a)) :
          AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading (localizedIdeal (K.map c.sectionsEquiv.toRingHom) a)) ⟶
            AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading K))
proof:
:= by
  rcases c with ⟨e, he⟩
  subst he
  unfold AffineOverlapComparison.projIso reesProjIsoOfRingEquiv reesProjMapOfRingEquiv reesProjMap
  rw [asIso_hom]
  exact (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map_comp (gradedReesEquivHom e K)
    (gradedLocalizationMap (K.map e.toRingHom) a)
    (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivHom e K)
    (irrelevant_le_map_gradedLocalizationMap (K.map e.toRingHom) a)).symm

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.AffineOverlapComparison.reesProjMap_comp_projIso_hom_comp_reesProjMap
statement:
theorem AffineOverlapComparison.reesProjMap_comp_projIso_hom_comp_reesProjMap
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (K : Ideal R) (f : R) {L : Ideal S}
    (c : AffineOverlapComparison (localizedIdeal K f) L) (a : S) :
    reesProjMap L a ≫ c.projIso.hom ≫ reesProjMap K f =
      c.map_ideal ▸
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map
          ((gradedLocalizationMap ((localizedIdeal K f).map c.sectionsEquiv.toRingHom) a).comp
            ((gradedReesEquivHom c.sectionsEquiv (localizedIdeal K f)).comp
              (gradedLocalizationMap K f)))
          (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp
            (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp
              (irrelevant_le_map_gradedLocalizationMap K f)
              (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivHom c.sectionsEquiv (localizedIdeal K f)))
            (irrelevant_le_map_gradedLocalizationMap
              ((localizedIdeal K f).map c.sectionsEquiv.toRingHom) a)) :
          AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading (localizedIdeal
              ((localizedIdeal K f).map c.sectionsEquiv.toRingHom) a)) ⟶
            AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading K))
proof:
:= by
  rcases c with ⟨e, he⟩
  subst he
  unfold AffineOverlapComparison.projIso reesProjIsoOfRingEquiv reesProjMapOfRingEquiv reesProjMap
  rw [asIso_hom]
  refine Eq.trans (congrArg (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map
      (gradedLocalizationMap ((localizedIdeal K f).map e.toRingHom) a)
      (irrelevant_le_map_gradedLocalizationMap ((localizedIdeal K f).map e.toRingHom) a) ≫ ·)
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map_comp (gradedLocalizationMap K f)
      (gradedReesEquivHom e (localizedIdeal K f))
      (irrelevant_le_map_gradedLocalizationMap K f)
      (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivHom e (localizedIdeal K f))).symm) ?_
  exact (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map_comp
    ((gradedReesEquivHom e (localizedIdeal K f)).comp (gradedLocalizationMap K f))
    (gradedLocalizationMap ((localizedIdeal K f).map e.toRingHom) a)
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp
      (irrelevant_le_map_gradedLocalizationMap K f)
      (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivHom e (localizedIdeal K f)))
    (irrelevant_le_map_gradedLocalizationMap ((localizedIdeal K f).map e.toRingHom) a)).symm

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.Proj_map_heq_of_pointwise_eq
statement:
theorem Proj_map_heq_of_pointwise_eq
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] {K : Ideal R} {J₁ J₂ : Ideal S} (hJ : J₁ = J₂)
    (φ₁ : grading K →+*ᵍ grading J₁) (φ₂ : grading K →+*ᵍ grading J₂)
    (hval : ∀ p : reesAlgebra K,
      ((φ₁ p : reesAlgebra J₁) : Polynomial S) = ((φ₂ p : reesAlgebra J₂) : Polynomial S))
    (proof1 : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading J₁) ≤
      HomogeneousIdeal.map φ₁ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading K)))
    (proof2 : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading J₂) ≤
      HomogeneousIdeal.map φ₂ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading K))) :
    HEq (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map φ₁ proof1) (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map φ₂ proof2)
proof:
:=
  ((heq_cast_hom (fun (J : Ideal S) ↦ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading J)) hJ
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map φ₁ proof1)).symm).trans
    (heq_of_eq (Proj_map_eq_of_pointwise_eq hJ φ₁ φ₂ hval proof1 proof2))

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.AffineOverlapComparison.heq_projIso_hom_comp_reesProjMap
statement:
theorem AffineOverlapComparison.heq_projIso_hom_comp_reesProjMap
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (K : Ideal R) (f : R) {L : Ideal S} (c : AffineOverlapComparison (localizedIdeal K f) L) :
    HEq (c.projIso.hom ≫ reesProjMap K f)
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map
        ((gradedReesEquivHom c.sectionsEquiv (localizedIdeal K f)).comp
          (gradedLocalizationMap K f))
        (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedLocalizationMap K f)
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivHom c.sectionsEquiv (localizedIdeal K f))))
proof:
:= by
  rcases c with ⟨e, he⟩
  subst he
  apply heq_of_eq
  unfold AffineOverlapComparison.projIso reesProjIsoOfRingEquiv reesProjMapOfRingEquiv reesProjMap
  rw [asIso_hom]
  exact (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map_comp (gradedLocalizationMap K f)
    (gradedReesEquivHom e (localizedIdeal K f))
    (irrelevant_le_map_gradedLocalizationMap K f)
    (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivHom e (localizedIdeal K f))).symm

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.AffineOverlapComparison.heq_reesProjMap_comp_projIso_hom_comp_reesProjMap
statement:
theorem AffineOverlapComparison.heq_reesProjMap_comp_projIso_hom_comp_reesProjMap
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (K : Ideal R) (f : R) {L : Ideal S} (c : AffineOverlapComparison (localizedIdeal K f) L)
    (a : S) :
    HEq (reesProjMap L a ≫ c.projIso.hom ≫ reesProjMap K f)
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map
        ((gradedLocalizationMap ((localizedIdeal K f).map c.sectionsEquiv.toRingHom) a).comp
          ((gradedReesEquivHom c.sectionsEquiv (localizedIdeal K f)).comp
            (gradedLocalizationMap K f)))
        (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp
          (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp
            (irrelevant_le_map_gradedLocalizationMap K f)
            (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivHom c.sectionsEquiv (localizedIdeal K f)))
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedLocalizationMap
            ((localizedIdeal K f).map c.sectionsEquiv.toRingHom) a)))
proof:
:= by
  rcases c with ⟨e, he⟩
  subst he
  apply heq_of_eq
  unfold AffineOverlapComparison.projIso reesProjIsoOfRingEquiv reesProjMapOfRingEquiv reesProjMap
  rw [asIso_hom]
  refine Eq.trans (congrArg (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map
      (gradedLocalizationMap ((localizedIdeal K f).map e.toRingHom) a)
      (irrelevant_le_map_gradedLocalizationMap ((localizedIdeal K f).map e.toRingHom) a) ≫ ·)
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map_comp (gradedLocalizationMap K f)
      (gradedReesEquivHom e (localizedIdeal K f))
      (irrelevant_le_map_gradedLocalizationMap K f)
      (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivHom e (localizedIdeal K f))).symm) ?_
  exact (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map_comp
    ((gradedReesEquivHom e (localizedIdeal K f)).comp (gradedLocalizationMap K f))
    (gradedLocalizationMap ((localizedIdeal K f).map e.toRingHom) a)
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp
      (irrelevant_le_map_gradedLocalizationMap K f)
      (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesEquivHom e (localizedIdeal K f)))
    (irrelevant_le_map_gradedLocalizationMap ((localizedIdeal K f).map e.toRingHom) a)).symm

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.algebraMap_basicOpen_eq
statement:
theorem algebraMap_basicOpen_eq (U : X.affineOpens) (f : Γ(X, U.1)) :
    algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) =
      (basicOpenSectionsEquiv U f).toRingHom.comp (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) (Localization.Away f))
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro r
  show algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) r =
    basicOpenSectionsEquiv U f (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) (Localization.Away f) r)
  rw [basicOpenSectionsEquiv_algebraMap]
  rfl

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenChartMap_mul_cocycle_pointwise
statement:
theorem basicOpenChartMap_mul_cocycle_pointwise (U : X.affineOpens) (f g : Γ(X, U.1))
    (p : reesAlgebra (I.ideal U)) :
    Polynomial.map (basicOpenComparisonMul I U f g).sectionsEquiv.toRingHom
        (Polynomial.map (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) (Localization.Away (f * g)))
          (p : Polynomial Γ(X, U.1))) =
      Polynomial.map (algebraMap Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) (Localization.Away
          (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) g)))
        (Polynomial.map (basicOpenComparison I U f).sectionsEquiv.toRingHom
          (Polynomial.map (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) (Localization.Away f))
            (p : Polynomial Γ(X, U.1))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Polynomial.map_map, Polynomial.map_map, Polynomial.map_map]
  congr 1
  letI := U.2.isLocalization_basicOpen f
  show (awayMulEquivOfIsLocalization f g).toRingHom.comp
      (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) (Localization.Away (f * g))) =
    ((algebraMap Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) (Localization.Away
          (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) g))).comp
        (basicOpenSectionsEquiv U f).toRingHom).comp
      (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) (Localization.Away f))
  rw [awayMulEquivOfIsLocalization_comp_algebraMap, algebraMap_basicOpen_eq, RingHom.comp_assoc]

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenChartMap_mul_cocycle_hJ
statement:
theorem basicOpenChartMap_mul_cocycle_hJ (U : X.affineOpens) (f g : Γ(X, U.1)) :
    (localizedIdeal (I.ideal U) (f * g)).map
        (basicOpenComparisonMul I U f g).sectionsEquiv.toRingHom =
      localizedIdeal ((localizedIdeal (I.ideal U) f).map
        (basicOpenComparison I U f).sectionsEquiv.toRingHom)
        (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) g)
proof:
:=
  (basicOpenComparisonMul I U f g).map_ideal.trans
    ((localizedIdeal_basicOpenComparisonMul I U f g).trans
      (congrArg (localizedIdeal · (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) g))
        (basicOpenComparison I U f).map_ideal).symm)

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.basicOpenChartMap_mul_cocycle
statement:
theorem basicOpenChartMap_mul_cocycle (U : X.affineOpens) (f g : Γ(X, U.1)) :
    HEq ((basicOpenComparisonMul I U f g).projIso.hom ≫ reesProjMap (I.ideal U) (f * g))
      (reesProjMap (I.ideal (X.affineBasicOpen f)) (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) g) ≫
        basicOpenChartMap I U f)
proof:
:=
  (AffineOverlapComparison.heq_projIso_hom_comp_reesProjMap (I.ideal U) (f * g)
      (basicOpenComparisonMul I U f g)).trans
    ((Proj_map_heq_of_pointwise_eq (basicOpenChartMap_mul_cocycle_hJ I U f g) _ _
        (basicOpenChartMap_mul_cocycle_pointwise I U f g) _ _).trans
      (AffineOverlapComparison.heq_reesProjMap_comp_projIso_hom_comp_reesProjMap
          (I.ideal U) f (basicOpenComparison I U f)
          (algebraMap Γ(X, U.1) Γ(X, X.basicOpen f) g)).symm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7s_pull_mem
statement:
theorem m7s_pull_mem (f : W ⟶ V) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [Flat f] (d : ℕ) (hd : PureRelDim f d)
    (n : ℕ) (c : RationalDimChow V n) :
    ops.pull f d hd n c ∈ m7sSuppSpan {x | height (f x) ≤ n} (n + d)
proof:
:= by
  induction c using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ ha hb
  | tmul q a =>
    have hq : q ⊗ₜ[ℤ] a = q • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] a) := by
      rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    rw [hq, map_smul]
    refine Submodule.smul_mem _ q ?_
    induction a using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H D =>
    let D' : dimensionCycles W (n + d) :=
      ⟨flatPullback f D.1, flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles f hd D.2⟩
    rw [ops.pull_mk f d hd n D D' (fun x ↦ rfl)]
    refine m7s_mem_suppSpan _ ?_
    intro x hx
    change D.1 (f x) * (flatPullbackCoeff f x : ℤ) ≠ 0 at hx
    change height (f x) ≤ n
    rw [D.2 (left_ne_zero_of_mul hx)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7s_lof_mem_tot
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (⟨m, hm⟩ : {m : ℕ // n + t ≤ m}) (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hc)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7s_tot_mono
statement: theorem m7s_tot_mono {n t t' : ℕ} (h : t ≤ t') : m7sTot C n t' ≤ m7sTot C n t
proof:
:=
  iSup_le fun m ↦ le_iSup_of_le (⟨m.1, by have := m.2; omega⟩ : {m : ℕ // n + t ≤ m}) le_rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7s_specClosed
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hxy
  have h : C.toBase y ≤ C.toBase x :=
    Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr (hxy.map C.toBase.continuous)
  exact (Order.height_mono h).trans hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7s_xi_mem_tot
statement:
theorem m7s_xi_mem_tot {n t : ℕ} {x : TotalChow C.scheme} (hx : x ∈ m7sTot C n (t + 1)) :
    xiCap ops C x ∈ m7sTot C n t
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : m7sTot C n (t + 1) ≤ (m7sTot C n t).comap (xiCap ops C) from h hx
  refine iSup_le fun m ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := m
  rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro c hc
  obtain ⟨m', rfl⟩ : ∃ m', m = m' + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
  simp only [Submodule.mem_comap]
  have hcap : xiCap ops C (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow C.scheme m) (m' + 1) c) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow C.scheme m) m'
        (ops.cap (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) m' c) := by
    rw [xiCap, totalCap, DirectSum.toModule_lof]
    rfl
  rw [hcap]
  exact m7s_lof_mem_tot C (by omega)
    (m7s_cap_mem ops _ _ m' _ (m7s_specClosed C n) hc)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7s_xi_pow_mem_tot
statement:
theorem m7s_xi_pow_mem_tot {n : ℕ} : ∀ (i t : ℕ) {x : TotalChow C.scheme},
    x ∈ m7sTot C n (t + i) → ((xiCap ops C) ^ i) x ∈ m7sTot C n t
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero => intro t x hx; simpa using hx
  | succ i ih =>
    intro t x hx
    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]
    exact m7s_xi_mem_tot ops C (ih (t + 1) (by rwa [show t + 1 + i = t + (i + 1) by omega]))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7s_push_tot_eq_zero
statement:
theorem m7s_push_tot_eq_zero {n : ℕ} {x : TotalChow C.scheme} (hx : x ∈ m7sTot C n 1) :
    totalPush ops C.toBase x = 0
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : m7sTot C n 1 ≤ LinearMap.ker (totalPush ops C.toBase) from h hx
  refine iSup_le fun m ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := m
  rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro c hc
  simp only [Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.mem_ker]
  rw [totalPush, DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    m7s_push_eq_zero' ops C.toBase m _ (fun x hx => hx.trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast hm)) hc, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.sandwich_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem sandwich_eq_zero_of_lt {e : ℕ} (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = e + 1) {j : ℕ}
    (hj : j < e) : sandwich ops C cp hC j = 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Flat C.toBase := C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos e))
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro c
  rw [LinearMap.zero_comp, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  change totalPush ops C.toBase (((xiCap ops C) ^ j)
    (totalPull ops C.toBase e (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC)
      (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) n c))) = 0
  have h1 : totalPull ops C.toBase e (cp.projBundle_relDim C hC)
      (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow X n) n c) ∈ m7sTot C n ((e - j) + j) := by
    rw [totalPull, DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply]
    exact m7s_lof_mem_tot C (by omega) (m7s_pull_mem ops C.toBase e _ n c)
  exact m7s_push_tot_eq_zero ops C
    (m7s_tot_mono C (by omega) (m7s_xi_pow_mem_tot ops C j (e - j) h1))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistPullHomAux_twistChosenTriplePullHom_comp_pullHom
statement:
theorem twistPullHomAux_twistChosenTriplePullHom_comp_pullHom
    (d : ℤ) (i j k : C.I)
    (l : (C.twistChosenTripleCocycleCover i j k).I₀) :
    Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
        (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
        (C.twistChosenTriplePullHomIJ
            (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d) i j k ≫
          C.twistChosenTriplePullHomJK
            (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d) i j k)
        ((C.twistChosenTripleCocycleCover i j k).f l)
        (C.twistChosenTripleLocalToChartI i j k l)
        (C.twistChosenTripleLocalToChartK i j k l)
        (C.twistChosenTripleLocalToChartI_eq i j k l).symm
        (C.twistChosenTripleLocalToChartK_eq i j k l).symm =
      Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
        (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
        (C.twistChosenTriplePullHomIK
          (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d) i j k)
        ((C.twistChosenTripleCocycleCover i j k).f l)
        (C.twistChosenTripleLocalToChartI i j k l)
        (C.twistChosenTripleLocalToChartK i j k l)
        (C.twistChosenTripleLocalToChartI_eq i j k l).symm
        (C.twistChosenTripleLocalToChartK_eq i j k l).symm
proof:
:= by
  rw [← twistPullHomAux_pullHom_comp
    (C.twistChosenPullback₃ i j k).p₁
    (C.twistChosenPullback₃ i j k).p₂
    (C.twistChosenPullback₃ i j k).p₃
    (C.twistChosenTriplePullHomIJ
      (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d) i j k)
    (C.twistChosenTriplePullHomJK
      (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d) i j k)
    ((C.twistChosenTripleCocycleCover i j k).f l)
    (C.twistChosenTripleLocalToChartI i j k l)
    (C.twistChosenTripleLocalToChartJ i j k l)
    (C.twistChosenTripleLocalToChartK i j k l)
    (C.twistChosenTripleLocalToChartI_eq i j k l).symm
    (C.twistChosenTripleLocalToChartJ_eq i j k l).symm
    (C.twistChosenTripleLocalToChartK_eq i j k l).symm]
  rw [C.twistChosenTriplePullHomIJ_pullHom d
      (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d) i j k l,
    C.twistChosenTriplePullHomJK_pullHom d
      (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d) i j k l,
    twistPullHomAux_twistChosenTripleLocalPullHom_comp C d i j k l,
    ← C.twistChosenTriplePullHomIK_pullHom d
      (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d) i j k l]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.map_three_eq_of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem map_three_eq_of_subsingleton
    {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D]
    [∀ A B : C, Subsingleton (A ⟶ B)]
    (F : C ⥤ D) {A B C' D' : C}
    (a : A ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ C') (c : C' ⟶ D') (d : A ⟶ D') :
    (F.map a ≫ F.map b) ≫ F.map c = F.map d
proof:
:= by
  rw [← F.map_comp, ← F.map_comp]
  exact congrArg F.map (Subsingleton.elim _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp_presheaf_map

        ((TopologicalSpace.Opens.map f.base).map

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.comp_preimage_image_eq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso_hom_app_app
statement:
theorem restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso_hom_app_app (f : T ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion f] (M : T.Modules) (U : T.Opens) :

      M.presheaf.map (eqToHom (f.preimage_image_eq U).symm).op

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrict_pushforwardComp_inv_comp_restrictFunctorComp
statement:
theorem restrict_pushforwardComp_inv_comp_restrictFunctorComp
    (f : T ⟶ Y) (k : Y ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion f] [IsOpenImmersion k]
    (M : T.Modules) :
    (restrictFunctor (f ≫ k)).map ((pushforwardComp f k).inv.app M) ≫
      (restrictFunctorComp f k).hom.app
        ((pushforward k).obj ((pushforward f).obj M)) =
    (restrictFunctorComp f k).hom.app
        ((pushforward k).obj ((pushforward f).obj M))
proof:
:= by
  ext U x
  rw [Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
    restrictFunctor_map_app]
  have hx := pushforwardComp_inv_app_apply f k M ((f ≫ k) ''ᵁ U) x
  exact congrArg (fun y => ((restrictFunctorComp f k).hom.app
    ((pushforward k).obj ((pushforward f).obj M))).app U y) hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictPushforwardAlongIso_counit
statement:
theorem restrictPushforwardAlongIso_counit (f : T ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    (k : Y ≅ Z) (M : T.Modules) :
    (restrictFunctor (f ≫ k.hom)).map
        ((pushforwardComp f k.hom).inv.app M) ≫
      (restrictPushforwardAlongIso f k ((pushforward f).obj M)).hom ≫
        (restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso f).hom.app M =
      (restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso (f ≫ k.hom)).hom.app M
proof:
:= by
  change (restrictFunctor (f ≫ k.hom)).map
        ((pushforwardComp f k.hom).inv.app M) ≫
      (restrictFunctorComp f k.hom).hom.app
        ((pushforward k.hom).obj ((pushforward f).obj M)) ≫
      (restrictFunctor f).map ((restrictAdjunction k.hom).counit.app ((pushforward f).obj M)) ≫
      (restrictAdjunction f).counit.app M =
      (restrictAdjunction (f ≫ k.hom)).counit.app M
  simp only [← Category.assoc]
  erw [restrict_pushforwardComp_inv_comp_restrictFunctorComp f k.hom M]
  apply Scheme.Modules.hom_ext
  intro U
  simp only [Hom.comp_app]
  erw [restrictFunctorComp_hom_app_app f k.hom
    ((pushforward k.hom).obj ((pushforward f).obj M)) (U := U)]
  erw [restrictFunctor_map_app f
    ((restrictAdjunction k.hom).counit.app ((pushforward f).obj M)) U]
  erw [restrictAdjunction_counit_app_app k.hom ((pushforward f).obj M) (f ''ᵁ U)]
  erw [restrictAdjunction_counit_app_app f M U]
  erw [restrictAdjunction_counit_app_app (f ≫ k.hom) M U]
  erw [pushforwardComp_presheaf_map f k.hom M]
  conv_lhs =>
    pattern (((pushforward f).obj M).presheaf.map _)
    rw [pushforward_obj_presheaf_map]
  exact map_three_eq_of_subsingleton M.presheaf _ _ _ _
