name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso_congr
statement:
theorem restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso_congr
    (f g : T ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion f] [IsOpenImmersion g]
    (h : f = g) (M : T.Modules) :
    (restrictFunctor f).map ((pushforwardCongr h).hom.app M) ≫
      (restrictFunctorCongr h).hom.app ((pushforward g).obj M) ≫
        (restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso g).hom.app M =
      (restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso f).hom.app M
proof:
:= by
  subst g
  simp only [pushforwardCongr_rfl, restrictFunctorCongr_rfl,
    Category.id_comp]
  cat_disch

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictPushforwardAlongIso_counit_congr
statement:
theorem restrictPushforwardAlongIso_counit_congr
    (f : T ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion f] (k : Y ≅ Z)
    (f' : T ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion f']
    [IsOpenImmersion (f ≫ k.hom)]
    (h : f' = f ≫ k.hom) (M : T.Modules) :
    (restrictFunctor f').map
        ((pushforwardCongr h).hom.app M ≫
          (pushforwardComp f k.hom).inv.app M) ≫
      (restrictFunctorCongr h).hom.app
          ((pushforward k.hom).obj ((pushforward f).obj M)) ≫
        (restrictPushforwardAlongIso f k ((pushforward f).obj M)).hom ≫
          (restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso f).hom.app M =
      (restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso f').hom.app M
proof:
:= by
  have hc := restrictPushforwardAlongIso_counit f k M
  have he := restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso_congr f' (f ≫ k.hom) h M
  have hn := (restrictFunctorCongr h).hom.naturality
    ((pushforwardComp f k.hom).inv.app M)
  have hn' :
      (restrictFunctor f').map ((pushforwardComp f k.hom).inv.app M) ≫
        (restrictFunctorCongr h).hom.app
          ((pushforward k.hom).obj ((pushforward f).obj M)) =
      (restrictFunctorCongr h).hom.app ((pushforward (f ≫ k.hom)).obj M) ≫
        (restrictFunctor (f ≫ k.hom)).map
          ((pushforwardComp f k.hom).inv.app M) := by
    exact hn
  have hstep := congrArg
    (fun t => (restrictFunctor f').map ((pushforwardCongr h).hom.app M) ≫ t ≫
      (restrictPushforwardAlongIso f k ((pushforward f).obj M)).hom ≫
      (restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso f).hom.app M) hn'
  have hstep2 := congrArg
    (fun t => (restrictFunctor f').map ((pushforwardCongr h).hom.app M) ≫
      (restrictFunctorCongr h).hom.app ((pushforward (f ≫ k.hom)).obj M) ≫ t) hc
  simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc] at hstep hstep2 he ⊢
  exact hstep.trans (hstep2.trans he)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.unionInl_chartTerm_counitSquare
statement:
theorem unionInl_chartTerm_counitSquare
    (C C' : AffineFrameCover X E) (d : ℤ) (i : C.I) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ((C.union C').chartι (Sum.inl i))).map
        (C.unionDescentInl_chartTermIso C' d i).hom ≫
      (C.unionInl_restrictPushedIso C' i
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.chartι i)).obj
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i))).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso (C.chartι i)).hom.app
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i) =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso
        ((C.union C').chartι (Sum.inl i))).hom.app
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)
proof:
:= by
  let hchart : IsOpenImmersion ((C.union C').chartι (Sum.inl i)) :=
    (C.union C').chartι_isOpenImmersion (Sum.inl i)
  let hcomp : IsOpenImmersion (C.chartι i ≫ (C.isoUnionLeft C').hom) :=
    (C.chartι_isoUnionLeft_hom C' i).symm ▸
      (C.union C').chartι_isOpenImmersion (Sum.inl i)
  change (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ((C.union C').chartι (Sum.inl i))).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (C.chartι_isoUnionLeft_hom C' i).symm).hom.app
            (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i) ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (C.chartι i)
            (C.isoUnionLeft C').hom).inv.app (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr
        (C.chartι_isoUnionLeft_hom C' i).symm).hom.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.isoUnionLeft C').hom).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.chartι i)).obj
              (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i))) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictPushforwardAlongIso (C.chartι i) (C.isoUnionLeft C')
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.chartι i)).obj
            (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i))).hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso (C.chartι i)).hom.app
            (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i) =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso
        ((C.union C').chartι (Sum.inl i))).hom.app
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)
  exact
    (@Scheme.Modules.restrictPushforwardAlongIso_counit_congr _ _ _
      (C.chartι i) (C.chartι_isOpenImmersion i)
      (C.isoUnionLeft C') ((C.union C').chartι (Sum.inl i)) hchart hcomp
      (C.chartι_isoUnionLeft_hom C' i).symm (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.unionDescentInl_restrictionProjection_square
statement:
theorem unionDescentInl_restrictionProjection_square
    (C C' : AffineFrameCover X E) (d : ℤ) (i : C.I) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ((C.union C').chartι (Sum.inl i))).map
        (C.unionDescentInl_descendedIso C' d).hom ≫
      (C.unionInl_restrictPushedIso C' i (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf d)).hom ≫
        C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionProjection d i =
      (C.unionDescentInl C' d).restrictionProjection i
proof:
:= by
  have hn := C.unionInl_restrictPushedIso_naturality C' i
    ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d
      (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d)).component i)
  change (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ((C.union C').chartι (Sum.inl i))).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.isoUnionLeft C').hom).map
        ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d
          (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d)).component i)) ≫
      (C.unionInl_restrictPushedIso C' i
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (C.chartι i)).obj
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i))).hom =
      (C.unionInl_restrictPushedIso C' i (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf d)).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι i)).map
          ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d
            (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d)).component i) at hn
  have hk := C.unionDescentInl_descendedIso_component_restrict C' d i
  have hc := C.unionInl_chartTerm_counitSquare C' d i
  change _ ≫ _ ≫
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι i)).map
      ((C.twistingSheafDescentData d
        (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d)).component i) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso (C.chartι i)).hom.app
        (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)) =
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ((C.union C').chartι (Sum.inl i))).map
      ((C.unionDescentInl C' d).component i) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso
        ((C.union C').chartι (Sum.inl i))).hom.app
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)
  rw [← reassoc_of% hn, reassoc_of% hk, hc]

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.frameHom_app_apply
statement:
lemma frameHom_app_apply {U : X.Opens} {I : Type u} (x : I → P.obj (op U)) (W : (Over U)ᵒᵖ)
    (l : I →₀ Γ(X, W.unop.left)) :
    ((frameHom P x).app W l : P.obj (op W.unop.left)) =
      frameMap P x W.unop.left (leOfHom W.unop.hom) l
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.over_mem_of_basicOpen
statement:
theorem over_mem_of_basicOpen {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U) {W : Over U} (S : Sieve W)
    (h : ∀ (g : Γ(X, U)) (hg : X.basicOpen g ≤ W.left),
      S.arrows (Over.homMk (homOfLE hg) : Over.mk (homOfLE hg ≫ W.hom) ⟶ W)) :
    S ∈ ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U) W
proof:
:= by
  rw [GrothendieckTopology.mem_over_iff, Opens.mem_grothendieckTopology]
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨g, hle, hyg⟩ := hU.exists_basicOpen_le (V := W.left) ⟨y, hy⟩ (leOfHom W.hom hy)
  exact ⟨_, homOfLE hle, (Sieve.overEquiv_iff S _).2 (h g hle), hyg⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.frameHom_bijective_basicOpen
statement:
theorem frameHom_bijective_basicOpen
    (hx : ∀ g : Γ(X, U), Function.Bijective (frameMap P x (X.basicOpen g) (X.basicOpen_le g)))
    (g : Γ(X, U)) (f : X.basicOpen g ⟶ U) :
    Function.Bijective ((frameHom P x).app (op (Over.mk f)))
proof:
:= by
  have h : ⇑((frameHom P x).app (op (Over.mk f))) =
      ⇑(frameMap P x (X.basicOpen g) (X.basicOpen_le g)) := by
    funext l
    exact frameHom_app_apply x _ l
  rw [h]
  exact hx g

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.frameHom_isLocallyInjective
statement:
theorem frameHom_isLocallyInjective (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (hx : ∀ g : Γ(X, U), Function.Bijective (frameMap P x (X.basicOpen g) (X.basicOpen_le g))) :
    Presheaf.IsLocallyInjective ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U)
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map (frameHom P x)) where
  equalizerSieve_mem {W} a b hab
proof:
:= by
    apply over_mem_of_basicOpen hU
    intro g hg
    apply (frameHom_bijective_basicOpen x hx g (homOfLE hg ≫ W.unop.hom)).1
    change (frameHom P x).app _ ((PresheafOfModules.freeObj _).map _ a) =
      (frameHom P x).app _ ((PresheafOfModules.freeObj _).map _ b)
    rw [PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply, PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply]
    exact congrArg _ hab

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.frameHom_isLocallySurjective
statement:
theorem frameHom_isLocallySurjective (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (hx : ∀ g : Γ(X, U), Function.Bijective (frameMap P x (X.basicOpen g) (X.basicOpen_le g))) :
    Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U)
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _).map (frameHom P x)) where
  imageSieve_mem {W} s
proof:
:= by
    apply over_mem_of_basicOpen hU
    intro g hg
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := (frameHom_bijective_basicOpen x hx g (homOfLE hg ≫ W.hom)).2
      (((SheafOfModules.restrictPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.ringCatSheaf U).obj
        P).map (Over.homMk (homOfLE hg) : Over.mk (homOfLE hg ≫ W.hom) ⟶ W).op s)
    exact ⟨t, ht⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.isIso_sheafify_frameHom
statement:
theorem isIso_sheafify_frameHom (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (hx : ∀ g : Γ(X, U), Function.Bijective (frameMap P x (X.basicOpen g) (X.basicOpen_le g))) :
    IsIso ((SheafOfModules.identitySheafificationOver (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      X.ringCatSheaf U).map (frameHom P x))
proof:
:= by
  letI := frameHom_isLocallyInjective x hU hx
  letI := frameHom_isLocallySurjective x hU hx
  change (MorphismProperty.isomorphisms _).inverseImage
    (PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)) (frameHom P x)
  rw [← PresheafOfModules.inverseImage_W_toPresheaf_eq_inverseImage_isomorphisms
    (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)]
  exact ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U).W_of_isLocallyBijective _

name: SchemeKTheory.Cotangent.hasConstantRank_of_localFrames
statement:
theorem hasConstantRank_of_localFrames (n : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ y : X, ∃ (U : X.Opens) (_ : IsAffineOpen U) (_ : y ∈ U)
      (x : ULift.{u} (Fin n) → P.obj (op U)),
      ∀ g : Γ(X, U), Function.Bijective (frameMap P x (X.basicOpen g) (X.basicOpen_le g))) :
    HasConstantRank X ((moduleSheafification X).obj P) n
proof:
:= by
  choose U hU hyU x hx using h
  let e : ∀ y : X, SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over (U y)) (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) ≅
      ((moduleSheafification X).obj P).over (U y) := fun y ↦
    (overIsoFree (x y) (hU y) (hx y)).symm
  refine ⟨{ I := X, X := U, coversTop := ?_
            generators := fun y ↦ SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.equivOfIso (e y)
              (SheafOfModules.free.generatingSections (ULift.{u} (Fin n))) }, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Opens.coversTop_iff]
    exact top_le_iff.mp fun y _ ↦ TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨y, hyU y⟩
  · constructor
    intro y
    infer_instance
  · constructor
    intro y
    haveI : (SheafOfModules.free.generatingSections (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over (U y))
        (ULift.{u} (Fin n))).IsFiniteType :=
      SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.IsFiniteType.mk
        (show Finite (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) from inferInstance)
    exact SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.equivOfIso_isFiniteType _ (e y)
  · intro y
    change Nat.card (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) = n
    simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.D34.exists_trivializingFrameCover
statement:
theorem exists_trivializingFrameCover (L E : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) :
    ∃ C₀ : AffineFrameCover X E,
      Nonempty (∀ i : C₀.I,
        SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over (C₀.U i)) PUnit ≅ L.over (C₀.U i))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨CL, hCL⟩ := exists_affineFrameCover_of_constantRank hL
  obtain ⟨CE⟩ := exists_affineFrameCover X E hE
  choose κ hsub heq using
    fun p : CE.I × CL.I ↦ Opens.isBasis_iff_cover.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens (CE.U p.1 ⊓ CL.U p.2)
  let U : (Σ p : CE.I × CL.I, κ p) → X.Opens := fun j ↦ j.2
  have hUE : ∀ j, U j ≤ CE.U j.1.1 := fun j ↦ by
    have : U j ≤ CE.U j.1.1 ⊓ CL.U j.1.2 := by
      dsimp only [U]
      rw [heq j.1]
      exact le_sSup j.2.2
    exact this.trans inf_le_left
  have hUL : ∀ j, U j ≤ CL.U j.1.2 := fun j ↦ by
    have : U j ≤ CE.U j.1.1 ⊓ CL.U j.1.2 := by
      dsimp only [U]
      rw [heq j.1]
      exact le_sSup j.2.2
    exact this.trans inf_le_right
  have hcov : IsOpenCover U := by
    rw [IsOpenCover, iSup_sigma]
    have h1 : ∀ p : CE.I × CL.I, (⨆ a : κ p, U ⟨p, a⟩) = CE.U p.1 ⊓ CL.U p.2 := fun p ↦ by
      dsimp only [U]
      rw [heq p, sSup_eq_iSup']
    have hE' : (⨆ i, CE.U i) = ⊤ := CE.covers
    have hL' : (⨆ k, CL.U k) = ⊤ := CL.covers
    calc (⨆ p : CE.I × CL.I, ⨆ a : κ p, U ⟨p, a⟩)
        = ⨆ p : CE.I × CL.I, CE.U p.1 ⊓ CL.U p.2 := iSup_congr h1
      _ = (⨆ i, CE.U i) ⊓ ⨆ k, CL.U k := iSup_inf_iSup.symm
      _ = ⊤ := by rw [hE', hL', top_inf_eq]
  refine ⟨
    { I := Σ p : CE.I × CL.I, κ p
      U := U
      covers := hcov
      isAffine := fun j ↦ hsub j.1 j.2.2
      basisIndex := fun j ↦ CE.basisIndex j.1.1
      basisIndex_finite := fun j ↦ CE.basisIndex_finite j.1.1
      frame := fun j ↦ CE.restrictedFrame j.1.1 (U j) (hUE j) }, ⟨fun j ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  have hc : Nat.card (CL.basisIndex j.1.2) = 1 := hCL j.1.2
  haveI : Unique (CL.basisIndex j.1.2) := (Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.mp hc).2 |>.some |> fun a ↦
    ⟨⟨a⟩, fun b ↦ (Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.mp hc).1.elim b a⟩
  exact ((SheafOfModules.freeFunctor (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over (U j))).mapIso
      (Equiv.toIso (Equiv.equivPUnit (CL.basisIndex j.1.2)).symm)) ≪≫
    CL.restrictedFrame j.1.2 (U j) (hUL j)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.D34.projBundleTwistIso
statement:
theorem projBundleTwistIso (L E : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1)
    (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E)
    (C : AffineFrameCover X E) (C' : AffineFrameCover X (tensorSheaf X L E)) :
    ∃ iso : C.scheme ≅ C'.scheme, iso.hom ≫ C'.toBase = C.toBase
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C₀, ⟨θ⟩⟩ := exists_trivializingFrameCover L E hL hE
  let T := lineTwistData L C₀ θ
  refine ⟨AffineFrameCover.isoOfCovers C C₀ ≪≫ T.schemeIso.symm ≪≫
    AffineFrameCover.isoOfCovers T.cover C', ?_⟩
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [AffineFrameCover.isoOfCovers_toBase, ← T.schemeIso_toBase, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc,
    AffineFrameCover.isoOfCovers_toBase]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.D34.exists_closedImmersion_into_free
statement:
theorem exists_closedImmersion_into_free {k : Type u} [Field k] (N : ℕ) {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (j : X ⟶ space k N) [IsClosedImmersion j] (E : X.Modules) (r : ℕ)
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) (C : AffineFrameCover X E) :
    ∃ (I : Type u) (_ : Fintype I) (C' : AffineFrameCover X (FreeM X I))
      (f : C.scheme ⟶ C'.scheme),
      IsClosedImmersion f ∧ f ≫ C'.toBase = C.toBase
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, I, hI, CD, C', f, hf, hfb⟩ :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D31.exists_closedImmersion_twist_into_free N j E r hE
  have hV : HasConstantRank X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (D : ℤ))) 1 :=
    hasConstantRank_pullback X j _ 1
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D14.hasConstantRank_twist (k := k) N (D : ℤ))
  obtain ⟨iso, hiso⟩ := projBundleTwistIso _ E hV hE.isFiniteLocallyFree C CD
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion (iso.hom ≫ f) := inferInstance
  exact ⟨I, hI, C', iso.hom ≫ f, inferInstance, by rw [Category.assoc, hfb, hiso]⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingK0Class_mul
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingK0Class_mul (d e : ℤ) :
    projectiveTwistingK0Class R n d *
        projectiveTwistingK0Class R n e =
      projectiveTwistingK0Class R n (d + e)
proof:
:= by
  let X := ProjectiveTwistSpace R n
  let D : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X M} :=
    ⟨projectiveTwistingSheaf R n d,
      projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n d⟩
  let E : {M : X.Modules // SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X M} :=
    ⟨projectiveTwistingSheaf R n e,
      projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n e⟩
  let hDE :=
    SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree X D.1 E.1 D.2 E.2
  have hmul := SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf_mul X D E
  have hiso :
      SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf X
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X D.1 E.1) hDE =
        SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf X
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n (d + e))
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n (d + e)) :=
    SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf_iso X hDE
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n (d + e))
      (projectiveTwistingTensorIso R n d e)
  change
    SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf X D.1 D.2 *
        SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf X E.1 E.2 =
      SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf X
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n (d + e))
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n (d + e))
  calc
    _ = SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf X
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X D.1 E.1) hDE := by
      change
        SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf X D.1 D.2 *
            SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf X E.1 E.2 =
          SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf X
            (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X D.1 E.1) hDE at hmul
      exact hmul
    _ = _ := hiso

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingK0Class_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem projectiveTwistingK0Class_zero :
    projectiveTwistingK0Class R n 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  let X := ProjectiveTwistSpace R n
  let h0 :=
    projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n 0
  let hOne :=
    SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree X
  change SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf X
      (projectiveTwistingSheaf R n 0) h0 = 1
  calc
    _ = SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf X
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X) hOne :=
      SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf_iso X h0 hOne
        (projectiveTwistingZeroIso R n)
    _ = 1 := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingK0ClassUnit_add

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistComparisonOpen_preimage
statement:
theorem twistComparisonOpen_preimage (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') {i j : C'.I}
    (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (overlapIso e C' i j).hom ⁻¹ᵁ C'.twistComparisonOpen i j c =
      (transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j (c.transport e C')
proof:
:= by
  let q := (overlapIso e C' i j).hom
  let f := (C'.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c
  let fC := ((transport e C').basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f (c.transport e C')
  let a := (componentIso e C' c).hom
  letI : IsOpenImmersion q := inferInstance
  have hcomp : a ≫ f = fC ≫ q := componentIso_hom_toOverlap e C' c
  have hr : f.opensRange = q ''ᵁ fC.opensRange := by
    calc
      f.opensRange = (a ≫ f).opensRange :=
        (Scheme.Hom.opensRange_comp_of_isIso a f).symm
      _ = (fC ≫ q).opensRange := opensRange_congr _ _ hcomp
      _ = q ''ᵁ fC.opensRange := Scheme.Hom.opensRange_comp fC q
  change q ⁻¹ᵁ f.opensRange = fC.opensRange
  rw [hr, Scheme.Hom.preimage_image_eq]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistComparisonOpen_image
statement:
theorem twistComparisonOpen_image (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') {i j : C'.I}
    (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (overlapIso e C' i j).hom ''ᵁ
        (transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j (c.transport e C') =
      C'.twistComparisonOpen i j c
proof:
:= by
  let q := (overlapIso e C' i j).hom
  have hpre := twistComparisonOpen_preimage e C' c
  calc
    q ''ᵁ (transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j (c.transport e C') =
      q ''ᵁ (q ⁻¹ᵁ C'.twistComparisonOpen i j c) := by
        exact congrArg (fun U ↦ q ''ᵁ U) hpre.symm
    _ = C'.twistComparisonOpen i j c := by
      rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf,
        Scheme.Hom.opensRange_of_isIso, top_inf_eq]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistComparisonOpenIso_hom_ι
statement:
theorem twistComparisonOpenIso_hom_ι (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') {i j : C'.I}
    (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (twistComparisonOpenIso e C' c).hom ≫
        (C'.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι =
      ((transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j (c.transport e C')).ι ≫
        (overlapIso e C' i j).hom
proof:
:= by
  unfold twistComparisonOpenIso
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom]
  let q := (overlapIso e C' i j).hom
  let U := (transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j (c.transport e C')
  have hV : q ''ᵁ U = C'.twistComparisonOpen i j c :=
    twistComparisonOpen_image e C' c
  change (q.isoImage U ≪≫
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun V : (C'.overlap i j).Opens ↦ V.toScheme) hV)).hom ≫
        (C'.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι = U.ι ≫ q
  rw [Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc, opensEqToIso_hom_ι hV]
  exact q.isoImage_hom_ι U

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistComparisonOpenIso_commonChart
statement:
theorem twistComparisonOpenIso_commonChart (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') {i j : C'.I}
    (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    (twistComparisonOpenIso e C' c).hom ≫
        (C'.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom =
      ((transport e C').commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j (c.transport e C')).hom ≫
        (commonChartIso e C' c).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono c.chartToLeft).1
  calc
    ((twistComparisonOpenIso e C' c).hom ≫
        (C'.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom) ≫ c.chartToLeft =
      (twistComparisonOpenIso e C' c).hom ≫
        ((C'.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι ≫ C'.overlapToChart i j) := by
          simpa only [Category.assoc] using
            congrArg (fun f ↦ (twistComparisonOpenIso e C' c).hom ≫ f)
              (C'.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver_hom_chartToLeft i j c)
    _ = (((transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j (c.transport e C')).ι ≫
          (overlapIso e C' i j).hom) ≫ C'.overlapToChart i j := by
            simpa only [Category.assoc] using
              congrArg (fun f ↦ f ≫ C'.overlapToChart i j)
                (twistComparisonOpenIso_hom_ι e C' c)
    _ = ((transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j (c.transport e C')).ι ≫
        ((transport e C').overlapToChart i j ≫ (chartIso e C' i).hom) := by
          simpa only [Category.assoc] using
            congrArg (fun f ↦
              ((transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j (c.transport e C')).ι ≫ f)
              (overlapIso_hom_toChart e C' i j)
    _ = ((transport e C').commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j
          (c.transport e C')).hom ≫
        ((c.transport e C').chartToLeft ≫ (chartIso e C' i).hom) := by
          simpa only [Category.assoc] using
            congrArg (fun f ↦ f ≫ (chartIso e C' i).hom)
              ((transport e C').commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver_hom_chartToLeft i j
                (c.transport e C')).symm
    _ = (((transport e C').commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j
          (c.transport e C')).hom ≫
        (commonChartIso e C' c).hom) ≫ c.chartToLeft := by
          simpa only [Category.assoc] using
            congrArg (fun f ↦
              ((transport e C').commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j
                (c.transport e C')).hom ≫ f)
              (chartIso_leftRestriction e C' c)

name: SchemeKTheory.SplitKernel.kernel_reduce
statement:
theorem kernel_reduce [HasKernels C] {P Q A B L : C}
    (g : P ⟶ Q) (σ : Q ⟶ P) (hσ : σ ≫ g = 𝟙 Q)
    (ιP : L ⟶ P) (πP : P ⟶ L) (eP : A ⟶ P) (pP : P ⟶ A)
    (hPtot : πP ≫ ιP + pP ≫ eP = 𝟙 P) (hep : eP ≫ pP = 𝟙 A) (hιp : ιP ≫ pP = 0)
    (ιQ : L ⟶ Q) (πQ : Q ⟶ L) (eQ : B ⟶ Q) (pQ : Q ⟶ B)
    (hQtot : πQ ≫ ιQ + pQ ≫ eQ = 𝟙 Q) (hepQ : eQ ≫ pQ = 𝟙 B) (heπQ : eQ ≫ πQ = 0)
    (v : L ⟶ L) (hv1 : ιP ≫ g ≫ πQ ≫ v = 𝟙 L) (hv2 : v ≫ ιP ≫ g ≫ πQ = 𝟙 L) :
    ∃ (g'' : A ⟶ B) (σ'' : B ⟶ A), σ'' ≫ g'' = 𝟙 B ∧ Nonempty (kernel g ≅ kernel g'')
proof:
:= by
  let j : A ⟶ P := eP - eP ≫ g ≫ πQ ≫ v ≫ ιP
  have hjh : j ≫ g ≫ πQ = 0 := by
    simp only [j, Preadditive.sub_comp, Category.assoc, hv2, Category.comp_id, sub_self]
  have hjp : j ≫ pP = 𝟙 A := by
    simp only [j, Preadditive.sub_comp, Category.assoc, hιp, comp_zero, hep, sub_zero]
  have hpe : pP ≫ eP = 𝟙 P - πP ≫ ιP := by
    rw [← hPtot]; abel
  have key : ∀ {T : C} (x : T ⟶ P), x ≫ g ≫ πQ = 0 → x ≫ pP ≫ j = x := by
    intro T x hx
    have h1 : x ≫ pP ≫ j = x ≫ (pP ≫ eP) - x ≫ (pP ≫ eP) ≫ g ≫ πQ ≫ v ≫ ιP := by
      simp only [j, Preadditive.comp_sub, Category.assoc]
    rw [h1, hpe]
    simp only [Preadditive.comp_sub, Preadditive.sub_comp, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp,
      Category.assoc, reassoc_of% hx, zero_comp, reassoc_of% hv1]
    abel
  refine ⟨j ≫ g ≫ pQ, eQ ≫ σ ≫ pP, ?_, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  · have hx : (eQ ≫ σ) ≫ g ≫ πQ = 0 := by
      simp only [Category.assoc, reassoc_of% hσ, heπQ]
    have := key (eQ ≫ σ) hx
    simp only [Category.assoc] at this
    simp only [Category.assoc, reassoc_of% this, reassoc_of% hσ, hepQ]
  · have hker : kernel.ι g ≫ g ≫ πQ = 0 := by
      rw [kernel.condition_assoc, zero_comp]
    have hk := key (kernel.ι g) hker
    have hlift1 : (kernel.ι g ≫ pP) ≫ j ≫ g ≫ pQ = 0 := by
      rw [Category.assoc, reassoc_of% hk, kernel.condition_assoc, zero_comp]
    have hlift2 : (kernel.ι (j ≫ g ≫ pQ) ≫ j) ≫ g = 0 := by
      have e1 : kernel.ι (j ≫ g ≫ pQ) ≫ j ≫ g ≫ pQ = 0 := kernel.condition _
      calc (kernel.ι (j ≫ g ≫ pQ) ≫ j) ≫ g
          = (kernel.ι (j ≫ g ≫ pQ) ≫ j ≫ g) ≫ (πQ ≫ ιQ + pQ ≫ eQ) := by
            rw [hQtot, Category.comp_id, Category.assoc]
        _ = 0 := by
            simp only [Preadditive.comp_add, Category.assoc, reassoc_of% hjh, zero_comp,
              reassoc_of% e1, comp_zero, add_zero]
    exact
      { hom := kernel.lift _ (kernel.ι g ≫ pP) hlift1
        inv := kernel.lift _ (kernel.ι (j ≫ g ≫ pQ) ≫ j) hlift2
        hom_inv_id := by
          ext
          simp only [Category.assoc, kernel.lift_ι, kernel.lift_ι_assoc, Category.id_comp, hk]
        inv_hom_id := by
          ext
          simp only [Category.assoc, kernel.lift_ι, kernel.lift_ι_assoc, Category.id_comp,
            hjp, Category.comp_id] }

name: SchemeKTheory.SplitKernel.complIncl_complProj
statement:
theorem complIncl_complProj (L : C) {n : ℕ} (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    complIncl L i ≫ complProj L i = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  ext m m'
  simp only [complIncl, complProj, biproduct.ι_desc_assoc, Category.assoc, biproduct.lift_π,
    Category.id_comp]
  by_cases h : m = m'
  · subst h; simp
  · rw [biproduct.ι_π_ne _ (fun e => h (Fin.succAbove_right_injective e).symm),
      biproduct.ι_π_ne _ (fun e => h e.symm)]

name: SchemeKTheory.SplitKernel.ι_complProj

name: SchemeKTheory.SplitKernel.π_ι_add_complProj_complIncl
statement:
theorem π_ι_add_complProj_complIncl (L : C) {n : ℕ} (i : Fin (n + 1)) :

proof:

    biproduct.ι (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => L) j) i).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.SplitKernel.kernel_step
statement:
theorem kernel_step [HasKernels C] (L : C) {r s : ℕ}
    (g : (⨁ fun _ : Fin (r + 1) => L) ⟶ (⨁ fun _ : Fin (s + 1) => L))
    (σ : (⨁ fun _ : Fin (s + 1) => L) ⟶ (⨁ fun _ : Fin (r + 1) => L)) (hσ : σ ≫ g = 𝟙 _)
    (i : Fin (r + 1))
    [IsIso (biproduct.ι (fun _ : Fin (r + 1) => L) i ≫ g ≫
      biproduct.π (fun _ : Fin (s + 1) => L) 0)] :
    ∃ (g'' : (⨁ fun _ : Fin r => L) ⟶ (⨁ fun _ : Fin s => L))
      (σ'' : (⨁ fun _ : Fin s => L) ⟶ (⨁ fun _ : Fin r => L)),
      σ'' ≫ g'' = 𝟙 _ ∧ Nonempty (kernel g ≅ kernel g'')
proof:
:= by
  refine kernel_reduce g σ hσ (biproduct.ι (fun _ : Fin (r + 1) => L) i)
    (biproduct.π (fun _ : Fin (r + 1) => L) i) (complIncl L i)
    (complProj L i) (π_ι_add_complProj_complIncl L i) (complIncl_complProj L i) (ι_complProj L i)
    (biproduct.ι (fun _ : Fin (s + 1) => L) 0) (biproduct.π (fun _ : Fin (s + 1) => L) 0)
    (complIncl L 0) (complProj L 0) (π_ι_add_complProj_complIncl L 0)
    (complIncl_complProj L 0) (complIncl_π L 0)
    (inv (biproduct.ι (fun _ : Fin (r + 1) => L) i ≫ g ≫
      biproduct.π (fun _ : Fin (s + 1) => L) 0)) ?_ ?_
  · simpa only [Category.assoc] using
      IsIso.hom_inv_id (biproduct.ι (fun _ : Fin (r + 1) => L) i ≫ g ≫
        biproduct.π (fun _ : Fin (s + 1) => L) 0)
  · exact IsIso.inv_hom_id _

name: SchemeKTheory.SplitKernel.app_eq_mul_endVal
statement:
theorem app_eq_mul_endVal (φ : unitModule Y ⟶ unitModule Y) (V : Y.Opens) (x : Γ(Y, V)) :
    (φ.app V x : Γ(Y, V)) = x * Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top : V ⟶ ⊤).op (endVal φ)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : φ.app V x = x • φ.app V (1 : Γ(Y, V)) := by
    rw [← Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul]
    congr 1
    exact (mul_one x).symm
  have h2 := congrArg (fun f => f (1 : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    (φ.mapPresheaf.naturality (homOfLE le_top : V ⟶ ⊤).op)
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.mapPresheaf_app] at h2
  rw [h1]
  change x * _ = _
  congr 1
  refine Eq.trans ?_ h2
  change _ = φ.app V (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top : V ⟶ ⊤).op 1)
  rw [map_one]

name: SchemeKTheory.SplitKernel.endVal_comp
statement:
theorem endVal_comp (φ ψ : unitModule Y ⟶ unitModule Y) :
    endVal (φ ≫ ψ) = endVal φ * endVal ψ
proof:
:= by
  have := app_eq_mul_endVal ψ ⊤ (endVal φ)
  change (ψ.app ⊤ (endVal φ) : Γ(Y, ⊤)) = _
  rw [this, show (homOfLE le_top : (⊤ : Y.Opens) ⟶ ⊤) = 𝟙 _ from rfl, op_id,
    Y.presheaf.map_id]
  rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.SplitKernel.endVal_id
statement: theorem endVal_id : endVal (𝟙 (unitModule Y)) = 1
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeKTheory.SplitKernel.isIso_app_of_le_basicOpen
statement:
theorem isIso_app_of_le_basicOpen (φ : unitModule Y ⟶ unitModule Y) (V : Y.Opens)
    (hV : V ≤ Y.basicOpen (endVal φ)) : IsIso (φ.app V)
proof:
:= by
  have hd := Y.toRingedSpace.isUnit_res_basicOpen (endVal φ)
  have hc : IsUnit (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top : V ⟶ ⊤).op (endVal φ)) := by
    have := hd.map (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op).hom
    have e : Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top : V ⟶ ⊤).op =
        Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (Y.basicOpen_le (endVal φ))).op ≫
          Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op := by
      rw [← Functor.map_comp]; rfl
    rw [e]
    exact this
  have happ := app_eq_mul_endVal φ V
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hc
  rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
  constructor
  · intro a b hab
    let a' : Γ(Y, V) := a
    let b' : Γ(Y, V) := b
    have h' : a' * (u : Γ(Y, V)) = b' * (u : Γ(Y, V)) := by
      rw [hu, ← happ, ← happ]; exact hab
    exact u.isUnit.mul_left_injective h'
  · intro b
    let b' : Γ(Y, V) := b
    let a' : Γ(Y, V) := b' * ↑u⁻¹
    refine ⟨a', ?_⟩
    have := happ a'
    refine this.trans ?_
    change b' * ↑u⁻¹ * _ = b'
    rw [← hu, mul_assoc, Units.inv_mul, mul_one]

name: SchemeKTheory.SplitKernel.exists_isIso_restrict_ι_comp
statement:
theorem exists_isIso_restrict_ι_comp (y : Y) {r : ℕ}
    (h : (⨁ fun _ : Fin r => unitModule Y) ⟶ unitModule Y)
    (τ : unitModule Y ⟶ ⨁ fun _ : Fin r => unitModule Y) (hτ : τ ≫ h = 𝟙 _) :
    ∃ (i : Fin r) (W : Y.Opens), y ∈ W ∧
      IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).map
        (biproduct.ι (fun _ : Fin r => unitModule Y) i ≫ h))
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : 𝟙 (unitModule Y) = ∑ j, (τ ≫ biproduct.π (fun _ : Fin r => unitModule Y) j) ≫
      (biproduct.ι (fun _ : Fin r => unitModule Y) j ≫ h) := by
    rw [← hτ]
    calc τ ≫ h = τ ≫ (∑ j, biproduct.π (fun _ : Fin r => unitModule Y) j ≫
          biproduct.ι (fun _ : Fin r => unitModule Y) j) ≫ h := by
          rw [biproduct.total, Category.id_comp]
      _ = _ := by simp only [Preadditive.sum_comp, Preadditive.comp_sum, Category.assoc]
  have hval : (1 : Γ(Y, ⊤)) = ∑ j, endVal (τ ≫ biproduct.π (fun _ : Fin r => unitModule Y) j) *
      endVal (biproduct.ι (fun _ : Fin r => unitModule Y) j ≫ h) := by
    have := congrArg endValHom hsum
    rw [map_sum] at this
    simpa only [endValHom, AddMonoidHom.coe_mk, ZeroHom.coe_mk, endVal_comp,
      endVal_id] using this
  let G := (Y.presheaf.germ ⊤ y trivial).hom
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ :
      ∃ i, IsUnit (G (endVal (biproduct.ι (fun _ : Fin r => unitModule Y) i ≫ h))) := by
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    have hmem : G 1 ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk y) := by
      rw [hval, map_sum]
      refine Ideal.sum_mem _ (fun j _ => ?_)
      rw [map_mul]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ ((IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).mpr (hcon j))
    rw [map_one] at hmem
    exact (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal _).ne_top ((Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).mpr hmem)
  refine ⟨i, Y.basicOpen (endVal (biproduct.ι (fun _ : Fin r => unitModule Y) i ≫ h)),
    (Y.mem_basicOpen_top _ y).mpr hi, ?_⟩
  rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.isIso_iff_isIso_app]
  intro U
  have hle : (Scheme.Opens.ι (Y.basicOpen (endVal (biproduct.ι (fun _ : Fin r => unitModule Y) i ≫
      h)))) ''ᵁ U ≤ Y.basicOpen (endVal (biproduct.ι (fun _ : Fin r => unitModule Y) i ≫ h)) := by
    simpa using (Scheme.Opens.ι _).image_le_opensRange U
  exact isIso_app_of_le_basicOpen (biproduct.ι (fun _ : Fin r => unitModule Y) i ≫ h) _ hle

name: SchemeKTheory.SplitKernel.exists_restrict_kernel_iso_biprod
statement:
theorem exists_restrict_kernel_iso_biprod (s : ℕ) : ∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (y : Y) (r : ℕ)
    (g : (⨁ fun _ : Fin r => unitModule Y) ⟶ (⨁ fun _ : Fin s => unitModule Y))
    (σ : (⨁ fun _ : Fin s => unitModule Y) ⟶ (⨁ fun _ : Fin r => unitModule Y)), σ ≫ g = 𝟙 _ →
    ∃ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (ι : Z ⟶ Y) (_ : IsOpenImmersion ι), y ∈ ι.opensRange ∧
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ι).obj (kernel g) ≅
        ⨁ fun _ : Fin (r - s) => unitModule Z)
proof:
:= by
  induction s with
  | zero =>
    intro Y y r g σ hσ
    have hg : g = 0 := by
      apply biproduct.hom_ext
      intro j
      exact j.elim0
    refine ⟨Y, 𝟙 Y, inferInstance, ⟨y, rfl⟩, ⟨?_⟩⟩
    exact Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorId.app _ ≪≫ kernelIsoOfEq hg ≪≫ kernelZeroIsoSource
  | succ s ih =>
    intro Y y r g σ hσ
    have hτ : (biproduct.ι (fun _ : Fin (s + 1) => unitModule Y) 0 ≫ σ) ≫
        (g ≫ biproduct.π (fun _ : Fin (s + 1) => unitModule Y) 0) = 𝟙 _ := by
      simp only [Category.assoc, reassoc_of% hσ, biproduct.ι_π_self]
    obtain ⟨i, W, hyW, hiso⟩ := exists_isIso_restrict_ι_comp y (g ≫ biproduct.π _ 0) _ hτ
    obtain ⟨r', rfl⟩ : ∃ r', r = r' + 1 := ⟨r - 1, by have := i.pos; omega⟩
    let F := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι
    let L := F.obj (unitModule Y)
    let eP := F.mapBiproduct (fun _ : Fin (r' + 1) => unitModule Y)
    let eQ := F.mapBiproduct (fun _ : Fin (s + 1) => unitModule Y)
    let g1 : (⨁ fun _ : Fin (r' + 1) => L) ⟶ (⨁ fun _ : Fin (s + 1) => L) :=
      eP.inv ≫ F.map g ≫ eQ.hom
    let σ1 : (⨁ fun _ : Fin (s + 1) => L) ⟶ (⨁ fun _ : Fin (r' + 1) => L) :=
      eQ.inv ≫ F.map σ ≫ eP.hom
    have hσ1 : σ1 ≫ g1 = 𝟙 _ := by
      simp only [σ1, g1, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
      rw [← F.map_comp_assoc, hσ, F.map_id, Category.id_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id]
    have hι : biproduct.ι (fun _ : Fin (r' + 1) => L) i ≫ g1 ≫
        biproduct.π (fun _ : Fin (s + 1) => L) 0 =
          F.map (biproduct.ι _ i ≫ g ≫ biproduct.π _ 0) := by
      simp only [g1, eP, eQ, Functor.mapBiproduct_inv, Functor.mapBiproduct_hom,
        biproduct.ι_desc_assoc, Category.assoc, Functor.map_comp]
      erw [biproduct.lift_π]
    haveI : IsIso (biproduct.ι (fun _ : Fin (r' + 1) => L) i ≫ g1 ≫
        biproduct.π (fun _ : Fin (s + 1) => L) 0) := by
      rw [hι]; exact hiso
    obtain ⟨g'', σ'', hσ'', ⟨eK⟩⟩ := kernel_step L g1 σ1 hσ1 i
    let u : L ≅ unitModule W := Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso W.ι
    let eA := biproduct.mapIso (fun _ : Fin r' => u)
    let eB := biproduct.mapIso (fun _ : Fin s => u)
    let g3 := eA.inv ≫ g'' ≫ eB.hom
    let σ3 := eB.inv ≫ σ'' ≫ eA.hom
    have hσ3 : σ3 ≫ g3 = 𝟙 _ := by
      simp only [σ3, g3, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, reassoc_of% hσ'',
        Iso.inv_hom_id]
    obtain ⟨Z, ι2, hι2, hy2, ⟨e2⟩⟩ := ih W ⟨y, hyW⟩ r' g3 σ3 hσ3
    rw [show r' + 1 - (s + 1) = r' - s by omega]
    refine ⟨Z, ι2 ≫ W.ι, inferInstance, ?_, ⟨?_⟩⟩
    · obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hy2
      exact ⟨z, by simp [hz]⟩
    · let eW : F.obj (kernel g) ≅ kernel g3 :=
        PreservesKernel.iso F g ≪≫ (kernelConjIso eP eQ (F.map g)).symm ≪≫ eK ≪≫
          (kernelConjIso eA eB g'').symm
      exact (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp ι2 W.ι).app _ ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ι2).mapIso eW ≪≫ e2

name: SchemeKTheory.SplitKernel.exists_localData_of_frames
statement:
theorem exists_localData_of_frames {X : Scheme.{u}} {F Q : X.Modules}
    (q₁ : F.LocalGeneratorsData) [q₁.IsLocallyFreeData] [q₁.IsFiniteType]
    (q₃ : Q.LocalGeneratorsData) [q₃.IsLocallyFreeData] [q₃.IsFiniteType]
    (g : F ⟶ Q) [Epi g] (x : X) :
    ∃ (i : q₁.I) (j : q₃.I) (V : X.Opens) (_ : x ∈ V)
      (gV : (⨁ fun _ : Fin (frameCard q₁ i) => unitModule V) ⟶
        (⨁ fun _ : Fin (frameCard q₃ j) => unitModule V))
      (σ : (⨁ fun _ : Fin (frameCard q₃ j) => unitModule V) ⟶
        (⨁ fun _ : Fin (frameCard q₁ i) => unitModule V)),
      σ ≫ gV = 𝟙 _ ∧
        Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj (kernel g) ≅ kernel gV)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcover₁ : IsOpenCover q₁.X :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff X q₁.X).mp q₁.coversTop
  have hcover₃ : IsOpenCover q₃.X :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff X q₃.X).mp q₃.coversTop
  have hxUnion₁ : x ∈ ⋃ i, (q₁.X i : Set X) := by
    rw [hcover₁.iSup_set_eq_univ]
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  have hxUnion₃ : x ∈ ⋃ i, (q₃.X i : Set X) := by
    rw [hcover₃.iSup_set_eq_univ]
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hxUnion₁ hxUnion₃
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := hxUnion₁
  obtain ⟨j, hxj⟩ := hxUnion₃
  let I := (q₁.generators i).I
  let J := (q₃.generators j).I
  letI : (q₁.generators i).IsFiniteType :=
    SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType i
  letI : (q₃.generators j).IsFiniteType :=
    SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType j
  letI : Finite I := by
    dsimp only [I]
    infer_instance
  letI : Finite J := by
    dsimp only [J]
    infer_instance
  letI : Fintype I := Fintype.ofFinite I
  letI : Fintype J := Fintype.ofFinite J
  let eI : I ≃ Fin (frameCard q₁ i) := Finite.equivFin I
  let eJ : J ≃ Fin (frameCard q₃ j) := Finite.equivFin J
  let U := q₁.X i ⊓ q₃.X j
  have hxU : x ∈ U := ⟨hxi, hxj⟩
  let F₁ := SheafOfModules.overMap X.ringCatSheaf
    (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U ≤ q₁.X i))
  let F₃ := SheafOfModules.overMap X.ringCatSheaf
    (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U ≤ q₃.X j))
  let e₁U : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) I ≅ F.over U :=
    Scheme.Modules.freeOverMapIso X (q₁.X i) U inf_le_left I ≪≫
      F₁.mapIso (asIso (q₁.generators i).π) ≪≫
        (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf
          (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U ≤ q₁.X i))).app F
  let e₃U : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) J ≅ Q.over U :=
    Scheme.Modules.freeOverMapIso X (q₃.X j) U inf_le_right J ≪≫
      F₃.mapIso (asIso (q₃.generators j).π) ≪≫
        (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf
          (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U ≤ q₃.X j))).app Q
  obtain ⟨V, hVU, hxV, sec, hsec⟩ :=
    Scheme.Modules.exists_open_section_of_epi_free_over X J g U e₃U x hxU
  let G := SheafOfModules.overMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)
  let e₁V : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V) I ≅ F.over V :=
    Scheme.Modules.freeOverMapIso X U V hVU I ≪≫ G.mapIso e₁U ≪≫
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)).app F
  let e₃V : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V) J ≅ Q.over V :=
    Scheme.Modules.freeOverMapIso X U V hVU J ≪≫ G.mapIso e₃U ≪≫
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap X.ringCatSheaf (homOfLE hVU)).app Q
  let R := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι
  let α := Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V
  let E := (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V).functor
  let eF := restrictFrameIso F V I eI e₁V
  let eQ := restrictFrameIso Q V J eJ e₃V
  let σR : R.obj Q ⟶ R.obj F := (α.app Q).inv ≫ E.map sec ≫ (α.app F).hom
  have hσR : σR ≫ R.map g = 𝟙 _ := by
    have nat : E.map (g.over V) ≫ α.hom.app Q = α.hom.app F ≫ R.map g := α.hom.naturality g
    simp only [σR, Category.assoc, Iso.app_hom, Iso.app_inv]
    have h2 : E.map sec ≫ E.map (g.over V) ≫ α.hom.app Q = α.hom.app Q := by
      rw [← E.map_comp_assoc, hsec, E.map_id, Category.id_comp]
    erw [← nat, h2]
    exact Iso.inv_hom_id_app α Q
  refine ⟨i, j, V, hxV, eF.inv ≫ R.map g ≫ eQ.hom, eQ.inv ≫ σR ≫ eF.hom, ?_, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  · simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, reassoc_of% hσR, Iso.inv_hom_id]
  · exact PreservesKernel.iso R g ≪≫ (kernelConjIso eF eQ (R.map g)).symm

name: SchemeKTheory.SplitKernel.exists_localFree_of_frames
statement:
theorem exists_localFree_of_frames {X : Scheme.{u}} {F Q : X.Modules}
    (q₁ : F.LocalGeneratorsData) [q₁.IsLocallyFreeData] [q₁.IsFiniteType]
    (q₃ : Q.LocalGeneratorsData) [q₃.IsLocallyFreeData] [q₃.IsFiniteType]
    (g : F ⟶ Q) [Epi g] (x : X) :
    ∃ (i : q₁.I) (j : q₃.I) (Z : Scheme.{u}) (ι : Z ⟶ X) (_ : IsOpenImmersion ι),
      x ∈ ι.opensRange ∧
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ι).obj (kernel g) ≅
        ⨁ fun _ : Fin (frameCard q₁ i - frameCard q₃ j) =>
          unitModule Z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, j, V, hxV, gV, σ, hσ, ⟨eV⟩⟩ := exists_localData_of_frames q₁ q₃ g x
  obtain ⟨Z, ι2, hι2, hy2, ⟨e2⟩⟩ := exists_restrict_kernel_iso_biprod _ V ⟨x, hxV⟩ _ gV σ hσ
  refine ⟨i, j, Z, ι2 ≫ V.ι, inferInstance, ?_, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hy2
    exact ⟨z, by simp [hz]⟩
  · exact (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp ι2 V.ι).app _ ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ι2).mapIso eV ≪≫ e2

name: SchemeKTheory.SplitKernel.exists_localGeneratorsData_of_local
statement:
theorem exists_localGeneratorsData_of_local {X : Scheme.{u}} (M : X.Modules) (m : X → ℕ)
    (H : ∀ x : X, ∃ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (ι : Z ⟶ X) (_ : IsOpenImmersion ι), x ∈ ι.opensRange ∧
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ι).obj M ≅ ⨁ fun _ : Fin (m x) => unitModule Z)) :
    ∃ q : SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.{u} M, q.IsLocallyFreeData ∧ q.IsFiniteType ∧
      ∀ i, ∃ x : X, Nat.card (q.generators i).I = m x
proof:
:= by
  choose Z ι hι hx e using H
  let q : SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.{u} M :=
    { I := X
      X := fun x => (ι x).opensRange
      coversTop := by
        refine (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := X) (fun x => (ι x).opensRange)).2 ?_
        refine eq_top_iff.2 ?_
        intro y _
        exact Opens.mem_iSup.2 ⟨y, hx y⟩
      generators := fun x => SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.equivOfIso
        (frameOnOpensRange (ι x) M (m x) (e x).some)
        (SheafOfModules.free.generatingSections (ULift.{u} (Fin (m x)))) }
  refine ⟨q, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact
      { isIso := fun x => by
          change IsIso (SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.equivOfIso
            (frameOnOpensRange (ι x) M (m x) (e x).some)
            (SheafOfModules.free.generatingSections (ULift.{u} (Fin (m x))))).π
          infer_instance }
  · exact
      { isFiniteType := fun x => by
          change (SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.equivOfIso
            (frameOnOpensRange (ι x) M (m x) (e x).some)
            (SheafOfModules.free.generatingSections (ULift.{u} (Fin (m x))))).IsFiniteType
          constructor
          change Finite (ULift.{u} (Fin (m x)))
          infer_instance }
  · intro x
    refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
    change Nat.card (ULift.{u} (Fin (m x))) = m x
    simp

name: SchemeKTheory.hasConstantRank_kernel
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q₁, hq₁, hq₁fin, hc₁⟩ := hF
  obtain ⟨q₃, hq₃, hq₃fin, hc₃⟩ := hQ
  letI : q₁.IsLocallyFreeData := hq₁
  letI : q₁.IsFiniteType := hq₁fin
  letI : q₃.IsLocallyFreeData := hq₃
  letI : q₃.IsFiniteType := hq₃fin
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin, hcard⟩ := exists_localGeneratorsData_of_local (kernel g)
    (fun _ ↦ r - s) (fun x ↦ by
      obtain ⟨i, j, Z, ι, hι, hx, he⟩ := exists_localFree_of_frames q₁ q₃ g x
      have h₁ : frameCard q₁ i = r := hc₁ i
      have h₃ : frameCard q₃ j = s := hc₃ j
      rw [h₁, h₃] at he
      exact ⟨Z, ι, hι, hx, he⟩)
  refine ⟨q, hq, hqfin, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hcard i
  exact hx

name: SchemeKTheory.isFiniteLocallyFree_kernel
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q₁, hq₁, hq₁fin⟩ := hF.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  obtain ⟨q₃, hq₃, hq₃fin⟩ := hQ.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  letI : q₁.IsLocallyFreeData := hq₁
  letI : q₁.IsFiniteType := hq₁fin
  letI : q₃.IsLocallyFreeData := hq₃
  letI : q₃.IsFiniteType := hq₃fin
  have H : ∀ x : Y, ∃ (m : ℕ) (Z : Scheme.{u}) (ι : Z ⟶ Y) (_ : IsOpenImmersion ι),
      x ∈ ι.opensRange ∧
        Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor ι).obj (kernel g) ≅
          ⨁ fun _ : Fin m => unitModule Z) := fun x ↦ by
    obtain ⟨i, j, Z, ι, hι, hx, he⟩ := exists_localFree_of_frames q₁ q₃ g x
    exact ⟨_, Z, ι, hι, hx, he⟩
  choose m hm using H
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin, -⟩ := exists_localGeneratorsData_of_local (kernel g) m hm
  exact ⟨⟨q, hq, hqfin⟩⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistOverlapIsoOfRestrictLocalCompatibility_restrict
statement:
theorem twistOverlapIsoOfRestrictLocalCompatibility_restrict
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I)
    (h : C.TwistOverlapRestrictLocalRestrictionIndependence d i j)
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    [IsOpenImmersion (C.transition i j)] :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι).map
        (C.twistOverlapIsoOfRestrictLocalCompatibility d i j h).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback
            (C.overlapToChart i j)).app (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)).inv ≫

            (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i)).app
              (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j)).hom

    twistOverlapRestrictIsoOfLocalCompatibility

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem_restrict
statement:
theorem canonicalTwistTransitionSystem_restrict
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    [IsOpenImmersion (C.transition i j)] :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι).map
        ((C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d).iso i j).hom =

          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback
            (C.overlapToChart i j)).app (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)).inv ≫
        (C.twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeIso d i j c).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback
            (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i)).app
              (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j)).hom

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.over_eq_overIsoOfRestrictIso_of_restrict_eq
statement:
theorem over_eq_overIsoOfRestrictIso_of_restrict_eq
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {M N : Y.Modules} (U : Y.Opens)
    (f : M ⟶ N)
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj M ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).obj N)
    (h : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map f = e.hom) :
    f.over U = (overIsoOfRestrictIso U e).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map_injective
  rw [overIsoOfRestrictIso_map]
  apply (cancel_mono ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.app N)).1
  change
    (SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf U ⋙
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor).map f ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.app N =
      ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.app M ≫ e.hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).inv.app N) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.app N
  rw [(Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.naturality f, h]
  simp

    Functor.mapIso_inv, Category.assoc] using
    C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem_restrict d i j c

    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)

name: SchemeKTheory.subsingleton_exteriorPower_finsupp
statement:
theorem subsingleton_exteriorPower_finsupp (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (I : Type u)
    [Fintype I] (n : ℕ) (hn : Fintype.card I < n) :
    Subsingleton (⋀[R]^n (I →₀ R))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : LinearOrder I := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
  let b := (Finsupp.basisSingleOne (R := R) (ι := I)).exteriorPower n
  haveI : IsEmpty (Set.powersetCard I n) := ⟨fun s ↦ by
    have h1 := Set.powersetCard.card_eq s
    have h2 := Finset.card_le_univ (s : Finset I)
    omega⟩

  · exact h
  · exact (IsEmpty.false b.index_nonempty.some).elim

name: SchemeKTheory.subsingleton_sections_of_isZero
statement:
theorem subsingleton_sections_of_isZero (N : SheafOfModules.{u} R) (hN : IsZero N) (V : Cᵒᵖ) :
    Subsingleton (N.val.obj V)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : ∀ x : N.val.obj V, x = 0 := fun x ↦ by
    have := congrArg (fun f : N ⟶ N ↦ f.val.app V x) (hN.eq_of_src (𝟙 N) 0)
    have h2 : (SheafOfModules.Hom.val (0 : N ⟶ N)).app V x = 0 := rfl
    simpa [h2] using this
  exact ⟨fun a b ↦ by rw [h0 a, h0 b]⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.modulesHom_ext_of_over_coversTop
statement:
private theorem modulesHom_ext_of_over_coversTop
    {M N : Y.Modules} {I : Type u}
    (U : I → Y.Opens)
    (hU : (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y).CoversTop U)
    (f g : M ⟶ N)
    (h : ∀ i, f.over (U i) = g.over (U i)) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply (SheafOfModules.toSheaf Y.ringCatSheaf).map_injective
  apply Sheaf.hom_ext
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext W
  apply AddCommGrpCat.hom_ext
  ext m
  apply N.isSheaf.isSeparated W.unop
    (Sieve.ofObjects U W.unop) (hU W.unop)
  rintro Z a ⟨i, ⟨b⟩⟩
  have happ := congrArg
    (fun k ↦ k.val.app (op (Over.mk b))) (h i)
  change N.val.map a.op (f.val.app W m) =
    N.val.map a.op (g.val.app W m)
  calc
    N.val.map a.op (f.val.app W m) =
        (show N.val.obj (op Z) from
          f.val.app (op Z) (M.val.map a.op m)) :=
      (CategoryTheory.congr_fun (f.val.naturality a.op) m).symm
    _ = (show N.val.obj (op Z) from
        g.val.app (op Z) (M.val.map a.op m)) := by
      exact CategoryTheory.congr_fun happ _
    _ = (show N.val.obj (op Z) from
        N.val.map a.op (g.val.app W m)) := by
      exact CategoryTheory.congr_fun (g.val.naturality a.op) m

name: SchemeKTheory.isZero_of_isZero_over

    IsZero N
proof:

name: SchemeKTheory.isZero_exteriorPowerSheaf_free
statement:
theorem isZero_exteriorPowerSheaf_free (I : Type u) [Fintype I] (k : ℕ)
    (hk : Fintype.card I < k) :
    IsZero (exteriorPowerSheaf Y (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I) k)
proof:
:= by
  have hP : IsZero (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower (finsuppFreePresheaf Y I) k) :=
    isZero_presheafOfModules_of_subsingleton _ (fun U ↦
      subsingleton_exteriorPower_finsupp (Y.presheaf.obj U) I k hk)
  exact IsZero.of_iso ((moduleSheafification Y).map_isZero hP)
    ((moduleSheafification Y).mapIso
      ((PresheafOfModules.exteriorPowerFunctor k).mapIso (underlyingFreeIsoFinsuppFree Y I)))

name: SchemeKTheory.isZero_exteriorPowerSheaf_of_rank_lt
statement:
theorem isZero_exteriorPowerSheaf_of_rank_lt (M : Y.Modules) (r : ℕ) (hr : HasConstantRank Y M r)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : r < k) : IsZero (exteriorPowerSheaf Y M k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin, hcard⟩ := hr
  apply isZero_of_isZero_over Y _ q.X q.coversTop
  intro i
  let σ := q.generators i
  haveI : σ.IsFiniteType := hqfin.isFiniteType i
  haveI : Finite σ.I := SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.IsFiniteType.finite
  letI : Fintype σ.I := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have hcardI : Fintype.card σ.I = r := by
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]; exact hcard i
  haveI : IsIso σ.π := hq.isIso i
  let e : M.over (q.X i) ≅ (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) σ.I).over (q.X i) :=
    (asIso σ.π).symm ≪≫ freeOverIso Y (q.X i) σ.I
  let e' : (exteriorPowerSheaf Y M k).over (q.X i) ≅
      (exteriorPowerSheaf Y (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) σ.I) k).over (q.X i) :=
    (exteriorPowerSheafOverIso Y (q.X i) M k).symm ≪≫
      exteriorPowerSheafOverMapIso Y (q.X i) e k ≪≫
      exteriorPowerSheafOverIso Y (q.X i) _ k
  exact IsZero.of_iso
    (isZero_over_of_isZero Y _ (isZero_exteriorPowerSheaf_free Y σ.I k (by omega)) _) e'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D11.projBundle_relDim
proof:
:= by
  letI : C.scheme.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    ⟨C.toBase ≫ X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)⟩
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (C.scheme ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (C.toBase ≫ X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    infer_instance
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := C.covers.exists_mem (C.toBase x)
  have hcard := hrank i
  haveI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  haveI : Nonempty (C.basisIndex i) := (Nat.card_pos_iff.mp (by omega)).1
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, C.U i) := m6pb_isNoetherianRing_chart (k := k) _ (C.isAffine i)
  have hn : C.positiveRankDimension i = e := by
    unfold AffineFrameCover.positiveRankDimension
    letI : Fintype (C.basisIndex i) := Fintype.ofFinite _
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hcard]
    rfl
  let b : Module.Basis (Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1)) Γ(X, C.U i)
      (E.val.obj (Opposite.op (C.U i))) :=
    (C.sectionBasis i).reindex (C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i)
  
  have h1 : C.chartι i ≫ C.toBase =
      intrinsicToSpec (R := Γ(X, C.U i)) (M := E.val.obj (Opposite.op (C.U i))) ≫
        (C.isAffine i).fromSpec := by
    rw [C.chartι_toBase]
    rfl
  have h2 : inv (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b) ≫
      intrinsicToSpec (R := Γ(X, C.U i)) (M := E.val.obj (Opposite.op (C.U i))) =
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) := by
    rw [IsIso.inv_comp_eq, intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace_comp_toSpec]
  
  have hx1 : x ∈ Set.range (C.chartι i) := by
    have hpb := C.isPullback_chartι_toBase i
    rw [← hpb.isoPullback_hom_fst, m6pb_range_iso_comp, Scheme.Pullback.range_fst,
      Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
    exact hi
  obtain ⟨x1, rfl⟩ := hx1
  set x2 := intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b x1 with hx2
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, x2 ∈ coordinateOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a := by
    have : x2 ∈ (⊤ : (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space Γ(X, C.U i)
        (C.positiveRankDimension i)).Opens) := trivial
    rw [← coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top] at this
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp this
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : x2 ∈ Set.range (m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a) := by
    rw [m6pb_range_stdChart]
    exact ha
  let J := m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a ≫
    inv (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b) ≫ C.chartι i
  haveI : IsOpenImmersion J :=
    @IsOpenImmersion.comp _ _ _ _ _ inferInstance
      (@IsOpenImmersion.comp _ _ _ _ _ inferInstance (C.chartι_isOpenImmersion i))
  have hJv : J v = C.chartι i x1 := by
    change C.chartι i (inv (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b)
      (m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a v)) = C.chartι i x1
    rw [hv, hx2]
    change C.chartι i ((intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b ≫
      inv (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b)) x1) = C.chartι i x1
    rw [IsIso.hom_inv_id]
    rfl
  have hsq : J ≫ C.toBase = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPolynomial.C :
      Γ(X, C.U i) →+* MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a)
        Γ(X, C.U i))) ≫ (C.isAffine i).fromSpec := by
    have h3 : inv (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b) ≫ C.chartι i ≫ C.toBase =
        SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) ≫
          (C.isAffine i).fromSpec := by
      have := congrArg (fun q ↦ inv (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b) ≫ q) h1
      refine this.trans ?_
      rw [← Category.assoc, h2]
    change m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a ≫
      inv (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b) ≫ C.chartι i ≫ C.toBase = _
    refine (congrArg (fun q ↦ m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a ≫ q)
      h3).trans ?_
    rw [← Category.assoc, m6pb_stdChart_toSpec]
  haveI : Flat (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPolynomial.C :
      Γ(X, C.U i) →+* MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a)
        Γ(X, C.U i)))) := by
    rw [Flat.SpecMap_iff]
    change (algebraMap Γ(X, C.U i)
      (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a) Γ(X, C.U i))).Flat
    exact RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff.mpr Module.Flat.of_free
  have key := m6pb_pureRelDim_transfer k C.toBase J _ (C.isAffine i).fromSpec hsq
    (m6pb_pureRelDim_mvPolynomial Γ(X, C.U i)
      (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a)) v (by rw [hJv]; exact hx)
  rw [hJv, m6pb_natCard_affineChartIndex, hn] at key
  exact key

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D11.totalBaseChange
statement:
theorem totalBaseChange (ops : ChowOps k) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (f' : X' ⟶ Y')
    (g' : X' ⟶ X) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [g.IsOver (Spk k)] [f'.IsOver (Spk k)]
    [g'.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsProper f] [IsProper f'] [Flat g] [Flat g'] (d : ℕ)
    (hg : PureRelDim g d) (hg' : PureRelDim g' d) (hsq : IsPullback g' f' f g) :
    totalPull ops g d hg ∘ₗ totalPush ops f = totalPush ops f' ∘ₗ totalPull ops g' d hg'
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a y =>
    induction y using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
    | H D =>
      have h1 : a ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X n) =
          a • ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk D : DimChow X n)) := by
        rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      rw [h1]
      simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.comp_apply]
      congr 1
      simp only [totalPush, totalPull, DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply,
        D9.push_eq_pushD9, D2.pull_eq_pullD2, D9.pushD9_mk0, D2.pullD2_mk (k := k)]
      have key : ∀ (E E' : dimensionCycles Y' (n + d)), E.1 = E'.1 →
          DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow Y' n) (n + d)
            ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk E : DimChow Y' (n + d))) =
          DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow Y' n) (n + d)
            ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] (QuotientAddGroup.mk E' : DimChow Y' (n + d))) := by
        intro E E' h
        rw [Subtype.ext h]
      exact key _ _ (flatPullback_properPushforward f g f' g' hsq D.1)
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: CharacteristicClasses.totalChernRoots_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem totalChernRoots_empty (root : I → A) :
    totalChernRoots A ∅ root = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [totalChernRoots]

name: CharacteristicClasses.totalChernRoots_insert
statement:
@[simp]
theorem totalChernRoots_insert [DecidableEq I] (s : Finset I) (root : I → A)
    {i : I} (hi : i ∉ s) :
    totalChernRoots A (insert i s) root =
      (1 + Polynomial.C (root i) * Polynomial.X) * totalChernRoots A s root
proof:
:= by
  simp [totalChernRoots, hi]

name: CharacteristicClasses.totalChernRoots_union
statement:
theorem totalChernRoots_union [DecidableEq I] {s t : Finset I} (h : Disjoint s t)
    (root : I → A) :
    totalChernRoots A (s ∪ t) root =
      totalChernRoots A s root * totalChernRoots A t root
proof:
:= by
  simp only [totalChernRoots, Finset.prod_union h]

name: CharacteristicClasses.coeff_zero_totalChernRoots
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_zero_totalChernRoots (s : Finset I) (root : I → A) :
    (totalChernRoots A s root).coeff 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [totalChernRoots, Polynomial.coeff_zero_prod]

name: CharacteristicClasses.coeff_one_totalChernRoots
statement:
theorem coeff_one_totalChernRoots (s : Finset I) (root : I → A) :
    (totalChernRoots A s root).coeff 1 = ∑ i ∈ s, root i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [totalChernRoots, Polynomial.coeff_one]
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
      rw [totalChernRoots_insert A s root hi, Polynomial.mul_coeff_one]
      simp [ih, hi, Polynomial.coeff_one, add_comm]

name: CharacteristicClasses.chernClassRoots_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chernClassRoots_zero (s : Finset I) (root : I → A) :
    chernClassRoots A 0 s root = 1
proof:
:=
  coeff_zero_totalChernRoots A s root

name: CharacteristicClasses.chernClassRoots_one
statement:
theorem chernClassRoots_one (s : Finset I) (root : I → A) :
    chernClassRoots A 1 s root = ∑ i ∈ s, root i
proof:
:=
  coeff_one_totalChernRoots A s root

name: CharacteristicClasses.chernClassRoots_two_insert
statement:
theorem chernClassRoots_two_insert [DecidableEq I] (s : Finset I) (root : I → A)
    {i : I} (hi : i ∉ s) :
    chernClassRoots A 2 (insert i s) root =
      root i * chernClassRoots A 1 s root + chernClassRoots A 2 s root
proof:
:= by
  rw [chernClassRoots, totalChernRoots_insert A s root hi, Polynomial.coeff_mul]
  have h : Finset.antidiagonal 2 = {(0, 2), (1, 1), (2, 0)} := by
    exact rfl
  rw [h]
  simp [chernClassRoots, Polynomial.coeff_one, Polynomial.coeff_X]
  ring

name: CharacteristicClasses.chernClassRoots_union
statement:
theorem chernClassRoots_union [DecidableEq I] {s t : Finset I} (h : Disjoint s t)
    (root : I → A) (n : ℕ) :
    chernClassRoots A n (s ∪ t) root =
      ∑ ij ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n,
        chernClassRoots A ij.1 s root * chernClassRoots A ij.2 t root
proof:
:= by
  rw [chernClassRoots, totalChernRoots_union A h root, Polynomial.coeff_mul]
  rfl

name: CharacteristicClasses.chRoots_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chRoots_empty (root : I → A) :
    chRoots A ∅ root = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [chRoots]

name: CharacteristicClasses.toddRoots_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toddRoots_empty (root : I → A) :
    toddRoots A ∅ root = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [toddRoots]

name: CharacteristicClasses.chRoots_insert
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chRoots_insert [DecidableEq I] (s : Finset I) (root : I → A)
    {i : I} (hi : i ∉ s) :
    chRoots A (insert i s) root = chRoot A (root i) + chRoots A s root
proof:
:= by
  simp [chRoots, hi]

name: CharacteristicClasses.toddRoots_insert
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toddRoots_insert [DecidableEq I] (s : Finset I) (root : I → A)
    {i : I} (hi : i ∉ s) :
    toddRoots A (insert i s) root = toddRoot A (root i) * toddRoots A s root
proof:
:= by
  simp [toddRoots, hi]

name: CharacteristicClasses.chRoots_union
statement:
theorem chRoots_union [DecidableEq I] {s t : Finset I} (h : Disjoint s t)
    (root : I → A) :
    chRoots A (s ∪ t) root = chRoots A s root + chRoots A t root
proof:
:= by
  simp only [chRoots, Finset.sum_union h]

name: CharacteristicClasses.toddRoots_union
statement:
theorem toddRoots_union [DecidableEq I] {s t : Finset I} (h : Disjoint s t)
    (root : I → A) :
    toddRoots A (s ∪ t) root = toddRoots A s root * toddRoots A t root
proof:
:= by
  simp only [toddRoots, Finset.prod_union h]

name: CharacteristicClasses.chRoots_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chRoots_singleton (i : I) (root : I → A) :
    chRoots A {i} root = chRoot A (root i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [chRoots]

name: CharacteristicClasses.chRoots_singleton_neg
statement:
theorem chRoots_singleton_neg (i : I) (root : I → A) :
    chRoots A {i} (fun j ↦ -root j) * chRoots A {i} root = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [chRoot_neg_mul]

name: CharacteristicClasses.chRootsDiff_eq_union_sdiff
proof:
:= by
  have hdisj : Disjoint (s \ t) t := Disjoint.symm (@Finset.disjoint_sdiff I _ t s)
  have hunion : (s \ t) ∪ t = s := Finset.sdiff_union_of_subset h
  have hsum := chRoots_union A hdisj root
  rw [chRootsDiff]
  conv_lhs => arg 1; rw [← hunion]
  rw [hsum]
  abel

name: CharacteristicClasses.chRoots_product
statement:
theorem chRoots_product {J : Type*} (s : Finset I) (t : Finset J)
    (root : I → A) (root' : J → A) :
    chRoots A (s ×ˢ t) (tensorRoot A root root') =
      chRoots A s root * chRoots A t root'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [chRoots, Finset.sum_product, tensorRoot]
  simp_rw [← chRoot_add]
  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  congr 1
  funext i
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]

name: CharacteristicClasses.constantCoeff_chRoots
statement:
@[simp]
theorem constantCoeff_chRoots (s : Finset I) (root : I → A) :
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff (chRoots A s root) = (s.card : A)
proof:
:= by
  simp [chRoots]

name: CharacteristicClasses.constantCoeff_toddRoots
statement:
@[simp]
theorem constantCoeff_toddRoots (s : Finset I) (root : I → A) :
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff (toddRoots A s root) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [toddRoots]

name: CharacteristicClasses.coeff_chRoots
statement:
theorem coeff_chRoots (s : Finset I) (root : I → A) (n : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (chRoots A s root) =
      ∑ i ∈ s, root i ^ n * algebraMap ℚ A ((1 : ℚ) / Nat.factorial n)
proof:
:= by
  simp [chRoots, coeff_chRoot]

name: CharacteristicClasses.sum_sq_roots_eq
statement:
theorem sum_sq_roots_eq (s : Finset I) (root : I → A) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, root i ^ 2 =
      (∑ i ∈ s, root i) ^ 2 - 2 * chernClassRoots A 2 s root
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [chernClassRoots, totalChernRoots, Polynomial.coeff_one]
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, Finset.sum_insert hi,
        chernClassRoots_two_insert A s root hi, chernClassRoots_one]
      rw [ih]
      ring

name: CharacteristicClasses.coeff_one_chRoots_eq_c1
statement:
theorem coeff_one_chRoots_eq_c1 (s : Finset I) (root : I → A) :
    PowerSeries.coeff 1 (chRoots A s root) = chernClassRoots A 1 s root
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_chRoots, chernClassRoots_one]
  norm_num

name: CharacteristicClasses.coeff_two_chRoots_eq
statement:
theorem coeff_two_chRoots_eq (s : Finset I) (root : I → A) :
    PowerSeries.coeff 2 (chRoots A s root) =
      ((∑ i ∈ s, root i) ^ 2 - 2 * chernClassRoots A 2 s root) *
        algebraMap ℚ A ((1 : ℚ) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_chRoots]
  norm_num [Nat.factorial]
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul, sum_sq_roots_eq]

name: CharacteristicClasses.coeff_one_toddRoots
statement:
theorem coeff_one_toddRoots (s : Finset I) (root : I → A) :
    PowerSeries.coeff 1 (toddRoots A s root) =
      ∑ i ∈ s, root i * algebraMap ℚ A ((1 : ℚ) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
      rw [toddRoots_insert A s root hi, PowerSeries.coeff_one_mul]
      simp [ih, hi]

name: CharacteristicClasses.coeff_two_mul
statement:
lemma coeff_two_mul (φ ψ : PowerSeries A) :
    PowerSeries.coeff 2 (φ * ψ) =
      PowerSeries.coeff 2 φ * PowerSeries.constantCoeff ψ +
        PowerSeries.coeff 1 φ * PowerSeries.coeff 1 ψ +
          PowerSeries.constantCoeff φ * PowerSeries.coeff 2 ψ
proof:
:= by
  have h : Finset.antidiagonal 2 = {(0, 2), (1, 1), (2, 0)} := by
    exact rfl
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul, h]
  simp [PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff]
  ring

name: CharacteristicClasses.coeff_two_toddRoots
statement:
theorem coeff_two_toddRoots (s : Finset I) (root : I → A) :
    PowerSeries.coeff 2 (toddRoots A s root) =
      ((∑ i ∈ s, root i) ^ 2 + chernClassRoots A 2 s root) *
        algebraMap ℚ A ((1 : ℚ) / 12)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [chernClassRoots, totalChernRoots, Polynomial.coeff_one]
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
      rw [toddRoots_insert A s root hi, coeff_two_mul]
      rw [constantCoeff_toddRoot, constantCoeff_toddRoots,
        coeff_one_toddRoot, coeff_one_toddRoots, coeff_two_toddRoot, ih,
        chernClassRoots_two_insert A s root hi]
      simp only [Finset.sum_insert, hi, not_false_eq_true]
      rw [chernClassRoots_one]
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
      push_cast
      have hrat : (algebraMap ℚ A ((1 : ℚ) / 2)) ^ 2 =
          algebraMap ℚ A ((1 : ℚ) / 12) + algebraMap ℚ A ((1 : ℚ) / 12) +
            algebraMap ℚ A ((1 : ℚ) / 12) := by
        calc
          _ = algebraMap ℚ A (((1 : ℚ) / 2) ^ 2) := by rw [map_pow]
          _ = algebraMap ℚ A
              (((1 : ℚ) / 12) + (1 : ℚ) / 12 + (1 : ℚ) / 12) := by norm_num
          _ = _ := by rw [map_add, map_add]
      ring_nf
      rw [hrat]
      ring

name: CharacteristicClasses.coeff_two_chRoots_mul_toddRoots
statement:
theorem coeff_two_chRoots_mul_toddRoots {J : Type*} (s : Finset I) (t : Finset J)
    (root : I → A) (tangentRoot : J → A) :
    PowerSeries.coeff 2 (chRoots A s root * toddRoots A t tangentRoot) =
      ((∑ i ∈ s, root i) ^ 2 - 2 * chernClassRoots A 2 s root) *
          algebraMap ℚ A ((1 : ℚ) / 2) +
        (∑ i ∈ s, root i) * (∑ j ∈ t, tangentRoot j) *
          algebraMap ℚ A ((1 : ℚ) / 2) +
        (s.card : A) *
          (((∑ j ∈ t, tangentRoot j) ^ 2 + chernClassRoots A 2 t tangentRoot) *
            algebraMap ℚ A ((1 : ℚ) / 12))
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_two_mul, constantCoeff_toddRoots, coeff_two_chRoots_eq,
    coeff_one_chRoots_eq_c1, chernClassRoots_one, coeff_one_toddRoots,
    constantCoeff_chRoots, coeff_two_toddRoots]
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
  ring

name: CharacteristicClasses.coeff_one_chRoots_mul_toddRoots
statement:
theorem coeff_one_chRoots_mul_toddRoots {J : Type*} (s : Finset I) (t : Finset J)
    (root : I → A) (tangentRoot : J → A) :
    PowerSeries.coeff 1 (chRoots A s root * toddRoots A t tangentRoot) =
      (∑ i ∈ s, root i) +
        (s.card : A) * (∑ j ∈ t, tangentRoot j) *
          algebraMap ℚ A ((1 : ℚ) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_one_mul, constantCoeff_toddRoots,
    coeff_one_chRoots_eq_c1, chernClassRoots_one, coeff_one_toddRoots,
    constantCoeff_chRoots]
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.KDGb.map_appLE_le_comap_ideal
statement:
theorem map_appLE_le_comap_ideal {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (I : Y.IdealSheafData)
    (V : Y.affineOpens) (U : X.affineOpens) (h : (U : X.Opens) ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ (V : Y.Opens)) :
    Ideal.map (f.appLE V U h).hom (I.ideal V) ≤ (I.comap f).ideal U
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsAffine (U : X.Opens) := U.2
  haveI : IsAffine (V : Y.Opens) := V.2
  rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro a ha
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap]
  have e : ∀ x : Γ(Y, (V : Y.Opens)),
      (V : Y.Opens).topIso.hom.hom ((V : Y.Opens).topIso.inv.hom x) = x := fun x =>
    Iso.inv_hom_id_apply (V : Y.Opens).topIso x
  have hρ : (V : Y.Opens).topIso.inv a ∈
      (I.comap (V : Y.Opens).ι).ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩ := by
    rw [KSpecialization.ARRHU.mem_comap_ι_top_iff, e]
    exact ha
  have h1 := CIIB6.comap_ideal_top_affine (f.resLE V U h) (I.comap (V : Y.Opens).ι)
  rw [KSpecialization.ARRHU.comap_eq_comap_comap f I V U h] at h1
  have h2 : (f.resLE V U h).appTop.hom ((V : Y.Opens).topIso.inv a) ∈
      ((I.comap f).comap (U : X.Opens).ι).ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩ := by
    rw [h1]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hρ
  rw [KSpecialization.ARRHU.mem_comap_ι_top_iff] at h2
  have hr' : (f.resLE V U h).appTop =
      (V : Y.Opens).topIso.hom ≫ f.appLE V U h ≫ (U : X.Opens).topIso.inv :=
    Scheme.Hom.resLE_app_top f h
  have hcat : (V : Y.Opens).topIso.inv ≫ ((V : Y.Opens).topIso.hom ≫ f.appLE V U h ≫
      (U : X.Opens).topIso.inv) ≫ (U : X.Opens).topIso.hom = f.appLE V U h := by
    simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  rw [hr'] at h2
  have hc := congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom a) hcat
  exact hc ▸ h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.KDGb.comap_ideal_eq_map
statement:
theorem comap_ideal_eq_map {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (I : Y.IdealSheafData)
    (V : Y.affineOpens) (U : X.affineOpens) (h : (U : X.Opens) ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ (V : Y.Opens)) :
    (I.comap f).ideal U = Ideal.map (f.appLE V U h).hom (I.ideal V)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine (KSpecialization.ARRHU.comap_ideal_le_span f I V U h).trans ?_
    rw [Ideal.map]
  · exact map_appLE_le_comap_ideal f I V U h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.KDGb.pullbackSec_app_one
statement:
theorem pullbackSec_app_one (g : W ⟶ S) (σ : tensorUnitSheaf S ⟶ L) (V : S.Opens) :
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (pullbackSec g σ) (g ⁻¹ᵁ V) (1 : Γ(W, g ⁻¹ᵁ V)) =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app L).app V
        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ V (1 : Γ(S, V)))
proof:
:= by
  have nat := Adjunction.unit_naturality (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g) σ
  have h2 := congrArg (fun φ : tensorUnitSheaf S ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj L) => φ.app V (1 : Γ(S, V))) nat
  have h1 := AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso_inv_one g V
  change (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (Scheme.Modules.pullback g |>.map σ) (g ⁻¹ᵁ V))
    (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso g).inv (g ⁻¹ᵁ V)
      (1 : Γ(W, g ⁻¹ᵁ V))) = _
  rw [h1]
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at h2
  exact h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.KDGb.sectionOfHom_pullbackSec
statement:
theorem sectionOfHom_pullbackSec (g : W ⟶ S) (σ : tensorUnitSheaf S ⟶ L) :
    E26.sectionOfHom (pullbackSec g σ) = wPullbackSection g (E26.sectionOfHom σ)
