  pullbackSec_app_one g σ ⊤

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.KDGb.qc_fp_of_hasConstantRank
statement:
theorem qc_fp_of_hasConstantRank (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) :
    L.IsQuasicoherent ∧ L.IsFinitePresentation
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hL.isFiniteLocallyFree.isLocallyFree
  exact ⟨inferInstance, IsFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation X hL.isFiniteLocallyFree⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.KDGb.hasConstantRank_pullback_one
proof:
:=
  hasConstantRank_pullback W g L 1 hL

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.KDGb.wCoord_pullbackSec
statement:
theorem wCoord_pullbackSec (g : W ⟶ S) (σ : tensorUnitSheaf S ⟶ L) (w : W)
    (d : WFrame L (g w)) :
    wCoord (WFrame.ofData (pullbackWFrame g d w d.mem)) (E26.sectionOfHom (pullbackSec g σ)) =
      g.app d.U (wCoord d (E26.sectionOfHom σ))
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (wFrameSec (WFrame.ofData (pullbackWFrame g d w d.mem))
      (WFrame.ofData (pullbackWFrame g d w d.mem)).U le_rfl) := fun a b hab => by
    have := congrArg (E27.wCoordFun (WFrame.ofData (pullbackWFrame g d w d.mem))
      (WFrame.ofData (pullbackWFrame g d w d.mem)).U le_rfl) hab
    rwa [E27.wCoordFun_wFrameSec, E27.wCoordFun_wFrameSec] at this
  apply hinj
  rw [wCoord_spec, sectionOfHom_pullbackSec]
  exact (wFrameSec_pullbackWFrame g d (E26.sectionOfHom σ) (wCoord d (E26.sectionOfHom σ))
    (wCoord_spec d (E26.sectionOfHom σ)) w d.mem).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.KDGb.sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_pullbackSec
statement:
theorem sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_pullbackSec (hL : HasConstantRank S L 1)
    (σ : tensorUnitSheaf S ⟶ L) (g : W ⟶ S) :
    sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf (pullbackSec g σ) = (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).comap g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hq, hf⟩ := qc_fp_of_hasConstantRank hL
  obtain ⟨hq', hf'⟩ := qc_fp_of_hasConstantRank (hasConstantRank_pullback_one hL g)
  haveI := hq
  haveI := hf
  haveI := hq'
  haveI := hf'
  have hex : ∀ w : W, ∃ (d : WFrame L (g w)) (V : S.affineOpens) (U : W.affineOpens),
      V.1 ≤ d.U ∧ w ∈ U.1 ∧ U.1 ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V.1 := by
    intro w
    obtain ⟨d⟩ := exists_wFrame hL (g w)
    obtain ⟨V', hV', hxV, hVd⟩ := (Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp S.isBasis_affineOpens) d.mem
    obtain ⟨U', hU', hwU, hUV⟩ := (Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp W.isBasis_affineOpens)
      (show w ∈ g ⁻¹ᵁ V' from hxV)
    exact ⟨d, ⟨V', hV'⟩, ⟨U', hU'⟩, hVd, hwU, hUV⟩
  choose d V U hVd hwU hUV using hex
  refine Scheme.IdealSheafData.ext_of_iSup_eq_top U ?_ (fun w => ?_)
  · rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro z _
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨z, hwU z⟩
  · have hUd : (U w).1 ≤ (WFrame.ofData (pullbackWFrame g (d w) w (d w).mem)).U := by
      intro x hx
      exact hVd w (hUV w hx)
    rw [E27.sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_ideal_eq_span (pullbackSec g σ)
      (WFrame.ofData (pullbackWFrame g (d w) w (d w).mem)) (U w) hUd,
      wCoord_pullbackSec g σ w (d w),
      comap_ideal_eq_map g _ (V w) (U w) (hUV w),
      E27.sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_ideal_eq_span σ (d w) (V w) (hVd w),
      Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
    congr 2
    have h1 := Scheme.Hom.map_appLE g (hUV w) (homOfLE (hVd w)).op
    have h2 : g.app (d w).U ≫ W.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUd).op = g.appLE (d w).U (U w).1 hUd := by
      rw [Scheme.Hom.app_eq_appLE]
      exact Scheme.Hom.appLE_map g le_rfl (homOfLE hUd).op
    exact (congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom (wCoord (d w) (E26.sectionOfHom σ))) h2).trans
      (congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom (wCoord (d w) (E26.sectionOfHom σ))) h1).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.KDGb.sectionIsRegular_of_ne_bot
statement:
theorem sectionIsRegular_of_ne_bot [IsIntegral W] (hL : HasConstantRank W L 1)
    (σ : tensorUnitSheaf W ⟶ L) (hne : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ ≠ ⊥) :
    SectionIsRegular σ
proof:
:= by
  refine sectionIsRegular_of_integral
    (KSpecialization.AR7R.isLocalLineFrame_of_hasConstantRank_one hL) σ (fun U hU h0 => ?_)
  apply A5CD.ideal_ne_bot_of_ne_bot hne U hU
  rw [eq_bot_iff]
  refine (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_le_affine σ U).trans ?_
  change sectionEvaluationIdeal (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ U (1 : Γ(W, U))) ≤ ⊥
  exact ((congrArg sectionEvaluationIdeal h0).trans A5CD.sectionEvaluationIdeal_zero).le

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.KDGb.ne_bot_of_sectionIsRegular
statement:
theorem ne_bot_of_sectionIsRegular [IsIntegral W] (hL : HasConstantRank W L 1)
    (σ : tensorUnitSheaf W ⟶ L) (hreg : SectionIsRegular σ) :
    sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hq, hf⟩ := qc_fp_of_hasConstantRank hL
  haveI := hq
  haveI := hf
  intro hbot
  obtain ⟨w⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty W)
  obtain ⟨d⟩ := exists_wFrame hL w
  obtain ⟨V', hV', hwV, hVd⟩ := (Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp W.isBasis_affineOpens) d.mem
  let V : W.affineOpens := ⟨V', hV'⟩
  have h1 := E27.sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_ideal_eq_span σ d V hVd
  rw [hbot] at h1
  have h2 : W.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVd).op (wCoord d (E26.sectionOfHom σ)) = 0 := by
    have : (Ideal.span {W.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVd).op (wCoord d (E26.sectionOfHom σ))} :
        Ideal Γ(W, V.1)) = ⊥ := h1.symm
    exact Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot.mp this
  have h3 : Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ V.1 (1 : Γ(W, V.1)) = 0 := by
    rw [E27.hom_app_one_eq_smul σ d V.1 hVd, h2, zero_smul]
  haveI : Nonempty V.1 := ⟨⟨w, hwV⟩⟩
  have h4 := hreg V 1 (by rw [h3, smul_zero])
  exact one_ne_zero h4

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.KDGb.nonempty_tensor_dual_unit
statement:
theorem nonempty_tensor_dual_unit {L : W.Modules} (h : HasConstantRank W L 1) :
    Nonempty (tensorSheaf W L (lineBundleDual W L) ≅ tensorUnitSheaf W)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, -, hcard⟩ := id h
  letI := hq
  exact ⟨tensorLineBundleDualIso L q.X q.coversTop
    (fun i ↦ (LineBundleDual.exists_triv L q hcard i).some)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.KDGb.nonempty_iso_of_dual_iso
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T₂⟩ := nonempty_tensor_dual_unit h₂
  obtain ⟨i₁⟩ := tensorDualCancel_nonempty h₁ L₂
  let a : tensorSheaf W L₂ (lineBundleDual W L₁) ≅ tensorUnitSheaf W :=
    (tensorSheafBifunctor W).mapIso (Iso.prod (Iso.refl L₂) e) ≪≫ T₂
  exact ⟨(tensorUnitIsoLeft _ L₁ a).symm ≪≫ i₁⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.KDGb.nonempty_iso_of_evaluationIdeal_eq
statement:
theorem nonempty_iso_of_evaluationIdeal_eq {L₁ L₂ : W.Modules}
    (h₁ : HasConstantRank W L₁ 1) (h₂ : HasConstantRank W L₂ 1)
    (σ₁ : tensorUnitSheaf W ⟶ L₁) (σ₂ : tensorUnitSheaf W ⟶ L₂)
    (hr₁ : SectionIsRegular σ₁) (hr₂ : SectionIsRegular σ₂)
    (h : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ₁ = sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ₂) :
    Nonempty (L₁ ≅ L₂)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hq₁, hf₁⟩ := qc_fp_of_hasConstantRank h₁
  obtain ⟨hq₂, hf₂⟩ := qc_fp_of_hasConstantRank h₂
  haveI := hq₁
  haveI := hf₁
  haveI := hq₂
  haveI := hf₂
  have e := dualIso_of_evaluationIdeal_eq
    (KSpecialization.AR7R.isLocalLineFrame_of_hasConstantRank_one h₁)
    (KSpecialization.AR7R.isLocalLineFrame_of_hasConstantRank_one h₂) σ₁ σ₂ hr₁ hr₂ h
  exact nonempty_iso_of_dual_iso h₁ h₂ e

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.scaleRingHom_of_isHomogeneous
proof:
:= by
  have h := eval₂Hom_mul_of_isHomogeneous (MvPolynomial.C (σ := Fin (n + 1)) (R := R))
    (fun j ↦ (MvPolynomial.X j : Polynomial R n)) (MvPolynomial.C u) hp
  have h2 : MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (MvPolynomial.C (σ := Fin (n + 1)) (R := R))
      (fun j ↦ (MvPolynomial.X j : Polynomial R n)) p = p := by
    simp [MvPolynomial.coe_eval₂Hom, MvPolynomial.eval₂_eta]
  rw [h2, ← map_pow] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.gradedScale_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gradedScale_apply (u : R) (p : Polynomial R n) :
    gradedScale u p = scaleRingHom u p
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.gradedScale_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gradedScale_X (u : R) (b : Fin (n + 1)) :
    gradedScale u (MvPolynomial.X b : Polynomial R n) =
      MvPolynomial.X b * MvPolynomial.C u
proof:
:= by
  simp [gradedScale, scaleRingHom]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.irrelevant_le_map_of_X_mem
statement:
theorem irrelevant_le_map_of_X_mem {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] {m n : ℕ}
    (F : grading R m →+*ᵍ grading S n)
    (h : ∀ b : Fin (n + 1), (MvPolynomial.X b : Polynomial S n) ∈
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading R m)).map F) :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading S n) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading R m)).map F
proof:
:= by
  refine (HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_irrelevant_le (grading S n)).2 ?_
  intro d hd p hp
  have hpX : p ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range (MvPolynomial.X (R := S))) := by
    rw [show Set.range (MvPolynomial.X (R := S)) =
        MvPolynomial.X '' (Set.univ : Set (Fin (n + 1))) by simp]
    rw [MvPolynomial.mem_ideal_span_X_image]
    intro m hm
    have hdeg : m.degree = d := by
      rw [Finsupp.degree_eq_weight_one]
      exact hp (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hm)
    have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by
      intro hm0
      subst m
      simp at hdeg
      omega
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Finsupp.ne_iff.mp hm0
    exact ⟨i, Set.mem_univ _, hi⟩
  apply (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_) hpX
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  exact h i

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.irrelevant_le_map_gradedScale
statement:
theorem irrelevant_le_map_gradedScale (u : Rˣ) :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading R n) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading R n)).map (gradedScale (u : R))
proof:
:= by
  refine irrelevant_le_map_of_X_mem _ fun b ↦ ?_
  have h1 : (MvPolynomial.X b : Polynomial R n) =
      gradedScale (u : R) (MvPolynomial.X b * MvPolynomial.C ((u⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R)) := by
    rw [gradedScale_apply, map_mul, scaleRingHom, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X', MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C]
    rw [mul_assoc, ← map_mul]
    simp
  rw [h1]
  exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (gradedScale (u : R))
    (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem (grading R n)
      Nat.zero_lt_one (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n b)))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.awayι_comp_map_gradedScale
statement:
theorem awayι_comp_map_gradedScale (u : Rˣ) {i : ℕ} (hi : 0 < i) {x : Polynomial R n}
    (hx : x ∈ grading R n i) :
    Proj.awayι (grading R n) (gradedScale (u : R) x) ((gradedScale (u : R)).map_mem hx) hi ≫
        Proj.map (gradedScale (u : R)) (irrelevant_le_map_gradedScale u) =
      Proj.awayι (grading R n) (gradedScale (u : R) x) ((gradedScale (u : R)).map_mem hx) hi
proof:
:= by
  have hxeq : (gradedScale (u : R)) x = x * MvPolynomial.C ((u : R) ^ i) :=
    scaleRingHom_of_isHomogeneous (u : R) hx
  have hg : (MvPolynomial.C ((u : R) ^ i) : Polynomial R n) ∈ grading R n 0 :=
    MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_C _ _
  have key := Proj.SpecMap_awayMap_awayι (𝒜 := grading R n) (f_deg := hx) (hm := hi)
    (g_deg := hg) (hx := hxeq)
  have hmap : HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map (gradedScale (u : R)) x =
      HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap (grading R n) hg hxeq := by
    ext z
    obtain ⟨m, a, ha, rfl⟩ := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_surjective (grading R n) hx z
    rw [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap_mk]
    have hnum : (gradedScale (u : R)) a = a * MvPolynomial.C ((u : R) ^ i) ^ m := by
      rw [gradedScale_apply, scaleRingHom_of_isHomogeneous (u : R) (d := m • i) ha,
        ← map_pow, ← pow_mul]
      simp [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
    simp only [hnum]
  rw [Proj.awayι_comp_map _ _ hi _ hx, hmap]
  exact key

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.map_gradedScale
statement:
theorem map_gradedScale (u : Rˣ) :
    Proj.map (gradedScale (u : R)) (irrelevant_le_map_gradedScale u) = 𝟙 (space R n)
proof:
:= by
  refine (Proj.mapAffineOpenCover (gradedScale (u : R))
    (irrelevant_le_map_gradedScale u)).openCover.hom_ext _ _ fun s ↦ ?_
  simp only [Scheme.AffineOpenCover.openCover_f, Proj.mapAffineOpenCover_f]
  exact awayι_comp_map_gradedScale u s.1.pos s.2.2

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.segreGraded_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem segreGraded_apply (p : Polynomial k M) :

proof: := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.segreRingHom_coordinate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem segreRingHom_coordinate (a : Fin (N + 1)) (b : Fin (n + 1)) :
    segreRingHom e κ c (coordinate k M (e (a, b))) =
      MvPolynomial.C (c a) * MvPolynomial.X b
proof:
:= by
  simp [segreRingHom, coordinate]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.segreRingHom_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem segreRingHom_C (a : k) :
    segreRingHom e κ c (MvPolynomial.C a) = MvPolynomial.C (κ a)
proof:
:= by
  simp [segreRingHom]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.segreRingHom_ext
proof:
:=
  MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext h1 h2

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.gradedMap_comp_segreGraded
statement:
theorem gradedMap_comp_segreGraded {S : Type u} [CommRing S] (g : R →+* S) :
    (gradedMap g n).comp (segreGraded e κ c) = segreGraded e (g.comp κ) (fun a ↦ g (c a))
proof:
:= by
  apply GradedRingHom.ext
  intro p
  have : ((gradedMap g n : grading R n →+*ᵍ grading S n) : Polynomial R n →+* Polynomial S n).comp
      (segreRingHom e κ c) = segreRingHom e (g.comp κ) (fun a ↦ g (c a)) := by
    apply segreRingHom_ext
    · intro a; simp
    · intro m
      obtain ⟨⟨a, b⟩, rfl⟩ := e.surjective m
      change MvPolynomial.map g (segreRingHom e κ c (coordinate k M (e (a, b)))) =
        segreRingHom e (g.comp κ) (fun a ↦ g (c a)) (coordinate k M (e (a, b)))
      rw [segreRingHom_coordinate, segreRingHom_coordinate]
      simp
  exact RingHom.congr_fun this p

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.gradedScale_comp_segreGraded
statement:
theorem gradedScale_comp_segreGraded (u : R) :
    (gradedScale u).comp (segreGraded e κ c) = segreGraded e κ (fun a ↦ c a * u)
proof:
:= by
  apply GradedRingHom.ext
  intro p
  have : ((gradedScale u : grading R n →+*ᵍ grading R n) : Polynomial R n →+* Polynomial R n).comp
      (segreRingHom e κ c) = segreRingHom e κ (fun a ↦ c a * u) := by
    apply segreRingHom_ext
    · intro a; simp [scaleRingHom]
    · intro m
      obtain ⟨⟨a, b⟩, rfl⟩ := e.surjective m
      change gradedScale u (segreRingHom e κ c (coordinate k M (e (a, b)))) =
        segreRingHom e κ (fun a ↦ c a * u) (coordinate k M (e (a, b)))
      rw [segreRingHom_coordinate, segreRingHom_coordinate, map_mul, gradedScale_X]
      simp only [gradedScale_apply, scaleRingHom, MvPolynomial.C_mul, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C]
      ring
  exact RingHom.congr_fun this p

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.irrelevant_le_map_segreGraded
statement:
theorem irrelevant_le_map_segreGraded (hc : ∃ a₀, c a₀ = 1) :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading R n) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading k M)).map (segreGraded e κ c)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ := hc
  refine irrelevant_le_map_of_X_mem _ fun b ↦ ?_
  have h1 : (MvPolynomial.X b : Polynomial R n) =
      segreGraded e κ c (coordinate k M (e (a₀, b))) := by
    rw [segreGraded_apply, segreRingHom_coordinate, ha₀]
    simp
  rw [h1]
  exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _
    (HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem (grading k M) Nat.zero_lt_one
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k M _))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.segreMap_scale
statement:
theorem segreMap_scale (u : Rˣ) (hc : ∃ a₀, c a₀ = 1) (hc' : ∃ a₀, c a₀ * (u : R) = 1) :
    segreMap e κ (fun a ↦ c a * (u : R)) hc' = segreMap e κ c hc
proof:
:= by
  unfold segreMap
  have h := Proj.map_comp (segreGraded e κ c) (gradedScale (u : R))
    (irrelevant_le_map_segreGraded e κ c hc) (irrelevant_le_map_gradedScale u)
  have h1 : Proj.map (gradedScale (u : R)) (irrelevant_le_map_gradedScale u) =
      𝟙 (Proj (grading R n)) := map_gradedScale u
  rw [h1, Category.id_comp] at h
  rw [← h]
  congr 1
  exact (gradedScale_comp_segreGraded e κ c (u : R)).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.map_comp_segreMap
statement:
theorem map_comp_segreMap {S : Type u} [CommRing S] (g : R →+* S) (hc : ∃ a₀, c a₀ = 1)
    (hc' : ∃ a₀, g (c a₀) = 1) :
    map g n ≫ segreMap e κ c hc = segreMap e (g.comp κ) (fun a ↦ g (c a)) hc'
proof:
:= by
  unfold segreMap map space
  rw [← Proj.map_comp]
  congr 1
  exact gradedMap_comp_segreGraded e κ c g

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.xi_self
statement: theorem xi_self (i : Fin (N + 1)) : xi k N i i = 1
proof:
:= by

  simp only [xi, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.val_one, pow_one]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.lam_xi
statement:
theorem lam_xi (i j a : Fin (N + 1)) :
    lam1 k N i j (xi k N i a) = lam2 k N i j (xi k N j a) * lam1 k N i j (xi k N i j)
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp only [lam1, lam2, xi, HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap_mk,
    HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk]
  rw [Localization.mk_mul, Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  simp only [pow_one, Submonoid.coe_mul, OneMemClass.coe_one]
  ring

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.lam_xi_unit
statement:
theorem lam_xi_unit (i j : Fin (N + 1)) :
    lam1 k N i j (xi k N i j) * lam2 k N i j (xi k N j i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp only [lam1, lam2, xi, HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap_mk,
    HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk,
    HomogeneousLocalization.val_one]
  rw [Localization.mk_mul, ← Localization.mk_one, Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff,
    Localization.r_iff_exists]
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  simp only [pow_one, Submonoid.coe_mul, OneMemClass.coe_one]
  ring

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.map_comp_map
statement:
theorem map_comp_map {R S T : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
    (f : R →+* S) (g : S →+* T) (n : ℕ) :
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.map g n ≫ SchemeProjectiveSpace.map f n =
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.map (g.comp f) n
proof:
:= by
  unfold SchemeProjectiveSpace.map space
  rw [← Proj.map_comp]
  congr 1
  apply GradedRingHom.ext
  intro p
  simp [MvPolynomial.map_map]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.awayChart_comp_toSpec

    awayChart k N i ≫ toSpec k N =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (coefficientToCoordinateAway k N i))
proof:
:=
  coordinateAwayι_comp_toSpec k N i

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.jChart_fst
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem jChart_fst (i : Fin (N + 1)) :
    jChart k N n i ≫ pullback.fst _ _ = toSpec (Aff k N i) n ≫ awayChart k N i
proof:
:=
  pullback.lift_fst _ _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.jChart_snd
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem jChart_snd (i : Fin (N + 1)) :
    jChart k N n i ≫ pullback.snd _ _ =
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.map (coefficientToCoordinateAway k N i) n
proof:
:=
  pullback.lift_snd _ _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.isPullback_jChart
statement:
theorem isPullback_jChart (i : Fin (N + 1)) :
    IsPullback (jChart k N n i) (toSpec (Aff k N i) n) (pullback.fst _ _) (awayChart k N i)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := isPullback_map_toSpec (coefficientToCoordinateAway k N i) n
  have h2 : IsPullback (pullback.snd (toSpec k N) (toSpec k n)) (pullback.fst _ _)
      (toSpec k n) (toSpec k N) := (IsPullback.of_hasPullback _ _).flip
  refine IsPullback.of_right (h₁₁ := jChart k N n i) (h₁₂ := pullback.snd _ _)
    (h₂₁ := awayChart k N i) (h₂₂ := toSpec k N) ?_ ?_ h2
  · rw [jChart_snd, awayChart_comp_toSpec]
    exact h1
  · exact jChart_fst k N n i

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.range_jChart
statement:
theorem range_jChart (i : Fin (N + 1)) :
    Set.range (jChart k N n i) =
      (pullback.fst (toSpec k N) (toSpec k n)) ⁻¹' Set.range (awayChart k N i)
proof:
:= by
  have hp := isPullback_jChart k N n i
  rw [← hp.isoPullback_hom_fst]
  simp only [Scheme.Hom.comp_base, TopCat.hom_comp, ContinuousMap.coe_comp, Set.range_comp]
  rw [Set.range_eq_univ.mpr (by exact hp.isoPullback.hom.homeomorph.surjective), Set.image_univ]
  rw [IsOpenImmersion.range_pullbackFst]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.lam1_kappa
statement:
theorem lam1_kappa (i j : Fin (N + 1)) :
    (lam1 k N i j).comp (coefficientToCoordinateAway k N i) = kappa2 i j
proof:
:= by
  refine RingHom.ext fun a ↦ ?_
  simp only [coefficientToCoordinateAway, kappa2, lam1, RingHom.comp_apply,
    HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_eq]
  exact HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap_fromZeroRingHom (grading k N)
    (coordinate_mem_degree_one k N j) rfl _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.lam2_kappa
statement:
theorem lam2_kappa (i j : Fin (N + 1)) :
    (lam2 k N i j).comp (coefficientToCoordinateAway k N j) = kappa2 i j
proof:
:= by
  refine RingHom.ext fun a ↦ ?_
  simp only [coefficientToCoordinateAway, kappa2, lam2, RingHom.comp_apply,
    HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_eq]
  exact HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap_fromZeroRingHom (grading k N)
    (coordinate_mem_degree_one k N i)
    ((rfl : coordinate k N i * coordinate k N j = _).trans (mul_comm _ _)) _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.segreMap_congr
proof:
:= by
  subst h1 h2
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.segreChart_compat
statement:
theorem segreChart_compat (i j : Fin (N + 1)) {T : Scheme.{u}}
    (q1 : T ⟶ space (Aff k N i) n) (q2 : T ⟶ space (Aff k N j) n)
    (h : q1 ≫ jChart k N n i = q2 ≫ jChart k N n j) :
    q1 ≫ segreChart e i = q2 ≫ segreChart e j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hα : (q1 ≫ toSpec (Aff k N i) n) ≫ awayChart k N i =
      (q2 ≫ toSpec (Aff k N j) n) ≫ awayChart k N j := by
    have := congrArg (fun t ↦ t ≫ pullback.fst (toSpec k N) (toSpec k n)) h
    simpa [Category.assoc] using this
  have hβ : q1 ≫ SchemeProjectiveSpace.map (coefficientToCoordinateAway k N i) n =
      q2 ≫ SchemeProjectiveSpace.map (coefficientToCoordinateAway k N j) n := by
    have := congrArg (fun t ↦ t ≫ pullback.snd (toSpec k N) (toSpec k n)) h
    simpa [Category.assoc] using this
  
  let hpi := Proj.pullbackAwayιIso (grading k N) (coordinate_mem_degree_one k N i) Nat.zero_lt_one
    (coordinate_mem_degree_one k N j) Nat.zero_lt_one
    (x := coordinate k N i * coordinate k N j) rfl
  let c : T ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of (Aff2 k N i j)) :=
    pullback.lift (q1 ≫ toSpec (Aff k N i) n) (q2 ≫ toSpec (Aff k N j) n) hα ≫ hpi.hom
  have hc1 : c ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (lam1 k N i j)) = q1 ≫ toSpec (Aff k N i) n := by
    simp only [c, Category.assoc]
    erw [Proj.pullbackAwayιIso_hom_SpecMap_awayMap_left]
    exact pullback.lift_fst _ _ _
  have hc2 : c ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (lam2 k N i j)) = q2 ≫ toSpec (Aff k N j) n := by
    simp only [c, Category.assoc]
    erw [Proj.pullbackAwayιIso_hom_SpecMap_awayMap_right]
    exact pullback.lift_snd _ _ _
  have hspec : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (kappa2 i j : k →+* Aff2 k N i j)) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (lam1 k N i j)) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (coefficientToCoordinateAway k N i)) := by
    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, lam1_kappa]
  have hP2 := isPullback_map_toSpec (kappa2 i j : k →+* Aff2 k N i j) n
  let q : T ⟶ space (Aff2 k N i j) n :=
    hP2.lift (q1 ≫ SchemeProjectiveSpace.map (coefficientToCoordinateAway k N i) n) c (by
      rw [hspec, ← Category.assoc c, hc1, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, ← map_toSpec])
  have hq_fst : q ≫ SchemeProjectiveSpace.map (kappa2 i j : k →+* Aff2 k N i j) n =
      q1 ≫ SchemeProjectiveSpace.map (coefficientToCoordinateAway k N i) n :=
    hP2.lift_fst _ _ _
  have hq_snd : q ≫ toSpec (Aff2 k N i j) n = c := hP2.lift_snd _ _ _
  have hq1 : q ≫ SchemeProjectiveSpace.map (lam1 k N i j) n = q1 := by
    refine (isPullback_map_toSpec (coefficientToCoordinateAway k N i) n).hom_ext ?_ ?_
    · rw [Category.assoc, map_comp_map, lam1_kappa, hq_fst]
    · rw [Category.assoc, map_toSpec, ← Category.assoc, hq_snd, hc1]
  have hq2 : q ≫ SchemeProjectiveSpace.map (lam2 k N i j) n = q2 := by
    refine (isPullback_map_toSpec (coefficientToCoordinateAway k N j) n).hom_ext ?_ ?_
    · rw [Category.assoc, map_comp_map, lam2_kappa, hq_fst, hβ]
    · rw [Category.assoc, map_toSpec, ← Category.assoc, hq_snd, hc2]
  have e1 : SchemeProjectiveSpace.map (lam1 k N i j) n ≫ segreChart e i =
      segreMap e (kappa2 i j) (fun a ↦ lam1 k N i j (xi k N i a))
        ⟨i, by simp [xi_self]⟩ := by
    unfold segreChart
    rw [map_comp_segreMap e (coefficientToCoordinateAway k N i) (xi k N i) (lam1 k N i j)
      ⟨i, xi_self k N i⟩ ⟨i, by simp [xi_self]⟩]
    exact segreMap_congr e _ _ (lam1_kappa i j) rfl
  have e2 : SchemeProjectiveSpace.map (lam2 k N i j) n ≫ segreChart e j =
      segreMap e (kappa2 i j) (fun a ↦ lam2 k N i j (xi k N j a))
        ⟨j, by simp [xi_self]⟩ := by
    unfold segreChart
    rw [map_comp_segreMap e (coefficientToCoordinateAway k N j) (xi k N j) (lam2 k N i j)
      ⟨j, xi_self k N j⟩ ⟨j, by simp [xi_self]⟩]
    exact segreMap_congr e _ _ (lam2_kappa i j) rfl
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one _ (lam_xi_unit k N i j)
  have e3 : segreMap e (kappa2 i j) (fun a ↦ lam1 k N i j (xi k N i a))
        ⟨i, by simp [xi_self]⟩ =
      segreMap e (kappa2 i j) (fun a ↦ lam2 k N i j (xi k N j a))
        ⟨j, by simp [xi_self]⟩ := by
    rw [← segreMap_scale e (kappa2 i j) (fun a ↦ lam2 k N i j (xi k N j a)) u
      ⟨j, by simp [xi_self]⟩ ⟨i, by simp only [hu]; rw [mul_comm]; exact lam_xi_unit k N i j⟩]
    refine segreMap_congr e _ _ rfl ?_
    funext a
    rw [hu, lam_xi]
  calc q1 ≫ segreChart e i = (q ≫ SchemeProjectiveSpace.map (lam1 k N i j) n) ≫ segreChart e i := by
        rw [hq1]
    _ = q ≫ segreMap e (kappa2 i j) (fun a ↦ lam1 k N i j (xi k N i a))
        ⟨i, by simp [xi_self]⟩ := by rw [Category.assoc, e1]
    _ = q ≫ segreMap e (kappa2 i j) (fun a ↦ lam2 k N i j (xi k N j a))
        ⟨j, by simp [xi_self]⟩ := by rw [e3]
    _ = (q ≫ SchemeProjectiveSpace.map (lam2 k N i j) n) ≫ segreChart e j := by
        rw [Category.assoc, e2]
    _ = q2 ≫ segreChart e j := by rw [hq2]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.jChart_segreHom
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem jChart_segreHom (i : Fin (N + 1)) :
    jChart k N n i ≫ segreHom e = segreChart e i
proof:
:=
  (segreCover k N n).ι_glueMorphisms _ _ i

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.awayCast_mk'
statement:
theorem awayCast_mk' {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {m : ℕ} (d : ℕ) {p q : Polynomial R m}
    (h : p = q) (hp : p ∈ grading R m 1) (r : Polynomial R m) (hr : r ∈ grading R m d) :
    (RingEquiv.cast
        (R := fun x : Polynomial R m ↦ HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading R m) x) h).toRingHom
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading R m) hp d r (by simpa using hr)) =
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading R m) (h ▸ hp) d r (by simpa using hr)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.kappaAway_eq_mk
statement:
theorem kappaAway_eq_mk (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (m : ℕ) (i : Fin (m + 1)) (r : R) :
    coefficientToCoordinateAway R m i r =
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading R m) (coordinate_mem_degree_one R m i) 0
        (MvPolynomial.C r) (by simp)
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective _
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.psi_z
statement:
theorem psi_z (a : Fin (N + 1)) (b : Fin (n + 1)) :
    psiA e a (coordinate k M (e (a, b))) = coordinate (Aff k N a) n b
proof:
:= by
  rw [segreGraded_apply, segreRingHom_coordinate, xi_self]
  simp [coordinate]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.theta_mk
statement:
theorem theta_mk (a : Fin (N + 1)) (b : Fin (n + 1)) (d : ℕ) (q : Polynomial k M)
    (hq : q ∈ grading k M d) :
    theta e a b (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading k M) (coordinate_mem_degree_one k M _)
        d q (by simpa using hq)) =
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading (Aff k N a) n)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one (Aff k N a) n b) d (psiA e a q)
        (by simpa using (psiA e a).map_mem hq)
proof:
:= by
  unfold theta
  rw [RingHom.comp_apply, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map_mk]
  exact awayCast_mk' d (psi_z e a b) ((psiA e a).map_mem (coordinate_mem_degree_one k M _))
    (psiA e a q) ((psiA e a).map_mem hq)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.theta_kappa
statement:
theorem theta_kappa (a : Fin (N + 1)) (b : Fin (n + 1)) (c : k) :
    theta e a b (coefficientToCoordinateAway k M (e (a, b)) c) =
      coefficientToCoordinateAway (Aff k N a) n b (coefficientToCoordinateAway k N a c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [kappaAway_eq_mk k M (e (a, b)) c,
    theta_mk e a b 0 (MvPolynomial.C c) (MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_C _ _),
    kappaAway_eq_mk (Aff k N a) n b]
  simp only [segreGraded_apply, segreRingHom_C]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.theta_xi_b
statement:
theorem theta_xi_b (a x : Fin (N + 1)) (b : Fin (n + 1)) :
    theta e a b (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading k M)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one k M (e (a, b))) 1 (coordinate k M (e (x, b)))
        (by simpa using coordinate_mem_degree_one k M (e (x, b)))) =
      coefficientToCoordinateAway (Aff k N a) n b (xi k N a x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [theta_mk e a b 1 _ (coordinate_mem_degree_one k M (e (x, b))),
    kappaAway_eq_mk (Aff k N a) n b (xi k N a x)]
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp only [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, segreGraded_apply, segreRingHom_coordinate]
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  simp [coordinate]
  ring

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.theta_xi_a
statement:
theorem theta_xi_a (a : Fin (N + 1)) (b y : Fin (n + 1)) :
    theta e a b (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading k M)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one k M (e (a, b))) 1 (coordinate k M (e (a, y)))
        (by simpa using coordinate_mem_degree_one k M (e (a, y)))) =
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading (Aff k N a) n)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one (Aff k N a) n b) 1 (coordinate (Aff k N a) n y)
        (by simpa using coordinate_mem_degree_one (Aff k N a) n y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [theta_mk e a b 1 _ (coordinate_mem_degree_one k M (e (a, y)))]
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp only [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, segreGraded_apply, segreRingHom_coordinate,
    xi_self]
  simp [coordinate]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.theta_surjective
statement:
theorem theta_surjective (a : Fin (N + 1)) (b : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Function.Surjective ⇑(theta (k := k) e a b)
proof:
:= by
  have hr : ∀ r : Aff k N a,
      coefficientToCoordinateAway (Aff k N a) n b r ∈ (theta (k := k) e a b).range := by
    intro r
    obtain ⟨P, rfl⟩ := awayCoordinateHom_surjective k N a r
    induction P using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
    | C c =>
      refine ⟨coefficientToCoordinateAway k M (e (a, b)) c, ?_⟩
      rw [theta_kappa]
      simp [awayCoordinateHom]
    | add p q hp hq =>
      rw [map_add, map_add]
      exact add_mem hp hq
    | mul_X p x hp =>
      rw [map_mul, map_mul]
      refine mul_mem hp ?_
      refine ⟨HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading k M)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one k M (e (a, b))) 1 (coordinate k M (e (x.1, b)))
        (by simpa using coordinate_mem_degree_one k M (e (x.1, b))), ?_⟩
      rw [theta_xi_b]
      simp [awayCoordinateHom, coordinateRatio, xi]
  intro t
  obtain ⟨P, rfl⟩ := awayCoordinateHom_surjective (Aff k N a) n b t
  suffices h : awayCoordinateHom (Aff k N a) n b P ∈ (theta (k := k) e a b).range from h
  induction P using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C r =>
    simpa [awayCoordinateHom] using hr r
  | add p q hp hq =>
    rw [map_add]
    exact add_mem hp hq
  | mul_X p y hp =>
    rw [map_mul]
    refine mul_mem hp ?_
    refine ⟨HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading k M)
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k M (e (a, b))) 1 (coordinate k M (e (a, y.1)))
      (by simpa using coordinate_mem_degree_one k M (e (a, y.1))), ?_⟩
    rw [theta_xi_a]
    simp [awayCoordinateHom, coordinateRatio]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.awayChartN_comp_segreChart
statement:
theorem awayChartN_comp_segreChart (a : Fin (N + 1)) (b : Fin (n + 1)) :
    awayChartN (Aff k N a) n b ≫ segreChart (k := k) e a =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (theta (k := k) e a b)) ≫
        Proj.awayι (grading k M) (coordinate k M (e (a, b)))
          (coordinate_mem_degree_one k M _) Nat.zero_lt_one
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := awayι_eq_of_eq n (psi_z (k := k) e a b)
    ((psiA e a).map_mem (coordinate_mem_degree_one k M (e (a, b))))
  have h2 := Proj.awayι_comp_map (psiA e a) (irrelevant_le_map_segreGraded e _ _ ⟨a, xi_self k N a⟩)
    Nat.zero_lt_one (coordinate k M (e (a, b))) (coordinate_mem_degree_one k M _)
  unfold segreChart segreMap
  change Proj.awayι (grading (Aff k N a) n) (coordinate (Aff k N a) n b) _ Nat.zero_lt_one ≫
    Proj.map (psiA e a) _ = _
  rw [h1, Category.assoc, h2, ← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.awayChartN_comp_toSpec
statement:
theorem awayChartN_comp_toSpec (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (m : ℕ) (d : Fin (m + 1)) :
    awayChartN R m d ≫ toSpec R m =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (coefficientToCoordinateAway R m d))
proof:
:=
  coordinateAwayι_comp_toSpec R m d

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.toSpec_awayChartN_mem
statement:
theorem toSpec_awayChartN_mem {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {m : ℕ} (r : R) (q : Polynomial R m)
    (hq : q ∈ grading R m 1) (d : Fin (m + 1)) (p' : Spec (CommRingCat.of (Aff R m d)))
    (hp : (awayChartN R m d).base p' ∈ Proj.basicOpen (grading R m) (MvPolynomial.C r * q)) :
    (toSpec R m).base ((awayChartN R m d).base p') ∈ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : (MvPolynomial.C r * q : Polynomial R m) ∈ grading R m 1 := by
    have := (MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_C (σ := Fin (m + 1)) r).mul hq
    simpa using this
  have heq := Proj.awayι_preimage_basicOpen (𝒜 := grading R m)
    (f_deg := coordinate_mem_degree_one R m d) (hm := Nat.zero_lt_one) (g_deg := hmem)
    (hm' := Nat.zero_lt_one)
  have h1 : p' ∈ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen
      (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.isLocalizationElem
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one R m d) hmem) := by
    rw [← heq]
    exact hp
  have hel : HomogeneousLocalization.Away.isLocalizationElem
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one R m d) hmem =
      coefficientToCoordinateAway R m d r *
        HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading R m) (coordinate_mem_degree_one R m d) 1 q
          (by simpa using hq) := by
    apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
    rw [kappaAway_eq_mk R m d r]
    simp only [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk]
    rw [Localization.mk_mul, Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    simp only [pow_one, pow_zero, one_mul, Submonoid.coe_mul]
    try ring
  rw [hel, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_mul] at h1
  have h2 : p' ∈ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (coefficientToCoordinateAway R m d r) := h1.1
  have h3 : (toSpec R m).base ((awayChartN R m d).base p') =
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (coefficientToCoordinateAway R m d))).base p' :=
    congrArg (fun f ↦ f.base p') (awayChartN_comp_toSpec R m d)
  have h4 : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (coefficientToCoordinateAway R m d))).base p' =
      PrimeSpectrum.comap (coefficientToCoordinateAway R m d) p' := rfl
  rw [h3, h4]
  exact (PrimeSpectrum.mem_basicOpen r
    (PrimeSpectrum.comap (coefficientToCoordinateAway R m d) p')).2
    ((PrimeSpectrum.mem_basicOpen _ _).1 h2)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.toSpec_mem_basicOpen
statement:
theorem toSpec_mem_basicOpen {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {m : ℕ} (r : R) (q : Polynomial R m)
    (hq : q ∈ grading R m 1) (p : space R m)
    (hp : p ∈ Proj.basicOpen (grading R m) (MvPolynomial.C r * q)) :
    (toSpec R m).base p ∈ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p', hp'⟩ := (coordinateAffineOpenCover R m).covers p
  have hp'' : (awayChartN R m ((coordinateAffineOpenCover R m).idx p)).base p' = p := hp'
  have := toSpec_awayChartN_mem r q hq ((coordinateAffineOpenCover R m).idx p) p'
    (by rw [hp'']; exact hp)
  rwa [hp''] at this

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.mem_basicOpen_xi_iff
statement:
theorem mem_basicOpen_xi_iff {k : Type u} [CommRing k] {N : ℕ} (i a : Fin (N + 1))
    (x : Spec (CommRingCat.of (Aff k N i))) :
    (awayChartN k N i).base x ∈ Proj.basicOpen (grading k N) (coordinate k N a) ↔
      x ∈ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (xi k N i a)
proof:
:= by
  have heq := Proj.awayι_preimage_basicOpen (𝒜 := grading k N)
    (f_deg := coordinate_mem_degree_one k N i) (hm := Nat.zero_lt_one)
    (g_deg := coordinate_mem_degree_one k N a) (hm' := Nat.zero_lt_one)
  have hel : HomogeneousLocalization.Away.isLocalizationElem
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one k N i) (coordinate_mem_degree_one k N a) = xi k N i a := by
    apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
    simp [xi]
  rw [hel] at heq
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [← heq]
    exact h
  · intro h
    rw [← heq] at h
    exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.gChart_comp_segreHom
statement:
theorem gChart_comp_segreHom (a : Fin (N + 1)) (b : Fin (n + 1)) :
    gChart (k := k) a b ≫ segreHom e =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (theta (k := k) e a b)) ≫ awayChartN k M (e (a, b))
proof:
:= by
  unfold gChart
  rw [Category.assoc, jChart_segreHom]
  exact awayChartN_comp_segreChart e a b

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.fst_mem_of_segreChart_mem
statement:
theorem fst_mem_of_segreChart_mem (a : Fin (N + 1)) (b : Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin (N + 1))
    (p : space (Aff k N i) n)
    (hw : (segreChart e i).base p ∈ Proj.basicOpen (grading k M) (coordinate k M (e (a, b)))) :
    (pullback.fst (toSpec k N) (toSpec k n)).base ((jChart k N n i).base p) ∈
      Proj.basicOpen (grading k N) (coordinate k N a)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : p ∈ Proj.basicOpen (grading (Aff k N i) n) (MvPolynomial.C (xi k N i a) *
      coordinate (Aff k N i) n b) := by
    have := Proj.map_preimage_basicOpen (psiA e i)
      (irrelevant_le_map_segreGraded e _ _ ⟨i, xi_self k N i⟩) (coordinate k M (e (a, b)))
    have h3 : p ∈ Proj.map (psiA e i) (irrelevant_le_map_segreGraded e _ _ ⟨i, xi_self k N i⟩) ⁻¹ᵁ
        Proj.basicOpen (grading k M) (coordinate k M (e (a, b))) := hw
    rw [this] at h3
    have hz : psiA e i (coordinate k M (e (a, b))) =
        MvPolynomial.C (xi k N i a) * coordinate (Aff k N i) n b := by
      rw [segreGraded_apply, segreRingHom_coordinate]
      rfl
    rw [hz] at h3
    exact h3
  have h4 := toSpec_mem_basicOpen (xi k N i a) (coordinate (Aff k N i) n b)
    (coordinate_mem_degree_one _ n b) p h2
  have h5 : (pullback.fst (toSpec k N) (toSpec k n)).base ((jChart k N n i).base p) =
      (awayChartN k N i).base ((toSpec (Aff k N i) n).base p) := by
    have := congrArg (fun f ↦ f.base p) (jChart_fst (k := k) N n i)
    exact this
  rw [h5]
  exact (mem_basicOpen_xi_iff i a _).2 h4

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.fst_mem_of_segreHom_mem
statement:
theorem fst_mem_of_segreHom_mem (a : Fin (N + 1)) (b : Fin (n + 1)) (w : segreSource k N n)
    (hw : (segreHom e).base w ∈ Proj.basicOpen (grading k M) (coordinate k M (e (a, b)))) :
    (pullback.fst (toSpec k N) (toSpec k n)).base w ∈
      Proj.basicOpen (grading k N) (coordinate k N a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := (segreCover k N n).covers w
  have hp' : (jChart k N n ((segreCover k N n).idx w)).base p = w := hp
  rw [← hp'] at hw ⊢
  have h1 : (segreHom e).base ((jChart k N n ((segreCover k N n).idx w)).base p) =
      (segreChart e ((segreCover k N n).idx w)).base p := by
    have := congrArg (fun f ↦ f.base p) (jChart_segreHom (k := k) e ((segreCover k N n).idx w))
    exact this
  rw [h1] at hw
  exact fst_mem_of_segreChart_mem e a b _ p hw

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.range_awayChartN_eq
statement:
theorem range_awayChartN_eq {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {m : ℕ} (i : Fin (m + 1)) (x : space R m) :
    x ∈ Set.range (awayChartN R m i).base ↔ x ∈ Proj.basicOpen (grading R m) (coordinate R m i)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Proj.opensRange_awayι (grading R m) (coordinate R m i)
    (coordinate_mem_degree_one R m i) Nat.zero_lt_one
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rw [← h]
    exact hx
  · intro hx
    rw [← h] at hx
    exact hx

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.range_pullback_segreHom
statement:
theorem range_pullback_segreHom (a : Fin (N + 1)) (b : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Set.range (pullback.fst (segreHom e) (awayChartN k M (e (a, b)))).base =
      Set.range (gChart (k := k) a b).base
proof:
:= by
  have hr := IsOpenImmersion.range_pullbackFst (awayChartN k M (e (a, b))) (segreHom e)
  ext w
  constructor
  · intro hw
    have hw1 : w ∈ (segreHom e) ⁻¹ᵁ (awayChartN k M (e (a, b))).opensRange := by
      rw [hr] at hw
      exact hw
    have hw2 : (segreHom e).base w ∈ Proj.basicOpen (grading k M) (coordinate k M (e (a, b))) :=
      (range_awayChartN_eq (e (a, b)) _).1 hw1
    have hf := fst_mem_of_segreHom_mem e a b w hw2
    have hr : w ∈ Set.range (jChart k N n a).base := by
      rw [range_jChart]
      exact (range_awayChartN_eq a _).2 hf
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hr
    have hp1 : (segreHom e).base ((jChart k N n a).base p) = (segreChart e a).base p := by
      have := congrArg (fun f ↦ f.base p) (jChart_segreHom (k := k) e a)
      exact this
    rw [hp1] at hw2
    have hp2 : p ∈ Proj.basicOpen (grading (Aff k N a) n) (coordinate (Aff k N a) n b) := by
      have := Proj.map_preimage_basicOpen (psiA e a)
        (irrelevant_le_map_segreGraded e _ _ ⟨a, xi_self k N a⟩) (coordinate k M (e (a, b)))
      have h3 : p ∈ Proj.map (psiA e a) (irrelevant_le_map_segreGraded e _ _ ⟨a, xi_self k N a⟩) ⁻¹ᵁ
          Proj.basicOpen (grading k M) (coordinate k M (e (a, b))) := hw2
      rw [this, psi_z] at h3
      exact h3
    obtain ⟨p', rfl⟩ := (range_awayChartN_eq b p).2 hp2
    exact ⟨p', rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨p', rfl⟩
    have hc := congrArg (fun f ↦ f.base p') (gChart_comp_segreHom (k := k) e a b)
    have hc' : (segreHom e).base ((gChart (k := k) a b).base p') ∈
        Set.range (awayChartN k M (e (a, b))).base := by
      have : (segreHom e).base ((gChart (k := k) a b).base p') =
          (awayChartN k M (e (a, b))).base
            ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (theta (k := k) e a b))).base p') := hc
      rw [this]
      exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [hr]
    exact hc'

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.isClosedImmersion_segreHom
statement: theorem isClosedImmersion_segreHom : IsClosedImmersion (segreHom (k := k) e)
proof:
:= by
  refine IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.of_openCover
    (coordinateAffineOpenCover k M).openCover ?_
  intro c
  obtain ⟨⟨a, b⟩, rfl⟩ := e.surjective c
  change IsClosedImmersion (pullback.snd (segreHom e) (awayChartN k M (e (a, b))))
  let ι := IsOpenImmersion.isoOfRangeEq (pullback.fst (segreHom e) (awayChartN k M (e (a, b))))
    (gChart (k := k) a b) (range_pullback_segreHom e a b)
  have hι : ι.hom ≫ gChart (k := k) a b = pullback.fst (segreHom e) (awayChartN k M (e (a, b))) :=
    IsOpenImmersion.isoOfRangeEq_hom_fac _ _ _
  have hfst : pullback.snd (segreHom e) (awayChartN k M (e (a, b))) =
      ι.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (theta (k := k) e a b)) := by
    rw [← cancel_mono (awayChartN k M (e (a, b))), ← pullback.condition, ← hι, Category.assoc,
      Category.assoc, gChart_comp_segreHom]
  rw [hfst]
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (theta (k := k) e a b))) :=
    IsClosedImmersion.spec_of_surjective _ (theta_surjective (k := k) e a b)
  infer_instance

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.isPullback_prodMap
statement:
theorem isPullback_prodMap {X : Scheme.{u}} (π : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (j : X ⟶ space k N) (hj : j ≫ toSpec k N = π) :
    IsPullback (prodMap (n := n) π j hj) (pullback.fst π (toSpec k n)) (pullback.fst _ _) j
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : IsPullback (pullback.snd (toSpec k N) (toSpec k n)) (pullback.fst _ _)
      (toSpec k n) (toSpec k N) := (IsPullback.of_hasPullback _ _).flip
  have h1 : IsPullback (pullback.snd π (toSpec k n)) (pullback.fst _ _) (toSpec k n) π :=
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback _ _).flip
  refine IsPullback.of_right (h₁₁ := prodMap (n := n) π j hj) (h₁₂ := pullback.snd _ _)
    (h₂₁ := j) (h₂₂ := toSpec k N) ?_ ?_ h2
  · have : prodMap (n := n) π j hj ≫ pullback.snd (toSpec k N) (toSpec k n) =
        pullback.snd π (toSpec k n) := by
      unfold prodMap pullback.map
      rw [pullback.lift_snd]
      simp
    rw [this, hj]
    exact h1
  · unfold prodMap pullback.map
    rw [pullback.lift_fst]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.isClosedImmersion_segreOn
statement:
theorem isClosedImmersion_segreOn {X : Scheme.{u}} (π : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (j : X ⟶ space k N) [IsClosedImmersion j] (hj : j ≫ toSpec k N = π) :
    IsClosedImmersion (segreOn (n := n) e π j hj)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion (prodMap (n := n) π j hj) :=
    MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (isPullback_prodMap π j hj).flip inferInstance
  haveI := isClosedImmersion_segreHom (k := k) e
  unfold segreOn
  infer_instance

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.isFiniteLocallyFree_tautologicalKernel
statement:
theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_tautologicalKernel (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree Z E) :
    IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme C.tautologicalKernel
proof:
:=
  isFiniteLocallyFree_kernel C.scheme (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global C.toBase E hE)
    (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).isFiniteLocallyFree C.tautologicalQuotient

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.classOf_tautologicalKernel_add
statement:
theorem classOf_tautologicalKernel_add (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree Z E) :
    k0ClassOf C.scheme C.tautologicalKernel (C.isFiniteLocallyFree_tautologicalKernel hE) +
        k0ClassOf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
          (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).isFiniteLocallyFree =
      pullbackK0RingHom C.toBase (k0ClassOf Z E hE)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pullbackK0RingHom_classOf]
  exact (ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_middle C.scheme.Modules
    (IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme) _ _ _ C.tautologicalKernelι_comp
    C.tautologicalKernel_shortExact).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullback_classOf_tautologicalKernel
statement:
theorem pullback_classOf_tautologicalKernel (s : Z ⟶ C.scheme) (hs : s ≫ C.toBase = 𝟙 Z)
    (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree Z E) :
    pullbackK0RingHom s
        (k0ClassOf C.scheme C.tautologicalKernel (C.isFiniteLocallyFree_tautologicalKernel hE)) =
      k0ClassOf Z E hE -
        k0ClassOf Z ((Scheme.Modules.pullback s).obj (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))
          (pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global s _
            (C.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).isFiniteLocallyFree)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (pullbackK0RingHom s) (C.classOf_tautologicalKernel_add hE)
  rw [map_add, ← RingHom.comp_apply, pullbackK0RingHom_comp, hs, pullbackK0RingHom_id,
    RingHom.id_apply, pullbackK0RingHom_classOf s (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)] at h
  exact eq_sub_of_add_eq h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullback_classOf_tautologicalKernel_zeroSection
statement:
theorem pullback_classOf_tautologicalKernel_zeroSection (s : Z ⟶ C.scheme)
    (hs : s ≫ C.toBase = 𝟙 Z) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree Z E) (N : K0 Z)
    (hEN : k0ClassOf Z E hE = N + 1)
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.pullback s).obj (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) ≅ tensorUnitSheaf Z) :
    pullbackK0RingHom s
        (k0ClassOf C.scheme C.tautologicalKernel (C.isFiniteLocallyFree_tautologicalKernel hE)) =
      N
proof:
:= by
  rw [C.pullback_classOf_tautologicalKernel s hs hE, hEN,
    k0ClassOf_iso Z _ (tensorUnitSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree Z) e]
  change N + 1 - 1 = N
  rw [add_sub_cancel_right]

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.polynomial_map_mem_reesAlgebra_mapRingHom
statement:
theorem polynomial_map_mem_reesAlgebra_mapRingHom
    (φ : R →+* S) (I : Ideal R) (p : reesAlgebra I) :
    Polynomial.map φ (p : R[X]) ∈ reesAlgebra (I.map φ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_reesAlgebra_iff]
  intro n
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_map, ← Ideal.map_pow]
  exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem φ (p.2 n)

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesAlgebraMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reesAlgebraMap_apply (φ : R →+* S) (I : Ideal R)
    (p : reesAlgebra I) :
    ((reesAlgebraMap φ I p : reesAlgebra (I.map φ)) : S[X]) =
      Polynomial.map φ (p : R[X])
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.homogeneous_eq_monomial
statement:
theorem homogeneous_eq_monomial
    (I : Ideal R) {d : ℕ} (q : reesAlgebra I) (hq : q ∈ grading I d) :
    (q : R[X]) = Polynomial.monomial d ((q : R[X]).coeff d)
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  by_cases hnd : n = d
  · subst n
    simp
  · have hsupp : (q : R[X]).support ⊆ {d} := by
      rw [mem_grading_iff, AddMonoidAlgebra.mem_grade_iff] at hq
      exact hq
    have hn : n ∉ (q : R[X]).support := fun hn ↦ hnd (Finset.mem_singleton.mp (hsupp hn))
    have hzero : (q : R[X]).coeff n = 0 := by
      exact Classical.byContradiction fun hne ↦
        hn (Polynomial.mem_support_iff.mpr hne)
    exact hzero.trans (Polynomial.coeff_monomial_of_ne _ hnd).symm

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.monomial_mem_map_irrelevant
statement:
theorem monomial_mem_map_irrelevant
    (φ : R →+* S) (I : Ideal R) {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d)
    {s : S} (hs : s ∈ (I ^ d).map φ) :
    (⟨Polynomial.monomial d s, by
        rw [reesAlgebra.monomial_mem, ← Ideal.map_pow]
        exact hs⟩ : reesAlgebra (I.map φ)) ∈
      ((HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading I)).map
        (gradedReesMap φ I)).toIdeal
proof:
:= by
  change s ∈ Ideal.span (φ '' (↑(I ^ d) : Set R)) at hs
  induction hs using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem s hs =>
      obtain ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ := hs
      let p : reesAlgebra I :=
        ⟨Polynomial.monomial d r, reesAlgebra.monomial_mem.mpr hr⟩
      have hpgrade : p ∈ grading I d := by
        rw [mem_grading_iff, AddMonoidAlgebra.mem_grade_iff]
        exact Polynomial.support_monomial_subset d r
      have hpirr : p ∈ HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading I) :=
        HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem (grading I) hd hpgrade
      have hmap := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (gradedReesMap φ I) hpirr
      change _ ∈ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading I)).toIdeal.map
        (gradedReesMap φ I)
      convert hmap using 1
      apply Subtype.ext
      change Polynomial.monomial d (φ r) =
        Polynomial.map φ (Polynomial.monomial d r)
      ext n
      simp [Polynomial.coeff_monomial]
  | zero =>
      change _ ∈ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading I)).toIdeal.map
        (gradedReesMap φ I)
      convert ((HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading I)).toIdeal.map
        (gradedReesMap φ I)).zero_mem using 1
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact Polynomial.monomial_zero_right d
  | add x y hx hy ihx ihy =>
      change _ ∈ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading I)).toIdeal.map
        (gradedReesMap φ I)
      have hadd :=
        ((HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading I)).toIdeal.map
          (gradedReesMap φ I)).add_mem ihx ihy
      convert hadd using 1
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact map_add (Polynomial.monomial d) x y
  | smul s x hx ihx =>
      change _ ∈ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading I)).toIdeal.map
        (gradedReesMap φ I)
      have hmul :=
        ((HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading I)).toIdeal.map
          (gradedReesMap φ I)).mul_mem_left
            (algebraMap S (reesAlgebra (I.map φ)) s) ihx
      convert hmul using 1
      apply Subtype.ext
      change Polynomial.monomial d (s • x) =
        Polynomial.C s * Polynomial.monomial d x
      rw [Polynomial.C_mul_monomial]
      rfl

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesMap
statement:
theorem irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesMap (φ : R →+* S) (I : Ideal R) :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading (I.map φ)) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading I)).map (gradedReesMap φ I)
proof:
:= by
  refine (HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_irrelevant_le (grading (I.map φ))).2 ?_
  intro d hd q hq
  have hqpoly := homogeneous_eq_monomial (I.map φ) q hq
  have hcoeff : (q : S[X]).coeff d ∈ (I ^ d).map φ := by
    rw [Ideal.map_pow]
    exact q.2 d
  have hmono := monomial_mem_map_irrelevant φ I hd hcoeff
  let m : reesAlgebra (I.map φ) :=
    ⟨Polynomial.monomial d ((q : S[X]).coeff d), by
      rw [reesAlgebra.monomial_mem, ← Ideal.map_pow]
      exact hcoeff⟩
  have hqm : q = m := Subtype.ext hqpoly
  change q ∈ ((HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading I)).map
    (gradedReesMap φ I)).toIdeal
  rw [hqm]
  exact hmono

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.gradedReesMap_comp_pointwise
statement:
theorem gradedReesMap_comp_pointwise
    {T : Type u} [CommRing T] (φ : R →+* S) (ψ : S →+* T)
    (I : Ideal R) (p : reesAlgebra I) :
    (((gradedReesMap ψ (I.map φ)).comp (gradedReesMap φ I) p :
        reesAlgebra ((I.map φ).map ψ)) : T[X]) =
      ((gradedReesMap (ψ.comp φ) I p :
        reesAlgebra (I.map (ψ.comp φ))) : T[X])
proof:
:= by
  change Polynomial.map ψ (Polynomial.map φ (p : R[X])) =
    Polynomial.map (ψ.comp φ) (p : R[X])
  rw [Polynomial.map_map]

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesProjMapOfRingHom_comp
statement:
theorem reesProjMapOfRingHom_comp
    {T : Type u} [CommRing T] (φ : R →+* S) (ψ : S →+* T)
    (I : Ideal R) :
    (Ideal.map_map φ ψ (I := I)) ▸
        ((reesProjMapOfRingHom ψ (I.map φ) ≫ reesProjMapOfRingHom φ I) :
          AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading ((I.map φ).map ψ)) ⟶
            AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading I)) =
      reesProjMapOfRingHom (ψ.comp φ) I
proof:
:= by
  unfold reesProjMapOfRingHom
  rw [show AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map (gradedReesMap ψ (I.map φ))
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesMap ψ (I.map φ)) ≫
        AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map (gradedReesMap φ I)
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesMap φ I) =
      AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map
        ((gradedReesMap ψ (I.map φ)).comp (gradedReesMap φ I))
        (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesMap φ I)
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesMap ψ (I.map φ))) by
    exact (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map_comp
      (gradedReesMap φ I) (gradedReesMap ψ (I.map φ))
      (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesMap φ I)
      (irrelevant_le_map_gradedReesMap ψ (I.map φ))).symm]
  exact Proj_map_eq_of_pointwise_eq (Ideal.map_map φ ψ (I := I))
    ((gradedReesMap ψ (I.map φ)).comp (gradedReesMap φ I))
    (gradedReesMap (ψ.comp φ) I)
    (gradedReesMap_comp_pointwise φ ψ I) _ _

proof:

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesProjMapOfRingHomTo_congr
statement:
theorem reesProjMapOfRingHomTo_congr
    {φ φ' : R →+* S} (hφ : φ = φ') (I : Ideal R) (J : Ideal S)

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.reesProjMapOfRingHomTo_comp
statement:
theorem reesProjMapOfRingHomTo_comp
    {T : Type u} [CommRing T] (φ : R →+* S) (ψ : S →+* T)
    (I : Ideal R) (J : Ideal S) (K : Ideal T)
    (hJ : I.map φ = J) (hK : J.map ψ = K) :
    reesProjMapOfRingHomTo ψ J K hK ≫
        reesProjMapOfRingHomTo φ I J hJ =
      reesProjMapOfRingHomTo (ψ.comp φ) I K
        ((Ideal.map_map φ ψ (I := I)).symm.trans
          ((congrArg (Ideal.map ψ) hJ).trans hK))
proof:
:= by
  subst J
  subst K
  simp only [reesProjMapOfRingHomTo, eqToHom_refl, Category.id_comp]
  apply eq_eqToHom_comp_of_cast_eq
    (fun L : Ideal T ↦ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (grading L))
  exact reesProjMapOfRingHom_comp φ ψ I

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.affineOpenIsoSpec_hom_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem affineOpenIsoSpec_hom_naturality
    (U V : X.affineOpens) (hVU : V.1 ≤ U.1) :
    V.2.isoSpec.hom ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op).hom) =
      X.homOfLE hVU ≫ U.2.isoSpec.hom
proof:
:= by
  have hInv :
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op).hom) ≫
        U.2.isoSpec.inv =
      V.2.isoSpec.inv ≫ X.homOfLE hVU := by
    have hρ :
        CommRingCat.ofHom
            (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op).hom =
          X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op := by
      apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
      rfl
    rw [hρ]
    apply (cancel_epi V.2.isoSpec.hom).1
    simp only [Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
    rw [IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_hom,
      Scheme.Opens.toSpecΓ_SpecMap_presheaf_map_assoc,
      ← U.2.isoSpec_hom]
    simp
  apply (cancel_mono U.2.isoSpec.inv).1
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [hInv]
  simp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistPullHomAux_twistChosenTripleLocalPullHomIJ_eq_final
statement:
theorem twistPullHomAux_twistChosenTripleLocalPullHomIJ_eq_final
    (d : ℤ) (i j k : C.I)
    (l : (C.twistChosenTripleCocycleCover i j k).I₀) :
    let q
proof:
:= C.twistChosenTripleCocycleIndex i j k l
    let c := q.1.1.1
    let W := q.2.affineOpen
    let hWi := q.2.affineOpen_le_A.trans c.affineOpen_le_left
    let _ : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
    let _ : Finite (C.basisIndex j) := C.basisIndex_finite j
    let _ : Module.Free Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1)) :=
      Module.Free.of_basis (C.restrictedSectionBasis i W.1 hWi)
    let _ : Module.Finite Γ(X, W.1) (E.val.obj (op W.1)) :=
      Module.Finite.of_basis (C.restrictedSectionBasis i W.1 hWi)
    C.twistChosenTripleLocalPullHomIJ
        (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d) i j k l =
      Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
        (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
        (c.canonicalTwistComparisonFinalPullbackIso
          i W hWi
          q.2.affineOpen_le_A

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D22.isPointwiseGenerated_of_epi_free
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  let d : LineBundleLocalData X M p := Scheme.Modules.lineBundleLocalDataAt X M
    hL.isFiniteLocallyFree (genericRank_eq_one_of_hasConstantRank hL) p
  let m : Γ(M, d.U) := C1Cap.frameGen d
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hpV, t, ht⟩ := exists_local_preimage_of_epi φ d.U m p d.mem
  let sI : I → Γ(M, ⊤) := fun i => Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (inFree I i ≫ φ) ⊤ (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))
  let c : I → Γ(X, d.U) := fun i => sectionCoordSec d (sI i)
  let a : I → Γ(X, V) := fun i => (show Γ(X, V) from Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (prFree I i) V t)
  have hdec := free_app_decomp I φ V t
  have hsum : C1Cap.frameSec d V hV (∑ i, a i * X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op (c i)) =
      C1Cap.frameSec d V hV 1 := by
    let fs : Γ(X, V) →+ Γ(M, V) := AddMonoidHom.mk' (C1Cap.frameSec d V hV) (frameSec_add d V hV)
    have hfs : ∀ x, C1Cap.frameSec d V hV x = fs x := fun x => rfl
    have hterm : ∀ i, C1Cap.frameSec d V hV (a i * X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op (c i)) =
        a i • M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op (sI i) := by
      intro i
      have e1 : C1Cap.frameSec d V hV (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op (c i)) =
          M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op (sI i) := by
        have l1 := frameSec_restrict d d.U V le_rfl hV (c i)
        have e2 := sectionCoordSec_spec d (sI i)
        rw [l1, e2, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← M.presheaf.map_comp]
        rfl
      rw [C1Cap.frameSec_smul d V hV (a i * _), mul_smul,
        ← C1Cap.frameSec_smul d V hV (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op (c i)), e1]
    rw [hfs, map_sum]
    simp only [← hfs]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hterm i), ← hdec, ht, C1Cap.frameSec_one]
  have h1 : ∑ i, a i * X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op (c i) = 1 :=
    C1Cap.frameSec_injective d V hV hsum
  by_contra hne
  simp only [not_exists] at hne
  have hmem : ∀ i, X.presheaf.germ d.U p d.mem (c i) ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk p) := by
    intro i
    rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal]
    exact fun hu => hne (sI i) d hu
  have h2 := congrArg (X.presheaf.germ V p hpV) h1
  rw [map_sum, map_one] at h2
  have h3 : (1 : X.presheaf.stalk p) ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk p) := by
    rw [← h2]
    refine Ideal.sum_mem _ (fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [map_mul, X.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE hV) p hpV (c i)]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (hmem i)
  rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal] at h3
  exact h3 isUnit_one

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D22.hasAmpleGenerators_of_closedImmersion
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI hLfp : L.IsFinitePresentation := IsFiniteLocallyFree.isFinitePresentation X hL.isFiniteLocallyFree
  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj L).IsFinitePresentation :=
    isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_isFinite j L
  obtain ⟨D, G, hG⟩ := serre_generation k N ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj L)
  letI := hG
  let B : X.Modules := twistPullbackNat (k := k) N j D
  have hB : HasConstantRank X B 1 := hasConstantRank_twistPullbackNat N j D
  refine ⟨B, hB, twistPullbackNat_generated N j D, ?_⟩
  let V := projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (D : ℤ)
  let L' : X.Modules := tensorSheaf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj V) L
  have hL' : HasConstantRank X (tensorSheaf X L B) 1 := by
    have h := hasConstantRank_tensorSheaf hL hB
    rwa [Nat.one_mul] at h
  let e : tensorSheaf (space k N) V ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj L) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj L' :=
    projectionFormulaIso j V (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree k N _) L
  haveI : Finite G.I := hG.finite
  letI : Fintype G.I := Fintype.ofFinite G.I
  let e1 : FreeM (space k N) G.I ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj L' := G.π ≫ e.hom
  haveI : Epi e1 := epi_comp' G.epi inferInstance
  haveI hP : Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).map e1) := inferInstance
  haveI hC := ClosedImmersionCoverF11.counit_epi j L'
  let φ : FreeM X G.I ⟶ L' :=
    (pullbackFreeIso j G.I).inv ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback j).map e1 ≫ ClosedImmersionCoverF11.counitHom j L'
  haveI : Epi (φ) := epi_comp' (inferInstance : Epi (pullbackFreeIso j G.I).inv) (epi_comp' hP hC)
  let φ' : FreeM X G.I ⟶ tensorSheaf X L B := φ ≫ (tensorSheafSymmetry X _ _).hom
  haveI : Epi φ' := epi_comp' inferInstance inferInstance
  exact isPointwiseGenerated_of_epi_free G.I hL' φ'

statement:
theorem QuillenChain.Γ_surjective_of_section (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    {M N : (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Modules} (g : M ⟶ N) (s : N ⟶ M) (h : s ≫ g = 𝟙 N) :
    Function.Surjective ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map g).hom
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  have h2 : (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map s ≫
