    (hsurj : Function.Surjective ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).map S.g)).hom) :
    Function.Injective ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).map S.g)).hom
proof:
:= by
  let G := S.X₃
  let V := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj G
  let P := (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj V
  obtain ⟨hfin, -⟩ := globalSections_finite_projective R n G hF
    (higherDirectImage_isZero_of_isMumfordRegular R n G hF hreg)
  haveI := hF
  haveI : G.IsFinitePresentation := hF.isFinitePresentation
  haveI : G.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  haveI := isQuasicoherent_pushforward_toSpec R n G
  let Qm : ModuleCat.{u} R := (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj V
  haveI : Module.Finite R Qm := Module.Finite.equiv (PushforwardFree.globalSectionsEquiv R n G)
  let c := (tilde.adjunction (R := CommRingCat.of R)).counit.app V
  have hc : IsIso c := Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent V
  let e1 : projectiveBaseModuleTilde R Qm ≅ V := @asIso _ _ _ _ c hc
  let e2 : P ≅ projectiveBaseModulePullback R n Qm :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).mapIso e1.symm
  let e3 : moduleTwist R n P ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≅
      projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n Qm ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) :=
    tensorSheafSymmetry (space R n) P _ ≪≫ tensorSheafMapIso (space R n) (Iso.refl _) e2
  let eBP : projectiveTwistingBaseModule R n (ModuleCat.of R Qm) ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≅ S.X₂ :=
    e3.symm ≪≫ Quillen.twistCastZeroIso R n P ≪≫ eP.symm
  let A := (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj S.X₂)
  let eTot : (R × Qm) ≃ₗ[R] R × A :=
    Quillen.sqZeroSplitEquiv R Qm n ≪≫ₗ (LinearEquiv.refl R R).prodCongr
      (coordinateCechModuleSheafHZeroLinearEquiv R n _ ≪≫ₗ
        projectiveModuleHZeroLinearEquivSections R n _ ≪≫ₗ Quillen.secEquiv R n eBP ≪≫ₗ
        PushforwardFree.globalSectionsEquiv R n S.X₂)
  let f : A →ₗ[R] Qm := ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).map S.g)).hom
  let φ : (R × Qm) →ₗ[R] (R × Qm) := (LinearMap.prodMap LinearMap.id f) ∘ₗ eTot.toLinearMap
  have hφ : Function.Surjective φ := by
    rintro ⟨a, b⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hsurj b
    refine ⟨eTot.symm (a, x), ?_⟩
    simp [φ, f, hx]
  have hinj := OrzechProperty.injective_of_surjective_endomorphism φ hφ
  intro x y hxy
  have hxy' : f x = f y := hxy
  have h1 : eTot.symm (0, x) = eTot.symm (0, y) := hinj (by simp [φ, hxy'])
  exact congrArg Prod.snd (eTot.symm.injective h1)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.QuillenChain.R0_isZero
statement:
theorem QuillenChain.R0_isZero (S : ShortComplex (space R n).Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (hZ : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) S.X₁)
    (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) S.X₃) (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n S.X₃ 0)
    (eP : S.X₂ ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj S.X₃))
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).map S.g)).hom) :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) S.X₁ 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hinj := QuillenChain.Γ_injective R n S hF hreg eP hsurj
  haveI : S.X₁.IsFinitePresentation := hZ.isFinitePresentation
  haveI : S.X₁.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  haveI := isQuasicoherent_pushforward_toSpec R n S.X₁
  haveI : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).IsRightAdjoint :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (toSpec R n)).isRightAdjoint
  haveI : (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).IsRightAdjoint :=
    (tilde.adjunction (R := CommRingCat.of R)).isRightAdjoint
  haveI : (tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of R)).IsLeftAdjoint :=
    (tilde.adjunction (R := CommRingCat.of R)).isLeftAdjoint
  haveI : Mono S.f := hS.mono_f
  let ι := (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).map S.f)
  have hι : Function.Injective ι.hom := (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective ι).1 inferInstance
  have hcomp : ι ≫ (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).map S.g) = 0 := by
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp, S.zero, Functor.map_zero, Functor.map_zero]
  have h0 : ∀ s, ι.hom s = 0 := fun s ↦ hinj (by
    have := congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ.hom s) hcomp
    simp only [ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply, ModuleCat.hom_zero,
      LinearMap.zero_apply] at this
    rw [this, map_zero])
  haveI : Subsingleton ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj S.X₁)) :=
    ⟨fun s t ↦ hι ((h0 s).trans (h0 t).symm)⟩
  have hΓ := ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj S.X₁))
  have hT := (tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of R)).map_isZero hΓ
  let c := (tilde.adjunction (R := CommRingCat.of R)).counit.app
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj S.X₁)
  have hc : IsIso c := Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj S.X₁)
  have hV : IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj S.X₁) :=
    hT.of_iso (@asIso _ _ _ _ c hc).symm
  exact hV.of_iso (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationZeroIso (toSpec R n) _)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.QuillenChain.isZero_of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem QuillenChain.isZero_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton R] (G : (space R n).Modules)
    (hG : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) G) (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n G 0) : IsZero G
proof:
:= by
  refine Quillen.isZero_of_regular R n G hG hreg ?_
  haveI : G.IsFinitePresentation := hG.isFinitePresentation
  haveI : G.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  haveI := isQuasicoherent_pushforward_toSpec R n G
  haveI : (tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of R)).IsLeftAdjoint :=
    (tilde.adjunction (R := CommRingCat.of R)).isLeftAdjoint
  haveI : Subsingleton ↑(CommRingCat.of R) := inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton R)
  haveI : Subsingleton ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj G)) :=
    Module.subsingleton (CommRingCat.of R) _
  have hΓ := ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj G))
  have hT := (tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of R)).map_isZero hΓ
  let c := (tilde.adjunction (R := CommRingCat.of R)).counit.app
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj G)
  have hc : IsIso c := Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj G)
  have hV : IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj G) :=
    hT.of_iso (@asIso _ _ _ _ c hc).symm
  exact hV.of_iso (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafificationZeroIso (toSpec R n) _)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.QuillenChain.step
statement:
theorem QuillenChain.step (S : ShortComplex (space R n).Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) S.X₃) (hreg : IsMumfordRegular R n S.X₃ 0)
    (eP : S.X₂ ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj S.X₃))
    (q : ℕ) (hq : q + 1 ≤ n)
    (h : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n)
      (moduleTwist R n S.X₃ (-((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) q)) :
    IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n)
      (moduleTwist R n S.X₁ (-((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) (q + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let N := projectiveTwistingSheaf R n (-((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))
  have hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) N := projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n _
  haveI := tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits (space R n) N hN
  haveI := tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits (space R n) N hN
  let S' := S.map (tensorSheafRightFunctor (space R n) N)
  have hS' : S'.ShortExact := hS.map_of_exact _
  have h1' : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) S'.X₃ q) := h
  have h3 : IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n) S'.X₂ (q + 1)) :=
    Quillen.R_iso R n (tensorSheafMapIso (space R n) eP.symm (Iso.refl N)) (q + 1)
      (Quillen.pullback_vanishing R n S.X₃ hF hreg q (-((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (Or.inl (by omega)))
  exact (affineLocalLongExactSheafification₃_exact (toSpec R n) S' hS' q).isZero_of_both_zeros
    (h1'.eq_of_src _ _) (h3.eq_of_tgt _ _)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.QuillenChain.vanishing
statement:
theorem QuillenChain.vanishing (Sk : ℕ → ShortComplex (space R n).Modules)
    (hS : ∀ k, (Sk k).ShortExact) (h1 : ∀ k, IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) (Sk k).X₁)
    (h3 : ∀ k, IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) (Sk k).X₃)
    (hreg : ∀ k, IsMumfordRegular R n (Sk k).X₃ 0)
    (eP : ∀ k, (Sk k).X₂ ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj (Sk k).X₃))
    (hsurj : ∀ k, Function.Surjective ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).map (Sk k).g)).hom)
    (link : ∀ k, (Sk (k + 1)).X₃ ≅ moduleTwist R n (Sk k).X₁ 1) (k : ℕ) :
    ∀ q, q ≤ k → IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n)
      (moduleTwist R n (Sk k).X₁ (-(q : ℤ))) q)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : ∀ j, IsZero (affineLocalHigherDirectImageSheafification (toSpec R n)
      (moduleTwist R n (Sk j).X₁ (-((0 : ℕ) : ℤ))) 0) := fun j ↦
    Quillen.R_iso R n (Quillen.twistNegZeroIso R n _).symm 0
      (QuillenChain.R0_isZero R n (Sk j) (hS j) (h1 j) (h3 j) (hreg j) (eP j) (hsurj j))
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro q hq
    obtain rfl : q = 0 := by omega
    exact h0 0
  | succ k ih =>
    intro q hq
    rcases q with _ | q
    · exact h0 (k + 1)
    · by_cases hqn : q + 1 ≤ n
      · refine QuillenChain.step R n (Sk (k + 1)) (hS _) (h3 _) (hreg _) (eP _) q hqn ?_
        have e := moduleTwistTwistIso R n (Sk k).X₁ 1 (-((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (-(q : ℤ))
          (by push_cast; ring)
        have e' : moduleTwist R n (Sk (k + 1)).X₃ (-((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ≅
            moduleTwist R n (Sk k).X₁ (-(q : ℤ)) :=
          tensorSheafMapIso (space R n) (link k) (Iso.refl _) ≪≫ e
        exact Quillen.R_iso R n e'.symm q (ih q (by omega))
      · exact Quillen.dimension R n _ (tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) _ _ (h1 _)
          (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n _)) q (by omega)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.QuillenChain.isZero
statement:
theorem QuillenChain.isZero (Sk : ℕ → ShortComplex (space R n).Modules)
    (hS : ∀ k, (Sk k).ShortExact) (h1 : ∀ k, IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) (Sk k).X₁)
    (h3 : ∀ k, IsFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) (Sk k).X₃)
    (hreg : ∀ k, IsMumfordRegular R n (Sk k).X₃ 0)
    (eP : ∀ k, (Sk k).X₂ ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pullback (toSpec R n)).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).obj (Sk k).X₃))
    (hsurj : ∀ k, Function.Surjective ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (toSpec R n)).map (Sk k).g)).hom)
    (link : ∀ k, (Sk (k + 1)).X₃ ≅ moduleTwist R n (Sk k).X₁ 1) :
    IsZero (Sk n).X₁
proof:
:= by
  have hZ := h1 n
  have hregZ : IsMumfordRegular R n (Sk n).X₁ 0 := by
    intro q hq
    rw [zero_sub]
    by_cases hqn : q ≤ n
    · exact QuillenChain.vanishing R n Sk hS h1 h3 hreg eP hsurj link n q hqn
    · obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ : ∃ p, q = p + 1 := ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩
      exact Quillen.dimension R n _ (tensorSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree (space R n) _ _ hZ
        (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree R n _)) p (by omega)
  exact Quillen.isZero_of_regular R n _ hZ hregZ
    (QuillenChain.R0_isZero R n (Sk n) (hS n) (h1 n) (h3 n) (hreg n) (eP n) (hsurj n))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleQuillen.exists_section
statement:
theorem BundleQuillen.exists_section {Lp : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒴} {Rp : 𝒴 ⥤ 𝒳} (adjp : Lp ⊣ Rp)
    {Rπ : ℬ ⥤ 𝒜} (A : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒜) (Ψ : 𝒴 ⥤ ℬ) (BC : Rp ⋙ A ≅ Ψ ⋙ Rπ) (F : 𝒴) :
    ∃ s : Rπ.obj (Ψ.obj F) ⟶ Rπ.obj (Ψ.obj (Lp.obj (Rp.obj F))),
      s ≫ Rπ.map (Ψ.map (adjp.counit.app F)) = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  have hnat : A.map (Rp.map (adjp.counit.app F)) ≫ BC.hom.app F =
      BC.hom.app (Lp.obj (Rp.obj F)) ≫ Rπ.map (Ψ.map (adjp.counit.app F)) :=
    BC.hom.naturality (adjp.counit.app F)
  have htri : adjp.unit.app (Rp.obj F) ≫ Rp.map (adjp.counit.app F) = 𝟙 (Rp.obj F) :=
    adjp.right_triangle_components F
  have key : (A.map (adjp.unit.app (Rp.obj F)) ≫ BC.hom.app (Lp.obj (Rp.obj F))) ≫
      Rπ.map (Ψ.map (adjp.counit.app F)) = BC.hom.app F := by
    rw [Category.assoc, ← hnat, ← Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, htri]
    exact (congrArg (· ≫ BC.hom.app F) (A.map_id (Rp.obj F))).trans (Category.id_comp _)
  refine ⟨BC.inv.app F ≫ (A.map (adjp.unit.app (Rp.obj F)) ≫
    BC.hom.app (Lp.obj (Rp.obj F))), ?_⟩
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans ((congrArg (BC.inv.app F ≫ ·) key).trans
    (BC.inv_hom_id_app F))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleQuillen.isZero_of_restrict
statement:
theorem BundleQuillen.isZero_of_restrict {Y : Scheme.{u}} (G : Y.Modules) {ι : Type*}
    (Z : ι → Scheme.{u}) (j : ∀ k, Z k ⟶ Y) [∀ k, IsOpenImmersion (j k)]
    (hcov : ∀ y : Y, ∃ k, ∃ z : Z k, j k z = y)
    (h : ∀ k, IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (j k)).obj G)) : IsZero G
proof:
:= by
  have hepi : Epi (0 : G ⟶ G) :=
    BundleRegularity.epi_of_restrict (0 : G ⟶ G) Z j hcov
      fun k ↦ ⟨fun a b _ ↦ (h k).eq_of_src a b⟩
  rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero]
  exact hepi.left_cancellation _ _ (by simp)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleQuillen.transport
statement:
theorem BundleQuillen.transport {Y : Scheme.{u}} {A A' B D : Y.Modules} (e : A' ≅ A) (f : A ⟶ B)
    (g : B ⟶ D) (w : f ≫ g = 0) (h : (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact) :
    ∃ (f' : A' ⟶ B) (g' : B ⟶ D) (w' : f' ≫ g' = 0), (ShortComplex.mk f' g' w').ShortExact
proof:
:=
  ⟨e.hom ≫ f, g, by rw [Category.assoc, w, comp_zero],
    ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso (S₁ := ShortComplex.mk f g w)
      (ShortComplex.isoMk e.symm (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (by simp) (by simp)) h⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleQuillen.rankAt_free
statement:
theorem BundleQuillen.rankAt_free {Y : Scheme.{u}} (x : Y) (I : Type u) [Finite I] :
    rankAt x (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I) = Nat.card I
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : Fintype I := Fintype.ofFinite I
  let U := (stalkLinearFunctor x).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)
  let e₁ : (stalkLinearFunctor x).obj (∐ fun _ : I ↦ SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf) ≅
      ∐ fun _ : I ↦ U :=
    PreservesCoproduct.iso (stalkLinearFunctor x)
      (fun _ : I ↦ SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)
  let e₂ : (∐ fun _ : I ↦ U) ≅ ModuleCat.of (Y.presheaf.stalk x) (⨁ (_ : I), U) :=
    ModuleCat.coprodIsoDirectSum (fun _ : I ↦ U)
  let e₃ : (⨁ (_ : I), U) ≃ₗ[Y.presheaf.stalk x] (I → Y.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    (DirectSum.linearEquivFunOnFintype (R := Y.presheaf.stalk x) (ι := I)
      (M := fun _ : I ↦ U)).trans (LinearEquiv.piCongrRight fun _ ↦ unitStalkLinearEquivAt x)
  change Module.finrank (Y.presheaf.stalk x)
    ((stalkLinearFunctor x).obj (∐ fun _ : I ↦ SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)) = _
  rw [((e₁.trans e₂).toLinearEquiv.trans e₃).finrank_eq, Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card,
    Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleQuillen.card_eq
statement:
theorem BundleQuillen.card_eq {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) (i : C.I) (x : X)
    (hx : x ∈ C.U i) : Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq1, hq2, hcard⟩ := hE
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq1
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := hq2
  have hcover : IsOpenCover q.X :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff X q.X).mp q.coversTop
  have hxUnion : x ∈ ⋃ j, (q.X j : Set X) := by
    rw [hcover.iSup_set_eq_univ]
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hxUnion
  obtain ⟨j, hxj⟩ := hxUnion
  let I := (q.generators j).I
  letI : (q.generators j).IsFiniteType :=
    SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType j
  letI : Finite I := by
    dsimp only [I]
    infer_instance
  let eOver : (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I).over (q.X j) ≅ E.over (q.X j) :=
    (SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X (q.X j) I).symm ≪≫ asIso (q.generators j).π
  let e1 := stalkFreeLinearEquivAtOfOverIso E x (q.X j) hxj I eOver
  haveI := C.basisIndex_finite i
  let e2 := stalkFreeLinearEquivAtOfOverIso E x (C.U i) hx (C.basisIndex i) (C.globalFreeFrame i)
  have h1 := BundleQuillen.rankAt_free x I
  have h2 := BundleQuillen.rankAt_free x (C.basisIndex i)
  unfold rankAt at h1 h2
  rw [e1.finrank_eq] at h1
  rw [e2.finrank_eq] at h2
  rw [← h2, h1]
  exact hcard j

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.quillenSyzygy_spec
statement:
theorem quillenSyzygy_spec [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    (F : C.scheme.Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme F)
    (hreg : IsMumfordRegular C F 0) :
    ∀ k, IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme (C.quillenSyzygy F k) ∧
      IsMumfordRegular C (C.quillenSyzygy F k) 0
  | 0 => ⟨hF, hreg⟩
  | k + 1 => by
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩
proof:
:= quillenSyzygy_spec hpos F hF hreg k
    obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, h5, h6⟩ := quillenCounit_kernel_spec C hpos _ h1 h2
    exact ⟨h5, h6⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.BundleQuillen.chart_kernel_isZero
statement:
theorem BundleQuillen.chart_kernel_isZero [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) (F : C.scheme.Modules)
    (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme F) (hreg : IsMumfordRegular C F 0) (i : C.I) {n : ℕ}
    (e : C.basisIndex i ≃ Fin (n + 1)) :
    IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e)).obj
      (kernel (quillenCounit C (C.quillenSyzygy F n))))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, C.U i) :=
    IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨C.U i, C.isAffine i⟩
  have spec := C.quillenSyzygy_spec hpos F hF hreg
  have Q5 := fun k ↦ quillenCounit_kernel_spec C hpos _ (spec k).1 (spec k).2
  have hsurj : ∀ k, Function.Surjective
      ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of Γ(X, C.U i))).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) n)).map
          (((quillenCounitSeq C (C.quillenSyzygy F k)).map
            (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e))).g))).hom := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := BundleQuillen.exists_section
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction C.toBase)
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.isAffine i).fromSpec)
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e)) (BundleRegularity.BC C i e)
      (C.quillenSyzygy F k)
    exact SchemeProjectiveSpace.QuillenChain.Γ_surjective_of_section Γ(X, C.U i) _ s hs
  exact SchemeProjectiveSpace.QuillenChain.isZero Γ(X, C.U i) n
    (fun k ↦ (quillenCounitSeq C (C.quillenSyzygy F k)).map
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (standardChartEmb C i e)))
    (fun k ↦ (Q5 k).1.map_of_exact _)
    (fun k ↦ BundleRegularity.restrict_isFiniteLocallyFree _ _ (Q5 k).2.2.2.1)
    (fun k ↦ BundleRegularity.restrict_isFiniteLocallyFree _ _ (spec k).1)
    (fun k ↦ BundleRegularity.chartRegular C i e _ (spec k).1 0 (spec k).2)
    (fun k ↦ BundleRegularity.pullbackPushforwardChartIso C i e _)
    hsurj
    (fun k ↦ BundleRegularity.twistIso C i e _ 1)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.quillenSyzygy_isZero
statement:
theorem quillenSyzygy_isZero [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) (F : C.scheme.Modules)
    (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme F) (hreg : IsMumfordRegular C F 0) :
    IsZero (C.quillenSyzygy F r)
proof:
:= by
  choose nr er using BundleRegularity.hrank C hpos
  refine BundleQuillen.isZero_of_restrict _
    (fun i ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.space Γ(X, C.U i) (nr i))
    (fun i ↦ standardChartEmb C i (er i).some) ?_ (fun i ↦ ?_)
  · intro x
    have hx : C.toBase x ∈ (⨆ i, C.U i : X.Opens) := by
      rw [C.covers]
      trivial
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.1 hx
    have hx' : x ∈ ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) (nr i) ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤).ι ≫
        standardChartEmb C i (er i).some).opensRange := by
      rw [standardChartEmb_opensRange_top]
      exact hi
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hx'
    exact ⟨i, (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) (nr i) ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤).ι w,
      by rw [← hw, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]⟩
  · haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, C.U i) :=
      IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨C.U i, C.isAffine i⟩
    obtain ⟨hG, hGreg⟩ := C.quillenSyzygy_spec hpos F hF hreg r
    rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial Γ(X, C.U i) with hsub | hnt
    · exact SchemeProjectiveSpace.QuillenChain.isZero_of_subsingleton Γ(X, C.U i) (nr i) _
        (BundleRegularity.restrict_isFiniteLocallyFree _ _ hG)
        (BundleRegularity.chartRegular C i (er i).some _ hG 0 hGreg)
    · obtain ⟨y⟩ : Nonempty (Spec Γ(X, C.U i)) := PrimeSpectrum.nonempty_iff_nontrivial.2 hnt
      have hx : (C.isAffine i).fromSpec y ∈ C.U i := by
        change (C.isAffine i).fromSpec y ∈ ((C.U i : X.Opens) : Set X)
        rw [← (C.isAffine i).range_fromSpec]
        exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
      have hcard := BundleQuillen.card_eq C hE i _ hx
      have hr : r = nr i + 1 := by
        rw [← hcard, Nat.card_congr (er i).some, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fin]
      rw [hr]
      have hZ := BundleQuillen.chart_kernel_isZero C hpos F hF hreg i (er i).some
      have h1 := (tensorSheafRightFunctor _
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingSheaf Γ(X, C.U i) (nr i) 1)).map_isZero hZ
      exact h1.of_iso (BundleRegularity.twistIso C i (er i).some _ 1)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.quillenResolution_step
statement:
theorem quillenResolution_step [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    (F : C.scheme.Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme F)
    (hreg : IsMumfordRegular C F 0) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ (f : twist C (C.quillenSyzygy F (k + 1)) (-((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ⟶
        tensorSheaf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.toBase).obj (C.quillenSyzygy F k)))
          (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (-(k : ℤ))))
      (g : tensorSheaf C.scheme ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.toBase).obj (C.quillenSyzygy F k)))
          (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (-(k : ℤ))) ⟶ twist C (C.quillenSyzygy F k) (-(k : ℤ)))
      (w : f ≫ g = 0), (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hG, hGreg⟩ := C.quillenSyzygy_spec hpos F hF hreg k
  obtain ⟨hS, -⟩ := quillenCounit_kernel_spec C hpos _ hG hGreg
  let N := C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (-(k : ℤ))
  have hN : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme N := C.canonicalTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree _
  haveI := tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits C.scheme N hN
  haveI := tensorSheafRightFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits C.scheme N hN
  let S' := (quillenCounitSeq C (C.quillenSyzygy F k)).map (tensorSheafRightFunctor C.scheme N)
  have hS' : S'.ShortExact := hS.map_of_exact _
  let e : twist C (C.quillenSyzygy F (k + 1)) (-((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) ≅ S'.X₁ :=
    twistTwistIso C hpos (kernel (quillenCounit C (C.quillenSyzygy F k))) 1
      (-((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (-(k : ℤ)) (by push_cast; ring)
  exact BundleQuillen.transport e S'.f S'.g S'.zero hS'

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.classOf_mem_span_of_isMumfordRegular
statement:
theorem classOf_mem_span_of_isMumfordRegular [IsNoetherian X]
    (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)) {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r)
    (F : C.scheme.Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme F) (hreg : IsMumfordRegular C F 0) :
    letI
proof:
:= C.projectiveBundleK0Algebra hpos
    k0ClassOf C.scheme F hF ∈ Submodule.span (K0 X)
      (Set.range fun i : Fin r ↦ C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-(i : ℤ))) := by
  letI := C.projectiveBundleK0Algebra hpos
  have spec := C.quillenSyzygy_spec hpos F hF hreg
  let T : ℕ → X.Modules := fun k ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.toBase).obj (C.quillenSyzygy F k)
  have hT : ∀ k, IsFiniteLocallyFree X (T k) := fun k ↦
    (quillenCounit_kernel_spec C hpos _ (spec k).1 (spec k).2).2.1
  let Z : ℕ → C.scheme.Modules := fun k ↦ twist C (C.quillenSyzygy F k) (-(k : ℤ))
  have hZ : ∀ k, IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme (Z k) := fun k ↦
    twist_isFiniteLocallyFree C _ (spec k).1 _
  have hF0 : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme (twist C F 0) := twist_isFiniteLocallyFree C F hF 0
  have hZ0 : Z 0 = twist C F 0 := by
    change twist C F (-((0 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = twist C F 0
    rw [Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero]
  have hZr : IsZero (Z r) :=
    (tensorSheafRightFunctor C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf (-(r : ℤ)))).map_isZero
      (C.quillenSyzygy_isZero hpos hE F hF hreg)
  have hmem := classOf_mem_span_of_resolution C hpos r (twist C F 0) hF0 T hT Z hZ
    (fun k _ ↦ C.quillenResolution_step hpos F hF hreg k) (eqToIso hZ0) hZr
  have hmul : k0ClassOf C.scheme (twist C F 0) hF0 =
      k0ClassOf C.scheme F hF * C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class 0 :=
    (k0ClassOf_mul C.scheme ⟨F, hF⟩
      ⟨C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 0, C.canonicalTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree 0⟩).symm
  rw [hmul, canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_zero, mul_one] at hmem
  exact hmem

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.classOf_mem_span_twists
statement:
theorem classOf_mem_span_twists [IsNoetherian X] (hpos : ∀ i, Nonempty (C.basisIndex i))
    {r : ℕ} (hE : HasConstantRank X E r)
    (F : C.scheme.Modules) (hF : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme F) :
    letI
proof:
:= C.projectiveBundleK0Algebra hpos
    k0ClassOf C.scheme F hF ∈ Submodule.span (K0 X)
      (Set.range fun d : ℤ ↦ C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class d) := by
  letI := C.projectiveBundleK0Algebra hpos
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_isMumfordRegular C hpos F hF
  have hFm : IsFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme (twist C F m) := twist_isFiniteLocallyFree C F hF m
  have hres := C.classOf_mem_span_of_isMumfordRegular hpos hE (twist C F m) hFm
    ((isMumfordRegular_twist_iff C hpos F m).mp hm)
  
  have hclass : k0ClassOf C.scheme F hF =
      k0ClassOf C.scheme (twist C F m) hFm * C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-m) := by
    have hmul : k0ClassOf C.scheme (twist C F m) hFm =
        k0ClassOf C.scheme F hF * C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class m :=
      (k0ClassOf_mul C.scheme ⟨F, hF⟩
        ⟨C.canonicalTwistingSheaf m, C.canonicalTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree m⟩).symm
    rw [hmul, mul_assoc, C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_mul hpos, add_neg_cancel,
      canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_zero, mul_one]
  rw [hclass]
  
  let μ : K0 C.scheme →ₗ[K0 X] K0 C.scheme :=
    LinearMap.mulRight (K0 X) (C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-m))
  have hle : Submodule.span (K0 X)
        (Set.range fun i : Fin r ↦ C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class (-(i : ℤ))) ≤
      (Submodule.span (K0 X)
        (Set.range fun d : ℤ ↦ C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class d)).comap μ := by
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨-(i : ℤ) + -m, ?_⟩
    simp only [μ, LinearMap.mulRight_apply]
    rw [C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_mul hpos]
  exact hle hres

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.span_eq_top
proof:
:= C.projectiveBundleK0Algebra hpos
    ⊤ ≤ Submodule.span (K0 X) (Set.range fun i : Fin r ↦ C.tautologicalK0Class ^ (i : ℕ)) := by
  letI := C.projectiveBundleK0Algebra hpos
  intro x _
  refine k0_induction C.scheme
    (· ∈ Submodule.span (K0 X) (Set.range fun i : Fin r ↦ C.tautologicalK0Class ^ (i : ℕ)))
    (Submodule.zero_mem _) (fun a b ha hb ↦ Submodule.add_mem _ ha hb) (fun a ha ↦ ?_) ?_ x
  · have := Submodule.smul_mem _ (-1 : K0 X) ha
    rwa [Algebra.smul_def, map_neg, map_one, neg_one_mul] at this
  intro F hF
  have hgen := C.classOf_mem_span_twists hpos hE F hF
  refine (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_) hgen
  rintro _ ⟨d, rfl⟩
  show C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class d ∈ _
  rw [C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_eq_zpow hpos d]
  refine zpow_mem_span_of_relation r hr _ (C.tautologicalK0Unit hpos)
    (C.k0_relation hpos hr hE) ?_ d
  
  have hu := isUnit_lambdaClass_top X E r hE
  have hrev : ((Fin.rev (⟨0, hr⟩ : Fin r)) : ℕ) + 1 = r := by
    simp only [Fin.val_rev]
    omega
  change IsUnit ((-1 : K0 X) ^ (((Fin.rev (⟨0, hr⟩ : Fin r)) : ℕ) + 1) *
    lambdaClass X E hE.isFiniteLocallyFree (((Fin.rev (⟨0, hr⟩ : Fin r)) : ℕ) + 1))
  rw [hrev]
  exact (isUnit_one.neg.pow r).mul hu

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechLaurentClearingExponent_bound
statement:
theorem coordinateCechLaurentClearingExponent_bound (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) (x : coordinateLaurentPiece k n d p a)
    (e : CoordinateLaurentExponent n) (he : e ∈ x.1.support) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (e i).natAbs + d.natAbs ≤
      coordinateCechLaurentClearingExponent k n d p a x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let w (e' : CoordinateLaurentExponent n) : ℕ :=
    Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun j ↦ (e' j).natAbs) + d.natAbs
  have hi : (e i).natAbs + d.natAbs ≤ w e := by
    apply Nat.add_le_add_right
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ ↦ Nat.zero_le (e j).natAbs)
      (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hsingle : w e ≤ Finset.sum x.1.support w :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (fun e' _ ↦ Nat.zero_le (w e')) he
  exact hi.trans (by
    simpa only [coordinateCechLaurentClearingExponent, w] using hsingle)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechDenominatorLaurentExponent_apply_pos_of_mem_range
statement:
theorem coordinateCechDenominatorLaurentExponent_apply_pos_of_mem_range (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (hi : i ∈ Set.range a) :
    1 ≤ coordinateCechDenominatorLaurentExponent n p a i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hi
  calc
    (1 : ℤ) = coordinateLaurentBasisExponent n (a t) (a t) := by
      simp only [coordinateLaurentBasisExponent_apply, if_pos]
    _ ≤ ∑ s, coordinateLaurentBasisExponent n (a s) (a t) :=
      Finset.single_le_sum
        (f := fun s : Fin (p + 1) ↦
          coordinateLaurentBasisExponent n (a s) (a t))
        (fun s _ ↦ by
          rw [coordinateLaurentBasisExponent_apply]
          split <;> omega)
        (Finset.mem_univ t)
    _ = coordinateCechDenominatorLaurentExponent n p a (a t) := by
      rw [coordinateCechDenominatorLaurentExponent, Finset.sum_apply']

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.sub_shift_nonnegative
statement:
private theorem sub_shift_nonnegative (z d : ℤ) (q : ℕ) (c delta : ℤ)
    (hq : z.natAbs + d.natAbs ≤ q) (hc : 1 ≤ c)
    (hdelta : delta = 0 ∨ delta = 1) :
    0 ≤ z - (q • (-c) + d • delta)
proof:
:= by
  have hq' : (z.natAbs : ℤ) + (d.natAbs : ℤ) ≤ (q : ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hq
  rw [Int.natCast_natAbs, Int.natCast_natAbs] at hq'
  have hz : -(z.natAbs : ℤ) ≤ z := by
    rw [Int.natCast_natAbs]
    exact neg_abs_le z
  have hd : d ≤ (d.natAbs : ℤ) := by
    rw [Int.natCast_natAbs]
    exact le_abs_self d
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ (q : ℤ) := by omega
  have hqc : (q : ℤ) ≤ (q : ℤ) * c := by
    calc
      (q : ℤ) = (q : ℤ) * 1 := by ring
      _ ≤ (q : ℤ) * c := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc hq0
  have hzero : 0 ≤ z + (q : ℤ) := by omega
  have hbase : 0 ≤ z + (q : ℤ) - d := by omega
  rcases hdelta with rfl | rfl
  · simp only [nsmul_eq_mul, zsmul_eq_mul, mul_zero, add_zero, mul_neg,
      sub_neg_eq_add]
    omega
  · simp only [nsmul_eq_mul, zsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, mul_neg]
    have hgoal : 0 ≤ z + (q : ℤ) * c - d := by omega
    convert hgoal using 1 <;> norm_num <;> ring

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechClearedLaurentPolynomial_support_nonnegative
statement:
theorem coordinateCechClearedLaurentPolynomial_support_nonnegative (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) (x : coordinateLaurentPiece k n d p a)
    (e : CoordinateLaurentExponent n)
    (he : e ∈ (coordinateCechClearedLaurentPolynomial k n d p a x).support)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) : 0 ≤ e i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let q := coordinateCechLaurentClearingExponent k n d p a x
  let shift := coordinateCechTwistShiftExponent n d q p a
  have hxcoeff : x.1 (e + shift) ≠ 0 := by
    have hecoeff := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp he
    change (x.1 * (AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-shift) 1 :
      CoordinateLaurentPolynomial k n)) e ≠ 0 at hecoeff
    rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.mul_single_apply] at hecoeff
    simpa only [neg_neg, mul_one] using hecoeff
  have hxsupp : e + shift ∈ x.1.support := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr hxcoeff
  by_cases hi : i ∈ Set.range a
  · have hq := coordinateCechLaurentClearingExponent_bound k n d p a x
      (e + shift) hxsupp i
    have hc := coordinateCechDenominatorLaurentExponent_apply_pos_of_mem_range
      n p a i hi
    have hdelta :
        coordinateLaurentBasisExponent n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a) i = 0 ∨
          coordinateLaurentBasisExponent n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a) i = 1 := by
      by_cases hdi : coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a = i
      · exact Or.inr (by simp [coordinateLaurentBasisExponent_apply, hdi])
      · exact Or.inl (by simp [coordinateLaurentBasisExponent_apply, hdi])
    have hnonneg := sub_shift_nonnegative
      ((e + shift) i) d q
      (coordinateCechDenominatorLaurentExponent n p a i)
      (coordinateLaurentBasisExponent n (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a) i)
      hq hc hdelta
    have hshiftApply :
        shift i = q • (-(coordinateCechDenominatorLaurentExponent n p a i)) +
          d • coordinateLaurentBasisExponent n
            (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a) i := by
      simp only [shift, coordinateCechTwistShiftExponent, Finsupp.add_apply,
        Finsupp.smul_apply, Finsupp.neg_apply]
    rw [← hshiftApply] at hnonneg
    simpa only [Finsupp.add_apply, add_sub_cancel_right] using hnonneg
  · have hallowed := (x.2 (e + shift) hxcoeff).2
    have hshiftZero : shift i = 0 := by
      simpa only [shift] using
        (coordinateCechTwistShiftExponent_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range
          n d q p a i hi)
    by_contra hnonneg
    have hei : e i < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hnonneg
    have horiginal : (e + shift) i < 0 := by
      simpa only [Finsupp.add_apply, hshiftZero, add_zero] using hei
    exact hi (hallowed i horiginal)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechClearedLaurentPolynomial_support_subset_range
statement:
theorem coordinateCechClearedLaurentPolynomial_support_subset_range (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) (x : coordinateLaurentPiece k n d p a) :
    ↑(coordinateCechClearedLaurentPolynomial k n d p a x).support ⊆
      Set.range (coordinateExponentToLaurent n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro e he
  let m : Fin (n + 1) →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.mapRange Int.toNat (by simp) e
  refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro i
  change (Int.toNat (e i) : ℤ) = e i
  exact Int.toNat_of_nonneg
    (coordinateCechClearedLaurentPolynomial_support_nonnegative k n d p a x e he i)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.polynomialToCoordinateLaurent_coordinateCechLaurentNumerator
statement:
theorem polynomialToCoordinateLaurent_coordinateCechLaurentNumerator (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) (x : coordinateLaurentPiece k n d p a) :
    polynomialToCoordinateLaurent k n
        (coordinateCechLaurentNumerator k n d p a x) =
      coordinateCechClearedLaurentPolynomial k n d p a x
proof:
:= by
  change Finsupp.mapDomain (coordinateExponentToLaurent n)
      (Finsupp.comapDomain (coordinateExponentToLaurent n)
        (coordinateCechClearedLaurentPolynomial k n d p a x)
        (coordinateExponentToLaurent_injective n).injOn) = _
  exact Finsupp.mapDomain_comapDomain
    (coordinateExponentToLaurent n) (coordinateExponentToLaurent_injective n) _
    (coordinateCechClearedLaurentPolynomial_support_subset_range k n d p a x)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechClearedLaurentPolynomial_support_totalDegree
statement:
theorem coordinateCechClearedLaurentPolynomial_support_totalDegree (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) (x : coordinateLaurentPiece k n d p a)
    (e : CoordinateLaurentExponent n)
    (he : e ∈ (coordinateCechClearedLaurentPolynomial k n d p a x).support) :
    coordinateLaurentTotalDegree n e =
      ((coordinateCechLaurentClearingExponent k n d p a x * (p + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let q := coordinateCechLaurentClearingExponent k n d p a x
  let shift := coordinateCechTwistShiftExponent n d q p a
  have hxcoeff : x.1 (e + shift) ≠ 0 := by
    have hecoeff := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp he
    change (x.1 * (AddMonoidAlgebra.single (-shift) 1 :
      CoordinateLaurentPolynomial k n)) e ≠ 0 at hecoeff
    rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.mul_single_apply] at hecoeff
    simpa only [neg_neg, mul_one] using hecoeff
  have hdegree := (x.2 (e + shift) hxcoeff).1
  change coordinateLaurentTotalDegreeAddHom n (e + shift) = d at hdegree
  rw [map_add, coordinateLaurentTotalDegreeAddHom_apply,
    coordinateLaurentTotalDegreeAddHom_apply,
    coordinateCechTwistShiftExponent_totalDegree] at hdegree
  change coordinateLaurentTotalDegree n e = ((q * (p + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)
  push_cast at hdegree ⊢
  omega

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechLaurentNumerator_mem_grading
statement:
theorem coordinateCechLaurentNumerator_mem_grading (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) (x : coordinateLaurentPiece k n d p a) :
    coordinateCechLaurentNumerator k n d p a x ∈
      grading k n
        (coordinateCechLaurentClearingExponent k n d p a x • (p + 1))
proof:
:= by
  change (coordinateCechLaurentNumerator k n d p a x).IsHomogeneous _
  intro m hm
  change (Finsupp.weight (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ 1)) m = _
  rw [← Finsupp.degree_eq_weight_one]
  have hclearedCoeff :
      coordinateCechClearedLaurentPolynomial k n d p a x
          (coordinateExponentToLaurent n m) ≠ 0 := by
    change coordinateCechLaurentNumerator k n d p a x m ≠ 0 at hm
    simpa only [coordinateCechLaurentNumerator, Finsupp.comapDomain_apply] using hm
  have hclearedSupport : coordinateExponentToLaurent n m ∈
      (coordinateCechClearedLaurentPolynomial k n d p a x).support :=
    Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr hclearedCoeff
  have hdegree := coordinateCechClearedLaurentPolynomial_support_totalDegree
    k n d p a x (coordinateExponentToLaurent n m) hclearedSupport
  rw [coordinateExponentToLaurent_totalDegree] at hdegree
  have hdegreeNat : m.degree =
      coordinateCechLaurentClearingExponent k n d p a x * (p + 1) := by
    exact_mod_cast hdegree
  change m.degree = coordinateCechLaurentClearingExponent k n d p a x * (p + 1)
  exact hdegreeNat

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechClearedLaurentPolynomial_mul_shift
statement:
theorem coordinateCechClearedLaurentPolynomial_mul_shift (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) (x : coordinateLaurentPiece k n d p a) :
    coordinateCechClearedLaurentPolynomial k n d p a x *
        AddMonoidAlgebra.single
          (coordinateCechTwistShiftExponent n d
            (coordinateCechLaurentClearingExponent k n d p a x) p a) 1 =
      x.1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coordinateCechClearedLaurentPolynomial, mul_assoc,
    AddMonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, neg_add_cancel, one_mul]
  rw [← AddMonoidAlgebra.one_def, mul_one]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechLaurentNormalForm_numerator
statement:
theorem coordinateCechLaurentNormalForm_numerator (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) (x : coordinateLaurentPiece k n d p a) :
    let q
proof:
:= coordinateCechLaurentClearingExponent k n d p a x
    let f := coordinateCechLaurentNumerator k n d p a x
    (polynomialToCoordinateLaurent k n f *
          coordinateCechEquationLaurentInverse k n p a ^ q) *
        coordinateTwistingFrameLaurentMonomial k n d
          (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a) = x.1 := by
  dsimp only
  rw [coordinateCechLaurentNormalForm_eq_mul_single,
    polynomialToCoordinateLaurent_coordinateCechLaurentNumerator]
  exact coordinateCechClearedLaurentPolynomial_mul_shift k n d p a x

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurentPiece_surjective
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurentPiece_surjective (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    Function.Surjective (coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurentPiece k n d p a)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  let q := coordinateCechLaurentClearingExponent k n d p a x
  let f := coordinateCechLaurentNumerator k n d p a x
  have hf : f ∈ grading k n (q • (p + 1)) :=
    coordinateCechLaurentNumerator_mem_grading k n d p a x
  refine ⟨(coordinateCechTwistingFrameEvaluation k n d p a).symm
      ((coordinateCechBasicOpenIsoAway k n p a).hom
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading k n)
          (coordinateCechEquation_mem_degree k n p a) q f hf)), ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  change coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurent k n d p a
      ((coordinateCechTwistingFrameEvaluation k n d p a).symm
        ((coordinateCechBasicOpenIsoAway k n p a).hom
          (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (grading k n)
            (coordinateCechEquation_mem_degree k n p a) q f hf))) = x.1
  rw [coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurent_mk]
  exact coordinateCechLaurentNormalForm_numerator k n d p a x

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.polynomialToCoordinateLaurent_injective
statement:
theorem polynomialToCoordinateLaurent_injective :
    Function.Injective (polynomialToCoordinateLaurent k n)
proof:
:= by
  intro f g h
  apply AddMonoidAlgebra.mapDomain_injective (R := k)
    (coordinateExponentToLaurent_injective n)
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechEquation_mem_nonZeroDivisors
statement:
theorem coordinateCechEquation_mem_nonZeroDivisors (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateCechEquation k n p a ∈ nonZeroDivisors (Polynomial k n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [coordinateCechEquation, coordinate]
  exact MvPolynomial.prod_X_mem_nonZeroDivisors Finset.univ a

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechLocalizationToLaurent_injective
statement:
theorem coordinateCechLocalizationToLaurent_injective (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    Function.Injective (coordinateCechLocalizationToLaurent k n p a)
proof:
:= by
  have haway : Function.Injective
      (algebraMap (Polynomial k n)
        (Localization.Away (coordinateCechEquation k n p a))) :=
    IsLocalization.injective _
      (Submonoid.powers_le.mpr (coordinateCechEquation_mem_nonZeroDivisors k n p a))
  unfold coordinateCechLocalizationToLaurent Localization.awayLift
    IsLocalization.Away.lift
  rw [IsLocalization.lift_injective_iff]
  intro f g
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact congrArg (polynomialToCoordinateLaurent k n) (haway h)
  · intro h
    exact congrArg
      (algebraMap (Polynomial k n)
        (Localization.Away (coordinateCechEquation k n p a)))
      (polynomialToCoordinateLaurent_injective k n h)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechAwayToLaurent_injective
statement:
theorem coordinateCechAwayToLaurent_injective (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    Function.Injective (coordinateCechAwayToLaurent k n p a)
proof:
:= by
  intro z w h
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective _
  apply coordinateCechLocalizationToLaurent_injective k n p a
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent_injective
statement:
theorem coordinateCechBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent_injective (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    Function.Injective (coordinateCechBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent k n p a)
proof:
:= by
  have hinv : Function.Injective
      (coordinateCechBasicOpenIsoAway k n p a).inv.hom :=
    (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
      (coordinateCechBasicOpenIsoAway k n p a).inv).1
  simpa only [coordinateCechBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent, RingHom.coe_comp] using
    (coordinateCechAwayToLaurent_injective k n p a).comp hinv

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateTwistingFrameLaurentMonomial_isUnit
statement:
theorem coordinateTwistingFrameLaurentMonomial_isUnit (d : ℤ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    IsUnit (coordinateTwistingFrameLaurentMonomial k n d i)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨coordinateLaurentMonomialUnit k n
    (d • coordinateLaurentBasisExponent n i), rfl⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurent_injective
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurent_injective (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    Function.Injective (coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurent k n d p a)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  apply (coordinateCechTwistingFrameEvaluation k n d p a).injective
  apply coordinateCechBasicOpenSectionsToLaurent_injective k n p a
  apply (coordinateTwistingFrameLaurentMonomial_isUnit k n d
    (coordinateCechDistinguishedIndex n p a)).mul_right_cancel
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurentPiece_injective
statement:
theorem coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurentPiece_injective (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) :
    Function.Injective (coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurentPiece k n d p a)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  apply coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurent_injective k n d p a
  simpa only [coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurentPiece_coe] using
    congrArg Subtype.val h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv_apply (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1))
    (x : Γ(projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d, coordinateCechIntersection k n p a)) :
    coordinateCechTwistingSectionsLaurentEquiv k n d p a x =
      coordinateCechTwistingSectionsToLaurentPiece k n d p a x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.dualEvalVal_add
statement:
theorem dualEvalVal_add (U : X.Opens) (f g : L.over U ⟶ (unitMod X).over U) :
    dualEvalVal σ U (f + g) = dualEvalVal σ U f + dualEvalVal σ U g
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.dualEvalVal_sub
statement:
theorem dualEvalVal_sub (U : X.Opens) (f g : L.over U ⟶ (unitMod X).over U) :
    dualEvalVal σ U (f - g) = dualEvalVal σ U f - dualEvalVal σ U g
proof:
:=
  map_sub (dualEvalAdd σ U) f g

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.dualEvalVal_smul
statement:
theorem dualEvalVal_smul (U : X.Opens) (r : Γ(X, U)) (f : L.over U ⟶ (unitMod X).over U) :
    dualEvalVal σ U (r • f) = r * dualEvalVal σ U f
proof:
:=
  evalAt_smul_right L U _ r f

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.dualEvalVal_res
statement:
theorem dualEvalVal_res {U V : X.Opens} (i : op U ⟶ op V)
    (f : L.over U ⟶ (unitMod X).over U) :
    dualEvalVal σ V (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X (leOfHom i.unop) f) =
      X.presheaf.map i (dualEvalVal σ U f)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (σ.val.app (op V)).hom (1 : Γ(X, V)) =
      L.val.map i ((σ.val.app (op U)).hom (1 : Γ(X, U))) := by
    have := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply σ.val i
      (show (tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op U) from (1 : Γ(X, U)))
    have h1 : (tensorUnitSheaf X).val.map i
        (show (tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op U) from (1 : Γ(X, U))) =
        (show (tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op V) from (1 : Γ(X, V))) :=
      map_one (X.presheaf.map i).hom
    rw [h1] at this
    exact this
  change evalAt L V ((σ.val.app (op V)).hom (1 : Γ(X, V)))
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X (leOfHom i.unop) f) = _
  rw [h]
  let φ : Over.mk (homOfLE (leOfHom i.unop)) ⟶ Over.mk (𝟙 U) :=
    Over.homMk (homOfLE (leOfHom i.unop))
  exact (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (f.val.naturality φ.op) ((σ.val.app (op U)).hom (1 : Γ(X, U))))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.dualEval_app
statement:
theorem dualEval_app (U : X.Opens) (f : L.over U ⟶ (unitMod X).over U) :
    (dualEval σ).val.app (op U) f = dualEvalVal σ U f
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.dualEvalVal_mem_affineIdeal
statement:
theorem dualEvalVal_mem_affineIdeal (U : X.affineOpens) (f : L.over U.1 ⟶ (unitMod X).over U.1) :
    dualEvalVal σ U.1 f ∈ sectionAffineEvaluationIdeal σ U
proof:
:=
  ⟨(f.val.app (topOver U.1)).hom, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.dualEval_structureMap_zero
statement:
theorem dualEval_structureMap_zero [L.IsQuasicoherent] [L.IsFinitePresentation] :
    dualEval σ ≫ ConormalSheaf.structureMap (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply SchemeKTheory.KoszulComplexSheaf.moduleHom_eq_of_affine_app_eq X
  intro U
  ext f
  change (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι.app U.1 (dualEvalVal σ U.1 f) = 0
  have hmem : dualEvalVal σ U.1 f ∈ (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).ideal U := by
    rw [sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_affine σ U]
    exact dualEvalVal_mem_affineIdeal σ U f
  rw [← (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).ker_subschemeι_app U] at hmem
  exact RingHom.mem_ker.mp hmem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.exists_frameNbhd
statement:
theorem exists_frameNbhd (hline : IsLocalLineFrame L) {W : X.Opens} {x : X} (hx : x ∈ W) :
    ∃ V : X.affineOpens, x ∈ V.1 ∧ V.1 ≤ W ∧
      Nonempty (L.over V.1 ≅ (tensorUnitSheaf X).over V.1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hline x
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨V, hV, rfl⟩, hxV, hVUW⟩ :=
    X.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open (show x ∈ (U.1 ⊓ W : X.Opens) from ⟨hxU, hx⟩)
      (U.1 ⊓ W).isOpen
  refine ⟨⟨V, hV⟩, hxV, fun y hy => (hVUW hy).2, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  exact resIso (L := L) (fun y hy => (hVUW hy).1) e

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.sectionOverTrivializationCoefficient_eq_evalAt
statement:
theorem sectionOverTrivializationCoefficient_eq_evalAt (V : X.Opens)
    (e : L.over V ≅ (tensorUnitSheaf X).over V) :
    sectionOverTrivializationCoefficient σ V e =
      evalAt L V ((σ.val.app (op V)).hom (1 : Γ(X, V))) e.hom
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.dualEvalVal_eq_zero_local
statement:
theorem dualEvalVal_eq_zero_local (hreg : SectionIsRegular σ) (V : X.affineOpens)
    (e : L.over V.1 ≅ (tensorUnitSheaf X).over V.1)
    (G : L.over V.1 ⟶ (unitMod X).over V.1) (h : dualEvalVal σ V.1 G = 0) : G = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hc := sectionOverTrivializationCoefficient_isRegular σ hreg V e
  have hG := hom_eq_smul (L := L) e G
  have h2 : dualEvalVal σ V.1 G =
      evalAt L V.1 (localGen e) G * sectionOverTrivializationCoefficient σ V.1 e := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hG]
    rw [dualEvalVal, evalAt_smul_right]
    rfl
  rw [h2] at h
  have h3 : evalAt L V.1 (localGen e) G = 0 :=
    hc.2 (by simpa using h)
  rw [hG, h3, zero_smul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.dualEvalVal_eq_zero
statement:
theorem dualEvalVal_eq_zero (hline : IsLocalLineFrame L) (hreg : SectionIsRegular σ)
    (W : X.Opens) (F : L.over W ⟶ (unitMod X).over W) (h : dualEvalVal σ W F = 0) :
    F = 0
proof:
:= by
  choose V hxV hVW he using fun x : W => exists_frameNbhd hline x.2
  let T : TopCat.Sheaf Ab X := ⟨(lineBundleDual X L).presheaf, (lineBundleDual X L).isSheaf⟩
  refine T.eq_of_locally_eq' (fun x : W => (V x).1) W (fun x => homOfLE (hVW x)) ?_ F 0 ?_
  · intro y hy
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hxV ⟨y, hy⟩⟩
  · intro x
    have hG : Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X (hVW x) F = 0 := by
      apply dualEvalVal_eq_zero_local σ hreg (V x) (he x).some
      have := dualEvalVal_res σ (U := W) (V := (V x).1) (homOfLE (hVW x)).op F
      rw [this, h]
      exact map_zero _
    refine hG.trans ?_
    exact (map_zero (T.1.map (homOfLE (hVW x)).op).hom).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.exists_dual_local
statement:
theorem exists_dual_local [L.IsQuasicoherent] [L.IsFinitePresentation]
    (V : X.affineOpens) (e : L.over V.1 ≅ (tensorUnitSheaf X).over V.1) (b : Γ(X, V.1))
    (hb : (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι.app V.1 b = 0) :
    ∃ F : L.over V.1 ⟶ (unitMod X).over V.1, dualEvalVal σ V.1 F = b
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : b ∈ (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).ideal V := by
    rw [← (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).ker_subschemeι_app V]
    exact RingHom.mem_ker.mpr hb
  rw [sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_affine_overIso σ V e, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hmem
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hmem
  refine ⟨r • (show L.over V.1 ⟶ (unitMod X).over V.1 from e.hom), ?_⟩
  rw [dualEvalVal, evalAt_smul_right]
  exact hr

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.presheaf_map_comp_apply
statement:
theorem presheaf_map_comp_apply {U V W : X.Opens} (h1 : V ≤ U) (h2 : W ≤ V) (a : Γ(X, U)) :
    X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h2).op (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h1).op a) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h2.trans h1)).op a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.exists_dual_global
statement:
theorem exists_dual_global [L.IsQuasicoherent] [L.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hline : IsLocalLineFrame L) (hreg : SectionIsRegular σ)
    (W : X.Opens) (a : Γ(X, W))
    (ha : (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι.app W a = 0) :
    ∃ F : L.over W ⟶ (unitMod X).over W, dualEvalVal σ W F = a
proof:
:= by
  choose V hxV hVW he using fun x : W => exists_frameNbhd hline x.2
  have hloc : ∀ x : W, ∃ F : L.over (V x).1 ⟶ (unitMod X).over (V x).1,
      dualEvalVal σ (V x).1 F = X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hVW x)).op a := fun x =>
    exists_dual_local σ (V x) (he x).some _
      (ConormalSheaf.subschemeι_app_map_eq_zero _ _ a ha)
  choose Fx hFx using hloc
  let T : TopCat.Sheaf Ab X := ⟨(lineBundleDual X L).presheaf, (lineBundleDual X L).isSheaf⟩
  have hcomp : TopCat.Presheaf.IsCompatible T.1 (fun x : W => (V x).1) Fx := by
    intro x y
    have hz := dualEvalVal_eq_zero σ hline hreg ((V x).1 ⊓ (V y).1)
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X (inf_le_left : (V x).1 ⊓ (V y).1 ≤ (V x).1) (Fx x) -
        Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X (inf_le_right : (V x).1 ⊓ (V y).1 ≤ (V y).1) (Fx y))
      (by
        rw [dualEvalVal_sub]
        have h1 := dualEvalVal_res σ (U := (V x).1) (V := (V x).1 ⊓ (V y).1)
          (homOfLE (inf_le_left : (V x).1 ⊓ (V y).1 ≤ (V x).1)).op (Fx x)
        have h2 := dualEvalVal_res σ (U := (V y).1) (V := (V x).1 ⊓ (V y).1)
          (homOfLE (inf_le_right : (V x).1 ⊓ (V y).1 ≤ (V y).1)).op (Fx y)
        rw [h1, h2, hFx, hFx, presheaf_map_comp_apply, presheaf_map_comp_apply, sub_self])
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hz
  have hcov : W ≤ ⨆ x : W, (V x).1 := by
    intro y hy
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hxV ⟨y, hy⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨F, hF, -⟩ := T.existsUnique_gluing' (fun x : W => (V x).1) W
    (fun x => homOfLE (hVW x)) hcov Fx hcomp
  refine ⟨F, ?_⟩
  let S : TopCat.Sheaf Ab X := ⟨(unitMod X).presheaf, (unitMod X).isSheaf⟩
  refine S.eq_of_locally_eq' (fun x : W => (V x).1) W (fun x => homOfLE (hVW x)) hcov _ _ ?_
  intro x
  have h1 := dualEvalVal_res σ (U := W) (V := (V x).1) (homOfLE (hVW x)).op F
  change X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hVW x)).op (dualEvalVal σ W F) =
    X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hVW x)).op a
  rw [← h1]
  have h2 : Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X (hVW x) F = Fx x := hF x
  rw [h2, hFx]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.moduleHom_isIso_of_app_bijective
statement:
theorem moduleHom_isIso_of_app_bijective {M N : X.Modules} (f : M ⟶ N)
    (h : ∀ W : X.Opens, Function.Bijective (f.val.app (op W))) : IsIso f
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : IsIso ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).map f).hom := by
    have : ∀ W, IsIso (((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).map f).hom.app W) := fun W ↦
      (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective _).2 (h W.unop)
    exact NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app _
  have h2 : IsIso ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).map f) := by
    have : IsIso ((sheafToPresheaf _ _).map ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).map f)) := h1
    exact isIso_of_reflects_iso _ (sheafToPresheaf _ _)
  let F := SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf
  have hF : F.ReflectsIsomorphisms := by
    have : (F ⋙ sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat).ReflectsIsomorphisms :=
      inferInstanceAs
        ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
          PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf X.ringCatSheaf.obj).ReflectsIsomorphisms)
    exact reflectsIsomorphisms_of_comp F (sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat)
  exact hF.reflects f

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.frameCover_coversTop
statement:
theorem frameCover_coversTop (hline : IsLocalLineFrame L) :
    ∃ (U : X → X.Opens) (_ : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop U)
      (_ : ∀ x, L.over (U x) ≅ (unitMod X).over (U x)), True
proof:
:= by
  choose U hxU he using fun x : X => hline x
  refine ⟨fun x => (U x).1, ?_, fun x => (he x).some, trivial⟩
  apply (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := X) _).2
  ext x
  simp only [TopologicalSpace.Opens.coe_iSup, Set.mem_iUnion, TopologicalSpace.Opens.coe_top, Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
  exact ⟨x, hxU x⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.dualToIdeal_ι
statement:
theorem dualToIdeal_ι : dualToIdeal σ ≫ ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ) =
    dualEval σ
proof: := kernel.lift_ι _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.dualToIdeal_app_ι
statement:
theorem dualToIdeal_app_ι (W : X.Opens) (F : L.over W ⟶ (unitMod X).over W) :
    (ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ)).val.app (op W)
      ((dualToIdeal σ).val.app (op W) F) = dualEvalVal σ W F
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun k : lineBundleDual X L ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X => k.val.app (op W) F)
    (dualToIdeal_ι σ)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.dualToIdeal_isIso
statement:
theorem dualToIdeal_isIso (hline : IsLocalLineFrame L) (hreg : SectionIsRegular σ) :
    IsIso (dualToIdeal σ)
proof:
:= by
  apply moduleHom_isIso_of_app_bijective
  intro W
  constructor
  · intro s t hst
    have h1 := dualToIdeal_app_ι σ W s
    have h2 := dualToIdeal_app_ι σ W t
    have h3 : dualEvalVal σ W s = dualEvalVal σ W t := by
      rw [← h1, ← h2]
      exact congrArg _ hst
    have h4 : s - t = 0 := dualEvalVal_eq_zero σ hline hreg W (s - t)
      ((dualEvalVal_sub σ W s t).trans (by rw [h3, sub_self]))
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp h4
  · intro s
    let a := (ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ)).val.app (op W) s
    have ha : (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι.app W a = 0 :=
      (ConormalSheaf.idealModule_exact (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ) W).apply_apply_eq_zero s
    obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := exists_dual_global σ hline hreg W a ha
    refine ⟨F, ?_⟩
    apply ConormalSheaf.idealModuleι_app_injective (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ) W
    exact (dualToIdeal_app_ι σ W F).trans hF

      (C.twistOverlapTargetRestrictLocalSchemeIso d i j c)

  have ha : (C.union C').transition (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inl j) ≫
      (C.union C').overlapToChart (Sum.inl j) (Sum.inl i) =

  letI : IsOpenImmersion c.chartToRight :=
    CommonBasicOpen.chartToRight_isOpenImmersion c
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom := by
    infer_instance
  exact restrictRestrictionSquareIso_heq_of_a_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ha

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIASM.chTot_push
statement:
theorem chTot_push (hP : ProjBundleClosedPos (ProjectiveIntegral k))
    (g : X ⟶ Y) [g.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsProper g] (E : Y.Modules)
    (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y E) :
    totalPushOn (opsV4 k) g ∘ₗ chTot (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) hP ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E) =
      chTot (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) hP E ∘ₗ totalPushOn (opsV4 k) g
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty X := CHEXACT.nonempty_of_fact k (W := X)
  haveI : Nonempty Y := CHEXACT.nonempty_of_fact k (W := Y)
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := CHEXACT.exists_rank k hE
  have hr' := hasConstantRank_pullback X g E r hr
  have key : Alg.Interw (totalPushOn (opsV4 k) g)
      (chTot (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) hP ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E))
      (chTot (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) hP E) := by
    unfold chTot
    refine Alg.Interw.gsum (totalPushOn_degPres k g) (fun n ↦ ?_)
    rw [chOpOn_eq hr', chOpOn_eq hr, constRankChernAssignOn'_eq _ _ _ _ r hr',
      constRankChernAssignOn'_eq _ _ _ _ r hr]
    intro v
    exact CIIL1D.projFormulaPi_ch g (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) hP E r hr n v
  exact LinearMap.ext fun v ↦ key v

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIASM.chK0_push
statement:
theorem chK0_push (hP : ProjBundleClosedPos (ProjectiveIntegral k)) (h : ChExact k hP)
    (g : X ⟶ Y) [g.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsProper g] (w : K0 Y) (b : TotalChow X) :
    totalPushOn (opsV4 k) g (chK0 k hP h (pullbackK0 g w) b) =
      chK0 k hP h w (totalPushOn (opsV4 k) g b)
proof:
:= by
  let f₁ : K0 Y →+ (TotalChow X →ₗ[ℚ] TotalChow Y) :=
    AddMonoidHom.mk' (fun w ↦ totalPushOn (opsV4 k) g ∘ₗ chK0 k hP h (pullbackK0 g w))
      (by intro a b; simp only [map_add, LinearMap.comp_add])
  let f₂ : K0 Y →+ (TotalChow X →ₗ[ℚ] TotalChow Y) :=
    AddMonoidHom.mk' (fun w ↦ chK0 k hP h w ∘ₗ totalPushOn (opsV4 k) g)
      (by intro a b; simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_comp])
  have hf : f₁ = f₂ := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    intro x
    obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := x
    change totalPushOn (opsV4 k) g ∘ₗ chK0 k hP h (pullbackK0 g (k0ClassOf Y E hE)) =
      chK0 k hP h (k0ClassOf Y E hE) ∘ₗ totalPushOn (opsV4 k) g
    rw [pullbackK0_classOf, chK0_classOf_eq_chTot hP h _ _, chK0_classOf_eq_chTot hP h _ _]
    exact chTot_push hP g E hE
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun (DFunLike.congr_fun hf w) b

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIASM.caseII_of_pencil
statement:
theorem caseII_of_pencil (K : PencilK P) (h : ChExact k (closedPosV4 k)) (O : PencilOpen K h) :
    CaseII k (closedPosV4 k) h P.i
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  set ℓ := K.lift x with hℓ
  have hy : y = pullbackK0 P.j ℓ := K.injA (by rw [hxy, hℓ, K.hbcA x])
  subst hy
  
  have hqj : totalPushOn (opsV4 k) P.q ∘ₗ totalPushOn (opsV4 k) P.j = LinearMap.id := by
    rw [← totalPushOn_comp (opsV4 k) P.j P.q,
      totalPushOn_congr (opsV4 k) P.qj, totalPushOn_id]
  
  have hqe : totalPushOn (opsV4 k) P.q ∘ₗ totalPushOn (opsV4 k) P.e =
      totalPushOn (opsV4 k) P.i ∘ₗ totalPushOn (opsV4 k) P.π := by
    rw [← totalPushOn_comp (opsV4 k) P.e P.q, ← totalPushOn_comp (opsV4 k) P.π P.i,
      totalPushOn_congr (opsV4 k) P.qe]
  have e1 : chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h (pullbackK0 P.j ℓ) (fundClass k (W := P.A)) =
      totalPushOn (opsV4 k) P.q (totalPushOn (opsV4 k) P.j
        (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h (pullbackK0 P.j ℓ) (fundClass k (W := P.A)))) :=
    (LinearMap.congr_fun hqj _).symm
  rw [e1, chK0_push (closedPosV4 k) h P.j ℓ, K.fibreRel, map_add, O.kdisj x, zero_add,
    ← chK0_push (closedPosV4 k) h P.e ℓ]
  have e2 := LinearMap.congr_fun hqe
    (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h (pullbackK0 P.e ℓ) (fundClass k (W := P.E)))
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at e2
  rw [e2, O.zeroSection x _ (K.hbcE x)]

name: RingEquiv.awayMap'_comp_algebraMap
statement:
theorem _root_.RingEquiv.awayMap'_comp_algebraMap {S₁ S₂ : Type u} [CommRing S₁] [CommRing S₂]
    (e : S₁ ≃+* S₂) (a : S₁) {b : S₂} (hab : e a = b) :
    (e.awayMap' a hab).toRingHom.comp (algebraMap S₁ (Localization.Away a)) =
      (algebraMap S₂ (Localization.Away b)).comp e.toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  subst hab
  exact RingEquiv.awayMap_comp_algebraMap e a

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.awayMulEquivOfIsLocalization_eq_of_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem awayMulEquivOfIsLocalization_eq_of_ringEquiv
    {S₁ S₂ : Type u} [CommRing S₁] [CommRing S₂] [Algebra R S₁] [Algebra R S₂]
    (f g : R) [IsLocalization.Away f S₁] [IsLocalization.Away f S₂]
    (e : S₁ ≃+* S₂) (he : e.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap R S₁) = algebraMap R S₂) :
    awayMulEquivOfIsLocalization (S := S₁) f g =
      (awayMulEquivOfIsLocalization (S := S₂) f g).trans
        (e.awayMap' (algebraMap R S₁ g) (RingHom.congr_fun he g)).symm
proof:
:= by
  apply RingEquiv.toRingHom_injective
  apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers (f * g))
  have h1 := awayMulEquivOfIsLocalization_comp_algebraMap (S := S₁) f g
  have h2 := awayMulEquivOfIsLocalization_comp_algebraMap (S := S₂) f g
  have h3 := RingEquiv.awayMap'_comp_algebraMap e (algebraMap R S₁ g) (RingHom.congr_fun he g)
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro x
  show (awayMulEquivOfIsLocalization (S := S₁) f g) (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (f * g)) x) =
    ((awayMulEquivOfIsLocalization (S := S₂) f g).trans
        (e.awayMap' (algebraMap R S₁ g) (RingHom.congr_fun he g)).symm)
      (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (f * g)) x)
  rw [show (awayMulEquivOfIsLocalization (S := S₁) f g)
        (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (f * g)) x) =
      (algebraMap S₁ (Localization.Away (algebraMap R S₁ g)) (algebraMap R S₁ x)) from
    RingHom.congr_fun h1 x]
  rw [show ((awayMulEquivOfIsLocalization (S := S₂) f g).trans
        (e.awayMap' (algebraMap R S₁ g) (RingHom.congr_fun he g)).symm)
        (algebraMap R (Localization.Away (f * g)) x) =
      (e.awayMap' (algebraMap R S₁ g) (RingHom.congr_fun he g)).symm
        (algebraMap S₂ (Localization.Away (algebraMap R S₂ g)) (algebraMap R S₂ x)) from
    congrArg (e.awayMap' (algebraMap R S₁ g) (RingHom.congr_fun he g)).symm
      (RingHom.congr_fun h2 x)]
  rw [show algebraMap R S₂ x = e (algebraMap R S₁ x) from
    (RingHom.congr_fun he x).symm]
  rw [show (algebraMap S₂ (Localization.Away (algebraMap R S₂ g)))
        (e (algebraMap R S₁ x)) =
      (e.awayMap' (algebraMap R S₁ g) (RingHom.congr_fun he g))
        (algebraMap S₁ (Localization.Away (algebraMap R S₁ g)) (algebraMap R S₁ x)) from
    (RingHom.congr_fun h3 (algebraMap R S₁ x)).symm]
  exact ((e.awayMap' (algebraMap R S₁ g) (RingHom.congr_fun he g)).symm_apply_apply _).symm

theorem fibre_isOver' [IsIntegral A] (φk : k →+* Γ(A, ⊤)) (c : k) :

proof:
:= totalOver (k := k) J
    (fibreιGlobal A J k φk c).IsOver (Spk k) := by
  letI := totalOver (k := k) J
  refine ⟨?_⟩

name: GRRBlueprintV4.RG7.fibreRel_ambient
statement:
theorem fibreRel_ambient (c : k) :
    letI
proof:
:= KG2B.zOver (k := k) J
    haveI := z_lft (k := k) J
    haveI := z_noeth J
    letI := totalOver (k := k) J
    haveI := total_lft (k := k) J hA
    haveI := total_isNoetherian (k := k) J hA
    haveI := SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_totalGlobal
      A J
    haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k (totalGlobal A J)) :=
      ⟨CIICLASS.projectiveIntegral_of_K (projectiveIntegralK_total (k := k) J hA)⟩
    letI := componentOver (k := k) J
    haveI := component_lft J (KG2B.coverJ J hAreg hZ) (KG2B.projectiveIntegralK_Z J hA)
    haveI := component_isNoetherian J (KG2B.coverJ J hAreg hZ) (KG2B.projectiveIntegralK_Z J hA)
    haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k (component A J)) :=
      ⟨CIICLASS.projectiveIntegral_of_K (KG2B.projectiveIntegralK_E J hA hAreg hZ)⟩
    haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k A) := ⟨CIICLASS.projectiveIntegral_of_K hA⟩
    haveI := fibre_isOver' (k := k) J φk c
    haveI := component_isOver' (k := k) J
    ∃ (L N : (totalGlobal A J).Modules)
      (hL : SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank (totalGlobal A J) L 1)
      (hN : SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank (totalGlobal A J) N 1),
      totalPushOn (GRRBlueprintV4.opsV4 k) (fibreιGlobal A J k φk c)
          (GRRBlueprintV4.fundClass k (W := A)) =
        totalCapOn (GRRBlueprintV4.opsV4 k) (LPof L N) (hasConstantRank_LPof hL hN)
            (GRRBlueprintV4.fundClass k (W := totalGlobal A J)) +
          totalPushOn (GRRBlueprintV4.opsV4 k) (componentToTotal A J)
            (GRRBlueprintV4.fundClass k (W := component A J)) := by
  letI := KG2B.zOver (k := k) J
  haveI := z_lft (k := k) J
  haveI := z_noeth J
  letI := totalOver (k := k) J
  haveI := total_lft (k := k) J hA
  haveI := total_isNoetherian (k := k) J hA
  haveI := SchemeNormalCone.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveCompletionDeformation.IntegralARRM346.isIntegral_totalGlobal
    A J
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k (totalGlobal A J)) :=
    ⟨CIICLASS.projectiveIntegral_of_K (projectiveIntegralK_total (k := k) J hA)⟩
  letI := componentOver (k := k) J
  haveI := component_lft J (KG2B.coverJ J hAreg hZ) (KG2B.projectiveIntegralK_Z J hA)
  haveI := component_isNoetherian J (KG2B.coverJ J hAreg hZ) (KG2B.projectiveIntegralK_Z J hA)
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k (component A J)) :=
    ⟨CIICLASS.projectiveIntegral_of_K (KG2B.projectiveIntegralK_E J hA hAreg hZ)⟩
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k A) := ⟨CIICLASS.projectiveIntegral_of_K hA⟩
  haveI := fibre_isOver' (k := k) J φk c
  haveI := component_isOver' (k := k) J
  haveI := isIntegral_component J (KG2B.coverJ J hAreg hZ) (KG2B.projectiveIntegralK_Z J hA)
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := exists_height_generic hA
  exact fibreRel_totalGlobal_of_height A J φk c (n := d) hd

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.isIntegral_pullback_proj
statement:
theorem isIntegral_pullback_proj {A : Scheme.{u}} (g : A ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    [IsIntegral A] (n : ℕ) : IsIntegral (pullback g (toSpec k n))
proof:
:= by
  let J : Type u := ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1))
  let eJ : J ≃ Fin (n + 1) := Equiv.ulift
  let C : AffineFrameCover A (D22.FreeM A J) := D35.pulledCover g
  have hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = n + 1 := fun i ↦ by
    change Nat.card J = n + 1
    rw [Nat.card_congr eJ]
    simp
  haveI : IsIntegral C.scheme := C.isIntegral_scheme_of_card hC
  exact isIntegral_of_iso (D35.freeBundleIso eJ g C).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIICLASS.projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod
statement:
theorem projectiveIntegralK_of_iso_prod {A : Scheme.{u}} [A.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (A ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian A] (hA : ProjectiveIntegralK k A) (n : ℕ)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} [Y.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (e : Y ≅ pullback (A ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n))
    (he : e.hom ≫ pullback.fst _ _ ≫ A ↘ Spk k = Y ↘ Spk k) :
    ProjectiveIntegralK k Y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hI, hex⟩ := hA
  haveI := hI
  haveI : IsIntegral (pullback (A ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k n)) := isIntegral_pullback_proj _ n
  obtain ⟨M, s, hs, hsk⟩ := exists_closedImmersion_prod_over (A ↘ Spk k)
    (by obtain ⟨N, j, hj, hjk⟩ := hex; exact ⟨N, j, hj, hjk⟩) n
  refine ⟨isIntegral_of_iso e, M, e.hom ≫ s, ?_, ?_⟩
  · haveI := hs
    infer_instance
  · rw [Category.assoc, hsk, ← he]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictPushforwardBaseChange_ring
statement:
lemma restrictPushforwardBaseChange_ring
    (i : X ⟶ Z) (j : Y ⟶ Z) (f : W ⟶ X) (g : W ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion i] [IsOpenImmersion g]
    (hp : IsPullback f g i j) (U : X.Opens) :
    (i.appIso U).inv ≫ j.app (i ''ᵁ U) ≫
        Y.presheaf.map
          (eqToHom
            (IsOpenImmersion.image_preimage_eq_preimage_image_of_isPullback
              hp U)).op =
      f.app U ≫ (g.appIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ U)).inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsOpenImmersion.app_eq_appIso_inv_app_of_comp_eq
    f i (g ≫ j) hp.w.symm U]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Scheme.Hom.comp_app]
  change
    (i.appIso U).inv ≫
        (j.app (i ''ᵁ U) ≫
          Y.presheaf.map
            (eqToHom
              (IsOpenImmersion.image_preimage_eq_preimage_image_of_isPullback
                hp U)).op) =
      (i.appIso U).inv ≫
        (j.app (i ''ᵁ U) ≫
          g.app (j ⁻¹ᵁ (i ''ᵁ U)) ≫
          W.presheaf.map
            (eqToHom
              (IsOpenImmersion.app_eq_invApp_app_of_comp_eq_aux
                f i (g ≫ j) hp.w.symm U)).op ≫
          (g.appIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ U)).inv)
  congr 1
  let hV : f ⁻¹ᵁ U ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ (j ⁻¹ᵁ (i ''ᵁ U)) :=
    le_of_eq
      (IsOpenImmersion.app_eq_invApp_app_of_comp_eq_aux
        f i (g ≫ j) hp.w.symm U)
  change
    j.app (i ''ᵁ U) ≫
        Y.presheaf.map
          (eqToHom
            (IsOpenImmersion.image_preimage_eq_preimage_image_of_isPullback
              hp U)).op =
      j.app (i ''ᵁ U) ≫
        g.appLE (j ⁻¹ᵁ (i ''ᵁ U)) (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) hV ≫
          (g.appIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ U)).inv
  rw [g.appLE_appIso_inv hV]
  congr 1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictPushforwardBaseChangeIso_hom_app_apply
statement:
theorem restrictPushforwardBaseChangeIso_hom_app_apply
    (i : X ⟶ Z) (j : Y ⟶ Z) (f : W ⟶ X) (g : W ⟶ Y)

    LinearMap.comp_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictPushforwardBaseChangeIso_inv_app_apply'

    (i : X ⟶ Z) (j : Y ⟶ Z) (f : W ⟶ X) (g : W ⟶ Y)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistRestrictTransitionAlongIso_hom_eq
statement:
theorem twistRestrictTransitionAlongIso_hom_eq
    {d : ℤ} (T : C.TwistTransitionSystem d)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ C.scheme) {i j : C.I}
    (g : Y ⟶ C.overlap i j)
    (fᵢ : Y ⟶ C.chart i) (fⱼ : Y ⟶ C.chart j)
    [IsOpenImmersion g] [IsOpenImmersion fᵢ] [IsOpenImmersion fⱼ]
    (hqᵢ : fᵢ ≫ C.chartι i = q)
    (hqⱼ : fⱼ ≫ C.chartι j = q)
    (hfᵢ : g ≫ C.overlapToChart i j = fᵢ)
    (hfⱼ :
      g ≫ (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i) = fⱼ) :
    (C.twistRestrictTransitionAlongIso T g fᵢ fⱼ hfᵢ hfⱼ).hom =
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback fᵢ).app
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)).hom ≫
        C.twistPullHom T q fᵢ fⱼ hqᵢ hqⱼ ≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback fⱼ).app
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j)).inv
proof:
:= by
  unfold twistPullHom
  rw [Pseudofunctor.DescentData'.pullHom'_eq_pullHom
    (C.twistTransitionHomChosen T)
    q fᵢ fⱼ g hqᵢ hqⱼ hfᵢ hfⱼ]
  have hTransition :
      C.twistTransitionHomChosen T i j =
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback
          (C.overlapToChart i j)).app
            (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)).inv ≫
        (C.twistRestrictTransitionIso T i j).hom ≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback
          (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i)).app
            (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j)).hom := by
    simp only [twistRestrictTransitionIso, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc,
      Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  rw [hTransition]
  have key := CommonBasicOpen.twistPullHomAux_pullHom_restrictConversion
    (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i) (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j)
    (C.overlapToChart i j)
    (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i)
    (C.twistRestrictTransitionIso T i j).hom
    g fᵢ fⱼ hfᵢ hfⱼ
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (congrArg
    (fun z ↦ ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback fᵢ).app
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)).hom ≫ z ≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback fⱼ).app
          (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j)).inv) key.symm)
  simp [twistRestrictTransitionAlongIso, twistRestrictTransitionIso, Category.assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistTripleRestrictTransition_comp
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem twistTripleRestrictTransition_comp
    {d : ℤ} (T : C.TwistTransitionSystem d)
    (hT : C.TwistTransitionLaws T) (i j k : C.I) :
    (C.twistTripleRestrictTransitionIJ T i j k).hom ≫
        (C.twistTripleRestrictTransitionJK T i j k).hom =
      (C.twistTripleRestrictTransitionIK T i j k).hom
proof:
:= by
  let H := C.twistChosenPullback₃ i j k
  unfold twistTripleRestrictTransitionIJ
    twistTripleRestrictTransitionJK
    twistTripleRestrictTransitionIK
  rw [C.twistRestrictTransitionAlongIso_hom_eq T
      H.p H.p₁₂ H.p₁ H.p₂
      (C.twistChosenPullback₃_w₁ i j k)
      (C.twistChosenPullback₃_w₂ i j k)
      H.p₁₂_p₁ H.p₁₂_p₂,
    C.twistRestrictTransitionAlongIso_hom_eq T
      H.p H.p₂₃ H.p₂ H.p₃
      (C.twistChosenPullback₃_w₂ i j k)
      (C.twistChosenPullback₃_w₃ i j k)
      H.p₂₃_p₂ H.p₂₃_p₃,
    C.twistRestrictTransitionAlongIso_hom_eq T
      H.p H.p₁₃ H.p₁ H.p₃
      (C.twistChosenPullback₃_w₁ i j k)
      (C.twistChosenPullback₃_w₃ i j k)
      H.p₁₃_p₁ H.p₁₃_p₃]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  slice_lhs 2 3 =>
    rw [hT.comp H.p H.p₁ H.p₂ H.p₃
      (C.twistChosenPullback₃_w₁ i j k)
      (C.twistChosenPullback₃_w₂ i j k)
      (C.twistChosenPullback₃_w₃ i j k)]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistLocalChartCochain_π
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem twistLocalChartCochain_π
    {d : ℤ} (T : C.TwistTransitionSystem d) (i j : C.I) :
