name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeCoefficients_eq_zero_of_not_surjective
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeCoefficients_eq_zero_of_not_surjective
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (x : (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjectionLinear k n d p).range)
    (a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) (ha : ¬Function.Surjective a)
    (e : coordinateLaurentAllNegativeDegreeExponent n d) :
    coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeCoefficients k n d p x a e = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ := x.2
  change (x.1 a).1 e.1 = 0
  calc
    _ = (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjection k n d p x' a).1 e.1 :=
      congrArg (fun z : coordinateLaurentHigherTerm k n d p ↦ (z a).1 e.1) hx'.symm
    _ = 0 := congrArg
      (fun z : coordinateLaurentPiece k n d p a ↦ z.1 e.1)
      (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjection_apply_eq_zero_of_not_surjective
        k n d p x' a ha)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients_injective
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients_injective
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective
      (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients k n d p)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  apply coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeCoefficients_injective k n d p
  funext a e
  by_cases ha : Function.Surjective a
  · let aa :
        {a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) // Function.Surjective a} :=
      ⟨a, ha⟩
    exact congrFun (congrFun hxy aa) e
  · rw [coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeCoefficients_eq_zero_of_not_surjective
      k n d p x a ha e,
      coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeCoefficients_eq_zero_of_not_surjective
        k n d p y a ha e]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentAllNegativePolynomialOfCoefficients_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateLaurentAllNegativePolynomialOfCoefficients_apply
    (d : ℤ) (c : coordinateLaurentAllNegativeDegreeExponent n d → k)
    (e : coordinateLaurentAllNegativeDegreeExponent n d) :
    coordinateLaurentAllNegativePolynomialOfCoefficients k n d c e.1 = c e
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeDegreeExponent n d) :=
    coordinateLaurentAllNegativeDegreeExponent_finite n d
  change
    Finsupp.embDomain
        (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeDegreeExponentEmbedding n d)
        (Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm c) e.1 = c e
  rw [show e.1 =
      coordinateLaurentAllNegativeDegreeExponentEmbedding n d e from rfl,
    Finsupp.embDomain_apply_self]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentHigherTermOfSurjectiveCoefficients_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateLaurentHigherTermOfSurjectiveCoefficients_apply
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (c : coordinateLaurentAllNegativeSurjectiveCoefficientSpace k n d p)
    (a : {a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) // Function.Surjective a})
    (e : coordinateLaurentAllNegativeDegreeExponent n d) :
    (coordinateLaurentHigherTermOfSurjectiveCoefficients k n d p c a.1).1 e.1 =
      c a e
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateLaurentHigherTermOfSurjectiveCoefficients, dif_pos a.2]
  exact coordinateLaurentAllNegativePolynomialOfCoefficients_apply k n d (c a) e

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients_surjective
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients_surjective
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective
      (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients k n d p)
proof:
:= by
  intro c
  let x := coordinateLaurentHigherTermOfSurjectiveCoefficients k n d p c
  let px :
      (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjectionLinear k n d p).range :=
    ⟨coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjectionLinear k n d p x, ⟨x, rfl⟩⟩
  refine ⟨px, ?_⟩
  funext a e
  change
    (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjection k n d p x a.1).1 e.1 =
      c a e
  rw [coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjection_apply_coeff, if_pos e.2.2]
  exact coordinateLaurentHigherTermOfSurjectiveCoefficients_apply k n d p c a e

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeDifferential_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeDifferential_val
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (x : (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjectionLinear k n d p).range) :
    (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeDifferential k n d p x).1 =
      coordinateLaurentHigherDifferentialLinear k n d p x.1
proof:
:=
  by
    unfold coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeDifferential
    rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients_apply
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (x : (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjectionLinear k n d p).range)
    (a : {a : Fin (p + 1) → Fin (n + 1) // Function.Surjective a})
    (e : coordinateLaurentAllNegativeDegreeExponent n d) :
    coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients k n d p x a e =
      (x.1 a.1).1 e.1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentSurjectiveWordDifferential_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateLaurentSurjectiveWordDifferential_apply
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (c : coordinateLaurentAllNegativeSurjectiveCoefficientSpace k n d p)
    (a : {a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) // Function.Surjective a})
    (e : coordinateLaurentAllNegativeDegreeExponent n d) :
    coordinateLaurentSurjectiveWordDifferential k n d p c a e =
      ∑ r : Fin (p + 2), (-1 : k) ^ r.val *
        if h : Function.Surjective (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove) then
          c ⟨a.1 ∘ r.succAbove, h⟩ e
        else 0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients_differential
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients_differential
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (x : (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjectionLinear k n d p).range) :
    coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients k n d (p + 1)
        (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeDifferential k n d p x) =
      coordinateLaurentSurjectiveWordDifferential k n d p
        (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients k n d p x)
proof:
:= by
  funext a e
  rw [coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients_apply,
    coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeDifferential_val,
    coordinateLaurentSurjectiveWordDifferential_apply]
  change
    (coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d p x.1 a.1).1 e.1 =
      ∑ r : Fin (p + 2), (-1 : k) ^ r.val *
        if h : Function.Surjective (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove) then
          (x.1 (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove)).1 e.1
        else 0
  rw [coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_apply_coeff]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  by_cases h : Function.Surjective (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove)
  · rw [dif_pos h]
  · have hz : (x.1 (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove)).1 e.1 = 0 :=
      coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeCoefficients_eq_zero_of_not_surjective
        k n d p x (a.1 ∘ r.succAbove) h e
    rw [dif_neg h, hz, mul_zero]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_comp_self
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_comp_self
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (x : coordinateLaurentHigherTerm k n d p) :
    coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d (p + 1)
        (coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d p x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let e (q : ℕ) :=
    coordinateCechTwistingLaurentHigherTermEquiv k n d q
  let xNative :
      coordinateCechHigherTerm k n (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) p :=
    (e p).symm x
  have hmap (q : ℕ)
      (z : coordinateCechHigherTerm k n (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d) q) :
      e (q + 1) (coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential k n d q z) =
        coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d q (e q z) := by
    rw [coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential_eq_transported_unconditional,
      coordinateCechTwistingTransportedHigherDifferential_toLaurent]
  have hnative :
      coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential k n d (p + 1)
          (coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential k n d p xNative) = 0 := by
    have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      ((projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex k n d).d_comp_d
        p (p + 1) (p + 2)) xNative
    change
      coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential k n d (p + 1)
          (coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential k n d p xNative) = 0 at h
    exact h
  calc
    _ = coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d (p + 1)
        (e (p + 1)
          (coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential k n d p xNative)) := by
      rw [hmap]
      simp [xNative, e]
    _ = e (p + 2)
        (coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential k n d (p + 1)
          (coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential k n d p xNative)) :=
      (hmap (p + 1)
        (coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential k n d p xNative)).symm
    _ = 0 := by rw [hnative, map_zero]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateLaurentSurjectiveWordDifferential_comp_self
statement:
theorem coordinateLaurentSurjectiveWordDifferential_comp_self
    (d : ℤ) (p : ℕ)
    (c : coordinateLaurentAllNegativeSurjectiveCoefficientSpace k n d p) :
    coordinateLaurentSurjectiveWordDifferential k n d (p + 1)
        (coordinateLaurentSurjectiveWordDifferential k n d p c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let E (q : ℕ) :=
    coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficientsLinearEquiv k n d q
  let x :
      (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeHigherProjectionLinear k n d p).range :=
    (E p).symm c
  have hx :
      coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients k n d p x = c :=
    (E p).apply_symm_apply c
  have hdd :
      coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeDifferential k n d (p + 1)
          (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeDifferential k n d p x) = 0 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change
      coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d (p + 1)
          (coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential k n d p x.1) = 0
    exact coordinateLaurentHigherDifferential_comp_self k n d p x.1
  calc
    _ = coordinateLaurentSurjectiveWordDifferential k n d (p + 1)
        (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients k n d (p + 1)
          (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeDifferential k n d p x)) := by
      rw [coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients_differential, hx]
    _ = coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients k n d (p + 2)
        (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeDifferential k n d (p + 1)
          (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeDifferential k n d p x)) :=
      (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeSurjectiveCoefficients_differential
        k n d (p + 1)
        (coordinateLaurentAllNegativeRangeDifferential k n d p x)).symm
    _ = 0 := by rw [hdd, map_zero]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.A12ZX.lowPart_lof
statement:
theorem lowPart_lof (j : ℕ) (T : Alg.Op M) (n : ℕ) (z : M n) :
    lowPart j T (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M n z) =
      if j ≤ n then DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M (n - j)
        (DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ M (n - j) (T (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M n z))) else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold lowPart
  rw [DirectSum.toModule_lof]
  split_ifs <;> rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.A12ZX.lowPart_add
statement: theorem lowPart_add (j : ℕ) (T S : Alg.Op M) : lowPart j (T + S) = lowPart j T + lowPart j S
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, lowPart_lof]
  split_ifs
  · rw [map_add, map_add]
  · simp

name: GRRBlueprintV4.A12ZX.lowPart_zero
statement: theorem lowPart_zero (j : ℕ) : lowPart j (0 : Alg.Op M) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, lowPart_lof, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: GRRBlueprintV4.A12ZX.lowPart_neg
statement: theorem lowPart_neg (j : ℕ) (T : Alg.Op M) : lowPart j (-T) = -lowPart j T
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.neg_apply, lowPart_lof]
  split_ifs
  · rw [map_neg, map_neg]
  · simp

name: GRRBlueprintV4.A12ZX.lowPart_mem
statement: theorem lowPart_mem (j : ℕ) (T : Alg.Op M) : lowPart j T ∈ lowSub M j
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_lowSub]
  intro m z i hi
  rw [lowPart_lof]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [DirectSum.lof_eq_of]
    exact DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne (m - j) i _ (by omega)
  · simp

name: GRRBlueprintV4.A12ZX.low_one_zero
statement: theorem low_one_zero (y : M 0) : C (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M 0 y) = 0
proof:
:=
  low_lof_lt hC (Nat.zero_lt_one) y

name: GRRBlueprintV4.A12ZX.low_one_succ
statement:
theorem low_one_succ (i : ℕ) (y : M (i + 1)) :
    C (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M (i + 1) y) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M i
        (DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ M i (C (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M (i + 1) y)))
proof:
:= by
  have h := low_lof_ge hC (m := i + 1) (a := 1) (by omega) y
  exact h

name: GRRBlueprintV4.A12ZX.low_one_apply
statement:
theorem low_one_apply (i : ℕ) (w : DirectSum ℕ M) :
    DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ M i (C w) =
      DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ M i
        (C (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M (i + 1) (DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ M (i + 1) w)))
proof:
:= by
  induction w using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | of m z =>
    simp only [← DirectSum.lof_eq_of ℚ]
    by_cases h : m = i + 1
    · subst h
      rw [DirectSum.component.lof_self]
    · have h1 : DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ M i (C (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M m z)) = 0 :=
        hC m z i (by omega)
      have h2 : DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ M (i + 1) (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M m z) = 0 := by
        rw [DirectSum.lof_eq_of]
        exact DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne m (i + 1) z (by omega)
      rw [h1, h2, map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
  | add x y hx hy =>
    rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, map_add, map_add, map_add]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.A12ZX.lowPart_succ_mul_left
statement:
theorem lowPart_succ_mul_left (j : ℕ) (T : Alg.Op M) :
    lowPart (j + 1) (C * T) = C * lowPart j T
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, lowPart_lof]
  by_cases h1 : j + 1 ≤ n
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, n - j = i + 1 := ⟨n - j - 1, by omega⟩
    have hi' : n - (j + 1) = i := by omega
    rw [if_pos h1, if_pos (by omega), hi', hi, low_one_apply hC i (T (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M n z))]
    exact (low_one_succ hC i _).symm
  · rw [if_neg h1]
    by_cases h2 : j ≤ n
    · have hn : n - j = 0 := by omega
      rw [if_pos h2, hn, low_one_zero hC]
    · rw [if_neg h2, map_zero]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.A12ZX.lowPart_succ_mul_right
statement:
theorem lowPart_succ_mul_right (j : ℕ) (T : Alg.Op M) :
    lowPart (j + 1) (T * C) = lowPart j T * C
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, lowPart_lof]
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    rw [low_one_zero hC, if_neg (by omega), map_zero]
  | succ a =>
    rw [low_one_succ hC a z, lowPart_lof]
    by_cases h : j ≤ a
    · rw [if_pos (by omega), if_pos h]
      have : a + 1 - (j + 1) = a - j := by omega
      rw [this]
    · rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg h]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.A12ZX.lowPart_comm
statement:
theorem lowPart_comm {T : Alg.Op M} (hT : C * T = T * C) (j : ℕ) :
    C * lowPart j T = lowPart j T * C
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lowPart_succ_mul_left hC, ← lowPart_succ_mul_right hC, hT]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.A12ZX.gsum_commute
statement:
theorem gsum_commute {C : Alg.Op M} (hC : C ∈ lowSub M 1) (a : ℕ → Alg.Op M)
    (ha : ∀ m, a m ∈ lowSub M m) (hcomm : ∀ m, C * a m = a m * C) :
    C * Alg.gsum a = Alg.gsum a * C
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Module.End.mul_apply]
  rw [Alg.gsum_lof, LinearMap.sum_apply, map_sum]
  have hc : ∀ m x, C (a m x) = a m (C x) := fun m x => by
    have := LinearMap.congr_fun (congrArg (fun T : Alg.Op M => (T : Alg.Op M)) (hcomm m)) x
    simpa [Module.End.mul_apply] using this
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    rw [low_one_zero hC]
    simp [hc, low_one_zero hC]
  | succ a' =>
    simp only [hc]
    rw [low_one_succ hC a' z, Alg.gsum_lof, LinearMap.sum_apply,
      Finset.sum_range_succ _ (a' + 1),
      low_lof_lt (ha (a' + 1)) (Nat.lt_succ_self a'), add_zero]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.A12ZX.chK0_comm_cap
statement:
theorem chK0_comm_cap {W : Scheme.{u}} [W.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (W ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian W] [Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k W)] (M : W.Modules) (hM : HasConstantRank W M 1)
    (w : K0 W) :
    totalCapOn (opsV4 k) M hM * chK0 k hP hCh w = chK0 k hP hCh w * totalCapOn (opsV4 k) M hM
proof:
:= by
  haveI : _root_.Nonempty W := CHEXACT.nonempty_of_fact k (W := W)
  have hW : WhitneyConstRankOn (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) hP := whitney_projectiveIntegral hP
  have hcap : totalCapOn (opsV4 k) M hM ∈ lowSub (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow W n) 1 :=
    totalCapOn_mem_lowering (opsV4 k) M hM
  have key : ∀ (E : W.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree W E),
      totalCapOn (opsV4 k) M hM * chK0 k hP hCh (k0ClassOf W E hE) =
        chK0 k hP hCh (k0ClassOf W E hE) * totalCapOn (opsV4 k) M hM := by
    intro E hE
    rw [chK0_classOf_eq_chTot hP hCh E hE]
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := CHEXACT.exists_rank k hE
    unfold chTot
    refine gsum_commute hcap _ (fun n ↦ lowSub_of_loweringSub
      (chOpOn_lowering (ops := opsV4 k) (cp := cpV4 k) (hP := hP) hW hr n)) fun n ↦ ?_
    have h := chOpOn_comm_cOp (ops := opsV4 k) (cp := cpV4 k) (hP := hP) hW hr hM n 1
    rw [constRankChernAssignOn'_line (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) hP M hM 1] at h
    simpa using h
  let f : K0 W →+ Module.End ℚ (TotalChow W) :=
    (AddMonoidHom.mulLeft (totalCapOn (opsV4 k) M hM)).comp (chK0 k hP hCh)
  let g : K0 W →+ Module.End ℚ (TotalChow W) :=
    (AddMonoidHom.mulRight (totalCapOn (opsV4 k) M hM)).comp (chK0 k hP hCh)
  have hfg : f = g := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    intro x
    exact key x.1 x.2
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hfg w

name: GRRBlueprintV4.A12ZX.zxOp_add
statement:
theorem zxOp_add (w w' : K0 C.scheme) (m : ℕ) :
    zxOp k hP hCh C hC (w + w') m = zxOp k hP hCh C hC w m + zxOp k hP hCh C hC w' m
proof:
:= by
  unfold zxOp
  rw [map_add, lowPart_add]
  simp only [LinearMap.add_comp, LinearMap.comp_add]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.A12ZX.zxOp_zero
statement: theorem zxOp_zero (m : ℕ) : zxOp k hP hCh C hC 0 m = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold zxOp
  rw [map_zero, lowPart_zero]
  simp

name: GRRBlueprintV4.A12ZX.zxOp_neg
statement:
theorem zxOp_neg (w : K0 C.scheme) (m : ℕ) :
    zxOp k hP hCh C hC (-w) m = -zxOp k hP hCh C hC w m
proof:
:= by
  unfold zxOp
  rw [map_neg, lowPart_neg]
  simp only [LinearMap.neg_comp, LinearMap.comp_neg]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.A12ZX.zxOp_sub
statement:
theorem zxOp_sub (w w' : K0 C.scheme) (m : ℕ) :
    zxOp k hP hCh C hC (w - w') m = zxOp k hP hCh C hC w m - zxOp k hP hCh C hC w' m
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, zxOp_add, zxOp_neg]
  abel

name: GRRBlueprintV4.A12ZX.zxOp_mem_lowering
statement:
theorem zxOp_mem_lowering (w : K0 C.scheme) (m : ℕ) :
    zxOp k hP hCh C hC w m ∈ loweringSub X m
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_loweringSub]
  intro n z j hj
  haveI : Flat C.toBase := C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos r))
  unfold zxOp
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  have h1 : totalPullOn (opsV4 k) C.toBase r ((cpV4 k).projBundle_relDim C hC)
      (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun i ↦ RationalDimChow X i) n z) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun i ↦ RationalDimChow C.scheme i) (n + r)
        ((opsV4 k).pull C.toBase r ((cpV4 k).projBundle_relDim C hC) n z) := by
    simp [totalPullOn]
  rw [h1, lowPart_lof]
  by_cases hmn : m ≤ n
  · rw [if_pos (by omega)]
    simp only [totalPushOn, DirectSum.toModule_lof, LinearMap.comp_apply]
    rw [DirectSum.lof_eq_of]
    exact DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne (n + r - (r + m)) j _ (by omega)
  · rw [if_neg (by omega), map_zero]
    rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.A12ZX.zxOp_cap
statement:
theorem zxOp_cap (L : X.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank X L 1) (w : K0 C.scheme) (m : ℕ) :
    totalCapOn (opsV4 k) L hL * zxOp k hP hCh C hC w m =
      zxOp k hP hCh C hC w m * totalCapOn (opsV4 k) L hL
proof:
:= by
  haveI : _root_.Nonempty C.scheme := CHEXACT.nonempty_of_fact k (W := C.scheme)
  haveI : Flat C.toBase := C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos r))
  have hπL := hasConstantRank_pullback C.scheme C.toBase L 1 hL
  have hcap : totalCapOn (opsV4 k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.toBase).obj L) hπL ∈
      lowSub (fun n ↦ RationalDimChow C.scheme n) 1 :=
    totalCapOn_mem_lowering (opsV4 k) _ hπL
  have hcomm := lowPart_comm hcap (T := chK0 k hP hCh w)
    (chK0_comm_cap k hP hCh _ hπL w) (r + m)
  have hpush := (cpV4 k).cap_push C.toBase L hL
  have hpull := (cpV4 k).cap_pull C.toBase r ((cpV4 k).projBundle_relDim C hC) L hL
  unfold zxOp
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  have e1 := LinearMap.congr_fun hpull z
  have e3 := LinearMap.congr_fun hcomm (totalPullOn (opsV4 k) C.toBase r
    ((cpV4 k).projBundle_relDim C hC) z)
  have e4 := LinearMap.congr_fun hpush
    (lowPart (M := fun n ↦ RationalDimChow C.scheme n) (r + m) (chK0 k hP hCh w)
      (totalPullOn (opsV4 k) C.toBase r ((cpV4 k).projBundle_relDim C hC) z))
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Module.End.mul_apply] at e1 e3 e4 ⊢
  rw [← e4, e3, e1]

name: KSpecialization.AR7R.abstract_eval
statement:
theorem abstract_eval {P Q : C} {A B : D} (cP : F.obj P ⟶ A) (cQ : F.obj Q ⟶ B)
    (s : A ⟶ 𝟙_ D) (Us : P ⟶ 𝟙_ C)
    (hs : F.map Us ≫ Functor.OplaxMonoidal.η F = cP ≫ s) :
    Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ F P Q ≫ (cP ⊗ₘ cQ) ≫ (s ▷ B ≫ (λ_ B).hom) =
      F.map ((Us ▷ Q) ≫ (λ_ Q).hom) ≫ cQ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Functor.map_comp, Functor.Monoidal.map_whiskerRight_assoc, Functor.Monoidal.map_leftUnitor]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [tensorHom_def, Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc (A ◁ cQ), whisker_exchange]
  rw [Functor.Monoidal.μ_δ_assoc, ← MonoidalCategory.comp_whiskerRight_assoc, hs,
    MonoidalCategory.comp_whiskerRight_assoc]
  simp only [Category.assoc, MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor_naturality]

name: KSpecialization.AR7R.central_transport
statement:
theorem central_transport {T' T : C ⥤ C} (θ : T' ≅ T) (σ : T ⟶ 𝟭 C)
    (hc : ∀ E : C, σ.app (T.obj E) = T.map (σ.app E)) :
    ∀ E : C, (θ.hom ≫ σ).app (T'.obj E) = T'.map ((θ.hom ≫ σ).app E)
proof:
:= by
  intro E
  have n0 : T.map (θ.hom.app E) ≫ σ.app (T.obj E) = σ.app (T'.obj E) ≫ θ.hom.app E :=
    σ.naturality (θ.hom.app E)
  have n1 : T'.map (σ.app E) ≫ θ.hom.app E = θ.hom.app (T.obj E) ≫ T.map (σ.app E) :=
    θ.hom.naturality (σ.app E)
  have n2 : T'.map (θ.hom.app E) ≫ θ.hom.app (T.obj E) =
      θ.hom.app (T'.obj E) ≫ T.map (θ.hom.app E) := θ.hom.naturality (θ.hom.app E)
  have e1 : (θ.hom ≫ σ).app (T'.obj E) ≫ θ.hom.app E =
      θ.hom.app (T'.obj E) ≫ T.map (θ.hom.app E) ≫ T.map (σ.app E) := by
    rw [NatTrans.comp_app, Category.assoc, ← n0, ← hc E]
    simp
  have e2 : T'.map ((θ.hom ≫ σ).app E) ≫ θ.hom.app E =
      θ.hom.app (T'.obj E) ≫ T.map (θ.hom.app E) ≫ T.map (σ.app E) := by
    have n3 : T'.map (θ.hom.app E) ≫ θ.hom.app (T.obj E) ≫ T.map (σ.app E) =
        θ.hom.app (T'.obj E) ≫ T.map (θ.hom.app E) ≫ T.map (σ.app E) := by
      rw [← Category.assoc, n2, Category.assoc]
    rw [NatTrans.comp_app, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc, n1]
    exact n3
  haveI : IsIso (θ.hom.app E) := inferInstance
  exact (cancel_mono (θ.hom.app E)).1 (e1.trans e2.symm)

name: KSpecialization.AR7R.theta_koszul
statement:
theorem theta_koszul {Λ : X.Modules} (s : Λ ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) (E : X.Modules) :
    (tensorSheafIsoLocalizedTensor X Λ E).hom ≫
        (ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR1.koszulσ Λ s).app E =
      (moduleSheafification X).map (evalPre s E) ≫ cnt E
proof:
:= by
  rw [ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR1.koszulσ_app]
  have h1 : (tensorSheafIsoLocalizedTensor X Λ E).hom =
      Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (moduleSheafification X) (underlyingCommPresheaf X Λ)
        (underlyingCommPresheaf X E) ≫ (cnt Λ ⊗ₘ cnt E) := rfl
  have h2 : Functor.OplaxMonoidal.η (moduleSheafification X) = cnt (tensorUnitSheaf X) := rfl
  rw [h1]
  refine abstract_eval (moduleSheafification X) (cnt Λ) (cnt E) s
    ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map s) ?_
  rw [h2]
  exact (moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).counit.naturality s

name: KSpecialization.AR7R.evalPre_app_tmul
statement:
theorem evalPre_app_tmul {Λ : X.Modules} (s : Λ ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) (E : X.Modules)
    (W : X.Opens) (l : Λ.val.obj (op W)) (m : E.val.obj (op W)) :
    (evalPre s E).app (op W) (l ⊗ₜ m) = (s.val.app (op W)).hom l • m
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: KSpecialization.AR7R.koszul_app_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem koszul_app_eq_zero_iff {Λ : X.Modules} (s : Λ ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) (E : X.Modules) :
    (ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR1.koszulσ Λ s).app E = 0 ↔
      ∀ (W : X.Opens) (l : Λ.val.obj (op W)) (m : E.val.obj (op W)),
        (s.val.app (op W)).hom l • m = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hψ : evalPre s E = 0 ↔
      ∀ (W : X.Opens) (l : Λ.val.obj (op W)) (m : E.val.obj (op W)),
        (s.val.app (op W)).hom l • m = 0 := by
    constructor
    · intro h W l m
      exact (evalPre_app_tmul s E W l m).symm.trans
        (congrArg (fun f => f.app (op W) (l ⊗ₜ m)) h)
    · intro h
      apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
      intro W
      apply ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.tensor_ext
      intro l m
      have := h W.unop l m
      change (evalPre s E).app W (l ⊗ₜ m) = 0
      exact (evalPre_app_tmul s E W.unop l m).trans this
  rw [← hψ]
  let adj := moduleSheafificationAdjunction X
  have hz : (adj.homEquiv (underlyingCommPresheaf X Λ ⊗ underlyingCommPresheaf X E) E).symm 0 = 0 := by
    rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_counit]; simp
  have hs : (adj.homEquiv (underlyingCommPresheaf X Λ ⊗ underlyingCommPresheaf X E) E).symm
      (evalPre s E) = (moduleSheafification X).map (evalPre s E) ≫ cnt E := by
    rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_counit]; rfl
  have hθ : ((tensorSheafIsoLocalizedTensor X Λ E).hom ≫
        (ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR1.koszulσ Λ s).app E = 0) ↔
      (ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR1.koszulσ Λ s).app E = 0 := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      have := (cancel_epi (tensorSheafIsoLocalizedTensor X Λ E).hom).1 (h.trans (comp_zero).symm)
      exact this
    · intro h
      rw [h]; exact comp_zero
  refine hθ.symm.trans ?_
  rw [theta_koszul, ← hs]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact (adj.homEquiv _ E).symm.injective (h.trans hz.symm)
  · intro h
    rw [h]
    exact hz

name: KSpecialization.AR7R.sheafification_map_eq_of_locally
statement:
theorem sheafification_map_eq_of_locally
    {A B : PresheafOfModules.{u} (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)} (φ ψ : A ⟶ B)
    (h : ∀ x : X, ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ ∀ W : X.Opens, W ≤ U →
      ∀ a : A.obj (op W), φ.app (op W) a = ψ.app (op W) a) :
    (moduleSheafification X).map φ = (moduleSheafification X).map ψ
proof:
:= by
  let adj := moduleSheafificationAdjunction X
  apply (adj.homEquiv _ _).injective
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
  have n1 : adj.unit.app A ≫ (underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map
      ((moduleSheafification X).map φ) = φ ≫ adj.unit.app B := (adj.unit.naturality φ).symm
  have n2 : adj.unit.app A ≫ (underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map
      ((moduleSheafification X).map ψ) = ψ ≫ adj.unit.app B := (adj.unit.naturality ψ).symm
  refine n1.trans (Eq.trans ?_ n2.symm)
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro W
  obtain ⟨W⟩ := W
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro a
  change (adj.unit.app B).app (op W) (φ.app (op W) a) =
    (adj.unit.app B).app (op W) (ψ.app (op W) a)
  choose U hU hprop using fun x : W => h x.1
  let G := (moduleSheafification X).obj B
  have hcov : W ≤ ⨆ x : W, W ⊓ U x := by
    intro y hy
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hy, hU ⟨y, hy⟩⟩
  refine TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' (⟨G.presheaf, G.isSheaf⟩ : TopCat.Sheaf Ab X)
    (fun x : W => W ⊓ U x) W (fun x => homOfLE inf_le_left) hcov _ _ fun x => ?_
  have key : ∀ f : A ⟶ B,
      G.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : W ⊓ U x ≤ W)).op
        ((adj.unit.app B).app (op W) (f.app (op W) a)) =
      (adj.unit.app B).app (op (W ⊓ U x))
        (f.app (op (W ⊓ U x)) (A.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : W ⊓ U x ≤ W)).op a)) := by
    intro f
    have e1 := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply (adj.unit.app B)
      (homOfLE (inf_le_left : W ⊓ U x ≤ W)).op (f.app (op W) a)
    have e2 := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply f
      (homOfLE (inf_le_left : W ⊓ U x ≤ W)).op a
    exact e1.symm.trans (congrArg (fun z => (adj.unit.app B).app (op (W ⊓ U x)) z) e2.symm)
  change G.presheaf.map _ _ = G.presheaf.map _ _ 
  rw [key φ, key ψ, hprop x (W ⊓ U x) inf_le_right]

name: KSpecialization.AR7R.braiding_tmul_of_cyclic
statement:
theorem braiding_tmul_of_cyclic
    (P : PresheafOfModules.{u} (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))
    (W : (X.Opens)ᵒᵖ) (g : P.obj W)
    (hg : ∀ m : P.obj W, ∃ r : (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).obj W, m = r • g)
    (m n : P.obj W) :
    (β_ P P).hom.app W (m ⊗ₜ n) = m ⊗ₜ n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := hg m
  obtain ⟨r', rfl⟩ := hg n
  change (β_ (P.obj W) (P.obj W)).hom _ = _
  rw [ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.braiding_hom_apply]
  have h1 : ∀ a b : (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).obj W,
      (a • g) ⊗ₜ[(X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).obj W] (b • g) =
        (a * b) • (g ⊗ₜ[(X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat).obj W] g) := by
    intro a b
    rw [← TensorProduct.smul_tmul', TensorProduct.tmul_smul, smul_smul]
  rw [h1, h1, mul_comm]

name: KSpecialization.AR7R.map_braiding_self_eq_id
statement:
theorem map_braiding_self_eq_id (Λ : X.Modules) (hΛ : LocallyTrivial Λ) :
    (moduleSheafification X).map
        (β_ (underlyingCommPresheaf X Λ) (underlyingCommPresheaf X Λ)).hom = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (moduleSheafification X).map_id]
  apply sheafification_map_eq_of_locally
  intro x
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hΛ x
  refine ⟨U, hxU, fun W hW a => ?_⟩
  have hcyc : (β_ (underlyingCommPresheaf X Λ) (underlyingCommPresheaf X Λ)).hom.app (op W) =
      𝟙 _ := by
    apply ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.tensor_ext
    intro m n
    exact braiding_tmul_of_cyclic (underlyingCommPresheaf X Λ) (op W)
      (SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.localGen
        (SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.resIso (L := Λ) hW e))
      (fun m => ⟨_, SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.section_eq_smul_localGen
        (SchemeKTheory.LineBundleDual.resIso (L := Λ) hW e) m⟩) m n
  exact congrArg (fun f => f.hom a) hcyc

name: KSpecialization.AR7R.braiding_self_eq_id
statement:
theorem braiding_self_eq_id (Λ : X.Modules) (hΛ : LocallyTrivial Λ) :
    (β_ Λ Λ).hom = 𝟙 (Λ ⊗ Λ)
proof:
:= by
  let P := underlyingCommPresheaf X Λ
  let F := moduleSheafification X
  haveI : IsIso (cnt Λ) :=
    (inferInstance : IsIso ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
      (structurePresheafId X)).counit.app Λ))
  have h1 := map_braiding_self_eq_id Λ hΛ
  have h2 : F.map (β_ P P).hom = Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ F P P ≫ (β_ (F.obj P) (F.obj P)).hom ≫
      Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ F P P := Functor.map_braiding F P P
  have h3 : (β_ (F.obj P) (F.obj P)).hom = 𝟙 _ := by
    have h4 : Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ F P P ≫ F.map (β_ P P).hom ≫
        Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ F P P = (β_ (F.obj P) (F.obj P)).hom := by
      rw [h2]
      simp only [Category.assoc, Functor.Monoidal.μ_δ_assoc, Functor.Monoidal.μ_δ,
        Category.comp_id]
    rw [← h4, h1]
    exact (congrArg (fun f => Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ F P P ≫ f)
      (Category.id_comp (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ F P P))).trans (Functor.Monoidal.μ_δ F P P)
  have h5 := BraidedCategory.braiding_naturality (cnt Λ) (cnt Λ)
  rw [h3, Category.id_comp] at h5
  haveI : IsIso (cnt Λ ⊗ₘ cnt Λ) := inferInstance
  exact (cancel_epi (cnt Λ ⊗ₘ cnt Λ)).1 (h5.trans (Category.comp_id _).symm)

name: KSpecialization.AR7R.thetaIso_natural
statement:
theorem thetaIso_natural (Λ : X.Modules) {E E' : X.Modules} (f : E ⟶ E') :
    (moduleSheafification X).map (underlyingCommPresheaf X Λ ◁
        (underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map f) ≫
      (tensorSheafIsoLocalizedTensor X Λ E').hom =
      (tensorSheafIsoLocalizedTensor X Λ E).hom ≫ Λ ◁ f
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∀ M : X.Modules, (tensorSheafIsoLocalizedTensor X Λ M).hom =
      Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (moduleSheafification X) (underlyingCommPresheaf X Λ)
        (underlyingCommPresheaf X M) ≫ (cnt Λ ⊗ₘ cnt M) := fun M => rfl
  rw [h1, h1]
  have hn : (moduleSheafification X).map ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map f) ≫ cnt E' =
      cnt E ≫ f := (moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).counit.naturality f
  have e1 := Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ_natural_right (moduleSheafification X)
    (underlyingCommPresheaf X Λ) ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map f)
  have e2 : (moduleSheafification X).obj (underlyingCommPresheaf X Λ) ◁
      (moduleSheafification X).map ((underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map f) ≫ (cnt Λ ⊗ₘ cnt E') =
      (cnt Λ ⊗ₘ cnt E) ≫ Λ ◁ f := by
    refine Eq.trans (congrArg (fun q => q ≫ (cnt Λ ⊗ₘ cnt E'))
      (MonoidalCategory.id_tensorHom _ _).symm) ?_
    refine Eq.trans ?_ (congrArg (fun q => (cnt Λ ⊗ₘ cnt E) ≫ q)
      (MonoidalCategory.id_tensorHom _ _))
    refine (MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_comp_tensorHom _ _ _ _).trans
      (Eq.trans ?_ (MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_comp_tensorHom _ _ _ _).symm)
    exact congrArg₂ (· ⊗ₘ ·) (Eq.trans (Category.id_comp _) (Category.comp_id _).symm)
      ((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).counit.naturality f)
  refine (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans ?_
  refine Eq.trans (congrArg (fun q => q ≫ (cnt Λ ⊗ₘ cnt E')) e1.symm) ?_
  refine (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans ?_
  refine Eq.trans (congrArg (fun q => _ ≫ q) e2) ?_
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm

name: KSpecialization.AR7R.sigmaT_app_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem sigmaT_app_eq_zero_iff {Λ : X.Modules} (s : Λ ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) (E : X.Modules) :
    (sigmaT Λ s).app E = 0 ↔
      ∀ (W : X.Opens) (l : Λ.val.obj (op W)) (m : E.val.obj (op W)),
        (s.val.app (op W)).hom l • m = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← koszul_app_eq_zero_iff]
  change (thetaIso Λ).hom.app E ≫ (ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR1.koszulσ Λ s).app E = 0 ↔ _
  constructor
  · intro h
    haveI : IsIso ((thetaIso Λ).hom.app E) := inferInstance
    exact (cancel_epi ((thetaIso Λ).hom.app E)).1 (h.trans comp_zero.symm)
  · intro h
    rw [h]; exact comp_zero

name: KSpecialization.AR7R.sigmaT_central
statement:
theorem sigmaT_central {Λ : X.Modules} (hΛ : LocallyTrivial Λ) (s : Λ ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) :
    ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR1.Central (tensorSheafLeftFunctor X Λ) (sigmaT Λ s)
proof:
:=
  central_transport (thetaIso Λ) _
    (ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR1.koszulσ_central Λ s (braiding_self_eq_id Λ hΛ))

name: KSpecialization.AR7R.locallyTrivial_dual
statement: theorem locallyTrivial_dual (hline : IsLocalLineFrame L) : LocallyTrivial (lineBundleDual X L)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hline x
  haveI := dualTriv_isIso e
  exact ⟨U.1, hxU, ⟨(asIso (dualTriv e)).symm⟩⟩

name: KSpecialization.AR7R.central_twist
statement:
theorem central_twist (hline : IsLocalLineFrame L) :
    ExactGrothendieck.CartierGysinAR1.Central (tensorSheafLeftFunctor X (lineBundleDual X L))
      (sigmaT (lineBundleDual X L) (dualEval σ))
proof:
:=
  sigmaT_central (locallyTrivial_dual hline) (dualEval σ)

name: KSpecialization.AR7R.dualEval_smul_eq_zero_of_idealKills
statement:
theorem dualEval_smul_eq_zero_of_idealKills {E : X.Modules}
    (hE : KSpecialization.AR4.IdealKills (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ) E)
    (W : X.Opens) (l : (lineBundleDual X L).val.obj (op W)) (m : E.val.obj (op W)) :
    ((dualEval σ).val.app (op W)).hom l • m = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine KSpecialization.AR4.smul_eq_zero_of_local hE _ (fun W' hW' => ?_) m
  have h := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply (dualEval σ).val (homOfLE hW').op l
  have hmem := AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.dualEvalVal_mem_affineIdeal σ W' ((lineBundleDual X L).val.map (homOfLE hW').op l)
  rw [← sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_affine σ W'] at hmem
  have h' : (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hW').op) (((dualEval σ).val.app (op W)).hom l) =
      ((dualEval σ).val.app (op W')).hom ((lineBundleDual X L).val.map (homOfLE hW').op l) :=
    h.symm
  rw [h']
  exact hmem

name: KSpecialization.AR7R.idealKills_of_dualEval_smul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem idealKills_of_dualEval_smul_eq_zero (hline : IsLocalLineFrame L) {E : X.Modules}
    (h : ∀ (W : X.Opens) (l : (lineBundleDual X L).val.obj (op W)) (m : E.val.obj (op W)),
      ((dualEval σ).val.app (op W)).hom l • m = 0) :
    KSpecialization.AR4.IdealKills (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ) E
proof:
:= by
  intro W r hr m
  choose V hxV hVW he using fun x : (W : X.Opens) =>
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.exists_frameNbhd hline x.2
  have hcov : (W : X.Opens) ≤ ⨆ x : (W : X.Opens), (V x).1 := by
    intro y hy
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hxV ⟨y, hy⟩⟩
  refine TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' (⟨E.presheaf, E.isSheaf⟩ : TopCat.Sheaf Ab X)
    (fun x : (W : X.Opens) => (V x).1) W (fun x => homOfLE (hVW x)) hcov _ _ fun x => ?_
  change E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hVW x)).op (r • m) = E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hVW x)).op 0
  rw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul, map_zero]
  have hr' := KSpecialization.AR4.res_mem_ideal (I := sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ) (hVW x) hr
  have hb : (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι.app (V x).1
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hVW x)).op r) = 0 := by
    rw [← (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).ker_subschemeι_app (V x)] at hr'
    exact RingHom.mem_ker.mp hr'
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.exists_dual_local σ (V x) (he x).some _ hb
  have h2 := h (V x).1 F (E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hVW x)).op m)
  change (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hVW x)).op r) • (E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hVW x)).op m) = 0
  rw [← hF]
  exact h2

name: KSpecialization.AR7R.ar7Bridge
statement:
theorem ar7Bridge (hline : IsLocalLineFrame L) :
    AR7Bridge (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ) (tensorSheafLeftFunctor X (lineBundleDual X L))
      (sigmaT (lineBundleDual X L) (dualEval σ)) where
  killed_of_idealKills E hE
proof:
:=
    (sigmaT_app_eq_zero_iff (dualEval σ) E).2 (dualEval_smul_eq_zero_of_idealKills σ hE)
  idealKills_of_killed E _ h :=
    idealKills_of_dualEval_smul_eq_zero σ hline ((sigmaT_app_eq_zero_iff (dualEval σ) E).1 h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.A5CD.fibreRel_totalGlobal
statement:
theorem fibreRel_totalGlobal [IsIntegral Y] [IsIntegral (totalGlobal Y J)]
    [(totalGlobal Y J).Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (totalGlobal Y J ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian (totalGlobal Y J)] [Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k (totalGlobal Y J))]
    [Y.Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian Y]
    [Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k Y)]
    [(component Y J).Over (Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (component Y J ↘ Spk k)]
    [IsNoetherian (component Y J)] [Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k (component Y J))]
    [IsIntegral (component Y J)]
    [(fibreιGlobal Y J k φk c).IsOver (Spk k)] [(componentToTotal Y J).IsOver (Spk k)]
    {n : ℕ}
    (hX : height (genericPoint (totalGlobal Y J)) = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
    (hZ₁ : height (genericPoint Y) = (n : ℕ∞))
    (hE : height (genericPoint (component Y J)) = (n : ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ (L N : (totalGlobal Y J).Modules)
      (hL : SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank (totalGlobal Y J) L 1)
      (hN : SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank (totalGlobal Y J) N 1),
      totalPushOn (GRRBlueprintV4.opsV4 k) (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk c)
          (GRRBlueprintV4.fundClass k (W := Y)) =
        totalCapOn (GRRBlueprintV4.opsV4 k) (LPof L N) (hasConstantRank_LPof hL hN)
            (GRRBlueprintV4.fundClass k (W := totalGlobal Y J)) +
          totalPushOn (GRRBlueprintV4.opsV4 k) (componentToTotal Y J)
            (GRRBlueprintV4.fundClass k (W := component Y J))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, hL, σ₁, -, hid₁⟩ := exists_cartierData_fibre Y J k φk c
  obtain ⟨N, hN, σE, -, hidE⟩ := exists_cartierData_exceptional Y J k φk
  exact ⟨L, N, hL, hN, fibreRel_cheap hL hN σ₁ (fibreιGlobal Y J k φk c) hid₁ σE
    (componentToTotal Y J) hidE hX hZ₁ hE⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.m7geo_germToFunctionField_restrict
statement:
theorem m7geo_germToFunctionField_restrict {U V : X.Opens} [Nonempty U] [Nonempty V]
    (hUV : U ≤ V) (f : Γ(X, V)) :
    X.germToFunctionField U (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUV).op f) =
      X.germToFunctionField V f
proof:
:= by
  exact X.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE hUV) (genericPoint X)
    (((genericPoint_spec X).mem_open_set_iff U.isOpen).mpr (by simpa using ‹Nonempty U›)) f

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.m7geo_ord_germ_eq_one
statement:
theorem m7geo_ord_germ_eq_one (U : X.Opens) [Nonempty U] (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (z : U) (hz : coheight (z : X) = 1)
    (π : Γ(X, U))
    (hheight : ((hU.primeIdealOf z).asIdeal).height = 1)
    (hπ : (hU.primeIdealOf z).asIdeal = Ideal.span {π}) :
    X.ord (X.germToFunctionField U π) (z : X) = 1
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hU.isLocalization_stalk z
  have hπ0 : π ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact Ideal.ne_bot_of_height_eq_one hheight (by rw [hπ, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot])
  rw [← X.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField z.2 π]
  have hinj := IsLocalization.injective (X.presheaf.stalk (z : X))
    (Ideal.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors (hU.primeIdealOf z).asIdeal)
  apply Scheme.ord_algebraMap_eq_one_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal hz
  · exact (map_ne_zero_iff _ hinj).mpr hπ0
  · rw [← IsLocalization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal
      (hU.primeIdealOf z).asIdeal, hπ, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.m7geo_ord_germ_eq_one'
statement:
theorem m7geo_ord_germ_eq_one' (U : X.Opens) [Nonempty U] (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (z : U) (hz : coheight (z : X) = 1)
    (π : Γ(X, U)) (hπ : (hU.primeIdealOf z).asIdeal = Ideal.span {π}) :
    X.ord (X.germToFunctionField U π) (z : X) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hheight : ((hU.primeIdealOf z).asIdeal).height = 1 := by
    rw [← hU.fromSpec_primeIdealOf z] at hz
    rw [coheight_eq_of_isOpenImmersion, ← idealHeight_eq_coheight] at hz
    exact hz
  exact m7geo_ord_germ_eq_one U hU z hz π hheight hπ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geo_pointClosure_app_ker
statement:
theorem m7geo_pointClosure_app_ker {X : Scheme.{u}} (w : X)
    (U : X.affineOpens) (hw : w ∈ U.1) :
    RingHom.ker ((pointClosureι w).app U).hom =
      (U.2.primeIdealOf ⟨w, hw⟩).asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  change RingHom.ker ((pointClosureIdeal w).subschemeι.app U).hom = _
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_subschemeι_app]
  exact pointClosureIdeal_ideal w U hw

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geo_principal_of_comap_kernel_sup
statement:
theorem m7geo_principal_of_comap_kernel_sup {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (φ : A →+* B) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) (J : Ideal B) (x : A)
    (hJ : J.comap φ = RingHom.ker φ ⊔ Ideal.span {x}) :
    J = Ideal.span {φ x}
proof:
:= by
  calc
    J = (J.comap φ).map φ := (Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective φ hφ J).symm
    _ = (RingHom.ker φ ⊔ Ideal.span {x}).map φ := by rw [hJ]
    _ = Ideal.span {φ x} := by
      rw [Ideal.map_sup, (Ideal.map_eq_bot_iff_le_ker φ).mpr le_rfl, bot_sup_eq,
        Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geo_eq_of_height_one
statement:
theorem m7geo_eq_of_height_one {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    {P Q : Ideal A} [P.IsPrime] [Q.IsPrime] (hPQ : P ≤ Q)
    (hP : P.height = 1) (hQ : Q.height = 1) : P = Q
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  have hlt : P < Q := lt_of_le_of_ne hPQ hne
  have h := Ideal.height_add_one_le_of_lt_of_isPrime hlt
  rw [hP, hQ] at h
  norm_num at h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geo_eq_of_quotient_height_one
statement:
theorem m7geo_eq_of_quotient_height_one {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    {Q Q' P : Ideal A} [Q.IsPrime] [Q'.IsPrime] [P.IsPrime]
    (hQQ' : Q < Q') (hQ'P : Q' ≤ P)
    (hheight : (P.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk Q)).height = 1) : P = Q'
proof:
:= by
  let f := Ideal.Quotient.mk Q
  have hf : Function.Surjective f := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hkQ' : RingHom.ker f ≤ Q' := by rw [Ideal.mk_ker]; exact hQQ'.le
  have hkP : RingHom.ker f ≤ P := hkQ'.trans hQ'P
  haveI : (Q'.map f).IsPrime := Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective hf hkQ'
  haveI : (P.map f).IsPrime := Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective hf hkP
  haveI : (⊥ : Ideal (A ⧸ Q)).IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_bot
  have hlt1 : (⊥ : Ideal (A ⧸ Q)) < Q'.map f := by
    refine bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.mpr fun h ↦ hQQ'.ne ?_
    have hc := congrArg (Ideal.comap f) h
    rw [Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective f hf, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot,
      Ideal.mk_ker, sup_eq_left.mpr hQQ'.le] at hc
    exact hc.symm
  by_contra hne
  have hlt2 : Q'.map f < P.map f := by
    refine lt_of_le_of_ne (Ideal.map_mono hQ'P) fun h ↦ hne ?_
    have hc := congrArg (Ideal.comap f) h
    rw [Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective f hf, Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective f hf,
      ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, Ideal.mk_ker, sup_eq_left.mpr hQQ'.le,
      sup_eq_left.mpr (hQQ'.le.trans hQ'P)] at hc
    exact hc.symm
  have h1 := Ideal.height_add_one_le_of_lt_of_isPrime hlt1
  have h2 := Ideal.height_add_one_le_of_lt_of_isPrime hlt2
  have htw : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ (P.map f).height := by
    calc
      (2 : ℕ∞) = 0 + 1 + 1 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ (⊥ : Ideal (A ⧸ Q)).height + 1 + 1 := by gcongr; exact zero_le
      _ ≤ (Q'.map f).height + 1 := by gcongr
      _ ≤ (P.map f).height := h2
  rw [hheight] at htw
  norm_num at htw

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geo_quotient_prime_principal
proof:
:= by
  rw [hQ, Ideal.map_sup, Ideal.map_quotient_self, bot_sup_eq, Ideal.map_span,
    Set.image_singleton]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.m7geo_awayCoordinateEquiv_ratio
statement:
theorem m7geo_awayCoordinateEquiv_ratio (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ)
    {c : Fin (n + 1)} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    awayCoordinateEquiv R n 0 (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.isLocalizationElem
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n 0) (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n c)) =
      MvPolynomial.X ⟨c, hc⟩
proof:
:= by
  unfold awayCoordinateEquiv
  rw [RingEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
  change _ = awayCoordinateHom R n 0 (MvPolynomial.X ⟨c, hc⟩)
  rw [awayCoordinateHom, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X']
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp [coordinateRatio, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.m7geo_stdChart_mem_coordinateOpen
statement:
theorem m7geo_stdChart_mem_coordinateOpen (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ)
    {c : Fin (n + 1)} (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (Q : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n 0) R)) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_stdChart R n 0 Q ∈ coordinateOpen R n c ↔
      MvPolynomial.X (⟨c, hc⟩ : AffineChartIndex n 0) ∉ Q.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  have hpre := Proj.awayι_preimage_basicOpen (grading R n)
    (f_deg := coordinate_mem_degree_one R n 0) (hm := Nat.zero_lt_one)
    (g_deg := coordinate_mem_degree_one R n c) (hm' := Nat.zero_lt_one)
  change Spec.map (awayCoordinateEquiv R n 0).toCommRingCatIso.hom Q ∈
    Proj.awayι (grading R n) (coordinate R n 0) (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n 0)
      Nat.zero_lt_one ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen (grading R n) (coordinate R n c) ↔ _
  rw [hpre]
  change awayCoordinateEquiv R n 0
      (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.isLocalizationElem
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n 0) (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n c)) ∉ Q.asIdeal ↔ _
  rw [m7geo_awayCoordinateEquiv_ratio R n hc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geo_chartι_mem_W
statement:
theorem m7geo_chartι_mem_W (k : C.basisIndex i) (y : C.chart i) :
    C.chartι i y ∈ m7geoF_W C i k ↔ y ∈ C.literalLinearOpen ⟨i, k⟩
proof:
:= by
  change C.chartι i y ∈ ((C.literalLinearOpen ⟨i, k⟩).ι ≫ C.chartι i).opensRange ↔ _
  rw [Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
    have heq : (C.literalLinearOpen ⟨i, k⟩).ι z = y :=
      (C.chartι i).isOpenEmbedding.injective hz
    have hzmem : (C.literalLinearOpen ⟨i, k⟩).ι z ∈ C.literalLinearOpen ⟨i, k⟩ :=
      z.2
    exact heq ▸ hzmem
  · intro hy
    exact ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geo_J_mem_W_iff
statement:
theorem m7geo_J_mem_W_iff
    (a c : Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1))
    (Q : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a)
      Γ(X, C.U i))) :
    m7g_J C i a Q ∈ m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm c) ↔
      m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a Q ∈
        coordinateOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) c
proof:
:= by
  let y : C.chart i := inv (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace (m7g_b C i))
    (m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a Q)
  change C.chartι i y ∈ m7geoF_W C i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm c) ↔ _
  refine (m7geo_chartι_mem_W C i _ y).trans ?_
  change y ∈
      linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (Opposite.op (C.U i)))
        (C.sectionBasis i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm c)) ↔ _
  have hb : C.sectionBasis i ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm c) = m7g_b C i c := by
    simp [m7g_b]
  rw [hb, ← intrinsicToStandard_preimage_coordinateOpen (m7g_b C i) c]
  change (inv (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace (m7g_b C i)) ≫
      intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace (m7g_b C i))
      (m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a Q) ∈
        coordinateOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) c ↔
      m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a Q ∈
        coordinateOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) c
  rw [IsIso.inv_hom_id]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geo_Q_succ
proof:
:= by
  let s := m7geo_nextIndex C i t ht
  have hs : ∀ j : AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0,
      ((j.1 : ℕ) ≤ t + 1 ↔ ((j.1 : ℕ) ≤ t ∨ j = s)) := by
    intro j
    constructor
    · intro h
      by_cases h' : (j.1 : ℕ) ≤ t
      · exact Or.inl h'
      · right
        apply Subtype.ext
        apply Fin.ext
        change (j.1 : ℕ) = t + 1
        omega
    · rintro (h | rfl)
      · omega
      · exact le_rfl
  exact m7g_ker_succ hs

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geo_Q_succ_quotient
statement:
theorem m7geo_Q_succ_quotient (t : ℕ) (ht : t < C.positiveRankDimension i) :
    (m7g_Q C i hv (t + 1)).asIdeal.map
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (m7g_Q C i hv t).asIdeal) =
      Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk (m7g_Q C i hv t).asIdeal
        (MvPolynomial.X (m7geo_nextIndex C i t ht))}
proof:
:=
  m7geo_quotient_prime_principal _ _ _ (m7geo_Q_succ C i hv t ht)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geo_w_mem_next
statement:
theorem m7geo_w_mem_next (t : ℕ) (ht : t < C.positiveRankDimension i) :
    m7g_w C i hv t ∈ m7geoF_W C i
      ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm ⟨t + 1, by omega⟩)
proof:
:= by
  let c : Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1) := ⟨t + 1, by omega⟩
  have hc : c ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have : (c : ℕ) = 0 := congrArg Fin.val h
    dsimp [c] at this
    omega
  change m7g_J C i 0 (m7g_Q C i hv t) ∈ m7geoF_W C i
    ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm c)
  rw [m7geo_J_mem_W_iff C i, SchemeProjectiveSpace.m7geo_stdChart_mem_coordinateOpen
    Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) hc]
  change MvPolynomial.X (⟨c, hc⟩ : AffineChartIndex _ 0) ∉
    RingHom.ker (m7g_phi (m7g_q C i hv).asIdeal
      (fun j : AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0 ↦ (j.1 : ℕ)) t)
  apply m7g_X_not_mem
  change ¬ t + 1 ≤ t
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geo_w_succ_not_mem_next
statement:
theorem m7geo_w_succ_not_mem_next (t : ℕ) (ht : t < C.positiveRankDimension i) :
    m7g_w C i hv (t + 1) ∉ m7geoF_W C i
      ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm ⟨t + 1, by omega⟩)
proof:
:= by
  let c : Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1) := ⟨t + 1, by omega⟩
  have hc : c ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have : (c : ℕ) = 0 := congrArg Fin.val h
    dsimp [c] at this
    omega
  change ¬ (m7g_J C i 0 (m7g_Q C i hv (t + 1)) ∈ m7geoF_W C i
    ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm c))
  rw [m7geo_J_mem_W_iff C i, SchemeProjectiveSpace.m7geo_stdChart_mem_coordinateOpen
    Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) hc]
  change ¬ (MvPolynomial.X (⟨c, hc⟩ : AffineChartIndex _ 0) ∉
    RingHom.ker (m7g_phi (m7g_q C i hv).asIdeal
      (fun j : AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0 ↦ (j.1 : ℕ)) (t + 1)))
  push Not
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker, m7g_phi_X, if_pos]
  change t + 1 ≤ t + 1
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geo_Q_unique_of_height_one
statement:
theorem m7geo_Q_unique_of_height_one (t : ℕ) (ht : t < C.positiveRankDimension i)
    (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0)
      Γ(X, C.U i)))
    (hQ : (m7g_Q C i hv t).asIdeal ≤ P.asIdeal)
    (hX : MvPolynomial.X (m7geo_nextIndex C i t ht) ∈ P.asIdeal)
    (hheight : (P.asIdeal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (m7g_Q C i hv t).asIdeal)).height = 1) :
    P = m7g_Q C i hv (t + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let s := m7geo_nextIndex C i t ht
  have hle : (m7g_Q C i hv t).asIdeal ≤ (m7g_Q C i hv (t + 1)).asIdeal := by
    rw [m7geo_Q_succ C i hv t ht]
    exact le_sup_left
  have hnot : ¬ (m7g_Q C i hv (t + 1)).asIdeal ≤ (m7g_Q C i hv t).asIdeal := by
    intro h
    have hs : MvPolynomial.X s ∈ (m7g_Q C i hv (t + 1)).asIdeal := by
      rw [m7geo_Q_succ C i hv t ht]
      exact Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.subset_span rfl)
    have hst : ¬ ((s.1 : ℕ) ≤ t) := by
      change ¬ t + 1 ≤ t
      omega
    exact (m7g_X_not_mem (I := (m7g_q C i hv).asIdeal)
      (lv := fun j : AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0 ↦ (j.1 : ℕ)) hst) (h hs)
  have hlt : (m7g_Q C i hv t).asIdeal < (m7g_Q C i hv (t + 1)).asIdeal :=
    lt_of_le_not_ge hle hnot
  have hQ'P : (m7g_Q C i hv (t + 1)).asIdeal ≤ P.asIdeal := by
    rw [m7geo_Q_succ C i hv t ht]
    exact sup_le hQ (Ideal.span_le.mpr (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hX))
  apply PrimeSpectrum.ext
  exact m7geo_eq_of_quotient_height_one hlt hQ'P hheight

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geo_Q_le_of_pointClosure_chart0
statement:
theorem m7geo_Q_le_of_pointClosure_chart0 (t : ℕ)
    (z : pointClosureScheme (m7g_w C i hv t))
    (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0)
      Γ(X, C.U i)))
    (hz : pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z = m7g_J C i 0 P) :
    (m7g_Q C i hv t).asIdeal ≤ P.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  have hsp : m7g_w C i hv t ⤳ pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z := by
    rw [specializes_iff_mem_closure, ← range_pointClosureι]
    exact ⟨z, rfl⟩
  rw [hz] at hsp
  have hsp' : m7g_J C i 0 (m7g_Q C i hv t) ⤳ m7g_J C i 0 P := by
    simpa only [m7g_w] using hsp
  exact (PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes _ _).mpr
    ((m7g_J C i 0).isOpenEmbedding.isInducing.specializes_iff.mp hsp')

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geo_eq_of_specializes_coheight_one
statement:
theorem m7geo_eq_of_specializes_coheight_one {Y : Scheme.{u}} {a b : Y}
    (ha : coheight a = 1) (hb : coheight b = 1) (hab : a ⤳ b) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  have hle : b ≤ a := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr hab
  have hlt : b < a := lt_of_le_not_ge hle fun hge ↦
    hne ((hab.antisymm (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hge)).eq)
  have h := Order.coheight_add_one_le hlt
  rw [ha, hb] at h
  norm_num at h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geo_closure_chart0_unique
statement:
theorem m7geo_closure_chart0_unique [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (t : ℕ) (ht : t < C.positiveRankDimension i)
    (z : pointClosureScheme (m7g_w C i hv t)) (hz : coheight z = 1)
    (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0)
      Γ(X, C.U i)))
    (himage : pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z = m7g_J C i 0 P)
    (hX : MvPolynomial.X (m7geo_nextIndex C i t ht) ∈ P.asIdeal) :
    pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z = m7g_w C i hv (t + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hQ := m7geo_Q_le_of_pointClosure_chart0 C i hv t z P himage
  have hQ' : (m7g_Q C i hv (t + 1)).asIdeal ≤ P.asIdeal := by
    rw [m7geo_Q_succ C i hv t ht]
    exact sup_le hQ (Ideal.span_le.mpr (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hX))
  obtain ⟨z', hz', hz'image⟩ := m7g_step C i hv t ht
  have hspP : m7g_J C i 0 (m7g_Q C i hv (t + 1)) ⤳ m7g_J C i 0 P :=
    ((PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes _ _).mp hQ').map (m7g_J C i 0).continuous
  have hspimage : pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z' ⤳
      pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z := by
    rw [hz'image, himage]
    exact hspP
  have hsp : z' ⤳ z :=
    (pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t)).isEmbedding.isInducing.specializes_iff.mp hspimage
  have heq : z' = z := m7geo_eq_of_specializes_coheight_one hz' hz hsp
  rw [← heq, hz'image]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geo_closure_chart0_unique_of_not_mem_W
statement:
theorem m7geo_closure_chart0_unique_of_not_mem_W [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (t : ℕ) (ht : t < C.positiveRankDimension i)
    (z : pointClosureScheme (m7g_w C i hv t)) (hz : coheight z = 1)
    (P : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0)
      Γ(X, C.U i)))
    (himage : pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z = m7g_J C i 0 P)
    (hnot : pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z ∉ m7geoF_W C i
      ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm ⟨t + 1, by omega⟩)) :
    pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z = m7g_w C i hv (t + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let c : Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1) := ⟨t + 1, by omega⟩
  have hc : c ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have : (c : ℕ) = 0 := congrArg Fin.val h
    dsimp [c] at this
    omega
  have hnotP : m7g_J C i 0 P ∉ m7geoF_W C i
      ((C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i).symm c) := by
    rw [← himage]
    exact hnot
  rw [m7geo_J_mem_W_iff C i,
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.m7geo_stdChart_mem_coordinateOpen
      Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) hc] at hnotP
  have hX : MvPolynomial.X (m7geo_nextIndex C i t ht) ∈ P.asIdeal := by
    change MvPolynomial.X (⟨c, hc⟩ : AffineChartIndex _ 0) ∈ P.asIdeal
    simpa only [not_not] using hnotP
  exact m7geo_closure_chart0_unique C i hv t ht z hz P himage hX

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.CommonBasicOpen.rightChartMap_comp_chartToBase

theorem rightChartMap_comp_chartToBase (e : CommonBasicOpen A B) :

name: GRRBlueprintV4.pointNormV4
statement:
theorem pointNormV4 [IsProper (Spk k ↘ Spk k)] (hP : ProjBundleClosedPos (ProjectiveIntegral k))
    (h : ChExact k hP) : PointNormV4 k hP h
proof:
:= by
  intro w
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := spk_exists_intCast k w
  have h1 : chK0 k hP h (1 : K0 (Spk k)) (fundClass k (W := Spk k)) = fundClass k (W := Spk k) := by
    have : (1 : K0 (Spk k)) =
        k0ClassOf _ (tensorUnitSheaf _) (tensorUnitSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree _) := rfl
    rw [this, chK0_classOf, fundClass_spk, chBundle_lof_zero, rkOf_unit]
    simp
  have hadd : ∀ a b : TotalChow (Spk k), degT k (Spk k) (a + b) = degT k (Spk k) a + degT k (Spk k) b :=
    fun a b ↦ by simp [degT]
  have h0 : degT k (Spk k) (0 : TotalChow (Spk k)) = 0 := by simp [degT]
  have h1' : degT k (Spk k) (fundClass k (W := Spk k)) = 1 := by
    rw [fundClass_spk, degT_lof_zero, degQ_pt]
  have h1e : ((eulerSpk k (k0ToG0 (Spk k) 1) : ℤ) : ℚ) = 1 := by rw [eulerSpk_one]; simp
  set L : K0 (Spk k) → ℚ := fun w ↦ ((eulerSpk k (k0ToG0 (Spk k) w) : ℤ) : ℚ) with hL
  set R : K0 (Spk k) → ℚ := fun w ↦ degT k (Spk k) (chK0 k hP h w (fundClass k (W := Spk k))) with hR
  have LA : ∀ a b, L (a + b) = L a + L b := fun a b ↦ by simp [hL, map_add]
  have RA : ∀ a b, R (a + b) = R a + R b := fun a b ↦ by
    simp only [hR]
    rw [map_add (chK0 k hP h) a b, LinearMap.add_apply, hadd]
  have LN : ∀ a, L (-a) = -L a := fun a ↦ by simp [hL, map_neg]
  have RN : ∀ a, R (-a) = -R a := fun a ↦ by
    simp only [hR]
    rw [map_neg (chK0 k hP h) a, LinearMap.neg_apply]
    simp [degT]
  have L1 : L 1 = 1 := h1e
  have R1 : R 1 = 1 := by simp only [hR]; rw [h1, h1']
  show L (n : K0 (Spk k)) = R (n : K0 (Spk k))
  induction n using Int.induction_on with
  | zero => simp [hL, hR, h0]
  | succ n ih => rw [Int.cast_add, Int.cast_one, LA, RA, ih, L1, R1]
  | pred n ih => rw [show ((-(n : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) : K0 (Spk k)) = ((-(n : ℤ) : ℤ) : K0 (Spk k)) + (-1 : K0 (Spk k)) by push_cast; ring, LA, RA, ih, LN, RN, L1, R1]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.hrr_of_inputs
statement:
theorem hrr_of_inputs
    [(i ≫ toSpec k n).IsOver (Spk k)] [(toSpec k n).IsOver (Spk k)] {r : ℕ}
    (h : GRRInputsV4 k (toSpec k n) i (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n 1)
      (AdamsRRFinal.hasConstantRank_projectiveTwistingSheaf k n 1) (n + 1)
      (projectiveDerivedPushforward k n hn) r)
    (x : K0 X) :
    ((g0Euler k (ClosedImmersionCohomology.projectiveClosedImmersion_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic
        k n hn i (comp_over i (Spk k)).symm) (k0ToG0 X x) : ℤ) : ℚ) =
      degT k (Spk k) (totalPushOn (opsV4 k) (i ≫ toSpec k n)
        (((tdLine k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k n 1))
          (hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1 (AdamsRRFinal.hasConstantRank_projectiveTwistingSheaf k n 1))) ^
            (n + 1)) (tauX k (closedPosV4 k) h.chExact i x)))
proof:
:= by
  have hover : X ↘ Spk k = i ≫ toSpec k n := (comp_over i (Spk k)).symm
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := h.resY (projectiveDerivedPushforward k n hn
    (finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X x)))
  have hg := grr_of_inputs k (toSpec k n) i _ _ (n + 1) _ h x w hw
  have e1 := DFunLike.congr_fun
    (ClosedImmersionCohomology.projectiveClosedImmersion_g0Euler k n hn i hover
      (ClosedImmersionCohomology.projectiveClosedImmersion_hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic
        k n hn i hover)) (k0ToG0 X x)
  have e2 := DFunLike.congr_fun (g0Euler_comp_projectiveDerivedPushforward k n hn)
    (finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X x))
  have e3 := pointNormV4 k (closedPosV4 k) h.chExact w
  rw [hw] at e3
  have e4 := e1.symm.trans e2.symm
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply] at e4
  rw [e4]
  exact e3.trans (by rw [hg])

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoF_sqIso_hom_unit
statement:
theorem m7geoF_sqIso_hom_unit (L : S.Modules) (O' : S.Opens) (s : Γ(L, O')) :
    ((restrictFunctor e).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)).presheaf.map
        (eqToHom (m7geoF_sq_preimage_eq f j e g w O')).op
        ((m7geoF_sqIso f j e g w L).hom.app (g ⁻¹ᵁ (j ⁻¹ᵁ O'))
          (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app
            ((restrictFunctor j).obj L)).app (j ⁻¹ᵁ O')
              (((restrictAdjunction j).unit.app L).app O' s))) =
      ((restrictAdjunction e).unit.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)).app
        (f ⁻¹ᵁ O') (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app L).app O' s)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [m7geoF_sqIso, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.app_hom,
    Iso.app_inv, Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  rw [C1Cap.pullback_map_unit, C1Cap.restrictFunctorIsoPullback_hom_restrict]
  have e2 := C1Cap.pullbackComp_hom_unit g j L O' s
  erw [e2]
  rw [← C1Cap.app_presheaf_map, ← C1Cap.app_presheaf_map]
  erw [C1Cap.pullbackCongr_hom_unit w L O' s]
  erw [C1Cap.pullbackComp_inv_unit e f L O' s]
  exact C1Cap.restrictFunctorIsoPullback_inv_unit _ _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoF_sqUnitFrame_one
statement:
theorem m7geoF_sqUnitFrame_one (O' : S.Opens) (s : Γ(L, O'))
    (hs : φ.inv.app (j ⁻¹ᵁ O') (1 : Γ(O, j ⁻¹ᵁ O')) =
      ((restrictAdjunction j).unit.app L).app O' s) :
    (m7geoF_sqUnitFrame f j e g w φ).hom.app (e ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ O')) (1 : Γ(V, e ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ O'))) =
      ((restrictAdjunction e).unit.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)).app
        (f ⁻¹ᵁ O') (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app L).app O' s)
proof:
:= by
  have hK : (m7geoF_sqUnitFrame f j e g w φ).hom.app (g ⁻¹ᵁ (j ⁻¹ᵁ O'))
      (1 : Γ(V, g ⁻¹ᵁ (j ⁻¹ᵁ O'))) =
      (m7geoF_sqIso f j e g w L).hom.app (g ⁻¹ᵁ (j ⁻¹ᵁ O'))
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map φ.inv).app (g ⁻¹ᵁ (j ⁻¹ᵁ O'))
          ((C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso g).inv.app (g ⁻¹ᵁ (j ⁻¹ᵁ O'))
            (1 : Γ(V, g ⁻¹ᵁ (j ⁻¹ᵁ O'))))) := rfl
  have h1 := C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso_inv_one g (j ⁻¹ᵁ O')
  have h2 := C1Cap.pullback_map_unit g φ.inv (j ⁻¹ᵁ O') (1 : Γ(O, j ⁻¹ᵁ O'))
  have hsq := m7geoF_sqIso_hom_unit f j e g w L O' s
  have hnat := C1Cap.app_presheaf_map (m7geoF_sqUnitFrame f j e g w φ).hom
    (eqToHom (m7geoF_sq_preimage_eq f j e g w O')) (1 : Γ(V, g ⁻¹ᵁ (j ⁻¹ᵁ O')))
  rw [C1Cap.unit_presheaf_map_one] at hnat
  rw [hnat, hK, h1]
  erw [h2]
  rw [hs]
  exact hsq
