name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoF_frameGen_frame
statement:
theorem m7geoF_frameGen_frame (y : Y) (hy : f y ∈ j.opensRange) (s : Γ(L, j.opensRange))
    (hs : φ.inv.app (j ⁻¹ᵁ j.opensRange) (1 : Γ(O, j ⁻¹ᵁ j.opensRange)) =
      ((restrictAdjunction j).unit.app L).app j.opensRange s) :
    C1Cap.frameGen (m7geoF_frame f j φ y hy) =
      ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app L).app j.opensRange s
proof:
:= by
  let U' : Y.Opens := m7geoF_U f j
  let m := (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op U')
    (1 : Γ(Y, U'))
  have hT : (↑((SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) PUnit).val.obj (op U')) : Type u) =
      ↑((SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) PUnit).val.obj
        (op (U'.ι ''ᵁ (U'.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U')))) := by
    rw [C1Cap.image_preimage_ι_self]
  have hq : ((overFunctorEquiv U').app (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) PUnit)).inv ≫
      (overEquiv U').functor.map (m7geoF_globalFrame f j φ).hom ≫
        ((overFunctorEquiv U').app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)).hom =
      (m7geoF_restrictFrame f j φ).hom := by
    rw [m7geoF_globalFrame, Functor.FullyFaithful.preimageIso_hom,
      Functor.FullyFaithful.map_preimage]
    exact C1Cap.iso_cancel_aux ((overFunctorEquiv U').app _) ((overFunctorEquiv U').app _) _
  have H : HEq ((((overFunctorEquiv U').app
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) PUnit)).inv ≫
      (overEquiv U').functor.map (m7geoF_globalFrame f j φ).hom ≫
        ((overFunctorEquiv U').app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)).hom).app
          (U'.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U') (cast hT m))
      ((m7geoF_globalFrame f j φ).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE (le_refl U')))) m) :=
    overFunctorEquiv_restrict_app_heq (le_refl U') (m7geoF_globalFrame f j φ).hom m
  have H' : HEq ((m7geoF_restrictFrame f j φ).hom.app (U'.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U') (cast hT m))
      (C1Cap.frameGen (m7geoF_frame f j φ y hy)) := by
    refine (heq_of_eq (congrArg (fun ψ ↦ Scheme.Modules.Hom.app ψ (U'.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U') (cast hT m))
      hq)).symm.trans (H.trans ?_)
    unfold C1Cap.frameGen
    rw [m7geoF_frame_globalFrame_hom]
    rfl
  have ha : (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app
      (op (U'.ι ''ᵁ (U'.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U'))) (1 : Γ(Y, U'.ι ''ᵁ (U'.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U'))) = cast hT m := by
    apply eq_of_heq
    refine (C1Cap.heq_of_opens_eq
      (P := fun O ↦ Γ(SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) PUnit, O))
      (fun O ↦ (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op O)
        (1 : Γ(Y, O))) (C1Cap.image_preimage_ι_self U')).trans ?_
    exact (cast_heq hT m).symm
  have e1 : (m7geoF_restrictFrame f j φ).hom.app (U'.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U')
      ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app
        (op (U'.ι ''ᵁ (U'.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U'))) (1 : Γ(Y, U'.ι ''ᵁ (U'.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U')))) =
      (m7geoF_sqUnitFrame f j U'.ι (m7geoF_lift f j) (m7geoF_lift_fac f j) φ).hom.app
        (U'.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U') (1 : Γ((U' : Scheme.{u}), U'.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U')) := by
    simp only [m7geoF_restrictFrame, Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom,
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
    have h1 := C1Cap.iso_hom_inv_app (S := Y)
      (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)) (U'.ι ''ᵁ (U'.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U'))
      (1 : Γ(Y, U'.ι ''ᵁ (U'.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U')))
    erw [h1, C1Cap.restrictUnitIso_hom_one]
  rw [ha, m7geoF_sqUnitFrame_one f j U'.ι (m7geoF_lift f j) (m7geoF_lift_fac f j) φ
    j.opensRange s hs, restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app] at e1
  apply eq_of_heq
  refine H'.symm.trans ((heq_of_eq e1).trans ?_)
  exact C1Cap.presheaf_map_heq _ (C1Cap.image_preimage_ι_self U') _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoF_transitionSection_frame
statement:
theorem m7geoF_transitionSection_frame (y₁ y₂ : Y) (hy₁ : f y₁ ∈ j₁.opensRange)
    (hy₂ : f y₂ ∈ j₂.opensRange) (s₁ : Γ(L, j₁.opensRange)) (s₂ : Γ(L, j₂.opensRange))
    (hs₁ : φ₁.inv.app (j₁ ⁻¹ᵁ j₁.opensRange) (1 : Γ(O₁, j₁ ⁻¹ᵁ j₁.opensRange)) =
      ((restrictAdjunction j₁).unit.app L).app j₁.opensRange s₁)
    (hs₂ : φ₂.inv.app (j₂ ⁻¹ᵁ j₂.opensRange) (1 : Γ(O₂, j₂ ⁻¹ᵁ j₂.opensRange)) =
      ((restrictAdjunction j₂).unit.app L).app j₂.opensRange s₂)
    (r : Γ(S, j₁.opensRange ⊓ j₂.opensRange))
    (hr : L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : j₁.opensRange ⊓ j₂.opensRange ≤ _)).op s₁ =
      r • L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : j₁.opensRange ⊓ j₂.opensRange ≤ _)).op s₂) :
    (m7geoF_frame f j₁ φ₁ y₁ hy₁).transitionSection (m7geoF_frame f j₂ φ₂ y₂ hy₂) =
      f.app (j₁.opensRange ⊓ j₂.opensRange) r
proof:
:= by
  apply C1Cap.frameSec_injective (m7geoF_frame f j₂ φ₂ y₂ hy₂) _ inf_le_right
  rw [C1Cap.frameSec_transitionSection, C1Cap.frameSec_smul (m7geoF_frame f j₂ φ₂ y₂ hy₂)
    ((m7geoF_frame f j₁ φ₁ y₁ hy₁).U ⊓ (m7geoF_frame f j₂ φ₂ y₂ hy₂).U) inf_le_right
    (f.app (j₁.opensRange ⊓ j₂.opensRange) r), C1Cap.frameSec_one,
    C1Cap.frameSec_one, m7geoF_frameGen_frame f j₁ φ₁ y₁ hy₁ s₁ hs₁,
    m7geoF_frameGen_frame f j₂ φ₂ y₂ hy₂ s₂ hs₂]
  have h := congrArg (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app L).app
    (j₁.opensRange ⊓ j₂.opensRange)) hr
  have h1 := C1Cap.app_presheaf_map ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app L)
    (homOfLE (inf_le_left : j₁.opensRange ⊓ j₂.opensRange ≤ _)) s₁
  have h2 := C1Cap.app_presheaf_map ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app L)
    (homOfLE (inf_le_right : j₁.opensRange ⊓ j₂.opensRange ≤ _)) s₂
  have h3 := Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app L) r
    (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : j₁.opensRange ⊓ j₂.opensRange ≤ _)).op s₂)
  exact h1.symm.trans (h.trans (h3.trans (congrArg (fun z ↦ r • z) h2)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoF_hs_of_hom
statement:
theorem m7geoF_hs_of_hom {W0 : S.Opens} (s0 : Γ(L, W0)) (hle : j ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ W0)
    (hle' : j.opensRange ≤ W0)
    (h : φ.hom.app ⊤ (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op s0) = (1 : Γ(O, ⊤))) :
    φ.inv.app (j ⁻¹ᵁ j.opensRange) (1 : Γ(O, j ⁻¹ᵁ j.opensRange)) =
      ((restrictAdjunction j).unit.app L).app j.opensRange
        (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle').op s0)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : φ.inv.app ⊤ (1 : Γ(O, ⊤)) = L.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op s0 := by
    rw [← h]
    exact C1Cap.iso_inv_hom_app φ ⊤ _
  have hn := C1Cap.app_presheaf_map φ.inv (homOfLE le_top : j ⁻¹ᵁ j.opensRange ⟶ ⊤)
    (1 : Γ(O, ⊤))
  rw [C1Cap.unit_presheaf_map_one] at hn
  rw [hn, h0, restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app]
  change L.presheaf.map _ (L.presheaf.map _ s0) = L.presheaf.map _ (L.presheaf.map _ s0)
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoF_rel_of_hom
statement:
theorem m7geoF_rel_of_hom {W0 : S.Opens} (s s' : Γ(L, W0)) (hle : j ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ W0)
    (ρ : Γ(O, ⊤))
    (h1 : φ.hom.app ⊤ (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op s) = (1 : Γ(O, ⊤)))
    (h2 : φ.hom.app ⊤ (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op s') = ρ) :
    L.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op s' =
      (j.appIso ⊤).inv ρ • L.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op s
proof:
:= by
  let x : Γ((restrictFunctor j).obj L, ⊤) := L.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op s
  have hx : φ.hom.app ⊤ (ρ • x) = ρ := by
    rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul, h1]
    exact mul_one ρ
  calc L.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op s' =
        φ.inv.app ⊤ (φ.hom.app ⊤ (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op s')) :=
          (C1Cap.iso_inv_hom_app φ ⊤ _).symm
    _ = φ.inv.app ⊤ (φ.hom.app ⊤ (ρ • x)) := by rw [h2, hx]
    _ = ρ • x := C1Cap.iso_inv_hom_app φ ⊤ _
    _ = _ := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoF_W_le
statement: theorem m7geoF_W_le (i : C.I) (k : C.basisIndex i) : m7geoF_W C i k ≤ C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i
proof:
:=
  tautQuotient_toBase_range_le C i k

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoF_image_top_le
statement:
theorem m7geoF_image_top_le (i : C.I) (k : C.basisIndex i) :
    m7geoF_j C i k ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i
proof:
:=
  ((m7geoF_j C i k).image_le_opensRange ⊤).trans (tautQuotient_toBase_range_le C i k)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoF_chart_hs
statement:
theorem m7geoF_chart_hs (i : C.I) (k : C.basisIndex i) :
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheafLiteralLinearOpenIso 1 ⟨i, k⟩).inv.app
        (m7geoF_j C i k ⁻¹ᵁ m7geoF_W C i k)
        (1 : Γ((C.literalLinearOpen ⟨i, k⟩).toScheme, m7geoF_j C i k ⁻¹ᵁ m7geoF_W C i k)) =
      ((restrictAdjunction (m7geoF_j C i k)).unit.app (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)).app
        (m7geoF_W C i k) (m7geoF_gen C i k)
proof:
:=
  m7geoF_hs_of_hom (m7geoF_j C i k) (C.canonicalTwistingSheafLiteralLinearOpenIso 1 ⟨i, k⟩)
    (tautQuotient_t C i k) (m7geoF_image_top_le C i k) (m7geoF_W_le C i k)
    (tautQuotient_literal_t C i k)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoF_chart_rel
statement:
theorem m7geoF_chart_rel (i : C.I) (c l : C.basisIndex i) :
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (inf_le_left : m7geoF_W C i c ⊓ m7geoF_W C i l ≤ _)).op (m7geoF_gen C i c) =
      m7geoF_ratio C i c l • (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (inf_le_right : m7geoF_W C i c ⊓ m7geoF_W C i l ≤ _)).op (m7geoF_gen C i l)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  have hrel := m7geoF_rel_of_hom (m7geoF_j C i l)
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheafLiteralLinearOpenIso 1 ⟨i, l⟩)
    (tautQuotient_t C i l) (tautQuotient_t C i c) (m7geoF_image_top_le C i l) _
    (tautQuotient_literal_t C i l) (m7geoF_literal_t C i l c)
  have hle : m7geoF_W C i c ⊓ m7geoF_W C i l ≤ m7geoF_j C i l ''ᵁ ⊤ :=
    inf_le_right.trans (Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange (m7geoF_j C i l)).ge
  have h2 := congrArg ((C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op) hrel
  rw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul] at h2
  simp only [m7geoF_gen, m7geoF_ratio]
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (h2.trans ?_)
  · rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
    rfl
  · congr 1
    rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoF_chart_transitionSection
statement:
theorem m7geoF_chart_transitionSection (i : C.I) (c l : C.basisIndex i)
    (y₁ y₂ : pointClosureScheme w) (hy₁ : pointClosureι w y₁ ∈ m7geoF_W C i c)
    (hy₂ : pointClosureι w y₂ ∈ m7geoF_W C i l) :
    (m7geoF_chartFrame C w i c y₁ hy₁).transitionSection (m7geoF_chartFrame C w i l y₂ hy₂) =
      (pointClosureι w).app (m7geoF_W C i c ⊓ m7geoF_W C i l) (m7geoF_ratio C i c l)
proof:
:=
  m7geoF_transitionSection_frame (pointClosureι w) (m7geoF_j C i c) (m7geoF_j C i l)
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheafLiteralLinearOpenIso 1 ⟨i, c⟩)
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheafLiteralLinearOpenIso 1 ⟨i, l⟩) y₁ y₂ hy₁ hy₂
    (m7geoF_gen C i c) (m7geoF_gen C i l) (m7geoF_chart_hs C i c) (m7geoF_chart_hs C i l)
    (m7geoF_ratio C i c l) (m7geoF_chart_rel C i c l)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoF_nonempty
statement:
theorem m7geoF_nonempty (i : C.I) (c l : C.basisIndex i)
    (y₁ y₂ : pointClosureScheme w) (hy₁ : pointClosureι w y₁ ∈ m7geoF_W C i c)
    (hy₂ : pointClosureι w y₂ ∈ m7geoF_W C i l) :
    Nonempty (pointClosureι w ⁻¹ᵁ (m7geoF_W C i c ⊓ m7geoF_W C i l))
proof:
:=
  Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.overlapNonempty (m7geoF_chartFrame C w i c y₁ hy₁)
    (m7geoF_chartFrame C w i l y₂ hy₂)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoF_regularTransition_chart
statement:
theorem m7geoF_regularTransition_chart (i : C.I) (c l : C.basisIndex i)
    (y₁ y₂ : pointClosureScheme w) (hy₁ : pointClosureι w y₁ ∈ m7geoF_W C i c)
    (hy₂ : pointClosureι w y₂ ∈ m7geoF_W C i l) :
    (m7geoF_chartFrame C w i c y₁ hy₁).regularTransitionFunction
        (m7geoF_chartFrame C w i l y₂ hy₂) =
      haveI
proof:
:= m7geoF_nonempty C w i c l y₁ y₂ hy₁ hy₂
      algebraMap Γ(pointClosureScheme w, pointClosureι w ⁻¹ᵁ (m7geoF_W C i c ⊓ m7geoF_W C i l))
        (pointClosureScheme w).functionField
        ((pointClosureι w).app (m7geoF_W C i c ⊓ m7geoF_W C i l) (m7geoF_ratio C i c l)) := by
  rw [Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.regularTransitionFunction,
    m7geoF_chart_transitionSection]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoF_coeff_chartFrame
statement:
theorem m7geoF_coeff_chartFrame
    (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree (pointClosureScheme w)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι w)).obj (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)))
    (hrank : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank (pointClosureScheme w)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι w)).obj (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)) = 1)
    (i : C.I) (c l : C.basisIndex i) (b₀ : pointClosureScheme w)
    (hb₀ : pointClosureι w b₀ ∈ m7geoF_W C i c) (z : pointClosureScheme w)
    (hz : pointClosureι w z ∈ m7geoF_W C i l) :
    Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame hM hrank (m7geoF_chartFrame C w i c b₀ hb₀) z =
      haveI
proof:
:= m7geoF_nonempty C w i c l b₀ z hb₀ hz
      (pointClosureScheme w).ord
        (algebraMap Γ(pointClosureScheme w, pointClosureι w ⁻¹ᵁ (m7geoF_W C i c ⊓ m7geoF_W C i l))
          (pointClosureScheme w).functionField
          ((pointClosureι w).app (m7geoF_W C i c ⊓ m7geoF_W C i l) (m7geoF_ratio C i c l))) z := by
  rw [Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame_eq_on_localData hM hrank _
    (m7geoF_chartFrame C w i l z hz) z hz, m7geoF_regularTransition_chart]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoF_frame_field
statement:
theorem m7geoF_frame_field
    (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree (pointClosureScheme w)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι w)).obj (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)))
    (hrank : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank (pointClosureScheme w)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι w)).obj (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)) = 1)
    (v : X) (w' : C.scheme) (i : C.I) (c : C.basisIndex i) (hw : w ∈ m7geoF_W C i c)
    (hord : ∀ z : pointClosureScheme w, coheight z = 1 → C.toBase (pointClosureι w z) = v →
      ∃ (l : C.basisIndex i) (hz : pointClosureι w z ∈ m7geoF_W C i l),
        ∀ (y₁ : pointClosureScheme w) (hy₁ : pointClosureι w y₁ ∈ m7geoF_W C i c),
        haveI := m7geoF_nonempty C w i c l y₁ z hy₁ hz
        (pointClosureScheme w).ord
          (algebraMap
            Γ(pointClosureScheme w, pointClosureι w ⁻¹ᵁ (m7geoF_W C i c ⊓ m7geoF_W C i l))
            (pointClosureScheme w).functionField
            ((pointClosureι w).app (m7geoF_W C i c ⊓ m7geoF_W C i l) (m7geoF_ratio C i c l))) z =
          if pointClosureι w z = w' then 1 else 0) :
    ∃ (b₀ : pointClosureScheme w)
      (b : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme w)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι w)).obj (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)) b₀),
      ∀ z : pointClosureScheme w, coheight z = 1 → C.toBase (pointClosureι w z) = v →
        Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame hM hrank b z =
          if pointClosureι w z = w' then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hb₀ : pointClosureι w (pointClosureGenericPoint w) ∈ m7geoF_W C i c := by
    rw [pointClosureι_genericPoint]
    exact hw
  refine ⟨pointClosureGenericPoint w, m7geoF_chartFrame C w i c _ hb₀, ?_⟩
  intro z hz hzv
  obtain ⟨l, hzl, h⟩ := hord z hz hzv
  rw [m7geoF_coeff_chartFrame C w hM hrank i c l _ hb₀ z hzl]
  exact h _ hb₀

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoF_ratio_self
statement: theorem m7geoF_ratio_self (i : C.I) (c : C.basisIndex i) : m7geoF_ratio C i c c = 1
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  simp only [m7geoF_ratio, tautChart_component, tautChart_ratioSection_self]
  simp only [map_one]
  erw [map_one, map_one]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoF_ord_one
statement:
theorem m7geoF_ord_one [IsLocallyNoetherian C.scheme] {U : (pointClosureScheme w).Opens}
    [Nonempty U] (z : pointClosureScheme w) (hz : Order.coheight z = 1) (hzU : z ∈ U) :
    (pointClosureScheme w).ord (algebraMap Γ(pointClosureScheme w, U)
      (pointClosureScheme w).functionField 1) z = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := Scheme.ord_of_isUnit (X := pointClosureScheme w) (U := U)
    (f := (1 : Γ(pointClosureScheme w, U))) isUnit_one hz hzU
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoF_frame_field'
statement:
theorem m7geoF_frame_field'
    (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree (pointClosureScheme w)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι w)).obj (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)))
    (hrank : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank (pointClosureScheme w)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι w)).obj (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)) = 1)
    (v : X) (w' : C.scheme) (i : C.I) (c : C.basisIndex i) (hw : w ∈ m7geoF_W C i c)
    (hw' : w' ∉ m7geoF_W C i c)
    (hord : ∀ z : pointClosureScheme w, coheight z = 1 → C.toBase (pointClosureι w z) = v →
      pointClosureι w z ∉ m7geoF_W C i c →
      ∃ (l : C.basisIndex i) (hz : pointClosureι w z ∈ m7geoF_W C i l),
        ∀ (y₁ : pointClosureScheme w) (hy₁ : pointClosureι w y₁ ∈ m7geoF_W C i c),
        haveI := m7geoF_nonempty C w i c l y₁ z hy₁ hz
        (pointClosureScheme w).ord
          (algebraMap
            Γ(pointClosureScheme w, pointClosureι w ⁻¹ᵁ (m7geoF_W C i c ⊓ m7geoF_W C i l))
            (pointClosureScheme w).functionField
            ((pointClosureι w).app (m7geoF_W C i c ⊓ m7geoF_W C i l) (m7geoF_ratio C i c l))) z =
          if pointClosureι w z = w' then 1 else 0) :
    ∃ (b₀ : pointClosureScheme w)
      (b : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme w)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι w)).obj (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)) b₀),
      ∀ z : pointClosureScheme w, coheight z = 1 → C.toBase (pointClosureι w z) = v →
        Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame hM hrank b z =
          if pointClosureι w z = w' then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  refine m7geoF_frame_field C w hM hrank v w' i c hw ?_
  intro z hz hzv
  by_cases hzc : pointClosureι w z ∈ m7geoF_W C i c
  · refine ⟨c, hzc, fun y₁ hy₁ ↦ ?_⟩
    have hne : pointClosureι w z ≠ w' := fun h ↦ hw' (h ▸ hzc)
    rw [if_neg hne, m7geoF_ratio_self, map_one]
    haveI := m7geoF_nonempty C w i c c y₁ z hy₁ hzc
    exact m7geoF_ord_one C w z hz ⟨hzc, hzc⟩
  · exact hord z hz hzv hzc

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D6.stalkDimensionFormula_source
statement:
theorem stalkDimensionFormula_source (g : DimRelationGenerator X n) :
    C1Cap.StalkDimensionFormula g.Y
proof:
:= by
  letI : g.Y.Over (Spk k) := ⟨g.i ≫ (X ↘ Spk k)⟩
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (g.Y ↘ Spk k) :=
    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType (g.i ≫ (X ↘ Spk k)))
  exact FiniteTypeCodimension.stalkDimensionFormula_of_locallyOfFiniteType k (g.Y ↘ Spk k)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D6.coheight_le_two_source
statement:
theorem coheight_le_two_source (g : DimRelationGenerator X n) {w y : g.Y} (h : w ⤳ y)
    (hw : coheight w = 1)
    (hd : ringKrullDim (g.Y.presheaf.stalk y ⧸ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h) = 1) :
    coheight y ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hX := stalkDimensionFormula_source (k := k) g y (Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h)
    inferInstance
  rw [hd, Scheme.height_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes, hw, ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight] at hX
  have h2 : ((1 + 1 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) = (coheight y : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    rw [← hX]
    rfl
  have : coheight y = 1 + 1 := (WithBot.coe_injective h2).symm
  rw [this]
  exact le_of_eq rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D6.comp_genericPoint_dim
statement:
theorem comp_genericPoint_dim (g : DimRelationGenerator X n) (w : g.Y) :
    (pointClosureι w ≫ g.i) (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme w)) = g.i w
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← C1Cap.pointClosureGenericPoint_eq_genericPoint,
    pointClosureι_genericPoint]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D6.relGenD_cycle_apply
statement:
theorem relGenD_cycle_apply (g : DimRelationGenerator X (n + 1)) (w : g.Y)
    (hw : coheight w = 1) (y : g.Y) :
    (relGenD (k := k) g w hw).cycle.1 (g.i y) = pushedDiv g.f w y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hy : ∃ z, pointClosureι w z = y
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hy
    have h := AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_closedImmersion
      (relGenD (k := k) g w hw).i (div (relGenD (k := k) g w hw).f) (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ())
      (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) z
    rw [pushedDiv_apply]
    exact h
  · have hnot : g.i y ∉ Set.range (relGenD (k := k) g w hw).i := by
      rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
      apply hy
      refine ⟨z, g.i.isEmbedding.injective ?_⟩
      rw [← hz]
      exact (Scheme.Hom.comp_apply _ _ _).symm
    change AlgebraicCycle.pushforward (relGenD (k := k) g w hw).i
      (div (relGenD (k := k) g w hw).f) (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) _ = _
    rw [AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range _ _ _ _ _ hnot]
    unfold pushedDiv
    rw [dif_neg hy]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D6.relGenD_cycle_apply_of_not_mem_range
statement:
theorem relGenD_cycle_apply_of_not_mem_range (g : DimRelationGenerator X (n + 1)) (w : g.Y)
    (hw : coheight w = 1) {x : X} (hx : x ∉ Set.range g.i) :
    (relGenD (k := k) g w hw).cycle.1 x = 0
proof:
:= by
  change AlgebraicCycle.pushforward (relGenD (k := k) g w hw).i
    (div (relGenD (k := k) g w hw).f) (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) _ = _
  apply AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range
  rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
  exact hx ⟨pointClosureι w z, (Scheme.Hom.comp_apply _ _ _).symm⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D6.isProperForD_one
statement:
theorem isProperForD_one (g : DimRelationGenerator X n) :
    IsProperForD g (fun _ ↦ 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∀ y : g.Y, C1Cap.LocalEquations.pullback g.i (fun _ ↦ 1) y = 1 := fun y ↦ by
    simp [C1Cap.LocalEquations.pullback]
  have hnm : ∀ w : g.Y, C1Cap.LocalEquations.pullback g.i (fun _ ↦ 1) w ∉
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (g.Y.presheaf.stalk w) := fun w ↦ by
    rw [h1]
    exact IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal.mpr isUnit_one
  refine ⟨fun y ↦ by rw [h1]; exact one_ne_zero, fun x y h ↦ by rw [h1, h1, map_one],
    Set.finite_empty.subset fun w hw ↦ hnm w hw.2, fun w _ hw ↦ (hnm w hw).elim⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D6.relCycleD_mem
statement:
theorem relCycleD_mem (g : DimRelationGenerator X (n + 1)) (a : C1Cap.LocalEquations X)
    (ha : IsProperForD g a) : relCycleD (k := k) g a ha ∈ dimRationalEquivalence X n
proof:
:=
  AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun w _ ↦ AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem _
    (show (relGenD (k := k) g w.1 ((ha.finite.mem_toFinset.mp w.2).1)).cycle ∈
        dimRationalEquivalence X n from AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨_, rfl⟩) _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D6.c1CapCyclesCoeff_relationD
statement:
theorem c1CapCyclesCoeff_relationD (g : DimRelationGenerator X (n + 1))
    (a : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (ha : IsProperForD g a) (x : X) :
    C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff a g.cycle.1 x = (relCycleD (k := k) g a ha).1 x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change _ = evalHomD X n x (relCycleD (k := k) g a ha)
  rw [relCycleD, map_sum]
  simp only [map_zsmul, smul_eq_mul]
  change _ = ∑ w ∈ ha.finite.toFinset.attach,
    ((Ring.ord (g.Y.presheaf.stalk w.1) (a.pullback g.i w.1)).toNat : ℤ) *
      (relGenD (k := k) g w.1 ((ha.finite.mem_toFinset.mp w.2).1)).cycle.1 x
  have hg : g.cycle.1 = AlgebraicCycle.pushforward g.i (div g.f) (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) :=
    rfl
  have hα : ∀ w : g.Y, div g.f w ≠ 0 → (fun _ ↦ ()) w = (fun _ ↦ ()) (g.i w) :=
    fun _ _ ↦ rfl
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.range g.i
  · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [hg, C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff_pushforward_apply g.i a (div g.f) _ _ hα y,
      c1CapCyclesCoeff_div (a.pullback g.i) g.f g.hf ha.ne_zero ha.associated ha.proper
        (fun w y h hw hd ↦ coheight_le_two_source (k := k) g h hw hd) y]
    simp_rw [relGenD_cycle_apply]
    rw [Finset.sum_attach ha.finite.toFinset (fun w ↦
      ((Ring.ord (g.Y.presheaf.stalk w) (a.pullback g.i w)).toNat : ℤ) * pushedDiv g.f w y)]
    rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ (s := ha.finite.toFinset) ?_]
    · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun w hw ↦ ?_
      exact if_pos ((ha.finite.mem_toFinset).mp hw)
    · intro w hw
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hw
      rw [Finset.mem_coe, ha.finite.mem_toFinset]
      by_contra h
      exact hw (if_neg h)
  · rw [hg, C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff_pushforward_apply_of_not_mem_range g.i a (div g.f) _ _ hx]
    symm
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun w _ ↦ ?_
    rw [relGenD_cycle_apply_of_not_mem_range (k := k) g _ _ hx, mul_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D6.capCycles_relation
statement:
theorem capCycles_relation (g : DimRelationGenerator X (n + 1))
    (d : DimCapProperData (k := k) L hL n g) :
    capCycles (k := k) L hL n g.cycle = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set fs := compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1 with hfs
  have hcod : ∀ v, g.cycle.1 v ≠ 0 → height v = n + 1 := fun v hv ↦ g.cycle.2 hv
  have hsupp : ∀ v, v ∈ fs.support ↔ g.cycle.1 v ≠ 0 := fun v ↦ by
    rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, hfs, compactCycleFinsupp_apply]
  let Rep : X → dimensionCycles X n := fun v ↦
    if h : height v = n + 1 ∧ g.cycle.1 v ≠ 0 then (d.represents v h.1 h.2).choose else 0
  have hRep : ∀ v ∈ fs.support, ∀ hc : height v = n + 1,
      primeCapOrZero (k := k) L hL n v = (QuotientAddGroup.mk (Rep v) : DimChow X n) := by
    intro v hv hc
    have hv' := (hsupp v).mp hv
    rw [primeCapOrZero, dif_pos hc]
    simp only [Rep, dif_pos (And.intro hc hv')]
    exact (d.represents v hc hv').choose_spec.1
  have hRepv : ∀ v ∈ fs.support, ∀ y, (Rep v).1 y =
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff d.a₁ v y - C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff d.a₂ v y := by
    intro v hv y
    have hv' := (hsupp v).mp hv
    have hc := hcod v hv'
    simp only [Rep, dif_pos (And.intro hc hv')]
    exact (d.represents v hc hv').choose_spec.2 y
  change fs.sum (fun v m ↦ m • primeCapOrZero (k := k) L hL n v) = 0
  rw [Finsupp.sum_congr (g2 := fun v m ↦ m • (QuotientAddGroup.mk (Rep v) : DimChow X n))
    fun v hv ↦ by rw [hRep v hv (hcod v ((hsupp v).mp hv))]]
  set C := fs.sum fun v m ↦ m • Rep v with hC
  have hclass : fs.sum (fun v m ↦ m • (QuotientAddGroup.mk (Rep v) : DimChow X n)) =
      (QuotientAddGroup.mk C : DimChow X n) := by
    rw [hC]
    have := map_finsuppSum (QuotientAddGroup.mk' (dimRationalEquivalence X n)) fs
      (fun v m ↦ m • Rep v)
    simp only [map_zsmul, QuotientAddGroup.mk'_apply] at this
    exact this.symm
  rw [hclass, QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff]
  have hCeq : C = relCycleD (k := k) g d.a₁ d.proper₁ - relCycleD (k := k) g d.a₂ d.proper₂ := by
    ext x
    change evalHomD X n x C = evalHomD X n x (relCycleD (k := k) g d.a₁ d.proper₁ -
      relCycleD (k := k) g d.a₂ d.proper₂)
    rw [map_sub]
    change _ = (relCycleD (k := k) g d.a₁ d.proper₁).1 x -
      (relCycleD (k := k) g d.a₂ d.proper₂).1 x
    rw [← c1CapCyclesCoeff_relationD (k := k) g d.a₁ d.proper₁ x,
      ← c1CapCyclesCoeff_relationD (k := k) g d.a₂ d.proper₂ x]
    rw [hC, map_finsuppSum]
    simp only [map_zsmul, smul_eq_mul]
    change ∑ v ∈ fs.support, fs v * (Rep v).1 x = _
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun v hv ↦ by rw [hRepv v hv x]]
    unfold C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff
    have hsub : ∀ a : C1Cap.LocalEquations X,
        Function.support (fun v ↦ g.cycle.1 v * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a v x) ⊆
          ↑fs.support := by
      intro a v hv
      rw [Finset.mem_coe, hsupp]
      exact left_ne_zero_of_mul hv
    rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ (hsub d.a₁),
      finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ (hsub d.a₂), ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun v _ ↦ ?_
    rw [hfs, compactCycleFinsupp_apply, mul_sub]
  rw [hCeq]
  exact sub_mem (relCycleD_mem (k := k) g _ _) (relCycleD_mem (k := k) g _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D6.capDescends_of_properMeeting
statement:
theorem capDescends_of_properMeeting (h : DimCapProperMeeting (k := k) L hL n) :
    CapDescends (k := k) L hL n
proof:
:=
  fun g ↦ capCycles_relation (k := k) L hL n g (h g).some

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.boundaryPullbackComp_assoc_obj
statement:
theorem boundaryPullbackComp_assoc_obj {W X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : W ⟶ X) (g : X ⟶ Y)
 (h : Y ⟶ Z) (M : Z.Modules) :
 (pullbackComp f (g ≫ h)).inv.app M ≫
 (pullback f).map ((pullbackComp g h).inv.app M) ≫
 (pullbackComp f g).hom.app ((pullback h).obj M) ≫
 (pullbackComp (f ≫ g) h).hom.app M = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  have ha := congrArg (fun a => a.app M) (pseudofunctor_associativity f g h)
  simpa using ha

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.boundaryPullbackComp_assoc_inv_obj
statement:
theorem boundaryPullbackComp_assoc_inv_obj {W X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : W ⟶ X)
    (g : X ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ Z) (M : Z.Modules) :
    (pullbackComp f (g ≫ h)).inv.app M ≫
      (pullback f).map ((pullbackComp g h).inv.app M) =
    (pullbackComp (f ≫ g) h).inv.app M ≫
      (pullbackComp f g).inv.app ((pullback h).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono ((pullbackComp f g).hom.app ((pullback h).obj M))).1
  apply (cancel_mono ((pullbackComp (f ≫ g) h).hom.app M)).1
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc]
  rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_app]
  exact boundaryPullbackComp_assoc_obj f g h M

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackPrefixIso_assoc
statement:
theorem pullbackPrefixIso_assoc
    {A B C D : Scheme.{u}} (q : B ⟶ A) (r : C ⟶ B) (t : D ⟶ C)
    (p : C ⟶ A) (b : D ⟶ B) (s : D ⟶ A)
    (hp : r ≫ q = p) (hb : t ≫ r = b)
    (hsp : t ≫ p = s) (hsb : b ≫ q = s) (M : A.Modules) :
    pullbackPrefixIso s p t hsp M ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback t).mapIso (pullbackPrefixIso p q r hp M) =
      pullbackPrefixIso s q b hsb M ≪≫
        pullbackPrefixIso b r t hb ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  subst p
  subst b
  subst s
  apply Iso.ext
  simpa [pullbackPrefixIso, Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr] using
    boundaryPullbackComp_assoc_inv_obj t r q M

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackComparisonSquareIso_eq_prefix
statement:
theorem pullbackComparisonSquareIso_eq_prefix
    {A B C D : Scheme.{u}}
    (r : D ⟶ B) (q : B ⟶ A) (a : D ⟶ C) (v : C ⟶ A)
    (h : r ≫ q = a ≫ v) (s : D ⟶ A)
    (hr : r ≫ q = s) (ha : a ≫ v = s) (M : A.Modules) :
    pullbackComparisonSquareIso r q a v h M =
      (pullbackPrefixIso s q r hr M).symm ≪≫
        pullbackPrefixIso s v a ha M
proof:
:= by
  subst s
  have hh : ha = h.symm := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [hh]
  apply Iso.ext
  simp [pullbackComparisonSquareIso, pullbackPrefixIso,
    Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackPrefixIso_square
statement:
theorem pullbackPrefixIso_square
    {A B C D : Scheme.{u}}
    (r : D ⟶ B) (q : B ⟶ A) (a : D ⟶ C) (v : C ⟶ A)
    (h : r ≫ q = a ≫ v) (s : D ⟶ A)
    (hr : r ≫ q = s) (ha : a ≫ v = s) (M : A.Modules) :
    pullbackPrefixIso s q r hr M ≪≫
        pullbackComparisonSquareIso r q a v h M =
      pullbackPrefixIso s v a ha M
proof:
:= by
  rw [pullbackComparisonSquareIso_eq_prefix r q a v h s hr ha M]
  simp only [← Iso.trans_assoc, Iso.self_symm_id, Iso.refl_trans]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.triplePullbackPrefixIso_eq_top
statement:
theorem triplePullbackPrefixIso_eq_top {A B C D : Scheme.{u}}
    (s : D ⟶ A) (q : B ⟶ A) (r : C ⟶ B) (t : D ⟶ C)
    (h : (t ≫ r) ≫ q = s) (p : C ⟶ A)
    (hp : r ≫ q = p) (ht : t ≫ p = s) (M : A.Modules) :
    triplePullbackPrefixIso s q r t h M =
      pullbackPrefixIso s p t ht M ≪≫
        (pullback t).mapIso (pullbackPrefixIso p q r hp M)
proof:
:=
  (pullbackPrefixIso_assoc q r t p (t ≫ r) s hp rfl ht h M).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.triplePullbackPrefixIso_eq_bottom
statement:
theorem triplePullbackPrefixIso_eq_bottom {A B C D : Scheme.{u}}
    (s : D ⟶ A) (q : B ⟶ A) (r : C ⟶ B) (t : D ⟶ C)
    (h : (t ≫ r) ≫ q = s) (b : D ⟶ B)
    (hb : t ≫ r = b) (hs : b ≫ q = s) (M : A.Modules) :
    triplePullbackPrefixIso s q r t h M =
      pullbackPrefixIso s q b hs M ≪≫
        pullbackPrefixIso b r t hb ((pullback q).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  subst b
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.triplePullbackPrefixIso_top_square
statement:
theorem triplePullbackPrefixIso_top_square
    {A B C D F : Scheme.{u}}
    (s : D ⟶ A) (q : B ⟶ A) (r : C ⟶ B) (t : D ⟶ C)
    (a : C ⟶ F) (v : F ⟶ A) (hs : (t ≫ r) ≫ q = s)
    (h : r ≫ q = a ≫ v) (hs' : (t ≫ a) ≫ v = s) (M : A.Modules) :
    triplePullbackPrefixIso s q r t hs M ≪≫
        (pullback t).mapIso (pullbackComparisonSquareIso r q a v h M) =
      triplePullbackPrefixIso s v a t hs' M
proof:
:= by
  let ht : t ≫ (r ≫ q) = s := (Category.assoc t r q).symm.trans hs
  rw [triplePullbackPrefixIso_eq_top s q r t hs (r ≫ q) rfl ht M,
    triplePullbackPrefixIso_eq_top s v a t hs' (r ≫ q) h.symm ht M]
  rw [Iso.trans_assoc, ← Functor.mapIso_trans,
    pullbackPrefixIso_square r q a v h (r ≫ q) rfl h.symm M]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.triplePullbackPrefixIso_bottom_square
statement:
theorem triplePullbackPrefixIso_bottom_square
    {A B C D F : Scheme.{u}}
    (s : D ⟶ A) (q : B ⟶ A) (r : C ⟶ B) (t : D ⟶ C)
    (a : D ⟶ F) (v : F ⟶ B) (hs : (t ≫ r) ≫ q = s)
    (h : t ≫ r = a ≫ v) (hs' : (a ≫ v) ≫ q = s) (M : A.Modules) :
    triplePullbackPrefixIso s q r t hs M ≪≫
        pullbackComparisonSquareIso t r a v h ((pullback q).obj M) =
      triplePullbackPrefixIso s q v a hs' M
proof:
:= by
  rw [triplePullbackPrefixIso_eq_bottom s q r t hs (t ≫ r) rfl hs M,
    triplePullbackPrefixIso_eq_bottom s q v a hs' (t ≫ r) h.symm hs M]
  rw [Iso.trans_assoc,
    pullbackPrefixIso_square t r a v h (t ≫ r) rfl h.symm ((pullback q).obj M)]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackComparisonSquareIso_naturality
statement:
theorem pullbackComparisonSquareIso_naturality
    {A B C D : Scheme.{u}}
    (r : D ⟶ B) (q : B ⟶ A) (a : D ⟶ C) (v : C ⟶ A)
    (h : r ≫ q = a ≫ v) {M N : A.Modules} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (pullback r).map ((pullback q).map f) ≫
        (pullbackComparisonSquareIso r q a v h N).hom =
      (pullbackComparisonSquareIso r q a v h M).hom ≫
        (pullback a).map ((pullback v).map f)
proof:
:= by
  unfold pullbackComparisonSquareIso
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.app_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.app_inv, Category.assoc]
  change (pullback q ⋙ pullback r).map f ≫
      (pullbackComp r q).hom.app N ≫ (pullbackCongr h).hom.app N ≫
        (pullbackComp a v).inv.app N =
    (pullbackComp r q).hom.app M ≫ (pullbackCongr h).hom.app M ≫
      (pullbackComp a v).inv.app M ≫ (pullback v ⋙ pullback a).map f
  rw [(pullbackComp r q).hom.naturality_assoc f,
    (pullbackCongr h).hom.naturality_assoc f,
    (pullbackComp a v).inv.naturality f]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackComparisonSquareIso_boundary_cube
statement:
theorem pullbackComparisonSquareIso_boundary_cube
    {A A' B B' D D' Z Z' : Scheme.{u}}
    (z : A ⟶ A') (qC : B ⟶ A) (q : B' ⟶ A') (qB : B ⟶ B')
    (rC : Z ⟶ B) (r : Z' ⟶ B') (a : Z ⟶ Z')
    (lC : D ⟶ A) (l : D' ⟶ A') (k : D ⟶ D')
    (tC : Z ⟶ D) (t : Z' ⟶ D')
    (hQ : qB ≫ q = qC ≫ z) (hU : a ≫ r = rC ≫ qB)
    (hO : t ≫ l = r ≫ q) (hT : a ≫ t = tC ≫ k)
    (hL : k ≫ l = lC ≫ z) (hC : tC ≫ lC = rC ≫ qC)
    (M : A'.Modules) :
    (pullback rC).mapIso (pullbackComparisonSquareIso qC z qB q hQ.symm M) ≪≫
      pullbackComparisonSquareIso rC qB a r hU.symm ((pullback q).obj M) ≪≫
      (pullback a).mapIso (pullbackComparisonSquareIso r q t l hO.symm M) ≪≫
      pullbackComparisonSquareIso a t tC k hT ((pullback l).obj M) ≪≫
      (pullback tC).mapIso (pullbackComparisonSquareIso k l lC z hL M) =
    pullbackComparisonSquareIso rC qC tC lC hC.symm ((pullback z).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  let s := (rC ≫ qC) ≫ z
  have h0 : (rC ≫ qC) ≫ z = s := rfl
  have h1 : (rC ≫ qB) ≫ q = s := by
    rw [Category.assoc, hQ, ← Category.assoc]
  have h2 : (a ≫ r) ≫ q = s := by rw [hU]; exact h1
  have h3 : (a ≫ t) ≫ l = s := by
    rw [Category.assoc, hO, ← Category.assoc]; exact h2
  have h4 : (tC ≫ k) ≫ l = s := by rw [← hT]; exact h3
  have h5 : (tC ≫ lC) ≫ z = s := by
    rw [Category.assoc, ← hL, ← Category.assoc]; exact h4
  have hp : triplePullbackPrefixIso s z qC rC h0 M ≪≫
      ((pullback rC).mapIso (pullbackComparisonSquareIso qC z qB q hQ.symm M) ≪≫
        pullbackComparisonSquareIso rC qB a r hU.symm ((pullback q).obj M) ≪≫
        (pullback a).mapIso (pullbackComparisonSquareIso r q t l hO.symm M) ≪≫
        pullbackComparisonSquareIso a t tC k hT ((pullback l).obj M) ≪≫
        (pullback tC).mapIso (pullbackComparisonSquareIso k l lC z hL M)) =
      triplePullbackPrefixIso s z lC tC h5 M := by
    simp only [← Iso.trans_assoc]
    rw [triplePullbackPrefixIso_top_square s z qC rC qB q h0 hQ.symm h1 M,
      triplePullbackPrefixIso_bottom_square s q qB rC a r h1 hU.symm h2 M,
      triplePullbackPrefixIso_top_square s q r a t l h2 hO.symm h3 M,
      triplePullbackPrefixIso_bottom_square s l t a tC k h3 hT h4 M,
      triplePullbackPrefixIso_top_square s l k tC lC z h4 hL h5 M]
  have hf := triplePullbackPrefixIso_bottom_square s z qC rC tC lC
    h0 hC.symm h5 M
  apply Iso.ext
  apply (cancel_epi (triplePullbackPrefixIso s z qC rC h0 M).hom).1
  simpa only [Iso.trans_hom] using congrArg Iso.hom (hp.trans hf.symm)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackComparisonSquareIso_boundary_cube_module
statement:
theorem pullbackComparisonSquareIso_boundary_cube_module
    {A A' B B' D D' Z Z' : Scheme.{u}}
    (z : A ⟶ A') (qC : B ⟶ A) (q : B' ⟶ A') (qB : B ⟶ B')
    (rC : Z ⟶ B) (r : Z' ⟶ B') (a : Z ⟶ Z')
    (lC : D ⟶ A) (l : D' ⟶ A') (k : D ⟶ D')
    (tC : Z ⟶ D) (t : Z' ⟶ D')
    (hQ : qB ≫ q = qC ≫ z) (hU : a ≫ r = rC ≫ qB)
    (hO : t ≫ l = r ≫ q) (hT : a ≫ t = tC ≫ k)
    (hL : k ≫ l = lC ≫ z) (hC : tC ≫ lC = rC ≫ qC)
    (M : A'.Modules) {N : A.Modules} (α : (pullback z).obj M ≅ N) :
    (pullback rC).mapIso
        ((pullback qC).mapIso α.symm ≪≫
          pullbackComparisonSquareIso qC z qB q hQ.symm M) ≪≫
      pullbackComparisonSquareIso rC qB a r hU.symm ((pullback q).obj M) ≪≫
      (pullback a).mapIso (pullbackComparisonSquareIso r q t l hO.symm M) ≪≫
      (pullbackComparisonSquareIso a t tC k hT ((pullback l).obj M) ≪≫
        (pullback tC).mapIso
          (pullbackComparisonSquareIso k l lC z hL M ≪≫
            (pullback lC).mapIso α)) =
      pullbackComparisonSquareIso rC qC tC lC hC.symm N
proof:
:= by
  have hc := pullbackComparisonSquareIso_boundary_cube z qC q qB rC r a
    lC l k tC t hQ hU hO hT hL hC M
  apply Iso.ext
  have hn := pullbackComparisonSquareIso_naturality rC qC tC lC hC.symm α.inv
  simp only [Functor.mapIso_trans, Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom,
    Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc]
  have hh := congrArg (fun β =>
    (pullback rC).map ((pullback qC).map α.inv) ≫ β.hom ≫
      (pullback tC).map ((pullback lC).map α.hom)) hc
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Category.assoc] at hh
  rw [hh, ← Category.assoc, hn]
  simp only [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, α.inv_hom_id]
  rw [(pullback lC).map_id, (pullback tC).map_id, Category.comp_id]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictionBoundaryIso_eq_route
statement:
theorem restrictionBoundaryIso_eq_route
    {B B' Z Z' : Scheme.{u}} (rC : Z ⟶ B) (qB : B ⟶ B')
    (a : Z ⟶ Z') (r : Z' ⟶ B') [IsOpenImmersion rC] [IsOpenImmersion r]
    {P : B.Modules} {Q : B'.Modules} {TC : Z.Modules} {TO : Z'.Modules}
    (S : P ≅ (pullback qB).obj Q)
    (LC : (pullback rC).obj P ≅ TC) (LO : (pullback r).obj Q ≅ TO)
    (O : (pullback a).obj TO ≅ TC)
    (K : (pullback rC).obj ((pullback qB).obj Q) ≅
      (pullback a).obj ((pullback r).obj Q))
    (h : (pullback rC).mapIso S ≪≫ K ≪≫ (pullback a).mapIso LO ≪≫ O = LC) :
    ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback rC).app P ≪≫ LC) ≪≫ O.symm ≪≫
        (pullback a).mapIso ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback r).app Q ≪≫ LO).symm =
      (restrictFunctor rC).mapIso S ≪≫
        (restrictFunctorIsoPullback rC).app ((pullback qB).obj Q) ≪≫ K ≪≫
          (pullback a).mapIso ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback r).app Q).symm
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (restrictFunctor rC).mapIso S ≪≫
      (restrictFunctorIsoPullback rC).app ((pullback qB).obj Q) =
    (restrictFunctorIsoPullback rC).app P ≪≫ (pullback rC).mapIso S := by
    apply Iso.ext
    simpa only [Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.app_hom] using
      (restrictFunctorIsoPullback rC).hom.naturality S.hom
  rw [← Iso.trans_assoc, ← Iso.trans_assoc, hn]
  rw [← h]
  apply Iso.ext
  simp only [Iso.trans_symm, Functor.mapIso_trans, Functor.mapIso_symm,
    Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictionBoundaryIso_eq_route_assoc
statement:
theorem restrictionBoundaryIso_eq_route_assoc
    {B B' Z Z' : Scheme.{u}} (rC : Z ⟶ B) (qB : B ⟶ B')
    (a : Z ⟶ Z') (r : Z' ⟶ B') [IsOpenImmersion rC] [IsOpenImmersion r]
    {P : B.Modules} {Q : B'.Modules} {TC : Z.Modules} {TO : Z'.Modules}
    (S : P ≅ (pullback qB).obj Q)
    (LC : (pullback rC).obj P ≅ TC) (LO : (pullback r).obj Q ≅ TO)
    (O : (pullback a).obj TO ≅ TC)
    (K : (pullback rC).obj ((pullback qB).obj Q) ≅
      (pullback a).obj ((pullback r).obj Q))
    (h : (pullback rC).mapIso S ≪≫ K ≪≫ (pullback a).mapIso LO ≪≫ O = LC) :
    (restrictFunctorIsoPullback rC).app P ≪≫ LC ≪≫ O.symm ≪≫
        (pullback a).mapIso ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback r).app Q ≪≫ LO).symm =
      (restrictFunctor rC).mapIso S ≪≫
        (restrictFunctorIsoPullback rC).app ((pullback qB).obj Q) ≪≫ K ≪≫
          (pullback a).mapIso ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback r).app Q).symm
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Iso.trans_assoc] using
    restrictionBoundaryIso_eq_route rC qB a r S LC LO O K h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistOverlapSourceTransportIso_eq_square
statement:
theorem twistOverlapSourceTransportIso_eq_square (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (i j : C'.I) :

      (pullback ((transport e C').overlapToChart i j)).mapIso
        (chartTwistIso e C' i).symm ≪≫
      pullbackComparisonSquareIso ((transport e C').overlapToChart i j)
        (chartIso e C' i).hom (overlapIso e C' i j).hom (C'.overlapToChart i j)
        (overlapIso_hom_toChart e C' i j).symm (C'.chartTwistingSheaf 1 i)

    pullbackComparisonSquareIso, Iso.symm_symm_eq]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistOverlapSourceLocalSchemeIso_eq_square

    (C : AffineFrameCover X E) (d : ℤ) {i j : C.I} (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :

      (restrictFunctorIsoPullback (C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι).app
        ((pullback (C.overlapToChart i j)).obj (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)) ≪≫
      pullbackComparisonSquareIso (C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι
        (C.overlapToChart i j) (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom

    commonOpenChartTransportIso e C' c M =
      pullbackComparisonSquareIso (twistComparisonOpenIso e C' c).hom
        (C'.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom

        (commonChartIso e C' c).hom (twistComparisonOpenIso_commonChart e C' c) M

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.commonChartTwistLeftTransportRoute_eq_square
statement:
theorem commonChartTwistLeftTransportRoute_eq_square (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') {i j : C'.I} (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    commonChartTwistLeftTransportRoute e C' c =
      pullbackComparisonSquareIso (commonChartIso e C' c).hom c.chartToLeft
        (c.transport e C').chartToLeft (chartIso e C' i).hom
        (chartIso_leftRestriction e C' c).symm (C'.chartTwistingSheaf 1 i) ≪≫
      (pullback (c.transport e C').chartToLeft).mapIso (chartTwistIso e C' i)
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (chartIso e C' i).hom := by infer_instance
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (commonChartIso e C' c).hom := by infer_instance
  letI : IsOpenImmersion c.chartToLeft := CommonBasicOpen.chartToLeft_isOpenImmersion c
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (c.transport e C').chartToLeft :=
    CommonBasicOpen.chartToLeft_isOpenImmersion (c.transport e C')
  unfold commonChartTwistLeftTransportRoute
  rw [pullbackRestrictionCompIso_refl_eq_trans c.chartToLeft
      (commonChartIso e C' c).hom (C'.chartTwistingSheaf 1 i),
    pullbackRestrictionCompIso_refl_eq_trans (chartIso e C' i).hom
      (c.transport e C').chartToLeft (C'.chartTwistingSheaf 1 i)]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistComparisonOpenPullbackRestrictionIso_eq_square
statement:
theorem twistComparisonOpenPullbackRestrictionIso_eq_square (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') {i j : C'.I} (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    (M : (C'.overlap i j).Modules) :
    twistComparisonOpenPullbackRestrictionIso e C' c M =
      (restrictFunctorIsoPullback
        ((transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j (c.transport e C')).ι).app
          ((pullback (overlapIso e C' i j).hom).obj M) ≪≫
      pullbackComparisonSquareIso
        ((transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j (c.transport e C')).ι
        (overlapIso e C' i j).hom (twistComparisonOpenIso e C' c).hom
        (C'.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι (twistComparisonOpenIso_hom_ι e C' c).symm M ≪≫
      (pullback (twistComparisonOpenIso e C' c).hom).mapIso
        ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback (C'.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι).app M).symm
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (overlapIso e C' i j).hom := by infer_instance
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (twistComparisonOpenIso e C' c).hom := by infer_instance
  unfold twistComparisonOpenPullbackRestrictionIso
  dsimp only
  rw [pullbackSquareRestrictionIso_eq_pullbackComp
    ((transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j (c.transport e C')).ι
    (overlapIso e C' i j).hom (twistComparisonOpenIso e C' c).hom
    (C'.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι (twistComparisonOpenIso_hom_ι e C' c) M]
  simp only [pullbackComparisonSquareIso, Iso.trans_assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistRestrictionSourceRouteIso_eq_boundary
statement:
theorem twistRestrictionSourceRouteIso_eq_boundary (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') {i j : C'.I} (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    twistRestrictionSourceRouteIso e C' c =
      (restrictFunctor
        ((transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j (c.transport e C')).ι).mapIso
          (twistOverlapSourceTransportIso e C' i j) ≪≫
        twistComparisonOpenPullbackRestrictionIso e C' c
          ((pullback (C'.overlapToChart i j)).obj (C'.chartTwistingSheaf 1 i))
proof:
:= by
  unfold twistRestrictionSourceRouteIso commonOpenTwistLeftTransportIso
  rw [twistOverlapSourceLocalSchemeIso_eq_square,
    twistOverlapSourceLocalSchemeIso_eq_square,
    commonOpenChartTransportIso_eq_square, commonChartTwistLeftTransportRoute_eq_square,
    twistOverlapSourceTransportIso_eq_square, twistComparisonOpenPullbackRestrictionIso_eq_square]
  simp only [Iso.trans_assoc]
  apply restrictionBoundaryIso_eq_route_assoc
  exact pullbackComparisonSquareIso_boundary_cube_module
    (chartIso e C' i).hom ((transport e C').overlapToChart i j)
    (C'.overlapToChart i j) (overlapIso e C' i j).hom
    ((transport e C').twistComparisonOpen i j (c.transport e C')).ι
    (C'.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι (twistComparisonOpenIso e C' c).hom
    (c.transport e C').chartToLeft c.chartToLeft (commonChartIso e C' c).hom
    ((transport e C').commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j (c.transport e C')).hom
    (C'.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom
    (overlapIso_hom_toChart e C' i j) (twistComparisonOpenIso_hom_ι e C' c)
    (C'.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver_hom_chartToLeft i j c)
    (twistComparisonOpenIso_commonChart e C' c) (chartIso_leftRestriction e C' c).symm
    ((transport e C').commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver_hom_chartToLeft i j (c.transport e C'))
    (C'.chartTwistingSheaf 1 i) (chartTwistIso e C' i)

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3.zeroGysin_k0ToG0
statement:
theorem zeroGysin_k0ToG0
    (hmono : ∀ (E : Y.Modules), IsFiniteLocallyFree Y E → Mono (tMul t E)) (y : K0 Y) :
    zeroGysin t (k0ToG0 Y y) =
      k0ToG0 (zeroScheme t) (pullbackK0 (zeroι t) y)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (zeroGysin t).comp (k0ToG0 Y) = (k0ToG0 (zeroScheme t)).comp (pullbackK0 (zeroι t)) := by
    refine ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _ fun V => ?_
    obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := V
    haveI := hmono E hE
    change zeroGysin t (k0ToG0 Y (k0ClassOf Y E hE)) =
      k0ToG0 (zeroScheme t) (pullbackK0 (zeroι t) (k0ClassOf Y E hE))
    rw [k0ToG0_classOf, zeroGysin_classOf_of_mono, pullbackK0_classOf, k0ToG0_classOf]
  exact congrArg (fun f : K0 Y →+ G0 (zeroScheme t) => f y) h

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3.pullFibre_pushCokernel
statement:
theorem pullFibre_pushCokernel
    {Wz : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian Wz] (η : Wz ⟶ W) (Fz : Wz ⟶ zeroScheme t)
    [IsClosedImmersion Fz] (hsq : Fz ≫ zeroι t = η ≫ F)
    (V : W.Modules) (hV : IsCoherentLike W V) (G : Wz.Modules) (hG : IsCoherentLike Wz G)
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward η).obj G ≅ cokernel (tMul (F.appTop t) V)) :
    pullFibre t (ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf Y.Modules
        (Killed (IsCoherentLike Y) (tNatTrans t))
        (pushCokernelObject F t V hV).1 (pushCokernelObject F t V hV).2) =
      finitePushforward Fz (g0ClassOf Wz G hG)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf Y.Modules
        (Killed (IsCoherentLike Y) (tNatTrans t))
        (pushCokernelObject F t V hV).1 (pushCokernelObject F t V hV).2 =
      pushZero t (finitePushforward Fz (g0ClassOf Wz G hG)) := by
    rw [finitePushforward_classOf]
    change _ = pushFibre t (zeroι t) (zeroι_appTop t) (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _
      ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pushforward Fz).obj G, (finitePushObject Fz ⟨G, hG⟩).2⟩)
    rw [pushFibre_classOf]
    refine ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso _ _ _ _ (killed_zero t) (isZero_zero _) ?_
    refine (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).mapIso e.symm ≪≫ ?_
    refine (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp η F).app G ≪≫ ?_
    refine (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr hsq.symm).app G ≪≫ ?_
    exact ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp Fz (zeroι t)).app G).symm
  rw [h1]
  exact congrArg (fun f : G0 (zeroScheme t) →+ G0 (zeroScheme t) => f _)
    (pullFibre_comp_pushZero t) |>.trans (by simp)

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3.hbc_principal
statement:
theorem hbc_principal
    (hmono : ∀ (E : Y.Modules), IsFiniteLocallyFree Y E → Mono (tMul t E))
    {Wz : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian Wz] (η : Wz ⟶ W) (Fz : Wz ⟶ zeroScheme t)
    [IsClosedImmersion Fz] (hsq : Fz ≫ zeroι t = η ≫ F)
    (V : W.Modules) (hV : IsCoherentLike W V) [Mono (tMul (F.appTop t) V)]
    (G : Wz.Modules) (hG : IsCoherentLike Wz G)
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward η).obj G ≅ cokernel (tMul (F.appTop t) V))
    (y : K0 Y) (hy : k0ToG0 Y y = finitePushforward F (g0ClassOf W V hV)) :
    k0ToG0 (zeroScheme t) (pullbackK0 (zeroι t) y) =
      finitePushforward Fz (g0ClassOf Wz G hG)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← zeroGysin_k0ToG0 t hmono, hy, zeroGysin, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply,
    schemeGysin_finitePushforward_of_mono F t V hV]
  exact pullFibre_pushCokernel t F η Fz hsq V hV G hG e

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3.smul_pushforward_of_pullbackK0_eq_one
statement:
theorem smul_pushforward_of_pullbackK0_eq_one (ℓ : K0 Y) (hℓ : pullbackK0 F ℓ = 1)

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3.kdisj_k0
statement:
theorem kdisj_k0 (hinj : Function.Injective (k0ToG0 Y)) (ℓ : K0 Y) (hℓ : pullbackK0 F ℓ = 1)
    (v : G0 W) (y : K0 Y) (hy : k0ToG0 Y y = finitePushforward F v) :

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3.pullbackK0_classOf_eq_one

theorem pullbackK0_classOf_eq_one (L : Y.Modules) (hL : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y L)

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3.cartierGysin_k0ToG0
statement:
theorem cartierGysin_k0ToG0 (hI : KSpecialization.AR4.LocallyPrincipal I)
    (hB : AR7Bridge I T σ) (hc : Central T σ)
    (hT : ∀ E, IsCoherentLike Y E → IsCoherentLike Y (T.obj E))
    (hmono : ∀ E : Y.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFree Y E → Mono (ap T σ E)) (z : K0 Y) :
    KSpecialization.AR4.g0KilledIEquiv hI
        (killedTransport hB (cartierGysin hc kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike hT (k0ToG0 Y z))) =
      k0ToG0 I.subscheme (pullbackK0 I.subschemeι z)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ((KSpecialization.AR4.g0KilledIEquiv hI).toAddMonoidHom.comp
      ((killedTransport hB).comp (cartierGysin hc kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike hT))).comp
        (k0ToG0 Y) =
      (k0ToG0 I.subscheme).comp (pullbackK0 I.subschemeι) := by
    refine ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext _ _ fun V => ?_
    obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := V
    haveI := hmono E hE
    change KSpecialization.AR4.g0KilledIEquiv hI
        (killedTransport hB (cartierGysin hc kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike hT
          (k0ToG0 Y (k0ClassOf Y E hE)))) =
      k0ToG0 I.subscheme (pullbackK0 I.subschemeι (k0ClassOf Y E hE))
    rw [k0ToG0_classOf, pullbackK0_classOf, k0ToG0_classOf]
    exact cartierGysin_eq_pullback hI hB hc hT E hE.isFinitePresentation
  exact congrArg (fun f : K0 Y →+ G0 I.subscheme => f z) h

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3.hbc_cartier
statement:
theorem hbc_cartier (hI : KSpecialization.AR4.LocallyPrincipal I)
    (hB : AR7Bridge I T σ) (hc : Central T σ)
    (hT : ∀ E, IsCoherentLike Y E → IsCoherentLike Y (T.obj E))
    (hmono : ∀ E : Y.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFree Y E → Mono (ap T σ E))
    (c : PushCompat TW σW T σ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F))
    (hcW : Central TW σW) (hTW : ∀ E, IsCoherentLike W E → IsCoherentLike W (TW.obj E))
    (hker : ∀ E, IsCoherentLike W E →
      IsIso (kernelComparison (ap TW σW E) (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F)))
    (hcok : ∀ E, IsCoherentLike W E →
      IsIso (cokernelComparison (ap TW σW E) (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F)))
    (V : W.Modules) (hV : IsCoherentLike W V) [Mono (ap TW σW V)]
    (y : K0 Y) (hy : k0ToG0 Y y = finitePushforward F (g0ClassOf W V hV)) :
    k0ToG0 I.subscheme (pullbackK0 I.subschemeι y) =
      KSpecialization.AR4.g0KilledIEquiv hI (killedTransport hB
        (killedMap c (finitePush_obj F) (finitePush_exactOn F)
          (subcategoryClassOf W.Modules (Killed TW σW (IsCoherentLike W))
            (cokernel (ap TW σW V))
            (killed_cokernel hcW kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike hTW hV))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cartierGysin_k0ToG0 hI hB hc hT hmono y, hy]
  have hcomm := cartierGysin_comp_finitePushforward F c hcW hTW hc hT hker hcok
  rw [← mapOn_pushforward_eq_finitePushforward F]
  have h2 := congrArg (fun f : G0 W →+ _ => f (g0ClassOf W V hV)) hcomm
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply] at h2
  rw [h2]
  unfold g0ClassOf
  rw [cartierGysin_classOf_of_mono hcW kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike hTW V hV]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistPullHomAux_transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso_hom_eq_restrictConversion
statement:
theorem twistPullHomAux_transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso_hom_eq_restrictConversion
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)

    [IsOpenImmersion c.chartToRight] :
    (C.transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso d i j c).hom =
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback c.chartToLeft).app
        (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i)).inv ≫
      (C.transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonRestrictIso d i j c).hom ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback c.chartToRight).app
        (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j)).hom
proof:
:= by

    transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonRestrictIso
    TwistingSheafRestrictionData.pullbackIso

    Iso.symm_inv, id_eq, Category.assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistPullHomAux_pullHom_congr_g
statement:
theorem twistPullHomAux_pullHom_congr_g
    {A B Y D : Scheme.{u}} {M : A.Modules} {N : B.Modules}
    (f₁ : Y ⟶ A) (f₂ : Y ⟶ B)
    (φ : (Scheme.Modules.pullback f₁).obj M ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback f₂).obj N)
    (g g' : D ⟶ Y) (gf₁ : D ⟶ A) (gf₂ : D ⟶ B)
    (h : g = g')
    (hgf₁ : g ≫ f₁ = gf₁) (hgf₂ : g ≫ f₂ = gf₂)
    (hgf₁' : g' ≫ f₁ = gf₁) (hgf₂' : g' ≫ f₂ = gf₂) :
    Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
        (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
        φ g gf₁ gf₂ hgf₁ hgf₂ =
      Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
        (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
        φ g' gf₁ gf₂ hgf₁' hgf₂'
proof:
:= by
  subst g'
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistPullHomAux_canonicalTwistTransition_pullHom_commonChart
statement:
theorem twistPullHomAux_canonicalTwistTransition_pullHom_commonChart
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
        (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
        (f₁ := C.overlapToChart i j)
        (f₂ := C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i)
        ((C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d).iso i j).hom
        (C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι
        ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ≫ c.chartToLeft)
        ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ≫ c.chartToRight)
        (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver_hom_chartToLeft i j c).symm
        (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver_hom_chartToRight i j c).symm =
      Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
        (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
        (C.transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso d i j c).hom
        (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom
        ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ≫ c.chartToLeft)
        ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ≫ c.chartToRight)
        rfl rfl
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (C.transition i j) :=
    C.transition_isOpenImmersion' i j
  letI : IsOpenImmersion c.chartToLeft :=
    CommonBasicOpen.chartToLeft_isOpenImmersion c
  letI : IsOpenImmersion c.chartToRight :=
    CommonBasicOpen.chartToRight_isOpenImmersion c
  letI : IsOpenImmersion
      (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom := by
    infer_instance
  letI : IsOpenImmersion
      ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ≫ c.chartToLeft) := by
    infer_instance
  letI : IsOpenImmersion
      ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ≫ c.chartToRight) := by
    infer_instance
  rw [twistPullHomAux_canonicalTwistTransitionSystem_iso_hom]
  rw [CommonBasicOpen.twistPullHomAux_pullHom_restrictConversion]
  rw [C.twistOverlapRestrictHomOfLocalCompatibility_restrict]
  rw [twistPullHomAux_transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso_hom_eq_restrictConversion]
  have hPullRhs :=
    CommonBasicOpen.twistPullHomAux_pullHom_restrictConversion
      (C.chartTwistingSheaf d i) (C.chartTwistingSheaf d j)
      c.chartToLeft c.chartToRight
      (C.transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonRestrictIso d i j c).hom
      (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom
      ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ≫ c.chartToLeft)
      ((C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom ≫ c.chartToRight)
      rfl rfl
  rw [hPullRhs]
  unfold twistOverlapRestrictLocalSchemeIso
    twistOverlapSourceRestrictLocalSchemeIso
    twistOverlapTargetRestrictLocalSchemeIso
    restrictRestrictionSquareIso
    restrictRestrictionSquareNatIso
    restrictCompPrefixNatIso'
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.trans_inv,
    Iso.symm_inv, Iso.app_hom, Iso.app_inv,
    Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.mapIso_inv, NatTrans.comp_app,
    Category.assoc,
    Iso.hom_inv_id_app, Iso.inv_hom_id_app,
    Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc,
    Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
  simp only [twistPullHomAux_restrictFunctorCongr_hom_inv_hom_assoc,
    twistPullHomAux_restrictFunctorCongr_inv_hom_inv_assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistPullHomAux_canonicalTwistTransition_pullHom'_commonChartMap
statement:
theorem twistPullHomAux_canonicalTwistTransition_pullHom'_commonChartMap
    (d : ℤ) (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    {D : Scheme.{u}} (q : D ⟶ C.scheme) (a : D ⟶ c.chart)
    (fL : D ⟶ C.chart i) (fR : D ⟶ C.chart j)
    (haL : a ≫ c.chartToLeft = fL)
    (haR : a ≫ c.chartToRight = fR)
    (hf₁ : fL ≫ C.chartι i = q)
    (hf₂ : fR ≫ C.chartι j = q) :
    Pseudofunctor.DescentData'.pullHom'
        (C.twistTransitionHomChosen
          (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d))
        q fL fR hf₁ hf₂ =
      Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
        (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
        (C.transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso d i j c).hom
        a fL fR haL haR
proof:
:= by
  let e := C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c
  let U := C.twistComparisonOpen i j c
  let p : D ⟶ C.overlap i j := a ≫ e.inv ≫ U.ι
  have hp₁ : p ≫ C.overlapToChart i j = fL := by
    calc
      p ≫ C.overlapToChart i j = a ≫ c.chartToLeft := by
        dsimp only [p, e, U]
        rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc,
          ← C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver_hom_chartToLeft i j c]
        simp
      _ = fL := haL
  have hp₂ :
      p ≫ (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i) =
        fR := by
    calc
      p ≫ (C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i) =
          a ≫ c.chartToRight := by
        dsimp only [p, e, U]
        simp only [Category.assoc]
        rw [← C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver_hom_chartToRight i j c]
        simp
      _ = fR := haR
  have hOuterL :
      (a ≫ e.inv) ≫ (e.hom ≫ c.chartToLeft) = fL := by
    calc
      _ = a ≫ c.chartToLeft := by simp
      _ = fL := haL
  have hOuterR :
      (a ≫ e.inv) ≫ (e.hom ≫ c.chartToRight) = fR := by
    calc
      _ = a ≫ c.chartToRight := by simp
      _ = fR := haR
  rw [Pseudofunctor.DescentData'.pullHom'_eq_pullHom
    (C.twistTransitionHomChosen
      (C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d))
    q fL fR p
    hf₁ hf₂ hp₁ hp₂]
  calc
    _ =
        Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
          (Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
            ((C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d).iso i j).hom
            U.ι (e.hom ≫ c.chartToLeft)
              (e.hom ≫ c.chartToRight)
            (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver_hom_chartToLeft i j c).symm
            (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver_hom_chartToRight i j c).symm)
          (a ≫ e.inv) fL fR hOuterL hOuterR := by
        simpa only [p, e, U, Category.assoc] using
          (Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom_pullHom
            (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
            ((C.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem d).iso i j).hom
            U.ι (e.hom ≫ c.chartToLeft) (e.hom ≫ c.chartToRight)
            (a ≫ e.inv) fL fR
            (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver_hom_chartToLeft i j c).symm
            (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver_hom_chartToRight i j c).symm
            hOuterL hOuterR).symm
    _ =
        Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
          (Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
            (C.transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso d i j c).hom
            e.hom (e.hom ≫ c.chartToLeft)
              (e.hom ≫ c.chartToRight) rfl rfl)
          (a ≫ e.inv) fL fR hOuterL hOuterR := by
        rw [twistPullHomAux_canonicalTwistTransition_pullHom_commonChart]
    _ =
        Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom
          (C.transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso d i j c).hom
          ((a ≫ e.inv) ≫ e.hom)
          fL fR := by
      exact
        Pseudofunctor.LocallyDiscreteOpToCat.pullHom_pullHom
          (F := Scheme.Modules.pullbackPseudofunctor)
          (C.transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso d i j c).hom
          e.hom (e.hom ≫ c.chartToLeft) (e.hom ≫ c.chartToRight)
          (a ≫ e.inv) fL fR
          rfl rfl hOuterL hOuterR
    _ = _ := by
      have ha : (a ≫ e.inv) ≫ e.hom = a := by simp
      have hCompL :
          ((a ≫ e.inv) ≫ e.hom) ≫ c.chartToLeft = fL := by
        rw [ha]
        exact haL
      have hCompR :
          ((a ≫ e.inv) ≫ e.hom) ≫ c.chartToRight = fR := by
        rw [ha]
        exact haR
      exact twistPullHomAux_pullHom_congr_g
        c.chartToLeft c.chartToRight
        (C.transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso d i j c).hom
        ((a ≫ e.inv) ≫ e.hom) a
        fL fR ha
        hCompL hCompR haL haR

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.native_height_eq_τ
statement:
theorem native_height_eq_τ (X : Scheme.{u})
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] (x : X) :
    height x = τ k X x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, -⟩ :=
    (TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens)
      (show x ∈ (⊤ : X.Opens) from trivial)
  rw [height_eq_coheight_primeIdealOf k X hV x hxV,
    coheight_primeIdealOf_eq_τ k X hV x hxV]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.native_height_ne_top
statement:
theorem native_height_ne_top (X : Scheme.{u})
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] (x : X) :
    height x ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, -⟩ :=
    (TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens)
      (show x ∈ (⊤ : X.Opens) from trivial)
  rw [native_height_eq_τ k X x]
  exact τ_ne_top k X hV x hxV

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.native_height_tower
statement:
theorem native_height_tower {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] (x : X) :
    letI : Algebra (Y.residueField (f x)) (X.residueField x)
proof:
:=
      (f.residueFieldMap x).hom.toAlgebra
    height x = height (f x) +
      Cardinal.toENat (Algebra.trdeg (Y.residueField (f x)) (X.residueField x)) := by
  letI : Algebra k (Y.residueField (f x)) := (kRes k Y (f x)).toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra k (X.residueField x) := (kRes k X x).toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra (Y.residueField (f x)) (X.residueField x) :=
    (f.residueFieldMap x).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : IsScalarTower k (Y.residueField (f x)) (X.residueField x) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun r ↦ (residueFieldMap_kRes f x r).symm)
  have h := congrArg Cardinal.toENat
    (trdeg_add_eq k (Y.residueField (f x)) (A := X.residueField x))
  rw [map_add] at h
  rw [native_height_eq_τ k X x, native_height_eq_τ k Y (f x)]
  exact h.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProjectiveBaseChangeDimension.native_relative_trdeg_of_pureRelDim
statement:
theorem native_relative_trdeg_of_pureRelDim {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (d : ℕ) (hd : PureRelDim f d) (x : X) (hx : flatPullbackCoeff f x ≠ 0) :
    letI : Algebra (Y.residueField (f x)) (X.residueField x)
proof:
:=
      (f.residueFieldMap x).hom.toAlgebra
    Cardinal.toENat (Algebra.trdeg (Y.residueField (f x)) (X.residueField x)) = d := by
  have ht := native_height_tower k f x
  have hh := hd x hx
  exact ENat.add_right_injective_of_ne_top (native_height_ne_top k Y (f x))
    (ht.symm.trans hh)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackProjectiveMap_pureRelDim
statement:
theorem pullbackProjectiveMap_pureRelDim (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [IsNoetherian X]
    {E : Y.Modules} (C : AffineFrameCover Y E) (g : X ⟶ Y)
    [g.IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (d : ℕ) (hd : PureRelDim g d) : PureRelDim (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) d
proof:
:= by
  letI : (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g).IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    M7.pullbackProjectiveMap_isOver C g
  intro z hz
  let x : X := (C.pullbackFrameCover g).toBase z
  have hx : flatPullbackCoeff g x ≠ 0 := C.pullbackProjectiveMap_source_coeff_ne_zero g z hz
  have hr := native_relative_trdeg_of_pureRelDim k g d hd x hx
  have he := congrArg Cardinal.toENat (C.pullbackProjectiveMap_relative_residue_trdeg g z hz)
  have ht := native_height_tower k (C.pullbackProjectiveMap g) z
  rw [he, hr] at ht
  exact ht

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.CartierDivisorData.unitOldZeroIso_hom_val
statement:
lemma unitOldZeroIso_hom_val (U : X.Opens) [Nonempty U] (a : Γ(X, U)) :
    (((unitOldZeroIso (X := X)).hom.val.app (op U)) a).1 =
      X.germToFunctionField U a
proof:
:= by
  let ηU : genericPoint X ∈ U :=
    ((genericPoint_spec X).mem_open_set_iff U.isOpen).mpr
      (by simpa using (inferInstance : Nonempty U))
  let η : (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology (genericPoint X)).fiber.obj U := ⟨⟨ηU⟩⟩
  have hcomp :
      (AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.sheafToSheafViaSubmodule
          (0 : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ)).val.app (op U)
          (((unitOldZeroIso (X := X)).hom.val.app (op U)) a) =
        AlgebraicGeometry.AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.unitToSheafZero.app (op U) a := by
    have hmorph :
        (unitOldZeroIso (X := X)).hom ≫
            (AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.sheafIsoSheafViaSubmodule
              (0 : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ)).hom =
          (AlgebraicGeometry.AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.unitIsoSheafZero
            (X := X)).hom := by
      change
        (AlgebraicGeometry.AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.unitIsoSheafZero
            (X := X)).hom ≫
            (AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.sheafIsoSheafViaSubmodule
              (0 : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ)).inv ≫
              (AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.sheafIsoSheafViaSubmodule
                (0 : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ)).hom = _
      rw [Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
    have happ := congrArg
      (fun f ↦ f.val.app (op U) a) hmorph
    exact happ
  have heval := congrArg
    (fun s ↦ AlgebraicGeometry.AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.eval η s.1) hcomp
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.SchemeBridge.sheafToSheafViaSubmodule_app_apply,
    AlgebraicGeometry.AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.eval_constSection,
    AlgebraicGeometry.AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.eval_unitToSheafZero_app,
    mul_one] at heval
  exact heval

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.CartierDivisorData.unitOldZeroIso_inv_germ
statement:
lemma unitOldZeroIso_inv_germ (U : X.Opens) [Nonempty U]
    (s : AlgebraicCycle.Sheaf.carrier (0 : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) U) :
    X.germToFunctionField U
        (((unitOldZeroIso (X := X)).inv.val.app (op U)) s) = s.1
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp :
      ((unitOldZeroIso (X := X)).hom.val.app (op U))
          (((unitOldZeroIso (X := X)).inv.val.app (op U)) s) = s := by
    change (((unitOldZeroIso (X := X)).inv ≫
      (unitOldZeroIso (X := X)).hom).val.app (op U)) s = s
    rw [Iso.inv_hom_id]
    rfl
  have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hcomp
  rw [unitOldZeroIso_hom_val] at hval
  exact hval

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.CartierDivisorData.coversTop
statement:
theorem coversTop (d : CartierDivisorData D) :
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).CoversTop d.U

statement:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.CartierDivisorData.sheaf_genericRank
statement:
theorem sheaf_genericRank (d : CartierDivisorData D) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X D.1.sheaf = 1
proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.CartierDivisorData.transitionUnitIso_lineBundleLocalData_hom
statement:
lemma transitionUnitIso_lineBundleLocalData_hom
    (d : CartierDivisorData D) (x y : X) (V : X.Opens)
    (hVx : V ≤ d.U x) (hVy : V ≤ d.U y) :
    ((d.lineBundleLocalData x).transitionUnitIsoOver
      (d.lineBundleLocalData y) V hVx hVy).hom =
        (unitOldZeroIso (X := X)).hom.over V ≫
          restrictHomOverLE X hVx (d.localPrincipalSheafIso x).inv ≫
          restrictHomOverLE X hVy (d.localPrincipalSheafIso y).hom ≫
          (unitOldZeroIso (X := X)).inv.over V
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [lineBundleLocalData]
  simp [LineBundleLocalData.transitionUnitIsoOver, LineBundleLocalData.transitionIsoOver,
    LineBundleLocalData.globalFrameOverLE_hom,
    LineBundleLocalData.globalFrameOverLE_inv, LineBundleLocalData.globalFrame,
    localFrame, restrictHomOverLE_comp, restrictHomOverLE_over,
    Category.assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.CartierDivisorData.regularTransitionFunction_lineBundleLocalData
statement:
theorem regularTransitionFunction_lineBundleLocalData
    (d : CartierDivisorData D) (x y : X) :
    (d.lineBundleLocalData x).regularTransitionFunction (d.lineBundleLocalData y) =
      d.equation y / d.equation x
proof:
:= by
  letI : Nonempty (d.U x ⊓ d.U y : X.Opens) :=
    ⟨⟨genericPoint X,
      LineBundleLocalData.genericPoint_mem (d.lineBundleLocalData x),
      LineBundleLocalData.genericPoint_mem (d.lineBundleLocalData y)⟩⟩
  rw [LineBundleLocalData.regularTransitionFunction,
    LineBundleLocalData.transitionSection, LineBundleLocalData.transitionSectionOver,
    LineBundleLocalData.transitionAppIsoOver]
  simp only [Functor.mapIso_hom]
  rw [transitionUnitIso_lineBundleLocalData_hom]
  dsimp only [lineBundleLocalData]
  change X.germToFunctionField (d.U x ⊓ d.U y)
    (((unitOldZeroIso (X := X)).inv.val.app (op (d.U x ⊓ d.U y)))
      (d.mulSection y (d.U x ⊓ d.U y) inf_le_right
        (d.divSection x (d.U x ⊓ d.U y) inf_le_left
          (((unitOldZeroIso (X := X)).hom.val.app (op (d.U x ⊓ d.U y)))
            (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op (d.U x ⊓ d.U y))))))) = _
  rw [unitOldZeroIso_inv_germ]
  change d.equation y * ((d.equation x)⁻¹ *
    (((unitOldZeroIso (X := X)).hom.val.app (op (d.U x ⊓ d.U y)))
      (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op (d.U x ⊓ d.U y)))).1) = _
  rw [unitOldZeroIso_hom_val]
  simp [div_eq_mul_inv]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.CartierDivisorData.lineBundleDivisorCycleWithFrame_eq_sub_div
statement:
theorem lineBundleDivisorCycleWithFrame_eq_sub_div
    (d : CartierDivisorData D) :
    lineBundleDivisorCycleWithFrame d.sheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree d.sheaf_genericRank
        (d.lineBundleLocalData (genericPoint X)) =
      D.1 - AlgebraicGeometry.div (d.equation (genericPoint X))
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  rw [lineBundleDivisorCycleWithFrame_apply,
    lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame_eq_on_localData
      d.sheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree d.sheaf_genericRank
      (d.lineBundleLocalData (genericPoint X)) (d.lineBundleLocalData p) p (d.mem p),
    d.regularTransitionFunction_lineBundleLocalData]
  by_cases hp : coheight p = 1
  · rw [X.ord_div hp _ _ (d.equation_ne_zero p)
      (d.equation_ne_zero (genericPoint X))]
    change X.ord (d.equation p) p - X.ord (d.equation (genericPoint X)) p =
      D.1 p - X.ord (d.equation (genericPoint X)) p
    rw [d.coeff_eq_ord p p (d.mem p)]
  · have hDp : D.1 p = 0 := by
      by_contra h
      exact hp (D.2 h)
    rw [ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hp]
    change 0 = D.1 p - X.ord (d.equation (genericPoint X)) p
    rw [ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hp, hDp, sub_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.CartierDivisorData.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame_eq_sub_principal

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.CartierDivisorData.lineBundleDivisorClass_sheaf_eq

theorem lineBundleDivisorClass_sheaf_eq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.regularTransitionFunction_lineBundleCartierDivisorDataWithFrame
statement:
lemma regularTransitionFunction_lineBundleCartierDivisorDataWithFrame
    (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree X M)
    (hrank : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X M = 1)
    (b : LineBundleLocalData X M bpoint) (x y : X) :
    let d
proof:
:= lineBundleCartierDivisorDataWithFrame hM hrank b
    (lineBundleLocalDataAt X M hM hrank x).regularTransitionFunction
        (lineBundleLocalDataAt X M hM hrank y) =
      (d.lineBundleLocalData x).regularTransitionFunction
        (d.lineBundleLocalData y) := by
