name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorialLocalIsoWithFrame_compatible
statement:
lemma lineBundleDivisorialLocalIsoWithFrame_compatible
    (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree X M)
    (hrank : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X M = 1)
    (b : LineBundleLocalData X M bpoint) :
    Presheaf.FamilyOfElementsOnObjects.IsCompatible
      (fun x : X ↦ localHomSection X
        (lineBundleLocalDataAt X M hM hrank x).U
        (lineBundleDivisorialLocalIsoWithFrame hM hrank b x).hom)
proof:
:= by
  intro Z x y f g
  let ex := lineBundleLocalDataAt X M hM hrank x
  let ey := lineBundleLocalDataAt X M hM hrank y
  let d := lineBundleCartierDivisorDataWithFrame hM hrank b
  let cx := d.lineBundleLocalData x
  let cy := d.lineBundleLocalData y
  have hZx : Z ≤ ex.U := f.le
  have hZy : Z ≤ ey.U := g.le
  have hZcx : Z ≤ cx.U := hZx
  have hZcy : Z ≤ cy.U := hZy
  rw [show f = homOfLE hZx from Subsingleton.elim _ _,
    show g = homOfLE hZy from Subsingleton.elim _ _,
    sheafHom_map_localHomSection, sheafHom_map_localHomSection]
  apply congrArg (SheafOfModules.toSheaf (X.ringCatSheaf.over Z)).map
  by_cases hZ : Nonempty Z
  · letI : Nonempty Z := hZ
    rw [show (lineBundleDivisorialLocalIsoWithFrame hM hrank b x).hom =
        ex.globalFrame.inv ≫ (d.lineBundleLocalData x).globalFrame.hom from rfl,
      show (lineBundleDivisorialLocalIsoWithFrame hM hrank b y).hom =
        ey.globalFrame.inv ≫ (d.lineBundleLocalData y).globalFrame.hom from rfl]
    calc
      restrictHomOverLE X hZx
          (ex.globalFrame.inv ≫ (d.lineBundleLocalData x).globalFrame.hom) =
          restrictHomOverLE X hZx ex.globalFrame.inv ≫
            restrictHomOverLE X hZx (d.lineBundleLocalData x).globalFrame.hom :=
        restrictHomOverLE_comp X hZx _ _
      _ = restrictHomOverLE X hZy ey.globalFrame.inv ≫
            restrictHomOverLE X hZy (d.lineBundleLocalData y).globalFrame.hom := by
        exact LineBundleLocalData.comparisonHom_eq_of_transitionIsoOver_eq
          ex ey cx cy Z hZx hZy hZcx hZcy
            (LineBundleLocalData.transitionIsoOver_eq_of_regularTransitionFunction_eq
              ex ey cx cy Z hZx hZy hZcx hZcy
                (regularTransitionFunction_lineBundleCartierDivisorDataWithFrame
                  hM hrank b x y))
      _ = restrictHomOverLE X hZy
          (ey.globalFrame.inv ≫ (d.lineBundleLocalData y).globalFrame.hom) :=
        (restrictHomOverLE_comp X hZy _ _).symm
  · letI : IsEmpty Z := ⟨fun z ↦ hZ ⟨z⟩⟩
    exact hom_ext_of_isEmpty_open (X := X) (U := Z) _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleToDivisorialHomWithFrame_over
statement:
lemma lineBundleToDivisorialHomWithFrame_over
    (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree X M)
    (hrank : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X M = 1)
    (b : LineBundleLocalData X M bpoint) (x : X) :
    (lineBundleToDivisorialHomWithFrame hM hrank b).over
        (lineBundleLocalDataAt X M hM hrank x).U =
      (lineBundleDivisorialLocalIsoWithFrame hM hrank b x).hom
proof:
:=
  glueHom_over X
    (fun x : X ↦ (lineBundleLocalDataAt X M hM hrank x).U)
    (lineBundleLocalDataAt_coversTop X M hM hrank)
    (fun x ↦ (lineBundleDivisorialLocalIsoWithFrame hM hrank b x).hom)
    (lineBundleDivisorialLocalIsoWithFrame_compatible hM hrank b) x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.lineBundleToDivisorialHomWithFrame_isIso
statement:
theorem lineBundleToDivisorialHomWithFrame_isIso
    (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree X M)
    (hrank : AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericRank X M = 1)
    (b : LineBundleLocalData X M bpoint) :
    IsIso (lineBundleToDivisorialHomWithFrame hM hrank b)
proof:
:=
  glueHom_isIso X
    (fun x : X ↦ (lineBundleLocalDataAt X M hM hrank x).U)
    (lineBundleLocalDataAt_coversTop X M hM hrank)
    (fun x ↦ (lineBundleDivisorialLocalIsoWithFrame hM hrank b x).hom)
    (lineBundleDivisorialLocalIsoWithFrame_compatible hM hrank b)
    (fun _ ↦ inferInstance)

name: KSpecialization.ARRHBCP.hbcE_general_bundle
statement:
theorem hbcE_general_bundle (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1) (hreg : SectionIsRegular σ)
    (hs : Mono (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ)))
    (V : W.Modules) (hV : IsFiniteLocallyFree W V) (y : K0 Y)
    (hy : k0ToG0 Y y = finitePushforward F (g0ClassOf W V hV.isFinitePresentation)) :
    k0ToG0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme (pullbackK0 ιΣ y) =
      finitePushforward FzΣ
        (k0ToG0 (pullback F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι)
          (pullbackK0 ηΣ (k0ClassOf W V hV)))
proof:
:= by
  have hV₀ : IsCoherentLike W V := hV.isFinitePresentation
  letI : V.IsFinitePresentation := hV₀
  haveI : Mono (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)))
      (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) V) :=
    CIIL3B.mono_sigmaT_app (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ)) _ hV
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (pullback F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι) :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian ηΣ
  have hT := tensorSheaf_isCoherentLike W _ _
    (SchemeKTheory.hasConstantRank_pullback W F _ 1
      (lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank L hL)).isFiniteLocallyFree hV₀
  have hC : IsCoherentLike W (cokernel (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)))
        (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) V)) :=
    (kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike (Y := W)).cokernel _ hT hV₀
  letI : (cokernel (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)))
        (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) V)).IsFinitePresentation := hC
  have hunit := KSpecialization.ARRHU.hunit_ARRHU σ hL F V hV₀
  have hG0 : IsCoherentLike (pullback F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ηΣ).obj (cokernel (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)))
        (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) V))) :=
    pullback_isFinitePresentation_global ηΣ _
  have hG' := (finitePushObject FzΣ ⟨_, hG0⟩).2
  let e : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward ιΣ).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward FzΣ).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ηΣ).obj (cokernel (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)))
        (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) V)))) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj (cokernel (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)))
        (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) V)) :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp FzΣ ιΣ).app _ ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr pullback.condition.symm).app _ ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp ηΣ F).app _).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).mapIso (asIso (SchemeKTheory.ProjectionFormula.adjUnit ηΣ _)).symm
  have h := CIIL3B.hbc_cartier_closed σ hL hreg F _ hV₀ y hy _ hG' e
  rw [h]
  haveI := CIIL3B.isIso_pullback_fst_cokernel_π σ F hL V
  have hV₂ : IsCoherentLike (pullback F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ηΣ).obj V) :=
    pullback_isFinitePresentation_global ηΣ _
  have hcls : g0ClassOf (pullback F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι) _ hG0 =
      k0ToG0 (pullback F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι)
        (pullbackK0 ηΣ (k0ClassOf W V hV)) := by
    have h1 : g0ClassOf (pullback F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι) _ hG0 =
        g0ClassOf (pullback F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι) _ hV₂ :=
      g0ClassOf_iso _ _ _ (asIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ηΣ).map (cokernel.π _))).symm
    rw [h1, pullbackK0_classOf, k0ToG0_classOf]
  refine (finitePushforward_classOf FzΣ _ hG0).symm.trans ?_
  rw [hcls]

name: KSpecialization.ARRHBCP.hbcE_general
statement:
theorem hbcE_general (hL : HasConstantRank Y L 1) (hreg : SectionIsRegular σ)
    (hs : Mono (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ)))
    (hres : Function.Bijective (k0ToG0 Y)) (w : K0 W) (y : K0 Y)
    (hy : k0ToG0 Y y = finitePushforward F (k0ToG0 W w)) :
    k0ToG0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme (pullbackK0 ιΣ y) =
      finitePushforward FzΣ
        (k0ToG0 (pullback F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι)
          (pullbackK0 ηΣ w))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (pullback F (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι) :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian ηΣ
  let Ψ : G0 Y ≃+ K0 Y := (AddEquiv.ofBijective (k0ToG0 Y) hres).symm
  have hΨ : ∀ g, k0ToG0 Y (Ψ g) = g := fun g =>
    (AddEquiv.ofBijective (k0ToG0 Y) hres).apply_symm_apply g
  let L' : K0 W →+ G0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme :=
    (k0ToG0 _).comp ((pullbackK0 ιΣ).comp (Ψ.toAddMonoidHom.comp ((finitePushforward F).comp
      (k0ToG0 W))))
  let R : K0 W →+ G0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme :=
    (finitePushforward FzΣ).comp ((k0ToG0 _).comp (pullbackK0 ηΣ))
  have hLR : L' = R := by
    apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
    intro E
    change k0ToG0 _ (pullbackK0 ιΣ (Ψ (finitePushforward F (k0ToG0 W (k0ClassOf W E.1 E.2))))) =
      finitePushforward FzΣ (k0ToG0 _ (pullbackK0 ηΣ (k0ClassOf W E.1 E.2)))
    rw [k0ToG0_classOf]
    exact hbcE_general_bundle σ F hL hreg hs E.1 E.2 _ (by rw [hΨ])
  have hyΨ : y = Ψ (finitePushforward F (k0ToG0 W w)) := by
    rw [← hy]; exact ((AddEquiv.ofBijective (k0ToG0 Y) hres).symm_apply_apply y).symm
  have := DFunLike.congr_fun hLR w
  change k0ToG0 _ (pullbackK0 ιΣ (Ψ (finitePushforward F (k0ToG0 W w)))) =
    finitePushforward FzΣ (k0ToG0 _ (pullbackK0 ηΣ w)) at this
  rw [hyΨ]; exact this

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.mem_lowSub
statement:
theorem mem_lowSub {n : ℕ} {T : Alg.Op M} :
    T ∈ lowSub M n ↔ ∀ (m : ℕ) (z : M m) (j : ℕ), j + n ≠ m →
      T (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M m z) j = 0
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.low_apply_support
statement:
theorem low_apply_support {a b : ℕ} {T : Alg.Op M} (hT : T ∈ lowSub M a) (m : ℕ)
    (v : DirectSum ℕ M) (hv : ∀ j', j' + b ≠ m → v j' = 0) (j : ℕ) (hj : j + (a + b) ≠ m) :
    T v j = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_of v, map_sum]
  change (DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ M j) (∑ i ∈ DFinsupp.support v, T (DirectSum.of M i (v i))) = 0
  rw [map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i hi ↦ ?_
  have hi' : v i ≠ 0 := DFinsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hi
  have hib : i + b = m := by
    by_contra hc
    exact hi' (hv i hc)
  exact hT i (v i) j (by omega)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.low_lof_lt
statement:
theorem low_lof_lt {a : ℕ} {T : Alg.Op M} (hT : T ∈ lowSub M a) {m : ℕ} (h : m < a)
    (z : M m) : T (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M m z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply DFinsupp.ext
  intro j
  exact hT m z j (by omega)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.low_lof_ge
statement:
theorem low_lof_ge {a : ℕ} {T : Alg.Op M} (hT : T ∈ lowSub M a) {m : ℕ} (h : a ≤ m)
    (z : M m) :
    T (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M m z) =
      DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M (m - a) (T (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M m z) (m - a))
proof:
:= by
  apply DFinsupp.ext
  intro j
  by_cases hj : j = m - a
  · subst hj
    exact (DirectSum.of_eq_same (m - a) _).symm
  · exact (hT m z j (by omega)).trans
      (DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne (m - a) j _ hj).symm

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tot_lof
statement:
theorem tot_lof (F : PowerSeries (Alg.Op M)) (n : ℕ) (y : M n) :
    tot F (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M n y) =
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), PowerSeries.coeff m F (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M n y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold tot
  rw [Alg.gsum_lof, LinearMap.sum_apply]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tot_lof_stable
statement:
theorem tot_lof_stable {F : PowerSeries (Alg.Op M)} (hF : GSer (lowFam M) F) {n N : ℕ}
    (hN : n < N) (y : M n) :
    tot F (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M n y) =
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, PowerSeries.coeff m F (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M n y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tot_lof]
  apply Finset.sum_subset
  · intro m hm
    simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hm ⊢
    omega
  · intro m hmN hmn
    simp only [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hmN hmn
    exact low_lof_lt (hF m) (by omega) y

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tot_add
statement: theorem tot_add (F H : PowerSeries (Alg.Op M)) : tot (F + H) = tot F + tot H
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro y
  simp only [tot, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, Alg.gsum, DirectSum.toModule_lof,
    map_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tot_smul
statement: theorem tot_smul (q : ℚ) (F : PowerSeries (Alg.Op M)) : tot (q • F) = q • tot F
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro y
  simp only [tot, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, Alg.gsum, DirectSum.toModule_lof,
    Finset.smul_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tot_zero
statement: theorem tot_zero : tot (0 : PowerSeries (Alg.Op M)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro y
  simp [tot, Alg.gsum]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tot_neg
statement: theorem tot_neg (F : PowerSeries (Alg.Op M)) : tot (-F) = -tot F
proof:
:= by
  have h := tot_add (-F) F
  rw [neg_add_cancel, tot_zero] at h
  exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h.symm

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tot_one
statement: theorem tot_one : tot (1 : PowerSeries (Alg.Op M)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro y
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, tot_lof,
    Finset.sum_eq_single 0 (fun b _ hb ↦ by simp [PowerSeries.coeff_one, hb]) (by simp)]
  simp

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.sum_antidiagonal_range
statement:
theorem sum_antidiagonal_range {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A] (g : ℕ → ℕ → A) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ∑ pq ∈ Finset.antidiagonal m, g pq.1 pq.2 =
      ∑ q ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ∑ p ∈ Finset.range (n - q + 1), g p q
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∀ m, ∑ pq ∈ Finset.antidiagonal m, g pq.1 pq.2 =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), g (m - k) k := by
    intro m
    rw [← Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_swap]
    simp only [Prod.fst_swap, Prod.snd_swap]
    rw [Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ (fun a b ↦ g b a)]
  simp_rw [h1]
  rw [Finset.sum_range_diag_flip (n + 1) (fun j i ↦ g i j)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi ↦ ?_
  have : n + 1 - i = n - i + 1 := by
    have := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
    omega
  rw [this]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tot_mul
statement:
theorem tot_mul {F H : PowerSeries (Alg.Op M)} (hF : GSer (lowFam M) F)
    (hH : GSer (lowFam M) H) : tot (F * H) = tot F * tot H
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro y
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, tot_lof, tot_lof,
    map_sum]
  have step : ∀ q ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      tot F (PowerSeries.coeff q H (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M n y)) =
        ∑ p ∈ Finset.range (n - q + 1),
          (PowerSeries.coeff p F * PowerSeries.coeff q H) (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M n y) := by
    intro q hq
    have hq' : q ≤ n := by
      have := Finset.mem_range.mp hq
      omega
    have hv := low_lof_ge (hH q) hq' y
    set w := PowerSeries.coeff q H (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M n y) (n - q) with hw
    calc tot F (PowerSeries.coeff q H (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M n y))
        = tot F (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M (n - q) w) := congrArg (tot F) hv
      _ = ∑ p ∈ Finset.range (n - q + 1),
            PowerSeries.coeff p F (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M (n - q) w) :=
          tot_lof_stable hF (by omega) w
      _ = _ := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ ↦ ?_
          rw [Module.End.mul_apply, ← hv]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl step]
  have hc : ∀ m, PowerSeries.coeff m (F * H) (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M n y) =
      ∑ pq ∈ Finset.antidiagonal m,
        (PowerSeries.coeff pq.1 F * PowerSeries.coeff pq.2 H) (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M n y) := by
    intro m
    rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  simp only [hc]
  rw [sum_antidiagonal_range (fun p q ↦
    (PowerSeries.coeff p F * PowerSeries.coeff q H) (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M n y)) n]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.tot_pow
statement:
theorem tot_pow {F : PowerSeries (Alg.Op M)} (hF : GSer (lowFam M) F) (j : ℕ) :
    tot (F ^ j) = tot F ^ j
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, pow_zero, tot_one]
  | succ j ih => rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, tot_mul (hF.pow j) hF, ih]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.coeff_expSer
statement:
theorem coeff_expSer (L : PowerSeries R) (m : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff m (expSer L) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (1 / (j.factorial : ℚ)) • PowerSeries.coeff m (L ^ j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [expSer, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.coeff_pow_lt
statement:
theorem coeff_pow_lt (L : PowerSeries R) (hL : PowerSeries.constantCoeff L = 0) {m j : ℕ}
    (h : m < j) : PowerSeries.coeff m (L ^ j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction j generalizing m with
  | zero => omega
  | succ j ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun pq hpq ↦ ?_
    have hs := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hpq
    by_cases hp : pq.1 < j
    · rw [ih hp, zero_mul]
    · have : pq.2 = 0 := by omega
      rw [this, PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, hL, mul_zero]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.GSer.expSer
statement:
theorem GSer.expSer {𝒢 : GradedFam R} {L : PowerSeries R} (hL : GSer 𝒢 L) :
    GSer 𝒢 (expSer L)
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  rw [coeff_expSer]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j _ ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ((hL.pow j) m)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.constantCoeff_expSer
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_expSer (L : PowerSeries R) :
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff (expSer L) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, coeff_expSer]
  simp

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.gexp_tot
statement:
theorem gexp_tot {L : PowerSeries (Alg.Op M)} (hL : GSer (lowFam M) L)
    (h0 : PowerSeries.constantCoeff L = 0) : Alg.gexp (tot L) = tot (expSer L)
proof:
:= by
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro y
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, Alg.gexp_lof, tot_lof]
  simp only [LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, coeff_expSer]
  have e1 : ∀ j, (tot L ^ j) (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M n y) =
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        ((PowerSeries.coeff m (L ^ j) : Alg.Op M) (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ M n y)) := by
    intro j
    rw [← tot_pow hL j, tot_lof]
  simp only [e1, one_div, Finset.smul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m hm ↦ ?_
  have hm' := Finset.mem_range.mp hm
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_subset
  · intro j hj
    simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hj ⊢
    omega
  · intro j hjn hjm
    simp only [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hjn hjm
    rw [coeff_pow_lt L h0 (by omega)]
    simp

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.expSer_neg_mul
statement:
theorem expSer_neg_mul {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra ℚ R] (L : PowerSeries R)
    (h0 : PowerSeries.constantCoeff L = 0)
    (hc : ∀ i j, PowerSeries.coeff i L * PowerSeries.coeff j L =
      PowerSeries.coeff j L * PowerSeries.coeff i L) :
    expSer (-L) * expSer L = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, _, _, φ, hinj, hl⟩ := exists_comm_lift (Set.range fun i ↦ PowerSeries.coeff i L)
    (by rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩ _ ⟨j, rfl⟩; exact hc i j)
  choose a ha using fun i ↦ hl (PowerSeries.coeff i L) ⟨i, rfl⟩
  set La : PowerSeries K := PowerSeries.mk a with hLa
  have hmap : PowerSeries.map (φ : K →+* R) La = L := by
    ext i
    simp [hLa, ha]
  have hLa0 : PowerSeries.constantCoeff La = 0 := by
    apply hinj
    rw [← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, hLa, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, ha, map_zero,
      PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, h0]
  have hneg0 : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (-La) = 0 := by simp [hLa0]
  have hexp : ∀ F : PowerSeries K, PowerSeries.constantCoeff F = 0 →
      expSer F = (PowerSeries.exp K).subst F := by
    intro F hF
    ext m
    rw [coeff_expSer, coeff_exp_subst F hF]
  have hK : expSer (-La) * expSer La = 1 := by
    rw [hexp _ hneg0, hexp _ hLa0, ← exp_subst_add _ _ hneg0 hLa0, neg_add_cancel]
    have h00 : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (0 : PowerSeries K) = 0 := by simp
    ext m
    rw [coeff_exp_subst 0 h00, PowerSeries.coeff_one,
      Finset.sum_eq_single 0 (fun b _ hb ↦ by simp [zero_pow hb]) (by simp)]
    simp
  have hE : ∀ F : PowerSeries K, expSer (PowerSeries.map (φ : K →+* R) F) =
      PowerSeries.map (φ : K →+* R) (expSer F) := by
    intro F
    ext m
    rw [coeff_expSer, PowerSeries.coeff_map, coeff_expSer, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
    rw [← map_pow, PowerSeries.coeff_map]
    simp
  have e1 : expSer (-L) = PowerSeries.map (φ : K →+* R) (expSer (-La)) := by
    rw [← hE, map_neg, hmap]
  have e2 : expSer L = PowerSeries.map (φ : K →+* R) (expSer La) := by
    rw [← hE, hmap]
  rw [e1, e2, ← map_mul, hK, map_one]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.constantCoeff_tlSeries
statement: theorem constantCoeff_tlSeries : constantCoeff tlSeries = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, tlSeries, coeff_mk]; simp [toddLogCoeff]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.hasSubst_tlSeries
statement: theorem hasSubst_tlSeries : HasSubst tlSeries
proof:
:=
  HasSubst.of_constantCoeff_zero' constantCoeff_tlSeries

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.X_mul_derivative_tl
statement:
theorem X_mul_derivative_tl :
    PowerSeries.X * d⁄dX ℚ tlSeries = 1 - bernoulliPowerSeries ℚ
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rcases n with _ | n
  · simp [bernoulliPowerSeries]
  · rw [coeff_succ_X_mul, coeff_derivative, tlSeries, coeff_mk, map_sub, coeff_one,
      bernoulliPowerSeries, coeff_mk]
    simp only [toddLogCoeff, Nat.succ_ne_zero, if_false, Algebra.algebraMap_self,
      RingHom.id_apply, zero_sub, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul]
    push_cast
    field_simp

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.derivative_bernoulli_tl
statement:
theorem derivative_bernoulli_tl :
    d⁄dX ℚ (bernoulli'PowerSeries ℚ) =
      d⁄dX ℚ tlSeries * bernoulli'PowerSeries ℚ
proof:
:= by
  set T := bernoulli'PowerSeries ℚ
  set e := PowerSeries.exp ℚ
  set B := bernoulliPowerSeries ℚ
  set dL := d⁄dX ℚ tlSeries
  have h1 : T * (e - 1) = PowerSeries.X * e := bernoulli'PowerSeries_mul_exp_sub_one ℚ
  have h2 : d⁄dX ℚ T * (e - 1) + T * e = e + PowerSeries.X * e := by
    have := congrArg (d⁄dX ℚ) h1
    rw [Derivation.leibniz, Derivation.leibniz, map_sub, Derivation.map_one_eq_zero,
      derivative_exp, derivative_X, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul,
      smul_eq_mul] at this
    linear_combination this
  have h3 : PowerSeries.X * dL = 1 - B := X_mul_derivative_tl
  have h4 : B * (e - 1) = PowerSeries.X := bernoulliPowerSeries_mul_exp_sub_one ℚ
  have hX : (PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries ℚ) ≠ 0 := X_ne_zero
  have he : e - 1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg (coeff 1) h
    simp [e, coeff_exp] at this
  have key : (PowerSeries.X * (e - 1)) * (d⁄dX ℚ T - dL * T) = 0 := by
    linear_combination
      PowerSeries.X * h2 - (e - 1) * T * h3 + T * h4 - (1 + PowerSeries.X) * h1
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp key with h | h
  · exact absurd h (mul_ne_zero hX he)
  · exact sub_eq_zero.mp h

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.exp_subst_tl
statement:
theorem exp_subst_tl :
    (PowerSeries.exp ℚ).subst tlSeries = bernoulli'PowerSeries ℚ
proof:
:= by
  set E := (PowerSeries.exp ℚ).subst tlSeries
  set T := bernoulli'PowerSeries ℚ
  set dL := d⁄dX ℚ tlSeries
  have hdE : d⁄dX ℚ E = E * dL := by
    rw [derivative_subst ℚ hasSubst_tlSeries, derivative_exp]
  have hT0 : constantCoeff T = 1 := by
    simp [T, bernoulli'PowerSeries, ← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply]
  have hE0 : constantCoeff E = 1 := by
    exact constantCoeff_exp_subst _ constantCoeff_tlSeries
  have hTT : T * T⁻¹ = 1 := PowerSeries.mul_inv_cancel T (by rw [hT0]; exact one_ne_zero)
  have hF : E * T⁻¹ = 1 := by
    apply derivative.ext
    · rw [Derivation.leibniz, derivative_inv', derivative_bernoulli_tl, hdE,
        Derivation.map_one_eq_zero, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
      linear_combination (-(E * dL * T⁻¹)) * hTT
    · rw [map_mul, hE0, constantCoeff_inv, hT0, map_one]; norm_num
  calc E = E * T⁻¹ * T := by rw [mul_assoc, mul_comm T⁻¹, hTT, mul_one]
    _ = T := by rw [hF, one_mul]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.exp_subst_tl'
statement: theorem exp_subst_tl' : (PowerSeries.exp ℚ).subst tlSeries = CharacteristicClasses.toddLine ℚ
proof:
:=
  exp_subst_tl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.logCoeff_todd
statement:
theorem logCoeff_todd (m : ℕ) :
    Alg.logCoeff (fun j ↦ PowerSeries.coeff j (CharacteristicClasses.toddLine ℚ)) m =
      toddLogCoeff m
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ m ih =>
    cases m with
    | zero => simp [Alg.logCoeff, toddLogCoeff]
    | succ m =>
      set q : ℕ → ℚ := fun j ↦ PowerSeries.coeff j (CharacteristicClasses.toddLine ℚ) with hq
      have hq0 : q 0 = 1 := by
        simp [hq, CharacteristicClasses.toddLine, bernoulli'PowerSeries]
      have hI : (((m : ℚ) + 1)) * q (m + 1) =
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (((j : ℚ) + 1) * toddLogCoeff (j + 1)) * q (m - j) := by
        have h := congrArg (PowerSeries.coeff m) (derivative_bernoulli_tl)
        rw [PowerSeries.coeff_derivative, PowerSeries.coeff_mul,
          Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk] at h
        have h' : q (m + 1) * ((m : ℚ) + 1) = _ := h
        rw [mul_comm, h']
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
        rw [PowerSeries.coeff_derivative, tlSeries, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
        simp only [hq, CharacteristicClasses.toddLine]
        ring
      rw [Alg.logCoeff]
      have hs : ∑ j : Fin m, (((j : ℕ) : ℚ) + 1) *
            Alg.logCoeff q ((j : ℕ) + 1) * q (m - (j : ℕ)) =
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, (((j : ℕ) : ℚ) + 1) * toddLogCoeff (j + 1) * q (m - j) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_range (fun j ↦ (((j : ℕ) : ℚ) + 1) * toddLogCoeff (j + 1) * q (m - j))]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
        rw [ih ((j : ℕ) + 1) (by have := j.isLt; omega)]
      rw [hs]
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Nat.sub_self, hq0, mul_one] at hI
      have hm1 : ((m : ℚ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp
      linarith

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.ChernData.dual
statement:
theorem ChernData.dual (h : ChernData c) : ChernData (Alg.dualChern c) where
  zero
proof:
:= by simp [Alg.dualChern, h.zero]
  low := fun i ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (h.low i)
  comm := fun i j ↦ by
    simp only [Alg.dualChern, smul_mul_smul_comm, h.comm i j, mul_comm ((-1 : ℚ) ^ i)]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.ChernData.psum_eq
statement: theorem ChernData.psum_eq (h : ChernData c) (m : ℕ) : Alg.powerSum c m = psumG c m
proof:
:=
  GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.powerSum_eq_psumG c h.zero h.comm m

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.ChernData.gser_tlSer
statement: theorem ChernData.gser_tlSer (h : ChernData c) : GSer (lowFam M) (tlSer c)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  rw [tlSer, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (psumG_mem (𝒢 := lowFam M) h.low n)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.constantCoeff_tlSer
statement: theorem constantCoeff_tlSer (c : ℕ → Alg.Op M) : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (tlSer c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, tlSer, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
  simp [toddLogCoeff, psumG]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.ChernData.comm_tlSer
statement:
theorem ChernData.comm_tlSer (h : ChernData c) (i j : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff i (tlSer c) * PowerSeries.coeff j (tlSer c) =
      PowerSeries.coeff j (tlSer c) * PowerSeries.coeff i (tlSer c)
proof:
:= by
  have hT : ∀ n, ∀ l, c l * psumG c n = psumG c n * c l := fun n l ↦
    psumG_commute c (c l) (fun i ↦ h.comm l i) n
  have hP : ∀ m n, psumG c m * psumG c n = psumG c n * psumG c m := fun m n ↦
    psumG_commute c (psumG c m) (fun i ↦ (hT m i).symm) n
  simp only [tlSer, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, smul_mul_smul, hP i j, mul_comm (toddLogCoeff i)]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.expSer_tlSer
statement: theorem expSer_tlSer (c : ℕ → Alg.Op M) : expSer (tlSer c) = PowerSeries.mk (tdG c)
proof:
:= by
  refine PowerSeries.ext fun m ↦ ?_
  rw [coeff_expSer, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
  rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.ChernData.logTd_eq_tot
statement: theorem ChernData.logTd_eq_tot (h : ChernData c) : Alg.logTd c = tot (tlSer c)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Alg.logTd tot
  congr 1
  funext m
  rw [tlSer, PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
  by_cases hm : m = 0
  · subst hm
    simp [toddLogCoeff]
  · rw [if_neg hm, logCoeff_todd, h.psum_eq]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.ChernData.tdFromChern_eq_tot
statement:
theorem ChernData.tdFromChern_eq_tot (h : ChernData c) :
    Alg.tdFromChern c = tot (PowerSeries.mk (tdG c))
proof:
:= by
  unfold Alg.tdFromChern
  rw [h.logTd_eq_tot, gexp_tot h.gser_tlSer (constantCoeff_tlSer c), expSer_tlSer]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.constantCoeff_tdSer
statement:
theorem constantCoeff_tdSer (c : ℕ → Alg.Op M) :
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff (PowerSeries.mk (tdG c)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← expSer_tlSer, constantCoeff_expSer]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.ChernData.gser_tdSer
statement: theorem ChernData.gser_tdSer (h : ChernData c) : GSer (lowFam M) (PowerSeries.mk (tdG c))
proof:
:=
  gSer_mk fun i ↦ tdG_mem (𝒢 := lowFam M) h.low i

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.ChernData.gser_tdInvSer
statement:
theorem ChernData.gser_tdInvSer (h : ChernData c) :
    GSer (lowFam M) (PowerSeries.invOfUnit (PowerSeries.mk (tdG c)) 1)
proof:
:=
  GSer.inv fun i ↦ tdG_mem (𝒢 := lowFam M) h.low i

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.ChernData.tot_td_mul_inv
statement:
theorem ChernData.tot_td_mul_inv (h : ChernData c) :
    tot (PowerSeries.mk (tdG c)) * tot (PowerSeries.invOfUnit (PowerSeries.mk (tdG c)) 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hC : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (PowerSeries.mk (tdG c)) =
      ((1 : (Alg.Op M)ˣ) : Alg.Op M) := by
    simpa using constantCoeff_tdSer c
  rw [← tot_mul h.gser_tdSer h.gser_tdInvSer, PowerSeries.mul_invOfUnit _ 1 hC, tot_one]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.ChernData.tot_inv_mul_td
statement:
theorem ChernData.tot_inv_mul_td (h : ChernData c) :
    tot (PowerSeries.invOfUnit (PowerSeries.mk (tdG c)) 1) * tot (PowerSeries.mk (tdG c)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hC : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (PowerSeries.mk (tdG c)) =
      ((1 : (Alg.Op M)ˣ) : Alg.Op M) := by
    simpa using constantCoeff_tdSer c
  rw [← tot_mul h.gser_tdInvSer h.gser_tdSer, PowerSeries.invOfUnit_mul _ 1 hC, tot_one]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.ChernData.tdInvFromChern_eq_tot
statement:
theorem ChernData.tdInvFromChern_eq_tot (h : ChernData c) :
    Alg.tdInvFromChern c = tot (PowerSeries.invOfUnit (PowerSeries.mk (tdG c)) 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hneg : GSer (lowFam M) (-tlSer c) := by
    intro n
    rw [map_neg]
    exact Submodule.neg_mem _ (h.gser_tlSer n)
  have hinv : expSer (-tlSer c) = PowerSeries.invOfUnit (PowerSeries.mk (tdG c)) 1 := by
    have h1 : expSer (-tlSer c) * PowerSeries.mk (tdG c) = 1 := by
      rw [← expSer_tlSer]
      exact expSer_neg_mul _ (constantCoeff_tlSer c) h.comm_tlSer
    have hC : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (PowerSeries.mk (tdG c)) = ((1 : (Alg.Op M)ˣ) : Alg.Op M) := by
      simpa using constantCoeff_tdSer c
    have h2 := PowerSeries.mul_invOfUnit (PowerSeries.mk (tdG c)) 1 hC
    calc expSer (-tlSer c) = expSer (-tlSer c) *
          (PowerSeries.mk (tdG c) * PowerSeries.invOfUnit (PowerSeries.mk (tdG c)) 1) := by
            rw [h2, mul_one]
      _ = _ := by rw [← mul_assoc, h1, one_mul]
  unfold Alg.tdInvFromChern
  rw [h.logTd_eq_tot, ← tot_neg, gexp_tot hneg (by simp [constantCoeff_tlSer]), hinv]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.ChernData.chFromChern_eq_tot
statement:
theorem ChernData.chFromChern_eq_tot (h : ChernData c) (r : ℕ) :
    Alg.chFromChern r c = tot (PowerSeries.mk (chG r c))
proof:
:= by
  unfold Alg.chFromChern tot
  have e : (fun n ↦ PowerSeries.coeff n (PowerSeries.mk (chG r c))) =
      (fun m ↦ if m = 0 then (r : ℚ) • (1 : Alg.Op M) else 0) +
      (fun m ↦ if m = 0 then (0 : Alg.Op M) else
        (PowerSeries.coeff m (CharacteristicClasses.chLine ℚ)) • Alg.powerSum c m) := by
    funext m
    cases m with
    | zero => simp [chG]
    | succ m =>
      simp only [PowerSeries.coeff_mk, chG, Pi.add_apply, Nat.succ_ne_zero, if_false, zero_add,
        h.psum_eq, CharacteristicClasses.chLine, PowerSeries.coeff_exp]
      simp
  rw [e, GRRBlueprintV4.CHEXACT.gsum_add]
  congr 1
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro y
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  rw [Alg.gsum_lof, LinearMap.sum_apply,
    Finset.sum_eq_single 0 (fun b _ hb ↦ by simp [hb]) (by simp)]
  simp

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.evSer_mul
statement:
theorem evSer_mul (x : R) (f g : PowerSeries ℚ) :
    evSer x (f * g) = evSer x f * evSer x g
proof:
:= by
  refine PowerSeries.ext fun n ↦ ?_
  simp only [evSer, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_mul, Finset.sum_smul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp ↦ ?_
  rw [Finset.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
  rw [smul_mul_smul_comm, ← pow_add, hp]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.evSer_one
statement: theorem evSer_one (x : R) : evSer x 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine PowerSeries.ext fun n ↦ ?_
  simp only [evSer, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_one]
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · subst hn; simp
  · simp [hn]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.X_mul_tdInvLine
statement:
theorem X_mul_tdInvLine :
    PowerSeries.X * tdInvLine = 1 - PowerSeries.evalNegHom (PowerSeries.exp ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  refine PowerSeries.ext fun n ↦ ?_
  rcases n with _ | n
  · rw [PowerSeries.coeff_zero_X_mul, map_sub, PowerSeries.coeff_one, if_pos rfl]
    simp [PowerSeries.evalNegHom, PowerSeries.coeff_rescale, PowerSeries.coeff_exp]
  · rw [PowerSeries.coeff_succ_X_mul, tdInvLine, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, map_sub,
      PowerSeries.coeff_one, if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)]
    simp [PowerSeries.evalNegHom, PowerSeries.coeff_exp, pow_succ, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.toddLine_mul_tdInvLine
statement: theorem toddLine_mul_tdInvLine : CharacteristicClasses.toddLine ℚ * tdInvLine = 1
proof:
:= by
  set T := CharacteristicClasses.toddLine ℚ with hT
  set e := PowerSeries.exp ℚ
  set En := PowerSeries.evalNegHom e
  have h1 : T * (e - 1) = PowerSeries.X * e := bernoulli'PowerSeries_mul_exp_sub_one ℚ
  have h2 : e * En = 1 := PowerSeries.exp_mul_exp_neg_eq_one
  have h3 := X_mul_tdInvLine
  have key : PowerSeries.X * (T * tdInvLine) = PowerSeries.X * 1 := by
    calc PowerSeries.X * (T * tdInvLine) = T * (PowerSeries.X * tdInvLine) := by ring
      _ = T * (1 - En) := by rw [h3]
      _ = (T * (e - 1)) * En := by linear_combination (-T) * h2
      _ = PowerSeries.X * 1 := by rw [h1]; linear_combination PowerSeries.X * h2
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ PowerSeries.X_ne_zero key

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOT.invOfUnit_evSer
statement:
theorem invOfUnit_evSer (x : R) (f g : PowerSeries ℚ) (hf0 : PowerSeries.constantCoeff f = 1)
    (hfg : f * g = 1) :
    PowerSeries.invOfUnit (evSer x f) 1 = evSer x g
proof:
:= by
  have h1' : evSer x g * evSer x f = 1 := by
    rw [← evSer_mul, mul_comm, hfg, evSer_one]
  have hC : PowerSeries.constantCoeff (evSer x f) = ((1 : Rˣ) : R) := by
    rw [← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, evSer, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, pow_zero,
      PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, hf0]
    simp
  have h2 := PowerSeries.mul_invOfUnit (evSer x f) 1 hC
  calc PowerSeries.invOfUnit (evSer x f) 1
      = (evSer x g * evSer x f) * PowerSeries.invOfUnit (evSer x f) 1 := by rw [h1', one_mul]
    _ = evSer x g := by rw [mul_assoc, h2, mul_one]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap_comp
statement:
theorem gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap_comp
    (φ : M →ₗ[R] N) (ψ : N →ₗ[S] P) :
    (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap
        (R := S) (S := T) (M := N) (N := P) ψ).comp
        (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap
          (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N) φ) =
      gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap
        (R := R) (S := T) (M := M) (N := P)
        (ψ.restrictScalars R ∘ₗ φ)
proof:
:= by
  apply GradedRingHom.ext
  intro x
  change
    symmetricAlgebraMap
        (R := S) (S := T) (M := N) (N := P) ψ
        (symmetricAlgebraMap
          (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N) φ x) =
      symmetricAlgebraMap
        (R := R) (S := T) (M := M) (N := P)
        (ψ.restrictScalars R ∘ₗ φ) x
  let F : SymmetricAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] SymmetricAlgebra T P :=
    { toRingHom :=
        (symmetricAlgebraMap
          (R := S) (S := T) (M := N) (N := P) ψ).comp
          (symmetricAlgebraMap
            (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N) φ)
      commutes' := by
        intro r
        change
          symmetricAlgebraMap
              (R := S) (S := T) (M := N) (N := P) ψ
              (symmetricAlgebraMap
                (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N) φ
                (algebraMap R (SymmetricAlgebra R M) r)) =
            algebraMap R (SymmetricAlgebra T P) r
        calc
          symmetricAlgebraMap
                (R := S) (S := T) (M := N) (N := P) ψ
                (symmetricAlgebraMap
                  (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N) φ
                  (algebraMap R (SymmetricAlgebra R M) r)) =
              symmetricAlgebraMap
                (R := S) (S := T) (M := N) (N := P) ψ
                (algebraMap S (SymmetricAlgebra S N)
                  (algebraMap R S r)) :=
            congrArg
              (symmetricAlgebraMap
                (R := S) (S := T) (M := N) (N := P) ψ)
              (symmetricAlgebraMap_algebraMap
                (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N) φ r)
          _ = algebraMap T (SymmetricAlgebra T P)
                (algebraMap S T (algebraMap R S r)) :=
            symmetricAlgebraMap_algebraMap
              (R := S) (S := T) (M := N) (N := P) ψ
              (algebraMap R S r)
          _ = algebraMap T (SymmetricAlgebra T P)
                (algebraMap R T r) :=
            congrArg
              (algebraMap T (SymmetricAlgebra T P))
              (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R S T r).symm
          _ = algebraMap R (SymmetricAlgebra T P) r := rfl }
  let G : SymmetricAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] SymmetricAlgebra T P :=
    { toRingHom :=
        symmetricAlgebraMap
          (R := R) (S := T) (M := M) (N := P)
          (ψ.restrictScalars R ∘ₗ φ)
      commutes' := by
        intro r
        exact symmetricAlgebraMap_algebraMap
          (R := R) (S := T) (M := M) (N := P)
          (ψ.restrictScalars R ∘ₗ φ) r }
  have hFG : F = G := by
    apply SymmetricAlgebra.algHom_ext
    ext m
    simp [F, G]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hFG x

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.symmetricProjMap_comp
statement:
theorem symmetricProjMap_comp
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [Module.Free T P] [Module.Finite T P]
    (φ : M →ₗ[R] N) (ψ : N →ₗ[S] P)
    (hφ : Submodule.span S (Set.range φ) = ⊤)
    (hψ : Submodule.span T (Set.range ψ) = ⊤)
    (hcomp :
      Submodule.span T
        (Set.range (ψ.restrictScalars R ∘ₗ φ)) = ⊤) :
    symmetricProjMap ψ hψ ≫ symmetricProjMap φ hφ =
      symmetricProjMap (ψ.restrictScalars R ∘ₗ φ) hcomp
proof:
:= by
  unfold symmetricProjMap
  calc
    AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map
          (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap ψ)
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap ψ hψ) ≫
        AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map
          (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ)
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ hφ) =
      AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map
        ((gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap ψ).comp
          (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ))
        (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ hφ)
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap ψ hψ)) := by
      exact (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map_comp
        (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ)
        (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap ψ)
        (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ hφ)
        (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap ψ hψ)).symm
    _ = AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map
          (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap
            (ψ.restrictScalars R ∘ₗ φ))
          (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap
            (ψ.restrictScalars R ∘ₗ φ) hcomp) := by
      let Q := { f : symGrading R M →+*ᵍ symGrading T P //
        HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (symGrading T P) ≤
          (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (symGrading R M)).map f }
      let p : Q :=
        ⟨(gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap ψ).comp
            (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ),
          HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp
            (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap φ hφ)
            (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap ψ hψ)⟩
      let q : Q :=
        ⟨gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap
            (ψ.restrictScalars R ∘ₗ φ),
          irrelevant_le_map_gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap
            (ψ.restrictScalars R ∘ₗ φ) hcomp⟩
      have hpq : p = q := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap_comp
          (R := R) (S := S) (T := T)
          (M := M) (N := N) (P := P) φ ψ
      exact congrArg
        (fun t : Q ↦ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map t.1 t.2) hpq

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.symmetricProjMap_congr
statement:
theorem symmetricProjMap_congr
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [Module.Free T P] [Module.Finite T P]
    {φ ψ : M →ₗ[R] P} (h : φ = ψ)
    (hφ : Submodule.span T (Set.range φ) = ⊤)
    (hψ : Submodule.span T (Set.range ψ) = ⊤) :
    symmetricProjMap φ hφ = symmetricProjMap ψ hψ
proof:
:= by
  subst ψ

statement:
theorem semilinearMap_heq_of_ringHom_eq
    {f g : R →+* S} (hfg : f = g)
    (φ : M →ₛₗ[f] N) (ψ : M →ₛₗ[g] N)
    (hval : ∀ m, φ m = ψ m) :
    HEq φ ψ
proof:
:= by
  subst g
  apply heq_of_eq
  ext m
  exact hval m

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.semilinearSymmetricProjMap_congr
statement:
theorem semilinearSymmetricProjMap_congr
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    {f g : R →+* S} (hfg : f = g)
    (φ : M →ₛₗ[f] N) (ψ : M →ₛₗ[g] N)
    (hφψ : HEq φ ψ)
    (hφ : Submodule.span S (Set.range φ) = ⊤)
    (hψ : Submodule.span S (Set.range ψ) = ⊤) :
    semilinearSymmetricProjMap f φ hφ =
      semilinearSymmetricProjMap g ψ hψ
proof:
:= by
  subst g
  have hmap : φ = ψ := eq_of_heq hφψ
  subst ψ
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.semilinearSymmetricProjMap_comp
statement:
theorem semilinearSymmetricProjMap_comp
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [Module.Free T P] [Module.Finite T P]
    (f : R →+* S) (g : S →+* T)
    (φ : M →ₛₗ[f] N) (ψ : N →ₛₗ[g] P)
    (hφ : Submodule.span S (Set.range φ) = ⊤)
    (hψ : Submodule.span T (Set.range ψ) = ⊤)
    (hcomp :
      Submodule.span T
        (Set.range
          (semilinearMapComp f g φ ψ)) = ⊤) :
    semilinearSymmetricProjMap g ψ hψ ≫
        semilinearSymmetricProjMap f φ hφ =
      semilinearSymmetricProjMap (g.comp f)
        (semilinearMapComp f g φ ψ) hcomp
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra R S := f.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra S T := g.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra R T := (g.comp f).toAlgebra
  letI : IsScalarTower R S T :=
    ⟨fun r s t ↦ by
      change g (f r * s) * t = g (f r) * (g s * t)
      rw [map_mul, mul_assoc]⟩
  letI : Module R N := Module.compHom N f
  letI : IsScalarTower R S N :=
    ⟨fun r s n ↦ by
      change (f r * s) • n = f r • s • n
      rw [mul_smul]⟩
  letI : Module S P := Module.compHom P g
  letI : IsScalarTower S T P :=
    ⟨fun s t p ↦ by
      change (g s * t) • p = g s • t • p
      rw [mul_smul]⟩
  letI : Module R P := Module.compHom P (g.comp f)
  letI : IsScalarTower R T P :=
    ⟨fun r t p ↦ by
      change (g (f r) * t) • p = g (f r) • t • p
      rw [mul_smul]⟩
  letI : IsScalarTower R S P :=
    ⟨fun r s p ↦ by
      change g (f r * s) • p = g (f r) • g s • p
      rw [map_mul, mul_smul]⟩
  let φlin := semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap f φ
  let ψlin := semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap g ψ
  let complin : M →ₗ[R] P := ψlin.restrictScalars R ∘ₗ φlin
  let directlin : M →ₗ[R] P :=
    semilinearToRestrictionLinearMap (g.comp f)
      (semilinearMapComp f g φ ψ)
  have hlin : complin = directlin := by
    ext m
    change ψ (φ m) = ψ (φ m)
    rfl
  have hcompLin :
      Submodule.span T (Set.range complin) = ⊤ := by
    rw [hlin]
    change Submodule.span T
      (Set.range (semilinearMapComp f g φ ψ)) = ⊤
    exact hcomp
  change
    symmetricProjMap ψlin hψ ≫ symmetricProjMap φlin hφ =
      symmetricProjMap directlin hcomp
  calc
    symmetricProjMap ψlin hψ ≫ symmetricProjMap φlin hφ =
        symmetricProjMap complin hcompLin := by
      exact symmetricProjMap_comp
        (R := R) (S := S) (T := T)
        (M := M) (N := N) (P := P)
        φlin ψlin hφ hψ hcompLin
    _ = symmetricProjMap directlin hcomp :=
      symmetricProjMap_congr
        (R := R) (T := T) (M := M) (P := P)
        hlin hcompLin hcomp

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transportTwistRecoveryAssembly_left
statement:
theorem transportTwistRecoveryAssembly_left (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') (i j : C'.I) :
    let D
proof:
:= C'.twistingSheafDescentData 1 (C'.canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1)
    let Dn := (transport e C').twistingSheafDescentData 1
      ((transport e C').canonicalTwistTransitionSystem 1)
    transportTwistPulledRecoveryAlong e C' i (Dn.left (i,j)) ≫
      (twistOverlapSourceTransportIso e C' i j).hom =
    (transportTwistOverlapLeftAmbientIso e C' i j).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (overlapIso e C' i j).hom).map
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackRecoveryAlong D i (D.left (i,j))) := by
  have h := transportTwistPullbackChartIso_left_recovery_square e C' i j
  dsimp only [transportTwistPulledRecoveryAlong, Scheme.Modules.pullbackRecoveryAlong,
    canonicalTwistPullbackRecovery, transportTwistOverlapLeftAmbientIso,
    canonicalTwistingSheaf, twistingSheafOfTransitions] at h ⊢
  simp only [twistRecoveryAssembly_left_field, twistRecoveryAssembly_ambient_field] at h ⊢
  dsimp only [twistRecoveryAssembly_chart_field, twistRecoveryAssembly_overlap_field,
    twistRecoveryAssembly_module_field] at h ⊢
  simp only [Category.assoc] at h ⊢
  exact h

statement:

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientFreeCoherence_free_comp
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotientFreeCoherence_free_comp
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (I : Type u) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f g).hom.app (SheafOfModules.free (R := Z.ringCatSheaf) I) ≫
      (pullbackFreeIso (f ≫ g) I).hom =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map (pullbackFreeIso g I).hom ≫ (pullbackFreeIso f I).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi ((pullbackFreeIso f I).inv ≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map (pullbackFreeIso g I).inv)).1
  simp only [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp_assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id]
  erw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
  simp only [Category.id_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id]
  apply Sigma.hom_ext
  intro i
  change SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i ≫
    (pullbackFreeIso f I).inv ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map (pullbackFreeIso g I).inv ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f g).hom.app (SheafOfModules.free (R := Z.ringCatSheaf) I) ≫
          (pullbackFreeIso (f ≫ g) I).hom = SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i
  rw [← Category.assoc, SchemeKTheory.ιFree_comp_pullbackObjFreeIso_inv]
  rw [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp_assoc, SchemeKTheory.ιFree_comp_pullbackObjFreeIso_inv]
  simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  erw [(Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f g).hom.naturality_assoc]
  rw [SchemeKTheory.pullback_map_ιFree_comp_pullbackFreeIso_hom]
  change (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso f).inv ≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso g).inv ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f g).hom.app (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Z) ≫
        (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso (f ≫ g)).hom ≫
          SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i = _
  have hu := congrArg (fun z => z ≫ SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i)
    (pullbackObjUnitIso_comp_hom f g)
  simp only [Category.assoc] at hu
  erw [hu]
  simp only [← Functor.map_comp_assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id,
    Category.id_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientFreeCoherence_free_congr
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotientFreeCoherence_free_congr
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f g : X ⟶ Y} (h : f = g) (I : Type u) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr h).hom.app (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) I) ≫
      (pullbackFreeIso g I).hom = (pullbackFreeIso f I).hom
proof:
:= by
  subst g
  simp [Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientFreeCoherence_free_square
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotientFreeCoherence_free_square
    {P Q U V : Scheme.{u}} (q : P ⟶ Q) (p : Q ⟶ V) (r : P ⟶ U) (h : U ⟶ V)
    (comm : q ≫ p = r ≫ h) (I : Type u) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map (pullbackFreeIso p I).hom ≫ (pullbackFreeIso q I).hom =
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp q p ≪≫ Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr comm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp r h).symm).hom.app (SheafOfModules.free (R := V.ringCatSheaf) I) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback r).map (pullbackFreeIso h I).hom ≫ (pullbackFreeIso r I).hom
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, NatTrans.comp_app]
  rw [← pullbackTwistQuotientFreeCoherence_free_comp r h I]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc]
  rw [pullbackTwistQuotientFreeCoherence_free_congr comm I]
  exact (pullbackTwistQuotientFreeCoherence_free_comp q p I).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwistQuotientFreeCoherence_natural_frame_path
statement:
theorem pullbackTwistQuotientFreeCoherence_natural_frame_path
    {A B : Type*} [Category A] [Category B] (F G : A ⥤ B) (N : F ≅ G)
    {M K : A} {Q T : B} (e : M ≅ K) (r : Q ≅ G.obj M)
    (u : F.obj K ≅ T) (v : G.obj K ≅ T)
    (h : u.hom = N.hom.app K ≫ v.hom) :
    F.map e.hom ≫ u.hom ≫ v.inv ≫ G.map e.inv ≫ r.inv = N.hom.app M ≫ r.inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [h]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  erw [N.hom.naturality_assoc]
  rw [← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id]
  erw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
  simp only [Category.id_comp]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackRestriction_congr_square
statement:
theorem pullbackRestriction_congr_square
    {A B : Scheme.{u}} {f g : B ⟶ A}
    [IsOpenImmersion f] [IsOpenImmersion g]
    (h : f = g) (M : A.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr h).hom.app M ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback g).app M).inv =
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback f).app M).inv ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr h).hom.app M
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  simp [Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr, restrictFunctorCongr_refl_hom_app]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackRestrictionCompIso_twistingSheafRestriction_hom_eq'
statement:
theorem pullbackRestrictionCompIso_twistingSheafRestriction_hom_eq'
    {R S T M N P ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [AddCommGroup P] [Module T P] [Module.Free T P] [Module.Finite T P]
    [Finite ι]
    {b : Module.Basis ι R M} {c : Module.Basis ι S N}
    {e : Module.Basis ι T P} {d : ℤ}
    {q : space S N ⟶ space R M} {r : space T P ⟶ space S N}
    [IsOpenImmersion q] [IsOpenImmersion r]
    (Dq : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c d q)
    (Dr : TwistingSheafRestrictionData c e d r) :
    (pullbackRestrictionCompIso (r ≫ q) q r rfl
        (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback r).mapIso Dq.pullbackIso ≪≫
      Dr.pullbackIso).hom =
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (r ≫ q)).app
      (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d)).inv ≫
      (twistingSheafRestrictionCompIso Dq Dr).hom
proof:
:= by
  have h := pullbackRestrictionCompIso_twistingSheafRestriction_hom
    (rfl : r ≫ q = r ≫ q) Dq Dr
  simpa only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.app_hom,
    restrictFunctorCongr_refl_hom_app, Category.id_comp] using h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictFunctorCongr_hom_symm_hom
statement:
theorem restrictFunctorCongr_hom_symm_hom
    {A B : Scheme.{u}} {f g : B ⟶ A}
    [IsOpenImmersion f] [IsOpenImmersion g]
    (h : f = g) (M : A.Modules) :

      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr h.symm).hom.app M = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  simp [restrictFunctorCongr_refl_hom_app]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistingSheafPullbackComp_square_hom_eq
statement:
theorem twistingSheafPullbackComp_square_hom_eq
    {R S T U M N P Q ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T] [CommRing U]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [AddCommGroup P] [Module T P] [Module.Free T P] [Module.Finite T P]
    [AddCommGroup Q] [Module U Q] [Module.Free U Q] [Module.Finite U Q]
    [Finite ι]
    {b : Module.Basis ι R M} {c : Module.Basis ι S N}
    {c' : Module.Basis ι T P} {e : Module.Basis ι U Q} {d : ℤ}
    {q : space S N ⟶ space R M} {r : space U Q ⟶ space S N}
    {q' : space T P ⟶ space R M} {r' : space U Q ⟶ space T P}
    [IsOpenImmersion q] [IsOpenImmersion r]
    [IsOpenImmersion q'] [IsOpenImmersion r']
    (hq : ∀ k, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b k) = linearOpen S N (c k))
    (hr : ∀ k, r ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen S N (c k) = linearOpen U Q (e k))
    (hq' : ∀ k, q' ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b k) = linearOpen T P (c' k))
    (hr' : ∀ k, r' ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen T P (c' k) = linearOpen U Q (e k))
    (h : r ≫ q = r' ≫ q')
    (Dq : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c d q)
    (Dr : TwistingSheafRestrictionData c e d r)
    (Dq' : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c' d q')
    (Dr' : TwistingSheafRestrictionData c' e d r')
    (hDq : Dq.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q hq).hom)
    (hDr : Dr.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso c e r hr).hom)
    (hDq' : Dq'.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c' q' hq').hom)
    (hDr' : Dr'.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso c' e r' hr').hom) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr h).app
        (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d) ≪≫
      pullbackRestrictionCompIso (r' ≫ q') q' r' rfl
        (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback r').mapIso Dq'.pullbackIso ≪≫
      Dr'.pullbackIso).hom =
    (pullbackRestrictionCompIso (r ≫ q) q r rfl
        (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback r).mapIso Dq.pullbackIso ≪≫
      Dr.pullbackIso).hom
proof:
:= by
  let L := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d
  have hSq := twistingSheafRestrictionComp_square_hom_eq
    hq hr hq' hr' h Dq Dr Dq' Dr' hDq hDr hDq' hDr'
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.app_hom] at hSq
  have hForward :
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr h).hom.app L ≫
        (twistingSheafRestrictionCompIso Dq' Dr').hom =
      (twistingSheafRestrictionCompIso Dq Dr).hom := by
    calc
      _ = (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr h).hom.app L ≫
          ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr h.symm).hom.app L ≫
            (twistingSheafRestrictionCompIso Dq Dr).hom) := by rw [hSq]
      _ = ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr h).hom.app L ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr h.symm).hom.app L) ≫
            (twistingSheafRestrictionCompIso Dq Dr).hom := by rw [Category.assoc]
      _ = _ := by rw [restrictFunctorCongr_hom_symm_hom]; simp
  have hP2 :
      (pullbackRestrictionCompIso (r' ≫ q') q' r' rfl L).hom ≫
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback r').mapIso Dq'.pullbackIso).hom ≫
            Dr'.pullbackIso.hom =
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (r' ≫ q')).app L).inv ≫
          (twistingSheafRestrictionCompIso Dq' Dr').hom := by
    simpa only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.app_hom, Category.assoc] using
      pullbackRestrictionCompIso_twistingSheafRestriction_hom_eq' Dq' Dr'
  have hP1 :
      (pullbackRestrictionCompIso (r ≫ q) q r rfl L).hom ≫
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback r).mapIso Dq.pullbackIso).hom ≫
            Dr.pullbackIso.hom =
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (r ≫ q)).app L).inv ≫
          (twistingSheafRestrictionCompIso Dq Dr).hom := by
    simpa only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.app_hom, Category.assoc] using
      pullbackRestrictionCompIso_twistingSheafRestriction_hom_eq' Dq Dr
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.app_hom]
  rw [hP2]
  conv_lhs => rw [← Category.assoc]
  rw [pullbackRestriction_congr_square h L]
  rw [Category.assoc, hForward]
  exact hP1.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.chartTwist_left_pullback_naturality
statement:
theorem chartTwist_left_pullback_naturality
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {E E' : X.Modules} (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') {i j : C'.I}
    (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    [Finite (C'.basisIndex i)]
    [Finite ((transport e C').basisIndex i)] :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr
        (chartIso_leftRestriction e C' c).symm).app
          (C'.chartTwistingSheaf 1 i) ≪≫
      pullbackRestrictionCompIso
        ((c.transport e C').chartToLeft ≫ (chartIso e C' i).hom)
        (chartIso e C' i).hom (c.transport e C').chartToLeft rfl
        (C'.chartTwistingSheaf 1 i) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (c.transport e C').chartToLeft).mapIso
        (chartTwistRestrictionData e C' i).pullbackIso ≪≫
      ((c.transport e C').leftTwistRestrictionData 1).pullbackIso).hom =
    (pullbackRestrictionCompIso
        ((commonChartIso e C' c).hom ≫ c.chartToLeft)
        c.chartToLeft (commonChartIso e C' c).hom rfl
        (C'.chartTwistingSheaf 1 i) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (commonChartIso e C' c).hom).mapIso
        (c.leftTwistRestrictionData 1).pullbackIso ≪≫
      (commonChartLeftTwistRestrictionData e C' c).pullbackIso).hom
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (C'.basisIndex i) := C'.basisIndex_finite i
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C'.U i) (E'.val.obj (op (C'.U i))) :=
    C'.sectionModule_free i
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C'.U i) (E'.val.obj (op (C'.U i))) :=
    C'.sectionModule_finite i
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C'.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C'.U i))) :=
    (transport e C').sectionModule_free i
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C'.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C'.U i))) :=
    (transport e C').sectionModule_finite i
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) := c.sectionModule_free
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) := c.sectionModule_finite
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    (c.transport e C').sectionModule_free
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    (c.transport e C').sectionModule_finite
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (chartIso e C' i).hom := inferInstance
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (commonChartIso e C' c).hom := inferInstance
  letI : IsOpenImmersion c.chartToLeft :=
    CommonBasicOpen.chartToLeft_isOpenImmersion c
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (c.transport e C').chartToLeft :=
    CommonBasicOpen.chartToLeft_isOpenImmersion (c.transport e C')
  apply twistingSheafPullbackComp_square_hom_eq
    c.chartToLeft_preimage_linearOpen
    (fun k ↦ commonChartIso_preimage_leftLinearOpen e C' c k)
    (fun k ↦ chartIso_preimage_linearOpen e C' i k)
    (c.transport e C').chartToLeft_preimage_linearOpen
    (chartIso_leftRestriction e C' c).symm
    (c.leftTwistRestrictionData 1)
    (commonChartLeftTwistRestrictionData e C' c)
    (chartTwistRestrictionData e C' i)
    ((c.transport e C').leftTwistRestrictionData 1)
    (by rfl) (by rfl) (by rfl) (by rfl)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.chartTwist_right_pullback_naturality
statement:
theorem chartTwist_right_pullback_naturality
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {E E' : X.Modules} (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') {i j : C'.I}
    (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j)
    [Finite (C'.basisIndex j)]
    [Finite ((transport e C').basisIndex j)] :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr
        (chartIso_rightRestriction e C' c).symm).app
          (C'.chartTwistingSheaf 1 j) ≪≫
      pullbackRestrictionCompIso
        ((c.transport e C').chartToRight ≫ (chartIso e C' j).hom)
        (chartIso e C' j).hom (c.transport e C').chartToRight rfl
        (C'.chartTwistingSheaf 1 j) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (c.transport e C').chartToRight).mapIso
        (chartTwistRestrictionData e C' j).pullbackIso ≪≫
      ((c.transport e C').rightTwistRestrictionData 1).pullbackIso).hom =
    (pullbackRestrictionCompIso
        ((commonChartIso e C' c).hom ≫ c.chartToRight)
        c.chartToRight (commonChartIso e C' c).hom rfl
        (C'.chartTwistingSheaf 1 j) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (commonChartIso e C' c).hom).mapIso
        (c.rightTwistRestrictionData 1).pullbackIso ≪≫
      (commonChartRightTwistRestrictionData e C' c).pullbackIso).hom
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (C'.basisIndex j) := C'.basisIndex_finite j
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C'.U j) (E'.val.obj (op (C'.U j))) :=
    C'.sectionModule_free j
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C'.U j) (E'.val.obj (op (C'.U j))) :=
    C'.sectionModule_finite j
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C'.U j) (E.val.obj (op (C'.U j))) :=
    (transport e C').sectionModule_free j
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C'.U j) (E.val.obj (op (C'.U j))) :=
    (transport e C').sectionModule_finite j
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) := c.sectionModule_free
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) := c.sectionModule_finite
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    (c.transport e C').sectionModule_free
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    (c.transport e C').sectionModule_finite
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (chartIso e C' j).hom := inferInstance
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (commonChartIso e C' c).hom := inferInstance
  letI : IsOpenImmersion c.chartToRight :=
    CommonBasicOpen.chartToRight_isOpenImmersion c
  letI : IsOpenImmersion (c.transport e C').chartToRight :=
    CommonBasicOpen.chartToRight_isOpenImmersion (c.transport e C')
  apply twistingSheafPullbackComp_square_hom_eq
    c.chartToRight_preimage_linearOpen
    (fun k ↦ commonChartIso_preimage_rightLinearOpen e C' c k)
    (fun k ↦ chartIso_preimage_linearOpen e C' j k)
    (c.transport e C').chartToRight_preimage_linearOpen
    (chartIso_rightRestriction e C' c).symm
    (c.rightTwistRestrictionData 1)
    (commonChartRightTwistRestrictionData e C' c)
    (chartTwistRestrictionData e C' j)
    ((c.transport e C').rightTwistRestrictionData 1)
    (by rfl) (by rfl) (by rfl) (by rfl)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso_transport_naturality
statement:
theorem transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso_transport_naturality
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {E E' : X.Modules} (e : E ≅ E')
    (C' : AffineFrameCover X E') {i j : C'.I}
    (c : C'.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (commonChartIso e C' c).hom).mapIso
        (C'.transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso 1 i j c) ≪≫
      commonChartTwistRightTransportIso e C' c).hom =
    (commonChartTwistLeftTransportIso e C' c ≪≫
      (transport e C').transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso 1 i j
        (c.transport e C')).hom
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (C'.basisIndex i) := C'.basisIndex_finite i
  letI : Finite (C'.basisIndex j) := C'.basisIndex_finite j
  letI : Finite ((transport e C').basisIndex i) :=
    (transport e C').basisIndex_finite i
  letI : Finite ((transport e C').basisIndex j) :=
    (transport e C').basisIndex_finite j
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) := c.sectionModule_free
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E'.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) := c.sectionModule_finite
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    (c.transport e C').sectionModule_free
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, c.affineOpen.1)
      (E.val.obj (op c.affineOpen.1)) :=
    (c.transport e C').sectionModule_finite
  unfold commonChartTwistLeftTransportIso
    commonChartTwistRightTransportIso
    transitionCanonicalTwistComparisonIso
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom,
    Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  have hcancel :
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (commonChartIso e C' c).hom).map
          ((c.rightTwistRestrictionData 1).pullbackIso).inv ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (commonChartIso e C' c).hom).map
          ((c.rightTwistRestrictionData 1).pullbackIso).hom = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [← Functor.map_comp]
    simp
  have hcancel_assoc :
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (commonChartIso e C' c).hom).map
          ((c.rightTwistRestrictionData 1).pullbackIso).inv ≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (commonChartIso e C' c).hom).map
            ((c.rightTwistRestrictionData 1).pullbackIso).hom ≫
          ((commonChartRightTwistRestrictionData e C' c).pullbackIso.hom ≫
            ((c.transport e C').rightTwistRestrictionData 1).pullbackIso.inv)) =
      (commonChartRightTwistRestrictionData e C' c).pullbackIso.hom ≫
        ((c.transport e C').rightTwistRestrictionData 1).pullbackIso.inv := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, hcancel, Category.id_comp]
  rw [hcancel_assoc]
  slice_lhs 2 3 =>
    exact commonChart_twistingSheafBasisIso_naturality e C' c
  simp only [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, Category.assoc]

name: RiemannRoch.KNFB.chartSection_ker

name: RiemannRoch.KNFB.zeroSection_app_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem zeroSection_app_eq_zero_iff (W : (C.chart i).affineOpens) (a : Γ(C.chart i, W.1)) :
    (C.quotientSection q hq).app (C.chartι i ''ᵁ W.1)
        (((C.chartι i).appIso W.1).inv.hom a) = 0 ↔
      a ∈ (symmetricProjMap (S := Γ(Z, C.U i)) (quotientSectionMap q (C.U i))
        (quotientSectionMap_spans q hq (C.U i))).ker.ideal W
proof:
:= by
  have h := Scheme.ker_ideal_of_isPullback_of_isOpenImmersion
    (C.quotientSection q hq) (C.chartSection q hq i) (C.U i).ι (C.chartι i)
    (rankTwo_quotientSection_chart_isPullback C q hq i) W
  rw [chartSection_ker] at h
  rw [h]
  refine Iff.trans ?_ Iff.rfl
  show _ ↔ ((C.chartι i).appIso W.1).inv.hom a ∈ (C.quotientSection q hq).ker.ideal
    ⟨C.chartι i ''ᵁ W.1, W.2.image_of_isOpenImmersion _⟩
  rw [Scheme.Hom.ker_apply, RingHom.mem_ker]
