name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIFZ.tdInvN_of_rank_zero
statement:
theorem tdInvN_of_rank_zero (hP : ProjBundleClosedPos (ProjectiveIntegral k)) (i : X ⟶ Z)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (hr : HasConstantRank X (conormalSheaf i) 0) : tdInvN k hP i = 1
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsIntegral X := (Fact.out : ProjectiveIntegral k X).1
  have hc : ∀ j, chernSeq k hP (conormalSheaf i) j = if j = 0 then 1 else 0 := fun j ↦ by
    unfold chernSeq
    rw [constRankChernAssignOn'_eq (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) hP _ 0 hr]
    rfl
  unfold tdInvN
  exact Alg.tdInvFromChern_delta _ (Alg.dualChern_delta _ hc)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIFZ.caseII_of_isIso
statement:
theorem caseII_of_isIso (h : ChExact k (closedPosV4 k)) (i : X ⟶ Z) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [i.IsOver (Spk k)] [IsIso i] (hr : HasConstantRank X (conormalSheaf i) 0)
    (injZ : Function.Injective (k0ToG0 Z)) : CaseII k (closedPosV4 k) h i
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  haveI : (asIso i).hom.IsOver (Spk k) := inferInstanceAs (i.IsOver (Spk k))
  have hy0 : k0ToG0 Z (pullbackK0 (asIso i).inv x) = finitePushforward i (k0ToG0 X x) :=
    KSpecialization.ARRHBCP.k0ToG0_pullbackK0_iso (asIso i).symm x
  have hy : y = pullbackK0 (asIso i).inv x := injZ (hxy.trans hy0.symm)
  have hx : pullbackK0 i y = x := by
    rw [hy, pullbackK0_comp_apply]
    have : i ≫ (asIso i).inv = 𝟙 X := by simp
    rw [this, pullbackK0_id]
    rfl
  have hF := fundClass_push_iso k (asIso i)
  have hP := GRRBlueprintV4.CIIASM.chK0_push (closedPosV4 k) h i y (fundClass k (W := X))
  rw [hx] at hP
  unfold tauX
  rw [tdInvN_of_rank_zero k (closedPosV4 k) i hr]
  have hF' : totalPushOn (opsV4 k) i (fundClass k (W := X)) = fundClass k (W := Z) := hF
  rw [hF'] at hP
  exact hP.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F16.exists_closedPoint_generator_k
statement:
theorem exists_closedPoint_generator_k
    (hW : DimensionCatenary (Spec (CommRingCat.of A[X]))) {k : ℕ}
    (ξ0 v0 : Spec (CommRingCat.of A[X]))
    (hcξ : flatPullbackCoeff (linePi A) ξ0 ≠ 0) (hπ : linePi A ξ0 = linePi A v0)
    (hsp : ξ0 ⤳ v0) (hne : ξ0 ≠ v0) (hv : height v0 = (k : ℕ∞)) :
    ∃ g : DimRelationGenerator (Spec (CommRingCat.of A[X])) k,
      f17η g = ξ0 ∧ height ξ0 = ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ∧ g.cycle.1 v0 ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ x, x ≠ v0 → g.cycle.1 x ≠ 0 → ξ0 ⤳ x ∧ linePi A x ≠ linePi A v0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set q : PrimeSpectrum A := PrimeSpectrum.comap (C : A →+* A[X]) ξ0 with hq
  haveI hqp : q.asIdeal.IsPrime := q.isPrime
  have hξ := eq_extended_of_coeff_ne_zero ξ0 hcξ
  have hv0q : PrimeSpectrum.comap (C : A →+* A[X]) v0 = q := hπ.symm
  let φ : A[X] →+* (A ⧸ q.asIdeal)[X] := Polynomial.mapRingHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk q.asIdeal)
  have hφs : Function.Surjective φ := Polynomial.map_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hker : RingHom.ker φ = ξ0.asIdeal := by
    rw [Polynomial.ker_mapRingHom, Ideal.mk_ker]
    exact hξ.symm
  have hle : ξ0.asIdeal ≤ v0.asIdeal := (PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes ξ0 v0).mpr hsp
  have hne' : v0.asIdeal ≠ ξ0.asIdeal := fun h ↦ hne (PrimeSpectrum.ext h.symm)
  haveI : IsDomain (A ⧸ q.asIdeal) := Ideal.Quotient.isDomain q.asIdeal
  haveI : v0.asIdeal.IsPrime := v0.isPrime
  set Qb : Ideal (A ⧸ q.asIdeal)[X] := v0.asIdeal.map φ with hQb
  haveI hQbp : Qb.IsPrime :=
    Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective hφs (by rw [hker]; exact hle)
  have hcomap : Qb.comap φ = v0.asIdeal := by
    rw [hQb, Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective φ hφs, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, hker]
    exact sup_eq_left.mpr hle
  have hQ0 : Qb.comap (C : (A ⧸ q.asIdeal) →+* (A ⧸ q.asIdeal)[X]) = ⊥ := by
    ext b
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective b
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.mem_bot, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    have h1 : (C (Ideal.Quotient.mk q.asIdeal a) : (A ⧸ q.asIdeal)[X]) = φ (C a) := by
      simp [φ]
    rw [h1, ← Ideal.mem_comap, hcomap]
    have h2 : a ∈ q.asIdeal ↔ C a ∈ v0.asIdeal := by
      have := congrArg (fun J : PrimeSpectrum A ↦ a ∈ J.asIdeal) hv0q
      simpa using this.symm
    exact h2.symm
  have hQne : Qb ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro h
    apply hne'
    rw [← hcomap, h, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, hker]
  obtain ⟨F, hF0, hFQ, hFuniq⟩ := exists_generator Qb hQ0 hQne
  have hht : Qb.height = 1 := height_eq_one_of_gen Qb hQ0 hQne F hFQ hFuniq
  let Y : Scheme.{u} := Spec (CommRingCat.of (A ⧸ q.asIdeal)[X])
  let ι : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A[X]) := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion ι := IsClosedImmersion.spec_of_surjective _ hφs
  let y0 : Y := (⟨Qb, hQbp⟩ : PrimeSpectrum (A ⧸ q.asIdeal)[X])
  have hιy : ∀ y : Y, ι y = PrimeSpectrum.comap φ y := fun _ ↦ rfl
  have hιy0 : ι y0 = v0 := PrimeSpectrum.ext hcomap
  have hcoh0 : coheight y0 = 1 := by
    rw [coheight_spec_eq]; exact hht
  have hgen : ι (genericPoint Y) = ξ0 := by
    rw [genericPoint_eq_bot_of_affine, hιy]
    apply PrimeSpectrum.ext
    change Ideal.comap φ ⊥ = ξ0.asIdeal
    rw [← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, hker]
  have hheight : height ξ0 = ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
    have h := hW Y ι y0 hcoh0
    rw [hιy0, hgen, hv] at h
    rw [← h]; push_cast; rfl
  have hdim : ∀ y : Y, coheight y = 1 → height (ι y) = (k : ℕ∞) := by
    intro y hy
    have h := hW Y ι y hy
    rw [hgen, hheight] at h
    push_cast at h ⊢
    exact ENat_add_one_cancel h
  let g : DimRelationGenerator (Spec (CommRingCat.of A[X])) k :=
    { Y := Y, i := ι, f := specFun _ F, hf := specFun_ne_zero hF0, dimension := hdim }
  have hval : ∀ y : Y, g.cycle.1 (ι y) = Scheme.ord (specFun _ F) y := by
    intro y
    change properPushforward ι (div (specFun _ F)) (ι y) = _
    unfold properPushforward
    exact pushforward_apply_closedImmersion ι _ (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) y
  have hFy0 : F ∈ y0.asIdeal := hFQ
  refine ⟨g, hgen, hheight, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hιy0, hval]
    exact ord_specFun_ne_zero hF0 hcoh0 hFy0
  · intro x hxv hcx
    have hx : x ∈ (properPushforward ι (div (specFun _ F))).support := hcx
    rw [properPushforward, pushforward_support_closedImmersion ι (div (specFun _ F))
      (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl)] at hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hx
    have hcy : coheight y = 1 := div_support hy
    have hordy : Scheme.ord (specFun _ F) y ≠ 0 := hy
    have hyy0 : y ≠ y0 := by
      rintro rfl
      exact hxv hιy0
    have hFy : F ∈ y.asIdeal := by
      by_contra hFn
      exact hordy (ord_specFun_of_not_mem F hcy hFn)
    refine ⟨?_, fun hπy ↦ hyy0 ?_⟩
    · rw [← hgen]
      exact ((f17_genericPoint_specializes Y y).map ι.continuous)
    · 
      have e : φ.comp (C : A →+* A[X]) =
          (C : (A ⧸ q.asIdeal) →+* (A ⧸ q.asIdeal)[X]).comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk q.asIdeal) := by
        ext a <;> simp [φ]
      have h1 : Ideal.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk q.asIdeal)
          (Ideal.comap (C : (A ⧸ q.asIdeal) →+* (A ⧸ q.asIdeal)[X]) y.asIdeal) = q.asIdeal := by
        rw [Ideal.comap_comap, ← e, ← Ideal.comap_comap]
        have := congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal hπy
        change Ideal.comap (C : A →+* A[X]) (Ideal.comap φ y.asIdeal) =
          Ideal.comap (C : A →+* A[X]) v0.asIdeal at this
        rw [Ideal.comap_comap] at this ⊢
        rw [this]
        exact congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal hv0q
      have h2 : Ideal.comap (C : (A ⧸ q.asIdeal) →+* (A ⧸ q.asIdeal)[X]) y.asIdeal = ⊥ := by
        apply Ideal.comap_injective_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
        rw [h1, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, Ideal.mk_ker]
      exact PrimeSpectrum.ext (hFuniq y.asIdeal y.isPrime h2 hFy)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F16.line_core_k
statement: theorem line_core_k (k : ℕ) : FibreClosedPointCycleK (lineProj U) k
proof:
:= by
  letI := lineOver K U
  haveI := lineOver_lft K U
  intro ξ v hv hcξ hfξ hξv hne
  obtain ⟨U0, hU0, hmem, -⟩ :=
    exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (x := lineProj U v) (U := ⊤) (by simp)
  set j' := chartIncl hU0 with hj'
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(U, U0) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨U0, hU0⟩
  have hrange := range_chartIncl hU0
  have hvr : v ∈ Set.range j' := by rw [hrange]; exact hmem
  have hξr : ξ ∈ Set.range j' := by
    rw [hrange]
    change lineProj U ξ ∈ U0
    rw [hfξ]; exact hmem
  obtain ⟨v0, rfl⟩ := hvr
  obtain ⟨ξ0, rfl⟩ := hξr
  have hcomm := chartIncl_comm hU0
  have hfj : ∀ u, lineProj U (j' u) = hU0.fromSpec (linePi (Γ(U, U0)) u) := fun u ↦ by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hcomm, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  have hJinj : Function.Injective hU0.fromSpec := hU0.fromSpec.isOpenEmbedding.injective
  have hcoeff : ∀ u, flatPullbackCoeff (lineProj U) (j' u) =
      flatPullbackCoeff (linePi (Γ(U, U0))) u := by
    intro u
    have h1 := m6pb_coeff_comp j' (lineProj U) u
    rw [flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion j' u, mul_one, hcomm, m6pb_coeff_comp,
      flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion hU0.fromSpec, one_mul] at h1
    exact h1.symm
  have hπ : linePi (Γ(U, U0)) ξ0 = linePi (Γ(U, U0)) v0 :=
    hJinj (by rw [← hfj, ← hfj]; exact hfξ)
  have hξ0v0 : ξ0 ⤳ v0 := j'.isOpenEmbedding.isInducing.specializes_iff.mp hξv
  have hne0 : ξ0 ≠ v0 := fun h ↦ hne (by rw [h])
  have hcξ0 : flatPullbackCoeff (linePi (Γ(U, U0))) ξ0 ≠ 0 := by rwa [← hcoeff]
  have hv0 : height v0 = (k : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [← m6pb_height_openImmersion K j' v0]; exact hv
  letI : (Spec (CommRingCat.of (Γ(U, U0))[X])).Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
    ⟨j' ≫ (Line U) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)⟩
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType ((Spec (CommRingCat.of (Γ(U, U0))[X])) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (j' ≫ (Line U) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
    infer_instance
  have hW : DimensionCatenary (Spec (CommRingCat.of (Γ(U, U0))[X])) :=
    dimensionCatenary_of_finiteType K
  obtain ⟨g, hgη, hht, hg1, hg2⟩ :=
    exists_closedPoint_generator_k hW ξ0 v0 hcξ0 hπ hξ0v0 hne0 hv0
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hRj, hRsupp⟩ := lift_generator_supp K j' g
  refine ⟨R.1, mem_relC.mpr ⟨R.2, hR⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hRj]; exact hg1
  · rw [hfj, m6pb_height_openImmersion K hU0.fromSpec]
    have h1 := pureRelDim_linePi ξ0 hcξ0
    rw [hht] at h1
    have h2 : height (linePi (Γ(U, U0)) ξ0) = (k : ℕ∞) := by
      push_cast at h1 ⊢
      exact ENat_add_one_cancel h1.symm
    rw [h2]
  · intro x hxv hx
    by_cases hxr : x ∈ Set.range j'
    · obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hxr
      rw [hRj] at hx
      have hu : u ≠ v0 := fun h ↦ hxv (by rw [h])
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hg2 u hu hx
      refine ⟨h1.map j'.continuous, fun h ↦ h2 (hJinj ?_)⟩
      rw [← hfj, ← hfj]; exact h
    · have h1 := hRsupp x hx
      rw [hgη] at h1
      refine ⟨h1, fun h ↦ hxr ?_⟩
      rw [hrange]
      change lineProj U x ∈ U0
      rw [h]; exact hmem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F16.single_zero_mem
statement:
theorem single_zero_mem (v : Line U) (hv : height v = 0) :
    (Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single v (1 : ℤ) : AlgebraicCycle (Line U) ℤ) ∈
      Tzero (Line U) 0
proof:
:= by
  letI := lineOver K U
  haveI := lineOver_lft K U
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξv, hfξ, hcξ⟩ := f17_exists_max_generization (lineProj U) v
  have hne : ξ ≠ v := by
    rintro rfl
    have h1 := line_pureRelDim K U ξ hcξ
    rw [hv] at h1
    exact one_ne_zero (add_eq_zero.mp h1.symm).2
  obtain ⟨C, hCrel, hCv, hfw, hCx⟩ := line_core_k K U 0 ξ v (by simpa using hv) hcξ hfξ hξv hne
  have hC : C = C v • (Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single v (1 : ℤ) : AlgebraicCycle (Line U) ℤ) := by
    ext x
    simp only [Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_zsmul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single_apply]
    by_cases hxv : x = v
    · subst hxv; simp
    · simp only [hxv, if_false, mul_zero]
      by_contra hCx0
      obtain ⟨hspec, hfne⟩ := hCx x hxv hCx0
      have hfspec : lineProj U ξ ⤳ lineProj U x := hspec.map (lineProj U).continuous
      have hlt : lineProj U x < lineProj U ξ :=
        f17_lt_of_specializes hfspec (fun h ↦ hfne (h.symm.trans hfξ))
      have h2 := lt_of_lt_of_le (height_strictMono hlt
        (lt_of_le_of_lt (height_mono hlt.le) (lt_of_le_of_lt hfw (ENat.coe_lt_top _)))) hfw
      simp at h2
  exact ⟨C v, hCv, by rw [← hC]; exact hCrel⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F16.lineDimZero_of
statement:
theorem lineDimZero_of (U : Scheme.{u}) [U.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (U ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsLocallyNoetherian U] [CompactSpace U]
    (D : AlgebraicCycle (Line U) ℤ) (hD : D ∈ dimensionCycles (Line U) 0) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, N ≠ 0 ∧ (N : ℤ) • D ∈ relC (Line U) 0
proof:
:= by
  letI := lineOver K U
  haveI := lineOver_lft K U
  haveI : CompactSpace (Line U) := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace (lineProj U)
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hsum⟩ := eq_sum_single D
  have hmem : D ∈ Tzero (Line U) 0 := by
    rw [hsum]
    refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun x hx ↦ zsmul_mem (single_zero_mem K U x ?_) _
    exact hD (show D x ≠ 0 from (hS x).mpr hx)
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hr⟩ := hmem
  rcases Int.natAbs_eq N with h | h
  · exact ⟨N.natAbs, Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr hN, by rw [← h]; exact hr⟩
  · refine ⟨N.natAbs, Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr hN, ?_⟩
    have : ((N.natAbs : ℕ) : ℤ) • D = -(N • D) := by
      have h2 : N • D = (-((N.natAbs : ℕ) : ℤ)) • D := by rw [← h]
      rw [h2, neg_smul, neg_neg]
    rw [this]
    exact neg_mem hr

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7geoF_projection_taut
statement:
theorem m7geoF_projection_taut {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M] {ι : Type u} [Finite ι]
    (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (k l : ι) :
    (linearLocalFrameProjection R M b 1 k).app ⊤
      ((twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b 1).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_top : (linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ ⊤)).op
          ((tautChart_tautHom R M b (b l)).app ⊤ (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ⊤)))) =
      (show Γ((linearOpen R M (b k)).toScheme, ⊤) from tautChart_component R M (b k) (b l))
proof:
:= by
  have e : (tautChart_tautHom R M b (b l)).app ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤)
      (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤))) =
      (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b 1).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_top : (linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ ⊤)).op
          ((tautChart_tautHom R M b (b l)).app ⊤ (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ⊤))) := by
    rw [← tautChart_app_map]
    congr 1
  rw [← e, linearLocalFrameProjection_app_eq]
  have h1 : (Pi.π (fun j ↦ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit
      (space R M) (linearOpen R M (b j))) k).app
      ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤)
      ((kernel.ι (linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b 1)).app
        ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤)
        ((tautChart_tautHom R M b (b l)).app ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤)
          (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤))))) =
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) (linearOpen R M (b k))).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE le_top).op (tautChart_component R M (b k) (b l)) := by
    exact (tautChart_app3 _ _ _ _ _).trans ((congrArg
      (fun f : SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModules (space R M) ⟶
          SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) (linearOpen R M (b k)) ↦
        f.app ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤)
          (1 : (space R M).presheaf.obj (op ((linearOpen R M (b k)).ι ''ᵁ ⊤))))
      (tautChart_tautHom_kernel_π R M b (b l) k)).trans
      (tautChart_unitHomEquiv_symm_sectionsOfTop_app' _ _ _))
  erw [h1]
  simp only [tautChart_component]
  change (space R M).presheaf.map _ ((space R M).presheaf.map _ ((space R M).presheaf.map _
    (tautChart_ratioSection R M (b k) (b l)))) = (space R M).presheaf.map _
      (tautChart_ratioSection R M (b k) (b l))
  rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  congr 2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.AffineFrameCoverGeo.m7geoF_literal_t
statement:
theorem m7geoF_literal_t (i : C.I) (k l : C.basisIndex i) :
    letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i)
proof:
:= C.basisIndex_finite i
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheafLiteralLinearOpenIso 1 ⟨i, k⟩).hom.app ⊤
      ((C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE ((((C.literalLinearOpen ⟨i, k⟩).ι ≫ C.chartι i).image_le_opensRange ⊤).trans
          (tautQuotient_toBase_range_le C i k))).op (tautQuotient_t C i l)) =
      (show Γ((C.literalLinearOpen ⟨i, k⟩).toScheme, ⊤) from
        tautChart_component Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i k)
          (C.sectionBasis i l)) := by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  simp only [SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistingSheafLiteralLinearOpenIso,
    id_eq]
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
    Iso.app_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp_hom_app_app]
  rw [tautQuotient_t, tautQuotient_chartSection]
  refine (congrArg (fun z => (SchemeProjectiveBundle.twistingSheafOfBasisIndexLinearOpenIso
    Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i) 1 k).inv.app ⊤ z)
      (tautQuotient_restrictionIso_taut C i k _ _ _ _)).trans ?_
  exact m7geoF_projection_taut (C.sectionBasis i) k l

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.symEval_ι
statement: @[simp] theorem symEval_ι (r : R) : symEval R (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R R r) = r
proof:
:=
  SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply _ r

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.symGen_mem
statement: theorem symGen_mem : symGen R ∈ symGrading R R 1
proof:
:= by
  change _ ∈ LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R R : R →ₗ[R] SymmetricAlgebra R R) ^ 1
  rw [pow_one]
  exact LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.ι_eq_algebraMap_mul
statement:
theorem ι_eq_algebraMap_mul (r : R) :
    SymmetricAlgebra.ι R R r = algebraMap R _ r * symGen R
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Algebra.smul_def, ← map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.eq_of_mem_symGrading
statement:
theorem eq_of_mem_symGrading {n : ℕ} {x : SymmetricAlgebra R R} (hx : x ∈ symGrading R R n) :
    x = algebraMap R _ (symEval R x) * symGen R ^ n
proof:
:= by
  change x ∈ LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R R : R →ₗ[R] SymmetricAlgebra R R) ^ n at hx
  refine Submodule.pow_induction_on_left'
    (M := LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R R : R →ₗ[R] SymmetricAlgebra R R))
    (C := fun d y _ ↦ y = algebraMap R _ (symEval R y) * symGen R ^ d) ?_ ?_ ?_ hx
  · intro r
    simp
  · intro y z d _ _ hy hz
    rw [map_add, map_add, add_mul, ← hy, ← hz]
  · intro y hy d z _ hz
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [map_mul, symEval_ι, map_mul, pow_succ', ι_eq_algebraMap_mul]
    conv_lhs => rw [hz]
    ring

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.irrelevant_le_span_symGen
statement:
theorem irrelevant_le_span_symGen :
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (symGrading R R)).toIdeal ≤
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun _ : Unit ↦ symGen R)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x hx
  have hx' : x ∈ HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (symGrading R R) := hx
  rw [HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_iff, GradedRing.proj_apply] at hx'
  rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_decompose (symGrading R R) x]
  refine Ideal.sum_mem _ fun c _ ↦ ?_
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos c with rfl | hc
  · rw [hx']; exact zero_mem _
  · rw [eq_of_mem_symGrading R (DirectSum.decompose (symGrading R R) x c).2]
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, c = k + 1 := ⟨c - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [pow_succ]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨(), rfl⟩))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.basicOpen_symGen_eq_top
statement:
theorem basicOpen_symGen_eq_top :
    Proj.basicOpen (symGrading R R) (symGen R) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have := Proj.iSup_basicOpen_eq_top (symGrading R R) (fun _ : Unit ↦ symGen R)
    (irrelevant_le_span_symGen R)
  simpa using this

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.fromZeroRingHom_symGen_bijective
statement:
theorem fromZeroRingHom_symGen_bijective :
    Function.Bijective (HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom (symGrading R R)
      (Submonoid.powers (symGen R)))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro y hy
    have hv := congrArg HomogeneousLocalization.val hy
    change Localization.mk y.1 1 = Localization.mk 0 1 at hv
    rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists] at hv
    obtain ⟨⟨c, k, rfl⟩, hc⟩ := hv
    simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, mul_zero] at hc
    have h0 := congrArg (symEval R) hc
    rw [map_mul, map_pow, symEval_ι, one_pow, one_mul, map_zero] at h0
    apply Subtype.ext
    change y.1 = 0
    rw [eq_of_mem_symGrading R y.2, h0]
    simp
  · intro z
    obtain ⟨n, a, ha, rfl⟩ := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_surjective
      (symGrading R R) (symGen_mem R) z
    have ha' : a ∈ symGrading R R n := by simpa using ha
    refine ⟨⟨algebraMap R _ (symEval R a), ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · have := eq_of_mem_symGrading R (x := algebraMap R _ (symEval R a)) (n := 0)
      exact Submodule.algebraMap_mem _
    · apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
      rw [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk]
      change Localization.mk _ 1 = _
      rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
      refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
      simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul]
      conv_rhs => rw [eq_of_mem_symGrading R ha']
      ring

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.span_range_eq_top_of_one_mem
statement:
theorem span_range_eq_top_of_one_mem {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {σ : R →+* S}
    (g : M →ₛₗ[σ] S) (h : ∃ m, g m = 1) : Submodule.span S (Set.range g) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := h
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro s _
  have : s = s • g m := by rw [hm, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  rw [this]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨m, rfl⟩)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.ringHomSemilinear_spans
statement:
theorem ringHomSemilinear_spans (f : R →+* S) :
    Submodule.span S (Set.range (ringHomSemilinear f)) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  span_range_eq_top_of_one_mem _ ⟨1, map_one f⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.specMap_comp_inv_rankOneToSpec
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem specMap_comp_inv_rankOneToSpec (f : R →+* S) :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f) ≫ inv (rankOneToSpec R) =
      inv (rankOneToSpec S) ≫
        semilinearSymmetricProjMap f (ringHomSemilinear f) (ringHomSemilinear_spans f)
proof:
:= by
  have h := semilinearSymmetricProjMap_toSpec f (ringHomSemilinear f) (ringHomSemilinear_spans f)
  rw [IsIso.eq_inv_comp, ← Category.assoc, IsIso.comp_inv_eq]
  exact h.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.localSection_toSpec
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem localSection_toSpec (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (hφ : Submodule.span R (Set.range φ) = ⊤) :
    localSection φ hφ ≫ (Proj.toSpecZero (symGrading R M) ≫
      Spec.map (degreeZeroAlgEquiv (R := R) (M := M)).symm.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.hom) =
        𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  unfold localSection
  rw [Category.assoc, semilinearSymmetricProjMap_toSpec]
  change inv (rankOneToSpec R) ≫ rankOneToSpec R ≫ Spec.map (𝟙 _) = 𝟙 _
  rw [Spec.map_id, Category.comp_id, IsIso.inv_hom_id]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.quotientSectionMap_spans
statement:
theorem quotientSectionMap_spans (U : Z.Opens) :
    Submodule.span Γ(Z, U) (Set.range (quotientSectionMap q U)) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  span_range_eq_top_of_one_mem _ (hq U (show (tensorUnitSheaf Z).val.obj (op U) from (1 : Γ(Z, U))))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.quotientSectionMap_restrict
statement:
theorem quotientSectionMap_restrict {U V : Z.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) (m : E.val.obj (op U)) :
    quotientSectionMap q V (E.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE h).op m) =
      Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (quotientSectionMap q U m)
proof:
:=
  PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply q.val (homOfLE h).op m

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.homOfLE_isoSpec_hom
statement:
theorem homOfLE_isoSpec_hom {i : C.I} (V : Z.affineOpens) (hV : V.1 ≤ C.U i) :
    Z.homOfLE hV ≫ (C.isAffine i).isoSpec.hom =
      V.2.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op).hom)
proof:
:= by
  have key : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op).hom) ≫
      (C.isAffine i).isoSpec.inv = V.2.isoSpec.inv ≫ Z.homOfLE hV := by
    have hf : CommRingCat.ofHom (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op).hom =
        Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op := by
      apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
      rfl
    rw [hf]
    apply (cancel_epi V.2.isoSpec.hom).1
    simp only [Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
    rw [IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_hom, Scheme.Opens.toSpecΓ_SpecMap_presheaf_map_assoc,
      ← (C.isAffine i).isoSpec_hom]
    simp
  rw [← cancel_epi V.2.isoSpec.inv, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, ← reassoc_of% key,
    Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.homOfLE_chartSection
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem homOfLE_chartSection {i : C.I} (V : Z.affineOpens) (hV : V.1 ≤ C.U i)
    [Module.Free Γ(Z, V.1) (E.val.obj (op V.1))] [Module.Finite Γ(Z, V.1) (E.val.obj (op V.1))] :
    Z.homOfLE hV ≫ C.chartSection q hq i =
      V.2.isoSpec.hom ≫
        localSection (quotientSectionMap q V.1) (quotientSectionMap_spans q hq V.1) ≫
          semilinearSymmetricProjMap (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op).hom
            (E.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE hV).op) (C.restriction_spans i V.1 hV)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hq (C.U i)
    (show (tensorUnitSheaf Z).val.obj (op (C.U i)) from (1 : Γ(Z, C.U i)))
  have hn' : quotientSectionMap q (C.U i) n = 1 := hn
  have hL : Submodule.span Γ(Z, V.1) (Set.range (semilinearMapComp (RingHom.id _)
      (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op).hom (quotientSectionMap q (C.U i))
      (ringHomSemilinear (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op).hom))) = ⊤ := by
    refine span_range_eq_top_of_one_mem _ ⟨n, ?_⟩
    change Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op (quotientSectionMap q (C.U i) n) = 1
    rw [hn']
    exact map_one _
  have hR : Submodule.span Γ(Z, V.1) (Set.range (semilinearMapComp
      (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op).hom (RingHom.id _)
      (E.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE hV).op) (quotientSectionMap q V.1))) = ⊤ := by
    refine span_range_eq_top_of_one_mem _ ⟨n, ?_⟩
    change quotientSectionMap q V.1 (E.val.restrictₛₗ (homOfLE hV).op n) = 1
    rw [quotientSectionMap_restrict, hn']
    exact map_one _
  unfold chartSection localSection
  rw [reassoc_of% (C.homOfLE_isoSpec_hom V hV)]
  have h2 := specMap_comp_inv_rankOneToSpec_assoc (Z.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op).hom
    (semilinearSymmetricProjMap (RingHom.id _) (quotientSectionMap q (C.U i))
      (quotientSectionMap_spans q hq _))
  refine (congrArg (fun g ↦ V.2.isoSpec.hom ≫ g) h2).trans ?_
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  congr 2
  refine (semilinearSymmetricProjMap_comp _ _ _ _ _ _ hL).trans
    ((semilinearSymmetricProjMap_congr (RingHom.ext fun _ ↦ rfl) _ _ ?_ _ hR).trans
      (semilinearSymmetricProjMap_comp _ _ _ _ _ _ hR).symm)
  exact semilinearMap_heq_of_ringHom_eq (RingHom.ext fun _ ↦ rfl) _ _ fun m ↦
    (quotientSectionMap_restrict q hV m).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.chartToLeft_chartι
statement:
theorem chartToLeft_chartι {i j : C.I} (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    c.chartToLeft ≫ C.chartι i = c.chartToRight ≫ C.chartι j
proof:
:= by
  refine (cancel_epi (C.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j c).hom).1 ?_
  have h1 := C.commonBasicOpenChartIso_hom_chartToLeft_assoc i j c (C.chartι i)
  have h2 : (C.commonBasicOpenChartIso i j c).hom ≫ c.chartToRight ≫ C.chartι j =
      C.localTransition i j c ≫ C.overlapToChart j i ≫ C.chartι j :=
    (C.localTransition_toChart_assoc i j c _).symm
  refine h1.trans (Eq.trans ?_ h2.symm)
  rw [← C.basicOpenOverlapCover_transition_assoc]
  exact congrArg (fun g ↦ (C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).f c ≫ g)
    (C.glueData.glue_condition i j).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.chartSection_compatible
statement:
theorem chartSection_compatible (x y : C.I) :
    pullback.fst (C.baseCover.f x) (C.baseCover.f y) ≫ (C.chartSection q hq x ≫ C.chartι x) =
      pullback.snd (C.baseCover.f x) (C.baseCover.f y) ≫ (C.chartSection q hq y ≫ C.chartι y)
proof:
:= by
  let h := isPullback_opens_inf (C.U x) (C.U y)
  refine (cancel_epi h.isoPullback.hom).1 ?_
  have hf : h.isoPullback.hom ≫ pullback.fst (C.baseCover.f x) (C.baseCover.f y) =
      Z.homOfLE inf_le_left := h.isoPullback_hom_fst
  have hs : h.isoPullback.hom ≫ pullback.snd (C.baseCover.f x) (C.baseCover.f y) =
      Z.homOfLE inf_le_right := h.isoPullback_hom_snd
  refine ((reassoc_of% hf) _).trans (Eq.trans ?_ ((reassoc_of% hs) _).symm)
  refine (CommonBasicOpen.baseCover C x y).hom_ext _ _
    fun (c : C.CommonBasicOpen x y) ↦ ?_
  refine (cancel_epi c.affineOpenIsoInIntersection.hom).1 ?_
  simp only [CommonBasicOpen.affineOpenIsoInIntersection_hom_baseCover_assoc]
  refine (Scheme.homOfLE_homOfLE_assoc Z _ _ _).trans
    (Eq.trans ?_ (Scheme.homOfLE_homOfLE_assoc Z _ _ _).symm)
  refine (C.homOfLE_chartSection_assoc q hq c.affineOpen c.affineOpen_le_left _).trans
    (Eq.trans ?_ (C.homOfLE_chartSection_assoc q hq c.affineOpen c.affineOpen_le_right _).symm)
  exact congrArg (fun g ↦ c.affineOpen.2.isoSpec.hom ≫
    localSection (quotientSectionMap q c.affineOpen.1) (quotientSectionMap_spans q hq _) ≫ g)
    (C.chartToLeft_chartι c)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.baseCover_quotientSection
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem baseCover_quotientSection (i : C.I) :
    C.baseCover.f i ≫ C.quotientSection q hq = C.chartSection q hq i ≫ C.chartι i
proof:
:=
  Scheme.Cover.ι_glueMorphisms C.baseCover (fun i ↦ C.chartSection q hq i ≫ C.chartι i)
    (C.chartSection_compatible q hq) i

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.chartSection_chartToAmbient
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem chartSection_chartToAmbient (i : C.I) :
    C.chartSection q hq i ≫ C.chartToAmbient i = (C.U i).ι
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := localSection_toSpec_assoc (quotientSectionMap q (C.U i))
    (quotientSectionMap_spans q hq (C.U i)) ((C.isAffine i).isoSpec.inv ≫ (C.U i).ι)
  have h2 : (C.isAffine i).isoSpec.hom ≫ (C.isAffine i).isoSpec.inv ≫ (C.U i).ι = (C.U i).ι :=
    Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc _ _
  change (C.isAffine i).isoSpec.hom ≫
      localSection (quotientSectionMap q (C.U i)) (quotientSectionMap_spans q hq (C.U i)) ≫
        ((Proj.toSpecZero (symGrading Γ(Z, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))) ≫
          Spec.map (degreeZeroAlgEquiv (R := Γ(Z, C.U i))
            (M := E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))).symm.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.hom) ≫
          (C.isAffine i).isoSpec.inv) ≫ (C.U i).ι = _
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  exact (congrArg (fun g ↦ (C.isAffine i).isoSpec.hom ≫ g) h1).trans h2

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.quotientSection_toBase
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem quotientSection_toBase : C.quotientSection q hq ≫ C.toBase = 𝟙 Z
proof:
:= by
  refine C.baseCover.hom_ext _ _ fun i ↦ ?_
  refine (C.baseCover_quotientSection_assoc q hq i C.toBase).trans ?_
  rw [Category.comp_id]
  exact (congrArg (fun g ↦ C.chartSection q hq i ≫ g) (C.chartι_toBase i)).trans
    (C.chartSection_chartToAmbient q hq i)

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.moduleHom_mono_of_app_injective

    (h : ∀ W : X.Opens, Function.Injective (f.val.app (op W))) : Mono f
proof:
:= by

    (AddCommGrpCat.mono_iff_injective _).2 (h W.unop)
  have h2 : Mono ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).map f).hom := NatTrans.mono_of_mono_app _
  have h3 : Mono ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).map f) :=

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.mono_sigmaT_app
statement:
theorem mono_sigmaT_app {Λ : X.Modules} (s : Λ ⟶ tensorUnitSheaf X) [Mono s]
    (E : X.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) : Mono ((sigmaT Λ s).app E)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits X E hE
  have h1 : Mono ((tensorSheafLeftFunctor X E).map s) := inferInstance
  have h2 : Mono ((MonoidalCategory.tensorLeft E).map s) := by
    have n := (thetaIso E).hom.naturality s
    haveI : IsIso ((thetaIso E).hom.app Λ) := inferInstance
    haveI : Mono ((tensorSheafLeftFunctor X E).map s ≫ (thetaIso E).hom.app (tensorUnitSheaf X)) :=
      mono_comp _ _
    have key : (MonoidalCategory.tensorLeft E).map s = inv ((thetaIso E).hom.app Λ) ≫
        ((tensorSheafLeftFunctor X E).map s ≫ (thetaIso E).hom.app (tensorUnitSheaf X)) :=
      (IsIso.eq_inv_comp _).2 n.symm
    rw [key]
    infer_instance
  have h3 : Mono (s ▷ E) := by
    have n := BraidedCategory.braiding_naturality_left s E
    haveI : Mono (E ◁ s) := h2
    haveI : Mono (β_ Λ E).hom := (inferInstance : IsIso (β_ Λ E).hom).mono_of_iso
    haveI : Mono ((β_ Λ E).hom ≫ E ◁ s) := mono_comp _ _
    exact mono_of_mono_fac n
  haveI : Mono (λ_ E).hom := (inferInstance : IsIso (λ_ E).hom).mono_of_iso
  have h4 : Mono ((s ▷ E) ≫ (λ_ E).hom) := @mono_comp _ _ _ _ _ (s ▷ E) h3 (λ_ E).hom this
  change Mono ((thetaIso Λ).hom.app E ≫ ((s ▷ E) ≫ (λ_ E).hom))
  haveI : Mono ((thetaIso Λ).hom.app E) :=
    (inferInstance : IsIso ((thetaIso Λ).hom.app E)).mono_of_iso
  exact @mono_comp _ _ _ _ _ _ this _ h4

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.killedTransport_killedMap_cokernel_iso
statement:
theorem killedTransport_killedMap_cokernel_iso
    [T.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits T] [PreservesFiniteColimits T]
    [T.PreservesMonomorphisms] [TW.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits TW]
    [PreservesFiniteColimits TW] [TW.PreservesMonomorphisms]
    (hI : LocallyPrincipal I) (hB : AR7Bridge I T σ)
    (c : PushCompat TW σW T σ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F))
    (hcW : Central TW σW) (hTW : ∀ E, IsCoherentLike W E → IsCoherentLike W (TW.obj E))
    (V : W.Modules) (hV : IsCoherentLike W V)
    (G : I.subscheme.Modules) (hG : IsCoherentLike I.subscheme G)
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward I.subschemeι).obj G ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj (cokernel (ap TW σW V))) :
    g0KilledIEquiv hI (killedTransport hB
        (killedMap c (finitePush_obj F) (finitePush_exactOn F)
          (subcategoryClassOf W.Modules (Killed TW σW (IsCoherentLike W))
            (cokernel (ap TW σW V))
            (killed_cokernel hcW kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike hTW hV)))) =
      g0ClassOf I.subscheme G hG
proof:
:= by
  have hK := killed_cokernel hcW kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike hTW hV
  have m1 : killedMap c (finitePush_obj F) (finitePush_exactOn F)
      (subcategoryClassOf W.Modules (Killed TW σW (IsCoherentLike W)) (cokernel (ap TW σW V)) hK) =
      subcategoryClassOf Y.Modules (Killed T σ (IsCoherentLike Y))
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj (cokernel (ap TW σW V)))
        (c.killed (finitePush_obj F) _ hK) := mapOn_classOf _ _ _ _ _
  rw [m1, killedTransport_classOf]
  have h1 : subcategoryClassOf Y.Modules (KilledI I)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj (cokernel (ap TW σW V)))
      ⟨(c.killed (finitePush_obj F) _ hK).1, hB.idealKills_of_killed _ (c.killed (finitePush_obj F) _ hK).1
        (c.killed (finitePush_obj F) _ hK).2⟩ =
      KSpecialization.AR4.pushZero (I := I) (g0ClassOf I.subscheme G hG) := by
    change _ = KSpecialization.AR4.pushZero (I := I) (ExactGrothendieck.classOf _ _ ⟨G, hG⟩)
    rw [KSpecialization.AR4.pushZero_classOf]
    exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso _ _ _ _ KSpecialization.AR4.killedI_zero
      (isZero_zero _) e.symm
  rw [h1]
  have h2 := congrArg (fun f : G0 I.subscheme →+ G0 I.subscheme =>
    f (g0ClassOf I.subscheme G hG)) (KSpecialization.AR4.pullFibre_comp_pushZero hI)
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.id_apply] at h2
  exact h2

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.hbc_cartier_closed
statement:
theorem hbc_cartier_closed (hL : SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank Y L 1)
    (hreg : SectionIsRegular σ)
    {W : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian W] (F : W ⟶ Y) [IsFinite F]
    (V : W.Modules) (hV : IsCoherentLike W V)
    [Mono (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)))
      (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) V)]
    (y : K0 Y) (hy : k0ToG0 Y y = finitePushforward F (g0ClassOf W V hV))
    (G : (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme.Modules)
    (hG : IsCoherentLike (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme G)
    (e : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι).obj G ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj
        (cokernel (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)))
          (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) V))) :
    k0ToG0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme
        (pullbackK0 (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι y) =
      g0ClassOf (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme G hG
proof:
:= by
  have hline : IsLocalLineFrame L := isLocalLineFrame_of_hasConstantRank_one hL
  have hΛ1 : SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank Y (lineBundleDual Y L) 1 :=
    lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank L hL
  have hΛ : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y (lineBundleDual Y L) := hΛ1.isFiniteLocallyFree
  have hΛW1 := SchemeKTheory.hasConstantRank_pullback W F _ 1 hΛ1
  have hΛW : IsFiniteLocallyFree W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)) :=
    hΛW1.isFiniteLocallyFree
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits Y _ hΛ
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits Y _ hΛ
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits W _ hΛW
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits W _ hΛW
  have hT : ∀ E, IsCoherentLike Y E → IsCoherentLike Y
      ((tensorSheafLeftFunctor Y (lineBundleDual Y L)).obj E) := fun E hE =>
    tensorSheaf_isCoherentLike Y _ _ hΛ hE
  have hTW : ∀ E, IsCoherentLike W E → IsCoherentLike W
      ((tensorSheafLeftFunctor W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L))).obj E) :=
    fun E hE => tensorSheaf_isCoherentLike W _ _ hΛW hE
  have hcW := sigmaT_central (locallyTrivial_of_hasConstantRank_one hΛW1)
    (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))
  have hI := KSpecialization.AR4.locallyPrincipal_sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ hline
  have hmono : ∀ E : Y.Modules, IsFiniteLocallyFree Y E →
      Mono (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor Y (lineBundleDual Y L))
        (sigmaT (lineBundleDual Y L) (dualEval σ)) E) :=
    fun E hE => hmono_of_sectionIsRegular σ hline hreg E hE
  have := hbc_cartier F hI (ar7Bridge σ hline) (central_twist σ hline) hT hmono
    (pushCompat F (dualEval σ) hΛ) hcW hTW
    (fun E _ => isIso_kernelComparison_pushforward F _)
    (fun E hE => isIso_cokernelComparison_pushforward F _ (hTW E hE) hE) V hV y hy
  rw [this]
  exact killedTransport_killedMap_cokernel_iso F hI (ar7Bridge σ hline)
    (pushCompat F (dualEval σ) hΛ) hcW hTW V hV G hG e

name: KSpecialization.CIIL3B.exists_datum_cartier
statement:
theorem exists_datum_cartier (hL : SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank Y L 1)
    {W : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian W] (F : W ⟶ Y) [IsFinite F]
    (V : W.Modules) (hV : IsCoherentLike W V) :
    ∃ (G : (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme.Modules)
      (_ : IsCoherentLike (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subscheme G),
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).subschemeι).obj G ≅
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj
          (cokernel (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)))
            (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) V)))
proof:
:= by
  have hline : IsLocalLineFrame L := isLocalLineFrame_of_hasConstantRank_one hL
  have hΛ1 : SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank Y (lineBundleDual Y L) 1 :=
    lineBundleDual_hasConstantRank L hL
  have hΛ : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y (lineBundleDual Y L) := hΛ1.isFiniteLocallyFree
  have hΛW1 := SchemeKTheory.hasConstantRank_pullback W F _ 1 hΛ1
  have hΛW : IsFiniteLocallyFree W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L)) :=
    hΛW1.isFiniteLocallyFree
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits Y _ hΛ
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits Y _ hΛ
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteLimits W _ hΛW
  haveI := tensorSheafLeftFunctor_preservesFiniteColimits W _ hΛW
  have hTW : ∀ E, IsCoherentLike W E → IsCoherentLike W
      ((tensorSheafLeftFunctor W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj (lineBundleDual Y L))).obj E) :=
    fun E hE => tensorSheaf_isCoherentLike W _ _ hΛW hE
  have hcW := sigmaT_central (locallyTrivial_of_hasConstantRank_one hΛW1)
    (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))
  have hI := KSpecialization.AR4.locallyPrincipal_sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ hline
  have hK := killed_cokernel hcW kerCokerClosed_isCoherentLike hTW hV
  have hc := (pushCompat F (dualEval σ) hΛ).killed (finitePush_obj F) _ hK
  have hkill := (ar7Bridge σ hline).idealKills_of_killed _ hc.1 hc.2
  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward F).obj
      (cokernel (ap (tensorSheafLeftFunctor W ((Scheme.Modules.pullback F).obj
        (lineBundleDual Y L))) (sigmaT _ (pullbackSection F (dualEval σ))) V))).IsFinitePresentation :=
    hc.1
  obtain ⟨G, hG, ⟨e⟩⟩ := KSpecialization.AR4.exists_pushforward_iso_of_killedI hI _ hkill
  exact ⟨G, hG, ⟨e⟩⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7g_sub_es_mem
statement:
theorem m7g_sub_es_mem {S : Type u} [CommRing S] (s : σ) (f : MvPolynomial σ S) :
    f - m7g_es s f ∈ Ideal.span {X s}
proof:
:= by
  induction f using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C a => simp [m7g_es]
  | add p q hp hq =>
    rw [map_add, add_sub_add_comm]
    exact add_mem hp hq
  | mul_X p j hp =>
    rw [map_mul]
    have e : p * X j - m7g_es s p * m7g_es s (X j) =
        (p - m7g_es s p) * X j + m7g_es s p * (X j - m7g_es s (X j)) := by ring
    rw [e]
    refine add_mem (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hp) (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ ?_)
    by_cases hj : j = s
    · subst hj
      simp only [m7g_es, eval₂Hom_X', if_true, sub_zero]
      exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
    · simp [m7g_es, hj]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7g_phi_succ_eq_comp_es
statement:
theorem m7g_phi_succ_eq_comp_es {s : σ} {t : ℕ} (hs : ∀ j, (lv j ≤ t + 1 ↔ (lv j ≤ t ∨ j = s))) :
    m7g_phi I lv (t + 1) = (m7g_phi I lv t).comp (m7g_es s)
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro a
    simp [m7g_es, m7g_phi_C]
  · intro j
    rw [RingHom.comp_apply, m7g_phi_X]
    by_cases hj : j = s
    · subst hj
      simp [m7g_es, (hs j).mpr (Or.inr rfl)]
    · by_cases hjt : lv j ≤ t
      · simp [m7g_es, hj, hjt, (hs j).mpr (Or.inl hjt), m7g_phi_X]
      · have : ¬ lv j ≤ t + 1 := fun h ↦ ((hs j).mp h).elim hjt hj
        simp [m7g_es, hj, hjt, this, m7g_phi_X]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7g_phi_succ_eq_es_comp
statement:
theorem m7g_phi_succ_eq_es_comp {s : σ} {t : ℕ} (hs : ∀ j, (lv j ≤ t + 1 ↔ (lv j ≤ t ∨ j = s))) :
    m7g_phi I lv (t + 1) = (m7g_es s).comp (m7g_phi I lv t)
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro a
    simp [m7g_es, m7g_phi_C]
  · intro j
    rw [RingHom.comp_apply, m7g_phi_X, m7g_phi_X]
    by_cases hj : j = s
    · subst hj
      rw [if_pos ((hs j).mpr (Or.inr rfl))]
      split_ifs <;> simp [m7g_es]
    · by_cases hjt : lv j ≤ t
      · simp [hjt, (hs j).mpr (Or.inl hjt)]
      · have : ¬ lv j ≤ t + 1 := fun h ↦ ((hs j).mp h).elim hjt hj
        simp [m7g_es, hj, hjt, this]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7g_ker_succ
statement:
theorem m7g_ker_succ {s : σ} {t : ℕ} (hs : ∀ j, (lv j ≤ t + 1 ↔ (lv j ≤ t ∨ j = s))) :
    RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I lv (t + 1)) = RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I lv t) ⊔ Ideal.span {X s}
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro f hf
    have h1 : m7g_es s f ∈ RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I lv t) := by
      rw [RingHom.mem_ker, ← RingHom.comp_apply, ← m7g_phi_succ_eq_comp_es hs]
      exact hf
    have e : f = m7g_es s f + (f - m7g_es s f) := by ring
    rw [e]
    exact add_mem (Ideal.mem_sup_left h1) (Ideal.mem_sup_right (m7g_sub_es_mem s f))
  · refine sup_le ?_ ?_
    · intro f hf
      rw [RingHom.mem_ker] at hf ⊢
      rw [m7g_phi_succ_eq_es_comp hs, RingHom.comp_apply, hf, map_zero]
    · rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff, SetLike.mem_coe, RingHom.mem_ker, m7g_phi_X,
        if_pos ((hs s).mpr (Or.inr rfl))]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7g_X_not_mem
statement:
theorem m7g_X_not_mem [I.IsPrime] {s : σ} {t : ℕ} (hst : ¬ lv s ≤ t) :
    X s ∉ RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I lv t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker, m7g_phi_X, if_neg hst]
  exact MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero s

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7g_no_prime_between
statement:
theorem m7g_no_prime_between [IsNoetherianRing (MvPolynomial σ R)] [I.IsPrime] {s : σ} {t : ℕ}
    (hs : ∀ j, (lv j ≤ t + 1 ↔ (lv j ≤ t ∨ j = s))) (P : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R)) [P.IsPrime]
    (h1 : RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I lv t) ≤ P) (h2 : P ≤ RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I lv (t + 1))) :
    P = RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I lv t) ∨ P = RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I lv (t + 1))
proof:
:= by
  set Q := RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I lv t) with hQ
  set Q' := RingHom.ker (m7g_phi I lv (t + 1)) with hQ'
  haveI : Q.IsPrime := m7g_ker_isPrime I lv t
  haveI : Q'.IsPrime := m7g_ker_isPrime I lv (t + 1)
  have hsup : Q' = Q ⊔ Ideal.span {X s} := m7g_ker_succ hs
  by_cases hx : X s ∈ P
  · right
    refine le_antisymm h2 ?_
    rw [hsup]
    exact sup_le h1 (by rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]; exact hx)
  · left
    by_contra hne
    have hmin : Q' ∈ (Q ⊔ Ideal.span {X s}).minimalPrimes := by
      rw [← hsup]
      exact ⟨⟨inferInstance, le_rfl⟩, fun J hJ _ ↦ hJ.2⟩
    have hht := Ideal.map_height_le_one_of_mem_minimalPrimes hmin
    let f := Ideal.Quotient.mk Q
    have hf : Function.Surjective f := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    have hkP : RingHom.ker f ≤ P := by rw [Ideal.mk_ker]; exact h1
    have hkQ' : RingHom.ker f ≤ Q' := hkP.trans h2
    haveI hPb : (P.map f).IsPrime := Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective hf hkP
    haveI : (Q'.map f).IsPrime := Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective hf hkQ'
    haveI : (⊥ : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R ⧸ Q)).IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_bot
    have hcP : (P.map f).comap f = P := by
      rw [Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ hf, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, sup_eq_left.mpr hkP]
    have hlt1 : (⊥ : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R ⧸ Q)) < P.map f := by
      refine bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.mpr fun h ↦ hne ?_
      refine le_antisymm ?_ h1
      rw [← hcP, h, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, Ideal.mk_ker]
    have hlt2 : P.map f < Q'.map f := by
      refine lt_of_le_of_ne (Ideal.map_mono h2) fun h ↦ hx ?_
      rw [← hcP, h, Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ hf, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot,
        sup_eq_left.mpr hkQ', hsup]
      exact Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.subset_span rfl)
    have e1 := Ideal.height_add_one_le_of_lt_of_isPrime hlt1
    have e2 := Ideal.height_add_one_le_of_lt_of_isPrime hlt2
    have e3 : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ (Q'.map f).height := by
      calc (2 : ℕ∞) = 0 + 1 + 1 := by norm_num
        _ ≤ (⊥ : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ R ⧸ Q)).height + 1 + 1 := by gcongr; exact zero_le
        _ ≤ (P.map f).height + 1 := by gcongr
        _ ≤ _ := e2
    have := e3.trans hht
    norm_num at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7g_map_max_iso
statement:
theorem m7g_map_max_iso {A B : CommRingCat.{u}} (e : A ≅ B) [IsLocalRing A] [IsLocalRing B] :
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).map e.hom.hom = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B
proof:
:= by
  have : ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).map e.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv).IsMaximal :=
    Ideal.map_isMaximal_of_equiv _
  exact IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7g_map_max_localRingHom
statement:
theorem m7g_map_max_localRingHom {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S)
    (Q : Ideal S) [Q.IsPrime] (h : (Q.comap f).map f = Q) :
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime (Q.comap f))).map
        (Localization.localRingHom (Q.comap f) Q f rfl) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime Q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal, Ideal.map_map]
  have e : (Localization.localRingHom (Q.comap f) Q f rfl).comp
      (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime (Q.comap f))) =
      (algebraMap S (Localization.AtPrime Q)).comp f := by
    ext x
    exact Localization.localRingHom_to_map _ _ _ rfl x
  rw [e, ← Ideal.map_map, h, Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7g_coeff_spec_eq_one
statement:
theorem m7g_coeff_spec_eq_one {R S : CommRingCat.{u}} (φ : R ⟶ S) (p : PrimeSpectrum S)
    (h : (p.asIdeal.comap φ.hom).map φ.hom = p.asIdeal) :
    flatPullbackCoeff (Spec.map φ) p = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hmax : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((Spec R).presheaf.stalk (Spec.map φ p))).map
      ((Spec.map φ).stalkMap p).hom = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((Spec S).presheaf.stalk p) := by
    rw [← Scheme.localRingHom_comp_stalkIso]
    change Ideal.map ((Spec.stalkIso S p).inv.hom.comp ((Localization.localRingHom _ _ φ.hom rfl).comp
      (Spec.stalkIso R (PrimeSpectrum.comap φ.hom p)).hom.hom))
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((Spec R).presheaf.stalk (PrimeSpectrum.comap φ.hom p))) = _
    rw [← Ideal.map_map, ← Ideal.map_map]
    have h1 := m7g_map_max_iso (Spec.stalkIso R (PrimeSpectrum.comap φ.hom p))
    have h2 := m7g_map_max_localRingHom φ.hom p.asIdeal h
    have h3 := m7g_map_max_iso (Spec.stalkIso S p).symm
    exact (congrArg (Ideal.map _) ((congrArg (Ideal.map _) h1).trans h2)).trans h3
  unfold flatPullbackCoeff
  rw [hmax]
  haveI : IsSimpleModule ((Spec S).presheaf.stalk p)
      ((Spec S).presheaf.stalk p ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((Spec S).presheaf.stalk p)) :=
    isSimpleModule_iff_isCoatom.mpr (Ideal.isMaximal_def.mp inferInstance)
  rw [Module.length_eq_one]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7g_finrank_residue_eq_one
statement:
theorem m7g_finrank_residue_eq_one {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsLocalRing B] (φ : A →+* B) [IsLocalHom φ]
    (h : ∀ b, ∃ a, b - φ a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B) :
    @Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) _ _
      (RingHom.toAlgebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map φ)).toModule = 1
proof:
:= by
  letI := RingHom.toAlgebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map φ)
  refine finrank_eq_one_iff'.mpr ⟨1, one_ne_zero, fun w ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective w
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h b
  refine ⟨IsLocalRing.residue A a, ?_⟩
  rw [Algebra.smul_def, mul_one, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra,
    IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map_residue]
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff]
  have := neg_mem ha
  rwa [neg_sub] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7g_lrh_surj_mod
statement:
theorem m7g_lrh_surj_mod {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S) (Q : Ideal S)
    [Q.IsPrime] (g : S → R) (hg : ∀ b, b - f (g b) ∈ Q) (β : Localization.AtPrime Q) :
    ∃ α, β - Localization.localRingHom (Q.comap f) Q f rfl α ∈
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime Q)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨b, s⟩, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.mk'_surjective Q.primeCompl β
  have hs : g s ∈ (Q.comap f).primeCompl := by
    intro hgs
    apply s.2
    have := add_mem (hg s) hgs
    rwa [sub_add_cancel] at this
  refine ⟨IsLocalization.mk' (Localization.AtPrime (Q.comap f)) (g b) ⟨g s, hs⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [Localization.localRingHom_mk']
  change IsLocalization.mk' _ b s - _ ∈ _
  rw [← IsLocalization.mk'_sub]
  refine (IsLocalization.AtPrime.mk'_mem_maximal_iff (S := Localization.AtPrime Q) (I := Q) _ _
    inferInstance).mpr ?_
  have e : b * f (g s) - f (g b) * s = (b - f (g b)) * f (g s) - f (g b) * (s - f (g s)) := by
    ring
  change b * f (g s) - f (g b) * s ∈ Q
  rw [e]
  exact sub_mem (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (hg b)) (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (hg s))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7g_degree_spec_eq_one
statement:
theorem m7g_degree_spec_eq_one {R S : CommRingCat.{u}} (φ : R ⟶ S) (p : PrimeSpectrum S)
    (g : S → R) (hg : ∀ b, b - φ.hom (g b) ∈ p.asIdeal) :
    (Spec.map φ).degree p = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold Scheme.Hom.degree
  refine m7g_finrank_residue_eq_one _ fun b ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := m7g_lrh_surj_mod φ.hom p.asIdeal g hg ((Spec.stalkIso S p).hom b)
  refine ⟨(Spec.stalkIso R (PrimeSpectrum.comap φ.hom p)).inv α, ?_⟩
  have hst := Scheme.localRingHom_comp_stalkIso φ p
  have key : ∀ y, ((Spec.map φ).stalkMap p).hom y = (Spec.stalkIso S p).inv.hom
      (Localization.localRingHom _ _ φ.hom rfl
        ((Spec.stalkIso R (PrimeSpectrum.comap φ.hom p)).hom.hom y)) := fun y ↦ by
    rw [← hst]
    rfl
  have ha : (Spec.stalkIso R (PrimeSpectrum.comap φ.hom p)).hom.hom
      ((Spec.stalkIso R (PrimeSpectrum.comap φ.hom p)).inv.hom α) = α := by
    rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Iso.inv_hom_id]
    rfl
  have e : ((Spec.map φ).stalkMap p).hom ((Spec.stalkIso R (PrimeSpectrum.comap φ.hom p)).inv α) =
      (Spec.stalkIso S p).inv.hom (Localization.localRingHom _ _ φ.hom rfl α) := by
    rw [key]
    exact congrArg _ (congrArg _ ha)
  rw [e]
  have eb : b = (Spec.stalkIso S p).inv.hom ((Spec.stalkIso S p).hom.hom b) := by simp
  rw [eb, ← map_sub, ← m7g_map_max_iso (Spec.stalkIso S p).symm]
  exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hα

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7g_degree_openImmersion
statement:
theorem m7g_degree_openImmersion {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j] (x : X) :
    j.degree x = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold Scheme.Hom.degree
  refine m7g_finrank_residue_eq_one _ fun b ↦ ⟨(inv (j.stalkMap x)).hom b, ?_⟩
  have : (j.stalkMap x).hom ((inv (j.stalkMap x)).hom b) = b := by
    rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, IsIso.inv_hom_id]
    rfl
  rw [this, sub_self]
  exact zero_mem _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7g_J_toBase
statement:
theorem m7g_J_toBase (i : C.I) [Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)]
    (a : Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1)) :
    m7g_J C i a ≫ C.toBase = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPolynomial.C :
      Γ(X, C.U i) →+* MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a)
        Γ(X, C.U i))) ≫ (C.isAffine i).fromSpec
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : C.chartι i ≫ C.toBase =
      intrinsicToSpec (R := Γ(X, C.U i)) (M := E.val.obj (Opposite.op (C.U i))) ≫
        (C.isAffine i).fromSpec := by
    rw [C.chartι_toBase]
    rfl
  have h2 : inv (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace (m7g_b C i)) ≫
      intrinsicToSpec (R := Γ(X, C.U i)) (M := E.val.obj (Opposite.op (C.U i))) =
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) := by
    rw [IsIso.inv_comp_eq, intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace_comp_toSpec]
  have h3 : inv (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace (m7g_b C i)) ≫ C.chartι i ≫ C.toBase =
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) ≫
        (C.isAffine i).fromSpec := by
    have := congrArg (fun q ↦ inv (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace (m7g_b C i)) ≫ q) h1
    refine this.trans ?_
    rw [← Category.assoc, h2]
  change m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a ≫
    inv (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace (m7g_b C i)) ≫ C.chartι i ≫ C.toBase = _
  refine (congrArg (fun q ↦ m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a ≫ q)
    h3).trans ?_
  rw [← Category.assoc, m6pb_stdChart_toSpec]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7g_J_apply_toBase
statement:
theorem m7g_J_apply_toBase (i : C.I) [Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)]
    (a : Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1))
    (u : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a)
      Γ(X, C.U i))) :
    C.toBase (m7g_J C i a u) =
      (C.isAffine i).fromSpec (PrimeSpectrum.comap (MvPolynomial.C : Γ(X, C.U i) →+*
        MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a) Γ(X, C.U i)) u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, m7g_J_toBase, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7g_exists_J
statement:
theorem m7g_exists_J (i : C.I) [Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)] (x : C.scheme)
    (hx : C.toBase x ∈ C.U i) :
    ∃ (a : Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1))
      (u : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a)
        Γ(X, C.U i))), m7g_J C i a u = x
proof:
:= by
  have hx1 : x ∈ Set.range (C.chartι i) := by
    have hpb := C.isPullback_chartι_toBase i
    rw [← hpb.isoPullback_hom_fst, m6pb_range_iso_comp, Scheme.Pullback.range_fst,
      Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
    exact hx
  obtain ⟨x1, rfl⟩ := hx1
  set x2 := intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace (m7g_b C i) x1 with hx2
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, x2 ∈ coordinateOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a := by
    have : x2 ∈ (⊤ : (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space Γ(X, C.U i)
        (C.positiveRankDimension i)).Opens) := trivial
    rw [← coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top] at this
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp this
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : x2 ∈ Set.range (m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a) := by
    rw [m6pb_range_stdChart]
    exact ha
  refine ⟨a, v, ?_⟩
  change C.chartι i (inv (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace (m7g_b C i))
    (m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a v)) = C.chartι i x1
  rw [hv, hx2]
  change C.chartι i ((intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace (m7g_b C i) ≫
    inv (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace (m7g_b C i))) x1) = C.chartι i x1
  rw [IsIso.hom_inv_id]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7g_awayCoordinateEquiv_elem
statement:
theorem m7g_awayCoordinateEquiv_elem (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) {a : Fin (n + 1)}
    (h0 : (0 : Fin (n + 1)) ≠ a) :
    awayCoordinateEquiv R n a (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.isLocalizationElem
      (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n a) (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n 0)) =
      MvPolynomial.X ⟨0, h0⟩
proof:
:= by
  unfold awayCoordinateEquiv
  rw [RingEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
  change _ = awayCoordinateHom R n a (MvPolynomial.X ⟨0, h0⟩)
  rw [awayCoordinateHom, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X']
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  simp [coordinateRatio, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7g_overlap
statement:
theorem m7g_overlap (i : C.I) [Nonempty (C.basisIndex i)]
    {a : Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1)} (h0 : (0 : Fin _) ≠ a)
    (u : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a)
      Γ(X, C.U i)))
    (hu : (MvPolynomial.X ⟨0, h0⟩ : MvPolynomial _ Γ(X, C.U i)) ∉ u.asIdeal) :
    ∃ u0, m7g_J C i 0 u0 = m7g_J C i a u
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a u ∈ coordinateOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0 := by
    have hpre := Proj.awayι_preimage_basicOpen (grading Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i))
      (f_deg := coordinate_mem_degree_one Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a) (hm := Nat.zero_lt_one)
      (g_deg := coordinate_mem_degree_one Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0) (hm' := Nat.zero_lt_one)
    change Spec.map (awayCoordinateEquiv Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a).toCommRingCatIso.hom u ∈
      Proj.awayι (grading Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i)) (coordinate Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a) (coordinate_mem_degree_one Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a)
        Nat.zero_lt_one ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen (grading Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i)) (coordinate Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0)
    rw [hpre]
    change awayCoordinateEquiv Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a
      (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.isLocalizationElem
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a)
        (coordinate_mem_degree_one Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0)) ∉ u.asIdeal
    rw [m7g_awayCoordinateEquiv_elem Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) h0]
    exact hu
  obtain ⟨u0, hu0⟩ : m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a u ∈
      Set.range (m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0) := by
    rw [m6pb_range_stdChart]
    exact hmem
  refine ⟨u0, ?_⟩
  change C.chartι i (inv (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace (m7g_b C i))
    (m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0 u0)) = C.chartι i (inv (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace (m7g_b C i))
    (m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a u))
  rw [hu0]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7g_lv_pos
statement: theorem m7g_lv_pos (j : AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0) : 0 < (j.1 : ℕ)
proof:
:=
  Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h ↦ j.2 (Fin.ext h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7g_comap_eq_q
statement:
theorem m7g_comap_eq_q {a : Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1)}
    (u : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a)
      Γ(X, C.U i))) (hu : C.toBase (m7g_J C i a u) = v) :
    PrimeSpectrum.comap MvPolynomial.C u = m7g_q C i hv
proof:
:= by
  apply (C.isAffine i).fromSpec.isOpenEmbedding.injective
  rw [← m7g_J_apply_toBase, hu]
  exact ((C.isAffine i).fromSpec_primeIdealOf ⟨v, hv⟩).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7g_base
statement: theorem m7g_base (t : ℕ) : C.toBase (m7g_w C i hv t) = v
proof:
:= by
  rw [m7g_w, m7g_J_apply_toBase]
  have : PrimeSpectrum.comap MvPolynomial.C (m7g_Q C i hv t) = m7g_q C i hv :=
    PrimeSpectrum.ext (m7g_comap_ker _ _ t)
  rw [this]
  exact (C.isAffine i).fromSpec_primeIdealOf ⟨v, hv⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7g_Q_zero
statement:
theorem m7g_Q_zero :
    (m7g_Q C i hv 0).asIdeal = (m7g_q C i hv).asIdeal.map MvPolynomial.C
proof:
:=
  m7g_ker_zero _ _ (m7g_lv_pos C i)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7g_coeff_zero
statement: theorem m7g_coeff_zero : flatPullbackCoeff C.toBase (m7g_w C i hv 0) = 1
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Flat (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPolynomial.C : Γ(X, C.U i) →+*
      MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0) Γ(X, C.U i)))) := by
    rw [Flat.SpecMap_iff]
    change (algebraMap Γ(X, C.U i)
      (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0) Γ(X, C.U i))).Flat
    exact RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff.mpr Module.Flat.of_free
  have h1 := m6pb_coeff_comp (m7g_J C i 0) C.toBase (m7g_Q C i hv 0)
  rw [flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion (m7g_J C i 0), mul_one, m7g_J_toBase, m6pb_coeff_comp,
    flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion (C.isAffine i).fromSpec, one_mul] at h1
  rw [m7g_w, ← h1]
  apply m7g_coeff_spec_eq_one
  change ((m7g_Q C i hv 0).asIdeal.comap MvPolynomial.C).map MvPolynomial.C =
    (m7g_Q C i hv 0).asIdeal
  exact (congrArg (Ideal.map _) (m7g_comap_ker _ _ 0)).trans (m7g_Q_zero C i hv).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7g_degree
statement:
theorem m7g_degree (t : ℕ) (ht : C.positiveRankDimension i ≤ t) :
    C.toBase.degree (m7g_w C i hv t) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := hom_degree_comp (m7g_J C i 0) C.toBase (m7g_Q C i hv t)
  rw [m7g_degree_openImmersion (m7g_J C i 0), one_mul, m7g_J_toBase, hom_degree_comp,
    m7g_degree_openImmersion (C.isAffine i).fromSpec, mul_one] at h1
  rw [m7g_w, ← h1]
  refine m7g_degree_spec_eq_one _ _ (fun b ↦ MvPolynomial.constantCoeff b) fun b ↦ ?_
  change b - MvPolynomial.C (MvPolynomial.constantCoeff b) ∈ RingHom.ker _
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker, map_sub, m7g_phi_eq_constantCoeff _ _ t (fun j ↦ by
    have := j.1.2
    omega)]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7g_eq_w0_of_J0
statement:
theorem m7g_eq_w0_of_J0
    (u : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0)
      Γ(X, C.U i))) (hu : C.toBase (m7g_J C i 0 u) = v)
    (hc : flatPullbackCoeff C.toBase (m7g_J C i 0 u) ≠ 0) :
    m7g_J C i 0 u = m7g_w C i hv 0
proof:
:= by
  have hq := m7g_comap_eq_q C i hv u hu
  have hle : m7g_Q C i hv 0 ≤ u := by
    change (m7g_Q C i hv 0).asIdeal ≤ u.asIdeal
    rw [m7g_Q_zero, Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, ← hq]
    exact le_rfl
  have hsp : m7g_w C i hv 0 ⤳ m7g_J C i 0 u :=
    ((PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes _ _).mp hle).map (m7g_J C i 0).continuous
  by_contra hne
  exact hc (m6pb_coeff_eq_zero_of_specializes C.toBase hsp (Ne.symm hne)
    (by rw [m7g_base, hu]))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7g_coeff_unique
statement:
theorem m7g_coeff_unique (x : C.scheme) (hx : C.toBase x = v)
    (hc : flatPullbackCoeff C.toBase x ≠ 0) : x = m7g_w C i hv 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, u, rfl⟩ := m7g_exists_J C i x (hx ▸ hv)
  let lv1 : AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a → ℕ := fun _ ↦ 1
  let Q0a : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a)
      Γ(X, C.U i)) :=
    ⟨RingHom.ker (m7g_phi (m7g_q C i hv).asIdeal lv1 0), m7g_ker_isPrime _ _ _⟩
  have hQ0a : Q0a.asIdeal = (m7g_q C i hv).asIdeal.map MvPolynomial.C :=
    m7g_ker_zero _ _ (fun _ ↦ Nat.one_pos)
  have hq := m7g_comap_eq_q C i hv u hx
  have hle : Q0a ≤ u := by
    change Q0a.asIdeal ≤ u.asIdeal
    rw [hQ0a, Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, ← hq]
    exact le_rfl
  have hsp : m7g_J C i a Q0a ⤳ m7g_J C i a u :=
    ((PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes _ _).mp hle).map (m7g_J C i a).continuous
  have hbase : C.toBase (m7g_J C i a Q0a) = v := by
    rw [m7g_J_apply_toBase]
    have : PrimeSpectrum.comap MvPolynomial.C Q0a = m7g_q C i hv :=
      PrimeSpectrum.ext (m7g_comap_ker _ _ 0)
    rw [this]
    exact (C.isAffine i).fromSpec_primeIdealOf ⟨v, hv⟩
  have hA : m7g_J C i a Q0a = m7g_J C i a u := by
    by_contra hne
    exact hc (m6pb_coeff_eq_zero_of_specializes C.toBase hsp hne (by rw [hbase, hx]))
  obtain ⟨u0, hu0⟩ : ∃ u0, m7g_J C i 0 u0 = m7g_J C i a u := by
    by_cases ha : (0 : Fin _) = a
    · subst ha
      exact ⟨u, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨u0, hu0⟩ := m7g_overlap C i ha Q0a
        (m7g_X_not_mem (I := (m7g_q C i hv).asIdeal) (lv := lv1) (by simp [lv1]))
      exact ⟨u0, hu0.trans hA⟩
  rw [← hu0] at hx hc ⊢
  exact m7g_eq_w0_of_J0 C i hv u0 hx hc

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7g_step
statement:
theorem m7g_step [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (t : ℕ) (ht : t < C.positiveRankDimension i) :
    ∃ z : pointClosureScheme (m7g_w C i hv t), coheight z = 1 ∧
      pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) z = m7g_w C i hv (t + 1)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, C.U i) :=
    IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian ⟨C.U i, C.isAffine i⟩
  let s : AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0 :=
    ⟨⟨t + 1, by omega⟩, fun h ↦ by simp [Fin.ext_iff] at h⟩
  have hs : ∀ j : AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0,
      ((j.1 : ℕ) ≤ t + 1 ↔ ((j.1 : ℕ) ≤ t ∨ j = s)) := by
    intro j
    constructor
    · intro h
      by_cases h' : (j.1 : ℕ) ≤ t
      · exact Or.inl h'
      · right
        apply Subtype.ext
        apply Fin.ext
        change (j.1 : ℕ) = t + 1
        omega
    · rintro (h | rfl)
      · omega
      · exact le_rfl
  have hst : ¬ ((s.1 : ℕ) ≤ t) := by
    change ¬ (t + 1 ≤ t)
    omega
  have hle : m7g_Q C i hv t ≤ m7g_Q C i hv (t + 1) := by
    change RingHom.ker _ ≤ RingHom.ker _
    rw [m7g_ker_succ hs]
    exact le_sup_left
  have hne : m7g_Q C i hv t ≠ m7g_Q C i hv (t + 1) := by
    intro h
    apply m7g_X_not_mem (I := (m7g_q C i hv).asIdeal)
      (lv := fun j : AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) 0 ↦ (j.1 : ℕ)) hst
    have e := congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal h
    change RingHom.ker _ = RingHom.ker _ at e
    rw [e, m7g_ker_succ hs]
    exact Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.subset_span rfl)
  have hJinj := (m7g_J C i 0).isOpenEmbedding.injective
  have hJind := (m7g_J C i 0).isOpenEmbedding.isInducing
  have hsp : m7g_w C i hv t ⤳ m7g_w C i hv (t + 1) :=
    ((PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes _ _).mp hle).map (m7g_J C i 0).continuous
  have hmem : m7g_w C i hv (t + 1) ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t)) := by
    rw [range_pointClosureι]
    exact specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp hsp
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hmem
  refine ⟨z, ?_, hz⟩
  set ι := pointClosureι (m7g_w C i hv t) with hιdef
  set g := pointClosureGenericPoint (m7g_w C i hv t) with hgdef
  have hιg : ι g = m7g_w C i hv t := pointClosureι_genericPoint _
  have hιe := ι.isEmbedding
  have hall : ∀ y, y ≤ g := by
    intro y
    rw [Scheme.le_iff_specializes, ← hιe.isInducing.specializes_iff, hιg,
      specializes_iff_mem_closure, ← range_pointClosureι]
    exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
  have hgmax : IsMax g := fun y _ ↦ hall y
  have hzg : z ≠ g := by
    intro h
    apply hne
    apply hJinj
    change m7g_w C i hv t = m7g_w C i hv (t + 1)
    exact (hιg.symm.trans (congrArg (fun y ↦ ι y) h.symm)).trans hz
  have hanti : ∀ a b : pointClosureScheme (m7g_w C i hv t), a ≤ b → b ≤ a → a = b :=
    fun a b hab hba ↦ ((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hba).antisymm (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hab)).eq
  have hzlt : z < g := lt_of_le_not_ge (hall z) fun h ↦ hzg (hanti _ _ (hall z) h)
  have hup : ∀ y, z < y → y = g := by
    intro y hy
    have h1 : ι y ⤳ ι z := (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hy.le).map ι.continuous
    have h2 : m7g_w C i hv t ⤳ ι y :=
      (congrArg (fun a ↦ a ⤳ ι y) hιg).mp ((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp (hall y)).map ι.continuous)
    rw [hz] at h1
    have hr : ι y ∈ Set.range (m7g_J C i 0) :=
      h1.mem_open (m7g_J C i 0).isOpenEmbedding.isOpen_range ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := hr
    rw [← hP] at h1 h2
    have hP1 : (m7g_Q C i hv t).asIdeal ≤ P.asIdeal :=
      (PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes _ _).mpr (hJind.specializes_iff.mp h2)
    have hP2 : P.asIdeal ≤ (m7g_Q C i hv (t + 1)).asIdeal :=
      (PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes _ _).mpr (hJind.specializes_iff.mp h1)
    rcases m7g_no_prime_between hs P.asIdeal hP1 hP2 with h | h
    · apply hιe.injective
      rw [hιg, ← hP]
      exact congrArg (m7g_J C i 0) (PrimeSpectrum.ext h)
    · exfalso
      apply hy.ne'
      apply hιe.injective
      rw [hz, ← hP]
      exact congrArg (m7g_J C i 0) (PrimeSpectrum.ext h)
  have hle1 : coheight z ≤ 1 := by
    have : coheight z ≤ ((1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
      rw [coheight_le_coe_iff]
      intro y hy
      rw [hup y hy, coheight_eq_zero.mpr hgmax]
      norm_num
    simpa using this
  have hne0 : coheight z ≠ 0 :=
    coheight_ne_zero.mpr fun hm ↦ hzg (hanti _ _ (hall z) (hm (hall z)))
  exact le_antisymm hle1 (Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hne0)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7gW_step
statement:
theorem m7gW_step [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (hC : ∀ i, Nat.card (C.basisIndex i) = e + 1) (v : X) : ∀ t < e, ∃ z : pointClosureScheme (m7gW C hC v t),
    coheight z = 1 ∧ pointClosureι (m7gW C hC v t) z = m7gW C hC v (t + 1)
proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.m7s_genericRank_pointClosure
statement:
theorem m7s_genericRank_pointClosure (L : W.Modules) (hL : HasConstantRank W L 1) (v : W) :
    SingularCurve.genericRank (pointClosureScheme v)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj L) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin, hcard⟩ :=
    hasConstantRank_pullback (pointClosureScheme v) (pointClosureι v) L 1 hL
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := hqfin
  have hcover : TopologicalSpace.IsOpenCover q.X :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := pointClosureScheme v) q.X).mp q.coversTop
  have hη : genericPoint (pointClosureScheme v) ∈ ⋃ i, (q.X i : Set (pointClosureScheme v)) := by
    rw [hcover.iSup_set_eq_univ]
    exact Set.mem_univ _
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hη
  rw [SingularCurve.genericRank_eq_natCard_localGenerators _ _ q i hi, hcard i]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIASM.zsClassP
statement:
theorem zsClassP
    (bridge : lambdaMinusOne (RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).tautologicalKernel
      ((RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).hasConstantRank_tautologicalKernel M.hE) =
      kosClassX M.CX M.hN)
    (injE : Function.Injective (k0ToG0 E)) (x : K0 X) (ε : K0 E)
    (hε : k0ToG0 E ε = finitePushforward s (k0ToG0 X x)) :
    ε = pullbackK0 M.φ.hom
      (pullbackK0 (RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).toBase x * kosClassX M.CX M.hN)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherian (RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).scheme :=
    (RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).isNoetherian_scheme
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian E := inferInstance
  apply injE
  rw [ARRG45C.k0ToG0_pullbackK0, DFunLike.congr_fun
    (ARRG45C.flatPullbackG0_iso_eq_finitePushforward_inv M.φ) _, hε]
  have hKP := RiemannRoch.KNFB.koszulProd_adaptedCover (N := conormalSheaf i) M.CN M.hE
  rw [bridge] at hKP
  rw [k0ToG0_mul, ← hKP]
  have hpf := finitePushforward_k0ToG0_mul_pullback
    (RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).zeroSection (1 : K0 X)
    (pullbackK0 (RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).toBase x)
  have hx : (1 : K0 X) * pullbackK0RingHom (RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).zeroSection
      (pullbackK0 (RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).toBase x) = x := by
    rw [one_mul, pullbackK0RingHom_apply, pullbackK0_comp_apply,
      AffineFrameCover.zeroSection_toBase, pullbackK0_id]
    rfl
  rw [hx] at hpf
  rw [← hpf]
  have hzs : (RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).zeroSection ≫ M.φ.inv = s := by
    rw [← M.hφs, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
  have h2 := DFunLike.congr_fun (ARRG45C.finitePushforward_comp
    (RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).zeroSection M.φ.inv) (k0ToG0 X x)
  have h3 := DFunLike.congr_fun (ARRG45C.finitePushforward_congr hzs) (k0ToG0 X x)
  exact h3.symm.trans h2

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIASM.zsClass
statement:
theorem zsClass
    (bridge : lambdaMinusOne (RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).tautologicalKernel
      ((RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).hasConstantRank_tautologicalKernel M.hE) =
      kosClassX M.CX M.hN)
    (injE : Function.Injective (k0ToG0 E)) (x : K0 X) (ε : K0 E)
    (hε : k0ToG0 E ε = finitePushforward s (k0ToG0 X x)) :
    ε = pullbackK0 π x * M.kosE
proof:
:= by
  rw [zsClassP M bridge injE x ε hε]
  have h1 : pullbackK0 π x =
      pullbackK0 M.φ.hom (pullbackK0 (RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).toBase x) := by
    rw [pullbackK0_comp_apply, M.hφπ]
  have hm := (pullbackK0RingHom M.φ.hom).map_mul
    (pullbackK0 (RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).toBase x) (kosClassX M.CX M.hN)
  simp only [pullbackK0RingHom_apply] at hm
  rw [h1, ZSModel.kosE, ← hm]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.CIIASM.zeroSection_of_gates
statement:
theorem zeroSection_of_gates (h : ChExact k (closedPosV4 k)) (G : ZSChowGates M h)
    (bridge : lambdaMinusOne (RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).tautologicalKernel
      ((RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN).hasConstantRank_tautologicalKernel M.hE) =
      kosClassX M.CX M.hN)
    (injE : Function.Injective (k0ToG0 E)) (x : K0 X) (ε : K0 E)
    (hε : k0ToG0 E ε = finitePushforward s (k0ToG0 X x)) :
    totalPushOn (opsV4 k) π (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h ε (fundClass k (W := E))) =
      tauX k (closedPosV4 k) h i x
proof:
:= by
  haveI := M.flat
  have hP := zsClassP M bridge injE x ε hε
  set P := RiemannRoch.KNFA.adaptedCover M.CN with hPdef
  set y : K0 P.scheme := pullbackK0 P.toBase x * kosClassX M.CX M.hN with hy
  
  have h1 : totalPushOn (opsV4 k) M.φ.hom (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h ε (fundClass k (W := E))) =
      chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h y (fundClass k (W := P.scheme)) := by
    rw [hP, chK0_push (closedPosV4 k) h M.φ.hom y, G.fundPush]
  have h2 : totalPushOn (opsV4 k) π (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h ε (fundClass k (W := E))) =
      totalPushOn (opsV4 k) P.toBase
        (totalPushOn (opsV4 k) M.φ.hom (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h ε (fundClass k (W := E)))) := by
    have hcomp : totalPushOn (opsV4 k) P.toBase ∘ₗ totalPushOn (opsV4 k) M.φ.hom =
        totalPushOn (opsV4 k) π := by
      rw [← totalPushOn_comp (opsV4 k) M.φ.hom P.toBase, totalPushOn_congr (opsV4 k) M.hφπ]
    exact (LinearMap.congr_fun hcomp _).symm
  rw [h2, h1]
  have h3 : chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h y = chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h (kosClassX M.CX M.hN) *
      chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h (pullbackK0 P.toBase x) := by
    rw [hy, mul_comm, G.chMul]
  rw [h3, Module.End.mul_apply, ← G.fundPull]
  have h4 := LinearMap.congr_fun (chK_pull_flat (k := k) P.toBase
    ((cpV4 k).projBundle_relDim P M.hC) x) (fundClass k (W := X))
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at h4
  have h5 : chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h (pullbackK0 P.toBase x)
      (totalPullOn (opsV4 k) P.toBase (e + 1) ((cpV4 k).projBundle_relDim P M.hC)
        (fundClass k (W := X))) =
      totalPullOn (opsV4 k) P.toBase (e + 1) ((cpV4 k).projBundle_relDim P M.hC)
        (chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) h x (fundClass k (W := X))) := h4.symm
  rw [h5, G.zxTot]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackProjectiveChartMap_preimage_basisOpen
statement:
theorem pullbackProjectiveChartMap_preimage_basisOpen (a : C.pullbackFrameIndex g)
    (k : C.basisIndex a.1) :
    C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a ⁻¹ᵁ
      linearOpen Γ(Y, C.U a.1) (E.val.obj (op (C.U a.1))) (C.sectionBasis a.1 k) =
    linearOpen Γ(X, C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.obj (op (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)))
      ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionBasis a k)
proof:
:= by
  have h := semilinearSymmetricProjMap_preimage_linearOpen
    (PullbackFrameSections.coefficientMap g (C.U a.1) (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a) a.2.2)
    (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap g a) (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap_spans g a) (C.sectionBasis a.1 k)
  rw [C.pullbackFrameSectionMap_basis g a k] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackProjectiveChartMap_preimage_basisOverlap
statement:
theorem pullbackProjectiveChartMap_preimage_basisOverlap (a : C.pullbackFrameIndex g)
    (k l : C.basisIndex a.1) :
    C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a ⁻¹ᵁ
      linearOverlapOpen Γ(Y, C.U a.1) (E.val.obj (op (C.U a.1)))
        (C.sectionBasis a.1 k) (C.sectionBasis a.1 l) =
    linearOverlapOpen Γ(X, C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.obj (op (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)))
      ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionBasis a k) ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionBasis a l)
proof:
:= by
  have h := semilinearSymmetricProjMap_preimage_linearOverlapOpen
    (PullbackFrameSections.coefficientMap g (C.U a.1) (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a) a.2.2)
    (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap g a) (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap_spans g a)
    (C.sectionBasis a.1 k) (C.sectionBasis a.1 l)
  rw [C.pullbackFrameSectionMap_basis g a k, C.pullbackFrameSectionMap_basis g a l] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackProjectiveChartMap_app_twistTransition_heq
statement:
theorem pullbackProjectiveChartMap_app_twistTransition_heq (a : C.pullbackFrameIndex g)
    (d : ℤ) (k l : C.basisIndex a.1) :
    HEq ((C.pullbackProjectiveChartMap g a).app
      (linearOverlapOpen Γ(Y, C.U a.1) (E.val.obj (op (C.U a.1)))
        (C.sectionBasis a.1 k) (C.sectionBasis a.1 l))
      (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit Γ(Y, C.U a.1) (E.val.obj (op (C.U a.1)))
        d (C.sectionBasis a.1 k) (C.sectionBasis a.1 l)).1)
      (linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit Γ(X, C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E).val.obj (op (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a)))
        d ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionBasis a k) ((C.pullbackFrameCover g).sectionBasis a l)).1
proof:
:= by
  have h := semilinearSymmetricProjMap_app_transitionSectionUnit_heq
    (PullbackFrameSections.coefficientMap g (C.U a.1) (C.pullbackFrameOpen g a) a.2.2)
    (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap g a) (C.pullbackFrameSectionMap_spans g a)
    d (C.sectionBasis a.1 k) (C.sectionBasis a.1 l)
  rw [C.pullbackFrameSectionMap_basis g a k, C.pullbackFrameSectionMap_basis g a l] at h
  exact h
