name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwist_unitToPushforward_mul_naturality
statement:
theorem pullbackTwist_unitToPushforward_mul_naturality
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (a : Γ(Y, ⊤)ˣ) :
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso a).hom ≫
      SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit f.toRingCatSheafHom =
    SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit f.toRingCatSheafHom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso
          (Units.map f.appTop.hom.toMonoidHom a)).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitModulesHom_ext_top
  change Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit f.toRingCatSheafHom) ⊤
      (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso a).hom ⊤ (1 : Γ(Y, ⊤))) =
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso
      (Units.map f.appTop.hom.toMonoidHom a)).hom) ⊤
      (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit f.toRingCatSheafHom) ⊤ (1 : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
  rw [Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app]
  change f.appTop (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso a).hom ⊤ (1 : Γ(Y, ⊤))) =
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso
      (Units.map f.appTop.hom.toMonoidHom a)).hom ⊤ (f.appTop (1 : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
  erw [SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso_hom_app_apply,
    SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso_hom_app_apply]
  simp [SchemeProjectiveSpace.restrictTopUnit]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pullbackTwist_unitMul_naturality
statement:
theorem pullbackTwist_unitMul_naturality
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (a : Γ(Y, ⊤)ˣ) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).map (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso a).hom ≫
      (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso f).hom =
    (SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso f).hom ≫
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso
        (Units.map f.appTop.hom.toMonoidHom a)).hom
proof:
:= by
  change (SheafOfModules.pullback f.toRingCatSheafHom).map
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso a).hom ≫
        SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit f.toRingCatSheafHom =
    SheafOfModules.pullbackObjUnitToUnit f.toRingCatSheafHom ≫
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.unitMulSheafIso
        (Units.map f.appTop.hom.toMonoidHom a)).hom
  apply ((SheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f.toRingCatSheafHom).homEquiv _ _).injective
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left, Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right,
    SheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction_homEquiv_pullbackObjUnitToUnit]
  exact pullbackTwist_unitToPushforward_mul_naturality f a

      (chartT π (r := r) U) U.1.ι (pullback.fst π (toSpec k r))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB4.isPullback_chartRho
statement:
theorem isPullback_chartRho (a : D.ι) :
    IsPullback (chartRho (I.ideal (D.V a)) (D.s a) (D.span_eq a))
      (GlobalBlowup.affineι B I (D.V a)) (chartT π (r := r) (D.V a)) (D.phi π)
proof:
:= by
  have hbig : IsPullback
      (chartRho (I.ideal (D.V a)) (D.s a) (D.span_eq a) ≫
        toSpec Γ(B, (D.V a).1) r ≫ (GlobalBlowup.isAffineOpen B (D.V a)).isoSpec.inv)
      (GlobalBlowup.affineι B I (D.V a)) (D.V a).1.ι (D.phi π ≫ pullback.fst _ _) := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, chartRho_toSpec, D.phi_fst]
    exact GlobalBlowup.isPullback_affine B I (D.V a)
  refine IsPullback.of_right hbig ?_ (isPullback_chartT_open π (D.V a))
  rw [D.affineι_phi π a]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB4.GenData.phi_isClosedImmersion
statement: theorem GenData.phi_isClosedImmersion : IsClosedImmersion (D.phi π)
proof:
:= by
  refine IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.of_openCover (P := @IsClosedImmersion) (D.targetCover π) ?_
  intro a
  have H := (isPullback_chartRho π D a).flip
  change IsClosedImmersion (pullback.snd (D.phi π) (chartT π (r := r) (D.V a)))
  have e : pullback.snd (D.phi π) (chartT π (r := r) (D.V a)) =
      H.isoPullback.inv ≫
        chartRho (I.ideal (D.V a)) (D.s a) (D.span_eq a) := by
    rw [Iso.eq_inv_comp, H.isoPullback_hom_snd]
  rw [e]
  haveI : IsIso H.isoPullback.inv := inferInstance
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB4.span_padGen
statement:
theorem span_padGen (C : GlobalBlowup.CentreGenerators B I) (c : C.ι) :
    I.ideal (C.W c) = Ideal.span (Set.range (padGen C c))
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [C.span c]
    apply Ideal.span_mono
    rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨k.succ, by simp [padGen]⟩
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    induction j using Fin.cases with
    | zero => simp [padGen]
    | succ k => simpa [padGen] using C.mem c k

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB4.blowupRees
statement:
theorem blowupRees (k : Type u) [Field k] (hC : GlobalBlowup.CentreGeneratorsExist k) :
    BlowupRees k
proof:
:= by
  intro B π _ hB I _
  obtain ⟨N, j, hj, hjk⟩ := hB
  haveI := hj
  haveI : IsNoetherian (space k N) := SchemeProjectiveSpace.isNoetherian k N
  haveI : IsNoetherian B :=
    { __ := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian j
      __ := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace j }
  obtain ⟨C⟩ := hC B π ⟨N, j, hj, hjk⟩ I
  exact ⟨C.n, (genData C).phi π, GenData.phi_isClosedImmersion π (genData C), (genData C).phi_fst π⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB4.blowupRees_unconditional
statement: theorem blowupRees_unconditional (k : Type u) [Field k] : BlowupRees k
proof:
:=
  blowupRees k (CIIB3.centreGeneratorsExist k)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB4.blowup_in_class'
statement:
theorem blowup_in_class' (k : Type u) [Field k] (B : Scheme.{u})
    (π : B ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) [IsIntegral B]
    (hB : ∃ (N : ℕ) (j : B ⟶ space k N), IsClosedImmersion j ∧ j ≫ toSpec k N = π)
    (I : B.IdealSheafData) (hne : I ≠ ⊥) :
    IsIntegral (GlobalBlowup.blowup B I) ∧
      ∃ (N : ℕ) (j : GlobalBlowup.blowup B I ⟶ space k N), IsClosedImmersion j ∧
        j ≫ toSpec k N = GlobalBlowup.toBase B I ≫ π
proof:
:=
  blowup_in_class GlobalBlowup.blowupIntegral (blowupRees_unconditional k) B π hB I hne

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.DescentData.overlapProductIso_inv_π
statement:
private theorem overlapProductIso_inv_π
    (D : DescentData Y I) (D' : DescentData Z I)
    (F : Y.Modules ⥤ Z.Modules)
    (eO : D'.overlapCochains ≅ F.obj D.overlapCochains)
    (eOverlap : ∀ ij : I × I, D'.overlapTerm ij ≅ F.obj (D.overlapTerm ij))
    (hO : ∀ ij, eO.hom ≫ F.map (Pi.π D.overlapTerm ij) =
      Pi.π D'.overlapTerm ij ≫ (eOverlap ij).hom)
    (ij : I × I) :
    eO.inv ≫ Pi.π D'.overlapTerm ij =
      F.map (Pi.π D.overlapTerm ij) ≫ (eOverlap ij).inv
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun q => eO.inv ≫ q ≫ (eOverlap ij).inv) (hO ij)
  simpa only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc,
    Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id] using h.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.DescentData.descentLeft_natural_of_components
statement:
theorem descentLeft_natural_of_components
    (D : DescentData Y I) (D' : DescentData Z I)
    (F : Y.Modules ⥤ Z.Modules)
    (eC : D'.chartCochains ≅ F.obj D.chartCochains)
    (eO : D'.overlapCochains ≅ F.obj D.overlapCochains)
    (eChart : ∀ i : I, D'.chartTerm i ≅ F.obj (D.chartTerm i))
    (eOverlap : ∀ ij : I × I, D'.overlapTerm ij ≅ F.obj (D.overlapTerm ij))
    (hC : ∀ i, eC.hom ≫ F.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm i) =
      Pi.π D'.chartTerm i ≫ (eChart i).hom)
    (hO : ∀ ij, eO.hom ≫ F.map (Pi.π D.overlapTerm ij) =
      Pi.π D'.overlapTerm ij ≫ (eOverlap ij).hom)
    (hUnit : ∀ ij : I × I,
      (eChart ij.1).hom ≫ F.map
        (pushforwardPullbackUnit (D.toAmbient ij.1) (D.left ij) (D.module ij.1)) =
      pushforwardPullbackUnit (D'.toAmbient ij.1) (D'.left ij) (D'.module ij.1) ≫
        (eOverlap ij).hom) :
    D'.descentLeft ≫ eO.hom = eC.hom ≫ F.map D.descentLeft
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : D'.descentLeft = eC.hom ≫ F.map D.descentLeft ≫ eO.inv by
    rw [h, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro ij
  have hOi := overlapProductIso_inv_π D D' F eO eOverlap hO ij
  calc
    D'.descentLeft ≫ Pi.π D'.overlapTerm ij =
      Pi.π D'.chartTerm ij.1 ≫
        pushforwardPullbackUnit (D'.toAmbient ij.1) (D'.left ij) (D'.module ij.1) :=
      D'.descentLeft_π ij
    _ = Pi.π D'.chartTerm ij.1 ≫ (eChart ij.1).hom ≫ F.map
        (pushforwardPullbackUnit (D.toAmbient ij.1) (D.left ij) (D.module ij.1)) ≫
        (eOverlap ij).inv := by
      have h := congrArg (fun q => Pi.π D'.chartTerm ij.1 ≫ q ≫ (eOverlap ij).inv)
        (hUnit ij)
      simpa only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id] using h.symm
    _ = eC.hom ≫ F.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm ij.1) ≫ F.map
        (pushforwardPullbackUnit (D.toAmbient ij.1) (D.left ij) (D.module ij.1)) ≫
        (eOverlap ij).inv := by
      have h := congrArg (fun q => q ≫ F.map
        (pushforwardPullbackUnit (D.toAmbient ij.1) (D.left ij) (D.module ij.1)) ≫
        (eOverlap ij).inv) (hC ij.1)
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using h.symm
    _ = eC.hom ≫ F.map D.descentLeft ≫ F.map (Pi.π D.overlapTerm ij) ≫
        (eOverlap ij).inv := by
      have h := congrArg F.map (D.descentLeft_π ij)
      simp only [Functor.map_comp] at h
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg
        (fun q => eC.hom ≫ q ≫ (eOverlap ij).inv) h.symm
    _ = eC.hom ≫ F.map D.descentLeft ≫ eO.inv ≫ Pi.π D'.overlapTerm ij := by
      rw [hOi]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.DescentData.descentRight_natural_of_components
statement:
theorem descentRight_natural_of_components
    (D : DescentData Y I) (D' : DescentData Z I)
    (F : Y.Modules ⥤ Z.Modules)
    (eC : D'.chartCochains ≅ F.obj D.chartCochains)
    (eO : D'.overlapCochains ≅ F.obj D.overlapCochains)
    (eChart : ∀ i : I, D'.chartTerm i ≅ F.obj (D.chartTerm i))
    (eOverlap : ∀ ij : I × I, D'.overlapTerm ij ≅ F.obj (D.overlapTerm ij))
    (hC : ∀ i, eC.hom ≫ F.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm i) =
      Pi.π D'.chartTerm i ≫ (eChart i).hom)
    (hO : ∀ ij, eO.hom ≫ F.map (Pi.π D.overlapTerm ij) =
      Pi.π D'.overlapTerm ij ≫ (eOverlap ij).hom)
    (hRight : ∀ ij : I × I,
      (eChart ij.2).hom ≫ F.map
        (pushforwardPullbackUnit (D.toAmbient ij.2) (D.right ij) (D.module ij.2) ≫
          (pushforwardCongr (D.fac ij).symm).hom.app
            ((pullback (D.right ij)).obj (D.module ij.2)) ≫
          (pushforward (D.left ij ≫ D.toAmbient ij.1)).map
            (D.transition ij).inv) =
      (pushforwardPullbackUnit (D'.toAmbient ij.2) (D'.right ij) (D'.module ij.2) ≫
        (pushforwardCongr (D'.fac ij).symm).hom.app
          ((pullback (D'.right ij)).obj (D'.module ij.2)) ≫
        (pushforward (D'.left ij ≫ D'.toAmbient ij.1)).map
          (D'.transition ij).inv) ≫ (eOverlap ij).hom) :
    D'.descentRight ≫ eO.hom = eC.hom ≫ F.map D.descentRight
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : D'.descentRight = eC.hom ≫ F.map D.descentRight ≫ eO.inv by
    rw [h, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro ij
  have hOi := overlapProductIso_inv_π D D' F eO eOverlap hO ij
  let r : D.chartTerm ij.2 ⟶ D.overlapTerm ij :=
    pushforwardPullbackUnit (D.toAmbient ij.2) (D.right ij) (D.module ij.2) ≫
      (pushforwardCongr (D.fac ij).symm).hom.app
        ((pullback (D.right ij)).obj (D.module ij.2)) ≫
      (pushforward (D.left ij ≫ D.toAmbient ij.1)).map (D.transition ij).inv
  let r' : D'.chartTerm ij.2 ⟶ D'.overlapTerm ij :=
    pushforwardPullbackUnit (D'.toAmbient ij.2) (D'.right ij) (D'.module ij.2) ≫
      (pushforwardCongr (D'.fac ij).symm).hom.app
        ((pullback (D'.right ij)).obj (D'.module ij.2)) ≫
      (pushforward (D'.left ij ≫ D'.toAmbient ij.1)).map (D'.transition ij).inv
  have hr : (eChart ij.2).hom ≫ F.map r = r' ≫ (eOverlap ij).hom := hRight ij
  have hD : D.descentRight ≫ Pi.π D.overlapTerm ij =
      Pi.π D.chartTerm ij.2 ≫ r := D.descentRight_π ij
  have hD' : D'.descentRight ≫ Pi.π D'.overlapTerm ij =
      Pi.π D'.chartTerm ij.2 ≫ r' := D'.descentRight_π ij
  calc
    D'.descentRight ≫ Pi.π D'.overlapTerm ij =
      Pi.π D'.chartTerm ij.2 ≫ r' := hD'
    _ = Pi.π D'.chartTerm ij.2 ≫ (eChart ij.2).hom ≫ F.map r ≫
        (eOverlap ij).inv := by
      have h := congrArg (fun q => Pi.π D'.chartTerm ij.2 ≫ q ≫ (eOverlap ij).inv) hr
      simpa only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id] using h.symm
    _ = eC.hom ≫ F.map (Pi.π D.chartTerm ij.2) ≫ F.map r ≫
        (eOverlap ij).inv := by
      have h := congrArg (fun q => q ≫ F.map r ≫ (eOverlap ij).inv) (hC ij.2)
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using h.symm
    _ = eC.hom ≫ F.map D.descentRight ≫ F.map (Pi.π D.overlapTerm ij) ≫
        (eOverlap ij).inv := by
      have h := congrArg F.map hD
      simp only [Functor.map_comp] at h
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg
        (fun q => eC.hom ≫ q ≫ (eOverlap ij).inv) h.symm
    _ = eC.hom ≫ F.map D.descentRight ≫ eO.inv ≫ Pi.π D'.overlapTerm ij := by
      rw [hOi]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4D.chBundle_pull_flat
statement:
theorem chBundle_pull_flat (E : Y.Modules) (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y E) (β : TotalChow Y) :
    totalPullOn (opsV4 k) g d hd (chBundle k (closedPosV4 k) E β) =
      chBundle k (closedPosV4 k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E)
        (totalPullOn (opsV4 k) g d hd β)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty Y := CHEXACT.nonempty_of_fact k (W := Y)
  haveI : Nonempty X := CHEXACT.nonempty_of_fact k (W := X)
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := CHEXACT.exists_rank k hE
  have hr' := hasConstantRank_pullback X g E r hr
  have hE' : IsFiniteLocallyFree X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E) :=
    pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global g E hE
  have hW : WhitneyConstRankOn (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) (closedPosV4 k) :=
    whitney_projectiveIntegral (k := k) (closedPosV4 k)
  rw [chBundle_eq_chTot (closedPosV4 k) hE, chBundle_eq_chTot (closedPosV4 k) hE']
  have key : totalPullOn (opsV4 k) g d hd ∘ₗ chTot (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) (closedPosV4 k) E =
      chTot (opsV4 k) (cpV4 k) (closedPosV4 k) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj E) ∘ₗ
        totalPullOn (opsV4 k) g d hd := by
    apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
    intro m
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro y
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
    rw [totalPullOn_lof, chTot_lof_stable hW hr (N := m + d + 1) (by omega),
      chTot_lof_stable hW hr' (N := m + d + 1) (by omega), map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
    have := LinearMap.congr_fun (chOpOn_flat (cp := cpV4 k) (hP := closedPosV4 k) g d hd E hr n)
      (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun i ↦ RationalDimChow Y i) m y)
    simpa [totalPullOn_lof] using this
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun key β

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4B.flatPullbackCoeff_generic_eq_one
statement:
theorem flatPullbackCoeff_generic_eq_one {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hη : f (genericPoint X) = genericPoint Y) :
    flatPullbackCoeff f (genericPoint X) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hbot := AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.maximalIdeal_stalk_eq_bot_of_eq_genericPoint hη
  have hI : Ideal.map (CommRingCat.Hom.hom (Scheme.Hom.stalkMap f (genericPoint X)))
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk (f (genericPoint X)))) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X)) := by
    rw [hbot, Ideal.map_bot]
    exact (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.maximalIdeal_stalk_eq_bot_of_eq_genericPoint rfl).symm
  unfold flatPullbackCoeff
  rw [hI]
  haveI : IsSimpleModule (X.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X))
      ((X.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X)) ⧸
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X))) :=
    isSimpleModule_iff_isCoatom.mpr (Ideal.isMaximal_def.mp inferInstance)
  rw [Module.length_eq_one]
  rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1N4B.fundClass_scheme_eq_pull
statement:
theorem fundClass_scheme_eq_pull :
    haveI : Flat C.toBase
proof:
:= C.toBase_flat (C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos e))
    fundClass k (W := C.scheme) =
      totalPullOn (opsV4 k) C.toBase e ((cpV4 k).projBundle_relDim C hC)
        (fundClass k (W := Y)) := by
  haveI : IsIntegral Y := (Fact.out : ProjectiveIntegral k Y).1
  haveI : IsIntegral C.scheme := (Fact.out : ProjectiveIntegral k C.scheme).1
  have hpos := C.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card hC (Nat.succ_pos e)
  haveI : Flat C.toBase := C.toBase_flat hpos
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective C.toBase := C.toBase_surjective hpos
  have hηZ : C.toBase (genericPoint C.scheme) = genericPoint Y := by
    have h := (genericPoint_spec C.scheme).image C.toBase.continuous
    rw [Set.image_univ, Set.range_eq_univ.mpr hsurj, closure_univ] at h
    exact h.eq (genericPoint_spec Y)
  obtain ⟨d, hdY⟩ := exists_height_genericPoint k Y
  have hrel := (cpV4 k).projBundle_relDim C hC
  have hcoeff1 : flatPullbackCoeff C.toBase (genericPoint C.scheme) = 1 :=
    flatPullbackCoeff_generic_eq_one C.toBase hηZ
  have hdZ : height (genericPoint C.scheme) = ((d + e : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [hrel _ (by rw [hcoeff1]; exact one_ne_zero), hηZ, hdY]
    push_cast; rfl
  have hzero : ∀ x : C.scheme, x ≠ genericPoint C.scheme →
      C.toBase x = genericPoint Y → flatPullbackCoeff C.toBase x = 0 := by
    intro x hx hπ
    by_contra hc
    have h := hrel x hc
    rw [hπ, hdY] at h
    have hle : x ≤ genericPoint C.scheme :=
      (genericPoint_spec C.scheme).specializes trivial
    have hlt : x < genericPoint C.scheme := lt_iff_le_not_ge.mpr ⟨hle, fun hge ↦ hx (by
      have h1 : x ⤳ genericPoint C.scheme := hge
      have h2 : IsGenericPoint x (⊤ : Set C.scheme) := by
        have := (specializes_iff_closure_subset.mp h1)
        rw [(genericPoint_spec C.scheme).def] at this
        exact Set.eq_univ_of_univ_subset this
      exact h2.eq (genericPoint_spec C.scheme))⟩
    have hfin : height x ≠ ⊤ := by
      rw [h]; exact ne_of_lt (by rw [← ENat.coe_add]; exact ENat.coe_lt_top _) 
    have := Order.height_strictMono hlt (lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr hfin)
    rw [hdZ, h] at this
    push_cast at this
    exact lt_irrefl _ this
  rw [fundClass_eq k (W := Y) d hdY, fundClass_eq k (W := C.scheme) (d + e) hdZ, totalPullOn,
    DirectSum.toModule_lof]
  refine congrArg (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℕ (fun m ↦ RationalDimChow C.scheme m) (d + e)) ?_
  refine ((opsV4 k).pull_mk C.toBase e hrel d
    (dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint Y) d hdY) (dimPrimeCycle (genericPoint C.scheme) (d + e) hdZ) ?_).symm
  intro x
  by_cases hx : x = genericPoint C.scheme
  · subst hx
    simp [dimPrimeCycle, Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single_apply, hηZ, hcoeff1]
  · by_cases hπ : C.toBase x = genericPoint Y
    · simp [dimPrimeCycle, Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single_apply, hx, hπ, hzero x hx hπ]
    · simp [dimPrimeCycle, Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single_apply, hx, hπ]

proof:
:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.a12_mono
statement: theorem a12_mono (K : Type u) [Field K] : Mono (a12Cover K).tautologicalPushforwardHom
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ∀ (U : (a12X K).Opensᵒᵖ),
      Function.Injective ((a12Cover K).tautologicalPushforwardHom.val.app U) by
    suffices Mono ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (a12X K).ringCatSheaf).map
        (a12Cover K).tautologicalPushforwardHom) by
      cat_disch
    exact CategoryTheory.Sheaf.mono_of_injective _ h
  intro U
  obtain ⟨W⟩ := U
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro m hm
  by_cases hW : (W : Set (a12X K)).Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hW
    have hWU : W = (a12Cover K).U PUnit.unit := by
      refine le_antisymm (fun y _ => ?_) (fun y _ => ?_)
      · show y ∈ (⊤ : (a12X K).Opens)
        trivial
      · have : y = x := Subsingleton.elim _ _
        rw [this]; exact hx
    subst hWU
    exact a11_alpha_app_injective (a12Cover K) PUnit.unit m hm
  · have hW' : (W : Set (a12X K)) = ∅ := Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hW
    let T : TopCat.Sheaf Ab (a12X K) := ⟨(tensorUnitSheaf (a12X K) ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf (a12X K)).presheaf,
      (tensorUnitSheaf (a12X K) ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf (a12X K)).isSheaf⟩
    refine T.eq_of_locally_eq' (fun p : Empty => (⊥ : (a12X K).Opens)) W (fun p => p.elim) ?_ m 0 ?_
    · intro y hy
      exact absurd ⟨y, hy⟩ hW
    · intro p; exact p.elim

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushedUnitTensorFrame_hom_factorization
statement:
theorem pushedUnitTensorFrame_hom_factorization
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (U : Y.Opens) :
    let f0
proof:
:= SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
      (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over U)
    let eX := eqToIso (rfl :
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y).over U =
        SheafOfModules.unit (Y.ringCatSheaf.over U))
    let f := f0 ≪≫ eX.symm
    let a := SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
      U.ι.toRingCatSheafHom
    let p := pushedUnitOpenFrame Y U
    (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver
      (X := Y) (M := SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y) U f f).hom ≫
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap Y a a).over U =
    (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver
      (X := Y) (M := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y U) U p p).hom := by
  dsimp only
  let f0 := SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
    (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over U)
  let eX := eqToIso (rfl :
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y).over U =
        SheafOfModules.unit (Y.ringCatSheaf.over U))
  let f := f0 ≪≫ eX.symm
  let a := SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
    U.ι.toRingCatSheafHom
  let p := pushedUnitOpenFrame Y U
  let aIso := (pushedUnitOpenOverIso Y U).symm
  have hIso : aIso.hom = a.over U := by
    simpa only [aIso, Iso.symm_hom] using
      pushedUnitOpenOverIso_inv_eq_unitToPushforward Y U
  have hFrame := pushedUnitOpenFrame_hom_factorization_unitToPushforward Y U
  have hf : f.hom = f0.hom := by
    dsimp [f, eX]
    exact Category.comp_id _
  have hSquare : f.hom ≫ aIso.hom = p.hom := by
    rw [hf, hIso]
    exact hFrame.symm
  have hTensor := tensorFrameOverLocal_hom_naturality_of_commuting_frames
    (X := Y) U aIso aIso f f p p (Iso.refl _) hSquare hSquare
  rw [tensorSheafMap_hom_over]
  let tf := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFreePUnitFrameOver U
  let τ0 := SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y U
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y) (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y)
  let τ1 := SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y U
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y U) (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y U)
  change
    (tf.hom ≫
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso Y U f f).hom ≫ τ0.hom) ≫
        (τ0.inv ≫ SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap Y U
          (a.over U) (a.over U) ≫ τ1.hom) =
      tf.hom ≫
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso Y U p p).hom ≫ τ1.hom
  have hLocal := congrArg (fun z => z ≫ τ1.hom) hTensor
  change
    (tf.hom ≫
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso Y U f f).hom ≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap Y U aIso.hom aIso.hom) ≫ τ1.hom =
    (Iso.refl _ ≪≫ Iso.refl _).hom ≫
      (tf.hom ≫ (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso Y U p p).hom) ≫ τ1.hom
      at hLocal
  rw [hIso] at hLocal
  calc
    _ = tf.hom ≫
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso Y U f f).hom ≫
          SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap Y U (a.over U) (a.over U) ≫ τ1.hom := by
      simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
    _ = _ := hLocal
    _ = _ := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tensorSheafOverLeftUnitor_compat
statement:
theorem tensorSheafOverLeftUnitor_compat
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.Opens) :
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso X U
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)).hom ≫
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafLeftUnitor X
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)).hom.over U =
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverLeftUnitor X U
      (SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over U))).hom
proof:
:= by
  let P := SchemeKTheory.underlyingCommPresheaf X
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)
  let F := PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀OfCommRingCat
    (Over.forget U) X.presheaf
  let A := PresheafOfModules.sheafification
    (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)
  let S := SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafification X
  let T := SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U
  let localAdj := PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
    (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)
  let globalAdj := SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafificationAdjunction X
  let localUnit := SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)
  let R := SheafOfModules.restrictPresheaf
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.ringCatSheaf U
  let localRight := SheafOfModules.forget (X.ringCatSheaf.over U) ⋙
    PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)
  let R' := (((Over.forget U).op ⋙ X.presheaf) ⋙
    forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
  letI : MonoidalCategory
      (PresheafOfModules.{u} (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj) :=
    inferInstanceAs (MonoidalCategory (PresheafOfModules.{u} R'))
  let Q := P ⊗ P
  let μ := Functor.Monoidal.μIso F P P
  let eP := SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafificationOverIso X U Q
  let globalL := SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafLeftUnitor X
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)
  let lG := MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor P
  let lU := MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor (localRight.obj localUnit)
  let rη := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.moduleSheafificationUnitOver
    X U Q
  have hLax :
      μ.hom ≫ F.map lG.hom =
      (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor (F.obj P)).hom := by
    dsimp only [P, SchemeKTheory.underlyingCommPresheaf,
      SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf, F]
    rfl
  have hLambda :
      (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor (F.obj P)).hom = lU.hom := by
    dsimp only [lU, F, P, SchemeKTheory.underlyingCommPresheaf,
      SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf, localRight, localUnit,
      SchemeKTheory.structurePresheafId]
    rfl
  have hGlobal :
      globalAdj.homEquiv _ _ globalL.hom = lG.hom :=
    SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafification_homEquiv_tensorSheafLeftUnitor
      X (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_apply] at hGlobal
  have hRestrMap :
      localRight.map (T.map globalL.hom) =
        R.map ((SchemeKTheory.underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map
          globalL.hom) := rfl
  have hUnitAdj : rη ≫ localRight.map (T.map globalL.hom) =
      F.map lG.hom := by
    change R.map (globalAdj.unit.app Q) ≫
      localRight.map (T.map globalL.hom) = F.map lG.hom
    rw [hRestrMap]
    calc
      _ = R.map (globalAdj.unit.app Q ≫
          (SchemeKTheory.underlyingCommPresheafFunctor X).map globalL.hom) := by
        rw [← R.map_comp]
      _ = R.map lG.hom := congrArg (fun f => R.map f) hGlobal
      _ = F.map lG.hom := rfl
  have hLocalCounit :
      localAdj.homEquiv _ _ (localAdj.counit.app localUnit) = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [← localAdj.homEquiv_symm_id localUnit]
    exact Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _
  have hRight :
      localAdj.homEquiv _ _
          (A.map lU.hom ≫ localAdj.counit.app localUnit) = lU.hom := by
    calc
      _ = lU.hom ≫ localAdj.homEquiv _ _
          (localAdj.counit.app localUnit) :=
        localAdj.homEquiv_naturality_left lU.hom _
      _ = _ := by
        rw [hLocalCounit]
        exact Category.comp_id _
  have hE :
      localAdj.homEquiv (R.obj Q) (T.obj (S.obj Q)) eP.hom = rη := by
    simpa only [localAdj, eP, rη] using
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.moduleSheafificationOverIso_hom_adjunct
        X U Q
  have hLeft :
      localAdj.homEquiv _ _
          (A.map μ.hom ≫ eP.hom ≫ T.map globalL.hom) = lU.hom := by
    calc
      _ = μ.hom ≫ localAdj.homEquiv _ _
          (eP.hom ≫ T.map globalL.hom) :=
        localAdj.homEquiv_naturality_left μ.hom _
      _ = μ.hom ≫ (rη ≫ localRight.map (T.map globalL.hom)) := by
        congr 1
        calc
          _ = localAdj.homEquiv _ _ eP.hom ≫
              localRight.map (T.map globalL.hom) :=
                localAdj.homEquiv_naturality_right eP.hom _
          _ = _ := by rw [hE]
      _ = μ.hom ≫ F.map lG.hom := by rw [hUnitAdj]
      _ = lU.hom := by
        rw [hLax]
        exact hLambda
  simp only [SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso,
    SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverLeftUnitor,
    SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafLeftUnitor,
    Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.map_comp,
    Category.assoc]
  apply (localAdj.homEquiv _ _).injective
  change localAdj.homEquiv _ _
      (A.map μ.hom ≫ eP.hom ≫ T.map globalL.hom) =
    localAdj.homEquiv _ _
      (A.map lU.hom ≫ localAdj.counit.app localUnit)
  exact hLeft.trans hRight.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.restrictTensorUnit_compat
statement:
theorem restrictTensorUnit_compat
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q] :
    let β
proof:
:= SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X) (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)
    β.hom ≫ SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap Y
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).hom
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).hom ≫
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafLeftUnitor Y
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y)).hom =
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafLeftUnitor X
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).hom := by
  dsimp only
  let cp := SchemeKTheory.openRestrictionSheafificationIso q
    ((SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X).val ⊗
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X).val)
  apply (cancel_epi cp.hom).1
  rw [SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso]
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom,
    Category.assoc, cp, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  apply (SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafificationAdjunction Y).homEquiv _ _ |>.injective
  conv_lhs =>
    erw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left]
    dsimp only [SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap]
    erw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left]
    erw [SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafification_homEquiv_tensorSheafLeftUnitor]
  conv_rhs =>
    erw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
    erw [SchemeKTheory.openRestrictionSheafificationComparison_homEquiv]
  have hX := SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafification_homEquiv_tensorSheafLeftUnitor
    X (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit] at hX
  change
    (SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app
        ((SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X).val ⊗
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X).val) ≫ _ = _ at hX
  rw [(SchemeKTheory.underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).map_comp]
  rw [← SchemeKTheory.openRestrictionPresheaf_map_underlying q
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafLeftUnitor X
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)).hom]
  have hF := congrArg
    (fun f ↦ (SchemeKTheory.openRestrictionPresheaf q).map f) hX
  simp only [Functor.map_comp] at hF
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro U
  simp only [PresheafOfModules.comp_app]
  have hFU := congrArg (fun f ↦ f.app U) hF
  simp only [PresheafOfModules.comp_app] at hFU
  let c := ((SchemeKTheory.underlyingCommPresheafFunctor Y).map
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).hom).app U
  have hFUc := congrArg (fun f ↦ f ≫ c) hFU
  calc
    _ = ((SchemeKTheory.openRestrictionPresheaf q).map
          (MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor
            (SchemeKTheory.underlyingCommPresheaf X
              (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X))).hom).app U ≫ c := by
      set e := pushforwardTensorIso (Scheme.Hom.opensFunctor q)
        (SchemeKTheory.openRestrictionRingHom q) (fun V ↦ SchemeKTheory.openRestrictionRingHom_app_isIso q V)
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X).val (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X).val with he
      let eU : _ ≅ _ :=
        { hom := e.hom.app U
          inv := e.inv.app U
          hom_inv_id := by rw [← PresheafOfModules.comp_app, e.hom_inv_id]; rfl
          inv_hom_id := by rw [← PresheafOfModules.comp_app, e.inv_hom_id]; rfl }
      change eU.hom ≫ _ = _
      rw [← Iso.eq_inv_comp]
      apply ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.tensor_ext
      intro x y
      simp only [ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply]
      have hμ := ModuleCat.restrictScalars_μ_tmul
        ((SchemeKTheory.openRestrictionRingHom q).app U).hom
        ((SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj ((Scheme.Hom.opensFunctor q).op.obj U))
        ((SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj ((Scheme.Hom.opensFunctor q).op.obj U)) x y
      erw [hμ]
      simp only [PresheafOfModules.leftUnitor_hom_app,
        PresheafOfModules.tensorHom_app]
      change (q.appIso U.unop).hom.hom (@id Γ(X, q ''ᵁ U.unop) x) *
          (q.appIso U.unop).hom.hom (@id Γ(X, q ''ᵁ U.unop) y) =
        (q.appIso U.unop).hom.hom (@id Γ(X, q ''ᵁ U.unop) x * @id Γ(X, q ''ᵁ U.unop) y)
      exact (map_mul _ _ _).symm
    _ = _ := hFUc.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.openLiftUnitFrame_frameCancel
statement:
theorem openLiftUnitFrame_frameCancel {Y : Scheme.{u}} (V : Y.Opens)
    {M : SheafOfModules.{u} (Y.ringCatSheaf.over V)}
    (αV : M ≅ SheafOfModules.unit (Y.ringCatSheaf.over V)) :
    let f0Y
proof:
:= SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over V)
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso Y V (f0Y ≪≫ αV.symm) (f0Y ≪≫ αV.symm)).inv ≫
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso Y V f0Y.symm f0Y.symm).inv =
    SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap Y V αV.hom αV.hom := by
  dsimp only
  let f0Y := SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over V)
  let R' := (((Over.forget V).op ⋙ Y.presheaf) ⋙
    forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
  let F₀ := SheafOfModules.identitySheafificationOver
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) Y.ringCatSheaf V
  letI : MonoidalCategory
      (PresheafOfModules.{u} (Y.ringCatSheaf.over V).obj) :=
    inferInstanceAs (MonoidalCategory (PresheafOfModules.{u} R'))
  let d' := (SheafOfModules.forget (Y.ringCatSheaf.over V)).mapIso (f0Y ≪≫ αV.symm)
  let u' := (SheafOfModules.forget (Y.ringCatSheaf.over V)).mapIso f0Y.symm
  let a' := (SheafOfModules.forget (Y.ringCatSheaf.over V)).map αV.hom
  change F₀.map (d'.inv ⊗ₘ d'.inv) ≫ F₀.map (u'.inv ⊗ₘ u'.inv) = F₀.map (a' ⊗ₘ a')
  have hda : d'.inv ≫ u'.inv = a' := by
    simp only [d', u', a', Functor.mapIso_inv, Iso.trans_inv, Iso.symm_inv,
      ← Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  rw [← F₀.map_comp, MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_comp_tensorHom, hda]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.openLiftUnitFrame_middle
statement:
theorem openLiftUnitFrame_middle {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q] (V : Y.Opens)
    (hβ : (SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X) (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)).hom ≫
      SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap Y
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).hom
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).hom ≫
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafLeftUnitor Y
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y)).hom =
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafLeftUnitor X
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).hom)
    (hL : (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y V
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y)
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y)).hom ≫
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafLeftUnitor Y
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y)).hom.over V =
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverLeftUnitor Y V
      (SheafOfModules.unit (Y.ringCatSheaf.over V))).hom) :
    let G
proof:
:= Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q
    let α := Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q
    let αV := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf V).mapIso α
    let f0Y := SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over V)
    let globalL := SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafLeftUnitor X
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)
    let β := SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X) (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)
    (G.map globalL.inv).over V ≫ β.hom.over V ≫
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y V
        (G.obj (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X))
        (G.obj (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X))).inv ≫
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso Y V (f0Y ≪≫ αV.symm) (f0Y ≪≫ αV.symm)).inv ≫
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso Y V f0Y.symm f0Y.symm).inv ≫
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverLeftUnitor Y V
        (SheafOfModules.unit (Y.ringCatSheaf.over V))).hom = α.hom.over V := by
  dsimp only
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q
  let α := Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q
  let αV := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf V).mapIso α
  let O := SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf V
  let globalL := SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafLeftUnitor X
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)
  let globalLY := SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafLeftUnitor Y
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y)
  let β := SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X) (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)
  let τG := SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y V
    (G.obj (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X))
    (G.obj (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X))
  let τY := SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y V
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y) (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y)
  let LY := SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverLeftUnitor Y V
    (SheafOfModules.unit (Y.ringCatSheaf.over V))
  have h1 := openLiftUnitFrame_frameCancel V αV
  have h2 : τG.inv ≫ SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap Y V αV.hom αV.hom =
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap Y α.hom α.hom).over V ≫ τY.inv := by
    have hM := tensorSheafMap_hom_over α.hom α.hom V
    change (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap Y α.hom α.hom).over V =
      τG.inv ≫ SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap Y V αV.hom αV.hom ≫ τY.hom at hM
    rw [hM]
    simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
  have h3 : τY.inv ≫ LY.hom = globalLY.hom.over V := by
    rw [Iso.inv_comp_eq]
    exact hL.symm
  have h4 : (G.map globalL.inv).over V ≫ β.hom.over V ≫
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap Y α.hom α.hom).over V ≫ globalLY.hom.over V =
      α.hom.over V := by
    change O.map (G.map globalL.inv) ≫ O.map β.hom ≫
      O.map (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap Y α.hom α.hom) ≫ O.map globalLY.hom =
      O.map α.hom
    rw [← O.map_comp, ← O.map_comp, ← O.map_comp]
    congr 1
    change G.map globalL.inv ≫ (β.hom ≫ SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap Y α.hom α.hom ≫
      globalLY.hom) = α.hom
    rw [hβ, ← Category.assoc, ← G.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id, G.map_id, Category.id_comp]
  calc
    _ = (G.map globalL.inv).over V ≫ β.hom.over V ≫ τG.inv ≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap Y V αV.hom αV.hom ≫ LY.hom := by
      rw [reassoc_of% h1]
    _ = (G.map globalL.inv).over V ≫ β.hom.over V ≫
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap Y α.hom α.hom).over V ≫ τY.inv ≫ LY.hom := by
      rw [reassoc_of% h2]
    _ = _ := by rw [h3]; exact h4

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushedUnitTensorFrame_openLift
statement:
theorem pushedUnitTensorFrame_openLift
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (U : X.Opens) (V : Y.Opens) (h : q ⁻¹ᵁ U = V) :
    let p
proof:
:= restrictOpenLift q U V h
    let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor p
    let EU := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U
    let EV := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V
    let E := EV.functor
    let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q
    let PU := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X U
    let PV := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y V
    let B := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivFreePUnitIso q U V h
    let cast := pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso q U V h
    let sourceFrame := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver U
      (pushedUnitOpenFrame X U) (pushedUnitOpenFrame X U)
    let targetFrame := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver V
      (pushedUnitOpenFrame Y V) (pushedUnitOpenFrame Y V)
    let C := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso_viaRestriction q U V h PU PU
    H.map (EU.functor.map sourceFrame.hom) ≫ C.hom ≫
      SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
        (E.map (cast.hom.over V)) (E.map (cast.hom.over V)) ≫
      (overEquivTensorSheafIso Y V PV PV).inv ≫
      E.map (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y V PV PV).hom ≫
      E.map targetFrame.inv = B.hom := by
  dsimp only
  let p := restrictOpenLift q U V h
  let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor p
  let EU := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U
  let EV := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V
  let E := EV.functor
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q
  let PU := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X U
  let PV := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y V
  let B := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivFreePUnitIso q U V h
  let cast := pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso q U V h
  let sourceFrame := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver U
    (pushedUnitOpenFrame X U) (pushedUnitOpenFrame X U)
  let targetFrame := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver V
    (pushedUnitOpenFrame Y V) (pushedUnitOpenFrame Y V)
  let C := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso_viaRestriction q U V h PU PU
  let uX := SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit U.ι.toRingCatSheafHom
  let uY := SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit V.ι.toRingCatSheafHom
  let α := Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q
  let C₀ := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso_viaRestriction q U V h
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X) (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)
  let f0X := SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U)
  let eX := eqToIso (rfl :
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X).over U =
      SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over U))
  let fX := f0X ≪≫ eX.symm
  let f0Y := SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over V)
  let eY := eqToIso (rfl :
    (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y).over V =
      SheafOfModules.unit (Y.ringCatSheaf.over V))
  let fY := f0Y ≪≫ eY.symm
  let unitFrameX := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver
    (X := X) (M := SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X) U fX fX
  let unitFrameY := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver
    (X := Y) (M := SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y) V fY fY
  let tail := (overEquivTensorSheafIso Y V PV PV).inv ≫
    E.map (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y V PV PV).hom ≫
    E.map targetFrame.inv
  have hUnit := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso_unitToPushforward_naturality
    q U V h
  have hFactorT := pushedUnitTensorFrame_hom_factorization_unitToPushforward X U
  change unitFrameX.hom ≫ (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X uX uX).over U =
    sourceFrame.hom at hFactorT
  have hSource : H.map (EU.functor.map sourceFrame.hom) =
      H.map (EU.functor.map unitFrameX.hom) ≫
        H.map (EU.functor.map ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X uX uX).over U)) := by
    calc
      _ = H.map (EU.functor.map
          (unitFrameX.hom ≫ (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X uX uX).over U)) := by
        exact congrArg (fun f => H.map (EU.functor.map f)) hFactorT.symm
      _ = _ := by simp only [Functor.map_comp]
  let aFrame := H.map (EU.functor.map unitFrameX.hom)
  let bTensor := H.map
    (EU.functor.map ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X uX uX).over U))
  have hSource' : H.map (EU.functor.map sourceFrame.hom) =
      aFrame ≫ bTensor := by
    change H.map (EU.functor.map sourceFrame.hom) =
      H.map (EU.functor.map unitFrameX.hom) ≫
        H.map (EU.functor.map ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X uX uX).over U))
    exact hSource
  rw [hSource]
  change H.map (EU.functor.map ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X uX uX).over U)) ≫
      C.hom ≫ SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
        (E.map (cast.hom.over V)) (E.map (cast.hom.over V)) =
    C₀.hom ≫ SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)

                  _ = E.map (𝟙 _) := congrArg E.map (Iso.inv_hom_id gYOver)
                  _ = 𝟙 _ := E.map_id _
              dsimp only [gYOver] at hCancelGY
              dsimp only [gYOver]
              rw [← Category.assoc (E.map
                (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
                  (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over V)).inv) (E.map
                (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
                  (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over V)).hom)
                (overEquivUnitIso Y V).hom]
              rw [hCancelGY]
              simp only [Category.id_comp]
              simp only [restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso,
                SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso,
                overEquivUnitIso, SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheafOverIso,
                overEquivTensorSheafIso, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.trans_inv,
                Iso.symm_hom, Iso.symm_inv, Functor.mapIso_hom,
                Functor.mapIso_inv, Iso.refl_hom, Iso.refl_inv,
                Category.assoc, Functor.map_comp]
              rw [hAlphaOverIso]
              have hCancelF0 :
                  (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U
                    f0X.symm f0X.symm).hom ≫
                    (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U
                      f0X f0X).hom = 𝟙 _ := by
                rw [← tensorSheafOverMapIso_inv_local U f0X f0X]
                exact (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U
                  f0X f0X).inv_hom_id
              have hMappedCancel :
                  H.map (EU.functor.map
                    (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U
                      (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
                        (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).symm
                      (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
                        (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).symm).hom) ≫
                  H.map (EU.functor.map
                    (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U
                      f0X f0X).hom) = 𝟙 _ := by
                change H.map (EU.functor.map
                    (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U
                      f0X.symm f0X.symm).hom) ≫
                  H.map (EU.functor.map
                    (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U
                      f0X f0X).hom) = 𝟙 _
                calc
                  _ = H.map (EU.functor.map
                      ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U
                        f0X.symm f0X.symm).hom ≫
                        (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U
                          f0X f0X).hom)) := by
                    rw [← H.map_comp, ← EU.functor.map_comp]
                  _ = H.map (EU.functor.map (𝟙 _)) :=
                    congrArg (fun f => H.map (EU.functor.map f)) hCancelF0
                  _ = 𝟙 _ := by simp
              conv_lhs =>
                arg 2
                rw [← Category.assoc]
                rw [hMappedCancel]
              simp only [Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp]
              let αQ := (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app
                (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)

              have hAlphaQ : αQ.inv ≫

                    (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).hom := by
                have hIso : overEquivTensorUnitIso X U =
                    (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app
                      (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X) ≪≫
                    restrictOpenImmersionTensorUnitIso U.ι := by
                  unfold overEquivTensorUnitIso
                    SchemeKTheory.overEquivFunctorObj_overIso_pullbackObj
                    restrictOpenImmersionTensorUnitIso
                  rfl
                rw [hIso, Iso.trans_hom]
                rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
                exact restrictOpenImmersionTensorUnitIso_eq_restrictUnitIso U.ι
              have hUnitSq := restrictUnitIso_openLift_naturality q U V h
              have hAlphaQFull : αQ.inv ≫

                    (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).hom := by
                have hIdEU : EU.functor.map

                    𝟙 (EU.functor.obj

                  EU.functor.map_id _

                calc

                      (overEquivTensorUnitIso X U).hom := rfl
                  _ = αQ.inv ≫ (overEquivTensorUnitIso X U).hom := by
                    rw [Category.comp_id]
                  _ = _ := hAlphaQ
              let βP := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback p

              let ηP := SchemeKTheory.pullbackObjUnitIso p
              let eP := eqToIso (rfl :
                SheafOfModules.unit ((U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf) =
                  SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf (U : Scheme))
              have hBetaTheta :
                  βP.hom.app (SheafOfModules.unit
                      ((U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf)) ≫ θP.hom =
                    H.map eP.hom ≫ βP.hom.app
                      (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf (U : Scheme)) := by
                change βP.hom.app (SheafOfModules.unit
                    ((U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf)) ≫
                  (Scheme.Modules.pullback p).map eP.hom =
                    H.map eP.hom ≫ βP.hom.app
                      (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf (U : Scheme))
                exact (βP.hom.naturality eP.hom).symm
              have hBetaEta :
                  βP.hom.app (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf (U : Scheme)) ≫
                    ηP.hom = (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso p).hom := by
                simpa only [βP, ηP, restrictOpenImmersionTensorUnitIso,
                  Iso.trans_hom, Iso.app_hom] using
                    restrictOpenImmersionTensorUnitIso_eq_restrictUnitIso p
              have hBetaP :
                  βP.hom.app (SheafOfModules.unit
                      ((U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf)) ≫ θP.hom ≫ ηP.hom =
                    (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso p).hom := by
                calc
                  _ = H.map eP.hom ≫
                      βP.hom.app (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf (U : Scheme)) ≫
                        ηP.hom := by
                    simpa only [Category.assoc] using
                      congrArg (fun f => f ≫ ηP.hom) hBetaTheta
                  _ = H.map eP.hom ≫
                      (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso p).hom := by rw [hBetaEta]
                  _ = _ := by
                    have heP : eP.hom = 𝟙 _ := by
                      dsimp only [eP]
                      rfl
                    rw [heP]
                    have hIdH := H.map_id
                      (SheafOfModules.unit ((U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf))
                    rw [hIdH, Category.id_comp]
              have hCompUnitFirst : H.map αQ.inv ≫
                  H.map (EU.functor.map (𝟙 (SheafOfModules.unit
                    (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)))) =
                  H.map (αQ.inv ≫ EU.functor.map (𝟙 (SheafOfModules.unit
                    (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)))) :=
                (H.map_comp _ _).symm
              have hCompUnitSecond :
                  H.map (αQ.inv ≫ EU.functor.map (𝟙 (SheafOfModules.unit
                    (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)))) ≫
                    H.map (overEquivTensorUnitIso X U).hom =
                  H.map (αQ.inv ≫ EU.functor.map (𝟙 (SheafOfModules.unit
                    (X.ringCatSheaf.over U))) ≫
                    (overEquivTensorUnitIso X U).hom) := by
                calc
                  _ = H.map
                      ((αQ.inv ≫ EU.functor.map (𝟙 (SheafOfModules.unit
                        (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)))) ≫
                        (overEquivTensorUnitIso X U).hom) :=
                        (H.map_comp _ _).symm
                  _ = _ := congrArg H.map (Category.assoc _ _ _)
              have hRightUnit :
                  H.map αQ.inv ≫
                    H.map (EU.functor.map (𝟙 (SheafOfModules.unit
                      (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)))) ≫
                    H.map (overEquivTensorUnitIso X U).hom ≫
                    βP.hom.app (SheafOfModules.unit
                      ((U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf)) ≫ θP.hom ≫ ηP.hom =
                  H.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).hom ≫
                    (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso p).hom := by
                calc
                  _ = H.map αQ.inv ≫
                      H.map (EU.functor.map (𝟙 (SheafOfModules.unit
                        (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)))) ≫
                      H.map (overEquivTensorUnitIso X U).hom ≫
                      βP.hom.app (SheafOfModules.unit
                        ((U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf)) ≫ θP.hom ≫ ηP.hom := by
                    rfl
                  _ = H.map (αQ.inv ≫
                      EU.functor.map (𝟙 (SheafOfModules.unit
                        (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)))) ≫
                      H.map (overEquivTensorUnitIso X U).hom ≫
                      βP.hom.app (SheafOfModules.unit
                        ((U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf)) ≫ θP.hom ≫ ηP.hom := by
                    simpa only [Category.assoc] using
                      congrArg (fun f => f ≫
                        H.map (overEquivTensorUnitIso X U).hom ≫
                          βP.hom.app (SheafOfModules.unit
                            ((U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf)) ≫ θP.hom ≫ ηP.hom)
                        hCompUnitFirst
                  _ = H.map (αQ.inv ≫
                      EU.functor.map (𝟙 (SheafOfModules.unit
                        (X.ringCatSheaf.over U))) ≫
                      (overEquivTensorUnitIso X U).hom) ≫
                      βP.hom.app (SheafOfModules.unit
                        ((U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf)) ≫ θP.hom ≫ ηP.hom := by
                    simpa only [Category.assoc] using
                      congrArg (fun f => f ≫
                        βP.hom.app (SheafOfModules.unit
                          ((U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf)) ≫ θP.hom ≫ ηP.hom)
                        hCompUnitSecond
                  _ = H.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).hom ≫
                      βP.hom.app (SheafOfModules.unit
                        ((U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf)) ≫ θP.hom ≫ ηP.hom := by
                    rw [hAlphaQFull]
                  _ = _ := by
                    simpa only [Category.assoc] using
                      congrArg (fun f =>
                        H.map (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso U.ι).hom ≫ f)
                        hBetaP
              let K := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι
              let R := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι
              let eOpen := restrictFunctorOpenLiftIso q U V h
              let globalL := SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafLeftUnitor X
                (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)
              let localL := SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverLeftUnitor X U
                (SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over U))
              let τX := SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso X U
                (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)
                (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)
              let αTen := (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app
                (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X
                  (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)
                  (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X))
              have hUnitCompat := tensorSheafOverLeftUnitor_compat U
              have hOverUnitUnitor :
                  globalL.hom.over U ≫ globalL.inv.over U = 𝟙 _ := by
                let O := SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U
                change O.map globalL.hom ≫ O.map globalL.inv = _
                calc
                  _ = O.map (globalL.hom ≫ globalL.inv) := by
                    rw [← O.map_comp]
                  _ = O.map (𝟙 _) := congrArg O.map globalL.hom_inv_id
                  _ = _ := O.map_id _
              have hUnitCompatInv : localL.inv ≫ τX.hom =
                  globalL.inv.over U := by
                calc
                  localL.inv ≫ τX.hom =
                      localL.inv ≫ τX.hom ≫
                        (globalL.hom.over U ≫ globalL.inv.over U) := by
                    rw [hOverUnitUnitor]
                    simp
                  _ = localL.inv ≫ (τX.hom ≫ globalL.hom.over U) ≫
                      globalL.inv.over U := by
                    simp only [Category.assoc]
                  _ = localL.inv ≫ localL.hom ≫ globalL.inv.over U := by
                    simpa only [Category.assoc] using
                      congrArg (fun f => localL.inv ≫ f ≫ globalL.inv.over U)
                        hUnitCompat
                  _ = globalL.inv.over U := by
                    rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
              have hAlphaKey :
                  (SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf U ⋙
                    EU.functor).map globalL.inv =
                  EU.functor.map (globalL.inv.over U) := rfl
              have hAlphaNat :=
                (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).hom.naturality globalL.inv
              rw [hAlphaKey] at hAlphaNat
              have hAlphaMove : αQ.inv ≫
                  EU.functor.map (globalL.inv.over U) ≫ αTen.hom =
                    K.map globalL.inv := by
                calc
                  _ = αQ.inv ≫
                      (EU.functor.map (globalL.inv.over U) ≫ αTen.hom) := by
                    simp only [Category.assoc]
                  _ = αQ.inv ≫ (αQ.hom ≫ K.map globalL.inv) :=
                    congrArg (fun f => αQ.inv ≫ f) hAlphaNat
                  _ = _ := by simp
              have hUnitPrefix :
                  αQ.inv ≫ EU.functor.map localL.inv ≫
                    EU.functor.map τX.hom ≫ αTen.hom =
                  K.map globalL.inv := by

                      αTen.hom := by simp only [Category.assoc]
                  _ = αQ.inv ≫ EU.functor.map (localL.inv ≫ τX.hom) ≫

                  _ = αQ.inv ≫ EU.functor.map (globalL.inv.over U) ≫
                      αTen.hom := by rw [hUnitCompatInv]
                  _ = _ := hAlphaMove
              have hUnitPrefixMapped :
                  H.map αQ.inv ≫ H.map (EU.functor.map localL.inv) ≫
                    H.map (EU.functor.map τX.hom) ≫ H.map αTen.hom =
                  H.map (K.map globalL.inv) := by
                calc
                  _ = H.map (αQ.inv ≫ EU.functor.map localL.inv ≫
                      EU.functor.map τX.hom ≫ αTen.hom) := by
                    rw [← H.map_comp, ← H.map_comp, ← H.map_comp]
                  _ = _ := congrArg H.map hUnitPrefix
              have hUnitPrefixMappedExpanded := hUnitPrefixMapped
              dsimp only [localL, τX, αTen] at hUnitPrefixMappedExpanded
              have hUnitPrefixMappedLeft := hUnitPrefixMappedExpanded
              rw [← Category.assoc] at hUnitPrefixMappedLeft
              rw [← Category.assoc] at hUnitPrefixMappedLeft
              have hEUnitInv :
                  (K ⋙ H).map globalL.inv ≫
                    ((restrictFunctorOpenLiftIso q U V h).app
                      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X
                      (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)
                      (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X))).inv =

                    (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)).inv ≫
                    (G ⋙ R).map globalL.inv := by

                rw [← Category.assoc]
                rw [← Category.assoc]

              rw [← Functor.comp_map]
              rw [← Category.assoc]
              rw [hEUnitInv]
              simp only [SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverLeftUnitor,

                hAlphaQFull, hBetaP, hFrameConvG, hFrameConvR,

                Iso.trans_hom, Iso.trans_inv, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.symm_inv,
                Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.mapIso_inv, Functor.map_comp,
                Category.assoc, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
              unfold SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso
                SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso
              simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.trans_inv, Iso.symm_hom,
                Iso.symm_inv, Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.mapIso_inv,
                Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc, Category.id_comp,
                Category.comp_id]
              rw [hRightUnit]
              rw [hUnitSq]
              let eUnit := (restrictFunctorOpenLiftIso q U V h).app
                (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)
              change eUnit.inv ≫ _ = eUnit.inv ≫ _
              apply (cancel_epi eUnit.inv).2
              have hAlphaKeyV :
                  (SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf V ⋙ E).map
                    (G.map globalL.inv) =
                    E.map ((G.map globalL.inv).over V) := rfl
              have hAlphaInvV :
                  R.map (G.map globalL.inv) ≫
                    ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V).app
                      (G.obj (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X
                        (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)
                        (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X)))).inv =
                  ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V).app
                    (G.obj (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X))).inv ≫
                    E.map ((G.map globalL.inv).over V) := by
                have hNat :=
                  (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V).inv.naturality
                    (G.map globalL.inv)
                rw [hAlphaKeyV] at hNat
                exact hNat
              rw [Functor.comp_map]
              rw [← Category.assoc]
              rw [hAlphaInvV]
              have hKey := openLiftUnitFrame_middle q V (restrictTensorUnit_compat q)
                (tensorSheafOverLeftUnitor_compat V)
              dsimp only at hKey
              let ψY := (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V).app
                (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf Y)
              have hψ : ψY.inv ≫ (overEquivTensorUnitIso Y V).hom =
                  (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso V.ι).hom := by
                have hIso : overEquivTensorUnitIso Y V =
                    ψY ≪≫ restrictOpenImmersionTensorUnitIso V.ι := by
                  unfold overEquivTensorUnitIso
                    SchemeKTheory.overEquivFunctorObj_overIso_pullbackObj
                    restrictOpenImmersionTensorUnitIso
                  rfl
                rw [hIso, Iso.trans_hom]
                rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
                exact restrictOpenImmersionTensorUnitIso_eq_restrictUnitIso V.ι
              have hNatα := (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V).inv.naturality α.hom
              have hFinal :
                  ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V).app
                      (G.obj (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X))).inv ≫

                      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y V
                        (G.obj (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X))
                        (G.obj (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X))).inv ≫
                      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso Y V (f0Y ≪≫ αV.symm)
                        (f0Y ≪≫ αV.symm)).inv ≫
                      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso Y V f0Y.symm f0Y.symm).inv ≫
                      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverLeftUnitor Y V
                        (SheafOfModules.unit (Y.ringCatSheaf.over V))).hom) ≫
                    E.map (𝟙 (SheafOfModules.unit (Y.ringCatSheaf.over V))) ≫
                    (overEquivTensorUnitIso Y V).hom =
                  R.map α.hom ≫ (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso V.ι).hom := by
                rw [hKey, E.map_id, Category.id_comp]
                change _ ≫ (SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf V ⋙ E).map α.hom ≫ _ = _
                have hNat' : ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V).app
                      (G.obj (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf X))).inv ≫
                    (SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf V ⋙ E).map α.hom =
                    R.map α.hom ≫ ψY.inv := hNatα.symm
                rw [← Category.assoc, hNat', Category.assoc, hψ]
              simp only [SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverLeftUnitor,
                Iso.trans_hom, Iso.trans_inv, Iso.symm_hom,
                Iso.symm_inv, Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.mapIso_inv,
                Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc] at hFinal
              unfold SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso
                SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso at hFinal
              simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.trans_inv, Iso.symm_hom,
                Iso.symm_inv, Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.mapIso_inv,
                Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc] at hFinal
