name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushedUnitOpenFrameTransport_cast
statement:
theorem pushedUnitOpenFrameTransport_cast
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (U : X.Opens) (V : Y.Opens) (h : q ⁻¹ᵁ U = V) :
    let F
proof:
:= pushedUnitOpenFrameTransport q U V h
    let cast := pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso q U V h
    F.hom ≫ cast.hom.over V = (pushedUnitOpenFrame Y V).hom := by
  dsimp only
  let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (restrictOpenLift q U V h)
  let EU := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U
  let EV := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V
  let E := EV.functor
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q
  let PU := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X U
  let cast := pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso q U V h
  let B := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivFreePUnitIso q U V h
  let A := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso q U V h PU
  let pX := pushedUnitOpenFrame X U
  let pY := pushedUnitOpenFrame Y V
  let eF : EV.functor.obj
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over V) PUnit) ≅
      EV.functor.obj ((G.obj PU).over V) :=
    B.symm ≪≫ H.mapIso (EU.functor.mapIso pX) ≪≫ A
  let F := isoLiftThroughEquivalence EV eF
  have hP := pushedUnitOpenFrame_openLift_naturality q U V h
  change H.map (EU.functor.map pX.hom) ≫ A.hom ≫
      E.map (cast.hom.over V) = B.hom ≫ E.map pY.hom at hP
  have hFMap : eF.hom ≫ E.map (cast.hom.over V) = E.map pY.hom := by
    change B.inv ≫ H.map (EU.functor.map pX.hom) ≫ A.hom ≫
        E.map (cast.hom.over V) = E.map pY.hom
    calc
      _ = B.inv ≫ B.hom ≫ E.map pY.hom := by
        exact congrArg (fun z => B.inv ≫ z) hP
      _ = _ := by simp
  apply EV.functor.map_injective
  calc
    EV.functor.map (F.hom ≫ cast.hom.over V) =
        EV.functor.map F.hom ≫ E.map (cast.hom.over V) := by
      rw [Functor.map_comp]
    _ = eF.hom ≫ E.map (cast.hom.over V) := by
      rw [isoLiftThroughEquivalence_map]
    _ = E.map pY.hom := hFMap

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.tensorSheafOverMapIso_comp_local
statement:
private theorem tensorSheafOverMapIso_comp_local
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.Opens)
    {A B C D E F : SheafOfModules.{u} (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)}
    (a : A ≅ B) (b : B ≅ C) (d : D ≅ E) (e : E ≅ F) :
    SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U a d ≪≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U b e =
      SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso X U (a ≪≫ b) (d ≪≫ e)
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  let R' := (((Over.forget U).op ⋙ X.presheaf) ⋙
    forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
  let F₀ := SheafOfModules.identitySheafificationOver
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.ringCatSheaf U
  letI : MonoidalCategory
      (PresheafOfModules.{u} (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj) :=
    inferInstanceAs (MonoidalCategory (PresheafOfModules.{u} R'))
  let a' := (SheafOfModules.forget (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).mapIso a
  let b' := (SheafOfModules.forget (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).mapIso b
  let d' := (SheafOfModules.forget (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).mapIso d
  let e' := (SheafOfModules.forget (X.ringCatSheaf.over U)).mapIso e
  change F₀.map (a'.hom ⊗ₘ d'.hom) ≫ F₀.map (b'.hom ⊗ₘ e'.hom) =
    F₀.map ((a'.hom ≫ b'.hom) ⊗ₘ (d'.hom ≫ e'.hom))
  calc
    _ = F₀.map ((a'.hom ⊗ₘ d'.hom) ≫ (b'.hom ⊗ₘ e'.hom)) := by
      rw [F₀.map_comp]
    _ = F₀.map ((a'.hom ≫ b'.hom) ⊗ₘ (d'.hom ≫ e'.hom)) := by
      congr 1
      exact MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_comp_tensorHom _ _ _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.pushedUnitTensorFrameTransport_cast
statement:
theorem pushedUnitTensorFrameTransport_cast
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (U : X.Opens) (V : Y.Opens) (h : q ⁻¹ᵁ U = V) :
    let F
proof:
:= pushedUnitOpenFrameTransport q U V h
    let cast := pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso q U V h
    (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver V F F).hom ≫
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap Y cast.hom cast.hom).over V =
    (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver V
      (pushedUnitOpenFrame Y V) (pushedUnitOpenFrame Y V)).hom := by
  dsimp only
  let F := pushedUnitOpenFrameTransport q U V h
  let cast := pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso q U V h
  let p := pushedUnitOpenFrame Y V
  let τ₁ := SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y V
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y V)
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y V)
  let tf := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFreePUnitFrameOver V
  have hF := pushedUnitOpenFrameTransport_cast q U V h
  change F.hom ≫ cast.hom.over V = p.hom at hF
  let cIso := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor Y.ringCatSheaf V).mapIso cast
  have hc : cIso.hom = cast.hom.over V := rfl
  have hFrame : F.hom ≫ cIso.hom = (Iso.refl _).hom ≫ p.hom := by
    simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.id_comp]
    rw [hc]
    exact hF
  have hTensor := tensorFrameOverLocal_hom_naturality_of_commuting_frames
    (X := Y) V cIso cIso F F p p (Iso.refl _) hFrame hFrame
  rw [tensorSheafMap_hom_over]
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver,
    Iso.trans_hom, Iso.refl_hom, Category.id_comp,
    Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  change
    (tf.hom ≫ (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso Y V F F).hom ≫
      SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap Y V cIso.hom cIso.hom) ≫ τ₁.hom =
    (tf.hom ≫
      (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMapIso Y V p p).hom) ≫ τ₁.hom
  exact congrArg (fun z => z ≫ τ₁.hom) hTensor

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.openLiftTensorFrame_middle_generic
statement:
theorem openLiftTensorFrame_middle_generic
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (U : X.Opens) (V : Y.Opens) (h : q ⁻¹ᵁ U = V)
    {M N : X.Modules}
    (κM : M ⟶ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X U)
    (κN : N ⟶ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X U)
    (lamM : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj M ⟶ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y V)
    (lamN : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj N ⟶ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y V)
    (fM : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) PUnit ≅ M.over U)
    (fN : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) PUnit ≅ N.over U)
    (gM : SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over V) PUnit ≅
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj M).over V)
    (gN : SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf.over V) PUnit ≅
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).obj N).over V)
    (hS : (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver U fM fN).hom ≫
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X κM κN).over U =
      (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver U
        (pushedUnitOpenFrame X U) (pushedUnitOpenFrame X U)).hom)
    (hT : (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver V gM gN).hom ≫
        (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap Y lamM lamN).over V =
      (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver V
        (pushedUnitOpenFrame Y V) (pushedUnitOpenFrame Y V)).hom)
    (hC : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (restrictOpenLift q U V h)).map
          ((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map
            ((SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X κM κN).over U)) ≫
        (restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso_viaRestriction q U V h
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X U)
          (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X U)).hom ≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
          ((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V).functor.map
            ((pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso q U V h).hom.over V))
          ((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V).functor.map
            ((pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso q U V h).hom.over V)) =
      (restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso_viaRestriction q U V h M N).hom ≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
          ((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V).functor.map (lamM.over V))
          ((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V).functor.map (lamN.over V))) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (restrictOpenLift q U V h)).map
        ((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map
          (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver U fM fN).symm.hom) ≫
      (restrictOpenLiftOverEquivFreePUnitIso q U V h).hom =
    (restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso q U V h (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X M N)).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V).functor.map
        ((SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q M N).hom.over V) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V).functor.map
        (Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver V gM gN).symm.hom
proof:
:= by
  let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q
  let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (restrictOpenLift q U V h)
  let EU := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U
  let E := (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V).functor
  let PU := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit X U
  let PV := SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit Y V
  let B := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivFreePUnitIso q U V h
  let A := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso q U V h (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X M N)
  let C₀ := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso_viaRestriction q U V h M N
  let C₁ := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso_viaRestriction q U V h PU PU
  let cast := pushedUnitRestrictOpenImmersionCastIso q U V h
  let S := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver U
    (pushedUnitOpenFrame X U) (pushedUnitOpenFrame X U)
  let tF := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver V
    (pushedUnitOpenFrame Y V) (pushedUnitOpenFrame Y V)
  let TU := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver U fM fN
  let TV := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver V gM gN
  let τG := SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y V (G.obj M) (G.obj N)
  let τP := SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverIso Y V PV PV
  let oP := overEquivTensorSheafIso Y V PV PV
  let β := SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q M N
  let Kx := (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap X κM κN).over U
  let K := (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap Y lamM lamN).over V
  have hU := pushedUnitTensorFrame_openLift q U V h
  change H.map (EU.functor.map S.hom) ≫ C₁.hom ≫
      SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
        (E.map (cast.hom.over V)) (E.map (cast.hom.over V)) ≫
      oP.inv ≫ E.map τP.hom ≫ E.map tF.inv = B.hom at hU
  change H.map (EU.functor.map Kx) ≫ C₁.hom ≫
      SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
        (E.map (cast.hom.over V)) (E.map (cast.hom.over V)) =
      C₀.hom ≫ SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
        (E.map (lamM.over V)) (E.map (lamN.over V)) at hC
  change TU.hom ≫ Kx = S.hom at hS
  change TV.hom ≫ K = tF.hom at hT
  have hPost := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso_viaRestriction_post_naturality
    q U V h lamM lamN
  change C₀.hom ≫ SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
        (E.map (lamM.over V)) (E.map (lamN.over V)) =
      A.hom ≫ E.map (β.hom.over V) ≫ E.map τG.inv ≫
        E.map (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap Y V (lamM.over V) (lamN.over V)) ≫
        oP.hom at hPost
  have hK : K = τG.inv ≫
      SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafOverMap Y V (lamM.over V) (lamN.over V) ≫ τP.hom :=
    tensorSheafMap_hom_over lamM lamN V
  have hKey : A.hom ≫ E.map (β.hom.over V) ≫ E.map K =
      C₀.hom ≫ SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (V : Scheme)
        (E.map (lamM.over V)) (E.map (lamN.over V)) ≫ oP.inv ≫ E.map τP.hom := by
    rw [reassoc_of% hPost, hK]
    simp only [Functor.map_comp, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  have hSinv : TU.inv ≫ S.hom = Kx := by
    rw [← hS, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  have hTinv : TV.inv = K ≫ tF.inv := by
    rw [Iso.eq_comp_inv, ← hT, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  have hL : H.map (EU.functor.map TU.inv) ≫ H.map (EU.functor.map S.hom) =
      H.map (EU.functor.map Kx) := by
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp, hSinv]
  change H.map (EU.functor.map TU.inv) ≫ B.hom =
    A.hom ≫ E.map (β.hom.over V) ≫ E.map TV.inv
  rw [← hU, reassoc_of% hL, reassoc_of% hC, hTinv, Functor.map_comp, reassoc_of% hKey]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver_openLift_middleSquare
statement:
theorem intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver_openLift_middleSquare
    {R S M N ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [Finite ι]
    {b : Module.Basis ι R M} {c : Module.Basis ι S N}
    {d e : ℤ} {q : space S N ⟶ space R M} [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (Dd : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c d q)
    (De : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c e q)
    (hOpen : ∀ i, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b i) =
      linearOpen S N (c i))
    (hDd : Dd.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q hOpen).hom)
    (hDe : De.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q hOpen).hom)
    (i : ι)
    :
    let X
proof:
:= space R M
    let Y := space S N
    let U := linearOpen R M (b i)
    let V := linearOpen S N (c i)
    let H := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor
      (restrictOpenLift q U V (hOpen i))
    let EU := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U
    let EV := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V
    let E := EV.functor
    let G := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q
    let Td := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d
    let Te := twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b e
    let A (T : X.Modules) := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivIso q U V (hOpen i) T
    let Fd := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLiftTransport hOpen Dd hDd i
    let Fe := intrinsicTwistingFrameOver_openLiftTransport hOpen De hDe i
    let Tframe := Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver V
      Fd.val Fe.val
    let B := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivFreePUnitIso q U V (hOpen i)
    H.map (EU.functor.map
        ((Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.tensorFrameOver U
          (intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b d i U le_rfl)
          (intrinsicTwistingFrameOver b e i U le_rfl)).symm.hom)) ≫
      B.hom =
    (A (SchemeKTheory.tensorSheaf X Td Te)).hom ≫
      E.map (((SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q Td Te).hom.over V)) ≫
      E.map Tframe.symm.hom
 := by
  intro X Y U V H EU EV E G Td Te A Fd Fe Tframe B
  have hC := restrictOpenLiftOverEquivTensorIso_twistingComponents_naturality
    Dd De hOpen hDd hDe i
  dsimp only at hC
  rw [SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap_comp, ← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp,
    ← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp] at hC
  exact openLiftTensorFrame_middle_generic q U V (hOpen i)
    (twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b d i) (twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b e i)
    (Dd.restrictIso.hom ≫ twistingSheafBasisComponent S N c d i)
    (De.restrictIso.hom ≫ twistingSheafBasisComponent S N c e i)
    _ _ Fd.val Fe.val
    (intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver_hom_comp_basisComponents b d e i)
    (intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver_openLiftTransport_comp_basisComponents
      Dd De hOpen hDd hDe i)
    hC

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistingSheafRestrictionData_tensorNaturality
statement:
theorem twistingSheafRestrictionData_tensorNaturality
    {R S M N ι : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N]
    [Finite ι]
    {b : Module.Basis ι R M} {c : Module.Basis ι S N}
    {d e : ℤ} {q : space S N ⟶ space R M} [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (Dd : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c d q)
    (De : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c e q)
    (Ds : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c (d + e) q)
    (hOpen : ∀ i, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b i) =
      linearOpen S N (c i))
    (hDd : Dd.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q hOpen).hom)
    (hDe : De.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q hOpen).hom)
    (hDs : Ds.chartIso.hom =
      (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q hOpen).hom) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
          (intrinsicTwistingTensorHom b d e) ≫ Ds.restrictIso.hom =
      (SchemeKTheory.restrictFunctorObjTensorSheafIso q
          (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b d)
          (twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b e)).hom ≫
        SchemeKTheory.tensorSheafMap (space S N)
          Dd.restrictIso.hom De.restrictIso.hom ≫
        intrinsicTwistingTensorHom c d e
proof:
:=
  twistingSheafRestrictionData_tensorNaturality_of_middleFrameSquare
    Dd De Ds hOpen hDd hDe hDs
    (fun i ↦ intrinsicTwistingTensorFrameOver_openLift_middleSquare Dd De hOpen hDd hDe i)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E15.inv_series_rel
statement:
theorem inv_series_rel (ℓ : R) (u v : PowerSeries R) (hu : PowerSeries.constantCoeff u = 1)
    (hv : PowerSeries.constantCoeff v = 1)
    (h0 : PowerSeries.coeff 0 v = PowerSeries.coeff 0 u)
    (hs : ∀ n, PowerSeries.coeff (n + 1) v =
      PowerSeries.coeff (n + 1) u - PowerSeries.coeff n u * ℓ) (n : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff (n + 1) (PowerSeries.invOfUnit u 1) =
      PowerSeries.coeff (n + 1) (PowerSeries.invOfUnit v 1) -
        ℓ * PowerSeries.coeff n (PowerSeries.invOfUnit v 1) ∧
    PowerSeries.coeff 0 (PowerSeries.invOfUnit u 1) =
      PowerSeries.coeff 0 (PowerSeries.invOfUnit v 1)
proof:
:= by
  set φ : PowerSeries R := 1 - PowerSeries.C ℓ * PowerSeries.X with hφ
  have hvu : v = u * φ := by
    refine PowerSeries.ext fun n => ?_
    rcases n with _ | n
    · simp [hφ, h0]
    · rw [hs n, hφ, mul_sub, mul_one, ← mul_assoc, map_sub]
      rw [PowerSeries.coeff_succ_mul_X, PowerSeries.coeff_mul_C]
  have hu1 : PowerSeries.constantCoeff u = ((1 : Rˣ) : R) := by simpa using hu
  have hv1 : PowerSeries.constantCoeff v = ((1 : Rˣ) : R) := by simpa using hv
  have h1 := PowerSeries.mul_invOfUnit v 1 hv1
  have h2 := PowerSeries.invOfUnit_mul u 1 hu1
  have key : PowerSeries.invOfUnit u 1 = φ * PowerSeries.invOfUnit v 1 := by
    calc PowerSeries.invOfUnit u 1
        = PowerSeries.invOfUnit u 1 * (u * (φ * PowerSeries.invOfUnit v 1)) := by
          rw [← mul_assoc u, ← hvu, h1, mul_one]
      _ = φ * PowerSeries.invOfUnit v 1 := by rw [← mul_assoc, h2, one_mul]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [key, hφ, sub_mul, one_mul, mul_assoc, map_sub, PowerSeries.coeff_C_mul,
      PowerSeries.coeff_succ_X_mul]
  · rw [key, hφ]
    simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E15.totalPush_congr
statement:
theorem totalPush_congr {V W : Scheme.{u}} [V.Over (Spk k)] [W.Over (Spk k)]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (V ↘ Spk k)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (W ↘ Spk k)] [IsNoetherian V]
    [IsNoetherian W] (f g : V ⟶ W) (h : f = g) [f.IsOver (Spk k)] [g.IsOver (Spk k)]
    [IsProper f] [IsProper g] : totalPush ops f = totalPush ops g
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E15.sandwich_rel
statement:
theorem sandwich_rel (P : ProjDivisorData ops cp L B D hL e) (m : ℕ) (x : TotalChow X) :
    sandwich ops P.CD cp P.hCD m x =
      sandwich ops P.CB cp P.hCB (m + 1) x - sandwich ops P.CB cp P.hCB m (totalCap ops L hL x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨iso⟩ := P.twist
  haveI := P.isOver
  haveI := P.isClosedImmersion
  haveI : Flat P.CB.toBase :=
    P.CB.toBase_flat (P.CB.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card P.hCB (Nat.succ_pos _))
  haveI : Flat P.CD.toBase :=
    P.CD.toBase_flat (P.CD.nonempty_basisIndex_of_card P.hCD (Nat.succ_pos _))
  haveI : (P.j ≫ P.CB.toBase).IsOver (Spk k) := by rw [P.comm]; infer_instance
  haveI : IsProper (P.j ≫ P.CB.toBase) := by rw [P.comm]; infer_instance
  have hpush : totalPush ops P.CD.toBase = totalPush ops P.CB.toBase ∘ₗ totalPush ops P.j := by
    rw [← totalPush_congr ops _ _ P.comm]
    exact cp.push_comp P.j P.CB.toBase
  have hxi : ∀ y, totalPush ops P.j (xiCap ops P.CD y) = xiCap ops P.CB (totalPush ops P.j y) := by
    intro y
    have h1 := cp.cap_push P.j (P.CB.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
      (P.CB.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
    have h2 := cp.cap_iso (hasConstantRank_pullback P.CD.scheme P.j _ 1
      (P.CB.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))
      (P.CD.hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) ⟨iso⟩
    have h3 := LinearMap.congr_fun h1 y
    rw [h2] at h3
    exact h3
  have hxipow : ∀ (n : ℕ) y, totalPush ops P.j ((xiCap ops P.CD ^ n) y) =
      (xiCap ops P.CB ^ n) (totalPush ops P.j y) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => intro y; simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro y
      rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, ih, hxi]
  have hpull : ∀ z, pullProj ops cp P.CB P.hCB (totalCap ops L hL z) =
      capPullLine ops L hL P.CB (pullProj ops cp P.CB P.hCB z) := fun z =>
    LinearMap.congr_fun (cp.cap_pull P.CB.toBase _ (cp.projBundle_relDim P.CB P.hCB) L hL) z
  have e1 : sandwich ops P.CD cp P.hCD m x =
      totalPush ops P.CB.toBase (totalPush ops P.j
        ((xiCap ops P.CD ^ m) (pullProj ops cp P.CD P.hCD x))) := by
    change totalPush ops P.CD.toBase ((xiCap ops P.CD ^ m) (pullProj ops cp P.CD P.hCD x)) = _
    rw [hpush]
    rfl
  rw [e1, hxipow, P.push_eq x, LinearMap.sub_apply, map_sub, map_sub]
  have e2 : ∀ r, sandwich ops P.CB cp P.hCB r x =
      totalPush ops P.CB.toBase ((xiCap ops P.CB ^ r) (pullProj ops cp P.CB P.hCB x)) :=
    fun r => rfl
  have e3 : sandwich ops P.CB cp P.hCB m (totalCap ops L hL x) =
      totalPush ops P.CB.toBase ((xiCap ops P.CB ^ m)
        (capPullLine ops L hL P.CB (pullProj ops cp P.CB P.hCB x))) := by
    change totalPush ops P.CB.toBase ((xiCap ops P.CB ^ m)
      (pullProj ops cp P.CB P.hCB (totalCap ops L hL x))) = _
    rw [hpull]
  rw [e2, e3, pow_succ, Module.End.mul_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E15.segre_rel
statement:
theorem segre_rel (P : ProjDivisorData ops cp L B D hL e) :
    segre ops P.CD cp P.hCD 0 = segre ops P.CB cp P.hCB 0 ∧
    ∀ i, segre ops P.CD cp P.hCD (i + 1) =
      segre ops P.CB cp P.hCB (i + 1) - segre ops P.CB cp P.hCB i * totalCap ops L hL
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun i => ?_⟩
  · refine LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
    have h := sandwich_rel ops cp P e x
    have z : sandwich ops P.CB cp P.hCB e = 0 := sandwich_eq_zero_of_lt ops P.CB cp P.hCB
      (Nat.lt_succ_self e)
    change sandwich ops P.CD cp P.hCD (e + 0) x = sandwich ops P.CB cp P.hCB (e + 1 + 0) x
    rw [add_zero, add_zero, h, z]
    simp
  · refine LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
    have h := sandwich_rel ops cp P (e + (i + 1)) x
    change sandwich ops P.CD cp P.hCD (e + (i + 1)) x =
      sandwich ops P.CB cp P.hCB (e + 1 + (i + 1)) x -
        (sandwich ops P.CB cp P.hCB (e + 1 + i) * totalCap ops L hL) x
    rw [h, Module.End.mul_apply, show e + 1 + i = e + (i + 1) by omega,
      show e + 1 + (i + 1) = e + (i + 1) + 1 by omega]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E15.sum_pattern
statement:
theorem sum_pattern (ℓ : Module.End ℚ (TotalChow X)) (F : ℕ → Module.End ℚ (TotalChow X))
    (m : ℕ) :
    (∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal (m + 1),
      (if p.1 = 0 then (1 : Module.End ℚ (TotalChow X)) else if p.1 = 1 then ℓ else 0) ∘ₗ F p.2)
      = F (m + 1) + ℓ ∘ₗ F m
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_succ]
  simp only [if_true, Module.End.one_eq_id, LinearMap.id_comp, Nat.succ_ne_zero, if_false]
  congr 1
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (0, m)]
  · simp
  · intro p _ hp
    have : p.1 ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hp (Prod.ext h0 (by
      have := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp ‹p ∈ _›; simp_all))
    simp [this]
  · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mpr (by simp)) h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E15.whitneyConv_of_projDivisorData
statement:
theorem whitneyConv_of_projDivisorData (P : ProjDivisorData ops cp L B D hL e)
    (hB : HasConstantRank X B (e + 1 + 1)) (hD : HasConstantRank X D (e + 1)) :
    WhitneyConv (X := X) (geometricChernAssign ops cp) L B D
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  obtain ⟨s0, srel⟩ := segre_rel ops cp P
  have hu0 : segre ops P.CB cp P.hCB 0 = 1 := segre_zero ops P.CB cp P.hCB
  have hv0 : segre ops P.CD cp P.hCD 0 = 1 := segre_zero ops P.CD cp P.hCD
  set u := segreSeries ops P.CB cp P.hCB with hu
  set v := segreSeries ops P.CD cp P.hCD with hv
  have hcu : PowerSeries.constantCoeff u = 1 := by
    simp [hu, segreSeries, ← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, hu0]
  have hcv : PowerSeries.constantCoeff v = 1 := by
    simp [hv, segreSeries, ← PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, hv0]
  have hrel := inv_series_rel (totalCap ops L hL) u v hcu hcv
    (by simp [hu, hv, segreSeries, s0]) (fun n => by simp [hu, hv, segreSeries, srel n])
  have hL1 := geometricChernAssign_line ops cp L hL
  rw [geometricChernAssign_constantRank ops cp B (e + 1 + 1) hB,
    show chernOp ops cp B (e + 1 + 1) hB = chernOfCover ops P.CB cp P.hCB from
      chernOp_eq_chernOfCover ops cp P.CB hB P.hCB]
  simp_rw [geometricChernAssign_constantRank ops cp D (e + 1) hD,
    show chernOp ops cp D (e + 1) hD = chernOfCover ops P.CD cp P.hCD from
      chernOp_eq_chernOfCover ops cp P.CD hD P.hCD, hL1]
  simp only [geometricChernLineVal]
  rcases n with _ | n
  · rw [Finset.Nat.antidiagonal_zero, Finset.sum_singleton]
    simp only [chernOfCover, pow_zero, one_smul, if_true, Module.End.one_eq_id,
      LinearMap.id_comp]
    exact (hrel 0).2
  · rw [sum_pattern]
    obtain ⟨h1, -⟩ := hrel n
    simp only [chernOfCover]
    have key : ∀ (a : ℚ) (x y : Module.End ℚ (TotalChow X)), a • (x - y) = a • x - a • y :=
      fun a x y => smul_sub a x y
    rw [← hv, h1, key, pow_succ]
    simp only [mul_neg, mul_one, Module.End.mul_eq_comp, LinearMap.comp_smul]
    module

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E15.whitneyConv_of_rankOpens_D
statement:
theorem whitneyConv_of_rankOpens_D {φ : CharAssign k} {lv : LineVal k}
    (hφ : IsNaturalChar ops φ lv) {A B D : X.Modules} (hA : IsFiniteLocallyFree X A)
    (hB : IsFiniteLocallyFree X B) (hD : IsFiniteLocallyFree X D)
    (h : ∀ r ∈ rankAssembly_ranks D hD,
      WhitneyConv (X := (characteristicRankOpen D hD r : Scheme)) φ
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (characteristicRankOpen D hD r).ι).obj A)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (characteristicRankOpen D hD r).ι).obj B)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (characteristicRankOpen D hD r).ι).obj D)) :
    WhitneyConv (X := X) φ A B D
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro α
  apply rankAssembly_total_joint_injective D hD ops
  intro r hr
  have hd := pureRelDim_openImmersion k (characteristicRankOpen D hD r).ι
  have h1 := LinearMap.congr_fun (hφ.natural (characteristicRankOpen D hD r).ι 0 hd B hB n) α
  have h2 := LinearMap.congr_fun
    (whitneyConv_pull_convolution ops hφ (characteristicRankOpen D hD r).ι 0 hd hA hD n) α
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at h1 h2
  rw [h1, h2, h r hr n]
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E15.lineSubWhitney_of_projDivisorGate
statement:
theorem lineSubWhitney_of_projDivisorGate (hG : ProjDivisorGate ops cp) :
    LineSubWhitney ops cp
proof:
:= by
  intro Y _ _ _ L B D a b w hex hL hB hD
  haveI : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y L := hL.isFiniteLocallyFree
  haveI : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y B := hB
  haveI : IsFiniteLocallyFree Y D := hD
  refine whitneyConv_of_rankOpens_D ops (geometricChernAssign_isNatural ops cp)
    hL.isFiniteLocallyFree hB hD ?_
  intro r _
  let ι := (characteristicRankOpen D hD r).ι
  have hDr := characteristicRankOpen_hasConstantRank D hD r
  have hT := pullback_map_shortExact_global ι (ShortComplex.mk a b w) hex
  have hqB := pullback_isFiniteLocallyFree_global ι B hB
  have hqL := hasConstantRank_pullback _ ι L 1 hL
  have hT' : (ShortComplex.mk ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).map a)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).map b) (by
        rw [← Functor.map_comp, w, Functor.map_zero])).ShortExact := hT
  have hBr : HasConstantRank (characteristicRankOpen D hD r : Scheme)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj B) (1 + r) :=
    hasConstantRank_of_pointwise_rank _ hqB _ (fun x => by
      rw [rankAt_add x _ hT' hqL.isFiniteLocallyFree hDr.isFiniteLocallyFree,
        rankAt_of_hasConstantRank hqL, rankAt_of_hasConstantRank hDr])
  cases r with
  | zero =>
    intro n
    exact geometricChernAssign_whitney_right_zero ops cp _ _ _ hT' hDr n
  | succ e =>
    have hBr' : HasConstantRank (characteristicRankOpen D hD (e + 1) : Scheme)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ι).obj B) (e + 1 + 1) := by
      have : 1 + (e + 1) = e + 1 + 1 := by omega
      rwa [this] at hBr
    obtain ⟨P⟩ := hG _ _ _ hT' hqL e hBr' hDr
    exact whitneyConv_of_projDivisorData ops cp P hBr' hDr

name: AlgebraicGeometry.D34.homEquiv_map_chain
proof:
:= by
  have : F.map f ≫ F.map g ≫ F.map h ≫ adj.counit.app M =
      (adj.homEquiv _ _).symm (f ≫ g ≫ h) := by
    rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_counit]
    simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.D34.tensorTriv_inv_eq
statement:
theorem tensorTriv_inv_eq (V : X.Opens)
    (θ : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V) PUnit ≅ L.over V) :
    (tensorTriv L E V θ).inv =
      (moduleSheafificationOverIso X V (L.val ⊗ E.val)).inv ≫ tensorTrivQ L E V θ
proof:
:= by
  unfold tensorTrivQ tensorTriv
  unfold tensorSheafOverIso tensorSheafOverMapIso tensorSheafOverLeftUnitor
  simp only [Iso.trans_inv, Iso.symm_inv, Functor.mapIso_inv, tensorIso_inv, Iso.trans_hom,
    Functor.mapIso_hom, Category.assoc]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.D34.adjunct_tensorTriv_inv
statement:
theorem adjunct_tensorTriv_inv (V : X.Opens)
    (θ : SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V) PUnit ≅ L.over V) :
    Scheme.Modules.moduleSheafificationOverHomEquiv X V (tensorUnderlyingPresheaf L E)
        (E.over V) (tensorTriv L E V θ).inv =
      tensorTrivAdjunct L E V θ
proof:
:= by
  let R' := (((Over.forget V).op ⋙ X.presheaf) ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)
  letI : MonoidalCategory (_root_.PresheafOfModules.{u} R') := inferInstance
  let A := SheafOfModules.identitySheafificationOver
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.ringCatSheaf V
  let F := PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀OfCommRingCat (Over.forget V) X.presheaf
  let θ' := (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over V)).symm ≪≫ θ
  let Md : _root_.PresheafOfModules.{u} R' := (L.over V).val
  let Nd : _root_.PresheafOfModules.{u} R' := (E.over V).val
  let Sd : _root_.PresheafOfModules.{u} R' :=
    (SheafOfModules.unit (X.ringCatSheaf.over V)).val
  let dInv : Md ⟶ Sd := θ'.inv.val
  let G := tensorTriv L E V θ
  let adj := PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
    (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over V).obj)
  let μ := Functor.Monoidal.μIso F L.val E.val
  let l := MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor Nd
  let de := dInv ⊗ₘ 𝟙 Nd
  let eP := moduleSheafificationOverIso X V (L.val ⊗ E.val)
  let M := E.over V
  let q := A.map μ.inv ≫ A.map de ≫ A.map l.hom ≫ adj.counit.app M
  unfold tensorTrivAdjunct
  dsimp only
  change adj.homEquiv _ _ (eP.hom ≫ G.inv) = μ.inv ≫ de ≫ l.hom
  have hG : G.inv = eP.inv ≫ q := tensorTriv_inv_eq L E V θ
  rw [hG]
  calc
    _ = adj.homEquiv _ _ q := congrArg (adj.homEquiv _ _) (eP.hom_inv_id_assoc q)
    _ = _ := homEquiv_map_chain (M := M) adj μ.inv de l.hom

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.structure_eq
statement: theorem structure_eq : (A ↘ Spk k) = A.toSpecΓ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (phiK (k := k) (A := A)))
proof:
:= by
  have h := Scheme.toSpecΓ_naturality (A ↘ Spk k)
  rw [← SpecMap_ΓSpecIso_hom] at h
  have h2 := congrArg (· ≫ Spec.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv) h
  simp only [Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id, Spec.map_id, Category.comp_id] at h2
  rw [h2]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.openι_structure
statement:
theorem openι_structure (U : A.affineOpens) :
    U.1.ι ≫ (A ↘ Spk k) = (U.2).isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (DeformationSpace.kAlg A k (phiK (k := k) (A := A)) U))
proof:
:= by
  rw [structure_eq, ← Category.assoc, ← Scheme.Opens.toSpecΓ_SpecMap_presheaf_map_top, IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_hom, Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.isPullback_affine_k
statement:
theorem isPullback_affine_k (U : A.affineOpens) :
    IsPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.mapRingHom (DeformationSpace.kAlg A k (phiK (k := k) (A := A)) U))))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.C : Γ(A, U.1) →+* Γ(A, U.1)[X])))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.C : k →+* k[X])))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (DeformationSpace.kAlg A k (phiK (k := k) (A := A)) U)))
proof:
:= by
  letI := (DeformationSpace.kAlg A k (phiK (k := k) (A := A)) U).toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra k[X] Γ(A, U.1)[X] := Polynomial.algebra k Γ(A, U.1)
  exact isPullback_SpecMap_of_isPushout _ _ _ _
    (CommRingCat.isPushout_of_isPushout k k[X] Γ(A, U.1) Γ(A, U.1)[X])

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.lineAffineToOpen_eq
statement:
theorem lineAffineToOpen_eq (U : A.affineOpens) :
    GlobalCompletion.lineAffineToOpen A U =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.C : Γ(A, U.1) →+* Γ(A, U.1)[X])) ≫ (U.2).isoSpec.inv
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_epi (GlobalCompletion.lineAffineIso A U).hom]
  have h : (GlobalCompletion.lineAffineIso A U).hom ≫ GlobalCompletion.lineAffineToOpen A U =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Γ(A, U.1) (AffineDeformationSpace.extendedRees Γ(A, U.1) (⊥ : Ideal Γ(A, U.1))))) ≫ (U.2).isoSpec.inv := by
    unfold GlobalCompletion.lineAffineToOpen
    simp only [← Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.id_comp]
    rfl
  rw [h]
  dsimp only [GlobalCompletion.lineAffineIso, asIso_hom]
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 2
  refine CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext fun r ↦ ?_)
  change algebraMap _ _ r = (AffineDeformationSpace.structureMap Γ(A, U.1) (⊥ : Ideal Γ(A, U.1))) (Polynomial.C r)
  rw [Polynomial.C_eq_algebraMap]
  exact ((AffineDeformationSpace.structureMap Γ(A, U.1) (⊥ : Ideal Γ(A, U.1))).commutes r).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.lineAffineι_toLineOver
statement:
theorem lineAffineι_toLineOver (U : A.affineOpens) :
    GlobalCompletion.lineAffineι A U ≫ DeformationSpace.toLineOver A ⊥ k (phiK (k := k) (A := A)) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.mapRingHom (DeformationSpace.kAlg A k (phiK (k := k) (A := A)) U)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold GlobalCompletion.lineAffineι
  rw [Category.assoc, DeformationSpace.affineι_toLineOver, Iso.inv_comp_eq]
  unfold GlobalCompletion.lineAffineIso
  rw [asIso_hom, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.isPullback_line
statement:
theorem isPullback_line :
    IsPullback (DeformationSpace.toBase A ⊥)
      (DeformationSpace.toLineOver A ⊥ k (phiK (k := k) (A := A))) (A ↘ Spk k)
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Polynomial.C : k →+* k[X])))
proof:
:= by
  refine Scheme.isPullback_of_openCover _ _ _ _ A.directedAffineCover fun U ↦ ?_
  have h := (GlobalCompletion.isPullback_lineAffine A U).flip
  refine (isPullback_affine_k U).flip.of_iso h.isoPullback (U.2).isoSpec.symm (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · change _ = h.isoPullback.hom ≫ pullback.snd _ _
    rw [h.isoPullback_hom_snd, lineAffineToOpen_eq]
    rfl
  · change _ = h.isoPullback.hom ≫ pullback.fst _ _ ≫ _
    rw [← Category.assoc, h.isoPullback_hom_fst, lineAffineι_toLineOver]
    simp
  · change _ = (U.2).isoSpec.inv ≫ U.1.ι ≫ _
    rw [openι_structure]
    simp
  · simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.line_w
statement:
theorem line_w (i : Fin 2) :
    DeformationSpace.toBase A ⊥ ≫ (A ↘ Spk k) =
      (DeformationSpace.toLineOver A ⊥ k (phiK (k := k) (A := A)) ≫ ProjectiveLine.chart k i) ≫ toSpec k 1
proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.jChart_snd

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB6.isPullback_jChart
statement:
theorem isPullback_jChart (i : Fin 2) :
    IsPullback (jChart (k := k) (A := A) i) (DeformationSpace.toLineOver A ⊥ k (phiK (k := k) (A := A)))
      (pullback.snd (A ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1)) (ProjectiveLine.chart k i)
proof:
:= by
  have hbig : IsPullback (jChart (k := k) (A := A) i ≫ pullback.fst _ _)
      (DeformationSpace.toLineOver A ⊥ k (phiK (k := k) (A := A))) (A ↘ Spk k)
      (ProjectiveLine.chart k i ≫ toSpec k 1) := by

  exact IsPullback.of_right hbig (jChart_snd i) (IsPullback.of_hasPullback (A ↘ Spk k) (toSpec k 1))

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1BR.finitePushforward_id
statement:
theorem finitePushforward_id (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] :
    finitePushforward (𝟙 X) = AddMonoidHom.id (G0 X)
proof:
:= by
  apply ExactGrothendieck.hom_ext
  intro x
  change finitePushforward (𝟙 X) (g0ClassOf X x.1 x.2) = g0ClassOf X x.1 x.2
  rw [finitePushforward_classOf]
  exact ExactGrothendieck.subcategoryClassOf_iso X.Modules (IsCoherentLike X) _ _
    (show IsCoherentLike X (0 : X.Modules) from
      inferInstanceAs (0 : X.Modules).IsFinitePresentation)
    (isZero_zero _) ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardId X).app x.1)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1BR.finitePushforward_inv_hom

theorem finitePushforward_inv_hom (e : X ≅ W) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsLocallyNoetherian W] :

proof:

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1BR.fShriekG0_coverIso_hom
statement:
theorem fShriekG0_coverIso_hom (i : X ⟶ (cover g n).scheme) [IsClosedImmersion i] :
    fShriekG0 g hn (i ≫ (coverIso g n).hom) =
      (SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.projectiveBundleDerivedPushforward
        (cover_rank g hn)).comp (finitePushforward i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold fShriekG0 piShriek
  rw [ARRG45C.finitePushforward_comp]
  refine AddMonoidHom.ext fun z => ?_
  have := congrArg (fun φ : G0 (cover g n).scheme →+ G0 (cover g n).scheme => φ (finitePushforward i z))
    (finitePushforward_inv_hom (coverIso g n))
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.id_apply] at this ⊢
  rw [this]

        (cover_rank g hn)).comp (finitePushforward (j ≫ (coverIso g n).inv))

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1BR.grr_relative_fShriek
statement:
theorem grr_relative_fShriek (hCh : ChExact k (closedPosV4 k)) {r : ℕ}
    (hconormal : HasConstantRank X (conormalSheaf i) r)
    (hII : CaseII k (closedPosV4 k) hCh i)
    [(i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) n).toBase).IsOver (Spk k)]
    (x : K0 X) (w : K0 Y)
    (hw : k0ToG0 Y w =
      fShriekG0 (Y ↘ Spk k) hn (i ≫ (coverIso (Y ↘ Spk k) n).hom) (k0ToG0 X x)) :
    chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) hCh w (fundClass k (W := Y)) =
      totalPushOn (opsV4 k) (i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) n).toBase)
        (((tdLine k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj
            ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) n).canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))
          (hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1
            ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) n).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))) ^ (n + 1))
          (tauX k (closedPosV4 k) hCh i x))
proof:
:= by
  refine grr_relative_of_caseII k hY hreg hn i hCh hconormal hII x w ?_
  rw [hw, fShriekG0_coverIso_hom]
  rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1BR.grr_relative_fShriekK0
statement:
theorem grr_relative_fShriekK0 (hCh : ChExact k (closedPosV4 k)) {r : ℕ}
    (hconormal : HasConstantRank X (conormalSheaf i) r)
    (hII : CaseII k (closedPosV4 k) hCh i)
    [(i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) n).toBase).IsOver (Spk k)]
    (resY : ResolutionRegularClosedF15.Resolution Y) (x : K0 X) :
    chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) hCh
        (fShriekK0 resY (Y ↘ Spk k) hn (i ≫ (coverIso (Y ↘ Spk k) n).hom) x)
        (fundClass k (W := Y)) =
      totalPushOn (opsV4 k) (i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) n).toBase)
        (((tdLine k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj
            ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) n).canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))
          (hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1
            ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) n).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))) ^ (n + 1))
          (tauX k (closedPosV4 k) hCh i x))
proof:
:=
  grr_relative_fShriek k hY hreg hn i hCh hconormal hII x _
    (k0ToG0_fShriekK0 resY (Y ↘ Spk k) hn (i ≫ (coverIso (Y ↘ Spk k) n).hom) x)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1BR.grr_relative_fShriekK0PI
statement:
theorem grr_relative_fShriekK0PI (hCh : ChExact k (closedPosV4 k)) {r : ℕ}
    (hconormal : HasConstantRank X (conormalSheaf i) r)
    (hII : CaseII k (closedPosV4 k) hCh i)
    [(i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) n).toBase).IsOver (Spk k)] (x : K0 X) :
    chK0 k (closedPosV4 k) hCh
        (fShriekK0PI hY hreg n (i ≫ (coverIso (Y ↘ Spk k) n).hom) x)
        (fundClass k (W := Y)) =
      totalPushOn (opsV4 k) (i ≫ (cover (Y ↘ Spk k) n).toBase)
        (((tdLine k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj
            ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) n).canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))
          (hasConstantRank_pullback X i _ 1
            ((cover (Y ↘ Spk k) n).hasConstantRank_canonicalTwistingSheaf 1))) ^ (n + 1))
          (tauX k (closedPosV4 k) hCh i x))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  exact grr_relative_fShriekK0 k hY hreg hn i hCh hconormal hII
    (resolutionOfProjectiveIntegralK hY hreg) x

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1BR.fShriekG0All_zero
statement:
theorem fShriekG0All_zero (j : X ⟶ pullback g (toSpec k 0)) [IsClosedImmersion j] :

name: GRRBlueprintV4.T1BR.fShriekG0All_succ

theorem fShriekG0All_succ (m : ℕ) (j : X ⟶ pullback g (toSpec k (m + 1))) [IsClosedImmersion j] :

proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.awayMap_surjective_of_degreewise
statement:
theorem awayMap_surjective_of_degreewise (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ)
    (hsurj : ∀ (i : ℕ) (b : B), b ∈ ℬ i → ∃ a ∈ 𝒜 i, f a = b) {d : ℕ} (s : A) (hs : s ∈ 𝒜 d) :
    Function.Surjective (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map f s)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨m, x, hx, rfl⟩ := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_surjective ℬ (f.map_mem hs) z
  obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := hsurj _ x hx
  refine ⟨HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk 𝒜 hs m a ha, ?_⟩
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map_mk]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.isClosedImmersion_projMap_of_surjective
statement:
theorem isClosedImmersion_projMap_of_surjective (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (hf : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map f)
    (hsurj : ∀ (i : ℕ) (b : B), b ∈ ℬ i → ∃ a ∈ 𝒜 i, f a = b) :
    IsClosedImmersion (Proj.map f hf)
proof:
:= by
  let 𝒰 := Proj.affineOpenCover 𝒜
  apply IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.of_openCover (𝒰 := 𝒰.openCover)
  intro s
  have hsq : IsPullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map f (s.2 : A))))
      (Proj.awayι ℬ (f s.2) (f.map_mem s.2.2) s.1.2) (Proj.awayι 𝒜 (s.2 : A) s.2.2 s.1.2)
      (Proj.map f hf) := by
    apply IsOpenImmersion.isPullback
    · exact Proj.awayι_comp_map f hf s.1.2 (s.2 : A) s.2.2
    · simpa only [Proj.opensRange_awayι] using Proj.map_preimage_basicOpen f hf (s.2 : A)
  change IsClosedImmersion (pullback.snd (Proj.map f hf) (Proj.awayι 𝒜 (s.2 : A) s.2.2 s.1.2))
  rw [← MorphismProperty.cancel_left_of_respectsIso @IsClosedImmersion
      hsq.flip.isoPullback.hom, hsq.flip.isoPullback_hom_snd]
  exact IsClosedImmersion.spec_of_surjective _
    (awayMap_surjective_of_degreewise f hsurj (s.2 : A) s.2.2)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.projMap_congr'
statement:
theorem projMap_congr' {f g : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ} (e : f = g)
    (hf : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map f)
    (hg : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).map g) :
    Proj.map f hf = Proj.map g hg
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.mem_of_hI
statement: theorem mem_of_hI (j : Fin (r + 1)) : s j ∈ I
proof:
:=
  hI.symm ▸ Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.genRingHom_X
statement:
theorem genRingHom_X (j : Fin (r + 1)) :
    genRingHom I s hI (MvPolynomial.X j) = generator I ⟨s j, mem_of_hI I s hI j⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp [genRingHom]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.genRingHom_C
statement:
theorem genRingHom_C (a : A) :
    genRingHom I s hI (MvPolynomial.C a) = algebraMap A (reesAlgebra I) a
proof:
:= by
  simp [genRingHom]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.algebraMap_mem_grade_zero
statement: theorem algebraMap_mem_grade_zero (a : A) : algebraMap A (reesAlgebra I) a ∈ grade I 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : ((algebraMap A (reesAlgebra I) a : reesAlgebra I) : _root_.Polynomial A) =
      _root_.Polynomial.C a := rfl
  change ((algebraMap A (reesAlgebra I) a : reesAlgebra I) : _root_.Polynomial A) =
    _root_.Polynomial.monomial 0
      (((algebraMap A (reesAlgebra I) a : reesAlgebra I) : _root_.Polynomial A).coeff 0)
  rw [h]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.genRingHom_mem_grade
statement:
theorem genRingHom_mem_grade {d : ℕ} {p : SchemeProjectiveSpace.Polynomial A r}
    (hp : p ∈ grading A r d) : genRingHom I s hI p ∈ grade I d
proof:
:= by
  have hp' : p.IsHomogeneous d := hp
  rw [MvPolynomial.as_sum p, map_sum]
  refine sum_mem fun m hm ↦ ?_
  have hdeg : m.degree = d := by
    rw [Finsupp.degree_eq_weight_one]
    exact hp' (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hm)
  have h1 : genRingHom I s hI (MvPolynomial.monomial m (MvPolynomial.coeff m p)) =
      algebraMap A (reesAlgebra I) (MvPolynomial.coeff m p) *
        ∏ j ∈ m.support, generator I ⟨s j, mem_of_hI I s hI j⟩ ^ m j := by
    simp [genRingHom, MvPolynomial.eval₂_monomial, Finsupp.prod]
  rw [h1]
  have h2 : ∏ j ∈ m.support, generator I ⟨s j, mem_of_hI I s hI j⟩ ^ m j ∈
      grade I (∑ j ∈ m.support, m j • 1) :=
    SetLike.prod_pow_mem_graded (grade I) (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℕ))
      (fun j ↦ generator I ⟨s j, mem_of_hI I s hI j⟩) (F := m.support) m
      (fun j _ ↦ generator_mem_grade_one I _)
  have h3 : ∑ j ∈ m.support, m j • 1 = d := by
    rw [← hdeg, Finsupp.degree]
    simp
  rw [h3] at h2
  have := SetLike.mul_mem_graded (algebraMap_mem_grade_zero I (MvPolynomial.coeff m p)) h2
  simpa using this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.pow_le_reachIdeal
statement: theorem pow_le_reachIdeal (i : ℕ) : I ^ i ≤ reachIdeal I s hI i
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    intro c _
    refine ⟨MvPolynomial.C c, MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_C _ _, ?_⟩
    rw [genRingHom_C]
    change _root_.Polynomial.C c = _
    simp
  | succ i ih =>
    rw [pow_succ]
    refine Ideal.mul_le.mpr fun x hx y hy ↦ ?_
    have hy' : y ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range s) := hI ▸ hy
    refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun y _ ↦ x * y ∈ reachIdeal I s hI (i + 1)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      hy'
    · rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨p, hp, hpx⟩ := ih hx
      refine ⟨p * MvPolynomial.X j, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact (show p.IsHomogeneous i from hp).mul (MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_X A j)
      · rw [map_mul, genRingHom_X, Subalgebra.coe_mul, hpx]
        change _root_.Polynomial.monomial i x * _root_.Polynomial.monomial 1 (s j) = _
        rw [_root_.Polynomial.monomial_mul_monomial]
    · simp
    · intro y z _ _ hy hz
      rw [mul_add]
      exact add_mem hy hz
    · intro a y _ hy
      rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_left_comm]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ a hy

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.genGraded_surjective
statement:
theorem genGraded_surjective (i : ℕ) (b : reesAlgebra I) (hb : b ∈ grade I i) :
    ∃ a ∈ grading A r i, genGraded I s hI a = b
proof:
:= by
  have hb' : (b : _root_.Polynomial A) =
      _root_.Polynomial.monomial i ((b : _root_.Polynomial A).coeff i) := hb
  have hc : (b : _root_.Polynomial A).coeff i ∈ I ^ i :=
    (mem_reesAlgebra_iff I _).mp b.2 i
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpc⟩ := pow_le_reachIdeal I s hI i hc
  refine ⟨p, hp, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
  change ((genRingHom I s hI p : reesAlgebra I) : _root_.Polynomial A) = _
  rw [hpc]
  exact hb'.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.irrelevant_le_map_genGraded
statement:
theorem irrelevant_le_map_genGraded :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grade I) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading A r)).map (genGraded I s hI)
proof:
:= by
  change (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grade I)).toIdeal ≤
    ((HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading A r)).map (genGraded I s hI)).toIdeal
  refine (irrelevant_le_span_generatorOfFamily I s hI).trans ?_
  rw [Ideal.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
  have hX := HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem (grading A r) Nat.zero_lt_one
    (coordinate_mem_degree_one A r j)
  have := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (genGraded I s hI) hX
  have hg : generatorOfFamily I s hI j = genGraded I s hI (coordinate A r j) :=
    (genRingHom_X I s hI j).symm
  rw [hg]
  exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.chartRho_toSpec
statement: theorem chartRho_toSpec : chartRho I s hI ≫ toSpec A r = ReesBlowup.projection I
proof:
:= by
  unfold chartRho
  change Proj.map (genGraded I s hI) (irrelevant_le_map_genGraded I s hI) ≫
      (Proj.toSpecZero (grading A r) ≫
        Spec.map (degreeZeroEquiv A r).symm.toCommRingCatIso.hom) = _
  rw [← Category.assoc, Proj.map_toSpecZero, Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp]
  unfold ReesBlowup.projection
  congr 2
  refine CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext fun a ↦ ?_)
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [Proj.degreeZeroMap, genGraded, genRingHom_C, degreeZeroEquiv, ReesBlowup.zeroEquiv,
    ReesBlowup.component]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.chartPsi_toSpec
statement:
theorem chartPsi_toSpec (κ : k →+* A) :
    chartPsi I s hI κ ≫ toSpec k r =
      ReesBlowup.projection I ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom κ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartPsi, Category.assoc, map_toSpec, ← Category.assoc, chartRho_toSpec]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.chartPhi_fst
statement:
theorem chartPhi_fst (κ : k →+* A) :
    chartPhi I s hI κ ≫ pullback.fst _ _ = ReesBlowup.projection I
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartPhi, Category.assoc, IsPullback.isoPullback_hom_fst, chartRho_toSpec]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.chartPhi_snd
statement:
theorem chartPhi_snd (κ : k →+* A) :
    chartPhi I s hI κ ≫ pullback.snd _ _ = chartPsi I s hI κ
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartPhi, Category.assoc, IsPullback.isoPullback_hom_snd, chartPsi]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.chartPsi_schemeMapOfEq
statement:
theorem chartPsi_schemeMapOfEq {B : Type u} [CommRing B] (f : A →+* B) (κ : k →+* A)
    (κ' : k →+* B) (hκ : f.comp κ = κ') (J : Ideal B)
    (hJ : J = Ideal.span (Set.range (fun j ↦ f (s j)))) (h : I.map f = J) :
    ReesBlowupOfEq.schemeMapOfEq I f J h ≫ chartPsi I s hI κ =
      chartPsi J (fun j ↦ f (s j)) hJ κ'
proof:
:= by
  subst hκ
  have key : (ReesBlowupOfEq.gradedMapOfEq I f J h).comp (genGraded I s hI) =
      (genGraded J (fun j ↦ f (s j)) hJ).comp (SchemeProjectiveSpace.gradedMap f r) := by
    apply GradedRingHom.ext
    intro p
    have hring : ((ReesBlowupOfEq.gradedMapOfEq I f J h).toRingHom.comp
        (genGraded I s hI).toRingHom) =
        (genGraded J (fun j ↦ f (s j)) hJ).toRingHom.comp (MvPolynomial.map f) := by
      apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
      · intro a
        apply Subtype.ext
        simp [genGraded, ReesBlowupOfEq.gradedMapOfEq, ReesBlowupOfEq.reesMapOfEq, genRingHom_C]
      · intro j
        apply Subtype.ext
        simp [genGraded, ReesBlowupOfEq.gradedMapOfEq, ReesBlowupOfEq.reesMapOfEq, genRingHom_X,
          ReesBlowup.generator]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun hring p
  have hl : ReesBlowupOfEq.schemeMapOfEq I f J h ≫ chartRho I s hI =
      Proj.map ((ReesBlowupOfEq.gradedMapOfEq I f J h).comp (genGraded I s hI))
        (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp (irrelevant_le_map_genGraded I s hI)
          (ReesBlowupOfEq.irrelevant_le_map_gradedMapOfEq I f J h)) :=
    (Proj.map_comp (genGraded I s hI) (ReesBlowupOfEq.gradedMapOfEq I f J h) _ _).symm
  have hr : chartRho J (fun j ↦ f (s j)) hJ ≫ SchemeProjectiveSpace.map f r =
      Proj.map ((genGraded J (fun j ↦ f (s j)) hJ).comp (SchemeProjectiveSpace.gradedMap f r))
        (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp (irrelevant_le_map_gradedMap f r)
          (irrelevant_le_map_genGraded J (fun j ↦ f (s j)) hJ)) :=
    (Proj.map_comp (SchemeProjectiveSpace.gradedMap f r) (genGraded J (fun j ↦ f (s j)) hJ)
      _ _).symm
  have e2 : SchemeProjectiveSpace.map (f.comp κ) r =
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.map f r ≫ SchemeProjectiveSpace.map κ r :=
    (SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.map_comp_map κ f r).symm
  rw [chartPsi, chartPsi, ← Category.assoc, hl, e2, ← Category.assoc, hr]
  congr 1
  exact ReesBlowupOfEq.projMap_congr key _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.projMap_comp_gradedScale
statement:
theorem projMap_comp_gradedScale {B σ : Type u} [CommRing B] [SetLike σ B]
    [AddSubgroupClass σ B] {ℬ : ℕ → σ} [GradedRing ℬ] (g : grading A r →+*ᵍ ℬ)
    (hg : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant ℬ ≤ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (grading A r)).map g)
    (u : Aˣ) :
    Proj.map (g.comp (SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.gradedScale (u : A)))
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_comp
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.irrelevant_le_map_gradedScale u) hg) =
      Proj.map g hg
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : Proj.map (SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.gradedScale (u : A))
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.irrelevant_le_map_gradedScale u) =
      𝟙 (Proj (grading A r)) := SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.map_gradedScale u
  rw [Proj.map_comp _ _ (SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.irrelevant_le_map_gradedScale u) hg, h2,
    Category.comp_id]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.genGraded_comp_gradedScale
statement:
theorem genGraded_comp_gradedScale (u : Aˣ) (s' : Fin (r + 1) → A)
    (hs' : ∀ j, s' j = (u : A) * s j) (hI' : I = Ideal.span (Set.range s')) :
    (genGraded I s hI).comp (SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.gradedScale (u : A)) =
      genGraded I s' hI'
proof:
:= by
  apply GradedRingHom.ext
  intro p
  have hring : (genGraded I s hI).toRingHom.comp
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.gradedScale (u : A)).toRingHom =
      (genGraded I s' hI').toRingHom := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro a
      simp [SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.gradedScale,
        SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.scaleRingHom, genGraded, genRingHom_C]
    · intro j
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp [SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.gradedScale,
        SchemeProjectiveSpace.SegreD36.scaleRingHom, genGraded, genRingHom_X,
        ReesBlowup.generator, hs']
      rw [genRingHom_C]
      change _root_.Polynomial.monomial 1 (s j) * _root_.Polynomial.C (u : A) = _
      rw [mul_comm, _root_.Polynomial.C_mul_monomial]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hring p

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.projMap_genGraded_unit
statement:
theorem projMap_genGraded_unit (u : Aˣ) (s' : Fin (r + 1) → A)
    (hs' : ∀ j, s' j = (u : A) * s j) (hI' : I = Ideal.span (Set.range s')) :
    Proj.map (genGraded I s' hI') (irrelevant_le_map_genGraded I s' hI') =
      Proj.map (genGraded I s hI) (irrelevant_le_map_genGraded I s hI)
proof:
:= by
  have key := genGraded_comp_gradedScale I s hI u s' hs' hI'
  have e2 := projMap_comp_gradedScale (genGraded I s hI) (irrelevant_le_map_genGraded I s hI) u
  refine (projMap_congr' key.symm _ _).trans e2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.chartRho_unit
statement:
theorem chartRho_unit (u : Aˣ) (s' : Fin (r + 1) → A) (hs' : ∀ j, s' j = (u : A) * s j)
    (hI' : I = Ideal.span (Set.range s')) :
    chartRho I s' hI' = chartRho I s hI
proof:
:=
  projMap_genGraded_unit I s hI u s' hs' hI'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CIIB1.chartPsi_unit
statement:
theorem chartPsi_unit (u : Aˣ) (s' : Fin (r + 1) → A) (hs' : ∀ j, s' j = (u : A) * s j)
    (hI' : I = Ideal.span (Set.range s')) (κ : k →+* A) :
    chartPsi I s' hI' κ = chartPsi I s hI κ
proof:
:= by
  unfold chartPsi
  rw [chartRho_unit I s hI u s' hs' hI']

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E29.baseIso_unit
statement:
theorem baseIso_unit {S T Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : S ⟶ T) (p : T ⟶ Z) (a : S ⟶ Z)
    (comm : j ≫ p = a) (M : Z.Modules) (O : Z.Opens) (s : Γ(M, O)) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p).obj M)).presheaf.map
      (eqToHom (by subst comm; rfl : j ⁻¹ᵁ (p ⁻¹ᵁ O) = a ⁻¹ᵁ O)).op
      ((((pullbackCongr comm).symm ≪≫ (pullbackComp j p).symm).app M).hom.app (a ⁻¹ᵁ O)
        (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction a).unit.app M).app O s)) =
    ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j).unit.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p).obj M)).app
        (p ⁻¹ᵁ O) (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p).unit.app M).app O s)
proof:
:= by
  subst comm
  have h := Chow.C1Cap.pullbackComp_inv_unit j p M O s
  refine Eq.trans ?_ h
  simp [pullbackCongr]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E29.uMap_app_unit
statement:
theorem uMap_app_unit {X : Scheme.{u}} {B D : X.Modules} (CB : AffineFrameCover X B)
    (CD : AffineFrameCover X D) (j : CD.scheme ⟶ CB.scheme) (comm : j ≫ CB.toBase = CD.toBase)
    (U : X.Opens) (e : B.val.obj (op U)) (V : CD.scheme.Opens) (hV : V ≤ CD.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ U)
    (hV' : V ≤ j ⁻¹ᵁ (CB.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ U)) :
    (E18.uMap CB CD j comm).app V
        (PullbackFrameSections.sectionMap CD.toBase B U V hV e) =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj (CB.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE hV').op
        (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j).unit.app (CB.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)).app
          (CB.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ U) ((CB.tautologicalPushforwardHom.val.app (op U)).hom e))
proof:
:= by
  have hd : j ⁻¹ᵁ (CB.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ U) = CD.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ U := by rw [← comm]; rfl
  change (E18.uMap CB CD j comm).app V
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullback CD.toBase).obj B).presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op
      (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction CD.toBase).unit.app B).app U e)) = _
  rw [tautChart_app_map]
  have key : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj (CB.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)).presheaf.map
      (eqToHom hd).op ((E18.uMap CB CD j comm).app (CD.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ U)
        (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction CD.toBase).unit.app B).app U e)) =
      ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j).unit.app (CB.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)).app
          (CB.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ U) ((CB.tautologicalPushforwardHom.val.app (op U)).hom e) := by
    unfold E18.uMap
    simp only [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
    rw [← tautChart_app_map ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).map CB.tautologicalQuotient)]
    have bu := baseIso_unit j CB.toBase CD.toBase comm B U e
    erw [bu]
    rw [C1Cap.pullback_map_unit]
    exact congrArg _ (E24.taut_app_eq_quotient_unit CB U e).symm
  rw [← key, ← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E29.taut_rel
statement:
theorem taut_rel (i : C.I) (d x : E.val.obj (op (C.U i)))
    (hle : C.chartι i ''ᵁ linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) x ≤
      C.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ C.U i) :
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op
      ((C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.val.app (op (C.U i))).hom d) =
    ((C.chartι i).appIso (linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) x)).inv
        (tautChart_ratioSection Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) x d) •
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op
        ((C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.val.app (op (C.U i))).hom x)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  set W := linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) x with hW
  let φ := C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 1 i
  have hrec : ∀ y : E.val.obj (op (C.U i)),
      φ.hom.app W ((C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op
        ((C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.val.app (op (C.U i))).hom y)) =
      (C.chartTwistingSheaf 1 i).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op
        (E23.tautS Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i) y) := by
    intro y
    have h1 : (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op
        ((C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.val.app (op (C.U i))).hom y) =
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι i)).obj
          (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op
          ((C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map
            (homOfLE (AffineFrameCover.tautQuotient_chartι_image_top C i).le).op
            ((C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.val.app (op (C.U i))).hom y)) := by
      rw [Scheme.Modules.restrict_map]
      erw [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
      rfl
    rw [h1, tautChart_app_map φ.hom]
    exact congrArg _ (rankTwo_originalChart_tautRecovery C i y)
  have inj : ∀ y z : Γ(C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1, C.chartι i ''ᵁ W),
      φ.hom.app W y = φ.hom.app W z → y = z := by
    intro y z h
    have h' := congrArg (φ.inv.app W) h
    rwa [C1Cap.iso_inv_hom_app φ W y, C1Cap.iso_inv_hom_app φ W z] at h'
  refine inj _ _ ?_
  have hsm := Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul φ.hom
    (tautChart_ratioSection Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) x d)
    (show Γ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (C.chartι i)).obj (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1), W) from
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op
        ((C.tautologicalPushforwardHom.val.app (op (C.U i))).hom x))
  refine (hrec d).trans ?_
  refine (E23.tautS_rel Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) (C.sectionBasis i) x d).trans ?_
  refine Eq.trans ?_ hsm.symm
  exact congrArg _ (hrec x).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E29.litU_eq
statement:
theorem litU_eq (i : P.I) (l : P.toD.basisIndex i) :
    E24.litU P.toD ⟨i, l⟩ =
      P.toD.chartι i ''ᵁ E23.linOpenD P i (P.toD.sectionBasis i l)
proof:
:= by
  change ((P.toD.literalLinearOpen ⟨i, l⟩).ι ≫ P.toD.chartι i) ''ᵁ ⊤ = _
  rw [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange, Scheme.Hom.opensRange_comp,
    ← Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange, Scheme.Opens.ι_image_top]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E29.linOpenD_le_toBase
statement:
theorem linOpenD_le_toBase (i : P.I) (x : D.val.obj (op (P.U i))) :
    P.toD.chartι i ''ᵁ E23.linOpenD P i x ≤ P.toD.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ P.U i
proof:
:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E29.v_eq
statement:
theorem v_eq (i : P.I) (l : P.toD.basisIndex i) (e : B.val.obj (op (P.U i))) :
    (E18.vMap P.toD b).app (E24.litU P.toD ⟨i, l⟩)
        (PullbackFrameSections.sectionMap P.toD.toBase B (P.U i) (E24.litU P.toD ⟨i, l⟩)
          (E24.litU_le P.toD ⟨i, l⟩) e) =
      rho P i l e • E24.litG P.toD ⟨i, l⟩
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (P.toD.basisIndex i) := P.toD.basisIndex_finite i
  have h1 : (E18.vMap P.toD b).app (E24.litU P.toD ⟨i, l⟩)
        (PullbackFrameSections.sectionMap P.toD.toBase B (P.U i) (E24.litU P.toD ⟨i, l⟩)
          (E24.litU_le P.toD ⟨i, l⟩) e) =
      (P.toD.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map (homOfLE (E24.litU_le P.toD ⟨i, l⟩)).op
        ((P.toD.tautologicalPushforwardHom.val.app (op (P.toD.U i))).hom
          (SchemeProjectiveBundle.E14.secMap b (P.U i) e)) := by
    change (((Scheme.Modules.pullback P.toD.toBase).map b) ≫ P.toD.tautologicalQuotient).app
        (E24.litU P.toD ⟨i, l⟩)
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullback P.toD.toBase).obj B).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (E24.litU_le P.toD ⟨i, l⟩)).op
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction P.toD.toBase).unit.app B).app
          (P.U i) e)) = _
    rw [tautChart_app_map, E24.vMap_app_unit]
    rfl
  have hA : ∀ z : Γ(P.toD.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1, P.toD.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ P.U i),
      (P.toD.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map (homOfLE (E24.litU_le P.toD ⟨i, l⟩)).op z =
      (P.toD.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map (homOfLE (litU_eq P i l).le).op
        ((P.toD.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (linOpenD_le_toBase P i (P.toD.sectionBasis i l))).op z) := by
    intro z
    rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply]
    rfl
  have ht := taut_rel P.toD i (SchemeProjectiveBundle.E14.secMap b (P.U i) e)
    (P.toD.sectionBasis i l) (linOpenD_le_toBase P i (P.toD.sectionBasis i l))
  rw [h1, hA]
  refine (congrArg ((P.toD.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map (homOfLE (litU_eq P i l).le).op)
    ht).trans ?_
  rw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul]
  refine congrArg₂ (· • ·) rfl ?_
  rw [E24.litG, ← AffineFrameCover.tautologicalPushforwardHom_app P.toD i l]
  rw [hA]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E29.u_eq
statement:
theorem u_eq (i : P.I) (l : P.toD.basisIndex i) (m e : B.val.obj (op (P.U i)))
    (hm : SchemeProjectiveBundle.E14.secMap b (P.U i) m = P.toD.sectionBasis i l) :
    (E18.uMap P.toB P.toD P.jHom P.jHom_toBase).app (E24.litU P.toD ⟨i, l⟩)
        (PullbackFrameSections.sectionMap P.toD.toBase B (P.U i) (E24.litU P.toD ⟨i, l⟩)
          (E24.litU_le P.toD ⟨i, l⟩) e) =
      rho P i l e • (E18.uMap P.toB P.toD P.jHom P.jHom_toBase).app (E24.litU P.toD ⟨i, l⟩)
        (PullbackFrameSections.sectionMap P.toD.toBase B (P.U i) (E24.litU P.toD ⟨i, l⟩)
          (E24.litU_le P.toD ⟨i, l⟩) m)
proof:
:= by
  have hV' : E24.litU P.toD ⟨i, l⟩ ≤ P.jHom ⁻¹ᵁ (P.toB.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ P.U i) :=
    (litU_eq P i l).le.trans (E23.linOpenD_le P i (P.toD.sectionBasis i l))
  rw [uMap_app_unit P.toB P.toD P.jHom P.jHom_toBase (P.U i) e _ (E24.litU_le P.toD ⟨i, l⟩) hV',
    uMap_app_unit P.toB P.toD P.jHom P.jHom_toBase (P.U i) m _ (E24.litU_le P.toD ⟨i, l⟩) hV']
  have hur := E23.unit_rel P i m e (P.toD.sectionBasis i l) hm
  have h2 := congrArg
    (((Scheme.Modules.pullback P.jHom).obj (P.toB.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (litU_eq P i l).le).op) hur
  rw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul, ← Functor.map_comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp_apply] at h2
  exact h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E29.pluckerHu_of_unit_rel
statement: theorem pluckerHu_of_unit_rel : E24.PluckerHu P
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨i, l⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := P.surj i (P.toD.sectionBasis i l)
  refine ⟨(E18.uMap P.toB P.toD P.jHom P.jHom_toBase).app (E24.litU P.toD ⟨i, l⟩)
    (PullbackFrameSections.sectionMap P.toD.toBase B (P.U i) (E24.litU P.toD ⟨i, l⟩)
      (E24.litU_le P.toD ⟨i, l⟩) m), ?_⟩
  intro k f hf
  have hv := v_eq P i l (P.toB.sectionBasis i k)
  have hfg : f • E24.litG P.toD ⟨i, l⟩ = rho P i l (P.toB.sectionBasis i k) •
      E24.litG P.toD ⟨i, l⟩ := hf.symm.trans hv
  have hfree : f = rho P i l (P.toB.sectionBasis i k) := by
    have h0 : (f - rho P i l (P.toB.sectionBasis i k)) •
        (P.toD.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (le_refl (E24.litU P.toD ⟨i, l⟩))).op (E24.litG P.toD ⟨i, l⟩) = 0 := by
      have hid : (homOfLE (le_refl (E24.litU P.toD ⟨i, l⟩))).op =
          𝟙 (op (E24.litU P.toD ⟨i, l⟩)) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      rw [hid, Functor.map_id_apply, sub_smul, hfg, sub_self]
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 (E24.litG_free P.toD ⟨i, l⟩ _ le_rfl _ h0)
  rw [hfree]
  exact u_eq P i l m (P.toB.sectionBasis i k) hm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E29.twistIso_of_E24
statement:
theorem twistIso_of_E24 :
    Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback P.jHom).obj (P.toB.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1) ≅
      P.toD.canonicalTwistingSheaf 1)
proof:
:=

name: RiemannRoch.KNFA.AdaptedChart.ker_awayMap
statement:
theorem AdaptedChart.ker_awayMap (ch : AdaptedChart C i) :
    RingHom.ker (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map
      (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap (S := Γ(X, C.U i)) ch.φ)
      (linearForm Γ(X, C.U i) ((N ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U i)))
        (ch.basis (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)))) =
    Ideal.span (Set.range fun j : ch.κ =>
      tautChart_ratio Γ(X, C.U i) ((N ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U i)))
        (ch.basis (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) (ch.basis (Sum.inl j)))
proof:
:=
  ker_awayMap_adapted ch.basis ch.φ ch.basis_inl ch.basis_inr

name: RiemannRoch.KNFA.AdaptedChart.chart_kernel_ideal
statement:
theorem AdaptedChart.chart_kernel_ideal (ch : AdaptedChart C i) :
    (symmetricProjMap (S := Γ(X, C.U i)) ch.φ
        (SchemeProjectiveBundle.E14.span_range_of_surjective
          (surjective_of_adapted ch.basis ch.φ ch.basis_inr))).ker.ideal
      ⟨linearOpen Γ(X, C.U i) ((N ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U i)))
          (ch.basis (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)),
        Proj.isAffineOpen_basicOpen _ _ (linearForm_mem_degree_one _ _ _) Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun j : ch.κ =>
        tautChart_ratioSection Γ(X, C.U i) ((N ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U i)))
          (ch.basis (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) (ch.basis (Sum.inl j)))

name: RiemannRoch.KNFA.AdaptedChart.chartAlgebra
statement:
theorem AdaptedChart.chartAlgebra (ch : AdaptedChart C i) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (e : Fin n ≃ ch.κ),
      RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular
        (LinearChartRing Γ(X, C.U i) ((N ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U i)))
          (ch.basis (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)))
        (List.ofFn fun k : Fin n =>
          tautChart_ratio Γ(X, C.U i) ((N ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U i)))
            (ch.basis (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) (ch.basis (Sum.inl (e k)))) ∧
      Function.Bijective (ratioHom Γ(X, C.U i)
        ((N ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U i))) ch.basis) ∧
      RingHom.ker (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map
        (gradedSymmetricAlgebraMap (S := Γ(X, C.U i)) ch.φ)
        (linearForm Γ(X, C.U i) ((N ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U i)))
          (ch.basis (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)))) =
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun j : ch.κ =>
        tautChart_ratio Γ(X, C.U i) ((N ⊞ tensorUnitSheaf X).val.obj (op (C.U i)))
          (ch.basis (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)) (ch.basis (Sum.inl j)))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := ch.finite
  obtain ⟨n, ⟨e⟩⟩ := Finite.exists_equiv_fin ch.κ
  refine ⟨_, e.symm, ?_, ⟨ratioHom_injective _ _ ch.basis, ratioHom_surjective _ _ ch.basis⟩,
    ch.ker_awayMap⟩
  exact isWeaklyRegular_ratios _ _ ch.basis e.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.D31.exists_epi_free_twist
statement:
theorem exists_epi_free_twist {k : Type u} [CommRing k] [IsNoetherianRing k]
    (N : ℕ) {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (j : X ⟶ space k N) [IsClosedImmersion j] (E : X.Modules) [E.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hE : IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) :
    ∃ (D : ℕ) (I : Type u) (_ : Fintype I)
      (φ : FreeM X I ⟶
        tensorSheaf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj (projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (D : ℤ))) E),
      Epi φ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj E).IsFinitePresentation :=
    isFinitePresentation_pushforward_of_isFinite j E
  obtain ⟨D, G, hG⟩ := serre_generation k N ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj E)
  letI := hG
  let V := projectiveTwistingSheaf k N (D : ℤ)
  let L' : X.Modules := tensorSheaf X ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj V) E
  let e : tensorSheaf (space k N) V ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj E) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj L' :=
    projectionFormulaIso j V (projectiveTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree k N _) E
  haveI : Finite G.I := hG.finite
  letI : Fintype G.I := Fintype.ofFinite G.I
  let e1 : FreeM (space k N) G.I ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj L' := G.π ≫ e.hom
  haveI : Epi e1 := epi_comp' G.epi inferInstance
  haveI hP : Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).map e1) := inferInstance
  haveI hC := ClosedImmersionCoverF11.counit_epi j L'
  let φ : FreeM X G.I ⟶ L' :=
    (pullbackFreeIso j G.I).inv ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback j).map e1 ≫ ClosedImmersionCoverF11.counitHom j L'
  haveI : Epi (φ) := epi_comp' (inferInstance : Epi (pullbackFreeIso j G.I).inv) (epi_comp' hP hC)
  exact ⟨D, G.I, inferInstance, φ, inferInstance⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.twistZero_unitMul_one

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.twistZero_transition_zero
statement:
theorem twistZero_transition_zero (e : ℤ) (he : e = 0) (x y : M) :
    pushedLinearOverlapTransition R M e x y = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  subst he
  have h1 : linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit R M 0 x y = 1 := by
    simp [linearTwistTransitionSectionUnit]
    rfl
  unfold pushedLinearOverlapTransition linearOverlapTransitionIso
  rw [h1, map_one, twistZero_unitMul_one]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.twistZero_u_restriction
statement:
theorem twistZero_u_restriction {Y : Scheme.{u}} {U V : Y.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) :
    twistZero_u U ≫ SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction h = twistZero_u V
proof:
:= by
  ext W x
  have e1 : (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (twistZero_u U) W) x = U.ι.app W x := rfl
  have e2 : (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (twistZero_u V) W) x = V.ι.app W x := rfl
  have e3 : ∀ s : Γ(Y, U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W)),
      (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction h) W) s =
        Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestrictionOpen h W)).op s :=
    fun s => rfl
  change (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction h) W)
    ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (twistZero_u U) W) x) = _
  rw [e1, e2, e3]
  simp only [Scheme.Opens.ι_app]
  exact (Functor.map_comp_apply Y.presheaf _ _ x).symm

  rintro ⟨i, j⟩
  simp only [Category.assoc, linearDescentLeft_π, linearDescentRight_π,
    twistZero_delta_π_assoc, twistZero_transition_zero (R := R) (M := M) 0 rfl, Category.comp_id,

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.twistZero_zeta_component

@[reassoc]
