name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.twistZero_zeta_isIso
statement: theorem twistZero_zeta_isIso : IsIso (twistZero_zeta b)
proof:
:= by
  apply SchemeKTheory.moduleHom_isIso_of_over_cover (twistZero_zeta b)
    (fun i : ι ↦ linearOpen R M (b i)) (intrinsicLinearOpen_coversTop b)
  intro i
  letI : IsIso ((twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b 0 i).over (linearOpen R M (b i))) :=
    twistingSheafBasisComponent_over_isIso_of_le R M b 0 i le_rfl
  have hc : (twistZero_zeta b).over (linearOpen R M (b i)) ≫
      (twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b 0 i).over (linearOpen R M (b i)) =
      (pushedUnitOpenOverIso (space R M) (linearOpen R M (b i))).inv := by
    rw [AffineFrameCover.pushedUnitOpenOverIso_inv_eq_unitToPushforward]
    exact congrArg (fun f ↦ SheafOfModules.Hom.over f (linearOpen R M (b i)))
      (twistZero_zeta_component b i)
  letI : IsIso ((twistZero_zeta b).over (linearOpen R M (b i)) ≫
      (twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b 0 i).over (linearOpen R M (b i))) := by
    rw [hc]; infer_instance
  exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right _
    ((twistingSheafBasisComponent R M b 0 i).over (linearOpen R M (b i)))

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.twistZero_u_frameChange
statement:
theorem twistZero_u_frameChange (e : ℤ) (he : e = 0) (x y : M) (V : (space R M).Opens)
    (hVx : V ≤ linearOpen R M x) (hVy : V ≤ linearOpen R M y) :
    (twistZero_u (linearOpen R M x)).over V ≫ (linearFrameChangeOverIso R M e x y V hVx hVy).hom =
      (twistZero_u (linearOpen R M y)).over V
proof:
:= by
  subst he
  have hOx : linearOverlapOpen R M x y ≤ linearOpen R M x :=
    (linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M x y).le.trans inf_le_left
  have hOy : linearOverlapOpen R M x y ≤ linearOpen R M y :=
    (linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M x y).le.trans inf_le_right
  have hx := twistZero_u_restriction hOx
  have hy := twistZero_u_restriction hOy
  simp only [linearFrameChangeOverIso, Iso.trans_hom, asIso_hom, Iso.symm_hom, asIso_inv]
  rw [twistZero_transition_zero (R := R) (M := M) 0 rfl]
  have hcomp : (twistZero_u (linearOpen R M x)).over V ≫
      (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction hOx).over V =
      (twistZero_u (linearOpen R M y)).over V ≫
        (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnitRestriction hOy).over V :=
    congrArg (fun f ↦ SheafOfModules.Hom.over f V) (hx.trans hy.symm)
  have hid : SheafOfModules.Hom.over
      (𝟙 (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space R M) (linearOverlapOpen R M x y))) V =
      𝟙 _ := rfl
  rw [hid, Category.id_comp, reassoc_of% hcomp, IsIso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.twistZero_zeta_basisChange
statement:
theorem twistZero_zeta_basisChange {ι κ : Type u} [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    (b : Module.Basis ι R M) (c : Module.Basis κ R M) :
    twistZero_zeta b ≫ (twistingSheafBasisChangeIso R M b c 0).hom = twistZero_zeta c
proof:
:= by
  apply AffineFrameCover.modulesHom_ext_of_over_coversTop
    (fun ij : ι × κ ↦ basisChangeOpen R M b c ij.1 ij.2) (basisChangeOpen_coversTop R M b c)
  rintro ⟨i, j⟩
  dsimp only
  have hVbi : basisChangeOpen R M b c i j ≤ linearOpen R M (b i) :=
    (linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (c j)).le.trans inf_le_left
  have hVcj : basisChangeOpen R M b c i j ≤ linearOpen R M (c j) :=
    (linearOverlapOpen_eq_inf R M (b i) (c j)).le.trans inf_le_right
  have hB : ((twistingSheafBasisChangeIso R M b c 0).hom).over (basisChangeOpen R M b c i j) =
      (twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso R M b 0 i hVbi).hom ≫
        (linearFrameChangeOverIso R M (-0) (b i) (c j) _ hVbi hVcj).hom ≫
        (twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso R M c 0 j hVcj).inv := by
    have h1 := twistingSheafBasisChangeHom_over R M b c 0 i j
    have h2 := twistingSheafBasisChangeLocalOverIso_restrict_hom R M b c 0 i j (le_refl _)
    rw [← h1] at h2
    exact h2
  have hzb : (twistZero_zeta b).over (basisChangeOpen R M b c i j) ≫
      (twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso R M b 0 i hVbi).hom =
      (twistZero_u (linearOpen R M (b i))).over (basisChangeOpen R M b c i j) :=
    congrArg (fun f ↦ SheafOfModules.Hom.over f (basisChangeOpen R M b c i j))
      (twistZero_zeta_component b i)
  have hzc : (twistZero_zeta c).over (basisChangeOpen R M b c i j) ≫
      (twistingSheafBasisComponentOverIso R M c 0 j hVcj).hom =
      (twistZero_u (linearOpen R M (c j))).over (basisChangeOpen R M b c i j) :=
    congrArg (fun f ↦ SheafOfModules.Hom.over f (basisChangeOpen R M b c i j))
      (twistZero_zeta_component c j)
  change (twistZero_zeta b).over _ ≫ ((twistingSheafBasisChangeIso R M b c 0).hom).over _ =
    (twistZero_zeta c).over _
  rw [hB, reassoc_of% hzb, reassoc_of% (twistZero_u_frameChange (-0) neg_zero (b i) (c j) _ hVbi hVcj),
    ← hzc, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.twistZero_zeta_restrict
statement:
theorem twistZero_zeta_restrict {R S M N ι : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N] [Module.Free S N] [Module.Finite S N] [Finite ι]
    {b : Module.Basis ι R M} {c : Module.Basis ι S N}
    {q : space S N ⟶ space R M} [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (D : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c 0 q)
    (hOpen : ∀ i, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b i) = linearOpen S N (c i))
    (hD : D.chartIso.hom = (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q hOpen).hom) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map (twistZero_zeta b) ≫ D.restrictIso.hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).hom ≫ twistZero_zeta c
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (kernel.ι (linearDescentLeft S N c - linearDescentRight S N c 0))).1
  have hK : D.restrictIso.hom ≫ kernel.ι (linearDescentLeft S N c - linearDescentRight S N c 0) =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map
        (kernel.ι (linearDescentLeft R M b - linearDescentRight R M b 0)) ≫ D.chartIso.hom :=
    AffineFrameCover.restrictKernelComparisonIso_hom_ι q _ _ D.chartIso D.overlapIso D.naturality
  refine (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans ?_
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
  refine (congrArg (fun t ↦ (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map (twistZero_zeta b) ≫ t) hK).trans ?_
  refine ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor q).map_comp_assoc _ _ _).symm.trans ?_
  refine Eq.trans ?_
    (congrArg (fun t ↦ (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).hom ≫ t) (twistZero_zeta_ι c)).symm
  rw [twistZero_zeta_ι, hD]
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro k
  have e1 := pushedUnitPiRestrictOpenImmersionIso_hom_π q (fun i ↦ linearOpen R M (b i)) k
  have e2 := AffineFrameCover.restrictUnitToPushforwardOpenImmersion_naturality q
    (linearOpen R M (b k))
  simp only [linearChartCochainsRestrictIso, pushedUnitPiCastIso, Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc,
    Pi.mapIso_hom_π]
  rw [reassoc_of% e1, ← Functor.map_comp_assoc, twistZero_delta_π]
  refine ((reassoc_of% e2) (eqToHom (congrArg (SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedUnit (space S N))
    (hOpen k)))).trans ?_
  refine (congrArg (fun t ↦ (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).hom ≫ t)
    (twistZero_u_cast (hOpen k))).trans ?_
  exact ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg _ (twistZero_delta_π c k))).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistZero_unitPrefix
statement:
private theorem twistZero_unitPrefix {Y Z W : Scheme.{u}} (s : W ⟶ Y) (q : Z ⟶ Y) (r : W ⟶ Z)
    [IsOpenImmersion s] [IsOpenImmersion q] [IsOpenImmersion r] (h : r ≫ q = s) :
    (restrictCompPrefixIso' s q r h (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)).hom ≫
        𝐑[r].map (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso r).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso s).hom
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  unfold restrictCompPrefixIso'
  rw [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.app_hom, Iso.app_hom, restrictFunctorCongr_refl_hom_app, Category.id_comp]
  exact restrictUnitIso_comp_hom q r

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistZero_oneSideZero
statement:
private theorem twistZero_oneSideZero
    (D : TwistingSheafRestrictionData b c 0 q)
    (hOpen : ∀ i, q ⁻¹ᵁ linearOpen R M (b i) = linearOpen S N (c i))
    (hD : D.chartIso.hom = (linearChartCochainsRestrictIso b c q hOpen).hom)
    {O : Xg.Modules} (ρ : 𝐑[ιg].obj O ≅ twistingSheafOfBasisIndex R M b 0) :
    tensorOverlap_tr p ιg g hg (ρ ≪≫ (twistZero_zetaIso b).symm ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso ιg).symm).hom =
      (tensorOverlap_leg ιg p g κ hg hκ ρ D).hom ≫ 𝐑[κ].map (twistZero_zetaIso c).inv ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso κ).hom ≫ (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso p).inv
proof:
:= by
  have hB : 𝐑[q].map (twistZero_zetaIso b).hom ≫ D.restrictIso.hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).hom ≫ (twistZero_zetaIso c).hom :=
    twistZero_zeta_restrict D hOpen hD
  have hB' : D.restrictIso.hom ≫ (twistZero_zetaIso c).inv =
      𝐑[q].map (twistZero_zetaIso b).inv ≫ (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).hom := by
    rw [← cancel_epi (𝐑[q].map (twistZero_zetaIso b).hom), reassoc_of% hB]
    simp
  have U1 := twistZero_unitPrefix g q κ hκ
  have U2 := twistZero_unitPrefix p ιg g hg
  have Pn := tensorOverlap_pre_nat g q κ hκ (twistZero_zetaIso b).inv
  have U2' : 𝐑[g].map (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso ιg).inv ≫
      (restrictCompPrefixIso' p ιg g hg (SheafOfModules.unit Xg.ringCatSheaf)).inv =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso g).hom ≫ (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso p).inv := by
    rw [Iso.eq_comp_inv, ← U2]
    simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
    rw [← Functor.map_comp_assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp]
  have hκB : 𝐑[κ].map D.restrictIso.hom ≫ 𝐑[κ].map (twistZero_zetaIso c).inv =
      𝐑[κ].map (𝐑[q].map (twistZero_zetaIso b).inv) ≫
        𝐑[κ].map (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso q).hom := by
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, hB', Functor.map_comp]
  unfold tensorOverlap_tr tensorOverlap_leg
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  rw [U2', reassoc_of% hκB, ← reassoc_of% Pn, reassoc_of% U1]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistZero_localS
statement:
private theorem twistZero_localS (i j : C.I) (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    tensorOverlap_tr (C.tensorOverlap_p i j c) (C.tensorOverlap_ιs i) (C.tensorOverlap_gL i j c)
        (C.tensorOverlap_hL i j c) (C.twistZero_chartIso i).hom =
      tensorOverlap_tr (C.tensorOverlap_p i j c) (C.tensorOverlap_ιs j) (C.tensorOverlap_gR i j c)
        (C.tensorOverlap_hR i j c) (C.twistZero_chartIso j).hom
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) := C.sectionModule_free i
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C.U i) (E.val.obj (op (C.U i))) := C.sectionModule_finite i
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  letI : Module.Free Γ(X, C.U j) (E.val.obj (op (C.U j))) := C.sectionModule_free j
  letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, C.U j) (E.val.obj (op (C.U j))) := C.sectionModule_finite j
  letI : Finite (C.basisIndex j) := C.basisIndex_finite j
  have OSi := twistZero_oneSideZero (C.tensorOverlap_ιs i) (C.tensorOverlap_p i j c)
    (C.tensorOverlap_gL i j c) (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom (C.tensorOverlap_hL i j c)
    (C.tensorOverlap_hκL i j c) (c.leftTwistRestrictionData 0) c.chartToLeft_preimage_linearOpen rfl
    (C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 0 i)
  have OSj := twistZero_oneSideZero (C.tensorOverlap_ιs j) (C.tensorOverlap_p i j c)
    (C.tensorOverlap_gR i j c) (C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom (C.tensorOverlap_hR i j c)
    (C.tensorOverlap_hκR i j c) (c.rightTwistRestrictionData 0) c.chartToRight_preimage_linearOpen
    rfl (C.canonicalTwistingSheafRestrictionIso 0 j)
  have DI := C.tensorOverlap_descent 0 i j c
  have BC : (twistZero_zetaIso c.leftSectionBasis).hom ≫ (c.twistingSheafBasisIso 0).hom =
      (twistZero_zetaIso c.rightSectionBasis).hom :=
    twistZero_zeta_basisChange c.leftSectionBasis c.rightSectionBasis
  have BC' : (c.twistingSheafBasisIso 0).hom ≫ (twistZero_zetaIso c.rightSectionBasis).inv =
      (twistZero_zetaIso c.leftSectionBasis).inv := by
    rw [← cancel_epi (twistZero_zetaIso c.leftSectionBasis).hom, Iso.hom_inv_id,
      reassoc_of% BC, Iso.hom_inv_id]
  have BCκ : 𝐑[(C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom].map (c.twistingSheafBasisIso 0).hom ≫
      𝐑[(C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom].map
        (twistZero_zetaIso c.rightSectionBasis).inv =
      𝐑[(C.commonBasicOpenChartIsoOver i j c).hom].map
        (twistZero_zetaIso c.leftSectionBasis).inv := by
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, BC']
  refine OSi.trans ?_
  refine Eq.trans ?_ OSj.symm
  rw [← DI, Category.assoc, reassoc_of% BCκ]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistZero_local
statement:
private theorem twistZero_local (i j : C.I)
    (c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j) :
    tensorOverlap_tr ((C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι ≫ C.overlapToChart i j ≫ C.chartι i)
        (C.chartι i) ((C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι ≫ C.overlapToChart i j)
        (by simp only [Category.assoc])
        (C.twistZero_chartIso i).hom =
      tensorOverlap_tr ((C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι ≫ C.overlapToChart i j ≫ C.chartι i)
        (C.chartι j) ((C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι ≫ C.transition i j ≫
          C.overlapToChart j i)
        (by simp only [Category.assoc]; rw [C.overlapToChart_chartι_eq i j])
        (C.twistZero_chartIso j).hom
proof:
:=
  C.twistZero_localS i j c

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistZero_indep
statement:
private theorem twistZero_indep (i j : C.I)
    {W : Scheme.{u}} (s : W ⟶ C.scheme) [IsOpenImmersion s]
    (gi : W ⟶ C.chart i) (gj : W ⟶ C.chart j) [IsOpenImmersion gi] [IsOpenImmersion gj]
    (hi : gi ≫ C.chartι i = s) (hj : gj ≫ C.chartι j = s) :
    tensorOverlap_tr s (C.chartι i) gi hi (C.twistZero_chartIso i).hom =
      tensorOverlap_tr s (C.chartι j) gj hj (C.twistZero_chartIso j).hom
proof:
:= by
  let p : ∀ c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j, (C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).toScheme ⟶ C.scheme :=
    fun c ↦ (C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι ≫ C.overlapToChart i j ≫ C.chartι i
  have hcov : (Opens.grothendieckTopology W).CoversTop
      (fun c : C.CommonBasicOpen i j ↦ s ⁻¹ᵁ (p c).opensRange) := by
    refine (Opens.coversTop_iff (T := W) _).2 ?_
    rw [TopologicalSpace.IsOpenCover, eq_top_iff]
    intro x _
    rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup]
    have hij : C.glueData.ι i (gi x) = C.glueData.ι j (gj x) := by
      change (C.chartι i) (gi x) = (C.chartι j) (gj x)
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hi, hj]
    obtain ⟨z, hz1, hz2⟩ := (C.glueData.ι_eq_iff i j (gi x) (gj x)).1 hij
    have hcovO := (C.basicOpenOverlapCover i j).isOpenCover_opensRange
    rw [TopologicalSpace.IsOpenCover, eq_top_iff] at hcovO
    have hz := hcovO (Set.mem_univ z)
    rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup] at hz
    obtain ⟨c, w, hw⟩ := hz
    refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
    change s x ∈ Set.range (p c)
    refine ⟨⟨z, ⟨w, hw⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only [p, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    change (C.chartι i) (C.glueData.f i j z) = s x
    rw [hz1, ← hi, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  apply modulesHom_ext_of_restrict_coversTop _ hcov
  intro c
  let U := s ⁻¹ᵁ (p c).opensRange
  have hrange : Set.range (U.ι ≫ s).base ⊆ Set.range (p c).base := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    have hx := x.2
    rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact hx
  let k := IsOpenImmersion.lift (p c) (U.ι ≫ s) hrange
  have hk : k ≫ p c = U.ι ≫ s := IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _
  haveI : IsOpenImmersion k := by
    have : IsOpenImmersion (k ≫ p c) := by rw [hk]; infer_instance
    exact IsOpenImmersion.of_comp k (p c)
  have hki : k ≫ ((C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι ≫ C.overlapToChart i j) = U.ι ≫ gi := by
    rw [← cancel_mono (C.chartι i)]
    simp only [Category.assoc, hi]
    exact hk
  have hkj : k ≫ ((C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι ≫ C.transition i j ≫
      C.overlapToChart j i) = U.ι ≫ gj := by
    rw [← cancel_mono (C.chartι j)]
    simp only [Category.assoc, hj, ← C.overlapToChart_chartι_eq i j]
    exact hk
  have hL := C.twistZero_local i j c
  have hRi := tensorOverlap_tr_restrict (p c) (C.chartι i)
    ((C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι ≫ C.overlapToChart i j) k
    (by simp only [Category.assoc, p]) (C.twistZero_chartIso i).hom
  have hRj := tensorOverlap_tr_restrict (p c) (C.chartι j)
    ((C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι ≫ C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i) k
    (by simp only [Category.assoc, p]; rw [C.overlapToChart_chartι_eq i j])
    (C.twistZero_chartIso j).hom
  have hCi := tensorOverlap_tr_congr (C.chartι i) hk hki
    (by simp only [Category.assoc]; rfl) (by rw [Category.assoc, hi])
    (C.twistZero_chartIso i).hom
  have hCj := tensorOverlap_tr_congr (C.chartι j) hk hkj
    (by simp only [Category.assoc]; rw [← C.overlapToChart_chartι_eq i j])
    (by rw [Category.assoc, hj])
    (C.twistZero_chartIso j).hom
  have hkey : tensorOverlap_tr (k ≫ p c) (C.chartι i)
      (k ≫ (C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι ≫ C.overlapToChart i j)
      (by simp only [Category.assoc]; rfl)
      (C.twistZero_chartIso i).hom =
    tensorOverlap_tr (k ≫ p c) (C.chartι j)
      (k ≫ (C.twistComparisonOpen i j c).ι ≫ C.transition i j ≫ C.overlapToChart j i)
      (by simp only [Category.assoc]; rw [← C.overlapToChart_chartι_eq i j])
      (C.twistZero_chartIso j).hom := by
    have h1 := hRi
    rw [hL, hRj] at h1
    simp only [Iso.cancel_iso_inv_left, Iso.cancel_iso_hom_right] at h1
    exact h1.symm
  rw [tensorOverlap_tr_restrict, tensorOverlap_tr_restrict, hCi, hCj, hkey]

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistZero_restrictionIndependence
statement:
private theorem twistZero_restrictionIndependence (i j : C.I) {V : C.scheme.Opens}
    (hVi : V ≤ (C.chartι i).opensRange) (hVj : V ≤ (C.chartι j).opensRange) :
    Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE C.scheme hVi
        (tensorOverlap_OI (C.chartι i) (C.twistZero_chartIso i)).hom =
      Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE C.scheme hVj
        (tensorOverlap_OI (C.chartι j) (C.twistZero_chartIso j)).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorOverlap_OI_eq, tensorOverlap_OI_eq,
    tensorOverlap_restrict_overIso, tensorOverlap_restrict_overIso]
  congr 2
  apply Iso.ext
  rw [tensorOverlap_openRange_tr, tensorOverlap_openRange_tr]
  exact C.twistZero_indep i j V.ι _ _ _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistZero_compatible
statement:
private theorem twistZero_compatible :
    Presheaf.FamilyOfElementsOnObjects.IsCompatible
      (fun i : C.I ↦
        Scheme.Modules.localHomSection C.scheme (C.chartι i).opensRange
          (tensorOverlap_OI (C.chartι i) (C.twistZero_chartIso i)).hom)
proof:
:= by
  intro V i j f g
  have hVi : V ≤ (C.chartι i).opensRange := f.le
  have hVj : V ≤ (C.chartι j).opensRange := g.le
  rw [show f = homOfLE hVi from Subsingleton.elim _ _,
    show g = homOfLE hVj from Subsingleton.elim _ _,
    Scheme.Modules.sheafHom_map_localHomSection,
    Scheme.Modules.sheafHom_map_localHomSection]
  exact congrArg
    (SheafOfModules.toSheaf (C.scheme.ringCatSheaf.over V)).map
    (C.twistZero_restrictionIndependence i j hVi hVj)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.twistZero_glueHom_isIso
statement: theorem twistZero_glueHom_isIso : IsIso C.twistZero_glueHom
proof:
:=
  Scheme.Modules.glueHom_isIso C.scheme
    (fun i : C.I ↦ (C.chartι i).opensRange)
    C.chartOpens_coversTop
    (fun i : C.I ↦ (tensorOverlap_OI (C.chartι i) (C.twistZero_chartIso i)).hom)
    C.twistZero_compatible (fun _ ↦ inferInstance)

name: SchemeProjectiveBundle.AffineFrameCover.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_zero
statement:
theorem canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class_zero :
    C.canonicalTwistingSheafK0Class 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  change SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf C.scheme (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf 0)
      (C.canonicalTwistingSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree 0) = 1
  calc
    _ = SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf C.scheme (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf C.scheme)
          (SchemeKTheory.tensorUnitSheaf_isFiniteLocallyFree C.scheme) :=
      SchemeKTheory.k0ClassOf_iso C.scheme _ _ C.canonicalTwistingSheafZeroIso
    _ = 1 := rfl

name: SchemeReesAlgebra.RelativeProj.affineRestrictionMap_heq
statement:
theorem affineRestrictionMap_heq
    {E E' C C' : X.affineOpens} (hE : E = E') (hC : C = C')
    (h : E.1 ≤ C.1) (h' : E'.1 ≤ C'.1) :
    HEq (affineRestrictionMap I h) (affineRestrictionMap I h')
proof:
:= by
  subst E'
  subst C'
  rfl

    (affineRestrictionMap I e.affineOpen_le_right)
    (affineRestrictionMap I (X.affineBasicOpen_le e.right))

      e.affineOpen_le_right (X.affineBasicOpen_le e.right))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechSectionRes_exact
statement:
theorem coordinateCechSectionRes_exact
    (M : (space k n).Modules) :
    Function.Exact
      (coordinateCechSectionRes k n M)
      (coordinateCechSectionRightRes k n M -
        coordinateCechSectionLeftRes k n M)
proof:
:= by
  let F := M.presheaf
  let U : Fin (n + 1) → TopologicalSpace.Opens (space k n) :=
    coordinateCechCover k n
  let charts := fun i : Fin (n + 1) ↦ F.obj (op (U i))
  let overlaps := fun ij : Fin (n + 1) × Fin (n + 1) ↦
    F.obj (op (coordinateOverlapOpen k n ij.1 ij.2))
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    let sf : (i : Fin (n + 1)) → F.obj (op (U i)) :=
      fun i ↦ (Limits.Pi.π charts i).hom x
    have hsf : TopCat.Presheaf.IsCompatible F U sf := by
      intro i j
      have ht := congrArg
        (fun z ↦ (Limits.Pi.π overlaps (i, j)).hom z) hx
      rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, Preadditive.sub_comp,
        coordinateCechSectionRightRes_π,
        coordinateCechSectionLeftRes_π, map_zero] at ht
      change F.map
            (homOfLE
              ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_right)).op
            (sf j) -
          F.map
            (homOfLE
              ((coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j).le.trans inf_le_left)).op
            (sf i) = 0 at ht
      have ht' := sub_eq_zero.mp ht
      let e : coordinateOverlapOpen k n i j =
          coordinateOpen k n i ⊓ coordinateOpen k n j :=
        coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf k n i j
      let bL : op (coordinateOpen k n i) ⟶
          op (coordinateOverlapOpen k n i j) :=
        (homOfLE (e.le.trans inf_le_left)).op
      let bR : op (coordinateOpen k n j) ⟶
          op (coordinateOverlapOpen k n i j) :=
        (homOfLE (e.le.trans inf_le_right)).op
      let q : op (coordinateOverlapOpen k n i j) ⟶
          op (coordinateOpen k n i ⊓ coordinateOpen k n j) :=
        (eqToHom e.symm).op
      let cL : op (coordinateOpen k n i) ⟶
          op (coordinateOpen k n i ⊓ coordinateOpen k n j) :=
        (TopologicalSpace.Opens.infLELeft _ _).op
      let cR : op (coordinateOpen k n j) ⟶
          op (coordinateOpen k n i ⊓ coordinateOpen k n j) :=
        (TopologicalSpace.Opens.infLERight _ _).op
      have hL : F.map cL = F.map bL ≫ F.map q := by
        calc
          _ = F.map (bL ≫ q) :=
            congrArg (fun a ↦ F.map a) (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
          _ = _ := F.map_comp bL q
      have hR : F.map cR = F.map bR ≫ F.map q := by
        calc
          _ = F.map (bR ≫ q) :=
            congrArg (fun a ↦ F.map a) (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
          _ = _ := F.map_comp bR q
      change F.map cL (sf i) = F.map cR (sf j)
      calc
        F.map cL (sf i) = (F.map bL ≫ F.map q) (sf i) :=
          ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hL (sf i)
        _ = F.map q (F.map bL (sf i)) := rfl
        _ = F.map q (F.map bR (sf j)) :=
          congrArg (fun z ↦ F.map q z) ht'.symm
        _ = (F.map bR ≫ F.map q) (sf j) := rfl
        _ = F.map cR (sf j) :=
          ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hR.symm (sf j)
    let S : TopCat.Sheaf Ab (space k n) := ⟨F, Scheme.Modules.isSheaf M⟩
    obtain ⟨s, hs, -⟩ := S.existsUnique_gluing' U
      (⊤ : (space k n).Opens) (fun _ ↦ homOfLE le_top)
      (coordinateCechCover_isOpenCover k n).ge sf hsf
    refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
    apply (Limits.Concrete.productEquiv charts).injective
    funext i
    rw [Limits.Concrete.productEquiv_apply_apply,
      Limits.Concrete.productEquiv_apply_apply]
    have hi := hs i
    change F.map (homOfLE le_top).op s = sf i at hi
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, coordinateCechSectionRes_π]
    simpa only [sf] using hi
  · rintro ⟨s, rfl⟩
    have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (coordinateCechSectionFork k n M).condition s
    change
      (coordinateCechSectionRightRes k n M)
          (coordinateCechSectionRes k n M s) =
        (coordinateCechSectionLeftRes k n M)
          (coordinateCechSectionRes k n M s) at h
    change
      (coordinateCechSectionRightRes k n M)
          (coordinateCechSectionRes k n M s) -
        (coordinateCechSectionLeftRes k n M)
          (coordinateCechSectionRes k n M s) = 0
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechAugmentation_exact
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechAugmentation_exact (d : ℤ) :
    Function.Exact
      (projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechAugmentation k n d).hom
      ((projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex k n d).d 0 1).hom
proof:
:= by
  let M := projectiveTwistingSheaf k n d
  let e₀ := coordinateCechZeroTermIso k n M
  let e₁ := coordinateCechOneTermIso k n M
  let diff := coordinateCechSectionRightRes k n M -
    coordinateCechSectionLeftRes k n M
  have hcat : e₀.inv ≫ (projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex k n d).d 0 1 =
      diff ≫ e₁.inv := by
    apply (cancel_mono e₁.hom).1
    calc
      (e₀.inv ≫ (projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex k n d).d 0 1) ≫ e₁.hom =
          e₀.inv ≫
            ((projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex k n d).d 0 1 ≫ e₁.hom) :=
        Category.assoc _ _ _
      _ = e₀.inv ≫ (e₀.hom ≫ diff) :=
        congrArg (fun f ↦ e₀.inv ≫ f)
          (projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechComplex_d_zero_conjugates k n d)
      _ = diff := by simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
      _ = (diff ≫ e₁.inv) ≫ e₁.hom := by simp
  apply Function.Exact.of_ladder_addEquiv_of_exact
    (e₁ := AddEquiv.refl _)
    (e₂ := e₀.addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv.symm)
    (e₃ := e₁.addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv.symm)
    (f₁₂ := (coordinateCechSectionRes k n M).hom)
    (f₂₃ := diff.hom)
  · rfl
  · exact congrArg AddCommGrpCat.Hom.hom hcat
  · exact coordinateCechSectionRes_exact k n M

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingAugmentedCoordinateCechComplex_exactAt_one
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingAugmentedCoordinateCechComplex_exactAt_one (d : ℤ) :
    (projectiveTwistingAugmentedCoordinateCechComplex k n d).ExactAt 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff'
    (projectiveTwistingAugmentedCoordinateCechComplex k n d) 0 1 2
    (by simp) (by simp)]
  rw [ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff_function_exact]
  exact projectiveTwistingCoordinateCechAugmentation_exact k n d

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.projectiveTwistingAugmentedCoordinateCechComplex_exactAt_add_two
statement:
theorem projectiveTwistingAugmentedCoordinateCechComplex_exactAt_add_two
    (d : ℤ) (hcompat : ProjectiveTwistingCechLaurentNativeCofaceCompatible k n d)
    (hd : -(n : ℤ) ≤ d) (p : ℕ) :
    (projectiveTwistingAugmentedCoordinateCechComplex k n d).ExactAt (p + 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff'
    (projectiveTwistingAugmentedCoordinateCechComplex k n d)
    (p + 1) (p + 2) (p + 3) (by simp) (by simp)]
  rw [ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff]
  intro x hx
  change coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential k n d (p + 1) x = 0 at hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ :=
    coordinateCechTwistingNativeHigherDifferential_preimage_of_map_eq_zero
      k n d hcompat hd p x hx
  refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
  exact hy

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.overToPushed_app
statement:
theorem overToPushed_app {M : X.Modules} (ξ : M.over U ⟶ (LineBundleDual.unitMod X).over U)
    (W : X.Opens) (m : M.val.obj (op W)) :
    (overToPushed ξ).val.app (op W) m =
      ξ.val.app (op (pushedOver (U := U) W))
        (M.val.map (homOfLE (pushedOpen_le' (U := U) W)).op m)
proof: := rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.overToPushed_restriction
statement:
theorem overToPushed_restriction {V : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) {M : X.Modules}
    (ξ : M.over U ⟶ (LineBundleDual.unitMod X).over U) :
    overToPushed ξ ≫ pushedUnitRestriction h =
      overToPushed (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X h ξ)
proof:
:= by
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro W
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro m
  let g : (Over.map (homOfLE h)).obj (pushedOver (U := V) W.unop) ⟶ pushedOver (U := U) W.unop :=
    Over.homMk (homOfLE (pushedUnitRestrictionOpen h W.unop))
  have hn := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply ξ.val g.op
    (M.val.map (homOfLE (pushedOpen_le' (U := U) W.unop)).op m)
  change X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (pushedUnitRestrictionOpen h W.unop)).op
      (ξ.val.app (op (pushedOver (U := U) W.unop))
        (M.val.map (homOfLE (pushedOpen_le' (U := U) W.unop)).op m)) =
    ξ.val.app (op ((Over.map (homOfLE h)).obj (pushedOver (U := V) W.unop)))
      (M.val.map (homOfLE (pushedOpen_le' (U := V) W.unop)).op m)
  refine hn.symm.trans ?_
  congr 1
  change M.val.map (homOfLE (pushedUnitRestrictionOpen h W.unop)).op
    (M.val.map (homOfLE (pushedOpen_le' (U := U) W.unop)).op m) = _
  rw [← PresheafOfModules.map_comp_apply]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.overToPushed_pushedMul
statement:
theorem overToPushed_pushedMul {M : X.Modules}
    (ξ : M.over U ⟶ (LineBundleDual.unitMod X).over U) (c : Γ(X, U)) :
    overToPushed ξ ≫ Koszul.pushedMul U (U.topIso.inv.hom c) =
      overToPushed (ξ ≫ LineBundleDual.mulSectionHom X U c)
proof:
:= by
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro W
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro m
  let y : Γ(X, U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ W.unop)) := ξ.val.app (op (pushedOver (U := U) W.unop))
    (M.val.map (homOfLE (pushedOpen_le' (U := U) W.unop)).op m)
  change Scheme.Modules.Hom.app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.ι).map
      (Koszul.mulHom (U.topIso.inv.hom c))) W.unop y =
    X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (pushedOpen_le (U := U) W.unop)).op c * y
  rw [Scheme.Modules.pushforward_map_app]
  erw [Koszul.mulHom_app_apply]
  congr 1
  change X.presheaf.map _ (X.presheaf.map _ c) = _
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.overHom_app_leOver

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.overHom_ext_of_restricted_frame
statement:
theorem overHom_ext_of_restricted_frame {I : Type u} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (x : I → P.obj (op U)) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (hx : ∀ g : Γ(X, U), Function.Bijective (frameMap P x (X.basicOpen g) (X.basicOpen_le g)))
    {V : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) {N : SheafOfModules.{u} (X.ringCatSheaf.over V)}
    (φ ψ : ((moduleSheafification X).obj P).over V ⟶ N)
    (hφψ : ∀ i, φ.val.app (topOver V) (sheafifyUnitApp V (P.map (homOfLE h).op (x i))) =
      ψ.val.app (topOver V) (sheafifyUnitApp V (P.map (homOfLE h).op (x i)))) : φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  let L := (moduleSheafification X).obj P
  let e := overIsoFree x hU hx
  have key : ∀ i, Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X h (frameSec L e i) ≫ φ =
      Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X h (frameSec L e i) ≫ ψ := by
    intro i
    apply unitMod_hom_ext
    let o : Γ(X, U) := 1
    let o' : Γ(X, V) := 1
    have h1 : (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X h (frameSec L e i)).val.app (topOver V)
        o' = sheafifyUnitApp V (P.map (homOfLE h).op (x i)) := by
      rw [restrictHomOverLE_app_top]
      let g : Over.mk (homOfLE h) ⟶ Over.mk (𝟙 U) := Over.homMk (homOfLE h)
      have hn := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply (frameSec L e i).val g.op o
      have h1' : ((unitMod X).over U).val.map g.op o = o' :=
        map_one (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
      rw [h1'] at hn
      refine hn.trans ?_
      rw [← sheafifyUnitApp_map h]
      congr 1
      exact overIsoFree_inv_ιFree x hU hx i
    have hc : ∀ χ : L.over V ⟶ N,
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE X h (frameSec L e i) ≫ χ).val.app (topOver V) o' =
          χ.val.app (topOver V) (sheafifyUnitApp V (P.map (homOfLE h).op (x i))) :=
      fun χ ↦ by rw [← h1]; rfl
    exact (hc φ).trans ((hφψ i).trans (hc ψ).symm)
  rw [← Category.id_comp φ, ← Category.id_comp ψ, ← res_sum_coframe_frameSec (L := L) (e := e) h,
    Preadditive.sum_comp, Preadditive.sum_comp]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
  rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, key i]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.dRel_mul
statement:
theorem dRel_mul (W : X.Opens) (c₁ c₂ : Γ(X, W)) :
    dRel f W (c₁ * c₂) = c₁ • dRel f W c₂ + c₂ • dRel f W c₁
proof:
:= by
  letI := (f.appLE ⊤ W le_top).hom.toAlgebra
  unfold dRel
  rw [Derivation.leibniz, map_add, map_smul, map_smul]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.dRel_map
statement:
theorem dRel_map {W W' : X.Opens} (h : W' ≤ W) (c : Γ(X, W)) :
    (relativePresheaf f).map (homOfLE h).op (dRel f W c) =
      dRel f W' (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op c)
proof:
:= by
  have := relativePresheaf_map_compareMap f (V₀ := ⊤) h le_top
    (letI := (f.appLE ⊤ W le_top).hom.toAlgebra; KaehlerDifferential.D Γ(S, ⊤) Γ(X, W) c)
  rw [KaehlerDifferential.map_D] at this
  exact this

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.dRel_one
statement: theorem dRel_one (W : X.Opens) : dRel f W 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI := (f.appLE ⊤ W le_top).hom.toAlgebra
  unfold dRel
  rw [Derivation.map_one_eq_zero, map_zero]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.locDer_mul
statement:
theorem locDer_mul {U' : X.Opens} (ξ : (relativeSheaf f).over U' ⟶ (unitMod X).over U')
    {V : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ U') (c₁ c₂ : Γ(X, V)) :
    locDer f ξ h (c₁ * c₂) = c₁ * locDer f ξ h c₂ + c₂ * locDer f ξ h c₁
proof:
:= by
  unfold locDer sheafifyUnitApp
  rw [dRel_mul]
  erw [(((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app (relativePresheaf f)).app (op V)).hom.map_add,
    (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app (relativePresheaf f)).app (op V)).hom.map_smul,
    (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app (relativePresheaf f)).app (op V)).hom.map_smul,
    (ξ.val.app (leOver h)).hom.map_add, (ξ.val.app (leOver h)).hom.map_smul,
    (ξ.val.app (leOver h)).hom.map_smul]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.locDer_one
statement:
theorem locDer_one {U' : X.Opens} (ξ : (relativeSheaf f).over U' ⟶ (unitMod X).over U')
    {V : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ U') : locDer f ξ h 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold locDer sheafifyUnitApp
  rw [dRel_one]
  erw [(((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app (relativePresheaf f)).app (op V)).hom.map_zero,
    (ξ.val.app (leOver h)).hom.map_zero]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.cotangentChartFrame_eq
statement:
theorem cotangentChartFrame_eq (a : Fin (n + 1)) (k : ULift.{u} (AffineChartIndex n a)) :
    cotangentChartFrame R n a k =
      dRel (toSpec R n) (coordinateOpen R n a) (Koszul.ratio R n a k.down.1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold cotangentChartFrame dRel
  rw [chartKaehlerBasis_apply]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.locDer_eulerChartMap
statement:
theorem locDer_eulerChartMap (c j l : Fin (n + 1)) {V : (space R n).Opens}
    (h : V ≤ coordinateOpen R n c) :
    locDer (toSpec R n) (eulerChartMap R n c j) h
        ((space R n).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (Koszul.ratio R n c l)) =
      (if l = j then 1 else 0) -
        (if j = c then (space R n).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (Koszul.ratio R n c l) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  unfold locDer
  rw [← dRel_map, ← sheafifyUnitApp_map]
  refine (overHom_app_leOver (M := relativeSheaf (toSpec R n)) h (eulerChartMap R n c j) _).trans ?_
  by_cases hl : l = c
  · subst hl
    rw [Koszul.ratio_self, dRel_one]
    have h0 : sheafifyUnitApp (P := relativePresheaf (toSpec R n)) (coordinateOpen R n l) 0 = 0 :=
      (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction (space R n)).unit.app
        (relativePresheaf (toSpec R n))).app (op (coordinateOpen R n l))).hom.map_zero
    rw [h0]
    erw [(( eulerChartMap R n l j).val.app (topOver (coordinateOpen R n l))).hom.map_zero,
      map_zero, map_one]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all
  · have := eulerChartMap_frame R n c j ⟨⟨l, hl⟩⟩
    rw [cotangentChartFrame_eq] at this
    erw [this]
    simp only [eulerChartCoeff]
    rw [map_sub]
    congr 1
    · split_ifs <;> simp
    · split_ifs <;> simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.overlap_le_left
statement:
theorem overlap_le_left (a b : Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateOverlapOpen R n a b ≤ coordinateOpen R n a
proof:
:=
  (coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n a b).le.trans inf_le_left

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.overlap_le_right
statement:
theorem overlap_le_right (a b : Fin (n + 1)) :
    coordinateOverlapOpen R n a b ≤ coordinateOpen R n b
proof:
:=
  (coordinateOverlapOpen_eq_inf R n a b).le.trans inf_le_right

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.twistTransitionSectionUnit_neg_one
statement:
theorem twistTransitionSectionUnit_neg_one (a b : Fin (n + 1)) :
    twistTransitionSectionUnit R n (-1) a b = (twistTransitionSectionUnit R n 1 a b)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  unfold twistTransitionSectionUnit twistTransitionUnit
  rw [zpow_neg, zpow_one, map_inv]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.eulerChartMap_compat
statement:
theorem eulerChartMap_compat (a b j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE _ (overlap_le_left R n a b) (eulerChartMap R n a j) =
      Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE _ (overlap_le_right R n a b) (eulerChartMap R n b j) ≫
        mulSectionHom _ _ (twistTransitionSectionUnit R n (-1) a b :
          Γ(space R n, coordinateOverlapOpen R n a b))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let hVa := overlap_le_left R n a b
  let hVb := overlap_le_right R n a b
  let V := coordinateOverlapOpen R n a b
  refine overHom_ext_of_restricted_frame (cotangentChartFrame R n a) (coordinateOpen_isAffine R n a)
    (cotangentChartFrame_bijective R n a) hVa _ _ (fun k ↦ ?_)
  rw [cotangentChartFrame_eq, dRel_map]
  let ra : Fin (n + 1) → Γ(space R n, V) := fun l ↦
    (space R n).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVa).op (Koszul.ratio R n a l)
  let rb : Fin (n + 1) → Γ(space R n, V) := fun l ↦
    (space R n).presheaf.map (homOfLE hVb).op (Koszul.ratio R n b l)
  let T1 : Γ(space R n, V) := (twistTransitionSectionUnit R n 1 a b : Γ(space R n, V))
  let Tm : Γ(space R n, V) := (twistTransitionSectionUnit R n (-1) a b : Γ(space R n, V))
  have F1 : ∀ l, ra l = rb l * T1 := fun l ↦ Koszul.ratio_overlap R n a b l
  have Fa : ra a = 1 := by
    change (space R n).presheaf.map _ (Koszul.ratio R n a a) = 1
    rw [Koszul.ratio_self, map_one]
  have Fb : rb b = 1 := by
    change (space R n).presheaf.map _ (Koszul.ratio R n b b) = 1
    rw [Koszul.ratio_self, map_one]
  have hTT : Tm * T1 = 1 := by
    change ((twistTransitionSectionUnit R n (-1) a b : Γ(space R n, V)ˣ) : Γ(space R n, V)) *
      ((twistTransitionSectionUnit R n 1 a b : Γ(space R n, V)ˣ) : Γ(space R n, V)) = 1
    rw [twistTransitionSectionUnit_neg_one, Units.inv_mul]
  have hTm : Tm = rb a := by
    have h1 : rb a * T1 = 1 := (F1 a).symm.trans Fa
    calc Tm = Tm * (rb a * T1) := by rw [h1, mul_one]
      _ = rb a * (Tm * T1) := by ring
      _ = rb a := by rw [hTT, mul_one]
  have hprod : ra k.down.1 * rb a = rb k.down.1 := by
    rw [F1, mul_assoc, mul_comm T1, ← hTm, hTT, mul_one]
  have hL := locDer_eulerChartMap R n a j k.down.1 hVa
  have hδa := locDer_eulerChartMap R n b j a hVb
  have hδk := locDer_eulerChartMap R n b j k.down.1 hVb
  have hleib := locDer_mul (toSpec R n) (eulerChartMap R n b j) hVb (ra k.down.1) (rb a)
  rw [hprod] at hleib
  
  change locDer (toSpec R n) (eulerChartMap R n a j) hVa (ra k.down.1) =
    (space R n).presheaf.map (𝟙 V).op Tm *
      locDer (toSpec R n) (eulerChartMap R n b j) hVb (ra k.down.1)
  rw [CategoryTheory.op_id, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
  change _ = Tm * _
  change locDer _ _ _ (ra k.down.1) = (if k.down.1 = j then 1 else 0) - (if j = a then ra k.down.1 else 0)
    at hL
  change locDer _ _ _ (rb a) = (if a = j then 1 else 0) - (if j = b then rb a else 0) at hδa
  change locDer _ _ _ (rb k.down.1) =
    (if k.down.1 = j then 1 else 0) - (if j = b then rb k.down.1 else 0) at hδk
  rw [hL, hTm]
  have key : rb a * locDer (toSpec R n) (eulerChartMap R n b j) hVb (ra k.down.1) =
      locDer (toSpec R n) (eulerChartMap R n b j) hVb (rb k.down.1) -
        ra k.down.1 * locDer (toSpec R n) (eulerChartMap R n b j) hVb (rb a) := by
    rw [hleib]; ring
  rw [key, hδk, hδa]
  have hk : k.down.1 ≠ a := k.down.2
  have Fab : a = b → rb a = 1 := fun h ↦ h ▸ Fb
  have hk' : (a = j) ↔ (j = a) := eq_comm
  simp only [hk']
  by_cases hja : j = a <;> by_cases hjb : j = b <;> by_cases hkj : k.down.1 = j
  · exact absurd (hkj.trans hja) hk
  · simp only [if_pos hja, if_pos hjb, if_neg hkj]
    rw [Fab (hja.symm.trans hjb)] at hprod ⊢
    linear_combination -hprod
  · exact absurd (hkj.trans hja) hk
  · simp only [if_pos hja, if_neg hjb, if_neg hkj]
    ring
  · simp only [if_neg hja, if_pos hjb, if_pos hkj]
    linear_combination -hprod
  · simp only [if_neg hja, if_pos hjb, if_neg hkj]
    linear_combination -hprod
  · simp only [if_neg hja, if_neg hjb, if_pos hkj]
    ring
  · simp only [if_neg hja, if_neg hjb, if_neg hkj]
    ring

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition_eq
statement:
theorem pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition_eq (d : ℤ) (a b : Fin (n + 1)) :
    pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition R n d a b =
      Koszul.pushedMul (coordinateOverlapOpen R n a b)
        ((coordinateOverlapOpen R n a b).topIso.inv.hom
          (twistTransitionSectionUnit R n d a b : Γ(space R n, coordinateOverlapOpen R n a b)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition, coordinateOverlapTransitionIso, Koszul.unitMulSheafIso_hom]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.eulerChartCochain_compat
statement:
theorem eulerChartCochain_compat (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    eulerChartCochain R n j ≫ coordinateDescentLeft R n =
      eulerChartCochain R n j ≫ coordinateDescentRight R n (-1)
proof:
:= by
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  rintro ⟨a, b⟩
  simp only [Category.assoc, coordinateDescentLeft_π, coordinateDescentRight_π]
  rw [eulerChartCochain, Pi.lift_π_assoc, Pi.lift_π_assoc, pushedCoordinateOverlapTransition_eq,
    overToPushed_restriction, reassoc_of% (overToPushed_restriction (overlap_le_right R n a b)
      (eulerChartMap R n b j)), overToPushed_pushedMul]
  congr 1
  exact eulerChartMap_compat R n a b j

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.eulerContraction_ι
statement:
theorem eulerContraction_ι (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    eulerContraction R n j ≫ Koszul.ι R n (-1) = eulerChartCochain R n j
proof:
:=
  projectiveTwistingSheafLift_ι R n (-1) _ _

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.overToPushed_sum
statement:
theorem overToPushed_sum {X : Scheme.{u}} {U : X.Opens} {M : X.Modules} {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι)
    (ξ : ι → (M.over U ⟶ (unitMod X).over U)) :
    overToPushed (∑ i ∈ s, ξ i) = ∑ i ∈ s, overToPushed (ξ i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    simp only [Finset.sum_empty]
    apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
    apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
    intro W
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro m
    rfl
  | insert i s hi ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, Finset.sum_insert hi, ← ih]
    apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
    apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
    intro W
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro m
    rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.sum_eulerContraction_X
statement:
theorem sum_eulerContraction_X :
    ∑ j, eulerContraction R n j ≫ Koszul.X R n j (-1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (Koszul.ι R n (-1 + 1))).1
  rw [Preadditive.sum_comp, zero_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Koszul.X_ι, reassoc_of% (eulerContraction_ι R n)]
  apply Pi.hom_ext
  intro a
  rw [Preadditive.sum_comp, zero_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Koszul.mulPi_π, eulerChartCochain, Pi.lift_π_assoc, Koszul.chartMul,
    Koszul.chartCoeff, overToPushed_pushedMul]
  rw [← overToPushed_sum]
  have h0 : ∑ j, eulerChartMap R n a j ≫ mulSectionHom _ _ (Koszul.ratio R n a j) = 0 := by
    simp only [← smul_def, eulerChartMap, Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    simp only [← Finset.sum_smul]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k _ ↦ ?_
    erw [eulerChartCoeff_sum R n a k, zero_smul]
  rw [h0]
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext
  apply PresheafOfModules.hom_ext
  intro W
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro m
  rfl

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOD.ConvData.dual
statement:
theorem ConvData.dual {cA cD cB : ℕ → GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Op M} (h : ConvData cA cD cB) :
    ConvData (GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.dualChern cA) (GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.dualChern cD)
      (GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.dualChern cB) where
  A0
proof:
:= by simp [GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.dualChern, h.A0]
  D0 := by simp [GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.dualChern, h.D0]
  AA := fun i j ↦ by
    simp only [GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.dualChern, smul_mul_smul_comm, h.AA i j,
      mul_comm ((-1 : ℚ) ^ i)]
  DD := fun i j ↦ by
    simp only [GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.dualChern, smul_mul_smul_comm, h.DD i j,
      mul_comm ((-1 : ℚ) ^ i)]
  AD := fun i j ↦ by
    simp only [GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.dualChern, smul_mul_smul_comm, h.AD i j,
      mul_comm ((-1 : ℚ) ^ i)]
  conv := fun n ↦ by
    simp only [GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.dualChern]
    rw [h.conv n, Finset.smul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp ↦ ?_
    have hp' : p.1 + p.2 = n := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp
    rw [smul_mul_smul_comm, ← pow_add, hp']

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOD.tdG_comm_tdG
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∀ i, cE i * tdG cF q = tdG cF q * cE i := fun i ↦
    tdG_commute (c := cF) (T := cE i) (fun j ↦ h i j) q
  exact (tdG_commute (c := cE) (T := tdG cF q) (fun i ↦ (h1 i).symm) p).symm

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOD.dualChern_comm
statement:
theorem dualChern_comm {cE cF : ℕ → GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.Op M}
    (h : ∀ i j, cE i * cF j = cF j * cE i) (i j : ℕ) :
    GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.dualChern cE i * GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.dualChern cF j =
      GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.dualChern cF j * GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.dualChern cE i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.dualChern, smul_mul_smul_comm, h i j, mul_comm ((-1 : ℚ) ^ i)]

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOD.tdDualTot_mult
statement:
theorem tdDualTot_mult {A B D : X.Modules} (a : A ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ D) (w : a ≫ b = 0)
    (h : (ShortComplex.mk a b w).ShortExact) {r s : ℕ}
    (hA : HasConstantRank X A r) (hD : HasConstantRank X D s) :
    tdDualTot ops cp hP B = tdDualTot ops cp hP A * tdDualTot ops cp hP D
proof:
:= by
  have cA := chernData_constRank (hP := hP) hW hA
  have cD := chernData_constRank (hP := hP) hW hD
  unfold tdDualTot dualChernOf
  rw [← tot_mul cA.dual.gser_tdSer cD.dual.gser_tdSer]
  congr 1
  refine PowerSeries.ext fun n ↦ ?_
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
  simp only [PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
  exact (ConvData.dual (convData hW a b w h hA hD)).td n

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOD.tdDualTot_commute
statement:
theorem tdDualTot_commute {E F : X.Modules} {r s : ℕ}
    (hE : HasConstantRank X E r) (hF : HasConstantRank X F s) :
    tdDualTot ops cp hP E * tdDualTot ops cp hP F =
      tdDualTot ops cp hP F * tdDualTot ops cp hP E
proof:
:= by
  have cE := chernData_constRank (hP := hP) hW hE
  have cF := chernData_constRank (hP := hP) hW hF
  unfold tdDualTot dualChernOf
  rw [← tot_mul cE.dual.gser_tdSer cF.dual.gser_tdSer,
    ← tot_mul cF.dual.gser_tdSer cE.dual.gser_tdSer]
  congr 1
  refine PowerSeries.ext fun n ↦ ?_
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul, PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
  simp only [PowerSeries.coeff_mk]
  have hc : ∀ i j, constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X E i * constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X F j =
      constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X F j * constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X E i :=
    fun i j ↦ cOp_comm hW hE hF i j
  calc ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, tdG (GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.dualChern
        (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X E)) p.1 *
          tdG (GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.dualChern (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X F)) p.2
      = ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, tdG (GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.dualChern
          (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X F)) p.2 *
          tdG (GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.dualChern (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X E)) p.1 :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ ↦ tdG_comm_tdG (dualChern_comm hc) p.1 p.2
    _ = ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, tdG (GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.dualChern
          (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X F)) p.1 *
          tdG (GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.dualChern (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X E)) p.2 :=
        Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_swap
          (f := fun p : ℕ × ℕ ↦ tdG (GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.dualChern
            (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X F)) p.1 *
            tdG (GRRBlueprintV4.Alg.dualChern (constRankChernAssignOn' ops cp hP X E)) p.2)

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOD.tdDualUnit_commute
statement:
theorem tdDualUnit_commute (E F : {E : W.Modules // IsFiniteLocallyFree W E}) :
    tdDualUnit k W E.1 E.2 * tdDualUnit k W F.1 F.2 =
      tdDualUnit k W F.1 F.2 * tdDualUnit k W E.1 E.2
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty W := CHEXACT.nonempty_of_fact k
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := CHEXACT.exists_rank k E.2
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := CHEXACT.exists_rank k F.2
  refine Units.ext ?_
  rw [Units.val_mul, Units.val_mul]
  exact tdDualTot_commute (hP := closedPosV4 k) (whitney_projectiveIntegral (closedPosV4 k)) hr hs

name: GRRBlueprintV4.TOD.tdDualUnit_comm_gen
statement:
theorem tdDualUnit_comm_gen :
    ∀ x ∈ Set.range (fun E : {E : W.Modules // IsFiniteLocallyFree W E} ↦
        tdDualUnit k W E.1 E.2),

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E27.wCoordFun_wFrameSec
statement:
theorem wCoordFun_wFrameSec (d : WFrame L x) (V : X.Opens) (hV : V ≤ d.U) (c : Γ(X, V)) :
    wCoordFun d V hV (wFrameSec d V hV c) = c
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : d.globalFrame.inv.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV)))
      (d.globalFrame.hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV)))
        ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op V) c)) =
      (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op V) c :=
    congrArg (fun ψ ↦ ψ.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV)))
      ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op V) c))
      d.globalFrame.hom_inv_id
  have h2 : (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).hom.val.app (op V)
      ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op V) c) = c :=
    congrArg (fun ψ ↦ ψ.val.app (op V) c)
      (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv_hom_id
  change (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).hom.val.app (op V)
    (d.globalFrame.inv.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV)))
      (d.globalFrame.hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV)))
        ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op V) c))) = c
  rw [h1]
  exact h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E27.hom_app_one_eq_smul
statement:
theorem hom_app_one_eq_smul (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (d : WFrame L x) (U' : X.Opens)
    (hU' : U' ≤ d.U) :
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ U' (1 : Γ(X, U')) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hU').op (wCoord d (sectionOfHom σ)) • wFrameSec d U' hU' 1
proof:
:= by
  set s : Γ(L, ⊤) := sectionOfHom σ with hs
  set c := wCoord d s with hcdef
  have hc := wCoord_spec d s
  rw [wFrameSec_smul, wFrameSec_one] at hc
  have h2 := congrArg (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE hU').op) hc
  rw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul] at h2
  have h3 : L.presheaf.map (homOfLE hU').op (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : d.U ≤ ⊤)).op s) =
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.app σ U' (1 : Γ(X, U')) := by
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← L.presheaf.map_comp]
    exact section_app_one_restrict σ (le_top : U' ≤ ⊤)
  rw [h3] at h2
  have h4 : L.presheaf.map (homOfLE hU').op (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_refl d.U)).op (wFrameGen d)) =
      wFrameSec d U' hU' 1 := by
    rw [wFrameSec_one, ← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← L.presheaf.map_comp]
    rfl
  rw [h4] at h2
  exact h2.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E27.sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_ideal_eq_span
statement:
theorem sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_ideal_eq_span [L.IsQuasicoherent] [L.IsFinitePresentation]
    (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (d : WFrame L x) (U' : X.affineOpens) (hU' : U'.1 ≤ d.U) :
    (sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ).ideal U' =
      Ideal.span {X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hU').op (wCoord d (sectionOfHom σ))}
proof:
:= by
  rw [sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_affine σ U']
  unfold sectionAffineEvaluationIdeal
  rw [hom_app_one_eq_smul σ d U'.1 hU']
  exact sectionEvaluationIdeal_smul_eq_span (wFrameSec d U' hU' 1) (wCoordFun d U'.1 hU')
    (wCoordFun_wFrameSec d U'.1 hU' 1) _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E27.ker_stalkMap_eq_span_germ_wCoord
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_eq_span_germ_wCoord {V : Scheme.{u}} [L.IsQuasicoherent]
    [L.IsFinitePresentation] (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (j : V ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    (hid : sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf σ = j.ker) (q : V) (d : WFrame L (j q)) :
    RingHom.ker (j.stalkMap q).hom =
      Ideal.span {X.presheaf.germ d.U (j q) d.mem (wCoord d (sectionOfHom σ))}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V', hV', hqV, hVd⟩ := (Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens) d.mem
  let U' : X.affineOpens := ⟨V', hV'⟩
  rw [ker_stalkMap_eq_map_germ_ker j U' q hqV, ← hid,
    sectionEvaluationIdealSheaf_ideal_eq_span σ d U' hVd, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
  congr 2
  exact X.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE hVd) (j q) hqV _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.E27.isSMulRegular_germ_wCoord
statement:
theorem isSMulRegular_germ_wCoord (σ : tensorUnitSheaf X ⟶ L) (hreg : SectionIsRegular σ)
    (d : WFrame L x) :
    IsSMulRegular (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (X.presheaf.germ d.U x d.mem (wCoord d (sectionOfHom σ)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V', hV', hxV, hVd⟩ := (Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens) d.mem
  let U' : X.affineOpens := ⟨V', hV'⟩
  letI : Algebra Γ(X, V') (X.presheaf.stalk x) := X.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk ⟨x, hxV⟩
  haveI := hV'.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hxV⟩
  set c' := X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVd).op (wCoord d (sectionOfHom σ)) with hc'
  have hg : X.presheaf.germ d.U x d.mem (wCoord d (sectionOfHom σ)) =
      algebraMap Γ(X, V') (X.presheaf.stalk x) c' :=
    (X.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE hVd) x hxV _).symm
  rw [hg]
  have core : ∀ t : X.presheaf.stalk x,
      algebraMap Γ(X, V') (X.presheaf.stalk x) c' * t = 0 → t = 0 := by
    intro t ht0
    obtain ⟨⟨r1, u⟩, ht⟩ := IsLocalization.surj
      (hV'.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxV⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl t
    have h1 : algebraMap Γ(X, V') (X.presheaf.stalk x) (c' * r1) = 0 := by
      rw [map_mul]
      have := congrArg (fun z ↦ algebraMap Γ(X, V') (X.presheaf.stalk x) c' * z) ht
      simp only at this
      rw [← this, ← mul_assoc, ht0, zero_mul]
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (IsLocalization.map_eq_zero_iff
      (hV'.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxV⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl _ _).mp h1
    have hmr : (m : Γ(X, V')) * r1 = 0 := by
      refine hreg U' ((m : Γ(X, V')) * r1) ?_
      rw [hom_app_one_eq_smul σ d V' hVd, smul_smul]
      have : (m : Γ(X, V')) * r1 * c' = 0 := by
        calc (m : Γ(X, V')) * r1 * c' = (m : Γ(X, V')) * (c' * r1) := by ring
          _ = 0 := hm
      rw [this, zero_smul]
    have hmu : IsUnit (algebraMap Γ(X, V') (X.presheaf.stalk x) (m : Γ(X, V'))) :=
      IsLocalization.map_units (X.presheaf.stalk x) m
    have hr1 : algebraMap Γ(X, V') (X.presheaf.stalk x) r1 = 0 := by
      have := congrArg (algebraMap Γ(X, V') (X.presheaf.stalk x)) hmr
      rw [map_mul, map_zero] at this
      exact (hmu.mul_right_eq_zero).mp this
    have huu : IsUnit (algebraMap Γ(X, V') (X.presheaf.stalk x) (u : Γ(X, V'))) :=
      IsLocalization.map_units (X.presheaf.stalk x) u
    rw [hr1] at ht
    exact (huu.mul_left_eq_zero).mp ht
  intro a b hab
  have h0 : algebraMap Γ(X, V') (X.presheaf.stalk x) c' * (a - b) = 0 := by
    rw [mul_sub]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hab
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (core _ h0)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.FRI.fibreRel_projective
statement:
theorem fibreRel_projective [Infinite k] [IsIntegral X]
    (hX : ∀ z : X, IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk z))
    (φk : k →+* Γ(space k n, ⊤)) (c : k) :
    letI
proof:
:= kerOver k n i
    haveI := ker_lft k n i
    haveI := ker_noeth k n i
    letI := totalOver (k := k) (A := space k n) i.ker
    haveI := total_lft' k n i
    haveI := total_noeth k n i
    haveI := isIntegral_total k n i
    haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k (totalGlobal (space k n) i.ker)) :=
      ⟨CIICLASS.projectiveIntegral_of_K (by
        haveI : IsNoetherian (space k n) := SchemeProjectiveSpace.isNoetherian k n
        haveI := space_lft k n
        exact projectiveIntegralK_total (k := k) i.ker (space_member k n))⟩
    letI := componentOver (k := k) i.ker
    haveI := component_lft i.ker (SchemeKTheory.F14.quasiregularCover k n i
      (CIICLASS.T1N23.projectiveSpace_regStalks k n) hX)
      (kerOver_member k n i)
    haveI := component_isNoetherian i.ker (SchemeKTheory.F14.quasiregularCover k n i
      (CIICLASS.T1N23.projectiveSpace_regStalks k n) hX)
      (kerOver_member k n i)
    haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k (component (space k n) i.ker)) :=
      ⟨CIICLASS.projectiveIntegral_of_K (projectiveIntegralK_component_projective k n i
        (CIICLASS.T1N23.projectiveSpace_regStalks k n) hX)⟩
    haveI := fibre_isOver k n i φk c
    haveI := component_isOver k n i
    ∃ (L N : (totalGlobal (space k n) i.ker).Modules)
      (hL : SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank (totalGlobal (space k n) i.ker) L 1)
      (hN : SchemeKTheory.HasConstantRank (totalGlobal (space k n) i.ker) N 1),
      totalPushOn (GRRBlueprintV4.opsV4 k) (fibreιGlobal (space k n) i.ker k φk c)
          (GRRBlueprintV4.fundClass k (W := space k n)) =
        totalCapOn (GRRBlueprintV4.opsV4 k) (LPof L N) (hasConstantRank_LPof hL hN)
            (GRRBlueprintV4.fundClass k (W := totalGlobal (space k n) i.ker)) +
          totalPushOn (GRRBlueprintV4.opsV4 k) (componentToTotal (space k n) i.ker)
            (GRRBlueprintV4.fundClass k (W := component (space k n) i.ker)) := by
  letI := kerOver k n i
  haveI := ker_lft k n i
  haveI := ker_noeth k n i
  letI := totalOver (k := k) (A := space k n) i.ker
  haveI := total_lft' k n i
  haveI := total_noeth k n i
  haveI := isIntegral_total k n i
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k (totalGlobal (space k n) i.ker)) :=
    ⟨CIICLASS.projectiveIntegral_of_K (by
      haveI : IsNoetherian (space k n) := SchemeProjectiveSpace.isNoetherian k n
      haveI := space_lft k n
      exact projectiveIntegralK_total (k := k) i.ker (space_member k n))⟩
  letI := componentOver (k := k) i.ker
  haveI := component_lft i.ker (SchemeKTheory.F14.quasiregularCover k n i
    (CIICLASS.T1N23.projectiveSpace_regStalks k n) hX)
    (kerOver_member k n i)
  haveI := component_isNoetherian i.ker (SchemeKTheory.F14.quasiregularCover k n i
    (CIICLASS.T1N23.projectiveSpace_regStalks k n) hX)
    (kerOver_member k n i)
  haveI : Fact (ProjectiveIntegral k (component (space k n) i.ker)) :=
    ⟨CIICLASS.projectiveIntegral_of_K (projectiveIntegralK_component_projective k n i
      (CIICLASS.T1N23.projectiveSpace_regStalks k n) hX)⟩
  haveI := fibre_isOver k n i φk c
  haveI := component_isOver k n i
  haveI := isIntegral_total k n i
  haveI := isIntegral_component i.ker (SchemeKTheory.F14.quasiregularCover k n i
    (CIICLASS.T1N23.projectiveSpace_regStalks k n) hX) (kerOver_member k n i)
  exact fibreRel_totalGlobal_of_height (space k n) i.ker φk c (n := n)
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.M7.CASE1B.height_genericPoint_space k n)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechSupportLayer_cocycle_peel
statement:
theorem coordinateCechSupportLayer_cocycle_peel
    (m p : ℕ) (hmp : m ≤ p + 1)
    (x : coordinateCechHigherTerm k n M (p + 1))
    (hxsmall :
      ∀ a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1),
        (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card < m →
          (Pi.π
            (fun c : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              M.presheaf.obj
                (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) c)))
            a).hom x = 0)
    (hcycle :
      (coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M (p + 1)).hom x = 0) :
    ∃ y : coordinateCechHigherTerm k n M p,
      (∀ a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1),
        (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card < m + 1 →
          (Pi.π
            (fun c : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              M.presheaf.obj
                (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) c)))
            a).hom
              (x -
                (coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom y) = 0) ∧
      (coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M (p + 1)).hom
          (x - (coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hylayer, hyexact⟩ :=
    coordinateCechFixedSupportLayer_cocycle_primitive
      k n M m p hmp x hxsmall hcycle
  refine ⟨y, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a ha
    have hle :
        (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card ≤ m := by
      exact Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (by simpa only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using ha)
    by_cases heq : (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card = m
    · rw [map_sub, hylayer a heq, sub_self]
    · have hlt : (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card < m :=
        lt_of_le_of_ne hle heq
      have hdy :
          (Pi.π
            (fun c : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              M.presheaf.obj
                (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) c)))
            a).hom
              ((coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom y) = 0 := by
        rw [coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential_apply]
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro r _
        have hdelete :
            (coordinateCechWordSupport n (a ∘ r.succAbove)).card < m :=
          (coordinateCechWordSupport_card_comp_succAbove_le n a r).trans_lt hlt
        rw [hyexact (a ∘ r.succAbove) (ne_of_lt hdelete),
          map_zero, smul_zero]
      rw [map_sub, hxsmall a hlt, hdy, sub_zero]
  · rw [map_sub, hcycle]
    have hdd :
        (coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M (p + 1)).hom
            ((coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom y) = 0 := by
      have h :=
        ((coordinateCechComplexFunctor k n).obj M).d_comp_d
          p (p + 1) (p + 2)
      change
        ((coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p ≫
          coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M (p + 1)).hom) y = 0
      rw [show coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p ≫
          coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M (p + 1) = 0 by
        exact h]
      rfl
    rw [hdd, sub_zero]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechSupport_cocycle_peel_iterate
statement:
theorem coordinateCechSupport_cocycle_peel_iterate
    (m r p : ℕ) (hmrp : m + r ≤ p + 2)
    (x : coordinateCechHigherTerm k n M (p + 1))
    (hxsmall :
      ∀ a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1),
        (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card < m →
          (Pi.π
            (fun c : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              M.presheaf.obj
                (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) c)))
            a).hom x = 0)
    (hcycle :
      (coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M (p + 1)).hom x = 0) :
    ∃ y : coordinateCechHigherTerm k n M p,
      (∀ a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1),
        (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card < m + r →
          (Pi.π
            (fun c : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              M.presheaf.obj
                (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) c)))
            a).hom
              (x -
                (coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom y) = 0) ∧
      (coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M (p + 1)).hom
          (x - (coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction r generalizing x with
  | zero =>
      refine ⟨0, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro a ha
        simpa only [Nat.add_zero, map_zero, sub_zero] using hxsmall a ha
      · simpa only [map_zero, sub_zero] using hcycle
  | succ r ih =>
      have hmrp' : m + r ≤ p + 2 := by omega
      obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀small, hy₀cycle⟩ :=
        ih hmrp' x hxsmall hcycle
      let z :=
        x - (coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom y₀
      have hmp : m + r ≤ p + 1 := by omega
      obtain ⟨y₁, hy₁small, hy₁cycle⟩ :=
        coordinateCechSupportLayer_cocycle_peel
          k n M (m + r) p hmp z hy₀small hy₀cycle
      refine ⟨y₀ + y₁, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro a ha
        have hres :
            x -
                (coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom
                  (y₀ + y₁) =
              z -
                (coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom y₁ := by
          rw [map_add]
          dsimp only [z]
          abel
        rw [hres]
        apply hy₁small a
        omega
      · have hres :
            x -
                (coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom
                  (y₀ + y₁) =
              z -
                (coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom y₁ := by
          rw [map_add]
          dsimp only [z]
          abel
        rw [hres]
        exact hy₁cycle

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential_preimage_of_map_eq_zero_of_dimension
statement:
theorem coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential_preimage_of_map_eq_zero_of_dimension
    (p : ℕ) (hnp : n < p + 1)
    (x : coordinateCechHigherTerm k n M (p + 1))
    (hx :
      (coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M (p + 1)).hom x = 0) :
    ∃ y : coordinateCechHigherTerm k n M p,
      (coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom y = x
proof:
:= by
  have hbound : 1 + (n + 1) ≤ p + 2 := by omega
  have hxsmall :
      ∀ a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1),
        (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card < 1 →
          (Pi.π
            (fun c : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
              M.presheaf.obj
                (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) c)))
            a).hom x = 0 := by
    intro a ha
    have hmem :
        a 0 ∈ coordinateCechWordSupport n a :=
      (mem_coordinateCechWordSupport_iff n a (a 0)).2 ⟨0, rfl⟩
    have hpos : 0 < (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card :=
      Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨a 0, hmem⟩
    omega
  obtain ⟨y, hres, -⟩ :=
    coordinateCechSupport_cocycle_peel_iterate
      k n M 1 (n + 1) p hbound x hxsmall hx
  have hresZero :
      x - (coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M p).hom y = 0 := by
    apply (Limits.Concrete.productEquiv
      (fun a : Fin (p + 2) → Fin (n + 1) ↦
        M.presheaf.obj
          (op (coordinateCechIntersection k n (p + 1) a)))).injective
    funext a
    rw [Limits.Concrete.productEquiv_apply_apply,
      Limits.Concrete.productEquiv_apply_apply]
    have hle :
        (coordinateCechWordSupport n a).card ≤ n + 1 := by
      have :=
        Finset.card_le_card
          (Finset.subset_univ (coordinateCechWordSupport n a))
      simpa only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using this
    have ha := hres a (by omega)
    simpa using ha
  exact ⟨y, (sub_eq_zero.mp hresZero).symm⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechComplex_exactAt_of_dimension
statement:
theorem coordinateCechComplex_exactAt_of_dimension
    {q : ℕ} (hnq : n < q) :
    ((coordinateCechComplexFunctor k n).obj M).ExactAt q
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | p := q
  · omega
  rw [HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff'
    ((coordinateCechComplexFunctor k n).obj M)
    p (p + 1) (p + 2) (by simp) (by simp)]
  rw [ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff]
  intro x hx
  change
    (coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential k n M (p + 1)).hom x = 0 at hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ :=
    coordinateCechNativeHigherDifferential_preimage_of_map_eq_zero_of_dimension
      k n M p hnq x hx
  exact ⟨y, hy⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coordinateCechHomology_isZero_of_dimension
statement:
theorem coordinateCechHomology_isZero_of_dimension
    {q : ℕ} (hnq : n < q) :
    IsZero (((coordinateCechComplexFunctor k n).obj M).homology q)
proof:
:=
  (coordinateCechComplex_exactAt_of_dimension k n M hnq).isZero_homology

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.bijective_Γevaluation_spec_field
statement:
theorem bijective_Γevaluation_spec_field (y : Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :
    Function.Bijective ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv ≫
      (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).Γevaluation y).hom
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨RingHom.injective _, ?_⟩
  have h := Scheme.Spec.algebraMap_residueFieldIso_inv (CommRingCat.of k) y
  have h2 : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv ≫
      (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).Γevaluation y =
      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k _) ≫ (Scheme.Spec.residueFieldIso _ y).inv := by
    rw [h]; rfl
  rw [h2, CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.coe_comp]
  haveI : y.asIdeal.IsMaximal := y.asIdeal.isMaximal_of_isPrime
  exact (Scheme.Spec.residueFieldIso _ y).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.symm.surjective.comp
    (Ideal.algebraMap_residueField_surjective y.asIdeal)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.finrank_residueField_eq_degree
statement:
theorem finrank_residueField_eq_degree (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (x : X) :
    @Module.finrank k (X.residueField x) _ _ (AlgebraicCycle.instModuleCarrierResidueField k x) =
      (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).degree x
proof:
:= by
  letI A : Algebra k (X.residueField x) :=
    ((X.Γevaluation x).hom.comp (globalSec (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k))).toAlgebra
  have hM : AlgebraicCycle.instModuleCarrierResidueField k x = A.toModule :=
    Module.ext' _ _ (fun _ _ ↦ rfl)
  rw [hM]
  set g := X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)
  set y := g x
  set ι := ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv ≫
      (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).Γevaluation y).hom with hι
  have hij : (g.residueFieldMap x).hom.comp
      (RingEquiv.ofBijective ι (bijective_Γevaluation_spec_field k y)).toRingHom =
      (RingEquiv.refl (X.residueField x)).toRingHom.comp
        ((X.Γevaluation x).hom.comp (globalSec (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k))) := by
    ext r
    exact Scheme.Γevaluation_naturality_apply g x _
  exact @Algebra.finrank_eq_of_equiv_equiv k (X.residueField x) _ _ A _ (X.residueField x) _ _
    ((g.residueFieldMap x).hom.toAlgebra)
    (RingEquiv.ofBijective ι (bijective_Γevaluation_spec_field k y)) (RingEquiv.refl _) hij

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.properPushforward_toSpec_apply
statement:
theorem properPushforward_toSpec_apply (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [CompactSpace X] (D : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ)
    (y : Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :
    properPushforward (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) D y = AlgebraicCycle.degree k D
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Subsingleton (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton (PrimeSpectrum k))
  rw [properPushforward_apply, AlgebraicCycle.degree]
  simp_rw [finrank_residueField_eq_degree k X]
  symm
  apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
  intro x hx
  rw [Function.mem_support] at hx
  rw [Finset.mem_coe, mem_preimageSupportFinite_toFinset_iff]
  exact ⟨Subsingleton.elim _ _, fun h0 ↦ hx (by rw [h0, zero_mul])⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.coheight_eq_one_of_height_of_height_genericPoint
statement:
theorem coheight_eq_one_of_height_of_height_genericPoint {Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Z] (v : Z)
    {k : ℕ} (hv : height v = k) (hη : height (genericPoint Z) = (k : ℕ∞) + 1) :
    coheight v = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hle : ∀ x : Z, x ≤ genericPoint Z := fun x ↦
    Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr ((genericPoint_spec Z).specializes (Set.mem_univ x))
  have hlt : v < genericPoint Z := by
    refine lt_of_le_not_ge (hle v) (fun h ↦ ?_)
    have := Order.height_mono h
    rw [hv, hη] at this
    have : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast this
    norm_cast at this
    omega
  apply le_antisymm
  · by_contra hc
    push Not at hc
    have h2 : ((2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ coheight v := Order.add_one_le_of_lt hc
    obtain ⟨p, hp0, hlen⟩ := Order.exists_series_of_le_coheight v h2
    have h01 : p ⟨0, by omega⟩ < p ⟨1, by omega⟩ := p.strictMono (Fin.mk_lt_mk.mpr (by omega))
    have h12 : p ⟨1, by omega⟩ < p ⟨2, by omega⟩ := p.strictMono (Fin.mk_lt_mk.mpr (by omega))
    have hp0' : p ⟨0, by omega⟩ = v := hp0
    have ha := Order.height_add_one_le h01
    have hb := Order.height_add_one_le h12
    have hc2 := Order.height_mono (hle (p ⟨2, by omega⟩))
    rw [hp0', hv] at ha
    rw [hη] at hc2
    have : (k : ℕ∞) + 1 + 1 ≤ k + 1 := by
      calc (k : ℕ∞) + 1 + 1 ≤ height (p ⟨1, by omega⟩) + 1 := by gcongr
        _ ≤ _ := hb.trans hc2
    have : ((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
      push_cast; simp only [add_assoc, one_add_one_eq_two] at this; exact this
    norm_cast at this
    omega
  · exact Order.one_le_iff_pos.mpr (Order.coheight_pos.mpr (not_isMax_of_lt hlt))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.height_ne_top_of_finiteType
statement:
theorem height_ne_top_of_finiteType (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] (x : X) : height x ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, -⟩ := (TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens)
    (show x ∈ (⊤ : X.Opens) from trivial)
  rw [height_eq_coheight_primeIdealOf k X hV x hxV, coheight_primeIdealOf_eq_τ k X hV x hxV]
  exact τ_ne_top k X hV x hxV

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.height_eq_τ
statement:
theorem height_eq_τ (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] (x : X) : height x = τ k X x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, -⟩ := (TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens)
    (show x ∈ (⊤ : X.Opens) from trivial)
  rw [height_eq_coheight_primeIdealOf k X hV x hxV, coheight_primeIdealOf_eq_τ k X hV x hxV]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.coheight_map_eq_one_of_finiteType
statement:
theorem coheight_map_eq_one_of_finiteType {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y]
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [IsDominant f]
    (hdeg : f.degree (genericPoint X) ≠ 0) (w : X) (hw : coheight w = 1)
    (hwd : f.degree w ≠ 0) : coheight (f w) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hf := heightCompatible_of_finiteType k f
  have hcat : height w + 1 = height (genericPoint X) :=
    dimensionCatenary_of_finiteType (X := X) k X (𝟙 X) w hw
  have hη : height (genericPoint Y) = height (genericPoint X) := by
    rw [← RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.map_genericPoint f]
    exact hf _ hdeg
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp (height_ne_top_of_finiteType k X w)
  apply coheight_eq_one_of_height_of_height_genericPoint (f w) (k := n)
  · rw [hf w hwd, ← hn]
  · rw [hη, ← hcat, ← hn]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.properPushforward_toSpec_one_div
statement:
theorem properPushforward_toSpec_one_div (s : (space k 1).functionField) (hs : s ≠ 0) :
    properPushforward (toSpec k 1) (div s) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  change properPushforward (space k 1 ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (div s) y = 0
  rw [properPushforward_toSpec_apply]
  exact weilDivisorDegree_principal k s hs

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.graphMap_comp_toSpec
statement:
theorem graphMap_comp_toSpec :
    graphMap k U r ≫ toSpec k 1 = U.ι ≫ (W ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_of_isAffine
  have hf : (coordinateOpen_isAffine k 1 0).fromSpec.appTop =
      (space k 1).presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op ≫
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(space k 1, coordinateOpen k 1 0)).inv :=
    ((coordinateOpen_isAffine k 1 0).fromSpec_app_of_le ⊤ le_top).trans (by
      congr 1)
  have hS : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (graphRingHom k U r))).appTop =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso _).hom ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom (graphRingHom k U r) ≫
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso _).inv := by
    rw [← Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
  simp only [graphMap, Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, Category.assoc, hf, hS,
    Scheme.Opens.toSpecΓ_appTop]
  rw [← cancel_epi (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv]
  ext c
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply]
  erw [Iso.inv_hom_id_apply, Iso.inv_hom_id_apply]
  change U.topIso.inv (graphRingHom k U r
      (structureRingHom (X := space k 1) (R := CommRingCat.of k) (coordinateOpen k 1 0) c)) = _
  rw [← chartPolynomialEquiv_symm_C, graphRingHom, RingHom.comp_apply]
  erw [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [Polynomial.coe_eval₂RingHom, Polynomial.eval₂_C]
  change W.presheaf.map _ (W.presheaf.map _ _) = W.presheaf.map _ _
  rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.opensι_genericPoint
statement: theorem opensι_genericPoint : U.ι (genericPoint U.toScheme) = genericPoint W
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsDominant U.ι := AlgebraicGeometry.Opens.isDominant_ι
    (U.isOpen.dense (Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr fun h ↦ by
      obtain ⟨⟨x, hx⟩⟩ := ‹Nonempty U›
      have : x ∈ (U : Set W) := hx
      rw [h] at this
      exact this))
  exact RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.map_genericPoint U.ι

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.isDominant_of_map_genericPoint
statement:
theorem isDominant_of_map_genericPoint {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (h : f (genericPoint X) = genericPoint Y) : IsDominant f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  rw [denseRange_iff_closure_range, Set.eq_univ_iff_forall]
  intro y
  have hmem : genericPoint Y ∈ Set.range f := ⟨_, h⟩
  exact closure_mono (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hmem)
    ((genericPoint_spec Y).specializes (Set.mem_univ y) |> fun hs ↦ by
      rw [← specializes_iff_mem_closure]; exact hs)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.genericPoint_graphImage
statement:
