    genericPoint (graphImage k U r) = (graphLift k U r).toImage (genericPoint U.toScheme)
proof:
:=
  (toImage_genericPoint _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.graphFst_genericPoint
statement:
theorem graphFst_genericPoint :
    graphFst k U r (genericPoint (graphImage k U r)) = genericPoint W
proof:
:= by
  rw [genericPoint_graphImage, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, toImage_graphFst, opensι_genericPoint]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.graphFst_degree
statement: theorem graphFst_degree : (graphFst k U r).degree (genericPoint (graphImage k U r)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  set γ := (graphLift k U r).toImage
  set ηU := genericPoint U.toScheme
  have hc := Scheme.residueFieldMap_comp γ (graphFst k U r) ηU
  have hc' := Scheme.Hom.residueFieldMap_congr (toImage_graphFst k U r) ηU
  have hbij : Function.Bijective ((γ ≫ graphFst k U r).residueFieldMap ηU).hom := by
    rw [hc', CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.coe_comp]
    exact (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (U.ι.residueFieldMap ηU)).comp
      (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _)
  rw [hc] at hbij
  change Function.Bijective (fun z ↦ (γ.residueFieldMap ηU).hom
    (((graphFst k U r).residueFieldMap (γ ηU)).hom z)) at hbij
  have h2 : Function.Bijective (γ.residueFieldMap ηU).hom :=
    ⟨RingHom.injective _, hbij.surjective.of_comp⟩
  have h1 : Function.Bijective ((graphFst k U r).residueFieldMap (γ ηU)).hom := by
    refine ⟨RingHom.injective _, fun z ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hbij.surjective ((γ.residueFieldMap ηU).hom z)
    exact ⟨w, h2.injective hw⟩
  rw [genericPoint_graphImage]
  letI : Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↑(W.presheaf.stalk (graphFst k U r (γ ηU))))
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↑((graphImage k U r).presheaf.stalk (γ ηU))) :=
    RingHom.toAlgebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map ((graphFst k U r).stalkMap (γ ηU)).hom)
  exact Algebra.finrank_eq_one_iff_bijective_algebraMap.mpr h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.graphRingHom_injective
statement:
theorem graphRingHom_injective (hr : letI := (kSec k W U).toAlgebra; Transcendental k r) :
    Function.Injective (graphRingHom k U r)
proof:
:= by
  letI := (kSec k W U).toAlgebra
  have h := (transcendental_iff_injective).mp hr
  intro a b hab
  apply (chartPolynomialEquiv k).injective
  apply h
  simp only [graphRingHom, RingHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.coe_eval₂RingHom] at hab
  rw [Polynomial.aeval_def, Polynomial.aeval_def]
  exact hab

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.genericPoint_opens_eq
statement:
theorem genericPoint_opens_eq :
    genericPoint U.toScheme =
      ⟨genericPoint W, (opensι_genericPoint U) ▸ (genericPoint U.toScheme).2⟩
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (by simpa using opensι_genericPoint U)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.graphMap_genericPoint
statement:
theorem graphMap_genericPoint (hr : Function.Injective (graphRingHom k U r)) :
    graphMap k U r (genericPoint U.toScheme) = genericPoint (space k 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hU : IsAffineOpen U := ‹IsAffine U.toScheme›
  have h1 : U.toSpecΓ (genericPoint U.toScheme) = genericPoint (Spec Γ(W, U)) := by
    rw [genericPoint_opens_eq U, ← hU.primeIdealOf_genericPoint]
    rfl
  have h2 : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (graphRingHom k U r)) (genericPoint (Spec Γ(W, U))) =
      genericPoint (Spec Γ(space k 1, coordinateOpen k 1 0)) := by
    rw [genericPoint_eq_bot_of_affine, genericPoint_eq_bot_of_affine]
    apply PrimeSpectrum.ext
    change Ideal.comap (graphRingHom k U r) ⊥ = ⊥
    exact Ideal.comap_bot_of_injective _ hr
  have h3 := (coordinateOpen_isAffine k 1 0).primeIdealOf_genericPoint
  simp only [graphMap, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, h1, h2]
  rw [← h3, IsAffineOpen.fromSpec_primeIdealOf]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.graphSnd_genericPoint
statement:
theorem graphSnd_genericPoint (hr : Function.Injective (graphRingHom k U r)) :
    graphSnd k U r (genericPoint (graphImage k U r)) = genericPoint (space k 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [genericPoint_graphImage, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, toImage_graphSnd,
    graphMap_genericPoint k U r hr]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.isDominant_graphSnd
statement:
theorem isDominant_graphSnd (hr : Function.Injective (graphRingHom k U r)) :
    IsDominant (graphSnd k U r)
proof:
:=
  isDominant_of_map_genericPoint _ (graphSnd_genericPoint k U r hr)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.height_genericPoint_graphImage
statement:
theorem height_genericPoint_graphImage :
    height (genericPoint (graphImage k U r)) = height (genericPoint W)
proof:
:= by
  have hf := heightCompatible_of_finiteType k (graphFst k U r)
  rw [← graphFst_genericPoint k U r]
  exact (hf _ (by rw [graphFst_degree]; exact one_ne_zero)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.graphSnd_degree_ne_zero
statement:
theorem graphSnd_degree_ne_zero (hr : Function.Injective (graphRingHom k U r))
    (hW : height (genericPoint W) = height (genericPoint (space k 1))) :
    (graphSnd k U r).degree (genericPoint (graphImage k U r)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  have h := τ_lt_of_degree_eq_zero k (graphSnd k U r) _ h0
  rw [graphSnd_genericPoint k U r hr, ← height_eq_τ, ← height_eq_τ,
    height_genericPoint_graphImage, hW] at h
  exact lt_irrefl _ h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.height_genericPoint_projectiveLine
statement: theorem height_genericPoint_projectiveLine : height (genericPoint (space k 1)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hcat : height (infinityPoint k (le_refl 1)) + 1 = height (genericPoint (space k 1)) :=
    dimensionCatenary_of_finiteType (X := space k 1) k (space k 1) (𝟙 _) _
      (coheight_infinityPoint k (le_refl 1))
  have hle : height (genericPoint (space k 1)) ≤ 1 := by
    have h1 := Order.height_le_krullDim (genericPoint (space k 1))
    have h2 : krullDim (space k 1) ≤ ((1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
      rw [← Order.krullDimLE_iff]
      infer_instance
    exact_mod_cast h1.trans h2
  refine le_antisymm hle ?_
  rw [← hcat]
  exact le_add_self

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.exists_transcendental_section
statement:
theorem exists_transcendental_section (W : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral W]
    [W.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (W ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (hW : height (genericPoint W) = 1) :
    ∃ (U : W.Opens) (_ : IsAffineOpen U) (_ : Nonempty U) (r : Γ(W, U)),
      letI
proof:
:= (kSec k W U).toAlgebra; Transcendental k r := by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hηU, -⟩ := (TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp W.isBasis_affineOpens)
    (show genericPoint W ∈ (⊤ : W.Opens) from trivial)
  haveI : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨_, hηU⟩⟩
  letI := (kSec k W U).toAlgebra
  have ht := trdeg_quotient_primeIdealOf k W hU _ hηU
  rw [← height_eq_τ, hW] at ht
  have hna : ¬ Algebra.IsAlgebraic k
      (Γ(W, U) ⧸ (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨genericPoint W, hηU⟩).asIdeal) := by
    intro h
    rw [← trdeg_eq_zero_iff, ← Cardinal.toENat_eq_zero] at h
    rw [h] at ht
    exact zero_ne_one ht
  rw [Algebra.isAlgebraic_def] at hna
  push Not at hna
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hna
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
  exact ⟨U, hU, ‹_›, a, fun ha ↦ hx (ha.algHom (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k _))⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.properPushforward_div_eq_zero_of_curve
statement:
theorem properPushforward_div_eq_zero_of_curve (W : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral W]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian W] [W.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [IsProper (W ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] (hW : height (genericPoint W) = 1)
    (s : W.functionField) (hs : s ≠ 0) :
    properPushforward (W ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (div s) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hne, r, hr⟩ := exists_transcendental_section k W hW
  haveI : IsAffine U.toScheme := hU
  have hinj := graphRingHom_injective k U r hr
  haveI := isDominant_graphSnd k U r hinj
  letI := functionFieldAlgebra (graphFst k U r)
  set t := algebraMap W.functionField (graphImage k U r).functionField s with ht_def
  have ht : t ≠ 0 := (map_ne_zero_iff _ (algebraMap _ _).injective).mpr hs
  have hda : (graphFst k U r).degree (genericPoint (graphImage k U r)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [graphFst_degree]; exact one_ne_zero
  have hdb := graphSnd_degree_ne_zero k U r hinj
    (by rw [hW, height_genericPoint_projectiveLine])
  have hA := properPushforward_div_eq_div_norm (graphFst k U r) t ht hda
    (coheight_map_eq_one_of_finiteType k (graphFst k U r) hda)
  have hN : Algebra.norm W.functionField t = s := by
    rw [ht_def, Algebra.norm_algebraMap, finrank_functionField_eq_degree, graphFst_degree,
      pow_one]
  have hB := properPushforward_div_eq_div_norm (graphSnd k U r) t ht hdb
    (coheight_map_eq_one_of_finiteType k (graphSnd k U r) hdb)
  have hNb : (letI := functionFieldAlgebra (graphSnd k U r)
      Algebra.norm (space k 1).functionField t) ≠ 0 := by
    letI := functionFieldAlgebra (graphSnd k U r)
    haveI := RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.finiteDimensional_of_degree _ hdb
    exact Algebra.norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr ht
  calc properPushforward (W ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (div s)
      = properPushforward (W ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
          (properPushforward (graphFst k U r) (div t)) := by rw [hA, hN]
    _ = properPushforward (graphFst k U r ≫ (W ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (div t) :=
        (properPushforward_comp _ _ _).symm
    _ = properPushforward (graphSnd k U r ≫ toSpec k 1) (div t) :=
        properPushforward_congr (graphFst_comp k U r) _
    _ = properPushforward (toSpec k 1) (properPushforward (graphSnd k U r) (div t)) :=
        properPushforward_comp _ _ _
    _ = 0 := by rw [hB]; exact properPushforward_toSpec_one_div k _ hNb

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.principalDegreeVanishes
statement: theorem principalDegreeVanishes : PrincipalDegreeVanishes k
proof:
:= by
  intro W _ _ g _ _ s hs
  letI : W.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := ⟨g⟩
  haveI : IsProper (W ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := ‹IsProper g›
  change properPushforward (W ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (div s) = 0
  by_cases hW : height (genericPoint W) = 1
  · exact properPushforward_div_eq_zero_of_curve k W hW s hs
  · ext y
    change properPushforward _ _ y = 0
    by_contra hy
    obtain ⟨x, -, hdx, hdeg⟩ := exists_of_properPushforward_apply_ne_zero _ _ y hy
    apply hW
    letI : (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := ⟨𝟙 _⟩
    haveI : (W ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
      ⟨Category.comp_id _⟩
    haveI : Subsingleton (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
      inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton (PrimeSpectrum k))
    have hf := heightCompatible_of_finiteType k (W ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) x hdeg
    have h0 : height ((W ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) x) = 0 :=
      Order.height_eq_zero.mpr fun b _ ↦ le_of_eq (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
    have hcat : height x + 1 = height (genericPoint W) :=
      dimensionCatenary_of_finiteType (X := W) k W (𝟙 W) x (div_support hdx)
    rw [← hcat, ← hf, h0, zero_add]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.properPushforwardDescends_toSpec
statement:
theorem properPushforwardDescends_toSpec (n p : ℕ) :
    ProperPushforwardDescends (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k n) p (p - n)
proof:
:=
  properPushforwardDescends_toSpec_of_principalDegreeVanishes k (principalDegreeVanishes k) n p

name: AlgebraicGeometry.AlgebraicCycle.mem_preimageSupport_toFinset_iff
proof:
:= by
  simp [Function.locallyFinsupp.preimageSupport, Function.mem_support]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_closedImmersion
statement:
theorem pushforward_apply_closedImmersion {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion f] (D : AlgebraicCycle Y ℤ)
    {N : Type*} [DecidableEq N] (wy : Y → N) (wx : X → N)
    (hgrade : ∀ y : Y, D y ≠ 0 → wy y = wx (f y)) (y : Y) :
    pushforward f D wy wx (f y) = D y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hD : D y = 0
  · rw [hD, pushforward]
    dsimp only [Function.locallyFinsupp.map]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro z hz
    have hfz : f z = f y := (mem_preimageSupport_toFinset_iff f D _ z).mp hz |>.1
    rw [f.isEmbedding.injective hfz, hD, zero_mul]
  · rw [pushforward]
    dsimp only [Function.locallyFinsupp.map]
    change (∑ z ∈ (f.preimageSupportFinite D (f y)).toFinset,
      D z * (mapAux f wy wx z : ℤ)) = D y
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single y]
    · simp [mapAux, hgrade y hD, f.degree_eq_one_of_isClosedImmersion]
    · intro z hz hzy
      have hfz : f z = f y := (mem_preimageSupport_toFinset_iff f D _ z).mp hz |>.1
      exact (hzy (f.isEmbedding.injective hfz)).elim
    · intro hy
      exact (hy ((mem_preimageSupport_toFinset_iff f D _ y).mpr ⟨rfl, hD⟩)).elim

name: AlgebraicGeometry.AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range
statement:
theorem pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion f] (D : AlgebraicCycle Y ℤ)
    {N : Type*} [DecidableEq N] (wy : Y → N) (wx : X → N)
    (x : X) (hx : x ∉ Set.range f) : pushforward f D wy wx x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [pushforward]
  dsimp only [Function.locallyFinsupp.map]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro y hy
  have hfy : f y = x := (mem_preimageSupport_toFinset_iff f D x y).mp hy |>.1
  exact (hx ⟨y, hfy⟩).elim

name: AlgebraicGeometry.AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_support_closedImmersion
statement:
theorem pushforward_support_closedImmersion {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion f] (D : AlgebraicCycle Y ℤ)
    {N : Type*} [DecidableEq N] (wy : Y → N) (wx : X → N)
    (hgrade : ∀ y : Y, D y ≠ 0 → wy y = wx (f y)) :
    (pushforward f D wy wx).support = f '' D.support
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    change pushforward f D wy wx x ≠ 0 at hx
    by_cases hrange : x ∈ Set.range f
    · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hrange
      refine ⟨y, ?_, rfl⟩
      change D y ≠ 0
      simpa [pushforward_apply_closedImmersion f D wy wx hgrade y] using hx
    · exact (hx (pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range f D wy wx x hrange)).elim
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    change pushforward f D wy wx (f y) ≠ 0
    rw [pushforward_apply_closedImmersion f D wy wx hgrade y]
    exact hy

name: AlgebraicGeometry.AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_eq_closedImmersion
statement:
theorem pushforward_eq_closedImmersion {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion f] (D : AlgebraicCycle Y ℤ)
    {N M : Type*} [DecidableEq N] [DecidableEq M]
    (wy : Y → N) (wx : X → N) (wy' : Y → M) (wx' : X → M)
    (hgrade : ∀ y : Y, D y ≠ 0 → wy y = wx (f y))
    (hgrade' : ∀ y : Y, D y ≠ 0 → wy' y = wx' (f y)) :
    pushforward f D wy wx = pushforward f D wy' wx'
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.range f
  · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [pushforward_apply_closedImmersion f D wy wx hgrade y,
      pushforward_apply_closedImmersion f D wy' wx' hgrade' y]
  · rw [pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range f D wy wx x hx,
      pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range f D wy' wx' x hx]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_comp_closedImmersion
statement:
theorem pushforward_comp_closedImmersion {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : Y ⟶ Z) (g : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion f] [IsClosedImmersion g]
    (D : AlgebraicCycle Y ℤ) {N : Type*} [DecidableEq N]
    (wy : Y → N) (wz : Z → N) (wx : X → N)
    (hfgrade : ∀ y : Y, D y ≠ 0 → wy y = wz (f y))
    (hggrade : ∀ z : Z, pushforward f D wy wz z ≠ 0 → wz z = wx (g z)) :
    pushforward (f ≫ g) D wy wx = pushforward g (pushforward f D wy wz) wz wx
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : ∀ y : Y, D y ≠ 0 → wy y = wx ((f ≫ g) y) := by
    intro y hy
    rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact (hfgrade y hy).trans (hggrade (f y) (by
      rw [pushforward_apply_closedImmersion f D wy wz hfgrade y]
      exact hy))
  have himage : (f ≫ g) '' D.support = g '' (f '' D.support) := by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_image]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
      exact ⟨f y, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, by rwa [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]⟩
    · rintro ⟨z, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, hzx⟩
      exact ⟨y, hy, (Scheme.Hom.comp_apply f g y).trans hzx⟩
  ext x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ g '' (f '' D.support)
  · obtain ⟨z, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := hx
    calc
      pushforward (f ≫ g) D wy wx (g (f y)) = D y := by
        rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
        exact pushforward_apply_closedImmersion (f ≫ g) D wy wx hcomp y
      _ = pushforward g (pushforward f D wy wz) wz wx (g (f y)) := by
        rw [pushforward_apply_closedImmersion g (pushforward f D wy wz) wz wx hggrade (f y),
          pushforward_apply_closedImmersion f D wy wz hfgrade y]
  · have hdnot : x ∉ (pushforward (f ≫ g) D wy wx).support := by
      rw [pushforward_support_closedImmersion (f ≫ g) D wy wx hcomp, himage]
      exact hx
    have hsnot : x ∉ (pushforward g (pushforward f D wy wz) wz wx).support := by
      rw [pushforward_support_closedImmersion g (pushforward f D wy wz) wz wx hggrade,
        pushforward_support_closedImmersion f D wy wz hfgrade]
      exact hx
    have hd0 : pushforward (f ≫ g) D wy wx x = 0 := by
      simpa [Function.mem_support] using hdnot
    have hs0 : pushforward g (pushforward f D wy wz) wz wx x = 0 := by
      simpa [Function.mem_support] using hsnot
    rw [hd0, hs0]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_zero_closedImmersion
statement:
theorem pushforward_zero_closedImmersion {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion f] {N : Type*} [DecidableEq N]
    (wy : Y → N) (wx : X → N) :
    pushforward f (0 : AlgebraicCycle Y ℤ) wy wx = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hgrade : ∀ y : Y, (0 : AlgebraicCycle Y ℤ) y ≠ 0 → wy y = wx (f y) := by
    simp
  ext x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.range f
  · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [pushforward_apply_closedImmersion f 0 wy wx hgrade y]
    rfl
  · rw [pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range f 0 wy wx x hx]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_add_closedImmersion
statement:
theorem pushforward_add_closedImmersion {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion f] (D E : AlgebraicCycle Y ℤ)
    {N : Type*} [DecidableEq N] (wy : Y → N) (wx : X → N)
    (hD : ∀ y : Y, D y ≠ 0 → wy y = wx (f y))
    (hE : ∀ y : Y, E y ≠ 0 → wy y = wx (f y)) :
    pushforward f (D + E) wy wx = pushforward f D wy wx + pushforward f E wy wx
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : ∀ y : Y, (D + E) y ≠ 0 → wy y = wx (f y) := by
    intro y hy
    by_cases hDy : D y = 0
    · apply hE y
      intro hEy
      exact hy (by simp [hDy, hEy])
    · exact hD y hDy
  ext x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.range f
  · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
    change pushforward f (D + E) wy wx (f y) =
      pushforward f D wy wx (f y) + pushforward f E wy wx (f y)
    rw [pushforward_apply_closedImmersion f (D + E) wy wx hsum y,
      pushforward_apply_closedImmersion f D wy wx hD y,
      pushforward_apply_closedImmersion f E wy wx hE y]
    rfl
  · rw [pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range f (D + E) wy wx x hx,
      show (pushforward f D wy wx + pushforward f E wy wx) x =
        pushforward f D wy wx x + pushforward f E wy wx x by rfl,
      pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range f D wy wx x hx,
      pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range f E wy wx x hx]
    simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_zsmul_closedImmersion
statement:
theorem pushforward_zsmul_closedImmersion {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion f] (D : AlgebraicCycle Y ℤ) (n : ℤ)
    {N : Type*} [DecidableEq N] (wy : Y → N) (wx : X → N)
    (hD : ∀ y : Y, D y ≠ 0 → wy y = wx (f y)) :
    pushforward f (n • D) wy wx = n • pushforward f D wy wx
proof:
:= by
  have hmul : ∀ y : Y, (n • D) y ≠ 0 → wy y = wx (f y) := by
    intro y hy
    apply hD y
    intro hDy
    exact hy (by simp [hDy])
  ext x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.range f
  · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
    change pushforward f (n • D) wy wx (f y) =
      n • pushforward f D wy wx (f y)
    rw [pushforward_apply_closedImmersion f (n • D) wy wx hmul y,
      pushforward_apply_closedImmersion f D wy wx hD y]
    rfl
  · rw [pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range f (n • D) wy wx x hx,
      show (n • pushforward f D wy wx) x = n • pushforward f D wy wx x by rfl,
      pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range f D wy wx x hx]
    simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.AlgebraicCycle.degree_pushforward_closedImmersion
statement:
theorem degree_pushforward_closedImmersion {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion f]
    (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (D : AlgebraicCycle Y ℤ)
    {N : Type*} [DecidableEq N] (wy : Y → N) (wx : X → N)
    (hgrade : ∀ y : Y, D y ≠ 0 → wy y = wx (f y))
    [∀ y : Y, IsScalarTower k ↑(X.residueField (f y)) ↑(Y.residueField y)] :
    degree k (pushforward f D wy wx) = degree k D
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [degree]
  let g : X → ℤ := fun x =>
    pushforward f D wy wx x * (Module.finrank k ↑(X.residueField x) : ℤ)
  let hfn : Y → ℤ := fun y =>
    D y * (Module.finrank k ↑(Y.residueField y) : ℤ)
  have hsupp : Function.support g ⊆ Set.range (fun y : Y ↦ f y) := by
    intro x hx
    by_contra hxrange
    have : g x = 0 := by
      simp [g, pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range f D wy wx x hxrange]
    exact hx this
  calc
    ∑ᶠ x : X, g x = ∑ᶠ x ∈ Set.univ, g x := (finsum_mem_univ g).symm
    _ = ∑ᶠ x ∈ Set.range (fun y : Y ↦ f y), g x :=
      finsum_mem_inter_support_eq' g Set.univ _ fun x hx => by
        simp only [Set.mem_univ, true_iff]
        exact hsupp hx
    _ = ∑ᶠ y : Y, g (f y) := finsum_mem_range f.isEmbedding.injective
    _ = ∑ᶠ y : Y, hfn y := by
      apply finsum_congr
      intro y
      simp only [g, hfn]
      rw [pushforward_apply_closedImmersion f D wy wx hgrade y,
        ← f.finrank_residueField_eq_of_isClosedImmersion k y]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ker_baseChangeTensor_eq_span
statement:
theorem ker_baseChangeTensor_eq_span
    {R S T : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
    [Algebra R S] [Algebra R T]
    (a : R) (h : RingHom.ker (algebraMap R T) = Ideal.span {a})
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (algebraMap R T)) :
    RingHom.ker (algebraMap S (S ⊗[R] T)) =
      Ideal.span {algebraMap R S a}
proof:
:= by
  let g : R →ₐ[R] T := Algebra.ofId R T
  let e : S ⊗[R] R ≃ₐ[S] S := Algebra.TensorProduct.rid R S S
  let m : S ⊗[R] R →ₐ[R] S ⊗[R] T :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id R S) g
  have hgker : RingHom.ker g.toRingHom = Ideal.span {a} := h
  have hm : RingHom.ker m.toRingHom =
      Ideal.span {Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight a} := by
    calc
      RingHom.ker m.toRingHom =
          Ideal.map Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (RingHom.ker g.toRingHom) := by
            dsimp [m]
            exact Algebra.TensorProduct.lTensor_ker g hsurj
      _ = Ideal.span {Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight a} := by
        rw [hgker, Ideal.map_span]
        congr 1
        ext x
        simp
  have hcomp : m.toRingHom.comp e.symm.toRingHom =
      algebraMap S (S ⊗[R] T) := by
    ext s
    simp [m, e, g, Algebra.TensorProduct.rid_symm_apply]
  rw [← hcomp, ← RingHom.comap_ker, hm]
  have himage : Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight a =
      e.symm (algebraMap R S a) := by
    simp only [Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply, e,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.rid_symm_apply]
    simpa using
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_one_eq_one_tmul (A := S) (B := R) a).symm
  rw [himage]
  have hspan : Ideal.span {e.symm (algebraMap R S a)} =
      Ideal.map e.symm.toRingHom (Ideal.span {algebraMap R S a}) := by
    rw [Ideal.map_span]
    simp
  rw [hspan]
  exact Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective _ e.symm.bijective

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.hasPrincipalKernel_baseChangeTensor
statement:
theorem hasPrincipalKernel_baseChangeTensor
    {R S T : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]

    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (algebraMap R T)) :
    HasPrincipalKernel (algebraMap S (S ⊗[R] T))
proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.hasPrincipalKernel_respectsIso
statement:
theorem hasPrincipalKernel_respectsIso :
    RingHom.RespectsIso (@HasPrincipalKernel)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro R S T _ _ _ f e hf
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hf
    exact ⟨a, (RingHom.ker_equiv_comp f e).trans ha⟩
  · intro R S T _ _ _ f e hf
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hf
    refine ⟨e.symm a, ?_⟩
    rw [← RingHom.comap_ker, ha]
    have hspan : Ideal.span {a} =
        Ideal.map e.toRingHom (Ideal.span {e.symm a}) := by
      rw [Ideal.map_span]
      simp
    rw [hspan]
    exact Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective _ e.bijective

statement:
theorem surjectivePrincipal_respectsIso :
    RingHom.RespectsIso (@SurjectivePrincipal)
proof:
:= by
  exact RingHom.surjective_respectsIso.and hasPrincipalKernel_respectsIso

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.surjectivePrincipal_isStableUnderBaseChange
statement:
theorem surjectivePrincipal_isStableUnderBaseChange :
    RingHom.IsStableUnderBaseChange (@SurjectivePrincipal)
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.IsStableUnderBaseChange.mk surjectivePrincipal_respectsIso
  intro R S T _ _ _ _ _ h
  exact ⟨RingHom.surjective_isStableUnderBaseChange.tensorProduct S h.1,
    hasPrincipalKernel_baseChangeTensor h.2 h.1⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.exists_eq_span_comap_equiv_iff
statement:
theorem exists_eq_span_comap_equiv_iff
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (e : R ≃+* S) (I : Ideal S) :
    (∃ a : R, I.comap e.toRingHom = Ideal.span {a}) ↔
      ∃ b : S, I = Ideal.span {b}
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
    refine ⟨e a, ?_⟩
    calc
      I = Ideal.map e.toRingHom (I.comap e.toRingHom) :=
        (Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective e.toRingHom e.surjective I).symm
      _ = Ideal.map e.toRingHom (Ideal.span {a}) := by rw [ha]
      _ = Ideal.span {e a} := by rw [Ideal.map_span]; simp
  · rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
    refine ⟨e.symm b, ?_⟩
    rw [hb]
    have hspan : Ideal.span {b} =
        Ideal.map e.toRingHom (Ideal.span {e.symm b}) := by
      rw [Ideal.map_span]
      simp
    rw [hspan]
    exact Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective _ e.bijective

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.IdealSheafData.exists_generator_comap_open_iff
statement:
theorem IdealSheafData.exists_generator_comap_open_iff
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (I : Y.IdealSheafData) (j : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] (U : X.affineOpens) :
    (∃ a : Γ(X, U), (I.comap j).ideal U = Ideal.span {a}) ↔
      ∃ b : Γ(Y, ↑(⟨j ''ᵁ U.1,
          U.2.image_of_isOpenImmersion j⟩ : Y.affineOpens)),
        I.ideal ⟨j ''ᵁ U.1, U.2.image_of_isOpenImmersion j⟩ = Ideal.span {b}
proof:
:= by
  rw [I.ideal_comap_of_isOpenImmersion j U]
  exact exists_eq_span_comap_equiv_iff
    (j.appIso U).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
    (I.ideal ⟨j ''ᵁ U.1, U.2.image_of_isOpenImmersion j⟩)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.IdealSheafData.exists_generator_comap_top_of_isAffine
statement:
theorem IdealSheafData.exists_generator_comap_top_of_isAffine
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] [IsAffine Y]
    (I : Y.IdealSheafData) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hI : ∃ a : Γ(Y, ⊤), I.ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top Y⟩ = Ideal.span {a}) :
    ∃ b : Γ(X, ⊤),
      (I.comap f).ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top X⟩ = Ideal.span {b}
proof:
:= by
  let i : I.subscheme ⟶ Y := I.subschemeι
  letI : IsAffine I.subscheme :=
    (IsClosedImmersion.isAffine_surjective_of_isAffine i).1
  have hiSurj : Function.Surjective i.appTop :=
    (IsClosedImmersion.isAffine_surjective_of_isAffine i).2
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hI
  have hiKer : RingHom.ker i.appTop.hom = Ideal.span {a} := by
    calc
      RingHom.ker i.appTop.hom =
          i.ker.ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top Y⟩ := by
            change RingHom.ker (i.app (⊤ : Y.Opens)).hom =
              i.ker.ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top Y⟩
            exact (i.ker_apply ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top Y⟩).symm
      _ = Ideal.span {a} := by simpa [i] using ha
  have hi : SurjectivePrincipal i.appTop.hom :=
    ⟨hiSurj, ⟨a, hiKer⟩⟩
  let P : MorphismProperty CommRingCat :=
    RingHom.toMorphismProperty (@SurjectivePrincipal)
  have hstable : P.IsStableUnderCobaseChange :=
    (RingHom.isStableUnderCobaseChange_toMorphismProperty_iff).2
      surjectivePrincipal_isStableUnderBaseChange
  have hpush : IsPushout f.appTop i.appTop
      (pullback.fst f i).appTop (pullback.snd f i).appTop :=
    isPushout_appTop_of_isPullback (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f i)
  have hp : SurjectivePrincipal (pullback.fst f i).appTop.hom :=
    hstable.of_isPushout hpush hi
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hp.2
  refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
  change (pullback.fst f I.subschemeι).ker.ideal
      ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top X⟩ = Ideal.span {b}
  rw [(pullback.fst f I.subschemeι).ker_apply]
  exact hb

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.IdealSheafIsLocallyPrincipal.comap
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨V, hfxV, a, ha⟩ := hI (f x)
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨U, hU, rfl⟩, hxU, hUV⟩ :=
    X.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open hfxV
      (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).isOpen
  let U' : X.affineOpens := ⟨U, hU⟩
  letI : IsAffine U'.1.toScheme := U'.2
  letI : IsAffine V.1.toScheme := V.2
  let g : U'.1.toScheme ⟶ V.1.toScheme := f.resLE V.1 U'.1 hUV
  let IV : V.1.toScheme.IdealSheafData := I.comap V.1.ι
  let topV : V.1.toScheme.affineOpens :=
    ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top V.1.toScheme⟩
  have hIV : ∃ c : Γ(V.1.toScheme, ⊤),
      IV.ideal topV = Ideal.span {c} := by
    apply (IdealSheafData.exists_generator_comap_open_iff I V.1.ι topV).2
    dsimp [topV]
    let W : Y.affineOpens :=
      ⟨V.1.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : V.1.toScheme.Opens),
        (isAffineOpen_top V.1.toScheme).image_of_isOpenImmersion V.1.ι⟩
    change ∃ b : Γ(Y, W), I.ideal W = Ideal.span {b}
    have hW : W = V := Subtype.ext V.1.ι_image_top
    rw [hW]
    exact ⟨a, ha⟩
  have hAffine : ∃ c : Γ(U'.1.toScheme, ⊤),
      (IV.comap g).ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top U'.1.toScheme⟩ =
        Ideal.span {c} :=
    IdealSheafData.exists_generator_comap_top_of_isAffine IV g hIV
  have hsheaf : IV.comap g = (I.comap f).comap U'.1.ι := by
    dsimp [IV, g]
    rw [← I.comap_comp, ← I.comap_comp, f.resLE_comp_ι]
  have hOpenTop : ∃ c : Γ(U'.1.toScheme, ⊤),
      ((I.comap f).comap U'.1.ι).ideal
        ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top U'.1.toScheme⟩ = Ideal.span {c} := by
    simpa [hsheaf] using hAffine
  let topU : U'.1.toScheme.affineOpens :=
    ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top U'.1.toScheme⟩
  have hUPrincipal :=
    (IdealSheafData.exists_generator_comap_open_iff
      (I.comap f) U'.1.ι topU).1
      (by simpa [topU] using hOpenTop)
  have hUPrincipal' : ∃ b : Γ(X, U'),
      (I.comap f).ideal U' = Ideal.span {b} := by
    dsimp [topU] at hUPrincipal
    let W : X.affineOpens :=
      ⟨U'.1.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : U'.1.toScheme.Opens),
        (isAffineOpen_top U'.1.toScheme).image_of_isOpenImmersion U'.1.ι⟩
    change ∃ b : Γ(X, W), (I.comap f).ideal W = Ideal.span {b} at hUPrincipal
    have hW : W = U' := Subtype.ext U'.1.ι_image_top
    rw [hW] at hUPrincipal
    exact hUPrincipal
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hUPrincipal'
  refine ⟨U', hxU, b, ?_⟩
  exact hb

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.isRegularLocalRing_of_codimension_two
statement:
theorem isRegularLocalRing_of_codimension_two
    (hreg : ∀ x : X, coheight x = 2 →
      IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (x : X) :
    IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)
proof:
:= by
  have hupper : coheight x ≤ 2 := by
    have h := (Order.coheight_le_krullDim x).trans
      (Order.KrullDimLE.krullDim_le (n := 2) (α := ↥X))
    have h' : (↑(coheight x) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ↑(2 : ℕ∞) := by
      simpa using h
    exact WithBot.coe_le_coe.mp h'
  by_cases hx₂ : coheight x = 2
  · exact hreg x hx₂
  · have hle_one : coheight x ≤ 1 :=
      ENat.lt_two_iff.mp (lt_of_le_of_ne hupper hx₂)
    rcases Order.le_one_iff.mp hle_one with hx | hx
    · have hxη : x = genericPoint X := by
        have hle : x ≤ genericPoint X := le_top
        exact ((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hle).antisymm
          (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp ((coheight_eq_zero.mp hx) hle))).eq.symm
      subst x
      change IsRegularLocalRing X.functionField
      infer_instance
    · letI := IsIntegralInCodimensionOne.stalk_domain x hx
      letI := IsRegularInCodimensionOne.stalk_dvr x hx
      infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.mem_genericPoints_pullback_pointClosures_of_snd_coheight_one
statement:
theorem mem_genericPoints_pullback_pointClosures_of_snd_coheight_one
    {x z : X} (hx : coheight x = 1) (hz : coheight z = 1) (hxz : x ≠ z)
    (w : (pullback (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) : Scheme.{u}))
    (hw : coheight (pullback.snd (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) w) = 1) :
    w ∈ genericPoints
      (pullback (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) : Scheme.{u})
proof:
:= by
  let toX :
      (pullback (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ X :=
    pullback.fst (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) ≫ pointClosureι x
  letI : IsClosedImmersion toX := by
    dsimp only [toX]
    infer_instance
  letI : CompactSpace
      (pullback (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) : Scheme.{u}) :=
    toX.isClosedEmbedding.compactSpace
  letI : IsNoetherian
      (pullback (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) : Scheme.{u}) :=
    { __ := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian toX }
  apply mem_genericPoints_of_isMax
  intro w' hww'
  have hsnd : pullback.snd (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) w ≤
      pullback.snd (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) w' :=
    Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr
      ((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hww').map
        (pullback.snd (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z)).continuous)
  by_cases heq : pullback.snd (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) w =
      pullback.snd (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) w'
  · have : w = w' :=
      (pullback.snd (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z)).isEmbedding.injective heq
    exact this.ge
  · have hsndlt : pullback.snd (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) w <
        pullback.snd (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) w' :=
      lt_of_le_not_ge hsnd fun hge ↦ heq
        ((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hge).antisymm
          (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hsnd)).eq
    have hzero : coheight
        (pullback.snd (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) w') = 0 := by
      have h := Order.coheight_add_one_le hsndlt
      rw [hw] at h
      exact Order.lt_one_iff.mp
        ((ENat.add_one_le_iff' (n := 1) (by simp)).mp h)
    have hgeneric :
        pullback.snd (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) w' =
          pointClosureGenericPoint z := by
      have hle := pointClosure_le_genericPoint
        (pullback.snd (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) w')
      exact ((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hle).antisymm
        (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp ((coheight_eq_zero.mp hzero) hle))).eq.symm
    have hxspec : x ⤳ z := by
      rw [specializes_iff_mem_closure, ← range_pointClosureι x]
      refine ⟨pullback.fst (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) w', ?_⟩
      calc
        pointClosureι x (pullback.fst (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) w') =
            pointClosureι z (pullback.snd (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) w') := by
          change
            (pullback.fst (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) ≫ pointClosureι x) w' =
              (pullback.snd (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) ≫ pointClosureι z) w'
          rw [pullback.condition]
        _ = z := by rw [hgeneric, pointClosureι_genericPoint]
    have hzxlt : z < x :=
      lt_of_le_not_ge (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr hxspec) fun hge ↦
        hxz (((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hge).antisymm hxspec).eq.symm)
    have hcontra := Order.coheight_add_one_le hzxlt
    rw [hx, hz] at hcontra
    norm_num at hcontra

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionPrimeIntersectionData.cycle_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range_x
statement:
theorem ExpectedCodimensionPrimeIntersectionData.cycle_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range_x

  apply ht

theorem mk_mul_mk
    (a b : ℚ)
    (x y : RationalCodimensionChow X 1)
    (z w : RationalCodimensionChow X 2) :
    mk D a x z * mk D b y w =
      mk D (a * b) (a • y + b • x)
        (a • w + b • z + D.rationalProduct x y)
proof:
:= by
  apply Unitization.ext
  · rfl
  · apply Prod.ext
    · simp
    · rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteClosedIntersectionData.intersectionNumber_eq_sum
statement:
@[simp]
theorem intersectionNumber_eq_sum [CompactSpace X] :
    d.intersectionNumber k = ∑ z : d.intersection,
      (d.localMultiplicity z : ℤ) * Module.finrank k (X.residueField (d.toX z))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change AlgebraicCycle.degree k
    (∑ z : d.intersection,
      Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single (d.toX z) (d.localMultiplicity z : ℤ)) = _
  have hsum : ∀ s : Finset d.intersection,
      AlgebraicCycle.degree k
        (∑ z ∈ s,
          Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single (d.toX z) (d.localMultiplicity z : ℤ)) =
        ∑ z ∈ s,
          (d.localMultiplicity z : ℤ) * Module.finrank k (X.residueField (d.toX z)) := by
    intro s
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp [AlgebraicCycle.degree]
    | @insert z s hz ih =>
        rw [Finset.sum_insert hz, Finset.sum_insert hz, AlgebraicCycle.degree_sum,
          AlgebraicCycle.degree_single, ih]
  simpa using hsum Finset.univ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteClosedIntersectionData.intersectionNumber_nonneg
statement: theorem intersectionNumber_nonneg [CompactSpace X] : 0 ≤ d.intersectionNumber k
proof:
:= by
  rw [d.intersectionNumber_eq_sum k]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun z _ =>
    mul_nonneg (Int.natCast_nonneg (d.localMultiplicity z))
      (Int.natCast_nonneg (Module.finrank k (X.residueField (d.toX z))))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteClosedIntersectionData.swap_intersectionNumber
statement:

proof:
:= by
  rw [intersectionNumber, intersectionNumber, d.swap_cycle]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteClosedIntersectionData.intersectionNumber_baseField
statement:
theorem intersectionNumber_baseField
    (k0 : Type u) [Field k0] [Algebra k k0]
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k0))] [FiniteDimensional k k0]
    [∀ x : X, IsScalarTower k k0 (X.residueField x)]
    [∀ x : X, FiniteDimensional k0 (X.residueField x)] :
    d.intersectionNumber k =
      (Module.finrank k k0 : ℤ) * d.intersectionNumber k0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [intersectionNumber, AlgebraicCycle.degree]
  calc
    (∑ᶠ x : X, d.cycle.1 x * (Module.finrank k (X.residueField x) : ℤ)) =
        ∑ᶠ x : X, (Module.finrank k k0 : ℤ) *
          (d.cycle.1 x * (Module.finrank k0 (X.residueField x) : ℤ)) := by
      apply finsum_congr
      intro x
      rw [(Module.finrank_mul_finrank k k0 (X.residueField x)).symm]
      push_cast
      ring
    _ = (Module.finrank k k0 : ℤ) *
        ∑ᶠ x : X, d.cycle.1 x *
          (Module.finrank k0 (X.residueField x) : ℤ) := by
      rw [mul_finsum]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity_mul
statement:
theorem localMultiplicity_mul {a b : X.presheaf.stalk y} (h : v ⤳ y)
    (hb : b ∉ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h) :
    localMultiplicity (a * b) h = localMultiplicity a h + localMultiplicity b h
proof:

  rw [map_mul]

  (Scheme.ord_algebraMap_eq_length_toNat hx c hc).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CartierIntersection.localCommutativity
statement:
theorem localCommutativity [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hy : coheight y ≤ 2) (a s : X.presheaf.stalk y) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hs : s ≠ 0)
    (hgood : ∀ q : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk y), q.IsPrime → a ∈ q → s ∈ q →
      q = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk y)) :
    ∑ᶠ x : {x : X // x ⤳ y},
        (if x.1 ≠ y ∧ s ∈ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes x.2 then
          Ring.ord (X.presheaf.stalk x.1) ((X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes x.2).hom s) *
            localMultiplicity a x.2
        else 0) =
      ∑ᶠ x : {x : X // x ⤳ y},
        (if x.1 ≠ y ∧ a ∈ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes x.2 then
          Ring.ord (X.presheaf.stalk x.1) ((X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes x.2).hom a) *
            localMultiplicity s x.2
        else 0)
proof:
:=
  SchemeLocalOrdSymmetry.scheme_localOrdSymmetry hy a s ha hs hgood

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SurfaceDegreeNormalization.sourcePrincipalDegree_eq_zero_of_normalizationComparison
statement:
theorem sourcePrincipalDegree_eq_zero_of_normalizationComparison
    [CompactSpace X] [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X 2)
    (d : NormalizationComparisonData k g) :
    letI : g.Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
proof:
:= relationSourceOver k g;
    AlgebraicCycle.degree k (div g.f) = 0 := by
  let N := normalizationSource g
  let ν : N ⟶ g.Y := SingularCurve.normalizationMorphism g.Y
  letI : g.Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := relationSourceOver k g
  letI : N.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := normalizationOver k g
  letI : IsFinite ν := d.finite
  letI : IsProper (N ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := by
    change IsProper (ν ≫ g.i ≫ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    infer_instance
  letI : CompactSpace N :=
    (quasiCompact_iff_compactSpace (N ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))).mp inferInstance
  letI : IsLocallyNoetherian N :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian ν
  letI : IsNoetherian N :=
    { toIsLocallyNoetherian := inferInstance
      toCompactSpace := inferInstance }
  letI : KrullDimLE 1 N := d.krullDimLE
  letI : IsRegularInCodimensionOne N := d.regularInCodimensionOne
  letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (N ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (ν ≫ g.i ≫ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    infer_instance
  have hfinite :
      (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.structureSheafModule N).HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic
        k :=
    d.structureSheafFinite
  have hnormal : AlgebraicCycle.degree k (div (pullbackFunction g)) = 0 :=
    SchemeBridge.degree_principal_eq_zero_of_structureSheaf_finite k hfinite
      (pullbackFunction g) (pullbackFunction_ne_zero g)
  exact d.principalDegreeComparison.trans hnormal

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SurfaceDegreeNormalization.codimensionTwoRelation_degree_eq_zero_of_normalizationComparison
statement:
theorem codimensionTwoRelation_degree_eq_zero_of_normalizationComparison
    [CompactSpace X] [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X 2)
    (d : NormalizationComparisonData k g) :
    codimensionCycleDegree (X := X) k 2 g.cycle = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI : g.Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := relationSourceOver k g
  rw [codimensionTwoRelation_degree_eq_source k g d.sourceResidueTower]
  exact sourcePrincipalDegree_eq_zero_of_normalizationComparison k g d

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SurfaceDegreeNormalization.surfaceDegreeDataOfNormalizationComparisons

  relation_degree_zero g
proof:
:=
    codimensionTwoRelation_degree_eq_zero_of_normalizationComparison k g (d.source g)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ker_localRingHom_quotient_span_singleton_idealComap
statement:
theorem ker_localRingHom_quotient_span_singleton_idealComap
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (a : R)
    (p : PrimeSpectrum (R ⧸ Ideal.span {a})) :
    RingHom.ker (Localization.localRingHom
      (p.asIdeal.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a}))) p.asIdeal
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a})) rfl) =
        Ideal.span {algebraMap R
          (Localization.AtPrime
            (p.asIdeal.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a})))) a}
proof:
:= by
  let φ : R →+* (R ⧸ Ideal.span {a}) := Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a})
  have hφ : Function.Surjective φ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hT : Submonoid.map φ (p.asIdeal.comap φ).primeCompl =
      p.asIdeal.primeCompl :=
    Ideal.map_primeCompl_comap_of_surjective φ hφ p.asIdeal
  change RingHom.ker (IsLocalization.map
    (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) φ
      (Localization.le_comap_primeCompl_iff.mpr le_rfl)) = _
  rw [IsLocalization.ker_map (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) φ hT]
  have hker : RingHom.ker φ = Ideal.span {a} := Ideal.mk_ker
  rw [hker, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ker_localRingHom_quotient_span_singleton
statement:
theorem ker_localRingHom_quotient_span_singleton
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (a : R)
    (p : PrimeSpectrum (R ⧸ Ideal.span {a})) :
    RingHom.ker (Localization.localRingHom
      (p.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a}))).asIdeal p.asIdeal
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a})) rfl) =
        Ideal.span {algebraMap R
          (Localization.AtPrime
            (p.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a}))).asIdeal) a}
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal] using
    ker_localRingHom_quotient_span_singleton_idealComap a p

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.stalkMap_affineStalkElement
statement:
theorem stalkMap_affineStalkElement
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (a : R) (p : PrimeSpectrum S) :
    ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)).stalkMap p).hom
        (affineStalkElement a (p.comap f)) =
      affineStalkElement (f a) p
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Scheme.localRingHom_comp_stalkIso]
  change (Spec.stalkIso (.of S) p).inv.hom
      (Localization.localRingHom (p.comap f).asIdeal p.asIdeal f rfl
        ((Spec.stalkIso (.of R) (p.comap f)).hom.hom
          (affineStalkElement a (p.comap f)))) =
    affineStalkElement (f a) p
  simp [affineStalkElement]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.stalkCongr_affineStalkElement
statement:
theorem stalkCongr_affineStalkElement
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (a : R) {p q : PrimeSpectrum R} (h : p = q) :
    ((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq h)).hom
        (affineStalkElement a p) = affineStalkElement a q
proof:
:= by
  subst q
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ker_stalkMap_Spec_quotient_span_singleton
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_Spec_quotient_span_singleton
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (a : R)
    (p : PrimeSpectrum (R ⧸ Ideal.span {a})) :
    RingHom.ker ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a})))).stalkMap p).hom =
        Ideal.span {principalQuotientStalkElement a p}
proof:
:= by
  let φ : R →+* (R ⧸ Ideal.span {a}) := Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a})
  let q : PrimeSpectrum R := p.comap φ
  let eR : ((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.stalk q) ≃+*
      Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal :=
    (Spec.stalkIso (.of R) q).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  rw [← Scheme.localRingHom_comp_stalkIso]
  change RingHom.ker
      ((Spec.stalkIso (.of (R ⧸ Ideal.span {a})) p).inv.hom.comp
        ((Localization.localRingHom q.asIdeal p.asIdeal φ rfl).comp
          (Spec.stalkIso (.of R) q).hom.hom)) = _
  have hinj : Function.Injective
      (Spec.stalkIso (.of (R ⧸ Ideal.span {a})) p).inv.hom :=
    (Spec.stalkIso (.of (R ⧸ Ideal.span {a})) p).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.injective
  rw [RingHom.ker_comp_of_injective _ hinj]
  rw [← RingHom.comap_ker]
  dsimp only [q, φ]
  rw [ker_localRingHom_quotient_span_singleton a p]
  change (Ideal.span {algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) a}).comap
    eR.toRingHom = Ideal.span {principalQuotientStalkElement a p}
  calc
    _ = (Ideal.span {algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) a}).map eR.symm := by
      exact (Ideal.map_symm eR).symm
    _ = Ideal.span {eR.symm (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) a)} := by
      rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
    _ = Ideal.span {principalQuotientStalkElement a p} := by
      rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.principalQuotientStalkElement_ne_zero
statement:
theorem principalQuotientStalkElement_ne_zero
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] (a : R) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (p : PrimeSpectrum (R ⧸ Ideal.span {a})) :
    principalQuotientStalkElement a p ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (map_ne_zero_iff _
    ((Spec.stalkIso (.of R)
      (p.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a})))).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.injective)).mpr
  exact (map_ne_zero_iff _
    (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R
      (Localization.AtPrime
        (p.asIdeal.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a})))))).mpr ha

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.morphismLocalLength_Spec_quotient_span_singleton
statement:
theorem morphismLocalLength_Spec_quotient_span_singleton
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (a : R)
    (p : PrimeSpectrum (R ⧸ Ideal.span {a})) :
    morphismLocalLength (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a})))) p =
      Module.length ((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.stalk
        (p.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a}))))
        (((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.stalk
          (p.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a})))) ⧸
            Ideal.span {principalQuotientStalkElement a p})
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsClosedImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a})))) :=
    IsClosedImmersion.spec_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  exact morphismLocalLength_eq_length_principalQuotient
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a})))) p
      (principalQuotientStalkElement a p)
      (ker_stalkMap_Spec_quotient_span_singleton a p)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.div_principalQuotientStalkElement_eq_morphismLocalLength_toNat
statement:
theorem div_principalQuotientStalkElement_eq_morphismLocalLength_toNat
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (a : R) (ha : a ≠ 0) (p : PrimeSpectrum (R ⧸ Ideal.span {a}))
    (hp : coheight ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a})))) p) = 1) :
    div (algebraMap
      ((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.stalk
        (p.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a}))))
      (Spec (.of R)).functionField (principalQuotientStalkElement a p))
        (p.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a}))) =
      ((morphismLocalLength (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a})))) p).toNat : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsClosedImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a})))) :=
    IsClosedImmersion.spec_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  exact div_algebraMap_eq_morphismLocalLength_toNat
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a})))) p hp
      (principalQuotientStalkElement a p)
      (principalQuotientStalkElement_ne_zero a ha p)
      (ker_stalkMap_Spec_quotient_span_singleton a p)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.surfacePointClosureRelation_cycle_eq_finset_sum
statement:
theorem surfacePointClosureRelation_cycle_eq_finset_sum
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [Order.KrullDimLE 2 X]
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (z : CodimensionPoint X 1)
    (f : (pointClosureScheme z.1).functionField) (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (factor : ι → (pointClosureScheme z.1).functionField)
    (hfactor : ∀ i, factor i ≠ 0) (exponent : ι → ℤ)
    (hproduct : f = ∏ i ∈ s, factor i ^ exponent i) :
    (surfacePointClosureRelation z f hf).cycle =
      ∑ i ∈ s, exponent i •
        (surfacePointClosureRelation z (factor i) (hfactor i)).cycle
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext t
  by_cases ht : t ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι z.1)
  · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := ht
    have hleft : (surfacePointClosureRelation z f hf).cycle.1
        (pointClosureι z.1 y) = div f y := by
      have h := RationalRelationGenerator.cycle_apply_i
        (surfacePointClosureRelation z f hf) y
      change (surfacePointClosureRelation z f hf).cycle.1
        (pointClosureι z.1 y) = div f y at h
      exact h
    have hterm : ∀ i,
        (exponent i •
          (surfacePointClosureRelation z (factor i) (hfactor i)).cycle).1
            (pointClosureι z.1 y) = exponent i • div (factor i) y := by
      intro i
      change exponent i •
          (surfacePointClosureRelation z (factor i) (hfactor i)).cycle.1
            (pointClosureι z.1 y) = exponent i • div (factor i) y
      have h := RationalRelationGenerator.cycle_apply_i
        (surfacePointClosureRelation z (factor i) (hfactor i)) y
      change (surfacePointClosureRelation z (factor i) (hfactor i)).cycle.1
        (pointClosureι z.1 y) = div (factor i) y at h
      rw [h]
    rw [hleft]
    simp only [AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum,
      Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
    simp_rw [hterm]
    have hdiv := congrArg
      (fun D : AlgebraicCycle (pointClosureScheme z.1) ℤ ↦ D y)
      (div_finset_prod_zpow s factor (fun i _ ↦ hfactor i) exponent)
    rw [hproduct]
    exact hdiv.trans (by
      simp only [Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply,
        Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_zsmul, Pi.smul_apply])
  · rw [RationalRelationGenerator.cycle_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range]
    · symm
      simp only [AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum,
        Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro i hi
      change exponent i *
          (surfacePointClosureRelation z (factor i) (hfactor i)).cycle.1 t = 0
      rw [RationalRelationGenerator.cycle_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range]
      · exact mul_zero _
      · intro hmem
        obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hmem
        apply ht
        exact ⟨x, by
          change (pointClosureι z.1) x = t at hx
          exact hx⟩
    · exact ht

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProperCycleIntersectionData.cycle_eq_sum_primeCycle
statement:
theorem ProperCycleIntersectionData.cycle_eq_sum_primeCycle
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] {p q : ℕ}
    {D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ p} (z : CodimensionPoint X q)
    (d : ProperCycleIntersectionData X p q D (primeCycle z.1 q z.2)) :
    d.cycle = ∑ x : (compactCycleFinsupp D.1).support,
      compactCycleFinsupp D.1 x •
        (d.pair x (primeCycleSupportPoint z)).cycle
proof:
:= by
  let y0 := primeCycleSupportPoint z
  letI : Unique
      ((compactCycleFinsupp (primeCycle z.1 q z.2).1).support) :=
    { default := y0
      uniq := fun y ↦ by
        apply Subtype.ext
        by_contra h
        have hy := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp y.2
        rw [compactCycleFinsupp_apply,
          primeCycle_apply_of_ne z.1 y.1 q z.2 h] at hy
        exact hy rfl }
  simp only [ProperCycleIntersectionData.cycle, Fintype.sum_unique]
  apply Fintype.sum_congr
  intro x
  have hy : ((default :
      (compactCycleFinsupp (primeCycle z.1 q z.2).1).support) : X) = z.1 := by
    by_contra h
    have hdefault := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp
      (default : (compactCycleFinsupp (primeCycle z.1 q z.2).1).support).2
    rw [compactCycleFinsupp_apply,
      primeCycle_apply_of_ne z.1
        (default : (compactCycleFinsupp
          (primeCycle z.1 q z.2).1).support).1 q z.2 h] at hdefault
    exact hdefault rfl
  rw [compactCycleFinsupp_apply, hy, compactCycleFinsupp_apply,
    primeCycle_apply_same, mul_one]
  congr 1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.expectedIntersectionCycle_eq_sum_primeCycle
statement:
theorem expectedIntersectionCycle_eq_sum_primeCycle
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] {p q : ℕ}
    {D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ p} (z : CodimensionPoint X q)
    (h : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D (primeCycle z.1 q z.2)) :
    expectedIntersectionCycle h =
      ∑ x : (compactCycleFinsupp D.1).support,
        compactCycleFinsupp D.1 x •
          (expectedPrimeIntersectionData h x (primeCycleSupportPoint z)).cycle
proof:
:= by
  let y0 := primeCycleSupportPoint z
  letI : Unique
      ((compactCycleFinsupp (primeCycle z.1 q z.2).1).support) :=
    { default := y0
      uniq := fun y ↦ by
        apply Subtype.ext
        by_contra hne
        have hy := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp y.2
        rw [compactCycleFinsupp_apply,
          primeCycle_apply_of_ne z.1 y.1 q z.2 hne] at hy
        exact hy rfl }
  simp only [expectedIntersectionCycle, Fintype.sum_unique]
  apply Fintype.sum_congr
  intro x
  have hy : ((default :
      (compactCycleFinsupp (primeCycle z.1 q z.2).1).support) : X) = z.1 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hdefault := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp
      (default : (compactCycleFinsupp (primeCycle z.1 q z.2).1).support).2
    rw [compactCycleFinsupp_apply,
      primeCycle_apply_of_ne z.1
        (default : (compactCycleFinsupp
          (primeCycle z.1 q z.2).1).support).1 q z.2 hne] at hdefault
    exact hdefault rfl
  rw [compactCycleFinsupp_apply, hy, compactCycleFinsupp_apply,

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalRelationGenerator.cyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_primeCycle_of_apply_eq_zero
statement:
theorem RationalRelationGenerator.cyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_primeCycle_of_apply_eq_zero
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [Order.KrullDimLE 2 X]
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X 1) (z : CodimensionPoint X 1)
    (hcycle : g.cycle.1 z.1 = 0) :
    CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension g.cycle (primeCycle z.1 1 z.2)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy
  have hyz : y = z.1 := by
    by_contra hne
    rw [primeCycle_apply_of_ne z.1 y 1 z.2 hne] at hy
    exact hy rfl
  subst y
  apply primeCyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_one_one_of_ne
    x z.1 (g.cycle.2 hx) z.2
  intro hxz

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension.rightPrimeMeeting
statement:
theorem CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension.rightPrimeMeeting
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] {p q : ℕ}
    {D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ p} {E : CodimensionCycles X ℤ q}
    (h : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D E)
    (y : (compactCycleFinsupp E.1).support) :
    CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D
      (primeCycle y.1 q (E.2 (by
        change E.1 y.1 ≠ 0
        simpa only [compactCycleFinsupp_apply] using
          Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp y.2)))
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx z hz
  have hzy : z = y.1 := by
    by_contra hne
    rw [primeCycle_apply_of_ne y.1 z q _ hne] at hz
    exact hz rfl
  subst z
  apply h x hx y.1
  simpa only [compactCycleFinsupp_apply] using
    Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp y.2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.expectedIntersectionCycle_eq_sum_right_primeCycle
statement:
theorem expectedIntersectionCycle_eq_sum_right_primeCycle
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] {p q : ℕ}
    {D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ p} {E : CodimensionCycles X ℤ q}
    (h : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D E) :
    expectedIntersectionCycle h =
      ∑ y : (compactCycleFinsupp E.1).support,
        compactCycleFinsupp E.1 y •
          expectedIntersectionCycle (h.rightPrimeMeeting y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [expectedIntersectionCycle]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Fintype.sum_congr
  intro y
  let hy : coheight y.1 = q := E.2 (by
    change E.1 y.1 ≠ 0
    simpa only [compactCycleFinsupp_apply] using
      Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp y.2)
  let z : CodimensionPoint X q := ⟨y.1, hy⟩
  rw [expectedIntersectionCycle_eq_sum_primeCycle z (h.rightPrimeMeeting y)]
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Fintype.sum_congr
  intro x
  have hdata : expectedPrimeIntersectionData (h.rightPrimeMeeting y) x
      (primeCycleSupportPoint z) = expectedPrimeIntersectionData h x y := by
    apply ExpectedCodimensionPrimeIntersectionData.eq_of_points_eq
    · rfl
    · rfl
  rw [hdata, smul_smul]
  rw [mul_comm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SurfaceRestrictionFactorizationData.restriction_cycle_eq_intersection_cycle
proof:
:= by
  let r := g.surfaceRestrictionRelationAtOfCyclesMeetProperly hg z hproper
  calc
    r.cycle = (surfacePointClosureRelation z r.f r.hf).cycle := by rfl
    _ = ∑ x : (compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1).support,
        compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1 x •
        (surfacePointClosureRelation z (P.factor x) (P.factor_ne_zero x)).cycle := by

          (Finset.univ : Finset (compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1).support)

        (P.properData.pair x (primeCycleSupportPoint z)).cycle := by
      apply Fintype.sum_congr

      (P.properData.cycle_eq_sum_primeCycle z).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SurfaceExpectedRestrictionFactorizationData.restriction_cycle_eq_expectedIntersectionCycle
statement:
theorem restriction_cycle_eq_expectedIntersectionCycle
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNoetherian X]
    [IsRegularInCodimensionOne X] [Order.KrullDimLE 2 X]
    {g : RationalRelationGenerator X 1} {hg : g.cycle ≠ 0}
    {z : CodimensionPoint X 1} {hcycle : g.cycle.1 z.1 = 0}
    (P : SurfaceExpectedRestrictionFactorizationData g hg z hcycle) :
    (g.surfaceRestrictionRelationAt hg z hcycle).cycle =
      expectedIntersectionCycle
        (g.cyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_primeCycle_of_apply_eq_zero z hcycle)
proof:
:= by
  let r := g.surfaceRestrictionRelationAt hg z hcycle
  let hmeeting :=
    g.cyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_primeCycle_of_apply_eq_zero z hcycle
  calc
    r.cycle = (surfacePointClosureRelation z r.f r.hf).cycle := by rfl
    _ = ∑ x : (compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1).support,
        compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1 x •
        (surfacePointClosureRelation z (P.factor x) (P.factor_ne_zero x)).cycle := by
      simpa [r] using
        (surfacePointClosureRelation_cycle_eq_finset_sum
          (Finset.univ : Finset (compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1).support)
          z r.f r.hf P.factor P.factor_ne_zero
          (fun x ↦ compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1 x) P.function_eq)
    _ = ∑ x : (compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1).support,
        compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1 x •
        (expectedPrimeIntersectionData hmeeting x
          (primeCycleSupportPoint z)).cycle := by
      apply Fintype.sum_congr
      intro x
      rw [P.factor_cycle_eq x]
    _ = expectedIntersectionCycle hmeeting :=
      (expectedIntersectionCycle_eq_sum_primeCycle z hmeeting).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SurfaceExpectedRestrictionTheory.relation_expectedIntersectionCycle_mem_rationalEquivalenceSubgroup
statement:
theorem relation_expectedIntersectionCycle_mem_rationalEquivalenceSubgroup
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNoetherian X]
    [IsRegularInCodimensionOne X] [Order.KrullDimLE 2 X]
    (T : SurfaceExpectedRestrictionTheory X)
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X 1) (E : CodimensionCycles X ℤ 1)
    (h : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension g.cycle E) :
    expectedIntersectionCycle h ∈ rationalEquivalenceSubgroup X 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hg : g.cycle = 0
  · letI : IsEmpty ((compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1).support) :=
      ⟨fun x ↦ by
        have hx := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp x.2
        rw [compactCycleFinsupp_apply] at hx
        have hx0 : g.cycle.1 x.1 = 0 := by
          simpa using congrArg
            (fun c : CodimensionCycles X ℤ 1 ↦ c.1 x.1) hg
        exact hx hx0⟩
    have hzero : expectedIntersectionCycle h = 0 := by
      rw [expectedIntersectionCycle]
      simp
    rw [hzero]
    exact AddSubgroup.zero_mem _
  · rw [expectedIntersectionCycle_eq_sum_right_primeCycle h]
    apply AddSubgroup.sum_mem _
    intro y hy
    let hz : coheight y.1 = 1 := E.2 (by
      change E.1 y.1 ≠ 0
      simpa only [compactCycleFinsupp_apply] using
        Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp y.2)
    let z : CodimensionPoint X 1 := ⟨y.1, hz⟩
    let hyMeeting := h.rightPrimeMeeting y
    have hcycle : g.cycle.1 z.1 = 0 :=
      cycle_apply_eq_zero_of_cyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_primeCycle
        g.cycle z hyMeeting
    let P := T.factorization g hg z hcycle
    apply AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem _ _
    have hm := P.expectedIntersectionCycle_mem_rationalEquivalenceSubgroup
    have heq : expectedIntersectionCycle hyMeeting =
        expectedIntersectionCycle
          (g.cyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_primeCycle_of_apply_eq_zero z hcycle) :=
      expectedIntersectionCycle_proof_irrel _ _
    rw [heq]
    exact hm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SurfaceExpectedRestrictionTheory.expectedIntersectionCycle_relation_mem_rationalEquivalenceSubgroup
statement:
theorem expectedIntersectionCycle_relation_mem_rationalEquivalenceSubgroup
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNoetherian X]
    [IsRegularInCodimensionOne X] [Order.KrullDimLE 2 X]
    (T : SurfaceExpectedRestrictionTheory X)
    (D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ 1) (g : RationalRelationGenerator X 1)
    (h : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D g.cycle) :
    expectedIntersectionCycle h ∈ rationalEquivalenceSubgroup X 2
proof:
:= by
  have hm := T.relation_expectedIntersectionCycle_mem_rationalEquivalenceSubgroup
    g D h.symm
  have heq : expectedIntersectionCycle h.symm = expectedIntersectionCycle h := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact expectedIntersectionCycle_symm h
  rw [heq] at hm
  exact hm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ker_eq_span_singleton_of_equiv_commutes
statement:
theorem ker_eq_span_singleton_of_equiv_commutes
    {A B C D : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C] [CommRing D]
    (f : A →+* B) (g : C →+* D) (eA : A ≃+* C) (eB : B ≃+* D)
    (h : eB.toRingHom.comp f = g.comp eA.toRingHom)
    (a : A) (hf : RingHom.ker f = Ideal.span {a}) :
    RingHom.ker g = Ideal.span {eA a}
proof:
:= by
  calc
    RingHom.ker g = (RingHom.ker f).map eA := by
      ext c
      rw [Ideal.mem_map_of_equiv]
      constructor
      · intro hc
        refine ⟨eA.symm c, ?_, eA.apply_symm_apply c⟩
        rw [RingHom.mem_ker]
        apply eB.injective
        rw [map_zero]
        calc
          eB (f (eA.symm c)) = g (eA (eA.symm c)) :=
            DFunLike.congr_fun h (eA.symm c)
          _ = g c := by rw [eA.apply_symm_apply]
          _ = 0 := RingHom.mem_ker.mp hc
      · rintro ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
        rw [RingHom.mem_ker]
        calc
          g (eA b) = eB (f b) := (DFunLike.congr_fun h b).symm
          _ = 0 := by rw [RingHom.mem_ker.mp hb, map_zero]
    _ = Ideal.span {eA a} := by
      rw [hf, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ker_eq_span_singleton_of_equiv_commutes_symm
statement:
theorem ker_eq_span_singleton_of_equiv_commutes_symm
    {A B C D : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C] [CommRing D]
    (f : A →+* B) (g : C →+* D) (eA : A ≃+* C) (eB : B ≃+* D)
    (h : eB.toRingHom.comp f = g.comp eA.toRingHom)
    (c : C) (hg : RingHom.ker g = Ideal.span {c}) :
    RingHom.ker f = Ideal.span {eA.symm c}
proof:
:= by
  apply ker_eq_span_singleton_of_equiv_commutes g f eA.symm eB.symm _ c hg
  ext x
  apply eB.injective
  calc
    eB (eB.symm (g x)) = g x := eB.apply_symm_apply (g x)
    _ = g (eA (eA.symm x)) := by rw [eA.apply_symm_apply]
    _ = eB (f (eA.symm x)) :=
      (DFunLike.congr_fun h (eA.symm x)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.stalkMap_square_of_arrow_iso
statement:
theorem stalkMap_square_of_arrow_iso
    {Z X Z' X' : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) (j : Z' ⟶ X')
    (eZ : Z ≅ Z') (eX : X ≅ X')
    (h : eZ.hom ≫ j = i ≫ eX.hom) (z : Z) :
    j.stalkMap (eZ.hom z) ≫ (sourceStalkIsoOfArrowIso eZ z).hom =
      (targetStalkIsoOfArrowIso i j eZ eX h z).hom ≫ i.stalkMap z
proof:
:= by
  change j.stalkMap (eZ.hom z) ≫ eZ.hom.stalkMap z =
    (X'.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (by
      change (eZ.hom ≫ j) z = (i ≫ eX.hom) z
      rw [h]))).hom ≫ eX.hom.stalkMap (i z) ≫ i.stalkMap z
  calc
    j.stalkMap (eZ.hom z) ≫ eZ.hom.stalkMap z =
        (eZ.hom ≫ j).stalkMap z :=
      (Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp eZ.hom j z).symm
    _ = (X'.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (h ▸ rfl))).hom ≫
        (i ≫ eX.hom).stalkMap z :=
      Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_congr_hom (eZ.hom ≫ j) (i ≫ eX.hom) h z
    _ = (X'.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (h ▸ rfl))).hom ≫
        (eX.hom.stalkMap (i z) ≫ i.stalkMap z) := by
      rw [Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp]
    _ = ((X'.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (h ▸ rfl))).hom ≫
        eX.hom.stalkMap (i z)) ≫ i.stalkMap z :=
      (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ker_stalkMap_eq_span_of_arrow_iso
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_eq_span_of_arrow_iso
    {Z X Z' X' : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) (j : Z' ⟶ X')
    (eZ : Z ≅ Z') (eX : X ≅ X')
    (h : eZ.hom ≫ j = i ≫ eX.hom) (z : Z)
    (a : X'.presheaf.stalk (j (eZ.hom z)))
    (hker : RingHom.ker (j.stalkMap (eZ.hom z)).hom = Ideal.span {a}) :
    RingHom.ker (i.stalkMap z).hom =
      Ideal.span {principalStalkElementOfArrowIso i j eZ eX h z a}
proof:
:= by
  apply ker_eq_span_singleton_of_equiv_commutes
    (j.stalkMap (eZ.hom z)).hom (i.stalkMap z).hom
    (targetStalkIsoOfArrowIso i j eZ eX h z).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
    (sourceStalkIsoOfArrowIso eZ z).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
    _ a hker
  change ((j.stalkMap (eZ.hom z)) ≫
    (sourceStalkIsoOfArrowIso eZ z).hom).hom =
      ((targetStalkIsoOfArrowIso i j eZ eX h z).hom ≫
        i.stalkMap z).hom
  exact congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom
    (stalkMap_square_of_arrow_iso i j eZ eX h z)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ker_stalkMap_pullback_snd_eq_span_of_symmetry
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_pullback_snd_eq_span_of_symmetry
    {Z X Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (z : (pullback i f : Scheme.{u}))
    (a : X.presheaf.stalk
      (pullback.fst f i ((pullbackSymmetry i f).hom z)))
    (hker : RingHom.ker
      ((pullback.fst f i).stalkMap ((pullbackSymmetry i f).hom z)).hom =
        Ideal.span {a}) :
    RingHom.ker ((pullback.snd i f).stalkMap z).hom =
      Ideal.span {principalStalkElementOfPullbackSymmetry i f z a}
proof:
:= by
  exact ker_stalkMap_eq_span_of_arrow_iso
    (pullback.snd i f) (pullback.fst f i)
    (pullbackSymmetry i f) (Iso.refl X) (by
      simpa using pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_fst i f) z a hker

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.stalkCongr_comp_apply_of_eq
statement:
theorem stalkCongr_comp_apply_of_eq
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {p q r s : X}
    (hpq : p = q) (hqr : q = r) (hrs : r = s) (hps : p = s)
    (a : X.presheaf.stalk p) :
    (X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hrs)).hom
        ((X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hqr)).hom
          ((X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hpq)).hom a)) =
      (X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hps)).hom a
proof:
:= by
  subst q
  subst r
  subst s
  simp
