name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.stalkMap_inv_naturality_of_point_eq
statement:
theorem stalkMap_inv_naturality_of_point_eq
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) {p q : X} (h : p = q)
    [IsIso (f.stalkMap p)] [IsIso (f.stalkMap q)]
    (a : X.presheaf.stalk p) :
    (asIso (f.stalkMap q)).inv.hom
        ((X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq h)).hom a) =
      (Y.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (congrArg f h))).hom
        ((asIso (f.stalkMap p)).inv.hom a)
proof:
:= by
  apply (asIso (f.stalkMap q)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.injective
  change (asIso (f.stalkMap q)).hom.hom
      ((asIso (f.stalkMap q)).inv.hom
        ((X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq h)).hom a)) =
    (asIso (f.stalkMap q)).hom.hom
      ((Y.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (congrArg f h))).hom
        ((asIso (f.stalkMap p)).inv.hom a))
  rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_apply]
  have hpoint := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_congr_point f p q h)
      ((asIso (f.stalkMap p)).inv.hom a)
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hpoint
  have hp : (f.stalkMap p).hom ((asIso (f.stalkMap p)).inv.hom a) = a := by
    change (asIso (f.stalkMap p)).hom.hom
      ((asIso (f.stalkMap p)).inv.hom a) = a
    exact (asIso (f.stalkMap p)).inv_hom_id_apply a
  rw [hp] at hpoint
  exact hpoint

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.pullbackSymmetryBaseChangeStalkElement_eq
statement:
theorem pullbackSymmetryBaseChangeStalkElement_eq
    {Z X Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (z : (pullback i f : Scheme.{u}))
    (a : Y.presheaf.stalk (i (pullback.fst i f z))) :
    pullbackSymmetryBaseChangeStalkElement i f z a =
      pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkElement i f z a
proof:
:= by
  have hZ : pullback.fst i f z =
      pullback.snd f i ((pullbackSymmetry i f).hom z) := by
    change pullback.fst i f z =
      ((pullbackSymmetry i f).hom ≫ pullback.snd f i) z
    rw [pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_snd]
  have hX : pullback.fst f i ((pullbackSymmetry i f).hom z) =
      pullback.snd i f z := by
    change ((pullbackSymmetry i f).hom ≫ pullback.fst f i) z =
      pullback.snd i f z
    rw [pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_fst]
  have hSwap :
      i (pullback.snd f i ((pullbackSymmetry i f).hom z)) =
        f (pullback.fst f i ((pullbackSymmetry i f).hom z)) := by
    change (pullback.snd f i ≫ i) ((pullbackSymmetry i f).hom z) =
      (pullback.fst f i ≫ f) ((pullbackSymmetry i f).hom z)
    rw [pullback.condition]
  have hOriginal : i (pullback.fst i f z) = f (pullback.snd i f z) := by
    change (pullback.fst i f ≫ i) z = (pullback.snd i f ≫ f) z
    rw [pullback.condition]
  let b := (Y.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hSwap)).hom
    ((Y.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (congrArg i hZ))).hom a)
  have hpointMap :
      (X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hX)).hom
          ((f.stalkMap
            (pullback.fst f i ((pullbackSymmetry i f).hom z))).hom b) =
        (f.stalkMap (pullback.snd i f z)).hom
          ((Y.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (congrArg f hX))).hom b) := by
    simpa only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] using
      ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
        (Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_congr_point f
          (pullback.fst f i ((pullbackSymmetry i f).hom z))
          (pullback.snd i f z) hX) b
  have hambient :
      (Y.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (congrArg f hX))).hom b =
        (Y.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hOriginal)).hom a := by
    exact stalkCongr_comp_apply_of_eq Y
      (congrArg i hZ) hSwap (congrArg f hX) hOriginal a
  change
    ((Iso.refl X).hom.stalkMap (pullback.snd i f z)).hom
        ((X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hX)).hom
          ((f.stalkMap
            (pullback.fst f i ((pullbackSymmetry i f).hom z))).hom b)) =
      (f.stalkMap (pullback.snd i f z)).hom
        ((Y.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hOriginal)).hom a)
  calc
    _ = (X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hX)).hom
          ((f.stalkMap
            (pullback.fst f i ((pullbackSymmetry i f).hom z))).hom b) := by
      change ((𝟙 X : X ⟶ X).stalkMap (pullback.snd i f z)).hom _ = _
      rw [Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_id]
      rfl
    _ = (f.stalkMap (pullback.snd i f z)).hom
          ((Y.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (congrArg f hX))).hom b) :=
      hpointMap
    _ = _ := congrArg
      (fun y ↦ (f.stalkMap (pullback.snd i f z)).hom y) hambient

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ker_stalkMap_pullback_snd_eq_span_pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkElement_of_symmetry
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_pullback_snd_eq_span_pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkElement_of_symmetry
    {Z X Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (z : (pullback i f : Scheme.{u}))
    (a : Y.presheaf.stalk (i (pullback.fst i f z)))
    (hker : RingHom.ker
      ((pullback.fst f i).stalkMap ((pullbackSymmetry i f).hom z)).hom =
        Ideal.span {
          pullbackBaseChangeStalkElement f i ((pullbackSymmetry i f).hom z)
            (pullbackSymmetryAmbientStalkElement i f z a)}) :
    RingHom.ker ((pullback.snd i f).stalkMap z).hom =
      Ideal.span {pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkElement i f z a}
proof:
:= by
  rw [ker_stalkMap_pullback_snd_eq_span_of_symmetry i f z
    (pullbackBaseChangeStalkElement f i ((pullbackSymmetry i f).hom z)
      (pullbackSymmetryAmbientStalkElement i f z a)) hker]
  change Ideal.span {pullbackSymmetryBaseChangeStalkElement i f z a} = _
  rw [pullbackSymmetryBaseChangeStalkElement_eq]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.stalkMap_square_of_isIso_stalkMaps
statement:
theorem stalkMap_square_of_isIso_stalkMaps
    {Z X Z' X' : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) (j : Z' ⟶ X')
    (s : Z' ⟶ Z) (t : X' ⟶ X) (h : s ≫ i = j ≫ t) (z : Z')
    [IsIso (s.stalkMap z)] [IsIso (t.stalkMap (j z))] :
    i.stalkMap (s z) ≫ (sourceStalkIsoOfIsIsoSquare s z).hom =
      (targetStalkIsoOfIsIsoSquare i j s t h z).hom ≫ j.stalkMap z
proof:
:= by
  change i.stalkMap (s z) ≫ s.stalkMap z =
    (X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (by
      change (s ≫ i) z = (j ≫ t) z
      rw [h]))).hom ≫ t.stalkMap (j z) ≫ j.stalkMap z
  calc
    i.stalkMap (s z) ≫ s.stalkMap z = (s ≫ i).stalkMap z :=
      (Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp s i z).symm
    _ = (X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (h ▸ rfl))).hom ≫
        (j ≫ t).stalkMap z :=
      Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_congr_hom (s ≫ i) (j ≫ t) h z
    _ = (X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (h ▸ rfl))).hom ≫
        (t.stalkMap (j z) ≫ j.stalkMap z) := by
      rw [Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp]
    _ = ((X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (h ▸ rfl))).hom ≫
        t.stalkMap (j z)) ≫ j.stalkMap z :=
      (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.stalkMap_principalStalkElementOfIsIsoSquare
statement:
theorem stalkMap_principalStalkElementOfIsIsoSquare
    {Z X Z' X' : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) (j : Z' ⟶ X')
    (s : Z' ⟶ Z) (t : X' ⟶ X) (h : s ≫ i = j ≫ t) (z : Z')
    [IsIso (s.stalkMap z)] [IsIso (t.stalkMap (j z))]
    (a : X'.presheaf.stalk (j z)) :
    (i.stalkMap (s z)).hom
        (principalStalkElementOfIsIsoSquare i j s t h z a) =
      (sourceStalkIsoOfIsIsoSquare s z).inv.hom ((j.stalkMap z).hom a)
proof:
:= by
  apply (sourceStalkIsoOfIsIsoSquare s z).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.injective
  change ((i.stalkMap (s z) ≫ (sourceStalkIsoOfIsIsoSquare s z).hom).hom
      ((targetStalkIsoOfIsIsoSquare i j s t h z).inv.hom a)) = _
  rw [stalkMap_square_of_isIso_stalkMaps i j s t h z]
  simp
  exact ((sourceStalkIsoOfIsIsoSquare s z).inv_hom_id_apply
    ((j.stalkMap z).hom a)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ker_stalkMap_eq_span_of_isIso_square
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_eq_span_of_isIso_square
    {Z X Z' X' : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) (j : Z' ⟶ X')
    (s : Z' ⟶ Z) (t : X' ⟶ X) (h : s ≫ i = j ≫ t) (z : Z')
    [IsIso (s.stalkMap z)] [IsIso (t.stalkMap (j z))]
    (a : X'.presheaf.stalk (j z))
    (hker : RingHom.ker (j.stalkMap z).hom = Ideal.span {a}) :
    RingHom.ker (i.stalkMap (s z)).hom =
      Ideal.span {principalStalkElementOfIsIsoSquare i j s t h z a}
proof:
:= by
  apply ker_eq_span_singleton_of_equiv_commutes_symm
    (i.stalkMap (s z)).hom (j.stalkMap z).hom
    (targetStalkIsoOfIsIsoSquare i j s t h z).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
    (sourceStalkIsoOfIsIsoSquare s z).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
    _ a hker
  change ((i.stalkMap (s z)) ≫
    (sourceStalkIsoOfIsIsoSquare s z).hom).hom =
      ((targetStalkIsoOfIsIsoSquare i j s t h z).hom ≫
        j.stalkMap z).hom
  exact congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom
    (stalkMap_square_of_isIso_stalkMaps i j s t h z)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteTypeCodimension.ringKrullDim_ne_top
statement: theorem ringKrullDim_ne_top : ringKrullDim R ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.ringKrullDim_eq_toENat_trdeg k R]
  have h := trdeg_lt_aleph0 (R := k) (S := R)
  intro htop
  have : Cardinal.toENat (Algebra.trdeg k R) = ⊤ := by exact_mod_cast htop
  rw [Cardinal.toENat_eq_top] at this
  exact absurd h (not_lt.mpr this)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteTypeCodimension.coheight_add_height
statement:
theorem coheight_add_height (q : PrimeSpectrum R) :
    ((coheight q + height q : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R
proof:
:= by
  have h := SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.ringKrullDim_quotient_add_height k R q.asIdeal
  rw [← SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.PrimeSpectrum.coheight_eq_ringKrullDim_quotient,
    q.height_eq_orderHeight] at h
  rw [← h]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteTypeCodimension.height_eq_height_Ici_add_height
statement:
theorem height_eq_height_Ici_add_height {q p : PrimeSpectrum R} (hqp : q ≤ p) :
    height p = height (⟨p, hqp⟩ : Set.Ici q) + height q
proof:
:= by
  set π := Ideal.Quotient.mk q.asIdeal
  have hπ : Function.Surjective π := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let f : PrimeSpectrum (R ⧸ q.asIdeal) → PrimeSpectrum R := PrimeSpectrum.comap π
  have hfle : ∀ a b, f a ≤ f b ↔ a ≤ b := by
    intro a b
    change a.asIdeal.comap π ≤ b.asIdeal.comap π ↔ a.asIdeal ≤ b.asIdeal
    exact Ideal.comap_le_comap_iff_of_surjective π hπ _ _
  have hfmono : StrictMono f := fun a b hab ↦
    lt_of_le_not_ge ((hfle a b).2 hab.le) fun h ↦ hab.not_ge ((hfle b a).1 h)
  have hq : ∀ a, q ≤ f a := by
    intro a
    change q.asIdeal ≤ a.asIdeal.comap π
    intro x hx
    change π x ∈ a.asIdeal
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hx]
    exact a.asIdeal.zero_mem
  have hrange : ∀ b : PrimeSpectrum R, q ≤ b → ∃ a, f a = b := by
    intro b hb
    have hmem : b ∈ Set.range f := by
      rw [range_comap_of_surjective _ (f := π) hπ, Ideal.mk_ker]
      exact hb
    exact hmem
  let g : PrimeSpectrum (R ⧸ q.asIdeal) → Set.Ici q := fun a ↦ ⟨f a, hq a⟩
  have hgmono : StrictMono g := fun a b hab ↦ hfmono hab
  obtain ⟨pb, hpb⟩ := hrange p hqp
  
  have hheight : height pb = height (⟨p, hqp⟩ : Set.Ici q) := by
    have := Order.height_eq_of_strictMono g hgmono (fun a b hba ↦ by
      obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := hrange b.1 b.2
      refine ⟨a', ?_, Subtype.ext ha'⟩
      have hle : f a' ≤ f a := by rw [ha']; exact hba.le
      have hle' := (hfle a' a).1 hle
      refine lt_of_le_of_ne hle' fun h ↦ hba.ne ?_
      apply Subtype.ext
      change b.1 = f a
      rw [← ha', h]) pb
    rw [this]
    congr 1
    exact Subtype.ext hpb
  
  have hcoheight : coheight pb = coheight p := by
    rw [← hpb]
    exact Order.coheight_eq_of_strictMono f hfmono (fun a b hab ↦ by
      obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := hrange b (le_trans (hq a) hab.le)
      refine ⟨a', ?_, ha'⟩
      have hle' := (hfle a a').1 (by rw [ha']; exact hab.le)
      refine lt_of_le_of_ne hle' fun h ↦ hab.ne ?_
      rw [← ha', h]) pb
  have e1 := coheight_add_height k pb
  have e2 := coheight_add_height k q
  have e3 := coheight_add_height k p
  rw [← SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.PrimeSpectrum.coheight_eq_ringKrullDim_quotient q] at e1
  rw [hheight, hcoheight] at e1
  have hD := ringKrullDim_ne_top k (R := R)
  rw [← e2] at e3 hD
  have e1' : coheight p + height (⟨p, hqp⟩ : Set.Ici q) = coheight q := by exact_mod_cast e1
  have e3' : coheight p + height p = coheight q + height q := by exact_mod_cast e3
  have hD' : coheight q + height q ≠ ⊤ := fun h ↦ hD (by rw [h]; rfl)
  have hcq : coheight q ≠ ⊤ := fun h ↦ hD' (by rw [h, top_add])
  have hhq : height q ≠ ⊤ := fun h ↦ hD' (by rw [h, add_top])
  have hcp : coheight p ≠ ⊤ := fun h ↦ hcq (by rw [← e1', h, top_add])
  have hhp : height p ≠ ⊤ := fun h ↦ hD' (by rw [← e3', h, add_top])
  have hb : height (⟨p, hqp⟩ : Set.Ici q) ≠ ⊤ := fun h ↦ hcq (by rw [← e1', h, add_top])
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hcp
  obtain ⟨b, hb'⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hb
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hcq
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hhq
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hhp
  rw [← ha, ← hb', ← hc] at e1'
  rw [← ha, ← he, ← hc, ← hd] at e3'
  rw [← he, ← hb', ← hd]
  have h1 : a + b = c := by exact_mod_cast e1'
  have h3 : a + e = c + d := by exact_mod_cast e3'
  exact_mod_cast (by omega : e = b + d)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteTypeCodimension.coheight_Iic_eq_of_upper
statement:
theorem coheight_Iic_eq_of_upper (f : α → β) (hf : ∀ a b, f a ≤ f b ↔ a ≤ b)
    (hup : ∀ a b, f a ≤ b → ∃ a', f a' = b) {x w : α} (h : x ≤ w) :
    coheight (⟨x, h⟩ : Set.Iic w) = coheight (⟨f x, (hf x w).2 h⟩ : Set.Iic (f w))
proof:
:= by
  let G : Set.Iic w → Set.Iic (f w) := fun a ↦ ⟨f a.1, (hf a.1 w).2 a.2⟩
  have hG : StrictMono G := fun a b hab ↦ by
    change f a.1 < f b.1
    exact lt_of_le_not_ge ((hf _ _).2 hab.le) fun h' ↦ hab.not_ge ((hf _ _).1 h')
  refine Order.coheight_eq_of_strictMono G hG (fun a b hab ↦ ?_) ⟨x, h⟩
  obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := hup a.1 b.1 hab.le
  have hle : a' ≤ w := (hf a' w).1 (by rw [ha']; exact b.2)
  refine ⟨⟨a', hle⟩, ?_, Subtype.ext ha'⟩
  change a.1 < a'
  have h1 : a.1 ≤ a' := (hf _ _).1 (by rw [ha']; exact hab.le)
  refine lt_of_le_not_ge h1 fun h2 ↦ hab.not_ge ?_
  change b.1 ≤ f a.1
  rw [← ha']
  exact (hf _ _).2 h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteTypeCodimension.coheight_eq_coheight_Iic_of_lower
statement:
theorem coheight_eq_coheight_Iic_of_lower (f : α → β) (hf : ∀ a b, f a ≤ f b ↔ a ≤ b)
    {w₀ : β} (hw : ∀ a, f a ≤ w₀) (hrange : ∀ b, b ≤ w₀ → ∃ a, f a = b) (x : α) :
    coheight x = coheight (⟨f x, hw x⟩ : Set.Iic w₀)
proof:
:= by
  let G : α → Set.Iic w₀ := fun a ↦ ⟨f a, hw a⟩
  have hG : StrictMono G := fun a b hab ↦ by
    change f a < f b
    exact lt_of_le_not_ge ((hf _ _).2 hab.le) fun h' ↦ hab.not_ge ((hf _ _).1 h')
  refine Order.coheight_eq_of_strictMono G hG (fun a b hab ↦ ?_) x
  obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := hrange b.1 b.2
  refine ⟨a', ?_, Subtype.ext ha'⟩
  have h1 : a ≤ a' := (hf _ _).1 (by rw [ha']; exact hab.le)
  refine lt_of_le_not_ge h1 fun h2 ↦ hab.not_ge ?_
  change b.1 ≤ f a
  rw [← ha']
  exact (hf _ _).2 h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteTypeCodimension.specPrime_le_iff
statement: theorem specPrime_le_iff (a b : Spec R) : specPrime R b ≤ specPrime R a ↔ a ≤ b

:=
  (specOrderIsoPrimeSpectrum R).map_rel_iff

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteTypeCodimension.coheight_eq_height_specPrime
statement: theorem coheight_eq_height_specPrime (y : Spec R) : coheight y = height (specPrime R y)

:=
  (Order.coheight_orderIso (specOrderIsoPrimeSpectrum R) y).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteTypeCodimension.coheight_Iic_eq_height_Ici
statement:
theorem coheight_Iic_eq_height_Ici {x w : Spec R} (h : x ≤ w) :
    coheight (⟨x, h⟩ : Set.Iic w) =
      height (⟨specPrime R x, (specPrime_le_iff R x w).2 h⟩ : Set.Ici (specPrime R w))
proof:
:= by
  let G : Set.Iic w → (Set.Ici (specPrime R w))ᵒᵈ := fun a ↦
    OrderDual.toDual ⟨specPrime R a.1, (specPrime_le_iff R a.1 w).2 a.2⟩
  have hG : StrictMono G := fun a b hab ↦ by
    change specPrime R b.1 < specPrime R a.1
    exact lt_of_le_not_ge ((specPrime_le_iff R _ _).2 hab.le)
      fun h' ↦ hab.not_ge ((specPrime_le_iff R _ _).1 h')
  refine Order.coheight_eq_of_strictMono G hG (fun a b hab ↦ ?_) ⟨x, h⟩
  let y : Spec R := (OrderDual.ofDual b).1
  have hy : y ≤ w := (specPrime_le_iff R y w).1 (OrderDual.ofDual b).2
  refine ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, ?_, rfl⟩
  have hab' : (OrderDual.ofDual b).1 < specPrime R a.1 := hab
  change a.1 < y
  exact lt_of_le_not_ge ((specPrime_le_iff R _ _).1 hab'.le)
    fun h2 ↦ hab'.not_ge ((specPrime_le_iff R _ _).2 h2)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteTypeCodimension.exists_finiteType_chart
statement:
theorem exists_finiteType_chart (x : X) :
    ∃ (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (f : Spec R ⟶ X) (_ : IsOpenImmersion f) (_ : IsDomain R)
      (_ : Algebra k R) (_ : Algebra.FiniteType k R), x ∈ Set.range f.base
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, f, hf, hx, -⟩ :=
    Scheme.exists_affine_mem_range_and_range_subset (x := x) (U := ⊤) trivial
  obtain ⟨x', rfl⟩ := hx
  haveI : Nonempty (Spec R) := ⟨x'⟩
  haveI := isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion f
  haveI : IsDomain R := (affine_isIntegral_iff R).mp inferInstance
  have hft : LocallyOfFiniteType (Spec.map (Spec.preimage (f ≫ g))) := by
    rw [Spec.map_preimage]
    infer_instance
  have hφ : (Spec.preimage (f ≫ g)).hom.FiniteType :=
    (HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @LocallyOfFiniteType)).mp hft
  letI : Algebra k R := (Spec.preimage (f ≫ g)).hom.toAlgebra
  exact ⟨R, f, hf, inferInstance, this, hφ, ⟨x', rfl⟩⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteTypeCodimension.open_order_facts
statement:
theorem open_order_facts {R : CommRingCat.{u}} (f : Spec R ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion f] :
    (∀ a b, f.base a ≤ f.base b ↔ a ≤ b) ∧ (∀ a b, f.base a ≤ b → ∃ a', f.base a' = b)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun a b ↦ ?_, fun a b h ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [Scheme.le_iff_specializes, Scheme.le_iff_specializes]
    exact f.isOpenEmbedding.isInducing.specializes_iff
  · exact (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp h).mem_open f.isOpenEmbedding.isOpen_range ⟨a, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteTypeCodimension.coheight_eq_coheight_Iic_add
statement:
theorem coheight_eq_coheight_Iic_add {x w : X} (hxw : x ≤ w) :
    coheight x = coheight (⟨x, hxw⟩ : Set.Iic w) + coheight w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, f, _, _, _, _, x', rfl⟩ := exists_finiteType_chart k g x
  obtain ⟨hfle, hup⟩ := open_order_facts f
  obtain ⟨w', rfl⟩ := hup x' w hxw
  have hx'w' : x' ≤ w' := (hfle _ _).1 hxw
  rw [coheight_eq_of_isOpenImmersion f (x := x'), coheight_eq_of_isOpenImmersion f (x := w')]
  have hrel := coheight_Iic_eq_of_upper f.base hfle hup hx'w'
  rw [show (⟨f.base x', hxw⟩ : Set.Iic (f.base w')) = ⟨f.base x', (hfle x' w').2 hx'w'⟩ from rfl,
    ← hrel, coheight_Iic_eq_height_Ici R hx'w', coheight_eq_height_specPrime R x',
    coheight_eq_height_specPrime R w']
  exact height_eq_height_Ici_add_height k _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteTypeCodimension.exists_open_coheight_le
statement:
theorem exists_open_coheight_le (x : X) :
    ∃ (U : Set X) (N : ℕ), IsOpen U ∧ x ∈ U ∧ ∀ y ∈ U, coheight y ≤ N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, f, _, _, _, _, hx⟩ := exists_finiteType_chart k g x
  obtain ⟨x', rfl⟩ := hx
  have hD := coheight_add_height k (specPrime R x')
  have hne := ringKrullDim_ne_top k (R := R)
  rw [← hD] at hne
  have hne' : coheight (specPrime R x') + height (specPrime R x') ≠ ⊤ :=
    fun h ↦ hne (by rw [h]; rfl)
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hne'
  refine ⟨Set.range f.base, N, f.isOpenEmbedding.isOpen_range, ⟨x', rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨y', rfl⟩
  rw [coheight_eq_of_isOpenImmersion f (x := y'), coheight_eq_height_specPrime R y']
  have h1 : ((height (specPrime R y') : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R :=
    Order.height_le_krullDim _
  rw [← hD, ← hN] at h1
  exact_mod_cast h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteTypeCodimension.coheight_ne_top
statement: theorem coheight_ne_top (x : X) : coheight x ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, N, -, hx, hU⟩ := exists_open_coheight_le k g x
  exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top (ENat.coe_ne_top N) (hU x hx)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteTypeCodimension.exists_krullDimLE
statement: theorem exists_krullDimLE [CompactSpace X] : ∃ n : ℕ, Order.KrullDimLE n X
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose U N hUo hxU hUb using exists_open_coheight_le k g
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := isCompact_univ.elim_finite_subcover U hUo
    (fun x _ ↦ Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨x, hxU x⟩)
  refine ⟨t.sup N, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  rw [Order.krullDim_eq_iSup_coheight]
  refine iSup_le fun y ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨x, hxt, hyx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (ht (Set.mem_univ y))
  have h1 := hUb x y hyx
  have h2 : (N x : ℕ∞) ≤ (t.sup N : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast Finset.le_sup hxt
  exact_mod_cast h1.trans h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteTypeCodimension.coheight_eq_coheight_Iic_closedImmersion
statement:
theorem coheight_eq_coheight_Iic_closedImmersion {Z X : Scheme.{u}} [IrreducibleSpace Z]
    (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] (z : Z) :
    coheight z = coheight (⟨i.base z, by
      rw [Set.mem_Iic, Scheme.le_iff_specializes]
      exact (genericPoint_specializes z).map i.base.hom.continuous⟩ :
        Set.Iic (i.base (genericPoint Z)))
proof:
:= by
  have hfle : ∀ a b, i.base a ≤ i.base b ↔ a ≤ b := fun a b ↦ by
    rw [Scheme.le_iff_specializes, Scheme.le_iff_specializes]
    exact i.isClosedEmbedding.isInducing.specializes_iff
  have hw : ∀ a, i.base a ≤ i.base (genericPoint Z) := fun a ↦ by
    rw [Scheme.le_iff_specializes]
    exact (genericPoint_specializes a).map i.base.hom.continuous
  refine coheight_eq_coheight_Iic_of_lower i.base hfle hw (fun b hb ↦ ?_) z
  exact (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hb).mem_closed i.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range
    ⟨genericPoint Z, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteTypeCodimension.coheight_closedImmersion
statement:
theorem coheight_closedImmersion (z : Z) :
    coheight (i.base z) = coheight z + coheight (i.base (genericPoint Z))
proof:
:= by
  rw [coheight_eq_coheight_Iic_closedImmersion i z]
  exact coheight_eq_coheight_Iic_add k g _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteTypeCodimension.pointClosureι_genericPoint_eq
statement:
theorem pointClosureι_genericPoint_eq (w : X) :
    pointClosureι w (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme w)) = w
proof:
:= by
  have haeq : pointClosureGenericPoint w = genericPoint (pointClosureScheme w) :=
    (pointClosureGenericPoint_isGeneric w).eq (genericPoint_spec (pointClosureScheme w))
  rw [← haeq, pointClosureι_genericPoint]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteTypeCodimension.stalkDimensionFormula_of_locallyOfFiniteType
statement: theorem stalkDimensionFormula_of_locallyOfFiniteType : C1Cap.StalkDimensionFormula X
proof:
:= by
  intro y P hP
  obtain ⟨w, h, rfl⟩ := Scheme.exists_specializes_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_eq y P
  have hy : y ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι w) := by
    rw [range_pointClosureι]
    exact specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp h
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hy
  have e1 : ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk (pointClosureι w z) ⧸
      Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h) = (coheight z : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
    C1Cap.ringKrullDim_quotient_stalkPrime w z
  have e2 := Scheme.height_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h
  have e3 := ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight (pointClosureι w z)
  have hadd := coheight_closedImmersion k g (pointClosureι w) z
  rw [pointClosureι_genericPoint_eq] at hadd
  rw [e1, e2, e3, hadd]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.morphismLocalLength_comp_closedImmersion
statement:
theorem morphismLocalLength_comp_closedImmersion
    {Z Y X : Scheme.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion g] (z : Z) :
    morphismLocalLength (f ≫ g) z = morphismLocalLength f z
proof:
:= by
  unfold morphismLocalLength
  letI : Algebra ↑(X.presheaf.stalk ((f ≫ g) z))
      ↑(Y.presheaf.stalk (f z)) :=
    (g.stalkMap (f z)).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra ↑(Y.presheaf.stalk (f z)) ↑(Z.presheaf.stalk z) :=
    (f.stalkMap z).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra ↑(X.presheaf.stalk ((f ≫ g) z)) ↑(Z.presheaf.stalk z) :=
    ((f ≫ g).stalkMap z).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : IsScalarTower ↑(X.presheaf.stalk ((f ≫ g) z))
      ↑(Y.presheaf.stalk (f z)) ↑(Z.presheaf.stalk z) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
      ext r
      change ((f ≫ g).stalkMap z).hom r =
        (f.stalkMap z).hom ((g.stalkMap (f z)).hom r)
      rw [Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp]
      rfl)
  exact Module.length_eq_of_surjective (g.stalkMap_surjective (f z))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteClosedIntersectionData.morphismLocalLength_eq_fst
statement:
theorem morphismLocalLength_eq_fst
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {p : ℕ} (d : FiniteClosedIntersectionData X p)
    (z : d.intersection) :
    morphismLocalLength d.toX z =
      morphismLocalLength (Limits.pullback.fst d.i d.j) z
proof:
:= by
  exact morphismLocalLength_comp_closedImmersion
    (Limits.pullback.fst d.i d.j) d.i z

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteClosedIntersectionData.morphismLocalLength_eq_snd
statement:
theorem morphismLocalLength_eq_snd
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {p : ℕ} (d : FiniteClosedIntersectionData X p)
    (z : d.intersection) :
    morphismLocalLength d.toX z =
      morphismLocalLength (Limits.pullback.snd d.i d.j) z
proof:
:= by
  rw [show d.toX = Limits.pullback.snd d.i d.j ≫ d.j by
    exact Limits.pullback.condition]
  exact morphismLocalLength_comp_closedImmersion
    (Limits.pullback.snd d.i d.j) d.j z

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteClosedIntersectionData.localMultiplicity_eq_fst
statement:
theorem localMultiplicity_eq_fst
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {p : ℕ} (d : FiniteClosedIntersectionData X p)
    (z : d.intersection) :
    d.localMultiplicity z =
      (morphismLocalLength (Limits.pullback.fst d.i d.j) z).toNat
proof:
:= by
  change (morphismLocalLength d.toX z).toNat =
    (morphismLocalLength (Limits.pullback.fst d.i d.j) z).toNat
  rw [d.morphismLocalLength_eq_fst]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteClosedIntersectionData.localMultiplicity_eq_snd
statement:
theorem localMultiplicity_eq_snd
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {p : ℕ} (d : FiniteClosedIntersectionData X p)
    (z : d.intersection) :
    d.localMultiplicity z =
      (morphismLocalLength (Limits.pullback.snd d.i d.j) z).toNat
proof:
:= by
  change (morphismLocalLength d.toX z).toNat =
    (morphismLocalLength (Limits.pullback.snd d.i d.j) z).toNat
  rw [d.morphismLocalLength_eq_snd]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteClosedIntersectionData.principalDivisor_fst_apply_eq_localMultiplicity
statement:
theorem principalDivisor_fst_apply_eq_localMultiplicity
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {p : ℕ} (d : FiniteClosedIntersectionData X p)
    [IsIntegral d.D] [IsLocallyNoetherian d.D] (z : d.intersection)
    (hz : coheight (Limits.pullback.fst d.i d.j z) = 1)
    (a : d.D.presheaf.stalk (Limits.pullback.fst d.i d.j z)) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hker : RingHom.ker ((Limits.pullback.fst d.i d.j).stalkMap z).hom =
      Ideal.span {a}) :
    div (algebraMap (d.D.presheaf.stalk (Limits.pullback.fst d.i d.j z))
      d.D.functionField a) (Limits.pullback.fst d.i d.j z) =
        (d.localMultiplicity z : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  change div (algebraMap (d.D.presheaf.stalk (Limits.pullback.fst d.i d.j z))
      d.D.functionField a) (Limits.pullback.fst d.i d.j z) =
    ((morphismLocalLength d.toX z).toNat : ℤ)
  rw [d.morphismLocalLength_eq_fst]
  exact div_algebraMap_eq_morphismLocalLength_toNat
    (Limits.pullback.fst d.i d.j) z hz a ha hker

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteClosedIntersectionData.principalDivisor_snd_apply_eq_localMultiplicity
statement:
theorem principalDivisor_snd_apply_eq_localMultiplicity
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {p : ℕ} (d : FiniteClosedIntersectionData X p)
    [IsIntegral d.E] [IsLocallyNoetherian d.E] (z : d.intersection)
    (hz : coheight (Limits.pullback.snd d.i d.j z) = 1)
    (a : d.E.presheaf.stalk (Limits.pullback.snd d.i d.j z)) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hker : RingHom.ker ((Limits.pullback.snd d.i d.j).stalkMap z).hom =
      Ideal.span {a}) :
    div (algebraMap (d.E.presheaf.stalk (Limits.pullback.snd d.i d.j z))
      d.E.functionField a) (Limits.pullback.snd d.i d.j z) =
        (d.localMultiplicity z : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  change div (algebraMap (d.E.presheaf.stalk (Limits.pullback.snd d.i d.j z))
      d.E.functionField a) (Limits.pullback.snd d.i d.j z) =
    ((morphismLocalLength d.toX z).toNat : ℤ)
  rw [d.morphismLocalLength_eq_snd]
  exact div_algebraMap_eq_morphismLocalLength_toNat
    (Limits.pullback.snd d.i d.j) z hz a ha hker

name: FlatProperBaseChangeAlgebra.length_self_eq_of_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem length_self_eq_of_ringEquiv {A B : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (e : A ≃+* B) :
    Module.length A A = Module.length B B
proof:
:= by
  letI := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  rw [(AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := e) (fun _ => rfl)).toLinearEquiv.length_eq]
  exact Module.length_eq_of_surjective (R := B) (M := B) e.surjective

name: FlatProperBaseChangeAlgebra.map_maximalIdeal_of_equiv
statement:
theorem map_maximalIdeal_of_equiv {R R' : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing R'] [IsLocalRing R]
    [IsLocalRing R'] (e : R ≃+* R') : (maximalIdeal R).map (e : R →+* R') = maximalIdeal R'
proof:
:= by
  have : ((maximalIdeal R).map (e : R →+* R')).IsMaximal := Ideal.map_isMaximal_of_equiv e
  exact IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal this

name: FlatProperBaseChangeAlgebra.lc_eq_of_equiv
statement:
theorem lc_eq_of_equiv {R S R' S' : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing R'] [CommRing S']
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing R'] (φ : R →+* S) (ψ : R' →+* S') (eR : R ≃+* R')
    (eS : S ≃+* S') (h : ∀ r, eS (φ r) = ψ (eR r)) : lc φ = lc ψ
proof:
:= by
  unfold lc
  set I := (maximalIdeal R).map φ
  set I' := (maximalIdeal R').map ψ
  have hI : I' = I.map (eS : S →+* S') := by
    simp only [I, I']
    rw [Ideal.map_map]
    have : (eS : S →+* S').comp φ = ψ.comp (eR : R →+* R') := RingHom.ext h
    rw [this, ← Ideal.map_map, map_maximalIdeal_of_equiv]
  have e : (S ⧸ I) ≃+* (S' ⧸ I') := Ideal.quotientEquiv I I' eS hI
  rw [Module.length_eq_of_surjective (R := S ⧸ I) (M := S ⧸ I) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective,
    Module.length_eq_of_surjective (R := S' ⧸ I') (M := S' ⧸ I') Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective,
    length_self_eq_of_ringEquiv e]

name: FlatProperBaseChangeAlgebra.ld_eq_of_equiv
statement:
theorem ld_eq_of_equiv {R S R' S' : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing R'] [CommRing S']
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing R'] [IsLocalRing S] [IsLocalRing S'] (φ : R →+* S) (ψ : R' →+* S')
    [IsLocalHom φ] [IsLocalHom ψ] (eR : R ≃+* R')
    (eS : S ≃+* S') (h : ∀ r, eS (φ r) = ψ (eR r)) : ld φ = ld ψ
proof:
:= by
  unfold ld
  letI := (ResidueField.map φ).toAlgebra
  letI := (ResidueField.map ψ).toAlgebra
  refine Algebra.finrank_eq_of_equiv_equiv (ResidueField.mapEquiv eR) (ResidueField.mapEquiv eS) ?_
  ext x
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := residue_surjective x
  change ResidueField.map ψ (ResidueField.map (eR : R →+* R') (residue R x)) =
    ResidueField.map (eS : S →+* S') (ResidueField.map φ (residue R x))
  simp [ResidueField.map_residue, h]

name: FlatProperBaseChangeAlgebra.isLocalHom_of_good
statement:
theorem isLocalHom_of_good (Q : Ideal (B ⊗[κ] K)) [Q.IsPrime]
    (hQ : Q.comap (algebraMap B (B ⊗[κ] K)) = maximalIdeal B) :
    IsLocalHom (algebraMap B (Localization.AtPrime Q))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun b hb ↦ ?_⟩
  by_contra hnu
  have hb' : b ∈ maximalIdeal B := hnu
  rw [← hQ, Ideal.mem_comap] at hb'
  rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply B (B ⊗[κ] K) (Localization.AtPrime Q)] at hb
  have := (IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff (Localization.AtPrime Q) Q _).mpr hb'
  exact (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).mp this hb

name: FlatProperBaseChangeAlgebra.length_ne_top_of_good
statement:
theorem length_ne_top_of_good (Q : Ideal (B ⊗[κ] K)) [Q.IsPrime]
    (hQ : Q.comap (algebraMap B (B ⊗[κ] K)) = maximalIdeal B)
    (hfin : Module.length (Localization.AtPrime Q) (Localization.AtPrime Q) ≠ ⊤) :
    Module.length B B ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isLocalHom_of_good Q hQ
  haveI : Module.Flat B (Localization.AtPrime Q) :=
    Module.Flat.trans B (B ⊗[κ] K) (Localization.AtPrime Q)
  have h := IsLocalRing.length_baseChange B (Localization.AtPrime Q) B
  rw [(TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.rid B (Localization.AtPrime Q)
    (Localization.AtPrime Q)).length_eq] at h
  intro htop
  apply hfin
  rw [h, htop]
  apply ENat.top_mul
  simpa [← pos_iff_ne_zero, Module.length_pos_iff] using
    (map_maximalIdeal_lt_top (algebraMap B (Localization.AtPrime Q))).ne

name: FlatProperBaseChangeAlgebra.length_W_eq
statement:
theorem length_W_eq [Module.Finite κ K] :
    Module.length B (B ⊗[κ] K) = Module.finrank κ K * Module.length B B
proof:
:= by
  rw [Module.length_of_free_of_finite, Module.finrank_baseChange]

name: FlatProperBaseChangeAlgebra.comap_eq_maximalIdeal_of_length_ne_top
statement:
theorem comap_eq_maximalIdeal_of_length_ne_top
    (hW : Module.length B (B ⊗[κ] K) ≠ ⊤) (Q : Ideal (B ⊗[κ] K)) [Q.IsPrime] :
    Q.comap (algebraMap B (B ⊗[κ] K)) = maximalIdeal B
proof:
:= by
  set J := Q.comap (algebraMap B (B ⊗[κ] K))
  let g : (B ⧸ J) →ₗ[B] ((B ⊗[κ] K) ⧸ Q) :=
    (Ideal.quotientMapₐ Q (Algebra.ofId B (B ⊗[κ] K)) le_rfl).toLinearMap
  have hinj : Function.Injective g := Ideal.quotientMap_injective
  have h1 : Module.length B (B ⧸ J) ≤ Module.length B ((B ⊗[κ] K) ⧸ Q) :=
    Module.length_le_of_injective g hinj
  have h2 : Module.length B ((B ⊗[κ] K) ⧸ Q) ≤ Module.length B (B ⊗[κ] K) :=
    Module.length_le_of_surjective ((Submodule.mkQ Q).restrictScalars B)
      (Submodule.mkQ_surjective _)
  have hfin : IsFiniteLength B (B ⧸ J) :=
    Module.length_ne_top_iff.mp (ne_top_of_le_ne_top hW (h1.trans h2))
  have hArt : IsArtinian B (B ⧸ J) := (isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp hfin).2
  haveI : IsArtinianRing (B ⧸ J) := isArtinian_of_tower B hArt
  haveI : (⊥ : Ideal (B ⧸ J)).IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_bot
  haveI : (⊥ : Ideal (B ⧸ J)).IsMaximal := IsArtinianRing.isMaximal_of_isPrime _
  have hmax : (Ideal.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) ⊥).IsMaximal :=
    Ideal.comap_isMaximal_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  rw [← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, Ideal.mk_ker] at hmax
  exact IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hmax

name: FlatProperBaseChangeAlgebra.length_W_eq_sum
statement:
theorem length_W_eq_sum (hW : Module.length B (B ⊗[κ] K) ≠ ⊤) :
    ∃ _ : Fintype (PrimeSpectrum (B ⊗[κ] K)), Module.length B (B ⊗[κ] K) =
      ∑ Q : PrimeSpectrum (B ⊗[κ] K), Module.length B (Localization.AtPrime Q.asIdeal)
proof:
:= by
  have hfin : IsFiniteLength B (B ⊗[κ] K) := Module.length_ne_top_iff.mp hW
  have hArt : IsArtinian B (B ⊗[κ] K) := (isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp hfin).2
  haveI : IsArtinianRing (B ⊗[κ] K) := isArtinian_of_tower B hArt
  let _ : Fintype (PrimeSpectrum (B ⊗[κ] K)) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  refine ⟨inferInstance, ?_⟩
  let e := ((PrimeSpectrum.toPiLocalizationEquiv (B ⊗[κ] K)).restrictScalars B).toLinearEquiv
  rw [e.length_eq]
  exact Module.length_pi_of_fintype B _

name: FlatProperBaseChangeAlgebra.residueField_map_toAlgebra
statement:
theorem residueField_map_toAlgebra {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [IsLocalRing R]
    [IsLocalRing S] [Algebra R S] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap R S)] :
    (ResidueField.map (algebraMap R S)).toAlgebra =
      (inferInstance : Algebra (ResidueField R) (ResidueField S))
proof:
:= by
  refine Algebra.algebra_ext _ _ (fun x ↦ ?_)
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := residue_surjective x
  rfl

name: FlatProperBaseChangeAlgebra.flat_aeval_of_transcendental
statement:
theorem flat_aeval_of_transcendental {k : K} (hk : Transcendental κ k) :
    (Polynomial.aeval (R := κ) k).toRingHom.Flat
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra κ[X] K := (Polynomial.aeval (R := κ) k).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  haveI : FaithfulSMul κ[X] K :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective κ[X] K).mpr (transcendental_iff_injective.mp hk)
  change Module.Flat κ[X] K
  infer_instance

name: FlatProperBaseChangeAlgebra.isAlgebraic_of_good
statement:
theorem isAlgebraic_of_good (Q : Ideal (B ⊗[κ] K)) [Q.IsPrime]
    (hQ : Q.comap (algebraMap B (B ⊗[κ] K)) = maximalIdeal B)
    (hfin : Module.length (Localization.AtPrime Q) (Localization.AtPrime Q) ≠ ⊤)
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap B (Localization.AtPrime Q))]
    (hdeg : Module.Finite (ResidueField B) (ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime Q))) :
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic κ K
proof:
:= by
  set W := B ⊗[κ] K
  set WQ := Localization.AtPrime Q
  have hFL : IsFiniteLength WQ WQ := Module.length_ne_top_iff.mp hfin
  haveI : IsArtinianRing WQ := (isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp hFL).2
  refine ⟨fun k ↦ ?_⟩
  by_contra hk
  let ev : κ[X] →ₐ[κ] K := Polynomial.aeval k
  have hev : ev.toRingHom.Flat := flat_aeval_of_transcendental hk
  let ψ₀ : B ⊗[κ] κ[X] →ₐ[B] W := Algebra.TensorProduct.lTensor (S := B) B ev
  have hψ₀ : ψ₀.toRingHom.Flat := RingHom.Flat.lTensor B hev
  let e := polyEquivTensor' κ B
  let ψ : B[X] →ₐ[B] W := ψ₀.comp e.toAlgHom
  have hψ : ψ.toRingHom.Flat := RingHom.Flat.comp (RingHom.Flat.of_bijective e.bijective) hψ₀
  letI : Algebra B[X] W := ψ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  haveI : Module.Flat B[X] W := hψ
  set 𝔡 := Q.comap (algebraMap B[X] W) with h𝔡
  set 𝔪 : Ideal B[X] := (maximalIdeal B).map Polynomial.C with h𝔪
  haveI : 𝔪.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_map_C_of_isPrime
  have hψC : ∀ b : B, algebraMap B[X] W (Polynomial.C b) = algebraMap B W b := fun b ↦
    ψ.commutes b
  have hle : 𝔪 ≤ 𝔡 := by
    rw [h𝔪, Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro b hb
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, h𝔡, Ideal.mem_comap, hψC, ← Ideal.mem_comap, hQ]
    exact hb
  have hEq : 𝔡 = 𝔪 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hlt : 𝔪 < 𝔡 := lt_of_le_of_ne hle (Ne.symm hne)
    haveI : Q.LiesOver 𝔡 := ⟨rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨Q', hQ'Q, hQ'p, -⟩ := Ideal.exists_ideal_lt_liesOver_of_lt (S := W) Q hlt
    have hdisj : Disjoint (Q.primeCompl : Set W) Q' := by
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      intro w hw hw'
      exact hw (hQ'Q.le hw')
    haveI := IsLocalization.isPrime_of_isPrime_disjoint Q.primeCompl WQ Q' hQ'p hdisj
    have hmax : (Q'.map (algebraMap W WQ)).IsMaximal := IsArtinianRing.isMaximal_of_isPrime _
    have h1 : Q'.map (algebraMap W WQ) = maximalIdeal WQ := IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hmax
    have h2 : (Q'.map (algebraMap W WQ)).under W = Q' :=
      IsLocalization.under_map_of_isPrime_disjoint Q.primeCompl WQ hQ'p hdisj
    rw [h1, Localization.AtPrime.under_maximalIdeal] at h2
    exact hQ'Q.ne h2.symm
  
  set y : ResidueField WQ := residue WQ (algebraMap W WQ (1 ⊗ₜ k))
  have halg : IsAlgebraic (ResidueField B) y := Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic y
  obtain ⟨h, hne, hy⟩ := halg
  obtain ⟨h', rfl⟩ := Polynomial.map_surjective (residue B) residue_surjective h
  let Φ : B[X] →+* ResidueField WQ :=
    (residue WQ).comp ((algebraMap W WQ).comp (algebraMap B[X] W))
  let Φ' : B[X] →+* ResidueField WQ :=
    (Polynomial.aeval y).toRingHom.comp (Polynomial.mapRingHom (residue B))
  have hΦ : Φ = Φ' := by
    refine Polynomial.ringHom_ext (fun b ↦ ?_) ?_
    · simp only [Φ, Φ', RingHom.comp_apply, hψC, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_C,
        AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe, Polynomial.aeval_C]
      rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]
      rfl
    · simp only [Φ, Φ', RingHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_X,
        AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe, Polynomial.aeval_X, y]
      congr 2
      change ψ₀ (e Polynomial.X) = _
      simp [e, ψ₀, ev]
      show Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id B B) (Polynomial.aeval k) (1 ⊗ₜ Polynomial.X) = _
      rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, Polynomial.aeval_X]
      rfl
  have hzero : Φ h' = 0 := by
    rw [hΦ]
    simpa [Φ'] using hy
  have hmem : h' ∈ 𝔡 := by
    rw [h𝔡, Ideal.mem_comap, ← IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff WQ Q,
      ← IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff]
    exact hzero
  rw [hEq, h𝔪, ← IsLocalRing.ker_residue, ← Polynomial.ker_mapRingHom, RingHom.mem_ker] at hmem
  exact hne (by simpa using hmem)

name: FlatProperBaseChangeAlgebra.finite_of_isAlgebraic_residue
statement:
theorem finite_of_isAlgebraic_residue {R A : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
    [Algebra.FiniteType R A] (q : Ideal R) [q.IsPrime] (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime]
    (hq : q = p.comap (algebraMap R A))
    (halg : @Algebra.IsAlgebraic (ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime q))
      (ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime p)) _ _
      (ResidueField.map (Localization.localRingHom q p (algebraMap R A) hq)).toAlgebra) :
    @Module.Finite (ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime q)) (ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime p))
      _ _ (ResidueField.map (Localization.localRingHom q p (algebraMap R A) hq)).toAlgebra.toModule
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set κ := ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime q)
  set K := ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime p)
  letI : Algebra κ K := (ResidueField.map (Localization.localRingHom q p (algebraMap R A) hq)).toAlgebra
  let ι : A →+* K := (residue _).comp (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime p))
  have hι : ∀ r : R, ι (algebraMap R A r) =
      algebraMap κ K (residue _ (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q) r)) := by
    intro r
    change _ = ResidueField.map _ _
    rw [ResidueField.map_residue, Localization.localRingHom_to_map]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (Algebra.FiniteType.out : (⊤ : Subalgebra R A).FG)
  set S := Algebra.adjoin κ (ι '' (s : Set A))
  have h1 : ∀ a : A, ι a ∈ S := by
    intro a
    have ha : a ∈ Algebra.adjoin R (s : Set A) := by rw [hs]; trivial
    induction ha using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
    | mem x hx => exact Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    | algebraMap r => rw [hι]; exact S.algebraMap_mem _
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact S.add_mem hx hy
    | mul x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_mul]; exact S.mul_mem hx hy
  have h2 : S = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro z _
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := residue_surjective z
    obtain ⟨a, b, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.exists_mk'_eq p.primeCompl z
    have hb : ι b ≠ 0 := by
      change residue _ (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime p) b) ≠ 0
      rw [Ne, IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff,
        IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff (Localization.AtPrime p) p]
      exact b.2
    have hz : residue _ (IsLocalization.mk' (Localization.AtPrime p) a b) = ι a * (ι b)⁻¹ := by
      rw [eq_mul_inv_iff_mul_eq₀ hb]
      change residue _ (IsLocalization.mk' (Localization.AtPrime p) a b) *
        residue _ (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime p) b) = residue _ (algebraMap A _ a)
      rw [← map_mul, IsLocalization.mk'_spec]
    rw [hz]
    exact S.mul_mem (h1 a) (Subalgebra.inv_mem_of_algebraic S (x := ⟨ι b, h1 b⟩)
      (halg.isAlgebraic (ι b)))
  haveI : Algebra.FiniteType κ K := ⟨⟨s.image ι, by rw [Finset.coe_image]; exact h2⟩⟩
  haveI : Algebra.IsIntegral κ K := Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isIntegral
  exact Algebra.IsIntegral.finite

name: FlatProperBaseChangeAlgebra.isLocalRing_quotient
statement:
theorem isLocalRing_quotient {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [IsLocalRing S] (I : Ideal S)
    (h : I ≤ maximalIdeal S) : IsLocalRing (S ⧸ I)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nontrivial (S ⧸ I) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr (ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal S).ne_top h)
  exact IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective

name: FlatProperBaseChangeAlgebra.map_le_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem map_le_maximalIdeal {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [IsLocalRing R]
    [IsLocalRing S] (f : R →+* S) [IsLocalHom f] : (maximalIdeal R).map f ≤ maximalIdeal S
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap]

name: FlatProperBaseChangeAlgebra.comap_mk_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem comap_mk_maximalIdeal {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [IsLocalRing S] (J : Ideal S)
    [IsLocalRing (S ⧸ J)] :
    (maximalIdeal (S ⧸ J)).comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) = maximalIdeal S
proof:
:=
  IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal
    (Ideal.comap_isMaximal_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective)

name: FlatProperBaseChangeAlgebra.finrank_eq_toNat_length
statement:
theorem finrank_eq_toNat_length (k V : Type*) [Field k] [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V] :
    Module.finrank k V = (Module.length k V).toNat
proof:
:= by
  rw [Module.length_eq_rank, Cardinal.toNat_toENat]
  rfl

name: FlatProperBaseChangeAlgebra.residueField_map_bijective
statement:
theorem residueField_map_bijective {X Y : Type*} [CommRing X] [CommRing Y] [IsLocalRing X]
    [IsLocalRing Y] (π : X →+* Y) [IsLocalHom π] (hπ : Function.Surjective π) :
    Function.Bijective (ResidueField.map π)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(ResidueField.map π).injective, fun y ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := residue_surjective y
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hπ y
  exact ⟨residue X x, ResidueField.map_residue _ _⟩

name: FlatProperBaseChangeAlgebra.ld_eq_of_surj
statement:
theorem ld_eq_of_surj {R S R' S' : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing R'] [CommRing S']
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing R'] [IsLocalRing S] [IsLocalRing S'] (φ : R →+* S)
    (ψ : R' →+* S') [IsLocalHom φ] [IsLocalHom ψ] (π₁ : R →+* R') (π₂ : S →+* S')
    [IsLocalHom π₁] [IsLocalHom π₂] (h₁ : Function.Surjective π₁)
    (h₂ : Function.Surjective π₂) (h : ∀ r, π₂ (φ r) = ψ (π₁ r)) : ld φ = ld ψ
proof:
:= by
  unfold ld
  letI := (ResidueField.map φ).toAlgebra
  letI := (ResidueField.map ψ).toAlgebra
  refine Algebra.finrank_eq_of_equiv_equiv
    (RingEquiv.ofBijective _ (residueField_map_bijective π₁ h₁))
    (RingEquiv.ofBijective _ (residueField_map_bijective π₂ h₂)) ?_
  ext x
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := residue_surjective x
  change ResidueField.map ψ (ResidueField.map π₁ (residue R x)) =
    ResidueField.map π₂ (ResidueField.map φ (residue R x))
  simp [ResidueField.map_residue, h]

name: FlatProperBaseChangeAlgebra.isLocalHom_of_comap
statement:
theorem isLocalHom_of_comap {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [IsLocalRing R]
    [IsLocalRing S] (f : R →+* S) (h : maximalIdeal R ≤ (maximalIdeal S).comap f) :
    IsLocalHom f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun a ha ↦ ?_⟩
  by_contra hna
  have : f a ∈ maximalIdeal S := h hna
  exact (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal _).mp this ha

name: FlatProperBaseChangeAlgebra.lc_localRingHom_congr
statement:
theorem lc_localRingHom_congr {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] {I₁ I₂ : Ideal R}
    [I₁.IsPrime] [I₂.IsPrime] (J : Ideal S) [J.IsPrime] (f : R →+* S) (h₁ : I₁ = J.comap f)
    (h₂ : I₂ = J.comap f) :
    lc (Localization.localRingHom I₁ J f h₁) = lc (Localization.localRingHom I₂ J f h₂)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl : I₁ = I₂ := h₁.trans h₂.symm
  rfl

name: FlatProperBaseChangeAlgebra.ld_localRingHom_congr
statement:
theorem ld_localRingHom_congr {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] {I₁ I₂ : Ideal R}
    [I₁.IsPrime] [I₂.IsPrime] (J : Ideal S) [J.IsPrime] (f : R →+* S) (h₁ : I₁ = J.comap f)
    (h₂ : I₂ = J.comap f) :
    ld (Localization.localRingHom I₁ J f h₁) = ld (Localization.localRingHom I₂ J f h₂)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl : I₁ = I₂ := h₁.trans h₂.symm
  rfl

name: FlatProperBaseChangeAlgebra.mapAtPrime_algebraMap
statement:
theorem mapAtPrime_algebraMap {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (I : Ideal R) [I.IsPrime]
    (J : Ideal S) [J.IsPrime] (f : R →+* S) (hIJ : I = J.comap f) (Rₚ : Type*) [CommRing Rₚ]
    [Algebra R Rₚ] [IsLocalization.AtPrime Rₚ I] (x : R) :
    mapAtPrime I J f hIJ Rₚ (algebraMap R Rₚ x) = algebraMap S _ (f x)
proof:
:=
  IsLocalization.map_eq _ _

name: FlatProperBaseChangeAlgebra.ld_localRingHom_eq_map
statement:
theorem ld_localRingHom_eq_map {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (I : Ideal R) [I.IsPrime]
    (J : Ideal S) [J.IsPrime] (f : R →+* S) (hIJ : I = J.comap f) (Rₚ : Type*) [CommRing Rₚ]
    [Algebra R Rₚ] [IsLocalization.AtPrime Rₚ I] [IsLocalRing Rₚ] :
    ld (Localization.localRingHom _ J f rfl) = ld (mapAtPrime I J f hIJ Rₚ)
proof:
:= by
  subst hIJ
  refine ld_eq_of_equiv _ _ (IsLocalization.algEquiv (J.comap f).primeCompl
    (Localization.AtPrime (J.comap f)) Rₚ).toRingEquiv (RingEquiv.refl _) (fun r ↦ ?_)
  obtain ⟨⟨a, s⟩, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.mk'_surjective (J.comap f).primeCompl r
  simp only [RingEquiv.refl_apply, AlgEquiv.toRingEquiv_eq_coe, AlgEquiv.coe_ringEquiv,
    IsLocalization.algEquiv_mk', Localization.localRingHom_mk', mapAtPrime, IsLocalization.map_mk']

name: FlatProperBaseChangeAlgebra.lc_eq_length_of_surj
statement:
theorem lc_eq_length_of_surj {R S N : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing N]
    [IsLocalRing R] (φ : R →+* S) (π : S →+* N) (hπ : Function.Surjective π)
    (hker : RingHom.ker π = (maximalIdeal R).map φ) :
    letI
proof:
:= π.toAlgebra
    lc φ = (Module.length S N).toNat := by
  letI := π.toAlgebra
  unfold lc
  congr 1
  let e₁ := Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective (f := Algebra.ofId S N) hπ
  let e₂ := Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq S (hker : RingHom.ker (Algebra.ofId S N) = _)
  exact (e₂.symm.trans e₁).toLinearEquiv.length_eq

name: FlatProperBaseChangeAlgebra.toNat_length_restrict
statement:
theorem toNat_length_restrict (B N : Type*) [CommRing B] [CommRing N] [IsLocalRing B]
    [IsLocalRing N] [Algebra B N] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap B N)] :
    (Module.length B N).toNat = (Module.length N N).toNat * ld (algebraMap B N)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsLocalRing.length_restrictScalars B N N, ENat.toNat_mul]
  congr 1
  unfold ld
  rw [residueField_map_toAlgebra, finrank_eq_toNat_length]

name: FlatProperBaseChangeAlgebra.toNat_sum_of_ne_top
statement:
theorem toNat_sum_of_ne_top {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℕ∞) (h : ∑ i ∈ s, f i ≠ ⊤) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, f i).toNat = ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).toNat
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert ha] at h ⊢
    rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, ENat.toNat_add (WithTop.add_ne_top.mp h).1 (WithTop.add_ne_top.mp h).2,
      ih (WithTop.add_ne_top.mp h).2]

name: FlatProperBaseChangeAlgebra.core
statement:
theorem core [Algebra.FiniteType R A] :
    ∃ s : Finset (PrimeSpectrum (A ⊗[R] R')),
      (∀ P ∈ s, P.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] R')) = p ∧ P.asIdeal.comap rR' = q') ∧
      (∀ P : PrimeSpectrum (A ⊗[R] R'), P.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap A _) = p →
        P.asIdeal.comap rR' = q' →
        lc (Localization.localRingHom _ P.asIdeal (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] R')) rfl) *
          ld (Localization.localRingHom _ P.asIdeal rR' rfl) ≠ 0 → P ∈ s) ∧
      ∑ P ∈ s, lc (Localization.localRingHom _ P.asIdeal (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] R')) rfl) *
          ld (Localization.localRingHom _ P.asIdeal rR' rfl) =
        ld (Localization.localRingHom q p (algebraMap R A) hp) * lc φB
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hI : 𝔍 ≤ maximalIdeal 𝒪₂ := map_le_maximalIdeal φB
  haveI : IsLocalRing 𝔅 := isLocalRing_quotient 𝔍 hI
  letI : Algebra 𝕜 𝕂 := (ResidueField.map φA).toAlgebra
  let κBq : 𝕜 →+* 𝔅 := Ideal.Quotient.lift (maximalIdeal 𝒪) ((Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝔍).comp φB)
    (fun x hx ↦ Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hx))
  letI : Algebra 𝕜 𝔅 := κBq.toAlgebra
  
  let ιK : A →+* 𝕂 := (residue 𝒪₁).comp (algebraMap A 𝒪₁)
  have e2 : ∀ r : R, algebraMap R 𝔅 r = κBq (residue 𝒪 (algebraMap R 𝒪 r)) := by
    intro r
    change _ = Ideal.Quotient.lift _ _ _ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ _)
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.lift_mk, ← Ideal.Quotient.mk_algebraMap]
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝔍 _ = Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝔍 (φB _)
    rw [hφB, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R R' 𝒪₂]
  have e1 : ∀ r : R, ιK (algebraMap R A r) = algebraMap 𝕜 𝕂 (residue 𝒪 (algebraMap R 𝒪 r)) := by
    intro r
    change _ = ResidueField.map φA _
    rw [ResidueField.map_residue, Localization.localRingHom_to_map]
    rfl
  let fB : R' →ₐ[R] 𝕎 := (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (R := 𝕜) (S := R) (A := 𝔅)
    (B := 𝕂)).comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R R' 𝔅)
  let fA : A →ₐ[R] 𝕎 :=
    { toRingHom := Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom.comp ιK
      commutes' := by
        intro r
        rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_apply]
        change Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (ιK (algebraMap R A r)) = _
        rw [e1, AlgHom.commutes, Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_apply, e2]
        rfl }
  let θ₀ := (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift fA fB (fun x y ↦ Commute.all (fA x) (fB y))).toRingHom
  have hθ₀ : ∀ (a : A) (r' : R'), θ₀ (a ⊗ₜ r') = (algebraMap R' 𝔅 r' ⊗ₜ ιK a : 𝕎) := by
    intro a r'
    change Algebra.TensorProduct.lift fA fB _ (a ⊗ₜ r') = _
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_tmul]
    change (1 ⊗ₜ ιK a : 𝕎) * (algebraMap R' 𝔅 r' ⊗ₜ 1) = _
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, one_mul, mul_one]

    have htmΦ : ∀ Q : PrimeSpectrum 𝕎,
        lc (Localization.localRingHom _ (Φ Q).asIdeal (algebraMap A 𝕋) rfl) *
          ld (Localization.localRingHom _ (Φ Q).asIdeal rR' rfl) =
        (Module.length 𝔅 (Localization.AtPrime Q.asIdeal)).toNat := by
      intro Q
      obtain ⟨Q', _, hQ', -, h⟩ := hterm (Φ Q) (hΦA Q) (hΦB Q)
      obtain rfl : Q' = Q.asIdeal := huniq _ _ hQ'
      exact h
    refine ⟨Finset.univ.image Φ, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro P hP
      obtain ⟨Q, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hP
      exact ⟨hΦA Q, hΦB Q⟩
    · intro P hA hB _
      obtain ⟨Q, hQp, hQθ, -, -⟩ := hterm P hA hB
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨⟨Q, hQp⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, PrimeSpectrum.ext hQθ⟩
    · rw [Finset.sum_image (fun _ _ _ _ h ↦ hΦinj h)]
      simp_rw [htmΦ]
      rw [← toNat_sum_of_ne_top _ _ (hsum ▸ hW), ← hsum, length_W_eq, ENat.toNat_mul,
        ENat.toNat_coe, hRHS_ld, hRHS_lc]
  · refine ⟨∅, by simp, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro P hA hB hne
      exfalso
      obtain ⟨Q, hQp, -, hgood, h⟩ := hterm P hA hB
      rw [h] at hne
      have hfin : Module.length 𝔅 (Localization.AtPrime Q) ≠ ⊤ := fun ht ↦ hne (by rw [ht]; rfl)
      haveI := isLocalHom_of_good Q hgood
      have hr := IsLocalRing.length_restrictScalars 𝔅 (Localization.AtPrime Q)
        (Localization.AtPrime Q)
      rw [hr] at hfin
      have hb0 : Module.length (ResidueField 𝔅) (ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime Q)) ≠ 0 :=
        (Module.length_pos).ne'
      have h1 : Module.length (Localization.AtPrime Q) (Localization.AtPrime Q) ≠ ⊤ := by
        intro ht; rw [ht, ENat.top_mul hb0] at hfin; exact hfin rfl
      have h0 : Module.length (Localization.AtPrime Q) (Localization.AtPrime Q) ≠ 0 :=
        (Module.length_pos).ne'
      have h2' : Module.length (ResidueField 𝔅) (ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime Q)) ≠ ⊤ := by
        intro ht; rw [ht, ENat.mul_top h0] at hfin; exact hfin rfl
      have h2 : Module.Finite (ResidueField 𝔅) (ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime Q)) := by
        have := (isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp (Module.length_ne_top_iff.mp h2')).1
        exact Module.IsNoetherian.finite _ _
      have halg := isAlgebraic_of_good Q hgood h1 h2
      have hK : Module.Finite 𝕜 𝕂 := finite_of_isAlgebraic_residue q p hp halg
      exact hcase ⟨hK, length_ne_top_of_good Q hgood h1⟩
    · rw [Finset.sum_empty, hRHS_ld, hRHS_lc]
      by_cases hK : Module.Finite 𝕜 𝕂
      · have hB : Module.length 𝔅 𝔅 = ⊤ := by
          by_contra hB; exact hcase ⟨hK, hB⟩
        rw [hB]; simp
      · rw [Module.finrank_of_not_finite hK, zero_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.bc_lc_arrow
statement:
theorem bc_lc_arrow {R S R' S' : CommRingCat.{u}} [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing R'] (f : R ⟶ S)
    (g : R' ⟶ S') (e : Arrow.mk f ≅ Arrow.mk g) : lc f.hom = lc g.hom
proof:
:=
  lc_eq_of_equiv _ _ (Arrow.leftFunc.mapIso e).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
    (Arrow.rightFunc.mapIso e).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv (fun r ↦
      (congrArg (fun h ↦ h.hom r) (Arrow.w_mk_right e.hom)).symm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.bc_ld_arrow
statement:
theorem bc_ld_arrow {R S R' S' : CommRingCat.{u}} [IsLocalRing R] [IsLocalRing R'] [IsLocalRing S]
    [IsLocalRing S'] (f : R ⟶ S) (g : R' ⟶ S') [IsLocalHom f.hom] [IsLocalHom g.hom]
    (e : Arrow.mk f ≅ Arrow.mk g) : ld f.hom = ld g.hom
proof:
:=
  ld_eq_of_equiv _ _ (Arrow.leftFunc.mapIso e).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
    (Arrow.rightFunc.mapIso e).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv (fun r ↦
      (congrArg (fun h ↦ h.hom r) (Arrow.w_mk_right e.hom)).symm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.bc_coeff_eq_lc
statement: theorem bc_coeff_eq_lc (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : X) : flatPullbackCoeff f x = lc (f.stalkMap x).hom
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.bc_degree_eq_ld
statement: theorem bc_degree_eq_ld (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : X) : f.degree x = ld (f.stalkMap x).hom
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.bc_coeff_congr
statement:
theorem bc_coeff_congr {f₁ f₂ : X ⟶ Y} (e : f₁ = f₂) (x : X) :
    flatPullbackCoeff f₁ x = flatPullbackCoeff f₂ x
proof: := by subst e; rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.bc_degree_congr
statement: theorem bc_degree_congr {f₁ f₂ : X ⟶ Y} (e : f₁ = f₂) (x : X) : f₁.degree x = f₂.degree x
proof:
:= by
  subst e; rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.bc_coeff_comp_right
statement:
theorem bc_coeff_comp_right (h : Z ⟶ X) (ι : X ⟶ Y) (z : Z) [IsIso (ι.stalkMap (h z))] :
    flatPullbackCoeff (h ≫ ι) z = flatPullbackCoeff h z
proof:
:=
  lc_eq_of_equiv _ _ (asIso (ι.stalkMap (h z))).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv (RingEquiv.refl _)
    (fun r ↦ congrArg (fun k ↦ k.hom r) (Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp h ι z))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.bc_degree_comp_right
statement:
theorem bc_degree_comp_right (h : Z ⟶ X) (ι : X ⟶ Y) (z : Z) [IsIso (ι.stalkMap (h z))] :
    (h ≫ ι).degree z = h.degree z
proof:
:=
  ld_eq_of_equiv _ _ (asIso (ι.stalkMap (h z))).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv (RingEquiv.refl _)
    (fun r ↦ congrArg (fun k ↦ k.hom r) (Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp h ι z))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.bc_coeff_comp_left
statement:
theorem bc_coeff_comp_left (φ : Z ⟶ X) (h : X ⟶ Y) (z : Z) [IsIso (φ.stalkMap z)] :
    flatPullbackCoeff (φ ≫ h) z = flatPullbackCoeff h (φ z)
proof:
:=
  lc_eq_of_equiv _ _ (RingEquiv.refl _) (asIso (φ.stalkMap z)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.symm
    (fun r ↦ by
      rw [congrArg (fun k ↦ k.hom r) (Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp φ h z)]
      exact RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.bc_degree_comp_left
statement:
theorem bc_degree_comp_left (φ : Z ⟶ X) (h : X ⟶ Y) (z : Z) [IsIso (φ.stalkMap z)] :
    (φ ≫ h).degree z = h.degree (φ z)
proof:
:=
  ld_eq_of_equiv _ _ (RingEquiv.refl _) (asIso (φ.stalkMap z)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.symm
    (fun r ↦ by
      rw [congrArg (fun k ↦ k.hom r) (Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp φ h z)]
      exact RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.bc_coeff_Spec
statement:
theorem bc_coeff_Spec {R S : CommRingCat.{u}} (φ : R ⟶ S) (P : Spec S) :
    flatPullbackCoeff (Spec.map φ) P =
      lc (Localization.localRingHom (P.asIdeal.comap φ.hom) P.asIdeal φ.hom rfl)
proof:
:=
  bc_lc_arrow _ _ (Scheme.arrowStalkMapSpecIso φ P)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.bc_degree_Spec
statement:
theorem bc_degree_Spec {R S : CommRingCat.{u}} (φ : R ⟶ S) (P : Spec S) :
    (Spec.map φ).degree P =
      ld (Localization.localRingHom (P.asIdeal.comap φ.hom) P.asIdeal φ.hom rfl)
proof:
:= by
  have h : IsLocalHom (CommRingCat.ofHom (Localization.localRingHom
      (PrimeSpectrum.comap φ.hom P).asIdeal P.asIdeal φ.hom rfl)).hom :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsLocalHom (Localization.localRingHom _ _ _ rfl))
  exact @bc_ld_arrow _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ inferInstance h (Scheme.arrowStalkMapSpecIso φ P)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.bc_htr
statement:
theorem bc_htr {R A R' : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing R'] [Algebra R A]
    [Algebra R R'] (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ Y') (ιA : Spec (CommRingCat.of A) ⟶ X)
    (ιB : Spec (CommRingCat.of R') ⟶ Y') [IsOpenImmersion ιA] [IsOpenImmersion ιB]
    (φ : Spec (CommRingCat.of (A ⊗[R] R')) ⟶ X') [IsOpenImmersion φ]
    (hφg' : φ ≫ g' = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] R'))) ≫ ιA)
    (hφf' : φ ≫ f' = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom : R' →+* A ⊗[R] R')) ≫ ιB)
    (P : Spec (CommRingCat.of (A ⊗[R] R'))) :
    flatPullbackCoeff g' (φ P) * f'.degree (φ P) =
      lc (Localization.localRingHom _ P.asIdeal (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] R')) rfl) *
      ld (Localization.localRingHom _ P.asIdeal
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom : R' →+* A ⊗[R] R') rfl)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← bc_coeff_comp_left φ g' P, ← bc_degree_comp_left φ f' P, bc_coeff_congr hφg',
    bc_degree_congr hφf', bc_coeff_comp_right, bc_degree_comp_right, bc_coeff_Spec,
    bc_degree_Spec]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.bc_pointwise
statement:
theorem bc_pointwise (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (f' : X' ⟶ Y') (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (hsq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (x : X) (y' : Y') (hxy : f x = g y') :
    ∃ s : Finset X', (∀ x' ∈ s, g' x' = x ∧ f' x' = y') ∧
      (∀ x', g' x' = x → f' x' = y' → flatPullbackCoeff g' x' * f'.degree x' ≠ 0 → x' ∈ s) ∧
      ∑ x' ∈ s, flatPullbackCoeff g' x' * f'.degree x' = f.degree x * flatPullbackCoeff g y'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hyV, -⟩ := exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (x := f x) (U := ⊤) (by simp)
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hxU, hUV⟩ :=
    exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (x := x) (U := f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (show f x ∈ V from hyV)
  obtain ⟨U', hU', hyU', hUV'⟩ :=
    exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (x := y') (U := g ⁻¹ᵁ V) (show g y' ∈ V from hxy ▸ hyV)
  have hle : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V := fun z hz ↦ hUV hz
  have hle' : U' ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V := fun z hz ↦ hUV' hz
  let α := f.appLE V U hle
  let β := g.appLE V U' hle'
  letI : Algebra Γ(Y, V) Γ(X, U) := α.hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra Γ(Y, V) Γ(Y', U') := β.hom.toAlgebra
  haveI : Algebra.FiniteType Γ(Y, V) Γ(X, U) :=
    HasRingHomProperty.appLE @LocallyOfFiniteType f ‹_› ⟨V, hV⟩ ⟨U, hU⟩ hle
  have e₁ : Spec.map α ≫ hV.fromSpec = hU.fromSpec ≫ f := IsAffineOpen.SpecMap_appLE_fromSpec f hV hU hle
  have e₂ : Spec.map β ≫ hV.fromSpec = hU'.fromSpec ≫ g :=
    IsAffineOpen.SpecMap_appLE_fromSpec g hV hU' hle'
  let ψ := pullback.map (Spec.map α) (Spec.map β) f g hU.fromSpec hU'.fromSpec hV.fromSpec e₁ e₂
  let φ : Spec (.of (Γ(X, U) ⊗[Γ(Y, V)] Γ(Y', U'))) ⟶ X' :=
    (pullbackSpecIso Γ(Y, V) Γ(X, U) Γ(Y', U')).inv ≫ ψ ≫ hsq.isoPullback.inv
  haveI : IsOpenImmersion φ := by
    dsimp only [φ]; infer_instance
  have hφg' : φ ≫ g' = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Γ(X, U)
      (Γ(X, U) ⊗[Γ(Y, V)] Γ(Y', U')))) ≫ hU.fromSpec := by
    simp only [φ, ψ, Category.assoc, IsPullback.isoPullback_inv_fst, pullback.lift_fst]
    rw [← Category.assoc]
    congr 1
    exact pullbackSpecIso_inv_fst' _ _ _
  have hφf' : φ ≫ f' = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom :
        Γ(Y', U') →+* Γ(X, U) ⊗[Γ(Y, V)] Γ(Y', U'))) ≫ hU'.fromSpec := by
    simp only [φ, ψ, Category.assoc, IsPullback.isoPullback_inv_snd, pullback.lift_snd]
    rw [← Category.assoc]
    congr 1
    exact pullbackSpecIso_inv_snd _ _ _
  let p := hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxU⟩
  let q' := hU'.primeIdealOf ⟨y', hyU'⟩
  have hp_pt : hU.fromSpec p = x := hU.fromSpec_primeIdealOf _
  have hq_pt : hU'.fromSpec q' = y' := hU'.fromSpec_primeIdealOf _
  have hpq : q'.asIdeal.comap β.hom = p.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap Γ(Y, V) Γ(X, U)) := by
    have h1 := IsAffineOpen.comap_primeIdealOf_appLE V hV U hU hle hxU
    have h2 := IsAffineOpen.comap_primeIdealOf_appLE V hV U' hU' hle' hyU'
    have h3 : hV.primeIdealOf ⟨f x, hle hxU⟩ = hV.primeIdealOf ⟨g y', hle' hyU'⟩ :=
      congrArg hV.primeIdealOf (Subtype.ext hxy)
    exact congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal (h2.trans (h3.symm.trans h1.symm))
  obtain ⟨s₀, hmem, hcompl, hsum⟩ := FlatProperBaseChangeAlgebra.core (R := Γ(Y, V)) (A := Γ(X, U))
    (R' := Γ(Y', U')) (q'.asIdeal.comap β.hom) p.asIdeal q'.asIdeal hpq
    (O₂ := Localization.AtPrime q'.asIdeal)
    (Localization.localRingHom (q'.asIdeal.comap β.hom) q'.asIdeal β.hom rfl)
    (fun r ↦ Localization.localRingHom_to_map _ _ _ _ r)
  have htr : ∀ P, flatPullbackCoeff g' (φ P) * f'.degree (φ P) =
      lc (Localization.localRingHom _ P.asIdeal
        (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (Γ(X, U) ⊗[Γ(Y, V)] Γ(Y', U'))) rfl) *
      ld (Localization.localRingHom _ P.asIdeal
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom :
          Γ(Y', U') →+* Γ(X, U) ⊗[Γ(Y, V)] Γ(Y', U')) rfl) :=
    fun P ↦ bc_htr g' f' hU.fromSpec hU'.fromSpec φ hφg' hφf' P
  have hdeg : f.degree x = ld (Localization.localRingHom (q'.asIdeal.comap β.hom) p.asIdeal
      (algebraMap Γ(Y, V) Γ(X, U)) hpq) := by
    rw [← hp_pt, ← bc_degree_comp_left hU.fromSpec f p, ← bc_degree_congr e₁,
      bc_degree_comp_right, bc_degree_Spec]
    exact ld_localRingHom_congr _ _ rfl hpq
  have hcoef : flatPullbackCoeff g y' =
      lc (Localization.localRingHom (q'.asIdeal.comap β.hom) q'.asIdeal β.hom rfl) := by
    rw [← hq_pt, ← bc_coeff_comp_left hU'.fromSpec g q', ← bc_coeff_congr e₂,
      bc_coeff_comp_right, bc_coeff_Spec]
  have hptA : ∀ P : Spec (.of (Γ(X, U) ⊗[Γ(Y, V)] Γ(Y', U'))), g' (φ P) =
      hU.fromSpec (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Γ(X, U)
        (Γ(X, U) ⊗[Γ(Y, V)] Γ(Y', U')))) P) := fun P ↦ by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hφg', Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  have hptB : ∀ P : Spec (.of (Γ(X, U) ⊗[Γ(Y, V)] Γ(Y', U'))), f' (φ P) =
      hU'.fromSpec (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom :
          Γ(Y', U') →+* Γ(X, U) ⊗[Γ(Y, V)] Γ(Y', U'))) P) := fun P ↦ by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hφf', Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  have hinj : Function.Injective φ := φ.isOpenEmbedding.injective
  have hrange : ∀ x', g' x' ∈ Set.range hU.fromSpec → f' x' ∈ Set.range hU'.fromSpec →
      x' ∈ Set.range φ := by
    intro x' h1 h2
    have hz : hsq.isoPullback.hom x' ∈ Set.range ψ := by
      rw [Scheme.Pullback.range_map]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · show pullback.fst f g (hsq.isoPullback.hom x') ∈ Set.range hU.fromSpec
        rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hsq.isoPullback_hom_fst]; exact h1
      · show pullback.snd f g (hsq.isoPullback.hom x') ∈ Set.range hU'.fromSpec
        rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hsq.isoPullback_hom_snd]; exact h2
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hz
    refine ⟨(pullbackSpecIso Γ(Y, V) Γ(X, U) Γ(Y', U')).hom z, ?_⟩
    change hsq.isoPullback.inv (ψ ((pullbackSpecIso Γ(Y, V) Γ(X, U) Γ(Y', U')).inv
      ((pullbackSpecIso Γ(Y, V) Γ(X, U) Γ(Y', U')).hom z))) = x'
    rw [Scheme.hom_inv_apply, hz, Scheme.hom_inv_apply]
  refine ⟨s₀.image φ, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x' hx'
    obtain ⟨P, hP, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx'
    obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := hmem P hP
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hptA, ← hp_pt]
      congr 1
      exact PrimeSpectrum.ext hA
    · rw [hptB, ← hq_pt]
      congr 1
      exact PrimeSpectrum.ext hB
  · intro x' hgx hfx hne
    obtain ⟨P, rfl⟩ := hrange x' ⟨p, hp_pt.trans hgx.symm⟩ ⟨q', hq_pt.trans hfx.symm⟩
    refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨P, hcompl P ?_ ?_ ?_, rfl⟩
    · have := hU.fromSpec.isOpenEmbedding.injective ((hptA P).symm.trans (hgx.trans hp_pt.symm))
      exact congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal this
    · have := hU'.fromSpec.isOpenEmbedding.injective ((hptB P).symm.trans (hfx.trans hq_pt.symm))
      exact congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal this
    · rw [← htr]; exact hne
  · rw [Finset.sum_image (fun a _ b _ h ↦ hinj h), Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun P _ ↦ htr P),
      hdeg, hcoef]
    exact hsum

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.bc_properPushforward_apply_eq_sum
statement:
theorem bc_properPushforward_apply_eq_sum (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] (D : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ)
    (y : Y) (T : Finset X) (hT : ∀ x, f x = y → D x * (f.degree x : ℤ) ≠ 0 → x ∈ T) :
    properPushforward f D y = ∑ x ∈ T with f x = y, D x * (f.degree x : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set T' := T ∪ (f.preimageSupportFinite D y).toFinset
  rw [properPushforward_apply_eq_sum_of_subset f D y T' (fun x hx hD ↦ Finset.mem_union_right _
    ((mem_preimageSupportFinite_toFinset_iff f D y x).mpr ⟨hx, hD⟩))]
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_subset
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at hx ⊢
    exact ⟨Finset.mem_union_left _ hx.1, hx.2⟩
  · intro x hx hx'
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at hx hx'
    by_contra h
    exact hx' ⟨hT x hx.2 h, hx.2⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.flatPullback_properPushforward
statement:
theorem flatPullback_properPushforward (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (f' : X' ⟶ Y') (g' : X' ⟶ X) [IsProper f] [Flat g] [IsLocallyNoetherian X']
    [IsLocallyNoetherian Y'] [QuasiCompact f']
    (hsq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (D : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) :
    flatPullback g (properPushforward f D) = properPushforward f' (flatPullback g' D)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext y'
  rw [flatPullback_apply, properPushforward_apply]
  set S := (f.preimageSupportFinite D (g y')).toFinset
  have hS : ∀ x ∈ S, f x = g y' := fun x hx ↦
    ((mem_preimageSupportFinite_toFinset_iff f D _ x).mp hx).1
  let sx : X → Finset X' := fun x ↦
    if h : f x = g y' then Classical.choose (bc_pointwise f g f' g' hsq x y' h) else ∅
  have hsx : ∀ x, f x = g y' →
      (∀ x' ∈ sx x, g' x' = x ∧ f' x' = y') ∧
      (∀ x', g' x' = x → f' x' = y' → flatPullbackCoeff g' x' * f'.degree x' ≠ 0 → x' ∈ sx x) ∧
      ∑ x' ∈ sx x, flatPullbackCoeff g' x' * f'.degree x' =
        f.degree x * flatPullbackCoeff g y' := by
    intro x h
    simp only [sx, dif_pos h]
    exact Classical.choose_spec (bc_pointwise f g f' g' hsq x y' h)
  have hw : ∀ x', f (g' x') = g (f' x') := fun x' ↦ by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hsq.w, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  rw [bc_properPushforward_apply_eq_sum f' _ y' (S.biUnion sx) (by
    intro x' hx' hne
    rw [flatPullback_apply] at hne
    have hD : D (g' x') ≠ 0 := by intro h; apply hne; simp [h]
    have hc : flatPullbackCoeff g' x' * f'.degree x' ≠ 0 := by
      intro h; apply hne
      rw [mul_assoc, ← Nat.cast_mul, h, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero]
    have hfx : f (g' x') = g y' := (hw x').trans (congrArg g hx')
    exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨g' x', (mem_preimageSupportFinite_toFinset_iff f D _ _).mpr
      ⟨hfx, hD⟩, (hsx _ hfx).2.1 x' rfl hx' hc⟩)]
  have hfilter : (S.biUnion sx).filter (fun x' ↦ f' x' = y') = S.biUnion sx := by
    apply Finset.filter_true_of_mem
    intro x' hx'
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hx'
    exact ((hsx x (hS x hx)).1 x' hx').2
  rw [hfilter, Finset.sum_biUnion]
  · rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x hx ↦ ?_)
    obtain ⟨h1, -, h3⟩ := hsx x (hS x hx)
    have : ∀ x' ∈ sx x, flatPullback g' D x' * (f'.degree x' : ℤ) =
        D x * ((flatPullbackCoeff g' x' * f'.degree x' : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
      intro x' hx'
      rw [flatPullback_apply, (h1 x' hx').1]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl this, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Nat.cast_sum, h3]
    push_cast
    ring
  · intro x₁ hx₁ x₂ hx₂ hne
    rw [Function.onFun, Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro x' h₁ h₂
    exact hne (((hsx x₁ (hS x₁ hx₁)).1 x' h₁).1.symm.trans ((hsx x₂ (hS x₂ hx₂)).1 x' h₂).1)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SurfaceExpectedRestrictionOrderData.ofLocalFactorizations
statement:
theorem SurfaceExpectedRestrictionOrderData.ofLocalFactorizations
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNoetherian X]
    [IsRegularInCodimensionOne X] [Order.KrullDimLE 2 X]
    {g : RationalRelationGenerator X 1} {hg : g.cycle ≠ 0}
    {z : CodimensionPoint X 1} {hcycle : g.cycle.1 z.1 = 0}
    (P : ∀ y : pointClosureScheme z.1,
      SurfaceRestrictionLocalFactorizationAt g hg z hcycle y) :
    SurfaceExpectedRestrictionOrderData g hg z hcycle where
  order_eq
proof:
:= by
    classical
    intro y
    show div (X := pointClosureScheme z.1)
      (g.surfaceRestrictionRelationAt hg z hcycle).f y = _
    have hprod : (∏ x : (compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1).support,
        (P y).factor x ^ compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1 x) ≠ 0 :=
      Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun i _ ↦ zpow_ne_zero _ ((P y).factor_ne_zero i)
    have hfeq : ((g.surfaceRestrictionRelationAt hg z hcycle).f :
        (pointClosureScheme z.1).functionField) =
        (P y).unit * ∏ x, (P y).factor x ^ compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1 x :=
      (P y).function_eq
    have happ : (div (P y).unit +
        ∑ x : (compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1).support,
          compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1 x • div ((P y).factor x)) y =
        div (P y).unit y +
          ∑ x : (compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1).support,
            compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1 x * div ((P y).factor x) y := by
      simp
    rw [hfeq, div_mul _ (P y).unit_ne_zero _ hprod,
      div_finset_prod_zpow Finset.univ (P y).factor
        (fun i _ ↦ (P y).factor_ne_zero i), happ,
      (P y).unit_order_eq_zero, zero_add]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ ↦ by rw [(P y).factor_order_eq x]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SurfaceLocalFactorizationTheory.toLocalTheory
statement:
theorem SurfaceLocalFactorizationTheory.toLocalTheory
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNoetherian X]
    [IsRegularInCodimensionOne X] [Order.KrullDimLE 2 X]
    (T : SurfaceLocalFactorizationTheory X) :
    SurfaceExpectedRestrictionLocalTheory X where
  orderData g hg z hcycle
proof:
:=
    SurfaceExpectedRestrictionOrderData.ofLocalFactorizations
      (T.factorizationAt g hg z hcycle)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.codimensionComponent_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem codimensionComponent_apply (R : Type*) [AddCommGroup R]
    (p : ℕ) (D : AlgebraicCycle X R) (x : X) :
    codimensionComponent X R p D x = if coheight x = p then D x else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hx : coheight x = p <;>
    simp [codimensionComponent, hx]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.codimensionComponent_mem
statement:
theorem codimensionComponent_mem (R : Type*) [AddCommGroup R]
    (p : ℕ) (D : AlgebraicCycle X R) :
    codimensionComponent X R p D ∈ codimensionCycles X R p
proof:
:=
  AlgebraicCycle.restrict_support_subset

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.codimensionComponent_eq_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem codimensionComponent_eq_self (R : Type*) [AddCommGroup R]
    (p : ℕ) (D : AlgebraicCycle X R)
    (hD : D ∈ codimensionCycles X R p) :
    codimensionComponent X R p D = D
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [codimensionComponent_apply]
  split
  · rfl
  · rename_i hx
    have hDx : D x = 0 := by
      by_contra h
      exact hx (hD h)
    exact hDx.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.codimensionComponent_idem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem codimensionComponent_idem (R : Type*) [AddCommGroup R]
    (p : ℕ) (D : AlgebraicCycle X R) :
    codimensionComponent X R p (codimensionComponent X R p D) =
      codimensionComponent X R p D
proof:
:=
  codimensionComponent_eq_self X R p _ (codimensionComponent_mem X R p D)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.codimensionComponent_range
statement:
theorem codimensionComponent_range (R : Type*) [AddCommGroup R] (p : ℕ) :
    (codimensionComponent X R p).range = codimensionCycles X R p
proof:
:= by
  ext D
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨E, rfl⟩
    exact codimensionComponent_mem X R p E
  · intro hD
    exact ⟨D, codimensionComponent_eq_self X R p D hD⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.codimensionComponent_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
theorem codimensionComponent_eq_zero_of_mem (R : Type*) [AddCommGroup R]
    {p q : ℕ} (hpq : p ≠ q)
    (D : AlgebraicCycle X R) (hD : D ∈ codimensionCycles X R q) :
    codimensionComponent X R p D = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [codimensionComponent_apply]
  split
  · rename_i hx
    have hDx : D x = 0 := by
      by_contra h
      have hq := hD h
      have hpq' : (p : ℕ∞) = (q : ℕ∞) := hx.symm.trans hq
      apply hpq
      exact_mod_cast hpq'
    simp [hDx]
  · rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.codimensionComponent_eq_zero_of_krullDimLE
statement:
theorem codimensionComponent_eq_zero_of_krullDimLE
    (R : Type*) [AddCommGroup R] (n p : ℕ) [Order.KrullDimLE n X]
    (hnp : n < p) (D : AlgebraicCycle X R) :
    codimensionComponent X R p D = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [codimensionComponent_apply]
  split
  · rename_i hx
    have hkrull : krullDim X ≤ (n : ℕ∞) :=
      Order.KrullDimLE.krullDim_le
    have hcoh : coheight x ≤ (n : ℕ∞) := by
      exact_mod_cast (coheight_le_krullDim x).trans hkrull
    rw [hx] at hcoh
    have hpn : p ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hcoh
    omega
  · rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.sum_codimensionComponent_eq
statement:
theorem sum_codimensionComponent_eq (R : Type*) [AddCommGroup R]
    (n : ℕ) [Order.KrullDimLE n X] (D : AlgebraicCycle X R) :
    ∑ p ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), codimensionComponent X R p D = D
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  let p := (coheight x).toNat
  have hkrull : krullDim X ≤ (n : ℕ∞) :=
    Order.KrullDimLE.krullDim_le
  have hcoh : coheight x ≤ (n : ℕ∞) := by
    exact_mod_cast (coheight_le_krullDim x).trans hkrull
  have hne : coheight x ≠ ⊤ := by
    exact (hcoh.trans_lt (ENat.coe_lt_top n)).ne
  have hpcoh : coheight x = (p : ℕ∞) := by
    exact (ENat.coe_toNat hne).symm
  have hpn : p ∈ Finset.range (n + 1) := by
    rw [Finset.mem_range, Nat.lt_succ_iff]
    exact ENat.toNat_le_of_le_coe hcoh
  simp only [Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single p]
  · simp [codimensionComponent_apply, hpcoh]
  · intro q hq hqp
    rw [codimensionComponent_apply]
    have hxq : coheight x ≠ (q : ℕ∞) := by
      rw [hpcoh]
      exact_mod_cast hqp.symm
    simp [hxq]
  · exact fun hp ↦ (hp hpn).elim

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.closedImmersion_coheight_ne_zero
statement:
theorem closedImmersion_coheight_ne_zero
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X 0) (y : g.Y) (hy : coheight y = 1) :
    coheight (g.i y) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have himax : IsMax (g.i y) := coheight_eq_zero.mp hzero
  have hiy : g.i y = genericPoint X := by
    exact ((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp le_top).antisymm
      (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp (himax le_top))).eq.symm
  have hle : y ≤ genericPoint g.Y := le_top
  have hmaple : g.i y ≤ g.i (genericPoint g.Y) :=
    Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr
      ((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hle).map g.i.continuous)
  have hiη : g.i (genericPoint g.Y) = genericPoint X := by
    have hgeneric_le : genericPoint X ≤ g.i (genericPoint g.Y) := by
      rw [← hiy]
      exact hmaple
    exact ((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp le_top).antisymm
      (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hgeneric_le)).eq.symm
  have hyη : y = genericPoint g.Y :=
    g.i.isClosedEmbedding.injective (hiy.trans hiη.symm)
  have hηzero : coheight (genericPoint g.Y) = 0 :=
    coheight_eq_zero.mpr isMax_top
  rw [hyη, hηzero] at hy
  exact zero_ne_one hy

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalRelationGenerator.cycle_eq_zero_of_codimension_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem RationalRelationGenerator.cycle_eq_zero_of_codimension_zero
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X 0) : g.cycle = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsupp :
      (AlgebraicCycle.pushforward g.i (div g.f)
        (fun _ ↦ (0 : ℕ∞)) coheight).support ⊆ (∅ : Set X) := by
    dsimp only [AlgebraicCycle.pushforward]
    apply Function.locallyFinsupp.map_homogeneous
      (s := {y : g.Y | coheight y = 1})
      (t := (∅ : Set X))
      g.i.isSpectralMap _ (div g.f) div_support
    intro y hy _
    exact (closedImmersion_coheight_ne_zero g y hy (g.codimension y hy)).elim
  apply Subtype.ext
  change AlgebraicCycle.pushforward g.i (div g.f)
      (fun _ ↦ (0 : ℕ∞)) coheight = 0
  exact AlgebraicCycle.homogeneous_ext hsupp (by simp) (by simp)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.rationalEquivalenceSubgroup_zero_eq_bot
statement:
theorem rationalEquivalenceSubgroup_zero_eq_bot :

proof:

  · rw [rationalEquivalenceSubgroup, AddSubgroup.closure_le]
    rintro D ⟨g, rfl⟩
    simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.codimensionZeroCoefficient_genericPointCycle
statement:
@[simp]
theorem codimensionZeroCoefficient_genericPointCycle (n : ℤ) :

proof:
:= by
  simp [codimensionZeroCoefficient]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.genericPointCycle_coefficient
statement:
theorem genericPointCycle_coefficient (D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ 0) :
    genericPointCycle (X := X) (codimensionZeroCoefficient D) = D
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext x
  classical
  by_cases hx : x = genericPoint X
  · subst x
    simp [codimensionZeroCoefficient]
  · have hDx : D.1 x = 0 := by
      by_contra h
      have hcoh : coheight x = 0 := D.property h
      have hmax : IsMax x := coheight_eq_zero.mp hcoh
      have hxη : x = genericPoint X := by
        exact ((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp le_top).antisymm
          (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp (hmax le_top))).eq.symm
      exact hx hxη
    rw [genericPointCycle_apply_of_ne _ _ hx]
    exact hDx.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.codimensionZeroChowCoefficient_classOf
statement:

theorem codimensionZeroChowCoefficient_classOf
