proof:
:=
  gradedClassLift_classOf _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.codimensionZeroPairing_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem codimensionZeroPairing_apply (q : ℕ)
    (D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ q) (E : CodimensionCycles X ℤ 0) :
    codimensionZeroPairing (X := X) q D E =
      codimensionZeroCoefficient E • D
proof:
:=
  by simp [codimensionZeroPairing]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.codimensionZeroProduct_eq_smul
statement:
theorem codimensionZeroProduct_eq_smul (q : ℕ)
    (x : CodimensionChow X q) (y : CodimensionChow X 0) :
    codimensionZeroProduct (X := X) q x y =
      codimensionZeroChowCoefficient y • x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective
    (rationalEquivalenceSubgroup X q) x
  obtain ⟨E, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective
    (rationalEquivalenceSubgroup X 0) y
  change (codimensionZeroIntersectionData (X := X) q).product
      (gradedClassOf X q D) (gradedClassOf X 0 E) =
    codimensionZeroChowCoefficient (gradedClassOf X 0 E) • gradedClassOf X q D
  rw [IntersectionPairingData.product_classOf_classOf,
    codimensionZeroChowCoefficient_classOf]
  change gradedClassOf X q
      (codimensionZeroPairing (X := X) q D E) =
    codimensionZeroCoefficient E • gradedClassOf X q D
  rw [codimensionZeroPairing_apply]
  change gradedClassMap X q (codimensionZeroCoefficient E • D) =
    codimensionZeroCoefficient E • gradedClassMap X q D
  exact map_zsmul (gradedClassMap X q) (codimensionZeroCoefficient E) D

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.codimensionZeroProduct_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem codimensionZeroProduct_one (q : ℕ) (x : CodimensionChow X q) :
    codimensionZeroProduct (X := X) q x
      (gradedClassOf X 0 (genericPointCycle (X := X) 1)) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [codimensionZeroProduct_eq_smul]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.rationalCodimensionZeroProduct_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rationalCodimensionZeroProduct_one (q : ℕ)
    (x : RationalCodimensionChow X q) :
    (codimensionZeroIntersectionData (X := X) q).rationalProduct x
      ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        gradedClassOf X 0 (genericPointCycle (X := X) 1)) = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a D =>
      rw [IntersectionPairingData.rationalProduct_tmul_tmul]
      change (a * 1) ⊗ₜ[ℤ]
        codimensionZeroProduct (X := X) q D
          (gradedClassOf X 0 (genericPointCycle (X := X) 1)) =
        a ⊗ₜ[ℤ] D
      rw [codimensionZeroProduct_one, mul_one]
  | add x y hx hy =>
      rw [IntersectionPairingData.rationalProduct_add_left, hx, hy]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_stalkPrime_congr
statement:
theorem f17_stalkPrime_congr {x₁ x₂ y : X} (h₁ : x₁ ⤳ y) (h₂ : x₂ ⤳ y) (e : x₁ = x₂) :
    stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h₁ = stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h₂
proof:
:= by
  subst e; rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_stalkPrime_self
statement:
theorem f17_stalkPrime_self {x y : X} (h : x ⤳ y) (e : x = y) :
    stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk y)

:= by
  subst e
  unfold stalkPrimeOfSpecializes

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_stalkPrime_le_iff
statement:
theorem f17_stalkPrime_le_iff {x₁ x₂ y : X} (h₁ : x₁ ⤳ y) (h₂ : x₂ ⤳ y) :
    stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h₁ ≤ stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h₂ ↔ x₁ ⤳ x₂
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ P Q : PrimeSpectrum (X.presheaf.stalk y),
      P ≤ Q ↔ X.fromSpecStalk y P ⤳ X.fromSpecStalk y Q := fun P Q ↦
    (PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes P Q).trans
      (X.fromSpecStalk y).isEmbedding.specializes_iff.symm
  have := key ⟨_, stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_isPrime h₁⟩ ⟨_, stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_isPrime h₂⟩
  rw [fromSpecStalk_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h₁, fromSpecStalk_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h₂] at this
  exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_comap_stalkPrime
statement:
theorem f17_comap_stalkPrime (f : X ⟶ Y) {x' x : X} (h : x' ⤳ x) :
    (stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h).comap (f.stalkMap x).hom =
      stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (h.map f.continuous)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomm := Scheme.Hom.stalkSpecializes_stalkMap f x' x h
  unfold stalkPrimeOfSpecializes
  rw [Ideal.comap_comap, ← CommRingCat.hom_comp, ← hcomm, CommRingCat.hom_comp,
    ← Ideal.comap_comap, IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_exists_generization
statement:
theorem f17_exists_generization (f : X ⟶ Y) [Flat f] (x : X) {y' : Y} (hy : y' ⤳ f x) :
    ∃ x', x' ⤳ x ∧ f x' = y'
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x) := (f.stalkMap x).hom.toAlgebra
  haveI : Module.Flat (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x) := Flat.stalkMap f x
  haveI : IsLocalHom (algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsLocalHom (f.stalkMap x).hom)
  haveI : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)).LiesOver
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x))) :=
    ⟨(IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap (algebraMap _ _)).symm⟩
  obtain ⟨P, -, hP, hPo⟩ := Ideal.exists_ideal_le_liesOver_of_le
    (p := stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hy) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal (Ideal.IsPrime.ne_top inferInstance))
  obtain ⟨x', h', hx'⟩ := exists_specializes_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_eq x P
  refine ⟨x', h', ?_⟩
  have h1 := f17_comap_stalkPrime f h'
  rw [hx'] at h1
  have h2 : P.comap (f.stalkMap x).hom = stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hy := hPo.over.symm
  exact stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_injective (h'.map f.continuous) hy (h1.symm.trans h2)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_coeff_ne_zero_of_max
statement:
theorem f17_coeff_ne_zero_of_max [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : X)
    (hmax : ∀ z, z ⤳ x → f z = f x → z = x) : flatPullbackCoeff f x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  set I := (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x))).map (f.stalkMap x).hom with hIdef
  have hIm : I ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x) := by
    rw [hIdef, Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap]
  have hI : ∀ P : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x), P.IsPrime → I ≤ P →
      P = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x) := by
    intro P hP hIP
    obtain ⟨z, h, rfl⟩ := exists_specializes_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_eq x P
    have hc : (stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h).comap (f.stalkMap x).hom =
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) := by
      apply le_antisymm (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal (Ideal.IsPrime.ne_top inferInstance))
      exact Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mp hIP
    rw [f17_comap_stalkPrime] at hc
    have hz : f z = f x := stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_injective _ (specializes_refl (f x))
      (hc.trans (f17_stalkPrime_self _ rfl).symm)
    have := hmax z h hz
    subst this
    exact f17_stalkPrime_self h rfl
  haveI := LocalOrdSymmetry.isArtinian_quotient_of_unique_prime
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) I hIm hI
  have hfin : Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x) (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ I) ≠ ⊤ :=
    Module.length_ne_top_iff.mpr (isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mpr
      ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩)
  have hne : I ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal _).ne_top hIm
  haveI : Nontrivial (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ I) := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hne
  have hne0 : Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x) (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ I) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Ne, Module.length_eq_zero_iff]
    exact not_subsingleton _
  unfold flatPullbackCoeff
  rw [← hIdef]
  intro h0
  rcases ENat.toNat_eq_zero.mp h0 with h | h
  exacts [hne0 h, hfin h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_exists_max_generization
statement:
theorem f17_exists_max_generization [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : X) :
    ∃ ξ, ξ ⤳ x ∧ f ξ = f x ∧ flatPullbackCoeff f ξ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  set I := (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x))).map (f.stalkMap x).hom with hIdef
  have hIm : I ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x) := by
    rw [hIdef, Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap]
  obtain ⟨P, hPmin, -⟩ := Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_le hIm
  haveI : P.IsPrime := hPmin.1.1
  obtain ⟨ξ, h, rfl⟩ := exists_specializes_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_eq x P
  
  have hfib : ∀ z (hz : z ⤳ x), I ≤ stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hz → f z = f x := by
    intro z hz hIz
    have hc : (stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hz).comap (f.stalkMap x).hom =
        IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) := by
      apply le_antisymm (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal (Ideal.IsPrime.ne_top inferInstance))
      exact Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mp hIz
    rw [f17_comap_stalkPrime] at hc
    exact stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_injective _ (specializes_refl (f x))
      (hc.trans (f17_stalkPrime_self _ rfl).symm)
  have hfξ : f ξ = f x := hfib ξ h hPmin.1.2
  refine ⟨ξ, h, hfξ, f17_coeff_ne_zero_of_max f ξ ?_⟩
  intro z hzξ hfz
  have hzx : z ⤳ x := hzξ.trans h
  have hIz : I ≤ stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hzx := by
    rw [hIdef, Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, f17_comap_stalkPrime,
      f17_stalkPrime_self _ (hfz.trans hfξ)]
  have hle : stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hzx ≤ stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h :=
    (f17_stalkPrime_le_iff hzx h).mpr hzξ
  have heq : stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h = stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hzx :=
    le_antisymm (hPmin.2 ⟨inferInstance, hIz⟩ hle) hle
  exact stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_injective hzx h heq.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17Ξ_finite
statement:
theorem f17Ξ_finite [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f]
    (g : DimRelationGenerator Y k) : (f17Ξ f g).Finite
proof:
:= by
  let D' : AlgebraicCycle Y ℤ := Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single (f17η g) 1
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hηU, -⟩ := exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (x := f17η g) (U := ⊤) (by simp)
  have hK : IsCompact (f ⁻¹' (U : Set Y)) :=
    QuasiCompact.isCompact_preimage _ U.2 hU.isCompact
  refine ((flatPullback f D').locallyFiniteSupport.finite_inter_support_of_isCompact hK).subset ?_
  rintro ξ ⟨hξ, hc⟩
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · change f ξ ∈ U
    rw [hξ]
    exact hηU
  · change D' (f ξ) * (flatPullbackCoeff f ξ : ℤ) ≠ 0
    simp [D', hξ, hc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_pc_generic
statement:
theorem f17_pc_generic (ξ : X) :
    pointClosureι ξ (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme ξ)) = ξ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (pointClosureGenericPoint_isGeneric ξ).eq (genericPoint_spec _)]
  exact pointClosureι_genericPoint ξ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_stalkSpecializes_bijective
statement:
theorem f17_stalkSpecializes_bijective {Z : Scheme.{u}} {a b : Z} (h : a ⤳ b) (e : a = b) :
    Function.Bijective (Z.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  rw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkSpecializes_refl]
  exact Function.bijective_id

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_hb
statement:
theorem f17_hb {ξ : X} (hξ : f ξ = f17η g) :
    f (pointClosureι ξ (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme ξ))) = f17η g
proof:
:= by
  rw [f17_pc_generic]; exact hξ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17σ₀_surjective
statement:
theorem f17σ₀_surjective {ξ : X} (hξ : f ξ = f17η g) :
    Function.Surjective (f17σ₀ (g := g) hξ)
proof:
:=
  (g.i.stalkMap_surjective (genericPoint g.Y)).comp
    (f17_stalkSpecializes_bijective _ (f17_hb hξ).symm).2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_ker_le
statement:
theorem f17_ker_le {ξ : X} (hξ : f ξ = f17η g) :
    RingHom.ker (f17σ₀ (g := g) hξ) ≤ RingHom.ker (f17τ₀ (f := f) ξ)
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker] at ha ⊢
  have hmem : a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _ := by
    by_contra hna
    have hu : IsUnit a := by
      rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff, not_not] at hna
      exact hna
    exact (hu.map (f17σ₀ (g := g) hξ)).ne_zero ha
  rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff] at hmem
  by_contra hne
  apply hmem
  have hu : IsUnit (f17τ₀ (f := f) ξ a) := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hne
  unfold f17τ₀ at hu
  rw [RingHom.comp_apply] at hu
  exact isUnit_of_map_unit _ _ (isUnit_of_map_unit _ _ hu)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17Φ_σ₀
statement:
theorem f17Φ_σ₀ {ξ : X} (hξ : f ξ = f17η g) (a) :
    f17Φ hξ (f17σ₀ (g := g) hξ a) = f17τ₀ (f := f) ξ a
proof:
:=
  RingHom.liftOfSurjective_comp_apply _ _ _ a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_comp
statement:
theorem f17_comp {ξ : X} (hξ : f ξ = f17η g) (w : pointClosureScheme ξ) (v : g.Y)
    (hv : g.i v = f (pointClosureι ξ w)) (a : Y.presheaf.stalk (f (pointClosureι ξ w))) :
    algebraMap ((pointClosureScheme ξ).presheaf.stalk w) (pointClosureScheme ξ).functionField
        (((pointClosureι ξ).stalkMap w).hom ((f.stalkMap (pointClosureι ξ w)).hom a)) =
      f17Φ hξ (algebraMap (g.Y.presheaf.stalk v) g.Y.functionField
        ((g.i.stalkMap v).hom ((Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (specializes_of_eq hv)).hom a)))
proof:
:= by
  have hw : genericPoint (pointClosureScheme ξ) ⤳ w := (genericPoint_spec _).specializes trivial
  have hvV : genericPoint g.Y ⤳ v := (genericPoint_spec _).specializes trivial
  have hιw := hw.map (pointClosureι ξ).continuous
  have hfιw := hιw.map f.continuous
  
  have e1 := congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ.hom ((f.stalkMap (pointClosureι ξ w)).hom a))
    (Scheme.Hom.stalkSpecializes_stalkMap (pointClosureι ξ) _ w hw)
  have e2 := congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ.hom a)
    (Scheme.Hom.stalkSpecializes_stalkMap f _ (pointClosureι ξ w) hιw)
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply] at e1 e2
  have hL : algebraMap ((pointClosureScheme ξ).presheaf.stalk w)
      (pointClosureScheme ξ).functionField
        (((pointClosureι ξ).stalkMap w).hom ((f.stalkMap (pointClosureι ξ w)).hom a)) =
      f17τ₀ (f := f) ξ ((Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes hfιw).hom a) := by
    change ((pointClosureScheme ξ).presheaf.stalkSpecializes _).hom _ = _
    rw [← e1, ← e2]
    rfl
  
  have e3 := congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ.hom ((Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (specializes_of_eq hv)).hom a))
    (Scheme.Hom.stalkSpecializes_stalkMap g.i _ v hvV)
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply] at e3
  have e4 := congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ.hom a)
    (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkSpecializes_comp Y.presheaf (hvV.map g.i.continuous)
      (specializes_of_eq hv))
  have e5 := congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ.hom a)
    (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkSpecializes_comp Y.presheaf (specializes_of_eq (f17_hb hξ).symm) hfιw)
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply] at e4 e5
  have hR : algebraMap (g.Y.presheaf.stalk v) g.Y.functionField
      ((g.i.stalkMap v).hom ((Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (specializes_of_eq hv)).hom a)) =
      f17σ₀ (g := g) hξ ((Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes hfιw).hom a) := by
    change (g.Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes _).hom _ = _
    rw [← e3]
    unfold f17σ₀
    rw [RingHom.comp_apply, e4, e5]
  rw [hL, hR, f17Φ_σ₀]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17Φ_ne_zero
statement: theorem f17Φ_ne_zero {ξ : X} (hξ : f ξ = f17η g) : f17Φ hξ g.f ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  (map_ne_zero (f17Φ hξ)).mpr g.hf

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17σ_surjective
statement:
theorem f17σ_surjective {x : X} {v : g.Y} (hv : g.i v = f x) :
    Function.Surjective (f17σ hv)
proof:
:=
  (g.i.stalkMap_surjective v).comp (f17_stalkSpecializes_bijective _ hv).2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_prime_over_K
statement:
theorem f17_prime_over_K {x : X} {v : g.Y} (hv : g.i v = f x) (hcv : coheight v = 1)
    (P : Ideal (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x))) [P.IsPrime] (hKP : RingHom.ker (f17σ hv) ≤ P) :
    P = RingHom.ker (f17σ hv) ∨ P = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Ring.KrullDimLE 1 (g.Y.presheaf.stalk v) := krullDimLE_of_coheight hcv
  have hs := f17σ_surjective hv
  haveI hQ : (P.map (f17σ hv)).IsPrime := Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective hs hKP
  have hcm : (P.map (f17σ hv)).comap (f17σ hv) = P := by
    rw [Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ hs, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, sup_eq_left.mpr hKP]
  by_cases hbot : P.map (f17σ hv) = ⊥
  · left
    rw [← hcm, hbot, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot]
  · right
    haveI := Ideal.IsPrime.isMaximal_of_ne_bot hQ hbot
    have hmax : ((P.map (f17σ hv)).comap (f17σ hv)).IsMaximal :=
      Ideal.comap_isMaximal_of_surjective _ hs
    rw [hcm] at hmax
    exact IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hmax

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_K_ne_max
statement:
theorem f17_K_ne_max {x : X} {v : g.Y} (hv : g.i v = f x) (hcv : coheight v = 1) :
    RingHom.ker (f17σ hv) ≠ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _
proof:
:= by
  intro hK
  have hfield : IsField (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x) ⧸ RingHom.ker (f17σ hv)) := by
    rw [hK]
    exact (Ideal.Quotient.maximal_ideal_iff_isField_quotient _).mp inferInstance
  have hfield' : IsField (g.Y.presheaf.stalk v) :=
    (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective (f17σ_surjective hv)).symm.toMulEquiv.isField hfield
  have h1 := ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight v
  rw [ringKrullDim_eq_zero_of_isField hfield', hcv] at h1
  exact absurd h1 (by decide)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_K_lt_max
statement:
theorem f17_K_lt_max {x : X} {v : g.Y} (hv : g.i v = f x) (hcv : coheight v = 1) :
    ∃ t, t ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) ∧ t ∉ RingHom.ker (f17σ hv)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  exact f17_K_ne_max hv hcv (le_antisymm
    (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal (Ideal.IsPrime.ne_top inferInstance)) hcon)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_fibre_artinian
statement:
theorem f17_fibre_artinian {x : X} (hcx : flatPullbackCoeff f x ≠ 0)
    (P : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) [hP : P.IsPrime]
    (hIP : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x))).map (f.stalkMap x).hom ≤ P) :
    P = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _
proof:
:= by
  set I := (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x))).map (f.stalkMap x).hom with hIdef
  have hfin : Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x) (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ I) ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro htop
    apply hcx
    unfold flatPullbackCoeff
    rw [← hIdef, htop]
    rfl
  have hFL := Module.length_ne_top_iff.mp hfin
  have hArt : IsArtinian (X.presheaf.stalk x) (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ I) :=
    (isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp hFL).2
  haveI : IsArtinianRing (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ I) := isArtinian_of_tower (X.presheaf.stalk x) hArt
  haveI : (P.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).IsPrime :=
    Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (by rw [Ideal.mk_ker]; exact hIP)
  haveI : (P.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).IsMaximal := IsArtinianRing.isMaximal_of_isPrime _
  have hmax : (Ideal.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) (P.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))).IsMaximal :=
    Ideal.comap_isMaximal_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  rw [Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot,
    Ideal.mk_ker, sup_eq_left.mpr hIP] at hmax
  exact IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hmax

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_prime_over_J
statement:
theorem f17_prime_over_J {x : X} {v : g.Y} (hv : g.i v = f x) (hcv : coheight v = 1)
    (hcx : flatPullbackCoeff f x ≠ 0) (P : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) [P.IsPrime]
    (hJP : f17J hv ≤ P) :
    P.comap (f.stalkMap x).hom = RingHom.ker (f17σ hv) ∨ P = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _
proof:
:= by
  have hK : RingHom.ker (f17σ hv) ≤ P.comap (f.stalkMap x).hom :=
    Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mp hJP
  rcases f17_prime_over_K hv hcv (P.comap (f.stalkMap x).hom) hK with h | h
  · exact Or.inl h
  · right
    apply f17_fibre_artinian hcx
    rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_J_le_max
statement:
theorem f17_J_le_max {x : X} {v : g.Y} (hv : g.i v = f x) :
    f17J hv ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold f17J
  rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap]
  exact IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal (Ideal.IsPrime.ne_top inferInstance)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_exists_below
statement:
theorem f17_exists_below [Flat f] {x : X} {v : g.Y} (hv : g.i v = f x) :
    ∃ P : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x), P.IsPrime ∧ f17J hv ≤ P ∧
      P.comap (f.stalkMap x).hom = RingHom.ker (f17σ hv)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x) := (f.stalkMap x).hom.toAlgebra
  haveI : Module.Flat (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x) := Flat.stalkMap f x
  haveI : IsLocalHom (algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsLocalHom (f.stalkMap x).hom)
  haveI : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)).LiesOver
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x))) :=
    ⟨(IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap (algebraMap _ _)).symm⟩
  obtain ⟨P, -, hP, hPo⟩ := Ideal.exists_ideal_le_liesOver_of_le
    (p := RingHom.ker (f17σ hv)) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal (Ideal.IsPrime.ne_top inferInstance))
  have hc : P.comap (f.stalkMap x).hom = RingHom.ker (f17σ hv) := hPo.over.symm
  refine ⟨P, hP, ?_, hc⟩
  unfold f17J
  rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, hc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_minimal_comap
statement:
theorem f17_minimal_comap [Flat f] {x : X} {v : g.Y} (hv : g.i v = f x) (hcv : coheight v = 1)
    (hcx : flatPullbackCoeff f x ≠ 0) (q : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (hq : q ∈ (f17J hv).minimalPrimes) :
    q.comap (f.stalkMap x).hom = RingHom.ker (f17σ hv)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : q.IsPrime := hq.1.1
  rcases f17_prime_over_J hv hcv hcx q hq.1.2 with h | h
  · exact h
  · exfalso
    obtain ⟨P, hP, hJP, hPc⟩ := f17_exists_below hv
    have hle : P ≤ q := h ▸ IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal hP.ne_top
    have hqP : q ≤ P := hq.2 ⟨hP, hJP⟩ hle
    apply f17_K_ne_max hv hcv
    rw [← hPc, le_antisymm hle hqP, h, IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_map_mk_lt
statement:
theorem f17_map_mk_lt {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {I P Q : Ideal R} (hIP : I ≤ P) (hPQ : P < Q) :
    P.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) < Q.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
proof:
:= by
  refine lt_of_le_of_ne (Ideal.map_mono hPQ.le) fun h ↦ hPQ.ne ?_
  have hc := congrArg (Ideal.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) h
  rw [Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective,
    Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot,
    Ideal.mk_ker, sup_eq_left.mpr hIP, sup_eq_left.mpr (hIP.trans hPQ.le)] at hc
  exact hc

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_hdim
statement:
theorem f17_hdim [Flat f] {x : X} {v : g.Y} (hv : g.i v = f x) (hcv : coheight v = 1)
    (hcx : flatPullbackCoeff f x ≠ 0) :
    ∀ P : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x), P.IsPrime → f17J hv ≤ P →
      P ∈ (f17J hv).minimalPrimes ∨ P.IsMaximal
proof:
:= by
  intro P hP hJP
  rcases f17_prime_over_J hv hcv hcx P hJP with hPc | hPm
  swap
  · right; rw [hPm]; infer_instance
  left
  refine ⟨⟨hP, hJP⟩, fun P' hP' hle ↦ ?_⟩
  by_contra hPP'
  have hlt : P' < P := lt_of_le_of_ne hle fun h ↦ hPP' (h ▸ le_rfl)
  haveI := hP'.1
  have hPm : P ≠ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _ := by
    intro h
    apply f17_K_ne_max hv hcv
    rw [← hPc, h, IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap]
  have hlt2 : P < IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _ :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal hP.ne_top) hPm
  obtain ⟨t, htm, htK⟩ := f17_K_lt_max hv hcv
  have hmin : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x) ∈
      (f17J hv ⊔ Ideal.span {(f.stalkMap x).hom t}).minimalPrimes := by
    refine ⟨⟨inferInstance, sup_le (f17_J_le_max hv) ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
      have : t ∈ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)).comap (f.stalkMap x).hom := by
        rw [IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_comap]; exact htm
      exact this
    · intro Q ⟨hQ, hJQ⟩ _
      rcases f17_prime_over_J hv hcv hcx Q (le_sup_left.trans hJQ) with h | h
      · exfalso
        apply htK
        rw [← h]
        exact hJQ (Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _))
      · rw [h]
  have hht := Ideal.map_height_le_one_of_mem_minimalPrimes hmin
  haveI : (P'.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (f17J hv))).IsPrime :=
    Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (by rw [Ideal.mk_ker]; exact hP'.2)
  haveI : (P.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (f17J hv))).IsPrime :=
    Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (by rw [Ideal.mk_ker]; exact hJP)
  haveI : ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)).map
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (f17J hv))).IsPrime :=
    Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
      (by rw [Ideal.mk_ker]; exact f17_J_le_max hv)
  have h1 := Ideal.height_add_one_le_of_lt_of_isPrime (f17_map_mk_lt hP'.2 hlt)
  have h2 := Ideal.height_add_one_le_of_lt_of_isPrime (f17_map_mk_lt hJP hlt2)
  have h3 : (1 : ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ 1 := by
    calc (1 : ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ (P.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (f17J hv))).height + 1 := by
          gcongr
          exact le_add_self.trans h1
      _ ≤ _ := h2
      _ ≤ 1 := hht
  exact absurd h3 (by decide)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_chiKer_aux
statement:
theorem f17_chiKer_aux {A B : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] [Module.Flat A B]
    (K : Ideal A) [hK : K.IsPrime] (a : A) (haK : a ∉ K) :
    chiKer (algebraMap A B a) (B ⧸ K.map (algebraMap A B)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let e := (Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivTensorQuot B K).toLinearEquiv
  have hinj : Function.Injective (LinearMap.lsmul A (A ⧸ K) a) := by
    rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
    intro m hm
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective m
    rw [LinearMap.lsmul_apply, Algebra.smul_def, Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq, ← map_mul,
      Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem] at hm
    exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr ((hK.mem_or_mem hm).resolve_left haK)
  have hT := Module.Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap (M := B) _ hinj
  have hTe : ∀ z : TensorProduct A B (A ⧸ K),
      LinearMap.lTensor B (LinearMap.lsmul A (A ⧸ K) a) z = algebraMap A B a • z := by
    intro z
    induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | tmul β m =>
        rw [LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, LinearMap.lsmul_apply, TensorProduct.tmul_smul,
          algebraMap_smul]
    | add z₁ z₂ h₁ h₂ => rw [map_add, h₁, h₂, smul_add]
  have hker : LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.lsmul B (B ⧸ K.map (algebraMap A B))
      (algebraMap A B a)) = ⊥ := by
    rw [LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
    intro y hy
    rw [LinearMap.lsmul_apply] at hy
    have h1 : e (algebraMap A B a • y) = 0 := by rw [hy, LinearEquiv.map_zero]
    rw [LinearEquiv.map_smul, ← hTe] at h1
    have h2 : e y = 0 := hT (h1.trans (LinearMap.map_zero _).symm)
    exact e.injective (h2.trans (LinearEquiv.map_zero e).symm)
  unfold chiKer
  rw [hker, Module.length_bot]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_chiKer_zero
statement:
theorem f17_chiKer_zero [Flat f] {x : X} {v : g.Y} (hv : g.i v = f x)
    (a : Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) (ha : f17σ hv a ≠ 0) :
    chiKer ((f.stalkMap x).hom a) (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ f17J hv) = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x) := (f.stalkMap x).hom.toAlgebra
  haveI : Module.Flat (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x) := Flat.stalkMap f x
  exact f17_chiKer_aux (RingHom.ker (f17σ hv)) a (fun h ↦ ha (RingHom.mem_ker.mp h))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_chiCoker
statement:
theorem f17_chiCoker {x : X} {v : g.Y} [Flat f] (hv : g.i v = f x) (a : Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) :
    chiCoker ((f.stalkMap x).hom a) (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ f17J hv) =
      Ring.ord (g.Y.presheaf.stalk v) (f17σ hv a) *
        Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x) (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x))).map (f.stalkMap x).hom)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x) := (f.stalkMap x).hom.toAlgebra
  haveI : Module.Flat (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x) := Flat.stalkMap f x
  haveI : IsLocalHom (algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsLocalHom (f.stalkMap x).hom)
  set K := RingHom.ker (f17σ hv) with hKdef
  rw [chiCoker_quotient]
  have hL : f17J hv ⊔ Ideal.span {(f.stalkMap x).hom a} =
      (K ⊔ Ideal.span {a}).map (algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) := by
    rw [Ideal.map_sup, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
    rfl
  rw [hL, (Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivTensorQuot (X.presheaf.stalk x)
    (K ⊔ Ideal.span {a})).toLinearEquiv.length_eq, IsLocalRing.length_baseChange]
  congr 1
  rw [← chiCoker_quotient, chiCoker_quotient_ord,
    ← ord_ringEquiv (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective (f17σ_surjective hv))]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_ord_ne_top
statement:
theorem f17_ord_ne_top {v : g.Y} (hcv : coheight v = 1) {a' : g.Y.presheaf.stalk v}
    (ha : a' ≠ 0) : Ring.ord (g.Y.presheaf.stalk v) a' ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Ring.KrullDimLE 1 (g.Y.presheaf.stalk v) := krullDimLE_of_coheight hcv
  exact Ring.ord_ne_top (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr ha)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_coeff_length
statement:
theorem f17_coeff_length {x : X} (hcx : flatPullbackCoeff f x ≠ 0) :
    Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x) (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x))).map (f.stalkMap x).hom) =
      (flatPullbackCoeff f x : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  unfold flatPullbackCoeff at hcx ⊢
  refine (ENat.coe_toNat ?_).symm
  intro h
  apply hcx
  rw [h]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_core
statement:
theorem f17_core [Flat f] {x : X} {v : g.Y} (hv : g.i v = f x) (hcv : coheight v = 1)
    (hcx : flatPullbackCoeff f x ≠ 0) (a : Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) (ha : f17σ hv a ≠ 0)
    (T : Finset (PrimeSpectrum (X.presheaf.stalk x)))
    (hT : ∀ q, q ∈ T ↔ q.asIdeal ∈ (f17J hv).minimalPrimes) :
    Ring.ord (g.Y.presheaf.stalk v) (f17σ hv a) * (flatPullbackCoeff f x : ℕ∞) =
      ∑ q ∈ T, lengthAt q.asIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ f17J hv) *
        chiCoker ((f.stalkMap x).hom a) (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ q.asIdeal)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← f17_coeff_length hcx, ← f17_chiCoker hv a]
  have hfin : chiCoker ((f.stalkMap x).hom a) (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ f17J hv) ≠ ⊤ := by
    rw [f17_chiCoker hv a, f17_coeff_length hcx]
    exact WithTop.mul_ne_top (f17_ord_ne_top hcv ha) (ENat.coe_ne_top _)
  have hart : IsArtinian (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ (f17J hv ⊔ Ideal.span {(f.stalkMap x).hom a})) := by
    rw [chiCoker_quotient] at hfin
    exact (isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp (Module.length_ne_top_iff.mp hfin)).2
  have hdev := devissage ((f.stalkMap x).hom a) (f17J hv) hart T (fun q h ↦ (hT q).2 h)
    (fun q h ↦ (hT q).1 h) (f17_hdim hv hcv hcx) (f17J hv) le_rfl
  have hzero : ∀ q ∈ T, lengthAt q.asIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ f17J hv) *
      chiKer ((f.stalkMap x).hom a) (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ q.asIdeal) = 0 := by
    intro q hq
    have hc := f17_minimal_comap hv hcv hcx q.asIdeal ((hT q).1 hq)
    have hnot : (f.stalkMap x).hom a ∉ q.asIdeal := by
      intro h
      have : a ∈ q.asIdeal.comap (f.stalkMap x).hom := h
      rw [hc, RingHom.mem_ker] at this
      exact ha this
    rw [chiKer_quotient_prime_eq_zero q.asIdeal hnot, mul_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero hzero, add_zero, f17_chiKer_zero hv a ha, zero_add] at hdev
  exact hdev

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_genericPoint_specializes
statement:
theorem f17_genericPoint_specializes (Z : Scheme.{u}) [IrreducibleSpace Z] (z : Z) :
    genericPoint Z ⤳ z
proof:
:=
  (genericPoint_spec Z).specializes trivial

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_isMax_genericPoint
statement: theorem f17_isMax_genericPoint (Z : Scheme.{u}) [IrreducibleSpace Z] : IsMax (genericPoint Z)
proof:
:=
  fun b _ ↦ Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr (f17_genericPoint_specializes Z b)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_eq_genericPoint_of_isMax
statement:
theorem f17_eq_genericPoint_of_isMax {Z : Scheme.{u}} [IrreducibleSpace Z] {z : Z} (hz : IsMax z) :
    z = genericPoint Z
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : z ≤ genericPoint Z := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr (f17_genericPoint_specializes Z z)
  exact ((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp (hz h1)).antisymm (f17_genericPoint_specializes Z z)).eq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_coheight_eq_one
statement:
theorem f17_coheight_eq_one {α : Type*} [Preorder α] {a : α} (hna : ¬ IsMax a)
    (h : ∀ b, a < b → IsMax b) : coheight a = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Order.coheight_le_iff']
    intro p hp
    by_contra hlen
    push Not at hlen
    have h2 : 2 ≤ p.length := by
      have : (1 : ℕ∞) < (p.length : ℕ∞) := hlen
      exact_mod_cast Order.add_one_le_of_lt this
    have h01 : p ⟨0, by omega⟩ < p ⟨1, by omega⟩ := p.strictMono (by simp [Fin.lt_def])
    have h12 : p ⟨1, by omega⟩ < p ⟨2, by omega⟩ := p.strictMono (by simp [Fin.lt_def])
    have hp0 : p ⟨0, by omega⟩ = a := hp
    rw [hp0] at h01
    exact (h _ h01).not_lt h12
  · rw [Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero, Ne, Order.coheight_eq_zero]
    exact hna

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_length_quot_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem f17_length_quot_ringEquiv {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (e : R ≃+* S)
    (I : Ideal R) : Module.length R (R ⧸ I) = Module.length S (S ⧸ I.map (e : R →+* S))
proof:
:= by
  have hs : RingHomSurjective (e : R →+* S) := ⟨e.surjective⟩
  let φ := Ideal.quotientEquiv I (I.map (e : R →+* S)) e rfl
  have hsmulR : ∀ r y : R, r • (Ideal.Quotient.mk I y) = Ideal.Quotient.mk I (r * y) :=
    fun _ _ ↦ rfl
  have hsmulS : ∀ r y : S, r • (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (e : R →+* S)) y)
      = Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (e : R →+* S)) (r * y) := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
  let F : (R ⧸ I) →ₛₗ[(e : R →+* S)] (S ⧸ I.map (e : R →+* S)) :=
    { toFun := φ
      map_add' := map_add φ
      map_smul' := by
        intro r y
        obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
        rw [hsmulR, Ideal.quotientEquiv_mk, Ideal.quotientEquiv_mk, RingHom.coe_coe,
          map_mul, hsmulS] }
  exact length_eq_of_bijective (e : R →+* S) F φ.bijective

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_hη
statement: theorem f17_hη {x : X} {v : g.Y} (hv : g.i v = f x) : f17η g ⤳ f x
proof:
:=
  ((f17_genericPoint_specializes g.Y v).map g.i.continuous).trans (specializes_of_eq hv)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_v_ne_generic
statement: theorem f17_v_ne_generic {v : g.Y} (hcv : coheight v = 1) : v ≠ genericPoint g.Y
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rw [h, Order.coheight_eq_zero.mpr (f17_isMax_genericPoint _)] at hcv
  exact zero_ne_one hcv

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_Kη
statement:
theorem f17_Kη {x : X} {v : g.Y} (hv : g.i v = f x) (hcv : coheight v = 1)
    (h : f17η g ⤳ f x) : stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h = RingHom.ker (f17σ hv)
proof:
:= by
  have hvV := f17_genericPoint_specializes g.Y v
  have hKle : RingHom.ker (f17σ hv) ≤ stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h := by
    intro a ha
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker] at ha
    have e3 := congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ.hom ((Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (specializes_of_eq hv)).hom a))
      (Scheme.Hom.stalkSpecializes_stalkMap g.i _ v hvV)
    have e4 := congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ.hom a)
      (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkSpecializes_comp Y.presheaf (hvV.map g.i.continuous)
        (specializes_of_eq hv))
    simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply] at e3 e4
    have h0 : (g.i.stalkMap (genericPoint g.Y)).hom
        ((Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom a) = 0 := by
      rw [e4] at e3
      refine e3.trans ?_
      change (g.Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes hvV).hom (f17σ hv a) = 0
      rw [ha, map_zero]
    change (Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _
    by_contra hn
    have hu : IsUnit ((Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom a) := by
      rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff, not_not] at hn
      exact hn
    exact (hu.map (g.i.stalkMap (genericPoint g.Y)).hom).ne_zero h0
  have hne : stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h ≠ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _ := by
    intro hm
    have h1 : f17η g = f x := stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_injective h (specializes_refl (f x))
      (hm.trans (f17_stalkPrime_self _ rfl).symm)
    have h2 : genericPoint g.Y = v := g.i.isEmbedding.injective (h1.trans hv.symm)
    exact f17_v_ne_generic hcv h2.symm
  rcases f17_prime_over_K hv hcv _ hKle with h' | h'
  · exact h'
  · exact absurd h' hne

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_comap_ξ
proof:
:= by
  rw [f17_comap_stalkPrime, f17_stalkPrime_congr _ (f17_hη hv) hξ, f17_Kη hv hcv]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_mem_minimalPrimes
statement:
theorem f17_mem_minimalPrimes {x : X} {v : g.Y} (hv : g.i v = f x) (hcv : coheight v = 1)
    {ξ : X} (hξ : ξ ∈ f17Ξ f g) (h : ξ ⤳ x) :
    stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h ∈ (f17J hv).minimalPrimes
proof:
:= by
  have hc := f17_comap_ξ hv hcv hξ.1 h
  have hJ : f17J hv ≤ stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h := by
    unfold f17J; rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, hc]
  refine ⟨⟨inferInstance, hJ⟩, fun P ⟨hP, hJP⟩ hle ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := exists_specializes_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_eq x P
  have hzξ : z ⤳ ξ := (f17_stalkPrime_le_iff hz h).mp hle
  have hcP : (stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hz).comap (f.stalkMap x).hom = RingHom.ker (f17σ hv) :=
    le_antisymm (hc ▸ Ideal.comap_mono hle) (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mp hJP)
  have hc' := hc
  rw [f17_comap_stalkPrime] at hcP hc'
  have hfz : f z = f ξ := stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_injective _ _ (hcP.trans hc'.symm)
  have hzeq : z = ξ := by
    by_contra hne
    exact hξ.2 (m6pb_coeff_eq_zero_of_specializes f hzξ hne hfz)
  subst hzeq
  exact le_rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_lengthAt
statement:
theorem f17_lengthAt {x : X} {v : g.Y} (hv : g.i v = f x) (hcv : coheight v = 1) {ξ : X}
    (hξ : ξ ∈ f17Ξ f g) (h : ξ ⤳ x) :
    lengthAt (stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h) (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ f17J hv) =
      (flatPullbackCoeff f ξ : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lengthAt_quotient]
  letI := stalkSpecializesAlgebra h
  haveI := isLocalization_stalkSpecializes h
  let e := stalkSpecializesAlgEquiv h
  rw [f17_length_quot_ringEquiv e.toRingEquiv, ← f17_coeff_length hξ.2]
  suffices hmap : ((f17J hv).map (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (Localization.AtPrime (stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h)))).map (e.toRingEquiv :
        Localization.AtPrime (stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h) →+* X.presheaf.stalk ξ) =
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk (f ξ))).map (f.stalkMap ξ).hom by
    rw [hmap]
  rw [Ideal.map_map]
  have h1 : (e.toRingEquiv : Localization.AtPrime (stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h) →+*
      X.presheaf.stalk ξ).comp (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) _) =
      (X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom := by
    ext b
    exact e.commutes b
  rw [h1]
  unfold f17J
  rw [Ideal.map_map]
  have hn := congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom (Scheme.Hom.stalkSpecializes_stalkMap f ξ x h)
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp] at hn
  rw [← hn, ← Ideal.map_map]
  congr 1
  have hK : RingHom.ker (f17σ hv) = stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (h.map f.continuous) := by
    rw [f17_stalkPrime_congr _ (f17_hη hv) hξ.1, f17_Kη hv hcv]
  letI := stalkSpecializesAlgebra (h.map f.continuous)
  haveI := isLocalization_stalkSpecializes (h.map f.continuous)
  rw [hK]
  exact IsLocalization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_ker_pc
statement:
theorem f17_ker_pc (ξ : X) (w : pointClosureScheme ξ) (h : ξ ⤳ pointClosureι ξ w) :
    RingHom.ker ((pointClosureι ξ).stalkMap w).hom = stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h
proof:
:= by
  have hw := f17_genericPoint_specializes (pointClosureScheme ξ) w
  have h0 : stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hw = ⊥ := by
    unfold stalkPrimeOfSpecializes
    rw [IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_eq_bot]
    exact Ideal.comap_bot_of_injective _
      (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective ((pointClosureScheme ξ).presheaf.stalk w)
        (pointClosureScheme ξ).functionField)
  rw [RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, ← h0, f17_comap_stalkPrime,
    f17_stalkPrime_congr _ h (f17_pc_generic ξ)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_chiCoker_pc
statement:
theorem f17_chiCoker_pc (ξ : X) (w : pointClosureScheme ξ) (h : ξ ⤳ pointClosureι ξ w)
    (b : X.presheaf.stalk (pointClosureι ξ w)) :
    chiCoker b (X.presheaf.stalk (pointClosureι ξ w) ⧸ stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h) =
      Ring.ord ((pointClosureScheme ξ).presheaf.stalk w) (((pointClosureι ξ).stalkMap w).hom b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chiCoker_quotient_ord, ← f17_ker_pc ξ w h,
    ← ord_ringEquiv (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective
      ((pointClosureι ξ).stalkMap_surjective w))]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_coheight_pc
statement:
theorem f17_coheight_pc [Flat f] {x : X} {v : g.Y} (hv : g.i v = f x) (hcv : coheight v = 1)
    (hcx : flatPullbackCoeff f x ≠ 0) {ξ : X} (hξ : ξ ∈ f17Ξ f g) (w : pointClosureScheme ξ)
    (hw : pointClosureι ξ w = x) : coheight w = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hηw := f17_genericPoint_specializes (pointClosureScheme ξ) w
  have hξx : ξ ⤳ x := by
    have := hηw.map (pointClosureι ξ).continuous
    rwa [f17_pc_generic, hw] at this
  apply f17_coheight_eq_one
  · intro hmax
    have hw' := f17_eq_genericPoint_of_isMax hmax
    have hxξ : x = ξ := by rw [← hw, hw', f17_pc_generic]
    have : g.i v = g.i (genericPoint g.Y) := hv.trans (hxξ ▸ hξ.1)
    exact f17_v_ne_generic hcv (g.i.isEmbedding.injective this)
  · intro b hb
    have hbw : b ⤳ w := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hb.le
    have hbx : pointClosureι ξ b ⤳ x := hw ▸ hbw.map (pointClosureι ξ).continuous
    have hξb : ξ ⤳ pointClosureι ξ b := by
      have := (f17_genericPoint_specializes (pointClosureScheme ξ) b).map
        (pointClosureι ξ).continuous
      rwa [f17_pc_generic] at this
    have hqP : stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hξx ≤ stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hbx :=
      (f17_stalkPrime_le_iff hξx hbx).mpr hξb
    have hqmin := f17_mem_minimalPrimes hv hcv hξ hξx
    have hJP : f17J hv ≤ stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hbx := hqmin.1.2.trans hqP
    rcases f17_hdim hv hcv hcx _ inferInstance hJP with hPmin | hPmax
    · have hle : stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hbx ≤ stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hξx :=
        hPmin.2 hqmin.1 hqP
      have hbξ : pointClosureι ξ b = ξ :=
        stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_injective _ _ (le_antisymm hle hqP)
      have : b = genericPoint (pointClosureScheme ξ) :=
        (pointClosureι ξ).isEmbedding.injective (hbξ.trans (f17_pc_generic ξ).symm)
      rw [this]
      exact f17_isMax_genericPoint _
    · exfalso
      have hm : stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hbx = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _ :=
        IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hPmax
      have h1 : pointClosureι ξ b = x := stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_injective hbx
        (specializes_refl x) (hm.trans (f17_stalkPrime_self _ rfl).symm)
      have : b = w := (pointClosureι ξ).isEmbedding.injective (h1.trans hw.symm)
      exact hb.ne this.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_exists_of_minimal
statement:
theorem f17_exists_of_minimal [Flat f] {x : X} {v : g.Y} (hv : g.i v = f x)
    (hcv : coheight v = 1) (hcx : flatPullbackCoeff f x ≠ 0) (q : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (hq : q ∈ (f17J hv).minimalPrimes) :
    ∃ ξ, ∃ _ : ξ ∈ f17Ξ f g, ∃ h : ξ ⤳ x, stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h = q
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hq.1.1
  obtain ⟨z, h, rfl⟩ := exists_specializes_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_eq x q
  have hcK := f17_minimal_comap hv hcv hcx _ hq
  have hc := hcK
  rw [f17_comap_stalkPrime, ← f17_Kη hv hcv (f17_hη hv)] at hc
  have hfz : f z = f17η g := stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_injective _ _ hc
  refine ⟨z, ⟨hfz, f17_coeff_ne_zero_of_max f z ?_⟩, h, rfl⟩
  intro z' hz' hfz'
  have hz'x := hz'.trans h
  have hle := (f17_stalkPrime_le_iff hz'x h).mpr hz'
  have hc1 : (stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hz'x).comap (f.stalkMap x).hom =
      (stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h).comap (f.stalkMap x).hom := by
    rw [f17_comap_stalkPrime, f17_comap_stalkPrime]
    exact f17_stalkPrime_congr _ _ hfz'
  have hJ : f17J hv ≤ stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hz'x := by
    unfold f17J
    rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, hc1, hcK]
  have := hq.2 ⟨inferInstance, hJ⟩ hle
  exact stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_injective _ _ (le_antisymm hle this)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_pc_apply_eq_zero
statement:
theorem f17_pc_apply_eq_zero {ξ x : X} (h : ¬ ξ ⤳ x)
    (D : AlgebraicCycle (pointClosureScheme ξ) ℤ) : properPushforward (pointClosureι ξ) D x = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold properPushforward
  apply pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range
  rw [range_pointClosureι]
  exact fun hm ↦ h (specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr hm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_pc_apply
statement:
theorem f17_pc_apply {ξ : X} (D : AlgebraicCycle (pointClosureScheme ξ) ℤ)
    (w : pointClosureScheme ξ) : properPushforward (pointClosureι ξ) D (pointClosureι ξ w) = D w
proof:
:= by
  unfold properPushforward
  exact pushforward_apply_closedImmersion (pointClosureι ξ) D (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ())
    (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) w

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_term
statement:
theorem f17_term [Flat f] {x : X} {v : g.Y} (hv : g.i v = f x) (hcv : coheight v = 1)
    (hcx : flatPullbackCoeff f x ≠ 0) {ξ : X} (hξ : ξ ∈ f17Ξ f g)
    (a b : Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) (ha : f17σ hv a ≠ 0) (hb : f17σ hv b ≠ 0)
    (hr : algebraMap (g.Y.presheaf.stalk v) g.Y.functionField (f17σ hv a) /
      algebraMap (g.Y.presheaf.stalk v) g.Y.functionField (f17σ hv b) = g.f) (h : ξ ⤳ x) :
    properPushforward (pointClosureι ξ) (div (f17Φ hξ.1 g.f)) x =
      ((chiCoker ((f.stalkMap x).hom a) (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h)).toNat : ℤ) -
      ((chiCoker ((f.stalkMap x).hom b) (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h)).toNat : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : x ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι ξ) := by
    rw [range_pointClosureι]; exact specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp h
  have hcw := f17_coheight_pc hv hcv hcx hξ w hw
  subst hw
  have hα : algebraMap ((pointClosureScheme ξ).presheaf.stalk w) (pointClosureScheme ξ).functionField
      (((pointClosureι ξ).stalkMap w).hom ((f.stalkMap (pointClosureι ξ w)).hom a)) =
      f17Φ hξ.1 (algebraMap (g.Y.presheaf.stalk v) g.Y.functionField (f17σ hv a)) :=
    f17_comp hξ.1 w v hv a
  have hβ : algebraMap ((pointClosureScheme ξ).presheaf.stalk w) (pointClosureScheme ξ).functionField
      (((pointClosureι ξ).stalkMap w).hom ((f.stalkMap (pointClosureι ξ w)).hom b)) =
      f17Φ hξ.1 (algebraMap (g.Y.presheaf.stalk v) g.Y.functionField (f17σ hv b)) :=
    f17_comp hξ.1 w v hv b
  have hne : ∀ c : Y.presheaf.stalk (f (pointClosureι ξ w)), f17σ hv c ≠ 0 →
      ((pointClosureι ξ).stalkMap w).hom ((f.stalkMap (pointClosureι ξ w)).hom c) ≠ 0 := by
    intro c hc h0
    have hγ := f17_comp hξ.1 w v hv c
    rw [h0, map_zero] at hγ
    have : algebraMap (g.Y.presheaf.stalk v) g.Y.functionField (f17σ hv c) ≠ 0 :=
      (map_ne_zero_iff _ (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective _ _)).mpr hc
    exact (map_ne_zero (f17Φ hξ.1)).mpr this hγ.symm
  have hrξ : f17Φ hξ.1 g.f = algebraMap ((pointClosureScheme ξ).presheaf.stalk w)
        (pointClosureScheme ξ).functionField
        (((pointClosureι ξ).stalkMap w).hom ((f.stalkMap (pointClosureι ξ w)).hom a)) /
      algebraMap ((pointClosureScheme ξ).presheaf.stalk w) (pointClosureScheme ξ).functionField
        (((pointClosureι ξ).stalkMap w).hom ((f.stalkMap (pointClosureι ξ w)).hom b)) := by
    rw [← hr, map_div₀, hα, hβ]
  rw [f17_pc_apply, hrξ, Scheme.div_div_algebraMap_eq_length_sub hcw _ _ (hne a ha) (hne b hb),
    f17_chiCoker_pc ξ w h, f17_chiCoker_pc ξ w h]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_sum
statement:
theorem f17_sum [Flat f] {x : X} {v : g.Y} (hv : g.i v = f x) (hcv : coheight v = 1)
    (hcx : flatPullbackCoeff f x ≠ 0) (hfin : (f17Ξ f g).Finite)
    (a : Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) (ha : f17σ hv a ≠ 0) :
    (Ring.ord (g.Y.presheaf.stalk v) (f17σ hv a)).toNat * flatPullbackCoeff f x =
      ∑ ξ ∈ hfin.toFinset.attach, (if h : ξ.1 ⤳ x then flatPullbackCoeff f ξ.1 *
        (chiCoker ((f.stalkMap x).hom a)
          (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h)).toNat else 0)
proof:
:= by
  set S : Set (PrimeSpectrum (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :=
    {q | q.asIdeal ∈ (f17J hv).minimalPrimes} with hSdef
  have hS : S.Finite := (Ideal.finite_minimalPrimes_of_isNoetherianRing _ (f17J hv)).preimage
    (fun p _ q _ h ↦ PrimeSpectrum.ext h)
  have hcore := f17_core hv hcv hcx a ha hS.toFinset (fun q ↦ by simp [hSdef])
  have hmem : ∀ ξ ∈ hfin.toFinset.attach, ξ.1 ∈ f17Ξ f g := fun ξ _ ↦ hfin.mem_toFinset.mp ξ.2
  let G : {ξ // ξ ∈ hfin.toFinset} → ℕ∞ := fun ξ ↦ if h : ξ.1 ⤳ x then
    (flatPullbackCoeff f ξ.1 : ℕ∞) *
      chiCoker ((f.stalkMap x).hom a) (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h) else 0
  have hsp : ∀ ξ, G ξ ≠ 0 → ξ.1 ⤳ x := fun ξ hne ↦ by
    by_contra hn
    exact hne (dif_neg hn)
  have hsum : ∑ ξ ∈ hfin.toFinset.attach, G ξ = ∑ q ∈ hS.toFinset,
      lengthAt q.asIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ f17J hv) *
        chiCoker ((f.stalkMap x).hom a) (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ q.asIdeal) := by
    apply Finset.sum_bij_ne_zero (fun ξ _ hne ↦ ⟨stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (hsp ξ hne), inferInstance⟩)
    · intro ξ hξ hne
      rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
      exact f17_mem_minimalPrimes hv hcv (hmem ξ hξ) (hsp ξ hne)
    · intro ξ₁ _ h₁ ξ₂ _ h₂ heq
      exact Subtype.ext (stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_injective _ _
        (congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal heq))
    · intro q hq hne
      rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at hq
      obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, h, hqξ⟩ := f17_exists_of_minimal hv hcv hcx q.asIdeal hq
      have hq' : q = ⟨stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h, inferInstance⟩ := PrimeSpectrum.ext hqξ.symm
      subst hq'
      have hG : G ⟨ξ, hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr hξ⟩ = lengthAt (stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h)
          (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ f17J hv) *
          chiCoker ((f.stalkMap x).hom a) (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h) := by
        change (if h : ξ ⤳ x then _ else _) = _
        rw [dif_pos h, ← f17_lengthAt hv hcv hξ h]
      exact ⟨⟨ξ, hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr hξ⟩, Finset.mem_attach _ _, hG ▸ hne, rfl⟩
    · intro ξ hξ hne
      change (if h : ξ.1 ⤳ x then _ else _) = _
      rw [dif_pos (hsp ξ hne), f17_lengthAt hv hcv (hmem ξ hξ) (hsp ξ hne)]
  rw [← hsum] at hcore
  have hfinL : Ring.ord (g.Y.presheaf.stalk v) (f17σ hv a) * (flatPullbackCoeff f x : ℕ∞) ≠ ⊤ :=
    WithTop.mul_ne_top (f17_ord_ne_top hcv ha) (ENat.coe_ne_top _)
  have hG : ∀ ξ ∈ hfin.toFinset.attach, G ξ = ((if h : ξ.1 ⤳ x then flatPullbackCoeff f ξ.1 *
      (chiCoker ((f.stalkMap x).hom a)
        (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h)).toNat else 0 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
    intro ξ hξ
    have hle : G ξ ≤ ∑ ξ ∈ hfin.toFinset.attach, G ξ :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ ↦ zero_le) hξ
    have hGt : G ξ ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top (hcore ▸ hfinL) hle
    change (if h : ξ.1 ⤳ x then _ else _) = _
    by_cases h : ξ.1 ⤳ x
    · rw [dif_pos h, dif_pos h]
      have hGt' : (flatPullbackCoeff f ξ.1 : ℕ∞) *
          chiCoker ((f.stalkMap x).hom a) (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h) ≠ ⊤ := by
        have := hGt
        change (if h : ξ.1 ⤳ x then _ else _) ≠ ⊤ at this
        rwa [dif_pos h] at this
      have hct : chiCoker ((f.stalkMap x).hom a)
          (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h) ≠ ⊤ := by
        intro htop
        rw [htop, ENat.mul_top (by exact_mod_cast (hmem ξ hξ).2)] at hGt'
        exact hGt' rfl
      push_cast
      rw [ENat.coe_toNat hct]
    · rw [dif_neg h, dif_neg h]
      rfl
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hG, ← Nat.cast_sum,
    ← ENat.coe_toNat (f17_ord_ne_top hcv ha)] at hcore
  exact_mod_cast hcore

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_good
statement:
theorem f17_good [Flat f] {x : X} {v : g.Y} (hv : g.i v = f x) (hcv : coheight v = 1)
    (hcx : flatPullbackCoeff f x ≠ 0) (hfin : (f17Ξ f g).Finite) :
    div g.f v * (flatPullbackCoeff f x : ℤ) =
      ∑ ξ ∈ hfin.toFinset.attach, (flatPullbackCoeff f ξ.1 : ℤ) *
        properPushforward (pointClosureι ξ.1)
          (div (f17Φ (hfin.mem_toFinset.mp ξ.2).1 g.f)) x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a', b', hb', hr⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective (A := g.Y.presheaf.stalk v) g.f
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := f17σ_surjective hv a'
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := f17σ_surjective hv b'
  have hb0 : f17σ hv b ≠ 0 := nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hb'
  have ha0 : f17σ hv a ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, map_zero, zero_div] at hr
    exact g.hf hr.symm
  have hdiv : div g.f v =
      ((Ring.ord (g.Y.presheaf.stalk v) (f17σ hv a)).toNat : ℤ) -
      ((Ring.ord (g.Y.presheaf.stalk v) (f17σ hv b)).toNat : ℤ) := by
    rw [← hr, Scheme.div_div_algebraMap_eq_length_sub hcv _ _ ha0 hb0]
    rfl
  have hsa := f17_sum hv hcv hcx hfin a ha0
  have hsb := f17_sum hv hcv hcx hfin b hb0
  rw [hdiv, sub_mul]
  have e1 : ((Ring.ord (g.Y.presheaf.stalk v) (f17σ hv a)).toNat : ℤ) *
      (flatPullbackCoeff f x : ℤ) = ((Ring.ord (g.Y.presheaf.stalk v) (f17σ hv a)).toNat *
        flatPullbackCoeff f x : ℕ) := by push_cast; ring
  have e2 : ((Ring.ord (g.Y.presheaf.stalk v) (f17σ hv b)).toNat : ℤ) *
      (flatPullbackCoeff f x : ℤ) = ((Ring.ord (g.Y.presheaf.stalk v) (f17σ hv b)).toNat *
        flatPullbackCoeff f x : ℕ) := by push_cast; ring
  rw [e1, e2, hsa, hsb]
  push_cast
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ξ hξ ↦ ?_
  by_cases h : ξ.1 ⤳ x
  · rw [dif_pos h, dif_pos h, f17_term hv hcv hcx (hfin.mem_toFinset.mp ξ.2) a b ha0 hb0 hr h]
    push_cast
    ring
  · rw [dif_neg h, dif_neg h, f17_pc_apply_eq_zero h]
    simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_lt_of_specializes
statement: theorem f17_lt_of_specializes {Z : Scheme.{u}} {a b : Z} (h : a ⤳ b) (hne : a ≠ b) : b < a
proof:
:=
  lt_of_le_not_ge (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr h) fun h' ↦
    hne (h.antisymm (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp h')).eq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_range
statement: theorem f17_range {ξ x : X} (hξ : f ξ = f17η g) (h : ξ ⤳ x) : f x ∈ Set.range g.i
proof:
:=
  (h.map f.continuous).mem_closed g.i.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range (by rw [hξ]; exact ⟨_, rfl⟩)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_pushforward_apply_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem f17_pushforward_apply_of_not_mem {x : X} (hr : f x ∉ Set.range g.i) :
    properPushforward g.i (div g.f) (f x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold properPushforward
  exact pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range _ _ _ _ _ hr

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_pushforward_apply
statement:
theorem f17_pushforward_apply {x : X} {v : g.Y} (hv : g.i v = f x) :
    properPushforward g.i (div g.f) (f x) = div g.f v
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hv]
  unfold properPushforward
  exact pushforward_apply_closedImmersion g.i _ (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) v

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_no_long_chain
statement:
theorem f17_no_long_chain [Flat f] (hX : DimensionCatenary X) {d : ℕ} (hf : PureRelDim f d)
    (hH : height (f17η g) = k + 1) {ξ : X} (hξ : ξ ∈ f17Ξ f g) (w : pointClosureScheme ξ)
    (hw1 : coheight w = 1) {x a b : X} (hw : pointClosureι ξ w = x)
    (hax : a ⤳ x) (hax' : a ≠ x) (hba : b ⤳ a) (hba' : b ≠ a) (hb : f b ∈ Set.range g.i) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨vb, hvb⟩ := hb
  have hηb : f17η g ⤳ f b :=
    ((f17_genericPoint_specializes g.Y vb).map g.i.continuous).trans (specializes_of_eq hvb)
  obtain ⟨b', hb'b, hfb'⟩ := f17_exists_generization f b hηb
  obtain ⟨ξ'', hξ''b', hfξ'', hc''⟩ := f17_exists_max_generization f b'
  have hcat := hX _ (pointClosureι ξ) w hw1
  rw [f17_pc_generic, hw, hf ξ hξ.2, hξ.1, hH] at hcat
  have hh'' : height ξ'' = (k + 1 : ℕ∞) + d := by rw [hf ξ'' hc'', hfξ'', hfb', hH]
  have h1 := Order.height_add_one_le (f17_lt_of_specializes hax hax')
  have h2 := Order.height_add_one_le (f17_lt_of_specializes hba hba')
  have h3 : height b ≤ height ξ'' :=
    Order.height_mono (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr (hξ''b'.trans hb'b))
  have hle : height x + 1 + 1 ≤ height x + 1 := by
    calc height x + 1 + 1 ≤ height a + 1 := by gcongr
      _ ≤ height b := h2
      _ ≤ height ξ'' := h3
      _ = height x + 1 := by rw [hh'', hcat]
  have hxfin : height x ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro htop
    rw [htop, top_add] at hcat
    exact (WithTop.add_ne_top.mpr ⟨WithTop.add_ne_top.mpr ⟨ENat.coe_ne_top k, ENat.one_ne_top⟩,
      ENat.coe_ne_top d⟩) hcat.symm
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hxfin
  rw [← hn] at hle
  norm_cast at hle
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_unit_zero
statement:
theorem f17_unit_zero {ξ : X} (hξ : f ξ = f17η g) (w : pointClosureScheme ξ)
    (hv : g.i (genericPoint g.Y) = f (pointClosureι ξ w)) : div (f17Φ hξ g.f) w = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hcw : coheight w = 1
  swap
  · rw [div_eq_ord]; exact Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hcw _
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := f17σ_surjective hv g.f
  have hunit : IsUnit a := by
    have hmax := RingHom.ker_isMaximal_of_surjective _ (f17σ_surjective hv)
    have hK := IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hmax
    by_contra hna
    have hm : a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _ :=
      (IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal a).mpr (mem_nonunits_iff.mpr hna)
    rw [← hK, RingHom.mem_ker, ha] at hm
    exact g.hf hm
  have hc := f17_comp hξ w (genericPoint g.Y) hv a
  have hid : (g.Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (f17_genericPoint_specializes g.Y _)).hom
      (f17σ hv a) = g.f := by
    rw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkSpecializes_refl, ha]
    rfl
  have key : f17Φ hξ g.f = algebraMap ((pointClosureScheme ξ).presheaf.stalk w)
      (pointClosureScheme ξ).functionField
      (((pointClosureι ξ).stalkMap w).hom ((f.stalkMap (pointClosureι ξ w)).hom a)) := by
    rw [hc]
    congr 1
    exact hid.symm
  have hu := (hunit.map (f.stalkMap (pointClosureι ξ w)).hom).map
    ((pointClosureι ξ).stalkMap w).hom
  rw [key, Scheme.div_algebraMap_eq_length_toNat hcw _ hu.ne_zero,
    Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top.mpr hu]
  haveI : Subsingleton ((pointClosureScheme ξ).presheaf.stalk w ⧸
      (⊤ : Ideal ((pointClosureScheme ξ).presheaf.stalk w))) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.subsingleton_iff.mpr rfl
  rw [Module.length_eq_zero]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_pointwise_pos
statement:
theorem f17_pointwise_pos [Flat f] [QuasiCompact f] (hX : DimensionCatenary X) {d : ℕ}
    (hf : PureRelDim f d) (hH : height (f17η g) = k + 1) (x : X) :
    flatPullback f g.cycle.1 x = ∑ ξ ∈ (f17Ξ_finite f g).toFinset.attach,
      (flatPullbackCoeff f ξ.1 : ℤ) * properPushforward (pointClosureι ξ.1)
        (div (f17Φ ((f17Ξ_finite f g).mem_toFinset.mp ξ.2).1 g.f)) x
proof:
:= by
  set hfin := f17Ξ_finite f g
  rw [flatPullback_apply]
  change properPushforward g.i (div g.f) (f x) * _ = _
  by_cases hrange : f x ∈ Set.range g.i
  swap
  · rw [f17_pushforward_apply_of_not_mem hrange, zero_mul]
    symm
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro ξ _
    have : ¬ ξ.1 ⤳ x := fun h ↦ hrange (f17_range (hfin.mem_toFinset.mp ξ.2).1 h)
    rw [f17_pc_apply_eq_zero this, mul_zero]
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hrange
  rw [f17_pushforward_apply hv]
  by_cases hgood : flatPullbackCoeff f x ≠ 0 ∧ coheight v = 1
  · exact f17_good hv hgood.2 hgood.1 hfin
  have hLHS : div g.f v * (flatPullbackCoeff f x : ℤ) = 0 := by
    by_cases hcx : flatPullbackCoeff f x = 0
    · simp [hcx]
    · have hcv : coheight v ≠ 1 := fun h ↦ hgood ⟨hcx, h⟩
      rw [div_eq_ord, Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hcv, zero_mul]
  rw [hLHS]
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro ξ _
  have hξ := hfin.mem_toFinset.mp ξ.2
  by_cases h : ξ.1 ⤳ x
  swap
  · rw [f17_pc_apply_eq_zero h, mul_zero]
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : x ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι ξ.1) := by
    rw [range_pointClosureι]; exact specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp h
  rw [← hw, f17_pc_apply]
  by_cases hvη : v = genericPoint g.Y
  · subst hvη
    rw [f17_unit_zero hξ.1 w (hv.trans (congrArg f hw).symm), mul_zero]
  by_cases hcw : coheight w = 1
  swap
  · rw [div_eq_ord, Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hcw, mul_zero]
  exfalso
  have hiv : g.i v ≠ f17η g := fun e ↦ hvη (g.i.isEmbedding.injective e)
  by_cases hcx : flatPullbackCoeff f x = 0
  · have hnm : ¬ ∀ z, z ⤳ x → f z = f x → z = x := fun hm ↦ f17_coeff_ne_zero_of_max f x hm hcx
    push Not at hnm
    obtain ⟨z, hzx, hfz, hne⟩ := hnm
    obtain ⟨b', hb'z, hfb'⟩ := f17_exists_generization f z
      ((f17_hη hv).trans (specializes_of_eq hfz.symm))
    have hb'ne : b' ≠ z := by
      intro e
      apply hiv
      rw [hv, ← hfz, ← e, hfb']
    exact f17_no_long_chain hX hf hH hξ w hcw hw hzx hne hb'z hb'ne ⟨_, hfb'.symm⟩
  · have hcv : coheight v ≠ 1 := fun h ↦ hgood ⟨hcx, h⟩
    have hc0 : coheight v ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, Order.coheight_eq_zero]
      intro hmax
      exact hvη (f17_eq_genericPoint_of_isMax hmax)
    have h2 : ((2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ coheight v := by
      generalize coheight v = c at hcv hc0 ⊢
      induction c using ENat.recTopCoe with
      | top => exact le_top
      | coe n =>
          norm_cast at hcv hc0 ⊢
          omega
    obtain ⟨p, hp0, hplen⟩ := Order.exists_series_of_le_coheight v h2
    have h01 : p ⟨0, by omega⟩ < p ⟨1, by omega⟩ := p.strictMono (by simp [Fin.lt_def])
    have h12 : p ⟨1, by omega⟩ < p ⟨2, by omega⟩ := p.strictMono (by simp [Fin.lt_def])
    have hp0' : p ⟨0, by omega⟩ = v := hp0
    rw [hp0'] at h01
    have hs1 : p ⟨1, by omega⟩ ⤳ v := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp h01.le
    have hs2 : p ⟨2, by omega⟩ ⤳ p ⟨1, by omega⟩ := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp h12.le
    obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁x, hfx₁⟩ := f17_exists_generization f x
      ((hs1.map g.i.continuous).trans (specializes_of_eq hv))
    obtain ⟨x₂, hx₂x₁, hfx₂⟩ := f17_exists_generization f x₁
      ((hs2.map g.i.continuous).trans (specializes_of_eq hfx₁.symm))
    have hx₁ne : x₁ ≠ x := by
      intro e
      apply h01.ne'
      apply g.i.isEmbedding.injective
      rw [← hfx₁, e, hv]
    have hx₂ne : x₂ ≠ x₁ := by
      intro e
      apply h12.ne'
      apply g.i.isEmbedding.injective
      rw [← hfx₂, e, hfx₁]
    exact f17_no_long_chain hX hf hH hξ w hcw hw hx₁x hx₁ne hx₂x₁ hx₂ne ⟨_, hfx₂.symm⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_pullback_zero_of_ne
statement:
theorem f17_pullback_zero_of_ne [Flat f] (hX : DimensionCatenary X) {d : ℕ}
    (hf : PureRelDim f d) (hH : height (f17η g) ≠ k + 1) : flatPullback f g.cycle.1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.ext
  intro x
  rw [flatPullback_apply, Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
  change properPushforward g.i (div g.f) (f x) * _ = 0
  by_contra hne
  have hL : properPushforward g.i (div g.f) (f x) ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul hne
  have hcx : flatPullbackCoeff f x ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hne
    simp [h]
  have hrange : f x ∈ Set.range g.i := by
    by_contra hr
    exact hL (f17_pushforward_apply_of_not_mem hr)
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hrange
  rw [f17_pushforward_apply hv] at hL
  have hcv : coheight v = 1 := div_support hL
  obtain ⟨q, hq, -⟩ := Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_le (f17_J_le_max hv)
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, h, -⟩ := f17_exists_of_minimal hv hcv hcx q hq
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : x ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι ξ) := by
    rw [range_pointClosureι]; exact specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp h
  have hcw := f17_coheight_pc hv hcv hcx hξ w hw
  have hcat := hX _ (pointClosureι ξ) w hcw
  rw [f17_pc_generic, hw, hf ξ hξ.2, hξ.1, hf x hcx, ← hv, g.dimension v hcv] at hcat
  apply hH
  apply enat_add_right_cancel (ENat.coe_ne_top d)
  rw [← hcat]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.f17_sum_apply
statement:
theorem f17_sum_apply {ι : Type*} {n : ℕ} (s : Finset ι) (D : ι → dimensionCycles X n) (x : X) :
    ((∑ i ∈ s, D i : dimensionCycles X n) : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) x =
      ∑ i ∈ s, (D i : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [AddSubgroup.val_finsetSum, Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.flatPullback_generator_mem
statement:
theorem flatPullback_generator_mem [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (f : X ⟶ Y) [Flat f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (hX : DimensionCatenary X) {d k : ℕ} (hf : PureRelDim f d) (g : DimRelationGenerator Y k) :
    (⟨flatPullback f g.cycle.1, flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles f hf g.cycle.2⟩ :
      dimensionCycles X (k + d)) ∈ dimRationalEquivalence X (k + d)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hH : height (f17η g) = k + 1
  · set hfin := f17Ξ_finite f g
    have heq : (⟨flatPullback f g.cycle.1, flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles f hf g.cycle.2⟩ :
        dimensionCycles X (k + d)) = ∑ ξ ∈ hfin.toFinset.attach,
          (flatPullbackCoeff f ξ.1 : ℤ) • (f17gen hX hf hH (hfin.mem_toFinset.mp ξ.2)).cycle := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.ext
      intro x
      rw [f17_sum_apply, f17_pointwise_pos hX hf hH x]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ξ _ ↦ ?_
      rw [AddSubgroup.coe_zsmul, Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_zsmul, Pi.smul_apply,
        smul_eq_mul]
      rfl
    rw [heq]
    exact AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun ξ _ ↦
      AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem _ (AddSubgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_range_self _)) _
  · have h0 := f17_pullback_zero_of_ne hX hf hH
    have : (⟨flatPullback f g.cycle.1, flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles f hf g.cycle.2⟩ :
        dimensionCycles X (k + d)) = 0 := Subtype.ext h0
    rw [this]
    exact zero_mem _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.flatPullback_mem_dimRationalEquivalence
statement:
theorem flatPullback_mem_dimRationalEquivalence [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (f : X ⟶ Y) [Flat f]
    [QuasiCompact f] (hX : DimensionCatenary X) {d k : ℕ} (hf : PureRelDim f d) (D : dimensionCycles Y k)
    (hD : D ∈ dimRationalEquivalence Y k) :
    (⟨flatPullback f D.1, flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles f hf D.2⟩ :
      dimensionCycles X (k + d)) ∈ dimRationalEquivalence X (k + d)
proof:
:= by
  induction hD using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem D hD =>
      obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := hD
      exact flatPullback_generator_mem f hX hf g
  | zero =>
      have : (⟨flatPullback f (0 : dimensionCycles Y k).1,
          flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles f hf (0 : dimensionCycles Y k).2⟩ :
            dimensionCycles X (k + d)) = 0 := Subtype.ext ((flatPullbackHom f).map_zero)
      rw [this]; exact zero_mem _
  | add D E _ _ hD hE =>
      have : (⟨flatPullback f (D + E).1,
          flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles f hf (D + E).2⟩ : dimensionCycles X (k + d)) =
          ⟨flatPullback f D.1, flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles f hf D.2⟩ +
          ⟨flatPullback f E.1, flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles f hf E.2⟩ :=
        Subtype.ext (flatPullback_add f D.1 E.1)
      rw [this]; exact add_mem hD hE
  | neg D _ hD =>
      have : (⟨flatPullback f (-D).1,
          flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles f hf (-D).2⟩ : dimensionCycles X (k + d)) =
          -⟨flatPullback f D.1, flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles f hf D.2⟩ :=
        Subtype.ext ((flatPullbackHom f).map_neg D.1)
      rw [this]; exact neg_mem hD

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.flatPullbackChow_mk
statement:
theorem flatPullbackChow_mk [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (f : X ⟶ Y) [Flat f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (hX : DimensionCatenary X) {d : ℕ} (hf : PureRelDim f d) (k : ℕ) (D : dimensionCycles Y k) :
    flatPullbackChow f hX hf k (QuotientAddGroup.mk D) =
      QuotientAddGroup.mk ⟨flatPullback f D.1, flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles f hf D.2⟩
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.rationalizeAddHom_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rationalizeAddHom_tmul
    {A : Type v} {B : Type w} [AddCommGroup A] [AddCommGroup B]
    (f : A →+ B) (a : ℚ) (x : A) :
    rationalizeAddHom f (a ⊗ₜ[ℤ] x) = a ⊗ₜ[ℤ] f x
proof:
:= by
  simp [rationalizeAddHom]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.rationalizeAddHom_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rationalizeAddHom_zero
    {A : Type v} {B : Type w} [AddCommGroup A] [AddCommGroup B] :
    rationalizeAddHom (0 : A →+ B) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply AddMonoidHom.ext
  intro z
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => rfl
  | tmul a x => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp [hx, hy]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.rationalizeAddHom_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rationalizeAddHom_add
    {A : Type v} {B : Type w} [AddCommGroup A] [AddCommGroup B]
    (f g : A →+ B) :
    rationalizeAddHom (f + g) = rationalizeAddHom f + rationalizeAddHom g
proof:
:= by
  apply AddMonoidHom.ext
  intro z
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => rfl
  | tmul a x =>
      simp only [rationalizeAddHom_tmul, AddMonoidHom.add_apply]
      rw [TensorProduct.tmul_add]
  | add x y hx hy =>
      simp only [map_add, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, hx, hy]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.IntersectionPairingData.integralLeftRationalHom_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem integralLeftRationalHom_tmul
    (x : CodimensionChow X p) (b : ℚ) (y : CodimensionChow X q) :
    T.integralLeftRationalHom x (b ⊗ₜ[ℤ] y) =
      b ⊗ₜ[ℤ] T.product x y
proof:
:=
  rationalizeAddHom_tmul _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.IntersectionPairingData.rationalProduct_tmul_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rationalProduct_tmul_tmul
    (a b : ℚ) (x : CodimensionChow X p) (y : CodimensionChow X q) :
    T.rationalProduct (a ⊗ₜ[ℤ] x) (b ⊗ₜ[ℤ] y) =
      (a * b) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] T.product x y
proof:
:= by
  simp [rationalProduct, rationalProductHom, integralLeftRationalHom,
    rationalizeAddHom]
  change (a * b) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] T.product x y = _
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.IntersectionPairingData.rationalProduct_zero_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rationalProduct_zero_left (y : RationalCodimensionChow X q) :
    T.rationalProduct 0 y = 0
proof:
:= by
  change T.rationalProductHom 0 y = 0
  rw [map_zero]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.IntersectionPairingData.rationalProduct_zero_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rationalProduct_zero_right (x : RationalCodimensionChow X p) :
    T.rationalProduct x 0 = 0

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.IntersectionPairingData.rationalProduct_add_left
statement:
theorem rationalProduct_add_left
    (x x' : RationalCodimensionChow X p) (y : RationalCodimensionChow X q) :
    T.rationalProduct (x + x') y =
      T.rationalProduct x y + T.rationalProduct x' y
proof:
:= by
  change T.rationalProductHom (x + x') y = _

  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.IntersectionPairingData.rationalProduct_add_right
statement:
theorem rationalProduct_add_right
    (x : RationalCodimensionChow X p) (y y' : RationalCodimensionChow X q) :
    T.rationalProduct x (y + y') =
      T.rationalProduct x y + T.rationalProduct x y'
proof:
:=
  map_add (T.rationalProductHom x) y y'

name: ModuleCat.natCast_le_depth_iff
statement:
theorem natCast_le_depth_iff [Small.{v} R] (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{v} R) (n : ℕ) :
    (n : ℕ∞) ≤ depth I M ↔
      ∀ i < n, Subsingleton (Ext (ModuleCat.of R (Shrink.{v} (R ⧸ I))) M i)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h i hi
    rw [depth] at h
    by_contra hsub
    letI : Nontrivial (Ext (ModuleCat.of R (Shrink.{v} (R ⧸ I))) M i) :=
      not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial.mp hsub
    have hle : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ (i : ℕ∞) :=
      h.trans (iInf_le (fun j : {j : ℕ // Nontrivial
        (Ext (ModuleCat.of R (Shrink.{v} (R ⧸ I))) M j)} ↦ (j.1 : ℕ∞)) ⟨i, inferInstance⟩)
    exact (not_le_of_gt hi) (by exact_mod_cast hle)
  · intro h
    rw [depth]
    refine le_iInf fun i ↦ ?_
    by_contra hle
    have hi : i.1 < n := by
      exact_mod_cast (lt_of_not_ge hle)
    exact not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial.mpr i.2 (h i.1 hi)

name: ModuleCat.natCast_le_depth_quotSMulTop_of_succ_le_depth
statement:
theorem natCast_le_depth_quotSMulTop_of_succ_le_depth [Small.{v} R]
    (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{v} R) (r : R) (hr : IsSMulRegular M r) (n : ℕ)
    (h : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ depth I M) :
    (n : ℕ∞) ≤ depth I (ModuleCat.of R (QuotSMulTop r M))
proof:
:= by
  rw [natCast_le_depth_iff] at h ⊢
  intro i hi
  have zero1 := AddCommGrpCat.isZero_of_iff_subsingleton.mpr (h i (by omega))
  have zero2 := AddCommGrpCat.isZero_of_iff_subsingleton.mpr (h (i + 1) (by omega))
  exact AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero <| ShortComplex.Exact.isZero_of_both_zeros
    ((Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₃'
      (ModuleCat.of R (Shrink.{v} (R ⧸ I))) hr.smulShortComplex_shortExact)
      i (i + 1) rfl)
    (zero1.eq_zero_of_src _) (zero2.eq_zero_of_tgt _)

name: ModuleCat.natCast_le_depth_iff_exists_isRegular
statement:
theorem natCast_le_depth_iff_exists_isRegular [Small.{v} R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (I : Ideal R) (M : ModuleCat.{v} R) [Module.Finite R M]
    (smul_lt : I • (⊤ : Submodule R M) < ⊤) (n : ℕ) :
    (n : ℕ∞) ≤ depth I M ↔
      ∃ rs : List R, rs.length = n ∧ (∀ r ∈ rs, r ∈ I) ∧ IsRegular M rs
proof:
:= by
  rw [natCast_le_depth_iff]
  exact (exists_isRegular_tfae I n M smul_lt).out 1 3

name: ModuleCat.natCast_le_localDepth_iff_exists_isWeaklyRegular
statement:
theorem natCast_le_localDepth_iff_exists_isWeaklyRegular [Small.{v} R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R] (M : ModuleCat.{v} R)
    [Module.Finite R M] [Nontrivial M] (n : ℕ) :
    (n : ℕ∞) ≤ localDepth M ↔
      ∃ rs : List R, rs.length = n ∧
        (∀ r ∈ rs, r ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) ∧ IsWeaklyRegular M rs
proof:
:= by
  have smul_lt :
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R • (⊤ : Submodule R M) < ⊤ := by
    rw [lt_top_iff_ne_top]
    exact (Submodule.top_ne_ideal_smul_of_le_jacobson_annihilator
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_le_jacobson (Module.annihilator R M))).symm
  rw [localDepth, natCast_le_depth_iff_exists_isRegular
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) M smul_lt n]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨rs, hrs, hmem, hreg⟩
    exact ⟨rs, hrs, hmem, hreg.toIsWeaklyRegular⟩
  · rintro ⟨rs, hrs, hmem, hreg⟩
    exact ⟨rs, hrs, hmem,
      IsRegular.of_isWeaklyRegular_of_mem_maximalIdeal M hmem hreg⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.D7.isIso_stalkMap_of_flat_of_preimmersion
statement:
theorem isIso_stalkMap_of_flat_of_preimmersion {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [Flat f]
    [IsPreimmersion f] (x : X) : IsIso (f.stalkMap x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
  refine ⟨?_, f.stalkMap_surjective x⟩
  algebraize [(f.stalkMap x).hom]
  have : Module.FaithfullyFlat (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    @Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom _ _ _ _ _ _ _
      (Flat.stalkMap f x) (f.toLRSHom.prop x)
  exact ‹RingHom.FaithfullyFlat _›.injective

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.D7.gS_closedPoint
statement:
theorem gS_closedPoint : gS Y (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (Y.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint Y))) =
    genericPoint Y
proof: := Scheme.fromSpecStalk_closedPoint

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.D7.genericPoint_map_of_isDominant'
statement: theorem genericPoint_map_of_isDominant' [IsDominant h] : h (genericPoint W) = genericPoint Y
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (genericPoint_spec W).image h.continuous
  rw [Set.image_univ, h.denseRange.closure_range] at h1
  exact h1.eq (genericPoint_spec Y)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.D7.exists_point
statement:
theorem exists_point [IsDominant h] :
    ∃ x0 : GF h, gF h x0 = genericPoint W
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, -⟩ := Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback (f := h) (g := gS Y)
    (genericPoint W) (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (Y.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint Y)))
    ((genericPoint_map_of_isDominant' h).trans gS_closedPoint.symm)
