name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.D7.closure_point
statement:
theorem closure_point {x0 : GF h} (hx0 : gF h x0 = genericPoint W) :
    closure {x0} = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.eq_univ_of_forall
  intro x'
  rw [← specializes_iff_mem_closure]
  refine ((gF h).isEmbedding.isInducing.specializes_iff).mp ?_
  rw [hx0]
  exact genericPoint_specializes _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.D7.gF_genericPoint
statement: theorem gF_genericPoint [IsDominant h] : gF h (genericPoint (GF h)) = genericPoint W
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x0, hx0⟩ := exists_point h
  have : genericPoint (GF h) = x0 := (genericPoint_spec _).eq (closure_point h hx0)
  rw [this, hx0]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.finsuppPairing_apply
statement:
private theorem finsuppPairing_apply
    (K : CodimensionPoint X p → CodimensionPoint X q →
      CodimensionCycles X ℤ (p + q))
    (D : CodimensionPoint X p →₀ ℤ)
    (E : CodimensionPoint X q →₀ ℤ) :
    finsuppPairing K D E =
      D.sum fun x a ↦ E.sum fun y b ↦ (a * b) • K x y
proof:
:= by
  simp [finsuppPairing, coefficientHom, intSmulAddHom, smul_smul, mul_comm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.finsupp_sum_eq_support_sum
statement:
private theorem finsupp_sum_eq_support_sum
    {A M N : Type*} [Zero M] [AddCommMonoid N]
    (f : A →₀ M) (g : A → M → N) :
    f.sum g = ∑ x : f.support, g x.1 (f x.1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Finsupp.sum, Finset.sum_coe_sort_eq_attach]
  exact (Finset.sum_attach f.support (fun a ↦ g a (f a))).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.codim_of_mem_cycle_support
proof:
:= by
  apply D.2
  change D.1 x.1 ≠ 0
  simpa only [compactCycleFinsupp_apply] using Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp x.2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.expectedIntersectionCycle_eq_finsuppPairing
statement:
private theorem expectedIntersectionCycle_eq_finsuppPairing
    {D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ p} {E : CodimensionCycles X ℤ q}
    (h : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D E)
    (K : CodimensionPoint X p → CodimensionPoint X q →
      CodimensionCycles X ℤ (p + q))
    (hK : ∀ (x : (compactCycleFinsupp D.1).support)
      (y : (compactCycleFinsupp E.1).support),
      K ⟨x.1, codim_of_mem_cycle_support D x⟩
          ⟨y.1, codim_of_mem_cycle_support E y⟩ =
        (expectedPrimeIntersectionData h x y).cycle) :
    finsuppPairing K (compactCodimCycleFinsupp p D)
        (compactCodimCycleFinsupp q E) =
      expectedIntersectionCycle h
proof:
:= by
  rw [finsuppPairing_apply]
  simp only [expectedIntersectionCycle]
  rw [finsupp_sum_eq_support_sum]
  symm
  apply Fintype.sum_equiv (supportEquiv D) _ _
  intro x
  rw [finsupp_sum_eq_support_sum]
  apply Fintype.sum_equiv (supportEquiv E) _ _
  intro y
  simp only [supportEquiv, Equiv.coe_fn_mk, compactCodimCycleFinsupp_apply]
  rw [hK x y, compactCycleFinsupp_apply, compactCycleFinsupp_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.expectedIntersectionCycle_congr_left
statement:
theorem expectedIntersectionCycle_congr_left
    {D D' : CodimensionCycles X ℤ p} {E : CodimensionCycles X ℤ q}
    (h : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D E)
    (h' : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D' E)
    (hDD' : D = D') :
    expectedIntersectionCycle h = expectedIntersectionCycle h'
proof:
:= by
  subst D'
  exact expectedIntersectionCycle_proof_irrel _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.expectedIntersectionCycle_congr_right
statement:
theorem expectedIntersectionCycle_congr_right
    {D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ p} {E E' : CodimensionCycles X ℤ q}
    (h : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D E)
    (h' : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D E')
    (hEE' : E = E') :
    expectedIntersectionCycle h = expectedIntersectionCycle h'
proof:
:= by
  subst E'
  exact expectedIntersectionCycle_proof_irrel _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.commonPrimeIntersectionCycle_eq
statement:
private theorem commonPrimeIntersectionCycle_eq
    {D D' : CodimensionCycles X ℤ p} {E : CodimensionCycles X ℤ q}
    (h : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D E)
    (h' : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D' E)
    (A : CodimensionCycles X ℤ p)
    (hA : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension A E)
    (hxChoice : ∀ x : X, A.1 x ≠ 0 →
      D.1 x ≠ 0 ∨ (D.1 x = 0 ∧ D'.1 x ≠ 0))
    (x : (compactCycleFinsupp A.1).support)
    (y : (compactCycleFinsupp E.1).support) :
    commonPrimeIntersectionCycle h h'
        ⟨x.1, codim_of_mem_cycle_support A x⟩
        ⟨y.1, codim_of_mem_cycle_support E y⟩ =
      (expectedPrimeIntersectionData hA x y).cycle
proof:
:= by
  have hxA : A.1 x.1 ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [compactCycleFinsupp_apply] using
      Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp x.2
  have hyE : E.1 y.1 ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [compactCycleFinsupp_apply] using
      Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp y.2
  rcases hxChoice x.1 hxA with hxD | ⟨hxD, hxD'⟩
  · rw [commonPrimeIntersectionCycle, dif_pos hxD, dif_pos hyE]
    congr 1
  · rw [commonPrimeIntersectionCycle, dif_neg (not_ne_iff.mpr hxD),
      dif_pos hxD', dif_pos hyE]
    congr 1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.expectedIntersectionCycle_add_left
statement:
theorem expectedIntersectionCycle_add_left
    {D D' : CodimensionCycles X ℤ p} {E : CodimensionCycles X ℤ q}
    (h : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D E)
    (h' : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D' E) :
    expectedIntersectionCycle (h.add_left h') =
      expectedIntersectionCycle h + expectedIntersectionCycle h'
proof:
:= by
  let K := commonPrimeIntersectionCycle h h'
  have hD := expectedIntersectionCycle_eq_finsuppPairing h K
    (commonPrimeIntersectionCycle_eq h h' D h
      (fun x hx ↦ Or.inl hx))
  have hD' := expectedIntersectionCycle_eq_finsuppPairing h' K
    (commonPrimeIntersectionCycle_eq h h' D' h'
      (fun x hx ↦ by
        by_cases hxD : D.1 x ≠ 0
        · exact Or.inl hxD
        · exact Or.inr ⟨not_ne_iff.mp hxD, hx⟩))
  have hsum := expectedIntersectionCycle_eq_finsuppPairing
    (h.add_left h') K
    (commonPrimeIntersectionCycle_eq h h' (D + D') (h.add_left h')
      (fun x hx ↦ by
        change D.1 x + D'.1 x ≠ 0 at hx
        by_cases hxD : D.1 x ≠ 0
        · exact Or.inl hxD
        · exact Or.inr ⟨not_ne_iff.mp hxD, fun hxD' ↦ hx (by
            rw [not_ne_iff.mp hxD, hxD', zero_add])⟩))
  rw [show compactCodimCycleFinsupp p (D + D') =
      compactCodimCycleFinsupp p D + compactCodimCycleFinsupp p D' from
    map_add (compactCodimCycleFinsuppAddHom p) D D'] at hsum
  rw [map_add] at hsum
  change finsuppPairing K (compactCodimCycleFinsupp p D)
      (compactCodimCycleFinsupp q E) +
    finsuppPairing K (compactCodimCycleFinsupp p D')
      (compactCodimCycleFinsupp q E) =
    expectedIntersectionCycle (h.add_left h') at hsum
  rw [← hD, ← hD', ← hsum]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.expectedIntersectionCycle_zero_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem expectedIntersectionCycle_zero_left
    (E : CodimensionCycles X ℤ q) :
    expectedIntersectionCycle
      (CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension.zero_left (p := p) E) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [expectedIntersectionCycle]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.expectedIntersectionCycle_neg_left
statement:
theorem expectedIntersectionCycle_neg_left
    {D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ p} {E : CodimensionCycles X ℤ q}
    (h : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D E) :
    expectedIntersectionCycle h.neg_left = -expectedIntersectionCycle h
proof:
:= by
  have hadd := expectedIntersectionCycle_add_left h h.neg_left
  have hzero : expectedIntersectionCycle (h.add_left h.neg_left) = 0 := by
    simpa only [add_neg_cancel] using
      (expectedIntersectionCycle_zero_left (p := p) E)
  rw [hzero] at hadd
  exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left (by
    simpa only [add_comm] using hadd.symm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.expectedIntersectionCycle_add_right
statement:
theorem expectedIntersectionCycle_add_right
    {D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ p} {E E' : CodimensionCycles X ℤ q}
    (h : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D E)
    (h' : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D E') :
    expectedIntersectionCycle (h.add_right h') =
      expectedIntersectionCycle h + expectedIntersectionCycle h'
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hadd := congrArg
    (fun C : CodimensionCycles X ℤ (q + p) ↦ C.1)
    (expectedIntersectionCycle_add_left h.symm h'.symm)
  calc
    (expectedIntersectionCycle (h.add_right h')).1 =
        (expectedIntersectionCycle (h.add_right h').symm).1 :=
      (expectedIntersectionCycle_symm (h.add_right h')).symm
    _ = (expectedIntersectionCycle (h.symm.add_left h'.symm)).1 :=
      congrArg Subtype.val (expectedIntersectionCycle_proof_irrel _ _)
    _ = (expectedIntersectionCycle h.symm +
        expectedIntersectionCycle h'.symm).1 := hadd
    _ = (expectedIntersectionCycle h + expectedIntersectionCycle h').1 := by
      change (expectedIntersectionCycle h.symm).1 +
          (expectedIntersectionCycle h'.symm).1 =
        (expectedIntersectionCycle h).1 +
          (expectedIntersectionCycle h').1
      rw [expectedIntersectionCycle_symm h,
        expectedIntersectionCycle_symm h']

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.expectedIntersectionCycle_zero_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem expectedIntersectionCycle_zero_right
    (D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ p) :
    expectedIntersectionCycle

proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.expectedIntersectionCycle_neg_right
statement:
theorem expectedIntersectionCycle_neg_right
    {D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ p} {E : CodimensionCycles X ℤ q}
    (h : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D E) :
    expectedIntersectionCycle h.neg_right = -expectedIntersectionCycle h
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hneg := congrArg
    (fun C : CodimensionCycles X ℤ (q + p) ↦ C.1)
    (expectedIntersectionCycle_neg_left h.symm)
  calc
    (expectedIntersectionCycle h.neg_right).1 =
        (expectedIntersectionCycle h.neg_right.symm).1 :=
      (expectedIntersectionCycle_symm h.neg_right).symm
    _ = (expectedIntersectionCycle h.symm.neg_left).1 :=
      congrArg Subtype.val (expectedIntersectionCycle_proof_irrel _ _)
    _ = (-expectedIntersectionCycle h.symm).1 := hneg
    _ = (-expectedIntersectionCycle h).1 := by
      change -(expectedIntersectionCycle h.symm).1 =
        -(expectedIntersectionCycle h).1
      rw [expectedIntersectionCycle_symm h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PushforwardCodimensionCompatible.comp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.properPushforwardCycles_comp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.properPushforwardCycles_eq_closedImmersion

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProperPushforwardDescends.comp
statement:
theorem comp {g : Y ⟶ Z} [QuasiCompact g] {r : ℕ} (hf : ProperPushforwardDescends f p q)
    (hg : ProperPushforwardDescends g q r) : ProperPushforwardDescends (f ≫ g) p r where
  codimension
proof:
:= hf.codimension.comp hg.codimension
  relation G := by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProperPushforwardDescends.of_closedImmersion

theorem of_closedImmersion (j : X ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion j]

    ProperPushforwardDescends j p q where
  codimension
proof:
:= PushforwardCodimensionCompatible.of_closedImmersion j codimension
  relation G := by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.properPushforwardChow_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem properPushforwardChow_classOf (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] {p q : ℕ}

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.properPushforwardChow_comp
statement:
theorem properPushforwardChow_comp (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) [QuasiCompact f]
    [QuasiCompact g] {p q r : ℕ} (hf : ProperPushforwardDescends f p q)
    (hg : ProperPushforwardDescends g q r) (hfg : ProperPushforwardDescends (f ≫ g) p r) :
    properPushforwardChow (f ≫ g) hfg =
      (properPushforwardChow g hg).comp (properPushforwardChow f hf)
proof:
:= by

  intro D
  rw [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, properPushforwardChow_classOf, properPushforwardChow_classOf,
    properPushforwardChow_classOf,

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.properPushforwardChow_id

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.properPushforwardChow_eq_closedImmersion

theorem properPushforwardRationalChow_comp_closedImmersion (j : X ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion j]

    properPushforwardRationalChow (j ≫ g) hjg =

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.principalWeilDivisor_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem principalWeilDivisor_one :
    principalWeilDivisor X 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change AlgebraicGeometry.div (1 : X.functionField) = 0
  have h := AlgebraicGeometry.div_mul (X := X)
    (1 : X.functionField) one_ne_zero 1 one_ne_zero
  rw [one_mul] at h
  have hzero : (0 : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) =
      AlgebraicGeometry.div (1 : X.functionField) := by
    apply add_right_cancel (b := AlgebraicGeometry.div
      (1 : X.functionField))
    simpa only [zero_add] using h
  exact hzero.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.principalWeilDivisor_mul
statement:
theorem principalWeilDivisor_mul
    (f g : X.functionField) (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    principalWeilDivisor X (f * g) =
      principalWeilDivisor X f + principalWeilDivisor X g
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact AlgebraicGeometry.div_mul f hf g hg

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.principalWeilDivisor_inv
statement:
theorem principalWeilDivisor_inv
    (f : X.functionField) (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    principalWeilDivisor X f⁻¹ = -principalWeilDivisor X f
proof:
:= by
  have hmul : principalWeilDivisor X (f * f⁻¹) =
      principalWeilDivisor X f + principalWeilDivisor X f⁻¹ :=
    principalWeilDivisor_mul X f f⁻¹ hf (inv_ne_zero hf)
  rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hf, principalWeilDivisor_one] at hmul
  exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left (by
    simpa only [add_comm] using hmul.symm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.mem_principalDivisorSubgroup_iff
statement:
theorem mem_principalDivisorSubgroup_iff
    (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    D ∈ principalDivisorSubgroup X ↔
      ∃ f : X.functionField, f ≠ 0 ∧
        D = principalWeilDivisor X f
proof:
:= by
  change D ∈ AddSubgroup.closure
      {E | ∃ f : X.functionField, f ≠ 0 ∧
        E = principalWeilDivisor X f} ↔ _
  constructor
  · intro hD
    exact (show AddSubgroup.closure
      {E | ∃ f : X.functionField, f ≠ 0 ∧
        E = principalWeilDivisor X f} ≤
      singlePrincipalDivisorSubgroup (X := X) by
        rw [AddSubgroup.closure_le]
        exact fun _ h ↦ h) hD
  · exact fun hD ↦ AddSubgroup.subset_closure hD

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.classOf_zero

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.classOf_principalWeilDivisor
statement:
@[simp]
theorem classOf_principalWeilDivisor (f : X.functionField) (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    classOf X (principalWeilDivisor X f) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change QuotientAddGroup.mk' (principalDivisorSubgroup X) (principalWeilDivisor X f) = 0
  apply QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem.mpr
  rw [sub_zero]
  change principalWeilDivisor X f ∈ AddSubgroup.closure
    {D | ∃ g : X.functionField, g ≠ 0 ∧ D = principalWeilDivisor X g}
  exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩

proof:

  QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.selfLocalLength_eq_morphismLocalLength_closedImmersion
statement:
theorem selfLocalLength_eq_morphismLocalLength_closedImmersion
    {Z X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] (f : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion f] (z : Z) :
    selfLocalLength z = morphismLocalLength f z
proof:
:= by
  unfold selfLocalLength morphismLocalLength
  letI : Algebra ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (f z)) ↑(Z.presheaf.stalk z) :=
    (f.stalkMap z).hom.toAlgebra
  exact (Module.length_eq_of_surjective (f.stalkMap_surjective z)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.cycle_apply_toX

theorem cycle_apply_toX (z : d.intersection)

    d.cycle.1 (d.toX z) = (genericMultiplicity z : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  change (AlgebraicCycle.pushforward d.toX (fundamentalCycle d.intersection)
    (fun _ ↦ (r : ℕ∞)) coheight) (d.toX z) = _
  rw [AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_closedImmersion d.toX
    (fundamentalCycle d.intersection) (fun _ ↦ (r : ℕ∞)) coheight
    d.fundamental_grade z]
  exact fundamentalCycle_apply_of_mem_genericPoints hz

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.cycle_support

    (fun _ ↦ (r : ℕ∞)) coheight).support = _
  rw [AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_support_closedImmersion d.toX
    (fundamentalCycle d.intersection) (fun _ ↦ (r : ℕ∞)) coheight
    d.fundamental_grade, fundamentalCycle_support]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteClosedIntersectionData.intersection_mem_genericPoints
statement:
theorem intersection_mem_genericPoints (z : d.intersection) :
    z ∈ genericPoints d.intersection
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsNoetherian d.intersection :=
    ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.instIsNoetherianIntersection
      d.toExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData
  have hlength : selfLocalLength z ≠ ⊤ := by
    rw [selfLocalLength_eq_morphismLocalLength_closedImmersion d.toX z]
    exact d.finiteLength z
  letI : IsArtinianRing ↑(d.intersection.presheaf.stalk z) :=
    (isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp
      (Module.length_ne_top_iff.mp hlength)).2
  apply mem_genericPoints_iff_coheight_eq_zero.mpr
  apply WithBot.coe_eq_coe.mp
  rw [← ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight]
  exact ringKrullDimZero_iff_ringKrullDim_eq_zero.mp inferInstance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteClosedIntersectionData.localMultiplicity_eq_genericMultiplicity
statement:
theorem localMultiplicity_eq_genericMultiplicity (z : d.intersection) :
    d.localMultiplicity z = genericMultiplicity z
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsNoetherian d.intersection :=
    ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.instIsNoetherianIntersection
      d.toExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData
  unfold localMultiplicity genericMultiplicity
  exact congrArg ENat.toNat
    (selfLocalLength_eq_morphismLocalLength_closedImmersion d.toX z).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteClosedIntersectionData.cycle_eq_expectedCodimensionCycle
statement:
theorem cycle_eq_expectedCodimensionCycle :
    d.cycle = d.toExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.cycle
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsNoetherian d.intersection :=
    ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.instIsNoetherianIntersection
      d.toExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.range d.toX
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [d.cycle_apply_toX]
    have htoX : d.toX = d.toExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.toX := by
      rfl
    rw [htoX]
    have hnew := ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.cycle_apply_toX
        d.toExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData z
        (d.intersection_mem_genericPoints z)
    calc
      (d.localMultiplicity z : ℤ) = (genericMultiplicity z : ℤ) := by
        exact_mod_cast d.localMultiplicity_eq_genericMultiplicity z
      _ = d.toExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.cycle.1
          (d.toExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.toX z) := by
        convert hnew.symm using 1
        unfold genericMultiplicity selfLocalLength
        dsimp [FiniteClosedIntersectionData.intersection,
          ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.intersection,
          toExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData]
        change (↑(Module.length ↑(d.intersection.presheaf.stalk z)
          ↑(d.intersection.presheaf.stalk z)).toNat : ℤ) =
            ↑(Module.length ↑(d.intersection.presheaf.stalk z)
              ↑(d.intersection.presheaf.stalk z)).toNat
        rfl
  · have hold : d.cycle.1 x = 0 :=
      d.cycle_apply_eq_zero_of_not_exists x hx
    have hnew : d.toExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.cycle.1 x = 0 := by
      change (AlgebraicCycle.pushforward d.toX (fundamentalCycle d.intersection)
        (fun _ ↦ (r : ℕ∞)) coheight) x = 0
      exact AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range d.toX
        (fundamentalCycle d.intersection) (fun _ ↦ (r : ℕ∞)) coheight x hx
    rw [hold, hnew]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ord_algebraMap_eq_ringOrd
statement:
theorem ord_algebraMap_eq_ringOrd {pt w : X} (h : w ⤳ pt) (hw : coheight w = 1)
    (c : X.presheaf.stalk pt) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    letI
proof:
:= Scheme.stalkSpecializesAlgebra h
    X.ord (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) X.functionField c) w =
      ((Ring.ord (X.presheaf.stalk w)
        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) (X.presheaf.stalk w) c)).toNat : ℤ) := by
  letI := Scheme.stalkSpecializesAlgebra h
  haveI := Scheme.isScalarTower_functionField h
  letI : Ring.KrullDimLE 1 (X.presheaf.stalk w) := krullDimLE_of_coheight hw
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) X.functionField) :=
    IsFractionRing.injective _ _
  have hne : algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) (X.presheaf.stalk w) c ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hc
    apply hinj
    rw [map_zero, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply (X.presheaf.stalk pt) (X.presheaf.stalk w)
      X.functionField c, hzero, map_zero]
  rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply (X.presheaf.stalk pt) (X.presheaf.stalk w) X.functionField c,
    Scheme.ord_algebraMap_eq_length_toNat hw _ hne]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.localEquation_ne_zero
statement:
theorem localEquation_ne_zero {pt x : X} (hx : x ⤳ pt) (hxc : coheight x = 1)
    {π : X.presheaf.stalk pt} (hgen : Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hx = Ideal.span {π}) :
    π ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  refine Ideal.ne_bot_of_height_eq_one (I := Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hx) ?_ ?_
  · rw [Scheme.height_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes, hxc]
  · rw [hgen, h, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.localEquation_prime
statement:
theorem localEquation_prime {pt x : X} (hx : x ⤳ pt) (hxc : coheight x = 1)
    {π : X.presheaf.stalk pt} (hgen : Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hx = Ideal.span {π}) :
    Prime π
proof:
:= by
  have hπ : π ≠ 0 := localEquation_ne_zero hx hxc hgen
  refine (Ideal.span_singleton_prime hπ).mp ?_
  rw [← hgen]
  exact Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_isPrime hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ord_localEquation_self
statement:
theorem ord_localEquation_self {pt x : X} (hx : x ⤳ pt) (hxc : coheight x = 1)
    {π : X.presheaf.stalk pt} (hgen : Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hx = Ideal.span {π}) :
    X.ord (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) X.functionField π) x = 1
proof:
:= by
  haveI := IsRegularInCodimensionOne.stalk_dvr x hxc
  have hπ0 : π ≠ 0 := localEquation_ne_zero hx hxc hgen
  have hπ : Prime π := localEquation_prime hx hxc hgen
  letI := Scheme.stalkSpecializesAlgebra hx
  have h1 : (1 : ℕ∞) ≤ Ring.ord (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) (X.presheaf.stalk x) π) := by
    have hd : π ^ 1 ∣ π := ⟨1, by ring⟩
    have h := (Scheme.pow_dvd_iff_natCast_le_ord hx hπ hgen π 1).mp hd
    rwa [Nat.cast_one] at h
  have h2 : ¬ ((2 : ℕ∞) ≤ Ring.ord (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) (X.presheaf.stalk x) π)) := by
    intro hle
    have hle' : ((2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ Ring.ord (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) (X.presheaf.stalk x) π) := by
      rw [Nat.cast_ofNat]
      exact hle
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (Scheme.pow_dvd_iff_natCast_le_ord hx hπ hgen π 2).mpr hle'
    have hcancel : π * 1 = π * (π * c) := by
      rw [mul_one]
      calc π = π ^ 2 * c := hc
        _ = π * (π * c) := by ring
    exact hπ.not_unit (isUnit_of_dvd_one ⟨c, mul_left_cancel₀ hπ0 hcancel⟩)
  set o := Ring.ord (X.presheaf.stalk x)
    (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) (X.presheaf.stalk x) π) with ho
  have hfin : o ≠ ⊤ := fun htop ↦ h2 (htop ▸ le_top)
  have hcast : ((o.toNat : ℕ) : ℕ∞) = o := ENat.coe_toNat hfin
  have h1' : 1 ≤ o.toNat := by
    have hc1 : ((1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ ((o.toNat : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
      rw [hcast, Nat.cast_one]; exact h1
    exact_mod_cast hc1
  have h2' : o.toNat < 2 := by
    by_contra hge
    refine h2 ?_
    have hc2 : ((2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ ((o.toNat : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.not_lt.mp hge
    rw [hcast, Nat.cast_ofNat] at hc2
    exact hc2
  rw [ord_algebraMap_eq_ringOrd hx hxc π hπ0, ← ho]
  have hone : o.toNat = 1 := by omega
  rw [hone]
  norm_num

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ord_localEquation_of_ne
statement:
theorem ord_localEquation_of_ne {pt x w : X} (hx : x ⤳ pt) (hw : w ⤳ pt)
    (hxc : coheight x = 1) (hwc : coheight w = 1) (hne : w ≠ x)
    {π πw : X.presheaf.stalk pt}
    (hgen : Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hx = Ideal.span {π})
    (hgenw : Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hw = Ideal.span {πw}) :
    X.ord (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) X.functionField π) w = 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI := IsRegularInCodimensionOne.stalk_dvr w hwc
  have hπ0 : π ≠ 0 := localEquation_ne_zero hx hxc hgen
  have hπw : Prime πw := localEquation_prime hw hwc hgenw
  letI := Scheme.stalkSpecializesAlgebra hw
  have hnotdvd : ¬ (πw ∣ π) := by
    intro hdvd
    have hmem : π ∈ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hw := by
      rw [hgenw, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
      exact hdvd
    have hsub : Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hx ≤ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hw := by
      rw [hgen, Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
      exact hmem
    have heq : Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hx = Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hw := by
      by_contra hne'
      have hlt : Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hx < Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hw :=
        lt_of_le_of_ne hsub hne'
      have h := Ideal.height_add_one_le_of_lt_of_isPrime hlt
      rw [Scheme.height_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes, Scheme.height_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes,
        hxc, hwc] at h
      norm_num at h
    exact hne (Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_injective hw hx heq.symm)
  have hlt : ¬ ((1 : ℕ∞) ≤ Ring.ord (X.presheaf.stalk w)
      (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) (X.presheaf.stalk w) π)) := by
    intro hle
    exact hnotdvd (by simpa using
      (Scheme.pow_dvd_iff_natCast_le_ord hw hπw hgenw π 1).mpr (by simpa using hle))
  rw [ord_algebraMap_eq_ringOrd hw hwc π hπ0]
  have hzero : Ring.ord (X.presheaf.stalk w)
      (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) (X.presheaf.stalk w) π) = 0 := by
    by_contra hne0
    exact hlt (Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hne0)
  rw [hzero]
  norm_num

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ringKrullDim_stalk_le_two
statement: theorem ringKrullDim_stalk_le_two (pt : X) : ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk pt) ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hb : ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk pt) ≤ ((2 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    rw [ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight]
    exact (Order.coheight_le_krullDim pt).trans
      (Order.KrullDimLE.krullDim_le (n := 2) (α := ↥X))
  have hc : ((2 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) = (2 : WithBot ℕ∞) := by norm_cast
  rwa [hc] at hb

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.uniqueFactorizationMonoid_stalk
statement:
theorem uniqueFactorizationMonoid_stalk
    (hreg : ∀ x : X, IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)) (pt : X) :
    UniqueFactorizationMonoid (X.presheaf.stalk pt)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hreg pt
  exact UniqueFactorizationMonoid.of_forall_isPrincipal_of_height_eq_one
    fun p _ hph ↦ IsRegularLocalRing.isPrincipal_of_height_one_of_ringKrullDim_le_two
      (X.presheaf.stalk pt) (ringKrullDim_stalk_le_two pt) p hph

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.exists_localEquation
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hreg pt
  haveI := IsRegularLocalRing.isPrincipal_of_height_one_of_ringKrullDim_le_two
    (X.presheaf.stalk pt) (ringKrullDim_stalk_le_two pt) (Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hx)
    (by rw [Scheme.height_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes, hxc])
  exact Submodule.IsPrincipal.principal (Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hx)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.localEquationAt_spec
proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.localEquationAt_ne_zero
statement:
theorem localEquationAt_ne_zero (hreg : ∀ x : X, IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (pt x : X) (hxc : coheight x = 1) : localEquationAt hreg pt x hxc ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x ⤳ pt
  · exact localEquation_ne_zero hx hxc (localEquationAt_spec hreg hx hxc)
  · rw [localEquationAt, dif_neg hx]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ord_algebraMap_localEquationAt_self
statement:
theorem ord_algebraMap_localEquationAt_self
    (hreg : ∀ x : X, IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    {pt x : X} (hxc : coheight x = 1) (hx : x ⤳ pt) :
    X.ord (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) X.functionField
      (localEquationAt hreg pt x hxc)) x = 1
proof:
:=
  ord_localEquation_self hx hxc (localEquationAt_spec hreg hx hxc)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ord_algebraMap_localEquationAt_of_ne
statement:
theorem ord_algebraMap_localEquationAt_of_ne
    (hreg : ∀ x : X, IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    {pt x w : X} (hxc : coheight x = 1) (hw : w ⤳ pt) (hwc : coheight w = 1) (hwx : w ≠ x) :
    X.ord (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) X.functionField
      (localEquationAt hreg pt x hxc)) w = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x ⤳ pt
  · obtain ⟨πw, hπw⟩ := exists_localEquation hreg hw hwc
    exact ord_localEquation_of_ne hx hw hxc hwc hwx
      (localEquationAt_spec hreg hx hxc) hπw
  · rw [localEquationAt, dif_neg hx, map_one]
    exact (X.ord_eq_iff hwc one_ne_zero).mpr (by simp)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.coheight_relation_support
statement:
theorem coheight_relation_support (g : RationalRelationGenerator X 1)
    (x : (compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1).support) : coheight x.1 = 1
proof:
:=
  g.cycle.2 (by
    change g.cycle.1 x.1 ≠ 0
    simpa only [compactCycleFinsupp_apply] using Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp x.2)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.relationLocalFactor_ne_zero
statement:
theorem relationLocalFactor_ne_zero
    (hreg : ∀ x : X, IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X 1) (pt : X)
    (x : (compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1).support) :

proof:
:=
  (map_ne_zero_iff _
    (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective (X.presheaf.stalk pt) X.functionField)).mpr
    (localEquationAt_ne_zero hreg pt x.1 (coheight_relation_support g x))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.div_relationLocalFactor_self

theorem div_relationLocalFactor_self

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.div_relationLocalFactor_of_ne
statement:
theorem div_relationLocalFactor_of_ne
    (hreg : ∀ x : X, IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X 1) {pt w : X} (hw : w ⤳ pt) (hwc : coheight w = 1)
    (x : (compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1).support) (hwx : w ≠ x.1) :
    div (relationLocalFactor hreg g pt x) w = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_eq_ord, relationLocalFactor]
  exact ord_algebraMap_localEquationAt_of_ne hreg _ hw hwc hwx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.div_relationLocalFactor_prod
statement:
theorem div_relationLocalFactor_prod
    (hreg : ∀ x : X, IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X 1) {pt w : X} (hw : w ⤳ pt) (hwc : coheight w = 1) :
    div (∏ x : (compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1).support,
        relationLocalFactor hreg g pt x ^ (compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1 x)) w =
      g.cycle.1 w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [div_finset_prod_zpow Finset.univ (relationLocalFactor hreg g pt)
    (fun i _ ↦ relationLocalFactor_ne_zero hreg g pt i)]
  have happ : (∑ x : (compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1).support,
      compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1 x • div (relationLocalFactor hreg g pt x)) w =
      ∑ x : (compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1).support,
        compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1 x * div (relationLocalFactor hreg g pt x) w := by
    simp
  rw [happ]
  have hterm : ∀ x : (compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1).support,
      compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1 x * div (relationLocalFactor hreg g pt x) w =
        if w = x.1 then compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1 x else 0 := by
    intro x
    by_cases hwx : w = x.1
    · subst hwx
      rw [div_relationLocalFactor_self hreg g x hw, if_pos rfl, mul_one]
    · rw [div_relationLocalFactor_of_ne hreg g hw hwc x hwx, if_neg hwx, mul_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ ↦ hterm x]
  by_cases hws : w ∈ (compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1).support
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (⟨w, hws⟩ : (compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1).support)]
    · rw [if_pos rfl, compactCycleFinsupp_apply]
    · intro b _ hb
      refine if_neg fun hwb ↦ hb ?_
      exact Subtype.ext hwb.symm
    · intro hmem
      exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) hmem
  · have hzero : g.cycle.1 w = 0 := by
      have := Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hws
      rwa [compactCycleFinsupp_apply] at this
    rw [hzero]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun x _ ↦ if_neg fun hwx ↦ hws ?_
    rw [hwx]
    exact x.2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.exists_units_targetFunctionOfIsIso_eq
statement:
theorem exists_units_targetFunctionOfIsIso_eq
    (hreg : ∀ x : X, IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X 1) [IsIso g.i] (pt : X) :
    ∃ v : (X.presheaf.stalk pt)ˣ,
      g.targetFunctionOfIsIso =
        algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) X.functionField (v : X.presheaf.stalk pt) *
          ∏ x : (compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1).support,
            relationLocalFactor hreg g pt x ^ (compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1 x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI := uniqueFactorizationMonoid_stalk hreg pt
  have hf : g.targetFunctionOfIsIso ≠ 0 := g.targetFunctionOfIsIso_ne_zero
  have hP : (∏ x : (compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1).support,
      relationLocalFactor hreg g pt x ^ (compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1 x)) ≠ 0 :=
    Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun i _ ↦
      zpow_ne_zero _ (relationLocalFactor_ne_zero hreg g pt i)
  have hordf : ∀ w : X, X.ord g.targetFunctionOfIsIso w = g.cycle.1 w := by
    intro w
    have h := congrArg (fun D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ 1 ↦ D.1 w)
      g.cycle_eq_principalWeilDivisor_of_isIso
    exact h.symm
  have hord : ∀ (w : X), w ⤳ pt → coheight w = 1 →
      X.ord (g.targetFunctionOfIsIso /
        ∏ x : (compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1).support,
          relationLocalFactor hreg g pt x ^ (compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1 x)) w = 0 := by
    intro w hw hwc
    rw [X.ord_div hwc _ _ hf hP, hordf w, ← div_eq_ord,
      div_relationLocalFactor_prod hreg g hw hwc, sub_self]
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := Scheme.exists_units_algebraMap_eq_of_forall_ord_eq_zero
    (div_ne_zero hf hP) hord
  exact ⟨v, by rw [hv, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hP]⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ord_algebraMap_eq_zero_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem ord_algebraMap_eq_zero_of_isUnit {x : X} (hx : coheight x = 1)
    {a : X.presheaf.stalk x} (ha : IsUnit a) :
    X.ord (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField a) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : Subsingleton (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ Ideal.span {a}) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.subsingleton_iff.mpr (Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top.mpr ha)
  rw [ord_algebraMap_eq_length_toNat hx a ha.ne_zero, Module.length_eq_zero]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ord_algebraMap_eq_one_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal
statement:
theorem ord_algebraMap_eq_one_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal {x : X} (hx : coheight x = 1)
    {a : X.presheaf.stalk x} (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hmax : Ideal.span {a} = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    X.ord (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField a) x = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [ord_algebraMap_eq_length_toNat hx a ha, hmax]
  have hsimple : IsSimpleModule (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :=
    isSimpleModule_iff_isCoatom.mpr
      (Ideal.isMaximal_def.mp (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal _))
  rw [Module.length_eq_one_iff.mpr hsimple]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.one_le_ord_algebraMap_of_not_isUnit
statement:
theorem one_le_ord_algebraMap_of_not_isUnit {x : X} (hx : coheight x = 1)
    {a : X.presheaf.stalk x} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hna : ¬ IsUnit a) :
    1 ≤ X.ord (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField a) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [ord_algebraMap_eq_length_toNat hx a ha]
  letI : Ring.KrullDimLE 1 (X.presheaf.stalk x) := krullDimLE_of_coheight hx
  have hfin : Ring.ord (X.presheaf.stalk x) a ≠ ⊤ :=
    Ring.ord_ne_top (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero ha)
  have hnt : Nontrivial (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ Ideal.span {a}) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr (by rwa [ne_eq, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top])
  have hpos : 0 < Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ Ideal.span {a}) := Module.length_pos
  change Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x) (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ Ideal.span {a}) ≠ ⊤ at hfin
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hfin
  rw [← hm] at hpos ⊢
  have hm0 : 0 < m := by exact_mod_cast hpos
  simp only [ENat.toNat_coe]
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.exists_specializes_coheight_eq_one_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_eq_span
proof:
:= by
  haveI hp : (Ideal.span {π} : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk pt)).IsPrime :=
    (Ideal.span_singleton_prime hπ.ne_zero).mpr hπ
  obtain ⟨w, h, hw⟩ := exists_specializes_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_eq pt (Ideal.span {π})
  refine ⟨w, h, ?_, hw⟩
  have hle : (Ideal.span {π} : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk pt)).height ≤ 1 :=
    Ideal.height_le_one_of_isPrincipal_of_mem_minimalPrimes (Ideal.span {π}) (Ideal.span {π})
      (by simp [Ideal.minimalPrimes_eq_subsingleton_self])
  have hge : 1 ≤ (Ideal.span {π} : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk pt)).height :=
    Ideal.one_le_height_span_singleton_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors
      (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hπ.ne_zero)
  rw [← height_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h, hw]
  exact le_antisymm hle hge

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.exists_units_algebraMap_eq_of_forall_ord_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_units_algebraMap_eq_of_forall_ord_eq_zero [IsRegularInCodimensionOne X] {pt : X}
    [UniqueFactorizationMonoid (X.presheaf.stalk pt)]
    {f : X.functionField} (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (hord : ∀ (w : X) (_ : w ⤳ pt), coheight w = 1 → X.ord f w = 0) :
    ∃ u : (X.presheaf.stalk pt)ˣ,
      algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) X.functionField (u : X.presheaf.stalk pt) = f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨⟨a, b⟩, hab⟩ :=
    IsLocalization.surj (M := nonZeroDivisors (X.presheaf.stalk pt)) f
  have hbne : (b : X.presheaf.stalk pt) ≠ 0 := mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mp b.2
  have hinj : Function.Injective
      (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) X.functionField) :=
    IsFractionRing.injective _ _
  have hbK : algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) X.functionField (b : X.presheaf.stalk pt) ≠ 0 :=
    fun hzero => hbne (hinj (by rw [map_zero]; exact hzero))
  have haK : algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) X.functionField a ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← hab]; exact mul_ne_zero hf hbK
  have hane : a ≠ 0 := fun h => haK (by simp [h])
  
  have hdvd : ∀ π : X.presheaf.stalk pt, Prime π → ∀ n : ℕ,
      π ^ n ∣ a ↔ π ^ n ∣ (b : X.presheaf.stalk pt) := by
    intro π hπ n
    obtain ⟨w, h, hw1, hgen⟩ :=
      exists_specializes_coheight_eq_one_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_eq_span hπ
    haveI := IsIntegralInCodimensionOne.stalk_domain w hw1
    haveI := IsRegularInCodimensionOne.stalk_dvr w hw1
    letI := stalkSpecializesAlgebra h
    haveI := isScalarTower_functionField h
    letI : Ring.KrullDimLE 1 (X.presheaf.stalk w) := krullDimLE_of_coheight hw1
    have htower : ∀ c : X.presheaf.stalk pt,
        algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) X.functionField c =
          algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk w) X.functionField
            (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) (X.presheaf.stalk w) c) :=
      fun c => IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply _ _ _ c
    have hne_w : ∀ c : X.presheaf.stalk pt, c ≠ 0 →
        algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) (X.presheaf.stalk w) c ≠ 0 := by
      intro c hc hzero
      exact hc (hinj (by rw [map_zero, htower c, hzero, map_zero]))
    have haw := hne_w a hane
    have hbw := hne_w _ hbne
    
    have hordEq : ∀ c : X.presheaf.stalk pt, c ≠ 0 →
        X.ord (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) X.functionField c) w =
          ((Ring.ord (X.presheaf.stalk w)
            (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) (X.presheaf.stalk w) c)).toNat : ℤ) := by
      intro c hc
      rw [htower c, ord_algebraMap_eq_length_toNat hw1 _ (hne_w c hc)]
      rfl
    have hordab : Ring.ord (X.presheaf.stalk w)
          (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) (X.presheaf.stalk w) a) =
        Ring.ord (X.presheaf.stalk w)
          (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) (X.presheaf.stalk w) (b : X.presheaf.stalk pt)) := by
      have hmul : X.ord (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) X.functionField a) w =
          X.ord (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) X.functionField
            (b : X.presheaf.stalk pt)) w := by
        rw [← hab, X.ord_mul hw1 hf hbK, hord w h hw1, zero_add]
      rw [hordEq a hane, hordEq _ hbne] at hmul
      have hta := Ring.ord_ne_top (R := X.presheaf.stalk w)
        (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr haw)
      have htb := Ring.ord_ne_top (R := X.presheaf.stalk w)
        (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hbw)
      have hnat : (Ring.ord (X.presheaf.stalk w)
            (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) (X.presheaf.stalk w) a)).toNat =
          (Ring.ord (X.presheaf.stalk w)
            (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) (X.presheaf.stalk w)
              (b : X.presheaf.stalk pt))).toNat := by exact_mod_cast hmul
      rw [← ENat.coe_toNat hta, ← ENat.coe_toNat htb, hnat]
    rw [pow_dvd_iff_natCast_le_ord h hπ hgen a n,
      pow_dvd_iff_natCast_le_ord h hπ hgen (b : X.presheaf.stalk pt) n, hordab]
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.exists_unit_algebraMap_eq_of_forall_pow_dvd_iff
    (K := X.functionField) hane hbne hdvd
  refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
  apply mul_right_cancel₀ hbK
  rw [← hu, hab]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SurfaceDegreeNormalization.normalizationMorphism_isFinite_of_affineNormalizationFiniteType
statement:
theorem normalizationMorphism_isFinite_of_affineNormalizationFiniteType
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral Y] (h : AffineNormalizationFiniteType Y) :
    IsFinite (SingularCurve.normalizationMorphism Y)
proof:
:= by
  let f := SingularCurve.genericPointMorphism Y
  change IsFinite f.fromNormalization
  constructor
  intro U hU
  letI := (f.app U).hom.toAlgebra
  rw [f.fromNormalization_app hU, CommRingCat.hom_comp,
    RingHom.finite_respectsIso.cancel_right_isIso]
  change (f.normalizationDiagramMap.app (op U)).hom.Finite
  apply RingHom.Finite.of_isIntegral_of_finiteType
  · change (algebraMap Γ(Y, U)
      (integralClosure Γ(Y, U) Γ(Spec (Y.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint Y)),
        f ⁻¹ᵁ U))).IsIntegral
    exact algebraMap_isIntegral_iff.mpr inferInstance
  · exact h ⟨U, hU⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SurfaceDegreeNormalization.normalizationComparisonDataOfAffineNormalizationFiniteType
statement:
theorem normalizationComparisonDataOfAffineNormalizationFiniteType
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X 2)
    (hfiniteType : RelationNormalizationAffineFiniteType g)
    (hkrullDimLE : KrullDimLE 1 (normalizationSource g))
    (hregular : IsRegularInCodimensionOne (normalizationSource g))
    (htower : RelationSourceResidueTower k g)
    (hstructureFinite : NormalizationStructureSheafFinite k g)
    (hprincipal :
      letI : IsFinite (SingularCurve.normalizationMorphism g.Y) :=
        normalizationMorphism_isFinite_of_affineNormalizationFiniteType g.Y hfiniteType
      PrincipalDegreeComparison k g) :
    NormalizationComparisonData k g
proof:
:= by
  let hν : IsFinite (SingularCurve.normalizationMorphism g.Y) :=
    normalizationMorphism_isFinite_of_affineNormalizationFiniteType g.Y hfiniteType
  refine
    { finite := hν
      krullDimLE := hkrullDimLE
      regularInCodimensionOne := hregular
      sourceResidueTower := htower
      structureSheafFinite := hstructureFinite
      principalDegreeComparison := ?_ }
  letI : IsFinite (SingularCurve.normalizationMorphism g.Y) := hν
  exact hprincipal

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SurfaceDegreeNormalization.codimensionTwoRelation_degree_eq_zero_of_affineNormalizationFiniteType
statement:
theorem codimensionTwoRelation_degree_eq_zero_of_affineNormalizationFiniteType
    [CompactSpace X] [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X 2)
    (hfiniteType : RelationNormalizationAffineFiniteType g)
    (hkrullDimLE : KrullDimLE 1 (normalizationSource g))
    (hregular : IsRegularInCodimensionOne (normalizationSource g))
    (htower : RelationSourceResidueTower k g)
    (hstructureFinite : NormalizationStructureSheafFinite k g)
    (hprincipal :
      letI : IsFinite (SingularCurve.normalizationMorphism g.Y) :=
        normalizationMorphism_isFinite_of_affineNormalizationFiniteType g.Y hfiniteType
      PrincipalDegreeComparison k g) :
    codimensionCycleDegree (X := X) k 2 g.cycle = 0
proof:

    (normalizationComparisonDataOfAffineNormalizationFiniteType k g hfiniteType
      hkrullDimLE hregular htower hstructureFinite hprincipal)

name: ModuleCat.exists_isRegular_of_exists_subsingleton_ext
statement:
lemma exists_isRegular_of_exists_subsingleton_ext [Small.{v} R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (I : Ideal R)
    (n : ℕ) (M : ModuleCat.{v} R) [Module.Finite R M] (smul_lt : I • (⊤ : Submodule R M) < ⊤)
    (N : ModuleCat.{v} R) [Module.Finite R N]
    (h_supp : Module.support R N = PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus I)
    (h_ext : ∀ i < n, Subsingleton (Ext N M i)) :
    ∃ rs : List R, rs.length = n ∧ (∀ r ∈ rs, r ∈ I) ∧ IsRegular M rs
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing M with
  | zero =>
    have : Nontrivial M := (Submodule.nontrivial_iff R).mp (nontrivial_of_lt _ _ smul_lt)
    use []
    simp [isRegular_iff]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Module.support_eq_zeroLocus, PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_eq_iff] at h_supp
    
    have : Subsingleton (N ⟶ M) := Ext.addEquiv₀.subsingleton_congr.mp (h_ext 0 n.zero_lt_succ)
    have : Subsingleton (N →ₗ[R] M) := ModuleCat.homAddEquiv.symm.subsingleton
    obtain ⟨x, mem_ann, hx⟩ := subsingleton_linearMap_iff.mp this
    
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := le_of_le_of_eq Ideal.le_radical h_supp mem_ann
    
    have h_ext' : ∀ i < n, Subsingleton (Ext N (ModuleCat.of R (QuotSMulTop (x ^ k) M)) i) := by
      intro i hi
      
      
      have zero1 := AddCommGrpCat.isZero_of_iff_subsingleton.mpr (h_ext i (by omega))
      have zero2 := AddCommGrpCat.isZero_of_iff_subsingleton.mpr (h_ext (i + 1) (by omega))
      exact AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero <| ShortComplex.Exact.isZero_of_both_zeros
        ((Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₃' N (hx.pow k).smulShortComplex_shortExact) i (i + 1) rfl)
        (zero1.eq_zero_of_src _) (zero2.eq_zero_of_tgt _)
    obtain ⟨rs, len, mem, reg⟩ := ih (ModuleCat.of R (QuotSMulTop (x ^ k) M))
      (smul_top_quotSMulTop_ne_top_of_smul_top_ne_top hk smul_lt.ne).lt_top h_ext'
    use x ^ k :: rs
    simpa [len, hk] using ⟨mem, hx.pow k, reg⟩

name: ModuleCat.subsingleton_ext_of_exists_isRegular
statement:
lemma subsingleton_ext_of_exists_isRegular [Small.{v} R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (I : Ideal R)
    (N : ModuleCat.{v} R) [Nfin : Module.Finite R N]
    (Nsupp : Module.support R N ⊆ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus I)
    (M : ModuleCat.{v} R) [Module.Finite R M] (smul_lt : I • (⊤ : Submodule R M) < ⊤)
    (rs : List R) (mem : ∀ r ∈ rs, r ∈ I) (reg : IsRegular M rs) :
    ∀ i < rs.length, Subsingleton (Ext N M i)
proof:
:= by
  generalize len : rs.length = n
  induction n generalizing M rs with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rintro i hi
    have le_rad := Nsupp
    rw [Module.support_eq_zeroLocus, PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_subset_zeroLocus_iff] at le_rad
    match rs with
    | [] => simp at len
    | a :: rs' =>
      
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := le_rad (mem a List.mem_cons_self)
      simp only [isRegular_cons_iff] at reg
      simp only [List.mem_cons, forall_eq_or_imp] at mem
      simp only [List.length_cons, Nat.add_left_inj] at len
      
      match i with
      | 0 => 
        have : Subsingleton (N →ₗ[R] M) := subsingleton_linearMap_iff.mpr ⟨a ^ k, hk, reg.1.pow k⟩
        exact (Ext.addEquiv₀.trans ModuleCat.homAddEquiv).subsingleton
      | i + 1 =>
        let g := (AddCommGrpCat.ofHom ((Ext.mk₀ (smulShortComplex M a).f).postcomp N
          (add_zero (i + 1))))
        
        
        have mono_g : Mono g := by
          apply (Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₁' N reg.1.smulShortComplex_shortExact i (i + 1)
            rfl).mono_g ((AddCommGrpCat.isZero_of_iff_subsingleton.mpr ?_).eq_zero_of_src _)
          apply ih (ModuleCat.of R (QuotSMulTop a M)) _ rs' mem.2 reg.2 len i (by omega)
          exact (smul_top_quotSMulTop_ne_top_of_smul_top_ne_top mem.1 smul_lt.ne).lt_top
        let gk := AddCommGrpCat.ofHom ((Ext.mk₀ (M.smulShortComplex (a ^ k)).f).postcomp N
          (add_zero (i + 1)))
        have mono_gk : Mono gk := by
          simp only [smulShortComplex_f_eq_smul_id, g, gk] at mono_g ⊢
          exact (Ext.postcomp_smul_id_mono_iff (a ^ k) (i + 1)).mpr <|
            ((Ext.postcomp_smul_id_mono_iff a (i + 1)).mp mono_g).pow k
        
        have zero_gk : gk = 0 := Ext.postcomp_smul_id_eq_zero_of_mem_annihilator hk (i + 1)
        exact AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero (IsZero.of_mono_eq_zero _ zero_gk)

name: ModuleCat.exists_isRegular_tfae
statement:
lemma exists_isRegular_tfae [Small.{v} R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (I : Ideal R) (n : ℕ)
    (M : ModuleCat.{v} R) [Module.Finite R M] (smul_lt : I • (⊤ : Submodule R M) < ⊤) :
    [∀ N : ModuleCat.{v} R, Nontrivial N → Module.Finite R N →
      Module.support R N ⊆ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus I → ∀ i < n, Subsingleton (Ext N M i),
      ∀ i < n, Subsingleton (Ext (ModuleCat.of R (Shrink.{v} (R ⧸ I))) M i),
      ∃ N : ModuleCat R, Nontrivial N ∧ Module.Finite R N ∧
      Module.support R N = PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus I ∧ ∀ i < n, Subsingleton (Ext N M i),
      ∃ rs : List R, rs.length = n ∧ (∀ r ∈ rs, r ∈ I) ∧ RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular M rs
      ].TFAE
proof:
:= by
  
  have ntrQ : Nontrivial (R ⧸ I) := by
    apply Submodule.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr
    by_contra eq
    simp [eq] at smul_lt
  have suppQ : Module.support R (Shrink.{v} (R ⧸ I)) = PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus I := by
    rw [(Shrink.linearEquiv R _).support_eq, Module.support_eq_zeroLocus, annihilator_quotient]
  tfae_have 1 → 2 := fun h1 i hi ↦ h1 (ModuleCat.of R (Shrink.{v} (R ⧸ I)))
    inferInstance inferInstance suppQ.subset i hi
  tfae_have 2 → 3 := fun h2 ↦ ⟨(ModuleCat.of R (Shrink.{v} (R ⧸ I))),
    inferInstance, Module.Finite.equiv (Shrink.linearEquiv R (R ⧸ I)).symm, suppQ, h2⟩
  tfae_have 3 → 4 := fun ⟨N, _, _, h_supp, h_ext⟩ ↦
    exists_isRegular_of_exists_subsingleton_ext I n M smul_lt N h_supp h_ext
  tfae_have 4 → 1 := fun ⟨rs, len, mem, reg⟩ N Nntr Nfin Nsupp i hi ↦
    subsingleton_ext_of_exists_isRegular I N Nsupp M smul_lt rs mem reg i (hi.trans_eq len.symm)
  tfae_finish

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.one_le_coheight_of_ne_genericPoint
statement:
private theorem one_le_coheight_of_ne_genericPoint
    {z : X} (hz : z ≠ genericPoint X) : (1 : ℕ∞) ≤ coheight z
proof:
:= by
  have hle : z ≤ genericPoint X :=
    Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr ((genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial)
  have hlt : z < genericPoint X := lt_of_le_not_ge hle fun hge ↦ hz
    (((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hge).antisymm
      (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hle)).eq)
  have h := Order.coheight_add_one_le hlt
  have hzero : coheight (genericPoint X) = 0 :=
    coheight_eq_zero.mpr isMax_top
  rw [hzero, zero_add] at h
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalRelationGenerator.isIso_of_cycle_ne_zero
statement:
theorem RationalRelationGenerator.isIso_of_cycle_ne_zero
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X 1) (hg : g.cycle ≠ 0) :
    IsIso g.i
proof:
:= by
  have hcycle : g.cycle.1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hg
    exact Subtype.ext hzero
  obtain ⟨_, y, hy, rfl⟩ := by
    have hsupp : g.cycle.1.support.Nonempty :=
      Function.support_nonempty_iff.mpr (by
        intro hzero
        apply hcycle
        ext x
        exact congrFun hzero x)
    rw [g.cycle_support] at hsupp
    exact hsupp
  have hycodim : coheight y = 1 := div_support hy
  have hiycodim : coheight (g.i y) = 1 := g.codimension y hycodim
  have hi_generic : g.i (genericPoint g.Y) = genericPoint X := by
    by_contra hne
    have hiηcodim : (1 : ℕ∞) ≤ coheight (g.i (genericPoint g.Y)) :=
      one_le_coheight_of_ne_genericPoint hne
    have hmaple : g.i y ≤ g.i (genericPoint g.Y) :=
      Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr
        ((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp (show y ≤ genericPoint g.Y from le_top)).map
          g.i.continuous)
    have hyη : y ≠ genericPoint g.Y := by
      intro heq
      have hηzero : coheight (genericPoint g.Y) = 0 :=
        coheight_eq_zero.mpr isMax_top
      rw [heq, hηzero] at hycodim
      exact zero_ne_one hycodim
    have himage_ne : g.i y ≠ g.i (genericPoint g.Y) := fun heq ↦
      hyη (g.i.isClosedEmbedding.injective heq)
    have hlt : g.i y < g.i (genericPoint g.Y) :=
      lt_of_le_not_ge hmaple fun hge ↦ himage_ne
        (((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hmaple).antisymm
          (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hge)).eq.symm)
    have htwo : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ coheight (g.i y) := by
      have hplus : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤
          coheight (g.i (genericPoint g.Y)) + 1 := by
        simpa only [one_add_one_eq_two, add_comm] using
          (add_le_add_right hiηcodim 1)
      exact hplus.trans (Order.coheight_add_one_le hlt)
    rw [hiycodim] at htwo
    norm_num at htwo
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective g.i := by
    intro x
    have hrange_closed : IsClosed (Set.range g.i) :=
      g.i.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range
    have hclosure : closure ({genericPoint X} : Set X) ⊆ Set.range g.i :=
      closure_minimal (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr ⟨genericPoint g.Y, hi_generic⟩)
        hrange_closed
    apply hclosure
    rw [genericPoint_closure]
    trivial
  letI : Surjective g.i := ⟨hsurj⟩
  exact isIso_of_isClosedImmersion_of_surjective g.i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalRelationGenerator.isIso_of_cycle_ne_zero_of_krullDimLE_one
statement:
theorem RationalRelationGenerator.isIso_of_cycle_ne_zero_of_krullDimLE_one
    [Order.KrullDimLE 1 X] (g : RationalRelationGenerator X 1) (hg : g.cycle ≠ 0) :
    IsIso g.i
proof:
:=
  g.isIso_of_cycle_ne_zero hg

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalRelationGenerator.targetFunctionOfIsIso_ne_zero
statement:
theorem targetFunctionOfIsIso_ne_zero (g : RationalRelationGenerator X p) [IsIso g.i] :
    g.targetFunctionOfIsIso ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  (Scheme.functionFieldIsoOfIso g.i).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.symm.map_ne_zero_iff.mpr g.hf

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalRelationGenerator.cycle_eq_principalWeilDivisor_of_isIso
statement:
theorem cycle_eq_principalWeilDivisor_of_isIso
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X 1) [IsIso g.i] :
    g.cycle =
      (principalWeilDivisor X g.targetFunctionOfIsIso : CodimensionCycles X ℤ 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := g.i.surjective x
  have hgrade : ∀ z : g.Y, div g.f z ≠ 0 →
      (1 : ℕ∞) = coheight (g.i z) := by
    intro z hz
    exact (g.codimension z (div_support hz)).symm
  change AlgebraicCycle.pushforward g.i (div g.f)
      (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℕ∞)) coheight (g.i y) =
    div g.targetFunctionOfIsIso (g.i y)
  rw [AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_closedImmersion g.i (div g.f)
    (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℕ∞)) coheight hgrade y]
  change g.Y.ord g.f y = X.ord g.targetFunctionOfIsIso (g.i y)
  simpa only [targetFunctionOfIsIso,
    RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using
      Scheme.ord_functionFieldIsoOfIso g.i g.targetFunctionOfIsIso y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.rationalEquivalenceSubgroup_one_le_principalDivisorSubgroup
statement:
theorem rationalEquivalenceSubgroup_one_le_principalDivisorSubgroup
    : rationalEquivalenceSubgroup X 1 ≤ principalDivisorSubgroup X
proof:
:= by
  rw [rationalEquivalenceSubgroup, AddSubgroup.closure_le]
  rintro D ⟨g, rfl⟩
  by_cases hcycle : g.cycle = 0
  · rw [hcycle]
    exact (principalDivisorSubgroup X).zero_mem
  · letI : IsIso g.i :=
      g.isIso_of_cycle_ne_zero hcycle
    rw [g.cycle_eq_principalWeilDivisor_of_isIso]
    exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure
      ⟨g.targetFunctionOfIsIso, g.targetFunctionOfIsIso_ne_zero, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.exists_eq_principalWeilDivisor_of_gradedClassOf_eq
statement:
theorem exists_eq_principalWeilDivisor_of_gradedClassOf_eq
    (D E : WeilDivisor X)
    (h : gradedClassOf X 1 (D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ 1) =
      gradedClassOf X 1 (E : CodimensionCycles X ℤ 1)) :
    ∃ f : X.functionField, f ≠ 0 ∧
      D - E = principalWeilDivisor X f
proof:
:= by
  apply (mem_principalDivisorSubgroup_iff X (D - E)).mp
  apply rationalEquivalenceSubgroup_one_le_principalDivisorSubgroup
  exact gradedClassOf_eq_iff.mp h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.exists_identityPrincipalRelation_cycle_eq_sub_of_gradedClassOf_eq
statement:
theorem exists_identityPrincipalRelation_cycle_eq_sub_of_gradedClassOf_eq
    (D E : CodimensionCycles X ℤ 1)
    (h : gradedClassOf X 1 D = gradedClassOf X 1 E) :
    ∃ g : RationalRelationGenerator X 1, g.cycle = D - E
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hsub⟩ :=
    exists_eq_principalWeilDivisor_of_gradedClassOf_eq
      (D : WeilDivisor X) (E : WeilDivisor X) h
  refine ⟨identityPrincipalRelation f hf, ?_⟩
  rw [identityPrincipalRelation_cycle]
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact congrArg Subtype.val hsub.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.codimensionOneToGradedChow_injective
statement:
theorem codimensionOneToGradedChow_injective :
    Function.Injective (codimensionOneToGradedChow (X := X))
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  obtain ⟨D, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective
    (principalDivisorSubgroup X) a
  obtain ⟨E, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective
    (principalDivisorSubgroup X) b
  change classOf X D = classOf X E
  rw [classOf_eq_iff]
  apply rationalEquivalenceSubgroup_one_le_principalDivisorSubgroup
  apply gradedClassOf_eq_iff.mp
  change codimensionOneToGradedChow (classOf X D) =
    codimensionOneToGradedChow (classOf X E) at hab
  rw [codimensionOneToGradedChow_classOf,
    codimensionOneToGradedChow_classOf] at hab
  exact hab

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.movingLemmaStatement_of_leftMoving
statement:
theorem movingLemmaStatement_of_leftMoving
    (h : ∀ E : CodimensionCycles X ℤ q, LeftMovingStatement (p := p) E) :
    MovingLemmaStatement X p q
proof:
:= by
  intro x y
  obtain ⟨E, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective
    (rationalEquivalenceSubgroup X q) y
  have hx : x ∈ properLeftChowClasses E :=
    (leftMovingStatement_iff E).mp (h E) x
  obtain ⟨D, hproper, hclass⟩ :=
    (mem_properLeftChowClasses_iff E x).mp hx
  obtain ⟨d⟩ := hproper
  exact ⟨⟨D, E, hclass, rfl, d⟩⟩

    (rationalEquivalenceSubgroup X p) x

    (rightMovingStatement_iff D).mp (h D) y
  obtain ⟨E, hproper, hclass⟩ :=
    (mem_properRightChowClasses_iff D y).mp hy
  obtain ⟨d⟩ := hproper
  exact ⟨⟨D, E, rfl, hclass, d⟩⟩

statement:
theorem intersectionClass_zero_left (E : CodimensionCycles X ℤ q) :
    (ProperRepresentativeWitness.mk 0 E (gradedClassOf_zero X p) rfl
      (properCycleIntersectionDataZeroLeft E)).intersectionClass = 0
proof:
:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProperRepresentativeWitness.intersectionClass_eq_product
statement:
theorem intersectionClass_eq_product (w : ProperRepresentativeWitness x y)
    (K : ProperIntersectionKernel X p q) (T : IntersectionPairingData X p q)
    (hpairing : T.pairing = K.pairing) :
    w.intersectionClass = T.product x y
proof:
:= by
  calc
    w.intersectionClass =
        gradedClassOf X (p + q) (K.pairing w.left w.right) := by
      rw [intersectionClass,
        K.pairing_eq_properCycleIntersectionData w.proper]
    _ = T.product (gradedClassOf X p w.left)
        (gradedClassOf X q w.right) := by
      rw [T.product_classOf_classOf, hpairing]
    _ = T.product x y := by
      rw [w.left_class, w.right_class]

    (x : CodimensionChow X p) (y : CodimensionChow X q) :
    (h.witness x y).intersectionClass = T.product x y
proof:
:=
  (h.witness x y).intersectionClass_eq_product K T hpairing

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.isMax_of_mem_genericPoints
statement: theorem isMax_of_mem_genericPoints {z : Z} (hz : z ∈ genericPoints Z) : IsMax z
proof:
:= by
  intro y hzy
  rw [Scheme.le_iff_specializes] at hzy ⊢
  apply specializes_iff_closure_subset.mpr
  exact hz.2 isIrreducible_singleton.closure hzy.closure_subset

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.mem_genericPoints_of_isMax
statement: theorem mem_genericPoints_of_isMax {z : Z} (hz : IsMax z) : z ∈ genericPoints Z
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨isIrreducible_singleton.closure, ?_⟩
  intro s hs hzs
  let η := hs.closure.genericPoint
  have hη : IsGenericPoint η (closure s) :=
    hs.closure.isGenericPoint_genericPoint isClosed_closure
  have hzmem : z ∈ closure s :=
    subset_closure (hzs (subset_closure (Set.mem_singleton z)))
  have hzη : z ≤ η := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr (hη.specializes hzmem)
  have hηz : η ≤ z := hz hzη
  have hclosure : closure {η} ⊆ closure {z} :=
    (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hηz).closure_subset
  rw [isGenericPoint_def] at hη
  exact subset_closure.trans (hη ▸ hclosure)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.coheight_eq_zero_of_mem_genericPoints
statement:
theorem coheight_eq_zero_of_mem_genericPoints {z : Z} (hz : z ∈ genericPoints Z) :

proof:
:=
  coheight_eq_zero.mpr (isMax_of_mem_genericPoints hz)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.mem_genericPoints_iff_coheight_eq_zero
statement:

proof:
:=
  ⟨coheight_eq_zero_of_mem_genericPoints,
    fun hz ↦ mem_genericPoints_of_isMax (coheight_eq_zero.mp hz)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.selfLocalLength_ne_top_of_mem_genericPoints
statement:
theorem selfLocalLength_ne_top_of_mem_genericPoints {z : Z} (hz : z ∈ genericPoints Z) :
    selfLocalLength z ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  letI : Ring.KrullDimLE 0 (Z.presheaf.stalk z) :=
    krullDimLE_of_coheight (coheight_eq_zero_of_mem_genericPoints hz)
  letI : IsArtinianRing ↑(Z.presheaf.stalk z) :=
    IsNoetherianRing.isArtinianRing_of_krullDimLE_zero
  exact Module.length_ne_top

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.genericMultiplicity_pos
statement:
theorem genericMultiplicity_pos {z : Z} (hz : z ∈ genericPoints Z) :
    0 < genericMultiplicity z
proof:
:= by
  apply ENat.toNat_pos
  · exact ne_of_gt (Module.length_pos : 0 < selfLocalLength z)
  · exact selfLocalLength_ne_top_of_mem_genericPoints hz

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.fundamentalCycle_apply_of_mem_genericPoints
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fundamentalCycle_apply_of_mem_genericPoints {z : Z} (hz : z ∈ genericPoints Z) :
    fundamentalCycle Z z = (genericMultiplicity z : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [fundamentalCycle, Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single_apply, hz]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.fundamentalCycle_apply_of_not_mem_genericPoints
statement:
theorem fundamentalCycle_apply_of_not_mem_genericPoints {z : Z} (hz : z ∉ genericPoints Z) :
    fundamentalCycle Z z = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [fundamentalCycle, Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single_apply, hz]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.fundamentalCycle_support
statement: theorem fundamentalCycle_support : (fundamentalCycle Z).support = genericPoints Z
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  change fundamentalCycle Z z ≠ 0 ↔ z ∈ genericPoints Z
  by_cases hz : z ∈ genericPoints Z
  · rw [fundamentalCycle_apply_of_mem_genericPoints hz]
    have hne : (genericMultiplicity z : ℤ) ≠ 0 :=
      Int.ofNat_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt (genericMultiplicity_pos hz))
    exact ⟨fun _ ↦ hz, fun _ ↦ hne⟩
  · rw [fundamentalCycle_apply_of_not_mem_genericPoints hz]
    constructor
    · exact fun h ↦ (h rfl).elim
    · exact fun h ↦ (hz h).elim

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ord_algebraMap_eq_length_toNat
statement:
theorem ord_algebraMap_eq_length_toNat
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    {x : X} (hx : coheight x = 1)
    (a : X.presheaf.stalk x) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    X.ord (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField a) x =
      ((Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((X.presheaf.stalk x) ⧸ Ideal.span {a})).toNat : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  let R := X.presheaf.stalk x
  letI : Ring.KrullDimLE 1 R := krullDimLE_of_coheight hx
  have hnonzerodivisor : a ∈ nonZeroDivisors R := by
    exact mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr ha
  have hfinite : Ring.ord R a ≠ ⊤ := Ring.ord_ne_top hnonzerodivisor
  have hf : algebraMap R X.functionField a ≠ 0 :=
    (map_ne_zero_iff _ (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R X.functionField)).mpr ha
  rw [ord_eq_iff hx hf]
  change Ring.ordFrac R (algebraMap R X.functionField a) =
    Multiplicative.ofAdd
      ((Module.length R (R ⧸ Ideal.span {a})).toNat : ℤ)
  rw [Ring.ordFrac_eq_ord R ha]
  apply Ring.ordMonoidWithZeroHom_eq_coe R hnonzerodivisor
  exact (ENat.coe_toNat hfinite).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.div_algebraMap_eq_length_toNat
statement:
theorem div_algebraMap_eq_length_toNat
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    {x : X} (hx : coheight x = 1)
    (a : X.presheaf.stalk x) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    div (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField a) x =
      ((Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((X.presheaf.stalk x) ⧸ Ideal.span {a})).toNat : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_eq_ord]
  exact ord_algebraMap_eq_length_toNat hx a ha

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.map_germ_of_le
statement:
theorem map_germ_of_le {U V : X.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) {x : X} (hx : x ∈ U.1) :
    (I.ideal U).map (X.presheaf.germ U.1 x hx).hom
      = (I.ideal V).map (X.presheaf.germ V.1 x (h hx)).hom
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← I.map_ideal h]
  simp only [Ideal.map_map, ← CommRingCat.hom_comp, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res']

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.map_germ_eq
statement:
theorem map_germ_eq {U V : X.affineOpens} {x : X} (hU : x ∈ U.1) (hV : x ∈ V.1) :
    (I.ideal U).map (X.presheaf.germ U.1 x hU).hom
      = (I.ideal V).map (X.presheaf.germ V.1 x hV).hom
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, g, e, hxf⟩ := exists_basicOpen_le_affine_inter U.2 V.2 x ⟨hU, hV⟩
  have hWU : X.affineBasicOpen f ≤ U := X.affineBasicOpen_le f
  have hWV : X.affineBasicOpen f ≤ V := fun z hz => X.basicOpen_le g (e ▸ hz)
  rw [← I.map_germ_of_le hWU (x := x) hxf, ← I.map_germ_of_le hWV (x := x) hxf]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalk_eq
statement:
theorem stalk_eq {x : X} {U : X.affineOpens} (hx : x ∈ U.1) :
    I.stalk x = (I.ideal U).map (X.presheaf.germ U.1 x hx).hom
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (iSup_le fun V => (I.map_germ_eq V.2 hx).le) ?_
  exact le_iSup (fun V : { U : X.affineOpens // x ∈ U.1 } =>
    (I.ideal V.1).map (X.presheaf.germ V.1.1 x V.2).hom) ⟨U, hx⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.exists_ideal_eq_span_of_stalk_eq_span
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set U : X.affineOpens :=
    ⟨(X.affineCover.f (X.affineCover.idx x)).opensRange, isAffineOpen_opensRange _⟩ with hUdef
  have hxU : x ∈ U.1 := X.affineCover.covers x
  letI algx : Algebra Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x) := X.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk ⟨x, hxU⟩
  haveI hloc := U.2.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hxU⟩
  haveI hnoeth : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, U) := IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian U
  set p : Ideal Γ(X, U) := (U.2.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxU⟩).asIdeal with hpdef
  set J : Ideal Γ(X, U) := I.ideal U with hJdef
  have halg : (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) = (X.presheaf.germ U.1 x hxU).hom := rfl
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hprin
  rw [I.stalk_eq hxU, ← halg] at hc
  
  obtain ⟨⟨a, s⟩, e⟩ := IsLocalization.surj (M := p.primeCompl) c
  have hcspan : J.map (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x))
      = Ideal.span {algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x) a} := by
    rw [hc, ← e, Ideal.span_singleton_mul_right_unit (IsLocalization.map_units _ s)]
  
  have ha_mem : algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x) a
      ∈ J.map (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) := by
    rw [hcspan]; exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _
  rw [IsLocalization.algebraMap_mem_map_algebraMap_iff p.primeCompl] at ha_mem
  obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀, hm₀J⟩ := ha_mem
  
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := (IsNoetherian.noetherian J : J.FG)
  have hgen : ∀ g ∈ G, ∃ t : p.primeCompl, ∃ b : Γ(X, U), (t : Γ(X, U)) * g = b * a := by
    intro g hg
    have hgJ : g ∈ J := hG ▸ Ideal.subset_span hg
    have hmem : algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x) g
        ∈ Ideal.span {algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x) a} := by
      rw [← hcspan]; exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hgJ
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hmem
    obtain ⟨⟨b, t⟩, ed⟩ := IsLocalization.surj (M := p.primeCompl) d
    have key : algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x) (g * (t : Γ(X, U)))
        = algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x) (b * a) := by
      rw [map_mul, map_mul, ← hd, ← ed]; ring
    rw [IsLocalization.eq_iff_exists p.primeCompl] at key
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := key
    refine ⟨u * t, (u : Γ(X, U)) * b, ?_⟩
    rw [Submonoid.coe_mul]
    linear_combination hu
  choose t b ht using hgen
  
  set s₀ : Γ(X, U) := m₀ * ∏ g ∈ G.attach, (t g.1 g.2 : Γ(X, U)) with hs₀def
  have hs₀p : s₀ ∈ p.primeCompl :=
    Submonoid.mul_mem _ hm₀ (Submonoid.prod_mem _ fun g _ => (t g.1 g.2).2)
  have hm₀dvd : m₀ ∣ s₀ := Dvd.intro _ rfl
  have htdvd : ∀ (g : Γ(X, U)) (hg : g ∈ G), (t g hg : Γ(X, U)) ∣ s₀ :=
    fun g hg => Dvd.dvd.mul_left (Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_attach G ⟨g, hg⟩)) m₀
  
  haveI hawy : IsLocalization.Away s₀ Γ(X, X.basicOpen s₀) := U.2.isLocalization_basicOpen s₀
  set ψ : Γ(X, U) →+* Γ(X, X.basicOpen s₀) :=
    algebraMap Γ(X, U) Γ(X, X.basicOpen s₀) with hψdef
  have hψs₀ : IsUnit (ψ s₀) :=
    IsLocalization.map_units (M := Submonoid.powers s₀) _ ⟨s₀, Submonoid.mem_powers _⟩
  have hψunit : ∀ d : Γ(X, U), d ∣ s₀ → IsUnit (ψ d) :=
    fun d hd => isUnit_of_dvd_unit (map_dvd ψ hd) hψs₀
  refine ⟨X.affineBasicOpen s₀, ?_, ψ a, ?_⟩
  · rw [Scheme.affineBasicOpen_coe, X.mem_basicOpen s₀ x hxU]
    exact IsLocalization.map_units (X.presheaf.stalk x) ⟨s₀, hs₀p⟩
  · have hres : I.ideal (X.affineBasicOpen s₀) = J.map ψ := (I.map_ideal_basicOpen U s₀).symm
    rw [hres]
    refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
    · refine Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr ?_
      rw [← hG]
      refine Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_
      rintro g hg
      have hut := hψunit _ (htdvd g hg)
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hut.exists_left_inv
      have := congrArg ψ (ht g hg)
      rw [map_mul, map_mul] at this
      refine Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mpr ⟨v * ψ (b g hg), ?_⟩
      calc v * ψ (b g hg) * ψ a = v * (ψ (b g hg) * ψ a) := by ring
        _ = v * (ψ (t g hg : Γ(X, U)) * ψ g) := by rw [this]
        _ = (v * ψ (t g hg : Γ(X, U))) * ψ g := by ring
        _ = ψ g := by rw [hv, one_mul]
    · refine Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_
      rw [Set.singleton_subset_iff]
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := (hψunit _ hm₀dvd).exists_left_inv
      have hmem : ψ (m₀ * a) ∈ J.map ψ := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hm₀J
      have : ψ a = v * ψ (m₀ * a) := by
        rw [map_mul, ← mul_assoc, hv, one_mul]
      rw [this]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hmem

name: RegularResolution.hasPDLE_zero_of_projective
statement:
theorem hasPDLE_zero_of_projective (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
