name: RegularResolution.hasPDLE_succ_of_ker
statement:
theorem hasPDLE_succ_of_ker {F N : Type u} [AddCommGroup F] [Module R F] [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module R N] [Module.Projective R F] (f : F →ₗ[R] N) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (n : ℕ)
    (h : HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of R (LinearMap.ker f)) n) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of R N) (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hS := LinearMap.shortExact_shortComplexKer hf
  have : Projective (ModuleCat.of R F) := inferInstance
  exact hS.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_X₃ (n + 1) h inferInstance

name: RegularResolution.hasPDLE_ker_of_succ
statement:
theorem hasPDLE_ker_of_succ {F N : Type u} [AddCommGroup F] [Module R F] [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module R N] [Module.Projective R F] (f : F →ₗ[R] N) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (n : ℕ)
    (h : HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of R N) (n + 1)) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of R (LinearMap.ker f)) n
proof:
:= by
  have hS := LinearMap.shortExact_shortComplexKer hf
  have : Projective (ModuleCat.of R F) := inferInstance
  exact hS.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_X₁ (n + 1) inferInstance h

name: RegularResolution.isSMulRegular_pi
statement:
theorem isSMulRegular_pi {x : R} (hx : IsSMulRegular R x) (k : ℕ) :
    IsSMulRegular (Fin k → R) x
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  funext i
  exact hx (congrFun hab i)

name: RegularResolution.isSMulRegular_submodule
statement:
theorem isSMulRegular_submodule {F : Type u} [AddCommGroup F] [Module R F] {x : R}
    (hx : IsSMulRegular F x) (K : Submodule R F) : IsSMulRegular K x
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  exact Subtype.ext (hx (congrArg Subtype.val hab))

name: RegularResolution.quotSMulTop_map_ker_subtype_injective
statement:
theorem quotSMulTop_map_ker_subtype_injective {F N : Type u} [AddCommGroup F] [Module R F]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (f : F →ₗ[R] N) {x : R} (hN : IsSMulRegular N x) :
    Function.Injective (QuotSMulTop.map x (LinearMap.ker f).subtype)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro a ha
  induction a using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
  | H k =>
    rw [QuotSMulTop.map_apply_mk] at ha
    have hk : (k : F) ∈ x • (⊤ : Submodule R F) := (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mp ha
    obtain ⟨y, -, hy⟩ := (Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists _ _ _).mp hk
    have hfy : f y = 0 := by
      apply hN
      change x • f y = x • 0
      rw [← map_smul, hy, smul_zero]
      exact k.2
    have hk' : k = x • (⟨y, hfy⟩ : LinearMap.ker f) := Subtype.ext hy.symm
    rw [hk']
    exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr
      (Submodule.smul_mem_pointwise_smul _ x _ Submodule.mem_top)

name: RegularResolution.hasPDLE_of_quotSMulTop
statement:
theorem hasPDLE_of_quotSMulTop [IsLocalRing R] {x : R} (hxm : x ∈ maximalIdeal R)
    (hx : IsSMulRegular R x) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (N : Type u) [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Module.Finite R N],
      IsSMulRegular N x →
      HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (QuotSMulTop x N)) n →
      HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of R N) n
  | 0, N, _, _, _, hN, h => by
      letI
proof:
:= ModuleCat.quotientSpanIsLocalRing R x hxm
      rw [← projective_iff_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_zero, ← IsProjective.iff_projective] at h
      haveI := Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite R (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (QuotSMulTop x N)
      haveI : Module.Free (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (QuotSMulTop x N) :=
        Module.free_of_flat_of_isLocalRing
      haveI := Module.finitePresentation_of_finite R N
      have hjac : x ∈ (⊥ : Ideal R).jacobson := by
        rw [IsLocalRing.jacobson_eq_maximalIdeal ⊥ bot_ne_top]; exact hxm
      haveI : Module.Free R N := (Module.free_quotSMulTop_iff_free R N hjac hN).mp inferInstance
      exact hasPDLE_zero_of_projective N
  | n + 1, N, _, _, _, hN, h => by
      obtain ⟨k, f, hf⟩ := Module.Finite.exists_fin' R N
      let K := LinearMap.ker f
      have hK : IsSMulRegular K x := isSMulRegular_submodule (isSMulRegular_pi hx k) K
      have hsurj : Function.Surjective (algebraMap R (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x})) :=
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
      let ι : QuotSMulTop x K →ₗ[R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}] QuotSMulTop x (Fin k → R) :=
        LinearMap.extendScalarsOfSurjective hsurj (QuotSMulTop.map x K.subtype)
      let π : QuotSMulTop x (Fin k → R) →ₗ[R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}] QuotSMulTop x N :=
        LinearMap.extendScalarsOfSurjective hsurj (QuotSMulTop.map x f)
      have hex : Function.Exact (QuotSMulTop.map x K.subtype) (QuotSMulTop.map x f) :=
        QuotSMulTop.map_exact x (LinearMap.exact_subtype_ker_map f) hf
      have hιc : ⇑ι = ⇑(QuotSMulTop.map x K.subtype) := rfl
      have hπc : ⇑π = ⇑(QuotSMulTop.map x f) := rfl
      have hexι : Function.Exact ι π := by rw [hιc, hπc]; exact hex
      have hinj : Function.Injective ι := by
        rw [hιc]; exact quotSMulTop_map_ker_subtype_injective f hN
      have hsur : Function.Surjective π := by rw [hπc]; exact QuotSMulTop.map_surjective x hf
      have h0 : π.comp ι = 0 := LinearMap.ext fun y => hexι.apply_apply_eq_zero y
      have hS := ModuleCat.shortComplex_shortExact
        (ModuleCat.shortComplexOfCompEqZero ι π h0) hexι hinj hsur
      have hK' : HasProjectiveDimensionLE
          (ModuleCat.of (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (QuotSMulTop x K)) n :=
        hS.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_X₁ (n + 1) inferInstance h
      exact hasPDLE_succ_of_ker f hf n (hasPDLE_of_quotSMulTop hxm hx n K hK hK')

name: IsRegularLocalRing.hasPDLE_of_embeddingDimension_eq
statement:
theorem hasPDLE_of_embeddingDimension_eq :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsRegularLocalRing R], embeddingDimension R = n →
      ∀ (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M],
        HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of R M) n
  | 0, R, _, _, hn, M, _, _, _ => by
      have hdim : ringKrullDim R = 0
proof:
:= by
        rw [← coe_embeddingDimension_eq_ringKrullDim, hn]; rfl
      letI := (isField_of_ringKrullDim_eq_zero hdim).toField
      haveI : Module.Free R M := Module.Free.of_divisionRing R M
      exact hasPDLE_zero_of_projective M
  | n + 1, R, _, _, hn, M, _, _, _ => by
      classical
      have hdim : ringKrullDim R ≠ 0 := by
        rw [← coe_embeddingDimension_eq_ringKrullDim, hn]
        exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)
      obtain ⟨x, hxm, hx2⟩ := exists_mem_maximalIdeal_notMem_sq hdim
      haveI := isDomain_of_isRegularLocalRing R
      have hx : IsSMulRegular R x := isSMulRegular_of_notMem_sq_of_isDomain hx2
      letI := quotient_span_singleton_isRegularLocalRing hxm hx2
      have hn' : embeddingDimension (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) = n := by
        have := embeddingDimension_quotient_span_singleton hxm hx2
        rw [this, hn]; rfl
      obtain ⟨k, f, hf⟩ := Module.Finite.exists_fin' R M
      let K := LinearMap.ker f
      have hK : IsSMulRegular K x := isSMulRegular_submodule (isSMulRegular_pi hx k) K
      haveI := Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite R (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) (QuotSMulTop x K)
      have hbar := hasPDLE_of_embeddingDimension_eq n (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) hn' (QuotSMulTop x K)
      exact hasPDLE_succ_of_ker f hf n (hasPDLE_of_quotSMulTop hxm hx n K hK hbar)

name: IsRegularLocalRing.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_embeddingDimension
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLE_embeddingDimension (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Module.Finite R M] :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE M (embeddingDimension R)
proof:
:=
  hasPDLE_of_embeddingDimension_eq _ R rfl M

name: IsRegularLocalRing.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_ringKrullDim_le
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_ringKrullDim_le (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Module.Finite R M]
    (d : ℕ) (hd : ringKrullDim R ≤ d) : HasProjectiveDimensionLE M d
proof:
:= by
  have h := hasProjectiveDimensionLE_embeddingDimension M
  have hle : embeddingDimension R ≤ d := by
    rw [← coe_embeddingDimension_eq_ringKrullDim] at hd
    exact_mod_cast hd
  exact hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge M (embeddingDimension R + 1) (d + 1) (by omega)

name: IsRegularRing.hasProjectiveDimensionLE
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLE (d : ℕ) (hd : ringKrullDim R ≤ d)
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Module.Finite R M] : HasProjectiveDimensionLE M d
proof:
:= by
  rw [ModuleCat.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_iff_forall_primeSpectrum]
  intro p
  haveI : IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime p.1) := inferInstance
  haveI : Module.Finite (Localization.AtPrime p.1) (M.localizedModule p.1.primeCompl) :=
    Module.Finite.of_isLocalizedModule p.1.primeCompl (M.localizedModuleMkLinearMap p.1.primeCompl)
  apply IsRegularLocalRing.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_ringKrullDim_le _ d
  rw [IsLocalization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height p.1]
  exact (Ideal.height_le_ringKrullDim_of_ne_top p.2.ne_top).trans hd

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_congr
statement:
theorem stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_congr {a a' pt : X} (h : a ⤳ pt) (h' : a' ⤳ pt) (he : a = a') :
    Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h = Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h'
proof:
:= by
  subst he
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.pointClosureι_genericPoint'
statement:
theorem pointClosureι_genericPoint' (x : X) :
    pointClosureι x (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme x)) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (pointClosureGenericPoint_isGeneric x).eq (genericPoint_spec (pointClosureScheme x))]
  exact pointClosureι_genericPoint x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.stalkCongr_localEquationAt
statement:
theorem stalkCongr_localEquationAt (hreg : ∀ x : X, IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    {pt pt' : X} (h : pt = pt') (x : X) (hxc : coheight x = 1) :
    (X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq h)).hom (localEquationAt hreg pt x hxc) =
      localEquationAt hreg pt' x hxc
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ker_stalkMap_pointClosureι_eq_span_localEquationAt
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_pointClosureι_eq_span_localEquationAt
    (hreg : ∀ x : X, IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    {x : X} (hxc : coheight x = 1) (p : pointClosureScheme x) :
    RingHom.ker ((pointClosureι x).stalkMap p).hom =
      Ideal.span {localEquationAt hreg (pointClosureι x p) x hxc}
proof:
:= by
  have hspec : x ⤳ pointClosureι x p := by
    rw [specializes_iff_mem_closure, ← range_pointClosureι x]
    exact Set.mem_range_self p
  have hgp : pointClosureι x (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme x)) = x :=
    pointClosureι_genericPoint' x
  have hg' : pointClosureι x (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme x)) ⤳ pointClosureι x p := by
    rw [hgp]; exact hspec
  rw [ker_stalkMap_eq_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (pointClosureι x) p hg',
    stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_congr hg' hspec hgp, localEquationAt_spec hreg hspec hxc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ker_stalkMap_snd_eq_span_localEquationAt
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_snd_eq_span_localEquationAt
    (hreg : ∀ x : X, IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    {x z : X} (hxc : coheight x = 1)
    (w : (pullback (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) : Scheme.{u})) :
    RingHom.ker ((pullback.snd (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z)).stalkMap w).hom =
      Ideal.span {((pointClosureι z).stalkMap
          (pullback.snd (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) w)).hom
        (localEquationAt hreg
          (pointClosureι z (pullback.snd (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) w)) x hxc)}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcond : pointClosureι x (pullback.fst (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) w) =
      pointClosureι z (pullback.snd (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) w) := by
    change (pullback.fst (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) ≫ pointClosureι x) w =
      (pullback.snd (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) ≫ pointClosureι z) w
    rw [pullback.condition]
  have hi : IsLocallyPrincipalClosedImmersion (pointClosureι x) :=
    isLocallyPrincipalClosedImmersion_pointClosureι_of_regular (fun t _ ↦ hreg t) hxc
  obtain ⟨U, hU, aU, haU⟩ :=
    hi (pointClosureι x (pullback.fst (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) w))
  let c : PrincipalOpenPullbackChart (pointClosureι x) U.1.ι :=
    principalOpenPullbackChartOfKernelIdealEqSpan (pointClosureι x) U aU haU
  let d : At (i := pointClosureι x) (t := U.1.ι) (pointClosureι z) w :=
    At.ofPoint (i := pointClosureι x) (t := U.1.ι) (pointClosureι z) w
      ⟨pointClosureι x (pullback.fst (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) w), hU⟩ rfl
  rw [At.ker_stalkMap_snd_eq_span_pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkElement (pointClosureι z) d c]
  
  have hupstairs : Ideal.span {(At.leftChartAt (pointClosureι z) d c).stalkElement} =
      Ideal.span {localEquationAt hreg
        (pointClosureι x (pullback.fst (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) w)) x hxc} := by
    rw [← PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.At.ker_stalkMap (At.leftChartAt (pointClosureι z) d c),
      ker_stalkMap_pointClosureι_eq_span_localEquationAt hreg hxc]
  have hmap := congrArg (Ideal.map (pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkMap
    (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) w).hom) hupstairs
  rw [Ideal.map_span, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, Set.image_singleton] at hmap
  rw [show pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkElement (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) w
      (At.leftChartAt (pointClosureι z) d c).stalkElement =
      (pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkMap (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) w).hom
        (At.leftChartAt (pointClosureι z) d c).stalkElement from rfl, hmap]
  have hgeneq : (pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkMap (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) w).hom
      (localEquationAt hreg
        (pointClosureι x (pullback.fst (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) w)) x hxc) =
      ((pointClosureι z).stalkMap
          (pullback.snd (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) w)).hom
        (localEquationAt hreg
          (pointClosureι z (pullback.snd (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι z) w)) x hxc) := by
    rw [pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkMap, CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply,
      stalkCongr_localEquationAt hreg hcond x hxc]
  rw [hgeneq]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.idealSheafKoszulOpenPullbackIso_hom_quotient
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem idealSheafKoszulOpenPullbackIso_hom_quotient
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (I : X.IdealSheafData) (U : X.affineOpens)
    (rs : List Γ(X, U)) (h : I.ideal U = Ideal.ofList rs) :
    (idealSheafKoszulOpenPullbackIso I U rs h).hom ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.ofList rs))) =
    pullback.snd I.subschemeι U.1.ι ≫ U.2.isoSpec.hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [idealSheafKoszulOpenPullbackIso, Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc]
  simp only [Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.op_hom, Scheme.Spec_map, Quiver.Hom.unop_op]
  rw [← Spec.map_comp]
  have hcomp : (Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq Γ(X, U) h).symm.toRingEquiv.toRingHom.comp
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.ofList rs)) = Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.ideal U) := by
    ext a
    simp [Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq_symm]
  have hcompCat : CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.ofList rs)) ≫
      (Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq Γ(X, U) h).symm.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.hom =
      CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.ideal U)) := by
    ext a
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun hcomp a
  rw [hcompCat]
  exact idealSheafOpenPullbackIso_hom_quotient I U

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SchemeLocalOrdSymmetry.three_le_ringKrullDim_of_chain
statement:
theorem three_le_ringKrullDim_of_chain {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    {q q' Q : Ideal R} [hq : q.IsPrime] [hq' : q'.IsPrime] [hQ : Q.IsPrime]
    (h1 : ⊥ < q') (h2 : q' < q) (h3 : q < Q) : (3 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R
proof:
:= by
  let s : LTSeries (PrimeSpectrum R) :=
    (((RelSeries.singleton _ (⟨⊥, Ideal.isPrime_bot⟩ : PrimeSpectrum R)).snoc ⟨q', hq'⟩
      (by exact h1)).snoc ⟨q, hq⟩ (by exact h2)).snoc ⟨Q, hQ⟩ (by exact h3)
  have hs := LTSeries.length_le_krullDim s
  have hlen : s.length = 3 := rfl
  rw [hlen] at hs
  exact hs

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SchemeLocalOrdSymmetry.ord_quotient_map_atMaximal
statement:
theorem ord_quotient_map_atMaximal {D : Type*} [CommRing D] [IsLocalRing D] (q : Ideal D)
    (a : D) :
    Ring.ord (Localization.AtPrime (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal D) ⧸
        q.map (algebraMap D (Localization.AtPrime (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal D))))
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap D _ a)) =
      Ring.ord (D ⧸ q) (Ideal.Quotient.mk q a)
proof:
:= by
  set L := Localization.AtPrime (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal D)
  let e : D ≃ₐ[D] L := IsLocalization.atUnits D (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal D).primeCompl
    (fun x hx ↦ (IsUnit.mem_submonoid_iff x).mpr (IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal.mp hx))
  have hq : q.map (algebraMap D L) = q.map ((e.toRingEquiv : D ≃+* L) : D →+* L) := by
    congr 1
  let E := Ideal.quotientEquiv q (q.map (algebraMap D L)) e.toRingEquiv hq
  rw [← LocalOrdSymmetry.ord_ringEquiv E (Ideal.Quotient.mk q a)]
  congr 1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SchemeLocalOrdSymmetry.ord_atPrime_stalkPrime
statement:
theorem ord_atPrime_stalkPrime {X : Scheme.{u}} {x y : X} (h : x ⤳ y)
    (a : X.presheaf.stalk y) :
    Ring.ord (Localization.AtPrime (Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h))
        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk y) _ a) =
      Ring.ord (X.presheaf.stalk x) ((X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom a)
proof:
:= by
  letI := Scheme.stalkSpecializesAlgebra h
  rw [← LocalOrdSymmetry.ord_ringEquiv (Scheme.stalkSpecializesAlgEquiv h).toRingEquiv]
  congr 1
  exact (Scheme.stalkSpecializesAlgEquiv h).commutes a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SchemeLocalOrdSymmetry.stalk_localOrdSymmetry
statement:
theorem stalk_localOrdSymmetry {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X] {y : X}
    (hy : coheight y ≤ 2) (a s : X.presheaf.stalk y) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hs : s ≠ 0)
    (hgood : ∀ q : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk y), q.IsPrime → a ∈ q → s ∈ q →
      q = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk y)) :
    ∑ᶠ q : PrimeSpectrum (X.presheaf.stalk y),
        (if q.asIdeal < IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk y) ∧ s ∈ q.asIdeal then
          Ring.ord (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) (algebraMap _ _ s) *
            Ring.ord (X.presheaf.stalk y ⧸ q.asIdeal) (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a)
        else 0) =
      ∑ᶠ q : PrimeSpectrum (X.presheaf.stalk y),
        (if q.asIdeal < IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk y) ∧ a ∈ q.asIdeal then
          Ring.ord (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) (algebraMap _ _ a) *
            Ring.ord (X.presheaf.stalk y ⧸ q.asIdeal) (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ s)
        else 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hchain : ∀ q q' : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk y), q.IsPrime → q'.IsPrime → ⊥ < q' →
      q' < q → q < IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk y) → False := by
    intro q q' hq hq' h1 h2 h3
    have h := three_le_ringKrullDim_of_chain h1 h2 h3
    rw [ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight] at h
    have h2 : ((coheight y : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
      WithBot.coe_le_coe.mpr hy
    have h3 := h.trans h2
    have h4 : (3 : ℕ∞) ≤ 2 := WithBot.coe_le_coe.mp h3
    exact absurd h4 (by decide)
  have key := localOrdSymmetry (X.presheaf.stalk y) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _) a s ha hs
    hchain (fun q hq _ haq hsq ↦ hgood q hq haq hsq)
  simpa only [ord_quotient_map_atMaximal] using key

theorem stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_self {X : Scheme.{u}} {y : X} (h : y ⤳ y) :
