name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.flatPullback_add
statement:
theorem flatPullback_add [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (f : X ⟶ Y) (D E : AlgebraicCycle Y ℤ) :
    flatPullback f (D + E) = flatPullback f D + flatPullback f E
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change (D (f x) + E (f x)) * _ = D (f x) * _ + E (f x) * _
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.flatPullback_mem_dimensionCycles
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  change D (f x) * (flatPullbackCoeff f x : ℤ) ≠ 0 at hx
  have h1 : D (f x) ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul hx
  have h2 : flatPullbackCoeff f x ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; apply hx; simp [h]
  change height x = ((k + d : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
  rw [hf x h2, hD h1]
  push_cast
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.flatPullbackCoeff_eq_one_of_isIso
statement:
theorem flatPullbackCoeff_eq_one_of_isIso (j : X ⟶ Y) (x : X) [IsIso (j.stalkMap x)] :
    flatPullbackCoeff j x = 1
proof:
:= by
  let e := (asIso (j.stalkMap x)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  have hmax : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk (j x))).map (j.stalkMap x).hom =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x) := by
    have : ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk (j x))).map e).IsMaximal :=
      Ideal.map_isMaximal_of_equiv e
    exact IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal this
  unfold flatPullbackCoeff
  rw [hmax]
  haveI : IsSimpleModule (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :=
    isSimpleModule_iff_isCoatom.mpr (Ideal.isMaximal_def.mp inferInstance)
  rw [Module.length_eq_one]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion
statement:
theorem flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion (j : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j] (x : X) :
    flatPullbackCoeff j x = 1
proof:
:=
  flatPullbackCoeff_eq_one_of_isIso j x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_coheight_chart
statement:
theorem m6pb_coheight_chart [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] (W : Y.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
    (y : Y) (hy : y ∈ W) :
    Order.coheight (hW.primeIdealOf ⟨y, hy⟩) = m6pb_t k y
proof:
:= by
  letI := m6pb_algW k W
  haveI : Algebra.FiniteType k Γ(Y, W) := by
    have h1 := HasRingHomProperty.appLE @LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
      inferInstance ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩ ⟨W, hW⟩ (by simp)
    have h2 : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv.hom.FiniteType :=
      RingHom.FiniteType.of_surjective _ (fun a ↦ ⟨(Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).hom a,
        by simp⟩)
    exact h1.comp h2
  rw [SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.PrimeSpectrum.coheight_eq_toENat_trdeg_residueField (k := k)]
  unfold m6pb_t
  letI := m6pb_algK k y
  letI := TopCat.Presheaf.algebra_section_stalk Y.presheaf ⟨y, hy⟩
  haveI := hW.isLocalization_stalk ⟨y, hy⟩
  set P := hW.primeIdealOf ⟨y, hy⟩
  let e1 : Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal ≃ₐ[Γ(Y, W)] Y.presheaf.stalk y :=
    IsLocalization.algEquiv P.asIdeal.primeCompl _ _
  let e2 : P.asIdeal.ResidueField ≃+* Y.residueField y :=
    IsLocalRing.ResidueField.mapEquiv e1.toRingEquiv
  have hcomm : ∀ c0 : k, e2 (algebraMap k P.asIdeal.ResidueField c0) =
      algebraMap k (Y.residueField y) c0 := by
    intro c0
    have h1 : algebraMap k P.asIdeal.ResidueField c0 = IsLocalRing.residue _
        (algebraMap Γ(Y, W) (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal) (algebraMap k Γ(Y, W) c0)) := by
      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal)
        P.asIdeal.ResidueField, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k Γ(Y, W)
        (Localization.AtPrime P.asIdeal)]
      rfl
    rw [h1]
    change IsLocalRing.residue _ (e1 _) = _
    rw [AlgEquiv.commutes]
    change IsLocalRing.residue _ (Y.presheaf.germ W y hy
      (((Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).appLE ⊤ W (by simp)).hom
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv.hom c0))) =
      IsLocalRing.residue _ (Y.presheaf.germ ⊤ y trivial
        ((Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).appTop.hom
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv.hom c0)))
    rw [Scheme.Hom.appLE, CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply,
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]
    rfl
  exact congrArg Cardinal.toENat (AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := e2) hcomm).trdeg_eq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_isNoetherianRing_chart
statement:
theorem m6pb_isNoetherianRing_chart [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] (W : Y.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W) :
    IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y, W)
proof:
:= by
  letI := m6pb_algW k W
  haveI : Algebra.FiniteType k Γ(Y, W) := by
    have h1 := HasRingHomProperty.appLE @LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
      inferInstance ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩ ⟨W, hW⟩ (by simp)
    have h2 : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv.hom.FiniteType :=
      RingHom.FiniteType.of_surjective _ (fun a ↦ ⟨(Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).hom a,
        by simp⟩)
    exact h1.comp h2
  exact Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing k Γ(Y, W)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_t_lt
statement:
theorem m6pb_t_lt [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] {a b : Y} (hab : a < b) :
    m6pb_t k a + 1 ≤ m6pb_t k b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hW, haW, -⟩ := exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (x := a) (U := ⊤) (by simp)
  have hba : b ⤳ a := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hab.le
  have hbW : b ∈ W := hba.mem_open W.2 haW
  rw [← m6pb_coheight_chart W hW a haW, ← m6pb_coheight_chart W hW b hbW]
  apply Order.coheight_add_one_le
  have hspec : (⟨b, hbW⟩ : W) ⤳ ⟨a, haW⟩ :=
    (Topology.IsInducing.subtypeVal.specializes_iff).mp hba
  have hle : hW.primeIdealOf ⟨b, hbW⟩ ≤ hW.primeIdealOf ⟨a, haW⟩ :=
    (PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes _ _).mpr (hspec.map hW.isoSpec.hom.continuous)
  refine lt_of_le_of_ne hle ?_
  intro heq
  apply hab.ne
  have := congrArg (fun q ↦ hW.fromSpec q) heq
  simp only [hW.fromSpec_primeIdealOf] at this
  exact this.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_height_le_t
statement:
theorem m6pb_height_le_t [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] (y : Y) :
    height y ≤ m6pb_t k y
proof:
:= by
  suffices H : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ y : Y, m6pb_t k y = n → height y ≤ n by
    by_cases htop : m6pb_t k y = ⊤
    · rw [htop]; exact le_top
    · obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp htop
      rw [← hn]
      exact H n y hn.symm
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro y hy
    rw [Order.height_le_coe_iff]
    intro z hz
    have h1 := m6pb_t_lt (k := k) hz
    rw [hy] at h1
    have hzt : m6pb_t k z ≠ ⊤ := by
      intro h
      rw [h, top_add] at h1
      exact ENat.coe_ne_top n (top_le_iff.mp h1)
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hzt
    rw [← hm] at h1
    have hmn : m < n := by
      have : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast h1
      have := ENat.coe_le_coe.mp this
      omega
    calc height z ≤ m := ih m hmn z hm.symm
      _ < n := by exact_mod_cast hmn

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_height_openImmersion
statement:
theorem m6pb_height_openImmersion (k : Type u) [Field k] [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] (j : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (x : X) : height (j x) = height x
proof:
:= by
  have hsp : ∀ a b : X, j a ⤳ j b ↔ a ⤳ b := fun a b ↦ j.isOpenEmbedding.isInducing.specializes_iff
  have hmono : StrictMono (fun a : X ↦ j a) := by
    intro a b hab
    rw [lt_iff_le_not_ge, Scheme.le_iff_specializes, Scheme.le_iff_specializes] at hab ⊢
    rw [hsp, hsp]
    exact hab
  apply le_antisymm
  · obtain ⟨W, hW, hxW, hWj⟩ :=
      exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (x := j x) (U := j.opensRange) ⟨x, rfl⟩
    refine (m6pb_height_le_t (k := k) (j x)).trans ?_
    rw [← m6pb_coheight_chart W hW (j x) hxW]
    let φ := IsOpenImmersion.lift j hW.fromSpec (by rw [hW.range_fromSpec]; exact hWj)
    have hφ : φ ≫ j = hW.fromSpec := IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _
    have hφsp : ∀ a b, φ a ⤳ φ b ↔ a ⤳ b := by
      intro a b
      rw [← hsp, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hφ]
      exact hW.fromSpec.isOpenEmbedding.isInducing.specializes_iff
    have hφmono : StrictMono (fun a : Spec Γ(Y, W) ↦ φ a) := by
      intro a b hab
      rw [lt_iff_le_not_ge, Scheme.le_iff_specializes, Scheme.le_iff_specializes] at hab ⊢
      rw [hφsp, hφsp]
      exact hab
    have hψ : StrictMono (fun q ↦ φ ((specOrderIsoPrimeSpectrum Γ(Y, W)).symm q)) :=
      hφmono.comp (specOrderIsoPrimeSpectrum _).symm.strictMono
    have := Order.height_le_height_apply_of_strictMono _ hψ
      (OrderDual.toDual (hW.primeIdealOf ⟨j x, hxW⟩))
    rw [Order.height_toDual] at this
    have hx : φ ((specOrderIsoPrimeSpectrum Γ(Y, W)).symm
        (OrderDual.toDual (hW.primeIdealOf ⟨j x, hxW⟩))) = x := by
      apply j.isOpenEmbedding.injective
      change (φ ≫ j) _ = j x
      rw [hφ]
      exact hW.fromSpec_primeIdealOf ⟨j x, hxW⟩
    rw [hx] at this
    exact this
  · exact Order.height_le_height_apply_of_strictMono _ hmono x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.pureRelDim_openImmersion
statement:
theorem pureRelDim_openImmersion (k : Type u) [Field k] [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] (j : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j] :
    PureRelDim j 0
proof:
:= by
  intro x _
  rw [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero]
  exact (m6pb_height_openImmersion k j x).symm

statement:

    height q = Order.coheight (α := PrimeSpectrum R) q

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_pureRelDim_mvPolynomial
statement:
theorem m6pb_pureRelDim_mvPolynomial (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (σ : Type) [Finite σ] :
    PureRelDim (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPolynomial.C : A →+* MvPolynomial σ A)))
      (Nat.card σ)
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq
  set f := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPolynomial.C : A →+* MvPolynomial σ A)) with hfdef
  let P : PrimeSpectrum A := PrimeSpectrum.comap (MvPolynomial.C : A →+* MvPolynomial σ A) q
  haveI hPprime : (P.asIdeal.map (MvPolynomial.C : A →+* MvPolynomial σ A)).IsPrime :=
    (Ideal.Quotient.isDomain_iff_prime _).mp (MulEquiv.isDomain (MvPolynomial σ (A ⧸ P.asIdeal))
      (MvPolynomial.quotientEquivQuotientMvPolynomial (σ := σ) P.asIdeal).symm.toMulEquiv)
  let Q0 : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial σ A) :=
    ⟨P.asIdeal.map (MvPolynomial.C : A →+* MvPolynomial σ A), hPprime⟩
  have hQ0le : Q0 ≤ q := by
    change P.asIdeal.map MvPolynomial.C ≤ (q : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial σ A)).asIdeal
    rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    exact le_rfl
  have hcomapQ0 : PrimeSpectrum.comap (MvPolynomial.C : A →+* MvPolynomial σ A) Q0 = P := by
    ext a
    change MvPolynomial.C a ∈ P.asIdeal.map MvPolynomial.C ↔ a ∈ P.asIdeal
    rw [MvPolynomial.mem_map_C_iff]
    constructor
    · intro h
      simpa using h 0
    · intro h m
      rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_C]
      split_ifs
      · exact h
      · exact zero_mem _
  have hQ : (Q0 : Spec (CommRingCat.of (MvPolynomial σ A))) = q := by
    by_contra hne
    apply hq
    exact m6pb_coeff_eq_zero_of_specializes f
      ((PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes Q0 q).mp hQ0le) hne hcomapQ0
  rw [m6pb_height_spec, m6pb_height_spec, ← hQ]
  have h1 := SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.PrimeSpectrum.coheight_eq_ringKrullDim_quotient Q0
  have h2 := SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.PrimeSpectrum.coheight_eq_ringKrullDim_quotient P
  have h3 : ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial σ A ⧸ Q0.asIdeal) =
      ringKrullDim (A ⧸ P.asIdeal) + Nat.card σ :=
    (ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv
      (MvPolynomial.quotientEquivQuotientMvPolynomial (σ := σ) P.asIdeal).toRingEquiv).symm.trans
      MvPolynomial.ringKrullDim_of_isNoetherianRing
  rw [h3, ← h2] at h1
  change Order.coheight Q0 = Order.coheight (PrimeSpectrum.comap
    (MvPolynomial.C : A →+* MvPolynomial σ A) Q0) + _
  rw [hcomapQ0]
  exact_mod_cast h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_coeff_comp
statement:
theorem m6pb_coeff_comp (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) [Flat f] (x : X) :
    flatPullbackCoeff (f ≫ g) x = flatPullbackCoeff g (f x) * flatPullbackCoeff f x
proof:
:= by
  unfold flatPullbackCoeff
  letI : Algebra (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x) := (f.stalkMap x).hom.toAlgebra
  haveI : Module.Flat (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x) := Flat.stalkMap f x
  haveI : IsLocalHom (algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsLocalHom (f.stalkMap x).hom)
  set I := (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Z.presheaf.stalk (g (f x)))).map (g.stalkMap (f x)).hom
  have hI : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Z.presheaf.stalk ((f ≫ g) x))).map
      ((f ≫ g).stalkMap x).hom = I.map (algebraMap _ _) := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp]
    change _ = Ideal.map (f.stalkMap x).hom
      (Ideal.map (g.stalkMap (f x)).hom (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Z.presheaf.stalk (g (f x)))))
    rw [Ideal.map_map]
    rfl
  rw [hI, (Algebra.TensorProduct.quotIdealMapEquivTensorQuot (X.presheaf.stalk x)
    I).toLinearEquiv.length_eq, IsLocalRing.length_baseChange, ENat.toNat_mul]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.flatPullback_comp
statement:
theorem flatPullback_comp [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (g : Y ⟶ Z) [Flat f] [Flat g] (D : AlgebraicCycle Z ℤ) :
    flatPullback (f ≫ g) D = flatPullback f (flatPullback g D)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change D ((f ≫ g) x) * (flatPullbackCoeff (f ≫ g) x : ℤ) =
    (D (g (f x)) * (flatPullbackCoeff g (f x) : ℤ)) * (flatPullbackCoeff f x : ℤ)
  rw [m6pb_coeff_comp f g x, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  push_cast
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.flatPullback_id
statement:
theorem flatPullback_id [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (D : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) :
    flatPullback (𝟙 X) D = D
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change D x * (flatPullbackCoeff (𝟙 X) x : ℤ) = D x
  rw [flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion (𝟙 X) x]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_pureRelDim_transfer
statement:
theorem m6pb_pureRelDim_transfer (k : Type u) [Field k] {P V B : Scheme.{u}}
    [P.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (P ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (p : P ⟶ X) (J : V ⟶ P) [IsOpenImmersion J] (g : V ⟶ B) [Flat g] (J0 : B ⟶ X)
    [IsOpenImmersion J0] (hsq : J ≫ p = g ≫ J0) {r : ℕ} (hg : PureRelDim g r) (v : V)
    (hv : flatPullbackCoeff p (J v) ≠ 0) :
    height (J v) = height (p (J v)) + r
proof:
:= by
  have hc1 : flatPullbackCoeff (J ≫ p) v = flatPullbackCoeff p (J v) := by
    rw [m6pb_coeff_comp J p v, flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion J v, mul_one]
  have hc2 : flatPullbackCoeff (g ≫ J0) v = flatPullbackCoeff g v := by
    rw [m6pb_coeff_comp g J0 v, flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion J0 (g v), one_mul]
  have hgv : flatPullbackCoeff g v ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← hc2, ← hsq, hc1]
    exact hv
  have hpJ : p (J v) = J0 (g v) := by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hsq, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  rw [m6pb_height_openImmersion k J v, hpJ, m6pb_height_openImmersion k J0 (g v)]
  exact hg v hgv

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_range_iso_comp
statement:
theorem m6pb_range_iso_comp {A B C : Scheme.{u}} (φ : A ⟶ B) [IsIso φ] (g : B ⟶ C) :
    Set.range (φ ≫ g) = Set.range g
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨φ a, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨b, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨inv φ b, ?_⟩
    change g ((inv φ ≫ φ) b) = g b
    rw [IsIso.inv_hom_id]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_stdChart_toSpec
statement:
theorem m6pb_stdChart_toSpec (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) (a : Fin (n + 1)) :
    m6pb_stdChart R n a ≫ SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec R n =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (MvPolynomial.C : R →+* MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n a) R))
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : (awayCoordinateEquiv R n a).toRingHom.comp
      (projectiveCoordinateChartScalarRingHom R n a) = MvPolynomial.C := by
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro c
    apply (awayCoordinateEquiv R n a).symm.injective
    simp [awayCoordinateEquiv, awayCoordinateHom, projectiveCoordinateChartScalarRingHom,
      coefficientToCoordinateAway, HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_eq]
  have h : (Proj.basicOpen (grading R n) (coordinate R n a)).ι ≫
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec R n =
      (Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading R n) (coordinate R n a)
          (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n a) Nat.zero_lt_one).hom ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (projectiveCoordinateChartScalarRingHom R n a)) :=
    projectiveCoordinateOpen_ι_toSpec R n a
  unfold m6pb_stdChart
  refine (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans ?_
  refine (congrArg (fun q ↦ Spec.map (awayCoordinateEquiv R n a).toCommRingCatIso.hom ≫ q)
    ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg (fun q ↦ (Proj.basicOpenIsoSpec (grading R n)
      (coordinate R n a) (coordinate_mem_degree_one R n a) Nat.zero_lt_one).inv ≫ q) h))).trans ?_
  rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← hcomp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_range_stdChart
statement:
theorem m6pb_range_stdChart (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) (a : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Set.range (m6pb_stdChart R n a) = (coordinateOpen R n a : Set _)
proof:
:= by
  unfold m6pb_stdChart
  rw [m6pb_range_iso_comp, m6pb_range_iso_comp]
  exact Scheme.Opens.range_ι _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.m6pb_natCard_affineChartIndex
statement:
theorem m6pb_natCard_affineChartIndex (n : ℕ) (a : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Nat.card (AffineChartIndex n a) = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.pureRelDim_projectiveBundle
statement:
theorem pureRelDim_projectiveBundle (k : Type u) [Field k] [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] (E : X.Modules)
    (hE : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) (r : ℕ)
    (hrank : ∀ i, ((chosenAffineFrameCover X E hE).U i : Set X).Nonempty →
      Nat.card ((chosenAffineFrameCover X E hE).basisIndex i) = r + 1) :
    PureRelDim (projectiveBundleToBase X E hE) r
proof:
:= by
  letI : (projectiveBundle X E hE).Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    ⟨projectiveBundleToBase X E hE ≫ X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)⟩
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (projectiveBundle X E hE ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (projectiveBundleToBase X E hE ≫ X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    infer_instance
  set C := chosenAffineFrameCover X E hE with hCdef
  have hp : projectiveBundleToBase X E hE = C.toBase := rfl
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := C.covers.exists_mem (projectiveBundleToBase X E hE x)
  have hcard := hrank i ⟨_, hi⟩
  haveI : Finite (C.basisIndex i) := C.basisIndex_finite i
  haveI : Nonempty (C.basisIndex i) := (Nat.card_pos_iff.mp (by omega)).1
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, C.U i) := m6pb_isNoetherianRing_chart (k := k) _ (C.isAffine i)
  have hn : C.positiveRankDimension i = r := by
    unfold AffineFrameCover.positiveRankDimension
    letI : Fintype (C.basisIndex i) := Fintype.ofFinite _
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hcard]
    rfl
  let b : Module.Basis (Fin (C.positiveRankDimension i + 1)) Γ(X, C.U i)
      (E.val.obj (Opposite.op (C.U i))) :=
    (C.sectionBasis i).reindex (C.positiveRankBasisEquiv i)
  
  have h1 : C.chartι i ≫ C.toBase =
      intrinsicToSpec (R := Γ(X, C.U i)) (M := E.val.obj (Opposite.op (C.U i))) ≫
        (C.isAffine i).fromSpec := by
    rw [C.chartι_toBase]
    rfl
  have h2 : inv (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b) ≫
      intrinsicToSpec (R := Γ(X, C.U i)) (M := E.val.obj (Opposite.op (C.U i))) =
      SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) := by
    rw [IsIso.inv_comp_eq, intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace_comp_toSpec]
  
  have hx1 : x ∈ Set.range (C.chartι i) := by
    have hpb := C.isPullback_chartι_toBase i
    rw [← hpb.isoPullback_hom_fst, m6pb_range_iso_comp, Scheme.Pullback.range_fst,
      Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
    exact hi
  obtain ⟨x1, rfl⟩ := hx1
  set x2 := intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b x1 with hx2
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, x2 ∈ coordinateOpen Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a := by
    have : x2 ∈ (⊤ : (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space Γ(X, C.U i)
        (C.positiveRankDimension i)).Opens) := trivial
    rw [← coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top] at this
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp this
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : x2 ∈ Set.range (m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a) := by
    rw [m6pb_range_stdChart]
    exact ha
  let J := m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a ≫
    inv (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b) ≫ C.chartι i
  haveI : IsOpenImmersion J :=
    @IsOpenImmersion.comp _ _ _ _ _ inferInstance
      (@IsOpenImmersion.comp _ _ _ _ _ inferInstance (C.chartι_isOpenImmersion i))
  have hJv : J v = C.chartι i x1 := by
    change C.chartι i (inv (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b)
      (m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a v)) = C.chartι i x1
    rw [hv, hx2]
    change C.chartι i ((intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b ≫
      inv (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b)) x1) = C.chartι i x1
    rw [IsIso.hom_inv_id]
    rfl
  have hsq : J ≫ C.toBase = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPolynomial.C :
      Γ(X, C.U i) →+* MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a)
        Γ(X, C.U i))) ≫ (C.isAffine i).fromSpec := by
    have h3 : inv (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b) ≫ C.chartι i ≫ C.toBase =
        SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) ≫
          (C.isAffine i).fromSpec := by
      have := congrArg (fun q ↦ inv (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b) ≫ q) h1
      refine this.trans ?_
      rw [← Category.assoc, h2]
    change m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a ≫
      inv (intrinsicToStandardProjectiveSpace b) ≫ C.chartι i ≫ C.toBase = _
    refine (congrArg (fun q ↦ m6pb_stdChart Γ(X, C.U i) (C.positiveRankDimension i) a ≫ q)
      h3).trans ?_
    rw [← Category.assoc, m6pb_stdChart_toSpec]
  haveI : Flat (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPolynomial.C :
      Γ(X, C.U i) →+* MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a)
        Γ(X, C.U i)))) := by
    rw [Flat.SpecMap_iff]
    change (algebraMap Γ(X, C.U i)
      (MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a) Γ(X, C.U i))).Flat
    exact RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff.mpr Module.Flat.of_free
  have key := m6pb_pureRelDim_transfer k C.toBase J _ (C.isAffine i).fromSpec hsq
    (m6pb_pureRelDim_mvPolynomial Γ(X, C.U i)
      (AffineChartIndex (C.positiveRankDimension i) a)) v (by rw [hJv]; exact hx)
  rw [hJv, m6pb_natCard_affineChartIndex, hn] at key
  exact key

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.pureRelDim_projectiveSpace_toSpec
statement:
theorem pureRelDim_projectiveSpace_toSpec (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ) :
    PureRelDim (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k n) n
proof:
:= by
  letI : (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n).Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    ⟨SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k n⟩
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType ((SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k n))
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, x ∈ coordinateOpen k n a := by
    have : x ∈ (⊤ : (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n).Opens) := trivial
    rw [← coordinateOpen_iSup_eq_top] at this
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp this
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ : x ∈ Set.range (m6pb_stdChart k n a) := by
    rw [m6pb_range_stdChart]
    exact ha
  have hc : flatPullbackCoeff (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (MvPolynomial.C : k →+* MvPolynomial (AffineChartIndex n a) k))) v ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← m6pb_stdChart_toSpec, m6pb_coeff_comp,
      flatPullbackCoeff_openImmersion (m6pb_stdChart k n a) v, mul_one]
    exact hx
  have key := m6pb_pureRelDim_mvPolynomial k (AffineChartIndex n a) v hc
  rw [m6pb_natCard_affineChartIndex] at key
  rw [m6pb_height_openImmersion k (m6pb_stdChart k n a) v, key, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply,
    m6pb_stdChart_toSpec]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PureRelDim.comp
statement:
theorem PureRelDim.comp {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ Z} [Flat f] {d e : ℕ} (hf : PureRelDim f d)
    (hg : PureRelDim g e) : PureRelDim (f ≫ g) (e + d)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [m6pb_coeff_comp] at hx
  rw [hf x (right_ne_zero_of_mul hx), Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hg (f x) (left_ne_zero_of_mul hx),
    Nat.cast_add, add_assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.morphismLocalLength_comp_iso
statement:
theorem morphismLocalLength_comp_iso {W Z X : Scheme.{u}} (e : W ≅ Z)
    (f : Z ⟶ X) (w : W) :
    morphismLocalLength (e.hom ≫ f) w = morphismLocalLength f (e.hom w)
proof:
:= by
  unfold morphismLocalLength
  letI : Algebra ↑(X.presheaf.stalk ((e.hom ≫ f) w))
      ↑(Z.presheaf.stalk (e.hom w)) :=
    (f.stalkMap (e.hom w)).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra ↑(X.presheaf.stalk ((e.hom ≫ f) w)) ↑(W.presheaf.stalk w) :=
    ((e.hom ≫ f).stalkMap w).hom.toAlgebra
  let eAlg : ↑(Z.presheaf.stalk (e.hom w))
      ≃ₐ[↑(X.presheaf.stalk ((e.hom ≫ f) w))] ↑(W.presheaf.stalk w) :=
    AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv
      (f := (asIso (e.hom.stalkMap w)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv) (by
        intro r
        change (e.hom.stalkMap w).hom ((f.stalkMap (e.hom w)).hom r) =
          ((e.hom ≫ f).stalkMap w).hom r
        rw [Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp]
        rfl)
  exact eAlg.toLinearEquiv.length_eq.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.schemeHom_apply_eq_of_eq
statement:
private theorem schemeHom_apply_eq_of_eq {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} {f g : Y ⟶ Z}
    (h : f = g) (y : Y) : f y = g y
proof:
:= by
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (congrArg (fun q : Y ⟶ Z => q.base) h) y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteClosedIntersectionData.coe_localMultiplicity
statement:
theorem coe_localMultiplicity (z : d.intersection) :
    (d.localMultiplicity z : ℕ∞) = morphismLocalLength d.toX z
proof:
:= by
  exact ENat.coe_toNat (d.finiteLength z)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteClosedIntersectionData.cycle_apply_toX
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cycle_apply_toX (z : d.intersection) :
    d.cycle.1 (d.toX z) = (d.localMultiplicity z : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite d.intersection
  dsimp only [cycle]
  simp only [Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply,
    Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single z]
  · simp
  · intro w _ hwz
    have hne : d.toX z ≠ d.toX w := by
      intro h
      exact hwz (d.toX.isClosedEmbedding.injective h.symm)
    simp [hne]
  · simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteClosedIntersectionData.intersectionSymmetry_inv_comp_toX
statement:
theorem intersectionSymmetry_inv_comp_toX :
    d.intersectionSymmetry.inv ≫ d.toX =
      CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.fst d.j d.i ≫ d.j
proof:
:= by
  rw [toX, intersectionSymmetry, ← Category.assoc,
    CategoryTheory.Limits.pullbackSymmetry_inv_comp_fst]
  exact (CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.condition (f := d.j) (g := d.i)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteClosedIntersectionData.swap_localMultiplicity
statement:
theorem swap_localMultiplicity
    (z : CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) d.j d.i) :
    d.swap.localMultiplicity z =
      d.localMultiplicity (d.intersectionSymmetry.inv z)
proof:
:= by
  change (morphismLocalLength
      (CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.fst d.j d.i ≫ d.j) z).toNat =
    (morphismLocalLength d.toX (d.intersectionSymmetry.inv z)).toNat
  rw [← d.intersectionSymmetry_inv_comp_toX,
    show d.intersectionSymmetry.inv = d.intersectionSymmetry.symm.hom by rfl,
    morphismLocalLength_comp_iso]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteClosedIntersectionData.intersectionSymmetry_hom_comp_swap_toX
statement:
theorem intersectionSymmetry_hom_comp_swap_toX :
    d.intersectionSymmetry.hom ≫ d.swap.toX = d.toX
proof:
:= by
  change d.intersectionSymmetry.hom ≫
      (CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.fst d.j d.i ≫ d.j) = d.toX
  rw [intersectionSymmetry, toX, ← Category.assoc,
    CategoryTheory.Limits.pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_fst]
  exact (CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.condition (f := d.i) (g := d.j)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteClosedIntersectionData.swap_localMultiplicity_symmetry
statement:
theorem swap_localMultiplicity_symmetry (z : d.intersection) :
    d.swap.localMultiplicity (d.intersectionSymmetry.hom z) = d.localMultiplicity z
proof:
:= by
  rw [d.swap_localMultiplicity]
  congr 1
  exact (Scheme.homeoOfIso d.intersectionSymmetry).left_inv z

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteClosedIntersectionData.cycle_apply_eq_zero_of_not_exists
statement:
theorem cycle_apply_eq_zero_of_not_exists (x : X)
    (hx : ¬ ∃ z : d.intersection, d.toX z = x) : d.cycle.1 x = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite d.intersection
  dsimp only [cycle]
  simp only [Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro z _
  have hne : x ≠ d.toX z := by
    intro h
    exact hx ⟨z, h.symm⟩
  simp [Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.single_apply, hne]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteClosedIntersectionData.localMultiplicity_pos
statement: theorem localMultiplicity_pos (z : d.intersection) : 0 < d.localMultiplicity z
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z))
      ↑(d.intersection.presheaf.stalk z) :=
    (d.toX.stalkMap z).hom.toAlgebra
  apply ENat.toNat_pos
  · exact ne_of_gt (Module.length_pos :
      0 < morphismLocalLength d.toX z)
  · exact d.finiteLength z

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteClosedIntersectionData.cycle_support
statement: theorem cycle_support : d.cycle.1.support = Set.range d.toX
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    by_contra h
    change ¬ ∃ z, d.toX z = x at h
    exact hx (d.cycle_apply_eq_zero_of_not_exists x h)
  · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
    change d.cycle.1 (d.toX z) ≠ 0
    rw [d.cycle_apply_toX]
    exact Int.ofNat_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt (d.localMultiplicity_pos z))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteClosedIntersectionData.swap_cycle
statement: theorem swap_cycle : d.swap.cycle = d.cycle
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext x
  by_cases hx : ∃ z : d.intersection, d.toX z = x
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hx
    have hpoint : d.swap.toX (d.intersectionSymmetry.hom z) = d.toX z :=
      schemeHom_apply_eq_of_eq d.intersectionSymmetry_hom_comp_swap_toX z
    calc
      d.swap.cycle.1 (d.toX z) =
          d.swap.cycle.1 (d.swap.toX (d.intersectionSymmetry.hom z)) :=
        congrArg (fun y => d.swap.cycle.1 y) hpoint.symm
      _ = (d.swap.localMultiplicity (d.intersectionSymmetry.hom z) : ℤ) :=
        d.swap.cycle_apply_toX _
      _ = (d.localMultiplicity z : ℤ) :=
        congrArg (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℤ)) (d.swap_localMultiplicity_symmetry z)
      _ = d.cycle.1 (d.toX z) := (d.cycle_apply_toX z).symm
  · rw [d.cycle_apply_eq_zero_of_not_exists x hx]
    apply d.swap.cycle_apply_eq_zero_of_not_exists
    change ¬ ∃ w : CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) d.j d.i,
      (CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.fst d.j d.i ≫ d.j) w = x
    rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
    apply hx
    refine ⟨d.intersectionSymmetry.inv w, ?_⟩
    have hpoint : d.toX (d.intersectionSymmetry.inv w) =
        (CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.fst d.j d.i ≫ d.j) w :=
      schemeHom_apply_eq_of_eq d.intersectionSymmetry_inv_comp_toX w
    exact hpoint.trans hw

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.exists_commonPrincipalOpenAt
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U₁, hx₁, a₁, ha₁⟩ := hI x
  obtain ⟨U₂, hx₂, a₂, ha₂⟩ := hJ x
  obtain ⟨f, g, e, hxf⟩ :=
    exists_basicOpen_le_affine_inter U₁.2 U₂.2 x ⟨hx₁, hx₂⟩
  have hleft : I.ideal (X.affineBasicOpen f) =
      Ideal.span {(X.presheaf.map (homOfLE <| X.basicOpen_le f).op).hom a₁} := by
    rw [← I.map_ideal_basicOpen U₁ f, ha₁, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
  have hright : ∃ b : Γ(X, X.affineBasicOpen f),
      J.ideal (X.affineBasicOpen f) = Ideal.span {b} := by
    have hWW : X.affineBasicOpen f = X.affineBasicOpen g := Subtype.ext e
    rw [hWW]
    refine ⟨(X.presheaf.map (homOfLE <| X.basicOpen_le g).op).hom a₂, ?_⟩
    rw [← J.map_ideal_basicOpen U₂ g, ha₂, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hright
  exact ⟨⟨X.affineBasicOpen f, hxf,
    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE <| X.basicOpen_le f).op).hom a₁, b, hleft, hb⟩⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.nonempty_commonPrincipalCharts_ofIdealSheaves
statement:
theorem nonempty_commonPrincipalCharts_ofIdealSheaves
    {I J : X.IdealSheafData}
    {codim : ∀ z : pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) I.subschemeι J.subschemeι,
      z ∈ genericPoints (pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) I.subschemeι J.subschemeι) →
        coheight ((pullback.fst I.subschemeι J.subschemeι ≫ I.subschemeι) z) = r}
    (hI : IdealSheafIsLocallyPrincipal I) (hJ : IdealSheafIsLocallyPrincipal J)
    (x : X) : Nonempty ((ofIdealSheaves I J codim).CommonPrincipalCharts x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c⟩ := exists_commonPrincipalOpenAt hI hJ x
  exact ⟨⟨c.W, c.mem,
    principalOpenPullbackChartOfIdealEqSpan I c.W c.leftEquation c.left_ideal_eq,
    principalOpenPullbackChartOfIdealEqSpan J c.W c.rightEquation c.right_ideal_eq⟩⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.nonempty_commonPrincipalCharts_ofClosedImmersions
statement:
theorem nonempty_commonPrincipalCharts_ofClosedImmersions
    (d : ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData X r)
    (hi : IsLocallyPrincipalClosedImmersion d.i)
    (hj : IsLocallyPrincipalClosedImmersion d.j) (x : X) :
    Nonempty (d.CommonPrincipalCharts x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c⟩ := exists_commonPrincipalOpenAt hi hj x
  exact ⟨⟨c.W, c.mem,
    principalOpenPullbackChartOfKernelIdealEqSpan d.i c.W
      c.leftEquation c.left_ideal_eq,
    principalOpenPullbackChartOfKernelIdealEqSpan d.j c.W
      c.rightEquation c.right_ideal_eq⟩⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.LocalData.isTorIndependent_of_commonPrincipalCharts
statement:
theorem LocalData.isTorIndependent_of_commonPrincipalCharts
    [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral d.D] (hr : 2 ≤ r) {z : d.intersection}
    (c : d.CommonPrincipalCharts (d.toX z))
    (hz : z ∈ genericPoints d.intersection)
    (t : d.LocalData z) : t.IsTorIndependent
proof:
:= by
  let q := c.restrictionAt d
  let cLeftAt :=
    PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.OpenIntersectionRestriction.At.leftChartAt d.j q c.cLeft
  let cRightAt :=
    PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.OpenIntersectionRestriction.At.rightChartAt d.j q c.cRight
  have hTransverse :=
    d.rightAmbientStalkElement_not_mem_span_leftChartAt hr c.W.1.ι c.cLeft c.cRight q hz
  have hAmbient : d.rightAmbientStalkElement z cRightAt.stalkElement ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply hTransverse
    rw [h0]
    exact Ideal.zero_mem _
  have regAmbient : IsSMulRegular
      (ModuleCat.of ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z)) ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z)))
      (d.rightAmbientStalkElement z cRightAt.stalkElement) :=
    (IsRegular.of_ne_zero hAmbient).isSMulRegular
  have regLeft : IsSMulRegular (d.leftStalkModule z)
      (d.rightAmbientStalkElement z cRightAt.stalkElement) := by
    rw [d.isSMulRegular_leftStalkModule_iff]
    intro x hx
    have hker : RingHom.ker (d.leftStalkMap z).hom =
        Ideal.span {cLeftAt.stalkElement} := by
      change RingHom.ker (d.i.stalkMap (d.leftPoint z)).hom = _
      exact cLeftAt.ker_stalkMap
    rw [hker] at hx ⊢
    have hPrime : (Ideal.span {cLeftAt.stalkElement}).IsPrime := by
      rw [← cLeftAt.ker_stalkMap]
      exact RingHom.ker_isPrime _
    exact idealSaturation_of_isPrime_of_not_mem hPrime hTransverse x hx
  intro n
  exact SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution.isZero_module_of_iso_principalQuotient_of_isSMulRegular
    ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z))
    (d.rightAmbientStalkElement z cRightAt.stalkElement)
    regAmbient (d.leftStalkModule z) regLeft
    (d.principalQuotientIsoRightStalkModule z
      (d.rightAmbientStalkElement z cRightAt.stalkElement)
      (d.ker_rightStalkMap_eq_span_rightAmbientStalkElement z
        cRightAt.stalkElement cRightAt.ker_stalkMap)) n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.hasCommonPrincipalCharts_ofIdealSheaves
statement:
theorem hasCommonPrincipalCharts_ofIdealSheaves
    {I J : X.IdealSheafData}
    {codim : ∀ z : pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) I.subschemeι J.subschemeι,
      z ∈ genericPoints (pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) I.subschemeι J.subschemeι) →
        coheight ((pullback.fst I.subschemeι J.subschemeι ≫ I.subschemeι) z) = r}
    (hI : IdealSheafIsLocallyPrincipal I) (hJ : IdealSheafIsLocallyPrincipal J) :
    (ofIdealSheaves I J codim).HasCommonPrincipalCharts
proof:
:=
  fun x ↦ nonempty_commonPrincipalCharts_ofIdealSheaves hI hJ x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.hasCommonPrincipalCharts_ofClosedImmersions
statement:
theorem hasCommonPrincipalCharts_ofClosedImmersions
    (hi : IsLocallyPrincipalClosedImmersion d.i)
    (hj : IsLocallyPrincipalClosedImmersion d.j) : d.HasCommonPrincipalCharts
proof:
:=
  fun x ↦ nonempty_commonPrincipalCharts_ofClosedImmersions d hi hj x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.GlobalData.isTorIndependent_ofCommonPrincipalCharts
statement:
theorem isTorIndependent_ofCommonPrincipalCharts
    [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral d.D] (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    (hc : d.HasCommonPrincipalCharts) :
    (ofCommonPrincipalCharts d hr hc).IsTorIndependent
proof:
:=
  fun z hz ↦
    LocalData.isTorIndependent_of_commonPrincipalCharts d hr
      (Classical.choice (hc (d.toX z))) hz _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.GlobalData.cycle_ofCommonPrincipalCharts_eq
statement:
theorem cycle_ofCommonPrincipalCharts_eq
    [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral d.D] (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    (hc : d.HasCommonPrincipalCharts) :
    (ofCommonPrincipalCharts d hr hc).cycle = d.cycle
proof:
:=
  cycle_eq_expectedCodimensionCycle _
    (isTorIndependent_ofCommonPrincipalCharts d hr hc)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.GlobalData.cycle_ofLocallyPrincipalIdealSheaves_eq
statement:
theorem GlobalData.cycle_ofLocallyPrincipalIdealSheaves_eq
    (I J : X.IdealSheafData)
    (codim : ∀ z : pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) I.subschemeι J.subschemeι,
      z ∈ genericPoints (pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) I.subschemeι J.subschemeι) →
        coheight ((pullback.fst I.subschemeι J.subschemeι ≫ I.subschemeι) z) = r)
    (hI : IdealSheafIsLocallyPrincipal I) (hJ : IdealSheafIsLocallyPrincipal J)
    [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral I.subscheme] (hr : 2 ≤ r) :
    (GlobalData.ofLocallyPrincipalIdealSheaves I J codim hI hJ hr).cycle =
      (ofIdealSheaves I J codim).cycle
proof:
:=
  haveI : IsIntegral (ofIdealSheaves I J codim).D := ‹IsIntegral I.subscheme›

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.relationCombinationSupportEnvelope_apply_of_mem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem relationCombinationSupportEnvelope_apply_of_mem
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X]
    (c : RationalRelationGenerator X 1 →₀ ℤ) (z : CodimensionPoint X 1)
    (hz : z ∈ relationCombinationSupport c) :
    (relationCombinationSupportEnvelope c).1 z.1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [relationCombinationSupportEnvelope]
  change ((compactCodimCycleEquivFinsupp 1)
    ((compactCodimCycleEquivFinsupp 1).symm
      (Finset.sum (relationCombinationSupport c) fun x => Finsupp.single x 1))) z = 1
  rw [AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  change Finsupp.applyAddHom z
    (Finset.sum (relationCombinationSupport c) fun x => Finsupp.single x 1) = 1
  rw [map_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single z]
  · simp
  · intro x hx hne
    simp [hne]
  · exact fun h ↦ (h hz).elim

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.relationCycle_support_subset_supportEnvelope
statement:
theorem relationCycle_support_subset_supportEnvelope
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X]
    (c : RationalRelationGenerator X 1 →₀ ℤ)
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X 1) (hg : g ∈ c.support)
    {x : X} (hx : g.cycle.1 x ≠ 0) :
    (relationCombinationSupportEnvelope c).1 x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let z : CodimensionPoint X 1 := ⟨x, g.cycle.2 hx⟩
  have hzg : z ∈ ((compactCodimCycleEquivFinsupp 1) g.cycle).support := by
    rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff]
    change g.cycle.1 z.1 ≠ 0
    exact hx
  have hz : z ∈ relationCombinationSupport c := by
    rw [relationCombinationSupport]
    exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨g, hg, hzg⟩
  change (relationCombinationSupportEnvelope c).1 z.1 ≠ 0
  rw [relationCombinationSupportEnvelope_apply_of_mem c z hz]
  exact one_ne_zero

    (E : CodimensionCycles X ℤ 1) (hE : E ∈ cycles)

proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.DivisorLinearSystemData.exists_cycle_meeting_relationCombination
statement:
theorem exists_cycle_meeting_relationCombination
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {k : Type v} {V : Type w}
    [Field k] [Infinite k] [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V]
    [IsNoetherian X] [Order.KrullDimLE 2 X]
    {a : CodimensionChow X 1}
    (L : DivisorLinearSystemData X k V a)
    (c : RationalRelationGenerator X 1 →₀ ℤ) :
    ∃ D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ 1,
      gradedClassOf X 1 D = a ∧
        ∀ g ∈ c.support, CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D g.cycle
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hclass, hdisjoint⟩ :=
    L.exists_cycle_disjoint_support (relationCombinationSupportEnvelope c)
  refine ⟨D, hclass, ?_⟩
  intro g hg
  apply cyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_one_one_of_disjoint_support
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxD hxg
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint hxD
      (relationCycle_support_subset_supportEnvelope c g hg hxg)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.DivisorLinearSystemData.exists_cycle_meeting_cycles_and_relationCombination
statement:
theorem exists_cycle_meeting_cycles_and_relationCombination
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {k : Type v} {V : Type w}
    [Field k] [Infinite k] [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V]
    [IsNoetherian X] [Order.KrullDimLE 2 X]
    {a : CodimensionChow X 1}
    (L : DivisorLinearSystemData X k V a)
    (cycles : Finset (CodimensionCycles X ℤ 1))
    (c : RationalRelationGenerator X 1 →₀ ℤ) :
    ∃ D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ 1,
      gradedClassOf X 1 D = a ∧
        (∀ E ∈ cycles, CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D E) ∧
        ∀ g ∈ c.support, CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D g.cycle
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hclass, hdisjoint⟩ :=
    L.exists_cycle_disjoint_support (simultaneousMovingSupportEnvelope cycles c)
  refine ⟨D, hclass, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro E hE
    apply cyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_one_one_of_disjoint_support
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hxD hxE
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint hxD
      (literalCycle_support_subset_simultaneousMovingSupportEnvelope cycles c E hE hxE)
  · intro g hg
    apply cyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_one_one_of_disjoint_support
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hxD hxg
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint hxD
      (relationCycle_support_subset_simultaneousMovingSupportEnvelope cycles c g hg hxg)

statement:
lemma koszulPair_d_comp_d (a b : A) :
    (koszulPairDOne A a b).comp (koszulPairDTwo A a b) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro r
  simp [koszulPairDOne, koszulPairDTwo]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.koszulPair_exact_middle
statement:
theorem koszulPair_exact_middle (a b : A)
    (reg : IsWeaklyRegular (ModuleCat.of A A) [a, b]) :
    (ShortComplex.moduleCatMk (koszulPairDTwo A a b) (koszulPairDOne A a b)
      (koszulPair_d_comp_d A a b)).Exact
proof:
:= by
  rw [ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff]
  intro x hx
  change koszulPairDOne A a b x = 0 at hx
  have hreg := (isWeaklyRegular_cons_iff (ModuleCat.of A A) a [b]).mp reg
  have regA : IsSMulRegular (ModuleCat.of A A) a := hreg.1
  have regB : IsSMulRegular (QuotSMulTop a A) b :=
    (isWeaklyRegular_singleton_iff (QuotSMulTop a A) b).mp hreg.2
  have hbq : b • (Submodule.Quotient.mk x.2 : QuotSMulTop a A) = 0 := by
    rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul]
    apply (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero (a • (⊤ : Submodule A A))).mpr
    change b * x.2 ∈ a • (⊤ : Submodule A A)
    have heq : b * x.2 = a * (-x.1) := by
      dsimp [koszulPairDOne] at hx
      linear_combination hx
    rw [heq]
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using
      Submodule.smul_mem_pointwise_smul (-x.1) a (⊤ : Submodule A A) trivial
  have hx2q : (Submodule.Quotient.mk x.2 : QuotSMulTop a A) = 0 :=
    regB.right_eq_zero_of_smul hbq
  have hx2mem : x.2 ∈ a • (⊤ : Submodule A A) :=
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero (a • (⊤ : Submodule A A))).mp hx2q
  rcases (Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists x.2 a (⊤ : Submodule A A)).mp hx2mem with
    ⟨r, -, har⟩
  have har' : a * r = x.2 := by simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using har
  have ha : a • (x.1 + b * r) = 0 := by
    change a * (x.1 + b * r) = 0
    dsimp [koszulPairDOne] at hx
    rw [← har'] at hx
    linear_combination hx
  have hfirst : x.1 = -b * r := by
    have hz := regA.right_eq_zero_of_smul ha
    linear_combination hz
  refine ⟨r, ?_⟩
  change koszulPairDTwo A a b r = x
  ext
  · exact hfirst.symm
  · exact har'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.koszulPairComplex_isZero
statement:
theorem koszulPairComplex_isZero (a b : A) (n : ℕ) :
    IsZero ((koszulPairComplex A a b).X (n + 3))
proof:
:= by
  let Z := ModuleCat.of A (Fin 0 → A)
  have hZ : IsZero Z :=
    ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mpr
      (inferInstance : Subsingleton (Fin 0 → A))
  apply IsZero.of_iso hZ
  exact ChainComplex.mkXIso
    (ModuleCat.of A A) (ModuleCat.of A (A × A)) (ModuleCat.of A A)
    (ModuleCat.ofHom (koszulPairDOne A a b))
    (ModuleCat.ofHom (koszulPairDTwo A a b))
    (ModuleCat.hom_ext (koszulPair_d_comp_d A a b))
    (zeroSuccessor A) n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.koszulPairComplex_exactAt_succ
statement:
theorem koszulPairComplex_exactAt_succ (a b : A)
    (reg : IsWeaklyRegular (ModuleCat.of A A) [a, b]) (n : ℕ) :
    (koszulPairComplex A a b).ExactAt (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain _ | n := n
  · rw [HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff' _ 2 1 0 (by simp) (by simp)]
    rw [ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff]
    change ∀ x : A × A, koszulPairDOne A a b x = 0 →
      ∃ r : A, koszulPairDTwo A a b r = x
    have h := koszulPair_exact_middle A a b reg
    rw [ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff] at h
    exact h
  · obtain _ | n := n
    · rw [HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff' _ 3 2 1 (by simp) (by simp)]
      apply (ShortComplex.exact_iff_mono _
        ((koszulPairComplex_isZero A a b 0).eq_of_src _ _)).2
      change Mono (ModuleCat.ofHom (koszulPairDTwo A a b))
      rw [ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective]
      intro x y hxy
      have regA : IsSMulRegular (ModuleCat.of A A) a :=
        ((isWeaklyRegular_cons_iff (ModuleCat.of A A) a [b]).mp reg).1
      apply regA
      have hsnd := congrArg Prod.snd hxy
      change a * x = a * y at hsnd
      simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using hsnd
    · exact HomologicalComplex.ExactAt.of_isZero
        (koszulPairComplex_isZero A a b n)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.koszulPair_quotient_comp
statement:
lemma koszulPair_quotient_comp (a b : A) :
    (koszulPairQuotientMap A a b).comp (koszulPairDOne A a b) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({a, b} : Set A))
    (a * x.1 + b * x.2) = 0
  apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
  apply Ideal.mem_span_pair.mpr
  refine ⟨x.1, x.2, ?_⟩
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.koszulPair_augmentation_exact
statement:
theorem koszulPair_augmentation_exact (a b : A) :
    (ShortComplex.moduleCatMk (koszulPairDOne A a b)
      (koszulPairQuotientMap A a b) (koszulPair_quotient_comp A a b)).Exact
proof:
:= by
  rw [ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff]
  intro x hx
  change koszulPairQuotientMap A a b x = 0 at hx
  change Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({a, b} : Set A)) x = 0 at hx
  rcases Ideal.mem_span_pair.mp (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp hx) with ⟨r, s, hrs⟩
  refine ⟨(r, s), ?_⟩
  change a * r + b * s = x
  linear_combination hrs

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution.isZero_module_koszulPair
statement:
theorem isZero_module_koszulPair (a b : A)
    (reg : IsWeaklyRegular (ModuleCat.of A A) [a, b])
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) (n : ℕ) :
    IsZero (module A M
      (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ Ideal.span ({a, b} : Set A))) (n + 3))
proof:
:= by
  apply (koszulPair A a b reg).isZero_module A M
  change 2 < n + 3
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution.isZero_module_of_iso_koszulPair
statement:
theorem isZero_module_of_iso_koszulPair (a b : A)
    (reg : IsWeaklyRegular (ModuleCat.of A A) [a, b])
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) {N' : ModuleCat.{u} A}
    (e : ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ Ideal.span ({a, b} : Set A)) ≅ N') (n : ℕ) :
    IsZero (module A M N' (n + 3))
proof:
:= by
  apply ((koszulPair A a b reg).ofIso A e).isZero_module A M
  change 2 < n + 3
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution.koszulPairEulerData_multiplicity
statement:
theorem koszulPairEulerData_multiplicity (a b : A)
    (reg : IsWeaklyRegular (ModuleCat.of A A) [a, b])
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) (hM : Module.length A (↑M : Type u) ≠ ⊤) :
    (koszulPairEulerData A a b reg M hM).multiplicity =
      (length A M (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ Ideal.span ({a, b} : Set A))) 0).toNat -
        (length A M (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ Ideal.span ({a, b} : Set A))) 1).toNat +
          (length A M (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ Ideal.span ({a, b} : Set A))) 2).toNat
proof:
:= by
  simp [koszulPairEulerData, toEulerDataOfFiniteTerms, toEulerData,
    koszulPair, EulerData.multiplicity, signedLength, Finset.sum_range_succ,
    sub_eq_add_neg]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.mem_preimageSupportFinite_toFinset_iff
statement:
theorem mem_preimageSupportFinite_toFinset_iff (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f]
    (D : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) (y : Y) (x : X) :
    x ∈ (f.preimageSupportFinite D y).toFinset ↔ f x = y ∧ D x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [Function.locallyFinsupp.preimageSupport, Function.mem_support]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.properPushforward_apply
statement:
theorem properPushforward_apply (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] (D : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ)
    (y : Y) :
    properPushforward f D y =
      ∑ x ∈ (f.preimageSupportFinite D y).toFinset, D x * (f.degree x : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  change (∑ x ∈ (f.preimageSupportFinite D y).toFinset,
    D x * ((mapAux f (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) x : ℕ) : ℤ)) = _
  simp [mapAux]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.properPushforward_apply_eq_sum_of_subset
statement:
theorem properPushforward_apply_eq_sum_of_subset (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f]
    (D : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) (y : Y) (T : Finset X)
    (hT : ∀ x, f x = y → D x ≠ 0 → x ∈ T) :
    properPushforward f D y =
      ∑ x ∈ T with f x = y, D x * (f.degree x : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [properPushforward_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_subset
  · intro x hx
    rw [mem_preimageSupportFinite_toFinset_iff] at hx
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hT x hx.1 hx.2, hx.1⟩
  · intro x hx hx'
    rw [mem_preimageSupportFinite_toFinset_iff] at hx'
    have hfx : f x = y := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
    have : D x = 0 := by
      by_contra h
      exact hx' ⟨hfx, h⟩
    simp [this]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.properPushforward_add
statement:
theorem properPushforward_add (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] (D E : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) :
    properPushforward f (D + E) = properPushforward f D + properPushforward f E
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  set T := (f.preimageSupportFinite D y).toFinset ∪ (f.preimageSupportFinite E y).toFinset
  have hmem : ∀ (F : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ), (∀ x, f x = y → F x ≠ 0 → D x ≠ 0 ∨ E x ≠ 0) →
      ∀ x, f x = y → F x ≠ 0 → x ∈ T := by
    intro F hF x hx hFx
    rcases hF x hx hFx with h | h
    · exact Finset.mem_union_left _
        ((mem_preimageSupportFinite_toFinset_iff f D y x).mpr ⟨hx, h⟩)
    · exact Finset.mem_union_right _
        ((mem_preimageSupportFinite_toFinset_iff f E y x).mpr ⟨hx, h⟩)
  change properPushforward f (D + E) y = properPushforward f D y + properPushforward f E y
  rw [properPushforward_apply_eq_sum_of_subset f (D + E) y T (hmem _ (fun x _ h ↦ by
      by_contra hc
      push Not at hc
      apply h
      change D x + E x = 0
      rw [hc.1, hc.2, add_zero])),
    properPushforward_apply_eq_sum_of_subset f D y T (hmem _ (fun x _ h ↦ Or.inl h)),
    properPushforward_apply_eq_sum_of_subset f E y T (hmem _ (fun x _ h ↦ Or.inr h)),
    ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x _
  change (D x + E x) * _ = _
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.properPushforward_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem properPushforward_zero (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] :
    properPushforward f (0 : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  rw [properPushforward_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro x hx
  rw [mem_preimageSupportFinite_toFinset_iff] at hx
  exact (hx.2 rfl).elim

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.properPushforwardHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem properPushforwardHom_apply (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] (D : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) :
    properPushforwardHom f D = properPushforward f D
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.finrank_residueField_map_tower
proof:
:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.hom_degree_comp
statement:
theorem hom_degree_comp (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (x : X) :
    (f ≫ g).degree x = f.degree x * g.degree (f x)
proof:
:= by
  have hχ : IsLocalHom ((f ≫ g).stalkMap x).hom := inferInstance
  exact @finrank_residueField_map_tower _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (g.stalkMap (f x)).hom
    (f.stalkMap x).hom ((f ≫ g).stalkMap x).hom _ _ hχ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.properPushforward_congr
statement:
theorem properPushforward_congr {f f' : X ⟶ Y} [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiCompact f']
    (h : f = f') (D : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) : properPushforward f D = properPushforward f' D
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.properPushforward_comp
statement:
theorem properPushforward_comp (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiCompact g]
    (D : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) :
    properPushforward (f ≫ g) D = properPushforward g (properPushforward f D)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  set T := ((f ≫ g).preimageSupportFinite D z).toFinset with hTdef
  have hT : ∀ x, x ∈ T ↔ g (f x) = z ∧ D x ≠ 0 := by
    intro x
    rw [hTdef, mem_preimageSupportFinite_toFinset_iff, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  change properPushforward (f ≫ g) D z = properPushforward g (properPushforward f D) z
  rw [properPushforward_apply, ← hTdef]
  have hinner : ∀ y, g y = z → properPushforward f D y =
      ∑ x ∈ T with f x = y, D x * (f.degree x : ℤ) := by
    intro y hy
    apply properPushforward_apply_eq_sum_of_subset
    intro x hx hDx
    exact (hT x).mpr ⟨hx ▸ hy, hDx⟩
  rw [properPushforward_apply_eq_sum_of_subset g (properPushforward f D) z (T.image f)]
  · rw [Finset.filter_true_of_mem (fun y hy ↦ by
        obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
        exact ((hT x).mp hx).1)]
    calc ∑ x ∈ T, D x * ((f ≫ g).degree x : ℤ)
        = ∑ y ∈ T.image f, ∑ x ∈ T with f x = y, D x * ((f ≫ g).degree x : ℤ) :=
          (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun x hx ↦ Finset.mem_image_of_mem f hx) _).symm
      _ = ∑ y ∈ T.image f, properPushforward f D y * (g.degree y : ℤ) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro y hy
          obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
          rw [hinner _ ((hT x₀).mp hx₀).1, Finset.sum_mul]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro x hx
          rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2.symm, hom_degree_comp]
          push_cast
          ring
  · intro y hy hy0
    rw [hinner y hy] at hy0
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hy0
    obtain ⟨hxT, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hx
    exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem f hxT

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.properPushforward_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem properPushforward_id (D : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) :
    properPushforward (𝟙 X) D = D
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change properPushforward (𝟙 X) D ((𝟙 X : X ⟶ X) x) = D x
  exact pushforward_apply_closedImmersion (𝟙 X) D (fun _ : X ↦ ()) (fun _ : X ↦ ())
    (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.properPushforward_eq_pushforward_closedImmersion
statement:
theorem properPushforward_eq_pushforward_closedImmersion (j : X ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    (D : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) {N : Type*} [DecidableEq N] (wx : X → N) (wy : Y → N)
    (h : ∀ x, D x ≠ 0 → wx x = wy (j x)) :
    properPushforward j D = pushforward j D wx wy
proof:
:=
  pushforward_eq_closedImmersion j D (fun _ : X ↦ ()) (fun _ : Y ↦ ()) wx wy (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.exists_of_properPushforward_apply_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_of_properPushforward_apply_ne_zero (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f]
    (D : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) (y : Y) (hy : properPushforward f D y ≠ 0) :
    ∃ x, f x = y ∧ D x ≠ 0 ∧ f.degree x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [properPushforward_apply] at hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hy
  obtain ⟨hfx, hDx⟩ := (mem_preimageSupportFinite_toFinset_iff f D y x).mp hx
  refine ⟨x, hfx, hDx, fun h ↦ hx0 ?_⟩
  simp [h]

name: IsRegularLocalRing.exists_mem_maximalIdeal_notMem_sq
statement:
theorem exists_mem_maximalIdeal_notMem_sq [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R ≠ 0) :
    ∃ a : R, a ∈ maximalIdeal R ∧ a ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hlt : maximalIdeal R ^ 2 < maximalIdeal R :=
    maximalIdeal_sq_lt_of_ringKrullDim_ne_zero hdim
  obtain ⟨a, ha, ha2⟩ := Set.exists_of_ssubset hlt
  exact ⟨a, ha, ha2⟩

name: IsRegularLocalRing.exists_finset_span_card_eq_spanFinrank_containing
statement:
theorem exists_finset_span_card_eq_spanFinrank_containing
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [DecidableEq R]
    {a : R} (ha : a ∈ maximalIdeal R) (ha2 : a ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ 2) :
    ∃ t : Finset R, a ∈ t ∧ t.card = (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank ∧
      Submodule.span R (t : Set R) = maximalIdeal R
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set κ := ResidueField R
  set m : Ideal R := maximalIdeal R
  set V := CotangentSpace R
  let v : V := m.toCotangent ⟨a, ha⟩
  have hv : v ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Ne, Ideal.toCotangent_eq_zero]
    exact ha2
  let b := Module.finBasis κ V
  choose w hw using fun i : Fin (Module.finrank κ V) =>
    (Ideal.toCotangent_surjective m) (b i)
  obtain ⟨jIdx, hj⟩ : ∃ jIdx : Fin (Module.finrank κ V), b.repr v jIdx ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have : v = 0 := by
      rw [← b.sum_repr v]
      exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => by simp [h i]
    exact hv this
  
  have hspan_cot :
      Submodule.span κ
        (insert v (b '' (Finset.univ.erase jIdx : Set (Fin (Module.finrank κ V))))) = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff, ← b.span_eq, Submodule.span_le]
    intro yi hyi
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_range.mp hyi
    by_cases hijIdx : i = jIdx
    · have hv_eq : v = ∑ idx, b.repr v idx • b idx := (b.sum_repr v).symm
      have hdecomp :
          (∑ idx, b.repr v idx • b idx) - ∑ idx ∈ Finset.univ.erase jIdx, b.repr v idx • b idx =
            b.repr v jIdx • b jIdx := by
        rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ jIdx)]
        abel
      have hv' :
          v - ∑ idx ∈ Finset.univ.erase jIdx, b.repr v idx • b idx = b.repr v jIdx • b jIdx :=
        (congrArg (fun w =>
            w - ∑ idx ∈ Finset.univ.erase jIdx, b.repr v idx • b idx) hv_eq).trans hdecomp
      have hbj :
          b jIdx =
            (b.repr v jIdx)⁻¹ •
              (v - ∑ idx ∈ Finset.univ.erase jIdx, b.repr v idx • b idx) := by
        have hinv := congrArg (fun z => (b.repr v jIdx)⁻¹ • z) hv'
        rw [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hj, one_smul] at hinv
        exact hinv.symm
      have hv_mem :
          v ∈ Submodule.span κ
            (insert v (b '' (Finset.univ.erase jIdx : Set (Fin (Module.finrank κ V))))) :=
        Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_insert _ _)
      have hrest :
          ∀ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase jIdx,
            b i ∈ Submodule.span κ
              (insert v (b '' (Finset.univ.erase jIdx : Set (Fin (Module.finrank κ V))))) := by
        intro i hi
        refine Submodule.subset_span (Or.inr ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩)
      rw [hijIdx, hbj]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _
        (sub_mem hv_mem (sum_mem fun idx hi => Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hrest idx hi)))
    · exact Submodule.subset_span
        (Or.inr ⟨i, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hijIdx, Finset.mem_univ i⟩, rfl⟩)
  let t : Finset R :=
    insert a ((Finset.univ.erase jIdx).image fun i => (w i : R))
  let ts : Set R := (↑t : Set R)
  let tm : Set m := {y : m | (y : R) ∈ ts}
  have val_span :
      ∀ {z : m}, z ∈ Submodule.span R tm → (z : R) ∈ Submodule.span R ts := by
    intro z hz
    induction hz using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy => exact Submodule.subset_span hy
    | zero => exact zero_mem (Submodule.span R ts)
    | add u v _ _ hu hv => exact add_mem hu hv
    | smul r y _ hy => exact Submodule.smul_mem (Submodule.span R ts) r hy
  have hat : a ∈ t := Finset.mem_insert_self a _
  have ha_ts : a ∈ ts := by simpa [ts, t] using hat
  
  have hspan : Submodule.span R ts = m := by
    have htop : Submodule.span κ (m.toCotangent '' {x : m | (x : R) ∈ ts}) = ⊤ := by
      rw [eq_top_iff, ← hspan_cot, Submodule.span_le]
      intro yi hyi
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_image] at hyi
      rcases hyi with rfl | ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
      · exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ha_ts, rfl⟩
      · have hi' : (w i : R) ∈ ts := by
          have : (w i : R) ∈
              insert a ((Finset.univ.erase jIdx).image (fun j : Fin (Module.finrank κ V) => (w j : R))) :=
            Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩)
          simpa [ts, t] using this
        exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨w i, hi', hw i⟩
    have htopR : Submodule.span R tm = ⊤ := by
      rwa [← CotangentSpace.span_image_eq_top_iff]
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
      intro x hx
      have hx' : x ∈ ts := hx
      by_cases hxa : x = a
      · subst hxa; exact ha
      · have : x ∈ (Finset.univ.erase jIdx).image fun i => (w i : R) := by
          simpa [ts, t, hxa, not_false_eq_true, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_image] using hx'
        obtain ⟨i, _, heq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp this
        rw [← heq]
        exact (w i).2
    · intro x hx
      have hmem : (⟨x, hx⟩ : m) ∈ Submodule.span R tm := by
        rw [htopR]
        exact Submodule.mem_top
      exact val_span (z := ⟨x, hx⟩) hmem
  
  have hfin : Module.finrank κ V = m.spanFinrank :=
    (spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_eq_finrank_cotangentSpace (R := R)).symm
  have hcard_le : t.card ≤ Module.finrank κ V := by
    have hpos : 0 < Module.finrank κ V := by
      rw [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero, ne_eq, finrank_cotangentSpace_eq_zero_iff]
      intro hf
      have hmbot : m = ⊥ := isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq.mp hf
      have ha0 : a = 0 := Ideal.mem_bot.mp (hmbot ▸ ha)
      exact ha2 (by simp [ha0])
    have hle : t.card ≤ (Finset.univ.erase jIdx).card + 1 := by
      rw [show t = insert a ((Finset.univ.erase jIdx).image fun i => (w i : R)) from rfl]
      calc
        (insert a ((Finset.univ.erase jIdx).image fun i => (w i : R))).card
            ≤ ((Finset.univ.erase jIdx).image fun i => (w i : R)).card + 1 :=
          Finset.card_insert_le a _
        _ ≤ (Finset.univ.erase jIdx).card + 1 := Nat.add_le_add_right Finset.card_image_le 1
    have herase : (Finset.univ.erase jIdx).card + 1 = Module.finrank κ V := by
      have hpos' : 0 < Module.finrank κ V := hpos
      simp [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ jIdx), Fintype.card_fin,
        Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.succ_le_iff.mp hpos')]
    exact Nat.le_trans hle (Nat.le_of_eq herase)
  have hcard_ge : m.spanFinrank ≤ t.card := by
    rw [← hspan]
    exact (Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_ncard_of_finite t.finite_toSet).trans
      (le_of_eq (Set.ncard_coe_finset (s := t)))
  refine ⟨t, hat, ?_, hspan⟩
  omega

name: IsRegularLocalRing.quotient_span_singleton_isRegularLocalRing
statement:
theorem quotient_span_singleton_isRegularLocalRing [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    [DecidableEq R]
    {a : R} (ha : a ∈ maximalIdeal R) (ha2 : a ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ 2) :
    IsRegularLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {a})
proof:
:= by
  let Q := R ⧸ Ideal.span {a}
  letI : IsLocalRing Q := ModuleCat.quotientSpanIsLocalRing R a ha
  letI : IsNoetherianRing Q := Ideal.Quotient.isNoetherianRing _
  letI : DecidableEq Q := Classical.decEq Q
  obtain ⟨t, hat, hcard, hspan⟩ :=
    exists_finset_span_card_eq_spanFinrank_containing (R := R) ha ha2
  let t₀ : Finset Q := (t.erase a).image (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a}))
  have hmap :
      (maximalIdeal R).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a})) = maximalIdeal Q :=
    map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hspanQ : Ideal.span (t₀ : Set Q) = maximalIdeal Q := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · refine Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_
      intro x hx
      rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hx with ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      have : Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a}) y ∈
          (maximalIdeal R).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a})) :=
        Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _
          (by
            rw [← hspan]
            exact Submodule.subset_span (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hy))
      rwa [hmap] at this
    · rw [← hmap, ← hspan, Ideal.map_span]
      refine Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_
      rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      by_cases hya : y = a
      · rw [show Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a}) y = 0 from by
          rw [hya, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
          exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self a]
        exact Ideal.zero_mem (Ideal.span (t₀ : Set Q))
      · exact Ideal.subset_span
          (show Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a}) y ∈ (t₀ : Set Q) from
            Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨y, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hya, hy⟩, rfl⟩)
  have hspanFin_le :
      (maximalIdeal Q).spanFinrank ≤ Nat.sub (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank 1 := by
    have hle : (Ideal.span (t₀ : Set Q)).spanFinrank ≤ t₀.card :=
      (Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_ncard_of_finite t₀.finite_toSet).trans_eq (by simp)
    have hle' : (maximalIdeal Q).spanFinrank ≤ t₀.card := by
      rwa [← hspanQ]
    have hcard₀ : t₀.card ≤ Nat.sub t.card 1 := by
      have := Finset.card_image_le (s := t.erase a)
        (f := Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a}))
      rwa [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hat] at this
    have hcard₁ : Nat.sub t.card 1 = Nat.sub (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank 1 := by rw [hcard]
    exact Nat.le_trans hle' (hcard₀.trans (Nat.le_of_eq hcard₁))
  have hdim_le : ringKrullDim R ≤ ringKrullDim Q + 1 := by
    have h := ringKrullDim_le_ringKrullDim_quotSMulTop_succ (x := a) ha
    have hI : Ideal.span {a} = a • (⊤ : Ideal R) := by simp [← Submodule.ideal_span_singleton_smul]
    rw [show ringKrullDim (R ⧸ a • (⊤ : Ideal R)) = ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span {a}) from
      ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq R hI).symm.toRingEquiv] at h
    simpa [Q] using h
  have hdpos : 1 ≤ (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank := by
    by_contra h
    have h0 : (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank = 0 := by omega
    have hmbot : maximalIdeal R = ⊥ :=
      (Submodule.spanFinrank_eq_zero_iff_eq_bot (IsNoetherian.noetherian _)).1 h0
    have ha0 : a = 0 := Ideal.mem_bot.mp (hmbot ▸ ha)
    exact ha2 (by simp [ha0])
  have hdimQ_ge : ↑(Nat.sub (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank 1) ≤ ringKrullDim Q := by
    have hpos : 0 < IsRegularLocalRing.embeddingDimension R := by
      rw [IsRegularLocalRing.embeddingDimension]
      exact hdpos
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' hpos
    have hn1 : IsRegularLocalRing.embeddingDimension R = n + 1 := by
      simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using hn
    have this : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ ringKrullDim Q + 1 := by
      have h := hdim_le
      rw [← IsRegularLocalRing.coe_embeddingDimension_eq_ringKrullDim, hn1] at h
      exact h
    have hstep : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim Q :=
      ENat.WithBot.add_le_add_natCast_right_iff.mp this
    have hsub : Nat.sub (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank 1 = n := by
      rw [show (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank = n + 1 from
        by rw [← IsRegularLocalRing.embeddingDimension, hn1]]
      rfl
    rw [hsub]
    exact_mod_cast hstep
  exact IsRegularLocalRing.of_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_le (R := Q) <|
    (Nat.cast_le.mpr hspanFin_le).trans hdimQ_ge

name: IsRegularLocalRing.isField_of_ringKrullDim_eq_zero
statement:
theorem isField_of_ringKrullDim_eq_zero [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R = 0) : IsField R
proof:
:= by
  have hspan : (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank = 0 := by
    have := IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R := R)
    rw [hdim] at this
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hm : maximalIdeal R = ⊥ :=
    (Submodule.spanFinrank_eq_zero_iff_eq_bot (IsNoetherian.noetherian _)).1 hspan
  exact isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq.mpr hm

name: IsRegularLocalRing.exists_generator_maximalIdeal_of_ringKrullDim_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_generator_maximalIdeal_of_ringKrullDim_eq_one [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R = 1) :
    ∃ ϖ : R, maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span {ϖ} ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, ϖ ^ n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hfin : Module.finrank (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) = 1 := by
    have := (iff_finrank_cotangentSpace (R := R)).mp inferInstance
    rw [hdim] at this
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hprin : (maximalIdeal R).IsPrincipal :=
    finrank_cotangentSpace_le_one_iff.mp (by omega)
  obtain ⟨ϖ, hϖ⟩ := hprin.principal
  refine ⟨ϖ, hϖ, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have hpow : maximalIdeal R ^ n = ⊥ := by
    rw [hϖ, Ideal.span_singleton_pow, hn, span_singleton_eq_bot.mpr rfl]
  have hArt : IsArtinianRing R :=
    (isArtinianRing_iff_isNilpotent_maximalIdeal R).mpr ⟨n, hpow⟩
  have h0 : Ring.KrullDimLE 0 R :=
    (isArtinianRing_iff_krullDimLE_zero (R := R)).mp hArt
  have hle0 : ringKrullDim R ≤ 0 := (Ring.krullDimLE_iff (n := 0)).mp h0
  rw [hdim] at hle0
  exact absurd hle0 (by decide)

name: IsRegularLocalRing.exists_unit_mul_pow_eq_of_ringKrullDim_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_unit_mul_pow_eq_of_ringKrullDim_eq_one [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R = 1) {ϖ : R}
    (hϖ : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span {ϖ}) {a : R} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (u : Rˣ) (k : ℕ), a = u * ϖ ^ k
proof:
:= by
  have hiInf : ⨅ n : ℕ, maximalIdeal R ^ n = ⊥ :=
    Ideal.iInf_pow_eq_bot_of_isLocalRing _ (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top
  have hex : ∃ n : ℕ, a ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ n := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have : a ∈ ⨅ n : ℕ, maximalIdeal R ^ n := by simp [h]
    rw [hiInf] at this
    exact ha (by simpa using this)
  classical
  let k := Nat.find hex
  have hk_not : a ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ k := Nat.find_spec hex
  have hk_pos : 0 < k := by
    rcases k with - | k
    · exfalso
      have : a ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ 0 := by simp [pow_zero]
      exact hk_not this
    · omega
  have hk_mem : a ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ (k - 1) := by
    have : ¬a ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ (k - 1) :=
      Nat.find_min hex (Nat.sub_lt hk_pos (by decide))
    simpa using this
  have : a ∈ Ideal.span {ϖ ^ (k - 1)} := by
    rwa [hϖ, Ideal.span_singleton_pow] at hk_mem
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp this
  have hr_unit : IsUnit r := by
    rw [← notMem_maximalIdeal]
    intro hrm
    have : a ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ k := by
      have hr' : r ∈ Ideal.span {ϖ} := by simpa [hϖ] using hrm
      obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hr'
      have hx : a = s * ϖ ^ k := by
        calc a
            _ = ϖ ^ (k - 1) * r := hr
            _ = ϖ ^ (k - 1) * (ϖ * s) := by rw [hs]
            _ = s * ϖ ^ k := by
              rw [← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel hk_pos]
              exact (mul_comm s (ϖ ^ k)).symm
      rw [hx, hϖ, Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem (Ideal.span {ϖ ^ k}) s (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self (ϖ ^ k))
    exact hk_not this
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hr_unit
  exact ⟨u, k - 1, by rw [hr, hu, mul_comm]⟩

name: IsRegularLocalRing.isDomain_of_ringKrullDim_le_one
statement:
theorem isDomain_of_ringKrullDim_le_one [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R ≤ 1) : IsDomain R
proof:
:= by
  have hspan_eq : ((maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R :=
    IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal
  have hle : (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank ≤ 1 := by
    have : ((maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ 1 := hspan_eq ▸ hdim
    exact_mod_cast this
  rcases Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one.mp hle with hcard | hcard
  · have h0 : ringKrullDim R = 0 := by
      rw [← hspan_eq, hcard]; rfl
    exact (isField_of_ringKrullDim_eq_zero h0).isDomain
  · have h1 : ringKrullDim R = 1 := by
      rw [← hspan_eq, hcard]; rfl
    obtain ⟨ϖ, hϖ, hpow⟩ := exists_generator_maximalIdeal_of_ringKrullDim_eq_one h1
    have : NoZeroDivisors R := by
      refine ⟨fun {a b} hab => ?_⟩
      by_cases ha0 : a = 0
      · exact Or.inl ha0
      by_cases hb0 : b = 0
      · exact Or.inr hb0
      obtain ⟨u, i, rfl⟩ := exists_unit_mul_pow_eq_of_ringKrullDim_eq_one h1 hϖ ha0
      obtain ⟨v, j, rfl⟩ := exists_unit_mul_pow_eq_of_ringKrullDim_eq_one h1 hϖ hb0
      have hprod : (u * v : R) * ϖ ^ (i + j) = 0 := by
        convert hab using 1
        ring
      have : ϖ ^ (i + j) = 0 :=
        (IsUnit.mul_right_eq_zero (IsUnit.mul u.isUnit v.isUnit)).mp hprod
      exact absurd this (hpow _)
    exact NoZeroDivisors.to_isDomain R

name: IsRegularLocalRing.isDomain
statement: theorem isDomain [IsRegularLocalRing R] (hdim : ringKrullDim R ≤ 1) : IsDomain R
proof:
:=
  isDomain_of_ringKrullDim_le_one hdim

name: ModuleCat.coe_localKrullDim
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_localKrullDim :
    (localKrullDim R : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim R
proof:
:=
  WithBot.coe_unbot _ _

name: ModuleCat.IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.exists_isWeaklyRegular
statement:
theorem IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.exists_isWeaklyRegular
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing R]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ localKrullDim R) :
    ∃ rs : List R, rs.length = n ∧
      (∀ r ∈ rs, r ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) ∧ IsWeaklyRegular R rs
proof:
:= by
  have hn' : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ ringDepth R := by
    rw [IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.depth_eq_dimension]
    exact hn
  change (n : ℕ∞) ≤ localDepth (ModuleCat.of R R) at hn'
  rw [natCast_le_localDepth_iff_exists_isWeaklyRegular] at hn'
  exact hn'

name: ModuleCat.IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.exists_isSMulRegular
statement:
theorem IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.exists_isSMulRegular
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing R]
    (hpos : (1 : ℕ∞) ≤ localKrullDim R) :
    ∃ r : R, r ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R ∧ IsSMulRegular R r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨rs, hrs, hmem, hreg⟩ :=
    IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.exists_isWeaklyRegular R 1 hpos
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := List.length_eq_one_iff.mp hrs
  refine ⟨r, hmem r (by simp), ?_⟩
  exact (isWeaklyRegular_singleton_iff R r).mp hreg

name: ModuleCat.ringDepth_le_localKrullDim
statement:
theorem ringDepth_le_localKrullDim [IsNoetherianRing R] :
    ringDepth R ≤ localKrullDim R
proof:
:= by
  refine ENat.forall_natCast_le_iff_le.mp fun n hn ↦ ?_
  change (n : ℕ∞) ≤ localDepth (ModuleCat.of R R) at hn
  rw [natCast_le_localDepth_iff_exists_isWeaklyRegular] at hn
  obtain ⟨rs, hrs, hmem, hreg⟩ := hn
  have hregular : IsRegular R rs :=
    IsRegular.of_isWeaklyRegular_of_mem_maximalIdeal R hmem hreg
  haveI : Nontrivial (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList rs) := by
    apply Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr
    have hle : Ideal.ofList rs ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R :=
      Ideal.span_le.mpr hmem
    exact (hle.trans_lt (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).lt_top).ne
  have hdim := ringKrullDim_add_length_eq_ringKrullDim_of_isRegular rs hregular
  have hnonneg : (0 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList rs) :=
    ringKrullDim_nonneg_of_nontrivial
  have hdimn :
      ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList rs) + (n : WithBot ℕ∞) =
        ringKrullDim R := by
    simpa [hrs] using hdim
  have hn' : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R := by
    rw [← hdimn]
    simpa [add_comm] using add_le_add_left hnonneg (n : WithBot ℕ∞)
  have hn'' : ((n : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤
      (localKrullDim R : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    rw [coe_localKrullDim]
    exact hn'
  exact WithBot.coe_le_coe.mp hn''

name: ModuleCat.natCast_le_ringDepth_quotient_of_natCast_le_depth_quotSMulTop
statement:
theorem natCast_le_ringDepth_quotient_of_natCast_le_depth_quotSMulTop
    [IsNoetherianRing R] (r : R) (hrm : r ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) (n : ℕ)
    (h : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ depth (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
      (ModuleCat.of R (QuotSMulTop r R))) :
    (n : ℕ∞) ≤ @ringDepth (R ⧸ Ideal.span {r}) _
      (quotientSpanIsLocalRing R r hrm)
proof:
:= by
  let Q := R ⧸ Ideal.span {r}
  letI : IsLocalRing Q := quotientSpanIsLocalRing R r hrm
  letI : IsLocalHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {r})) :=
    IsLocalHom.of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  letI : Nontrivial (QuotSMulTop r R) :=
    nontrivial_quotSMulTop_of_mem_maximalIdeal R hrm
  have smul_lt : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R •
      (⊤ : Submodule R (QuotSMulTop r R)) < ⊤ := by
    rw [lt_top_iff_ne_top]
    exact (Submodule.top_ne_ideal_smul_of_le_jacobson_annihilator
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_le_jacobson
        (Module.annihilator R (QuotSMulTop r R)))).symm
  rw [natCast_le_depth_iff_exists_isRegular
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) _ smul_lt n] at h
  obtain ⟨rs, hrs, hmem, hreg⟩ := h
  let e : QuotSMulTop r R ≃ₗ[R] Q :=
    Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ (by
      rw [← Submodule.ideal_span_singleton_smul]
      simp)
  have hregR : IsWeaklyRegular Q rs :=
    (e.isWeaklyRegular_congr rs).mp hreg.toIsWeaklyRegular
  have hregQ : IsWeaklyRegular Q
      (rs.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {r}))) :=
    (isWeaklyRegular_map_algebraMap_iff Q Q rs).mpr hregR
  have hmemQ : ∀ q ∈ rs.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {r})),
      q ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Q := by
    intro q hq
    rcases List.mem_map.mp hq with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    exact map_nonunit (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {r})) a (hmem a ha)
  rw [ringDepth, natCast_le_localDepth_iff_exists_isWeaklyRegular]
  exact ⟨rs.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {r})), by simp [hrs], hmemQ, hregQ⟩

name: ModuleCat.natCast_le_ringDepth_quotient_of_succ_le_ringDepth
statement:
theorem natCast_le_ringDepth_quotient_of_succ_le_ringDepth [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (r : R) (hrm : r ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) (hr : IsSMulRegular R r) (n : ℕ)
    (h : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ ringDepth R) :
    (n : ℕ∞) ≤ @ringDepth (R ⧸ Ideal.span {r}) _
      (quotientSpanIsLocalRing R r hrm)
proof:
:= by
  apply natCast_le_ringDepth_quotient_of_natCast_le_depth_quotSMulTop R r hrm n
  apply natCast_le_depth_quotSMulTop_of_succ_le_depth
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) (ModuleCat.of R R) r hr n
  simpa [ringDepth, localDepth] using h

name: ModuleCat.localKrullDim_quotient_add_one
statement:
theorem localKrullDim_quotient_add_one [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (r : R) (hrm : r ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) (hr : IsSMulRegular R r) :
    @localKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span {r}) _ (quotientSpanIsLocalRing R r hrm) + 1 =
      localKrullDim R
proof:
:= by
  let Q := R ⧸ Ideal.span {r}
  letI : IsLocalRing Q := quotientSpanIsLocalRing R r hrm
  have hweak : IsWeaklyRegular R [r] :=
    (isWeaklyRegular_singleton_iff R r).mpr hr
  have hregular : IsRegular R [r] :=
    IsRegular.of_isWeaklyRegular_of_mem_maximalIdeal R (by simpa using hrm) hweak
  have hdim : ringKrullDim Q + 1 = ringKrullDim R := by
    have h := ringKrullDim_add_length_eq_ringKrullDim_of_isRegular [r] hregular
    rw [Ideal.ofList_singleton] at h
    exact h
  apply WithBot.coe_injective
  simpa only [WithBot.coe_add, WithBot.coe_one, coe_localKrullDim] using hdim

name: ModuleCat.IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.quotient_span_singleton
statement:
theorem IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.quotient_span_singleton [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing R]
    (r : R) (hrm : r ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) (hr : IsSMulRegular R r) :
    @IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {r}) _
      (quotientSpanIsLocalRing R r hrm)
proof:
:= by
  let Q := R ⧸ Ideal.span {r}
  letI : IsLocalRing Q := quotientSpanIsLocalRing R r hrm
  constructor
  apply le_antisymm (ringDepth_le_localKrullDim Q)
  refine ENat.forall_natCast_le_iff_le.mp fun n hn ↦ ?_
  have hn' : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ localKrullDim Q + 1 := by
    simpa using add_le_add_right hn 1
  rw [localKrullDim_quotient_add_one R r hrm hr,
    ← IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.depth_eq_dimension (R := R)] at hn'
  exact natCast_le_ringDepth_quotient_of_succ_le_ringDepth R r hrm hr n hn'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.cycle_support_finite
statement:
private theorem cycle_support_finite {X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X]

proof:
:= by

    CompactSpace.isCompact_univ
