      bs.ext_elem (fun i => absurd ⟨i⟩ hemp)
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hz0
  have hsub : Subsingleton (Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex R (p : Submodule R R)) := by
    refine ⟨fun i j => ?_⟩
    by_contra hij
    have hli := bs.linearIndependent
    set l : Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex R (p : Submodule R R) →₀ R :=
      Finsupp.single i ((bs j : (p : Submodule R R)) : R) -
        Finsupp.single j ((bs i : (p : Submodule R R)) : R) with hl
    have hlc : Finsupp.linearCombination R bs l = 0 := by
      rw [hl]
      simp only [map_sub, Finsupp.linearCombination_single, sub_eq_zero]
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp only [SetLike.val_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    have hl0 := linearIndependent_iff.mp hli l hlc
    have hbj : ((bs j : (p : Submodule R R)) : R) = 0 := by
      have h2 := congrArg (fun t => t i) hl0
      simpa [hl, Finsupp.single_apply, hij, Ne.symm hij] using h2
    exact bs.ne_zero j (Subtype.ext hbj)
  obtain ⟨i⟩ := hne
  refine ⟨⟨((bs i : (p : Submodule R R)) : R), ?_⟩⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro z hz
    have hmem : (⟨z, hz⟩ : (p : Submodule R R)) ∈ Submodule.span R (Set.range bs) := by
      rw [bs.span_eq]; trivial
    have hrange : Set.range bs = {bs i} := by
      ext y
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨j, rfl⟩; rw [Subsingleton.elim j i]; rfl
      · rintro rfl; exact ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [hrange, Submodule.mem_span_singleton] at hmem
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hmem
    refine Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr ⟨r, ?_⟩
    have h3 := congrArg Subtype.val hr
    simpa [Algebra.smul_def, mul_comm] using h3.symm
  · rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    exact (bs i).2

name: IsRegularLocalRing.exists_koszul_data
statement:
theorem exists_koszul_data [IsRegularLocalRing R] (hdim : ringKrullDim R = 2)
    (p : Ideal R) [hp : p.IsPrime] (hph : p.height = 1) :
    ∃ a b : R, maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span {a, b} ∧ a ∉ p ∧
      ∀ v : R, a ∣ b * v → a ∣ v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : DecidableEq R := Classical.decEq R
  haveI : IsDomain R := isDomain_of_isRegularLocalRing R
  have hdim0 : ringKrullDim R ≠ 0 := by rw [hdim]; decide
  have hsq : maximalIdeal R ^ 2 < maximalIdeal R :=
    maximalIdeal_sq_lt_of_ringKrullDim_ne_zero hdim0
  have hple : p ≤ maximalIdeal R := IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal_of_isPrime p
  have hpne : p ≠ maximalIdeal R := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hph
    rw [← IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim, hph] at hdim
    exact absurd hdim (by decide)
  have havoid : ¬ ((maximalIdeal R : Set R) ⊆ (maximalIdeal R ^ 2 : Ideal R) ∪ (p : Set R)) := by
    rw [Ideal.subset_union]
    rintro (h | h)
    · exact absurd (le_antisymm h hsq.le) (by simpa using hsq.ne')
    · exact hpne (le_antisymm hple h)
  obtain ⟨a, hamem, hanot⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp havoid
  have ha2 : a ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ 2 := fun h => hanot (Or.inl h)
  have hap : a ∉ p := fun h => hanot (Or.inr h)
  
  obtain ⟨t, hat, hcard, hspan⟩ :=
    exists_finset_span_card_eq_spanFinrank_containing (R := R) hamem ha2
  have hrank : (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank = 2 := by
    have h := IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R := R)
    rw [hdim] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  rw [hrank] at hcard
  obtain ⟨x, y, hxy, rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.mp hcard
  obtain ⟨b, hab⟩ : ∃ b : R, Submodule.span R (({x, y} : Finset R) : Set R)
      = Ideal.span {a, b} := by
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hat with rfl | hay
    · exact ⟨y, by simp [Ideal.span]⟩
    · rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hay
      subst hay
      exact ⟨x, by simp [Ideal.span, Set.pair_comm]⟩
  have hm : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span {a, b} := by rw [← hspan, hab]
  
  have hbspan : b ∉ Ideal.span ({a} : Set R) := by
    intro hb
    have hle : maximalIdeal R ≤ Ideal.span ({a} : Set R) := by
      rw [hm, Ideal.span_le]
      rintro z (rfl | rfl)
      · exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
      · exact hb
    have heq : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span ({a} : Set R) :=
      le_antisymm hle (by rw [hm]; exact Ideal.span_mono (by simp))
    have : (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank ≤ 1 := by
      rw [heq]
      simpa only [← Set.ncard_singleton a] using
        Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_ncard_of_finite (Set.finite_singleton a)
    omega
  
  refine ⟨a, b, hm, hap, fun v hv => ?_⟩
  haveI : IsRegularLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({a} : Set R)) :=
    quotient_span_singleton_isRegularLocalRing hamem ha2
  haveI : IsDomain (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({a} : Set R)) := isDomain_of_isRegularLocalRing _
  have hbq : (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({a} : Set R)) b) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem] using hbspan
  have hmul : (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({a} : Set R)) b) *
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span ({a} : Set R)) v) = 0 := by
    rw [← map_mul]
    exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr hv)
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hmul with h | h
  · exact absurd h hbq
  · exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp h)

name: IsRegularLocalRing.isPrincipal_of_height_one
statement:
theorem isPrincipal_of_height_one [IsRegularLocalRing R] (hdim : ringKrullDim R = 2)
    (p : Ideal R) [hp : p.IsPrime] (hph : p.height = 1) : Submodule.IsPrincipal p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : IsDomain R := isDomain_of_isRegularLocalRing R
  obtain ⟨a, b, hm, hap, hbdvd⟩ := exists_koszul_data hdim p hph
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := fun h => hap (h ▸ p.zero_mem)
  have hp0 : p ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro h
    rw [h, Ideal.height_bot] at hph
    exact absurd hph (by decide)
  haveI : Module.Finite R (p : Submodule R R) :=
    Module.Finite.iff_fg.mpr (IsNoetherian.noetherian p)
  haveI : Module.FinitePresentation R (p : Submodule R R) :=
    Module.finitePresentation_of_finite R _
  haveI : Module.Free R (p : Submodule R R) :=
    Module.free_of_maximalIdeal_rTensor_injective
      (maximalIdeal_rTensor_injective_of_prime ha0 hbdvd hm p hap)
  exact isPrincipal_of_free p hp0

name: IsRegularLocalRing.isDiscreteValuationRing_localization_height_one
statement:
theorem isDiscreteValuationRing_localization_height_one (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    [IsRegularLocalRing R] (hdim : ringKrullDim R = 2)
    (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime] (hph : p.height = 1) :
    letI
proof:
:= isDomain_of_isRegularLocalRing R
    IsDiscreteValuationRing (Localization.AtPrime p) := by
  classical
  letI : IsDomain R := isDomain_of_isRegularLocalRing R
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := (isPrincipal_of_height_one hdim p hph).principal
  haveI : IsRegularLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime p) := by
    apply IsRegularLocalRing.of_spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_le
    have hmap : maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime p)
        = Ideal.span {algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p) f} := by
      rw [← Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal]
      have hps := congrArg (Ideal.map (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p))) hf
      rw [hps, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
    rw [ringKrullDim_localizationAtPrime_eq_one_of_height_eq_one p hph, hmap]
    simpa only [Nat.cast_le_one,
      ← Set.ncard_singleton (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p) f)] using
      Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_ncard_of_finite
        (Set.finite_singleton (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p) f))
  exact isDiscreteValuationRing_localizationAtPrime_of_height_one_of_regular p hph

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.ringKrullDim_quotient_eq_one
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_eq_one (hR : ringKrullDim R ≤ 2) (P : Ideal R) [P.IsPrime]
    (hPm : P ≠ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) {r : R} (hr : r ∈ P) (hr0 : r ≠ 0) :
    ringKrullDim (R ⧸ P) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hPtop : P ≠ ⊤ := Ideal.IsPrime.ne_top inferInstance
  haveI : Nontrivial (R ⧸ P) := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hPtop
  have h1 : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ P) + 1 ≤ ringKrullDim R :=
    ringKrullDim_succ_le_of_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mk P) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
      (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hr0) (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hr)
  have h0 : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ P) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    haveI : Ring.KrullDimLE 0 (R ⧸ P) := (ringKrullDimZero_iff_ringKrullDim_eq_zero).mpr h
    have hfield : IsField (R ⧸ P) := Ring.KrullDimLE.isField_of_isDomain
    have hmax : P.IsMaximal := Ideal.Quotient.maximal_of_isField P hfield
    exact hPm (IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hmax)
  have hnn : 0 ≤ ringKrullDim (R ⧸ P) := ringKrullDim_nonneg_of_nontrivial
  have h2 : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ P) + 1 ≤ 2 := h1.trans hR
  generalize ringKrullDim (R ⧸ P) = d at h0 hnn h2 ⊢
  induction d using WithBot.recBotCoe with
  | bot => exact absurd hnn (by simp)
  | coe e =>
    induction e using ENat.recTopCoe with
    | top =>
      exfalso
      have h3 : (⊤ : ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ 2 :=
        WithBot.coe_le_coe.mp (by rw [WithBot.coe_add, WithBot.coe_one]; exact h2)
      simp at h3
    | coe n =>
      have h3 : (n : ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ 2 :=
        WithBot.coe_le_coe.mp (by rw [WithBot.coe_add, WithBot.coe_one]; exact h2)
      have h4 : n + 1 ≤ 2 := by exact_mod_cast h3
      have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by
        rintro rfl
        exact h0 rfl
      have : n = 1 := by omega
      subst this
      rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.exists_fraction_avoiding
statement:
theorem exists_fraction_avoiding [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (hchain : ∀ q P : Ideal R, q.IsPrime → P.IsPrime → ⊥ < q → q < P →
      P < IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R → False)
    {a : R} (ha : a ≠ 0) {f : K} (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (hunit : ∀ q : Ideal R, q.IsPrime → q ≠ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R → a ∈ q →
      ∃ s t : R, s ∉ q ∧ t ∉ q ∧ algebraMap R K t * f = algebraMap R K s) :
    ∃ s t : R, s ≠ 0 ∧ t ≠ 0 ∧ algebraMap R K t * f = algebraMap R K s ∧
      (∀ P : Ideal R, P.IsPrime → a ∈ P → s ∈ P → P = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) ∧
      (∀ P : Ideal R, P.IsPrime → a ∈ P → t ∈ P → P = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set m := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R
  set S : Set (Ideal R) := {q | q ∈ (Ideal.span {a}).minimalPrimes ∧ q ≠ m} with hSdef
  have hSfin : S.Finite :=
    (Ideal.finite_minimalPrimes_of_isNoetherianRing R _).subset fun q hq ↦ hq.1
  let T : Finset (Ideal R) := insert ⊥ hSfin.toFinset
  have hprime : ∀ i ∈ T, i ≠ ⊥ → i ≠ ⊥ → (id i).IsPrime := by
    intro i hi hi₁ _
    rw [Finset.mem_insert] at hi
    rcases hi with rfl | hi
    · exact (hi₁ rfl).elim
    · exact ((Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).mp hi).1.1.1
  have hnot : ¬ ∃ i ∈ T, denomIdeal R f ≤ id i := by
    rintro ⟨i, hi, hle⟩
    rw [Finset.mem_insert] at hi
    rcases hi with rfl | hi
    · obtain ⟨⟨s, t⟩, ht⟩ := IsLocalization.surj (nonZeroDivisors R) f
      have hmem : (t : R) ∈ denomIdeal R f := ⟨s, by rw [mul_comm]; exact ht⟩
      have h0 := hle hmem
      rw [id, Ideal.mem_bot] at h0
      exact nonZeroDivisors.coe_ne_zero t h0
    · rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at hi
      obtain ⟨s', t', -, ht', he⟩ := hunit i hi.1.1.1 hi.2
        (hi.1.1.2 (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self a))
      exact ht' (hle ⟨s', he⟩)
  have hJ := mt (Ideal.subset_union_prime (s := T) (f := id) ⊥ ⊥ hprime).mp hnot
  obtain ⟨t, htJ, htU⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp hJ
  obtain ⟨s, hts⟩ := htJ
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, SetLike.mem_coe, id, exists_prop, not_exists, not_and] at htU
  have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ htU ⊥ (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _) (by rw [h]; exact Ideal.zero_mem _)
  have htS : ∀ q ∈ S, t ∉ q := fun q hq ↦
    htU q (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem ((Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).mpr hq))
  have hinj := IsFractionRing.injective R K
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [map_zero, mul_eq_zero] at hts
    rcases hts with h | h
    · exact ht0 (hinj (by rw [h, map_zero]))
    · exact hf h
  
  have key : ∀ P : Ideal R, P.IsPrime → a ∈ P → P ≠ m → P ∈ S := by
    intro P hP haP hPm
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hqP⟩ := Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_le
      ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem P).mpr haP)
    have hqprime : q.IsPrime := hq.1.1
    have hqm : q ≠ m := by
      intro h
      apply hPm
      exact le_antisymm (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal hP.ne_top) (h ▸ hqP)
    have hqbot : ⊥ < q := by
      rw [bot_lt_iff_ne_bot]
      intro h
      apply ha
      have := hq.1.2 (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self a)
      rwa [h, Ideal.mem_bot] at this
    have hPq : P = q := by
      by_contra hne
      exact hchain q P hqprime hP hqbot (lt_of_le_of_ne hqP (Ne.symm hne))
        (lt_of_le_of_ne (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal hP.ne_top) hPm)
    rw [hPq]
    exact ⟨hq, hqm⟩
  refine ⟨s, t, hs0, ht0, hts, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro P hP haP hsP
    by_contra hPm
    have hPS := key P hP haP hPm
    obtain ⟨s', t', hs', ht', he⟩ := hunit P hP hPm haP
    have hmul : t' * s = t * s' := by
      apply hinj
      rw [map_mul, map_mul, ← hts, ← he]
      ring
    have : t * s' ∈ P := by
      rw [← hmul]
      exact P.mul_mem_left _ hsP
    rcases hP.mem_or_mem this with h | h
    · exact htS P hPS h
    · exact hs' h
  · intro P hP haP htP
    by_contra hPm
    exact htS P (key P hP haP hPm) htP

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.finsum_enat_eq_coe_finsum_toNat
statement:
theorem finsum_enat_eq_coe_finsum_toNat {α : Type*} (φ : α → ℕ∞) (hfin : (support φ).Finite)
    (htop : ∀ x, φ x ≠ ⊤) :
    ∑ᶠ x, φ x = ((∑ᶠ x, (φ x).toNat : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  have hsupp : HasFiniteSupport fun x ↦ (φ x).toNat := by
    refine hfin.subset fun x hx ↦ ?_
    intro h
    apply hx
    simp [h]
  have := (Nat.castAddMonoidHom ℕ∞).map_finsum hsupp
  simp only [Nat.coe_castAddMonoidHom] at this
  rw [this]
  exact finsum_congr fun x ↦ (ENat.coe_toNat (htop x)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.finsum_eq_finsum_subtype
statement:
theorem finsum_eq_finsum_subtype {α : Type*} (F : α → ℤ) (p : α → Prop)
    (h : ∀ x, F x ≠ 0 → p x) : ∑ᶠ x, F x = ∑ᶠ x : {x // p x}, F x
proof:
:= by
  rw [finsum_subtype_eq_finsum_cond, ← finsum_mem_univ]
  change ∑ᶠ i ∈ Set.univ, F i = ∑ᶠ i ∈ {i | p i}, F i
  exact finsum_mem_inter_support_eq' _ _ _ fun x hx ↦ by
    simp only [Set.mem_univ, Set.mem_setOf_eq, true_iff]
    exact h x hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.algebraMap_stalkSpecializes
statement:
theorem algebraMap_stalkSpecializes {x y : W} (h : x ⤳ y) (r : W.presheaf.stalk y) :
    algebraMap (W.presheaf.stalk x) W.functionField ((W.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom r) =
      algebraMap (W.presheaf.stalk y) W.functionField r
proof:
:= by
  simp only [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
  rw [← RingHom.comp_apply, ← CommRingCat.hom_comp, TopCat.Presheaf.stalkSpecializes_comp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.restrictHom_stalkSpecializes
statement:
theorem restrictHom_stalkSpecializes (w : W) (z : pointClosureScheme w)
    (c : W.presheaf.stalk (pointClosureι w z)) :
    restrictHom w ((W.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι w z)).hom c) =
      algebraMap _ (pointClosureScheme w).functionField (((pointClosureι w).stalkMap z).hom c)
proof:
:= by
  set η := pointClosureGenericPoint w
  have hη : η ⤳ z := (pointClosureGenericPoint_isGeneric w).specializes (Set.mem_univ z)
  have h₁ : pointClosureι w η ⤳ w := by rw [pointClosureι_genericPoint]
  have e1 : (W.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h₁).hom
      ((W.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι w z)).hom c) =
      (W.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (h₁.trans (C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι w z))).hom c := by
    rw [← RingHom.comp_apply, ← CommRingCat.hom_comp, TopCat.Presheaf.stalkSpecializes_comp]
  have e2 : ((pointClosureι w).stalkMap η).hom
      ((W.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (h₁.trans (C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι w z))).hom c) =
      ((pointClosureScheme w).presheaf.stalkSpecializes hη).hom
        (((pointClosureι w).stalkMap z).hom c) :=
    (pointClosureι w).stalkSpecializes_stalkMap_apply η z hη c
  unfold restrictHom
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
  rw [e1, e2, algebraMap_stalkSpecializes]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.restrictFun_ne_zero
statement: theorem restrictFun_ne_zero (f : W.functionField) (w : W) : restrictFun f w ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold restrictFun
  split_ifs with h
  · exact (h.choose_spec.1.map (restrictHom w)).ne_zero
  · exact one_ne_zero

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.ord_restrictFun
statement:
theorem ord_restrictFun [IsLocallyNoetherian W] (f : W.functionField) (w : W)
    (hu : IsUnitAt f w) (z : pointClosureScheme w) (hz : coheight z = 1)
    (s t : W.presheaf.stalk (pointClosureι w z))
    (hs : s ∉ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι w z))
    (ht : t ∉ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι w z))
    (hst : algebraMap _ W.functionField t * f = algebraMap _ W.functionField s) :
    (pointClosureScheme w).ord (restrictFun f w) z =
      ((CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity s (C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι w z)).toNat : ℤ) -
        ((CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity t (C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι w z)).toNat :
          ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hres : restrictFun f w = restrictHom w hu.choose := by
    unfold restrictFun
    rw [dif_pos hu]
  obtain ⟨hcu, hcf⟩ := hu.choose_spec
  set c := hu.choose
  
  have hloc : (W.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι w z)).hom t * c =
      (W.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι w z)).hom s := by
    apply IsFractionRing.injective (W.presheaf.stalk w) W.functionField
    rw [map_mul, algebraMap_stalkSpecializes, algebraMap_stalkSpecializes, hcf, hst]
  have hV := congrArg (restrictHom w) hloc
  rw [map_mul, restrictHom_stalkSpecializes, restrictHom_stalkSpecializes, ← hres] at hV
  have hker := C1Cap.ker_stalkMap_pointClosureι w z
  have hs0 : ((pointClosureι w).stalkMap z).hom s ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [Ne, ← RingHom.mem_ker, hker]
  have ht0 : ((pointClosureι w).stalkMap z).hom t ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [Ne, ← RingHom.mem_ker, hker]
  have ht0' : algebraMap ((pointClosureScheme w).presheaf.stalk z)
      (pointClosureScheme w).functionField
      (((pointClosureι w).stalkMap z).hom t) ≠ 0 :=
    (map_ne_zero_iff _ (IsFractionRing.injective _ _)).mpr ht0
  have hord := (pointClosureScheme w).ord_mul hz ht0' (restrictFun_ne_zero f w)
  rw [hV] at hord
  rw [C1Cap.localMultiplicity_toNat_eq_ord w z hz s hs,
    C1Cap.localMultiplicity_toNat_eq_ord w z hz t ht, hord]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.pushedDiv_apply
statement:
theorem pushedDiv_apply [IsLocallyNoetherian W] (f : W.functionField) (w : W)
    (z : pointClosureScheme w) :
    pushedDiv f w (pointClosureι w z) = div (restrictFun f w) z
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∃ z', pointClosureι w z' = pointClosureι w z := ⟨z, rfl⟩
  unfold pushedDiv
  rw [dif_pos h, (pointClosureι w).isEmbedding.injective h.choose_spec]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.exists_of_pushedDiv_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_of_pushedDiv_ne_zero [IsLocallyNoetherian W] {f : W.functionField} {w y : W}
    (h : pushedDiv f w y ≠ 0) :
    ∃ hwy : w ⤳ y,
      ringKrullDim (W.presheaf.stalk y ⧸ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hwy) = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold pushedDiv at h
  split_ifs at h with hex
  swap
  · exact absurd rfl h
  have hz1 : coheight hex.choose = 1 := div_support h
  have key : ∀ z, pointClosureι w z = y → coheight z = 1 → ∃ hwy : w ⤳ y,
      ringKrullDim (W.presheaf.stalk y ⧸ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hwy) = 1 := by
    rintro z rfl hz
    exact ⟨C1Cap.specializes_pointClosureι w z, (C1Cap.ringKrullDim_quotient_eq_one_iff w z).mpr hz⟩
  exact key _ hex.choose_spec hz1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.ringKrullDim_quotient_self
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_self {y : W} (h : y ⤳ y) :
    ringKrullDim (W.presheaf.stalk y ⧸ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [SchemeLocalOrdSymmetry.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_self h]
  exact ringKrullDim_eq_zero_of_isField
    ((Ideal.Quotient.maximal_ideal_iff_isField_quotient _).mp inferInstance)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.pushedDiv_self
statement:
theorem pushedDiv_self [IsLocallyNoetherian W] (f : W.functionField) (y : W) :
    pushedDiv f y y = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  obtain ⟨h', hd⟩ := exists_of_pushedDiv_ne_zero h
  rw [ringKrullDim_quotient_self] at hd
  exact zero_ne_one hd

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.natWeight_of_ne
statement:
theorem natWeight_of_ne {y : W} (c b : W.presheaf.stalk y) (x : {x : W // x ⤳ y})
    (hxy : x.1 ≠ y) :
    natWeight c b x =
      (Ring.ord (W.presheaf.stalk x.1) ((W.presheaf.stalkSpecializes x.2).hom c)).toNat *
        (CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity b x.2).toNat
proof:
:= by
  unfold natWeight
  split_ifs with h
  · rfl
  · have hc : c ∉ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes x.2 := fun hc ↦ h ⟨hxy, hc⟩
    have hu : IsUnit ((W.presheaf.stalkSpecializes x.2).hom c) := by
      rw [← IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal]
      exact hc
    rw [Ring.ord_of_isUnit hu]
    simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.ringKrullDim_stalk_le_two
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_stalk_le_two {y : W} (hy : coheight y ≤ 2) :
    ringKrullDim (W.presheaf.stalk y) ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight]
  exact WithBot.coe_le_coe.mpr hy

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.finite_generizations_mem
proof:
:= by
  let F : {x : W // x ⤳ y} → Ideal (W.presheaf.stalk y) :=
    fun x ↦ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes x.2
  have hinj : Function.Injective F := fun x₁ x₂ e ↦
    Subtype.ext (Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_injective x₁.2 x₂.2 e)
  refine ((Ideal.finite_minimalPrimes_of_isNoetherianRing _ (Ideal.span {c})).preimage
    hinj.injOn).subset ?_
  rintro x ⟨hxy, hcx⟩
  have hx1 : coheight x.1 = 1 := C1Cap.coheight_eq_one_of_mem_stalkPrime x.2 hxy hy hc hcx
  have hht : (Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes x.2).height = 1 := by
    rw [Scheme.height_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes, hx1]
  refine ⟨⟨inferInstance, (Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).mpr hcx⟩, fun q hq hqle ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hqp, hcq⟩ := hq
  by_contra hne
  have hlt : q < Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes x.2 := lt_of_le_of_ne hqle fun e ↦ hne (e ▸ le_rfl)
  have h1 := Ideal.height_add_one_le_of_lt_of_isPrime hlt
  rw [hht] at h1
  have hfin : q.height ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top (by rw [hht]; exact ENat.one_ne_top)
    (Ideal.height_mono hqle)
  have hq0 : q.height = 0 := Order.lt_one_iff.mp ((ENat.add_one_le_iff hfin).mp h1)
  rw [Ideal.height_eq_zero_iff_eq_bot] at hq0
  have := (Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).mp hcq
  rw [hq0, Ideal.mem_bot] at this
  exact hc this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.hasFiniteSupport_natWeight
statement:
theorem hasFiniteSupport_natWeight {y : W} (hy : coheight y ≤ 2) {c : W.presheaf.stalk y}
    (hc : c ≠ 0) (b : W.presheaf.stalk y) : HasFiniteSupport (natWeight c b)
proof:
:= by
  refine (finite_generizations_mem hy hc).subset fun x hx ↦ ?_
  by_contra h
  apply hx
  unfold natWeight
  exact if_neg h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.generizationWeight_eq_natWeight
statement:
theorem generizationWeight_eq_natWeight {y : W} (hy : coheight y ≤ 2) {c b : W.presheaf.stalk y}
    (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hgood : ∀ q : Ideal (W.presheaf.stalk y), q.IsPrime → c ∈ q → b ∈ q →
      q = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (W.presheaf.stalk y))
    (x : {x : W // x ⤳ y}) :
    SchemeLocalOrdSymmetry.generizationWeight c b x = (natWeight c b x : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  unfold SchemeLocalOrdSymmetry.generizationWeight natWeight
  split_ifs with h
  · obtain ⟨hxy, hcx⟩ := h
    have hx1 : coheight x.1 = 1 := C1Cap.coheight_eq_one_of_mem_stalkPrime x.2 hxy hy hc hcx
    haveI : Ring.KrullDimLE 1 (W.presheaf.stalk x.1) := krullDimLE_of_coheight hx1
    have hcx0 : (W.presheaf.stalkSpecializes x.2).hom c ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hc
      apply C1Cap.stalkSpecializes_injective x.2
      rw [h0, map_zero]
    have h1 : Ring.ord (W.presheaf.stalk x.1) ((W.presheaf.stalkSpecializes x.2).hom c) ≠ ⊤ :=
      Ring.ord_ne_top (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hcx0)
    have hpm : Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes x.2 ≠ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _ :=
      ((SchemeLocalOrdSymmetry.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_lt_maximalIdeal_iff x.2).mpr hxy).ne
    have hb : b ∉ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes x.2 := fun hb ↦ hpm (hgood _ inferInstance hcx hb)
    have hdim := ringKrullDim_quotient_eq_one (ringKrullDim_stalk_le_two hy) _ hpm hcx hc
    haveI : Ring.KrullDimLE 1 (W.presheaf.stalk y ⧸ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes x.2) :=
      Ring.krullDimLE_iff.mpr (le_of_eq (by rw [hdim]; rfl))
    have hb0 : Ideal.Quotient.mk (Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes x.2) b ≠ 0 := by
      rwa [Ne, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    have h2 : Ring.ord (W.presheaf.stalk y ⧸ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes x.2)
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ b) ≠ ⊤ :=
      Ring.ord_ne_top (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hb0)
    rw [Nat.cast_mul, ENat.coe_toNat h1]
    unfold CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity
    rw [ENat.coe_toNat h2]
  · rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.coe_finsum_natWeight
statement:
theorem coe_finsum_natWeight {y : W} (hy : coheight y ≤ 2) {c : W.presheaf.stalk y} (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (b : W.presheaf.stalk y) {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoidWithOne M] :
    ((∑ᶠ x, natWeight c b x : ℕ) : M) = ∑ᶠ x, (natWeight c b x : M)
proof:
:=
  (Nat.castAddMonoidHom M).map_finsum (hasFiniteSupport_natWeight hy hc b)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.finsum_natWeight_symm
statement:
theorem finsum_natWeight_symm {y : W} (hy : coheight y ≤ 2) {a s : W.presheaf.stalk y}
    (ha : a ≠ 0) (hs : s ≠ 0)
    (hgood : ∀ q : Ideal (W.presheaf.stalk y), q.IsPrime → a ∈ q → s ∈ q →
      q = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (W.presheaf.stalk y)) :
    ∑ᶠ x, natWeight s a x = ∑ᶠ x, natWeight a s x
proof:
:= by
  have key := SchemeLocalOrdSymmetry.scheme_localOrdSymmetry hy a s ha hs hgood
  rw [finsum_congr (generizationWeight_eq_natWeight hy hs fun q hq h1 h2 ↦ hgood q hq h2 h1),
    finsum_congr (generizationWeight_eq_natWeight hy ha hgood), ← coe_finsum_natWeight hy hs,
    ← coe_finsum_natWeight hy ha] at key
  exact_mod_cast key

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.div_eq_sub_of_fraction
statement:
theorem div_eq_sub_of_fraction {y : W} {f : W.functionField} (hf : f ≠ 0)
    {s t : W.presheaf.stalk y} (hs : s ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (hst : algebraMap _ W.functionField t * f = algebraMap _ W.functionField s)
    (x : {x : W // x ⤳ y}) (hx1 : coheight x.1 = 1) :
    div f x.1 =
      ((Ring.ord (W.presheaf.stalk x.1) ((W.presheaf.stalkSpecializes x.2).hom s)).toNat : ℤ) -
        (Ring.ord (W.presheaf.stalk x.1) ((W.presheaf.stalkSpecializes x.2).hom t)).toNat
proof:
:= by
  have hne : ∀ r : W.presheaf.stalk y, r ≠ 0 → (W.presheaf.stalkSpecializes x.2).hom r ≠ 0 :=
    fun r hr h0 ↦ hr (C1Cap.stalkSpecializes_injective x.2 (by rw [h0, map_zero]))
  rw [CartierIntersection.ord_stalk_toNat_eq_ord hx1 _ (hne s hs),
    CartierIntersection.ord_stalk_toNat_eq_ord hx1 _ (hne t ht),
    algebraMap_stalkSpecializes, algebraMap_stalkSpecializes, ← hst,
    W.ord_mul hx1 ((map_ne_zero_iff _ (IsFractionRing.injective _ _)).mpr ht) hf, div_eq_ord]
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.mem_maximalIdeal_iff_of_associated
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := h
  constructor
  · intro hc
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hc
  · intro hd
    have := Ideal.mul_mem_right ((v⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) _ hd
    simpa [mul_assoc] using this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.ord_eq_of_associated
statement:
theorem ord_eq_of_associated {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {c d : R} (h : Associated c d) :
    Ring.ord R c = Ring.ord R d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := h
  exact (Ring.ord_mul_of_isUnit_right v.isUnit c).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.c1Cap_div_local
statement:
theorem c1Cap_div_local (y : W) (hy : coheight y ≤ 2) (hf : f ≠ 0) (ha : a y ≠ 0)
    (hcompat : ∀ (x : W) (h : x ⤳ y),
      Associated ((W.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom (a y)) (a x))
    (hproper : ∀ x : W, x ⤳ y → coheight x = 1 →
      a x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (W.presheaf.stalk x) → IsUnitAt f x) :
    ∑ᶠ w, div f w * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a w y =
      ∑ᶠ w, (if coheight w = 1 ∧ a w ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (W.presheaf.stalk w) then
        ((Ring.ord (W.presheaf.stalk w) (a w)).toNat : ℤ) * pushedDiv f w y else 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set A := a y with hAdef
  have hchain : ∀ q P : Ideal (W.presheaf.stalk y), q.IsPrime → P.IsPrime → ⊥ < q → q < P →
      P < IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (W.presheaf.stalk y) → False := by
    intro q P hq hP h1 h2 h3
    have h := SchemeLocalOrdSymmetry.three_le_ringKrullDim_of_chain h1 h2 h3
    have h4 := h.trans (ringKrullDim_stalk_le_two hy)
    have h5 : (3 : ℕ∞) ≤ 2 := WithBot.coe_le_coe.mp h4
    exact absurd h5 (by decide)
  have hunit : ∀ q : Ideal (W.presheaf.stalk y), q.IsPrime →
      q ≠ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _ → A ∈ q →
      ∃ s t : W.presheaf.stalk y, s ∉ q ∧ t ∉ q ∧
        algebraMap _ W.functionField t * f = algebraMap _ W.functionField s := by
    intro q hq hqm hAq
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Scheme.exists_specializes_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_eq y q
    have hxy : x ≠ y := (SchemeLocalOrdSymmetry.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_lt_maximalIdeal_iff hx).mp
      (lt_of_le_of_ne (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal hq.ne_top) hqm)
    have hx1 : coheight x = 1 := C1Cap.coheight_eq_one_of_mem_stalkPrime hx hxy hy ha hAq
    have hax : a x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _ :=
      (mem_maximalIdeal_iff_of_associated (hcompat x hx)).mp hAq
    obtain ⟨c, hcu, hcf⟩ := hproper x hx hx1 hax
    letI := Scheme.stalkSpecializesAlgebra hx
    haveI := Scheme.isLocalization_stalkSpecializes hx
    obtain ⟨⟨s', t'⟩, he⟩ := IsLocalization.surj (Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hx).primeCompl c
    have he' : c * (W.presheaf.stalkSpecializes hx).hom t' =
        (W.presheaf.stalkSpecializes hx).hom s' := he
    have ht'u : IsUnit ((W.presheaf.stalkSpecializes hx).hom t') := by
      rw [← IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal]
      exact t'.2
    refine ⟨s', t', ?_, t'.2, ?_⟩
    · intro hs'
      apply IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal.mpr (he' ▸ hcu.mul ht'u)
      exact hs'
    · rw [← algebraMap_stalkSpecializes hx, ← algebraMap_stalkSpecializes hx s', ← he', ← hcf,
        map_mul, mul_comm]
  obtain ⟨s, t, hs0, ht0, hst, hgs, hgt⟩ := exists_fraction_avoiding hchain ha hf hunit
  have keys := finsum_natWeight_symm hy ha hs0 hgs
  have keyt := finsum_natWeight_symm hy ha ht0 hgt
  
  have hL : ∀ x : {x : W // x ⤳ y}, div f x.1 * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a x.1 y =
      (natWeight s A x : ℤ) - natWeight t A x := by
    intro x
    by_cases hxy : x.1 = y
    · have h0 : ∀ c : W.presheaf.stalk y, natWeight c A x = 0 := by
        intro c
        unfold natWeight
        rw [if_neg fun h ↦ h.1 hxy]
      rw [h0, h0]
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := x
      simp only at hxy
      subst hxy
      unfold C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff
      rw [dif_pos hx, if_neg (by rw [ringKrullDim_quotient_self]; exact zero_ne_one)]
      simp
    rw [natWeight_of_ne s A x hxy, natWeight_of_ne t A x hxy]
    have hunit0 : ∀ c : W.presheaf.stalk y, c ∉ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes x.2 →
        Ring.ord (W.presheaf.stalk x.1) ((W.presheaf.stalkSpecializes x.2).hom c) = 0 := by
      intro c hc
      apply Ring.ord_of_isUnit
      rw [← IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal]
      exact hc
    by_cases hx1 : coheight x.1 = 1
    · rw [div_eq_sub_of_fraction hf hs0 ht0 hst x hx1]
      by_cases hmem : s ∈ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes x.2 ∨
          t ∈ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes x.2
      · have hpm : Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes x.2 ≠ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _ :=
          ((SchemeLocalOrdSymmetry.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_lt_maximalIdeal_iff x.2).mpr hxy).ne
        have hdim : ringKrullDim (W.presheaf.stalk y ⧸ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes x.2) = 1 := by
          rcases hmem with h | h
          · exact ringKrullDim_quotient_eq_one (ringKrullDim_stalk_le_two hy) _ hpm h hs0
          · exact ringKrullDim_quotient_eq_one (ringKrullDim_stalk_le_two hy) _ hpm h ht0
        unfold C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff
        rw [dif_pos x.2, if_pos hdim]
        push_cast
        ring
      · simp only [not_or] at hmem
        rw [hunit0 s hmem.1, hunit0 t hmem.2]
        simp
    · have hs : s ∉ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes x.2 := fun h ↦
        hx1 (C1Cap.coheight_eq_one_of_mem_stalkPrime x.2 hxy hy hs0 h)
      have ht : t ∉ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes x.2 := fun h ↦
        hx1 (C1Cap.coheight_eq_one_of_mem_stalkPrime x.2 hxy hy ht0 h)
      rw [div_eq_ord, Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hx1, hunit0 s hs, hunit0 t ht]
      simp
  have hR : ∀ x : {x : W // x ⤳ y},
      (if coheight x.1 = 1 ∧ a x.1 ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (W.presheaf.stalk x.1) then
        ((Ring.ord (W.presheaf.stalk x.1) (a x.1)).toNat : ℤ) * pushedDiv f x.1 y else 0) =
      (natWeight A s x : ℤ) - natWeight A t x := by
    intro x
    by_cases hxy : x.1 = y
    · have h0 : ∀ c : W.presheaf.stalk y, natWeight A c x = 0 := by
        intro c
        unfold natWeight
        rw [if_neg fun h ↦ h.1 hxy]
      rw [h0, h0]
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := x
      simp only at hxy
      subst hxy
      simp [pushedDiv_self]
    rw [natWeight_of_ne A s x hxy, natWeight_of_ne A t x hxy]
    have hmem := mem_maximalIdeal_iff_of_associated (hcompat x.1 x.2)
    have hord := ord_eq_of_associated (hcompat x.1 x.2)
    rw [← hord]
    by_cases hA : A ∈ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes x.2
    · have hx1 : coheight x.1 = 1 := C1Cap.coheight_eq_one_of_mem_stalkPrime x.2 hxy hy ha hA
      have hax : a x.1 ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _ := hmem.mp hA
      rw [if_pos ⟨hx1, hax⟩]
      have hpm : Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes x.2 ≠ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _ :=
        ((SchemeLocalOrdSymmetry.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_lt_maximalIdeal_iff x.2).mpr hxy).ne
      have hs : s ∉ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes x.2 := fun h ↦ hpm (hgs _ inferInstance hA h)
      have ht : t ∉ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes x.2 := fun h ↦ hpm (hgt _ inferInstance hA h)
      have hdim := ringKrullDim_quotient_eq_one (ringKrullDim_stalk_le_two hy) _ hpm hA ha
      have hu := hproper x.1 x.2 hx1 hax
      have hpd : pushedDiv f x.1 y =
          ((CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity s x.2).toNat : ℤ) -
            (CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity t x.2).toNat := by
        obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := x
        simp only at hs ht hdim hu ⊢
        obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := C1Cap.exists_pointClosureι_eq hx
        subst hz
        have hz1 : coheight z = 1 := (C1Cap.ringKrullDim_quotient_eq_one_iff x z).mp hdim
        rw [pushedDiv_apply, div_eq_ord]
        exact ord_restrictFun f x hu z hz1 s t hs ht hst
      rw [hpd]
      push_cast
      ring
    · have hax : a x.1 ∉ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _ := fun h ↦ hA (hmem.mpr h)
      rw [if_neg fun h ↦ hax h.2]
      have hu : IsUnit ((W.presheaf.stalkSpecializes x.2).hom A) := by
        rw [← IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal]
        exact hA
      rw [Ring.ord_of_isUnit hu]
      simp
  have hsuppL : ∀ w : W, div f w * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a w y ≠ 0 → w ⤳ y := by
    intro w hw
    by_contra h
    apply hw
    rw [C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_not_specializes a h, mul_zero]
  have hsuppR : ∀ w : W, (if coheight w = 1 ∧ a w ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (W.presheaf.stalk w)
      then ((Ring.ord (W.presheaf.stalk w) (a w)).toNat : ℤ) * pushedDiv f w y else 0) ≠ 0 →
      w ⤳ y := by
    intro w hw
    split_ifs at hw
    · have : pushedDiv f w y ≠ 0 := right_ne_zero_of_mul hw
      exact (exists_of_pushedDiv_ne_zero this).1
    · exact absurd rfl hw
  rw [finsum_eq_finsum_subtype _ _ hsuppL, finsum_eq_finsum_subtype _ _ hsuppR,
    finsum_congr hL, finsum_congr hR]
  have hfin : ∀ c b : W.presheaf.stalk y, c ≠ 0 →
      HasFiniteSupport fun x ↦ (natWeight c b x : ℤ) := by
    intro c b hc
    refine (hasFiniteSupport_natWeight hy hc b).subset fun x hx ↦ ?_
    intro h
    apply hx
    simp [h]
  rw [finsum_sub_distrib (hfin _ _ hs0) (hfin _ _ ht0),
    finsum_sub_distrib (hfin _ _ ha) (hfin _ _ ha), ← coe_finsum_natWeight hy hs0,
    ← coe_finsum_natWeight hy ht0, ← coe_finsum_natWeight hy ha, ← coe_finsum_natWeight hy ha,
    keys, keyt]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.c1CapCyclesCoeff_div
statement:
theorem c1CapCyclesCoeff_div (hf : f ≠ 0) (ha : ∀ y, a y ≠ 0)
    (hcompat : ∀ ⦃x y : W⦄ (h : x ⤳ y),
      Associated ((W.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom (a y)) (a x))
    (hproper : ∀ x : W, coheight x = 1 →
      a x ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (W.presheaf.stalk x) → IsUnitAt f x)
    (hcat : ∀ ⦃w y : W⦄ (h : w ⤳ y), coheight w = 1 →
      ringKrullDim (W.presheaf.stalk y ⧸ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h) = 1 → coheight y ≤ 2)
    (y : W) :
    C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff a (div f) y =
      ∑ᶠ w, (if coheight w = 1 ∧ a w ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (W.presheaf.stalk w) then
        ((Ring.ord (W.presheaf.stalk w) (a w)).toNat : ℤ) * pushedDiv f w y else 0)
proof:
:= by
  unfold C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff
  by_cases hex : ∃ (w : W) (h : w ⤳ y), coheight w = 1 ∧
      ringKrullDim (W.presheaf.stalk y ⧸ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h) = 1
  · obtain ⟨w, h, hw, hd⟩ := hex
    exact c1Cap_div_local a f y (hcat h hw hd) hf (ha y) (fun x hx ↦ hcompat hx)
      (fun x _ hx hax ↦ hproper x hx hax)
  · push Not at hex
    rw [finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero, finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero]
    · intro w
      split_ifs with hc
      · obtain ⟨hw, -⟩ := hc
        by_contra hne
        obtain ⟨h, hd⟩ := exists_of_pushedDiv_ne_zero (right_ne_zero_of_mul hne)
        exact hex w h hw hd
      · rfl
    · intro w
      by_cases hd : div f w = 0
      · rw [hd, zero_mul]
      have hw : coheight w = 1 := div_support hd
      unfold C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff
      split_ifs with h hdim
      · exact absurd hdim (hex w h hw)
      · rw [mul_zero]
      · rw [mul_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.ker_stalkMap_eq_stalkPrime
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_eq_stalkPrime (j : V ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion j] (z : V) :
    RingHom.ker (j.stalkMap z).hom = Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes
      (((genericPoint_spec V).specializes trivial : genericPoint V ⤳ z).map j.continuous)
proof:
:= by
  set η := genericPoint V
  have hη : η ⤳ z := (genericPoint_spec V).specializes trivial
  have hη' : j η ⤳ j z := hη.map j.continuous
  have hkerη : RingHom.ker (j.stalkMap η).hom =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk (j η)) := by
    have hsurj : Function.Surjective (j.stalkMap η).hom := j.stalkMap_surjective η
    have hbot : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (V.presheaf.stalk η) = ⊥ :=
      C1Cap.maximalIdeal_stalk_eq_bot_of_eq_genericPoint rfl
    have hmax : (Ideal.comap (j.stalkMap η).hom (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _)).IsMaximal :=
      Ideal.comap_isMaximal_of_surjective _ hsurj
    rw [RingHom.ker, ← hbot]
    exact IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hmax
  have hinj := C1Cap.stalkSpecializes_injective hη
  ext c
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker, Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes, Ideal.mem_comap, ← hkerη, RingHom.mem_ker]
  have happ : (j.stalkMap η).hom ((X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes hη').hom c) =
      (V.presheaf.stalkSpecializes hη).hom ((j.stalkMap z).hom c) :=
    j.stalkSpecializes_stalkMap_apply η z hη c
  rw [happ]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [h, map_zero]
  · intro h
    exact hinj (by rw [h, map_zero])

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.coheight_apply_eq_add
statement:
theorem coheight_apply_eq_add (hdf : C1Cap.StalkDimensionFormula X) (j : V ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion j] (z : V) :
    coheight (j z) = coheight (j (genericPoint V)) + coheight z
proof:
:= by
  have hη' : j (genericPoint V) ⤳ j z :=
    ((genericPoint_spec V).specializes trivial : genericPoint V ⤳ z).map j.continuous
  have hd := hdf (j z) (Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hη') inferInstance
  let e : X.presheaf.stalk (j z) ⧸ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hη' ≃+* V.presheaf.stalk z :=
    (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq (ker_stalkMap_eq_stalkPrime j z).symm).trans
      (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective (j.stalkMap_surjective z))
  rw [ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv e, ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight,
    Scheme.height_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes, ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight] at hd
  have h : ((coheight (j (genericPoint V)) + coheight z : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
      (coheight (j z) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    rw [← hd, add_comm]
    rfl
  exact (WithBot.coe_injective h).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.comp_genericPoint
statement:
theorem comp_genericPoint (g : RationalRelationGenerator X p) (w : g.Y) :
    (pointClosureι w ≫ g.i) (genericPoint (pointClosureScheme w)) = g.i w
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← C1Cap.pointClosureGenericPoint_eq_genericPoint,
    pointClosureι_genericPoint]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.coheight_le_two_of_ringKrullDim
statement:
theorem coheight_le_two_of_ringKrullDim (hdf : C1Cap.StalkDimensionFormula X)
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X p) {w y : g.Y} (h : w ⤳ y) (hw : coheight w = 1)
    (hd : ringKrullDim (g.Y.presheaf.stalk y ⧸ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h) = 1) :
    coheight y ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hX := hdf (g.i y) (Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (h.map g.i.base.hom.continuous))
    inferInstance
  rw [ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (C1Cap.stalkQuotientEquiv g.i h), hd,
    Scheme.height_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes, g.codimension w hw, ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight]
    at hX
  have hiy : coheight (g.i y) = 1 + p := by
    have : (((1 + p : ℕ∞)) : WithBot ℕ∞) = (coheight (g.i y) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
      rw [← hX]
      rfl
    exact (WithBot.coe_injective this).symm
  have e1 := coheight_apply_eq_add hdf g.i y
  have e2 := coheight_apply_eq_add hdf g.i w
  rw [g.codimension w hw, hw] at e2
  rw [hiy] at e1
  generalize coheight (g.i (genericPoint g.Y)) = c at e1 e2
  induction c using ENat.recTopCoe with
  | top => exact absurd e2 (by simp)
  | coe c =>
    induction hco : coheight y using ENat.recTopCoe with
    | top =>
      rw [hco] at e1
      rw [add_top] at e1
      exact absurd e1 (by rw [← Nat.cast_one, ← Nat.cast_add]; exact ENat.coe_ne_top _)
    | coe n =>
      rw [hco] at e1
      have h2 : p = c + 1 := by exact_mod_cast e2
      have h1 : 1 + p = c + n := by exact_mod_cast e1
      have : n = 2 := by omega
      rw [this]
      rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.relGen_cycle_apply
statement:
theorem relGen_cycle_apply (hdf : C1Cap.StalkDimensionFormula X)
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X p) (w : g.Y) (hw : coheight w = 1) (y : g.Y) :
    (relGen hdf g w hw).cycle.1 (g.i y) = pushedDiv g.f w y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hy : ∃ z, pointClosureι w z = y
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hy
    have h := RationalRelationGenerator.cycle_apply_i (relGen hdf g w hw) z
    have hi : (relGen hdf g w hw).i z = g.i (pointClosureι w z) := Scheme.Hom.comp_apply _ _ _
    rw [hi] at h
    rw [h, pushedDiv_apply]
    rfl
  · have hnot : g.i y ∉ Set.range (relGen hdf g w hw).i := by
      rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
      apply hy
      refine ⟨z, g.i.isEmbedding.injective ?_⟩
      rw [← hz]
      exact (Scheme.Hom.comp_apply _ _ _).symm
    rw [RationalRelationGenerator.cycle_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range _ _ hnot]
    unfold pushedDiv
    rw [dif_neg hy]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.relGen_cycle_apply_of_not_mem_range
proof:
:= by
  apply RationalRelationGenerator.cycle_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range
  rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
  exact hx ⟨pointClosureι w z, (Scheme.Hom.comp_apply _ _ _).symm⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.relCycle_mem
statement:
theorem relCycle_mem (hdf : C1Cap.StalkDimensionFormula X) (g : RationalRelationGenerator X p)
    (a : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (ha : IsProperFor g a) :
    relCycle hdf g a ha ∈ rationalEquivalenceSubgroup X (p + 1)
proof:
:=
  AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun _ _ ↦ AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem _ (relation_cycle_mem _) _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.c1CapCyclesCoeff_relation
statement:
theorem c1CapCyclesCoeff_relation (hdf : C1Cap.StalkDimensionFormula X)
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X p) (a : C1Cap.LocalEquations X) (ha : IsProperFor g a)
    (x : X) :
    C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff a g.cycle.1 x = (relCycle hdf g a ha).1 x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change _ = evalHom X (p + 1) x (relCycle hdf g a ha)
  rw [relCycle, map_sum]
  simp only [map_zsmul, smul_eq_mul]
  change _ = ∑ w ∈ ha.finite.toFinset.attach,
    ((Ring.ord (g.Y.presheaf.stalk w.1) (a.pullback g.i w.1)).toNat : ℤ) *
      (relGen hdf g w.1 ((ha.finite.mem_toFinset.mp w.2).1)).cycle.1 x
  have hg : g.cycle.1 = AlgebraicCycle.pushforward g.i (div g.f) (fun _ ↦ (p : ℕ∞)) coheight :=
    rfl
  have hα : ∀ w : g.Y, div g.f w ≠ 0 → (fun _ ↦ (p : ℕ∞)) w = coheight (g.i w) :=
    fun w hw ↦ (g.codimension w (div_support hw)).symm
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.range g.i
  · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [hg, C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff_pushforward_apply g.i a (div g.f) _ _ hα y,
      c1CapCyclesCoeff_div (a.pullback g.i) g.f g.hf ha.ne_zero ha.associated ha.proper
        (fun w y h hw hd ↦ coheight_le_two_of_ringKrullDim hdf g h hw hd) y]
    simp_rw [relGen_cycle_apply]
    rw [Finset.sum_attach ha.finite.toFinset (fun w ↦
      ((Ring.ord (g.Y.presheaf.stalk w) (a.pullback g.i w)).toNat : ℤ) * pushedDiv g.f w y)]
    rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ (s := ha.finite.toFinset) ?_]
    · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun w hw ↦ ?_
      exact if_pos ((ha.finite.mem_toFinset).mp hw)
    · intro w hw
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hw
      rw [Finset.mem_coe, ha.finite.mem_toFinset]
      by_contra h
      exact hw (if_neg h)
  · rw [hg, C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff_pushforward_apply_of_not_mem_range g.i a (div g.f) _ _ hx]
    symm
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun w _ ↦ ?_
    rw [relGen_cycle_apply_of_not_mem_range hdf g _ _ hx, mul_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1CapDescent.c1CapCycles_relation
statement:
theorem c1CapCycles_relation [CompactSpace X] (g : RationalRelationGenerator X p)
    (d : C1CapProperData L hL hrank hdf g) :
    C1Cap.c1CapCycles L hL hrank hdf p g.cycle = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set fs := compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1 with hfs
  have hcod : ∀ v, g.cycle.1 v ≠ 0 → coheight v = p := fun v hv ↦ g.cycle.2 hv
  have hsupp : ∀ v, v ∈ fs.support ↔ g.cycle.1 v ≠ 0 := fun v ↦ by
    rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, hfs, compactCycleFinsupp_apply]
  let Rep : X → CodimensionCycles X ℤ (p + 1) := fun v ↦
    if h : coheight v = p ∧ g.cycle.1 v ≠ 0 then (d.represents v h.1 h.2).choose else 0
  have hRep : ∀ v ∈ fs.support,
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeOrZero L hL hrank hdf p v = gradedClassOf X (p + 1) (Rep v) := by
    intro v hv
    have hv' := (hsupp v).mp hv
    have hc := hcod v hv'
    rw [C1Cap.c1CapPrimeOrZero, dif_pos hc]
    simp only [Rep, dif_pos (And.intro hc hv')]
    exact (d.represents v hc hv').choose_spec.1
  have hRepv : ∀ v ∈ fs.support, ∀ y, (Rep v).1 y =
      C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff d.a₁ v y - C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff d.a₂ v y := by
    intro v hv y
    have hv' := (hsupp v).mp hv
    have hc := hcod v hv'
    simp only [Rep, dif_pos (And.intro hc hv')]
    exact (d.represents v hc hv').choose_spec.2 y
  change fs.sum (fun v n ↦ n • C1Cap.c1CapPrimeOrZero L hL hrank hdf p v) = 0
  rw [Finsupp.sum_congr (g2 := fun v n ↦ n • gradedClassOf X (p + 1) (Rep v))
    fun v hv ↦ by rw [hRep v hv]]
  set C := fs.sum fun v n ↦ n • Rep v with hC
  have hclass : fs.sum (fun v n ↦ n • gradedClassOf X (p + 1) (Rep v)) =
      gradedClassOf X (p + 1) C := by
    rw [hC, ← gradedClassMap_apply, map_finsuppSum]
    simp only [map_zsmul, gradedClassMap_apply]
  rw [hclass, ← gradedClassOf_zero, gradedClassOf_eq_iff, sub_zero]
  have hCeq : C = relCycle hdf g d.a₁ d.proper₁ - relCycle hdf g d.a₂ d.proper₂ := by
    ext x
    change evalHom X (p + 1) x C = evalHom X (p + 1) x (relCycle hdf g d.a₁ d.proper₁ -
      relCycle hdf g d.a₂ d.proper₂)
    rw [map_sub]
    change _ = (relCycle hdf g d.a₁ d.proper₁).1 x - (relCycle hdf g d.a₂ d.proper₂).1 x
    rw [← c1CapCyclesCoeff_relation hdf g d.a₁ d.proper₁ x,
      ← c1CapCyclesCoeff_relation hdf g d.a₂ d.proper₂ x]
    rw [hC, map_finsuppSum]
    simp only [map_zsmul, smul_eq_mul]
    change ∑ v ∈ fs.support, fs v * (Rep v).1 x = _
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun v hv ↦ by rw [hRepv v hv x]]
    unfold C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff
    have hsub : ∀ a : C1Cap.LocalEquations X,
        support (fun v ↦ g.cycle.1 v * C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff a v x) ⊆ ↑fs.support := by
      intro a v hv
      rw [Finset.mem_coe, hsupp]
      exact left_ne_zero_of_mul hv
    rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ (hsub d.a₁),
      finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ (hsub d.a₂), ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun v _ ↦ ?_
    rw [hfs, compactCycleFinsupp_apply, mul_sub]
  rw [hCeq]
  exact sub_mem (relCycle_mem hdf g _ _) (relCycle_mem hdf g _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.pushforwardCodimensionCompatible_toSpec
statement:
theorem pushforwardCodimensionCompatible_toSpec (n p : ℕ) :
    PushforwardCodimensionCompatible (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k n) p (p - n)
proof:
:= by
  intro x _ hx
  have hle : coheight x ≤ n := by
    have h1 := Order.coheight_le_krullDim x
    have h2 : krullDim (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n) ≤ n := by
      rw [← Order.krullDimLE_iff]
      infer_instance
    exact_mod_cast h1.trans h2
  rw [hx] at hle
  have hpn : p - n = 0 := Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le (by exact_mod_cast hle)
  rw [hpn, coheight_spec_field k]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.properPushforwardCycles_generator_eq_zero
statement:
theorem properPushforwardCycles_generator_eq_zero {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f]
    {p q : ℕ} (hf : PushforwardCodimensionCompatible f p q) (G : RationalRelationGenerator X p)
    (h0 : properPushforward (G.i ≫ f) (div G.f) = 0) :
    properPushforwardCycles f hf G.cycle = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [properPushforwardCycles_coe]
  change properPushforward f (AlgebraicCycle.pushforward G.i (div G.f) (fun _ ↦ (p : ℕ∞))
    coheight) = 0
  rw [← properPushforward_eq_pushforward_closedImmersion G.i (div G.f) _ _
    (fun y hy ↦ (G.codimension y (div_support hy)).symm), ← properPushforward_comp]
  exact h0

theorem isWeaklyRegular_map_ringEquiv
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (e : R ≃+* S)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ker_eq_ofList_of_equiv_commutes
statement:
theorem ker_eq_ofList_of_equiv_commutes
    {A B C D : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C] [CommRing D]
    (f : A →+* B) (g : C →+* D) (eA : A ≃+* C) (eB : B ≃+* D)
    (h : eB.toRingHom.comp f = g.comp eA.toRingHom)
    (as : List A) (hf : RingHom.ker f = Ideal.ofList as) :
    RingHom.ker g = Ideal.ofList (as.map eA)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    RingHom.ker g = (RingHom.ker f).map eA := by
      ext c
      rw [Ideal.mem_map_of_equiv]
      constructor
      · intro hc
        refine ⟨eA.symm c, ?_, eA.apply_symm_apply c⟩
        rw [RingHom.mem_ker]
        apply eB.injective
        rw [map_zero]
        calc
          eB (f (eA.symm c)) = g (eA (eA.symm c)) :=
            DFunLike.congr_fun h (eA.symm c)
          _ = g c := by rw [eA.apply_symm_apply]
          _ = 0 := RingHom.mem_ker.mp hc
      · rintro ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
        rw [RingHom.mem_ker]
        calc
          g (eA b) = eB (f b) := (DFunLike.congr_fun h b).symm
          _ = 0 := by rw [RingHom.mem_ker.mp hb, map_zero]
    _ = Ideal.ofList (as.map eA) := by
      rw [hf]
      exact Ideal.map_ofList eA.toRingHom as

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ker_eq_ofList_of_equiv_commutes_symm
statement:
theorem ker_eq_ofList_of_equiv_commutes_symm
    {A B C D : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C] [CommRing D]
    (f : A →+* B) (g : C →+* D) (eA : A ≃+* C) (eB : B ≃+* D)
    (h : eB.toRingHom.comp f = g.comp eA.toRingHom)
    (cs : List C) (hg : RingHom.ker g = Ideal.ofList cs) :
    RingHom.ker f = Ideal.ofList (cs.map eA.symm)
proof:
:= by
  apply ker_eq_ofList_of_equiv_commutes g f eA.symm eB.symm _ cs hg
  ext x
  apply eB.injective
  calc
    eB (eB.symm (g x)) = g x := eB.apply_symm_apply (g x)
    _ = g (eA (eA.symm x)) := by rw [eA.apply_symm_apply]
    _ = eB (f (eA.symm x)) :=
      (DFunLike.congr_fun h (eA.symm x)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ker_stalkMap_eq_ofList_of_arrow_iso
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_eq_ofList_of_arrow_iso
    {Z X Z' X' : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) (j : Z' ⟶ X')
    (eZ : Z ≅ Z') (eX : X ≅ X')
    (h : eZ.hom ≫ j = i ≫ eX.hom) (z : Z)
    (as : List (X'.presheaf.stalk (j (eZ.hom z))))
    (hker : RingHom.ker (j.stalkMap (eZ.hom z)).hom = Ideal.ofList as) :
    RingHom.ker (i.stalkMap z).hom =
      Ideal.ofList (as.map (targetStalkIsoOfArrowIso i j eZ eX h z).hom.hom)
proof:
:= by
  apply ker_eq_ofList_of_equiv_commutes
    (j.stalkMap (eZ.hom z)).hom (i.stalkMap z).hom
    (targetStalkIsoOfArrowIso i j eZ eX h z).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
    (sourceStalkIsoOfArrowIso eZ z).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
    _ as hker
  change ((j.stalkMap (eZ.hom z)) ≫
    (sourceStalkIsoOfArrowIso eZ z).hom).hom =
      ((targetStalkIsoOfArrowIso i j eZ eX h z).hom ≫ i.stalkMap z).hom
  exact congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom
    (stalkMap_square_of_arrow_iso i j eZ eX h z)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ker_localRingHom_quotient_ideal
statement:
theorem ker_localRingHom_quotient_ideal
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R)
    (p : PrimeSpectrum (R ⧸ I)) :
    RingHom.ker (Localization.localRingHom
      (p.asIdeal.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) p.asIdeal
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) rfl) =
        I.map (algebraMap R
          (Localization.AtPrime (p.asIdeal.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))))
proof:
:= by
  let φ : R →+* (R ⧸ I) := Ideal.Quotient.mk I
  have hφ : Function.Surjective φ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hT : Submonoid.map φ (p.asIdeal.comap φ).primeCompl =
      p.asIdeal.primeCompl :=
    Ideal.map_primeCompl_comap_of_surjective φ hφ p.asIdeal
  change RingHom.ker (IsLocalization.map
    (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) φ
      (Localization.le_comap_primeCompl_iff.mpr le_rfl)) = _
  rw [IsLocalization.ker_map (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) φ hT]
  rw [Ideal.mk_ker]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ker_localRingHom_quotient_ideal_comap
statement:
theorem ker_localRingHom_quotient_ideal_comap
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R)
    (p : PrimeSpectrum (R ⧸ I)) :
    RingHom.ker (Localization.localRingHom
      (p.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).asIdeal p.asIdeal
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) rfl) =
        I.map (algebraMap R
          (Localization.AtPrime (p.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).asIdeal))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal] using ker_localRingHom_quotient_ideal I p

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ker_stalkMap_Spec_quotient_ofList
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_Spec_quotient_ofList
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (rs : List R)
    (p : PrimeSpectrum (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList rs)) :
    RingHom.ker ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.ofList rs)))).stalkMap p).hom =
        Ideal.ofList (rs.map (fun a ↦ quotientStalkElement (Ideal.ofList rs) a p))
proof:
:= by
  let I : Ideal R := Ideal.ofList rs
  let φ : R →+* (R ⧸ I) := Ideal.Quotient.mk I
  let q : PrimeSpectrum R := p.comap φ
  let eR : ((Spec (.of R)).presheaf.stalk q) ≃+*
      Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal :=
    (Spec.stalkIso (.of R) q).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  rw [← Scheme.localRingHom_comp_stalkIso]
  change RingHom.ker
      ((Spec.stalkIso (.of (R ⧸ I)) p).inv.hom.comp
        ((Localization.localRingHom q.asIdeal p.asIdeal φ rfl).comp
          (Spec.stalkIso (.of R) q).hom.hom)) = _
  have hinj : Function.Injective (Spec.stalkIso (.of (R ⧸ I)) p).inv.hom :=
    (Spec.stalkIso (.of (R ⧸ I)) p).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.injective
  rw [RingHom.ker_comp_of_injective _ hinj]
  rw [← RingHom.comap_ker]
  dsimp only [q, φ, I]
  rw [ker_localRingHom_quotient_ideal_comap]
  change ((Ideal.ofList rs).map
      (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal))).comap eR.toRingHom = _
  calc
    _ = ((Ideal.ofList rs).map
        (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal))).map eR.symm := by
      exact (Ideal.map_symm eR).symm
    _ = (Ideal.ofList rs).map
        (eR.symm.toRingHom.comp
          (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal))) := by
      exact Ideal.map_map (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal))
        eR.symm.toRingHom
    _ = Ideal.ofList (rs.map (fun a ↦
        eR.symm (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) a))) := by
      rw [Ideal.map_ofList]
      congr 1
    _ = Ideal.ofList
        (rs.map (fun a ↦ quotientStalkElement (Ideal.ofList rs) a p)) := by
      rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.KoszulOpenPullbackChart.ker_stalkMap_openPullback
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_openPullback (c : KoszulOpenPullbackChart i t)
    (w : (pullback i t : Scheme.{u})) :
    RingHom.ker ((pullback.snd i t).stalkMap w).hom =
      Ideal.ofList (c.localStalkEquations w)
proof:
:= by
  apply ker_stalkMap_eq_ofList_of_arrow_iso
    (pullback.snd i t)
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.ofList c.equations))))
    c.sourceIso c.targetIso c.commutes w (c.standardStalkEquations w)
  exact ker_stalkMap_Spec_quotient_ofList c.equations (c.sourceIso.hom w)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.KoszulOpenPullbackChart.localStalkEquations_regular
statement:
theorem localStalkEquations_regular (c : KoszulOpenPullbackChart i t)
    (w : (pullback i t : Scheme.{u})) :
    RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular
      (U.presheaf.stalk (pullback.snd i t w)) (c.localStalkEquations w)
proof:
:= by
  let p : PrimeSpectrum (c.R ⧸ Ideal.ofList c.equations) := c.sourceIso.hom w
  let q : PrimeSpectrum c.R := p.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.ofList c.equations))
  have hloc : RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular
      (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)
      (c.equations.map (algebraMap c.R (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal))) :=
    c.regular.of_isLocalization (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) q.asIdeal.primeCompl
  let eR : Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal ≃+*
      (Spec (.of c.R)).presheaf.stalk q :=
    (Spec.stalkIso (.of c.R) q).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  have hstandard := isWeaklyRegular_map_ringEquiv eR hloc
  have hstandard' : RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular
      ((Spec (.of c.R)).presheaf.stalk q) (c.standardStalkEquations w) := by
    have hEq :
        (c.equations.map
          (algebraMap c.R (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal))).map eR =
            c.standardStalkEquations w := by
      dsimp only [standardStalkEquations, quotientStalkElement, eR, q, p]
      rw [List.map_map]
      congr 1
    rw [← hEq]
    exact hstandard
  let eT := (targetStalkIsoOfArrowIso (pullback.snd i t)
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.ofList c.equations))))
    c.sourceIso c.targetIso c.commutes w).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  exact isWeaklyRegular_map_ringEquiv eT hstandard'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.KoszulOpenPullbackChart.ker_stalkMap
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap (c : KoszulOpenPullbackChart i t)
    (w : (pullback i t : Scheme.{u})) :
    RingHom.ker (i.stalkMap (pullback.fst i t w)).hom =
      Ideal.ofList (c.stalkEquations w)
proof:
:= by
  apply ker_eq_ofList_of_equiv_commutes_symm
    (i.stalkMap (pullback.fst i t w)).hom
    ((pullback.snd i t).stalkMap w).hom
    (targetStalkIsoOfIsIsoSquare i (pullback.snd i t)
      (pullback.fst i t) t pullback.condition w).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
    (sourceStalkIsoOfIsIsoSquare (pullback.fst i t) w).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
    _ (c.localStalkEquations w) (c.ker_stalkMap_openPullback w)
  change ((i.stalkMap (pullback.fst i t w)) ≫
    (sourceStalkIsoOfIsIsoSquare (pullback.fst i t) w).hom).hom =
      ((targetStalkIsoOfIsIsoSquare i (pullback.snd i t)
        (pullback.fst i t) t pullback.condition w).hom ≫
        (pullback.snd i t).stalkMap w).hom
  exact congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom
    (stalkMap_square_of_isIso_stalkMaps i (pullback.snd i t)
      (pullback.fst i t) t pullback.condition w)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.KoszulOpenPullbackChart.stalkEquations_regular
statement:
theorem stalkEquations_regular (c : KoszulOpenPullbackChart i t)
    (w : (pullback i t : Scheme.{u})) :
    RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular
      (X.presheaf.stalk (i (pullback.fst i t w))) (c.stalkEquations w)
proof:
:= by
  exact isWeaklyRegular_map_ringEquiv
    (targetStalkIsoOfIsIsoSquare i (pullback.snd i t)
      (pullback.fst i t) t pullback.condition w).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
    (c.localStalkEquations_regular w)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.KoszulOpenPullbackChart.At.ker_stalkMap

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.genericRank_pullback
statement:
theorem genericRank_pullback {Y X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y] (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (M : X.Modules) (hM : IsFiniteLocallyFree X M) :
    SingularCurve.genericRank Y ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M) =
      SingularCurve.genericRank X M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin⟩ := hM.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := hqfin
  let C := pullbackLocalGeneratorsOpenCover f q
  let I : C.I₀ → Type u := fun i ↦ (q.generators i).I
  letI : ∀ i, Finite (I i) := fun i ↦ by
    letI : (q.generators i).IsFiniteType :=
      SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType i
    dsimp only [I]
    infer_instance
  let D := freeTrivializedOpenCoverLocalGeneratorsData C ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj M) I
    (pullbackLocalGeneratorsOpenCoverIso f q)
  let i := C.idx (genericPoint Y)
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := C.covers (genericPoint Y)
  have hηi : genericPoint Y ∈ D.X i := ⟨w, hw⟩
  rw [SingularCurve.genericRank_eq_natCard_localGenerators Y _ D i hηi]
  have hfx : f (genericPoint Y) ∈ q.X i := by
    rw [← hw]
    change f ((pullback.fst f ((localGeneratorsOpenCover q).f i)) w) ∈ q.X i
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, pullback.condition, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact ((pullback.snd f ((localGeneratorsOpenCover q).f i)) w).2
  have hηX : genericPoint X ∈ q.X i :=
    ((genericPoint_spec X).specializes (Set.mem_univ _)).mem_open (q.X i).isOpen hfx
  exact (SingularCurve.genericRank_eq_natCard_localGenerators X M q i hηX).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_not_specializes
statement:
theorem c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_not_specializes (a : LocalEquations X) {v y : X}
    (h : ¬ v ⤳ y) : c1CapPrimeCoeff a v y = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold c1CapPrimeCoeff
  rw [dif_neg h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.ringKrullDim_quotient_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_eq_one_iff (v : X) (z : pointClosureScheme v) :
    ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk (pointClosureι v z) ⧸
        Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (specializes_pointClosureι v z)) = 1 ↔
      coheight z = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [ringKrullDim_quotient_stalkPrime]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact_mod_cast h
  · intro h
    rw [h]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_pointClosureι
statement:
theorem c1CapPrimeCoeff_pointClosureι (a : LocalEquations X) (v : X) (z : pointClosureScheme v) :
    c1CapPrimeCoeff a v (pointClosureι v z) =
      if coheight z = 1 then
        ((CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity (a (pointClosureι v z))
          (specializes_pointClosureι v z)).toNat : ℤ)
      else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold c1CapPrimeCoeff
  rw [dif_pos (specializes_pointClosureι v z)]
  by_cases hz : coheight z = 1
  · rw [if_pos ((ringKrullDim_quotient_eq_one_iff v z).mpr hz), if_pos hz]
  · rw [if_neg (fun h ↦ hz ((ringKrullDim_quotient_eq_one_iff v z).mp h)), if_neg hz]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_ord
statement:
theorem c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_ord [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (a : LocalEquations X) (v : X)
    (z : pointClosureScheme v) (hz : coheight z = 1)
    (ha : a (pointClosureι v z) ∉ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (specializes_pointClosureι v z)) :
    c1CapPrimeCoeff a v (pointClosureι v z) =
      (pointClosureScheme v).ord
        (algebraMap ((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalk z) (pointClosureScheme v).functionField
          (((pointClosureι v).stalkMap z).hom (a (pointClosureι v z)))) z
proof:
:= by
  rw [c1CapPrimeCoeff_pointClosureι, if_pos hz]
  exact localMultiplicity_toNat_eq_ord v z hz _ ha

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.coheight_eq_one_iff_coheight_pointClosureι
statement:
theorem coheight_eq_one_iff_coheight_pointClosureι {p : ℕ} (v : X) (hv : coheight v = p)
    (z : pointClosureScheme v)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk (pointClosureι v z) ⧸
        Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (specializes_pointClosureι v z)) +
        (((Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (specializes_pointClosureι v z)).height : ℕ∞) :
          WithBot ℕ∞) =
      ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk (pointClosureι v z))) :
    coheight z = 1 ↔ coheight (pointClosureι v z) = ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coheight_pointClosureι v z hdim, hv]
  induction hco : coheight z using ENat.recTopCoe with
  | top =>
    refine ⟨fun h ↦ absurd h (by simp), fun h ↦ absurd h ?_⟩
    rw [add_top]
    exact ENat.top_ne_coe _
  | coe n =>
    constructor
    · intro h
      have : n = 1 := by exact_mod_cast h
      subst this
      rfl
    · intro h
      have h' : p + n = p + 1 := by exact_mod_cast h
      have : n = 1 := by omega
      rw [this]
      rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.codimension_pointClosureι
statement:
theorem codimension_pointClosureι (hdf : StalkDimensionFormula X) {p : ℕ} (v : X)
    (hv : coheight v = p) :
    ∀ z : pointClosureScheme v, coheight z = 1 →
      coheight (pointClosureι v z) = ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
proof:
:=
  fun z hz ↦ coheight_pointClosureι_eq_succ v hv z hz (hdf _ _ inferInstance)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.c1CapPrime_eq_classOf_withFrame
statement:
theorem c1CapPrime_eq_classOf_withFrame [IsLocallyNoetherian X] {p : ℕ} (v : X)
    (hcod : ∀ z : pointClosureScheme v, coheight z = 1 →
      coheight (pointClosureι v z) = ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
    {bpoint : pointClosureScheme v}
    (b : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme v)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj L) bpoint) :
    c1CapPrime L hL hrank v hcod =
      gradedClassOf X (p + 1) (closedImmersionPushforwardCycles (pointClosureι v) hcod
        ((Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame
          (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosureι L hL v)
          (genericRank_pullback_pointClosureι L hL hrank v) b : WeilDivisor _) :
            CodimensionCycles _ ℤ 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [c1CapPrime, Scheme.Modules.lineBundleFirstChernClass,
    Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorClass_eq_withFrame _ _ b,
    Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorClassWithFrame, codimensionOneToGradedChow_classOf,
    closedImmersionPushforwardChow_classOf]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.c1CapPrimeRepresentative_eq_coeff
statement:
theorem c1CapPrimeRepresentative_eq_coeff [IsLocallyNoetherian X] {p : ℕ} (v : X)
    (hcod : ∀ z : pointClosureScheme v, coheight z = 1 →
      coheight (pointClosureι v z) = ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
    {bpoint : pointClosureScheme v}
    (b : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme v)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj L) bpoint)
    (a : LocalEquations X)
    (hloc : ∀ z : pointClosureScheme v, coheight z = 1 →
      a (pointClosureι v z) ∉ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (specializes_pointClosureι v z) ∧
      ∃ (w : pointClosureScheme v) (d : Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData (pointClosureScheme v)
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pointClosureι v)).obj L) w),
        z ∈ d.U ∧ b.regularTransitionFunction d =
          algebraMap ((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalk z) (pointClosureScheme v).functionField
            (((pointClosureι v).stalkMap z).hom (a (pointClosureι v z)))) :
    ⇑(closedImmersionPushforwardCycles (pointClosureι v) hcod
        ((Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame
          (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosureι L hL v)
          (genericRank_pullback_pointClosureι L hL hrank v) b : WeilDivisor _) :
            CodimensionCycles _ ℤ 1)).1 = c1CapPrimeCoeff a v
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι v)
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [closedImmersionPushforwardCycles_apply]
    change Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame _ _ b z = _
    by_cases hz : coheight z = 1
    · obtain ⟨ha, w, d, hzd, htr⟩ := hloc z hz
      rw [Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame_eq_on_localData _ _ b d z hzd, htr,
        c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_ord a v z hz ha]
    · rw [c1CapPrimeCoeff_pointClosureι, if_neg hz]
      exact Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hz _
  · rw [closedImmersionPushforwardCycles_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range _ _ _ x hx,
      c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_not_specializes]
    intro h
    apply hx
    rw [range_pointClosureι]
    exact specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.c1CapCycles_primeCycle
statement:
theorem c1CapCycles_primeCycle [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [CompactSpace X]
    (hdf : StalkDimensionFormula X) {p : ℕ} (v : X) (hv : coheight v = p) :
    c1CapCycles L hL hrank hdf p (primeCycle v p hv) =
      c1CapPrime L hL hrank v (codimension_pointClosureι hdf v hv)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsingle : compactCycleFinsupp (primeCycle v p hv).1 = Finsupp.single v 1 := by
    ext x
    rw [compactCycleFinsupp_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
    by_cases hx : x = v
    · subst hx
      simp
    · rw [primeCycle_apply_of_ne v x p hv hx, if_neg (Ne.symm hx)]
  show (compactCycleFinsupp (primeCycle v p hv).1).sum
    (fun w n ↦ n • c1CapPrimeOrZero L hL hrank hdf p w) = _
  rw [hsingle, Finsupp.sum_single_index (zero_zsmul _), one_zsmul, c1CapPrimeOrZero,
    dif_pos hv]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SurfaceDegreeNormalization.affineNormalizationFiniteType_of_locallyOfFiniteType
statement:
theorem affineNormalizationFiniteType_of_locallyOfFiniteType {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Y]
    (π : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType π] :
    AffineNormalizationFiniteType Y
proof:
:= by
  intro U
  letI := ((SingularCurve.genericPointMorphism Y).app U.1).hom.toAlgebra
  change (algebraMap Γ(Y, U.1) (integralClosure Γ(Y, U.1)
    Γ(Spec (Y.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint Y)),
      (SingularCurve.genericPointMorphism Y) ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))).FiniteType
  exact (RingHom.finite_algebraMap.mpr
    (RiemannRoch.NoetherFiniteness.finite_integralClosure_fromSpecStalk_app π U.2)).finiteType

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SurfaceDegreeNormalization.normalizationMorphism_isFinite_of_locallyOfFiniteType
statement:
theorem normalizationMorphism_isFinite_of_locallyOfFiniteType {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Y]
    (π : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType π] :
    IsFinite (SingularCurve.normalizationMorphism Y)
proof:
:=
  normalizationMorphism_isFinite_of_affineNormalizationFiniteType Y
    (affineNormalizationFiniteType_of_locallyOfFiniteType π)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.morphismLocalLength_eq_length_quotient_ker
statement:
theorem morphismLocalLength_eq_length_quotient_ker
    {Z X : Scheme.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion f] (z : Z) :
    morphismLocalLength f z =
      Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk (f z))
        ((X.presheaf.stalk (f z)) ⧸ RingHom.ker (f.stalkMap z).hom)
proof:
:= by
  unfold morphismLocalLength
  letI : Algebra ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (f z)) ↑(Z.presheaf.stalk z) :=
    (f.stalkMap z).hom.toAlgebra
  let eRing :
      (↑(X.presheaf.stalk (f z)) ⧸ RingHom.ker (f.stalkMap z).hom) ≃+*
        ↑(Z.presheaf.stalk z) :=
    RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective (f.stalkMap_surjective z)
  let eAlg :
      (↑(X.presheaf.stalk (f z)) ⧸ RingHom.ker (f.stalkMap z).hom) ≃ₐ[
        ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (f z))] ↑(Z.presheaf.stalk z) :=
    AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := eRing) (by
      intro r
      exact RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective_apply_mk
        (f.stalkMap_surjective z) r)
  exact eAlg.toLinearEquiv.length_eq.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.morphismLocalLength_eq_length_principalQuotient
statement:
theorem morphismLocalLength_eq_length_principalQuotient
    {Z X : Scheme.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion f] (z : Z)

    (hker : RingHom.ker (f.stalkMap z).hom = Ideal.span {a}) :
    morphismLocalLength f z =
      Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk (f z))
        ((X.presheaf.stalk (f z)) ⧸ Ideal.span {a})
proof:
:= by
  rw [morphismLocalLength_eq_length_quotient_ker f z, hker]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.div_algebraMap_eq_morphismLocalLength_toNat
statement:
theorem div_algebraMap_eq_morphismLocalLength_toNat
    {Z X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (f : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion f] (z : Z)
    (hx : coheight (f z) = 1)
    (a : X.presheaf.stalk (f z)) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hker : RingHom.ker (f.stalkMap z).hom = Ideal.span {a}) :
    div (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (f z)) X.functionField a) (f z) =
      ((morphismLocalLength f z).toNat : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [morphismLocalLength_eq_length_principalQuotient f z a hker,
    Scheme.div_algebraMap_eq_length_toNat hx a ha]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteClosedIntersectionData.principalDivisor_apply_eq_localMultiplicity
statement:
theorem principalDivisor_apply_eq_localMultiplicity
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {p : ℕ} [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (d : FiniteClosedIntersectionData X p) (z : d.intersection)
    (hx : coheight (d.toX z) = 1)
    (a : X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z)) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hker : RingHom.ker (d.toX.stalkMap z).hom = Ideal.span {a}) :
    div (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z)) X.functionField a) (d.toX z) =
      (d.localMultiplicity z : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  change div (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z)) X.functionField a) (d.toX z) =
    ((morphismLocalLength d.toX z).toNat : ℤ)
  exact div_algebraMap_eq_morphismLocalLength_toNat d.toX z hx a ha hker

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionPrimeIntersectionData.cycle_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range_y
statement:
theorem ExpectedCodimensionPrimeIntersectionData.cycle_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range_y
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] {p q : ℕ}
    (d : ExpectedCodimensionPrimeIntersectionData X p q) (t : X)
    (ht : t ∉ Set.range (pointClosureι d.y)) :
    d.cycle.1 t = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  have hmem : t ∈ d.cycle.1.support := hne
  rw [d.cycle_support] at hmem
  obtain ⟨w, -, rfl⟩ := hmem
  apply ht
  refine ⟨pullback.snd (pointClosureι d.x) (pointClosureι d.y) w, ?_⟩
  calc pointClosureι d.y (pullback.snd (pointClosureι d.x) (pointClosureι d.y) w)
      = (pullback.snd (pointClosureι d.x) (pointClosureι d.y) ≫ pointClosureι d.y) w :=
        (Scheme.Hom.comp_apply _ _ _).symm
    _ = (pullback.fst (pointClosureι d.x) (pointClosureι d.y) ≫ pointClosureι d.x) w := by
        rw [pullback.condition]
    _ = d.toExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.toX w := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SurfaceExpectedRestrictionOrderData.restriction_cycle_eq_expectedIntersectionCycle
statement:
theorem restriction_cycle_eq_expectedIntersectionCycle
    (P : SurfaceExpectedRestrictionOrderData g hg z hcycle) :
    (g.surfaceRestrictionRelationAt hg z hcycle).cycle =
      expectedIntersectionCycle
        (g.cyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_primeCycle_of_apply_eq_zero z hcycle)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [expectedIntersectionCycle_eq_sum_primeCycle z
    (g.cyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_primeCycle_of_apply_eq_zero z hcycle)]
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext t
  by_cases ht : t ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι z.1)
  · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := ht
    have hleft : (g.surfaceRestrictionRelationAt hg z hcycle).cycle.1
        (pointClosureι z.1 y) = div (g.surfaceRestrictionRelationAt hg z hcycle).f y := by
      have h := RationalRelationGenerator.cycle_apply_i
        (g.surfaceRestrictionRelationAt hg z hcycle) y
      change (g.surfaceRestrictionRelationAt hg z hcycle).cycle.1 (pointClosureι z.1 y) =
        div (g.surfaceRestrictionRelationAt hg z hcycle).f y at h
      exact h
    have hterm : ∀ x : (compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1).support,
        (compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1 x •
            (expectedPrimeIntersectionData
              (g.cyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_primeCycle_of_apply_eq_zero z hcycle)
              x (primeCycleSupportPoint z)).cycle).1 (pointClosureι z.1 y) =
          compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1 x *
            (expectedPrimeIntersectionData
              (g.cyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_primeCycle_of_apply_eq_zero z hcycle)
              x (primeCycleSupportPoint z)).cycle.1 (pointClosureι z.1 y) := by
      intro x
      change compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1 x •
          (expectedPrimeIntersectionData
            (g.cyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_primeCycle_of_apply_eq_zero z hcycle)
            x (primeCycleSupportPoint z)).cycle.1 (pointClosureι z.1 y) = _
      simp
    rw [hleft, P.order_eq y]
    simp only [AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum, Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_sum,
      Finset.sum_apply]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ ↦ (hterm x).symm
  · have hleft : (g.surfaceRestrictionRelationAt hg z hcycle).cycle.1 t = 0 := by
      apply RationalRelationGenerator.cycle_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range
      exact ht
    have hterm : ∀ x : (compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1).support,
        (compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1 x •
            (expectedPrimeIntersectionData
              (g.cyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_primeCycle_of_apply_eq_zero z hcycle)
              x (primeCycleSupportPoint z)).cycle).1 t = 0 := by
      intro x
      have hzero := ExpectedCodimensionPrimeIntersectionData.cycle_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range_y
        (expectedPrimeIntersectionData
          (g.cyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_primeCycle_of_apply_eq_zero z hcycle)
          x (primeCycleSupportPoint z)) t ht
      change compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1 x •
          (expectedPrimeIntersectionData
            (g.cyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_primeCycle_of_apply_eq_zero z hcycle)
            x (primeCycleSupportPoint z)).cycle.1 t = 0
      rw [hzero, smul_zero]
    rw [hleft]
    symm
    simp only [AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum, Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_sum,
      Finset.sum_apply]
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun x _ ↦ hterm x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SurfaceExpectedRestrictionOrderData.expectedIntersectionCycle_mem_rationalEquivalenceSubgroup
statement:
theorem expectedIntersectionCycle_mem_rationalEquivalenceSubgroup
    (P : SurfaceExpectedRestrictionOrderData g hg z hcycle) :

        (g.cyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_primeCycle_of_apply_eq_zero z hcycle) ∈

proof:
