name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SurfaceExpectedRestrictionFactorizationData.toOrderData
statement:
theorem SurfaceExpectedRestrictionFactorizationData.toOrderData
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNoetherian X]
    [IsRegularInCodimensionOne X] [Order.KrullDimLE 2 X]
    {g : RationalRelationGenerator X 1} {hg : g.cycle ≠ 0}
    {z : CodimensionPoint X 1} {hcycle : g.cycle.1 z.1 = 0}
    (P : SurfaceExpectedRestrictionFactorizationData g hg z hcycle) :
    SurfaceExpectedRestrictionOrderData g hg z hcycle where
  order_eq
proof:
:= by
    classical
    intro y
    have hcycleEq := P.restriction_cycle_eq_expectedIntersectionCycle
    rw [expectedIntersectionCycle_eq_sum_primeCycle z
      (g.cyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_primeCycle_of_apply_eq_zero z hcycle)] at hcycleEq
    have h := congrArg
      (fun D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ 2 ↦ D.1 (pointClosureι z.1 y)) hcycleEq
    simp only [AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum, Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_sum,
      Finset.sum_apply] at h
    have hleft : (g.surfaceRestrictionRelationAt hg z hcycle).cycle.1
        (pointClosureι z.1 y) = div (g.surfaceRestrictionRelationAt hg z hcycle).f y := by
      have h' := RationalRelationGenerator.cycle_apply_i
        (g.surfaceRestrictionRelationAt hg z hcycle) y
      change (g.surfaceRestrictionRelationAt hg z hcycle).cycle.1 (pointClosureι z.1 y) =
        div (g.surfaceRestrictionRelationAt hg z hcycle).f y at h'
      exact h'
    have hterm : ∀ x : (compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1).support,
        (compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1 x •
            (expectedPrimeIntersectionData
              (g.cyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_primeCycle_of_apply_eq_zero z hcycle)
              x (primeCycleSupportPoint z)).cycle).1 (pointClosureι z.1 y) =
          compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1 x *
            (expectedPrimeIntersectionData
              (g.cyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_primeCycle_of_apply_eq_zero z hcycle)
              x (primeCycleSupportPoint z)).cycle.1 (pointClosureι z.1 y) := by
      intro x
      change compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1 x •
          (expectedPrimeIntersectionData
            (g.cyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_primeCycle_of_apply_eq_zero z hcycle)
            x (primeCycleSupportPoint z)).cycle.1 (pointClosureι z.1 y) = _
      simp
    rw [← hleft, h]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ ↦ hterm x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SurfaceExpectedRestrictionLocalTheory.relation_expectedIntersectionCycle_mem_rationalEquivalenceSubgroup
statement:
theorem relation_expectedIntersectionCycle_mem_rationalEquivalenceSubgroup
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNoetherian X]
    [IsRegularInCodimensionOne X] [Order.KrullDimLE 2 X]
    (T : SurfaceExpectedRestrictionLocalTheory X)
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X 1) (E : CodimensionCycles X ℤ 1)
    (h : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension g.cycle E) :
    expectedIntersectionCycle h ∈ rationalEquivalenceSubgroup X 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hg : g.cycle = 0
  · letI : IsEmpty ((compactCycleFinsupp g.cycle.1).support) :=
      ⟨fun x ↦ by
        have hx := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp x.2
        rw [compactCycleFinsupp_apply] at hx
        have hx0 : g.cycle.1 x.1 = 0 := by
          simpa using congrArg
            (fun c : CodimensionCycles X ℤ 1 ↦ c.1 x.1) hg
        exact hx hx0⟩
    have hzero : expectedIntersectionCycle h = 0 := by
      rw [expectedIntersectionCycle]
      simp
    rw [hzero]
    exact AddSubgroup.zero_mem _
  · rw [expectedIntersectionCycle_eq_sum_right_primeCycle h]
    apply AddSubgroup.sum_mem _
    intro y hy
    let hz : coheight y.1 = 1 := E.2 (by
      change E.1 y.1 ≠ 0
      simpa only [compactCycleFinsupp_apply] using
        Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp y.2)
    let z : CodimensionPoint X 1 := ⟨y.1, hz⟩
    let hyMeeting := h.rightPrimeMeeting y
    have hcycle : g.cycle.1 z.1 = 0 :=
      cycle_apply_eq_zero_of_cyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_primeCycle
        g.cycle z hyMeeting
    let P := T.orderData g hg z hcycle
    apply AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem _ _
    have hm := P.expectedIntersectionCycle_mem_rationalEquivalenceSubgroup
    have heq : expectedIntersectionCycle hyMeeting =
        expectedIntersectionCycle
          (g.cyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_primeCycle_of_apply_eq_zero z hcycle) :=
      expectedIntersectionCycle_proof_irrel _ _
    rw [heq]
    exact hm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SurfaceExpectedRestrictionLocalTheory.expectedIntersectionCycle_relation_mem_rationalEquivalenceSubgroup
statement:
theorem expectedIntersectionCycle_relation_mem_rationalEquivalenceSubgroup
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNoetherian X]
    [IsRegularInCodimensionOne X] [Order.KrullDimLE 2 X]
    (T : SurfaceExpectedRestrictionLocalTheory X)
    (D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ 1) (g : RationalRelationGenerator X 1)
    (h : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D g.cycle) :
    expectedIntersectionCycle h ∈ rationalEquivalenceSubgroup X 2
proof:
:= by
  have hm := T.relation_expectedIntersectionCycle_mem_rationalEquivalenceSubgroup
    g D h.symm
  have heq : expectedIntersectionCycle h.symm = expectedIntersectionCycle h := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact expectedIntersectionCycle_symm h
  rw [heq] at hm
  exact hm

statement:
theorem SurfaceExpectedRestrictionTheory.toLocalTheory
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsNoetherian X]

    (T : SurfaceExpectedRestrictionTheory X) :
    SurfaceExpectedRestrictionLocalTheory X where

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.map_mem_genericPoints_iff_of_iso
statement:
theorem map_mem_genericPoints_iff_of_iso (e : W ≅ Z) (w : W) :
    e.hom w ∈ genericPoints Z ↔ w ∈ genericPoints W
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_genericPoints_iff_coheight_eq_zero,
    mem_genericPoints_iff_coheight_eq_zero,
    Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.coheight_eq e.hom e.hom.isOpenEmbedding]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.selfLocalLength_iso
statement:
theorem selfLocalLength_iso (e : W ≅ Z) (w : W) :
    selfLocalLength w = selfLocalLength (e.hom w)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    selfLocalLength w = morphismLocalLength e.hom w :=
      selfLocalLength_eq_morphismLocalLength_closedImmersion e.hom w
    _ = morphismLocalLength (𝟙 Z) (e.hom w) := by
      simpa using morphismLocalLength_comp_iso e (𝟙 Z) w
    _ = selfLocalLength (e.hom w) :=
      (selfLocalLength_eq_morphismLocalLength_closedImmersion (𝟙 Z) (e.hom w)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.genericMultiplicity_iso
statement:
theorem genericMultiplicity_iso (e : W ≅ Z) (w : W) :
    genericMultiplicity w = genericMultiplicity (e.hom w)
proof:
:=
  congrArg ENat.toNat (selfLocalLength_iso e w)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.fundamentalCycle_apply_iso
statement:
theorem fundamentalCycle_apply_iso (e : W ≅ Z) (w : W) :
    fundamentalCycle W w = fundamentalCycle Z (e.hom w)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hw : w ∈ genericPoints W
  · have hew : e.hom w ∈ genericPoints Z :=
      (map_mem_genericPoints_iff_of_iso e w).mpr hw
    rw [fundamentalCycle_apply_of_mem_genericPoints hw,
      fundamentalCycle_apply_of_mem_genericPoints hew]
    exact_mod_cast genericMultiplicity_iso e w
  · have hew : e.hom w ∉ genericPoints Z := by
      simpa only [map_mem_genericPoints_iff_of_iso e w] using hw
    rw [fundamentalCycle_apply_of_not_mem_genericPoints hw,
      fundamentalCycle_apply_of_not_mem_genericPoints hew]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.fundamentalCycle_pushforward_iso
statement:
theorem fundamentalCycle_pushforward_iso (e : W ≅ Z) :
    AlgebraicCycle.pushforward e.hom (fundamentalCycle W)
      (fun _ ↦ (0 : ℕ∞)) coheight = fundamentalCycle Z
proof:
:= by
  have hgrade : ∀ w : W, fundamentalCycle W w ≠ 0 →
      (0 : ℕ∞) = coheight (e.hom w) := by
    intro w hw
    have hwG : w ∈ genericPoints W := by
      rw [← fundamentalCycle_support]
      exact hw
    exact (coheight_eq_zero_of_mem_genericPoints
      ((map_mem_genericPoints_iff_of_iso e w).mpr hwG)).symm
  ext z
  let w : W := e.inv z
  have hwz : e.hom w = z := (Scheme.homeoOfIso e).right_inv z
  rw [← hwz,
    AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_closedImmersion e.hom (fundamentalCycle W)
      (fun _ ↦ (0 : ℕ∞)) coheight hgrade w]
  exact fundamentalCycle_apply_iso e w

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.intersectionSymmetry_inv_comp_toX
statement:
theorem intersectionSymmetry_inv_comp_toX :
    d.intersectionSymmetry.inv ≫ d.toX = pullback.fst d.j d.i ≫ d.j
proof:
:= by

    pullbackSymmetry_inv_comp_fst]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.intersectionSymmetry_hom_comp_swap_toX
statement:
theorem intersectionSymmetry_hom_comp_swap_toX :
    d.intersectionSymmetry.hom ≫ d.swap.toX = d.toX
proof:
:= by
  change d.intersectionSymmetry.hom ≫
      (pullback.fst d.j d.i ≫ d.j) = d.toX
  rw [intersectionSymmetry, toX, ← Category.assoc,
    pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_fst]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.range_swap_toX
statement: theorem range_swap_toX : Set.range d.swap.toX = Set.range d.toX
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨d.intersectionSymmetry.inv z, ?_⟩
    exact schemeHom_apply_eq_of_eq d.intersectionSymmetry_inv_comp_toX z
  · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨d.intersectionSymmetry.hom z, ?_⟩
    exact schemeHom_apply_eq_of_eq d.intersectionSymmetry_hom_comp_swap_toX z

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.cycle_apply_toX_fundamental
statement:
private theorem cycle_apply_toX_fundamental (z : d.intersection) :
    d.cycle.1 (d.toX z) = fundamentalCycle d.intersection z
proof:
:= by
  have hgrade : ∀ w : d.intersection,
      fundamentalCycle d.intersection w ≠ 0 →
        (r : ℕ∞) = coheight (d.toX w) := by
    intro w hw
    apply (d.codimension w ?_).symm
    rw [← fundamentalCycle_support]
    exact hw
  change (AlgebraicCycle.pushforward d.toX (fundamentalCycle d.intersection)
    (fun _ ↦ (r : ℕ∞)) coheight) (d.toX z) = _
  exact AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_closedImmersion d.toX
    (fundamentalCycle d.intersection) (fun _ ↦ (r : ℕ∞)) coheight hgrade z

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.swap_cycle
statement: theorem swap_cycle : d.swap.cycle = d.cycle
proof:
:= by
  let f : pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) d.j d.i ⟶ X :=
    pullback.fst d.j d.i ≫ d.j
  letI : IsClosedImmersion f := by
    dsimp only [f]
    infer_instance
  letI : CompactSpace (pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) d.j d.i) :=
    f.isClosedEmbedding.compactSpace
  letI : IsNoetherian (pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) d.j d.i) :=
    { __ := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian f }
  letI : IsNoetherian d.swap.intersection :=
    ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.instIsNoetherianIntersection d.swap
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.range d.toX
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hx
    have hpoint : d.swap.toX (d.intersectionSymmetry.hom z) = d.toX z :=
      schemeHom_apply_eq_of_eq d.intersectionSymmetry_hom_comp_swap_toX z
    calc
      d.swap.cycle.1 (d.toX z) =
          d.swap.cycle.1 (d.swap.toX (d.intersectionSymmetry.hom z)) := by
        rw [hpoint]
      _ = fundamentalCycle d.swap.intersection (d.intersectionSymmetry.hom z) :=
        d.swap.cycle_apply_toX_fundamental _
      _ = fundamentalCycle d.intersection z :=
        (fundamentalCycle_apply_iso d.intersectionSymmetry z).symm
      _ = d.cycle.1 (d.toX z) := (d.cycle_apply_toX_fundamental z).symm
  · have hxswap : x ∉ Set.range d.swap.toX := by
      rwa [d.range_swap_toX]
    have hd0 : d.cycle.1 x = 0 := by
      change (AlgebraicCycle.pushforward d.toX (fundamentalCycle d.intersection)
        (fun _ ↦ (r : ℕ∞)) coheight) x = 0
      exact AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range d.toX
        (fundamentalCycle d.intersection) (fun _ ↦ (r : ℕ∞)) coheight x hx
    have hswap0 : d.swap.cycle.1 x = 0 := by
      change (AlgebraicCycle.pushforward d.swap.toX (fundamentalCycle d.swap.intersection)
        (fun _ ↦ (r : ℕ∞)) coheight) x = 0
      exact AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range d.swap.toX
        (fundamentalCycle d.swap.intersection) (fun _ ↦ (r : ℕ∞)) coheight x hxswap
    rw [hd0, hswap0]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionPrimeIntersectionData.swap_cycle
statement: theorem swap_cycle : d.swap.cycle.1 = d.cycle.1
proof:
:= by
  let s := d.toExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData
  let Y : Scheme.{u} := pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) (pointClosureι d.y) (pointClosureι d.x)
  let f : Y ⟶ X :=
    pullback.fst (pointClosureι d.y) (pointClosureι d.x) ≫ pointClosureι d.y
  letI : IsClosedImmersion f := by
    dsimp only [f]
    infer_instance
  letI : CompactSpace Y := f.isClosedEmbedding.compactSpace
  letI : IsNoetherian Y := { __ := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian f }
  letI : IsNoetherian
      (pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) (pointClosureι d.swap.x) (pointClosureι d.swap.y)) := by
    change IsNoetherian Y
    infer_instance
  letI : IsNoetherian s.swap.intersection :=
    ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.instIsNoetherianIntersection s.swap
  have hleft : d.swap.cycle.1 = s.swap.cycle.1 := by
    change AlgebraicCycle.pushforward f (fundamentalCycle Y)
        (fun _ ↦ ((q + p : ℕ) : ℕ∞)) coheight =
      AlgebraicCycle.pushforward f (fundamentalCycle Y)
        (fun _ ↦ ((p + q : ℕ) : ℕ∞)) coheight
    apply AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_eq_closedImmersion
    · intro z hz
      apply (d.swap.codimension z ?_).symm
      rw [← fundamentalCycle_support]
      exact hz
    · intro z hz
      apply (s.swap.codimension z ?_).symm
      rw [← fundamentalCycle_support]
      exact hz
  calc
    d.swap.cycle.1 = s.swap.cycle.1 := hleft
    _ = s.cycle.1 := congrArg Subtype.val s.swap_cycle
    _ = d.cycle.1 := rfl

name: ModuleCat.mem_maximalIdeal_of_ringKrullDim_add_length_eq
statement:
theorem mem_maximalIdeal_of_ringKrullDim_add_length_eq [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (rs : List R)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList rs) + rs.length = ringKrullDim R)
    {r : R} (hr : r ∈ rs) : r ∈ maximalIdeal R
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hrm
  have hunit : IsUnit r := notMem_maximalIdeal.mp hrm
  have htop : Ideal.ofList rs = ⊤ :=
    Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ (Ideal.subset_span hr) hunit
  have hbot : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList rs) = ⊥ := by
    rw [htop]; exact ringKrullDim_eq_bot_of_subsingleton
  have hne : ringKrullDim R ≠ ⊥ :=
    (lt_of_lt_of_le (WithBot.bot_lt_coe 0) ringKrullDim_nonneg_of_nontrivial).ne'
  exact hne (by simpa [hbot] using hdim.symm)

name: ModuleCat.ringKrullDim_le_ringKrullDim_ofList_add_length
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_le_ringKrullDim_ofList_add_length
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (rs : List R) (hmem : ∀ r ∈ rs, r ∈ maximalIdeal R) :
    ringKrullDim R ≤ ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList rs) + rs.length
proof:
:= by
  induction hn : rs.length generalizing R rs with
  | zero =>
    have hrs : rs = [] := List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero hn
    subst hrs
    rw [Ideal.ofList_nil, Nat.cast_zero, add_zero,
      ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (RingEquiv.quotientBot R)]
  | succ n ih =>
    match rs with
    | [] => cases hn
    | r :: rs =>
      have hrm : r ∈ maximalIdeal R := hmem r (by simp)
      have hmem' : ∀ a ∈ rs, a ∈ maximalIdeal R := fun a ha ↦ hmem a (by simp [ha])
      have hspan : (r • (⊤ : Ideal R)) = Ideal.span {r} := by
        ext y
        simp [Ideal.mem_span_singleton, Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists, eq_comm,
          dvd_iff_exists_eq_mul_right]
      have h1 : ringKrullDim R ≤ ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span {r}) + 1 := by
        rw [← hspan]
        exact ringKrullDim_le_ringKrullDim_quotSMulTop_succ hrm
      let Q := R ⧸ Ideal.span {r}
      letI : IsLocalRing Q := quotientSpanIsLocalRing R r hrm
      letI : IsNoetherianRing Q := Ideal.Quotient.isNoetherianRing _
      letI : IsLocalHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {r})) :=
        IsLocalHom.of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
      let rsQ : List Q := rs.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {r}))
      have hmemQ : ∀ q ∈ rsQ, q ∈ maximalIdeal Q := by
        intro q hq
        rcases List.mem_map.mp hq with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
        exact map_nonunit _ a (hmem' a ha)
      have hlen : rsQ.length = n := by
        simp only [rsQ, List.length_map]
        simpa [List.length_cons] using hn
      have h2 :
          ringKrullDim Q ≤ ringKrullDim (Q ⧸ Ideal.ofList rsQ) + rsQ.length := by
        simpa [hlen] using ih (R := Q) rsQ hmemQ hlen
      have hrsQ :
          Ideal.ofList rsQ =
            Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {r})) (Ideal.ofList rs) := by
        dsimp [rsQ]
        exact (Ideal.map_ofList (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {r})) rs).symm
      have e : Q ⧸ Ideal.ofList rsQ ≃+* R ⧸ Ideal.ofList (r :: rs) := by
        refine (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hrsQ).trans ?_
        refine (DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotSup (Ideal.span {r}) (Ideal.ofList rs)).trans ?_
        exact Ideal.quotEquivOfEq (by simp [Ideal.ofList_cons, sup_comm])
      have h2' :
          ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span {r}) ≤
            ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList (r :: rs)) + rs.length := by
        simpa [ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv e.symm, List.length_map, Q, rsQ] using h2
      have hrs_len : rs.length = n := Nat.succ_injective (by simpa [List.length_cons] using hn)
      refine le_trans h1 ?_
      have h2'' :
          ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span {r}) + 1 ≤
            ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList (r :: rs)) + ↑(n + 1) := by
        simpa [hrs_len, Nat.cast_succ, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using
          add_le_add_right h2' 1
      exact h2''

name: ModuleCat.ringKrullDim_quotient_span_singleton_add_one_of_ofList_cons
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_span_singleton_add_one_of_ofList_cons [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (r : R) (rs : List R)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList (r :: rs)) + (rs.length + 1) = ringKrullDim R) :
    r ∈ maximalIdeal R ∧
      ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span {r}) + 1 = ringKrullDim R ∧
      ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList (r :: rs)) + rs.length =
        ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span {r})
proof:
:= by
  have hmem_all : ∀ a ∈ r :: rs, a ∈ maximalIdeal R := fun a ha ↦
    mem_maximalIdeal_of_ringKrullDim_add_length_eq (r :: rs) (by simpa using hdim) ha
  have hrm : r ∈ maximalIdeal R := hmem_all r (by simp)
  have hmem_tail : ∀ a ∈ rs, a ∈ maximalIdeal R := fun a ha ↦ hmem_all a (by simp [ha])
  have hspan : (r • (⊤ : Ideal R)) = Ideal.span {r} := by
    ext y
    simp [Ideal.mem_span_singleton, Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists, eq_comm,
      dvd_iff_exists_eq_mul_right]
  have hle₁ : ringKrullDim R ≤ ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span {r}) + 1 := by
    rw [← hspan]
    exact ringKrullDim_le_ringKrullDim_quotSMulTop_succ hrm
  let Q := R ⧸ Ideal.span {r}
  letI : IsLocalRing Q := quotientSpanIsLocalRing R r hrm
  letI : IsNoetherianRing Q := Ideal.Quotient.isNoetherianRing _
  letI : IsLocalHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {r})) :=
    IsLocalHom.of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  let rsQ : List Q := rs.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {r}))
  have hmemQ : ∀ q ∈ rsQ, q ∈ maximalIdeal Q := by
    intro q hq
    rcases List.mem_map.mp hq with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    exact map_nonunit _ a (hmem_tail a ha)
  have hle₂ :
      ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span {r}) ≤
        ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList (r :: rs)) + rs.length := by
    have h := ringKrullDim_le_ringKrullDim_ofList_add_length (R := Q) rsQ hmemQ
    have hrsQ :
        Ideal.ofList rsQ =
          Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {r})) (Ideal.ofList rs) := by
      dsimp [rsQ]
      exact (Ideal.map_ofList (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {r})) rs).symm
    have e : Q ⧸ Ideal.ofList rsQ ≃+* R ⧸ Ideal.ofList (r :: rs) := by
      refine (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hrsQ).trans ?_
      refine (DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotSup (Ideal.span {r}) (Ideal.ofList rs)).trans ?_
      exact Ideal.quotEquivOfEq (by simp [Ideal.ofList_cons, sup_comm])
    simpa [ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv e.symm, List.length_map, Q, rsQ] using h
  have hdrop : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span {r}) + 1 = ringKrullDim R := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · calc
        ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span {r}) + 1
            ≤ ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList (r :: rs)) + rs.length + 1 := by
          simpa [add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using add_le_add_right hle₂ 1
        _ = ringKrullDim R := by rw [← hdim, add_assoc, add_comm (rs.length : WithBot ℕ∞)]
    · exact hle₁
  have hsum :
      ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList (r :: rs)) + rs.length + 1 =
        ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span {r}) + 1 := by
    have h1 : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList (r :: rs)) + rs.length + 1 = ringKrullDim R := by
      rw [← hdim, add_assoc, add_comm (rs.length : WithBot ℕ∞)]
    rw [h1, hdrop]
  have heq : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList (r :: rs)) + rs.length =
      ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span {r}) :=
    (ENat.WithBot.add_one_cancel).mp hsum
  exact ⟨hrm, hdrop, heq⟩

name: ModuleCat.ringDepth_eq_of_quotIdeal_eq
statement:
theorem ringDepth_eq_of_quotIdeal_eq [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {I J : Ideal R} [IsLocalRing (R ⧸ I)] [IsLocalRing (R ⧸ J)] (hIJ : I = J) :
    ringDepth (R ⧸ I) = ringDepth (R ⧸ J)
proof:
:= by
  subst hIJ
  rfl

name: ModuleCat.ringDepth_quotient_span_singleton_add_one
statement:
theorem ringDepth_quotient_span_singleton_add_one [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (x : R) (hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal R) (hreg : IsSMulRegular R x) :
    @ringDepth (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) _ (quotientSpanIsLocalRing R x hx) + 1 =
      ringDepth R
proof:
:= by
  let Q := R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}
  letI : IsLocalRing Q := quotientSpanIsLocalRing R x hx
  letI : Algebra R Q := Ideal.Quotient.algebra _
  letI : IsScalarTower R Q Q := IsScalarTower.right
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine ENat.forall_natCast_le_iff_le.mp fun n hn => ?_
    rcases n with (_ | m)
    · exact bot_le
    · have hm : (m : ℕ∞) ≤ @ringDepth Q _ _ :=
        (ENat.add_le_add_iff_right (by simp : (1 : ℕ∞) ≠ ⊤)).mp hn
      rw [ringDepth, natCast_le_localDepth_iff_exists_isWeaklyRegular] at hm
      obtain ⟨qs, hlen, hmemQ, hregQ⟩ := hm
      classical
      have lifts : ∀ q ∈ qs, ∃ a ∈ maximalIdeal R, Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}) a = q := by
        intro q hq
        have hq' : q ∈ maximalIdeal Q := hmemQ q hq
        rw [← map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}))
          Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective] at hq'
        obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ :=
          (Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective).mp hq'
        exact ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      have hex_rs (l : List Q) (hmem : ∀ q ∈ l, q ∈ maximalIdeal Q) :
          ∃ rs : List R, rs.length = l.length ∧
            rs.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) = l ∧
            ∀ a ∈ rs, a ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
        induction l with
        | nil => exact ⟨[], by simp⟩
        | cons q0 tl ih =>
          have hq' : q0 ∈ maximalIdeal Q := hmem q0 List.mem_cons_self
          rw [← map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}))
            Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective] at hq'
          obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ :=
            (Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective).mp hq'
          obtain ⟨rs, hlen', hmap, hmemR⟩ :=
            ih (fun q hq => hmem q (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr hq)))
          exact ⟨a :: rs, by simp [hlen'], by simp [hmap],
            by intro b hb; cases hb with | head => exact ha | tail _ hb => exact hmemR b hb⟩
      obtain ⟨rs, hrslen, hrs_map, hmemR⟩ := hex_rs qs hmemQ
      let e : QuotSMulTop x R ≃ₗ[R] Q :=
        Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ (by rw [← Submodule.ideal_span_singleton_smul]; simp)
      have hreg_map : IsWeaklyRegular Q (rs.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}))) := by
        simpa [hrs_map] using hregQ
      have hreg_rs : IsWeaklyRegular Q rs :=
        (isWeaklyRegular_map_algebraMap_iff Q Q rs).mp hreg_map
      have hreg_quot : IsWeaklyRegular (QuotSMulTop x R) rs :=
        (e.isWeaklyRegular_congr rs).mpr hreg_rs
      exact show ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ ringDepth R by
        rw [ringDepth, natCast_le_localDepth_iff_exists_isWeaklyRegular]
        refine ⟨x :: rs, by simp [hrslen, hlen], ?_,
          (isWeaklyRegular_cons_iff R x rs).mpr ⟨hreg, hreg_quot⟩⟩
        intro a ha
        cases ha with
        | head => exact hx
        | tail _ ha => exact hmemR a ha
  · refine ENat.forall_natCast_le_iff_le.mp fun n hn => ?_
    rcases n with (_ | m)
    · exact bot_le
    · simpa [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_comm, add_left_comm] using
        add_le_add_right
          (natCast_le_ringDepth_quotient_of_succ_le_ringDepth R x hx hreg m hn) 1

name: ModuleCat.isSMulRegular_pow
statement:
theorem isSMulRegular_pow {x : R} (hx : IsSMulRegular R x) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, IsSMulRegular R (x ^ n)
  | 0 => IsSMulRegular.of_right_eq_zero_of_smul fun a ha => by simpa using ha
  | n + 1 => by
    refine IsSMulRegular.of_right_eq_zero_of_smul fun a ha => ?_
    have hx' : x • (x ^ n • a) = 0
proof:
:= by
      simpa [pow_succ', smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc] using ha
    exact (isSMulRegular_pow hx n).right_eq_zero_of_smul (hx.right_eq_zero_of_smul hx')

name: ModuleCat.associatedPrimes_map_quotient_mk
statement:
theorem associatedPrimes_map_quotient_mk [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {I q : Ideal R} (hle : I ≤ q)
    (hq : q ∈ associatedPrimes R (R ⧸ I)) :
    q.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) ∈ associatedPrimes (R ⧸ I) (R ⧸ I)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : q.IsPrime := (AssociatedPrimes.mem_iff.mp hq).isPrime
  haveI : (q.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).IsPrime :=
    Ideal.isPrime_map_quotientMk_of_isPrime hle
  rw [AssociatedPrimes.mem_iff, isAssociatedPrime_iff] at hq ⊢
  obtain ⟨_hqPrime, x, hqcolon⟩ := hq
  refine ⟨inferInstance, x, SetLike.ext fun a => ?_⟩
  have hcolon {b : R} : b ∈ q ↔ (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) b • x = 0 := by
    constructor
    · intro hb
      have hb' := Submodule.mem_colon_singleton.mp (hqcolon ▸ hb)
      simpa [Submodule.mem_bot, Algebra.smul_def, Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq] using hb'
    · intro hb
      exact hqcolon ▸ Submodule.mem_colon_singleton.mpr (by
        simpa [Submodule.mem_bot, Algebra.smul_def, Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq] using hb)
  constructor
  · intro ha
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hab⟩ :=
      (Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective).mp ha
    rw [Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, Submodule.mem_bot]
    rw [← hab, hcolon.mp hb]
  · intro ha
    rw [Submodule.mem_colon_singleton, Submodule.mem_bot] at ha
    refine (Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective).2 ?_
    refine ⟨Quotient.out a, hcolon.mpr ?_, Ideal.Quotient.mk_out a⟩
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.mk_out]
    exact ha

name: ModuleCat.exists_mem_associatedPrimes_quotient_pow_of_mem_minimalPrimes_sup
statement:
theorem exists_mem_associatedPrimes_quotient_pow_of_mem_minimalPrimes_sup [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {p : Ideal R} (hp : p ∈ associatedPrimes R R) (x : R)
    {q : Ideal R} (hq : q ∈ (p ⊔ Ideal.span {x}).minimalPrimes) :
    ∃ n > 0, q ∈ associatedPrimes R (R ⧸ (Ideal.span {x} ^ n : Ideal R))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [AssociatedPrimes.mem_iff, isAssociatedPrime_iff_exists_injective_linearMap] at hp
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨f, hf⟩⟩ := hp
  let N : Submodule R R := LinearMap.range f
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Ideal.exists_pow_inf_eq_pow_smul (Ideal.span {x}) N
  set n := k + 1
  have hnpos : 0 < n := Nat.succ_pos _
  have hAR : (Ideal.span {x} ^ n : Ideal R) • (⊤ : Submodule R R) ⊓ N ≤ Ideal.span {x} • N := by
    have h := hk n (Nat.le_succ _)
    have hk' : n - k = 1 := by
      dsimp [n]
      omega
    calc
      (Ideal.span {x} ^ n : Ideal R) • (⊤ : Submodule R R) ⊓ N
          = (Ideal.span {x} ^ (n - k)) • ((Ideal.span {x} ^ k : Ideal R) • (⊤ : Submodule R R) ⊓ N) := h
      _ = Ideal.span {x} • ((Ideal.span {x} ^ k : Ideal R) • (⊤ : Submodule R R) ⊓ N) := by
          rw [Ideal.span_singleton_pow x (n - k), hk', pow_one]
      _ ≤ Ideal.span {x} • N := by
          gcongr
          exact inf_le_right
  let I : Ideal R := Ideal.span {x} ^ n
  let Nbar : Submodule R (R ⧸ I) := N.map (Submodule.mkQ I)
  have hp_le_ann : p ≤ Module.annihilator R Nbar := by
    intro b hb
    refine Module.mem_annihilator.mpr fun y => ?_
    obtain ⟨z, hz, heq⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp y.property
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hft⟩ := LinearMap.mem_range.mp hz
    have hbt : b • t = 0 := by
      rw [Algebra.smul_def, Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hb]
      exact zero_mul t
    have hb0 : b • f t = 0 := by rw [← f.map_smul, hbt, map_zero]
    apply Subtype.ext
    show b • (y : R ⧸ I) = 0
    calc b • (y : R ⧸ I)
        = b • (Submodule.mkQ I) (f t) := by rw [← heq]
      _ = (Submodule.mkQ I) (b • f t) := (Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul I b (f t)).symm
      _ = 0 := by rw [hb0, map_zero]
  have hx_rad : x ∈ (Module.annihilator R Nbar).radical :=
    Ideal.mem_radical_iff.mpr ⟨n, Module.mem_annihilator.mpr fun y => by
      obtain ⟨z, hz, heq⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp y.property
      obtain ⟨t, ht, hft⟩ := LinearMap.mem_range.mp hz
      have hxI : x ^ n ∈ I := by
        simpa [I] using Ideal.pow_mem_pow (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self x) n
      apply Subtype.ext
      show (x ^ n) • (y : R ⧸ I) = 0
      calc (x ^ n) • (y : R ⧸ I)
          = (x ^ n) • (Submodule.mkQ I) (f t) := by rw [← heq]
        _ = (Submodule.mkQ I) ((x ^ n) • f t) := (Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul I (x ^ n) (f t)).symm
        _ = (Submodule.mkQ I) (x ^ n * f t) := by simp [Algebra.smul_def]
        _ = 0 := (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero I).mpr (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hxI)⟩
  have hsup_rad : p ⊔ Ideal.span {x} ≤ (Module.annihilator R Nbar).radical :=
    sup_le (hp_le_ann.trans Ideal.le_radical)
      (Ideal.span_le.mpr (by simpa using hx_rad))
  have hAnn_le_sup : Module.annihilator R Nbar ≤ p ⊔ Ideal.span {x} := by
    intro a ha
    have hf1mem : Ideal.Quotient.mk I (f 1) ∈ Nbar :=
      Submodule.mem_map.mpr ⟨f 1, LinearMap.mem_range_self f 1, rfl⟩
    have hzero : a • (⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk I (f 1), hf1mem⟩ : ↥Nbar) = 0 :=
      Module.mem_annihilator.mp ha ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk I (f 1), hf1mem⟩
    have hzero' : Ideal.Quotient.mk I (a * f 1) = 0 := by
      rw [(Ideal.Quotient.mk I).map_mul a (f 1), ← Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq, ← Algebra.smul_def]
      exact Subtype.ext_iff.mp hzero
    have haf : a • f 1 ∈ I := (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero I).mp hzero'
    have hfa : f (Ideal.Quotient.mk p a) = a • f 1 := by
      rw [← f.map_smul a (1 : R ⧸ p)]
      congr 1
      rw [Algebra.smul_def, Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq, mul_one]
    have haf' : f (Ideal.Quotient.mk p a) ∈ I := hfa ▸ haf
    have hxN : f (Ideal.Quotient.mk p a) ∈ x • N := by
      have hmem_top : f (Ideal.Quotient.mk p a) ∈ I • (⊤ : Submodule R R) := by
        rw [← mul_one (f (Ideal.Quotient.mk p a)), ← smul_eq_mul]
        exact Submodule.smul_mem_smul haf' Submodule.mem_top
      have := hAR ⟨hmem_top, LinearMap.mem_range_self f (Ideal.Quotient.mk p a)⟩
      rwa [Submodule.ideal_span_singleton_smul] at this
    obtain ⟨y, hy, heq⟩ := (Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists _ x N).mp hxN
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hft⟩ := LinearMap.mem_range.mp hy
    have heq' : Ideal.Quotient.mk p a = x • t := by
      apply hf
      rw [map_smul]
      exact heq.symm
    have : Ideal.Quotient.mk p a =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk p (x * Quotient.out t) := by
      rw [heq', (Ideal.Quotient.mk p).map_mul x (Quotient.out t), Ideal.Quotient.mk_out t,
        Algebra.smul_def, Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq]
    have hmem : a - x * Quotient.out t ∈ p :=
      Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp (by simp [this])
    have hxterm : x * Quotient.out t ∈ Ideal.span {x} :=
      Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self x)
    rw [show a = a - x * Quotient.out t + x * Quotient.out t from by ring]
    exact Submodule.add_mem_sup hmem hxterm
  have hAnn_le_q : Module.annihilator R Nbar ≤ q := hAnn_le_sup.trans hq.1.2
  haveI : Module.Finite R (R ⧸ p) := inferInstance
  haveI : Module.Finite R N := Module.Finite.range f
  haveI : Module.Finite R Nbar := inferInstance
  have hq_min : q ∈ (Module.annihilator R Nbar).minimalPrimes := by
    have hsup_le_of_ann {r : Ideal R} [hr : r.IsPrime]
        (hran : Module.annihilator R Nbar ≤ r) : p ⊔ Ideal.span {x} ≤ r :=
      hsup_rad.trans (Ideal.radical_mono hran) |>.trans (IsPrime.radical hr).le
    refine ⟨⟨hq.1.1, hAnn_le_q⟩, ?_⟩
    intro r ⟨hrPrime, hran⟩ hrle
    exact hq.2 ⟨hrPrime, hsup_le_of_ann hran⟩ hrle
  exact ⟨n, hnpos,
    associatedPrimes.subset_of_injective Nbar.injective_subtype
      (Module.associatedPrimes.minimalPrimes_annihilator_subset_associatedPrimes
        (R := R) (M := Nbar) hq_min)⟩

name: ModuleCat.ringDepth_le_ringKrullDim_of_mem_associatedPrimes
statement:
theorem ringDepth_le_ringKrullDim_of_mem_associatedPrimes
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [FiniteRingKrullDim R]
    {p : Ideal R} (hp : p ∈ associatedPrimes R R) :
    (ringDepth R : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim (R ⧸ p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : p.IsPrime := (AssociatedPrimes.mem_iff.mp hp).isPrime
  have hnotBot : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ p) ≠ ⊥ :=
    (WithBot.bot_lt_coe 0).trans_le ringKrullDim_nonneg_of_nontrivial |>.ne'
  have hnotTop : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ p) ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top ringKrullDim_ne_top (ringKrullDim_quotient_le p)
  let n := (ringKrullDim (R ⧸ p)).unbot hnotBot
  have hdim : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ p) = (n : WithBot ℕ∞) := (WithBot.coe_unbot _ hnotBot).symm
  rw [hdim, WithBot.coe_le_coe]
  refine ENat.forall_natCast_le_iff_le.mp ?_
  intro d hd
  induction d with
    | zero => exact bot_le
    | succ d _ =>
      by_cases hmAss : maximalIdeal R ∈ associatedPrimes R R
      · have hdepth0 : ¬ (1 : ℕ∞) ≤ ringDepth R := by
          intro h
          have h' : (1 : ℕ∞) ≤ ringDepth R := by simpa [ringDepth] using h
          obtain ⟨rs, hrs, hmem, hreg⟩ :=
            (natCast_le_localDepth_iff_exists_isWeaklyRegular (ModuleCat.of R R) 1).mp h'
          obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := List.length_eq_one_iff.mp hrs
          have hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal R := hmem x (by simp)
          have hregx : IsSMulRegular R x :=
            (isWeaklyRegular_singleton_iff _ _).mp hreg
          have : x ∈ ⋃ q ∈ associatedPrimes R R, ↑q :=
            Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨maximalIdeal R, hmAss, hx⟩
          rw [biUnion_associatedPrimes_eq_compl_regular] at this
          exact this hregx
        exact absurd (le_trans (by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_pos d) hd) hdepth0
      · have hpos : (1 : ℕ∞) ≤ ringDepth R :=
          le_trans (by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le d)) hd
        have smul_lt : maximalIdeal R • (⊤ : Submodule R R) < ⊤ := by
          rw [lt_top_iff_ne_top]
          exact (Submodule.top_ne_ideal_smul_of_le_jacobson_annihilator
            (maximalIdeal_le_jacobson (Module.annihilator R R))).symm
        obtain ⟨rs, hrs, hmem, hreg⟩ :=
          (natCast_le_depth_iff_exists_isRegular (maximalIdeal R) (ModuleCat.of R R) smul_lt 1).mp
            (by simpa [ringDepth, localDepth] using hpos)
        obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := List.length_eq_one_iff.mp hrs
        have hx : x ∈ maximalIdeal R := hmem x (by simp)
        have hregx : IsSMulRegular R x :=
          (isWeaklyRegular_singleton_iff _ _).mp hreg.toIsWeaklyRegular
        have hxp : x ∉ p := by
          intro hxp
          have : x ∈ ⋃ q ∈ associatedPrimes R R, ↑q := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩
          rw [biUnion_associatedPrimes_eq_compl_regular] at this
          exact this hregx
        let Rp := R ⧸ p
        haveI : Nontrivial Rp := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr (IsPrime.ne_top ‹_›)
        haveI : IsLocalRing Rp :=
          IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk p) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
        haveI : IsDomain Rp := Ideal.Quotient.isDomain p
        have hx0 : Ideal.Quotient.mk p x ≠ 0 := mt Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp hxp
        have hregRp : IsSMulRegular Rp (Ideal.Quotient.mk p x) :=
          IsSMulRegular.of_right_eq_zero_of_smul fun a ha =>
            (mul_eq_zero.mp (by simpa [smul_eq_mul] using ha)).resolve_left hx0
        haveI : IsLocalHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk p) :=
          IsLocalHom.of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
        have hmemRp : Ideal.Quotient.mk p x ∈ maximalIdeal Rp :=
          map_nonunit _ x hx
        have hdimDrop :
            ringKrullDim (R ⧸ (p ⊔ Ideal.span {x})) + 1 = ringKrullDim (R ⧸ p) := by
          have e : R ⧸ (p ⊔ Ideal.span {x}) ≃+* Rp ⧸ Ideal.span {Ideal.Quotient.mk p x} := by
            refine (DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotSup p (Ideal.span {x})).symm.trans (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq ?_)
            simp [Ideal.map_span]
          simpa [ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv e] using
            ringKrullDim_quotient_span_singleton_succ_eq_ringKrullDim (R := Rp) hregRp hmemRp
        obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Ideal.nonempty_minimalPrimes (I := p ⊔ Ideal.span {x}) (by
          intro htop
          have hle : p ⊔ Ideal.span {x} ≤ maximalIdeal R :=
            sup_le (le_maximalIdeal (IsPrime.ne_top ‹_›))
              (Ideal.span_le.mpr (by simpa using hx))
          exact (hle.trans_lt (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).lt_top).ne htop)
        obtain ⟨n', hnpos, hAss⟩ :=
          exists_mem_associatedPrimes_quotient_pow_of_mem_minimalPrimes_sup hp x hq
        let Q := R ⧸ (Ideal.span {x} ^ n' : Ideal R)
        letI : IsLocalRing Q := quotientPowSpanIsLocalRing x n' hx hnpos
        have hspanPow : Ideal.span {x} ^ n' = Ideal.span {x ^ n'} :=
          Ideal.span_singleton_pow x n'
        have hpow : IsSMulRegular R (x ^ n') := isSMulRegular_pow hregx n'
        have hxpow : x ^ n' ∈ maximalIdeal R :=
          Ideal.pow_mem_of_mem (I := maximalIdeal R) hx n' hnpos
        have hdepthQ : ringDepth Q + 1 = ringDepth R := by
          haveI : IsLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x ^ n'}) :=
            quotientSpanIsLocalRing R (x ^ n') hxpow
          have h := ringDepth_quotient_span_singleton_add_one (x ^ n') hxpow hpow
          calc ringDepth Q + 1
              = ringDepth (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x ^ n'}) + 1 := by
                  congr 1
                  exact ringDepth_eq_of_quotIdeal_eq hspanPow
            _ = ringDepth R := h
        have hxqn : Ideal.span {x} ^ n' ≤ q :=
          (Ideal.pow_le_self hnpos.ne').trans (le_sup_right.trans hq.1.2)
        let qQ : Ideal Q := q.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x} ^ n'))
        have hqQAss : qQ ∈ associatedPrimes Q Q :=
          associatedPrimes_map_quotient_mk hxqn hAss
        have hdQ : (d : ℕ∞) ≤ ringDepth Q := by
          have h1 : ((d + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ ringDepth R := hd
          have h2 : (d : ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ ringDepth Q + 1 := by simpa [hdepthQ] using h1
          exact (ENat.add_le_add_iff_right (by simp)).1 h2
        have ihAppl := ringDepth_le_ringKrullDim_of_mem_associatedPrimes (R := Q) (p := qQ) hqQAss
        have hdimq : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ q) = ringKrullDim (Q ⧸ qQ) :=
          ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv <|
            (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq (sup_eq_right.mpr hxqn)).symm.trans
              (DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotSup (Ideal.span {x} ^ n') q).symm
        have hle : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ q) ≤ ringKrullDim (R ⧸ (p ⊔ Ideal.span {x})) :=
          ringKrullDim_le_of_surjective _ (Ideal.Quotient.factor_surjective hq.1.2)
        have : ((d + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ (n : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
          have h1 : (d : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim (Q ⧸ qQ) :=
            le_trans (WithBot.coe_le_coe.mpr hdQ) ihAppl
          have h2 : (d : WithBot ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ ringKrullDim (Q ⧸ qQ) + 1 :=
            by simpa [add_comm] using add_le_add_right h1 1
          have h3 : ringKrullDim (Q ⧸ qQ) + 1 ≤ ringKrullDim (R ⧸ p) := by
            calc ringKrullDim (Q ⧸ qQ) + 1
                = ringKrullDim (R ⧸ q) + 1 := by rw [← hdimq]
              _ ≤ ringKrullDim (R ⧸ (p ⊔ Ideal.span {x})) + 1 := by
                simpa [add_comm] using add_le_add_right hle 1
              _ = ringKrullDim (R ⧸ p) := hdimDrop
          exact h2.trans (by rw [← hdim]; exact h3)
        exact WithBot.coe_le_coe.mp this

name: ModuleCat.IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.isSMulRegular_of_ringKrullDim_quotient_succ
statement:
theorem IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.isSMulRegular_of_ringKrullDim_quotient_succ
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [FiniteRingKrullDim R] [IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing R]
    (r : R) (hrm : r ∈ maximalIdeal R)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span {r}) + 1 = ringKrullDim R) :
    IsSMulRegular R r
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hreg
  have hrZD : r ∈ ⋃ p ∈ associatedPrimes R R, ↑p := by
    rw [biUnion_associatedPrimes_eq_compl_regular]; exact hreg
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hrp⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hrZD
  haveI : p.IsPrime := (AssociatedPrimes.mem_iff.mp hp).isPrime
  have hle : Ideal.span {r} ≤ p := Ideal.span_le.mpr (by simpa using hrp)
  have hdimLe : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ p) ≤ ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span {r}) :=
    ringKrullDim_le_of_surjective _ (Ideal.Quotient.factor_surjective hle)
  have hdimEq : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ p) = ringKrullDim R := by
    have hle' : (ringDepth R : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim (R ⧸ p) :=
      ringDepth_le_ringKrullDim_of_mem_associatedPrimes hp
    exact le_antisymm (ringKrullDim_quotient_le p)
      (by simpa [IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.depth_eq_dimension, coe_localKrullDim] using hle')
  have : ringKrullDim R + 1 ≤ ringKrullDim R := by
    calc
      ringKrullDim R + 1 = ringKrullDim (R ⧸ p) + 1 := by rw [hdimEq]
      _ ≤ ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span {r}) + 1 := by gcongr
      _ = ringKrullDim R := hdim
  exact not_le_of_gt (by
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := WithBot.ne_bot_iff_exists.mp (ringKrullDim_ne_bot (R := R))
    have hm_ne : m ≠ ⊤ := fun ht =>
      ringKrullDim_ne_top (R := R) (by rw [← hm, WithBot.coe_eq_top.mpr ht])
    rw [← hm]
    exact WithBot.coe_lt_coe.mpr ((ENat.lt_add_one_iff hm_ne).mpr le_rfl)) this

name: ModuleCat.IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.isWeaklyRegular_of_ringKrullDim_add_length
statement:
theorem IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.isWeaklyRegular_of_ringKrullDim_add_length
    (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [IsLocalRing S]
    [IsNoetherianRing S] [FiniteRingKrullDim S] [IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing S]
    (rs : List S)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim (S ⧸ Ideal.ofList rs) + rs.length = ringKrullDim S) :
    IsWeaklyRegular S rs
proof:
:= by
  match rs with
  | [] => exact IsWeaklyRegular.nil S S
  | r :: rs =>
    obtain ⟨hrm, hdim_head, hdim_tail⟩ :=
      ringKrullDim_quotient_span_singleton_add_one_of_ofList_cons r rs (by simpa using hdim)
    have hreg : IsSMulRegular S r :=
      IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.isSMulRegular_of_ringKrullDim_quotient_succ r hrm hdim_head
    let Q := S ⧸ Ideal.span {r}
    letI : IsLocalRing Q := quotientSpanIsLocalRing S r hrm
    haveI : IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing Q :=
      IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.quotient_span_singleton S r hrm hreg
    haveI : FiniteRingKrullDim Q := by
      rw [finiteRingKrullDim_iff_ne_bot_and_top]
      exact ⟨(lt_of_lt_of_le (WithBot.bot_lt_coe 0)
          ringKrullDim_nonneg_of_nontrivial).ne',
        ne_top_of_le_ne_top ringKrullDim_ne_top (ringKrullDim_quotient_le (Ideal.span {r}))⟩
    let rsQ := rs.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {r}))
    have hdimQ : ringKrullDim (Q ⧸ Ideal.ofList rsQ) + rsQ.length = ringKrullDim Q := by
      have hrsQ :
          Ideal.ofList rsQ =
            Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {r})) (Ideal.ofList rs) := by
        dsimp [rsQ]
        exact (Ideal.map_ofList (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {r})) rs).symm
      have e : Q ⧸ Ideal.ofList rsQ ≃+* S ⧸ Ideal.ofList (r :: rs) := by
        refine (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hrsQ).trans ?_
        refine (DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotSup (Ideal.span {r}) (Ideal.ofList rs)).trans ?_
        exact Ideal.quotEquivOfEq (by simp [Ideal.ofList_cons, sup_comm])
      rw [ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv e, List.length_map]
      simpa [Q] using hdim_tail
    have hweakQ : IsWeaklyRegular Q rsQ :=
      IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.isWeaklyRegular_of_ringKrullDim_add_length Q rsQ hdimQ
    have e : QuotSMulTop r S ≃ₗ[S] Q :=
      Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ (by rw [← Submodule.ideal_span_singleton_smul]; simp)
    have hregRs : IsWeaklyRegular Q rs :=
      (isWeaklyRegular_map_algebraMap_iff Q Q rs).mp hweakQ
    have hregQuot : IsWeaklyRegular (QuotSMulTop r S) rs :=
      (e.isWeaklyRegular_congr rs).mpr hregRs
    exact (isWeaklyRegular_cons_iff S r rs).mpr ⟨hreg, hregQuot⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.MovedIntersectionProductData.product_zero_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem product_zero_left (y : CodimensionChow X q) : T.product 0 y = 0
proof:
:= by
  change T.productHom 0 y = 0
  rw [map_zero]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.MovedIntersectionProductData.product_zero_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem product_zero_right (x : CodimensionChow X p) : T.product x 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  map_zero (T.productHom x)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.MovedIntersectionProductData.product_add_left
statement:
theorem product_add_left (x x' : CodimensionChow X p) (y : CodimensionChow X q) :
    T.product (x + x') y = T.product x y + T.product x' y
proof:
:= by
  change T.productHom (x + x') y = _
  rw [map_add]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.MovedIntersectionProductData.product_add_right
statement:
theorem product_add_right (x : CodimensionChow X p) (y y' : CodimensionChow X q) :
    T.product x (y + y') = T.product x y + T.product x y'
proof:
:=
  map_add (T.productHom x) y y'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.MovedIntersectionProductData.witness_intersectionClass_eq_product
statement:
theorem witness_intersectionClass_eq_product
    {x : CodimensionChow X p} {y : CodimensionChow X q}
    (w : ExpectedCodimensionRepresentativeWitness x y) :
    w.intersectionClass = T.product x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [ExpectedCodimensionRepresentativeWitness.intersectionClass,
    ExpectedCodimensionRepresentativeWitness.intersectionCycle,
    ← T.product_classOf_classOf w.left w.right w.meeting,
    w.left_class, w.right_class]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.MovedIntersectionProductData.integralLeftRationalHom_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem integralLeftRationalHom_tmul
    (x : CodimensionChow X p) (b : ℚ) (y : CodimensionChow X q) :
    T.integralLeftRationalHom x (b ⊗ₜ[ℤ] y) =
      b ⊗ₜ[ℤ] T.product x y
proof:
:=
  rationalizeAddHom_tmul _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.MovedIntersectionProductData.rationalProduct_tmul_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rationalProduct_tmul_tmul
    (a b : ℚ) (x : CodimensionChow X p) (y : CodimensionChow X q) :
    T.rationalProduct (a ⊗ₜ[ℤ] x) (b ⊗ₜ[ℤ] y) =
      (a * b) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] T.product x y
proof:
:= by
  simp [rationalProduct, rationalProductHom, integralLeftRationalHom,
    rationalizeAddHom]
  change (a * b) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] T.product x y = _
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.MovedIntersectionProductData.rationalProduct_zero_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rationalProduct_zero_left (y : RationalCodimensionChow X q) :
    T.rationalProduct 0 y = 0
proof:
:= by
  change T.rationalProductHom 0 y = 0
  rw [map_zero]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.MovedIntersectionProductData.rationalProduct_zero_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rationalProduct_zero_right (x : RationalCodimensionChow X p) :
    T.rationalProduct x 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  map_zero (T.rationalProductHom x)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.MovedIntersectionProductData.rationalProduct_add_left
statement:
theorem rationalProduct_add_left
    (x x' : RationalCodimensionChow X p) (y : RationalCodimensionChow X q) :
    T.rationalProduct (x + x') y =
      T.rationalProduct x y + T.rationalProduct x' y
proof:
:= by
  change T.rationalProductHom (x + x') y = _
  rw [map_add]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.MovedIntersectionProductData.rationalProduct_add_right
statement:
theorem rationalProduct_add_right
    (x : RationalCodimensionChow X p) (y y' : RationalCodimensionChow X q) :
    T.rationalProduct x (y + y') =
      T.rationalProduct x y + T.rationalProduct x y'
proof:
:=
  map_add (T.rationalProductHom x) y y'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.MovedIntersectionProductData.rationalProduct_smul_left
statement:
theorem rationalProduct_smul_left
    (a : ℚ) (x : RationalCodimensionChow X p)
    (y : RationalCodimensionChow X q) :
    T.rationalProduct (a • x) y = a • T.rationalProduct x y
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x x' hx hx' =>
      rw [smul_add, T.rationalProduct_add_left,
        hx, hx', T.rationalProduct_add_left, smul_add]
  | tmul b z =>
      induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on with
      | zero => simp
      | add y y' hy hy' =>
          rw [T.rationalProduct_add_right, hy, hy',
            T.rationalProduct_add_right, smul_add]
      | tmul c w =>
          rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul',
            T.rationalProduct_tmul_tmul,
            T.rationalProduct_tmul_tmul,
            TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
          simp only [smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.MovedIntersectionProductData.rationalProduct_smul_right
statement:
theorem rationalProduct_smul_right
    (a : ℚ) (x : RationalCodimensionChow X p)
    (y : RationalCodimensionChow X q) :
    T.rationalProduct x (a • y) = a • T.rationalProduct x y
proof:
:= by
  induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add y y' hy hy' =>
      rw [smul_add, T.rationalProduct_add_right,
        hy, hy', T.rationalProduct_add_right, smul_add]
  | tmul b z =>
      induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
      | zero => simp
      | add x x' hx hx' =>
          rw [T.rationalProduct_add_left, hx, hx',
            T.rationalProduct_add_left, smul_add]
      | tmul c w =>
          rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul',
            T.rationalProduct_tmul_tmul,
            T.rationalProduct_tmul_tmul,
            TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
          simp only [smul_eq_mul]
          ring_nf

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.MovedIntersectionProductData.rationalProduct_comm_of_product_comm
statement:
theorem rationalProduct_comm_of_product_comm
    {r : ℕ} (S : MovedIntersectionProductData X r r)
    (hcomm : ∀ (x y : CodimensionChow X r),
      S.product x y = S.product y x)
    (x y : RationalCodimensionChow X r) :
    S.rationalProduct x y = S.rationalProduct y x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x x' hx hx' =>
      rw [S.rationalProduct_add_left, S.rationalProduct_add_right, hx, hx']
  | tmul a z =>
      induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on with
      | zero => simp
      | add y y' hy hy' =>
          rw [S.rationalProduct_add_right, S.rationalProduct_add_left, hy, hy']
      | tmul b w =>
          rw [S.rationalProduct_tmul_tmul,
            S.rationalProduct_tmul_tmul, hcomm, mul_comm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_comap_stalkMap
statement:
theorem stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_comap_stalkMap {w y : V} (h : w ⤳ y) :

      Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (h.map ι.base.hom.continuous)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes, Ideal.mem_comap, IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal,
    mem_nonunits_iff]
  have hsq := Scheme.Hom.stalkSpecializes_stalkMap_apply ι w y h x
  change ¬IsUnit ((V.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom ((ι.stalkMap y).hom x)) ↔ _
  rw [← show (ι.stalkMap w).hom ((X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes
      (ι.base.hom.map_specializes h)).hom x) =
      (V.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom ((ι.stalkMap y).hom x) from hsq]
  exact (isUnit_map_iff (ι.stalkMap w).hom _).not

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_map
statement:
theorem c1CapPrimeCoeff_map (a : LocalEquations X) (w y : V) :
    c1CapPrimeCoeff a (ι w) (ι y) = c1CapPrimeCoeff (a.pullback ι) w y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : w ⤳ y
  · have hX : ι w ⤳ ι y := h.map ι.base.hom.continuous
    unfold c1CapPrimeCoeff
    rw [dif_pos hX, dif_pos h]
    have hdim := ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (stalkQuotientEquiv ι h)
    have hmult : CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity (a (ι y)) hX =
        CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity (a.pullback ι y) h := by
      unfold CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity LocalEquations.pullback
      rw [← stalkQuotientEquiv_mk ι h, Ring.ord_map_ringEquiv]
    rw [hdim, hmult]
  · have hX : ¬ ι w ⤳ ι y := fun hX => h (ι.isEmbedding.isInducing.specializes_iff.mp hX)
    unfold c1CapPrimeCoeff
    rw [dif_neg hX, dif_neg h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range
statement:
theorem c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range (a : LocalEquations X) (w : V) {x : X}
    (hx : x ∉ Set.range ι) : c1CapPrimeCoeff a (ι w) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold c1CapPrimeCoeff

  intro h
  exact hx (h.mem_closed ι.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range ⟨w, rfl⟩)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff_pushforward_apply
statement:
theorem c1CapCyclesCoeff_pushforward_apply (y : V) :
    c1CapCyclesCoeff a (AlgebraicCycle.pushforward ι α wV wX) (ι y) =
      c1CapCyclesCoeff (a.pullback ι) α y
proof:
:= by
  unfold c1CapCyclesCoeff
  set P := AlgebraicCycle.pushforward ι α wV wX
  have hsupp : Function.support (fun v : X => P v * c1CapPrimeCoeff a v (ι y)) ⊆
      Set.range ι := by
    intro v hv
    by_contra hvr
    apply hv
    simp only [P, AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range ι α wV wX v hvr,
      zero_mul]
  rw [← finsum_mem_univ, finsum_mem_inter_support_eq' _ Set.univ (Set.range ι) fun v hv => by
      simp only [Set.mem_univ, true_iff]
      exact hsupp hv,
    finsum_mem_range ι.isEmbedding.injective]
  refine finsum_congr fun w => ?_
  simp only [P]
  rw [AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_closedImmersion ι α wV wX hα w,
    c1CapPrimeCoeff_map]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff_pushforward_apply_of_not_mem_range
statement:
theorem c1CapCyclesCoeff_pushforward_apply_of_not_mem_range {x : X} (hx : x ∉ Set.range ι) :
    c1CapCyclesCoeff a (AlgebraicCycle.pushforward ι α wV wX) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold c1CapCyclesCoeff
  refine finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero fun v => ?_
  by_cases hv : v ∈ Set.range ι
  · obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hv
    rw [c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range ι a w hx, mul_zero]
  · rw [AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range ι α wV wX _ hv, zero_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.c1CapCyclesCoeff_pushforward
statement:
theorem c1CapCyclesCoeff_pushforward (β : AlgebraicCycle V ℤ)
    (hβ : ⇑β = c1CapCyclesCoeff (a.pullback ι) α)
    (hβgrade : ∀ w : V, β w ≠ 0 → wV w = wX (ι w)) :
    c1CapCyclesCoeff a (AlgebraicCycle.pushforward ι α wV wX) =
      ⇑(AlgebraicCycle.pushforward ι β wV wX)
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.range ι
  · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [c1CapCyclesCoeff_pushforward_apply ι a α wV wX hα y,
      AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_closedImmersion ι β wV wX hβgrade y, hβ]
  · rw [c1CapCyclesCoeff_pushforward_apply_of_not_mem_range ι a α wV wX hx,
      AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range ι β wV wX x hx]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.not_properPrimeIntersectionData_self
statement:
theorem not_properPrimeIntersectionData_self
    (d : ProperPrimeIntersectionData X 1 1) (hxy : d.x = d.y) : False
proof:
:= by
  rcases d with ⟨x, y, hx, hy, hlength, hcodim⟩
  dsimp at hxy
  subst y
  let a := pointClosureGenericPoint x
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := Scheme.Pullback.exists_preimage_pullback a a rfl
  have hto :
      (pullback.fst (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι x) ≫ pointClosureι x) w = x := by
    change pointClosureι x
        (pullback.fst (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι x) w) = x
    rw [hw.1, pointClosureι_genericPoint]
  have hc := hcodim w
  rw [hto, hx] at hc
  norm_num at hc

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.finite_of_movingLemmaStatement_zero_zero
statement:
theorem finite_of_movingLemmaStatement_zero_zero
    (h : MovingLemmaStatement X 0 0) : Finite X
proof:
:= by
  let c : CodimensionChow X 0 :=
    gradedClassOf X 0 (genericPointCycle (X := X) 1)
  obtain ⟨w⟩ := h c c
  have hleftCoeff : codimensionZeroCoefficient w.left = 1 := by
    have hw := congrArg (codimensionZeroChowCoefficient (X := X)) w.left_class
    simpa [c] using hw
  have hrightCoeff : codimensionZeroCoefficient w.right = 1 := by
    have hw := congrArg (codimensionZeroChowCoefficient (X := X)) w.right_class
    simpa [c] using hw
  have hleft : w.left = genericPointCycle (X := X) 1 := by
    rw [← genericPointCycle_coefficient w.left, hleftCoeff]
  have hright : w.right = genericPointCycle (X := X) 1 := by
    rw [← genericPointCycle_coefficient w.right, hrightCoeff]
  let x : (compactCycleFinsupp w.left.1).support :=
    ⟨genericPoint X, by
      rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, compactCycleFinsupp_apply, hleft]
      simp⟩
  let y : (compactCycleFinsupp w.right.1).support :=
    ⟨genericPoint X, by
      rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, compactCycleFinsupp_apply, hright]
      simp⟩
  let d := w.proper.pair x y
  have hdx : d.x = genericPoint X := by
    exact (w.proper.pair_x x y).trans rfl
  have hdy : d.y = genericPoint X := by
    exact (w.proper.pair_y x y).trans rfl
  have hiSurj : Function.Surjective (pointClosureι (genericPoint X)) := by
    intro t
    have ht : t ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι (genericPoint X)) := by
      rw [range_pointClosureι, genericPoint_closure]
      trivial
    exact ht
  letI : Surjective (pointClosureι (genericPoint X)) := ⟨hiSurj⟩
  letI : IsIso (pointClosureι (genericPoint X)) :=
    isIso_of_isClosedImmersion_of_surjective _
  letI : IsIso (pointClosureι d.x) := by rw [hdx]; infer_instance
  letI : IsIso (pointClosureι d.y) := by rw [hdy]; infer_instance
  let P := pullback (pointClosureι d.x) (pointClosureι d.y)
  letI : Finite P := d.finite_intersection
  letI : IsIso (pullback.fst (pointClosureι d.x) (pointClosureι d.y)) :=
    inferInstance
  let e₁ := (Scheme.homeoOfIso
    (asIso (pullback.fst (pointClosureι d.x) (pointClosureι d.y)))).toEquiv
  letI : Finite (pointClosureScheme d.x) :=
    (Equiv.finite_iff e₁).mp inferInstance
  let e₂ := (Scheme.homeoOfIso (asIso (pointClosureι d.x))).toEquiv
  exact (Equiv.finite_iff e₂).mp inferInstance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.not_movingLemmaStatement_zero_zero
statement:
theorem not_movingLemmaStatement_zero_zero [Infinite X] :
    ¬ MovingLemmaStatement X 0 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  letI : Finite X := finite_of_movingLemmaStatement_zero_zero h
  exact not_finite X

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.not_primeCyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_self
statement:
theorem not_primeCyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_self
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    (z : X) (hz : coheight z = 1) :
    ¬ PrimeCyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension z z 1 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  letI : CompactSpace (pointClosureScheme z) :=
    (pointClosureι z).isClosedEmbedding.compactSpace
  letI : IsNoetherian (pointClosureScheme z) := { }
  let e : pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) (pointClosureι z) (pointClosureι z) ≅
      pointClosureScheme z :=
    asIso (pullback.fst (pointClosureι z) (pointClosureι z))
  letI : CompactSpace
      (pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) (pointClosureι z) (pointClosureι z)) :=
    e.hom.isClosedEmbedding.compactSpace
  letI : IsNoetherian
      (pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) (pointClosureι z) (pointClosureι z)) := { }
  let a := genericPoint (pointClosureScheme z)
  let w := e.inv a
  have haG : a ∈ genericPoints (pointClosureScheme z) := by
    apply mem_genericPoints_of_isMax
    exact isMax_top
  have hwG : w ∈ genericPoints
      (pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) (pointClosureι z) (pointClosureι z)) := by
    apply (map_mem_genericPoints_iff_of_iso e w).mp
    rw [show e.hom w = a by
      exact (Scheme.homeoOfIso e).right_inv a]
    exact haG
  have hcodim := h w hwG
  have hto :
      (pullback.fst (pointClosureι z) (pointClosureι z) ≫ pointClosureι z) w = z := by
    change pointClosureι z (e.hom w) = z
    rw [show e.hom w = a by
      exact (Scheme.homeoOfIso e).right_inv a,
      show a = pointClosureGenericPoint z by
        exact (genericPoint_spec (pointClosureScheme z)).eq
          (pointClosureGenericPoint_isGeneric z)]
    exact pointClosureι_genericPoint z
  rw [hto, hz] at hcodim
  norm_num at hcodim

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.cycle_apply_eq_zero_of_cyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_primeCycle
statement:
theorem cycle_apply_eq_zero_of_cyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_primeCycle
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    (D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ 1) (z : CodimensionPoint X 1)
    (h : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D (primeCycle z.1 1 z.2)) :
    D.1 z.1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hz
  exact not_primeCyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_self z.1 z.2
    (h z.1 hz z.1 (by simp))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.primeCyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_one_one_of_ne
statement:
theorem primeCyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_one_one_of_ne
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [Order.KrullDimLE 2 X]
    (x y : X) (hx : coheight x = 1) (hy : coheight y = 1)
    (hxy : x ≠ y) : PrimeCyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension x y 1 1
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  let t : X :=
    (pullback.fst (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι y) ≫ pointClosureι x) z
  have hsx : Specializes x t := by
    have hsource : Specializes (pointClosureGenericPoint x)
        (pullback.fst (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι y) z) :=
      (pointClosureGenericPoint_isGeneric x).specializes trivial
    simpa only [t, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, pointClosureι_genericPoint] using
      hsource.map (pointClosureι x).continuous
  have hsy : Specializes y t := by
    have hsource : Specializes (pointClosureGenericPoint y)
        (pullback.snd (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι y) z) :=
      (pointClosureGenericPoint_isGeneric y).specializes trivial
    have hmap : Specializes y (pointClosureι y
        (pullback.snd (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι y) z)) := by
      simpa only [pointClosureι_genericPoint] using
        hsource.map (pointClosureι y).continuous
    change Specializes y t
    rw [show t = pointClosureι y
      (pullback.snd (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι y) z) by
        change (pullback.fst (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι y) ≫
          pointClosureι x) z =
          (pullback.snd (pointClosureι x) (pointClosureι y) ≫
            pointClosureι y) z
        rw [pullback.condition]]
    exact hmap
  have htx : t ≤ x := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr hsx
  have ht_ne_x : t ≠ x := by
    intro htxeq
    have hxy_le : x ≤ y := by
      rw [← htxeq]
      exact Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr hsy
    have hxy_lt : x < y := lt_of_le_not_ge hxy_le fun hyx ↦
      hxy (((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hxy_le).antisymm
        (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hyx)).eq.symm)
    have h := Order.coheight_add_one_le hxy_lt
    rw [hx, hy] at h
    norm_num at h
  have htx_lt : t < x := lt_of_le_not_ge htx fun hxt ↦
    ht_ne_x (((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp htx).antisymm
      (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hxt)).eq.symm)
  have hlower : 2 ≤ coheight t := by
    have h := Order.coheight_add_one_le htx_lt
    rw [hx] at h
    norm_num at h ⊢
    exact h
  have hupper : coheight t ≤ 2 := by
    have h := (Order.coheight_le_krullDim t).trans
      (Order.KrullDimLE.krullDim_le (n := 2) (α := ↥X))
    have h' : (↑(coheight t) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ↑(2 : ℕ∞) := by
      simpa using h
    exact WithBot.coe_le_coe.mp h'
  change coheight t = 1 + 1
  norm_num
  exact le_antisymm hupper hlower

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.cyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_one_one_of_disjoint_support
statement:
theorem cyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_one_one_of_disjoint_support
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [Order.KrullDimLE 2 X]
    {D E : CodimensionCycles X ℤ 1}
    (hdisjoint : Disjoint D.1.support E.1.support) :
    CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D E
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy
  apply primeCyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_one_one_of_ne
    x y (D.2 hx) (E.2 hy)
  intro hxy
  subst y
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint hx hy

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.DivisorLinearSystemData.exists_cycle_disjoint_support
statement:
theorem exists_cycle_disjoint_support
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {k : Type v} {V : Type w}
    [Field k] [Infinite k] [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V]
    [CompactSpace X] {c : CodimensionChow X 1}
    (L : DivisorLinearSystemData X k V c)
    (E : CodimensionCycles X ℤ 1) :
    ∃ D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ 1,
      gradedClassOf X 1 D = c ∧ Disjoint D.1.support E.1.support
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hE : (compactCycleFinsupp E.1).support.Nonempty
  · have heval : ∀ i : (compactCycleFinsupp E.1).support,
        ∃ s : V, L.evaluation i.1 s ≠ 0 := by
      intro i
      apply L.exists_evaluation_ne_zero i.1
      apply E.2
      change E.1 i.1 ≠ 0
      simpa only [compactCycleFinsupp_apply] using
        Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp i.2
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ :=
      Module.Dual.exists_forall_ne_zero_of_forall_exists
        (fun i : (compactCycleFinsupp E.1).support ↦ L.evaluation i.1) heval
    have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hE
      intro hs0
      have h := hs ⟨x, hx⟩
      rw [hs0, map_zero] at h
      exact h rfl
    let s0 : {s : V // s ≠ 0} := ⟨s, hs0⟩
    refine ⟨L.cycle s0, L.class_cycle s0, ?_⟩
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hxD hxE
    have hxSupport : x ∈ (compactCycleFinsupp E.1).support := by
      rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, compactCycleFinsupp_apply]
      exact hxE
    have hzero := L.cycle_apply_eq_zero_of_evaluation_ne_zero
      s0 x (hs ⟨x, hxSupport⟩)
    exact hxD hzero
  · refine ⟨L.cycle L.nonzeroSection, L.class_cycle L.nonzeroSection, ?_⟩
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hxD hxE
    apply hE
    exact ⟨x, by
      rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, compactCycleFinsupp_apply]
      exact hxE⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.DivisorLinearSystemData.exists_cycle_meeting_in_expected_codimension
statement:
theorem exists_cycle_meeting_in_expected_codimension
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {k : Type v} {V : Type w}
    [Field k] [Infinite k] [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V]
    [IsNoetherian X] [Order.KrullDimLE 2 X]
    {c : CodimensionChow X 1}

      CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D E ∧ gradedClassOf X 1 D = c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hclass, hdisjoint⟩ := L.exists_cycle_disjoint_support E
  exact ⟨D,
    cyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension_one_one_of_disjoint_support hdisjoint,
    hclass⟩

theorem postcomposeRelationCombination_single {Z X : Scheme.{u}} {p q : ℕ}

    (codimension : ∀ g : RationalRelationGenerator Z p,
      ∀ y : g.Y, coheight y = 1 → coheight ((g.i ≫ j) y) = q)
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator Z p) (n : ℤ) :

:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.rationalRelationCombinationAddHom_postcompose
statement:
theorem rationalRelationCombinationAddHom_postcompose {Z X : Scheme.{u}} {p q : ℕ}
    (j : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    (codimension : ∀ g : RationalRelationGenerator Z p,
      ∀ y : g.Y, coheight y = 1 → coheight ((g.i ≫ j) y) = q)
    (c : RationalRelationGenerator Z p →₀ ℤ) :
    rationalRelationCombinationAddHom X q
        (postcomposeRelationCombination j codimension c) =
      c.sum (fun g n ↦ n • (g.postcompose j (codimension g)).cycle)
proof:
:= by
  induction c using Finsupp.induction with
  | zero => simp
  | single_add g n c hg hn ih =>
      rw [postcomposeRelationCombination_add, postcomposeRelationCombination_single, map_add,
        rationalRelationCombinationAddHom_single, ih]
      rw [Finsupp.sum_add_index'
        (f := Finsupp.single g n) (g := c)
        (h := fun r m ↦ m • (r.postcompose j (codimension r)).cycle)
        (fun _ ↦ zero_zsmul _)
        (fun r a b ↦ add_zsmul (r.postcompose j (codimension r)).cycle a b)]
      simp

        rationalEquivalenceSubgroup X q
proof:
:=
  rationalRelationCombinationAddHom_mem _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.relationCombination_postcompose_grade
statement:
private theorem relationCombination_postcompose_grade {Z X : Scheme.{u}} {p q : ℕ}
    (j : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    (codimension : ∀ g : RationalRelationGenerator Z p,
      ∀ y : g.Y, coheight y = 1 → coheight ((g.i ≫ j) y) = q)
    (c : RationalRelationGenerator Z p →₀ ℤ) :
    ∀ z : Z, (rationalRelationCombinationAddHom Z p c).1 z ≠ 0 →
      (q : ℕ∞) = coheight (j z)
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  induction c using Finsupp.induction with
  | zero => simp at hz
  | single_add g n c hg hn ih =>
      rw [map_add, rationalRelationCombinationAddHom_single] at hz
      change (n • g.cycle.1 + (rationalRelationCombinationAddHom Z p c).1) z ≠ 0 at hz
      by_cases hsingle : (n • g.cycle.1) z = 0
      · apply ih
        intro hc
        apply hz
        change (n • g.cycle.1) z +
          (rationalRelationCombinationAddHom Z p c).1 z = 0
        rw [hsingle, hc, zero_add]
      · have hgcycle : g.cycle.1 z ≠ 0 := by
          intro hgz
          exact hsingle (by simp [hgz])
        have hzmem : z ∈ g.cycle.1.support := hgcycle
        rw [RationalRelationGenerator.cycle_support] at hzmem
        obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hzmem
        rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
        exact (codimension g y (div_support hy)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.rationalRelationCombinationAddHom_postcompose_eq_pushforward
statement:
theorem rationalRelationCombinationAddHom_postcompose_eq_pushforward
    {Z X : Scheme.{u}} {p q : ℕ}
    (j : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    (codimension : ∀ g : RationalRelationGenerator Z p,
      ∀ y : g.Y, coheight y = 1 → coheight ((g.i ≫ j) y) = q)
    (c : RationalRelationGenerator Z p →₀ ℤ) :
    (rationalRelationCombinationAddHom X q
      (postcomposeRelationCombination j codimension c)).1 =
        AlgebraicCycle.pushforward j (rationalRelationCombinationAddHom Z p c).1
          (fun _ ↦ (q : ℕ∞)) coheight
proof:
:= by
  induction c using Finsupp.induction with
  | zero =>
      rw [postcomposeRelationCombination_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
      change (0 : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) = AlgebraicCycle.pushforward j
        (0 : AlgebraicCycle Z ℤ) (fun _ ↦ (q : ℕ∞)) coheight
      rw [AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_zero_closedImmersion]
  | single_add g n c hg hn ih =>
      have hggrade : ∀ z : Z, g.cycle.1 z ≠ 0 →
          (q : ℕ∞) = coheight (j z) := by
        intro z hz
        have hzmem : z ∈ g.cycle.1.support := hz
        rw [RationalRelationGenerator.cycle_support] at hzmem
        obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hzmem
        rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
        exact (codimension g y (div_support hy)).symm
      have hngrade : ∀ z : Z, (n • g.cycle.1) z ≠ 0 →
          (q : ℕ∞) = coheight (j z) := by
        intro z hz
        apply hggrade z
        intro hgz
        exact hz (by simp [hgz])
      have hcgrade := relationCombination_postcompose_grade j codimension c
      rw [postcomposeRelationCombination_add, postcomposeRelationCombination_single,
        map_add, rationalRelationCombinationAddHom_single, map_add,
        rationalRelationCombinationAddHom_single]
      change n • (g.postcompose j (codimension g)).cycle.1 +
          (rationalRelationCombinationAddHom X q
            (postcomposeRelationCombination j codimension c)).1 =
        AlgebraicCycle.pushforward j
          (n • g.cycle.1 + (rationalRelationCombinationAddHom Z p c).1)
          (fun _ ↦ (q : ℕ∞)) coheight
      calc
        _ = n • AlgebraicCycle.pushforward j g.cycle.1
              (fun _ ↦ (q : ℕ∞)) coheight +
            AlgebraicCycle.pushforward j (rationalRelationCombinationAddHom Z p c).1
              (fun _ ↦ (q : ℕ∞)) coheight := by
          rw [RationalRelationGenerator.postcompose_cycle_eq_pushforward, ih]
        _ = AlgebraicCycle.pushforward j (n • g.cycle.1)
              (fun _ ↦ (q : ℕ∞)) coheight +
            AlgebraicCycle.pushforward j (rationalRelationCombinationAddHom Z p c).1
              (fun _ ↦ (q : ℕ∞)) coheight := by
          rw [AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_zsmul_closedImmersion j g.cycle.1 n
            (fun _ ↦ (q : ℕ∞)) coheight hggrade]
        _ = _ := (AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_add_closedImmersion j
          (n • g.cycle.1) (rationalRelationCombinationAddHom Z p c).1
          (fun _ ↦ (q : ℕ∞)) coheight hngrade hcgrade).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.exists_pushforward_mem_rationalEquivalenceSubgroup
statement:
theorem exists_pushforward_mem_rationalEquivalenceSubgroup
    {Z X : Scheme.{u}} {p q : ℕ}
    (j : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    (codimension : ∀ g : RationalRelationGenerator Z p,
      ∀ y : g.Y, coheight y = 1 → coheight ((g.i ≫ j) y) = q)
    (D : CodimensionCycles Z ℤ p) (hD : D ∈ rationalEquivalenceSubgroup Z p) :
    ∃ E : CodimensionCycles X ℤ q,
      E ∈ rationalEquivalenceSubgroup X q ∧
        E.1 = AlgebraicCycle.pushforward j D.1 (fun _ ↦ (q : ℕ∞)) coheight
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ :=
    (mem_rationalEquivalenceSubgroup_iff_exists_relationCombination D).mp hD
  refine ⟨rationalRelationCombinationAddHom X q
    (postcomposeRelationCombination j codimension c), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact rationalRelationCombinationAddHom_mem _
  · rw [rationalRelationCombinationAddHom_postcompose_eq_pushforward, hc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.rationalizeAddHom_comp
statement:
theorem rationalizeAddHom_comp
    {A : Type v} {B : Type w} {C : Type x}
    [AddCommGroup A] [AddCommGroup B] [AddCommGroup C]
    (g : B →+ C) (f : A →+ B) :
    rationalizeAddHom (g.comp f) =
      (rationalizeAddHom g).comp (rationalizeAddHom f)
proof:
:= by
  apply AddMonoidHom.ext
  intro z
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => rfl
  | tmul a y => simp
  | add y z hy hz => simp [hy, hz]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.rationalizeAddHom_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rationalizeAddHom_id
    {A : Type v} [AddCommGroup A] :
    rationalizeAddHom (AddMonoidHom.id A) =
      AddMonoidHom.id (TensorProduct ℤ ℚ A)
proof:
:= by
  apply AddMonoidHom.ext
  intro z
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => rfl
  | tmul a y => simp
  | add y z hy hz => simp [hy, hz]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.closedImmersionPushforwardRationalChow_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem closedImmersionPushforwardRationalChow_tmul
    {Z X : Scheme.{u}} {p q : ℕ}

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.closedImmersionPushforwardRationalChow_cycleClass
statement:

theorem closedImmersionPushforwardRationalChow_cycleClass
    {Z X : Scheme.{u}} {p q : ℕ}
    (j : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion j]

    (D : CodimensionCycles Z ℤ p) :
    closedImmersionPushforwardRationalChow j codimension

        (closedImmersionPushforwardCycles j codimension D)
