name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.closedImmersionPushforwardRationalChow_comp
statement:
theorem closedImmersionPushforwardRationalChow_comp
    {Y Z X : Scheme.{u}} {p q r : ℕ}
    (f : Y ⟶ Z) (g : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion f] [IsClosedImmersion g]
    (hf : ∀ y : Y, coheight y = p → coheight (f y) = q)
    (hg : ∀ z : Z, coheight z = q → coheight (g z) = r) :
    closedImmersionPushforwardRationalChow (f ≫ g)
        (closedImmersionCodimension_comp f g hf hg) =
      (closedImmersionPushforwardRationalChow g hg).comp
        (closedImmersionPushforwardRationalChow f hf)
proof:
:= by
  rw [closedImmersionPushforwardRationalChow,
    closedImmersionPushforwardChow_comp, rationalizeAddHom_comp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.closedImmersionPushforwardRationalChow_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem closedImmersionPushforwardRationalChow_id
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {p : ℕ} :
    closedImmersionPushforwardRationalChow (𝟙 X) closedImmersionCodimension_id =
      AddMonoidHom.id (RationalCodimensionChow X p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [closedImmersionPushforwardRationalChow,
    closedImmersionPushforwardChow_id, rationalizeAddHom_id]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.closedImmersionPushforwardRationalChow_smul
statement:
theorem closedImmersionPushforwardRationalChow_smul
    {Z X : Scheme.{u}} {p q : ℕ}
    (j : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    (codimension : ∀ z : Z, coheight z = p → coheight (j z) = q)
    (a : ℚ) (z : RationalCodimensionChow Z p) :
    closedImmersionPushforwardRationalChow j codimension (a • z) =
      a • closedImmersionPushforwardRationalChow j codimension z
proof:
:= by
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp [smul_add, hx, hy]
      | tmul b z =>
      rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', closedImmersionPushforwardRationalChow_tmul,
        closedImmersionPushforwardRationalChow_tmul, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul']

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ord_inv
statement:
theorem ord_inv {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    {x : X} (hx : coheight x = 1) (f : X.functionField) (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    X.ord f⁻¹ x = -X.ord f x
proof:
:= by
  have h := X.ord_mul hx hf (inv_ne_zero hf)
  have hone : X.ord (1 : X.functionField) x = 0 := by
    rw [X.ord_eq_iff hx one_ne_zero]
    simp
  rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hf, hone] at h
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ord_div
statement:
theorem ord_div {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    {x : X} (hx : coheight x = 1) (f g : X.functionField)
    (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    X.ord (f / g) x = X.ord f x - X.ord g x
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, X.ord_mul hx hf (inv_ne_zero hg), X.ord_inv hx g hg]
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.div_div_algebraMap_eq_length_sub
statement:
theorem div_div_algebraMap_eq_length_sub
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    {x : X} (hx : coheight x = 1)
    (a b : X.presheaf.stalk x) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    div (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField a /
      algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField b) x =
      ((Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((X.presheaf.stalk x) ⧸ Ideal.span {a})).toNat : ℤ) -
      ((Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((X.presheaf.stalk x) ⧸ Ideal.span {b})).toNat : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have ha' : algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField a ≠ 0 :=
    (map_ne_zero_iff _
      (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField)).mpr ha
  have hb' : algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField b ≠ 0 :=
    (map_ne_zero_iff _
      (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField)).mpr hb
  rw [div_eq_ord, X.ord_div hx _ _ ha' hb']
  rw [← div_eq_ord, X.div_algebraMap_eq_length_toNat hx a ha]
  rw [← div_eq_ord, X.div_algebraMap_eq_length_toNat hx b hb]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.div_inv
statement:
theorem div_inv {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (f : X.functionField) (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    div f⁻¹ = -div f
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  by_cases hx : coheight x = 1
  · rw [div_eq_ord, Scheme.ord_inv hx f hf]
    rfl
  · simp [div_eq_ord, Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hx]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.div_div
statement:
theorem div_div {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (f g : X.functionField) (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    div (f / g) = div f - div g
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  by_cases hx : coheight x = 1
  · rw [div_eq_ord, Scheme.ord_div hx f g hf hg]
    rfl
  · simp [div_eq_ord, Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hx]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.div_pow_nonzero
statement:
theorem div_pow_nonzero {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (f : X.functionField) (hf : f ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    div (f ^ n) = n • div f
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      ext x
      simp only [pow_zero, zero_nsmul, div_eq_ord,
        Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
      by_cases hx : Order.coheight x = 1
      · exact (X.ord_eq_iff hx one_ne_zero).mpr (by simp)
      · exact X.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hx 1
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [pow_succ, div_mul _ (pow_ne_zero n hf) _ hf, ih, succ_nsmul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.div_zpow_nonzero
statement:
theorem div_zpow_nonzero {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (f : X.functionField) (hf : f ≠ 0) (n : ℤ) :
    div (f ^ n) = n • div f
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | ofNat n =>
      simpa using div_pow_nonzero f hf n
  | negSucc n =>
      rw [zpow_negSucc, div_inv _ (pow_ne_zero (n + 1) hf),
        div_pow_nonzero f hf (n + 1)]
      simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.div_finset_prod_zpow
statement:
theorem div_finset_prod_zpow {X : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → X.functionField)
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, f i ≠ 0) (n : ι → ℤ) :
    div (∏ i ∈ s, f i ^ n i) = ∑ i ∈ s, n i • div (f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      ext x
      simp only [Finset.prod_empty, Finset.sum_empty, div_eq_ord,
        Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
      by_cases hx : Order.coheight x = 1
      · exact (X.ord_eq_iff hx one_ne_zero).mpr (by simp)
      · exact X.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hx 1
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
      rw [Finset.prod_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha]
      rw [div_mul _ (zpow_ne_zero (n a)
        (hf a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s))) _]
      · rw [div_zpow_nonzero _ (hf a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)), ih]
        intro i hi
        exact hf i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)
      · exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun i hi ↦
          zpow_ne_zero (n i) (hf i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.exists_coheight_eq_two
statement: theorem exists_coheight_eq_two : ∃ x : space k 2, coheight x = 2
proof:
:= by
  let R := Γ(space k 2, coordinateOpen k 2 (firstIndex 2))
  have hcard : Nat.card (AffineChartIndex 2 (firstIndex 2)) = 2 := by
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
    decide
  have hdim : ringKrullDim R = 2 := by
    rw [ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (coordinateOpenSectionsEquiv k 2 (firstIndex 2)),
      MvPolynomial.ringKrullDim_of_isNoetherianRing,
      ringKrullDim_eq_zero_of_isField (Field.toIsField k), hcard]
    rfl
  have h2 : ((2 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ Order.krullDim (PrimeSpectrum R) := by
    change _ ≤ ringKrullDim R
    rw [hdim]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := Order.le_krullDim_iff.mp h2
  refine ⟨(firstChart_isAffine k 2).fromSpec l.last, ?_⟩
  rw [coheight_firstChart_fromSpec, PrimeSpectrum.height_eq_orderHeight]
  apply le_antisymm
  · have h := Order.height_le_krullDim l.last
    change _ ≤ ringKrullDim R at h
    rw [hdim] at h
    have h' : ((height l.last : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := h
    exact WithBot.coe_le_coe.mp h'
  · have h := Order.length_le_height_last (p := l)
    rw [hl] at h
    exact_mod_cast h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.isClosed_of_coheight_eq_two
statement:
theorem isClosed_of_coheight_eq_two {x : space k 2} (hx : coheight x = 2) :
    IsClosed ({x} : Set (space k 2))
proof:
:= by
  refine closure_subset_iff_isClosed.mp fun z hz ↦ ?_
  have hxz : x ⤳ z := specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr hz
  have hle : z ≤ x := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr hxz
  by_contra hne
  have hlt : z < x := lt_of_le_not_ge hle fun hge ↦
    hne ((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hge).antisymm hxz).eq
  have h3 := Order.coheight_add_one_le hlt
  rw [hx] at h3
  have h4 : coheight z ≤ 2 := coheight_le_of_krullDimLE 2 z
  have : (2 : ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ 2 := h3.trans h4
  exact absurd this (by decide)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.finrank_residueField_ne_zero
statement:
theorem finrank_residueField_ne_zero {x : space k 2} (hx : coheight x = 2) :
    Module.finrank k ((space k 2).residueField x) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (space k 2 ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType (toSpec k 2))
  haveI := AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.finite_residueField_of_isClosed k
    (isClosed_of_coheight_eq_two k hx)
  exact Module.finrank_pos.ne'

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.degree_primeCycle
statement:
theorem degree_primeCycle {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] (x : X) (p : ℕ)
    (hx : coheight x = p) :
    AlgebraicCycle.degree k (primeCycle x p hx).1 = Module.finrank k (X.residueField x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [AlgebraicCycle.degree, finsum_eq_single _ x (fun y hy ↦ by
    rw [primeCycle_apply_of_ne x y p hx hy, zero_mul]), primeCycle_apply_same, one_mul]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.codimensionTwoChow_ne_zero_of_surfaceDegreeData
statement:
theorem codimensionTwoChow_ne_zero_of_surfaceDegreeData
    (d : SurfaceDegreeData (space k 2) k) :
    ∃ z : CodimensionChow (space k 2) 2, SurfaceDegreeData.integralDegree k d z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_coheight_eq_two k
  refine ⟨gradedClassOf (space k 2) 2 (primeCycle x 2 hx), ?_⟩
  rw [SurfaceDegreeData.integralDegree_classOf, degree_primeCycle]
  exact_mod_cast finrank_residueField_ne_zero k hx

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.codimensionTwoChow_nontrivial
statement:
theorem codimensionTwoChow_nontrivial
    (hχ : ∀ g : RationalRelationGenerator (space k 2) 2,
      SurfaceDegreeNormalization.NormalizationStructureSheafFinite k g) :
    ∃ z : CodimensionChow (space k 2) 2, z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsProper (space k 2 ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsProper (toSpec k 2))
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := codimensionTwoChow_ne_zero_of_surfaceDegreeData k
    (surfaceDegreeData_of_normalizationStructureSheafFinite k hχ)
  exact ⟨z, fun h ↦ hz (by rw [h, map_zero])⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.principalQuotientComplex_isZero
statement:
theorem principalQuotientComplex_isZero (a : A) (n : ℕ) :
    IsZero ((principalQuotientComplex A a).X (n + 2))
proof:
:= by
  let Z := ModuleCat.of A (Fin 0 → A)
  have hZ : IsZero Z :=
    ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mpr
      (inferInstance : Subsingleton (Fin 0 → A))
  apply IsZero.of_iso hZ
  exact ChainComplex.mk'XIso (ModuleCat.of A A) (ModuleCat.of A A)
    (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.lsmul A A a))
    (zeroResolutionSuccessor A) n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.principalQuotientComplex_exactAt_succ
statement:
theorem principalQuotientComplex_exactAt_succ (a : A)
    (reg : IsSMulRegular (ModuleCat.of A A) a) (n : ℕ) :
    (principalQuotientComplex A a).ExactAt (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain _ | n := n
  · rw [HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff' _ 2 1 0 (by simp) (by simp)]
    apply (ShortComplex.exact_iff_mono _
      ((principalQuotientComplex_isZero A a 0).eq_of_src _ _)).2
    change Mono (ModuleCat.smulShortComplex (ModuleCat.of A A) a).f
    exact reg.smulShortComplex_shortExact.mono_f
  · exact HomologicalComplex.ExactAt.of_isZero
      (principalQuotientComplex_isZero A a n)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.tensorPrincipalQuotientComplex_exactAt_succ
statement:
theorem tensorPrincipalQuotientComplex_exactAt_succ (a : A)
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) (reg : IsSMulRegular M a) (n : ℕ) :
    ((((tensoringLeft (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj M).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.down ℕ)).obj (principalQuotientComplex A a)).ExactAt (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let F := (tensoringLeft (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj M
  obtain _ | n := n
  · rw [HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff' _ 2 1 0 (by simp) (by simp)]
    apply (ShortComplex.exact_iff_mono _
      ((F.map_isZero (principalQuotientComplex_isZero A a 0)).eq_of_src _ _)).2
    change Mono (F.map (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.lsmul A A a)))
    have hcomm :
        F.map (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.lsmul A A a)) ≫
            (MonoidalCategory.rightUnitor M).hom =
          (MonoidalCategory.rightUnitor M).hom ≫
            ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.lsmul A M a) := by
      apply ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.tensor_ext
      intro m r
      simp [F]
      change (a * r) • m = a • r • m
      rw [smul_smul]
    rw [ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective]
    intro x y hxy
    have hρ : Function.Injective (MonoidalCategory.rightUnitor M).hom :=
      (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective _).mp inferInstance |>.1
    have hmul : Function.Injective
        (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.lsmul A M a)).hom := by
      change Function.Injective (LinearMap.lsmul A M a)
      exact reg
    apply hρ
    apply hmul
    calc
      _ = (MonoidalCategory.rightUnitor M).hom
          (F.map (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.lsmul A A a)) x) :=
        (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hcomm x).symm
      _ = (MonoidalCategory.rightUnitor M).hom
          (F.map (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.lsmul A A a)) y) :=
        congrArg (MonoidalCategory.rightUnitor M).hom hxy
      _ = _ := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hcomm y
  · exact HomologicalComplex.ExactAt.of_isZero
      (F.map_isZero (principalQuotientComplex_isZero A a n))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.length_zero_eq_tensor
statement:
theorem length_zero_eq_tensor (M N : ModuleCat.{u} A) :
    length A M N 0 =
      Module.length A ((M ⊗ N : ModuleCat.{u} A) : Type u)
proof:
:=
  (zeroIsoTensor A M N).toLinearEquiv.length_eq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.length_eq_zero_of_isZero
statement:
theorem length_eq_zero_of_isZero (M N : ModuleCat.{u} A) (n : ℕ)
    (h : IsZero (module A M N n)) : length A M N n = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [length, Module.length_eq_zero_iff]
  exact ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.signedLength_eq_zero_of_isZero
statement:
theorem signedLength_eq_zero_of_isZero (M N : ModuleCat.{u} A) (n : ℕ)
    (h : IsZero (module A M N n)) : signedLength A M N n = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [signedLength, length_eq_zero_of_isZero A M N n h]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.EulerData.multiplicity_eq
statement: theorem multiplicity_eq (d e : EulerData A M N) : d.multiplicity = e.multiplicity
proof:
:= by
  unfold multiplicity
  rcases le_total d.bound e.bound with hde | hed
  · apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono (Nat.succ_le_succ hde))
    intro n hnE hnD
    rw [signedLength_eq_zero_of_isZero A M N n]
    apply d.vanishes n
    simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hnD hnE
    omega
  · symm
    apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_mono (Nat.succ_le_succ hed))
    intro n hnD hnE
    rw [signedLength_eq_zero_of_isZero A M N n]
    apply e.vanishes n
    simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hnE hnD
    omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution.homology_length_ne_top_of_X
statement:
theorem homology_length_ne_top_of_X
    (K : HomologicalComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) (ComplexShape.down ℕ)) (n : ℕ)
    (h : Module.length A (↑(K.X n) : Type u) ≠ ⊤) :
    Module.length A (↑(K.homology n) : Type u) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [Module.length_ne_top_iff] at h ⊢
  exact (h.of_injective
    ((ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective (K.iCycles n)).mp inferInstance)).of_surjective
      ((ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective (K.homologyπ n)).mp inferInstance)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution.isZero_module
statement:
theorem isZero_module (d : BoundedProjectiveResolution A N) (M : ModuleCat.{u} A)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : d.bound < n) : IsZero (module A M N n)
proof:
:= by
  change IsZero
    (((((tensoringLeft (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj M).leftDerived n).obj N))
  refine IsZero.of_iso ?_
    (d.resolution.isoLeftDerivedObj ((tensoringLeft (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj M) n)
  erw [← HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff_isZero_homology]
  exact ShortComplex.exact_of_isZero_X₂ _
    (((tensoringLeft (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj M).map_isZero (d.isZero n hn))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution.length_ne_top_of_term
statement:
theorem length_ne_top_of_term (d : BoundedProjectiveResolution A N)
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) (n : ℕ)
    (hterm : Module.length A
      (↑(((tensoringLeft (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj M).obj
        (d.resolution.complex.X n)) : Type u) ≠ ⊤) :
    length A M N n ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  change Module.length A
    (↑(((((tensoringLeft (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj M).leftDerived n).obj N)) : Type u) ≠ ⊤
  rw [(d.resolution.isoLeftDerivedObj
      ((tensoringLeft (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj M) n).toLinearEquiv.length_eq]
  exact homology_length_ne_top_of_X A
    (((tensoringLeft (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj M).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.down ℕ) |>.obj d.resolution.complex) n hterm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution.isZero_module_principalQuotient
statement:
theorem isZero_module_principalQuotient (a : A)
    (reg : IsSMulRegular (ModuleCat.of A A) a) (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) (n : ℕ) :
    IsZero (module A M (ModuleCat.of A (QuotSMulTop a A)) (n + 2))
proof:
:= by
  apply (principalQuotient A a reg).isZero_module A M
  change 1 < n + 2
  omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution.isZero_module_principalQuotient_of_isSMulRegular
statement:
theorem isZero_module_principalQuotient_of_isSMulRegular (a : A)
    (regA : IsSMulRegular (ModuleCat.of A A) a) (M : ModuleCat.{u} A)
    (regM : IsSMulRegular M a) (n : ℕ) :
    IsZero (module A M (ModuleCat.of A (QuotSMulTop a A)) (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  change IsZero
    (((((tensoringLeft (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj M).leftDerived (n + 1)).obj
      (ModuleCat.of A (QuotSMulTop a A))))
  refine IsZero.of_iso ?_
    ((principalQuotientResolution A a regA).isoLeftDerivedObj
      ((tensoringLeft (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj M) (n + 1))
  erw [← HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff_isZero_homology]
  exact tensorPrincipalQuotientComplex_exactAt_succ A a M regM n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution.isZero_module_of_iso_principalQuotient_of_isSMulRegular
statement:
theorem isZero_module_of_iso_principalQuotient_of_isSMulRegular (a : A)
    (regA : IsSMulRegular (ModuleCat.of A A) a) (M : ModuleCat.{u} A)
    (regM : IsSMulRegular M a) {N' : ModuleCat.{u} A}
    (e : ModuleCat.of A (QuotSMulTop a A) ≅ N') (n : ℕ) :
    IsZero (module A M N' (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let resolution := (principalQuotient A a regA).ofIso A e
  change IsZero
    (((((tensoringLeft (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj M).leftDerived (n + 1)).obj N'))
  refine IsZero.of_iso ?_
    (resolution.resolution.isoLeftDerivedObj
      ((tensoringLeft (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj M) (n + 1))
  erw [← HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff_isZero_homology]
  exact tensorPrincipalQuotientComplex_exactAt_succ A a M regM n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution.principalQuotientEulerData_multiplicity
statement:
theorem principalQuotientEulerData_multiplicity (a : A)
    (reg : IsSMulRegular (ModuleCat.of A A) a) (M : ModuleCat.{u} A)
    (hM : Module.length A (↑M : Type u) ≠ ⊤) :
    (principalQuotientEulerData A a reg M hM).multiplicity =
      (length A M (ModuleCat.of A (QuotSMulTop a A)) 0).toNat -
        (length A M (ModuleCat.of A (QuotSMulTop a A)) 1).toNat
proof:
:= by
  simp [principalQuotientEulerData, toEulerDataOfFiniteTerms, toEulerData,
    principalQuotient, EulerData.multiplicity, signedLength, Finset.sum_range_succ,
    sub_eq_add_neg]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.eulerDataOfTorIndependent_multiplicity
statement:
theorem eulerDataOfTorIndependent_multiplicity
    (M N : ModuleCat.{u} A)
    (hzero : Module.length A ((M ⊗ N : ModuleCat.{u} A) : Type u) ≠ ⊤)
    (hTor : ∀ n : ℕ, IsZero (module A M N (n + 1))) :
    (eulerDataOfTorIndependent A M N hzero hTor).multiplicity =
      (Module.length A ((M ⊗ N : ModuleCat.{u} A) : Type u)).toNat
proof:
:= by
  simp [EulerData.multiplicity, eulerDataOfTorIndependent, signedLength,
    length_zero_eq_tensor]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.eulerDataOfProjective_multiplicity
statement:
theorem eulerDataOfProjective_multiplicity
    (M N : ModuleCat.{u} A) [Projective N]
    (hzero : Module.length A ((M ⊗ N : ModuleCat.{u} A) : Type u) ≠ ⊤) :
    (eulerDataOfProjective A M N hzero).multiplicity =
      (Module.length A ((M ⊗ N : ModuleCat.{u} A) : Type u)).toNat
proof:
:= by
  apply eulerDataOfTorIndependent_multiplicity

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.codimensionCycleDegree_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem codimensionCycleDegree_apply (p : ℕ) (D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ p) :
    codimensionCycleDegree k p D = AlgebraicCycle.degree k D.1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SurfaceDegreeData.integralDegree_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem integralDegree_classOf (D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ 2) :
    integralDegree (X := X) k d (gradedClassOf X 2 D) =
      AlgebraicCycle.degree k D.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [integralDegree, gradedClassLift_classOf, codimensionCycleDegree_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SurfaceDegreeData.degree_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degree_tmul (a : ℚ) (z : CodimensionChow X 2) :
    degree (X := X) k d (a ⊗ₜ[ℤ] z) =
      a * (integralDegree (X := X) k d z : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [degree, mul_comm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SurfaceDegreeData.degree_smul
statement:
theorem degree_smul (a : ℚ) (z : RationalCodimensionChow X 2) :
    degree (X := X) k d (a • z) = a * degree (X := X) k d z
proof:
:= by
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp [smul_add, hx, hy, mul_add]
  | tmul b z =>
      rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      simp [degree_tmul, smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SurfaceDegreeData.degree_rationalGradedClassOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degree_rationalGradedClassOf (D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ 2) :
    degree (X := X) k d (rationalGradedClassOf X 2 D) =
      (AlgebraicCycle.degree k D.1 : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rationalGradedClassOf_apply, degree_tmul, integralDegree_classOf]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SurfaceDegreeData.degree_finiteIntersection
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degree_finiteIntersection (I : FiniteClosedIntersectionData X 2) :
    degree (X := X) k d (rationalGradedClassOf X 2 I.cycle) =
      (I.intersectionNumber k : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [degree_rationalGradedClassOf]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SurfaceDegreeData.degree_finiteIntersection_nonneg
statement:
theorem degree_finiteIntersection_nonneg (I : FiniteClosedIntersectionData X 2) :
    0 ≤ degree (X := X) k d (rationalGradedClassOf X 2 I.cycle)
proof:
:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.residueFieldMap_bijective_of_isClosedImmersion
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.residueFieldMap_bijective_of_isClosedImmersion
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion f] (x : X) :
    Function.Bijective (f.residueFieldMap x).hom
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra ↑(Y.residueField (f x)) ↑(X.residueField x) :=
    (f.residueFieldMap x).hom.toAlgebra
  constructor
  · exact FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective
      (Y.residueField (f x)) (X.residueField x)
  · intro z
    obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective z
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := f.stalkMap_surjective x s
    refine ⟨IsLocalRing.residue _ r, ?_⟩
    change IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (f.stalkMap x).hom
      (IsLocalRing.residue _ r) = IsLocalRing.residue _ s
    rw [IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map_residue, hr]

proof:

  letI : Algebra
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↑(Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)))
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField ↑(X.presheaf.stalk x)) :=
    RingHom.toAlgebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (f.stalkMap x).hom)
  apply Algebra.finrank_eq_one_iff_bijective_algebraMap.mpr
  exact f.residueFieldMap_bijective_of_isClosedImmersion x

statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.finrank_residueField_eq_of_isClosedImmersion
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion f]
    (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (x : X)
    [IsScalarTower k ↑(Y.residueField (f x)) ↑(X.residueField x)] :
    Module.finrank k ↑(X.residueField x) =
      Module.finrank k ↑(Y.residueField (f x))
proof:
:= by
  have hdeg : Module.finrank ↑(Y.residueField (f x)) ↑(X.residueField x) = 1 :=
    f.residueDegree_eq_one_of_isClosedImmersion x
  have := Module.finrank_mul_finrank k ↑(Y.residueField (f x)) ↑(X.residueField x)
  simp only [hdeg, mul_one] at this
  exact this.symm

proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.expectedIntersectionClass_eq_of_left_class_eq
statement:
theorem expectedIntersectionClass_eq_of_left_class_eq
    (T : SurfaceExpectedRestrictionLocalTheory X)
    {D D' E : CodimensionCycles X ℤ 1}
    (h : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D E)
    (h' : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D' E)
    (hclass : gradedClassOf X 1 D = gradedClassOf X 1 D') :
    gradedClassOf X 2 (expectedIntersectionCycle h) =
      gradedClassOf X 2 (expectedIntersectionCycle h')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hgcycle⟩ :=
    exists_identityPrincipalRelation_cycle_eq_sub_of_gradedClassOf_eq D D' hclass
  have hgcycle' : g.cycle = D + -D' := by
    simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg] using hgcycle
  have hgmeeting : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension g.cycle E := by
    rw [hgcycle']
    exact h.add_left h'.neg_left
  have hm :=
    T.relation_expectedIntersectionCycle_mem_rationalEquivalenceSubgroup
      g E hgmeeting
  have hm' :
      expectedIntersectionCycle (h.add_left h'.neg_left) ∈
        rationalEquivalenceSubgroup X 2 := by
    rw [← expectedIntersectionCycle_congr_left hgmeeting
      (h.add_left h'.neg_left) hgcycle']
    exact hm
  rw [expectedIntersectionCycle_add_left h h'.neg_left,
    expectedIntersectionCycle_neg_left h'] at hm'
  apply gradedClassOf_eq_iff.mpr
  simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg] using hm'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.expectedIntersectionClass_eq_of_right_class_eq
statement:
theorem expectedIntersectionClass_eq_of_right_class_eq
    (T : SurfaceExpectedRestrictionLocalTheory X)
    {D E E' : CodimensionCycles X ℤ 1}
    (h : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D E)
    (h' : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D E')
    (hclass : gradedClassOf X 1 E = gradedClassOf X 1 E') :
    gradedClassOf X 2 (expectedIntersectionCycle h) =
      gradedClassOf X 2 (expectedIntersectionCycle h')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hgcycle⟩ :=
    exists_identityPrincipalRelation_cycle_eq_sub_of_gradedClassOf_eq E E' hclass
  have hgcycle' : g.cycle = E + -E' := by
    simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg] using hgcycle
  have hgmeeting : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D g.cycle := by
    rw [hgcycle']
    exact h.add_right h'.neg_right
  have hm :=
    T.expectedIntersectionCycle_relation_mem_rationalEquivalenceSubgroup
      D g hgmeeting
  have hm' :
      expectedIntersectionCycle (h.add_right h'.neg_right) ∈
        rationalEquivalenceSubgroup X 2 := by
    rw [← expectedIntersectionCycle_congr_right hgmeeting
      (h.add_right h'.neg_right) hgcycle']
    exact hm
  rw [expectedIntersectionCycle_add_right h h'.neg_right,
    expectedIntersectionCycle_neg_right h'] at hm'
  apply gradedClassOf_eq_iff.mpr
  simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg] using hm'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.expectedIntersectionClass_eq_of_classes_eq
statement:
theorem expectedIntersectionClass_eq_of_classes_eq
    {k : Type v} {V : Type w}
    [Field k] [Infinite k] [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V]
    (T : SurfaceExpectedRestrictionLocalTheory X)
    (L : SurfaceDivisorLinearSystems X k V)
    {D D' E E' : CodimensionCycles X ℤ 1}
    (h : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D E)
    (h' : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D' E')
    (hD : gradedClassOf X 1 D = gradedClassOf X 1 D')
    (hE : gradedClassOf X 1 E = gradedClassOf X 1 E') :
    gradedClassOf X 2 (expectedIntersectionCycle h) =
      gradedClassOf X 2 (expectedIntersectionCycle h')
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨F, hFclass, hcycles, _⟩ :=
    (L.system (gradedClassOf X 1 D)).exists_cycle_meeting_cycles_and_relationCombination
      {E, E'} 0
  have hFE : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension F E :=
    hcycles E (by simp)
  have hFE' : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension F E' :=
    hcycles E' (by simp)
  calc
    gradedClassOf X 2 (expectedIntersectionCycle h) =
        gradedClassOf X 2 (expectedIntersectionCycle hFE) :=
      expectedIntersectionClass_eq_of_left_class_eq T h hFE hFclass.symm
    _ = gradedClassOf X 2 (expectedIntersectionCycle hFE') :=
      expectedIntersectionClass_eq_of_right_class_eq T hFE hFE' hE
    _ = gradedClassOf X 2 (expectedIntersectionCycle h') :=
      expectedIntersectionClass_eq_of_left_class_eq T hFE' h'
        (hFclass.trans hD)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.surfaceMovedIntersectionValue_classOf_classOf
statement:
theorem surfaceMovedIntersectionValue_classOf_classOf
    {k : Type v} {V : Type w}
    [Field k] [Infinite k] [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V]
    (T : SurfaceExpectedRestrictionLocalTheory X)
    (L : SurfaceDivisorLinearSystems X k V)
    (D E : CodimensionCycles X ℤ 1)
    (h : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D E) :
    surfaceMovedIntersectionValue L
        (gradedClassOf X 1 D) (gradedClassOf X 1 E) =
      gradedClassOf X 2 (expectedIntersectionCycle h)
proof:
:= by
  let w := L.expectedCodimensionMovingStatement.witness
    (gradedClassOf X 1 D) (gradedClassOf X 1 E)
  change gradedClassOf X 2 (expectedIntersectionCycle w.meeting) =
    gradedClassOf X 2 (expectedIntersectionCycle h)
  exact expectedIntersectionClass_eq_of_classes_eq T L w.meeting h
    w.left_class w.right_class

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.surfaceMovedIntersectionValue_zero_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem surfaceMovedIntersectionValue_zero_right
    {k : Type v} {V : Type w}
    [Field k] [Infinite k] [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V]
    (T : SurfaceExpectedRestrictionLocalTheory X)
    (L : SurfaceDivisorLinearSystems X k V)
    (x : CodimensionChow X 1) :
    surfaceMovedIntersectionValue L x 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hDx⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective
    (rationalEquivalenceSubgroup X 1) x
  rw [← hDx]
  change surfaceMovedIntersectionValue L (gradedClassOf X 1 D) 0 = 0
  simpa using surfaceMovedIntersectionValue_classOf_classOf T L D
    (0 : CodimensionCycles X ℤ 1)
    (CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension.zero_right D)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.surfaceMovedIntersectionValue_add_right
statement:
theorem surfaceMovedIntersectionValue_add_right
    {k : Type v} {V : Type w}
    [Field k] [Infinite k] [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V]
    (T : SurfaceExpectedRestrictionLocalTheory X)
    (L : SurfaceDivisorLinearSystems X k V)
    (x : CodimensionChow X 1) (y y' : CodimensionChow X 1) :
    surfaceMovedIntersectionValue L x (y + y') =
      surfaceMovedIntersectionValue L x y +
        surfaceMovedIntersectionValue L x y'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨E, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective
    (rationalEquivalenceSubgroup X 1) y
  obtain ⟨E', rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective
    (rationalEquivalenceSubgroup X 1) y'
  obtain ⟨D, hDclass, hcycles, _⟩ :=
    (L.system x).exists_cycle_meeting_cycles_and_relationCombination
      {E, E'} 0
  have hDE : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D E :=
    hcycles E (by simp)
  have hDE' : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D E' :=
    hcycles E' (by simp)
  calc
    surfaceMovedIntersectionValue L x
        (gradedClassOf X 1 E + gradedClassOf X 1 E') =
      surfaceMovedIntersectionValue L (gradedClassOf X 1 D)
        (gradedClassOf X 1 (E + E')) := by
          rw [hDclass, gradedClassOf_add]
    _ = gradedClassOf X 2
        (expectedIntersectionCycle (hDE.add_right hDE')) :=
      surfaceMovedIntersectionValue_classOf_classOf T L (D := D) (E := E + E')
        (hDE.add_right hDE')
    _ = gradedClassOf X 2 (expectedIntersectionCycle hDE) +
        gradedClassOf X 2 (expectedIntersectionCycle hDE') := by
      rw [expectedIntersectionCycle_add_right hDE hDE', gradedClassOf_add]
    _ = surfaceMovedIntersectionValue L (gradedClassOf X 1 D)
          (gradedClassOf X 1 E) +
        surfaceMovedIntersectionValue L (gradedClassOf X 1 D)
          (gradedClassOf X 1 E') := by
      rw [surfaceMovedIntersectionValue_classOf_classOf T L D E hDE,
        surfaceMovedIntersectionValue_classOf_classOf T L D E' hDE']
    _ = surfaceMovedIntersectionValue L x (gradedClassOf X 1 E) +
        surfaceMovedIntersectionValue L x (gradedClassOf X 1 E') := by
      rw [hDclass]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.surfaceMovedIntersectionValue_zero_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem surfaceMovedIntersectionValue_zero_left
    {k : Type v} {V : Type w}
    [Field k] [Infinite k] [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.surfaceMovedIntersectionValue_add_left
statement:
theorem surfaceMovedIntersectionValue_add_left
    {k : Type v} {V : Type w}
    [Field k] [Infinite k] [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V]
    (T : SurfaceExpectedRestrictionLocalTheory X)
    (L : SurfaceDivisorLinearSystems X k V)
    (x x' : CodimensionChow X 1) (y : CodimensionChow X 1) :
    surfaceMovedIntersectionValue L (x + x') y =
      surfaceMovedIntersectionValue L x y +
        surfaceMovedIntersectionValue L x' y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨D, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective
    (rationalEquivalenceSubgroup X 1) x
  obtain ⟨D', rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective
    (rationalEquivalenceSubgroup X 1) x'
  obtain ⟨E, hEclass, hcycles, _⟩ :=
    (L.system y).exists_cycle_meeting_cycles_and_relationCombination
      {D, D'} 0
  have hDE : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D E :=
    (hcycles D (by simp)).symm
  have hD'E : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D' E :=
    (hcycles D' (by simp)).symm
  calc
    surfaceMovedIntersectionValue L
        (gradedClassOf X 1 D + gradedClassOf X 1 D') y =
      surfaceMovedIntersectionValue L (gradedClassOf X 1 (D + D'))
        (gradedClassOf X 1 E) := by
          rw [hEclass, gradedClassOf_add]
    _ = gradedClassOf X 2
        (expectedIntersectionCycle (hDE.add_left hD'E)) :=
      surfaceMovedIntersectionValue_classOf_classOf T L (D := D + D') (E := E)
        (hDE.add_left hD'E)
    _ = gradedClassOf X 2 (expectedIntersectionCycle hDE) +
        gradedClassOf X 2 (expectedIntersectionCycle hD'E) := by
      rw [expectedIntersectionCycle_add_left hDE hD'E, gradedClassOf_add]
    _ = surfaceMovedIntersectionValue L (gradedClassOf X 1 D)
          (gradedClassOf X 1 E) +
        surfaceMovedIntersectionValue L (gradedClassOf X 1 D')
          (gradedClassOf X 1 E) := by
      rw [surfaceMovedIntersectionValue_classOf_classOf T L D E hDE,
        surfaceMovedIntersectionValue_classOf_classOf T L D' E hD'E]
    _ = surfaceMovedIntersectionValue L (gradedClassOf X 1 D) y +
        surfaceMovedIntersectionValue L (gradedClassOf X 1 D') y := by
      rw [hEclass]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.surfaceMovedIntersectionProductData_product_comm
statement:
theorem surfaceMovedIntersectionProductData_product_comm
    {k : Type v} {V : Type w}
    [Field k] [Infinite k] [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V]
    (T : SurfaceExpectedRestrictionLocalTheory X)
    (L : SurfaceDivisorLinearSystems X k V)
    (x y : CodimensionChow X 1) :
    (surfaceMovedIntersectionProductData T L).product x y =
      (surfaceMovedIntersectionProductData T L).product y x
proof:
:= by
  let w := L.expectedCodimensionMovingStatement.witness x y
  have hcycle :
      expectedIntersectionCycle w.meeting.symm =
        expectedIntersectionCycle w.meeting := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact expectedIntersectionCycle_symm w.meeting
  calc
    (surfaceMovedIntersectionProductData T L).product x y =
        gradedClassOf X 2 (expectedIntersectionCycle w.meeting) := by
      simpa only [MovedIntersectionProductData.product,
        w.left_class, w.right_class] using
        (surfaceMovedIntersectionProductData T L).product_classOf_classOf
          w.left w.right w.meeting
    _ = gradedClassOf X 2 (expectedIntersectionCycle w.meeting.symm) := by
      rw [hcycle]
    _ = (surfaceMovedIntersectionProductData T L).product y x := by
      symm
      simpa only [MovedIntersectionProductData.product,
        w.right_class, w.left_class] using
        (surfaceMovedIntersectionProductData T L).product_classOf_classOf
          w.right w.left w.meeting.symm

  (surfaceMovedIntersectionProductData T L).rationalProduct_comm_of_product_comm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.gradedDegreeOfStructureSheafFinite_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gradedDegreeOfStructureSheafFinite_classOf
    (hχO : (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.structureSheafModule X).HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic
      k) (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    gradedDegreeOfStructureSheafFinite k hχO
        (gradedClassOf X 1 (D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ 1)) =
      AlgebraicCycle.degree k D.1
proof:
:= by
  change degreeOfStructureSheafFinite k hχO
      ((codimensionOneEquivGradedChow (X := X)).symm
        (gradedClassOf X 1 (D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ 1))) =
    AlgebraicCycle.degree k D.1
  rw [← codimensionOneToGradedChow_classOf D]
  change degreeOfStructureSheafFinite k hχO
      ((codimensionOneEquivGradedChow (X := X)).symm
        ((codimensionOneEquivGradedChow (X := X)) (classOf X D))) =

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.rationalGradedDegreeOfStructureSheafFinite_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rationalGradedDegreeOfStructureSheafFinite_tmul
    (hχO : (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.structureSheafModule X).HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic
      k) (a : ℚ) (z : CodimensionChow X 1) :
    rationalGradedDegreeOfStructureSheafFinite k hχO (a ⊗ₜ[ℤ] z) =
      a * (gradedDegreeOfStructureSheafFinite k hχO z : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [rationalGradedDegreeOfStructureSheafFinite, mul_comm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.rationalGradedDegreeOfStructureSheafFinite_smul
statement:
theorem rationalGradedDegreeOfStructureSheafFinite_smul
    (hχO : (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.structureSheafModule X).HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic
      k) (a : ℚ) (z : RationalCodimensionChow X 1) :
    rationalGradedDegreeOfStructureSheafFinite k hχO (a • z) =
      a * rationalGradedDegreeOfStructureSheafFinite k hχO z
proof:
:= by
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp [smul_add, hx, hy, mul_add]
  | tmul b z =>
      rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      simp [rationalGradedDegreeOfStructureSheafFinite_tmul, smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.rationalGradedDegreeOfStructureSheafFinite_divisor
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rationalGradedDegreeOfStructureSheafFinite_divisor
    (hχO : (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.structureSheafModule X).HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic
      k) (a : ℚ) (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    rationalGradedDegreeOfStructureSheafFinite k hχO
        (a ⊗ₜ[ℤ] gradedClassOf X 1 (D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ 1)) =
      a * AlgebraicCycle.degree k D.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [rationalGradedDegreeOfStructureSheafFinite_tmul,
    gradedDegreeOfStructureSheafFinite_classOf]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.weilDivisorDegree_principal
statement:
theorem weilDivisorDegree_principal (f : X.functionField) (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    weilDivisorDegree k (principalWeilDivisor X f) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let uf : X.functionFieldˣ := Units.mk0 f hf
  have hprincipal : principalWeilDivisor X f = SchemeBridge.schemePrincipalDivisor uf := rfl
  rw [hprincipal, weilDivisorDegree_apply,
    SchemeBridge.degree_weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor]
  rw [SchemeBridge.weilDivisorToFunctionFieldDivisor_schemePrincipalDivisor]
  exact FunctionField.Divisor.deg_principal_eq_zero k X.functionField uf

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.principalDivisorSubgroup_le_degree_ker
statement:
theorem principalDivisorSubgroup_le_degree_ker :
    principalDivisorSubgroup X ≤ (weilDivisorDegree k).ker
proof:
:= by
  rw [principalDivisorSubgroup, AddSubgroup.closure_le]
  rintro D ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
  change weilDivisorDegree k (principalWeilDivisor X f) = 0
  exact weilDivisorDegree_principal k f hf

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.degree_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degree_classOf (D : WeilDivisor X) :
    degree k (classOf X D) = AlgebraicCycle.degree k D.1
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.degree_principal_class
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degree_principal_class (f : X.functionField) (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    degree k (classOf X (principalWeilDivisor X f)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [degree_classOf]
  exact weilDivisorDegree_principal k f hf

name: UniqueFactorizationMonoid.associated_of_forall_emultiplicity_eq
statement:
theorem associated_of_forall_emultiplicity_eq {a b : A} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ p : A, Prime p → emultiplicity p a = emultiplicity p b) : Associated a b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : NormalizationMonoid A := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizationMonoid
  rw [associated_iff_normalizedFactors_eq_normalizedFactors ha hb]
  ext q
  have key : ∀ hirr : Irreducible q, normalize q = q →
      (normalizedFactors a).count q = (normalizedFactors b).count q := by
    intro hirr hnorm
    have hcount := h q hirr.prime
    rw [emultiplicity_eq_count_normalizedFactors hirr ha,
      emultiplicity_eq_count_normalizedFactors hirr hb, hnorm] at hcount
    exact_mod_cast hcount
  by_cases hqa : q ∈ normalizedFactors a
  · exact key (irreducible_of_normalized_factor q hqa) (normalize_normalized_factor q hqa)
  · by_cases hqb : q ∈ normalizedFactors b
    · exact key (irreducible_of_normalized_factor q hqb) (normalize_normalized_factor q hqb)
    · rw [Multiset.count_eq_zero_of_notMem hqa, Multiset.count_eq_zero_of_notMem hqb]

name: UniqueFactorizationMonoid.associated_of_forall_pow_dvd_iff
statement:
theorem associated_of_forall_pow_dvd_iff {a b : A} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ p : A, Prime p → ∀ n : ℕ, p ^ n ∣ a ↔ p ^ n ∣ b) : Associated a b
proof:
:=
  associated_of_forall_emultiplicity_eq ha hb fun p hp =>
    emultiplicity_eq_emultiplicity_iff.mpr (h p hp)

name: UniqueFactorizationMonoid.exists_unit_algebraMap_eq_of_forall_emultiplicity_eq
statement:
theorem exists_unit_algebraMap_eq_of_forall_emultiplicity_eq
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K] {a b : A} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ p : A, Prime p → emultiplicity p a = emultiplicity p b) :
    ∃ u : Aˣ, algebraMap A K a = algebraMap A K (u : A) * algebraMap A K b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := associated_of_forall_emultiplicity_eq ha hb h
  refine ⟨u⁻¹, ?_⟩
  rw [← hu, ← map_mul]
  congr 1
  rw [mul_comm a, ← mul_assoc, Units.inv_mul, one_mul]

name: UniqueFactorizationMonoid.exists_unit_algebraMap_eq_of_forall_pow_dvd_iff
statement:
theorem exists_unit_algebraMap_eq_of_forall_pow_dvd_iff
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K] {a b : A} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ p : A, Prime p → ∀ n : ℕ, p ^ n ∣ a ↔ p ^ n ∣ b) :
    ∃ u : Aˣ, algebraMap A K a = algebraMap A K (u : A) * algebraMap A K b
proof:
:=
  exists_unit_algebraMap_eq_of_forall_emultiplicity_eq ha hb fun p hp =>
    emultiplicity_eq_emultiplicity_iff.mpr (h p hp)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.iso_hom_inv_app
statement:
theorem iso_hom_inv_app {S : Scheme.{u}} {A B : S.Modules} (e : A ≅ B) (O : S.Opens)
    (x : Γ(B, O)) : e.hom.app O (e.inv.app O x) = x
proof:
:= by
  change (e.inv ≫ e.hom).app O x = x
  rw [e.inv_hom_id]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.iso_inv_hom_app
statement:
theorem iso_inv_hom_app {S : Scheme.{u}} {A B : S.Modules} (e : A ≅ B) (O : S.Opens)
    (x : Γ(A, O)) : e.inv.app O (e.hom.app O x) = x
proof:
:= by
  change (e.hom ≫ e.inv).app O x = x
  rw [e.hom_inv_id]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.restrict_unit_comp_restrictFunctorIsoPullback
statement:
theorem restrict_unit_comp_restrictFunctorIsoPullback {S T : Scheme.{u}} (q : S ⟶ T)
    [IsOpenImmersion q] (M : T.Modules) :
    (restrictAdjunction q).unit.app M ≫
        (pushforward q).map ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).hom.app M) =
      (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q).unit.app M
proof:
:=
  Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app _ _ M

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.restrictFunctorIsoPullback_hom_restrict
statement:
theorem restrictFunctorIsoPullback_hom_restrict {S T : Scheme.{u}} (q : S ⟶ T)
    [IsOpenImmersion q] (M : T.Modules) (O : T.Opens) (s : Γ(M, O)) :
    ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).hom.app M).app (q ⁻¹ᵁ O)
        (((restrictAdjunction q).unit.app M).app O s) =
      ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q).unit.app M).app O s
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (fun φ ↦ (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app φ O) s)
    (restrict_unit_comp_restrictFunctorIsoPullback q M)
  exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.restrictFunctorIsoPullback_inv_unit
statement:
theorem restrictFunctorIsoPullback_inv_unit {S T : Scheme.{u}} (q : S ⟶ T)
    [IsOpenImmersion q] (M : T.Modules) (O : T.Opens) (s : Γ(M, O)) :
    ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).inv.app M).app (q ⁻¹ᵁ O)
        (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q).unit.app M).app O s) =
      ((restrictAdjunction q).unit.app M).app O s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← restrictFunctorIsoPullback_hom_restrict]
  exact iso_inv_hom_app ((restrictFunctorIsoPullback q).app M) _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.pullbackComp_inv_unit
statement:
theorem pullbackComp_inv_unit {S T Z : Scheme.{u}} (q : S ⟶ T) (p : T ⟶ Z) (M : Z.Modules)
    (O : Z.Opens) (s : Γ(M, O)) :
    ((pullbackComp q p).inv.app M).app ((q ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ O)
        (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (q ≫ p)).unit.app M).app O s) =
      ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q).unit.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p).obj M)).app
        (p ⁻¹ᵁ O) (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p).unit.app M).app O s)
proof:
:= by
  have hc := unit_conjugateEquiv ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p).comp
    (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q)) (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (q ≫ p))
    (pullbackComp q p).inv M
  rw [conjugateEquiv_pullbackComp_inv, Adjunction.comp_unit_app] at hc
  have := congrArg (fun φ ↦ (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app φ O) s) hc
  refine Eq.trans ?_ this.symm
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.pullbackComp_hom_unit
statement:
theorem pullbackComp_hom_unit {S T Z : Scheme.{u}} (q : S ⟶ T) (p : T ⟶ Z) (M : Z.Modules)
    (O : Z.Opens) (s : Γ(M, O)) :
    ((pullbackComp q p).hom.app M).app (q ⁻¹ᵁ (p ⁻¹ᵁ O))
        (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q).unit.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p).obj M)).app
          (p ⁻¹ᵁ O) (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction p).unit.app M).app O s)) =
      ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (q ≫ p)).unit.app M).app O s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pullbackComp_inv_unit]
  exact iso_hom_inv_app ((pullbackComp q p).app M) _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.pullbackCongr_hom_unit
statement:
theorem pullbackCongr_hom_unit {S T : Scheme.{u}} {a b : S ⟶ T} (h : a = b) (M : T.Modules)
    (O : T.Opens) (s : Γ(M, O)) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback b).obj M).presheaf.map (eqToHom (by rw [h])).op
        (((pullbackCongr h).hom.app M).app (a ⁻¹ᵁ O)
          (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction a).unit.app M).app O s)) =
      ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction b).unit.app M).app O s
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  simp [pullbackCongr]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.pullback_map_unit
statement:
theorem pullback_map_unit {S T : Scheme.{u}} (q : S ⟶ T) {A B : T.Modules} (φ : A ⟶ B)
    (O : T.Opens) (x : Γ(A, O)) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback q).map φ).app (q ⁻¹ᵁ O)
        (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q).unit.app A).app O x) =
      ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q).unit.app B).app O (φ.app O x)
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (fun ψ ↦ (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app ψ O) x)
    ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q).unit.naturality φ)
  exact this.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.app_presheaf_map
proof:
:= by
  have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (φ.mapPresheaf.naturality i.op) x
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at h
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.preimage_morphismRestrict_eq
statement:
theorem preimage_morphismRestrict_eq (O : X.Opens) :
    (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ O) = (f ∣_ U) ⁻¹ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ O)
proof:
:= by
  change ((f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ≫ f) ⁻¹ᵁ O = ((f ∣_ U) ≫ U.ι) ⁻¹ᵁ O
  rw [morphismRestrict_ι]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.restrictPullbackIso_hom_unit
statement:
theorem restrictPullbackIso_hom_unit (L : X.Modules) (O : X.Opens) (s : Γ(L, O)) :
    ((restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)).presheaf.map
        (eqToHom (preimage_morphismRestrict_eq f U O)).op
        ((restrictPullbackIso f U L).hom.app ((f ∣_ U) ⁻¹ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ O))
          (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (f ∣_ U)).unit.app
            ((restrictFunctor U.ι).obj L)).app (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ O)
              (((restrictAdjunction U.ι).unit.app L).app O s))) =
      ((restrictAdjunction (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).unit.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)).app
        (f ⁻¹ᵁ O) (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app L).app O s)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [restrictPullbackIso, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.app_hom,
    Iso.app_inv, Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  rw [pullback_map_unit, restrictFunctorIsoPullback_hom_restrict]
  have e2 := pullbackComp_hom_unit (f ∣_ U) U.ι L O s
  erw [e2]
  rw [← app_presheaf_map, ← app_presheaf_map]
  erw [pullbackCongr_hom_unit (morphismRestrict_ι f U) L O s]
  erw [pullbackComp_inv_unit (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι f L O s]
  exact restrictFunctorIsoPullback_inv_unit _ _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.heq_of_opens_eq
statement:
theorem heq_of_opens_eq {S : Scheme.{u}} {P : S.Opens → Type u} (g : ∀ O, P O) {A B : S.Opens}
    (h : A = B) : HEq (g A) (g B)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.presheaf_map_heq
statement:
theorem presheaf_map_heq {S : Scheme.{u}} (M : S.Modules) {A B : S.Opens} (h : A = B)
    (i : A ⟶ B) (x : Γ(M, B)) : HEq (M.presheaf.map i.op x) x
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  have hi : i = 𝟙 A := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  subst hi
  rw [CategoryTheory.op_id, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso_hom_unit_one
statement:
theorem pullbackUnitIso_hom_unit_one {S T : Scheme.{u}} (q : S ⟶ T) (O : T.Opens) :
    (pullbackUnitIso q).hom.app (q ⁻¹ᵁ O)
        (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf)).app O (1 : Γ(T, O))) =
      (1 : Γ(S, q ⁻¹ᵁ O))
proof:
:= by
  have h := SheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction_homEquiv_pullbackObjUnitToUnit
    q.toRingCatSheafHom
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit] at h
  have h2 := congrArg (fun ψ ↦ ψ.val.app (op O) (1 : Γ(T, O))) h
  simp only [SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit_val_app_apply] at h2
  refine (Eq.trans ?_ h2).trans ?_
  · rfl
  · exact map_one (ConcreteCategory.hom (q.toRingCatSheafHom.hom.app (op O)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.pullbackUnitIso_inv_one
statement:
theorem pullbackUnitIso_inv_one {S T : Scheme.{u}} (q : S ⟶ T) (O : T.Opens) :
    (pullbackUnitIso q).inv.app (q ⁻¹ᵁ O) (1 : Γ(S, q ⁻¹ᵁ O)) =
      ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction q).unit.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf)).app O (1 : Γ(T, O))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pullbackUnitIso_hom_unit_one q O]
  exact iso_inv_hom_app (pullbackUnitIso q) _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.restrictUnitIso_inv_one
statement:
theorem restrictUnitIso_inv_one {S T : Scheme.{u}} (q : S ⟶ T) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (O : S.Opens) : (restrictUnitIso q).inv.app O (1 : Γ(S, O)) = (1 : Γ(T, q ''ᵁ O))
proof:
:= by
  change (q.appIso O).inv.hom 1 = 1
  exact map_one _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.restrictUnitIso_hom_one
statement:
theorem restrictUnitIso_hom_one {S T : Scheme.{u}} (q : S ⟶ T) [IsOpenImmersion q]
    (O : S.Opens) : (restrictUnitIso q).hom.app O (1 : Γ(T, q ''ᵁ O)) = (1 : Γ(S, O))

  change (q.appIso O).hom.hom 1 = 1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.unit_presheaf_map_one
statement:
theorem unit_presheaf_map_one {S : Scheme.{u}} {A B : S.Opens} (i : A ⟶ B) :
    (Scheme.Modules.presheaf (SheafOfModules.unit S.ringCatSheaf : S.Modules)).map i.op
      (1 : Γ(S, B)) = (1 : Γ(S, A))

:= by
  change (S.presheaf.map i.op).hom 1 = 1
  exact map_one _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.image_preimage_ι_self
statement: theorem image_preimage_ι_self (U : X.Opens) : U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U) = U

:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.restrictUnitFrame_one
statement:
theorem restrictUnitFrame_one (d : LineBundleLocalData X L x) :
    (restrictUnitFrame d).hom.app (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U) (1 : Γ(d.U, d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)) =
      ((restrictAdjunction d.U.ι).unit.app L).app d.U (frameGen d)
proof:
:= by
  let m := (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op d.U)
    (1 : Γ(X, d.U))
  have hT : (↑((SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit).val.obj (op d.U)) : Type u) =
      ↑((SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit).val.obj
        (op (d.U.ι ''ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)))) := by
    rw [image_preimage_ι_self]
  have H : HEq ((restrictFrame d).hom.app (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U) (cast hT m)) (frameGen d) :=
    overFunctorEquiv_restrict_app_heq (le_refl d.U) d.globalFrame.hom m
  have e1 : (restrictUnitFrame d).hom.app (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U) (1 : Γ(d.U, d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)) =
      (restrictFrame d).hom.app (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)
        ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app
          (op (d.U.ι ''ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)))
          (1 : Γ(X, d.U.ι ''ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)))) := by
    simp only [restrictUnitFrame, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom,
      Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
    rw [restrictUnitIso_inv_one]
    rfl
  have ha : (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app
      (op (d.U.ι ''ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))) (1 : Γ(X, d.U.ι ''ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))) =
        cast hT m := by
    apply eq_of_heq
    refine (heq_of_opens_eq (P := fun O ↦ Γ(SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit, O))
      (fun O ↦ (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op O)
        (1 : Γ(X, O))) (image_preimage_ι_self d.U)).trans ?_
    exact (cast_heq hT m).symm
  rw [e1, ha, restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app]
  apply eq_of_heq
  exact H.trans (presheaf_map_heq L (image_preimage_ι_self d.U) _ (frameGen d)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.pullbackUnitFrame_one
statement:
theorem pullbackUnitFrame_one (d : LineBundleLocalData X L x) :
    (pullbackUnitFrame f d).hom.app ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
        (1 : Γ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U : Scheme.{u}), (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))) =
      ((restrictAdjunction (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι).unit.app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)).app
        (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U) (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app L).app d.U (frameGen d))
proof:
:= by
  have hK : (pullbackUnitFrame f d).hom.app ((f ∣_ d.U) ⁻¹ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
      (1 : Γ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U : Scheme.{u}), (f ∣_ d.U) ⁻¹ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))) =
      (restrictPullbackIso f d.U L).hom.app ((f ∣_ d.U) ⁻¹ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f ∣_ d.U)).map (restrictUnitFrame d).hom).app
          ((f ∣_ d.U) ⁻¹ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
          ((pullbackUnitIso (f ∣_ d.U)).inv.app ((f ∣_ d.U) ⁻¹ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
            (1 : Γ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U : Scheme.{u}),
              (f ∣_ d.U) ⁻¹ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))))) := rfl
  have h1 := pullbackUnitIso_inv_one (f ∣_ d.U) (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)
  have h2 := pullback_map_unit (f ∣_ d.U) (restrictUnitFrame d).hom (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)
    (1 : Γ((d.U : Scheme.{u}), d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
  have h3 := restrictUnitFrame_one d
  have hsq := restrictPullbackIso_hom_unit f d.U L d.U (frameGen d)
  have hnat := app_presheaf_map (pullbackUnitFrame f d).hom
    (eqToHom (preimage_morphismRestrict_eq f d.U d.U))
    (1 : Γ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U : Scheme.{u}), (f ∣_ d.U) ⁻¹ᵁ (d.U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)))
  rw [unit_presheaf_map_one] at hnat
  rw [hnat, hK, h1]
  erw [h2]
  rw [h3]
  exact hsq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.iso_cancel_aux
statement:
theorem iso_cancel_aux {C : Type*} [Category C] {A B A' B' : C} (a : A' ≅ A) (b : B' ≅ B)

proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.pullbackFrame_globalFrame_hom

theorem pullbackFrame_globalFrame_hom (d : LineBundleLocalData X L x) (y : Y)
    (hy : f y ∈ d.U) :
    (pullbackFrame f d y hy).globalFrame.hom = (pullbackGlobalFrame f d).hom
