name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.restrictApp_heq_gen
statement:
theorem restrictApp_heq_gen {Y : Scheme.{u}} {M N : Y.Modules} (U : Y.Opens)
    (q : M.over U ⟶ N.over U) (m : ↑(M.val.obj (op U)))
    (hT : (↑(M.val.obj (op U)) : Type u) = ↑(M.val.obj (op (U.ι ''ᵁ (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U))))) :
    HEq ((((overFunctorEquiv U).app M).inv ≫ (overEquiv U).functor.map q ≫
        ((overFunctorEquiv U).app N).hom).app (U.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U) (cast hT m))
      (q.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE (le_refl U)))) m)
proof:
:=
  overFunctorEquiv_restrict_app_heq (le_refl U) q m

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.fpbHT
statement:
theorem fpbHT (U' : Y.Opens) :
    (↑((SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) PUnit).val.obj (op U')) : Type u) =
      ↑((SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) PUnit).val.obj
        (op (U'.ι ''ᵁ (U'.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U'))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [image_preimage_ι_self]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.fpbHq
statement:
theorem fpbHq (d : LineBundleLocalData X L x) :
    ((overFunctorEquiv (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)).app
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) PUnit)).inv ≫
      (overEquiv (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)).functor.map (pullbackGlobalFrame f d).hom ≫
        ((overFunctorEquiv (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)).app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)).hom =
      (pullbackRestrictFrame f d).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [pullbackGlobalFrame, Functor.FullyFaithful.preimageIso_hom,
    Functor.FullyFaithful.map_preimage]
  exact iso_cancel_aux ((overFunctorEquiv (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)).app _)
    ((overFunctorEquiv (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)).app _) _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.fpbHH
statement:
theorem fpbHH (d : LineBundleLocalData X L x) :
    HEq ((((overFunctorEquiv (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)).app
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) PUnit)).inv ≫
      (overEquiv (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)).functor.map (pullbackGlobalFrame f d).hom ≫
        ((overFunctorEquiv (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)).app ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)).hom).app
          ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)) (cast (fpbHT (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)) (fpbGen (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))))
      ((pullbackGlobalFrame f d).hom.val.app
        (op (Over.mk (homOfLE (le_refl (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))))) (fpbGen (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)))
proof:
:= by
  apply restrictApp_heq_gen

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.fpbHH'
statement:
theorem fpbHH' (d : LineBundleLocalData X L x) (y : Y) (hy : f y ∈ d.U) :
    HEq ((pullbackRestrictFrame f d).hom.app ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
        (cast (fpbHT (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)) (fpbGen (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))))
      (frameGen (pullbackFrame f d y hy))
proof:
:= by
  refine (heq_of_eq (congrArg
    (fun φ ↦ Scheme.Modules.Hom.app φ ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
      (cast (fpbHT (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)) (fpbGen (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))))
    (fpbHq f d))).symm.trans ((fpbHH f d).trans ?_)
  unfold frameGen
  rw [pullbackFrame_globalFrame_hom]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.fpbHa
statement:
theorem fpbHa (U' : Y.Opens) :
    (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app
      (op (U'.ι ''ᵁ (U'.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U'))) (1 : Γ(Y, U'.ι ''ᵁ (U'.ι ⁻¹ᵁ U'))) =
        cast (fpbHT U') (fpbGen U')
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_of_heq
  refine (heq_of_opens_eq (P := fun O ↦ Γ(SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) PUnit, O))
    (fun O ↦ (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op O)
      (1 : Γ(Y, O))) (image_preimage_ι_self U')).trans ?_
  exact (cast_heq (fpbHT U') (fpbGen U')).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.fpbHe1
statement:
theorem fpbHe1 (d : LineBundleLocalData X L x) :
    (pullbackRestrictFrame f d).hom.app ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
      ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := Y.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app
        (op ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ''ᵁ ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))))
        (1 : Γ(Y, (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ''ᵁ ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))))) =
      (pullbackUnitFrame f d).hom.app ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
        (1 : Γ(((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U : Y.Opens) : Scheme.{u}), (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pullbackRestrictFrame, Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom,
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  have h1 := iso_hom_inv_app (S := Y)
    (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := Y.ringCatSheaf))
    ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ''ᵁ ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)))
    (1 : Γ(Y, (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ''ᵁ ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))))
  have h3 := restrictUnitIso_hom_one (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))
  exact congrArg (fun z ↦ ConcreteCategory.hom (Hom.app (pullbackUnitFrame f d).hom
    ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))) z)
    ((congrArg (fun z ↦ ConcreteCategory.hom (Hom.app (restrictUnitIso (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι).hom
      ((f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U))) z) h1).trans h3)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.frameGen_pullbackFrame
statement:
theorem frameGen_pullbackFrame (d : LineBundleLocalData X L x) (y : Y) (hy : f y ∈ d.U) :
    frameGen (pullbackFrame f d y hy) =
      ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app L).app d.U (frameGen d)
proof:
:= by
  have e1 := fpbHe1 f d
  rw [fpbHa, pullbackUnitFrame_one, restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app] at e1
  apply eq_of_heq
  refine (fpbHH' f d y hy).symm.trans ((heq_of_eq e1).trans ?_)
  exact presheaf_map_heq _ (image_preimage_ι_self (f ⁻¹ᵁ d.U)) _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.frameSec_smul
statement:
theorem frameSec_smul (d : LineBundleLocalData S M x) (V : S.Opens) (hV : V ≤ d.U)
    (c : Γ(S, V)) : frameSec d V hV c = c • frameSec d V hV 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold frameSec
  have h1 : (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op V) c =
      c • (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op V)
        (1 : Γ(S, V)) := by
    have h := ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app
      (op V)).hom.map_smul c (1 : Γ(S, V))
    exact (congrArg (fun z ↦ (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app
      (op V) z) (show c = c * (1 : Γ(S, V)) from (mul_one c).symm)).trans h
  rw [h1]
  exact (d.globalFrame.hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV)))).hom.map_smul c _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.frameSec_one
statement:
theorem frameSec_one (d : LineBundleLocalData S M x) (V : S.Opens) (hV : V ≤ d.U) :
    frameSec d V hV 1 = M.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op (frameGen d)
proof:
:= by
  unfold frameSec frameGen
  have hn := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (d.globalFrame.hom.val.naturality
    (Over.homMk (homOfLE hV) : Over.mk (homOfLE hV) ⟶ Over.mk (homOfLE (le_refl d.U))).op)
    ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op d.U)
      (1 : Γ(S, d.U)))
  refine Eq.trans (congrArg (fun z ↦ (d.globalFrame.hom.val.app
    (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV)))) z) ?_) hn
  have h2 := app_presheaf_map (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)).inv
    (homOfLE hV) (1 : Γ(S, d.U))
  rw [unit_presheaf_map_one] at h2
  exact h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.frameSec_transitionSection
statement:
theorem frameSec_transitionSection (d : LineBundleLocalData S M x) {y : S}
    (e : LineBundleLocalData S M y) :
    frameSec e (d.U ⊓ e.U) inf_le_right (d.transitionSection e) =
      frameSec d (d.U ⊓ e.U) inf_le_left 1
proof:
:=
  LineBundleLocalData.globalFrame_transitionSection d e

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.frameSec_injective
statement:
theorem frameSec_injective (d : LineBundleLocalData S M x) (V : S.Opens) (hV : V ≤ d.U) :
    Function.Injective (frameSec d V hV)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  unfold frameSec at hab
  have h1 := congrArg (d.globalFrame.inv.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV)))) hab
  have hi : ∀ m, d.globalFrame.inv.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV)))
      (d.globalFrame.hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV))) m) = m := fun m ↦
    congrArg (fun ψ ↦ ψ.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hV))) m) d.globalFrame.hom_inv_id
  rw [hi, hi] at h1
  have h2 := congrArg ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)).hom.val.app (op V))
    h1
  have hj : ∀ c : Γ(S, V), (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)).hom.val.app
      (op V) ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op V) c) = c :=
    fun c ↦ iso_hom_inv_app (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit (R := S.ringCatSheaf)) V c
  rwa [hj, hj] at h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.frameGen_restrict_eq_smul
statement:
theorem frameGen_restrict_eq_smul (d : LineBundleLocalData S M x) {y : S}
    (e : LineBundleLocalData S M y) :
    M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ d.U)).op (frameGen d) =
      d.transitionSection e •
        M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ e.U)).op (frameGen e)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← frameSec_one, ← frameSec_one, ← frameSec_smul, frameSec_transitionSection]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.transitionSection_pullbackFrame
statement:
theorem transitionSection_pullbackFrame (d : LineBundleLocalData X L x)
    (e : LineBundleLocalData X L x') (y y' : Y) (hy : f y ∈ d.U) (hy' : f y' ∈ e.U) :
    (pullbackFrame f d y hy).transitionSection (pullbackFrame f e y' hy') =
      f.app (d.U ⊓ e.U) (d.transitionSection e)
proof:
:= by
  apply frameSec_injective (pullbackFrame f e y' hy') _ inf_le_right
  rw [frameSec_transitionSection, frameSec_smul (pullbackFrame f e y' hy')
    ((pullbackFrame f d y hy).U ⊓ (pullbackFrame f e y' hy').U) inf_le_right
    (f.app (d.U ⊓ e.U) (d.transitionSection e)), frameSec_one,
    frameSec_one, frameGen_pullbackFrame, frameGen_pullbackFrame]
  have hX := frameGen_restrict_eq_smul d e
  have h := congrArg (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app L).app (d.U ⊓ e.U)) hX
  have h1 := app_presheaf_map ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app L)
    (homOfLE (inf_le_left : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ d.U)) (frameGen d)
  have h2 := app_presheaf_map ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app L)
    (homOfLE (inf_le_right : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ e.U)) (frameGen e)
  have h3 := Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app L)
    (d.transitionSection e) (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : d.U ⊓ e.U ≤ e.U)).op
      (frameGen e))
  exact h1.symm.trans (h.trans (h3.trans (congrArg (fun z ↦ d.transitionSection e • z) h2)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.pointClosureι_genericPoint_mem
statement:
theorem pointClosureι_genericPoint_mem :
    pointClosureι v (pointClosureGenericPoint v) ∈ (E.frame v).U
proof:
:= by
  rw [pointClosureι_genericPoint]
  exact (E.frame v).mem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.pointCoord_eq
statement:
theorem pointCoord_eq (z : pointClosureScheme v) :
    pointCoord E v z =
      refCoord E v * (refFrame E v).regularTransitionFunction (pointFrame E v z)
proof:
:= by
  set ι := pointClosureι v
  set dv := E.frame v
  set dz := E.frame (ι z)
  have hc := E.compat v (ι z)
  have hmap := congrArg (ι.app (dv.U ⊓ dz.U)) hc
  rw [map_mul] at hmap
  have n1 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (ι.naturality (homOfLE (inf_le_right : dv.U ⊓ dz.U ≤ dz.U)).op) (E.coord (ι z))
  have n2 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (ι.naturality (homOfLE (inf_le_left : dv.U ⊓ dz.U ≤ dv.U)).op) (E.coord v)
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at n1 n2
  rw [n1, n2] at hmap
  have hW : Nonempty ((refFrame E v).U ⊓ (pointFrame E v z).U : (pointClosureScheme v).Opens) :=
    LineBundleLocalData.overlapNonempty _ _
  have h := congrArg (algebraMap Γ(pointClosureScheme v,
    (refFrame E v).U ⊓ (pointFrame E v z).U) (pointClosureScheme v).functionField) hmap
  erw [map_mul] at h
  have r1 := LineBundleLocalData.algebraMap_functionField_restrict (X := pointClosureScheme v)
    (U := (pointFrame E v z).U) (V := (refFrame E v).U ⊓ (pointFrame E v z).U) inf_le_right
    (ι.app dz.U (E.coord (ι z)))
  have r2 := LineBundleLocalData.algebraMap_functionField_restrict (X := pointClosureScheme v)
    (U := (refFrame E v).U) (V := (refFrame E v).U ⊓ (pointFrame E v z).U) inf_le_left
    (ι.app dv.U (E.coord v))
  have ht : (refFrame E v).transitionSection (pointFrame E v z) =
      ι.app (dv.U ⊓ dz.U) ((E.frame v).transitionSection (E.frame (ι z))) :=
    transitionSection_pullbackFrame ι _ _ _ _ _ _
  unfold pointCoord refCoord LineBundleLocalData.regularTransitionFunction
  rw [ht]
  exact r1.trans (h.trans (congrArg (· * _) r2.symm))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.refCoord_ne_zero
statement:
theorem refCoord_ne_zero (E : LocalEquationFrames L a) (v : X) (hv : IsUnit (a v)) :
    refCoord E v ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  set ι := pointClosureι v
  set η := pointClosureGenericPoint v
  have hη : ι η ∈ (E.frame v).U := pointClosureι_genericPoint_mem E v
  haveI : Nonempty (ι ⁻¹ᵁ (E.frame v).U) := ⟨⟨η, hη⟩⟩
  have h1 : refCoord E v = algebraMap ((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalk η)
      (pointClosureScheme v).functionField
      ((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.germ (ι ⁻¹ᵁ (E.frame v).U) η hη
        (ι.app (E.frame v).U (E.coord v))) := by
    rw [Scheme.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField]
    rfl
  have hu : IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ (E.frame v).U (ι η) hη (E.coord v)) := by
    have key : ∀ (w : X) (hw : w ∈ (E.frame v).U), w = v →
        IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ (E.frame v).U w hw (E.coord v)) := by
      rintro w hw rfl
      have hg := E.germ_coord w
      exact hg ▸ hv
    exact key _ hη (pointClosureι_genericPoint v)
  have hu2 := hu.map (ι.stalkMap η).hom
  rw [Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply] at hu2
  rw [h1]
  intro h0
  apply hu2.ne_zero
  exact (map_eq_zero_iff _ (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective _ _)).mp h0

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.weilDivisor_add_principal_apply
statement:
theorem weilDivisor_add_principal_apply (E : LocalEquationFrames L a) (hv : IsUnit (a v))
    (z : pointClosureScheme v)
    (hz : coheight z = 1) :
    (Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame
        (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosureι L hL v)
        (genericRank_pullback_pointClosureι L hL hrank v) (refFrame E v)).1 z +
      (principalWeilDivisor (pointClosureScheme v) (refCoord E v)).1 z =
      c1CapPrimeCoeff a v (pointClosureι v z)
proof:
:= by
  set ι := pointClosureι v
  haveI : Nonempty (ι ⁻¹ᵁ (E.frame (ι z)).U) := ⟨⟨z, (E.frame (ι z)).mem⟩⟩
  have hrtf := (refFrame E v).regularTransitionFunction_ne_zero (pointFrame E v z)
  have hg := refCoord_ne_zero E v hv
  have hpc := pointCoord_eq E v z
  have hpc0 : pointCoord E v z ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hpc]
    exact mul_ne_zero hg hrtf
  have hpa : algebraMap ((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalk z)
      (pointClosureScheme v).functionField ((ι.stalkMap z).hom (a (ι z))) = pointCoord E v z := by
    rw [← E.germ_coord (ι z)]
    erw [Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply]
    rw [Scheme.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField]
    rfl
  have ha : a (ι z) ∉ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (specializes_pointClosureι v z) := by
    rw [← ker_stalkMap_pointClosureι, RingHom.mem_ker]
    intro h0
    apply hpc0
    rw [← hpa, h0, map_zero]
  rw [Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame_apply,
    Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorCoeffWithFrame_eq_on_localData _ _ (refFrame E v)
      (pointFrame E v z) z (pointFrame E v z).mem]
  change _ + (pointClosureScheme v).ord (refCoord E v) z = _
  rw [c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_ord a v z hz ha, hpa, hpc,
    (pointClosureScheme v).ord_mul hz hg hrtf, add_comm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.c1CapPrime_eq_classOf_c1CapPrimeCoeff
statement:
theorem c1CapPrime_eq_classOf_c1CapPrimeCoeff (E : LocalEquationFrames L a) {p : ℕ}
    (hcod : ∀ z : pointClosureScheme v, coheight z = 1 →
      coheight (pointClosureι v z) = ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞))
    (hv : IsUnit (a v)) :
    ∃ D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ (p + 1),
      gradedClassOf X (p + 1) D = c1CapPrime L hL hrank v hcod ∧
        ⇑D.1 = c1CapPrimeCoeff a v
proof:
:= by
  let hLV := isFiniteLocallyFree_pullback_pointClosureι L hL v
  let hrV := genericRank_pullback_pointClosureι L hL hrank v
  let R : WeilDivisor (pointClosureScheme v) :=
    Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hLV hrV (refFrame E v) +
      principalWeilDivisor (pointClosureScheme v) (refCoord E v)
  refine ⟨closedImmersionPushforwardCycles (pointClosureι v) hcod
    (R : CodimensionCycles _ ℤ 1), ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hR : classOf (pointClosureScheme v) R =
        classOf (pointClosureScheme v)
          (Scheme.Modules.lineBundleWeilDivisorWithFrame hLV hrV (refFrame E v)) := by
      rw [classOf_add, classOf_principalWeilDivisor _ _ (refCoord_ne_zero E v hv), add_zero]
    rw [c1CapPrime, Scheme.Modules.lineBundleFirstChernClass,
      Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorClass_eq_withFrame _ _ (refFrame E v),
      Scheme.Modules.lineBundleDivisorClassWithFrame, ← hR, codimensionOneToGradedChow_classOf,
      closedImmersionPushforwardChow_classOf]
  · funext x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.range (pointClosureι v)
    · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hx
      rw [closedImmersionPushforwardCycles_apply]
      by_cases hz : coheight z = 1
      · exact weilDivisor_add_principal_apply v hL hrank E hv z hz
      · rw [c1CapPrimeCoeff_pointClosureι, if_neg hz]
        change (pointClosureScheme v).ord _ z + (pointClosureScheme v).ord _ z = 0
        rw [Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hz, Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hz,
          add_zero]
    · rw [closedImmersionPushforwardCycles_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range _ _ _ x hx,
        c1CapPrimeCoeff_eq_zero_of_not_specializes]
      intro h
      apply hx
      rw [range_pointClosureι]
      exact specializes_iff_mem_closure.mp h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CHPnTop.specField_Γevaluation_comp_bijective
statement:
theorem specField_Γevaluation_comp_bijective (x : Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :
    Function.Bijective (((Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).Γevaluation x).hom.comp
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv.hom)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨RingHom.injective _, ?_⟩
  have h := Scheme.Spec.algebraMap_residueFieldIso_inv (CommRingCat.of k) x
  have hχ : ((Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).Γevaluation x).hom.comp
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv.hom =
      (Scheme.Spec.residueFieldIso (CommRingCat.of k) x).inv.hom.comp
        (algebraMap k x.asIdeal.ResidueField) := by
    have := congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom h
    simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom] at this
    rw [this]
    rfl
  rw [hχ]
  exact ((ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
    (Scheme.Spec.residueFieldIso (CommRingCat.of k) x).inv).2).comp
    (Ideal.algebraMap_residueField_surjective x.asIdeal)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CHPnTop.toSpec_degree_eq_finrank
statement:
theorem toSpec_degree_eq_finrank {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] (x : X) :
    (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).degree x = Module.finrank k (X.residueField x)
proof:
:= by
  set π := X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k) with hπ
  let χ := ((Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).Γevaluation (π x)).hom.comp
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv.hom
  letI : Algebra ((Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).residueField (π x)) (X.residueField x) :=
    (π.residueFieldMap x).hom.toAlgebra
  have hrank : Module.rank k (X.residueField x) =
      Module.rank ((Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).residueField (π x)) (X.residueField x) := by
    refine rank_eq_of_equiv_equiv χ (AddEquiv.refl _)
      (specField_Γevaluation_comp_bijective k (π x)) (fun r m ↦ ?_)
    change (X.Γevaluation x).hom (globalSec (X := X) (R := CommRingCat.of k) r) * m =
      (π.residueFieldMap x).hom (χ r) * m
    congr 1
    exact (Γevaluation_naturality_apply π x _).symm
  change Module.finrank ((Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).residueField (π x)) (X.residueField x) = _
  rw [Module.finrank, Module.finrank, hrank]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CHPnTop.degree_eq_properPushforward_toSpec
statement:
theorem degree_eq_properPushforward_toSpec {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (D : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) (pt : Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :
    AlgebraicCycle.degree k D = properPushforward (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) D pt
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : Subsingleton (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton (PrimeSpectrum k))
  rw [properPushforward_apply, AlgebraicCycle.degree,
    finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ (s := ((X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).preimageSupportFinite
      D pt).toFinset) ?_]
  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ ↦ ?_)
    rw [toSpec_degree_eq_finrank]
  · intro x hx
    rw [Finset.mem_coe, mem_preimageSupportFinite_toFinset_iff]
    refine ⟨Subsingleton.elim _ _, fun h0 ↦ hx ?_⟩
    simp [h0]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CHPnTop.coheight_eq_zero_of_map_eq_genericPoint
statement:
theorem coheight_eq_zero_of_map_eq_genericPoint (hdeg : h.degree (genericPoint N) ≠ 0) (x : N)
    (hx : h x = genericPoint Y) : coheight x = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI := RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.ffAlgebra h
  haveI := RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.finiteDimensional_of_degree h hdeg
  letI : Algebra (Y.presheaf.stalk (h x)) (N.presheaf.stalk x) := (h.stalkMap x).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra (Y.presheaf.stalk (h x)) N.functionField :=
    ((algebraMap Y.functionField N.functionField).comp
      (algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk (h x)) Y.functionField)).toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower (Y.presheaf.stalk (h x)) Y.functionField N.functionField :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun _ ↦ rfl)
  haveI : IsScalarTower (Y.presheaf.stalk (h x)) (N.presheaf.stalk x) N.functionField :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun a ↦ RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.ffHom_algebraMap_stalk h x a)
  
  have hbij : Function.Bijective (algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk (h x)) Y.functionField) :=
    RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.stalkSpecializes_bijective Y.presheaf hx.symm
  have hAfield : IsField (Y.presheaf.stalk (h x)) :=
    MulEquiv.isField (Field.toIsField Y.functionField)
      (RingEquiv.ofBijective _ hbij).toMulEquiv
  haveI : Module.Finite (Y.presheaf.stalk (h x)) Y.functionField :=
    Module.Finite.of_surjective (Algebra.linearMap _ _) hbij.2
  haveI : Module.Finite (Y.presheaf.stalk (h x)) N.functionField :=
    Module.Finite.trans Y.functionField N.functionField
  haveI : Algebra.IsIntegral (Y.presheaf.stalk (h x)) N.functionField := inferInstance
  have hCL : Function.Injective (algebraMap (N.presheaf.stalk x) N.functionField) :=
    IsFractionRing.injective _ _
  haveI : Algebra.IsIntegral (Y.presheaf.stalk (h x)) (N.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    ⟨fun c ↦ (isIntegral_algHom_iff (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom (Y.presheaf.stalk (h x))
      (N.presheaf.stalk x) N.functionField) hCL).mp (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral _)⟩
  have hCfield : IsField (N.presheaf.stalk x) := isField_of_isIntegral_of_isField' hAfield
  have hdim := ringKrullDim_eq_zero_of_isField hCfield
  rw [ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight] at hdim
  exact_mod_cast hdim

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CHPnTop.coheight_map_eq_one
statement:
theorem coheight_map_eq_one [KrullDimLE 1 Y] (hdeg : h.degree (genericPoint N) ≠ 0) (x : N)
    (hx : coheight x = 1) : coheight (h x) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hle : coheight (h x) ≤ 1 := by
    have h1 := Order.coheight_le_krullDim (h x)
    have h2 : krullDim Y ≤ ((1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
      rw [← Order.krullDimLE_iff]
      infer_instance
    exact_mod_cast h1.trans h2
  refine le_antisymm hle (Order.one_le_iff_pos.mpr (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr fun h0 ↦ ?_))
  have hmax : IsMax (h x) := Order.coheight_eq_zero.mp h0
  have e1 : h x ≤ genericPoint Y := RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.le_genericPoint' _
  have e2 : genericPoint Y ≤ h x := hmax e1
  have hη : h x = genericPoint Y :=
    ((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp e2).antisymm (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp e1)).eq
  have := coheight_eq_zero_of_map_eq_genericPoint h hdeg x hη
  rw [hx] at this
  exact one_ne_zero this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CHPnTop.ord_pow_eq
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [Scheme.ord_eq_iff hy one_ne_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, Scheme.ord_mul hy (pow_ne_zero _ hf) hf, ih]
    push_cast
    ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CHPnTop.properPushforward_div_ffHom
statement:
theorem properPushforward_div_ffHom [IsProper h] [KrullDimLE 1 Y]
    (hdeg : h.degree (genericPoint N) ≠ 0) (f : Y.functionField) (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    properPushforward h (div ((RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.ffHom h).hom f)) =
      (h.degree (genericPoint N) : ℤ) • div f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI := RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.ffAlgebra h
  haveI := RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.finiteDimensional_of_degree h hdeg
  have hr : (RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.ffHom h).hom f ≠ 0 := (map_ne_zero _).mpr hf
  ext y
  change properPushforward h (div ((RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.ffHom h).hom f)) y =
    (h.degree (genericPoint N) : ℤ) * div f y
  by_cases hy : coheight y = 1
  · have hfib := RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.finite_fibre h hdeg y hy
    rw [properPushforward_apply_eq_sum_of_subset h _ y hfib.toFinset
      (fun x hx _ ↦ hfib.mem_toFinset.mpr hx), Finset.sum_filter,
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x hx ↦ if_pos (show h x = y from hfib.mem_toFinset.mp hx))]
    simp only [div_eq_ord]
    rw [RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.local_sum h hdeg y hy _ hr]
    change Scheme.ord (Algebra.norm Y.functionField (algebraMap Y.functionField N.functionField f))
      y = _
    rw [Algebra.norm_algebraMap, ord_pow_eq hy hf, AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.finrank_functionField_eq_degree h]
  · rw [div_eq_ord, Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hy, mul_zero, properPushforward_apply]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hxy, hdx⟩ := (mem_preimageSupportFinite_toFinset_iff h _ y x).mp hx
    exact absurd (hxy ▸ coheight_map_eq_one h hdeg x (div_support hdx)) hy

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CHPnTop.degree_div_ffHom
statement:
theorem degree_div_ffHom (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsProper h] [KrullDimLE 1 Y]
    [N.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [CompactSpace N] [CompactSpace Y]
    (hover : N ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k) = h ≫ (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    (hdeg : h.degree (genericPoint N) ≠ 0) (f : Y.functionField) (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    AlgebraicCycle.degree k (div ((RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.ffHom h).hom f)) =
      (h.degree (genericPoint N) : ℤ) * AlgebraicCycle.degree k (div f)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    (quasiCompact_iff_compactSpace _).mpr inferInstance
  haveI : QuasiCompact (N ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    (quasiCompact_iff_compactSpace _).mpr inferInstance
  have pt : Spec (CommRingCat.of k) := (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (genericPoint Y)
  rw [degree_eq_properPushforward_toSpec k _ pt, degree_eq_properPushforward_toSpec k _ pt,
    properPushforward_congr hover, properPushforward_comp,
    properPushforward_div_ffHom h hdeg f hf, ← properPushforwardHom_apply, map_zsmul,
    properPushforwardHom_apply]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CHPnTop.degree_genericPoint_ne_zero_of_isFinite
statement:
theorem degree_genericPoint_ne_zero_of_isFinite [IsFinite h] :
    h.degree (genericPoint N) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  letI := RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.ffAlgebra h
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hηU, -⟩ := exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (X := Y) (x := genericPoint Y)
    (U := ⊤) (by simp)
  haveI : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨_, hηU⟩⟩
  have hV : IsAffineOpen (h ⁻¹ᵁ U) := hU.preimage h
  have hηV : genericPoint N ∈ h ⁻¹ᵁ U := by
    change h (genericPoint N) ∈ U
    rw [RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.map_genericPoint h]
    exact hηU
  haveI : Nonempty (h ⁻¹ᵁ U) := ⟨⟨_, hηV⟩⟩
  letI : Algebra Γ(Y, U) Γ(N, h ⁻¹ᵁ U) := (h.app U).hom.toAlgebra
  haveI : Module.Finite Γ(Y, U) Γ(N, h ⁻¹ᵁ U) := IsFinite.finite_app h U hU
  haveI := functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen Y U hU
  haveI := functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen N (h ⁻¹ᵁ U) hV
  letI : Algebra Γ(Y, U) N.functionField :=
    ((algebraMap Y.functionField N.functionField).comp
      (algebraMap Γ(Y, U) Y.functionField)).toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(Y, U) Y.functionField N.functionField :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun _ ↦ rfl)
  haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(Y, U) Γ(N, h ⁻¹ᵁ U) N.functionField :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun r ↦ by
      change (RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.ffHom h).hom (Y.germToFunctionField U r) =
        N.germToFunctionField (h ⁻¹ᵁ U) (h.app U r)
      rw [RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.ffHom_germ h U (h ⁻¹ᵁ U) le_rfl, Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app])
  have hinjRK : Function.Injective (algebraMap Γ(Y, U) N.functionField) := by
    change Function.Injective ((algebraMap Y.functionField N.functionField).comp
      (algebraMap Γ(Y, U) Y.functionField))
    exact (algebraMap Y.functionField N.functionField).injective.comp
      (IsFractionRing.injective Γ(Y, U) Y.functionField)
  haveI : FaithfulSMul Γ(Y, U) Γ(N, h ⁻¹ᵁ U) := by
    rw [faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective]
    intro a b hab
    apply hinjRK
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply Γ(Y, U) Γ(N, h ⁻¹ᵁ U) N.functionField, hab,
      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]
  haveI : Algebra.IsIntegral Γ(Y, U) Γ(N, h ⁻¹ᵁ U) := inferInstance
  haveI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic Γ(Y, U) Γ(N, h ⁻¹ᵁ U) := Algebra.IsIntegral.isAlgebraic
  haveI : Module.Finite Y.functionField N.functionField :=
    Module.Finite.of_isLocalization Γ(Y, U) Γ(N, h ⁻¹ᵁ U) (nonZeroDivisors Γ(Y, U))
  rw [← AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.finrank_functionField_eq_degree h]
  exact (Module.finrank_pos).ne'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CHPnTop.coheight_le_one_of_krullDimLE
statement: theorem coheight_le_one_of_krullDimLE [KrullDimLE 1 Y] (y : Y) : coheight y ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := Order.coheight_le_krullDim y
  have h2 : krullDim Y ≤ ((1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    rw [← Order.krullDimLE_iff]
    infer_instance
  exact_mod_cast h1.trans h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CHPnTop.krullDimLE_one_of_degree_ne_zero
statement:
theorem krullDimLE_one_of_degree_ne_zero [KrullDimLE 1 Y]
    (hdeg : h.degree (genericPoint N) ≠ 0) : KrullDimLE 1 N
proof:
:= by
  refine Order.KrullDimLE.mk ?_
  rw [Order.krullDim_eq_iSup_coheight]
  refine iSup_le fun x ↦ ?_
  have hle := coheight_le_one_of_krullDimLE (h x)
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hle with h1 | h1
  · rw [RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.coheight_eq_one_of_map h hdeg x h1]
    rfl
  · have h0 : coheight (h x) = 0 := Order.lt_one_iff.mp h1
    have hmax : IsMax (h x) := Order.coheight_eq_zero.mp h0
    have e1 : h x ≤ genericPoint Y := RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.le_genericPoint' _
    have e2 : genericPoint Y ≤ h x := hmax e1
    have hη : h x = genericPoint Y :=
      ((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp e2).antisymm (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp e1)).eq
    rw [coheight_eq_zero_of_map_eq_genericPoint h hdeg x hη]
    norm_num

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CHPnTop.codimensionCycleDegree_relation_eq_source
statement:
theorem codimensionCycleDegree_relation_eq_source [CompactSpace X]
    {p : ℕ} (g : RationalRelationGenerator X p) :
    letI : g.Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
proof:
:= relationSourceOver k g
    codimensionCycleDegree (X := X) k p g.cycle = AlgebraicCycle.degree k (div g.f) := by
  letI : g.Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := relationSourceOver k g
  haveI : CompactSpace g.Y := g.i.isClosedEmbedding.compactSpace
  haveI : QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    (quasiCompact_iff_compactSpace _).mpr inferInstance
  haveI : QuasiCompact (g.Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    (quasiCompact_iff_compactSpace _).mpr inferInstance
  have pt : Spec (CommRingCat.of k) := (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g.i (genericPoint g.Y))
  rw [codimensionCycleDegree_apply]
  change AlgebraicCycle.degree k (AlgebraicCycle.pushforward g.i (div g.f)
    (fun _ ↦ (p : ℕ∞)) coheight) = _
  rw [← properPushforward_eq_pushforward_closedImmersion g.i (div g.f) _ _
      (fun y hy ↦ (g.codimension y (div_support hy)).symm),
    degree_eq_properPushforward_toSpec k _ pt, degree_eq_properPushforward_toSpec k _ pt,
    ← properPushforward_comp]
  rfl

statement:

proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CHPnTop.relationNormalization_isFinite

theorem relationNormalization_isFinite [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X 2) :
    IsFinite (SingularCurve.normalizationMorphism g.Y)
proof:
:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CHPnTop.relationDegree_eq_zero_of_normalization
statement:
theorem relationDegree_eq_zero_of_normalization [CompactSpace X]
    [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [KrullDimLE 2 X]
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X 2) (hN : NormalizationPrincipalDegreeZero k g) :
    codimensionCycleDegree (X := X) k 2 g.cycle = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI : g.Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := relationSourceOver k g
  rw [codimensionCycleDegree_relation_eq_source k g]
  haveI : KrullDimLE 1 g.Y := relationSource_krullDimLE_one g
  let N := normalizationSource g
  let ν : N ⟶ g.Y := SingularCurve.normalizationMorphism g.Y
  haveI : IsFinite ν := relationNormalization_isFinite k g
  letI : IsLocallyNoetherian N := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian ν
  letI : N.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := normalizationOver k g
  haveI : CompactSpace g.Y := g.i.isClosedEmbedding.compactSpace
  haveI : IsProper (N ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := by
    change IsProper (ν ≫ g.i ≫ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    infer_instance
  haveI : CompactSpace N :=
    (quasiCompact_iff_compactSpace (N ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))).mp inferInstance
  have hdeg := degree_genericPoint_ne_zero_of_isFinite ν
  have key := degree_div_ffHom ν k rfl hdeg g.f g.hf
  have hN' : AlgebraicCycle.degree k (div ((RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.ffHom ν).hom g.f))
      = 0 := hN
  rw [hN'] at key
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp key.symm).resolve_left (by exact_mod_cast hdeg)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CHPnTop.normalizationPrincipalDegreeZero_of_structureSheafFinite
statement:
theorem normalizationPrincipalDegreeZero_of_structureSheafFinite [CompactSpace X]
    [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [KrullDimLE 2 X]
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X 2) (hχ : NormalizationStructureSheafFinite k g) :
    NormalizationPrincipalDegreeZero k g
proof:
:= by
  let N := normalizationSource g
  let ν : N ⟶ g.Y := SingularCurve.normalizationMorphism g.Y
  haveI : IsFinite ν := relationNormalization_isFinite k g
  letI : IsLocallyNoetherian N := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian ν
  letI : N.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := normalizationOver k g
  haveI : IsProper (N ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := by
    change IsProper (ν ≫ g.i ≫ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    infer_instance
  haveI : CompactSpace N :=
    (quasiCompact_iff_compactSpace (N ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))).mp inferInstance
  haveI : IsNoetherian N :=
    { toIsLocallyNoetherian := inferInstance
      toCompactSpace := inferInstance }
  haveI : KrullDimLE 1 N := normalizationSource_krullDimLE_one g
  haveI : IsRegularInCodimensionOne N := relationNormalization_isRegularInCodimensionOne k g
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (N ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (ν ≫ g.i ≫ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    infer_instance
  exact SchemeBridge.degree_principal_eq_zero_of_structureSheaf_finite k hχ
    (pullbackFunction g) (pullbackFunction_ne_zero g)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CHPnTop.surfaceDegreeData_of_normalizationStructureSheafFinite
statement:
theorem surfaceDegreeData_of_normalizationStructureSheafFinite [CompactSpace X]
    [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [KrullDimLE 2 X]
    (hχ : ∀ g : RationalRelationGenerator X 2, NormalizationStructureSheafFinite k g) :
    SurfaceDegreeData X k where
  relation_degree_zero g
proof:
:= relationDegree_eq_zero_of_normalization k g
    (normalizationPrincipalDegreeZero_of_structureSheafFinite k g (hχ g))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension.add_left
statement:
theorem add_left (h : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D E)
    (h' : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D' E) :
    CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension (D + D') E
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy
  change D.1 x + D'.1 x ≠ 0 at hx
  by_cases hxD : D.1 x ≠ 0
  · exact h x hxD y hy
  · apply h' x ?_ y hy
    intro hxD'
    apply hx
    rw [not_ne_iff.mp hxD, hxD', zero_add]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension.neg_left
statement:
theorem neg_left (h : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D E) :
    CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension (-D) E
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.expectedIntersectionCycle_symm
statement:
theorem expectedIntersectionCycle_symm
    (h : CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D E) :
    (expectedIntersectionCycle h.symm).1 = (expectedIntersectionCycle h).1
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  simp only [expectedIntersectionCycle, AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum,
    Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro y _
  have hpair : expectedPrimeIntersectionData h.symm y x =
      (expectedPrimeIntersectionData h x y).swap := by
    apply ExpectedCodimensionPrimeIntersectionData.eq_of_points_eq <;> rfl
  change
    ((compactCycleFinsupp E.1 y * compactCycleFinsupp D.1 x) •
      (expectedPrimeIntersectionData h.symm y x).cycle.1) t =
    ((compactCycleFinsupp D.1 x * compactCycleFinsupp E.1 y) •
      (expectedPrimeIntersectionData h x y).cycle.1) t
  rw [hpair, (expectedPrimeIntersectionData h x y).swap_cycle, mul_comm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProperCycleIntersectionData.toCyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension
statement:
theorem ProperCycleIntersectionData.toCyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension
    (d : ProperCycleIntersectionData X p q D E) :
    CyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension D E
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy
  let xs : (compactCycleFinsupp D.1).support :=
    ⟨x, Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr (by simpa only [compactCycleFinsupp_apply] using hx)⟩
  let ys : (compactCycleFinsupp E.1).support :=
    ⟨y, Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr (by simpa only [compactCycleFinsupp_apply] using hy)⟩
  have hpair_x : (d.pair xs ys).x = x := d.pair_x xs ys
  have hpair_y : (d.pair xs ys).y = y := d.pair_y xs ys
  change PrimeCyclesMeetInExpectedCodimension x y p q
  rw [← hpair_x, ← hpair_y]
  exact fun z _ ↦ (d.pair xs ys).codimension z

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionMovingStatement.witness_intersectionClass_eq_product
statement:
theorem ExpectedCodimensionMovingStatement.witness_intersectionClass_eq_product
    (h : ExpectedCodimensionMovingStatement X p q)
    (T : IntersectionPairingData X p q)
    (x : CodimensionChow X p) (y : CodimensionChow X q)
    (hpairing : T.pairing (h.witness x y).left (h.witness x y).right =
      (h.witness x y).intersectionCycle) :
    (h.witness x y).intersectionClass = T.product x y
proof:
:= by
  let w := h.witness x y
  calc
    w.intersectionClass =
        gradedClassOf X (p + q) (T.pairing w.left w.right) := by
      rw [ExpectedCodimensionRepresentativeWitness.intersectionClass,
        hpairing]
    _ = T.product (gradedClassOf X p w.left)
        (gradedClassOf X q w.right) := by
      rw [T.product_classOf_classOf]
    _ = T.product x y := by
      rw [w.left_class, w.right_class]

name: IsRegularLocalRing.maximalIdeal_notMem_minimalPrimes
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_notMem_minimalPrimes [IsLocalRing R]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R ≠ 0) : maximalIdeal R ∉ minimalPrimes R
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  refine hdim ?_
  rw [← IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim,
    Ideal.height_eq_zero_iff.mpr hmem]
  simp

name: IsRegularLocalRing.exists_mem_maximalIdeal_notMem_sq_notMem_minimalPrimes
statement:
theorem exists_mem_maximalIdeal_notMem_sq_notMem_minimalPrimes [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R ≠ 0) :
    ∃ a : R, a ∈ maximalIdeal R ∧ a ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ 2 ∧
      ∀ p ∈ minimalPrimes R, a ∉ p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfin : (minimalPrimes R).Finite := minimalPrimes.finite_of_isNoetherianRing R
  set P : Finset (Ideal R) := hfin.toFinset with hPdef
  set s : Finset (Ideal R) := insert (maximalIdeal R ^ 2) P with hsdef
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  
  have hsub : ((maximalIdeal R : Ideal R) : Set R) ⊆
      ⋃ i ∈ (↑s : Set (Ideal R)), ((id i : Ideal R) : Set R) := by
    intro a ha
    by_cases h2 : a ∈ maximalIdeal R ^ 2
    · exact Set.mem_biUnion
        (show maximalIdeal R ^ 2 ∈ (↑s : Set (Ideal R)) by simp [hsdef]) h2
    · obtain ⟨p, hp, hap⟩ := hcon a ha h2
      exact Set.mem_biUnion
        (show p ∈ (↑s : Set (Ideal R)) by simp [hsdef, hPdef, hp]) hap
  have hprime : ∀ i ∈ s, i ≠ maximalIdeal R ^ 2 → i ≠ maximalIdeal R ^ 2 →
      (id i : Ideal R).IsPrime := by
    intro i hi hne _
    have hiP : i ∈ P := (Finset.mem_insert.mp hi).resolve_left hne
    exact IsMinimalPrime.isPrime (hfin.mem_toFinset.mp hiP)
  obtain ⟨i, his, hle⟩ :=
    (Ideal.subset_union_prime (f := (id : Ideal R → Ideal R))
      (maximalIdeal R ^ 2) (maximalIdeal R ^ 2) hprime (I := maximalIdeal R)).mp hsub
  simp only [id_eq] at hle
  rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp his with rfl | hiP
  · 
    exact (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_sq_lt_of_ringKrullDim_ne_zero hdim).ne
      (le_antisymm (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_sq_lt_of_ringKrullDim_ne_zero hdim).le hle)
  · 
    have hip : i ∈ minimalPrimes R := hfin.mem_toFinset.mp hiP
    haveI : i.IsPrime := IsMinimalPrime.isPrime hip
    have hieq : i = maximalIdeal R :=
      le_antisymm (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal (Ideal.IsPrime.ne_top ‹i.IsPrime›)) hle
    exact maximalIdeal_notMem_minimalPrimes hdim (hieq ▸ hip)

name: isDomain_of_isRegularLocalRing
statement:
theorem isDomain_of_isRegularLocalRing (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsRegularLocalRing A] :
    IsDomain A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  generalize hn : embeddingDimension A = n
  revert A
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro A _ _ hn
    have hdim : ringKrullDim A = 0 := by
      rw [← IsRegularLocalRing.coe_embeddingDimension_eq_ringKrullDim A, hn]
      simp
    exact (isField_of_ringKrullDim_eq_zero hdim).isDomain
  | succ n ih =>
    intro A _ _ hn
    letI : DecidableEq A := Classical.decEq A
    have hdimne : ringKrullDim A ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have hpos : (0 : WithBot ℕ∞) < ringKrullDim A := by
        rw [← IsRegularLocalRing.coe_embeddingDimension_eq_ringKrullDim A]
        exact_mod_cast (show 0 < embeddingDimension A from by rw [hn]; omega)
      rw [h0] at hpos
      exact (lt_irrefl 0) hpos
    obtain ⟨x, hxm, hx2, hxmin⟩ :=
      exists_mem_maximalIdeal_notMem_sq_notMem_minimalPrimes hdimne
    
    letI := quotientSpanIsLocalRing A x hxm
    letI : IsRegularLocalRing (A ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      quotient_span_singleton_isRegularLocalRing hxm hx2
    letI : DecidableEq (A ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) := Classical.decEq _
    have hQdim : embeddingDimension (A ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) = n := by
      have h := embeddingDimension_quotient_span_singleton hxm hx2
      rw [hn] at h
      simpa using h
    have hQdom : IsDomain (A ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) := ih _ hQdim
    haveI hxprime : (Ideal.span {x} : Ideal A).IsPrime :=
      (Ideal.Quotient.isDomain_iff_prime _).mp hQdom
    
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hqle⟩ :=
      Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_le (I := (⊥ : Ideal A)) (J := Ideal.span {x}) bot_le
    have hq' : q ∈ minimalPrimes A := hq
    haveI : q.IsPrime := IsMinimalPrime.isPrime hq'
    have hxq : x ∉ q := hxmin q hq'
    
    have hqsmul : (q : Submodule A A) ≤ (Ideal.span {x} : Ideal A) • (q : Submodule A A) := by
      intro y hy
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp (hqle hy)
      have hr : r ∈ q := (Ideal.IsPrime.mem_or_mem ‹q.IsPrime› hy).resolve_right hxq
      have hmem := Submodule.smul_mem_smul (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self x) hr
      simpa [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using hmem
    have hjac : (Ideal.span {x} : Ideal A) ≤ Ideal.jacobson (⊥ : Ideal A) := by
      rw [IsLocalRing.jacobson_eq_maximalIdeal (⊥ : Ideal A) bot_ne_top]
      exact Ideal.span_le.mpr (by simpa using hxm)
    have hqbot : q = ⊥ :=
      Submodule.eq_bot_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot _ _ (IsNoetherian.noetherian _) hqsmul hjac
    haveI hbot : (⊥ : Ideal A).IsPrime := hqbot ▸ ‹q.IsPrime›
    haveI : NoZeroDivisors A := by
      refine ⟨fun {a b} hab => ?_⟩
      have hmem : a * b ∈ (⊥ : Ideal A) := by simpa using hab
      rcases Ideal.IsPrime.mem_or_mem hbot hmem with h | h
      · exact Or.inl (by simpa using h)
      · exact Or.inr (by simpa using h)
    exact NoZeroDivisors.to_isDomain A

name: ModuleCat.IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.of_isRegularLocalRing_unconditional
statement:
theorem IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.of_isRegularLocalRing_unconditional
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsRegularLocalRing A] : IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing A

  exact IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.of_isRegularLocalRing

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalRelationGenerator.cycle_apply_codimensionPoint
statement:
theorem cycle_apply_codimensionPoint {X : Scheme.{u}} {p : ℕ}
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X p) (x : CodimensionPoint X p) :
    g.cycle.1 x.1 =
      ∑ y ∈ (g.i.preimageSupportFinite (div g.f) x.1).toFinset,
        div g.f y * (g.i.degree y : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cycle]
  dsimp only [AlgebraicCycle.pushforward, Function.locallyFinsupp.map]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro y _
  by_cases hdiv : div g.f y = 0
  · simp [hdiv]
  · have hcodimY : coheight y = 1 := div_support hdiv
    have hcodim : coheight (g.i y) = p := g.codimension y hcodimY
    simp [AlgebraicCycle.mapAux, hcodim]

proof:

  rw [g.i.degree_eq_one_of_isClosedImmersion]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalRelationGenerator.compactCodimCycleFinsupp_cycle_apply_eq_sum_ord
statement:
@[simp]
theorem compactCodimCycleFinsupp_cycle_apply_eq_sum_ord
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] {p : ℕ}
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X p) (x : CodimensionPoint X p) :
    compactCodimCycleFinsupp p g.cycle x =
      ∑ y ∈ (g.i.preimageSupportFinite (div g.f) x.1).toFinset, div g.f y
proof:
:= by
  rw [compactCodimCycleFinsupp_apply, cycle_apply_codimensionPoint_eq_sum_ord]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalRelationGenerator.mem_preimageSupport_toFinset_iff
statement:
private theorem mem_preimageSupport_toFinset_iff {X : Scheme.{u}} {p : ℕ}
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X p) (x : X) (y : g.Y) :
    y ∈ (g.i.preimageSupportFinite (div g.f) x).toFinset ↔
      g.i y = x ∧ div g.f y ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [Function.locallyFinsupp.preimageSupport, Function.mem_support]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalRelationGenerator.cycle_apply_i
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cycle_apply_i {X : Scheme.{u}} {p : ℕ}
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X p) (y : g.Y) :
    g.cycle.1 (g.i y) = div g.f y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hy : div g.f y = 0
  · rw [hy, cycle]
    dsimp only [AlgebraicCycle.pushforward, Function.locallyFinsupp.map]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro z hz
    have hiz : g.i z = g.i y := (mem_preimageSupport_toFinset_iff g _ z).mp hz |>.1
    rw [g.i.isEmbedding.injective hiz, hy, zero_mul]
  · have hcodim : coheight (g.i y) = p :=
      g.codimension y (div_support hy)
    rw [cycle_apply_codimensionPoint_eq_sum_ord g ⟨g.i y, hcodim⟩]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single y]
    · intro z hz hzy
      have hiz : g.i z = g.i y := (mem_preimageSupport_toFinset_iff g _ z).mp hz |>.1
      exact (hzy (g.i.isEmbedding.injective hiz)).elim
    · intro hy'
      exact (hy' ((mem_preimageSupport_toFinset_iff g _ y).mpr ⟨rfl, hy⟩)).elim

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalRelationGenerator.cycle_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range
proof:
:= by
  rw [cycle]
  dsimp only [AlgebraicCycle.pushforward, Function.locallyFinsupp.map]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro y hy
  have hiy : g.i y = x := (mem_preimageSupport_toFinset_iff g x y).mp hy |>.1
  exact (hx ⟨y, hiy⟩).elim

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalRelationGenerator.cycle_support
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    change g.cycle.1 x ≠ 0 at hx
    by_cases hrange : x ∈ Set.range g.i
    · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hrange
      refine ⟨y, ?_, rfl⟩
      change div g.f y ≠ 0
      simpa using hx
    · exact (hx (cycle_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range g x hrange)).elim
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    change g.cycle.1 (g.i y) ≠ 0
    rw [cycle_apply_i]
    exact hy

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalRelationGenerator.div_support_finite
statement:
theorem div_support_finite {X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] {p : ℕ}
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X p) : (div g.f).support.Finite
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Finite.of_finite_image (f := g.i)
  · rw [← cycle_support g]
    change (Function.support g.cycle.1.toFun).Finite
    have h := g.cycle.1.locallyFiniteSupport.finite_inter_support_of_isCompact
      CompactSpace.isCompact_univ
    simpa only [Set.univ_inter] using h
  · exact g.i.isEmbedding.injective.injOn

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalRelationGenerator.principalDivisorFinsupp_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem principalDivisorFinsupp_apply {X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] {p : ℕ}
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X p) (y : g.Y) :
    g.principalDivisorFinsupp y = div g.f y
proof:
:= by
  exact congrFun Finsupp.ofSupportFinite_coe y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalRelationGenerator.principalDivisorCodimFinsupp_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem principalDivisorCodimFinsupp_apply {X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] {p : ℕ}
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X p) (y : CodimensionPoint g.Y 1) :
    g.principalDivisorCodimFinsupp y = div g.f y
proof:
:= by
  change g.principalDivisorFinsupp y.1 = div g.f y
  rw [principalDivisorFinsupp_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalRelationGenerator.relationPoint_injective
statement:
theorem relationPoint_injective {X : Scheme.{u}} {p : ℕ}
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X p) : Function.Injective g.relationPoint
proof:
:= by
  intro y z hyz
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply g.i.isEmbedding.injective
  exact congrArg Subtype.val hyz

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalRelationGenerator.compactCodimCycleFinsupp_cycle_eq_mapDomain
statement:
theorem compactCodimCycleFinsupp_cycle_eq_mapDomain
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] {p : ℕ}
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X p) :
    compactCodimCycleFinsupp p g.cycle =
      Finsupp.mapDomain g.relationPoint g.principalDivisorCodimFinsupp
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.range g.relationPoint
  · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_apply g.relationPoint_injective]
    simp [relationPoint]
  · rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_notin_range _ _ hx]
    by_cases hi : x.1 ∈ Set.range g.i
    · obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hi
      by_cases hdiv : div g.f y = 0
      · rw [compactCodimCycleFinsupp_apply, ← hy, cycle_apply_i, hdiv]
      · have hcodimY : coheight y = 1 := div_support hdiv
        have hrel : g.relationPoint ⟨y, hcodimY⟩ = x := Subtype.ext hy
        exact (hx ⟨⟨y, hcodimY⟩, hrel⟩).elim
    · rw [compactCodimCycleFinsupp_apply,
        cycle_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range g x.1 hi]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProperIntersectionKernel.pairing_relationGenerator_primeCycle
statement:
theorem pairing_relationGenerator_primeCycle
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X p) (z : CodimensionPoint X q) :
    K.pairing g.cycle (primeCycle z.1 q z.2) =
      (compactCodimCycleFinsupp p g.cycle).sum (fun x _ ↦
        (∑ y ∈ (g.i.preimageSupportFinite (div g.f) x.1).toFinset,
          div g.f y * (g.i.degree y : ℤ)) • (K.pair x z).cycle)
proof:
:= by
  rw [K.pairing_apply_primeCycle]
  simp only [Finsupp.sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x _
  rw [RationalRelationGenerator.compactCodimCycleFinsupp_cycle_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProperIntersectionKernel.pairing_primeCycle_relationGenerator
statement:
theorem pairing_primeCycle_relationGenerator
    (z : CodimensionPoint X p) (g : RationalRelationGenerator X q) :
    K.pairing (primeCycle z.1 p z.2) g.cycle =
      (compactCodimCycleFinsupp q g.cycle).sum (fun x _ ↦
        (∑ y ∈ (g.i.preimageSupportFinite (div g.f) x.1).toFinset,
          div g.f y * (g.i.degree y : ℤ)) • (K.pair z x).cycle)
proof:
:= by
  rw [K.pairing_primeCycle_apply]
  simp only [Finsupp.sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x _
  rw [RationalRelationGenerator.compactCodimCycleFinsupp_cycle_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProperIntersectionKernel.pairing_relationGenerator_primeCycle_eq_sum_ord
statement:
theorem pairing_relationGenerator_primeCycle_eq_sum_ord
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X p) (z : CodimensionPoint X q) :
    K.pairing g.cycle (primeCycle z.1 q z.2) =
      (compactCodimCycleFinsupp p g.cycle).sum (fun x _ ↦
        (∑ y ∈ (g.i.preimageSupportFinite (div g.f) x.1).toFinset, div g.f y) •
          (K.pair x z).cycle)
proof:
:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProperIntersectionKernel.pairing_primeCycle_relationGenerator_eq_sum_ord
statement:
theorem pairing_primeCycle_relationGenerator_eq_sum_ord
    (z : CodimensionPoint X p) (g : RationalRelationGenerator X q) :
    K.pairing (primeCycle z.1 p z.2) g.cycle =
      (compactCodimCycleFinsupp q g.cycle).sum (fun x _ ↦
        (∑ y ∈ (g.i.preimageSupportFinite (div g.f) x.1).toFinset, div g.f y) •
          (K.pair z x).cycle)
proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProperIntersectionKernel.pairing_relationGenerator_primeCycle_eq_source_sum
statement:
theorem pairing_relationGenerator_primeCycle_eq_source_sum
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X p) (z : CodimensionPoint X q) :
    K.pairing g.cycle (primeCycle z.1 q z.2) =
      g.principalDivisorCodimFinsupp.sum (fun y n ↦
        n • (K.pair (g.relationPoint y) z).cycle)
proof:
:= by
  rw [K.pairing_apply_primeCycle,
    RationalRelationGenerator.compactCodimCycleFinsupp_cycle_eq_mapDomain]
  exact Finsupp.sum_mapDomain_index (fun _ ↦ zero_zsmul _) (fun _ _ _ ↦ add_zsmul _ _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProperIntersectionKernel.pairing_primeCycle_relationGenerator_eq_source_sum
statement:
theorem pairing_primeCycle_relationGenerator_eq_source_sum
    (z : CodimensionPoint X p) (g : RationalRelationGenerator X q) :
    K.pairing (primeCycle z.1 p z.2) g.cycle =
      g.principalDivisorCodimFinsupp.sum (fun y n ↦
        n • (K.pair z (g.relationPoint y)).cycle)
proof:
:= by
  rw [K.pairing_primeCycle_apply,
    RationalRelationGenerator.compactCodimCycleFinsupp_cycle_eq_mapDomain]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.D7.ffIso_algebraMap
statement:
theorem ffIso_algebraMap (x : X) (r : Y.presheaf.stalk (φ x)) :
    (ffIso φ hgen).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
        (algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk (φ x)) Y.functionField r) =
      algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField
        ((asIso (φ.stalkMap x)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv r)
proof:
:= by
  let hX : genericPoint X ⤳ x := (genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial
  let hY : genericPoint Y ⤳ φ x := (genericPoint_spec Y).specializes trivial
  let hη : φ (genericPoint X) ⤳ genericPoint Y := specializes_of_eq hgen
  have htransport :
      (Y.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hgen.symm)).hom
          (Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes hY r) =
        Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (hX.map φ.continuous) r := by
    change (Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes hη)
        (Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes hY r) =
      Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (hX.map φ.continuous) r
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, TopCat.Presheaf.stalkSpecializes_comp]
  change (φ.stalkMap (genericPoint X)).hom
      ((Y.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hgen.symm)).hom
        (Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes hY r)) =
    X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes hX ((φ.stalkMap x).hom r)
  rw [htransport]
  exact φ.stalkSpecializes_stalkMap_apply (genericPoint X) x hX r

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.D7.coheight_map_of_isIso_stalkMap
statement: theorem coheight_map_of_isIso_stalkMap (x : X) : coheight (φ x) = coheight x
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight (X := X) x
  have h2 := ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight (X := Y) (φ x)
  have h3 : ringKrullDim (Y.presheaf.stalk (φ x)) = ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (asIso (φ.stalkMap x)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  rw [h3, h1] at h2
  exact_mod_cast h2.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.D7.ord_ffIso
statement:
theorem ord_ffIso (q : Y.functionField) (x : X) :
    X.ord ((ffIso φ hgen).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv q) x = Y.ord q (φ x)
proof:
:= by
  have hcoheight := coheight_map_of_isIso_stalkMap φ x
  by_cases hx : coheight x = 1
  · have hy : coheight (φ x) = 1 := hcoheight.trans hx
    rw [Scheme.ord_eq_ordHom_of_coheight_eq_one hx, Scheme.ord_eq_ordHom_of_coheight_eq_one hy]
    letI : Ring.KrullDimLE 1 (X.presheaf.stalk x) := krullDimLE_of_coheight hx
    letI : Ring.KrullDimLE 1 (Y.presheaf.stalk (φ x)) := krullDimLE_of_coheight hy
    have hord :
        Ring.ordFrac (X.presheaf.stalk x)
            ((ffIso φ hgen).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv q) =
          Ring.ordFrac (Y.presheaf.stalk (φ x)) q :=
      Ring.ordFrac_map_ringEquiv
        (asIso (φ.stalkMap x)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
        (ffIso φ hgen).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
        (ffIso_algebraMap φ hgen x) q
    exact congrArg (fun a ↦ Multiplicative.toAdd (WithZero.recZeroCoe 1 id a)) hord
  · have hy : coheight (φ x) ≠ 1 := by rwa [hcoheight]
    rw [Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hx, Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hy]

name: IsLocalization.pow_dvd_iff_map_pow_dvd_map
statement:
theorem pow_dvd_iff_map_pow_dvd_map {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    {P : Ideal A} [P.IsPrime] {π : A} (hπ : Prime π) (hgen : P = Ideal.span {π})
    (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra A S] [IsLocalization.AtPrime S P]
    (a : A) (n : ℕ) :
    π ^ n ∣ a ↔ (algebraMap A S π) ^ n ∣ algebraMap A S a
proof:
:= by
  subst hgen
  refine ⟨fun h => by simpa using map_dvd (algebraMap A S) h, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
  obtain ⟨⟨b, s⟩, hbs⟩ := IsLocalization.surj (M := (Ideal.span {π} : Ideal A).primeCompl) t
  have hmap : algebraMap A S (s * a) = algebraMap A S (π ^ n * b) := by
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, mul_comm ((algebraMap A S) s), ht, mul_assoc, hbs, map_pow]
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (IsLocalization.eq_iff_exists (Ideal.span {π} : Ideal A).primeCompl S).mp hmap
  have hmem : ∀ d : (Ideal.span {π} : Ideal A).primeCompl, ¬ π ∣ (d : A) :=
    fun d hd => d.2 (Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr hd)
  have hdvd : π ^ n ∣ ((c : A) * s) * a := by
    refine ⟨(c : A) * b, ?_⟩
    calc ((c : A) * s) * a = (c : A) * (s * a) := by ring
      _ = (c : A) * (π ^ n * b) := by rw [hc]
      _ = π ^ n * ((c : A) * b) := by ring
  have hns : ¬ π ∣ ((c : A) * s) := by
    intro hd
    rcases hπ.dvd_mul.mp hd with hd' | hd'
    · exact hmem c hd'
    · exact hmem s hd'
  exact hπ.pow_dvd_of_dvd_mul_left n hns hdvd

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.pow_dvd_iff_natCast_le_ord
statement:
theorem pow_dvd_iff_natCast_le_ord {w pt : X} (h : w ⤳ pt)
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk w)]
    {π : X.presheaf.stalk pt} (hπ : Prime π)
    (hgen : stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h = Ideal.span {π}) (a : X.presheaf.stalk pt) (n : ℕ) :
    letI
proof:
:= stalkSpecializesAlgebra h
    π ^ n ∣ a ↔ (n : ℕ∞) ≤ Ring.ord (X.presheaf.stalk w)
      (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) (X.presheaf.stalk w) a) := by
  letI := stalkSpecializesAlgebra h
  haveI := isLocalization_stalkSpecializes h
  
  have hunif : Irreducible (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) (X.presheaf.stalk w) π) := by
    rw [IsDiscreteValuationRing.irreducible_iff_uniformizer]
    rw [← IsLocalization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal (stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h)
      (X.presheaf.stalk w), hgen, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
  rw [IsLocalization.pow_dvd_iff_map_pow_dvd_map hπ hgen (X.presheaf.stalk w) a n,
    ← IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal_le_iff_dvd, hunif.addVal_pow, Ring.ord_eq_addVal]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.IntersectionPairingData.rightDescend_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rightDescend_classOf (D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ p)
    (E : CodimensionCycles X ℤ q) :
    T.rightDescend D (gradedClassOf X q E) =
      gradedClassOf X (p + q) (T.pairing D E)

:=
  gradedClassLift_classOf _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.IntersectionPairingData.leftCycleHom_apply_classOf

theorem leftCycleHom_apply_classOf (D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ p)

      gradedClassOf X (p + q) (T.pairing D E)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.IntersectionPairingData.leftCycleHom_relation
statement:
theorem leftCycleHom_relation (g : RationalRelationGenerator X p) :
    T.leftCycleHom g.cycle = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply gradedClass_hom_ext
  intro E
  apply QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem.mpr
  rw [sub_zero]
  exact T.relation_left g E

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.IntersectionPairingData.product_classOf_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem product_classOf_classOf (D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ p)
    (E : CodimensionCycles X ℤ q) :
    T.product (gradedClassOf X p D) (gradedClassOf X q E) =
      gradedClassOf X (p + q) (T.pairing D E)
proof:
:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.IntersectionPairingData.product_zero_left
statement:

theorem product_zero_left (y : CodimensionChow X q) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.IntersectionPairingData.product_add_left
statement:
theorem product_add_left (x x' : CodimensionChow X p)
    (y : CodimensionChow X q) :
    T.product (x + x') y = T.product x y + T.product x' y

    (y y' : CodimensionChow X q) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.gradedClassMap_apply
statement:

theorem gradedClassMap_apply (X : Scheme.{u}) (p : ℕ)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.gradedClassOf_zero

    (D E : CodimensionCycles X ℤ p) :
    gradedClassOf X p (D + E) = gradedClassOf X p D + gradedClassOf X p E

    (D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ p) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.gradedClassOf_relation
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gradedClassOf_relation {X : Scheme.{u}} {p : ℕ}
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X p) :
    gradedClassOf X p g.cycle = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem.mpr
  rw [sub_zero]
  exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨g, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.gradedClassOf_eq_iff
statement:
theorem gradedClassOf_eq_iff {X : Scheme.{u}} {p : ℕ}
    {D E : CodimensionCycles X ℤ p} :
    gradedClassOf X p D = gradedClassOf X p E ↔
      D - E ∈ rationalEquivalenceSubgroup X p
proof:
:=
  QuotientAddGroup.eq_iff_sub_mem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.rationalEquivalenceSubgroup_le_ker
statement:
theorem rationalEquivalenceSubgroup_le_ker {X : Scheme.{u}} {p : ℕ}
    {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A]
    (F : CodimensionCycles X ℤ p →+ A)
    (hF : ∀ g : RationalRelationGenerator X p, F g.cycle = 0) :
    rationalEquivalenceSubgroup X p ≤ F.ker
proof:
:= by
  rw [rationalEquivalenceSubgroup, AddSubgroup.closure_le]
  rintro D ⟨g, rfl⟩
  exact hF g

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.gradedClassLift_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gradedClassLift_classOf {X : Scheme.{u}} {p : ℕ}
    {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A]
    (F : CodimensionCycles X ℤ p →+ A)
    (hF : ∀ g : RationalRelationGenerator X p, F g.cycle = 0)
    (D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ p) :
    gradedClassLift F hF (gradedClassOf X p D) = F D
proof:
:= by
  apply QuotientAddGroup.lift_mk'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.isLocalization_stalkSpecializes
statement:
theorem isLocalization_stalkSpecializes (h : x ⤳ y) :
    letI
proof:
:= stalkSpecializesAlgebra h
    IsLocalization.AtPrime (X.presheaf.stalk x) (stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h) := by
  letI := stalkSpecializesAlgebra h
  
  set U : X.Opens := (X.affineCover.f (X.affineCover.idx y)).opensRange with hUdef
  have hU : IsAffineOpen U := isAffineOpen_opensRange _
  have hyU : y ∈ U := X.affineCover.covers y
  have hxU : x ∈ U := h.mem_open U.2 hyU
  letI algy : Algebra Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk y) :=
    X.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk ⟨y, hyU⟩
  letI algx : Algebra Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    X.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk ⟨x, hxU⟩
  haveI hlx := hU.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hxU⟩
  haveI hly := hU.isLocalization_stalk ⟨y, hyU⟩
  set px : Ideal Γ(X, U) := (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxU⟩).asIdeal with hpxdef
  set py : Ideal Γ(X, U) := (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨y, hyU⟩).asIdeal with hpydef
  
  have hle : px ≤ py := by
    have hsub : (⟨x, hxU⟩ : U) ⤳ (⟨y, hyU⟩ : U) := (subtype_specializes_iff _ _).mpr h
    exact (PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes _ _).mpr
      (hsub.map (Scheme.Hom.continuous hU.isoSpec.hom))
  have hcompl : py.primeCompl ≤ px.primeCompl := fun a ha ha' => ha (hle ha')
  
  haveI htower : IsScalarTower Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk y) (X.presheaf.stalk x) := by
    refine IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' ?_
    have hgerm := X.presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes (U := U) hyU h
    have hgerm' := congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom hgerm
    simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp] at hgerm'
    simpa [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra] using hgerm'.symm
  
  have hmap : ∀ a : Γ(X, U), (X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom
      (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk y) a) = algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x) a := by
    intro a
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk y) (X.presheaf.stalk x) a]
    simp [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
  
  haveI key : IsLocalization (px.primeCompl.map (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk y)))
      (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    IsLocalization.isLocalization_of_submonoid_le (X.presheaf.stalk y) (X.presheaf.stalk x)
      py.primeCompl px.primeCompl hcompl
  
  refine IsLocalization.isLocalization_of_is_exists_mul_mem (X.presheaf.stalk x)
    (px.primeCompl.map (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk y)))
    (stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h).primeCompl ?_ ?_
  · rintro _ ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    show _ ∉ stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h
    rw [stalkPrimeOfSpecializes, Ideal.mem_comap, hmap a, IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal]
    exact IsLocalization.map_units (X.presheaf.stalk x) ⟨a, ha⟩
  · rintro ⟨u, hu⟩
    obtain ⟨⟨a, s⟩, e⟩ := IsLocalization.surj (M := py.primeCompl) u
    have hfu : IsUnit ((X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom u) := by
      rw [← IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal]
      exact hu
    have hfs : IsUnit (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x) (s : Γ(X, U))) :=
      IsLocalization.map_units (X.presheaf.stalk x) ⟨(s : Γ(X, U)), hcompl s.2⟩
    have hfa : IsUnit (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x) a) := by
      have := congrArg (X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom e
      rw [map_mul, hmap, hmap] at this
      rw [← this]
      exact hfu.mul hfs
    have ha : a ∈ px.primeCompl :=
      (IsLocalization.AtPrime.isUnit_to_map_iff (X.presheaf.stalk x) px a).mp hfa
    refine ⟨algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk y) (s : Γ(X, U)), ?_⟩
    rw [mul_comm, e]
    exact Submonoid.mem_map_of_mem _ ha

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.isScalarTower_functionField
statement:
theorem isScalarTower_functionField [IrreducibleSpace X] (h : x ⤳ y) :
    letI
proof:
:= stalkSpecializesAlgebra h
    IsScalarTower (X.presheaf.stalk y) (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField := by
  letI := stalkSpecializesAlgebra h
  apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq'
  simp_rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
  change _ = (X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h ≫ _).hom
  rw [X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes_comp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.fromSpecStalk_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes
statement:
theorem fromSpecStalk_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (h : x ⤳ y) :
    X.fromSpecStalk y ⟨stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h, stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_isPrime h⟩ = x
proof:
:= by
  calc X.fromSpecStalk y ⟨stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h, stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_isPrime h⟩
      = (Spec.map (X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h) ≫ X.fromSpecStalk y)
          (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (X.presheaf.stalk x)) := by
        rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
        congr 1
    _ = X.fromSpecStalk x (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (X.presheaf.stalk x)) := by
        rw [Scheme.SpecMap_stalkSpecializes_fromSpecStalk]
    _ = x := Scheme.fromSpecStalk_closedPoint

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_injective
statement:
theorem stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_injective {x₁ x₂ : X} (h₁ : x₁ ⤳ y) (h₂ : x₂ ⤳ y)
    (e : stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h₁ = stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h₂) : x₁ = x₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [← fromSpecStalk_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h₁, ← fromSpecStalk_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h₂]
  congr 1
  exact PrimeSpectrum.ext e

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.exists_specializes_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_eq
statement:
theorem exists_specializes_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_eq (y : X)
    (P : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk y)) [P.IsPrime] :
    ∃ (x : X) (h : x ⤳ y), stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h = P
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : X.fromSpecStalk y ⟨P, ‹P.IsPrime›⟩ ∈ Set.range (X.fromSpecStalk y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [Scheme.range_fromSpecStalk] at hmem
  refine ⟨X.fromSpecStalk y ⟨P, ‹P.IsPrime›⟩, hmem, ?_⟩
  have := fromSpecStalk_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes hmem
  have hinj := (X.fromSpecStalk y).isEmbedding.injective
  exact congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal (hinj this)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.height_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes
statement:
theorem height_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (h : x ⤳ y) :
    (stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h).height = Order.coheight x
proof:
:= by
  letI := stalkSpecializesAlgebra h
  haveI := isLocalization_stalkSpecializes h
  have h1 : ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x) = (stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h).height :=
    IsLocalization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height _ _
  have h2 : ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x) = Order.coheight x :=
    ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight x
  exact_mod_cast h1.symm.trans h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.properPushforward_generator_mem_of_S2
statement:
theorem properPushforward_generator_mem_of_S2 (hS2 : GenericFibreVanishing k) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsProper f] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] [f.IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (hf : HeightCompatible f) (hY : DimensionCatenary Y) {n : ℕ} (g : DimRelationGenerator X n) :
    (⟨properPushforward f g.cycle.1,
        properPushforward_mem_dimensionCycles f hf g.cycle.2⟩ : dimensionCycles Y n) ∈
      dimRationalEquivalence Y n
proof:
:= by
  have hX : DimensionCatenary X := dimensionCatenary_of_finiteType (X := X) k
  set e : g.Y ⟶ Y := g.i ≫ f with he
  have hcyc : properPushforward f g.cycle.1 =
      properPushforward e.imageι (properPushforward e.toImage (div g.f)) := by
    change properPushforward f (properPushforward g.i (div g.f)) = _
    rw [← properPushforward_comp, ← properPushforward_comp]
    exact properPushforward_congr (Scheme.Hom.toImage_imageι e).symm _
  by_cases hw : ∃ w : g.Y, coheight w = 1
  swap
  · have hdiv : div g.f = 0 := by
      ext w
      by_contra hne
      exact hw ⟨w, div_support hne⟩
    rw [dimensionCycles_zero_mk _ _ (by rw [hcyc, hdiv, properPushforward_zero,
      properPushforward_zero])]
    exact zero_mem _
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hw
  
  letI : g.Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := ⟨g.i ≫ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))⟩
  haveI : g.i.IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := ⟨rfl⟩
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (g.Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (g.i ≫ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    infer_instance
  letI : e.image.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := ⟨e.imageι ≫ (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))⟩
  haveI : e.imageι.IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := ⟨rfl⟩
  haveI : e.toImage.IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := ⟨by
    change e.toImage ≫ (e.imageι ≫ (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) =
      g.i ≫ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    rw [← Category.assoc, Scheme.Hom.toImage_imageι, he, Category.assoc]
    rw [CategoryTheory.comp_over (f := f) (S := Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]⟩
  by_cases hdeg : e.toImage.degree (genericPoint g.Y) = 0
  · rw [dimensionCycles_zero_mk _ _ (by
      rw [hcyc, properPushforward_div_eq_zero_of_degree_eq_zero k e.toImage g.f g.hf hdeg
        (hS2 g.Y e.image e.toImage g.f g.hf hdeg), properPushforward_zero])]
    exact zero_mem _
  have hηX : height (g.i (genericPoint g.Y)) = (n : ℕ∞) + 1 := by
    rw [← hX g.Y g.i w hw, g.dimension w hw]
  have hdege : e.degree (genericPoint g.Y) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.toImage_imageι e, hom_degree_comp,
      Scheme.Hom.degree_eq_one_of_isClosedImmersion e.imageι, mul_one]
    exact hdeg
  have hdegf : f.degree (g.i (genericPoint g.Y)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [he, hom_degree_comp] at hdege
    exact right_ne_zero_of_mul hdege
  have hηY : height (e.imageι (genericPoint e.image)) = (n : ℕ∞) + 1 := by
    rw [← toImage_genericPoint e, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.toImage_imageι, he,
      Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hf _ hdegf, hηX]
  have hηI : height (genericPoint e.image) = (n : ℕ∞) + 1 := by
    rw [← height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion e.imageι]; exact hηY
  have hcodim : ∀ w : g.Y, coheight w = 1 → e.toImage.degree w ≠ 0 →
      coheight (e.toImage w) = 1 := by
    intro w hw1 hdw
    have hdew : e.degree w ≠ 0 := by
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.toImage_imageι e, hom_degree_comp,
        Scheme.Hom.degree_eq_one_of_isClosedImmersion e.imageι, mul_one]
      exact hdw
    have hdfw : f.degree (g.i w) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [he, hom_degree_comp] at hdew
      exact right_ne_zero_of_mul hdew
    have hk : height (e.toImage w) = n := by
      rw [← height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion e.imageι, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply,
        Scheme.Hom.toImage_imageι, he, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hf _ hdfw, g.dimension w hw1]
    exact coheight_eq_one_of_height_of_height_genericPoint _ hk hηI
  letI := functionFieldAlgebra e.toImage
  haveI := RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.finiteDimensional_of_degree e.toImage hdeg
  have hEq := properPushforward_div_eq_div_norm e.toImage g.f
    g.hf hdeg hcodim
  let s : e.image.functionField := Algebra.norm e.image.functionField g.f
  have hs : s ≠ 0 := (Algebra.norm_ne_zero_iff).mpr g.hf
  let G : DimRelationGenerator Y n :=
    { Y := e.image
      i := e.imageι
      f := s
      hf := hs
      dimension := fun v hv ↦ ENat_add_one_cancel ((hY e.image e.imageι v hv).trans hηY) }
  have hG : (⟨properPushforward f g.cycle.1,
      properPushforward_mem_dimensionCycles f hf g.cycle.2⟩ : dimensionCycles Y n) =
      G.cycle := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change properPushforward f g.cycle.1 = properPushforward e.imageι (div s)
    rw [hcyc, hEq]
  rw [hG]
  exact AddSubgroup.subset_closure ⟨G, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.properPushforward_mem_dimRationalEquivalence_of_S2
statement:
theorem properPushforward_mem_dimRationalEquivalence_of_S2 (hS2 : GenericFibreVanishing k)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] [f.IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (hf : HeightCompatible f) (hY : DimensionCatenary Y) {n : ℕ} (D : dimensionCycles X n)
    (hD : D ∈ dimRationalEquivalence X n) :
    (⟨properPushforward f D.1, properPushforward_mem_dimensionCycles f hf D.2⟩ :
        dimensionCycles Y n) ∈ dimRationalEquivalence Y n
proof:
:= by
  induction hD using AddSubgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem D hD =>
      obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := hD
      exact properPushforward_generator_mem_of_S2 k hS2 f hf hY g
  | zero =>
      have : (⟨properPushforward f (0 : dimensionCycles X n).1,
          properPushforward_mem_dimensionCycles f hf (0 : dimensionCycles X n).2⟩ :
            dimensionCycles Y n) = 0 := Subtype.ext (properPushforward_zero f)
      rw [this]
      exact zero_mem _
  | add D E _ _ hD hE =>
      have : (⟨properPushforward f (D + E).1,
          properPushforward_mem_dimensionCycles f hf (D + E).2⟩ : dimensionCycles Y n) =
          ⟨properPushforward f D.1, properPushforward_mem_dimensionCycles f hf D.2⟩ +
          ⟨properPushforward f E.1, properPushforward_mem_dimensionCycles f hf E.2⟩ :=
        Subtype.ext (properPushforward_add f D.1 E.1)
      rw [this]
      exact add_mem hD hE
  | neg D _ hD =>
      have : (⟨properPushforward f (-D).1,
          properPushforward_mem_dimensionCycles f hf (-D).2⟩ : dimensionCycles Y n) =
          -⟨properPushforward f D.1, properPushforward_mem_dimensionCycles f hf D.2⟩ :=
        Subtype.ext ((properPushforwardHom f).map_neg D.1)
      rw [this]
      exact neg_mem hD

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.properPushforwardDimChow_mk
statement:
theorem properPushforwardDimChow_mk (hS2 : GenericFibreVanishing k) (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] [f.IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] (n : ℕ)
    (D : dimensionCycles X n) :
    properPushforwardDimChow k hS2 f n (QuotientAddGroup.mk D) =
      QuotientAddGroup.mk ⟨properPushforward f D.1,
        properPushforward_mem_dimensionCycles f (heightCompatible_of_finiteType k f) D.2⟩
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.properPushforwardDimChow_id
statement:
theorem properPushforwardDimChow_id (hS2 : GenericFibreVanishing k) [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (n : ℕ) (x : DimChow X n) :
    properPushforwardDimChow k hS2 (𝟙 X) n x = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
  | H D =>
    rw [properPushforwardDimChow_mk]
    congr 1
    exact Subtype.ext (properPushforward_id D.1)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.properPushforwardDimChow_comp
statement:
theorem properPushforwardDimChow_comp (hS2 : GenericFibreVanishing k) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    [IsProper f] [IsProper g] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] [IsLocallyNoetherian Z]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [g.IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] (n : ℕ)
    (x : DimChow X n) :
    properPushforwardDimChow k hS2 (f ≫ g) n x =
      properPushforwardDimChow k hS2 g n (properPushforwardDimChow k hS2 f n x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
  | H D =>
    rw [properPushforwardDimChow_mk, properPushforwardDimChow_mk,
      properPushforwardDimChow_mk]
    congr 1
    exact Subtype.ext (properPushforward_comp f g D.1)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.properPushforwardRationalDimChow_tmul
statement:
theorem properPushforwardRationalDimChow_tmul (hS2 : GenericFibreVanishing k) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsProper f] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] [f.IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] (n : ℕ) (a : ℚ)
    (D : DimChow X n) :
    properPushforwardRationalDimChow k hS2 f n (a ⊗ₜ[ℤ] D) =
      a ⊗ₜ[ℤ] properPushforwardDimChow k hS2 f n D
proof:
:= by
  simp [properPushforwardRationalDimChow]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.toX_eq_j_rightPoint

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.leftStalkMap_surjective

  d.i.stalkMap_surjective (d.leftPoint z)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.rightStalkMap_surjective
statement:
theorem rightStalkMap_surjective (z : d.intersection) :
    Function.Surjective (d.rightStalkMap z).hom
proof:
:= by
  intro b
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := d.j.stalkMap_surjective (d.rightPoint z) b
  let e := X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (d.toX_eq_j_rightPoint z))
  refine ⟨e.inv a, ?_⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.ker_rightStalkMap_eq_span_rightAmbientStalkElement
statement:
theorem ker_rightStalkMap_eq_span_rightAmbientStalkElement (z : d.intersection)
    (a : X.presheaf.stalk (d.j (d.rightPoint z)))
    (hker : RingHom.ker (d.j.stalkMap (d.rightPoint z)).hom = Ideal.span {a}) :
    RingHom.ker (d.rightStalkMap z).hom =
      Ideal.span {d.rightAmbientStalkElement z a}
proof:
:= by
  let e := X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (d.toX_eq_j_rightPoint z))
  exact ker_eq_span_singleton_of_equiv_commutes_symm
    (d.rightStalkMap z).hom (d.j.stalkMap (d.rightPoint z)).hom
    e.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv (RingEquiv.refl _)
    (by rfl) a hker

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.rightStalkMap_eq_pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkMap
