name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.leftStalkMap_comp_fst_stalkMap
statement:
theorem leftStalkMap_comp_fst_stalkMap (z : d.intersection) :
    d.leftStalkMap z ≫ (pullback.fst d.i d.j).stalkMap z = d.toX.stalkMap z
proof:
:= by
  exact (Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp (pullback.fst d.i d.j) d.i z).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.rightStalkMap_comp_snd_stalkMap
statement:
theorem rightStalkMap_comp_snd_stalkMap (z : d.intersection) :
    d.rightStalkMap z ≫ (pullback.snd d.i d.j).stalkMap z = d.toX.stalkMap z
proof:
:= by
  change (X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (d.toX_eq_j_rightPoint z))).hom ≫
      d.j.stalkMap (d.rightPoint z) ≫ (pullback.snd d.i d.j).stalkMap z =
    (pullback.fst d.i d.j ≫ d.i).stalkMap z
  calc
    _ = (X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (d.toX_eq_j_rightPoint z))).hom ≫
        (pullback.snd d.i d.j ≫ d.j).stalkMap z := by
      dsimp only [rightPoint]
      rw [Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp]
    _ = (pullback.fst d.i d.j ≫ d.i).stalkMap z :=
      (Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_congr_hom
        (pullback.fst d.i d.j ≫ d.i) (pullback.snd d.i d.j ≫ d.j)
          (pullback.condition (f := d.i) (g := d.j)) z).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.fst_stalkMap_leftStalkMap_apply
statement:
theorem fst_stalkMap_leftStalkMap_apply (z : d.intersection)
    (a : X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z)) :
    ((pullback.fst d.i d.j).stalkMap z).hom ((d.leftStalkMap z).hom a) =
      (d.toX.stalkMap z).hom a
proof:
:=
  ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (d.leftStalkMap_comp_fst_stalkMap z) a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.snd_stalkMap_rightStalkMap_apply
statement:
theorem snd_stalkMap_rightStalkMap_apply (z : d.intersection)
    (a : X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z)) :
    ((pullback.snd d.i d.j).stalkMap z).hom ((d.rightStalkMap z).hom a) =
      (d.toX.stalkMap z).hom a
proof:
:=
  ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (d.rightStalkMap_comp_snd_stalkMap z) a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.isSMulRegular_leftStalkModule_iff
statement:
theorem isSMulRegular_leftStalkModule_iff (z : d.intersection)
    (a : X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z)) :
    IsSMulRegular (d.leftStalkModule z) a ↔
      ∀ x : X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z),
        a * x ∈ RingHom.ker (d.leftStalkMap z).hom →
          x ∈ RingHom.ker (d.leftStalkMap z).hom
proof:
:= by
  let A := ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z))
  let B := ↑(d.D.presheaf.stalk (d.leftPoint z))
  let f : A →+* B := (d.leftStalkMap z).hom
  letI : Algebra A B := f.toAlgebra
  change IsSMulRegular B a ↔ ∀ x : A, a * x ∈ RingHom.ker f → x ∈ RingHom.ker f
  constructor
  · intro h x hx
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker] at hx ⊢
    apply h.right_eq_zero_of_smul
    change f a * f x = 0
    rw [← map_mul, hx]
  · intro h
    apply IsSMulRegular.of_right_eq_zero_of_smul
    intro b hb
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := d.leftStalkMap_surjective z b
    rw [← RingHom.mem_ker]
    apply h x
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker]
    change f (a * x) = 0
    rw [map_mul]
    exact hb

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.TensorComparison.eq
statement: theorem eq (a b : d.TensorComparison z) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  cases a with
  | mk ah ah_tmul =>
      cases b with
      | mk bh bh_tmul =>
          congr 1
          apply ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.tensor_ext
          intro m n
          rw [ah_tmul, bh_tmul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.tensorIncludeRight_surjective
statement:
theorem tensorIncludeRight_surjective (z : d.intersection) :
    Function.Surjective (d.tensorIncludeRight z)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z))
      ↑(d.D.presheaf.stalk (d.leftPoint z)) := (d.leftStalkMap z).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z))
      ↑(d.E.presheaf.stalk (d.rightPoint z)) := (d.rightStalkMap z).hom.toAlgebra
  change Function.Surjective (TensorProduct.mk ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z))
    (d.D.presheaf.stalk (d.leftPoint z)) (d.E.presheaf.stalk (d.rightPoint z)) 1)
  exact TensorProduct.mk_surjective _ _ _ (d.i.stalkMap_surjective (d.leftPoint z))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.tensorIncludeRight_eq_zero_iff_of_ker_eq_span
statement:
theorem tensorIncludeRight_eq_zero_iff_of_ker_eq_span (z : d.intersection)
    (a : X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z))
    (hleft : RingHom.ker (d.leftStalkMap z).hom = Ideal.span {a})
    (c : d.E.presheaf.stalk (d.rightPoint z)) :
    (d.tensorIncludeRight z) c = 0 ↔
      c ∈ Ideal.span {(d.rightStalkMap z).hom a}
proof:
:= by
  let A : Type u := ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z))
  let B : Type u := ↑(d.D.presheaf.stalk (d.leftPoint z))
  let C : Type u := ↑(d.E.presheaf.stalk (d.rightPoint z))
  letI : Algebra A B := (d.leftStalkMap z).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra A C := (d.rightStalkMap z).hom.toAlgebra
  let e : C ⊗[A] B ≃ₐ[A] B ⊗[A] C := Algebra.TensorProduct.comm A C B
  have hbase : RingHom.ker (algebraMap C (C ⊗[A] B)) =
      Ideal.span {algebraMap A C a} :=
    ker_baseChangeTensor_eq_span (R := A) (S := C) (T := B) a hleft
      (d.i.stalkMap_surjective (d.leftPoint z))
  have hq : (d.tensorIncludeRight z) c =
      e (algebraMap C (C ⊗[A] B) c) := by
    change (1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A] c = e (c ⊗ₜ[A] (1 : B))
    rfl
  rw [hq]
  constructor
  · intro hc
    have hc' : algebraMap C (C ⊗[A] B) c = 0 := by
      exact e.injective (hc.trans (map_zero e).symm)
    change c ∈ Ideal.span {algebraMap A C a}
    rw [← hbase]
    exact hc'
  · intro hc
    have hc' : algebraMap C (C ⊗[A] B) c = 0 := by
      rw [← RingHom.mem_ker, hbase]
      exact hc
    rw [hc', map_zero]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.tensorIncludeRight_comp_canonicalTensorComparison_apply
statement:
theorem tensorIncludeRight_comp_canonicalTensorComparison_apply (z : d.intersection)
    (c : d.E.presheaf.stalk (d.rightPoint z)) :
    (d.tensorIncludeRight z ≫ (d.canonicalTensorComparison z).hom) c =
      ((pullback.snd d.i d.j).stalkMap z).hom c
proof:
:= by
  change (d.canonicalTensorComparison z).hom ((d.tensorIncludeRight z) c) =
    ((pullback.snd d.i d.j).stalkMap z).hom c
  rw [tensorIncludeRight]
  change (d.canonicalTensorComparison z).hom
      ((1 : d.D.presheaf.stalk (d.leftPoint z)) ⊗ₜ c) =
    ((pullback.snd d.i d.j).stalkMap z).hom c
  rw [(d.canonicalTensorComparison z).hom_tmul]
  exact (congrArg (fun q ↦ q * ((pullback.snd d.i d.j).stalkMap z).hom c)
    (map_one ((pullback.fst d.i d.j).stalkMap z).hom)).trans (one_mul _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.canonicalTensorComparison_injective_iff_ker_eq
statement:
theorem canonicalTensorComparison_injective_iff_ker_eq (z : d.intersection) :
    Function.Injective (d.canonicalTensorComparison z).hom ↔
      LinearMap.ker (d.tensorIncludeRight z).hom =
        LinearMap.ker
          (d.tensorIncludeRight z ≫ (d.canonicalTensorComparison z).hom).hom
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hinj
    apply le_antisymm
    · intro c hc
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at hc ⊢
      change (d.canonicalTensorComparison z).hom ((d.tensorIncludeRight z) c) = 0
      rw [hc, map_zero]
    · intro c hc
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at hc ⊢
      apply hinj
      change (d.canonicalTensorComparison z).hom ((d.tensorIncludeRight z) c) =
        (d.canonicalTensorComparison z).hom 0
      simpa using hc
  · intro hker x y hxy
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := d.tensorIncludeRight_surjective z (x - y)
    rw [← hc]
    have hccomp : c ∈ LinearMap.ker
        (d.tensorIncludeRight z ≫ (d.canonicalTensorComparison z).hom).hom := by
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
      change (d.canonicalTensorComparison z).hom ((d.tensorIncludeRight z) c) = 0
      rw [hc, map_sub, hxy, sub_self]
    have hcq : c ∈ LinearMap.ker (d.tensorIncludeRight z).hom := by
      rw [hker]
      exact hccomp
    exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hcq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.canonicalTensorComparison_ker_eq_of_principal
statement:
theorem canonicalTensorComparison_ker_eq_of_principal (z : d.intersection)
    (a : X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z))
    (hleft : RingHom.ker (d.leftStalkMap z).hom = Ideal.span {a})
    (hproj : RingHom.ker ((pullback.snd d.i d.j).stalkMap z).hom =
      Ideal.span {(d.rightStalkMap z).hom a}) :
    LinearMap.ker (d.tensorIncludeRight z).hom =
      LinearMap.ker
        (d.tensorIncludeRight z ≫ (d.canonicalTensorComparison z).hom).hom
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.mem_ker,
    d.tensorIncludeRight_eq_zero_iff_of_ker_eq_span z a hleft,
    d.tensorIncludeRight_comp_canonicalTensorComparison_apply]
  change c ∈ Ideal.span {(d.rightStalkMap z).hom a} ↔
    c ∈ RingHom.ker ((pullback.snd d.i d.j).stalkMap z).hom
  rw [hproj]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.canonicalTensorComparison_surjective
statement:
theorem canonicalTensorComparison_surjective (z : d.intersection) :
    Function.Surjective (d.canonicalTensorComparison z).hom
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := (pullback.fst d.i d.j).stalkMap_surjective z x
  refine ⟨b ⊗ₜ (1 : d.E.presheaf.stalk (d.rightPoint z)), ?_⟩
  rw [(d.canonicalTensorComparison z).hom_tmul]
  change ((pullback.fst d.i d.j).stalkMap z).hom b *
      ((pullback.snd d.i d.j).stalkMap z).hom
        (1 : d.E.presheaf.stalk (d.rightPoint z)) =
    ((pullback.fst d.i d.j).stalkMap z).hom b
  exact (congrArg (fun q ↦ ((pullback.fst d.i d.j).stalkMap z).hom b * q)
    (map_one ((pullback.snd d.i d.j).stalkMap z).hom)).trans (mul_one _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.ComparisonData.comparisonInjective
statement:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.LocalData.tensor_length_ne_top
statement:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.LocalData.multiplicity_eq_genericMultiplicity
statement:
theorem multiplicity_eq_genericMultiplicity
    (t : d.LocalData z) (hz : z ∈ genericPoints d.intersection)
    (hTor : t.IsTorIndependent) :
    t.multiplicity = (genericMultiplicity z : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  let e₀ := SerreTor.eulerDataOfTorIndependent
    ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z)) (d.leftStalkModule z) (d.rightStalkModule z)
      (t.tensor_length_ne_top hz) hTor
  rw [multiplicity, SerreTor.EulerData.multiplicity_eq
      (A := ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z))) t.euler e₀,
    SerreTor.eulerDataOfTorIndependent_multiplicity]
  have hlength :
      Module.length ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z))
          (↑((d.leftStalkModule z) ⊗ (d.rightStalkModule z)) : Type u) =
        selfLocalLength z := by
    rw [(t.tensorIso.toLinearEquiv).length_eq]
    exact (selfLocalLength_eq_morphismLocalLength_closedImmersion d.toX z).symm
  rw [hlength]
  rfl

    AlgebraicCycle.pushforward d.toX (fundamentalCycle d.intersection)
      (fun _ ↦ (r : ℕ∞)) coheight

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.D7.genericFibreDegreeZero_of_proper
statement:
theorem genericFibreDegreeZero_of_proper {W Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral W] [IsIntegral Y]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian W] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] (h : W ⟶ Y) [IsProper h] [IsDominant h]
    (r : W.functionField) (hr : r ≠ 0) : GenericFibreDegreeZero h r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (SK Y) := inferInstance
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian (GF h) := inferInstance
  have hsq : IsPullback (gF h) (fF h) h (gS Y) := IsPullback.of_hasPullback _ _
  have hgen := gF_genericPoint h
  let r' : (GF h).functionField := (ffIso (gF h) hgen).hom r
  have hr' : r' ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply hr
    exact (ffIso (gF h) hgen).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.injective (by
      rw [map_zero]; exact h0)
  have hdiv : flatPullback (gF h) (div r) = div r' := by
    ext x'
    rw [flatPullback_apply, flatPullbackCoeff_eq_one_of_isIso, Nat.cast_one, mul_one,
      div_eq_ord, div_eq_ord]
    exact (ord_ffIso (gF h) hgen r x').symm
  have key := flatPullback_properPushforward h (gS Y) (fF h) (gF h) hsq (div r)
  rw [hdiv] at key
  have hzero : properPushforward (fF h) (div r') = 0 :=
    principalDegreeVanishes (Y.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint Y)) (GF h) (fF h) r' hr'
  rw [hzero] at key
  have hev := congrArg (fun D : AlgebraicCycle (SK Y) ℤ ↦ D (IsLocalRing.closedPoint
    (Y.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint Y)))) key
  haveI hiso := isIso_stalkMap_of_flat_of_preimmersion (gS Y)
    (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (Y.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint Y)))
  rw [flatPullback_apply, flatPullbackCoeff_eq_one_of_isIso, gS_closedPoint] at hev
  unfold GenericFibreDegreeZero
  rw [Nat.cast_one, mul_one] at hev
  exact hev

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.D7.genericFibreVanishing
statement: theorem genericFibreVanishing (k : Type u) [Field k] : GenericFibreVanishing k
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ h _ _ _ r hr _ ↦ genericFibreDegreeZero_of_proper h r hr

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.properPushforward_mem_dimensionCycles
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  change properPushforward f D y ≠ 0 at hy
  rw [properPushforward_apply] at hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hy
  obtain ⟨rfl, hDx⟩ := (mem_preimageSupportFinite_toFinset_iff f D y x).mp hx
  have hdeg : f.degree x ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hx0
    simp [h]
  change height (f x) = k
  rw [hf x hdeg]
  exact hD hDx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.heightCompatible_comp
statement:
theorem heightCompatible_comp (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (hf : HeightCompatible f)
    (hg : HeightCompatible g) : HeightCompatible (f ≫ g)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [hom_degree_comp] at hx
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, hg (f x) (right_ne_zero_of_mul hx),
    hf x (left_ne_zero_of_mul hx)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion
statement:
theorem height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion (j : X ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion j] (x : X) :
    height (j x) = height x
proof:
:= by
  have hle : ∀ a b : X, j a ≤ j b ↔ a ≤ b := by
    intro a b
    rw [Scheme.le_iff_specializes, Scheme.le_iff_specializes]
    exact j.isClosedEmbedding.isInducing.specializes_iff
  have hmono : StrictMono (fun a : X ↦ j a) := by
    intro a b hab
    exact lt_of_le_not_ge ((hle a b).mpr hab.le) (fun h ↦ hab.not_ge ((hle b a).mp h))
  refine (height_eq_of_strictMono (fun a : X ↦ j a) hmono ?_ x).symm
  intro a b hb
  have hspec : j a ⤳ b := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hb.le
  obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ : b ∈ Set.range j :=
    hspec.mem_closed j.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range ⟨a, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨a', lt_of_le_not_ge ((hle a' a).mp hb.le) (fun h ↦ hb.not_ge ((hle a a').mpr h)), rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.heightCompatible_of_isClosedImmersion
statement:
theorem heightCompatible_of_isClosedImmersion (j : X ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion j] :
    HeightCompatible j
proof:
:=
  fun x _ ↦ height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion j x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.DimRelationGenerator.mem

proof:
:= by

  rw [properPushforward, pushforward_support_closedImmersion g.i (div g.f) (fun _ ↦ ())
    (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl)] at hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hx
  exact g.dimension y (div_support hy)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.trdeg_quotient_lt
statement:
theorem trdeg_quotient_lt {k A : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    {P Q : Ideal A} [hP : P.IsPrime] [hQ : Q.IsPrime] (hPQ : P < Q)
    (hfin : Algebra.trdeg k (A ⧸ P) < ℵ₀) :
    Algebra.trdeg k (A ⧸ Q) < Algebra.trdeg k (A ⧸ P)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ι, xb, hxb⟩ := exists_isTranscendenceBasis' k (A ⧸ Q)
  choose x hx using fun i ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (I := Q) (xb i)
  let y : ι → A ⧸ P := fun i ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mk P (x i)
  have hxbx : xb = fun i ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k Q (x i) := funext fun i ↦ (hx i).symm
  have hyx : y = fun i ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k P (x i) := rfl
  have hQeval : ∀ F : MvPolynomial ι k, MvPolynomial.aeval x F ∈ Q → F = 0 := by
    intro F hF
    apply (algebraicIndependent_iff.mp hxb.1) F
    rw [hxbx, ← MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply, Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk,
      Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    exact hF
  have hPeval : ∀ F : MvPolynomial ι k, MvPolynomial.aeval y F =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk P (MvPolynomial.aeval x F) := by
    intro F
    rw [hyx, ← MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply, Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk]
  have hyind : AlgebraicIndependent k y := by
    refine algebraicIndependent_iff.mpr fun F hF ↦ hQeval F ?_
    rw [hPeval, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem] at hF
    exact hPQ.le hF
  have hle : Algebra.trdeg k (A ⧸ Q) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k (A ⧸ P) := by
    rw [← hxb.cardinalMk_eq_trdeg]
    exact hyind.cardinalMk_le_trdeg
  refine lt_of_le_of_ne hle fun heq ↦ ?_
  have hιfin : #ι < ℵ₀ := by rw [hxb.cardinalMk_eq_trdeg, heq]; exact hfin
  haveI : Finite ι := Cardinal.lt_aleph0_iff_finite.mp hιfin
  have hyb : IsTranscendenceBasis k y :=
    hyind.isTranscendenceBasis_of_trdeg_le_of_finite (by rw [← heq, ← hxb.cardinalMk_eq_trdeg])
  haveI := hyb.isAlgebraic
  obtain ⟨c, hcQ, hcP⟩ := SetLike.exists_of_lt hPQ
  have hc0 : Ideal.Quotient.mk P c ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [Ne, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  have hcmem : Ideal.Quotient.mk P c ∈ Q.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk P) := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hcQ
  have hne := Ideal.comap_ne_bot_of_algebraic_mem hc0 hcmem
    (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic (R := Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range y)) _)
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hz0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hne
  have hzmem : (z : A ⧸ P) ∈ (MvPolynomial.aeval (R := k) y).range := by
    rw [← Algebra.adjoin_range_eq_range_aeval]; exact z.2
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := hzmem
  have hF0 : F ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    apply hz0
    ext
    simpa using hF.symm
  apply hF0
  apply hQeval
  rw [← Ideal.mem_quotient_iff_mem hPQ.le, ← hPeval]
  change MvPolynomial.aeval y F ∈ _
  rw [show (MvPolynomial.aeval y) F = (z : A ⧸ P) from hF]
  exact hz

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ringKrullDim_le_of_isAlgebraic
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_le_of_isAlgebraic (k A B : Type u) [Field k] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [IsDomain A] [IsDomain B] [Algebra k A] [Algebra k B] [Algebra A B] [IsScalarTower k A B]
    [Algebra.FiniteType k B] [FaithfulSMul A B] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic A B] :
    ringKrullDim B ≤ ringKrullDim A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (Algebra.FiniteType.out : (⊤ : Subalgebra k B).FG)
  have hmult : ∀ b : B, ∃ y : A, y ≠ 0 ∧ _root_.IsIntegral A (y • b) := fun b ↦
    (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic (R := A) b).exists_integral_multiple
  choose y hy0 hyint using hmult
  set a : A := ∏ b ∈ s, y b with ha
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun b _ ↦ hy0 b
  set b0 : B := algebraMap A B a with hb0
  have hb00 : b0 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply ha0
    apply FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective A B
    rw [map_zero]
    exact h
  have hbint : _root_.IsIntegral A b0 := isIntegral_algebraMap
  have hgen : ∀ b ∈ s, _root_.IsIntegral A (b0 * b) := by
    intro b hb
    have : b0 * b = (∏ b' ∈ s.erase b, y b') • (y b • b) := by
      rw [smul_smul, Finset.prod_erase_mul s y hb, Algebra.smul_def]
    rw [this, Algebra.smul_def]
    exact isIntegral_algebraMap.mul (hyint b)
  have hall : ∀ c : B, ∃ N : ℕ, _root_.IsIntegral A (b0 ^ N * c) := by
    intro c
    have hc : c ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (s : Set B) := by rw [hs]; trivial
    induction hc using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
    | mem x hx => exact ⟨1, by rw [pow_one]; exact hgen x hx⟩
    | algebraMap r =>
      refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      rw [pow_zero, one_mul, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k A B]
      exact isIntegral_algebraMap
    | add x z _ _ hx hz =>
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hz
      refine ⟨N + M, ?_⟩
      have : b0 ^ (N + M) * (x + z) = b0 ^ M * (b0 ^ N * x) + b0 ^ N * (b0 ^ M * z) := by ring
      rw [this]
      exact ((hbint.pow M).mul hN).add ((hbint.pow N).mul hM)
    | mul x z _ _ hx hz =>
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hz
      refine ⟨N + M, ?_⟩
      have : b0 ^ (N + M) * (x * z) = (b0 ^ N * x) * (b0 ^ M * z) := by ring
      rw [this]
      exact hN.mul hM
  have hpow : Submonoid.powers b0 ≤ nonZeroDivisors B :=
    powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors hb00
  haveI : IsDomain (Localization.Away b0) := IsLocalization.isDomain_localization hpow
  haveI : Algebra.FiniteType B (Localization.Away b0) :=
    haveI := IsLocalization.Away.finitePresentation b0 (S := Localization.Away b0)
    inferInstance
  haveI : Algebra.FiniteType k (Localization.Away b0) :=
    Algebra.FiniteType.trans (S := B) inferInstance inferInstance
  haveI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic B (Localization.Away b0) :=
    IsLocalization.isAlgebraic (Localization.Away b0) (Submonoid.powers b0)
  haveI : FaithfulSMul B (Localization.Away b0) :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective B _).mpr
      (IsLocalization.injective (Localization.Away b0) hpow)
  have hBa : ringKrullDim (Localization.Away b0) = ringKrullDim B := by
    rw [SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.ringKrullDim_eq_toENat_trdeg k (Localization.Away b0),
      SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.ringKrullDim_eq_toENat_trdeg k B,
      SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.trdeg_eq_of_isAlgebraic k B (Localization.Away b0)]
  rw [← hBa]
  let f : PrimeSpectrum (Localization.Away b0) → PrimeSpectrum A := fun Q ↦
    PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A B) (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B _) Q)
  refine Order.krullDim_le_of_strictMono f ?_
  intro Q Q' hQQ'
  have hinj := PrimeSpectrum.localization_comap_injective (Localization.Away b0)
    (Submonoid.powers b0)
  set P := PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B (Localization.Away b0)) Q with hP
  set P' := PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B (Localization.Away b0)) Q' with hP'
  have hle : P.asIdeal ≤ P'.asIdeal := Ideal.comap_mono hQQ'.le
  have hlt : P.asIdeal < P'.asIdeal := by
    refine lt_of_le_of_ne hle fun h ↦ hQQ'.ne (hinj (PrimeSpectrum.ext h))
  have hb0P' : b0 ∉ P'.asIdeal := by
    intro h
    exact Q'.isPrime.ne_top (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ h
      (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit b0))
  obtain ⟨c, hcP', hcP⟩ := SetLike.exists_of_lt hlt
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hall c
  have hxP' : b0 ^ N * c ∈ P'.asIdeal := P'.asIdeal.mul_mem_left _ hcP'
  have hxP : b0 ^ N * c ∉ P.asIdeal := by
    intro h
    rcases P.isPrime.mem_or_mem h with h | h
    · exact hb0P' (hle (P.isPrime.mem_of_pow_mem N h))
    · exact hcP h
  rw [← PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal_lt_asIdeal]
  exact Ideal.comap_lt_comap_of_integral_mem_sdiff hle ⟨hxP', hxP⟩ hN

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.evaluation_eq_zero_iff_mem_primeIdealOf
proof:
:= by
  rw [hU.primeIdealOf_eq_map_closedPoint]
  change _ ↔ X.presheaf.germ U x hx a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _
  rw [← IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.kSec_evaluation
statement:
theorem kSec_evaluation (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] (U : X.Opens)
    (x : X) (hx : x ∈ U) (r : k) :
    X.evaluation U x hx (kSec k X U r) = kRes k X x r
proof:
:= by
  change (X.residue x).hom (X.presheaf.germ U x hx
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op (kΓ k X r))) =
    (X.residue x).hom (X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial (kΓ k X r))
  rw [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.trdeg_quotient_primeIdealOf
statement:
theorem trdeg_quotient_primeIdealOf (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (x : X) (hx : x ∈ U) :
    letI
proof:
:= (kSec k X U).toAlgebra
    Cardinal.toENat (Algebra.trdeg k (Γ(X, U) ⧸ (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩).asIdeal)) =
      τ k X x := by
  letI := (kSec k X U).toAlgebra
  letI := (kRes k X x).toAlgebra
  set p := (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩).asIdeal with hp
  let φ : Γ(X, U) ⧸ p →+* X.residueField x :=
    Ideal.Quotient.lift p (X.evaluation U x hx).hom
      (fun a ha ↦ (evaluation_eq_zero_iff_mem_primeIdealOf X hU x hx a).mpr ha)
  letI : Algebra (Γ(X, U) ⧸ p) (X.residueField x) := φ.toAlgebra
  have hφ : ∀ a : Γ(X, U), φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk p a) = X.evaluation U x hx a := fun a ↦ rfl
  have hφinj : Function.Injective φ := by
    rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, ← evaluation_eq_zero_iff_mem_primeIdealOf X hU x hx a,
      ← hφ]
    exact ha
  haveI : FaithfulSMul (Γ(X, U) ⧸ p) (X.residueField x) :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective _ _).mpr hφinj
  haveI : IsScalarTower k (Γ(X, U) ⧸ p) (X.residueField x) := by
    refine IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun r ↦ ?_
    change kRes k X x r = φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk p (kSec k X U r))
    rw [hφ, kSec_evaluation]
  haveI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (Γ(X, U) ⧸ p) (X.residueField x) := by
    constructor
    intro z
    letI : Algebra Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
      TopCat.Presheaf.algebra_section_stalk X.presheaf ⟨x, hx⟩
    haveI : IsLocalization.AtPrime (X.presheaf.stalk x) p := hU.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hx⟩
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective (R := X.presheaf.stalk x) z
    obtain ⟨⟨a, t⟩, hw⟩ := IsLocalization.surj p.primeCompl w
    have hw' := congrArg (IsLocalRing.residue (X.presheaf.stalk x)) hw
    rw [map_mul] at hw'
    refine ⟨Polynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk p t) * Polynomial.X -
      Polynomial.C (Ideal.Quotient.mk p a), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro h
      have h1 := congrArg (fun q ↦ Polynomial.coeff q 1) h
      simp only [Polynomial.coeff_sub, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X, Polynomial.coeff_C,
        Polynomial.coeff_zero] at h1
      simp only [if_true, one_ne_zero, if_false, sub_zero] at h1
      exact t.2 (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp h1)
    · simp only [map_sub, map_mul, Polynomial.aeval_C, Polynomial.aeval_X]
      change φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk p t) * _ - φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk p a) = 0
      rw [hφ, hφ, sub_eq_zero, mul_comm]
      exact hw'
  change _ = Cardinal.toENat (Algebra.trdeg k (X.residueField x))
  rw [SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.trdeg_eq_of_isAlgebraic k (Γ(X, U) ⧸ p) (X.residueField x)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.finiteType_kSec
statement:
theorem finiteType_kSec (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U) :
    (kSec k X U).FiniteType
proof:
:= by
  have h := (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).finiteType_appLE
    (isAffineOpen_top (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) hU (by simp)
  have hiso : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv.hom.FiniteType :=
    RingHom.FiniteType.of_surjective _
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.symm.surjective
  exact h.comp hiso

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.fromSpec_specializes_iff
statement:
theorem fromSpec_specializes_iff (X : Scheme.{u}) {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (P Q : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, U)) : hU.fromSpec P ⤳ hU.fromSpec Q ↔ P ≤ Q
proof:
:=
  hU.fromSpec.isOpenEmbedding.isInducing.specializes_iff.trans
    (PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes P Q).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.specializes_iff_primeIdealOf_le
statement:
theorem specializes_iff_primeIdealOf_le (X : Scheme.{u}) {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    {a b : X} (ha : a ∈ U) (hb : b ∈ U) :
    a ⤳ b ↔ hU.primeIdealOf ⟨a, ha⟩ ≤ hU.primeIdealOf ⟨b, hb⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [← fromSpec_specializes_iff X hU, hU.fromSpec_primeIdealOf, hU.fromSpec_primeIdealOf]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.strictMono_toDual_fromSpec
statement:
theorem strictMono_toDual_fromSpec (X : Scheme.{u}) {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U) :
    StrictMono (fun P : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, U) ↦ OrderDual.toDual (hU.fromSpec P))
proof:
:= by
  intro P Q hPQ
  change OrderDual.toDual _ < OrderDual.toDual _
  rw [OrderDual.toDual_lt_toDual, lt_iff_le_not_ge, Scheme.le_iff_specializes,
    Scheme.le_iff_specializes, fromSpec_specializes_iff, fromSpec_specializes_iff]
  exact ⟨hPQ.le, hPQ.not_ge⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.coheight_primeIdealOf_le_height
statement:
theorem coheight_primeIdealOf_le_height (X : Scheme.{u}) {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (x : X) (hx : x ∈ U) : Order.coheight (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩) ≤ Order.height x
proof:
:= by
  have := Order.coheight_le_coheight_apply_of_strictMono _ (strictMono_toDual_fromSpec X hU)
    (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩)
  simpa [hU.fromSpec_primeIdealOf] using this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.coheight_eq_height_primeIdealOf
statement:
theorem coheight_eq_height_primeIdealOf (X : Scheme.{u}) {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (x : X) (hx : x ∈ U) : Order.coheight x = Order.height (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩)
proof:
:= by
  have := Order.height_eq_of_strictMono _ (strictMono_toDual_fromSpec X hU) ?_
    (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩)
  · simpa [hU.fromSpec_primeIdealOf] using this.symm
  · intro P b hb
    have hb' : hU.fromSpec P < OrderDual.ofDual b := hb
    have hspec : OrderDual.ofDual b ⤳ hU.fromSpec P := hb'.le
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ : OrderDual.ofDual b ∈ Set.range hU.fromSpec :=
      hspec.mem_open hU.fromSpec.isOpenEmbedding.isOpen_range ⟨P, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨Q, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← hQ, lt_iff_le_not_ge, Scheme.le_iff_specializes, Scheme.le_iff_specializes,
        fromSpec_specializes_iff, fromSpec_specializes_iff] at hb'
      exact lt_of_le_not_ge hb'.1 hb'.2
    · rw [hQ]
      rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.τ_lt_of_lt
statement:
theorem τ_lt_of_lt (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] {x y : X} (hxy : y < x)
    (hfin : τ k X x < ⊤) : τ k X y < τ k X x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hyU, -⟩ := (TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens)
    (show y ∈ (⊤ : X.Opens) from trivial)
  have hspec : x ⤳ y := hxy.le
  have hxU : x ∈ U := hspec.mem_open U.isOpen hyU
  have hlt : (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxU⟩).asIdeal < (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨y, hyU⟩).asIdeal := by
    rw [PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal_lt_asIdeal, lt_iff_le_not_ge,
      ← specializes_iff_primeIdealOf_le X hU, ← specializes_iff_primeIdealOf_le X hU]
    rw [lt_iff_le_not_ge, Scheme.le_iff_specializes, Scheme.le_iff_specializes] at hxy
    exact hxy
  letI := (kSec k X U).toAlgebra
  have hx := trdeg_quotient_primeIdealOf k X hU x hxU
  have hy := trdeg_quotient_primeIdealOf k X hU y hyU
  rw [← hx, ← hy]
  rw [← hx, Cardinal.toENat_lt_top] at hfin
  have := trdeg_quotient_lt (k := k) hlt hfin
  exact Cardinal.toENat_strictMonoOn (Set.mem_Iic.mpr (this.trans hfin).le)
    (Set.mem_Iic.mpr hfin.le) this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.height_le_τ
statement:
theorem height_le_τ (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : X), τ k X x = n → Order.height x ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro x hx
    rw [Order.height_le_coe_iff]
    intro y hy
    have hlt := τ_lt_of_lt k X hy (by rw [hx]; exact ENat.coe_lt_top n)
    rw [hx] at hlt
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m : ℕ, τ k X y = m :=
      ⟨(τ k X y).toNat, (ENat.coe_toNat (ne_top_of_lt hlt)).symm⟩
    rw [hm, Nat.cast_lt] at hlt
    exact (ih m hlt y hm).trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast hlt)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.coheight_primeIdealOf_eq_τ
statement:
theorem coheight_primeIdealOf_eq_τ (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (x : X) (hx : x ∈ U) : Order.coheight (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩) = τ k X x
proof:
:= by
  letI := (kSec k X U).toAlgebra
  haveI : Algebra.FiniteType k Γ(X, U) := finiteType_kSec k X hU
  have h1 := SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.PrimeSpectrum.coheight_eq_ringKrullDim_quotient (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩)
  rw [SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.ringKrullDim_eq_toENat_trdeg k
    (Γ(X, U) ⧸ (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩).asIdeal)] at h1
  rw [← trdeg_quotient_primeIdealOf k X hU x hx]
  exact_mod_cast h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.τ_ne_top
statement:
theorem τ_ne_top (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (x : X) (hx : x ∈ U) : τ k X x ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  letI := (kSec k X U).toAlgebra
  haveI : Algebra.FiniteType k Γ(X, U) := finiteType_kSec k X hU
  rw [← trdeg_quotient_primeIdealOf k X hU x hx]
  exact (Cardinal.toENat_lt_top.mpr (trdeg_lt_aleph0 (R := k))).ne

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.height_eq_coheight_primeIdealOf
statement:
theorem height_eq_coheight_primeIdealOf (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (x : X) (hx : x ∈ U) : Order.height x = Order.coheight (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (coheight_primeIdealOf_le_height X hU x hx)
  rw [coheight_primeIdealOf_eq_τ k X hU x hx]
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp (τ_ne_top k X hU x hx)
  rw [← hn]
  exact height_le_τ k X n x hn.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.heightCompatible_of_finiteType
statement:
theorem heightCompatible_of_finiteType (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] : HeightCompatible f
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have e : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) = X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k) :=
    CategoryTheory.comp_over (f := f) (S := Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
  have hΓ : ∀ r : k, f.appTop.hom (kΓ k Y r) = kΓ k X r := by
    intro r
    change ((Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).appTop ≫ f.appTop).hom _ =
      (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).appTop.hom _
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, e]
  
  have hτ : τ k Y (f x) = τ k X x := by
    letI : Algebra k (Y.residueField (f x)) := (kRes k Y (f x)).toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra k (X.residueField x) := (kRes k X x).toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra (Y.residueField (f x)) (X.residueField x) :=
      (f.residueFieldMap x).hom.toAlgebra
    haveI : Module.Finite (Y.residueField (f x)) (X.residueField x) :=
      Module.finite_of_finrank_pos (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hx)
    haveI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (Y.residueField (f x)) (X.residueField x) :=
      Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_finite _ _
    haveI : IsScalarTower k (Y.residueField (f x)) (X.residueField x) := by
      refine IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun r ↦ ?_
      have h1 := Scheme.Γevaluation_naturality_apply f x (kΓ k Y r)
      change (X.Γevaluation x).hom (kΓ k X r) =
        (f.residueFieldMap x).hom ((Y.Γevaluation (f x)).hom (kΓ k Y r))
      rw [← hΓ r]
      exact h1.symm
    change Cardinal.toENat (Algebra.trdeg k (Y.residueField (f x))) =
      Cardinal.toENat (Algebra.trdeg k (X.residueField x))
    rw [SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.trdeg_eq_of_isAlgebraic k (Y.residueField (f x)) (X.residueField x)]
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, -⟩ := (TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens)
    (show x ∈ (⊤ : X.Opens) from trivial)
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp (τ_ne_top k X hV x hxV)
  have hxh : Order.height x = n := by
    rw [height_eq_coheight_primeIdealOf k X hV x hxV, coheight_primeIdealOf_eq_τ k X hV x hxV, hn]
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [hxh]
    exact height_le_τ k Y n (f x) (hτ.trans hn.symm)
  
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hfxU, -⟩ := (TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp Y.isBasis_affineOpens)
    (show f x ∈ (⊤ : Y.Opens) from trivial)
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, hVU⟩ := (TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens)
    (show x ∈ f ⁻¹ᵁ U from hfxU)
  set q := hU.primeIdealOf ⟨f x, hVU hxV⟩ with hq
  set P := hV.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxV⟩ with hP
  have hcomap' : P.asIdeal.comap (f.appLE U V hVU).hom = q.asIdeal :=
    congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal (IsAffineOpen.comap_primeIdealOf_appLE U hU V hV hVU hxV)
  letI := (kSec k Y U).toAlgebra
  letI := (kSec k X V).toAlgebra
  haveI : Algebra.FiniteType k Γ(X, V) := finiteType_kSec k X hV
  let ψ : Γ(Y, U) ⧸ q.asIdeal →+* Γ(X, V) ⧸ P.asIdeal :=
    Ideal.quotientMap P.asIdeal (f.appLE U V hVU).hom hcomap'.ge
  letI : Algebra (Γ(Y, U) ⧸ q.asIdeal) (Γ(X, V) ⧸ P.asIdeal) := ψ.toAlgebra
  have hψinj : Function.Injective ψ := Ideal.quotientMap_injective' hcomap'.le
  haveI : FaithfulSMul (Γ(Y, U) ⧸ q.asIdeal) (Γ(X, V) ⧸ P.asIdeal) :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective _ _).mpr hψinj
  have happ : ∀ r : k, (f.appLE U V hVU).hom (kSec k Y U r) = kSec k X V r := by
    intro r
    change (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op ≫ f.appLE U V hVU).hom (kΓ k Y r) = _
    rw [Scheme.Hom.map_appLE]
    change (X.presheaf.map _).hom (f.appTop.hom (kΓ k Y r)) = _
    rw [hΓ r]
    rfl
  haveI : IsScalarTower k (Γ(Y, U) ⧸ q.asIdeal) (Γ(X, V) ⧸ P.asIdeal) := by
    refine IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun r ↦ ?_
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk P.asIdeal (kSec k X V r) =
      ψ (Ideal.Quotient.mk q.asIdeal (kSec k Y U r))
    rw [Ideal.quotientMap_mk, happ]
  have hA := trdeg_quotient_primeIdealOf k Y hU (f x) (hVU hxV)
  have hB := trdeg_quotient_primeIdealOf k X hV x hxV
  haveI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (Γ(Y, U) ⧸ q.asIdeal) (Γ(X, V) ⧸ P.asIdeal) := by
    rw [← trdeg_eq_zero_iff, ← Cardinal.toENat_eq_zero]
    have hadd := congrArg Cardinal.toENat
      (trdeg_add_eq k (Γ(Y, U) ⧸ q.asIdeal) (A := Γ(X, V) ⧸ P.asIdeal))
    rw [map_add] at hadd
    rw [← hP] at hB
    rw [hA, hB, hτ, ← hn] at hadd
    generalize Cardinal.toENat (Algebra.trdeg (Γ(Y, U) ⧸ q.asIdeal) (Γ(X, V) ⧸ P.asIdeal)) = t
      at hadd ⊢
    have ht : t ≠ ⊤ := by
      rintro rfl
      simp at hadd
    lift t to ℕ using ht
    norm_cast at hadd ⊢
    omega
  have hdim := ringKrullDim_le_of_isAlgebraic k (Γ(Y, U) ⧸ q.asIdeal) (Γ(X, V) ⧸ P.asIdeal)
  rw [← SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.PrimeSpectrum.coheight_eq_ringKrullDim_quotient,
    ← SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.PrimeSpectrum.coheight_eq_ringKrullDim_quotient] at hdim
  have hdim' : Order.coheight P ≤ Order.coheight q := by exact_mod_cast hdim
  rw [height_eq_coheight_primeIdealOf k X hV x hxV]
  exact hdim'.trans (coheight_primeIdealOf_le_height Y hU (f x) (hVU hxV))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.dimensionCatenary_of_finiteType
statement:
theorem dimensionCatenary_of_finiteType (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] :
    DimensionCatenary X
proof:
:= by
  intro V _ j _ v hv
  rw [height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion j v, height_apply_of_isClosedImmersion j (genericPoint V)]
  letI : V.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := ⟨j ≫ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))⟩
  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (V ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType (j ≫ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))))
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hvU, -⟩ := (TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp V.isBasis_affineOpens)
    (show v ∈ (⊤ : V.Opens) from trivial)
  have hηU : genericPoint V ∈ U := (genericPoint_specializes v).mem_open U.isOpen hvU
  haveI : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨v, hvU⟩⟩
  rw [height_eq_coheight_primeIdealOf k V hU v hvU, height_eq_coheight_primeIdealOf k V hU _ hηU]
  have hη : hU.primeIdealOf ⟨genericPoint V, hηU⟩ = ⊥ := by
    rw [hU.primeIdealOf_genericPoint, genericPoint_eq_bot_of_affine]
  rw [hη]
  have hht : (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨v, hvU⟩).asIdeal.height = 1 := by
    rw [PrimeSpectrum.height_eq_orderHeight, ← coheight_eq_height_primeIdealOf V hU v hvU, hv]
  letI := (kSec k V U).toAlgebra
  haveI : Algebra.FiniteType k Γ(V, U) := finiteType_kSec k V hU
  have hdf := SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.ringKrullDim_quotient_add_height k Γ(V, U)
    (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨v, hvU⟩).asIdeal
  rw [hht, ← SchemeNormalCone.Algebra.PrimeSpectrum.coheight_eq_ringKrullDim_quotient] at hdf
  apply WithBot.coe_injective
  rw [Order.coheight_bot_eq_krullDim, WithBot.coe_add]
  exact hdf

name: Ring.ord_map_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem ord_map_ringEquiv (e : R ≃+* S) (x : R) :
    Ring.ord S (e x) = Ring.ord R x
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra R S := e.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let eAlg : R ≃ₐ[R] S := AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := e) (fun _ ↦ rfl)
  have hspan : Ideal.span {e x} = (Ideal.span {x}).map e.toRingHom := by
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
    rfl
  let eQuot : (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) ≃ₐ[R] (S ⧸ Ideal.span {e x}) :=
    Ideal.quotientEquivAlg (Ideal.span {x}) (Ideal.span {e x}) eAlg hspan
  calc
    Ring.ord S (e x) = Module.length S (S ⧸ Ideal.span {e x}) := rfl
    _ = Module.length R (S ⧸ Ideal.span {e x}) :=
      (Module.length_eq_of_surjective (M := S ⧸ Ideal.span {e x})
        e.surjective).symm
    _ = Module.length R (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      eQuot.toLinearEquiv.length_eq.symm
    _ = Ring.ord R x := rfl

name: Ring.addVal_map_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem addVal_map_ringEquiv (e : R ≃+* S) (x : R) :
    IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal S (e x) = IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal R x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · subst x
    simp [IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal_zero]
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible R
  obtain ⟨n, u, rfl⟩ :=
    IsDiscreteValuationRing.eq_unit_mul_pow_irreducible hx hπ
  rw [map_mul, map_pow,
    IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal_def' u hπ n]
  exact IsDiscreteValuationRing.addVal_def'
    (Units.map e.toMonoidHom u) (hπ.map e.toMulEquiv) n

name: Ring.ord_map_ringEquiv_of_dvr
statement:
theorem ord_map_ringEquiv_of_dvr (e : R ≃+* S) (x : R) :
    Ring.ord S (e x) = Ring.ord R x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ring.ord_eq_addVal, Ring.ord_eq_addVal, addVal_map_ringEquiv]

name: Ring.ordMonoidWithZeroHom_map_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem ordMonoidWithZeroHom_map_ringEquiv (e : R ≃+* S) (x : R) :
    Ring.ordMonoidWithZeroHom S (e x) = Ring.ordMonoidWithZeroHom R x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · subst x
    simp
  rw [Ring.ordMonoidWithZeroHom_eq_ord
      (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr (e.map_ne_zero_iff.mpr hx)),
    Ring.ordMonoidWithZeroHom_eq_ord
      (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hx),
    ord_map_ringEquiv]

name: Ring.ordFrac_map_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem ordFrac_map_ringEquiv
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing S]
    [Ring.KrullDimLE 1 R] [Ring.KrullDimLE 1 S]
    [Algebra R K] [Algebra S L]
    [IsFractionRing R K] [IsFractionRing S L]
    (eR : R ≃+* S) (eK : K ≃+* L)
    (hcompat : ∀ r : R,
      eK (algebraMap R K r) = algebraMap S L (eR r))
    (x : K) :
    Ring.ordFrac S (eK x) = Ring.ordFrac R x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, hb, rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective (A := R) x
  by_cases ha : a = 0
  · subst a
    simp
  simp only [map_div₀, hcompat]
  rw [Ring.ordFrac_eq_ord S (eR.map_ne_zero_iff.mpr ha),
    Ring.ordFrac_eq_ord R ha,
    Ring.ordFrac_eq_ord S (eR.map_ne_zero_iff.mpr
      (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mp hb)),
    Ring.ordFrac_eq_ord R (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mp hb),
    ordMonoidWithZeroHom_map_ringEquiv,
    ordMonoidWithZeroHom_map_ringEquiv]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.functionFieldIsoOfIso_algebraMap
statement:
theorem functionFieldIsoOfIso_algebraMap (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso f]
    (x : X) (r : Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) :
    (functionFieldIsoOfIso f).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
        (algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) Y.functionField r) =
      algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField
        ((asIso (f.stalkMap x)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv r)
proof:
:= by
  let hX : genericPoint X ⤳ x := (genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial
  let hY : genericPoint Y ⤳ f x := (genericPoint_spec Y).specializes trivial
  let hη : f (genericPoint X) ⤳ genericPoint Y :=
    specializes_of_eq (genericPoint_eq_of_isOpenImmersion f)
  have htransport :
      (Y.presheaf.stalkCongr
          (.of_eq (genericPoint_eq_of_isOpenImmersion f).symm)).hom
          (Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes hY r) =
        Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (hX.map f.continuous) r := by
    change (Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes hη)
        (Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes hY r) =
      Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (hX.map f.continuous) r
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply,
      TopCat.Presheaf.stalkSpecializes_comp]
  change (f.stalkMap (genericPoint X)).hom
      ((Y.presheaf.stalkCongr
          (.of_eq (genericPoint_eq_of_isOpenImmersion f).symm)).hom
        (Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes hY r)) =
    X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes hX ((f.stalkMap x).hom r)
  rw [htransport]
  exact f.stalkSpecializes_stalkMap_apply (genericPoint X) x hX r

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ord_functionFieldIsoOfIso
statement:
theorem ord_functionFieldIsoOfIso (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso f]
    (q : Y.functionField) (x : X) :
    X.ord ((functionFieldIsoOfIso f).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv q) x =
      Y.ord q (f x)
proof:
:= by
  have hcoheight : coheight (f x) = coheight x :=
    Topology.IsOpenEmbedding.coheight_eq f f.isOpenEmbedding
  by_cases hx : coheight x = 1
  · have hy : coheight (f x) = 1 := hcoheight.trans hx
    rw [ord_eq_ordHom_of_coheight_eq_one hx,
      ord_eq_ordHom_of_coheight_eq_one hy]
    letI : Ring.KrullDimLE 1 (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
      krullDimLE_of_coheight hx
    letI : Ring.KrullDimLE 1 (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) :=
      krullDimLE_of_coheight hy
    have hord :
        Ring.ordFrac (X.presheaf.stalk x)
            ((functionFieldIsoOfIso f).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv q) =
          Ring.ordFrac (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) q :=
      Ring.ordFrac_map_ringEquiv
        (asIso (f.stalkMap x)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
        (functionFieldIsoOfIso f).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
        (functionFieldIsoOfIso_algebraMap f x) q
    exact congrArg (fun a ↦
      Multiplicative.toAdd (WithZero.recZeroCoe 1 id a)) hord
  · have hy : coheight (f x) ≠ 1 := by
      rwa [hcoheight]
    rw [ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hx,
      ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hy]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.compactCodimCycleFinsupp_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem compactCodimCycleFinsupp_apply {X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] (p : ℕ)
    (D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ p) (x : CodimensionPoint X p) :
    compactCodimCycleFinsupp p D x = D.1 x.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [compactCodimCycleFinsupp, Finsupp.subtypeDomain_apply, compactCycleFinsupp_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.codimPointFinsuppToCycleAddHom_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem codimPointFinsuppToCycleAddHom_single {X : Scheme.{u}} (p : ℕ)
    (x : CodimensionPoint X p) (n : ℤ) :
    codimPointFinsuppToCycleAddHom p (Finsupp.single x n) =
      n • primeCycle x.1 p x.2
proof:
:= by
  simp [codimPointFinsuppToCycleAddHom, intSmulHom]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.codimPointFinsuppToCycleAddHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem codimPointFinsuppToCycleAddHom_apply {X : Scheme.{u}} (p : ℕ)
    (f : CodimensionPoint X p →₀ ℤ) (x : CodimensionPoint X p) :
    (codimPointFinsuppToCycleAddHom p f).1 x.1 = f x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction f using Finsupp.induction with
  | zero => simp
  | single_add a b f ha hb ih =>
      rw [map_add, AddSubgroup.coe_add, Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_add,
        Pi.add_apply, ih, codimPointFinsuppToCycleAddHom_single]
      by_cases h : a = x
      · subst a
        simp
      · have hval : x.1 ≠ a.1 := fun hax ↦ h (Subtype.ext hax.symm)
        change b • (primeCycle a.1 p a.2).1 x.1 + f x =
          (Finsupp.single a b) x + f x
        rw [primeCycle_apply_of_ne a.1 x.1 p a.2 hval]
        simp [h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProperIntersectionKernel.finsuppPairing_apply
statement:
theorem finsuppPairing_apply (D : CodimensionPoint X p →₀ ℤ)
    (E : CodimensionPoint X q →₀ ℤ) :
    K.finsuppPairing D E =
      D.sum fun x a ↦ E.sum fun y b ↦ (a * b) • (K.pair x y).cycle
proof:
:= by
  simp [finsuppPairing, coefficientHom, zsmulAddHom, smul_smul, mul_comm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProperIntersectionKernel.finsupp_sum_eq_support_sum
statement:
private theorem finsupp_sum_eq_support_sum {A M N : Type*} [Zero M] [AddCommMonoid N]
    (f : A →₀ M) (g : A → M → N) :
    f.sum g = ∑ x : f.support, g x.1 (f x.1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Finsupp.sum, Finset.sum_coe_sort_eq_attach]
  exact (Finset.sum_attach f.support (fun a ↦ g a (f a))).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProperIntersectionKernel.codim_of_mem_cycle_support
proof:
:= by
  apply D.2
  change D.1 x.1 ≠ 0
  simpa only [compactCycleFinsupp_apply] using Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp x.2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProperIntersectionKernel.pairing_eq_cycleData
statement:
theorem pairing_eq_cycleData (D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ p)
    (E : CodimensionCycles X ℤ q) :
    K.pairing D E = (K.cycleData D E).cycle
proof:
:= by
  change K.finsuppPairing (compactCodimCycleFinsupp p D)
    (compactCodimCycleFinsupp q E) = (K.cycleData D E).cycle
  rw [finsuppPairing_apply]
  simp only [cycleData, ProperCycleIntersectionData.cycle]
  rw [finsupp_sum_eq_support_sum]
  symm
  apply Fintype.sum_equiv (supportEquiv D) _ _
  intro x
  rw [finsupp_sum_eq_support_sum]
  apply Fintype.sum_equiv (supportEquiv E) _ _
  intro y
  simp [supportEquiv]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProperIntersectionKernel.pairing_eq_properCycleIntersectionData
statement:
theorem pairing_eq_properCycleIntersectionData
    {D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ p} {E : CodimensionCycles X ℤ q}
    (d : ProperCycleIntersectionData X p q D E) :
    K.pairing D E = d.cycle
proof:
:= by
  rw [K.pairing_eq_cycleData D E]
  exact ProperCycleIntersectionData.cycle_eq _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProperIntersectionKernel.compactCodimCycleFinsupp_primeCycle
statement:
theorem compactCodimCycleFinsupp_primeCycle
    (x : CodimensionPoint X p) :
    compactCodimCycleFinsupp p (primeCycle x.1 p x.2) = Finsupp.single x 1
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  by_cases h : z = x
  · subst z
    simp
  · have hzx : z.1 ≠ x.1 := fun hval ↦ h (Subtype.ext hval)
    rw [compactCodimCycleFinsupp_apply, primeCycle_apply_of_ne x.1 z.1 p x.2 hzx]
    simp [h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProperIntersectionKernel.pairing_apply_primeCycle
statement:
theorem pairing_apply_primeCycle (D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ p)
    (y : CodimensionPoint X q) :
    K.pairing D (primeCycle y.1 q y.2) =
      (compactCodimCycleFinsupp p D).sum fun x a ↦
        a • (K.pair x y).cycle
proof:
:= by
  change K.finsuppPairing (compactCodimCycleFinsupp p D)
    (compactCodimCycleFinsupp q (primeCycle y.1 q y.2)) = _
  rw [compactCodimCycleFinsupp_primeCycle, finsuppPairing_apply]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProperIntersectionKernel.pairing_primeCycle_apply
statement:
theorem pairing_primeCycle_apply (x : CodimensionPoint X p)
    (E : CodimensionCycles X ℤ q) :
    K.pairing (primeCycle x.1 p x.2) E =
      (compactCodimCycleFinsupp q E).sum fun y b ↦
        b • (K.pair x y).cycle
proof:
:= by
  change K.finsuppPairing
    (compactCodimCycleFinsupp p (primeCycle x.1 p x.2))
    (compactCodimCycleFinsupp q E) = _
  rw [compactCodimCycleFinsupp_primeCycle, finsuppPairing_apply]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProperIntersectionKernel.pairing_primeCycle
statement:
theorem pairing_primeCycle (x : CodimensionPoint X p) (y : CodimensionPoint X q) :
    K.pairing (primeCycle x.1 p x.2) (primeCycle y.1 q y.2) =
      (K.pair x y).cycle
proof:
:= by
  change K.finsuppPairing
    (compactCodimCycleFinsupp p (primeCycle x.1 p x.2))
    (compactCodimCycleFinsupp q (primeCycle y.1 q y.2)) = (K.pair x y).cycle
  rw [compactCodimCycleFinsupp_primeCycle,
    compactCodimCycleFinsupp_primeCycle]
  simp [finsuppPairing, coefficientHom, zsmulAddHom]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProperIntersectionKernel.relation_left_of_primeCycles
statement:
theorem relation_left_of_primeCycles
    (h : ∀ (g : RationalRelationGenerator X p) (y : CodimensionPoint X q),
      K.pairing g.cycle (primeCycle y.1 q y.2) ∈
        rationalEquivalenceSubgroup X (p + q)) :
    ∀ (g : RationalRelationGenerator X p) (E : CodimensionCycles X ℤ q),
      K.pairing g.cycle E ∈ rationalEquivalenceSubgroup X (p + q)
proof:
:= by
  intro g E
  rw [← (compactCodimCycleEquivFinsupp q).left_inv E]
  let f := compactCodimCycleFinsupp q E
  change K.pairing g.cycle (codimPointFinsuppToCycleAddHom q f) ∈
    rationalEquivalenceSubgroup X (p + q)
  induction f using Finsupp.induction with
  | zero => simp
  | single_add y n f hy hn ih =>
      rw [map_add, codimPointFinsuppToCycleAddHom_single, map_add, map_zsmul]
      exact AddSubgroup.add_mem _ (AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem _ (h g y) n) ih

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProperIntersectionKernel.relation_right_of_primeCycles
statement:
theorem relation_right_of_primeCycles
    (h : ∀ (x : CodimensionPoint X p) (g : RationalRelationGenerator X q),
      K.pairing (primeCycle x.1 p x.2) g.cycle ∈
        rationalEquivalenceSubgroup X (p + q)) :
    ∀ (D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ p) (g : RationalRelationGenerator X q),
      K.pairing D g.cycle ∈ rationalEquivalenceSubgroup X (p + q)
proof:
:= by
  intro D g
  rw [← (compactCodimCycleEquivFinsupp p).left_inv D]
  let f := compactCodimCycleFinsupp p D
  change K.pairing (codimPointFinsuppToCycleAddHom p f) g.cycle ∈
    rationalEquivalenceSubgroup X (p + q)
  induction f using Finsupp.induction with
  | zero => simp
  | single_add x n f hx hn ih =>
      rw [map_add, codimPointFinsuppToCycleAddHom_single, map_add, map_zsmul]
      exact AddSubgroup.add_mem _ (AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem _ (h x g) n) ih

name: IsRegularLocalRing.coe_embeddingDimension_eq_ringKrullDim

name: IsRegularLocalRing.exists_systemOfParameters

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.isWeaklyRegular_of_ker_stalkMap_eq_ofList_of_isCohenMacaulay
statement:
theorem isWeaklyRegular_of_ker_stalkMap_eq_ofList_of_isCohenMacaulay
    (z : d.intersection) (hz : z ∈ genericPoints d.intersection)
    [ModuleCat.IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z))]
    (rs : List (X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z)))
    (hker : RingHom.ker (d.toX.stalkMap z).hom = Ideal.ofList rs)
    (hlen : rs.length = r) :
    IsWeaklyRegular (X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z)) rs
proof:
:= by
  let e :
      (↑(X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z)) ⧸ Ideal.ofList rs) ≃+*
        ↑(d.intersection.presheaf.stalk z) :=
    (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hker.symm).trans
      (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective (d.toX.stalkMap_surjective z))
  have hquot :
      ringKrullDim (↑(X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z)) ⧸ Ideal.ofList rs) = 0 := by
    rw [ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv e, ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight,
      coheight_eq_zero_of_mem_genericPoints hz]
    simp
  have hco : coheight (d.toX z) = (r : ℕ∞) := d.codimension z hz
  have hamb : ringKrullDim ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z)) =
      ((r : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    rw [ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight, hco]
  letI : FiniteRingKrullDim ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z)) := by
    rw [finiteRingKrullDim_iff_ne_bot_and_top, hamb]
    refine ⟨(WithBot.bot_lt_coe (r : ℕ∞)).ne', ?_⟩
    intro h
    have h' : (r : ℕ∞) = ⊤ := by
      apply WithBot.coe_eq_coe.mp
      simpa only [WithBot.coe_top] using h
    exact ENat.coe_ne_top r h'
  apply ModuleCat.IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.isWeaklyRegular_of_ringKrullDim_add_length
  rw [hquot, hlen, hamb]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.isWeaklyRegular_of_ker_stalkMap_eq_ofList_of_regularLocalDomain_le_two
statement:
theorem isWeaklyRegular_of_ker_stalkMap_eq_ofList_of_regularLocalDomain_le_two
    (z : d.intersection) (hz : z ∈ genericPoints d.intersection)
    [IsRegularLocalRing ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z))]
    [IsDomain ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z))]
    (hr : r ≤ 2)
    (rs : List (X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z)))
    (hker : RingHom.ker (d.toX.stalkMap z).hom = Ideal.ofList rs)
    (hlen : rs.length = r) :
    IsWeaklyRegular (X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z)) rs
proof:
:= by
  letI : DecidableEq ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z)) := Classical.decEq _
  have hco : coheight (d.toX z) = (r : ℕ∞) := d.codimension z hz
  have hamb : ringKrullDim ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z)) =
      ((r : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    rw [ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight, hco]
  have hemb : IsRegularLocalRing.embeddingDimension
      ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z)) ≤ 2 := by
    have hle :
        ((IsRegularLocalRing.embeddingDimension
          ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z)) : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤
          ((r : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
      rw [IsRegularLocalRing.coe_embeddingDimension_eq_ringKrullDim, hamb]
    have hleNat : IsRegularLocalRing.embeddingDimension
        ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z)) ≤ r := by
      exact_mod_cast hle
    exact hleNat.trans hr
  letI : ModuleCat.IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z)) :=
    ModuleCat.IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.of_isRegularLocalRing_of_isDomain_of_embeddingDimension_le_two
      hemb
  exact d.isWeaklyRegular_of_ker_stalkMap_eq_ofList_of_isCohenMacaulay z hz rs hker hlen

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.hyperplanePoint_asIdeal
proof:
:=
  asHomogeneousIdeal_hyperplaneι_genericHyperplanePoint k n s hs hn

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coheight_hyperplanePoint
statement:
theorem coheight_hyperplanePoint (s : grading k n 1) (hs : s ≠ 0) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    coheight (hyperplanePoint k n s hs hn) = 1
proof:
:=
  coheight_hyperplaneι_eq_one k n s hs _
    (genericHyperplanePoint_mem_genericPoints k n s hs hn)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.eq_hyperplanePoint_of_mem
statement:
theorem eq_hyperplanePoint_of_mem (s : grading k n 1) (hs : s ≠ 0) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (x : space k n) (hsx : (s : Polynomial k n) ∈ x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal)
    (hx : coheight x = 1) :
    x = hyperplanePoint k n s hs hn
proof:
:= by
  set h := hyperplanePoint k n s hs hn with hh
  have hspec : h ⤳ x := by
    rw [specializes_iff_mem_closure]
    refine (ProjectiveSpectrum.le_iff_mem_closure _ h x).mp ?_
    change h.asHomogeneousIdeal ≤ x.asHomogeneousIdeal
    intro f hf
    have hf' : f ∈ h.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal := hf
    rw [hh, hyperplanePoint_asIdeal, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hf'
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hf'
    exact x.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal.mul_mem_left c hsx
  have hxle : x ≤ h := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr hspec
  by_contra hne
  have hlt : x < h := lt_of_le_not_ge hxle fun hge ↦ hne
    (((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hge).antisymm hspec).eq)
  have hcodim := Order.coheight_add_one_le hlt
  rw [coheight_hyperplanePoint, hx] at hcodim
  norm_num at hcodim

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.genericMultiplicity_genericHyperplanePoint
statement:
theorem genericMultiplicity_genericHyperplanePoint (s : grading k n 1) (hs : s ≠ 0)
    (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    genericMultiplicity (genericHyperplanePoint k n s hs hn) = 1
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isIntegral_hyperplane k n s hs hn
  have hg := genericHyperplanePoint_mem_genericPoints k n s hs hn
  letI : Ring.KrullDimLE 0
      ((hyperplane k n s).presheaf.stalk (genericHyperplanePoint k n s hs hn)) :=
    krullDimLE_of_coheight (coheight_eq_zero_of_mem_genericPoints hg)
  have hF : IsField
      ((hyperplane k n s).presheaf.stalk (genericHyperplanePoint k n s hs hn)) :=
    Ring.KrullDimLE.isField_of_isDomain
  letI := hF.toField
  unfold genericMultiplicity selfLocalLength
  rw [Module.length_eq_one]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.hyperplaneCycle_eq_primeCycle
statement:
theorem hyperplaneCycle_eq_primeCycle (s : grading k n 1) (hs : s ≠ 0) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    hyperplaneCycle k n s hs =
      primeCycle (hyperplanePoint k n s hs hn) 1 (coheight_hyperplanePoint k n s hs hn)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext x
  by_cases hxh : x = hyperplanePoint k n s hs hn
  · subst hxh
    rw [primeCycle_apply_same]
    rw [hyperplanePoint, hyperplaneCycle_apply_hyperplaneι k n s hs _
      (coheight_hyperplanePoint k n s hs hn),
      genericMultiplicity_genericHyperplanePoint]
    rfl
  · rw [primeCycle_apply_of_ne _ _ _ _ hxh]
    by_cases hx1 : coheight x = 1
    · have hrange : x ∉ Set.range (hyperplaneι k n s) := by
        intro hr
        exact hxh (eq_hyperplanePoint_of_mem k n s hs hn x
          ((mem_range_hyperplaneι_iff k n s x).mp hr) hx1)
      change (AlgebraicCycle.pushforward (hyperplaneι k n s)
        (fundamentalCycle (hyperplane k n s)) (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℕ∞)) coheight) x = 0
      exact AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_eq_zero_of_not_mem_range
        (hyperplaneι k n s) (fundamentalCycle (hyperplane k n s))
        (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℕ∞)) coheight x hrange
    · by_contra h
      exact hx1 ((hyperplaneCycle k n s hs).2 h)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.primeCycle_congr
statement:
theorem primeCycle_congr {X : Scheme.{u}} {x y : X} (h : x = y) (p : ℕ)
    (hx : coheight x = p) (hy : coheight y = p) :
    primeCycle x p hx = primeCycle y p hy
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.firstChart_isAffine

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coheight_firstChart

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.germToFunctionField_eq_algebraMap_firstChart
statement:
theorem germToFunctionField_eq_algebraMap_firstChart (y : coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n))
    (a : Γ(space k n, coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n))) :
    (space k n).germToFunctionField (coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n)) a =
      algebraMap ((space k n).presheaf.stalk (y : space k n)) (space k n).functionField
        (algebraMap Γ(space k n, coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n))
          ((space k n).presheaf.stalk (y : space k n)) a)
proof:
:=
  (Scheme.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField y.2 a).symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.ord_germ_firstChart_eq_zero
statement:
theorem ord_germ_firstChart_eq_zero (y : coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n))
    (hy : coheight (y : space k n) = 1)
    (a : Γ(space k n, coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n)))
    (ha : a ∉ ((firstChart_isAffine k n).primeIdealOf y).asIdeal) :
    (space k n).ord ((space k n).germToFunctionField (coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n)) a)
      (y : space k n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI := (firstChart_isAffine k n).isLocalization_stalk y
  rw [germToFunctionField_eq_algebraMap_firstChart k n y]
  apply Scheme.ord_algebraMap_eq_zero_of_isUnit hy
  exact (IsLocalization.AtPrime.isUnit_to_map_iff _ _ a).mpr ha

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.one_le_ord_germ_firstChart
statement:
theorem one_le_ord_germ_firstChart (y : coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n))
    (hy : coheight (y : space k n) = 1)
    (a : Γ(space k n, coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n))) (ha0 : a ≠ 0)
    (ha : a ∈ ((firstChart_isAffine k n).primeIdealOf y).asIdeal) :
    1 ≤ (space k n).ord ((space k n).germToFunctionField (coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n)) a)
      (y : space k n)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := (firstChart_isAffine k n).isLocalization_stalk y
  rw [germToFunctionField_eq_algebraMap_firstChart k n y]
  have hinj := IsLocalization.injective ((space k n).presheaf.stalk (y : space k n))
    (Ideal.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors ((firstChart_isAffine k n).primeIdealOf y).asIdeal)
  apply Scheme.one_le_ord_algebraMap_of_not_isUnit hy
  · exact (map_ne_zero_iff _ hinj).mpr ha0
  · rw [IsLocalization.AtPrime.isUnit_to_map_iff _
      ((firstChart_isAffine k n).primeIdealOf y).asIdeal a]
    exact fun h ↦ h ha

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.ord_germ_firstChart_eq_one
statement:
theorem ord_germ_firstChart_eq_one (y : coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n))
    (hy : coheight (y : space k n) = 1)
    (π : Γ(space k n, coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n)))
    (hπ : ((firstChart_isAffine k n).primeIdealOf y).asIdeal = Ideal.span {π}) :
    (space k n).ord ((space k n).germToFunctionField (coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n)) π)
      (y : space k n) = 1
proof:
:= by
  haveI := (firstChart_isAffine k n).isLocalization_stalk y
  have hP : ((firstChart_isAffine k n).primeIdealOf y).asIdeal.height = 1 := by
    rw [← coheight_firstChart, hy]
  have hπ0 : π ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact Ideal.ne_bot_of_height_eq_one hP (by rw [hπ, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot])
  rw [germToFunctionField_eq_algebraMap_firstChart k n y]
  have hinj := IsLocalization.injective ((space k n).presheaf.stalk (y : space k n))
    (Ideal.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors ((firstChart_isAffine k n).primeIdealOf y).asIdeal)
  apply Scheme.ord_algebraMap_eq_one_of_span_eq_maximalIdeal hy
  · exact (map_ne_zero_iff _ hinj).mpr hπ0
  · rw [← IsLocalization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal
      ((firstChart_isAffine k n).primeIdealOf y).asIdeal, hπ, Ideal.map_span,
      Set.image_singleton]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.exists_prime_generator_firstChart
statement:
theorem exists_prime_generator_firstChart (y : coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n))
    (hy : coheight (y : space k n) = 1) :
    ∃ π : Γ(space k n, coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n)), Prime π ∧
      ((firstChart_isAffine k n).primeIdealOf y).asIdeal = Ideal.span {π}
proof:
:= by
  have hP : ((firstChart_isAffine k n).primeIdealOf y).asIdeal.height = 1 := by
    rw [← coheight_firstChart, hy]
  obtain ⟨π, hπmem, hπ⟩ := Ideal.IsPrime.exists_mem_prime_of_ne_bot inferInstance
    (Ideal.ne_bot_of_height_eq_one hP)
  exact ⟨π, hπ, Ideal.eq_span_singleton_of_height_eq_one hP hπmem hπ⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coheight_infinityPoint

:=
  coheight_hyperplanePoint k n _ _ hn

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.infinityPoint_not_mem_firstChart
statement:
theorem infinityPoint_not_mem_firstChart (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    infinityPoint k hn ∉ coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h' : coordinate k n (firstIndex n) ∉ (infinityPoint k hn).asHomogeneousIdeal := h
  apply h'
  change coordinate k n (firstIndex n) ∈ (infinityPoint k hn).asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal
  rw [infinityPoint, hyperplanePoint_asIdeal]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.mem_firstChart_of_ne_infinityPoint

theorem mem_firstChart_of_ne_infinityPoint (hn : 1 ≤ n) (x : space k n)
    (hx : coheight x = 1) (hne : x ≠ infinityPoint k hn) :
    x ∈ coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n)

:= by
  by_contra hxU
  apply hne
  apply eq_hyperplanePoint_of_mem k n _ _ hn x _ hx

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.hyperplaneClass_eq_primeCycle
statement:
theorem hyperplaneClass_eq_primeCycle (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    hyperplaneClass k n = gradedClassOf (space k n) 1
      (primeCycle (infinityPoint k hn) 1 (coheight_infinityPoint k hn))
proof:
:= by
  rw [hyperplaneClass, hyperplaneCycle_eq_primeCycle k n _ _ hn]
