name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.principalWeilDivisor_chartGenerator
statement:
theorem principalWeilDivisor_chartGenerator (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (y : coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n)) (hy : coheight (y : space k n) = 1)
    (π : Γ(space k n, coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n)))
    (hπ : ((firstChart_isAffine k n).primeIdealOf y).asIdeal = Ideal.span {π}) :
    (principalWeilDivisor (space k n)
        ((space k n).germToFunctionField (coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n)) π) :
          CodimensionCycles (space k n) ℤ 1) =
      primeCycle (y : space k n) 1 hy +
        (space k n).ord ((space k n).germToFunctionField (coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n)) π)
            (infinityPoint k hn) •
          primeCycle (infinityPoint k hn) 1 (coheight_infinityPoint k hn)
proof:
:= by
  have hyi : (y : space k n) ≠ infinityPoint k hn := fun h ↦
    infinityPoint_not_mem_firstChart k hn (h ▸ y.2)
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext z
  simp only [AddSubgroup.coe_add, AddSubgroupClass.coe_zsmul,
    Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_add, Function.locallyFinsuppWithin.coe_zsmul,
    Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  change (space k n).ord _ z = _
  by_cases hz1 : coheight z = 1
  · by_cases hzy : z = y
    · rw [hzy, primeCycle_apply_same, primeCycle_apply_of_ne _ _ _ _ hyi,
        ord_germ_firstChart_eq_one k n y hy π hπ]
      simp
    · by_cases hzi : z = infinityPoint k hn
      · rw [hzi, primeCycle_apply_same, primeCycle_apply_of_ne _ _ _ _ (Ne.symm hyi)]
        simp
      · rw [primeCycle_apply_of_ne _ _ _ _ hzy, primeCycle_apply_of_ne _ _ _ _ hzi]
        simp only [mul_zero, add_zero]
        have hzU := mem_firstChart_of_ne_infinityPoint k hn z hz1 hzi
        let z' : coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n) := ⟨z, hzU⟩
        apply ord_germ_firstChart_eq_zero k n z' hz1
        intro hπz
        apply hzy
        have hPy : ((firstChart_isAffine k n).primeIdealOf y).asIdeal.height = 1 := by
          rw [← coheight_firstChart, hy]
        have hPz : ((firstChart_isAffine k n).primeIdealOf z').asIdeal.height = 1 := by
          rw [← coheight_firstChart]
          exact hz1
        have hle : ((firstChart_isAffine k n).primeIdealOf y).asIdeal ≤
            ((firstChart_isAffine k n).primeIdealOf z').asIdeal := by
          rw [hπ, Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
          exact hπz
        have heq : ((firstChart_isAffine k n).primeIdealOf y).asIdeal =
            ((firstChart_isAffine k n).primeIdealOf z').asIdeal := by
          by_contra hne
          have hlt := lt_of_le_of_ne hle hne
          haveI : ((firstChart_isAffine k n).primeIdealOf z').asIdeal.FiniteHeight := by
            exact ⟨Or.inr (by rw [hPz]; exact ENat.one_ne_top)⟩
          have hh := Ideal.height_strict_mono_of_isPrime_of_isPrime hlt
          rw [hPy, hPz] at hh
          exact lt_irrefl _ hh
        have hpt := congrArg (firstChart_isAffine k n).fromSpec (PrimeSpectrum.ext heq)
        rw [(firstChart_isAffine k n).fromSpec_primeIdealOf,
          (firstChart_isAffine k n).fromSpec_primeIdealOf] at hpt
        exact hpt.symm
  · have hzy : z ≠ y := fun h ↦ hz1 (h ▸ hy)
    have hzi : z ≠ infinityPoint k hn := fun h ↦ hz1 (h ▸ coheight_infinityPoint k hn)
    rw [Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hz1, primeCycle_apply_of_ne _ _ _ _ hzy,
      primeCycle_apply_of_ne _ _ _ _ hzi]
    simp

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.gradedClassOf_zsmul
statement:
theorem gradedClassOf_zsmul {X : Scheme.{u}} (p : ℕ) (m : ℤ) (D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ p) :
    gradedClassOf X p (m • D) = m • gradedClassOf X p D
proof:
:=
  map_zsmul (gradedClassMap X p) m D

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.gradedClassOf_primeCycle_mem_zmultiples
statement:
theorem gradedClassOf_primeCycle_mem_zmultiples (hn : 1 ≤ n) (x : space k n)
    (hx : coheight x = 1) :
    gradedClassOf (space k n) 1 (primeCycle x 1 hx) ∈
      AddSubgroup.zmultiples (hyperplaneClass k n)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hxi : x = infinityPoint k hn
  · subst hxi
    rw [hyperplaneClass_eq_primeCycle k hn]
    exact AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples _
  · have hxU := mem_firstChart_of_ne_infinityPoint k hn x hx hxi
    obtain ⟨π, hπp, hπ⟩ := exists_prime_generator_firstChart k n ⟨x, hxU⟩ hx
    have hdiv := principalWeilDivisor_chartGenerator k hn ⟨x, hxU⟩ hx π hπ
    have hφ : (space k n).germToFunctionField (coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n)) π ≠ 0 :=
      (map_ne_zero_iff _ (Scheme.germToFunctionField_injective _ _)).mpr hπp.ne_zero
    have h0 := gradedClassOf_principalWeilDivisor
      ((space k n).germToFunctionField (coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n)) π) hφ
    rw [hdiv, gradedClassOf_add, gradedClassOf_zsmul,
      ← hyperplaneClass_eq_primeCycle k hn] at h0
    have hx' : gradedClassOf (space k n) 1 (primeCycle x 1 hx) =
        -((space k n).ord ((space k n).germToFunctionField
          (coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n)) π) (infinityPoint k hn) • hyperplaneClass k n) :=
      eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h0
    rw [hx']
    exact AddSubgroup.neg_mem _ (AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem _ (AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples _) _)

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.mem_zmultiples_hyperplaneClass
statement:
theorem mem_zmultiples_hyperplaneClass (hn : 1 ≤ n) (c : CodimensionChow (space k n) 1) :
    c ∈ AddSubgroup.zmultiples (hyperplaneClass k n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective
    (rationalEquivalenceSubgroup (space k n) 1) c
  change gradedClassOf (space k n) 1 D ∈ _
  rw [← (compactCodimCycleEquivFinsupp 1).symm_apply_apply D]
  generalize (compactCodimCycleEquivFinsupp 1) D = f
  induction f using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero =>
      rw [map_zero, gradedClassOf_zero]
      exact AddSubgroup.zero_mem _
  | add f g hf hg =>
      rw [map_add, gradedClassOf_add]
      exact AddSubgroup.add_mem _ hf hg
  | single x m =>
      change gradedClassOf (space k n) 1
        (codimPointFinsuppToCycleAddHom 1 (Finsupp.single x m)) ∈ _
      rw [codimPointFinsuppToCycleAddHom_single, gradedClassOf_zsmul]
      exact AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem _ (gradedClassOf_primeCycle_mem_zmultiples k hn x.1 x.2) m

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.exists_chartPoint_of_prime
statement:
theorem exists_chartPoint_of_prime (π : Γ(space k n, coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n)))
    (hπ : Prime π) :
    ∃ y : coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n), coheight (y : space k n) = 1 ∧
      ((firstChart_isAffine k n).primeIdealOf y).asIdeal = Ideal.span {π}
proof:
:= by
  let Q : PrimeSpectrum Γ(space k n, coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n)) :=
    ⟨Ideal.span {π}, (Ideal.span_singleton_prime hπ.ne_zero).mpr hπ⟩
  let y : coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n) :=
    ⟨(firstChart_isAffine k n).fromSpec Q, firstChart_fromSpec_mem k n Q⟩
  have hyQ : (firstChart_isAffine k n).primeIdealOf y = Q := by
    apply (firstChart_isAffine k n).fromSpec.isOpenEmbedding.injective
    exact (firstChart_isAffine k n).fromSpec_primeIdealOf y
  refine ⟨y, ?_, by rw [hyQ]⟩
  rw [coheight_firstChart, hyQ]
  exact Ideal.height_span_singleton_eq_one_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors
    (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hπ.ne_zero) hπ.not_unit

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.exists_isUnit_germ_eq_of_ord_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_isUnit_germ_eq_of_ord_eq_zero (φ : (space k n).functionField) (hφ : φ ≠ 0)
    (hord : ∀ y : coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n), coheight (y : space k n) = 1 →
      (space k n).ord φ (y : space k n) = 0) :
    ∃ c : Γ(space k n, coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n)), IsUnit c ∧
      (space k n).germToFunctionField (coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n)) c = φ
proof:
:= by
  haveI := functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen (space k n) _ (firstChart_isAffine k n)
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, rfl⟩ :=
    IsFractionRing.exists_reduced_fraction Γ(space k n, coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n)) φ
  have hb0 : (b : Γ(space k n, coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n))) ≠ 0 :=
    nonZeroDivisors.coe_ne_zero b
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    apply hφ
    exact IsLocalization.mk'_zero _
  have hdiv : IsLocalization.mk' (space k n).functionField a b =
      algebraMap _ (space k n).functionField a /
        algebraMap _ (space k n).functionField
          (b : Γ(space k n, coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n))) := by
    rw [IsFractionRing.mk'_eq_div]
  have hinj := IsFractionRing.injective Γ(space k n, coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n))
    (space k n).functionField
  have hunit : ∀ c d : Γ(space k n, coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n)), c ≠ 0 → d ≠ 0 →
      IsRelPrime c d →
      (∀ y : coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n), coheight (y : space k n) = 1 →
        (space k n).ord (algebraMap _ (space k n).functionField c /
          algebraMap _ (space k n).functionField d) (y : space k n) = 0) → IsUnit d := by
    intro c d hc hd hcd hcd0
    by_contra hdu
    obtain ⟨π, hπirr, hπd⟩ := WfDvdMonoid.exists_irreducible_factor hdu hd
    have hπ : Prime π := hπirr.prime
    have hπc : ¬ π ∣ c := fun h ↦ hπ.not_unit (hcd h hπd)
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyπ⟩ := exists_chartPoint_of_prime k n π hπ
    have h1 := hcd0 y hy
    rw [Scheme.ord_div hy _ _ ((map_ne_zero_iff _ hinj).mpr hc)
      ((map_ne_zero_iff _ hinj).mpr hd)] at h1
    have h2 : (space k n).ord (algebraMap _ (space k n).functionField c) (y : space k n) = 0 :=
      ord_germ_firstChart_eq_zero k n y hy c (by
        rw [hyπ, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
        exact hπc)
    have h3 : 1 ≤ (space k n).ord (algebraMap _ (space k n).functionField d) (y : space k n) :=
      one_le_ord_germ_firstChart k n y hy d hd (by
        rw [hyπ, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
        exact hπd)
    omega
  have hbu : IsUnit (b : Γ(space k n, coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n))) :=
    hunit a b ha0 hb0 hab (fun y hy ↦ by rw [← hdiv]; exact hord y hy)
  have hau : IsUnit a := hunit b a hb0 ha0 hab.symm (fun y hy ↦ by
    have hne : algebraMap _ (space k n).functionField a /
        algebraMap _ (space k n).functionField (b : Γ(space k n, coordinateOpen k n
          (firstIndex n))) ≠ 0 :=
      div_ne_zero ((map_ne_zero_iff _ hinj).mpr ha0) ((map_ne_zero_iff _ hinj).mpr hb0)
    rw [← inv_div, Scheme.ord_inv hy _ hne, ← hdiv, hord y hy, neg_zero])
  refine ⟨a * ↑hbu.unit⁻¹, hau.mul (Units.isUnit _), ?_⟩
  rw [hdiv]
  change algebraMap _ (space k n).functionField (a * ↑hbu.unit⁻¹) = _
  rw [eq_div_iff ((map_ne_zero_iff _ hinj).mpr hb0), ← map_mul, mul_assoc,
    hbu.val_inv_mul, mul_one]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.algebraMap_sectionAway
statement:
theorem algebraMap_sectionAway (s : grading k n 1) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    algebraMap (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading k n) (coordinate k n i))
        (Localization.Away (coordinate k n i)) (sectionAway k n s i) =
      algebraMap (Polynomial k n) (Localization.Away (coordinate k n i)) s *
        IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (S := Localization.Away (coordinate k n i))
          (coordinate k n i)
proof:
:= by
  have h := awayMk_val_eq_mul_invSelf_pow k n i 1 (s : Polynomial k n) s.2
  rw [pow_one] at h
  exact h

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.coe_smul_firstCoordinateSection
statement:
theorem coe_smul_firstCoordinateSection (r : k) :
    ((r • firstCoordinateSection k n : grading k n 1) : Polynomial k n) =
      MvPolynomial.C r * coordinate k n (firstIndex n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.coe_smul, MvPolynomial.smul_eq_C_mul]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.sectionAway_firstCoordinateSection
statement:
theorem sectionAway_firstCoordinateSection :
    sectionAway k n (firstCoordinateSection k n) (firstIndex n) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply (show Function.Injective (algebraMap
      (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading k n) (coordinate k n (firstIndex n)))
      (Localization.Away (coordinate k n (firstIndex n)))) from
    HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective _)
  rw [algebraMap_sectionAway, map_one]
  exact IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf (coordinate k n (firstIndex n))

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.sectionAway_smul_firstCoordinateSection
statement:
theorem sectionAway_smul_firstCoordinateSection (r : k) :
    sectionAway k n (r • firstCoordinateSection k n) (firstIndex n) =
      awayCoordinateHom k n (firstIndex n) (MvPolynomial.C r)
proof:
:= by
  apply (show Function.Injective (algebraMap
      (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (grading k n) (coordinate k n (firstIndex n)))
      (Localization.Away (coordinate k n (firstIndex n)))) from
    HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective _)
  rw [algebraMap_sectionAway, awayCoordinateHom, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C,
    coefficientToCoordinateAway_val, coe_smul_firstCoordinateSection, map_mul, mul_assoc,
    IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf, mul_one]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.germ_isUnit_eq_sectionRatio
statement:
theorem germ_isUnit_eq_sectionRatio (c : Γ(space k n, coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n)))
    (hc : IsUnit c) :
    ∃ r : k, r ≠ 0 ∧
      (space k n).germToFunctionField (coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n)) c =
        sectionRatio k n (r • firstCoordinateSection k n) (firstCoordinateSection k n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hcr⟩ := MvPolynomial.isUnit_iff_eq_C_of_isReduced.mp
    (hc.map (coordinateOpenSectionsEquiv k n (firstIndex n)))
  refine ⟨r, hr.ne_zero, ?_⟩
  have hc' : c = (coordinateOpenSectionsEquiv k n (firstIndex n)).symm (MvPolynomial.C r) := by
    rw [← hcr, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hsec : c = sectionOnCoordinateOpen k n (r • firstCoordinateSection k n) (firstIndex n) := by
    rw [hc', sectionOnCoordinateOpen, sectionAway_smul_firstCoordinateSection]
    rfl
  have hone : sectionFunction k n (firstCoordinateSection k n) (firstIndex n) = 1 := by
    rw [sectionFunction, sectionOnCoordinateOpen, sectionAway_firstCoordinateSection, map_one]
    exact map_one _
  rw [sectionRatio]
  change _ = sectionFunction k n (r • firstCoordinateSection k n) (firstIndex n) /
    sectionFunction k n (firstCoordinateSection k n) (firstIndex n)
  rw [hone, div_one, hsec]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.principalWeilDivisor_sectionRatio_smul
statement:
theorem principalWeilDivisor_sectionRatio_smul (hn : 1 ≤ n) (r : k) (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    principalWeilDivisor (space k n)
      (sectionRatio k n (r • firstCoordinateSection k n) (firstCoordinateSection k n)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hs0 := firstCoordinateSection_ne_zero k n
  have hrs : r • firstCoordinateSection k n ≠ 0 := smul_ne_zero hr hs0
  have h := hyperplaneCycle_sub_eq_principalWeilDivisor k n _ _ hrs hs0
  have hpt : hyperplanePoint k n (r • firstCoordinateSection k n) hrs hn =
      hyperplanePoint k n (firstCoordinateSection k n) hs0 hn := by
    apply ProjectiveSpectrum.ext
    apply HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_injective
    rw [hyperplanePoint_asIdeal, hyperplanePoint_asIdeal, coe_smul_firstCoordinateSection]
    exact Ideal.span_singleton_mul_left_unit ((isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hr).map MvPolynomial.C) _
  rw [hyperplaneCycle_eq_primeCycle k n _ hrs hn, hyperplaneCycle_eq_primeCycle k n _ hs0 hn,
    primeCycle_congr hpt 1 _ (coheight_hyperplanePoint k n _ hs0 hn), sub_self] at h
  exact h.symm

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.zsmul_hyperplaneClass_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem zsmul_hyperplaneClass_eq_zero_iff (hn : 1 ≤ n) (m : ℤ) :
    m • hyperplaneClass k n = 0 ↔ m = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ by rw [h, zero_zsmul]⟩
  let D : CodimensionCycles (space k n) ℤ 1 :=
    m • primeCycle (infinityPoint k hn) 1 (coheight_infinityPoint k hn)
  have hD : gradedClassOf (space k n) 1 D = gradedClassOf (space k n) 1 0 := by
    rw [gradedClassOf_zsmul, ← hyperplaneClass_eq_primeCycle k hn, h, gradedClassOf_zero]
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hDφ⟩ := exists_eq_principalWeilDivisor_of_gradedClassOf_eq D 0 hD
  rw [sub_zero] at hDφ
  have hcoef : ∀ z : space k n, D.1 z = (space k n).ord φ z := fun z ↦
    congrArg (fun E : WeilDivisor (space k n) ↦ E.1 z) hDφ
  have hDapply : ∀ z : space k n, D.1 z =
      m * (primeCycle (infinityPoint k hn) 1 (coheight_infinityPoint k hn)).1 z := by
    intro z
    simp [D]
  have hord : ∀ y : coordinateOpen k n (firstIndex n), coheight (y : space k n) = 1 →
      (space k n).ord φ (y : space k n) = 0 := by
    intro y _
    have hyi : (y : space k n) ≠ infinityPoint k hn := fun h ↦
      infinityPoint_not_mem_firstChart k hn (h ▸ y.2)
    rw [← hcoef, hDapply, primeCycle_apply_of_ne _ _ _ _ hyi, mul_zero]
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hcφ⟩ := exists_isUnit_germ_eq_of_ord_eq_zero k n φ hφ hord
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hcr⟩ := germ_isUnit_eq_sectionRatio k n c hc
  have hdiv0 : principalWeilDivisor (space k n) φ = 0 := by
    rw [← hcφ, hcr]
    exact principalWeilDivisor_sectionRatio_smul k hn r hr
  have hm := hcoef (infinityPoint k hn)
  rw [hDapply, primeCycle_apply_same, mul_one] at hm
  rw [hm]
  change (principalWeilDivisor (space k n) φ).1 (infinityPoint k hn) = 0
  rw [hdiv0]
  rfl

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.zmultiplesHom_hyperplaneClass_bijective
statement:
theorem zmultiplesHom_hyperplaneClass_bijective (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    Function.Bijective (zmultiplesHom (CodimensionChow (space k n) 1) (hyperplaneClass k n))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro a b hab
    simp only [zmultiplesHom_apply] at hab
    have h : (a - b) • hyperplaneClass k n = 0 := by simp [sub_zsmul, hab]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((zsmul_hyperplaneClass_eq_zero_iff k hn _).mp h)
  · intro c
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples_iff.mp (mem_zmultiples_hyperplaneClass k hn c)
    exact ⟨m, by simpa using hm⟩

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.codimensionOneChowEquivInt_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem codimensionOneChowEquivInt_symm_apply (hn : 1 ≤ n) (m : ℤ) :
    (codimensionOneChowEquivInt k hn).symm m = m • hyperplaneClass k n
proof:
:= by
  simp [codimensionOneChowEquivInt]

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.codimensionOneChowEquivInt_zsmul
statement:
theorem codimensionOneChowEquivInt_zsmul (hn : 1 ≤ n) (m : ℤ) :
    codimensionOneChowEquivInt k hn (m • hyperplaneClass k n) = m
proof:
:= by

theorem codimensionOneChowEquivInt_hyperplaneClass (hn : 1 ≤ n) :

name: SchemeProjectiveSpace.codimensionOneChowEquivInt_hyperplaneCycle
statement:
theorem codimensionOneChowEquivInt_hyperplaneCycle (hn : 1 ≤ n) (s : grading k n 1)
    (hs : s ≠ 0) :
    codimensionOneChowEquivInt k hn (gradedClassOf (space k n) 1 (hyperplaneCycle k n s hs)) =
      1
proof:
:= by

    (firstCoordinateSection_ne_zero k n)]

statement:

    codimensionOneChowEquivInt k (le_refl 1)

name: IsRegularLocalRing.isSMulRegular_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem isSMulRegular_of_ne_zero [IsDomain R] {r : R} (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    IsSMulRegular R r
proof:
:=
  IsSMulRegular.of_right_eq_zero_of_smul fun a ha =>
    (mul_eq_zero.mp (by simpa [smul_eq_mul] using ha)).resolve_left hr

name: IsRegularLocalRing.ne_zero_of_notMem_sq
statement:
theorem ne_zero_of_notMem_sq [IsLocalRing R] {x : R}
    (hx2 : x ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ 2) : x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0; exact hx2 (by simp [h0])

name: IsRegularLocalRing.isSMulRegular_of_notMem_sq_of_isDomain
statement:
theorem isSMulRegular_of_notMem_sq_of_isDomain [IsDomain R] [IsLocalRing R] {x : R}

proof:
:=
  isSMulRegular_of_ne_zero (ne_zero_of_notMem_sq hx2)

name: IsRegularLocalRing.exists_units_eq_of_span_singleton_eq_span_singleton
statement:
theorem exists_units_eq_of_span_singleton_eq_span_singleton [IsLocalRing R]
    {x y : R} (hx : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span {x})
    (hy : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span {y})
    (hy_ne : ∀ n : ℕ, y ^ n ≠ 0) :
    ∃ u : Rˣ, x = u * y
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : x ∈ Ideal.span {y} := by rw [← hy, hx]; exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _
  have h2 : y ∈ Ideal.span {x} := by rw [← hx, hy]; exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp h1
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp h2
  have hrs : y = s * r * y := by
    calc y = x * s := hs
      _ = (y * r) * s := by rw [← hr]
      _ = s * r * y := by ring
  have h1srs : (1 - s * r) * y = 0 := by
    rw [sub_mul, one_mul, ← hrs, sub_self]
  have hsr_unit : IsUnit (s * r) := by
    by_contra hnu
    rw [← mem_nonunits_iff, ← mem_maximalIdeal] at hnu
    have h1u : IsUnit (1 - s * r) := by
      rw [← notMem_maximalIdeal]
      intro hmem
      have : (1 : R) ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
        convert add_mem hmem hnu using 1; abel
      exact (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top <| Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ this isUnit_one
    exact hy_ne 1 ((IsUnit.mul_right_eq_zero h1u).mp (by rw [pow_one]; exact h1srs))
  have hr_unit : IsUnit r := by
    by_contra hnu
    rw [← mem_nonunits_iff, ← mem_maximalIdeal] at hnu
    have : s * r ∈ maximalIdeal R := Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ hnu
    exact (mem_nonunits_iff.mp ((mem_maximalIdeal _).mp this)) hsr_unit
  obtain ⟨u, hr_u⟩ := hr_unit
  exact ⟨u, by
    calc x = y * r := hr
      _ = y * (u : R) := by rw [← hr_u]
      _ = u * y := mul_comm y u⟩

name: IsRegularLocalRing.isSMulRegular_of_ringKrullDim_eq_one
statement:
theorem isSMulRegular_of_ringKrullDim_eq_one [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim R = 1) {x : R}
    (hxspan : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span {x}) :
    IsSMulRegular R x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hyspan, hyne⟩ := exists_generator_maximalIdeal_of_ringKrullDim_eq_one hdim
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ :=
    exists_units_eq_of_span_singleton_eq_span_singleton hxspan hyspan hyne
  refine IsSMulRegular.of_right_eq_zero_of_smul fun a ha => by
    have : (u : R) * y * a = 0 := by
      simpa [hu, hxspan, mul_assoc] using ha
    have hya : y * a = 0 := by
      have heq := congrArg (fun z => (↑u⁻¹ : R) * z) this
      simpa [← mul_assoc] using heq
    by_contra a_ne
    obtain ⟨v, k, rfl⟩ :=
      exists_unit_mul_pow_eq_of_ringKrullDim_eq_one hdim hyspan a_ne
    have : (v : R) * y ^ (k + 1) = 0 := by
      calc (v : R) * y ^ (k + 1) = v * (y ^ k * y) := by rw [pow_succ]
        _ = (v * y ^ k) * y := by ring
        _ = 0 := by
          rw [mul_comm (v * y ^ k) y]
          exact hya
    exact hyne (k + 1) ((IsUnit.mul_right_eq_zero v.isUnit).mp this)

name: IsRegularLocalRing.embeddingDimension_quotient_span_singleton
statement:
theorem embeddingDimension_quotient_span_singleton [IsRegularLocalRing R]
    [DecidableEq R]
    {x : R} (hxm : x ∈ maximalIdeal R) (hx2 : x ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ 2) :
    letI
proof:
:= ModuleCat.quotientSpanIsLocalRing R x hxm
    letI := quotient_span_singleton_isRegularLocalRing hxm hx2
    embeddingDimension (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) = Nat.sub (embeddingDimension R) 1 := by
  let Q := R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}
  letI : IsLocalRing Q := ModuleCat.quotientSpanIsLocalRing R x hxm
  letI : IsRegularLocalRing Q := quotient_span_singleton_isRegularLocalRing hxm hx2
  letI : DecidableEq Q := Classical.decEq Q
  letI : IsNoetherianRing Q := Ideal.Quotient.isNoetherianRing _
  obtain ⟨t, hat, hcard, hspan⟩ :=
    exists_finset_span_card_eq_spanFinrank_containing (R := R) hxm hx2
  let t₀ : Finset Q := (t.erase x).image (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}))
  have hmap :
      (maximalIdeal R).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) = maximalIdeal Q :=
    map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hspanQ : Ideal.span (t₀ : Set Q) = maximalIdeal Q := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · refine Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_
      intro z hz
      rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hz with ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      have : Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}) y ∈
          (maximalIdeal R).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x})) :=
        Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _
          (by rw [← hspan]; exact Submodule.subset_span (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hy))
      rwa [hmap] at this
    · rw [← hmap, ← hspan, Ideal.map_span]
      refine Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_
      rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      by_cases hyx : y = x
      · rw [show Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}) y = 0 from by
          rw [hyx, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
          exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self x]
        exact Ideal.zero_mem (Ideal.span (t₀ : Set Q))
      · exact Ideal.subset_span
          (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨y, Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hyx, hy⟩, rfl⟩)
  have hle : (maximalIdeal Q).spanFinrank ≤ Nat.sub (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank 1 := by
    have hle' : (Ideal.span (t₀ : Set Q)).spanFinrank ≤ t₀.card :=
      (Submodule.spanFinrank_span_le_ncard_of_finite t₀.finite_toSet).trans_eq (by simp)
    have hle'' : (maximalIdeal Q).spanFinrank ≤ t₀.card := by rwa [← hspanQ]
    have hcard₀ : t₀.card ≤ Nat.sub t.card 1 := by
      have := Finset.card_image_le (s := t.erase x)
        (f := Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {x}))
      rwa [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hat] at this
    have hcard₁ : Nat.sub t.card 1 = Nat.sub (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank 1 := by rw [hcard]
    exact Nat.le_trans hle'' (hcard₀.trans (Nat.le_of_eq hcard₁))
  have hge : Nat.sub (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank 1 ≤ (maximalIdeal Q).spanFinrank := by
    have hdim_le : ringKrullDim R ≤ ringKrullDim Q + 1 := by
      have h := ringKrullDim_le_ringKrullDim_quotSMulTop_succ (x := x) hxm
      have hI : Ideal.span {x} = x • (⊤ : Ideal R) := by simp [← Submodule.ideal_span_singleton_smul]
      rw [show ringKrullDim (R ⧸ x • (⊤ : Ideal R)) = ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) from
        ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq R hI).symm.toRingEquiv] at h
      simpa [Q] using h
    have hpos : 0 < IsRegularLocalRing.embeddingDimension R := by
      rw [IsRegularLocalRing.embeddingDimension, ← hcard]
      exact Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨x, hat⟩
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' hpos
    have hn1 : IsRegularLocalRing.embeddingDimension R = n + 1 := by
      simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using hn
    have this : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ ringKrullDim Q + 1 := by
      rw [← IsRegularLocalRing.coe_embeddingDimension_eq_ringKrullDim, hn1] at hdim_le
      exact hdim_le
    have hstep : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim Q :=
      ENat.WithBot.add_le_add_natCast_right_iff.mp this
    have hsub : Nat.sub (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank 1 = n := by
      rw [show (maximalIdeal R).spanFinrank = n + 1 from
        by rw [← IsRegularLocalRing.embeddingDimension, hn1]]
      rfl
    rw [hsub]
    have : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ((maximalIdeal Q).spanFinrank : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
      rw [IsRegularLocalRing.spanFinrank_maximalIdeal (R := Q)]
      exact hstep
    exact_mod_cast this
  simp only [embeddingDimension] at hle hge hcard ⊢
  exact Nat.le_antisymm hle hge

name: ModuleCat.succ_natCast_le_ringDepth_of_natCast_le_ringDepth_quotient
statement:
theorem succ_natCast_le_ringDepth_of_natCast_le_ringDepth_quotient
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (r : R) (hrm : r ∈ maximalIdeal R) (hr : IsSMulRegular R r) (n : ℕ)
    (h : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ @ringDepth (R ⧸ Ideal.span {r}) _
      (quotientSpanIsLocalRing R r hrm)) :
    ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ ringDepth R
proof:
:= by
  let Q := R ⧸ Ideal.span {r}
  letI : IsLocalRing Q := quotientSpanIsLocalRing R r hrm
  letI : Algebra R Q := Ideal.Quotient.algebra _
  letI : IsScalarTower R Q Q := IsScalarTower.right
  rw [ringDepth, natCast_le_localDepth_iff_exists_isWeaklyRegular] at h ⊢
  obtain ⟨qs, hlen, hmemQ, hregQ⟩ := h
  classical
  have mk_lift (q : Q) (hqM : q ∈ maximalIdeal Q) :
      ∃ a ∈ maximalIdeal R, Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {r}) a = q := by
    rw [← map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {r}))
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective] at hqM
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ :=
      (Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective).mp hqM
    exact ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
  have hex_rs (l : List Q) (hmem : ∀ q ∈ l, q ∈ maximalIdeal Q) :
      ∃ rs : List R, rs.length = l.length ∧
        rs.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {r})) = l ∧
        ∀ a ∈ rs, a ∈ maximalIdeal R := by
    induction l with
    | nil => exact ⟨[], by simp⟩
    | cons q0 tl ih =>
      obtain ⟨a, ha, heq⟩ := mk_lift q0 (hmem q0 List.mem_cons_self)
      obtain ⟨rs, hlen', hmap, hmemR⟩ :=
        ih (fun q hq => hmem q (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr hq)))
      exact ⟨a :: rs, by simp [hlen'], by simp [heq, hmap],
        by intro b hb; cases hb with | head => exact ha | tail _ hb => exact hmemR b hb⟩
  obtain ⟨rs, hrslen, hrs_map, hmemR⟩ := hex_rs qs hmemQ
  let e : QuotSMulTop r R ≃ₗ[R] Q :=
    Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ (by
      rw [← Submodule.ideal_span_singleton_smul]
      simp)
  have hreg_map : IsWeaklyRegular Q (rs.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {r}))) := by
    simpa [hrs_map] using hregQ
  have hreg_rs : IsWeaklyRegular Q rs :=
    (isWeaklyRegular_map_algebraMap_iff Q Q rs).mp hreg_map
  have hreg_quot : IsWeaklyRegular (QuotSMulTop r R) rs :=
    (e.isWeaklyRegular_congr rs).mpr hreg_rs
  refine ⟨r :: rs, by simp [hrslen, hlen], ?_,
    (isWeaklyRegular_cons_iff R r rs).mpr ⟨hr, hreg_quot⟩⟩
  intro a ha
  cases ha with
  | head => exact hrm
  | tail _ ha => exact hmemR a ha

name: ModuleCat.IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.of_quotient_span_singleton_isCohenMacaulay
statement:
theorem IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.of_quotient_span_singleton_isCohenMacaulay
    [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (r : R) (hrm : r ∈ maximalIdeal R) (hr : IsSMulRegular R r)
    (hQ : @IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {r}) _
      (quotientSpanIsLocalRing R r hrm)) :
    IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing R
proof:
:= by
  let Q := R ⧸ Ideal.span {r}
  letI : IsLocalRing Q := quotientSpanIsLocalRing R r hrm
  constructor
  apply le_antisymm (ringDepth_le_localKrullDim R)
  refine ENat.forall_natCast_le_iff_le.mp fun n hn ↦ ?_
  cases n with
  | zero => exact bot_le
  | succ m =>
    have hm : (m : ℕ∞) ≤ @localKrullDim Q _ _ := by
      have hdim := localKrullDim_quotient_add_one R r hrm hr
      have hn' : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ localKrullDim R := hn
      have : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ @localKrullDim Q _ _ + 1 := by
        rwa [← hdim] at hn'
      exact (ENat.add_le_add_iff_right (by simp : (1 : ℕ∞) ≠ ⊤)).mp
        (by simpa [add_comm] using this)
    have hm' : (m : ℕ∞) ≤ @ringDepth Q _ _ := by
      rw [IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.depth_eq_dimension (R := Q)]
      exact hm
    exact succ_natCast_le_ringDepth_of_natCast_le_ringDepth_quotient r hrm hr m hm'

name: ModuleCat.IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.of_isRegularLocalRing_of_embeddingDimension_eq_zero
statement:
theorem IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.of_isRegularLocalRing_of_embeddingDimension_eq_zero
    [IsRegularLocalRing R] (hdim : embeddingDimension R = 0) :
    IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing R
proof:
:= by
  have hkrull : ringKrullDim R = 0 := by
    simpa [hdim, ← coe_embeddingDimension_eq_ringKrullDim R]
  have hfield := isField_of_ringKrullDim_eq_zero hkrull
  letI : Field R := hfield.toField
  constructor
  apply le_antisymm (ringDepth_le_localKrullDim R)
  have : localKrullDim R = 0 := by
    rw [localKrullDim_eq_embeddingDimension, hdim]; simp
  rw [this]
  exact bot_le

name: ModuleCat.IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.of_isRegularLocalRing_of_embeddingDimension_eq_one
statement:
theorem IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.of_isRegularLocalRing_of_embeddingDimension_eq_one
    [IsRegularLocalRing R] [DecidableEq R] (hdim : embeddingDimension R = 1) :
    IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing R
proof:
:= by
  have hkrull : ringKrullDim R = 1 := by
    simpa [hdim, ← coe_embeddingDimension_eq_ringKrullDim R]
  letI : IsDomain R := isDomain_of_ringKrullDim_le_one (le_of_eq hkrull)
  obtain ⟨x, hxspan, hϖne⟩ := exists_generator_maximalIdeal_of_ringKrullDim_eq_one hkrull
  have hxm : x ∈ maximalIdeal R := by rw [hxspan]; exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self x
  have hx2 : x ∉ maximalIdeal R ^ 2 := by
    intro hx2'
    rw [hxspan, Ideal.span_singleton_pow] at hx2'
    obtain ⟨a, hax⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hx2'
    have hxreg := isSMulRegular_of_ringKrullDim_eq_one hkrull hxspan
    have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := fun h => hϖne 1 (by simp [h])
    have heq : x * 1 = x * (x * a) :=
      (mul_one x).trans (hax.trans (by rw [pow_two, mul_assoc]))
    have hax1 : x * a = 1 := (mul_left_cancel₀ hx0 heq).symm
    have hxU : IsUnit x := isUnit_iff_exists_inv.mpr ⟨a, hax1⟩
    exact absurd hxm ((notMem_maximalIdeal).mpr hxU)
  have hxreg : IsSMulRegular R x := isSMulRegular_of_ringKrullDim_eq_one hkrull hxspan
  letI := quotientSpanIsLocalRing R x hxm
  letI : IsRegularLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
    quotient_span_singleton_isRegularLocalRing hxm hx2
  have hQdim : embeddingDimension (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) = 0 := by
    have := embeddingDimension_quotient_span_singleton hxm hx2
    rw [hdim] at this
    simpa [Nat.sub_self] using this
  have hQ : IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
    of_isRegularLocalRing_of_embeddingDimension_eq_zero hQdim
  exact IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.of_quotient_span_singleton_isCohenMacaulay x hxm hxreg hQ

name: ModuleCat.IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.of_isRegularLocalRing_of_embeddingDimension_le_one
statement:
theorem IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.of_isRegularLocalRing_of_embeddingDimension_le_one
    [IsRegularLocalRing R] [DecidableEq R] (hdim : embeddingDimension R ≤ 1) :
    IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing R
proof:
:= by
  cases e : embeddingDimension R with
  | zero => exact of_isRegularLocalRing_of_embeddingDimension_eq_zero e
  | succ n =>
    have : n = 0 := by omega
    subst this
    exact of_isRegularLocalRing_of_embeddingDimension_eq_one e

name: ModuleCat.IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.of_isRegularLocalRing
statement:
theorem IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.of_isRegularLocalRing
    [IsRegularLocalRing R] [DecidableEq R]
    (regularLocal_isDomain :
      ∀ (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [IsRegularLocalRing S], IsDomain S) :
    IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing R
proof:
:= by
  generalize hn : embeddingDimension R = n
  revert R
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro R _ _ _ hn
    exact of_isRegularLocalRing_of_embeddingDimension_eq_zero hn
  | succ n ih =>
    intro R _ _ _ hn
    letI : IsDomain R := regularLocal_isDomain R
    have hkrull_ne : ringKrullDim R ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have hpos : (0 : WithBot ℕ∞) < ringKrullDim R := by
        rw [← IsRegularLocalRing.coe_embeddingDimension_eq_ringKrullDim R]
        exact_mod_cast (show 0 < embeddingDimension R from by rw [hn]; omega)
      rw [h0] at hpos
      exact (lt_irrefl 0) hpos
    obtain ⟨x, hxm, hx2⟩ := exists_mem_maximalIdeal_notMem_sq hkrull_ne
    have hxreg : IsSMulRegular R x := isSMulRegular_of_notMem_sq_of_isDomain hx2
    letI := quotientSpanIsLocalRing R x hxm
    letI : IsRegularLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      quotient_span_singleton_isRegularLocalRing hxm hx2
    letI : DecidableEq (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) := Classical.decEq _
    have hQdim : embeddingDimension (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) = n := by
      have := embeddingDimension_quotient_span_singleton hxm hx2
      rw [hn] at this
      simpa using this
    have hQ : IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
      @ih (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) _ _ _ hQdim
    exact IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.of_quotient_span_singleton_isCohenMacaulay x hxm hxreg hQ

name: ModuleCat.IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.of_isRegularLocalRing_of_isDomain_of_embeddingDimension_le_two
statement:
theorem IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.of_isRegularLocalRing_of_isDomain_of_embeddingDimension_le_two
    [IsRegularLocalRing R] [IsDomain R] [DecidableEq R] (hdim : embeddingDimension R ≤ 2) :
    IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing R
proof:
:= by
  cases e : embeddingDimension R with
  | zero => exact of_isRegularLocalRing_of_embeddingDimension_eq_zero e
  | succ n =>
    cases n with
    | zero => exact of_isRegularLocalRing_of_embeddingDimension_eq_one e
    | succ m =>
      have hm0 : m = 0 := by omega
      subst hm0
      have hkrull_ne : ringKrullDim R ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        have hpos : (0 : WithBot ℕ∞) < ringKrullDim R := by
          rw [← IsRegularLocalRing.coe_embeddingDimension_eq_ringKrullDim R]
          exact_mod_cast (show 0 < embeddingDimension R from by rw [e]; omega)
        rw [h0] at hpos
        exact (lt_irrefl 0) hpos
      obtain ⟨x, hxm, hx2⟩ := exists_mem_maximalIdeal_notMem_sq hkrull_ne
      have hxreg : IsSMulRegular R x := isSMulRegular_of_notMem_sq_of_isDomain hx2
      letI := quotientSpanIsLocalRing R x hxm
      letI : IsRegularLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
        quotient_span_singleton_isRegularLocalRing hxm hx2
      letI : DecidableEq (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) := Classical.decEq _
      have hQdim : embeddingDimension (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) = 1 := by
        have := embeddingDimension_quotient_span_singleton hxm hx2
        rw [e] at this
        simpa using this
      have hQ : IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {x}) :=
        of_isRegularLocalRing_of_embeddingDimension_eq_one hQdim
      exact IsCohenMacaulayLocalRing.of_quotient_span_singleton_isCohenMacaulay x hxm hxreg hQ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.codimensionTwoRelation_degree_eq_source
statement:
theorem codimensionTwoRelation_degree_eq_source
    [CompactSpace X] (g : RationalRelationGenerator X 2)
    (htower : RelationSourceResidueTower k g) :
    letI : g.Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
proof:
:= relationSourceOver k g;
    codimensionCycleDegree (X := X) k 2 g.cycle =
      AlgebraicCycle.degree k (div g.f) := by
  letI : g.Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := relationSourceOver k g
  have htower' : AlgebraicCycle.ClosedImmersionResidueTower g.i k := by
    simpa [RelationSourceResidueTower] using htower
  rw [codimensionCycleDegree_apply]
  change AlgebraicCycle.degree k
      (AlgebraicCycle.pushforward g.i (div g.f)
        (fun _ ↦ (2 : ℕ∞)) coheight) =
    AlgebraicCycle.degree k (div g.f)
  exact @AlgebraicCycle.degree_pushforward_closedImmersion
    X g.Y g.i inferInstance k inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance
    (div g.f) ℕ∞ inferInstance (fun _ ↦ (2 : ℕ∞)) coheight
    (fun y hy ↦ (g.codimension y (div_support hy)).symm) htower'.tower

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.codimensionTwoRelation_degree_eq_zero_of_regularSource
statement:
theorem codimensionTwoRelation_degree_eq_zero_of_regularSource
    [CompactSpace X] [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator X 2)
    (d : RegularRelationSourceCurveData k g) :
    codimensionCycleDegree (X := X) k 2 g.cycle = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI : g.Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := relationSourceOver k g
  letI : CompactSpace g.Y := g.i.isClosedEmbedding.compactSpace
  letI : IsNoetherian g.Y :=
    { toIsLocallyNoetherian := inferInstance
      toCompactSpace := inferInstance }
  letI : KrullDimLE 1 g.Y := d.krullDimLE
  letI : IsRegularInCodimensionOne g.Y := d.regularInCodimensionOne
  letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (g.Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (g.i ≫ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    infer_instance
  have hfinite :
      (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.structureSheafModule g.Y).HasFiniteEulerCharacteristic
        k :=
    d.structureSheafFinite
  rw [codimensionTwoRelation_degree_eq_source k g d.residueTower]
  exact SchemeBridge.degree_principal_eq_zero_of_structureSheaf_finite k hfinite g.f g.hf

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.surfaceDegreeDataOfRegularRelationSources
statement:
theorem surfaceDegreeDataOfRegularRelationSources
    [CompactSpace X] [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]

  relation_degree_zero g
proof:
