    codimensionTwoRelation_degree_eq_zero_of_regularSource k g (d.source g)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.codimensionOneLocalRepresentative_algebraMap_of_specializes
statement:
theorem codimensionOneLocalRepresentative_algebraMap_of_specializes
    {z pt : X} (hz : coheight z = 1) (h : z ⤳ pt) (c : X.presheaf.stalk pt)
    (hord : X.ord (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) X.functionField c) z = 0) :
    codimensionOneLocalRepresentative
        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk pt) X.functionField c) z hz hord =
      (X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom c
proof:
:= by
  apply IsFractionRing.injective (X.presheaf.stalk z) X.functionField
  rw [algebraMap_codimensionOneLocalRepresentative]
  letI := Scheme.stalkSpecializesAlgebra h
  haveI := Scheme.isScalarTower_functionField h
  exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply (X.presheaf.stalk pt) (X.presheaf.stalk z)
    X.functionField c

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.specializes_pointClosureι
statement:
theorem specializes_pointClosureι {z : X} (y : pointClosureScheme z) :
    z ⤳ pointClosureι z y
proof:
:= by
  have h := (pointClosureGenericPoint_specializes y).map (pointClosureι z).continuous
  rwa [pointClosureι_genericPoint] at h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.restrictFunctionToPointClosure_algebraMap_stalkMap
statement:
theorem restrictFunctionToPointClosure_algebraMap_stalkMap
    {z : X} (hz : coheight z = 1) (y : pointClosureScheme z)
    (c : X.presheaf.stalk (pointClosureι z y))
    (hord : X.ord (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (pointClosureι z y))
      X.functionField c) z = 0) :
    restrictFunctionToPointClosure
        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (pointClosureι z y)) X.functionField c) z hz hord =
      algebraMap ((pointClosureScheme z).presheaf.stalk y)
        (pointClosureScheme z).functionField
        (((pointClosureι z).stalkMap y).hom c)
proof:
:= by
  have hηy : pointClosureGenericPoint z ⤳ y := pointClosureGenericPoint_specializes y
  have hzy : z ⤳ pointClosureι z y := specializes_pointClosureι y
  rw [restrictFunctionToPointClosure,
    codimensionOneLocalRepresentative_algebraMap_of_specializes hz hzy c hord]
  have hcomp : ((X.presheaf.stalkCongr
        (.of_eq (pointClosureι_genericPoint z).symm)).hom).hom
        ((X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes hzy).hom c) =
      (X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes
        ((pointClosureι z).base.hom.map_specializes hηy)).hom c := by
    simp [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkCongr_hom]
  rw [hcomp, Scheme.Hom.stalkSpecializes_stalkMap_apply]
  letI := Scheme.stalkSpecializesAlgebra hηy
  haveI := Scheme.isScalarTower_functionField hηy
  exact (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply ((pointClosureScheme z).presheaf.stalk y)
    ((pointClosureScheme z).presheaf.stalk (pointClosureGenericPoint z))
    (pointClosureScheme z).functionField (((pointClosureι z).stalkMap y).hom c)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ker_stalkMap_eq_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_eq_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes {Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Z]
    (f : Z ⟶ X) (p : Z) (h : f (genericPoint Z) ⤳ f p) :
    RingHom.ker (f.stalkMap p).hom = Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h
proof:
:= by
  have hgen : genericPoint Z ⤳ p := (genericPoint_spec Z).specializes trivial
  letI : Field (Z.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint Z)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Field Z.functionField)
  have hinj : Function.Injective (Z.presheaf.stalkSpecializes hgen).hom :=
    IsFractionRing.injective (Z.presheaf.stalk p) Z.functionField
  ext s
  have hsq : (Z.presheaf.stalkSpecializes hgen).hom ((f.stalkMap p).hom s) =
      (f.stalkMap (genericPoint Z)).hom ((X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom s) :=
    (Scheme.Hom.stalkSpecializes_stalkMap_apply f (genericPoint Z) p hgen s).symm
  constructor
  · intro hs
    have h0 : (f.stalkMap (genericPoint Z)).hom
        ((X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom s) = 0 := by
      rw [← hsq, RingHom.mem_ker.mp hs, map_zero]
    show (X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom s ∈
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk (f (genericPoint Z)))
    rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff]
    intro hu
    have hu' := hu.map (f.stalkMap (genericPoint Z)).hom
    rw [h0] at hu'
    exact not_isUnit_zero hu'
  · intro hs
    have hnu : ¬ IsUnit ((X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom s) := by
      have : (X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom s ∈
          IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk (f (genericPoint Z))) := hs
      rwa [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff] at this
    have h0 : (f.stalkMap (genericPoint Z)).hom
        ((X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom s) = 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      exact hnu (isUnit_of_map_unit (f.stalkMap (genericPoint Z)).hom _
        (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hne))
    refine RingHom.mem_ker.mpr (hinj ?_)
    rw [hsq, h0, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.pointClosure_le_genericPoint
statement:
theorem pointClosure_le_genericPoint {z : X} (y : pointClosureScheme z) :
    y ≤ pointClosureGenericPoint z
proof:
:=
  Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr (pointClosureGenericPoint_specializes y)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.pointClosureι_strictMono
statement:
theorem pointClosureι_strictMono {z : X} {y y' : pointClosureScheme z} (hlt : y < y') :
    pointClosureι z y < pointClosureι z y'
proof:
:= by
  have hle : pointClosureι z y ≤ pointClosureι z y' :=
    Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr
      ((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hlt.le).map (pointClosureι z).continuous)
  refine lt_of_le_not_ge hle fun hge ↦ absurd ?_ hlt.ne
  exact (pointClosureι z).isEmbedding.injective
    ((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hge).antisymm
      (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hle)).eq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.pointClosure_coheight_le_one
statement:
theorem pointClosure_coheight_le_one [Order.KrullDimLE 2 X] {z : X} (hz : coheight z = 1)
    (y : pointClosureScheme z) : coheight y ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [show ((1 : ℕ∞)) = ((1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) from rfl, Order.coheight_le_coe_iff]
  intro y' hy'
  have hbound : ∀ w : pointClosureScheme z, pointClosureι z w < z →
      ¬ (y < w) := by
    intro w hw hyw
    have h1 : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ coheight (pointClosureι z w) := by
      have h := Order.coheight_add_one_le hw
      rw [hz] at h
      norm_num at h ⊢
      exact h
    have h2 : coheight (pointClosureι z w) + 1 ≤ coheight (pointClosureι z y) :=
      Order.coheight_add_one_le (pointClosureι_strictMono hyw)
    have h3 : (3 : ℕ∞) ≤ coheight (pointClosureι z y) := by
      refine le_trans ?_ h2
      calc (3 : ℕ∞) = 2 + 1 := by decide
        _ ≤ coheight (pointClosureι z w) + 1 := by gcongr
    have h4 : coheight (pointClosureι z y) ≤ 2 := by
      have h := (Order.coheight_le_krullDim (pointClosureι z y)).trans
        (Order.KrullDimLE.krullDim_le (n := 2) (α := ↥X))
      have h' : (↑(coheight (pointClosureι z y)) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ↑(2 : ℕ∞) := by
        simpa using h
      exact WithBot.coe_le_coe.mp h'
    exact absurd (h3.trans h4) (by decide)
  have hy'gen : y' = pointClosureGenericPoint z := by
    by_contra hne
    refine hbound y' ?_ hy'
    have hle : pointClosureι z y' ≤ z := by
      have := pointClosure_le_genericPoint y'
      simpa [pointClosureι_genericPoint] using
        (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr
          ((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp this).map (pointClosureι z).continuous))
    refine lt_of_le_not_ge hle fun hge ↦ hne ?_
    exact (pointClosureι z).isEmbedding.injective
      (((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hge).antisymm
        (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hle)).eq.trans
          (pointClosureι_genericPoint z).symm)
  subst hy'gen
  have : coheight (pointClosureGenericPoint z) = 0 := by
    rw [(pointClosureGenericPoint_isGeneric z).eq
      (genericPoint_spec (pointClosureScheme z))]
    exact coheight_eq_zero.mpr isMax_top
  rw [this]
  norm_num

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.exists_of_pushforward_apply_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_of_pushforward_apply_ne_zero (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f]
    {N : Type*} [DecidableEq N] (wx : X → N) (wy : Y → N) (D : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) (y : Y)
    (h : AlgebraicCycle.pushforward f D wx wy y ≠ 0) : ∃ x, f x = y ∧ D x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have e : AlgebraicCycle.pushforward f D wx wy y =
      ∑ x ∈ (f.preimageSupportFinite D y).toFinset,
        D x * ((AlgebraicCycle.mapAux f wx wy x : ℕ) : ℤ) := rfl
  rw [e] at h
  obtain ⟨x, hx, -⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero h
  simp only [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Function.locallyFinsupp.preimageSupport,
    Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Function.mem_support] at hx
  exact ⟨x, hx.1, hx.2⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.coheight_spec_field
statement:
theorem coheight_spec_field (K : Type u) [Field K] (y : Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :
    coheight y = 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Subsingleton (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton (PrimeSpectrum K))
  exact coheight_eq_zero.mpr fun b _ ↦ (Subsingleton.elim b y).le

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.pushforward_mem_codimensionCycles_sub
statement:
theorem pushforward_mem_codimensionCycles_sub (K : Type u) [Field K] (n : ℕ) [KrullDimLE n X]
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) [QuasiCompact f] (p : ℕ)
    (D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ p) :
    AlgebraicCycle.pushforward f (D : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) ∈
      codimensionCycles (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) ℤ (p - n)
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨x, -, hx⟩ := exists_of_pushforward_apply_ne_zero f _ _ (D : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) y hy
  have hxp : coheight x = p := D.2 hx
  have hle : coheight x ≤ n := by
    have h1 := Order.coheight_le_krullDim x
    have h2 : krullDim X ≤ n := by
      rw [← Order.krullDimLE_iff]
      infer_instance
    exact_mod_cast h1.trans h2
  rw [hxp] at hle
  have hpn : p - n = 0 := Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le (by exact_mod_cast hle)
  change coheight y = ((p - n : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
  rw [hpn, coheight_spec_field K y]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.pushforward_toSpec_mem_codimensionCycles
statement:
theorem pushforward_toSpec_mem_codimensionCycles (k : Type u) [Field k] (n p : ℕ)
    (D : CodimensionCycles (SchemeProjectiveSpace.space k n) ℤ p) :
    AlgebraicCycle.pushforward (SchemeProjectiveSpace.toSpec k n) (D : AlgebraicCycle _ ℤ)
        (fun _ ↦ ()) (fun _ ↦ ()) ∈
      codimensionCycles (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) ℤ (p - n)
proof:
:=
  pushforward_mem_codimensionCycles_sub k n _ p D

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.not_mem_span_singleton_of_maximalIdeal_mem_minimalPrimes_pair
proof:
:= by
  intro ha
  have hspan : (Ideal.span {a, b} : Ideal R) = Ideal.span {b} := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · rw [Ideal.span_le]
      rintro x (rfl | hx)
      · exact ha
      · exact Ideal.subset_span hx
    · exact Ideal.span_mono (Set.subset_insert a {b})
  rw [hspan] at hmin
  have hheight : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).height ≤ 1 :=
    Ideal.height_le_one_of_isPrincipal_of_mem_minimalPrimes_of_isLocalRing _ hmin
  exact hdim (by
    rw [← IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim]
    exact_mod_cast hheight)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.ker_toX_stalkMap_eq_span_pair
statement:
theorem ker_toX_stalkMap_eq_span_pair (z : d.intersection)
    (a b : X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z))
    (ha : RingHom.ker (d.rightStalkMap z).hom = Ideal.span {a})
    (hproj : RingHom.ker ((pullback.snd d.i d.j).stalkMap z).hom =
      Ideal.span {(d.rightStalkMap z).hom b}) :
    RingHom.ker (d.toX.stalkMap z).hom = Ideal.span {a, b}
proof:
:= by
  have hra : ∀ x : X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z),
      (d.rightStalkMap z).hom x = 0 ↔ a ∣ x := by
    intro x
    rw [← RingHom.mem_ker, ha, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  have hb0 : ((pullback.snd d.i d.j).stalkMap z).hom
      ((d.rightStalkMap z).hom b) = 0 := by
    have hmem : (d.rightStalkMap z).hom b ∈
        RingHom.ker ((pullback.snd d.i d.j).stalkMap z).hom := by
      rw [hproj]
      exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
    exact RingHom.mem_ker.mp hmem
  ext x
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker, Ideal.mem_span_pair]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hsnd : ((pullback.snd d.i d.j).stalkMap z).hom
        ((d.rightStalkMap z).hom x) = 0 :=
      (d.snd_stalkMap_rightStalkMap_apply z x).trans hx
    have hmem := RingHom.mem_ker.mpr hsnd
    rw [hproj] at hmem
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hmem
    obtain ⟨c', rfl⟩ := d.rightStalkMap_surjective z c
    have hc' : (d.rightStalkMap z).hom x =
        (d.rightStalkMap z).hom b * (d.rightStalkMap z).hom c' := hc
    have hsub : (d.rightStalkMap z).hom (x - b * c') = 0 := by
      rw [map_sub, map_mul, hc', sub_self]
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := (hra _).mp hsub
    refine ⟨u, c', ?_⟩
    have hx' : x = a * u + b * c' := by
      rw [← hu]
      ring
    rw [hx']
    ring
  · rintro ⟨u, v, rfl⟩
    have hta : (d.toX.stalkMap z).hom a = 0 := by
      rw [← d.snd_stalkMap_rightStalkMap_apply z a, (hra a).mpr dvd_rfl]
      exact map_zero _
    have htb : (d.toX.stalkMap z).hom b = 0 := by
      rw [← d.snd_stalkMap_rightStalkMap_apply z b]
      exact hb0
    rw [map_add, map_mul, map_mul, hta, htb, mul_zero, mul_zero, add_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.maximalIdeal_mem_minimalPrimes_ker_toX_stalkMap
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_mem_minimalPrimes_ker_toX_stalkMap
    (z : d.intersection) (hz : z ∈ genericPoints d.intersection) :
    IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z)) ∈
      (RingHom.ker (d.toX.stalkMap z).hom).minimalPrimes
proof:
:= by
  have hσ : Function.Surjective (d.toX.stalkMap z).hom :=
    d.toX.stalkMap_surjective z
  letI : Ring.KrullDimLE 0 ↑(d.intersection.presheaf.stalk z) :=
    krullDimLE_of_coheight (coheight_eq_zero_of_mem_genericPoints hz)
  have hkerle : RingHom.ker (d.toX.stalkMap z).hom ≤
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z)) :=
    IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal (RingHom.ker_ne_top _)
  refine ⟨⟨(IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal _).isPrime, hkerle⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro q ⟨hqPrime, hIq⟩ hqle
  haveI := hqPrime
  have hmapPrime : (Ideal.map (d.toX.stalkMap z).hom q).IsPrime :=
    Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective hσ hIq
  have hmapMax : (Ideal.map (d.toX.stalkMap z).hom q).IsMaximal :=
    Ring.krullDimLE_zero_iff.mp inferInstance _ hmapPrime
  haveI := hmapMax
  have hqeq : Ideal.comap (d.toX.stalkMap z).hom
      (Ideal.map (d.toX.stalkMap z).hom q) = q := by
    rw [Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective _ hσ, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot]
    exact sup_eq_left.mpr hIq
  have hqMax : q.IsMaximal := by
    rw [← hqeq]
    exact Ideal.comap_isMaximal_of_surjective _ hσ
  exact le_of_eq (IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hqMax).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ExpectedCodimensionIntersectionData.rightAmbientStalkElement_not_mem_span_leftChartAt
statement:
theorem rightAmbientStalkElement_not_mem_span_leftChartAt {z : d.intersection}
    (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    {U : Scheme.{u}} (t : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion t]
    (cLeft : PrincipalOpenPullbackChart d.i t)
    (cRight : PrincipalOpenPullbackChart d.j t)
    (q : PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.OpenIntersectionRestriction.At
      (i := d.i) (t := t) d.j z)
    (hz : z ∈ genericPoints d.intersection) :
    d.rightAmbientStalkElement z
        (PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.OpenIntersectionRestriction.At.rightChartAt
          d.j q cRight).stalkElement ∉
      Ideal.span {
        (PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.OpenIntersectionRestriction.At.leftChartAt
          d.j q cLeft).stalkElement}
proof:
:= by
  let cLeftAt :=
    PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.OpenIntersectionRestriction.At.leftChartAt d.j q cLeft
  let cRightAt :=
    PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.OpenIntersectionRestriction.At.rightChartAt d.j q cRight
  have ha : RingHom.ker (d.rightStalkMap z).hom =
      Ideal.span {d.rightAmbientStalkElement z cRightAt.stalkElement} :=
    d.ker_rightStalkMap_eq_span_rightAmbientStalkElement z cRightAt.stalkElement
      cRightAt.ker_stalkMap
  have hproj : RingHom.ker ((pullback.snd d.i d.j).stalkMap z).hom =
      Ideal.span {(d.rightStalkMap z).hom cLeftAt.stalkElement} := by
    rw [d.rightStalkMap_apply_eq_pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkElement]
    exact PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.OpenIntersectionRestriction.At.ker_stalkMap_snd_eq_span_pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkElement
      d.j q cLeft
  have hker : RingHom.ker (d.toX.stalkMap z).hom =
      Ideal.span {d.rightAmbientStalkElement z cRightAt.stalkElement,
        cLeftAt.stalkElement} :=
    d.ker_toX_stalkMap_eq_span_pair z
      (d.rightAmbientStalkElement z cRightAt.stalkElement)
      cLeftAt.stalkElement ha hproj
  have hmin : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z)) ∈
      (Ideal.span {d.rightAmbientStalkElement z cRightAt.stalkElement,
        cLeftAt.stalkElement}).minimalPrimes := by
    rw [← hker]
    exact d.maximalIdeal_mem_minimalPrimes_ker_toX_stalkMap z hz
  have hdim : ¬ ringKrullDim ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z)) ≤ 1 := by
    have hco : coheight (d.toX z) = (r : ℕ∞) := d.codimension z hz
    rw [ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight, hco]
    intro hle
    have h1 : (r : ℕ∞) ≤ (1 : ℕ∞) := by exact_mod_cast hle
    have h2 : r ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast h1
    omega
  haveI hNR : IsNoetherianRing ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z)) := inferInstance
  exact @not_mem_span_singleton_of_maximalIdeal_mem_minimalPrimes_pair
    ↑(X.presheaf.stalk (d.toX z)) _ hNR _ _ _ hmin hdim

name: RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.map_genericPoint
statement: theorem map_genericPoint [IsDominant h] : h (genericPoint X) = genericPoint Y
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (genericPoint_spec X).image h.continuous
  rw [Set.image_univ, h.denseRange.closure_range] at h1
  exact h1.eq (genericPoint_spec Y)

name: RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.genericPoint_mem
statement:
theorem genericPoint_mem {Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Z] (U : Z.Opens) [h : Nonempty U] :
    genericPoint Z ∈ U
proof:
:=
  ((genericPoint_spec Z).mem_open_set_iff U.isOpen).mpr (by simpa using h)

name: RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.ffHom_germ
statement:
theorem ffHom_germ [IsDominant h] (U : Y.Opens) [Nonempty U] (V : X.Opens) [Nonempty V]
    (e : V ≤ h ⁻¹ᵁ U) (r : Γ(Y, U)) :
    (ffHom h).hom (Y.germToFunctionField U r) = X.germToFunctionField V (h.appLE U V e r)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ffHom, Scheme.germToFunctionField, CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply]
  erw [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes_apply]
  erw [Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply]
  rw [Scheme.Hom.appLE, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  erw [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]

name: RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.ffHom_algebraMap_stalk
statement:
theorem ffHom_algebraMap_stalk [IsDominant h] (x : X) (a : Y.presheaf.stalk (h x)) :
    (ffHom h).hom (algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk (h x)) Y.functionField a) =
      algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField ((h.stalkMap x).hom a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, r, rfl⟩ := Y.presheaf.exists_germ_eq a
  haveI : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨h x, hxU⟩⟩
  haveI : Nonempty (h ⁻¹ᵁ U) := ⟨⟨x, hxU⟩⟩
  erw [Scheme.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField, ffHom_germ h U (h ⁻¹ᵁ U) le_rfl,
    Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply, Scheme.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField,
    Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app]

name: RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.stalkSpecializes_bijective
statement:
theorem stalkSpecializes_bijective {T : TopCat} (F : TopCat.Presheaf CommRingCat T) {x y : T}
    (hxy : x = y) : Function.Bijective (F.stalkSpecializes (specializes_of_eq hxy)).hom
proof:
:= by
  subst hxy
  rw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkSpecializes_refl]
  exact Function.bijective_id

name: RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.residue_bijective_of_isField
statement:
theorem residue_bijective_of_isField {O : Type*} [CommRing O] [IsLocalRing O] (hO : IsField O) :
    Function.Bijective (IsLocalRing.residue O)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, IsLocalRing.residue_surjective⟩
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro a ha
  rw [IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff, IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff] at ha
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hO.mul_inv_cancel hne
  exact ha (IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one b hb)

name: RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.finiteDimensional_of_degree
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_of_degree [IsDominant h] (hdeg : h.degree (genericPoint X) ≠ 0) :
    letI
proof:
:= ffAlgebra h
    FiniteDimensional Y.functionField X.functionField := by
  letI := ffAlgebra h
  set ψ := Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (specializes_of_eq (map_genericPoint h)) with hψ
  have hψb : Function.Bijective ψ.hom := stalkSpecializes_bijective Y.presheaf (map_genericPoint h)
  let eψ := RingEquiv.ofBijective ψ.hom hψb
  have hOfield : IsField (Y.presheaf.stalk (h (genericPoint X))) :=
    MulEquiv.isField (Field.toIsField Y.functionField) eψ.symm.toMulEquiv
  have hLfield : IsField X.functionField := Field.toIsField _
  let i := eψ.trans (RingEquiv.ofBijective _ (residue_bijective_of_isField hOfield))
  let j := RingEquiv.ofBijective _ (residue_bijective_of_isField hLfield)
  letI : Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Y.presheaf.stalk (h (genericPoint X))))
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X))) :=
    RingHom.toAlgebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (h.stalkMap (genericPoint X)).hom)
  have hcompat : (algebraMap (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Y.presheaf.stalk (h (genericPoint X))))
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X)))).comp i.toRingHom =
      j.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap Y.functionField X.functionField) := by
    ext k
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom]
    change IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (h.stalkMap (genericPoint X)).hom
      (IsLocalRing.residue _ (ψ.hom k)) = IsLocalRing.residue _ ((ffHom h).hom k)
    rw [IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map_residue]
    rfl
  have hfr := Algebra.finrank_eq_of_equiv_equiv i j hcompat
  have hpos : 0 < Module.finrank Y.functionField X.functionField := by
    rw [hfr]; exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hdeg
  exact Module.finite_of_finrank_pos hpos

name: RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.le_genericPoint'
statement: theorem le_genericPoint' {Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Z] (x : Z) : x ≤ genericPoint Z
proof:
:=
  Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr ((genericPoint_spec Z).specializes (Set.mem_univ x))

name: RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.coheight_genericPoint
statement: theorem coheight_genericPoint {Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Z] : coheight (genericPoint Z) = 0
proof:
:=
  Order.coheight_eq_zero.mpr fun b _ ↦ le_genericPoint' b

name: RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.coheight_eq_one_of_map
statement:
theorem coheight_eq_one_of_map [IsDominant h] (hdeg : h.degree (genericPoint X) ≠ 0) (x : X)
    (hx : coheight (h x) = 1) : coheight x = 1
proof:
:= by
  letI := ffAlgebra h
  haveI := finiteDimensional_of_degree h hdeg
  haveI : Ring.KrullDimLE 1 (Y.presheaf.stalk (h x)) := krullDimLE_of_coheight hx
  letI : Algebra (Y.presheaf.stalk (h x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x) := (h.stalkMap x).hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra (Y.presheaf.stalk (h x)) X.functionField :=
    ((algebraMap Y.functionField X.functionField).comp
      (algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk (h x)) Y.functionField)).toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower (Y.presheaf.stalk (h x)) Y.functionField X.functionField :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun _ ↦ rfl)
  haveI : IsScalarTower (Y.presheaf.stalk (h x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun a ↦ ffHom_algebraMap_stalk h x a)
  have hCL : Function.Injective (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField) :=
    IsFractionRing.injective _ _
  have hdim := krullDimLE_one_of_finite (Y.presheaf.stalk (h x)) Y.functionField
    (L := X.functionField) (C := X.presheaf.stalk x) hCL
  rw [Ring.krullDimLE_iff, ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight] at hdim
  have hle : coheight x ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast hdim
  refine le_antisymm hle (Order.one_le_iff_pos.mpr (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr fun h0 ↦ ?_))
  have hmax : IsMax x := Order.coheight_eq_zero.mp h0
  have h1 : genericPoint X ≤ x := hmax (le_genericPoint' x)
  have h2 : genericPoint Y ≤ h x := by
    rw [← map_genericPoint h]
    exact Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr ((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp h1).map h.continuous)
  have := Order.coheight_anti h2
  rw [coheight_genericPoint, hx] at this
  exact absurd this (by norm_num)

name: RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.finite_fibre
statement:
theorem finite_fibre [IsDominant h] [IsProper h] (hdeg : h.degree (genericPoint X) ≠ 0) (y : Y)
    (hy : coheight y = 1) : (h ⁻¹' {y}).Finite
proof:
:= by
  have hcoh : ∀ x, h x = y → coheight x = 1 := fun x hx ↦
    coheight_eq_one_of_map h hdeg x (hx ▸ hy)
  
  have hinc : ∀ x x', h x = y → h x' = y → x ⤳ x' → x = x' := by
    intro x x' hx hx' hxx'
    by_contra hne
    have hlt : x' < x := by
      refine lt_of_le_not_ge (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr hxx') (fun hle ↦ hne ?_)
      exact (hxx'.antisymm (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hle)).eq
    have := Order.coheight_add_one_le hlt
    rw [hcoh x hx, hcoh x' hx'] at this
    exact absurd this (by norm_num)
  let F := h.fiber y
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian F :=
    (inferInstance : IsLocallyNoetherian (Limits.pullback h (Y.fromSpecResidueField y)))
  haveI : AlgebraicGeometry.IsNoetherian F := {}
  have hincF : ∀ a b : F, a ⤳ b → a = b := by
    intro a b hab
    have ha : h (h.fiberι y a) = y := by
      have : h.fiberι y a ∈ Set.range (h.fiberι y) := ⟨a, rfl⟩
      rw [Scheme.Hom.range_fiberι] at this; exact this
    have hb : h (h.fiberι y b) = y := by
      have : h.fiberι y b ∈ Set.range (h.fiberι y) := ⟨b, rfl⟩
      rw [Scheme.Hom.range_fiberι] at this; exact this
    exact (h.fiberι y).isEmbedding.injective
      (hinc _ _ ha hb (hab.map (h.fiberι y).continuous))
  have hfinF : (Set.univ : Set F).Finite := by
    have hcomp := TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace.finite_irreducibleComponents (α := F)
    have hsub : ∀ C ∈ irreducibleComponents F, ({c : F | IsGenericPoint c C}).Subsingleton :=
      fun C _ a ha b hb ↦ ha.eq hb
    refine (hcomp.biUnion fun C hC ↦ (hsub C hC).finite).subset ?_
    intro x _
    obtain ⟨C, hC, hxC⟩ :=
      exists_mem_irreducibleComponents_subset_of_isIrreducible {x} isIrreducible_singleton
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := QuasiSober.sober hC.1
      (isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents C hC)
    have hgx : g ⤳ x := hg.specializes (hxC rfl)
    have := hincF g x hgx
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    exact ⟨C, hC, this ▸ hg⟩
  have := hfinF.image (h.fiberι y)
  rw [Set.image_univ, Scheme.Hom.range_fiberι] at this
  exact this

name: RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.exists_chart
statement:
theorem exists_chart [IsDominant h] [IsProper h] (hdeg : h.degree (genericPoint X) ≠ 0) (y : Y)
    (hy : coheight y = 1) :
    ∃ (U : Y.Opens) (W : X.Opens) (_ : IsAffineOpen U) (_ : IsAffineOpen W) (e : W ≤ h ⁻¹ᵁ U),
      y ∈ U ∧ W = h ⁻¹ᵁ U ∧ (h.appLE U W e).hom.Finite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hyV, hfinV⟩ :=
    exists_isFinite_morphismRestrict_of_finite_preimage_singleton h y (finite_fibre h hdeg y hy)
  obtain ⟨U', hU', hyU', -⟩ := exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (X := V.toScheme)
    (x := (⟨y, hyV⟩ : V)) (U := ⊤) (by simp)
  refine ⟨V.ι ''ᵁ U', (h ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι ''ᵁ ((h ∣_ V) ⁻¹ᵁ U'), hU'.image_of_isOpenImmersion V.ι,
    (hU'.preimage (h ∣_ V)).image_of_isOpenImmersion _,
    (image_morphismRestrict_preimage h V U').le, ⟨⟨y, hyV⟩, hyU', rfl⟩,
    image_morphismRestrict_preimage h V U', ?_⟩
  have := IsFinite.finite_app (h ∣_ V) U' hU'
  rw [morphismRestrict_app'] at this
  exact this

name: RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.length_stalk_quot_toNat
statement:
theorem length_stalk_quot_toNat (x : X) (y : Y) (hxy : h x = y) (b : X.presheaf.stalk x) :
    letI : Algebra (Y.presheaf.stalk y) (X.presheaf.stalk x)
proof:
:=
      (Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (specializes_of_eq hxy) ≫ h.stalkMap x).hom.toAlgebra
    (Module.length (Y.presheaf.stalk y) (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ Ideal.span {b})).toNat =
      (Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk x) (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ Ideal.span {b})).toNat *
        h.degree x := by
  letI iAC : Algebra (Y.presheaf.stalk y) (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    (Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (specializes_of_eq hxy) ≫ h.stalkMap x).hom.toAlgebra
  letI iAA' : Algebra (Y.presheaf.stalk y) (Y.presheaf.stalk (h x)) :=
    (Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (specializes_of_eq hxy)).hom.toAlgebra
  letI iA'C : Algebra (Y.presheaf.stalk (h x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    (h.stalkMap x).hom.toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower (Y.presheaf.stalk y) (Y.presheaf.stalk (h x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun _ ↦ rfl)
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk y) (Y.presheaf.stalk (h x))) :=
    (stalkSpecializes_bijective Y.presheaf hxy).2
  rw [Module.length_eq_of_surjective (S := Y.presheaf.stalk y) (R := Y.presheaf.stalk (h x))
    hsurj]
  haveI : IsLocalHom (algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk (h x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsLocalHom (h.stalkMap x).hom)
  rw [IsLocalRing.length_restrictScalars (Y.presheaf.stalk (h x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x)
    (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ Ideal.span {b}), ENat.toNat_mul]
  congr 1
  rw [Module.length_eq_rank, Cardinal.toNat_toENat]
  refine @Algebra.finrank_eq_of_equiv_equiv (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Y.presheaf.stalk (h x)))
    (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk x)) _ _ inferInstance
    (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Y.presheaf.stalk (h x)))
    (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk x)) _ _
    (RingHom.toAlgebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (h.stalkMap x).hom))
    (RingEquiv.refl _) (RingEquiv.refl _) ?_
  ext c
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective c
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom,
    RingEquiv.refl_apply]
  erw [IsLocalRing.ResidueField.algebraMap_residue]

name: RiemannRoch.ProperPushforwardNorm.local_sum
statement:
theorem local_sum [IsDominant h] [IsProper h] (hdeg : h.degree (genericPoint X) ≠ 0) (y : Y)
    (hy : coheight y = 1) (r : X.functionField) (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    letI
proof:
:= ffAlgebra h
    ∑ x ∈ (finite_fibre h hdeg y hy).toFinset, Scheme.ord r x * (h.degree x : ℤ) =
      Scheme.ord (Algebra.norm Y.functionField r) y := by
  classical
  letI := ffAlgebra h
  haveI hfd := finiteDimensional_of_degree h hdeg
  obtain ⟨U, W, hU, hW, e, hyU, hWeq, hfin⟩ := exists_chart h hdeg y hy
  set fib := (finite_fibre h hdeg y hy).toFinset with hfib
  have hfibmem : ∀ x, x ∈ fib ↔ h x = y := fun x ↦ by simp [hfib]
  have hfibW : ∀ x ∈ fib, x ∈ W := fun x hx ↦ by
    rw [hWeq]
    show h x ∈ U
    rw [(hfibmem x).mp hx]; exact hyU
  haveI : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨y, hyU⟩⟩
  have hηW : genericPoint X ∈ W := by
    rw [hWeq]; show h _ ∈ U; rw [map_genericPoint]; exact genericPoint_mem U
  haveI : Nonempty W := ⟨⟨_, hηW⟩⟩
  have hcoh : ∀ x ∈ fib, coheight x = 1 := fun x hx ↦
    coheight_eq_one_of_map h hdeg x (((hfibmem x).mp hx).symm ▸ hy)
  
  letI : Algebra Γ(Y, U) Γ(X, W) := (h.appLE U W e).hom.toAlgebra
  haveI : Module.Finite Γ(Y, U) Γ(X, W) := hfin
  haveI : IsFractionRing Γ(Y, U) Y.functionField :=
    functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen Y U hU
  haveI : IsFractionRing Γ(X, W) X.functionField :=
    functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen X W hW
  letI : Algebra Γ(Y, U) X.functionField :=
    ((algebraMap Y.functionField X.functionField).comp
      (algebraMap Γ(Y, U) Y.functionField)).toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(Y, U) Y.functionField X.functionField :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun _ ↦ rfl)
  haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(Y, U) Γ(X, W) X.functionField :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun r ↦ ffHom_germ h U W e r)
  set p := (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨y, hyU⟩).asIdeal with hp
  letI : Algebra Γ(Y, U) (Y.presheaf.stalk y) := Y.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk ⟨y, hyU⟩
  haveI : IsLocalization.AtPrime (Y.presheaf.stalk y) p := hU.isLocalization_stalk ⟨y, hyU⟩
  haveI : IsScalarTower Γ(Y, U) (Y.presheaf.stalk y) Y.functionField :=
    functionField_isScalarTower Y U ⟨y, hyU⟩
  haveI : Ring.KrullDimLE 1 (Y.presheaf.stalk y) := krullDimLE_of_coheight hy
  
  have hfibT : ∀ t : fib, h t.1 = y := fun t ↦ (hfibmem t.1).mp t.2
  let Q : fib → Ideal Γ(X, W) := fun t ↦ (hW.primeIdealOf ⟨t.1, hfibW t.1 t.2⟩).asIdeal
  letI instSD : ∀ t : fib, Algebra Γ(X, W) (X.presheaf.stalk t.1) := fun t ↦
    X.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk ⟨t.1, hfibW t.1 t.2⟩
  haveI : ∀ t : fib, IsLocalization.AtPrime (X.presheaf.stalk t.1) (Q t) := fun t ↦
    hW.isLocalization_stalk ⟨t.1, hfibW t.1 t.2⟩
  letI instAD : ∀ t : fib, Algebra (Y.presheaf.stalk y) (X.presheaf.stalk t.1) := fun t ↦
    (Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (specializes_of_eq (hfibT t)) ≫ h.stalkMap t.1).hom.toAlgebra
  have hDtower : ∀ (t : fib) (r : Γ(Y, U)),
      algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk y) (X.presheaf.stalk t.1)
        (algebraMap Γ(Y, U) (Y.presheaf.stalk y) r) =
      algebraMap Γ(X, W) (X.presheaf.stalk t.1) (algebraMap Γ(Y, U) Γ(X, W) r) := by
    intro t r
    change (h.stalkMap t.1).hom ((Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes _).hom
      (Y.presheaf.germ U y hyU r)) = X.presheaf.germ W t.1 _ (h.appLE U W e r)
    erw [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes_apply, Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply]
    rw [Scheme.Hom.appLE, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
    erw [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]
  have hprimeY : ∀ (z : Y) (hz : z ∈ U), z = y →
      hU.primeIdealOf ⟨z, hz⟩ = hU.primeIdealOf ⟨y, hyU⟩ := by
    intro z hz hzy; subst hzy; rfl
  have hQover : ∀ t, (Q t).comap (algebraMap Γ(Y, U) Γ(X, W)) = p := by
    intro t
    have h1 := IsAffineOpen.comap_primeIdealOf_appLE U hU W hW e (hfibW t.1 t.2)
    rw [hprimeY _ _ (hfibT t)] at h1
    rw [hp, ← h1, PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal]
    rfl
  have hQinj : Function.Injective Q := by
    intro t₁ t₂ hq
    have h1 : hW.primeIdealOf ⟨t₁.1, hfibW t₁.1 t₁.2⟩ = hW.primeIdealOf ⟨t₂.1, hfibW t₂.1 t₂.2⟩ :=
      PrimeSpectrum.ext hq
    have h2 := congrArg hW.fromSpec h1
    rw [hW.fromSpec_primeIdealOf, hW.fromSpec_primeIdealOf] at h2
    exact Subtype.ext h2
  have hQsurj : ∀ Q' : Ideal Γ(X, W), Q'.IsPrime →
      Q'.comap (algebraMap Γ(Y, U) Γ(X, W)) = p → ∃ t, Q t = Q' := by
    intro Q' hQ' hQ'p
    let P : PrimeSpectrum Γ(X, W) := ⟨Q', hQ'⟩
    have hxW : hW.fromSpec P ∈ W := by
      have : hW.fromSpec P ∈ Set.range hW.fromSpec := ⟨P, rfl⟩
      rw [hW.range_fromSpec] at this; exact this
    have hPx : hW.primeIdealOf ⟨hW.fromSpec P, hxW⟩ = P :=
      hW.fromSpec.isOpenEmbedding.injective (by rw [hW.fromSpec_primeIdealOf])
    have hxy : h (hW.fromSpec P) = y := by
      have h1 := IsAffineOpen.comap_primeIdealOf_appLE U hU W hW e hxW
      rw [hPx] at h1
      have h2 : PrimeSpectrum.comap (h.appLE U W e).hom P = hU.primeIdealOf ⟨y, hyU⟩ := by
        ext1; rw [PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal]; exact hQ'p
      rw [h2] at h1
      have h3 := congrArg hU.fromSpec h1
      rw [hU.fromSpec_primeIdealOf, hU.fromSpec_primeIdealOf] at h3
      exact h3.symm
    have hxfib : hW.fromSpec P ∈ fib := (hfibmem _).mpr hxy
    refine ⟨⟨_, hxfib⟩, ?_⟩
    change (hW.primeIdealOf ⟨hW.fromSpec P, hfibW _ hxfib⟩).asIdeal = Q'
    rw [hPx]
  
  have key : ∀ b : Γ(X, W), b ≠ 0 →
      ∑ x ∈ fib, Scheme.ord (algebraMap Γ(X, W) X.functionField b) x * (h.degree x : ℤ) =
        Scheme.ord (Algebra.norm Y.functionField (algebraMap Γ(X, W) X.functionField b)) y := by
    intro b hb
    obtain ⟨hfinsum, hnorm⟩ := local_formula (R := Γ(Y, U)) (S := Γ(X, W))
      (K := Y.functionField) (L := X.functionField) p (A := Y.presheaf.stalk y) Q
      (fun t : fib ↦ X.presheaf.stalk t.1) hDtower hQover hQinj hQsurj b hb
    have hgerm : ∀ t : fib, algebraMap Γ(X, W) (X.presheaf.stalk t.1) b ≠ 0 := fun t ↦ by
      intro h0
      exact hb (germ_injective_of_isIntegral X t.1 (hfibW t.1 t.2) (h0.trans (map_zero _).symm))
    have hterm : ∀ t : fib, Scheme.ord (algebraMap Γ(X, W) X.functionField b) t.1 *
        (h.degree t.1 : ℤ) =
        ((Module.length (Y.presheaf.stalk y) (X.presheaf.stalk t.1 ⧸
          Ideal.span {algebraMap Γ(X, W) (X.presheaf.stalk t.1) b})).toNat : ℤ) := by
      intro t
      have e1 := Scheme.ord_algebraMap_eq_length_toNat (hcoh t.1 t.2) _ (hgerm t)
      have e2 : algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk t.1) X.functionField
          (algebraMap Γ(X, W) (X.presheaf.stalk t.1) b) =
          algebraMap Γ(X, W) X.functionField b :=
        Scheme.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField (hfibW t.1 t.2) b
      rw [e2] at e1
      rw [e1]
      have e3 := length_stalk_quot_toNat h t.1 y (hfibT t)
        (algebraMap Γ(X, W) (X.presheaf.stalk t.1) b)
      rw [e3]
      push_cast
      rfl
    rw [← Finset.sum_coe_sort fib]
    simp_rw [hterm]
    have hsumNat : ((∑ t : fib, Module.length (Y.presheaf.stalk y) (X.presheaf.stalk t.1 ⧸
        Ideal.span {algebraMap Γ(X, W) (X.presheaf.stalk t.1) b})).toNat : ℤ) =
        ∑ t : fib, ((Module.length (Y.presheaf.stalk y) (X.presheaf.stalk t.1 ⧸
          Ideal.span {algebraMap Γ(X, W) (X.presheaf.stalk t.1) b})).toNat : ℤ) := by
      have hne : ∀ t ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset fib), Module.length (Y.presheaf.stalk y)
          (X.presheaf.stalk t.1 ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap Γ(X, W) (X.presheaf.stalk t.1) b}) ≠ ⊤ :=
        fun t _ h0 ↦ hfinsum (by
          have := Finset.single_le_sum (s := Finset.univ)
            (f := fun t : fib ↦ Module.length (Y.presheaf.stalk y)
              (X.presheaf.stalk t.1 ⧸ Ideal.span {algebraMap Γ(X, W) (X.presheaf.stalk t.1) b}))
            (fun _ _ ↦ zero_le) (Finset.mem_univ t)
          rw [h0] at this
          exact top_unique this)
      rw [← Nat.cast_sum]
      congr 1
      rw [← ENat.toNat_coe (∑ t : fib, _), Nat.cast_sum]
      congr 1
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t ht ↦ (ENat.coe_toNat (hne t ht)).symm
    rw [← hsumNat]
    have hN : Algebra.norm Y.functionField (algebraMap Γ(X, W) X.functionField b) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Algebra.norm_ne_zero_iff]
      exact (map_ne_zero_iff _ (IsFractionRing.injective _ _)).mpr hb
    symm
    rw [Scheme.ord_eq_iff hy hN]
    exact hnorm
  
  obtain ⟨a, c, hc, rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective (A := Γ(X, W)) r
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hc
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hr
  have haL : algebraMap Γ(X, W) X.functionField a ≠ 0 :=
    (map_ne_zero_iff _ (IsFractionRing.injective _ _)).mpr ha0
  have hcL : algebraMap Γ(X, W) X.functionField c ≠ 0 :=
    (map_ne_zero_iff _ (IsFractionRing.injective _ _)).mpr hc0
  have hsplit : ∀ x ∈ fib, Scheme.ord (algebraMap Γ(X, W) X.functionField a /
      algebraMap Γ(X, W) X.functionField c) x * (h.degree x : ℤ) =
      Scheme.ord (algebraMap Γ(X, W) X.functionField a) x * (h.degree x : ℤ) -
        Scheme.ord (algebraMap Γ(X, W) X.functionField c) x * (h.degree x : ℤ) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Scheme.ord_div (hcoh x hx) _ _ haL hcL]
    ring
  have hNc : Algebra.norm Y.functionField (algebraMap Γ(X, W) X.functionField c) ≠ 0 :=
    (Algebra.norm_ne_zero_iff).mpr hcL
  have hNdiv : Algebra.norm Y.functionField (algebraMap Γ(X, W) X.functionField a /
      algebraMap Γ(X, W) X.functionField c) =
      Algebra.norm Y.functionField (algebraMap Γ(X, W) X.functionField a) /
        Algebra.norm Y.functionField (algebraMap Γ(X, W) X.functionField c) :=
    eq_div_of_mul_eq hNc (by rw [← map_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hcL])
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hsplit, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, key a ha0, key c hc0, hNdiv,
    Scheme.ord_div hy _ _ ((Algebra.norm_ne_zero_iff).mpr haL) hNc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.finrank_functionField_eq_degree
statement:
theorem finrank_functionField_eq_degree :
    letI
proof:
:= functionFieldAlgebra h
    Module.finrank Y.functionField X.functionField = h.degree (genericPoint X) := by
  letI := ffAlgebra h
  set ψ := Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (specializes_of_eq (map_genericPoint h)) with hψ
  have hψb : Function.Bijective ψ.hom := stalkSpecializes_bijective Y.presheaf (map_genericPoint h)
  let eψ := RingEquiv.ofBijective ψ.hom hψb
  have hOfield : IsField (Y.presheaf.stalk (h (genericPoint X))) :=
    MulEquiv.isField (Field.toIsField Y.functionField) eψ.symm.toMulEquiv
  have hLfield : IsField X.functionField := Field.toIsField _
  let i := eψ.trans (RingEquiv.ofBijective _ (residue_bijective_of_isField hOfield))
  let j := RingEquiv.ofBijective _ (residue_bijective_of_isField hLfield)
  letI : Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Y.presheaf.stalk (h (genericPoint X))))
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X))) :=
    RingHom.toAlgebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (h.stalkMap (genericPoint X)).hom)
  have hcompat : (algebraMap (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Y.presheaf.stalk (h (genericPoint X))))
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X)))).comp i.toRingHom =
      j.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap Y.functionField X.functionField) := by
    ext k
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom]
    change IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (h.stalkMap (genericPoint X)).hom
      (IsLocalRing.residue _ (ψ.hom k)) = IsLocalRing.residue _ ((ffHom h).hom k)
    rw [IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map_residue]
    rfl
  rw [Algebra.finrank_eq_of_equiv_equiv i j hcompat]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.properPushforward_div_eq_div_norm
statement:
theorem properPushforward_div_eq_div_norm (r : X.functionField) (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (hdeg : h.degree (genericPoint X) ≠ 0)
    (hcodim : ∀ w : X, coheight w = 1 → h.degree w ≠ 0 → coheight (h w) = 1) :
    letI
proof:
:= functionFieldAlgebra h
    properPushforward h (div r) = div (Algebra.norm Y.functionField r) := by
  letI := ffAlgebra h
  haveI := finiteDimensional_of_degree h hdeg
  ext y
  change properPushforward h (div r) y = div (Algebra.norm Y.functionField r) y
  by_cases hy : coheight y = 1
  · have hfib := finite_fibre h hdeg y hy
    have hmem : ∀ x ∈ hfib.toFinset, h x = y := fun x hx ↦ hfib.mem_toFinset.mp hx
    rw [properPushforward_apply_eq_sum_of_subset h (div r) y hfib.toFinset
      (fun x hx _ ↦ hfib.mem_toFinset.mpr hx), Finset.sum_filter,
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x hx ↦ if_pos (hmem x hx))]
    simp only [div_eq_ord]
    exact local_sum h hdeg y hy r hr
  · rw [div_eq_ord, Scheme.ord_eq_zero_of_coheight_neq_one hy, properPushforward_apply]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hxy, hdx⟩ := (mem_preimageSupportFinite_toFinset_iff h (div r) y x).mp hx
    by_cases hdeg0 : h.degree x = 0
    · simp [hdeg0]
    · exact absurd (hxy ▸ hcodim x (div_support hdx) hdeg0) hy

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.exists_properPushforward_div_eq_div
statement:
theorem exists_properPushforward_div_eq_div (r : X.functionField) (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (hdeg : h.degree (genericPoint X) ≠ 0)
    (hcodim : ∀ w : X, coheight w = 1 → h.degree w ≠ 0 → coheight (h w) = 1) :
    ∃ s : Y.functionField, s ≠ 0 ∧ properPushforward h (div r) = div s
proof:
:= by
  letI := functionFieldAlgebra h
  haveI := finiteDimensional_of_degree h hdeg
  exact ⟨Algebra.norm Y.functionField r, (Algebra.norm_ne_zero_iff).mpr hr,
    properPushforward_div_eq_div_norm h r hr hdeg hcodim⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalRelationGenerator.postcompose_i
statement:
@[simp]
theorem postcompose_i {Z X : Scheme.{u}} {p q : ℕ}
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator Z p) (j : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    (codimension : ∀ y : g.Y, coheight y = 1 → coheight ((g.i ≫ j) y) = q) :
    (g.postcompose j codimension).i = g.i ≫ j
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalRelationGenerator.postcompose_f
statement:
@[simp]
theorem postcompose_f {Z X : Scheme.{u}} {p q : ℕ}
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator Z p) (j : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    (codimension : ∀ y : g.Y, coheight y = 1 → coheight ((g.i ≫ j) y) = q) :
    (g.postcompose j codimension).f = g.f
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalRelationGenerator.postcompose_cycle_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem postcompose_cycle_apply {Z X : Scheme.{u}} {p q : ℕ}
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator Z p) (j : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    (codimension : ∀ y : g.Y, coheight y = 1 → coheight ((g.i ≫ j) y) = q)
    (y : g.Y) :
    (g.postcompose j codimension).cycle.1 (j (g.i y)) = div g.f y
proof:
:= by
  have hi : (g.postcompose j codimension).i y = j (g.i y) := by
    change (g.i ≫ j) y = j (g.i y)
    exact Scheme.Hom.comp_apply g.i j y
  have hc := cycle_apply_i (g.postcompose j codimension) y
  rw [hi, postcompose_f] at hc
  exact hc

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalRelationGenerator.postcompose_cycle_support
statement:
theorem postcompose_cycle_support {Z X : Scheme.{u}} {p q : ℕ}
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator Z p) (j : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    (codimension : ∀ y : g.Y, coheight y = 1 → coheight ((g.i ≫ j) y) = q) :
    (g.postcompose j codimension).cycle.1.support =
      j '' (g.i '' (div g.f).support)
proof:
:= by
  have hs := cycle_support (g.postcompose j codimension)
  rw [postcompose_i, postcompose_f] at hs
  rw [hs]
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_image]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
    exact ⟨g.i y, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, by rwa [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]⟩
  · rintro ⟨z, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, hzx⟩
    refine ⟨y, hy, ?_⟩
    exact (Scheme.Hom.comp_apply g.i j y).trans hzx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalRelationGenerator.postcompose_cycle_eq_pushforward
statement:
theorem postcompose_cycle_eq_pushforward {Z X : Scheme.{u}} {p q : ℕ}
    (g : RationalRelationGenerator Z p) (j : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    (codimension : ∀ y : g.Y, coheight y = 1 → coheight ((g.i ≫ j) y) = q) :
    (g.postcompose j codimension).cycle.1 =
      AlgebraicCycle.pushforward j g.cycle.1 (fun _ ↦ (q : ℕ∞)) coheight
proof:
:= by
  have hp : ∀ y : g.Y, div g.f y ≠ 0 →
      (p : ℕ∞) = coheight (g.i y) := by
    intro y hy
    exact (g.codimension y (div_support hy)).symm
  have hq : ∀ y : g.Y, div g.f y ≠ 0 →
      (q : ℕ∞) = (q : ℕ∞) := by
    intro y hy
    rfl
  have hfirst := AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_eq_closedImmersion g.i (div g.f)
    (fun _ ↦ (p : ℕ∞)) coheight (fun _ ↦ (q : ℕ∞)) (fun _ ↦ (q : ℕ∞)) hp hq
  have hjgrade : ∀ z : Z,
      AlgebraicCycle.pushforward g.i (div g.f) (fun _ ↦ (q : ℕ∞))
        (fun _ ↦ (q : ℕ∞)) z ≠ 0 → (q : ℕ∞) = coheight (j z) := by
    intro z hz
    have hzmem : z ∈ (AlgebraicCycle.pushforward g.i (div g.f)
        (fun _ ↦ (q : ℕ∞)) (fun _ ↦ (q : ℕ∞))).support := hz
    rw [AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_support_closedImmersion g.i (div g.f)
      (fun _ ↦ (q : ℕ∞)) (fun _ ↦ (q : ℕ∞)) hq] at hzmem
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hzmem
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    exact (codimension y (div_support hy)).symm
  change AlgebraicCycle.pushforward (g.i ≫ j) (div g.f)
      (fun _ ↦ (q : ℕ∞)) coheight =
    AlgebraicCycle.pushforward j
      (AlgebraicCycle.pushforward g.i (div g.f) (fun _ ↦ (p : ℕ∞)) coheight)
      (fun _ ↦ (q : ℕ∞)) coheight
  rw [AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_comp_closedImmersion g.i j (div g.f)
    (fun _ ↦ (q : ℕ∞)) (fun _ ↦ (q : ℕ∞)) coheight hq hjgrade, ← hfirst]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.pointClosureIdeal_ideal
statement:
theorem pointClosureIdeal_ideal (w : X) (U : X.affineOpens) (hw : w ∈ U.1) :
    (pointClosureIdeal w).ideal U = (U.2.primeIdealOf ⟨w, hw⟩).asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : U.2.fromSpec ⁻¹' ({w} : Set X) = {U.2.primeIdealOf ⟨w, hw⟩} := by
    ext q
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    constructor
    · intro hq
      exact U.2.fromSpec.isOpenEmbedding.injective
        (hq.trans (U.2.fromSpec_primeIdealOf ⟨w, hw⟩).symm)
    · rintro rfl
      exact U.2.fromSpec_primeIdealOf ⟨w, hw⟩
  have hpre : U.2.fromSpec ⁻¹' (closure {w} : Set X)
      = PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (U.2.primeIdealOf ⟨w, hw⟩).asIdeal := by
    rw [U.2.fromSpec.isOpenEmbedding.isOpenMap.preimage_closure_eq_closure_preimage
      U.2.fromSpec.continuous, h2]
    exact PrimeSpectrum.closure_singleton _
  exact (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal_ideal (pointClosure w) U).trans
    ((congrArg PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal hpre).trans
      ((PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus_eq_radical _).trans
        (U.2.primeIdealOf ⟨w, hw⟩).isPrime.radical))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.stalk_pointClosureIdeal
statement:
theorem stalk_pointClosureIdeal {w x : X} (h : w ⤳ x) :
    (pointClosureIdeal w).stalk x = Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h
proof:
:= by
  set U : X.affineOpens :=
    ⟨(X.affineCover.f (X.affineCover.idx x)).opensRange, isAffineOpen_opensRange _⟩ with hUdef
  have hxU : x ∈ U.1 := X.affineCover.covers x
  have hwU : w ∈ U.1 := h.mem_open U.1.2 hxU
  letI algx : Algebra Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x) := X.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk ⟨x, hxU⟩
  letI algw : Algebra Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk w) := X.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk ⟨w, hwU⟩
  haveI hlx := U.2.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hxU⟩
  haveI hlw := U.2.isLocalization_stalk ⟨w, hwU⟩
  have hcomap : (Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h).comap
      (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) = (U.2.primeIdealOf ⟨w, hwU⟩).asIdeal := by
    rw [Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes, Ideal.comap_comap]
    have hgerm : (X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom.comp
        (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x))
        = algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk w) := by
      show (X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom.comp (X.presheaf.germ U.1 x hxU).hom
          = (X.presheaf.germ U.1 w hwU).hom
      rw [← CommRingCat.hom_comp, X.presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes]
    rw [hgerm]
    exact IsLocalization.AtPrime.under_maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk w) _
  calc (pointClosureIdeal w).stalk x
      = ((pointClosureIdeal w).ideal U).map (X.presheaf.germ U.1 x hxU).hom :=
        Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalk_eq _ hxU
    _ = ((Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h).comap
          (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x))).map
          (algebraMap Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :=
        congrArg (fun J => Ideal.map (X.presheaf.germ U.1 x hxU).hom J)
          ((pointClosureIdeal_ideal w U hwU).trans hcomap.symm)
    _ = Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h :=
        IsLocalization.map_under (U.2.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxU⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl _
          (Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.stalk_pointClosureIdeal_eq_top
statement:
theorem stalk_pointClosureIdeal_eq_top {w x : X} (h : ¬ w ⤳ x) :
    (pointClosureIdeal w).stalk x = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hxV : x ∈ (⟨(closure {w})ᶜ, isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl⟩ : X.Opens) := fun hx =>
    h (specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr hx)
  obtain ⟨V, hVaff, hxV', hVsub⟩ :=
    TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens hxV
  set U : X.affineOpens := ⟨V, hVaff⟩ with hUdef
  have hempty : U.2.fromSpec ⁻¹' (closure {w} : Set X) = ∅ := by
    ext q
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
    intro hq
    have h0 : U.2.fromSpec q ∈ Set.range (U.2.fromSpec : Spec Γ(X, U) → X) :=
      Set.mem_range_self q
    rw [U.2.range_fromSpec] at h0
    exact hVsub h0 hq
  have hideal : (pointClosureIdeal w).ideal U = ⊤ :=
    (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal_ideal (pointClosure w) U).trans
      ((congrArg PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal hempty).trans PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal_empty)
  calc (pointClosureIdeal w).stalk x
      = ((pointClosureIdeal w).ideal U).map (X.presheaf.germ U.1 x hxV').hom :=
        Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalk_eq _ hxV'
    _ = (⊤ : Ideal Γ(X, U)).map (X.presheaf.germ U.1 x hxV').hom :=
        congrArg (fun J => Ideal.map (X.presheaf.germ U.1 x hxV').hom J) hideal
    _ = ⊤ := Ideal.map_top _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.idealSheafIsLocallyPrincipal_pointClosureIdeal
statement:
theorem idealSheafIsLocallyPrincipal_pointClosureIdeal [IsLocallyNoetherian X] {w : X}
    (hstalk : ∀ (x : X) (h : w ⤳ x),
      Submodule.IsPrincipal (Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h)) :
    IdealSheafIsLocallyPrincipal (pointClosureIdeal w)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  have hprin : ∃ c : X.presheaf.stalk x, (pointClosureIdeal w).stalk x = Ideal.span {c} := by
    by_cases h : w ⤳ x
    · haveI := hstalk x h
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.IsPrincipal.principal (Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h)
      exact ⟨c, (stalk_pointClosureIdeal h).trans hc⟩
    · exact ⟨1, (stalk_pointClosureIdeal_eq_top h).trans Ideal.span_singleton_one.symm⟩
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, a, ha⟩ :=
    (pointClosureIdeal w).exists_ideal_eq_span_of_stalk_eq_span hprin
  exact ⟨U, hxU, a, ha⟩

name: IsRegularLocalRing.isPrincipal_of_height_one_of_ringKrullDim_le_two
statement:
theorem isPrincipal_of_height_one_of_ringKrullDim_le_two (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    [IsRegularLocalRing R] (hdim : ringKrullDim R ≤ 2) (p : Ideal R) [hp : p.IsPrime]
    (hph : p.height = 1) : Submodule.IsPrincipal p
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsDomain R := isDomain_of_isRegularLocalRing R
  by_cases hpm : p = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R
  · subst hpm
    have h1 : ringKrullDim R = 1 := by
      rw [← IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim, hph]
      rfl
    haveI := isDiscreteValuationRing_of_ringKrullDim_eq_one (R := R) h1
    exact IsPrincipalIdealRing.principal _
  · have hlt : p < IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (IsLocalRing.le_maximalIdeal_of_isPrime p) hpm
    have h3 : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).height := by
      have hstep := Ideal.height_add_one_le_of_lt_of_isPrime hlt
      rw [hph] at hstep
      exact_mod_cast hstep
    have h2 : (2 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ ringKrullDim R := by
      rw [← IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_height_eq_ringKrullDim]
      exact WithBot.coe_le_coe.mpr h3
    exact isPrincipal_of_height_one (le_antisymm hdim h2) p hph

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.idealSheafIsLocallyPrincipal_pointClosureIdeal_of_regular
statement:
theorem idealSheafIsLocallyPrincipal_pointClosureIdeal_of_regular
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [Order.KrullDimLE 2 X] {w : X}
    (hreg : ∀ x : X, w ⤳ x → IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (hw : Order.coheight w = 1) :
    IdealSheafIsLocallyPrincipal (pointClosureIdeal w)
proof:
:= by
  refine idealSheafIsLocallyPrincipal_pointClosureIdeal (fun x h => ?_)
  haveI := hreg x h
  refine IsRegularLocalRing.isPrincipal_of_height_one_of_ringKrullDim_le_two
    (X.presheaf.stalk x) ?_ _ ?_
  · have hb : ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x) ≤ ((2 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
      rw [ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight]
      exact (Order.coheight_le_krullDim x).trans
        (Order.KrullDimLE.krullDim_le (n := 2) (α := X))
    have hc : ((2 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) = (2 : WithBot ℕ∞) := by norm_cast
    rw [hc] at hb
    exact hb
  · rw [Scheme.height_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes, hw]

statement:
theorem isLocallyPrincipalClosedImmersion_pointClosureι_of_regular

theorem idealSheafOpenPullbackIso_hom_subschemeCover

    (idealSheafOpenPullbackIso I U).hom ≫ I.subschemeCover.f U =
      pullback.fst I.subschemeι U.1.ι
proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.idealSheafOpenPullbackIso_hom_quotient
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem idealSheafOpenPullbackIso_hom_quotient
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (I : X.IdealSheafData) (U : X.affineOpens) :
    (idealSheafOpenPullbackIso I U).hom ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.ideal U))) =
    pullback.snd I.subschemeι U.1.ι ≫ U.2.isoSpec.hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono U.2.isoSpec.inv]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
  change (idealSheafOpenPullbackIso I U).hom ≫ I.glueDataObjι U =
    pullback.snd I.subschemeι U.1.ι
  rw [← cancel_mono U.1.ι]
  rw [Category.assoc, ← I.subschemeCover_map_subschemeι U, ← Category.assoc,
    idealSheafOpenPullbackIso_hom_subschemeCover, pullback.condition]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.idealSheafPrincipalOpenPullbackIso_hom_quotient
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem idealSheafPrincipalOpenPullbackIso_hom_quotient
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (I : X.IdealSheafData) (U : X.affineOpens)
    (a : Γ(X, U)) (h : I.ideal U = Ideal.span {a}) :
    (idealSheafPrincipalOpenPullbackIso I U a h).hom ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a}))) =
    pullback.snd I.subschemeι U.1.ι ≫ U.2.isoSpec.hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [idealSheafPrincipalOpenPullbackIso, Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc]
  simp only [Functor.mapIso_hom, Iso.op_hom, Scheme.Spec_map,
    Quiver.Hom.unop_op]
  rw [← Spec.map_comp]
  have hcomp : (Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq Γ(X, U) h).symm.toRingEquiv.toRingHom.comp
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a})) = Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.ideal U) := by
    ext r
    simp [Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq_symm]
  have hcompCat : CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a})) ≫
      (Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq Γ(X, U) h).symm.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.hom =
      CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.ideal U)) := by
    ext r
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun hcomp r
  rw [hcompCat]
  exact idealSheafOpenPullbackIso_hom_quotient I U
