theorem exists_stalk_generator_of_isLocallyPrincipalClosedImmersion
    {Z X : Scheme.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion f]
    (hf : IsLocallyPrincipalClosedImmersion f) (z : Z) :
    ∃ a : X.presheaf.stalk (f z),
      RingHom.ker (f.stalkMap z).hom = Ideal.span {a}
proof:
:= by
  let eZ : Z ≅ f.image := asIso f.toImage
  have hcomm : eZ.hom ≫ f.imageι = f ≫ (Iso.refl X).hom := by
    simp [eZ, Scheme.Hom.toImage_imageι]
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hf.exists_stalk_generator (eZ.hom z)
  exact ⟨principalStalkElementOfArrowIso f f.imageι eZ (Iso.refl X) hcomm z a,
    ker_stalkMap_eq_span_of_arrow_iso f f.imageι eZ (Iso.refl X) hcomm z a ha⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.exists_stalkElement_div_eq_morphismLocalLength_toNat
statement:
theorem exists_stalkElement_div_eq_morphismLocalLength_toNat
    {Z X : Scheme.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion f]
    [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hf : IsLocallyPrincipalClosedImmersion f) (z : Z)
    (hker : RingHom.ker (f.stalkMap z).hom ≠ ⊥)
    (hz : Order.coheight (f z) = 1) :
    ∃ a : X.presheaf.stalk (f z), a ≠ 0 ∧
      div (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (f z)) X.functionField a) (f z) =
        ((morphismLocalLength f z).toNat : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_stalk_generator_of_isLocallyPrincipalClosedImmersion f hf z
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hker
    rw [ha, h]
    simp
  exact ⟨a, ha0, div_algebraMap_eq_morphismLocalLength_toNat f z hz a ha0 ha⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution.coneD_sq
statement:
lemma coneD_sq (d : BoundedProjectiveResolution A M) (r : A) (n : ℕ) :
    d.coneD r (n + 1) ≫ d.coneD r n = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      change d.K.d 1 0 (d.K.d 2 1 x.1 + r • x.2) + r • (-(d.K.d 1 0 x.2)) = 0
      rw [map_add, map_smul]
      have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (d.K.d_comp_d 2 1 0) x.1
      change d.K.d 1 0 (d.K.d 2 1 x.1) = 0 at h
      rw [h]
      module
  | succ n =>
      apply Prod.ext
      · change d.K.d (n + 2) (n + 1)
            (d.K.d (n + 3) (n + 2) x.1 + r • x.2) +
            r • (-(d.K.d (n + 2) (n + 1) x.2)) = 0
        rw [map_add, map_smul]
        have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
          (d.K.d_comp_d (n + 3) (n + 2) (n + 1)) x.1
        change d.K.d (n + 2) (n + 1) (d.K.d (n + 3) (n + 2) x.1) = 0 at h
        rw [h]
        module
      · change -(d.K.d (n + 1) n (-(d.K.d (n + 2) (n + 1) x.2))) = 0
        rw [map_neg]
        have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
          (d.K.d_comp_d (n + 2) (n + 1) n) x.2
        change d.K.d (n + 1) n (d.K.d (n + 2) (n + 1) x.2) = 0 at h
        rw [h]
        simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution.coneComplex_d_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coneComplex_d_zero (d : BoundedProjectiveResolution A M) (r : A) :
    (d.coneComplex r).d 1 0 = d.coneDZero r
proof:
:= by
  change ChainComplex.of.d d.coneX (d.coneD r) 1 0 = d.coneDZero r
  change ChainComplex.of.d d.coneX (d.coneD r) (0 + 1) 0 = d.coneDZero r
  rw [ChainComplex.of_d]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution.coneComplex_d_succ
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coneComplex_d_succ (d : BoundedProjectiveResolution A M) (r : A) (n : ℕ) :
    (d.coneComplex r).d (n + 2) (n + 1) = d.coneDSucc r n
proof:
:= by
  change ChainComplex.of.d d.coneX (d.coneD r) (n + 2) (n + 1) = d.coneDSucc r n
  change ChainComplex.of.d d.coneX (d.coneD r) ((n + 1) + 1) (n + 1) =
    d.coneDSucc r n
  rw [ChainComplex.of_d]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution.coneComplex_isZero
statement:
theorem coneComplex_isZero (d : BoundedProjectiveResolution A M) (r : A)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : d.bound + 1 < n) : IsZero ((d.coneComplex r).X n)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n =>
      change IsZero (ModuleCat.of A (d.K.X (n + 1) × d.K.X n))
      apply ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mpr
      have h₁ : IsZero (d.K.X (n + 1)) := d.isZero (n + 1) (by omega)
      have h₂ : IsZero (d.K.X n) := d.isZero n (by omega)
      haveI : Subsingleton (d.K.X (n + 1)) :=
        ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp h₁
      haveI : Subsingleton (d.K.X n) :=
        ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp h₂
      infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution.cone_d_comp_augmentation
statement:
lemma cone_d_comp_augmentation (d : BoundedProjectiveResolution A M) (r : A) :
    d.coneD r 0 ≫ ModuleCat.ofHom (d.coneAugmentationLinear r) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change (Submodule.Quotient.mk
    (d.resolution.π.f 0 (d.K.d 1 0 x.1 + r • x.2)) : QuotSMulTop r M) = 0
  rw [map_add, map_smul]
  have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom d.resolution.complex_d_comp_π_f_zero x.1
  change d.resolution.π.f 0 (d.K.d 1 0 x.1) = 0 at h
  rw [h, zero_add]
  apply (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero (r • (⊤ : Submodule A M))).mpr
  exact Submodule.smul_mem_pointwise_smul _ _ ⊤ trivial

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution.cone_augmentation_exact
statement:
theorem cone_augmentation_exact (d : BoundedProjectiveResolution A M) (r : A) :
    (ShortComplex.moduleCatMk (d.coneDZero r).hom (d.coneAugmentationLinear r)
      (by
        apply LinearMap.ext
        intro x
        exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (d.cone_d_comp_augmentation r) x)).Exact
proof:
:= by
  rw [ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff]
  intro x hx
  change d.K.X 0 at x
  change (Submodule.Quotient.mk
    (d.resolution.π.f 0 x) : QuotSMulTop r M) = 0 at hx
  have hmem : d.resolution.π.f 0 x ∈ r • (⊤ : Submodule A M) :=
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero (r • (⊤ : Submodule A M))).mp hx
  rcases (Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists _ r (⊤ : Submodule A M)).mp hmem with
    ⟨m, -, hm⟩
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (d.resolution.π.f 0) :=
    (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mp inferInstance
  rcases hsurj m with ⟨y, hy⟩
  have hker : d.resolution.π.f 0 (x - r • y) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, map_smul, hy]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hm.symm
  have hExact := d.resolution.exact₀
  rw [ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff] at hExact
  have hExact' : ∀ x : d.K.X 0, d.resolution.π.f 0 x = 0 →
      ∃ z : d.K.X 1, d.K.d 1 0 z = x := by
    simpa only using hExact
  rcases hExact' (x - r • y) hker with ⟨z, hz⟩
  refine ⟨(z, y), ?_⟩
  change d.K.d 1 0 z + r • y = x
  rw [hz]
  abel

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution.resolution_exact_lift
statement:
lemma resolution_exact_lift (d : BoundedProjectiveResolution A M) (n : ℕ)
    (x : d.K.X (n + 1)) (hx : d.K.d (n + 1) n x = 0) :
    ∃ z : d.K.X (n + 2), d.K.d (n + 2) (n + 1) z = x
proof:
:= by
  have hExact := d.resolution.exact_succ n
  rw [ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff] at hExact
  simpa only using hExact x hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution.resolution_exact_zero_lift
statement:
lemma resolution_exact_zero_lift (d : BoundedProjectiveResolution A M)
    (x : d.K.X 0) (hx : d.resolution.π.f 0 x = 0) :
    ∃ z : d.K.X 1, d.K.d 1 0 z = x
proof:
:= by
  have hExact := d.resolution.exact₀
  rw [ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff] at hExact
  simpa only using hExact x hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution.coneComplex_exactAt_succ
statement:
theorem coneComplex_exactAt_succ (d : BoundedProjectiveResolution A M) (r : A)
    (reg : IsSMulRegular M r) (n : ℕ) :
    (d.coneComplex r).ExactAt (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      rw [HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff' _ 2 1 0 (by simp) (by simp)]
      rw [ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff]
      intro x hx
      change d.K.X 1 × d.K.X 0 at x
      change d.K.d 1 0 x.1 + r • x.2 = 0 at hx
      have hrπ : r • d.resolution.π.f 0 x.2 = 0 := by
        have h := congrArg (d.resolution.π.f 0) hx
        rw [map_add, map_smul, map_zero] at h
        have hdπ := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
          d.resolution.complex_d_comp_π_f_zero x.1
        change d.resolution.π.f 0 (d.K.d 1 0 x.1) = 0 at hdπ
        rwa [hdπ, zero_add] at h
      have hπ : d.resolution.π.f 0 x.2 = 0 := reg.right_eq_zero_of_smul hrπ
      rcases d.resolution_exact_zero_lift x.2 hπ with ⟨z, hz⟩
      have hcycle : d.K.d 1 0 (x.1 + r • z) = 0 := by
        rw [map_add, map_smul, hz]
        exact hx
      rcases d.resolution_exact_lift 0 (x.1 + r • z) hcycle with ⟨w, hw⟩
      refine ⟨(w, -z), ?_⟩
      change (d.K.d 2 1 w + r • (-z), -(d.K.d 1 0 (-z))) = x
      apply Prod.ext
      · rw [hw, smul_neg]
        abel
      · rw [map_neg, hz]
        simp
  | succ n =>
      rw [HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff' _ (n + 3) (n + 2) (n + 1)
        (by simp) (by simp)]
      rw [ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff]
      intro x hx
      change d.K.X (n + 2) × d.K.X (n + 1) at x
      change (d.coneComplex r).d (n + 2) (n + 1) x = 0 at hx
      rw [d.coneComplex_d_succ r n] at hx
      have hfirst := congrArg Prod.fst hx
      have hsecond := congrArg Prod.snd hx
      change d.K.d (n + 2) (n + 1) x.1 + r • x.2 = 0 at hfirst
      change -(d.K.d (n + 1) n x.2) = 0 at hsecond
      have hx₂ : d.K.d (n + 1) n x.2 = 0 := neg_eq_zero.mp hsecond
      rcases d.resolution_exact_lift n x.2 hx₂ with ⟨z, hz⟩
      have hcycle : d.K.d (n + 2) (n + 1) (x.1 + r • z) = 0 := by
        rw [map_add, map_smul, hz]
        exact hfirst
      rcases d.resolution_exact_lift (n + 1) (x.1 + r • z) hcycle with ⟨w, hw⟩
      refine ⟨(w, -z), ?_⟩
      change (d.coneComplex r).d (n + 3) (n + 2) (w, -z) = x
      rw [d.coneComplex_d_succ r (n + 1)]
      change (d.K.d (n + 3) (n + 2) w + r • (-z),
        -(d.K.d (n + 2) (n + 1) (-z))) = x
      apply Prod.ext
      · rw [hw, smul_neg]
        abel
      · rw [map_neg, hz]
        simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution.cone_finiteTensorTerms
statement:
theorem cone_finiteTensorTerms (d : BoundedProjectiveResolution A M) (r : A)
    (reg : IsSMulRegular M r)
    (L : ModuleCat.{u} A)
    (h : ∀ n, Module.length A
      (↑(((tensoringLeft (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj L).obj (d.K.X n)) : Type u) ≠ ⊤) :
    ∀ n, Module.length A
      (↑(((tensoringLeft (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj L).obj
        ((d.cone r reg).resolution.complex.X n)) :
        Type u) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  cases n with
  | zero => exact h 0
  | succ n =>
      change Module.length A
        (TensorProduct A (↑L : Type u) (d.K.X (n + 1) × d.K.X n)) ≠ ⊤
      rw [(TensorProduct.prodRight A A (↑L : Type u) (d.K.X (n + 1)) (d.K.X n)).length_eq,
        Module.length_prod]
      exact WithTop.add_ne_top.mpr ⟨h (n + 1), h n⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution.finiteTensorTerm_of_isZero
statement:
theorem finiteTensorTerm_of_isZero (L P : ModuleCat.{u} A) (hP : IsZero P) :
    Module.length A
      (↑(((tensoringLeft (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj L).obj P) : Type u) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hZ := ((tensoringLeft (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj L).map_isZero hP
  have hs : Subsingleton
      (↑(((tensoringLeft (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj L).obj P) : Type u) :=
    ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp hZ
  rw [Module.length_eq_zero_iff.mpr hs]
  exact WithTop.zero_ne_top

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution.self_finiteTensorTerms
statement:
theorem self_finiteTensorTerms (L : ModuleCat.{u} A)
    (hL : Module.length A (↑L : Type u) ≠ ⊤) :
    ∀ n, Module.length A
      (↑(((tensoringLeft (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj L).obj
        ((self (ModuleCat.of A A)).resolution.complex.X n)) : Type u) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      change Module.length A (TensorProduct A (↑L : Type u) A) ≠ ⊤
      rwa [(TensorProduct.rid A (↑L : Type u)).length_eq]
  | succ n =>
      apply finiteTensorTerm_of_isZero (A := A) L
      exact HomologicalComplex.isZero_single_obj_X (.down ℕ) 0 (ModuleCat.of A A) (n + 1)
        (by omega)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution.ofWeaklyRegular_finiteTensorTerms
statement:
theorem ofWeaklyRegular_finiteTensorTerms {P : ModuleCat.{u} A}
    (d : BoundedProjectiveResolution A P) (rs : List A)
    (reg : IsWeaklyRegular P rs) (L : ModuleCat.{u} A)
    (h : ∀ n, Module.length A
      (↑(((tensoringLeft (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj L).obj
        (d.resolution.complex.X n)) : Type u) ≠ ⊤) :
    ∀ n, Module.length A
      (↑(((tensoringLeft (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj L).obj
        ((d.ofWeaklyRegular rs reg).resolution.complex.X n)) : Type u) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  induction rs generalizing P with
  | nil =>
      intro n
      change Module.length A
        (↑(((tensoringLeft (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj L).obj
          (d.resolution.complex.X n)) : Type u) ≠ ⊤
      exact h n
  | cons r rs ih =>
      have hreg := (isWeaklyRegular_cons_iff P r rs).mp reg
      have hcone := d.cone_finiteTensorTerms r hreg.1 L h
      have htail := ih (d.cone r hreg.1) hreg.2 hcone
      intro n
      change Module.length A
        (↑(((tensoringLeft (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj L).obj
          (((d.cone r hreg.1).ofWeaklyRegular rs hreg.2).resolution.complex.X n)) :
            Type u) ≠ ⊤
      exact htail n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution.ofWeaklyRegular_bound
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofWeaklyRegular_bound (d : BoundedProjectiveResolution A M)
    (rs : List A) (reg : IsWeaklyRegular M rs) :
    (d.ofWeaklyRegular rs reg).bound = d.bound + rs.length
proof:
:= by
  induction rs generalizing M with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons r rs ih =>
      rw [ofWeaklyRegular]
      simp only [ofIso]
      rw [ih]
      simp [cone]
      omega

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution.koszul_bound
statement:
@[simp]
theorem koszul_bound (rs : List A)
    (reg : IsWeaklyRegular (ModuleCat.of A A) rs) :
    (koszul rs reg).bound = rs.length
proof:
:= by
  simp only [koszul, BoundedProjectiveResolution.ofIso]
  rw [ofWeaklyRegular_bound]
  simp [self]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution.koszul_finiteTensorTerms
statement:
theorem koszul_finiteTensorTerms (rs : List A)
    (reg : IsWeaklyRegular (ModuleCat.of A A) rs)
    (L : ModuleCat.{u} A) (hL : Module.length A (↑L : Type u) ≠ ⊤) :
    ∀ n, Module.length A
      (↑(((tensoringLeft (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj L).obj
        ((koszul rs reg).resolution.complex.X n)) : Type u) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have h := ofWeaklyRegular_finiteTensorTerms (self (ModuleCat.of A A)) rs reg L
    (self_finiteTensorTerms L hL)
  intro n
  change Module.length A
    (↑(((tensoringLeft (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj L).obj
      (((self (ModuleCat.of A A)).ofWeaklyRegular rs reg).resolution.complex.X n)) :
        Type u) ≠ ⊤
  exact h n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution.isZero_module_koszul
statement:
theorem isZero_module_koszul (rs : List A)
    (reg : IsWeaklyRegular (ModuleCat.of A A) rs)
    (L : ModuleCat.{u} A) (n : ℕ) (hn : rs.length < n) :
    IsZero (module A L (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ Ideal.ofList rs)) n)
proof:
:= by
  apply (koszul rs reg).isZero_module A L
  rwa [koszul_bound]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution.isZero_module_of_iso_koszul
statement:
theorem isZero_module_of_iso_koszul (rs : List A)
    (reg : IsWeaklyRegular (ModuleCat.of A A) rs)
    (L : ModuleCat.{u} A) {N' : ModuleCat.{u} A}
    (e : ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ Ideal.ofList rs) ≅ N')
    (n : ℕ) (hn : rs.length < n) : IsZero (module A L N' n)
proof:
:= by
  apply ((koszul rs reg).ofIso A e).isZero_module A L
  change (koszul rs reg).bound < n
  rwa [koszul_bound]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.SerreTor.BoundedProjectiveResolution.koszulEulerData_multiplicity
statement:
theorem koszulEulerData_multiplicity (rs : List A)
    (reg : IsWeaklyRegular (ModuleCat.of A A) rs)
    (L : ModuleCat.{u} A) (hL : Module.length A (↑L : Type u) ≠ ⊤) :
    (koszulEulerData rs reg L hL).multiplicity =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (rs.length + 1),
        signedLength A L (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ Ideal.ofList rs)) n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [koszulEulerData, toEulerDataOfFiniteTerms, toEulerData,
    EulerData.multiplicity, koszul_bound]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteClosedIntersectionData.FstPrincipalRelationData.div_apply_fst
statement:
theorem div_apply_fst (P : FstPrincipalRelationData d) (z : d.intersection) :
    div P.function (pullback.fst d.i d.j z) =
      (d.localMultiplicity z : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have ha : P.equation z ≠ 0 := by
    intro ha
    apply P.function_ne_zero
    rw [← P.equation_maps z, ha, map_zero]
  have h := d.principalDivisor_fst_apply_eq_localMultiplicity z
    (P.codimension_fst z) (P.equation z) ha (P.ker_stalkMap z)
  rw [P.equation_maps z] at h
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteClosedIntersectionData.FstPrincipalRelationData.relation_cycle_eq
statement:
theorem relation_cycle_eq (P : FstPrincipalRelationData d) :
    P.relation.cycle = d.cycle
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.range d.toX
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hx
    change P.relation.cycle.1 (d.toX z) = d.cycle.1 (d.toX z)
    rw [d.cycle_apply_toX]
    have htoX : d.toX z = d.i (pullback.fst d.i d.j z) := by
      exact Scheme.Hom.comp_apply _ _ _
    rw [htoX]
    have hc := RationalRelationGenerator.cycle_apply_i P.relation
      (pullback.fst d.i d.j z)
    have hc' : P.relation.cycle.1 (d.i (pullback.fst d.i d.j z)) =
        div P.function (pullback.fst d.i d.j z) := by
      change P.relation.cycle.1 (d.i (pullback.fst d.i d.j z)) =
        div P.function (pullback.fst d.i d.j z) at hc
      exact hc
    rw [hc', P.div_apply_fst]
  · rw [d.cycle_apply_eq_zero_of_not_exists x hx]
    by_contra hne
    have hmem : x ∈ P.relation.cycle.1.support := hne
    rw [RationalRelationGenerator.cycle_support] at hmem
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hmem
    have hsupp := P.divisor_support
    change y ∈ (div P.function).support at hy
    rw [hsupp] at hy
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hy
    apply hx
    refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
    exact (Scheme.Hom.comp_apply _ _ _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteClosedIntersectionData.FstPrincipalRelationData.cycle_mem_rationalEquivalenceSubgroup
statement:
theorem cycle_mem_rationalEquivalenceSubgroup (P : FstPrincipalRelationData d) :
    d.cycle ∈ rationalEquivalenceSubgroup X p
proof:
:= by
  rw [← P.relation_cycle_eq]
  exact relation_cycle_mem P.relation

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteClosedIntersectionData.SndPrincipalRelationData.div_apply_snd
statement:
theorem div_apply_snd (P : SndPrincipalRelationData d) (z : d.intersection) :
    div P.function (pullback.snd d.i d.j z) =
      (d.localMultiplicity z : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have ha : P.equation z ≠ 0 := by
    intro ha
    apply P.function_ne_zero
    rw [← P.equation_maps z, ha, map_zero]
  have h := d.principalDivisor_snd_apply_eq_localMultiplicity z
    (P.codimension_snd z) (P.equation z) ha (P.ker_stalkMap z)
  rw [P.equation_maps z] at h
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteClosedIntersectionData.SndPrincipalRelationData.relation_cycle_eq
statement:
theorem relation_cycle_eq (P : SndPrincipalRelationData d) :
    P.relation.cycle = d.cycle
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.range d.toX
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hx
    change P.relation.cycle.1 (d.toX z) = d.cycle.1 (d.toX z)
    rw [d.cycle_apply_toX]
    have htoX : d.toX z = d.j (pullback.snd d.i d.j z) := by
      change (pullback.fst d.i d.j ≫ d.i) z = d.j (pullback.snd d.i d.j z)
      rw [pullback.condition]
      exact Scheme.Hom.comp_apply _ _ _
    rw [htoX]
    have hc := RationalRelationGenerator.cycle_apply_i P.relation
      (pullback.snd d.i d.j z)
    have hc' : P.relation.cycle.1 (d.j (pullback.snd d.i d.j z)) =
        div P.function (pullback.snd d.i d.j z) := by
      change P.relation.cycle.1 (d.j (pullback.snd d.i d.j z)) =
        div P.function (pullback.snd d.i d.j z) at hc
      exact hc
    rw [hc', P.div_apply_snd]
  · rw [d.cycle_apply_eq_zero_of_not_exists x hx]
    by_contra hne
    have hmem : x ∈ P.relation.cycle.1.support := hne
    rw [RationalRelationGenerator.cycle_support] at hmem
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hmem
    have hsupp := P.divisor_support
    change y ∈ (div P.function).support at hy
    rw [hsupp] at hy
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hy
    apply hx
    refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
    change d.toX z = d.j (pullback.snd d.i d.j z)
    change (pullback.fst d.i d.j ≫ d.i) z = d.j (pullback.snd d.i d.j z)
    rw [pullback.condition]
    exact Scheme.Hom.comp_apply _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.FiniteClosedIntersectionData.SndPrincipalRelationData.cycle_mem_rationalEquivalenceSubgroup
statement:
theorem cycle_mem_rationalEquivalenceSubgroup (P : SndPrincipalRelationData d) :
    d.cycle ∈ rationalEquivalenceSubgroup X p
proof:
:= by
  rw [← P.relation_cycle_eq]
  exact relation_cycle_mem P.relation

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProperIntersectionKernel.movedIntersectionClass_eq_product_ofPrincipalRelations
statement:
theorem movedIntersectionClass_eq_product_ofPrincipalRelations
    (moving : MovingLemmaStatement X p q)
    (relation_left : ∀ (g : RationalRelationGenerator X p)
      (z : CodimensionPoint X q) (y : CodimensionPoint g.Y 1),
      @FiniteClosedIntersectionData.SndPrincipalRelationData X (p + q)
        (K.pair (g.relationPoint y) z).toFiniteClosedIntersectionData
        (pointClosure_isIntegral (K.pair (g.relationPoint y) z).y)
        (pointClosure_isLocallyNoetherian (K.pair (g.relationPoint y) z).y))
    (relation_right : ∀ (z : CodimensionPoint X p)
      (g : RationalRelationGenerator X q) (y : CodimensionPoint g.Y 1),
      @FiniteClosedIntersectionData.FstPrincipalRelationData X (p + q)
        (K.pair z (g.relationPoint y)).toFiniteClosedIntersectionData
        (pointClosure_isIntegral (K.pair z (g.relationPoint y)).x)
        (pointClosure_isLocallyNoetherian (K.pair z (g.relationPoint y)).x))
    (x : CodimensionChow X p) (y : CodimensionChow X q) :
    (moving.witness x y).intersectionClass =
      (K.toIntersectionPairingDataOfPrincipalRelations
        relation_left relation_right).product x y
proof:
:=
  moving.witness_intersectionClass_eq_product K
    (K.toIntersectionPairingDataOfPrincipalRelations relation_left relation_right) rfl x y

name: RiemannRoch.NoetherFiniteness.isIntegralClosure_of_isIntegral_bot
statement:
theorem isIntegralClosure_of_isIntegral_bot (R A B C : Type*) [CommRing R] [CommRing A]
    [CommRing B] [CommRing C] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] [Algebra A B] [IsScalarTower R A B]
    [Algebra C B] [Algebra R C] [IsScalarTower R C B] [Algebra.IsIntegral R A]
    [IsIntegralClosure C A B] : IsIntegralClosure C R B where
  algebraMap_injective
proof:
:= IsIntegralClosure.algebraMap_injective C A B
  isIntegral_iff {x} := ⟨fun hx => IsIntegralClosure.isIntegral_iff.mp (hx.tower_top (A := A)),
    fun hx => isIntegral_trans (R := R) (A := A) x (IsIntegralClosure.isIntegral_iff.mpr hx)⟩

name: RiemannRoch.NoetherFiniteness.finite_integralClosure_of_isSeparable
statement:
theorem finite_integralClosure_of_isSeparable
    (R V A L : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsIntegrallyClosed R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [Field V] [Algebra R V] [IsFractionRing R V]
    [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [Algebra.IsIntegral R A]
    [Field L] [Algebra R L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower R A L] [Algebra V L]
    [IsScalarTower R V L] [FiniteDimensional V L] [Algebra.IsSeparable V L] :
    Module.Finite A (integralClosure A L)
proof:
:= by
  have : IsIntegralClosure (integralClosure A L) R L :=
    isIntegralClosure_of_isIntegral_bot R A L (integralClosure A L)
  have : Module.Finite R (integralClosure A L) :=
    IsIntegralClosure.finite R V L (integralClosure A L)
  exact Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite R A _

name: RiemannRoch.NoetherFiniteness.finite_integralClosure_of_algHom
statement:
theorem finite_integralClosure_of_algHom {P L M : Type*} [CommRing P] [IsNoetherianRing P]
    [CommRing L] [CommRing M] [Algebra P L] [Algebra P M] (f : L →ₐ[P] M)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) [Module.Finite P (integralClosure P M)] :
    Module.Finite P (integralClosure P L)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherian P (integralClosure P M) :=
    isNoetherian_of_isNoetherianRing_of_finite P _
  let j : integralClosure P L →ₗ[P] integralClosure P M :=
    { toFun := fun z => ⟨f z, z.2.map f⟩
      map_add' := fun a b => Subtype.ext (map_add f (a : L) (b : L))
      map_smul' := fun c a => Subtype.ext (map_smul f c (a : L)) }
  exact Module.Finite.of_injective j fun a b h => Subtype.ext (hf (congrArg Subtype.val h))

name: RiemannRoch.NoetherFiniteness.finite_integralClosure_of_isSeparable_tower
statement:
theorem finite_integralClosure_of_isSeparable_tower
    (P V E M : Type*) [CommRing P] [IsDomain P] [IsNoetherianRing P]
    [Field V] [Algebra P V] [IsFractionRing P V]
    [Field E] [Algebra P E] [Algebra V E] [IsScalarTower P V E] [FiniteDimensional V E]
    [Field M] [Algebra P M] [Algebra E M] [IsScalarTower P E M] [FiniteDimensional E M]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable E M] [Module.Finite P (integralClosure P E)] :
    Module.Finite P (integralClosure P M)
proof:
:= by
  let B := integralClosure P E
  haveI : IsNoetherian P B := isNoetherian_of_isNoetherianRing_of_finite P B
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing B := isNoetherian_of_tower P inferInstance
  haveI : IsFractionRing B E := integralClosure.isFractionRing_of_finite_extension V E
  haveI : IsIntegrallyClosed B := integralClosure.isIntegrallyClosedOfFiniteExtension V
  haveI : IsScalarTower P B M := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x => by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply B E M, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply P B E,
      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]
  haveI : Module.Finite B (integralClosure B M) := IsIntegralClosure.finite B E M _
  haveI : Module.Finite P (integralClosure B M) := Module.Finite.trans B _
  haveI : IsNoetherian P (integralClosure B M) := isNoetherian_of_isNoetherianRing_of_finite P _
  let j : integralClosure P M →ₗ[P] integralClosure B M :=
    { toFun := fun z => ⟨z, z.2.tower_top⟩
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
  refine Module.Finite.of_injective j fun a b h => ?_
  have h' := congrArg Subtype.val h
  exact Subtype.ext h'

name: RiemannRoch.NoetherFiniteness.finite_integralClosure_adjoin_roots
statement:
theorem finite_integralClosure_adjoin_roots (e : ℕ) (W : Finset V) :
    Module.Finite (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k) (integralClosure (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k)
      (IntermediateField.adjoin V
        (((iterateFrobeniusEquiv Ω p e).symm ∘ algebraMap V Ω) '' (W : Set V))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set P := MvPolynomial (Fin s) k
  set q := p ^ e with hq
  set r := (iterateFrobeniusEquiv Ω p e).symm
  have hq0 : 0 < q := expChar_pow_pos k p e
  have hrq : ∀ x, r x ^ q = x := fun x => by
    have := (iterateFrobeniusEquiv Ω p e).apply_symm_apply x
    rwa [iterateFrobeniusEquiv_def] at this
  have hrpow : ∀ x, r (x ^ q) = x := fun x => by
    rw [RingEquiv.symm_apply_eq, iterateFrobeniusEquiv_def]
  have hPΩ : Function.Injective (algebraMap P Ω) := by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq P V Ω]
    exact (algebraMap V Ω).injective.comp (IsFractionRing.injective P V)
  have hdiv := fun w : V => IsFractionRing.div_surjective (A := P) w
  choose f g hg hfg using hdiv
  set D : Set k := ⋃ w ∈ (W : Set V), ((f w).coeffs ∪ (g w).coeffs : Set k) with hD
  have hDfin : D.Finite := W.finite_toSet.biUnion fun w _ => Set.toFinite _
  set k0 : Subfield k := Subfield.closure (Set.range (fun c : k => c ^ q) ∪ D) with hk0
  let P0 := MvPolynomial (Fin s) k0
  let φ : P0 →+* P := MvPolynomial.map k0.subtype
  let ψ : P0 →+* Ω := r.toRingHom.comp ((algebraMap P Ω).comp φ)
  have hψ : Function.Injective ψ :=
    r.injective.comp (hPΩ.comp (MvPolynomial.map_injective _ k0.subtype_injective))
  let fr : k →+* k0 := (iterateFrobenius k p e).codRestrict k0 fun c =>
    Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl ⟨c, by simp [iterateFrobenius_def, q]⟩)
  let σ : P →+* P0 := MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom ((MvPolynomial.C).comp fr) fun i => X i ^ q
  have hσ : ψ.comp σ = algebraMap P Ω := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro c
      have h1 : k0.subtype (fr c) = c ^ q := iterateFrobenius_def p e c
      change r (algebraMap P Ω (φ (σ (C c)))) = _
      rw [show σ (C c) = C (fr c) from eval₂Hom_C _ _ _]
      rw [show φ (C (fr c)) = C (k0.subtype (fr c)) from map_C _ _, h1, C_pow, map_pow, hrpow]
    · intro i
      change r (algebraMap P Ω (φ (σ (X i)))) = _
      rw [show σ (X i) = X i ^ q from eval₂Hom_X' _ _ _, map_pow,
        show φ (X i) = X i from map_X _ _, map_pow, hrpow]
  letI : Algebra P0 Ω := ψ.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra P P0 := σ.toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower P P0 Ω :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x => (congrArg (· x) hσ).symm
  let F0 := FractionRing P0
  let ℓ : F0 →ₐ[P0] Ω := IsFractionRing.liftAlgHom (K := F0) (g := Algebra.ofId P0 Ω) hψ
  let S : Subfield Ω := ℓ.toRingHom.fieldRange
  have hψS : ∀ a : P0, ψ a ∈ S := fun a => ⟨algebraMap P0 F0 a, ℓ.commutes a⟩
  have hPS : ∀ x : P, algebraMap P Ω x ∈ S := fun x => by
    rw [← hσ]; exact hψS _
  have hVS : ∀ v : V, algebraMap V Ω v ∈ S := fun v => by
    obtain ⟨a, b, -, rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective (A := P) v
    rw [map_div₀, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]
    exact div_mem (hPS a) (hPS b)
  have hDk0 : D ⊆ k0 := fun c hc => Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr hc)
  have hcoeffS : ∀ x : P, (x.coeffs : Set k) ⊆ D → r (algebraMap P Ω x) ∈ S := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨x0, rfl⟩ : x ∈ Set.range φ :=
      mem_range_map_iff_coeffs_subset.mpr fun c hc => ⟨⟨c, hDk0 (hx hc)⟩, rfl⟩
    exact hψS x0
  have hWS : ∀ w ∈ W, r (algebraMap V Ω w) ∈ S := by
    intro w hw
    rw [← hfg w, map_div₀, map_div₀, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply,
      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]
    refine div_mem (hcoeffS _ fun c hc => ?_) (hcoeffS _ fun c hc => ?_)
    · exact Set.mem_biUnion (x := w) hw (Or.inl hc)
    · exact Set.mem_biUnion (x := w) hw (Or.inr hc)
  let S' : IntermediateField V Ω := S.toIntermediateField hVS
  have hES : IntermediateField.adjoin V
      (((iterateFrobeniusEquiv Ω p e).symm ∘ algebraMap V Ω) '' (W : Set V)) ≤ S' := by
    rw [IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff]
    rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    exact hWS w hw
  
  let T : Set Ω := Set.range (fun i => r (algebraMap P Ω (X i))) ∪
    (fun d => r (algebraMap P Ω (C d))) '' D
  have hTfin : T.Finite := (Set.finite_range _).union (hDfin.image _)
  have hint : ∀ x : P, IsIntegral P (r (algebraMap P Ω x)) := fun x =>
    ⟨Polynomial.X ^ q - Polynomial.C x, Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C x hq0.ne', by
      simp [Polynomial.eval₂_sub, hrq]⟩
  have hTint : ∀ t ∈ T, IsIntegral P t := by
    rintro _ (⟨i, rfl⟩ | ⟨d, -, rfl⟩) <;> exact hint _
  let R : Subalgebra P Ω := Algebra.adjoin P T
  have hRfin : Module.Finite P R := Algebra.finite_adjoin_of_finite_of_isIntegral hTfin hTint
  have hinv : ∀ x : k, x⁻¹ = x ^ (q - 1) * x⁻¹ ^ q := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, q = m + 1 := ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [hm, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    rcases eq_or_ne x 0 with rfl | hx
    · simp
    · rw [pow_succ, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_pow, mul_inv_cancel₀ hx, one_pow, one_mul]
  have hC : ∀ c ∈ k0, r (algebraMap P Ω (C c)) ∈ R := by
    intro c hc
    induction hc using Subfield.closure_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      rcases hx with ⟨b, rfl⟩ | hx
      · rw [C_pow, map_pow, hrpow]
        exact R.algebraMap_mem _
      · exact Algebra.subset_adjoin (Or.inr ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)
    | one => simp only [map_one]; exact R.one_mem
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => simpa only [map_add] using R.add_mem hx hy
    | neg x _ hx => simpa only [map_neg] using R.neg_mem hx
    | mul x y _ _ hx hy => simpa only [map_mul] using R.mul_mem hx hy
    | inv x _ hx =>
      rw [hinv x]
      simp only [map_mul, map_pow, hrpow]
      exact R.mul_mem (R.pow_mem hx _) (R.algebraMap_mem _)
  have hψR : ∀ a : P0, ψ a ∈ R := by
    intro a
    induction a using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
    | C c =>
      change r (algebraMap P Ω (φ (C c))) ∈ R
      rw [show φ (C c) = C (k0.subtype c) from map_C _ _]
      exact hC c c.2
    | add a b ha hb => simpa only [map_add] using R.add_mem ha hb
    | mul_X a i ha =>
      rw [map_mul]
      refine R.mul_mem ha (Algebra.subset_adjoin (Or.inl ⟨i, ?_⟩))
      change r (algebraMap P Ω (X i)) = r (algebraMap P Ω (φ (X i)))
      rw [show φ (X i) = X i from map_X _ _]
  have hmemR : ∀ z : integralClosure P (IntermediateField.adjoin V
      (((iterateFrobeniusEquiv Ω p e).symm ∘ algebraMap V Ω) '' (W : Set V))),
      (((z : _) : Ω)) ∈ R := by
    intro z
    haveI : IsScalarTower P (IntermediateField.adjoin V
      (((iterateFrobeniusEquiv Ω p e).symm ∘ algebraMap V Ω) '' (W : Set V))) Ω :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x => rfl
    have hz : IsIntegral P ((z : _) : Ω) :=
      z.2.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom P _ Ω)
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hES ((z : IntermediateField.adjoin V
      (((iterateFrobeniusEquiv Ω p e).symm ∘ algebraMap V Ω) '' (W : Set V)))).2
    have hz0 : IsIntegral P0 ((z : _) : Ω) := hz.tower_top
    have ht0 : IsIntegral P0 t := by
      rw [← isIntegral_algHom_iff ℓ ℓ.toRingHom.injective]
      exact ht ▸ hz0
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := IsIntegrallyClosed.isIntegral_iff.mp ht0
    rw [← ht]
    change ℓ (algebraMap P0 F0 a) ∈ R
    rw [ℓ.commutes]
    exact hψR a
  haveI : IsNoetherian P R := isNoetherian_of_isNoetherianRing_of_finite P R
  let j : integralClosure P (IntermediateField.adjoin V
      (((iterateFrobeniusEquiv Ω p e).symm ∘ algebraMap V Ω) '' (W : Set V))) →ₗ[P] R :=
    { toFun := fun z => ⟨_, hmemR z⟩
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
  refine Module.Finite.of_injective j fun a b h => ?_
  have h' := congrArg Subtype.val h
  apply Subtype.ext; apply Subtype.ext
  exact h'

name: RiemannRoch.NoetherFiniteness.finite_integralClosure_mvPolynomial
statement:
theorem finite_integralClosure_mvPolynomial (k : Type*) [Field k] (s : ℕ)
    (V L : Type*) [Field V] [Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k) V]
    [IsFractionRing (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k) V] [Field L] [Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k) L]
    [Algebra V L] [IsScalarTower (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k) V L] [FiniteDimensional V L] :
    Module.Finite (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k) (integralClosure (MvPolynomial (Fin s) k) L)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set P := MvPolynomial (Fin s) k
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := ExpChar.exists k
  haveI : ExpChar V p := expChar_of_injective_ringHom (f := (algebraMap P V).comp MvPolynomial.C)
    ((IsFractionRing.injective P V).comp (MvPolynomial.C_injective (Fin s) k)) p
  haveI : ExpChar L p := expChar_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap V L).injective p
  let Ω := AlgebraicClosure L
  haveI : ExpChar Ω p := expChar_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap L Ω).injective p
  haveI : PerfectRing Ω p := PerfectField.toPerfectRing p
  let Ls := separableClosure V L
  haveI : IsPurelyInseparable Ls L := separableClosure.isPurelyInseparable V L
  haveI : ExpChar Ls p := expChar_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap V Ls).injective p
  let b := Module.Free.chooseBasis V L
  let u := Module.Free.chooseBasis V Ls
  choose n hn using fun i => IsPurelyInseparable.pow_mem Ls p (b i)
  set e := ∑ i, n i with he
  have hbe : ∀ i, b i ^ p ^ e ∈ (algebraMap Ls L).range := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hn i
    have hle : n i ≤ e := Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => Nat.zero_le (n j)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    refine ⟨y ^ p ^ (e - n i), ?_⟩
    rw [map_pow, hy, ← pow_mul, ← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hle]
  choose y hy using hbe
  have hspan := Field.span_map_pow_expChar_pow_eq_top_of_isSeparable p e u.span_eq
  have hc : ∀ i, ∃ c : _ → V, ∑ j, c j • u j ^ p ^ e = y i := fun i =>
    (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun V).mp (hspan ▸ Submodule.mem_top)
  choose c hc using hc
  let W : Finset V := Finset.univ.image fun ij : _ × _ => c ij.1 ij.2
  set r := (iterateFrobeniusEquiv Ω p e).symm with hr
  have hrq : ∀ x, r x ^ p ^ e = x := fun x => by
    have := (iterateFrobeniusEquiv Ω p e).apply_symm_apply x
    rwa [iterateFrobeniusEquiv_def] at this
  have hrpow : ∀ x, r (x ^ p ^ e) = x := fun x => by
    rw [hr, RingEquiv.symm_apply_eq, iterateFrobeniusEquiv_def]
  set E' : IntermediateField V Ω :=
    IntermediateField.adjoin V (((iterateFrobeniusEquiv Ω p e).symm ∘ algebraMap V Ω) ''
      (W : Set V)) with hE'
  haveI : Module.Finite P (integralClosure P E') :=
    finite_integralClosure_adjoin_roots p s V Ω e W
  haveI : IsScalarTower P E' Ω := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x => rfl
  haveI : Finite (((iterateFrobeniusEquiv Ω p e).symm ∘ algebraMap V Ω) '' (W : Set V)) :=
    (W.finite_toSet.image _).to_subtype
  haveI : FiniteDimensional V E' := by
    refine IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_adjoin ?_
    rintro _ ⟨w, -, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨Polynomial.X ^ p ^ e - Polynomial.C w,
      Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C w (expChar_pow_pos k p e).ne', by
        simp [Polynomial.eval₂_sub, ← hr, hrq]⟩
  let M' : IntermediateField E' Ω :=
    IntermediateField.adjoin E' (Set.range fun j => algebraMap L Ω (u j : L))
  have huint : ∀ j, IsIntegral V (algebraMap L Ω (u j : L)) := fun j =>
    (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral (R := V) (u j : L)).map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom V L Ω)
  haveI : FiniteDimensional E' M' := by
    refine IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_adjoin ?_
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact (huint j).tower_top
  haveI : Algebra.IsSeparable E' M' := by
    refine (IntermediateField.isSeparable_adjoin_iff_isSeparable E' _).mpr ?_
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    have hsep : IsSeparable V (u j : L) := mem_separableClosure_iff.mp (u j).2
    exact ((hsep.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom V L Ω) (algebraMap L Ω).injective)).tower_top E'
  haveI : IsScalarTower P E' M' := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x => rfl
  haveI : Module.Finite P (integralClosure P M') :=
    finite_integralClosure_of_isSeparable_tower P V E' M'
  have hb : ∀ i, algebraMap L Ω (b i) =
      ∑ j, r (algebraMap V Ω (c i j)) * algebraMap L Ω (u j : L) := by
    intro i
    have h1 : algebraMap L Ω (b i) ^ p ^ e =
        ∑ j, algebraMap V Ω (c i j) * algebraMap L Ω (u j : L) ^ p ^ e := by
      rw [← map_pow, ← hy i, ← hc i, map_sum, map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      rw [Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, map_mul, map_pow, map_pow,
        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply V Ls L, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply V L Ω]
      rfl
    calc algebraMap L Ω (b i) = r (algebraMap L Ω (b i) ^ p ^ e) := (hrpow _).symm
      _ = _ := by rw [h1, map_sum]; simp only [map_mul, hrpow]
  have hVM : ∀ v : V, algebraMap V Ω v ∈ M' := fun v => M'.algebraMap_mem (algebraMap V E' v)
  have hrM : ∀ w ∈ W, r (algebraMap V Ω w) ∈ M' := fun w hw =>
    M'.algebraMap_mem ⟨r (algebraMap V Ω w), IntermediateField.subset_adjoin V _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩⟩
  have huM : ∀ j, algebraMap L Ω (u j : L) ∈ M' := fun j =>
    IntermediateField.subset_adjoin E' _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
  have hbM : ∀ i, algebraMap L Ω (b i) ∈ M' := by
    intro i
    rw [hb i]
    exact sum_mem fun j _ => mul_mem
      (hrM _ (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ (i, j)))) (huM j)
  have hLM : ∀ x : L, algebraMap L Ω x ∈ M' := by
    intro x
    rw [← b.sum_repr x, map_sum]
    refine sum_mem fun i _ => ?_
    rw [Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply V L Ω]
    exact mul_mem (hVM _) (hbM i)
  let f : L →ₐ[P] M' :=
    { toFun := fun x => ⟨algebraMap L Ω x, hLM x⟩
      map_one' := Subtype.ext (map_one _)
      map_mul' := fun x y => Subtype.ext (map_mul _ x y)
      map_zero' := Subtype.ext (map_zero _)
      map_add' := fun x y => Subtype.ext (map_add _ x y)
      commutes' := fun x => Subtype.ext (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply P L Ω x).symm }
  exact finite_integralClosure_of_algHom f f.toRingHom.injective

name: RiemannRoch.NoetherFiniteness.finite_integralClosure_of_finiteType
statement:
theorem finite_integralClosure_of_finiteType
    (k A K L : Type*) [Field k] [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [Algebra k A]
    [Algebra.FiniteType k A] [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K] [Field L]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra A L] [IsScalarTower A K L] [FiniteDimensional K L] :
    Module.Finite A (integralClosure A L)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, g, hinj, hfin⟩ := exists_finite_inj_algHom_of_fg k A
  let P := MvPolynomial (Fin s) k
  letI : Algebra P A := g.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have : Module.Finite P A := hfin
  have : FaithfulSMul P A := (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective P A).mpr hinj
  letI : Algebra P K := ((algebraMap A K).comp (algebraMap P A)).toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower P A K := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  letI : Algebra P L := ((algebraMap A L).comp (algebraMap P A)).toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower P A L := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  have : IsScalarTower P K L := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x => by
    change algebraMap A L (algebraMap P A x) = _
    exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A K L _
  have : FaithfulSMul P K := (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective P K).mpr
    ((IsFractionRing.injective A K).comp hinj)
  letI : Algebra (FractionRing P) K := FractionRing.liftAlgebra P K
  letI : Algebra (FractionRing P) L :=
    ((algebraMap K L).comp (algebraMap (FractionRing P) K)).toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower (FractionRing P) K L := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  have : IsScalarTower P (FractionRing P) L := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x => by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply (FractionRing P) K L,
      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply P (FractionRing P) K, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]
  have : Algebra.IsIntegral P A := Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite P A
  have : Module.Finite (FractionRing P) K := Module.Finite.of_isLocalization P A P⁰
  have : Module.Finite (FractionRing P) L := Module.Finite.trans K L
  haveI : Module.Finite P (integralClosure P L) :=
    finite_integralClosure_mvPolynomial k s (FractionRing P) L
  haveI : IsIntegralClosure (integralClosure A L) P L :=
    isIntegralClosure_of_isIntegral_bot P A L (integralClosure A L)
  haveI : Module.Finite P (integralClosure A L) :=
    Module.Finite.equiv (IsIntegralClosure.equiv P (integralClosure P L) L
      (integralClosure A L)).toLinearEquiv
  exact Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite P A _

name: RiemannRoch.NoetherFiniteness.finite_integralClosure_fractionRing
statement:
theorem finite_integralClosure_fractionRing
    (k A K : Type*) [Field k] [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [Algebra k A]
    [Algebra.FiniteType k A] [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K] :
    Module.Finite A (integralClosure A K)
proof:
:=
  finite_integralClosure_of_finiteType k A K K

name: RiemannRoch.NoetherFiniteness.finite_integralClosure_fromSpecStalk_app
proof:
:= ((Y.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint Y)).app U).hom.toAlgebra
    Module.Finite Γ(Y, U) (integralClosure Γ(Y, U)
      Γ(Spec (Y.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint Y)), (Y.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint Y)) ⁻¹ᵁ U)) := by
  let f := Y.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint Y)
  letI := (f.app U).hom.toAlgebra
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty U with hUe | hUne
  · have hU0 : U = ⊥ := by
      rw [eq_bot_iff]; intro x hx; exact (hUe.false ⟨x, hx⟩).elim
    subst hU0
    haveI : Subsingleton (integralClosure Γ(Y, ⊥)
        Γ(Spec (Y.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint Y)), f ⁻¹ᵁ ⊥)) := Module.subsingleton Γ(Y, ⊥) _
    infer_instance
  · have hη : genericPoint Y ∈ U :=
      ((genericPoint_spec Y).mem_open_set_iff U.isOpen).mpr (by simpa using hUne)
    let φ : k →+* Γ(Y, U) :=
      (π.appLE ⊤ U (by simp)).hom.comp (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv.hom
    have hφ : φ.FiniteType := RingHom.FiniteType.comp
      (HasRingHomProperty.appLE @LocallyOfFiniteType π ‹_› ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩ ⟨U, hU⟩ _)
      (RingHom.FiniteType.of_surjective _
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.surjective)
    letI : Algebra k Γ(Y, U) := φ.toAlgebra
    haveI : Algebra.FiniteType k Γ(Y, U) := hφ
    haveI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(Y, U) := Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing k _
    haveI := functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen Y U hU
    haveI := finite_integralClosure_fractionRing k Γ(Y, U) Y.functionField
    haveI : Unique (Spec (Y.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint Y))) :=
      inferInstanceAs (Unique (Spec (.of Y.functionField)))
    have hpre : f ⁻¹ᵁ U = ⊤ := by
      rw [eq_top_iff]
      intro x _
      have hx : x = IsLocalRing.closedPoint (Y.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint Y)) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      show f x ∈ U
      rw [hx, Scheme.fromSpecStalk_closedPoint]
      exact hη
    let ρ := (Spec (Y.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint Y))).presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (le_top : f ⁻¹ᵁ U ≤ ⊤)).op
    haveI : IsIso ρ := by
      have h1 : (homOfLE (le_top : f ⁻¹ᵁ U ≤ ⊤)) = eqToHom hpre := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      simp only [ρ, h1, eqToHom_op, eqToHom_map]
      infer_instance
    let e : Y.functionField ≃+* Γ(Spec (Y.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint Y)), f ⁻¹ᵁ U) :=
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso _).symm ≪≫ asIso ρ).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
    have he : ∀ a : Γ(Y, U), algebraMap Γ(Y, U) Γ(Spec (Y.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint Y)),
        f ⁻¹ᵁ U) a = e (algebraMap Γ(Y, U) Y.functionField a) := by
      intro a
      change (f.app U).hom a = ρ.hom ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso _).inv.hom
        ((Y.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint Y) hη).hom a))
      rw [Scheme.fromSpecStalk_app hη]
      rfl
    let g : Γ(Spec (Y.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint Y)), f ⁻¹ᵁ U) →ₐ[Γ(Y, U)]
        Y.functionField :=
      { e.symm.toRingHom with
        commutes' := fun a => by
          change e.symm _ = _
          rw [he, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply] }
    exact finite_integralClosure_of_algHom g e.symm.injective

name: RiemannRoch.NoetherFiniteness.isFinite_fromNormalization_fromSpecStalk_genericPoint
statement:
theorem isFinite_fromNormalization_fromSpecStalk_genericPoint {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Y] (π : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType π] :
    IsFinite (Y.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint Y)).fromNormalization
proof:
:= by
  let f := Y.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint Y)
  change IsFinite f.fromNormalization
  constructor
  intro U hU
  letI := (f.app U).hom.toAlgebra
  rw [f.fromNormalization_app hU, CommRingCat.hom_comp,
    RingHom.finite_respectsIso.cancel_right_isIso]
  change (f.normalizationDiagramMap.app (op U)).hom.Finite
  change (algebraMap Γ(Y, U) (integralClosure Γ(Y, U)
    Γ(Spec (Y.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint Y)), f ⁻¹ᵁ U))).Finite
  have H := finite_integralClosure_fromSpecStalk_app π hU
  exact RingHom.finite_algebraMap.mpr H

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ker_stalkMap_eq_span_of_openPullback
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_eq_span_of_openPullback
    {Z X U : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) (t : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion t]
    (w : (pullback i t : Scheme.{u}))
    (a : U.presheaf.stalk (pullback.snd i t w))
    (hker : RingHom.ker ((pullback.snd i t).stalkMap w).hom = Ideal.span {a}) :
    RingHom.ker (i.stalkMap (pullback.fst i t w)).hom =
      Ideal.span {principalOpenPullbackStalkElement i t w a}
proof:
:= by
  exact ker_stalkMap_eq_span_of_isIso_square i (pullback.snd i t)
    (pullback.fst i t) t pullback.condition w a hker

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.targetStalkIsoOfArrowIso_affineStalkElement
statement:
theorem targetStalkIsoOfArrowIso_affineStalkElement
    {Z X Z' : Scheme.{u}} {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    (i : Z ⟶ X) (j : Z' ⟶ Spec (.of R))
    (eZ : Z ≅ Z') (eX : X ≅ Spec (.of R))
    (h : eZ.hom ≫ j = i ≫ eX.hom) (z : Z) (a : R) :
    (targetStalkIsoOfArrowIso i j eZ eX h z).hom
        (affineStalkElement a (j (eZ.hom z))) =
      (eX.hom.stalkMap (i z)).hom (affineStalkElement a (eX.hom (i z)))
proof:
:= by
  have hp : j (eZ.hom z) = eX.hom (i z) := by
    change (eZ.hom ≫ j) z = (i ≫ eX.hom) z
    rw [h]
  have hcongr := stalkCongr_affineStalkElement a hp
  simp only [targetStalkIsoOfArrowIso, Iso.trans_hom, asIso_hom,
    ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  convert congrArg (fun y ↦ (eX.hom.stalkMap (i z)).hom y) hcongr using 1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.stalkCongr_localStalkElement
statement:
theorem stalkCongr_localStalkElement (c : PrincipalOpenPullbackChart i t)
    {w w' : (pullback i t : Scheme.{u})} (h : w = w') :

      (.of_eq (congrArg (pullback.snd i t) h))).hom (c.localStalkElement w) =

proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.ker_stalkMap_openPullback
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_openPullback (c : PrincipalOpenPullbackChart i t)
    (w : (pullback i t : Scheme.{u})) :
    RingHom.ker ((pullback.snd i t).stalkMap w).hom =
      Ideal.span {c.localStalkElement w}
proof:
:= by
  exact ker_stalkMap_eq_span_of_arrow_iso (pullback.snd i t)
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {c.equation}))))
    c.sourceIso c.targetIso c.commutes w
    (principalQuotientStalkElement c.equation (c.sourceIso.hom w))
    (ker_stalkMap_Spec_quotient_span_singleton c.equation (c.sourceIso.hom w))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.ker_stalkMap
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap (c : PrincipalOpenPullbackChart i t)
    (w : (pullback i t : Scheme.{u})) :
    RingHom.ker (i.stalkMap (pullback.fst i t w)).hom =
      Ideal.span {c.stalkElement w}
proof:
:= by
  exact ker_stalkMap_eq_span_of_openPullback i t w (c.localStalkElement w)
    (c.ker_stalkMap_openPullback w)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.localStalkElement_ne_zero
statement:
theorem localStalkElement_ne_zero (c : PrincipalOpenPullbackChart i t)
    [IsDomain c.R] (ha : c.equation ≠ 0)
    (w : (pullback i t : Scheme.{u})) : c.localStalkElement w ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  exact (map_ne_zero_iff _
    (targetStalkIsoOfArrowIso (pullback.snd i t)
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {c.equation}))))
      c.sourceIso c.targetIso c.commutes w).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.injective).mpr
    (principalQuotientStalkElement_ne_zero c.equation ha (c.sourceIso.hom w))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.stalkElement_ne_zero
statement:
theorem stalkElement_ne_zero (c : PrincipalOpenPullbackChart i t)
    [IsDomain c.R] (ha : c.equation ≠ 0)
    (w : (pullback i t : Scheme.{u})) : c.stalkElement w ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  exact (map_ne_zero_iff _
    (targetStalkIsoOfIsIsoSquare i (pullback.snd i t)
      (pullback.fst i t) t pullback.condition w).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.injective).mpr
    (c.localStalkElement_ne_zero ha w)

statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem map_fst :
    map (i := i) (t := t) j ≫ pullback.fst i j =
      pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) ≫
        pullback.fst i t
proof:
:= by

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem map_snd :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.OpenIntersectionRestriction.exists_preimage
statement:
theorem exists_preimage (z : (pullback i j : Scheme.{u})) (u : U)
    (h : i (pullback.fst i j z) = t u) :
    ∃ w : (pullback (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) : Scheme.{u}),
      map (i := i) (t := t) j w = z
proof:
:= by
  have hij : i (pullback.fst i j z) = j (pullback.snd i j z) := by
    change (pullback.fst i j ≫ i) z = (pullback.snd i j ≫ j) z
    rw [pullback.condition]
  have hleft : pullback.fst i j z ∈ Set.range (pullback.fst i t) := by
    rw [Scheme.Pullback.range_fst]
    exact ⟨u, h.symm⟩
  have hright : pullback.snd i j z ∈ Set.range (pullback.fst j t) := by
    rw [Scheme.Pullback.range_fst]
    exact ⟨u, (hij.symm.trans h).symm⟩
  change z ∈ Set.range (pullback.map
    (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) i j
    (pullback.fst i t) (pullback.fst j t) t
    (pullback.condition (f := i) (g := t)).symm
    (pullback.condition (f := j) (g := t)).symm)
  rw [Scheme.Pullback.range_map]
  exact ⟨hleft, hright⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.OpenIntersectionRestriction.ker_stalkMap_snd_eq_span_of_restriction
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_snd_eq_span_of_restriction
    (w : (pullback (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) : Scheme.{u}))
    (a : (pullback j t).presheaf.stalk
      (pullback.snd (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) w))
    (hker : RingHom.ker
      ((pullback.snd (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t)).stalkMap w).hom =
        Ideal.span {a}) :
    RingHom.ker ((pullback.snd i j).stalkMap
      (map (i := i) (t := t) j w)).hom =
      Ideal.span {
        principalStalkElementOfIsIsoSquare
          (pullback.snd i j)
          (pullback.snd (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t))
          (map (i := i) (t := t) j) (pullback.fst j t)
          (map_snd (i := i) (t := t) j) w a}
proof:
:= by
  exact ker_stalkMap_eq_span_of_isIso_square
    (pullback.snd i j)
    (pullback.snd (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t))
    (map (i := i) (t := t) j) (pullback.fst j t)
    (map_snd (i := i) (t := t) j) w a hker

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.OpenIntersectionRestriction.At.left_point
statement:
theorem left_point {z : (pullback i j : Scheme.{u})}
    (d : At (i := i) (t := t) j z) :
    pullback.fst i t
        (pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) d.point) =
      pullback.fst i j z
proof:
:= by
  calc
    pullback.fst i t
        (pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) d.point) =
        pullback.fst i j (map (i := i) (t := t) j d.point) := by
      change (pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) ≫
          pullback.fst i t) d.point =
        (map (i := i) (t := t) j ≫ pullback.fst i j) d.point
      rw [map_fst]
    _ = pullback.fst i j z := congrArg (pullback.fst i j) d.map_point

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.OpenIntersectionRestriction.At.right_point
statement:
theorem right_point {z : (pullback i j : Scheme.{u})}
    (d : At (i := i) (t := t) j z) :
    pullback.fst j t
        (pullback.snd (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) d.point) =
      pullback.snd i j z
proof:
:= by
  calc
    pullback.fst j t
        (pullback.snd (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) d.point) =
        pullback.snd i j (map (i := i) (t := t) j d.point) := by
      change (pullback.snd (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) ≫
          pullback.fst j t) d.point =
        (map (i := i) (t := t) j ≫ pullback.snd i j) d.point
      rw [map_snd]
    _ = pullback.snd i j z := congrArg (pullback.snd i j) d.map_point

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.OpenIntersectionRestriction.At.principalStalkElement_commonTarget
statement:
theorem principalStalkElement_commonTarget
    (w : (pullback (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) : Scheme.{u}))
    (a : U.presheaf.stalk
      (pullback.snd i t
        (pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) w))) :
    principalStalkElementOfIsIsoSquare j (pullback.snd j t)
        (pullback.fst j t) t pullback.condition
        (pullback.snd (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) w)
        ((U.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (by
          change (pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) ≫
              pullback.snd i t) w =
            (pullback.snd (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) ≫
              pullback.snd j t) w
          rw [pullback.condition]))).hom a) =
      (X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (by
        calc
          i (pullback.fst i t
              (pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) w)) =
              t (pullback.snd i t
                (pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) w)) := by
            change (pullback.fst i t ≫ i)
                (pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) w) =
              (pullback.snd i t ≫ t)
                (pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) w)
            rw [pullback.condition]
          _ = t (pullback.snd j t
                (pullback.snd (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) w)) := by
            congr 1
            change (pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) ≫
                pullback.snd i t) w =
              (pullback.snd (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) ≫
                pullback.snd j t) w
            rw [pullback.condition]
          _ = j (pullback.fst j t
                (pullback.snd (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) w)) := by
            change (pullback.snd j t ≫ t)
                (pullback.snd (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) w) =
              (pullback.fst j t ≫ j)
                (pullback.snd (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) w)
            rw [pullback.condition]))).hom
        (principalStalkElementOfIsIsoSquare i (pullback.snd i t)
          (pullback.fst i t) t pullback.condition
          (pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) w) a)
proof:
:= by
  let wL := pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) w
  let wR := pullback.snd (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) w
  let uL := pullback.snd i t wL
  let uR := pullback.snd j t wR
  have hU : uL = uR := by
    change (pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) ≫
        pullback.snd i t) w =
      (pullback.snd (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) ≫
        pullback.snd j t) w
    rw [pullback.condition]
  have hI : i (pullback.fst i t wL) = t uL := by
    change (pullback.fst i t ≫ i) wL = (pullback.snd i t ≫ t) wL
    rw [pullback.condition]
  have hJ : j (pullback.fst j t wR) = t uR := by
    change (pullback.fst j t ≫ j) wR = (pullback.snd j t ≫ t) wR
    rw [pullback.condition]
  have hLocal : i (pullback.fst i t wL) = j (pullback.fst j t wR) :=
    hI.trans ((congrArg t hU).trans hJ.symm)
  let hDirect : t uL = j (pullback.fst j t wR) :=
    (congrArg t hU).trans hJ.symm
  have hnat := stalkMap_inv_naturality_of_point_eq t hU a
  simp [principalStalkElementOfIsIsoSquare, targetStalkIsoOfIsIsoSquare,
    wL, wR, uL, uR]
  change (X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hJ.symm)).hom
      ((inv (t.stalkMap uR)).hom
        ((U.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hU)).hom a)) =
    (X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hDirect)).hom
      ((inv (t.stalkMap uL)).hom a)
  change (inv (t.stalkMap uR)).hom
      ((U.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hU)).hom a) = _ at hnat
  rw [hnat]
  let b := (inv (t.stalkMap uL)).hom a
  simpa [b, hDirect] using stalkCongr_comp_apply_of_eq X
    (congrArg t hU) rfl hJ.symm hDirect b

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.OpenIntersectionRestriction.At.stalkElement_pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkElement
statement:
theorem stalkElement_pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkElement
    {z : (pullback i j : Scheme.{u})}
    (d : At (i := i) (t := t) j z)
    (a : U.presheaf.stalk
      (pullback.snd i t
        (pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) d.point))) :
    stalkElement (i := i) (t := t) j d
        (pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkElement
          (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) d.point a) =
      pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkElement i j z
        (ambientStalkElement (i := i) (t := t) j d a)
proof:
:= by
  let wL := pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) d.point
  let wR := pullback.snd (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) d.point
  have hU : pullback.snd i t wL = pullback.snd j t wR := by
    change (pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) ≫
        pullback.snd i t) d.point =
      (pullback.snd (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) ≫
        pullback.snd j t) d.point
    rw [pullback.condition]
  let aR := (U.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hU)).hom a
  let bL := principalStalkElementOfIsIsoSquare i (pullback.snd i t)
    (pullback.fst i t) t pullback.condition wL a
  let bR := principalStalkElementOfIsIsoSquare j (pullback.snd j t)
    (pullback.fst j t) t pullback.condition wR aR
  have hCommon : bR =
      (X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (by
        calc
          i (pullback.fst i t wL) = t (pullback.snd i t wL) := by
            change (pullback.fst i t ≫ i) wL = (pullback.snd i t ≫ t) wL
            rw [pullback.condition]
          _ = t (pullback.snd j t wR) := congrArg t hU
          _ = j (pullback.fst j t wR) := by
            change (pullback.snd j t ≫ t) wR = (pullback.fst j t ≫ j) wR
            rw [pullback.condition]))).hom bL := by
    simpa [wL, wR, aR, bL, bR] using
      principalStalkElement_commonTarget (i := i) (t := t) j d.point a
  have hSquare : (j.stalkMap (pullback.fst j t wR)).hom bR =
      (sourceStalkIsoOfIsIsoSquare (pullback.fst j t) wR).inv.hom
        (((pullback.snd j t).stalkMap wR).hom aR) := by
    simpa [bR] using stalkMap_principalStalkElementOfIsIsoSquare
      j (pullback.snd j t) (pullback.fst j t) t pullback.condition wR aR
  have hRight := right_point (i := i) (t := t) j d
  have hPointMap :
      (Y.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hRight)).hom
          ((j.stalkMap (pullback.fst j t wR)).hom bR) =
        (j.stalkMap (pullback.snd i j z)).hom
          ((X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (congrArg j hRight))).hom bR) := by
    simpa [wR] using ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_congr_point j
        (pullback.fst j t wR) (pullback.snd i j z) hRight) bR
  have hLeft := left_point (i := i) (t := t) j d
  have hGlobal : i (pullback.fst i j z) = j (pullback.snd i j z) := by
    change (pullback.fst i j ≫ i) z = (pullback.snd i j ≫ j) z
    rw [pullback.condition]
  have hLocal : i (pullback.fst i t wL) = j (pullback.fst j t wR) := by
    calc
      i (pullback.fst i t wL) = t (pullback.snd i t wL) := by
        change (pullback.fst i t ≫ i) wL = (pullback.snd i t ≫ t) wL
        rw [pullback.condition]
      _ = t (pullback.snd j t wR) := congrArg t hU
      _ = j (pullback.fst j t wR) := by
        change (pullback.snd j t ≫ t) wR = (pullback.fst j t ≫ j) wR
        rw [pullback.condition]
  let hDirect : i (pullback.fst i t wL) = j (pullback.snd i j z) :=
    hLocal.trans (congrArg j hRight)
  have hAmbient :
      (X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (congrArg j hRight))).hom bR =
        (X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hGlobal)).hom
          ((X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (congrArg i hLeft))).hom bL) := by
    rw [hCommon]
    calc
      (X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (congrArg j hRight))).hom
          ((X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hLocal)).hom bL) =
          (X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hDirect)).hom bL := by
        exact stalkCongr_comp_apply_of_eq_two X
          hLocal (congrArg j hRight) hDirect bL
      _ = (X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hGlobal)).hom
          ((X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (congrArg i hLeft))).hom bL) := by
        symm
        exact stalkCongr_comp_apply_of_eq_two X
          (congrArg i hLeft) hGlobal hDirect bL
  have hFinal :
      (Y.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hRight)).hom
          ((sourceStalkIsoOfIsIsoSquare (pullback.fst j t) wR).inv.hom
            (((pullback.snd j t).stalkMap wR).hom aR)) =
        (j.stalkMap (pullback.snd i j z)).hom
          ((X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hGlobal)).hom
            ((X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (congrArg i hLeft))).hom bL)) := by
    rw [← hSquare, hPointMap, hAmbient]
  simpa [stalkElement, ambientStalkElement,
    principalStalkElementOfIsIsoSquare, targetStalkIsoOfIsIsoSquare,
    sourceStalkIsoOfIsIsoSquare,
    pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkElement, pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkMap,
    Iso.trans_inv, wL, wR, aR, bL] using hFinal

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.OpenIntersectionRestriction.At.ker_stalkMap_snd_eq_span
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_snd_eq_span {z : (pullback i j : Scheme.{u})}
    (d : At (i := i) (t := t) j z)
    (a : (pullback j t).presheaf.stalk
      (pullback.snd (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t) d.point))
    (hker : RingHom.ker
      ((pullback.snd (pullback.snd i t) (pullback.snd j t)).stalkMap d.point).hom =
        Ideal.span {a}) :
    RingHom.ker ((pullback.snd i j).stalkMap z).hom =
      Ideal.span {stalkElement (i := i) (t := t) j d a}
proof:
:= by
  rcases d with ⟨w, hw⟩
  subst z
  simpa [stalkElement] using
    ker_stalkMap_snd_eq_span_of_restriction (i := i) (t := t) j w a hker

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.OpenRightRestriction.map_fst
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem map_fst : map f g v ≫ pullback.fst f g = pullback.fst f (v ≫ g)
proof:
:= by
  change pullback.lift _ _ _ ≫ pullback.fst f g = _
  rw [pullback.lift_fst, Category.comp_id]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.OpenRightRestriction.map_snd
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem map_snd :
    map f g v ≫ pullback.snd f g = pullback.snd f (v ≫ g) ≫ v

  rw [pullback.lift_snd]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.OpenRightRestriction.exists_preimage
statement:
theorem exists_preimage (z : (pullback f g : Scheme.{u})) (y : V)
    (h : v y = pullback.snd f g z) :
    ∃ w : (pullback f (v ≫ g) : Scheme.{u}), map f g v w = z
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : pullback.fst f g z ∈ Set.range (𝟙 A : A ⟶ A) :=
    ⟨pullback.fst f g z, rfl⟩
  have hright : pullback.snd f g z ∈ Set.range v := ⟨y, h⟩
  change z ∈ Set.range (pullback.map f (v ≫ g) f g
    (𝟙 A) v (𝟙 S) (by simp) (by simp))
  rw [Scheme.Pullback.range_map]
  exact ⟨hleft, hright⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.OpenRightRestriction.ker_stalkMap_snd_eq_span_of_restriction
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_snd_eq_span_of_restriction
    (w : (pullback f (v ≫ g) : Scheme.{u}))
    (a : V.presheaf.stalk (pullback.snd f (v ≫ g) w))
    (hker : RingHom.ker ((pullback.snd f (v ≫ g)).stalkMap w).hom =
      Ideal.span {a}) :
    RingHom.ker ((pullback.snd f g).stalkMap (map f g v w)).hom =
      Ideal.span {
        principalStalkElementOfIsIsoSquare
          (pullback.snd f g) (pullback.snd f (v ≫ g))
          (map f g v) v (map_snd f g v) w a}
proof:
:= by
  exact ker_stalkMap_eq_span_of_isIso_square
    (pullback.snd f g) (pullback.snd f (v ≫ g))
    (map f g v) v (map_snd f g v) w a hker

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.OpenRightRestriction.At.fst_point
statement:
theorem fst_point {z : (pullback f g : Scheme.{u})} (d : At f g v z) :
    pullback.fst f g z = pullback.fst f (v ≫ g) d.point
proof:
:= by
  calc
    pullback.fst f g z = pullback.fst f g (map f g v d.point) :=
      congrArg (pullback.fst f g) d.map_point.symm
    _ = pullback.fst f (v ≫ g) d.point := by
      change (map f g v ≫ pullback.fst f g) d.point = _
      rw [map_fst]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.OpenRightRestriction.At.snd_point
statement:
theorem snd_point {z : (pullback f g : Scheme.{u})} (d : At f g v z) :
    v (pullback.snd f (v ≫ g) d.point) = pullback.snd f g z
proof:
:= by
  calc
    v (pullback.snd f (v ≫ g) d.point) =
        pullback.snd f g (map f g v d.point) := by
      change (pullback.snd f (v ≫ g) ≫ v) d.point =
        (map f g v ≫ pullback.snd f g) d.point
      rw [map_snd]
    _ = pullback.snd f g z := congrArg (pullback.snd f g) d.map_point

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.OpenRightRestriction.At.stalkElement_pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkElement
statement:
theorem stalkElement_pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkElement
    {z : (pullback f g : Scheme.{u})} (d : At f g v z)
    (a : S.presheaf.stalk (f (pullback.fst f g z))) :
    stalkElement f g v d
        (pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkElement f (v ≫ g) d.point
          (ambientStalkElement f g v d a)) =
      pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkElement f g z a
proof:
:= by
  rcases d with ⟨w, hw⟩
  subst z
  have hA : pullback.fst f g (map f g v w) =
      pullback.fst f (v ≫ g) w := by
    change (map f g v ≫ pullback.fst f g) w =
      pullback.fst f (v ≫ g) w
    rw [map_fst]
  have hB : v (pullback.snd f (v ≫ g) w) =
      pullback.snd f g (map f g v w) := by
    change (pullback.snd f (v ≫ g) ≫ v) w =
      (map f g v ≫ pullback.snd f g) w
    rw [map_snd]
  have hRestricted : f (pullback.fst f (v ≫ g) w) =
      g (v (pullback.snd f (v ≫ g) w)) := by
    change (pullback.fst f (v ≫ g) ≫ f) w =
      (pullback.snd f (v ≫ g) ≫ v ≫ g) w
    rw [pullback.condition]
  have hOriginal : f (pullback.fst f g (map f g v w)) =
      g (pullback.snd f g (map f g v w)) := by
    change (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (map f g v w) =
      (pullback.snd f g ≫ g) (map f g v w)
    rw [pullback.condition]
  have hToRestricted : f (pullback.fst f g (map f g v w)) =
      g (v (pullback.snd f (v ≫ g) w)) :=
    (congrArg f hA).trans hRestricted
  let b := (S.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hToRestricted)).hom a
  simp [stalkElement, ambientStalkElement,
    principalStalkElementOfIsIsoSquare, targetStalkIsoOfIsIsoSquare,
    pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkElement, pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkMap,
    Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp, Iso.trans_inv]
  change
    (B.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hB)).hom
        ((g.stalkMap (v (pullback.snd f (v ≫ g) w))).hom b) =
      (g.stalkMap (pullback.snd f g (map f g v w))).hom
        ((S.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hOriginal)).hom a)
  have hpointMap :
      (B.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hB)).hom
          ((g.stalkMap (v (pullback.snd f (v ≫ g) w))).hom b) =
        (g.stalkMap (pullback.snd f g (map f g v w))).hom
          ((S.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (congrArg g hB))).hom b) := by
    simpa only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] using
      ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
        (Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_congr_point g
          (v (pullback.snd f (v ≫ g) w))
          (pullback.snd f g (map f g v w)) hB) b
  have hambient :
      (S.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (congrArg g hB))).hom b =
        (S.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hOriginal)).hom a := by
    simpa [b] using stalkCongr_comp_apply_of_eq S hToRestricted rfl
      (congrArg g hB) hOriginal a
  exact hpointMap.trans
    (congrArg
      (fun y ↦ (g.stalkMap (pullback.snd f g (map f g v w))).hom y) hambient)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.OpenRightRestriction.At.ker_stalkMap_snd_eq_span
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_snd_eq_span {z : (pullback f g : Scheme.{u})}
    (d : At f g v z)
    (a : V.presheaf.stalk (pullback.snd f (v ≫ g) d.point))
    (hker : RingHom.ker ((pullback.snd f (v ≫ g)).stalkMap d.point).hom =
      Ideal.span {a}) :
    RingHom.ker ((pullback.snd f g).stalkMap z).hom =
      Ideal.span {stalkElement f g v d a}
proof:
:= by
  rcases d with ⟨w, hw⟩
  subst z
  simpa [stalkElement] using
    ker_stalkMap_snd_eq_span_of_restriction f g v w a hker

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.AffineBaseChange.pullbackIso_hom_fst
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem pullbackIso_hom_fst (b : c.AffineBaseChange V g) :
    b.pullbackIso.hom ≫
      pullback.fst (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap c.R b.S)))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {c.equation})))) =

theorem pullbackIso_hom_snd (b : c.AffineBaseChange V g) :
