name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.AffineBaseChange.stalkElement_eq_transport_pullbackBaseChangeStalkElement
statement:
theorem stalkElement_eq_transport_pullbackBaseChangeStalkElement
    (b : c.AffineBaseChange V g)
    (z : (pullback g (pullback.snd i t) : Scheme.{u})) :
    b.stalkElement z =
      principalStalkElementOfArrowIso
        (pullback.fst g (pullback.snd i t))
        (pullback.fst (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap c.R b.S)))
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {c.equation})))))
        b.pullbackIso b.targetIso b.pullbackIso_hom_fst z
        (pullbackBaseChangeStalkElement
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap c.R b.S)))
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {c.equation}))))
          (b.pullbackIso.hom z)
          (affineStalkElement c.equation
            ((pullback.snd (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap c.R b.S)))
              (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
                (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {c.equation}))))
              (b.pullbackIso.hom z)).comap
                (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {c.equation})))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [stalkElement,
    principalPullbackStalkElement_eq_pullbackBaseChangeStalkElement]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.AffineBaseChange.stalkElement_eq_pullbackBaseChangeStalkElement
statement:
theorem stalkElement_eq_pullbackBaseChangeStalkElement
    (b : c.AffineBaseChange V g)
    (z : (pullback g (pullback.snd i t) : Scheme.{u})) :
    b.stalkElement z =
      pullbackBaseChangeStalkElement g (pullback.snd i t) z
        (c.localStalkElement (pullback.snd g (pullback.snd i t) z))
proof:
:= by
  let x := pullback.fst g (pullback.snd i t) z
  let w := pullback.snd g (pullback.snd i t) z
  let f' := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap c.R b.S))
  let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {c.equation})))
  let a' := affineStalkElement c.equation
    ((b.targetIso.hom x).comap (algebraMap c.R b.S))
  have hfstPoint : pullback.fst f' q (b.pullbackIso.hom z) = b.targetIso.hom x := by
    change (b.pullbackIso.hom ≫ pullback.fst f' q) z =
      (pullback.fst g (pullback.snd i t) ≫ b.targetIso.hom) z
    rw [b.pullbackIso_hom_fst]
  have hpull : pullback.snd i t w = g x := by
    change (pullback.snd g (pullback.snd i t) ≫ pullback.snd i t) z =
      (pullback.fst g (pullback.snd i t) ≫ g) z
    rw [← pullback.condition]
  have htarget : b.stalkElement z =
      (sourceStalkIsoOfArrowIso b.targetIso x).hom
        ((f'.stalkMap (b.targetIso.hom x)).hom a') := by
    have hcongr := stalkCongr_affineStalkElement
      (algebraMap c.R b.S c.equation) hfstPoint
    simpa [stalkElement, f', q, a',
      principalPullbackStalkElement_eq_affineStalkElement,
      principalStalkElementOfArrowIso, targetStalkIsoOfArrowIso,
      sourceStalkIsoOfArrowIso, stalkMap_affineStalkElement] using
        congrArg (fun y ↦ (b.targetIso.hom.stalkMap x).hom y) hcongr
  have hlocalOriginal : c.localStalkElement w =
      (c.targetIso.hom.stalkMap (pullback.snd i t w)).hom
        (affineStalkElement c.equation
          (c.targetIso.hom (pullback.snd i t w))) := by
    change
      (targetStalkIsoOfArrowIso (pullback.snd i t)
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {c.equation}))))
        c.sourceIso c.targetIso c.commutes w).hom
          (affineStalkElement c.equation
            ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
              (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {c.equation}))))
                (c.sourceIso.hom w))) = _
    exact targetStalkIsoOfArrowIso_affineStalkElement
      (pullback.snd i t)
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {c.equation}))))
      c.sourceIso c.targetIso c.commutes w c.equation
  have hpointMap := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_congr_point c.targetIso.hom
      (pullback.snd i t w) (g x) hpull)
    (affineStalkElement c.equation
      (c.targetIso.hom (pullback.snd i t w)))
  have hlocalLeft :
      ((U.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hpull)).hom
        (c.localStalkElement w)) =
      (c.targetIso.hom.stalkMap (g x)).hom
        (affineStalkElement c.equation (c.targetIso.hom (g x))) := by
    calc
      _ = (U.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hpull)).hom
          ((c.targetIso.hom.stalkMap (pullback.snd i t w)).hom
            (affineStalkElement c.equation
              (c.targetIso.hom (pullback.snd i t w)))) :=
        congrArg (fun y ↦ (U.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hpull)).hom y)
          hlocalOriginal
      _ = (c.targetIso.hom.stalkMap (g x)).hom
          (((Spec (.of c.R)).presheaf.stalkCongr
            (.of_eq (congrArg c.targetIso.hom hpull))).hom
              (affineStalkElement c.equation
                (c.targetIso.hom (pullback.snd i t w)))) := hpointMap
      _ = _ := congrArg
        (fun y ↦ (c.targetIso.hom.stalkMap (g x)).hom y)
        (stalkCongr_affineStalkElement c.equation
          (congrArg c.targetIso.hom hpull))
  have hlocalRight :
      (targetStalkIsoOfArrowIso g f' b.targetIso c.targetIso b.commutes x).hom a' =
      (c.targetIso.hom.stalkMap (g x)).hom
        (affineStalkElement c.equation (c.targetIso.hom (g x))) := by
    change
      (targetStalkIsoOfArrowIso g f' b.targetIso c.targetIso b.commutes x).hom
          (affineStalkElement c.equation (f' (b.targetIso.hom x))) = _
    exact targetStalkIsoOfArrowIso_affineStalkElement
      g f' b.targetIso c.targetIso b.commutes x c.equation
  have hlocal :
      (U.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hpull)).hom (c.localStalkElement w) =
      (targetStalkIsoOfArrowIso g f' b.targetIso c.targetIso b.commutes x).hom a' :=
    hlocalLeft.trans hlocalRight.symm
  have hsquare := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (stalkMap_square_of_arrow_iso g f'
      b.targetIso c.targetIso b.commutes x) a'
  calc
    b.stalkElement z = (sourceStalkIsoOfArrowIso b.targetIso x).hom
        ((f'.stalkMap (b.targetIso.hom x)).hom a') := htarget
    _ = (g.stalkMap x).hom
        ((targetStalkIsoOfArrowIso g f' b.targetIso c.targetIso b.commutes x).hom a') :=
      hsquare
    _ = (g.stalkMap x).hom
        ((U.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hpull)).hom (c.localStalkElement w)) :=
      congrArg (fun y ↦ (g.stalkMap x).hom y) hlocal.symm
    _ = pullbackBaseChangeStalkElement g (pullback.snd i t) z
        (c.localStalkElement (pullback.snd g (pullback.snd i t) z)) := by
      rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.AffineBaseChange.ker_stalkMap
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap (b : c.AffineBaseChange V g)
    (z : (pullback g (pullback.snd i t) : Scheme.{u})) :
    RingHom.ker ((pullback.fst g (pullback.snd i t)).stalkMap z).hom =
      Ideal.span {b.stalkElement z}
proof:
:= by
  exact ker_stalkMap_eq_span_of_arrow_iso
    (pullback.fst g (pullback.snd i t))
    (pullback.fst (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap c.R b.S)))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {c.equation})))))
    b.pullbackIso b.targetIso b.pullbackIso_hom_fst z
    (principalPullbackStalkElement c.R b.S c.equation (b.pullbackIso.hom z))
    (ker_stalkMap_pullback_fst_principal c.R b.S c.equation (b.pullbackIso.hom z))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.AffineBaseChange.ker_stalkMap_eq_span_pullbackBaseChangeStalkElement
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_eq_span_pullbackBaseChangeStalkElement
    (b : c.AffineBaseChange V g)
    (z : (pullback g (pullback.snd i t) : Scheme.{u})) :
    RingHom.ker ((pullback.fst g (pullback.snd i t)).stalkMap z).hom =
      Ideal.span {
        pullbackBaseChangeStalkElement g (pullback.snd i t) z
          (c.localStalkElement
            (pullback.snd g (pullback.snd i t) z))}
proof:
:= by
  rw [b.ker_stalkMap z,
    b.stalkElement_eq_pullbackBaseChangeStalkElement z]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.AffineBaseChange.ker_stalkMap_snd_eq_span_pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkElement
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_snd_eq_span_pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkElement
    (b : c.AffineBaseChange V g)
    (z : (pullback (pullback.snd i t) g : Scheme.{u})) :
    RingHom.ker ((pullback.snd (pullback.snd i t) g).stalkMap z).hom =
      Ideal.span {
        pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkElement (pullback.snd i t) g z
          (c.localStalkElement
            (pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) g z))}
proof:
:= by
  have hpoint : pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) g z =
      pullback.snd g (pullback.snd i t)
        ((pullbackSymmetry (pullback.snd i t) g).hom z) := by
    change pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) g z =
      ((pullbackSymmetry (pullback.snd i t) g).hom ≫
        pullback.snd g (pullback.snd i t)) z
    rw [pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_snd]
  apply
    ker_stalkMap_pullback_snd_eq_span_pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkElement_of_symmetry
      (pullback.snd i t) g z
        (c.localStalkElement (pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) g z))
  have hlocal :
      pullbackSymmetryAmbientStalkElement (pullback.snd i t) g z
          (c.localStalkElement (pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) g z)) =
        c.localStalkElement
          (pullback.snd g (pullback.snd i t)
            ((pullbackSymmetry (pullback.snd i t) g).hom z)) := by
    change
      (U.presheaf.stalkCongr
        (.of_eq (congrArg (pullback.snd i t) hpoint))).hom
          (c.localStalkElement (pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) g z)) = _
    exact c.stalkCongr_localStalkElement hpoint
  rw [hlocal]
  exact b.ker_stalkMap_eq_span_pullbackBaseChangeStalkElement
    ((pullbackSymmetry (pullback.snd i t) g).hom z)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.AffineBaseChange.ker_stalkMap_eq_span_transport_pullbackBaseChangeStalkElement
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_eq_span_transport_pullbackBaseChangeStalkElement
    (b : c.AffineBaseChange V g)
    (z : (pullback g (pullback.snd i t) : Scheme.{u})) :
    RingHom.ker ((pullback.fst g (pullback.snd i t)).stalkMap z).hom =
      Ideal.span {
        principalStalkElementOfArrowIso
          (pullback.fst g (pullback.snd i t))
          (pullback.fst (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap c.R b.S)))
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
              (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {c.equation})))))
          b.pullbackIso b.targetIso b.pullbackIso_hom_fst z
          (pullbackBaseChangeStalkElement
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap c.R b.S)))
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
              (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {c.equation}))))
            (b.pullbackIso.hom z)
            (affineStalkElement c.equation
              ((pullback.snd (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap c.R b.S)))
                (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
                  (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {c.equation}))))
                (b.pullbackIso.hom z)).comap
                  (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {c.equation})))))}
proof:
:= by
  rw [b.ker_stalkMap z,
    b.stalkElement_eq_transport_pullbackBaseChangeStalkElement z]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.AffineNeighbourhoodAt.ker_stalkMap_snd_eq_span_principalBaseChangeStalkElement
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_snd_eq_span_principalBaseChangeStalkElement
    (z : (pullback (pullback.snd i t) g : Scheme.{u}))

      (c.localStalkElement

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.PrincipalOpenPullbackChart.AffineNeighbourhoodAt.principalBaseChangeStalkElement_eq_pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkElement
statement:
theorem principalBaseChangeStalkElement_eq_pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkElement
    (z : (pullback (pullback.snd i t) g : Scheme.{u}))
    (d : AffineNeighbourhoodAt Y
      (pullback.snd (pullback.snd i t) g z)) :
    principalBaseChangeStalkElement g c z d =
      pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkElement (pullback.snd i t) g z
        (c.localStalkElement (pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) g z))
proof:
:= by
  let e := d.rightRestrictionAt (pullback.snd i t) g z
  have hlocal :
      OpenRightRestriction.At.ambientStalkElement
          (pullback.snd i t) g d.map e
          (c.localStalkElement (pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) g z)) =
        c.localStalkElement
          (pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) (d.map ≫ g) e.point) := by
    change
      (U.presheaf.stalkCongr
        (.of_eq (congrArg (pullback.snd i t)
          (OpenRightRestriction.At.fst_point
            (pullback.snd i t) g d.map e)))).hom
          (c.localStalkElement (pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) g z)) = _
    exact c.stalkCongr_localStalkElement
      (OpenRightRestriction.At.fst_point (pullback.snd i t) g d.map e)
  change OpenRightRestriction.At.stalkElement
      (pullback.snd i t) g d.map e
        (pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkElement
          (pullback.snd i t) (d.map ≫ g) e.point
          (c.localStalkElement
            (pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) (d.map ≫ g) e.point))) = _
  rw [← hlocal]
  exact OpenRightRestriction.At.stalkElement_pullbackBaseChangeSndStalkElement
    (pullback.snd i t) g d.map e
      (c.localStalkElement (pullback.fst (pullback.snd i t) g z))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.pointClosure_codimension_two
statement:
theorem pointClosure_codimension_two [Order.KrullDimLE 2 X]
    (z : X) (hz : coheight z = 1) (y : pointClosureScheme z)
    (hy : coheight y = 1) : coheight (pointClosureι z y) = 2
proof:
:= by
  let a := pointClosureGenericPoint z
  have ha0 : coheight a = 0 := by
    have haeq : a = genericPoint (pointClosureScheme z) :=
      (pointClosureGenericPoint_isGeneric z).eq
        (genericPoint_spec (pointClosureScheme z))
    rw [haeq]
    exact coheight_eq_zero.mpr isMax_top
  have hspec : Specializes z (pointClosureι z y) := by
    have hsource : Specializes a y :=
      (pointClosureGenericPoint_isGeneric z).specializes trivial
    simpa only [a, pointClosureι_genericPoint] using
      hsource.map (pointClosureι z).continuous
  have hle : pointClosureι z y ≤ z :=
    Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr hspec
  have hne : pointClosureι z y ≠ z := by
    intro h
    have hya : y = a := (pointClosureι z).isEmbedding.injective
      (h.trans (pointClosureι_genericPoint z).symm)
    rw [hya, ha0] at hy
    exact zero_ne_one hy
  have hlt : pointClosureι z y < z :=
    lt_of_le_not_ge hle fun hge ↦ hne
      (((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hle).antisymm
        (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hge)).eq.symm)
  have hlower : 2 ≤ coheight (pointClosureι z y) := by
    have h := Order.coheight_add_one_le hlt
    rw [hz] at h
    norm_num at h ⊢
    exact h
  have hupper : coheight (pointClosureι z y) ≤ 2 := by
    have h := (Order.coheight_le_krullDim (pointClosureι z y)).trans
      (Order.KrullDimLE.krullDim_le (n := 2) (α := ↥X))
    have h' : (↑(coheight (pointClosureι z y)) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤
        ↑(2 : ℕ∞) := by
      simpa using h
    exact WithBot.coe_le_coe.mp h'
  exact le_antisymm hupper hlower

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ProperPrimeIntersectionData.swap_cycle
statement: theorem swap_cycle : d.swap.cycle.1 = d.cycle.1
proof:
:= by
  let a := d.swap.toFiniteClosedIntersectionData
  let b := d.toFiniteClosedIntersectionData.swap
  change a.cycle.1 = d.toFiniteClosedIntersectionData.cycle.1
  rw [← d.toFiniteClosedIntersectionData.swap_cycle]
  change a.cycle.1 = b.cycle.1
  ext t
  by_cases ht : ∃ z : b.intersection, b.toX z = t
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := ht
    change a.cycle.1 (a.toX z) = b.cycle.1 (b.toX z)
    rw [a.cycle_apply_toX, b.cycle_apply_toX]
    rfl
  · rw [b.cycle_apply_eq_zero_of_not_exists t ht]
    apply a.cycle_apply_eq_zero_of_not_exists
    change ¬ ∃ z : b.intersection, b.toX z = t
    exact ht

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.properPushforward_div_eq_zero_of_noBad
statement:
theorem properPushforward_div_eq_zero_of_noBad {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (h : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact h]
    [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsIntegral Y] (r : X.functionField)
    (hbad : ∀ x : X, coheight x = 1 → h.degree x ≠ 0 → h x = genericPoint Y)
    (hgen : properPushforward h (div r) (genericPoint Y) = 0) :
    properPushforward h (div r) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  by_cases hy : y = genericPoint Y
  · subst hy
    exact hgen
  rw [properPushforward_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨rfl, hx0⟩ := (mem_preimageSupportFinite_toFinset_iff h (div r) _ x).mp hx
  have hc : coheight x = 1 := div_support hx0
  by_cases hd : h.degree x = 0
  · simp [hd]
  · exact (hy (hbad x hc hd)).elim

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F14drop_noBad
statement:
theorem F14drop_noBad {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (h : X ⟶ Y) [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y]
    (hf : HeightCompatible h) (hX : DimensionCatenary X)
    (hdim : height (genericPoint Y) < height (genericPoint X)) :
    ∀ x : X, coheight x = 1 → h.degree x ≠ 0 → h x = genericPoint Y
proof:
:= by
  intro x hc hd
  by_contra hne
  have hle : h x ≤ genericPoint Y :=
    Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr ((genericPoint_spec Y).specializes trivial)
  have hlt : h x < genericPoint Y := lt_of_le_not_ge hle fun hge => hne
    (((Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hge).antisymm (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hle)).eq)
  have h1 := height_add_one_le hlt
  rw [hf x hd] at h1
  have h2 : height x + 1 = height (genericPoint X) := hX X (𝟙 X) x hc
  rw [h2] at h1
  exact absurd hdim (not_lt.mpr h1)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.F14drop_of_dimension
statement:
theorem F14drop_of_dimension {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (h : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact h] [IsIntegral X]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsIntegral Y] (r : X.functionField)
    (hf : HeightCompatible h) (hX : DimensionCatenary X)
    (hdim : height (genericPoint Y) < height (genericPoint X))
    (hgen : properPushforward h (div r) (genericPoint Y) = 0) :
    properPushforward h (div r) = 0
proof:
:=
  properPushforward_div_eq_zero_of_noBad h r (F14drop_noBad h hf hX hdim) hgen

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.essFiniteType_residueField
statement:
theorem essFiniteType_residueField (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] (x : X) :
    letI
proof:
:= (kRes k X x).toAlgebra
    Algebra.EssFiniteType k (X.residueField x) := by
  letI := (kRes k X x).toAlgebra
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hx, -⟩ := (TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens)
    (show x ∈ (⊤ : X.Opens) from trivial)
  letI := (kSec k X U).toAlgebra
  haveI : Algebra.FiniteType k Γ(X, U) := finiteType_kSec k X hU
  set p := (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩).asIdeal with hp
  let φ : Γ(X, U) ⧸ p →+* X.residueField x :=
    Ideal.Quotient.lift p (X.evaluation U x hx).hom
      (fun a ha ↦ (evaluation_eq_zero_iff_mem_primeIdealOf X hU x hx a).mpr ha)
  letI : Algebra (Γ(X, U) ⧸ p) (X.residueField x) := φ.toAlgebra
  have hφ : ∀ a : Γ(X, U), φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk p a) = X.evaluation U x hx a := fun a ↦ rfl
  have hφinj : Function.Injective φ := by
    rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, ← evaluation_eq_zero_iff_mem_primeIdealOf X hU x hx a,
      ← hφ]
    exact ha
  haveI : FaithfulSMul (Γ(X, U) ⧸ p) (X.residueField x) :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective _ _).mpr hφinj
  haveI : IsScalarTower k (Γ(X, U) ⧸ p) (X.residueField x) := by
    refine IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun r ↦ ?_
    change kRes k X x r = φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk p (kSec k X U r))
    rw [hφ, kSec_evaluation]
  haveI : IsFractionRing (Γ(X, U) ⧸ p) (X.residueField x) := by
    refine IsFractionRing.of_field _ _ fun z ↦ ?_
    letI : Algebra Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
      TopCat.Presheaf.algebra_section_stalk X.presheaf ⟨x, hx⟩
    haveI : IsLocalization.AtPrime (X.presheaf.stalk x) p := hU.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hx⟩
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective (R := X.presheaf.stalk x) z
    obtain ⟨⟨a, t⟩, hw⟩ := IsLocalization.surj p.primeCompl w
    have hw' := congrArg (IsLocalRing.residue (X.presheaf.stalk x)) hw
    rw [map_mul] at hw'
    refine ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk p a, Ideal.Quotient.mk p t, ?_⟩
    have ht : algebraMap (Γ(X, U) ⧸ p) (X.residueField x) (Ideal.Quotient.mk p t) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      exact t.2 (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp (hφinj (h0.trans (map_zero φ).symm)))
    rw [eq_div_iff ht]
    change _ * φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk p t) = φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk p a)
    rw [hφ, hφ]
    exact hw'
  haveI : Algebra.EssFiniteType (Γ(X, U) ⧸ p) (X.residueField x) :=
    Algebra.EssFiniteType.of_isLocalization (X.residueField x) (nonZeroDivisors (Γ(X, U) ⧸ p))
  exact Algebra.EssFiniteType.comp k (Γ(X, U) ⧸ p) (X.residueField x)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.τ_lt_of_degree_eq_zero
statement:
theorem τ_lt_of_degree_eq_zero {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] (x : X) (hx : f.degree x = 0) :
    τ k Y (f x) < τ k X x
proof:
:= by
  have e : f ≫ (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) = X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k) :=
    CategoryTheory.comp_over (f := f) (S := Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
  have hΓ : ∀ r : k, f.appTop.hom (kΓ k Y r) = kΓ k X r := by
    intro r
    change ((Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).appTop ≫ f.appTop).hom _ =
      (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).appTop.hom _
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, e]
  letI : Algebra k (Y.residueField (f x)) := (kRes k Y (f x)).toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra k (X.residueField x) := (kRes k X x).toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra (Y.residueField (f x)) (X.residueField x) :=
    (f.residueFieldMap x).hom.toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower k (Y.residueField (f x)) (X.residueField x) := by
    refine IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun r ↦ ?_
    have h1 := Scheme.Γevaluation_naturality_apply f x (kΓ k Y r)
    change (X.Γevaluation x).hom (kΓ k X r) =
      (f.residueFieldMap x).hom ((Y.Γevaluation (f x)).hom (kΓ k Y r))
    rw [← hΓ r]
    exact h1.symm
  haveI : Algebra.EssFiniteType k (X.residueField x) := essFiniteType_residueField k X x
  haveI : Algebra.EssFiniteType (Y.residueField (f x)) (X.residueField x) :=
    Algebra.EssFiniteType.of_comp k _ _
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, -⟩ := (TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens)
    (show x ∈ (⊤ : X.Opens) from trivial)
  have hfin : τ k X x ≠ ⊤ := τ_ne_top k X hV x hxV
  have hadd := congrArg Cardinal.toENat
    (trdeg_add_eq k (Y.residueField (f x)) (A := X.residueField x))
  rw [map_add] at hadd
  change τ k Y (f x) + _ = τ k X x at hadd
  by_contra hlt
  rw [not_lt] at hlt
  have h0 : Cardinal.toENat
      (Algebra.trdeg (Y.residueField (f x)) (X.residueField x)) = 0 := by
    generalize Cardinal.toENat (Algebra.trdeg (Y.residueField (f x)) (X.residueField x)) = t
      at hadd ⊢
    generalize τ k Y (f x) = a at hadd hlt
    generalize τ k X x = b at hadd hlt hfin
    lift b to ℕ using hfin
    have ha : a ≠ ⊤ := by
      rintro rfl
      simp at hadd
    have ht : t ≠ ⊤ := by
      rintro rfl
      simp at hadd
    lift a to ℕ using ha
    lift t to ℕ using ht
    norm_cast at hadd hlt ⊢
    omega
  haveI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (Y.residueField (f x)) (X.residueField x) := by
    rw [← trdeg_eq_zero_iff, ← Cardinal.toENat_eq_zero]
    exact h0
  haveI : Module.Finite (Y.residueField (f x)) (X.residueField x) :=
    Algebra.finite_of_essFiniteType_of_isAlgebraic
  exact (Module.finrank_pos (R := Y.residueField (f x)) (M := X.residueField x)).ne' hx

theorem genericPoint_map_of_isDominant {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y]

proof:
:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.height_genericPoint_lt_of_degree_eq_zero
statement:
theorem height_genericPoint_lt_of_degree_eq_zero {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X]
    [IsIntegral Y] [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (h : X ⟶ Y) [h.IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [IsDominant h]
    (hdeg : h.degree (genericPoint X) = 0) :
    Order.height (genericPoint Y) < Order.height (genericPoint X)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, -⟩ := (TopologicalSpace.Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp X.isBasis_affineOpens)
    (show genericPoint X ∈ (⊤ : X.Opens) from trivial)
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp (τ_ne_top k X hV _ hxV)
  have hX : Order.height (genericPoint X) = n := by
    rw [height_eq_coheight_primeIdealOf k X hV _ hxV, coheight_primeIdealOf_eq_τ k X hV _ hxV,
      hn]
  have hlt := τ_lt_of_degree_eq_zero k h _ hdeg
  rw [genericPoint_map_of_isDominant h, ← hn] at hlt
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m : ℕ, τ k Y (genericPoint Y) = m :=
    ⟨(τ k Y (genericPoint Y)).toNat, (ENat.coe_toNat (ne_top_of_lt hlt)).symm⟩
  rw [hm, Nat.cast_lt] at hlt
  rw [hX]
  exact (height_le_τ k Y m _ hm).trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast hlt)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.closedImmersionPushforwardCycles_mem_rationalEquivalenceSubgroup

theorem closedImmersionPushforwardCycles_mem_rationalEquivalenceSubgroup
    {Z X : Scheme.{u}} {p q : ℕ}

proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.closedImmersionCodimension_comp
statement:
theorem closedImmersionCodimension_comp
    {Y Z X : Scheme.{u}} {p q r : ℕ}
    (f : Y ⟶ Z) (g : Z ⟶ X)
    (hf : ∀ y : Y, coheight y = p → coheight (f y) = q)
    (hg : ∀ z : Z, coheight z = q → coheight (g z) = r) :
    ∀ y : Y, coheight y = p → coheight ((f ≫ g) y) = r
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  exact hg (f y) (hf y hy)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.closedImmersionPushforwardCycles_comp
statement:
theorem closedImmersionPushforwardCycles_comp
    {Y Z X : Scheme.{u}} {p q r : ℕ}
    (f : Y ⟶ Z) (g : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion f] [IsClosedImmersion g]
    (hf : ∀ y : Y, coheight y = p → coheight (f y) = q)
    (hg : ∀ z : Z, coheight z = q → coheight (g z) = r)
    (D : CodimensionCycles Y ℤ p) :
    closedImmersionPushforwardCycles (f ≫ g)
        (closedImmersionCodimension_comp f g hf hg) D =
      closedImmersionPushforwardCycles g hg
        (closedImmersionPushforwardCycles f hf D)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change AlgebraicCycle.pushforward (f ≫ g) D.1
      (fun _ ↦ (r : ℕ∞)) coheight =
    AlgebraicCycle.pushforward g
      (AlgebraicCycle.pushforward f D.1 (fun _ ↦ (q : ℕ∞)) coheight)
      (fun _ ↦ (r : ℕ∞)) coheight
  have hfgrade : ∀ y : Y, D.1 y ≠ 0 →
      (q : ℕ∞) = coheight (f y) := by
    intro y hy
    exact (hf y (D.2 hy)).symm
  have hnormalize :
      AlgebraicCycle.pushforward f D.1
          (fun _ ↦ (r : ℕ∞)) (fun _ ↦ (r : ℕ∞)) =
        AlgebraicCycle.pushforward f D.1
          (fun _ ↦ (q : ℕ∞)) coheight :=
    AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_eq_closedImmersion f D.1
      (fun _ ↦ (r : ℕ∞)) (fun _ ↦ (r : ℕ∞))
      (fun _ ↦ (q : ℕ∞)) coheight (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) hfgrade
  have hggrade : ∀ z : Z,
      AlgebraicCycle.pushforward f D.1
          (fun _ ↦ (r : ℕ∞)) (fun _ ↦ (r : ℕ∞)) z ≠ 0 →
        (r : ℕ∞) = coheight (g z) := by
    intro z hz
    apply (hg z ?_).symm
    apply (closedImmersionPushforwardCycles f hf D).2
    change AlgebraicCycle.pushforward f D.1
      (fun _ ↦ (q : ℕ∞)) coheight z ≠ 0
    rwa [← hnormalize]
  calc
    _ = AlgebraicCycle.pushforward g
        (AlgebraicCycle.pushforward f D.1
          (fun _ ↦ (r : ℕ∞)) (fun _ ↦ (r : ℕ∞)))
        (fun _ ↦ (r : ℕ∞)) coheight :=
      AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_comp_closedImmersion f g D.1
        (fun _ ↦ (r : ℕ∞)) (fun _ ↦ (r : ℕ∞)) coheight
        (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) hggrade
    _ = _ := by rw [hnormalize]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.closedImmersionPushforwardChow_comp
statement:
theorem closedImmersionPushforwardChow_comp
    {Y Z X : Scheme.{u}} {p q r : ℕ}
    (f : Y ⟶ Z) (g : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion f] [IsClosedImmersion g]
    (hf : ∀ y : Y, coheight y = p → coheight (f y) = q)
    (hg : ∀ z : Z, coheight z = q → coheight (g z) = r) :
    closedImmersionPushforwardChow (f ≫ g)
        (closedImmersionCodimension_comp f g hf hg) =
      (closedImmersionPushforwardChow g hg).comp
        (closedImmersionPushforwardChow f hf)
proof:
:= by
  apply gradedClass_hom_ext
  intro D
  simp only [closedImmersionPushforwardChow_classOf, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]
  rw [closedImmersionPushforwardCycles_comp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.closedImmersionPushforwardCycles_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem closedImmersionPushforwardCycles_id
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {p : ℕ} (D : CodimensionCycles X ℤ p) :
    closedImmersionPushforwardCycles (𝟙 X) closedImmersionCodimension_id D = D
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change AlgebraicCycle.pushforward (𝟙 X) D.1
    (fun _ ↦ (p : ℕ∞)) coheight = D.1
  have hgrade : ∀ x : X, D.1 x ≠ 0 →
      (p : ℕ∞) = coheight ((𝟙 X) x) := by
    intro x hx
    simpa using (D.2 hx).symm
  ext x
  simpa using AlgebraicCycle.pushforward_apply_closedImmersion (𝟙 X) D.1
    (fun _ ↦ (p : ℕ∞)) coheight hgrade x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.closedImmersionPushforwardChow_id

theorem closedImmersionPushforwardChow_id {X : Scheme.{u}} {p : ℕ} :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.degree_closedImmersionPushforwardCycles

theorem degree_closedImmersionPushforwardCycles
    {Z X : Scheme.{u}} {p q : ℕ}
    (j : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    (codimension : ∀ z : Z, coheight z = p → coheight (j z) = q)
    (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [Z.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (D : CodimensionCycles Z ℤ p)
    [∀ z : Z, IsScalarTower k ↑(X.residueField (j z)) ↑(Z.residueField z)] :
    AlgebraicCycle.degree k (closedImmersionPushforwardCycles j codimension D).1 =
      AlgebraicCycle.degree k D.1
proof:
:= by
  have hgrade : ∀ z : Z, D.1 z ≠ 0 → (q : ℕ∞) = coheight (j z) := by
    intro z hz
    exact (codimension z (D.2 hz)).symm
  simpa [closedImmersionPushforwardCycles_coe] using
    AlgebraicCycle.degree_pushforward_closedImmersion j k D.1
      (fun _ ↦ (q : ℕ∞)) coheight hgrade

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.stalkSpecializes_injective
statement:
theorem stalkSpecializes_injective {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Y] {w z : Y} (h : w ⤳ z) :
    Function.Injective (Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : (Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes ((genericPoint_spec Y).specializes trivial)).hom.comp
      (Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom =
        algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk z) Y.functionField := by
    rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, ← CommRingCat.hom_comp,
      TopCat.Presheaf.stalkSpecializes_comp]
  have hinj : Function.Injective
      ((Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes ((genericPoint_spec Y).specializes trivial)).hom.comp
        (Y.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h).hom) := by
    rw [hcomp]
    exact IsFractionRing.injective _ _
  rw [RingHom.coe_comp] at hinj
  exact hinj.of_comp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.ker_stalkMap_pointClosureι_genericPoint
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_pointClosureι_genericPoint (v : X) :
    RingHom.ker ((pointClosureι v).stalkMap (pointClosureGenericPoint v)).hom =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk (pointClosureι v (pointClosureGenericPoint v)))
proof:
:= by
  set η := pointClosureGenericPoint v
  set ψ := ((pointClosureι v).stalkMap η).hom
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective ψ := (pointClosureι v).stalkMap_surjective η
  have hbot : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalk η) = ⊥ :=
    maximalIdeal_stalk_eq_bot_of_eq_genericPoint (pointClosureGenericPoint_eq_genericPoint v)
  have hmax : (Ideal.comap ψ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _)).IsMaximal :=
    Ideal.comap_isMaximal_of_surjective ψ hsurj
  rw [RingHom.ker, ← hbot]
  exact IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hmax

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.ker_stalkMap_pointClosureι
statement:
theorem ker_stalkMap_pointClosureι (v : X) (z : pointClosureScheme v) :
    RingHom.ker ((pointClosureι v).stalkMap z).hom =
      Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (specializes_pointClosureι v z)
proof:
:= by
  set η := pointClosureGenericPoint v
  have hη : η ⤳ z := (pointClosureGenericPoint_isGeneric v).specializes (Set.mem_univ z)
  have hη' : pointClosureι v η ⤳ pointClosureι v z := hη.map (pointClosureι v).continuous
  rw [stalkPrimeOfSpecializes_congr (pointClosureι_genericPoint v).symm _ hη']
  have hsq := (pointClosureι v).stalkSpecializes_stalkMap η z hη
  have hinj := stalkSpecializes_injective hη
  ext a
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker, Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes, Ideal.mem_comap,
    ← ker_stalkMap_pointClosureι_genericPoint v, RingHom.mem_ker]
  have happ : ((pointClosureι v).stalkMap η).hom ((X.presheaf.stalkSpecializes hη').hom a) =
      ((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalkSpecializes hη).hom
        (((pointClosureι v).stalkMap z).hom a) :=
    (pointClosureι v).stalkSpecializes_stalkMap_apply η z hη a
  rw [happ]
  constructor
  · intro ha
    rw [ha, map_zero]
  · intro ha
    exact hinj (by rw [ha, map_zero])

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.pointClosureStalkEquiv_mk

theorem pointClosureStalkEquiv_mk (v : X) (z : pointClosureScheme v)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.localMultiplicity_eq_ord_stalkMap
statement:
theorem localMultiplicity_eq_ord_stalkMap (v : X) (z : pointClosureScheme v)
    (a : X.presheaf.stalk (pointClosureι v z)) :
    CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity a (specializes_pointClosureι v z) =
      Ring.ord ((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalk z) (((pointClosureι v).stalkMap z).hom a)
proof:
:= by
  unfold CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity
  rw [← pointClosureStalkEquiv_mk, LocalOrdSymmetry.ord_ringEquiv]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.localMultiplicity_eq_ord_stalkMap'
statement:
theorem localMultiplicity_eq_ord_stalkMap' (v : X) (z : pointClosureScheme v)
    (a : X.presheaf.stalk (pointClosureι v z)) (h : v ⤳ pointClosureι v z) :
    CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity a h =
      Ring.ord ((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalk z) (((pointClosureι v).stalkMap z).hom a)
proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.localMultiplicity_toNat_eq_ord
statement:
theorem localMultiplicity_toNat_eq_ord [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (v : X) (z : pointClosureScheme v)
    (hz : coheight z = 1) (a : X.presheaf.stalk (pointClosureι v z))
    (ha : a ∉ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (specializes_pointClosureι v z)) :
    ((CartierIntersection.localMultiplicity a (specializes_pointClosureι v z)).toNat : ℤ) =
      (pointClosureScheme v).ord
        (algebraMap ((pointClosureScheme v).presheaf.stalk z) (pointClosureScheme v).functionField
          (((pointClosureι v).stalkMap z).hom a)) z
proof:
:= by
  have hne : ((pointClosureι v).stalkMap z).hom a ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [Ne, ← RingHom.mem_ker, ker_stalkMap_pointClosureι]
  rw [localMultiplicity_eq_ord_stalkMap]
  exact CartierIntersection.ord_stalk_toNat_eq_ord hz _ hne

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.coheight_add_one_le_of_specializes
statement:
theorem coheight_add_one_le_of_specializes {x y : X} (h : x ⤳ y) (hne : x ≠ y) :
    coheight x + 1 ≤ coheight y
proof:
:= by
  have hle : y ≤ x := Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr h
  have hlt : y < x := lt_of_le_not_ge hle fun hge ↦
    hne (h.antisymm (Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hge)).eq
  exact Order.coheight_add_one_le hlt

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.coheight_eq_one_of_mem_stalkPrime
statement:
theorem coheight_eq_one_of_mem_stalkPrime [IsIntegral X] {x y : X} (h : x ⤳ y) (hne : x ≠ y)
    (hy : coheight y ≤ 2) {c : X.presheaf.stalk y} (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hcx : c ∈ Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h) : coheight x = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hup := (coheight_add_one_le_of_specializes h hne).trans hy
  have hpos : coheight x ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← Scheme.height_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes h, Ne, Ideal.height_eq_zero_iff_eq_bot]
    intro hbot
    rw [hbot, Ideal.mem_bot] at hcx
    exact hc hcx
  induction hco : coheight x using ENat.recTopCoe with
  | top => rw [hco] at hup; simp at hup
  | coe n =>
    rw [hco] at hup hpos
    have h2 : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ ((2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by exact_mod_cast hup
    have h2' : n + 1 ≤ 2 := by exact_mod_cast h2
    have h0 : n ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hpos
    have : n = 1 := by omega
    rw [this]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.coheight_eq_one_of_generizationWeight_ne_zero
statement:
theorem coheight_eq_one_of_generizationWeight_ne_zero [IsIntegral X] {y : X}
    (hy : coheight y ≤ 2) {c : X.presheaf.stalk y} (hc : c ≠ 0) (b : X.presheaf.stalk y)
    (x : {x : X // x ⤳ y})
    (hw : SchemeLocalOrdSymmetry.generizationWeight c b x ≠ 0) : coheight x.1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold SchemeLocalOrdSymmetry.generizationWeight at hw
  split_ifs at hw with hcond
  · exact coheight_eq_one_of_mem_stalkPrime x.2 hcond.1 hy hc hcond.2
  · exact (hw rfl).elim

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.ringKrullDim_quotient_stalkPrime
statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_quotient_stalkPrime (v : X) (z : pointClosureScheme v) :
    ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk (pointClosureι v z) ⧸
        Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (specializes_pointClosureι v z)) =
      (coheight z : WithBot ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (pointClosureStalkEquiv v z), ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.coheight_pointClosureι
statement:
theorem coheight_pointClosureι (v : X) (z : pointClosureScheme v)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk (pointClosureι v z) ⧸
        Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (specializes_pointClosureι v z)) +
        (((Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (specializes_pointClosureι v z)).height : ℕ∞) :
          WithBot ℕ∞) =
      ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk (pointClosureι v z))) :
    coheight (pointClosureι v z) = coheight v + coheight z
proof:
:= by
  rw [ringKrullDim_quotient_stalkPrime, Scheme.height_stalkPrimeOfSpecializes,
    ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight] at hdim
  have h : ((coheight v + coheight z : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
      (coheight (pointClosureι v z) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    rw [← hdim, add_comm]
    rfl
  exact (WithBot.coe_injective h).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.C1Cap.coheight_pointClosureι_eq_succ
statement:
theorem coheight_pointClosureι_eq_succ {p : ℕ} (v : X) (hv : coheight v = p)
    (z : pointClosureScheme v) (hz : coheight z = 1)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk (pointClosureι v z) ⧸
        Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (specializes_pointClosureι v z)) +
        (((Scheme.stalkPrimeOfSpecializes (specializes_pointClosureι v z)).height : ℕ∞) :
          WithBot ℕ∞) =
      ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk (pointClosureι v z))) :
    coheight (pointClosureι v z) = ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coheight_pointClosureι v z hdim, hv, hz]
  push_cast
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.toPresheafFiber_pointModuleFiberToStalk
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem toPresheafFiber_pointModuleFiberToStalk (p : X) (F : X.Modules)
    (U : TopologicalSpace.Opens ↑X) (hp : p ∈ U) :
    (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).toPresheafFiber U ⟨⟨hp⟩⟩
        F.val.presheaf ≫ pointModuleFiberToStalk p F =
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf U p hp
proof:
:=
  (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).toPresheafFiber_presheafFiberDesc
    _ _ U ⟨⟨hp⟩⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.pointStalkToModuleFiber_toStalk
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem pointStalkToModuleFiber_toStalk (p : X) (F : X.Modules) :
    pointStalkToModuleFiber p F ≫ pointModuleFiberToStalk p F = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply TopCat.Presheaf.stalk_hom_ext
  intro U hpU
  have hgi : TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf U p hpU ≫
        pointStalkToModuleFiber p F =
      (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).toPresheafFiber
        U ⟨⟨hpU⟩⟩ F.val.presheaf := by
    apply colimit.ι_desc
  simpa only [Category.comp_id] using
    (calc
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf U p hpU ≫
            (pointStalkToModuleFiber p F ≫ pointModuleFiberToStalk p F) =
          (TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf U p hpU ≫
            pointStalkToModuleFiber p F) ≫ pointModuleFiberToStalk p F :=
        (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).toPresheafFiber
            U ⟨⟨hpU⟩⟩ F.val.presheaf ≫ pointModuleFiberToStalk p F :=
        congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ pointModuleFiberToStalk p F) hgi
      _ = TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf U p hpU :=
        toPresheafFiber_pointModuleFiberToStalk p F U hpU)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.pointModuleFiberToStalk_toFiber
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem pointModuleFiberToStalk_toFiber (p : X) (F : X.Modules) :
    pointModuleFiberToStalk p F ≫ pointStalkToModuleFiber p F = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).presheafFiber_hom_ext
  intro U x
  let x' : (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).fiber.obj U :=
    ⟨⟨x.down.down⟩⟩
  have hx : x = x' := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hgi' : TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf U p x.down.down ≫
        pointStalkToModuleFiber p F =
      (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).toPresheafFiber
        U x' F.val.presheaf := by
    apply colimit.ι_desc
  have hgi : TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf U p x.down.down ≫
        pointStalkToModuleFiber p F =
      (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).toPresheafFiber
        U x F.val.presheaf := by
    rw [hx]
    exact hgi'
  have hcomp' :=
    toPresheafFiber_pointModuleFiberToStalk p F U x.down.down
  have hcomp :
      (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).toPresheafFiber
            U x F.val.presheaf ≫ pointModuleFiberToStalk p F =
        TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf U p x.down.down := by
    rw [hx]
    exact hcomp'
  simpa only [Category.comp_id] using
    (calc
      (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).toPresheafFiber
            U x F.val.presheaf ≫
          (pointModuleFiberToStalk p F ≫ pointStalkToModuleFiber p F) =
        ((Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).toPresheafFiber
            U x F.val.presheaf ≫ pointModuleFiberToStalk p F) ≫
          pointStalkToModuleFiber p F := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf U p x.down.down ≫
          pointStalkToModuleFiber p F :=
        congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ pointStalkToModuleFiber p F) hcomp
      _ = (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).toPresheafFiber
          U x F.val.presheaf := hgi)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.toCommLocalModuleSkyscraper_eval
statement:
theorem toCommLocalModuleSkyscraper_eval (p : X) (F : X.Modules)
    {U : (TopologicalSpace.Opens ↑X)ᵒᵖ}
    (x : (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).fiber.obj (unop U))
    (s : ↑(F.val.obj U)) :
    (Pi.π (fun _ => AddCommGrpCat.of
      ↑((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X p).obj F)) x).hom
        ((toCommLocalModuleSkyscraper p F).val.app U s) =
      (TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf (unop U) p x.down.down).hom s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let M := (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X p).obj F
  let Φ := Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p
  change (Pi.π (fun _ : Φ.fiber.obj (unop U) => AddCommGrpCat.of ↑M) x).hom
      (((Φ.skyscraperPresheafHomEquiv
        (pointModuleFiberToStalk p F)).app U).hom s) = _
  simp only [Point.skyscraperPresheafHomEquiv_apply_app]
  exact (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.pi_lift_π_apply
    (fun _ : Φ.fiber.obj (unop U) => AddCommGrpCat.of ↑M)
    (fun x => Φ.toPresheafFiber (unop U) x F.val.presheaf ≫
      pointModuleFiberToStalk p F) x s).trans
    (ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
      (toPresheafFiber_pointModuleFiberToStalk p F (unop U) x.down.down) s)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.pointSkyscraper_stalk_isZero_of_not_specializes
statement:
theorem pointSkyscraper_stalk_isZero_of_not_specializes
    (p q : X) (M : Ab.{u}) (h : ¬ Specializes p q) :
    IsZero (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk
      ((Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).skyscraperPresheaf M) q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero]
  apply TopCat.Presheaf.stalk_hom_ext
  intro V hqV
  simp only [Category.comp_id, comp_zero]
  obtain ⟨U, hUopen, hqU, hpU⟩ := not_specializes_iff_exists_open.mp h
  let Uo : TopologicalSpace.Opens X := ⟨U, hUopen⟩
  let W : TopologicalSpace.Opens X := V ⊓ Uo
  have hqW : q ∈ W := ⟨hqV, hqU⟩
  have hpW : p ∉ W := fun hpW => hpU hpW.2
  let P := (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).skyscraperPresheaf M
  have hzero : IsZero (P.obj (op W)) :=
    AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.skyscraperPresheaf_obj_isZero p M hpW
  have hres := TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res P
    (homOfLE (show W ≤ V from inf_le_left)) q hqW
  calc
    TopCat.Presheaf.germ P V q hqV =
        P.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op ≫ TopCat.Presheaf.germ P W q hqW := hres.symm
    _ = 0 ≫ TopCat.Presheaf.germ P W q hqW := by
      rw [hzero.eq_of_tgt (P.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op) 0]
    _ = 0 := zero_comp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.pointSkyscraperTopSection_π
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem pointSkyscraperTopSection_π (p : X) (M : Ab.{u})
    (x : (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).fiber.obj
      (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.Opens X)) :
    pointSkyscraperTopSection p M ≫ Pi.π _ x = 𝟙 M
proof:
:=
  Pi.lift_π _ x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.pointSkyscraper_projection_topSection_res
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem pointSkyscraper_projection_topSection_res (p : X) (M : Ab.{u})
    (U : TopologicalSpace.Opens X) (hpU : p ∈ U) :
    Pi.π (fun _ : (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).fiber.obj U => M)
        ⟨⟨hpU⟩⟩ ≫
      pointSkyscraperTopSection p M ≫
      ((Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).skyscraperPresheaf M).map
        (homOfLE le_top).op = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  let x : (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).fiber.obj U := ⟨⟨hpU⟩⟩
  change Pi.π (fun _ : (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).fiber.obj U => M) x ≫
      pointSkyscraperTopSection p M ≫
      ((Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).skyscraperPresheaf M).map
        (homOfLE le_top).op = 𝟙 _
  apply Pi.hom_ext
    (f := fun _ : (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).fiber.obj U => M)
  intro z
  have hzx : z = x := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  subst z
  have hmap := Point.skyscraperPresheaf_map_π
    (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p) M
    (homOfLE (show U ≤ (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.Opens X) from le_top)).op x
  let xtop := (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).fiber.map
    (homOfLE (show U ≤ (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.Opens X) from le_top)) x
  have hcomp := congrArg
    (fun f => (Pi.π (fun _ : (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).fiber.obj U => M) x ≫
      pointSkyscraperTopSection p M) ≫ f) hmap
  simp only [Category.assoc, pointSkyscraperTopSection_π,
    Category.comp_id] at hcomp
  change (Pi.π
      (fun _ : (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).fiber.obj U => M) x ≫
        pointSkyscraperTopSection p M ≫
          ((Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).skyscraperPresheaf M).map
            (homOfLE le_top).op ≫ Pi.π _ x) = Pi.π _ x
  exact hcomp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.toCommLocalModuleSkyscraperStalk_valueIso_hom
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem toCommLocalModuleSkyscraperStalk_valueIso_hom
    (p : X) (F : X.Modules) :
    toCommLocalModuleSkyscraperStalk p F ≫
      (commLocalModuleSkyscraperStalkValueIso p F).hom = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  let M := (moduleStalkFunctorLinear X p).obj F
  let M' := (ModuleCat.restrictScalars
      (pointPresheafFiberToStalk p X.ringCatSheaf).hom).obj
        ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars
          (AlgebraicCycle.SheafViaSubmodule.stalkCompare p)).obj M)
  let G := (commLocalModuleSkyscraperFunctor p).obj M
  let g := ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).map
    (toCommLocalModuleSkyscraper p F)).hom
  apply TopCat.Presheaf.stalk_hom_ext
  intro U hpU
  let x : (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).fiber.obj U := ⟨⟨hpU⟩⟩
  have hmap := TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ U p hpU g
  have hmap' : TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf U p hpU ≫
      toCommLocalModuleSkyscraperStalk p F =
        g.app (op U) ≫ TopCat.Presheaf.germ G.val.presheaf U p hpU := by
    exact hmap
  have htargetM : TopCat.Presheaf.germ G.val.presheaf U p hpU ≫
      (commLocalModuleSkyscraperStalkValueIso p F).hom =
        Pi.π (fun _ : (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).fiber.obj U =>
          AddCommGrpCat.of ↑M) x := by
    change TopCat.Presheaf.germ
        ((Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).skyscraperPresheaf
          (AddCommGrpCat.of ↑M)) U p hpU ≫
      (pointSkyscraperStalkValueIso p (AddCommGrpCat.of ↑M)).hom = _
    exact colimit.isoColimitCocone_ι_hom _ _
  have htarget : TopCat.Presheaf.germ G.val.presheaf U p hpU ≫
      (commLocalModuleSkyscraperStalkValueIso p F).hom =
        Pi.π (fun _ : (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).fiber.obj U =>
          AddCommGrpCat.of ↑M') x :=
    htargetM
  have heval := toCommLocalModuleSkyscraper_eval p F x
  have heval' (s : ↑(F.val.obj (op U))) :
      (Pi.π (fun _ : (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).fiber.obj U =>
        AddCommGrpCat.of ↑M') x).hom (g.app (op U) s) =
          (TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf U p hpU).hom s :=
    heval s
  simpa only [Category.comp_id] using
    (calc
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf U p hpU ≫
          (toCommLocalModuleSkyscraperStalk p F ≫
            (commLocalModuleSkyscraperStalkValueIso p F).hom) =
        (TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf U p hpU ≫
          toCommLocalModuleSkyscraperStalk p F) ≫
            (commLocalModuleSkyscraperStalkValueIso p F).hom :=
          (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = (g.app (op U) ≫ TopCat.Presheaf.germ G.val.presheaf U p hpU) ≫
            (commLocalModuleSkyscraperStalkValueIso p F).hom := by rw [hmap']
      _ = g.app (op U) ≫
          (TopCat.Presheaf.germ G.val.presheaf U p hpU ≫
            (commLocalModuleSkyscraperStalkValueIso p F).hom) :=
          Category.assoc _ _ _
      _ = g.app (op U) ≫ Pi.π
          (fun _ : (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p).fiber.obj U =>
            AddCommGrpCat.of ↑M') x :=
        congrArg (fun q => g.app (op U) ≫ q) htarget
      _ = TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf U p hpU := by
        ext s
        exact heval' s)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.toCommLocalModuleSkyscraperStalk_eq_iso_inv
statement:
theorem toCommLocalModuleSkyscraperStalk_eq_iso_inv (p : X) (F : X.Modules) :
    toCommLocalModuleSkyscraperStalk p F =
      (commLocalModuleSkyscraperStalkValueIso p F).inv
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (commLocalModuleSkyscraperStalkValueIso p F).hom).mp
  rw [toCommLocalModuleSkyscraperStalk_valueIso_hom,
    (commLocalModuleSkyscraperStalkValueIso p F).inv_hom_id]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.toCommLocalModuleSkyscraperStalkIso_hom
statement:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.isZero_pi_of_finite
statement:
theorem isZero_pi_of_finite {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι] (A : ι → Ab.{u})

proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.ordinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct_stalk_isZero
statement:
theorem ordinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct_stalk_isZero
    (F : X.Modules) (S : Finset X) (q : X)
    (hS : ∀ p : S, ¬ Specializes p.1 q) :
    IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.stalkFunctor X q).obj
      (ordinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct F S))
proof:
:= by
  let K : S → X.Modules := fun p =>
    (commLocalModuleSkyscraperFunctor p.1).obj
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X p.1).obj F)
  let T := Scheme.Modules.stalkFunctor X q
  have hK : ∀ p : S, IsZero (T.obj (K p)) := by
    intro p
    change IsZero (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk
      ((Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology p.1).skyscraperPresheaf
        (AddCommGrpCat.of ↑((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X p.1).obj F))) q)
    exact pointSkyscraper_stalk_isZero_of_not_specializes p.1 q _ (hS p)
  have hPi : IsZero (∏ᶜ fun p : S => T.obj (K p)) :=
    isZero_pi_of_finite (fun p : S => T.obj (K p)) hK
  letI : PreservesLimit (Discrete.functor K) T := by
    dsimp [T]
    infer_instance
  exact IsZero.of_iso hPi (PreservesProduct.iso T K)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct_stalk_isIso_of_mem
statement:
theorem toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct_stalk_isIso_of_mem
    [IsIntegral X] [Order.KrullDimLE 1 X]
    (F : X.Modules) (S : Finset X)
    (hSη : ∀ p : S, p.1 ≠ genericPoint X) (q : X) (hq : q ∈ S) :
    IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.stalkFunctor X q).map
      (toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct F S))
proof:
:= by
  let K : S → X.Modules := fun p =>
    (commLocalModuleSkyscraperFunctor p.1).obj
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X p.1).obj F)
  let T := Scheme.Modules.stalkFunctor X q
  let g : ∀ p : S, T.obj F ⟶ T.obj (K p) := fun p =>
    T.map (toCommLocalModuleSkyscraper p.1 F)
  let p : S := ⟨q, hq⟩
  letI : IsIso (g p) := by
    change IsIso (toCommLocalModuleSkyscraperStalk q F)
    simpa only [toCommLocalModuleSkyscraperStalkIso_hom] using
      (toCommLocalModuleSkyscraperStalkIso q F).isIso_hom
  have hK : ∀ i : S, i ≠ p → IsZero (T.obj (K i)) := by
    intro i hip
    have hiq : i.1 ≠ q := by
      intro hiq
      exact hip (Subtype.ext hiq)
    change IsZero (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk
      ((Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology i.1).skyscraperPresheaf
        (AddCommGrpCat.of ↑((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X i.1).obj F))) q)
    exact pointSkyscraper_stalk_isZero_of_not_specializes i.1 q _
      (not_specializes_of_ne_of_ne_genericPoint (hSη i) hiq)
  let e := liftIsoOfUniqueNonzero (T.obj F) (fun i : S => T.obj (K i)) g p hK
  letI : IsIso (Pi.lift g) := e.isIso_hom
  letI : PreservesLimit (Discrete.functor K) T := by
    dsimp [T]
    infer_instance
  letI : IsIso (piComparison T K) :=
    (PreservesProduct.iso T K).isIso_hom
  have hcomp : T.map (toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct F S) ≫
      piComparison T K = Pi.lift g := by
    simpa only [K, g, ordinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct,
      toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct] using
      map_lift_piComparison T K F
        (fun i : S => toCommLocalModuleSkyscraper i.1 F)
  haveI : IsIso (T.map (toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct F S) ≫
      piComparison T K) := by
    rw [hcomp]
    infer_instance
  let hπ : IsIso (piComparison T K) :=
    (PreservesProduct.iso T K).isIso_hom
  let hc : IsIso (T.map (toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct F S) ≫
      piComparison T K) := inferInstance
  exact @IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right _ _ _ _ _
    (T.map (toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct F S)) (piComparison T K) hπ hc

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct_stalk_isIso_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct_stalk_isIso_of_not_mem
    [IsIntegral X] [Order.KrullDimLE 1 X]
    (F : X.Modules) (S : Finset X)
    (hSη : ∀ p : S, p.1 ≠ genericPoint X)
    (hsupp : moduleSheafSupport F ⊆ (S : Set X))
    (q : X) (hq : q ∉ S) :
    IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.stalkFunctor X q).map
      (toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct F S))
proof:
:= by
  let T := Scheme.Modules.stalkFunctor X q
  have hqSupp : q ∉ moduleSheafSupport F := by
    intro hqSupp
    exact hq (hsupp hqSupp)
  have hsource : IsZero (T.obj F) := by
    change IsZero (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf q)
    rw [AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton]
    exact not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton.mp hqSupp
  have hspecializes : ∀ p : S, ¬ Specializes p.1 q := by
    intro p
    apply not_specializes_of_ne_of_ne_genericPoint (hSη p)
    intro hpq
    exact hq (hpq ▸ p.2)
  have htarget : IsZero (T.obj (ordinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct F S)) :=
    ordinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct_stalk_isZero F S q hspecializes
  exact hsource.isIso htarget _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct_stalk_isIso
statement:
theorem toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct_stalk_isIso
    [IsIntegral X] [Order.KrullDimLE 1 X]
    (F : X.Modules) (S : Finset X)
    (hSη : ∀ p : S, p.1 ≠ genericPoint X)
    (hsupp : moduleSheafSupport F ⊆ (S : Set X)) (q : X) :
    IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.stalkFunctor X q).map
      (toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct F S))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hq : q ∈ S
  · exact toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct_stalk_isIso_of_mem F S hSη q hq
  · exact toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct_stalk_isIso_of_not_mem F S hSη hsupp q hq

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct_isIso
statement:
theorem toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct_isIso
    [IsIntegral X] [Order.KrullDimLE 1 X]
    (F : X.Modules) (S : Finset X)
    (hSη : ∀ p : S, p.1 ≠ genericPoint X)
    (hsupp : moduleSheafSupport F ⊆ (S : Set X)) :
    IsIso (toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct F S)
proof:
:= by
  let f := toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct F S
  let T := Scheme.Modules.toAddCommGrpSheaf X
  letI (q : X) : IsIso
      ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor Ab.{u} q).map ((T.map f).hom)) := by
    change IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.stalkFunctor X q).map
      (toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct F S))
    exact toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct_stalk_isIso F S hSη hsupp q
  haveI : IsIso (T.map f) :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.isIso_of_stalkFunctor_map_iso (T.map f)
  exact isIso_of_reflects_iso f T

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.shortExact_biprod_left
statement:
theorem shortExact_biprod_left {A B C : X.Modules}
    (P : X.Modules) (i : A ⟶ B) (p : B ⟶ C) (w : i ≫ p = 0)
    (hS : (ShortComplex.mk i p w).ShortExact) :
    (ShortComplex.mk (biprod.map (𝟙 P) i) (biprod.snd ≫ p) (by simp [w])).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  let i' : P ⊞ A ⟶ P ⊞ B := biprod.map (𝟙 P) i
  let p' : P ⊞ B ⟶ C := biprod.snd ≫ p
  have wi' : i' ≫ p' = 0 := by
    dsimp [i', p']
    simp [w]
  haveI : Mono i := hS.mono_f
  haveI : Epi p := hS.epi_g
  haveI : Mono i' := by
    dsimp [i']
    infer_instance
  haveI : Epi p' := by
    dsimp [p']
    infer_instance
  let lift : ∀ {W : X.Modules} (g : W ⟶ P ⊞ B) (_ : g ≫ p' = 0), W ⟶ P ⊞ A :=
    fun {_} g hg => biprod.lift (g ≫ biprod.fst)
      (hS.exact.lift (g ≫ biprod.snd) (by
        dsimp [p'] at hg
        simpa only [Category.assoc] using hg))
  have lift_fac : ∀ {W : X.Modules} (g : W ⟶ P ⊞ B) (hg : g ≫ p' = 0),
      lift g hg ≫ i' = g := by
    intro W g hg
    apply biprod.hom_ext
    · dsimp [lift, i']
      simp
    · dsimp [lift, i']
      rw [Category.assoc, biprod.map_snd]
      rw [← Category.assoc, biprod.lift_snd]
      exact hS.exact.lift_f (g ≫ biprod.snd) _
  have hker : IsLimit (KernelFork.ofι i' wi') :=
    KernelFork.IsLimit.ofι' i' wi' (fun g hg => ⟨lift g hg, lift_fac g hg⟩)
  have hexact : (ShortComplex.mk i' p' wi').Exact :=
    ShortComplex.exact_of_f_is_kernel _ hker
  have hshort : (ShortComplex.mk i' p' wi').ShortExact :=
    ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk' hexact inferInstance inferInstance
  simpa only [i', p'] using hshort

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.exists_pointSkyscraperDevissage_product
statement:
theorem exists_pointSkyscraperDevissage_product
    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (A : ι → X.Modules) (ps : ι → List X)
    (d : ∀ i, PointSkyscraperDevissage (A i) (ps i)) :
    ∃ qs : List X, Nonempty (PointSkyscraperDevissage (∏ᶜ A) qs)
proof:
:= by
  let P : Type u → Prop := fun α => ∀ (B : α → X.Modules) (rs : α → List X),
    (∀ i, PointSkyscraperDevissage (B i) (rs i)) →
      ∃ qs : List X, Nonempty (PointSkyscraperDevissage (∏ᶜ B) qs)
  apply Finite.induction_empty_option (P := P)
  · intro α β e hα B rs dB
    obtain ⟨qs, ⟨dqs⟩⟩ := hα (B ∘ e) (rs ∘ e) (fun i => dB (e i))
    exact ⟨qs, ⟨PointSkyscraperDevissage.iso
      (Pi.whiskerEquiv e (fun _ => Iso.refl _)).symm dqs⟩⟩
  · intro B rs dB
    have hzero : IsZero (∏ᶜ B) := by
      rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero]
      apply Pi.hom_ext
      intro i
      exact PEmpty.elim i
    exact ⟨[], ⟨PointSkyscraperDevissage.iso hzero.isoZero
      PointSkyscraperDevissage.zero⟩⟩
  · intro α _ hα B rs dB
    obtain ⟨qs, ⟨dqs⟩⟩ := hα (fun i => B (some i)) (fun i => rs (some i))
      (fun i => dB (some i))
    let db := PointSkyscraperDevissage.biprod (dB none) dqs
    exact ⟨qs ++ rs none, ⟨PointSkyscraperDevissage.iso
      (productOptionIso B) db⟩⟩
  · exact d

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.exists_pointSkyscraperDevissage_of_finiteSupport
statement:
theorem exists_pointSkyscraperDevissage_of_finiteSupport
    [IsIntegral X] [Order.KrullDimLE 1 X]
    (F : X.Modules) (S : Finset X)
    (hSη : ∀ p : S, p.1 ≠ genericPoint X)
    (hsupp : moduleSheafSupport F ⊆ (S : Set X))
    (hfinite : ∀ p : S, IsFiniteLength (X.presheaf.stalk p.1)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X p.1).obj F)) :
    ∃ ps : List X, Nonempty (PointSkyscraperDevissage F ps)
proof:
:= by
  let A : S → X.Modules := fun p =>
    (commLocalModuleSkyscraperFunctor p.1).obj
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X p.1).obj F)
  let ps : S → List X := fun p =>
    finiteLengthPointSkyscraperPoints p.1 (hfinite p)
  let d : ∀ p : S, PointSkyscraperDevissage (A p) (ps p) := fun p =>
    finiteLengthPointSkyscraperDevissage p.1 (hfinite p)
  obtain ⟨qs, ⟨dqs⟩⟩ := exists_pointSkyscraperDevissage_product A ps d
  letI : IsIso (toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct F S) :=
    toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct_isIso F S hSη hsupp
  exact ⟨qs, ⟨PointSkyscraperDevissage.iso
    (asIso (toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct F S)) dqs⟩⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.exists_pointSkyscraperDevissage_product_with_property
statement:
theorem exists_pointSkyscraperDevissage_product_with_property
    {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (A : ι → X.Modules) (ps : ι → List X)
    (d : ∀ i, PointSkyscraperDevissage (A i) (ps i))
    (P : X → Prop) (hP : ∀ i p, p ∈ ps i → P p) :
    ∃ qs : List X, (∀ p, p ∈ qs → P p) ∧
      Nonempty (PointSkyscraperDevissage (∏ᶜ A) qs)
proof:
:= by
  let Q : Type u → Prop := fun α => ∀ (B : α → X.Modules) (rs : α → List X),
    (∀ i, PointSkyscraperDevissage (B i) (rs i)) →
    (∀ i p, p ∈ rs i → P p) →
      ∃ qs : List X, (∀ p, p ∈ qs → P p) ∧
        Nonempty (PointSkyscraperDevissage (∏ᶜ B) qs)
  apply Finite.induction_empty_option (P := Q)
  · intro α β e hα B rs dB hB
    obtain ⟨qs, hqs, ⟨dqs⟩⟩ := hα (B ∘ e) (rs ∘ e)
      (fun i => dB (e i)) (fun i p hp => hB (e i) p hp)
    exact ⟨qs, hqs, ⟨PointSkyscraperDevissage.iso
      (Pi.whiskerEquiv e (fun _ => Iso.refl _)).symm dqs⟩⟩
  · intro B rs dB hB
    have hzero : IsZero (∏ᶜ B) := by
      rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero]
      apply Pi.hom_ext
      intro i
      exact PEmpty.elim i
    exact ⟨[], by simp, ⟨PointSkyscraperDevissage.iso hzero.isoZero
      PointSkyscraperDevissage.zero⟩⟩
  · intro α _ hα B rs dB hB
    obtain ⟨qs, hqs, ⟨dqs⟩⟩ := hα (fun i => B (some i))
      (fun i => rs (some i)) (fun i => dB (some i))
      (fun i p hp => hB (some i) p hp)
    let db := PointSkyscraperDevissage.biprod (dB none) dqs
    refine ⟨qs ++ rs none, ?_, ⟨PointSkyscraperDevissage.iso
      (productOptionIso B) db⟩⟩
    intro p hp
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hp with hp | hp
    · exact hqs p hp
    · exact hB none p hp
  · exact d
  · exact hP

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.exists_pointSkyscraperDevissage_of_finiteSupport_with_points
statement:
theorem exists_pointSkyscraperDevissage_of_finiteSupport_with_points
    [IsIntegral X] [Order.KrullDimLE 1 X]
    (F : X.Modules) (S : Finset X)
    (hSη : ∀ p : S, p.1 ≠ genericPoint X)
    (hsupp : moduleSheafSupport F ⊆ (S : Set X))
    (hfinite : ∀ p : S, IsFiniteLength (X.presheaf.stalk p.1)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X p.1).obj F)) :
    ∃ ps : List X, (∀ p, p ∈ ps → p ∈ S) ∧
      Nonempty (PointSkyscraperDevissage F ps)
proof:
:= by
  let A : S → X.Modules := fun p =>
    (commLocalModuleSkyscraperFunctor p.1).obj
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X p.1).obj F)
  let points : S → List X := fun p =>
    finiteLengthPointSkyscraperPoints p.1 (hfinite p)
  let d : ∀ p : S, PointSkyscraperDevissage (A p) (points p) := fun p =>
    finiteLengthPointSkyscraperDevissage p.1 (hfinite p)
  have hpoints : ∀ i p, p ∈ points i → p ∈ S := by
    intro i p hp
    have hpEq : p = i.1 :=
      mem_finiteLengthPointSkyscraperPoints_eq i.1 (hfinite i) hp
    simpa only [hpEq] using i.2
  obtain ⟨qs, hqs, ⟨dqs⟩⟩ :=
    exists_pointSkyscraperDevissage_product_with_property A points d
      (fun p => p ∈ S) hpoints
  letI : IsIso (toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct F S) :=
    toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct_isIso F S hSη hsupp
  exact ⟨qs, hqs, ⟨PointSkyscraperDevissage.iso
    (asIso (toOrdinaryStalkSkyscraperProduct F S)) dqs⟩⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.exists_pointSkyscraperDevissage_of_genericStalk_isZero_of_stalk_isTorsion
statement:
theorem exists_pointSkyscraperDevissage_of_genericStalk_isZero_of_stalk_isTorsion
    [IsIntegral X] [IsNoetherian X] [Order.KrullDimLE 1 X]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFiniteType]
    (hη : IsZero (F.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X)))
    (htorsion : ∀ x, x ≠ genericPoint X →
      Module.IsTorsion (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X x).obj F)) :
    ∃ ps : List X, (∀ p, p ∈ ps → p ≠ genericPoint X) ∧
      Nonempty (PointSkyscraperDevissage F ps)
proof:
:= by
  let hsupport :=
    moduleSheafSupport_finite_of_genericStalk_isZero_of_isFiniteType F hη
  let S : Finset X := hsupport.toFinset
  have hsupp : moduleSheafSupport F ⊆ (S : Set X) := by
    intro x hx
    exact hsupport.mem_toFinset.mpr hx
  have hSη : ∀ p : S, p.1 ≠ genericPoint X := by
    intro p hp
    have hpSupp : p.1 ∈ moduleSheafSupport F :=
      hsupport.mem_toFinset.mp p.2
    have hnot : genericPoint X ∉ moduleSheafSupport F := by
      change ¬ Nontrivial (F.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X))
      exact not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton.mpr
        (AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp hη)
    exact hnot (hp ▸ hpSupp)
  have hfinite : ∀ p : S, IsFiniteLength (X.presheaf.stalk p.1)
      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X p.1).obj F) := fun p =>
    moduleStalk_isFiniteLength_of_isFiniteType_of_isTorsion X p.1
      (hSη p) F (htorsion p.1 (hSη p))
  obtain ⟨ps, hps, dps⟩ :=
    exists_pointSkyscraperDevissage_of_finiteSupport_with_points F S hSη hsupp hfinite
  exact ⟨ps, fun p hp => hSη ⟨p, hps p hp⟩, dps⟩

name: SchemeKTheory.exteriorPowerSheafOverMapIso_freeOverIso_hom_unit_topWedge
statement:
lemma exteriorPowerSheafOverMapIso_freeOverIso_hom_unit_topWedge
    [IsIntegral X] (U : X.Opens) (I : Type u) [Fintype I] :
    let T : (Over U)ᵒᵖ
proof:
:= op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))
    let P₀ := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower
      (underlyingCommPresheafOverForExteriorPower X U
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) I))
      (Fintype.card I)
    let P₁ := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower
      (underlyingCommPresheafOverForExteriorPower X U
        ((SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I).over U))
      (Fintype.card I)
    let adj := PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
      (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)
    let e := exteriorPowerSheafOverMapIso X U
      (freeOverIso X U I) (Fintype.card I)
    let w₀ : P₀.obj T := by
      classical
      letI : LinearOrder I := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
      exact ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (fun j ↦
        (SheafOfModules.freeSection
          (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerIndexEquiv I j)).eval T)
    let w₁ : P₁.obj T := by
      classical
      letI : LinearOrder I := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
      exact ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (fun j ↦
        (Scheme.Modules.overSectionOfElement X
          (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I) U
          ((SheafOfModules.freeSection
            (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerIndexEquiv I j)).eval
              (op U))).eval T)
    (e.hom.val.app T).hom
        (((adj.unit.app P₀).app T).hom w₀) =
      ((adj.unit.app P₁).app T).hom w₁ := by
  classical
  letI : LinearOrder I := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
  dsimp only
  let T : (Over U)ᵒᵖ := op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))
  let P₀ := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower
    (underlyingCommPresheafOverForExteriorPower X U
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) I))
    (Fintype.card I)
  let P₁ := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower
    (underlyingCommPresheafOverForExteriorPower X U
      ((SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I).over U))
    (Fintype.card I)
  let adj := PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
    (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)
  let f := underlyingCommPresheafOverHomForExteriorPower X U
    (freeOverIso X U I).hom
  let φ := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPowerMap f (Fintype.card I)
  let w₀ : P₀.obj T := ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (fun j ↦
    (SheafOfModules.freeSection
      (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerIndexEquiv I j)).eval T)
  let w₁ : P₁.obj T := ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (fun j ↦
    (Scheme.Modules.overSectionOfElement X
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I) U
      ((SheafOfModules.freeSection
        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerIndexEquiv I j)).eval
          (op U))).eval T)
  have hfree (j : Fin (Fintype.card I)) :
      f.app T
          ((SheafOfModules.freeSection
            (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerIndexEquiv I j)).eval T) =
        (Scheme.Modules.overSectionOfElement X
          (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I) U
          ((SheafOfModules.freeSection
            (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerIndexEquiv I j)).eval
              (op U))).eval T := by
    exact congrArg (fun s ↦ s.eval T)
      (Scheme.Modules.sectionsMap_freeOverIso_hom_freeSection X U I
        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerIndexEquiv I j))
  have hmap : φ.app T w₀ = w₁ := by
    change ModuleCat.exteriorPower.map (f.app T) (Fintype.card I)
        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk _) = ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk _
    rw [ModuleCat.exteriorPower.map_mk]
    congr 1
    funext j
    exact hfree j
  have hη := adj.unit.naturality φ
  simp only [Functor.id_map] at hη
  have hηT := congrArg (fun k ↦ k.app T) hη
  have hw := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hηT w₀
  change
    ((adj.unit.app P₁).app T).hom (φ.app T w₀) =
      (exteriorPowerSheafOverMapIso X U
        (freeOverIso X U I) (Fintype.card I)).hom.val.app T
          (((adj.unit.app P₀).app T).hom w₀) at hw
  rw [hmap] at hw
  exact hw.symm

private lemma exteriorPowerRestrictPresheafIso_hom_topWedge
    (U : X.Opens) (I : Type u) [Fintype I] [LinearOrder I] :

proof:

        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerIndexEquiv I j)).eval (op U))

name: SchemeKTheory.exteriorPowerSheafOverFreeIso_hom_unit_topWedge
statement:
lemma exteriorPowerSheafOverFreeIso_hom_unit_topWedge
    [IsIntegral X] (U : X.Opens) (I : Type u) [Fintype I] :
    let T : (Over U)ᵒᵖ
proof:
:= op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))
    let F : X.Modules :=
      SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I
    let P₀ := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower
      (underlyingCommPresheafOverForExteriorPower X U
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) I))
      (Fintype.card I)
    let P₂ := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower F.val (Fintype.card I)
    let adj := PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
      (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)
    let e₁ := exteriorPowerSheafOverMapIso X U
      (freeOverIso X U I) (Fintype.card I)
    let e₂ := exteriorPowerSheafOverIso X U F (Fintype.card I)
    let w₀ : P₀.obj T := by
      classical
      letI : LinearOrder I := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
      exact ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (fun j ↦
        (SheafOfModules.freeSection
          (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerIndexEquiv I j)).eval T)
    let w₂ : P₂.obj (op U) := by
      classical
      letI : LinearOrder I := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
      exact ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (fun j ↦
        (SheafOfModules.freeSection
          (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerIndexEquiv I j)).eval (op U))
    (((e₁.hom ≫ e₂.hom).val.app T).hom
        (((adj.unit.app P₀).app T).hom w₀)) =
      (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app P₂).app (op U)).hom w₂ := by
  classical
  letI : LinearOrder I := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
  dsimp only
  let T : (Over U)ᵒᵖ := op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))
  let F : X.Modules :=
    SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I
  let P₀ := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower
    (underlyingCommPresheafOverForExteriorPower X U
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf.over U) I))
    (Fintype.card I)
  let P₁ := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower
    (underlyingCommPresheafOverForExteriorPower X U (F.over U))
    (Fintype.card I)
  let P₂ := PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower F.val (Fintype.card I)
  let adj := PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
    (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)
  let e₁ := exteriorPowerSheafOverMapIso X U
    (freeOverIso X U I) (Fintype.card I)
  let e₂ := exteriorPowerSheafOverIso X U F (Fintype.card I)
  let ρ := (exteriorPowerRestrictPresheafIso X U F.val
    (Fintype.card I)).hom
  let η := Scheme.Modules.moduleSheafificationUnitOver X U P₂
  let w₀ : P₀.obj T := ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (fun j ↦
    (SheafOfModules.freeSection
      (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerIndexEquiv I j)).eval T)
  let w₁ : P₁.obj T := ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (fun j ↦
    (Scheme.Modules.overSectionOfElement X F U
      ((SheafOfModules.freeSection
        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerIndexEquiv I j)).eval
          (op U))).eval T)
  let w₂ : P₂.obj (op U) := ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (fun j ↦
    (SheafOfModules.freeSection
      (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerIndexEquiv I j)).eval (op U))
  have h₁ :=
    exteriorPowerSheafOverMapIso_freeOverIso_hom_unit_topWedge X U I
  dsimp only at h₁
  have hρ : (ρ.app T).hom w₁ = w₂ :=
    exteriorPowerRestrictPresheafIso_hom_topWedge X U I
  have hAdj :=
    Scheme.Modules.exteriorPowerSheafOverIso_hom_adjunct X U F
      (Fintype.card I)
  dsimp only at hAdj
  have h₂ := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (congrArg (fun k ↦ k.app T) hAdj) w₁
  change
    (e₂.hom.val.app T).hom
        (((adj.unit.app P₁).app T).hom w₁) =
      (η.app T).hom ((ρ.app T).hom w₁) at h₂
  rw [hρ] at h₂
  change
    (e₂.hom.val.app T).hom
        (((adj.unit.app P₁).app T).hom w₁) =
      (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app P₂).app (op U)).hom w₂ at h₂
  change
    (e₂.hom.val.app T).hom
        ((e₁.hom.val.app T).hom
          (((adj.unit.app P₀).app T).hom w₀)) =
      (((moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app P₂).app (op U)).hom w₂
  calc
    _ = (e₂.hom.val.app T).hom
        (((adj.unit.app P₁).app T).hom w₁) :=
      congrArg (fun z ↦ (e₂.hom.val.app T).hom z) h₁
    _ = _ := h₂
