name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.functionFieldLinearEquiv_eq_of_apply_one_eq
statement:
private lemma functionFieldLinearEquiv_eq_of_apply_one_eq
    {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module X.functionField M]
    (e f : X.functionField ≃ₗ[X.functionField] M)
    (h : e 1 = f 1) : e = f
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearEquiv.ext
  intro r
  calc
    e r = r • e 1 := by simpa using e.map_smul r 1
    _ = r • f 1 := congrArg (fun w ↦ r • w) h
    _ = f r := by simpa using (f.map_smul r 1).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.determinantStalkBasisRationalTrivialization_one_eq_chartGerm
statement:
theorem determinantStalkBasisRationalTrivialization_one_eq_chartGerm
    (E : X.Modules) (hE : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X E)
    (q : E.LocalGeneratorsData)
    [q.IsLocallyFreeData] [q.IsFiniteType]
    (i : q.I) {x : X} (hxi : x ∈ q.X i) :
    let U
proof:
:= q.X i
    let hη : genericPoint X ∈ U :=
      ((genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial).mem_open U.isOpen hxi
    let T : (Over U)ᵒᵖ := op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))
    let a : Fin (genericRank X E) → E.val.obj (op U) := fun j ↦
      ((q.generators i).s
        (determinantLocalGeneratorsStalkIndexEquiv X E q i hη j)).eval T
    let z : (SchemeKTheory.determinant X E).val.obj (op U) :=
      (((SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app
        (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower E.val (genericRank X E))).app (op U)).hom
          (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk a)
    (determinantStalkBasisRationalTrivialization X E hE x
      (determinantLocalGeneratorsStalkBasis X E q i hxi)).equiv 1 =
        (SchemeKTheory.determinant X E).presheaf.germ
          U (genericPoint X) hη z := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let U := q.X i
  let I := (q.generators i).I
  letI : (q.generators i).IsFiniteType :=
    SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType i
  letI : Finite I := by
    dsimp only [I]
    infer_instance
  letI : Fintype I := Fintype.ofFinite I
  letI : LinearOrder I := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
  let hη : genericPoint X ∈ U :=
    ((genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial).mem_open U.isOpen hxi
  let T : (Over U)ᵒᵖ := op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))
  let c := determinantLocalGeneratorsStalkBasis X E q i hxi
  letI : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X E := hE
  letI : Module.Finite X.functionField ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj E) :=
    genericStalk_finite_of_isFiniteLocallyFree X E hE
  let hinj : Function.Injective (stalkToGeneric X E x) :=
    IsGenericallyTorsionFree.stalkToGeneric_injective x
  let b := stalkBasisToGenericBasis X E x (genericRank X E) c hinj rfl
  let a : Fin (genericRank X E) → E.val.obj (op U) := fun j ↦
    ((q.generators i).s
      (determinantLocalGeneratorsStalkIndexEquiv X E q i hη j)).eval T
  let z : (SchemeKTheory.determinant X E).val.obj (op U) :=
    (((SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app
      (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower E.val (genericRank X E))).app (op U)).hom
        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk a)
  have hb (j : Fin (genericRank X E)) :
      b j = E.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) hη (a j) := by
    calc
      b j = (stalkToGeneric X E x).hom (c j) := by
        exact stalkBasisToGenericBasis_apply X E x (genericRank X E)
          c hinj rfl j
      _ = determinantLocalGeneratorsStalkBasis X E q i hη j := by
        exact determinantLocalGeneratorsStalkBasis_stalkToGeneric
          X E q i hxi j
      _ = E.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) hη (a j) := by
        exact determinantLocalGeneratorsStalkBasis_generic_eq_germ
          X E q i hη j
  have hz :
      (((SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app
        (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower E.val (genericRank X E))).app (op U)).hom
          (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk a) = z := by
    rfl
  change SchemeKTheory.determinantGenericStalkLinearEquiv X E hE
      ((ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso b).inv 1) = _
  have h1 : (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso b).inv 1 =
      ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk b := by
    rw [ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerFinBasisIso_inv_one]
  have hmk :
      ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk b =
        ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (fun j ↦
          E.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) hη (a j)) := by
    congr 1
    funext j
    exact hb j
  calc
    _ = SchemeKTheory.determinantGenericStalkLinearEquiv X E hE
        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk b) :=
      congrArg (SchemeKTheory.determinantGenericStalkLinearEquiv X E hE) h1
    _ = SchemeKTheory.determinantGenericStalkLinearEquiv X E hE
        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (fun j ↦
          E.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) hη (a j))) :=
      congrArg (SchemeKTheory.determinantGenericStalkLinearEquiv X E hE) hmk
    _ = (SchemeKTheory.determinant X E).presheaf.germ
        U (genericPoint X) hη
        ((((SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app
          (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower E.val
            (genericRank X E))).app (op U)).hom
              (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk a)) :=
      SchemeKTheory.determinantGenericStalkLinearEquiv_mk_germs
        X E hE U hη a
    _ = (SchemeKTheory.determinant X E).presheaf.germ
        U (genericPoint X) hη z :=
      congrArg
        (fun s ↦ (SchemeKTheory.determinant X E).presheaf.germ
          U (genericPoint X) hη s) hz

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.determinantLocalFrameData_genericTrivialization_one_eq_chartGerm
statement:
theorem determinantLocalFrameData_genericTrivialization_one_eq_chartGerm
    (E : X.Modules) (q : E.LocalGeneratorsData)
    [q.IsLocallyFreeData] [q.IsFiniteType]
    (i : q.I) {x : X} (hxi : x ∈ q.X i) :
    let U
proof:
:= q.X i
    let hη : genericPoint X ∈ U :=
      ((genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial).mem_open U.isOpen hxi
    let T : (Over U)ᵒᵖ := op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))
    let a : Fin (genericRank X E) → E.val.obj (op U) := fun j ↦
      ((q.generators i).s
        (determinantLocalGeneratorsStalkIndexEquiv X E q i hη j)).eval T
    let z : (SchemeKTheory.determinant X E).val.obj (op U) :=
      (((SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app
        (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower E.val (genericRank X E))).app (op U)).hom
          (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk a)
    (determinantLocalFrameData X E q i hxi).genericTrivialization 1 =
      (SchemeKTheory.determinant X E).presheaf.germ
        U (genericPoint X) hη z := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let U := q.X i
  let hη : genericPoint X ∈ U :=
    ((genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial).mem_open U.isOpen hxi
  letI : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨genericPoint X, hη⟩⟩
  let T : (Over U)ᵒᵖ := op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))
  let d := determinantLocalFrameData X E q i hxi
  let a : Fin (genericRank X E) → E.val.obj (op U) := fun j ↦
    ((q.generators i).s
      (determinantLocalGeneratorsStalkIndexEquiv X E q i hη j)).eval T
  let z : (SchemeKTheory.determinant X E).val.obj (op U) :=
    (((SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app
      (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower E.val (genericRank X E))).app (op U)).hom
        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk a)
  have hglobal :
      ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (X.ringCatSheaf.over U) T).map
        d.globalFrame.hom)
          ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
            (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op U)
              (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op U))) = z := by
    exact determinantLocalFrameData_globalFrame_one_eq_chartSection
      X E q i hxi
  have hsection :
      ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (X.ringCatSheaf.over U) T).map
        (d.globalFrameOverLE U le_rfl).hom)
          ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
            (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op U)
              (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op U))) = z := by
    rw [Scheme.Modules.LineBundleLocalData.globalFrameOverLE_hom]
    rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictHomOverLE_app]
    change
      ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (X.ringCatSheaf.over U) T).map
        d.globalFrame.hom)
          ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
            (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op U)
              (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op U))) = z
    exact hglobal
  have h := d.genericTrivialization_algebraMap U le_rfl
    (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op U))
  rw [map_one] at h
  exact h.trans (congrArg (fun s ↦ (SchemeKTheory.determinant X E).presheaf.germ
    U (genericPoint X) hη s) hsection)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.determinantLocalFrameData_genericTrivialization_eq_stalkBasis
statement:
theorem determinantLocalFrameData_genericTrivialization_eq_stalkBasis
    (E : X.Modules) (hE : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X E)

    [q.IsLocallyFreeData] [q.IsFiniteType]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.hasFiniteEulerCharacteristic_of_finiteSupport_of_stalk_isFiniteLength

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.zeroDimensionalLength_eq_sum_stalk_length_mul_finrank

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.eulerChar_eq_sum_stalk_length_mul_finrank
statement:
theorem eulerChar_eq_sum_stalk_length_mul_finrank
    [IsIntegral X] [Order.KrullDimLE 1 X]
    (F : X.Modules) (S : Finset X)
    (hSη : ∀ p : S, p.1 ≠ genericPoint X)

      ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X p.1).obj F))

    F.eulerChar k = (∑ p : S,
      (Module.length (X.presheaf.stalk p.1)
        ((moduleStalkFunctorLinear X p.1).obj F)).toNat *

:= by

    _ = (∑ p : S,

      exact_mod_cast hsum

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.germ_eq_of_open_eq
statement:
private theorem germ_eq_of_open_eq
    (P : TopCat.Presheaf AddCommGrpCat X) {U V : X.Opens} (hUV : U = V)
    (x : X) (hxU : x ∈ U) (hxV : x ∈ V)
    (sU : ↑(P.obj (op U))) (sV : ↑(P.obj (op V))) (hs : HEq sU sV) :
    P.germ U x hxU sU = P.germ V x hxV sV
proof:
:= by
  subst V
  cases hs
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericCommonLatticeStalkDeterminantRationalTrivialization_genericRankFree
statement:
theorem genericCommonLatticeStalkDeterminantRationalTrivialization_genericRankFree
    (E : X.Modules) (hE : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X E) (x : X) :
    genericCommonLatticeStalkDeterminantRationalTrivialization X
        (genericRankFreeSheaf X E) E
        (genericRankFreeStalkSheafIso X E hE)
        (SchemeKTheory.free_isFiniteLocallyFree X
          (ULift.{u} (Fin (genericRank X E))))
        hE x (genericRankFreeStalkBasis X E x) =
      genericRankFreeDeterminantRationalTrivialization X E hE
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F : X.Modules := genericRankFreeSheaf X E
  let hF : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X F :=
    SchemeKTheory.free_isFiniteLocallyFree X
      (ULift.{u} (Fin (genericRank X E)))
  letI : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X F := hF
  letI : Module.Finite X.functionField ((genericStalkFunctor X).obj F) :=
    genericStalk_finite_of_isFiniteLocallyFree X F hF
  let hinj : Function.Injective (stalkToGeneric X F x) :=
    IsGenericallyTorsionFree.stalkToGeneric_injective x
  let hdim : genericRank X F = genericRank X E :=
    genericRank_genericRankFreeSheaf X E
  change
    genericCommonLatticeDeterminantRationalTrivialization X F E
        (genericRankFreeStalkSheafIso X E hE) hE
        (stalkBasisToGenericBasis X F x (genericRank X E)
          (genericRankFreeStalkBasis X E x) hinj hdim) =
      genericCommonLatticeDeterminantRationalTrivialization X F E
        (genericRankFreeStalkSheafIso X E hE) hE
        (genericRankFreeGenericBasis X E)
  congr 1
  simpa only [F, hinj, hdim] using
    stalkBasisToGenericBasis_genericRankFreeStalkBasis X E x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.freeGenericCoordinate_eq_germ
statement:
private theorem freeGenericCoordinate_eq_germ
    (I : Type u) [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (U : X.Opens) (hηU : genericPoint X ∈ U) (i : I) :
    (freeStalkPiLinearEquiv (X := X) I (genericPoint X)).symm
        (Pi.single (M := fun _ : I ↦ X.functionField) i 1) =
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I).val.presheaf
        U (genericPoint X) hηU
        ((SheafOfModules.freeSection i).eval (op U))
proof:
:= by
  rw [freeStalkPiLinearEquiv_symm_single]
  have hunit :
      (PresheafOfModules.unitStalkLinearEquiv X (genericPoint X)).symm 1 =
        TopCat.Presheaf.germ
          (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).val.presheaf
          U (genericPoint X) hηU (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op U)) := by
    apply (PresheafOfModules.unitStalkLinearEquiv X (genericPoint X)).injective
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rw [PresheafOfModules.unitStalkLinearEquiv_germ]
    exact ((X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) hηU).hom.map_one).symm
  rw [hunit]
  change
    ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat (genericPoint X)).map
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
        (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map
          ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf).map
            (SheafOfModules.ιFree (R := X.ringCatSheaf) i)))).hom
        (TopCat.Presheaf.germ
          (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).val.presheaf
          U (genericPoint X) hηU (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op U))) = _
  erw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.overSectionOfElement_identity_eval_of_sectionsMap_eq
statement:
private theorem overSectionOfElement_identity_eval_of_sectionsMap_eq
    (U : X.Opens) (F E : X.Modules) (e : F.over U ⟶ E.over U)
    (m : F.val.obj (op U)) (s : (E.over U).sections)
    (h : SheafOfModules.sectionsMap e
      (Scheme.Modules.overSectionOfElement X F U m) = s) :
    e.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) m = s.eval (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))
proof:
:= by
  have h' := congrArg (fun z ↦ z.eval (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))) h
  change e.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))
      ((Scheme.Modules.overSectionOfElement X F U m).eval
        (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))) = _ at h'
  rw [Scheme.Modules.overSectionOfElement_eval] at h'
  have hop : (Over.mk (𝟙 U)).hom.op = 𝟙 (op U) := rfl
  rw [hop] at h'
  have hmap : F.val.map (𝟙 (op U)) m = m := by
    rw [F.val.map_id]
    rfl
  exact (congrArg (fun z ↦ e.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) z) hmap).symm.trans h'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericStalkFreeLinearEquivOfLocalGenerators_coordinate_germ
statement:
private theorem genericStalkFreeLinearEquivOfLocalGenerators_coordinate_germ
    (E : X.Modules) (q : E.LocalGeneratorsData)
    [q.IsLocallyFreeData] [q.IsFiniteType]
    (i : q.I) [Fintype (q.generators i).I] [DecidableEq (q.generators i).I]
    (hηi : genericPoint X ∈ q.X i)
    (a : (q.generators i).I) :
    genericStalkFreeLinearEquivOfOverIso X E (q.X i) hηi
        (q.generators i).I
        ((SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X (q.X i) (q.generators i).I).symm ≪≫
          asIso (q.generators i).π)
        ((freeStalkPiLinearEquiv (X := X) (q.generators i).I
          (genericPoint X)).symm
            (Pi.single
              (M := fun _ : (q.generators i).I ↦ X.functionField) a 1)) =
      E.presheaf.germ (q.X i) (genericPoint X) hηi
        (((q.generators i).s a).eval
          (op (Over.mk (𝟙 (q.X i)))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let U := q.X i
  let I := (q.generators i).I
  let F : X.Modules := SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I
  let eOver : F.over U ≅ E.over U :=
    (SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X U I).symm ≪≫ asIso (q.generators i).π
  let f : (U : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ X := Scheme.Opens.ι U
  let W : (U : Scheme.{u}).Opens := f ⁻¹ᵁ U
  have himage : f ''ᵁ W = U := by
    dsimp only [f, W]
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf,
      Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι, inf_eq_right]
  have hηimage : genericPoint X ∈ f ''ᵁ W := by
    rw [himage]
    exact hηi
  let m : F.val.obj (op U) := (SheafOfModules.freeSection a).eval (op U)
  let mImage : F.val.obj (op (f ''ᵁ W)) := by
    rw [himage]
    exact m
  let s : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj F).val.obj (op W) := by
    exact mImage
  let eRestr : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj F ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj E :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app F).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.mapIso eOver ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app E
  have h := genericStalkFreeLinearEquivOfOverIso_germ
    X E U hηi I eOver U le_rfl hηi s
  dsimp only at h
  have hsource :
      F.presheaf.germ (f ''ᵁ W) (genericPoint X)
          hηimage s =
        F.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) hηi m := by
    apply germ_eq_of_open_eq X _ himage
    simp [s, mImage, m]
    exact cast_heq _ _
  have hsections :
      SheafOfModules.sectionsMap eOver.hom
          (Scheme.Modules.overSectionOfElement X F U m) =
        (q.generators i).s a := by
    change SheafOfModules.sectionsMap
        ((SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X U I).inv ≫ (q.generators i).π)
          (Scheme.Modules.overSectionOfElement X F U m) = _
    rw [← Scheme.Modules.sectionsMap_freeOverIso_hom_freeSection X U I a]
    rw [← SheafOfModules.sectionsMap_comp]
    simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
    exact SheafOfModules.sectionsMap_freeHomEquiv_symm_freeSection
      (q.generators i).s a
  have heval :
      eOver.hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) m =
        ((q.generators i).s a).eval (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) := by
    exact overSectionOfElement_identity_eval_of_sectionsMap_eq
      X U F E eOver.hom m ((q.generators i).s a) hsections
  have hrestrict := Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv_restrict_app_heq
    (X := X) le_rfl eOver.hom m
  dsimp only at hrestrict
  have htarget :
      E.presheaf.germ (f ''ᵁ W) (genericPoint X)
          hηimage
          (eRestr.hom.val.app (op W) s) =
        E.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) hηi
          (((q.generators i).s a).eval (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))) := by
    apply germ_eq_of_open_eq X _ himage
    exact hrestrict.trans (heq_of_eq heval)
  rw [hsource] at h
  have hfree := freeGenericCoordinate_eq_germ X I U hηi a
  change
    (freeStalkPiLinearEquiv (X := X) I (genericPoint X)).symm
        (Pi.single (M := fun _ : I ↦ X.functionField) a 1) =
      F.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) hηi m at hfree
  rw [← hfree] at h
  exact h.trans htarget

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.determinantLocalGeneratorsStalkBasis_generic_eq_germ
statement:
theorem determinantLocalGeneratorsStalkBasis_generic_eq_germ
    (E : X.Modules) (q : E.LocalGeneratorsData)
    [q.IsLocallyFreeData] [q.IsFiniteType]
    (i : q.I) (hηi : genericPoint X ∈ q.X i)
    (j : Fin (genericRank X E)) :
    determinantLocalGeneratorsStalkBasis X E q i hηi j =
      E.presheaf.germ (q.X i) (genericPoint X) hηi
        (((q.generators i).s
          (determinantLocalGeneratorsStalkIndexEquiv X E q i hηi j)).eval
            (op (Over.mk (𝟙 (q.X i)))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let I := (q.generators i).I
  letI : (q.generators i).IsFiniteType :=
    SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType i
  letI : Finite I := by
    dsimp only [I]
    infer_instance
  letI : Fintype I := Fintype.ofFinite I
  let a : I := determinantLocalGeneratorsStalkIndexEquiv X E q i hηi j
  rw [determinantLocalGeneratorsStalkBasis_apply]
  dsimp only [determinantLocalGeneratorsStalkVector,
    localGeneratorsStalkLinearEquiv]
  change
    genericStalkFreeLinearEquivOfOverIso X E (q.X i) hηi I
        ((SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X (q.X i) I).symm ≪≫
          asIso (q.generators i).π)
        ((freeStalkPiLinearEquiv (X := X) I (genericPoint X)).symm
          (Pi.single (M := fun _ : I ↦ X.functionField) a 1)) =
      E.presheaf.germ (q.X i) (genericPoint X) hηi
        (((q.generators i).s a).eval (op (Over.mk (𝟙 (q.X i)))))
  exact genericStalkFreeLinearEquivOfLocalGenerators_coordinate_germ
    X E q i hηi a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.stalk_isIntegrallyClosed_of_isAffineOpen
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra Γ(N, W) (N.presheaf.stalk x) :=

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.isIntegrallyClosed_integralClosure_genericPoint
statement:
theorem isIntegrallyClosed_integralClosure_genericPoint {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Y]
    {V : Y.Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (hVne : Nonempty V) :
    letI
proof:
:= ((genericPointMorphism Y).app V).hom.toAlgebra
    IsIntegrallyClosed (integralClosure Γ(Y, V)
      Γ(Spec (Y.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint Y)), (genericPointMorphism Y) ⁻¹ᵁ V)) := by
  let f := genericPointMorphism Y
  letI := (f.app V).hom.toAlgebra
  have hη : genericPoint Y ∈ V :=
    ((genericPoint_spec Y).mem_open_set_iff V.isOpen).mpr (by simpa using hVne)
  haveI : Unique (Spec (Y.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint Y))) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Unique (Spec (.of Y.functionField)))
  have hpre : f ⁻¹ᵁ V = ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro x _
    have hx : x = IsLocalRing.closedPoint (Y.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint Y)) :=
      Subsingleton.elim _ _
    show f x ∈ V
    rw [hx]
    exact (Scheme.fromSpecStalk_closedPoint (X := Y) (x := genericPoint Y)).symm ▸ hη
  let ρ := (Spec (Y.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint Y))).presheaf.map
    (homOfLE (le_top : f ⁻¹ᵁ V ≤ ⊤)).op
  haveI : IsIso ρ := by
    have h1 : (homOfLE (le_top : f ⁻¹ᵁ V ≤ ⊤)) = eqToHom hpre := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    simp only [ρ, h1, eqToHom_op, eqToHom_map]
    infer_instance
  let e : Y.functionField ≃+* Γ(Spec (Y.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint Y)), f ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
    ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso _).symm ≪≫ asIso ρ).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  have he : ∀ a : Γ(Y, V), algebraMap Γ(Y, V) Γ(Spec (Y.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint Y)),
      f ⁻¹ᵁ V) a = e (algebraMap Γ(Y, V) Y.functionField a) := by
    intro a
    change ((Y.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint Y)).app V).hom a = ρ.hom ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso _).inv.hom
      ((Y.presheaf.germ V (genericPoint Y) hη).hom a))
    rw [Scheme.fromSpecStalk_app hη]
    rfl
  let g : Γ(Spec (Y.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint Y)), f ⁻¹ᵁ V) ≃ₐ[Γ(Y, V)]
      Y.functionField :=
    AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := e.symm) fun a ↦ by
      rw [he, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  haveI := functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen Y V hV
  haveI : IsIntegrallyClosed (integralClosure Γ(Y, V) Y.functionField) :=
    integralClosure.isIntegrallyClosedOfFiniteExtension Y.functionField
  let gh : Γ(Spec (Y.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint Y)), f ⁻¹ᵁ V) →ₐ[Γ(Y, V)] Y.functionField :=
    (g : Γ(Spec (Y.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint Y)), f ⁻¹ᵁ V) →ₐ[Γ(Y, V)] Y.functionField)
  have hmap : (integralClosure Γ(Y, V) Γ(Spec (Y.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint Y)),
      f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).map gh = integralClosure Γ(Y, V) Y.functionField :=
    integralClosure_map_algEquiv (R := Γ(Y, V)) g
  let ψ₁ := Subalgebra.equivMapOfInjective (integralClosure Γ(Y, V)
    Γ(Spec (Y.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint Y)), f ⁻¹ᵁ V)) gh g.injective
  let ψ₂ := Subalgebra.equivOfEq _ _ hmap
  exact IsIntegrallyClosed.of_equiv (ψ₁.trans ψ₂).symm.toRingEquiv

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.normalizationScheme_stalk_isIntegrallyClosed
statement:
theorem normalizationScheme_stalk_isIntegrallyClosed {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Y]
    (x : normalizationScheme Y) :
    IsIntegrallyClosed ((normalizationScheme Y).presheaf.stalk x)
proof:
:= by
  let f := genericPointMorphism Y
  let ν := normalizationMorphism Y
  have hmem : ν x ∈ (⨆ V : Y.affineOpens, (V : Y.Opens)) := by
    rw [iSup_affineOpens_eq_top]; trivial
  obtain ⟨⟨V, hV⟩, hxV⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mp hmem
  have hW : IsAffineOpen (ν ⁻¹ᵁ V) := hV.preimage ν
  letI := (f.app V).hom.toAlgebra
  have hint := isIntegrallyClosed_integralClosure_genericPoint hV ⟨⟨ν x, hxV⟩⟩
  have hWc : IsIntegrallyClosed Γ(normalizationScheme Y, ν ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
    IsIntegrallyClosed.of_equiv (f.normalizationObjIso hV).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.symm
  exact stalk_isIntegrallyClosed_of_isAffineOpen hW hWc x hxV

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.normalizationScheme_isRegularInCodimensionOne
statement:
theorem normalizationScheme_isRegularInCodimensionOne {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Y]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian (normalizationScheme Y)] :
    IsRegularInCodimensionOne (normalizationScheme Y) where
  dvr x hx
proof:
:= by
    haveI := normalizationScheme_stalk_isIntegrallyClosed x
    haveI : Ring.KrullDimLE 1 ((normalizationScheme Y).presheaf.stalk x) :=
      krullDimLE_of_coheight (by exact_mod_cast hx)
    have hnf : ¬ IsField ((normalizationScheme Y).presheaf.stalk x) := by
      intro hF
      have h1 := ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight x
      rw [ringKrullDim_eq_zero_of_isField hF, hx] at h1
      exact absurd h1 (by decide)
    have key :=
      (IsDiscreteValuationRing.TFAE ((normalizationScheme Y).presheaf.stalk x) hnf).out 0 3
    have hm : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((normalizationScheme Y).presheaf.stalk x) ≠ ⊥ :=
      (IsLocalRing.isField_iff_maximalIdeal_eq).not.mp hnf
    refine key.mpr ⟨inferInstance, IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _, ⟨hm, inferInstance⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro P ⟨hP0, hP⟩
    exact IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal (Ideal.IsPrime.isMaximal_of_ne_bot hP hP0)

name: SchemeKTheory.freePUnit_globalGenerator_eq_freeSection_eval
statement:
private lemma freePUnit_globalGenerator_eq_freeSection_eval (U : X.Opens) :
    (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
      (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op U)

      (SheafOfModules.freeSection PUnit.unit).eval (op U)

name: SchemeKTheory.determinantLocalFrame_hom_topExteriorGenerator
statement:
theorem determinantLocalFrame_hom_topExteriorGenerator
    (M : X.Modules) (q : M.LocalGeneratorsData)
    [q.IsLocallyFreeData] [q.IsFiniteType]
    (p : Σ i : q.I, q.X i) :
    SheafOfModules.sectionsMap (determinantLocalFrame X M q p).hom
        (SheafOfModules.freeSection PUnit.unit) =
      determinantLocalChartTopWedgeSheafSection X M q p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let U := q.X p.1
  have hη : genericPoint X ∈ U :=
    ((genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial).mem_open U.isOpen p.2.property
  let T : (Over U)ᵒᵖ := op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))
  let s := SheafOfModules.sectionsMap (determinantLocalFrame X M q p).hom
    (SheafOfModules.freeSection PUnit.unit)
  let t := determinantLocalChartTopWedgeSheafSection X M q p
  let d := AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.determinantLocalFrameData
    X M q p.1 p.2.property
  let e := freeOverIso X U PUnit
  let g := Scheme.Modules.overSectionOfElement X
    (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit) U
      ((SheafOfModules.freeSection PUnit.unit).eval (op U))
  have hfree :
      SheafOfModules.sectionsMap e.hom
          (SheafOfModules.freeSection PUnit.unit) = g := by
    exact Scheme.Modules.sectionsMap_freeOverIso_hom_freeSection
      X U PUnit PUnit.unit
  have hpre :
      SheafOfModules.sectionsMap e.inv g =
        SheafOfModules.freeSection PUnit.unit := by
    rw [← hfree, ← SheafOfModules.sectionsMap_comp]
    simp only [e, Iso.hom_inv_id, SheafOfModules.sectionsMap_id]
  have hsections :
      SheafOfModules.sectionsMap d.globalFrame.hom g = s := by
    change SheafOfModules.sectionsMap
        (e.inv ≫ (determinantLocalFrame X M q p).hom) g = s
    rw [SheafOfModules.sectionsMap_comp, hpre]
  have hglobal :=
    SingularCurve.determinantLocalFrameData_globalFrame_one_eq_chartSection
      X M q p.1 p.2.property
  dsimp only at hglobal
  change
    ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (X.ringCatSheaf.over U) T).map
      d.globalFrame.hom)
        ((SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
          (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op U)
            (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op U))) =
      determinantLocalChartTopWedgeGlobal X M q p.1 hη at hglobal
  have hgT :
      g.eval T =
        (SheafOfModules.freePUnitIsoUnit
          (R := X.ringCatSheaf)).inv.val.app (op U)
            (1 : X.presheaf.obj (op U)) := by
    dsimp only [g]
    rw [Scheme.Modules.overSectionOfElement_eval]
    dsimp only [T]
    rw [show (Over.mk (𝟙 U)).hom.op = 𝟙 (op U) by rfl]
    calc
      _ = (SheafOfModules.freeSection PUnit.unit).eval (op U) :=
        PresheafOfModules.sections_property
          (SheafOfModules.freeSection PUnit.unit) (𝟙 (op U))
      _ = _ := (freePUnit_globalGenerator_eq_freeSection_eval X U).symm
  have hglobalSection :
      (SheafOfModules.sectionsMap d.globalFrame.hom g).eval T =
        determinantLocalChartTopWedgeGlobal X M q p.1 hη := by
    change
      ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (X.ringCatSheaf.over U) T).map
        d.globalFrame.hom) (g.eval T) = _
    rw [hgT]
    exact hglobal
  have hT : s.eval T = t.eval T := by
    calc
      s.eval T = (SheafOfModules.sectionsMap d.globalFrame.hom g).eval T :=
        congrArg (fun z ↦ z.eval T) hsections.symm
      _ = determinantLocalChartTopWedgeGlobal X M q p.1 hη := hglobalSection
      _ = t.eval T := by
        dsimp only [t, determinantLocalChartTopWedgeSheafSection]
        rw [Scheme.Modules.overSectionOfElement_eval]
        dsimp only [T]
        rw [show (Over.mk (𝟙 U)).hom.op = 𝟙 (op U) by rfl]
        exact (Functor.map_id_apply (determinant X M).val.presheaf
          (op U) (determinantLocalChartTopWedgeGlobal X M q p.1 hη)).symm
  apply PresheafOfModules.sections_ext
  intro V
  let c : V.unop ⟶ Over.mk (𝟙 U) := Over.homMk V.unop.hom
  have hs := PresheafOfModules.sections_property s c.op
  have ht := PresheafOfModules.sections_property t c.op
  change s.eval V = t.eval V
  calc
    s.eval V = ((determinant X M).over U).val.map c.op (s.eval T) := hs.symm
    _ = ((determinant X M).over U).val.map c.op (t.eval T) :=
      congrArg (fun z ↦ ((determinant X M).over U).val.map c.op z) hT
    _ = t.eval V := ht

name: PresheafOfModules.unitStalkLinearEquiv_germ
statement:
theorem unitStalkLinearEquiv_germ (U : X.Opens) (x : X) (hx : x ∈ U)
    (a : X.presheaf.obj (op U)) :
    unitStalkLinearEquiv X x
        (TopCat.Presheaf.germ
          (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).val.presheaf U x hx a) =
      X.presheaf.germ U x hx a
proof:
:= by
  let α : TopCat.Presheaf.stalk
        (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).val.presheaf x ≅
      (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat ⋙ forget₂ RingCat AddCommGrpCat).obj
        (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    Limits.colimit.isoColimitCocone
      ⟨_, Limits.isColimitOfPreserves
        (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat ⋙ forget₂ RingCat AddCommGrpCat)
        (Limits.colimit.isColimit ((OpenNhds.inclusion x).op ⋙ X.presheaf))⟩
  change α.hom
      (TopCat.Presheaf.germ
        (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).val.presheaf U x hx a) =
    X.presheaf.germ U x hx a
  have hι : TopCat.Presheaf.germ
      (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).val.presheaf U x hx ≫ α.hom =
      (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat ⋙ forget₂ RingCat AddCommGrpCat).map
        (X.presheaf.germ U x hx) :=
    Limits.colimit.isoColimitCocone_ι_hom ..
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hι a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkLinearEquiv_germ
statement:
theorem restrictStalkLinearEquiv_germ (U : X.Opens) (hxU : x ∈ U)
    (s : ((restrictFunctor f).obj M).val.obj (op U)) :
    letI
proof:
:= restrictStalkModule f x M
    restrictStalkLinearEquiv f x M
        (TopCat.Presheaf.germ ((restrictFunctor f).obj M).presheaf U x hxU s) =
      M.presheaf.germ (f ''ᵁ U) (f x) (by simpa) s := by
  letI := restrictStalkModule f x M
  change (restrictStalkNatIso f x).hom.app M
      (TopCat.Presheaf.germ ((restrictFunctor f).obj M).presheaf U x hxU s) = _
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (germ_restrictStalkNatIso_hom_app f x M hxU) s

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkLinearEquiv_symm_germ
statement:
theorem restrictStalkLinearEquiv_symm_germ (U : X.Opens) (hxU : x ∈ U)
    (s : ((restrictFunctor f).obj M).val.obj (op U)) :
    letI
proof:
:= restrictStalkModule f x M
    (restrictStalkLinearEquiv f x M).symm
        (M.presheaf.germ (f ''ᵁ U) (f x) (by simpa) s) =
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ ((restrictFunctor f).obj M).presheaf U x hxU s := by
  letI := restrictStalkModule f x M
  apply (restrictStalkLinearEquiv f x M).injective
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact (restrictStalkLinearEquiv_germ f x M U hxU s).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.presheafOfModules_app_heq_of_obj_eq
statement:
private theorem presheafOfModules_app_heq_of_obj_eq
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C]
    {R : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ RingCat.{w}} {F G : _root_.PresheafOfModules.{w} R}
    (q : F ⟶ G) {A B : Cᵒᵖ} (hAB : A = B)
    (a : F.obj A) (b : F.obj B) (hab : HEq a b) :
    HEq (q.app A a) (q.app B b)
proof:

  subst B

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv_inv_app_heq
statement:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv_restrict_app_heq
proof:
:= U
    let f : S ⟶ X := Scheme.Opens.ι U
    let W : S.Opens := f ⁻¹ᵁ V
    let hImage : f ''ᵁ W = V := by
      dsimp only [f, W]
      rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf,
        Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι, inf_eq_right]
      exact hVU
    let mImage : M.val.obj (op (f ''ᵁ W)) := by
      rw [hImage]
      exact m
    let mRestr : ((restrictFunctor f).obj M).val.obj (op W) := mImage
    let qRestr : (restrictFunctor f).obj M ⟶ (restrictFunctor f).obj N :=
      ((overFunctorEquiv U).app M).inv ≫
        (overEquiv U).functor.map q ≫
          ((overFunctorEquiv U).app N).hom
    HEq (qRestr.val.app (op W) mRestr)
      (q.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hVU))) m) := by
  dsimp only
  let f : (U : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ X := Scheme.Opens.ι U
  let W : (U : Scheme.{u}).Opens := f ⁻¹ᵁ V
  let hImage : f ''ᵁ W = V := by
    dsimp only [f, W]
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf,
      Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι, inf_eq_right]
    exact hVU
  let mImage : M.val.obj (op (f ''ᵁ W)) := by
    rw [hImage]
    exact m
  let mRestr : ((restrictFunctor f).obj M).val.obj (op W) := mImage
  let αM := (overFunctorEquiv U).app M
  let αN := (overFunctorEquiv U).app N
  let t := αM.inv.val.app (op W) mRestr
  let r := ((overEquiv U).functor.map q).val.app (op W) t
  let z := αN.hom.val.app (op W) r
  change HEq z (q.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hVU))) m)
  have hz : HEq z r := by
    exact overFunctorEquiv_hom_app_heq U W r
  have hr : HEq r
      (q.val.app (op (U.overEquivalence.inverse.obj W)) t) := by
    exact overEquiv_map_app_heq U W q t
  have ht : HEq t mRestr := by
    exact overFunctorEquiv_inv_app_heq U W mRestr
  have hm : HEq mRestr m := by
    simp [mRestr, mImage]
  have hObj : U.overEquivalence.inverse.obj W =
      Over.mk (homOfLE hVU) := by
    refine CostructuredArrow.obj_ext _ _ hImage ?_
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hlast : HEq
      (q.val.app (op (U.overEquivalence.inverse.obj W)) t)
      (q.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hVU))) m) := by
    exact presheafOfModules_app_heq_of_obj_eq q.val
      (congrArg op hObj) t m (ht.trans hm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericStalkFreeLinearEquivOfOverIso_germ
statement:
theorem genericStalkFreeLinearEquivOfOverIso_germ (M : X.Modules)
    (U : X.Opens) (hηU : genericPoint X ∈ U) (I : Type u)
    (eOver : (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I).over U ≅ M.over U)
    (V : X.Opens) (_hVU : V ≤ U) (hηV : genericPoint X ∈ V)
    (s : ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Scheme.Opens.ι U)).obj
      (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I)).val.obj
        (op ((Scheme.Opens.ι U) ⁻¹ᵁ V))) :
    let S : Scheme.{u}
proof:
:= U
    let y : S := ⟨genericPoint X, hηU⟩
    let f : S ⟶ X := Scheme.Opens.ι U
    let F : X.Modules := SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I
    let eRestr : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj F ≅
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj M :=
      ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app F).symm ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.mapIso eOver ≪≫
          (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app M
    let W : S.Opens := f ⁻¹ᵁ V
    genericStalkFreeLinearEquivOfOverIso X M U hηU I eOver
        (F.presheaf.germ (f ''ᵁ W) (genericPoint X)
          (by
            change f y ∈ f ''ᵁ W
            have hy : y ∈ W := by
              change f y ∈ V
              exact hηV
            simpa using hy) s) =
      M.presheaf.germ (f ''ᵁ W) (genericPoint X)
        (by
          change f y ∈ f ''ᵁ W
          have hy : y ∈ W := by
            change f y ∈ V
            exact hηV
          simpa using hy)
        (eRestr.hom.val.app (op W) s) := by
  dsimp only
  let S : Scheme.{u} := U
  let y : S := ⟨genericPoint X, hηU⟩
  let f : S ⟶ X := Scheme.Opens.ι U
  let F : X.Modules := SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I
  let eRestr : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj F ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj M :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app F).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.mapIso eOver ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app M
  let W : S.Opens := f ⁻¹ᵁ V
  have hyW : y ∈ W := by
    change f y ∈ V
    exact hηV
  let eLocal :
      ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk
          (show PresheafOfModules.{u}
              (S.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat) from
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj F).val).presheaf y) ≃ₗ[
        ↑(S.presheaf.stalk y)]
      ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk
          (show PresheafOfModules.{u}
              (S.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat) from
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj M).val).presheaf y) :=
    ((PresheafOfModules.stalkFunctorLinear (R := S.presheaf) y).mapIso
      ((SheafOfModules.forget S.ringCatSheaf).mapIso eRestr)).toLinearEquiv
  letI := Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkModule f y F
  letI := Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkModule f y M
  change
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkLinearEquiv f y M)
      (eLocal
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkLinearEquiv f y F).symm
          (F.presheaf.germ (f ''ᵁ W) (f y) (by simpa) s))) = _
  rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkLinearEquiv_symm_germ]
  change (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkLinearEquiv f y M)
      (((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat y).map
        ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
          (S.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map
            ((SheafOfModules.forget S.ringCatSheaf).map eRestr.hom))).hom
          (TopCat.Presheaf.germ
            ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj F).presheaf W y hyW s)) = _
  erw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply]
  change (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkLinearEquiv f y M)
      (TopCat.Presheaf.germ
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj M).presheaf W y hyW
          (eRestr.hom.val.app (op W) s)) = _
  rw [Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkLinearEquiv_germ]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.unitStalkToGeneric_injective
statement:
theorem unitStalkToGeneric_injective (x : X) :
    Function.Injective
      (stalkToGeneric X (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) x)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, s, rfl⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.exists_germ_eq
    (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).val.presheaf a
  obtain ⟨V, hxV, t, rfl⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.exists_germ_eq
    (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).val.presheaf b
  let hspec : Specializes (genericPoint X) x :=
    (genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial
  have hηU : genericPoint X ∈ U := hspec.mem_open U.isOpen hxU
  have hηV : genericPoint X ∈ V := hspec.mem_open V.isOpen hxV
  have hs := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (TopCat.Presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes
      (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).val.presheaf hxU hspec) s
  have ht := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (TopCat.Presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes
      (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).val.presheaf hxV hspec) t
  rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hs ht
  have hgeneric :
      (TopCat.Presheaf.germ
        (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).val.presheaf U
          (genericPoint X) hηU).hom s =
      (TopCat.Presheaf.germ
        (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).val.presheaf V
          (genericPoint X) hηV).hom t :=
    hs.symm.trans (hab.trans ht)
  have hk := congrArg
    (PresheafOfModules.unitStalkLinearEquiv X (genericPoint X)) hgeneric
  rw [PresheafOfModules.unitStalkLinearEquiv_germ,
    PresheafOfModules.unitStalkLinearEquiv_germ] at hk
  let W : X.Opens := U ⊓ V
  have hxW : x ∈ W := ⟨hxU, hxV⟩
  have hηW : genericPoint X ∈ W := ⟨hηU, hηV⟩
  let iU : W ⟶ U := homOfLE inf_le_left
  let iV : W ⟶ V := homOfLE inf_le_right
  refine TopCat.Presheaf.germ_ext (F :=
      (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).val.presheaf)
    W hxW iU iV ?_
  haveI : Nonempty W := ⟨⟨x, hxW⟩⟩
  apply X.germToFunctionField_injective W
  change X.presheaf.germ W (genericPoint X) hηW
      (X.presheaf.map iU.op s) =
    X.presheaf.germ W (genericPoint X) hηW
      (X.presheaf.map iV.op t)
  rw [X.presheaf.germ_res_apply iU (genericPoint X) hηW s,
    X.presheaf.germ_res_apply iV (genericPoint X) hηW t]
  exact hk

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.restrictStalkNatIso_stalkSpecializes
statement:
theorem restrictStalkNatIso_stalkSpecializes
    {S X : Scheme.{u}} (f : S ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    (x y : S) (h : Specializes y x) (M : X.Modules) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj M).presheaf.stalkSpecializes h ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso f y).hom.app M =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso f x).hom.app M ≫
        M.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (h.map f.continuous)
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  change
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso f y).hom.app M
        (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj M).presheaf.stalkSpecializes h m) =
      M.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (h.map f.continuous)
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso f x).hom.app M m)
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, s, rfl⟩ := TopCat.Presheaf.exists_germ_eq
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj M).presheaf m
  have hyU : y ∈ U := h.mem_open U.isOpen hxU
  have hs := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (TopCat.Presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj M).presheaf hxU h) s
  have hx := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (Scheme.Modules.germ_restrictStalkNatIso_hom_app f x M hxU) s
  have hy := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (Scheme.Modules.germ_restrictStalkNatIso_hom_app f y M hyU) s
  have ht := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (TopCat.Presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes M.presheaf (by simpa)
      (h.map f.continuous)) s
  rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at hs hx hy ht
  calc
    _ = (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso f y).hom.app M
          (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj M).presheaf.germ U y hyU s) :=
      congrArg _ hs
    _ = M.presheaf.germ (f ''ᵁ U) (f y) (by simpa) s := hy
    _ = M.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (h.map f.continuous)
          (M.presheaf.germ (f ''ᵁ U) (f x) (by simpa) s) := ht.symm
    _ = _ := congrArg _ hx.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.restrictStalkNatIso_hom_stalkSpecializes
statement:
theorem restrictStalkNatIso_hom_stalkSpecializes
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : S ⟶ T) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    (M : T.Modules) {x y : S} (h : Specializes x y) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj M).presheaf.stalkSpecializes h ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso f x).hom.app M =
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso f y).hom.app M ≫
        M.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (f.base.hom.map_specializes h)
proof:
:=
  restrictStalkNatIso_stalkSpecializes f y x h M

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.freeStalkToGeneric_injective
statement:
theorem freeStalkToGeneric_injective (I : Type u) [Finite I] (x : X) :
    Function.Injective
      (stalkToGeneric X
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I) x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Fintype I := Fintype.ofFinite I
  let A : I → X.Modules := fun _ ↦ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf
  let Fₓ := Scheme.Modules.stalkFunctor X x
  let Fη := Scheme.Modules.stalkFunctor X (genericPoint X)
  let τ := stalkToGenericNat X x
  letI : HasBiproduct (fun i ↦ Fₓ.obj (A i)) :=
    HasBiproduct.of_hasCoproduct _
  letI : HasBiproduct (fun i ↦ Fη.obj (A i)) :=
    HasBiproduct.of_hasCoproduct _
  let eₓ : Fₓ.obj (colimit (Discrete.functor A)) ≅
      colimit (Discrete.functor fun i ↦ Fₓ.obj (A i)) :=
    PreservesCoproduct.iso Fₓ A
  let eη : Fη.obj (colimit (Discrete.functor A)) ≅
      colimit (Discrete.functor fun i ↦ Fη.obj (A i)) :=
    PreservesCoproduct.iso Fη A
  let hcomponent (i : I) : Mono (τ.app (A i)) := by
    apply ConcreteCategory.mono_of_injective
    change Function.Injective
      (stalkToGeneric X (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) x)
    exact unitStalkToGeneric_injective X x
  letI : ∀ i : I, Mono (τ.app (A i)) := hcomponent
  have hmap : eₓ.inv ≫ τ.app (colimit (Discrete.functor A)) ≫ eη.hom =
      Limits.Sigma.map (fun i ↦ τ.app (A i)) := by
    apply Limits.Sigma.hom_ext
    intro i
    rw [show eₓ.inv = sigmaComparison Fₓ A by rfl]
    rw [Limits.ι_comp_sigmaComparison_assoc]
    have hn := τ.naturality (Limits.Sigma.ι A i)
    change Fₓ.map (Limits.Sigma.ι A i) ≫
        τ.app (colimit (Discrete.functor A)) =
      τ.app (A i) ≫ Fη.map (Limits.Sigma.ι A i) at hn
    rw [← Category.assoc, hn, Category.assoc]
    have hηcomp : Fη.map (Limits.Sigma.ι A i) ≫ eη.hom =
        Limits.Sigma.ι (fun i ↦ Fη.obj (A i)) i := by
      apply (cancel_mono eη.inv).1
      calc
        (Fη.map (Limits.Sigma.ι A i) ≫ eη.hom) ≫ eη.inv =
            Fη.map (Limits.Sigma.ι A i) := by simp
        _ = Limits.Sigma.ι (fun i ↦ Fη.obj (A i)) i ≫ eη.inv := by
          rw [show eη.inv = sigmaComparison Fη A by rfl]
          exact (Limits.ι_comp_sigmaComparison Fη A i).symm
    rw [hηcomp, Limits.Sigma.ι_map]
  have hsig : Mono (Limits.Sigma.map (fun i ↦ τ.app (A i))) :=
    @Limits.Sigma.map_mono I Ab.{u} _ _
      (fun i ↦ Fₓ.obj (A i)) (fun i ↦ Fη.obj (A i))
      inferInstance inferInstance (fun i ↦ τ.app (A i)) hcomponent
  have hmono : Mono
      (eₓ.inv ≫ τ.app (colimit (Discrete.functor A)) ≫ eη.hom) := by
    rw [hmap]
    exact hsig
  have hinj : Function.Injective
      (eₓ.inv ≫ τ.app (colimit (Discrete.functor A)) ≫ eη.hom) :=
    (AddCommGrpCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp hmono
  change Function.Injective (τ.app (colimit (Discrete.functor A)))
  intro a b hab
  apply eₓ.addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv.injective
  change eₓ.hom a = eₓ.hom b
  apply hinj
  simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
  rw [eₓ.hom_inv_id_apply, eₓ.hom_inv_id_apply]
  exact congrArg eη.hom.hom hab

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.isGenericallyTorsionFree_of_iso
statement:
theorem isGenericallyTorsionFree_of_iso {F G : X.Modules} (e : F ≅ G)
    [IsGenericallyTorsionFree X F] : IsGenericallyTorsionFree X G where
  stalkToGeneric_injective x
proof:
:= by
    intro a b hab
    let Fₓ := Scheme.Modules.stalkFunctor X x
    let Fη := Scheme.Modules.stalkFunctor X (genericPoint X)
    let τ := stalkToGenericNat X x
    let eₓ := Fₓ.mapIso e
    let eη := Fη.mapIso e
    have hn := τ.naturality e.inv
    have ha := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hn a
    have hb := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom hn b
    rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at ha hb
    have hpre : eₓ.inv.hom a = eₓ.inv.hom b := by
      apply IsGenericallyTorsionFree.stalkToGeneric_injective x
      exact ha.trans ((congrArg eη.inv.hom hab).trans hb.symm)
    exact eₓ.addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv.symm.injective hpre

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.restrict_stalkSpecializes_injective
statement:
theorem restrict_stalkSpecializes_injective
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : S ⟶ T) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    (M : T.Modules) {z y : S} (h : Specializes z y)
    (hT : Function.Injective
      (M.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (f.base.hom.map_specializes h))) :
    Function.Injective
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj M).presheaf.stalkSpecializes h)
proof:
:= by
  let localMap :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj M).presheaf.stalkSpecializes h
  let globalMap := M.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (f.base.hom.map_specializes h)
  let eᵧ := (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso f y).hom.app M
  let ez := (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso f z).hom.app M
  let heᵧIso : IsIso eᵧ := by dsimp [eᵧ]; infer_instance
  let hezIso : IsIso ez := by dsimp [ez]; infer_instance
  let heᵧMono : Mono eᵧ := @IsIso.mono_of_iso _ _ _ _ eᵧ heᵧIso
  let hezMono : Mono ez := @IsIso.mono_of_iso _ _ _ _ ez hezIso
  let hglobalMono : Mono globalMap := ConcreteCategory.mono_of_injective _ hT
  have hsquare : localMap ≫ ez = eᵧ ≫ globalMap :=
    restrictStalkNatIso_hom_stalkSpecializes f M h
  have hcomp : Mono (localMap ≫ ez) := by
    rw [hsquare]
    exact @mono_comp _ _ _ _ _ eᵧ heᵧMono globalMap hglobalMono
  let hlocalMono : Mono localMap :=
    (@mono_comp_iff_of_mono _ _ _ _ _ localMap ez hezMono).mp hcomp
  exact (AddCommGrpCat.mono_iff_injective localMap).mp hlocalMono

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.stalkSpecializes_injective_of_restrict
statement:
theorem stalkSpecializes_injective_of_restrict
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : S ⟶ T) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    (M : T.Modules) {z y : S} (h : Specializes z y)
    (hS : Function.Injective
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj M).presheaf.stalkSpecializes h)) :
    Function.Injective
      (M.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (f.base.hom.map_specializes h))
proof:
:= by
  let localMap :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj M).presheaf.stalkSpecializes h
  let globalMap := M.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (f.base.hom.map_specializes h)
  let eᵧ := (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso f y).hom.app M
  let ez := (Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso f z).hom.app M
  let heᵧIso : IsIso eᵧ := by dsimp [eᵧ]; infer_instance
  let hezIso : IsIso ez := by dsimp [ez]; infer_instance
  let hezMono : Mono ez := @IsIso.mono_of_iso _ _ _ _ ez hezIso
  let hlocalMono : Mono localMap := ConcreteCategory.mono_of_injective _ hS
  have hsquare : localMap ≫ ez = eᵧ ≫ globalMap :=
    restrictStalkNatIso_hom_stalkSpecializes f M h
  have hcomp : Mono (eᵧ ≫ globalMap) := by
    rw [← hsquare]
    exact @mono_comp _ _ _ _ _ localMap hlocalMono ez hezMono
  let hglobalMono : Mono globalMap :=
    (@mono_comp_iff_of_isIso _ _ _ _ _ eᵧ heᵧIso globalMap).mp hcomp
  exact (AddCommGrpCat.mono_iff_injective globalMap).mp hglobalMono

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.stalkSpecializes_injective_of_iso
statement:
theorem stalkSpecializes_injective_of_iso {M N : X.Modules}
    (e : M ≅ N) {z y : X} (h : Specializes z y)
    (hN : Function.Injective (N.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h)) :
    Function.Injective (M.presheaf.stalkSpecializes h)
proof:
:= by
  change Function.Injective ((stalkSpecializesNat X h).app M)
  let localM := (stalkSpecializesNat X h).app M
  let localN := (stalkSpecializesNat X h).app N
  let eᵧ := ((Scheme.Modules.stalkFunctor X y).mapIso e).hom
  let ez := ((Scheme.Modules.stalkFunctor X z).mapIso e).hom
  let heᵧIso : IsIso eᵧ := by dsimp [eᵧ]; infer_instance
  let hezIso : IsIso ez := by dsimp [ez]; infer_instance
  let heᵧMono : Mono eᵧ := @IsIso.mono_of_iso _ _ _ _ eᵧ heᵧIso
  let hezMono : Mono ez := @IsIso.mono_of_iso _ _ _ _ ez hezIso
  let hlocalNMono : Mono localN := ConcreteCategory.mono_of_injective _ hN
  have hsquare : localM ≫ ez = eᵧ ≫ localN :=
    ((stalkSpecializesNat X h).naturality e.hom).symm
  have hcomp : Mono (localM ≫ ez) := by
    rw [hsquare]
    exact @mono_comp _ _ _ _ _ eᵧ heᵧMono localN hlocalNMono
  let hlocalMMono : Mono localM :=
    (@mono_comp_iff_of_mono _ _ _ _ _ localM ez hezMono).mp hcomp
  exact (AddCommGrpCat.mono_iff_injective localM).mp hlocalMMono

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.isGenericallyTorsionFree_of_isFiniteLocallyFree
statement:
theorem isGenericallyTorsionFree_of_isFiniteLocallyFree (M : X.Modules)
    (hM : SchemeKTheory.IsFiniteLocallyFree X M) :
    IsGenericallyTorsionFree X M
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro x
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqfin⟩ := hM.exists_finiteLocallyFreeData
  letI : q.IsLocallyFreeData := hq
  letI : q.IsFiniteType := hqfin
  let hcover : IsOpenCover q.X :=
    (Opens.coversTop_iff X q.X).mp q.coversTop
  have hxUnion : x ∈ ⋃ i, (q.X i : Set X) := by
    rw [hcover.iSup_set_eq_univ]
    exact Set.mem_univ x
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hxUnion
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := hxUnion
  let U := q.X i
  letI : Nonempty U := ⟨⟨x, hxi⟩⟩
  let S : Scheme.{u} := U
  let f : S ⟶ X := Scheme.Opens.ι U
  have hηU : genericPoint X ∈ U :=
    ((genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial).mem_open U.isOpen hxi
  let y : S := ⟨x, hxi⟩
  let z : S := ⟨genericPoint X, hηU⟩
  have hzy : Specializes z y := by
    change Specializes (⟨genericPoint X, hηU⟩ : U) (⟨x, hxi⟩ : U)
    rw [subtype_specializes_iff]
    exact (genericPoint_spec X).specializes trivial
  let I := (q.generators i).I
  letI : (q.generators i).IsFiniteType :=
    SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData.IsFiniteType.isFiniteType i
  letI : Finite I := by
    dsimp only [I]
    infer_instance
  let F : X.Modules := SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) I
  let eOver : F.over U ≅ M.over U :=
    (SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X U I).symm ≪≫ asIso (q.generators i).π
  let eRestr : (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj F ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj M :=
    ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app F).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.mapIso eOver ≪≫
        (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U).app M
  have hfreeGlobal : Function.Injective
      (F.presheaf.stalkSpecializes (hzy.map f.continuous)) := by
    change Function.Injective (stalkToGeneric X F x)
    exact freeStalkToGeneric_injective X I x
  have hfreeRestr : Function.Injective
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj F).presheaf.stalkSpecializes hzy) :=
    restrict_stalkSpecializes_injective f F hzy hfreeGlobal
  have hMRestr : Function.Injective
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f).obj M).presheaf.stalkSpecializes hzy) :=
    stalkSpecializes_injective_of_iso S eRestr.symm hzy hfreeRestr
  have hglobal := stalkSpecializes_injective_of_restrict f M hzy hMRestr
  change Function.Injective (stalkToGeneric X M x) at hglobal
  exact hglobal

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.ringCatStalk_smul_eq_functionField_smul
statement:
theorem ringCatStalk_smul_eq_functionField_smul
    (F : X.Modules)
    (r : ↑(X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X)))
    (m : ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf (genericPoint X))) :
    r • m = (ringCatStalkToFunctionField X).hom r •
      (show ↑((genericStalkFunctor X).obj F) from m)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module ↑X.functionField
      ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf (genericPoint X)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Module ↑X.functionField ↑((genericStalkFunctor X).obj F))
  obtain ⟨Ur, a, ha⟩ := Concrete.colimit_exists_rep
    ((OpenNhds.inclusion (genericPoint X)).op ⋙ X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf) r
  obtain ⟨Um, b, hb⟩ := Concrete.colimit_exists_rep
    ((OpenNhds.inclusion (genericPoint X)).op ⋙ F.val.presheaf) m
  rcases Ur with ⟨⟨U, hηU⟩⟩
  rcases Um with ⟨⟨V, hηV⟩⟩
  let W : Opens X := U ⊓ V
  have hηW : genericPoint X ∈ W := ⟨hηU, hηV⟩
  let iU : W ⟶ U := homOfLE inf_le_left
  let iV : W ⟶ V := homOfLE inf_le_right
  let aW : X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf.obj (op W) :=
    X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf.map iU.op a
  let bW : F.val.presheaf.obj (op W) := F.val.presheaf.map iV.op b
  have hr : X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf.germ W (genericPoint X) hηW aW = r := by
    change X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf.germ W (genericPoint X) hηW
      (X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf.map iU.op a) = r
    rw [X.ringCatSheaf.presheaf.germ_res_apply iU (genericPoint X) hηW a]
    exact ha
  have hm : TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf W (genericPoint X) hηW bW = m := by
    change TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf W (genericPoint X) hηW
      (F.val.presheaf.map iV.op b) = m
    rw [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply F.val.presheaf iV (genericPoint X) hηW b]
    exact hb
  rw [← hr, ← hm, ringCatStalkToFunctionField_germ]
  rw [← F.val.germ_ringCat_smul]
  exact (SchemeKTheory.underlyingCommPresheaf X F).germ_smul
    (genericPoint X) W hηW aW bW

statement:
private lemma eqMpr_isoTrans_hom
    {C : Type v} [Category.{w} C] {ι : Type*} (F : ι → C)
    {m n : ι} (h : m = n) {A B : C} (e : A ≅ B) (g : B ≅ F n) :
    (Eq.mpr (congrArg (fun k ↦ A ≅ F k) h) (e ≪≫ g)).hom =
      e.hom ≫ (Eq.mpr (congrArg (fun k ↦ B ≅ F k) h) g).hom
proof:
:= by
  subst n
  rfl

private lemma eqMpr_isoTrans_hom_precomp
    {C : Type v} [Category.{w} C] {ι : Type*} (F : ι → C)
    {m n : ι} (h : m = n) {D A B : C} (f : D ⟶ A)
    (e : A ≅ B) (g : B ≅ F n) :
    f ≫ (Eq.mpr (congrArg (fun k ↦ A ≅ F k) h) (e ≪≫ g)).hom =
      (f ≫ e.hom) ≫
        (Eq.mpr (congrArg (fun k ↦ B ≅ F k) h) g).hom
proof:
:= by
  subst n
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.determinantLocalChartCore_hom_unitTopWedgeFintype
statement:
private lemma determinantLocalChartCore_hom_unitTopWedgeFintype
    (E : X.Modules) (q : E.LocalGeneratorsData)
    [q.IsLocallyFreeData] [q.IsFiniteType]
    (i : q.I) [instF : Fintype (q.generators i).I]
    [instL : LinearOrder (q.generators i).I]
    (hF : instF = determinantLocalIndexFintype X E q i)
    (hL : instL = determinantLocalIndexLinearOrder X E q i) :
    let U
proof:
:= q.X i
    let T : (Over U)ᵒᵖ := op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))
    let zCard : (SchemeKTheory.exteriorPowerSheaf X E
        (Fintype.card (q.generators i).I)).val.obj (op U) :=
      (((SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app
        (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower E.val
          (Fintype.card (q.generators i).I))).app (op U)).hom
          (determinantLocalChartTopWedgeFintype X E q i)
    let chart := determinantLocalChartCore X E q i
      (Fintype.card (q.generators i).I)
    (((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
      (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)).homEquiv _ _ chart.hom).app T).hom
        (determinantLocalChartFreeTopWedgeFintype X E q i) = zCard := by
  classical
  subst instF
  subst instL
  letI : Fintype (q.generators i).I :=
    determinantLocalIndexFintype X E q i
  letI : LinearOrder (q.generators i).I :=
    determinantLocalIndexLinearOrder X E q i
  let comparison : (Σ n : ℕ, Fin n ≃ (q.generators i).I) → Prop := fun p ↦
    (((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
      (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over (q.X i)).obj)).homEquiv _ _
        (determinantLocalChartCore X E q i p.1).hom).app
          (op (Over.mk (𝟙 (q.X i))))).hom
          (determinantLocalChartFreeWedgeAt X E q i p.1 p.2) =
      (((SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app
        (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower E.val p.1)).app (op (q.X i))).hom
          (determinantLocalChartWedgeAt X E q i p.1 p.2)
  have hchart := SchemeKTheory.determinantLocalChartMap_hom_unit_topWedge
    X E q i
  dsimp only at hchart
  have hnat : comparison
      ⟨Nat.card (q.generators i).I,
        SchemeKTheory.determinantLocalChartIndexEquiv X E q i⟩ := by
    exact hchart
  have hp :
      (⟨Nat.card (q.generators i).I,
          SchemeKTheory.determinantLocalChartIndexEquiv X E q i⟩ :
          Σ n : ℕ, Fin n ≃ (q.generators i).I) =
        ⟨Fintype.card (q.generators i).I,
          ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerIndexEquiv
            (q.generators i).I⟩ := by
    have hcard : Nat.card (q.generators i).I =
        Fintype.card (q.generators i).I := Nat.card_eq_fintype_card
    apply Sigma.ext hcard
    let e := ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerIndexEquiv
      (q.generators i).I
    change HEq ((finCongr hcard).trans e) e
    exact (@eqRec_heq ℕ (fun n ↦ Fin n ≃ (q.generators i).I)
      _ _ hcard ((finCongr hcard).trans e)).symm.trans
        (heq_of_eq (eqRec_finCongr_trans hcard e))
  change comparison
    ⟨Fintype.card (q.generators i).I,
      ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerIndexEquiv (q.generators i).I⟩
  exact hp ▸ hnat

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.determinantLocalChartAtRank_hom_unitTopWedge
statement:
private lemma determinantLocalChartAtRank_hom_unitTopWedge
    (E : X.Modules) (q : E.LocalGeneratorsData)
    [q.IsLocallyFreeData] [q.IsFiniteType]
    (i : q.I) [instF : Fintype (q.generators i).I]
    [instL : LinearOrder (q.generators i).I]
    (hF : instF = determinantLocalIndexFintype X E q i)
    (hL : instL = determinantLocalIndexLinearOrder X E q i)
    (r : ℕ) (hrank : r = Fintype.card (q.generators i).I) :
    let U
proof:
:= q.X i
    let T : (Over U)ᵒᵖ := op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))
    let zCard : (SchemeKTheory.exteriorPowerSheaf X E
        (Fintype.card (q.generators i).I)).val.obj (op U) :=
      (((SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app
        (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower E.val
          (Fintype.card (q.generators i).I))).app (op U)).hom
          (determinantLocalChartTopWedgeFintype X E q i)
    let z : (SchemeKTheory.exteriorPowerSheaf X E r).val.obj (op U) :=
      Eq.mpr
        (congrArg (fun k ↦
          ModuleCat.carrier
            ((SchemeKTheory.exteriorPowerSheaf X E k).val.obj (op U))) hrank)
        zCard
    let chart := determinantLocalChartAtRank X E q i r hrank
    (((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
      (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over U).obj)).homEquiv _ _ chart.hom).app T).hom
        (determinantLocalChartFreeTopWedgeFintype X E q i) = z := by
  classical
  subst r
  dsimp only
  exact determinantLocalChartCore_hom_unitTopWedgeFintype X E q i hF hL

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.determinantLocalFrame_hom_factor
statement:
private lemma determinantLocalFrame_hom_factor
    (E : X.Modules) (q : E.LocalGeneratorsData)
    [q.IsLocallyFreeData] [q.IsFiniteType]
    (i : q.I) {x : X} (hxi : x ∈ q.X i)
    (hrank : genericRank X E =
      @Fintype.card (q.generators i).I
        (determinantLocalIndexFintype X E q i)) :
    letI : Fintype (q.generators i).I
proof:
:=
      determinantLocalIndexFintype X E q i
    (SchemeKTheory.determinantLocalFrame X E q ⟨i, ⟨x, hxi⟩⟩).hom =
      (SchemeKTheory.exteriorPowerSheafOverFreeIsoFreePUnit X (q.X i)
        (q.generators i).I).inv ≫
      (determinantLocalTransportedChart X E q i hrank).hom := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  letI : Fintype (q.generators i).I :=
    determinantLocalIndexFintype X E q i
  exact eqMpr_isoTrans_hom
    (fun k ↦ (SchemeKTheory.exteriorPowerSheaf X E k).over (q.X i))
    hrank
    (SchemeKTheory.exteriorPowerSheafOverFreeIsoFreePUnit X (q.X i)
      (q.generators i).I).symm
    (determinantLocalChartCore X E q i (Fintype.card (q.generators i).I))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.determinantLocalFrame_hom_factor_precomp
statement:
private lemma determinantLocalFrame_hom_factor_precomp
    (E : X.Modules) (q : E.LocalGeneratorsData)
    [q.IsLocallyFreeData] [q.IsFiniteType]
    (i : q.I) {x : X} (hxi : x ∈ q.X i)
    (hrank : genericRank X E =
      @Fintype.card (q.generators i).I
        (determinantLocalIndexFintype X E q i)) :
    letI : Fintype (q.generators i).I
proof:
:=
      determinantLocalIndexFintype X E q i
    (SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X (q.X i) PUnit).inv ≫
        (SchemeKTheory.determinantLocalFrame X E q
          ⟨i, ⟨x, hxi⟩⟩).hom =
      ((SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X (q.X i) PUnit).inv ≫
          (SchemeKTheory.exteriorPowerSheafOverFreeIsoFreePUnit
            X (q.X i) (q.generators i).I).inv) ≫
        (determinantLocalTransportedChart X E q i hrank).hom := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  letI : Fintype (q.generators i).I :=
    determinantLocalIndexFintype X E q i
  exact eqMpr_isoTrans_hom_precomp
    (fun k ↦ (SchemeKTheory.exteriorPowerSheaf X E k).over (q.X i))
    hrank
    (SchemeKTheory.freeOverIso X (q.X i) PUnit).inv
    (SchemeKTheory.exteriorPowerSheafOverFreeIsoFreePUnit X (q.X i)
      (q.generators i).I).symm
    (determinantLocalChartCore X E q i (Fintype.card (q.generators i).I))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.determinantLocalTransportedChart_hom_unitTopWedgeRaw
statement:
private lemma determinantLocalTransportedChart_hom_unitTopWedgeRaw
    (E : X.Modules) (q : E.LocalGeneratorsData)
    [q.IsLocallyFreeData] [q.IsFiniteType]
    (i : q.I) [instF : Fintype (q.generators i).I]
    [instL : LinearOrder (q.generators i).I]
    (hF : instF = determinantLocalIndexFintype X E q i)
    (hL : instL = determinantLocalIndexLinearOrder X E q i)
    (hrank : genericRank X E = Fintype.card (q.generators i).I) :
    (((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
      (𝟙 (X.ringCatSheaf.over (q.X i)).obj)).homEquiv _ _
        (determinantLocalTransportedChart X E q i hrank).hom).app
          (op (Over.mk (𝟙 (q.X i))))).hom
        (determinantLocalChartFreeTopWedgeFintype X E q i) =
      (((SchemeKTheory.moduleSheafificationAdjunction X).unit.app
        (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower E.val
          (genericRank X E))).app (op (q.X i))).hom
        (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.mk (fun j ↦
          ((q.generators i).s
            (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerIndexEquiv
              (q.generators i).I (finCongr hrank j))).eval
                (op (Over.mk (𝟙 (q.X i))))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h := determinantLocalChartAtRank_hom_unitTopWedge
    X E q i hF hL (genericRank X E) hrank
  dsimp only at h
  let aCard : Fin (Fintype.card (q.generators i).I) →
      E.val.obj (op (q.X i)) := fun j ↦
    ((q.generators i).s
      (ModuleCat.exteriorPower.topExteriorPowerIndexEquiv
        (q.generators i).I j)).eval (op (Over.mk (𝟙 (q.X i))))
  have htop :
      determinantLocalChartTopWedgeFintype X E q i =
        (show
          (PresheafOfModules.exteriorPower
            (SchemeKTheory.underlyingCommPresheafOverForExteriorPower
              X (q.X i) (E.over (q.X i)))
            (Fintype.card (q.generators i).I)).obj

theorem genericStalkToModuleFiber_toStalk (F : X.Modules) :
    genericStalkToModuleFiber X F ≫ genericPointModuleFiberToStalk X F = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply TopCat.Presheaf.stalk_hom_ext
  intro U hηU
  have hgi : TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf U (genericPoint X) hηU ≫
        genericStalkToModuleFiber X F =
      (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology (genericPoint X)).toPresheafFiber
        U ⟨⟨hηU⟩⟩ F.val.presheaf := by
    apply colimit.ι_desc
  simpa only [Category.comp_id] using
    (calc
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf U (genericPoint X) hηU ≫
            (genericStalkToModuleFiber X F ≫ genericPointModuleFiberToStalk X F) =
          (TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf U (genericPoint X) hηU ≫
            genericStalkToModuleFiber X F) ≫ genericPointModuleFiberToStalk X F :=
        (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology (genericPoint X)).toPresheafFiber
            U ⟨⟨hηU⟩⟩ F.val.presheaf ≫ genericPointModuleFiberToStalk X F :=
        congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ genericPointModuleFiberToStalk X F) hgi
      _ = TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf U (genericPoint X) hηU :=
        toPresheafFiber_genericPointModuleFiberToStalk X F U hηU)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericPointModuleFiberToStalk_toFiber
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem genericPointModuleFiberToStalk_toFiber (F : X.Modules) :
    genericPointModuleFiberToStalk X F ≫ genericStalkToModuleFiber X F = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology (genericPoint X)).presheafFiber_hom_ext
  intro U x
  let x' : (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology (genericPoint X)).fiber.obj U :=
    ⟨⟨x.down.down⟩⟩
  have hx : x = x' := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hgi' : TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf U (genericPoint X) x.down.down ≫
        genericStalkToModuleFiber X F =
      (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology (genericPoint X)).toPresheafFiber
        U x' F.val.presheaf := by
    apply colimit.ι_desc
  have hgi : TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf U (genericPoint X) x.down.down ≫
        genericStalkToModuleFiber X F =
      (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology (genericPoint X)).toPresheafFiber
        U x F.val.presheaf := by
    rw [hx]
    exact hgi'
  have hcomp' :=
    toPresheafFiber_genericPointModuleFiberToStalk X F U x.down.down
  have hcomp :
      (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology (genericPoint X)).toPresheafFiber
            U x F.val.presheaf ≫ genericPointModuleFiberToStalk X F =
        TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf U (genericPoint X) x.down.down := by
    rw [hx]
    exact hcomp'
  simpa only [Category.comp_id] using
    (calc
      (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology (genericPoint X)).toPresheafFiber
            U x F.val.presheaf ≫
          (genericPointModuleFiberToStalk X F ≫ genericStalkToModuleFiber X F) =
        ((Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology (genericPoint X)).toPresheafFiber
            U x F.val.presheaf ≫ genericPointModuleFiberToStalk X F) ≫
          genericStalkToModuleFiber X F := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf U (genericPoint X) x.down.down ≫
          genericStalkToModuleFiber X F :=
        congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ genericStalkToModuleFiber X F) hcomp
      _ = (Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology (genericPoint X)).toPresheafFiber
          U x F.val.presheaf := hgi)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericValueToSkyscraperFiber_toValue
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem genericValueToSkyscraperFiber_toValue (M : AddCommGrpCat.{u}) :
    genericValueToSkyscraperFiber X M ≫ genericSkyscraperFiberToValue X M = 𝟙 M
proof:
:= by
  let Φ := Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology (genericPoint X)
  let x : Φ.fiber.obj (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.Opens X) := ⟨⟨trivial⟩⟩
  let sec : M ⟶ (Φ.skyscraperPresheaf M).obj
      (op (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.Opens X)) :=
    Pi.lift (fun _ : Φ.fiber.obj (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.Opens X) => 𝟙 M)
  have heval := Φ.toPresheafFiber_skyscraperPresheafHomEquiv_symm
    (𝟙 (Φ.skyscraperPresheaf M)) (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.Opens X) x
  have heval' := heval
  simp only [NatTrans.id_app, Category.id_comp] at heval'
  change (sec ≫ Φ.toPresheafFiber (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.Opens X) x
      (Φ.skyscraperPresheaf M)) ≫
        Φ.skyscraperPresheafHomEquiv.symm (𝟙 _) = 𝟙 M
  calc
    _ = sec ≫ (Φ.toPresheafFiber (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.Opens X) x
        (Φ.skyscraperPresheaf M) ≫
          Φ.skyscraperPresheafHomEquiv.symm (𝟙 _)) := Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = sec ≫ _ :=
      congrArg (fun q => sec ≫ q) heval'
    _ = 𝟙 M := by
      dsimp only [sec]
      exact Pi.lift_π (fun _ : Φ.fiber.obj (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.Opens X) => 𝟙 M) x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.genericSkyscraperFiberToValue_valueToFiber
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem genericSkyscraperFiberToValue_valueToFiber (M : AddCommGrpCat.{u}) :
    genericSkyscraperFiberToValue X M ≫ genericValueToSkyscraperFiber X M = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  let Φ := Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology (genericPoint X)
  apply Φ.presheafFiber_hom_ext
  intro U y
  let x : Φ.fiber.obj (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.Opens X) := ⟨⟨trivial⟩⟩
  let sec : M ⟶ (Φ.skyscraperPresheaf M).obj
      (op (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.Opens X)) :=
    Pi.lift (fun _ : Φ.fiber.obj (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.Opens X) => 𝟙 M)
  let f : U ⟶ (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.Opens X) := homOfLE le_top
  let proj : (Φ.skyscraperPresheaf M).obj (op U) ⟶ M :=
    Pi.π (fun _ : Φ.fiber.obj U => M) y
  have heval := Φ.toPresheafFiber_skyscraperPresheafHomEquiv_symm
    (𝟙 (Φ.skyscraperPresheaf M)) U y
  have heval' := heval
  simp only [NatTrans.id_app, Category.id_comp] at heval'
  have heval'' :
      Φ.toPresheafFiber U y (Φ.skyscraperPresheaf M) ≫
          Φ.skyscraperPresheafHomEquiv.symm (𝟙 _) = proj := heval'
  have hres :
      (proj ≫ sec) ≫ (Φ.skyscraperPresheaf M).map f.op =
        𝟙 ((Φ.skyscraperPresheaf M).obj (op U)) := by
    apply Pi.hom_ext (f := fun _ : Φ.fiber.obj U => M)
    intro z
    have hzy : z = y := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [hzy]
    change (((proj ≫ sec) ≫
        Pi.map' (Φ.fiber.map f) (fun _ : Φ.fiber.obj U => 𝟙 M)) ≫
          Pi.π (fun _ : Φ.fiber.obj U => M) y) =
      (𝟙 ((Φ.skyscraperPresheaf M).obj (op U))) ≫
        Pi.π (fun _ : Φ.fiber.obj U => M) y
    have hsec : sec ≫ Pi.π
        (fun _ : Φ.fiber.obj (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.Opens X) => M)
          (Φ.fiber.map f y) = 𝟙 M := by
      dsimp only [sec]
      exact Pi.lift_π
        (fun _ : Φ.fiber.obj (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.Opens X) => 𝟙 M) (Φ.fiber.map f y)
    simpa only [Category.id_comp] using
      (calc
        ((proj ≫ sec) ≫ Pi.map' (Φ.fiber.map f) (fun _ => 𝟙 M)) ≫
              Pi.π (fun _ : Φ.fiber.obj U => M) y =
            (proj ≫ sec) ≫
              (Pi.map' (Φ.fiber.map f) (fun _ => 𝟙 M) ≫
                Pi.π (fun _ : Φ.fiber.obj U => M) y) := Category.assoc _ _ _
        _ = (proj ≫ sec) ≫
              (Pi.π (fun _ : Φ.fiber.obj (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.Opens X) => M)
                (Φ.fiber.map f y) ≫ 𝟙 M) :=
          congrArg (fun q => (proj ≫ sec) ≫ q)
            (Pi.map'_comp_π
              (f := fun _ : Φ.fiber.obj (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.Opens X) => M)
              (g := fun _ : Φ.fiber.obj U => M)
              (Φ.fiber.map f) (fun _ : Φ.fiber.obj U => 𝟙 M) y)
        _ = proj ≫
              (sec ≫ Pi.π
                (fun _ : Φ.fiber.obj (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.Opens X) => M)
                  (Φ.fiber.map f y)) := by simp only [Category.assoc, Category.comp_id]
        _ = proj ≫ 𝟙 M := congrArg (fun q => proj ≫ q) hsec
        _ = proj := Category.comp_id _
        _ = Pi.π (fun _ : Φ.fiber.obj U => M) y := rfl)
  have hw := Φ.toPresheafFiber_w f y (Φ.skyscraperPresheaf M)
  have hx : Φ.fiber.map f y = x := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [hx] at hw
  change Φ.toPresheafFiber U y (Φ.skyscraperPresheaf M) ≫
      (Φ.skyscraperPresheafHomEquiv.symm (𝟙 _) ≫
        (sec ≫ Φ.toPresheafFiber (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.Opens X) x
          (Φ.skyscraperPresheaf M))) =
    Φ.toPresheafFiber U y (Φ.skyscraperPresheaf M) ≫ 𝟙 _
  simpa only [Category.comp_id] using
    (calc
      Φ.toPresheafFiber U y (Φ.skyscraperPresheaf M) ≫
          (Φ.skyscraperPresheafHomEquiv.symm (𝟙 _) ≫
            (sec ≫ Φ.toPresheafFiber (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.Opens X) x
              (Φ.skyscraperPresheaf M))) =
        ((Φ.toPresheafFiber U y (Φ.skyscraperPresheaf M) ≫
          Φ.skyscraperPresheafHomEquiv.symm (𝟙 _)) ≫ sec) ≫
            Φ.toPresheafFiber (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.Opens X) x
              (Φ.skyscraperPresheaf M) := by simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = (proj ≫ sec) ≫
            Φ.toPresheafFiber (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.Opens X) x
              (Φ.skyscraperPresheaf M) :=
        congrArg (fun q => (q ≫ sec) ≫
          Φ.toPresheafFiber (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.Opens X) x
            (Φ.skyscraperPresheaf M)) heval''
      _ = (proj ≫ sec) ≫
          ((Φ.skyscraperPresheaf M).map f.op ≫
            Φ.toPresheafFiber U y (Φ.skyscraperPresheaf M)) :=
        congrArg (fun q => (proj ≫ sec) ≫ q) hw.symm
      _ = ((proj ≫ sec) ≫
          (Φ.skyscraperPresheaf M).map f.op) ≫
            Φ.toPresheafFiber U y (Φ.skyscraperPresheaf M) :=
        (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = Φ.toPresheafFiber U y (Φ.skyscraperPresheaf M) := by rw [hres, Category.id_comp])

name: AlgebraicGeometry.SingularCurve.toGenericStalkSheafStalk_iso_hom
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem toGenericStalkSheafStalk_iso_hom (F : X.Modules) :
    toGenericStalkSheafStalk X F ≫ (genericStalkSheafStalkIso X F).hom = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  let Φ := Opens.pointGrothendieckTopology (genericPoint X)
  let G := genericStalkSheaf X F
  let S := AddCommGrpCat.of
    ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf (genericPoint X))
  let g := ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).map
    (toGenericStalkSheaf X F)).hom
  change toGenericStalkSheafStalk X F ≫
      (genericStalkToModuleFiber X G ≫ genericSkyscraperFiberToValue X S) = 𝟙 _
  apply TopCat.Presheaf.stalk_hom_ext
  intro U hηU
  let x : Φ.fiber.obj U := ⟨⟨hηU⟩⟩
  have hmap := TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ U (genericPoint X) hηU g
  have htargetFiber :
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ G.val.presheaf U (genericPoint X) hηU ≫
          genericStalkToModuleFiber X G =
        Φ.toPresheafFiber U x G.val.presheaf := by
    apply colimit.ι_desc
  let proj : G.val.presheaf.obj (op U) ⟶ S :=
    Pi.π (fun _ : Φ.fiber.obj U => S) x
  have heval := Φ.toPresheafFiber_skyscraperPresheafHomEquiv_symm
    (𝟙 (Φ.skyscraperPresheaf S)) U x
  have heval' := heval
  simp only [NatTrans.id_app, Category.id_comp] at heval'
  have htargetEval :
      Φ.toPresheafFiber U x G.val.presheaf ≫
          genericSkyscraperFiberToValue X S = proj := by
    change Φ.toPresheafFiber U x (Φ.skyscraperPresheaf S) ≫
        Φ.skyscraperPresheafHomEquiv.symm (𝟙 _) = proj
    exact heval'
  have hmapEval :
      g.app (op U) ≫ proj =
        Φ.toPresheafFiber U x F.val.presheaf ≫
          genericPointModuleFiberToStalk X F := by
    change (Φ.skyscraperPresheafHomEquiv
        (genericPointModuleFiberToStalk X F)).app (op U) ≫
          Pi.π (fun _ : Φ.fiber.obj U => S) x = _
    exact Φ.skyscraperPresheafHomEquiv_app_π
      (genericPointModuleFiberToStalk X F) U x
  have hcombine :
      g.app (op U) ≫
          (Φ.toPresheafFiber U x G.val.presheaf ≫
            genericSkyscraperFiberToValue X S) =
        Φ.toPresheafFiber U x F.val.presheaf ≫
          genericPointModuleFiberToStalk X F := by
    exact (congrArg (fun q => g.app (op U) ≫ q) htargetEval).trans hmapEval
  have htail :
      g.app (op U) ≫
          ((TopCat.Presheaf.germ G.val.presheaf U (genericPoint X) hηU ≫
            genericStalkToModuleFiber X G) ≫ genericSkyscraperFiberToValue X S) =
        TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf U (genericPoint X) hηU := by
    exact (congrArg (fun q => g.app (op U) ≫
      (q ≫ genericSkyscraperFiberToValue X S)) htargetFiber).trans
        (hcombine.trans (toPresheafFiber_genericPointModuleFiberToStalk X F U hηU))
  have htail' :
      ((g.app (op U) ≫
          TopCat.Presheaf.germ G.val.presheaf U (genericPoint X) hηU) ≫
            genericStalkToModuleFiber X G) ≫ genericSkyscraperFiberToValue X S =
        TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf U (genericPoint X) hηU := by
    calc
      _ = g.app (op U) ≫
          ((TopCat.Presheaf.germ G.val.presheaf U (genericPoint X) hηU ≫
            genericStalkToModuleFiber X G) ≫ genericSkyscraperFiberToValue X S) := by
        simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = _ := htail
  simpa only [Category.comp_id] using
    (calc
      TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf U (genericPoint X) hηU ≫
          (toGenericStalkSheafStalk X F ≫
            (genericStalkToModuleFiber X G ≫ genericSkyscraperFiberToValue X S)) =
        ((TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf U (genericPoint X) hηU ≫
          toGenericStalkSheafStalk X F) ≫ genericStalkToModuleFiber X G) ≫
            genericSkyscraperFiberToValue X S := by simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf U (genericPoint X) hηU :=
        (congrArg (fun q => (q ≫ genericStalkToModuleFiber X G) ≫
          genericSkyscraperFiberToValue X S) hmap).trans htail')
